name: Matrix.IsNonsingularMMatrix.det_pos
statement:
theorem IsNonsingularMMatrix.det_pos {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsNonsingularMMatrix) :
    0 < A.det
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := hA.exists_positive_certificate
  let T : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ := fun t => (1 - t) • 1 + t • A
  have hTunit (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : IsUnit (T t) := by
    have hTZ : (T t).IsZMatrix := by
      intro i j hij
      simpa only [T, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hij, if_false,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_add] using mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht.1 (hA.1 i j hij)
    apply (hTZ.isNonsingularMMatrix_of_positive_certificate hx (fun i => ?_)).2.1
    have he : (T t *ᵥ x) i = (1 - t) * x i + t * (A *ᵥ x) i := by
      change (((1 - t) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) + t • A) *ᵥ x) i = _
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
      rfl
    rw [he]
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · simp only [ht0, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact hx i
    · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) (hx i).le)
        (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne ht.1 (Ne.symm ht0)) (hAx i))
  have hdet (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (T t).det ≠ 0 :=
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (hTunit t ht)).ne_zero
  have hc : Continuous (fun t => (T t).det) := by fun_prop
  by_contra! hle
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((T 1).det) ((T 0).det) := by
    change (T 1).det ≤ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (T 0).det
    simpa only [T, sub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add, sub_zero, add_zero,
      Matrix.det_one] using And.intro hle zero_le_one
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' zero_le_one hc.continuousOn hzero
  exact hdet t ht hz

name: Matrix.IsNonsingularMMatrix.principal_minor_pos
proof:
:=
  (hA.submatrix _ Subtype.val_injective).det_pos

name: Matrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_principal_minors_pos
statement:
theorem isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_principal_minors_pos {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) :
    A.IsNonsingularMMatrix ↔ ∀ S : Finset ι,
      0 < (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → ι) (Subtype.val : S → ι)).det
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hM => hM.principal_minor_pos, fun hminor => ?_⟩
  have hdet : 0 < A.det := by
    let e : (Finset.univ : Finset ι) ≃ ι := Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv (fun _ => mem_univ _)
    have h := hminor Finset.univ
    change 0 < (A.submatrix e e).det at h
    simpa only [Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self] using h
  have hcoeff (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
      0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * A.charpoly.coeff (Fintype.card ι - k) := by
    rw [NLAlib.signed_charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_principal_minors A k hk]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun S _ => (hminor S).le
  obtain ⟨s, B, _, hB, hAB⟩ := hA.exists_positive_shift_nonnegative
  obtain ⟨p, _, hs, he⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector hB
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hs
  let aRoot := s - (spectralRadius ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
  have hAp : A *ᵥ p = aRoot • p := by
    rw [hAB, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, he, sub_smul]
  have hroot : A.charpoly.eval aRoot = 0 :=
    (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp (mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hpne hAp)).eq_zero
  have hrootpos : 0 < aRoot := by
    by_contra! hle
    by_cases hz : aRoot = 0
    · have hunit : IsUnit A := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet.ne')
      have hzero : A *ᵥ p = 0 := by rw [hAp, hz, zero_smul]
      exact hpne (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hunit (hzero.trans (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm))
    · have hneg : aRoot < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hz
      have hc (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
          0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card ι - j) * A.charpoly.coeff j := by
        simpa only [Nat.sub_sub_self hj] using hcoeff (Fintype.card ι - j) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
      have hpos := NLAlib.mul_eval_neg_pos_of_signed_coeff_nonneg A.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim
        A.charpoly_monic hc (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
      simp only [neg_neg, hroot, mul_zero, lt_self_iff_false] at hpos
  exact (isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_exists_shift_above_spectralRadius hA).mpr
    ⟨s, B, hB, hAB, sub_pos.mp hrootpos⟩

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.submatrix
statement:
theorem IsZMatrix.submatrix {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix)
    (e : κ → ι) (he : Function.Injective e) : (A.submatrix e e).IsZMatrix
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact hA (e i) (e j) (fun h => hij (he h))

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.positive_certificate_submatrix
statement:
theorem IsZMatrix.positive_certificate_submatrix {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix)
    {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hAx : ∀ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ x) i)
    (e : κ → ι) (he : Function.Injective e) :
    ∀ i, 0 < (A.submatrix e e *ᵥ (x ∘ e)) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i
  have hsum : (A *ᵥ x) (e i) ≤ (A.submatrix e e *ᵥ (x ∘ e)) i := by
    change (∑ j : ι, A (e i) j * x j) ≤ ∑ j : κ, A (e i) (e j) * x (e j)
    have himg : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.image e, A (e i) j * x j) =
        ∑ j : κ, A (e i) (e j) * x (e j) :=
      Finset.sum_image (fun j _ k _ h => he h)
    rw [← himg]
    have hh : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.image e, -(A (e i) j * x j)) ≤
        ∑ j : ι, -(A (e i) j * x j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      intro j _ hj
      apply neg_nonneg.mpr
      apply mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      · apply hA
        intro hij
        exact hj (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ i, hij⟩)
      · exact (hx j).le
    simpa only [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_le_neg_iff] using hh
  exact (hAx (e i)).trans_le hsum

name: Matrix.IsNonsingularMMatrix.submatrix
statement:
theorem IsNonsingularMMatrix.submatrix {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsNonsingularMMatrix)
    (e : κ → ι) (he : Function.Injective e) :
    (A.submatrix e e).IsNonsingularMMatrix
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := hA.exists_positive_certificate
  exact (hA.1.submatrix e he).isNonsingularMMatrix_of_positive_certificate
    (fun i => hx (e i)) (hA.1.positive_certificate_submatrix hx hAx e he)

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.pos_of_nonnegative_eigenvector
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hpne
  have hpj : 0 < p j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp j) hj.symm
  intro i
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hki⟩ := (isIrreducible_iff_exists_pow_pos hA.nonneg).mp hA i j
  have hpos : 0 < (A ^ k *ᵥ p) i := (mul_pos hki hpj).trans_le
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ => mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA.nonneg k i l) (hp l))
      (mem_univ j))
  by_contra hi
  have hz : p i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hi) (hp i)
  rw [pow_mulVec_eq_pow_smul_of_mulVec_eq_smul heig, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hz, mul_zero] at hpos
  exact (lt_irrefl _ hpos)

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.eigenspace_eq_span_of_positive_eigenvector
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.eigenspace_eq_span_of_positive_eigenvector
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) {p : ι → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (heig : A *ᵥ p = r • p) :
    Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' r = ℝ ∙ p
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hxEig : A *ᵥ x = r • x := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ (fun k => x k / p k)
      Finset.univ_nonempty
    let a := x i / p i
    let v := x - a • p
    have hv (j : ι) : 0 ≤ v j := sub_nonneg.mpr
      ((le_div_iff₀ (hp j)).mp (hi j (mem_univ j)))
    have hvi : v i = 0 := by
      dsimp [v, a]
      field_simp [(hp i).ne']
      ring
    have hvEig : A *ᵥ v = r • v := by
      simp only [v, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hxEig, heig, smul_sub, smul_smul]
      rw [mul_comm r a]
    have hv0 : v = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hpos := hA.pos_of_nonnegative_eigenvector hv hne hvEig i
      rw [hvi] at hpos
      exact (lt_irrefl _ hpos)
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨a, (sub_eq_zero.mp hv0).symm⟩
  · apply (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem p _).mpr
    exact Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr heig

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.exists_positive_perron_pair
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.exists_positive_perron_pair {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p q : ι → ℝ,
      0 < (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < q i) ∧ (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, q i = 1) ∧
      A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p ∧
      q ᵥ* A = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpsum, heig⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector hA.nonneg
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqsum, hqeig⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector hA.transpose.nonneg
  have hspec : spectrum ℂ (Aᵀ.map Complex.ofReal) = spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) := by
    ext μ
    change μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)ᵀ ↔ _
    simp only [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_transpose]
  have hradii : spectralRadius ℂ (Aᵀ.map Complex.ofReal) =
      spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) := by simp only [spectralRadius, hspec]
  rw [hradii] at hqeig
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hpsum
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hqsum
  have hpp := hA.pos_of_nonnegative_eigenvector hp hpne heig
  have hqq := hA.transpose.pos_of_nonnegative_eigenvector hq hqne hqeig
  have hentry : ∃ i j, A i j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hAne (funext fun i => funext fun j => h i j)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := hentry
  have hpos : 0 < (A *ᵥ p) i :=
    (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hA.nonneg i j) hij.symm) (hpp j)).trans_le
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hA.nonneg i k) (hp k)) (mem_univ j))
  have hrpos : 0 < (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal := by
    rw [heig] at hpos
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right (hpp i)).mp hpos
  exact ⟨p, q, hrpos, hpp, hqq, hpsum, hqsum, heig, by
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_transpose] using hqeig⟩

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.rootMultiplicity_perron_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, _, hp, hq, _, _, hAp, hqA⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := hp (Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›)
    rw [hz] at h
    exact lt_irrefl _ h
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin'
      (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal) = 1 := by
    rw [hA.eigenspace_eq_span_of_positive_eigenvector hp hAp, finrank_span_singleton hpne]
  have hpair : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ p := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hp i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  exact NLAlib.rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one_of_pairing_ne_zero
    hAp hqA hdim hpair.ne'

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.rootMultiplicity_perron_complexification_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.rootMultiplicity_perron_complexification_eq_one
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly.rootMultiplicity
      ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = A.charpoly.map Complex.ofRealHom :=
    Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
  rw [hmap]
  have hroot := Polynomial.eq_rootMultiplicity_map (p := A.charpoly) (f := Complex.ofRealHom)
    Complex.ofReal_injective (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
  exact hroot.symm.trans (hA.rootMultiplicity_perron_eq_one hAne)

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.nonnegative_eigenvector_eq_pos_smul
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.nonnegative_eigenvector_eq_pos_smul
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0)
    {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p)
    {v : ι → ℝ} {μ : ℝ} (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) (hvne : v ≠ 0)
    (hAv : A *ᵥ v = μ • v) :
    μ = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ v = c • p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, q, _, _, hq, _, _, _, hqA⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  have hvpos := hA.pos_of_nonnegative_eigenvector hv hvne hAv
  have hpair : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ v := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hvpos i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have heq : μ * (q ⬝ᵥ v) = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal * (q ⬝ᵥ v) := by
    calc
      _ = q ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) := by rw [hAv, dotProduct_smul]; rfl
      _ = (q ᵥ* A) ⬝ᵥ v := Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [hqA, smul_dotProduct]; rfl
  have hμ := (mul_right_cancel₀ hpair.ne') heq
  refine ⟨hμ, ?_⟩
  have hmem : v ∈ Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin'
      (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal :=
    Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (by
      change A *ᵥ v = _
      rw [hAv, hμ])
  rw [hA.eigenspace_eq_span_of_positive_eigenvector hp hAp] at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    let i : ι := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›
    have hvi := hvpos i
    rw [← hc] at hvi
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right (hp i)).mp hvi
  exact ⟨c, hcpos, hc.symm⟩

name: Matrix.perron_projector_pos_idempotent_and_commutes
statement:
theorem perron_projector_pos_idempotent_and_commutes
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {p q : ι → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = r • p) (hqA : q ᵥ* A = r • q) :
    let P
proof:
:= (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q
    (∀ i j, 0 < P i j) ∧ P * P = P ∧ A * P = r • P ∧ P * A = r • P := by
  have hpair : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ p := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hp i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨fun i j => ?_, NLAlib.normalized_vecMulVec_mul_self hpair.ne',
    NLAlib.mul_normalized_vecMulVec_eq_smul hAp hqA⟩
  exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpair) (mul_pos (hp i) (hq j))

name: Matrix.norm_eigenvalue_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution
statement:
theorem norm_eigenvalue_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hBA : ∀ i j, norm (B i j) ≤ A i j)
    {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) {r : ℝ}
    (hAp : ∀ i, (A *ᵥ p) i ≤ r * p i)
    {μ : ℂ} {z : ι → ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hBz : B *ᵥ z = μ • z) : ‖μ‖ ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz
  have hzj : 0 < ‖z j‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hj
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun k => ‖z k‖ / p k)
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  let t : ℝ := ‖z i‖ / p i
  have ht : 0 < t := (div_pos hzj (hp j)).trans_le (hi j (mem_univ j))
  have hzi : ‖z i‖ = t * p i := by
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp [(hp i).ne']
  have hzle (k : ι) : ‖z k‖ ≤ t * p k :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (hp k)).mp (hi k (mem_univ k))
  have hAi (k : ι) : 0 ≤ A i k := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hBA i k)
  have hnorm : ‖μ‖ * ‖z i‖ ≤ t * (r * p i) := by
    calc
      ‖μ‖ * ‖z i‖ = ‖(B *ᵥ z) i‖ := by rw [hBz]; simp
      _ ≤ ∑ k, ‖B i k * z k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ = ∑ k, ‖B i k‖ * ‖z k‖ := by simp only [norm_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ k, A i k * (t * p k) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
        mul_le_mul (hBA i k) (hzle k) (norm_nonneg _) (hAi k)
      _ = t * (A *ᵥ p) i := by
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        funext k
        ring
      _ ≤ t * (r * p i) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hAp i) ht.le
  rw [hzi] at hnorm
  have htp : 0 < t * p i := mul_pos ht (hp i)
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ htp).mp (by nlinarith [hnorm])

name: Matrix.spectralRadius_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hBA : ∀ i j, norm (B i j) ≤ A i j)
    {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) {r : ℝ}
    (hAp : ∀ i, (A *ᵥ p) i ≤ r * p i) :
    spectralRadius ℂ B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralRadius
  apply iSup₂_le
  intro μ hμ
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hBz⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hnorm := norm_eigenvalue_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution hBA hp hAp hz hBz
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hnorm

name: Matrix.mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hA i k) (hB k j)

name: Matrix.inverse_fromBlocks_bottomRight_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem inverse_fromBlocks_bottomRight_of_isUnit
    (E : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (F : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (G : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (H : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (hE : IsUnit E) (hA : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)⁻¹.toBlocks₂₂ = (H - G * E⁻¹ * F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let := E.invertibleOfIsUnitDet ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det E).mp hE)
  have hS : IsUnit (H - G * E⁻¹ * F) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] using
      Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₁₁.mp hA
  let := (H - G * E⁻¹ * F).invertibleOfIsUnitDet
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)
  let := (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H).invertibleOfIsUnitDet
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA)
  have h := Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks₁₁_eq E F G H
  simp only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] at h
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.schurComplement
proof:
:= by
  have hF : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (-F) i j := fun i j => neg_nonneg.mpr
    (hA (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) (by simp))
  have hG : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (-G) i j := fun i j => neg_nonneg.mpr
    (hA (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) (by simp))
  have hprod : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (G * E⁻¹ * F) i j := by
    have h := mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg
      (mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg hG hE.2.2) hF
    simpa only [Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, neg_neg] using h
  intro i j hij
  exact sub_nonpos.mpr ((hA (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j) (by simpa using hij)).trans (hprod i j))

name: Matrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_fromBlocks_iff
statement:
theorem isNonsingularMMatrix_fromBlocks_iff
    (E : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (F : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (G : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (H : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (hA : (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H).IsZMatrix) (hEunit : IsUnit E) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H).IsNonsingularMMatrix ↔
      E.IsNonsingularMMatrix ∧ (H - G * E⁻¹ * F).IsNonsingularMMatrix
proof:
:= by
  let := E.invertibleOfIsUnitDet ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det E).mp hEunit)
  constructor
  · intro hM
    have hE : E.IsNonsingularMMatrix := by
      exact hM.submatrix Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective
    have hSunit : IsUnit (H - G * E⁻¹ * F) := by
      simpa only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] using
        Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₁₁.mp hM.2.1
    refine ⟨hE, hA.schurComplement hE, hSunit, fun i j => ?_⟩
    rw [← inverse_fromBlocks_bottomRight_of_isUnit E F G H hEunit hM.2.1]
    exact hM.2.2 (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j)
  · rintro ⟨hE, hS⟩
    have hMunit : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H) := by
      apply Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₁₁.mpr
      simpa only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] using hS.2.1
    let := (H - G * E⁻¹ * F).invertibleOfIsUnitDet
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.2.1)
    let := (Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H).invertibleOfIsUnitDet
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hMunit)
    have hInv := Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks₁₁_eq E F G H
    simp only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] at hInv
    have hF : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (-F) i j := fun i j => neg_nonneg.mpr
      (hA (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) (by simp))
    have hG : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (-G) i j := fun i j => neg_nonneg.mpr
      (hA (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) (by simp))
    have hEF : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (E⁻¹ * (-F)) i j :=
      mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg hE.2.2 hF
    have hSG : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ ((H - G * E⁻¹ * F)⁻¹ * (-G)) i j :=
      mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg hS.2.2 hG
    have hEFSG : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (E⁻¹ * F * (H - G * E⁻¹ * F)⁻¹ * G * E⁻¹) i j := by
      have h := mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg
        (mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg (mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg hEF hS.2.2) hG) hE.2.2
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, neg_neg] using h
    refine ⟨hA, hMunit, fun i j => ?_⟩
    rw [hInv]
    cases i with
    | inl i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j => exact add_nonneg (hE.2.2 i j) (hEFSG i j)
      | inr j =>
        have h := mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg hEF hS.2.2 i j
        change 0 ≤ (-(E⁻¹ * F * (H - G * E⁻¹ * F)⁻¹)) i j
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul] using h
    | inr i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j =>
        have h := mul_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg hSG hE.2.2 i j
        change 0 ≤ (-((H - G * E⁻¹ * F)⁻¹ * G * E⁻¹)) i j
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul] using h
      | inr j => exact hS.2.2 i j

name: Matrix.spectralRadius_toReal_le_of_positive_subsolution
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_toReal_le_of_positive_subsolution {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i)
    {r : ℝ} (hAp : ∀ i, (A *ᵥ p) i ≤ r * p i) :
    (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by
    let i : ι := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (A *ᵥ p) i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hA i j) (hp j).le
    exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right (hp i)).mp (hnonneg.trans (hAp i))
  have hspec := spectralRadius_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution
    (A := A) (B := A.map Complex.ofReal) (fun i j => by
      simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA i j), le_refl])
    hp hAp
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr] using ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hspec

name: Matrix.le_spectralRadius_toReal_of_nonnegative_supersolution
statement:
theorem le_spectralRadius_toReal_of_nonnegative_supersolution {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hxne : x ≠ 0)
    {r : ℝ} (hAx : ∀ i, r * x i ≤ (A *ᵥ x) i) :
    r ≤ (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! hr
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hAp⟩ := exists_positive_strict_subsolution_of_spectralRadius_lt hA hr
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hxne
  have hxj : 0 < x j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hx j) hj.symm
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun k => x k / p k)
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  let t := x i / p i
  have ht : 0 < t := (div_pos hxj (hp j)).trans_le (hi j (mem_univ j))
  have hxi : x i = t * p i := by dsimp [t]; field_simp [(hp i).ne']
  have hxle (k : ι) : x k ≤ t * p k := (div_le_iff₀ (hp k)).mp (hi k (mem_univ k))
  have hbound : (A *ᵥ x) i ≤ t * (A *ᵥ p) i := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ k, A i k * (t * p k) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hxle k) (hA i k)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        funext k
        ring
  have hstrict := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hAp i) ht
  have hstrict' : (A *ᵥ x) i < r * x i := hbound.trans_lt (by
    simpa only [hxi, mul_left_comm] using hstrict)
  exact not_lt_of_ge (hAx i) hstrict'

name: Matrix.collatz_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem collatz_ratio_bounds {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) :
    Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ x) i / x i) ≤
      (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal ∧
    (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal ≤
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ x) i / x i)
proof:
:= by
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := hx (Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›)
    rw [hz] at h
    exact lt_irrefl _ h
  constructor
  · apply le_spectralRadius_toReal_of_nonnegative_supersolution hA (fun i => (hx i).le) hxne
    intro i
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (hx i)).mp (Finset.inf'_le _ (mem_univ i))
  · apply spectralRadius_toReal_le_of_positive_subsolution hA hx
    intro i
    exact (div_le_iff₀ (hx i)).mp
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun i => (A *ᵥ x) i / x i) (mem_univ i))

name: Matrix.isGLB_positive_collatz_max_ratios
statement:
theorem isGLB_positive_collatz_max_ratios {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    IsGLB {s : ℝ | ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < x i) ∧
      s = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ x) i / x i)}
      (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro s ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (collatz_ratio_bounds hA hx).2
  · intro a ha
    by_contra! hlt
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := exists_positive_strict_subsolution_of_spectralRadius_lt hA hlt
    have hmax : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ x) i / x i) < a :=
      (Finset.sup'_lt_iff _).mpr fun i _ => (div_lt_iff₀ (hx i)).mpr (hAx i)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (ha ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)) hmax

name: Matrix.isGreatest_nonnegative_collatz_supersolutions
statement:
theorem isGreatest_nonnegative_collatz_supersolutions {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    IsGreatest {r : ℝ | ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i, r * x i ≤ (A *ᵥ x) i} (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, he⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector hA
    refine ⟨p, hp, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · intro hz
      simp [hz] at hs
    · rw [he]
      exact le_rfl
  · rintro r ⟨x, hx, hne, hAx⟩
    exact le_spectralRadius_toReal_of_nonnegative_supersolution hA hx hne hAx

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.nonneg_of_mulVec_nonneg_of_positive_certificate
statement:
theorem IsZMatrix.nonneg_of_mulVec_nonneg_of_positive_certificate
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hAx : ∀ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ x) i)
    {u : ι → ℝ} (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (A *ᵥ u) i) : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j
  by_contra hj
  have huj : u j < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hj
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ (fun k => u k / x k)
    ⟨j, mem_univ j⟩
  let a : ℝ := u i / x i
  have ha : a < 0 := (hi j (mem_univ j)).trans_lt (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos huj (hx j))
  have hd (k : ι) : 0 ≤ u k - a * x k := by
    have hk : a ≤ u k / x k := hi k (mem_univ k)
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((le_div_iff₀ (hx k)).mp hk)
  have hz : u i - a * x i = 0 := by
    dsimp [a]
    field_simp [(hx i).ne']
    ring
  have hsum : (A *ᵥ (u - a • x)) i ≤ 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro k _
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst k
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hz, mul_zero, le_refl]
    · exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hA i k hik) (hd k)
  have he : (A *ᵥ (u - a • x)) i = (A *ᵥ u) i - a * (A *ᵥ x) i := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    rfl
  rw [he] at hsum
  have hneg := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos ha (hAx i)
  linarith [hu i]

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_of_positive_certificate
statement:
theorem IsZMatrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_of_positive_certificate
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hAx : ∀ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ x) i) :
    A.IsNonsingularMMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : ∀ {u : ι → ℝ}, (∀ i, 0 ≤ (A *ᵥ u) i) → ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i :=
    fun hu => hA.nonneg_of_mulVec_nonneg_of_positive_certificate hx hAx hu
  have hker : ∀ u, A *ᵥ u = 0 → u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    have hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i := hmono (by simp [hu])
    have hn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (-u) i := hmono (by simp [Matrix.mulVec_neg, hu])
    exact funext fun i => le_antisymm (by simpa using hn i) (hp i)
  have hunit : IsUnit A := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp <|
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (Matrix.ker_mulVecLin_eq_bot_iff.mpr hker))
  refine ⟨hA, hunit, fun i j => ?_⟩
  have hInv := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A |>.mp hunit)
  have hcol : A *ᵥ (fun k => A⁻¹ k j) = fun k => if k = j then 1 else 0 := by
    funext k
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℝ => M k j) hInv
  exact hmono (u := fun k => A⁻¹ k j) (by
    rw [hcol]
    intro k
    dsimp only
    split_ifs <;> norm_num) i

name: Matrix.IsNonsingularMMatrix.nonneg_of_mulVec_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have he : A⁻¹ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ u) = u := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A |>.mp hA.2.1),
      Matrix.one_mulVec]
  intro i
  rw [← he]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hA.2.2 i j) (hu j)

name: Matrix.IsNonsingularMMatrix.exists_positive_certificate
statement:
theorem IsNonsingularMMatrix.exists_positive_certificate
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsNonsingularMMatrix) :
    ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < x i) ∧ ∀ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ x) i
proof:
:= by
  let x : ι → ℝ := A⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun _ => 1)
  have hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i := fun i =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hA.2.2 i j) zero_le_one
  have hAx : A *ᵥ x = fun _ => 1 := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A |>.mp hA.2.1),
      Matrix.one_mulVec]
  refine ⟨x, fun i => ?_, fun i => by rw [hAx]; norm_num⟩
  by_contra hi
  have hxi : x i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hi) (hx0 i)
  have hle : (A *ᵥ x) i ≤ 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro j _
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [hxi]
    · exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hA.1 i j hij) (hx0 j)
  rw [hAx] at hle
  norm_num at hle

name: Matrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_positive_certificate
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsNonsingularMMatrix.exists_positive_certificate,
    fun ⟨_, hx, hAx⟩ => hA.isNonsingularMMatrix_of_positive_certificate hx hAx⟩

name: Matrix.pow_apply_le_of_nonneg_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j := fun i j => (hA i j).trans (hAB i j)
  induction k generalizing i j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => mul_le_mul (ih i l) (hAB l j)
      (hA l j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hB k i l)

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.mono_of_le
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.mono_of_le {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAB : ∀ i j, A i j ≤ B i j) : B.IsIrreducible
proof:
:= by
  have hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j := fun i j => (hA.nonneg i j).trans (hAB i j)
  apply (isIrreducible_iff_exists_pow_pos hB).mpr
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hki⟩ := (isIrreducible_iff_exists_pow_pos hA.nonneg).mp hA i j
  exact ⟨k, hk, hki.trans_le (pow_apply_le_of_nonneg_of_le hA.nonneg hAB k i j)⟩

name: Matrix.spectralRadius_complexification_mono
proof:
:= by
  apply spectralRadius_le_of_abs_le_nonnegative (fun i j => (hA i j).trans (hAB i j))
  intro i j
  simpa only [Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA i j)]
    using hAB i j

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.spectralRadius_add_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : ∀ i j, A i j ≤ (A + E) i j := fun i j => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hE i j)
  have hB := hA.mono_of_le hAB
  have hBne : A + E ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hAne
    ext i j
    have hle := hAB i j
    rw [hz] at hle
    exact le_antisymm hle (hA.nonneg i j)
  obtain ⟨_, q, _, _, hq, _, _, _, hqA⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  obtain ⟨p, _, _, hp, _, _, _, hBp, _⟩ := hB.exists_positive_perron_pair hBne
  have hpair : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ p := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hp i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ : ∃ i j, E i j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hEne (funext fun i => funext fun j => h i j)
  have hEp : 0 < (E *ᵥ p) i := (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hE i j) hij.symm) (hp j)).trans_le
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hE i k) (hp k).le) (mem_univ j))
  have hpert : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ p) := (mul_pos (hq i) hEp).trans_le
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hq k).le
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => mul_nonneg (hE k l) (hp l).le)) (mem_univ i))
  have heq : (spectralRadius ℂ ((A + E).map Complex.ofReal)).toReal * (q ⬝ᵥ p) =
      (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal * (q ⬝ᵥ p) + q ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ p) := by
    calc
      _ = q ⬝ᵥ ((A + E) *ᵥ p) := by rw [hBp, dotProduct_smul]; rfl
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hqA, smul_dotProduct]
        rfl
  have hlt : (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal <
      (spectralRadius ℂ ((A + E).map Complex.ofReal)).toReal := by nlinarith
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (NLAlib.matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top _)
    (NLAlib.matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top _)).mp hlt

name: Matrix.sum_normalize_smul_eq
statement:
private theorem sum_normalize_smul_eq (x : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i, (a • x) i)⁻¹ • (a • x) = (∑ i, x i)⁻¹ • x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  by_cases hs : (∑ i, x i) = 0
  · simp [hs]
  · field_simp [ha, hs]

name: Matrix.tendsto_sum_normalized_power_mulVec_of_perron_limit
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_normalized_power_mulVec_of_perron_limit
    {T : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hps : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => T ^ k) atTop
      (𝓝 ((q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q)))
    {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hxne : x ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (∑ i, (T ^ k *ᵥ x) i)⁻¹ • (T ^ k *ᵥ x)) atTop (𝓝 p)
proof:
:= by
  have hqp : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ p := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hp i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hxne
  have hxj : 0 < x j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hx j) hj.symm
  have hqx : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ x := (mul_pos (hq j) hxj).trans_le
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hq i).le (hx i)) (mem_univ j))
  let c : ℝ := (q ⬝ᵥ x) / (q ⬝ᵥ p)
  have hc : 0 < c := div_pos hqx hqp
  have hproj : ((q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q) *ᵥ x = c • p := by
    ext i
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, Pi.smul_apply,
      MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, MulOpposite.unop_op, smul_eq_mul, c, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  have hcont : Continuous (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℝ => M *ᵥ x) := by fun_prop
  have hvlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => T ^ k *ᵥ x) atTop (𝓝 (c • p)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hproj] using hcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim
  have hsumcont : Continuous (fun v : ι → ℝ => ∑ i, v i) := by fun_prop
  have hsumlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ∑ i, (T ^ k *ᵥ x) i) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      hps, mul_one] using hsumcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hvlim
  have hresult := (hsumlim.inv₀ hc.ne').smul hvlim
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul] using hresult

name: Matrix.IsPrimitive.exists_tendsto_normalized_power_mulVec
statement:
theorem IsPrimitive.exists_tendsto_normalized_power_mulVec {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧
      ∀ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) → x ≠ 0 →
        Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (∑ i, (A ^ k *ᵥ x) i)⁻¹ • (A ^ k *ᵥ x)) atTop (𝓝 p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hr, hp, hq, hps, _, hAp, hqA⟩ := hA.isIrreducible.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  have hlim := (hA.isIrreducible.perron_power_limit_and_rate hAne hp hq hAp hqA
    ((hA.isIrreducible.isPrimitive_iff_unique_peripheral hAne).mp hA)).1
  refine ⟨p, hp, hps, fun x hx hxne => ?_⟩
  have hnormalized := tendsto_sum_normalized_power_mulVec_of_perron_limit hp hq hps hlim hx hxne
  convert hnormalized using 1
  funext k
  rw [smul_pow, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    sum_normalize_smul_eq _ (pow_ne_zero k (inv_ne_zero hr.ne'))]

name: Matrix.perron_normalization_projector_identities
statement:
theorem perron_normalization_projector_identities {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {p q : ι → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = r • p) (hqA : q ᵥ* A = r • q) :
    let P
proof:
:= (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q
    P * P = P ∧ (r⁻¹ • A) * P = P ∧ P * (r⁻¹ • A) = P := by
  have hpair : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ p := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hp i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have h := NLAlib.mul_normalized_vecMulVec_eq_smul hAp hqA
  refine ⟨NLAlib.normalized_vecMulVec_mul_self hpair.ne', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.smul_mul, h.1, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
  · rw [Matrix.mul_smul, h.2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.deflated_perron_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.deflated_perron_spectralRadius_lt_one
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0)
    {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p)
    (hqA : q ᵥ* A = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • q)
    (hperipheral : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal),
      ‖μ‖ = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal →
        μ = ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ)) :
    spectralRadius ℂ ((((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal)⁻¹ • A -
      (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q).map Complex.ofReal) < 1
proof:
:= by
  let r := (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
  obtain ⟨_, _, hr, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  let pc : ι → ℂ := fun i => (p i : ℂ)
  let qc : ι → ℂ := fun i => (q i : ℂ)
  have hpc : pc ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    let i : ι := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›
    have hp0 : (p i : ℂ) = 0 := congrFun hz i
    have hp0R : p i = 0 := Complex.ofReal_injective hp0
    exact (hp i).ne' hp0R
  have hpairReal : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ p := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (hq i) (hp i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hpairCast : qc ⬝ᵥ pc = ((q ⬝ᵥ p : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [pc, qc, dotProduct, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hpair : qc ⬝ᵥ pc ≠ 0 := by rw [hpairCast]; exact_mod_cast hpairReal.ne'
  have hAc : A.map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ pc = (r : ℂ) • pc := by
    funext i
    have h := congrArg Complex.ofReal (congrFun hAp i)
    simpa only [r, pc, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul] using h
  have hqc : qc ᵥ* A.map Complex.ofReal = (r : ℂ) • qc := by
    funext i
    have h := congrArg Complex.ofReal (congrFun hqA i)
    simpa only [r, qc, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul] using h
  have hbound (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)) : ‖μ‖ ≤ r := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hAz⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
    exact norm_eigenvalue_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution
      (A := A) (fun i j => by
        simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg (hA.nonneg i j), le_refl]) hp
      (fun i => by rw [hAp]; exact le_rfl) hz hAz
  have hgap := NLAlib.deflated_spectralRadius_lt_one_of_simple_unique_peripheral
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) hr hpc hpair hAc hqc
    (hA.rootMultiplicity_perron_complexification_eq_one hAne) hbound hperipheral
  have hmap : (r⁻¹ • A - (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q).map Complex.ofReal =
      (r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A.map Complex.ofReal - (qc ⬝ᵥ pc)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec pc qc := by
    rw [hpairCast]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
      pc, qc, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_inv]
  rw [hmap]
  exact hgap

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.perron_power_limit_and_rate
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.perron_power_limit_and_rate
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0)
    {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p)
    (hqA : q ᵥ* A = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • q)
    (hperipheral : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal),
      ‖μ‖ = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal →
        μ = ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ)) :
    let T
proof:
:= ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal)⁻¹ • A
    let P := (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => T ^ k) atTop (𝓝 P) ∧
      ∀ θ : ℝ, (spectralRadius ℂ ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < θ → θ < 1 →
        ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, NLAlib.specNorm (T ^ k - P) ≤ C * θ ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hr, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  have hid := perron_normalization_projector_identities hr hp hq hAp hqA
  have hgap := hA.deflated_perron_spectralRadius_lt_one hAne hp hq hAp hqA hperipheral
  exact ⟨NLAlib.tendsto_matrix_pow_projector_of_deflated_spectralRadius_lt_one _ _ hid.1 hid.2.1 hid.2.2 hgap,
    fun θ hθ _ => NLAlib.exists_specNorm_matrix_pow_sub_projector_le_geometric _ _ hid.1 hid.2.1 hid.2.2 hθ⟩

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.exists_attaining_collatz_ratios
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.exists_attaining_collatz_ratios {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧
      (∀ i, (A *ᵥ p) i / p i = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal) ∧
      Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ p) i / p i) =
        (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal ∧
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ p) i / p i) =
        (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, _, _, hp, _, hs, _, he, _⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  have hratio (i : ι) : (A *ᵥ p) i / p i =
      (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal := by
    rw [he]
    exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (hp i).ne'
  refine ⟨p, hp, hs, hratio, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [hratio, Finset.inf'_const]
  · simp only [hratio, Finset.sup'_const]

name: Matrix.mulVec_pos_of_pos_of_sum_one
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : 0 < ∑ j, x j := by rw [hs]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < x j := by
    by_contra! h
    have hle := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => h j)
    linarith
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hA i j).le (hx j))
    ⟨j, mem_univ j, mul_pos (hA i j) hj⟩

name: Matrix.isCompact_positiveSubsolutionSlice
statement:
private theorem isCompact_positiveSubsolutionSlice (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (R : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (positiveSubsolutionSlice A R)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsClosed {x : ι → ℝ | ∑ i, x i = 1} :=
    isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hb : IsClosed {x : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, (A *ᵥ x) i ≤ R * x i} := by
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  exact isCompact_Icc.inter_right (hs.inter hb)

name: Matrix.pos_of_mem_positiveSubsolutionSlice
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := mulVec_pos_of_pos_of_sum_one hA (fun j => hx.1.1 j) hx.2.1 i
  by_contra hi
  have hz : x i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hi) (hx.1.1 i)
  have hbound := hx.2.2 i
  rw [hz, mul_zero] at hbound
  linarith

name: Matrix.positive_eigenpair_of_nonempty_slice
statement:
private theorem positive_eigenpair_of_nonempty_slice {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {R : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 < A i j)
    (hK : (positiveSubsolutionSlice A R).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (p : ι → ℝ), 0 < r ∧ (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧
      (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧ A *ᵥ p = r • p
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => (A *ᵥ x) i / x i)
  have hf : ContinuousOn f (positiveSubsolutionSlice A R) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.finset_sup'_apply
    intro i _
    apply ContinuousOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    intro x hx
    exact (pos_of_mem_positiveSubsolutionSlice hA hx i).ne'
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_positiveSubsolutionSlice A R).exists_isMinOn hK hf
  have hpp : ∀ i, 0 < p i := pos_of_mem_positiveSubsolutionSlice hA hp
  let r := f p
  have hratio (i : ι) : (A *ᵥ p) i / p i ≤ r := by
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun i => (A *ᵥ p) i / p i) (mem_univ i)
  have hbound (i : ι) : (A *ᵥ p) i ≤ r * p i :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (hpp i)).mp (hratio i)
  have hrR : r ≤ R := Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun i _ =>
    (div_le_iff₀ (hpp i)).mpr (hp.2.2 i)
  have hAp : ∀ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ p) i :=
    mulVec_pos_of_pos_of_sum_one hA (fun i => (hpp i).le) hp.2.1
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    let i : ι := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty ι›
    exact (div_pos (hAp i) (hpp i)).trans_le (hratio i)
  refine ⟨r, p, hr, hpp, hp.2.1, ?_⟩
  by_contra heig
  have hstrict : ∃ j, (A *ᵥ p) j < r * p j := by
    by_contra! hj
    apply heig
    exact funext fun j => le_antisymm (hbound j) (hj j)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hstrict
  have hAA (i : ι) : (A *ᵥ (A *ᵥ p)) i < r * (A *ᵥ p) i := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ k, A i k * (A *ᵥ p) k := rfl
      _ < ∑ k, A i k * (r * p k) := Finset.sum_lt_sum
        (fun k _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound k) (hA i k).le)
        ⟨j, mem_univ j, mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hj (hA i j)⟩
      _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; funext k; ring
  let s : ℝ := ∑ i, (A *ᵥ p) i
  have hs : 0 < s := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hAp i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  let z : ι → ℝ := s⁻¹ • (A *ᵥ p)
  have hzpos (i : ι) : 0 < z i := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs) (hAp i)
  have hzsum : ∑ i, z i = 1 := by
    simp only [z, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne'
  have hAz (i : ι) : (A *ᵥ z) i < r * z i := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hAA i) (inv_pos.mpr hs)
    simpa only [z, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm] using h
  have hzK : z ∈ positiveSubsolutionSlice A R := by
    refine ⟨⟨fun i => (hzpos i).le, fun i => ?_⟩, hzsum, fun i => ?_⟩
    · exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => (hzpos k).le) (mem_univ i)).trans_eq hzsum
    · exact (hAz i).le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrR (hzpos i).le)
  have hfr : f z < r := (Finset.sup'_lt_iff _).mpr fun i _ =>
    (div_lt_iff₀ (hzpos i)).mpr (hAz i)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmin hzK)) hfr

name: Matrix.exists_positive_eigenpair_of_pos
statement:
theorem exists_positive_eigenpair_of_pos {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 < A i j) :
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (p : ι → ℝ), 0 < r ∧ (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧
      (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧ A *ᵥ p = r • p
proof:
:= by
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    dsimp [N]
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card ι)
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N]
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card ι)
  let x : ι → ℝ := fun _ => N⁻¹
  let R : ℝ := ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j
  have hrow (i : ι) : (∑ j, A i j) ≤ R :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => (hA k j).le) (mem_univ i)
  apply positive_eigenpair_of_nonempty_slice hA (R := R)
  refine ⟨x, ⟨⟨fun _ => (inv_pos.mpr hN).le, fun _ => ?_⟩, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩⟩
  · exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hN1
  · change (∑ _ : ι, N⁻¹) = 1
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hN.ne'
  · change (∑ j, A i j * N⁻¹) ≤ R * N⁻¹
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrow i) (inv_pos.mpr hN).le

name: Matrix.exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector_and_comparison
statement:
theorem exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector_and_comparison {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    ∃ p : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧
      A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p ∧
      (∀ B : Matrix ι ι ℂ, (∀ i j, norm (B i j) ≤ A i j) →
        spectralRadius ℂ B ≤ spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < t →
        ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < x i) ∧ ∀ i, (A *ᵥ x) i < t * x i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
  have hε (k : ℕ) : 0 < ε k := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  let C : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℝ := fun k i j => A i j + ε k
  have hCpos (k : ℕ) (i j : ι) : 0 < C k i j := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (hA i j) (hε k)
  choose r p hr hp hpsum heig using fun k => exists_positive_eigenpair_of_pos (hCpos k)
  let S : Set (ι → ℝ) := Set.Icc 0 (fun _ => 1) ∩ {x | ∑ i, x i = 1}
  have hS : IsCompact S := isCompact_Icc.inter_right
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have hpS (k : ℕ) : p k ∈ S := by
    refine ⟨⟨fun i => (hp k i).le, fun i => ?_⟩, hpsum k⟩
    exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => (hp k j).le) (mem_univ i)).trans_eq (hpsum k)
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, φ, hφ, hplim⟩ := hS.tendsto_subseq hpS
  have hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ε, one_div] using
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat :
        Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)))
  have hClim : Tendsto C atTop (𝓝 A) := by
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro j
    simpa only [C, add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add hεlim
  have hCsub := hClim.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hmulcont : Continuous (fun z : Matrix ι ι ℝ × (ι → ℝ) => z.1 *ᵥ z.2) := by fun_prop
  have hAP := hmulcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hCsub.prodMk_nhds hplim)
  let ρ : ℝ := ∑ i, (A *ᵥ p₀) i
  have hrdef (k : ℕ) : r k = ∑ i, (C k *ᵥ p k) i := by
    rw [heig k]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hpsum, mul_one]
  have hrcont : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => ∑ i, x i) := by fun_prop
  have hrlim : Tendsto (fun k => r (φ k)) atTop (𝓝 ρ) := by
    simpa only [ρ, Function.comp_def, ← hrdef] using hrcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hAP
  have hsmulcont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × (ι → ℝ) => z.1 • z.2) := by fun_prop
  have hRP := hsmulcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hrlim.prodMk_nhds hplim)
  have hlimEig : A *ᵥ p₀ = ρ • p₀ := by
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hAP (by simpa only [Function.comp_def, heig] using hRP)
  have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := ge_of_tendsto hrlim (Eventually.of_forall fun k => (hr (φ k)).le)
  have hρupper (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hBA : ∀ i j, norm (B i j) ≤ A i j) :
      spectralRadius ℂ B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ := by
    unfold spectralRadius
    apply iSup₂_le
    intro μ hμ
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hAz⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
    have hμr (k : ℕ) : ‖μ‖ ≤ r k := by
      apply norm_eigenvalue_le_of_abs_le_of_positive_subsolution (A := C k) (p := p k)
        (fun i j => ?_) (hp k) (fun i => ?_) hz hAz
      · exact (hBA i j).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hε k).le)
      · rw [heig k]
        exact le_rfl
    have hμρ : ‖μ‖ ≤ ρ := ge_of_tendsto hrlim (Eventually.of_forall fun k => hμr (φ k))
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hμρ
  have hpne : p₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hsum := hp₀.2
    rw [hz] at hsum
    simp at hsum
  have hcpne : (fun i => (p₀ i : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hpne
    funext i
    apply Complex.ofReal_injective
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, Complex.ofReal_zero] using congrFun hz i
  have hceig : A.map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ (fun i => (p₀ i : ℂ)) =
      (ρ : ℂ) • (fun i => (p₀ i : ℂ)) := by
    funext i
    have h := congrArg Complex.ofReal (congrFun hlimEig i)
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul, Matrix.map_apply] using h
  have hmem := mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hcpne hceig
  have hρlower : ENNReal.ofReal ρ ≤ spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) := by
    have hnorm : (‖(ρ : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) :=
      le_iSup_of_le (ρ : ℂ) (le_iSup_of_le hmem le_rfl)
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] at hnorm
    simpa only [coe_nnnorm, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hρ] using hnorm
  have hAA : ∀ i j, ‖A.map Complex.ofReal i j‖ ≤ A i j := by
    intro i j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA i j), le_refl]
  have hρeq := le_antisymm (hρupper _ hAA) hρlower
  refine ⟨p₀, fun i => hp₀.1.1 i, hp₀.2, ?_, (fun B hBA => ?_), ?_⟩
  · rw [hρeq, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hρ]
    exact hlimEig
  · rw [hρeq]
    exact hρupper B hBA
  · intro t ht
    have htρ : ρ < t := by simpa only [hρeq, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hρ] using ht
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hrlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds htρ)).exists
    refine ⟨p (φ k), hp (φ k), fun i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : (A *ᵥ p (φ k)) i ≤ (C (φ k) *ᵥ p (φ k)) i :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hε (φ k)).le) (hp (φ k) j).le
    rw [heig] at hcomp
    exact hcomp.trans_lt (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hk (hp (φ k) i))

name: Matrix.exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector
statement:
theorem exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    ∃ p : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧
      A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, he, _, _⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector_and_comparison hA
  exact ⟨p, hp, hs, he⟩

name: Matrix.spectralRadius_le_of_abs_le_nonnegative
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hcomp, _⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector_and_comparison hA
  exact hcomp B hBA

name: Matrix.exists_positive_strict_subsolution_of_spectralRadius_lt
statement:
theorem exists_positive_strict_subsolution_of_spectralRadius_lt
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < t) :
    ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < x i) ∧ ∀ i, (A *ᵥ x) i < t * x i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hsub⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector_and_comparison hA
