name: Matrix.spectralRadius_complexification_transpose
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_complexification_transpose (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    spectralRadius ℂ (Aᵀ.map Complex.ofReal) = spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hspec : spectrum ℂ (Aᵀ.map Complex.ofReal) = spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) := by
    ext μ
    change μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)ᵀ ↔ _
    simp only [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_transpose]
  simp only [spectralRadius, hspec]

name: Matrix.exists_nonnegative_perron_pair
statement:
theorem exists_nonnegative_perron_pair {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    ∃ p q : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) ∧
      (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, q i = 1) ∧
      A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p ∧
      q ᵥ* A = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, he⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector hA
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqs, hqe⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector (A := Aᵀ) (fun i j => hA j i)
  rw [spectralRadius_complexification_transpose, Matrix.mulVec_transpose] at hqe
  exact ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hs, hqs, he, hqe⟩

name: Matrix.peripheral_eigenvector_eq_smul_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun j => ‖z j‖ / p j)
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  let t : ℝ := ‖z i‖ / p i
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (hp i).le
  let w : ι → ℝ := fun j => B i j * p j / (r * p i)
  let u : ι → ℂ := fun j => z j / (p j : ℂ)
  have hden : 0 < r * p i := mul_pos hr (hp i)
  have hw (j : ι) : 0 < w j := div_pos (mul_pos (hB i j) (hp j)) hden
  have hws : ∑ j, w j = 1 := by
    simp only [w, ← Finset.sum_div]
    change (B *ᵥ p) i / (r * p i) = 1
    rw [hBp]
    exact div_self hden.ne'
  have hu (j : ι) : ‖u j‖ ≤ t := by
    simpa only [u, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hp j)]
      using hi j (mem_univ j)
  have havg : (∑ j, (w j : ℂ) * u j) = μ * z i / ((r * p i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ j, (B i j : ℂ) * z j) / ((r * p i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        dsimp [w, u]
        push_cast
        field_simp [(hp j).ne', hr.ne', (hp i).ne']
      _ = _ := by
        have h := congrFun hBz i
        simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
          congrArg (· / ((r * p i : ℝ) : ℂ)) h
  have havgnorm : ‖∑ j, (w j : ℂ) * u j‖ = t := by
    rw [havg, norm_div, norm_mul, hμ, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hden]
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp [hr.ne', (hp i).ne']
  have hrigid := Complex.eq_average_of_norm_average_eq_bound w u hw hws ht hu havgnorm
  refine ⟨∑ j, (w j : ℂ) * u j, funext fun j => ?_⟩
  have hpC : (p j : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hp j).ne'
  exact (div_eq_iff hpC).mp (hrigid j)

name: Matrix.IsPrimitive.peripheral_eigenvalue_eq_perron
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, _, hr, hp, _, _, _, hAp, _⟩ := hA.isIrreducible.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hAz⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := hA.exists_pos_pow
  have hpPower := pow_mulVec_eq_pow_smul_of_mulVec_eq_smul hAp k
  have hzPower : (A ^ k).map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ z = μ ^ k • z := by
    rw [NLAlib.map_ofReal_matrix_pow]
    exact pow_mulVec_eq_pow_smul_of_mulVec_eq_smul hAz k
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := peripheral_eigenvector_eq_smul_of_pos hk hp (pow_pos hr k)
    hpPower hzPower (by simp only [norm_pow, hμnorm])
  have hpC : A.map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ (fun i => (p i : ℂ)) =
      ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ) • (fun i => (p i : ℂ)) := by
    funext i
    have h := congrArg Complex.ofReal (congrFun hAp i)
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul] using h
  have hzr : A.map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ z =
      ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ) • z := by
    rw [hc, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hpC, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm c]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz
  have hEq := congrFun (hAz.symm.trans hzr) j
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hj hEq

name: Matrix.dotProduct_pos_of_nonnegative_sum_one
statement:
private theorem dotProduct_pos_of_nonnegative_sum_one {q x : ι → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hs : ∑ i, q i = 1) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < q j := by
    by_contra! h
    have hle := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => h j)
    rw [hs] at hle
    norm_num at hle
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hq i) (hx i).le)
    ⟨j, mem_univ j, mul_pos hj (hx j)⟩

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.exists_positive_shift_nonnegative
statement:
theorem IsZMatrix.exists_positive_shift_nonnegative {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) :
    ∃ (s : ℝ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ), 0 < s ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) ∧ A = s • 1 - B
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := 1 + ∑ i, max (A i i) 0
  have hs : 0 < s := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg zero_lt_one
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => le_max_right _ _)
  have hsdiag (i : ι) : A i i ≤ s := by
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => le_max_right (A j j) 0)
      (mem_univ i)
    have hi := le_max_left (A i i) 0
    dsimp [s]
    linarith
  let B := s • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) - A
  refine ⟨s, B, hs, fun i j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa only [B, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using sub_nonneg.mpr (hsdiag i)
    · simpa only [B, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hij, if_false,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_sub] using neg_nonneg.mpr (hA i j hij)
  · dsimp [B]
    abel

name: Matrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_exists_shift_above_spectralRadius
statement:
theorem isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_exists_shift_above_spectralRadius
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) : A.IsNonsingularMMatrix ↔
      ∃ (s : ℝ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ), (∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) ∧
        A = s • 1 - B ∧ (spectralRadius ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hM
    obtain ⟨s, B, _, hB, hAB⟩ := hA.exists_positive_shift_nonnegative
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := hM.exists_positive_certificate
    obtain ⟨_, q, _, hq, _, hqs, _, hqB⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_pair hB
    have hqx := dotProduct_pos_of_nonnegative_sum_one hq hqs hx
    have hqAx := dotProduct_pos_of_nonnegative_sum_one hq hqs hAx
    have heq : q ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) =
        (s - (spectralRadius ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal) * (q ⬝ᵥ x) := by
      rw [hAB, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
        dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hqB, smul_dotProduct]
      dsimp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    refine ⟨s, B, hB, hAB, ?_⟩
    rw [heq] at hqAx
    exact sub_pos.mp ((mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hqx).mp hqAx)
  · rintro ⟨s, B, hB, hAB, hρ⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hBx⟩ := exists_positive_strict_subsolution_of_spectralRadius_lt hB hρ
    apply hA.isNonsingularMMatrix_of_positive_certificate hx
    intro i
    rw [hAB, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (hBx i)

name: Matrix.norm_le_spectralRadius_toReal
statement:
private theorem norm_le_spectralRadius_toReal {B : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ B) : ‖μ‖ ≤ (spectralRadius ℂ B).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : (‖μ‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ spectralRadius ℂ B :=
    le_iSup_of_le μ (le_iSup_of_le hμ le_rfl)
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_toReal, coe_nnnorm] using
    ENNReal.toReal_mono (NLAlib.matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top B) hnorm

name: Matrix.IsNonsingularMMatrix.re_pos_of_mem_spectrum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, B, _, hAB, hρ⟩ :=
    (isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_exists_shift_above_spectralRadius hA.1).mp hA
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hAz⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hAc : A.map Complex.ofReal = (s : ℂ) • 1 - B.map Complex.ofReal := by
    rw [hAB]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij]
  have hBc : B.map Complex.ofReal = (s : ℂ) • 1 - A.map Complex.ofReal := by rw [hAc]; abel
  have hBz : B.map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ z = ((s : ℂ) - μ) • z := by
    rw [hBc, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hAz, sub_smul]
  have hnorm := norm_le_spectralRadius_toReal (mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hz hBz)
  have hre := Complex.re_le_norm ((s : ℂ) - μ)
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
  linarith

name: Matrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_spectrum_re_pos
statement:
theorem isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_spectrum_re_pos {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) :
    A.IsNonsingularMMatrix ↔ ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal), 0 < μ.re
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hM μ hμ => hM.re_pos_of_mem_spectrum hμ, fun hspec => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, B, _, hB, hAB⟩ := hA.exists_positive_shift_nonnegative
  obtain ⟨p, _, hs, he⟩ := exists_nonnegative_perron_eigenvector hB
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hs
  have hAp : A *ᵥ p = (s - (spectralRadius ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal) • p := by
    rw [hAB, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, he, sub_smul]
  have hmem := mem_spectrum_complexification_of_real_eigenpair hpne hAp
  have hpos := hspec _ hmem
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at hpos
  exact (isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_exists_shift_above_spectralRadius hA).mpr
    ⟨s, B, hB, hAB, sub_pos.mp hpos⟩

name: Matrix.IsZMatrix.mulVec_pos_iff_right_diagonal_strict_dominance
statement:
theorem IsZMatrix.mulVec_pos_iff_right_diagonal_strict_dominance
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsZMatrix) {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) :
    (∀ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ x) i) ↔
      ∀ i, 0 < (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i i ∧
        NLAlib.gershgorinRowRadius (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i < (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i i
proof:
:= by
  have he (i : ι) : (A *ᵥ x) i = (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i i -
      NLAlib.gershgorinRowRadius (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i := by
    have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, A i j * x j) + A i i * x i = (A *ᵥ x) i :=
      Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (mem_univ i)
    have habs : NLAlib.gershgorinRowRadius (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i =
        -(∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, A i j * x j) := by
      unfold NLAlib.gershgorinRowRadius
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
          (hA i j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1.symm) (hx j).le)]
    rw [habs, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro hpos i
    have hr := NLAlib.gershgorinRowRadius_nonneg (A * Matrix.diagonal x) i
    have hpi := hpos i
    rw [he i] at hpi
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · intro hdom i
    rw [he i]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (hdom i).2

name: Matrix.isPrimitive_of_tendsto_normalized_pow_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hij (i j : ι) : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, 0 < ((r⁻¹ • A) ^ k) i j :=
    (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hlim i) j).eventually (lt_mem_nhds (hP i j))
  have hall : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i j, 0 < ((r⁻¹ • A) ^ k) i j :=
    Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => Filter.eventually_all.mpr (hij i)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkpos⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop 1).and hall).exists
  refine ⟨hA, k, by omega, fun i j => ?_⟩
  have h := hkpos i j
  rw [smul_pow, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) k)).mp h

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.isPrimitive_iff_unique_peripheral
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.isPrimitive_iff_unique_peripheral {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    A.IsPrimitive ↔ ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal),
      ‖μ‖ = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal →
        μ = ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hP μ hμ hnorm => hP.peripheral_eigenvalue_eq_perron hAne hμ hnorm,
    fun hperipheral => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, q, hr, hp, hq, _, _, hAp, hqA⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  have hlim := (hA.perron_power_limit_and_rate hAne hp hq hAp hqA hperipheral).1
  apply isPrimitive_of_tendsto_normalized_pow_pos hA.nonneg hr _ hlim
  exact (perron_projector_pos_idempotent_and_commutes hp hq hAp hqA).1

name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.isPrimitive_iff_exists_tendsto_normalized_pow
statement:
theorem IsIrreducible.isPrimitive_iff_exists_tendsto_normalized_pow
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    A.IsPrimitive ↔ ∃ L : Matrix ι ι ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal)⁻¹ • A) ^ k)
        atTop (𝓝 L)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hP
    obtain ⟨p, q, _, hp, hq, _, _, hAp, hqA⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
    exact ⟨_, (hA.perron_power_limit_and_rate hAne hp hq hAp hqA
      ((hA.isPrimitive_iff_unique_peripheral hAne).mp hP)).1⟩
  · rintro ⟨L, hlim⟩
    apply (hA.isPrimitive_iff_unique_peripheral hAne).mpr
    intro μ hμ hμnorm
    obtain ⟨_, _, hr, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hA.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
    let r := (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal
    let T := r⁻¹ • A
    have hrC : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
    have hTmap : T.map Complex.ofReal = (r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A.map Complex.ofReal := by
      ext i j
      simp only [T, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_inv]
    have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℝ => M.map Complex.ofReal) := by fun_prop
    have hClim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (T.map Complex.ofReal) ^ k) atTop
        (𝓝 (L.map Complex.ofReal)) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, NLAlib.map_ofReal_matrix_pow] using
        hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hAz⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
    have hTz : T.map Complex.ofReal *ᵥ z = (μ / (r : ℂ)) • z := by
      rw [hTmap, Matrix.smul_mulVec, hAz, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hunitnorm : ‖μ / (r : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_div, hμnorm, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
      exact div_self hr.ne'
    have hμone := eigenvalue_eq_one_of_tendsto_pow hClim
      (mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hz hTz) hunitnorm
    exact (div_eq_one_iff_eq hrC).mp hμone

name: Matrix.IsPrimitive.exists_perron_power_limit_and_rate
statement:
theorem IsPrimitive.exists_perron_power_limit_and_rate {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hAne : A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p q : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < q i) ∧
      (∑ i, p i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, q i = 1) ∧
      let T
proof:
:= ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal)⁻¹ • A
      let P := (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q
      Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => T ^ k) atTop (𝓝 P) ∧
        ∀ θ : ℝ, (spectralRadius ℂ ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < θ → θ < 1 →
          ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, NLAlib.specNorm (T ^ k - P) ≤ C * θ ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨p, q, _, hp, hq, hps, hqs, hAp, hqA⟩ := hA.isIrreducible.exists_positive_perron_pair hAne
  exact ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hps, hqs, hA.isIrreducible.perron_power_limit_and_rate
    hAne hp hq hAp hqA ((hA.isIrreducible.isPrimitive_iff_unique_peripheral hAne).mp hA)⟩

name: NLAlib.mul_eq_of_range_le_of_isIdempotentElem
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hRange (show Q *ᵥ x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin from ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hy, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    show P * P = P from hP]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_idempotent_range_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_idempotent_range_blocks {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ,
    ∃ T : Matrix (Fin P.rank) (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols H ∧ H * Hᵀ = 1 ∧
      Hᵀ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 T 0 0
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℝ := orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q :=
    hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  have hRange : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin :=
    range_orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hHt, hHQ⟩ := exists_unitary_sum_completion
    (q := Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) Q hQ
    (by simpa using Nat.add_sub_of_le P.rank_le_card_height)
  let R := H.submatrix id Sum.inr
  have hHform : H = Matrix.fromCols Q R := by
    ext i j
    cases j with
    | inl j => exact congrArg (fun A : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℝ => A i j) hHQ
    | inr j => rfl
  have hCross : Rᵀ * Q = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₂₁ (show Hᵀ * H = 1 from hH)
    rw [hHform, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₂₁,
      show (1 : Matrix (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank))
        (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ).toBlocks₂₁ = 0 by
        ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₂₁]] using h
  have hPQ : P * Q = Q := mul_eq_of_range_le_of_isIdempotentElem hP hRange.le
  have hQP : Q * (Qᵀ * P) = P := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ hRange.ge
  have hRP : Rᵀ * P = 0 := by
    calc
      Rᵀ * P = Rᵀ * (Q * (Qᵀ * P)) := congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => Rᵀ * A) hQP.symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hCross, Matrix.zero_mul]
  refine ⟨H, Qᵀ * P * R, hH, hHt, ?_⟩
  rw [hHform, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul,
    Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hPQ, show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ,
    hRP, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_mulVec_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ≤
      specNorm A * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact A.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_forall_norm_toLp_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_forall_norm_toLp_mulVec_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ x : n → 𝕜, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ≤
      c * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖) : specNorm A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.toLpLin_apply]
  simpa using h x.ofLp

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_add_sq_of_star_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_add_sq_of_star_dotProduct_eq_zero (u v : n → 𝕜) (h : star u ⬝ᵥ v = 0) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (u + v) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [WithLp.toLp_add, @norm_add_sq 𝕜, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm, h, map_zero]
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_sq_add_norm_toLp_sq_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_sq_add_norm_toLp_sq_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem {P : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (P *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - P) *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have horth : star (P *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((1 - P) *ᵥ x) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hs.eq,
      Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, show P * P = P from hp, sub_self, Matrix.zero_mulVec,
      dotProduct_zero]
  have h := norm_toLp_add_sq_of_star_dotProduct_eq_zero _ _ horth
  rw [← Matrix.add_mulVec, add_sub_cancel, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.specNorm_add_le_max_of_projector_supports
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_le_of_forall_norm_toLp_mulVec_le _
    (le_trans (specNorm_nonneg X) (le_max_left _ _))
  intro x
  have horth : star (X *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Y *ᵥ x) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hXY,
      Matrix.zero_mulVec, dotProduct_zero]
  have hsum := norm_toLp_add_sq_of_star_dotProduct_eq_zero _ _ horth
  rw [← Matrix.add_mulVec] at hsum
  have hx := norm_toLp_mulVec_le X (P *ᵥ x)
  have hy := norm_toLp_mulVec_le Y ((1 - P) *ᵥ x)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hX] at hx
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hY] at hy
  have hsplit := norm_toLp_sq_add_norm_toLp_sq_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hs hp x
  set c := max (specNorm X) (specNorm Y) with hc
  have hXc : specNorm X ≤ c := le_max_left _ _
  have hYc : specNorm Y ≤ c := le_max_right _ _
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := (specNorm_nonneg X).trans hXc
  have hx2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hx 2
  have hy2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hy 2
  have hX2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg X) hXc 2)
    (sq_nonneg ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (P *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖)
  have hY2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg Y) hYc 2)
    (sq_nonneg ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - P) *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖)
  have h1 : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((X + Y) *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (c * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsum, mul_pow, ← hsplit, mul_add]
    rw [mul_pow] at hx2 hy2
    linarith
  exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).mp h1

name: NLAlib.sub_projector_eq_complement_mul_sub
statement:
theorem sub_projector_eq_complement_mul_sub {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜} :
    P - Q = (1 - Q) * P - Q * (1 - P)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  abel

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_projector_eq_max
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_projector_eq_max {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q) :
    specNorm (P - Q) = max (specNorm ((1 - Q) * P)) (specNorm (Q * (1 - P)))
proof:
:= by
  have hPP : P * P = P := hPi
  have hQQ : Q * Q = Q := hQi
  have hPc : (1 - P) * (1 - P) = 1 - P := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hPP]
    abel
  have hQz : (1 - Q) * Q = 0 := by simp [Matrix.sub_mul, hQQ]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [sub_projector_eq_complement_mul_sub, sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hh := specNorm_add_le_max_of_projector_supports hPs hPi
      (X := (1 - Q) * P) (Y := -(Q * (1 - P)))
      (by simp [Matrix.mul_assoc, hPP]) (by simp [Matrix.mul_assoc, hPc])
      (by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
          hPs.eq, hQs.eq, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (1 - Q) Q, hQz,
          Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, neg_zero])
    simpa only [specNorm_neg] using hh
  · apply max_le
    · have heq : (1 - Q) * P = (P - Q) * P := by simp [Matrix.sub_mul, hPP]
      rw [heq]
      exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (by
        have hh := Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem hPs hPi
        nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (P - Q)])
    · have heq : Q * (1 - P) = -(P - Q) * (1 - P) := by
        simp only [Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, hPP]
        abel
      rw [heq]
      have hPcs : (1 - P).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hPs
      exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (by
        have hh : specNorm (1 - P) ≤ 1 :=
          Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem hPcs hPc
        rw [specNorm_neg]
        nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (P - Q)])

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one_sub_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem specNorm_one_sub_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose (C : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (1 - Cᴴ * C) = specNorm (1 - C * Cᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD C
  set D := Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) =>
    ((singularValues C j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) with hD
  have hleft : 1 - Cᴴ * C = V * (1 - D) * Vᴴ := by
    rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      h.mul_conjTranspose_right]
  have hright : 1 - C * Cᴴ = U * (1 - D) * Uᴴ := by
    rw [h.mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      h.mul_conjTranspose_left]
  rw [hleft, hright,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_left]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    [DecidableEq p] {P : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Q : Matrix m p 𝕜} (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (projResidual P Q)ᴴ * projResidual P Q = 1 - (Pᴴ * Q)ᴴ * (Pᴴ * Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : (1 - P * Pᴴ)ᴴ = 1 - P * Pᴴ := by
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hH, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (1 - P * Pᴴ), one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_idem hP, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_comm
proof:
:= by
  have hc := specNorm_one_sub_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose (Pᴴ * Q)
  have hg : Qᴴ * P = (Pᴴ * Q)ᴴ := by simp
  have hp := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (projResidual P Q)
  have hq := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (projResidual Q P)
  rw [conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap hP hQ] at hp
  rw [conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap hQ hP, hg,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hq
  nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (projResidual P Q), specNorm_nonneg (projResidual Q P)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_frame_projector_eq_residual
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sub_projector_eq_max (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self P)
    (show P * Pᴴ * (P * Pᴴ) = P * Pᴴ from mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose hP)
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Q)
    (show Q * Qᴴ * (Q * Qᴴ) = Q * Qᴴ from mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose hQ)]
  have hleft : (1 - Q * Qᴴ) * (P * Pᴴ) = projResidual Q P * Pᴴ := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hright : (Q * Qᴴ) * (1 - P * Pᴴ) = (projResidual P Q * Qᴴ)ᴴ := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul]
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hleft, hright, specNorm_conjTranspose,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hP,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ,
    specNorm_residual_comm hQ hP, max_self]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_frame_projectors_eq_frobSq_overlap
statement:
theorem frobInner_frame_projectors_eq_frobSq_overlap (P Q : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (P * Pᴴ) (Q * Qᴴ) = frobSq (Pᴴ * Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_frame_projector_eq_two_mul_residual
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hP, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ,
    frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq_residual_eq_sub hP,
    frobSq_frame_eq_card hP, frobSq_frame_eq_card hQ,
    frobInner_frame_projectors_eq_frobSq_overlap]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_frame_projector_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
proof:
:= by
  let Q := orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  have hQ := hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  have hrange := range_orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  have hQP : Q * (Qᴴ * P) = P := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ hrange.ge
  have hPQ : P * Q = Q := by
    rw [Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec]
    intro x
    have hx : Q *ᵥ x ∈ LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin :=
      hrange.le (show Q *ᵥ x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin from ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hy, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      show P * P = P from hp]
  have hQtP : Qᴴ * P = Qᴴ := by
    have hh := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hPQ
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs.eq] using hh
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, hQP.symm.trans (congrArg (fun T => Q * T) hQtP)⟩

name: NLAlib.specNorm_complement_mul_projector_eq_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem specNorm_complement_mul_projector_eq_of_rank_eq {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q) (hr : P.rank = Q.rank) :
    specNorm ((1 - Q) * P) = specNorm ((1 - P) * Q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hPU⟩ := exists_frame_projector_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hPs hPi
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hQV⟩ := exists_frame_projector_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hQs hQi
  let e : Fin Q.rank ≃ Fin P.rank := finCongr hr.symm
  let V' := V.reindex (Equiv.refl n) e
  have hV' : HasOrthonormalCols V' := hV.reindex (Equiv.refl n) e
  have hVV : V' * V'ᴴ = V * Vᴴ := by
    simp only [V', Matrix.reindex_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Matrix.submatrix_id_id]
  have hQV' : Q = V' * V'ᴴ := hQV.trans hVV.symm
  have hleft : (1 - Q) * P = projResidual V' U * Uᴴ := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hPU, ← hQV']
  have hright : (1 - P) * Q = projResidual U V' * V'ᴴ := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, ← hPU, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hQV']
  rw [hleft, hright, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV', specNorm_residual_comm hV' hU]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_projector_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_projector_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q) (hr : P.rank = Q.rank) :
    specNorm (P - Q) = specNorm ((1 - Q) * P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sub_projector_eq_max hPs hPi hQs hQi]
  have ht : specNorm (Q * (1 - P)) = specNorm ((1 - P) * Q) := by
    rw [← specNorm_conjTranspose (Q * (1 - P))]
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, hPs.eq, hQs.eq]
  rw [ht, ← specNorm_complement_mul_projector_eq_of_rank_eq hPs hPi hQs hQi hr, max_self]

name: NLAlib.complex_cs_decomposition_properties
statement:
theorem complex_cs_decomposition_properties {p q n : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1)
    (hCard : Fintype.card p ≤ Fintype.card q)
    (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    (∃ e : p ↪ q,
      let c := fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁ ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
      (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ∃ V₁ W₁ : Matrix p p ℂ, ∃ V₂ W₂ : Matrix q q ℂ,
        V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1 ∧ W₁ᴴ * W₁ = 1 ∧ V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1 ∧ W₂ᴴ * W₂ = 1 ∧
        (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)ᴴ * U * Matrix.fromBlocks W₁ 0 0 W₂ =
          (csCanonicalMatrix c ((1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e)).map Complex.ofReal) ∧
    U.toBlocks₁₂.rank = U.toBlocks₂₁.rank ∧
    U.toBlocks₂₂.rank = U.toBlocks₁₁.rank + Fintype.card q - Fintype.card p ∧
    (∃ g : ℕ, g ≤ min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ∧
      ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ Antitone t ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i ↔ i < g) ∧
      ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℂ,
        Hᴴ * H = 1 ∧ H * Hᴴ = 1 ∧
        Hᴴ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 ((rectDiag t).map Complex.ofReal) 0 0 ∧
        (∀ i, singularValues P i =
          if i < P.rank then Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) else 0) ∧
        (∀ i, 1 < singularValues P i ↔ i < g) ∧
        (∀ i < g, t i = Real.sqrt (singularValues P i ^ 2 - 1))) ∧
    (∀ hr : 0 < P.rank, ∃ Q W : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℂ,
      Qᴴ * Q = 1 ∧ Wᴴ * W = 1 ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin ∧
      LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ ∧
      let θ := principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨P.rank - 1, by simpa using Nat.sub_lt hr Nat.one_pos⟩
      (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype W Q i ≤ θ) ∧
      θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ ‖P‖ = 1 / Real.cos θ) ∧
    (0 < P.rank → P.rank < Fintype.card n → ‖1 - P‖ = ‖P‖) ∧
    (P.rank = 0 → ‖P‖ = 0 ∧ ‖1 - P‖ = if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧
    (P.rank = Fintype.card n →
      ‖P‖ = (if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧ ‖1 - P‖ = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hCard
  exact ⟨⟨e, exists_complex_cs_decomposition_of_embedding U hU e⟩,
    rank_offDiagonal_blocks_eq_of_unitary U hU,
    rank_bottomRight_eq_rank_topLeft_add_card_sub_of_unitary U hU hCard,
    exists_unitary_idempotent_canonical_spectrum P hP,
    exists_complex_range_kernel_frames_norm_eq_secant P hP,
    (complex_idempotent_complement_norm_properties P hP).1,
    (complex_idempotent_complement_norm_properties P hP).2.1,
    (complex_idempotent_complement_norm_properties P hP).2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_comm
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_residual_eq_sub hP, frobSq_residual_eq_sub hQ, frobSq_frame_eq_card hP,
    frobSq_frame_eq_card hQ]
  congr 1
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (Pᴴ * Q), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_complement_mul_projector_eq_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_complement_mul_projector_eq_of_rank_eq {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q) (hr : P.rank = Q.rank) :
    frobSq ((1 - Q) * P) = frobSq ((1 - P) * Q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hPU⟩ := exists_frame_projector_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hPs hPi
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hQV⟩ := exists_frame_projector_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hQs hQi
  let e : Fin Q.rank ≃ Fin P.rank := finCongr hr.symm
  let V' := V.reindex (Equiv.refl n) e
  have hV' : HasOrthonormalCols V' := hV.reindex (Equiv.refl n) e
  have hVV : V' * V'ᴴ = V * Vᴴ := by
    simp only [V', Matrix.reindex_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Matrix.submatrix_id_id]
  have hQV' : Q = V' * V'ᴴ := hQV.trans hVV.symm
  have hleft : (1 - Q) * P = projResidual V' U * Uᴴ := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hPU, ← hQV']
  have hright : (1 - P) * Q = projResidual U V' * V'ᴴ := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, ← hPU, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hQV']
  rw [hleft, hright, frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hU, frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV',
    frobSq_residual_comm hV' hU]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projector_mul_complement_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_projector_mul_complement_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q) (hr : P.rank = Q.rank) :
    frobSq (Q * (1 - P)) = frobSq ((1 - Q) * P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (Q * (1 - P)), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hPs.eq, hQs.eq]
  exact (frobSq_complement_mul_projector_eq_of_rank_eq hPs hPi hQs hQi hr).symm

name: NLAlib.norm_array_le_one_of_hasOrthonormalCols

theorem norm_array_le_one_of_hasOrthonormalCols {n k : ℕ}
    {Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun _ => by simp
  have h2 : ‖Q‖ * ‖Q‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, show Qᴴ * Q = 1 from hQ]

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup {n : ℕ}
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : O.valᵀ * O.val = 1
proof:

  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    using O.property.1

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonalGroup_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonalGroup_smul_eq {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Q Q' : Stiefel n k) :
    ∃ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, O • Q = Q'
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fin.castLEEmb hkn
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWQ⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Q.val Q.property e
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVQ⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Q'.val Q'.property e
  change Wᵀ * W = 1 at hW
  change Vᵀ * V = 1 at hV
  have hWt : W * Wᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW
  let O := V * Wᵀ
  have hO : O ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ := by
    apply Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr
    simp only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    dsimp only [O]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᵀ, hV, Matrix.one_mul, hWt]
  refine ⟨⟨O, hO⟩, ?_⟩
  have heqOW : O * W = V := by
    dsimp only [O]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hW, Matrix.mul_one]
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i j
  change (O * Q.val) i j = Q'.val i j
  calc
    _ = (O * W) i (e j) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, hWQ]
    _ = V i (e j) := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i (e j)) heqOW
    _ = Q'.val i j := hVQ i j

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_mul_eq_re_trace
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (1 - P)ᴴ = 1 - P := hP.one_sub.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hi : (1 - P) * (1 - P) = 1 - P := hP.one_sub.isIdempotentElem
  rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs,
    Matrix.mul_assoc Aᴴ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (1 - P), hi,
    Matrix.trace_mul_comm Aᴴ, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_eq_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose, frobSq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc A, h]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_mul_add_sub_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_mul_add_sub_eq {P : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hP : IsStarProjection P) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix m l 𝕜) (c : ℝ) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * B) + c - frobSq ((1 - P) * A) =
      c - RCLike.re (A * Aᴴ - B * Bᴴ).trace +
        RCLike.re (P * (A * Aᴴ - B * Bᴴ)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_one_sub_mul_eq_re_trace hP, frobSq_one_sub_mul_eq_re_trace hP]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  ring

statement:

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix (S : Submodule 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (orthonormalBasisMatrix S)
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  have h := (euclideanBasis S).orthonormal
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite] at h
  have := h j k
  rw [Submodule.coe_inner, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at this
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, orthonormalBasisMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [← this]
  simp [dotProduct, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.range_orthonormalBasisMatrix
statement:
theorem range_orthonormalBasisMatrix (S : Submodule 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)) :
    LinearMap.range (orthonormalBasisMatrix S).mulVecLin = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  have hcols : Set.range (orthonormalBasisMatrix S).col =
      ⇑((WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (toEuclideanSubmodule S).subtype) ''
        Set.range (euclideanBasis S) := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]; rfl
  rw [hcols, ← Submodule.map_span, ← (euclideanBasis S).coe_toBasis, Module.Basis.span_eq,
    Submodule.map_comp, Submodule.map_subtype_top, toEuclideanSubmodule, ← Submodule.map_comp]
  simp

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace

    HasOrthonormalCols (orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace S)
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  have h := (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 S).orthonormal
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite] at h
  have hh := h j k
  rw [Submodule.coe_inner, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at hh
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [← hh]
  simp [dotProduct, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.columnSpace_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
statement:
theorem columnSpace_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
    (S : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) :
    columnSpace (orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace S) = S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [columnSpace_eq_span_columns]
  have hcols : (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2
      ((orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace S).col j)) =
      S.subtype ∘ (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 S) := by
    funext j
    apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
    rfl
  rw [hcols, Set.range_comp, ← Submodule.map_span,
    ← (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 S).coe_toBasis, Module.Basis.span_eq,
    Submodule.map_subtype_top]

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_columns_eq_one_apply
statement:
theorem sum_mul_columns_eq_one_apply (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (a b : d) : ∑ i, U i a * U i b = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) a b
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU) a) b
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_sq_mul_columns_eq_one
statement:
theorem sum_sum_sq_mul_columns_eq_one (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (a b : d) : ∑ i, ∑ j, (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcol (c : d) : ∑ i, U i c ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [pow_two, Matrix.one_apply_eq] using sum_mul_columns_eq_one_apply U hU c c
  simp_rw [mul_pow]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul_sum, hcol, hcol, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_mul_cross_columns_eq_one_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sum_mul_cross_columns_eq_one_sq
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a b : d) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b)) =
      ((1 : Matrix d d ℝ) a b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (∑ i, U i a * U i b) * (∑ j, U j a * U j b) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [sum_mul_columns_eq_one_apply U hU, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_sum_sq_row_mul_eq_sum_row_energy_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sum_sum_sq_row_mul_eq_sum_row_energy_sq (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, (U i a * U i b) ^ 2) =
      ∑ i, (∑ a, U i a ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ a, ∑ i, ∑ b, (U i a * U i b) ^ 2 := by
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ a, ∑ b, (U i a * U i b) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp_rw [mul_pow]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul_sum, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.sum_offDiagonal_frame_contractions_eq
statement:
theorem sum_offDiagonal_frame_contractions_eq
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else
      (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b)) =
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d -
        2 * ∑ i, (∑ a, U i a ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hoff (a b : d) :
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else
        (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b)) =
      1 + ((1 : Matrix d d ℝ) a b) ^ 2 - 2 * ∑ i, (U i a * U i b) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sum_sum_ite_ne_eq_sub_diag (fun (i j : ι) =>
      (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b))]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [sum_sum_sq_mul_columns_eq_one U hU, sum_sum_mul_cross_columns_eq_one_sq U hU]
    have hdiag : (∑ i, ((U i a * U i b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U i b) * (U i a * U i b))) =
        2 * ∑ i, (U i a * U i b) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      ring
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hdiag
    rw [hdiag]
  simp_rw [hoff, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [sum_sum_sum_sq_row_mul_eq_sum_row_energy_sq]
  simp only [Matrix.one_apply, ite_pow, one_pow, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_le_one_of_unitaryStiefel
statement:
theorem norm_le_one_of_unitaryStiefel {n k : ℕ}
    {Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : specNorm Q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  change ‖Q‖ ≤ 1
  have h1 : ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one,Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun _ => by simp
  have h2 : ‖Q‖*‖Q‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self,show Qᴴ*Q=1 from hQ]
    exact h1
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg Q]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_self_unitaryGroup
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self_unitaryGroup {n : ℕ}
    (O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜) : O.valᴴ*O.val=1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using O.property.1

name: NLAlib.exists_unitaryGroup_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unitaryGroup_smul_eq {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Q Q' : UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k) :
    ∃ O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜, O • Q = Q'
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fin.castLEEmb hkn
  obtain ⟨W,hW,hWQ⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Q.val Q.property e
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hVQ⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Q'.val Q'.property e
  have hWt : W*Wᴴ=1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW
  let O := V*Wᴴ
  have hO : O ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜 := by
    apply Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr
    simp only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
    dsimp only [O]
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ,hV,Matrix.one_mul,hWt]
  refine ⟨⟨O,hO⟩,?_⟩
  have heqOW : O*W=V := by
    dsimp only [O]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,hW,Matrix.mul_one]
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i j
  change (O*Q.val) i j=Q'.val i j
  calc
    _ = (O*W) i (e j) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_apply,hWQ]
    _ = V i (e j) := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 => M i (e j)) heqOW
    _ = Q'.val i j := hVQ i j

name: NLAlib.det_gram_fromCols_eq_mul_frobenius_norm_sq_sub_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem det_gram_fromCols_eq_mul_frobenius_norm_sq_sub_rangeProjector
    {m k : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype k] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq k]
    (B : Matrix m k ℂ) (v : Matrix m (Fin 1) ℂ) :
    ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det.re =
      (Bᴴ * B).det.re * ‖v - rangeProjector B * v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let G := Bᴴ * B
  let P := rangeProjector B
  by_cases hG : IsUnit G
  · let := hG.nonempty_invertible.some
    have hP : Pᴴ = P := (rangeProjector_isHermitian B).eq
    have hPP : P * P = P := rangeProjector_mul_self B
    have hcomp : (1 - P)ᴴ * (1 - P) = 1 - P := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hP, Matrix.sub_mul,
        Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hPP]
      abel
    have hleft : v - P * v = (1 - P) * v := by rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hf : ‖v - P * v‖ ^ 2 =
        (vᴴ * v - vᴴ * B * G⁻¹ * (Bᴴ * v)).trace.re := by
      rw [hleft, ← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (1 - P)ᴴ, hcomp, ← Matrix.mul_assoc vᴴ,
        Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.sub_mul]
      dsimp only [P]
      rw [rangeProjector_eq_mul_inv_gram_conjTranspose B hG]
      simp only [G, Matrix.mul_assoc, RCLike.re_to_complex]
    have hdet : ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det =
        G.det * (vᴴ * v - vᴴ * B * G⁻¹ * (Bᴴ * v)).det := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromCols_eq_fromRows_conjTranspose,
        Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
    have hGim : G.det.im = 0 := by
      exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self B).det_nonneg).2
    rw [hdet, Complex.mul_re, hGim, zero_mul, sub_zero, hf]
    congr 1
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_one, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  · have hdet : G.det = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hG ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det G).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne))
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hGz⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hBz : B *ᵥ z = 0 := by
      have hker : z ∈ LinearMap.ker G.mulVecLin := hGz
      change z ∈ LinearMap.ker (Bᴴ * B).mulVecLin at hker
      rw [Matrix.ker_mulVecLin_conjTranspose_mul_self] at hker
      exact hker
    let x : k ⊕ Fin 1 → ℂ := Sum.elim z (fun _ => 0)
    have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hx
      apply hz
      funext i
      exact congrFun hx (Sum.inl i)
    have hWx : Matrix.fromCols B v *ᵥ x = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec_sumElim, hBz]
      ext a
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    have hgram : ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols B v) *ᵥ x = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hWx, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    have hdet' : ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det = 0 :=
      Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp ⟨x, hx, hgram⟩
    change _ = G.det.re * _
    rw [hdet', hdet, Complex.zero_re, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.range_toEuclideanLin_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_eq
statement:
theorem range_toEuclideanLin_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_eq {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m p ℝ)
    (h : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin) :
    LinearMap.range A.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range B.toEuclideanLin
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h.le (show A *ᵥ v.ofLp ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin from ⟨v.ofLp, rfl⟩)
    exact ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 w, congrArg (WithLp.toLp 2) hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h.ge (show B *ᵥ v.ofLp ∈ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin from ⟨v.ofLp, rfl⟩)
    exact ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 w, congrArg (WithLp.toLp 2) hw⟩

name: NLAlib.isUnit_overlap_and_eq_mul_inv_mul_of_idempotent
statement:
theorem isUnit_overlap_and_eq_mul_inv_mul_of_idempotent {n r : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r]
    {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    {Q W : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hW : HasOrthonormalCols W)
    (hRange : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
    (hRow : LinearMap.range W.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Pᵀ.mulVecLin) :
    IsUnit (Wᵀ * Q) ∧ P = Q * (Wᵀ * Q)⁻¹ * Wᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let G := Qᵀ * P * W
  let C := Wᵀ * Q
  have hPQ : P * Q = Q := mul_eq_of_range_le_of_isIdempotentElem hP hRange.le
  have hQproj : Q * (Qᵀ * P) = P := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ hRange.ge
  have hWproj : P * W * Wᵀ = P := by
    have hh := congrArg Matrix.transpose (mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hW hRow.ge)
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hh
  have hGC : G * C = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = Qᵀ * (P * W * Wᵀ) * Q := by simp only [G, C, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Qᵀ * Q := by rw [hWproj, Matrix.mul_assoc, hPQ]
      _ = 1 := hQ
  have hCG : C * G = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hGC
  have hC : IsUnit C := ⟨⟨C, G, hCG, hGC⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨hC, ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hGC]
  change P = Q * (Qᵀ * P * W) * Wᵀ
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Q (Qᵀ * P) W, hQproj, hWproj]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_eq_inv_singularValues_last
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_eq_inv_singularValues_last {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] (C : Matrix r r ℝ) (hC : IsUnit C)
    (hr : 0 < Fintype.card r) :
    specNorm C⁻¹ = 1 / singularValues C (Fintype.card r - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hRank : C.rank = Fintype.card r := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit C hC
  rw [← moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit _ hC, specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq,
    hRank, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)]

name: NLAlib.sum_tail_mul_le_sum_shifted
statement:
private theorem sum_tail_mul_le_sum_shifted {a w : ℕ → ℝ} {N ℓ k : ℕ}
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ N) (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (ha : Antitone a)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1)
    (hbudget : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, w i ≤ (k : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, if i < ℓ then 0 else a i * w i) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, a (ℓ + j)
proof:
:= by
  have hSplit : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, w i) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, w i) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - ℓ), w (ℓ + j) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show N = ℓ + (N - ℓ) by omega]
    exact Finset.sum_range_add w ℓ (N - ℓ)
  have htBudget : ∑ j : Fin (N - ℓ), w (ℓ + j) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => w (ℓ + j)) (N - ℓ)]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, w i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hw0 i)
    linarith
  have ht := sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone
    (fun j : Fin (N - ℓ) => a (ℓ + j)) (fun j => w (ℓ + j))
    (fun j => ha0 _) (fun i j hij => ha (Nat.add_le_add_left hij ℓ))
    (fun j => hw0 _) (fun j => hw1 _) htBudget
  have hL : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, if i < ℓ then 0 else a i * w i) =
      ∑ j : Fin (N - ℓ), a (ℓ + j) * w (ℓ + j) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => a (ℓ + j) * w (ℓ + j)) (N - ℓ)]
    conv_lhs => rw [show N = ℓ + (N - ℓ) by omega]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
    have hHead : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, if i < ℓ then 0 else a i * w i) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)]
    rw [hHead, zero_add]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  rw [hL]
  apply ht.trans
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => if j < k then a (ℓ + j) else 0) (N - ℓ),
    ← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hf : (Finset.range (N - ℓ)).filter (fun j => j < k) =
      Finset.range (min (N - ℓ) k) := by ext j; simp
  rw [hf]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (Nat.min_le_right _ _))
    (fun j _ _ => ha0 _)

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.leadingFactor_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem IsSVD.leadingFactor_mul_conjTranspose {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    h.leadingFactor ℓ * (h.leadingFactor ℓ)ᴴ =
      U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p =>
        if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSVD.leadingFactor, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (rectDiag (singularValues A)), rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.tail_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem IsSVD.tail_mul_conjTranspose {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ) * (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ)ᴴ =
      U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p =>
        if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then 0 else ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let T : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 :=
    rectDiag (fun i => if i < ℓ then 0 else singularValues A i)
  have he : A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ = U * T * Vᴴ := by
    have hd := h.eq_head_add_tail ℓ
    change A = h.truncatedMatrix ℓ + U * T * Vᴴ at hd
    calc
      _ = (h.truncatedMatrix ℓ + U * T * Vᴴ) - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ :=
        congrArg (fun M => M - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ) hd
      _ = _ := by abel
  rw [he, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V, h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc T, rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag]
  have hD : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p => if (i : ℕ) < q then
      ((((if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then 0 else singularValues A i) ^ 2 : ℝ)) : 𝕜) else 0)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p => if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then 0 else
        ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hiq : (i : ℕ) < q
    · by_cases hiℓ : (i : ℕ) < ℓ <;> simp [hiq, hiℓ]
    · have hz : singularValues A i = 0 := singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A
        (show Fintype.card n ≤ (i : ℕ) by rw [h.card_right]; omega)
      simp [hiq, hz]
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun D => U * D * Uᴴ) hD

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.sub_leadingFactor_gram_eq_tail_gram
statement:
theorem IsSVD.sub_leadingFactor_gram_eq_tail_gram {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    A * Aᴴ - h.leadingFactor ℓ * (h.leadingFactor ℓ)ᴴ =
      (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ) * (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.mul_conjTranspose_self, h.leadingFactor_mul_conjTranspose,
    h.tail_mul_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub,
    Matrix.diagonal_sub]
  have hCoeff : (fun i : Fin p => ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) -
      if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) =
      (fun i : Fin p => if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then 0 else ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < ℓ <;> simp [hi]
  exact congrArg (fun f : Fin p → 𝕜 => U * Matrix.diagonal f * Uᴴ) hCoeff

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_projector_tail_le_sum_shifted
proof:
:= by
  let R := Uᴴ * P * U
  have hsR : R.IsHermitian := by
    change (Uᴴ * P * U)ᴴ = Uᴴ * P * U
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hs.eq,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hpR : IsIdempotentElem R := by
    change (Uᴴ * P * U) * (Uᴴ * P * U) = Uᴴ * P * U
    calc
      _ = Uᴴ * (P * (U * Uᴴ) * P) * U := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [h.mul_conjTranspose_left, Matrix.mul_one, show P * P = P from hp]
  let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < p then RCLike.re (R ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨i, hi⟩) else 0
  have hw (i : ℕ) : w i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    dsimp only [w]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem R hsR hpR _
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
  have hbudget : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, w i ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range w p]
    simp only [w, dif_pos (Fin.isLt _)]
    rw [h.re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul P,
      trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem P hp, RCLike.natCast_re]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  have hCapture : frobSq (P * (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, if i < ℓ then 0 else singularValues A i ^ 2 * w i := by
    let T := A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ
    let D : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal (fun i =>
      if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then 0 else ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))
    have hPT : frobSq (P * T) = RCLike.re (P * (T * Tᴴ)).trace := by
      rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (P * T), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs.eq,
        frobSq_mul_projector_eq_re_trace_mul hs hp Tᴴ, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    change frobSq (P * T) = _
    rw [hPT, h.tail_mul_conjTranspose ℓ]
    calc
      _ = RCLike.re ((P * U) * D * Uᴴ).trace := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, D]
      _ = RCLike.re (Uᴴ * ((P * U) * D)).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      _ = RCLike.re (R * D).trace := by simp only [R, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = RCLike.re (D * R).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin p, if (i : ℕ) < ℓ then 0 else singularValues A i ^ 2 * w i := by
        simp only [D, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.diagonal_mul, map_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < ℓ <;> simp [hi, w, i.isLt]
      _ = _ := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i =>
        if i < ℓ then 0 else singularValues A i ^ 2 * w i) p
  rw [hCapture]
  exact sum_tail_mul_le_sum_shifted hℓp (fun i => sq_nonneg _) (by
    intro i j hij
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A j) (singularValues_antitone A hij) 2)
    (fun i => (hw i).1) (fun i => (hw i).2) hbudget

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mul_frobSq_projector_tail_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Antitone (fun i => singularValues A i ^ 2) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A j) (singularValues_antitone A hij) 2
  have hCapture := h.frobSq_projector_tail_le_sum_shifted hℓp hs hp hr
  have hAverage := ha.mul_sum_tail_le_mul_sum_block hkl
  have hSplit := frobSq_eq_sum_prefix_sq_add_bestRankFrobSq A k
  have hSum := frobSq_eq_sum_prefix_sq_add_bestRankFrobSq A (k + ℓ)
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add] at hSum
  have hTail0 : 0 ≤ bestRankFrobSq A (k + ℓ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hBlock : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, singularValues A (k + i) ^ 2) ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k := by
    linarith
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCapture (Nat.cast_nonneg ℓ)).trans
    (hAverage.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBlock (Nat.cast_nonneg k)))

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.sub_truncatedMatrix_eq_zero_of_min_le
statement:
theorem IsSVD.sub_truncatedMatrix_eq_zero_of_min_le {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V)
    {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ ℓ) :
    A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp
  rw [h.frobSq_sub_truncatedMatrix, bestRankFrobSq]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (hℓ.trans hi)]
    simp
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.det_gram_fromCols_eq_mul_frobSq_sub_projector
statement:
theorem det_gram_fromCols_eq_mul_frobSq_sub_projector
    {m k : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype k] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq k]
    (B : Matrix m k ℝ) (v : Matrix m (Fin 1) ℝ) :
    ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᵀ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det =
      (Bᵀ * B).det * frobSq (v - B * moorePenroseInverse B * v)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Bᵀ * B
  let P := B * moorePenroseInverse B
  by_cases hG : IsUnit G
  · let := hG.nonempty_invertible.some
    have hP : Pᵀ = P := (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B).eq
    have hPP : P * P = P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B
    have hcomp : (1 - P)ᵀ * (1 - P) = 1 - P := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one, hP, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub,
        Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hPP]
      abel
    have hleft : v - P * v = (1 - P) * v := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hf : frobSq (v - P * v) =
        (vᵀ * v - vᵀ * B * G⁻¹ * (Bᵀ * v)).trace := by
      rw [hleft, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (1 - P)ᵀ, hcomp]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc vᵀ, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.sub_mul]
      dsimp only [P, G]
      rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL B hG]
      simp only [pinvL, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hdet : ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᵀ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det =
        G.det * (vᵀ * v - vᵀ * B * G⁻¹ * (Bᵀ * v)).det := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols,
        Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
    rw [hdet]
    change G.det * (vᵀ * v - vᵀ * B * G⁻¹ * (Bᵀ * v)).det = G.det * frobSq (v - P * v)
    rw [hf]
    congr 1
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_one, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  · have hdet : G.det = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hG ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det G).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne))
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hGz⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hBz : B *ᵥ z = 0 := by
      have hker : z ∈ LinearMap.ker G.mulVecLin := hGz
      change z ∈ LinearMap.ker (Bᵀ * B).mulVecLin at hker
      rw [Matrix.ker_mulVecLin_transpose_mul_self] at hker
      exact hker
    let x : k ⊕ Fin 1 → ℝ := Sum.elim z (fun _ => 0)
    have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hx
      apply hz
      funext i
      exact congrFun hx (Sum.inl i)
    have hWx : Matrix.fromCols B v *ᵥ x = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec_sumElim, hBz]
      ext a
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    have hgram : ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᵀ * Matrix.fromCols B v) *ᵥ x = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hWx, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    have hdet' : ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᵀ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det = 0 :=
      Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp ⟨x, hx, hgram⟩
    change _ = G.det * _
    rw [hdet', hdet, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_idempotent_canonical
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_idempotent_canonical {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ g : ℕ, g ≤ min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ∧
    ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ Antitone t ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i ↔ i < g) ∧
    ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℂ,
      Hᴴ * H = 1 ∧ H * Hᴴ = 1 ∧
      Hᴴ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 ((rectDiag t).map Complex.ofReal) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, T, hH, hHt, hBlock⟩ := exists_unitary_idempotent_range_blocks P hP
  obtain ⟨V, W, hVW⟩ := exists_isSVD T
  have hV : Vᴴ * V = 1 := hVW.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hW : Wᴴ * W = 1 := hVW.conjTranspose_mul_right
  have hSVD : Vᴴ * T * W =
      (rectDiag (fun i => singularValues T i) : Matrix _ _ ℝ).map Complex.ofReal := by
    rw [hVW.conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    ext i j
    simp only [rectDiag, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.map_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  let K := Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 W
  have hK : Kᴴ * K = 1 := by
    simp only [K, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      add_zero, zero_add, hV, hW, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  have hpos (i : ℕ) : 0 < singularValues T i ↔ i < T.rank := singularValues_pos_iff T i
  refine ⟨T.rank, le_min T.rank_le_height T.rank_le_width,
    (fun i => singularValues T i), singularValues_nonneg T,
    singularValues_antitone T, hpos, H * K, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Hᴴ H K,
      hH, Matrix.one_mul, hK]
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc K Kᴴ Hᴴ,
      mul_eq_one_comm.mp hK, Matrix.one_mul, hHt]
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    calc
      _ = Kᴴ * (Hᴴ * P * H) * K := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hBlock]
        simp only [K, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero,
          Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
          add_zero, zero_add, Matrix.mul_one, hV]
        exact congrArg (fun B => Matrix.fromBlocks 1 B 0 0) hSVD

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_sq_eq_one_sub_singularValues_last_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_sq_eq_one_sub_singularValues_last_sq [Nonempty p]
    {P : Matrix m n ℝ} {Q : Matrix m p ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    specNorm (projResidual P Q) ^ 2 = 1 - singularValues (Pᵀ * Q) (Fintype.card p - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let C := Pᵀ * Q
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  let ep := Fintype.equivFin p
  let CF := C.reindex en ep
  have hp : 0 < Fintype.card p := Fintype.card_pos
  let last : Fin (Fintype.card p) := ⟨Fintype.card p - 1, by omega⟩
  have hNorm : specNorm CF ≤ 1 := by
    rw [specNorm_reindex]
    have hh := specNorm_mul_le Pᵀ Q
    rw [specNorm_transpose] at hh
    exact hh.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hP)
      (specNorm_nonneg Q)).trans (by simpa using specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hQ))
  have hBounds (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ singularValues CF i ∧ singularValues CF i ≤ 1 :=
    ⟨singularValues_nonneg CF i, (singularValues_le_specNorm CF i).trans hNorm⟩
  have hLast : 0 ≤ 1 - singularValues CF last ^ 2 := by
    have hb := hBounds last
    nlinarith
  have hPi : ‖(fun i : Fin (Fintype.card p) => singularValues CF i ^ 2 - 1)‖ =
      1 - singularValues CF last ^ 2 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hLast).2
      intro i
      have hb := hBounds i
      have hl := hBounds last
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (by nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2])]
      have hOrder := singularValues_antitone CF (show i.val ≤ last.val by
        dsimp only [last]
        omega)
      nlinarith
    · have hh := norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card p) => singularValues CF i ^ 2 - 1) last
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)] at hh
      linarith
  have hGramNorm := specNorm_gram_sub_one_eq_norm_singularValues_sq_sub_one CF
  have hGramTransport : CFᵀ * CF - 1 = (Cᵀ * C - 1).reindex ep ep := by
    simp only [CF, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
    change _ = (Cᵀ * C).submatrix ep.symm ep.symm -
      (1 : Matrix p p ℝ).submatrix ep.symm ep.symm
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  rw [hGramTransport, specNorm_reindex, specNorm_sub_comm, hPi] at hGramNorm
  have hSigma : singularValues C (Fintype.card p - 1) = singularValues CF last := by
    rw [singularValues_reindex]
  have hResidual := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self (projResidual P Q)
  have hGram := conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap hP hQ
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hGram
  rw [hGram] at hResidual
  exact hResidual.trans (hGramNorm.trans (by rw [hSigma]))

name: NLAlib.specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_tan_last
statement:
theorem specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_tan_last {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hC : IsUnit (Pᵀ * Q)) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    specNorm (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q) =
      Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, by omega⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let C := (Pᵀ * Q).reindex e e
  have hUnit : IsUnit C := hC.map (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv ℝ e).toMonoidHom
  have hRank : C.rank = Fintype.card n := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Matrix.rank_of_isUnit C hUnit
  have hSigma : 0 < singularValues C last := (singularValues_pos_iff C last).mpr (by
    rw [hRank]
    exact last.isLt)
  have hAngleLast : principalAnglesFintype P Q last < Real.pi / 2 := by
    simpa only [principalAnglesFintype, C, singularValues_reindex,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr hSigma
  have hRangeLast := principalAngles_mem_Icc hP hQ last
  have hTanLast : 0 ≤ Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q last) :=
    Real.tan_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi_div_two hRangeLast.1 hRangeLast.2
  rw [tangentPrincipalAngles, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hTanLast).2
    intro i
    have hRange := principalAngles_mem_Icc hP hQ i
    have hOrder := principalAngles_monotone P Q (show i ≤ last by
      change i.val ≤ Fintype.card n - 1
      omega)
    have hAngle : principalAnglesFintype P Q i < Real.pi / 2 := hOrder.trans_lt hAngleLast
    have hTan : 0 ≤ Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q i) :=
      Real.tan_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi_div_two hRange.1 hRange.2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hTan]
    exact Real.strictMonoOn_tan.monotoneOn
      ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hRange.1], hAngle⟩
      ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hRangeLast.1], hAngleLast⟩ hOrder
  · have hh := norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q i)) last
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hTanLast] at hh

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_mul_inv_sq_eq_div_residual_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_mul_inv_sq_eq_div_residual_sq {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hC : IsUnit (Pᵀ * Q)) :
    specNorm (projResidual P Q * (Pᵀ * Q)⁻¹) ^ 2 =
      specNorm (projResidual P Q) ^ 2 / (1 - specNorm (projResidual P Q) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have hR : projResidual P Q = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hR, specNorm_zero]
  · have hn : 0 < Fintype.card n := Fintype.card_pos
    let last : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, by omega⟩
    have hSin : specNorm (projResidual P Q) = Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q last) :=
      (specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ).symm.trans
        (specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sin_last hP hQ hn)
    have hTan : specNorm (projResidual P Q * (Pᵀ * Q)⁻¹) =
        Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q last) :=
      (specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_residual_mul_inv hP hQ hC).symm.trans
        (specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_tan_last hP hQ hC hn)
    rw [hSin, hTan, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, div_pow]
    congr 1
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (principalAnglesFintype P Q last)]

name: NLAlib.principal_angle_characterizations
statement:
theorem principal_angle_characterizations {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix m r ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R)
    (hcomp : P*Pᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1) :
    (Monotone (principalAnglesFintype P Q)) ∧
    (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype P Q i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi/2) ∧
      Real.cos (principalAnglesFintype P Q i)=singularValues
        ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i) ∧
    (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=specNorm (Rᵀ*Q)) ∧
    (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=specNorm (projResidual P Q)) ∧
    (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=specNorm (P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)) ∧
    (frobSq (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=(Fintype.card n : ℝ)-frobSq (Pᵀ*Q)) ∧
    (frobSq (P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)=2*frobSq (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)) ∧
    (frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=frobNorm (Rᵀ*Q)) ∧
    (principalAnglesFintype P Q=principalAnglesFintype Q P) ∧
    (∀ P' Q' : Matrix m n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols P' → HasOrthonormalCols Q' →
      LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range P'.mulVecLin →
      LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin →
        principalAnglesFintype P Q=principalAnglesFintype P' Q') ∧
    (∀ hn : 0 < Fintype.card n, specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=
      Real.sqrt (1-singularValues ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n))
        (Fintype.card n-1)^2)) ∧
    (IsUnit (Pᵀ*Q) → specNorm (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q)=specNorm ((Rᵀ*Q)*(Pᵀ*Q)⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ hn : 0 < Fintype.card n,
      principalAnglesFintype P Q ⟨Fintype.card n-1, by omega⟩ < Real.pi/2 →
      specNorm (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q)=specNorm ((Rᵀ*Q)*(Pᵀ*Q)⁻¹)) ∧
    (Fintype.card n=0 → specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=0 ∧
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=0 ∧ specNorm (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q)=0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨principalAngles_monotone P Q, ?_,
    specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hP hQ hR hcomp,
    specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ,
    specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_projector_distance hP hQ,
    frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_card_sub_overlap hP hQ,
    frobSq_projector_distance_eq_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles hP hQ,
    frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hP hQ hR hcomp,
    principalAngles_comm P Q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact ⟨principalAngles_mem_Icc hP hQ i, cos_principalAngles hP hQ i⟩
  · intro P' Q' hP' hQ' hrP hrQ
    exact principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq hP hP' hQ hQ' hrP hrQ
  · intro hn
    exact specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sqrt_one_sub_last_sq hP hQ hn
  · intro hC
    exact specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap_mul_inv hP hQ hR hcomp hC
  · intro hn hang
    exact specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap_mul_inv hP hQ hR hcomp
      (isUnit_overlap_of_principalAngles_last_lt_pi_div_two hn hang)
  · intro hn
    have hs : sinePrincipalAngles P Q=0 := by ext i j; have hi := i.isLt; omega
    have ht : tangentPrincipalAngles P Q=0 := by ext i j; have hi := i.isLt; omega
    simp [hs, ht, specNorm_zero]

name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_le_of_range_le
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_le_of_range_le {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [DecidableEq a] [Fintype b]
    [DecidableEq b] (Q : Matrix n k ℝ) {Y : Matrix n a ℝ} {Z : Matrix n b ℝ}
    (hY : HasOrthonormalCols Y) (hZ : HasOrthonormalCols Z)
    (hle : LinearMap.range Z.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Y.mulVecLin) :
    directedSubspaceGap Q Z ≤ directedSubspaceGap Q Y
proof:
:= by
  have hZY : Y * (Yᵀ * Z) = Z := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hY hle
  have hU : (Yᵀ * Z)ᵀ * (Yᵀ * Z) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Y, Matrix.mul_assoc Y, hZY]
    exact hZ
  calc directedSubspaceGap Q Z = specNorm (projResidual Q Y * (Yᵀ * Z)) := by
        rw [directedSubspaceGap, residual_mul, hZY]
    _ ≤ specNorm (projResidual Q Y) * specNorm (Yᵀ * Z) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm (projResidual Q Y) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = directedSubspaceGap Q Y := mul_one _

name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_congr_right
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_congr_right {k₂ : Type*} [Fintype k₂] [DecidableEq k₂] (Q : Matrix n k ℝ)
    {Q' : Matrix n k' ℝ} {Q'' : Matrix n k₂ ℝ} (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (hQ'' : HasOrthonormalCols Q'')
    (h : LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Q''.mulVecLin) :
    directedSubspaceGap Q Q' = directedSubspaceGap Q Q''
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (directedSubspaceGap_le_of_range_le Q hQ'' hQ' h.le)
    (directedSubspaceGap_le_of_range_le Q hQ' hQ'' h.ge)

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_mul_right
statement:
theorem overlapTangentNorm_mul_right (Q : Matrix n k ℝ) (X : Matrix n k ℝ) {R : Matrix k k ℝ}
    (hR : IsUnit R) : overlapTangentNorm Q (X * R) = overlapTangentNorm Q X
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : R * R⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).1 hR)
  rw [overlapTangentNorm, overlapTangentNorm, ← residual_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_inv_rev,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc R, hR', Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_mul_of_range_le
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ z : a → ℝ, X *ᵥ z = Y.col j := fun j =>
    h (Matrix.range_mulVecLin Y ▸ Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  choose z hz using hc
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun i j => z j i, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  have hij := congrFun (hz j) i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col_apply] at hij
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply]
  exact hij.symm

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_eq_of_range_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := exists_eq_mul_of_range_le h.ge
  obtain ⟨R', hR'⟩ := exists_eq_mul_of_range_le h.le
  
  have hdX := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 hX
  have hdY : IsUnit (Qᵀ * Y).det := by
    rw [hR', ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.det_mul] at hdX
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hdX
  have hdR : IsUnit R.det := by
    have := hdY
    rw [hR, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.det_mul] at this
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right this
  rw [hR, overlapTangentNorm_mul_right Q X ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).2 hdR)]

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_congr_left
statement:
theorem overlapTangentNorm_congr_left {Q P : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (h : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
    (X : Matrix n k ℝ) : overlapTangentNorm Q X = overlapTangentNorm P X
proof:
:= by
  have hPQ : Q * (Qᵀ * P) = P := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ h.ge
  set W := Qᵀ * P with hWdef
  have hW : Wᵀ * W = 1 := by
    rw [hWdef, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hWdef, hPQ]
    exact hP
  have hW' : W * Wᵀ = 1 := (Matrix.mul_eq_one_comm_of_equiv (Equiv.refl k)).1 hW
  have hPt : Pᵀ * X = Wᵀ * (Qᵀ * X) := by
    rw [← hPQ, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hWinv : Wᵀ⁻¹ = W := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hW'
  rw [overlapTangentNorm, overlapTangentNorm, hPt, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hWinv, ← residual_eq_of_range_eq hQ hP h,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hWt : Wᵀᵀ * Wᵀ = 1 := by rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]; exact hW'
  conv_rhs => rw [← Matrix.transpose_transpose W]
  exact (specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hWt _).symm
