name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_eq_zero_of_range_le
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_eq_zero_of_range_le {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {Q : Matrix n k 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (X : Matrix n k' 𝕜)
    (h : LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    directedSubspaceGap Q X = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [directedSubspaceGap, projResidual, mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ h,
    sub_self, specNorm_zero]

name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (Q : Matrix n k ℝ) {Qp : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp)
    (hc : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) (X : Matrix n k' ℝ) :
    directedSubspaceGap Q X = specNorm (Qpᵀ * X)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : projResidual Q X = Qp * (Qpᵀ * X) := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← hc,
      add_sub_cancel_left, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hQp' : Qpᵀ * Qp = 1 := hQp
  rw [directedSubspaceGap, hres]
  refine (specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_eq_mul hQp' ?_).symm.trans ?_
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qpᵀ, hQp', Matrix.one_mul]
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qpᵀ, hQp', Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem overlapTangentNorm_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_mul {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (Q : Matrix n k ℝ) {Qp : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp)
    (hc : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) (X : Matrix n k ℝ) :
    overlapTangentNorm Q X = specNorm (Qpᵀ * X * (Qᵀ * X)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : projResidual Q X = Qp * (Qpᵀ * X) := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← hc,
      add_sub_cancel_left, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hQp' : Qpᵀ * Qp = 1 := hQp
  rw [overlapTangentNorm, hres, Matrix.mul_assoc Qp]
  refine (specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_eq_mul hQp' ?_).symm.trans ?_
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qpᵀ, hQp', Matrix.one_mul]
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qpᵀ, hQp', Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_eq_card_sub
proof:
:= by

  rw [frobSq_residual_eq_sub hQ, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, frobSq,

name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_eq_sqrt_one_sub_sq_singularValues
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_eq_sqrt_one_sub_sq_singularValues {r r' : ℕ} {Q : Matrix n (Fin r) ℝ}
    {Q' : Matrix n (Fin r') ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (hr' : 0 < r') (hrr : r' ≤ r) :
    directedSubspaceGap Q Q' = √(1 - singularValues (Qᵀ * Q') (r' - 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hrr
  let : Nonempty (Fin r') := ⟨⟨0, hr'⟩⟩
  have h : directedSubspaceGap Q Q' ^ 2 = 1 - singularValues (Qᵀ * Q') (Fintype.card (Fin r') - 1) ^ 2 :=
    specNorm_residual_sq_eq_one_sub_singularValues_last_sq hQ hQ'
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  rw [← h, Real.sqrt_sq (directedSubspaceGap_nonneg Q Q')]

name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_eq_sin_principalAngles
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_eq_sin_principalAngles {Q Q' : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q') (hk : 0 < Fintype.card k) :
    directedSubspaceGap Q Q' =
      Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype Q Q' ⟨Fintype.card k - 1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [directedSubspaceGap, ← specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hQ hQ',
    specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sin_last hQ hQ' hk]

name: NLAlib.directedSubspaceGap_lt_one_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem directedSubspaceGap_lt_one_iff_isUnit {Q Q' : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q') : directedSubspaceGap Q Q' < 1 ↔ IsUnit (Qᵀ * Q')
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty k with hk | hk
  · have hR : projResidual Q Q' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hUnit := isUnit_of_subsingleton (Qᵀ * Q')
    exact ⟨fun _ => hUnit, fun _ => by simp [directedSubspaceGap, hR, specNorm_zero]⟩
  · have hEq : directedSubspaceGap Q Q' ^ 2 = 1 - singularValues (Qᵀ * Q') (Fintype.card k - 1) ^ 2 :=
      specNorm_residual_sq_eq_one_sub_singularValues_last_sq hQ hQ'
    have hNonneg := directedSubspaceGap_nonneg Q Q'
    have hBound := directedSubspaceGap_le_one hQ hQ'
    have hSigma := singularValues_nonneg (Qᵀ * Q') (Fintype.card k - 1)
    rw [← singularValues_last_pos_iff_isUnit]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sq_tanThetaMax_eq_div

name: NLAlib.tanThetaMax_eq_tan_principalAngles
statement:
theorem tanThetaMax_eq_tan_principalAngles {Q X : Matrix n k ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hX : HasOrthonormalCols X)
    (hC : IsUnit (Qᵀ * X)) (hk : 0 < Fintype.card k) :
    tanThetaMax Q X hQ hC =
      Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype Q X ⟨Fintype.card k - 1, by omega⟩)
proof:

  rw [← specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_residual_mul_inv hQ hX hC]
  exact specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_tan_last hQ hX hC hk

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_csCanonicalMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_csCanonicalMatrix {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (c : p → ℝ) (E : Matrix q p ℝ) (hE : HasOrthonormalCols E)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : HasOrthonormalCols (csCanonicalMatrix c E)
proof:
:= by
  let C := Matrix.diagonal c
  let S := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.sqrt (1 - c i ^ 2))
  let R := E * C * Eᵀ + 1 - E * Eᵀ
  have hCt : Cᵀ = C := Matrix.diagonal_transpose _
  have hSt : Sᵀ = S := Matrix.diagonal_transpose _
  have hSum : C * C + S * S = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
      have hNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - c i ^ 2 := by nlinarith [(hc i).1, (hc i).2]
      rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hNonneg]
      ring
    · simp [Matrix.add_apply, hij]
  have hCS : C * S = S * C := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have hRt : Rᵀ = R := by
    dsimp [R]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_one, hCt, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hRE : R * E = E * C := by
    dsimp [R]
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [(show Eᵀ * E = 1 from hE), Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_one]
    abel
  have hER : Eᵀ * R = C * Eᵀ := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose hRE
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, hRt, hCt] using h
  have hRR : R * R = E * C * C * Eᵀ + 1 - E * Eᵀ := by
    calc
      R * R = R * E * C * Eᵀ + R - R * E * Eᵀ := by
        nth_rw 2 [show R = E * C * Eᵀ + 1 - E * Eᵀ from rfl]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = E * C * C * Eᵀ + 1 - E * Eᵀ := by
        rw [hRE]
        dsimp [R]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        abel
  have h11 : Cᵀ * C + (-E * S)ᵀ * (-E * S) = 1 := by
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_neg, hCt, hSt,
      Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, neg_neg, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Eᵀ E S, (show Eᵀ * E = 1 from hE), Matrix.one_mul]
    exact hSum
  have h12 : Cᵀ * (S * Eᵀ) + (-E * S)ᵀ * R = 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_neg, hCt, hSt,
      Matrix.neg_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc S Eᵀ R, hER, ← Matrix.mul_assoc S C Eᵀ, ← hCS]
    abel
  have h21 : (S * Eᵀ)ᵀ * C + Rᵀ * (-E * S) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose h12
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      Matrix.transpose_zero] using h
  have h22 : (S * Eᵀ)ᵀ * (S * Eᵀ) + Rᵀ * R = 1 := by
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hSt, hRt]
    rw [hRR]
    have hPair : (E * S) * (S * Eᵀ) + E * C * C * Eᵀ = E * Eᵀ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc S S Eᵀ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc C C Eᵀ,
        ← Matrix.add_mul]
      rw [add_comm (S * S) (C * C), hSum, Matrix.one_mul]
    calc
      _ = ((E * S) * (S * Eᵀ) + E * C * C * Eᵀ) + 1 - E * Eᵀ := by abel
      _ = 1 := by rw [hPair]; abel
  change (Matrix.fromBlocks C (S * Eᵀ) (-E * S) R)ᵀ *
    Matrix.fromBlocks C (S * Eᵀ) (-E * S) R = 1
  rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, h11, h12, h21, h22,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ g : ℕ, g ≤ min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ∧
    ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ Antitone t ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i ↔ i < g) ∧
    ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols H ∧ H * Hᵀ = 1 ∧
      Hᵀ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag t) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, T, hH, hHt, hBlock⟩ := exists_orthogonal_idempotent_range_blocks P hP
  obtain ⟨V, W, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD T
  let K := Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 W
  have hK : HasOrthonormalCols K := by
    change (Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 W)ᵀ * Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 W = 1
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add,
      show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left,
      show Wᵀ * W = 1 from hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  refine ⟨T.rank, le_min T.rank_le_height T.rank_le_width,
    singularValues T, singularValues_nonneg T, singularValues_antitone T,
    singularValues_pos_iff T, H * K, hH.mul hK, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc K Kᵀ Hᵀ,
      show K * Kᵀ = 1 from mul_eq_one_comm.mp hK, Matrix.one_mul, hHt]
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
    calc
      (Kᵀ * Hᵀ) * P * (H * K) = Kᵀ * (Hᵀ * P * H) * K := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag (singularValues T)) 0 0 := by
        rw [hBlock]
        simp only [K, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero,
          Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
          add_zero, zero_add, Matrix.mul_one, show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left,
          show Vᵀ * T * W = rectDiag (singularValues T) from hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_mul]

name: NLAlib.unitary_gram_mul
statement:
private theorem unitary_gram_mul {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {X Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : Xᴴ * X = 1) (hY : Yᴴ * Y = 1) :
    (X * Y)ᴴ * (X * Y) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Xᴴ X Y,
    hX, Matrix.one_mul, hY]

name: NLAlib.unitary_gram_blockDiagonal
statement:
private theorem unitary_gram_blockDiagonal {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    {A : Matrix p p ℂ} {B : Matrix q q ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ * A = 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B = 1) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B)ᴴ * Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero,
    zero_add, hA, hB, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_complex_cs_decomposition_of_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_complex_cs_decomposition_of_embedding {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (e : p ↪ q) :
    let c
proof:
:= fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁ ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
    (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∃ V₁ W₁ : Matrix p p ℂ, ∃ V₂ W₂ : Matrix q q ℂ,
      V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1 ∧ W₁ᴴ * W₁ = 1 ∧ V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1 ∧ W₂ᴴ * W₂ = 1 ∧
      (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)ᴴ * U * Matrix.fromBlocks W₁ 0 0 W₂ =
        (csCanonicalMatrix c ((1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e)).map Complex.ofRealHom := by
  dsimp only
  let c := fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁ ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
  let C : Matrix p p ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (c i : ℂ))
  let S : Matrix p p ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (Real.sqrt (1 - c i ^ 2) : ℂ))
  let E₀ := (1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e
  let E := E₀.map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hE₀ : HasOrthonormalCols E₀ := by
    have h : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
    exact h.submatrix_cols e
  have hE : Eᴴ * E = 1 := by
    rw [show Eᴴ = E₀ᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom from by ext; simp [E],
      ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := E₀ᵀ) (M := E₀), (show E₀ᵀ * E₀ = 1 from hE₀)]
    simp
  obtain ⟨V₀, W₀, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD U.toBlocks₁₁
  let ep := Fintype.equivFin p
  let V : Matrix p p ℂ := V₀.submatrix id ep
  let W : Matrix p p ℂ := W₀.submatrix id ep
  have hsq {X : Matrix p (Fin (Fintype.card p)) ℂ} (hX : Xᴴ * X = 1) :
      (X.submatrix id ep)ᴴ * X.submatrix id ep = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, ← Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hX,
      Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  have hV : Vᴴ * V = 1 := hsq hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hW : Wᴴ * W = 1 := hsq hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right
  have hVt : V * Vᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 hV
  have hVW : Vᴴ * U.toBlocks₁₁ * W = C := by
    have h := hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_mul
    ext i j
    have hij := congrArg (fun M => M (ep i) (ep j)) h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal] at hij
    simp only [V, W, C, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
      id_eq, Matrix.diagonal_apply, c]
    rw [hij]
    by_cases hij' : i = j
    · subst hij'; simp [ep]
    · have : ((ep i : ℕ) = ep j) ↔ False := ⟨fun h => hij' (ep.injective (Fin.ext h)), False.elim⟩
      simp [hij', this]
  let D := U.toBlocks₂₁ * W
  let M := Matrix.fromBlocks C (Vᴴ * U.toBlocks₁₂) D U.toBlocks₂₂
  have hMForm : Matrix.fromBlocks Vᴴ 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℂ) * U *
      Matrix.fromBlocks W 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℂ) = M := by
    conv_lhs => arg 1; arg 2; rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks U]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, hVW]
    rfl
  have hM : Mᴴ * M = 1 := by
    rw [← hMForm]
    exact unitary_gram_mul (unitary_gram_mul
      (unitary_gram_blockDiagonal (by simpa using hVt) (by simp)) hU)
      (unitary_gram_blockDiagonal hW (by simp))
  have hCt : Cᴴ = C := by simp [C, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
  have hSt : Sᴴ = S := by simp [S, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
  have hGram : C * C + Dᴴ * D = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₁₁ hM
    simpa only [M, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₁, hCt,
      show (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ).toBlocks₁₁ = 1 by
        ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₁₁, Matrix.one_apply]] using h
  have hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hci : 0 ≤ c i := singularValues_nonneg _ _
    have hdiag := congrArg (fun A : Matrix p p ℂ => (A i i).re) hGram
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (Dᴴ * D) i i := (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self D).diag_nonneg
    have hnonneg' : 0 ≤ ((Dᴴ * D) i i).re := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hnonneg).1
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, C, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal,
      Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq, Complex.add_re,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero,
      Complex.one_re] at hdiag
    exact ⟨hci, by nlinarith⟩
  have hCS : C * C + S * S = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
      have hs := Real.mul_self_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - c i ^ 2 by nlinarith [(hc i).1, (hc i).2])
      norm_cast
      nlinarith [hs]
    · simp [Matrix.add_apply, hij]
  have hSD : (-E * S)ᴴ * (-E * S) = Dᴴ * D := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_neg, hSt,
      Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, neg_neg, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Eᴴ E S, hE, Matrix.one_mul]
    exact add_left_cancel (hCS.trans hGram.symm)
  obtain ⟨O₀, hOD⟩ := exists_unitary_mul_eq_of_gram_eq (-E * S) D hSD
  let O := (O₀ : Matrix q q ℂ)
  have hOD' : O * D = -E * S := hOD
  have hO : Oᴴ * O = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self O₀
  let N := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix p p ℂ) 0 0 O * M
  have hN : Nᴴ * N = 1 := unitary_gram_mul (unitary_gram_blockDiagonal (by simp) hO) hM
  let K := (csCanonicalMatrix c E₀).map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hK : Kᴴ * K = 1 := by
    rw [show Kᴴ = (csCanonicalMatrix c E₀)ᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom from by ext; simp [K],
      ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom)
        (L := (csCanonicalMatrix c E₀)ᵀ) (M := csCanonicalMatrix c E₀), show (csCanonicalMatrix c E₀)ᵀ * csCanonicalMatrix c E₀ = 1 from
        hasOrthonormalCols_csCanonicalMatrix c E₀ hE₀ hc]
    simp
  have hFirst : N.submatrix id Sum.inl = K.submatrix id Sum.inl := by
    dsimp [N, M, K, csCanonicalMatrix]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul,
      add_zero, zero_add, hOD', Matrix.fromBlocks_map]
    ext i j
    cases i with
    | inl i => simp [C, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    | inr i =>
      change (-E * S) i j = ((-E₀ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.sqrt (1 - c i ^ 2))).map Complex.ofRealHom) i j
      rw [Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := -E₀)
        (M := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.sqrt (1 - c i ^ 2)))]
      simp [E, S, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hNZ⟩ := exists_unitary_right_block_of_first_columns_eq N K hN hK hFirst
  refine ⟨hc, V, W, Oᴴ, Z, hV, hW, ?_, hZ, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using (mul_eq_one_comm.mp hO)
  · have hLeft : Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix p p ℂ) 0 0 O *
        Matrix.fromBlocks Vᴴ 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℂ) = (Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 Oᴴ)ᴴ := by
      simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose]
    have hRight : Matrix.fromBlocks W 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℂ) *
        Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix p p ℂ) 0 0 Z = Matrix.fromBlocks W 0 0 Z := by
      simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    dsimp only [N] at hNZ
    rw [← hMForm] at hNZ
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hLeft, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_assoc, hRight] at hNZ
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hNZ

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_mul_eq
    (Q : Matrix m k ℂ) (Y : Matrix m l ℂ)
    (h : rangeProjector Q * Y = Y) (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ≤ ‖A - rangeProjector Y * A‖
proof:
:= by
  have hp := rangeProjector_mul_rangeProjector_of_mul_eq h
  have he : A - rangeProjector Q * A =
      (A - rangeProjector Y * A) -
        rangeProjector Q * (A - rangeProjector Y * A) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hp]
    abel
  rw [he]
  exact norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le _ _

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le_of_mul_eq

proof:

  have hp := rangeProjector_mul_rangeProjector_of_mul_eq h
  have he : A - rangeProjector Q * A =
      (A - rangeProjector Y * A) -

name: NLAlib.cs_decomposition_properties
statement:
theorem cs_decomposition_properties {p q n : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hCard : Fintype.card p ≤ Fintype.card q)
    (P : Matrix n n ℝ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    (∃ e : p ↪ q,
      let c := fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁ ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
      (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ∃ V₁ W₁ : Matrix p p ℝ, ∃ V₂ W₂ : Matrix q q ℝ,
        HasOrthonormalCols V₁ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W₁ ∧
        HasOrthonormalCols V₂ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W₂ ∧
        (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)ᵀ * U * Matrix.fromBlocks W₁ 0 0 W₂ =
          csCanonicalMatrix c ((1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e)) ∧
    U.toBlocks₁₂.rank = U.toBlocks₂₁.rank ∧
    U.toBlocks₂₂.rank = U.toBlocks₁₁.rank + Fintype.card q - Fintype.card p ∧
    (∃ g : ℕ, g ≤ min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ∧
      ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ Antitone t ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i ↔ i < g) ∧
      ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ,
        HasOrthonormalCols H ∧ H * Hᵀ = 1 ∧
        Hᵀ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag t) 0 0 ∧
        (∀ i, singularValues P i =
          if i < P.rank then Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) else 0) ∧
        (∀ i, 1 < singularValues P i ↔ i < g) ∧
        (∀ i < g, t i = Real.sqrt (singularValues P i ^ 2 - 1))) ∧
    (∀ hr : 0 < P.rank, ∃ Q W : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin ∧
      LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ ∧
      let θ := principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨P.rank - 1, by simpa using Nat.sub_lt hr Nat.one_pos⟩
      (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype W Q i ≤ θ) ∧
      θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ specNorm P = 1 / Real.cos θ) ∧
    (0 < P.rank → P.rank < Fintype.card n → specNorm (1 - P) = specNorm P) ∧
    (P.rank = 0 → specNorm P = 0 ∧
      specNorm (1 - P) = if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧
    (P.rank = Fintype.card n →
      specNorm P = (if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧ specNorm (1 - P) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hCard
  refine ⟨⟨e, exists_cs_decomposition_of_embedding U hU e⟩,
    rank_offDiagonal_blocks_eq_of_orthogonal U hU,
    rank_bottomRight_eq_rank_topLeft_add_card_sub_of_orthogonal U hU hCard,
    exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical_spectrum P hP, ?_,
    specNorm_one_sub_eq_of_idempotent_of_rank_pos_lt hP,
    (specNorm_idempotent_rank_endpoints hP).1, (specNorm_idempotent_rank_endpoints hP).2⟩
  intro hr
  exact exists_range_kernel_frames_specNorm_eq_secant P hP hr

name: NLAlib.norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_eq_of_gram_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix p n ℝ)
    (hGram : Aᵀ * A = Bᵀ * B) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖ = ‖B.toEuclideanLin x‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ x.ofLp) hGram
  rw [← show (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) = x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ x.ofLp) from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self A x.ofLp,
    ← show (B *ᵥ x.ofLp) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x.ofLp) = x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((Bᵀ * B) *ᵥ x.ofLp) from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self B x.ofLp] at h
  change ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 =
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ x.ofLp) : EuclideanSpace ℝ p)‖ ^ 2
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simpa only [dotProduct, sq] using h

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_toEuclideanLin_symm
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_toEuclideanLin_symm (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : Matrix m n ℝ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.toLinearMap
  have hQ : Q.toEuclideanLin = L.toLinearMap := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply _
  show Qᵀ * Q = 1
  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
  calc
    (Qᵀ * Q).toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.adjoint Q.toEuclideanLin ∘ₗ Q.toEuclideanLin := by
      rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint]
      simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    _ = LinearMap.id := by rw [hQ]; exact L.adjoint_comp_self'
    _ = (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).toEuclideanLin := by
      simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_gram_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (R : Matrix p n ℝ)
    (hGram : Aᵀ * A = Rᵀ * R) : A * moorePenroseInverse R * R = A
proof:
:= by
  let F : Matrix n n ℝ := 1 - moorePenroseInverse R * R
  have hRF : R * F = 0 := by
    simp only [F, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul, sub_self]
  have hAF : A * F = 0 := by
    apply Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_zero.mp
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul]
    calc
      Fᵀ * Aᵀ * (A * F) = Fᵀ * (Rᵀ * R) * F := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Aᵀ A F, hGram]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hRF, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero]
  simp only [F, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hAF
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hAF).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq [DecidableEq m] (A B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hGram : Aᵀ * A = Bᵀ * B) :
    ∃ U : Matrix m m ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ U * B = A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := LinearMap.range B.toEuclideanLin
  have hReconstruct : A * moorePenroseInverse B * B = A :=
    mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_gram_eq A B hGram
  let L : S →ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ m :=
    { toLinearMap := (A * moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin.comp S.subtype
      norm_map' := by
        intro z
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := z.property
        have hApply : (A * moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin
            (B.toEuclideanLin x) = A.toEuclideanLin x := by
          rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply]
          rw [← Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
          exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => M.toEuclideanLin x) hReconstruct
        change ‖(A * moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin z.val‖ = ‖z.val‖
        rw [← hx, hApply]
        exact norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_eq_of_gram_eq A B hGram x }
  let U : Matrix m m ℝ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.extend.toLinearMap
  refine ⟨U, hasOrthonormalCols_toEuclideanLin_symm L.extend, ?_⟩
  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hU : U.toEuclideanLin = L.extend.toLinearMap :=
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply _
  have hExtend := L.extend_apply ⟨B.toEuclideanLin x, LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x⟩
  have hApply : (A * moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin
      (B.toEuclideanLin x) = A.toEuclideanLin x := by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [← Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
    exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => M.toEuclideanLin x) hReconstruct
  calc
    (U * B).toEuclideanLin x = U.toEuclideanLin (B.toEuclideanLin x) := by
      simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    _ = L.extend (B.toEuclideanLin x) := congrArg (fun T => T (B.toEuclideanLin x)) hU
    _ = L ⟨B.toEuclideanLin x, LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x⟩ := hExtend
    _ = (A * moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin (B.toEuclideanLin x) := rfl
    _ = A.toEuclideanLin x := hApply

name: NLAlib.exists_hasOrthonormalCols_of_card_le
statement:
theorem exists_hasOrthonormalCols_of_card_le (hCard : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) :
    ∃ J : Matrix m n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : n ↪ m :=
    { toFun := fun j => (Fintype.equivFin m).symm
        ⟨((Fintype.equivFin n) j).val, ((Fintype.equivFin n) j).isLt.trans_le hCard⟩
      inj' := by
        intro i j hij
        apply (Fintype.equivFin n).injective
        apply Fin.ext
        have h := congrArg (fun k => ((Fintype.equivFin m) k).val) hij
        simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h }
  refine ⟨(1 : Matrix m m ℝ).submatrix id e, ?_⟩
  have hOne : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
  exact hOne.submatrix_cols e

name: NLAlib.singularValues_oblique_canonical
statement:
theorem singularValues_oblique_canonical {r s : ℕ} (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (ht : Antitone t)
    (hz : ∀ i, min r s ≤ i → t i = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
      (rectDiag t : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℝ) 0
      (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ)) k =
      if k < r then Real.sqrt (1 + t k ^ 2) else 0
proof:
:= by
  let N := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (rectDiag t : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℝ) 0 (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ)
  let D := Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin r => Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2)))
    (0 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℝ) 0 (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ)
  let d := fun i : ℕ => if i < r then Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) else 0
  have hd0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i := by intro i; dsimp [d]; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hd : Antitone d := by
    intro i j hij
    dsimp [d]
    split_ifs with hj hi hi
    · exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [ht hij, ht0 i, ht0 j])
    · omega
    · positivity
    · rfl
  have hGram : N * Nᵀ = D * Dᵀ := by
    dsimp [N, D]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.transpose_zero,
      Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      add_zero, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal,
      show (rectDiag t : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℝ) * (rectDiag t)ᵀ =
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin r => if (i : ℕ) < s then t i ^ 2 else 0) from
        rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag t]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
      rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by positivity)]
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < s
      · simp [hi]
      · rw [if_neg hi, hz i (min_le_right r s |>.trans (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi))]
        norm_num
    · simp [Matrix.add_apply, hij]
  have hND : singularValues N k = singularValues D k := by
    rw [← singularValues_transpose N, ← singularValues_transpose D]
    apply singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hGram
  have hD : D = (rectDiag d : Matrix (Fin (r + s)) (Fin (r + s)) ℝ).reindex
      finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm := by
    ext i j
    cases i with
    | inl i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j =>
        simp [D, Matrix.reindex_apply, rectDiag_apply, d,
          Matrix.diagonal_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
      | inr j =>
        have hij : (i : ℕ) ≠ r + j := by omega
        simp [D, Matrix.reindex_apply, rectDiag_apply, hij]
    | inr i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j =>
        have hij : r + (i : ℕ) ≠ j := by omega
        simp [D, Matrix.reindex_apply, rectDiag_apply, hij]
      | inr j =>
        simp [D, Matrix.reindex_apply, rectDiag_apply, d]
  rw [hND, hD, singularValues_reindex]
  change singularValues (rectDiag d : Matrix (Fin (r + s)) (Fin (r + s)) ℝ) k = d k
  by_cases hk : k < r + s
  · exact singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
      (U := (1 : Matrix (Fin (r + s)) (Fin (r + s)) ℝ))
      (V := (1 : Matrix (Fin (r + s)) (Fin (r + s)) ℝ))
      (by simp) (by simp) hd0 hd (by simp) (by simpa using hk)
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le _
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hk)]
    simp only [d, if_neg (show ¬k < r by omega)]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_eq_right_projection_add_residual
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_eq_right_projection_add_residual
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ‖A‖ ^ 2 = ‖A * P‖ ^ 2 + ‖A * (1 - P)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : (A * P)ᴴ * (A * P) = P * (Aᴴ * A) * P := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hright : (A * (1 - P))ᴴ * (A * (1 - P)) =
      (1 - P) * (Aᴴ * A) * (1 - P) := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hs.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hcomp : (1 - P) * (1 - P) = 1 - P := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, show P * P = P from hp]
    abel
  have htleft : (P * (Aᴴ * A) * P).trace = (P * (Aᴴ * A)).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, show P * P = P from hp]
  have htright : ((1 - P) * (Aᴴ * A) * (1 - P)).trace =
      ((1 - P) * (Aᴴ * A)).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hcomp]
  rw [← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    ← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    ← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, hleft, hright, htleft, htright]
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gram_nonneg
statement:
private theorem gram_nonneg {m q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q]
    (Y : Matrix m q ℝ) : 0 ≤ Yᵀ * Y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self Y).nonneg

name: NLAlib.sqrtGram_transpose
statement:
private theorem sqrtGram_transpose {m q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    (Y : Matrix m q ℝ) : (CFC.sqrt (Yᵀ * Y))ᵀ = CFC.sqrt (Yᵀ * Y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Yᵀ * Y)).star_eq

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame {m q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq q] (Y : Matrix m q ℝ) (hY : IsUnit (Yᵀ * Y)) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (polarFrame Y)
proof:
:= by
  let S := CFC.sqrt (Yᵀ * Y)
  have hS : IsUnit S := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff _ (gram_nonneg Y)).2 hY
  have hSd : IsUnit S.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).1 hS
  have hSl : S⁻¹ * S = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul S hSd
  have hSr : S * S⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S hSd
  have hSq : S * S = Yᵀ * Y := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ (gram_nonneg Y)
  have hSt : Sᵀ = S := sqrtGram_transpose Y
  have hSit : S⁻¹ᵀ = S⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hSt]
  change (Y * S⁻¹)ᵀ * (Y * S⁻¹) = 1
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hSit]
  calc
    S⁻¹ * Yᵀ * (Y * S⁻¹) = S⁻¹ * (Yᵀ * Y) * S⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = S⁻¹ * (S * S) * S⁻¹ := by rw [hSq]
    _ = (S⁻¹ * S) * (S * S⁻¹) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hSl, hSr]; simp

name: NLAlib.polarFrame_mul_transpose_mul_eq
statement:
theorem polarFrame_mul_transpose_mul_eq {m q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq q] (Y : Matrix m q ℝ) (hY : IsUnit (Yᵀ * Y)) :
    polarFrame Y * ((polarFrame Y)ᵀ * Y) = Y
proof:
:= by
  let S := CFC.sqrt (Yᵀ * Y)
  have hS : IsUnit S := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff _ (gram_nonneg Y)).2 hY
  have hSd : IsUnit S.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).1 hS
  have hSl : S⁻¹ * S = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul S hSd
  have hSq : S * S = Yᵀ * Y := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ (gram_nonneg Y)
  have hSt : Sᵀ = S := sqrtGram_transpose Y
  have hSit : S⁻¹ᵀ = S⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hSt]
  change (Y * S⁻¹) * ((Y * S⁻¹)ᵀ * Y) = Y
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hSit]
  calc
    (Y * S⁻¹) * (S⁻¹ * Yᵀ * Y) = Y * S⁻¹ * S⁻¹ * (Yᵀ * Y) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Y * S⁻¹ * S⁻¹ * (S * S) := by rw [hSq]
    _ = Y * S⁻¹ * (S⁻¹ * S) * S := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Y := by rw [hSl]; simp only [Matrix.mul_one, hSl, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.measurable_polarFrame_entry
statement:
theorem measurable_polarFrame_entry {m q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    (i : m) (j : q) : Measurable fun Y : Matrix m q ℝ => polarFrame Y i j
proof:
:= by
  have hcGram : Continuous fun Y : Matrix m q ℝ => Yᵀ * Y :=
    continuous_id.matrix_transpose.matrix_mul continuous_id
  have hcS : Continuous fun Y : Matrix m q ℝ => CFC.sqrt (Yᵀ * Y) :=
    CFC.continuousOn_sqrt.comp_continuous hcGram (fun Y => gram_nonneg Y)
  have hS : ∀ a b, Measurable fun Y : Matrix m q ℝ => CFC.sqrt (Yᵀ * Y) a b :=
    fun a b => (hcS.matrix_elem a b).measurable
  have hInv := measurable_inv_entry_of hS
  exact measurable_mul_entry_of (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp measurable_id) hInv i j

name: NLAlib.specNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le {Q : Matrix m r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix m n ℝ) : specNorm (Qᵀ*E) ≤ specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm Qᵀ*specNorm E := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1*specNorm E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (by rw [specNorm_transpose]; exact specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hQ) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_frame_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_frame_le {Q : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix m n ℝ) : specNorm (E*Q) ≤ specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm E*specNorm Q := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm E*1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hQ) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := mul_one _

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le {Q : Matrix m r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobNorm (Qᵀ*E) ≤ frobNorm E
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_frame_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_frame_le {Q : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobNorm (E*Q) ≤ frobNorm E
proof:
:= by
  have hh := frobNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hQ Eᵀ

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_frame_le_sqrt_card_mul_specNorm
proof:

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_square_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem rectDiag_square_eq_diagonal {k : ℕ} (s : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)=Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => s i)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [rectDiag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  by_cases h : i=j
  · subst j; simp
  · have hh : i.val ≠ j.val := fun hc => h (Fin.ext hc)

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.inv_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit C hC, moorePenroseInverse_eq_svd h,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, rectDiag_square_eq_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.one_sub_transpose_mul_self
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => 1-singularValues C i^2) =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)-Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues C i^2) := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_sub]
  rw [hd, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
    show V * Vᵀ = 1 from h.mul_conjTranspose_right,
    show Cᵀ * C = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues C i ^ 2) * Vᵀ from
      h.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.transpose_inv_mul_one_sub_gram_mul_inv
statement:
theorem IsSVD.transpose_inv_mul_one_sub_gram_mul_inv {k : ℕ}
    {C U V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (h : IsSVD C U V) (hC : IsUnit C) :
    (C⁻¹)ᵀ*(1-Cᵀ*C)*C⁻¹ = U*Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i : Fin k => (singularValues C i)⁻¹^2*(1-singularValues C i^2))*Uᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let D := Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => (singularValues C i)⁻¹)
  let H := Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => 1-singularValues C i^2)
  have hi : C⁻¹=V*D*Uᵀ := h.inv_eq hC
  have hg : 1-Cᵀ*C=V*H*Vᵀ := h.one_sub_transpose_mul_self
  have hcancel (T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) : Vᵀ*(V*T)=T := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, show Vᵀ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hd : D*H*D=Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i : Fin k => (singularValues C i)⁻¹^2*(1-singularValues C i^2)) := by
    dsimp only [D, H]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
    funext i
    ring
  rw [hi, hg]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, show Dᵀ=D by simp [D],
    Matrix.mul_assoc, hcancel]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc U D H, Matrix.mul_assoc U (D*H) D, hd]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_inv_sq_eq_norm_singular_ratio
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_inv_sq_eq_norm_singular_ratio {m : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [DecidableEq m] {k : ℕ} (R : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hC : IsUnit C) (hR : Rᵀ*R=1-Cᵀ*C) :
    specNorm (R*C⁻¹)^2 = ‖(fun i : Fin k => (singularValues C i)⁻¹^2*(1-singularValues C i^2))‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD C
  rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self, Matrix.transpose_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Rᵀ R, hR, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    h.transpose_inv_mul_one_sub_gram_mul_inv hC,
    specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := U) h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := U) h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
    specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_idempotent_range_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_idempotent_range_blocks {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℂ,
    ∃ T : Matrix (Fin P.rank) (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℂ,
      Hᴴ * H = 1 ∧ H * Hᴴ = 1 ∧ Hᴴ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 T 0 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := P.toEuclideanLin
  let R := LinearMap.range f
  let b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ
  have hr : finrank ℂ R = P.rank := (P.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin b.toBasis b.toBasis).symm
  have hs : finrank ℂ Rᗮ = Fintype.card n - P.rank := by
    have h := R.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
    rw [hr, finrank_euclideanSpace] at h
    omega
  let br := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ R).reindex (finCongr hr)
  let bs := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ Rᗮ).reindex (finCongr hs)
  obtain ⟨c, hcR, hcS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_sum R br bs
  have hf : f.comp f = f := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M.toEuclideanLin) (show P * P = P from hP)
    simpa only [f, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same] using h
  have hfix (x : R) : f x = x := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := x.property
    rw [← hy]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hf y
  let F := f.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis
  have h11 : F.toBlocks₁₁ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    simp only [F, Matrix.toBlocks₁₁, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hcR, hfix, ← Submodule.coe_inner, br.inner_eq_ite,
      Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply]
  have h21 : F.toBlocks₂₁ = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simp only [F, Matrix.toBlocks₂₁, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hcR, hcS, hfix, Matrix.zero_apply]
    exact Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (br j).property (bs i).property
  have h22 : F.toBlocks₂₂ = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simp only [F, Matrix.toBlocks₂₂, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hcS, Matrix.zero_apply]
    exact Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (LinearMap.mem_range_self f (bs j)) (bs i).property
  let H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℂ := b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis
  have hH : Hᴴ * H = 1 := b.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_conjTranspose_mul_self c
  have hHt : H * Hᴴ = 1 := b.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_self_mul_conjTranspose c
  have hback : c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis = Hᴴ := by
    calc
      c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis = c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * (H * Hᴴ) := by
        rw [hHt, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = Hᴴ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
        change (c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis) * Hᴴ = _
        rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hF : Hᴴ * P * H = F := by
    have h := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis f
    have hstd : f.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis = P := LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin b.toBasis b.toBasis P
    rw [hback, hstd] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨H, F.toBlocks₁₂, hH, hHt, ?_⟩
  rw [hF]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks F]
  rw [h11, h21, h22]

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_reindex_rows
statement:
theorem sinePrincipalAngles_reindex_rows {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n]
    (P Q : Matrix m n ℝ) (em : m ≃ p) :
    sinePrincipalAngles (P.reindex em (Equiv.refl n))
      (Q.reindex em (Equiv.refl n)) = sinePrincipalAngles P Q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sinePrincipalAngles, principalAnglesFintype,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Matrix.reindex_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl,
    Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv,
    Matrix.submatrix_id_id]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_frame_transition
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_frame_transition {P P' : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hP' : HasOrthonormalCols P')
    (hr : LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range P'.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ T : Matrix n n ℝ, Tᵀ*T=1 ∧ T*Tᵀ=1 ∧ P*T=P'
proof:
:= by
  let T := Pᵀ*P'
  have hPT : P*T=P' := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hP hr.ge
  have hTT : Tᵀ*T=1 := by
    have hgram : (P*T)ᵀ*(P*T)=Tᵀ*T := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Pᵀ P,
        (show Pᵀ * P = 1 from hP), Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [hPT, (show P'ᵀ * P' = 1 from hP')] at hgram
    exact hgram.symm
  exact ⟨T, hTT, mul_eq_one_comm.mp hTT, hPT⟩

name: NLAlib.principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_left
statement:
theorem principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_left {P P' : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hP' : HasOrthonormalCols P')
    (hr : LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range P'.mulVecLin) (Q : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    principalAnglesFintype P Q=principalAnglesFintype P' Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, _, hT, hPT⟩ := exists_orthogonal_frame_transition hP hP' hr
  have heq : P'ᵀ*Q=Tᵀ*(Pᵀ*Q) := by
    rw [← hPT, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hTt : Tᵀᵀ*Tᵀ=1 := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hT
  have hh : singularValues (Tᵀ*(Pᵀ*Q)) = singularValues (Pᵀ*Q) :=
    singularValues_isometry_mul (H := Tᵀ) hTt _
  funext i
  simp only [principalAnglesFintype, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, heq]
  rw [hh]

name: NLAlib.principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_right
statement:
theorem principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_right {Q Q' : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (hr : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin) (P : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    principalAnglesFintype P Q=principalAnglesFintype P Q'
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalAngles_comm P Q, principalAngles_comm P Q']
  exact principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_left hQ hQ' hr P

name: NLAlib.principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq {P P' Q Q' : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hP' : HasOrthonormalCols P')
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (hrP : LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range P'.mulVecLin)
    (hrQ : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin=LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin) :
    principalAnglesFintype P Q=principalAnglesFintype P' Q'
proof:
:=
  (principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_left hP hP' hrP Q).trans
    (principalAngles_eq_of_range_eq_right hQ hQ' hrQ P')

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_projector_eq_re_trace_mul
proof:

  calc
    _ = RCLike.re ((P * (Aᴴ * A)) * P).trace := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = RCLike.re (P * (P * (Aᴴ * A))).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc P P, show P * P = P from hp]

theorem frobSq_add_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero {X Y : Matrix m n 𝕜} (h : Xᴴ * Y = 0) :

name: NLAlib.one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hs, ?_⟩
  change (1 - P) * (1 - P) = 1 - P

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one_sub_projector_le_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_one_sub_projector_le_one {P : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) : specNorm (1 - P) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem hs hp
  exact Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem hh.1 hh.2

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement
proof:
:= by
  have hc := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem hs hp
  have hq : frobSq (Q * Z) = frobInner Z (Q * Z) := by
    rw [frobSq, frobInner_mul_mul, hs.eq, show Q * Q = Q from hp]
  have hqc : frobSq ((1 - Q) * Z) = frobInner Z ((1 - Q) * Z) := by
    rw [frobSq, frobInner_mul_mul, hc.1.eq, show (1 - Q) * (1 - Q) = 1 - Q from hc.2]
  rw [hq, hqc, ← frobInner_add_right, ← Matrix.add_mul]
  simp only [add_sub_cancel, Matrix.one_mul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_projector_add_complement
proof:
:= by
  have hh := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hs hp Zᴴ
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (Z * P), ← frobSq_conjTranspose (Z * (1 - P))]
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hs.eq,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, frobSq_conjTranspose] using hh

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_projector_mul_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hs hp A
  linarith [frobSq_nonneg (P * A)]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_four_projector_blocks
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_four_projector_blocks {Q : Matrix m m 𝕜} {P : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q)
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P) (Z : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq Z = frobSq (Q * Z * P) + frobSq (Q * Z * (1 - P)) +
      frobSq ((1 - Q) * Z * P) + frobSq ((1 - Q) * Z * (1 - P))
proof:
:= by
  have hq := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hQs hQi Z
  have hp := frobSq_mul_projector_add_complement hPs hPi (Q * Z)
  have hc := frobSq_mul_projector_add_complement hPs hPi ((1 - Q) * Z)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.frobSq_three_compressed_blocks_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem frobSq_three_compressed_blocks_le_two_mul {Q : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    {P : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hQs : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q)
    (hPs : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P) (Z : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (Q * Z * P) + frobSq ((1 - Q) * Z) + frobSq (Z * (1 - P)) ≤ 2 * frobSq Z
proof:
:= by
  have hfour := frobSq_eq_four_projector_blocks hQs hQi hPs hPi Z
  have hleft := frobSq_mul_projector_add_complement hPs hPi ((1 - Q) * Z)
  have hright := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hQs hQi (Z * (1 - P))
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hright
  have hnon := frobSq_nonneg (Q * Z * P)
  have hnon2 := frobSq_nonneg (Q * Z * (1 - P))
  have hnon3 := frobSq_nonneg ((1 - Q) * Z * P)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.range_mulVecLin_eq_of_range_toEuclideanLin_eq
statement:
theorem range_mulVecLin_eq_of_range_toEuclideanLin_eq {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m p ℝ)
    (h : LinearMap.range A.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range B.toEuclideanLin) :
    LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h.le (show A.toEuclideanLin (WithLp.toLp 2 v) ∈
      LinearMap.range A.toEuclideanLin from ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    exact ⟨w.ofLp, congrArg WithLp.ofLp hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h.ge (show B.toEuclideanLin (WithLp.toLp 2 v) ∈
      LinearMap.range B.toEuclideanLin from ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    exact ⟨w.ofLp, congrArg WithLp.ofLp hw⟩

name: NLAlib.range_toEuclideanLin_mul_le_complex
statement:
theorem range_toEuclideanLin_mul_le_complex {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n p ℂ) :
    LinearMap.range (A * B).toEuclideanLin ≤ LinearMap.range A.toEuclideanLin
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: NLAlib.range_toEuclideanLin_map_ofReal_eq
statement:
theorem range_toEuclideanLin_map_ofReal_eq {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m p ℝ)
    (h : LinearMap.range A.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range B.toEuclideanLin) :
    LinearMap.range (A.map Complex.ofRealHom).toEuclideanLin =
      LinearMap.range (B.map Complex.ofRealHom).toEuclideanLin
proof:
:= by
  have hr := range_mulVecLin_eq_of_range_toEuclideanLin_eq A B h
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_eq_mul_of_range_le hr.le
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := exists_eq_mul_of_range_le hr.ge
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hF, Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := B) (M := F)]
    exact range_toEuclideanLin_mul_le_complex _ _
  · rw [hG, Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := A) (M := G)]
    exact range_toEuclideanLin_mul_le_complex _ _

name: NLAlib.range_unitary_mul_eq_of_similarity
statement:
theorem range_unitary_mul_eq_of_similarity {n r : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r]
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (P R : Matrix n n ℂ) (Q : Matrix n r ℂ)
    (hP : P = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hQ : LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range R.toEuclideanLin) :
    LinearMap.range ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Q).toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ.toEuclideanLin := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨(U : Matrix n n ℂ).toEuclideanLin x, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M.toEuclideanLin x) hU
    simpa only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same, Matrix.toLpLin_one,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] using h
  have hright : LinearMap.range (((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ).toEuclideanLin =
      LinearMap.range ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R).toEuclideanLin := by
    simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
    exact LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
  rw [hP, hright]
  simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same, LinearMap.range_comp] at hQ ⊢
  rw [hQ]

name: NLAlib.star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols [DecidableEq q]
    {U : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (x : q → 𝕜) :
    star (U *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ x) = star x ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : Q * Qᴴ * (Q * Qᴴ) = Q * Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_idem
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_idem [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : (1 - Q * Qᴴ) * (1 - Q * Qᴴ) = 1 - Q * Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.one_mul, mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose hQ]
  abel

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : Qᴴ * (1 - Q * Qᴴ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.one_mul, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_conjTranspose_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_conjTranspose_mul [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : (1 - Q * Qᴴ)ᴴ * Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.residual_eq_one_sub_mul
statement:
theorem residual_eq_one_sub_mul [DecidableEq m] (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜)
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : projResidual Q A = (1 - Q * Qᴴ) * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [projResidual, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    Q * (Qᴴ * A) + projResidual Q A = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [projResidual]; abel

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_residual
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_residual [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : Qᴴ * projResidual Q A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [projResidual, Matrix.mul_sub, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul,
    sub_self]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_residual
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_residual [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (X : Matrix q n 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobInner (Q * X) (projResidual Q A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.trace_zero, map_zero]

name: NLAlib.residual_residual
statement:
theorem residual_residual [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : projResidual Q (projResidual Q A) = projResidual Q A
proof:
:= by
  show projResidual Q A - Q * (Qᴴ * projResidual Q A) = projResidual Q A
  rw [conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ, Matrix.mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.residual_mul_self
statement:
theorem residual_mul_self [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] (X : Matrix q p 𝕜) : projResidual Q (Q * X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [projResidual, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.residual_mul
statement:
theorem residual_mul (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    (Ω : Matrix n p 𝕜) : projResidual Q A * Ω = projResidual Q (A * Ω)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [projResidual, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.residual_mul_eq_zero_of_range
proof:
:= by
  rw [residual_mul, projResidual, h, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_frame_eq_card
statement:
theorem frobSq_frame_eq_card [DecidableEq n] {Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    frobSq Q = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_one,
    RCLike.natCast_re]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_frobSq_proj_add_residual
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← mul_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual Q A]
  exact frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _ (frobInner_mul_residual hQ _ A)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_frobSq_proj_add_residual hQ A,
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_eq_sub
statement:
theorem frobSq_residual_eq_sub [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (projResidual Q A) = frobSq A - frobSq (Qᴴ * A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual hQ A]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_residual_le [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq (projResidual Q A) ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_frobSq_proj_add_residual hQ A]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_le [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq (Qᴴ * A) ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual hQ A]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_proj_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_proj_le [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq (Q * (Qᴴ * A)) ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]
  exact frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_le hQ A

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_mul_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_mul_eq [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix q n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A - Q * B) = frobSq (projResidual Q A) + frobSq (Qᴴ * A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp : A - Q * B = projResidual Q A + Q * (Qᴴ * A - B) := by
    rw [projResidual, Matrix.mul_sub]; abel
  rw [hdecomp, frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _ (by
      rw [frobInner_comm]; exact frobInner_mul_residual hQ _ A),
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_le_frobSq_sub_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ A B]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_le_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem frobSq_residual_le_of_eq_mul [DecidableEq q] {q₁ : Type*} [Fintype q₁]
    {Q₁ : Matrix m q₁ 𝕜} {Q₂ : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ₂ : HasOrthonormalCols Q₂)
    {C : Matrix q q₁ 𝕜} (hC : Q₁ = Q₂ * C) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (projResidual Q₂ A) ≤ frobSq (projResidual Q₁ A)
proof:
:= by
  have h : projResidual Q₁ A = A - Q₂ * (C * (Q₁ᴴ * A)) := by
    rw [projResidual, hC, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hC]
  rw [h]
  exact frobSq_residual_le_frobSq_sub_mul hQ₂ A _

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_mul_le_of_isBestFrobRankApprox
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ A Y,
    frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ A B]
  exact add_le_add le_rfl (hY.2 B hB)

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m q 𝕜} :
    Aᴴ * B = 0 ↔ Bᴴ * A = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h <;> simpa using congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h

name: NLAlib.gram_conjTranspose_mul_eq
statement:
theorem gram_conjTranspose_mul_eq (P : Matrix m n 𝕜) (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜) :
    (Pᴴ * Q)ᴴ * (Pᴴ * Q) = (Qᴴ * P) * (Qᴴ * P)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_of_completion
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_of_completion [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} {Qp : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hcomp : Q * Qᴴ + Qp * Qpᴴ = 1) : Qᴴ * Qp = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M => Qᴴ * M * Qp) hcomp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_one] at h
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, hQp.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one] at h
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual
statement:
theorem residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q] {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} {Qp : Matrix m r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hcomp : Q * Qᴴ + Qp * Qpᴴ = 1) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    projResidual Q A = Qp * (Qpᴴ * projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Q * Qᴴ + Qp * Qpᴴ) * projResidual Q A = projResidual Q A := by
    rw [hcomp, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ A,
    Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.columnSpace_eq_span_columns
statement:
theorem columnSpace_eq_span_columns [DecidableEq n] (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    columnSpace B = Submodule.span 𝕜
      (Set.range (fun j => (WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)))
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.range (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B) = _
  rw [← Submodule.map_top, ← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜).toBasis.span_eq,
    Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  have hf : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B) ∘ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜).toBasis =
      (fun j => (WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) := by
    funext j
    simp only [Function.comp_def, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply,
      Matrix.toLpLin_apply, EuclideanSpace.single, PiLp.ofLp_single,
      Matrix.mulVec_single]
    simp
  exact congrArg (Submodule.span 𝕜) (congrArg Set.range hf)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_iff_orthonormal
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_iff_orthonormal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (V : Matrix m ι 𝕜) :
    HasOrthonormalCols V ↔ Orthonormal 𝕜 (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (V.col j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  constructor
  · intro hV a b
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hV.conjTranspose_mul_self a) b
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [mul_comm]; rfl
  · intro hV
    ext a b
    have h := hV a b
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, Matrix.col_apply] at h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [mul_comm]; rfl

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.orthonormal
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.orthonormal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {V : Matrix m ι 𝕜} (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    Orthonormal 𝕜 (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (V.col j))
proof:
:=
  (hasOrthonormalCols_iff_orthonormal V).mp hV

name: NLAlib.card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {Q : Matrix m r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : Fintype.card r ≤ Fintype.card m
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective Q.mulVecLin := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg (fun v => Qᴴ *ᵥ v) hxy
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
    rwa [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  simpa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using
    LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_completion
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_completion [DecidableEq m] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (V : Matrix m ι 𝕜) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (e : ι ↪ m) :
    ∃ W : Matrix m m 𝕜, HasOrthonormalCols W ∧ ∀ i j, W i (e j) = V i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : m → EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m := Function.extend e (col V) 0
  have hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 ((Set.range e).domRestrict v) := by
    have h1 : (Set.range e).domRestrict v =
        col V ∘ (Equiv.ofInjective e e.injective).symm := by
      funext x
      obtain ⟨a, j, rfl⟩ := x
      have : (Equiv.ofInjective e e.injective).symm ⟨e j, j, rfl⟩ = j :=
        (Equiv.ofInjective e e.injective).symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl
      simp only [Set.domRestrict_apply, Function.comp_apply, this, v]
      exact e.injective.extend_apply _ _ _
    rw [h1]
    exact (hV.orthonormal).comp _ (Equiv.injective _)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq
    (by simp [finrank_euclideanSpace])
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun i a => b a i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext a c
    have := (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal) a c
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply] at this
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [← this]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [mul_comm]; rfl
  · intro i j
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [hb (e j) ⟨j, rfl⟩]
    simp only [v, e.injective.extend_apply, col]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_complement
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_complement [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q] (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    ∃ Qp : Matrix m (Fin (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card q)) 𝕜,
      HasOrthonormalCols Qp ∧ Q * Qᴴ + Qp * Qpᴴ = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWQ⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Q hQ e
  have hWW : W * Wᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW.conjTranspose_mul_self
  let s : Finset m := (Finset.univ.map e)ᶜ
  have hs : s.card = Fintype.card m - Fintype.card q := by
    simp [s, Finset.card_compl, Finset.card_map]
  let g : Fin (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card q) → m :=
    fun j => (s.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hs.symm j)).1
  have hg : Function.Injective g := fun a b h => by
    have := s.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
    simpa [Fin.ext_iff] using congrArg Fin.val this
  have hgs : ∀ j, g j ∈ s := fun j => (s.equivFin.symm _).2
  have hsum (F : m → 𝕜) : ∑ j, F (g j) = ∑ a ∈ s, F a := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort s]
    exact (Fintype.sum_equiv ((finCongr hs.symm).trans s.equivFin.symm) _ _ fun j => rfl)
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun i j => W i (g j), ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext a b
    have := congrFun (congrFun hW.conjTranspose_mul_self (g a)) (g b)
    simpa [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hg.eq_iff] using this
  · ext a b
    have := congrFun (congrFun hWW a) b
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (Finset.univ.map e), Finset.sum_map] at this
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [← this, hsum (fun c => W a c * star (W b c))]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    rw [← hWQ a j, ← hWQ b j]
