name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_eq_of_range_eq [Fintype m] [DecidableEq q] {q' : Type*} [Fintype q']
    [DecidableEq q'] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} {Q' : Matrix m q' 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (h : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin) : Q * Qᴴ = Q' * Q'ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Q' * (Q'ᴴ * Q) = Q := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ' h.le
  have h2 : Q * (Qᴴ * Q') = Q' := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ h.ge
  have e1 : Q * Qᴴ = Q' * Q'ᴴ * (Q * Qᴴ) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc Q', h1]
  calc Q * Qᴴ = (Q * Qᴴ)ᴴ := (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Q).symm
    _ = (Q' * Q'ᴴ * (Q * Qᴴ))ᴴ := by rw [← e1]
    _ = Q * (Qᴴ * Q') * Q'ᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Q' * Q'ᴴ := by rw [h2]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical_spectrum {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ g : ℕ, g ≤ min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ∧
    ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ Antitone t ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i ↔ i < g) ∧
    ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols H ∧ H * Hᵀ = 1 ∧
      Hᵀ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag t) 0 0 ∧
      (∀ i, singularValues P i =
        if i < P.rank then Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) else 0) ∧
      (∀ i, 1 < singularValues P i ↔ i < g) ∧
      (∀ i < g, t i = Real.sqrt (singularValues P i ^ 2 - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht0, ht, htpos, H, hH, hHt, hBlock⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical P hP
  let N := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin P.rank) (Fin P.rank) ℝ)
    (rectDiag t : Matrix (Fin P.rank) (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ)
    0 (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ)
  have hz (i : ℕ) (hi : g ≤ i) : t i = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge hi) ((htpos i).mp h))) (ht0 i)
  have hForm : P = H * N * Hᵀ := by
    calc
      P = (H * Hᵀ) * P * (H * Hᵀ) := by rw [hHt]; simp
      _ = H * (Hᵀ * P * H) * Hᵀ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = H * N * Hᵀ := by rw [hBlock]
  have hSpec (i : ℕ) : singularValues P i =
      if i < P.rank then Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = singularValues (H * N * Hᵀ) i :=
        congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => singularValues A i) hForm
      _ = singularValues N i := by
        rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial H,
          singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose hH, singularValues_isometry_mul hH]
      _ = _ := singularValues_oblique_canonical t ht0 ht (fun j hj => hz j (hg.trans hj)) i
  refine ⟨g, hg, t, ht0, ht, htpos, H, hH, hHt, hBlock, hSpec, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hSpec]
    by_cases hir : i < P.rank
    · rw [if_pos hir]
      constructor
      · intro hi
        by_contra hig
        rw [hz i (Nat.le_of_not_gt hig)] at hi
        norm_num at hi
      · intro hi
        have hp := (htpos i).mpr hi
        have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + t i ^ 2 by positivity)
        have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + t i ^ 2)
        nlinarith
    · rw [if_neg hir]
      exact iff_of_false (by norm_num) (fun hi => hir (hi.trans_le (hg.trans (min_le_left _ _))))
  · intro i hi
    rw [hSpec i, if_pos (hi.trans_le (hg.trans (min_le_left _ _))),
      Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), add_sub_cancel_left, Real.sqrt_sq (ht0 i)]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_idempotent_canonical_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_idempotent_canonical_spectrum {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ g : ℕ, g ≤ min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ∧
    ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ Antitone t ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i ↔ i < g) ∧
    ∃ H : Matrix n (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℂ,
      Hᴴ * H = 1 ∧ H * Hᴴ = 1 ∧
      Hᴴ * P * H = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 ((rectDiag t).map Complex.ofRealHom) 0 0 ∧
      (∀ i, singularValues P i =
        if i < P.rank then Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) else 0) ∧
      (∀ i, 1 < singularValues P i ↔ i < g) ∧
      (∀ i < g, t i = Real.sqrt (singularValues P i ^ 2 - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, R, hR, hPR, hspec, hRank, _, _⟩ := exists_real_idempotent_unitary_similarity P hP
  change P = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R.map Complex.ofRealHom * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ at hPR
  obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht0, ht, htpos, L, hL, hLt, hBlock, hSpec, hGt, hCoeff⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical_spectrum R hR
  rw [hRank]
  have hU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  let LC := L.map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hLC : LCᴴ * LC = 1 := by
    rw [show LCᴴ = Lᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom from by ext; simp [LC], ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := Lᵀ) (M := L),
      (show Lᵀ * L = 1 from hL)]
    simp
  have hLCt : LC * LCᴴ = 1 := by
    rw [show LCᴴ = Lᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom from by ext; simp [LC], ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := L) (M := Lᵀ), hLt]
    simp
  let H := (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * LC
  have hconj : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * P * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = R.map Complex.ofRealHom := by
    rw [hPR]
    calc
      _ = ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) * R.map Complex.ofRealHom *
          ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hU, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  refine ⟨g, hg, t, ht0, ht, htpos, H, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [H, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ) LC, hU, Matrix.one_mul, hLC]
  · simp only [H, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc LC LCᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ, hLCt, Matrix.one_mul, hUt]
  · calc
      Hᴴ * P * H = LCᴴ * ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * P * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) * LC := by
        simp only [H, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (Lᵀ * R * L).map Complex.ofRealHom := by
        rw [hconj, show LCᴴ = Lᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom from by ext; simp [LC],
          ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := Lᵀ) (M := R),
          ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := Lᵀ * R) (M := L)]
      _ = _ := by rw [hBlock]; simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_map]
  · intro i; rw [hspec, hSpec]
  · intro i; rw [hspec]; exact hGt i
  · intro i hi; rw [hspec]; exact hCoeff i hi

name: NLAlib.complex_idempotent_complement_norm_properties
statement:
theorem complex_idempotent_complement_norm_properties {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    (0 < P.rank → P.rank < Fintype.card n → ‖1 - P‖ = ‖P‖) ∧
    (P.rank = 0 → ‖P‖ = 0 ∧ ‖1 - P‖ = if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧
    (P.rank = Fintype.card n → ‖P‖ = (if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧ ‖1 - P‖ = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, R, hR, _, _, hRank, hNorm, hComp⟩ := exists_real_idempotent_unitary_similarity P hP
  rw [hRank, hNorm, hComp]
  exact ⟨specNorm_one_sub_eq_of_idempotent_of_rank_pos_lt hR,
    (specNorm_idempotent_rank_endpoints hR).1, (specNorm_idempotent_rank_endpoints hR).2⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_sign_frobNorm_sub_le_projector
proof:
:= by
  have hu : frobSq U = 1 := by simpa using frobSq_frame_eq_card hU
  have hw : frobSq W = 1 := by simpa using frobSq_frame_eq_card hW
  have hun : frobNorm U = 1 := by nlinarith [frobNorm_sq U, frobNorm_nonneg U]
  have hwn : frobNorm W = 1 := by nlinarith [frobNorm_sq W, frobNorm_nonneg W]
  have hc := abs_frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm W U
  rw [hun, hwn, mul_one] at hc
  have ho : frobSq (Uᵀ * W) = frobInner W U ^ 2 := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply, frobInner_eq_sum_mul]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  have hp : frobSq (U * Uᵀ - W * Wᵀ) = 2 - 2 * frobInner W U ^ 2 := by
    change frobSq (Uᴴ * W) = _ at ho
    change frobSq (U * Uᴴ - W * Wᴴ) = _
    rw [frobSq_sub, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU,
      frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hW, frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq_conjTranspose,
      hu, hw, frobInner_frame_projectors_eq_frobSq_overlap, ho]
    ring
  let s : ℝ := if 0 ≤ frobInner W U then 1 else -1
  have hs : s ^ 2 = 1 := by dsimp [s]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hsc : s * frobInner W U = |frobInner W U| := by
    dsimp [s]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [abs_of_nonneg h]
    · simp [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h)]
  have hd : frobSq (W - s • U) = 2 - 2 * |frobInner W U| := by
    rw [frobSq_sub, frobSq_smul, frobInner_smul_right, hu, hw, hs]
    nlinarith [hsc]
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  have hcc : frobInner W U ^ 2 ≤ |frobInner W U| := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs (frobInner W U), abs_nonneg (frobInner W U)]
  have h1 := frobNorm_sq (W - s • U)
  have h2 := frobNorm_sq (U * Uᵀ - W * Wᵀ)
  rw [hd] at h1
  rw [hp] at h2
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (W - s • U), frobNorm_nonneg (U * Uᵀ - W * Wᵀ)]

name: NLAlib.headColumns_projector_succ_sub
statement:
theorem headColumns_projector_succ_sub {n : ℕ} (Q : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    headColumns Q (show j.val + 1 ≤ n by omega) *
        (headColumns Q (show j.val + 1 ≤ n by omega))ᵀ -
      headColumns Q j.isLt.le * (headColumns Q j.isLt.le)ᵀ =
        Q.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) * (Q.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j))ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    headColumns, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have he : (∑ i : Fin j.val, Q a (Fin.castLE (by omega) i.castSucc) *
      Q b (Fin.castLE (by omega) i.castSucc)) =
      ∑ i : Fin j.val, Q a (Fin.castLE j.isLt.le i) * Q b (Fin.castLE j.isLt.le i) := rfl
  rw [he]
  have hj : Fin.castLE (show j.val + 1 ≤ n by omega) (Fin.last j.val) = j := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [hj]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_signs_frobNorm_sub_le_of_head_projectors
statement:
theorem exists_signs_frobNorm_sub_le_of_head_projectors {n : ℕ}
    {Q W : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hW : HasOrthonormalCols W)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hgap : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ n), frobNorm
      (headColumns Q hj * (headColumns Q hj)ᵀ -
        headColumns W hj * (headColumns W hj)ᵀ) ≤ ε) :
    ∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, s i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      frobNorm (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s) ≤ Real.sqrt n * (2 * ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hcols (j : Fin n) := exists_sign_frobNorm_sub_le_projector
    (hQ.submatrix_cols (⟨fun _ : Fin 1 => j, fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩))
    (hW.submatrix_cols (⟨fun _ : Fin 1 => j, fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩))
  choose s hs hd using hcols
  have hb (j : Fin n) :
      frobNorm ((W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s).submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)) ≤ 2 * ε := by
    have he : (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s).submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) =
        W.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) - s j • Q.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) := by
      ext a b
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_diagonal,
        Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, id_eq]
      ring
    rw [he]
    apply (hd j).trans
    change frobNorm (Q.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) *
      (Q.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j))ᵀ - W.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) *
      (W.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j))ᵀ) ≤ _
    rw [← headColumns_projector_succ_sub Q j, ← headColumns_projector_succ_sub W j]
    let P := fun (Z : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) =>
      headColumns Z hi * (headColumns Z hi)ᵀ
    change frobNorm ((P Q (j.val+1) _ - P Q j.val _) -
      (P W (j.val+1) _ - P W j.val _)) ≤ _
    rw [show (P Q (j.val+1) _ - P Q j.val _) - (P W (j.val+1) _ - P W j.val _) =
      (P Q (j.val+1) _ - P W (j.val+1) _) - (P Q j.val _ - P W j.val _) by abel]
    exact (frobNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hgap (j.val+1) (by omega), hgap j.val j.isLt.le])
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  have hf : frobNorm (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * (2 * ε) ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_col]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, (2 * ε) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
        rw [← frobNorm_sq]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (frobNorm_nonneg _) (hb j) 2
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hr := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ n by positivity)
  have hp : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n * (2 * ε) := by positivity
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s)]

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.conjTranspose

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.inv_eq_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.inv_eq_conjTranspose {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.submatrix_cols

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.reindex
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.reindex {m n p q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n]
    [DecidableEq q] {U : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (U.reindex em en)

name: NLAlib.rank_isometry_mul_eq
statement:
theorem rank_isometry_mul_eq {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Q : Matrix m p 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix p n 𝕜) :
    (Q * A).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)
  have hBack : Qᴴ * (Q * A) = A := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  calc
    A.rank = (Qᴴ * (Q * A)).rank := congrArg Matrix.rank hBack.symm
    _ ≤ (Q * A).rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.rank_eq_card

theorem HasOrthonormalCols.rank_eq_card {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

    Q.rank = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.rank_one] using
    rank_isometry_mul_eq hQ (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_toEuclideanLin_symm_linearIsometry
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_toEuclideanLin_symm_linearIsometry
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (f : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n →ₗᵢ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm f.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasOrthonormalCols_iff_orthonormal _).mpr
  have hcol : (fun j => (WithLp.toLp 2
      ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm f.toLinearMap).col j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) =
      f ∘ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜) := by
    funext j
    have h := congrArg (fun g => g (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜 j))
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply f.toLinearMap)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.single, PiLp.ofLp_single,
      Matrix.mulVec_single, MulOpposite.op_one, one_smul, LinearIsometry.coe_toLinearMap] using h
  rw [hcol]
  exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜).orthonormal.comp_linearIsometry f

name: NLAlib.orthogonal_complement_conjTranspose
statement:
private theorem orthogonal_complement_conjTranspose {U : Matrix n r K} {V : Matrix n q K}
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) : Vᴴ*U=0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hUV
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_blockUnitaryAction
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_blockUnitaryAction
    (U : Matrix n r K) (V : Matrix n q K) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (W : Matrix.unitaryGroup q K) : HasOrthonormalCols (blockUnitaryAction U V W)
proof:
:= by
  have hVU := orthogonal_complement_conjTranspose hUV
  have hWW : (W : Matrix q q K)*(W : Matrix q q K)ᴴ=1 := by
    simpa only [Unitary.coe_star,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_mul_star_self W
  have h₁ : (U*Uᴴ)*(U*Uᴴ)=U*Uᴴ := by
    calc
      _ = U*(Uᴴ*U)*Uᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hU,Matrix.mul_one]
  have h₂ : (U*Uᴴ)*(V*(W : Matrix q q K)ᴴ*Vᴴ)=0 := by
    calc
      _ = U*(Uᴴ*V)*(W : Matrix q q K)ᴴ*Vᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hUV];simp
  have h₃ : (V*(W : Matrix q q K)*Vᴴ)*(U*Uᴴ)=0 := by
    calc
      _ = V*(W : Matrix q q K)*(Vᴴ*U)*Uᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hVU];simp
  have h₄ : (V*(W : Matrix q q K)*Vᴴ)*(V*(W : Matrix q q K)ᴴ*Vᴴ)=V*Vᴴ := by
    calc
      _ = V*(W : Matrix q q K)*(Vᴴ*V)*(W : Matrix q q K)ᴴ*Vᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hV,Matrix.mul_one]
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc V,hWW,Matrix.mul_one]
  have hstar : (blockUnitaryAction U V W)ᴴ = U*Uᴴ+V*(W : Matrix q q K)*Vᴴ := by
    simp only [blockUnitaryAction,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  unfold HasOrthonormalCols
  rw [hstar,blockUnitaryAction,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_add,
    h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,add_zero,zero_add,hcomp]

name: NLAlib.blockUnitaryAction_conjTranspose_mul_left
statement:
theorem blockUnitaryAction_conjTranspose_mul_left
    (U : Matrix n r K) (V : Matrix n q K) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0)
    (W : Matrix.unitaryGroup q K) : (blockUnitaryAction U V W)ᴴ*U=U
proof:
:= by
  have hVU := orthogonal_complement_conjTranspose hUV
  unfold blockUnitaryAction
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,Matrix.add_mul]
  calc
    _ = U*(Uᴴ*U)+V*(W : Matrix q q K)*(Vᴴ*U) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = U := by rw [hU,hVU];simp

name: NLAlib.blockUnitaryAction_conjTranspose_mul_right
statement:
theorem blockUnitaryAction_conjTranspose_mul_right
    (U : Matrix n r K) (V : Matrix n q K) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0)
    (W : Matrix.unitaryGroup q K) : (blockUnitaryAction U V W)ᴴ*V=V*(W : Matrix q q K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold blockUnitaryAction
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,Matrix.add_mul]
  calc
    _ = U*(Uᴴ*V)+V*(W : Matrix q q K)*(Vᴴ*V) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hUV,hV];simp

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_right_block_of_first_columns_eq
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_right_block_of_first_columns_eq {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (X Y : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hX : HasOrthonormalCols X)
    (hY : HasOrthonormalCols Y)
    (hFirst : X.submatrix id Sum.inl = Y.submatrix id Sum.inl) :
    ∃ W : Matrix q q ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols W ∧ X * Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 W = Y
proof:
:= by
  let T := Xᵀ * Y
  have hT : HasOrthonormalCols T := hX.conjTranspose.mul hY
  have hCols : T.submatrix id Sum.inl = (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ).submatrix id Sum.inl := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) p ℝ => Xᵀ * M) hFirst
    have hMul (Z : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) :
        Xᵀ * Z.submatrix id Sum.inl = (Xᵀ * Z).submatrix id Sum.inl := by
      simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using
        Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Xᵀ Z id (Equiv.refl (p ⊕ q)) Sum.inl
    rw [hMul, hMul, show Xᵀ * X = 1 from hX] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h11 : T.toBlocks₁₁ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    change T (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = (1 : Matrix p p ℝ) i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) p ℝ => M (Sum.inl i) j) hCols
    simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply, id_eq, Sum.inl.injEq] using h
  have h21 : T.toBlocks₂₁ = 0 := by
    ext i j
    change T (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) p ℝ => M (Sum.inr i) j) hCols
    simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply, id_eq, Sum.inr_ne_inl,
      ite_false, Matrix.zero_apply] using h
  have hGram : (Matrix.fromBlocks T.toBlocks₁₁ T.toBlocks₁₂ T.toBlocks₂₁ T.toBlocks₂₂)ᵀ *
      Matrix.fromBlocks T.toBlocks₁₁ T.toBlocks₁₂ T.toBlocks₂₁ T.toBlocks₂₂ = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks]
    exact hT
  have h12 : T.toBlocks₁₂ = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₁₂ hGram
    simpa only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₂, h11, h21, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.transpose_zero,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero,
      show (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ).toBlocks₁₂ = 0 by ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₁₂]] using h
  have h22 : HasOrthonormalCols T.toBlocks₂₂ := by
    change T.toBlocks₂₂ᵀ * T.toBlocks₂₂ = 1
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₂₂ hGram
    simpa only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₂₂, h12, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      zero_add, show (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ).toBlocks₂₂ = 1 by
        ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₂₂, Matrix.one_apply]] using h
  refine ⟨T.toBlocks₂₂, h22, ?_⟩
  have hBlocks : T = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 T.toBlocks₂₂ := by
    exact (Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks T).symm.trans
      (by rw [h11, h12, h21])
  rw [← hBlocks]
  change X * (Xᵀ * Y) = Y
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, show X * Xᵀ = 1 from mul_eq_one_comm.mp hX, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.orthogonal_blockDiagonal
proof:
:= by
  change Aᵀ * A = 1 at hA
  change Bᵀ * B = 1 at hB
  change (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B)ᵀ * Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B = 1
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero,
    zero_add, hA, hB, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_cs_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_cs_decomposition {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (E : Matrix q p ℝ) (hE : HasOrthonormalCols E) :
    let c
proof:
:= fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁
      ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
    (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∃ V₁ W₁ : Matrix p p ℝ, ∃ V₂ W₂ : Matrix q q ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols V₁ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W₁ ∧
      HasOrthonormalCols V₂ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W₂ ∧
      (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)ᵀ * U * Matrix.fromBlocks W₁ 0 0 W₂ =
        csCanonicalMatrix c E := by
  dsimp only
  let c := fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁
    ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
  let C := Matrix.diagonal c
  let S := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.sqrt (1 - c i ^ 2))
  obtain ⟨V, W, hV, hW, hVW⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_transpose_mul_mul_eq_diagonal_singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁
  change Vᵀ * U.toBlocks₁₁ * W = C at hVW
  have hOneP : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix p p ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
  have hOneQ : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
  let D := U.toBlocks₂₁ * W
  let M := Matrix.fromBlocks C (Vᵀ * U.toBlocks₁₂) D U.toBlocks₂₂
  have hMForm : Matrix.fromBlocks Vᵀ 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) * U *
      Matrix.fromBlocks W 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) = M := by
    conv_lhs => arg 1; arg 2; rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks U]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, hVW]
    rfl
  have hM : HasOrthonormalCols M := by
    rw [← hMForm]
    exact ((orthogonal_blockDiagonal hV.conjTranspose hOneQ).mul hU).mul
      (orthogonal_blockDiagonal hW hOneQ)
  have hGram : C * C + Dᵀ * D = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₁₁ (show Mᵀ * M = 1 from hM)
    simpa only [M, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₁, show Cᵀ = C from Matrix.diagonal_transpose _,
      show (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ).toBlocks₁₁ = 1 by
        ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₁₁, Matrix.one_apply]] using h
  have hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hci : 0 ≤ c i := singularValues_nonneg _ _
    have hdiag := congrArg (fun A : Matrix p p ℝ => A i i) hGram
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (Dᵀ * D) i i :=
      dotProduct_self_nonneg (fun j => D j i)
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, C, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal,
      Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at hdiag
    exact ⟨hci, by nlinarith⟩
  have hCS : C * C + S * S = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
      rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by nlinarith [(hc i).1, (hc i).2])]
      ring
    · simp [Matrix.add_apply, hij]
  have hSD : (-E * S)ᵀ * (-E * S) = Dᵀ * D := by
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_neg,
      show Sᵀ = S from Matrix.diagonal_transpose _, Matrix.neg_mul,
      Matrix.mul_neg, neg_neg, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Eᵀ E S, (show Eᵀ * E = 1 from hE), Matrix.one_mul]
    exact add_left_cancel (hCS.trans hGram.symm)
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hOD⟩ := exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq (-E * S) D hSD
  let N := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix p p ℝ) 0 0 O * M
  have hN : HasOrthonormalCols N := (orthogonal_blockDiagonal hOneP hO).mul hM
  have hFirst : N.submatrix id Sum.inl = (csCanonicalMatrix c E).submatrix id Sum.inl := by
    dsimp [N, M, csCanonicalMatrix]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, hOD]
    ext i j
    cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hNZ⟩ := exists_orthogonal_right_block_of_first_columns_eq
    N (csCanonicalMatrix c E) hN (hasOrthonormalCols_csCanonicalMatrix c E hE hc) hFirst
  refine ⟨hc, V, W, Oᵀ, Z, hV, hW, hO.conjTranspose, hZ, ?_⟩
  have hLeft : Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix p p ℝ) 0 0 O *
      Matrix.fromBlocks Vᵀ 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) =
      (Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 Oᵀ)ᵀ := by
    simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose]
  have hRight : Matrix.fromBlocks W 0 0 (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) *
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix p p ℝ) 0 0 Z = Matrix.fromBlocks W 0 0 Z := by
    simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  dsimp only [N] at hNZ
  rw [← hMForm] at hNZ
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hLeft, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, hRight] at hNZ
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hNZ

name: NLAlib.exists_cs_decomposition_of_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_cs_decomposition_of_embedding {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (e : p ↪ q) :
    let c
proof:
:= fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁
      ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
    (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∃ V₁ W₁ : Matrix p p ℝ, ∃ V₂ W₂ : Matrix q q ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols V₁ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W₁ ∧
      HasOrthonormalCols V₂ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W₂ ∧
      (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)ᵀ * U * Matrix.fromBlocks W₁ 0 0 W₂ =
        csCanonicalMatrix c ((1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e) := by
  have hOne : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
  exact exists_cs_decomposition U hU _ (hOne.submatrix_cols e)

name: NLAlib.unitaryQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem unitaryQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) (hA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)) :
    (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).val = unitaryQRNormalizedArray 𝕜 A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unitaryQRFrame,dif_pos hA]

name: NLAlib.isOpen_linearIndependent_unitaryQRColumnFamily
statement:
theorem isOpen_linearIndependent_unitaryQRColumnFamily (n k : ℕ) :
    IsOpen {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 | LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)}
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 => (Aᴴ*A).det) := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    fun_prop
  have heq : {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 | LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)} =
      {A | (Aᴴ*A).det ≠ 0} := by
    ext A
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [← Matrix.det_gram_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent,gram_unitaryQRColumnFamily]
  rw [heq]
  exact (isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const).isOpen_compl

name: NLAlib.measurable_unitaryQRNormalizedArray
statement:
theorem measurable_unitaryQRNormalizedArray (n k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (unitaryQRNormalizedArray 𝕜 (n := n) (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  have hc (j : Fin k) : Measurable (fun A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 => unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A j) := by
    dsimp only [unitaryQRColumnFamily]
    fun_prop
  apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
  intro i j
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) →L[𝕜] 𝕜).continuous.measurable.comp
    (measurable_gramSchmidtNormed_rclike 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜) hc j)

name: NLAlib.measurable_unitaryQRFrame
statement:
theorem measurable_unitaryQRFrame (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    Measurable (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.subtype_mk
  change Measurable (fun A => (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).val)
  have heq : (fun A => (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).val) =
      (fun A => if LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A) then unitaryQRNormalizedArray 𝕜 A
        else (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k hkn).val) := by
    funext A
    unfold unitaryQRFrame
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact Measurable.ite (isOpen_linearIndependent_unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 n k).measurableSet
    (measurable_unitaryQRNormalizedArray 𝕜 n k) measurable_const

name: NLAlib.unitaryQRColumnFamily_unitary_mul
statement:
theorem unitaryQRColumnFamily_unitary_mul {n k : ℕ}
    (O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) :
    unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 (O.val*A) = fun j =>
      HasOrthonormalCols.toLinearIsometry (conjTranspose_mul_self_unitaryGroup 𝕜 O)
        (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A j)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.unitaryQRNormalizedArray_unitary_mul
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  change (gramSchmidtNormed 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 (O.val*A)) j) i = _
  rw [unitaryQRColumnFamily_unitary_mul,gramSchmidtNormed_map_linearIsometry_rclike]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.unitaryQRFrame_unitary_mul
statement:
theorem unitaryQRFrame_unitary_mul {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜)
    (hA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)) :
    unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn (O.val*A) = O • unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A
proof:
:= by
  have hOA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 (O.val*A)) := by
    rw [unitaryQRColumnFamily_unitary_mul]
    let L := HasOrthonormalCols.toLinearIsometry (conjTranspose_mul_self_unitaryGroup 𝕜 O)
    exact hA.map' L.toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr L.injective)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn (O.val*A)).val = O.val*(unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).val
  rw [unitaryQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent 𝕜 hkn _ hOA,
    unitaryQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent 𝕜 hkn _ hA,unitaryQRNormalizedArray_unitary_mul]

name: NLAlib.unitaryQRFrame_mul_unitaryQRUpper
statement:
theorem unitaryQRFrame_mul_unitaryQRUpper {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) (hA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)) :
    (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).val*unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hkn A = A
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (gramSchmidtNormed 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A))) =
      Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)) := by
    calc
      _ = Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (gramSchmidt 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A))) := by
        simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
          span_gramSchmidtNormed (𝕜 := 𝕜) (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A) Set.univ
      _ = _ := span_gramSchmidt 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)
  have hsum (j : Fin k) : unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A j =
      ∑ i, inner 𝕜 (gramSchmidtNormed 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A) i)
        (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A j) • gramSchmidtNormed 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A) i := by
    apply eq_sum_inner_smul_of_mem_span_orthonormal_rclike 𝕜 _ (gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hA)
    rw [hspan]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j,rfl⟩
  ext i j
  have hh := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) => x i) (hsum j)
  simp only [unitaryQRColumnFamily,WithLp.ofLp_sum,WithLp.ofLp_smul,
    Finset.sum_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul] at hh
  simpa only [unitaryQRUpper,unitaryQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent 𝕜 hkn A hA,
    Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,unitaryQRNormalizedArray,
    unitaryQRColumnFamily,PiLp.inner_apply,RCLike.inner_apply,starRingEnd_apply,mul_comm] using hh.symm

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_unitaryQRUpper_mul_self
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_unitaryQRUpper_mul_self {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) (hA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)) :
    (unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hkn A)ᴴ*unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hkn A = Aᴴ*A
proof:
:= by
  let Q := (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).val
  let R := unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hkn A
  have hQ : Qᴴ*Q=1 := (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn A).property
  have hQR : Q*R=A := unitaryQRFrame_mul_unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hkn A hA
  calc
    Rᴴ*R = Rᴴ*(Qᴴ*Q)*R := by rw [hQ,Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (Q*R)ᴴ*(Q*R) := by rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hQR]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_unitaryQRUpper
statement:
theorem isUnit_unitaryQRUpper {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) (hA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 A)) :
    IsUnit (unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hkn A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hd
  have hdet := (Matrix.det_gram_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent (𝕜 := 𝕜)).mpr hA
  rw [gram_unitaryQRColumnFamily,← conjTranspose_unitaryQRUpper_mul_self 𝕜 hkn A hA,
    Matrix.det_mul,hd,mul_zero] at hdet
  exact hdet rfl

name: NLAlib.rank_toBlock_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem rank_toBlock_of_equiv {N m n : Type*} [Fintype N] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix N N ℂ) (p q : N → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q]
    (ep : {i // p i} ≃ m) (eq : {j // q j} ≃ n) :
    (A.toBlock p q).rank = (A.submatrix (fun i => (ep.symm i).val) (fun j => (eq.symm j).val)).rank
proof:
:= by
  exact (Matrix.rank_submatrix (A.toBlock p q) ep.symm eq.symm).symm

name: NLAlib.inverse_eq_conjTranspose_of_unitary
statement:
private theorem inverse_eq_conjTranspose_of_unitary {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {U : Matrix n n ℂ} (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) : IsUnit U.det ∧ U⁻¹ = Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hDet : U.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := congrArg Matrix.det hU
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose, hz, mul_zero, Matrix.det_one] at h
    exact zero_ne_one h
  have hUnit := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hDet
  refine ⟨hUnit, ?_⟩
  calc
    U⁻¹ = (Uᴴ * U) * U⁻¹ := by rw [hU, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = Uᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv U hUnit, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.rank_offDiagonal_blocks_eq_of_unitary
statement:
theorem rank_offDiagonal_blocks_eq_of_unitary {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) :
    U.toBlocks₁₂.rank = U.toBlocks₂₁.rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hUnit, hInv⟩ := inverse_eq_conjTranspose_of_unitary hU
  have h := card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement U hUnit
    (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isRight)
  have h12 : (U.toBlock (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isRight)).rank = U.toBlocks₁₂.rank := by
    exact rank_toBlock_of_equiv U _ _ Equiv.sumIsLeft Equiv.sumIsRight
  have hInv12 : (U⁻¹.toBlock (fun s => ¬s.isRight) (fun s => ¬s.isLeft)).rank =
      U.toBlocks₂₁.rank := by
    rw [rank_toBlock_of_equiv U⁻¹ _ _ (sumNotRightEquiv p q) (sumNotLeftEquiv p q), hInv]
    change U.toBlocks₂₁ᴴ.rank = U.toBlocks₂₁.rank
    exact Matrix.rank_conjTranspose _
  rw [h12, hInv12, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumIsRight : {s : p ⊕ q // s.isRight} ≃ q),
    Fintype.card_congr (sumNotLeftEquiv p q)] at h
  have h12le := U.toBlocks₁₂.rank_le_card_width
  have h21le := U.toBlocks₂₁.rank_le_card_height
  omega

name: NLAlib.rank_bottomRight_eq_rank_topLeft_add_card_sub_of_unitary
statement:
theorem rank_bottomRight_eq_rank_topLeft_add_card_sub_of_unitary {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1)
    (hCard : Fintype.card p ≤ Fintype.card q) :
    U.toBlocks₂₂.rank = U.toBlocks₁₁.rank + Fintype.card q - Fintype.card p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hUnit, hInv⟩ := inverse_eq_conjTranspose_of_unitary hU
  have h := card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement U hUnit
    (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft)
  have h11 : (U.toBlock (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft)).rank = U.toBlocks₁₁.rank :=
    rank_toBlock_of_equiv U _ _ Equiv.sumIsLeft Equiv.sumIsLeft
  have hInv22 : (U⁻¹.toBlock (fun s => ¬s.isLeft) (fun s => ¬s.isLeft)).rank =
      U.toBlocks₂₂.rank := by
    rw [rank_toBlock_of_equiv U⁻¹ _ _ (sumNotLeftEquiv p q) (sumNotLeftEquiv p q), hInv]
    change U.toBlocks₂₂ᴴ.rank = U.toBlocks₂₂.rank
    exact Matrix.rank_conjTranspose _
  rw [h11, hInv22, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumIsLeft : {s : p ⊕ q // s.isLeft} ≃ p),
    Fintype.card_congr (sumNotLeftEquiv p q)] at h
  have h11le := U.toBlocks₁₁.rank_le_card_width
  have h22le := U.toBlocks₂₂.rank_le_card_width
  omega

name: NLAlib.norm_le_one_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem norm_le_one_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem {P : Matrix m m ℂ}
    (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hPP : IsIdempotentElem P) : ‖P‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self P
  rw [hP.eq, show P * P = P from hPP] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg P]

name: NLAlib.norm_one_sub_rangeProjector_le
statement:
theorem norm_one_sub_rangeProjector_le (B : Matrix m k ℂ) :
    ‖(1 : Matrix m m ℂ) - rangeProjector B‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_one_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
  · simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
      (rangeProjector_isHermitian B).eq]
  · change (1 - rangeProjector B) * (1 - rangeProjector B) = _
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one, rangeProjector_mul_self]
    abel

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le (B : Matrix m k ℂ) (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ‖A - rangeProjector B * A‖ ≤ ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [show A - rangeProjector B * A = (1 - rangeProjector B) * A by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]]
  exact (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_one_sub_rangeProjector_le B) (norm_nonneg A)).trans_eq
      (one_mul _))

name: NLAlib.norm_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem norm_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {U : Matrix m k ℂ}
    (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (B : Matrix k n ℂ) : ‖U * B‖ = ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (U * B)
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ, hU,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (U * B), norm_nonneg B]

name: NLAlib.norm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem norm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {U : Matrix n k ℂ}
    (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (B : Matrix m k ℂ) : ‖B * Uᴴ‖ = ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose (B * Uᴴ), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    norm_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.norm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero {X Y : Matrix m n ℂ}
    (h : X * Yᴴ = 0) : ‖X + Y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖X‖ ^ 2 + ‖Y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h' : Y * Xᴴ = 0 := by
    have ht := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using ht
  have hG : (X + Y) * (X + Y)ᴴ = X * Xᴴ + Y * Yᴴ := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_add, h, h']
    abel
  have hRow : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℂ, ‖Z * Zᴴ‖ = ‖Z‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro Z
    have ht := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self Zᴴ
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at ht
    simpa only [pow_two] using ht
  rw [← hRow, hG]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans_eq (by rw [hRow, hRow])

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ‖A‖ ^ 2 = (A * Aᴴ).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.frobenius_norm_conjTranspose A,
    ← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, RCLike.re_to_complex]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {U : Matrix m k ℂ}
    (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (B : Matrix k n ℂ) : ‖U * B‖ ^ 2 = ‖B‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    ← frobNorm_eq_norm, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ, hU, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
    {U : Matrix n k ℂ} (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (B : Matrix m k ℂ) :
    ‖B * Uᴴ‖ ^ 2 = ‖B‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.frobenius_norm_conjTranspose (B * Uᴴ), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    frobenius_norm_sq_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU,
    Matrix.frobenius_norm_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_add_sq_eq_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_add_sq_eq_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero {X Y : Matrix m n ℂ}
    (h : X * Yᴴ = 0) : ‖X + Y‖ ^ 2 = ‖X‖ ^ 2 + ‖Y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h' : Y * Xᴴ = 0 := by
    have ht := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using ht
  rw [frobenius_norm_sq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose,
    frobenius_norm_sq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose,
    frobenius_norm_sq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_add, h, h',
    add_zero, zero_add, Matrix.trace_add, Complex.add_re]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_eq_left_projection_add_residual
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_eq_left_projection_add_residual
    (P : Matrix m m ℂ) (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hPP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) : ‖A‖ ^ 2 = ‖P * A‖ ^ 2 + ‖(1 - P) * A‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobenius_norm_sq_eq_right_projection_add_residual P hP hPP Aᴴ
  rw [Matrix.frobenius_norm_conjTranspose] at h
  have h1 : ‖Aᴴ * P‖ = ‖P * A‖ := by
    rw [← Matrix.frobenius_norm_conjTranspose (Aᴴ * P), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hP.eq]
  have h2 : ‖Aᴴ * (1 - P)‖ = ‖(1 - P) * A‖ := by
    rw [← Matrix.frobenius_norm_conjTranspose (Aᴴ * (1 - P)), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hP.eq]
  rwa [h1, h2] at h

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le
    (B : Matrix m k ℂ) (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ‖A - rangeProjector B * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs := frobenius_norm_sq_eq_left_projection_add_residual (rangeProjector B)
    (rangeProjector_isHermitian B) (rangeProjector_mul_self B) A
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hs
  linarith [sq_nonneg ‖rangeProjector B * A‖]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_complement_orthogonal
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_complement_orthogonal
    {𝕜 m q : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q]
    (E : Matrix m q 𝕜) (hE : HasOrthonormalCols E) :
    ∃ V : Matrix m (Fin (Fintype.card m-Fintype.card q)) 𝕜,
      HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ Eᴴ*V=0 ∧ E*Eᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hcomp⟩ := exists_unitary_complement E hE
  have hVV : V*Vᴴ=1-E*Eᴴ := by rw [← hcomp]; abel
  refine ⟨V,hV,?_,hcomp⟩
  calc
    Eᴴ*V = Eᴴ*(V*Vᴴ)*V := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [hV.conjTranspose_mul_self,Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = Eᴴ*(1-E*Eᴴ)*V := by rw [hVV]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.mul_one,← Matrix.mul_assoc Eᴴ E Eᴴ,
        hE.conjTranspose_mul_self,Matrix.one_mul,sub_self,Matrix.zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.native_singularValue_zero_eq_specNorm
proof:
:=
  singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm A

name: NLAlib.exists_idempotent_complement_norm_factor
statement:
theorem exists_idempotent_complement_norm_factor {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧
      specNorm P = (if P.rank = 0 then 0 else a) ∧
      specNorm (1 - P) = (if P.rank = Fintype.card n then 0 else a) ∧
      (P.rank = 0 ∨ P.rank = Fintype.card n → a = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht0, ht, htpos, H, hH, hHt, hBlock, hSpec, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_idempotent_canonical_spectrum P hP
  let N := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin P.rank) (Fin P.rank) ℝ)
    (rectDiag t : Matrix (Fin P.rank) (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ)
    0 (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ)
  have hz (i : ℕ) (hi : min P.rank (Fintype.card n - P.rank) ≤ i) : t i = 0 := by
    have hgi := hg.trans hi
    exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge hgi) ((htpos i).mp h))) (ht0 i)
  have hForm : 1 - P = H * (1 - N) * Hᵀ := by
    have hPForm : P = H * N * Hᵀ := by
      calc
        P = (H * Hᵀ) * P * (H * Hᵀ) := by rw [hHt]; simp
        _ = H * (Hᵀ * P * H) * Hᵀ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = H * N * Hᵀ := by rw [hBlock]
    calc
      _ = H * Hᵀ - H * N * Hᵀ := congrArg₂ (· - ·) hHt.symm hPForm
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hComplement : specNorm (1 - P) =
      if 0 < Fintype.card n - P.rank then Real.sqrt (1 + t 0 ^ 2) else 0 := by
    rw [← native_singularValue_zero_eq_specNorm]
    calc
      _ = singularValues (H * (1 - N) * Hᵀ) 0 :=
        congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => singularValues A 0) hForm
      _ = singularValues (1 - N) 0 := by
        rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial H,
          singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose hH, singularValues_isometry_mul hH]
      _ = _ := singularValues_one_sub_oblique_canonical t ht0 ht hz 0
  refine ⟨Real.sqrt (1 + t 0 ^ 2), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + t 0 ^ 2 by positivity)
    have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + t 0 ^ 2)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t 0)]
  · have hs := hSpec 0
    rw [native_singularValue_zero_eq_specNorm] at hs
    rw [hs]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  · rw [hComplement]
    have hRank := P.rank_le_card_height
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  · intro hEnd
    have hzero : t 0 = 0 := hz 0 (by rcases hEnd with h | h <;> simp [h])
    simp [hzero]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one_sub_eq_of_idempotent_of_rank_pos_lt
statement:
theorem specNorm_one_sub_eq_of_idempotent_of_rank_pos_lt {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hr : 0 < P.rank) (hn : P.rank < Fintype.card n) :
    specNorm (1 - P) = specNorm P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, _, h1, h2, _⟩ := exists_idempotent_complement_norm_factor P hP
  rw [h1, h2, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hr), if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt hn)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_idempotent_rank_endpoints
statement:
theorem specNorm_idempotent_rank_endpoints {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    (P.rank = 0 → specNorm P = 0 ∧
      specNorm (1 - P) = if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧
    (P.rank = Fintype.card n →
      specNorm P = (if Fintype.card n = 0 then 0 else 1) ∧ specNorm (1 - P) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, _, h1, h2, hEnd⟩ := exists_idempotent_complement_norm_factor P hP
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [h1, h2, hz, if_pos rfl, hEnd (Or.inl hz)]
    simp only [eq_comm]
    trivial
  · intro hf
    rw [h1, h2, hf, if_pos rfl, hEnd (Or.inr hf)]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_complex_range_kernel_frames_norm_eq_secant
statement:
theorem exists_complex_range_kernel_frames_norm_eq_secant {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hr : 0 < P.rank) :
    ∃ Q W : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℂ,
      Qᴴ * Q = 1 ∧ Wᴴ * W = 1 ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin ∧
      LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ ∧
      let θ
proof:
:= principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨P.rank - 1, by simpa using Nat.sub_lt hr Nat.one_pos⟩
      (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype W Q i ≤ θ) ∧
      θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ ‖P‖ = 1 / Real.cos θ := by
  obtain ⟨U, R, hR, hPR, _, hRank, hNorm, _⟩ := exists_real_idempotent_unitary_similarity P hP
  change P = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R.map Complex.ofRealHom * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ at hPR
  have hrR : 0 < R.rank := by omega
  obtain ⟨Q₀, W₀, hQ₀, hW₀, hRange, hRow, hAngles⟩ := exists_range_kernel_frames_specNorm_eq_secant R hR hrR
  let Q := (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Q₀.map Complex.ofRealHom
  let W := (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * W₀.map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hGram (F : Matrix n (Fin R.rank) ℝ) (hF : HasOrthonormalCols F) :
      ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * F.map Complex.ofRealHom)ᴴ *
        ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * F.map Complex.ofRealHom) = 1 := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (F.map Complex.ofRealHom),
      hU, Matrix.one_mul, (show (F.map Complex.ofRealHom)ᴴ = Fᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom by ext; simp), ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := Fᵀ) (M := F), (show Fᵀ * F = 1 from hF)]
    simp
  have hQrange : LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin :=
    range_unitary_mul_eq_of_similarity U P (R.map Complex.ofRealHom) (Q₀.map Complex.ofRealHom)
      hPR (range_toEuclideanLin_map_ofReal_eq Q₀ R hRange)
  have hRadj : Rᵀ.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.adjoint R.toEuclideanLin := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint R
  have hRow' : LinearMap.range W₀.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range Rᵀ.toEuclideanLin := by
    rw [hRow, hRadj, LinearMap.orthogonal_ker]
  have hPRadj : Pᴴ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Rᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    rw [hPR]
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      (show (R.map Complex.ofRealHom)ᴴ = Rᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom by ext; simp), Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hWrange : LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ := by
    calc
      _ = LinearMap.range Pᴴ.toEuclideanLin :=
        range_unitary_mul_eq_of_similarity U Pᴴ (Rᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom) (W₀.map Complex.ofRealHom)
          hPRadj (range_toEuclideanLin_map_ofReal_eq W₀ Rᵀ hRow')
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.orthogonal_ker]
  have hOverlap : Wᴴ * Q = (W₀ᵀ * Q₀).map Complex.ofRealHom := by
    simp only [W, Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (Q₀.map Complex.ofRealHom),
      hU, Matrix.one_mul, (show (W₀.map Complex.ofRealHom)ᴴ = W₀ᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom by ext; simp), ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := W₀ᵀ) (M := Q₀)]
  have hAngle (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin R.rank))) :
      principalAnglesFintype W Q i = principalAnglesFintype W₀ Q₀ i := by
    simp only [principalAnglesFintype, hOverlap, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    rw [show (W₀ᵀ * Q₀).map Complex.ofRealHom = (W₀ᵀ * Q₀).map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) from rfl,
      singularValues_map_ofReal]
  have hFinal : ∃ Q W : Matrix n (Fin R.rank) ℂ,
      Qᴴ * Q = 1 ∧ Wᴴ * W = 1 ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin ∧
      LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ ∧
      let θ := principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨R.rank - 1, by simpa using Nat.sub_lt hrR Nat.one_pos⟩
      (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype W Q i ≤ θ) ∧
      θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ ‖P‖ = 1 / Real.cos θ := by
    refine ⟨Q, W, hGram Q₀ hQ₀, hGram W₀ hW₀, hQrange, hWrange, ?_⟩
    dsimp only at hAngles ⊢
    simp only [hAngle, hNorm]
    exact hAngles
  let G (r : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ hr : 0 < r,
    ∃ Q W : Matrix n (Fin r) ℂ,
      Qᴴ * Q = 1 ∧ Wᴴ * W = 1 ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin ∧
      LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ ∧
      let θ := principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨r - 1, by simpa using Nat.sub_lt hr Nat.one_pos⟩
      (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype W Q i ≤ θ) ∧
      θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ ‖P‖ = 1 / Real.cos θ
  have hGR : G R.rank := fun _ => hFinal
  have hGP : G P.rank := Eq.mp (congrArg G hRank.symm) hGR
  exact hGP hr

name: NLAlib.sin_principalAngles_monotone
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  change Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q i) ≤ Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q j)
  rw [sin_principalAngles, sin_principalAngles]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  have horder := singularValues_antitone
    ((Pᴴ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) hij
  have hi := overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc hP hQ i
  have hj := overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc hP hQ j
  nlinarith [hi.1, hj.1]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sin_last
statement:
theorem specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sin_last {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q) =
      Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q ⟨Fintype.card n-1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n-1, by omega⟩
  have hl : 0 ≤ Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q last) := by
    rw [sin_principalAngles]
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  rw [sinePrincipalAngles, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hl).2
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q i) by
      rw [sin_principalAngles]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    apply sin_principalAngles_monotone hP hQ
    change i.val ≤ Fintype.card n-1
    omega
  · have hh := norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q i)) last
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hl] at hh
    exact hh

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sqrt_one_sub_last_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sqrt_one_sub_last_sq {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q) = Real.sqrt (1-singularValues
      ((Pᴴ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) (Fintype.card n-1)^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_sin_last hP hQ hn, sin_principalAngles]

name: NLAlib.exists_real_idempotent_unitary_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_real_idempotent_unitary_similarity {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ, ∃ R : Matrix n n ℝ,
      IsIdempotentElem R ∧ P = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R.map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      (∀ i, singularValues P i = singularValues R i) ∧
      P.rank = R.rank ∧ ‖P‖ = specNorm R ∧ ‖1 - P‖ = specNorm (1 - R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht0, ht, htpos, H, hH, hHt, hBlock⟩ := exists_unitary_idempotent_canonical P hP
  let e : (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le P.rank_le_card_height)
  let N : Matrix (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank))
      (Fin P.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - P.rank)) ℝ := Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag t) 0 0
  let R := N.reindex e e
  let Q : Matrix n n ℂ := H.submatrix id e.symm
  have hQ : Qᴴ * Q = 1 := by
    simp only [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix]
    rw [show Hᴴ.submatrix e.symm id * H.submatrix id e.symm =
      (Hᴴ * H).submatrix e.symm e.symm from
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Hᴴ H e.symm (Equiv.refl n) e.symm, hH]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, e.symm.injective.eq_iff]
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := ⟨Q, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr hQ⟩
  have hN : N * N = N := by simp [N, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  have hR : IsIdempotentElem R := by
    change R * R = R
    simp only [R, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hN]
  have hNmap : N.map Complex.ofReal = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 ((rectDiag t).map Complex.ofReal) 0 0 := by
    simp [N, Matrix.fromBlocks_map]
  have hPform : P = H * N.map Complex.ofReal * Hᴴ := by
    calc
      P = (H * Hᴴ) * P * (H * Hᴴ) := by rw [hHt]; simp
      _ = H * (Hᴴ * P * H) * Hᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hBlock, ← hNmap]
  have hfactor : P = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * R.map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    rw [hPform]
    change _ = Q * R.map Complex.ofReal * Qᴴ
    have hMap : R.map Complex.ofReal = (N.map Complex.ofReal).submatrix e.symm e.symm := rfl
    rw [hMap]
    simp only [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix]
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv H (N.map Complex.ofReal) id e.symm e.symm,
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (H * N.map Complex.ofReal) Hᴴ id e.symm id,
      Matrix.submatrix_id_id]
  have hspec (i : ℕ) : singularValues P i = singularValues R i := by
    rw [hfactor]
    have hU₁ : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
    rw [singularValues_eq_of_gram_charpoly_eq _ (R.map Complex.ofReal) (by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ), hU₁, Matrix.one_mul,
        Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hU₁, Matrix.mul_one])]
    exact singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) R i
  have hnorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
      ‖(U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A.map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ‖ = specNorm A := by
    change ‖((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A.map Complex.ofReal) * ((star U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ = _
    rw [CStarRing.norm_mul_coe_unitary _ (star U), CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary_mul,
      ← specNorm_eq_norm, ← singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm, ← singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm]
    exact singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) A 0
  have hrank : P.rank = R.rank := eq_of_forall_lt_iff fun k => by
    rw [← singularValues_ne_zero_iff, ← singularValues_ne_zero_iff, hspec]
  refine ⟨U, R, hR, hfactor, hspec, hrank, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfactor, hnorm]
  · have hcomp : 1 - P = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (1 - R).map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      have hmap : (1 - R).map Complex.ofReal = 1 - R.map Complex.ofReal := by
        ext i j; by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h]
      rw [hmap, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
        show (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 from Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U,
        ← hfactor]
    rw [hcomp, hnorm]

name: NLAlib.subspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem subspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_specNorm
    {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (F : Matrix r k ℝ) :
    subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range (U₁ + U₂ * F).mulVecLin) = specNorm F
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : U₂ᵀ * U₁ = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hU
  have hhead : ∀ z : k → ℝ, U₁ᵀ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ z) = z := by
    intro z
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, show U₁ᵀ * U₁ = 1 from hU₁, hU,
      Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have htail : ∀ z : k → ℝ, U₂ᵀ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ z) = F *ᵥ z := by
    intro z
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU', show U₂ᵀ * U₂ = 1 from hU₂,
      Matrix.one_mul, zero_add]
  let f := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (𝕜 := ℝ)).trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap F
  have he : ((fun x : n → ℝ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ᵀ *ᵥ x)‖) ''
      {x | x ∈ LinearMap.range (U₁ + U₂ * F).mulVecLin ∧
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁ᵀ *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ 1}) =
      ((fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ k => ‖f z‖) '' Metric.closedBall 0 1) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, hz⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 z, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, hhead, Metric.mem_closedBall,
          dist_zero_right] using hz
      · change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F *ᵥ z)‖ =
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ᵀ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ z))‖
        rw [htail]
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z, ⟨⟨WithLp.ofLp z, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [hhead, WithLp.toLp_ofLp, Metric.mem_closedBall,
          dist_zero_right] using hz
      · change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ᵀ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z))‖ =
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z)‖
        rw [htail]
  rw [subspaceTangent, he, ContinuousLinearMap.sSup_unitClosedBall_eq_norm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_zero {l : Type*} [Fintype l]
    (Q : Matrix n l ℝ) : vectorTangentToFrameENNReal Q 0 = 0

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_eq_top_of_projection_eq_zero
statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_eq_top_of_projection_eq_zero
    {l : Type*} [Fintype l] (Q : Matrix n l ℝ) {u : n → ℝ}
    (hu : u ≠ 0) (hp : Qᵀ *ᵥ u = 0) :
    vectorTangentToFrameENNReal Q u = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (by
    intro h
    apply hu
    exact WithLp.toLp_injective 2 h)
  simp only [vectorTangentToFrameENNReal, hp, Matrix.mulVec_zero, sub_zero,
    WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_top.mpr (Or.inl ⟨ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr hn, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_eq_ofReal
statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_eq_ofReal {l : Type*} [Fintype l]
    (Q : Matrix n l ℝ) {u : n → ℝ} (hp : Qᵀ *ᵥ u ≠ 0) :
    vectorTangentToFrameENNReal Q u = ENNReal.ofReal (vectorTangentToFrame Q u)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Qᵀ *ᵥ u)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (by
    intro h
    apply hp
    exact WithLp.toLp_injective 2 h)
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hn).symm

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrame_le_of_orthogonal_competitor
statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrame_le_of_orthogonal_competitor
    {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l] {Q : Matrix n l ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {u w : n → ℝ} (huNorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1)
    (huw : u ⬝ᵥ w = 0) (hw : u + w ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    vectorTangentToFrame Q u ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
    have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self u
    rw [huNorm, one_pow] at h
    exact h.symm
  let p := Qᵀ *ᵥ u
  let v := Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)
  have hpv : p ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    change (Qᵀ *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)) = 1
    rw [dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose,
      show Q *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)) = u + w from mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range hQ hw,
      dotProduct_comm,
      dotProduct_add, hu, huw, add_zero]
  have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 + w ⬝ᵥ w := by
    rw [show (Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)) = (u + w) ⬝ᵥ (u + w) from
      star_conjTranspose_mulVec_dotProduct_self_of_mem_range hQ hw]
    rw [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, hu, huw, dotProduct_comm w u, huw]
    ring
  have hcs : 1 ≤ (p ⬝ᵥ p) * (1 + w ⬝ᵥ w) := by
    have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ p v
    have hc : (p ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2 ≤ (p ⬝ᵥ p) * (v ⬝ᵥ v) := by
      simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using h
    simpa only [hpv, hvv, one_pow] using hc
  have hpp0 : 0 ≤ p ⬝ᵥ p := dotProduct_self_nonneg p
  have hpp : 0 < p ⬝ᵥ p := by
    by_contra h
    have hpzero : p ⬝ᵥ p = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h) hpp0
    rw [hpzero, zero_mul] at hcs
    linarith
  have hcross : u ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ p) = p ⬝ᵥ p := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose]
  have hee : (u - Q *ᵥ p) ⬝ᵥ (u - Q *ᵥ p) = 1 - p ⬝ᵥ p := by
    rw [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sub, hu, hcross,
      dotProduct_comm (Q *ᵥ p) u, hcross,
      show (Q *ᵥ p) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ p) = p ⬝ᵥ p from
        star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ p]
    ring
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p‖ ^ 2 = p ⬝ᵥ p := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    change (∑ i, p i ^ 2) = p ⬝ᵥ p
    simp only [dotProduct, pow_two]
  have hnormpos : 0 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p‖ := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 p)]
  unfold vectorTangentToFrame
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (u - Q *ᵥ p)‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hnormpos).2
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [mul_pow, hnorm, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  have hee' : (∑ i, (u - Q *ᵥ p) i ^ 2) = 1 - p ⬝ᵥ p := by
    simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using hee
  rw [hee']
  have hww : (∑ i, w i ^ 2) = w ⬝ᵥ w := by simp only [dotProduct, pow_two]
  rw [hww]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_le_of_orthogonal_competitor
statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_le_of_orthogonal_competitor
    {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l] {Q : Matrix n l ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {u w : n → ℝ} (huNorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1)
    (huw : u ⬝ᵥ w = 0) (hw : u + w ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    vectorTangentToFrameENNReal Q u ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
    have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self u
    rw [huNorm, one_pow] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hp : Qᵀ *ᵥ u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp
    have heq : (Qᵀ *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)) = 1 := by
      rw [dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose,
        show Q *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (u + w)) = u + w from
          mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range hQ hw, dotProduct_comm,
        dotProduct_add, hu, huw, add_zero]
    rw [hp, zero_dotProduct] at heq
    norm_num at heq
  rw [vectorTangentToFrameENNReal_eq_ofReal Q hp]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (vectorTangentToFrame_le_of_orthogonal_competitor hQ huNorm huw hw)

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrame_graph_col_le
statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrame_graph_col_le
    {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l] {Q : Matrix n l ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (F : Matrix r k ℝ)
    (hRange : LinearMap.range (U₁ + U₂ * F).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (i : k) : vectorTangentToFrame Q (U₁.col i) ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i)‖
proof:
:= by
  let e : k → ℝ := Pi.single i 1
  have he : U₁.col i = U₁ *ᵥ e := by simp [e]
  have hu : U₁.col i ⬝ᵥ U₁.col i = 1 := by
    rw [he, show (U₁ *ᵥ e) ⬝ᵥ (U₁ *ᵥ e) = e ⬝ᵥ e from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU₁ e]
    simp [e]
  have horth : U₁.col i ⬝ᵥ (U₂ *ᵥ F.col i) = 0 := by
    have hU' : U₂ᵀ * U₁ = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hU
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, he,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hU', Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_dotProduct]
  have hw : U₁.col i + U₂ *ᵥ F.col i ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin := by
    apply hRange
    rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    ext j
    simp [Matrix.col, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  have huNorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i)‖ = 1 := by
    have hnorm := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self (U₁.col i)
    rw [hu] at hnorm
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i))]
  have h := vectorTangentToFrame_le_of_orthogonal_competitor hQ huNorm horth hw
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ *ᵥ F.col i)‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i)‖ := by
    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two, star_trivial] using
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU₂ (F.col i)
  exact h.trans_eq hnorm

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_toMatrix_eq_conjugate
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_toMatrix_eq_conjugate {E n : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (b : OrthonormalBasis n ℝ E)
    (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    ∃ c : OrthonormalBasis n ℝ E, ∀ T : Module.End ℝ E,
      T.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = Qᵀ * T.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis * Q
proof:
:= by
  let L := hQ.toLinearIsometry
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective L :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective (f := L.toLinearMap)).mp L.injective
  let e := LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective L hsurj
  let c := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℝ).map (e.trans b.repr.symm)
  have hchange : b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = Q := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Basis.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, c, OrthonormalBasis.map_apply,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change (Q *ᵥ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℝ j).ofLp) i = Q i j
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, Matrix.mulVec_single]
  have hback : c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis = Qᵀ := by
    have hInv := Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip c.toBasis b.toBasis
    rw [hchange] at hInv
    calc
      c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis = c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * (Q * Qᵀ) := by
        rw [mul_eq_one_comm.mp (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = Qᵀ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hInv, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨c, fun T => ?_⟩
  have h := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
    c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis T
  rw [hback, hchange] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_sum_completion
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_sum_completion {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {m p q : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (Q : Matrix m p 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hcard : Fintype.card p + Fintype.card q = Fintype.card m) :
    ∃ H : Matrix m (p ⊕ q) 𝕜,
      HasOrthonormalCols H ∧ H * Hᴴ = 1 ∧ H.submatrix id Sum.inl = Q
proof:
:= by
  let e : (p ⊕ q) ≃ m := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simpa using hcard)
  let f : p ↪ m := ⟨fun i => e (Sum.inl i), e.injective.comp Sum.inl_injective⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWQ⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Q hQ f
  let H := W.reindex (Equiv.refl m) e.symm
  refine ⟨H, hW.reindex _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change W.submatrix id e * Wᴴ.submatrix e id = 1
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv W Wᴴ id e id, Matrix.submatrix_id_id]
    exact hW.mul_conjTranspose_self
  · ext i j
    exact hWQ i j

statement:
theorem headColumns_projector_add_tailColumns_projector {m : Type*} {n k : ℕ}
    (Q : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    headColumns Q hk * (headColumns Q hk)ᵀ + tailColumns Q hk * (tailColumns Q hk)ᵀ =
      Q * Qᵀ
proof:
:= by

  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    headColumns, tailColumns, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · rfl
  · exact Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (by omega)) _ _ (fun i => rfl)
