name: NLAlib.tan_principalAngles_sq
statement:
theorem tan_principalAngles_sq {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q i)^2 =
      (singularValues ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i)⁻¹^2*
        (1-singularValues ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc hP hQ i
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hb
  have hn : 0 ≤ 1-singularValues ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i^2 := by
    nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2]
  rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, cos_principalAngles hP hQ, sin_principalAngles,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hn, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_residual_mul_inv
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let C := Pᵀ*Q
  let CF := C.reindex e e
  let R := projResidual P Q
  let RF := R.reindex (Equiv.refl m) e
  have hCF : IsUnit CF := hC.map (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv ℝ e).toMonoidHom
  have hinv : CF⁻¹=(C⁻¹).reindex e e := by
    rw [← moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit CF hCF]
    change moorePenroseInverse (C.reindex e e) = _
    rw [moorePenroseInverse_reindex, moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit C hC]
  have hgram : RFᵀ*RF=1-CFᵀ*CF := by
    simp only [RF, CF, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.transpose_submatrix,
      Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
    have hh := conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap hP hQ
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hh
    change (Rᵀ*R).submatrix e.symm e.symm = 1-(Cᵀ*C).submatrix e.symm e.symm
    change Rᵀ*R=1-Cᵀ*C at hh
    rw [hh]
    change (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).submatrix e.symm e.symm - (Cᵀ*C).submatrix e.symm e.symm = _
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  have hprod : RF*CF⁻¹=(R*C⁻¹).reindex (Equiv.refl m) e := by
    rw [hinv]
    simp only [RF, Matrix.reindex_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl,
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
  have hi := specNorm_mul_inv_sq_eq_norm_singular_ratio RF CF hCF hgram
  rw [hprod, specNorm_reindex] at hi
  have ht := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q)
  have htg : (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q)ᵀ*tangentPrincipalAngles P Q =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (singularValues CF i)⁻¹^2*(1-singularValues CF i^2)) := by
    rw [tangentPrincipalAngles, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
    funext i
    change Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q i)*Real.tan (principalAnglesFintype P Q i) = _
    rw [← sq]
    exact tan_principalAngles_sq hP hQ i
  rw [htg] at ht
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal] at ht
  change specNorm (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q)^2 =
    ‖(fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (singularValues CF i)⁻¹^2*(1-singularValues CF i^2))‖ at ht
  change specNorm (R*C⁻¹)^2 = _ at hi
  nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (tangentPrincipalAngles P Q), specNorm_nonneg (R*C⁻¹)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap_mul_inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_tangentPrincipalAngles_eq_residual_mul_inv hP hQ hC,
    residual_eq_complement_mul_overlap hcomp, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (show Rᵀ * R = 1 from hR)]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_overlap_of_principalAngles_last_lt_pi_div_two
statement:
theorem isUnit_overlap_of_principalAngles_last_lt_pi_div_two {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (hangle : principalAnglesFintype P Q ⟨Fintype.card n-1, by omega⟩ < Real.pi/2) :
    IsUnit (Pᵀ*Q)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let C := (Pᵀ*Q).reindex e e
  have hs : 0 < singularValues C (Fintype.card n-1) := by
    simpa only [principalAnglesFintype, C, singularValues_reindex,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mp hangle)
  have hi := (singularValues_pos_iff C (Fintype.card n-1)).mp hs
  have hc := Matrix.rank_le_card_width C
  have hr : C.rank=Fintype.card n := by simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hc; omega
  have hC : IsUnit C := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det C).mpr
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq C (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hr)))
  have hh := hC.map (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv ℝ e.symm).toMonoidHom
  change IsUnit (C.reindex e.symm e.symm) at hh
  have hback : C.reindex e.symm e.symm=Pᵀ*Q := by
    ext i j
    simp [C, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  rw [hback] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.specNorm_idempotent_eq_secant_of_range_frames
statement:
theorem specNorm_idempotent_eq_secant_of_range_frames {n r : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r]
    {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    {Q W : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hW : HasOrthonormalCols W)
    (hRange : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
    (hRow : LinearMap.range W.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Pᵀ.mulVecLin)
    (hr : 0 < Fintype.card r) :
    let θ
proof:
:= principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨Fintype.card r - 1, by omega⟩
    θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ specNorm P = 1 / Real.cos θ := by
  obtain ⟨hC, hForm⟩ := isUnit_overlap_and_eq_mul_inv_mul_of_idempotent hP hQ hW hRange hRow
  have hRank : (Wᵀ * Q).rank = Fintype.card r := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hC
  have hpos : 0 < singularValues ((Wᵀ * Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin r)
      (Fintype.equivFin r)) (Fintype.card r - 1) := by
    apply (singularValues_pos_iff _ _).mpr
    rw [Matrix.rank_reindex, hRank]
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [principalAnglesFintype, singularValues_reindex,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr hpos
  · rw [hForm, specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols (show Wᵀ * W = 1 from hW),
      specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ),
      specNorm_inv_eq_inv_singularValues_last _ hC hr,
      cos_principalAngles hW hQ, singularValues_reindex,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, singularValues_eq_linearMap]

name: NLAlib.exists_range_kernel_frames_specNorm_eq_secant
statement:
theorem exists_range_kernel_frames_specNorm_eq_secant {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hr : 0 < P.rank) :
    ∃ Q W : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.range P.toEuclideanLin ∧
      LinearMap.range W.toEuclideanLin = (LinearMap.ker P.toEuclideanLin)ᗮ ∧
      let θ
proof:
:= principalAnglesFintype W Q ⟨P.rank - 1, by simpa using Nat.sub_lt hr Nat.one_pos⟩
      (∀ i, principalAnglesFintype W Q i ≤ θ) ∧
      θ < Real.pi / 2 ∧ specNorm P = 1 / Real.cos θ := by
  let Q : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℝ := orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin)
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q := hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix _
  have hRange : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin :=
    range_orthonormalBasisMatrix _
  have hWexists : ∃ W : Matrix n (Fin P.rank) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
      LinearMap.range W.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Pᵀ.mulVecLin := by
    have hEx : ∃ W : Matrix n (Fin Pᵀ.rank) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
        LinearMap.range W.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Pᵀ.mulVecLin :=
        ⟨orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range Pᵀ.mulVecLin),
          hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix _, range_orthonormalBasisMatrix _⟩
    convert hEx using 1
    rw [Matrix.rank_transpose]
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hRow⟩ := hWexists
  have hAdj : Pᵀ.toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.adjoint P.toEuclideanLin := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint P
  refine ⟨Q, W, hQ, hW, range_toEuclideanLin_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_eq Q P hRange, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [range_toEuclideanLin_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_eq W Pᵀ hRow, hAdj,
      LinearMap.orthogonal_ker]
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      apply principalAngles_monotone W Q
      change (i : ℕ) ≤ P.rank - 1
      have hi := i.isLt
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hi
      omega
    · have hWidth : 0 < Fintype.card (Fin P.rank) := by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hr
      have hSec := specNorm_idempotent_eq_secant_of_range_frames
        (n := n) (r := Fin P.rank) (P := P) (Q := Q) (W := W)
        hP hQ hW hRange hRow hWidth
      dsimp only at hSec
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hSec

statement:
theorem rangeProjector_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_hasOrthonormalCols {Q : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : rangeProjector Q = Q * Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hG : IsUnit (Qᴴ * Q) := by
    rw [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]
    exact isUnit_one
  rw [rangeProjector, moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL Q hG, pinvL,
    hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, inv_one, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.rangeProjector_eq_of_range_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hAB : rangeProjector A * rangeProjector B = rangeProjector B :=
    rangeProjector_mul_rangeProjector_of_mul_eq (rangeProjector_mul_of_range_le h.ge)
  have hBA : rangeProjector B * rangeProjector A = rangeProjector A :=
    rangeProjector_mul_rangeProjector_of_mul_eq (rangeProjector_mul_of_range_le h.le)
  have hAdj := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hAB
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (rangeProjector_isHermitian A).eq,
    (rangeProjector_isHermitian B).eq] at hAdj
  exact hBA.symm.trans hAdj

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanLin_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem toEuclideanLin_rangeProjector (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin (rangeProjector B) = (columnSpace B).starProjection.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  symm
  apply Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_orthogonal
  · refine ⟨Matrix.toEuclideanLin (moorePenroseInverse B) x, ?_⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
    rfl
  · rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
    rintro u ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hadj : Matrix.toEuclideanLin B = LinearMap.adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Bᴴ) := by
      rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    rw [hadj, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
    have hzero : Matrix.toEuclideanLin Bᴴ (x - Matrix.toEuclideanLin (rangeProjector B) x) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
      change Matrix.toEuclideanLin Bᴴ x - Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Bᴴ * rangeProjector B) x = 0
      have h : Bᴴ * rangeProjector B = Bᴴ := by
        have hh := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (rangeProjector_mul B)
        simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (rangeProjector_isHermitian B).eq] using hh
      rw [h, sub_self]
    simp [hzero]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le (B : Matrix m k 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (A - rangeProjector B * A) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [show A - rangeProjector B * A = (1 - rangeProjector B) * A by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]]
  exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_one_sub_rangeProjector_le_one B)
      (specNorm_nonneg A)).trans_eq (one_mul _))

proof:

  exact frobSq_one_sub_projector_mul_le (rangeProjector_isHermitian B)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hp := rangeProjector_mul_rangeProjector_of_mul_eq h
  have he : A - rangeProjector Q * A =
      (A - rangeProjector Y * A) - rangeProjector Q * (A - rangeProjector Y * A) := by

    abel

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_rangeProjector_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_rangeProjector_mulVec_le (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (c : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - rangeProjector B *ᵥ b)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - B *ᵥ c)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrArg (fun f : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m →ₗ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m =>
    f (WithLp.toLp 2 b)) (toEuclideanLin_rangeProjector B)
  change WithLp.toLp 2 (rangeProjector B *ᵥ b) =
    (columnSpace B).starProjection (WithLp.toLp 2 b) at hp
  have hc : WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ c) ∈ columnSpace B :=
    ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 c, rfl⟩
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b - WithLp.toLp 2 (rangeProjector B *ᵥ b)‖ ≤
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b - WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ c)‖
  rw [hp, Submodule.starProjection_minimal]
  exact ciInf_le ⟨0, Set.forall_mem_range.mpr fun _ => norm_nonneg _⟩
    (⟨WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ c), hc⟩ : columnSpace B)

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_le (B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (b : m → 𝕜) (c : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - B *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse B *ᵥ b))‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - B *ᵥ c)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  exact norm_sub_rangeProjector_mulVec_le B b c

name: NLAlib.eq_rangeProjector_mulVec_of_minimal
statement:
theorem eq_rangeProjector_mulVec_of_minimal {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {b y : m → 𝕜}
    (hy : y ∈ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin)
    (hmin : ∀ c : n → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - y)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - B *ᵥ c)‖) :
    y = rangeProjector B *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : WithLp.toLp 2 y ∈ columnSpace B := by
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 c, rfl⟩
  have hdist : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b - WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ =
      ⨅ w : columnSpace B, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b - w‖ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply le_ciInf
      intro w
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := w.property
      have hh := hmin c.ofLp
      change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b - WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b - Matrix.toEuclideanLin B c‖ at hh
      simpa only [hc] using hh
    · exact ciInf_le ⟨0, Set.forall_mem_range.mpr fun _ => norm_nonneg _⟩
        (⟨WithLp.toLp 2 y, hy'⟩ : columnSpace B)
  have he := (columnSpace B).eq_starProjection_of_mem_of_inner_eq_zero hy'
    (((columnSpace B).norm_eq_iInf_iff_inner_eq_zero hy').mp hdist)
  have hp := congrArg (fun f : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m →ₗ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m =>
    f (WithLp.toLp 2 b)) (toEuclideanLin_rangeProjector B)
  apply WithLp.toLp_injective 2
  exact he.symm.trans hp.symm

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_self_toEuclideanLin_symm
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self_toEuclideanLin_symm {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (L : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ m) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.toLinearMap)ᴴ *
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.toLinearMap) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : Matrix m n ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.toLinearMap
  have hQ : Q.toEuclideanLin = L.toLinearMap := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply _
  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
  calc
    (Qᴴ * Q).toEuclideanLin = LinearMap.adjoint Q.toEuclideanLin ∘ₗ Q.toEuclideanLin := by
      rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint]
      simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
    _ = LinearMap.id := by rw [hQ]; exact L.adjoint_comp_self'
    _ = (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).toEuclideanLin := by
      simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_eq_of_complex_gram_eq
statement:
theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_eq_of_complex_gram_eq {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix p n ℂ)
    (hGram : Aᴴ * A = Bᴴ * B) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖ = ‖B.toEuclideanLin x‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hG : LinearMap.adjoint A.toEuclideanLin ∘ₗ A.toEuclideanLin =
      LinearMap.adjoint B.toEuclideanLin ∘ₗ B.toEuclideanLin := by
    rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint,
      ← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint]
    simpa only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M.toEuclideanLin) hGram
  have hi : inner ℂ (A.toEuclideanLin x) (A.toEuclideanLin x) =
      inner ℂ (B.toEuclideanLin x) (B.toEuclideanLin x) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, ← LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    exact congrArg (inner ℂ x) (LinearMap.congr_fun hG x)
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  simp only [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K] at hi
  exact_mod_cast hi

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_mul_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_mul_eq_of_gram_eq {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] (A B : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (hGram : Aᴴ * A = Bᴴ * B) :
    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup m ℂ, (U : Matrix m m ℂ) * B = A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_linearIsometry_comp_eq_of_norm_eq A.toEuclideanLin B.toEuclideanLin
    (norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_eq_of_complex_gram_eq A B hGram)
  let U : Matrix m m ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm L.toLinearMap
  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := conjTranspose_mul_self_toEuclideanLin_symm L
  refine ⟨⟨U, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr hU⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
  simpa only [U, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hL

name: NLAlib.singularValues_one_sub_oblique_canonical
statement:
theorem singularValues_one_sub_oblique_canonical {r s : ℕ} (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (ht : Antitone t)
    (hz : ∀ i, min r s ≤ i → t i = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues ((1 : Matrix (Fin r ⊕ Fin s) (Fin r ⊕ Fin s) ℝ) -
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag t) 0 0) k =
      if k < s then Real.sqrt (1 + t k ^ 2) else 0
proof:
:= by
  let L := (1 : Matrix (Fin r ⊕ Fin s) (Fin r ⊕ Fin s) ℝ) -
    Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (rectDiag t) 0 0
  let T : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℝ := rectDiag t
  let A := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ) (-T) 0
    (0 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
  let B := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ) T 0
    (0 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
  have hA : Lᵀ.reindex (Equiv.sumComm _ _) (Equiv.sumComm _ _) = A := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [L, A, T, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply, rectDiag_apply, eq_comm]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp_all
  have hGram : A * Aᵀ = B * Bᵀ := by
    simp only [A, B, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_one,
      Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.transpose_neg, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg,
      neg_neg, neg_zero, add_zero]
  calc
    _ = singularValues A k := by
      rw [← hA, singularValues_reindex,
        singularValues_transpose]
    _ = singularValues B k := by
      rw [← singularValues_transpose A, ← singularValues_transpose B]
      apply singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hGram
    _ = _ := singularValues_oblique_canonical t ht0 ht (by simpa only [min_comm] using hz) k

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_right_block_of_first_columns_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_right_block_of_first_columns_eq {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (X Y : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) (hX : Xᴴ * X = 1)
    (hY : Yᴴ * Y = 1)
    (hFirst : X.submatrix id Sum.inl = Y.submatrix id Sum.inl) :
    ∃ W : Matrix q q ℂ, Wᴴ * W = 1 ∧ X * Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 W = Y
proof:
:= by
  let T := Xᴴ * Y
  have hT : Tᴴ * T = 1 := by
    simp only [T, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc X Xᴴ Y, mul_eq_one_comm.mp hX, Matrix.one_mul, hY]
  have hCols : T.submatrix id Sum.inl = (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ).submatrix id Sum.inl := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) p ℂ => Xᴴ * M) hFirst
    have hMul (Z : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) :
        Xᴴ * Z.submatrix id Sum.inl = (Xᴴ * Z).submatrix id Sum.inl := by
      simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using
        Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Xᴴ Z id (Equiv.refl (p ⊕ q)) Sum.inl
    rw [hMul, hMul, hX] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h11 : T.toBlocks₁₁ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    change T (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = (1 : Matrix p p ℂ) i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) p ℂ => M (Sum.inl i) j) hCols
    simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply, id_eq, Sum.inl.injEq] using h
  have h21 : T.toBlocks₂₁ = 0 := by
    ext i j
    change T (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) p ℂ => M (Sum.inr i) j) hCols
    simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply, id_eq, Sum.inr_ne_inl,
      ite_false, Matrix.zero_apply] using h
  have hGram : (Matrix.fromBlocks T.toBlocks₁₁ T.toBlocks₁₂ T.toBlocks₂₁ T.toBlocks₂₂)ᴴ *
      Matrix.fromBlocks T.toBlocks₁₁ T.toBlocks₁₂ T.toBlocks₂₁ T.toBlocks₂₂ = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks]
    exact hT
  have h12 : T.toBlocks₁₂ = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₁₂ hGram
    simpa only [Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₂, h11, h21, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero,
      show (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ).toBlocks₁₂ = 0 by ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₁₂]] using h
  have h22 : T.toBlocks₂₂ᴴ * T.toBlocks₂₂ = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₂₂ hGram
    simpa only [Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₂₂, h12, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      zero_add, show (1 : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ).toBlocks₂₂ = 1 by
        ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₂₂, Matrix.one_apply]] using h
  refine ⟨T.toBlocks₂₂, h22, ?_⟩
  have hBlocks : T = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 T.toBlocks₂₂ := by
    exact (Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks T).symm.trans
      (by rw [h11, h12, h21])
  rw [← hBlocks]
  change X * (Xᴴ * Y) = Y
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, show X * Xᴴ = 1 from mul_eq_one_comm.mp hX, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_isometry_mul_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem exists_isometry_mul_eq_of_gram_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix p n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card p) (hGram : Aᵀ * A = Bᵀ * B) :
    ∃ V : Matrix p m ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ V * A = B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_hasOrthonormalCols_of_card_le hCard
  have hPad : Bᵀ * B = (J * A)ᵀ * (J * A) := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Jᵀ J A,
      (show Jᵀ * J = 1 from hJ), Matrix.one_mul]
    exact hGram.symm
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hEq⟩ := exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq B (J * A) hPad
  refine ⟨O * J, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (O * J)ᵀ * (O * J) = 1
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Oᵀ O J,
      (show Oᵀ * O = 1 from hO), Matrix.one_mul, (show Jᵀ * J = 1 from hJ)]
  · simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hEq

name: NLAlib.gram_eq_iff_exists_isometry_mul_eq
statement:
theorem gram_eq_iff_exists_isometry_mul_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix p n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card p) :
    Aᵀ * A = Bᵀ * B ↔
      ∃ V : Matrix p m ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ V * A = B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_isometry_mul_eq_of_gram_eq A B hCard
  · rintro ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᵀ V A,
      (show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hV), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame {indices : r → n}
    (h : Function.Injective indices) : HasOrthonormalCols (coordinateFrame (𝕜 := 𝕜) indices)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_one.submatrix_cols ⟨indices, h⟩

name: NLAlib.coordinateFrame_conjTranspose_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateFrame_conjTranspose_mul {p : Type*} (indices : r → n) (U : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    (coordinateFrame indices)ᴴ * U = U.submatrix indices id
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [coordinateFrame, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.coordinateColumn_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateColumn_apply (i₀ i : m) (j : Unit) :
    coordinateColumn (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀ i j = if i = i₀ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateColumn, coordinateFrame, Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateColumn
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateColumn (i₀ : m) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (coordinateColumn (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: NLAlib.one_submatrix_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem one_submatrix_mul_conjTranspose (e : d ↪ n) :
    (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e * ((1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e)ᴴ =
      coordinateSelector (Finset.univ.map e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Finset.univ.map e
  · obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hi
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Function.id_def]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a]
    · by_cases haj : e a = j
      · subst j
        rw [Matrix.one_apply_eq, star_one, one_mul, coordinateSelector,
          Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, if_pos hi]
      · simp [Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm haj), coordinateSelector, haj]
    · intro b _ hba
      have hab : e a ≠ e b := fun h => hba (e.injective h).symm
      rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne hab, zero_mul]
    · simp
  · have he : ∀ a, i ≠ e a := by
      intro a hea
      exact hi (hea ▸ Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
    have hrow : ∀ a : d, (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) i (e a) = 0 := by
      intro a
      exact Matrix.one_apply_ne (he a)
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Function.id_def,
      hrow, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [coordinateSelector, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, if_neg hi]
    · simp [coordinateSelector, hij]

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_mul_eq_one_submatrix_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_mul_eq_one_submatrix_mul (X : Matrix n r 𝕜) (e : d ↪ n) :
    (coordinateSelector (Finset.univ.map e) : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X =
      (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e * X.submatrix e id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_submatrix_mul_conjTranspose e, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact coordinateFrame_conjTranspose_mul e X

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_coordinateSelector_mul_mul
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_coordinateSelector_mul_mul (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (e : d ↪ n) (hX : IsUnit (X.submatrix e id)) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse ((coordinateSelector (Finset.univ.map e) : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X) * Y =
      (X.submatrix e id)⁻¹ * Y.submatrix e id
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSelector_mul_eq_one_submatrix_mul]
  change moorePenroseInverse (coordinateFrame e * X.submatrix e id) * Y = _
  rw [
    moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols _ _ (hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame e.injective),
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit _ hX, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact coordinateFrame_conjTranspose_mul e Y

name: NLAlib.overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc {P Q : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (i : ℕ) :
    singularValues ((Pᴴ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i ∈
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact singularValues_nonneg _ _
  · have hh := singularValues_le_specNorm
      ((Pᴴ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i
    rw [specNorm_reindex] at hh
    have hp := specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hP
    have hq := specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hQ
    have hm := specNorm_mul_le Pᴴ Q
    rw [specNorm_conjTranspose] at hm
    have hb : specNorm P * specNorm Q ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ 1*specNorm Q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (specNorm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 := by simpa using hq
    exact hh.trans (hm.trans hb)

name: NLAlib.principalAngles_mem_Icc
proof:
:=
  by
    constructor
    · exact Real.arccos_nonneg _
    · apply Real.arccos_le_pi_div_two.mpr
      simpa only [singularValues_reindex] using (overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc hP hQ i).1

name: NLAlib.principalAngles_monotone
statement: theorem principalAngles_monotone (P Q : Matrix m n 𝕜) : Monotone (principalAnglesFintype P Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact Real.antitone_arccos (singularValues_antitone _ hij)

name: NLAlib.cos_principalAngles
statement:
theorem cos_principalAngles {P Q : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    Real.cos (principalAnglesFintype P Q i) =
      singularValues ((Pᴴ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i
proof:
:= by
  have hh := overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc hP hQ i
  simpa only [principalAnglesFintype, singularValues_reindex] using
    Real.cos_arccos (by linarith [hh.1]) hh.2

name: NLAlib.sin_principalAngles
statement:
theorem sin_principalAngles (P Q : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    Real.sin (principalAnglesFintype P Q i) =
      Real.sqrt (1-singularValues
        ((Pᴴ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  by
    simpa only [principalAnglesFintype, singularValues_reindex] using
      Real.sin_arccos (singularValues (Pᴴ * Q) i)

name: NLAlib.transpose_sinePrincipalAngles_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_sinePrincipalAngles_mul_self {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)ᵀ*sinePrincipalAngles P Q =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => 1-singularValues
        ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinePrincipalAngles, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
  funext i
  rw [← sq, sin_principalAngles, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Real.sq_sqrt]
  have hh := overlap_singularValues_mem_Icc hP hQ i
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hh
  nlinarith [hh.1, hh.2]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual
proof:
:= by
  let C := (Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)
  have hs := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)
  rw [transpose_sinePrincipalAngles_mul_self hP hQ] at hs
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal] at hs
  have hr := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self (projResidual P Q)
  have hGram := conjTranspose_residual_mul_residual_eq_one_sub_overlap hP hQ
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hGram
  rw [hGram] at hr
  have hc := specNorm_gram_sub_one_eq_norm_singularValues_sq_sub_one C
  have heq : Cᵀ*C-1 = ((Pᵀ*Q)ᵀ*(Pᵀ*Q)-1).reindex
      (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n) := by
    simp only [C, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
    change _ = ((Pᵀ*Q)ᵀ*(Pᵀ*Q)).submatrix _ _ - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).submatrix _ _
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  rw [heq, specNorm_reindex, specNorm_sub_comm] at hc
  have hn : ‖(fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => singularValues C j^2-1)‖ =
      ‖(fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => 1-singularValues C j^2)‖ := by
    rw [show (fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => singularValues C j^2-1) =
      -(fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => 1-singularValues C j^2) by ext j; simp]
    exact norm_neg _
  rw [hn] at hc
  change specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)^2 =
    ‖(fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => 1-singularValues C j^2)‖ at hs
  nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (sinePrincipalAngles P Q), specNorm_nonneg (projResidual P Q)]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_card_sub_overlap
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, transpose_sinePrincipalAngles_mul_self hP hQ,
    Matrix.trace_diagonal, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  congr 1
  rw [← frobSq_reindex (Pᵀ*Q) (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n),
    frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues, min_self, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => singularValues
    ((Pᵀ*Q).reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) j^2) (Fintype.card n)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobNorm, frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_card_sub_overlap hP hQ,
    frobSq_residual_eq_sub hP, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    frobSq_frame_eq_card hQ]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_projector_distance
proof:
:= by
  change specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q) = specNorm (P * Pᴴ - Q * Qᴴ)
  rw [specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ,
    specNorm_sub_frame_projector_eq_residual hP hQ]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projector_distance_eq_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles
proof:
:= by
  change frobSq (P * Pᴴ - Q * Qᴴ) = 2 * frobSq (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)
  rw [frobSq_sub_frame_projector_eq_two_mul_residual hP hQ,
    frobSq_residual_eq_sub hP, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_card_sub_overlap hP hQ,
    frobSq_frame_eq_card hQ]

name: NLAlib.principalAngles_comm
statement:
theorem principalAngles_comm {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (P Q : Matrix m n 𝕜) : principalAnglesFintype P Q = principalAnglesFintype Q P
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [principalAnglesFintype]
  rw [← singularValues_conjTranspose (Pᴴ * Q), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.residual_eq_complement_mul_overlap
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (1 : Matrix m m ℝ)-P*Pᵀ=R*Rᵀ := by
    rw [← hcomp]
    abel
  rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, heq, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap
statement:
theorem specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix m r ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R)
    (hcomp : P*Pᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1) : specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=specNorm (Rᵀ*Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ,
    residual_eq_complement_mul_overlap hcomp,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (show Rᵀ * R = 1 from hR)]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {P Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix m r ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R)
    (hcomp : P*Pᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1) : frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)=frobNorm (Rᵀ*Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ,
    residual_eq_complement_mul_overlap hcomp, frobNorm, frobNorm,
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hR]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ]
  exact (specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hP Q).trans (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hQ)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_qrNormalizedArray
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_qrNormalizedArray {n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (qrNormalizedArray A)
proof:
:= by
  have ho := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hA)
  rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  ext a b
  have hh := ho b a
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    qrNormalizedArray, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, eq_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) :
    (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val = qrNormalizedArray A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalQRFrame, dif_pos hA]

name: NLAlib.gram_qrColumnFamily
statement:
theorem gram_qrColumnFamily {n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    Matrix.gram ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) = Aᵀ * A
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.gram_apply, qrColumnFamily, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply,
    conj_trivial, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.isOpen_linearIndependent_qrColumnFamily
statement:
theorem isOpen_linearIndependent_qrColumnFamily (n k : ℕ) :
    IsOpen {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ | LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)}
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (Aᵀ * A).det) := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    fun_prop
  have heq : {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ | LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)} =
      {A | (Aᵀ * A).det ≠ 0} := by
    ext A
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [← Matrix.det_gram_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent, gram_qrColumnFamily]
  rw [heq]
  exact (isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const).isOpen_compl

name: NLAlib.measurable_qrNormalizedArray
statement:
theorem measurable_qrNormalizedArray (n k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (qrNormalizedArray (n := n) (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ j : Fin k, Measurable (fun A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ => qrColumnFamily A j) := by
    intro j
    dsimp only [qrColumnFamily]
    fun_prop
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro j
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.measurable.comp
    (measurable_gramSchmidtNormed qrColumnFamily hc j)

name: NLAlib.measurable_canonicalQRFrame
statement:
theorem measurable_canonicalQRFrame (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    Measurable (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.subtype_mk
  change Measurable (fun A => (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val)
  have heq : (fun A => (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val) =
      (fun A => if LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) then qrNormalizedArray A
        else (coordinateStiefel n k hkn).val) := by
    funext A
    unfold canonicalQRFrame
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact Measurable.ite (isOpen_linearIndependent_qrColumnFamily n k).measurableSet
    (measurable_qrNormalizedArray n k) measurable_const

name: NLAlib.canonicalQRUpper_apply_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem canonicalQRUpper_apply_eq_zero_of_lt {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A))
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : j < i) : canonicalQRUpper hkn A i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  change inner ℝ (qrColumnFamily (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val i) (qrColumnFamily A j) = 0
  rw [canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent hkn A hA]
  exact inner_gramSchmidtNormed_eq_zero_of_lt (qrColumnFamily A) hij

name: NLAlib.canonicalQRUpper_apply_self_pos
statement:
theorem canonicalQRUpper_apply_self_pos {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) (i : Fin k) :
    0 < canonicalQRUpper hkn A i i
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < inner ℝ (qrColumnFamily (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val i) (qrColumnFamily A i)
  rw [canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent hkn A hA]
  change 0 < inner ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) i) (qrColumnFamily A i)
  rw [inner_gramSchmidtNormed_self_eq_norm_gramSchmidt]
  exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hA)

name: NLAlib.qrColumnFamily_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem qrColumnFamily_orthogonal_mul {n k : ℕ}
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    qrColumnFamily (O.val * A) =
      fun j => HasOrthonormalCols.toLinearIsometry (transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup O)
        (qrColumnFamily A j)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.qrNormalizedArray_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem qrNormalizedArray_orthogonal_mul {n k : ℕ}
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    qrNormalizedArray (O.val * A) =
      O.val * qrNormalizedArray A
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  change (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily (O.val * A)) j) i = _
  rw [qrColumnFamily_orthogonal_mul, gramSchmidtNormed_map_linearIsometry]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.canonicalQRFrame_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem canonicalQRFrame_orthogonal_mul {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) :
    canonicalQRFrame n k hkn (O.val * A) =
      O • canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A
proof:
:= by
  have hOA : LinearIndependent ℝ
      (qrColumnFamily (O.val * A)) := by
    rw [qrColumnFamily_orthogonal_mul]
    let L := HasOrthonormalCols.toLinearIsometry (transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup O)
    exact hA.map' L.toLinearMap ((LinearMap.ker_eq_bot).mpr L.injective)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn (O.val * A)).val =
    (O.val * (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val)
  rw [canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent hkn _ hOA,
    canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent hkn A hA,
    qrNormalizedArray_orthogonal_mul]

name: NLAlib.canonicalQRUpper_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem canonicalQRUpper_orthogonal_mul {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) :
    canonicalQRUpper hkn (O.val * A) = canonicalQRUpper hkn A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change inner ℝ
    (qrColumnFamily (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn (O.val * A)).val i)
    (qrColumnFamily (O.val * A) j) = _
  rw [canonicalQRFrame_orthogonal_mul hkn O A hA]
  change inner ℝ
    (qrColumnFamily (O.val * (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val) i)
    (qrColumnFamily (O.val * A) j) = _
  rw [qrColumnFamily_orthogonal_mul, qrColumnFamily_orthogonal_mul]
  exact (HasOrthonormalCols.toLinearIsometry
    (transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup O)).inner_map_map _ _

name: NLAlib.canonicalQRFrame_mul_canonicalQRUpper
statement:
theorem canonicalQRFrame_mul_canonicalQRUpper {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) :
    (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val * canonicalQRUpper hkn A = A
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A))) =
      Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (qrColumnFamily A)) := by
    calc
      _ = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (gramSchmidt ℝ (qrColumnFamily A))) := by
        simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
          (span_gramSchmidtNormed (𝕜 := ℝ) (qrColumnFamily A) Set.univ)
      _ = _ := span_gramSchmidt ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)
  have hsum : ∀ j : Fin k, qrColumnFamily A j =
      ∑ i, (inner ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) i) (qrColumnFamily A j)) •
        gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) i := by
    intro j
    apply eq_sum_inner_smul_of_mem_span_orthonormal _ (gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hA)
    rw [hspan]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  ext i j
  have hh := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => x i) (hsum j)
  simp only [canonicalQRUpper, canonicalQRFrame_val_of_linearIndependent hkn A hA,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, qrColumnFamily, qrNormalizedArray,
    WithLp.toLp_ofLp]
  have hentry : (∑ a,
      (inner ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) a) (qrColumnFamily A j)) •
        gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) a) i =
      ∑ a, (inner ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) a) (qrColumnFamily A j)) *
        gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumnFamily A) a i := by
    simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hentry] at hh
  simpa only [qrColumnFamily, PiLp.toLp_apply, mul_comm] using hh.symm

name: NLAlib.transpose_canonicalQRUpper_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_canonicalQRUpper_mul_self {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumnFamily A)) :
    (canonicalQRUpper hkn A)ᵀ * canonicalQRUpper hkn A =
      Aᵀ * A
proof:
:= by
  let Q := (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).val
  let R := canonicalQRUpper hkn A
  have hQ : Qᵀ * Q = 1 := (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn A).property
  have hQR : Q * R = A := canonicalQRFrame_mul_canonicalQRUpper hkn A hA
  calc
    Rᵀ * R = Rᵀ * (Qᵀ * Q) * R := by rw [hQ, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (Q * R)ᵀ * (Q * R) := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hQR]
