name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.isIdempotentElem_singularDirectionProjector
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if keep i then 1 else 0)
  have hD : D * D = D := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    split_ifs <;> simp
  change (U * D * Uᴴ) * (U * D * Uᴴ) = U * D * Uᴴ
  calc
    _ = U * (D * (Uᴴ * U) * D) * Uᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one, hD]

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.conjTranspose_mul_singularDirectionProjector_mul
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.conjTranspose_mul_singularDirectionProjector_mul {p : ℕ}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (keep : Fin p → Bool) :
    Uᴴ * singularDirectionProjector U keep * U =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if keep i then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if keep i then 1 else 0)
  change Uᴴ * (U * D * Uᴴ) * U = D
  calc
    _ = (Uᴴ * U) * D * (Uᴴ * U) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem {ι K : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Field K]
    (P : Matrix ι ι K) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) : P.trace = (P.rank : K)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : IsIdempotentElem P.mulVecLin := by
    change P.mulVecLin.comp P.mulVecLin = P.mulVecLin
    rw [← Matrix.mulVecLin_mul, show P * P = P from hP]
  calc
    P.trace = LinearMap.trace K (ι → K) P.toLin' := (Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq P).symm
    _ = LinearMap.trace K (ι → K) P.mulVecLin := by rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply']
    _ = (P.rank : K) := LinearMap.IsProj.trace
      ((LinearMap.isProj_range_iff_isIdempotentElem P.mulVecLin).mpr hf)

name: NLAlib.re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem {ι 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [RCLike 𝕜] (P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (j : ι) :
    RCLike.re (P j j) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : Pᴴ * P = P := by rw [hs.eq]; exact hp
  have hsum : (∑ i, ‖P i j‖ ^ 2) = RCLike.re (P j j) := by
    have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M j j)) hgram
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, map_sum, RCLike.star_def,
      RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re] at he
    exact he
  have h0 : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (P j j) := by
    rw [← hsum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hsq : RCLike.re (P j j) ^ 2 ≤ RCLike.re (P j j) := by
    have ha := RCLike.abs_re_le_norm (P j j)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg h0] at ha
    have hn : 0 ≤ ‖P j j‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hb : ‖P j j‖ ^ 2 ≤ RCLike.re (P j j) := by
      rw [← hsum]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => sq_nonneg ‖P i j‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨h0, by nlinarith⟩

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_eq_projector_error_add
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_eq_projector_error_add {P : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hPP : IsIdempotentElem P) (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hPX : P * X = X) :
    frobSq (Y - X) = frobSq Y - frobSq (P * Y) + frobSq (P * Y - X)
proof:
:= by
  have hY := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hP hPP Y
  have hE := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hP hPP (Y - X)
  have hCX : (1 - P) * X = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hPX, sub_self]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hPX, Matrix.mul_sub, hCX, sub_zero] at hE
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_projector_mul_eq_sum
statement:
theorem IsSVD.frobSq_projector_mul_eq_sum {p q : ℕ} {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD Y U V)
    {P : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    frobSq (P * Y) =
      ∑ i : Fin p, singularValues Y i ^ 2 * RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * P * U) i i)
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : (P * Y) * (P * Y)ᴴ = P * (Y * Yᴴ) * P := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  set D : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((singularValues Y i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    hgram, h.mul_conjTranspose_self]
  calc
    _ = RCLike.re (P * U * (D * (Uᴴ * P))).trace := by
      congr 2
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, D]
    _ = RCLike.re ((D * (Uᴴ * P)) * (P * U)).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
    _ = RCLike.re (D * (Uᴴ * P * U)).trace := by
      congr 2
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc P P U, show P * P = P from hp]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.diagonal_mul, map_sum, D,
        RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_eq_sum_left_singularValues_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hp : IsIdempotentElem (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) := by change (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) * 1 = 1; simp
  have hc := h.frobSq_projector_mul_eq_sum (P := 1) Matrix.isHermitian_one hp
  simpa only [Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
    Matrix.one_apply_eq, RCLike.one_re, mul_one] using hc

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_prefix_sq_add_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_prefix_sq_add_bestRankFrobSq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    frobSq A = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A i ^ 2) + bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  rw [h.frobSq_eq_sum_left_singularValues_sq, bestRankFrobSq,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues A i ^ 2) (Fintype.card m)]
  by_cases hk : k ≤ Fintype.card m
  · have ht : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card m), if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (Fintype.card m), singularValues A i ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      congr 1
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]
      omega
    rw [ht]
    exact (Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hk).symm
  · have hmk : Fintype.card m ≤ k := by omega
    have ht : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card m), if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by rw [if_neg (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega)]
    rw [ht, add_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hmk)
    intro i _ hi
    have hz := singularValues_eq_zero_of_height_le A
      (show Fintype.card m ≤ i by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi)
    rw [hz, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projector_mul_le_sum_prefix_singularValues_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_projector_mul_le_sum_prefix_singularValues_sq {P : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (k : ℕ) (hr : P.rank ≤ k) :
    frobSq (P * A) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hPyth := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hs hp A
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hPyth
  have hBest := bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le A (P * A) k
    ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left P A).trans hr)
  have hSplit := frobSq_eq_sum_prefix_sq_add_bestRankFrobSq A k
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem IsSVD.re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul {p q : ℕ} {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD Y U V)
    (P : Matrix m m 𝕜) :
    (∑ i : Fin p, RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * P * U) i i)) = RCLike.re P.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_sum]
  change RCLike.re (Uᴴ * P * U).trace = _
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, h.mul_conjTranspose_left, Matrix.one_mul]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eq_diagonal_of_isIdempotentElem_of_re_diag
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eq_diagonal_of_isIdempotentElem_of_re_diag
    {P : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (keep : m → Bool) (hd : ∀ i, RCLike.re (P i i) = if keep i then 1 else 0) :
    P = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if keep i then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hPSD := hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp
  have hQ := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem hs hp
  have hQPSD := hQ.1.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hQ.2
  ext i j
  cases hj : keep j with
  | false =>
    have hz : P j j = 0 := by
      rw [← hs.coe_re_apply_self, hd j]
      simp [hj]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    have hij := apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hPSD hz i
    by_cases heq : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa [hj] using hij
    · simpa [heq] using hij
  | true =>
    have hz : (1 - P) j j = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq, ← hs.coe_re_apply_self, hd j]
      simp [hj]
    have hij := apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hQPSD hz i
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hij
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    by_cases heq : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa [hj] using hij.symm
    · simpa [heq] using hij.symm

name: NLAlib.inverse_eq_transpose_of_orthogonal
statement:
private theorem inverse_eq_transpose_of_orthogonal {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {U : Matrix n n ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) : IsUnit U.det ∧ U⁻¹ = Uᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hDet : U.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := congrArg Matrix.det (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU)
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hz, mul_zero, Matrix.det_one] at h
    exact zero_ne_one h
  have hUnit := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hDet
  refine ⟨hUnit, ?_⟩
  calc
    U⁻¹ = (Uᵀ * U) * U⁻¹ := by rw [show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = Uᵀ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv U hUnit, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.rank_offDiagonal_blocks_eq_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem rank_offDiagonal_blocks_eq_of_orthogonal {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    U.toBlocks₁₂.rank = U.toBlocks₂₁.rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hUnit, hInv⟩ := inverse_eq_transpose_of_orthogonal hU
  have h := card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement U hUnit
    (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isRight)
  have h12 : (U.toBlock (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isRight)).rank = U.toBlocks₁₂.rank := by
    exact rank_toBlock_of_equiv U _ _ Equiv.sumIsLeft Equiv.sumIsRight
  have hInv12 : (U⁻¹.toBlock (fun s => ¬s.isRight) (fun s => ¬s.isLeft)).rank =
      U.toBlocks₂₁.rank := by
    rw [rank_toBlock_of_equiv U⁻¹ _ _ (sumNotRightEquiv p q) (sumNotLeftEquiv p q), hInv]
    change U.toBlocks₂₁ᵀ.rank = U.toBlocks₂₁.rank
    exact Matrix.rank_transpose _
  rw [h12, hInv12, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumIsRight : {s : p ⊕ q // s.isRight} ≃ q),
    Fintype.card_congr (sumNotLeftEquiv p q)] at h
  have h12le := U.toBlocks₁₂.rank_le_card_width
  have h21le := U.toBlocks₂₁.rank_le_card_height
  omega

name: NLAlib.rank_bottomRight_eq_rank_topLeft_add_card_sub_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem rank_bottomRight_eq_rank_topLeft_add_card_sub_of_orthogonal {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hCard : Fintype.card p ≤ Fintype.card q) :
    U.toBlocks₂₂.rank = U.toBlocks₁₁.rank + Fintype.card q - Fintype.card p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hUnit, hInv⟩ := inverse_eq_transpose_of_orthogonal hU
  have h := card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement U hUnit
    (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft)
  have h11 : (U.toBlock (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft)).rank = U.toBlocks₁₁.rank :=
    rank_toBlock_of_equiv U _ _ Equiv.sumIsLeft Equiv.sumIsLeft
  have hInv22 : (U⁻¹.toBlock (fun s => ¬s.isLeft) (fun s => ¬s.isLeft)).rank =
      U.toBlocks₂₂.rank := by
    rw [rank_toBlock_of_equiv U⁻¹ _ _ (sumNotLeftEquiv p q) (sumNotLeftEquiv p q), hInv]
    change U.toBlocks₂₂ᵀ.rank = U.toBlocks₂₂.rank
    exact Matrix.rank_transpose _
  rw [h11, hInv22, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumIsLeft : {s : p ⊕ q // s.isLeft} ≃ p),
    Fintype.card_congr (sumNotLeftEquiv p q)] at h
  have h11le := U.toBlocks₁₁.rank_le_card_width
  have h22le := U.toBlocks₂₂.rank_le_card_width
  omega

name: NLAlib.frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le {Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} {E : Matrix m p 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hE : LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    frobSq (Qᴴ * E) = frobSq E
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ hE
  calc
    frobSq (Qᴴ * E) = frobSq (Q * (Qᴴ * E)) :=
      (frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self _).symm
    _ = frobSq E := congrArg frobSq h

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le {Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} {E : Matrix m p 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hE : LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    frobNorm (Qᴴ * E) = frobNorm E
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobNorm, frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le hQ hE]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_range_le [DecidableEq p]
    {Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} {E : Matrix m p 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hE : LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    specNorm (Qᴴ * E) = specNorm E
proof:
:=
  specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_eq_mul hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self
    (mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ hE).symm

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_le_of_add_conjTranspose_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).re_quadForm_nonneg v
  change 0 ≤ RCLike.re (quadForm ((-2 * a) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - (A + Aᴴ)) v) at h
  have hs := star_quadForm A v
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul,
    map_sub, map_add, RCLike.smul_re] at h
  change 0 ≤ (-2 * a) * RCLike.re (star v ⬝ᵥ v) -
    (RCLike.re (quadForm A v) + RCLike.re (quadForm Aᴴ v)) at h
  rw [← hs, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_re] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_compression_le
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_compression_le {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    {V : Matrix n k 𝕜} (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (v : k → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm (Vᴴ * A * V) v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA (V *ᵥ v)
  rw [← quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct] at h
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  have hn : star (V *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (V *ᵥ v) = star v ⬝ᵥ v := by
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      hV.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rwa [hn] at h

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_lyapunov_of_eigenvector
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_lyapunov_of_eigenvector (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    {E : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hE : E.IsHermitian) {v : n → 𝕜} {lam : ℝ}
    (hv : E *ᵥ v = (lam : 𝕜) • v) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm (A * E + E * Aᴴ) v) = 2 * lam * RCLike.re (quadForm A v)
proof:
:= by
  have hve : star v ᵥ* E = (lam : 𝕜) • star v := by
    rw [← hE.eq, ← Matrix.star_mulVec, hv, star_smul]
    simp
  have hq : quadForm (A * E + E * Aᴴ) v =
      (lam : 𝕜) * (quadForm A v + quadForm Aᴴ v) := by
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    rw [hv, Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_smul, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (star v) E, hve,
      smul_dotProduct]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hq, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, map_add, ← star_quadForm,
    RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_re]
  ring

name: NLAlib.eigenvector_star_dotProduct
proof:
:= by
  have h : (inner 𝕜 (hE.eigenvectorBasis j) (hE.eigenvectorBasis j) : 𝕜) = 1 := by
    rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hE.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 j]
    simp
  rwa [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm] at h

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_lyapunov_solution_of_quadratic_bound
statement:
theorem posSemidef_lyapunov_solution_of_quadratic_bound {A Q X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + Q = 0) : X.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hH := isHermitian_lyapunov_solution ha hA hQ.isHermitian hX
  apply hH.posSemidef_iff_eigenvalues_nonneg.mpr
  intro j
  let v := (hH.eigenvectorBasis j).ofLp
  have hv : X *ᵥ v = (hH.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) • v := by
    rw [← RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
    exact hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j
  have hq := hA v
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, eigenvector_star_dotProduct hH j,
    RCLike.one_re, mul_one] at hq
  have he := re_quadForm_lyapunov_of_eigenvector A hH hv
  rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hX] at he
  have hn : RCLike.re (quadForm (-Q) v) ≤ 0 := by
    simpa only [quadForm, Matrix.neg_mulVec, dotProduct_neg, map_neg] using
      neg_nonpos.mpr (hQ.re_quadForm_nonneg v)
  rw [he] at hn
  by_contra hneg
  have hl : hH.eigenvalues j < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hneg
  nlinarith [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hl (lt_of_le_of_lt hq (by linarith))]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_lyapunov_div
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_lyapunov_div {A E : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    (hE : E.IsHermitian) : specNorm E ≤ specNorm (A * E + E * Aᴴ) / (2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hE.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (by positivity))).mpr
  intro j
  let v := (hE.eigenvectorBasis j).ofLp
  have hv : E *ᵥ v = (hE.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) • v := by
    rw [← RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
    exact hE.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j
  have hq := hA v
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, eigenvector_star_dotProduct hE j,
    RCLike.one_re, mul_one] at hq
  have he := re_quadForm_lyapunov_of_eigenvector A hE hv
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := hE.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 j
  have hn := (RCLike.abs_re_le_norm (quadForm (A * E + E * Aᴴ) v)).trans
    (norm_quadForm_le_specNorm (A * E + E * Aᴴ) v)
  rw [hnorm, one_pow, mul_one, he] at hn
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * a)).2
  by_cases hl : 0 ≤ hE.eigenvalues j
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hl]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hl
    nlinarith [neg_le_abs (2 * hE.eigenvalues j * RCLike.re (quadForm A v))]
  · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hl)]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hq (le_of_not_ge hl)
    nlinarith [le_abs_self (2 * hE.eigenvalues j * RCLike.re (quadForm A v))]

name: NLAlib.sylvesterKronecker_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem sylvesterKronecker_map_ofReal (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    sylvesterKronecker (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) =
      (sylvesterKronecker A B).map Complex.ofReal
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨j,i⟩ ⟨l,k⟩
  by_cases hj : j = l <;> by_cases hi : i = k <;>
    simp [sylvesterKronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, hj, hi]

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_map_ofReal (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    sylvesterSep (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) = sylvesterSep A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold sylvesterSep
  rw [sylvesterKronecker_map_ofReal]
  exact singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (sylvesterKronecker A B) _

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_pos_iff_disjoint_complex_spectrum
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_pos_iff_disjoint_complex_spectrum [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    0 < sylvesterSep A B ↔ Disjoint (spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)) (spectrum ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sylvesterSep_map_ofReal, sylvesterSep_pos_iff_disjoint_spectrum]

name: NLAlib.isLeast_real_sylvesterSep_spectral_distances_of_normal
statement:
theorem isLeast_real_sylvesterSep_spectral_distances_of_normal [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∃ a ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal),
      ∃ b ∈ spectrum ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal), ‖a-b‖ = c} (sylvesterSep A B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAC : A.map Complex.ofReal * (A.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ =
      (A.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * A.map Complex.ofReal := by
    have h := congrArg (Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix) hA
    simp only [map_mul] at h
    have hstar : (A.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ = Aᴴ.map Complex.ofReal := by
      ext i j
      simp
    change A.map Complex.ofReal * Aᴴ.map Complex.ofReal = Aᴴ.map Complex.ofReal * A.map Complex.ofReal at h
    rwa [← hstar] at h
  have hBC : B.map Complex.ofReal * (B.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ =
      (B.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * B.map Complex.ofReal := by
    have h := congrArg (Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix) hB
    simp only [map_mul] at h
    have hstar : (B.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ = Bᴴ.map Complex.ofReal := by
      ext i j
      simp
    change B.map Complex.ofReal * Bᴴ.map Complex.ofReal = Bᴴ.map Complex.ofReal * B.map Complex.ofReal at h
    rwa [← hstar] at h
  have h := isLeast_sylvesterSep_spectral_distances_of_normal _ _ hAC hBC
  rw [sylvesterSep_map_ofReal] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.diagonal_sylvester
statement:
private theorem diagonal_sylvester (a : m → K) (b : n → K) (X : Matrix m n K) :
    Matrix.diagonal a * X - X * Matrix.diagonal b = fun i j => (a i - b j) * X i j
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  ring

name: NLAlib.diagonal_sylvester_lower
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (frobNorm_nonneg _)
  rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq, diagonal_sylvester, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,
    frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  rw [norm_mul, mul_pow]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ hc (hmin i j) 2) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.isLeast_sylvesterSep_diagonal
statement:
theorem isLeast_sylvesterSep_diagonal [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n] (a : m → K) (b : n → K) :
    IsLeast (Set.range (fun ij : m × n => ‖a ij.1 - b ij.2‖))
      (sylvesterSep (Matrix.diagonal a) (Matrix.diagonal b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : m × n → ℝ := fun ij => ‖a ij.1 - b ij.2‖
  let S := Finset.univ.image f
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.univ_nonempty.image f
  let c := S.min' hS
  have hcS : c ∈ S := Finset.min'_mem S hS
  obtain ⟨ij, _, hij⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hcS
  have hmin (i : m) (j : n) : c ≤ ‖a i - b j‖ :=
    Finset.min'_le S _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i,j), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by rw [← hij]; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hlow : c ≤ sylvesterSep (Matrix.diagonal a) (Matrix.diagonal b) := by
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hR⟩ := exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep (Matrix.diagonal a) (Matrix.diagonal b)
    simpa only [hX, mul_one, hR] using diagonal_sylvester_lower a b c hc hmin X
  let E : Matrix m n K := fun i j => if i = ij.1 then if j = ij.2 then 1 else 0 else 0
  have hE : frobNorm E = 1 := by
    have hsq : frobNorm E ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
      simp [E, apply_ite]
    nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg E]
  have hRE : Matrix.diagonal a * E - E * Matrix.diagonal b = (a ij.1 - b ij.2) • E := by
    rw [diagonal_sylvester]
    ext i j
    by_cases hi : i = ij.1 <;> by_cases hj : j = ij.2 <;>
      simp [E, hi, hj]
  have hupp : sylvesterSep (Matrix.diagonal a) (Matrix.diagonal b) ≤ c := by
    have hh := sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le (Matrix.diagonal a) (Matrix.diagonal b) E
    rw [hE, mul_one, hRE, frobNorm_smul_eq_norm_mul, hE, mul_one] at hh
    exact hh.trans_eq hij
  have heq : sylvesterSep (Matrix.diagonal a) (Matrix.diagonal b) = c := le_antisymm hupp hlow
  refine ⟨⟨ij, hij.trans heq.symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨⟨i,j⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact hmin i j

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_unitary_conj_le
statement:
private theorem sylvesterSep_unitary_conj_le [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup m K) (V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) :
    sylvesterSep ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ)
      ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) ≤ sylvesterSep A B
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ * (U : Matrix m m K) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hV : (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ * (V : Matrix n n K) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hR⟩ := exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep A B
  let X := (U : Matrix m m K) * Y * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ
  have hX : frobNorm X = 1 := by
    change frobNorm ((U : Matrix m m K) * Y * ((star V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) : Matrix n n K)) = 1
    rw [frobNorm_mul_right_unitary, frobNorm_mul_left_unitary, hY]
  have hEq : ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ) * X -
      X * ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) =
      (U : Matrix m m K) * (A * Y - Y * B) * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ := by
    dsimp only [X]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ (U : Matrix m m K) (Y * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ), hU,
      Matrix.one_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ (V : Matrix n n K) (B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ),
      hV, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hh := sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ)
    ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) X
  rw [hX, mul_one, hEq] at hh
  change _ ≤ frobNorm ((U : Matrix m m K) * (A * Y - Y * B) * ((star V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) : Matrix n n K)) at hh
  rw [frobNorm_mul_right_unitary, frobNorm_mul_left_unitary, hR] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_unitary_conj [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup m K) (V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) :
    sylvesterSep ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ)
      ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) = sylvesterSep A B
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ * (U : Matrix m m K) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hV : (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ * (V : Matrix n n K) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
  apply le_antisymm (sylvesterSep_unitary_conj_le A B U V)
  have h := sylvesterSep_unitary_conj_le ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ)
    ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) (star U) (star V)
  have hbackU : ((star U : Matrix.unitaryGroup m K) : Matrix m m K) *
      ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ) *
      (((star U : Matrix.unitaryGroup m K) : Matrix m m K))ᴴ = A := by
    change (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ * ((U : Matrix m m K) * A * (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ) *
      ((U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ)ᴴ = A
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ ((U : Matrix m m K) * A) (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix m m K)ᴴ (U : Matrix m m K) A,
      hU, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hU, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hbackV : ((star V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) : Matrix n n K) *
      ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) *
      (((star V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) : Matrix n n K))ᴴ = B := by
    change (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ * ((V : Matrix n n K) * B * (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ) *
      ((V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ)ᴴ = B
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ ((V : Matrix n n K) * B) (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (V : Matrix n n K)ᴴ (V : Matrix n n K) B,
      hV, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hV, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hbackU, hbackV] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.isLeast_sylvesterSep_spectral_distances_of_normal
statement:
theorem isLeast_sylvesterSep_spectral_distances_of_normal [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∃ a ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ∃ b ∈ spectrum ℂ B, ‖a - b‖ = c}
      (sylvesterSep A B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, a, rfl⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  obtain ⟨V, b, rfl⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hB
  have hspecU : spectrum ℂ ((U : Matrix m m ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal a * (U : Matrix m m ℂ)ᴴ) = Set.range a := by
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, spectrum_diagonal] using
      (Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal a) (U := U))
  have hspecV : spectrum ℂ ((V : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal b * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) = Set.range b := by
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, spectrum_diagonal] using
      (Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal b) (U := V))
  rw [sylvesterSep_unitary_conj, hspecU, hspecV]
  have hset : {c : ℝ | ∃ x ∈ Set.range a, ∃ y ∈ Set.range b, ‖x-y‖ = c} =
      Set.range (fun ij : m × n => ‖a ij.1-b ij.2‖) := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨i,rfl⟩, y, ⟨j,rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(i,j), rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨i,j⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a i, ⟨i,rfl⟩, b j, ⟨j,rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hset]
  exact isLeast_sylvesterSep_diagonal a b

name: NLAlib.sylvesterKronecker_mulVec
statement:
theorem sylvesterKronecker_mulVec (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) (X : Matrix m n K) :
    sylvesterKronecker A B *ᵥ matrixVectorization X = matrixVectorization (A * X - X * B)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨j,i⟩
  simp only [sylvesterKronecker, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, matrixVectorization, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.norm_matrixVectorization
statement:
theorem norm_matrixVectorization (X : Matrix m n K) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (matrixVectorization X)‖ = frobNorm X
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (matrixVectorization X)‖ ^ 2 = frobNorm X ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    simp only [matrixVectorization, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (matrixVectorization X)), frobNorm_nonneg X]

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_nonneg
statement: theorem sylvesterSep_nonneg (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) : 0 ≤ sylvesterSep A B
proof:
:=
  singularValues_nonneg _ _

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) (X : Matrix m n K) :
    sylvesterSep A B * frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (A * X - X * B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_last_mul_norm_le (sylvesterKronecker A B) (matrixVectorization X)
  simpa only [sylvesterSep, sylvesterKronecker_mulVec, norm_matrixVectorization] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep
statement:
theorem exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    ∃ X : Matrix m n K, frobNorm X = 1 ∧ frobNorm (A * X - X * B) = sylvesterSep A B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hKv⟩ := exists_unit_norm_mulVec_eq_singularValues_last (sylvesterKronecker A B)
  let X : Matrix m n K := fun i j => v (j,i)
  have hvX : matrixVectorization X = v := by ext ⟨j,i⟩; rfl
  refine ⟨X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← norm_matrixVectorization, hvX]; exact hv
  · rw [← norm_matrixVectorization, ← sylvesterKronecker_mulVec, hvX]
    exact hKv

name: NLAlib.isLeast_sylvesterSep
statement:
theorem isLeast_sylvesterSep [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∃ X : Matrix m n K, frobNorm X = 1 ∧ frobNorm (A * X - X * B) = c}
      (sylvesterSep A B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep A B, ?_⟩
  rintro c ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩
  simpa only [hX, mul_one] using sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le A B X

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_pos_iff_injective
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_pos_iff_injective [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    0 < sylvesterSep A B ↔ Function.Injective (sylvesterLinearMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsep
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro X hX
    have h := sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le A B X
    change A * X - X * B = 0 at hX
    rw [hX, frobNorm_zero] at h
    have hz : frobNorm X = 0 := by nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg X]
    exact (frobNorm_eq_zero_iff X).mp hz
  · intro hinj
    by_contra h
    have hz : sylvesterSep A B = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h) (sylvesterSep_nonneg A B)
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hS⟩ := exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep A B
    rw [hz] at hS
    have hL : sylvesterLinearMap A B X = sylvesterLinearMap A B 0 := by
      change A * X - X * B = _
      rw [(frobNorm_eq_zero_iff (A * X - X * B)).mp hS]
      simp [sylvesterLinearMap]
    have hzero := hinj hL
    rw [hzero, frobNorm_zero] at hX
    norm_num at hX

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_pos_iff_disjoint_spectrum
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_pos_iff_disjoint_spectrum [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    0 < sylvesterSep A B ↔ Disjoint (spectrum ℂ A) (spectrum ℂ B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sylvesterSep_pos_iff_injective, ← sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_iff_disjoint_spectrum]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp h⟩, fun h => h.1⟩

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sub_le_residual_div_sylvesterSep
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sub_le_residual_div_sylvesterSep (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X Xhat : Matrix m n K) (hsep : 0 < sylvesterSep A B)
    (hX : A * X - X * B = C) :
    frobNorm (X - Xhat) ≤ frobNorm (C - (A * Xhat - Xhat * B)) / sylvesterSep A B
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hsep).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  have he : A * (X - Xhat) - (X - Xhat) * B = C - (A * Xhat - Xhat * B) := by
    rw [← hX, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]; abel
  exact (sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le A B (X - Xhat)).trans_eq (congrArg frobNorm he)

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_eq_sum_re_quadForm
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_eq_sum_re_quadForm {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (E : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobInner E (A * E) = ∑ j, RCLike.re (quadForm A (E.col j))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, map_sum, quadForm, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Matrix.col_apply, Pi.star_apply]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_le
statement:
private theorem frobInner_mul_le {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    (E : Matrix n p 𝕜) : frobInner E (A * E) ≤ -a * frobSq E
proof:
:= by
  have hid : frobSq E = ∑ j, RCLike.re (star (E.col j) ⬝ᵥ E.col j) := by
    have h := frobInner_mul_eq_sum_re_quadForm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) E
    simpa only [Matrix.one_mul, quadForm, Matrix.one_mulVec, frobSq] using h
  rw [frobInner_mul_eq_sum_re_quadForm, hid, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
    simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct] using hA (E.col j)

name: NLAlib.frobInner_lyapunov_le
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := frobInner_mul_le hA E
  have hright := frobInner_mul_le hA Eᴴ
  have he : frobInner E (E * Aᴴ) = frobInner Eᴴ (A * Eᴴ) := by
    rw [← frobInner_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  rw [frobSq_conjTranspose] at hright
  rw [frobInner_add_right, he]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_le_lyapunov_div
statement:
theorem frobNorm_le_lyapunov_div {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    (E : Matrix n n 𝕜) : frobNorm E ≤ frobNorm (A * E + E * Aᴴ) / (2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  have he := frobInner_lyapunov_le hA E
  have hc := neg_le_abs (frobInner E (A * E + E * Aᴴ))
  have hcs := abs_frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm E (A * E + E * Aᴴ)
  have hsq := frobNorm_sq E
  by_cases hz : frobNorm E = 0
  · rw [hz]
    exact div_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  · have hp : 0 < frobNorm E := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobNorm_nonneg E) (Ne.symm hz)
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * a)).2
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.lyapunovLinearMap_injective
statement:
theorem lyapunovLinearMap_injective {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2) :
    Function.Injective (lyapunovLinearMap A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot).mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro E hE
  have h := frobInner_lyapunov_le hA E
  change A * E + E * Aᴴ = 0 at hE
  rw [hE, frobInner_zero_right] at h
  have hz : frobSq E = 0 := by nlinarith [frobSq_nonneg E]
  exact (frobSq_eq_zero_iff E).mp hz

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_lyapunov_of_quadratic_bound
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lyapunov_of_quadratic_bound {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    (Q : Matrix n n 𝕜) : ∃! X : Matrix n n 𝕜, A * X + X * Aᴴ + Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi := lyapunovLinearMap_injective ha hA
  have hs : Function.Surjective (lyapunovLinearMap A) := LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hi
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := hs (-Q)
  refine ⟨X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change A * X + X * Aᴴ = -Q at hX
    rw [hX, neg_add_cancel]
  · intro Y hY
    apply hi
    change A * Y + Y * Aᴴ = _
    rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hY]
    exact hX.symm

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_lyapunov_solution
statement:
theorem isHermitian_lyapunov_solution {A Q X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (quadForm A v) ≤ -a * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
    (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + Q = 0) : X.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hstar := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hX
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hQ.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] at hstar
  have he : A * Xᴴ + Xᴴ * Aᴴ + Q = 0 := by rw [add_comm (A * Xᴴ)]; exact hstar
  have hi := lyapunovLinearMap_injective ha hA
  exact hi ((eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left he).trans (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hX).symm)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sylvester_perturbation_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sylvester_perturbation_le (dA : Matrix m m K) (dB : Matrix n n K)
    (X : Matrix m n K) :
    frobNorm (dA * X - X * dB) ≤ (specNorm dA + specNorm dB) * frobNorm X
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ frobNorm (dA * X) + frobNorm (X * dB) := frobNorm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm dA * frobNorm X + frobNorm X * specNorm dB :=
      add_le_add (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm _ _) (frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.sub_norms_mul_frobNorm_le_sylvester_perturbed
statement:
theorem sub_norms_mul_frobNorm_le_sylvester_perturbed (A dA : Matrix m m K)
    (B dB : Matrix n n K) (X : Matrix m n K) :
    (sylvesterSep A B - (specNorm dA + specNorm dB)) * frobNorm X ≤
      frobNorm ((A + dA) * X - X * (B + dB))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := sylvesterSep_mul_frobNorm_le A B X
  have hpert := frobNorm_sylvester_perturbation_le dA dB X
  have he : A * X - X * B = ((A + dA) * X - X * (B + dB)) - (dA * X - X * dB) := by
    simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add]; abel
  have htri := frobNorm_sub_le ((A + dA) * X - X * (B + dB)) (dA * X - X * dB)
  rw [← he] at htri
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sylvesterSep_perturbed_ge
statement:
theorem sylvesterSep_perturbed_ge [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n] (A dA : Matrix m m K)
    (B dB : Matrix n n K) :
    sylvesterSep A B - (specNorm dA + specNorm dB) ≤ sylvesterSep (A + dA) (B + dB)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hS⟩ := exists_frobNorm_one_sylvester_eq_sep (A + dA) (B + dB)
  simpa only [hX, mul_one, hS] using sub_norms_mul_frobNorm_le_sylvester_perturbed A dA B dB X

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_sylvester_of_perturbation_margin
statement:
theorem existsUnique_sylvester_of_perturbation_margin [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A dA : Matrix m m K) (B dB : Matrix n n K) (C : Matrix m n K)
    (hmargin : specNorm dA + specNorm dB < sylvesterSep A B) :
    ∃! X : Matrix m n K, (A + dA) * X - X * (B + dB) = C
proof:
:= by
  have hsep : 0 < sylvesterSep (A + dA) (B + dB) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (sub_pos.mpr hmargin) (sylvesterSep_perturbed_ge A dA B dB)
  have hinj := (sylvesterSep_pos_iff_injective (A + dA) (B + dB)).mp hsep
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj) C
  exact ⟨X, hX, fun Y hY => hinj (hY.trans hX.symm)⟩

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sylvester_solution_perturbation_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sylvester_solution_perturbation_le (A dA : Matrix m m K)
    (B dB : Matrix n n K) (C dC X Xnew : Matrix m n K)
    (hmargin : specNorm dA + specNorm dB < sylvesterSep A B)
    (hX : A * X - X * B = C)
    (hXnew : (A + dA) * Xnew - Xnew * (B + dB) = C + dC) :
    frobNorm (Xnew - X) ≤
      (frobNorm dC + (specNorm dA + specNorm dB) * frobNorm X) /
        (sylvesterSep A B - (specNorm dA + specNorm dB))
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hmargin)).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  have hlow := sub_norms_mul_frobNorm_le_sylvester_perturbed A dA B dB (Xnew - X)
  have he : (A + dA) * (Xnew - X) - (Xnew - X) * (B + dB) = dC - (dA * X - X * dB) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
    have hnew : (A + dA) * X = C + X * B + dA * X := by
      rw [Matrix.add_mul, ← hX]; abel
    rw [hnew, Matrix.mul_add]
    have hfirst : (A + dA) * Xnew = C + dC + Xnew * (B + dB) :=
      sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hXnew
    rw [hfirst]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add]
    abel
  rw [he] at hlow
  exact hlow.trans ((frobNorm_sub_le _ _).trans
    (add_le_add le_rfl (frobNorm_sylvester_perturbation_le dA dB X)))

name: NLAlib.frobEnergy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem frobEnergy_zero (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobEnergy S 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [frobEnergy]

name: NLAlib.frobEnergy_smul
statement:
theorem frobEnergy_smul (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (X : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobEnergy S (c • X) = c ^ 2 * frobEnergy S X
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobEnergy, map_smul, frobInner_smul_left, frobInner_smul_right]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobEnergy_add
statement:
theorem frobEnergy_add (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V) (U V : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobEnergy S (U + V) = frobEnergy S U + 2 * frobInner V (S U) + frobEnergy S V
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobEnergy, map_add, frobInner_add_left, frobInner_add_right]
  rw [hS U V, frobInner_comm (S U) V]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobEnergy_sub
statement:
theorem frobEnergy_sub (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V) (U V : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobEnergy S (U - V) = frobEnergy S U - 2 * frobInner V (S U) + frobEnergy S V
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobEnergy, map_sub, frobInner_sub_left, frobInner_sub_right]
  rw [hS U V, frobInner_comm (S U) V]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobEnergy_sub_eq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero
statement:
theorem frobEnergy_sub_eq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero
    (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V)
    (X Xh Z : Matrix m n ℝ) (horth : frobInner (Xh - Z) (S (X - Xh)) = 0) :
    frobEnergy S (X - Z) = frobEnergy S (X - Xh) + frobEnergy S (Xh - Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show X - Z = (X - Xh) + (Xh - Z) by abel, frobEnergy_add S hS, horth]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isMinOn_frobEnergy_sub_iff_forall_frobInner_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isMinOn_frobEnergy_sub_iff_forall_frobInner_eq_zero
    (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V)
    (hpos : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℝ, Z ≠ 0 → 0 < frobEnergy S Z)
    (U : Submodule ℝ (Matrix m n ℝ)) (X Xh : Matrix m n ℝ) (hXh : Xh ∈ U) :
    IsMinOn (fun Z => frobEnergy S (X - Z)) (U : Set (Matrix m n ℝ)) Xh ↔
      ∀ Z ∈ U, frobInner Z (S (X - Xh)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isMinOn_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hmin Z hZ
    by_cases hz : Z = 0
    · simp [hz]
    let a := frobEnergy S Z
    let c := frobInner Z (S (X - Xh))
    have ha : 0 < a := hpos Z hz
    have hm := hmin (Xh + (c / a) • Z) (U.add_mem hXh (U.smul_mem (c / a) hZ))
    rw [show X - (Xh + (c / a) • Z) = (X - Xh) - (c / a) • Z by abel,
      frobEnergy_sub S hS (X - Xh) ((c / a) • Z), frobEnergy_smul,
      frobInner_smul_left] at hm
    change frobEnergy S (X - Xh) ≤
      frobEnergy S (X - Xh) - 2 * (c / a * c) + (c / a) ^ 2 * a at hm
    have hc : -2 * (c / a * c) + (c / a) ^ 2 * a = -(c ^ 2 / a) := by
      field_simp [ha.ne']
      ring
    have hnonpos : c ^ 2 / a ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have hs : c ^ 2 = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (by simpa only [zero_mul] using (div_le_iff₀ ha).mp hnonpos) (sq_nonneg c)
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hs
  · intro horth Z hZ
    rw [frobEnergy_sub_eq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero S hS X Xh Z
      (horth _ (U.sub_mem hXh hZ))]
    by_cases hz : Xh - Z = 0
    · simp [hz]
    · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hpos _ hz).le

name: NLAlib.eq_of_frobEnergy_sub_le_of_isMinOn
statement:
theorem eq_of_frobEnergy_sub_le_of_isMinOn
    (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V)
    (hpos : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℝ, Z ≠ 0 → 0 < frobEnergy S Z)
    (U : Submodule ℝ (Matrix m n ℝ)) (X Xh : Matrix m n ℝ) (hXh : Xh ∈ U)
    (hmin : IsMinOn (fun Z => frobEnergy S (X - Z)) (U : Set (Matrix m n ℝ)) Xh)
    {Z : Matrix m n ℝ} (hZ : Z ∈ U)
    (hle : frobEnergy S (X - Z) ≤ frobEnergy S (X - Xh)) : Z = Xh
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have horth := (isMinOn_frobEnergy_sub_iff_forall_frobInner_eq_zero S hS hpos U X Xh hXh).mp hmin
  by_contra hne
  have hp := hpos (Xh - Z) (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne))
  rw [frobEnergy_sub_eq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero S hS X Xh Z
    (horth _ (U.sub_mem hXh hZ))] at hle
  linarith

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
    (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V)
    (hpos : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℝ, Z ≠ 0 → 0 < frobEnergy S Z)
    (V : Matrix m p ℝ) (W : Matrix n q ℝ) (X F : Matrix m n ℝ) (hX : S X = F)
    (Y : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    Vᴴ * (F - S (V * Y * Wᴴ)) * W = 0 ↔
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy S (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) ≤ frobEnergy S (X - V * T * Wᴴ)) ∧
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy S (X - V * T * Wᴴ) ≤ frobEnergy S (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) →
          V * T * Wᴴ = V * Y * Wᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  let U := LinearMap.range (twoSidedTrialMap V W)
  let Xh := V * Y * Wᴴ
  have hXh : Xh ∈ U := ⟨Y, rfl⟩
  have hgal : Vᴴ * (F - S Xh) * W = 0 ↔
      ∀ Z ∈ U, frobInner Z (S (X - Xh)) = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h Z hZ
      obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := hZ
      change frobInner (V * T * Wᴴ) (S (X - Xh)) = 0
      rw [frobInner_mul_mul_conjTranspose, map_sub, hX, h]
      simp
    · intro h
      let R := Vᴴ * (F - S Xh) * W
      have hr := h ((twoSidedTrialMap V W) R) ⟨R, rfl⟩
      change frobInner (V * R * Wᴴ) (S (X - Xh)) = 0 at hr
      rw [frobInner_mul_mul_conjTranspose, map_sub, hX] at hr
      exact (frobSq_eq_zero_iff R).mp hr
  have hm := isMinOn_frobEnergy_sub_iff_forall_frobInner_eq_zero S hS hpos U X Xh hXh
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmin := hm.mpr (hgal.mp h)
    constructor
    · intro T
      exact (isMinOn_iff.mp hmin) _ ⟨T, rfl⟩
    · intro T hT
      exact eq_of_frobEnergy_sub_le_of_isMinOn S hS hpos U X Xh hXh hmin ⟨T, rfl⟩ hT
  · intro h
    apply hgal.mpr
    apply hm.mp
    rw [isMinOn_iff]
    rintro Z ⟨T, rfl⟩
    exact h.1 T

name: NLAlib.matrixMultitermLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixMultitermLinearMap_apply
    (A : ι → Matrix m m ℝ) (B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    matrixMultitermLinearMap A B X = ∑ i, A i * X * B i
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_multiterm_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_multiterm_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
    {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (A : ι → Matrix m m ℝ) (B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B V) =
      frobInner (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B U) V)
    (hpos : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℝ, Z ≠ 0 → 0 < frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) Z)
    (V : Matrix m p ℝ) (W : Matrix n q ℝ) (X F : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hX : matrixMultitermLinearMap A B X = F) (Y : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    Vᴴ * (F - ∑ i, A i * (V * Y * Wᴴ) * B i) * W = 0 ↔
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) ≤
          frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * T * Wᴴ)) ∧
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * T * Wᴴ) ≤
          frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) →
            V * T * Wᴴ = V * Y * Wᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [matrixMultitermLinearMap_apply] using
    conjTranspose_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
      (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) hS hpos V W X F hX Y

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_gram_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem mul_moorePenroseInverse_gram_mul_transpose (C : Matrix E V ℝ) :
    C * moorePenroseInverse (Cᵀ * C) * Cᵀ = rangeProjector C
proof:
:= by
  have hs := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian C
  have hp := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem C
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial C,
    moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  calc
    C * (moorePenroseInverse C * (moorePenroseInverse C)ᴴ) * Cᴴ =
        (C * moorePenroseInverse C) * (C * moorePenroseInverse C)ᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = C * moorePenroseInverse C := by rw [hs.eq]; exact hp
    _ = rangeProjector C := rfl

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.laplacian_leverage_eq_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem laplacian_leverage_eq_rangeProjector (w : E → ℝ) :
    o.weightedIncidence w * moorePenroseInverse (o.laplacian w) *
      (o.weightedIncidence w)ᵀ = rangeProjector (o.weightedIncidence w)
proof:
:=
  mul_moorePenroseInverse_gram_mul_transpose _

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.weight_mul_edgeResistance_eq_diag
statement:
theorem weight_mul_edgeResistance_eq_diag (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) (e : E) :
    w e * o.edgeResistance w e = rangeProjector (o.weightedIncidence w) e e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← o.laplacian_leverage_eq_rangeProjector]
  have hdiag : (o.weightedIncidence w * moorePenroseInverse (o.laplacian w) *
      (o.weightedIncidence w)ᵀ) e e =
      quadForm (moorePenroseInverse (o.laplacian w)) (o.weightedIncidence w e) := by
    rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
    rfl
  rw [hdiag]
  have hrow : o.weightedIncidence w e = Real.sqrt (w e) • o.incidence e := rfl
  rw [hrow, quadForm_smul, star_trivial, ← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (hw e)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.weight_mul_edgeResistance_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem weight_mul_edgeResistance_mem_Icc (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) (e : E) :
    w e * o.edgeResistance w e ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [o.weight_mul_edgeResistance_eq_diag w hw]
  exact re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem (rangeProjector (o.weightedIncidence w))
    (rangeProjector_isHermitian (o.weightedIncidence w))
    (rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem (o.weightedIncidence w)) e

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.rank_laplacian
statement:
theorem rank_laplacian (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) :
    (o.laplacian w).rank = Fintype.card V - Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent
proof:
:= by
  rw [laplacian, Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self, o.rank_weightedIncidence w hw]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.sum_weight_mul_edgeResistance
statement:
theorem sum_weight_mul_edgeResistance (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) :
    (∑ e, w e * o.edgeResistance w e) = ((o.laplacian w).rank : ℝ) ∧
    (∑ e, w e * o.edgeResistance w e) =
      ((Fintype.card V - Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ e, w e * o.edgeResistance w e) =
      ((o.weightedIncidence w).rank : ℝ) := by
    simp_rw [o.weight_mul_edgeResistance_eq_diag w (fun e => (hw e).le)]
    exact trace_mul_moorePenroseInverse _
  constructor
  · rw [hsum, laplacian, Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self]
  · rw [hsum, o.rank_weightedIncidence w hw]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.incidence_mulVec
statement:
theorem incidence_mulVec (x : V → ℝ) (e : E) :
    (o.incidence *ᵥ x) e = x (o.source e) - x (o.target e)
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidence, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.weightedIncidence_mulVec
statement:
theorem weightedIncidence_mulVec (w : E → ℝ) (x : V → ℝ) (e : E) :
    (o.weightedIncidence w *ᵥ x) e =
      Real.sqrt (w e) * (x (o.source e) - x (o.target e))
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ v, (Real.sqrt (w e) * o.incidence e v) * x v) = _
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  exact congrArg (Real.sqrt (w e) * ·) (o.incidence_mulVec x e)

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.weightedIncidence_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem weightedIncidence_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e)
    (x : V → ℝ) : o.weightedIncidence w *ᵥ x = 0 ↔
      ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → x u = x v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx u v huv
    obtain ⟨e, he | he⟩ := o.complete huv
    all_goals
      have hz := congrFun hx e
      rw [o.weightedIncidence_mulVec] at hz
      have hdiff := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left
        (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw e)).ne')
    · simpa only [he.1, he.2] using hdiff
    · simpa only [he.1, he.2] using hdiff.symm
  · intro hx
    funext e
    rw [o.weightedIncidence_mulVec, hx _ _ (o.adjacent e), sub_self, mul_zero]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.eq_of_reachable
statement:
theorem eq_of_reachable {x : V → ℝ} (hx : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → x u = x v)
    {u v : V} (h : G.Reachable u v) : x u = x v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hadj p ih => exact (hx _ _ hadj).trans ih

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.rank_weightedIncidence
statement:
theorem rank_weightedIncidence [Fintype E] (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) :
    (o.weightedIncidence w).rank = Fintype.card V - Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent
proof:
:= by
  let : Fintype G.ConnectedComponent := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hk : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (o.weightedIncidence w).mulVecLin) =
      Fintype.card G.ConnectedComponent := by
    rw [← (o.componentKernelEquiv w hw).finrank_eq]
    exact Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card ℝ
  have hr := (o.weightedIncidence w).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hk, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hr
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  change Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (o.weightedIncidence w).mulVecLin) = _
  omega

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.laplacian_eq_sum_weight_smul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem laplacian_eq_sum_weight_smul_vecMulVec (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) :
    o.laplacian w = ∑ e, w e • Matrix.vecMulVec (o.incidence e) (o.incidence e)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [laplacian, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, weightedIncidence,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  calc
    _ = Real.sqrt (w e) ^ 2 * (o.incidence e a * o.incidence e b) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw e)]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.laplacian_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem laplacian_zero : o.laplacian (fun _ => 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [o.laplacian_eq_sum_weight_smul_vecMulVec _ (fun _ => le_rfl)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.conjTranspose_mul_self [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : Qᴴ * Q = 1
proof: := hQ

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} :
    HasOrthonormalCols Q ↔ Qᴴ * Q = 1
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetPseudoinverse_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowSubsetPseudoinverse_univ (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) :
    rowSubsetPseudoinverse X Finset.univ = moorePenroseInverse X
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rowSubsetPseudoinverse, coordinateSelector_univ, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_one (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n)
    (hS : IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)) : rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * X = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hG : IsUnit ((coordinateSelector S * X)ᴴ * (coordinateSelector S * X)) := by
    rwa [← rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self X S]
  rw [rowSubsetPseudoinverse, moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL _ hG, pinvL,
    ← rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self X S, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    (coordinateSelector_isHermitian S).eq]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Xᴴ (coordinateSelector S) X]
  exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_of_isUnit (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n)
    (hS : IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)) :
    rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ = (rowSubsetGram X S)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = moorePenroseInverse ((coordinateSelector S * X)ᴴ * (coordinateSelector S * X)) :=
      (moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self _).symm
    _ = moorePenroseInverse (rowSubsetGram X S) :=
      congrArg moorePenroseInverse (rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self X S).symm
    _ = _ := moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit _ hS

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_smul_pseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_smul_pseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetVolume X S • (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ) =
      rowSubsetVolume X S • (rowSubsetGram X S)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : rowSubsetVolume X S = 0
  · rw [hzero, zero_smul, zero_smul]
  · rw [rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_of_isUnit X S
      ((rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X S).mp
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X S) (Ne.symm hzero)))]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetVolume X S • (rowSubsetGram X S)⁻¹ =
      (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate -
        if rowSubsetVolume X S = 0 then (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : (rowSubsetGram X S).det = 0 ↔ rowSubsetVolume X S = 0 := by
    rw [← ofReal_rowSubsetVolume]
    exact RCLike.ofReal_eq_zero
  rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜), ofReal_rowSubsetVolume,
    det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite]
  simp only [hzero]

name: NLAlib.adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector
statement:
theorem adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector S =
      rowSubsetVolume X S • rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S
proof:
:= by
  have h := adjugate_gram_mul_conjTranspose_eq_det_smul_moorePenroseInverse (coordinateSelector S * X)
  rw [← rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self X S, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    (coordinateSelector_isHermitian S).eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc] at h
  rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜), ofReal_rowSubsetVolume]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_right
statement:
private theorem hasDerivAt_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_right
    (X H : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (rowSubsetCrossGram X (X + t • H) S).det)
      ((rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate * rowSubsetCrossGram X H S).trace 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun t : ℝ => rowSubsetCrossGram X (X + t • H) S) =
      fun t => rowSubsetGram X S + t • rowSubsetCrossGram X H S := by
    funext t
    simp only [rowSubsetCrossGram, rowSubsetGram, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_smul]
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => rowSubsetCrossGram X (X + t • H) S)
      (rowSubsetCrossGram X H S) 0 := by
    rw [he]
    convert! (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (rowSubsetGram X S)).add
      ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (rowSubsetCrossGram X H S)) using 1
    simp only [zero_add, one_smul]
  simpa only [rowSubsetCrossGram, rowSubsetGram, zero_smul, add_zero] using hd.matrix_det

name: NLAlib.sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector
statement:
theorem sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector S) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : 𝕜) •
        ((rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c := (T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d)
  let K := (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector S) -
    (c : 𝕜) • ((rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector T)
  have hpair (H : Matrix n d 𝕜) : (K * H).trace = 0 := by
    have hl := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun S (_ : S ∈ T.powersetCard s) =>
      hasDerivAt_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_right X H S)
    have he : (fun t : ℝ => ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s,
        (rowSubsetCrossGram X (X + t • H) S).det) =
        fun t => (c : 𝕜) * (rowSubsetCrossGram X (X + t • H) T).det := by
      funext t
      exact sum_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_powersetCard X (X + t • H) T s hds
    rw [he] at hl
    have hh := hl.unique ((hasDerivAt_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_right X H T).const_mul (c : 𝕜))
    change (((∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector S) -
      (c : 𝕜) • ((rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector T)) * H).trace = 0
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_sub,
      Matrix.trace_sum, Matrix.trace_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa only [rowSubsetCrossGram, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hh
  have hz : K = 0 := Matrix.trace_mul_conjTranspose_self_eq_zero_iff.mp (hpair Kᴴ)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_smul_pseudoinverse_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_smul_pseudoinverse_powersetCard
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S • rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S) =
      (((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T) •
        rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector S := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro S _
      exact (adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector X S).symm
    _ = ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : 𝕜) •
        ((rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate * Xᴴ * coordinateSelector T) :=
      sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector X T s hds
    _ = ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : 𝕜) •
        (rowSubsetVolume X T • rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T) :=
      congrArg _ (adjugate_rowSubsetGram_mul_conjTranspose_selector X T)
    _ = _ := by rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.matrixOf_curry_update_eq_add_single
statement:
theorem matrixOf_curry_update_eq_add_single {ι κ R : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [DecidableEq κ] [CommRing R] (x : ι × κ → R) (i : ι) (j : κ) (t : R) :
    Matrix.of (fun a b => Function.update x (i, j) t (a, b)) =
      Matrix.of (fun a b => x (a, b)) + (t - x (i, j)) • Matrix.single i j 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  change Function.update x (i, j) t (a, b) =
    x (a, b) + (t - x (i, j)) * Matrix.single i j 1 a b
  by_cases ha : a = i <;> by_cases hb : b = j
  · subst a; subst b
    simp
  · subst a
    simp [hb, Ne.symm hb]
  · subst b
    simp [ha, Ne.symm ha]
  · simp [ha, Ne.symm ha]

name: Matrix.inv_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem inv_add_vecMulVec (M : Matrix n n K) (u v : n → K)
    (hM : IsUnit M.det) (hd : 1 + v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u) ≠ 0) :
    (M + vecMulVec u v)⁻¹ =
      M⁻¹ - ((1 + v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u))⁻¹ : K) •
        (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec u v * M⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let q : K := v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u)
  let c : K := (1 + q)⁻¹
  let U : Matrix n n K := vecMulVec u v
  have hcq : c * (1 + q) = 1 := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hd
  have hUinv : U * M⁻¹ * U = q • U := by
    dsimp [U, q]
    rw [vecMulVec_mul, vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, vecMulVec_smul]
  have hMP : M * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) = U * M⁻¹ := by
    calc
      M * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) = (M * M⁻¹) * U * M⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * M⁻¹ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM]
        simp
  have hUU : U * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) = q • (U * M⁻¹) := by
    calc
      U * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) = (U * M⁻¹ * U) * M⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (q • U) * M⁻¹ := by
        rw [hUinv]
      _ = q • (U * M⁻¹) := by
        rw [Matrix.smul_mul]
  have hsum : (M + U) * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) = (1 + q) • (U * M⁻¹) := by
    calc
      (M + U) * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹)
          = M * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) + U * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) := by
            rw [Matrix.add_mul]
      _ = U * M⁻¹ + U * (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹) := by
            rw [hMP]
      _ = U * M⁻¹ + q • (U * M⁻¹) := by
            rw [hUU]
      _ = (1 + q) • (U * M⁻¹) := by
            rw [add_smul]
            simp
  have hright : (M + U) * (M⁻¹ - c • (M⁻¹ * U * M⁻¹)) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM,
      Matrix.mul_smul, hsum, smul_smul]
    rw [hcq, one_smul]
    abel
  exact inv_eq_right_inv hright

name: Matrix.inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self
statement:
theorem inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self (M : Matrix n n K) (v : n → K) (t : K)
    (hM : IsUnit M.det)
    (hd : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹ =
      M⁻¹ - (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)))) •
        (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ (t • v)) = t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) := by
    rw [mulVec_smul, dotProduct_smul]
    rfl
  have hd' : 1 + v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ (t • v)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [hq] using hd
  have hmain := inv_add_vecMulVec M (t • v) v hM hd'
  have hU : vecMulVec (t • v) v = t • vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [smul_vecMulVec]
  rw [hU, hq] at hmain
  have hP : M⁻¹ * (t • vecMulVec v v) * M⁻¹ =
      t • (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [hP] at hmain
  have hscalar :
      ((1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)))⁻¹ : K) •
          (t • (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹)) =
        (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)))) •
          (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹) := by
    rw [smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [hscalar] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: Matrix.trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self
statement:
theorem trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self (M H : Matrix n n K)
    (v : n → K) (t : K) (hM : IsUnit M.det)
    (hd : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    (H * (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace =
      (H * M⁻¹).trace -
        (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)))) *
          (v ⬝ᵥ ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) *ᵥ v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self M v t hM hd]
  have htrace : (H * (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹)).trace =
      v ⬝ᵥ ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) *ᵥ v) := by
    calc
      (H * (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹)).trace
          = (H * M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹).trace := by
            rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (M⁻¹ * (H * M⁻¹) * vecMulVec v v).trace := by
            rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
      _ = (M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v).trace := by
            rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) * vecMulVec v v).trace := by
            rfl
      _ = (vecMulVec ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) *ᵥ v) v).trace := by
            rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec]
      _ = ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ v := by
            rw [Matrix.trace_vecMulVec]
      _ = v ⬝ᵥ ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) *ᵥ v) := by
            rw [dotProduct_comm]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, htrace]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.rank_le_iff_exists_mul
statement:
theorem rank_le_iff_exists_mul {K m n : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n K) (r : ℕ) :
    A.rank ≤ r ↔ ∃ (M : Matrix m (Fin r) K) (N : Matrix (Fin r) n K), A = M * N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hdim : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin) ≤
        Module.finrank K (Fin r → K) := by simpa [Matrix.rank] using h
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := finrank_le_iff_exists_linearMap.mp hdim
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := e.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr he)
    let f := (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).subtype.comp l
    let g := e.comp A.mulVecLin.rangeRestrict
    refine ⟨LinearMap.toMatrix' f, LinearMap.toMatrix' g, ?_⟩
    apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_mul, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    funext i
    exact (congrArg (fun z : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin => z.val i)
      (DFunLike.congr_fun hl (A.mulVecLin.rangeRestrict x))).symm
  · rintro ⟨M, N, rfl⟩
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left M N).trans (by simpa using M.rank_le_card_width)

name: NLAlib.rank_le_iff_exists_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem rank_le_iff_exists_mul_conjTranspose {K m n : Type*} [RCLike K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n K) (r : ℕ) :
    A.rank ≤ r ↔ ∃ (M : Matrix m (Fin r) K) (N : Matrix n (Fin r) K), A = M * Nᴴ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro h
    obtain ⟨M, N, hMN⟩ := (rank_le_iff_exists_mul A r).mp h
    exact ⟨M, Nᴴ, by simpa using hMN⟩
  · rintro ⟨M, N, hMN⟩
    exact (rank_le_iff_exists_mul A r).mpr ⟨M, Nᴴ, hMN⟩

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_dilation
statement:
theorem isHermitian_dilation {α : Type*} [AddMonoid α] [StarAddMonoid α] {m n : Type*}
    (A : Matrix m n α) : (dilation A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.dilation_add
statement:
theorem dilation_add {α : Type*} [AddMonoid α] [StarAddMonoid α] {m n : Type*}
    (A B : Matrix m n α) : dilation (A + B) = dilation A + dilation B
proof:
:= by
