name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.moorePenroseInverse_eq_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.moorePenroseInverse_eq_conjTranspose [DecidableEq n]
    {Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) : moorePenroseInverse Q = Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL Q (by rw [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]; exact isUnit_one),
    pinvL, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, inv_one, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_smul
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_smul (c : 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse (c • A) = c⁻¹ • moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · simp [hc]
  apply (isMoorePenroseInverse (c • A)).unique
  set B := moorePenroseInverse A
  have hAB : (c • A) * (c⁻¹ • B) = A * B := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  have hBA : (c⁻¹ • B) * (c • A) = B * A := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hAB, Matrix.mul_smul, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]
  · rw [hBA, Matrix.mul_smul, moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse]
  · rw [hAB]
    exact mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A
  · rw [hBA]
    exact moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hA : IsUnit A) : moorePenroseInverse A = A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply (isMoorePenroseInverse A).unique
  have hDet := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA
  constructor <;> simp [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hDet, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hDet]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.moorePenroseInverse {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.IsHermitian, ← moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose, hA.eq]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols [DecidableEq m]
    (Q : Matrix p m 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    moorePenroseInverse (Q * A) = moorePenroseInverse A * Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  apply (isMoorePenroseInverse (Q * A)).unique
  have h := isMoorePenroseInverse A
  set B := moorePenroseInverse A
  have hQt : Qᴴ * Q = 1 := hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hBA : B * Qᴴ * (Q * A) = B * A := by
    calc
      B * Qᴴ * (Q * A) = B * (Qᴴ * Q) * A := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * A := by rw [hQt, Matrix.mul_one]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      Q * A * (B * Qᴴ) * (Q * A) = Q * (A * B * (Qᴴ * Q) * A) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Q * A := by rw [hQt, Matrix.mul_one, h.mul_mul_eq]
  · calc
      B * Qᴴ * (Q * A) * (B * Qᴴ) = (B * (Qᴴ * Q) * A * B) * Qᴴ := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * Qᴴ := by rw [hQt, Matrix.mul_one, h.inv_mul_inv_eq]
  · have he : Q * A * (B * Qᴴ) = Q * (A * B) * Qᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [he]
    calc
      (Q * (A * B) * Qᴴ)ᴴ = Q * (A * B)ᴴ * Qᴴ := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Q * (A * B) * Qᴴ := by rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_eq]
  · rw [hBA]
    exact h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.moorePenroseInverse [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : (NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hB := hA.isHermitian.moorePenroseInverse
  have h := hA.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse A)
  simpa only [hB.eq, moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse] using h

name: NLAlib.tlsDataMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem tlsDataMatrix_mulVec (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜) :
    tlsDataMatrix A b *ᵥ v = A *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl) + v (Sum.inr ()) • b
proof:
:= by
  rw [tlsDataMatrix, Matrix.fromCols_mulVec]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.tls_minimum_eigenvector_first_block
statement:
theorem tls_minimum_eigenvector_first_block (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜)
    (he : ((tlsDataMatrix A b)ᴴ * tlsDataMatrix A b) *ᵥ v = (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • v) :
    (Aᴴ * A - (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • 1) *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl) =
      -(v (Sum.inr ()) • (Aᴴ *ᵥ b))
proof:
:= by
  have hh : Aᴴ *ᵥ (tlsDataMatrix A b *ᵥ v) = (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • (v ∘ Sum.inl) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at he
    ext i
    exact congrFun he (Sum.inl i)
  rw [tlsDataMatrix_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at hh
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  linear_combination hh

name: NLAlib.tls_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero_of_gap
statement:
theorem tls_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero_of_gap (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (hgap : tlsValue A b < lambdaMin (Aᴴ * A)) (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜)
    (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (he : ((tlsDataMatrix A b)ᴴ * tlsDataMatrix A b) *ᵥ v = (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • v) :
    v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).posDef_sub_smul_one_of_lt_lambdaMin hgap
  intro hz
  have hh := tls_minimum_eigenvector_first_block A b v he
  rw [hz, zero_smul, neg_zero] at hh
  have hhead : v ∘ Sum.inl = 0 := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hP.isUnit
    (by simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_zero] using hh)
  apply hv
  ext i
  cases i with
  | inl i => exact congrFun hhead i
  | inr i => cases i; exact hz

name: NLAlib.tlsSolutionOfVector_eq_inverse_of_gap
statement:
theorem tlsSolutionOfVector_eq_inverse_of_gap (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (hgap : tlsValue A b < lambdaMin (Aᴴ * A)) (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (he : ((tlsDataMatrix A b)ᴴ * tlsDataMatrix A b) *ᵥ v = (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • v) :
    tlsSolutionOfVector v = (Aᴴ * A - (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • 1)⁻¹ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Aᴴ * A - (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • 1
  have hP : P.PosDef :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).posDef_sub_smul_one_of_lt_lambdaMin hgap
  have hlast := tls_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero_of_gap A b hgap v hv he
  have hh := congrArg (fun w => P⁻¹ *ᵥ w) (tls_minimum_eigenvector_first_block A b v he)
  change P⁻¹ *ᵥ (P *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl)) = P⁻¹ *ᵥ (-(v (Sum.inr ()) • (Aᴴ *ᵥ b))) at hh
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul P ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hP.isUnit),
    Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_neg, Matrix.mulVec_smul] at hh
  ext i
  have hi := congrFun hh i
  change -v (Sum.inl i) / v (Sum.inr ()) = (P⁻¹ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i
  change v (Sum.inl i) = -(v (Sum.inr ()) * (P⁻¹ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i) at hi
  rw [hi]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.isTLSOptimal_iff_eq_inverse_of_gap
statement:
theorem isTLSOptimal_iff_eq_inverse_of_gap (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (hgap : tlsValue A b < lambdaMin (Aᴴ * A)) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    IsTLSOptimal A b x ↔ x = (Aᴴ * A - (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • 1)⁻¹ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, _, he, hchart⟩ := (isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_chart A b x).mp hx
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hv
    exact hchart.trans (tlsSolutionOfVector_eq_inverse_of_gap A b hgap v hv0 he)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (tlsDataMatrix A b)).exists_unit_lambdaMin_eigenvector
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hv
    have hl := tls_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero_of_gap A b hgap v hv0 he
    apply (isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_chart A b x).mpr
    exact ⟨v, hv, hl, he, hx.trans (tlsSolutionOfVector_eq_inverse_of_gap A b hgap v hv0 he).symm⟩

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_mul_reversed
statement:
private theorem rectDiag_mul_reversed (m n : ℕ) (σ τ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) *
        (rectDiag τ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) 𝕜) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin m => (((if (i : ℕ) < n then σ i * τ i else 0 : ℝ)) : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  by_cases hin : (i : ℕ) < n
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨i, hin⟩]
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        simp [hin]
      · have hij' : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
        simp [hij, hij']
    · intro k _ hki
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hki (Fin.ext h.symm)), zero_mul]
    · simp
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · simp [hin]
    · intro k _
      rw [if_neg (fun (h : (i : ℕ) = k) => hin (h.symm ▸ k.isLt)), zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_mul_inverse_mul
statement:
private theorem rectDiag_mul_inverse_mul (m n : ℕ) (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) *
        (rectDiag (fun k => (σ k)⁻¹) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) 𝕜) *
        (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) =
      (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectDiag_mul_reversed]
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
  by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
  · have hin : (i : ℕ) < n := by simpa only [hij] using j.isLt
    simp only [if_pos hin, if_pos hij]
    by_cases hσ : σ i = 0
    · simp [hσ]
    · rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hσ, RCLike.ofReal_one, one_mul]
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_diagonal_ofReal
statement:
private theorem isHermitian_diagonal_ofReal {k : Type*} [DecidableEq k] (d : k → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (d i : 𝕜)).IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by
    funext i
    simp [RCLike.star_def])

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse_rectDiag
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rectDiag_mul_inverse_mul m n σ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [inv_inv] using rectDiag_mul_inverse_mul (𝕜 := 𝕜) n m (fun k => (σ k)⁻¹)
  · rw [rectDiag_mul_reversed]
    exact isHermitian_diagonal_ofReal _
  · rw [rectDiag_mul_reversed]
    exact isHermitian_diagonal_ofReal _

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.isMoorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem IsSVD.isMoorePenroseInverse {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜}
    {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse A
      (V * (rectDiag (fun k => (singularValues A k)⁻¹) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin p) 𝕜) * Uᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (isMoorePenroseInverse_rectDiag (𝕜 := 𝕜) p q (singularValues A)).unitary_transform
    U V h.conjTranspose_mul_left h.conjTranspose_mul_right
  rwa [← h.eq] at hP

name: NLAlib.exists_isMoorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem exists_isMoorePenroseInverse {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : ∃ B : Matrix n m 𝕜, IsMoorePenroseInverse A B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  exact ⟨_, h.isMoorePenroseInverse⟩

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem isMoorePenroseInverse (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse A (moorePenroseInverse A)
proof:
:=
  (exists_isMoorePenroseInverse A).choose_spec

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul
statement:
theorem mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    A * moorePenroseInverse A * A = A
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse A).mul_mul_eq

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse

theorem moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :

:=

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem

theorem mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse_pinvL
statement:
theorem isMoorePenroseInverse_pinvL [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : IsUnit (Aᴴ * A)) : IsMoorePenroseInverse A (pinvL A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_pinvL_mul h,
    pinvL_mul_pinvL h, mul_pinvL_isHermitian A,
    pinvL_mul_isHermitian h⟩

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse_pinvR
statement:
theorem isMoorePenroseInverse_pinvR [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : IsUnit (A * Aᴴ)) : IsMoorePenroseInverse A (pinvR A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_pinvR_mul h,
    pinvR_mul_pinvR h, mul_pinvR_isHermitian h,
    pinvR_mul_isHermitian A⟩

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : IsUnit (Aᴴ * A)) : moorePenroseInverse A = pinvL A
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse A).unique

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : IsUnit (A * Aᴴ)) : moorePenroseInverse A = pinvR A

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_transpose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_transpose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse Aᵀ = (moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse Aᵀ).unique (isMoorePenroseInverse A).transpose

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse Aᴴ = (moorePenroseInverse A)ᴴ
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse Aᴴ).unique (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_moorePenroseInverse (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse (moorePenroseInverse A) = A
proof:

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem moorePenroseInverse_zero :
    moorePenroseInverse (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (isMoorePenroseInverse (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜)).unique
  constructor <;> simp

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse A = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hA := mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul A
    rw [h, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul] at hA
    exact hA.symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact moorePenroseInverse_zero

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse (Aᴴ * A) = moorePenroseInverse A * (moorePenroseInverse A)ᴴ
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse (Aᴴ * A)).unique (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose_mul_self

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_self_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_self_mul_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseInverse (A * Aᴴ) = (moorePenroseInverse A)ᴴ * moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose] using
    moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self Aᴴ

name: NLAlib.frobSq_moorePenroseInverse_eq_trace_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem frobSq_moorePenroseInverse_eq_trace_moorePenroseInverse (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (moorePenroseInverse A) = RCLike.re (moorePenroseInverse (A * Aᴴ)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, moorePenroseInverse_self_mul_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 = specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A * Aᴴ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_self_mul_conjTranspose]
  unfold specNorm
  rw [sq, ← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_reindex
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_reindex {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    moorePenroseInverse (A.reindex em en) = (moorePenroseInverse A).reindex en em
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse (A.reindex em en)).unique
    ((isMoorePenroseInverse A).submatrix em.symm en.symm)

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_svd
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_svd {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜}
    {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) :
    moorePenroseInverse A =
      V * (rectDiag (fun k => (singularValues A k)⁻¹) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin p) 𝕜) * Uᴴ
proof:
:=
  (NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse A).unique h.isMoorePenroseInverse

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec (M : Matrix m n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) :
    (d - (moorePenroseInverse M * M) *ᵥ d) ⬝ᵥ (d - (moorePenroseInverse M * M) *ᵥ d) =
      d ⬝ᵥ d - d ⬝ᵥ ((moorePenroseInverse M * M) *ᵥ d)
proof:
:= by
  set Z := moorePenroseInverse M * M
  have hsym : Zᵀ = Z := (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian M).eq
  have hidem : Z * Z = Z := (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem M).eq
  have hZZ : (Z *ᵥ d) ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ d) = d ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ d) := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hsym, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      hidem, dotProduct_comm]
  have hdZ : (Z *ᵥ d) ⬝ᵥ d = d ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ d) := dotProduct_comm _ _
  simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, hZZ, hdZ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec_le_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem dotProduct_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec_le_dotProduct_self (M : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (d : n → ℝ) :
    d ⬝ᵥ ((moorePenroseInverse M * M) *ᵥ d) ≤ d ⬝ᵥ d
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_self_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec M d
  have h0 := dotProduct_self_nonneg (d - (moorePenroseInverse M * M) *ᵥ d)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.inv_specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq_mul_dotProduct_le
statement:
theorem inv_specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq_mul_dotProduct_le [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {v : n → ℝ} (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) :
    (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  set B := moorePenroseInverse A
  by_cases hB : specNorm B = 0
  · simp only [hB, _root_.inv_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow,
      zero_mul]
    exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
  have hfix : B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ w)) = Aᵀ *ᵥ w := by
    have hsym : (B * A)ᵀ = B * A := (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq
    have h : B * A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ := by
      calc B * A * Aᵀ = (B * A)ᵀ * Aᵀ := by rw [hsym]
        _ = (A * (B * A))ᵀ := (Matrix.transpose_mul _ _).symm
        _ = Aᵀ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h]
  have hBound := sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq B (A *ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ w))
  rw [hfix] at hBound
  have hScale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBound (sq_nonneg (specNorm B)⁻¹)
  have hCancel : (specNorm B)⁻¹ ^ 2 * specNorm B ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB, one_pow]
  rw [← mul_assoc, hCancel, one_mul] at hScale
  simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using hScale

name: NLAlib.inv_specNorm_pinvL_sq_mul_dotProduct_le
statement:
theorem inv_specNorm_pinvL_sq_mul_dotProduct_le [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit (Aᵀ * A)) (v : n → ℝ) :
    (specNorm (pinvL A))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hB : specNorm (pinvL A) = 0
  · simp only [hB, inv_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), zero_mul]
    exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hBound := sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (pinvL A) (A *ᵥ v)
  have hId : pinvL A *ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pinvL_mul hA, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hId] at hBound
  have hScale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBound (sq_nonneg (specNorm (pinvL A))⁻¹)
  have hCancel : (specNorm (pinvL A))⁻¹ ^ 2 * specNorm (pinvL A) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB, one_pow]
  rw [← mul_assoc, hCancel, one_mul] at hScale
  simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using hScale

name: NLAlib.exists_mul_range_eq_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem exists_mul_range_eq_of_rank_le (A : Matrix m n K) (k : ℕ) (hk : A.rank ≤ k) :
    ∃ U : Matrix m (Fin k) K, ∃ T : Matrix (Fin k) n K,
      A = U * T ∧ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdim : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin) ≤ Module.finrank K (Fin k → K) := by
    simpa [Matrix.rank] using hk
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := finrank_le_iff_exists_linearMap.mp hdim
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := e.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr he)
  let f := (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).subtype.comp l
  let g := e.comp A.mulVecLin.rangeRestrict
  let U := LinearMap.toMatrix' f
  let T := LinearMap.toMatrix' g
  have hA : A = U * T := by
    apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_mul, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    funext i
    exact (congrArg (fun z : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin => z.val i)
      (DFunLike.congr_fun hl (A.mulVecLin.rangeRestrict x))).symm
  refine ⟨U,T,hA,le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨v,rfl⟩
    have hv : U *ᵥ v = f v := by
      change Matrix.toLin' (LinearMap.toMatrix' f) v = f v
      rw [Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
    rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, hv]
    exact (l v).property
  · rintro x ⟨v,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨T *ᵥ v, ?_⟩
    change U *ᵥ (T *ᵥ v) = A *ᵥ v
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hA]

name: NLAlib.exists_mul_of_range_le
statement:
theorem exists_mul_of_range_le (U : Matrix m p K) (X : Matrix m n K)
    (h : LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ E : Matrix p n K, X = U * E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx (j : n) : ∃ v : p → K, U *ᵥ v = X.col j := by
    apply h
    exact ⟨Pi.single j 1, by ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]⟩
  choose E hE using hx
  refine ⟨fun i j => E j i, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  exact (congrFun (hE j) i).symm

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_range_le
statement:
theorem mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_range_le (U : Matrix m p K) (X : Matrix m n K)
    (h : LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin) :
    U * moorePenroseInverse U * X = X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E,rfl⟩ := exists_mul_of_range_le U X h
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, (isMoorePenroseInverse U).mul_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.exists_mul_mul_conjTranspose_of_ranges
statement:
theorem exists_mul_mul_conjTranspose_of_ranges (U : Matrix m p K) (V : Matrix n q K)
    (X : Matrix m n K) (hU : LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hV : LinearMap.range Xᴴ.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range V.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ C : Matrix p q K, X = U * C * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hL := mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_range_le U X hU
  have hR := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_of_range_le V Xᴴ hV)
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hR
  refine ⟨moorePenroseInverse U * X * (moorePenroseInverse V)ᴴ, ?_⟩
  calc
    X = X * (moorePenroseInverse V)ᴴ * Vᴴ := by simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hR.symm
    _ = (U * moorePenroseInverse U * X) * (moorePenroseInverse V)ᴴ * Vᴴ := by rw [hL]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.range_mulVecLin_mul_le
statement:
theorem range_mulVecLin_mul_le (A : Matrix m p K) (B : Matrix p n K) :
    LinearMap.range (A * B).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_mul]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: NLAlib.range_submatrix_cols_le
statement:
theorem range_submatrix_cols_le (A : Matrix m n K) (f : p → n) :
    LinearMap.range (A.submatrix id f).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨f j,rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.range_submatrix_rows_le_of_range_le
statement:
theorem range_submatrix_rows_le_of_range_le (X : Matrix m n K) (U : Matrix m p K)
    (f : q → m) (h : LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin) :
    LinearMap.range (X.submatrix f id).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range (U.submatrix f id).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E,rfl⟩ := exists_mul_of_range_le U X h
  have he : (U * E).submatrix f id = (U.submatrix f id) * E := by ext i j; rfl
  rw [he]
  exact range_mulVecLin_mul_le _ _

name: NLAlib.transpose_selectionMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_selectionMatrix_apply {k : ℕ} (s : Fin k → n) (a : Fin k) (j : n) :
    (selectionMatrix s)ᵀ a j = if j = s a then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.mul_selectionMatrix
statement:
theorem mul_selectionMatrix {m : Type*} {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (s : Fin k → n) :
    A * selectionMatrix s = A.submatrix id s
proof:

  ext i j; simp [selectionMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.transpose_selectionMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem transpose_selectionMatrix_mul {m : Type*} [Fintype m] {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix n m ℝ)
    (s : Fin k → n) : (selectionMatrix s)ᵀ * A = A.submatrix s id
proof:

  ext i j; simp [selectionMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonovFilter_minimizer
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonovFilter_minimizer
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    ∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β (generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β) ≤
      generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have he := generalTikhonovObjective_add_of_normal_equation A L b hβ.le
    (generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β) (h.generalTikhonov_filter_normal_equation b hβ)
    (z - generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β)
  rw [add_sub_cancel] at he
  have hn := mul_nonneg hβ.le
    (sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (z - generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β))‖)
  linarith [sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (z - generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β))‖]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonovFilter_unique
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonovFilter_unique
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s)
    (hN : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, A *ᵥ v = 0 → L *ᵥ v = 0 → v = 0)
    (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β =
      moorePenroseInverse (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) ∧
    ∀ y, (∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β y ≤ generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z) →
      y = generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β
proof:
:= by
  have he (y) (hy : ∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β y ≤
      generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z) :
      y = moorePenroseInverse (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) := by
    obtain ⟨v, hvA, hvL, hv⟩ := (generalTikhonov_minimizers_iff A L b hβ y).mp hy
    simpa only [hN v hvA hvL, add_zero] using hv
  have hf := he _ (h.generalTikhonovFilter_minimizer b hβ)
  exact ⟨hf, fun y hy => (he y hy).trans hf.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.tendsto_generalTikhonovFilter_zero
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.tendsto_generalTikhonovFilter_zero
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovZeroLimit A X c b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => fun i =>
      (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (fun i => if c i = 0 then 0 else (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / (c i : 𝕜) ^ 2)) := by
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · simp only [hi, h.coefficient_eq_zero_of_left_eq_zero b i hi, zero_div, ite_true]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
    · have hc : ContinuousAt (fun β : ℝ =>
          (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) 0 := by
        apply continuousAt_const.div
        · fun_prop
        · simpa using (pow_ne_zero 2 (show (c i : 𝕜) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast hi))
      simpa [hi] using! hc.tendsto.mono_left inf_le_left
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : n → 𝕜 => (WithLp.toLp 2 (X *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)) := by
    fun_prop
  exact hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcoord

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.tendsto_generalTikhonovFilter_infinity
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.tendsto_generalTikhonovFilter_infinity
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
      atTop (𝓝 (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovInfinityLimit A X c s b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => fun i =>
      (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) atTop
      (𝓝 (fun i => if s i = 0 then (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / (c i : 𝕜) ^ 2 else 0)) := by
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    by_cases hi : s i = 0
    · simpa [hi] using (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto
        (fun _ : ℝ => (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / (c i : 𝕜) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 _))
    · have hw : Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2) atTop atTop := by
        apply tendsto_const_nhds.add_atTop
        exact tendsto_id.atTop_mul_const (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hi)
      have hinv : Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hw
      have hcast : Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => (((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜))
          atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa only [RCLike.ofReal_zero, Function.comp_def] using
          RCLike.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hinv
      simpa [hi, div_eq_mul_inv] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hcast
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : n → 𝕜 => (WithLp.toLp 2 (X *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)) := by
    fun_prop
  exact hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcoord

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_map_ofReal (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℂ) :
    (quadForm (A.map Complex.ofReal) u).re =
      quadForm A (fun i => (u i).re) + quadForm A (fun i => (u i).im)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm_eq_sum, Complex.re_sum, Matrix.map_apply,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re,
    Complex.conj_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, star_trivial,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_re_sq_add_norm_toLp_im_sq
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_re_sq_add_norm_toLp_im_sq (u : n → ℂ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (u i).re)‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (u i).im)‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
    RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, dotProduct, Complex.re_sum, Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_tikhonovInverse_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_tikhonovInverse_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    Tendsto (tikhonovInverse A) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (moorePenroseInverse A))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  let F := fun β : ℝ => V * diagonal
    (fun i : Fin A.rank => ((singularValues A i / (singularValues A i ^ 2 + β) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ
  have hscalar (i : Fin A.rank) : ContinuousAt
      (fun β : ℝ => ((singularValues A i / (singularValues A i ^ 2 + β) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) 0 := by
    apply RCLike.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.comp
    apply continuousAt_const.div (continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id)
    have hp := h.pos i
    simpa using (sq_pos_of_pos hp).ne'
  have hdiag : ContinuousAt (fun β : ℝ => diagonal
      (fun i : Fin A.rank => ((singularValues A i / (singularValues A i ^ 2 + β) : ℝ) : 𝕜))) 0 := by
    apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
    intro i
    apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
    intro j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] using hscalar i
    · simpa only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij] using
        (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : 𝕜)) 0)
  have hmul : Continuous (fun M : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin A.rank) 𝕜 => V * M * Uᴴ) := by
    fun_prop
  have hcont : ContinuousAt F 0 := hmul.continuousAt.comp hdiag
  have hF0 : F 0 = moorePenroseInverse A := by
    rw [h.moorePenroseInverse_eq]
    dsimp [F]
    congr 2
    funext i
    have hp := (h.pos i).ne'
    norm_cast
    simp only [add_zero]
    field_simp
  have heq : tikhonovInverse A =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)] F := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with β hβ
    exact h.tikhonovInverse_eq hβ
  rw [← hF0]
  exact (hcont.tendsto.mono_left inf_le_left).congr' heq.symm

name: NLAlib.tendsto_tikhonovInverse_mulVec_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_tikhonovInverse_mulVec_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    Tendsto (fun β : ℝ => (WithLp.toLp 2 (tikhonovInverse A β *ᵥ b) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (WithLp.toLp 2 (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n m 𝕜 =>
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (M *ᵥ b) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)) := by fun_prop
  exact hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (tendsto_tikhonovInverse_zero A)

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_unitNormalize
statement:
theorem continuousAt_unitNormalize {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → 𝕜) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (unitNormalize : (ι → 𝕜) → (ι → 𝕜)) v
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by
    have hh : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz; exact hv (congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz))
    exact_mod_cast hh
  apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  change ContinuousAt (fun w : ι → 𝕜 => (‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ : 𝕜)⁻¹ * w i) v
  apply ContinuousAt.mul
  · apply ContinuousAt.inv₀
    · fun_prop
    · exact hn
  · exact (continuous_apply i).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.isGLB_tlsCorrectionCosts
statement:
theorem isGLB_tlsCorrectionCosts (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    IsGLB (tlsCorrectionCosts A b) (tlsValue A b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro a ⟨x, D, hD, rfl⟩
    exact tlsValue_le_frobSq_of_feasible A b x D hD
  · intro a ha
    let C := tlsDataMatrix A b
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self C).exists_unit_lambdaMin_eigenvector
    have hvalue : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 = tlsValue A b :=
      (norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff C hv).mpr he
    by_cases hlast : v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0
    · have hc : frobSq (rankOneCancel C v) ∈ tlsCorrectionCosts A b :=
        ⟨tlsSolutionOfVector v, rankOneCancel C v, isTLSFeasible_rankOneCancel A b v hv hlast, rfl⟩
      simpa only [frobSq_rankOneCancel C v hv, hvalue] using ha hc
    · have hvlast : v (Sum.inr ()) = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hlast
      let w : ℝ → (n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜) :=
        fun t => v + (t : 𝕜) • Pi.single (Sum.inr ()) 1
      have hwlast (t : ℝ) : w t (Sum.inr ()) = (t : 𝕜) := by
        simp [w, hvlast, smul_eq_mul, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
      have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hv
      have hw : Tendsto w (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 v) := by
        have hc : ContinuousAt w 0 := by dsimp only [w]; fun_prop
        simpa [w] using! hc.tendsto.mono_left inf_le_left
      have hn : Tendsto (fun t => unitNormalize (w t)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 v) := by
        have hh := (continuousAt_unitNormalize v hv0).tendsto.comp hw
        simpa only [unitNormalize, hv, RCLike.ofReal_one, inv_one, one_smul,
          Function.comp_def] using! hh
      have hcost : Tendsto (fun t => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ unitNormalize (w t))‖ ^ 2)
          (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (tlsValue A b)) := by
        have hc : Continuous (fun u : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜 => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ u)‖ ^ 2) := by
          fun_prop
        simpa only [hvalue, Function.comp_def] using! hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hn
      apply ge_of_tendsto hcost
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
      have hlast : w t (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hwlast]
        exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt ht
      have hwt : w t ≠ 0 := fun hh => hlast (congrFun hh (Sum.inr ()))
      have hunit := norm_unitNormalize (w t) hwt
      have hnormlast := unitNormalize_apply_ne_zero (w t) (Sum.inr ()) hlast
      have hc : frobSq (rankOneCancel C (unitNormalize (w t))) ∈ tlsCorrectionCosts A b :=
        ⟨tlsSolutionOfVector (unitNormalize (w t)), rankOneCancel C (unitNormalize (w t)),
          isTLSFeasible_rankOneCancel A b _ hunit hnormlast, rfl⟩
      simpa only [frobSq_rankOneCancel C _ hunit] using ha hc

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.unique
statement:
theorem unique (hB : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) (hC : IsMoorePenroseInverse A C) :
    B = C
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : (B * A) * (C * A) = B * A := by
    calc
      (B * A) * (C * A) = B * (A * C * A) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * A := by rw [hC.mul_mul_eq]
  have hCA : (C * A) * (B * A) = C * A := by
    calc
      (C * A) * (B * A) = C * (A * B * A) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = C * A := by rw [hB.mul_mul_eq]
  have hBAeq : B * A = C * A := by
    have ht := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hBA
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hC.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq,
      hB.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq] at ht
    rw [hCA] at ht
    exact ht.symm
  have hAB : (A * B) * (A * C) = A * C := by
    calc
      (A * B) * (A * C) = (A * B * A) * C := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * C := by rw [hB.mul_mul_eq]
  have hAC : (A * C) * (A * B) = A * B := by
    calc
      (A * C) * (A * B) = (A * C * A) * B := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * B := by rw [hC.mul_mul_eq]
  have hABeq : A * B = A * C := by
    have ht := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hAB
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hC.conjTranspose_mul_eq,
      hB.conjTranspose_mul_eq] at ht
    rw [hAC] at ht
    exact ht
  calc
    B = B * A * B := hB.inv_mul_inv_eq.symm
    _ = C * A * B := by rw [hBAeq]
    _ = C * (A * B) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ = C * (A * C) := by rw [hABeq]
    _ = C * A * C := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = C := hC.inv_mul_inv_eq

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.swap
statement: theorem swap (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) : IsMoorePenroseInverse B A
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.inv_mul_inv_eq, h.mul_mul_eq, h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq, h.conjTranspose_mul_eq⟩

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.conjTranspose
statement:
theorem conjTranspose (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse Aᴴ Bᴴ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h.mul_mul_eq
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h.inv_mul_inv_eq
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
      h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq.symm
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
      h.conjTranspose_mul_eq.symm

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.transpose
statement:
theorem transpose (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse Aᵀ Bᵀ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose h.mul_mul_eq
  · simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose h.inv_mul_inv_eq
  · rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_transpose_eq_transpose_conjTranspose,
      h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq]
  · rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_transpose_eq_transpose_conjTranspose,
      h.conjTranspose_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.submatrix
statement:
theorem submatrix (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) (em : p ≃ m) (en : q ≃ n) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse (A.submatrix em en) (B.submatrix en em)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n 𝕜 => M.submatrix em en) h.mul_mul_eq
  · simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix n m 𝕜 => M.submatrix en em) h.inv_mul_inv_eq
  · simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix m m 𝕜 => M.submatrix em em) h.conjTranspose_mul_eq
  · simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M.submatrix en en) h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.unitary_transform
statement:
theorem unitary_transform [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) (U : Matrix p m 𝕜) (V : Matrix q n 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse (U * A * Vᴴ) (V * B * Uᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := hU
  have hV : Vᴴ * V = 1 := hV
  constructor
  · calc
      (U * A * Vᴴ) * (V * B * Uᴴ) * (U * A * Vᴴ) =
          U * (A * (Vᴴ * V) * B * (Uᴴ * U) * A) * Vᴴ := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * A * Vᴴ := by
        rw [hU, hV, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_one, h.mul_mul_eq]
  · calc
      (V * B * Uᴴ) * (U * A * Vᴴ) * (V * B * Uᴴ) =
          V * (B * (Uᴴ * U) * A * (Vᴴ * V) * B) * Uᴴ := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = V * B * Uᴴ := by
        rw [hU, hV, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_one, h.inv_mul_inv_eq]
  · have he : (U * A * Vᴴ) * (V * B * Uᴴ) = U * (A * B) * Uᴴ := by
      calc
        _ = U * (A * (Vᴴ * V) * B) * Uᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [hV, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [he]
    calc
      (U * (A * B) * Uᴴ)ᴴ = U * (A * B)ᴴ * Uᴴ := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * (A * B) * Uᴴ := by rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_eq]
  · have he : (V * B * Uᴴ) * (U * A * Vᴴ) = V * (B * A) * Vᴴ := by
      calc
        _ = V * (B * (Uᴴ * U) * A) * Vᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [he]
    calc
      (V * (B * A) * Vᴴ)ᴴ = V * (B * A)ᴴ * Vᴴ := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = V * (B * A) * Vᴴ := by rw [h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.mul_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem mul_isIdempotentElem (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) :
    IsIdempotentElem (A * B)
proof:
:= by
  change (A * B) * (A * B) = A * B
  calc
    _ = (A * B * A) * B := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = A * B := by rw [h.mul_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.inv_mul_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem inv_mul_isIdempotentElem (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) :
    IsIdempotentElem (B * A)
proof: := h.swap.mul_isIdempotentElem

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.mulVec_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_self_iff (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) (x : m → 𝕜) :
    (A * B) *ᵥ x = x ↔ ∃ y : n → 𝕜, A *ᵥ y = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨B *ᵥ x, by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]; exact hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h.mul_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.range_mul_eq
statement:
theorem range_mul_eq (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) :
    LinearMap.range (A * B).mulVecLin = LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨B *ᵥ y, by simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A *ᵥ y, by simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h.mul_mul_eq]⟩

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A B) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse (Aᴴ * A) (B * Bᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hCG : (B * Bᴴ) * (Aᴴ * A) = B * A := by
    calc
      _ = B * (A * B)ᴴ * A := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * (A * B) * A := by rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_eq]
      _ = (B * A * B) * A := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * A := by rw [h.inv_mul_inv_eq]
  have hGC : (Aᴴ * A) * (B * Bᴴ) = B * A := by
    calc
      _ = ((B * Bᴴ) * (Aᴴ * A))ᴴ := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
      _ = (B * A)ᴴ := by rw [hCG]
      _ = B * A := h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = (Aᴴ * A) * ((B * Bᴴ) * (Aᴴ * A)) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = (Aᴴ * A) * (B * A) := by rw [hCG]
      _ = Aᴴ * (A * B * A) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Aᴴ * A := by rw [h.mul_mul_eq]
  · calc
      _ = (B * A) * (B * Bᴴ) := by rw [hCG]
      _ = (B * A * B) * Bᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * Bᴴ := by rw [h.inv_mul_inv_eq]
  · rw [hGC]
    exact h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq
  · rw [hCG]
    exact h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq

name: NLAlib.norm_unitNormalize
statement:
theorem norm_unitNormalize {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → 𝕜) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (unitNormalize v)‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hv (congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz))
  simp [unitNormalize, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, norm_inv, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
    abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]

name: NLAlib.unitNormalize_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unitNormalize_apply_ne_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → 𝕜)
    (i : ι) (hi : v i ≠ 0) : unitNormalize v i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := fun hh => hi (congrFun hh i)
  have hn : (‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by
    have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz; exact hv (congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz))
    exact_mod_cast hnorm
  exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hn) hi

name: NLAlib.tlsSolutionOfVector_smul
statement:
theorem tlsSolutionOfVector_smul (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜) (a : 𝕜) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    tlsSolutionOfVector (a • v) = tlsSolutionOfVector v
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [tlsSolutionOfVector, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.tlsDirection_solutionOfVector
statement:
theorem tlsDirection_solutionOfVector (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜) (hv : v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0) :
    tlsDirection (tlsSolutionOfVector v) = -(v (Sum.inr ()))⁻¹ • v
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  cases i with
  | inl i => simp [tlsDirection, tlsSolutionOfVector, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  | inr i => cases i; simp [tlsDirection, hv]

name: NLAlib.tlsSolutionOfVector_unitNormalize_direction
statement:
theorem tlsSolutionOfVector_unitNormalize_direction (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tlsSolutionOfVector (unitNormalize (tlsDirection x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hv : tlsDirection x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hh
    have he := congrFun hh (Sum.inr ())
    simpa [tlsDirection] using he
  have hn : (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tlsDirection x)‖ : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by
    have hh : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tlsDirection x)‖ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz; exact hv (congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz))
    exact_mod_cast hh
  rw [unitNormalize, tlsSolutionOfVector_smul _ _ (inv_ne_zero hn)]
  ext i
  simp [tlsDirection, tlsSolutionOfVector]

name: NLAlib.isTLSFeasible_fromCols_iff
statement:
theorem isTLSFeasible_fromCols_iff (A E : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b f : m → 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    IsTLSFeasible A b x (Matrix.fromCols E (Matrix.replicateCol Unit f)) ↔
      (A + E) *ᵥ x = b + f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsTLSFeasible, tlsDataMatrix, tlsDirection, Matrix.add_mulVec,
    Matrix.fromCols_mulVec_sumElim]
  have hb : Matrix.replicateCol Unit b *ᵥ (fun _ => (-1 : 𝕜)) = -b := by
    ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  have hf : Matrix.replicateCol Unit f *ᵥ (fun _ => (-1 : 𝕜)) = -f := by
    ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [hb, hf]
  constructor <;> intro hh <;> linear_combination hh

name: NLAlib.isTLSFeasible_rankOneCancel
statement:
theorem isTLSFeasible_rankOneCancel (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜) (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) (hlast : v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0) :
    IsTLSFeasible A b (tlsSolutionOfVector v) (rankOneCancel (tlsDataMatrix A b) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsTLSFeasible, tlsDirection_solutionOfVector v hlast, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
    Matrix.add_mulVec, rankOneCancel_mulVec _ v hv, add_neg_cancel, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.tlsValue_le_frobSq_of_feasible
statement:
theorem tlsValue_le_frobSq_of_feasible (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (x : n → 𝕜) (D : Matrix m (n ⊕ Unit) 𝕜) (hD : IsTLSFeasible A b x D) :
    tlsValue A b ≤ frobSq D
proof:
:= by
  let v := unitNormalize (tlsDirection x)
  have hw : tlsDirection x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hh; have he := congrFun hh (Sum.inr ()); simpa [tlsDirection] using he
  have hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := norm_unitNormalize _ hw
  have hz : (tlsDataMatrix A b + D) *ᵥ v = 0 := by
    change (tlsDataMatrix A b + D) *ᵥ unitNormalize (tlsDirection x) = 0
    rw [unitNormalize, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hD, smul_zero]
  have hcan : D *ᵥ v = -(tlsDataMatrix A b *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec] at hz
    linear_combination hz
  exact (lambdaMin_gram_le_norm_mulVec_sq (tlsDataMatrix A b) hv).trans
    (frobSq_correction_minimum_iff (tlsDataMatrix A b) D v hv hcan).1

name: NLAlib.isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_chart
statement:
theorem isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_chart (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (x : n → 𝕜) : IsTLSOptimal A b x ↔
    ∃ v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧ v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0 ∧
      ((tlsDataMatrix A b)ᴴ * tlsDataMatrix A b) *ᵥ v = (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • v ∧
      x = tlsSolutionOfVector v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨D, hD, hcost⟩
    let v := unitNormalize (tlsDirection x)
    have hw : tlsDirection x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hh; have he := congrFun hh (Sum.inr ()); simpa [tlsDirection] using he
    have hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := norm_unitNormalize _ hw
    have hlast : v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0 := unitNormalize_apply_ne_zero _ _ (by simp [tlsDirection])
    have hz : (tlsDataMatrix A b + D) *ᵥ v = 0 := by
      change (tlsDataMatrix A b + D) *ᵥ unitNormalize (tlsDirection x) = 0
      rw [unitNormalize, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hD, smul_zero]
    have hcan : D *ᵥ v = -(tlsDataMatrix A b *ᵥ v) := by
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec] at hz; linear_combination hz
    have he : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tlsDataMatrix A b *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 = tlsValue A b :=
      le_antisymm (hcost ▸ (frobSq_correction_minimum_iff _ D v hv hcan).1)
        (lambdaMin_gram_le_norm_mulVec_sq _ hv)
    exact ⟨v, hv, hlast, (norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff _ hv).mp he,
      (tlsSolutionOfVector_unitNormalize_direction x).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hlast, he, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨rankOneCancel (tlsDataMatrix A b) v,
      isTLSFeasible_rankOneCancel A b v hv hlast,
      (frobSq_rankOneCancel _ v hv).trans ((norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff _ hv).mpr he)⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    (∃ x, IsTLSOptimal A b x) ↔
      ∃ v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧ v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0 ∧
        ((tlsDataMatrix A b)ᴴ * tlsDataMatrix A b) *ᵥ v = (tlsValue A b : 𝕜) • v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hl, he, _⟩ := (isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_chart A b x).mp hx
    exact ⟨v, hv, hl, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hl, he⟩
    exact ⟨tlsSolutionOfVector v,
      (isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_chart A b _).mpr ⟨v, hv, hl, he, rfl⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker
statement:
theorem finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker (f : E →ₗ[K] F) (S : Submodule K E) :
    Module.finrank K (S.map f) + Module.finrank K (S ⊓ LinearMap.ker f : Submodule K E) =
      Module.finrank K S
proof:
:= by
  let e : LinearMap.ker (f.domRestrict S) ≃ₗ[K] (S ⊓ LinearMap.ker f : Submodule K E) :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.val.val, x.val.property, x.property⟩
      invFun := fun x => ⟨⟨x.val, x.property.1⟩, x.property.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have h := (f.domRestrict S).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, e.finrank_eq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.rank_add_rank_sub_card_le_rank_mul
statement:
theorem rank_add_rank_sub_card_le_rank_mul (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) :
    A.rank + B.rank - Fintype.card n ≤ (A * B).rank
proof:
:= by
  have hB := finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker A.mulVecLin (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin)
  have hA := A.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hle : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin ⊓ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin :
      Submodule K (n → K)) ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono inf_le_right
  rw [← LinearMap.range_comp, ← Matrix.mulVecLin_mul] at hB
  rw [Module.finrank_pi] at hA
  change (A * B).rank + _ = B.rank at hB
  change A.rank + _ = Fintype.card n at hA
  omega

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_add_rank_mul_le_rank_add_rank_mul_mul
statement:
theorem rank_mul_add_rank_mul_le_rank_add_rank_mul_mul
    (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) (C : Matrix p q K) :
    (A * B).rank + (B * C).rank ≤ B.rank + (A * B * C).rank
proof:
:= by
  have hB := finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker A.mulVecLin (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin)
  have hBC := finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker A.mulVecLin
    (LinearMap.range (B * C).mulVecLin)
  have hRange : LinearMap.range (B * C).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_mul]
    exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _
  have hle := Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_inf_right (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) hRange)
  rw [← LinearMap.range_comp, ← Matrix.mulVecLin_mul] at hB hBC
  change (A * B).rank + _ = B.rank at hB
  change (A * (B * C)).rank + _ = (B * C).rank at hBC
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hBC
  omega

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_iff_sub_mem_ker
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_iff_sub_mem_ker (A : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) (x₀ : n → K)
    (h₀ : A *ᵥ x₀ = b) (x : n → K) :
    A *ᵥ x = b ↔ x - x₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_sub, h₀,
    sub_eq_zero]

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_bounds
statement:
theorem rank_mul_bounds (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) :
    A.rank + B.rank - Fintype.card n ≤ (A * B).rank ∧
      (A * B).rank ≤ min A.rank B.rank
proof:
:=
  ⟨rank_add_rank_sub_card_le_rank_mul A B, Matrix.rank_mul_le A B⟩

name: NLAlib.rank_fromCols_eq_iff_exists_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem rank_fromCols_eq_iff_exists_mulVec_eq [Fintype m]
    (A : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) :
    (Matrix.fromCols A (fun i (_ : Unit) => b i)).rank = A.rank ↔
      ∃ x : n → K, A *ᵥ x = b
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span K (Set.range A.col)
  have hCols : Set.range (Matrix.fromCols A (fun i (_ : Unit) => b i)).col =
      Set.range A.col ∪ {b} := by
    ext v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
      cases j with
      | inl j => exact Or.inl ⟨j, rfl⟩
      | inr j => exact Or.inr rfl
    · rintro (⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl)
      · exact ⟨Sum.inl j, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨Sum.inr (), rfl⟩
  rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols, Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols,
    hCols, Submodule.span_union]
  change Module.finrank K (S ⊔ Submodule.span K {b} : Submodule K (m → K)) =
    Module.finrank K S ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hEq : S = S ⊔ Submodule.span K {b} :=
      Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq le_sup_left h.symm
    have hb : b ∈ S := by
      rw [hEq]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton b))
    change b ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range A.col) at hb
    rw [← Matrix.range_mulVecLin] at hb
    exact hb
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hb : b ∈ S := by
      change b ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range A.col)
      rw [← Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [sup_eq_left.mpr (Submodule.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hb))]

name: NLAlib.solution_set_eq_add_ker
statement:
theorem solution_set_eq_add_ker (A : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) (x₀ : n → K)
    (h₀ : A *ᵥ x₀ = b) :
    {x : n → K | A *ᵥ x = b} =
      {x : n → K | ∃ z ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin, x = x₀ + z}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (A *ᵥ x = b) ↔ ∃ z ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin, x = x₀ + z
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨x - x₀, (mulVec_eq_iff_sub_mem_ker A b x₀ h₀ x).mp hx, ?_⟩
    abel
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, h₀, show A *ᵥ z = 0 from hz, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.leadingSubmatrix_apply
statement:
theorem leadingSubmatrix_apply (A : Matrix n n R) {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card n) (hj : (j : ℕ) < Fintype.card n) :
    leadingSubmatrix A k i j = A (monoEquivOfFin n rfl ⟨i, hi⟩) (monoEquivOfFin n rfl ⟨j, hj⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingSubmatrix, hi, hj]

name: NLAlib.leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le
statement:
theorem leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le (A : Matrix n n R) {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k)
    (h : Fintype.card n ≤ i ∨ Fintype.card n ≤ j) :
    leadingSubmatrix A k i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h <;> simp [leadingSubmatrix, not_lt.2 h]

name: NLAlib.leadingSubmatrix_eq_submatrix
statement:
theorem leadingSubmatrix_eq_submatrix (A : Matrix n n R) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    leadingSubmatrix A k =
      A.submatrix (fun i : Fin k => monoEquivOfFin n rfl (Fin.castLE hk i))
        (fun j : Fin k => monoEquivOfFin n rfl (Fin.castLE hk j))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [leadingSubmatrix_apply A i j (lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hk) (lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hk)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.leadingSubmatrix_fin
statement:
theorem leadingSubmatrix_fin {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    leadingSubmatrix A k = A.submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card (Fin m) := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hk
  have hj : (j : ℕ) < Fintype.card (Fin m) := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hk
  rw [leadingSubmatrix_apply A i j hi hj]
  have e : monoEquivOfFin (Fin m) rfl = Fin.castOrderIso (Fintype.card_fin m) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [e]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.leadingSubmatrix_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem leadingSubmatrix_transpose (A : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) :
    leadingSubmatrix Aᵀ k = (leadingSubmatrix A k)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card n ∧ (j : ℕ) < Fintype.card n
  · simp [leadingSubmatrix, h]
  · rw [not_and_or, not_lt, not_lt] at h
    simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le _ _ _ h,
      leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le _ _ _ h.symm]

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem leadingMinor_zero (A : Matrix n n R) : leadingMinor A 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingMinor, Matrix.det_isEmpty]

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_of_card_lt (A : Matrix n n R) {k : ℕ} (hk : Fintype.card n < k) :
    leadingMinor A k = 0
proof:
:=
  Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero ⟨Fintype.card n, hk⟩ fun j =>
    leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le A _ j (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_card
statement: theorem leadingMinor_card (A : Matrix n n R) : leadingMinor A (Fintype.card n) = A.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_eq_submatrix A le_rfl]
  have : (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => monoEquivOfFin n rfl (Fin.castLE le_rfl i)) =
      (monoEquivOfFin n rfl : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) := by
    ext i; rfl
  rw [this]
  exact Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self _ _

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_fin
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_fin {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    leadingMinor A k = (A.submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk)).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_fin A hk]

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem leadingMinor_transpose (A : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) :
    leadingMinor Aᵀ k = leadingMinor A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_transpose, Matrix.det_transpose, leadingMinor]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_updateCol_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_updateCol_of_orthonormal
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (e : n → 𝕜)
    (he : Qᴴ *ᵥ e = 0) (i : d) :
    (Q.updateCol i e)ᴴ * Q.updateCol i e =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j => if j = i then star e ⬝ᵥ e else 1)
proof:
:= by
  have he' : ∀ j, ∑ a, star (Q a j) * e a = 0 := fun j => congrFun he j
  have heStar : ∀ j, ∑ a, star (e a) * Q a j = 0 := by
    intro j
    have h := congrArg star (he' j)
    simpa only [star_sum, star_mul, star_star, star_zero, mul_comm] using h
  ext a b
  by_cases ha : a = i
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b = i
    · subst b
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
        Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, dotProduct, Pi.star_apply]
    · simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.updateCol_self,
        Matrix.updateCol_ne hb, Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ (Ne.symm hb)]
      exact heStar b
  · by_cases hb : b = i
    · subst b
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.updateCol_ne ha,
        Matrix.updateCol_self, Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ ha]
      exact he' a
    · have h := congrFun (congrFun hQ a) b
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] at h
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.updateCol_ne ha,
        Matrix.updateCol_ne hb]
      rw [h]
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst b
        simp [ha]
      · simp [Matrix.one_apply_ne hab, Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hab]

name: NLAlib.re_det_gram_updateCol_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem re_det_gram_updateCol_of_orthonormal
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (e : n → 𝕜)
    (he : Qᴴ *ᵥ e = 0) (i : d) :
    RCLike.re ((Q.updateCol i e)ᴴ * Q.updateCol i e).det = ∑ a, ‖e a‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjTranspose_mul_updateCol_of_orthonormal Q hQ e he i, Matrix.det_diagonal,
    Fintype.prod_ite_eq' i]
  simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse_singleton
statement:
theorem isMoorePenroseInverse_singleton (a : ℝ) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => a)) (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => a⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Subsingleton.elim i (0 : Fin 1), Subsingleton.elim j (0 : Fin 1), ite_true]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · simp [ha]
    · field_simp
  · ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Subsingleton.elim i (0 : Fin 1), Subsingleton.elim j (0 : Fin 1), ite_true]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · simp [ha]
    · field_simp
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Subsingleton.elim i (0 : Fin 1), Subsingleton.elim j (0 : Fin 1), ite_true]
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Subsingleton.elim i (0 : Fin 1), Subsingleton.elim j (0 : Fin 1), ite_true]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_singleton
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_singleton (a : ℝ) :
    moorePenroseInverse (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => a)) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => a⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  (isMoorePenroseInverse _).unique (isMoorePenroseInverse_singleton a)

name: NLAlib.firstBlockMap_coordinateSplit
statement:
private theorem firstBlockMap_coordinateSplit {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n K) (hA : IsUnit A.det) (p q : n → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    firstBlockMap ((coordinateSplit q).symm.trans
      ((A.toLinearEquiv (Pi.basisFun K n) hA).trans (coordinateSplit p))) =
      (A.toBlock p q).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext i
  change (∑ j : n, A i.val j * (if h : q j then x ⟨j, h⟩ else 0)) =
    ∑ j : {j // q j}, A i.val j.val * x j
  have h := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype q
    (fun j => A i.val j * (if h : q j then x ⟨j, h⟩ else 0))
  have hPos : (fun j : {j // q j} => A i.val j.val *
      (if h : q j.val then x ⟨j.val, h⟩ else 0)) = fun j => A i.val j.val * x j := by
    funext j; rw [dif_pos j.property]
  have hNeg : (fun j : {j // ¬q j} => A i.val j.val *
      (if h : q j.val then x ⟨j.val, h⟩ else 0)) = fun _ => (0 : K) := by
    funext j; rw [dif_neg j.property, mul_zero]
  rw [hPos, hNeg, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.finrank_ker_toBlock_eq_finrank_ker_inverse_complement
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_toBlock_eq_finrank_ker_inverse_complement {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n K) (hA : IsUnit A.det)
    (p q : n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (A.toBlock p q).mulVecLin) =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).mulVecLin)
proof:
:= by
  let f := (coordinateSplit q).symm.trans
    ((A.toLinearEquiv (Pi.basisFun K n) hA).trans (coordinateSplit p))
  have hFirst := firstBlockMap_coordinateSplit A hA p q
  have hLast : inverseLastBlockMap f =
      (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).mulVecLin := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    funext i
    change (∑ j : n, A⁻¹ i.val j * (if h : p j then 0 else y ⟨j, h⟩)) =
      ∑ j : {j // ¬p j}, A⁻¹ i.val j.val * y j
    have h := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype p
      (fun j => A⁻¹ i.val j * (if h : p j then 0 else y ⟨j, h⟩))
    have hPos : (fun j : {j // p j} => A⁻¹ i.val j.val *
        (if h : p j.val then 0 else y ⟨j.val, h⟩)) = fun _ => (0 : K) := by
      funext j; rw [dif_pos j.property, mul_zero]
    have hNeg : (fun j : {j // ¬p j} => A⁻¹ i.val j.val *
        (if h : p j.val then 0 else y ⟨j.val, h⟩)) = fun j => A⁻¹ i.val j.val * y j := by
      funext j; rw [dif_neg j.property]
    rw [hPos, hNeg, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h := (complementaryKernelEquiv f).finrank_eq
  rwa [hFirst, hLast] at h

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one {u : n → ℝ}
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
  rw [hu, one_pow] at h
  rw [dotProduct, h]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (sq (u i)).symm

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_planeRotation
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_planeRotation (u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1)
    (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (planeRotation u v c s)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hu
  have hv := dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hv
  have hvu : v ⬝ᵥ u = 0 := by rw [dotProduct_comm, huv]
  rw [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  let P := Matrix.vecMulVec u u + Matrix.vecMulVec v v
  let K := Matrix.vecMulVec u v - Matrix.vecMulVec v u
  have hPP : P * P = P := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
      hu, hv, huv, hvu, one_smul, zero_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hPK : P * K = K := by
    simp only [P, K, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
      hu, hv, huv, hvu, one_smul, zero_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_zero]
    abel
  have hKP : K * P = K := by
    simp only [P, K, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
      hu, hv, huv, hvu, one_smul, zero_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_zero]
    abel
  have hKK : K * K = -P := by
    simp only [P, K, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
      hu, hv, huv, hvu, one_smul, zero_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub]
    abel
  have hPt : Pᵀ = P := by simp [P, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_vecMulVec]
  have hKt : Kᵀ = -K := by
    simp only [K, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_vecMulVec]
    abel
  change (1 + (c - 1) • P + s • K)ᵀ * (1 + (c - 1) • P + s • K) = 1
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.transpose_one, hPt, hKt,
    Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, hPP, hPK, hKP, hKK,
    smul_neg, neg_mul]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcoef : (c - 1) * (c - 1) + 2 * (c - 1) + s * s = 0 := by nlinarith
  linear_combination hcoef * P i j

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_mulVec
statement:
theorem planeRotation_mulVec (u v x : n → ℝ) (c s : ℝ) :
    planeRotation u v c s *ᵥ x = x +
      (c - 1) • ((u ⬝ᵥ x) • u + (v ⬝ᵥ x) • v) +
      s • ((v ⬝ᵥ x) • u - (u ⬝ᵥ x) • v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [planeRotation, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, op_smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sq_rational_rotation_coefficients
statement:
theorem sq_rational_rotation_coefficients (t : ℝ) :
    ((1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2)) ^ 2 + (2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 1 + t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement
statement:
theorem card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {K : Type*} [Field K] (A : Matrix n n K) (hA : IsUnit A.det)
    (p q : n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    Fintype.card {j // q j} - (A.toBlock p q).rank =
      Fintype.card {j // ¬p j} - (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).rank
proof:
:= by
  have hA₁ := (A.toBlock p q).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hA₂ := (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [Module.finrank_pi] at hA₁ hA₂
  have h := finrank_ker_toBlock_eq_finrank_ker_inverse_complement A hA p q
  change (A.toBlock p q).rank + _ = _ at hA₁
  change (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).rank + _ = _ at hA₂
  omega

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetGram X S = ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X)ᴴ *
      ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rowSubsetGram, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    (coordinateSelector_isHermitian (𝕜 := 𝕜) S).eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc Xᴴ ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜)) ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜)),
    coordinateSelector_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_posSemidef
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_posSemidef (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    (rowSubsetGram X S).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_eq_sum
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_eq_sum (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetGram X S = ∑ i ∈ S, Matrix.vecMulVec (star (X i)) (X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a b
  rw [rowSubsetGram, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [coordinateSelector_mul_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply]
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_erase
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_erase (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) {i : n} (hi : i ∈ T) :
    rowSubsetGram X (T.erase i) = rowSubsetGram X T - Matrix.vecMulVec (star (X i)) (X i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSubsetGram_eq_sum, rowSubsetGram_eq_sum, eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
  exact Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hi

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_nonneg (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    0 ≤ rowSubsetVolume X S
proof:
:=
  (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (rowSubsetGram_posSemidef X S).det_nonneg).1

name: NLAlib.ofReal_rowSubsetVolume
statement:
theorem ofReal_rowSubsetVolume (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    (rowSubsetVolume X S : 𝕜) = (rowSubsetGram X S).det
proof:
:= by
  exact RCLike.ext (by simp [rowSubsetVolume])
    (by simpa using (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (rowSubsetGram_posSemidef X S).det_nonneg).2.symm)

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    0 < rowSubsetVolume X S ↔ IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ← ofReal_rowSubsetVolume]
  constructor
  · intro h hzero
    have hz := congrArg RCLike.re hzero
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re, map_zero] at hz
    exact h.ne' hz
  · intro h
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X S)
    intro hz
    apply h
    rw [← hz, RCLike.ofReal_zero]

name: NLAlib.det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix
statement:
theorem det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (S : Finset n) (J : SizedSubset n d) :
    (((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det =
      if J.val ⊆ S then (X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  split_ifs with hJS
  · congr 1
    ext i j
    change ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X) (sizedSubsetIndex J i) j = X (sizedSubsetIndex J i) j
    rw [coordinateSelector_mul_apply]
    apply if_pos
    have hm : sizedSubsetIndex J i ∈ (J.val : Set n) :=
      range_sizedSubsetIndex J ▸ Set.mem_range_self i
    exact hJS hm
  · obtain ⟨a, haJ, haS⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hJS
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (range_sizedSubsetIndex J ▸ haJ : a ∈ Set.range (sizedSubsetIndex J))
    apply Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero i
    intro j
    change ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X) (sizedSubsetIndex J i) j = 0
    rw [coordinateSelector_mul_apply, hi, if_neg haS]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetVolume X S = ∑ J : SizedSubset n d,
      if J.val ⊆ S then ‖(X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowSubsetVolume
  rw [rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    det_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_norm_sq, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J _
  rw [det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_mono
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_mono (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) {S T : Finset n} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    rowSubsetVolume X S ≤ rowSubsetVolume X T
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors, rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro J _
  by_cases hJS : J.val ⊆ S
  · rw [if_pos hJS, if_pos (hJS.trans hST)]
  · rw [if_neg hJS]
    split_ifs
    · exact sq_nonneg _
    · exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_powersetCard (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J _
  by_cases hJT : J.val ⊆ T
  · rw [if_pos hJT, ← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset J.val T s hJT (by simpa only [J.property] using hds)]
    simp only [J.property, nsmul_eq_mul]
  · rw [if_neg hJT, mul_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro S hS
    rw [if_neg (fun hJS => hJT (hJS.trans (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).1))]

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_eq_choose_mul
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_eq_choose_mul (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (s : ℕ)
    (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S) =
      ((Fintype.card n - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
        RCLike.re (Xᴴ * X).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have hGram := congrArg RCLike.re (det_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_norm_sq X)
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re] at hGram
  rw [hGram, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J _
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset J.val Finset.univ s (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (by simpa only [J.property] using hds)]
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, J.property, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.re_det_conjTranspose_mul_self_pos
statement:
theorem re_det_conjTranspose_mul_self_pos (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (hX : IsUnit (Xᴴ * X)) : 0 < RCLike.re (Xᴴ * X).det
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp
    (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X).det_nonneg).1
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg
  intro hzero
  have him := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp
    (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X).det_nonneg).2
  apply ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hX).ne_zero
  exact RCLike.ext (by simpa using hzero.symm) (by simpa using him)

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_pos
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_pos (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (s : ℕ)
    (hX : IsUnit (Xᴴ * X)) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hsn : s ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    0 < ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_rowSubsetVolume_eq_choose_mul X s hds]
  exact mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hsn _)))
    (re_det_conjTranspose_mul_self_pos X hX)

name: NLAlib.det_rowSubsetCrossGram_eq_sum_minors
statement:
theorem det_rowSubsetCrossGram_eq_sum_minors (A B : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    (rowSubsetCrossGram A B S).det = ∑ J : SizedSubset n d,
      if J.val ⊆ S then star ((A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det) *
        (B.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpad : ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * A)ᴴ * (coordinateSelector S * B) =
      rowSubsetCrossGram A B S := by
    simp only [rowSubsetCrossGram, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      (coordinateSelector_isHermitian (𝕜 := 𝕜) S).eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc Aᴴ (coordinateSelector S) (coordinateSelector S), coordinateSelector_mul_self]
  rw [← hpad, det_mul_eq_sum_det_submatrix_mul_det_submatrix]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J _
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.det_conjTranspose,
    det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix, det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.sum_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_powersetCard (A B : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetCrossGram A B S).det) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : 𝕜) *
        (rowSubsetCrossGram A B T).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [det_rowSubsetCrossGram_eq_sum_minors]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J _
  by_cases hJT : J.val ⊆ T
  · rw [if_pos hJT, ← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset J.val T s hJT (by simpa only [J.property] using hds)]
    simp only [J.property, nsmul_eq_mul]
  · rw [if_neg hJT, mul_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro S hS
    rw [if_neg (fun hJS => hJT (hJS.trans (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).1))]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_submatrix_succAbove
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_submatrix_succAbove {D : ℕ}
    (X : Matrix n (Fin (D + 1)) 𝕜) (S : Finset n) (i j : Fin (D + 1)) :
    (rowSubsetGram X S).submatrix j.succAbove i.succAbove =
      rowSubsetCrossGram (X.submatrix id j.succAbove) (X.submatrix id i.succAbove) S
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [rowSubsetGram, rowSubsetCrossGram, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, id_eq]

name: NLAlib.sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard_fin_succ
statement:
theorem sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard_fin_succ {D : ℕ}
    (X : Matrix n (Fin (D + 1)) 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hDs : D ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate) =
      ((T.card - D).choose (s - D) : 𝕜) • (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix, rowSubsetGram_submatrix_succAbove]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [sum_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_powersetCard _ _ T s (by simpa using hDs)]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  ring
