name: NLAlib.sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < Fintype.card d) (hds : Fintype.card d - 1 ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate) =
      ((T.card - (Fintype.card d - 1)).choose (s - (Fintype.card d - 1)) : 𝕜) •
        (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hd.ne'
  let e : d ≃ Fin (D + 1) := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simpa using hD)
  let Y := X.submatrix id e.symm
  have hG (S : Finset n) : rowSubsetGram Y S = (rowSubsetGram X S).submatrix e.symm e.symm := by
    ext i j
    simp only [rowSubsetGram, Y, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
  have hsum := sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard_fin_succ Y T s
    (by simpa only [hD, Nat.succ_sub_one] using hds)
  ext i j
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (D + 1)) (Fin (D + 1)) 𝕜 => M (e i) (e j)) hsum
  simpa only [hG, Matrix.adjugate_submatrix_equiv_self, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hD, Nat.succ_sub_one] using h

name: NLAlib.det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (M : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (h : M.rank = Fintype.card n) : M.det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hMv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  have hker : v ∈ LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin := by simpa using hMv
  have h1 : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin) :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨⟨v, hker⟩, by simpa using hv⟩
  have h2 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker M.mulVecLin
  rw [Matrix.rank] at h
  simp only [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at h2
  omega

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    (G : Matrix m n ℝ) : ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have := Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose G
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at this
  exact this.inv

name: NLAlib.abs_apply_le_apply_self_add_apply_self
statement:
theorem abs_apply_le_apply_self_add_apply_self {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (M : Matrix m m ℝ) (hM : M.PosSemidef) (i j : m) : |M i j| ≤ M i i + M j j
proof:
:= by
  have hs : M j i = M i j := by
    have := hM.isHermitian.apply i j
    simpa using this
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    have := hM.diag_nonneg (i := i)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg this]; linarith
  have h1 := hM.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1)
  have h2 := hM.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1)
  simp [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
    sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.mulVec_single, single_dotProduct,
    hs] at h1 h2
  rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_det_sq_mul_frobSq_inv_mul
statement:
theorem norm_det_sq_mul_frobSq_inv_mul [Fintype r]
    (R : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hR : IsUnit R) (E : Matrix d r 𝕜) :
    ‖R.det‖ ^ 2 * frobSq (R⁻¹ * E) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖(R.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).det‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : R.det • (R⁻¹ * E) = fun i j => (R.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).det := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrFun (Matrix.det_smul_inv_mulVec_eq_cramer R (fun a => E a j)
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR)) i
    simpa only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Pi.smul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.cramer_apply] using h
  rw [← frobSq_smul_eq_norm_sq_mul, he]
  exact frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq _

name: NLAlib.univ_map_sizedSubsetIndex
statement:
theorem univ_map_sizedSubsetIndex (J : SizedSubset n d) :
    Finset.univ.map ⟨sizedSubsetIndex J, sizedSubsetIndex_injective J⟩ = J.val
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.coe_injective
  simpa only [Finset.coe_map, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ,
    Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk] using range_sizedSubsetIndex J

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_sizedSubset
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_sizedSubset (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (J : SizedSubset n d) :
    rowSubsetVolume X J.val = ‖(X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors, Finset.sum_eq_single J]
  · rw [if_pos (Finset.Subset.refl _)]
  · intro K _ hKJ
    rw [if_neg]
    intro hK
    exact hKJ (Subtype.ext (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hK (by rw [J.property, K.property])))
  · simp

name: NLAlib.re_det_rowGram_sizedSubset_eq_rowSubsetVolume
statement:
theorem re_det_rowGram_sizedSubset_eq_rowSubsetVolume
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (J : SizedSubset n d) :
    RCLike.re ((X * Xᴴ).submatrix (Subtype.val : J.val → n) Subtype.val).det =
      rowSubsetVolume X J.val
proof:
:= by
  let e : J.val ≃ d := Fintype.equivOfCardEq ((Fintype.card_coe J.val).trans J.property)
  let R := X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id
  have hIndex : ((X * Xᴴ).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) (sizedSubsetIndex J)).det =
      ((X * Xᴴ).submatrix (Subtype.val : J.val → n) Subtype.val).det := by
    change (((X * Xᴴ).submatrix (Subtype.val : J.val → n) Subtype.val).submatrix e.symm e.symm).det = _
    exact Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e.symm _
  have hGram : (X * Xᴴ).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) (sizedSubsetIndex J) = R * Rᴴ := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix]
    simpa only [R, Equiv.coe_refl] using
      (Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv X Xᴴ (sizedSubsetIndex J) (Equiv.refl d) (sizedSubsetIndex J)).symm
  rw [← hIndex, hGram, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose,
    rowSubsetVolume_sizedSubset, mul_comm, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul,
    ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_submatrix_sizedSubset_of_rowSubsetVolume_pos
statement:
theorem isUnit_submatrix_sizedSubset_of_rowSubsetVolume_pos
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (J : SizedSubset n d) (hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X J.val) :
    IsUnit (X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSubsetVolume_sizedSubset] at hJ
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hz
  simp only [hz, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), lt_self_iff_false] at hJ

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul
statement:
theorem rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul [Fintype r]
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (J : SizedSubset n d) (hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X J.val)
    (E : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    rowSubsetPseudoinverse X J.val * E =
      (X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id)⁻¹ * E.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id
proof:
:= by
  let e : d ↪ n := ⟨sizedSubsetIndex J, sizedSubsetIndex_injective J⟩
  have h := moorePenroseInverse_coordinateSelector_mul_mul X e
    (isUnit_submatrix_sizedSubset_of_rowSubsetVolume_pos X J hJ) E
  simpa only [rowSubsetPseudoinverse, e, univ_map_sizedSubsetIndex,
    Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk] using h

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_mul_frobSq_pseudoinverse_mul
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_mul_frobSq_pseudoinverse_mul [Fintype r]
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (J : SizedSubset n d) (hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X J.val)
    (E : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    rowSubsetVolume X J.val * frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X J.val * E) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖((X.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSubsetVolume_sizedSubset, rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul X J hJ E,
    norm_det_sq_mul_frobSq_inv_mul _ (isUnit_submatrix_sizedSubset_of_rowSubsetVolume_pos X J hJ)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.frobSq_rowSubset_interpolation_error
statement:
theorem frobSq_rowSubset_interpolation_error [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (S : Finset n)
    (hS : IsUnit (rowSubsetGram Q S)) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A - Q * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * A)) =
      frobSq (projResidual Q A) + frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have he : rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * projResidual Q A =
      rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * A - Qᴴ * A := by
    rw [projResidual, Matrix.mul_sub, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_one Q S hS, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ, he, frobSq_sub_comm (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * A)]

name: NLAlib.det_updateCol_single_eq_of_complement_eq
statement:
theorem det_updateCol_single_eq_of_complement_eq {p : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p] (A B : Matrix p p ℝ) (i : p)
    (h : ∀ a b, a ≠ i → b ≠ i → A a b = B a b) :
    (A.updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)).det = (B.updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)).det
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.det_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro σ _
  by_cases hσ : σ i = i
  · congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [hσ]
    · have hσj : σ j ≠ i := fun he => hj (σ.injective (he.trans hσ.symm))
      simp only [Matrix.updateCol_apply, if_neg hj]
      exact h (σ j) j hσj hj
  · have hAz : (∏ j, (A.updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)) (σ j) j) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by simp [hσ])
    have hBz : (∏ j, (B.updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)) (σ j) j) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by simp [hσ])
    rw [hAz, hBz]

name: NLAlib.det_add_single_diagonal
statement:
theorem det_add_single_diagonal {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix p p ℝ) (i : p) (a : ℝ) :
    (A + Matrix.single i i a).det = A.det + a * (A.updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)).det
proof:
:= by
  have heq : A + Matrix.single i i a = A.updateCol i ((fun j => A j i) + a • Pi.single i 1) := by
    ext j k
    by_cases hk : k = i
    · subst k
      simp [Matrix.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
    · simp [hk, Ne.symm hk]
  rw [heq, Matrix.det_updateCol_add, Matrix.det_updateCol_smul]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg Matrix.det (Matrix.updateCol_eq_self A i)

name: NLAlib.det_updateCol_single_eq_det_mul_inv
statement:
theorem det_updateCol_single_eq_det_mul_inv {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix p p ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A.det) (i : p) :
    (A.updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)).det = A.det * A⁻¹ i i
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (Matrix.det_smul_inv_mulVec_eq_cramer A (Pi.single i 1) hA) i
  simpa [Matrix.cramer_apply, Matrix.mulVec_single] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_generalTikhonovNormal
statement:
theorem posSemidef_generalTikhonovNormal (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (L : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 ≤ β) : (generalTikhonovNormal A L β).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).add
    ((Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self L).smul hβ)

name: NLAlib.generalTikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective
statement:
theorem generalTikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (L : Matrix p n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (β : ℝ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    generalTikhonovObjective A L b β x =
      2 * quadraticObjective (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) x +
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : star (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ x = star b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hr : RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ b) = RCLike.re (star b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) := by
    calc
      _ = RCLike.re (star (star b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))) := by
        congr 1
        rw [← Matrix.star_dotProduct_star, star_star]
      _ = _ := by simp [RCLike.star_def]
  have hq : RCLike.re (quadForm (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) x) =
      RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) +
        β * RCLike.re (star (L *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ x)) := by
    simp only [generalTikhonovNormal, quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, map_add, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul,
      RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
    rw [← quadForm, quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, ← quadForm,
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  simp only [generalTikhonovObjective, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, star_sub,
    sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, map_sub, quadraticObjective, hq, hc, hr]
  ring

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonovNormal_congruence
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonovNormal_congruence
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (β : ℝ) :
    Xᴴ * generalTikhonovNormal A L β * X =
      diagonal (fun i => ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  rw [generalTikhonovNormal, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, h.left_gram, h.right_gram]
  ext i j
  by_cases he : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_pow]
  · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, he]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.coefficient_eq_zero_of_left_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.coefficient_eq_zero_of_left_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) (i : n) (hi : c i = 0) :
    (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := h.left_col_eq_zero i hi
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  change ∑ j, star ((A * X) j i) * b j = 0
  simp only [show ∀ j, (A * X) j i = 0 from fun j => congrFun hc j,
    star_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonov_filter_normal_equation
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonov_filter_normal_equation
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    generalTikhonovNormal A L β *ᵥ
      (X *ᵥ (fun i => (Xᴴ *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) i / ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))) =
        Aᴴ *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr
    ((Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose X).mpr h.invertible)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h.generalTikhonovNormal_congruence]
  ext i
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  by_cases hi : c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 = 0
  · have hc : c i = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c i), sq_nonneg (s i)]
    rw [h.coefficient_eq_zero_of_left_eq_zero b i hc, zero_div, mul_zero]
  · have hcast : ((c i ^ 2 + β * s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hi
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hcast

name: NLAlib.generalTikhonov_pinv_normal_equation
statement:
theorem generalTikhonov_pinv_normal_equation (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (L : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    generalTikhonovNormal A L β *ᵥ
      (moorePenroseInverse (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)) = Aᴴ *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, c, s, h⟩ := exists_isNormalizedGSVD A L
  have he := h.generalTikhonov_filter_normal_equation b hβ
  rw [← he, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]

name: NLAlib.generalTikhonovObjective_add_of_normal_equation
statement:
theorem generalTikhonovObjective_add_of_normal_equation
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (L : Matrix p n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (x : n → 𝕜) (hx : generalTikhonovNormal A L β *ᵥ x = Aᴴ *ᵥ b) (z : n → 𝕜) :
    generalTikhonovObjective A L b β (x + z) = generalTikhonovObjective A L b β x +
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ z)‖ ^ 2 + β * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ z)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he := quadraticObjective_add_of_mulVec_eq
    (posSemidef_generalTikhonovNormal A L hβ).isHermitian hx z
  simp only [generalTikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective, he]
  have hq : RCLike.re (quadForm (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) z) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ z)‖ ^ 2 + β * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ z)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [generalTikhonovNormal, quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, map_add, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul,
      RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
    rw [← quadForm, quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, ← quadForm,
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
    simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  rw [hq]
  ring

name: NLAlib.generalTikhonov_minimizers_iff
statement:
theorem generalTikhonov_minimizers_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (L : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (y : n → 𝕜) :
    (∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β y ≤ generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z) ↔
      ∃ v, A *ᵥ v = 0 ∧ L *ᵥ v = 0 ∧
        y = moorePenroseInverse (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) + v
proof:
:= by
  let x := moorePenroseInverse (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)
  have hx := generalTikhonov_pinv_normal_equation A L b hβ
  have he (z : n → 𝕜) : generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z =
      generalTikhonovObjective A L b β x + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (z - x))‖ ^ 2 +
        β * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (z - x))‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using
      generalTikhonovObjective_add_of_normal_equation A L b hβ.le x hx (z - x)
  have hmin (z : n → 𝕜) : generalTikhonovObjective A L b β x ≤
      generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z := by
    rw [he z]
    have hn := mul_nonneg hβ.le (sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (z - x))‖)
    linarith [sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (z - x))‖]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hle := hy x
    rw [he y] at hle
    have hA : A *ᵥ (y - x) = 0 := by
      have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (y - x))‖ = 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (y - x))‖,
          sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (y - x))‖,
          norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (y - x)))]
      exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)
    have hL : L *ᵥ (y - x) = 0 := by
      have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (y - x))‖ = 0 := by
        apply le_antisymm _ (norm_nonneg _)
        by_contra hh
        have hp := mul_pos hβ (sq_pos_of_pos (lt_of_not_ge hh))
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (y - x))‖]
      exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)
    exact ⟨y - x, hA, hL, (add_sub_cancel _ _).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hA, hL, rfl⟩ z
    rw [generalTikhonovObjective_add_of_normal_equation A L b hβ.le x hx v, hA, hL]
    simpa using hmin z

name: NLAlib.generalTikhonov_unique_minimizer_iff
statement:
theorem generalTikhonov_unique_minimizer_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (L : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (b : m → 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    (∃! x, ∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β x ≤ generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z) ↔
      ∀ v : n → 𝕜, A *ᵥ v = 0 → L *ᵥ v = 0 → v = 0
proof:
:= by
  let x := moorePenroseInverse (generalTikhonovNormal A L β) *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)
  have hx : ∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β x ≤ generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z := by
    apply (generalTikhonov_minimizers_iff A L b hβ x).mpr
    exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp, by simp [x]⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hu⟩ v hvA hvL
    have hxy : x = y := hu x hx
    have hv : ∀ z, generalTikhonovObjective A L b β (x + v) ≤
        generalTikhonovObjective A L b β z := by
      apply (generalTikhonov_minimizers_iff A L b hβ (x + v)).mpr
      exact ⟨v, hvA, hvL, rfl⟩
    have hh : x + v = x := (hu _ hv).trans hxy.symm
    exact add_left_cancel (hh.trans (add_zero x).symm)
  · intro hN
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨v, hvA, hvL, hv⟩ := (generalTikhonov_minimizers_iff A L b hβ y).mp hy
    simpa only [hN v hvA hvL, add_zero] using hv

name: NLAlib.inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq
statement:
theorem inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq (Q Y : Matrix m r 𝕜) (R : Matrix r r 𝕜)
    (hR : IsUnit R) (hY : IsUnit (Yᴴ*Y)) (hQR : Q*R=Y) :
    (Qᴴ*Q)⁻¹ = R*(Yᴴ*Y)⁻¹*Rᴴ ∧ IsUnit (Qᴴ*Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hRd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR
  have hYd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY
  have hg : Rᴴ*(Qᴴ*Q)*R = Yᴴ*Y := by
    rw [← hQR,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hrel : Rᴴ*(Qᴴ*Q) = (Yᴴ*Y)*R⁻¹ := by
    rw [← hg,Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R hRd,Matrix.mul_one]
  have hi : (R*(Yᴴ*Y)⁻¹*Rᴴ)*(Qᴴ*Q)=1 := by
    calc
      _ = R*(Yᴴ*Y)⁻¹*(Rᴴ*(Qᴴ*Q)) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = R*(Yᴴ*Y)⁻¹*((Yᴴ*Y)*R⁻¹) := by rw [hrel]
      _ = R*((Yᴴ*Y)⁻¹*(Yᴴ*Y))*R⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hYd,Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R hRd]
  exact ⟨Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hi,
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hi)⟩

name: NLAlib.trace_inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq
statement:
theorem trace_inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq (Q Y : Matrix m r 𝕜) (Z : Matrix s r 𝕜)
    (R : Matrix r r 𝕜) (hR : IsUnit R) (hY : IsUnit (Yᴴ*Y)) (hQR : Q*R=Y)
    (hGram : Rᴴ*R=Yᴴ*Y+Zᴴ*Z) :
    Matrix.trace (Qᴴ*Q)⁻¹ = (Fintype.card r : 𝕜)+Matrix.trace ((Yᴴ*Y)⁻¹*(Zᴴ*Z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq Q Y R hR hY hQR).1,
    Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.trace_mul_comm,Matrix.mul_assoc,hGram,
    Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.trace_add,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY),Matrix.trace_one]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_pinvR_adjoint_eq_re_trace
statement:
theorem frobSq_mul_pinvR_adjoint_eq_re_trace (X : Matrix r m 𝕜) (Z : Matrix s r 𝕜)
    (hX : IsUnit (X*Xᴴ)) :
    frobSq (Z*(pinvR X)ᴴ) = RCLike.re (Matrix.trace ((X*Xᴴ)⁻¹*(Zᴴ*Z)))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hX
  have hHerm : ((X*Xᴴ)⁻¹)ᴴ=(X*Xᴴ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hP : (pinvR X)ᴴ*pinvR X=(X*Xᴴ)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      _ = (X*Xᴴ)⁻¹*(X*Xᴴ)*(X*Xᴴ)⁻¹ := by
        unfold pinvR
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,hHerm]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd,Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = Matrix.trace (pinvR X*(Zᴴ*Z)*(pinvR X)ᴴ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Matrix.trace (((pinvR X)ᴴ*pinvR X)*(Zᴴ*Z)) := Matrix.trace_mul_cycle _ _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hP]

name: NLAlib.diag_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem diag_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef {R : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) (i : n) : R i i = ((RCLike.re (R i i) : ℝ) : 𝕜)
proof:
:=
  ((RCLike.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (hR.isHermitian.apply i i))).symm

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem trace_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef {R : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) : R.trace = ((RCLike.re R.trace : ℝ) : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hR.trace_nonneg).2
  exact (RCLike.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (RCLike.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr hi)).symm

name: NLAlib.re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef {R : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ RCLike.re R.trace
proof: := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hR.trace_nonneg).1

name: NLAlib.re_trace_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem re_trace_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef {R : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) : RCLike.re R.trace = 0 ↔ R = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ht
    apply hR.trace_eq_zero_iff.mp
    rw [trace_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef hR, ht, RCLike.ofReal_zero]
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.kkt_solution
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.kkt_solution {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜}
    (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z) (hB : IsUnit (B * Bᴴ)) (H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (f : n → 𝕜) (g : m → 𝕜) (xp : n → 𝕜) (hxp : B *ᵥ xp = g)
    (y : r → 𝕜) (hy : reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ y = Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ xp)) :
    let x
proof:
:= xp + Z *ᵥ y
    let l := (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ x))
    B *ᵥ x = g ∧ H *ᵥ x + Bᴴ *ᵥ l = f := by
  dsimp only
  have hx : B *ᵥ (xp + Z *ᵥ y) = g := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hZ.mul_eq_zero, Matrix.zero_mulVec,
      add_zero, hxp]
  refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  have hz : Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ (xp + Z *ᵥ y)) = 0 := by
    simp only [reducedHessian, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub] at hy
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_add]
    linear_combination -hy
  have he := hZ.eq_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero hB hz
  linear_combination -he

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.reduced_equation
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.reduced_equation {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜}
    (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z) (H : Matrix n n 𝕜) (f xp : n → 𝕜)
    (y : r → 𝕜) (l : m → 𝕜)
    (he : H *ᵥ (xp + Z *ᵥ y) + Bᴴ *ᵥ l = f) :
    reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ y = Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ xp)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : Zᴴ * Bᴴ = 0 := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hZ.mul_eq_zero, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero]
  have hh := congrArg (fun v => Zᴴ *ᵥ v) he
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec l Zᴴ Bᴴ, hz,
    Matrix.zero_mulVec, add_zero] at hh
  simp only [reducedHessian, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub]
  linear_combination hh

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.isUnit_kktMatrix_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit, ← Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit]
  change Function.Injective (kktMatrix H B).mulVecLin ↔
    Function.Injective (reducedHessian H Z).mulVecLin
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, ← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  change LinearMap.ker (kktMatrix H B).mulVecLin = ⊥ ↔
    LinearMap.ker (reducedHessian H Z).mulVecLin = ⊥
  rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot', LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    change reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ y = 0 at hy
    have he := hZ.kkt_solution hB H 0 0 0 (by simp) y (by simpa using hy)
    simp only [zero_add] at he
    let l := (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ (0 - H *ᵥ (Z *ᵥ y)))
    have hv : kktMatrix H B *ᵥ Sum.elim (Z *ᵥ y) l = 0 := by
      rw [kktMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec]
      simp only [Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
        Matrix.zero_mulVec, add_zero]
      ext i
      cases i with
      | inl i => exact congrFun he.2 i
      | inr i => exact congrFun he.1 i
    have hz := congrArg (fun v => Zᴴ *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl)) (h _ hv)
    change Zᴴ *ᵥ (Z *ᵥ y) = Zᴴ *ᵥ (0 : n → 𝕜) at hz
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hZ.orth.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_zero] using hz
  · intro h v hv
    change kktMatrix H B *ᵥ v = 0 at hv
    have htop : H *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl) + Bᴴ *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inr) = 0 := by
      ext i
      simpa only [kktMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Sum.elim_inl, Pi.zero_apply]
        using congrFun hv (Sum.inl i)
    have hbot : B *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl) = 0 := by
      ext i
      simpa only [kktMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Sum.elim_inr,
        Matrix.zero_mulVec, add_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hv (Sum.inr i)
    have hcoord := hZ.mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec hbot
    have hred : reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ (Zᴴ *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl)) = 0 := by
      have he := hZ.reduced_equation H 0 0 (Zᴴ *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl)) (v ∘ Sum.inr)
      apply (by simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_zero, sub_zero] using he)
      simpa only [zero_add, hcoord] using htop
    have hx : v ∘ Sum.inl = 0 := by
      have hh := h _ hred
      rw [hh, Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hcoord
      exact hcoord.symm
    have hl : v ∘ Sum.inr = 0 := by
      rw [hx, Matrix.mulVec_zero, zero_add] at htop
      have hh := congrArg (fun w => B *ᵥ w) htop
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hh
      exact Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hB (by simpa using hh)
    ext i
    cases i with
    | inl i => exact congrFun hx i
    | inr i => exact congrFun hl i

name: NLAlib.sizedSubsetIndex_injective
statement:
theorem sizedSubsetIndex_injective {n r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    (S : SizedSubset n r) : Function.Injective (sizedSubsetIndex S)
proof:
:= by
  exact Subtype.val_injective.comp (Equiv.injective _)

name: NLAlib.range_sizedSubsetIndex
statement:
theorem range_sizedSubsetIndex {n r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    (S : SizedSubset n r) : Set.range (sizedSubsetIndex S) = (S.val : Set n)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (Fintype.equivOfCardEq
      ((Fintype.card_coe S.val).trans S.property)).symm i |>.property
  · intro hx
    let e : S.val ≃ r := Fintype.equivOfCardEq ((Fintype.card_coe S.val).trans S.property)
    refine ⟨e ⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [sizedSubsetIndex, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.compoundMatrix_one
statement:
theorem compoundMatrix_one {n r R : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r] [CommRing R] :
    compoundMatrix r (1 : Matrix n n R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext S T
  by_cases hST : S = T
  · subst T
    simp only [compoundMatrix, Matrix.submatrix_one _ (sizedSubsetIndex_injective S),
      Matrix.det_one, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne hST]
    have hnsub : ¬ S.val ⊆ T.val := by
      intro hsub
      exact hST (Subtype.ext (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [S.property, T.property])))
    obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxT⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnsub
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (range_sizedSubsetIndex S ▸ hxS : x ∈ Set.range (sizedSubsetIndex S))
    apply Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero i
    intro j
    change (1 : Matrix n n R) (sizedSubsetIndex S i) (sizedSubsetIndex T j) = 0
    apply Matrix.one_apply_ne
    intro h
    apply hxT
    rw [← hi, h]
    exact (range_sizedSubsetIndex T ▸ Set.mem_range_self j : sizedSubsetIndex T j ∈ (T.val : Set n))

name: NLAlib.compoundMatrix_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem compoundMatrix_conjTranspose {m n r R : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [CommRing R] [StarRing R]
    (A : Matrix m n R) :
    compoundMatrix r Aᴴ = (compoundMatrix r A)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  ext S T
  change (Aᴴ.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) (sizedSubsetIndex T)).det =
    star ((A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex T) (sizedSubsetIndex S)).det)
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.det_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.det_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_norm_sq
statement:
theorem det_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_norm_sq {𝕜 m r : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq r]
    (A : Matrix m r 𝕜) :
    (Aᴴ * A).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset m r,
      (‖(A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) id).det‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_mul_eq_sum_det_submatrix_mul_det_submatrix, RCLike.ofReal_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.det_conjTranspose]
  simpa only [RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.star_def] using
    (RCLike.conj_mul ((A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) id).det))

name: NLAlib.card_sub_rank_blocks_eq
statement:
private theorem card_sub_rank_blocks_eq {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hM : IsUnit M.det) :
    Fintype.card p - M.toBlocks₁₁.rank = Fintype.card q - M⁻¹.toBlocks₂₂.rank
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement M hM
    (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft)
  have hFirst : (M.toBlock (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft)).rank = M.toBlocks₁₁.rank :=
    (Matrix.rank_submatrix (M.toBlock (fun s => s.isLeft) (fun s => s.isLeft))
      Equiv.sumIsLeft.symm Equiv.sumIsLeft.symm).symm
  have hLast : (M⁻¹.toBlock (fun s => ¬s.isLeft) (fun s => ¬s.isLeft)).rank = M⁻¹.toBlocks₂₂.rank :=
    (Matrix.rank_submatrix (M⁻¹.toBlock (fun s => ¬s.isLeft) (fun s => ¬s.isLeft))
      (complementEquiv p q).symm (complementEquiv p q).symm).symm
  rwa [hFirst, hLast,
    Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumIsLeft : {s : p ⊕ q // s.isLeft} ≃ p),
    Fintype.card_congr (complementEquiv p q)] at h

name: NLAlib.det_inverse_bottomRight_eq_zero_of_topLeft_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_inverse_bottomRight_eq_zero_of_topLeft_eq_zero {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hM : IsUnit M.det) (hZero : M.toBlocks₁₁.det = 0) :
    M⁻¹.toBlocks₂₂.det = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hLast
  have h := card_sub_rank_blocks_eq M hM
  have hRank := Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hLast
  rw [hRank, Nat.sub_self] at h
  have hBound := M.toBlocks₁₁.rank_le_card_width
  have hFull : M.toBlocks₁₁.rank = Fintype.card p := by omega
  exact det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq M.toBlocks₁₁ hFull hZero

name: NLAlib.det_inverse_bottomRight_eq_topLeft_div_det
statement:
theorem det_inverse_bottomRight_eq_topLeft_div_det {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (M : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℝ) (hM : IsUnit M.det) :
    M⁻¹.toBlocks₂₂.det = M.toBlocks₁₁.det / M.det
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hZero : M.toBlocks₁₁.det = 0
  · rw [det_inverse_bottomRight_eq_zero_of_topLeft_eq_zero M hM hZero, hZero, zero_div]
  · let A := M.toBlocks₁₁
    let B := M.toBlocks₁₂
    let C := M.toBlocks₂₁
    let D := M.toBlocks₂₂
    let S := D - C * A⁻¹ * B
    have hA : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hZero
    let := A.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hA
    have hFactor : M = Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D := (Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks M).symm
    have hDet : M.det = A.det * S.det := by
      rw [hFactor, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
    have hS : IsUnit S.det := by
      apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      intro hz
      exact hM.ne_zero (by rw [hDet, hz, mul_zero])
    let := S.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hS
    have hMBlock : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).det := by rw [← hFactor]; exact hM
    let := (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).invertibleOfIsUnitDet hMBlock
    have hInv := Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks₁₁_eq A B C D
    simp only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] at hInv
    have hCorner : M⁻¹.toBlocks₂₂ = S⁻¹ := by
      rw [hFactor, hInv]
      rfl
    rw [hCorner, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', hDet]
    have hAn : A.det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hA
    have hSn : S.det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hS
    field_simp
    rfl

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_eq_reindex_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem borderedMatrix_eq_reindex_fromBlocks (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    borderedMatrix a r c M =
      reindex (finOneSumEquiv n) (finOneSumEquiv n)
        (fromBlocks (of fun _ _ => a) (of fun _ j => r j) (of fun i _ => c i) M)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · have h : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm 0 = Sum.inl 0 := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    simp [h]
  · have h : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm 0 = Sum.inl 0 := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    have h' : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm j.succ = Sum.inr j := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    simp [h, h']
  · have h : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm 0 = Sum.inl 0 := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    have h' : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm i.succ = Sum.inr i := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    simp [h, h']
  · have h : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm i.succ = Sum.inr i := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    have h' : (finOneSumEquiv n).symm j.succ = Sum.inr j := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]; simp
    simp [h, h']

name: NLAlib.eq_borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem eq_borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix_pivotSchur
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0) :
    A = borderedMatrix 1 0 ((A 0 0)⁻¹ • fun i => A i.succ 0) 1 *
      borderedMatrix (A 0 0) (fun j => A 0 j.succ) 0 (pivotSchur A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix]
  conv_lhs => rw [← borderedMatrix_eta A]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · ext j; simp
  · ext i; simp [ha]
  · ext i j; simp [pivotSchur, vecMulVec_apply]

name: NLAlib.det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0) :
    A.det = A 0 0 * (pivotSchur A).det
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix_pivotSchur A ha]
  rw [det_mul, det_borderedMatrix_of_top_eq_zero, det_borderedMatrix_of_left_eq_zero]
  simp

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem isHermitian_pivotSchur {A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (pivotSchur A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm] at hA ⊢
  ext i j
  have h1 : A i.succ j.succ = A j.succ i.succ := hA.apply j.succ i.succ
  have h2 : A i.succ 0 = A 0 i.succ := hA.apply 0 i.succ
  have h3 : A j.succ 0 = A 0 j.succ := hA.apply 0 j.succ
  simp only [transpose_apply, pivotSchur_apply, h1, h2, h3]
  ring

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ)
    (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    vecCons x₀ y ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ vecCons x₀ y =
      A 0 0 * x₀ ^ 2 + x₀ * (∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) + x₀ * (∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0) +
        y ⬝ᵥ A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ *ᵥ y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_succ, cons_val_zero, cons_val_succ,
    submatrix_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  ring_nf

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec
statement:
theorem dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    y ⬝ᵥ pivotSchur A *ᵥ y = y ⬝ᵥ A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ *ᵥ y -
      (A 0 0)⁻¹ * ((∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0) * (∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, pivotSchur_apply, submatrix_apply, Finset.mul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

name: NLAlib.posDef_iff_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem posDef_iff_pivotSchur {A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A.PosDef ↔ 0 < A 0 0 ∧ (pivotSchur A).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hSh := isHermitian_pivotSchur hA
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm] at hA
  have hsym : ∀ y : Fin n → ℝ, ∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0 = ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j := fun y =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hA.apply 0 i.succ, mul_comm]
  constructor
  · intro hPD
    refine ⟨hPD.diag_pos, posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.2 ⟨hSh, fun y hy => ?_⟩⟩
    have hx0 : vecCons (-((A 0 0)⁻¹ * ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j)) y ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hy; ext i; simpa using congrFun h i.succ
    have hx := (posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.1 hPD).2 hx0
    simp only [star_trivial] at hx ⊢
    rw [dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons, hsym] at hx
    rw [dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec, hsym]
    have ha := hPD.diag_pos (i := 0)
    have key : A 0 0 * ((A 0 0)⁻¹ * ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) ^ 2 =
        (A 0 0)⁻¹ * ((∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) * ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) := by
      field_simp
    nlinarith [key]
  · rintro ⟨ha, hS⟩
    refine posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.2 ⟨Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr hA, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hxe : x = vecCons (x 0) (Fin.tail x) := (Fin.cons_self_tail x).symm
    simp only [star_trivial]
    rw [hxe, dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons, hsym]
    set y := Fin.tail x
    set t := ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · have hx0 : x 0 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; apply hx; rw [hxe, h0, hy]; ext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> simp
      have ht : t = 0 := by simp [t, hy]
      rw [ht, hy]
      simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, zero_dotProduct]
      positivity
    · have hq := (posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.1 hS).2 hy
      simp only [star_trivial] at hq
      rw [dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec, hsym] at hq
      have key : A 0 0 * (x 0 + (A 0 0)⁻¹ * t) ^ 2 =
          A 0 0 * x 0 ^ 2 + 2 * x 0 * t + (A 0 0)⁻¹ * (t * t) := by
        field_simp; ring
      nlinarith [key, mul_nonneg ha.le (sq_nonneg (x 0 + (A 0 0)⁻¹ * t))]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem posSemidef_pivotSchur {A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : (pivotSchur A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hAs := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hA.isHermitian
  have hsym : ∀ y : Fin n → ℝ, ∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0 = ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j := fun y =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hAs.apply 0 i.succ, mul_comm]
  refine posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.2
    ⟨isHermitian_pivotSchur hA.isHermitian, fun y => ?_⟩
  have hx := (posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.1 hA).2
    (vecCons (-((A 0 0)⁻¹ * ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j)) y)
  simp only [star_trivial] at hx ⊢
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons, hsym] at hx
  rw [dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec, hsym]
  have key : A 0 0 * ((A 0 0)⁻¹ * ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) ^ 2 =
      (A 0 0)⁻¹ * ((∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) * ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) := by
    by_cases ha : A 0 0 = 0
    · simp [ha]
    · field_simp
  nlinarith [key]

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_sub_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem sum_smul_sub_mul_conjTranspose (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (M : ι → Matrix r c 𝕜) (B : Matrix r c 𝕜) (hmean : ∑ i, p i • M i = B) :
    (∑ i, p i • ((M i - B) * (M i - B)ᴴ)) =
      (∑ i, p i • (M i * (M i)ᴴ)) - B * Bᴴ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hAdj : (∑ i, p i • (M i)ᴴ) = Bᴴ := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hmean
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_trivial] using h
  have hright : (∑ i, p i • (M i * Bᴴ)) = B * Bᴴ := by
    simp only [← Matrix.smul_mul]
    rw [← Matrix.sum_mul, hmean]
  have hleft : (∑ i, p i • (B * (M i)ᴴ)) = B * Bᴴ := by
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_smul]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_sum, hAdj]
  have hconst : (∑ i, p i • (B * Bᴴ)) = B * Bᴴ := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_smul, hp, one_smul]
  have hexp (i : ι) : (M i - B) * (M i - B)ᴴ =
      M i * (M i)ᴴ - M i * Bᴴ - B * (M i)ᴴ + B * Bᴴ := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub]
    abel
  simp_rw [hexp, smul_add, smul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    hright, hleft, hconst]
  abel

name: NLAlib.pinvL_mul_conjTranspose_eq_inv_gram
statement:
theorem pinvL_mul_conjTranspose_eq_inv_gram (F : Matrix s r 𝕜) (hF : IsUnit (Fᴴ*F)) :
    pinvL F*(pinvL F)ᴴ=(Fᴴ*F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [pinvL_conjTranspose, pinvL, pinvR, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  calc
    _ = ((Fᴴ*F)⁻¹*(Fᴴ*F))*(Fᴴ*F)⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hF), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.pinvL_blockNoise_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem pinvL_blockNoise_mul_conjTranspose (F : Matrix s r 𝕜) (H : Matrix s q 𝕜)
    (hF : IsUnit (Fᴴ*F)) (hrow : F*Fᴴ+H*Hᴴ=1) :
    (pinvL F*H)*(pinvL F*H)ᴴ=(Fᴴ*F)⁻¹-1
proof:
:= by
  have hH : H*Hᴴ=1-F*Fᴴ := by rw [← hrow]; abel
  calc
    _ = (pinvL F*(H*Hᴴ))*(pinvL F)ᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = pinvL F*(pinvL F)ᴴ-(pinvL F*F)*(pinvL F*F)ᴴ := by
      rw [hH, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.sub_mul]
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [pinvL_mul_conjTranspose_eq_inv_gram F hF, pinvL_mul hF,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_pinvL_blockNoise_eq_trace_inv_sub_card
statement:
theorem frobSq_pinvL_blockNoise_eq_trace_inv_sub_card (F : Matrix s r 𝕜) (H : Matrix s q 𝕜)
    (hF : IsUnit (Fᴴ*F)) (hrow : F*Fᴴ+H*Hᴴ=1) :
    frobSq (pinvL F*H)=RCLike.re ((Fᴴ*F)⁻¹).trace-Fintype.card r
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_mul_comm,
    pinvL_blockNoise_mul_conjTranspose F H hF hrow, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  simp

name: NLAlib.rowGram_sketch_blocks_eq_one
statement:
theorem rowGram_sketch_blocks_eq_one {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (Ω : Matrix m s 𝕜) (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix m q 𝕜)
    (hΩ : HasOrthonormalCols Ω) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1) :
    (Ωᴴ*U)*(Ωᴴ*U)ᴴ+(Ωᴴ*V)*(Ωᴴ*V)ᴴ=1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = Ωᴴ*(U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ)*Ω := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
        Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hcomp, Matrix.mul_one]; exact hΩ

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.moorePenroseInverse_singularTripletMatrix
statement:
theorem IsSingularTripletFamily.moorePenroseInverse_singularTripletMatrix
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsSingularTripletFamily A U V σ) :
    moorePenroseInverse (singularTripletMatrix U V σ) = truncatedSingularInverse U V σ
proof:
:=
  h.isThinSVD_singularTripletMatrix.moorePenroseInverse_eq

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.truncatedSingularInverse_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hUA : Uᴴ * A = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ := by
    have he := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h.adjoint_mul_left
    have hs : star (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) = fun i => (σ i : 𝕜) := by
      funext i; simp [Pi.star_apply]
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose, hs] using he
  have hD : (diagonal fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜)) * diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) =
      (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [(h.pos i).ne']
    · simp [hij]
  rw [truncatedSingularInverse, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUA, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_assoc V, hD, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.truncatedSingularInverse_unique_minimizer
statement:
theorem IsSingularTripletFamily.truncatedSingularInverse_unique_minimizer
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsSingularTripletFamily A U V σ) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ b ∈ LinearMap.range V.mulVecLin ∧
    (∀ x ∈ LinearMap.range V.mulVecLin,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ b) - b)‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - b)‖) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ LinearMap.range V.mulVecLin,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - b)‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ b) - b)‖ →
          x = truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix m r 𝕜 := A * V
  have hc : IsThinSVD C U (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜) σ := by
    refine ⟨h.left_orth, hasOrthonormalCols_one, h.pos, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.mul_one]
    exact h.mul_right
  have hleft : moorePenroseInverse C * C = 1 := by
    simpa using hc.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq
  have hinj : Function.Injective C.mulVec := by
    intro x y he
    have he' := congrArg (fun v => moorePenroseInverse C *ᵥ v) he
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hleft, Matrix.one_mulVec] using he'
  have hG : (Cᴴ * C).PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.conjTranspose_mul_self C hinj
  have hn : Cᴴ * C * moorePenroseInverse C = Cᴴ := by
    have he := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul C)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian C).eq] at he
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using he
  let z := moorePenroseInverse C *ᵥ b
  have hz : (Cᴴ * C) *ᵥ z = Cᴴ *ᵥ b := by
    dsimp [z]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hn]
  have hmin := quadraticObjective_minimizer_of_posDef hG hz
  have hVz : V *ᵥ z = truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ b := by
    dsimp [z]
    rw [hc.moorePenroseInverse_eq]
    simp only [Matrix.one_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, truncatedSingularInverse]
  have hobj (w : r → 𝕜) : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ w - b)‖ ^ 2 =
      2 * quadraticObjective (Cᴴ * C) (Cᴴ *ᵥ b) w + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa [tikhonovObjective, tikhonovNormal] using
      tikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective C b 0 w
  refine ⟨⟨z, hVz⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨w, rfl⟩
    rw [← hVz]
    change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (V *ᵥ z) - b)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (V *ᵥ w) - b)‖
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec z A V, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec w A V]
    change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ z - b)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ w - b)‖
    have hsq : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ z - b)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ w - b)‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hobj z, hobj w]
      linarith [hmin.1 w]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ z - b)),
      norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ w - b))]
  · rintro x ⟨w, rfl⟩ hw
    rw [← hVz] at hw
    change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (V *ᵥ w) - b)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (V *ᵥ z) - b)‖ at hw
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec w A V, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec z A V] at hw
    change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ w - b)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ z - b)‖ at hw
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw 2
    rw [hobj w, hobj z] at hsq
    have hwz : w = z := hmin.2 w (by linarith)
    rw [hwz]
    exact hVz

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.norm_truncatedSingularInverse_data_sub_sq
statement:
theorem IsSingularTripletFamily.norm_truncatedSingularInverse_data_sub_sq
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsSingularTripletFamily A U V σ) (x : n → 𝕜) (e : m → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x + e) - x)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - V * Vᴴ) *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ e)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let noise := truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ e
  let bias := (1 - V * Vᴴ) *ᵥ x
  have hV : Vᴴ *ᵥ bias = 0 := by
    dsimp [bias]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, sub_self, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
  have hcross : star noise ⬝ᵥ bias = 0 := by
    dsimp [noise, truncatedSingularInverse]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hV, dotProduct_zero]
  have hother : star bias ⬝ᵥ noise = 0 := by
    have he := congrArg star hcross
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_dotProduct_star, star_star, star_zero, dotProduct_comm] using he
  have herr : truncatedSingularInverse U V σ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x + e) - x = noise - bias := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h.truncatedSingularInverse_mul]
    dsimp [noise, bias]
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    abel
  rw [herr]
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (noise - bias)‖ ^ 2 =
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 bias‖ ^ 2 + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 noise‖ ^ 2
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, star_sub, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
    hcross, hother, map_sub, map_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub, map_neg]
  ring

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.specNorm_truncatedSingularInverse
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncatedSingularInverse,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.left_orth,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.right_orth]
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    have hlast := h.pos (⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin k)
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr
      intro i
      rw [norm_inv, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos (h.pos i), ← one_div]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hlast (singularValues_antitone A (by have := i.isLt; omega))
    · have hi := norm_le_pi_norm (fun i : Fin k => ((singularValues A i)⁻¹ : 𝕜))
        (⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin k)
      simpa [norm_inv, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos hlast, one_div] using hi

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.norm_truncatedSingularInverse_data_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem IsSingularTripletFamily.norm_truncatedSingularInverse_data_sub_sq_le {k : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m (Fin k) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin k) 𝕜}
    (h : IsSingularTripletFamily A U V (fun i => singularValues A i)) (hk : 0 < k)
    (x : n → 𝕜) (e : m → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (truncatedSingularInverse U V (fun i => singularValues A i) *ᵥ
      (A *ᵥ x + e) - x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - V * Vᴴ) *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 e‖ ^ 2 / singularValues A (k - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.norm_truncatedSingularInverse_data_sub_sq]
  have hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (truncatedSingularInverse U V (fun i => singularValues A i) *ᵥ e)‖ ≤
      (1 / singularValues A (k - 1)) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 e‖ := by
    rw [← h.specNorm_truncatedSingularInverse hk]
    open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
      exact (truncatedSingularInverse U V (fun i => singularValues A i)).l2_opNorm_mulVec
        (WithLp.toLp 2 e)
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hb 2
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  simpa [mul_pow, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hs

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.zeroLimit_minimumPenaltyLeastSquares
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.zeroLimit_minimumPenaltyLeastSquares
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares A L b (generalTikhonovZeroLimit A X c b)
proof:
:= by
  let f : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n → ℝ := fun x => residualEnergy A b x.ofLp
  let g : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n → ℝ := fun x => residualEnergy L 0 x.ofLp
  have hf : Continuous f := by dsimp [f, residualEnergy]; fun_prop
  have hg : Continuous g := by dsimp [g, residualEnergy]; fun_prop
  have hh := vanishing_penalty_limit_minimizes hf hg
    (fun β => (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovZeroLimit A X c b))
    (h.tendsto_generalTikhonovFilter_zero b) (by
      intro β hβ z
      simpa [f, g, residualEnergy, generalTikhonovObjective] using
        h.generalTikhonovFilter_minimizer b hβ z.ofLp)
  constructor
  · intro z
    exact hh.1 (WithLp.toLp 2 z)
  · intro z hz
    apply hh.2 (WithLp.toLp 2 z)
    intro y
    exact hz y.ofLp

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.infinityLimit_penaltyKernelLeastSquares
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.infinityLimit_penaltyKernelLeastSquares
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares A L b (generalTikhonovInfinityLimit A X c s b)
proof:
:= by
  let f : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n → ℝ := fun x => residualEnergy A b x.ofLp
  let g : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n → ℝ := fun x => residualEnergy L 0 x.ofLp
  have hf : Continuous f := by dsimp [f, residualEnergy]; fun_prop
  have hg : Continuous g := by dsimp [g, residualEnergy]; fun_prop
  have hh := diverging_penalty_limit_minimizes hf hg
    (fun x => sq_nonneg _) (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    (fun β => (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovFilter A X c s b β) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (generalTikhonovInfinityLimit A X c s b))
    (h.tendsto_generalTikhonovFilter_infinity b) 0 (by simp [g, residualEnergy]) (by
      intro β hβ z
      simpa [f, g, residualEnergy, generalTikhonovObjective] using
        h.generalTikhonovFilter_minimizer b hβ z.ofLp)
  constructor
  · have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ generalTikhonovInfinityLimit A X c s b)‖ = 0 := by
      simpa [g, residualEnergy] using (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hh.1)
    exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)
  · intro z hz
    apply hh.2 (WithLp.toLp 2 z)
    simp [g, residualEnergy, hz]

name: NLAlib.IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares.unique
statement:
theorem IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares.unique {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜}
    {b : m → 𝕜} {x y : n → 𝕜} (hx : IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares A L b x)
    (hy : IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares A L b y)
    (hN : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, A *ᵥ v = 0 → L *ᵥ v = 0 → v = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hA := mulVec_eq_of_residualEnergy_minimizers A b x y hx.1 (hy.1 x)
  let z := (1 / 2 : 𝕜) • (x + y)
  have hf : residualEnergy A b y = residualEnergy A b x := le_antisymm (hy.1 x) (hx.1 y)
  have hm : residualEnergy A b z = residualEnergy A b x := by
    have he := residualEnergy_midpoint A b x y
    rw [hA] at he
    simp only [WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), add_zero] at he
    dsimp only [z]
    linarith
  have hz : ∀ w, residualEnergy A b z ≤ residualEnergy A b w := by
    intro w; rw [hm]; exact hx.1 w
  have hpen := hx.2 z hz
  have hpen' := hy.2 x hx.1
  have he := residualEnergy_midpoint L 0 x y
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (x - y))‖ = 0 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (L *ᵥ (x - y)))]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hN (x - y) hA (congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)))

name: NLAlib.IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares.unique
statement:
theorem IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares.unique {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜}
    {b : m → 𝕜} {x y : n → 𝕜} (hx : IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares A L b x)
    (hy : IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares A L b y)
    (hN : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, A *ᵥ v = 0 → L *ᵥ v = 0 → v = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hL : L *ᵥ (x - y) = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hx.1, hy.1, sub_self]
  have hmid : L *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) • (x + y)) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_add, hx.1, hy.1, add_zero, smul_zero]
  have hm := hx.2 _ hmid
  have hyx := hy.2 x hx.1
  have he := residualEnergy_midpoint A b x y
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y))‖ = 0 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y)))]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hN (x - y) (congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)) hL)

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonov_endpoints_unique
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.generalTikhonov_endpoints_unique
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜} {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s)
    (hN : ∀ v : n → 𝕜, A *ᵥ v = 0 → L *ᵥ v = 0 → v = 0) (b : m → 𝕜) :
    (IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares A L b (generalTikhonovZeroLimit A X c b) ∧
      ∀ z, IsMinimumPenaltyLeastSquares A L b z → z = generalTikhonovZeroLimit A X c b) ∧
    (IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares A L b (generalTikhonovInfinityLimit A X c s b) ∧
      ∀ z, IsPenaltyKernelLeastSquares A L b z → z = generalTikhonovInfinityLimit A X c s b)
proof:
:= by
  have hz := h.zeroLimit_minimumPenaltyLeastSquares b
  have hi := h.infinityLimit_penaltyKernelLeastSquares b
  exact ⟨⟨hz, fun z hzz => hzz.unique hz hN⟩, ⟨hi, fun z hzz => hzz.unique hi hN⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanLin_inverseOnRange
statement:
@[simp] theorem toEuclideanLin_inverseOnRange (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A))
    (y : LinearMap.range (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A)) :
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (inverseOnRange A hA y) = y.val
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((LinearEquiv.ofInjective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) hA).apply_symm_apply y)

name: NLAlib.injective_toEuclideanLin_of_posDef_gram
statement:
theorem injective_toEuclideanLin_of_posDef_gram (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hG : (Aᵀ * A).PosDef) : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : Function.Injective A.mulVec := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hG.isUnit
    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hxy]
  intro x y hxy
  apply WithLp.ofLp_injective
  apply hmul
  apply WithLp.toLp_injective 2
  exact hxy

name: NLAlib.norm_inverseOnRange_le_of_posDef_gram_sub
statement:
theorem norm_inverseOnRange_le_of_posDef_gram_sub
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A))
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hG : (Aᵀ * A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef) :
    ‖inverseOnRange A hA‖ ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt b
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt b := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hb
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) ?_
  intro y
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n := inverseOnRange A hA y
  have hAx : Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x = y.val := toEuclideanLin_inverseOnRange A hA y
  have hh := hG.posSemidef.quadForm_nonneg x.ofLp
  simp only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hh
  have hgram : x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ x.ofLp) =
      (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
  rw [hgram, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hh
  change 0 ≤ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x‖ ^ 2 - b * ‖x‖ ^ 2 at hh
  rw [hAx] at hh
  have hynorm : ‖y.val‖ = ‖y‖ := rfl
  rw [hynorm] at hh
  have hbound : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖y‖ / Real.sqrt b := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hsqrt).mpr
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hb.le, norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg y]
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_comm] using hbound

name: NLAlib.le_of_posSemidef_of_continuous_of_forall_posDef
statement:
theorem le_of_posSemidef_of_continuous_of_forall_posDef
    {f g : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g)
    (h : ∀ M : Matrix n n ℝ, M.PosDef → f M ≤ g M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : f A ≤ g A
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => A + t • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hfl : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => f (A + t • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (f A)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_smul, add_zero] using
      ((hf.comp hc).continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto.mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)
  have hgl : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => g (A + t • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (g A)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_smul, add_zero] using
      ((hg.comp hc).continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto.mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hfl hgl
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
  exact h _ (Matrix.PosDef.posSemidef_add hA (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul ht))

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_mul_comm
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_mul_comm (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    normalizedTrace (A*B) = normalizedTrace (B*A)
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedTrace_one [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] :
    normalizedTrace (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) = 1
