name: NLAlib.trace_mul_eq_sum_mul_star
statement:
theorem trace_mul_eq_sum_mul_star {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (A * B).trace = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * star (B i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [← hB.apply i j, star_star]

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_eq_trace_sqrt_conjTranspose_mul
statement:
theorem trace_mul_eq_trace_sqrt_conjTranspose_mul {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    (A * B).trace =
      ((CFC.sqrt A * CFC.sqrt B)ᴴ * (CFC.sqrt A * CFC.sqrt B)).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hSA := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hSB := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg B).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hAA := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg
  have hBB := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self B hB.nonneg
  symm
  calc
    _ = (CFC.sqrt B * A * CFC.sqrt B).trace := by
      rw [conjTranspose_mul, hSA, hSB]
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (CFC.sqrt B) (CFC.sqrt A),
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc (CFC.sqrt A), hAA, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (B * A).trace := by
      rw [trace_mul_cycle, hBB]
    _ = (A * B).trace := trace_mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ (A * B).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_mul_eq_trace_sqrt_conjTranspose_mul hA hB]
  exact (posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).trace_nonneg

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem trace_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : (A * B).trace = 0 ↔ A * B = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [trace_mul_eq_trace_sqrt_conjTranspose_mul hA hB,
      trace_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_zero_iff] at h
    calc
      A * B = CFC.sqrt A * (CFC.sqrt A * CFC.sqrt B) * CFC.sqrt B := by
        simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg,
          Matrix.mul_assoc A, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self B hB.nonneg]
      _ = 0 := by rw [h, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]
  · intro h
    rw [h, trace_zero]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_iff_trace_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem posSemidef_iff_trace_mul_nonneg {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.PosSemidef ↔ ∀ B : Matrix n n 𝕜, B.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ (A * B).trace
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun hA B hB => trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA hB
  · intro h
    apply PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg hA
    intro x
    have hx := h (vecMulVec x (star x)) (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star x)
    simpa only [mul_vecMulVec, trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm] using hx

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_le_trace_mul_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem trace_mul_le_trace_mul_of_posSemidef {A B C : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hBC : B ≤ C) : (A * B).trace ≤ (A * C).trace
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA (Matrix.le_iff.mp hBC)
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub, trace_sub, sub_nonneg] using h

name: NLAlib.psd_trace_pairing_characterizations
statement:
theorem psd_trace_pairing_characterizations {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (A.PosSemidef ↔ ∀ B : Matrix n n 𝕜, B.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ (A * B).trace) ∧
    (∀ B : Matrix n n 𝕜, A.PosSemidef → B.PosSemidef →
      ((A * B).trace = 0 ↔ A * B = 0)) ∧
    (∀ B C : Matrix n n 𝕜, A.PosSemidef → B ≤ C →
      (A * B).trace ≤ (A * C).trace)
proof:
:=
  ⟨posSemidef_iff_trace_mul_nonneg hA,
    fun _ hA hB => trace_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef hA hB,
    fun _ _ hA hBC => trace_mul_le_trace_mul_of_posSemidef hA hBC⟩

name: NLAlib.frobSq_vecMulVec_star
statement:
theorem frobSq_vecMulVec_star (u : m → 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) :
    frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply, norm_mul,
    norm_star, mul_pow, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_vecMulVec_star
statement:
theorem frobInner_vecMulVec_star (u : m → 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) (M : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) M = RCLike.re (star u ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v))
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply, star_mul, star_star,
    dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.rankOneCancel_mulVec
statement:
theorem rankOneCancel_mulVec (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) : rankOneCancel C v *ᵥ v = -(C *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  have hdot : star v ⬝ᵥ v = (1 : 𝕜) := by
    have he : inner 𝕜 (WithLp.toLp 2 v) (WithLp.toLp 2 v) = (1 : 𝕜) := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hv]; norm_num
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm] using he
  rw [rankOneCancel, Matrix.neg_mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, hdot,
    MulOpposite.op_one, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_rankOneCancel
statement:
theorem frobSq_rankOneCancel (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    frobSq (rankOneCancel C v) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rankOneCancel, frobSq_neg, frobSq_vecMulVec_star, hv, one_pow, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_correction_decomposition
statement:
theorem frobSq_correction_decomposition (C D : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) (hD : D *ᵥ v = -(C *ᵥ v)) :
    frobSq D = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 + frobSq (D - rankOneCancel C v)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (D - rankOneCancel C v) *ᵥ v = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, hD, rankOneCancel_mulVec C v hv, sub_self]
  have hi : frobInner (rankOneCancel C v) (D - rankOneCancel C v) = 0 := by
    change frobInner (-Matrix.vecMulVec (C *ᵥ v) (star v)) (D - rankOneCancel C v) = 0
    rw [frobInner_neg_left, frobInner_vecMulVec_star, hz,
      dotProduct_zero, map_zero, neg_zero]
  have he := frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero (rankOneCancel C v) (D - rankOneCancel C v) hi
  rw [add_sub_cancel, frobSq_rankOneCancel C v hv] at he
  exact he

name: NLAlib.frobSq_correction_minimum_iff
statement:
theorem frobSq_correction_minimum_iff (C D : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) (hD : D *ᵥ v = -(C *ᵥ v)) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 ≤ frobSq D ∧
      (frobSq D = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 ↔ D = rankOneCancel C v)
proof:
:= by
  have he := frobSq_correction_decomposition C D v hv hD
  constructor
  · linarith [frobSq_nonneg (D - rankOneCancel C v)]
  · constructor
    · intro hh
      have hz : frobSq (D - rankOneCancel C v) = 0 := by linarith
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz)
    · rintro rfl
      exact frobSq_rankOneCancel C v hv

name: NLAlib.star_mulVec_dotProduct
statement:
private theorem star_mulVec_dotProduct {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (M : Matrix p q 𝕜) (v : q → 𝕜) (w : p → 𝕜) :
    star (M *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ w = star v ⬝ᵥ (Mᴴ *ᵥ w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.star_sumElim
statement:
private theorem star_sumElim (y : m → 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    star (Sum.elim y x) = Sum.elim (star y) (star x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; cases i <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix m m 𝕜} {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {C : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hM : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef) (z : m → 𝕜)
    (hz : A *ᵥ z = 0) : Bᴴ *ᵥ z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq : star (Sum.elim z (0 : n → 𝕜)) ⬝ᵥ
      Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C *ᵥ Sum.elim z (0 : n → 𝕜) = 0 := by
    simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, hz, star_sumElim, sumElim_dotProduct_sumElim]
  have hv := (hM.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff (Sum.elim z (0 : n → 𝕜))).mp hq
  have h := congrArg (fun v : m ⊕ n → 𝕜 => v ∘ Sum.inr) hv
  simpa [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec] using h

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix m m 𝕜} {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {C : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hM : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef) :
    (1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := hM.submatrix (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n)
  have hAh : Aᴴ = A := hA.isHermitian.eq
  have hAdh : (moorePenroseInverse A)ᴴ = moorePenroseInverse A :=
    (Matrix.IsHermitian.moorePenroseInverse hA.isHermitian).eq
  have hRowCol : moorePenroseInverse A * A = A * moorePenroseInverse A := by
    have h := (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A).eq
    rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hAh, hAdh] at h
  let F : Matrix m m 𝕜 := 1 - moorePenroseInverse A * A
  have hFh : Fᴴ = F := by
    simp only [F, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
      (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq]
  have hAF : A * F = 0 := by
    simp only [F]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul, sub_self]
  have hFid : F * F = F := by
    simp only [F]
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one, show (moorePenroseInverse A * A) * (moorePenroseInverse A * A) =
        moorePenroseInverse A * A from moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem A]
    abel
  have hFB : F * B = 0 := by
    apply Matrix.ext
    intro i j
    let z : m → 𝕜 := F *ᵥ B.col j
    have hz : A *ᵥ z = 0 := by
      simp only [z]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAF, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
    have hBz := conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef hM z hz
    have hDot : star (B.col j) ⬝ᵥ z = 0 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.col,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.star_apply] using congrFun hBz j
    have hFz : F *ᵥ z = z := by
      simp only [z]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hFid]
    have hzz : star z ⬝ᵥ z = 0 := by
      calc
        star z ⬝ᵥ z = star (B.col j) ⬝ᵥ (Fᴴ *ᵥ z) := star_mulVec_dotProduct F (B.col j) z
        _ = star (B.col j) ⬝ᵥ z := by rw [hFh, hFz]
        _ = 0 := hDot
    have hz0 : z = 0 := dotProduct_star_self_eq_zero.mp hzz
    simpa [z, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.col, dotProduct] using congrFun hz0 i
  simpa only [F, hRowCol] using hFB

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square
statement:
theorem dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hRange : A * moorePenroseInverse A * B = B)
    (y : m → 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    star (Sum.elim y x) ⬝ᵥ Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C *ᵥ Sum.elim y x =
      star (y + moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) ⬝ᵥ
        A *ᵥ (y + moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) +
      star x ⬝ᵥ generalizedSchurComplement A B C *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [generalizedSchurComplement]
  set w := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x) with hw
  have hAdh : (moorePenroseInverse A)ᴴ = moorePenroseInverse A :=
    (Matrix.IsHermitian.moorePenroseInverse hA).eq
  have hAw : A *ᵥ w = B *ᵥ x := by
    rw [hw, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hRange]
  have hRange' : Bᴴ * moorePenroseInverse A * A = Bᴴ := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hRange
    rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hAdh, hA.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc] at h
  have hCross : star w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) = star x ⬝ᵥ (Bᴴ *ᵥ y) := by
    rw [hw, star_mulVec_dotProduct, hAdh, star_mulVec_dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hRange']
  have hTail : star w ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x) = star x ⬝ᵥ (Bᴴ * moorePenroseInverse A * B) *ᵥ x := by
    rw [hw, star_mulVec_dotProduct, hAdh, star_mulVec_dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, star_sumElim, sumElim_dotProduct_sumElim,
    Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.sub_mulVec, star_add, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
    dotProduct_sub, hAw, hCross, hTail]
  ring

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff
statement:
theorem posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef ↔
      A.PosSemidef ∧ (1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B = 0 ∧
        (generalizedSchurComplement A B C).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hM
    have hA : A.PosSemidef := hM.submatrix (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n)
    have hC : C.PosSemidef := hM.submatrix (Sum.inr : n → m ⊕ n)
    have hCompat := one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef hM
    have hRange : A * moorePenroseInverse A * B = B := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hCompat
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hCompat).symm
    refine ⟨hA, hCompat, ?_⟩
    rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    refine ⟨hC.isHermitian.sub
      ((Matrix.PosSemidef.moorePenroseInverse hA).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B).isHermitian, ?_⟩
    intro x
    have h := hM.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Sum.elim (-(moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x))) x)
    rw [dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square A B C hA.isHermitian hRange]
      at h
    simpa only [neg_add_cancel, Matrix.zero_mulVec, star_zero, zero_dotProduct, zero_add] using h
  · rintro ⟨hA, hCompat, hS⟩
    have hRange : A * moorePenroseInverse A * B = B := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hCompat
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hCompat).symm
    have hCorr := (Matrix.PosSemidef.moorePenroseInverse hA).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
    have hC : C.IsHermitian := by
      simpa only [generalizedSchurComplement, sub_add_cancel] using
        hS.isHermitian.add hCorr.isHermitian
    rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    refine ⟨hA.isHermitian.fromBlocks (by simp) hC, ?_⟩
    intro z
    have hz : z = Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) := by ext i; cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hz, dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square A B C hA.isHermitian hRange]
    exact add_nonneg (hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg _) (hS.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.isLeast_generalizedSchurComplement_quadratic
statement:
theorem isLeast_generalizedSchurComplement_quadratic
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hM : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    IsLeast (Set.range (fun y : m → 𝕜 =>
      star (Sum.elim y x) ⬝ᵥ Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C *ᵥ Sum.elim y x))
      (star x ⬝ᵥ generalizedSchurComplement A B C *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hCompat, _⟩ := (posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff A B C).mp hM
  have hRange : A * moorePenroseInverse A * B = B := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hCompat
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hCompat).symm
  constructor
  · refine ⟨-(moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)), ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square A B C hA.isHermitian hRange]
    simp
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square A B C hA.isHermitian hRange]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_generalizedSchurComplement_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_generalizedSchurComplement_mulVec_le {A : Matrix m m 𝕜} {B : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {C : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef) (x : n → 𝕜) (y : m → 𝕜) :
    star x ⬝ᵥ (generalizedSchurComplement A B C *ᵥ x) ≤
      star (Sum.elim y x) ⬝ᵥ (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C *ᵥ Sum.elim y x)
proof:
:=
  (isLeast_generalizedSchurComplement_quadratic A B C hM x).2 ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_generalizedSchurComplement_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_generalizedSchurComplement_mulVec_eq {A : Matrix m m 𝕜} {B : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {C : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    star x ⬝ᵥ (generalizedSchurComplement A B C *ᵥ x) =
      star (Sum.elim (-(moorePenroseInverse A * B) *ᵥ x) x) ⬝ᵥ
        (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C *ᵥ Sum.elim (-(moorePenroseInverse A * B) *ᵥ x) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hCompat, _⟩ := (posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff A B C).mp hM
  have hRange : A * moorePenroseInverse A * B = B := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hCompat
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hCompat).symm
  rw [Matrix.neg_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    dotProduct_fromBlocks_eq_generalizedSchurComplement_square A B C hA.isHermitian hRange]
  simp

name: NLAlib.generalizedSchurComplement_nonneg
statement:
theorem generalizedSchurComplement_nonneg
    {A : Matrix m m 𝕜} {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {C : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hM : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C).PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ generalizedSchurComplement A B C
proof:
:=
  ((posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff A B C).mp hM).2.2.nonneg

name: NLAlib.generalizedSchurComplement_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  have hP : (moorePenroseInverse A)ᴴ = moorePenroseInverse A :=
    (Matrix.IsHermitian.moorePenroseInverse hA.isHermitian).eq
  have h : C - generalizedSchurComplement A B C =
      (moorePenroseInverse A * B)ᴴ * A * (moorePenroseInverse A * B) := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hP, generalizedSchurComplement, sub_sub_cancel]
    conv_lhs => rw [← moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [h]
  exact hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same _

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_equiv_eq_sign_mul
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_equiv_eq_sign_mul {n r : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (er ec : r ≃ n) :
    (A.submatrix er ec).det =
      (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm) : ℝ) * A.det
proof:
:= by
  have h : A.submatrix er ec = (A.submatrix er er).submatrix id (ec.trans er.symm) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, id_eq]
  rw [h, Matrix.det_permute', Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]

name: NLAlib.det_inverse_complement_minor_eq_sign_mul_div
statement:
theorem det_inverse_complement_minor_eq_sign_mul_div {n p q : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A.det) (er ec : (p ⊕ q) ≃ n) :
    (A⁻¹.submatrix (fun i : q => ec (Sum.inr i)) (fun j : q => er (Sum.inr j))).det =
      (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm) : ℝ) *
        (A.submatrix (fun i : p => er (Sum.inl i)) (fun j : p => ec (Sum.inl j))).det / A.det
proof:
:= by
  let M := A.submatrix er ec
  let J := A⁻¹.submatrix ec er
  have hDet : M.det = (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm) : ℝ) * A.det :=
    det_submatrix_equiv_eq_sign_mul A er ec
  have hSign : (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Units.ne_zero (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm)))
  have hM : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hDet ▸ mul_ne_zero hSign hA.ne_zero)
  have hMJ : M * J = 1 := by
    change A.submatrix er ec * A⁻¹.submatrix ec er = 1
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hA,
      Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  have hInv : M⁻¹ = J := by
    calc
      M⁻¹ = M⁻¹ * (M * J) := by rw [hMJ, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = J := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M hM, Matrix.one_mul]
  have h := det_inverse_bottomRight_eq_topLeft_div_det M hM
  rw [hInv] at h
  change (A⁻¹.submatrix (fun i : q => ec (Sum.inr i)) (fun j : q => er (Sum.inr j))).det =
    (A.submatrix (fun i : p => er (Sum.inl i)) (fun j : p => ec (Sum.inl j))).det / M.det at h
  rw [h, hDet]
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm)) with hs | hs
  · simp [hs]
  · simp [hs]
    exact (div_neg _).trans (neg_div _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.complementary_nullities_properties
statement:
theorem complementary_nullities_properties {n : Type u} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A.det) :
    (∀ (p q : n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q],
      Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (A.toBlock p q).mulVecLin) =
        Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).mulVecLin)) ∧
    (∀ (p q : n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q],
      Fintype.card {j // q j} - (A.toBlock p q).rank =
        Fintype.card {j // ¬p j} - (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬q i) (fun i => ¬p i)).rank) ∧
    (∀ (p : Type v) (q : Type w) [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
      (er ec : (p ⊕ q) ≃ n),
      (A⁻¹.submatrix (fun i : q => ec (Sum.inr i)) (fun j : q => er (Sum.inr j))).det =
        (Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.trans er.symm) : ℝ) *
          (A.submatrix (fun i : p => er (Sum.inl i)) (fun j : p => ec (Sum.inl j))).det / A.det) ∧
    (∀ (m : Type u) (r : Type v) (l : Type w) [Fintype m] [Fintype r] [Fintype l]
      [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq r] [DecidableEq l]
      (P : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m r ℝ) (C : Matrix l m ℝ) (D : Matrix l r ℝ),
      IsUnit P.det → (Matrix.fromBlocks P B C D).rank = P.rank + (D - C * P⁻¹ * B).rank)
proof:
:=
  ⟨finrank_ker_toBlock_eq_finrank_ker_inverse_complement A hA,
    card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement A hA,
    (by intros; exact det_inverse_complement_minor_eq_sign_mul_div A hA _ _),
    (by intros; exact rank_fromBlocks_eq_rank_add_rank_schur _ _ _ _ ‹_›)⟩

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.adjugate
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.adjugate {A : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    A.adjugate.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [← spectralGramRows_adjoint_mul hA, Matrix.adjugate_mul_distrib,
    ← Matrix.adjugate_conjTranspose]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose _

name: NLAlib.adjugate_gram_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem adjugate_gram_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (hdet : (Xᴴ * X).det = 0) : (Xᴴ * X).adjugate * Xᴴ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_zero X (Xᴴ * X).adjugate).mp
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul, hdet, zero_smul]

name: NLAlib.det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate
statement:
theorem det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate {A : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    A.det • A⁻¹ = A.adjugate
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', smul_smul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA).ne_zero, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite
statement:
theorem det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) :
    A.det • A⁻¹ = A.adjugate - if A.det = 0 then A.adjugate else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdet : A.det = 0
  · simp [hdet]
  · have hA : IsUnit A := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
    rw [det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate hA, if_neg hdet, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.adjugate_gram_mul_conjTranspose_eq_det_smul_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem adjugate_gram_mul_conjTranspose_eq_det_smul_moorePenroseInverse
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) :
    (Xᴴ * X).adjugate * Xᴴ = (Xᴴ * X).det • moorePenroseInverse X
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdet : (Xᴴ * X).det = 0
  · rw [adjugate_gram_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero X hdet, hdet, zero_smul]
  · have hG : IsUnit (Xᴴ * X) :=
      (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
    rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL X hG, pinvL, ← Matrix.smul_mul,
      det_smul_inv_eq_adjugate hG]

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_isHermitian
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_isHermitian (S : Finset n) :
    (coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint
  change star (fun i => if i ∈ S then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) = _
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.star_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_mul_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_mul_apply (S : Finset n) (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (i : n) (j : d) :
    ((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X) i j = if i ∈ S then X i j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSelector, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_mul_self
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_mul_self (S : Finset n) :
    (coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * coordinateSelector S = coordinateSelector S
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [coordinateSelector_mul_apply]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · simp [hi]
  · by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [coordinateSelector, hi]
    · simp [coordinateSelector, hij]

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateSelector_univ :
    coordinateSelector (Finset.univ : Finset n) = (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateSelector]

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_compl
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_compl (S : Finset n) :
    (coordinateSelector Sᶜ : Matrix n n 𝕜) = 1 - coordinateSelector S
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> simp [coordinateSelector, hi]
  · simp [coordinateSelector, hij]

name: NLAlib.rank_add_le
statement:
theorem rank_add_le {m n K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A B : Matrix m n K) : (A + B).rank ≤ A.rank + B.rank
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (A + B).mulVecLin) ≤
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin) +
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin)
  rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_add]
  have h : LinearMap.range (A.mulVecLin + B.mulVecLin) ≤
      LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ⊔ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin :=
    LinearMap.range_add_le A.mulVecLin B.mulVecLin
  exact (Submodule.finrank_mono h).trans
    (Submodule.finrank_add_le_finrank_add_finrank
      (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin) (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin))

name: NLAlib.apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero {A : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {i : m} (h : A i i = 0) (j : m) : A j i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : star (Pi.single i 1 : m → 𝕜) ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ Pi.single i 1 = 0 := by
    simp [h]
  have := congrFun ((hA.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff _).1 h0) j
  simpa using this

name: NLAlib.apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero' {A : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {i : m} (h : A i i = 0) (j : m) : A i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : A i j = star (A j i) := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hA.isHermitian i) j
    simpa using this.symm
  rw [hs, apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA h j, star_zero]

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_matrix_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_matrix_rank_eq_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [Fintype n] {R : Matrix m n K} (hR : R.rank = 0) : R = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : LinearMap.range R.mulVecLin = ⊥ := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp hR
  ext i j
  have hj : R.col j ∈ LinearMap.range R.mulVecLin := by
    rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [hrange, Submodule.mem_bot] at hj
  exact congrFun hj i

name: NLAlib.rank_fromBlocks_zero_zero_eq
statement:
theorem rank_fromBlocks_zero_zero_eq {K m n p q : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (A : Matrix m p K) (D : Matrix n q K) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D).rank = A.rank + D.rank
proof:
:= by
  let e : LinearMap.ker (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D).mulVecLin ≃ₗ[K]
      (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin × LinearMap.ker D.mulVecLin) :=
    { toFun := fun x =>
        (⟨fun j => x.val (Sum.inl j), by
          funext i
          have h := congrFun x.property (Sum.inl i)
          simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
            Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
            Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using h⟩,
        ⟨fun j => x.val (Sum.inr j), by
          funext i
          have h := congrFun x.property (Sum.inr i)
          simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
            Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
            Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, Pi.zero_apply] using h⟩)
      invFun := fun x => ⟨Sum.elim x.1.val x.2.val, by
        funext i
        cases i with
        | inl i =>
          have h := congrFun x.1.property i
          simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
            Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
            Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Sum.elim_inl, Pi.zero_apply] using h
        | inr i =>
          have h := congrFun x.2.property i
          simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
            Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
            Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.zero_apply] using h⟩
      left_inv := by intro x; apply Subtype.ext; funext i; cases i <;> rfl
      right_inv := by intro x; apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext <;> rfl
      map_add' := by intro x y; rfl
      map_smul' := by intro c x; rfl }
  have hK := e.finrank_eq
  rw [Module.finrank_prod] at hK
  have hA := A.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hD := D.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hAD := (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [Module.finrank_pi] at hA hD hAD
  rw [Fintype.card_sum] at hAD
  change A.rank + _ = _ at hA
  change D.rank + _ = _ at hD
  change (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D).rank + _ = _ at hAD
  omega

name: NLAlib.rank_fromBlocks_eq_rank_add_rank_schur
statement:
theorem rank_fromBlocks_eq_rank_add_rank_schur {m n l : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq l]
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix l m ℝ) (D : Matrix l n ℝ)
    (hA : IsUnit A.det) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).rank = A.rank + (D - C * A⁻¹ * B).rank
proof:
:= by
  let := A.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hA
  have hFactor := Matrix.fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁ A B C D
  rw [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] at hFactor
  have hLeft : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) 0 (C * A⁻¹)
      (1 : Matrix l l ℝ)).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, Matrix.det_one, Matrix.det_one, one_mul]
    exact isUnit_one
  have hRight : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) (A⁻¹ * B) 0
      (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.det_one, Matrix.det_one, one_mul]
    exact isUnit_one
  rw [hFactor, Matrix.rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det _ _ hRight,
    Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det _ _ hLeft, rank_fromBlocks_zero_zero_eq]

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : (A * moorePenroseInverse A).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _) ?_
  calc A.rank = (A * moorePenroseInverse A * A).rank := by rw [mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]
    _ ≤ (A * moorePenroseInverse A).rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem trace_mul_moorePenroseInverse [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    (A * moorePenroseInverse A).trace = (A.rank : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A),
    rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse]

name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (hQY : Q * (Qᴴ * Y) = Y) (hr : Fintype.card q ≤ Y.rank) :
    Q * Qᴴ = Y * moorePenroseInverse Y
proof:
:= by
  set P₁ := Q * Qᴴ with hP₁
  set P₂ := Y * moorePenroseInverse Y with hP₂
  have hP₁s : P₁ᴴ = P₁ := Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Q
  have hP₂s : P₂ᴴ = P₂ := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian Y
  have hP₁i : P₁ * P₁ = P₁ := mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose hQ
  have hP₂i : P₂ * P₂ = P₂ := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem Y
  have h12 : P₁ * P₂ = P₂ := by
    rw [hP₁, hP₂, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc Q, hQY]
  have h21 : P₂ * P₁ = P₂ := by
    have := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h12
    rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hP₁s, hP₂s] at this
  set M := P₁ - P₂ with hM
  have hMs : Mᴴ = M := by rw [hM, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, hP₁s, hP₂s]
  have hMi : M * M = M := by
    rw [hM, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, hP₁i, h12, h21, hP₂i]
    abel
  have htr1 : P₁.trace = (Fintype.card q : 𝕜) := by
    rw [hP₁, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_one]
  have htr2 : P₂.trace = (Y.rank : 𝕜) := trace_mul_moorePenroseInverse Y
  have hfrob : frobSq M = (Fintype.card q : ℝ) - Y.rank := by
    rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, hMs, hMi, hM, Matrix.trace_sub, htr1, htr2, map_sub,
      RCLike.natCast_re, RCLike.natCast_re]
  have hle : frobSq M ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hfrob]
    have : ((Fintype.card q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y.rank := by exact_mod_cast hr
    linarith
  have hM0 : M = 0 := (frobSq_eq_zero_iff M).1 (le_antisymm hle (frobSq_nonneg M))
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 hM0

name: NLAlib.inv_self_mul_conjTranspose_apply_self
statement:
theorem inv_self_mul_conjTranspose_apply_self {n k : ℕ}
    (G : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin k) 𝕜) (i : Fin (n+1))
    (hH : IsUnit (G.submatrix i.succAbove id * (G.submatrix i.succAbove id)ᴴ)) :
    (G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i = (gramRowResidual (G.submatrix i.succAbove id) (star (G i)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  set H := G.submatrix i.succAbove id with hHdef
  set g := star (G i) with hg
  set M := H*Hᴴ with hM
  set c := M⁻¹*ᵥ(H*ᵥg) with hc
  set s := star g ⬝ᵥ g - star (H*ᵥg) ⬝ᵥ c with hs
  set A := G*Gᴴ with hA
  set w := g-Hᴴ*ᵥc with hw
  set x : Fin (n+1) → 𝕜 := Fin.insertNth i 1 (-c) with hx
  have hdet : M.det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hH)
  have hHw : H*ᵥw=0 := by
    rw [hw, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hM, hc, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_self]
  have hgw : G i ⬝ᵥ w=s := by
    have hgi : G i=star g := by simp [hg]
    rw [hgi, hw, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose, star_star]
    simp only [hs, hg, star_star]
  have hGx : Gᴴ*ᵥx=w := by
    funext l
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hw, hx,
      Pi.sub_apply, hg, hHdef, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id, Pi.star_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i]
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hGw : G*ᵥw=Pi.single i s := by
    funext b
    induction b using Fin.succAboveCases i with
    | x =>
      simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
      rw [← hgw]
      rfl
    | p a =>
      rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Fin.succAbove_ne i a)]
      have h := congrFun hHw a
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, hHdef] using h
  have hAx : A*ᵥx=Pi.single i s := by
    rw [hA, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hGx, hGw]
  have hadj : A.adjugate i i=M.det := by
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
    have he : A.submatrix i.succAbove i.succAbove=M := by
      ext a b
      simp [hA, hM, hHdef, Matrix.mul_apply]
    rw [he, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hdetA : A.det=s*M.det := by
    have h1 : A.adjugate*ᵥ(A*ᵥx)=A.det•x := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.adjugate_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [hAx] at h1
    have h2 := congrFun h1 i
    have h3 : (A.adjugate*ᵥPi.single i s) i=A.adjugate i i*s := by
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [h3, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hx, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, mul_one, hadj] at h2
    rw [← h2, mul_comm]
  change A⁻¹ i i=s⁻¹
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', hdetA, hadj,
    mul_inv, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hdet, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.coeff_card_det_one_add_X_smul
statement:
private theorem coeff_card_det_one_add_X_smul (M : Matrix r r R) :
    (Matrix.det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).coeff (Fintype.card r) = M.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors]
  simp only [← Finset.card_univ (α := r), Finset.powersetCard_self, Finset.sum_singleton]
  let e : (Finset.univ : Finset r) ≃ r := Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv (fun _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
  exact Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e M

name: NLAlib.det_mul_eq_sum_det_submatrix_mul_det_submatrix
statement:
theorem det_mul_eq_sum_det_submatrix_mul_det_submatrix (A : Matrix r k R) (B : Matrix k r R) :
    (A * B).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset k r,
      (A.submatrix id (sizedSubsetIndex S)).det *
        (B.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) id).det
proof:
:= by
  have hPoly := Matrix.det_one_add_mul_comm ((X : R[X]) • A.map C) (B.map C)
  have hCoeff := congrArg (fun p : R[X] => p.coeff (Fintype.card r)) hPoly
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, ← Matrix.map_mul] at hCoeff
  rw [coeff_card_det_one_add_X_smul,
    Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors] at hCoeff
  rw [hCoeff]
  rw [← Finset.sum_attach]
  let e : {S // S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset k).powersetCard (Fintype.card r)} ≃
      SizedSubset k r := Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun S => by simp
  rw [← e.sum_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  let T := e S
  let eT : T.val ≃ r := Fintype.equivOfCardEq ((Fintype.card_coe T.val).trans T.property)
  have hSub : (B * A).submatrix (Subtype.val : T.val → k) (Subtype.val : T.val → k) =
      B.submatrix (Subtype.val : T.val → k) id * A.submatrix id (Subtype.val : T.val → k) := by
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl] using (Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv B A
      (Subtype.val : T.val → k) (Equiv.refl r) (Subtype.val : T.val → k)).symm
  change ((B * A).submatrix (Subtype.val : T.val → k) (Subtype.val : T.val → k)).det = _
  rw [hSub, ← Matrix.det_reindex_self eT]
  rw [Matrix.reindex_apply, ← Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv _ _ eT.symm (Equiv.refl r) eT.symm]
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix, Function.comp_id]
  rw [Matrix.det_mul]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_mul_eq_sum_minors
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_mul_eq_sum_minors (A : Matrix m k R) (B : Matrix k n R)
    (α : r → m) (β : r → n) :
    ((A * B).submatrix α β).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset k r,
      (A.submatrix α (sizedSubsetIndex S)).det *
        (B.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) β).det
proof:
:= by
  have h := det_mul_eq_sum_det_submatrix_mul_det_submatrix
    (A.submatrix α id) (B.submatrix id β)
  have hProd : A.submatrix α id * B.submatrix id β = (A * B).submatrix α β :=
    Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv A B α (Equiv.refl k) β
  simpa only [hProd, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix,
    Function.comp_id, Function.id_comp] using h

name: NLAlib.compoundMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem compoundMatrix_mul (A : Matrix m k R) (B : Matrix k n R) :
    compoundMatrix r (A * B) = compoundMatrix r A * compoundMatrix r B
proof:
:= by
  ext S T
  exact det_submatrix_mul_eq_sum_minors A B (sizedSubsetIndex S) (sizedSubsetIndex T)

name: NLAlib.det_transpose_mul_self_eq_sum_det_sq
statement:
theorem det_transpose_mul_self_eq_sum_det_sq [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m r ℝ) :
    (Aᵀ * A).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset m r,
      (A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) id).det ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_mul_eq_sum_det_submatrix_mul_det_submatrix]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.det_transpose, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.cauchy_binet_properties
statement:
theorem cauchy_binet_properties [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] :
    (∀ (A : Matrix m k R) (B : Matrix k n R) (α : r → m) (β : r → n),
      ((A * B).submatrix α β).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset k r,
        (A.submatrix α (sizedSubsetIndex S)).det *
          (B.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) β).det) ∧
    (∀ (A : Matrix m k R) (B : Matrix k n R),
      compoundMatrix r (A * B) = compoundMatrix r A * compoundMatrix r B) ∧
    (∀ A : Matrix m r ℝ, (Aᵀ * A).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset m r,
      (A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) id).det ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨det_submatrix_mul_eq_sum_minors, compoundMatrix_mul,
    det_transpose_mul_self_eq_sum_det_sq⟩

name: NLAlib.pinvL_mul
statement:
theorem pinvL_mul [DecidableEq n] {G : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (h : IsUnit (Gᴴ * G)) : pinvL G * G = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinvL
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h)]

name: NLAlib.mul_pinvR
statement:
theorem mul_pinvR [DecidableEq m] {G : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (h : IsUnit (G * Gᴴ)) : G * pinvR G = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinvR
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h)]

name: NLAlib.pinvL_conjTranspose
statement: theorem pinvL_conjTranspose [DecidableEq n] (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) : (pinvL G)ᴴ = pinvR Gᴴ
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinvL pinvR
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.pinvR_conjTranspose
statement: theorem pinvR_conjTranspose [DecidableEq m] (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) : (pinvR G)ᴴ = pinvL Gᴴ
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinvL pinvR
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.pinvL_transpose

name: NLAlib.isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card [DecidableEq m]
    (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hG : Matrix.rank G = Fintype.card m) : IsUnit (G * Gᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have htop : LinearMap.range (G * Gᴴ).mulVecLin = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    change Matrix.rank (G * Gᴴ) = Module.finrank 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)
    rw [Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose, hG, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
  exact Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.mp (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp htop)

proof:
:=
  mul_pinvR (isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card G hG)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_pinvR_eq_trace_inv
statement:
theorem frobSq_pinvR_eq_trace_inv [DecidableEq m] (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (pinvR G) = RCLike.re ((G * Gᴴ)⁻¹).trace
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsUnit (G * Gᴴ)
  · have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h
    have hherm : ((G * Gᴴ)⁻¹)ᴴ = (G * Gᴴ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    unfold frobSq pinvR
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hherm,
      Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc G, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd, Matrix.mul_one]
  · have h0 : (G * Gᴴ)⁻¹ = 0 :=
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit _ (by rwa [← Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det])
    have hp : pinvR G = 0 := by simp [pinvR, h0]
    rw [h0, hp, Matrix.trace_zero, frobSq_zero, map_zero]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_pinvL_eq_trace_inv
statement:
theorem frobSq_pinvL_eq_trace_inv [DecidableEq n] (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (pinvL G) = RCLike.re ((Gᴴ * G)⁻¹).trace
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsUnit (Gᴴ * G)
  · have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h
    have hherm : ((Gᴴ * G)⁻¹)ᴴ = (Gᴴ * G)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    unfold frobSq pinvL
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hherm,
      Matrix.trace_mul_comm, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Gᴴ, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  · have h0 : (Gᴴ * G)⁻¹ = 0 :=
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit _ (by rwa [← Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det])
    have hp : pinvL G = 0 := by simp [pinvL, h0]
    rw [h0, hp, Matrix.trace_zero, frobSq_zero, map_zero]

name: NLAlib.quadraticObjective_add_kernel_of_stationary
statement:
theorem quadraticObjective_add_kernel_of_stationary {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (Z : Matrix n r 𝕜) (f x : n → 𝕜)
    (hstat : Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ x) = 0) (y : r → 𝕜) :
    quadraticObjective H f (x + Z *ᵥ y) = quadraticObjective H f x +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * RCLike.re (quadForm (reducedHessian H Z) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : star f ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ y) = star x ⬝ᵥ (H *ᵥ (Z *ᵥ y)) := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => star v ⬝ᵥ y) hstat
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hh
    simp only [star_sub, sub_dotProduct, star_zero, zero_dotProduct] at hh
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hH.eq] at hh
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hh
  have hq := hH.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul x (Z *ᵥ y) 1 1
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul, one_pow, one_mul] at hq
  have he : quadForm (reducedHessian H Z) y = quadForm H (Z *ᵥ y) :=
    quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul H Z y
  unfold quadraticObjective
  rw [hq, dotProduct_add, map_add, hc, he]
  ring

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.quadratic_minimizer_of_reduced_posDef
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.quadratic_minimizer_of_reduced_posDef
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hG : (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef)
    (f x : n → 𝕜) (hstat : Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ x) = 0) :
    (∀ y, B *ᵥ y = B *ᵥ x → quadraticObjective H f x ≤ quadraticObjective H f y) ∧
      ∀ y, B *ᵥ y = B *ᵥ x →
        quadraticObjective H f y ≤ quadraticObjective H f x → y = x
proof:
:= by
  have he (y : n → 𝕜) (hy : B *ᵥ y = B *ᵥ x) :
      quadraticObjective H f y = quadraticObjective H f x +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * RCLike.re (quadForm (reducedHessian H Z) (Zᴴ *ᵥ (y - x))) := by
    have hc := hZ.mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec (v := y - x)
      (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hy, sub_self])
    simpa only [hc, add_sub_cancel] using
      quadraticObjective_add_kernel_of_stationary hH Z f x hstat (Zᴴ *ᵥ (y - x))
  constructor
  · intro y hy
    rw [he y hy]
    have hn := hG.posSemidef.re_quadForm_nonneg (Zᴴ *ᵥ (y - x))
    linarith
  · intro y hy hmin
    by_contra hne
    have hc := hZ.mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec (v := y - x)
      (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hy, sub_self])
    have hcoord : Zᴴ *ᵥ (y - x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      rw [hz, Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hc
      exact hne (sub_eq_zero.mp hc.symm)
    have hp := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hG.quadForm_pos hcoord)).1
    rw [he y hy] at hmin
    linarith

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.exists_unique_constrained_quadratic_minimum
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.exists_unique_constrained_quadratic_minimum
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    (hB : IsUnit (B * Bᴴ)) {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hG : (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef) (f : n → 𝕜) (g : m → 𝕜) :
    ∃ x, IsUniqueConstrainedQuadraticMinimum H B f g x
proof:
:= by
  let xp := Bᴴ *ᵥ ((B * Bᴴ)⁻¹ *ᵥ g)
  have hxp : B *ᵥ xp = g := by
    dsimp only [xp]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  let y := (reducedHessian H Z)⁻¹ *ᵥ (Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ xp))
  have hy : reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ y = Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ xp) := by
    dsimp only [y]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hG.isUnit), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  obtain ⟨hx, he⟩ := hZ.kkt_solution hB H f g xp hxp y hy
  have hz : Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ (xp + Z *ᵥ y)) = 0 := by
    simp only [reducedHessian, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub] at hy
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_add]
    linear_combination -hy
  obtain ⟨hmin, huniq⟩ := hZ.quadratic_minimizer_of_reduced_posDef hH hG f _ hz
  exact ⟨xp + Z *ᵥ y, hx, by simpa only [hx] using hmin, by simpa only [hx] using huniq⟩

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.reduced_posDef_of_unique_constrained_minimum_zero
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.reduced_posDef_of_unique_constrained_minimum_zero
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hmin : ∃ x, IsUniqueConstrainedQuadraticMinimum H B 0 0 x) :
    (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hm, hu⟩ := hmin
  have hneg : quadraticObjective H 0 (-x) = quadraticObjective H 0 x := by
    have hq : quadForm H (-x) = quadForm H x := by
      rw [show -x = (-1 : 𝕜) • x by simp, quadForm_smul]
      simp
    simp only [quadraticObjective, hq, star_zero, zero_dotProduct, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hxneg : -x = x := hu (-x) (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_neg, hx, neg_zero]) (by rw [hneg])
  have hx0 : x = 0 := by
    ext i
    have hi := congrFun hxneg i
    change -(x i) = x i at hi
    have hz : (2 : 𝕜) * x i = 0 := by linear_combination -hi
    exact (_root_.mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  subst x
  apply Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.mpr
  refine ⟨Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Z hH, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hz : Z *ᵥ y ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => Zᴴ *ᵥ v) he
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hZ.orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hh
    exact hy hh
  have hfeas : B *ᵥ (Z *ᵥ y) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hZ.mul_eq_zero, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
  have hn := hm (Z *ᵥ y) hfeas
  have hstrict : quadraticObjective H 0 0 < quadraticObjective H 0 (Z *ᵥ y) := by
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hn (fun he => hz (hu _ hfeas he.symm.le))
  have hq := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul H Z y
  have hre : 0 < RCLike.re (quadForm (reducedHessian H Z) y) := by
    change quadForm (reducedHessian H Z) y = _ at hq
    simp only [quadraticObjective, star_zero, zero_dotProduct, map_zero,
      quadForm_zero_right, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hstrict
    rw [← hq] at hstrict
    linarith
  have hGH : (reducedHessian H Z).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Z hH
  change 0 < quadForm (reducedHessian H Z) y
  rw [← hGH.ofReal_re_quadForm y]
  exact RCLike.ofReal_pos.mpr hre

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.reduced_posDef_iff_unique_constrained_minimum
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.reduced_posDef_iff_unique_constrained_minimum
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    (hB : IsUnit (B * Bᴴ)) {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef ↔
      ∀ (f : n → 𝕜) (g : m → 𝕜), ∃ x, IsUniqueConstrainedQuadraticMinimum H B f g x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun hG => hZ.exists_unique_constrained_quadratic_minimum hB hH hG
  · intro hh
    exact hZ.reduced_posDef_of_unique_constrained_minimum_zero hH (hh 0 0)

name: NLAlib.posDef_tikhonovNormal
statement:
theorem posDef_tikhonovNormal (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    (tikhonovNormal A β).PosDef
proof:
:=
  Matrix.PosDef.posSemidef_add (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
    (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hβ)

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.tikhonovInverse_eq
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.tikhonovInverse_eq {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    tikhonovInverse A β =
      V * diagonal (fun i => ((σ i / (σ i ^ 2 + β) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix r r 𝕜 := diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜))
  let G : Matrix r r 𝕜 := diagonal (fun i => ((σ i ^ 2 + β : ℝ) : 𝕜))
  let F : Matrix r r 𝕜 := diagonal (fun i => ((σ i / (σ i ^ 2 + β) : ℝ) : 𝕜))
  have hp := h.isSingularTripletFamily
  have hHV : tikhonovNormal A β * V = V * G := by
    calc
      _ = Aᴴ * (A * V) + β • V := by
        simp [tikhonovNormal, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = V * S * S + β • V := by
        rw [hp.mul_right, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hp.adjoint_mul_left]
      _ = V * (S * S + β • (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜)) := by
        simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        ext i j
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst j; simp [G, S, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, pow_two,
            RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
        · simp [G, S, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, hij]
  have hGF : G * F = S := by
    dsimp only [G, F, S]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    norm_cast
    have hd : σ i ^ 2 + β ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [hd]
  have hS : Sᴴ = S := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [S, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    · simp [S, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]
  have hAstar : Aᴴ = V * S * Uᴴ := by
    rw [h.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    change V * (Sᴴ * Uᴴ) = _
    rw [hS]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hnormal : tikhonovNormal A β * (V * F * Uᴴ) = Aᴴ := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hHV, Matrix.mul_assoc V G F, hGF,
      ← hAstar]
  unfold tikhonovInverse
  rw [← hnormal, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (posDef_tikhonovNormal A hβ).isUnit), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.tikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective
statement:
theorem tikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (β : ℝ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tikhonovObjective A b β x =
      2 * quadraticObjective (tikhonovNormal A β) (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) x +
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : star (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ x = star b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hr : RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ b) = RCLike.re (star b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) := by
    calc
      _ = RCLike.re (star (star b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))) := by
        congr 1
        rw [← Matrix.star_dotProduct_star, star_star]
      _ = _ := by simp [RCLike.star_def]
  have hq : RCLike.re (quadForm (tikhonovNormal A β) x) =
      RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) + β * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    simp only [tikhonovNormal, quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, map_add,
      RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
    rw [← quadForm, quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  simp only [tikhonovObjective, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, star_sub,
    sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, map_sub, quadraticObjective, hq, hc, hr]
  ring

name: NLAlib.tikhonovInverse_mulVec_unique_minimizer
statement:
theorem tikhonovInverse_mulVec_unique_minimizer (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    (∀ x, tikhonovObjective A b β (tikhonovInverse A β *ᵥ b) ≤
      tikhonovObjective A b β x) ∧
    ∀ x, tikhonovObjective A b β x ≤
      tikhonovObjective A b β (tikhonovInverse A β *ᵥ b) →
        x = tikhonovInverse A β *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hmin := quadraticObjective_inv_mulVec_minimizer (posDef_tikhonovNormal A hβ) (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)
  simp only [tikhonovInverse, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    tikhonovObjective_eq_quadraticObjective]
  constructor
  · intro x
    linarith [hmin.1 x]
  · intro x hx
    apply hmin.2 x
    linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_tikhonov_scalar_filter_le
statement:
private theorem abs_tikhonov_scalar_filter_le {s β : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    |s / (s ^ 2 + β)| ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt β)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < s ^ 2 + β := by positivity
  have hr : 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt β := by positivity
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_le_div_iff₀ hd hr]
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hβ.le
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s - Real.sqrt β)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_tikhonovInverse_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_tikhonovInverse_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    specNorm (tikhonovInverse A β) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt β)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  rw [h.tikhonovInverse_eq hβ,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.left_orth,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.right_orth]
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr
    intro i
    rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal]
    exact abs_tikhonov_scalar_filter_le (singularValues_nonneg A i) hβ

name: NLAlib.norm_tikhonovInverse_noise_le
statement:
theorem norm_tikhonovInverse_noise_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b e : m → 𝕜)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tikhonovInverse A β *ᵥ (b + e) - tikhonovInverse A β *ᵥ b)‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 e‖ / (2 * Real.sqrt β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, add_sub_cancel_left]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (tikhonovInverse A β) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 e‖ := by
      open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
        exact (tikhonovInverse A β).l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 e)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_tikhonovInverse_le A hβ)
        (norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 e))
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hb

name: NLAlib.quadForm_def
statement: theorem quadForm_def (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) : quadForm A z = star z ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.quadForm_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem quadForm_zero_right (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : quadForm A 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [quadForm]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem quadForm_zero_left (z : n → 𝕜) : quadForm (0 : Matrix n n 𝕜) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [quadForm]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_eq_sum
statement:
theorem quadForm_eq_sum (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :
    quadForm A z = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * (star (z i) * z j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_eq_sum_mul_mul
statement:
theorem quadForm_eq_sum_mul_mul (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :
    quadForm A z = ∑ i, ∑ j, star (z i) * A i j * z j
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_eq_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sq_eq_sum
statement:
theorem quadForm_sq_eq_sum (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :
    quadForm A z ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, A i j * A k l * (star (z i) * z j * star (z k) * z l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sq, quadForm_eq_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_reindex
statement:
theorem quadForm_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (e : ι ≃ κ)
    (z : ι → 𝕜) : quadForm (A.reindex e e) (fun k => z (e.symm k)) = quadForm A z
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_eq_sum, quadForm_eq_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  rw [e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ∑ k, A i (e.symm k) * (star (z i) * z (e.symm k)))]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ =>
    e.symm.sum_comp (fun j => A i j * (star (z i) * z j))

name: NLAlib.quadForm_add
statement:
theorem quadForm_add (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    quadForm A (x + y) =
      quadForm A x + star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) + star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) + quadForm A y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, star_add, Matrix.mulVec_add, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add]
  ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_smul
statement:
theorem quadForm_smul (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c : 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :
    quadForm A (c • z) = star c * c * quadForm A z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, star_smul, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, RCLike.star_def]
  ring

name: NLAlib.star_quadForm
statement:
theorem star_quadForm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :
    star (quadForm A z) = quadForm Aᴴ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm, quadForm, Matrix.star_dotProduct, Matrix.star_mulVec, star_star,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.ofReal_re_quadForm
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.ofReal_re_quadForm {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (z : n → 𝕜) :
    ((RCLike.re (quadForm A z) : ℝ) : 𝕜) = quadForm A z
proof:
:= by
  rw [RCLike.conj_eq_iff_re.mp]
  rw [← RCLike.star_def, star_quadForm, hA.eq]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.star_dotProduct_mulVec_comm
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.star_dotProduct_mulVec_comm {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x y : n → 𝕜) : star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = star (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.star_dotProduct_star, Matrix.star_mulVec, star_star, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
    hA.eq]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x y : n → 𝕜) (r s : ℝ) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm A ((r : 𝕜) • x + (s : 𝕜) • y)) =
      r ^ 2 * RCLike.re (quadForm A x) + 2 * r * s * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) +
        s ^ 2 * RCLike.re (quadForm A y)
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) = RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) := by
    rw [hA.star_dotProduct_mulVec_comm, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_re]
  rw [quadForm_add, quadForm_smul, quadForm_smul]
  simp only [star_smul, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    map_add, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul,
    hcross]
  ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_vecMulVec_star_self
statement:
theorem quadForm_vecMulVec_star_self (b x : n → 𝕜) :
    quadForm (Matrix.vecMulVec b (star b)) x = (‖star x ⬝ᵥ b‖ : 𝕜) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, op_smul_eq_mul, ← RCLike.mul_conj,
    ← RCLike.star_def, ← Matrix.star_dotProduct_star, star_star]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul {k : Type*} [Fintype k] (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (W : Matrix n k 𝕜) (v : k → 𝕜) :
    quadForm (Wᴴ * A * W) v = quadForm A (W *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm, quadForm, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (star v) Wᴴ, Matrix.star_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self {m : Type*} [Fintype m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (y : n → 𝕜) : quadForm (Aᴴ * A) y = star (A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_def
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_def (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    rayleighQuotient A x = RCLike.re (quadForm A x) / RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_mem_Icc {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a c : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm A x) ∈
      Set.Icc (a * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)) (c * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) with hUdef
  have hD : Uᴴ * A * U = Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hA.eigenvalues) := by
    have h := hA.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
    rwa [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_star_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] at h
  have hUU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]; exact Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  set y : n → 𝕜 := Uᴴ *ᵥ x with hy
  have hx : U *ᵥ y = x := by
    rw [hy, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hUU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hq : quadForm A x = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i : 𝕜) * (star (y i) * y i) := by
    rw [← hx, ← quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, hD, quadForm_def, dotProduct]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.star_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    ring
  have hyy : star y ⬝ᵥ y = star x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    rw [hy, Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hUU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hre : RCLike.re (quadForm A x) = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * ‖y i‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hq, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow,
      RCLike.ofReal_re]
  have hnorm : RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) = ∑ i, ‖y i‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hyy, dotProduct, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Pi.star_apply, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  rw [hre, hnorm, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact ⟨Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hspec i).1 (sq_nonneg _),
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hspec i).2 (sq_nonneg _)⟩

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_mul_same_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_mul_same_mem_Icc
    {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n k 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {a c : ℝ}
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c) (j : k) :
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ∈ Set.Icc a c
proof:
:= by
  set hB : (Qᴴ * A * Q).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA with hBdef
  let v : k → 𝕜 := (hB.eigenvectorBasis j).ofLp
  have hBv : (Qᴴ * A * Q) *ᵥ v = (hB.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) • v := by
    rw [← RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
    exact hB.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j
  have hvv : star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    have h1 := hB.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 j
    have h2 : (inner 𝕜 (hB.eigenvectorBasis j) (hB.eigenvectorBasis j) : 𝕜) = 1 := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, h1]; simp
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm] at h2
  have hQv : star (Q *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ v) = star v ⬝ᵥ v := by
    rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h1 : quadForm (Qᴴ * A * Q) v = (hB.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) := by
    rw [quadForm_def, hBv, dotProduct_smul, hvv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have h := hA.re_quadForm_mem_Icc hspec (Q *ᵥ v)
  rw [← quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, h1, RCLike.ofReal_re, hQv, hvv, RCLike.one_re, mul_one,
    mul_one] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_dotProduct
statement:
theorem isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_dotProduct (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x ↔
      ∀ y : n → ℝ, (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) ≤ (b - A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsLeastSquaresSolution
  simp only [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  exact ⟨fun h y => pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h y) 2,
    fun h y => (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).mp (h y)⟩

name: NLAlib.transpose_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (r : m → ℝ) : Aᵀ *ᵥ r = 0 ↔ ∀ y : n → ℝ, r ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h y
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, h, zero_dotProduct]
  · intro h
    have h1 := h (Aᵀ *ᵥ r)
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose] at h1
    exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h1

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    {b : m → ℝ} {x : n → ℝ} (h : Aᵀ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) = 0) (y : n → ℝ) :
    (b - A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ y) =
      (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) + (A *ᵥ (x - y)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - y))
proof:
:= by
  have horth := (transpose_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero A _).mp h (x - y)
  have hsplit : b - A *ᵥ y = (b - A *ᵥ x) + A *ᵥ (x - y) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]; abel
  rw [hsplit, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, horth, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ _),
    horth]
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    {b : m → ℝ} {x : n → ℝ} (h : Aᵀ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) = 0) (y : n → ℝ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  exact dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero h y

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x ↔ Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_dotProduct]
  have hiff : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b ↔ Aᵀ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]
  rw [hiff]
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    set r := b - A *ᵥ x with hr
    set g := Aᵀ *ᵥ r
    set c := g ⬝ᵥ g
    set d := (A *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ g) with hddef
    have hc : 0 ≤ c := dotProduct_self_nonneg g
    have hd : 0 ≤ d := dotProduct_self_nonneg _
    have hrg : r ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ g = c := by
      rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose]
    have key : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ -2 * t * c + t ^ 2 * d := by
      intro t
      have hres : b - A *ᵥ (x + t • g) = r - t • (A *ᵥ g) := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hr]; abel
      have h1 : r ⬝ᵥ r ≤ (r - t • (A *ᵥ g)) ⬝ᵥ (r - t • (A *ᵥ g)) := by
        rw [← hres, hr]; exact hmin _
      clear_value r g c d
      have hexp :
          (r - t • (A *ᵥ g)) ⬝ᵥ (r - t • (A *ᵥ g)) = r ⬝ᵥ r - 2 * t * c + t ^ 2 * d := by
        simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
          dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ g) r, hrg]
        rw [hddef]; ring
      rw [hexp] at h1
      linarith
    have h2 := key (c / (d + 1))
    have hd1 : 0 < d + 1 := by linarith
    have h3 : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 * (-(d + 2)) / (d + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have : -2 * (c / (d + 1)) * c + (c / (d + 1)) ^ 2 * d =
          c ^ 2 * (-(d + 2)) / (d + 1) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp; ring
      linarith
    have h4 : c ^ 2 * (-(d + 2)) ≥ 0 := by
      have := mul_nonneg h3 (sq_nonneg (d + 1))
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)] at this
    have hc0 : c = 0 := by nlinarith
    exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hc0
  · intro h y
    rw [dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero h y]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (b : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x ↔ ∀ y : n → ℝ, (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq,
    ← transpose_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero, Matrix.mulVec_sub,
    sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_mul_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_mul_moorePenroseInverse (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    Aᵀ * (A * moorePenroseInverse A) = Aᵀ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A).eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    ← Matrix.transpose_mul,
    mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec
statement:
theorem isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) :
    IsLeastSquaresSolution A b (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, transpose_mul_mul_moorePenroseInverse]

name: NLAlib.exists_isLeastSquaresSolution
statement:
theorem exists_isLeastSquaresSolution (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) :
    ∃ x, IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b⟩

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_mulVec_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x ↔ A *ᵥ x = (A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq A b _).mp
    (isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b)
  rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_sub, h, h0, sub_self]
    have h1 := congrArg (dotProduct (x - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) hz
    rw [dotProduct_zero, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose,
      dotProduct_self_eq_zero, Matrix.mulVec_sub, sub_eq_zero, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h1
    exact h1
  · intro h
    rw [h, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, transpose_mul_mul_moorePenroseInverse]

name: NLAlib.IsLeastSquaresSolution.sub_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_mulVec_eq A b x).mp h, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.IsLeastSquaresSolution.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  have horth := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero A b x).mp h x
  have hb : b = (b - A *ᵥ x) + A *ᵥ x := by abel
  conv_rhs => rw [hb]
  rw [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, horth, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ x), horth]
  ring

name: NLAlib.IsLeastSquaresSolution.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq
statement:
theorem IsLeastSquaresSolution.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ}
    {x : n → ℝ} (h : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 -
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  exact h.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq

name: NLAlib.rank_eq_card_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rank_eq_card_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    A.rank = Fintype.card n ↔ ∀ v : n → ℝ, A *ᵥ v = 0 → v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker A.mulVecLin
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at h
  rw [← Matrix.ker_mulVecLin_eq_bot_iff, ← Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]
  change Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin) = Fintype.card n ↔ _
  omega

name: NLAlib.isUnit_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem isUnit_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : IsUnit (Aᵀ * A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hAv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  apply hv
  apply (rank_eq_card_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero A).mp hA
  have hAv' : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = 0 := by rwa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have h1 := congrArg (dotProduct v) hAv'
  rwa [dotProduct_zero, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose,
    dotProduct_self_eq_zero] at h1

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_isLeastSquaresSolution_iff
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isLeastSquaresSolution_iff (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) :
    (∃! x, IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x) ↔ A.rank = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_eq_card_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero]
  set x₀ := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
  have h₀ := isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, -, hx⟩ v hv
    have h1 : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b (x₀ + v) := by
      rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_mulVec_eq, Matrix.mulVec_add, hv, add_zero,
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    have h2 : x₀ + v = x₀ := (hx _ h1).trans (hx _ h₀).symm
    exact add_eq_left.mp h2
  · intro hinj
    refine ⟨x₀, h₀, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hy' := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_mulVec_eq A b y).mp hy
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at hy'
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hinj _ (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hy', sub_self]))

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₀, -, hu⟩ := (existsUnique_isLeastSquaresSolution_iff A b).mpr hA
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (hu x hx).trans (hu _ (isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b)).symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_pinvL_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec hA,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL A (isUnit_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq hA)]

name: NLAlib.IsLeastSquaresSolution.norm_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem IsLeastSquaresSolution.norm_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_le
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {x : n → ℝ} (h : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ≤
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero,
    norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  set A' := moorePenroseInverse A
  set x₀ := A' *ᵥ b
  set z := x - x₀ with hzdef
  have hz : A *ᵥ z = 0 := by
    have hx := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_mulVec_eq A b x).mp h
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hx, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, sub_self]
  have horth : x₀ ⬝ᵥ z = 0 := by
    have hA' : A' = Aᵀ * A'ᵀ * A' := by
      rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
        (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq,
        moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse]
    have hx₀ : x₀ = Aᵀ *ᵥ ((A'ᵀ * A') *ᵥ b) := by
      change A' *ᵥ b = _
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hA']
    rw [hx₀, dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose, hz,
      zero_dotProduct]
  have hx : x = x₀ + z := by rw [hzdef]; abel
  rw [hx, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, horth, dotProduct_comm z, horth]
  linarith [dotProduct_self_nonneg z]

name: NLAlib.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_inv_mulVec_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_inv_mulVec_of_eq_mul [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hA : A = Q * R) (hR : IsUnit R) (b : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x ↔ x = R⁻¹ *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsUnit R.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR
  have hdt : IsUnit Rᵀ.det := by rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]
  have hQ' : Qᵀ * Q = 1 := hQ
  have hG : Rᵀ * Qᵀ * (Q * R) = Rᵀ * R := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᵀ, hQ', Matrix.one_mul]
  have e1 : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = Rᵀ *ᵥ (R *ᵥ x) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hA, Matrix.transpose_mul, hG, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have e2 : Aᵀ *ᵥ b = Rᵀ *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.transpose_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have hcT : ∀ v : n → ℝ, Rᵀ⁻¹ *ᵥ (Rᵀ *ᵥ v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdt, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hc : ∀ v : n → ℝ, R⁻¹ *ᵥ (R *ᵥ v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hc' : ∀ v : n → ℝ, R *ᵥ (R⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq, e1, e2]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hRx : R *ᵥ x = Qᵀ *ᵥ b := by rw [← hcT (R *ᵥ x), h, hcT]
    rw [← hRx, hc]
  · rintro rfl
    rw [hc']

name: NLAlib.IsLeastSquaresSolution.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem IsLeastSquaresSolution.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq_of_eq_mul [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hA : A = Q * R) (hR : IsUnit R) {b : m → ℝ} {x : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b x) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 -
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  have hd : IsUnit R.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR
  have hx := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_inv_mulVec_of_eq_mul hQ hA hR b x).mp h
  have hAx : A *ᵥ x = Q *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) := by
    rw [hx, hA, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [h.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq, hAx,
    show (Q *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) = (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ _]

name: NLAlib.IsQR.isLeastSquaresSolution_iff
proof:
:=
  isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_eq_inv_mulVec_of_eq_mul h.orth h.eq
