    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mpr (h.isUnit_det_iff.mpr hR)) b x

name: NLAlib.IsQR.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq
proof:
:=
  hx.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq_of_eq_mul h.orth h.eq
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mpr (h.isUnit_det_iff.mpr hR))

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_map_ofReal {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [RCLike 𝕜] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    moorePenroseInverse (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) =
      (moorePenroseInverse A).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  let f := algebraMap ℝ 𝕜
  have hf : Function.Semiconj f star star := by intro r; simp [f]
  apply (isMoorePenroseInverse (A.map f)).unique
  have h := isMoorePenroseInverse A
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.map_mul, h.mul_mul_eq]
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.map_mul, h.inv_mul_inv_eq]
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_map f hf, h.conjTranspose_mul_eq]
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_map f hf, h.conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_eq_det_image_of_injective
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_eq_det_image_of_injective (A : Matrix n n R)
    (h : ι → n) (hh : Function.Injective h) :
    (A.submatrix h h).det =
      (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : (Finset.univ.image h) → n) Subtype.val).det
proof:
:= by
  let e : ι ≃ (Finset.univ.image h) := Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun i => ⟨h i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩) (by
      constructor
      · intro i j hij
        exact hh (congrArg Subtype.val hij)
      · intro x
        obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp x.2
        exact ⟨i, Subtype.ext hi⟩)
  exact (Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e
    (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : (Finset.univ.image h) → n) Subtype.val))

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_not_injective
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_not_injective (A : Matrix n n R)
    (h : ι → n) (hh : ¬Function.Injective h) : (A.submatrix h h).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.Injective] at hh
  push Not at hh
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := hh
  apply Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq hne
  funext l
  change A (h i) (h l) = A (h j) (h l)
  rw [hij]

name: NLAlib.sum_det_submatrix_eq_factorial_mul_sum_principalMinors
statement:
theorem sum_det_submatrix_eq_factorial_mul_sum_principalMinors (A : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ h : Fin k → n, (A.submatrix h h).det) =
      (k.factorial : R) * ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k,
        (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ h : Fin k → n, if Function.Injective h then
        (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : (Finset.univ.image h) → n) Subtype.val).det else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro h _
      split_ifs with hh
      · exact det_submatrix_eq_det_image_of_injective A h hh
      · exact det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_not_injective A h hh
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using Finset.sum_injective_image_eq_factorial_nsmul
        (fun S : Finset n => (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det) k

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetLeverage_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowSubsetLeverage_nonneg (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (i : n) :
    0 ≤ rowSubsetLeverage X T i
proof:
:=
  (rowSubsetGram_posSemidef X T).inv.re_quadForm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_erase_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hG := (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X T).mp hT
  have hdet := det_add_vecMulVec ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hG)
    (-(star (X i))) (X i)
  have hd : (rowSubsetGram X (T.erase i)).det = (rowSubsetGram X T).det *
      (1 - quadForm (rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹ (star (X i))) := by
    rw [rowSubsetGram_erase X T hi]
    simpa only [Matrix.neg_vecMulVec, ← sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.mulVec_neg,
      dotProduct_neg, quadForm, star_star] using hdet
  unfold rowSubsetVolume rowSubsetLeverage
  rw [hd, ← ofReal_rowSubsetVolume X T, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, map_sub, RCLike.one_re,
    RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetLeverage_le_one
statement:
theorem rowSubsetLeverage_le_one (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) {i : n}
    (hi : i ∈ T) (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) : rowSubsetLeverage X T i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X (T.erase i)
  rw [rowSubsetVolume_erase_eq X T hi hT] at h
  exact sub_nonneg.mp ((mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hT).mp h)

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetLeverage
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetLeverage (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) :
    (∑ i ∈ T, rowSubsetLeverage X T i) = Fintype.card d
proof:
:= by
  have hG := (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X T).mp hT
  have ht : ∑ i ∈ T, quadForm (rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹ (star (X i)) =
      ((rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹ * rowSubsetGram X T).trace := by
    rw [rowSubsetGram_eq_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec]
    simp only [quadForm, star_star]
    exact dotProduct_comm _ _
  simp only [rowSubsetLeverage, ← map_sum]
  rw [ht, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hG),
    Matrix.trace_one, RCLike.natCast_re]

name: NLAlib.residualEnergy_midpoint
statement:
theorem residualEnergy_midpoint (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    4 * residualEnergy A b ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) • (x + y)) +
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y))‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * residualEnergy A b x + 2 * residualEnergy A b y
proof:
:= by
  have hr : A *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) • (x + y)) - b =
      (1 / 2 : 𝕜) • ((A *ᵥ x - b) + (A *ᵥ y - b)) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_add]
    module
  have hd : A *ᵥ (x - y) = (A *ᵥ x - b) - (A *ᵥ y - b) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]; abel
  unfold residualEnergy
  rw [hr, hd, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, norm_div, norm_one, RCLike.norm_two]
  have he := parallelogram_law_with_norm 𝕜 (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - b))
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ y - b))
  rw [← WithLp.toLp_add, ← WithLp.toLp_sub] at he
  nlinarith [he]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_of_residualEnergy_minimizers
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_of_residualEnergy_minimizers (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (x y : n → 𝕜) (hx : ∀ z, residualEnergy A b x ≤ residualEnergy A b z)
    (hy : residualEnergy A b y ≤ residualEnergy A b x) : A *ᵥ (x - y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := hx ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) • (x + y))
  have he := residualEnergy_midpoint A b x y
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y))‖ = 0 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y)))]
  exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)

name: NLAlib.landweberIterate_succ
statement:
theorem landweberIterate_succ (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (η : ℝ)
    (x₀ : n → 𝕜) (t : ℕ) :
    landweberIterate A b η x₀ (t + 1) =
      landweberStepMatrix A η *ᵥ landweberIterate A b η x₀ t + η • (Aᴴ *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [landweberIterate, landweberStepMatrix, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    Matrix.smul_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub, smul_sub]
  abel

name: NLAlib.landweberStepMatrix_mulVec_pinv_add
statement:
theorem landweberStepMatrix_mulVec_pinv_add (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (η : ℝ) :
    landweberStepMatrix A η *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) + η • (Aᴴ *ᵥ b) =
      moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Aᴴ * A * moorePenroseInverse A = Aᴴ := by
    have he := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul A)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A).eq] at he
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using he
  simp only [landweberStepMatrix, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hn]
  abel

name: NLAlib.landweberIterate_sub_pinv
statement:
theorem landweberIterate_sub_pinv (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (η : ℝ)
    (x₀ : n → 𝕜) (t : ℕ) :
    landweberIterate A b η x₀ t - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b =
      landweberStepMatrix A η ^ t *ᵥ (x₀ - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [landweberIterate]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [landweberIterate_succ, pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← ih, Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    have hf := landweberStepMatrix_mulVec_pinv_add A b η
    linear_combination hf

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.landweberStepMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.landweberStepMatrix_mul {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (η : ℝ) :
    landweberStepMatrix A η * V = V * diagonal (fun i => ((1 - η * σ i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) ∧
      landweberStepMatrix A η * (1 - V * Vᴴ) = 1 - V * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hp := h.isSingularTripletFamily
  have hgram : (Aᴴ * A) * V = V * diagonal (fun i => ((σ i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hp.mul_right, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hp.adjoint_mul_left,
      Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simp only [pow_two, RCLike.ofReal_mul]
  constructor
  · rw [landweberStepMatrix, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, hgram]
    have hd : diagonal (fun i => ((1 - η * σ i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) =
        (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜) - η • diagonal (fun i => ((σ i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j; simp [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
      · simp [hij]
    rw [hd, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one]
  · have hAP : A * (1 - V * Vᴴ) = 0 := by
      rw [h.eq]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.mul_assoc _ Vᴴ V, h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
      abel
    rw [landweberStepMatrix, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc Aᴴ A, hAP, Matrix.mul_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.landweberStepMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.landweberStepMatrix_pow {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (η : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    landweberStepMatrix A η ^ t = 1 - V * Vᴴ +
      V * diagonal (fun i => (((1 - η * σ i ^ 2) ^ t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', ih, Matrix.mul_add, (h.landweberStepMatrix_mul η).2,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, (h.landweberStepMatrix_mul η).1,
      Matrix.mul_assoc V, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 3
    funext i
    simp [pow_succ', RCLike.ofReal_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.landweberIterate_zero_eq
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.landweberIterate_zero_eq {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜} {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (b : m → 𝕜) (η : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    landweberIterate A b η 0 t =
      (V * diagonal (fun i => (((1 - (1 - η * σ i ^ 2) ^ t) / σ i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have he := landweberIterate_sub_pinv A b η 0 t
  have hP : (1 - V * Vᴴ) * moorePenroseInverse A = 0 := by
    rw [h.moorePenroseInverse_eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hz : (1 - V * Vᴴ) * V = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
        h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]
    rw [hz, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.zero_mul]
  rw [h.landweberStepMatrix_pow, zero_sub, Matrix.mulVec_neg, Matrix.add_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hP, Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_add] at he
  have hdiff : moorePenroseInverse A -
      V * diagonal (fun i => (((1 - η * σ i ^ 2) ^ t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ * moorePenroseInverse A =
      V * diagonal (fun i => (((1 - (1 - η * σ i ^ 2) ^ t) / σ i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    rw [h.moorePenroseInverse_eq]
    have hc : (V * diagonal (fun i => (((1 - η * σ i ^ 2) ^ t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ) *
        (V * diagonal (fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ) =
        V * (diagonal (fun i => (((1 - η * σ i ^ 2) ^ t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) *
          diagonal (fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜))) * Uᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V, h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [hc, ← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal,
      Matrix.diagonal_sub]
    congr 2
    funext i
    norm_cast
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv, sub_mul]
  rw [← hdiff, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  linear_combination he

name: NLAlib.landweberIterate_zero_matrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem landweberIterate_zero_matrix (b : m → 𝕜) (η : ℝ) (x₀ : n → 𝕜) (t : ℕ) :
    landweberIterate (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) b η x₀ t = x₀
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih => simp [landweberIterate, ih]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun i => (F i)ᵀ) l (𝓝 Aᵀ) :=
    (show Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => Mᵀ) by fun_prop).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim
  have he : (fun i => (F i)ᵀ) = F := by
    funext i
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using (hF i).isHermitian.eq
  rw [he] at ht
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := tendsto_nhds_unique ht hlim
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    (by simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hAt)
  intro x
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => x ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ x) := by
    unfold Matrix.mulVec dotProduct
    fun_prop
  simp only [star_trivial]
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds (hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun i => by
      change (0 : ℝ) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ F i *ᵥ x
      simpa only [star_trivial] using (hF i).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x)

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_of_hasSum
statement:
theorem posSemidef_of_hasSum {ι : Type*} {F : ι → Matrix n n ℝ} {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i).PosSemidef) (h : HasSum F A) : A.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  exact posSemidef_of_tendsto (fun S : Finset ι => Matrix.posSemidef_sum S (fun i _ => hF i)) h

name: NLAlib.sum_range_le_of_hasSum_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  exact posSemidef_of_hasSum (fun i => hF (i + k)) ((hasSum_nat_add_iff' k).mpr h)

name: NLAlib.quadraticObjective_add_of_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem quadraticObjective_add_of_mulVec_eq {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {f x : n → 𝕜} (hx : H *ᵥ x = f) (y : n → 𝕜) :
    quadraticObjective H f (x + y) = quadraticObjective H f x +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * RCLike.re (quadForm H y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : star f ⬝ᵥ y = star x ⬝ᵥ (H *ᵥ y) := by
    rw [← hx, Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hH.eq]
  have hq := hH.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul x y 1 1
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul, one_pow, one_mul] at hq
  unfold quadraticObjective
  rw [hq, dotProduct_add, map_add, hc]
  ring

name: NLAlib.quadraticObjective_minimizer_of_posDef
statement:
theorem quadraticObjective_minimizer_of_posDef {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.PosDef)
    {f x : n → 𝕜} (hx : H *ᵥ x = f) :
    (∀ y, quadraticObjective H f x ≤ quadraticObjective H f y) ∧
      ∀ y, quadraticObjective H f y ≤ quadraticObjective H f x → y = x
proof:
:= by
  have he (y : n → 𝕜) : quadraticObjective H f y = quadraticObjective H f x +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * RCLike.re (quadForm H (y - x)) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using
      quadraticObjective_add_of_mulVec_eq hH.isHermitian hx (y - x)
  constructor
  · intro y
    rw [he y]
    have hn := hH.posSemidef.re_quadForm_nonneg (y - x)
    linarith
  · intro y hy
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < RCLike.re (quadForm H (y - x)) :=
      (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hH.quadForm_pos (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))).1
    rw [he y] at hy
    linarith

name: NLAlib.quadraticObjective_inv_mulVec_minimizer
statement:
theorem quadraticObjective_inv_mulVec_minimizer {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.PosDef)
    (f : n → 𝕜) :
    (∀ y, quadraticObjective H f (H⁻¹ *ᵥ f) ≤ quadraticObjective H f y) ∧
      ∀ y, quadraticObjective H f y ≤ quadraticObjective H f (H⁻¹ *ᵥ f) → y = H⁻¹ *ᵥ f
proof:
:= by
  apply quadraticObjective_minimizer_of_posDef hH
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hH.isUnit), Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_landweberStepMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem tendsto_landweberStepMatrix_pow (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hA : A ≠ 0)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hstep : η < 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => landweberStepMatrix A η ^ t) atTop
      (𝓝 (1 - moorePenroseInverse A * A))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  have hN : 0 < specNorm A := by
    open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
      rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
      exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hA
  have hηN : η * specNorm A ^ 2 < 2 :=
    (lt_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hN)).mp hstep
  have hscalar (i : Fin A.rank) : Tendsto
      (fun t : ℕ => (((1 - η * singularValues A i ^ 2) ^ t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hs := h.pos i
    have hsN := singularValues_le_specNorm A i
    have hηs : η * singularValues A i ^ 2 < 2 :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hs.le hsN 2) hη.le).trans_lt hηN
    have hroot : |1 - η * singularValues A i ^ 2| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [mul_pos hη (sq_pos_of_pos hs)]
    have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => (1 - η * singularValues A i ^ 2) ^ t)
        atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one hroot
    simpa only [RCLike.ofReal_zero, Function.comp_def] using
      (RCLike.continuous_ofReal : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (x : 𝕜))).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hp
  have hdiag : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => diagonal
      (fun i : Fin A.rank => (((1 - η * singularValues A i ^ 2) ^ t : ℝ) : 𝕜)))
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin A.rank) 𝕜)) := by
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simpa using hscalar i
    · simpa [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij] using
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : 𝕜)) atTop (𝓝 0))
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin A.rank) 𝕜 =>
      (1 - V * Vᴴ) + V * M * Vᴴ) := by fun_prop
  have ht := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hdiag
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero] at ht
  rw [h.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq]
  exact ht.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => (h.landweberStepMatrix_pow η t).symm)

name: NLAlib.tendsto_landweberIterate
statement:
theorem tendsto_landweberIterate (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → 𝕜)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hstep : η < 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) (x₀ : n → 𝕜) :
    Tendsto (fun t => (WithLp.toLp 2 (landweberIterate A b η x₀ t) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
      atTop (𝓝 (WithLp.toLp 2 (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b +
        (1 - moorePenroseInverse A * A) *ᵥ x₀)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => (WithLp.toLp 2
      (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b + M *ᵥ (x₀ - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) :
        EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)) := by fun_prop
  have ht := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (tendsto_landweberStepMatrix_pow A hA hη hstep)
  have hkill : (1 - moorePenroseInverse A * A) * moorePenroseInverse A = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse, sub_self]
  have hz : (1 - moorePenroseInverse A * A) *ᵥ (x₀ - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) =
      (1 - moorePenroseInverse A * A) *ᵥ x₀ := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hkill, Matrix.zero_mulVec, sub_zero]
  rw [hz] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro t
  apply congrArg (fun v : n → 𝕜 => (WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
  have he := landweberIterate_sub_pinv A b η x₀ t
  linear_combination -he

name: NLAlib.tendsto_landweberIterate_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_landweberIterate_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → 𝕜)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hstep : η < 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) :
    Tendsto (fun t => (WithLp.toLp 2 (landweberIterate A b η 0 t) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))
      atTop (𝓝 (WithLp.toLp 2 (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using tendsto_landweberIterate A hA b hη hstep 0

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.mul_eq_zero {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜}
    (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z) : B * Z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec.mpr
  intro v
  have h : Z *ᵥ v ∈ LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin := by
    rw [← hZ.range_eq]
    exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  change B *ᵥ (Z *ᵥ v) = 0 at h
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.zero_mulVec] using h

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  have hm : v ∈ LinearMap.range Z.mulVecLin := by
    rw [hZ.range_eq]
    exact hv
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hm
  change Z *ᵥ (Zᴴ *ᵥ (Z *ᵥ w)) = Z *ᵥ w
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec w Zᴴ Z, hZ.orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.decomposition
proof:
:= by
  let w := v - Bᴴ *ᵥ ((B * Bᴴ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ v))
  have hw : B *ᵥ w = 0 := by
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB), Matrix.one_mulVec,
      sub_self]
  have hZw : Zᴴ *ᵥ w = Zᴴ *ᵥ v := by
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    have hz : Zᴴ * Bᴴ = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hZ.mul_eq_zero, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero]
    rw [hz, Matrix.zero_mulVec, sub_zero]
  have he := hZ.mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec hw
  rw [hZw] at he
  dsimp only [w] at he
  linear_combination -he

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.eq_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.eq_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    (hB : IsUnit (B * Bᴴ)) {v : n → 𝕜} (hv : Zᴴ *ᵥ v = 0) :
    v = Bᴴ *ᵥ ((B * Bᴴ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ v))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hv, Matrix.mulVec_zero, zero_add] using hZ.decomposition hB v

name: NLAlib.even_power_rpow_two_div
statement:
private theorem even_power_rpow_two_div {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (x ^ (2 * r)) ^ (2 / ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ)) = x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ 2 hp]
  exact Real.rpow_two x

name: NLAlib.dilation_sub
statement: private theorem dilation_sub (A H : Matrix m n ℂ) : dilation (A - H) = dilation A - dilation H
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> simp [dilation, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_even_moment_smoothness_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_even_moment_smoothness_complex (A H : Matrix m n ℂ)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ((schattenNormReal (A + H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) +
      schattenNormReal (A - H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r)) / 2) ^
        (2 / ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      schattenNormReal A (2 * r : ℕ) ^ 2 +
        (((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) * schattenNormReal H (2 * r : ℕ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Even (2 * r) := even_two_mul r
  have h := re_trace_even_moment_smoothness (dilation A) (dilation H)
    (isHermitian_dilation A) (isHermitian_dilation H) hp (by omega)
  have ht (X : Matrix m n ℂ) : (dilation X ^ (2 * r)).trace.re =
      2 * schattenNormReal X (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) := by
    exact re_trace_dilation_pow_even X hr
  rw [← dilation_add, ← dilation_sub, ht (A + H), ht (A - H), ht A, ht H] at h
  have hc : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hplus := schattenNormReal_nonneg (A + H) ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hminus := schattenNormReal_nonneg (A - H) ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have havg : 0 ≤ (schattenNormReal (A + H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) +
      schattenNormReal (A - H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r)) / 2 :=
    div_nonneg (add_nonneg (pow_nonneg hplus _) (pow_nonneg hminus _)) (by norm_num)
  have hl :
      (2 * schattenNormReal (A + H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) +
        2 * schattenNormReal (A - H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r)) / 2 =
      2 * ((schattenNormReal (A + H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) +
        schattenNormReal (A - H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r)) / 2) := by ring
  rw [hl, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) havg,
    Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg A _) _),
    Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg H _) _),
    even_power_rpow_two_div (schattenNormReal_nonneg A _) hr,
    even_power_rpow_two_div (schattenNormReal_nonneg H _) hr] at h
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hc).mp
  convert! h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_complexification_even
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_complexification_even (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    schattenNormReal (A.map Complex.ofReal) (2 * r : ℕ) = schattenNormReal A (2 * r : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (pow_left_inj₀ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
    (by omega : 2 * r ≠ 0)).mp
  rw [schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram _ hr,
    schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram _ hr]
  have hgram : (A.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * A.map Complex.ofReal =
      (realMatrixComplexification (Aᴴ * A) : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, realMatrixComplexification_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum,
      Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rw [hgram, ← map_pow, realMatrixComplexification_apply]
  simp [Matrix.trace, RCLike.re_to_complex, RCLike.re_to_real]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_even_moment_smoothness_real
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_even_moment_smoothness_real (A H : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ((schattenNormReal (A + H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) +
      schattenNormReal (A - H) (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r)) / 2) ^
        (2 / ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      schattenNormReal A (2 * r : ℕ) ^ 2 +
        (((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) * schattenNormReal H (2 * r : ℕ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := schattenNormReal_even_moment_smoothness_complex
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) (H.map Complex.ofReal) hr
  have hadd : A.map Complex.ofReal + H.map Complex.ofReal = (A + H).map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j; simp
  have hsub : A.map Complex.ofReal - H.map Complex.ofReal = (A - H).map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j; simp
  rw [hadd, hsub,
    schattenNormReal_complexification_even (A + H) hr,
    schattenNormReal_complexification_even (A - H) hr,
    schattenNormReal_complexification_even A hr,
    schattenNormReal_complexification_even H hr] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.apply_eq_sum_mul_single
statement:
theorem apply_eq_sum_mul_single (f : (ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    f x = ∑ i, f (Pi.single i 1) * x i
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single x, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h : Pi.single i (x i) = x i • Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext j
    by_cases hij : j = i <;> simp [hij]
  rw [h, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.Majorized.mem_convexHull_permutations
statement:
theorem Majorized.mem_convexHull_permutations {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y) :
    x ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hx
  have hclosed := (Set.finite_range (fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ)).isClosed_convexHull ℝ
  obtain ⟨f, u, hu, hux⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point
    (convex_convexHull ℝ _) hclosed hx
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hxy.exists_perm_sum_mul_le (fun i => f (Pi.single i 1))
  have hmem : y ∘ σ ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ) :=
    subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Set.mem_range_self σ)
  have hle : f x ≤ f (y ∘ σ) := by
    change f.toLinearMap x ≤ f.toLinearMap (y ∘ σ)
    rw [apply_eq_sum_mul_single f.toLinearMap x, apply_eq_sum_mul_single f.toLinearMap (y ∘ σ)]
    exact hσ
  exact (hle.trans_lt (hu _ hmem)).not_gt hux

name: NLAlib.mem_convexHull_permutations_iff_exists_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem mem_convexHull_permutations_iff_exists_doublyStochastic (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    x ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ) ↔
      ∃ D : Matrix ι ι ℝ, D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ ι ∧ D *ᵥ y = x
proof:
:= by
  let F : Matrix ι ι ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) := (Matrix.mulVecBilin ℝ ℝ).flip y
  have him : F '' {σ.permMatrix ℝ | σ : Equiv.Perm ι} =
      Set.range (fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨D, ⟨σ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨σ, by simp [F, LinearMap.flip_apply, Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec]⟩
    · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨σ.permMatrix ℝ, ⟨σ, rfl⟩,
        by simp [F, LinearMap.flip_apply, Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec]⟩
  rw [← him, ← F.image_convexHull, ← doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.majorized_iff_exists_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem majorized_iff_exists_doublyStochastic (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    Majorized x y ↔ ∃ D : Matrix ι ι ℝ, D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ ι ∧ D *ᵥ y = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    exact (mem_convexHull_permutations_iff_exists_doublyStochastic x y).mp
      hxy.mem_convexHull_permutations
  · rintro ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩
    exact majorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic y hD

name: NLAlib.majorized_iff_mem_convexHull_permutations
statement:
theorem majorized_iff_mem_convexHull_permutations (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    Majorized x y ↔ x ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_convexHull_permutations_iff_exists_doublyStochastic,
    majorized_iff_exists_doublyStochastic]

name: NLAlib.Majorized.sum_convex_le
statement:
theorem Majorized.sum_convex_le {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y)
    {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ) : (∑ i, φ (x i)) ≤ ∑ i, φ (y i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDx⟩ := (majorized_iff_exists_doublyStochastic x y).mp hxy
  rw [← hDx]
  exact sum_convex_mulVec_le_of_doublyStochastic y hD hφ

name: NLAlib.spectrum_mul_nonempty_and_sInf_nonneg_of_posDef_aux
statement:
private theorem spectrum_mul_nonempty_and_sInf_nonneg_of_posDef_aux [Nonempty n]
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (spectrum ℝ (A * B)).Nonempty ∧ 0 ≤ sInf (spectrum ℝ (A * B))
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA.inv hB.isHermitian
  change A⁻¹ = S * Sᵀ at hAA
  change B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ at hBB
  have hs : spectrum ℝ (A * B) = Set.range d := by
    simpa only [Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible] using
      spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB
  have hne : (spectrum ℝ (A * B)).Nonempty := hs ▸ Set.range_nonempty d
  refine ⟨hne, le_csInf hne ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  exact spectrum_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef hA hB.posSemidef hz

name: NLAlib.spectrum_mul_nonempty_of_posDef
statement:
theorem spectrum_mul_nonempty_of_posDef [Nonempty n]
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (spectrum ℝ (A * B)).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  (spectrum_mul_nonempty_and_sInf_nonneg_of_posDef_aux hA hB).1

name: NLAlib.sInf_spectrum_mul_nonneg_of_posDef
statement:
theorem sInf_spectrum_mul_nonneg_of_posDef [Nonempty n]
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    0 ≤ sInf (spectrum ℝ (A * B))
proof:
:=
  (spectrum_mul_nonempty_and_sInf_nonneg_of_posDef_aux hA hB).2

name: NLAlib.max_sInf_spectrum_mul_le_sInf_spectrum_hadamard
statement:
theorem max_sInf_spectrum_mul_le_sInf_spectrum_hadamard [Nonempty n]
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    max (sInf (spectrum ℝ (A * B))) (sInf (spectrum ℝ (A * Bᵀ))) ≤
      sInf (spectrum ℝ (A ⊙ B))
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have hBt : Bᵀ = B := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hB.isHermitian.eq
  rw [hBt, max_self]
  let c := sInf (spectrum ℝ (A * B))
  have hc := sInf_spectrum_mul_nonneg_of_posDef hA hB
  have hlow : c • A⁻¹ ≤ B := by
    apply (smul_le_iff_relative_spectrum_lower hA.inv hB.isHermitian c).mpr
    intro z hz
    rw [Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible] at hz
    exact csInf_le (A * B).finite_real_spectrum.bddBelow hz
  have hSchur := hadamard_le_hadamard_of_posSemidef_left hA.posSemidef hlow
  rw [Matrix.hadamard_smul] at hSchur
  have hunit : c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ c • (A ⊙ A⁻¹) :=
    smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (one_le_hadamard_inv hA) hc
  have hC : c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A ⊙ B := hunit.trans hSchur
  have hAB := hA.hadamard hB
  have hne : (spectrum ℝ (A ⊙ B)).Nonempty := by
    rw [hAB.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact Set.range_nonempty _
  apply le_csInf hne
  have h := (smul_le_iff_relative_spectrum_lower Matrix.PosDef.one hAB.isHermitian c).mp hC
  simpa only [inv_one, Matrix.one_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_range_rpow_le_of_pos_of_prod_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_rpow_le_of_pos_of_prod_le (x y : ℕ → ℝ) {N : ℕ}
    (hx : ∀ i < N, 0 < x i) (hy : ∀ i < N, 0 < y i)
    (hxa : Antitone x) (hya : Antitone y)
    (hprod : ∀ k ≤ N, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, x i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, y i)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, x i ^ p) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, y i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => Real.log (x i)
  let b : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => Real.log (y i)
  have ha : Antitone a := fun i j hij => Real.log_le_log (hx j j.isLt) (hxa hij)
  have hb : Antitone b := fun i j hij => Real.log_le_log (hy j j.isLt) (hya hij)
  have hab : WeaklyMajorized a b := by
    intro k hk
    have hkN : k ≤ N := by simpa using hk
    rw [sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone a ha, sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone b hb]
    rw [sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hkN (fun i => Real.log (x i)),
      sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hkN (fun i => Real.log (y i))]
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Finset.prod_pos (fun i hi => hx i (by
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hkN))) (hprod k hkN)
    rw [Real.log_prod (fun i hi => (hx i (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hkN)).ne'),
      Real.log_prod (fun i hi => (hy i (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hkN)).ne')] at hlog
    exact hlog
  have hmono : Monotone (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (p * u)) :=
    fun u v huv => Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huv hp.le)
  have hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (p * u)) := by
    convert! ConvexOn.comp_linearMap convexOn_exp (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ p) using 1
  have h := hab.sum_monotone_convex_le hmono hconv
  have heX (i : Fin N) : Real.exp (p * a i) = x i ^ p := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hx i i.isLt)]
    dsimp [a]
    rw [mul_comm]
  have heY (i : Fin N) : Real.exp (p * b i) = y i ^ p := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hy i i.isLt)]
    dsimp [b]
    rw [mul_comm]
  simp_rw [heX, heY] at h
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => x i ^ p) N,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => y i ^ p) N] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.sum_range_rpow_le_of_nonneg_of_prod_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_rpow_le_of_nonneg_of_prod_le (x y : ℕ → ℝ) {r : ℕ}
    (_hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (hxpos : ∀ i < r, 0 < x i) (hxzero : ∀ i, r ≤ i → x i = 0)
    (hxa : Antitone x) (hya : Antitone y)
    (hprod : ∀ k, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, x i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, y i)
    (N : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, x i ^ p) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, y i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let s := min r N
  have hsN : s ≤ N := min_le_right r N
  have hsr : s ≤ r := min_le_left r N
  have hxs (i : ℕ) (hi : i < s) : 0 < x i := hxpos i (hi.trans_le hsr)
  have hxp : 0 < ∏ i ∈ Finset.range s, x i := Finset.prod_pos fun i hi => hxs i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hyp : 0 < ∏ i ∈ Finset.range s, y i := hxp.trans_le (hprod s)
  have hys (i : ℕ) (hi : i < s) : 0 < y i := by
    by_contra h
    have hyi : y i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h) (hy0 i)
    have hzero : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range s, y j) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi) hyi
    rw [hzero] at hyp
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hyp
  have hpower := sum_range_rpow_le_of_pos_of_prod_le x y hxs hys hxa hya
    (fun k _ => hprod k) hp
  have hleft : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range s, x i ^ p) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, x i ^ p := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hsN)
    intro i hi hni
    have hir : r ≤ i := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi hni
      dsimp [s] at hni
      omega
    rw [hxzero i hir, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
  rw [hleft] at hpower
  exact hpower.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hsN) (fun i _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hy0 i) p))

name: NLAlib.sum_range_singularValues_mul_rpow_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_singularValues_mul_rpow_le {m n q : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n q ℝ) (N : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues (A * B) i ^ p) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (singularValues A i * singularValues B i) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_range_rpow_le_of_nonneg_of_prod_le
    (singularValues (A * B)) (fun i => singularValues A i * singularValues B i)
    (r := (A * B).rank) (singularValues_nonneg _)
    (fun i => mul_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) (singularValues_nonneg B i))
    (fun i hi => (singularValues_pos_iff _ i).mpr hi)
    (fun i hi => singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le _ hi) (singularValues_antitone _)
    (fun i j hij => mul_le_mul (singularValues_antitone A hij) (singularValues_antitone B hij)
      (singularValues_nonneg B j) (singularValues_nonneg A i))
    (prod_singularValues_mul_le A B) N hp

name: NLAlib.principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase_and_eq_iff_aux {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (T : Finset n) (hT : T.Nonempty) :
    principalMinor A T ^ (T.card - 1) ≤ ∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i) ∧
    (principalMinor A T ^ (T.card - 1) = (∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i)) ↔
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).IsDiag)
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty T := ⟨⟨hT.choose, hT.choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hM : (A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).PosDef := hA.submatrix Subtype.val_injective
  have h1 := det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton hM
  have h2 := det_pow_card_pred_eq_prod_complement_singleton_iff hM
  simp only [Fintype.card_coe, det_toBlock_complement_eq_principalMinor_erase] at h1 h2
  have hp : (∏ i : T, principalMinor A (T.erase i.val)) = ∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i) :=
    Finset.prod_coe_sort T (fun i => principalMinor A (T.erase i))
  rw [hp] at h1 h2
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: NLAlib.principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase
proof:
:=
  (principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase_and_eq_iff_aux hA T hT).1

name: NLAlib.principalMinor_pow_pred_eq_prod_erase_iff
statement:
theorem principalMinor_pow_pred_eq_prod_erase_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (T : Finset n) (hT : T.Nonempty) :
    principalMinor A T ^ (T.card - 1) = (∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i)) ↔
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).IsDiag
proof:
:=
  (principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase_and_eq_iff_aux hA T hT).2

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_succ_pow_le_of_posDef
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal (T : Finset n) (hT : T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1)) :
      principalMinor A T ^ k ≤ ∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i) := by
    have hc := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hT).2
    have hne : T.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
    simpa only [hc, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase hA T hne
  have hp := Finset.prod_le_prod
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1))
    (fun T _ => pow_nonneg (principalMinor_pos hA T).le k) hlocal
  rw [Finset.prod_pow, prod_powersetCard_prod_erase_eq_pow] at hp
  exact hp

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_succ_pow_le_of_posSemidef
proof:
:=
  le_of_posSemidef_of_continuous_of_forall_posDef (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    (fun M hM => principalMinorProduct_succ_pow_le_of_posDef hM k) hA

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_succ_pow_eq_iff_isDiag
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlocal (T : Finset n) (hT : T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1)) :
      principalMinor A T ^ k ≤ ∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i) ∧
      (principalMinor A T ^ k = (∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i)) ↔
        (A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).IsDiag) := by
    have hc := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hT).2
    have hne : T.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
    simpa only [hc, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using (principalMinor_pow_pred_le_prod_erase_and_eq_iff_aux hA T hne)
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hAll (T : Finset n) (hT : T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1)) :
        (A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).IsDiag := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hlt : principalMinor A T ^ k < ∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i) :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (hlocal T hT).1 (fun h => hnot ((hlocal T hT).2.mp h))
      have hp := Finset.prod_lt_prod
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1))
        (fun S _ => pow_pos (principalMinor_pos hA S) k)
        (fun S hS => (hlocal S hS).1) ⟨T, hT, hlt⟩
      rw [Finset.prod_pow, prod_powersetCard_prod_erase_eq_pow] at hp
      exact (ne_of_lt hp) heq
    intro i j hij
    obtain ⟨T, hpair, -, hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq
      (Finset.subset_univ ({i, j} : Finset n))
      (show ({i, j} : Finset n).card ≤ k + 1 by simp [hij]; omega)
      (show k + 1 ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset n).card by simpa using hkn)
    have hT : T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1) :=
      Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hcard⟩
    exact hAll T hT (i := ⟨i, hpair (by simp)⟩) (j := ⟨j, hpair (by simp)⟩)
      (fun h => hij (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  · intro hDiag
    have hp : (∏ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1), principalMinor A T ^ k) =
        ∏ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1), ∏ i ∈ T, principalMinor A (T.erase i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro T hT
      exact (hlocal T hT).2.mpr (hDiag.submatrix Subtype.val_injective)
    rw [Finset.prod_pow, prod_powersetCard_prod_erase_eq_pow] at hp
    exact hp

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_eq_nnnorm_of_spectrum_eq_range
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectralRadius, h, Pi.nnnorm_def, Finset.sup_univ_eq_ciSup,
    ENNReal.coe_iSup (Set.finite_range (fun i => ‖d i‖₊)).bddAbove]
  simp only [Set.mem_range, iSup_exists]
  rw [iSup_comm]
  simp

name: NLAlib.posDef_sub_iff_relative_spectralRadius_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB.isHermitian
  change A = S * Sᵀ at hAA
  change B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ at hBB
  have hdiff : A - B = S * diagonal (fun i => 1 - d i) * Sᵀ := by
    calc
      A - B = S * 1 * Sᵀ - S * diagonal d * Sᵀ := by rw [Matrix.mul_one, ← hAA, ← hBB]
      _ = S * (1 - diagonal d) * Sᵀ := by rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
      _ = S * diagonal (fun i => 1 - d i) * Sᵀ := by rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_sub]
  rw [hdiff]
  have hp : (S * diagonal (fun i => 1 - d i) * Sᵀ).PosDef ↔
      ∀ i, d i < 1 := by
    rw [show Sᵀ = star S from rfl, hS.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff, Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff]
    simp only [sub_pos]
  rw [hp, spectralRadius_eq_nnnorm_of_spectrum_eq_range
    (spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB)]
  rw [show (1 : ENNReal) = ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) from rfl, ENNReal.coe_lt_coe,
    ← NNReal.coe_lt_coe]
  change (∀ i, d i < 1) ↔ ‖d‖ < (1 : ℝ)
  rw [pi_norm_lt_iff zero_lt_one]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hd hB _)]

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_eq_specNorm_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_eq_specNorm_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    spectralRadius ℝ A = ENNReal.ofReal (specNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectralRadius_eq_nnnorm_of_spectrum_eq_range hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  have hn : specNorm A = ‖hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues‖ := by
    calc
      specNorm A = specNorm ((hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
          diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues *
          (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ) :=
        congrArg specNorm (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA.isHermitian)
      _ = ‖hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues‖ := by
        rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
          specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols
          (P := (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ))
          (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian),
          specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
            (P := (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ))
            (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian),
          specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  rw [hn]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal.symm

name: NLAlib.posDef_one_sub_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem posDef_one_sub_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : (1 - A).PosDef ↔ specNorm A < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [posDef_sub_iff_relative_spectralRadius_lt_one Matrix.PosDef.one hA, inv_one,
    Matrix.one_mul, spectralRadius_eq_specNorm_of_posSemidef hA]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff zero_lt_one]

name: NLAlib.map_pow_le_map_pow_of_posSemidef_le
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := (hB.nonneg.trans hBA).posSemidef
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have he : B.map (fun t => t ^ 0) = A.map (fun t => t ^ 0) := by ext i j; simp
    rw [he]
  | succ k ih =>
    have he (M : Matrix n n ℝ) : M.map (fun t => t ^ (k + 1)) = M.map (fun t => t ^ k) ⊙ M := by
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.hadamard_apply, pow_succ]
    rw [he, he]
    calc
      B.map (fun t => t ^ k) ⊙ B ≤ A.map (fun t => t ^ k) ⊙ B := by
        simpa only [Matrix.hadamard_comm] using hadamard_le_hadamard_of_posSemidef_left hB ih
      _ ≤ _ := hadamard_le_hadamard_of_posSemidef_left (posSemidef_map_pow hA k) hBA

name: NLAlib.sum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow_le_of_posSemidef_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow_le_of_posSemidef_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hBA : B ≤ A) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ • B.map (fun t => t ^ k)) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ • A.map (fun t => t ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k _
  exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (map_pow_le_map_pow_of_posSemidef_le hB hBA k) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.map_exp_le_map_exp_of_posSemidef_le
statement:
theorem map_exp_le_map_exp_of_posSemidef_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hBA : B ≤ A) : B.map Real.exp ≤ A.map Real.exp
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := (hasSum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow A).sub (hasSum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow B)
  apply posSemidef_of_hasSum _ hsum
  intro k
  rw [← smul_sub]
  exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp (map_pow_le_map_pow_of_posSemidef_le hB hBA k)).smul (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_of_nonneg_of_prefix_le
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_of_nonneg_of_prefix_le {n : ℕ} (a b c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (ha : Antitone a)
    (hp : ∀ k ≤ n, (∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then b i else 0) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then c i else 0) :
    (∑ i, a i * b i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * c i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < n then a ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < n then b ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
  let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < n then c ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
  have hs0 (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ s i := by dsimp [s]; split_ifs <;> simp [ha0]
  have hs : Antitone s := by
    intro i j hij
    by_cases hj : j < n
    · have hi : i < n := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
      simp only [s, dif_pos hi, dif_pos hj]
      exact ha hij
    · simp only [s, dif_neg hj]
      exact hs0 i
  have hprefix : ∀ k ≤ n, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, t i := by
    intro k hk
    have h := hp k hk
    have hd := sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hk d
    have hc := sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hk t
    simp only [d, t, dif_pos (Fin.isLt _)] at hd hc
    rwa [← hd, ← hc]
  have h := sum_range_mul_le_of_partial_le hs0 hs hprefix
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => s i * d i) n,
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => s i * t i) n] at h
  simpa only [s, d, t, dif_pos (Fin.isLt _)] using h

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.sum_sortedVector_mul_le
statement:
theorem WeaklyMajorized.sum_sortedVector_mul_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y) (a : ι → ℝ) (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    (∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector x i) ≤
      ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector y i
proof:
:=
  sum_mul_le_of_nonneg_of_prefix_le _ _ _ (fun i => ha0 (sortingEquiv a i))
    (sortedVector_antitone a) hxy

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le
statement:
theorem WeaklyMajorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y) (a : ι → ℝ) (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, (∑ i, a i * x i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * y (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  let σ : Equiv.Perm ι := (sortingEquiv a).symm.trans (sortingEquiv y)
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∑ i, a i * x i) ≤ ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector x i :=
      sum_mul_le_sum_sortedVector_mul a x
    _ ≤ ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector y i := hxy.sum_sortedVector_mul_le a ha0
    _ = ∑ i, a i * y (σ i) := by
      rw [← (sortingEquiv a).sum_comp (fun i => a i * y (σ i))]
      simp [sortedVector, σ]

name: NLAlib.card_filter_fin_lt
statement:
theorem card_filter_fin_lt {m k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter fun i => i.val < k).card = k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hkm : k < m
  · have he : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter fun i => i.val < k) =
        Finset.Iio (⟨k, hkm⟩ : Fin m) := by ext i; simp; rfl
    rw [he, Fin.card_Iio]
  · have hkm : k = m := by omega
    subst k
    simp

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone_of_sum_eq
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone_of_sum_eq {m k : ℕ}
    (a w : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1) (hk : k ≤ m) (hbudget : ∑ i, w i = (k : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, a i * w i) ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, if i.val < k then a i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m =>
    let c : ℝ := a (Fin.last m)
    have hshift (i : Fin (m + 1)) : 0 ≤ a i - c :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (ha (Fin.le_last i))
    have hanti : Antitone (fun i => a i - c) := fun i j hij => sub_le_sub_right (ha hij) c
    have h := sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone (fun i => a i - c) w
      hshift hanti hw0 hw1 hbudget.le
    have hleft : (∑ i, (a i - c) * w i) = (∑ i, a i * w i) - c * k := by
      simp_rw [sub_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hbudget]
    have hright : (∑ i : Fin (m + 1), if i.val < k then a i - c else 0) =
        (∑ i : Fin (m + 1), if i.val < k then a i else 0) - c * k := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
        card_filter_fin_lt hk, ← Finset.sum_filter]
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [hleft, hright] at h
    linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_mulVec_le_of_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem sum_mul_mulVec_le_of_doublyStochastic {n : ℕ}
    (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (hb : Antitone b)
    {D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hD : D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ (Fin n)) :
    (∑ i, a i * (D *ᵥ b) i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hab : Monovary a b := by
    rw [monovary_iff_forall_mul_nonneg]
    intro i j
    rcases le_total i j with hij | hji
    · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (ha hij))
        (sub_nonpos.mpr (hb hij))
    · exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (ha hji)) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hb hji))
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw1, hwD⟩ := exists_eq_sum_perm_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD
  rw [← hwD, Matrix.sum_mulVec]
  simp_rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ i, a i * (w σ * (σ.permMatrix ℝ *ᵥ b) i)) =
        ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), w σ * ∑ i, a i * b (σ i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      rw [Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      ring
    _ ≤ ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), w σ * ∑ i, a i * b i := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro σ _
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hw0 σ)
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hab.sum_smul_comp_perm_le_sum_smul (σ := σ)
    _ = ∑ i, a i * b i := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hw1, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.sum_convex_mulVec_le_of_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem sum_convex_mulVec_le_of_doublyStochastic {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (y : ι → ℝ) {D : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hD : D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ ι)
    {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ) :
    (∑ i, φ ((D *ᵥ y) i)) ≤ ∑ i, φ (y i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i, φ ((D *ᵥ y) i)) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, D i j * φ (y j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] using
        hφ.map_sum_le (fun j _ => nonneg_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD)
          (sum_row_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD i) (fun j _ => Set.mem_univ (y j))
    _ = ∑ j, φ (y j) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_col_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD j, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.posDef_extreme_eigenvalues_sandwich
statement:
theorem posDef_extreme_eigenvalues_sandwich {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    let a
proof:
:= hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩
    let b := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, hN⟩
    0 < a ∧ a ≤ b ∧ a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A ∧ A ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
  let lo : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩
  let hi : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨0, hN⟩
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have hpos : 0 < hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ lo := by
    simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hA.eigenvalues_pos (e lo)
  refine ⟨hpos, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone (by exact Nat.zero_le _), ?_⟩
  apply (loewner_sandwich_iff_relative_spectrum_subset Matrix.PosDef.one hA.isHermitian _ _).mpr
  simp only [inv_one, Matrix.one_mul, hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone (by exact Nat.le_pred_of_lt (Fin.isLt _)),
    hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone (by exact Nat.zero_le _)⟩

name: NLAlib.sq_add_div_four_mul_eq_sq_sqrt_ratio
statement:
theorem sq_add_div_four_mul_eq_sq_sqrt_ratio {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (4 * a * b) =
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (b / a) + (Real.sqrt (b / a))⁻¹) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let t := Real.sqrt (b / a)
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (div_pos hb ha)
  have hs : t ^ 2 = b / a := Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hb.le ha.le)
  calc
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (4 * a * b) = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ((b / a + 1) ^ 2 / (b / a)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ((t ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 / t ^ 2) := by rw [hs]
    _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (t + t⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      congr 1
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.ker_mulVecLin_eq_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem ker_mulVecLin_eq_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
    (hrank : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).rank = A.rank) :
    LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.ker (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ≤
      LinearMap.ker (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).mulVecLin := by
    intro x hx
    exact selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hA hx
  apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hker
  have hdA := A.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hdH := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  unfold Matrix.rank at hrank
  omega

name: NLAlib.selfAdjointPart_submatrix
statement:
theorem selfAdjointPart_submatrix (A : Matrix n n ℂ) {m : Type*} (e : m → n) :
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ (A.submatrix e e) : Matrix m m ℂ) =
      (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).submatrix e e
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef) : IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ x : n → ℂ, A *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hHx := selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hA.posSemidef hx
    exact (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hA.isUnit)
      (hHx.trans (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm)
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  exact hzero (x - y) (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxy, sub_self])

name: NLAlib.isUnit_submatrix_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem isUnit_submatrix_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef)
    {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (e : m → n) (he : Function.Injective e) :
    IsUnit (A.submatrix e e)
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart
  rw [selfAdjointPart_submatrix]
  exact hA.submatrix he

name: NLAlib.hasRowInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem hasRowInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
    (hrank : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).rank = A.rank) :
    HasRowInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  apply hasRowInclusion_of_prefix_kernel
  intro i x hx hAx
  have hquad : quadForm A x = 0 := by
    unfold quadForm dotProduct
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : j < i
    · simp [hAx j hj]
    · simp [hx j hj]
  have hH : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ x = 0 := by
    apply (hA.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff x).mp
    change quadForm (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) x = 0
    rw [quadForm_selfAdjointPart, hquad]
    rfl
  have hzero : A *ᵥ x = 0 := by
    have hh : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).mulVecLin := hH
    rw [← ker_mulVecLin_eq_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq hA hrank] at hh
    exact hh
  exact congrFun hzero i

name: NLAlib.hasColumnInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem hasColumnInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
    (hrank : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).rank = A.rank) :
    HasColumnInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  have hpart : (selfAdjointPart ℝ Aᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) = selfAdjointPart ℝ A := by
    simp [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, add_comm]
  have hRow : HasRowInclusion Aᴴ :=
    hasRowInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq (hpart.symm ▸ hA)
      (by rw [hpart, Matrix.rank_conjTranspose]; exact hrank)
  intro i
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcoeff⟩ := hRow i
  refine ⟨star c, fun j hj => by simp [hc j hj], ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have h := congrArg star (hcoeff k hk)
  simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, map_sum, star_mul, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.hasRowInclusion_and_hasColumnInclusion_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem hasRowInclusion_and_hasColumnInclusion_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef) :
    HasRowInclusion A ∧ HasColumnInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).rank = A.rank := by
    rw [Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hA.isUnit,
      Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ (isUnit_of_posDef_selfAdjointPart hA)]
  exact ⟨hasRowInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq hA.posSemidef hrank,
    hasColumnInclusion_of_posSemidef_selfAdjointPart_of_rank_eq hA.posSemidef hrank⟩

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_normalized_succ_le
statement:
theorem principalMinorProduct_normalized_succ_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < Fintype.card n) :
    principalMinorProduct A (k + 1) ^ (1 / ((Fintype.card n - 1).choose k : ℝ)) ≤
      principalMinorProduct A k ^ (1 / ((Fintype.card n - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply (rpow_inv_choose_compare_iff_pow_compare hk hkn
    (principalMinorProduct_nonneg hA k) (principalMinorProduct_nonneg hA (k + 1))).1.mpr
  exact principalMinorProduct_succ_pow_le_of_posSemidef hA k

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_normalized_succ_eq_iff_isDiag
statement:
theorem principalMinorProduct_normalized_succ_eq_iff_isDiag {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < Fintype.card n) :
    principalMinorProduct A (k + 1) ^ (1 / ((Fintype.card n - 1).choose k : ℝ)) =
      principalMinorProduct A k ^ (1 / ((Fintype.card n - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ)) ↔ A.IsDiag
proof:
:= by
  rw [(rpow_inv_choose_compare_iff_pow_compare hk hkn
    (principalMinorProduct_pos hA k).le (principalMinorProduct_pos hA (k + 1)).le).2]
  exact principalMinorProduct_succ_pow_eq_iff_isDiag hA hk hkn

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_normalized_antitone
statement:
theorem principalMinorProduct_normalized_antitone {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k l : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkl : k ≤ l) (hln : l ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    principalMinorProduct A l ^ (1 / ((Fintype.card n - 1).choose (l - 1) : ℝ)) ≤
      principalMinorProduct A k ^ (1 / ((Fintype.card n - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  revert hln
  induction l, hkl using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => intro _; exact le_rfl
  | succ l hkl ih =>
    intro hln
    have hstep := principalMinorProduct_normalized_succ_le hA (hk.trans hkl)
      (show l < Fintype.card n by omega)
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hstep ⊢
    exact hstep.trans (ih (by omega))

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_eq
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (d u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (α β : ℝ) (hAu : A *ᵥ u = α • u) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = β • v)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i, u i * v i = 0) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∑ i, ((planeRotation u v c s * A * (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ) i i - d i) ^ 2) -
      (∑ i, (A i i - d i) ^ 2) =
      2 * s ^ 2 * (β - α) * (∑ i, (A i i - d i) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2)) +
        s ^ 4 * (β - α) ^ 2 * (∑ i, (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_apply_diag_of_disjoint_eigenvectors
    A hA u v hu hv huv α β hAu hAv hdisjoint c s hcs]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_quadratic_neg
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (η / (δ * (K + 1)))
  have hden : 0 < δ * (K + 1) := mul_pos hδ (by linarith)
  have hh : 0 < h := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hη hden)
  have hh1 : h ≤ 1 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (by norm_num)
  have hbudget : h * (δ * (K + 1)) ≤ η :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp (min_le_right _ _)
  have hhδ : 0 < h * δ := mul_pos hh hδ
  have hlin : h * δ * K ≤ η := by nlinarith
  have hquad : h ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 * K ≤ h * δ * η := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlin hhδ.le
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨h, hh, hh1, ?_⟩
  have hneg : 0 < h * δ * η := mul_pos hhδ hη
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_le_of_diagonal_error_min
statement:
theorem eigenvalue_le_of_diagonal_error_min
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (d u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (α β : ℝ) (hAu : A *ᵥ u = α • u) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = β • v)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i, u i * v i = 0)
    (hη : 0 < ∑ i, (A i i - d i) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2))
    (hmin : ∀ R : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols R →
      (∑ i, (A i i - d i) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i, ((R * A * Rᵀ) i i - d i) ^ 2) :
    α ≤ β
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hδ : 0 < α - β := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
  let η := ∑ i, (A i i - d i) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2)
  let K := ∑ i, (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2) ^ 2
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨h, hh0, hh1, hneg⟩ := exists_pos_quadratic_neg hδ hη hK
  let c : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 - h)
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt h
  have hc : c ^ 2 = 1 - h := Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hh1)
  have hs : s ^ 2 = h := Real.sq_sqrt hh0.le
  have hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hc, hs]; ring
  have horth := hasOrthonormalCols_planeRotation u v hu hv huv c s hcs
  have hbound := hmin (planeRotation u v c s) horth
  have hdiff := sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_eq
    A hA d u v hu hv huv α β hAu hAv hdisjoint c s hcs
  have hs4 : s ^ 4 = h ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s ^ 2 - h)]
  change _ = 2 * s ^ 2 * (β - α) * η + s ^ 4 * (β - α) ^ 2 * K at hdiff
  rw [hs, hs4] at hdiff
  have heq : 2 * h * (β - α) * η + h ^ 2 * (β - α) ^ 2 * K =
      -2 * h * (α - β) * η + h ^ 2 * (α - β) ^ 2 * K := by ring
  rw [heq] at hdiff
  linarith

name: NLAlib.quadForm_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem quadForm_fromBlocks (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : m → ℝ) (y : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) (Sum.elim x y) =
      quadForm A x + 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y) + quadForm C y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    sumElim_dotProduct_sumElim, dotProduct_add, Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
statement:
theorem sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef) (x : m → ℝ) (y : n → ℝ) :
    (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y) ^ 2 ≤ quadForm A x * quadForm C y
proof:
:= by
  have hpoly : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ quadForm A x * (t * t) +
      (2 * (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y)) * t + quadForm C y := by
    intro t
    have h := hH.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Sum.elim (t • x) y)
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    change 0 ≤ quadForm (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) (Sum.elim (t • x) y) at h
    rw [quadForm_fromBlocks] at h
    simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
    nlinarith
  have h := discrim_le_zero hpoly
  dsimp [discrim] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.two_abs_bilinear_le_quadForm_add_of_sq_le
statement:
theorem two_abs_bilinear_le_quadForm_add_of_sq_le
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hC : C.PosSemidef)
    (h : ∀ x y, (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y) ^ 2 ≤ quadForm A x * quadForm C y) :
    ∀ x y, 2 * |x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y| ≤ quadForm A x + quadForm C y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  have ha : 0 ≤ quadForm A x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  have hc : 0 ≤ quadForm C y := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hC.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg y
  have hb := h x y
  nlinarith [sq_abs (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y), abs_nonneg (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y),
    sq_nonneg (quadForm A x - quadForm C y)]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_posSemidef_of_two_abs_bilinear_le_quadForm_add
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_posSemidef_of_two_abs_bilinear_le_quadForm_add
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian)
    (h : ∀ x y, 2 * |x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y| ≤ quadForm A x + quadForm C y) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    (hA.fromBlocks (by simp) hC)
  intro z
  have hz : z = Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) := by ext i; cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hz]
  simp only [star_trivial]
  change 0 ≤ quadForm (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) (Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr))
  rw [quadForm_fromBlocks]
  have hxy := h (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)
  linarith [neg_abs_le ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ (z ∘ Sum.inr))]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff_bilinear_tests
statement:
theorem posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff_bilinear_tests
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hC : C.PosSemidef) :
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef ↔
      ∀ x y, (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y) ^ 2 ≤ quadForm A x * quadForm C y) ∧
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef ↔
      ∀ x y, 2 * |x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y| ≤ quadForm A x + quadForm C y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef (A := A) (B := B) (C := C)
  have h2 := two_abs_bilinear_le_quadForm_add_of_sq_le (B := B) hA hC
  have h3 := fromBlocks_posSemidef_of_two_abs_bilinear_le_quadForm_add (B := B) hA.isHermitian hC.isHermitian
  exact ⟨⟨h1, fun h => h3 (h2 h)⟩, ⟨fun h => h2 (h1 h), h3⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.sq_bilinear_lt_quadForm_mul_of_fromBlocks_posDef
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.PosDef := hH.submatrix (Sum.inl_injective : Function.Injective (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n))
  have ha : 0 < quadForm A x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
  have hpoly : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < quadForm A x * (t * t) +
      (2 * (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y)) * t + quadForm C y := by
    intro t
    have hz : Sum.elim (t • x) y ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      apply hy
      exact funext fun i => congrFun he (Sum.inr i)
    have h := hH.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hz
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    change 0 < quadForm (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) (Sum.elim (t • x) y) at h
    rw [quadForm_fromBlocks] at h
    simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
    nlinarith
  have h := discrim_lt_zero (ne_of_gt ha) hpoly
  dsimp [discrim] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.two_abs_bilinear_lt_quadForm_add_of_sq_lt
statement:
theorem two_abs_bilinear_lt_quadForm_add_of_sq_lt
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef)
    (h : ∀ x y, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y) ^ 2 < quadForm A x * quadForm C y) :
    ∀ x y, x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 → 2 * |x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y| < quadForm A x + quadForm C y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    have hy := hxy.resolve_left (not_ne_iff.mpr rfl)
    have hc := hC.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hy
    simpa [quadForm] using hc
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · subst y
    have ha := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
    simpa [quadForm] using ha
  have ha : 0 < quadForm A x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
  have hc : 0 < quadForm C y := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hC.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hy
  have hb := h x y hx hy
  nlinarith [sq_abs (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y), abs_nonneg (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y),
    sq_nonneg (quadForm A x - quadForm C y)]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_posDef_of_two_abs_bilinear_lt_quadForm_add
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_posDef_of_two_abs_bilinear_lt_quadForm_add
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian)
    (h : ∀ x y, x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 → 2 * |x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y| < quadForm A x + quadForm C y) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (hA.fromBlocks (by simp) hC)
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z = Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) := by ext i; cases i <;> rfl
  have hxy : z ∘ Sum.inl ≠ 0 ∨ z ∘ Sum.inr ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hh
    simp only [not_or, not_not] at hh
    apply hz
    rw [hz', hh.1, hh.2]
    ext i
    cases i <;> rfl
  have hb := h (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) hxy
  rw [hz']
  simp only [star_trivial]
  change 0 < quadForm (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) (Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr))
  rw [quadForm_fromBlocks]
  linarith [neg_abs_le ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ (z ∘ Sum.inr))]

name: NLAlib.posDef_fromBlocks_iff_strict_bilinear_tests
statement:
theorem posDef_fromBlocks_iff_strict_bilinear_tests
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef) :
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔
      ∀ x y, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y) ^ 2 < quadForm A x * quadForm C y) ∧
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔
      ∀ x y, x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 → 2 * |x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y| < quadForm A x + quadForm C y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := fun h x y hx hy => sq_bilinear_lt_quadForm_mul_of_fromBlocks_posDef
    (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) h (x := x) (y := y) hx hy
  have h2 := two_abs_bilinear_lt_quadForm_add_of_sq_lt (B := B) hA hC
  have h3 := fromBlocks_posDef_of_two_abs_bilinear_lt_quadForm_add (B := B) hA.isHermitian hC.isHermitian
  exact ⟨⟨h1, fun h => h3 (h2 h)⟩, ⟨fun h => h2 (h1 h), h3⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.columnProjectionMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem columnProjectionMass_nonneg (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) (j : n) :
    0 ≤ columnProjectionMass Q S j
proof: := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.columnProjectionMass_le_one
statement:
theorem columnProjectionMass_le_one {Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (S : Finset n) (j : n) : columnProjectionMass Q S j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hD := sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic hQ
  rw [← sum_col_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD j]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun i _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.sum_columnProjectionMass_eq_card
statement:
theorem sum_columnProjectionMass_eq_card {Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (S : Finset n) : (∑ j, columnProjectionMass Q S j) = (S.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic hQ
  unfold columnProjectionMass
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have hrow (i : n) : (∑ j, Q i j ^ 2) = 1 := sum_row_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD i
  simp_rw [hrow]
  simp

name: NLAlib.columnProjectionMass_compl
statement:
theorem columnProjectionMass_compl {Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (S : Finset n) (j : n) : columnProjectionMass Q Sᶜ j = 1 - columnProjectionMass Q S j
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S (fun i => Q i j ^ 2)
  have hcol : (∑ i, Q i j ^ 2) = 1 := sum_col_of_mem_doublyStochastic (sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic hQ) j
  rw [hcol] at hsum
  unfold columnProjectionMass
  linarith

name: NLAlib.projectedColumn_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem projectedColumn_dotProduct_self (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) (j : n) :
    projectedColumn Q S j ⬝ᵥ projectedColumn Q S j = columnProjectionMass Q S j
proof:
:= by
  simp [projectedColumn, dotProduct, columnProjectionMass, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_eq_one_iff_dotProduct_self_eq_one
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_eq_one_iff_dotProduct_self_eq_one (x : n → ℝ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1 ↔ x ⬝ᵥ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_normalizedProjectedColumn
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_normalizedProjectedColumn (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) (j : n)
    (hj : 0 < columnProjectionMass Q S j) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_one_iff_dotProduct_self_eq_one]
  have hs : Real.sqrt (columnProjectionMass Q S j) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hj).ne'
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (columnProjectionMass_nonneg Q S j)
  unfold normalizedProjectedColumn
  rw [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, projectedColumn_dotProduct_self]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n)
    (j i : n) (hi : i ∉ S) : normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedProjectedColumn, projectedColumn, hi]

name: NLAlib.normalizedProjectedColumn_mul_compl_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedProjectedColumn_mul_compl_eq_zero (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n)
    (j k i : n) : normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j i * normalizedProjectedColumn Q Sᶜ k i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · rw [normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem Q Sᶜ k i (by simpa using hi), mul_zero]
  · rw [normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem Q S j i hi, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.normalizedProjectedColumn_dotProduct_compl_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedProjectedColumn_dotProduct_compl_eq_zero (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n)
    (j k : n) : normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j ⬝ᵥ normalizedProjectedColumn Q Sᶜ k = 0
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => normalizedProjectedColumn_mul_compl_eq_zero Q S j k i)

name: NLAlib.mulVec_column_eq_smul_of_orthogonal_diagonalization
proof:
:= by
  have hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal lam := by
    calc
      A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * (Qᵀ * Q) := by rw [hA]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Q * Matrix.diagonal lam := by rw [(show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.mul_one]
  funext i
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M i j) hAQ
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_columnProjectionMass_eq_sum_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag (i : n) : A i i = ∑ j, lam j * Q i j ^ 2 := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  simp_rw [columnProjectionMass, Finset.mul_sum, hdiag]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_commute_of_cross_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_commute_of_cross_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Finset n) (hcross : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ k ∉ S, A i k = 0) :
    A * coordinateSelector S = coordinateSelector S * A
proof:
:= by
  have hs (i k : n) : A i k = A k i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M k i) hA.eq
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  ext i k
  rw [coordinateSelector, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hk : k ∈ S
  · simp [hi, hk]
  · simp [hi, hk, hcross i hi k hk]
  · simp [hi, hk, hs i k, hcross k hk i hi]
  · simp [hi, hk]

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_mulVec_column
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_mulVec_column (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) (j : n) :
    coordinateSelector S *ᵥ (fun i => Q i j) = projectedColumn Q S j
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [coordinateSelector, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  simp [projectedColumn]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_projectedColumn_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mulVec_projectedColumn_eq_smul {A Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (lam : n → ℝ) (hA : A = Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) (S : Finset n)
    (hcomm : A * coordinateSelector S = coordinateSelector S * A) (j : n) :
    A *ᵥ projectedColumn Q S j = lam j • projectedColumn Q S j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinateSelector_mulVec_column Q S j, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hcomm,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_column_eq_smul_of_orthogonal_diagonalization hQ lam hA j,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_normalizedProjectedColumn_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mulVec_normalizedProjectedColumn_eq_smul {A Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (lam : n → ℝ) (hA : A = Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) (S : Finset n)
    (hcomm : A * coordinateSelector S = coordinateSelector S * A) (j : n) :
    A *ᵥ normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j = lam j • normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedProjectedColumn
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, mulVec_projectedColumn_eq_smul hQ lam hA S hcomm]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: NLAlib.coordinateSelector_compl_commute
statement:
theorem coordinateSelector_compl_commute {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (S : Finset n)
    (hcomm : A * coordinateSelector S = coordinateSelector S * A) :
    A * coordinateSelector Sᶜ = coordinateSelector Sᶜ * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSelector_compl, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul, hcomm]

name: NLAlib.exists_projectedColumn_pair
statement:
theorem exists_projectedColumn_pair {A Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (lam : n → ℝ) (hFactor : A = Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Finset n) (hcross : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ k ∉ S, A i k = 0) (j k : n)
    (hj : 0 < columnProjectionMass Q S j) (hk : columnProjectionMass Q S k < 1) :
    ∃ u v : n → ℝ, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1 ∧
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 ∧
      A *ᵥ u = lam j • u ∧ A *ᵥ v = lam k • v ∧ (∀ i, u i * v i = 0) ∧
      (∀ i ∉ S, u i = 0) ∧ (∀ i ∈ S, v i = 0)
proof:
:= by
