  have hcomm := coordinateSelector_commute_of_cross_eq_zero hA S hcross
  have hcommc := coordinateSelector_compl_commute S hcomm
  have hkc : 0 < columnProjectionMass Q Sᶜ k := by
    rw [columnProjectionMass_compl hQ]
    linarith
  refine ⟨normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j, normalizedProjectedColumn Q Sᶜ k,
    norm_toLp_normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j hj,
    norm_toLp_normalizedProjectedColumn Q Sᶜ k hkc,
    normalizedProjectedColumn_dotProduct_compl_eq_zero Q S j k,
    mulVec_normalizedProjectedColumn_eq_smul hQ lam hFactor S hcomm j,
    mulVec_normalizedProjectedColumn_eq_smul hQ lam hFactor Sᶜ hcommc k,
    fun i => normalizedProjectedColumn_mul_compl_eq_zero Q S j k i,
    fun i hi => normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem Q S j i hi,
    fun i hi => normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem Q Sᶜ k i (by simpa using hi)⟩

name: NLAlib.isCompact_orthogonalMatrices
statement: theorem isCompact_orthogonalMatrices : IsCompact {Q : Matrix n n ℝ | HasOrthonormalCols Q}
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let L := Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℝ ℝ e.symm e.symm
  let F : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ → Matrix n n ℝ := fun O => L O.val
  have hF : Continuous F := L.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have heq : Set.range F = {Q : Matrix n n ℝ | HasOrthonormalCols Q} := by
    ext Q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨O, rfl⟩
      exact (show HasOrthonormalCols O.val from transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup O).reindex e.symm e.symm
    · intro hQ
      let O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ :=
        ⟨Q.reindex e e, (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ).mpr (hQ.reindex e e)⟩
      refine ⟨O, ?_⟩
      ext i j
      simp [F, L, O, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  rw [← heq]
  exact isCompact_range hF

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_isMinOn_of_continuous
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_isMinOn_of_continuous (F : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ) (hF : Continuous F) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧
      ∀ R : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols R → F Q ≤ F R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hmin⟩ := isCompact_orthogonalMatrices.exists_isMinOn
    ⟨1, by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]⟩ hF.continuousOn
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, fun R hR => hmin hR⟩

name: NLAlib.prod_eigenvalues_eq_prod_sorted
statement:
theorem prod_eigenvalues_eq_prod_sorted {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : n, f (hA.eigenvalues i)) = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  rw [← e.prod_comp (fun i : n => f (hA.eigenvalues i))]
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.det_transpose_mul_mul_le_prod_eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (Qᵀ * G * Q).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc] using hG.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same Qᵀ
  have hd : (Qᵀ * G * Q).det = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card r), hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i := by
    calc
      _ = ∏ i : r, hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by
        simpa using hC.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues
      _ = _ := prod_eigenvalues_eq_prod_sorted hC.isHermitian (fun x => x)
  rw [hd]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  · intro i _
    exact eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hC i
  · intro i _
    exact Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le hG.isHermitian hQ i

name: NLAlib.det_gram_mul_le_prod_sq_singularValues
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (Aᵀ * A).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  have h := det_transpose_mul_mul_le_prod_eigenvalues₀ hG hQ
  have hkn : k ≤ n := by simpa using card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
  rw [show (Qᵀ * Aᵀ) * (A * Q) = Qᵀ * (Aᵀ * A) * Q by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]]
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  rw [← (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin k).symm).prod_comp]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hi : singularValues A (Fin.castLE hkn i) ^ 2 =
      hG.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm (Fin.castLE hkn i)) :=
    sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm (Fin.castLE hkn i))
  simpa only [Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_cast, Fin.castLE, Fin.cast, finCongr_apply] using hi.symm

name: NLAlib.sq_max_sum_sub_tail_le_card_mul_sum_sq
statement:
theorem sq_max_sum_sub_tail_le_card_mul_sum_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℝ) (_hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (S : Finset ι) {r : ℕ} (hcard : S.card ≤ r)
    {τ : ℝ} (htail : (∑ i, if i ∉ S then d i else 0) ≤ τ) :
    (max ((∑ i, d i) - τ) 0) ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℝ) * ∑ i, d i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hhead : (∑ i, if i ∈ S then d i else 0) = ∑ i ∈ S, d i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    simp
  have hsum : (∑ i, d i) = (∑ i ∈ S, d i) + ∑ i, if i ∉ S then d i else 0 := by
    rw [← hhead, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> simp [hi]
  have hlow : (∑ i, d i) - τ ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, d i := by rw [hsum]; linarith
  have hcs : (∑ i ∈ S, d i) ^ 2 ≤ (S.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ S, d i ^ 2 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq S (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) d
    simpa only [one_mul, one_pow, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using h
  have hsq : (∑ i ∈ S, d i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i, d i ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun i _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hcard' : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  have henergy : (∑ i ∈ S, d i) ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℝ) * ∑ i, d i ^ 2 :=
    hcs.trans (mul_le_mul hcard' hsq (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  by_cases hu : (∑ i, d i) ≤ τ
  · rw [max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hu), zero_pow two_ne_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  · rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hu).le)]
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hu).le) hlow 2).trans henergy

name: NLAlib.sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted
statement:
theorem sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : n, f (hA.eigenvalues i)) = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  rw [← e.sum_comp (fun i : n => f (hA.eigenvalues i))]
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : 0 ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.eigenvalues_nonneg (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i)
  simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.re_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀
statement:
private theorem re_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    RCLike.re A.trace = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), hA.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues, map_sum]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re]
  exact sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA (fun x => x)

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_self_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀_sq
statement:
private theorem re_trace_mul_self_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀_sq {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    RCLike.re (A * A).trace = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), hA.eigenvalues₀ i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_two]
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem, ← map_pow]
  rw [trace_conjStarAlgAut, Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal, map_sum]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply, Function.comp_apply, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  exact sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA (fun x => x ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.spectralTraceTail_nonneg
statement:
theorem spectralTraceTail_nonneg {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (r : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · exact eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA i
  · exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.spectralTraceTail_le_trace
statement:
theorem spectralTraceTail_le_trace {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (r : ℕ) :
    spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ≤ RCLike.re A.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ hA.isHermitian]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA i

name: NLAlib.sq_max_re_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_of_eigenvalues₀_le
statement:
theorem sq_max_re_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_of_eigenvalues₀_le
    {A R : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hR : R.PosSemidef)
    (hle : ∀ i, hR.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i) (r : ℕ) :
    (max (RCLike.re R.trace - spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) 0) ^ 2 ≤
      (r : ℝ) * RCLike.re (R * R).trace
proof:
:= by
  let d := hR.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
  let S := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).filter
    fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (i : ℕ) < r
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i := eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hR
  have hcard : S.card ≤ r := by
    have hi : S.image Fin.val ⊆ Finset.range r := by
      intro i hi
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    calc S.card = (S.image Fin.val).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injective S Fin.val_injective).symm
      _ ≤ (Finset.range r).card := Finset.card_le_card hi
      _ = r := Finset.card_range r
  have htail : (∑ i, if i ∉ S then d i else 0) ≤ spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r := by
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt, spectralTraceTail]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    split_ifs
    · exact hle i
    · exact le_rfl
  rw [re_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ hR.isHermitian, re_trace_mul_self_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀_sq]
  exact sq_max_sum_sub_tail_le_card_mul_sum_sq d hd S hcard htail

name: NLAlib.sq_max_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_mul_trace_sq
statement:
theorem sq_max_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_mul_trace_sq
    {A R : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hR : R.PosSemidef)
    (hRA : R ≤ A) (r : ℕ) :
    (max (R.trace - spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) 0) ^ 2 ≤
      (r : ℝ) * (R * R).trace
proof:
:=
  sq_max_re_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_of_eigenvalues₀_le hA hR
    (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hR.isHermitian hA.isHermitian hRA) r

name: NLAlib.rank_le_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rank_le_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {r : ℕ} (ht : spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0) : A.rank ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ j : Fin (Fintype.card n), r ≤ (j : ℕ) → hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hn : ∀ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), 0 ≤ if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then
        hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i else 0 := by
      intro i
      split_ifs
      · exact eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA i
      · exact le_rfl
    have h := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hn i)).mp ht j (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simpa only [if_pos hj] using h
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let f : {i : n // hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≠ 0} → Fin r := fun i =>
    ⟨(e.symm i.val).val, by
      by_contra hi
      have hz := hzero (e.symm i.val) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hi)
      apply i.property
      simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e] using hz⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply e.symm.injective
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : Fin r => z.val) hij
  rw [hA.isHermitian.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs]
  exact (Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf).trans (Fintype.card_fin r).le

name: NLAlib.det_principal_union_eq_det_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem det_principal_union_eq_det_fromBlocks {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (s t : Finset n) (hst : Disjoint s t) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ s ∪ t) (· ∈ s ∪ t)).det =
      (fromBlocks (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ s)) (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ t))
        (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ t))ᵀ (A.toBlock (· ∈ t) (· ∈ t))).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Equiv.Finset.union s t hst
  have hsym (i j : n) : A i j = A j i := by simpa using hA.apply j i
  have hm : (A.toBlock (· ∈ s ∪ t) (· ∈ s ∪ t)).submatrix e e =
      fromBlocks (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ s)) (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ t))
        (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ t))ᵀ (A.toBlock (· ∈ t) (· ∈ t)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> first | rfl | exact hsym _ _
  rw [← hm, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]

name: NLAlib.det_principal_three_sets_le_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem det_principal_three_sets_le_and_eq_iff_aux {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (I J K : Finset n) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIK : Disjoint I K) (hJK : Disjoint J K) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)) (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K))).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I)).det ≤
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ J) (· ∈ I ∪ J)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ K) (· ∈ I ∪ K)).det ∧
    ((A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)) (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K))).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I)).det =
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ J) (· ∈ I ∪ J)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ K) (· ∈ I ∪ K)).det ↔
      A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ K) -
        A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ I) * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I))⁻¹ *
          A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ K) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P := A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I)
  let U := A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ J)
  let V := A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ K)
  let D := A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ J)
  let E := A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ K)
  let F := A.toBlock (· ∈ K) (· ∈ K)
  let H := fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks D E Eᵀ F)
  have hIJK : Disjoint I (J ∪ K) := Finset.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hIJ, hIK⟩
  let eJK := Equiv.Finset.union J K hJK
  let e : (I ⊕ (J ⊕ K)) ≃ (I ∪ (J ∪ K) : Finset n) :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl I) eJK).trans (Equiv.Finset.union I (J ∪ K) hIJK)
  let f : I ⊕ (J ⊕ K) → n := fun i => (e i).val
  have hsym (i j : n) : A i j = A j i := by simpa using hA.isHermitian.apply j i
  have hRep : A.submatrix f f = H := by
    ext i j
    rcases i with i | (i | i) <;> rcases j with j | (j | j) <;>
      first | rfl | exact hsym _ _
  have hH : H.PosDef := by
    rw [← hRep]
    exact hA.submatrix (Subtype.val_injective.comp e.injective)
  have hDetH : H.det = (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)) (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K))).det := by
    rw [← hRep]
    exact Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)) (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)))
  have hUt : Uᵀ = A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ I) := by
    ext i j
    exact hsym _ _
  have h := And.intro (det_overlapping_blocks_le P U V D E F hH)
    (det_overlapping_blocks_eq_iff P U V D E F hH)
  change (H.det * P.det ≤ _ ∧ (H.det * P.det = _ ↔ _)) at h
  rw [hDetH, ← det_principal_union_eq_det_fromBlocks hA.isHermitian I J hIJ,
    ← det_principal_union_eq_det_fromBlocks hA.isHermitian I K hIK, hUt] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.det_principal_three_sets_le
statement:
theorem det_principal_three_sets_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (I J K : Finset n) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIK : Disjoint I K) (hJK : Disjoint J K) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)) (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K))).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I)).det ≤
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ J) (· ∈ I ∪ J)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ K) (· ∈ I ∪ K)).det
proof:
:=
  (det_principal_three_sets_le_and_eq_iff_aux hA I J K hIJ hIK hJK).1

name: NLAlib.det_principal_three_sets_eq_iff
statement:
theorem det_principal_three_sets_eq_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (I J K : Finset n) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIK : Disjoint I K) (hJK : Disjoint J K) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K)) (· ∈ I ∪ (J ∪ K))).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I)).det =
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ J) (· ∈ I ∪ J)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I ∪ K) (· ∈ I ∪ K)).det ↔
      A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ K) -
        A.toBlock (· ∈ J) (· ∈ I) * (A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ I))⁻¹ *
          A.toBlock (· ∈ I) (· ∈ K) = 0
proof:
:=
  (det_principal_three_sets_le_and_eq_iff_aux hA I J K hIJ hIK hJK).2

name: NLAlib.det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_and_eq_iff_of_posDef_aux
statement:
private theorem det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_and_eq_iff_of_posDef_aux
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (α β : Finset n) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∪ β) (· ∈ α ∪ β)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β)).det ≤
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ α) (· ∈ α)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ β) (· ∈ β)).det ∧
    ((A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∪ β) (· ∈ α ∪ β)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β)).det =
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ α) (· ∈ α)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ β) (· ∈ β)).det ↔
      A.toBlock (· ∈ α \ β) (· ∈ β \ α) -
        A.toBlock (· ∈ α \ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β) * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β))⁻¹ *
          A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ β \ α) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hij : Disjoint (α ∩ β) (α \ β) := by simp [Finset.disjoint_left]; aesop
  have hik : Disjoint (α ∩ β) (β \ α) := by simp [Finset.disjoint_left]; aesop
  have hjk : Disjoint (α \ β) (β \ α) := by simp [Finset.disjoint_left]; aesop
  have hu : (α ∩ β) ∪ ((α \ β) ∪ (β \ α)) = α ∪ β := by ext i; simp; tauto
  have ha : (α ∩ β) ∪ (α \ β) = α := by ext i; simp; tauto
  have hb : (α ∩ β) ∪ (β \ α) = β := by ext i; simp; tauto
  let D (s : Finset n) : ℝ := (A.toBlock (· ∈ s) (· ∈ s)).det
  have hh := det_principal_three_sets_le_and_eq_iff_aux hA
    (α ∩ β) (α \ β) (β \ α) hij hik hjk
  change D ((α ∩ β) ∪ ((α \ β) ∪ (β \ α))) * D (α ∩ β) ≤
      D ((α ∩ β) ∪ (α \ β)) * D ((α ∩ β) ∪ (β \ α)) ∧
    (D ((α ∩ β) ∪ ((α \ β) ∪ (β \ α))) * D (α ∩ β) =
      D ((α ∩ β) ∪ (α \ β)) * D ((α ∩ β) ∪ (β \ α)) ↔ _) at hh
  rw [hu, ha, hb] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_of_posDef
statement:
theorem det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_of_posDef
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (α β : Finset n) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∪ β) (· ∈ α ∪ β)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β)).det ≤
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ α) (· ∈ α)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ β) (· ∈ β)).det
proof:
:=
  (det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_and_eq_iff_of_posDef_aux hA α β).1

name: NLAlib.det_principal_union_mul_inter_eq_iff_of_posDef
statement:
theorem det_principal_union_mul_inter_eq_iff_of_posDef
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (α β : Finset n) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∪ β) (· ∈ α ∪ β)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β)).det =
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ α) (· ∈ α)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ β) (· ∈ β)).det ↔
      A.toBlock (· ∈ α \ β) (· ∈ β \ α) -
        A.toBlock (· ∈ α \ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β) * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β))⁻¹ *
          A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ β \ α) = 0
proof:
:=
  (det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_and_eq_iff_of_posDef_aux hA α β).2

name: NLAlib.det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_of_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (α β : Finset n) :
    (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∪ β) (· ∈ α ∪ β)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β)).det ≤
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ α) (· ∈ α)).det * (A.toBlock (· ∈ β) (· ∈ β)).det
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_posSemidef_of_continuous_of_forall_posDef (f := fun M : Matrix n n ℝ =>
    (M.toBlock (· ∈ α ∪ β) (· ∈ α ∪ β)).det * (M.toBlock (· ∈ α ∩ β) (· ∈ α ∩ β)).det)
    (g := fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => (M.toBlock (· ∈ α) (· ∈ α)).det * (M.toBlock (· ∈ β) (· ∈ β)).det)
    (by unfold Matrix.toBlock; fun_prop) (by unfold Matrix.toBlock; fun_prop)
    (fun M hM => det_principal_union_mul_inter_le_of_posDef hM α β) hA

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_le_card_mul_add_sum_max_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hp (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) :
      (if i.val < k then sortedVector x i else 0) ≤
        (if i.val < k then a else 0) + max (sortedVector x i - a) 0 := by
    by_cases hi : i.val < k
    · simp only [if_pos hi]
      linarith [le_max_left (sortedVector x i - a) 0]
    · simp only [if_neg hi, zero_add]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hp i)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h
  have hcard : (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card ι), if i.val < k then a else 0) = (k : ℝ) * a := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, card_filter_fin_lt hk]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rwa [hcard, sum_sortedVector x (fun z => max (z - a) 0)] at h

name: NLAlib.exists_sumLargest_eq_card_mul_add_sum_max_sub
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hn : Fintype.card ι = 0
  · have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
    have : IsEmpty ι := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hn
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    simp [hk0]
  · have hnpos : 0 < Fintype.card ι := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    let a : ℝ := if h : k < Fintype.card ι then sortedVector y ⟨k, h⟩
      else sortedVector y ⟨Fintype.card ι - 1, by omega⟩
    have hlow (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) (hi : i.val < k) : a ≤ sortedVector y i := by
      dsimp [a]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact sortedVector_antitone y (show i ≤ (⟨k, h⟩ : Fin _) from by
          change i.val ≤ k; omega)
      · exact sortedVector_antitone y (show i ≤ (⟨Fintype.card ι - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin _) from by
          change i.val ≤ Fintype.card ι - 1; omega)
    have hhigh (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) (hi : ¬ i.val < k) : sortedVector y i ≤ a := by
      dsimp [a]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact sortedVector_antitone y (show (⟨k, h⟩ : Fin _) ≤ i from by
          change k ≤ i.val; omega)
      · omega
    have he (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) : max (sortedVector y i - a) 0 =
        if i.val < k then sortedVector y i - a else 0 := by
      by_cases hi : i.val < k
      · rw [if_pos hi, max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlow i hi))]
      · rw [if_neg hi, max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr (hhigh i hi))]
    have hsum : (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card ι), if i.val < k then sortedVector y i - a else 0) =
        sumLargest y k - (k : ℝ) * a := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, card_filter_fin_lt hk]
      simp only [sumLargest, ← Finset.sum_filter, nsmul_eq_mul]
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [← sum_sortedVector y (fun z => max (z - a) 0)]
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [hsum]
    ring

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_of_sum_max_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_sumLargest_eq_card_mul_add_sum_max_sub y hk
  calc
    sumLargest x k ≤ (k : ℝ) * a + ∑ i, max (x i - a) 0 :=
      sumLargest_le_card_mul_add_sum_max_sub x hk a
    _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * a + ∑ i, max (y i - a) 0 := by linarith [h a]
    _ = sumLargest y k := ha.symm

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.sum_max_sub_le
statement:
theorem WeaklyMajorized.sum_max_sub_le {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, max (x i - a) 0) ≤ ∑ i, max (y i - a) 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := (Finset.univ : Finset ι).filter fun i => a < x i
  have hsum : (∑ i, max (x i - a) 0) = (∑ i ∈ S, x i) - (S.card : ℝ) * a := by
    have he (i : ι) : max (x i - a) 0 = if a < x i then x i - a else 0 := by
      by_cases hi : a < x i
      · rw [if_pos hi, max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      · rw [if_neg hi, max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const]
    simp [S, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hsum]
  have hS := (weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le x y).mp hxy S
  have hy := sumLargest_le_card_mul_add_sum_max_sub y (Finset.card_le_univ S) a
  linarith

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_max_sub_le
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_max_sub_le (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    WeaklyMajorized x y ↔
      ∀ a : ℝ, (∑ i, max (x i - a) 0) ≤ ∑ i, max (y i - a) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.sum_max_sub_le, weaklyMajorized_of_sum_max_sub_le⟩

name: NLAlib.submatrix_kronecker_diagonal
statement:
theorem submatrix_kronecker_diagonal (A B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B).submatrix (fun i => (i, i)) (fun i => (i, i)) = A ⊙ B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rfl

name: NLAlib.inv_hadamard_le_hadamard_inv
statement:
theorem inv_hadamard_le_hadamard_inv {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (A ⊙ B)⁻¹ ≤ A⁻¹ ⊙ B⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := inv_submatrix_le_submatrix_inv (hA.kronecker hB) (fun i : n => (i, i))
    (fun _ _ he => congrArg Prod.fst he)
  simpa only [submatrix_kronecker_diagonal, Matrix.inv_kronecker] using h

name: NLAlib.one_le_hadamard_inv
statement: theorem one_le_hadamard_inv {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) : 1 ≤ A ⊙ A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have h1 : (fromBlocks A 1 1 A⁻¹).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] using
      fromBlocks_inverse_gram_posSemidef hA (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
  have h2 : (fromBlocks A⁻¹ 1 1 A).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible] using
      fromBlocks_inverse_gram_posSemidef hA.inv (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
  have he : fromBlocks A 1 1 A⁻¹ ⊙ fromBlocks A⁻¹ 1 1 A =
      fromBlocks (A ⊙ A⁻¹) 1 1 (A ⊙ A⁻¹) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.hadamard_apply, Matrix.one_apply, mul_comm]
  have h := h1.hadamard h2
  rw [he] at h
  exact (posSemidef_equal_diagonal_fromBlocks_iff_le (hA.posSemidef.hadamard hA.inv.posSemidef)
    Matrix.PosSemidef.one).mp h

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_map_pow
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_pow {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (k : ℕ) :
    (A.map (fun t => t ^ k)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h := Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (fun _ : n => (1 : ℝ))
    simpa only [Matrix.map, pow_zero, star_trivial, Matrix.vecMulVec, one_mul] using h
  | succ k ih =>
    have he : A.map (fun t => t ^ (k + 1)) = A.map (fun t => t ^ k) ⊙ A := by
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.hadamard_apply, pow_succ]
    rw [he]
    exact ih.hadamard hA

name: NLAlib.hasSum_smul_map_pow_of_hasSum_entries
statement:
theorem hasSum_smul_map_pow_of_hasSum_entries (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i j, HasSum (fun k => c k * (A i j) ^ k) (f (A i j))) :
    HasSum (fun k => c k • A.map (fun t => t ^ k)) (A.map f)
proof:
:= by
  change HasSum (fun k => fun i j => c k * (A i j) ^ k) (fun i j => f (A i j))
  rw [Pi.hasSum]
  intro i
  rw [Pi.hasSum]
  intro j
  simpa only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using h i j

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_map_of_nonneg_powerSeries
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_of_nonneg_powerSeries {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ k, 0 ≤ c k) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i j, HasSum (fun k => c k * (A i j) ^ k) (f (A i j))) :
    (A.map f).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  posSemidef_of_hasSum (fun k => (posSemidef_map_pow hA k).smul (hc k))
    (hasSum_smul_map_pow_of_hasSum_entries A c f h)

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_map_ofScalarsSum_of_lt_radius
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_ofScalarsSum_of_lt_radius {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ k, 0 ≤ c k)
    (hr : ∀ i j, (‖A i j‖₊ : ENNReal) < (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℝ c).radius) :
    (A.map (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalarsSum c)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply posSemidef_map_of_nonneg_powerSeries hA c hc
  intro i j
  have hs := (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℝ c).hasSum
    (show A i j ∈ Metric.eball 0 (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℝ c).radius by
      simpa only [mem_eball_zero_iff, enorm_eq_nnnorm] using hr i j)
  simpa only [FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq, smul_eq_mul,
    FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalarsSum] using hs

name: NLAlib.hasSum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow
statement:
theorem hasSum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.quadForm_map_pow_vecMulVec_self
statement:
theorem quadForm_map_pow_vecMulVec_self (b x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm ((vecMulVec b b).map (fun t => t ^ k)) x = (∑ i, x i * b i ^ k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : (vecMulVec b b).map (fun t => t ^ k) =
      vecMulVec (fun i => b i ^ k) (fun i => b i ^ k) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, mul_pow]
  rw [he]
  have h := quadForm_vecMulVec_star_self (fun i => b i ^ k) x
  simp only [star_trivial, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_vecMulVec_of_injective
statement:
theorem posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_vecMulVec_of_injective (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ •
      (vecMulVec b b).map (fun t => t ^ k)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let H : Matrix n n ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ •
    (vecMulVec b b).map (fun t => t ^ k)
  have hBB : (vecMulVec b b).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star b
  have hH : H.PosSemidef := Matrix.posSemidef_sum _
    (fun k _ => (posSemidef_map_pow hBB k).smul (by positivity))
  have hform (x : n → ℝ) : quadForm H x =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ i, x i * b i ^ k) ^ 2 := by
    change x ⬝ᵥ (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n),
      (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ • (vecMulVec b b).map (fun t => t ^ k)) *ᵥ x = _
    simp only [Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [← quadForm_map_pow_vecMulVec_self b x k]
    rfl
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos hH.isHermitian
  intro x hx
  simp only [star_trivial]
  change 0 < quadForm H x
  by_contra hn
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ quadForm H x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hH.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  have hz : quadForm H x = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hnonneg
  rw [hform] at hz
  have hmom (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : (∑ i, x i * b i ^ (k : ℕ)) = 0 := by
    have hk0 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg j.factorial)) (sq_nonneg _))).mp hz
      k (Finset.mem_range.mpr k.isLt)
    have hf : ((k.val).factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by positivity
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hk0).resolve_left hf)
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have hzero : (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => x (e i)) = 0 :=
    Matrix.eq_zero_of_forall_pow_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero (hb.comp e.injective) (fun k => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [e.sum_comp (fun i => x i * b i ^ (k : ℕ))]
      exact hmom k)
  apply hx
  funext i
  simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hzero (e.symm i)

name: NLAlib.posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_of_rows_injective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hBA⟩ := exists_injective_vecMulVec_le_of_posSemidef_rows_injective hA hrows
  have hBB : (vecMulVec b b).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star b
  exact posDef_of_posDef_le (posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_vecMulVec_of_injective b hb)
    (sum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow_le_of_posSemidef_le hBB hBA (Fintype.card n))

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_single_row
statement:
private theorem planeRotation_single_row (i j k : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) :
    planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s k =
      if k = i then c • Pi.single i 1 + s • Pi.single j 1
      else if k = j then (-s) • Pi.single i 1 + c • Pi.single j 1
      else Pi.single k 1
proof:
:= by
  ext l
  by_cases hki : k = i <;> by_cases hkj : k = j
  · exact (hij (hki.symm.trans hkj)).elim
  · subst k
    simp [planeRotation, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hij, eq_comm]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  · subst k
    simp [planeRotation, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hij, eq_comm]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  · simp [planeRotation, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.single_apply, hki, hkj,
      Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_single_conjugation_diag
statement:
theorem planeRotation_single_conjugation_diag
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (k : n) :
    let Δ
proof:
:= 2 * c * s * A i j + s ^ 2 * (A j j - A i i)
    (planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s * A *
      (planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s)ᵀ) k k =
      A k k + if k = i then Δ else if k = j then -Δ else 0 := by
  dsimp only
  rw [Matrix.mul_mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    planeRotation_single_row i j k hij c s]
  have hji : A j i = A i j := congrArg (fun M => M i j) hA
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst k
    simp only [ite_true, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
      smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, single_dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_single_one,
      one_mul, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.col_apply, hji]
    linear_combination A i i * hcs
  · by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      simp only [if_neg hki, ite_true, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
        smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, single_dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_single_one,
        one_mul, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.col_apply, hji]
      linear_combination A j j * hcs
    · simp [hki, hkj, single_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_single_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_single_eq
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (d : n → ℝ) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    let Δ
proof:
:= 2 * c * s * A i j + s ^ 2 * (A j j - A i i)
    (∑ k, ((planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s * A *
      (planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s)ᵀ) k k - d k) ^ 2) -
      (∑ k, (A k k - d k) ^ 2) =
      2 * ((A i i - d i) - (A j j - d j)) * Δ + 2 * Δ ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  let Δ := 2 * c * s * A i j + s ^ 2 * (A j j - A i i)
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [planeRotation_single_conjugation_diag A hA i j hij c s hcs]
  have hpoint (k : n) :
      (A k k + (if k = i then Δ else if k = j then -Δ else 0) - d k) ^ 2 -
        (A k k - d k) ^ 2 =
        (if k = i then 2 * (A i i - d i) * Δ + Δ ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if k = j then -2 * (A j j - d j) * Δ + Δ ^ 2 else 0) := by
    by_cases hki : k = i <;> by_cases hkj : k = j
    · exact (hij (hki.symm.trans hkj)).elim
    · subst k; simp [hij]; ring
    · subst k; simp [Ne.symm hij]; ring
    · simp [hki, hkj]
  change (∑ k, ((A k k + (if k = i then Δ else if k = j then -Δ else 0) - d k) ^ 2 -
    (A k k - d k) ^ 2)) = _
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  ring

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_equal_diagonal_fromBlocks_iff_le
statement:
theorem posSemidef_equal_diagonal_fromBlocks_iff_le
    {A B : Matrix m m ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    (fromBlocks A B B A).PosSemidef ↔ B ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  have hBt : Bᵀ = B := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hB.isHermitian.eq
  constructor
  · intro hH
    have hH' : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ A).PosSemidef := by simpa only [hBt] using hH
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hA.isHermitian.sub hB.isHermitian)
    intro x
    have h := hH'.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Sum.elim x (-x))
    simp only [star_trivial] at h ⊢
    change 0 ≤ quadForm (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ A) (Sum.elim x (-x)) at h
    rw [quadForm_fromBlocks] at h
    simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_neg, dotProduct_neg, neg_dotProduct, neg_neg,
      Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub] at h ⊢
    linarith
  · intro hBA
    have hEq : (fromBlocks B B B B).PosSemidef := by
      have h := hB.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (fromRows (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) (1 : Matrix m m ℝ))
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_fromRows,
        Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
        Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols] at h
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_one] using h
    have hDiag := posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag (Matrix.le_iff.mp hBA) (Matrix.le_iff.mp hBA)
    convert hEq.add hDiag using 1
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Matrix.fromBlocks]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_inverse_gram_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have h := Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ X (Xᵀ * A⁻¹ * X) hA
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, sub_self] at h
  exact h.mpr Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

name: NLAlib.inv_compression_le_compression_inv
proof:
:= by
  change Vᵀ * V = 1 at hV
  have hVi : Function.Injective V.mulVec := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg (fun v => Vᵀ *ᵥ v) hxy
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hV, Matrix.one_mulVec] using h
  have hAV : (Vᵀ * A * V).PosDef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hVi
  have hH : (fromBlocks A 1 1 A⁻¹).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] using
      fromBlocks_inverse_gram_posSemidef hA (1 : Matrix m m ℝ)
  let D := fromBlocks V (0 : Matrix m n ℝ) (0 : Matrix m n ℝ) V
  have h := hH.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same D
  have hcomp : (fromBlocks (Vᵀ * A * V) 1 1 (Vᵀ * A⁻¹ * V)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [D, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose,
      Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul, add_zero, zero_add, hV] using h
  let : Invertible (Vᵀ * A * V) := hAV.isUnit.invertible
  have hs := (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (Vᵀ * A⁻¹ * V) hAV).mp
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_one] using hcomp)
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.le_iff] using hs

name: NLAlib.inv_submatrix_le_submatrix_inv
statement:
theorem inv_submatrix_le_submatrix_inv {A : Matrix m m ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (f : n → m) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (A.submatrix f f)⁻¹ ≤ A⁻¹.submatrix f f
proof:
:= by
  let V := (1 : Matrix m m ℝ).submatrix id f
  have hc (M : Matrix m m ℝ) : Vᵀ * M * V = M.submatrix f f := by
    rw [show Vᵀ = (1 : Matrix m m ℝ).submatrix f id by
      simp only [V, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.transpose_one]]
    have hl : (1 : Matrix m m ℝ).submatrix f id * M = M.submatrix f id := by
      simpa using Matrix.one_submatrix_mul f (Equiv.refl m) M
    rw [hl]
    simpa [V] using Matrix.mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl m) f (M.submatrix f id)
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols V := by
    change Vᵀ * V = 1
    have hh := hc (1 : Matrix m m ℝ)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.submatrix_one f hf] using hh
  simpa only [hc] using inv_compression_le_compression_inv hA hV

statement:

proof:

name: NLAlib.majorized_real_parts_eigenvalues_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem majorized_real_parts_eigenvalues_selfAdjointPart
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : n → ℂ)
    (hz : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (z i))) :
    Majorized (fun i => (z i).re)
      (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  obtain ⟨U, T, hA, -, hTchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A e
  let hH : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
  let hK : (selfAdjointPart ℝ T : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ T).property
  have hHK : hH.eigenvalues = hK.eigenvalues := by
    apply (hH.eigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues_iff hK).mpr
    have hconj : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) =
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (selfAdjointPart ℝ T : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      rw [hA, selfAdjointPart_mul_mul_conjTranspose]
    rw [hconj, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hmajor : Majorized (fun i => (T i i).re) hH.eigenvalues := by
    rw [hHK]
    simpa only [RCLike.re_to_complex, real_diagonal_selfAdjointPart] using
      majorized_diagonal_eigenvalues hK
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq z (fun i => T i i)
    (hz.symm.trans hTchar)
  have hperm := majorized_comp_perm (fun i => (T i i).re) σ
  have hre : (fun i => (z i).re) = (fun i => (T i i).re) ∘ σ := by
    funext i
    exact congrArg Complex.re (hσ i).symm
  rw [hre]
  exact hperm.trans hmajor

name: NLAlib.real_part_eigenvalue_mem_Icc_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem real_part_eigenvalue_mem_Icc_selfAdjointPart
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : n → ℂ)
    (hz : A.charpoly = ∏ j, (X - C (z j))) (i : n) :
    let hdim : 0 < Fintype.card n
proof:
:= Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩
    let hH : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
    (z i).re ∈ Set.Icc
      (hH.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hdim (by decide)⟩)
      (hH.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, hdim⟩) := by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  obtain ⟨U, T, hA, -, hTchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A e
  let hH : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
  let hK : (selfAdjointPart ℝ T : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ T).property
  have hHK : hH.eigenvalues = hK.eigenvalues := by
    apply (hH.eigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues_iff hK).mpr
    have hconj : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) =
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (selfAdjointPart ℝ T : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      rw [hA, selfAdjointPart_mul_mul_conjTranspose]
    rw [hconj, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hsorted : hH.eigenvalues₀ = hK.eigenvalues₀ := by
    funext k
    have hh := congrFun hHK (e k)
    simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hh
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq z (fun j => T j j)
    (hz.symm.trans hTchar)
  have hb := re_diagonal_mem_Icc_eigenvalues₀ hK (σ i) (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩)
  simpa only [RCLike.re_to_complex, real_diagonal_selfAdjointPart, hσ, ← hsorted] using hb

name: NLAlib.abs_det_le_prod_column_norm_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem abs_det_le_prod_column_norm_and_eq_iff_aux (B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    |B.det| ≤ ∏ i, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ∧
    (|B.det| = (∏ i, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖) ↔
      B.HasOrthogonalCols ∨ ∃ i, B.col i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Bᵀ * B
  let p := ∏ i, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖
  have hG : G.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self B
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hdiag (i : n) : G i i = ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [G, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply, sq]
  have hdet : G.det = |B.det| ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, sq_abs, sq]
  have hprod : (∏ i, G i i) = p ^ 2 := by
    simp only [hdiag]
    exact Finset.prod_pow Finset.univ 2 (fun i => ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖)
  have hle := det_le_prod_diag_of_posSemidef hG
  rw [hdet, hprod] at hle
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change |B.det| ≤ p
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg B.det]
  · have heq : |B.det| = p ↔ G.det = ∏ i, G i i := by
      rw [hdet, hprod]
      constructor
      · intro h; rw [h]
      · intro h; nlinarith [abs_nonneg B.det]
    rw [heq, det_eq_prod_diag_iff_of_posSemidef hG]
    apply or_congr
    · exact Matrix.transpose_mul_self_isDiag_iff_hasOrthogonalCols
    · apply exists_congr
      intro i
      rw [hdiag]
      simp

name: NLAlib.abs_det_le_prod_column_norm
statement:
theorem abs_det_le_prod_column_norm (B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    |B.det| ≤ ∏ i, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖
proof:
:=
  (abs_det_le_prod_column_norm_and_eq_iff_aux B).1

name: NLAlib.abs_det_eq_prod_column_norm_iff
statement:
theorem abs_det_eq_prod_column_norm_iff (B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    |B.det| = (∏ i, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (B.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖) ↔
      B.HasOrthogonalCols ∨ ∃ i, B.col i = 0
proof:
:=
  (abs_det_le_prod_column_norm_and_eq_iff_aux B).2

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_of_eigenvectors
statement:
theorem planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_of_eigenvectors
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (α β : ℝ) (hAu : A *ᵥ u = α • u) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = β • v)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    planeRotation u v c s * A * (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ =
      A + (s ^ 2 * (β - α)) • (Matrix.vecMulVec u u - Matrix.vecMulVec v v) +
        (c * s * (β - α)) • (Matrix.vecMulVec u v + Matrix.vecMulVec v u)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hu
  have hv := dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hv
  have hvu : v ⬝ᵥ u = 0 := by rw [dotProduct_comm, huv]
  have huA : u ᵥ* A = α • u := by rw [← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hA, hAu]
  have hvA : v ᵥ* A = β • v := by rw [← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hA, hAv]
  simp only [planeRotation, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_smul,
    Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.transpose_vecMulVec,
    Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, huA, hvA, hAu, hAv,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_smul, smul_smul,
    Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, op_smul_eq_smul,
    hu, hv, huv, hvu, zero_smul, one_smul,
    smul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub, smul_neg]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (α * u i * u j + β * v i * v j) * hcs

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_apply_diag_of_disjoint_eigenvectors
statement:
theorem planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_apply_diag_of_disjoint_eigenvectors
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (α β : ℝ) (hAu : A *ᵥ u = α • u) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = β • v)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i, u i * v i = 0) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (i : n) :
    (planeRotation u v c s * A * (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ) i i =
      A i i + s ^ 2 * (β - α) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_of_eigenvectors A hA u v hu hv huv α β hAu hAv c s hcs]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, hdisjoint i, mul_comm (v i) (u i),
    add_zero, mul_zero, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.rows_injective_of_posDef_map_exp
statement:
theorem rows_injective_of_posDef_map_exp {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (h : (A.map Real.exp).PosDef) : Function.Injective A.row
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (A.map Real.exp).row :=
    (Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit.mpr h.isUnit).injective
  intro i j hij
  apply hinj
  funext k

name: NLAlib.posDef_map_exp_iff_rows_injective
statement:
theorem posDef_map_exp_iff_rows_injective {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (A.map Real.exp).PosDef ↔ Function.Injective A.row
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact rows_injective_of_posDef_map_exp
  · intro hrows
    exact posDef_of_posDef_le (posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_of_rows_injective hA hrows)
      (sum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow_le_map_exp hA (Fintype.card n))

name: NLAlib.posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_iff_rows_injective
statement:
theorem posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_iff_rows_injective {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ • A.map (fun t => t ^ k)).PosDef ↔
      Function.Injective A.row
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact rows_injective_of_posDef_map_exp (posDef_of_posDef_le h
      (sum_inv_factorial_smul_map_pow_le_map_exp hA (Fintype.card n)))
  · exact posDef_sum_inv_factorial_map_pow_of_rows_injective hA

name: NLAlib.quadForm_bounds_of_sandwich
proof:
:= by
  have hl := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hlo).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  have hu := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hhi).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
