name: NLAlib.sq_bilinear_le_sq_ratio_mul_quadForm_of_sandwich
statement:
theorem sq_bilinear_le_sq_ratio_mul_quadForm_of_sandwich {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hlo : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) (hhi : A ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (x y : n → ℝ) (hxy : x ⬝ᵥ y = 0) :
    (x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y) ^ 2 ≤ ((b - a) / (b + a)) ^ 2 * quadForm A x * quadForm A y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x; simp [quadForm]
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · subst y; simp [quadForm]
  have hb : 0 < b := ha.trans_le hab
  have hs : 0 < quadForm A x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
  have ht : 0 < quadForm A y := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hy
  let r := Real.sqrt (quadForm A y)
  let s := Real.sqrt (quadForm A x)
  have hr : r ^ 2 = quadForm A y := Real.sq_sqrt ht.le
  have hs' : s ^ 2 = quadForm A x := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le
  let S := quadForm A x * quadForm A y
  let N := quadForm A y * (x ⬝ᵥ x) + quadForm A x * (y ⬝ᵥ y)
  let w := r * s * (x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y)
  have hS : 0 < S := mul_pos hs ht
  have hN (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ^ 2 = 1) :
      (r • x + (ε * s) • y) ⬝ᵥ (r • x + (ε * s) • y) = N := by
    have hyx : y ⬝ᵥ x = 0 := by rw [dotProduct_comm, hxy]
    simp only [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, hxy, hyx, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    calc
      _ = r ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) + ε ^ 2 * s ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y) := by ring
      _ = N := by rw [hε, hr, hs', one_mul]
  have hE (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ^ 2 = 1) :
      quadForm A (r • x + (ε * s) • y) = 2 * S + 2 * ε * w := by
    have h := hA.isHermitian.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul x y r (ε * s)
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq, star_trivial] at h
    rw [h]
    dsimp [S, w]
    rw [mul_pow, hε, one_mul, hr, hs']
    ring
  have hp := quadForm_bounds_of_sandwich hlo hhi (r • x + (1 * s) • y)
  have hm := quadForm_bounds_of_sandwich hlo hhi (r • x + (-1 * s) • y)
  rw [hN 1 (by norm_num), hE 1 (by norm_num)] at hp
  rw [hN (-1) (by norm_num), hE (-1) (by norm_num)] at hm
  have hupper : (a + b) * w ≤ (b - a) * S := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp.2 ha.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm.1 hb.le
    nlinarith
  have hlower : -((b - a) * S) ≤ (a + b) * w := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm.2 ha.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp.1 hb.le
    nlinarith
  have habs : |(a + b) * w| ≤ (b - a) * S := abs_le.mpr ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  have hsq := mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg ((a + b) * w)) habs
  have hw : w ^ 2 = S * (x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [w, S]
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hr, hs']
    ring
  have hsq' : (a + b) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y) ^ 2 ≤ (b - a) ^ 2 * S := by
    have hsq0 : ((a + b) * w) ^ 2 ≤ ((b - a) * S) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_abs ((a + b) * w)]
    rw [mul_pow (a + b) w 2, mul_pow (b - a) S 2, hw] at hsq0
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hS).mp
    nlinarith
  rw [div_pow, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (show 0 < b + a by positivity))).mpr
  dsimp [S] at hsq'
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.det_principal_complement_singleton_eq_det_mul_inv_diag
statement:
theorem det_principal_complement_singleton_eq_det_mul_inv_diag
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A.det) (i : n) :
    (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det = A.det * A⁻¹ i i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : {j : n // j ≠ i} ⊕ {j : n // ¬j ≠ i} ≃ n := Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j ≠ i)
  let : Subsingleton {j : n // ¬j ≠ i} := ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by
    have hx : x.val = i := not_ne_iff.mp x.property
    have hy : y.val = i := not_ne_iff.mp y.property
    exact hx.trans hy.symm)⟩
  have h := det_inverse_complement_minor_eq_sign_mul_div A hA e e
  simp only [Equiv.self_trans_symm, Equiv.Perm.sign_refl, Units.val_one, Int.cast_one, one_mul] at h
  change (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun j => ¬j ≠ i) (fun j => ¬j ≠ i)).det =
    (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det / A.det at h
  rw [Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ ⟨i, by simp⟩] at h
  change A⁻¹ i i = (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det / A.det at h
  rw [h]
  field_simp [hA.ne_zero]

name: NLAlib.isDiag_inv_iff_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem isDiag_inv_iff_of_isUnit {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    A⁻¹.IsDiag ↔ A.IsDiag
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.invertible
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible A, ← h.diagonal_diag, Matrix.inv_diagonal]
    exact Matrix.isDiag_diagonal _
  · intro h
    rw [← h.diagonal_diag, Matrix.inv_diagonal]
    exact Matrix.isDiag_diagonal _

name: NLAlib.det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton_and_eq_iff_aux
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A.det ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤
      ∏ i, (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det ∧
    (A.det ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) =
      (∏ i, (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det) ↔ A.IsDiag)
proof:
:= by
  have hAd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA.isUnit
  have hprod : (∏ i, (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det) =
      A.det ^ Fintype.card n * ∏ i, A⁻¹ i i := by
    simp_rw [det_principal_complement_singleton_eq_det_mul_inv_diag A hAd]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ]
  have hpow : A.det ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) = A.det ^ Fintype.card n * A⁻¹.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    nth_rw 2 [show Fintype.card n = (Fintype.card n - 1) + 1 by have := Fintype.card_pos (α := n); omega]
    rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hA.det_pos.ne', mul_one]
  have hpp : 0 < A.det ^ Fintype.card n := pow_pos hA.det_pos _
  rw [hprod, hpow]
  constructor
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (det_le_prod_diag_of_posSemidef hA.inv.posSemidef) hpp.le
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have he := mul_left_cancel₀ hpp.ne' h
      exact (isDiag_inv_iff_of_isUnit hA.isUnit).mp
        ((det_eq_prod_diag_iff_isDiag_of_posDef hA.inv).mp he)
    · intro h
      have he := (det_eq_prod_diag_iff_isDiag_of_posDef hA.inv).mpr
        ((isDiag_inv_iff_of_isUnit hA.isUnit).mpr h)
      rw [he]

name: NLAlib.det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton
statement:
theorem det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A.det ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤
      ∏ i, (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det
proof:
:=
  (det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton_and_eq_iff_aux hA).1

name: NLAlib.det_pow_card_pred_eq_prod_complement_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem det_pow_card_pred_eq_prod_complement_singleton_iff
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A.det ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) =
      (∏ i, (A.toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det) ↔ A.IsDiag
proof:
:=
  (det_pow_card_pred_le_prod_complement_singleton_and_eq_iff_aux hA).2

name: NLAlib.eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvaluePrefix, sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone,
    sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hk]

name: NLAlib.eigenvaluePrefix_of_card_le
statement:
theorem eigenvaluePrefix_of_card_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Fintype.card n ≤ k) : eigenvaluePrefix hA k = RCLike.re A.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvaluePrefix, sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le _ (by simpa using hk),
    hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues, map_sum]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re]
  exact (sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA id).symm

name: NLAlib.eigenvaluePrefix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eigenvaluePrefix_zero {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    eigenvaluePrefix hA 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [eigenvaluePrefix]

name: NLAlib.trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix
statement:
theorem trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    RCLike.re (Qᴴ * A * Q).trace ≤ eigenvaluePrefix hA (Fintype.card r)
proof:
:= by
  let hB : (Qᴴ * A * Q).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA
  rw [eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE hA (card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ),
    hB.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues, map_sum]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re]
  change (∑ i, id (hB.eigenvalues i)) ≤ _
  rw [sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hB id]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le hA hQ i

name: NLAlib.sum_bottom_eigenvalues_le_trace_compression
statement:
theorem sum_bottom_eigenvalues_le_trace_compression {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card r), hA.eigenvalues₀
      ⟨i.val + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card r), by
        have := card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ; omega⟩) ≤ RCLike.re (Qᴴ * A * Q).trace
proof:
:= by
  let hB : (Qᴴ * A * Q).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA
  rw [hB.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues, map_sum]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re]
  change _ ≤ ∑ i, id (hB.eigenvalues i)
  rw [sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hB id]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression hA hQ i

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_kyFanNorm_of_rank_le_of_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem frobInner_le_kyFanNorm_of_rank_le_of_specNorm_le_one {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {k : ℕ}
    (A P : Matrix m n ℝ) (hP : P.rank ≤ k) (hPn : specNorm P ≤ 1) :
    frobInner A P ≤ kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    frobInner A P ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i * singularValues P i :=
      frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A P
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        if i < k then singularValues A i else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : i < k
      · rw [if_pos hi]
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          ((singularValues_le_specNorm P i).trans hPn) (singularValues_nonneg A i)
      · rw [if_neg hi, singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le P (by omega), mul_zero]
    _ = kyFanNorm A k := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      rw [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]
      apply Finset.sum_subset
      · intro i hi
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hi ⊢
        exact hi.2
      · intro i hi hni
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hi hni
        exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by omega)

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_reindex
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_reindex {m n p q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm (A.reindex em en) k = kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, singularValues_reindex]

name: NLAlib.twoSided_compression_trace_reindex
statement:
theorem twoSided_compression_trace_reindex {m n r p q s : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype s]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix m r ℝ) (V : Matrix n r ℝ)
    (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) (er : r ≃ s) :
    ((U.reindex em er)ᵀ * A.reindex em en * V.reindex en er).trace = (Uᵀ * A * V).trace
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (U.reindex em er)ᵀ * A.reindex em en = (Uᵀ * A).reindex er en := by
    simpa only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.transpose_submatrix] using
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Uᵀ A er.symm em.symm en.symm
  have h2 : (Uᵀ * A).reindex er en * V.reindex en er = (Uᵀ * A * V).reindex er er := by
    simpa only [Matrix.reindex_apply] using
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (Uᵀ * A) V er.symm en.symm er.symm
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  exact er.symm.sum_comp (fun i => (Uᵀ * A * V) i i)

name: NLAlib.trace_twoSided_compression_le_kyFanNorm_fin
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (U * Vᵀ).rank ≤ k :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left U Vᵀ).trans (by simpa using U.rank_le_width)
  have hPn : specNorm (U * Vᵀ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial V,
      specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV]
    exact specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU
  have htrace : (Uᵀ * A * V).trace = frobInner A (U * Vᵀ) := by
    rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact Matrix.trace_mul_cycle Uᵀ A V
  rw [htrace]
  exact frobInner_le_kyFanNorm_of_rank_le_of_specNorm_le_one A (U * Vᵀ) hP hPn

name: NLAlib.trace_twoSided_compression_le_kyFanNorm
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  let er := Fintype.equivFin r
  have h := trace_twoSided_compression_le_kyFanNorm_fin (A.reindex em en)
    (hU.reindex em er) (hV.reindex en er)
  rwa [twoSided_compression_trace_reindex, kyFanNorm_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.det_rpow_inv_card_pow_card
statement:
theorem det_rpow_inv_card_pow_card {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    (A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))) ^ Fintype.card n = A.det
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hA.det_pos.le, one_div_mul_cancel hn, Real.rpow_one]

name: NLAlib.det_smul_rpow_inv_card
statement:
theorem det_smul_rpow_inv_card {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (c • A).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) =
      c * A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  rw [Matrix.det_smul, Real.mul_rpow (pow_nonneg hc _) hA.det_pos.le,
    ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hc, mul_one_div_cancel hn, Real.rpow_one]

name: NLAlib.det_inv_rpow_smul_eq_one
statement:
theorem det_inv_rpow_smul_eq_one {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    ((A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)))⁻¹ • A).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_smul, inv_pow, det_rpow_inv_card_pow_card hA hN, inv_mul_cancel₀ hA.det_pos.ne']

name: NLAlib.quadForm_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem quadForm_selfAdjointPart (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (x : n → ℂ) :
    quadForm (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) x = (quadForm A x).re
proof:
:= by
  simp only [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    quadForm, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_add]
  have h := star_quadForm A x
  simp only [quadForm] at h
  rw [← h]
  simp [Complex.ext_iff, Complex.real_smul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
    {x : n → ℂ} (hx : A *ᵥ x = 0) :
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (hA.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff x).mp
  change quadForm (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) x = 0
  rw [quadForm_selfAdjointPart]
  simp [quadForm, hx]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_zero_iff_realPart_and_imaginaryPart_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_zero_iff_realPart_and_imaginaryPart_mulVec_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
    (x : n → ℂ) :
    A *ᵥ x = 0 ↔ (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ x = 0 ∧
      (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdec := realPart_add_I_smul_imaginaryPart A
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hreal := selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hA hx
    change (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ x = 0 at hreal
    refine ⟨hreal, ?_⟩
    have heq := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M *ᵥ x) hdec
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, hreal, zero_add, hx] at heq
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp heq).resolve_left Complex.I_ne_zero
  · rintro ⟨hr, hi⟩
    rw [← hdec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, hr, hi, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_zero_iff_conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_zero_iff_conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
    (x : n → ℂ) : A *ᵥ x = 0 ↔ Aᴴ *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpart : (selfAdjointPart ℝ Aᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) = selfAdjointPart ℝ A := by
    simp [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, add_comm]
  have hdir (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
      (hB : (selfAdjointPart ℝ B : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef)
      (hb : B *ᵥ x = 0) : Bᴴ *ᵥ x = 0 := by
    have hh := selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hB hb
    have heq : B *ᵥ x + Bᴴ *ᵥ x = 0 := by
      have hscaled := congrArg (fun v : n → ℂ => (2 : ℝ) • v) hh
      simpa [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
        Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, smul_smul] using hscaled
    simpa [hb] using heq
  exact ⟨hdir A hA, fun hx => by
    simpa using hdir Aᴴ (hpart.symm ▸ hA) hx⟩

name: NLAlib.rank_selfAdjointPart_le_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem rank_selfAdjointPart_le_of_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef) :
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).rank ≤ A.rank
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ≤
      LinearMap.ker (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).mulVecLin := by
    intro x hx
    exact selfAdjointPart_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hA hx
  have hdim := Submodule.finrank_mono hker
  have hdA := A.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hdH := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  unfold Matrix.rank
  omega

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A.trace = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    A.trace = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i := hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
    _ = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i := sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA id

name: NLAlib.eigenvaluePrefix_add_le
statement:
theorem eigenvaluePrefix_add_le {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hAB : (A + B).IsHermitian) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    eigenvaluePrefix hAB k ≤ eigenvaluePrefix hA k + eigenvaluePrefix hB k
proof:
:= by
  let Q := topEigenframe hAB hk
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hAB hk
  have ht : (Qᵀ * (A + B) * Q).trace = eigenvaluePrefix hAB k := by
    rw [compression_topEigenframe_eq_diagonal hAB hk, Matrix.trace_diagonal,
      eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE hAB hk]
  rw [← ht, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.trace_add]
  have h1 := trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix hA hQ
  have h2 := trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix hB hQ
  simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Fintype.card_fin] at h1 h2
  exact add_le_add h1 h2

name: NLAlib.majorized_eigenvalues₀_add
statement:
theorem majorized_eigenvalues₀_add {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Majorized (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ (hA.eigenvalues₀ + hB.eigenvalues₀)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    have hkN : k ≤ Fintype.card n := by simpa using hk
    change sumLargest (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ k ≤
      sumLargest (fun i => hA.eigenvalues₀ i + hB.eigenvalues₀ i) k
    rw [sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀_antitone,
      sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone.add hB.eigenvalues₀_antitone)]
    rw [sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hkN, sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hkN]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simpa only [eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE _ hkN] using
      eigenvaluePrefix_add_le hA hB (hA.add hB) hkN
  · rw [← trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ (hA.add hB)]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [← trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ hA, ← trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ hB, Matrix.trace_add]

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_singularValues_add
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_singularValues_add {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    WeaklyMajorized
      (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues (A + B) i)
      (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) =>
        singularValues A i + singularValues B i)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hkN : k ≤ min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) := by simpa using hk
  have hantiA : Antitone (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) =>
      singularValues A i) := fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone _ hij
  have hantiB : Antitone (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) =>
      singularValues B i) := fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone _ hij
  have hantiAB : Antitone (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) =>
      singularValues (A + B) i) := fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone _ hij
  rw [sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ hantiAB,
    sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (hantiA.add hantiB)]
  rw [sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hkN (fun i => singularValues (A + B) i),
    sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hkN (fun i => singularValues A i + singularValues B i)]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simpa only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range] using kyFanNorm_add_le A B k

name: NLAlib.eigenvaluePrefix_realDilation
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE _ (by simp; omega)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hi := eigenvalues₀_dilation A (Fin.castLE (by omega : k ≤ m + n) i)
  have him : (i : ℕ) < m := lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  simpa [realDilationSpectrum, him, Fin.cast, Fin.castLE] using hi

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_prefix
statement:
theorem sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_prefix {m n : ℕ}
    (A E : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin (min m n))) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin S.card, singularValues E j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : Fin (min m n) → ℝ := fun i => singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i
  let f₀ : Fin (min m n) → Fin (m + n) := fun i =>
    if 0 ≤ δ i then Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i else
      (Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i).rev
  have hf₀ : Function.Injective f₀ := by
    intro i j hij
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hij
    dsimp [f₀] at hv
    split_ifs at hv <;> simp only [Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_rev] at hv
    all_goals
      have hi := i.isLt
      have hj := j.isLt
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
  let f : Fin (min m n) ↪ Fin (Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)) :=
    ⟨fun i => Fin.cast (by simp) (f₀ i), fun i j hij => hf₀ (Fin.ext (congrArg (fun k : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)) => k.val) hij))⟩
  have hspectrum (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin (min m n)) :
      (isHermitian_dilation C).eigenvalues₀ (f i) =
        if 0 ≤ δ i then singularValues C i else -singularValues C i := by
    change (isHermitian_dilation C).eigenvalues₀
      (Fin.cast (by simp) (if 0 ≤ δ i then Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i
        else (Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i).rev)) =
          if 0 ≤ δ i then singularValues C i else -singularValues C i
    split_ifs
    · exact eigenvalues₀_dilation_top C i
    · exact eigenvalues₀_dilation_bottom C i
  have hdiff (i : Fin (min m n)) :
      ((isHermitian_dilation A).add (isHermitian_dilation E)).eigenvalues₀ (f i) -
        (isHermitian_dilation A).eigenvalues₀ (f i) = |δ i| := by
    rw [eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq _ (isHermitian_dilation (A + E)) (dilation_add A E).symm]
    rw [hspectrum, hspectrum]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact (abs_of_nonneg hi).symm
    · dsimp [δ]
      rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hi)]
      ring
  have h := sum_eigenvalues₀_add_le_sum_add_eigenvaluePrefix
    (isHermitian_dilation A) (isHermitian_dilation E) (S.map f)
  have hcard : S.card ≤ min m n := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ S
  have hprefix : eigenvaluePrefix (isHermitian_dilation E) (S.map f).card =
        ∑ j : Fin S.card, singularValues E j := by
    simpa only [Finset.card_map] using eigenvaluePrefix_realDilation E hcard
  rw [hprefix, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_map] at h
  have hdiffsum :
      (∑ i ∈ S, ((isHermitian_dilation A).add (isHermitian_dilation E)).eigenvalues₀ (f i)) -
        (∑ i ∈ S, (isHermitian_dilation A).eigenvalues₀ (f i)) = ∑ i ∈ S, |δ i| := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hdiff i
  change (∑ i ∈ S, |δ i|) ≤ _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub_fin
statement:
private theorem weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (A E : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    WeaklyMajorized (fun i : Fin (min m n) =>
      |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|)
      (fun i : Fin (min m n) => singularValues E i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le]
  intro S
  have hcard : S.card ≤ min m n := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ S
  rw [sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone E hij),
    sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hcard]
  exact sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_prefix A E S

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    WeaklyMajorized (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) =>
      |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|)
      (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues E i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
    (E.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
  have hadd : A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) +
      E.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) =
      (A + E).reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) := rfl
  rw [hadd] at h
  simp only [singularValues_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_range_fin
statement:
private theorem sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_range_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (A E : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range S.card, singularValues E j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := S.filter fun k => k < min m n
  let e : {k // k ∈ T} ↪ Fin (min m n) :=
    ⟨fun k => ⟨k.val, (Finset.mem_filter.mp k.property).2⟩,
      fun i j hij => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun k : Fin (min m n) => k.val) hij)⟩
  let I := T.attach.map e
  have hT : (∑ i ∈ T, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|) =
      ∑ i ∈ S, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i| := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    intro k hk hkT
    have hge : min m n ≤ k := by
      simpa only [T, Finset.mem_filter, hk, true_and, not_lt] using hkT
    rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hge),
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hge)]
    simp
  have hI : (∑ i ∈ I, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|) =
      ∑ i ∈ T, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i| := by
    simp only [I, Finset.sum_map]
    change (∑ i ∈ T.attach, |singularValues (A + E) i.val - singularValues A i.val|) = _
    exact Finset.sum_attach T (fun i => |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|)
  have hcard : I.card ≤ S.card := by
    simp only [I, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_attach]
    exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ I, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i| := hT.symm.trans hI.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range I.card, singularValues E j := by
      simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range] using
        sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_prefix A E I
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hcard)
      (fun j _ _ => singularValues_nonneg E j)

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_range
statement:
theorem sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_range {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range S.card, singularValues E j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_range_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
    (E.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n)) S
  have hadd : A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) +
      E.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) =
      (A + E).reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) := rfl
  rw [hadd] at h
  simp only [singularValues_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub_padded
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub_padded {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    WeaklyMajorized (fun i : Fin d =>
      |singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i|)
      (fun i : Fin d => singularValues E i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le]
  intro S
  let e : Fin d ↪ ℕ := ⟨Fin.val, Fin.val_injective⟩
  have h := sum_abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_sum_range A E (S.map e)
  simp only [Finset.sum_map, e, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, Finset.card_map] at h
  have hcard : S.card ≤ d := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ S
  rw [sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone E hij),
    sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hcard]
  simp only [Fin.val_castLE]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.compression_submatrix_cols_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem compression_submatrix_cols_eq_diagonal {n r : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r] {A P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P)
    (d : n → ℝ) (hA : A = P * Matrix.diagonal d * Pᵀ) (e : r ↪ n) :
    (P.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A * P.submatrix id e = Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  have hwhole : Pᵀ * A * P = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    calc
      Pᵀ * A * P = (Pᵀ * P) * Matrix.diagonal d * (Pᵀ * P) := by
        rw [hA]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.diagonal d := by rw [(show Pᵀ * P = 1 from hP), Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have h1 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Pᵀ A e (Equiv.refl n) id
  have h2 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (Pᵀ * A) P e (Equiv.refl n) e
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h1 h2
  rw [Matrix.transpose_submatrix, h1, h2, hwhole,
    Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_embedding]

name: NLAlib.exists_trace_compression_eq_eigenvaluePrefix
statement:
theorem exists_trace_compression_eq_eigenvaluePrefix {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) : ∃ Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ (Qᵀ * A * Q).trace = eigenvaluePrefix hA k
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE hA hk]
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let f : Fin k ↪ n := (Fin.castLEEmb hk).trans e.toEmbedding
  let P : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols P := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  refine ⟨P.submatrix id f, hP.submatrix_cols f, ?_⟩
  rw [compression_submatrix_cols_eq_diagonal hP hA.eigenvalues
    (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA) f, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, f, e]

name: NLAlib.exists_trace_compression_eq_bottom_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem exists_trace_compression_eq_bottom_eigenvalues {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) : ∃ Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ (Qᵀ * A * Q).trace =
        ∑ i : Fin k, hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + (Fintype.card n - k), by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let f : Fin k ↪ n := (Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb hk).trans e.toEmbedding
  let P : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols P := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  refine ⟨P.submatrix id f, hP.submatrix_cols f, ?_⟩
  rw [compression_submatrix_cols_eq_diagonal hP hA.eigenvalues
    (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA) f, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, f, e, Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.exists_trace_twoSided_compression_eq_kyFanNorm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, R, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let em := Fin.castLEEmb (hk.trans (min_le_left _ _))
  let en := Fin.castLEEmb (hk.trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols P := hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hR : HasOrthonormalCols R := hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right
  refine ⟨P.submatrix id em, R.submatrix id en, hP.submatrix_cols em,
    hR.submatrix_cols en, ?_⟩
  have hwhole : Pᵀ * A * R = rectDiag (singularValues A) := hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_mul
  have h1 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Pᵀ A em (Equiv.refl m) id
  have h2 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (Pᵀ * A) R em (Equiv.refl n) en
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h1 h2
  rw [Matrix.transpose_submatrix, h1, h2, hwhole]
  have hd : (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix _ _ ℝ).submatrix em en =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues A i.val) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, rectDiag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      em, en, Fin.coe_castLEEmb, Fin.val_castLE]
    simp [Fin.val_inj]
  rw [hd, Matrix.trace_diagonal, kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_moorePenroseConditionNumber_sqrt
statement:
theorem quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_moorePenroseConditionNumber_sqrt {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (x : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm A x * quadForm A⁻¹ x ≤
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (moorePenroseConditionNumber A) + (Real.sqrt (moorePenroseConditionNumber A))⁻¹) ^ 2 *
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hN
  let a := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩
  let b := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, hN⟩
  obtain ⟨ha, hab, hlo, hhi⟩ := posDef_extreme_eigenvalues_sandwich hA hN
  have hc : moorePenroseConditionNumber A = b / a := moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_eigenvalues₀_ratio hA
  have hconst : (a + b) ^ 2 / (4 * a * b) =
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (moorePenroseConditionNumber A) + (Real.sqrt (moorePenroseConditionNumber A))⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hc]
    exact sq_add_div_four_mul_eq_sq_sqrt_ratio ha (ha.trans_le hab)
  have hk := quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_of_sandwich hA ha hab hlo hhi x
  change quadForm A x * quadForm A⁻¹ x ≤ ((a + b) ^ 2 / (4 * a * b)) *
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 4 at hk
  rw [hconst] at hk
  exact hk

name: NLAlib.add_smul_inv_le_smul_one_of_sandwich
statement:
theorem add_smul_inv_le_smul_one_of_sandwich {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hlo : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) (hhi : A ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) :
    A + (a * b) • A⁻¹ ≤ (a + b) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ t ∈ spectrum ℝ A, a ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b := by
    have h := (loewner_sandwich_iff_relative_spectrum_subset Matrix.PosDef.one hA.isHermitian a b).mp
      ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    simpa only [inv_one, Matrix.one_mul, Set.subset_def, Set.mem_Icc] using h
  have hf : ∀ t ∈ spectrum ℝ A, t + a * b * t⁻¹ ≤ a + b := by
    intro t ht
    have ht0 : 0 < t := ha.trans_le (hs t ht).1
    have hp := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr (hs t ht).1)
      (sub_nonpos.mpr (hs t ht).2)
    calc
      t + a * b * t⁻¹ = (t ^ 2 + a * b) / t := by field_simp
      _ ≤ a + b := (div_le_iff₀ ht0).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hinv : cfc (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) A = A⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using
      cfc_ringInverse_id (R := ℝ) (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (a := A) hA.isUnit hA.isHermitian
  have hfc : cfc (fun t : ℝ => t + a * b * t⁻¹) A = A + (a * b) • A⁻¹ := by
    rw [cfc_add (p := IsSelfAdjoint) A (fun t : ℝ => t) (fun t : ℝ => a * b * t⁻¹)
      (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _),
      cfc_id' (p := IsSelfAdjoint) ℝ A hA.isHermitian,
      cfc_const_mul (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (a * b) (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) A (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _), hinv]
  have h := (cfc_le_algebraMap_iff (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (fun t : ℝ => t + a * b * t⁻¹) (a + b) A
    (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) hA.isHermitian).mpr hf
  rw [hfc, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_of_sandwich_dotProduct
statement:
private theorem quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_of_sandwich_dotProduct {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hlo : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) (hhi : A ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (x : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm A x * quadForm A⁻¹ x ≤ ((a + b) ^ 2 / (4 * a * b)) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := ha.trans_le hab
  have hM := Matrix.le_iff.mp (add_smul_inv_le_smul_one_of_sandwich hA ha hlo hhi)
  have hm := hM.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hm
  have hs : 0 ≤ quadForm A x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  have ht : 0 ≤ quadForm A⁻¹ x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  change 0 ≤ (a + b) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) - (quadForm A x + a * b * quadForm A⁻¹ x) at hm
  have hsum : 0 ≤ quadForm A x + a * b * quadForm A⁻¹ x := by positivity
  have hsq := mul_self_le_mul_self hsum (sub_nonneg.mp hm)
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 4 * a * b by positivity)).mpr
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (quadForm A x - a * b * quadForm A⁻¹ x)]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_of_sandwich
statement:
theorem quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_of_sandwich {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hlo : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) (hhi : A ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (x : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm A x * quadForm A⁻¹ x ≤
      ((a + b) ^ 2 / (4 * a * b)) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_mul_quadForm_inv_le_of_sandwich_dotProduct hA ha hab hlo hhi x
  rwa [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, ← pow_mul] at h

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_le_one (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (fromBlocks 1 X Xᵀ 1).PosSemidef ↔ specNorm X ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) := invertibleOne
  have h := Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ X (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (Matrix.PosDef.one : (1 : Matrix m m ℝ).PosDef)
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, inv_one, Matrix.mul_one] at h
  rw [h, ← Matrix.le_iff]
  simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose, specNorm_transpose] using
    mul_transpose_le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one Xᵀ

name: NLAlib.exists_sqrt_contraction_factor_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
statement:
theorem exists_sqrt_contraction_factor_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef) :
    ∃ X : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm X ≤ 1 ∧ B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt C
proof:
:= by
  let H := fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C
  let R := CFC.sqrt H
  have hRt : Rᵀ = R := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg H).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hGram : Rᵀ * R = H := by rw [hRt]; exact CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self H hH.nonneg
  let L := R.submatrix id Sum.inl
  let T := R.submatrix id Sum.inr
  have hLA : Lᵀ * L = A := by
    calc
      Lᵀ * L = (Rᵀ * R).submatrix Sum.inl Sum.inl :=
        Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Rᵀ R Sum.inl (Equiv.refl _) Sum.inl
      _ = A := by rw [hGram]; rfl
  have hTC : Tᵀ * T = C := by
    calc
      Tᵀ * T = (Rᵀ * R).submatrix Sum.inr Sum.inr :=
        Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Rᵀ R Sum.inr (Equiv.refl _) Sum.inr
      _ = C := by rw [hGram]; rfl
  have hLT : Lᵀ * T = B := by
    calc
      Lᵀ * T = (Rᵀ * R).submatrix Sum.inl Sum.inr :=
        Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Rᵀ R Sum.inl (Equiv.refl _) Sum.inr
      _ = B := by rw [hGram]; rfl
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUL⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq L (by simp [Fintype.card_sum])
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVT⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq T (by simp [Fintype.card_sum])
  rw [hLA] at hUL
  rw [hTC] at hVT
  refine ⟨Uᵀ * V, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      specNorm (Uᵀ * V) ≤ specNorm Uᵀ * specNorm V := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [specNorm_transpose]
        exact (mul_le_mul (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU)
          (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hV) (specNorm_nonneg V) zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul 1)
  · have hSA : (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt A := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
    rw [← hLT, ← hUL, ← hVT, Matrix.transpose_mul, hSA]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_posSemidef_of_sqrt_contraction_factor
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_posSemidef_of_sqrt_contraction_factor
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B X : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hC : C.PosSemidef) (hX : specNorm X ≤ 1)
    (hB : B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt C) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let D := fromBlocks (CFC.sqrt A) (0 : Matrix m n ℝ) (0 : Matrix n m ℝ) (CFC.sqrt C)
  have hSA : (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hSC : (CFC.sqrt C)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt C := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg C).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have h := ((posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_le_one X).mpr hX).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same D
  have hBt : CFC.sqrt C * (Xᵀ * CFC.sqrt A) = Bᵀ := by
    rw [hB, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, hSA, hSC]
  simpa only [D, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose,
    hSA, hSC, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero,
    Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul, add_zero, zero_add,
    CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self C hC.nonneg,
    ← hB, Matrix.transpose_mul, hSA, hSC, Matrix.mul_assoc, hBt] using h

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff_exists_sqrt_contraction_factor
statement:
theorem posSemidef_fromBlocks_iff_exists_sqrt_contraction_factor
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hC : C.PosSemidef) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef ↔
      ∃ X : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm X ≤ 1 ∧ B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_sqrt_contraction_factor_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hB⟩
    exact fromBlocks_posSemidef_of_sqrt_contraction_factor hA hC hX hB

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.exists_le_majorized
statement:
theorem WeaklyMajorized.exists_le_majorized {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y) :
    ∃ z : ι → ℝ, x ≤ z ∧ Majorized z y
proof:
:= by
  let K := convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ)
  let C := K + Set.Iic (0 : ι → ℝ)
  have hK : IsCompact K := (Set.finite_range (fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ)).isCompact_convexHull ℝ
  have hCclosed : IsClosed C := by
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add] using
      (isClosed_Iic : IsClosed (Set.Iic (0 : ι → ℝ))).vadd_left_of_isCompact hK
  have hCconvex : Convex ℝ C := (convex_convexHull ℝ _).add (convex_Iic _)
  have hyK : y ∈ K := subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨Equiv.refl ι, rfl⟩
  have hxC : x ∈ C := by
    by_contra hx
    obtain ⟨f, u, hu, hux⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point hCconvex hCclosed hx
    have hf0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ f (Pi.single i 1) := by
      by_contra hi
      have hi : f (Pi.single i 1) < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hi
      let t : ℝ := (|u - f y| + 1) / (-f (Pi.single i 1))
      have ht : 0 ≤ t := by
        dsimp [t]
        exact div_nonneg (by linarith [abs_nonneg (u - f y)]) (by linarith)
      have hw : -t • Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) ≤ (0 : ι → ℝ) := by
        intro j
        by_cases hij : j = i <;> simp [hij, ht]
      have hmem : y + (-t • Pi.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∈ C :=
        Set.add_mem_add hyK hw
      have hlt := hu _ hmem
      have hprod : t * (-f (Pi.single i 1)) = |u - f y| + 1 := by
        dsimp [t]
        exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by linarith)
      have he : f (y + (-t • Pi.single i (1 : ℝ))) = f y + t * (-f (Pi.single i 1)) := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul]
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [he, hprod] at hlt
      linarith [le_abs_self (u - f y)]
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hxy.exists_perm_sum_mul_le (fun i => f (Pi.single i 1)) hf0
    have hpK : y ∘ σ ∈ K := subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    have hpC : y ∘ σ ∈ C := by
      simpa only [add_zero] using Set.add_mem_add hpK
        (Set.mem_Iic.mpr (show (0 : ι → ℝ) ≤ 0 from le_rfl))
    have hle : f x ≤ f (y ∘ σ) := by
      change f.toLinearMap x ≤ f.toLinearMap (y ∘ σ)
      rw [apply_eq_sum_mul_single f.toLinearMap x, apply_eq_sum_mul_single f.toLinearMap (y ∘ σ)]
      exact hσ
    exact (hle.trans_lt (hu _ hpC)).not_gt hux
  rcases hxC with ⟨z, hz, w, hw, hzw⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_, (majorized_iff_mem_convexHull_permutations z y).mpr hz⟩
  rw [← hzw]
  exact add_le_of_nonpos_right hw

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.sum_monotone_convex_le
statement:
theorem WeaklyMajorized.sum_monotone_convex_le {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y)
    {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφm : Monotone φ) (hφ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ) :
    (∑ i, φ (x i)) ≤ ∑ i, φ (y i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzy⟩ := hxy.exists_le_majorized
  exact (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hφm (hxz i)).trans (hzy.sum_convex_le hφ)

name: NLAlib.monotone_convexOn_max_sub
statement:
theorem monotone_convexOn_max_sub (a : ℝ) :
    Monotone (fun u : ℝ => max (u - a) 0) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun u : ℝ => max (u - a) 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun u v huv => max_le_max (sub_le_sub_right huv a) le_rfl, ?_⟩
  convert
    ((convexOn_id (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).add_const (-a)).sup
      (convexOn_const (0 : ℝ) convex_univ) using 1
  all_goals (ext; rfl)

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_monotone_convex_le
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_monotone_convex_le (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    WeaklyMajorized x y ↔ ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Monotone φ → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ →
      (∑ i, φ (x i)) ≤ ∑ i, φ (y i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h φ hm hc
    exact h.sum_monotone_convex_le hm hc
  · intro h
    apply weaklyMajorized_of_sum_max_sub_le
    intro a
    exact h _ (monotone_convexOn_max_sub a).1 (monotone_convexOn_max_sub a).2

name: NLAlib.majorized_iff_sum_convex_le
statement:
theorem majorized_iff_sum_convex_le (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    Majorized x y ↔ ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ →
      (∑ i, φ (x i)) ≤ ∑ i, φ (y i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h φ hc
    exact h.sum_convex_le hc
  · intro h
    refine ⟨weaklyMajorized_of_sum_max_sub_le (fun a =>
      h _ (monotone_convexOn_max_sub a).2), ?_⟩
    have hpos := h id (convexOn_id convex_univ)
    have hneg := h (fun u : ℝ => -u) (concaveOn_id convex_univ).neg
    simp only [id_eq, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at hpos hneg
    linarith

name: NLAlib.sortedVector_antitone
statement: theorem sortedVector_antitone (x : ι → ℝ) : Antitone (sortedVector x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have h := Tuple.monotone_sort (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card ι) =>
    -x ((Fintype.equivFin ι).symm i)) hij
  simpa only [sortedVector, sortingEquiv, Equiv.coe_trans, Function.comp_def,
    neg_le_neg_iff] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_sortedVector
statement:
theorem sum_sortedVector (x : ι → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, f (sortedVector x i)) = ∑ i, f (x i)
proof:
:=
  (sortingEquiv x).sum_comp (fun i => f (x i))

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem sumLargest_zero (x : ι → ℝ) : sumLargest x 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [sumLargest]

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le
statement:
theorem sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le (x : ι → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Fintype.card ι ≤ k) : sumLargest x k = ∑ i, x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumLargest, if_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (Fin.isLt _) hk)]
  exact sum_sortedVector x id

name: NLAlib.sum_le_sumLargest
statement:
theorem sum_le_sumLargest [DecidableEq ι] (x : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, x i) ≤ sumLargest x S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let w : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℝ := fun i => if sortingEquiv x i ∈ S then 1 else 0
  have hw : (∑ i, w i) = (S.card : ℝ) := by
    change (∑ i, (fun j : ι => if j ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) (sortingEquiv x i)) = _
    rw [(sortingEquiv x).sum_comp (fun j : ι => if j ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)]
    simp
  have hsum : (∑ i, sortedVector x i * w i) = ∑ i ∈ S, x i := by
    change (∑ i, (fun j : ι => x j * (if j ∈ S then 1 else 0)) (sortingEquiv x i)) = _
    rw [(sortingEquiv x).sum_comp (fun j : ι => x j * (if j ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0))]
    simp
  rw [← hsum]
  exact sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone_of_sum_eq (sortedVector x) w
    (sortedVector_antitone x) (fun i => by dsimp [w]; split <;> positivity)
    (fun i => by dsimp [w]; split <;> norm_num) (Finset.card_le_univ S) hw

name: NLAlib.card_largestCoordinates
statement:
theorem card_largestCoordinates [DecidableEq ι] (x : ι → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι) : (largestCoordinates x k).card = k
proof:
:= by
  simp [largestCoordinates, card_filter_fin_lt hk]

name: NLAlib.sum_largestCoordinates
statement:
theorem sum_largestCoordinates [DecidableEq ι] (x : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ largestCoordinates x k, x i) = sumLargest x k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [largestCoordinates, Finset.sum_map, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply,
    Finset.sum_filter, sumLargest, sortedVector, Function.comp_apply]

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_sumLargest
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨largestCoordinates x k, card_largestCoordinates x hk,
    sum_largestCoordinates x k⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩
  simpa [hS] using sum_le_sumLargest x S

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le [DecidableEq ι] (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    WeaklyMajorized x y ↔ ∀ S : Finset ι, (∑ i ∈ S, x i) ≤ sumLargest y S.card
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h S
    exact (sum_le_sumLargest x S).trans (h S.card (Finset.card_le_univ S))
  · intro h k hk
    have hS := h (largestCoordinates x k)
    rwa [card_largestCoordinates x hk, sum_largestCoordinates x k] at hS

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.refl

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.trans

    (hyz : WeaklyMajorized y z) : WeaklyMajorized x z
proof: := fun k hk => (hxy k hk).trans (hyz k hk)

name: NLAlib.Majorized.refl
