name: NLAlib.Majorized.trans
statement:
theorem Majorized.trans {x y z : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y)
    (hyz : Majorized y z) : Majorized x z
proof: := ⟨hxy.1.trans hyz.1, hxy.2.trans hyz.2⟩

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_sqrt_mul_frobNorm_mul_specNorm_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem frobInner_le_sqrt_mul_frobNorm_mul_specNorm_of_rank_le {r : ℕ} (X E : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hX : X.rank ≤ r) : frobInner X E ≤ Real.sqrt r * frobNorm X * specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  set P : Matrix m m ℝ := X * moorePenroseInverse X with hPdef
  have hPX : P * X = X := mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul X
  have hs : P.IsSymm := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian X
  have hp : IsIdempotentElem P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem X
  have hinner : frobInner X E = frobInner X (P * E) := by
    have h := frobInner_mul_mul P X (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) E
    rw [hPX, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
      hs.eq] at h
    exact h
  have hrank : ((P * E).rank : ℝ) ≤ r := by
    have h1 : (P * E).rank ≤ P.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left P E
    have h2 : P.rank ≤ X.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left X _
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans (h2.trans hX)
  have hspec : specNorm (P * E) ≤ specNorm E :=
    calc specNorm (P * E) ≤ specNorm P * specNorm E := specNorm_mul_le P E
      _ ≤ 1 * specNorm E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem hs hp)
          (specNorm_nonneg E)
      _ = specNorm E := one_mul _
  have hfrob : frobNorm (P * E) ≤ Real.sqrt r * specNorm E :=
    calc frobNorm (P * E) ≤ Real.sqrt ((P * E).rank : ℝ) * specNorm (P * E) :=
          frobNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_specNorm (P * E)
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt r * specNorm E :=
          mul_le_mul (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hrank) hspec (specNorm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  calc frobInner X E = frobInner X (P * E) := hinner
    _ ≤ frobNorm X * frobNorm (P * E) := frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm X (P * E)
    _ ≤ frobNorm X * (Real.sqrt r * specNorm E) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrob (frobNorm_nonneg X)
    _ = Real.sqrt r * frobNorm X * specNorm E := by ring

name: NLAlib.sum_range_mul_le_of_partial_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_mul_le_of_partial_le {s d t : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ}
    (hs0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (hs : Antitone s)
    (h : ∀ k ≤ N, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, t i) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i * d i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i * t i
proof:
:= by
  set F : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (t i - d i) with hF
  have hF0 : ∀ k ≤ N, 0 ≤ F k := fun k hk => by
    simp only [hF, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    linarith [h k hk]
  have key : ∀ K ≤ N, s K * F K ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, s i * (t i - d i) := by
    intro K
    induction K with
    | zero => intro _; simp [hF]
    | succ K ih =>
      intro hK
      have ih' := ih (by omega)
      have hF1 := hF0 (K + 1) hK
      have hs1 : s (K + 1) ≤ s K := hs (Nat.le_succ K)
      have hFK : F (K + 1) = F K + (t K - d K) := by simp only [hF]; rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hFK]
      rw [hFK] at hF1
      nlinarith
  have hN := key N le_rfl
  have h0 : 0 ≤ s N * F N := mul_nonneg (hs0 N) (hF0 N le_rfl)
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i * (t i - d i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i * t i - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s i * d i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  linarith

name: NLAlib.frobInner_rectDiag
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : frobInner (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) D =
      ∑ i : Fin m, σ i * diagonalSequence D i := by
    rw [frobInner, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, diagonalSequence]
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < n
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨i, hi⟩]
      · simp [hi]
      · intro j _ hj
        rw [if_neg (fun h => hj (Fin.ext h.symm)), star_zero, zero_mul]
      · simp
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      · simp [hi]
      · intro j _
        rw [if_neg (fun (h : (i : ℕ) = j) => hi (h ▸ j.isLt)), star_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => σ i * diagonalSequence D i) m]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi ⊢
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi (min_le_left m n)
  · intro i _ hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, lt_min_iff, not_and_or, not_lt] at hi
    have : ¬ (i < m ∧ i < n) := by omega
    simp [diagonalSequence, this]

name: NLAlib.sum_castLE_le
statement:
private theorem sum_castLE_le {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (f : Fin M → ℝ) (hf : ∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) :
    ∑ l : Fin N, f (Fin.castLE h l) ≤ ∑ j, f j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ hab => Fin.castLE_injective h hab)]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun j _ _ => hf j)

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range {N k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ N) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ l : Fin N, (if (l : ℕ) < k then g l else 0) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if i < k then g i else 0) N, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  omega

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_col_eq_one
statement:
private theorem sum_norm_sq_col_eq_one {m : ℕ} {p : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜}
    (hp : HasOrthonormalCols p) (c : Fin m) : ∑ j, ‖p j c‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M c c))
    hp.conjTranspose_mul_self
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
    RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, map_sum, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow,
    RCLike.ofReal_re, RCLike.one_re] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_row_eq_one
statement:
private theorem sum_norm_sq_row_eq_one {m : ℕ} {p : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜}
    (hp : p * pᴴ = 1) (c : Fin m) : ∑ j, ‖p c j‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M c c)) hp
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
    RCLike.star_def, RCLike.mul_conj, map_sum, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow,
    RCLike.ofReal_re, RCLike.one_re] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_range_diagonalSequence_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, R, h⟩ := exists_isSVD D
  have hkm : k ≤ m := hk.trans (min_le_left m n)
  have hkn : k ≤ n := hk.trans (min_le_right m n)
  let p : ℕ → Fin (min m n) → ℝ := fun i l =>
    if hi : i < m then ‖P ⟨i, hi⟩ (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) l)‖ else 0
  let r : ℕ → Fin (min m n) → ℝ := fun i l =>
    if hi : i < n then ‖R ⟨i, hi⟩ (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) l)‖ else 0
  let t : Fin (min m n) → ℝ := fun l => singularValues D l
  have hdiag : ∀ i, diagonalSequence D i ≤ ∑ l, t l * (p i l * r i l) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < m ∧ i < n
    · simp only [diagonalSequence, dif_pos hi, p, r, dif_pos hi.1, dif_pos hi.2, t]
      rw [h.apply, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => ?_
      calc RCLike.re ((singularValues D l : 𝕜) *
          P ⟨i, hi.1⟩ (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) l) *
            star (R ⟨i, hi.2⟩ (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) l)))
          ≤ ‖(singularValues D l : 𝕜) *
              P ⟨i, hi.1⟩ (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) l) *
                star (R ⟨i, hi.2⟩ (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) l))‖ :=
            RCLike.re_le_norm _
        _ = _ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_star, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
            abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg D _)]
          ring
    · simp only [diagonalSequence, dif_neg hi]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => mul_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg D _)
        (mul_nonneg (by simp only [p]; split_ifs <;> positivity)
          (by simp only [r]; split_ifs <;> positivity))
  have hcol : ∀ l, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, p i l ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, r i l ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro l
    constructor
    · calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, p i l ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, p i l ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_subset_range.2 hkm)
              (fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
        _ = ∑ j : Fin m, ‖P j (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) l)‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => p i l ^ 2) m]
            simp [p]
        _ = 1 := sum_norm_sq_col_eq_one h.conjTranspose_mul_left _
    · calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, r i l ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, r i l ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_subset_range.2 hkn)
              (fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
        _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ‖R j (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) l)‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => r i l ^ 2) n]
            simp [r]
        _ = 1 := sum_norm_sq_col_eq_one h.conjTranspose_mul_right _
  have hrow : ∀ i, ∑ l, p i l ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧ ∑ l, r i l ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · by_cases hi : i < m
      · calc ∑ l, p i l ^ 2 = ∑ l : Fin (min m n),
              (fun j => ‖P ⟨i, hi⟩ j‖ ^ 2) (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) l) := by simp [p, hi]
          _ ≤ ∑ j, ‖P ⟨i, hi⟩ j‖ ^ 2 :=
            sum_castLE_le (min_le_left m n) (fun j : Fin m => ‖P ⟨i, hi⟩ j‖ ^ 2)
              (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
          _ = 1 := sum_norm_sq_row_eq_one h.mul_conjTranspose_left _
      · simp [p, hi]
    · by_cases hi : i < n
      · calc ∑ l, r i l ^ 2 = ∑ l : Fin (min m n),
              (fun j => ‖R ⟨i, hi⟩ j‖ ^ 2) (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) l) := by simp [r, hi]
          _ ≤ ∑ j, ‖R ⟨i, hi⟩ j‖ ^ 2 :=
            sum_castLE_le (min_le_right m n) (fun j : Fin n => ‖R ⟨i, hi⟩ j‖ ^ 2)
              (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
          _ = 1 := sum_norm_sq_row_eq_one h.mul_conjTranspose_right _
      · simp [r, hi]
  let w : Fin (min m n) → ℝ := fun l => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (p i l ^ 2 + r i l ^ 2) / 2
  have hw0 : ∀ l, 0 ≤ w l := fun l =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity
  have hw1 : ∀ l, w l ≤ 1 := fun l => by
    have h1 := (hcol l).1
    have h2 := (hcol l).2
    simp only [w, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    linarith
  have hbudget : ∑ l, w l ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    simp only [w]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ∑ l, (p i l ^ 2 + r i l ^ 2) / 2
        ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
          have h1 := (hrow i).1
          have h2 := (hrow i).2
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          linarith
      _ = k := by simp
  have hanti : Antitone t := fun a b hab =>
    singularValues_antitone D (show (a : ℕ) ≤ b from hab)
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, diagonalSequence D i
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ∑ l, t l * (p i l * r i l) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hdiag i
    _ = ∑ l, t l * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, p i l * r i l := by
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ l, t l * w l := Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p i l - r i l)])
          (singularValues_nonneg D _)
    _ ≤ ∑ l : Fin (min m n), if (l : ℕ) < k then t l else 0 :=
        sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone t w (fun l => singularValues_nonneg D _) hanti
          hw0 hw1 hbudget
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues D i :=
        sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hk (singularValues D)

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul_fin
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD X
  set D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜 := Uᴴ * E * V with hDdef
  have hD : singularValues D = singularValues E := by
    have hU : HasOrthonormalCols Uᴴ := by
      rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
      exact h.mul_conjTranspose_left
    rw [hDdef, singularValues_mul_unitary _ h.conjTranspose_mul_right,
      singularValues_isometry_mul hU]
  have hinner : frobInner X E =
      frobInner (rectDiag (singularValues X) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) D := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, frobInner_eq_trace]
    conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
    simp only [hDdef, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm V]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hinner, frobInner_rectDiag]
  refine sum_range_mul_le_of_partial_le (singularValues_nonneg X) (singularValues_antitone X)
    fun k hk => ?_
  rw [← hD]
  exact sum_range_diagonalSequence_le D hk

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul
statement:
theorem frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul (X E : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner X E ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues X k * singularValues E k
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul_fin
    (X.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
    (E.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
  rwa [frobInner_reindex, singularValues_reindex, singularValues_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.sum_eigenvalues_rpow_add_le
statement:
theorem sum_eigenvalues_rpow_add_le {X Y : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) (hY : Y.PosSemidef) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ p) +
      (∑ i, hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ p) ≤
        ∑ i, (hX.add hY).isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let G := Matrix.fromRows (spectralGramRows hX) (spectralGramRows hY)
  have hG : G.conjTranspose * G = X + Y := by
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromRows_eq_fromCols_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows, spectralGramRows_adjoint_mul,
      spectralGramRows_adjoint_mul]
  have hd : (fun i => RCLike.re ((G * G.conjTranspose) i i)) =
      Sum.elim hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues := by
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl i =>
      have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M i i))
        (spectralGramRows_mul_adjoint hX)
      simpa [G, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using h
    | inr i =>
      have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M i i))
        (spectralGramRows_mul_adjoint hY)
      simpa [G, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using h
  have hm := (majorized_diagonal_eigenvalues
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self G)).1
  rw [hd] at hm
  have hs := hm.sum_rpow_le
    (by intro i; cases i <;> simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] <;>
      first | exact hX.eigenvalues_nonneg _ | exact hY.eigenvalues_nonneg _)
    (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose G).eigenvalues_nonneg hp
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type] at hs
  rw [sum_eigenvalues_mul_adjoint_eq_adjoint_mul G (fun x => x ^ p)
    (Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : p ≠ 0))] at hs
  simpa only [hG, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using hs

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal, one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) p) hp.ne']
  rw [min_self, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  simp_rw [singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA]
  exact (sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA.isHermitian (fun x => x ^ p)).symm

name: NLAlib.re_trace_rpow_add_le
statement:
theorem re_trace_rpow_add_le {X Y : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) (hY : Y.PosSemidef) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    RCLike.re (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) X).trace +
      RCLike.re (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) Y).trace ≤
        RCLike.re (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (X + Y)).trace
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hX.isHermitian,
    re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hY.isHermitian,
    re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues (hX.add hY).isHermitian] using
    sum_eigenvalues_rpow_add_le hX hY hp

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_sub_rpow_le
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (A-B).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := by simpa using hD.add hB
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  rw [schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hD hp0,
    schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA hp0,
    schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hB hp0]
  have h := sum_eigenvalues_rpow_add_le hD hB hp
  simp only [sub_add_cancel] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_sub_one
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (A-B).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := by simpa using hD.add hB
  have ht (M : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
      schattenNormReal M 1 = RCLike.re M.trace := by
    have h := schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hM (p := 1) zero_lt_one
    have ht := re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hM.isHermitian (fun x => x)
    have hc : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) M = M := cfc_id ℝ M hM.isHermitian
    rw [hc] at ht
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one, ← ht] using h
  rw [ht _ hD, ht _ hA, ht _ hB, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]

name: NLAlib.eigenvaluePrefix_add_spectralTraceTail
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvaluePrefix, sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone,
    spectralTraceTail, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have ht : RCLike.re A.trace = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), hA.eigenvalues₀ i := by
    rw [hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues, map_sum]
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re]
    exact sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA id
  rw [ht]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
  · simp [hi, not_le.mpr hi]
  · simp [hi, not_lt.mp hi]

name: NLAlib.spectralTraceTail_antitone
statement:
theorem spectralTraceTail_antitone {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    Antitone (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold spectralTraceTail
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  by_cases hb : b ≤ (i : ℕ)
  · simp [hb, hab.trans hb]
  · by_cases ha : a ≤ (i : ℕ)
    · simpa [hb, ha] using eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA i
    · simp [hb, ha]

name: NLAlib.spectralTraceTail_le_re_trace_of_rank_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  let B := A - R
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD B
  have hFix : (U * Uᴴ) * B = B := by
    rw [← h.mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq]
    exact mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul B
  have hTrace : (Uᴴ * B * U).trace = B.trace := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hFix]
  have hNonneg := re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef (hR.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same U)
  have hComp : RCLike.re B.trace ≤ RCLike.re (Uᴴ * A * U).trace := by
    have he : Uᴴ * R * U = Uᴴ * A * U - Uᴴ * B * U := by
      dsimp only [B]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
      abel
    rw [he, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, hTrace] at hNonneg
    linarith
  have hFan := trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix hA.isHermitian h.left_orth
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hFan
  have hSplit := eigenvaluePrefix_add_spectralTraceTail hA.isHermitian B.rank
  have hMono := spectralTraceTail_antitone hA hr
  have he : RCLike.re B.trace = RCLike.re A.trace - RCLike.re R.trace := by
    simp only [B, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.posDef_identity_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one
statement:
theorem posDef_identity_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (fromBlocks 1 X Xᵀ 1).PosDef ↔ specNorm X < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_and_schur,
    inv_one, Matrix.mul_one, and_iff_right Matrix.PosDef.one]
  have hG : (Xᵀ * X).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X
  rw [posDef_one_sub_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_posSemidef hG,
    ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial X,
    ← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  exact sq_lt_one_iff₀ (specNorm_nonneg X)

name: NLAlib.posDef_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_sqrt_factor
statement:
theorem posDef_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_sqrt_factor
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B X : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef) (hB : B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt C) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔ specNorm X < 1
proof:
:= by
  let D := fromBlocks (CFC.sqrt A) (0 : Matrix m n ℝ) (0 : Matrix n m ℝ) (CFC.sqrt C)
  have hSA : (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hSC : (CFC.sqrt C)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt C := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using (CFC.sqrt_nonneg C).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hD : IsUnit D := Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr
    ⟨(CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff A hA.posSemidef.nonneg).mpr hA.isUnit,
      (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff C hC.posSemidef.nonneg).mpr hC.isUnit⟩
  have hBt : CFC.sqrt C * (Xᵀ * CFC.sqrt A) = Bᵀ := by
    rw [hB, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, hSA, hSC]
  have hfactor : D * fromBlocks 1 X Xᵀ 1 * star D = fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C := by
    simp only [D, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, hSA, hSC, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_one, add_zero, zero_add,
      CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.posSemidef.nonneg,
      CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self C hC.posSemidef.nonneg, ← hB, Matrix.mul_assoc, hBt]
  rw [← hfactor, hD.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff,
    posDef_identity_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one]

name: NLAlib.posDef_fromBlocks_iff_exists_strict_sqrt_contraction_factor
statement:
theorem posDef_fromBlocks_iff_exists_strict_sqrt_contraction_factor
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔
      ∃ X : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm X < 1 ∧ B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hH
    obtain ⟨X, -, hX⟩ := exists_sqrt_contraction_factor_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef hH.posSemidef
    exact ⟨X, (posDef_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_sqrt_factor hA hC hX).mp hH, hX⟩
  · rintro ⟨X, hnorm, hX⟩
    exact (posDef_fromBlocks_iff_specNorm_lt_one_of_sqrt_factor hA hC hX).mpr hnorm

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_mul_comm
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_mul_comm (A B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    spectralRadius ℝ (A * B) = spectralRadius ℝ (B * A)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : spectrum ℝ (A * B) = spectrum ℝ (B * A) := by
    ext z
    rw [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly,
      Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm]
  simp only [spectralRadius, hs]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_positivity_iff_relative_spectralRadius
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_positivity_iff_relative_spectralRadius
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef) :
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef ↔
      spectralRadius ℝ (Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B * C⁻¹) ≤ 1) ∧
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔
      spectralRadius ℝ (Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B * C⁻¹) < 1)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have hD : (Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA.inv.posSemidef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
  constructor
  · have hs := Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ B C hA
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hs
    rw [hs, ← Matrix.le_iff, le_iff_relative_spectralRadius_le_one hC hD,
      spectralRadius_mul_comm C⁻¹]
  · rw [posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_and_schur,
      and_iff_right hA, posDef_sub_iff_relative_spectralRadius_lt_one hC hD,
      spectralRadius_mul_comm C⁻¹]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_diagonal_eq_of_majorized
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_diagonal_eq_of_majorized (d lam : n → ℝ)
    (hmajor : Majorized d lam) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧
      Matrix.diag (Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) = d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, ((Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) i i - d i) ^ 2
  have hF : Continuous F := by dsimp [F]; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hmin⟩ := exists_orthogonal_isMinOn_of_continuous F hF
  let A : Matrix n n ℝ := Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := by simp [A, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hA : A.IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hAt
  have hminA : ∀ R : Matrix n n ℝ, Rᵀ * R = 1 →
      (∑ i, (A i i - d i) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i, ((R * A * Rᵀ) i i - d i) ^ 2 := by
    intro R hR
    have hRQ : HasOrthonormalCols (R * Q) := by
      rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Rᵀ R Q, hR,
        Matrix.one_mul]
      exact hQ
    have hbound := hmin (R * Q) hRQ
    simpa only [F, A, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hbound
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_⟩
  change Matrix.diag A = d
  by_contra hneq
  let r : n → ℝ := fun i => A i i - d i
  have hnonzero : ∃ i, r i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hnot
    apply hneq
    funext i
    have hall : ∀ i, r i = 0 := by simpa only [not_exists, not_not] using hnot
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hall i)
  have htrace : (∑ i, A i i) = ∑ i, lam i := by
    change A.trace = _
    dsimp [A]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  have hsumr : ∑ i, r i = 0 := by
    simp only [r, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [htrace, hmajor.2]
    ring
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, S, hSne, hS, hmax⟩ := exists_pos_max_residual r hsumr hnonzero
  have hcross : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S, A i j = 0 := by
    intro i hi j hj
    have hstat := diagonal_error_stationarity_of_min A hAt d hminA i j
    change (r i - r j) * A i j = 0 at hstat
    have hdiff : r i - r j ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      have hjρ : r j = ρ := (sub_eq_zero.mp heq).symm.trans ((hS i).mp hi)
      exact hj ((hS j).mpr hjρ)
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hstat).resolve_left hdiff
  have hcomm := coordinateSelector_commute_of_cross_eq_zero hA S hcross
  have hcommC := coordinateSelector_compl_commute S hcomm
  let p : n → ℝ := columnProjectionMass Q S
  have hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j := columnProjectionMass_nonneg Q S
  have hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1 := columnProjectionMass_le_one hQ S
  have hbudget : ∑ j, p j = (S.card : ℝ) := sum_columnProjectionMass_eq_card hQ S
  have horder : ∀ j k, 0 < p j → p k < 1 → lam j ≤ lam k := by
    intro j k hj hk
    let u := normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j
    let v := normalizedProjectedColumn Q Sᶜ k
    have hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1 :=
      norm_toLp_normalizedProjectedColumn Q S j hj
    have hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1 :=
      norm_toLp_normalizedProjectedColumn Q Sᶜ k
        (by rw [columnProjectionMass_compl hQ S k]; exact sub_pos.mpr hk)
    have huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 := normalizedProjectedColumn_dotProduct_compl_eq_zero Q S j k
    have hAu : A *ᵥ u = lam j • u :=
      mulVec_normalizedProjectedColumn_eq_smul hQ lam rfl S hcomm j
    have hAv : A *ᵥ v = lam k • v :=
      mulVec_normalizedProjectedColumn_eq_smul hQ lam rfl Sᶜ hcommC k
    have hdisjoint : ∀ i, u i * v i = 0 :=
      normalizedProjectedColumn_mul_compl_eq_zero Q S j k
    have hsu : ∀ i ∉ S, u i = 0 := fun i hi =>
      normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem Q S j i hi
    have hsv : ∀ i ∈ S, v i = 0 := fun i hi =>
      normalizedProjectedColumn_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem Q Sᶜ k i (by simpa using hi)
    have hη : 0 < ∑ i, (A i i - d i) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2) :=
      sum_mul_sub_sq_pos_of_max_support r u v ρ S hS hmax hu hv hsu hsv
    exact eigenvalue_le_of_diagonal_error_min A hAt d u v hu hv huv
      (lam j) (lam k) hAu hAv hdisjoint hη hminA
  have hbottom := sum_mul_le_sum_sub_sumLargest_of_weight_order lam p hp0 hp1 horder
    (Finset.card_le_univ S) hbudget
  have hmajorS := hmajor.sum_sub_sumLargest_le_sum S
  have hweighted : (∑ j, lam j * p j) = ∑ i ∈ S, A i i :=
    sum_mul_columnProjectionMass_eq_sum_diagonal lam rfl S
  have hresidual : (∑ i ∈ S, A i i) = (∑ i ∈ S, d i) + (S.card : ℝ) * ρ := by
    have heq : ∀ i ∈ S, A i i = d i + ρ := by
      intro i hi
      have hr := (hS i).mp hi
      dsimp [r] at hr
      linarith
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl heq, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hmass : 0 < (S.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hSne.card_pos
  have hpositive : 0 < (S.card : ℝ) * ρ := mul_pos hmass hρ
  rw [hweighted, hresidual] at hbottom
  linarith

name: NLAlib.diagonal_conjugation_eq_sq_mulVec
statement:
theorem diagonal_conjugation_eq_sq_mulVec (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (lam : n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.diag (Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j => Q i j ^ 2) *ᵥ lam
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) i i = _
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Matrix.of_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.majorized_iff_exists_orthogonal_diagonal_eq
statement:
theorem majorized_iff_exists_orthogonal_diagonal_eq (d lam : n → ℝ) :
    Majorized d lam ↔ ∃ Q : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧
      Matrix.diag (Q * Matrix.diagonal lam * Qᵀ) = d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_orthogonal_diagonal_eq_of_majorized d lam
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, hdiag⟩
    rw [← hdiag, diagonal_conjugation_eq_sq_mulVec]
    exact majorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic lam (sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic hQ)

name: NLAlib.det_overlapping_blocks_le_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem det_overlapping_blocks_le_and_eq_iff_aux
    (P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (U : Matrix ι m ℝ) (V : Matrix ι n ℝ)
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hH : (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).PosDef) :
    (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).det * P.det ≤
      (fromBlocks P U Uᵀ A).det * (fromBlocks P V Vᵀ C).det ∧
    ((fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).det * P.det =
      (fromBlocks P U Uᵀ A).det * (fromBlocks P V Vᵀ C).det ↔
      B - Uᵀ * P⁻¹ * V = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : P.PosDef := hH.submatrix
    (Sum.inl_injective : Function.Injective (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ (m ⊕ n)))
  let : Invertible P := hP.isUnit.invertible
  have hPt : P⁻¹ᵀ = P⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hP.inv.isHermitian.eq
  let SA := A - Uᵀ * P⁻¹ * U
  let SB := B - Uᵀ * P⁻¹ * V
  let SC := C - Vᵀ * P⁻¹ * V
  have hSchur : fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C - (fromCols U V)ᵀ * P⁻¹ * fromCols U V =
      fromBlocks SA SB SBᵀ SC := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols]
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [SA, SB, SC, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_mul,
        hPt, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hSPD : (fromBlocks SA SB SBᵀ SC).PosDef := by
    rw [← hSchur]
    exact ((posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_and_schur P (fromCols U V) (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).mp hH).2
  have hdet : (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).det =
      P.det * (fromBlocks SA SB SBᵀ SC).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, hSchur]
  have hdetA : (fromBlocks P U Uᵀ A).det = P.det * SA.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
  have hdetC : (fromBlocks P V Vᵀ C).det = P.det * SC.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
  rw [hdet, hdetA, hdetC]
  constructor
  · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (det_fromBlocks_le_mul_det_of_posSemidef hSPD.posSemidef)
      (sq_nonneg P.det)
    nlinarith
  · have heq : (P.det * (fromBlocks SA SB SBᵀ SC).det * P.det =
        P.det * SA.det * (P.det * SC.det)) ↔ (fromBlocks SA SB SBᵀ SC).det = SA.det * SC.det := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hP.det_pos.ne')
        nlinarith
      · intro h
        rw [h]
        ring
    rw [heq, det_fromBlocks_eq_mul_det_iff_of_posDef hSPD]

name: NLAlib.det_overlapping_blocks_le
statement:
theorem det_overlapping_blocks_le
    (P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (U : Matrix ι m ℝ) (V : Matrix ι n ℝ)
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hH : (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).PosDef) :
    (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).det * P.det ≤
      (fromBlocks P U Uᵀ A).det * (fromBlocks P V Vᵀ C).det
proof:
:=
  (det_overlapping_blocks_le_and_eq_iff_aux P U V A B C hH).1

name: NLAlib.det_overlapping_blocks_eq_iff
statement:
theorem det_overlapping_blocks_eq_iff
    (P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (U : Matrix ι m ℝ) (V : Matrix ι n ℝ)
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hH : (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).PosDef) :
    (fromBlocks P (fromCols U V) (fromCols U V)ᵀ (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C)).det * P.det =
      (fromBlocks P U Uᵀ A).det * (fromBlocks P V Vᵀ C).det ↔
      B - Uᵀ * P⁻¹ * V = 0
proof:
:=
  (det_overlapping_blocks_le_and_eq_iff_aux P U V A B C hH).2

name: NLAlib.principalMinor_eq_det_toBlock
statement:
theorem principalMinor_eq_det_toBlock (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) :
    principalMinor A S = (A.toBlock (· ∈ S) (· ∈ S)).det
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.principalMinor_pos
statement:
theorem principalMinor_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (S : Finset n) :
    0 < principalMinor A S
proof:
:=
  (hA.submatrix (Subtype.val_injective : Function.Injective (Subtype.val : S → n))).det_pos

name: NLAlib.principalMinor_nonneg
statement:
theorem principalMinor_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (S : Finset n) :

proof: := (hA.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n)).det_nonneg

name: NLAlib.continuous_principalMinor
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_principalMinor (S : Finset n) :
    Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => principalMinor A S)

:= by

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.one_le_det_one_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.one_le_det_one_add {L : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.PosSemidef) : 1 ≤ (1 + L).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.det_one_add_eq_sum_principal_minors]
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum (fun S (_ : S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset n))) =>
    (hL.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n)).det_nonneg) (Finset.mem_univ (∅ : Finset n))
  simpa only [Matrix.det_isEmpty] using h

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_eq_prod
statement:
theorem principalMinorProduct_eq_prod (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    principalMinorProduct A k = ∏ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k, principalMinor A S
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_pos
statement:
theorem principalMinorProduct_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < principalMinorProduct A k
proof: := Finset.prod_pos (fun S _ => principalMinor_pos hA S)

name: NLAlib.principalMinorProduct_nonneg
statement:
theorem principalMinorProduct_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (k : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.continuous_principalMinorProduct
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_principalMinorProduct (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => principalMinorProduct A k)

:= by

name: NLAlib.det_toBlock_complement_eq_principalMinor_erase
statement:
theorem det_toBlock_complement_eq_principalMinor_erase
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (T : Finset n) (i : T) :
    ((A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i)).det =
      principalMinor A (T.erase i.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : {j : T // j ≠ i} ≃ (T.erase i.val : Finset n) :=
    { toFun := fun j => ⟨j.val.val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
        ⟨fun h => j.property (Subtype.ext h), j.val.property⟩⟩
      invFun := fun j => ⟨⟨j.val, (Finset.mem_erase.mp j.property).2⟩,
        fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.mp j.property).1 (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
      left_inv := by intro j; rfl
      right_inv := by intro j; rfl }
  have he : (A.toBlock (· ∈ T.erase i.val) (· ∈ T.erase i.val)).submatrix e e =
      (A.toBlock (· ∈ T) (· ∈ T)).toBlock (fun j => j ≠ i) (fun j => j ≠ i) := by
    rfl
  rw [← he, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.hadamard_le_hadamard_of_posSemidef_left
statement:
theorem hadamard_le_hadamard_of_posSemidef_left {A B C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hBC : B ≤ C) : A ⊙ B ≤ A ⊙ C
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.hadamard (Matrix.le_iff.mp hBC)
  have he : A ⊙ (C - B) = A ⊙ C - A ⊙ B := by ext i j; simp [Matrix.hadamard_apply, mul_sub]
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.posDef_hadamard_of_posDef_of_diag_pos
statement:
theorem posDef_hadamard_of_posDef_of_diag_pos {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ i, 0 < B i i) : (A ⊙ B).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hEmpty | hNonempty
  · let : IsEmpty n := hEmpty
    have he : A ⊙ B = (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [he]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one
  · let : Nonempty n := hNonempty
    obtain ⟨ha, -, hlo, -⟩ := posDef_extreme_eigenvalues_sandwich hA Fintype.card_pos
    have hle := hadamard_le_hadamard_of_posSemidef_left hB hlo
    rw [Matrix.hadamard_comm B A, Matrix.hadamard_smul, Matrix.hadamard_one] at hle
    exact posDef_of_posDef_le ((Matrix.PosDef.diagonal hdiag).smul ha) hle

name: NLAlib.abs_quadForm_le_iff_neg_le_and_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.le_iff, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hA.add hB)
      intro x
      have hx := (abs_le.mp (h x)).1
      simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add,
        neg_le_iff_add_nonneg, add_comm] using hx
    · apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hA.sub hB)
      intro x
      have hx := (abs_le.mp (h x)).2
      simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, sub_nonneg] using hx
  · rintro ⟨hp, hm⟩ x
    have hp' := hp.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    have hm' := hm.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_sub] at hp' hm'
    rw [abs_le]
    simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial]
    constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.neg_hadamard_le_hadamard_of_neg_le_of_le
statement:
theorem neg_hadamard_le_hadamard_of_neg_le_of_le {A B C D : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hAB : -A ≤ B) (hBA : B ≤ A) (hCD : -C ≤ D) (hDC : D ≤ C) : -(A ⊙ C) ≤ B ⊙ D
proof:
:= by
  have hABp : (A + B).PosSemidef := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm] at hAB; exact hAB
  have hABm : (A - B).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hBA
  have hCDp : (C + D).PosSemidef := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm] at hCD; exact hCD
  have hCDm : (C - D).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hDC
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have he : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((A + B) ⊙ (C + D) + (A - B) ⊙ (C - D)) = B ⊙ D + A ⊙ C := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.hadamard_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [← he]
  exact ((hABp.hadamard hCDp).add (hABm.hadamard hCDm)).smul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)

name: NLAlib.hadamard_le_hadamard_of_neg_le_of_le
statement:
theorem hadamard_le_hadamard_of_neg_le_of_le {A B C D : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hAB : -A ≤ B) (hBA : B ≤ A) (hCD : -C ≤ D) (hDC : D ≤ C) : B ⊙ D ≤ A ⊙ C
proof:
:= by
  have hABp : (A + B).PosSemidef := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm] at hAB; exact hAB
  have hABm : (A - B).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hBA
  have hCDp : (C + D).PosSemidef := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm] at hCD; exact hCD
  have hCDm : (C - D).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hDC
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  have he : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((A + B) ⊙ (C - D) + (A - B) ⊙ (C + D)) = A ⊙ C - B ⊙ D := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.hadamard_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [← he]
  exact ((hABp.hadamard hCDm).add (hABm.hadamard hCDp)).smul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)

name: NLAlib.abs_quadForm_hadamard_le_of_abs_quadForm_le
statement:
theorem abs_quadForm_hadamard_le_of_abs_quadForm_le {A B C D : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hAB : ∀ x, |quadForm B x| ≤ quadForm A x) (hCD : ∀ x, |quadForm D x| ≤ quadForm C x) :
    ∀ x, |quadForm (B ⊙ D) x| ≤ quadForm (A ⊙ C) x
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (abs_quadForm_le_iff_neg_le_and_le hA hB).mp hAB
  have hq := (abs_quadForm_le_iff_neg_le_and_le hC hD).mp hCD
  exact (abs_quadForm_le_iff_neg_le_and_le (hA.hadamard hC) (hB.hadamard hD)).mpr
    ⟨neg_hadamard_le_hadamard_of_neg_le_of_le hp.1 hp.2 hq.1 hq.2,
      hadamard_le_hadamard_of_neg_le_of_le hp.1 hp.2 hq.1 hq.2⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_sumLargest
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sumLargest (x w : ι → ℝ) (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι)
    (hbudget : ∑ i, w i = (k : ℝ)) : (∑ i, x i * w i) ≤ sumLargest x k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (sortingEquiv x).sum_comp (fun i => x i * w i)]
  exact sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone_of_sum_eq (sortedVector x)
    (w ∘ sortingEquiv x) (sortedVector_antitone x) (fun i => hw0 _)
    (fun i => hw1 _) hk (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      ((sortingEquiv x).sum_comp w).trans hbudget)

name: NLAlib.weaklyMajorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem weaklyMajorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic (y : ι → ℝ)
    {D : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hD : D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ ι) : WeaklyMajorized (D *ᵥ y) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le]
  intro S
  let w : ι → ℝ := fun j => ∑ i ∈ S, D i j
  have hw0 (j : ι) : 0 ≤ w j :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => nonneg_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD
  have hw1 (j : ι) : w j ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← sum_col_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD j]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ S)
      (fun i _ _ => nonneg_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD)
  have hw : (∑ j, w j) = (S.card : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [sum_row_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD]
    simp
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ S, (D *ᵥ y) i) = ∑ j, y j * w j := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, w]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
  rw [hsum]
  exact sum_mul_le_sumLargest y w hw0 hw1 (Finset.card_le_univ S) hw

name: NLAlib.majorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem majorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic (y : ι → ℝ)
    {D : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hD : D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ ι) : Majorized (D *ᵥ y) y
proof:
:=
  ⟨weaklyMajorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic y hD,
    sum_mulVec_of_mem_doublyStochastic hD⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_sub_sumLargest_le_sum_mul
statement:
theorem sum_sub_sumLargest_le_sum_mul (x w : ι → ℝ) (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι)
    (hbudget : ∑ i, w i = (k : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, x i) - sumLargest x (Fintype.card ι - k) ≤ ∑ i, x i * w i
proof:
:= by
  have hmass : (∑ i, (1 - w i)) = ((Fintype.card ι - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hbudget, Nat.cast_sub hk]
    simp
  have h := sum_mul_le_sumLargest x (fun i => 1 - w i)
    (fun i => sub_nonneg.mpr (hw1 i)) (fun i => by linarith [hw0 i])
    (Nat.sub_le _ _) hmass
  have he : (∑ i, x i * (1 - w i)) = (∑ i, x i) - ∑ i, x i * w i := by
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_one, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [he] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_threshold_of_weight_order
statement:
theorem exists_threshold_of_weight_order (a p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∀ i, p i ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ i j, 0 < p i → p j < 1 → a i ≤ a j)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < p i) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ, (∀ i, (a i - γ) * p i ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, 0 ≤ (a i - γ) * (1 - p i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < p i
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hpos
    exact ⟨i, by simp [S, hi]⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmax⟩ := S.exists_max_image a hS
  have hjp : 0 < p j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
  refine ⟨a j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : 0 < p i
    · exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
        (sub_nonpos.mpr (hmax i (by simp [S, hi]))) (hp0 i)
    · have hi0 : p i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hi) (hp0 i)
      simp [hi0]
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : p i < 1
    · exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (horder j i hjp hi))
        (sub_nonneg.mpr (hp1 i))
    · have hi1 : p i = 1 := le_antisymm (hp1 i) (le_of_not_gt hi)
      simp [hi1]

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_sum_of_weight_order
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_of_weight_order (a p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∀ i, p i ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ i j, 0 < p i → p j < 1 → a i ≤ a j)
    (T : Finset ι) (hbudget : ∑ i, p i = (T.card : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, a i * p i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ T, a i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hpos : ∃ i, 0 < p i
  · obtain ⟨γ, hleft, hright⟩ :=
      exists_threshold_of_weight_order a p hp0 hp1 horder hpos
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ T, (a i - γ) * (1 - p i)) -
        ∑ i ∈ Tᶜ, (a i - γ) * p i := by
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ => hleft i).trans
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hright i))
    have htotal : (∑ i, (a i - γ) * p i) =
        (∑ i, a i * p i) - γ * T.card := by
      simp_rw [sub_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hbudget]
    have hsplit := T.sum_add_sum_compl (fun i => (a i - γ) * p i)
    have hT : (∑ i ∈ T, (a i - γ) * (1 - p i)) =
        (∑ i ∈ T, a i) - γ * T.card - ∑ i ∈ T, (a i - γ) * p i := by
      simp_rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const]
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [hT] at hnonneg
    linarith
  · have hp : ∀ i, p i = 0 := by
      intro i
      exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt fun hi => hpos ⟨i, hi⟩) (hp0 i)
    have hcard : T.card = 0 := by simpa [hp] using hbudget.symm
    have hT : T = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hcard
    simp [hp, hT]

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_sum_sub_sumLargest_of_weight_order
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_sub_sumLargest_of_weight_order (a p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∀ i, p i ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ i j, 0 < p i → p j < 1 → a i ≤ a j)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι) (hbudget : ∑ i, p i = (k : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, a i * p i) ≤ (∑ i, a i) - sumLargest a (Fintype.card ι - k)
proof:
:= by
  let U := largestCoordinates a (Fintype.card ι - k)
  have hcardU : U.card = Fintype.card ι - k :=
    card_largestCoordinates a (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  have hcardT : Uᶜ.card = k := by rw [Finset.card_compl, hcardU]; omega
  have hsumU : (∑ i ∈ U, a i) = sumLargest a (Fintype.card ι - k) :=
    sum_largestCoordinates a _
  have hsplit := U.sum_add_sum_compl a
  have hbound := sum_mul_le_sum_of_weight_order a p hp0 hp1 horder Uᶜ
    (by rw [hcardT]; exact hbudget)
  rw [hsumU] at hsplit
  linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem norm_sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic_of_hasOrthonormalCols {P : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => ‖P i j‖ ^ 2) ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ n
proof:
:= by
  have hPP : P * Pᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hP
  rw [mem_doublyStochastic_iff_sum]
  refine ⟨fun i j => sq_nonneg _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M i i)) hPP
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
      RCLike.star_def, RCLike.mul_conj, map_sum, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re, RCLike.one_re] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.of_apply] using h
  · intro j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M j j)) (show Pᴴ * P = 1 from hP)
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
      RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, map_sum, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re, RCLike.one_re] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.of_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_eigenvectorUnitary
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_eigenvectorUnitary {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasOrthonormalCols, ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  exact Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary

name: NLAlib.sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => P i j ^ 2) ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using norm_sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic_of_hasOrthonormalCols hP

name: NLAlib.re_diagonal_eq_norm_sq_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec
statement:
theorem re_diagonal_eq_norm_sq_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (fun i => RCLike.re (A i i)) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j => ‖(hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) i j‖ ^ 2) *ᵥ
        hA.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hs : A = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Function.comp_def, U] using hA.spectral_theorem
  funext i
  calc
    RCLike.re (A i i) =
        RCLike.re ((U * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => (hA.eigenvalues j : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ) i i) :=
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re (M i i)) hs
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, RCLike.star_def, map_sum,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [mul_right_comm, RCLike.mul_conj, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul,
        RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.majorized_diagonal_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem majorized_diagonal_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    Majorized (fun i => RCLike.re (A i i)) hA.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_diagonal_eq_norm_sq_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec hA]
  exact majorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic hA.eigenvalues
    (norm_sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic_of_hasOrthonormalCols (hasOrthonormalCols_eigenvectorUnitary hA))

name: NLAlib.re_diagonal_mem_Icc_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem re_diagonal_mem_Icc_eigenvalues₀ {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n)
    (hcard : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    RCLike.re (A i i) ∈ Set.Icc
      (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hcard (by decide)⟩)
      (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, hcard⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let D := Matrix.of fun i j => ‖(hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) i j‖ ^ 2
  have hD := norm_sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic_of_hasOrthonormalCols (hasOrthonormalCols_eigenvectorUnitary hA)
  rw [mem_doublyStochastic_iff_sum] at hD
  have hrow : ∑ j, D i j = 1 := hD.2.1 i
  have hnonneg : ∀ j, 0 ≤ D i j := fun j => hD.1 i j
  have heq := congrFun (re_diagonal_eq_norm_sq_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec hA) i
  change RCLike.re (A i i) = ∑ j, D i j * hA.eigenvalues j at heq
  rw [heq]
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = ∑ j, D i j * hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hcard (by decide)⟩ := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, one_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone (by exact Nat.le_pred_of_lt (Fin.isLt _))) (hnonneg j)
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j, D i j * hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, hcard⟩ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone (by exact Nat.zero_le _)) (hnonneg j)
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.sum_convex_diagonal_le_trace_cfc
statement:
theorem sum_convex_diagonal_le_trace_cfc {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {φ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hφ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ φ) : (∑ i, φ (A i i)) ≤ (cfc φ A).trace
proof:
:= by
  have ht := re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA φ
  simp only [RCLike.re_to_real] at ht
  rw [ht]
  have h := (majorized_diagonal_eigenvalues hA).sum_convex_le hφ
  simpa only [RCLike.re_to_real] using h

name: NLAlib.congruence_le_congruence_iff
statement:
theorem congruence_le_congruence_iff {A B S : Matrix n n ℝ} (hS : IsUnit S) :
    S * A * Sᵀ ≤ S * B * Sᵀ ↔ A ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, ← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.le_iff]
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    hS.posSemidef_star_right_conjugate_iff (x := B - A)

name: NLAlib.smul_le_iff_relative_spectrum_lower
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, -⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB
  change A = S * Sᵀ at hAA
  change B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ at hBB
  have hsc : a • A = S * (a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) * Sᵀ := by
    simp only [hAA, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB, hsc, hBB,
    congruence_le_congruence_iff hS, Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal,
    Matrix.diagonal_sub, Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff]
  simp only [sub_nonneg, Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]

name: NLAlib.le_smul_iff_relative_spectrum_upper
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, -⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB
  change A = S * Sᵀ at hAA
  change B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ at hBB
  have hsc : b • A = S * (b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) * Sᵀ := by
    simp only [hAA, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB, hsc, hBB,
    congruence_le_congruence_iff hS, Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal,
    Matrix.diagonal_sub, Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff]
  simp only [sub_nonneg, Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]

name: NLAlib.loewner_sandwich_iff_relative_spectrum_subset
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_le_iff_relative_spectrum_lower hA hB, le_smul_iff_relative_spectrum_upper hA hB]
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_Icc]
  aesop

name: NLAlib.le_iff_relative_spectralRadius_le_one
proof:
:= by
  have hn := spectrum_inverse_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef hA hB
  have h := le_smul_iff_relative_spectrum_upper hA hB.isHermitian 1
  rw [one_smul] at h
  rw [h, spectralRadius, iSup₂_le_iff]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro z
  apply forall_congr'
  intro hz
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := hn hz
  rw [show (1 : ENNReal) = ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) from rfl, ENNReal.coe_le_coe]
  simp only [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, NNReal.coe_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg hz0]

name: NLAlib.le_iff_exists_sqrt_congruence_contraction
statement:
theorem le_iff_exists_sqrt_congruence_contraction {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    B ≤ A ↔ ∃ X : Matrix n n ℝ, 0 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ 1 ∧
      B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt A
proof:
:= by
  let R := CFC.sqrt A
  have hR : IsUnit R := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff A hA.posSemidef.nonneg).mpr hA.isUnit
  have hRt : Rᵀ = R := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hRit : R⁻¹ᵀ = R⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hRt]
  have hRd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR
  have hRRi := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R hRd
  have hRiR := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul R hRd
  have hSq : R * R = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hBX : R * (R⁻¹ * B * R⁻¹) * R = B := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc R R⁻¹, hRRi, Matrix.one_mul, hRiR, Matrix.mul_one]
  constructor
  · intro hBA
    refine ⟨R⁻¹ * B * R⁻¹, ?_, ?_, hBX.symm⟩
    · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hRit] using
        (hB.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R⁻¹).nonneg
    · apply (congruence_le_congruence_iff hR).mp
      simpa only [hRt, hBX, Matrix.mul_one, hSq] using hBA
  · rintro ⟨X, -, hX, hXB⟩
    have h := (congruence_le_congruence_iff hR).mpr hX
    change B = R * X * R at hXB
    simpa only [hRt, ← hXB, Matrix.mul_one, hSq] using h

name: NLAlib.trace_le_and_eq_iff_of_le_aux
statement:
private theorem trace_le_and_eq_iff_of_le_aux {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.trace ≤ B.trace ∧ (A.trace = B.trace ↔ A = B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB
  constructor
  · simpa only [Matrix.trace_sub, sub_nonneg] using h.trace_nonneg
  · have hz := h.trace_eq_zero_iff
    simpa only [Matrix.trace_sub, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] using hz

name: NLAlib.trace_le_of_le
statement:
theorem trace_le_of_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.trace ≤ B.trace
proof:
:=
  (trace_le_and_eq_iff_of_le_aux hAB).1

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_iff_of_le
statement:
theorem trace_eq_iff_of_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.trace = B.trace ↔ A = B
proof:
:=
  (trace_le_and_eq_iff_of_le_aux hAB).2

name: NLAlib.det_le_det_of_posSemidef_le
statement:
theorem det_le_det_of_posSemidef_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hAB : A ≤ B) : A.det ≤ B.det
proof:
:= by
  have hB := (hA.nonneg.trans hAB).posSemidef
  rw [hA.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues, hB.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  · intro i _; exact hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i
  · intro i _
    exact Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian
      (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB) _

name: NLAlib.le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : A ≤ 1 ↔ specNorm A ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hUt : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian
  have hUU : U * Uᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hUt
  have hUu : IsUnit U := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det U).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt)
  have hAU : A = U * diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues * Uᵀ :=
    eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA.isHermitian
  have hnorm : specNorm A = ‖hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues‖ := by
    calc
      specNorm A = specNorm (U * diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues * Uᵀ) := congrArg specNorm hAU
      _ = ‖hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues‖ := by
        rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
          specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := U) hUt,
          specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := U) hUt, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  have hord : A ≤ 1 ↔ diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      A ≤ 1 ↔ U * diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues * Uᵀ ≤ U * 1 * Uᵀ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_one, hUU, ← hAU]
      _ ↔ diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues ≤ 1 := congruence_le_congruence_iff hUu
  rw [hord, hnorm, Matrix.le_iff, ← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_sub,
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one]
  simp only [sub_nonneg, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.mul_transpose_le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem mul_transpose_le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one {m : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [DecidableEq m] (M : Matrix n m ℝ) :
    M * Mᵀ ≤ 1 ↔ specNorm M ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (M * Mᵀ).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose M
  rw [le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one_of_posSemidef hM,
    ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial M, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self]
  exact sq_le_one_iff₀ (specNorm_nonneg M)

name: NLAlib.sq_le_sq_iff_relative_specNorm_le_one
proof:
:= by
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA.isHermitian.eq
  have hBt : Bᵀ = B := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hB.eq
  have hAit : A⁻¹ᵀ = A⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hAt]
  have hAd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA.isUnit
  have hAAi := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAd
  have hAiA := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A hAd
  have hGram : A * ((A⁻¹ * B) * (A⁻¹ * B)ᵀ) * Aᵀ = B * B := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hBt, hAit, hAt]
    calc
      A * (A⁻¹ * B * (B * A⁻¹)) * A = (A * A⁻¹) * (B * B) * (A⁻¹ * A) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * B := by rw [hAAi, hAiA, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [← mul_transpose_le_one_iff_specNorm_le_one]
  calc
    B ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 ↔
        A * ((A⁻¹ * B) * (A⁻¹ * B)ᵀ) * Aᵀ ≤ A * 1 * Aᵀ := by
      rw [hGram, Matrix.mul_one, hAt, sq, sq]
    _ ↔ _ := congruence_le_congruence_iff hA.isUnit

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_sqrt
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_sqrt {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) (CFC.sqrt A) = CFC.sqrt ((realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) A)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique _
    (((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _).mpr (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef).nonneg
  rw [← map_mul, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_le_sqrt_of_posSemidef_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_sqrt_of_posSemidef_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hAB : A ≤ B) : CFC.sqrt A ≤ CFC.sqrt B
proof:
:= by
  have hB := (hA.nonneg.trans hAB).posSemidef
  apply ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ _).mp
  rw [realMatrixComplexification_sqrt hA, realMatrixComplexification_sqrt hB]
  exact CFC.sqrt_le_sqrt _ _ (((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ _).mpr hAB)

name: NLAlib.det_eq_iff_eq_of_posSemidef_le_posDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdet
    obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB.isHermitian
    change A = S * Sᵀ at hAA
    change B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ at hBB
    have hs : S.det ≠ 0 := ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hS).ne_zero
    have hp : ∏ i, d i = 1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hs
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hs
      simpa only [hAA, hBB, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal, Matrix.det_transpose,
        mul_one] using hdet
    have hd1 : ∀ i, d i ≤ 1 := by
      have hupper := (le_smul_iff_relative_spectrum_upper hA hB.isHermitian 1).mp
        (by simpa using hBA)
      rw [spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB] at hupper
      exact fun i => hupper (d i) ⟨i, rfl⟩
    let e : n → NNReal := fun i => ⟨d i, hd hB i⟩
    have he : ∏ i, e i = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((∏ i, e i : NNReal) : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ)
      rw [NNReal.coe_prod]
      exact hp
    have he1 : ∀ i, e i = 1 := by
      simpa only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_true_left] using
        (Finset.prod_eq_one_iff_of_le_one' (fun i _ => show e i ≤ 1 from hd1 i)).mp he
    have hd' : d = fun _ => 1 := by
      funext i
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (he1 i)
    rw [hBB, hd', Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one, ← hAA]
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: NLAlib.relative_spectrum_characterizations
statement:
theorem relative_spectrum_characterizations {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a • A ≤ B ∧ B ≤ b • A) ↔ spectrum ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) ⊆ Set.Icc a b) ∧
    (B ≤ A ↔ spectralRadius ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) ≤ 1) ∧
    (B ≤ A ↔ ∃ X : Matrix n n ℝ, 0 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ 1 ∧
      B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt A) ∧
    (B ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 ↔ specNorm (A⁻¹ * B) ≤ 1) ∧
    (B ≤ A → B.det ≤ A.det ∧ (B.det = A.det ↔ B = A) ∧
      B.trace ≤ A.trace ∧ (B.trace = A.trace ↔ B = A) ∧
      (∀ k, hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ k) ∧
      CFC.sqrt B ≤ CFC.sqrt A ∧ (B.PosDef → A⁻¹ ≤ B⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨loewner_sandwich_iff_relative_spectrum_subset hA hB.isHermitian a b,
    le_iff_relative_spectralRadius_le_one hA hB,
    le_iff_exists_sqrt_congruence_contraction hA hB,
    sq_le_sq_iff_relative_specNorm_le_one hA hB.isHermitian, fun hBA => ?_⟩
  have ht := trace_le_and_eq_iff_of_le_aux hBA
  exact ⟨det_le_det_of_posSemidef_le hB hBA, det_eq_iff_eq_of_posSemidef_le_posDef hA hB hBA,
    ht.1, ht.2, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hB.isHermitian hA.isHermitian
      (Matrix.le_iff.mp hBA), sqrt_le_sqrt_of_posSemidef_le hB hBA,
    fun hBPD => inv_le_inv_of_posDef hBPD hBA⟩

name: NLAlib.det_add_rpow_inv_card_ge_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem det_add_rpow_inv_card_ge_and_eq_iff_aux {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤
      (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ∧
    ((A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) =
      A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ↔
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ A = c • B)
proof:
:= by
  let p := A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
  let q := B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
  have hp : 0 < p := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hA.det_pos _
  have hq : 0 < q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hB.det_pos _
  have hpq : 0 < p + q := add_pos hp hq
  have hn : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  let P := p⁻¹ • A
  let Q := q⁻¹ • B
  let α := p / (p + q)
  let β := q / (p + q)
  have hP : P.PosDef := hA.smul (inv_pos.mpr hp)
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := hB.smul (inv_pos.mpr hq)
  have hPd : P.det = 1 := det_inv_rpow_smul_eq_one hA hN
  have hQd : Q.det = 1 := det_inv_rpow_smul_eq_one hB hN
  have hα : 0 < α := div_pos hp hpq
  have hβ : 0 < β := div_pos hq hpq
  have hαβ : α + β = 1 := by dsimp [α, β]; rw [← add_div, div_self hpq.ne']
  have hcombo : α • P + β • Q = (p + q)⁻¹ • (A + B) := by
    have hαp : α * p⁻¹ = (p + q)⁻¹ := by dsimp [α]; field_simp
    have hβq : β * q⁻¹ = (p + q)⁻¹ := by dsimp [β]; field_simp
    simp only [P, Q, smul_smul, hαp, hβq, smul_add]
  have hC : ((p + q)⁻¹ • (A + B)).PosDef := (hA.add hB).smul (inv_pos.mpr hpq)
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log ((p + q)⁻¹ • (A + B)).det := by
    have h := log_det_smul_add_ge hP hQ hα.le hβ.le hαβ
    simpa only [hPd, hQd, Real.log_one, mul_zero, zero_add, hcombo] using h
  have hdet1 : 1 ≤ ((p + q)⁻¹ • (A + B)).det := by
    apply (Real.log_le_log_iff zero_lt_one hC.det_pos).mp
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using hlog
  have hdetN : ((p + q)⁻¹ • (A + B)).det = ((p + q) ^ Fintype.card n)⁻¹ * (A + B).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_smul, inv_pow]
  have hpowPos : 0 < (p + q) ^ Fintype.card n := pow_pos hpq _
  have hdet : (p + q) ^ Fintype.card n ≤ (A + B).det := by
    rw [hdetN] at hdet1
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdet1 hpowPos.le
    simpa only [mul_one, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpowPos.ne', one_mul] using h
  have hroot : p + q ≤ (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow hpowPos.le hdet
      (show 0 ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) by positivity)
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hpq.le, mul_one_div_cancel hn, Real.rpow_one] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨hroot, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro heq
    change (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) = p + q at heq
    have hpow := det_rpow_inv_card_pow_card (hA.add hB) hN
    rw [heq] at hpow
    have hdetEq : ((p + q)⁻¹ • (A + B)).det = 1 := by
      rw [hdetN, ← hpow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpowPos.ne']
    have hPQ : P = Q := by
      apply (log_det_smul_add_eq_iff hP hQ hα hβ hαβ).mp
      simp only [hcombo, hdetEq, hPd, hQd, Real.log_one, mul_zero, zero_add]
    refine ⟨p / q, div_pos hp hq, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => p • M) hPQ
    simpa only [P, Q, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp.ne', one_smul, div_eq_mul_inv] using h
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hAB⟩
    have hsum : A + B = (c + 1) • B := by rw [hAB, add_smul, one_smul]
    rw [hsum, det_smul_rpow_inv_card hB hN (by positivity), hAB,
      det_smul_rpow_inv_card hB hN hc.le]
    ring

name: NLAlib.det_rpow_inv_card_add_le
statement:
theorem det_rpow_inv_card_add_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤
      (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  (det_add_rpow_inv_card_ge_and_eq_iff_aux hA hB hN).1

name: NLAlib.det_rpow_inv_card_add_le_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem det_rpow_inv_card_add_le_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤
      (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : 0 ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hdet : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M.det) := by fun_prop
  have hroot : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))) :=
    (Real.continuous_rpow_const hexp).comp hdet
  apply le_of_posSemidef_of_continuous_of_forall_posDef
    (continuous_const.add hroot) (hroot.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
    (fun Y hY => ?_) hB
  apply le_of_posSemidef_of_continuous_of_forall_posDef
    (hroot.add continuous_const) (hroot.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
    (fun X hX => det_rpow_inv_card_add_le hX hY hN) hA

name: NLAlib.det_add_rpow_inv_card_eq_iff
statement:
theorem det_add_rpow_inv_card_eq_iff {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) =
      A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ↔
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ A = c • B
proof:
:=
  (det_add_rpow_inv_card_ge_and_eq_iff_aux hA hB hN).2

name: NLAlib.concaveOn_det_rpow_inv_card
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_setOf_posDef, ?_⟩
  intro A hA B hB a b ha hb hab
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ha with ha | ha
  · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb with hb | hb
    · have h := det_rpow_inv_card_add_le (hA.smul ha) (hB.smul hb) hN
      simpa only [det_smul_rpow_inv_card hA hN ha.le, det_smul_rpow_inv_card hB hN hb.le,
        smul_eq_mul] using h
    · have ha1 : a = 1 := by linarith
      simp only [← hb, ha1, zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero, le_refl]
  · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
    simp only [← ha, hb1, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add, le_refl]

name: NLAlib.det_smul_add_rpow_inv_card_eq_iff
statement:
theorem det_smul_add_rpow_inv_card_eq_iff {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (a • A + b • B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) =
      a * A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + b * B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ↔
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ A = c • B
proof:
:= by
  have h := det_add_rpow_inv_card_eq_iff (hA.smul ha) (hB.smul hb) hN
  rw [det_smul_rpow_inv_card hA hN ha.le, det_smul_rpow_inv_card hB hN hb.le] at h
  rw [h]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, heq⟩
    refine ⟨a⁻¹ * (c * b), mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha) (mul_pos hc hb), ?_⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => a⁻¹ • M) heq
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha.ne', one_smul] using he
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, heq⟩
    refine ⟨a * c / b, div_pos (mul_pos ha hc) hb, ?_⟩
    rw [heq, smul_smul, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hb.ne']

name: NLAlib.exists_posDef_zero_dim_not_det_root_add_ge
statement:
theorem exists_posDef_zero_dim_not_det_root_add_ge :
    ∃ A B : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) ℝ, A.PosDef ∧ B.PosDef ∧
      ¬(A.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card (Fin 0) : ℝ)) + B.det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card (Fin 0) : ℝ)) ≤
        (A + B).det ^ (1 / (Fintype.card (Fin 0) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, 1, Matrix.PosDef.one, Matrix.PosDef.one, ?_⟩
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.sum_eigenvalues₀_add_le_sum_add_eigenvaluePrefix
statement:
theorem sum_eigenvalues₀_add_le_sum_add_eigenvaluePrefix {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (J : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))) :
    (∑ j ∈ J, (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ j) ≤ (∑ j ∈ J, hA.eigenvalues₀ j) +
      eigenvaluePrefix hB J.card
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∑ j ∈ J, (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB t).eigenvalues₀ j
  have hF : Continuous F := continuous_finsetSum J fun j _ => continuous_eigenvalues₀_pencil hA hB j
  have hvar (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      ∃ c ≤ eigenvaluePrefix hB J.card,
        ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto
        (fun ν => (F (t + (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2)) - F t) /
          ((1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2))) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    let h : ℕ → ℝ := fun ν => (1 - t) / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)
    have hhpos : ∀ ν, 0 < h ν := by
      intro ν
      exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht.2) (by positivity)
    have hh : Tendsto h atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hden : Tendsto (fun ν : ℕ => (ν : ℝ) + 2) atTop atTop :=
        by simpa only [Function.comp_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
          (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 2)
      exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden
    obtain ⟨c, hc, φ, hφ, hv⟩ := exists_subseq_eigenvalues₀_sum_difference_quotient_tendsto
      (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB t) hB J h hhpos hh
    refine ⟨c, hc, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
    apply hv.congr'
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro ν
    simp only [F, h]
    congr 2
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    exact eigenvalues₀_pencil_add hA hB t ((1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2)) j
  have hinc := sub_le_of_continuous_of_subseq_difference_quotient_le F hF.continuousOn
    (eigenvaluePrefix hB J.card) hvar
  have hF0 : F 0 = ∑ j ∈ J, hA.eigenvalues₀ j := by simp only [F, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hF1 : F 1 = ∑ j ∈ J, (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ j := by simp only [F, one_smul]
  rw [hF0, hF1] at hinc
  linarith

name: NLAlib.majorized_eigenvalues₀_add_sub
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rw [weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le]
    intro J
    have hJ := sum_eigenvalues₀_add_le_sum_add_eigenvaluePrefix hA hB J
    have hprefix : eigenvaluePrefix hB J.card ≤ sumLargest hB.eigenvalues₀ J.card := le_rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    linarith
  · have htrace (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) :
        (∑ i, hC.eigenvalues₀ i) = C.trace := by
      have h := sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hC id
      calc
        _ = ∑ i : n, hC.eigenvalues i := by simpa only [id_eq] using h.symm
        _ = C.trace := by simpa using hC.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues.symm
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, htrace _ (hA.add hB), htrace _ hA, htrace _ hB,
      Matrix.trace_add]
    ring

name: NLAlib.exists_nonsymmetric_quadratic_dominance_not_hadamard_preserved
statement:
theorem exists_nonsymmetric_quadratic_dominance_not_hadamard_preserved :
    ∃ B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, ¬B.IsHermitian ∧
      (∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, |quadForm B x| ≤ quadForm (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) x) ∧
      ∃ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        quadForm ((1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) ⊙ 1) x < |quadForm (B ⊙ B) x|
proof:
:= by
  let B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![0, 2; 0, 0]
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hh := h.apply (0 : Fin 2) 1
    norm_num [B] at hh
  · intro x
    simp [quadForm, B, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.one_apply]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|x 0| - |x 1|), sq_abs (x 0), sq_abs (x 1)]
  · refine ⟨fun _ => 1, ?_⟩
    norm_num [quadForm, B, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.hadamard_apply, Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE
statement:
theorem sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then a i else 0) = ∑ i : Fin k, a (Fin.castLE hk i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).map (Fin.castLEEmb hk) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun i => i.val < k := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact j.isLt
    · intro hi
      exact ⟨⟨i.val, hi⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, ← he, Finset.sum_map]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone
statement:
theorem sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a)
    (k : ℕ) : sumLargest a k = ∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then a i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k ≤ n
  · have bound (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S.card = k) :
        (∑ i ∈ S, a i) ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then a i else 0 := by
      let w : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => if i ∈ S then 1 else 0
      have hw : (∑ i, w i) = (k : ℝ) := by simp [w, hS]
      have hb := sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone_of_sum_eq a w ha
        (fun i => by dsimp [w]; split <;> positivity)
        (fun i => by dsimp [w]; split <;> norm_num) hk hw
      simpa [w] using hb
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← sum_largestCoordinates a k]
      exact bound _ (card_largestCoordinates a (by simpa using hk))
    · let S := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun i => i.val < k
      have hS : S.card = k := card_filter_fin_lt hk
      have hb := sum_le_sumLargest a S
      simpa only [S, Finset.sum_filter, hS] using hb
  · have hn : n ≤ k := by omega
    rw [sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le a (by simpa using hn)]
    simp only [if_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (Fin.isLt _) hn)]

name: NLAlib.majorized_comp_perm
statement:
theorem majorized_comp_perm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (x : ι → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) : Majorized (x ∘ σ) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec] using
    majorized_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic x (permMatrix_mem_doublyStochastic (σ := σ))

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_comp_perm
statement:
theorem sumLargest_comp_perm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (x : ι → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (k : ℕ) : sumLargest (x ∘ σ) k = sumLargest x k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι
  · have h1 := (majorized_comp_perm x σ).1 k hk
    have h2 := (majorized_comp_perm (x ∘ σ) σ.symm).1 k hk
    simp only [Function.comp_def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2
    exact le_antisymm h1 h2
  · rw [sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le _ (by omega), sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le _ (by omega)]
    exact Equiv.sum_comp σ x

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_add_le
statement:
theorem sumLargest_add_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (x y : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : sumLargest (x + y) k ≤ sumLargest x k + sumLargest y k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι
  · let S := largestCoordinates (x + y) k
    have hS : S.card = k := card_largestCoordinates _ hk
    rw [← sum_largestCoordinates (x + y) k]
    change (∑ i ∈ S, (x i + y i)) ≤ _
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simpa only [hS] using add_le_add (sum_le_sumLargest x S) (sum_le_sumLargest y S)
  · rw [sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le _ (by omega), sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le _ (by omega),
      sumLargest_eq_sum_of_card_le _ (by omega)]
    simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: NLAlib.Majorized.sum_sub_sumLargest_le_sum
statement:
theorem Majorized.sum_sub_sumLargest_le_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∑ i, y i) - sumLargest y (Fintype.card ι - S.card) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, x i
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := (weaklyMajorized_iff_sum_le x y).mp hxy.1 Sᶜ
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ S, x i) + (∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, x i) = ∑ i, y i :=
    (Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S x).trans hxy.2
  rw [Finset.card_compl] at hcomp
  linarith

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_apply
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_apply (u v : n → ℝ) (i j : n) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ =>
      planeRotation u v ((1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2)) (2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2)) i j)
      (2 * (u i * v j - v i * u j)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have ht := hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)
  have hc : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2)) 0 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)).fun_sub (ht.pow 2)).fun_div
      ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)).fun_add (ht.pow 2)) (by norm_num)
  have hs : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2)) 2 0 := by
    simpa using (ht.const_mul 2).fun_div
      ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)).fun_add (ht.pow 2)) (by norm_num)
  simpa [planeRotation, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, mul_add] using
    ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j)).fun_add
      ((hc.sub_const 1).mul_const (u i * u j + v i * v j))).fun_add
      (hs.mul_const (u i * v j - v i * u j))

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_conjugation_diag
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_conjugation_diag
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (u v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ =>
      let R := planeRotation u v ((1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2)) (2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2))
      (R * A * Rᵀ) i i)
      (4 * ∑ j, A i j * (u i * v j - v i * u j)) 0
proof:
:= by
  let R (t : ℝ) := planeRotation u v ((1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2))
    (2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2))
  have hR0 : R 0 = 1 := by simp [R, planeRotation]
  have hd := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset n)) fun j _ =>
    HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset n)) fun k _ =>
      ((hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_apply u v i k).mul_const (A k j)).mul
        (hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_apply u v i j)
