  change HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ j, ∑ k, (R t i k * A k j) * R t i j)
    (∑ j, ∑ k, (2 * (u i * v k - v i * u k) * A k j * R 0 i j +
      R 0 i k * A k j * (2 * (u i * v j - v i * u j)))) 0 at hd
  convert hd using 1
  · funext t
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    rfl
  · rw [hR0]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hfirst : (∑ j, ∑ k, 2 * (u i * v k - v i * u k) * A k j *
        (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j) = ∑ k, 2 * (u i * v k - v i * u k) * A k i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp [Matrix.one_apply]
    have hsecond : (∑ j, ∑ k, (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i k * A k j *
        (2 * (u i * v j - v i * u j))) =
        ∑ j, A i j * (2 * (u i * v j - v i * u j)) := by
      simp [Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [hfirst, hsecond]
    have hs : ∀ j, A j i = A i j := fun j => congrArg (fun M => M i j) hA
    simp_rw [hs]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring

name: NLAlib.diagonal_error_stationarity_of_min
statement:
theorem diagonal_error_stationarity_of_min
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (d : n → ℝ)
    (hmin : ∀ R : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols R →
      (∑ i, (A i i - d i) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i, ((R * A * Rᵀ) i i - d i) ^ 2)
    (i j : n) : ((A i i - d i) - (A j j - d j)) * A i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    ring
  let u : n → ℝ := Pi.single i 1
  let v : n → ℝ := Pi.single j 1
  let R (t : ℝ) := planeRotation u v ((1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2))
    (2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2))
  have hR0 : R 0 = 1 := by simp [R, planeRotation]
  have hsingle (a : n) : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single a (1 : ℝ)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [show (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single a (1 : ℝ)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) =
      EuclideanSpace.single a 1 from rfl, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one]
  have horth (t : ℝ) : HasOrthonormalCols (R t) := by
    apply hasOrthonormalCols_planeRotation
    · exact hsingle i
    · exact hsingle j
    · simp [u, v, dotProduct_single, hij]
    · exact sq_rational_rotation_coefficients t
  let f (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ k, ((R t * A * (R t)ᵀ) k k - d k) ^ 2
  have hlocal : IsLocalMin f 0 := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro t
    simpa [f, hR0] using hmin (R t) (horth t)
  have hd := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset n)) fun k _ =>
    ((hasDerivAt_planeRotation_rational_conjugation_diag A hA u v k).sub_const (d k)).pow 2
  change HasDerivAt f _ 0 at hd
  have hzero := hlocal.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hd
  have hzero' : (∑ k, 2 * (A k k - d k) *
      (4 * ∑ l, A k l * (u k * v l - v k * u l))) = 0 := by
    simpa [planeRotation] using hzero
  have hsum : (∑ k, 2 * (A k k - d k) *
      (4 * ∑ l, A k l * (u k * v l - v k * u l))) =
      8 * (((A i i - d i) - (A j j - d j)) * A i j) := by
    have hrow (k : n) : (∑ l, A k l * (u k * v l - v k * u l)) =
        u k * A k j - v k * A k i := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have h1 : (∑ l, A k l * (u k * v l)) = u k * A k j := by
        calc
          _ = u k * ((fun l => A k l) ⬝ᵥ v) := by
            simp only [dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro l _; ring
          _ = _ := by simp [v, dotProduct_single]
      have h2 : (∑ l, A k l * (v k * u l)) = v k * A k i := by
        calc
          _ = v k * ((fun l => A k l) ⬝ᵥ u) := by
            simp only [dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro l _; ring
          _ = _ := by simp [u, dotProduct_single]
      rw [h1, h2]
    simp_rw [hrow]
    have hpoint (k : n) : 2 * (A k k - d k) * (4 * (u k * A k j - v k * A k i)) =
        u k * (8 * (A k k - d k) * A k j) -
          v k * (8 * (A k k - d k) * A k i) := by ring
    simp_rw [hpoint]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    change u ⬝ᵥ (fun k => 8 * (A k k - d k) * A k j) -
      v ⬝ᵥ (fun k => 8 * (A k k - d k) * A k i) = _
    simp only [u, v, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
    rw [show A j i = A i j from congrArg (fun M => M i j) hA]
    ring
  rw [hsum] at hzero'
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA.isHermitian.eq
  have hH : (fromBlocks A A Aᵀ A).PosSemidef := by
    rw [hAt]
    exact (posSemidef_equal_diagonal_fromBlocks_iff_le hA hA).mpr le_rfl
  exact sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef hH x y

name: NLAlib.exists_injective_vecMulVec_le_of_posSemidef_rows_injective
statement:
theorem exists_injective_vecMulVec_le_of_posSemidef_rows_injective
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hrows : Function.Injective A.row) :
    ∃ b : n → ℝ, Function.Injective b ∧ vecMulVec b b ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_mulVec_injective_of_rows_injective A hrows
  let ν := quadForm A z
  have hν : 0 ≤ ν := by simpa only [ν, quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg z
  let r := Real.sqrt (1 + ν)
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hrs : r ^ 2 = 1 + ν := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  let b := r⁻¹ • (A *ᵥ z)
  have hb : Function.Injective b := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hz
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero hr.ne')
    exact hij
  refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    (hA.isHermitian.sub (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star b).isHermitian))
  intro x
  have hx : 0 ≤ quadForm A x := by simpa only [quadForm, star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  have hcs := sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_posSemidef hA x z
  have hscaled : x ⬝ᵥ b = (x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ z) / r := by
    simp only [b, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hbound : (x ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 ≤ quadForm A x := by
    rw [hscaled, div_pow, hrs]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 1 + ν by linarith)).mpr
    change (x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ z) ^ 2 ≤ quadForm A x * (1 + quadForm A z)
    nlinarith
  simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
  change 0 ≤ quadForm A x - quadForm (vecMulVec b b) x
  have h := quadForm_vecMulVec_star_self b x
  simp only [star_trivial, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h
  rw [h, sub_nonneg]
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.exists_matrix_charpoly_and_selfAdjointPart_charpoly_of_majorized
statement:
theorem exists_matrix_charpoly_and_selfAdjointPart_charpoly_of_majorized
    (x : n → ℝ) (z : n → ℂ) (h : Majorized (fun i => (z i).re) x) :
    ∃ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (z i)) ∧
      (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (x i : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hdiag⟩ := exists_orthogonal_diagonal_eq_of_majorized (fun i => (z i).re) x h
  let K := Q * diagonal x * Qᵀ
  have hKt : Kᵀ = K := by simp [K, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hKd (i : n) : K i i = (z i).re := congrFun hdiag i
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ := fun i j =>
    if i = j then z i else if e.symm i < e.symm j then 2 * (K i j : ℂ) else 0
  have hTd (i : n) : T i i = z i := by simp [T]
  have hTri : (T.submatrix e e).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    change j < i at hij
    have hne : e i ≠ e j := fun he => (ne_of_gt hij) (e.injective he)
    simp [T, hne, not_lt.mpr hij.le]
  have hChar : T.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (z i)) := by
    calc
      T.charpoly = (T.submatrix e e).charpoly := (Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm T).symm
      _ = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (X - C (z (e i))) := by
        rw [Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ hTri]
        simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, hTd]
      _ = _ := e.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (z i))
  have hPart : (selfAdjointPart ℝ T : Matrix n n ℂ) = (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) K := by
    ext i j
    have hKji : K j i = K i j := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M i j) hKt
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, T, hKd,
        (realMatrixComplexification_apply (𝕜 := ℂ)), Complex.ext_iff, Complex.real_smul]
      ring
    · have hji : j ≠ i := Ne.symm hij
      by_cases hlt : e.symm i < e.symm j
      · have hnlt : ¬e.symm j < e.symm i := not_lt.mpr hlt.le
        simp [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, T, hij, hji,
          hlt, hnlt, (realMatrixComplexification_apply (𝕜 := ℂ)), Complex.real_smul]
      · have hgt : e.symm j < e.symm i := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hlt)
          (fun he => hij (e.symm.injective he.symm))
        simp [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, T, hij, hji,
          hlt, hgt, hKji, (realMatrixComplexification_apply (𝕜 := ℂ)), Complex.real_smul]
  have hQc : ((realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) Q)ᴴ * (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) Q = 1 := by
    have hQ' : star Q * Q = 1 := hQ
    rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← map_star, ← map_mul, hQ', map_one]
  have hKc : (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) K = (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) Q *
      diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) * ((realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) Q)ᴴ := by
    have hmapT : (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) Qᵀ = ((realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) Q)ᴴ := by
      rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← map_star]
      rfl
    have hmapD : (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) (diagonal x) = diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) := by
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [(realMatrixComplexification_apply (𝕜 := ℂ)), hij]
    dsimp only [K]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hmapT, hmapD]
  refine ⟨T, hChar, ?_⟩
  rw [hPart, hKc, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQc, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_nonneg {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem kyFanNorm_zero {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    kyFanNorm A 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_zero_matrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem kyFanNorm_zero_matrix {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm (0 : Matrix m n ℝ) k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le _ (by simp)

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_eq_min
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_eq_min {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm A k = kyFanNorm A (min k (min m n))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (min_le_left _ _))
  intro i hi hni
  exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Fintype.card_fin] at hi hni ⊢
    omega)

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_add_le_fin
statement:
private theorem kyFanNorm_add_le_fin {m n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm (A + B) k ≤ kyFanNorm A k + kyFanNorm B k
proof:
:= by
  have hbound (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ min m n) :
      kyFanNorm (A + B) j ≤ kyFanNorm A j + kyFanNorm B j := by
    obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hUV⟩ :=
      exists_trace_twoSided_compression_eq_kyFanNorm (A + B) (by simpa using hj)
    have h1 := trace_twoSided_compression_le_kyFanNorm A hU hV
    have h2 := trace_twoSided_compression_le_kyFanNorm B hU hV
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h1 h2
    rw [← hUV, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.trace_add]
    exact add_le_add h1 h2
  rw [kyFanNorm_eq_min (A + B) k, kyFanNorm_eq_min A k, kyFanNorm_eq_min B k]
  exact hbound _ (min_le_right _ _)

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm (A + B) k ≤ kyFanNorm A k + kyFanNorm B k
proof:
:= by
  have h := kyFanNorm_add_le_fin (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
    (B.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n)) k
  change kyFanNorm ((A + B).reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n)) k ≤ _ at h
  rwa [kyFanNorm_reindex, kyFanNorm_reindex, kyFanNorm_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_smul
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_smul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm (c • A) k = |c| * kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, singularValues_smul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_orthogonal_mul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {U : Matrix m m ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (k : ℕ) : kyFanNorm (U * A) k = kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, singularValues_isometry_mul hU A]

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_mul_orthogonal
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_mul_orthogonal (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {V : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (k : ℕ) : kyFanNorm (A * V) k = kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, singularValues_mul_unitary A hV]

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_transpose
statement: theorem kyFanNorm_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) : kyFanNorm Aᵀ k = kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, singularValues_transpose]

name: NLAlib.kyFanSeminorm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem kyFanSeminorm_apply (k : ℕ) (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    kyFanSeminorm k A = kyFanNorm A k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_one_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_one_eq_specNorm {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : kyFanNorm A 1 = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_one]
  exact singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm A

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_kyFanNorm
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_kyFanNorm {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    specNorm A ≤ kyFanNorm A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← kyFanNorm_one_eq_specNorm A]
  simp only [kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_one]
  change singularValues A 0 ≤ _
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i)
    (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_eq_zero_iff {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    kyFanNorm A k = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hn : specNorm A = 0 := le_antisymm (by simpa [h] using specNorm_le_kyFanNorm A hk)
      (specNorm_nonneg A)
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (show ‖A‖ = 0 by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hn)
  · rintro rfl
    exact kyFanNorm_zero_matrix k

name: NLAlib.sq_diag_le_gram_diag
statement:
theorem sq_diag_le_gram_diag (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) :
    L i i ^ 2 ≤ (L * Lᵀ) i i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, ← sq]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (L i j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.det_le_prod_diag_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem det_le_prod_diag_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    A.det ≤ ∏ i, A i i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let O := LinearOrder.lift' (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n).injective
  let : LinearOrder n := { O with
    toDecidableEq := ‹DecidableEq n›
    compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq := by
      intro a b
      have he : O.toDecidableEq = ‹DecidableEq n› := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      change @compare n O.toOrd a b =
        @compareOfLessAndEq n a b O.toLT (O.toDecidableLT a b) ‹DecidableEq n›
      rw [← he]
      exact @LinearOrder.compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq n O a b }
  obtain ⟨L, hL, -, hLA'⟩ := exists_eq_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef hA
  have hLA := hLA'.symm
  rw [det_eq_prod_sq_diag_of_cholesky A L hL hLA]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (L i i))
  intro i _
  simpa only [hLA] using sq_diag_le_gram_diag L i

name: NLAlib.det_eq_prod_diag_iff_isDiag_of_posDef
statement:
theorem det_eq_prod_diag_iff_isDiag_of_posDef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A.det = (∏ i, A i i) ↔ A.IsDiag
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hdet
    let O := LinearOrder.lift' (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n).injective
    let : LinearOrder n := { O with
      toDecidableEq := ‹DecidableEq n›
      compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq := by
        intro a b
        have he : O.toDecidableEq = ‹DecidableEq n› := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        change @compare n O.toOrd a b =
          @compareOfLessAndEq n a b O.toLT (O.toDecidableLT a b) ‹DecidableEq n›
        rw [← he]
        exact @LinearOrder.compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq n O a b }
    obtain ⟨L, ⟨hLower, hPos, hLA⟩, -⟩ := existsUnique_cholesky_of_posDef A hA
    have hle (i : n) : L i i ^ 2 ≤ A i i := by
      simpa only [hLA] using sq_diag_le_gram_diag L i
    have heq (i : n) : L i i ^ 2 = A i i := by
      by_contra hne
      have hi : L i i ^ 2 < A i i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle i) hne
      have hp := Finset.prod_lt_prod (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n))
        (fun j _ => sq_pos_of_pos (hPos j)) (fun j _ => hle j) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩
      rw [← det_eq_prod_sq_diag_of_cholesky A L hLower hLA, hdet] at hp
      exact (lt_irrefl _ hp)
    have hLDiag : L.IsDiag := by
      intro i j hij
      have hrow : (∑ k, L i k ^ 2) = L i i ^ 2 := by
        rw [heq, ← hLA, Matrix.mul_apply]
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, sq]
      have hrest : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, L i k ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)] at hrow
        linarith
      have hj0 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (L i k))).mp hrest j (by simp [hij.symm])
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hj0
    rw [← hLA, ← hLDiag.diagonal_diag, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    exact Matrix.isDiag_diagonal _
  · intro hDiag
    calc
      A.det = (diagonal A.diag).det := congrArg Matrix.det hDiag.diagonal_diag.symm
      _ = ∏ i, A i i := by rw [Matrix.det_diagonal]; rfl

name: NLAlib.det_eq_prod_diag_iff_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem det_eq_prod_diag_iff_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    A.det = (∏ i, A i i) ↔ A.IsDiag ∨ ∃ i, A i i = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases hz : ∃ i, A i i = 0
    · exact Or.inr hz
    · have hpos (i : n) : 0 < A i i := lt_of_le_of_ne hA.diag_nonneg
        (Ne.symm (fun hi => hz ⟨i, hi⟩))
      have hd : 0 < A.det := by rw [heq]; exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hpos i)
      have hPD := hA.posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'
      exact Or.inl ((det_eq_prod_diag_iff_isDiag_of_posDef hPD).mp heq)
  · rintro (hDiag | ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · calc
        A.det = (diagonal A.diag).det := congrArg Matrix.det hDiag.diagonal_diag.symm
        _ = ∏ j, A j j := by rw [Matrix.det_diagonal]; rfl
    · have hp : ∏ j, A j j = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
      have hle := det_le_prod_diag_of_posSemidef hA
      rw [hp] at hle ⊢
      exact le_antisymm hle hA.det_nonneg

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_of_prefix_le_of_sum_eq
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_of_prefix_le_of_sum_eq {n : ℕ} (a b c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (ha : Antitone a)
    (hp : ∀ k ≤ n, (∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then b i else 0) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < k then c i else 0)
    (ht : (∑ i, b i) = ∑ i, c i) : (∑ i, a i * b i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * c i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    let v := a (Fin.last n)
    let s : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < n + 1 then a ⟨i, hi⟩ - v else 0
    let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < n + 1 then b ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
    let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i < n + 1 then c ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
    have hs0 (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ s i := by
      dsimp [s]
      split_ifs with hi
      · exact sub_nonneg.mpr (ha (Fin.le_last _))
      · exact le_rfl
    have hs : Antitone s := by
      intro i j hij
      by_cases hj : j < n + 1
      · have hi : i < n + 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
        simp only [s, dif_pos hi, dif_pos hj]
        exact sub_le_sub_right (ha hij) v
      · simp only [s, dif_neg hj]
        exact hs0 i
    have hprefix : ∀ k ≤ n + 1,
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, t i := by
      intro k hk
      have h := hp k hk
      have hd := sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hk d
      have hc := sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hk t
      simp only [d, t, dif_pos (Fin.isLt _)] at hd hc
      rwa [← hd, ← hc]
    have h := sum_range_mul_le_of_partial_le hs0 hs hprefix
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => s i * d i) (n + 1),
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => s i * t i) (n + 1)] at h
    simp only [s, d, t, dif_pos (Fin.isLt _)] at h
    have hb : (∑ i, (a i - v) * b i) = (∑ i, a i * b i) - v * ∑ i, b i := by
      simp_rw [sub_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    have hc : (∑ i, (a i - v) * c i) = (∑ i, a i * c i) - v * ∑ i, c i := by
      simp_rw [sub_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hb, hc, ht] at h
    linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_sum_sortedVector_mul
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_sortedVector_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (a x : ι → ℝ) : (∑ i, a i * x i) ≤ ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector x i
proof:
:= by
  let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) := (sortingEquiv a).trans (sortingEquiv x).symm
  have h := ((sortedVector_antitone a).monovary (sortedVector_antitone x)).sum_smul_comp_perm_le_sum_smul
    (σ := σ)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
  have he : (∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector x (σ i)) = ∑ i, a i * x i := by
    simp only [sortedVector, Function.comp_apply, σ, Equiv.trans_apply,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (sortingEquiv a).sum_comp (fun i => a i * x i)
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.Majorized.sum_sortedVector_mul_le
statement:
theorem Majorized.sum_sortedVector_mul_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector x i) ≤
      ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector y i
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_mul_le_of_prefix_le_of_sum_eq _ _ _ (sortedVector_antitone a)
  · exact hxy.1
  · change (∑ i, id (sortedVector x i)) = ∑ i, id (sortedVector y i)
    rw [sum_sortedVector x id, sum_sortedVector y id]
    exact hxy.2

name: NLAlib.Majorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le
statement:
theorem Majorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, (∑ i, a i * x i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * y (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  let σ : Equiv.Perm ι := (sortingEquiv a).symm.trans (sortingEquiv y)
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∑ i, a i * x i) ≤ ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector x i :=
      sum_mul_le_sum_sortedVector_mul a x
    _ ≤ ∑ i, sortedVector a i * sortedVector y i := hxy.sum_sortedVector_mul_le a
    _ = ∑ i, a i * y (σ i) := by
      rw [← (sortingEquiv a).sum_comp (fun i => a i * y (σ i))]
      simp [sortedVector, σ]

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_max_residual
statement:
theorem exists_pos_max_residual (r : n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, r i = 0)
    (hne : ∃ i, r i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ S : Finset n, S.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ i, i ∈ S ↔ r i = ρ) ∧ (∀ i, r i ≤ ρ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hne
  let _ : Nonempty n := ⟨i₀⟩
  obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_max_image r Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hmax : ∀ i, r i ≤ r j := fun i => hj i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hpos : 0 < r j := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hnonpos : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n), r i ≤ 0 :=
      fun i _ => (hmax i).trans (le_of_not_gt hnot)
    exact hi₀ ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos hnonpos).mp hsum i₀ (Finset.mem_univ i₀))
  refine ⟨r j, hpos, Finset.univ.filter (fun i => r i = r j), ?_, ?_, hmax⟩
  · exact ⟨j, by simp⟩
  · intro i
    simp

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_sq_eq_of_support
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sq_eq_of_support (r u : n → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (S : Finset n)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, r i = ρ) (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1)
    (hsupport : ∀ i ∉ S, u i = 0) :
    (∑ i, r i * u i ^ 2) = ρ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : ∀ i, r i * u i ^ 2 = ρ * u i ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S
    · rw [hS i hi]
    · simp [hsupport i hi]
  simp_rw [heq]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hu' : ∑ i, u i ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hu
  rw [hu', mul_one]

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_sq_lt_of_support_compl
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sq_lt_of_support_compl (r v : n → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (S : Finset n)
    (hmax : ∀ i, r i ≤ ρ) (hstrict : ∀ i ∉ S, r i < ρ)
    (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hsupport : ∀ i ∈ S, v i = 0) :
    (∑ i, r i * v i ^ 2) < ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hv' : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hv
  have hnonzero : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hzero : ∀ i, v i = 0 := by simpa only [not_exists, not_not] using hnot
    simp [hzero] at hv'
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hnonzero
  have hjS : j ∉ S := fun hjS => hj (hsupport j hjS)
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ i, (ρ - r i) * v i ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hmax i)) (sq_nonneg _)) |>.mpr
    exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hstrict j hjS)) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hj)⟩
  have heq : (∑ i, (ρ - r i) * v i ^ 2) = ρ - ∑ i, r i * v i ^ 2 := by
    simp_rw [sub_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hv', mul_one]
  rw [heq] at hpos
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_sub_sq_pos_of_max_support
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sub_sq_pos_of_max_support (r u v : n → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (S : Finset n)
    (hS : ∀ i, i ∈ S ↔ r i = ρ) (hmax : ∀ i, r i ≤ ρ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1)
    (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1)
    (hsu : ∀ i ∉ S, u i = 0) (hsv : ∀ i ∈ S, v i = 0) :
    0 < ∑ i, r i * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hstrict : ∀ i ∉ S, r i < ρ := by
    intro i hi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax i) (fun heq => hi ((hS i).mpr heq))
  have huavg := sum_mul_sq_eq_of_support r u ρ S
    (fun i hi => (hS i).mp hi) hu hsu
  have hvavg := sum_mul_sq_lt_of_support_compl r v ρ S hmax hstrict hv hsv
  simp_rw [mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, huavg]
  exact sub_pos.mpr hvavg

name: NLAlib.det_mul_prod_diag_le_det_hadamard_fin
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => intro A B _ _ _; simp
  | succ N ih =>
    intro A B hA hB hdiag
    have ha : 0 < A 0 0 := hA.diag_pos
    have hb : 0 < B 0 0 := hdiag 0
    have hS := ((posDef_iff_pivotSchur hA.isHermitian).mp hA).2
    let B₂ := B.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ
    have hB₂ : B₂.PosSemidef := hB.submatrix Fin.succ
    let u : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => A i.succ 0
    let R : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ := (A 0 0)⁻¹ • vecMulVec u u
    have hR : R.PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [star_trivial] using
        (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star u).smul (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)
    have hsym (j : Fin N) : A 0 j.succ = A j.succ 0 := by
      simpa using hA.isHermitian.apply j.succ 0
    have hPivot : pivotSchur (A ⊙ B) = pivotSchur A ⊙ B₂ + R ⊙ pivotSchur B := by
      ext i j
      simp only [pivotSchur_apply, Matrix.hadamard_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
        B₂, Matrix.submatrix_apply, R, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, u, hsym, _root_.mul_inv_rev]
      ring
    have hle : pivotSchur A ⊙ B₂ ≤ pivotSchur (A ⊙ B) := by
      rw [hPivot, Matrix.le_iff, add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact hR.hadamard (posSemidef_pivotSchur hB)
    have hd := det_le_det_of_posSemidef_le (hS.posSemidef.hadamard hB₂) hle
    have hInd := ih (pivotSchur A) B₂ hS hB₂ (fun i => hdiag i.succ)
    rw [det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur A ha.ne', Fin.prod_univ_succ,
      det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur (A ⊙ B) (by simpa only [Matrix.hadamard_apply] using (mul_pos ha hb).ne')]
    simp only [Matrix.hadamard_apply]
    calc
      A 0 0 * (pivotSchur A).det * (B 0 0 * ∏ i : Fin N, B i.succ i.succ) =
          (A 0 0 * B 0 0) * ((pivotSchur A).det * ∏ i, B₂ i i) := by dsimp [B₂]; ring
      _ ≤ (A 0 0 * B 0 0) * (pivotSchur A ⊙ B₂).det :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInd (mul_pos ha hb).le
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (mul_pos ha hb).le

name: NLAlib.det_mul_prod_diag_le_det_hadamard
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdet : A.det = 0
  · rw [hdet, zero_mul]
    exact (hA.hadamard hB).det_nonneg
  by_cases hzero : ∃ i, B i i = 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hzero
    have hp : (∏ j, B j j) = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
    rw [hp, mul_zero]
    exact (hA.hadamard hB).det_nonneg
  have hAPD := hA.posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  have hdiag (i : n) : 0 < B i i := lt_of_le_of_ne hB.diag_nonneg
    (Ne.symm (fun hi => hzero ⟨i, hi⟩))
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have h := det_mul_prod_diag_le_det_hadamard_fin (Fintype.card n) (A.submatrix e e)
    (B.submatrix e e) (hAPD.submatrix e.injective) (hB.submatrix e) (fun i => hdiag (e i))
  rw [Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self, ← Matrix.submatrix_hadamard, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self] at h
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply] at h
  rw [e.prod_comp (fun i => B i i)] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.max_det_mul_prod_diag_le_det_hadamard
proof:
:= by
  apply max_le
  · exact det_mul_prod_diag_le_det_hadamard hA hB
  · simpa only [Matrix.hadamard_comm] using det_mul_prod_diag_le_det_hadamard hB hA

name: NLAlib.norm_det_eq_re_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem norm_det_eq_re_of_posSemidef {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.PosSemidef) :
    ‖H.det‖ = H.det.re
proof:
:= by
  have hn := RCLike.norm_of_nonneg' hH.det_nonneg
  have h := congrArg Complex.re hn
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.norm_one_add_I_mul
statement:
private theorem norm_one_add_I_mul (t : ℝ) :
    ‖(1 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (t : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.norm_def]
  congr 1
  simp [Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_det_add_I_smul_factors
statement:
theorem exists_det_add_I_smul_factors {H K : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hK : K.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ t : n → ℝ,
      ‖(H + Complex.I • K).det‖ = H.det.re * ∏ i, Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) ∧
      ‖K.det‖ = H.det.re * ∏ i, |t i| ∧ (K = 0 ↔ ∀ i, t i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, t, hS, hHH, hKK, -⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hH hK
  have hdetH : H.det.re = ‖S.det‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← norm_det_eq_re_of_posSemidef hH.posSemidef, hHH,
      Matrix.det_mul, norm_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose, norm_star]
    ring
  have hA : H + Complex.I • K =
      S * diagonal (fun i => (1 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (t i : ℂ)) * Sᴴ := by
    have hd : diagonal (fun i => (1 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (t i : ℂ)) =
        1 + Complex.I • diagonal (fun i => (t i : ℂ)) := by
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal, hij]
    rw [hHH, hKK, hd]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    rfl
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul,
      Matrix.det_conjTranspose, norm_star, Matrix.det_diagonal,
      norm_prod, hdetH]
    simp only [norm_one_add_I_mul]
    ring
  · rw [hKK, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul,
      Matrix.det_conjTranspose, norm_star, Matrix.det_diagonal,
      norm_prod, hdetH]
    simp only [RCLike.norm_ofReal]
    ring
  · have hSH : IsUnit Sᴴ := (Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose S).mpr hS
    constructor
    · intro hKzero
      have hd : diagonal (fun i => (t i : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        apply hS.mul_left_cancel
        apply hSH.mul_right_cancel
        rw [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]
        exact hKK.symm.trans hKzero
      intro i
      have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i i) hd
      simpa using he
    · intro ht
      rw [hKK]
      simp [ht]

name: NLAlib.one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq
statement: private theorem one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t : ℝ) : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.le_sqrt (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t])

name: NLAlib.re_det_le_norm_det_add_I_smul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hdet, -, -⟩ := exists_det_add_I_smul_factors hH hK
  rw [hdet]
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) :=
    Finset.one_le_prod (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t i))
  have hre : 0 < H.det.re := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hH.det_pos).1
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.re_det_eq_norm_det_add_I_smul_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hdet, -, hzero⟩ := exists_det_add_I_smul_factors hH hK
  rw [hdet, hzero]
  have hre : 0 < H.det.re := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hH.det_pos).1
  have hp : (∏ i, Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2)) = 1 ↔ ∀ i, t i = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h i
      have hi : Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2) ≤ ∏ j, Real.sqrt (1 + t j ^ 2) := by
        have hh := Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
          (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Finset.mem_univ i))
          (fun j (_ : j ∈ ({i} : Finset n)) => Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + t j ^ 2))
          (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n)) _ => one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t j))
        simpa only [Finset.prod_singleton] using hh
      rw [h] at hi
      have hs := Real.sqrt_eq_one.mp (le_antisymm hi (one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t i)))
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t i)]
    · intro ht
      simp [ht]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hp.mp
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    rw [hp.mpr h, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.abs_le_sqrt_one_add_sq
statement:
private theorem abs_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t : ℝ) :
    |t| ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.le_sqrt (abs_nonneg t) (by positivity)).mpr (by simp [sq_abs])

name: NLAlib.one_add_abs_mul_le_sqrt_mul
statement:
private theorem one_add_abs_mul_le_sqrt_mul (a b : ℝ) :
    1 + |a| * |b| ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + a ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (1 + b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|a| - |b|), sq_abs a, sq_abs b]

name: NLAlib.one_add_prod_abs_le_prod_sqrt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := Fintype.exists_pair_of_one_lt_card (by omega : 1 < Fintype.card n)
  let s := (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j
  have hprod (f : n → ℝ) : (∏ k, f k) = f i * f j * ∏ k ∈ s, f k := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ f (Finset.mem_univ i),
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase i) f
        (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij.symm, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)]
    simp only [s, mul_assoc]
  have hrest1 : 1 ≤ ∏ k ∈ s, Real.sqrt (1 + t k ^ 2) :=
    Finset.one_le_prod fun k _ => one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t k)
  have hrestAbs : (∏ k ∈ s, |t k|) ≤ ∏ k ∈ s, Real.sqrt (1 + t k ^ 2) :=
    Finset.prod_le_prod (fun k _ => abs_nonneg (t k)) (fun k _ => abs_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t k))
  rw [hprod (fun k => |t k|), hprod (fun k => Real.sqrt (1 + t k ^ 2))]
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + |t i| * |t j|) * ∏ k ∈ s, Real.sqrt (1 + t k ^ 2) := by
      rw [add_mul, one_mul]
      exact add_le_add hrest1
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrestAbs (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)))
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (one_add_abs_mul_le_sqrt_mul (t i) (t j))
      (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.re_det_add_norm_det_le_norm_det_add_I_smul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hA, hKdet, -⟩ := exists_det_add_I_smul_factors hH hK
  rw [hA, hKdet]
  have hre : 0 < H.det.re := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hH.det_pos).1
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (one_add_prod_abs_le_prod_sqrt t hN) hre.le
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.one_add_prod_abs_rpow_le_prod_sqrt_rpow
statement:
private theorem one_add_prod_abs_rpow_le_prod_sqrt_rpow (t : n → ℝ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    1 + (∏ i, |t i|) ^ (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤
      (∏ i, Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2)) ^ (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix n n ℝ := diagonal (fun i => t i ^ 2)
  have hD : D.PosSemidef := Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => sq_nonneg (t i))
  have h := det_rpow_inv_card_add_le_of_posSemidef
    (A := (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) Matrix.PosSemidef.one hD hN
  have hdiag : 1 + D = diagonal (fun i => 1 + t i ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, ← Matrix.diagonal_add]
  rw [Matrix.det_one, hdiag, Matrix.det_diagonal, Matrix.det_diagonal] at h
  simp only [Real.one_rpow] at h
  have habs : (∏ i, |t i|) ^ 2 = ∏ i, t i ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_pow]
    simp only [sq_abs]
  have hsqrt : (∏ i, Real.sqrt (1 + t i ^ 2)) ^ 2 = ∏ i, (1 + t i ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_pow]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hrpow (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
      a ^ (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) = (a ^ 2) ^ (1 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul ha]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hrpow _ (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg (t i)),
    hrpow _ (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _), habs, hsqrt]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.re_det_rpow_add_norm_det_rpow_le_norm_det_add_I_smul_rpow
statement:
theorem re_det_rpow_add_norm_det_rpow_le_norm_det_add_I_smul_rpow
    {H K : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.PosDef) (hK : K.IsHermitian)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    H.det.re ^ (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) + ‖K.det‖ ^ (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤
      ‖(H + Complex.I • K).det‖ ^ (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hA, hKdet, -⟩ := exists_det_add_I_smul_factors hH hK
  have hre : 0 < H.det.re := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hH.det_pos).1
  rw [hA, hKdet, Real.mul_rpow hre.le (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg (t i)),
    Real.mul_rpow hre.le (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (one_add_prod_abs_rpow_le_prod_sqrt_rpow t hN)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hre.le (2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)))
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.majorized_real_parts_iff_exists_charpoly_and_selfAdjointPart_charpoly
statement:
theorem majorized_real_parts_iff_exists_charpoly_and_selfAdjointPart_charpoly
    (x : n → ℝ) (z : n → ℂ) :
    Majorized (fun i => (z i).re) x ↔
      ∃ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (z i)) ∧
        (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (x i : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_matrix_charpoly_and_selfAdjointPart_charpoly_of_majorized x z
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, hHchar⟩
    let hH : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
    have hchar : (∏ i, (X - C (hH.eigenvalues i : ℂ))) = ∏ i, (X - C (x i : ℂ)) :=
      hH.charpoly_eq.symm.trans hHchar
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : ℂ))
      (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) hchar
    have heq : hH.eigenvalues = x ∘ σ := by
      funext i
      exact Complex.ofReal_injective (hσ i).symm
    have hm : Majorized hH.eigenvalues x := by rw [heq]; exact majorized_comp_perm x σ
    exact (majorized_real_parts_eigenvalues_selfAdjointPart A z hA).trans hm

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posDef
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posDef {A : Matrix m m ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix m n ℝ) : Bᵀ * A * B = 0 ↔ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext i j
    let x : n → ℝ := Pi.single j 1
    have hq := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => x ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ x) h
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec] at hq
    have hzero : B *ᵥ x = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hp := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hn
      simp only [star_trivial] at hp
      rw [dotProduct_comm, Matrix.zero_mulVec, dotProduct_zero] at hq
      linarith
    simpa only [x, Matrix.mulVec_single_one, Matrix.col_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] using congrFun hzero i
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: NLAlib.det_fromBlocks_le_mul_det_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem det_fromBlocks_le_mul_det_of_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosSemidef) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).det ≤ A.det * C.det
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := hH.submatrix (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n)
  have hC : C.PosSemidef := hH.submatrix (Sum.inr : n → m ⊕ n)
  by_cases hAu : IsUnit A
  · have hAPD := hA.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr hAu
    let : Invertible A := hAu.invertible
    have hS : (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ B C hAPD).mp (by simpa using hH)
    have hCorr : (Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        hAPD.inv.posSemidef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
    have hSC : C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B ≤ C := by
      simpa only [Matrix.le_iff, sub_sub_cancel] using hCorr
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (det_le_det_of_posSemidef_le hS hSC) hA.det_nonneg
  · have hdetH : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).det = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hPD := hH.posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr hne
      have hAPD : A.PosDef := hPD.submatrix
        (Sum.inl_injective : Function.Injective (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n))
      exact hAu hAPD.isUnit
    rw [hdetH]
    exact mul_nonneg hA.det_nonneg hC.det_nonneg

name: NLAlib.det_fromBlocks_eq_mul_det_iff_of_posDef
statement:
theorem det_fromBlocks_eq_mul_det_iff_of_posDef
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).det = A.det * C.det ↔ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.PosDef := hH.submatrix
    (Sum.inl_injective : Function.Injective (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n))
  have hC : C.PosDef := hH.submatrix
    (Sum.inr_injective : Function.Injective (Sum.inr : n → m ⊕ n))
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have hS := ((posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_and_schur A B C).mp hH).2
  have hCorr : (Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      hA.inv.posSemidef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
  have hSC : C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B ≤ C := by
    simpa only [Matrix.le_iff, sub_sub_cancel] using hCorr
  constructor
  · intro heq
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] at heq
    have hdet := mul_left_cancel₀ hA.det_pos.ne' heq
    have he := (det_eq_iff_eq_of_posSemidef_le_posDef hC hS.posSemidef hSC).mp hdet
    have hz : Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => C - M) he
      simpa only [sub_sub_cancel, sub_self] using this
    exact (transpose_mul_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posDef hA.inv B).mp hz
  · rintro rfl
    simp [Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum_norm_sq_smul
statement:
theorem quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum_norm_sq_smul (d x : n → ℂ) :
    quadForm (Matrix.diagonal d) x = ∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 • d i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, dotProduct, Pi.star_apply,
    Complex.star_def]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self,
    Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.numericalRange_diagonal_eq_convexHull
statement:
theorem numericalRange_diagonal_eq_convexHull (d : n → ℂ) :
    numericalRange (Matrix.diagonal d) = convexHull ℝ (Set.range d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    apply mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype (fun i => ‖x i‖ ^ 2) d
      (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) _ (fun i => Set.mem_range_self i)
      (quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum_norm_sq_smul d x).symm
    simpa only [hx, one_pow] using (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).symm
  · intro hzmem
    rw [convexHull_range_eq_exists_affineCombination] at hzmem
    obtain ⟨s, w, hw, hsum, hz⟩ := hzmem
    let W : n → ℝ := fun i => if i ∈ s then w i else 0
    have hW (i : n) : 0 ≤ W i := by
      by_cases hi : i ∈ s
      · simpa only [W, if_pos hi] using hw i hi
      · simp only [W, if_neg hi, le_refl]
    have hWsum : ∑ i, W i = 1 := by
      simp only [W, Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
      exact hsum
    let x : n → ℂ := fun i => (Real.sqrt (W i) : ℂ)
    have hx (i : n) : ‖x i‖ ^ 2 = W i := by
      simp only [x, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt (hW i)]
    refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsq : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
        change (∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2) = 1
        simp only [hx, hWsum]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 x)]
    · rw [quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum_norm_sq_smul]
      simp only [hx, W, ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
      rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination s d w hsum] at hz
      exact hz

name: NLAlib.numericalRange_eq_convexHull_spectrum_of_normal
statement:
theorem numericalRange_eq_convexHull_spectrum_of_normal (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) : numericalRange A = convexHull ℝ (spectrum ℂ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, d, rfl⟩ := (normal_iff_exists_unitary_diagonalization A).mp hA
  have h := numericalRange_unitary_conjTranspose_mul_mul (star U) (Matrix.diagonal d)
  have hs : spectrum ℂ ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) = Set.range d := by
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, spectrum_diagonal]
      using (Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ)
        (a := Matrix.diagonal d) (U := U))
  rw [hs]
  simpa only [Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, numericalRange_diagonal_eq_convexHull,
    ] using h

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_embedding_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_decomposition
    [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ) {H : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : H.PosSemidef) (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    (hF : 0 < H.trace) {Λ ε : ℝ} (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ∃ s : Fin ⌊ε ^ 2 * H.trace / Λ⌋₊ ↪ I,
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => v (s j)) ∧
      ∀ a : Fin ⌊ε ^ 2 * H.trace / Λ⌋₊ → ℝ, a ≠ 0 →
        (1 - ε) ^ 2 * H.trace / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 <
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (∑ j, a j • v (s j))‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ := Fintype.card I
  have hM : 0 < M := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  let b₀ : ℝ := (1 - ε) * H.trace / M
  let δ : ℝ := (1 - ε) * Λ / (ε * M)
  let k : ℕ := ⌊ε ^ 2 * H.trace / Λ⌋₊
  have hb₀ : 0 < b₀ := by dsimp [b₀]; positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hparameters := floor_mul_decrement_lt_and_terminal_barrier_le hF hΛ hM hε hε1
  change (k : ℝ) * δ < b₀ ∧
    (1 - ε) ^ 2 * H.trace / M ≤ b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ at hparameters
  obtain ⟨s, hRank, hGap, _hPot⟩ :=
    exists_selectedFrameOperator_rank_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap v hH hframe hb₀ hδ hΛ hHle
      (by exact le_of_eq (neg_div_initial_barrier_eq hF hΛ hM hε hε1)) k hparameters.1
  let X : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ := fun i j => v (s j) i
  have hXX : X * Xᵀ = selectedFrameOperator v s := by
    ext i j
    change (∑ l : Fin k, v (s l) i * v (s l) j) =
      (∑ l : Fin k, vecMulVec (v (s l)) (v (s l))) i j
    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  have hXRank : X.rank = Fintype.card (Fin k) := by
    rw [← Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose X,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hXX, hRank, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => v (s j)) := by
    rw [linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span]
    have hh := hXRank
    rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective s := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hli.injective
    exact congrArg v hij
  refine ⟨⟨s, hinj⟩, hli, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hA : (X * Xᵀ).IsHermitian := by
    rw [hXX]
    exact (selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian
  have heigen : hA.eigenvalues = (selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian.eigenvalues :=
    (hA.eigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues_iff _).mpr (congrArg Matrix.charpoly hXX)
  have hGapX : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ < hA.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [heigen]
    exact hGap
  have hstrict := norm_mulVec_sq_gt_of_eigenvalues_gap X hXRank hA
    (b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ) hGapX a ha
  have hXa : X *ᵥ a = ∑ j, a j • v (s j) := by
    ext i
    change (∑ j : Fin k, v (s j) i * a j) = (∑ j : Fin k, a j • v (s j)) i
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [hXa] at hstrict
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hparameters.2 (sq_nonneg _)).trans_lt hstrict

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.specNorm_pos_of_ne_zero
statement: private theorem specNorm_pos_of_ne_zero (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) : 0 < specNorm L
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hL

name: NLAlib.exists_embedding_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_isotropic_frame
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_isotropic_frame
    [Nonempty I] [Nonempty n] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ∃ s : Fin ⌊ε ^ 2 * frobSq L / specNorm L ^ 2⌋₊ ↪ I,
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => L *ᵥ v (s j)) ∧
      ∀ a : Fin ⌊ε ^ 2 * frobSq L / specNorm L ^ 2⌋₊ → ℝ, a ≠ 0 →
        (1 - ε) ^ 2 * frobSq L / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 <
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (∑ j, a j • (L *ᵥ v (s j)))‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let H : Matrix n n ℝ := L * Lᵀ
  have hH : H.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose L
  have htrace : H.trace = frobSq L := by
    rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose]
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, H]
  have hF : 0 < H.trace := by
    rw [htrace]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg L) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff L).not.mpr hL))
  have hΛ : 0 < specNorm L ^ 2 :=
    sq_pos_of_pos (RestrictedInvertibility.specNorm_pos_of_ne_zero L hL)
  have hHle : H ≤ specNorm L ^ 2 • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.sub _ hH.isHermitian
      rw [Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal]
      exact Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal _
    · intro x
      have hb := (le_abs_self (x ⬝ᵥ (H *ᵥ x))).trans (abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm H x)
      have hnorm : specNorm H = specNorm L ^ 2 := by
        simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self L
      rw [hnorm] at hb
      simpa only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
        Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_nonneg] using hb
  have hdecomp : ∑ i, vecMulVec (L *ᵥ v i) (L *ᵥ v i) = H := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, L * vecMulVec (v i) (v i) * Lᵀ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
      _ = L * (∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) * Lᵀ := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = H := by rw [hframe, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hres := RestrictedInvertibility.exists_embedding_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_decomposition
    (fun i => L *ᵥ v i) hH hdecomp hF hΛ hHle hε hε1
  rw [htrace] at hres
  exact hres

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_isotropic_frame
statement:
theorem exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_isotropic_frame
    [Nonempty I] [Nonempty n] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ∃ S : Finset I,
      S.card = ⌊ε ^ 2 * frobSq L / specNorm L ^ 2⌋₊ ∧
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : S => L *ᵥ v i) ∧
      ∀ a : S → ℝ, a ≠ 0 →
        (1 - ε) ^ 2 * frobSq L / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 <
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (∑ i : S, a i • (L *ᵥ v i))‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, hli, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_embedding_norm_sum_sq_gt_of_isotropic_frame v hframe L hL hε hε1
  let S : Finset I := Finset.univ.image e
  let f₀ : Fin ⌊ε ^ 2 * frobSq L / specNorm L ^ 2⌋₊ → S :=
    fun j => ⟨e j, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f₀ := by
    constructor
    · intro i j hij
      exact e.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hij)
    · intro i
      obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp i.property
      exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩
  let f := Equiv.ofBijective f₀ hf
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [S]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  · exact (linearIndependent_equiv f).mp hli
  · intro a ha
    have hane : (fun j => a (f j)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply ha
      funext i
      have hh := congrFun hz (f.symm i)
      simpa only [f.apply_symm_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using hh
    have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => a (f j))‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, dotProduct]
      exact f.sum_comp (fun i => a i * a i)
    have hsum : (∑ j, a (f j) • (L *ᵥ v (e j))) =
        ∑ i : S, a i • (L *ᵥ v i) := by
      exact f.sum_comp (fun i : S => a i • (L *ᵥ v i))
    have hh := hbound (fun j => a (f j)) hane
    rw [hnorm, hsum] at hh
    exact hh

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub
proof:
:= by
  let z : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩
  have hu := hB.eigenvalues₀_add_le (hA.sub hB) i z (by simp [z])
  simp only [z, Nat.add_zero, Fin.eta] at hu
  have heq : B + (A - B) = A := by abel
  have hcongr := (hB.add (hA.sub hB)).eigenvalues₀_congr hA heq i
  rw [hcongr] at hu
  have hmem : RCLike.ofReal ((hA.sub hB).eigenvalues₀ z) ∈ spectrum 𝕜 (A - B) := by
    rw [(hA.sub hB).spectrum_eq_image_range,
      ← (hA.sub hB).range_eigenvalues₀]
    exact ⟨_, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hb : (hA.sub hB).eigenvalues₀ z ≤ specNorm (A - B) := by
    have hn : ‖(RCLike.ofReal ((hA.sub hB).eigenvalues₀ z) : 𝕜)‖ ≤ ‖A - B‖ :=
      spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hmem
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [RCLike.norm_ofReal, specNorm_eq_norm] using hn)
  linarith only [hu, hb]

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hu := eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub hA hB i
  have hl := eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub hB hA i
  have he : specNorm (B - A) = specNorm (A - B) := by
    rw [← neg_sub A B, specNorm_neg]
  rw [he] at hl
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hl], hu⟩

name: NLAlib.hausdorffDist_spectrum_le_specNorm_sub
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist (specNorm_nonneg _)
  · intro x hx
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hA.range_eigenvalues₀] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨hB.eigenvalues₀ i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hB.range_eigenvalues₀]
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using abs_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub hA hB i
  · intro x hx
    rw [hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hB.range_eigenvalues₀] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨hA.eigenvalues₀ i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hA.range_eigenvalues₀]
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using
        abs_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub hA hB i

name: NLAlib.hausdorffEDist_spectrum_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
  · rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact Set.range_nonempty _
  · rw [hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact Set.range_nonempty _
  · exact A.finite_real_spectrum.isBounded
  · exact B.finite_real_spectrum.isBounded

name: NLAlib.abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_sub_le_specNorm_sub
statement:
theorem abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_sub_le_specNorm_sub {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (s : Set ℝ) :
    |Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ A) s - Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ B) s| ≤
      specNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Metric.hausdorffDist_triangle (u := s) (hausdorffEDist_spectrum_ne_top hA hB)
  have hl := Metric.hausdorffDist_triangle (u := s) (hausdorffEDist_spectrum_ne_top hB hA)
  rw [Metric.hausdorffDist_comm (s := spectrum ℝ B) (t := spectrum ℝ A)] at hl
  have hb := hausdorffDist_spectrum_le_specNorm_sub hA hB
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hl, hb], by linarith only [hu, hb]⟩

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_hausdorffDist_spectrum
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_hausdorffDist_spectrum (s : Set ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun A : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n 𝕜) =>
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)) s)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro A B
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm]
  change |Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)) s -
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)) s| ≤
    ‖(A : Matrix n n 𝕜) - (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)‖
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
    abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_sub_le_specNorm_sub A.property.isHermitian B.property.isHermitian s

name: NLAlib.continuous_hausdorffDist_spectrum_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem continuous_hausdorffDist_spectrum_selfAdjointPart (s : Set ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n 𝕜 =>
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n 𝕜)) s)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Continuous (selfAdjointPart ℝ : Matrix n n 𝕜 → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n 𝕜)) :=
    continuous_selfAdjointPart ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜)
  exact (lipschitzWith_hausdorffDist_spectrum s).continuous.comp hp

name: NLAlib.aemeasurable_hausdorffDist_spectrum
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_hausdorffDist_spectrum {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) (s : Set ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (fun ω => Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X ω)) s) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (continuous_hausdorffDist_spectrum_selfAdjointPart (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := n) s).measurable
  apply (hm.comp_aemeasurable hX).congr
  filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
  exact congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ A) s)
    (hω.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ)

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_triangular_similarity_iff_unitary
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_triangular_similarity_iff_unitary
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    [LocallyFiniteOrderBot n] [WellFoundedLT n] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∃ V : Matrix n n ℂ, IsUnit V ∧ ∀ a, (V⁻¹ * A a * V).IsUpperTriangular) ↔
      ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
        ∀ a, ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * A a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨V, hV, htri⟩
    let p := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toBasis
    let b := p.map (Matrix.toLinearEquiv p V ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mp hV))
    have hVcoord : p.toMatrix b = V := by
      ext i j
      simp only [b, Basis.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_apply, Matrix.toLinearEquiv_apply]
      simpa only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply] using
        congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i j) (LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin p p V)
    have hbback : b.toMatrix p = V⁻¹ := by
      have h := Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip b p
      rw [hVcoord] at h
      exact (Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv h).symm
    let f (a : ι) : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := (A a).toEuclideanLin
    have hbtri (a : ι) : ((f a).toMatrix b b).IsUpperTriangular := by
      have hchange := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix b p b p (f a)
      have hstd : (f a).toMatrix p p = A a := LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin p p (A a)
      rw [hstd, hbback, hVcoord] at hchange
      rw [← hchange]
      exact htri a
    obtain ⟨q, hqtri⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_of_upper_triangular_basis b f hbtri
    let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
      ⟨p.toMatrix q.toBasis, (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary q⟩
    have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
    have hback : q.toBasis.toMatrix p = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
        (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse hUU) |>.mul_left_cancel
      change p.toMatrix q.toBasis * q.toBasis.toMatrix p =
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
      rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, hUU]
    refine ⟨U, fun a => ?_⟩
    have hchange := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      q.toBasis p q.toBasis p (f a)
    have hstd : (f a).toMatrix p p = A a := LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin p p (A a)
    rw [hstd, hback] at hchange
    exact hchange ▸ hqtri a
  · rintro ⟨U, hU⟩
    have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
    have hinv : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)⁻¹ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hUt
    refine ⟨U, (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt), ?_⟩
    simpa only [hinv] using hU

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_triangular_similarity_iff_unitary_of_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_triangular_similarity_iff_unitary_of_equiv
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    (∃ V : Matrix n n ℂ, IsUnit V ∧
      ∀ a i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → (V⁻¹ * A a * V) i j = 0) ↔
      ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
        ∀ a i j, e.symm j < e.symm i →
          ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * A a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder n := LinearOrder.lift' e.symm e.symm.injective
  let o : n ≃o Fin (Fintype.card n) := { e.symm with map_rel_iff' := Iff.rfl }
  let : LocallyFiniteOrderBot n := o.locallyFiniteOrderBot
  let : WellFoundedLT n := ⟨(measure (fun i => (e.symm i).val)).wf⟩
  exact exists_simultaneous_triangular_similarity_iff_unitary A

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_of_gram_charpoly_eq
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_of_gram_charpoly_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (h : (Aᴴ * A).charpoly = (Bᴴ * B).charpoly) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A k = singularValues B k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < Fintype.card n
  · have he := congrFun (eigenvalues₀_eq_of_charpoly_eq
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A) (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B)
      h) ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hs : singularValues A k ^ 2 = singularValues B k ^ 2 :=
      (sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A ⟨k, hk⟩).trans
        (he.trans (sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ B ⟨k, hk⟩).symm)
    nlinarith [singularValues_nonneg A k, singularValues_nonneg B k]
  · have hkn : Module.finrank 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) ≤ k := by
      simpa only [finrank_euclideanSpace] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hk
    rw [singularValues_eq_linearMap, singularValues_eq_linearMap,
      LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le _ hkn, LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le _ hkn]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (hGram : Aᴴ * A = Bᴴ * B) (k : ℕ) : singularValues A k = singularValues B k
proof:
:=
  singularValues_eq_of_gram_charpoly_eq A B (congrArg Matrix.charpoly hGram) k

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_congruence_diagonal_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_congruence_diagonal_of_commute {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : Commute A B) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix n n 𝕜) (a b : n → ℝ), HasOrthonormalCols U ∧
      Uᴴ * A * U = diagonal (fun i => (a i : 𝕜)) ∧
      Uᴴ * B * U = diagonal (fun i => (b i : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a := A.toEuclideanLin
  let b := B.toEuclideanLin
  have ha : a.IsSymmetric := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA
  have hb : b.IsSymmetric := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hB
  have hab : Commute a b := by
    change a.comp b = b.comp a
    simpa only [a, b, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same] using
      congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M.toEuclideanLin) hAB.eq
  let W : (𝕜 × 𝕜) → Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) :=
    fun i => Module.End.eigenspace a i.2 ⊓ Module.End.eigenspace b i.1
  have hsum : DirectSum.IsInternal W := ha.directSum_isInternal_of_commute hb hab
  have horth : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => W i) (fun i => (W i).subtypeₗᵢ) :=
    ha.orthogonalFamily_eigenspace_inf_eigenspace hb
  let s := Σ i : 𝕜 × 𝕜, Fin (Module.finrank 𝕜 (W i))
  let c₀ := hsum.collectedBasis (fun i => (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 (W i)).toBasis)
  let : Fintype s := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex c₀
  have hc₀ : Orthonormal 𝕜 c₀ := by
    simpa only [c₀, DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedBasis_coe, Submodule.coe_subtypeₗᵢ] using!
      horth.orthonormal_sigma_orthonormal
        (show ∀ i, Orthonormal 𝕜 (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 (W i)).toBasis by simp)
  let c := c₀.toOrthonormalBasis hc₀
  have hc : Fintype.card s = Fintype.card n := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis c.toBasis]
    exact finrank_euclideanSpace
  let e : s ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hc
  let v : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) := c.reindex e
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := Matrix.of (fun i j => v j i)
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := by
    apply (hasOrthonormalCols_iff_orthonormal U).mpr
    have he : (fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (U.col j)) = v := by
      funext j
      rfl
    rw [he]
    exact v.orthonormal
  have hcol (j : n) : v j ∈ W (e.symm j).1 := by
    simpa only [v, c, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply, Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis] using
      hsum.collectedBasis_mem (fun i => (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 (W i)).toBasis) (e.symm j)
  have hAU : A * U = U * diagonal (fun j => (e.symm j).1.2) := by
    ext i j
    have he := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp (hcol j).1
    have hi := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n => x i) he
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simpa [a, U, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hi
  have hBU : B * U = U * diagonal (fun j => (e.symm j).1.1) := by
    ext i j
    have he := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp (hcol j).2
    have hi := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n => x i) he
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simpa [b, U, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hi
  have hUA : Uᴴ * A * U = diagonal (fun j => (e.symm j).1.2) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAU, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hUB : Uᴴ * B * U = diagonal (fun j => (e.symm j).1.1) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hBU, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hreal (M : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hM : M.IsHermitian) (d : n → 𝕜)
      (hd : Uᴴ * M * U = diagonal d) (i : n) : (RCLike.re (d i) : 𝕜) = d i := by
    have hh : (diagonal d).IsHermitian := hd ▸ Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul U hM
    exact RCLike.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (by simpa using congrFun (congrFun hh.eq i) i)
  refine ⟨U, fun i => RCLike.re (e.symm i).1.2,
    fun i => RCLike.re (e.symm i).1.1, hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hreal A hA _ hUA] using hUA
  · simpa only [hreal B hB _ hUB] using hUB

name: NLAlib.le_mul_ridgeFraction_of_le
proof:
