name: NLAlib.card_mul_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
statement:
theorem card_mul_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (lam : ι → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) {μ t : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (S : Finset ι) (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, t ≤ lam i) :
    (S.card : ℝ) * t ≤ (t + μ) * effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ S, lam i / (lam i + μ) ≤ effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
    intro i
    exact div_nonneg (hlam i) (add_nonneg (hlam i) hμ.le)
  calc
    _ = ∑ _i ∈ S, t := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, (t + μ) * (lam i / (lam i + μ)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => threshold_le_mul_ridgeFraction (hlam i) hμ (hS i hi)
    _ = (t + μ) * ∑ i ∈ S, lam i / (lam i + μ) := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (add_nonneg ht hμ.le)

name: NLAlib.sum_compl_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
statement:
theorem sum_compl_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (lam : ι → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) {μ t : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (S : Finset ι)
    (hhead : ∀ i ∈ S, t ≤ lam i) (htail : ∀ i ∉ S, lam i ≤ t)
    (hcard : effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ ≤ S.card) :
    ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, lam i ≤ μ * effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (S.card : ℝ) * t ≤ (t + μ) * ∑ i ∈ S, lam i / (lam i + μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _i ∈ S, t := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, (t + μ) * (lam i / (lam i + μ)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => threshold_le_mul_ridgeFraction (hlam i) hμ (hhead i hi)
      _ = _ := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm
  have hr : ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, lam i ≤ (t + μ) * ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, lam i / (lam i + μ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, (t + μ) * (lam i / (lam i + μ)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => le_mul_ridgeFraction_of_le (hlam i) hμ
          (htail i (Finset.mem_compl.mp hi))
      _ = _ := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm
  have hsplit : (∑ i ∈ S, lam i / (lam i + μ)) +
      (∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, lam i / (lam i + μ)) = effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ := by
    exact Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S _
  have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard ht
  rw [← hsplit] at hc ⊢
  nlinarith only [hh, hr, hc]

name: NLAlib.apply_le_mul_of_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum_le
statement:
theorem apply_le_mul_of_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum_le {n : ℕ}
    (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hmono : Antitone lam)
    {μ γ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (j : Fin n)
    (hj : (1 + 1 / γ) * effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ ≤ (j.val : ℝ) + 1) :
    lam j ≤ γ * μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc := card_mul_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam hlam hμ (hlam j)
    (Finset.Iic j) (fun i hi => hmono (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hi))
  simp only [Fin.card_Iic, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hc
  by_contra hbad
  have hjpos : 0 < lam j := lt_trans (mul_pos hγ hμ) (lt_of_not_ge hbad)
  have hD : 0 < effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ := by
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos hjpos (add_pos hjpos hμ))
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => div_nonneg (hlam i)
      (add_nonneg (hlam i) hμ.le)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj hγ.le
  have he : (1 + 1 / γ) * effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ * γ =
      (1 + γ) * effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hγ]; ring
  rw [he] at hb
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hγ.le
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (hlam j)
  have h3 := mul_pos hD (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hbad))
  nlinarith only [h1, h2, h3]

name: NLAlib.sum_filter_ge_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
statement:
theorem sum_filter_ge_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum {n : ℕ}
    (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hmono : Antitone lam)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (k : ℕ) (hk : effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ ≤ k) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => k ≤ i.val), lam i ≤
      μ * effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkn : k < n
  · let j : Fin n := ⟨k, hkn⟩
    have h := sum_compl_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum lam hlam hμ (hlam j)
      (Finset.Iio j) (fun i hi => hmono (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi).le)
      (fun i hi => hmono (le_of_not_gt (fun h => hi (Finset.mem_Iio.mpr h))))
      (by simpa [j] using hk)
    convert h using 1
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp [j, Finset.mem_Iio, Fin.lt_def, not_lt]
  · have hz : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => k ≤ i.val) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro i hi
      have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      omega
    rw [hz, Finset.sum_empty]
    apply mul_nonneg hμ.le
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => div_nonneg (hlam i) (add_nonneg (hlam i) hμ.le)

name: NLAlib.det_smul_sub_smul_of_unitary_qz
statement:
theorem det_smul_sub_smul_of_unitary_qz
    (hA : A = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * S * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * T * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : T.IsUpperTriangular) (α β : ℂ) :
    (β • A - α • B).det = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).det *
      (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ.det * ∏ i, (β * S i i - α * T i i)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : β • A - α • B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) *
      (β • S - α • T) * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, ← hA, ← hB]
  have hu : (β • S - α • T).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, hS hij, hT hij]
  rw [hf, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hu]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.pencilPolynomial_eq_prod_of_unitary_qz
statement:
theorem pencilPolynomial_eq_prod_of_unitary_qz
    (hA : A = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * S * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * T * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : T.IsUpperTriangular) :
    pencilPolynomial A B = Polynomial.C ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).det *
      (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ.det) *
      ∏ i, (Polynomial.C (S i i) - Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (T i i))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : A.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ) - (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℂ) • B.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ) =
      (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ) *
        (S.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ) - (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℂ) • T.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ)) *
        ((Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ).map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    simp only [hA, hB, Matrix.map_mul]
  have hu : (S.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ) - (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℂ) • T.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ)).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, hS hij, hT hij]
  unfold pencilPolynomial
  rw [hf, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hu]
  have hmap (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
      (M.map (Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ)).det = Polynomial.C M.det := ((Polynomial.C : ℂ →+* Polynomial ℂ).map_det M).symm
  rw [hmap, hmap, map_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.pencilPolynomial_ne_zero_iff_of_unitary_qz
statement:
theorem pencilPolynomial_ne_zero_iff_of_unitary_qz
    (hA : A = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * S * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * T * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : T.IsUpperTriangular) :
    pencilPolynomial A B ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ i, S i i ≠ 0 ∨ T i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Polynomial.C ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).det *
      (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ.det) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · exact (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse (Unitary.coe_mul_star_self Q)).ne_zero
    · exact (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse (Unitary.coe_star_mul_self Z)).ne_zero
  rw [pencilPolynomial_eq_prod_of_unitary_qz hA hB hS hT, mul_ne_zero_iff,
    and_iff_right hc, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_const]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro i
  have hz : Polynomial.C (S i i) - Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (T i i) = 0 ↔
      S i i = 0 ∧ T i i = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro he
      have h0 := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.coeff 0) he
      have h1 := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.coeff 1) he
      simpa using And.intro h0 h1
    · rintro ⟨hs, ht⟩
      simp [hs, ht]
  simpa only [not_and_or] using (not_congr hz)

name: NLAlib.det_smul_sub_smul_eq_zero_iff_of_unitary_qz
statement:
theorem det_smul_sub_smul_eq_zero_iff_of_unitary_qz
    (hA : A = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * S * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * T * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : T.IsUpperTriangular) (α β : ℂ) :
    (β • A - α • B).det = 0 ↔ ∃ i, β * S i i = α * T i i
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).det ≠ 0 :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse (Unitary.coe_mul_star_self Q)).ne_zero
  have hZ : (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ.det ≠ 0 :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse (Unitary.coe_star_mul_self Z)).ne_zero
  rw [det_smul_sub_smul_of_unitary_qz hA hB hS hT, mul_eq_zero,
    or_iff_right (mul_ne_zero hQ hZ), Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and, sub_eq_zero]

name: NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum {A : Matrix n n K} {μ : K}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum K A) : ∃ x : n → K, x ≠ 0 ∧ A *ᵥ x = μ • x
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : (μ • (1 : Matrix n n K) - A).det = 0 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal] using
      (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp hμ).eq_zero
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec] using hAx)).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_vecMul_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_vecMul_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum {A : Matrix n n K} {μ : K}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum K A) : ∃ y : n → K, y ≠ 0 ∧ y ᵥ* A = μ • y
proof:
:= by
  have htrans : μ ∈ spectrum K Aᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_transpose] using hμ
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hAy⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum htrans
  exact ⟨y, hy, by simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_transpose] using hAy⟩

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_eq_zero_of_left_right_eigenvalues_ne
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : α * (y ⬝ᵥ x) = μ * (y ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    calc
      _ = y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by rw [hx, dotProduct_smul]; rfl
      _ = (y ᵥ* A) ⬝ᵥ x := Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec y A x
      _ = _ := by rw [hy, smul_dotProduct]; rfl
  exact (mul_eq_mul_right_iff.mp hpair).resolve_left hαμ

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_ne_zero {x : m → K} {y : n → K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hy
  intro hxy
  have heq := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n K => M i j) hxy
  exact mul_ne_zero hi hj heq

name: NLAlib.mul_vecMulVec_eq_vecMulVec_mul
statement:
theorem mul_vecMulVec_eq_vecMulVec_mul {A : Matrix m m K} {B : Matrix n n K}
    {x : m → K} {y : n → K} {μ : K} (hx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x)
    (hy : y ᵥ* B = μ • y) :
    A * Matrix.vecMulVec x y = Matrix.vecMulVec x y * B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, hx, hy]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.normalized_vecMulVec_mul_self
statement:
theorem normalized_vecMulVec_mul_self {x y : n → K} (hpair : y ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    ((y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y) *
      ((y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y) =
        (y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.mul_normalized_vecMulVec_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mul_normalized_vecMulVec_eq_smul {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K}
    {μ : K} (hx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hy : y ᵥ* A = μ • y) :
    A * ((y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y) =
      μ • ((y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y) ∧
    ((y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y) * A =
      μ • ((y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, hx, Matrix.smul_vecMulVec,
      smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]
  · rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, hy]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eigenvector_of_intertwines
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hS, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hx, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.vecMul_eigenvector_of_intertwines
proof:
