name: Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  intro hunit
  have hzero : (μ • (1 : Matrix ι ι K) - B) *ᵥ z = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hBz, sub_self]
  exact hz (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hunit (hzero.trans (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm))

name: Matrix.mem_spectrum_complexification_of_real_eigenpair
proof:
:= by
  have hcp : (fun i => (p i : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hp
    funext i
    apply Complex.ofReal_injective
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, Complex.ofReal_zero] using congrFun hz i
  apply mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hcp
  funext i
  have h := congrArg Complex.ofReal (congrFun heig i)
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul, Matrix.map_apply] using h

name: Matrix.pow_mulVec_eq_pow_smul_of_mulVec_eq_smul
statement:
theorem pow_mulVec_eq_pow_smul_of_mulVec_eq_smul {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
    {A : Matrix ι ι K} {p : ι → K} {r : K} (hp : A *ᵥ p = r • p) (k : ℕ) :
    A ^ k *ᵥ p = r ^ k • p
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hp, Matrix.mulVec_smul, ih,
      smul_smul, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.singularValues_delete_row_interlacing
statement:
theorem singularValues_delete_row_interlacing {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A (k + 1) ≤ singularValues (A.submatrix i.succAbove id) k ∧
      singularValues (A.submatrix i.succAbove id) k ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_le_submatrix_rows A i.succAbove Fin.succAbove_right_injective k
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  exact ⟨h, singularValues_submatrix_rows_le A i.succAbove Fin.succAbove_right_injective k⟩

name: NLAlib.singularValues_delete_col_interlacing
statement:
theorem singularValues_delete_col_interlacing {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A (k + 1) ≤ singularValues (A.submatrix id j.succAbove) k ∧
      singularValues (A.submatrix id j.succAbove) k ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_le_submatrix_cols A j.succAbove Fin.succAbove_right_injective k
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  exact ⟨h, singularValues_submatrix_cols_le A j.succAbove Fin.succAbove_right_injective k⟩

name: NLAlib.rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one_of_pairing_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one_of_pairing_ne_zero
    {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K} {μ : K}
    (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hdim : finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ) = 1)
    (hpair : y ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by intro hx; simp [hx] at hpair
  have hspan : K ∙ x = Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
      ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem x _).mpr (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hAx))
      (by rw [finrank_span_singleton hx, hdim])
  let N := A - μ • 1
  have hpairN (z : n → K) : y ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ z) = 0 := by
    simp only [N, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_sub, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hyA, smul_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_smul, sub_self]
  have hstep (z : n → K) (hz : N *ᵥ (N *ᵥ z) = 0) : N *ᵥ z = 0 := by
    have hmem : N *ᵥ z ∈ Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ := by
      apply Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
      change A *ᵥ (N *ᵥ z) = μ • (N *ᵥ z)
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      simpa only [N, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] using hz
    rw [← hspan] at hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    have hc0 : c = 0 := by
      have hp := hpairN z
      rw [← hc, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hp
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_right hpair
    rw [← hc, hc0, zero_smul]
  have hpower (k : ℕ) (z : n → K) (hz : N ^ k *ᵥ z = 0) : N *ᵥ z = 0 := by
    induction k generalizing z with
    | zero =>
      have hz0 : z = 0 := by simpa only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec] using hz
      rw [hz0, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      apply hstep z
      apply ih (N *ᵥ z)
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ]
      exact hz
  have hmax : Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ = Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ := by
    apply le_antisymm _ Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ z).mp hz
    have hkM : N ^ k *ᵥ z = 0 := by
      change (N ^ k).toLin' z = 0
      simpa only [N, Matrix.toLin'_pow, map_sub, map_smul, Matrix.toLin'_one,
        Module.End.one_eq_id] using hk
    apply Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
    change A *ᵥ z = μ • z
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [N, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] using hpower k z hkM
  have hm := LinearMap.finrank_maxGenEigenspace_eq A.toLin' μ
  rw [hmax, hdim, Matrix.charpoly_toLin'] at hm
  exact hm.symm

name: NLAlib.rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff_pairing_ne_zero_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff_pairing_ne_zero_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one
    [IsAlgClosed K] {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K} {μ : K}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hdim : finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ) = 1) :
    A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1 ↔ y ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨dotProduct_ne_zero_of_simple_eigenvalue hx hy hAx hyA,
    rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one_of_pairing_ne_zero hAx hyA hdim⟩

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.specNorm_le_re_trace
statement:
theorem PosSemidef.specNorm_le_re_trace {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    NLAlib.specNorm A ≤ A.trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have he : A.trace.re=∑ i, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hA.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    simp
  rw [hA.isHermitian.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues,he]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)).mpr
  intro i
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hA.eigenvalues_nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.rank_one_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
statement:
theorem rank_one_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
    (hstrict : ∀ (n : ℕ) (d b : Fin n → ℝ), StrictMono d → Monotone b →
      (∀ i, d i ≤ b i) → (∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
        ∏ j, (X - C (b j))) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (d b : Fin n → ℝ), Monotone d → Monotone b →
      (∀ i, d i ≤ b i) → (∀ i j, i < j → b i ≤ d j) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
        ∏ j, (X - C (b j))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro d b _ _ _ _
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro d b hd hb hlo hhi
    by_cases hs : StrictMono d
    · exact hstrict (n + 1) d b hs hb hlo (fun i j hij => hhi i j (by omega))
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_adjacent_eq_of_monotone_not_strictMono d hd hs
      let p := i.castSucc
      have hroot : b p = d p := rank_one_interlacing_forced_root d b hlo hhi i hi
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ih (d ∘ p.succAbove) (b ∘ p.succAbove)
        (hd.comp (Fin.strictMono_succAbove p).monotone)
        (hb.comp (Fin.strictMono_succAbove p).monotone)
        (fun j => hlo (p.succAbove j))
        (fun j l hjl => hhi _ _ (Fin.strictMono_succAbove p hjl))
      refine ⟨p.insertNth 0 v, ?_⟩
      rw [charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_insertNth, hv,
        Fin.prod_univ_succAbove (fun j => X - C (b j)) p, hroot]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.bordered_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
statement:
theorem bordered_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
    (hstrict : ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      StrictMono d → Monotone b → (∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
          (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
          ∏ j, (X - C (b j))) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      Monotone d → Monotone b → (∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
          (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
          ∏ j, (X - C (b j))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro d b _ hb h
    exact hstrict 0 d b (by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i) hb h
  | succ n ih =>
    intro d b hd hb h
    by_cases hs : StrictMono d
    · exact hstrict (n + 1) d b hs hb h
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_adjacent_eq_of_monotone_not_strictMono d hd hs
      let p := i.castSucc
      have hroot : b p.succ = d p := bordered_interlacing_forced_root d b h i hi
      obtain ⟨v, a, hva⟩ := ih (d ∘ p.succAbove) (b ∘ p.succ.succAbove)
        (hd.comp (Fin.strictMono_succAbove p).monotone)
        (hb.comp (Fin.strictMono_succAbove p.succ).monotone)
        (bordered_interlacing_succAbove d b hb h p)
      refine ⟨p.insertNth 0 v, a, ?_⟩
      rw [charpoly_bordered_diagonal_insertNth, hva,
        Fin.prod_univ_succAbove (fun j => X - C (b j)) p.succ, hroot]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.isClosed_setOf_charpolyRootCountIn_eq
statement:
theorem isClosed_setOf_charpolyRootCountIn_eq
    (A : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : Continuous A) (K L : Set ℂ)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L) (hdisj : Disjoint K L)
    (hspec : ∀ t, spectrum ℂ (A t) ⊆ K ∪ L) (r : ℕ) :
    IsClosed {t | charpolyRootCountIn (A t) K = r}
proof:
:= by
  let F : (n → ℂ) → Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℂ :=
    fun z j => ∏ i, ((j.val : ℂ) - z i)
  let G : Ω → Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℂ :=
    fun t j => (A t).charpoly.eval (j.val : ℂ)
  let box (s : Finset n) : Set (n → ℂ) := {z | ∀ i, z i ∈ if i ∈ s then K else L}
  let Cᵣ : Set (Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℂ) :=
    ⋃ s : {s : Finset n // s.card = r}, F '' box s.val
  have hF : Continuous F := by fun_prop
  have hG : Continuous G := by
    apply continuous_pi
    intro j
    change Continuous (fun t => (A t).charpoly.eval (j.val : ℂ))
    simp_rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly]
    exact (continuous_const.sub hA).matrix_det
  have hbox (s : Finset n) : IsCompact (box s) := by
    apply isCompact_pi_infinite
    intro i
    split_ifs <;> assumption
  have hC : IsCompact Cᵣ := isCompact_iUnion fun s => (hbox s.val).image hF
  have hcount (t : Ω) (s : Finset n) (z : n → ℂ) (hz : z ∈ box s) (hval : F z = G t) :
      charpolyRootCountIn (A t) K = s.card := by
    have hchar : (A t).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (z i)) :=
      charpoly_eq_prod_of_eval_eq (A t) z (fun j => (congrFun hval j).symm)
    rw [charpolyRootCountIn_eq_card_filter (A t) K z hchar]
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · have hzi : z i ∈ K := by simpa only [box, hi, ite_true] using hz i
      exact iff_of_true hzi hi
    · have hzi : z i ∈ L := by simpa only [box, hi, ite_false] using hz i
      have hnot : z i ∉ K := fun hk => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hk hzi
      exact iff_of_false hnot hi
  have heq : {t | charpolyRootCountIn (A t) K = r} = G ⁻¹' Cᵣ := by
    ext t
    constructor
    · intro ht
      obtain ⟨U, T, _, _, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization
        (A t) (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
      let z : n → ℂ := fun i => T i i
      let s : Finset n := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => z i ∈ K)
      have hsc : s.card = r := (charpolyRootCountIn_eq_card_filter (A t) K z hchar).symm.trans ht
      have hzspec (i : n) : z i ∈ spectrum ℂ (A t) := by
        apply Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mpr
        rw [hchar]
        simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_prod]
        apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
        simp [z]
      have hzbox : z ∈ box s := by
        intro i
        by_cases hi : z i ∈ K
        · simp only [s, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hi, ite_true]
        · have hzL : z i ∈ L := (hspec t (hzspec i)).resolve_left hi
          simpa only [s, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hi, ite_false] using hzL
      have hval : F z = G t := by
        funext j
        change (∏ i, ((j.val : ℂ) - T i i)) = (A t).charpoly.eval (j.val : ℂ)
        rw [hchar]
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨s, hsc⟩, z, hzbox, hval⟩
    · intro ht
      obtain ⟨s, z, hz, hval⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
      exact (hcount t s.val z hz hval).trans s.property
  rw [heq]
  exact hC.isClosed.preimage hG

name: NLAlib.charpolyRootCountIn_eq_of_preconnected
statement:
theorem charpolyRootCountIn_eq_of_preconnected [PreconnectedSpace Ω]
    (A : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : Continuous A) (K L : Set ℂ)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L) (hdisj : Disjoint K L)
    (hspec : ∀ t, spectrum ℂ (A t) ⊆ K ∪ L) (s t : Ω) :
    charpolyRootCountIn (A s) K = charpolyRootCountIn (A t) K
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed (r : ℕ) : IsClosed {x | charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K = r} :=
    isClosed_setOf_charpolyRootCountIn_eq A hA K L hK hL hdisj hspec r
  let r := charpolyRootCountIn (A s) K
  let S : Set Ω := {x | charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K = r}
  have hcomp : Sᶜ = ⋃ j : {j : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) // (j : ℕ) ≠ r},
      {x | charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K = (j.val : ℕ)} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      change charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K ≠ r at hx
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨⟨charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K,
        Nat.lt_succ_of_le (charpolyRootCountIn_le_card (A x) K)⟩, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      change charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K ≠ r
      rw [show charpolyRootCountIn (A x) K = (j.val : ℕ) from hj]
      exact j.property
  have hopen : IsOpen S := by
    rw [← isClosed_compl_iff, hcomp]
    exact isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun j => hclosed j.val
  have hall : (Set.univ : Set Ω) ⊆ S :=
    isPreconnected_univ.subset_isClopen ⟨hclosed r, hopen⟩ ⟨s, Set.mem_univ s, rfl⟩
  exact (hall (Set.mem_univ t)).symm

name: NLAlib.card_eigenvalues_lt_eq_card_sign_changes
statement:
theorem card_eigenvalues_lt_eq_card_sign_changes {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {x : ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → leadingMinor (A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) k ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i < x).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin m =>
        leadingMinor (A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) (k : ℕ) *
          leadingMinor (A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) ((k : ℕ) + 1) < 0).card
proof:
:= by
  let M := A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
  have hM : M.IsSymm := by
    change Mᵀ = M
    dsimp [M]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.transpose_one,
      (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hA).eq]
  have hminor (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) : leadingMinor M k ≠ 0 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk0
    · simp
    · exact hp k hk0 hk
  have hlu := isLU_lu ((luSucceeds_iff_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero M).mpr hminor)
  have hL : IsUnit (lu M).1 := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (by
    rw [hlu.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one]
    exact isUnit_one)
  have hLDL := hlu.eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hM
  have hcount := card_eigenvalues_lt_eq_card_neg_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul hA hL hLDL
  have hprod (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
      leadingMinor M k = ∏ i : Fin k, (lu M).2 (Fin.castLE hk i) (Fin.castLE hk i) := by
    exact hlu.leadingMinor_eq_prod k hk
  have hpivot (k : Fin m) : leadingMinor M ((k : ℕ) + 1) =
      leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) * (lu M).2 k k := by
    rw [hprod ((k : ℕ) + 1) (by omega), Fin.prod_univ_castSucc,
      hprod (k : ℕ) (by omega)]
    rfl
  rw [hcount]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro k hk
  have hpk : leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) ≠ 0 := hminor k k.isLt.le
  have hsq : 0 < leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hpk
  change (lu M).2 k k < 0 ↔ leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) * leadingMinor M ((k : ℕ) + 1) < 0
  rw [hpivot, show leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) * (leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) * (lu M).2 k k) =
    leadingMinor M (k : ℕ) ^ 2 * (lu M).2 k k by ring]
  simpa only [mul_zero] using (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left (b := (lu M).2 k k) (c := (0 : ℝ)) hsq).symm

name: NLAlib.inv_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero (d : n → K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d)⁻¹ = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  simp only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (hd _), Matrix.diagonal_one]

name: NLAlib.prod_mul_sum_div_eq_sum_prod_erase
statement:
theorem prod_mul_sum_div_eq_sum_prod_erase (d w : n → K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (∏ i, d i) * (∑ i, w i / d i) =
      ∑ i, w i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, d j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ d (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  field_simp [hd i]

name: NLAlib.det_fromBlocks_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_fromBlocks_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero
    {l : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    (d v : n → K) (a : K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol l v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow l v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : l => a)).det =
      (∏ i, d i) * (a - ∑ i, (v i) ^ 2 / d i)
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit (Matrix.diagonal d).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_diagonal, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hd i)
  let := ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr hdet).nonempty_invertible.some
  rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.det_diagonal, Matrix.det_unique,
    Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, inv_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero d hd]
  congr 1
  rw [Matrix.sub_apply]
  congr 1
  conv_lhs => rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.replicateRow_apply,
    Matrix.replicateCol_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_of_forall_ne_zero
    (d u v : n → K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec u v).det =
      (∏ i, d i) * (1 + ∑ i, u i * v i / d i)
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit (Matrix.diagonal d).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_diagonal, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hd i)
  rw [det_add_vecMulVec hdet, Matrix.det_diagonal,
    inv_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero d hd]
  congr 2
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.charpoly_fromBlocks_diagonal_replicate
statement:
theorem charpoly_fromBlocks_diagonal_replicate
    [Infinite K] {l : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    (d v : n → K) (a : K) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol l v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow l v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : l => a)).charpoly =
      (X - C a) * (∏ i, (X - C (d i))) -
        ∑ i, C ((v i) ^ 2) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X - C (d j))
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (Set.finite_range d).infinite_compl.mono
  intro z hz
  have hzd (i : n) : z - d i ≠ 0 := by
    apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
    intro h
    exact hz ⟨i, h.symm⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  have hblocks : Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : n ⊕ l => z) -
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol l v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow l v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : l => a) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => z - d i))
        (Matrix.replicateCol l (-v)) (Matrix.replicateRow l (-v))
        (Matrix.of fun _ _ : l => z - a) := by
    ext i j
    rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
    · by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.fromBlocks, hij]
    · simp [Matrix.fromBlocks]
    · simp [Matrix.fromBlocks]
    · have hij : i = j := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp [Matrix.fromBlocks, hij]
  rw [hblocks, det_fromBlocks_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero _ _ _ hzd, mul_sub,
    prod_mul_sum_div_eq_sum_prod_erase _ _ hzd]
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_sq]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec
    [Infinite K] (d v : n → K) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ i, (X - C (d i))) -
        ∑ i, C ((v i) ^ 2) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X - C (d j))
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (Set.finite_range d).infinite_compl.mono
  intro z hz
  have hzd (i : n) : z - d i ≠ 0 := by
    apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
    intro h
    exact hz ⟨i, h.symm⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  have hmat : Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : n => z) - (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => z - d i) + Matrix.vecMulVec (-v) v := by
    rw [Matrix.neg_vecMulVec, ← Matrix.diagonal_sub]
    abel
  rw [hmat, det_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_of_forall_ne_zero _ _ _ hzd, mul_add, mul_one,
    prod_mul_sum_div_eq_sum_prod_erase _ _ hzd]
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul, ← pow_two, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian
proof: := singularDirectionProjector_isHermitian _ _

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem
proof:
:=
  HasOrthonormalCols.isIdempotentElem_singularDirectionProjector h.conjTranspose_mul_right _

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_prefix_indicator
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_prefix_indicator (q k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin q, if (i : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = (min k q : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if i < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) q, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hf : (Finset.range q).filter (fun i => i < k) = Finset.range (min k q) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, lt_min_iff]
    omega
  rw [hf]
  simp

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rank_leadingRightProjector
proof:
:= by
  have ht : RCLike.re (h.leadingRightProjector k).trace = (min k q : ℕ) := by
    rw [IsSVD.leadingRightProjector, singularDirectionProjector, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
      h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_diagonal, map_sum]
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, apply_ite, RCLike.one_re, RCLike.zero_re] using
      sum_fin_prefix_indicator q k
  rw [trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ (h.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k),
    RCLike.natCast_re] at ht
  rw [h.card_right]
  exact_mod_cast ht

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rank_leadingRightProjector_of_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.rank_leadingRightProjector, min_eq_left hk]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mul_leadingRightProjector_eq_truncatedMatrix
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSVD.leadingRightProjector, singularDirectionProjector]
  conv_lhs => lhs; rw [h.eq]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V, h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hd : (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin q => if decide ((j : ℕ) < k) then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) =
      rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then singularValues A i else 0) := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, decide_eq_true_eq]
    by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
    · rw [if_pos hij, if_pos hij, ← hij]
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
      · simp only [if_pos hi, mul_one]
      · simp only [if_neg hi, mul_zero, RCLike.ofReal_zero]
    · simp only [if_neg hij, zero_mul]
  change U * ((rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) *
    ((Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin q => if decide ((j : ℕ) < k) then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) * Vᴴ)) = _
  simpa only [IsSVD.truncatedMatrix, Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun M => U * M * Vᴴ) hd

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_sub_mul_leadingRightProjector
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.mul_leadingRightProjector_eq_truncatedMatrix]
  exact h.frobSq_sub_truncatedMatrix k

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_mul_le_leadingRightProjector
statement:
theorem IsSVD.frobSq_mul_le_leadingRightProjector {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) (k : ℕ)
    {P : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (hr : P.rank ≤ k) :
    frobSq (A * P) ≤ frobSq (A * h.leadingRightProjector k)
proof:
:= by
  have hPyth := frobSq_mul_projector_add_complement hs hp A
  have hLead := frobSq_mul_projector_add_complement (h.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian k)
    (h.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k) A
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one] at hPyth hLead
  rw [h.frobSq_sub_mul_leadingRightProjector] at hLead
  have hBest := bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le A (A * P) k
    ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_right A P).trans hr)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.re_trace_mul_gram_le_leadingRightProjector
statement:
theorem IsSVD.re_trace_mul_gram_le_leadingRightProjector {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) (k : ℕ)
    {P : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (hr : P.rank ≤ k) :
    RCLike.re (P * (Aᴴ * A)).trace ≤
      RCLike.re (h.leadingRightProjector k * (Aᴴ * A)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_mul_projector_eq_re_trace_mul hs hp A,
    ← frobSq_mul_projector_eq_re_trace_mul (h.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian k)
      (h.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k) A]
  exact h.frobSq_mul_le_leadingRightProjector k hs hp hr

name: NLAlib.exists_rank_projector_maximizing_gram_trace
statement:
theorem exists_rank_projector_maximizing_gram_trace (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    ∃ P : Matrix n n 𝕜, P.IsHermitian ∧ IsIdempotentElem P ∧ P.rank = k ∧
      ∀ Q : Matrix n n 𝕜, Q.IsHermitian → IsIdempotentElem Q → Q.rank = k →
        RCLike.re (Q * (Aᴴ * A)).trace ≤ RCLike.re (P * (Aᴴ * A)).trace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  refine ⟨h.leadingRightProjector k, h.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian k,
    h.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k, h.rank_leadingRightProjector_of_le hk, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ hQQ hRank
  exact h.re_trace_mul_gram_le_leadingRightProjector k hQ hQQ hRank.le

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.range_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.range_eigenvalues₀ [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : Set.range hA.eigenvalues₀ = Set.range hA.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  have h : hA.eigenvalues = hA.eigenvalues₀ ∘ (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm :=
    rfl
  rw [h, (Equiv.surjective _).range_comp]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : lambdaMax A = hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMax, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hA.range_eigenvalues₀]
  refine IsGreatest.csSup_eq ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone (Nat.zero_le (i : ℕ))

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_eq_eigenvalues₀_last
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMin, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hA.range_eigenvalues₀]
  refine IsLeast.csInf_eq ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt i.isLt)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: NLAlib.nonempty_unitSphere
statement:
theorem nonempty_unitSphere [Nonempty n] :
    Nonempty {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty n›
  refine ⟨⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [show (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single i (1 : 𝕜)) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) = EuclideanSpace.single i 1
    from rfl, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one]

name: NLAlib.isEmpty_unitSphere
statement:
theorem isEmpty_unitSphere [IsEmpty n] :
    IsEmpty {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1}
proof:
:= ⟨fun x => by
  have h := x.2
  rw [Subsingleton.elim x.1 0, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero] at h
  exact zero_ne_one h⟩

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_iInf [DecidableEq n] {M : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hM : M.IsHermitian) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    hM.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hn⟩ =
      ⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1}, RCLike.re (star x.1 ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x.1))
proof:
:= by
  set e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  set k : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hn⟩
  have hmin : ∀ i, hM.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ hM.eigenvalues i := fun i =>
    hM.eigenvalues₀_antitone (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (e.symm i).isLt)
  
  set U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := (hM.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)
  have hUU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    simpa [U, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hM.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hD : Uᴴ * M * U = Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hM.eigenvalues) := by
    have h := hM.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
    simpa [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, U, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using h
  have hUy : ∀ x : n → 𝕜, U *ᵥ (Uᴴ *ᵥ x) = x := fun x => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hUU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hquad : ∀ x : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)) =
      ∑ i, hM.eigenvalues i * ‖(Uᴴ *ᵥ x) i‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) =
        ∑ i, (hM.eigenvalues i : 𝕜) * (star ((Uᴴ *ᵥ x) i) * (Uᴴ *ᵥ x) i) := by
      calc star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) = star (U *ᵥ (Uᴴ *ᵥ x)) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ (U *ᵥ (Uᴴ *ᵥ x))) := by
            rw [hUy]
        _ = star (Uᴴ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((Uᴴ * M * U) *ᵥ (Uᴴ *ᵥ x)) := by
            rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
              Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
        _ = _ := by
            rw [hD]
            simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Function.comp_apply, Pi.star_apply]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    rw [h1, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul,
      RCLike.ofReal_re]
  have hnorm : ∀ x : n → 𝕜, ∑ i, ‖(Uᴴ *ᵥ x) i‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [← EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 (Uᴴ *ᵥ x)), norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hUU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hlow : ∀ x : n → 𝕜, hM.eigenvalues₀ k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)) := by
    intro x
    rw [hquad, ← hnorm, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hmin i) (sq_nonneg _)
  
  set v : n → 𝕜 := ⇑(hM.eigenvectorBasis (e k))
  have hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := by
    rw [show (WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) = hM.eigenvectorBasis (e k) from rfl]
    exact hM.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 (e k)
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} =>
      RCLike.re (star x.1 ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x.1))) :=
    ⟨hM.eigenvalues₀ k, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; simpa [x.2] using hlow x.1⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : Nonempty {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} := ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
    exact le_ciInf fun x => by simpa [x.2] using hlow x.1
  · refine (ciInf_le hbdd ⟨v, hv⟩).trans_eq ?_
    show RCLike.re (star v ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v)) = _
    rw [hM.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis, dotProduct_smul, RCLike.smul_re, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
      hv, one_pow, mul_one]
    simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, k]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem singularValues_last_eq_iInf [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) =
      ⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1}, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have hE := isEmpty_unitSphere (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n)
    rw [Real.iInf_of_isEmpty, singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A
      (by simp)]
  · have hn' : 0 < Fintype.card n := Fintype.card_pos
    have hq : ∀ x : n → 𝕜, RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ ((Aᴴ * A) *ᵥ x)) =
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 := fun x => by
      rw [← star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
    have hsq : singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 =
        ⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1}, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hn'⟩
      rw [(Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues₀_last_eq_iInf hn'] at h
      simp_rw [hq] at h
      exact h
    have hne : Nonempty {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} := nonempty_unitSphere
    have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} =>
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ ^ 2) := ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; positivity⟩
    calc singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1)
        = Real.sqrt (singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2) :=
          (Real.sqrt_sq (singularValues_nonneg A _)).symm
      _ = Real.sqrt (⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1},
            ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ ^ 2) := by rw [hsq]
      _ = ⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1},
            Real.sqrt (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ ^ 2) :=
          Monotone.map_ciInf_of_continuousAt Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt
            (fun _ _ h => Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h) hbdd
      _ = _ := iInf_congr fun x => Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_le_norm_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun y : {y : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1} =>
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ y.1)‖) := ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩
  rw [singularValues_last_eq_iInf]
  exact ciInf_le hbdd (⟨x, hx⟩ : {y : n → 𝕜 // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1})

name: NLAlib.le_singularValues_last
proof:
:= by
  rw [singularValues_last_eq_iInf]
  have := nonempty_unitSphere (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n)
  exact le_ciInf fun x => h x.1 x.2

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_mul_norm_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_last_mul_norm_le [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero]; exact norm_nonneg _
  · have hx' : (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) ≠ 0 := fun h => hx ((WithLp.toLp_eq_zero 2).1 h)
    have hpos : 0 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hx'
    set r := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ with hr
    have hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (r⁻¹ • x)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [WithLp.toLp_smul]; exact norm_smul_inv_norm hx'
    have h := singularValues_last_le_norm_mulVec A hu
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv,
      abs_of_pos hpos] at h
    calc singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) * r ≤ r⁻¹ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ * r :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hpos.le
      _ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.sq_singularValues_last_mul_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem sq_singularValues_last_mul_norm_sq_le [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_pow]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A _) (norm_nonneg _))
    (singularValues_last_mul_norm_le A x) 2

name: NLAlib.inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_sum
statement:
theorem inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_sum [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    ⟪v, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) A u⟫
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * A i j * u j
proof:
:= by
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.one_sub_two_mul_mul_specNorm_le_iSup
statement:
theorem one_sub_two_mul_mul_specNorm_le_iSup [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (I : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ n × EuclideanSpace ℝ m))
    (hI : ∀ t ∈ I, ‖t.2‖ = 1)
    (hcov : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ m), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 →
      ∃ t ∈ I, ‖u - t.1‖ ≤ ε ∧ ‖v - t.2‖ ≤ ε) :
    (1 - 2 * ε) * specNorm A ≤ ⨆ t : I, ∑ i, ∑ j, t.1.2 i * A i j * t.1.1 j
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) A with hΦ
  have hM : specNorm A = ‖Φ‖ := rfl
  set S := ⨆ t : I, ∑ i, ∑ j, t.1.2 i * A i j * t.1.1 j with hS
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun t : I => ∑ i, ∑ j, t.1.2 i * A i j * t.1.1 j) :=
    (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  set M := ‖Φ‖ with hMdef
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := norm_nonneg _
  rw [hM]
  rcases hM0.lt_or_eq with hMpos | hMzero
  · 
    have claim : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r < M → r - 2 * ε * M ≤ S := by
      intro r hr0 hrM
      obtain ⟨x, hx1, hrx⟩ := Φ.exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm hrM
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        simp at hrx
        linarith
      have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hx0
      set u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n := (‖x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • x with hu
      have hu1 : ‖u‖ = 1 := norm_smul_inv_norm hx0
      have hΦu : ‖Φ x‖ ≤ ‖Φ u‖ := by
        rw [hu, map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_norm]
        rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hxpos]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hx1.le
      set w := Φ u with hw
      have hrw : r < ‖w‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hrx hΦu
      have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hrw; linarith
      set v : EuclideanSpace ℝ m := (‖w‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • w with hv
      have hv1 : ‖v‖ = 1 := norm_smul_inv_norm hw0
      have hvw : ⟪v, w⟫ = ‖w‖ := by
        rw [hv, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
        have : ‖w‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hw0
        field_simp
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htu, htv⟩ := hcov u v hu1 hv1
      have ht2 : ‖t.2‖ = 1 := hI t ht
      have hwM : ‖w‖ ≤ M := by
        have := Φ.le_opNorm u; rw [hu1, mul_one] at this; exact this
      have hdecomp : Φ t.1 = w - Φ (u - t.1) := by
        rw [map_sub]; abel
      have hval : ∑ i, ∑ j, t.2 i * A i j * t.1 j = ⟪t.2, Φ t.1⟫ :=
        (inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_sum A t.1 t.2).symm
      have hval2 : ⟪t.2, Φ t.1⟫ = ⟪v, w⟫ - ⟪v - t.2, w⟫ - ⟪t.2, Φ (u - t.1)⟫ := by
        rw [hdecomp, inner_sub_right, inner_sub_left]; ring
      have hb1 : ⟪v - t.2, w⟫ ≤ ε * M := by
        refine (real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans ?_
        exact mul_le_mul htv hwM (norm_nonneg _) hε
      have hb2 : ⟪t.2, Φ (u - t.1)⟫ ≤ ε * M := by
        refine (real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans ?_
        rw [ht2, one_mul]
        refine (Φ.le_opNorm _).trans ?_
        rw [mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htu hM0
      have hle : ∑ i, ∑ j, t.2 i * A i j * t.1 j ≤ S :=
        le_ciSup hbdd (⟨t, ht⟩ : I)
      rw [hval, hval2, hvw] at hle
      linarith
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    set r := (S + 2 * ε * M + M) / 2
    have h1 := claim (max r 0) (le_max_right _ _) (max_lt (by
      simp only [r]; nlinarith) hMpos)
    have : r ≤ max r 0 := le_max_left _ _
    simp only [r] at this
    nlinarith
  · 
    have hA : Φ = 0 := norm_eq_zero.1 hMzero.symm
    have hA' : ∀ t : I, ∑ i, ∑ j, t.1.2 i * A i j * t.1.1 j = 0 := by
      intro t
      rw [← inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_sum, ← hΦ, hA]
      simp
    rw [← hMzero]
    simp only [mul_zero]
    rw [hS]
    simp only [hA', Real.iSup_const_zero, le_refl]

name: NLAlib.exists_iInf_norm_mulVec_le_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
private lemma exists_iInf_norm_mulVec_le_of_norm_eq_one [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) :
    ∃ j : n, (⨅ y : {y : n → ℝ // y j = 1}, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ y.1)‖)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm] at hx ⊢
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_one] at hx
  obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun i => |x i|) Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  
  have hsum : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n * x j ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : x ⬝ᵥ x = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := by simp [dotProduct, sq]
    have h2 : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ _i : n, x j ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
      have := hj i (Finset.mem_univ _)
      rw [← sq_abs (x i), ← sq_abs (x j)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) this 2
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at h2
    linarith
  have hxj : x j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hsum; norm_num at hsum
  have hxa : 0 < |x j| := abs_pos.2 hxj
  
  have hsq : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n) * |x j| := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, ← Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    exact Real.one_le_sqrt.2 hsum
  set y : n → ℝ := (x j)⁻¹ • x with hy
  have hyj : y j = 1 := by simp [hy, hxj]
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun y : {y : n → ℝ // y j = 1} =>
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ y.1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y.1))) :=
    ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩
  refine (ciInf_le hbdd ⟨y, hyj⟩).trans ?_
  show Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) ≤ _
  have hsmul : Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ ((x j)⁻¹ • x)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ((x j)⁻¹ • x))) =
      |(x j)⁻¹| * Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      ← mul_assoc, Real.sqrt_mul (mul_self_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs]
  rw [hy, hsmul, abs_inv]
  set F := Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))
  have hF : 0 ≤ F := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hxa]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_iInf_norm_mulVec_le_of_singularValues_last_le
statement:
theorem exists_iInf_norm_mulVec_le_of_singularValues_last_le [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤ s) :
    ∃ j : n, (⨅ x : {x : n → ℝ // x j = 1}, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n) * s
proof:
:= by
  set D : n → ℝ := fun j =>
    ⨅ x : {x : n → ℝ // x j = 1}, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ with hD
  obtain ⟨j₀, -, hj₀⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ D Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨j₀, ?_⟩
  have hn0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
  
  have hlow : D j₀ / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n) ≤ singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) := by
    refine le_singularValues_last A fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_iInf_norm_mulVec_le_of_norm_eq_one A x hx
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hn0]
    calc D j₀ ≤ D j := hj₀ j (Finset.mem_univ _)
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hj
  have := (div_le_iff₀ hn0).1 (hlow.trans hs)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_le_norm_mul_norm
statement:
private lemma dotProduct_le_norm_mul_norm (v w : m → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ w ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
  rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (dotProduct_self_nonneg v)]
  refine le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_
  rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
  have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ v w
  simpa [dotProduct, sq] using h

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mul_transpose_mulVec
statement:
private lemma dotProduct_mul_transpose_mulVec (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : m → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((A * Aᵀ) *ᵥ x) = (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose]

name: NLAlib.sq_singularValues_last_mul_le
statement:
private lemma sq_singularValues_last_mul_le [DecidableEq n] (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (y : n → ℝ) :
    singularValues B (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y) ≤ (B *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sq_singularValues_last_mul_norm_sq_le B y
  rwa [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at h

name: NLAlib.one_div_le_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose
statement:
private lemma one_div_le_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hM : IsUnit (A * Aᵀ).det) (x : m → ℝ) (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) :
    0 < (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) ∧
      1 / ((Aᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ x)) ≤ specNorm (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  have hx' : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hx, one_pow]
  clear hx
  set M := A * Aᵀ with hM_def
  set q := (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) with hq_def
  have hMinv : M * M⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    rcases (dotProduct_self_nonneg (Aᵀ *ᵥ x)).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have h0 : Aᵀ *ᵥ x = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h.symm
      have h1 : M *ᵥ x = 0 := by rw [hM_def, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h0, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
      have h2 : x = 0 := by
        have : M⁻¹ *ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) = x := by
          rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M hM, Matrix.one_mulVec]
        rw [← this, h1, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
      rw [h2, dotProduct_zero] at hx'
      exact zero_ne_one hx'
  refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
  set w := M⁻¹ *ᵥ x with hw_def
  have hMw : M *ᵥ w = x := by rw [hw_def, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hMinv, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hsym : Mᵀ = M := by rw [hM_def, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hwMx : w ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hsym, hMw, hx']
  have hxMx : x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) = q := dotProduct_mul_transpose_mulVec A x
  set c := 1 / q with hc_def
  have hpsd : 0 ≤ (w - c • x) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ (w - c • x)) := by
    rw [hM_def, dotProduct_mul_transpose_mulVec]; exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hexp : (w - c • x) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ (w - c • x)) = w ⬝ᵥ x - 1 / q := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hMw, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
      dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, hwMx, hxMx, hx', dotProduct_smul]
    rw [hc_def]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hwx : 1 / q ≤ w ⬝ᵥ x := by linarith
  have hCS : w ⬝ᵥ x ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ := by
    have := dotProduct_le_norm_mul_norm w x
    rwa [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm x, hx', Real.sqrt_one, mul_one] at this
  have hop : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ≤ ‖M⁻¹‖ := by
    have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec M⁻¹ (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
    rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm x, hx', Real.sqrt_one, mul_one] at h
    exact h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.isUnit_and_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_le
statement:
private lemma isUnit_and_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1)) :
    IsUnit (A * Aᵀ).det ∧
      specNorm (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 / singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  set M := A * Aᵀ with hM_def
  set s := singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1) with hs_def
  have hs2 : 0 < s ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hlow : ∀ y : m → ℝ, s ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y) ≤ y ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ y) := fun y => by
    rw [hM_def, dotProduct_mul_transpose_mulVec]; exact sq_singularValues_last_mul_le Aᵀ y
  have hunit : IsUnit M.det := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.2 hdet
    have h1 := hlow v
    rw [hv, dotProduct_zero] at h1
    have h2 : v ⬝ᵥ v = 0 := le_antisymm (by nlinarith [dotProduct_self_nonneg v])
      (dotProduct_self_nonneg v)
    exact hv0 (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h2)
  refine ⟨hunit, ?_⟩
  have hMinv : M * M⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hunit
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) fun y => ?_
  show ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanLin M⁻¹ y)‖ ≤ 1 / s ^ 2 * ‖y‖
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct]
  have hT : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M⁻¹ y).ofLp = M⁻¹ *ᵥ y.ofLp := rfl
  rw [hT]
  set w := M⁻¹ *ᵥ y.ofLp with hw_def
  set yy := y.ofLp with hyy
  have hMw : M *ᵥ w = yy := by rw [hw_def, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hMinv, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h1 := hlow w
  rw [hMw] at h1
  have h2 := dotProduct_le_norm_mul_norm w yy
  rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, ← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm] at h2
  set a := Real.sqrt (w ⬝ᵥ w)
  set b := Real.sqrt (yy ⬝ᵥ yy)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have haa : a ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ w := Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
  have h3 : s ^ 2 * a ^ 2 ≤ a * b := by rw [haa]; linarith
  have h4 : s ^ 2 * a ≤ b := by
    rcases ha.lt_or_eq with hapos | ha0
    · nlinarith
    · rw [← ha0, mul_zero]; exact hb
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, le_div_iff₀ hs2]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_eq
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit (A * Aᵀ)) :
    specNorm (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹ = 1 / singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsUnit (A * Aᵀ).det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 hA
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with hr | hr
  · have h1 : (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [h1, specNorm_zero, singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le Aᵀ
      (by simp)]
    simp
  · have hne := nonempty_unitSphere (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := m)
    set N := specNorm (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹ with hN_def
    have x0 := hne.some
    have hNpos : 0 < N := by
      obtain ⟨hq, hle⟩ := one_div_le_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose A hM x0.1 x0.2
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hle
    have hlow : 1 / Real.sqrt N ≤ singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1) := by
      refine le_singularValues_last _ fun x hx => ?_
      obtain ⟨hq, hle⟩ := one_div_le_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose A hM x hx
      have h1 : 1 / N ≤ (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ x) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hNpos]; rw [div_le_iff₀ hq] at hle; linarith
      have h2 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      rwa [Real.sqrt_div' _ hNpos.le, Real.sqrt_one, sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm] at h2
    have hs : 0 < singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hlow
    have hup := (isUnit_and_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_le A hs).2
    apply le_antisymm hup
    have h1 : 1 / N ≤ singularValues Aᵀ (Fintype.card m - 1) ^ 2 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hlow 2
      rwa [div_pow, one_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hNpos.le] at this
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hNpos] at h1
    linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pinvR_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_pinvR_sq [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit (A * Aᵀ)) :
    specNorm (pinvR A) ^ 2 = specNorm (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm pinvR
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  have hsym : (A * Aᵀ)ᵀ = A * Aᵀ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have key : (Aᵀ * (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹)ᴴ * (Aᵀ * (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹) = (A * Aᵀ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hsym, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc A, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 hA),
      Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [sq, ← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, key]

name: NLAlib.exists_isolated_eigenvector_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_isolated_eigenvector_similarity {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K} {μ : K}
    (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y) (hpair : y ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (S : Matrix n n K) (i : n), IsUnit S ∧ Matrix.col S i = x ∧
      (∀ j, S⁻¹ i j = y j / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) ∧
      (∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) j i = if j = i then μ else 0) ∧
      (∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = if j = i then μ else 0) ∧
      (y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y =
        S * Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i 1) * S⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ℓ : (n → K) →ₗ[K] K :=
    { toFun z := y ⬝ᵥ z
      map_add' _ _ := dotProduct_add _ _ _
      map_smul' c z := by rw [dotProduct_smul]; rfl }
  obtain ⟨s, b, j, hx, hcoord⟩ := exists_basis_of_pairing_ne_zero (f := ℓ) (v := x) hpair
  let : Fintype s := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
  have hcard : Fintype.card s = Fintype.card n := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
  let e : s ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard
  let c : Basis n K (n → K) := b.reindex e
  let i : n := e j
  let p := Pi.basisFun K n
  let S : Matrix n n K := p.toMatrix c
  let : Invertible S := Basis.invertibleToMatrix p c
  have hS : IsUnit S := isUnit_of_invertible S
  have hci : c i = x := by
    simpa only [c, i, Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hx.symm
  have hcol : Matrix.col S i = x := by
    funext k
    simpa only [S, p, Matrix.col_apply, Basis.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basisFun_repr] using congrFun hci k
  have hℓ : ℓ = (y ⬝ᵥ x) • c.coord i := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hcoord z
    simpa only [LinearMap.smul_apply, ℓ, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
      Basis.coord_apply, c, i, Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h
  have hSinv : S⁻¹ = c.toMatrix p :=
    Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv (Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip c p)
  have hrow (k : n) : S⁻¹ i k = y k / (y ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hℓ (p k)
    have hval : y k = (y ⬝ᵥ x) * (c.repr (p k) i) := by
      simpa only [ℓ, p, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Pi.basisFun_apply, dotProduct_single,
        mul_one, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Basis.coord_apply] using h
    rw [hSinv, Basis.toMatrix_apply]
    apply (eq_div_iff hpair).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hval.symm
  have hM : S⁻¹ * A * S = A.toLin'.toMatrix c c := by
    have hstd : A.toLin'.toMatrix p p = A := by
      simpa only [p, Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin'] using LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin p p A
    rw [hSinv]
    nth_rw 1 [← hstd]
    exact basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix c p c p A.toLin'
  have hright (k : n) : (S⁻¹ * A * S) k i = if k = i then μ else 0 := by
    rw [hM, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, hci, Matrix.toLin'_apply, hAx,
      map_smul, ← hci, c.repr_self]
    simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite,
      mul_one, mul_zero, eq_comm]
  have hleft (z : n → K) : c.coord i (A *ᵥ z) = μ * c.coord i z := by
    have h : ℓ (A *ᵥ z) = μ * ℓ z := by
      change y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z) = μ * (y ⬝ᵥ z)
      rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hyA, smul_dotProduct]
      rfl
    rw [hℓ, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hpair
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have htop (k : n) : (S⁻¹ * A * S) i k = if k = i then μ else 0 := by
    rw [hM, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change c.coord i (A *ᵥ c k) = _
    rw [hleft, Basis.coord_apply, c.repr_self]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨S, i, hS, hcol, hrow, hright, htop, ?_⟩
  ext k l
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
    ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, hrow]
  have hkl : S k i = x k := congrFun hcol k
  rw [hkl]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
statement:
theorem forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (N : Set ℝ) {η C δ ε : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hcover : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε)
    (hcmp : ∀ u ∈ N,
      specNorm (resolvent A ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)) ≤
        C*specNorm (resolvent B ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ)
    (herror : δ+(C+1)*ε/η^2 ≤ (2*η)⁻¹) :
    ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∃ β ∈ spectrum ℝ B, dist ξ β ≤ 2*C*η
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ hξ
  have hn : Nonempty n := by
    obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ hξ
    exact ⟨i⟩
  let := hn
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hdist⟩ := hcover ξ hξ
  have hleft := hA.isSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_resolvent_real_sub_le ξ u hη.ne'
  have hright := hB.isSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_resolvent_real_sub_le u ξ hη.ne'
  simp only [← specNorm_eq_norm, abs_sub_comm u ξ] at hleft hright
  have hdist' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdist (sq_nonneg η)
  have hleft' := (le_abs_self _).trans (hleft.trans hdist')
  have hright' := (le_abs_self _).trans (hright.trans hdist')
  have hgrid := hcmp u hu
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright' hC
  apply exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison hA hB hξ hη herror
  rw [show δ+(C+1)*ε/η^2 = δ+ε/η^2+C*(ε/η^2) by ring]
  linear_combination hleft' + hgrid + hmul

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_embedding_posDef_gram_sub_singularTail
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_posDef_gram_sub_singularTail
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {k r : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkr : k < r) (hr : r ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ n,
      ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e -
        (((r - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1) /
          (2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * r)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hrl : r - 1 < A.rank := by omega
  have hkl : k ≤ r - 1 := by omega
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by omega
  have hnpos : 0 < Fintype.card n := hrpos.trans_le (hr.trans A.rank_le_card_width)
  have hE : 0 < bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1) := bestRankFrobSq_pos_of_lt_rank A hrl
  let T : ℝ := (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * r / bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1)
  have hT : 0 < T := by dsimp [T]; positivity
  obtain ⟨e, hePos, heTrace⟩ := exists_column_embedding_posDef_gram_trace_inv_le_tail A (r - 1) hrl
  let C := A.submatrix id e
  let G := Cᵀ * C
  have hTrace : G⁻¹.trace ≤ T := by
    apply heTrace.trans
    dsimp [T]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hE.le
    have hleft : (r - 1 : ℕ) ≤ r := Nat.sub_le _ _
    have hright : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) - (r - 1 : ℕ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (r - 1) (α := ℝ)]
    have hright0 : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) - (r - 1 : ℕ) := by
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr ((Nat.sub_le r 1).trans (hr.trans A.rank_le_card_width)))
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hleft) hright0).trans
      (by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright (Nat.cast_nonneg r)])
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_embedding_posDef_sub_smul_one_of_trace_inv_le G hePos hkl hT hTrace
  let s : Fin k ↪ n := ⟨fun i => e (f i), e.injective.comp f.injective⟩
  have hGram : G.submatrix f f = (A.submatrix id s)ᵀ * A.submatrix id s := by
    ext i j
    simp only [G, C, s, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, id_eq]
  have hNat : r - 1 - k + 1 = r - k := by omega
  have hscale : ((r - 1 - k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * T) =
      ((r - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1) /
        (2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * r) := by
    rw [hNat]
    dsimp [T]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  rwa [hGram, hscale] at hf

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.column_embedding_posDef_to_finset
statement:
private theorem column_embedding_posDef_to_finset
    {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (e : Fin k ↪ n) (b : ℝ)
    (hPos : ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e -
      b • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).PosDef) :
    ∃ S : Finset n, S.card = k ∧
      ((A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)))ᵀ * A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)) -
        b • (1 : Matrix S S ℝ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := Finset.univ.image e
  let f₀ : Fin k → S := fun j => ⟨e j, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f₀ := by
    constructor
    · intro i j hij
      exact e.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hij)
    · intro i
      obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp i.property
      exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩
  let f := Equiv.ofBijective f₀ hf
  have hval (i : S) : e (f.symm i) = (i : n) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (f.apply_symm_apply i)
  have heq :
      (((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e - b • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).submatrix
        f.symm f.symm) =
      (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)))ᵀ * A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)) -
        b • (1 : Matrix S S ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
    have hId := congrArg (fun P : Matrix S S ℝ => P i j)
      (Matrix.submatrix_one f.symm f.symm.injective (α := ℝ))
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply] at hId
    rw [hId]
    congr 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, hval]
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [S]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  · exact heq ▸ hPos.submatrix f.symm.injective

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_tail
statement:
theorem exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_tail
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {k r : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkr : k < r) (hr : r ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ S : Finset n, S.card = k ∧
      ∃ hA : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)))),
        ‖inverseOnRange (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n))) hA‖ ≤
          2 * singularTailInverseScale A k r
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ := ((r - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1) /
    (2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * r)
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by omega
  have hnpos : 0 < Fintype.card n := hrpos.trans_le (hr.trans A.rank_le_card_width)
  have hE : 0 < bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1) := bestRankFrobSq_pos_of_lt_rank A (by omega)
  have hdiff : 0 < r - k := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hkr
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_embedding_posDef_gram_sub_singularTail A hk hkr hr
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hPos⟩ := column_embedding_posDef_to_finset A e b he
  let C := A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n))
  have hGram : (Cᵀ * C).PosDef := by
    have hh := hPos.add (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hb)
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hh
  let hC := injective_toEuclideanLin_of_posDef_gram C hGram
  refine ⟨S, hS, hC, (norm_inverseOnRange_le_of_posDef_gram_sub C hC hb hPos).trans ?_⟩
  have hscale : 1 / b = 2 * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * r /
      ((r - k : ℕ) * bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1))) := by
    dsimp [b]
    field_simp
  have hnon : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * r /
      ((r - k : ℕ) * bestRankFrobSq A (r - 1)) := by positivity
  calc
    1 / Real.sqrt b = Real.sqrt (1 / b) := by
      symm
      simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using Real.sqrt_div (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) b
    _ = Real.sqrt 2 * singularTailInverseScale A k r := by
      rw [hscale, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
      rfl
    _ ≤ 2 * singularTailInverseScale A k r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (by nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)])
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_singularTail
statement:
theorem exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_singularTail
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkrank : k < A.rank) :
    ∃ S : Finset n, S.card = k ∧
      ∃ hA : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)))),
        ∀ r : ℕ, k < r → r ≤ A.rank →
          ‖inverseOnRange (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n))) hA‖ ≤
            2 * RestrictedInvertibility.singularTailInverseScale A k r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R : Finset ℕ := Finset.Icc (k + 1) A.rank
  have hR : R.Nonempty := ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hkrank⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image R
    (RestrictedInvertibility.singularTailInverseScale A k) hR
  have hr' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hr
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hA, hbound⟩ :=
    RestrictedInvertibility.exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_tail A hk
      (by omega) hr'.2
  refine ⟨S, hS, hA, ?_⟩
  intro t hkt ht
  exact hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (hmin t (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hkt, ht⟩)) (by norm_num))

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_min_singularTail
statement:
theorem exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_min_singularTail
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkrank : k < A.rank) :
    ∃ S : Finset n, S.card = k ∧
      ∃ hA : Function.Injective (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n)))),
        ‖inverseOnRange (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n))) hA‖ ≤
          2 * (Finset.Icc (k + 1) A.rank).inf'
            (by exact ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hkrank⟩⟩)
            (RestrictedInvertibility.singularTailInverseScale A k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hA, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_finset_card_eq_and_norm_inverseOnRange_le_singularTail A k hk hkrank
  refine ⟨S, hS, hA, ?_⟩
  have hh : ‖inverseOnRange (A.submatrix id (fun i : S => (i : n))) hA‖ / 2 ≤
      (Finset.Icc (k + 1) A.rank).inf'
        (by exact ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hkrank⟩⟩)
        (RestrictedInvertibility.singularTailInverseScale A k) := by
    apply Finset.le_inf' _ _
    intro r hr
    have hr' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hr
    have hh := hbound r (by omega) hr'.2
    linarith
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBases_real_pencil_upper_quasi_triangular
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBases_real_pencil_upper_quasi_triangular
    {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (k : ℕ) (A B : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hE : finrank ℝ E = k) (hF : finrank ℝ F = k) :
    ∃ (e : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℝ E) (f : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℝ F),
      IsUpperQuasiTriangular (A.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis) ∧
      (B.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing E F with
  | zero =>
    let e := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).reindex (finCongr hE)
    let f := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ F).reindex (finCongr hF)
    exact ⟨e, f, ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩, fun {i} => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hB : Function.Injective B
    · let bEquiv := B.linearEquivOfInjective hB (hE.trans hF.symm)
      let T : Module.End ℝ E := bEquiv.symm.toLinearMap.comp A
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_quasi_triangular (k + 1) T hE
      obtain ⟨f, hAf, hBf⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_pencil_of_quasi_basis A bEquiv e hF he
      exact ⟨e, f, hAf, hBf⟩
    · have : Nontrivial E := finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hE]; omega)
      have : Nontrivial F := finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hF]; omega)
      obtain ⟨u, v, a, hu, hv, hAu, hBu⟩ := exists_unit_pencil_image_line_of_not_injective A B hB
      have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hu
      have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hv
      let E' : Submodule ℝ E := (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ
      let F' : Submodule ℝ F := (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ
      have hE' : finrank ℝ E' = k := by
        have h := (ℝ ∙ u).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
        rw [finrank_span_singleton hu0, hE] at h
        dsimp [E']
        omega
      have hF' : finrank ℝ F' = k := by
        have h := (ℝ ∙ v).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
        rw [finrank_span_singleton hv0, hF] at h
        dsimp [F']
        omega
      let comp (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) : E' →ₗ[ℝ] F' :=
        F'.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (L.comp E'.subtype)
      obtain ⟨e', f', hA', hB'⟩ := ih (comp A) (comp B) hE' hF'
      obtain ⟨e, he0, heS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hE u hu e'
      obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hF v hv f'
      have hcol (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (c : ℝ) (hLu : L u = c • v) (i : Fin k) :
          L.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis i.succ 0 = 0 := by
        simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
          OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, he0, hLu,
          hfS, inner_smul_right]
        have hinner : inner ℝ (f' i : F) v = 0 :=
          Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left.mp (f' i).property
        rw [hinner, mul_zero]
      have htail (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
          (L.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
            (comp L).toMatrix e'.toBasis f'.toBasis := by
        ext i j
        simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
          OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
          OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, heS, hfS, comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Submodule.subtype_apply,
          Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left]
      refine ⟨e, f, isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_first_column_and_tail
        (hcol A a hAu) (by rw [htail]; exact hA'), ?_⟩
      intro i j hij
      revert hij
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · intro hij
        have hi : i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hij
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero hi
        exact hcol B 0 (by simpa only [zero_smul] using hBu) i
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
        · intro h; exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _)) h |>.elim
        · intro h
          change ((B.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ) i j = 0
          rw [htail]
          exact hB' (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h)

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_arrowhead_reindex
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_arrowhead_reindex (e : n ≃ m) (d v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ e.symm)) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) (v ∘ e.symm))
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) (v ∘ e.symm)) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.charpoly_reindex (e.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin 1)))
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Function.comp_def]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_reindex
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_reindex (e : n ≃ m) (d v : n → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ e.symm) + Matrix.vecMulVec (v ∘ e.symm) (v ∘ e.symm)).charpoly =
      (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.charpoly_reindex e (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v)]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec,
    Function.comp_def]

name: NLAlib.convexHull_real_finite_eq_Icc
statement:
private theorem convexHull_real_finite_eq_Icc {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hne : s.Nonempty) : convexHull ℝ s = Set.Icc (sInf s) (sSup s)
proof:
:= by
  have hlo := hs.isClosed.csInf_mem hne hs.bddBelow
  have hhi := hs.isClosed.csSup_mem hne hs.bddAbove
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply convexHull_min _ (convex_Icc _ _)
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨csInf_le hs.bddBelow hx, le_csSup hs.bddAbove hx⟩
  · have hle : sInf s ≤ sSup s := csInf_le hs.bddBelow hhi
    rw [← segment_eq_Icc hle, ← convexHull_pair]
    apply convexHull_mono
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hlo
    · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx ▸ hhi

name: NLAlib.re_image_numericalRange_eq_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem re_image_numericalRange_eq_selfAdjointPart (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Complex.re '' numericalRange A =
      Complex.re '' numericalRange (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨quadForm (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [quadForm_selfAdjointPart, Complex.ofReal_re]
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨quadForm A x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [quadForm_selfAdjointPart, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.re_image_numericalRange_eq_Icc
statement:
theorem re_image_numericalRange_eq_Icc [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Complex.re '' numericalRange A =
      Set.Icc (lambdaMin (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ))
        (lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  let H : Matrix n n ℂ := selfAdjointPart ℝ A
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := by
    change (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = _
    exact (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
  have hnormal : H * Hᴴ = Hᴴ * H := by rw [hH.eq]
  rw [re_image_numericalRange_eq_selfAdjointPart]
  change Complex.re '' numericalRange H = _
  rw [numericalRange_eq_convexHull_spectrum_of_normal H hnormal]
  have himage := Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap.image_convexHull (spectrum ℂ H)
  change Complex.re '' convexHull ℝ (spectrum ℂ H) =
    convexHull ℝ (Complex.re '' spectrum ℂ H) at himage
  rw [himage, hH.spectrum_eq_image_range, Set.image_image]
  have hcomp : (fun x : ℝ => (RCLike.ofReal x : ℂ).re) ''
      Set.range hH.eigenvalues = Set.range hH.eigenvalues := by
    ext x
    simp
  change convexHull ℝ ((fun x : ℝ => (RCLike.ofReal x : ℂ).re) ''
    Set.range hH.eigenvalues) = _
  rw [hcomp]
  rw [convexHull_real_finite_eq_Icc (Set.finite_range _) (Set.range_nonempty _)]
  change Set.Icc (sInf (Set.range hH.eigenvalues)) (sSup (Set.range hH.eigenvalues)) =
    Set.Icc (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H)
  rw [lambdaMin, lambdaMax, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]

name: NLAlib.gershgorinRowRadius_nonneg
statement:
theorem gershgorinRowRadius_nonneg (A : Matrix n n K) (i : n) :
    0 ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i
proof: := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => norm_nonneg (A i j)

name: NLAlib.diagonal_mem_gershgorinRowDisc
statement:
theorem diagonal_mem_gershgorinRowDisc (A : Matrix n n K) (i : n) :
    A i i ∈ gershgorinRowDisc A i
proof:
:= by
  change dist (A i i) (A i i) ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i
  rw [dist_self]
  exact gershgorinRowRadius_nonneg A i

name: NLAlib.mem_gershgorinRowUnion_of_mem
proof: := Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hi, hz⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.isCompact_gershgorinRowUnion
statement:
theorem isCompact_gershgorinRowUnion [ProperSpace K] (A : Matrix n n K) (I : Finset n) :
    IsCompact (gershgorinRowUnion A I)
proof:
:=
  I.finite_toSet.isCompact_biUnion fun i _ => isCompact_closedBall (A i i) (gershgorinRowRadius A i)

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum {A : Matrix n n K} {μ : K}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum K A) : ∃ i, μ ∈ gershgorinRowDisc A i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ

    ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hAx, hx⟩)

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_gershgorinColumnDisc_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_mem_gershgorinColumnDisc_of_mem_spectrum {A : Matrix n n K} {μ : K}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum K A) : ∃ i, μ ∈ gershgorinColumnDisc A i
proof:
:= by

  simpa only [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_transpose] using hμ

name: NLAlib.matrix_pow_mul_eq_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem matrix_pow_mul_eq_of_mul_eq {K : Type*} [Semiring K]
    (T P : Matrix ι ι K) (hTP : T * P = P) (k : ℕ) : T ^ k * P = P
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_assoc, hTP, ih]

name: NLAlib.matrix_sub_projector_pow_succ
statement:
theorem matrix_sub_projector_pow_succ {K : Type*} [Ring K]
    (T P : Matrix ι ι K) (hPP : P * P = P) (hTP : T * P = P) (hPT : P * T = P)
    (k : ℕ) : (T - P) ^ (k + 1) = T ^ (k + 1) - P
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub,
      matrix_pow_mul_eq_of_mul_eq T P hTP, hPT, hPP, ← pow_succ]
    abel

name: NLAlib.tendsto_matrix_pow_projector_of_deflated_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_matrix_pow_projector_of_deflated_spectralRadius_lt_one
    (T P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hPP : P * P = P) (hTP : T * P = P) (hPT : P * T = P)
    (hρ : spectralRadius ℂ ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal) < 1) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => T ^ k) atTop (𝓝 P)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := (tendsto_real_matrix_pow_zero_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one (T - P)).mpr hρ
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (T - P) ^ k + P) atTop (𝓝 P) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hzero.add_const P
  apply hlim.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with k hk
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  rw [show j.succ = j + 1 from rfl, matrix_sub_projector_pow_succ T P hPP hTP hPT]
  exact sub_add_cancel _ _

name: NLAlib.exists_specNorm_matrix_pow_sub_projector_le_geometric
statement:
theorem exists_specNorm_matrix_pow_sub_projector_le_geometric
    (T P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hPP : P * P = P) (hTP : T * P = P) (hPT : P * T = P)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : (spectralRadius ℂ ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < θ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, specNorm (T ^ k - P) ≤ C * θ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans_lt hθ
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_specNorm_real_matrix_pow_le_complex_spectralRadius_add
    (T - P) (sub_pos.mpr hθ)
  have hN' (k : ℕ) : specNorm ((T - P) ^ k) ≤
      matrixPowerBoundConstant ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal) θ N * θ ^ k := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hN k
  let c := matrixPowerBoundConstant ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal) θ N
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := zero_le_one.trans (one_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant _ hθpos N)
  refine ⟨specNorm (1 - P) + c, add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) hc, fun k => ?_⟩
  cases k with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right hc
  | succ k =>
    rw [← matrix_sub_projector_pow_succ T P hPP hTP hPT]
    exact (hN' _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg hθpos.le _))

name: NLAlib.charpolyRootCountIn_gershgorinRowUnion_eq_card
statement:
theorem charpolyRootCountIn_gershgorinRowUnion_eq_card
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (I : Finset n)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (gershgorinRowUnion A I) (gershgorinRowUnion A Iᶜ)) :
    charpolyRootCountIn A (gershgorinRowUnion A I) = I.card
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  let : PreconnectedSpace Ω := isPreconnected_iff_preconnectedSpace.mp isPreconnected_Icc
  let H : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ := fun t =>
    Matrix.diagonal A.diag + (t.val : ℂ) • (A - Matrix.diagonal A.diag)
  have hH : Continuous H := by fun_prop
  have hdiag (t : Ω) (i : n) : H t i i = A i i := by
    simp only [H, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.diag_apply, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hradius (t : Ω) (i : n) : gershgorinRowRadius (H t) i = t.val * gershgorinRowRadius A i := by
    dsimp only [gershgorinRowRadius]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hij : i ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1.symm
    simp only [H, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, zero_add, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg t.property.1]
  have hspec (t : Ω) : spectrum ℂ (H t) ⊆ gershgorinRowUnion A I ∪ gershgorinRowUnion A Iᶜ := by
    intro μ hμ
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum hμ
    have hmem : μ ∈ gershgorinRowDisc A i := by
      change dist μ (H t i i) ≤ gershgorinRowRadius (H t) i at hi
      rw [hdiag, hradius] at hi
      exact hi.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (gershgorinRowRadius_nonneg A i) t.property.2)
    by_cases hiI : i ∈ I
    · exact Or.inl (mem_gershgorinRowUnion_of_mem hiI hmem)
    · exact Or.inr (mem_gershgorinRowUnion_of_mem (Finset.mem_compl.mpr hiI) hmem)
  let t₀ : Ω := ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  let t₁ : Ω := ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hH₀ : H t₀ = Matrix.diagonal A.diag := by simp [H, t₀]
  have hH₁ : H t₁ = A := by simp [H, t₁]
  have hcount := charpolyRootCountIn_eq_of_preconnected H hH
    (gershgorinRowUnion A I) (gershgorinRowUnion A Iᶜ)
