    (isCompact_gershgorinRowUnion A I) (isCompact_gershgorinRowUnion A Iᶜ) hdisj hspec t₁ t₀
  rw [hH₁, hH₀] at hcount
  rw [hcount, charpolyRootCountIn_eq_card_filter _ _ A.diag (Matrix.charpoly_diagonal A.diag)]
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : n => A.diag i ∈ gershgorinRowUnion A I) = I := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro i
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Matrix.diag_apply]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      by_contra hiI
      have hL : A i i ∈ gershgorinRowUnion A Iᶜ :=
        mem_gershgorinRowUnion_of_mem (Finset.mem_compl.mpr hiI) (diagonal_mem_gershgorinRowDisc A i)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hi hL
    · intro hi
      exact mem_gershgorinRowUnion_of_mem hi (diagonal_mem_gershgorinRowDisc A i)
  rw [hfilter]

name: NLAlib.charpolyRootCountIn_gershgorinColumnUnion_eq_card
statement:
theorem charpolyRootCountIn_gershgorinColumnUnion_eq_card
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (I : Finset n)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (gershgorinColumnUnion A I) (gershgorinColumnUnion A Iᶜ)) :
    charpolyRootCountIn A (gershgorinColumnUnion A I) = I.card
proof:
:= by
  have h := charpolyRootCountIn_gershgorinRowUnion_eq_card Aᵀ I hdisj
  unfold charpolyRootCountIn at h ⊢
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_transpose] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.IsHurwitz.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one
statement:
theorem IsHurwitz.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsHurwitz A)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) : IsUnit (A - (p : ℂ) • 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : (p : ℂ) ∉ spectrum ℂ A := by
    intro h
    have := hA _ h
    simpa using (not_lt_of_ge hp.le this)
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℂ) - A) :=
    not_not.mp (fun h => hnot h)
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, neg_sub] using hu.neg

name: NLAlib.cayleyTransform_eq_one_add
statement:
theorem cayleyTransform_eq_one_add {K : Type*} [RCLike K] (A : Matrix n n K) (p : ℝ)
    (h : IsUnit (A - (p : K) • 1).det) :
    cayleyTransform A p = 1 + (2 * (p : K)) • (A - (p : K) • 1)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have heq : A + (p : K) • (1 : Matrix n n K) =
      (A - (p : K) • 1) + (2 * (p : K)) • 1 := by module
  rw [cayleyTransform, heq, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ h]
  simp

name: NLAlib.norm_cayley_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_cayley_lt_one {z : ℂ} (hz : z.re < 0) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ‖(z + (p : ℂ)) / (z - (p : ℂ))‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : z - (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] at hr
    linarith
  rw [norm_div, div_lt_one (norm_pos_iff.mpr hd)]
  have hs : ‖z + (p : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 < ‖z - (p : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_add, Complex.normSq_sub,
      Complex.normSq_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z + (p : ℂ)), norm_nonneg (z - (p : ℂ))]

name: NLAlib.spectrum_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem spectrum_cayleyTransform (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (h : IsUnit (A - (p : ℂ) • 1)) :
    spectrum ℂ (cayleyTransform A p) =
      (fun z : ℂ => (z + (p : ℂ)) / (z - (p : ℂ))) '' spectrum ℂ A
proof:
:= by
  let u := h.unit
  have huval : (u : Matrix n n ℂ) = A - (p : ℂ) • 1 := h.unit_spec
  have huinv : (A - (p : ℂ) • 1)⁻¹ = (↑u⁻¹ : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [← huval]
    exact u.val_inv
  have hinv : spectrum ℂ (A - (p : ℂ) • 1)⁻¹ =
      (spectrum ℂ (A - (p : ℂ) • 1))⁻¹ := by
    rw [huinv, ← spectrum.map_inv u, huval]
  have hscale : (2 * (p : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hp)
  have hshift : spectrum ℂ (A - (p : ℂ) • 1) = spectrum ℂ A - {(p : ℂ)} := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using (spectrum.sub_singleton_eq A (p : ℂ)).symm
  rw [cayleyTransform_eq_one_add A p ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h)]
  change spectrum ℂ (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) 1 +
    (Units.mk0 (2 * (p : ℂ)) hscale) • (A - (p : ℂ) • 1)⁻¹) = _
  rw [← spectrum.singleton_add_eq, spectrum.unit_smul_eq_smul _ (Units.mk0 _ hscale),
    hinv, hshift]
  have hden (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : z - (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    have hm : z - (p : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - (p : ℂ) • 1) := by
      rw [hshift]
      exact ⟨z, hz, (p : ℂ), rfl, rfl⟩
    intro heq
    rw [heq] at hm
    exact spectrum.zero_notMem ℂ h hm
  ext w
  simp only [Set.mem_add, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_smul_set, Set.mem_inv,
    Set.mem_sub, Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, rfl, v, ⟨v', ⟨z, hz, _, rfl, hzv⟩, hvinv⟩, hvw⟩
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    have hv' : v' = (z - (p : ℂ))⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [inv_inv] using (congrArg Inv.inv hzv).symm
    rw [← hvw, ← hvinv, hv']
    change (z + (p : ℂ)) / (z - (p : ℂ)) = 1 + (2 * (p : ℂ)) * (z - (p : ℂ))⁻¹
    field_simp [hden z hz]
    ring
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨1, rfl, (Units.mk0 (2 * (p : ℂ)) hscale) • (z - (p : ℂ))⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨(z - (p : ℂ))⁻¹, ⟨z, hz, (p : ℂ), rfl, by simp⟩, rfl⟩
    · change 1 + (2 * (p : ℂ)) * (z - (p : ℂ))⁻¹ = (z + (p : ℂ)) / (z - (p : ℂ))
      field_simp [hden z hz]
      ring

name: NLAlib.IsHurwitz.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one
statement:
theorem IsHurwitz.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsHurwitz A) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) : spectralRadius ℂ (cayleyTransform A p) < 1
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz : cayleyTransform A p = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, spectrum.spectralRadius_zero]
    exact zero_lt_one
  | inr hn =>
    apply spectrum.spectralRadius_lt_of_forall_lt_of_nonempty
      (spectrum.nonempty (cayleyTransform A p))
    intro μ hμ
    rw [spectrum_cayleyTransform A p hp.ne' (hA.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one p hp)] at hμ
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hμ
    exact_mod_cast norm_cayley_lt_one (hA z hz) p hp

name: NLAlib.submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_of_isolated_coordinate
statement:
theorem submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_of_isolated_coordinate (M : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (μ : K)
    (hcol : ∀ j, M j i = if j = i then μ else 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j, M i j = if j = i then μ else 0) :
    M.submatrix (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)) (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : {j : n // j = i} => μ)) 0 0
        (M.submatrix (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val) (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Unique {j : n // j = i} := ⟨⟨⟨i, rfl⟩⟩, fun j => Subtype.ext j.property⟩
  ext a b
  cases a with
  | inl a =>
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      change M a.val b.val = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : {j : n // j = i} => μ) a b
      rw [a.property, b.property, hcol]
      simp only [ite_true, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Subsingleton.elim a b, ite_true]
    | inr b =>
      change M a.val b.val = 0
      rw [a.property, hrow]
      exact if_neg b.property
  | inr a =>
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      change M a.val b.val = 0
      rw [b.property, hcol]
      exact if_neg a.property
    | inr b => rfl

name: NLAlib.submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_scalar_row_col
statement:
theorem submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_scalar_row_col (F : Matrix n n K) (i : n) :
    F.submatrix (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)) (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : {j : n // j = i} => F i i))
        (Matrix.replicateRow {j : n // j = i} (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => F i j.val))
        (Matrix.replicateCol {j : n // j = i} (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => F j.val i))
        (F.submatrix (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val) (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Unique {j : n // j = i} := ⟨⟨⟨i, rfl⟩⟩, fun j => Subtype.ext j.property⟩
  ext a b
  cases a with
  | inl a =>
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      change F a.val b.val = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : {j : n // j = i} => F i i) a b
      rw [a.property, b.property]
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Subsingleton.elim a b, ite_true]
    | inr b =>
      change F a.val b.val = F i b.val
      rw [a.property]
  | inr a =>
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      change F a.val b.val = F a.val i
      rw [b.property]
    | inr b => rfl

name: NLAlib.charpoly_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_eq
statement:
theorem charpoly_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_eq (A S : Matrix n n K) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    (S⁻¹ * A * S).charpoly = A.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S (S.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hS), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff (A S : Matrix n n K) (hS : IsUnit S) (μ : K) :
    μ ∈ spectrum K (S⁻¹ * A * S) ↔ μ ∈ spectrum K A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly,
    charpoly_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_eq A S hS]

name: NLAlib.nonsing_inv_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct_mulVec_div
statement:
theorem nonsing_inv_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct_mulVec_div
    (S E : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (x y : n → K)
    (hcol : Matrix.col S i = x) (hrow : ∀ j, S⁻¹ i j = y j / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    (S⁻¹ * E * S) i i = (y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  change (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ Matrix.col S i) = _
  rw [hcol]
  have hrowfun : (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) = (y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • y := by
    funext j
    simp only [hrow, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [hrowfun, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hk : 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k) :
    singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * hA.eigenvalues₀ k ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k ∧
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k ≤
      specNorm S ^ 2 * hA.eigenvalues₀ k
proof:
:= by
  have hlo (x : n → ℝ) : singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤
      (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) := by
    have h := sq_singularValues_last_mul_norm_sq_le Sᵀ x
    rwa [singularValues_transpose, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self,
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at h
  have hup (x : n → ℝ) : (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ≤
      specNorm S ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_transpose, dotProduct, pow_two] using sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq Sᵀ x
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le hA k
    have hdim := finrank_le_finrank_comap_endomorphism V Sᵀ.mulVecLin
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA) k (V.comap Sᵀ.mulVecLin) (by omega)
    intro x hx
    change Sᵀ *ᵥ x ∈ V at hx
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial] at *
    change _ ≤ quadForm (S * A * Sᵀ) x
    rw [show S * A * Sᵀ = (Sᵀ)ᴴ * A * Sᵀ by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose],
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    calc
      _ = hA.eigenvalues₀ k * (singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) := by ring
      _ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * ((Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlo x) hk
      _ ≤ _ := hAV _ hx
  · obtain ⟨W, hW, hAW⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul hA k
    have hdim := finrank_le_finrank_comap_endomorphism W Sᵀ.mulVecLin
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA) k (W.comap Sᵀ.mulVecLin) (by omega)
    intro x hx
    change Sᵀ *ᵥ x ∈ W at hx
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial] at *
    change quadForm (S * A * Sᵀ) x ≤ _
    rw [show S * A * Sᵀ = (Sᵀ)ᴴ * A * Sᵀ by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose],
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * ((Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x)) := hAW _ hx
      _ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * (specNorm S ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hup x) hk
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonpos {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hk : hA.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ 0) :
    specNorm S ^ 2 * hA.eigenvalues₀ k ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k ∧
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k ≤
      singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * hA.eigenvalues₀ k
proof:
:= by
  have hlo (x : n → ℝ) : singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤
      (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) := by
    have h := sq_singularValues_last_mul_norm_sq_le Sᵀ x
    rwa [singularValues_transpose, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self,
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at h
  have hup (x : n → ℝ) : (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ≤
      specNorm S ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_transpose, dotProduct, pow_two] using sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq Sᵀ x
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le hA k
    have hdim := finrank_le_finrank_comap_endomorphism V Sᵀ.mulVecLin
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA) k (V.comap Sᵀ.mulVecLin) (by omega)
    intro x hx
    change Sᵀ *ᵥ x ∈ V at hx
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial] at *
    change _ ≤ quadForm (S * A * Sᵀ) x
    rw [show S * A * Sᵀ = (Sᵀ)ᴴ * A * Sᵀ by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose],
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    calc
      _ = hA.eigenvalues₀ k * (specNorm S ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) := by ring
      _ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * ((Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left (hup x) hk
      _ ≤ _ := hAV _ hx
  · obtain ⟨W, hW, hAW⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul hA k
    have hdim := finrank_le_finrank_comap_endomorphism W Sᵀ.mulVecLin
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA) k (W.comap Sᵀ.mulVecLin) (by omega)
    intro x hx
    change Sᵀ *ᵥ x ∈ W at hx
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial] at *
    change quadForm (S * A * Sᵀ) x ≤ _
    rw [show S * A * Sᵀ = (Sᵀ)ᴴ * A * Sᵀ by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose],
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * ((Sᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ x)) := hAW _ hx
      _ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * (singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left (hlo x) hk
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalues₀_congruence_scale
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalues₀_congruence_scale {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ specNorm S ^ 2 ∧
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k = θ * hA.eigenvalues₀ k
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card n := (Nat.zero_le k.val).trans_lt k.isLt
  let : Nonempty n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hn
  have hscale : singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm S ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg S _) (singularValues_le_specNorm S _) 2
  by_cases hz : hA.eigenvalues₀ k = 0
  · have hb := eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonneg hA S k (by rw [hz])
    refine ⟨singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2, le_rfl, hscale, ?_⟩
    rw [hz] at hb ⊢
    simp only [mul_zero] at hb ⊢
    exact le_antisymm hb.2 hb.1
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hneg | hpos
    · have hb := eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonpos hA S k hneg.le
      refine ⟨(Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k /
        hA.eigenvalues₀ k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (le_div_iff_of_neg hneg).mpr hb.2
      · exact (div_le_iff_of_neg hneg).mpr hb.1
      · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hz]
    · have hb := eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonneg hA S k hpos.le
      refine ⟨(Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k /
        hA.eigenvalues₀ k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mpr hb.1
      · exact (div_le_iff₀ hpos).mpr hb.2
      · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hz]

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_eigenvalues₀_congruence_scale
statement:
theorem exists_pos_eigenvalues₀_congruence_scale {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (hS : IsUnit S) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1) ^ 2 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ specNorm S ^ 2 ∧ 0 < θ ∧
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k = θ * hA.eigenvalues₀ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨θ, hlo, hup, heq⟩ := exists_eigenvalues₀_congruence_scale hA S k
  haveI : Nonempty n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp ((Nat.zero_le k.val).trans_lt k.isLt)
  have hmin := (singularValues_last_pos_iff_isUnit S).mpr hS
  exact ⟨θ, hlo, hup, (sq_pos_of_pos hmin).trans_le hlo, heq⟩

name: NLAlib.card_eigenvalues₀_pos_congruence_le
statement:
theorem card_eigenvalues₀_pos_congruence_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k =>
      0 < (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k).card ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter fun k => 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ k).card
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro k hk
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  have hpos := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  by_contra h
  have hneg : hA.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h
  have hb := (eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonpos hA S k hneg).2
  have hnonpos := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg (singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1))) hneg
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hb.trans hnonpos)) hpos

name: NLAlib.card_eigenvalues₀_neg_congruence_le
statement:
theorem card_eigenvalues₀_neg_congruence_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k =>
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose S hA).eigenvalues₀ k < 0).card ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter fun k => hA.eigenvalues₀ k < 0).card
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro k hk
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  have hneg := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k := le_of_not_gt h
  have hb := (eigenvalues₀_congruence_bounds_of_nonneg hA S k hpos).1
  have hnonneg := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (singularValues S (Fintype.card n - 1))) hpos
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hnonneg.trans hb)) hneg

name: NLAlib.tendsto_pow_apply_zero_of_mem_maxGenEigenspace
statement:
theorem tendsto_pow_apply_zero_of_mem_maxGenEigenspace
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (f : Module.End ℂ E) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : ‖μ‖ < 1) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace μ) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (f ^ k) x) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let W := f.maxGenEigenspace μ
  have hpres : Set.MapsTo f W W := Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (Commute.refl f) μ
  let g : Module.End ℂ W := f.restrict hpres
  let b := Module.finBasis ℂ W
  let M := g.toMatrix b b
  have hspec (ν : ℂ) (hν : ν ∈ spectrum ℂ M) : ν = μ := by
    apply eq_of_hasEigenvalue_restrict_maxGenEigenspace f μ hpres
    apply (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_isRoot_charpoly _ _).mpr
    have hroot := Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp hν
    simpa only [M, LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix] using hroot
  have hρ : spectralRadius ℂ M < 1 := by
    have hle : spectralRadius ℂ M ≤ (‖μ‖₊ : ENNReal) := by
      apply iSup₂_le
      intro ν hν
      rw [hspec ν hν]
    exact hle.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hμ)
  let L : Matrix (Fin (finrank ℂ W)) (Fin (finrank ℂ W)) ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] (W →L[ℂ] W) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap.comp (Matrix.toLin b b).toLinearMap
  have hLpow (k : ℕ) : L (M ^ k) = (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (g ^ k)) := by
    change LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin b b (M ^ k)) = _
    rw [Matrix.toLin_pow, show Matrix.toLin b b M = g from Matrix.toLin_toMatrix b b g]
  have hL : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => L (M ^ k)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := L.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      (tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hρ)
    simpa only [map_zero, Function.comp_def] using h
  let z : W := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hz : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (L (M ^ k)) z) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hEval : Continuous (fun T : W →L[ℂ] W => T z) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_apply] using hEval.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hL
  have hback (k : ℕ) : ((g ^ k) z : E) = (f ^ k) x := by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
      change f ((g ^ k) z : E) = f ((f ^ k) x)
      rw [ih]
  have h := W.subtypeL.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hz
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, hLpow, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
    Submodule.coe_subtypeL, Submodule.subtype_apply, hback, map_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_positive_definite_pair_congruence
statement:
theorem exists_positive_definite_pair_congruence {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    ∃ (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ), IsUnit S ∧ A = S * Sᵀ ∧
      B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ ∧ (∀ i, 0 < d i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, -⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB.isHermitian
  refine ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, ?_⟩
  rw [hBB] at hB
  have hd : (diagonal d).PosDef := hS.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff.mp hB
  exact Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff.mp hd

name: NLAlib.smul_add_smul_eq_congruence_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA, hB]
  have hd : diagonal (fun i => a + b * d i) = a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + b • diagonal d := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_smul, ← Matrix.diagonal_add]
    rfl
  rw [hd]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.det_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem det_congruence_diagonal (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) :
    (S * diagonal d * Sᵀ).det = S.det ^ 2 * ∏ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  ring

name: NLAlib.log_det_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem log_det_congruence_diagonal {S : Matrix n n ℝ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (d : n → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) :
    Real.log (S * diagonal d * Sᵀ).det = Real.log (S.det ^ 2) + ∑ i, Real.log (d i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_congruence_diagonal, Real.log_mul
    (pow_ne_zero _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hS).ne_zero)
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => (hd i).ne')), Real.log_prod (fun i _ => (hd i).ne')]

name: NLAlib.inv_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem inv_congruence_diagonal (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (S * diagonal d * Sᵀ)⁻¹ = Sᵀ⁻¹ * diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹) * S⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (diagonal d)⁻¹ = diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹) := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [hd i]
    · simp [hij]
  rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hD, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.trace_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem trace_congruence_diagonal (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) :
    (S * diagonal d * Sᵀ).trace = ∑ i, d i * (Sᵀ * S) i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.lt_lambdaMax_one_sub_of_not_smul_one_le
statement:
theorem lt_lambdaMax_one_sub_of_not_smul_one_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfail : ¬ (1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ A) :
    ε < lambdaMax (1 - A)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hdef : 1 - A ≤ ε • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    rw [← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le
      (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ (Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hA)
        (le_of_not_gt hnot))
  apply hfail
  rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
  apply (sub_le_iff_le_add).mpr
  have h := add_le_add_right hdef A
  have he : A + (1 - A) = (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by abel
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.lt_lambdaMax_complexification_one_sub_of_not_smul_one_le
statement:
theorem lt_lambdaMax_complexification_one_sub_of_not_smul_one_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfail : ¬ (1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) :
    ε < lambdaMax (realMatrixComplexification (1 - A) : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hAc : (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian :=
    hA.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (fun x => by simp)
  have hfailc : ¬ (1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ realMatrixComplexification A := by
    intro h
    apply hfail
    apply (realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) _ _).mp
    simpa only [map_smul, map_one] using h
  simpa only [map_sub, map_one] using
    lt_lambdaMax_one_sub_of_not_smul_one_le hAc hfailc

name: NLAlib.isClosed_setOf_le_realMatrix
statement:
theorem isClosed_setOf_le_realMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    IsClosed {B : Matrix n n ℝ | A ≤ B}
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsClosed {B : Matrix n n ℂ |
      (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ B} :=
    isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_id
  have hp := hc.preimage (continuous_realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := n))
  simpa only [Set.preimage_ofPred_eq, realMatrixComplexification_le_iff] using hp

name: Complex.eq_one_of_tendsto_pow_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_tendsto_pow_of_norm_eq_one {z a : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1)
    (ha : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => z ^ k) atTop (𝓝 a)) : z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ‖a‖ = 1 := tendsto_nhds_unique ha.norm (by
    simpa only [norm_pow, hz, one_pow] using (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)))
  have hane : a ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hnorm
  have hshift := ha.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hmul : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => z ^ (k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (z * a)) := by
    simpa only [pow_succ'] using ha.const_mul z
  have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hmul hshift
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hane (by simpa only [one_mul] using heq)

name: Matrix.eigenvalue_eq_one_of_tendsto_pow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := NLAlib.exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℂ => (M *ᵥ z) j / z j) := by fun_prop
  have hp : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => μ ^ k) atTop (𝓝 ((L *ᵥ z) j / z j)) := by
    convert hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim using 1
    funext k
    change μ ^ k = (T ^ k *ᵥ z) j / z j
    rw [pow_mulVec_eq_pow_smul_of_mulVec_eq_smul he, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hj]
  exact Complex.eq_one_of_tendsto_pow_of_norm_eq_one hμnorm hp

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.card_eigenvalues_gt_eq_rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hA.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, Fintype.card_subtype]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro hi
    exact ne_of_gt (hb.trans hi)
  · intro hi
    exact (hgap i).resolve_left hi

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.rank_add_vecMulVec_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap
statement:
theorem rank_add_vecMulVec_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {b b' : ℝ}
    (hb' : 0 < b') (hbb' : b' ≤ b)
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i)
    (v : n → ℝ)
    (hinteraction : quadForm (A - b' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ v < -1) :
    (A + vecMulVec v v).rank = A.rank + 1 ∧
      ∀ i, (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
        (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v).isHermitian)).eigenvalues i = 0 ∨
        b' < (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
          (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v).isHermitian)).eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv : (vecMulVec v v).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v
  let hA' : (A + vecMulVec v v).IsHermitian := hA.add hv.isHermitian
  have hgap' : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b' < hA.eigenvalues i := by
    intro i
    rcases hgap i with hi | hi
    · exact Or.inl hi
    · exact Or.inr (hbb'.trans_lt hi)
  have hc := inertiaPos_add_vecMulVec_eq_add_one_of_shift hA b' v
    (isUnit_shift_of_eigenvalues_gap hA hb' hgap')
    (by simpa [quadForm, star_trivial] using hinteraction)
  have hmat : A - b' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + vecMulVec v v =
      A + vecMulVec v v - b' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by module
  rw [hmat, inertiaPos_sub_smul_one_eq_card hA' b',
    card_eigenvalues_gt_eq_rank hA hb' hgap'] at hc
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => b' < hA'.eigenvalues i) ⊆
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA'.eigenvalues i ≠ 0) := by
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i,
      ne_of_gt (hb'.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2)⟩
  have hlower : A.rank + 1 ≤ (A + vecMulVec v v).rank := by
    rw [← hc, hA'.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, Fintype.card_subtype]
    exact Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hupper : (A + vecMulVec v v).rank ≤ A.rank + 1 :=
    (rank_add_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le v v) _)
  have hrank := le_antisymm hupper hlower
  refine ⟨hrank, ?_⟩
  have heq : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => b' < hA'.eigenvalues i) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA'.eigenvalues i ≠ 0) := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
    rw [← Fintype.card_subtype, ← hA'.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, hrank, hc]
  intro i
  by_cases hi : hA'.eigenvalues i = 0
  · exact Or.inl hi
  · right
    have hm : i ∈ Finset.univ.filter fun j => hA'.eigenvalues j ≠ 0 := by simp [hi]
    rw [← heq] at hm
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_column_rank_eq_add_one_and_lowerPotential_le
statement:
theorem exists_column_rank_eq_add_one_and_lowerPotential_le
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    {A H : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.PosSemidef)
    (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    {b δ Λ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i)
    (hkernel : b * Λ ≤ δ * (H.trace - (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ))
    (hpot : lowerPotential H A b ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ) :
    ∃ i,
      (A + vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).rank = A.rank + 1 ∧
      (∀ j, (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
        (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v i)).isHermitian)).eigenvalues j = 0 ∨
        b - δ < (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
          (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v i)).isHermitian)).eigenvalues j) ∧
      lowerPotential H (A + vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) (b - δ) ≤
        lowerPotential H A b
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix n n ℝ := (A - (b - δ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹
  let Δ : ℝ := lowerPotential H A b - lowerPotential H A (b - δ)
  have hh := lowerPotential_gap_pos_and_trace_sq_le hA hH hδ hb hΛ hHle hgap hkernel
  change 0 < Δ ∧ Λ * (H * R ^ 2).trace ≤ Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ) at hh
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := by
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.inv
    apply hA.sub
    rw [Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal]
    exact Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal _
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hcert⟩ := exists_column_interaction_lt_neg_one v hframe hH hR
    hh.1 hΛ hδ hHle (show (H * R).trace = lowerPotential H A b - Δ by
      dsimp [R, Δ, lowerPotential]; ring) hpot hh.2
  have hspec := rank_add_vecMulVec_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap hA (sub_pos.mpr hb)
    (show b - δ ≤ b by linarith) hgap (v i) hi
  refine ⟨i, hspec.1, hspec.2, ?_⟩
  exact lowerPotential_add_vecMulVec_le (v i)
    (isUnit_shift_of_eigenvalues_gap hA (sub_pos.mpr hb) (by
      intro j
      rcases hgap j with hj | hj
      · exact Or.inl hj
      · exact Or.inr (by linarith))) hh.1
    (show lowerPotential H A (b - δ) = lowerPotential H A b - Δ by dsimp [Δ]; ring)
    hi hcert

name: NLAlib.norm_diagonal_mul_le_of_mulVec_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, A i j * v j = -(A i i * v i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have hrow := congrFun hv i
    change (∑ j, A i j * v j) = 0 at hrow
    rw [hrow, zero_sub]
  calc
    ‖A i i‖ * ‖v i‖ = ‖-(A i i * v i)‖ := by rw [norm_neg, norm_mul]
    _ = ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, A i j * v j‖ := congrArg norm hsum.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖A i j * v j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = _ := by simp only [norm_mul]

name: NLAlib.norm_eq_max_of_mulVec_eq_zero_of_entry_ne_zero
statement:
theorem norm_eq_max_of_mulVec_eq_zero_of_entry_ne_zero
    {A : Matrix n n K} {v : n → K} {M : ℝ} (hv : A *ᵥ v = 0)
    (hweak : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ ‖A i i‖)
    (hmax : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) {i j : n} (hi : ‖v i‖ = M) (hij : A i j ≠ 0) :
    ‖v j‖ = M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases heq : j = i
  · simpa only [heq] using hi
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := hi ▸ norm_nonneg (v i)
  have hbound := norm_diagonal_mul_le_of_mulVec_eq_zero hv i
  rw [hi] at hbound
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖A i k‖ * ‖v k‖ =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖A i k‖ * M := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmax k) (norm_nonneg _))
    · rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hweak i) hM).trans hbound
  have hzero : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖A i k‖ * (M - ‖v k‖) = 0 := by
    simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← hsum, sub_self]
  have hterm : ‖A i j‖ * (M - ‖v j‖) = 0 :=
    (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _ =>
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hmax k)))).mp hzero j
        (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨heq, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
  have := (mul_eq_zero.mp hterm).resolve_left (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hij)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.det_ne_zero_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
statement:
theorem det_ne_zero_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
    (A : Matrix n n K) (hIrred : (A.map norm).IsIrreducible)
    (hweak : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ ‖A i i‖)
    (hstrict : ∃ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖) : A.det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  have heig : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toLin' A) 0 := by
    rw [Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff, Module.End.eigenspace_zero, ne_comm]
    exact ne_of_lt (LinearMap.bot_lt_ker_of_det_eq_zero (by rwa [LinearMap.det_toLin']))
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvne⟩ := heig.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hAv : A *ᵥ v = 0 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.toLin'_apply, zero_smul] using Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hstrict
  let : Nonempty n := ⟨s⟩
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => ‖v i‖)
  have hmax (j : n) : ‖v j‖ ≤ ‖v i‖ := hi ▸ Finset.le_sup' (fun i => ‖v i‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hpos : 0 < ‖v i‖ := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hvne
    ext j
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm ((hmax j).trans h) (norm_nonneg _))
  let : Quiver n := Matrix.toQuiver (A.map norm)
  obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := hIrred.connected i s
  have hpath : ∀ {j : n} (q : Quiver.Path i j), ‖v j‖ = ‖v i‖ := by
    intro j q
    induction q with
    | nil => rfl
    | @cons b c q e ih =>
      exact norm_eq_max_of_mulVec_eq_zero_of_entry_ne_zero hAv hweak hmax ih
        (norm_pos_iff.mp e.down)
  have hprop := hpath p
  have hbound := norm_diagonal_mul_le_of_mulVec_eq_zero hAv s
  rw [hprop] at hbound
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase s, ‖A s j‖ * ‖v j‖) ≤
      gershgorinRowRadius A s * ‖v i‖ := by
    rw [gershgorinRowRadius, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmax j) (norm_nonneg _))
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound.trans hsum)) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs hpos)

name: NLAlib.exists_bound_pow_orbit_of_eigenvalues_le_one_of_peripheral_semisimple
statement:
theorem exists_bound_pow_orbit_of_eigenvalues_le_one_of_peripheral_semisimple
    (f : Module.End ℂ E)
    (hvalues : ∀ μ : ℂ, f.HasEigenvalue μ → ‖μ‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsemi : ∀ μ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ = 1 → f.maxGenEigenspace μ = f.eigenspace μ) :
    ∀ x : E, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) x‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let P : Submodule ℂ E :=
    { carrier := {x | ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) x‖ ≤ C}
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, by intro k; simp⟩
      add_mem' := by
        rintro x y ⟨C, hC⟩ ⟨D, hD⟩
        exact ⟨C + D, fun k => by simpa only [map_add] using
          (norm_add_le ((f ^ k) x) ((f ^ k) y)).trans (add_le_add (hC k) (hD k))⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro a x ⟨C, hC⟩
        exact ⟨‖a‖ * C, fun k => by
          simpa only [map_smul, norm_smul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC k) (norm_nonneg a)⟩ }
  have hprimary (μ : ℂ) : f.maxGenEigenspace μ ≤ P := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hx0 : x = 0
    · subst x
      exact P.zero_mem
    have heigen : f.HasEigenvalue μ := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace f μ x).mp hx
      have hg : f.HasGenEigenvector μ k x := ⟨Module.End.mem_genEigenspace_nat.mpr hk, hx0⟩
      exact Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasGenEigenvalue hg.hasUnifEigenvalue
    rcases (hvalues μ heigen).lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto _
        (tendsto_pow_apply_zero_of_mem_maxGenEigenspace f hlt hx)).exists_norm_le
      exact ⟨C, fun k => hC _ ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩
    · have hx' : x ∈ f.eigenspace μ := by rw [← hsemi μ heq]; exact hx
      have hxe : f.HasEigenvector μ x := ⟨hx', hx0⟩
      exact ⟨‖x‖, fun k => by simp only [hxe.pow_apply, norm_smul, norm_pow, heq, one_pow, one_mul, le_refl]⟩
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ E) ≤ P := by
    rw [← Module.End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top f]
    exact iSup_le hprimary
  exact fun x => htop (Submodule.mem_top : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℂ E))

name: NLAlib.exists_bound_norm_pow_of_bounded_pow_orbits
statement:
theorem exists_bound_norm_pow_of_bounded_pow_orbits (f : Module.End ℂ E)
    (hb : ∀ x : E, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) x‖ ≤ C) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f ^ k))‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis ℂ E
  choose C hC using fun i => hb (b i)
  let M : ℝ := ∑ i, max (C i) 0
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨Fintype.card (Fin (finrank ℂ E)) • ‖b.equivFunL.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * M, fun k => ?_⟩
  apply b.opNorm_le hM
  intro i
  exact (hC i k).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => le_max_right (C j) 0) (Finset.mem_univ i)))

name: NLAlib.exists_bound_norm_pow_iff_eigenvalues_le_one_and_peripheral_semisimple
statement:
theorem exists_bound_norm_pow_iff_eigenvalues_le_one_and_peripheral_semisimple
    (f : Module.End ℂ E) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f ^ k))‖ ≤ C) ↔
      (∀ μ : ℂ, f.HasEigenvalue μ → ‖μ‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ μ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ = 1 → f.maxGenEigenspace μ = f.eigenspace μ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
    have hb (x : E) : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) x‖ ≤ D := by
      refine ⟨C * ‖x‖, fun k => ?_⟩
      exact ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f ^ k)).le_opNorm x).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC k) (norm_nonneg x))
    refine ⟨?_, fun μ hμ => maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_bounded_pow_orbits f hb hμ⟩
    intro μ hμ
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hμ.exists_hasEigenvector
    exact norm_eigenvalue_le_one_of_bounded_pow_orbit f hx (hb x)
  · rintro ⟨hvalues, hsemi⟩
    exact exists_bound_norm_pow_of_bounded_pow_orbits f
      (exists_bound_pow_orbit_of_eigenvalues_le_one_of_peripheral_semisimple f hvalues hsemi)

name: NLAlib.exists_real_eigenline_or_plane
statement:
theorem exists_real_eigenline_or_plane {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [Nontrivial E] (T : Module.End ℝ E) :
    (∃ a : ℝ, ∃ u : E, u ≠ 0 ∧ T u = a • u) ∨
    (∃ a b : ℝ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ u v : E,
      LinearIndependent ℝ ![u, v] ∧
      T u = a • u - b • v ∧ T v = b • u + a • v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).toBasis
  let e := c.equivFun
  let M := T.toMatrix c c
  have : Nonempty (Fin (finrank ℝ E)) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp Module.finrank_pos
  have he (x : Fin (finrank ℝ E) → ℝ) : T (e.symm x) = e.symm (M *ᵥ x) := by
    apply e.injective
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    have h := T.toMatrix_mulVec_repr c c (e.symm x)
    simpa only [← Basis.equivFun_apply, e, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, M] using h.symm
  rcases exists_real_eigenvector_or_invariant_plane M with ⟨a, u, hu, hMu⟩ |
      ⟨a, b, hb, X, hX, hMX⟩
  · left
    refine ⟨a, e.symm u, fun h => hu (e.symm.injective (h.trans e.symm.map_zero.symm)), ?_⟩
    rw [he, hMu, map_smul]
  · right
    have hMu : M *ᵥ X.col 0 = a • X.col 0 - b • X.col 1 := by
      ext i
      have h := congrArg (fun N : Matrix (Fin (finrank ℝ E)) (Fin 2) ℝ => N i 0) hMX
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two,
        Matrix.col_apply, mul_comm, sub_eq_add_neg] using h
    have hMv : M *ᵥ X.col 1 = b • X.col 0 + a • X.col 1 := by
      ext i
      have h := congrArg (fun N : Matrix (Fin (finrank ℝ E)) (Fin 2) ℝ => N i 1) hMX
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two,
        Matrix.col_apply, mul_comm] using h
    refine ⟨a, b, hb, e.symm (X.col 0), e.symm (X.col 1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := hX.map' e.symm.toLinearMap e.symm.ker
      have hvec : (fun i => e.symm (X.col i)) = ![e.symm (X.col 0), e.symm (X.col 1)] := by
        funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_def, hvec] using h
    · rw [he, hMu, map_sub, map_smul, map_smul]
    · rw [he, hMv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: NLAlib.exists_invariant_subspace_finrank_one_or_two
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_subspace_finrank_one_or_two {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [Nontrivial E] (T : Module.End ℝ E) :
    ∃ P : Submodule ℝ E, (finrank ℝ P = 1 ∨ finrank ℝ P = 2) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_real_eigenline_or_plane T with ⟨a, u, hu, hTu⟩ |
      ⟨a, b, _, u, v, huv, hTu, hTv⟩
  · refine ⟨ℝ ∙ u, Or.inl (finrank_span_singleton hu), ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
    rw [map_smul, hTu]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · let P := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![u, v])
    have hu : u ∈ P := Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hv : v ∈ P := Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨P, Or.inr (by simpa [P] using finrank_span_eq_card huv), ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      fin_cases i
      · change T u ∈ P
        rw [hTu]
        exact P.sub_mem (P.smul_mem _ hu) (P.smul_mem _ hv)
      · change T v ∈ P
        rw [hTv]
        exact P.add_mem (P.smul_mem _ hu) (P.smul_mem _ hv)
    | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using P.zero_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using P.add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using P.smul_mem c hx

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq (a b : n → ℂ)
    (hab : (∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a i))) =
      ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (b i))) :
    (∑ i, ‖a i‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hroots (d : n → ℂ) :
      (∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (d i))).roots = Finset.univ.val.map d := by
    rw [Polynomial.roots_prod]
    · simp only [Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Multiset.bind_singleton]
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (d i))
  have h := congrArg (fun p : ℂ[X] => (p.roots.map (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2)).sum) hab
  simpa only [hroots, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_map_val] using h

name: NLAlib.frobSq_unitary_similarity
statement:
theorem frobSq_unitary_similarity (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (T : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    frobSq ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) = frobSq T
proof:
:= by
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  rw [frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hUt, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hUt]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq_of_normal
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq_of_normal {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (d i))) :
    frobSq A = ∑ i, ‖d i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, a, hUa⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have ha : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a i)) := by
    rw [hUa, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  rw [hUa, frobSq_unitary_similarity, frobSq_diagonal]
  exact sum_norm_sq_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq a d (ha.symm.trans hd)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_diag_add_frobSq_sub_diagonal
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_diag_add_frobSq_sub_diagonal (T : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    frobSq T = (∑ i, ‖T i i‖ ^ 2) + frobSq (T - Matrix.diagonal T.diag)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : frobSq T = frobSq (Matrix.diagonal T.diag) + frobSq (T - Matrix.diagonal T.diag) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
        sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), add_zero]
    · simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, Matrix.sub_apply, sub_zero, norm_zero,
        zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_add]
  rw [hsplit, frobSq_diagonal]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_schur_diagonal_le_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_schur_diagonal_le_frobSq
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (T : Matrix n n ℂ) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) :
    (∑ i, ‖T i i‖ ^ 2) ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA, frobSq_unitary_similarity, frobSq_eq_sum_diag_add_frobSq_sub_diagonal]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_schur_diagonal_eq_frobSq_iff_normal
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_schur_diagonal_eq_frobSq_iff_normal
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (T : Matrix n n ℂ) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T i i))) :
    (∑ i, ‖T i i‖ ^ 2) = frobSq A ↔ A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hmass := frobSq_eq_sum_diag_add_frobSq_sub_diagonal T
    have hnorm : frobSq A = frobSq T := by rw [hA, frobSq_unitary_similarity]
    have hzero : frobSq (T - Matrix.diagonal T.diag) = 0 := by linarith
    have hT : T = Matrix.diagonal T.diag := sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp hzero)
    exact mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_unitary_diagonalization U T.diag
      (hA.trans (congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ =>
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * M * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) hT))
  · intro hnormal
    exact (frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq_of_normal hnormal T.diag hchar).symm

name: NLAlib.spectrum_real_kronecker_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : Matrix n n ℂ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := by
    change Uᴴ * U = 1
    exact Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hD : A = thinSingularMatrix U U hA.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [thinSingularMatrix, U, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,
      Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Function.comp_def] using hA.spectral_theorem
  have hI : (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) =
      thinSingularMatrix (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) (fun _ : r => 1) := by
    simp [thinSingularMatrix]
  have hAmp : A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) =
      thinSingularMatrix (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ)) (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ))
        (fun ir => hA.eigenvalues ir.1) := by
    calc
      _ = thinSingularMatrix U U hA.eigenvalues ⊗ₖ
          thinSingularMatrix (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) (fun _ : r => 1) := by
        rw [← hD, ← hI]
      _ = _ := by rw [thinSingularMatrix_kronecker]; simp only [mul_one]
  have hW : HasOrthonormalCols (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ)) :=
    hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker hU hasOrthonormalCols_one
  calc
    _ = spectrum ℝ (thinSingularMatrix (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ))
        (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ)) (fun ir => hA.eigenvalues ir.1)) :=
      congrArg (spectrum ℝ) hAmp
    _ = Set.range (fun ir : n × r => hA.eigenvalues ir.1) :=
      spectrum_real_thinSingularMatrix _ hW _
    _ = Set.range hA.eigenvalues := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨ir, hir⟩; exact ⟨ir.1, hir⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩; exact ⟨(i, Classical.choice inferInstance), hi⟩
    _ = spectrum ℝ A := hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues.symm

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_kronecker_one
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_kronecker_one [Nonempty r] {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    lambdaMax (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix r r ℂ)) = lambdaMax A
proof:
:= by
  unfold lambdaMax
  rw [spectrum_real_kronecker_one hA]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef
statement:
theorem selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef {k : ℕ} (v : I → n → ℝ) (s : Fin k → I) :
    (selectedFrameOperator v s).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ fun j _ => by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v (s j))

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.selectedFrameOperator_snoc
proof:
:= by
  unfold selectedFrameOperator
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.lowerPotential_zero
statement:
private theorem lowerPotential_zero {H : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    lowerPotential H 0 b = -H.trace / b
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : ((-b) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ = (-b)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hb)), one_smul]
  unfold lowerPotential
  rw [zero_sub, ← neg_smul, hinv, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_smul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.eigenvalues_gap_of_eq
statement:
private theorem eigenvalues_gap_of_eq {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : A = B) (b : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i) :
    ∀ i, hB.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hB.eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by
  subst B
  exact hgap

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_selectedFrameOperator_rank_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap
statement:
theorem exists_selectedFrameOperator_rank_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap
    [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ) {H : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : H.PosSemidef) (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    {b₀ δ Λ : ℝ} (hb₀ : 0 < b₀) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (hpot₀ : -H.trace / b₀ ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : (k : ℝ) * δ < b₀) :
    ∃ s : Fin k → I,
      (selectedFrameOperator v s).rank = k ∧
      (∀ j, ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian).eigenvalues j = 0 ∨
        b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ <
          ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian).eigenvalues j) ∧
      lowerPotential H (selectedFrameOperator v s) (b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ) ≤
        -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ
proof:
:= by
  have hkernel₀ : b₀ * Λ ≤ δ * H.trace := by
    have hdiv : Λ / δ ≤ H.trace / b₀ := by
      have hm : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hp : -(H.trace / b₀) ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ := by
        simpa only [neg_div] using hpot₀
      linarith
    have hh := (div_le_div_iff₀ hδ hb₀).mp hdiv
    nlinarith
  have hind : ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → ∃ s : Fin t → I,
      (selectedFrameOperator v s).rank = t ∧
      (∀ j, ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian).eigenvalues j = 0 ∨
        b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ <
          ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian).eigenvalues j) ∧
      lowerPotential H (selectedFrameOperator v s) (b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ) ≤
        -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      let s : Fin 0 → I := Fin.elim0
      have hs : selectedFrameOperator v s = 0 := by simp [selectedFrameOperator]
      refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hs, Matrix.rank_zero]
      · intro j
        left
        exact congrFun
          ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian.eigenvalues_eq_zero_iff.mpr hs) j
      · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, hs, lowerPotential_zero hb₀] using hpot₀
    | succ t ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨s, hsRank, hsGap, hsPot⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht)
      let A := selectedFrameOperator v s
      let hA := (selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian
      have htδ : ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ < b₀ :=
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr ht) hδ.le).trans_lt hk
      have hb : δ < b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ := by push_cast at htδ; linarith
      have hkernel : (b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ) * Λ ≤ δ * (H.trace - (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ) := by
        dsimp [A]
        rw [hsRank]
        nlinarith
      obtain ⟨i, hiRank, hiGap, hiPot⟩ :=
        exists_column_rank_eq_add_one_and_lowerPotential_le v hA hH hframe hδ hb hΛ
          hHle hsGap hkernel hsPot
      refine ⟨Fin.snoc s i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [selectedFrameOperator_snoc]
        exact hiRank.trans (by rw [hsRank])
      · intro j
        have heq := selectedFrameOperator_snoc v s i
        have hh := eigenvalues_gap_of_eq _
          (selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v (Fin.snoc s i)).isHermitian heq.symm
          (b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ - δ) hiGap j
        have hbnew : b₀ - ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ = b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ - δ := by
          push_cast
          ring
        simpa only [hbnew] using hh
      · rw [selectedFrameOperator_snoc]
        have hbnew : b₀ - ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ = b₀ - (t : ℝ) * δ - δ := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hbnew]
        exact hiPot.trans hsPot
  exact hind k le_rfl

name: NLAlib.mul_eq_mul_iff_conjTranspose_mul_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_normal
statement:
theorem mul_eq_mul_iff_conjTranspose_mul_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_normal
    {A B X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A)
    (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) : A * X = X * B ↔ Aᴴ * X = X * Bᴴ
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => exact ⟨fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  | inr hn =>
    let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
    let : IsStarNormal B := ⟨hB.symm⟩
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (SemiconjBy.star_right ⟨hB.symm⟩ ⟨hA.symm⟩
        (show SemiconjBy X B A from h.symm)).symm
    · intro h
      have h' := SemiconjBy.star_right (inferInstance : IsStarNormal (star B))
        (inferInstance : IsStarNormal (star A))
        (show SemiconjBy X (star B) (star A) from h.symm)
      simpa only [star_star] using h'.symm

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_of_unit_eigenvector_of_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_of_unit_eigenvector_of_le [Nonempty ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a : ℝ} (hle : a • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) ≤ A)
    {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) (heig : A *ᵥ v = a • v) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card ι - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt Fintype.card_pos⟩ = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_iInf Fintype.card_pos]
  have hpos : (A - a • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hle
  have hlow : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1 → a ≤ RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hx, one_pow]
    have hp := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hx', mul_one, RCLike.re_to_real] at hp ⊢
    linarith
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun x : {x : ι → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} =>
      RCLike.re (star x.1 ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.1))) := ⟨a, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact hlow x.1 x.2⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (ciInf_le hbdd (⟨v, hv⟩ : {x : ι → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1})).trans_eq ?_
    show RCLike.re (star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) = a
    have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hv, one_pow]
    simp only [star_trivial, heig, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hvv, mul_one, RCLike.re_to_real]
  · have : Nonempty {x : ι → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} := ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
    exact le_ciInf fun x => hlow x.1 x.2

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_mul_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_mul_eq_diagonal
    [Nonempty ι] {A U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (l : ι → ℝ) (hdiag : Uᵀ * A * U = Matrix.diagonal l) (i₀ : ι) (hmin : ∀ i, l i₀ ≤ l i) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card ι - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt Fintype.card_pos⟩ = l i₀
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU
  have hUU : U * Uᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU'
  have hA' : A = U * Matrix.diagonal l * Uᵀ := by
    rw [← hdiag]
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUU, Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc A U Uᵀ, hUU]
    simp
  have hdif : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => l i - l i₀) =
      Matrix.diagonal l - l i₀ • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hij]
  have hpd : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => l i - l i₀)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr fun i => sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin i)
  have hpos := hpd.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hdif, Matrix.mul_sub,
    Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hUU] at hpos
  rw [← hA'] at hpos
  let e : ι → ℝ := Pi.single i₀ 1
  let v : ι → ℝ := U *ᵥ e
  have hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    dsimp [v]
    rw [show (U *ᵥ e) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ e) = e ⬝ᵥ ((Uᵀ * U) *ᵥ e) from
        star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self U e, hU', Matrix.one_mulVec]
    simp [e, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
  have hv' : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, hv, Real.sqrt_one]
  have heig : A *ᵥ v = l i₀ • v := by
    rw [hA']
    dsimp [v]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, hU', Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    simp [e]
  exact hA.eigenvalues₀_last_eq_of_unit_eigenvector_of_le (Matrix.le_iff.mpr hpos) hv' heig

name: NLAlib.det_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem det_add_vecMulVec {M : Matrix n n K} (hM : IsUnit M.det) (u v : n → K) :
    (M + Matrix.vecMulVec u v).det = M.det * (1 + v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u))
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : M + Matrix.vecMulVec u v =
      M * (1 + Matrix.vecMulVec (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u) v) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hfactor, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.vecMulVec_eq Unit,
    Matrix.det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow]

name: NLAlib.isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul
statement:
theorem isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul {A : Matrix n n K} {x : n → K}
    {μ : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) : A.charpoly.IsRoot μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.IsRoot, Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply,
    ← Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal]
  apply Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp
  exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    hAx, sub_self]⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_sub
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix n n K := z • 1 - A
  have hMdet : M.det ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [M, Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply,
      Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal] using hz
  have hM : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hMdet
  have hzμ : z - μ ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have hzEq : z = μ := sub_eq_zero.mp heq
    exact hz (hzEq ▸ (isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul hx hAx).eq_zero)
  have hMx : M *ᵥ x = (z - μ) • x := by
    simp only [M, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hAx,
      sub_smul]
  have hinv : M⁻¹ *ᵥ x = (z - μ)⁻¹ • x := by
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr ((M.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det).mpr hM)
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_smul, hMx, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hzμ, one_smul]
  have hshift : z • (1 : Matrix n n K) - (A + Matrix.vecMulVec x y) =
      M + Matrix.vecMulVec (-x) y := by
    simp only [M, Matrix.neg_vecMulVec]
    abel
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply, ← Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal,
    hshift, det_add_vecMulVec hM]
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_neg, hinv, dotProduct_neg, dotProduct_smul]
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply, ← Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  change (z - μ) * (M.det * (1 - (z - μ)⁻¹ * (y ⬝ᵥ x))) =
    (z - μ - y ⬝ᵥ x) * M.det
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_X_sub_C [Infinite K] {A : Matrix n n K}
    {x : n → K} {μ : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (y : n → K) :
    (X - C μ) * (A + Matrix.vecMulVec x y).charpoly =
      (X - C (μ + y ⬝ᵥ x)) * A.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  have hfinite := Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot A.charpoly_monic.ne_zero
  apply hfinite.infinite_compl.mono
  intro z hz
  have hz' : A.charpoly.eval z ≠ 0 := hz
  simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_C, sub_add_eq_sub_sub] using
    eval_charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_sub hx hAx y hz'

name: NLAlib.exists_charpoly_factor_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem exists_charpoly_factor_add_vecMulVec [Infinite K] {A : Matrix n n K}
    {x : n → K} {μ : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (y : n → K) :
    ∃ q : K[X], A.charpoly = (X - C μ) * q ∧
      (A + Matrix.vecMulVec x y).charpoly = (X - C (μ + y ⬝ᵥ x)) * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul hx hAx)
  refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero μ)
  rw [charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_X_sub_C hx hAx y, hq]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isThinSVD_coordinateRankOneMatrix
statement:
theorem isThinSVD_coordinateRankOneMatrix (i₀ : m) (j₀ : n) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    IsThinSVD (coordinateRankOneMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀ j₀ x) (coordinateColumn i₀)
      (coordinateColumn j₀) (fun _ : Unit => x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateColumn i₀, hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateColumn j₀,
    fun _ => hx, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.singularValues_coordinateRankOneMatrix_of_pos
statement:
theorem singularValues_coordinateRankOneMatrix_of_pos (i₀ : m) (j₀ : n)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < singularValues (coordinateRankOneMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀ j₀ x) k) :
    singularValues (coordinateRankOneMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀ j₀ x) k = x
proof:
:= by
  have ht := isThinSVD_coordinateRankOneMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀ j₀ hx
  have hr : (coordinateRankOneMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) i₀ j₀ x).rank = 1 := by
    simpa using ht.rank_eq_card
  have hkr := (singularValues_pos_iff _ _).mp hk
  have hzero : k = 0 := by omega
  subst k
  rw [singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm, coordinateRankOneMatrix,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix _ _ (hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateColumn i₀)
      (hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateColumn j₀), pi_norm_const, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos hx]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_conjTranspose (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (f : r → ℝ) : (thinSingularMatrix U V f)ᴴ = thinSingularMatrix V U f
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (f i : 𝕜))ᴴ = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f i : 𝕜)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j; simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    · simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, h, Ne.symm h]
  simp only [thinSingularMatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hd, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_mul {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜) (W : Matrix p r 𝕜)
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (f g : r → ℝ) :
    thinSingularMatrix U V f * thinSingularMatrix V W g =
      thinSingularMatrix U W (fun i => f i * g i)
proof:
:= by
  have he : thinSingularMatrix U V f * thinSingularMatrix V W g =
      U * (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f i : 𝕜)) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (g i : 𝕜))) * Wᴴ := by
    simp only [thinSingularMatrix, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V (Matrix.diagonal _ * Wᴴ),
      hV.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [he, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  simp only [thinSingularMatrix, RCLike.ofReal_mul]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_add
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_add (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (f g : r → ℝ) :
    thinSingularMatrix U V f + thinSingularMatrix U V g =
      thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => f i + g i)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => ((f i + g i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f i : 𝕜)) + Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (g i : 𝕜)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h]
  rw [thinSingularMatrix, thinSingularMatrix, thinSingularMatrix, hd,
    Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_smul
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_smul (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (a : ℝ) (f : r → ℝ) :
    a • thinSingularMatrix U V f = thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => a * f i)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => ((a * f i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) =
      a • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f i : 𝕜)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, Algebra.smul_def]
  rw [thinSingularMatrix, thinSingularMatrix, hd, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_gram
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_gram (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (f : r → ℝ) :
    (thinSingularMatrix U V f)ᴴ * thinSingularMatrix U V f =
      thinSingularMatrix V V (fun i => f i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [thinSingularMatrix_conjTranspose, thinSingularMatrix_mul V U V hU]
  simp only [pow_two]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_thinSingularMatrix
statement:
theorem specNorm_thinSingularMatrix [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (f : r → ℝ) :
    specNorm (thinSingularMatrix U V f) = ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [thinSingularMatrix, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg f)).mpr (fun i => by
      simpa only [RCLike.norm_ofReal, Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm f i)
  · exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).mpr (fun i => by
      simpa only [RCLike.norm_ofReal, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => (f i : 𝕜)) i)

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_sub
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_sub (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (f g : r → ℝ) :
    thinSingularMatrix U V f - thinSingularMatrix U V g =
      thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => f i - g i)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => ((f i - g i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f i : 𝕜)) - Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (g i : 𝕜)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h]
  rw [thinSingularMatrix, thinSingularMatrix, thinSingularMatrix, hd,
    Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]

name: NLAlib.multiset_singularValues_diagonal_complex
statement:
theorem multiset_singularValues_diagonal_complex {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℂ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card ι))).val.map
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card ι) => singularValues (Matrix.diagonal d) (i : ℕ)) =
    (Finset.univ : Finset ι).val.map (fun i => ‖d i‖)
proof:
:= by
  let G := (Matrix.diagonal d)ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal d
  have hG : G.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self _
  have hdiag : G = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((‖d i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    simp only [G, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simpa only [Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.ofReal_pow] using Complex.conj_mul' (d i)
  have hroot : G.charpoly.roots =
      (Finset.univ : Finset ι).val.map (fun i => ((‖d i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    rw [hdiag, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Polynomial.roots_prod]
    · simp only [Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Multiset.bind_singleton]
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _ _ => Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _
  have he := congrArg (Multiset.map (fun z : ℂ => Real.sqrt z.re))
    (hG.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀.symm.trans hroot)
  simp only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at he
  convert he using 1
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (Matrix.diagonal d) i]
  change singularValues (Matrix.diagonal d) (i : ℕ) =
    Real.sqrt (singularValues (Matrix.diagonal d) (i : ℕ) ^ 2)
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (singularValues_nonneg _ _)]

name: NLAlib.sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (f : ℝ → R) (hf : f 0=0) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ N) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f (singularValues A i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)), f (singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hN)
  intro i _ hi
  rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi), hf]

name: NLAlib.sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues
statement:
theorem sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, f ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), f (singularValues A i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted]
  simp_rw [← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀]
  exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => f (singularValues A i ^ 2)) (Fintype.card n)

name: NLAlib.sum_eigenvalues_mul_adjoint_eq_adjoint_mul
statement:
theorem sum_eigenvalues_mul_adjoint_eq_adjoint_mul (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : f 0=0) :
    (∑ i, f ((Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self A).eigenvalues i)) =
      ∑ i, f ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues A.conjTranspose f
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hl
  rw [hl, sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues]
  simp only [singularValues_conjTranspose]
  rw [sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A (fun x => f (x^2)) (by simpa using hf) (min_le_left _ _),
    sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A (fun x => f (x^2)) (by simpa using hf) (min_le_right _ _)]

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem realMatrixComplexification_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜) = A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff
statement:
theorem posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜).PosSemidef ↔ A.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    constructor
    · exact (Matrix.isHermitian_map_iff (fun x => by simp)
        (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜).injective).mp hA.isHermitian
    · intro x
      have h := hA.re_dotProduct_nonneg (fun i => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (x i))
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, realMatrixComplexification_apply, ← map_mul,
        ← map_sum] using h
  · intro hA
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    have h : (realMatrixComplexification (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) : Matrix n n 𝕜) ≤
        realMatrixComplexification A :=
      map_rel (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n)) hA.nonneg
    rwa [map_zero] at h

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_le_iff
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (A B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜) ≤ realMatrixComplexification B ↔ A ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, ← map_sub, posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff, Matrix.le_iff]

name: NLAlib.continuous_realMatrixComplexification
statement:
theorem continuous_realMatrixComplexification :
    Continuous (realMatrixComplexification : Matrix n n ℝ → Matrix n n 𝕜)
proof:
:=
  (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n)).toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_cfc
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_cfc (f : ℝ → ℝ) {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (cfc f A) : Matrix n n 𝕜) =
      cfc f (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  exact (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n)).map_cfc f A
    (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn f) continuous_realMatrixComplexification hA
    (hA.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (fun x => by simp))

name: NLAlib.posDef_realMatrixComplexification
statement:
theorem posDef_realMatrixComplexification {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff A).mpr hA.posSemidef |>.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
  exact hA.isUnit.map realMatrixComplexification

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_inv
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_inv {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    (realMatrixComplexification A⁻¹ : Matrix n n 𝕜) = (realMatrixComplexification A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hAc : IsUnit (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :=
    hA.map realMatrixComplexification
  have hCancel : (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n 𝕜) *
      realMatrixComplexification A⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), map_one]
  calc
    (realMatrixComplexification A⁻¹ : Matrix n n 𝕜) =
        (realMatrixComplexification A)⁻¹ *
          (realMatrixComplexification A * realMatrixComplexification A⁻¹) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hAc), Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = (realMatrixComplexification A)⁻¹ := by rw [hCancel, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem singularValues_conjTranspose [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    singularValues Aᴴ = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k < min (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card m)
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    exact singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul h.conjTranspose_mul_right
      h.conjTranspose_mul_left (singularValues_nonneg A) (singularValues_antitone A)
      h.conjTranspose_eq hk
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (not_lt.1 hk),
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (by rw [min_comm]; exact not_lt.1 hk)]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_transpose
statement:
theorem singularValues_transpose [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    singularValues Aᵀ = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact singularValues_conjTranspose A

name: NLAlib.singularValues_isometry_mul
statement:
theorem singularValues_isometry_mul [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    {H : Matrix m p 𝕜} (hH : HasOrthonormalCols H) (A : Matrix p n 𝕜) :
    singularValues (H * A) = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  apply singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Hᴴ H A,
    hH.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    {H : Matrix n p 𝕜} (hH : HasOrthonormalCols H) (A : Matrix m p 𝕜) :
    singularValues (A * Hᴴ) = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← singularValues_conjTranspose (A * Hᴴ), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, singularValues_isometry_mul hH,
    singularValues_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_mul_unitary
statement:
theorem singularValues_mul_unitary [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {V : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    singularValues (A * V) = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  have hVt : HasOrthonormalCols Vᴴ := by
    rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.1 hV
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
    singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose hVt A

name: NLAlib.eigenpair_of_isolated_similarity
statement:
theorem eigenpair_of_isolated_similarity
    (A S : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (μ : K) (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hcol : ∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) j i = if j = i then μ else 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = if j = i then μ else 0) :
    Matrix.col S i ≠ 0 ∧ (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) ≠ 0 ∧
    (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) ⬝ᵥ Matrix.col S i = 1 ∧
    A *ᵥ Matrix.col S i = μ • Matrix.col S i ∧
    (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) ᵥ* A = μ • (fun j => S⁻¹ i j)
proof:
:= by
  let := hS.nonempty_invertible.some
  have hpair : (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) ⬝ᵥ Matrix.col S i = 1 := by
    change (S⁻¹ * S) i i = 1
    rw [Matrix.inv_mul_of_invertible]
    simp
  have hx : Matrix.col S i ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hpair
  have hy : (fun j => S⁻¹ i j) ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, zero_dotProduct] at hpair; exact zero_ne_one hpair
  refine ⟨hx, hy, hpair, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hAS : A * S = S * (S⁻¹ * A * S) := by
      simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mul]
    funext j
    change (A * S) j i = μ * S j i
    rw [hAS, Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [hcol, mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  · have hSA : S⁻¹ * A = (S⁻¹ * A * S) * S⁻¹ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.mul_one]
    funext j
    change (S⁻¹ * A) i j = μ * S⁻¹ i j
    rw [hSA, Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [hrow, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: NLAlib.exists_adjugate_shift_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_adjugate_shift_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_finrank_eigenspace_eq_one
    {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K} {μ : K}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hdim : finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ) = 1) :
    ∃ γ : K, γ ≠ 0 ∧ (μ • (1 : Matrix n n K) - A).adjugate = γ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (μ • (1 : Matrix n n K) - A).mulVecLin =
      Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ := by
    ext z
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.sub_mulVec,
      Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff,
      Matrix.toLin'_apply, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]
  apply exists_adjugate_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_finrank_ker_eq_one _ hx hy
  · rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hAx, sub_self]
  · rw [Matrix.vecMul_sub, Matrix.vecMul_smul, Matrix.vecMul_one, hyA, sub_self]
  · rw [hker, hdim]

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_of_commute
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ a, A a * (A a)ᴴ = (A a)ᴴ * A a)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (A a) (A b)) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : ι → n → ℂ),
      ∀ a, A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (d a) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, T, hT⟩ := exists_simultaneous_unitary_schur_triangularization A hcomm
