    (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  refine ⟨U, fun a => (T a).diag, fun a => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hrep, _, hchar⟩ := hT a
  have hnorm := frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq_of_normal (hA a) (T a).diag hchar
  rw [hrep, frobSq_unitary_similarity] at hnorm
  simp only [Matrix.diag_apply] at hnorm
  have hmass := frobSq_eq_sum_diag_add_frobSq_sub_diagonal (T a)
  have hzero : frobSq (T a - Matrix.diagonal (T a).diag) = 0 := by linarith
  have hdiag : T a = Matrix.diagonal (T a).diag :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp hzero)
  rw [hdiag] at hrep
  exact hrep

name: NLAlib.pairwise_commute_iff_exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem pairwise_commute_iff_exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ a, A a * (A a)ᴴ = (A a)ᴴ * A a) :
    (Pairwise fun a b => Commute (A a) (A b)) ↔
      ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : ι → n → ℂ),
        ∀ a, A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (d a) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_of_commute A hA
  · rintro ⟨U, d, hrep⟩ a b _
    have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
    have hU : IsUnit (U : Matrix n n ℂ) :=
      (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt)
    apply commute_of_simultaneous_diagonalization hU
    · rw [hrep, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.mul_one]
    · rw [hrep, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_with_charpoly
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hdiag : ∀ a, IsDiagonalizable (A a))
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (A a) (A b)) (a₀ : ι) (d₀ : n → ℂ)
    (hd₀ : (A a₀).charpoly = ∏ j, (X - C (d₀ j))) :
    ∃ (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (d : ι → n → ℂ), IsUnit V ∧ d a₀ = d₀ ∧
      ∀ a, A a * V = V * Matrix.diagonal (d a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V, d, hV, hAV⟩ := exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_of_commute A hdiag hcomm
  have hchar : (A a₀).charpoly = ∏ j, (X - C (d a₀ j)) := by
    have hsim : A a₀ = V * Matrix.diagonal (d a₀) * V⁻¹ := by
      rw [← hAV, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv V
        ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mp hV), Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hsim, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul V ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mp hV),
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq d₀ (d a₀) (hd₀.symm.trans hchar)
  let W := V.submatrix id σ
  refine ⟨W, fun a j => d a (σ j), ?_, funext hσ, ?_⟩
  · exact (Matrix.isUnit_submatrix_equiv (Equiv.refl n) σ).mpr hV
  · intro a
    ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i (σ j)) (hAV a)
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h ⊢
    exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization_with_charpoly
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ a, A a * (A a)ᴴ = (A a)ᴴ * A a)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (A a) (A b)) (a₀ : ι) (d₀ : n → ℂ)
    (hd₀ : (A a₀).charpoly = ∏ j, (X - C (d₀ j))) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : ι → n → ℂ), d a₀ = d₀ ∧
      ∀ a, A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (d a) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, d, hrep⟩ := exists_simultaneous_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_of_commute A hA hcomm
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hchar : (A a₀).charpoly = ∏ j, (X - C (d a₀ j)) := by
    rw [hrep, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq d₀ (d a₀) (hd₀.symm.trans hchar)
  let V : Matrix n n ℂ := (U : Matrix n n ℂ).submatrix id σ
  have hVt : Vᴴ * V = 1 := by
    rw [show Vᴴ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ.submatrix σ id from rfl]
    have hmul := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
      σ (Equiv.refl n) σ
    simp only [Equiv.coe_refl] at hmul
    change (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ.submatrix σ id * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).submatrix id σ = 1
    rw [hmul, hUt, Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := ⟨V, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr hVt⟩
  refine ⟨W, fun a j => d a (σ j), funext hσ, fun a => ?_⟩
  have hAU : A a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (d a) := by
    rw [hrep, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hAV : A a * V = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => d a (σ j)) := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i (σ j)) hAU
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hVV : V * Vᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self W
  change A a = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => d a (σ j)) * Vᴴ
  rw [← hAV, Matrix.mul_assoc, hVV, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.det_one_add_X_smul_eq_of_diagonalization
statement:
theorem det_one_add_X_smul_eq_of_diagonalization {G U V : Matrix ι ι R} {d : ι → R}
    (hVU : V * U = 1) (hG : G = U * Matrix.diagonal d * V) :
    Matrix.det (1 + (X : R[X]) • G.map C) =
      Matrix.det (1 + (X : R[X]) • (Matrix.diagonal d).map C)
proof:
:= by
  let Up : Matrix ι ι R[X] := U.map C
  let Vp : Matrix ι ι R[X] := V.map C
  let Dp : Matrix ι ι R[X] := (Matrix.diagonal d).map C
  have hp : Vp * Up = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix ι ι R => M.map C) hVU
    simpa [Up, Vp, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.map_one] using h
  have hp' : Up * Vp = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 hp
  have hg : G.map C = Up * Dp * Vp := by
    rw [hG, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.map_mul]
  have he : 1 + (X : R[X]) • G.map C = Up * (1 + (X : R[X]) • Dp) * Vp := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hp']
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hg]
  have hd : Up.det * Vp.det = 1 := by rw [← Matrix.det_mul, hp', Matrix.det_one]
  rw [he, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul]
  dsimp only [Dp]
  calc
    Up.det * (1 + (X : R[X]) • (Matrix.diagonal d).map C).det * Vp.det =
        (Up.det * Vp.det) * (1 + (X : R[X]) • (Matrix.diagonal d).map C).det := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hd, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod_of_diagonalization
statement:
theorem sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod_of_diagonalization
    {G U V : Matrix ι ι R} {d : ι → R} (hVU : V * U = 1)
    (hG : G = U * Matrix.diagonal d * V) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, (G.submatrix
      (Subtype.val : S → ι) (Subtype.val : S → ι)).det) =
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors,
    det_one_add_X_smul_eq_of_diagonalization hVU hG,
    Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  have hD : (Matrix.diagonal d).submatrix (Subtype.val : S → ι) (Subtype.val : S → ι) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : S => d i) := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  rw [hD, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  exact Finset.prod_coe_sort S d

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod
    {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {G : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hG : G.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, (G.submatrix
      (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det) =
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, (hG.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : G = (hG.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hG.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) *
      star (hG.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) := by
    simpa [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Function.comp_def] using hG.spectral_theorem
  exact NLAlib.sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod_of_diagonalization
    (Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hG.eigenvectorUnitary) hd k

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.sum_re_det_submatrix_eq_factorial_mul_sum_prod_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.sum_re_det_submatrix_eq_factorial_mul_sum_prod_eigenvalues₀
    {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ h : Fin k → n, RCLike.re (A.submatrix h h).det) =
      (k.factorial : ℝ) *
        ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).powersetCard k,
          ∏ i ∈ S, hA.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have hSort :
      (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).powersetCard k,
        ∏ i ∈ S, (hA.eigenvalues₀ i : 𝕜)) =
      ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, (hA.eigenvalues i : 𝕜) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
      Finset.sum_powersetCard_prod_equiv e (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) k
  have hm := NLAlib.sum_det_submatrix_eq_factorial_mul_sum_principalMinors A k
  rw [hA.sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod, ← hSort] at hm
  have hh := congrArg RCLike.re hm
  simpa only [map_sum, RCLike.mul_re, RCLike.natCast_re, RCLike.natCast_im, zero_mul,
    sub_zero, ← RCLike.ofReal_prod, RCLike.ofReal_re] using hh

name: NLAlib.mem_numericalRange_iff
statement:
theorem mem_numericalRange_iff (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    z ∈ numericalRange A ↔ ∃ x : n → ℂ,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1 ∧ quadForm A x = z
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: NLAlib.isCompact_numericalRange
statement: theorem isCompact_numericalRange (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : IsCompact (numericalRange A)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n => quadForm A x.ofLp) := by
    unfold quadForm
    exact (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 (fun _ : n => ℂ)).star.dotProduct
      (continuous_const.matrix_mulVec (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 (fun _ : n => ℂ)))
  have heq : numericalRange A = (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n => quadForm A x.ofLp) ''
      Metric.sphere 0 1 := by
    ext z
    simp only [numericalRange, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_image, Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hz⟩
      exact ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 x, hx, hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hz⟩
      exact ⟨x.ofLp, hx, hz⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1).image hc

name: NLAlib.norm_quadForm_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem norm_quadForm_le_specNorm {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖quadForm A x‖ ≤ specNorm A * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi : inner 𝕜 (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) = quadForm A x := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
    rfl
  have hh := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
  rw [hi] at hh
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hh
    _ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ * (specNorm A * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖) := by
      gcongr
      open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
      exact A.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_le_specNorm_of_mem_numericalRange
statement:
theorem norm_le_specNorm_of_mem_numericalRange {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ numericalRange A) : ‖z‖ ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
  simpa only [hx, one_pow, mul_one] using norm_quadForm_le_specNorm A x

name: NLAlib.star_dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one
statement:
theorem star_dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one {x : n → ℂ}
    (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) : star x ⬝ᵥ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    star x ⬝ᵥ x = inner ℂ (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (WithLp.toLp 2 x) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
    _ = (‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 := inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K _
    _ = 1 := by rw [hx]; norm_num

name: NLAlib.spectrum_subset_numericalRange
statement:
theorem spectrum_subset_numericalRange (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    spectrum ℂ A ⊆ numericalRange A
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hz
  have hx' : (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hx
    exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp h
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ≠ 0 := (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx').ne'
  let c : ℂ := (‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ : ℂ)⁻¹
  have hc : ‖c‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖⁻¹ := by
    simp [c, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real]
  have hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c • x)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, hc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
  refine ⟨c • x, hu, ?_⟩
  have heigen : A *ᵥ (c • x) = z • (c • x) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, hAx, smul_comm]
  rw [quadForm, heigen, dotProduct_smul,
    star_dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.numericalRange_smul_add_smul_one
statement:
theorem numericalRange_smul_add_smul_one (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (α β : ℂ) :
    numericalRange (α • A + β • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) =
      (fun z => α * z + β) '' numericalRange A
proof:
:= by
  have hform (x : n → ℂ) (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) :
      quadForm (α • A + β • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) x = α * quadForm A x + β := by
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      star_dotProduct_self_eq_one_of_norm_toLp_eq_one hx, mul_one]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨quadForm A x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (hform x hx).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, hform x hx⟩

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_mulVec_of_hasOrthonormalCols
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  rw [← quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    quadForm_def, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.numericalRange_conjTranspose_mul_mul_subset
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, hz⟩
  refine ⟨Q *ᵥ x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_toLp_mulVec_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ, hx]
  · rw [← quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    exact hz

name: NLAlib.numericalRange_unitary_conjTranspose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem numericalRange_unitary_conjTranspose_mul_mul
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    numericalRange ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) = numericalRange A
proof:
:= by
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    change (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hUt : HasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    change (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      star_star, Unitary.coe_star]
      using Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm (numericalRange_conjTranspose_mul_mul_subset hU A)
  have h := numericalRange_conjTranspose_mul_mul_subset hUt
    ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ))
  have heq : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = A := by
    have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := by
      simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star] using
        Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
    calc
      _ = ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) * A *
          ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A := by rw [hUU, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, heq] using h

name: NLAlib.re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq
statement:
private theorem re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq (u : m → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (star u ⬝ᵥ u) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, map_sum, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul,
    ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.norm_le_mul_norm_of_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq, re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq, ← mul_pow] at h
  exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hc (norm_nonneg _)) two_ne_zero).1 h

name: NLAlib.le_of_norm_le_mul_norm
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq, re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq, ← mul_pow]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_le_specNorm_mul
statement:
private theorem norm_mulVec_le_specNorm_mul (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ specNorm B * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq B x
  refine norm_le_mul_norm_of_le (specNorm_nonneg B) ?_
  rw [re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq, re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_norm_sq,
    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.singularValues_add_add_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_add_add_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i j : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A + B) (i + j) ≤ singularValues A i + singularValues B j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, hA⟩ := exists_submodule_mulVec_dotProduct_le_sq_singularValues_mul A i
  obtain ⟨W₂, h₂, hB⟩ := exists_submodule_mulVec_dotProduct_le_sq_singularValues_mul B j
  have hσA := singularValues_nonneg A i
  have hσB := singularValues_nonneg B j
  have hW := card_le_finrank_inf_add h₁ h₂
  refine singularValues_le_of_forall_mem (A + B) (i + j) (W₁ ⊓ W₂) hW (add_nonneg hσA hσB)
    fun x hx => le_of_norm_le_mul_norm ?_
  have ha := norm_le_mul_norm_of_le hσA (hA x hx.1)
  have hb := norm_le_mul_norm_of_le hσB (hB x hx.2)
  calc ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((A + B) *ᵥ x)‖
      ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ x)‖ := by
        rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, WithLp.toLp_add]; exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (singularValues A i + singularValues B j) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ := by linarith

name: NLAlib.singularValues_add_le_add_specNorm
statement:
theorem singularValues_add_le_add_specNorm (A E : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A + E) k ≤ singularValues A k + specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_add_add_le A E k 0
  rwa [Nat.add_zero, singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm] at h

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_singularValues_add_add_specNorm
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_singularValues_add_add_specNorm (A E : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (k : ℕ) : singularValues A k ≤ singularValues (A + E) k + specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_add_le_add_specNorm (A + E) (-E) k
  rwa [add_neg_cancel_right, specNorm_neg] at h

name: NLAlib.abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_specNorm (A E : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    |singularValues (A + E) k - singularValues A k| ≤ specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := singularValues_add_le_add_specNorm A E k
  have h2 := singularValues_le_singularValues_add_add_specNorm A E k
  rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_singularValues_sub_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_singularValues_sub_le_specNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    |singularValues A k - singularValues B k| ≤ specNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_singularValues_add_sub_le_specNorm B (A - B) k
  rwa [add_sub_cancel] at h

name: NLAlib.abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    |singularValues A k - singularValues B k| ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:=
  (abs_singularValues_sub_le_specNorm A B k).trans (specNorm_le_frobNorm _)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_mul_le_specNorm_mul
statement:
theorem singularValues_mul_le_specNorm_mul (B : Matrix p m 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (B * A) k ≤ specNorm B * singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hA⟩ := exists_submodule_mulVec_dotProduct_le_sq_singularValues_mul A k
  have hσ := singularValues_nonneg A k
  have hB := specNorm_nonneg B
  refine singularValues_le_of_forall_mem (B * A) k W hW (mul_nonneg hB hσ)
    fun x hx => le_of_norm_le_mul_norm ?_
  have ha := norm_le_mul_norm_of_le hσ (hA x hx)
  calc ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((B * A) *ᵥ x)‖
      ≤ specNorm B * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]; exact norm_mulVec_le_specNorm_mul B _
    _ ≤ specNorm B * (singularValues A k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hB
    _ = specNorm B * singularValues A k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ := by ring

name: NLAlib.singularValues_mul_le_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem singularValues_mul_le_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n p 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A * C) k ≤ singularValues A k * specNorm C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hA⟩ := exists_submodule_mulVec_dotProduct_le_sq_singularValues_mul A k
  have hσ := singularValues_nonneg A k
  have hC := specNorm_nonneg C
  
  have hdim : Fintype.card p ≤ Module.finrank 𝕜 (W.comap C.mulVecLin) + k := by
    set g := W.mkQ ∘ₗ C.mulVecLin
    have hker : LinearMap.ker g = W.comap C.mulVecLin := by
      ext x; simp [g, Submodule.mem_comap]
    have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
    have h2 : Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range g) ≤ Module.finrank 𝕜 ((n → 𝕜) ⧸ W) :=
      Submodule.finrank_le _
    have h3 := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank W
    rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at h1 h3
    rw [hker] at h1
    omega
  refine singularValues_le_of_forall_mem (A * C) k _ hdim (mul_nonneg hσ hC)
    fun x hx => le_of_norm_le_mul_norm ?_
  have ha := norm_le_mul_norm_of_le hσ (hA (C *ᵥ x) hx)
  calc ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((A * C) *ᵥ x)‖
      ≤ singularValues A k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ x)‖ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]; exact ha
    _ ≤ singularValues A k * (specNorm C * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_mulVec_le_specNorm_mul C x) hσ
    _ = singularValues A k * specNorm C * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ := by ring

name: NLAlib.singularValues_residual_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_residual_le {q : Type*} [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (k : ℕ) : singularValues (projResidual Q A) k ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP : specNorm (1 - Q * Qᴴ : Matrix m m 𝕜) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hQ (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    rw [Matrix.mul_one] at h
    exact h.trans specNorm_one_le
  rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul]
  calc singularValues ((1 - Q * Qᴴ) * A) k ≤ specNorm (1 - Q * Qᴴ) * singularValues A k :=
        singularValues_mul_le_specNorm_mul _ A k
    _ ≤ 1 * singularValues A k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (singularValues_nonneg A k)
    _ = singularValues A k := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ}
    (hB : B.rank ≤ k) : singularValues A k ≤ specNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_add_add_le (A - B) B 0 k
  rwa [sub_add_cancel, Nat.zero_add, singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm,
    singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le B hB, add_zero] at h

name: NLAlib.isLeast_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨truncatedSVD A k, (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD A k).1,
    (specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq A k).symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro v ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
  exact singularValues_le_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le A B hB

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_singularValues_add_sub_le_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_singularValues_add_sub_le_frobSq (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        (singularValues (A + E) k - singularValues A k) ^ 2 ≤ frobSq E
proof:
:= by
  have hvN := (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul (A + E) A)
  have hF : frobSq E = frobSq (A + E) - 2 * frobInner (A + E) A + frobSq A := by
    rw [← frobSq_sub]
    congr 1
    abel
  set N := min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
  have hexp : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
      (singularValues (A + E) k - singularValues A k) ^ 2 =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues (A + E) k ^ 2 -
        2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues (A + E) k * singularValues A k +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A k ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
  rw [hexp, hF, frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues, frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm A ^ 2 = specNorm (Aᴴ * A)
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in unfold specNorm
  rw [sq, ← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm A ^ 2 = specNorm (Aᵀ * A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self A

name: NLAlib.singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : singularValues A 0 = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : Fintype.card n = 0
  · have : IsEmpty n := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hn
    have hA : A = 0 := by ext i j; exact isEmptyElim j
    rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A (by omega), hA, specNorm_zero]
  · have hnpos : 0 < Fintype.card n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    have hGram : specNorm (Aᴴ * A) =
        ‖(fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))‖ := by
      rw [hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_self,
        specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right,
        specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right,
        specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    have hMax : ‖(fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))‖ =
        singularValues A 0 ^ 2 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)).2
        intro j
        rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A j)
          (singularValues_antitone A (Nat.zero_le _)) 2
      · have h0 := norm_le_pi_norm
          (fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n) => ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) ⟨0, hnpos⟩
        change ‖((singularValues A 0 ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)‖ ≤ _ at h0
        rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (singularValues A 0))] at h0
        exact h0
    have hSq := specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self A
    rw [hGram, hMax] at hSq
    nlinarith [singularValues_nonneg A 0, specNorm_nonneg A]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_specNorm {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A k ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:=
  (singularValues_antitone A (Nat.zero_le k)).trans_eq (singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm A)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gram_sub_one_eq_norm_singularValues_sq_sub_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => singularValues A j ^ 2 - 1)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => singularValues A j ^ 2) - 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, ← Matrix.diagonal_sub]
  have hGram : Aᵀ * A - 1 =
      V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => singularValues A j ^ 2 - 1) * Vᵀ := by
    rw [show Aᵀ * A = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => singularValues A j ^ 2) * Vᵀ from
        hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_self, hdiag, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one, show V * Vᵀ = 1 from hSVD.mul_conjTranspose_right]
  rw [hGram, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial V,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := V) hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := V) hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ x) from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self A x,
    show Aᵀ * A = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin q => singularValues A j ^ 2) * Vᵀ from
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_pos_iff_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem singularValues_last_pos_iff_rank_eq_card {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    0 < singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1) ↔ A.rank = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  rw [singularValues_pos_iff]
  have hr := A.rank_le_card_width
  omega

name: NLAlib.charpolyRootCountIn_eq_card_filter
statement:
theorem charpolyRootCountIn_eq_card_filter (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (K : Set ℂ)
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    charpolyRootCountIn A K = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i ∈ K)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hroots : (∏ i, (X - C (d i))).roots = Finset.univ.val.map d := by
    rw [Polynomial.roots_prod]
    · simp only [Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Multiset.bind_singleton]
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (d i))
  dsimp only [charpolyRootCountIn]
  rw [hd, hroots, Multiset.countP_map]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.charpolyRootCountIn_le_card
statement:
theorem charpolyRootCountIn_le_card (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (K : Set ℂ) :
    charpolyRootCountIn A K ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, T, _, _, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  rw [charpolyRootCountIn_eq_card_filter A K (fun i => T i i) hchar]
  exact Finset.card_filter_le Finset.univ (fun i => T i i ∈ K)

name: NLAlib.charpoly_eq_prod_of_eval_eq
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_prod_of_eval_eq (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ j : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1),
      A.charpoly.eval (j.val : ℂ) = ∏ i, ((j.val : ℂ) - d i)) :
    A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq A.charpoly (∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (f := fun j : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) => (j.val : ℂ))
  · intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp at hij
    exact_mod_cast hij
  · intro j
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] using h j
  · simp only [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, Polynomial.natDegree_finsetProd_X_sub_C_eq_card,
      Finset.card_univ, max_self, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.lt_succ_self]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors_of_normal {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) :
    ∃ (b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) (d : n → ℂ),
      ∀ j, A *ᵥ ⇑(b j) = d j • ⇑(b j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  let H : Matrix n n ℂ := realPart A
  let K : Matrix n n ℂ := imaginaryPart A
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := (realPart A).property
  have hK : K.IsHermitian := (imaginaryPart A).property
  have hHC : H.toEuclideanLin.IsSymmetric := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hH
  have hKC : K.toEuclideanLin.IsSymmetric := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hK
  have hcomm : Commute H.toEuclideanLin K.toEuclideanLin :=
    (Commute.realPart_imaginaryPart A).map
      (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℂ n)).toRingHom
  let W (χ : ℂ × ℂ) : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :=
    Module.End.eigenspace H.toEuclideanLin χ.2 ⊓ Module.End.eigenspace K.toEuclideanLin χ.1
  have hW : DirectSum.IsInternal W := hHC.directSum_isInternal_of_commute hKC hcomm
  have hfinite : Set.Finite {χ | W χ ≠ ⊥} :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep hW.submodule_iSupIndep
  let : Fintype {χ : ℂ × ℂ // W χ ≠ ⊥} := hfinite.fintype
  let W' (χ : {χ // W χ ≠ ⊥}) := W χ
  have hW' : DirectSum.IsInternal W' := DirectSum.isInternal_ne_bot_iff.mpr hW
  have horth := (hHC.orthogonalFamily_eigenspace_inf_eigenspace hKC).comp
    (Subtype.val_injective : Function.Injective (fun χ : {χ // W χ ≠ ⊥} => χ.val))
  let b₀ := hW'.subordinateOrthonormalBasis (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ)) horth
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := b₀.reindex e
  let χ (j : n) := hW'.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex
    (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ)) (e.symm j) horth
  let d (j : n) : ℂ := (χ j).val.2 + I * (χ j).val.1
  refine ⟨b, d, fun j => ?_⟩
  have hmem : b j ∈ W' (χ j) := by
    simp only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply]
    exact hW'.subordinateOrthonormalBasis_subordinate
      (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ)) (e.symm j) horth
  have hHj : H.toEuclideanLin (b j) = (χ j).val.2 • b j :=
    Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hmem.1
  have hKj : K.toEuclideanLin (b j) = (χ j).val.1 • b j :=
    Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hmem.2
  have hdecomp : A = H + I • K := (realPart_add_I_smul_imaginaryPart A).symm
  have heig : A.toEuclideanLin (b j) = d j • b j := by
    rw [hdecomp, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      hHj, hKj, smul_smul, ← add_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℂ n => ⇑v) heig

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ),
      A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, d, hb⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors_of_normal hA
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis,
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  have hAU : A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    ext i j
    have hcol : ∀ k, (U : Matrix n n ℂ) k j = (b j) k := fun _ => rfl
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, hcol, Matrix.mulVec,
      dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using congrFun (hb j) i
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 :=
    Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  refine ⟨U, d, ?_⟩
  calc
    A = A * ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) := by
      rw [hUU, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAU]

name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_unitary_diagonalization
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) :
    A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 :=
    Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  rw [hA]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ),
    hUU, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hD : d * star d = star d * d := funext fun i => mul_comm (d i) (star (d i))
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.diagonal d), ← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.diagonal (star d)),
    Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  change (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (Matrix.diagonal (d * star d) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) =
    (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (Matrix.diagonal (star d * d) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
  rw [hD]

name: NLAlib.normal_iff_exists_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem normal_iff_exists_unitary_diagonalization (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A ↔ ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ),
      A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal,
    fun ⟨U, d, hA⟩ => mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_unitary_diagonalization U d hA⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_qz_triangularization
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_qz_triangularization
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ (V W T₁ T₂ : Matrix n n ℝ), HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
      A = V * T₁ * Wᵀ ∧ B = V * T₂ * Wᵀ ∧
      IsUpperQuasiTriangular (T₁.submatrix order order) ∧
      (∀ i j, order.symm j < order.symm i → T₂ i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e₀, f₀, hA₀, hB₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBases_real_pencil_upper_quasi_triangular
    (Fintype.card n) A.toEuclideanLin B.toEuclideanLin
    (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℝ)) (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℝ))
  let e : OrthonormalBasis n ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ n) := e₀.reindex order
  let f : OrthonormalBasis n ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ n) := f₀.reindex order
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℝ
  let V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℝ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix f.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary f⟩
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℝ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix e.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary e⟩
  let T (M : Matrix n n ℝ) := M.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis
  have hVorth : HasOrthonormalCols (V : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    have h : (V : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (V : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
    simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      h
  have hWorth : HasOrthonormalCols (W : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    have h : (W : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (W : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self W
    simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      h
  have hWW : (W : Matrix n n ℝ) * (W : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ = 1 := by
    have h : (W : Matrix n n ℝ) * (W : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self W
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using h
  have hback : e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (W : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
      (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse hWW) |>.mul_left_cancel
    change c.toBasis.toMatrix e.toBasis * e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
      (W : Matrix n n ℝ) * (W : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
    rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, hWW]
  have hFactor (M : Matrix n n ℝ) : M = (V : Matrix n n ℝ) * T M * (W : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
    have hh := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis e.toBasis c.toBasis f.toBasis M.toEuclideanLin
    have hstd : M.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = M :=
      LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis M
    rw [hback, hstd] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  refine ⟨V, W, T A, T B, hVorth, hWorth, hFactor A, hFactor B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcoords : (T A).submatrix order order = A.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix e₀.toBasis f₀.toBasis := by
      ext i j
      simp only [T, Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
        OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, e, f, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [hcoords]
    exact hA₀
  · intro i j hij
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    have h := hB₀ (i := order.symm i) (j := order.symm j) hij
    simpa only [e, f, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    exact hT (show j < i by omega)
  · intro i j l hij _
    exact Or.inl (hT (show j < i by omega))

name: NLAlib.mul_apply_subdiagonal_of_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem mul_apply_subdiagonal_of_upperTriangular
    {k : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Semiring K] {R T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) K}
    (hR : R.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : IsUpperQuasiTriangular T)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : j.val + 1 = i.val) : (R * T) i j = R i i * T i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
  · intro l _ hli
    by_cases hlt : l < i
    · rw [hR hlt, zero_mul]
    · rw [hT.1 l j (by have := Fin.val_ne_of_ne hli; omega), mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.IsUpperQuasiTriangular.upperTriangular_mul
statement:
theorem IsUpperQuasiTriangular.upperTriangular_mul
    {k : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Semiring K] {R T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) K}
    (hT : IsUpperQuasiTriangular T) (hR : R.IsUpperTriangular) :
    IsUpperQuasiTriangular (R * T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro l _
    by_cases hlt : l < i
    · rw [hR hlt, zero_mul]
    · rw [hT.1 l j (by omega), mul_zero]
  · intro i j l hij hjl
    rw [mul_apply_subdiagonal_of_upperTriangular hR hT hij,
      mul_apply_subdiagonal_of_upperTriangular hR hT hjl]
    rcases hT.2 i j l hij hjl with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [h, mul_zero])
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [h, mul_zero])

name: NLAlib.isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_first_column_and_tail
statement:
theorem isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_first_column_and_tail
    {k : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Zero K] {T : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) K}
    (hcol : ∀ i : Fin k, T i.succ 0 = 0)
    (htail : IsUpperQuasiTriangular (T.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ)) :
    IsUpperQuasiTriangular T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    revert hij
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · intro hij
      have hi : i ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hij
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero hi
      exact hcol i
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · intro h; simp at h
      · intro h
        exact htail.1 i j (by simpa using h)
  · intro i j l hij hjl
    have hi : i ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hij
    have hj : j ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hjl
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero hi
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero hj
    revert hjl
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun l => ?_) l
    · intro _; exact Or.inr (hcol j)
    · intro hjl
      exact htail.2 i j l (by simpa using hij) (by simpa using hjl)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resolvent_eq_pi_norm
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_conj_diagonal hA hζ, specNorm_eq_norm,
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  change ‖(hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ζ - (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))⁻¹) *
    ((star hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ = _
  rw [CStarRing.norm_mul_coe_unitary, CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary_mul,
    Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_spectrum_specNorm_resolvent_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : n → ℂ := fun i => (ζ - (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))⁻¹
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun j => ‖f j‖)
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨hA.eigenvalues i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rw [specNorm_resolvent_eq_pi_norm hA hζ]
    have heq : ‖f‖ = ‖f i‖ := le_antisymm
      ((pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).mpr (fun j => hi j (Finset.mem_univ j)))
      (norm_le_pi_norm f i)
    simpa only [f, norm_inv] using heq

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resolvent_eq_inv_of_mem_spectrum
proof:
:= by
  have hζ : ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using ne_of_gt hη
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero,
      add_zero, zero_add, abs_of_pos hη] using hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  · rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hξ
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hξ
    rw [specNorm_resolvent_eq_pi_norm hA hζ]
    have hnorm : ‖((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))⁻¹‖ = η⁻¹ := by
      rw [hi]
      have hs : (ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (ξ : ℂ) = (η : ℂ) * Complex.I := by ring
      rw [hs, norm_inv, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I,
        mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hη]
    rw [← hnorm]
    exact norm_le_pi_norm (fun j : n =>
      (((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (hA.eigenvalues j : ℂ))⁻¹) i

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison
statement:
theorem exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {ξ η C δ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hδ : δ ≤ (2 * η)⁻¹)
    (hcmp : specNorm (resolvent A ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤
      C * specNorm (resolvent B ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) + δ) :
    ∃ β ∈ spectrum ℝ B, dist ξ β ≤ 2 * C * η
proof:
:= by
  have hζ : ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using ne_of_gt hη
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, hnorm⟩ := exists_mem_spectrum_specNorm_resolvent_eq hB hζ
  rw [specNorm_resolvent_eq_inv_of_mem_spectrum hA hξ hη, hnorm] at hcmp
  have hdpos : 0 < ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ := by
    apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
    intro hz
    have hh := congrArg Complex.im hz
    exact hζ (by simpa using hh)
  have hhalf : (2 * η)⁻¹ ≤ C * ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖⁻¹ := by
    have hs : η⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * η)⁻¹ := by field_simp
    linarith
  have hnormle : ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * C * η := by
    have hs := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhalf (le_of_lt hdpos))
    rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hdpos), mul_one] at hs
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * η)
    have heq : ((2 * η)⁻¹ * ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖) * (2 * η) =
        ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ := by field_simp
    rw [heq] at hm
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨β, hβ, ?_⟩
  have hre := Complex.abs_re_le_norm ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ))
  have hre' : dist ξ β ≤ ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero] using hre
  exact hre'.trans hnormle

name: NLAlib.hausdorffDist_spectrum_le_of_resolvent_comparison
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_spectrum_le_of_resolvent_comparison
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {η C δ : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hδ : δ ≤ (2 * η)⁻¹)
    (hAB : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A,
      specNorm (resolvent A ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤
        C * specNorm (resolvent B ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) + δ)
    (hBA : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ B,
      specNorm (resolvent B ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤
        C * specNorm (resolvent A ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) + δ) :
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ A) (spectrum ℝ B) ≤ 2 * C * η
proof:
:= by
  have hAB' (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A) :=
    exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison hA hB hξ hη hδ (hAB ξ hξ)
  have hBA' (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ B) :=
    exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison hB hA hξ hη hδ (hBA ξ hξ)
  have hR : 0 ≤ 2 * C * η := by
    have hn : (spectrum ℝ A).Nonempty := by
      rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
      exact Set.range_nonempty _
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := hn
    obtain ⟨β, _, hb⟩ := hAB' ξ hξ
    exact dist_nonneg.trans hb
  exact Metric.hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist hR hAB' hBA'

name: NLAlib.resolvent_error_le_half_inv
statement:
private theorem resolvent_error_le_half_inv {η K₁ K₂ K₃ : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (h₁ : 6 * K₁ ≤ η) (h₂ : 6 * K₂ ≤ η ^ 2)
    (h₃ : 6 * K₃ ≤ η ^ 3) :
    K₁ / η ^ 2 + K₂ / η ^ 3 + K₃ / η ^ 4 ≤ (2 * η)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hn : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη
  have hsum : K₁ / η ^ 2 + K₂ / η ^ 3 + K₃ / η ^ 4 =
      (K₁ * η ^ 2 + K₂ * η + K₃) / η ^ 4 := by field_simp
  rw [hsum]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < η ^ 4)).mpr
  have heq : (2 * η)⁻¹ * η ^ 4 = η ^ 3 / 2 := by field_simp
  rw [heq]
  have h₁' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₁ (sq_nonneg η)
  have h₂' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₂ hη.le
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_error_bounds
statement:
theorem forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_error_bounds
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {η C K₁ K₂ K₃ : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (h₁ : 6 * K₁ ≤ η) (h₂ : 6 * K₂ ≤ η ^ 2) (h₃ : 6 * K₃ ≤ η ^ 3)
    (hAB : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A,
      specNorm (resolvent A ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤
        C * specNorm (resolvent B ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)) +
          K₁ / η ^ 2 + K₂ / η ^ 3 + K₃ / η ^ 4) :
    ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∃ β ∈ spectrum ℝ B, dist ξ β ≤ 2 * C * η
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ hξ
  apply exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison hA hB hξ hη
    (resolvent_error_le_half_inv hη h₁ h₂ h₃)
  simpa only [add_assoc] using hAB ξ hξ

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_add_le
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_add_le [Nonempty n] (A B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    lambdaMax (A + B) ≤ lambdaMax A + lambdaMax B
proof:
:= by
  let z : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩
  have h := hA.eigenvalues₀_add_le hB z z (by simpa only [z, zero_add] using Fintype.card_pos (α := n))
  rw [lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero (hA.add hB),
    lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero hA, lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero hB]
  simpa only [z, zero_add] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_lambdaMax_sub_le_specNorm_sub
statement:
theorem abs_lambdaMax_sub_le_specNorm_sub [Nonempty n]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    |lambdaMax A - lambdaMax B| ≤ specNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := lambdaMax_add_le B (A - B) hB (hA.sub hB)
  have h2 := lambdaMax_add_le A (B - A) hA (hB.sub hA)
  have hb1 := (hA.sub hB).lambdaMax_le_specNorm
  have hb2 := (hB.sub hA).lambdaMax_le_specNorm
  have he : specNorm (B - A) = specNorm (A - B) := by
    rw [← neg_sub A B, specNorm_neg]
  have hBA : B + (A - B) = A := by abel
  have hAB : A + (B - A) = B := by abel
  rw [hBA] at h1
  rw [hAB] at h2
  rw [he] at hb2
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart
statement:
theorem continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart [Nonempty n] :
    Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ =>
      lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  let f : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) → ℝ := fun A => lambdaMax (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
  have hf : LipschitzWith 1 f := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro A B
    simp only [f, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm]
    change |lambdaMax (A : Matrix n n ℂ) - lambdaMax (B : Matrix n n ℂ)| ≤
      ‖(A : Matrix n n ℂ) - (B : Matrix n n ℂ)‖
    simpa only [one_mul, specNorm_eq_norm] using
      abs_lambdaMax_sub_le_specNorm_sub (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
        A.property.isHermitian B.property.isHermitian
  have hp : Continuous (selfAdjointPart ℝ : Matrix n n ℂ → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap.continuous
  exact hf.continuous.comp hp

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_smul_add_smul_le
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_smul_add_smul_le [Nonempty n]
    (D Z : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hZ : Z.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    lambdaMax (a • D + b • Z) ≤
      a * lambdaMax (D + Z) + (b - a) * lambdaMax Z
proof:
:= by
  have he : a • D + b • Z = a • (D + Z) + (b - a) • Z := by
    rw [smul_add, sub_smul]
    abel
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ lambdaMax (a • (D + Z)) + lambdaMax ((b - a) • Z) :=
      lambdaMax_add_le _ _ ((hD.add hZ).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all a))
        (hZ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all (b - a)))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [lambdaMax_smul_of_nonneg _ ha,
        lambdaMax_smul_of_nonneg _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]

name: NLAlib.exists_isUnit_add_smul_of_isUnit_complex_pencil
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_add_smul_of_isUnit_complex_pencil (C D : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hS : IsUnit (C.map Complex.ofReal + Complex.I • D.map Complex.ofReal)) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, IsUnit (C + t • D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : Matrix n n ℝ[X] := fun i j => Polynomial.C (C i j) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (D i j)
  let p : ℝ[X] := M.det
  have hcomplex : p.eval₂ Complex.ofRealHom Complex.I =
      (C.map Complex.ofReal + Complex.I • D.map Complex.ofReal).det := by
    change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom Complex.ofRealHom Complex.I) M.det = _
    rw [RingHom.map_det]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    change Polynomial.eval₂ Complex.ofRealHom Complex.I
      (Polynomial.C (C i j) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (D i j)) =
        Complex.ofReal (C i j) + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal (D i j)
    simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_C,
      Polynomial.eval₂_X]
    rfl
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp0
    have hdet := (C.map Complex.ofReal + Complex.I • D.map Complex.ofReal).isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hS
    rw [← hcomplex, hp0, Polynomial.eval₂_zero] at hdet
    exact not_isUnit_zero hdet
  have ht : ∃ t : ℝ, p.eval t ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hp
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro t
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_zero] using h t
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ht
  refine ⟨t, (C + t • D).isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mpr ?_⟩
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  have heval : p.eval t = (C + t • D).det := by
    change (Polynomial.evalRingHom t) M.det = _
    rw [RingHom.map_det]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    change Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.C (C i j) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (D i j)) =
      C i j + t * D i j
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]
  exact heval ▸ ht

name: NLAlib.real_imaginary_parts_intertwine
statement:
theorem real_imaginary_parts_intertwine {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} {S : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : A.map Complex.ofReal * S = S * B.map Complex.ofReal) :
    A * S.map Complex.re = S.map Complex.re * B ∧
      A * S.map Complex.im = S.map Complex.im * B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => (M i j).re) hS
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.re_sum, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero] using h
  · ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => (M i j).im) hS
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.im_sum, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_real_isUnit_intertwiner_of_complex
statement:
theorem exists_real_isUnit_intertwiner_of_complex {A B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ}
    {S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hAB : ∀ i, (A i).map Complex.ofReal * S = S * (B i).map Complex.ofReal) :
    ∃ T : Matrix n n ℝ, IsUnit T ∧ ∀ i, A i * T = T * B i
proof:
:= by
  let C := S.map Complex.re
  let D := S.map Complex.im
  have hsplit : S = C.map Complex.ofReal + Complex.I • D.map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j
    simpa only [C, D, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using (Complex.re_add_im (S i j)).symm
  have hCD := hsplit ▸ hS
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_isUnit_add_smul_of_isUnit_complex_pencil C D hCD
  refine ⟨C + t • D, ht, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hparts := real_imaginary_parts_intertwine (hAB i)
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    hparts.1, hparts.2]

name: NLAlib.exists_real_similarity_of_complex_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_real_similarity_of_complex_similarity {A B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ}
    {S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hAB : ∀ i, (A i).map Complex.ofReal = S * (B i).map Complex.ofReal * S⁻¹) :
    ∃ T : Matrix n n ℝ, IsUnit T ∧ ∀ i, A i = T * B i * T⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hinter (i : ι) : (A i).map Complex.ofReal * S = S * (B i).map Complex.ofReal := by
    rw [hAB i, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul S (S.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hS),
      Matrix.mul_one]
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hAT⟩ := exists_real_isUnit_intertwiner_of_complex hS hinter
  refine ⟨T, hT, fun i => ?_⟩
  calc
    A i = A i * (T * T⁻¹) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv T (T.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hT), Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAT i]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_real_schur
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_real_schur {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ Q T : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧
      A = Q * T * Qᵀ ∧ IsRealSchurForm (T.submatrix order order)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_real_schur (Fintype.card n)
    A.toEuclideanLin (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℝ))
  let b : OrthonormalBasis n ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ n) := b₀.reindex order
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℝ
  let Q : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℝ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  let T := A.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    have h : (Q : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self Q
    simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using h
  have hQQ : (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) * (Q : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ
  have hback : b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (Q : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
    calc
      b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
          b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * ((Q : Matrix n n ℝ) * (Q : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ) := by
            rw [hQQ, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (Q : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
        change (b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis) * _ = _
        rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hFactor : A = (Q : Matrix n n ℝ) * T * (Q : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
    have h := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis A.toEuclideanLin
    have hstd : A.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = A :=
      LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis A
    rw [hback, hstd] at h
    exact h.symm
  refine ⟨Q, T, hQ, hFactor, ?_⟩
  have hcoords : T.submatrix order order = A.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix b₀.toBasis b₀.toBasis := by
    ext i j
    simp only [T, Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rwa [hcoords]

name: NLAlib.isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_small_leading_block
statement:
theorem isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_small_leading_block {p q : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Zero K]
    {T : Matrix (Fin (p + q)) (Fin (p + q)) K} (hp : p ≤ 2)
    (hzero : ∀ i : Fin q, ∀ j : Fin p, T (Fin.natAdd p i) (Fin.castAdd q j) = 0)
    (htail : IsUpperQuasiTriangular (T.submatrix (Fin.natAdd p) (Fin.natAdd p))) :
    IsUpperQuasiTriangular T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) i <;>
      refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) j
    · intro h; have := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd] at h; omega
    · intro h; have := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd] at h; omega
    · intro _; exact hzero i j
    · intro h; exact htail.1 i j (by simp only [Fin.val_natAdd] at h; omega)
  · intro i j l
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) i <;>
      refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) j <;>
      refine Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) (fun l => ?_) l
    · intro h₁ h₂; have := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd] at h₁ h₂; omega
    · intro h₁ h₂; have := j.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd] at h₂; omega
    · intro h₁ _; have := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd] at h₁; omega
    · intro h₁ _; have := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd] at h₁; omega
    · intro _ _; exact Or.inl (hzero i j)
    · intro _ _; exact Or.inl (hzero i j)
    · intro _ _; exact Or.inr (hzero j l)
    · intro h₁ h₂
      exact htail.2 i j l (by simp only [Fin.val_natAdd] at h₁; omega)
        (by simp only [Fin.val_natAdd] at h₂; omega)

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_quasi_triangular
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_quasi_triangular {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (k : ℕ) (T : Module.End ℝ E) (hk : finrank ℝ E = k) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℝ E,
      IsUpperQuasiTriangular (T.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing E with
  | h k ih =>
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · have : IsEmpty (Fin k) := by rw [hk0]; infer_instance
      exact ⟨(stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).reindex (finCongr hk),
        ⟨fun i => isEmptyElim i, fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩⟩
    have : Nontrivial E := Module.finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hk]; omega)
    obtain ⟨P, hPdim, hP⟩ := exists_invariant_subspace_finrank_one_or_two T
    let p := finrank ℝ P
    let q := finrank ℝ Pᗮ
    have hsum : p + q = k := P.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal.trans hk
    have hp : p ≤ 2 := by rcases hPdim with h | h <;> dsimp [p] <;> omega
    have hq : q < k := by rcases hPdim with h | h <;> dsimp [p] at hsum <;> omega
    let C : Module.End ℝ Pᗮ :=
      Pᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (T.comp Pᗮ.subtype)
    obtain ⟨bQ, hbQ⟩ := ih q hq C rfl
    let bP := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ P
    obtain ⟨b₀, hbP, hbQ'⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_sum P bP bQ
    let b₁ : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (p + q)) ℝ E := b₀.reindex finSumFinEquiv
    have hleft (i : Fin p) : b₁ (Fin.castAdd q i) = (bP i : E) := by
      simpa only [b₁, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd] using hbP i
    have hright (i : Fin q) : b₁ (Fin.natAdd p i) = (bQ i : E) := by
      simpa only [b₁, p, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd] using hbQ' i
    have htri : IsUpperQuasiTriangular (T.toMatrix b₁.toBasis b₁.toBasis) := by
      apply isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_small_leading_block hp
      · intro i j
        simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
          OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hleft, hright]
        exact Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (hP _ (bP j).property) (bQ i).property
      · have heq : (T.toMatrix b₁.toBasis b₁.toBasis).submatrix (Fin.natAdd p) (Fin.natAdd p) =
            C.toMatrix bQ.toBasis bQ.toBasis := by
          ext i j
          simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
            OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
            OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hright, C, LinearMap.comp_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Submodule.subtype_apply,
            Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left]
        rwa [heq]
    let b := b₁.reindex (finCongr hsum)
    refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      simpa only [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using htri.1 ((finCongr hsum).symm i)
          ((finCongr hsum).symm j) (by simpa using hij)
    · intro i j l hij hjl
      simpa only [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using htri.2 ((finCongr hsum).symm i)
          ((finCongr hsum).symm j) ((finCongr hsum).symm l)
            (by simpa using hij) (by simpa using hjl)

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_eq_pivot_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_eq_pivot_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    leadingMinor A (k + 1) = A 0 0 * leadingMinor (pivotSchur A) k
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : k + 1 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.succ_le_succ hk
  have hRestr : pivotSchur (A.submatrix (Fin.castLE hsucc) (Fin.castLE hsucc)) =
      (pivotSchur A).submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk) := by
    ext i j
    rfl
  simp only [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_fin _ hsucc, leadingSubmatrix_fin _ hk]
  rw [det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur _ (by exact ha), hRestr]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_pos_of_posDef
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_pos_of_posDef {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : 0 < leadingMinor A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_fin _ hk]
  exact (hA.submatrix (Fin.castLE_injective hk)).det_pos

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_leadingMinor_pos
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    apply PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos hA
    intro x hx
    exact False.elim (hx (Subsingleton.elim x 0))
  | succ n ih =>
    have ha : 0 < A 0 0 := by
      have h := hminor 1 (by rfl) (by omega)
      simpa [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_fin _ (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1)] using h
    apply (posDef_iff_pivotSchur hA).mpr
    refine ⟨ha, ih (isHermitian_pivotSchur hA) ?_⟩
    intro k hk₁ hkn
    have h := hminor (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [leadingMinor_eq_pivot_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur A ha.ne' k hkn] at h
    by_contra hb
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha.le (le_of_not_gt hb))) h

name: NLAlib.posDef_iff_leadingMinor_pos
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h k _ hk => leadingMinor_pos_of_posDef h k hk, posDef_of_leadingMinor_pos hA⟩

name: NLAlib.posDef_iff_trailingMinor_pos
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h k _ hk
    exact leadingMinor_pos_of_posDef (h.submatrix Fin.rev_injective) k hk
  · intro h
    have hrev : (A.submatrix Fin.rev Fin.rev).PosDef :=
      posDef_of_leadingMinor_pos (hA.submatrix Fin.rev) h
    have hA' := hrev.submatrix Fin.rev_injective
    have hmat : (A.submatrix Fin.rev Fin.rev).submatrix Fin.rev Fin.rev = A := by
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Fin.rev_rev]
    rw [hmat] at hA'
    exact hA'

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_eq_det
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_eq_det {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    leadingMinor A n = A.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_fin _ le_rfl]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_of_pivotSchur_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsSymm := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hAh
  have hsym : ∀ y : Fin n → ℝ,
      ∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0 = ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j := fun y =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hA.apply 0 i.succ, mul_comm]
  apply PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr hA)
  intro x
  have hxe : x = Matrix.vecCons (x 0) (Fin.tail x) := (Fin.cons_self_tail x).symm
  simp only [star_trivial]
  rw [hxe, dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons, hsym]
  set y := Fin.tail x
  set t := ∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j
  have hq := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg y
  simp only [star_trivial] at hq
  rw [dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec, hsym] at hq
  have key : A 0 0 * (x 0 + (A 0 0)⁻¹ * t) ^ 2 =
      A 0 0 * x 0 ^ 2 + 2 * x 0 * t + (A 0 0)⁻¹ * (t * t) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  nlinarith [key, mul_nonneg ha.le (sq_nonneg (x 0 + (A 0 0)⁻¹ * t))]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_of_leadingMinor_pos_and_det_nonneg
statement:
theorem posSemidef_of_leadingMinor_pos_and_det_nonneg {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hminor : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k < n → 0 < leadingMinor A k) (hdet : 0 ≤ A.det) :
    A.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    apply PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg hA
    intro x
    have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hx]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      change Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ at A
      change 0 ≤ (A : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ).det at hdet
      have ha : 0 ≤ A 0 0 := by simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_one] using hdet
      have hmat : A = diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => A 0 0) := by
        ext i j
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simp only [hi, hj, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
      rw [hmat]
      exact PosSemidef.diagonal fun _ => ha
    | succ n =>
      have ha : 0 < A 0 0 := by
        have h := hminor 1 (by rfl) (by omega)
        simpa [leadingMinor, leadingSubmatrix_fin _ (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1 + 1)] using h
      apply posSemidef_of_pivotSchur_posSemidef ( hA) ha
      apply ih (isHermitian_pivotSchur hA)
      · intro k hk hkn
        have h := hminor (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [leadingMinor_eq_pivot_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur A ha.ne' k (by omega)] at h
        by_contra hb
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha.le (le_of_not_gt hb))) h
      · have h := det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur A ha.ne'
        rw [h] at hdet
        by_contra hb
        have hneg := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha (lt_of_not_ge hb)
        exact (not_lt_of_ge hdet) hneg

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_real_normal_upper_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_real_normal_upper_fromBlocks {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ} {C : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hM : Matrix.fromBlocks A C 0 B * (Matrix.fromBlocks A C 0 B)ᵀ =
      (Matrix.fromBlocks A C 0 B)ᵀ * Matrix.fromBlocks A C 0 B) : C = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℝ => M.toBlocks₁₁.trace) hM
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
    Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.mul_zero,
    Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, Matrix.trace_add] at h
  have htr : (C * Cᵀ).trace = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm A Aᵀ] at h
    exact add_left_cancel (by simpa only [add_zero] using h)
  apply Matrix.trace_mul_conjTranspose_self_eq_zero_iff.mp
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using htr

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_real_normal_cut
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_real_normal_cut {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ * A) (p : n → Prop)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, ¬p i → p j → A i j = 0) :
    ∀ i j, p i → ¬p j → A i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Equiv.sumCompl p
  let M := A.submatrix e e
  have hM : M * Mᵀ = Mᵀ * M := by
    simp only [M, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hA]
  have h21 : M.toBlocks₂₁ = 0 := by
    ext i j
    exact hzero i.val j.val i.property j.property
  have hblock : M = Matrix.fromBlocks M.toBlocks₁₁ M.toBlocks₁₂ 0 M.toBlocks₂₂ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks M]
    rw [h21]
  have h12 : M.toBlocks₁₂ = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_real_normal_upper_fromBlocks (A := M.toBlocks₁₁) (B := M.toBlocks₂₂)
    simpa only [← hblock] using hM
  intro i j hi hj
  exact congrArg (fun N : Matrix {i // p i} {j // ¬p j} ℝ => N ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩) h12

name: NLAlib.real_normal_quasi_cut_eq_zero
statement:
theorem real_normal_quasi_cut_eq_zero {k r : ℕ}
    {T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hT : IsUpperQuasiTriangular T)
    (hN : T * Tᵀ = Tᵀ * T)
    (hboundary : ∀ i j : Fin k, i.val = r → j.val + 1 = r → T i j = 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin k, i.val < r → r ≤ j.val → T i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ i j : Fin k, ¬i.val < r → j.val < r → T i j = 0 := by
    intro i j hi hj
    by_cases hij : j.val + 1 < i.val
    · exact hT.1 i j hij
    · exact hboundary i j (by omega) (by omega)
  intro i j hi hj
  exact eq_zero_of_real_normal_cut hN (fun i => i.val < r) hzero i j hi (by omega)

name: NLAlib.real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_above_superdiagonal
proof:
:= by
  let l : Fin k := ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩
  by_cases hli : T l i = 0
  · apply real_normal_quasi_cut_eq_zero hT hN (r := i.val + 1) ?_ i j (by omega) (by omega)
    intro a b ha hb
    have ha' : a = l := Fin.ext ha
    have hb' : b = i := Fin.ext (by omega)
    simpa only [ha', hb'] using hli
  · apply real_normal_quasi_cut_eq_zero hT hN (r := i.val + 2) ?_ i j (by omega) (by omega)
    intro a b ha hb
    have hb' : b = l := Fin.ext (by dsimp [l]; omega)
    subst b
    exact (hT.2 a l i (by dsimp [l]; omega) (by rfl)).resolve_right hli

name: NLAlib.real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_of_subdiagonal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_of_subdiagonal_eq_zero {k : ℕ}
    {T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hT : IsUpperQuasiTriangular T)
    (hN : T * Tᵀ = Tᵀ * T) {i j : Fin k} (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val)
    (hji : T j i = 0) : T i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply real_normal_quasi_cut_eq_zero hT hN (r := j.val) ?_ i j (by omega) le_rfl
  intro a b ha hb
  have ha' : a = j := Fin.ext ha
  have hb' : b = i := Fin.ext (by omega)
  simpa only [ha', hb'] using hji

name: NLAlib.card_fin_head
statement:
private theorem card_fin_head {m k : ℕ} (hk : k < m) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter fun i : Fin m => (i : ℕ) < k).card = k
proof:
:= by
  have he : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter fun i : Fin m => (i : ℕ) < k) =
      Finset.Iio (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin m) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iio]
    rfl
  rw [he, Fin.card_Iio]

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone {m k : ℕ} (a w : Fin m → ℝ)
    (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (ha : Antitone a)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1)
    (hbudget : ∑ i, w i ≤ (k : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, a i * w i) ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, if (i : ℕ) < k then a i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k < m
  · let c : Fin m := ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hpoint (i : Fin m) : (a i - a c) * w i ≤
        if (i : ℕ) < k then a i - a c else 0 := by
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
      · rw [if_pos hi]
        have hac : a c ≤ a i := ha (show i ≤ c from Nat.le_of_lt hi)
        simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw1 i) (sub_nonneg.mpr hac)
      · rw [if_neg hi]
        have hac : a i ≤ a c := ha (show c ≤ i from not_lt.mp hi)
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hac) (hw0 i)
    have hcard := card_fin_head hk
    have hsum : (∑ i : Fin m, if (i : ℕ) < k then a i - a c else 0) =
        (∑ i : Fin m, if (i : ℕ) < k then a i else 0) - (k : ℝ) * a c := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, hcard]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    calc
      (∑ i, a i * w i) = a c * (∑ i, w i) + ∑ i, (a i - a c) * w i := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ ≤ a c * k + ∑ i : Fin m, if (i : ℕ) < k then a i - a c else 0 :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbudget (ha0 c))
          (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hpoint i))
      _ = ∑ i : Fin m, if (i : ℕ) < k then a i else 0 := by rw [hsum]; ring
  · have hmk : m ≤ k := not_lt.mp hk
    have hall (i : Fin m) : (i : ℕ) < k := lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hmk
    simp only [if_pos (hall _)]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw1 i) (ha0 i)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_projection_add_residual
statement:
private theorem frobSq_eq_projection_add_residual [DecidableEq m]
    (P : Matrix m m 𝕜) (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A = frobSq (P * A) + frobSq ((1 - P) * A)
proof:
:= by
  have horth : Pᴴ * (1 - P) = 0 := by
    rw [hs.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, show P * P = P from hp, sub_self]
  have hsplit : P * A + (1 - P) * A = A := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
    abel
  calc
    frobSq A = frobSq (P * A + (1 - P) * A) := congrArg frobSq hsplit.symm
    _ = _ := frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _
      (frobInner_mul_mul_eq_zero P A (1 - P) A horth)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projection_residual_le
statement:
private theorem frobSq_projection_residual_le [DecidableEq m]
    (P : Matrix m m 𝕜) (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hPB : P * B = B) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤ frobSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have horth : (1 - P)ᴴ * P = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hs.eq, Matrix.sub_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul, show P * P = P from hp, sub_self]
  have hsplit : (1 - P) * A + P * (A - B) = A - B := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, hPB]
    abel
  rw [← hsplit, frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _
    (frobInner_mul_mul_eq_zero (1 - P) A P (A - B) horth)]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_rectDiag
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag, Matrix.trace_diagonal, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    h.mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.trace_diagonal, map_sum]
  simp

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le [DecidableEq m]
    (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) (hB : B.rank ≤ k) :
    bestRankFrobSq A k ≤ frobSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  let P := B * moorePenroseInverse B
  have hs : P.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B
  have hp : IsIdempotentElem P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B
  have hPB : P * B = B := mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul B
  have hrankP : P.rank ≤ k := (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left B _).trans hB
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let R := Uᴴ * P * U
  have hsR : R.IsHermitian := by
    change (Uᴴ * P * U)ᴴ = Uᴴ * P * U
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hs.eq,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hpR : IsIdempotentElem R := by
    change (Uᴴ * P * U) * (Uᴴ * P * U) = Uᴴ * P * U
    calc
      _ = Uᴴ * (P * (U * Uᴴ) * P) * U := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Uᴴ * P * U := by
        rw [hSVD.mul_conjTranspose_left, Matrix.mul_one, show P * P = P from hp]
  have hrankR : R.rank ≤ k :=
    ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left (Uᴴ * P) U).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Uᴴ P)).trans hrankP
  have hbudget : ∑ i, RCLike.re (R i i) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [← map_sum]
    change RCLike.re R.trace ≤ (k : ℝ)
    rw [trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem R hpR, RCLike.natCast_re]
    exact_mod_cast hrankR
  have hweights (i : Fin (Fintype.card m)) : RCLike.re (R i i) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem R hsR hpR i
  have hcaptured : frobSq (P * A) =
      ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card m), singularValues A i ^ 2 * RCLike.re (R i i) := by
    have hgram : (P * A) * (P * A)ᴴ = P * (A * Aᴴ) * P := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    set D : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m)) (Fin (Fintype.card m)) 𝕜 :=
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))
    rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      hgram, hSVD.mul_conjTranspose_self]
    calc
      _ = RCLike.re (P * U * (D * (Uᴴ * P))).trace := by
        congr 2
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, D]
      _ = RCLike.re ((D * (Uᴴ * P)) * (P * U)).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      _ = RCLike.re (D * R).trace := by
        congr 2
        simp only [R, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc P P U, show P * P = P from hp]
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.diagonal_mul, map_sum, D,
          RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
  have hcaptured_le : frobSq (P * A) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card m), if (i : ℕ) < k then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0 := by
    rw [hcaptured]
    apply sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone
    · intro i; exact sq_nonneg _
    · intro i j hij
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A j) (singularValues_antitone A hij) 2
    · intro i; exact (hweights i).1
    · intro i; exact (hweights i).2
    · exact hbudget
  have hsplit : frobSq A =
      (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card m), if (i : ℕ) < k then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0) +
      bestRankFrobSq A k := by
