    rw [hSVD.frobSq_eq_sum, bestRankFrobSq,
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0),
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [hi, not_le.mpr hi]
    · simp [hi, not_lt.mp hi]
  have hpyth := frobSq_eq_projection_add_residual P hs hp A
  have hres := frobSq_projection_residual_le P hs hp A B hPB
  linarith

name: NLAlib.card_fin_head_le
statement:
private theorem card_fin_head_le (m k : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter fun i : Fin m => (i : ℕ) < k).card ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < m
  · rw [card_fin_head hk]
  · calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
      _ = m := by simp
      _ ≤ k := not_lt.mp hk

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rank_truncatedMatrix_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 :=
    rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then singularValues A i else 0)
  let H := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun i : Fin p => (i : ℕ) < k
  have hsupport : Function.support S.row ⊆ H := by
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro i hi
    have hik : ¬(i : ℕ) < k := by simpa [H] using hi
    ext j
    change S i j = 0
    simp [S, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hik]
  have hS : S.rank ≤ H.card := Matrix.rank_le_card_of_support_subset S H hsupport
  change (U * S * Vᴴ).rank ≤ k
  exact ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left (U * S) Vᴴ).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right U S)).trans
    (hS.trans (card_fin_head_le p k))

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_sub_truncatedMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have hp := h.card_left
  have hq := h.card_right
  let T : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 :=
    rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then 0 else singularValues A i)
  have hsplit : A = h.truncatedMatrix k + U * T * Vᴴ := h.eq_head_add_tail k
  have he : A - h.truncatedMatrix k = U * T * Vᴴ := by
    calc
      _ = (h.truncatedMatrix k + U * T * Vᴴ) - h.truncatedMatrix k :=
        congrArg (fun M => M - h.truncatedMatrix k) hsplit
      _ = _ := by abel
  rw [he, frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal h.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal h.conjTranspose_mul_left, frobSq_rectDiag,
    bestRankFrobSq, hp,
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hin : (i : ℕ) < q
  · rw [if_pos hin]
    by_cases hik : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [hik, not_le.mpr hik]
    · simp [hik, not_lt.mp hik]
  · rw [if_neg hin, singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A (by rw [hq]; exact not_lt.mp hin)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedMatrix
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.rank_truncatedMatrix_le k, ?_⟩
  intro B hB
  rw [h.frobSq_sub_truncatedMatrix k]
  exact bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le A B k hB

theorem isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :

    ∃ B : Matrix m n 𝕜, IsBestFrobRankApprox A k B

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_bestRankFrobSq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    frobSq (A - truncatedSVD A k) = bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:

name: NLAlib.IsBestFrobRankApprox.frobSq_sub_eq_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem IsBestFrobRankApprox.frobSq_sub_eq_bestRankFrobSq {k : ℕ} {A B : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (h : IsBestFrobRankApprox A k B) : frobSq (A - B) = bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← frobSq_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_bestRankFrobSq A k]
  exact le_antisymm (h.2 _ (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD A k).1)

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_eq_sInf
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_eq_sInf (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    bestRankFrobSq A k = sInf {v : ℝ | ∃ B : Matrix m n 𝕜, B.rank ≤ k ∧ v = frobSq (A - B)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hT := isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD A k
  rw [← hT.frobSq_sub_eq_bestRankFrobSq]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_csInf ⟨_, truncatedSVD A k, hT.1, rfl⟩ (by rintro v ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩; exact hT.2 Z hZ)
  · exact csInf_le ⟨0, by rintro v ⟨Z, _, rfl⟩; exact frobSq_nonneg _⟩ ⟨truncatedSVD A k, hT.1, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.specNorm_sub_truncatedMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have hp := h.card_left
  have hq := h.card_right
  set τ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if i < k then 0 else singularValues A i with hτ
  let T : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 := rectDiag τ
  have hsplit : A = h.truncatedMatrix k + U * T * Vᴴ := h.eq_head_add_tail k
  have he : A - h.truncatedMatrix k = U * T * Vᴴ := by
    calc
      _ = (h.truncatedMatrix k + U * T * Vᴴ) - h.truncatedMatrix k :=
        congrArg (fun M => M - h.truncatedMatrix k) hsplit
      _ = _ := by abel
  rw [he, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_left]
  have hσk := singularValues_nonneg A k
  have hsq : specNorm T ^ 2 = singularValues A k ^ 2 := by
    rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag,
      specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)).2 fun j => ?_
      split_ifs with hj
      · rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        simp only [hτ]
        split_ifs with hjk
        · simpa using sq_nonneg (singularValues A k)
        · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A j)
            (singularValues_antitone A (not_lt.1 hjk)) 2
      · simpa using sq_nonneg (singularValues A k)
    · by_cases hk : k < min p q
      · have hkm : k < p := lt_of_lt_of_le hk (min_le_left p q)
        have hkn : k < q := lt_of_lt_of_le hk (min_le_right p q)
        have h0 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun j : Fin q =>
          if (j : ℕ) < p then ((τ j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) ⟨k, hkn⟩
        simp only [hkm, if_true, hτ, lt_irrefl, if_false, RCLike.norm_ofReal] at h0
        rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at h0
      · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by rw [hp, hq]; exact not_lt.1 hk)]
        simp
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg T) hσk).1 hsq

statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (A - truncatedSVD A k) = singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncatedSVD
  exact (exists_isSVD A).choose_spec.choose_spec.specNorm_sub_truncatedMatrix k

name: NLAlib.exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ (S : Matrix n n 𝕜) (d : n → ℝ), IsUnit S ∧ A = S * Sᴴ ∧
      B = S * diagonal (fun i => (d i : 𝕜)) * Sᴴ ∧ (B.PosSemidef → ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i)
proof:
:= by
  let R := CFC.sqrt A
  have hR : IsUnit R := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff A hA.posSemidef.nonneg).mpr hA.isUnit
  have hRd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR
  have hRt : Rᴴ = R := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian.eq
  have hRit : R⁻¹ᴴ = R⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, hRt]
  have hSq : R * R = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hRRi : R * R⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R hRd
  have hRiR : R⁻¹ * R = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul R hRd
  let H := R⁻¹ * B * R⁻¹
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [H, hRit] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose R⁻¹ hB
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hUU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    simpa only [U, ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star] using
      Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : IsUnit U := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det U).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse hUU)
  have hSpectral : H = U * diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Function.comp_def, U]
      using hH.spectral_theorem
  refine ⟨R * U, hH.eigenvalues, hR.mul hU, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · symm
    calc
      (R * U) * (R * U)ᴴ = R * (U * Uᴴ) * R := by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hRt]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A := by rw [hUU, Matrix.mul_one, hSq]
  · have hRHR : R * H * R = B := by
      calc
        R * H * R = (R * R⁻¹) * B * (R⁻¹ * R) := by
          simp only [H, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = B := by rw [hRRi, hRiR, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    calc
      B = R * H * R := hRHR.symm
      _ = R * (U * diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ) * R := by rw [← hSpectral]
      _ = (R * U) * diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * (R * U)ᴴ := by
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hRt]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  · intro hBPSD
    have hHPSD : H.PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [H, hRit] using hBPSD.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R⁻¹
    exact hHPSD.eigenvalues_nonneg

name: NLAlib.inverse_mul_eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem inverse_mul_eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
    {A B S : Matrix n n ℝ} {d : n → ℝ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hA : A = S * Sᵀ) (hB : B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ) :
    A⁻¹ * B = Sᵀ⁻¹ * diagonal d * Sᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hSd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hS
  rw [hA, hB, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc S⁻¹ S, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul S hSd, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_inverse_mul_eq_prod_of_congruence
statement:
theorem charpoly_inverse_mul_eq_prod_of_congruence
    {A B S : Matrix n n ℝ} {d : n → ℝ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hA : A = S * Sᵀ) (hB : B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ) :
    (A⁻¹ * B).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))
proof:
:= by
  have hSt : IsUnit Sᵀ := (Matrix.isUnit_transpose S).mpr hS
  rw [inverse_mul_eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hS hA hB]
  have h := Matrix.charpoly_units_conj' hSt.unit (diagonal d)
  simpa only [Matrix.coe_units_inv, hSt.unit_spec, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal] using h

name: NLAlib.spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence
statement:
theorem spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence
    {A B S : Matrix n n ℝ} {d : n → ℝ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hA : A = S * Sᵀ) (hB : B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ) :
    spectrum ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) = Set.range d
proof:
:= by
  have hSt : IsUnit Sᵀ := (Matrix.isUnit_transpose S).mpr hS
  rw [inverse_mul_eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hS hA hB]
  have h := spectrum.units_conjugate' (R := ℝ) (a := diagonal d) (u := hSt.unit)
  simpa only [Matrix.coe_units_inv, hSt.unit_spec, spectrum_diagonal] using h

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_congruence
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_congruence
    {A B S : Matrix n n ℝ} {d : n → ℝ} (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hA : A = S * Sᵀ) (hB : B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ) :
    IsDiagonalizable (A⁻¹ * B)
proof:
:= by
  have hSt : IsUnit Sᵀ := (Matrix.isUnit_transpose S).mpr hS
  refine ⟨Sᵀ⁻¹, d, Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hSt, ?_⟩
  rw [inverse_mul_eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hS hA hB]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv Sᵀ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hSt), Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.inertia_diagonal_eq_of_congruence
proof:
:= by
  have hSt : IsUnit Sᵀ := (Matrix.isUnit_transpose S).mpr hS
  have hp := inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul (diagonal d) hSt
  have hn := inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul (diagonal d) hSt
  rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose, ← hB] at hp hn
  exact ⟨hp.symm, hn.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_posDef
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_posDef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.IsHermitian) : IsDiagonalizable (A⁻¹ * B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, -⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB
  exact isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_congruence hS hAA hBB

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_mul_of_posDef
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_mul_of_posDef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.IsHermitian) : IsDiagonalizable (A * B)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  simpa only [Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible] using
    isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_posDef hA.inv hB

name: NLAlib.spectrum_inverse_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef
statement:
theorem spectrum_inverse_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : spectrum ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) ⊆ Set.Ici 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB.isHermitian
  rw [spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact hd hB i

name: NLAlib.spectrum_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef
statement:
theorem spectrum_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : spectrum ℝ (A * B) ⊆ Set.Ici 0
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  simpa only [Matrix.inv_inv_of_invertible] using
    spectrum_inverse_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef hA.inv hB

name: NLAlib.definite_pair_congruence_characterizations
statement:
theorem definite_pair_congruence_characterizations {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∃ (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ), IsUnit S ∧ A = S * Sᵀ ∧
      B = S * diagonal d * Sᵀ ∧
      (A⁻¹ * B).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)) ∧
      spectrum ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) = Set.range d ∧ IsDiagonalizable (A⁻¹ * B) ∧
      inertiaPos (diagonal d) = inertiaPos B ∧ inertiaNeg (diagonal d) = inertiaNeg B ∧
      (B.PosSemidef → ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i)) ∧
    IsDiagonalizable (A * B) ∧ (B.PosSemidef → spectrum ℝ (A * B) ⊆ Set.Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_definite_pair_congruence_diagonal hA hB
  have hi := inertia_diagonal_eq_of_congruence hS hBB
  exact ⟨⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, charpoly_inverse_mul_eq_prod_of_congruence hS hAA hBB,
    spectrum_inverse_mul_eq_range_of_congruence hS hAA hBB,
    isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_congruence hS hAA hBB, hi.1, hi.2, hd⟩,
    isDiagonalizable_mul_of_posDef hA hB, spectrum_mul_subset_nonneg_of_posDef hA⟩

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (hb : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (b i))) : A.trace = ∑ i, b i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_eq_neg_charpoly_nextCoeff, hb, ← Matrix.charpoly_diagonal,
    ← Matrix.trace_eq_neg_charpoly_nextCoeff, Matrix.trace_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.border_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_eq_prod
statement:
theorem border_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_eq_prod
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (hb : (Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
        ∏ i, (X - C (b i))) : a = (∑ i, b i) - A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have ht := trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod _ b hb
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.fromBlocks, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
    Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at ht
  change a = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, A i i
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_add_vecMulVec
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (hb : (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (b i))) :
    (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = (∑ i, b i) - A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have ht := trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod _ b hb
  rw [Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec] at ht
  simp only [dotProduct, ← pow_two] at ht
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eq_trace_sub_sum_of_charpoly_sub_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eq_trace_sub_sum_of_charpoly_sub_vecMulVec
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (hb : (A - Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (b i))) :
    (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = A.trace - ∑ i, b i
proof:
:= by
  have ht := trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod _ b hb
  rw [Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec] at ht
  simp only [dotProduct, ← pow_two] at ht
  linarith

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_embedding_posDef_shift_trace_le_aux
statement:
private theorem exists_embedding_posDef_shift_trace_le_aux
    (k q : ℕ) {δ T : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hT : 0 < T) (hstep : 2 * δ * T ≤ 1)
    (G : Matrix (Fin (k + q)) (Fin (k + q)) ℝ) (hG : G.PosDef) (htrace : G⁻¹.trace ≤ T) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ Fin (k + q),
      (G.submatrix e e - ((q : ℝ) * δ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).PosDef ∧
      (G.submatrix e e - ((q : ℝ) * δ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ))⁻¹.trace ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨Function.Embedding.refl _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Function.Embedding.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id, Nat.cast_zero,
        zero_mul, zero_smul, sub_zero] using hG
    · simpa only [Function.Embedding.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id, Nat.cast_zero,
        zero_mul, zero_smul, sub_zero] using htrace
  | succ q ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, hjPos, hjTrace⟩ :=
      exists_principal_deletion_posDef_and_trace_inv_le hG hδ hT htrace hstep
    let B := (G - δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin (k + q + 1)) (Fin (k + q + 1)) ℝ)).submatrix
      j.succAbove j.succAbove
    obtain ⟨f, hfPos, hfTrace⟩ := ih B hjPos hjTrace
    let e : Fin k ↪ Fin (k + (q + 1)) :=
      ⟨fun i => j.succAbove (f i), Fin.succAbove_right_injective.comp f.injective⟩
    have heq : G.submatrix e e - (((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) =
        B.submatrix f f - ((q : ℝ) * δ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := by
      ext a b
      simp only [B, e, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
      have hId : (1 : Matrix (Fin (k + q + 1)) (Fin (k + q + 1)) ℝ)
          (j.succAbove (f a)) (j.succAbove (f b)) = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) a b :=
        congrArg (fun P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ => P a b) (Matrix.submatrix_one e e.injective)
      rw [hId]
      simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
      push_cast
      ring
    exact ⟨e, heq.symm ▸ hfPos, heq.symm ▸ hfTrace⟩

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_embedding_posDef_sub_smul_one_of_trace_inv_le
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_posDef_sub_smul_one_of_trace_inv_le
    {r k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) (hG : G.PosDef)
    (hk : k ≤ r) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (htrace : G⁻¹.trace ≤ T) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ Fin r,
      (G.submatrix e e - (((r - k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * T)) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
  let δ : ℝ := 1 / (2 * T)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hstep : 2 * δ * T ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
  obtain ⟨e, hePos, heTrace⟩ :=
    exists_embedding_posDef_shift_trace_le_aux k q hδ hT hstep G hG htrace
  have hcap : δ * (G.submatrix e e - ((q : ℝ) * δ) •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ))⁻¹.trace < 1 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heTrace hδ.le
    nlinarith
  have hfinal := hePos.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδ hcap
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  have heq : G.submatrix e e - ((q : ℝ) * δ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) -
      δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) =
      G.submatrix e e - (((k + q - k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * T)) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    push_cast
    dsimp [δ]
    module
  rwa [heq] at hfinal

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_isHermitian_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_isHermitian_with_charpoly
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (d : n → ℝ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ A = Q * Matrix.diagonal d * Qᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  obtain ⟨U, T, hsim, htri, hdiag⟩ :=
    exists_unitary_schur_triangularization_with_charpoly A e d hd
  have hUtU : (U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hback : (U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * A * (U : Matrix n n ℝ) = T := by
    rw [hsim]
    calc
      (U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * ((U : Matrix n n ℝ) * T * (U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ) *
          (U : Matrix n n ℝ) =
        ((U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℝ)) * T *
          ((U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℝ)) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = T := by rw [hUtU, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := hback ▸ Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul _ hA
  have hTt : Tᵀ = T := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hT.eq
  have hD : T = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] using hdiag i
    · rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij]
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (fun h => hij (e.symm.injective h)) with hlt | hgt
      · rw [← hTt]
        exact htri j i hlt
      · exact htri i j hgt
  refine ⟨U, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hUtU
  · simpa only [hD, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hsim

name: NLAlib.re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_row_radius_lt_re_diag
statement:
theorem re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_row_radius_lt_re_diag
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < (A i i).re)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : 0 < μ.re
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hnorm : ‖A i i - μ‖ ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := by
    simpa only [gershgorinRowDisc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hi
  have hre := (Complex.re_le_norm (A i i - μ)).trans hnorm
  simp only [Complex.sub_re] at hre
  linarith [hA i]

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_norm_sub_real_le_of_re_nonpos
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_norm_sub_real_le_of_re_nonpos {z : ℂ} {d : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hz : ‖z - (d : ℂ)‖ ≤ d) (hre : z.re ≤ 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖z - (d : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ d ^ 2 := sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hd |>.mpr hz
  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply] at hs
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero] at hs
  have hprod : 0 ≤ -(2 * z.re * d) :=
    neg_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hre) hd)
  have hr : z.re = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.im, sq_nonneg z.re]
  have hi : z.im = 0 := by rw [hr] at hs; nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.im]
  exact Complex.ext hr hi

name: NLAlib.re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_isUnit_of_weak_diagonal_dominance
statement:
theorem re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_isUnit_of_weak_diagonal_dominance
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hunit : IsUnit A)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, (A i i).im = 0)
    (hweak : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ (A i i).re)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : 0 < μ.re
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hnonpos
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hd : A i i = ((A i i).re : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hdiag i]
  have hnorm : ‖μ - ((A i i).re : ℂ)‖ ≤ (A i i).re := by
    have : ‖μ - A i i‖ ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := by
      simpa only [gershgorinRowDisc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hi
    rw [hd] at this
    exact this.trans (hweak i)
  have hzero := eq_zero_of_norm_sub_real_le_of_re_nonpos
    ((gershgorinRowRadius_nonneg A i).trans (hweak i)) hnorm hnonpos
  exact spectrum.zero_notMem ℂ hunit (hzero ▸ hμ)

name: NLAlib.re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
statement:
theorem re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hIrred : (A.map norm).IsIrreducible)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, (A i i).im = 0) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < (A i i).re)
    (hweak : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ ‖A i i‖)
    (hstrict : ∃ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : 0 < μ.re
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit A := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (det_ne_zero_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance A hIrred hweak hstrict))
  apply re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_isUnit_of_weak_diagonal_dominance hunit hdiag _ hμ
  intro i
  have hd : A i i = ((A i i).re : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hdiag i]
  have hn : ‖A i i‖ = (A i i).re := by
    calc
      ‖A i i‖ = ‖((A i i).re : ℂ)‖ := congrArg norm hd
      _ = (A i i).re := by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hpos i)]
  simpa only [hn] using hweak i

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_isHermitian_of_row_radius_lt_diag
statement:
theorem posDef_of_isHermitian_of_row_radius_lt_diag {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hstrict : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < A i i) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos.mpr
  intro j
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real j)
  have hb : A i i - hA.eigenvalues j ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := by
    have hn : ‖hA.eigenvalues j - A i i‖ ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := hi
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm] using hn)
  linarith [hstrict i]

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_isHermitian_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
statement:
theorem posDef_of_isHermitian_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hIrred : (A.map norm).IsIrreducible)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < A i i)
    (hweak : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ ‖A i i‖)
    (hstrict : ∃ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit A := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (det_ne_zero_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance A hIrred hweak hstrict))
  apply hA.posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos.mpr
  intro j
  have hμ := hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real j
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hb : A i i - hA.eigenvalues j ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := by
    have hn : ‖hA.eigenvalues j - A i i‖ ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := hi
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm] using hn)
  have hw : gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ A i i := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hpos i)] using hweak i
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues j := by linarith
  have hne : hA.eigenvalues j ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    exact spectrum.zero_notMem ℝ hunit (heq ▸ hμ)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg hne.symm

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.isSingularTripletFamily
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.left_orth, h.right_orth, h.pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
  · rw [h.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_assoc,
      h.left_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    · simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.submatrix_cols
statement:
theorem IsSingularTripletFamily.submatrix_cols {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m r 𝕜}
    {V : Matrix n r 𝕜} {σ : r → ℝ} (h : IsSingularTripletFamily A U V σ)
    {s : Type*} [Fintype s] [DecidableEq s] (e : s ↪ r) :
    IsSingularTripletFamily A (U.submatrix id e) (V.submatrix id e) (fun i => σ (e i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.left_orth.submatrix_cols e, h.right_orth.submatrix_cols e, fun i => h.pos (e i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have he : A * V.submatrix id e = (A * V).submatrix id e := rfl
    rw [he, h.mul_right]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  · have he : Aᴴ * U.submatrix id e = (Aᴴ * U).submatrix id e := rfl
    rw [he, h.adjoint_mul_left]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse_diagonal_ofReal
statement:
theorem isMoorePenroseInverse_diagonal_ofReal (σ : r → ℝ) :
    IsMoorePenroseInverse (diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)))
      (diagonal (fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    norm_cast
    by_cases h : σ i = 0 <;> simp [h]
  · rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    norm_cast
    by_cases h : σ i = 0 <;> simp [h]
  · ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j; simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, h, Ne.symm h]
  · ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j; simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.moorePenroseInverse_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (isMoorePenroseInverse_diagonal_ofReal (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ).unitary_transform
    U V h.left_orth h.right_orth
  rw [← h.eq] at hp
  exact (isMoorePenroseInverse A).unique hp

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.rank_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hD : IsUnit (diagonal fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_diagonal, Pi.isUnit_iff]
    intro i
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (h.pos i).ne')
  have hcomp : Uᴴ * A * V = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) := by
    rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, h.left_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [h.eq]
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans U.rank_le_card_width)
  · calc
      Fintype.card r = (diagonal fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)).rank :=
        (Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hD).symm
      _ = (Uᴴ * A * V).rank := congrArg Matrix.rank hcomp.symm
      _ ≤ (Uᴴ * A).rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ A.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (diagonal fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜)) * diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) =
      (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [(h.pos i).ne']
    · simp [hij]
  rw [h.moorePenroseInverse_eq, h.eq]
  calc
    _ = V * ((diagonal fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜)) * (Uᴴ * U) *
        diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜))) * Vᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [h.left_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one, hD, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (diagonal fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) * diagonal (fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜)) =
      (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; simp [(h.pos i).ne']
    · simp [hij]
  rw [h.moorePenroseInverse_eq, h.eq]
  calc
    _ = U * ((diagonal fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) * (Vᴴ * V) *
        diagonal (fun i => ((σ i)⁻¹ : 𝕜))) * Uᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one, hD, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_isThinSVD
statement:
theorem exists_isThinSVD [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix m (Fin A.rank) 𝕜) (V : Matrix n (Fin A.rank) 𝕜),
      IsThinSVD A U V (fun i => singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let em := Fin.castLEEmb A.rank_le_card_height
  let en := Fin.castLEEmb A.rank_le_card_width
  refine ⟨U.submatrix id em, V.submatrix id en,
    HasOrthonormalCols.submatrix_cols h.conjTranspose_mul_left em,
    HasOrthonormalCols.submatrix_cols h.conjTranspose_mul_right en,
    fun i => (singularValues_pos_iff A i).mpr i.isLt, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  rw [h.apply i j]
  let e := Fin.castLEEmb (le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width)
  let g : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) → 𝕜 := fun k =>
    (singularValues A k : 𝕜) *
      U i (Fin.castLE (min_le_left _ _) k) * star (V j (Fin.castLE (min_le_right _ _) k))
  have hs : ((U.submatrix id em * diagonal (fun i : Fin A.rank => (singularValues A i : 𝕜))) *
      (V.submatrix id en)ᴴ) i j = ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.map e, g k := by
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    dsimp [g, e, em, en]
    have hem : Fin.castLE (min_le_left (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))
        (Fin.castLE (le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width) k) =
        Fin.castLE A.rank_le_card_height k := Fin.ext rfl
    have hen : Fin.castLE (min_le_right (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))
        (Fin.castLE (le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width) k) =
        Fin.castLE A.rank_le_card_width k := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hem, hen]
    ring
  rw [hs]
  change (∑ k, g k) = _
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
  intro k hk hnot
  have hkr : A.rank ≤ k.val := by
    by_contra hlt
    apply hnot
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨k, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩
  dsimp [g]
  rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A hkr]
  simp

name: NLAlib.exists_isSingularTripletFamily
statement:
theorem exists_isSingularTripletFamily [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix m (Fin k) 𝕜) (V : Matrix n (Fin k) 𝕜),
      IsSingularTripletFamily A U V (fun i => singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  exact ⟨_, _, h.isSingularTripletFamily.submatrix_cols (Fin.castLEEmb hk)⟩

name: NLAlib.charpoly_mul_mul_transpose_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem charpoly_mul_mul_transpose_of_hasOrthonormalCols
    (Q A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (Q * A * Qᵀ).charpoly = A.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.mul_add_vecMulVec_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem mul_add_vecMulVec_mul_transpose (Q A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    Q * (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v) * Qᵀ =
      Q * A * Qᵀ + Matrix.vecMulVec (Q *ᵥ v) (Q *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul,
    Matrix.vecMul_transpose]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_mul_arrowhead_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_mul_arrowhead_mul_transpose
    (Q A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    let P : Matrix (n ⊕ Fin 1) (n ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ
proof:
:= Matrix.fromBlocks Q 0 0 1
    P * Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a) * Pᵀ =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Q * A * Qᵀ) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) (Q *ᵥ v))
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) (Q *ᵥ v)) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a) := by
  dsimp only
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.transpose_one,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero,
    zero_add, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.replicateRow_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (d v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ u : n → ℝ,
      (Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) u)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) u) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hdiag⟩ := exists_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_isHermitian_with_charpoly A hA d hd
  refine ⟨Q *ᵥ v, ?_⟩
  let P : Matrix (n ⊕ Fin 1) (n ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ := Matrix.fromBlocks Q 0 0 1
  change Qᵀ * Q = 1 at hQ
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols P := by
    rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    dsimp only [P]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.transpose_one,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero,
      zero_add, Matrix.one_mul, hQ, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  rw [hdiag, ← fromBlocks_mul_arrowhead_mul_transpose]
  exact charpoly_mul_mul_transpose_of_hasOrthonormalCols P _ hP

name: NLAlib.exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
statement:
theorem exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (d v : n → ℝ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ u : n → ℝ, (A + Matrix.vecMulVec u u).charpoly =
      (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hdiag⟩ := exists_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_isHermitian_with_charpoly A hA d hd
  refine ⟨Q *ᵥ v, ?_⟩
  rw [hdiag, ← mul_add_vecMulVec_mul_transpose]
  exact charpoly_mul_mul_transpose_of_hasOrthonormalCols Q _ hQ

name: NLAlib.charpoly_neg_eq_prod_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem charpoly_neg_eq_prod_of_isHermitian
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (d : n → ℝ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    (-A).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (-d i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hdiag⟩ := exists_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_isHermitian_with_charpoly A hA d hd
  have hneg : -A = Q * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -d i) * Qᵀ := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_neg, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, hdiag]
  rw [hneg, charpoly_mul_mul_transpose_of_hasOrthonormalCols Q _ hQ, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    specNorm A = ‖hA.eigenvalues‖
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := by
    change Uᴴ * U = 1
    exact Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have he : A = thinSingularMatrix U U hA.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [thinSingularMatrix, U, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,
      Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Function.comp_def] using hA.spectral_theorem
  calc
    specNorm A = specNorm (thinSingularMatrix U U hA.eigenvalues) := congrArg specNorm he
    _ = _ := specNorm_thinSingularMatrix U U hU hU _

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalue_le_lambdaMax
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalue_le_lambdaMax {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) : hA.eigenvalues i ≤ lambdaMax A
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csSup
  · rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  · exact hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.lambdaMax_nonneg_of_trace_re_nonneg
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.lambdaMax_nonneg_of_trace_re_nonneg [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (htr : 0 ≤ A.trace.re) : 0 ≤ lambdaMax A
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hsum : (∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i) < 0 :=
    Finset.sum_neg (fun i _ => (hA.eigenvalue_le_lambdaMax i).trans_lt (lt_of_not_ge hn))
      Finset.univ_nonempty
  have he : A.trace.re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    simp
  linarith

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.lambdaMax_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.lambdaMax_le_specNorm [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : lambdaMax A ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues, lambdaMax, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm hA.eigenvalues i)

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : lambdaMax A = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm hA.isHermitian.lambdaMax_le_specNorm
  rw [hA.isHermitian.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues]
  have hmax : 0 ≤ lambdaMax A :=
    (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg (Classical.choice inferInstance)).trans
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalue_le_lambdaMax _)
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hmax).mpr
  intro i
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)] using
    hA.isHermitian.eigenvalue_le_lambdaMax i

name: NLAlib.spectrum_real_diagonal_ofReal
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_diagonal_ofReal (d : n → ℝ) :
    spectrum ℝ (diagonal fun i => (d i : ℂ)) = Set.range d
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [← spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff ℂ, spectrum_diagonal]
  change (∃ i, (d i : ℂ) = (x : ℂ)) ↔ ∃ i, d i = x
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_inj]

name: NLAlib.spectrum_real_thinSingularMatrix
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_thinSingularMatrix (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (d : n → ℝ) :
    spectrum ℝ (thinSingularMatrix U U d) = Set.range d
proof:
:= by
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := ⟨U, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr hU⟩
  have he : spectrum ℝ ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (diagonal fun i => (d i : ℂ)) *
      (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) = spectrum ℝ (diagonal fun i => (d i : ℂ)) :=
    AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq
      (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) W).toAlgEquiv (diagonal fun i => (d i : ℂ))
  change spectrum ℝ (U * (diagonal fun i => (d i : ℂ)) * Uᴴ) = Set.range d
  exact he.trans (spectrum_real_diagonal_ofReal d)

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_schur_triangularization_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_schur_triangularization_with_charpoly
    {n 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [RCLike 𝕜] (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) (d : n → 𝕜)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n 𝕜) (T : Matrix n n 𝕜),
      A = (U : Matrix n n 𝕜) * T * (U : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → T i j = 0) ∧ ∀ i, T i i = d i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Module.End 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) := A.toEuclideanLin
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜
  have hstd : f.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = A := LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis A
  have hfchar : f.charpoly = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (X - C (d (e i))) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix f c.toBasis, hstd, hchar]
    exact (e.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (d i))).symm
  obtain ⟨b₀, htri₀, hdiag₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_triangular_with_charpoly
    (Fintype.card n) f (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := 𝕜)) (fun i => d (e i)) hfchar
  let b : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) := b₀.reindex e
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n 𝕜 :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  let T : Matrix n n 𝕜 := f.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n 𝕜) * (U : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hback : b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (U : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ := by
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
      (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse hUU) |>.mul_left_cancel
    change c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
      (U : Matrix n n 𝕜) * (U : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ
    rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, hUU]
  have hA : A = (U : Matrix n n 𝕜) * T * (U : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ := by
    have hbasis := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis f
    calc
      A = f.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis := hstd.symm
      _ = c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * f.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis *
          b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis := hbasis.symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hback]
  refine ⟨U, T, hA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using htri₀ (e.symm i) (e.symm j) hij
  · intro i
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hdiag₀ (e.symm i)

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_pencil_of_quasi_basis
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_pencil_of_quasi_basis
    {𝕜 E F : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F]
    {k : ℕ} (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (B : E ≃ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (e : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) 𝕜 E) (hF : finrank 𝕜 F = k)
    (hT : IsUpperQuasiTriangular
      ((B.symm.toLinearMap.comp A).toMatrix e.toBasis e.toBasis)) :
    ∃ f : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) 𝕜 F,
      IsUpperQuasiTriangular (A.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis) ∧
      (B.toLinearMap.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  let hdim : finrank 𝕜 F = Fintype.card (Fin k) := hF.trans (Fintype.card_fin k).symm
  let f := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis hdim (fun i => B (e i))
  have hR : (B.toLinearMap.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis).IsUpperTriangular := by
    have h := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis_inv_isUpperTriangular
      hdim (fun i => B (e i))
    intro i j hij
    simpa only [f, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe] using h (i := i) (j := j) hij
  have hcomp : B.toLinearMap.comp (B.symm.toLinearMap.comp A) = A := by
    ext x
    exact B.apply_symm_apply (A x)
  have hmat : A.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis =
      B.toLinearMap.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis *
        (B.symm.toLinearMap.comp A).toMatrix e.toBasis e.toBasis := by
    rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_comp, hcomp]
  refine ⟨f, ?_, hR⟩
  rw [hmat]
  exact hT.upperTriangular_mul hR

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_pencil_image_line_of_not_injective
statement:
theorem exists_unit_pencil_image_line_of_not_injective
    {𝕜 E F : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [Nontrivial E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [Nontrivial F]
    (A B : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (hB : ¬ Function.Injective B) :
    ∃ (u : E) (v : F) (a : 𝕜), ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ A u = a • v ∧ B u = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hker : B.ker ≠ ⊥ := fun h => hB (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp h)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  have hBx : B x = 0 := hx
  obtain ⟨y, c, hy, hAx⟩ : ∃ (y : F) (c : 𝕜), y ≠ 0 ∧ A x = c • y := by
    by_cases hAx : A x = 0
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ne (0 : F)
      exact ⟨y, 0, hy, by simp [hAx]⟩
    · exact ⟨A x, 1, hAx, by simp⟩
  have hxn : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0
  have hyn : 0 < ‖y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hy
  have hynK : (‖y‖ : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hyn.ne'
  let u := (‖x‖ : 𝕜)⁻¹ • x
  let v := (‖y‖ : 𝕜)⁻¹ • y
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [u, norm_smul, norm_inv, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg hxn.le,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hxn.ne']
  have hv : ‖v‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [v, norm_smul, norm_inv, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg hyn.le,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hyn.ne']
  refine ⟨u, v, (‖x‖ : 𝕜)⁻¹ * c * ‖y‖, hu, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [u, v, map_smul, hAx, smul_smul, mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hynK, mul_one]
  · simp only [u, map_smul, hBx, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.isRealSchurForm_of_small_leading_block
statement:
theorem isRealSchurForm_of_small_leading_block {p q : ℕ}
    {T : Matrix (Fin (p + q)) (Fin (p + q)) ℝ} (hp : p ≤ 2)
    (hzero : ∀ i : Fin q, ∀ j : Fin p, T (Fin.natAdd p i) (Fin.castAdd q j) = 0)
    (hhead : ∀ i j : Fin p, j.val + 1 = i.val →
      T (Fin.castAdd q i) (Fin.castAdd q j) ≠ 0 →
      T (Fin.castAdd q i) (Fin.castAdd q i) = T (Fin.castAdd q j) (Fin.castAdd q j) ∧
      T (Fin.castAdd q j) (Fin.castAdd q i) * T (Fin.castAdd q i) (Fin.castAdd q j) < 0)
    (htail : IsRealSchurForm (T.submatrix (Fin.natAdd p) (Fin.natAdd p))) :
    IsRealSchurForm T
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isUpperQuasiTriangular_of_small_leading_block hp hzero htail.1, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) i <;>
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) j
  · exact hhead i j
  · intro h; have := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd] at h; omega
  · intro _ h; exact (h (hzero i j)).elim
  · intro h hn
    exact htail.2 i j (by simp only [Fin.val_natAdd] at h; omega) hn

name: NLAlib.exists_small_real_schur_subspace
statement:
theorem exists_small_real_schur_subspace {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [Nontrivial E] (T : Module.End ℝ E) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 2 ∧ ∃ P : Submodule ℝ E,
      ∃ hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P, ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin p) ℝ P,
        ∀ i j, j.val + 1 = i.val → (T.restrict hP).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis i j ≠ 0 →
          (T.restrict hP).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis i i =
            (T.restrict hP).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis j j ∧
          (T.restrict hP).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis j i *
            (T.restrict hP).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis i j < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_invariant_line_or_real_schur_plane T with ⟨P, hdim, hP⟩ |
      ⟨P, hP, b, a, s, t, hmat, hst⟩
  · refine ⟨1, by omega, by omega, P, hP,
      (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ P).reindex (finCongr hdim), ?_⟩
    intro i j hij
    have := i.isLt
    omega
  · refine ⟨2, by omega, le_rfl, P, hP, b, ?_⟩
    intro i j hij _
    rw [hmat]
    have hi : i = 1 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
    have hj : j = 0 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
    subst i; subst j
    exact ⟨rfl, hst⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_real_schur
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_real_schur {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (k : ℕ) (T : Module.End ℝ E) (hk : finrank ℝ E = k) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℝ E,
      IsRealSchurForm (T.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing E with
  | h k ih =>
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · have : IsEmpty (Fin k) := by rw [hk0]; infer_instance
      exact ⟨(stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).reindex (finCongr hk),
        ⟨⟨fun i => isEmptyElim i, fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩, fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩⟩
    have : Nontrivial E := Module.finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hk]; omega)
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp, P, hP, bP, hhead⟩ := exists_small_real_schur_subspace T
    have hPdim : finrank ℝ P = p := by simpa using finrank_eq_card_basis bP.toBasis
    let q := finrank ℝ Pᗮ
    have hsum : p + q = k := by
      rw [← hPdim]
      exact P.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal.trans hk
    have hq : q < k := by omega
    let C : Module.End ℝ Pᗮ :=
      Pᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (T.comp Pᗮ.subtype)
    obtain ⟨bQ, hbQ⟩ := ih q hq C rfl
    obtain ⟨b₀, hbP, hbQ'⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_sum P bP bQ
    let b₁ : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (p + q)) ℝ E := b₀.reindex finSumFinEquiv
    have hleft (i : Fin p) : b₁ (Fin.castAdd q i) = (bP i : E) := by
      simpa only [b₁, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd] using hbP i
    have hright (i : Fin q) : b₁ (Fin.natAdd p i) = (bQ i : E) := by
      simpa only [b₁, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd] using hbQ' i
    have hhead' (i j : Fin p) :
        (T.toMatrix b₁.toBasis b₁.toBasis) (Fin.castAdd q i) (Fin.castAdd q j) =
          (T.restrict hP).toMatrix bP.toBasis bP.toBasis i j := by
      simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hleft,
        Submodule.coe_inner, LinearMap.restrict_apply]
    have htri : IsRealSchurForm (T.toMatrix b₁.toBasis b₁.toBasis) := by
      apply isRealSchurForm_of_small_leading_block hp
      · intro i j
        simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
          OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hleft, hright]
        exact Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (hP _ (bP j).property) (bQ i).property
      · simpa only [hhead'] using hhead
      · have heq : (T.toMatrix b₁.toBasis b₁.toBasis).submatrix (Fin.natAdd p) (Fin.natAdd p) =
            C.toMatrix bQ.toBasis bQ.toBasis := by
          ext i j
          simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
            OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
            OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hright, C, LinearMap.comp_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Submodule.subtype_apply,
            Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left]
        rwa [heq]
    let b := b₁.reindex (finCongr hsum)
    refine ⟨b, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      simpa only [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using htri.1.1 ((finCongr hsum).symm i)
          ((finCongr hsum).symm j) (by simpa using hij)
    · intro i j l hij hjl
      simpa only [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using htri.1.2 ((finCongr hsum).symm i)
          ((finCongr hsum).symm j) ((finCongr hsum).symm l)
            (by simpa using hij) (by simpa using hjl)
    · intro i j hij hn
      have h := htri.2 ((finCongr hsum).symm i) ((finCongr hsum).symm j) (by simpa using hij)
      simp only [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] at hn h ⊢
      exact h hn

name: NLAlib.exists_paired_charpoly_factors_add_mul_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_paired_charpoly_factors_add_mul_of_commute
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hAB : Commute A B) :
    ∃ a b : n → ℂ,
      A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (a i)) ∧ B.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (b i)) ∧
      (A + B).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (a i + b i)) ∧
      (A * B).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (a i * b i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Bool → Matrix n n ℂ := fun j => if j then A else B
  have hF : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (F i) (F j) := by
    intro i j hij
    cases i <;> cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hAB.symm
    · exact hAB
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  obtain ⟨U, T, hT⟩ := exists_simultaneous_unitary_schur_triangularization F hF e
  obtain ⟨hA, hTA, hcharA⟩ := hT true
  obtain ⟨hB, hTB, hcharB⟩ := hT false
  let : LinearOrder n := LinearOrder.lift' e.symm e.symm.injective
  have hTA' : (T true).IsUpperTriangular := hTA
  have hTB' : (T false).IsUpperTriangular := hTB
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hchar (M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
      ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * M * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ).charpoly = M.charpoly := by
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.one_mul]
  change A = _ at hA
  change B = _ at hB
  refine ⟨fun i => T true i i, fun i => T false i i, hcharA, hcharB, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsum : A + B = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (T true + T false) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hA, hB]
    rw [hsum, hchar, Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ (hTA'.add hTB')]
    rfl
  · have hprod : A * B = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (T true * T false) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      rw [hA, hB]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ),
        hUt, Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [hprod, hchar, Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ (hTA'.mul hTB')]
    simp only [mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular hTA' hTB']

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_principal_submatrix_of_finrank_eigenspace_gt
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_principal_submatrix_of_finrank_eigenspace_gt
    (A : Matrix n n K) (μ : K) (s : Finset n)
    (hdim : Fintype.card n - s.card < Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ)) :
    μ ∈ spectrum K (A.submatrix (fun j : s => j.val) (fun j : s => j.val))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ
  let T : W →ₗ[K] ({j : n // j ∉ s} → K) :=
    { toFun x := fun j => x.val j.val
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
  have hker : T.ker ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hzero
    have hrank := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp hzero)
    have hcard : Module.finrank K ({j : n // j ∉ s} → K) = Fintype.card n - s.card := by
      rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_coe]
    rw [hcard] at hrank
    exact (not_le_of_gt hdim) hrank
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  have hout (j : n) (hj : j ∉ s) : v.val j = 0 := congrFun hv ⟨j, hj⟩
  let w : s → K := fun j => v.val j.val
  have hw : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro hwzero
    apply hv0
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ s
    · exact congrFun hwzero ⟨j, hj⟩
    · exact hout j hj
  have heig : A *ᵥ v.val = μ • v.val := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp v.property
  have hAw : A.submatrix (fun j : s => j.val) (fun j : s => j.val) *ᵥ w = μ • w := by
    funext i
    have hsum := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (fun j : n => j ∈ s)
      (fun j => A i.val j * v.val j)
    have hzero : (∑ j : {j : n // j ∉ s}, A i.val j.val * v.val j.val) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j _
      rw [hout j.val j.property, mul_zero]
    rw [hzero, add_zero] at hsum
    change (∑ j : s, A i.val j.val * v.val j.val) = μ * v.val i.val
    convert! hsum.trans (congrFun heig i.val) using 1
    congr 1
    ext j
    simp
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not]
  apply Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp
  refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hAw, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_principal_submatrix_of_le_finrank_eigenspace
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_principal_submatrix_of_le_finrank_eigenspace
    (A : Matrix n n K) (μ : K) (s : Finset n) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ))
    (hs : Fintype.card n < s.card + k) :
    μ ∈ spectrum K (A.submatrix (fun j : s => j.val) (fun j : s => j.val))
proof:
:=
  mem_spectrum_principal_submatrix_of_finrank_eigenspace_gt A μ s (by
    have := s.card_le_univ
    omega)

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_of_isHermitian {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    IsDiagonalizable A
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hUt : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  have hU : IsUnit U := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det U).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt)
  refine ⟨U, hA.eigenvalues, hU, ?_⟩
  calc
    A * U = (U * diagonal hA.eigenvalues * Uᵀ) * U :=
      congrArg (fun M => M * U) (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA)
    _ = U * diagonal hA.eigenvalues := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_commute
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : ι → n → ℝ), HasOrthonormalCols U ∧
      ∀ i, A i * U = U * diagonal (d i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, d, hV, hAV⟩ := exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_of_commute A
    (fun i => isDiagonalizable_of_isHermitian (hA i)) hcomm
  have hGram : IsUnit (Vᵀ * V) := ((Matrix.isUnit_transpose V).mpr hV).mul hV
  refine ⟨polarFrame V, d, hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame V hGram, fun i => ?_⟩
  apply mul_polarFrame_eq_polarFrame_mul_of_intertwining (A i) (diagonal (d i)) V hGram
    (hAV i)
  have ht : (A i)ᵀ = A i := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using (hA i).eq
  simpa only [diagonal_transpose, ht] using hAV i

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_congruence_diagonal_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_congruence_diagonal_of_commute {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : Commute A B) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n → ℝ), HasOrthonormalCols U ∧
      Uᵀ * A * U = diagonal a ∧ Uᵀ * B * U = diagonal b
proof:
:= by
  let F : Bool → Matrix n n ℝ := fun i => if i then A else B
  have hF : ∀ i, (F i).IsHermitian := by intro i; cases i <;> assumption
  have hComm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (F i) (F j) := by
    intro i j hij
    cases i <;> cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hAB.symm
    · exact hAB
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  obtain ⟨U, d, hU, hUF⟩ :=
    exists_simultaneous_orthogonal_diagonalization_of_commute F hF hComm
  refine ⟨U, d true, d false, hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, show A * U = U * diagonal (d true) from hUF true,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul]
  · rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, show B * U = U * diagonal (d false) from hUF false,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.normal_of_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors
statement:
theorem normal_of_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hb : ∀ j, A *ᵥ ⇑(b j) = d j • ⇑(b j)) : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis,
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  have hAU : A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    ext i j
    have hcol : ∀ k, (U : Matrix n n ℂ) k j = (b j) k := fun _ => rfl
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    have h := congrFun (hb j) i
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Matrix.mul_apply, hcol, mul_comm] using h
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  apply mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_unitary_diagonalization U d
  rw [← hAU, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUU, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.normal_iff_exists_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors
statement:
theorem normal_iff_exists_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A ↔
      ∃ (b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) (d : n → ℂ),
        ∀ j, A *ᵥ ⇑(b j) = d j • ⇑(b j)
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors_of_normal,
    fun ⟨b, d, hb⟩ => normal_of_orthonormalBasis_eigenvectors A b d hb⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_characteristic_eq_frobSq_iff_normal
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_characteristic_eq_frobSq_iff_normal (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    (∑ i, ‖d i‖ ^ 2) = frobSq A ↔ A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, T, hA, _, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  have hsum := sum_norm_sq_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq d (fun i => T i i) (hd.symm.trans hchar)
  rw [hsum]
  exact sum_norm_sq_schur_diagonal_eq_frobSq_iff_normal U T hA hchar

name: NLAlib.commute_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff
statement:
theorem commute_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (A X S : Matrix n n K) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    Commute (S⁻¹ * A * S) (S⁻¹ * X * S) ↔ Commute A X
proof:
:= by
  let := hS.nonempty_invertible.some
  constructor
  · intro h
    change A * X = X * A
    have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => S * M * S⁻¹) h.eq
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_inv_cancel_left_of_invertible,
      Matrix.inv_mul_cancel_left_of_invertible, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible,
      Matrix.mul_one] using hh
  · intro h
    have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => S⁻¹ * M * S) h.eq
    change (S⁻¹ * A * S) * (S⁻¹ * X * S) = (S⁻¹ * X * S) * (S⁻¹ * A * S)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_inv_cancel_left_of_invertible] using hh

name: NLAlib.commute_similarity_blockDiagonal'_iff
statement:
theorem commute_similarity_blockDiagonal'_iff
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {m : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (m i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (m i)]
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) K)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (spectrum K (A i)) (spectrum K (A j)))
    (S X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, m i) K) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    Commute (S * Matrix.blockDiagonal' A * S⁻¹) X ↔
      ∃ Y : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) K,
        X = S * Matrix.blockDiagonal' Y * S⁻¹ ∧ ∀ i, Commute (A i) (Y i)
proof:
:= by
  let := hS.nonempty_invertible.some
  rw [← commute_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff _ X S hS]
  have hconj : S⁻¹ * (S * Matrix.blockDiagonal' A * S⁻¹) * S = Matrix.blockDiagonal' A := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.inv_mul_cancel_left_of_invertible,
      Matrix.inv_mul_of_invertible, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hconj, commute_blockDiagonal'_iff A hdisj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Y, hY, hcomm⟩
    refine ⟨Y, ?_, hcomm⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun M => S * M * S⁻¹) hY
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_inv_cancel_left_of_invertible,
      Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.mul_one] using h
  · rintro ⟨Y, hY, hcomm⟩
    refine ⟨Y, ?_, hcomm⟩
    rw [hY]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.inv_mul_cancel_left_of_invertible,
      Matrix.inv_mul_of_invertible, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_pos_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem singularValues_last_pos_iff_isUnit [Nonempty n] (C : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    0 < singularValues C (Fintype.card n - 1) ↔ IsUnit C
proof:
:= by
  rw [singularValues_last_pos_iff_rank_eq_card C Fintype.card_pos]
  refine ⟨fun hRank => ?_, Matrix.rank_of_isUnit C⟩
  refine (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det C).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun hdet => ?_)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hCv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker C.mulVecLin
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hrn
  have hr : Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range C.mulVecLin) = Fintype.card n := hRank
  have hker : Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.ker C.mulVecLin) = 0 := by omega
  rw [Submodule.finrank_eq_zero] at hker
  have hmem : v ∈ LinearMap.ker C.mulVecLin := by simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker] using hCv
  rw [hker, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact hv hmem

name: NLAlib.deflated_spectralRadius_lt_one_of_simple_unique_peripheral
statement:
theorem deflated_spectralRadius_lt_one_of_simple_unique_peripheral
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) {p q : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpair : q ⬝ᵥ p ≠ 0)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = (r : ℂ) • p) (hqA : q ᵥ* A = (r : ℂ) • q)
    (hsimple : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity (r : ℂ) = 1)
    (hbound : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖μ‖ ≤ r)
    (hperipheral : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖μ‖ = r → μ = (r : ℂ)) :
    spectralRadius ℂ ((r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A - (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q) < 1
proof:
:= by
  let P := (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q
  let T := (r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A
  let Q := T - P
  have hrC : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
  have hPP : P * P = P := normalized_vecMulVec_mul_self hpair
  have hAP : A * P = (r : ℂ) • P := (mul_normalized_vecMulVec_eq_smul hAp hqA).1
  have hPA : P * A = (r : ℂ) • P := (mul_normalized_vecMulVec_eq_smul hAp hqA).2
  have hTP : T * P = P := by
    change ((r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A) * P = P
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, hAP, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hrC, one_smul]
  have hPT : P * T = P := by
    change P * ((r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A) = P
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, hPA, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hrC, one_smul]
  have hPQ : P * Q = 0 := by
    change P * (T - P) = 0
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hPT, hPP, sub_self]
  have hPp : P *ᵥ p = p := by
    ext i
    simp only [P, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, MulOpposite.unop_op]
    field_simp [hpair]
  have hspanle : ℂ ∙ p ≤ Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' (r : ℂ) :=
    (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem p _).mpr (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hAp)
  have hdimle := LinearMap.finrank_eigenspace_le A.toLin' (r : ℂ)
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_toLin', hsimple] at hdimle
  have hdimge := Submodule.finrank_mono hspanle
  rw [finrank_span_singleton hp] at hdimge
  have hspan : ℂ ∙ p = Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' (r : ℂ) :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hspanle (by rw [finrank_span_singleton hp]; omega)
  apply spectrum.spectralRadius_lt_of_forall_lt
  intro μ hμ
  have hμreal : ‖μ‖ < (1 : ℝ) := by
    by_cases hμ0 : μ = 0
    · simp [hμ0]
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hQz⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
    have hPz0 : P *ᵥ z = 0 := by
      have hzero : μ • (P *ᵥ z) = 0 := by
        rw [← Matrix.mulVec_smul, ← hQz, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hPQ, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hμ0
    have hTz : T *ᵥ z = μ • z := by
      change (T - P) *ᵥ z = μ • z at hQz
      simpa only [Matrix.sub_mulVec, hPz0, sub_zero] using hQz
    have hAeq : A = (r : ℂ) • T := by
      change A = (r : ℂ) • ((r : ℂ)⁻¹ • A)
      rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hrC, one_smul]
    have hAz : A *ᵥ z = ((r : ℂ) * μ) • z := by
      rw [hAeq, Matrix.smul_mulVec, hTz, smul_smul]
    have hAzmem := Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hz hAz
    have hnorm := hbound _ hAzmem
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr] at hnorm
    have hnorm1 : ‖μ‖ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    by_contra! hnot
    have heq1 : ‖μ‖ = 1 := le_antisymm hnorm1 hnot
    have hper := hperipheral _ hAzmem (by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr, heq1, mul_one])
    have hμ1 : μ = 1 := mul_left_cancel₀ hrC (by simpa only [mul_one] using hper)
    have hmem : z ∈ Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' (r : ℂ) :=
      Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (by
        change A *ᵥ z = _
        simpa only [hμ1, mul_one] using hAz)
    rw [← hspan] at hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    have hPz : P *ᵥ z = z := by rw [← hc, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hPp]
    exact hz (hPz.symm.trans hPz0)
  exact_mod_cast hμreal

name: NLAlib.maxAdjacentAbsRatio_nonneg
statement:
theorem maxAdjacentAbsRatio_nonneg {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ maxAdjacentAbsRatio d
proof: := NNReal.coe_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.adjacentAbsRatio_le_max
statement:
theorem adjacentAbsRatio_le_max {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : i.val + 1 < n) :
    |d ⟨i.val+1, hi⟩| / |d i| ≤ maxAdjacentAbsRatio d
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨if h : i.val + 1 < n then |d ⟨i.val+1, h⟩| / |d i| else 0,
      by split_ifs <;> positivity⟩ : ℝ≥0)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  change (if h : i.val + 1 < n then |d ⟨i.val+1, h⟩| / |d i| else 0) ≤
    maxAdjacentAbsRatio d at h
  simpa only [dif_pos hi] using h

name: NLAlib.maxAdjacentAbsRatio_lt_one
statement:
theorem maxAdjacentAbsRatio_lt_one {n : ℕ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hd : StrictAnti fun i => |d i|) : maxAdjacentAbsRatio d < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxAdjacentAbsRatio
  apply NNReal.coe_lt_one.mpr
  apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (α := NNReal) (a := 1) (by norm_num)).mpr
  intro i _
  change (if h : i.val + 1 < n then |d ⟨i.val+1, h⟩| / |d i| else 0) < (1 : ℝ)
  split_ifs with hi
  · have hlt := hd (show i < (⟨i.val+1, hi⟩ : Fin n) from Fin.lt_def.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _))
    exact (div_lt_one (lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) hlt)).mpr hlt
  · norm_num

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_similarity
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_similarity (A : Matrix n n K) :
    IsDiagonalizable A ↔ ∃ (V : Matrix n n K) (d : n → K),
      IsUnit V ∧ A = V * Matrix.diagonal d * V⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨V, d, hV, hAV⟩
    refine ⟨V, d, hV, ?_⟩
    have hdet := V.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hV
    calc
      A = A * (V * V⁻¹) := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv V hdet, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV]
  · rintro ⟨V, d, hV, hA⟩
    refine ⟨V, d, hV, ?_⟩
    rw [hA, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul V (V.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hV),
      Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_independent_eigenvectors
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_independent_eigenvectors (A : Matrix n n K) :
    IsDiagonalizable A ↔ ∃ (v : n → n → K) (d : n → K),
      LinearIndependent K v ∧ ∀ j, A *ᵥ v j = d j • v j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨V, d, hV, hAV⟩
    refine ⟨Matrix.col V, d, Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mpr hV, ?_⟩
    intro j
    funext i
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => M i j) hAV
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Matrix.col_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h
  · rintro ⟨v, d, hv, hAv⟩
    let V : Matrix n n K := fun i j => v j i
    refine ⟨V, d, Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mp hv, ?_⟩
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    change (∑ k, A i k * v j k) = v j i * d j
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using congrFun (hAv j) i

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_eigenbasis (A : Matrix n n K) :
    IsDiagonalizable A ↔ ∃ (b : Basis n K (n → K)) (d : n → K),
      ∀ j, A *ᵥ b j = d j • b j
proof:
:= by
  rw [isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_independent_eigenvectors]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, d, hv, hAv⟩
    let b := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' v hv
      (Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card K).symm
    refine ⟨b, d, ?_⟩
    simpa only [b, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'] using hAv
  · rintro ⟨b, d, hAv⟩
    exact ⟨b, d, b.linearIndependent, hAv⟩

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_of_distinct_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_of_distinct_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n K} (d : n → K)
    (hd : Function.Injective d) (hroots : ∀ j, d j ∈ spectrum K A) :
    IsDiagonalizable A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose v hv hAv using fun j => exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum (hroots j)
  apply (isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_independent_eigenvectors A).mpr
  refine ⟨v, d, Module.End.eigenvectors_linearIndependent' A.toLin' d hd v ?_, hAv⟩
  intro j
  exact ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (hAv j), hv j⟩

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top (A : Matrix n n K) :
    IsDiagonalizable A ↔ (⨆ μ : K, Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hA
    obtain ⟨b, d, hb⟩ := (isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_eigenbasis A).mp hA
    apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem b).mpr
    intro j
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (d j) (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (hb j))
  · intro hspan
    have hsum : DirectSum.IsInternal (fun μ : K => Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ) :=
      DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
        (Module.End.eigenspaces_iSupIndep A.toLin') hspan
    let c := hsum.collectedBasis (fun μ => Module.finBasis K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ))
    let : Fintype (Σ μ : K, Fin (Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ))) :=
      FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex c
    have hcCard : Fintype.card (Σ μ : K, Fin (Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ))) =
        Fintype.card n := by
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis c, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
    let e := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcCard
    let b : Basis n K (n → K) := c.reindex e
    apply (isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_eigenbasis A).mpr
    refine ⟨b, fun j => (e.symm j).1, fun j => ?_⟩
    change A.toLin' (b j) = (e.symm j).1 • b j
    apply Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp
    simpa only [b, Basis.reindex_apply] using
      hsum.collectedBasis_mem (fun μ => Module.finBasis K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ)) (e.symm j)

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_of_isSemisimple
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_of_isSemisimple [IsAlgClosed K] {A : Matrix n n K}
    (hA : Module.End.IsSemisimple A.toLin') : IsDiagonalizable A
proof:
:=
  (isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top A).mpr hA.iSup_eigenspace_eq_top

name: NLAlib.IsDiagonalizable.isSemisimple
statement:
theorem IsDiagonalizable.isSemisimple {A : Matrix n n K} (hA : IsDiagonalizable A) :
    Module.End.IsSemisimple A.toLin'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, d, hb⟩ := (isDiagonalizable_iff_exists_eigenbasis A).mp hA
  let s : Finset K := Finset.univ.image d
  let p : K[X] := ∏ μ ∈ s, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ)
  have hp : Squarefree p := by
    apply Finset.squarefree_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime
    · intro α hα β hβ hαβ
      exact (Polynomial.isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub
        (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hαβ))).isRelPrime
    · intro μ hμ
      exact (Polynomial.irreducible_X_sub_C μ).squarefree
  apply Module.End.isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero hp
  apply b.ext
  intro j
  have heval : p.eval (d j) = 0 := by
    change (∏ μ ∈ s, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ)).eval (d j) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩)
    simp
  rw [Module.End.aeval_apply_of_mem_apply_eq_smul (hb j), heval, zero_smul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_iff_isSemisimple
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_iff_isSemisimple [IsAlgClosed K] (A : Matrix n n K) :
    IsDiagonalizable A ↔ Module.End.IsSemisimple A.toLin'
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsDiagonalizable.isSemisimple, isDiagonalizable_of_isSemisimple⟩

name: NLAlib.IsDiagonalizable.finrank_eigenspace_eq_rootMultiplicity
proof:
:= by
  have hm := LinearMap.finrank_maxGenEigenspace_eq A.toLin' μ
  have heq : Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ = Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ :=
    hA.isSemisimple.isFinitelySemisimple.maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace μ
  rw [heq] at hm
  simpa only [Matrix.charpoly_toLin'] using hm

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_iff_finrank_eigenspace_eq_rootMultiplicity
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_iff_finrank_eigenspace_eq_rootMultiplicity [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : Matrix n n K) : IsDiagonalizable A ↔
      ∀ μ : K, Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ) =
        A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun hA μ => hA.finrank_eigenspace_eq_rootMultiplicity μ
  · intro hmult
    have heq (μ : K) : Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ =
        Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ := by
      apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace
      rw [hmult μ, LinearMap.finrank_maxGenEigenspace_eq, Matrix.charpoly_toLin']
    apply (isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top A).mpr
    simpa only [heq] using Module.End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top A.toLin'

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_transpose_mul_mul_eq_diagonal_singularValues
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_transpose_mul_mul_eq_diagonal_singularValues
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p] (A : Matrix p p ℝ) :
    ∃ V W : Matrix p p ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
      Vᵀ * A * W = Matrix.diagonal
        (fun i => singularValues A ((Fintype.equivFin p) i))
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin p
  let AF := A.reindex e e
  obtain ⟨V, W, h⟩ := exists_isSVD AF
  refine ⟨V.reindex e.symm e.symm, W.reindex e.symm e.symm,
    HasOrthonormalCols.reindex h.conjTranspose_mul_left _ _,
    HasOrthonormalCols.reindex h.conjTranspose_mul_right _ _, ?_⟩
  have hBack : AF.reindex e.symm e.symm = A := by ext i j; simp [AF]
  have hEq := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card p))
      (Fin (Fintype.card p)) ℝ => M.reindex e.symm e.symm)
    (show Vᵀ * AF * W = rectDiag (singularValues AF) from h.conjTranspose_mul_mul)
  rw [mul_reindex _ _ e.symm e.symm e.symm,
    mul_reindex _ _ e.symm e.symm e.symm, hBack] at hEq
  have hTr : Vᵀ.reindex e.symm e.symm = (V.reindex e.symm e.symm)ᵀ := rfl
  rw [hTr] at hEq
  refine hEq.trans ?_
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.symm_symm,
    rectDiag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  have hij : ((e i : Fin (Fintype.card p)) : ℕ) = e j ↔ i = j := by
    constructor
    · exact fun h => e.injective (Fin.ext h)
    · rintro rfl; rfl
  simp only [hij]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst j
    exact congrFun (singularValues_reindex A _ _) _
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.norm_sq_complex
statement: private theorem norm_sq_complex (z : ℂ) : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2
proof:
:= by
