  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_blochVector_eq_one
statement:
private theorem norm_blochVector_eq_one {x : Fin 2 → ℂ}
    (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) : ‖blochVector x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖x 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖x 1‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
    simpa [hx, Fin.sum_univ_two] using h.symm
  have hc := norm_sq_complex (star (x 0) * x 1)
  rw [norm_mul, norm_star, mul_pow] at hc
  have hb : ‖blochVector x‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    change (∑ i : Fin 3, ‖![2 * (star (x 0) * x 1).re,
      2 * (star (x 0) * x 1).im, ‖x 0‖ ^ 2 - ‖x 1‖ ^ 2] i‖ ^ 2) = 1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ,
      Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (blochVector x)]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_eq_affine_bloch
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖x 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖x 1‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
    simpa [hx, Fin.sum_univ_two] using h.symm
  have hsC : (‖x 0‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) + (‖x 1‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) = 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hs
  have hself (z : ℂ) : star z * z = (‖z‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.star_def, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    push_cast
    rfl
  let c := star (x 0) * x 1
  have hq : quadForm B x = (‖x 0‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * B 0 0 +
      (‖x 1‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * B 1 1 + c * B 0 1 + star c * B 1 0 := by
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply,
      c, star_mul, star_star]
    linear_combination B 0 0 * hself (x 0) + B 1 1 * hself (x 1)
  have hc : c = (c.re : ℂ) + Complex.I * (c.im : ℂ) := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using (Complex.re_add_im c).symm
  have hcs : star c = (c.re : ℂ) - Complex.I * (c.im : ℂ) := by
    rw [hc]
    simp [star_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    ring
  rw [hq]
  change (‖x 0‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * B 0 0 + (‖x 1‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * B 1 1 + c * B 0 1 +
    star c * B 1 0 = (B 0 0 + B 1 1) / 2 +
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (blochVector x) i • ![(B 0 1 + B 1 0) / 2,
        Complex.I * (B 0 1 - B 1 0) / 2, (B 0 0 - B 1 1) / 2] i
  simp only [blochVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ,
    Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero, Complex.real_smul]
  change (‖x 0‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * B 0 0 + (‖x 1‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * B 1 1 + c * B 0 1 +
    star c * B 1 0 = (B 0 0 + B 1 1) / 2 +
      (((2 * c.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((B 0 1 + B 1 0) / 2) +
      (((2 * c.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (B 0 1 - B 1 0) / 2) +
      ((‖x 0‖ ^ 2 - ‖x 1‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((B 0 0 - B 1 1) / 2)))
  push_cast
  linear_combination ((B 0 0 + B 1 1) / 2) * hsC + B 0 1 * hc + B 1 0 * hcs

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_blochVector_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hs : r 0 ^ 2 + r 1 ^ 2 + r 2 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq r
    rw [hr] at h
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, add_assoc] using h.symm
  have hr2 : -1 ≤ r 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r 0), sq_nonneg (r 1)]
  by_cases hbot : r 2 = -1
  · have hzero0 : r 0 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r 1)]
    have hzero1 : r 1 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r 0)]
    refine ⟨![0, 1], ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![0, (1 : ℂ)] : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2))‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 ![0, (1 : ℂ)] : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2))]
    · ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [blochVector, hzero0, hzero1, hbot]
  · have hr2gt : -1 < r 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hr2 (Ne.symm hbot)
    let u : ℝ := Real.sqrt ((1 + r 2) / 2)
    have hu : 0 < u := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by dsimp; linarith)
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := hu.ne'
    have huSq : u ^ 2 = (1 + r 2) / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hden : (2 * u) ^ 2 = 2 * (1 + r 2) := by nlinarith
    let v : ℂ := (r 0 / (2 * u) : ℝ) + Complex.I * (r 1 / (2 * u) : ℝ)
    have hv : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (1 - r 2) / 2 := by
      rw [norm_sq_complex]
      simp only [v, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        zero_mul, mul_zero, one_mul, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
      rw [div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, hden]
      field_simp [show 1 + r 2 ≠ 0 by linarith]
      nlinarith [hs]
    have huNorm : ‖(u : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = (1 + r 2) / 2 := by
      simpa only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using huSq
    let x : Fin 2 → ℂ := ![(u : ℂ), v]
    have hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1 := by
      have hxSq : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        change ‖(u : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2 = 1
        rw [huNorm, hv]
        ring
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 x)]
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change 2 * (star (u : ℂ) * v).re = r 0
      simp only [v, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
        Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        zero_mul, mul_zero, one_mul, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
      field_simp [hu0]
    · change 2 * (star (u : ℂ) * v).im = r 1
      simp only [v, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
        Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        zero_mul, mul_zero, one_mul, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
      field_simp [hu0]
    · change ‖(u : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 - ‖v‖ ^ 2 = r 2
      rw [huNorm, hv]
      ring

name: NLAlib.numericalRange_eq_affine_bloch_image
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨blochMap B (blochVector x), ⟨blochVector x, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using norm_blochVector_eq_one hx
    · exact (quadForm_eq_affine_bloch hx B).symm
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hnorm : ‖r‖ = 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hr
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩ := exists_unit_blochVector_eq r hnorm
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    rw [quadForm_eq_affine_bloch hx B, hxr]

name: NLAlib.convex_numericalRange_two
statement:
theorem convex_numericalRange_two (B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Convex ℝ (numericalRange B)
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (blochMap B) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    have hdim := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp h)
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Complex.finrank_real_complex] at hdim
    omega
  rw [numericalRange_eq_affine_bloch_image]
  exact ((blochMap B).convex_image_sphere_of_ker_ne_bot hker).translate _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : specNorm A = ‖hA.eigenvalues‖
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rw [← Unitary.coe_star, CStarRing.norm_mul_coe_unitary,
    CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary_mul, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_trace_of_posSemidef {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : specNorm A ≤ Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl hi =>
    have hzero : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hzero, specNorm, Matrix.trace]
  | inr hi =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues).1
    dsimp only at hi
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hA.isHermitian, ← hi,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i), hA.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hA.eigenvalues_nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_mulVec_eq_specNorm_smul
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mulVec_eq_specNorm_smul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Nonempty ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ v : ι → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 ∧ A *ᵥ v = specNorm A • v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues).1
  dsimp only at hi
  have heig : hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i = specNorm A := by
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hA.isHermitian, ← hi,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)]
  let v : ι → ℝ := (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i).ofLp
  have hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    have hn := hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i
    have hs := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) hn
    rw [norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _), one_pow] at hs
    exact hs
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
  simpa only [heig] using hA.isHermitian.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_specNorm_mul_dotProduct_sq_le
statement:
theorem exists_unit_specNorm_mul_dotProduct_sq_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ v : ι → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 ∧
      ∀ z : ι → ℝ, specNorm A * (v ⬝ᵥ z) ^ 2 ≤ z ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, heig⟩ := exists_unit_mulVec_eq_specNorm_smul hA
  refine ⟨v, hv, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hsym : Aᵀ = A := (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hA.isHermitian).eq
  have hvAz : v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z) = specNorm A * (v ⬝ᵥ z) := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hsym, heig,
      smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  have hzAv : z ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = specNorm A * (v ⬝ᵥ z) := by
    rw [heig, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm]
  have hvAv : v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = specNorm A := by
    rw [heig, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hv, mul_one]
  have hpos := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (z - (v ⬝ᵥ z) • v)
  simp only [star_trivial] at hpos
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
    dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct,
    smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hvAz, hzAv, hvAv] at hpos
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hpos
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_bound_norm_matrix_pow_iff
statement:
theorem exists_bound_norm_matrix_pow_iff (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ C) ↔
      spectralRadius ℂ A ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ μ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ = 1 → Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toEuclideanLin μ =
        Module.End.eigenspace A.toEuclideanLin μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  let f : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := A.toEuclideanLin
  have hnorm (k : ℕ) : ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f ^ k)‖ = ‖A ^ k‖ := by
    have hp : LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f ^ k) =
        Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) (A ^ k) := by
      calc
        LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f ^ k) = (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap f) ^ k :=
          (Module.End.toContinuousLinearMap (EuclideanSpace ℂ n)).map_pow f k
        _ = Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) (A ^ k) :=
          (map_pow (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)) A k).symm
    rw [hp, Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM]
  have hspec (μ : ℂ) : f.HasEigenvalue μ ↔ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A := by
    rw [Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_mem_spectrum]
    change μ ∈ spectrum ℂ ((Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℂ n)) A) ↔ _
    rw [AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq]
  have hradius : (∀ μ : ℂ, f.HasEigenvalue μ → ‖μ‖ ≤ 1) ↔ spectralRadius ℂ A ≤ 1 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply iSup₂_le
      intro μ hμ
      exact_mod_cast h μ ((hspec μ).mpr hμ)
    · intro h μ hμ
      have hle : (‖μ‖₊ : ENNReal) ≤ 1 :=
        (le_iSup₂ (α := ENNReal) μ ((hspec μ).mp hμ)).trans h
      exact_mod_cast hle
  have h := exists_bound_norm_pow_iff_eigenvalues_le_one_and_peripheral_semisimple f
  simpa only [hnorm, hradius] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_bound_norm_real_matrix_pow_iff_complexification
statement:
theorem exists_bound_norm_real_matrix_pow_iff_complexification (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ C) ↔
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, specNorm ((A.map Complex.ofReal) ^ k) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  let L : Matrix n n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    { toFun M := M.map Complex.ofReal
      map_add' M N := by ext i j; simp
      map_smul' c M := by ext i j; simp [Complex.real_smul] }
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
    refine ⟨‖L.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * C, fun k => ?_⟩
    have h := L.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (A ^ k)
    change ‖(A ^ k).map Complex.ofReal‖ ≤ ‖L.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖A ^ k‖ at h
    rw [map_ofReal_matrix_pow] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC k) (norm_nonneg L.toContinuousLinearMap))
  · rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
    refine ⟨C, fun k => ?_⟩
    have h : specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ ‖(A ^ k).map Complex.ofReal‖ :=
      (specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (A ^ k)).trans_eq (specNorm_eq_norm _)
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, map_ofReal_matrix_pow] at h
    exact h.trans (hC k)

name: NLAlib.exists_bound_norm_real_matrix_pow_iff
statement:
theorem exists_bound_norm_real_matrix_pow_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ C) ↔
      spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ μ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ = 1 → Module.End.maxGenEigenspace (A.map Complex.ofReal).toEuclideanLin μ =
        Module.End.eigenspace (A.map Complex.ofReal).toEuclideanLin μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [exists_bound_norm_real_matrix_pow_iff_complexification, exists_bound_norm_matrix_pow_iff]

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_charpoly_of_interlacing
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (d : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (b : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (hinter : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
      (Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
          (∏ i, (X - C (b i))) ∧ a = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, a, hv⟩ := exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly d b hd hb hinter
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  have hdN : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C ((d ∘ e.symm) i)) :=
    hchar.trans (e.symm.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (d i))).symm
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_bordered_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
    A hA (d ∘ e.symm) (v ∘ e.symm) a hdN
  have hout := hu.trans ((charpoly_diagonal_arrowhead_reindex e d v a).trans hv)
  refine ⟨u, a, hout, ?_⟩
  rw [border_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_eq_prod A u a b hout,
    trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod A d hchar]

name: NLAlib.exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
statement:
theorem exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (d b : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ i, (X - C (b i))) ∧ (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly d b hd hb hlo hhi
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  have hdN : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C ((d ∘ e.symm) i)) :=
    hchar.trans (e.symm.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (d i))).symm
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
    A hA (d ∘ e.symm) (v ∘ e.symm) hdN
  have hout := hu.trans ((charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_reindex e d v).trans hv)
  refine ⟨u, hout, ?_⟩
  rw [sum_sq_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_add_vecMulVec A u b hout,
    trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod A d hchar]

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
statement:
theorem exists_sub_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (d b : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (hlo : ∀ i, b i ≤ d i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → d i ≤ b j) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, (A - Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ i, (X - C (b i))) ∧ (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = (∑ i, d i) - ∑ i, b i
proof:
:= by
  let d' : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ := fun i => -d i.rev
  let b' : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ := fun i => -b i.rev
  have hd' : Monotone d' := fun i j hij => neg_le_neg (hd (Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr hij))
  have hb' : Monotone b' := fun i j hij => neg_le_neg (hb (Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr hij))
  have hlo' (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : d' i ≤ b' i := neg_le_neg (hlo i.rev)
  have hhi' (i j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) : b' i ≤ d' j := by
    apply neg_le_neg
    apply hhi j.rev i.rev
    simp only [Fin.val_rev]
    omega
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  have hdN : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C ((d ∘ e.symm) i)) :=
    hchar.trans (e.symm.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (d i))).symm
  have hneg : (-A).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d' i)) := by
    rw [charpoly_neg_eq_prod_of_isHermitian A hA (d ∘ e.symm) hdN]
    calc
      (∏ i, (X - C (-((d ∘ e.symm) i)))) = ∏ i, (X - C (-d i)) :=
        e.symm.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (-d i))
      _ = ∏ i, (X - C (d' i)) := (Equiv.prod_comp Fin.revPerm (fun i => X - C (-d i))).symm
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ := exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (-A) hA.neg d' b' hd' hb' hneg hlo' hhi'
  have hS : (-A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).IsHermitian := by
    apply hA.neg.add
    simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_vecMulVec]
  have hbN : (-A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C ((b' ∘ e.symm) i)) :=
    hv.trans (e.symm.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (b' i))).symm
  have hout : (A - Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (b i)) := by
    have ht := charpoly_neg_eq_prod_of_isHermitian _ hS (b' ∘ e.symm) hbN
    have hmat : -(-A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v) = A - Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by abel
    rw [hmat] at ht
    refine ht.trans ?_
    calc
      (∏ i, (X - C (-((b' ∘ e.symm) i)))) = ∏ i, (X - C (-b' i)) :=
        e.symm.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (-b' i))
      _ = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (X - C (b i.rev)) := by simp only [b', neg_neg]
      _ = ∏ i, (X - C (b i)) := Equiv.prod_comp Fin.revPerm (fun i => X - C (b i))
  refine ⟨v, hout, ?_⟩
  rw [sum_sq_eq_trace_sub_sum_of_charpoly_sub_vecMulVec A v b hout,
    trace_eq_sum_of_charpoly_eq_prod A d hchar]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.trace_inv_submatrix_succAbove_eq
statement:
theorem trace_inv_submatrix_succAbove_eq {q : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (hM : IsUnit M)
    (j : Fin (q + 1)) (hjj : M⁻¹ j j ≠ 0) :
    (M.submatrix j.succAbove j.succAbove)⁻¹.trace =
      M⁻¹.trace - (M⁻¹ ^ 2) j j / M⁻¹ j j
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := M⁻¹
  let N : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun a b => R a b - R a j * R j b / R j j
  have hMR : M * R = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det M).mp hM)
  have hNj (b : Fin (q + 1)) : N j b = 0 := by
    dsimp [N]
    field_simp [show R j j ≠ 0 from hjj]
    ring
  have hfull (a b : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∑ l, M a l * N l b) = (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) a b -
        (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) a j * R j b / R j j := by
    have hab := congrArg (fun P : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ => P a b) hMR
    have haj := congrArg (fun P : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ => P a j) hMR
    change (∑ l, M a l * R l b) = _ at hab
    change (∑ l, M a l * R l j) = _ at haj
    calc
      _ = (∑ l, M a l * R l b) - (∑ l, M a l * R l j) * R j b / R j j := by
        dsimp [N]
        simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_div]
        apply congrArg₂ (· - ·) rfl
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro l _
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hab, haj]
  have hinv : (M.submatrix j.succAbove j.succAbove)⁻¹ =
      N.submatrix j.succAbove j.succAbove := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    ext a b
    change (∑ l : Fin q, M (j.succAbove a) (j.succAbove l) *
      N (j.succAbove l) (j.succAbove b)) = (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ) a b
    have hs := Fin.sum_univ_succAbove
      (fun l => M (j.succAbove a) l * N l (j.succAbove b)) j
    rw [hNj, mul_zero, zero_add, hfull] at hs
    have hne := j.succAbove_ne a
    have heq : (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (j.succAbove a) (j.succAbove b) =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ) a b := by
      exact congrArg (fun P : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ => P a b)
        (Matrix.submatrix_one j.succAbove Fin.succAbove_right_injective)
    simpa only [Matrix.one_apply_ne hne, zero_mul, zero_div, sub_zero, heq] using hs.symm
  rw [hinv]
  have hs := Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun a => N a a) j
  rw [hNj, zero_add] at hs
  change (∑ a : Fin q, N (j.succAbove a) (j.succAbove a)) = _
  rw [← hs]
  dsimp [N]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  change R.trace - (∑ a, R a j * R j a / R j j) = R.trace - (R ^ 2) j j / R j j
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, pow_two, Matrix.mul_apply]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_principal_deletion_posDef_and_trace_inv_le
statement:
theorem exists_principal_deletion_posDef_and_trace_inv_le {q : ℕ}
    {M : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ T : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (_hT : 0 < T) (htrace : M⁻¹.trace ≤ T)
    (hstep : 2 * δ * T ≤ 1) :
    ∃ j : Fin (q + 1),
      ((M - δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)).submatrix
        j.succAbove j.succAbove).PosDef ∧
      ((M - δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)).submatrix
        j.succAbove j.succAbove)⁻¹.trace ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  have hcap : δ * M⁻¹.trace < 1 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htrace hδ.le
    nlinarith
  let S := M - δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)
  let R := S⁻¹
  have hS : S.PosDef := hM.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδ hcap
  have hR : R.PosDef := hS.inv
  have hgap : 0 < R.trace - M⁻¹.trace := hM.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sub_trace_inv_pos hδ hcap
  have havg := hM.reciprocal_barrier_lower_le hδ hcap
  change 1 / δ - M⁻¹.trace ≤ (R ^ 2).trace / (R.trace - M⁻¹.trace) - R.trace at havg
  have hsq : (1 / δ - M⁻¹.trace + R.trace) * (R.trace - M⁻¹.trace) ≤ (R ^ 2).trace :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hgap).mp (by linarith)
  have hδT : δ * T ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hTδ : T ≤ 1 / δ := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hnon : 0 ≤ M⁻¹.trace := hM.inv.posSemidef.trace_nonneg
  have hRtrace : 0 < R.trace := hR.trace_pos
  have hquad : R.trace * (R.trace - T) ≤ (R ^ 2).trace := by
    have hd : 0 ≤ T - M⁻¹.trace := sub_nonneg.mpr htrace
    have hprod := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hTδ) hgap.le
    have hprod' := mul_nonneg hd hnon
    have hprod'' := mul_nonneg hd hgap.le
    nlinarith
  have hsum : (∑ j, R j j * (R.trace - T)) ≤ ∑ j, (R ^ 2) j j := by
    simpa only [← Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag] using hquad
  obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le Finset.univ_nonempty hsum
  refine ⟨j, hS.submatrix Fin.succAbove_right_injective, ?_⟩
  rw [trace_inv_submatrix_succAbove_eq S hS.isUnit j (ne_of_gt (hR.diag_pos (i := j)))]
  change R.trace - (R ^ 2) j j / R j j ≤ T
  have hdiv : R.trace - T ≤ (R ^ 2) j j / R j j :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (hR.diag_pos (i := j))).mpr (by nlinarith [hj])
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsDiagonalizable.of_surjective_intertwiner
statement:
theorem IsDiagonalizable.of_surjective_intertwiner {A : Matrix m m K}
    {B : Matrix n n K} (hB : IsDiagonalizable B)
    (T : (n → K) →ₗ[K] (m → K)) (hT : Function.Surjective T)
    (hcomm : ∀ x, T (B *ᵥ x) = A *ᵥ T x) : IsDiagonalizable A
proof:
:= by
  apply (isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top A).mpr
  apply top_le_iff.mp
  have hmap (μ : K) : (Module.End.eigenspace B.toLin' μ).map T ≤
      Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    apply Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
    change A *ᵥ T x = μ • T x
    have hx' : B *ᵥ x = μ • x := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx
    rw [← hcomm, hx', map_smul]
  calc
    ⊤ = (⊤ : Submodule K (n → K)).map T := by
      rw [Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hT]
    _ = (⨆ μ : K, Module.End.eigenspace B.toLin' μ).map T := by
      rw [(isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top B).mp hB]
    _ = ⨆ μ : K, (Module.End.eigenspace B.toLin' μ).map T := Submodule.map_iSup _ _
    _ ≤ ⨆ μ : K, Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ := iSup_mono hmap

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_fromBlocks_zero_zero_iff
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_fromBlocks_zero_zero_iff (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    IsDiagonalizable (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) ↔ IsDiagonalizable A ∧ IsDiagonalizable B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    let T₁ : ((m ⊕ n) → K) →ₗ[K] (m → K) :=
      { toFun x := fun i => x (Sum.inl i)
        map_add' _ _ := rfl
        map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
    let T₂ : ((m ⊕ n) → K) →ₗ[K] (n → K) :=
      { toFun x := fun i => x (Sum.inr i)
        map_add' _ _ := rfl
        map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
    constructor
    · apply h.of_surjective_intertwiner T₁ (fun x => ⟨Sum.elim x 0, rfl⟩)
      intro x
      ext i
      simp [T₁, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks]
    · apply h.of_surjective_intertwiner T₂ (fun x => ⟨Sum.elim 0 x, rfl⟩)
      intro x
      ext i
      simp [T₂, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks]
  · rintro ⟨⟨V, d, hV, hAV⟩, ⟨W, e, hW, hBW⟩⟩
    refine ⟨Matrix.fromBlocks V 0 0 W, Sum.elim d e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
      exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mp hV |>.mul
        ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).mp hW)
    · rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal]
      simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
        zero_add, add_zero, hAV, hBW]

name: NLAlib.diagonal_mul_change_eigenbasis_eq_change_eigenbasis_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem diagonal_mul_change_eigenbasis_eq_change_eigenbasis_mul_diagonal
    {A V W : Matrix n n K} {d : n → K} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hAV : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (hAW : A * W = W * Matrix.diagonal d) :
    Matrix.diagonal d * (V⁻¹ * W) = (V⁻¹ * W) * Matrix.diagonal d
proof:
:= by
  apply hV.mul_left_cancel
  change V * (Matrix.diagonal d * (V⁻¹ * W)) = V * ((V⁻¹ * W) * Matrix.diagonal d)
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc V (Matrix.diagonal d), ← hAV,
    Matrix.mul_assoc A V, ← Matrix.mul_assoc V V⁻¹,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv V ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mp hV), Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc V, ← Matrix.mul_assoc V V⁻¹,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv V ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mp hV), Matrix.one_mul]
  exact hAW

name: NLAlib.change_eigenbasis_apply_eq_zero_of_eigenvalues_ne
statement:
theorem change_eigenbasis_apply_eq_zero_of_eigenvalues_ne
    {A V W : Matrix n n K} {d : n → K} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hAV : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (hAW : A * W = W * Matrix.diagonal d)
    {i j : n} (hij : d i ≠ d j) : (V⁻¹ * W) i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => M i j)
    (diagonal_mul_change_eigenbasis_eq_change_eigenbasis_mul_diagonal hV hAV hAW)
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (by linear_combination h : (d i - d j) * (V⁻¹ * W) i j = 0)).resolve_left
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr hij)

name: NLAlib.isUnit_change_eigenbasis_and_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_change_eigenbasis_and_apply_eq_zero
    {A V W : Matrix n n K} {d : n → K} (hV : IsUnit V) (hW : IsUnit W)
    (hAV : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (hAW : A * W = W * Matrix.diagonal d) :
    IsUnit (V⁻¹ * W) ∧ ∀ i j, d i ≠ d j → (V⁻¹ * W) i j = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hV).mul hW,
    fun _ _ hij => change_eigenbasis_apply_eq_zero_of_eigenvalues_ne hV hAV hAW hij⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_spectral_neighborhood_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_spectral_neighborhood_net {D : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hD : D.IsHermitian) {L ε : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset ℝ, N.card ≤ Fintype.card n*(⌈2*L/ε⌉₊+1) ∧
      ∀ A : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm (A-D) ≤ L →
        ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hcard, hcover⟩ := Real.exists_finset_union_intervals_net hD.eigenvalues hL hε
  refine ⟨N, hcard, fun A hA ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, hclose⟩ := hD.isSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_norm_sub hξ
  rw [hD.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hβ
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hβ
  apply hcover ξ
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have hh : ‖D-A‖ ≤ L := by simpa only [norm_sub_rev, specNorm_eq_norm] using hA
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hclose.trans hh

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_spectral_neighborhood_net_card_sq
statement:
theorem exists_finset_spectral_neighborhood_net_card_sq {D : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hD : D.IsHermitian) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset ℝ, N.card ≤ 9*(Fintype.card n)^2 ∧
      ∀ A : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm (A-D) ≤ 4*Fintype.card n*ε →
        ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hcard, hcover⟩ := exists_finset_spectral_neighborhood_net hD
    (L := 4*Fintype.card n*ε) (by positivity) hε
  have hwidth : 2*(4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*ε)/ε = ((8*Fintype.card n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp [hε.ne']
    ring
  rw [hwidth, Nat.ceil_natCast] at hcard
  refine ⟨N, hcard.trans ?_, hcover⟩
  nlinarith [Nat.le_mul_self (Fintype.card n)]

name: NLAlib.commute_of_posSemidef_add_eq_diagonal_projection_ofReal
statement:
theorem commute_of_posSemidef_add_eq_diagonal_projection_ofReal
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} {p : n → ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hAB : A + B = diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)))
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = 0 ∨ p i = 1) : Commute A B
proof:
:= by
  have hAP : A * diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)) = A := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    rcases hp j with hj | hj
    · have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M j j) hAB
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, hj, RCLike.ofReal_zero] at he
      have hz : A j j = 0 := le_antisymm (by
        calc
          A j j ≤ A j j + B j j := le_add_of_nonneg_right (hB.diag_nonneg (i := j))
          _ = 0 := he) (hA.diag_nonneg (i := j))
      rw [hj, RCLike.ofReal_zero, mul_zero,
        apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA hz i]
    · rw [hj, RCLike.ofReal_one, mul_one]
  have hPA : diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)) * A = A := by
    have hd : (diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)))ᴴ = diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)) := by simp
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hd, hA.isHermitian.eq] using
      congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hAP
  change A * B = B * A
  have hl : A * A + A * B = A := by rw [← Matrix.mul_add, hAB, hAP]
  have hr : A * A + B * A = A := by rw [← Matrix.add_mul, hAB, hPA]
  exact add_left_cancel (hl.trans hr.symm)

name: NLAlib.exists_normalized_psd_pair_congruence
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_psd_pair_congruence {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (X : Matrix n n 𝕜) (a b : n → ℝ), IsUnit X ∧
      Xᴴ * A * X = diagonal (fun i => (a i : 𝕜)) ∧
      Xᴴ * B * X = diagonal (fun i => (b i : 𝕜)) ∧
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) ∧
      ∀ i, a i + b i = 0 ∨ a i + b i = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hC := (hA.add hB).isHermitian
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hC.eigenvectorUnitary
  let c := hC.eigenvalues
  have hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i := (hA.add hB).eigenvalues_nonneg
  have hUt : Uᴴ * U = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hC.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : IsUnit U := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det U).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt)
  have hCU : Uᴴ * (A + B) * U = diagonal (fun i => (c i : 𝕜)) := by
    simpa only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Function.comp_def, U, c]
      using hC.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
  let t : n → ℝ := fun i => if c i = 0 then 1 else (Real.sqrt (c i))⁻¹
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [t]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact inv_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (hc i) (Ne.symm hi)))
  let D : Matrix n n 𝕜 := diagonal (fun i => (t i : 𝕜))
  have hD : Dᴴ = D := by simp [D]
  let R : Matrix n n 𝕜 := U * D
  have hR : IsUnit R := hU.mul (Matrix.isUnit_diagonal.mpr
    (Pi.isUnit_iff.mpr fun i => isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast ht i)))
  let A' := Rᴴ * A * R
  let B' := Rᴴ * B * R
  have hA' : A'.PosSemidef := hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same R
  have hB' : B'.PosSemidef := hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same R
  let p : n → ℝ := fun i => t i * c i * t i
  have hsum : A' + B' = diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)) := by
    calc
      A' + B' = Rᴴ * (A + B) * R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, A', B']
      _ = D * (Uᴴ * (A + B) * U) * D := by
        simp only [R, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hD, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = diagonal (fun i => (p i : 𝕜)) := by
        rw [hCU, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
        simp only [p, map_mul]
  have hp : ∀ i, p i = 0 ∨ p i = 1 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · exact Or.inl (by simp [p, hi])
    · right
      have hs : Real.sqrt (c i) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (hc i) (Ne.symm hi))
      dsimp only [p, t]
      rw [if_neg hi]
      field_simp
      exact (Real.sq_sqrt (hc i)).symm
  obtain ⟨V, a, b, hV, hVA, hVB⟩ := exists_unitary_congruence_diagonal_of_commute
    hA'.isHermitian hB'.isHermitian
    (commute_of_posSemidef_add_eq_diagonal_projection_ofReal hA' hB' hsum hp)
  have hVu : IsUnit V := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hV.conjTranspose_mul_self)
  have ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := by
    have hpos := hA'.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same V
    rw [hVA] at hpos
    intro i
    have hi : (0 : 𝕜) ≤ (a i : 𝕜) := by simpa using hpos.diag_nonneg (i := i)
    exact_mod_cast hi
  have hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i := by
    have hpos := hB'.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same V
    rw [hVB] at hpos
    intro i
    have hi : (0 : 𝕜) ≤ (b i : 𝕜) := by simpa using hpos.diag_nonneg (i := i)
    exact_mod_cast hi
  refine ⟨R * V, a, b, hR.mul hVu, ?_, ?_, ha, hb, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [A', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hVA
  · simpa only [B', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hVB
  · have hP : (A' + B') * (A' + B') = A' + B' := by
      rw [hsum, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rcases hp i with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]
    have hVV : V * Vᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hV.conjTranspose_mul_self
    have hVsum : Vᴴ * (A' + B') * V = diagonal (fun i => ((a i + b i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hVA, hVB, Matrix.diagonal_add]
      simp only [map_add]
    have he : (Vᴴ * (A' + B') * V) * (Vᴴ * (A' + B') * V) = Vᴴ * (A' + B') * V := by
      calc
        _ = Vᴴ * ((A' + B') * (V * Vᴴ) * (A' + B')) * V := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [hVV, Matrix.mul_one, hP]
    rw [hVsum, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal] at he
    intro i
    have hi := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M i i) he
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] at hi
    have hir : (a i + b i) * (a i + b i) = a i + b i := by exact_mod_cast hi
    have hz : (a i + b i) * (a i + b i - 1) = 0 := by nlinarith [hir]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hh | hh
    · exact Or.inl hh
    · exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp hh)

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.inv_shift_eq
statement:
private theorem inv_shift_eq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ b) :
    (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ =
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
        diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹) *
        (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU1 : U * Uᵀ = 1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA
  have hU2 : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  have hD : diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - b) *
      diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hb i))]
    · simp [hij]
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  rw [sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul hA b, transpose_transpose]
  change (U * diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - b) * Uᵀ) *
      (U * diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹) * Uᵀ) = 1
  calc
    _ = U * (diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - b) * (Uᵀ * U) *
        diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹)) * Uᵀ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hU2, Matrix.mul_one, hD, Matrix.mul_one, hU1]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.weighted_trace_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (H * U * diagonal d * Uᵀ).trace := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (Uᵀ * (H * U) * diagonal d).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    _ = _ := by simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.trace_inv_shift_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem trace_inv_shift_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (H : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ b) :
    lowerPotential H A b = ∑ i,
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ * H * hA.eigenvectorUnitary) i i /
        (hA.eigenvalues i - b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerPotential, inv_shift_eq hA b hb, weighted_trace_diagonal]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.trace_sq_inv_shift_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem trace_sq_inv_shift_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (H : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ b) :
    (H * ((A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) ^ 2).trace = ∑ i,
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ * H * hA.eigenvectorUnitary) i i /
        (hA.eigenvalues i - b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  rw [inv_shift_eq hA b hb]
  have hp : (U * diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹) * Uᵀ) ^ 2 =
      U * diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) * Uᵀ := by
    rw [pow_two]
    calc
      _ = U * (diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹) * (Uᵀ * U) *
          diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹)) * Uᵀ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one, diagonal_mul_diagonal]; simp only [pow_two]
  change (H * (U * _ * Uᵀ) ^ 2).trace = _
  rw [hp, weighted_trace_diagonal]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow, U]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.isUnit_shift_of_eigenvalues_gap
statement:
theorem isUnit_shift_of_eigenvalues_gap {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i) :
    IsUnit (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ b := by
    intro i
    rcases hgap i with hi | hi <;> linarith
  have hright : (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
        diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - b)⁻¹) *
        (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ) = 1 := by
    rw [← inv_shift_eq hA b hn]
    apply Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv
    rw [sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul hA b,
      Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul]
    apply IsUnit.mul
    · apply IsUnit.mul
      · exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp
          (by simpa using isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hA)
      · rw [Matrix.det_diagonal]
        exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
          fun i _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hn i))
    · exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hA)
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse hright)

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.lowerPotential_gap_pos_and_trace_sq_le
statement:
theorem lowerPotential_gap_pos_and_trace_sq_le
    {A H : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.PosSemidef)
    {b δ Λ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i)
    (hkernel : b * Λ ≤ δ * (H.trace - (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ)) :
    let Δ
proof:
:= lowerPotential H A b - lowerPotential H A (b - δ)
    0 < Δ ∧
      Λ * (H * ((A - (b - δ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) ^ 2).trace ≤
        Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ) := by
  classical
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  let w : n → ℝ := fun i => (Uᵀ * H * U) i i
  have hU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  have hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := by
    have hp : (Uᵀ * H * U).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        hH.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same U
    intro i
    exact hp.diag_nonneg
  have hwle : ∀ i, w i ≤ Λ := by
    have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hHle).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same U
    have hh : Uᵀ * (Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - H) * U =
        Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - Uᵀ * H * U := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
        Matrix.mul_one, hU]
    have hp' : (Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - Uᵀ * H * U).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hh] using hp
    intro i
    have hi := hp'.diag_nonneg (i := i)
    simpa [w] using hi
  have hsum : ∑ i, w i = H.trace := by
    change (Uᵀ * H * U).trace = H.trace
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hq : H.trace - (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ ≤ ∑ i, if hA.eigenvalues i = 0 then w i else 0 := by
    have hs : (∑ i, if hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0 then w i else 0) ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ := by
      rw [hA.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, Fintype.card_subtype]
      calc
        _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0), w i := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0), Λ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hwle i
        _ = _ := by simp
    have heq : (∑ i, if hA.eigenvalues i = 0 then w i else 0) +
        (∑ i, if hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0 then w i else 0) = H.trace := by
      rw [← hsum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : hA.eigenvalues i = 0 <;> simp [hi]
    linarith
  have hn (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hcb : c ≤ b) : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ c := by
    intro i
    rcases hgap i with hi | hi <;> linarith
  have hh := weighted_reciprocal_sq_le hA.eigenvalues w hδ hb hΛ hw hgap
    (hkernel.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hδ.le))
  have hΔ : lowerPotential H A b - lowerPotential H A (b - δ) =
      ∑ i, w i * (1 / (hA.eigenvalues i - b) - 1 / (hA.eigenvalues i - (b - δ))) := by
    rw [trace_inv_shift_eq_sum hA H b (hn b (lt_trans hδ hb) le_rfl),
      trace_inv_shift_eq_sum hA H (b - δ) (hn (b - δ) (sub_pos.mpr hb) (by linarith)),
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp [w, U]
    ring
  dsimp only at hh ⊢
  rw [hΔ, trace_sq_inv_shift_eq_sum hA H (b - δ)
    (hn (b - δ) (sub_pos.mpr hb) (by linarith))]
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.real_normal_form_orthogonal_block_coefficients
statement:
theorem real_normal_form_orthogonal_block_coefficients {k : ℕ}
    {T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hF : IsRealNormalForm T) (hT : HasOrthonormalCols T) :
    (∀ i, (∀ j, j ≠ i → T j i = 0) → T i i = -1 ∨ T i i = 1) ∧
    (∀ i j, j.val + 1 = i.val → T i j ≠ 0 → (T j j) ^ 2 + (T i j) ^ 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hN : T * Tᵀ = Tᵀ * T := (mul_eq_one_comm.mp hT).trans hT.symm
  have hcol (i : Fin k) : ∑ l, T l i * T l i = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ => M i i) (show Tᵀ * T = 1 from hT)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq] using h
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    have hsum : ∑ l, T l i * T l i = T i i * T i i := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
      · intro l _ hli; rw [hi l hli, mul_zero]
      · simp
    have hs : (T i i) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := hcol i
      rw [hsum] at h
      nlinarith [h]
    have hf : (T i i - 1) * (T i i + 1) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
    · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
  · intro i j hij hn
    have hij' : i ≠ j := by intro h; subst i; omega
    have hsum : ∑ l, T l j * T l j = T j j * T j j + T i j * T i j := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ l, (if l = j then T j j * T j j else if l = i then T i j * T i j else 0) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro l _
          by_cases hlj : l = j
          · simp only [hlj, ite_true]
          by_cases hli : l = i
          · simp only [hli, hij', ite_false, ite_true]
          obtain ⟨_, hz⟩ := real_normal_quasi_row_eq_zero_of_pair hF.1.1 hN hij hn l hlj hli
          simp only [hlj, hli, ite_false, hz, mul_zero]
        _ = _ := by
          have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin k => l = j) = {j} := by
            ext l; simp
          simp [Finset.sum_ite, hij', hfilter]
    have h := hcol j
    rw [hsum] at h
    nlinarith [h]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_real_skew_normal_form
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_real_skew_normal_form {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = -A) (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ Q T : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ A = Q * T * Qᵀ ∧
      IsRealNormalForm (T.submatrix order order) ∧ ∀ i, T i i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hN : A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ * A := by rw [hA, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
  obtain ⟨Q, T, hQ, hAT, hF⟩ := exists_orthogonal_real_normal_form A hN order
  have hconj : Qᵀ * A * Q = T := by
    rw [hAT]
    calc
      _ = (Qᵀ * Q) * T * (Qᵀ * Q) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = T := by rw [(show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hskew : Tᵀ = -T := by
    rw [← hconj, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hA]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨Q, T, hQ, hAT, hF, fun i => ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M i i) hskew
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.neg_apply] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_real_orthogonal_normal_form
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_real_orthogonal_normal_form {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : HasOrthonormalCols A)
    (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ Q T : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ A = Q * T * Qᵀ ∧
      IsRealNormalForm (T.submatrix order order) ∧
      (∀ i, (∀ j, j ≠ i → T (order j) (order i) = 0) →
        T (order i) (order i) = -1 ∨ T (order i) (order i) = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, j.val + 1 = i.val → T (order i) (order j) ≠ 0 →
        (T (order j) (order j)) ^ 2 + (T (order i) (order j)) ^ 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hN : A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ * A := (mul_eq_one_comm.mp hA).trans hA.symm
  obtain ⟨Q, T, hQ, hAT, hF⟩ := exists_orthogonal_real_normal_form A hN order
  have hconj : Qᵀ * A * Q = T := by
    rw [hAT]
    calc
      _ = (Qᵀ * Q) * T * (Qᵀ * Q) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = T := by rw [(show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hT : HasOrthonormalCols T := by
    rw [← hconj]
    exact ((show HasOrthonormalCols Q from hQ).conjTranspose.mul hA).mul hQ
  have hTe : HasOrthonormalCols (T.submatrix order order) := by
    change Tᵀ.submatrix order order * T.submatrix order order = 1
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, (show Tᵀ * T = 1 from hT)]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, order.injective.eq_iff]
  obtain ⟨hscalar, hrotation⟩ := real_normal_form_orthogonal_block_coefficients hF hTe
  exact ⟨Q, T, hQ, hAT, hF, hscalar, hrotation⟩

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.reciprocal_gap_nonneg_and_sq_le
statement:
theorem reciprocal_gap_nonneg_and_sq_le {a b δ : ℝ}
    (ha : b < a) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    0 ≤ 1 / (a - b) - 1 / (a - (b - δ)) ∧
      δ / (a - (b - δ)) ^ 2 ≤
        1 / (a - b) - 1 / (a - (b - δ))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 < a - b := sub_pos.mpr ha
  have hy : 0 < a - (b - δ) := by linarith
  have hid : 1 / (a - b) - 1 / (a - (b - δ)) =
      δ / ((a - b) * (a - (b - δ))) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hid]
  constructor
  · positivity
  · apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hy) (mul_pos hx hy)).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ.le (mul_nonneg hy.le hδ.le)]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.zero_reciprocal_gap
statement:
theorem zero_reciprocal_gap {b δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b) :
    1 / (0 - b) - 1 / (0 - (b - δ)) = δ / (b * (b - δ))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_trans hδ hb)
  have hb' : b - δ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hb)
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.weighted_reciprocal_sq_le
statement:
theorem weighted_reciprocal_sq_le
    (a w : ι → ℝ) {b δ Λ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ b < a i)
    (hkernel : b * Λ ≤ δ * ∑ i, if a i = 0 then w i else 0) :
    let Δ
proof:
:= ∑ i, w i * (1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ)))
    0 < Δ ∧
      Λ * (∑ i, w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) ≤ Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ) := by
  classical
  let q : ℝ := ∑ i, if a i = 0 then w i else 0
  let Δ : ℝ := ∑ i, w i * (1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ)))
  let z : ℝ := δ * q / (b * (b - δ))
  have hb0 : 0 < b := lt_trans hδ hb
  have hb' : 0 < b - δ := sub_pos.mpr hb
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    have hh : 0 < δ * q := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hb0 hΛ) hkernel
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_right hh hδ.le
  have hz : 0 < z := by dsimp [z]; positivity
  have hgap (i : ι) : 0 ≤ 1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ)) := by
    rcases ha i with hi | hi
    · rw [hi, zero_reciprocal_gap hδ hb]
      positivity
    · exact (reciprocal_gap_nonneg_and_sq_le hi hδ).1
  have hzle : z ≤ Δ := by
    calc
      z = ∑ i, if a i = 0 then
          w i * (1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ))) else 0 := by
        simp only [z, q, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        split_ifs with hi
        · rw [hi, zero_reciprocal_gap hδ hb]
          ring
        · ring
      _ ≤ Δ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        split_ifs
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact mul_nonneg (hw i) (hgap i)
  have hΔ : 0 < Δ := hz.trans_le hzle
  have hpoint (i : ι) :
      δ * (w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) ≤
        w i * (1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ))) +
          if a i = 0 then δ ^ 2 * w i / (b * (b - δ) ^ 2) else 0 := by
    by_cases hi : a i = 0
    · rw [if_pos hi, hi, zero_reciprocal_gap hδ hb]
      have hbne := ne_of_gt hb0
      have hbne' := ne_of_gt hb'
      apply le_of_eq
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [if_neg hi, add_zero]
      have hab := (ha i).resolve_left hi
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (reciprocal_gap_nonneg_and_sq_le hab hδ).2 (hw i)
      calc
        δ * (w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) =
            w i * (δ / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hh
  have hsum : δ * (∑ i, w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) ≤
      Δ + δ ^ 2 * q / (b * (b - δ) ^ 2) := by
    calc
      δ * (∑ i, w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) ≤
          ∑ i, (w i * (1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ))) +
            if a i = 0 then δ ^ 2 * w i / (b * (b - δ) ^ 2) else 0) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hpoint i
      _ = Δ + δ ^ 2 * q / (b * (b - δ) ^ 2) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        simp only [q, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        split_ifs <;> ring
  have hk : Λ * (δ ^ 2 * q / (b * (b - δ) ^ 2)) ≤ δ * z ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [z]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkernel
      (show 0 ≤ δ ^ 2 * q / (b ^ 2 * (b - δ) ^ 2) by positivity)
    calc
      Λ * (δ ^ 2 * q / (b * (b - δ) ^ 2)) =
          (b * Λ) * (δ ^ 2 * q / (b ^ 2 * (b - δ) ^ 2)) := by
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (δ * q) * (δ ^ 2 * q / (b ^ 2 * (b - δ) ^ 2)) := hh
      _ = δ * (δ * q / (b * (b - δ))) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
  have hzsq : z ^ 2 ≤ Δ ^ 2 := sq_le_sq₀ hz.le hΔ.le |>.mpr hzle
  refine ⟨hΔ, ?_⟩
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hΛ.le
  have hright := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzsq hδ.le
  have hfinal : δ * (Λ * (∑ i, w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2)) ≤
      δ * (Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ)) := by
    have hδne : δ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ
    have heq : δ * (Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ)) = Λ * Δ + δ * Δ ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    nlinarith
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hδ).mp hfinal

name: NLAlib.finite_not_separable_charpoly_affine
statement:
theorem finite_not_separable_charpoly_affine
    {n K : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (A D : Matrix n n K) (hD : D.charpoly.Separable) :
    Set.Finite {t : K | ¬ (A + t • (D - A)).charpoly.Separable}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : Matrix n n K[X] := A.map (C : K → K[X]) + (X : K[X]) • (D - A).map (C : K → K[X])
  let P := M.charpoly
  let r : K[X] := P.resultant P.derivative (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card n - 1)
  have hmap (t : K) : P.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom t) = (A + t • (D - A)).charpoly := by
    rw [← Matrix.charpoly_map]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    simp [M, Matrix.map_apply]
  have heval (t : K) : r.eval t =
      (A + t • (D - A)).charpoly.resultant (A + t • (D - A)).charpoly.derivative := by
    have h := Polynomial.resultant_map_map P P.derivative
      (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card n - 1) (Polynomial.evalRingHom t)
    rw [← Polynomial.derivative_map, hmap] at h
    simpa only [r, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.natDegree_derivative,
      Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim] using h.symm
  have hsep (t : K) : (A + t • (D - A)).charpoly.Separable ↔ r.eval t ≠ 0 := by
    rw [heval, Polynomial.separable_def,
      ← Polynomial.isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime (A + t • (D - A)).charpoly_monic,
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  have hr1 : r.eval 1 ≠ 0 := (hsep 1).mp (by simpa using hD)
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; simp [hzero] at hr1
  apply (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hr).subset
  intro t ht
  exact not_ne_iff.mp ((hsep t).not.mp ht)

name: NLAlib.dense_separable_charpoly
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d : n → K := fun i => ((Fintype.equivFin n i).val : K)
  have hd : Function.Injective d := by
    intro i j hij
    apply (Fintype.equivFin n).injective
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [d] at hij
    exact_mod_cast hij
  let D := Matrix.diagonal d
  have hD : D.charpoly.Separable := by
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
    exact Polynomial.separable_prod_X_sub_C_iff.mpr hd
  intro A
  apply mem_closure_iff.mpr
  intro U hU hAU
  let g : K → Matrix n n K := fun t => A + t • (D - A)
  have hg : Continuous g := by fun_prop
  have hpre : g ⁻¹' U ∈ nhds (0 : K) :=
    (hg.continuousAt (x := 0)).preimage_mem_nhds (hU.mem_nhds (by simpa [g] using hAU))
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hgood⟩ := (infinite_of_mem_nhds (0 : K) hpre).exists_notMem_finite
    (finite_not_separable_charpoly_affine A D hD)
  exact ⟨g t, ht, not_not.mp hgood⟩

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.sum_quadForm_eq_trace_mul
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, (R * vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).trace := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp [quadForm, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm]
    _ = (R * ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).trace := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
    _ = _ := by rw [hH]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.rank_one_le_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum := Finset.sum_erase_add (Finset.univ : Finset I)
    (fun j => vecMulVec (v j) (v j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have heq : H - vecMulVec (v i) (v i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, vecMulVec (v j) (v j) := by
    rw [← hH, ← hsum]
    simp
  rw [heq]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ fun j _ => by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v j)

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.interaction_sq_le_weighted_quadForm
statement:
private theorem interaction_sq_le_weighted_quadForm
    (v : I → n → ℝ) (H R : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hH : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H) (hR : R.IsHermitian) (i : I) :
    (quadForm R (v i)) ^ 2 ≤ quadForm (R * H * R) (v i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (rank_one_le_decomposition v H hH i).quadForm_nonneg (R *ᵥ v i)
  have hcong : quadForm (R * H * R) (v i) = quadForm H (R *ᵥ v i) := by
    have hh := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul H R (v i)
    simpa only [hR.eq] using hh
  rw [hcong]
  have hid : quadForm (H - vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) (R *ᵥ v i) =
      quadForm H (R *ᵥ v i) - quadForm R (v i) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub,
      Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_smul]
    simp only [op_smul_eq_mul]
    rw [dotProduct_comm (R *ᵥ v i) (v i)]
    ring
  rw [hid] at hp
  linarith

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_column_interaction_lt_neg_one
statement:
theorem exists_column_interaction_lt_neg_one
    [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ) {H R : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    (hHpos : H.PosSemidef) (hR : R.IsHermitian)
    {Δ Λ δ φ : ℝ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (_hΛ : 0 < Λ) (_hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (htrace : (H * R).trace = φ - Δ)
    (hpot : φ ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ)
    (hsq : Λ * (H * R ^ 2).trace ≤ Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ)) :
    ∃ i, quadForm R (v i) < -1 ∧
      quadForm (R * H * R) (v i) ≤ Δ * (-1 - quadForm R (v i))
proof:
:= by
  have hRHR : (R * H * R).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [hR.eq] using hHpos.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same R
  have hsumN : (∑ i, quadForm (R * H * R) (v i)) ≤
      Λ * (H * R ^ 2).trace := by
    rw [sum_quadForm_eq_trace_mul v H (R * H * R) hH]
    have hh := trace_mul_le_trace_mul_of_posSemidef hRHR hHle
    have ht : ((R * H * R) * (Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))).trace =
        Λ * (H * R ^ 2).trace := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [pow_two, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
      exact Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
    exact ht ▸ hh
  have hsumQ : (∑ i, quadForm R (v i)) = φ - Δ := by
    rw [sum_quadForm_eq_trace_mul v H R hH, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, htrace]
  have hsumR : (∑ i, Δ * (-1 - quadForm R (v i))) =
      Δ * (-(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - (φ - Δ)) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsumQ]
    simp
  have hsum : (∑ i, quadForm (R * H * R) (v i)) ≤
      ∑ i, Δ * (-1 - quadForm R (v i)) := by
    rw [hsumR]
    calc
      _ ≤ Λ * (H * R ^ 2).trace := hsumN
      _ ≤ Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ) := hsq
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hΔ.le
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le Finset.univ_nonempty hsum
  refine ⟨i, ?_, hi⟩
  have hq := interaction_sq_le_weighted_quadForm v H R hH hR i
  have hnon : 0 ≤ quadForm (R * H * R) (v i) := hRHR.quadForm_nonneg _
  have hle : quadForm R (v i) ≤ -1 := by nlinarith
  by_contra hnot
  have heq : quadForm R (v i) = -1 := le_antisymm hle (not_lt.mp hnot)
  rw [heq] at hi hq
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.lowerPotential_add_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem lowerPotential_add_vecMulVec_le
    {A H : Matrix n n ℝ} {b Δ φ : ℝ} (v : n → ℝ)
    (hunit : IsUnit (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)))
    (_hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (htrace : lowerPotential H A b = φ - Δ)
    (hinteraction : quadForm (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ v < -1)
    (hcert : quadForm ((A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ * H *
        (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) v ≤
      Δ * (-1 - quadForm (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ v)) :
    lowerPotential H (A + vecMulVec v v) b ≤ φ
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix n n ℝ := (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹
  let q : ℝ := quadForm R v
  have hd : 1 + q < 0 := by dsimp [q, R]; linarith
  have hinv := Matrix.trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self
    (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) H v 1
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hunit)
    (show 1 + 1 * (v ⬝ᵥ ((A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0 by
      simpa [q, R, quadForm, star_trivial] using ne_of_lt hd)
  have hh : lowerPotential H (A + vecMulVec v v) b =
      (φ - Δ) - quadForm (R * H * R) v / (1 + q) := by
    have hmat : A + vecMulVec v v - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) =
        A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + (1 : ℝ) • vecMulVec v v := by module
    unfold lowerPotential
    rw [hmat]
    calc
      _ = _ := hinv
      _ = _ := by
        change lowerPotential H A b -
          (1 / (1 + 1 * q)) * quadForm (R * H * R) v = _
        rw [htrace]
        ring
  rw [hh]
  have hquot : -Δ ≤ quadForm (R * H * R) v / (1 + q) := by
    apply (le_div_iff_of_neg hd).mpr
    dsimp [R, q] at *
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.neg_div_initial_barrier_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hne : 1 - ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hε1)
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hF, ne_of_gt hΛ, ne_of_gt hM, ne_of_gt _hε, hne]
  ring

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.floor_mul_decrement_lt_and_terminal_barrier_le
proof:
:= (1 - ε) * F / M
    let δ := (1 - ε) * Λ / (ε * M)
    let k := ⌊ε ^ 2 * F / Λ⌋₊
    (k : ℝ) * δ < b₀ ∧ (1 - ε) ^ 2 * F / M ≤ b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ := by
  let b₀ := (1 - ε) * F / M
  let δ := (1 - ε) * Λ / (ε * M)
  let k := ⌊ε ^ 2 * F / Λ⌋₊
  have hb₀ : 0 < b₀ := by dsimp [b₀]; positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hk : (k : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ 2 * F / Λ := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hkb : (k : ℝ) * δ ≤ ε * b₀ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (ε ^ 2 * F / Λ) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk hδ.le
      _ = ε * b₀ := by
        dsimp [δ, b₀]
        field_simp
  have heq : (1 - ε) ^ 2 * F / M = (1 - ε) * b₀ := by dsimp [b₀]; ring
  refine ⟨hkb.trans_lt ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith
  · rw [heq]
    linarith

name: Matrix.tendsto_pow_zero_iff_forall_mulVec
statement:
theorem tendsto_pow_zero_iff_forall_mulVec (H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => H ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔
      ∀ v : n → 𝕜, Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (H ^ k) *ᵥ v) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    have hc : Continuous (fun T : Matrix n n 𝕜 => T *ᵥ v) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_mulVec] using hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h
  · intro h
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro j
    have hj := (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp (h (Pi.single j 1))) i
    simpa only [mulVec_single_one, col_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] using hj

name: Matrix.isUnit_one_sub_of_tendsto_pow_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_one_sub_of_tendsto_pow_zero {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => H ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0)) : IsUnit (1 - H)
proof:
:= by
  apply mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp
  intro x y hxy
  have hz : (1 - H) *ᵥ (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [mulVec_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  have hfix : H *ᵥ (x - y) = x - y := by
    rw [sub_mulVec, one_mulVec] at hz
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm
  have hp (k : ℕ) : (H ^ k) *ᵥ (x - y) = x - y := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ', ← mulVec_mulVec, ih, hfix]
  have ht := (tendsto_pow_zero_iff_forall_mulVec H).mp hH (x - y)
  simp only [hp] at ht
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds ht)

name: NLAlib.matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top
statement: theorem matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : spectralRadius ℂ A ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := spectrum.spectralRadius_le_pow_nnnorm_pow_one_div ℂ A 0
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_div_one, ENNReal.rpow_one, pow_one] at h
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top
    (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top) h

name: NLAlib.tendsto_norm_matrix_pow_rpow_spectralRadius
statement:
theorem tendsto_norm_matrix_pow_rpow_spectralRadius (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => specNorm (A ^ k) ^ (1 / k : ℝ)) atTop
      (𝓝 (spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  have h := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top A)).comp
    (spectrum.pow_norm_pow_one_div_tendsto_nhds_spectralRadius A)
  convert h using 1
  ext k
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)).symm

name: NLAlib.one_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant
statement:
theorem one_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant (A : Matrix n n ℂ) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (N : ℕ) : 1 ≤ matrixPowerBoundConstant A r N
proof:
:= by
  apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hr.le k)

name: NLAlib.norm_matrix_pow_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant_mul_pow
statement:
theorem norm_matrix_pow_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant_mul_pow (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (N : ℕ) (hN : ∀ k, N ≤ k → specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ r ^ k) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ matrixPowerBoundConstant A r N * r ^ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm at hN ⊢
  by_cases hk : k < N
  · have hsum : ‖A ^ k‖ / r ^ k ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ‖A ^ j‖ / r ^ j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hr.le j))
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hr k)).mp
    exact hsum.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
  · exact (hN k (le_of_not_gt hk)).trans
      (le_mul_of_one_le_left (pow_nonneg hr.le k) (one_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant A hr N))

name: NLAlib.exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_growth
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  have hevent := (tendsto_norm_matrix_pow_rpow_spectralRadius A).eventually
    (gt_mem_nhds hρr)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hevent
  have hbound (k : ℕ) (hk : N + 1 ≤ k) : ‖A ^ k‖ ≤ r ^ k := by
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
    have hroot : ‖A ^ k‖ ^ (1 / k : ℝ) ≤ r := (hN k (by omega)).le
    have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) hroot
      (Nat.cast_nonneg k : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ))
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _), one_div_mul_cancel (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hkpos.ne'),
      Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast] at hp
    exact hp
  exact ⟨N + 1, norm_matrix_pow_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant_mul_pow A hr (N + 1) hbound⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_spectralRadius_add
statement:
theorem exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_spectralRadius_add (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ,
      specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ matrixPowerBoundConstant A ((spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal + ε) N *
        ((spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal + ε) ^ k
proof:
:=
  exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_growth A
    (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hε) (lt_add_of_pos_right _ hε)

name: NLAlib.tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : (spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal < 1 := by
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top A) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hA
  let r : ℝ := ((spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal + 1) / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hρr : (spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_growth A hr hρr
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  exact squeeze_zero (fun k => norm_nonneg _) hN
    (by simpa using ((tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hr.le hr1).const_mul
      (matrixPowerBoundConstant A r N)))

name: NLAlib.summable_matrix_pow_of_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_matrix_pow_of_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : (spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal < 1 :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top A) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hA
  let r : ℝ := ((spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal + 1) / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hρr : (spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_growth A hr hρr
  exact Summable.of_norm_bounded ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr.le hr1).mul_left
    (matrixPowerBoundConstant A r N)) hN

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.re_star_dotProduct_self
statement:
private theorem re_star_dotProduct_self (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) = ∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, map_sum, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul,
    ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.re_star_dotProduct_self_pos
statement:
private theorem re_star_dotProduct_self_pos {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    0 < RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_star_dotProduct_self]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hx
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
    ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.2 hi) 2⟩

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.re_star_dotProduct_diagonal_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.star_apply, map_sum, Function.comp_apply,
    RCLike.star_def]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [mul_left_comm, RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul,
    RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.eigenvalues_e
statement:
private theorem eigenvalues_e (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    hA.eigenvalues (e j) = hA.eigenvalues₀ j
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.star_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec_apply
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.star_apply,
    Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply, Pi.star_apply]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.re_quadForm_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem re_quadForm_eq_sum (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm A x) = ∑ j, hA.eigenvalues₀ j * ‖coord hA j x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)
  have hUU : U * star U = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hD : star U * A * U = Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hA.eigenvalues) := by
    have h := hA.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
    simpa [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, U] using h
  have hx : x = U *ᵥ (star U *ᵥ x) := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hUU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hq : quadForm A x =
      star (star U *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((star U * A * U) *ᵥ (star U *ᵥ x)) := by
    set y := star U *ᵥ x
    rw [quadForm_def, hx, Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  rw [hq, hD, re_star_dotProduct_diagonal_mulVec, ← (e (n := n)).sum_comp]
  simp only [coord, eigenvalues_e, star_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec_apply, U]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_sum (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) = ∑ j, ‖coord hA j x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)
  have hUU : U * star U = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have h := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self (star U) x
  rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, star_star, hUU, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  rw [← h, re_star_dotProduct_self, ← (e (n := n)).sum_comp]
  simp only [coord, star_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec_apply, U]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.eigenvalues₀_mul_le_of_coord
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_quadForm_eq_sum hA, re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_sum hA, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  rcases le_or_gt j k with hjk | hjk
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone hjk) (sq_nonneg _)
  · simp [hx j hjk]

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.le_eigenvalues₀_mul_of_coord
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_quadForm_eq_sum hA, re_star_dotProduct_self_eq_sum hA, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  rcases lt_or_ge j k with hjk | hjk
  · simp [hx j hjk]
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone hjk) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.coord_of_hiMat
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun hx ⟨j - (k + 1), by omega⟩
  have hj' : (⟨k + 1 + (j - (k + 1)), by omega⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card n)) = j := by
    ext; simp only; omega
  simpa [hiMat, coord, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hj'] using h

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.coord_of_loMat
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun hx ⟨j, hj⟩
  simpa [loMat, coord, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.exists_mem_ne_zero_mulVec_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (M.domRestrict W) ≠ ⊥ :=
    LinearMap.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt (by rwa [Module.finrank_fin_fun])
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  refine ⟨y, y.2, fun h => hy0 (Subtype.ext h), ?_⟩
  simpa using hy

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.card_le_finrank_ker_add
statement:
private theorem card_le_finrank_ker_add {p : ℕ} (M : (n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin p → 𝕜)) :
    Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.ker M) + p
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker M
  have hr : finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range M) ≤ p := by
    simpa using (LinearMap.range M).finrank_le
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at h
  omega

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.nonempty_of_finrank_pos
statement:
private theorem nonempty_of_finrank_pos {W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜)} (hW : 0 < finrank 𝕜 W) :
    Nonempty {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ W ∧ x ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx0⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hW
  exact ⟨⟨x, x.2, fun h => hx0 (Subtype.ext h)⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.CourantFischer.rayleighQuotient_mem
statement:
private theorem rayleighQuotient_mem (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, by have
proof:
:= k.isLt; omega⟩ ≤ rayleighQuotient A x ∧
      rayleighQuotient A x ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  have hpos := re_star_dotProduct_self_pos hx
  rw [rayleighQuotient_def, le_div_iff₀ hpos, div_le_iff₀ hpos]
  refine ⟨eigenvalues₀_mul_le_of_coord hA _ fun j hj => ?_,
    le_eigenvalues₀_mul_of_coord hA _ fun j hj => ?_⟩
  · exact absurd hj (by rw [Fin.lt_def]; dsimp only; have := j.isLt; omega)
  · exact absurd hj (by rw [Fin.lt_def]; dsimp only; omega)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxW, hx0, hx⟩ :=
    exists_mem_ne_zero_mulVec_eq_zero (hiMat hA k) W (by omega)
  have h1 := eigenvalues₀_mul_le_of_coord hA k (coord_of_hiMat hA k hx)
  have h2 := hAW x hxW
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (h1.trans h2) (re_star_dotProduct_self_pos hx0)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, hx0, hx⟩ :=
    exists_mem_ne_zero_mulVec_eq_zero (loMat hA k) S (by omega)
  have h1 := le_eigenvalues₀_mul_of_coord hA k (coord_of_loMat hA k hx)
  have h2 := hAS x hxS
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (h2.trans h1) (re_star_dotProduct_self_pos hx0)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ∃ S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜), (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S ∧
      ∀ x ∈ S, hA.eigenvalues₀ k * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ RCLike.re (quadForm A x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨LinearMap.ker (hiMat hA k), ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · have := card_le_finrank_ker_add (hiMat hA k)
    omega
  · exact eigenvalues₀_mul_le_of_coord hA k (coord_of_hiMat hA k (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx))

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ∃ W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜), Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, RCLike.re (quadForm A x) ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨LinearMap.ker (loMat hA k), card_le_finrank_ker_add (loMat hA k),
    fun _ hx => le_eigenvalues₀_mul_of_coord hA k (coord_of_loMat hA k (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx))⟩

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iSup_iInf
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iSup_iInf {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ k =
      ⨆ S : {S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S},
        ⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ S.1 ∧ x ≠ 0}, rayleighQuotient A x.1
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : ∀ S : {S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S},
      (⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ S.1 ∧ x ≠ 0}, rayleighQuotient A x.1) ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k := by
    intro S
    obtain ⟨x, hxS, hx0, hx⟩ :=
      exists_mem_ne_zero_mulVec_eq_zero (loMat hA k) S.1 (by have := S.2; omega)
    have h1 := le_eigenvalues₀_mul_of_coord hA k (coord_of_loMat hA k hx)
    refine (ciInf_le ⟨hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩, ?_⟩
      ⟨x, hxS, hx0⟩).trans ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      exact (rayleighQuotient_mem hA k y.2.2).1
    · rw [rayleighQuotient_def, div_le_iff₀ (re_star_dotProduct_self_pos hx0)]
      exact h1
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ := hA.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le k
    have := nonempty_of_finrank_pos (W := S) (by omega)
    refine le_ciSup_of_le ⟨hA.eigenvalues₀ k, ?_⟩ ⟨S, hS⟩ (le_ciInf fun x => ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨S, rfl⟩
      exact hinner S
    · rw [rayleighQuotient_def, le_div_iff₀ (re_star_dotProduct_self_pos x.2.2)]
      exact hAS x.1 x.2.1
  · have : Nonempty {S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S} :=
      ⟨⟨⊤, by rw [finrank_top, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]; omega⟩⟩
    exact ciSup_le hinner

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iInf_iSup
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iInf_iSup {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ k =
      ⨅ W : {W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k},
        ⨆ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ W.1 ∧ x ≠ 0}, rayleighQuotient A x.1
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : ∀ W : {W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k},
      hA.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ ⨆ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ W.1 ∧ x ≠ 0}, rayleighQuotient A x.1 := by
    intro W
    obtain ⟨x, hxW, hx0, hx⟩ :=
      exists_mem_ne_zero_mulVec_eq_zero (hiMat hA k) W.1 (by have := W.2; omega)
    have h1 := eigenvalues₀_mul_le_of_coord hA k (coord_of_hiMat hA k hx)
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_ciSup ⟨hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩, ?_⟩ ⟨x, hxW, hx0⟩)
    · rw [rayleighQuotient_def, le_div_iff₀ (re_star_dotProduct_self_pos hx0)]
      exact h1
    · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      exact (rayleighQuotient_mem hA k y.2.2).2
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have : Nonempty {W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k} :=
      ⟨⟨⊤, by rw [finrank_top, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]; omega⟩⟩
    exact le_ciInf hinner
  · obtain ⟨W, hW, hAW⟩ := hA.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul k
    have := nonempty_of_finrank_pos (W := W) (by omega)
    refine ciInf_le_of_le ⟨hA.eigenvalues₀ k, ?_⟩ ⟨W, hW⟩ (ciSup_le fun x => ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨W, rfl⟩
      exact hinner W
    · rw [rayleighQuotient_def, div_le_iff₀ (re_star_dotProduct_self_pos x.2.2)]
      exact hAW x.1 x.2.1

name: NLAlib.card_le_finrank_inf_add
proof:
:= by
  have h := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq W₁ W₂
  have hs : finrank 𝕜 (W₁ ⊔ W₂ : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜)) ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    simpa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using (W₁ ⊔ W₂).finrank_le
  omega

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ := hA.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le k
  refine hB.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem k S hS fun x hx => (hAS x hx).trans ?_
  have h0 := (Matrix.le_iff.mp h).re_quadForm_nonneg x
  simp only [quadForm_def, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, map_sub] at h0 ⊢
  linarith

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_add_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_add_le {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i j : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hij : (i : ℕ) + j < Fintype.card n) :
    (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + j, hij⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i + hB.eigenvalues₀ j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, hA₁⟩ := hA.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul i
  obtain ⟨W₂, h₂, hB₂⟩ := hB.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul j
  refine (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem _ (W₁ ⊓ W₂) (card_le_finrank_inf_add h₁ h₂)
    fun x hx => ?_
  have ha := hA₁ x hx.1
  have hb := hB₂ x hx.2
