  simp only [quadForm_def, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add, map_add] at ha hb ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.finrank_map_mulVecLin_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
private theorem finrank_map_mulVecLin_of_hasOrthonormalCols {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (S : Submodule 𝕜 (r → 𝕜)) :
    finrank 𝕜 (S.map Q.mulVecLin) = finrank 𝕜 S
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective Q.mulVecLin := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg (fun v => Qᴴ *ᵥ v) hxy
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
    rwa [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  exact (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ hinj S).finrank_eq.symm

name: NLAlib.rayleigh_compression
statement:
private theorem rayleigh_compression {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (y : r → 𝕜) :
    quadForm A (Q *ᵥ y) = quadForm (Qᴴ * A * Q) y ∧
      star (Q *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ y) = star y ⬝ᵥ y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ y⟩
  rw [quadForm_def, quadForm_def, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (star y) Qᴴ, Matrix.star_mulVec]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE (card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ) i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hBS⟩ :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le i
  refine hA.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem _ (S.map Q.mulVecLin)
    (by rw [finrank_map_mulVecLin_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ]; simpa using hS) fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := rayleigh_compression (A := A) hQ y
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact hBS y hy

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card r),
      by have
proof:
:= card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ; omega⟩ ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues₀ i := by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hBW⟩ :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul i
  have hcard := card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ
  refine hA.eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem _ (W.map Q.mulVecLin)
    (by rw [finrank_map_mulVecLin_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ]; simp only; omega) fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := rayleigh_compression (A := A) hQ y
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact hBW y hy

name: NLAlib.submatrix_eq_compression
statement:
private theorem submatrix_eq_compression {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (e : r ↪ n) :
    HasOrthonormalCols ((1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e) ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e)ᴴ * A * (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e =
        A.submatrix e e
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : ((1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e)ᴴ = (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix e id := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change ((1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e)ᴴ * (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id e = 1
    rw [hQ, ← Matrix.submatrix_mul _ _ _ _ _ Function.bijective_id, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.submatrix_one_embedding]
  · rw [hQ, ← Matrix.submatrix_id_id A, ← Matrix.submatrix_mul _ _ _ _ _ Function.bijective_id,
      ← Matrix.submatrix_mul _ _ _ _ _ Function.bijective_id, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    rfl

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_submatrix_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_submatrix_le {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (e : r ↪ n)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    (hA.submatrix e).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e) i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hQ, hB⟩ := submatrix_eq_compression A e
  have h := hA.eigenvalues₀_compression_le hQ i
  convert h using 2
  exact hB.symm

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_submatrix
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_submatrix {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (e : r ↪ n)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card r),
      by have
proof:
:= Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e; omega⟩ ≤
      (hA.submatrix e).eigenvalues₀ i := by
  obtain ⟨hQ, hB⟩ := submatrix_eq_compression A e
  have h := hA.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression hQ i
  convert h using 2
  exact hB.symm

name: NLAlib.sq_singularValues_eq
statement:
private theorem sq_singularValues_eq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < Fintype.card n) :
    singularValues A k ^ 2 = (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hk⟩
proof:
:=
  sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A ⟨k, hk⟩

name: NLAlib.re_star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
private theorem re_star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) = RCLike.re (quadForm (Aᴴ * A) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_def, star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_of_forall_mem {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) (W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜))
    (hW : Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hAW : ∀ x ∈ W, RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤
      c ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    singularValues A k ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < Fintype.card n
  · have h := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem
      ⟨k, hk⟩ W hW (c := c ^ 2)
      fun x hx => by
        rw [← re_star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec]
        exact hAW x hx
    rw [← sq_singularValues_eq A hk] at h
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A k) hc two_ne_zero).1 h
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A (not_lt.1 hk)]
    exact hc

name: NLAlib.le_singularValues_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem le_singularValues_of_forall_mem {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) (S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜)) (hS : k + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S) {c : ℝ}
    (hAS : ∀ x ∈ S, c ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤
      RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))) :
    c ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  have hSn : finrank 𝕜 S ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    simpa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using S.finrank_le
  have hk : k < Fintype.card n := by omega
  rcases le_or_gt c 0 with hc | hc
  · exact hc.trans (singularValues_nonneg A k)
  have h := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem
    ⟨k, hk⟩ S hS (c := c ^ 2)
    fun x hx => by
      rw [← re_star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec]
      exact hAS x hx
  rw [← sq_singularValues_eq A hk] at h
  exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hc.le (singularValues_nonneg A k) two_ne_zero).1 h

name: NLAlib.exists_submodule_mulVec_dotProduct_le_sq_singularValues_mul
statement:
theorem exists_submodule_mulVec_dotProduct_le_sq_singularValues_mul {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜), Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤
        singularValues A k ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < Fintype.card n
  · obtain ⟨W, hW, hAW⟩ :=
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨W, hW, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [sq_singularValues_eq A hk, re_star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec]
    exact hAW x hx
  · refine ⟨⊥, by simp; omega, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [(Submodule.mem_bot 𝕜).1 hx]
    simp

name: NLAlib.exists_submodule_sq_singularValues_mul_le_mulVec_dotProduct
statement:
theorem exists_submodule_sq_singularValues_mul_le_mulVec_dotProduct {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < Fintype.card n) :
    ∃ S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜), k + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S ∧
      ∀ x ∈ S, singularValues A k ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤
        RCLike.re (star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨S, hS, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [sq_singularValues_eq A hk, re_star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec]
  exact hAS x hx

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_shift_pow_mulVec_of_left_eigenvector
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : y ᵥ* (A - μ • 1) = (α - μ) • y := by
    rw [Matrix.vecMul_sub, Matrix.vecMul_smul, Matrix.vecMul_one, hy, sub_smul]
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec, one_mul]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hshift,
      smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, ih, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_eq_zero_of_mem_maxGenEigenspace_of_left_eigenvalue_ne
statement:
theorem dotProduct_eq_zero_of_mem_maxGenEigenspace_of_left_eigenvalue_ne
    {A : Matrix n n K} {y z : n → K} {α μ : K}
    (hy : y ᵥ* A = α • y) (hαμ : α ≠ μ)
    (hz : z ∈ Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ) : y ⬝ᵥ z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ z).mp hz
  have hkM : (A - μ • 1) ^ k *ᵥ z = 0 := by
    change ((A - μ • 1) ^ k).toLin' z = 0
    simpa only [Matrix.toLin'_pow, map_sub, map_smul, Matrix.toLin'_one,
      Module.End.one_eq_id] using hk
  have hpair := dotProduct_shift_pow_mulVec_of_left_eigenvector hy μ k z
  rw [hkM, dotProduct_zero] at hpair
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hpair.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero k (sub_ne_zero.mpr hαμ))

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_ne_zero_of_simple_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem dotProduct_ne_zero_of_simple_eigenvalue [IsAlgClosed K] {A : Matrix n n K}
    {x y : n → K} {μ : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) : y ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hpair
  let ℓ : (n → K) →ₗ[K] K :=
    { toFun z := y ⬝ᵥ z
      map_add' _ _ := dotProduct_add _ _ _
      map_smul' c z := by rw [dotProduct_smul]; rfl }
  have hdim : Module.finrank K (Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ) = 1 := by
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_maxGenEigenspace_eq, Matrix.charpoly_toLin', hμ]
  have hxgen : x ∈ Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ :=
    Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hAx)
  have hspan : K ∙ x = Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' μ :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem x _).mpr hxgen)
      (by rw [finrank_span_singleton hx, hdim])
  have hline : K ∙ x ≤ ℓ.ker := (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem x _).mpr hpair
  have hgen (ν : K) : Module.End.maxGenEigenspace A.toLin' ν ≤ ℓ.ker := by
    by_cases hν : ν = μ
    · rw [hν, ← hspan]
      exact hline
    · intro z hz
      exact dotProduct_eq_zero_of_mem_maxGenEigenspace_of_left_eigenvalue_ne
        hyA (Ne.symm hν) hz
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K (n → K)) ≤ ℓ.ker := by
    rw [← Module.End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top A.toLin']
    exact iSup_le hgen
  have hℓ : ℓ = 0 := LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp (top_le_iff.mp htop)
  apply hy
  funext i
  have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun hℓ (Pi.single i 1)
  simpa only [ℓ, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, dotProduct_single, mul_one,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using hi

name: NLAlib.det_gram_mul_eq_zero_of_det_gram_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_gram_mul_eq_zero_of_det_gram_eq_zero {m p k : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    (A : Matrix m p ℝ) (Y : Matrix p k ℝ) (hY : (Yᵀ * Y).det = 0) :
    ((A * Y)ᵀ * (A * Y)).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hYx⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hY
  have hnorm : (Y *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Y *ᵥ x) = 0 := by
    rw [show (Y *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Y *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ ((Yᵀ * Y) *ᵥ x) from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self Y x, hYx]
    simp
  have hy : Y *ᵥ x = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hnorm
  apply Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hy, Matrix.mulVec_zero,
    Matrix.mulVec_zero]

name: NLAlib.det_gram_mul_le_det_gram_mul_prod_sq_singularValues
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hY : IsUnit (Yᵀ * Y)
  · let U := polarFrame Y
    let R := Uᵀ * Y
    have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame Y hY
    have hUR : U * R = Y := polarFrame_mul_transpose_mul_eq Y hY
    have hGram : Yᵀ * Y = Rᵀ * R := by
      calc
        Yᵀ * Y = (U * R)ᵀ * (U * R) := by rw [hUR]
        _ = Rᵀ * R := by
          rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U, show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hImage : (A * Y)ᵀ * (A * Y) = Rᵀ * (Uᵀ * (Aᵀ * A) * U) * R := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hUR]
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hdet : ((A * Y)ᵀ * (A * Y)).det =
        (Yᵀ * Y).det * ((A * U)ᵀ * (A * U)).det := by
      rw [hImage, hGram, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose,
        Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      ring
    rw [hdet]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (det_gram_mul_le_prod_sq_singularValues A hU)
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self Y).det_nonneg
  · have hdet : (Yᵀ * Y).det = 0 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not] using hY
    rw [hdet, zero_mul, det_gram_mul_eq_zero_of_det_gram_eq_zero A Y hdet]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.det_gram_mul_submatrix_eq_prod_sq_singularValues
proof:
:= by
  let E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ := (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn)
  have hVE : Vᵀ * V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn) = E := by
    have h := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Vᵀ V id (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) (Fin.castLE hkn)
    simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h
    rw [h, show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hT.conjTranspose_mul_right]
  have hEV : (V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn))ᵀ * V = Eᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using congrArg Matrix.transpose hVE
  have hGram : ((T * V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn))ᵀ *
      (T * V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn))) =
      Eᵀ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues T i ^ 2) * E := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
    calc
      _ = (V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn))ᵀ * (Tᵀ * T) *
          V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [show Tᵀ * T = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues T i ^ 2) * Vᵀ from
          hT.conjTranspose_mul_self]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [hVE, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hEV]
  have hDiag : Eᵀ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues T i ^ 2) * E =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues T i ^ 2) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [E, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        Matrix.one_apply]
    · simp [E, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        Matrix.one_apply, hij]
  rw [hGram, hDiag, Matrix.det_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.prod_singularValues_mul_le_fin
statement:
private theorem prod_singularValues_mul_le_fin {m p n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues (A * B) i) ≤
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A i * singularValues B i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ min m (min p n)
  · obtain ⟨U, V, hT⟩ := exists_isSVD (A * B)
    have hkn : k ≤ n := hk.trans ((min_le_right m (min p n)).trans (min_le_right p n))
    let Q := V.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn)
    have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q :=
      HasOrthonormalCols.submatrix_cols hT.conjTranspose_mul_right
        ⟨Fin.castLE hkn, Fin.castLE_injective hkn⟩
    have hdetT := hT.det_gram_mul_submatrix_eq_prod_sq_singularValues hkn
    have hA := det_gram_mul_le_det_gram_mul_prod_sq_singularValues A (B * Q)
    have hB := det_gram_mul_le_prod_sq_singularValues B hQ
    have hsq : (∏ i : Fin k, singularValues (A * B) i) ^ 2 ≤
        (∏ i : Fin k, singularValues A i * singularValues B i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_pow, ← Finset.prod_pow]
      calc
        _ = ((A * (B * Q))ᵀ * (A * (B * Q))).det := by
          simpa only [Q, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hdetT.symm
        _ ≤ ((B * Q)ᵀ * (B * Q)).det * ∏ i : Fin k, singularValues A i ^ 2 := hA
        _ ≤ (∏ i : Fin k, singularValues B i ^ 2) * ∏ i : Fin k, singularValues A i ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]; apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i : Fin k, singularValues A i * singularValues B i :=
      Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) (singularValues_nonneg B i)
    have h1 : 0 ≤ ∏ i : Fin k, singularValues (A * B) i :=
      Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ _
    rw [← Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range, ← Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range]
    nlinarith
  · have hbound : (A * B).rank ≤ min m (min p n) := by
      apply le_min (A * B).rank_le_height
      exact le_min ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left A B).trans A.rank_le_width) (A * B).rank_le_width
    have hzero : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues (A * B) i) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hk))
      exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le _ hbound
    rw [hzero]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) (singularValues_nonneg B i)

name: NLAlib.prod_singularValues_mul_le
statement:
theorem prod_singularValues_mul_le {m p n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m p ℝ) (B : Matrix p n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues (A * B) i) ≤
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A i * singularValues B i
proof:
:= by
  have h := prod_singularValues_mul_le_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin p))
    (B.reindex (Fintype.equivFin p) (Fintype.equivFin n)) k
  have hAB : A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin p) *
      B.reindex (Fintype.equivFin p) (Fintype.equivFin n) =
      (A * B).reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n) := by
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
  rwa [hAB, singularValues_reindex, singularValues_reindex, singularValues_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.isUnit_realMatrixComplexification_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_realMatrixComplexification_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    IsUnit (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ) ↔ IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hz
    have hn := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA
    apply (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hn)
    have hd := (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).map_det A
    rw [hz, map_zero] at hd
    exact hd.symm
  · intro hA
    exact hA.map realMatrixComplexification

name: NLAlib.commute_of_posSemidef_add_eq_diagonal_projection
proof:
:= by
  have hAP : A * diagonal p = A := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    rcases hp j with hj | hj
    · have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M j j) hAB
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, hj] at he
      have hz : A j j = 0 := by linarith [hA.diag_nonneg (i := j), hB.diag_nonneg (i := j)]
      rw [hj, mul_zero, apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA hz i]
    · rw [hj, mul_one]
  have hPA : diagonal p * A = A := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose hAP
    have ht : Aᵀ = A := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA.isHermitian.eq
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, ht] using h
  change A * B = B * A
  have hleft : A * A + A * B = A := by rw [← Matrix.mul_add, hAB, hAP]
  have hright : A * A + B * A = A := by rw [← Matrix.add_mul, hAB, hPA]
  exact add_left_cancel (hleft.trans hright.symm)

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_congruence_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_congruence_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n → ℝ), IsUnit X ∧
      Xᵀ * A * X = diagonal a ∧ Xᵀ * B * X = diagonal b ∧
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hC := (hA.add hB).isHermitian
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hC.eigenvectorUnitary
  let c := hC.eigenvalues
  have hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i := (hA.add hB).eigenvalues_nonneg
  have hUt : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hC
  have hUu : IsUnit U := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det U).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt)
  have hCU : Uᵀ * (A + B) * U = diagonal c := by
    calc
      Uᵀ * (A + B) * U = Uᵀ * (U * diagonal c * Uᵀ) * U :=
        congrArg (fun M => Uᵀ * M * U) (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hC)
      _ = diagonal c := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [hUt, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.one_mul]
  let t : n → ℝ := fun i => if c i = 0 then 1 else (Real.sqrt (c i))⁻¹
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    dsimp [t]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact inv_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (hc i) (Ne.symm hi)))
  let R := U * diagonal t
  have hR : IsUnit R := hUu.mul (Matrix.isUnit_diagonal.mpr
    (Pi.isUnit_iff.mpr fun i => isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ht i)))
  let A' := Rᵀ * A * R
  let B' := Rᵀ * B * R
  have hA' : A'.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [A', Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same R
  have hB' : B'.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [B', Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same R
  let p : n → ℝ := fun i => t i * c i * t i
  have hsum : A' + B' = diagonal p := by
    calc
      A' + B' = Rᵀ * (A + B) * R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, A', B']
      _ = diagonal t * (Uᵀ * (A + B) * U) * diagonal t := by
        simp only [R, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = diagonal p := by rw [hCU, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  have hp : ∀ i, p i = 0 ∨ p i = 1 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · exact Or.inl (by simp [p, hi])
    · right
      have hs : Real.sqrt (c i) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (hc i) (Ne.symm hi))
      dsimp [p, t]
      rw [if_neg hi]
      field_simp
      exact (Real.sq_sqrt (hc i)).symm
  obtain ⟨V, a, b, hV, hVA, hVB⟩ := exists_orthogonal_congruence_diagonal_of_commute
    hA'.isHermitian hB'.isHermitian
    (commute_of_posSemidef_add_eq_diagonal_projection hA' hB' hsum hp)
  have hVu : IsUnit V := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det V).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hV)
  refine ⟨R * V, a, b, hR.mul hVu, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [A', Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hVA
  · simpa only [B', Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hVB
  · apply Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mp
    rw [← hVA]
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA'.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same V
  · apply Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mp
    rw [← hVB]
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hB'.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same V

name: NLAlib.exists_normalized_diagonal_congruence_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_diagonal_congruence_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n → ℝ), IsUnit X ∧
      Xᵀ * A * X = diagonal a ∧ Xᵀ * B * X = diagonal b ∧
      (∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ a i = 1) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) ∧
      (∀ i, a i = 0 → b i = 0 ∨ b i = 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Y, a, b, hY, hYA, hYB, ha, hb⟩ := exists_diagonal_congruence_of_posSemidef hA hB
  let q : n → ℝ := fun i => if a i = 0 then b i else a i
  have hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i := by intro i; dsimp [q]; split_ifs <;> first | exact ha i | exact hb i
  let t : n → ℝ := fun i => if q i = 0 then 1 else (Real.sqrt (q i))⁻¹
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    dsimp [t]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact inv_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (hq i) (Ne.symm hi)))
  have htqt : ∀ i, q i ≠ 0 → t i * q i * t i = 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hs : Real.sqrt (q i) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (hq i) (Ne.symm hi))
    dsimp [t]
    rw [if_neg hi]
    field_simp
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (hq i)).symm
  let a' : n → ℝ := fun i => t i * a i * t i
  let b' : n → ℝ := fun i => t i * b i * t i
  refine ⟨Y * diagonal t, a', b', hY.mul (Matrix.isUnit_diagonal.mpr
    (Pi.isUnit_iff.mpr fun i => isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ht i))), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      (Y * diagonal t)ᵀ * A * (Y * diagonal t) =
          diagonal t * (Yᵀ * A * Y) * diagonal t := by
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = diagonal a' := by rw [hYA, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  · calc
      (Y * diagonal t)ᵀ * B * (Y * diagonal t) =
          diagonal t * (Yᵀ * B * Y) * diagonal t := by
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = diagonal b' := by rw [hYB, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  · intro i
    by_cases hai : a i = 0
    · exact Or.inl (by simp [a', hai])
    · right
      have hqi : q i = a i := if_neg hai
      simpa only [a', hqi] using htqt i (hqi ▸ hai)
  · intro i
    change 0 ≤ t i * b i * t i
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t i), hb i, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (t i)) (hb i)]
  · intro i hai
    have hai0 : a i = 0 := by
      change t i * a i * t i = 0 at hai
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (mul_eq_zero.mp hai |>.resolve_right (ht i))).resolve_left (ht i)
    have hqi : q i = b i := if_pos hai0
    by_cases hbi : b i = 0
    · exact Or.inl (by simp [b', hbi])
    · right
      simpa only [b', hqi] using htqt i (hqi ▸ hbi)

name: NLAlib.eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_inv_of_congruence
statement:
theorem eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_inv_of_congruence
    {A X : Matrix n n ℝ} {a : n → ℝ} (hX : IsUnit X)
    (hXA : Xᵀ * A * X = diagonal a) :
    A = Xᵀ⁻¹ * diagonal a * X⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hXd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det X).mp hX
  have hXtd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det Xᵀ).mp ((Matrix.isUnit_transpose X).mpr hX)
  rw [← hXA]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Xᵀ hXtd, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X hXd, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.ker_add_eq_inf_of_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_inf, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.add_mulVec]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hq : x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x + x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x = 0 := by rw [← dotProduct_add, h, dotProduct_zero]
    have ha : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x := by simpa using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    have hb : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x := by simpa using hB.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    exact ⟨(hA.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff x).mp (by simpa using (show x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x = 0 by linarith)),
      (hB.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff x).mp (by simpa using (show x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x = 0 by linarith))⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    rw [ha, hb, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.rank_eq_card_nonzero_of_diagonal_congruence
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr := congrArg Matrix.rank hXA
  rw [Matrix.rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det X _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hX),
    Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det Xᵀ _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp
      ((Matrix.isUnit_transpose _).mpr hX)), Matrix.rank_diagonal] at hr
  exact hr

name: NLAlib.semidefinite_pair_congruence_normal_form
statement:
theorem semidefinite_pair_congruence_normal_form {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (S : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n → ℝ), IsUnit S ∧
      A = S * diagonal a * Sᵀ ∧ B = S * diagonal b * Sᵀ ∧
      (∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ a i = 1) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) ∧
      (∀ i, a i = 0 → b i = 0 ∨ b i = 1) ∧
      A.rank = Fintype.card {i // a i = 1} ∧
      (A + B).rank = Fintype.card {i // a i = 1} +
        Fintype.card {i // a i = 0 ∧ b i = 1} ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ ↥(LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ⊓ LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin) =
        Fintype.card {i // a i = 0 ∧ b i = 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨X, a, b, hX, hXA, hXB, ha, hb, hab⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_diagonal_congruence_of_posSemidef hA hB
  have ha0 (i : n) : 0 ≤ a i := by rcases ha i with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hsum0 (i : n) : a i + b i = 0 ↔ a i = 0 ∧ b i = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h; constructor <;> linarith [ha0 i, hb i]
    · rintro ⟨h, h'⟩; rw [h, h', add_zero]
  have ha1 (i : n) : a i ≠ 0 ↔ a i = 1 := by rcases ha i with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hsum1 (i : n) : a i + b i ≠ 0 ↔ a i = 1 ∨ (a i = 0 ∧ b i = 1) := by
    simp only [ne_eq, hsum0]
    rcases ha i with hai | hai
    · rcases hab i hai with hbi | hbi <;> simp [hai, hbi]
    · simp [hai]
  have hXsum : Xᵀ * (A + B) * X = diagonal (fun i => a i + b i) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hXA, hXB, ← Matrix.diagonal_add]
  have hrA := rank_eq_card_nonzero_of_diagonal_congruence hX hXA
  have hrC := rank_eq_card_nonzero_of_diagonal_congruence hX hXsum
  have hrA' : A.rank = Fintype.card {i // a i = 1} := by
    simpa only [ha1] using hrA
  have hrC' : (A + B).rank = Fintype.card {i // a i = 1} +
      Fintype.card {i // a i = 0 ∧ b i = 1} := by
    rw [hrC]
    simp only [hsum1, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.filter_or]
    apply Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i hi hi'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi hi'
    exact zero_ne_one (hi'.1.symm.trans hi)
  have hnull : Module.finrank ℝ ↥(LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ⊓ LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin) =
      Fintype.card {i // a i = 0 ∧ b i = 0} := by
    rw [← ker_add_eq_inf_of_posSemidef hA hB]
    have hr : (A + B).rank + Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (A + B).mulVecLin) =
        Fintype.card n := by
      simpa only [Matrix.rank, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using
        LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (A + B).mulVecLin
    have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n)) (p := fun i => a i + b i = 0)
    simp only [Finset.card_univ, hsum0] at hc
    rw [hrC, Fintype.card_subtype] at hr
    simp only [ne_eq, hsum0] at hr
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    omega
  refine ⟨Xᵀ⁻¹, a, b, Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr ((Matrix.isUnit_transpose X).mpr hX),
    ?_, ?_, ha, hb, hab, hrA', hrC', hnull⟩
  · simpa only [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
      eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_inv_of_congruence hX hXA
  · simpa only [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
      eq_inv_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul_inv_of_congruence hX hXB

name: NLAlib.toQuadraticForm'_apply
statement:
theorem toQuadraticForm'_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    A.toQuadraticForm' x = quadForm A x
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.toQuadraticForm', Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply', quadForm]

name: NLAlib.equivalent_toQuadraticForm'_transpose_mul_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit X.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det X).1 hX
  let hXi := X.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hdet
  refine ⟨{ X.toLinearEquiv' hXi with map_app' := fun x => ?_ }⟩
  change A.toQuadraticForm' (X *ᵥ x) = (Xᵀ * A * X).toQuadraticForm' x
  rw [toQuadraticForm'_apply, toQuadraticForm'_apply, quadForm_def, quadForm_def,
    star_trivial, star_trivial,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec x Xᵀ,
    Matrix.vecMul_transpose]

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {X : Matrix n n ℝ} (hX : IsUnit X) :
    inertiaPos (Xᵀ * A * X) = inertiaPos A
proof:
:=
  (equivalent_toQuadraticForm'_transpose_mul_mul A hX).sigPos_eq

name: NLAlib.inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {X : Matrix n n ℝ} (hX : IsUnit X) :
    inertiaNeg (Xᵀ * A * X) = inertiaNeg A
proof:
:=
  (equivalent_toQuadraticForm'_transpose_mul_mul A hX).sigNeg_eq

name: NLAlib.toQuadraticForm'_diagonal
statement:
theorem toQuadraticForm'_diagonal (d : n → ℝ) :
    (diagonal d).toQuadraticForm' = QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ d
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [toQuadraticForm'_apply, QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares_apply, quadForm_def,
    star_trivial]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, smul_eq_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_diagonal
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_diagonal (d : n → ℝ) :
    inertiaPos (diagonal d) = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < d i).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [inertiaPos, toQuadraticForm'_diagonal, QuadraticForm.sigPos_weightedSumSquares,
    Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp

name: NLAlib.inertiaNeg_diagonal
statement:
theorem inertiaNeg_diagonal (d : n → ℝ) :
    inertiaNeg (diagonal d) = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => d i < 0).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [inertiaNeg, toQuadraticForm'_diagonal, QuadraticForm.sigNeg_weightedSumSquares,
    Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp

name: NLAlib.sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (x : ℝ) :
    A - x • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) =
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ)ᵀ *
        diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - x) * (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n ℝ := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
  have hUU : U * Uᵀ = 1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA
  rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    show (diagonal fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - x) = diagonal hA.eigenvalues - x • 1 by
      ext i j; by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h],
    Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hUU,
    ← eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary
statement:
theorem isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    IsUnit ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ)
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA))

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_sub_smul_one_eq_card
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_sub_smul_one_eq_card {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ℝ) :
    inertiaPos (A - x • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => x < hA.eigenvalues i).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul hA x,
    inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul _ (isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hA), inertiaPos_diagonal]
  simp_rw [sub_pos]

name: NLAlib.inertiaNeg_sub_smul_one_eq_card
statement:
theorem inertiaNeg_sub_smul_one_eq_card {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ℝ) :
    inertiaNeg (A - x • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i < x).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul hA x,
    inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul _ (isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hA), inertiaNeg_diagonal]
  simp_rw [sub_neg]

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_eq_card_eigenvalues_pos
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_eq_card_eigenvalues_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    inertiaPos A = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hA.eigenvalues i).card
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inertiaPos_sub_smul_one_eq_card hA 0

name: NLAlib.inertiaNeg_eq_card_eigenvalues_neg
statement:
theorem inertiaNeg_eq_card_eigenvalues_neg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    inertiaNeg A = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i < 0).card
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inertiaNeg_sub_smul_one_eq_card hA 0

name: NLAlib.card_eigenvalues_lt_eq_card_neg_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hLt : IsUnit Lᵀ := (Matrix.isUnit_transpose L).2 hL
  rw [← inertiaNeg_sub_smul_one_eq_card hA x, h, ← inertiaNeg_diagonal,
    ← inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul (diagonal d) hLt, Matrix.transpose_transpose]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_schur_triangularization
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_schur_triangularization (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (T : Matrix n n ℂ),
      A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → T i j = 0) ∧
      A.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T i i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := A.toEuclideanLin
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_triangular (Fintype.card n) f
    (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ))
  let b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := b₀.reindex e
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ := f.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hUUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hback : b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    calc
      b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
          b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) := by
            rw [hUU, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ :=
        (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
        change (b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis) *
          (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = _
        rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    have hbasis := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis f
    have hstd : f.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = A :=
      LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis A
    calc
      A = f.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis := hstd.symm
      _ = c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * f.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis *
          b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis := hbasis.symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hback]
  have htri : ∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → T i j = 0 := by
    intro i j hij
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using hb₀ (e.symm i) (e.symm j) hij
  have hTfin : (T.submatrix e e).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    exact htri (e i) (e j) (by simpa using hij)
  have hchar : T.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T i i)) := by
    calc
      T.charpoly = (T.submatrix e e).charpoly := (Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm T).symm
      _ = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T (e i) (e i))) :=
        Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ hTfin
      _ = _ := e.prod_comp (fun i => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T i i))
  refine ⟨U, T, hA, htri, ?_⟩
  rw [hA, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUUt, Matrix.one_mul, hchar]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_upperTriangular_diagonal_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_upperTriangular_diagonal_charpoly (k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin k) ℂ) (T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ),
      A = (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ) * T * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      T.IsUpperTriangular ∧ A.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T i i))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin k) = k := Fintype.card_fin k
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin k)) ≃ Fin k := finCongr hcard
  obtain ⟨U, T, hA, htri, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A e
  refine ⟨U, T, hA, ?_, hchar⟩
  intro i j hij
  apply htri i j
  exact hij

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_eq_mul_schur_mul_conjTranspose_bottom
statement:
private theorem fromBlocks_eq_mul_schur_mul_conjTranspose_bottom
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hCu : IsUnit C) :
    fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C =
      (fromBlocks 1 (B * C⁻¹) 0 1) *
      fromBlocks (A - B * C⁻¹ * Bᴴ) 0 0 C *
      (fromBlocks 1 (B * C⁻¹) 0 1)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible C := hCu.invertible
  have hCt : (C⁻¹)ᴴ = C⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hC.inv.eq
  simpa only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, fromBlocks_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hCt] using
    Matrix.fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₂₂ A B Bᴴ C

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_schur_complement_bottom
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.sub
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose B hC.inv

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur_bottom
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℝ := fromBlocks 1 (B * C⁻¹) 0 1
  let S : Matrix m m ℝ := A - B * C⁻¹ * Bᴴ
  have hL : IsUnit L :=
    isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨isUnit_one, isUnit_one⟩
  have hLt : IsUnit (Lᴴ) := by
    simpa using hL
  have hS : S.IsHermitian :=
    isHermitian_schur_complement_bottom hA hC B
  have hSym : L * fromBlocks S 0 0 C * Lᴴ = (Lᴴ)ᴴ * fromBlocks S 0 0 C * Lᴴ := by
    nth_rw 1 [← Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose L]
  calc
    inertiaPos (fromBlocks A B Bᴴ C) = inertiaPos (L * fromBlocks S 0 0 C * Lᴴ) := by
      rw [fromBlocks_eq_mul_schur_mul_conjTranspose_bottom B hC hCu]
    _ = inertiaPos (fromBlocks S 0 0 C) := by
      rw [hSym]
      exact inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul (X := Lᴴ) (A := fromBlocks S 0 0 C) hLt
    _ = inertiaPos C + inertiaPos S := by
      rw [inertiaPos_fromBlocks_zero hS hC, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_diagonal_one_pos
statement:
private lemma inertiaPos_diagonal_one_pos (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    inertiaPos (diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => c)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [inertiaPos_diagonal]
  have hf : (Finset.univ.filter fun _ : Fin 1 => 0 < c) = Finset.univ := by
    ext x
    simp [hc]
  rw [hf]
  simp

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_diagonal_one_neg
statement:
private lemma inertiaPos_diagonal_one_neg (c : ℝ) (hc : c < 0) :
    inertiaPos (diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => c)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [inertiaPos_diagonal]
  have hf : (Finset.univ.filter fun _ : Fin 1 => 0 < c) = ∅ := by
    ext x
    by_cases h : 0 < c
    · exfalso
      linarith
    · simp [h]
  rw [hf]
  simp

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_add_vecMulVec_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_add_vecMulVec_eq_add_one
    {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.IsHermitian) (hMu : IsUnit M) (v : n → ℝ)
    (hlt : v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v) < -1) :
    inertiaPos (M + vecMulVec v v) = inertiaPos M + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Matrix n (Fin 1) ℝ := fun i _ => v i
  let K : Matrix (n ⊕ Fin 1) (n ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ := fromBlocks M b bᴴ oneByOneNeg
  have hD_herm : oneByOneNeg.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal _
  have hDD : oneByOneNeg * oneByOneNeg = (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) := by
    dsimp [oneByOneNeg]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    fin_cases i
    fin_cases j
    norm_num
  have hDu : IsUnit oneByOneNeg := by
    refine ⟨⟨oneByOneNeg, oneByOneNeg, hDD, hDD⟩, rfl⟩
  have hK_top : inertiaPos K = inertiaPos M + inertiaPos (oneByOneNeg - bᴴ * M⁻¹ * b) := by
    simpa [K] using inertiaPos_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur hM hMu hD_herm b
  have hbMul : bᴴ * M⁻¹ * b = diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) := by
    let e : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 1
    have hb : b = vecMulVec v e := by
      ext i j
      simp [b, vecMulVec, e]
    have hbT : bᴴ = vecMulVec e v := by
      rw [hb, Matrix.conjTranspose_vecMulVec]
      ext i j
      simp [e, vecMulVec]
    have hdot : (v ᵥ* M⁻¹ ⬝ᵥ v) = v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v) := by
      exact (Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec v M⁻¹ v).symm
    calc
      bᴴ * M⁻¹ * b = (vecMulVec e v * M⁻¹) * vecMulVec v e := by
        rw [hbT, hb]
      _ = (vecMulVec e (v ᵥ* M⁻¹)) * vecMulVec v e := by
        rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul]
      _ = vecMulVec e ((v ᵥ* M⁻¹ ⬝ᵥ v) • e) := by
        rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec]
      _ = diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) := by
        rw [hdot]
        ext i j
        fin_cases i
        fin_cases j
        simp [vecMulVec, e]
  have hDq : oneByOneNeg - bᴴ * M⁻¹ * b =
      diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => -1 - v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) := by
    dsimp [oneByOneNeg]
    rw [hbMul, ← Matrix.diagonal_sub]
  have hpos : 0 < -1 - v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v) := by linarith
  have hDschur : inertiaPos (oneByOneNeg - bᴴ * M⁻¹ * b) = 1 := by
    rw [hDq]
    exact inertiaPos_diagonal_one_pos (-1 - v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) hpos
  have hK_bottom : inertiaPos K = inertiaPos oneByOneNeg +
      inertiaPos (M - b * oneByOneNeg⁻¹ * bᴴ) := by
    simpa [K] using inertiaPos_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur_bottom hM b hD_herm hDu
  have hDinv : oneByOneNeg⁻¹ = oneByOneNeg := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hDD
  have hbb : b * bᴴ = vecMulVec v v := by
    let e : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 1
    have hb : b = vecMulVec v e := by
      ext i j
      simp [b, vecMulVec, e]
    have hbT : bᴴ = vecMulVec e v := by
      rw [hb, Matrix.conjTranspose_vecMulVec]
      ext i j
      simp [e, vecMulVec]
    have he : e ⬝ᵥ e = 1 := by
      rw [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_one]
      simp [e]
    calc
      b * bᴴ = vecMulVec v e * vecMulVec e v := by
        rw [hbT, hb]
      _ = vecMulVec v ((e ⬝ᵥ e) • v) := by
        rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec]
      _ = vecMulVec v v := by
        rw [he, one_smul]
  have hbD : b * oneByOneNeg = -b := by
    ext i j
    dsimp [oneByOneNeg]
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simp [b]
  have hbDb : b * oneByOneNeg * bᴴ = -vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [hbD, Matrix.neg_mul, hbb]
  have hMupdate : M - b * oneByOneNeg⁻¹ * bᴴ = M + vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [hDinv, hbDb]
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add]
  have hD_inertia0 : inertiaPos oneByOneNeg = 0 := by
    dsimp [oneByOneNeg]
    exact inertiaPos_diagonal_one_neg (-1) (by norm_num)
  have hmain_top : inertiaPos K = inertiaPos M + 1 := by
    rw [hK_top, hDschur]
  have hmain_bottom : inertiaPos K = inertiaPos (M + vecMulVec v v) := by
    rw [hK_bottom, hMupdate, hD_inertia0]
    simp
  exact hmain_bottom.symm.trans hmain_top

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_add_vecMulVec_eq_add_one_of_shift
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_add_vecMulVec_eq_add_one_of_shift
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : ℝ) (v : n → ℝ)
    (hMu : IsUnit (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)))
    (hlt : v ⬝ᵥ ((A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ *ᵥ v) < -1) :
    inertiaPos (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + vecMulVec v v) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => b < hA.eigenvalues i).card + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hI : (b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).IsHermitian := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal]
    exact Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal _
  have hm :=
    inertiaPos_add_vecMulVec_eq_add_one (hA.sub hI) hMu v hlt
  rw [inertiaPos_sub_smul_one_eq_card hA b] at hm
  exact hm

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_eq_selected_omitted_grams
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_eq_selected_omitted_grams (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (f : p → m) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Aᵀ * A = (A.submatrix f id)ᵀ * A.submatrix f id +
      (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i : m // i ∉ Set.range f} → m) id)ᵀ *
        A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i : m // i ∉ Set.range f} → m) id
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype (Set.range f) := Subtype.fintype (fun i => i ∈ Set.range f)
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Function.id_def, Matrix.add_apply]
  have hsplit := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (fun i => i ∈ Set.range f)
    (fun k => A k i * A k j)
  have hselected : (∑ k : Set.range f, A k i * A k j) =
      ∑ k : p, A (f k) i * A (f k) j := by
    exact ((Equiv.ofInjective f hf).sum_comp (fun k : Set.range f => A k i * A k j)).symm
  rw [hselected] at hsplit
  exact hsplit.symm

name: NLAlib.singularValues_submatrix_rows_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_submatrix_rows_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (f : p → m) (hf : Function.Injective f) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A.submatrix f id) k ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k < Fintype.card n
  · let D := A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i : m // i ∉ Set.range f} → m) id
    have hd : (Aᵀ * A - (A.submatrix f id)ᵀ * A.submatrix f id).PosSemidef := by
      rw [transpose_mul_eq_selected_omitted_grams A f hf, add_sub_cancel_left]
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self D
    have h := Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (A.submatrix f id))
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A) hd ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (A.submatrix f id) ⟨k, hk⟩,
      ← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A ⟨k, hk⟩] at h
    nlinarith [singularValues_nonneg (A.submatrix f id) k, singularValues_nonneg A k]
  · rw [singularValues_eq_linearMap, singularValues_eq_linearMap,
      LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le, LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le]
    all_goals simpa only [finrank_euclideanSpace] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hk

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_submatrix_rows
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_submatrix_rows (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (f : p → m) (hf : Function.Injective f) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A (k + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p)) ≤
      singularValues (A.submatrix f id) k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i : m // i ∉ Set.range f} → m) id
  have hc : Fintype.card {i : m // i ∉ Set.range f} = Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Set.card_range_of_injective hf]
  by_cases hk : k + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p) < Fintype.card n
  · have hk₀ : k < Fintype.card n := by omega
    have hr : (Dᵀ * D).rank ≤ Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p := by
      rw [← hc]
      exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_le_card_height D)
    have h := eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_rank_le
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (A.submatrix f id))
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self D) hr ⟨k, hk₀⟩ hk
    have hGram := transpose_mul_eq_selected_omitted_grams A f hf
    change Aᵀ * A = (A.submatrix f id)ᵀ * A.submatrix f id + Dᵀ * D at hGram
    have heig := eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq
      ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (A.submatrix f id)).add
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self D))
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
      (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hGram.symm)
    rw [heig] at h
    rw [← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A
      ⟨k + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p), hk⟩,
      ← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (A.submatrix f id) ⟨k, hk₀⟩] at h
    nlinarith [singularValues_nonneg A (k + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p)),
      singularValues_nonneg (A.submatrix f id) k]
  · rw [singularValues_eq_linearMap, LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le]
    · exact singularValues_nonneg (A.submatrix f id) k
    · simpa only [finrank_euclideanSpace] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hk

name: NLAlib.singularValues_submatrix_cols_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_submatrix_cols_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (f : p → n) (hf : Function.Injective f) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A.submatrix id f) k ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_submatrix_rows_le Aᵀ f hf k
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_submatrix, singularValues_transpose, singularValues_transpose] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_submatrix_cols
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_submatrix_cols (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (f : p → n) (hf : Function.Injective f) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A (k + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card p)) ≤
      singularValues (A.submatrix id f) k
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_le_submatrix_rows Aᵀ f hf k
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_submatrix, singularValues_transpose, singularValues_transpose] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.singularValues_submatrix_interlacing
statement:
theorem singularValues_submatrix_interlacing
    {q : Type*} [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (f : p → m) (g : q → n) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A
      (k + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p) + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card q)) ≤
        singularValues (A.submatrix f g) k ∧
    singularValues (A.submatrix f g) k ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  have hc := singularValues_le_submatrix_cols (A.submatrix f id) g hg k
  have hr := singularValues_le_submatrix_rows A f hf
    (k + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card q))
  have hcu := singularValues_submatrix_cols_le (A.submatrix f id) g hg k
  have hru := singularValues_submatrix_rows_le A f hf k
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_submatrix, Function.comp_id, Function.id_comp] at hc hcu
  refine ⟨?_, hcu.trans hru⟩
  have hidx : k + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p) + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card q) =
      k + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card q) + (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card p) := by omega
  rw [hidx]
  exact hr.trans hc

name: NLAlib.realDilationSpectrum_antitone
statement:
theorem realDilationSpectrum_antitone {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Antitone (realDilationSpectrum A)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : (i : ℕ) ≤ j := hij
  simp only [realDilationSpectrum]
  split_ifs with hj hi hi
  · exact singularValues_antitone A hij'
  · omega
  · exact (neg_nonpos.mpr (singularValues_nonneg A _)).trans (singularValues_nonneg A _)
  · exact neg_le_neg (singularValues_antitone A (by omega))

name: NLAlib.diagonal_reindex_dilationOrdering
statement:
private theorem diagonal_reindex_dilationOrdering {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin m => singularValues A i)
      (fun j : Fin n => -singularValues A j))).reindex
        (dilationOrderingEquiv m n) (dilationOrderingEquiv m n) =
      Matrix.diagonal (realDilationSpectrum A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_equiv]
  congr 1
  funext k
  refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun j => ?_) k
  · simp [dilationOrderingEquiv, realDilationSpectrum, i.isLt]
  · simp [dilationOrderingEquiv, realDilationSpectrum, Fin.val_rev]
    apply congrArg (singularValues A)
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_dilation
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_dilation {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (k : Fin (m + n)) :
    (isHermitian_dilation A).eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (by simp) k) = realDilationSpectrum A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hHP⟩ := exists_dilation_orthogonal_diagonalization A
  have hc : (dilation A).charpoly = (Matrix.diagonal (realDilationSpectrum A)).charpoly := by
    rw [hHP, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Pᵀ P, hP, Matrix.one_mul]
    calc
      _ = ((Matrix.diagonal (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin m => singularValues A i)
        (fun j : Fin n => -singularValues A j))).reindex
          (dilationOrderingEquiv m n) (dilationOrderingEquiv m n)).charpoly :=
        (Matrix.charpoly_reindex (dilationOrderingEquiv m n) _).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg Matrix.charpoly (diagonal_reindex_dilationOrdering A)
  have hsort := (isHermitian_dilation A).sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀
  rw [hc, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Polynomial.roots_prod _ _ (by
    simp [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero])] at hsort
  simp only [Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Multiset.bind_singleton, Multiset.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, RCLike.re_to_real] at hsort
  have hl : List.ofFn (isHermitian_dilation A).eigenvalues₀ =
      List.ofFn (realDilationSpectrum A) := by
    rw [← hsort]
    simp_rw [Fin.univ_val_map, Multiset.coe_sort]
    apply List.mergeSort_of_pairwise
    simp_rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← List.sortedGE_iff_pairwise]
    exact (realDilationSpectrum_antitone A).sortedGE_ofFn
  have hv := congrArg (fun l : List ℝ => l.getD k 0) hl
  simpa using hv

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_dilation_top
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_dilation_top {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i : Fin (min m n)) :
    (isHermitian_dilation A).eigenvalues₀
      (Fin.cast (by simp) (Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i)) = singularValues A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvalues₀_dilation]
  simp [realDilationSpectrum, show (i : ℕ) < m from lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (min_le_left m n)]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_dilation_bottom
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_dilation_bottom {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i : Fin (min m n)) :
    (isHermitian_dilation A).eigenvalues₀
      (Fin.cast (by simp) ((Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i).rev)) =
      -singularValues A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvalues₀_dilation]
  have hm : ¬ (((Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i).rev : Fin (m + n)) : ℕ) < m := by
    simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_castLE]
    have hin := lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (min_le_right m n)
    omega
  simp only [realDilationSpectrum]
  rw [if_neg hm]
  have hi : m + n - 1 - ((Fin.castLE (by omega : min m n ≤ m + n) i).rev : Fin (m + n)).val = i.val := by
    simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_castLE]
    have hlt := i.isLt
    omega
  rw [hi]

name: NLAlib.scalar_eq_smul_one
statement:
private theorem scalar_eq_smul_one {τ : Type*} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ]
    (t : 𝕜) : Matrix.scalar τ t = t • (1 : Matrix τ τ 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, h]

name: NLAlib.eval_charpoly_kktMatrix_one
statement:
theorem eval_charpoly_kktMatrix_one (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hmn : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card n) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ≠ 1) :
    (kktMatrix 1 C).charpoly.eval t =
      (t - 1) ^ (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card m) *
        (C * Cᴴ).charpoly.eval (t ^ 2 - t)
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr ht
  let : Invertible ((t - 1) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) :=
    { invOf := (t - 1)⁻¹ • 1
      invOf_mul_self := by simp [smul_smul, ht0]
      mul_invOf_self := by simp [smul_smul, ht0] }
  have hblock : Matrix.scalar (n ⊕ m) t - kktMatrix 1 C =
      Matrix.fromBlocks ((t - 1) • 1) (-Cᴴ) (-C) (t • 1) := by
    rw [scalar_eq_smul_one, kktMatrix]
    ext (i | i) (j | j) <;>
      simp [Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Matrix.one_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have hc : t * (t - 1) = t ^ 2 - t := by ring
  have hinner : t • (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) -
      (-C) * ((t - 1)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) * (-Cᴴ) =
      (t - 1)⁻¹ • ((t ^ 2 - t) • (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) - C * Cᴴ) := by
    have hcoeff : (t - 1)⁻¹ * (t ^ 2 - t) = t := by rw [← hc]; field_simp
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, smul_neg, neg_neg, smul_sub, smul_smul, hcoeff]
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, hblock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁]
  change ((t - 1) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)).det *
    (t • (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) - (-C) * ((t - 1)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) * (-Cᴴ)).det = _
  rw [hinner, Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_one, mul_one,
    Matrix.eval_charpoly, scalar_eq_smul_one, ← mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero _ ht0), ← pow_add,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel hmn]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_kktMatrix_one
statement:
theorem charpoly_kktMatrix_one (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hmn : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (kktMatrix 1 C).charpoly =
      (X - 1) ^ (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card m) *
        (C * Cᴴ).charpoly.comp (X ^ 2 - X)
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (Set.finite_singleton (1 : 𝕜)).infinite_compl.mono
  intro t ht
  have ht1 : t ≠ 1 := ht
  simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_one, eval_comp] using
    eval_charpoly_kktMatrix_one C hmn ht1

name: NLAlib.charpoly_kktMatrix_one_eq_prod
statement:
theorem charpoly_kktMatrix_one_eq_prod (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hmn : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (kktMatrix 1 C).charpoly =
      (X - 1) ^ (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card m) *
        ∏ i, (X ^ 2 - X - Polynomial.C
          ((Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self C).eigenvalues i : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  rw [charpoly_kktMatrix_one C hmn, (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self C).charpoly_eq]
  simp only [prod_comp, sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_eq
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_eq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient (WithLp.toLp 2 b) =
      rayleighQuotient A b
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 = b ⬝ᵥ b := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [dotProduct, pow_two]
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient, ContinuousLinearMap.reApplyInnerSelf_apply,
    real_inner_comm, Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM, hn]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_bounds
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_bounds {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (b : n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient (WithLp.toLp 2 b) ∧
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient (WithLp.toLp 2 b) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_eq, rayleighQuotient_def, RCLike.re_to_real,
      RCLike.re_to_real, quadForm_def, star_trivial]
    apply div_nonneg _ (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
    simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg b
  · have h := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient_le_norm (WithLp.toLp 2 b)
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM, specNorm_eq_norm] using h)

name: NLAlib.sub_rayleighQuotient_pow_div_specNorm_le_log_overlap_div
statement:
theorem sub_rayleighQuotient_pow_div_specNorm_le_log_overlap_div
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hL : 0 < specNorm A)
    (i₀ : n) (h₀ : hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀ = specNorm A) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i₀ : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) :
    (specNorm A - (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient
      (WithLp.toLp 2 ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b))) / specNorm A ≤
      Real.log ((b ⬝ᵥ b) / ((hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i₀ : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) /
        ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let L := specNorm A
  have hLp : 0 < L := hL
  let c := fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b
  let d := fun i => hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i / L
  let M := fun s : ℕ => ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * d i ^ s
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i := fun i => div_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) hL.le
  have hd0 : d i₀ = 1 := by dsimp only [d, L]; rw [h₀, div_self hL.ne']
  have hc0 : 0 < c i₀ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb
  have hMe : 0 < M (2 * q) := by
    have h := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => c i ^ 2 * d i ^ (2 * q))
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (hd i) _)) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    rw [hd0, one_pow, mul_one] at h
    exact hc0.trans_le h
  have hEigen : ∀ i, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i = L * d i := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [d]
    field_simp [hLp.ne']
  have hD : ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) =
      L ^ (2 * q) * M (2 * q) := by
    have h := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum hA.isHermitian (X ^ q) b
    simp only [map_pow, aeval_X, eval_pow, eval_X, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm q 2] at h
    rw [h]
    dsimp only [M, c]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [hEigen i, mul_pow]
    ring
  have hN : ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b)) =
      L ^ (2 * q + 1) * M (2 * q + 1) := by
    have h := quadForm_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA.isHermitian (X ^ q) b
    simp only [map_pow, aeval_X, eval_pow, eval_X, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm q 2] at h
    rw [show ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b)) = quadForm A ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) from rfl, h]
    dsimp only [M, c]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← pow_succ', hEigen i, mul_pow]
    ring
  have hR : (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient (WithLp.toLp 2 ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b)) =
      L * (M (2 * q + 1) / M (2 * q)) := by
    rw [rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_eq, rayleighQuotient_def, RCLike.re_to_real,
      RCLike.re_to_real, quadForm_def, star_trivial, hN, hD, pow_succ]
    field_simp [hLp.ne', pow_ne_zero _ hLp.ne', hMe.ne']
  have hScalar := one_sub_sum_pow_div_sum_pow_le_log_div d c hd i₀ hd0 hb q
  have hEq : (L - L * (M (2 * q + 1) / M (2 * q))) / L =
      1 - M (2 * q + 1) / M (2 * q) := by field_simp [hLp.ne', hMe.ne']
  rw [hR, hEq]
  have hParseval : (∑ i, c i ^ 2) = b ⬝ᵥ b := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA.isHermitian b
  rw [hParseval] at hScalar
  exact hScalar

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_le_row_sum_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_norm_le_row_sum_of_mem_spectrum {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : ∃ i, ‖μ‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖A i j‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_gershgorinRowDisc_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hnorm : ‖μ - A i i‖ ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i := by
    simpa only [gershgorinRowDisc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hi
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  calc
    ‖μ‖ = ‖(μ - A i i) + A i i‖ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
    _ ≤ ‖μ - A i i‖ + ‖A i i‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ gershgorinRowRadius A i + ‖A i i‖ := add_le_add hnorm le_rfl
    _ = ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ := Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_le_max_row_sum
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_le_max_row_sum (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    spectralRadius ℂ A ≤
      (Finset.univ.sup (fun i => Real.toNNReal (∑ j, ‖A i j‖)) : ENNReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup₂_le
  intro μ hμ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_norm_le_row_sum_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hn : ‖μ‖₊ ≤ Real.toNNReal (∑ j, ‖A i j‖) := by
    simpa only [norm_toNNReal] using Real.toNNReal_mono hi
  exact_mod_cast hn.trans (Finset.le_sup
    (f := fun i : n => Real.toNNReal (∑ j, ‖A i j‖)) (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_le_max_column_sum
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_le_max_column_sum (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    spectralRadius ℂ A ≤
      (Finset.univ.sup (fun j => Real.toNNReal (∑ i, ‖A i j‖)) : ENNReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hspec : spectrum ℂ Aᵀ = spectrum ℂ A := by
    ext μ
    simp only [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_transpose]
  have h := spectralRadius_le_max_row_sum Aᵀ
  simpa only [spectralRadius, hspec, Matrix.transpose_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_le_min_max_row_column_sum
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_le_min_max_row_column_sum (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    spectralRadius ℂ A ≤ min
      (Finset.univ.sup (fun i => Real.toNNReal (∑ j, ‖A i j‖)) : ENNReal)
      (Finset.univ.sup (fun j => Real.toNNReal (∑ i, ‖A i j‖)) : ENNReal)
proof:
:=
  le_min (spectralRadius_le_max_row_sum A) (spectralRadius_le_max_column_sum A)

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_le_max_weighted_row_sum
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_le_max_weighted_row_sum
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (p : n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) :
    spectralRadius ℂ A ≤
      (Finset.univ.sup (fun i => Real.toNNReal ((p i)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p j * ‖A i j‖)) : ENNReal)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (p i : ℂ))
  let H : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (p i : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hpi (i : n) : (p i : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hp i).ne'
  have hHD : H * D = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simp only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (hpi _), Matrix.diagonal_one]
  have hD : IsUnit D := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det D).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hHD)
  have hInv : D⁻¹ = H := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hHD
  have hentry (i j : n) : ‖(D⁻¹ * A * D) i j‖ = (p i)⁻¹ * ‖A i j‖ * p j := by
    rw [hInv]
    dsimp only [H, D]
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv]
    simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hp i), abs_of_pos (hp j)]
  have hrow (i : n) : (∑ j, ‖(D⁻¹ * A * D) i j‖) = (p i)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p j * ‖A i j‖ := by
    simp only [hentry, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  apply iSup₂_le
  intro μ hμ
  have hμD := (mem_spectrum_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff A D hD μ).mpr hμ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_norm_le_row_sum_of_mem_spectrum hμD
  rw [hrow] at hi
  have hn : ‖μ‖₊ ≤ Real.toNNReal ((p i)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p j * ‖A i j‖) := by
    simpa only [norm_toNNReal] using Real.toNNReal_mono hi
  exact_mod_cast hn.trans (Finset.le_sup
    (f := fun i : n => Real.toNNReal ((p i)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p j * ‖A i j‖)) (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: NLAlib.convex_numericalRange_fin_le_two
statement:
private theorem convex_numericalRange_fin_le_two {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ 2)
    (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) : Convex ℝ (numericalRange B)
proof:
:= by
  have hcases : d = 0 ∨ d = 1 ∨ d = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have hnormal : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [numericalRange_eq_convexHull_spectrum_of_normal B hnormal]
    exact convex_convexHull _ _
  · have hnormal : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i
      fin_cases j
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
      ring
    rw [numericalRange_eq_convexHull_spectrum_of_normal B hnormal]
    exact convex_convexHull _ _
  · exact convex_numericalRange_two B

name: NLAlib.convex_numericalRange
statement:
theorem convex_numericalRange {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : Convex ℝ (numericalRange A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hqx⟩ := hz₁
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hqy⟩ := hz₂
  let S := Submodule.span ℂ ({x, y} : Set (n → ℂ))
  let : Fintype ({x, y} : Set (n → ℂ)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hd : Module.finrank ℂ S ≤ 2 := by
    have h := finrank_span_le_card (R := ℂ) ({x, y} : Set (n → ℂ))
    have hcard : ({x, y} : Set (n → ℂ)).toFinset.card ≤ 2 := by
      simp only [Set.toFinset_insert, Set.toFinset_singleton]
      exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    exact h.trans hcard
  let Q := orthonormalBasisMatrix S
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q := hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix S
  have hQS : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = S := range_orthonormalBasisMatrix S
  have hxS : x ∈ S := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  have hyS : y ∈ S := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  rw [← hQS] at hxS hyS
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hxS
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hyS
  change Q *ᵥ u = x at hu
  change Q *ᵥ v = y at hv
  have huNorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_toLp_mulVec_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ, hu, hx]
  have hvNorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_toLp_mulVec_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ, hv, hy]
  have hzu : z₁ ∈ numericalRange (Qᴴ * A * Q) := by
    refine ⟨u, huNorm, ?_⟩
    rw [quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, hu, hqx]
  have hzv : z₂ ∈ numericalRange (Qᴴ * A * Q) := by
    refine ⟨v, hvNorm, ?_⟩
    rw [quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, hv, hqy]
  have hC := (convex_numericalRange_fin_le_two hd (Qᴴ * A * Q)) hzu hzv ha hb hab
  exact numericalRange_conjTranspose_mul_mul_subset hQ A hC

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_lt_one_of_tendsto_matrix_pow_zero
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_lt_one_of_tendsto_matrix_pow_zero {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0)) : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hAz : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hAz, spectrum.spectralRadius_zero]
    exact zero_lt_one
  | inr hn =>
    have hnorm := tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mp hA
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hnorm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)))
    have hsmall : ‖A ^ (N + 1)‖ < 1 := hN (N + 1) (by omega)
    have hbound := spectrum.spectralRadius_le_pow_nnnorm_pow_one_div ℂ A N
    simp only [nnnorm_one, ENNReal.coe_one, ENNReal.one_rpow, mul_one] at hbound
    apply hbound.trans_lt
    apply ENNReal.rpow_lt_one
    · exact_mod_cast hsmall
    · positivity

name: NLAlib.tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_iff_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_iff_spectralRadius_lt_one (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔ spectralRadius ℂ A < 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨spectralRadius_lt_one_of_tendsto_matrix_pow_zero,
    tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one⟩

name: NLAlib.tsum_matrix_pow_eq_inv_of_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem tsum_matrix_pow_eq_inv_of_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1) : (∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) = (1 - A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hs := summable_matrix_pow_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA
  have hp := tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, A ^ k) * (1 - A))
      atTop (𝓝 ((∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) * (1 - A))) :=
    hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.mul_const (1 - A)
  have hright : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, A ^ k) * (1 - A))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simp only [geom_sum_mul_neg]
    simpa only [sub_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub hp
  have hInv : (∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) * (1 - A) = 1 := tendsto_nhds_unique hleft hright
  exact (Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hInv).symm

name: NLAlib.hasSum_matrix_pow_inv_of_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasSum_matrix_pow_inv_of_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1) : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k) (1 - A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_matrix_pow_eq_inv_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA]
  exact (summable_matrix_pow_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA).hasSum

name: NLAlib.isUnit_one_sub_of_matrix_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_one_sub_of_matrix_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1) : IsUnit (1 - A)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := summable_matrix_pow_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA
  have hp := tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, A ^ k) * (1 - A))
      atTop (𝓝 ((∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) * (1 - A))) :=
    hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.mul_const (1 - A)
  have hright : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, A ^ k) * (1 - A))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simp only [geom_sum_mul_neg]
    simpa only [sub_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub hp
  have hInv : (∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) * (1 - A) = 1 := tendsto_nhds_unique hleft hright
  have hdet := congrArg Matrix.det hInv
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one] at hdet
  apply (1 - A).isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hz
  rw [hz, mul_zero] at hdet
  exact zero_ne_one hdet

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_mul_rectDiag
statement:
theorem rectDiag_mul_rectDiag {m n p : ℕ} (s t : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) *
      (rectDiag t : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) =
      rectDiag (fun k => if k < n then s k * t k else 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, rectDiag_apply]
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < n
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨i, hi⟩]
    · split_ifs <;> simp_all
    · intro l _ hl
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hl (Fin.ext h.symm)), zero_mul]
    · simp
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · split_ifs <;> simp_all
    · intro l _
      rw [if_neg (fun (h : (i : ℕ) = l) => hi (h.symm ▸ l.isLt)), zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.pairRotation_transpose
statement:
private theorem pairRotation_transpose (m n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (pairRotation m n r)ᵀ = pairRotation m n r
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairRotation, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, transpose_rectDiag]

name: NLAlib.pairRotation_orthogonal
statement:
private theorem pairRotation_orthogonal (m n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ^ 2 + r ^ 2 = 1) :
    (pairRotation m n r)ᵀ * pairRotation m n r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairRotation_transpose, pairRotation, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  have htop :
      (Matrix.diagonal fun i : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) < n then r else 1) *
        (Matrix.diagonal fun i : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) < n then r else 1) +
      (rectDiag (fun _ => r) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * rectDiag (fun _ => r) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, rectDiag_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [ite_true]
      split_ifs <;> nlinarith
    · have hij' : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
      simp [hij, hij']
  have hbottom :
      (rectDiag (fun _ => r) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) * rectDiag (fun _ => r) +
      (Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < m then -r else 1) *
        (Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < m then -r else 1) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, rectDiag_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [ite_true]
      split_ifs <;> nlinarith
    · have hij' : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
      simp [hij, hij']
  have hoff :
      (Matrix.diagonal fun i : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) < n then r else 1) *
        (rectDiag (fun _ => r) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) +
      (rectDiag (fun _ => r) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) *
        (Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < m then -r else 1) = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, rectDiag_apply,
      Matrix.zero_apply]
    by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
    · have hin : (i : ℕ) < n := hij.symm ▸ j.isLt
      have hjm : (j : ℕ) < m := hij ▸ i.isLt
      simp only [if_pos hij, if_pos hin, if_pos hjm]
      ring
    · simp [hij]
  have hoff' := congrArg Matrix.transpose hoff
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose,
    transpose_rectDiag, Matrix.transpose_zero] at hoff'
  rw [htop, hbottom, hoff]
  have hoff'' :
      (rectDiag (fun _ => r) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) *
        (Matrix.diagonal fun i : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) < n then r else 1) +
      (Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < m then -r else 1) *
        (rectDiag (fun _ => r) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) = 0 := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using hoff'
  rw [hoff'', Matrix.fromBlocks_one]

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_dilation_mul_pairRotation
statement:
private theorem rectDiag_dilation_mul_pairRotation {m n : ℕ} (s : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ k, min m n ≤ k → s k = 0) (r : ℝ) :
    dilation (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * pairRotation m n r =
      pairRotation m n r * Matrix.diagonal (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin m => s i)
        (fun j : Fin n => -s j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilation, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, pairRotation, transpose_rectDiag,
    ← Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
  congr 1
  · rw [rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
    ext i j
    simp only [rectDiag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < n
      · simp [hi, mul_comm]
      · simp [hi, hs i (by omega)]
    · simp [hij, show (i : ℕ) ≠ j from fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)]
  · ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, rectDiag_apply]
