    by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
    · have hjm : (j : ℕ) < m := hij ▸ i.isLt
      simp only [if_pos hij, if_pos hjm]
      rw [hij]
      ring
    · simp [hij]
  · ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, rectDiag_apply]
    by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
    · have hjn : (j : ℕ) < n := hij ▸ i.isLt
      simp only [if_pos hij, if_pos hjn]
      rw [hij]
      ring
    · simp [hij]
  · rw [rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
    ext i j
    simp only [rectDiag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < m
      · simp [hi, mul_comm]
      · simp [hi, hs i (by omega)]
    · simp [hij, show (i : ℕ) ≠ j from fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)]

name: NLAlib.exists_dilation_orthogonal_diagonalization
statement:
theorem exists_dilation_orthogonal_diagonalization {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∃ P : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) ℝ, Pᵀ * P = 1 ∧
      dilation A = P * Matrix.diagonal (Sum.elim
        (fun i : Fin m => singularValues A i) (fun j : Fin n => -singularValues A j)) * Pᵀ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let W := Matrix.fromBlocks U 0 0 V
  let r := Real.sqrt (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let R := pairRotation m n r
  have hr : r ^ 2 + r ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have hsq : r ^ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    rw [hsq]
    norm_num
  have hR : Rᵀ * R = 1 := pairRotation_orthogonal m n r hr
  have hRR : R * Rᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hR
  have hW : Wᵀ * W = 1 := by
    simp only [W, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add,
      show Uᵀ * U = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
      show Vᵀ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  have hA : dilation A = W * dilation (rectDiag (singularValues A)) * Wᵀ := by
    simp only [W, dilation, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    rw [← show A = U * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * Vᵀ from h.eq,
      show Aᵀ = V * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) * Uᵀ from
        h.conjTranspose_eq, transpose_rectDiag]
  refine ⟨W * R, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Wᵀ, hW, Matrix.one_mul, hR]
  · have hrot := rectDiag_dilation_mul_pairRotation (singularValues A)
      (fun k hk => singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hk)) r
    have hdiag : dilation (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) =
        R * Matrix.diagonal (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin m => singularValues A i)
          (fun j : Fin n => -singularValues A j)) * Rᵀ := by
      rw [← hrot, Matrix.mul_assoc, hRR, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hA, hdiag, Matrix.transpose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_neg
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_neg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : hA.neg.eigenvalues₀ k = -hA.eigenvalues₀ k.rev
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le hA k.rev
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem hA.neg k S
    · simp only [Fin.val_rev] at hS
      omega
    · intro x hx
      have h := hAS x hx
      simp only [quadForm_def, RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial, Matrix.neg_mulVec,
        dotProduct_neg] at h ⊢
      nlinarith
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul hA k.rev
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem hA.neg k S
    · simp only [Fin.val_rev] at hS
      omega
    · intro x hx
      have h := hAS x hx
      simp only [quadForm_def, RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial, Matrix.neg_mulVec,
        dotProduct_neg] at h ⊢
      nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_ne_zero_mem_inf_of_card_lt_finrank_add
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_inf_of_card_lt_finrank_add
    (S W : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ))
    (h : Fintype.card n < finrank ℝ S + finrank ℝ W) :
    ∃ x : n → ℝ, x ∈ S ∧ x ∈ W ∧ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq S W
  have hsup : finrank ℝ (S ⊔ W : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)) ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    simpa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using (S ⊔ W).finrank_le
  have hpos : 0 < finrank ℝ (S ⊓ W : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)) := by omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hpos
  exact ⟨x, x.property.1, x.property.2, fun h => hx (Subtype.ext h)⟩

name: NLAlib.lt_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem lt_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ))
    (hS : (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank ℝ S) {c : ℝ}
    (hAS : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) < quadForm A x) :
    c < hA.eigenvalues₀ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hAW⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul hA k
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxW, hx0⟩ :=
    exists_ne_zero_mem_inf_of_card_lt_finrank_add S W (by omega)
  have h₁ := hAS x hxS hx0
  have h₂ := hAW x hxW
  have hxpos : 0 < x ⬝ᵥ x :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg x)
      (fun h => hx0 (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h.symm))
  have h : c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) < hA.eigenvalues₀ k * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := h₁.trans_le h₂
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_lt_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_lt_of_forall_mem {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (W : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ))
    (hW : Fintype.card n ≤ finrank ℝ W + k) {c : ℝ}
    (hAW : ∀ x ∈ W, x ≠ 0 → quadForm A x < c * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ k < c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le hA k
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxW, hx0⟩ :=
    exists_ne_zero_mem_inf_of_card_lt_finrank_add S W (by omega)
  have h₁ := hAS x hxS
  have h₂ := hAW x hxW hx0
  have hxpos : 0 < x ⬝ᵥ x :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg x)
      (fun h => hx0 (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h.symm))
  have h : hA.eigenvalues₀ k * (x ⬝ᵥ x) < c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := h₁.trans_lt h₂
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.finrank_le_card_eigenvalues₀_nonneg
statement:
theorem finrank_le_card_eigenvalues₀_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)) (hAS : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ quadForm A x) :
    finrank ℝ S ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd : finrank ℝ S ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    simpa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using S.finrank_le
  let f : Fin (finrank ℝ S) → {i : Fin (Fintype.card n) // 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i} := fun i =>
    ⟨⟨i, i.isLt.trans_le hd⟩,
      Matrix.IsHermitian.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem hA _ S (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt)
        (by simpa [quadForm] using hAS)⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun t => t.val.val) h
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_subtype] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

name: NLAlib.finrank_le_card_eigenvalues₀_pos
statement:
theorem finrank_le_card_eigenvalues₀_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)) (hAS : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → 0 < quadForm A x) :
    finrank ℝ S ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ i).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd : finrank ℝ S ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    simpa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using S.finrank_le
  let f : Fin (finrank ℝ S) → {i : Fin (Fintype.card n) // 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ i} := fun i =>
    ⟨⟨i, i.isLt.trans_le hd⟩,
      lt_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem hA _ S (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt)
        (by simpa only [zero_mul] using hAS)⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun t => t.val.val) h
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_subtype] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_order_and_counting
statement:
theorem eigenvalue_order_and_counting {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (∀ k, hA.neg.eigenvalues₀ k = -hA.eigenvalues₀ k.rev) ∧
    (∀ (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)) (c : ℝ),
      (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank ℝ S →
      (∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) < quadForm A x) → c < hA.eigenvalues₀ k) ∧
    (∀ S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ quadForm A x) →
      finrank ℝ S ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i).card) ∧
    (∀ S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → 0 < quadForm A x) →
      finrank ℝ S ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ i).card)
proof:
:=
  ⟨eigenvalues₀_neg hA,
    fun k S c hS hAS => lt_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem hA k S hS (c := c) hAS,
    finrank_le_card_eigenvalues₀_nonneg hA, finrank_le_card_eigenvalues₀_pos hA⟩

name: NLAlib.singularValues_reindex
statement:
theorem singularValues_reindex {m n p q 𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    singularValues (A.reindex em en) = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k < Fintype.card n
  · have hkq : k < Fintype.card q := by simpa only [← Fintype.card_congr en] using hk
    have hgram : ((A.reindex em en)ᴴ * (A.reindex em en)) = (Aᴴ * A).reindex en en := by
      simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix,
        Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
    have hs : singularValues (A.reindex em en) k ^ 2 = singularValues A k ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ _ ⟨k, hkq⟩,
        sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ _ ⟨k, hk⟩]
      exact (congrFun (eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq _ _ hgram) ⟨k, hkq⟩).trans
        (eigenvalues₀_reindex (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A) en ⟨k, hk⟩)
    nlinarith [singularValues_nonneg (A.reindex em en) k, singularValues_nonneg A k]
  · rw [singularValues_eq_linearMap, singularValues_eq_linearMap,
      LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le, LinearMap.singularValues_of_finrank_le]
    · simpa only [finrank_euclideanSpace] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hk
    · simpa only [finrank_euclideanSpace, ← Fintype.card_congr en] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hk

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, h.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
    h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_diagonal, map_sum]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => singularValues A k ^ 2)]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro k hk; simp at hk ⊢; omega
  · intro k _ hk
    rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A
      (by simp only [Finset.mem_range, min_le_iff] at hk ⊢; omega)]; simp

name: NLAlib.mul_sortedEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_sortedEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A*sortedEigenframe hA=sortedEigenframe hA*Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (sortedEigenframe hA*Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues₀*(sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ)*sortedEigenframe hA :=
      congrArg (fun T => T*sortedEigenframe hA) (eq_sortedEigenframe_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA)
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, (show (sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ * sortedEigenframe hA = 1 from hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe hA),
      Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.mul_submatrix_cols_eq_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_submatrix_cols_eq_mul_diagonal {N r : Type*} [Fintype N] [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq r] (U : Matrix n N ℝ) (d : N → ℝ)
    (e : r → N) (hU : A*U=U*Matrix.diagonal d) :
    A*U.submatrix id e=U.submatrix id e*Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : A*U.submatrix id e=(A*U).submatrix id e := by
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv A U id (Equiv.refl n) e
  rw [hmul, hU]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Function.comp_apply, id_eq]

name: NLAlib.mul_topEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_topEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    A*topEigenframe hA hk=topEigenframe hA hk*
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE hk i))
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_submatrix_cols_eq_mul_diagonal (sortedEigenframe hA) hA.eigenvalues₀
    (Fin.castLEEmb hk) (mul_sortedEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal hA)

name: NLAlib.mul_complementaryEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_complementaryEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    A*complementaryEigenframe hA hk=complementaryEigenframe hA hk*
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n-k) =>
        hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val+k, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := mul_submatrix_cols_eq_mul_diagonal (sortedEigenframe hA) hA.eigenvalues₀
    (Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb (Nat.sub_le (Fintype.card n) k)) (mul_sortedEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal hA)
  change A*complementaryEigenframe hA hk=complementaryEigenframe hA hk*Matrix.diagonal _ at hh
  have heq : (hA.eigenvalues₀ ∘ (Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb (Nat.sub_le (Fintype.card n) k)))=
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n-k) => hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val+k, by omega⟩) := by
    funext i
    apply congrArg hA.eigenvalues₀
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb, Nat.sub_sub_self hk]
  rw [heq] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_ite_ge_eq_sum_suffix
statement:
theorem sum_fin_ite_ge_eq_sum_suffix {N k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ N) (f : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin N, if k ≤ i.val then f i else 0)=
      ∑ j : Fin (N-k), f ⟨j.val+k, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => (⟨j.val+k, by omega⟩ : Fin N))
  · intro j _
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    omega
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    apply Fin.ext
    have hh := congrArg Fin.val hij
    change i.val+k=j.val+k at hh
    omega
  · intro i hi
    have hik : k ≤ i.val := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    refine ⟨⟨i.val-k, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    change i.val-k+k=i.val
    omega
  · intro j _
    rfl

name: NLAlib.topEigenframe_projector_add_complementary_eq_one
statement:
theorem topEigenframe_projector_add_complementary_eq_one (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    topEigenframe hA hk*(topEigenframe hA hk)ᵀ+
      complementaryEigenframe hA hk*(complementaryEigenframe hA hk)ᵀ=1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sortedEigenframe_mul_transpose_eq_one hA]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, topEigenframe,
    complementaryEigenframe, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
  have heq : (fun a : Fin (Fintype.card n-k) =>
      (Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb (Nat.sub_le (Fintype.card n) k)) a)=
      (fun a => (⟨a.val+k, by omega⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card n))) := by
    funext a
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb, Nat.sub_sub_self hk]
  simp_rw [heq]
  change (∑ a : Fin k, sortedEigenframe hA i (Fin.castLE hk a)*sortedEigenframe hA j (Fin.castLE hk a))+
    (∑ a : Fin (Fintype.card n-k), sortedEigenframe hA i ⟨a.val+k, by omega⟩*
      sortedEigenframe hA j ⟨a.val+k, by omega⟩)=_
  have hp := sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_prefix hk (fun a => sortedEigenframe hA i a*sortedEigenframe hA j a)
  have hs := sum_fin_ite_ge_eq_sum_suffix hk (fun a => sortedEigenframe hA i a*sortedEigenframe hA j a)
  rw [← hp, ← hs, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : a.val<k
  · have hnot : ¬ k ≤ a.val := by omega
    simp [ha, hnot]
  · have hge : k ≤ a.val := by omega
    simp [ha, hge]

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_eigenvalues_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_eq_eigenvalues_diagonal {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (d : r → ℝ) (i : r) :
    ∃ j, d j=(Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal d).eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal d).eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i
  rwa [spectrum_diagonal] at hh

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq {n 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [RCLike 𝕜] {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (h : A = B) : hA.eigenvalues₀ = hB.eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  subst B
  rfl

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_eq_of_charpoly_eq
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_eq_of_charpoly_eq {n 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (h : A.charpoly = B.charpoly) : hA.eigenvalues₀ = hB.eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ofFn_inj.mp
  rw [← hA.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀,
    ← hB.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀, h]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_reindex
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_reindex {n p 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype p]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [RCLike 𝕜] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (e : n ≃ p) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    (hA.reindex e).eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_congr e) i) = hA.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  have hl : List.ofFn (hA.reindex e).eigenvalues₀ = List.ofFn hA.eigenvalues₀ := by
    rw [← (hA.reindex e).sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀,
      ← hA.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀, Matrix.charpoly_reindex]
  have hc := List.ofFn_congr (Fintype.card_congr e) hA.eigenvalues₀
  have hf := List.ofFn_inj.mp (hl.trans hc)
  simpa only [Fin.cast] using congrFun hf (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_congr e) i)

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_map_ofReal {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hC : (A.map Complex.ofReal).IsHermitian) :
    hC.eigenvalues₀ = hA.eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = A.charpoly.map Complex.ofRealHom :=
    Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
  apply List.ofFn_inj.mp
  rw [← hC.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀,
    ← hA.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀, hmap,
    hA.splits_charpoly.roots_map]
  simp only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, RCLike.re_to_real]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.finrank_ker_mulVecLin_transpose_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_mulVecLin_transpose_eq (M : Matrix n n K) :
    finrank K (LinearMap.ker Mᵀ.mulVecLin) = finrank K (LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin)
proof:
:= by
  have hM := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker M.mulVecLin
  have hT := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker Mᵀ.mulVecLin
  change M.rank + _ = _ at hM
  change Mᵀ.rank + _ = _ at hT
  rw [Matrix.rank_transpose] at hT
  omega

name: NLAlib.adjugate_ne_zero_of_finrank_ker_eq_one
statement:
theorem adjugate_ne_zero_of_finrank_ker_eq_one (M : Matrix n n K)
    (hdim : finrank K (LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin) = 1) : M.adjugate ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker M.mulVecLin
  change M.rank + finrank K (LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin) = finrank K (n → K) at hr
  rw [hdim, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hr
  have hnull : Fintype.card n - M.rank = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨V, U, e, hV, hU, hM⟩ := Matrix.exists_rank_normal_form M
  let j : Fin M.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - M.rank) := Sum.inr ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let d : Fin M.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - M.rank) → K := Sum.elim (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 0)
  have hblock : (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin M.rank) (Fin M.rank) K) 0 0
      (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n - M.rank)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - M.rank)) K)) =
      Matrix.diagonal d := by
    simpa only [Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_zero] using
      Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal (fun _ : Fin M.rank => (1 : K))
        (fun _ : Fin (Fintype.card n - M.rank) => (0 : K))
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal d).adjugate j j = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro k hk
    have hkj : k ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
    cases k with
    | inl k => rfl
    | inr k =>
      exfalso
      apply hkj
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      have := k.isLt
      dsimp [j]
      omega
  intro hzero
  have hadj : (V * M * U).adjugate = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul_distrib, Matrix.adjugate_mul_distrib, hzero,
      Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero]
  rw [hM, hblock, Matrix.adjugate_submatrix_equiv_self] at hadj
  have hj := congrArg (fun N => N (e.symm j) (e.symm j)) hadj
  have hj' : (Matrix.diagonal d).adjugate j j = 0 := by simpa using hj
  exact one_ne_zero (hdiag.symm.trans hj')

name: NLAlib.exists_adjugate_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_finrank_ker_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_adjugate_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_finrank_ker_eq_one
    (M : Matrix n n K) {x y : n → K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hMx : M *ᵥ x = 0) (hyM : y ᵥ* M = 0)
    (hdim : finrank K (LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin) = 1) :
    ∃ γ : K, γ ≠ 0 ∧ M.adjugate = γ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : M.det = 0 := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp ⟨x, hx, hMx⟩
  have hspan : K ∙ x = LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem x _).mpr hMx)
      (by rw [finrank_span_singleton hx, hdim])
  have hspanT : K ∙ y = LinearMap.ker Mᵀ.mulVecLin :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
      ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem y _).mpr (by
        simpa only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_transpose] using hyM))
      (by rw [finrank_span_singleton hy, finrank_ker_mulVecLin_transpose_eq, hdim])
  have hMadj : M * M.adjugate = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mul_adjugate, hdet, zero_smul]
  have hadjM : M.adjugate * M = 0 := by rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul, hdet, zero_smul]
  have hcols (j : n) : ∃ c : K, c • x = Matrix.col M.adjugate j := by
    have hk : Matrix.col M.adjugate j ∈ LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin := by
      funext i
      exact congrArg (fun N : Matrix n n K => N i j) hMadj
    rw [← hspan] at hk
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hk
  choose c hc using hcols
  have hadj : M.adjugate = Matrix.vecMulVec x c := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrFun (hc j) i
    simpa only [Matrix.col_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_comm] using h.symm
  have hcM : c ᵥ* M = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
    rw [hadj, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul] at hadjM
    funext j
    have h := congrArg (fun N : Matrix n n K => N i j) hadjM
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hi
  have hcKer : c ∈ LinearMap.ker Mᵀ.mulVecLin := by
    simpa only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_transpose] using hcM
  rw [← hspanT] at hcKer
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hcKer
  have hform : M.adjugate = γ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y := by
    rw [hadj, ← hγ, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul]
  refine ⟨γ, ?_, hform⟩
  intro hzero
  apply adjugate_ne_zero_of_finrank_ker_eq_one M hdim
  rw [hform, hzero, zero_smul]

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly_of_strictMono
    {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hd : StrictMono d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) :
    ∃ (v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ), a = (∑ i, b i) - (∑ i, d i) ∧
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
          ∏ j, (X - C (b j))
proof:
:= by
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∏ i, (X - C (d i))
  let q : ℝ[X] := ∏ i, (X - C (b i))
  let a : ℝ := (∑ i, b i) - (∑ i, d i)
  let w (j : Fin n) : ℝ := -q.eval (d j) /
    (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (d j - d l))
  have hw (j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ w j := by
    simpa [w, q, eval_prod] using
      neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_bordered_interlacing d b hd hb h j
  let v (j : Fin n) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (w j)
  have hv (j : Fin n) : (v j) ^ 2 = w j := Real.sq_sqrt (hw j)
  have hp : p.Monic := monic_prod_X_sub_C _ _
  have hq : q.Monic := monic_prod_X_sub_C _ _
  have hpn : p.natDegree = n := by simp [p]
  have hqn : q.natDegree = n + 1 := by simp [q]
  have hbase : ((X - C a) * p).Monic := (monic_X_sub_C a).mul hp
  have hbn : ((X - C a) * p).natDegree = n + 1 := by
    rw [natDegree_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) hp.ne_zero, natDegree_X_sub_C, hpn]
    omega
  have hc : q.nextCoeff = ((X - C a) * p).nextCoeff := by
    rw [(monic_X_sub_C a).nextCoeff_mul hp, nextCoeff_X_sub_C]
    simp only [p, q, prod_X_sub_C_nextCoeff]
    dsimp only [a]
    ring
  have hdeg : (q - (X - C a) * p).degree < (Fintype.card (Fin n) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    simpa using degree_sub_lt_of_monic_nextCoeff_eq hq hbase hqn hbn hc
  have hpzero (j : Fin n) : p.eval (d j) = 0 := by
    simp only [p, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (sub_self _)
  have hpoly := polynomial_eq_base_sub_residue_sum d hd.injective q
    ((X - C a) * p) hdeg (fun j => by rw [eval_mul, hpzero, mul_zero])
  refine ⟨v, a, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [charpoly_fromBlocks_diagonal_replicate]
  simp only [hv]
  exact hpoly.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_strictMono
    {n : ℕ} (d b : Fin n → ℝ) (hd : StrictMono d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      ∏ j, (X - C (b j))
proof:
:= by
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∏ i, (X - C (d i))
  let q : ℝ[X] := ∏ i, (X - C (b i))
  let w (j : Fin n) : ℝ := -q.eval (d j) /
    (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (d j - d l))
  have hw (j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ w j := by
    simpa [w, q, eval_prod] using
      neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_rank_one_interlacing d b hd hb hlo hhi j
  let v (j : Fin n) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (w j)
  have hv (j : Fin n) : (v j) ^ 2 = w j := Real.sq_sqrt (hw j)
  have hp : p.Monic := monic_prod_X_sub_C _ _
  have hq : q.Monic := monic_prod_X_sub_C _ _
  have hpn : p.natDegree = n := by simp [p]
  have hqn : q.natDegree = n := by simp [q]
  have hdeg : (q - p).degree < (Fintype.card (Fin n) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    simpa using degree_sub_lt_of_monic_natDegree_eq hq hp hqn hpn
  have hpzero (j : Fin n) : p.eval (d j) = 0 := by
    simp only [p, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (sub_self _)
  have hpoly := polynomial_eq_base_sub_residue_sum d hd.injective q p hdeg hpzero
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  rw [charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec]
  simp only [hv]
  exact hpoly.symm

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.posSemidef_sub_lambdaMin_smul_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.posSemidef_sub_lambdaMin_smul_one [Nonempty n]
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    (H - (lambdaMin H : 𝕜) • 1).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hUU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hD : H = U * diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [U, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Function.comp_def] using hH.spectral_theorem
  have hmin (i : n) : lambdaMin H ≤ hH.eigenvalues i := by
    exact csInf_le (Set.toFinite (spectrum ℝ H)).bddBelow (hH.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
  have hpos : (diagonal (fun i => ((hH.eigenvalues i - lambdaMin H : ℝ) : 𝕜))).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal (fun i => by
      change (0 : 𝕜) ≤ ((hH.eigenvalues i - lambdaMin H : ℝ) : 𝕜)
      exact_mod_cast sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin i))
  have he : H - (lambdaMin H : 𝕜) • 1 =
      U * diagonal (fun i => ((hH.eigenvalues i - lambdaMin H : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    rw [show diagonal (fun i => ((hH.eigenvalues i - lambdaMin H : ℝ) : 𝕜)) =
        diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) - (lambdaMin H : 𝕜) • 1 by
          ext i j; by_cases hij : i = j <;>
            simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hij, smul_eq_mul,
              RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one, hUU, ← hD]
  rw [he]
  exact hpos.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_unit_lambdaMin_eigenvector
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_unit_lambdaMin_eigenvector [Nonempty n]
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ v : n → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧ H *ᵥ v = (lambdaMin H : 𝕜) • v
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let j : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt Fintype.card_pos⟩
  have he : hH.eigenvalues (e j) = lambdaMin H := by
    rw [lambdaMin_eq_eigenvalues₀_last hH]
    simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, j]
  refine ⟨⇑(hH.eigenvectorBasis (e j)), hH.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.norm_eq_one _, ?_⟩
  have hh := hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis (e j)
  rw [he] at hh
  ext i
  simpa only [Pi.smul_apply, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, smul_eq_mul] using congrFun hh i

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.posDef_sub_smul_one_of_lt_lambdaMin
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.posDef_sub_smul_one_of_lt_lambdaMin [Nonempty n]
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) {a : ℝ} (ha : a < lambdaMin H) :
    (H - (a : 𝕜) • 1).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hp := Matrix.PosDef.posSemidef_add hH.posSemidef_sub_lambdaMin_smul_one
    (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (sub_pos.mpr ha))
  convert hp using 1
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_one, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, map_sub]
    ring
  · simp [Matrix.one_apply, hij]

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_gram_sub_lambdaMin
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_gram_sub_lambdaMin (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm (Cᴴ * C - (lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) : 𝕜) • 1) v) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 - lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul,
    norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  rw [← quadForm, quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_gram_le_norm_mulVec_sq
statement:
theorem lambdaMin_gram_le_norm_mulVec_sq [Nonempty n] (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {v : n → 𝕜} (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self C).posSemidef_sub_lambdaMin_smul_one
  have hn := hp.re_quadForm_nonneg v
  rw [re_quadForm_gram_sub_lambdaMin, hv, one_pow, mul_one] at hn
  linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff
statement:
theorem norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff [Nonempty n] (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {v : n → 𝕜} (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 = lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) ↔
      (Cᴴ * C) *ᵥ v = (lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) : 𝕜) • v
proof:
:= by
  let H := Cᴴ * C - (lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) : 𝕜) • 1
  have hp : H.PosSemidef :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self C).posSemidef_sub_lambdaMin_smul_one
  have he : RCLike.re (quadForm H v) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 - lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) := by
    rw [re_quadForm_gram_sub_lambdaMin, hv, one_pow, mul_one]
  have hzero : quadForm H v = 0 ↔ RCLike.re (quadForm H v) = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro hh; rw [hh, map_zero]
    · intro hh; rw [← hp.isHermitian.ofReal_re_quadForm v, hh, RCLike.ofReal_zero]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← he, ← hzero, quadForm,
    hp.dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff]
  simp only [H, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_eq_zero]

name: NLAlib.dense_exists_injective_charpoly_factors_complex
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (dense_separable_charpoly (n := n) (K := ℂ)).mono
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨U, T, _, _, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  refine ⟨fun i => T i i, ?_, hchar⟩
  apply Polynomial.separable_prod_X_sub_C_iff.mp

name: NLAlib.dense_exists_injective_charpoly_factors_real
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (dense_separable_charpoly (n := n) (K := ℝ)).mono
  intro A hA
  have hcharMap : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = Polynomial.map Complex.ofRealHom A.charpoly :=
    Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
  have hsep : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly.Separable := by
    rw [hcharMap]
    exact hA.map
  obtain ⟨U, T, _, _, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  refine ⟨fun i => T i i, ?_, hchar⟩
  apply Polynomial.separable_prod_X_sub_C_iff.mp
  rw [← hchar]
  exact hsep

name: NLAlib.map_ofReal_matrix_pow
statement:
theorem map_ofReal_matrix_pow (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (A ^ k).map Complex.ofReal = (A.map Complex.ofReal) ^ k
proof:
:=
  map_pow Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix A k

name: NLAlib.tendsto_real_matrix_pow_zero_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_real_matrix_pow_zero_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔
      spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M.map Complex.ofReal) := by fun_prop
  have hre : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M.map Complex.re) := by fun_prop
  have hback (k : ℕ) : ((A.map Complex.ofReal) ^ k).map Complex.re = A ^ k := by
    rw [← map_ofReal_matrix_pow]
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro hA
    apply spectralRadius_lt_one_of_tendsto_matrix_pow_zero
    have h := hcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hA
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, map_ofReal_matrix_pow, Matrix.map_zero _ Complex.ofReal_zero] using h
  · intro hA
    have h := hre.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hback, Matrix.map_zero _ Complex.zero_re] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_prefix_specNorm_real_matrix_pow_le_complex_spectralRadius_add
statement:
theorem exists_prefix_specNorm_real_matrix_pow_le_complex_spectralRadius_add
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ,
      specNorm (A ^ k) ≤
        matrixPowerBoundConstant (A.map Complex.ofReal)
          ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal + ε) N *
            ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal + ε) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_spectralRadius_add (A.map Complex.ofReal) hε
  refine ⟨N, fun k => ?_⟩
  have hh : specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ ‖(A ^ k).map Complex.ofReal‖ :=
    (specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (A ^ k)).trans_eq (specNorm_eq_norm _)
  rw [map_ofReal_matrix_pow] at hh
  exact hh.trans (hN k)

name: NLAlib.summable_real_matrix_pow_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_real_matrix_pow_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) < 1) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  let C := A.map Complex.ofReal
  have hρ : (spectralRadius ℂ C).toReal < 1 :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top C) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hA
  let r : ℝ := ((spectralRadius ℂ C).toReal + 1) / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hρr : (spectralRadius ℂ C).toReal < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_growth C hr hρr
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr.le hr1).mul_left
    (matrixPowerBoundConstant C r N))
  intro k
  rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
  have hh : specNorm (A ^ k) ≤ ‖(A ^ k).map Complex.ofReal‖ :=
    (specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (A ^ k)).trans_eq (specNorm_eq_norm _)
  rw [map_ofReal_matrix_pow] at hh
  exact hh.trans (hN k)

name: NLAlib.hasSum_real_matrix_pow_inv_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasSum_real_matrix_pow_inv_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) < 1) : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => A ^ k) (1 - A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hs := summable_real_matrix_pow_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one hA
  have hp := (tendsto_real_matrix_pow_zero_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one A).mpr hA
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, A ^ k) * (1 - A))
      atTop (𝓝 ((∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) * (1 - A))) :=
    hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.mul_const (1 - A)
  have hright : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, A ^ k) * (1 - A))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simp only [geom_sum_mul_neg]
    simpa only [sub_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub hp
  have hInv : (∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) * (1 - A) = 1 := tendsto_nhds_unique hleft hright
  have hsum : (∑' k : ℕ, A ^ k) = (1 - A)⁻¹ := (Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hInv).symm
  rw [← hsum]
  exact hs.hasSum

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.gram_pow_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal fun i => singularValues A i ^ 2
  have hM : (A * Aᵀ) * U = U * D := by
    rw [show A * Aᵀ = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin m => singularValues A i ^ 2) * Uᵀ from
      h.mul_conjTranspose_self]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [show Uᵀ * U = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hp := pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hM q
  have hdiag : D ^ q * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) =
      rectDiag (fun j => singularValues A j ^ (2 * q + 1)) := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_pow]
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply, rectDiag_apply]
    split_ifs with hij
    · simp only [← pow_mul, ← pow_succ]
    · simp
  conv_lhs => arg 2; rw [h.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hp, Matrix.mul_assoc U, hdiag]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_gram_pow_mul
statement:
theorem singularValues_gram_pow_mul (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (q j : ℕ) :
    singularValues ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A) j = singularValues A j ^ (2 * q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < min m n
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    exact singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul h.conjTranspose_mul_left
      h.conjTranspose_mul_right (fun i => pow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) _)
      (fun a b hab => pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg A b)
        (singularValues_antitone A hab) _) (h.gram_pow_mul_eq q) hj
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using not_lt.mp hj),
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using not_lt.mp hj),
      zero_pow (by omega)]

name: NLAlib.rank_gram_pow_mul
statement:
theorem rank_gram_pow_mul (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_eq_card_singularValues_ne_zero, rank_eq_card_singularValues_ne_zero]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro j _
  rw [singularValues_gram_pow_mul]
  exact pow_ne_zero_iff (by omega)

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_insertNth
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_insertNth {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec (p.insertNth 0 v) (p.insertNth 0 v)).charpoly =
      (X - C (d p)) *
        (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ p.succAbove) + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let A := Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec (p.insertNth 0 v) (p.insertNth 0 v)
  let e := finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv p
  have hcross : ∀ j : Fin n, A (e (Sum.inl 0)) (e (Sum.inr j)) = 0 ∧
      A (e (Sum.inr j)) (e (Sum.inl 0)) = 0 := by
    intro j
    simp [A, e, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Fin.ne_succAbove,
      Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hsub : A.submatrix (fun j => e (Sum.inr j)) (fun j => e (Sum.inr j)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ p.succAbove) + Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
    ext i j
    simp [A, e, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Function.comp_def]
  have h := charpoly_eq_mul_of_isolated_equiv A e hcross
  rw [hsub] at h
  simpa only [A, e, finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv_inl, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Fin.insertNth_apply_same,
    zero_mul, add_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.charpoly_bordered_diagonal_insertNth
statement:
theorem charpoly_bordered_diagonal_insertNth {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d)
      (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) (p.insertNth 0 v))
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) (p.insertNth 0 v))
      (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
      (X - C (d p)) *
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ p.succAbove))
          (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v)
          (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let A := Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d)
    (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) (p.insertNth 0 v))
    (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) (p.insertNth 0 v)) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))
  let e : Fin 1 ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1 :=
    (Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin 1) (Fin n) (Fin 1)).symm.trans
      (Equiv.sumCongr (finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv p) (Equiv.refl (Fin 1)))
  have he0 : e (Sum.inl 0) = Sum.inl p := rfl
  have hel (i : Fin n) : e (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) = Sum.inl (p.succAbove i) := rfl
  have her (i : Fin 1) : e (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) = Sum.inr i := rfl
  have hcross : ∀ j : Fin n ⊕ Fin 1, A (e (Sum.inl 0)) (e (Sum.inr j)) = 0 ∧
      A (e (Sum.inr j)) (e (Sum.inl 0)) = 0 := by
    intro j
    cases j with
    | inl j => simp [he0, hel, A, Fin.ne_succAbove, Fin.succAbove_ne]
    | inr j => simp [he0, her, A]
  have hsub : A.submatrix (fun j => e (Sum.inr j)) (fun j => e (Sum.inr j)) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ p.succAbove))
        (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, hel, her, A, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Function.comp_def]
  have h := charpoly_eq_mul_of_isolated_equiv A e hcross
  rw [hsub] at h
  simpa only [he0, A, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] using h

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_normal_upper_fromBlocks
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ => M.toBlocks₁₁.trace) hM
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
    Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₁, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.mul_zero,
    Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, Matrix.trace_add] at h
  have htr : (C * Cᴴ).trace = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm A Aᴴ] at h
    exact add_left_cancel (by simpa only [add_zero] using h)
  have hsq : frobSq C = 0 := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, htr]
    rfl
  exact (frobSq_eq_zero_iff C).mp hsq

name: NLAlib.upper_fromBlocks_eq_diagonal_of_normal
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_zero_of_normal_upper_fromBlocks hM]

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly {n : ℕ} (d b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b) (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      ∏ j, (X - C (b j))
proof:
:= by
  apply rank_one_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
    (fun _ d b hd hb hlo hhi => exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_strictMono d b hd hb hlo hhi)
    n d b hd hb hlo
  exact interlacing_upper_of_adjacent d b hd hhi

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
        ∏ j, (X - C (b j))
proof:
:= by
  apply bordered_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases ?_ n d b hd hb h
  intro k d b hd hb h
  obtain ⟨v, a, _, hchar⟩ := exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly_of_strictMono d b hd hb h
  exact ⟨v, a, hchar⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_with_sum_sq
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_with_sum_sq {n : ℕ}
    (d b : Fin n → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b) (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ j, (X - C (b j))) ∧ (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_charpoly d b hd hb hlo hhi
  exact ⟨v, hv, by simpa only [Matrix.trace_diagonal] using
    sum_sq_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_add_vecMulVec (Matrix.diagonal d) v b hv⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly_with_trace
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly_with_trace {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
        (∏ j, (X - C (b j))) ∧ a = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, a, hchar⟩ := exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly d b hd hb h
  exact ⟨v, a, hchar, by simpa only [Matrix.trace_diagonal] using
    border_eq_sum_sub_trace_of_charpoly_eq_prod (Matrix.diagonal d) v a b hchar⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_two_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_two_eq_diagonal (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    ∃ U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols U ∧
      (Uᵀ * A * U) 0 0 = (Uᵀ * A * U) 1 1
proof:
:= by
  let H := A + Aᵀ
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := by
    change Hᵀ = H
    simp only [H, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_transpose, add_comm]
  let V : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols V := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hH
  have hVH : Vᵀ * H * V = Matrix.diagonal hH.eigenvalues := by
    calc
      _ = Vᵀ * (V * Matrix.diagonal hH.eigenvalues * Vᵀ) * V :=
        congrArg (fun M => Vᵀ * M * V) (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hH)
      _ = (Vᵀ * V) * Matrix.diagonal hH.eigenvalues * (Vᵀ * V) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [(show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hV), Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  let B := Vᵀ * A * V
  have hB : B + Bᵀ = Matrix.diagonal hH.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [H, B, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hVH
  have hOff : B 0 1 + B 1 0 = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ => M 0 1) hB
    simpa using h
  let r : ℝ := (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹
  have hr : r * r = 1 / 2 := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
    dsimp [r]
    rw [← mul_inv_rev, hs]
    norm_num
  let R : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![r, r; -r, r]
  have hR : HasOrthonormalCols R := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [R, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> nlinarith [hr]
  refine ⟨V * R, hV.mul hR, ?_⟩
  have hRB : (V * R)ᵀ * A * (V * R) = Rᵀ * B * R := by
    simp only [B, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hRB]
  simp only [R, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  nlinarith [hOff]

name: NLAlib.eq_of_hasEigenvalue_restrict_maxGenEigenspace
statement:
theorem eq_of_hasEigenvalue_restrict_maxGenEigenspace
    {K E : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E]
    (f : Module.End K E) (μ : K)
    (hpres : Set.MapsTo f (f.maxGenEigenspace μ) (f.maxGenEigenspace μ))
    {ν : K} (hν : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (f.restrict hpres) ν) : ν = μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxne⟩ := hν.exists_hasEigenvector
  have heig : f x.val = ν • x.val :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx)
  have hxν : x.val ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace ν :=
    Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr heig)
  by_contra hne
  have hz : x.val = 0 := by
    have hi : x.val ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace ν ⊓ f.maxGenEigenspace μ := ⟨hxν, x.property⟩
    rw [(f.disjoint_genEigenspace hne ⊤ ⊤).eq_bot] at hi
    exact hi
  exact hxne (Subtype.ext hz)

name: NLAlib.exists_similarity_primary_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem exists_similarity_primary_upperTriangular
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ (d : ℂ → ℕ) (e : (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (d μ)) ≃ n)
      (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (T : ∀ μ : ℂ, Matrix (Fin (d μ)) (Fin (d μ)) ℂ),
      IsUnit S ∧ (S⁻¹ * A * S).submatrix e e = Matrix.blockDiagonal' T ∧
      (∀ μ, (T μ).IsUpperTriangular) ∧ (∀ μ i, T μ i i = μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℂ n
  let f : Module.End ℂ E := A.toEuclideanLin
  let W (μ : ℂ) := f.maxGenEigenspace μ
  have hpres (μ : ℂ) : Set.MapsTo f (W μ) (W μ) :=
    Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (Commute.refl f) μ
  let C (μ : ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (W μ) := f.restrict (hpres μ)
  let d (μ : ℂ) := Module.finrank ℂ (W μ)
  choose b hb using fun μ : ℂ =>
    exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_triangular (E := W μ) (d μ) (C μ) rfl
  let T (μ : ℂ) : Matrix (Fin (d μ)) (Fin (d μ)) ℂ :=
    (C μ).toMatrix (b μ).toBasis (b μ).toBasis
  have htri (μ : ℂ) : (T μ).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    simpa only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply] using hb μ i j hij
  have hdiag (μ : ℂ) (i : Fin (d μ)) : T μ i i = μ := by
    have hroot : (T μ).charpoly.IsRoot (T μ i i) := by
      rw [Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ (htri μ)]
      simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simp
    have hν : (C μ).HasEigenvalue (T μ i i) := by
      apply (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_isRoot_charpoly _ _).mpr
      simpa only [T, LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix] using hroot
    exact eq_of_hasEigenvalue_restrict_maxGenEigenspace f μ (hpres μ) hν
  have hsum : DirectSum.IsInternal W :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
      f.independent_maxGenEigenspace (Module.End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top f)
  let c := hsum.collectedBasis (fun μ => (b μ).toBasis)
  let : Fintype (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (d μ)) := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex c
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (d μ)) = Fintype.card n := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis c, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  let e : (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (d μ)) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard
  let q := c.reindex e
  let p := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toBasis
  let S := p.toMatrix q
  let := Basis.invertibleToMatrix p q
  have hS : IsUnit S := isUnit_of_invertible S
  have hSinv : S⁻¹ = q.toMatrix p := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv (Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip q p)
  have hM : S⁻¹ * A * S = f.toMatrix q q := by
    have hstd : f.toMatrix p p = A := LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin p p A
    rw [hSinv]
    nth_rw 1 [← hstd]
    exact basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix q p q p f
  have hblock : f.toMatrix c c = Matrix.blockDiagonal' T := by
    ext ⟨μ, i⟩ ⟨ν, j⟩
    have hc : c ⟨ν, j⟩ = (b ν j : E) := by
      simp only [c, DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedBasis_coe, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis]
    have hfc : f (c ⟨ν, j⟩) ∈ W ν := by rw [hc]; exact hpres ν (b ν j).property
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    by_cases hμν : μ = ν
    · subst ν
      rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
      change (hsum.collectedBasis (fun μ => (b μ).toBasis)).repr (f (c ⟨μ, j⟩)) ⟨μ, i⟩ = _
      rw [hsum.collectedBasis_repr_of_mem _ hfc]
      simpa only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis] using
        congrArg (fun z : W μ => (b μ).toBasis.repr z i)
        (show (⟨f (c ⟨μ, j⟩), hfc⟩ : W μ) = C μ (b μ j) from
          Subtype.ext (congrArg f hc))
    · rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne T i j hμν]
      exact hsum.collectedBasis_repr_of_mem_ne _ (Ne.symm hμν) hfc
  refine ⟨d, e, S, T, hS, ?_, htri, hdiag⟩
  rw [hM]
  have hcoords : (f.toMatrix q q).submatrix e e = f.toMatrix c c := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, q, Basis.reindex_apply,
      Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact hcoords.trans hblock

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_unitary_schur_triangularization_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_unitary_schur_triangularization_with_charpoly
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (A a) (A b))
    (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) (a₀ : ι) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hchar : (A a₀).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ, ∃ T : ι → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ a, A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
        (∀ i j, order.symm j < order.symm i → T a i j = 0) ∧
        (A a).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (T a i i))) ∧
      ∀ i, T a₀ i i = d i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f (a : ι) : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := (A a).toEuclideanLin
  have hfcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (f a) (f b) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact (hcomm hab).map (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℂ n)).toRingHom
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ
  have hstd (a : ι) : (f a).toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = A a :=
    LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis (A a)
  have hfchar : (f a₀).charpoly = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (X - C (d (order i))) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix (f a₀) c.toBasis, hstd, hchar]
    exact (order.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (d i))).symm
  obtain ⟨b₀, htri₀, hdiag₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_simultaneous_upper_triangular_with_charpoly
    (Fintype.card n) f hfcomm (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ)) a₀ (fun i => d (order i)) hfchar
  let b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := b₀.reindex order
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  let T (a : ι) : Matrix n n ℂ := (f a).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hUtU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hback : b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    calc
      b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
          b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) := by
            rw [hUU, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
        change (b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis) * _ = _
        rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨U, T, fun a => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hA : A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      have h := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
        c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis (f a)
      rw [hback, hstd] at h
      exact h.symm
    have htri : ∀ i j, order.symm j < order.symm i → T a i j = 0 := by
      intro i j hij
      simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
      simpa only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using htri₀ a (order.symm i) (order.symm j) hij
    have hTfin : ((T a).submatrix order order).IsUpperTriangular := by
      intro i j hij
      exact htri (order i) (order j) (by simpa using hij)
    have hTchar : (T a).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (T a i i)) := by
      calc
        (T a).charpoly = ((T a).submatrix order order).charpoly :=
          (Matrix.charpoly_reindex order.symm (T a)).symm
        _ = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (X - C (T a (order i) (order i))) :=
          Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ hTfin
        _ = _ := order.prod_comp (fun i => X - C (T a i i))
    refine ⟨hA, htri, ?_⟩
    rw [hA, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUtU, Matrix.one_mul, hTchar]
  · intro i
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hdiag₀ (order.symm i)

name: CStarMatrix.spectrum_real_neg_rectangularDilation
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_neg_rectangularDilation (Y : Matrix m n A) :
    spectrum ℝ (-rectangularDilation Y) = spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y)
proof:
:= by
  let S : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A := blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (1, -1)
  have hSS : S * S = 1 := by
    change blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (1, -1) * blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (1, -1) = 1
    rw [← map_mul]
    norm_num
    change blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (1 : CStarMatrix m m A × CStarMatrix n n A) = 1
    exact map_one _
  let u : (CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A)ˣ := ⟨S, S, hSS, hSS⟩
  have hconj : (u : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A) * rectangularDilation Y *
      (↑u⁻¹ : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A) = -rectangularDilation Y := by
    change (Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 (-1) : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A) * Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Y Yᴴ 0 *
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 (-1) = -Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Y Yᴴ 0
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, zero_add, add_zero,
      neg_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_neg]
  rw [← hconj]
  exact spectrum.units_conjugate

name: CStarMatrix.mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_neg_iff
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_neg_iff (Y : Matrix m n A) (r : ℝ) :
    -r ∈ spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y) ↔ r ∈ spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun K : Set ℝ => -r ∈ K) (spectrum_real_neg_rectangularDilation Y)
  rw [← spectrum.neg_eq, Set.mem_neg, neg_neg] at h
  exact iff_of_eq h.symm

name: CStarMatrix.mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram
    (Y : Matrix m n A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    r ∈ spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y) ↔
      r ^ 2 ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hsq : r ^ 2 ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)) ∪
        spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Yᴴ * Y)) := by
      rw [← sq_image_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation]
      exact ⟨r, h, rfl⟩
    rcases hsq with hsq | hsq
    · exact hsq
    · exact (mem_spectrum_real_rowGram_iff_columnGram_of_ne_zero Y
        (ne_of_gt (sq_pos_of_pos hr))).mpr hsq
  · intro h
    have him : r ^ 2 ∈ (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) '' spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y) := by
      rw [sq_image_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation]
      exact Or.inl h
    rcases him with ⟨t, ht, htr⟩
    have heq : t = r ∨ t = -r := by
      have : (t - r) * (t + r) = 0 := by nlinarith only [htr]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
      · exact Or.inr (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h)
    rcases heq with heq | heq
    · simpa only [heq] using ht
    · rw [heq] at ht
      exact (mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_neg_iff Y r).mp ht

name: CStarMatrix.sqrt_mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff
statement:
theorem sqrt_mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff
    (Y : Matrix m n A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Real.sqrt r ∈ spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y) ↔
      r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram Y (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hr),
    Real.sq_sqrt hr.le]

name: NLAlib.not_mem_spectrum_submatrix_of_isolated_coordinate_of_simple
statement:
theorem not_mem_spectrum_submatrix_of_isolated_coordinate_of_simple
    (M : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (μ : K)
    (hcol : ∀ j, M j i = if j = i then μ else 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j, M i j = if j = i then μ else 0)
    (hμ : M.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    μ ∉ spectrum K
      (M.submatrix (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val) (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := M.submatrix (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val) (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val)
  have hfactor : M.charpoly = (X - C μ) * B.charpoly :=
    charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_submatrix_of_isolated_coordinate M i μ hcol hrow
  have hprod : (X - C μ) * B.charpoly ≠ 0 := hfactor ▸ M.charpoly_monic.ne_zero
  rw [hfactor, Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_mul hprod] at hμ
  simp only [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C] at hμ
  have hB : B.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 0 := Nat.add_eq_left.mp hμ
  intro hspec
  have hroot := Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp hspec
  have hpos := Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_pos'.mpr ⟨B.charpoly_monic.ne_zero, hroot⟩
  rw [hB] at hpos
  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl 0) hpos

name: NLAlib.exists_simple_eigenvalue_isolated_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_simple_eigenvalue_isolated_similarity [IsAlgClosed K]
    {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K} {μ : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ (S : Matrix n n K) (i : n), IsUnit S ∧ Matrix.col S i = x ∧
      (∀ j, S⁻¹ i j = y j / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) ∧
      (∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) j i = if j = i then μ else 0) ∧
      (∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = if j = i then μ else 0) ∧
      μ ∉ spectrum K ((S⁻¹ * A * S).submatrix
        (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val) (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val))
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := dotProduct_ne_zero_of_simple_eigenvalue hx hy hAx hyA hμ
  obtain ⟨S, i, hS, hcol, hrow, hright, hleft, hproj⟩ :=
    exists_isolated_eigenvector_similarity hAx hyA hpair
  have hchar : (S⁻¹ * A * S).charpoly = A.charpoly := by
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S (S.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hS), Matrix.one_mul]
  exact ⟨S, i, hS, hcol, hrow, hright, hleft,
    not_mem_spectrum_submatrix_of_isolated_coordinate_of_simple (S⁻¹ * A * S) i μ
      hright hleft (by simpa only [hchar] using hμ)⟩

name: CStarMatrix.spectrum_real_rowGram_eq_sq_positive_dilation
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_rowGram_eq_sq_positive_dilation
    (Y : Matrix m n A) (hgap : ∀ r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)), 0 < r) :
    spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)) =
      (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2) '' (spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y) ∩ Set.Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  constructor
  · intro hr
    have hr0 := hgap r hr
    exact ⟨Real.sqrt r, ⟨(sqrt_mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff Y hr0).mpr hr,
      Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hr0⟩, Real.sq_sqrt hr0.le⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, ⟨hs, hs0⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram Y hs0).mp hs

name: CStarMatrix.hausdorffDist_spectrum_rowGram_le_of_dilation_gap
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_spectrum_rowGram_le_of_dilation_gap
    (Y : Matrix m n A) (Z : Matrix m n B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgapY : ∀ r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)), 4 * δ ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hgapZ : ∀ r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Z * Zᴴ)), 4 * δ ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hd : Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y))
      (spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Z)) ≤ δ) :
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)))
      (spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Z * Zᴴ))) ≤
        2 * δ * Real.sqrt ‖ofMatrix (Z * Zᴴ)‖ + δ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hposY : ∀ r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)), 0 < r := by
    intro r hr
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hgapY r hr)
  have hposZ : ∀ r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Z * Zᴴ)), 0 < r := by
    intro r hr
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hgapZ r hr)
  rw [spectrum_real_rowGram_eq_sq_positive_dilation Y hposY,
    spectrum_real_rowGram_eq_sq_positive_dilation Z hposZ]
  apply Metric.hausdorffDist_sq_positive_le_of_gap
    (spectrum.isCompact _) (spectrum.isCompact _)
    (ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.spectrum_nonempty _ (isSelfAdjoint_rectangularDilation Y))
    (ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.spectrum_nonempty _ (isSelfAdjoint_rectangularDilation Z))
    hδ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  · intro r hr hr0
    have hs := hgapY (r ^ 2)
      ((mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram Y hr0).mp hr)
    nlinarith
  · intro r hr hr0
    have hs := hgapZ (r ^ 2)
      ((mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram Z hr0).mp hr)
    nlinarith
  · intro r hr hr0
    have hs := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem
      ((mem_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation_iff_sq_mem_rowGram Z hr0).mp hr)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg r)] at hs
    have hsqrt := Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg (ofMatrix (Z * Zᴴ)))
    have hnonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖ofMatrix (Z * Zᴴ)‖
    nlinarith
  · exact hd

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq
statement:
theorem exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq (a b : n → ℂ)
    (hab : (∏ i, (X - C (a i))) = ∏ i, (X - C (b i))) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, b (σ i) = a i
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : ((Finset.univ.val.map a).map fun z => X - C z).prod =
      ((Finset.univ.val.map b).map fun z => X - C z).prod := by
    simpa only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, Finset.prod_map_val] using hab
  have hroots := congrArg Polynomial.roots hprod
  simp only [Polynomial.roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C] at hroots
  exact exists_perm_eq_of_map_univ_val_eq a b hroots

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_with_charpoly {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
      A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, a, hUa⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hAU : A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal a := by
    rw [hUa, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.mul_one]
  have ha : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (a i)) := by
    rw [hUa, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_eq_of_prod_X_sub_C_eq d a (hd.symm.trans ha)
  let V : Matrix n n ℂ := (U : Matrix n n ℂ).submatrix id σ
  have hVt : Vᴴ * V = 1 := by
    rw [show Vᴴ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ.submatrix σ id from rfl]
    have hmul := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
      σ (Equiv.refl n) σ
    simp only [Equiv.coe_refl] at hmul
    change (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ.submatrix σ id * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).submatrix id σ = 1
    rw [hmul, hUt, Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := ⟨V, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr hVt⟩
  have hAV : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i (σ j)) hAU
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simpa only [V, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, hσ] using h
  have hVV : V * Vᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self W
  refine ⟨W, ?_⟩
  change A = V * Matrix.diagonal d * Vᴴ
  calc
    A = A * (V * Vᴴ) := by rw [hVV, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_similarity_iff_charpoly_eq_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_similarity_iff_charpoly_eq_of_normal {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) :
    (∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
      A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * B * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) ↔ A.charpoly = B.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hAB⟩
    have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
    rw [hAB, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.one_mul]
  · intro hchar
    obtain ⟨V, d, hVd⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hB
    have hVt : (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
    have hd : B.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)) := by
      rw [hVd, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hVt, Matrix.one_mul,
        Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
    obtain ⟨W, hWd⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal_with_charpoly hA d (hchar.trans hd)
    let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := W * star V
    refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
    rw [hVd]
    change A = ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) *
      ((V : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) *
        ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)ᴴ
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (V : Matrix n n ℂ),
      hVt, Matrix.one_mul]
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hWd

name: NLAlib.signed_charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_principal_minors
statement:
theorem signed_charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_principal_minors (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * A.charpoly.coeff (Fintype.card n - k) =
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k,
        (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_minors A k hk, ← mul_assoc,
    ← pow_add, show k + k = 2 * k by omega, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg_of_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [signed_charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_principal_minors A k hk]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun S _ => (hA.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n)).det_nonneg

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_of_signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem posSemidef_of_signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k, k ≤ Fintype.card n →
      0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * A.charpoly.coeff (Fintype.card n - k)) : A.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.posSemidef_iff_eigenvalues_nonneg.mpr
  intro i
  by_contra h
  have hneg : hA.eigenvalues i < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hc : ∀ j, j ≤ Fintype.card n →
      0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card n - j) * A.charpoly.coeff j := by
    intro j hj
    simpa only [Nat.sub_sub_self hj] using hcoeff (Fintype.card n - j) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  have hpos := mul_eval_neg_pos_of_signed_coeff_nonneg A.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim
    A.charpoly_monic hc (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
  have hroot : A.charpoly.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = 0 := by
    rw [hA.charpoly_eq, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,
      RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (sub_self _)
  simp only [neg_neg, hroot, mul_zero, lt_self_iff_false] at hpos

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_iff_signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem posSemidef_iff_signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.PosSemidef ↔ ∀ k, k ≤ Fintype.card n →
      0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * A.charpoly.coeff (Fintype.card n - k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h k hk => signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg_of_posSemidef h k hk,
    posSemidef_of_signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg hA⟩

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_iff_principal_minors_nonneg
statement:
theorem posSemidef_iff_principal_minors_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.PosSemidef ↔ ∀ S : Finset n,
      0 ≤ (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h S => (h.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n)).det_nonneg
  · intro h
    apply posSemidef_of_signed_charpoly_coeff_nonneg hA
    intro k hk
    rw [signed_charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_principal_minors A k hk]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun S _ => h S

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_one_neg_one_eq
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_one_neg_one_eq :
    (Matrix.diagonal ![(1 : ℝ), -1]).charpoly = (X : ℝ[X]) ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_two]
  ring

name: NLAlib.not_posSemidef_diagonal_one_neg_one
statement:
theorem not_posSemidef_diagonal_one_neg_one :
    ¬ (Matrix.diagonal ![(1 : ℝ), -1]).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hdiag := h.diag_nonneg (i := (1 : Fin 2))
  norm_num at hdiag

name: NLAlib.exists_real_charpoly_factors_of_complex_spectrum_real
statement:
theorem exists_real_charpoly_factors_of_complex_spectrum_real
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hreal : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal), μ.im = 0) :
    ∃ d : n → ℝ, A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, T, _, _, hchar⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) (Fintype.equivFin n).symm
  let d : n → ℝ := fun i => (T i i).re
  have hval (i : n) : (d i : ℂ) = T i i := by
    have hroot : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly.IsRoot (T i i) := by
      rw [hchar]
      simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simp
    have him := hreal (T i i) (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mpr hroot)
    apply Complex.ext
    · rfl
    · exact him.symm
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  apply Polynomial.map_injective Complex.ofRealHom Complex.ofRealHom.injective
  have hmap : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = A.charpoly.map Complex.ofRealHom :=
    Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
  rw [← hmap, hchar, Polynomial.map_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C,
    Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe, hval]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_triangularization_of_complex_spectrum_real
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_triangularization_of_complex_spectrum_real
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n)
    (hreal : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal), μ.im = 0) :
    ∃ Q T : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ A = Q * T * Qᵀ ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → T i j = 0) ∧
      A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (T i i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_real_charpoly_factors_of_complex_spectrum_real A hreal
  obtain ⟨U, T, hA, htri, hdiag⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization_with_charpoly A e d hd
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℝ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hUt
  refine ⟨U, T, hU, ?_, htri, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA
  · simpa only [hdiag] using hd

name: NLAlib.exists_real_similarity_upper_triangular_small_entries
statement:
theorem exists_real_similarity_upper_triangular_small_entries
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n)
    (hreal : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal), μ.im = 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ S : Matrix n n ℝ, IsUnit S ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm i < e.symm j → ‖(S⁻¹ * A * S) i j‖ < ε)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, T, hQ, hA, htri, _⟩ := exists_orthogonal_triangularization_of_complex_spectrum_real A e hreal
  have hQu : IsUnit Q := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hQ)
  have hInv : Q⁻¹ = Qᵀ := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hQ
  have hsim : Q⁻¹ * A * Q = T := by
    rw [hInv, hA]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc Q T Qᵀ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᵀ Q, (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ),
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.mul_one]
  exact exists_similarity_small_entries_of_triangular_similarity A Q hQu e
    (fun i j hij => by rw [hsim]; exact htri i j hij) hε

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_le_zero_of_card_pos_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_le_zero_of_card_pos_le {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (j : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hj : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ i).card ≤ j) :
    hB.eigenvalues₀ j ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j := lt_of_not_ge h
  let f : Fin (j.val + 1) → {i : Fin (Fintype.card n) // 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ i} := fun i =>
    ⟨⟨i, by omega⟩, hpos.trans_le (hB.eigenvalues₀_antitone (by
      change i.val ≤ j.val
      omega))⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i k h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun t => t.val.val) h
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_subtype] at hc
  omega

name: NLAlib.card_eigenvalues₀_pos_neg
statement:
theorem card_eigenvalues₀_pos_neg {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hB.neg.eigenvalues₀ i).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hB.eigenvalues₀ i < 0).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : {i : Fin (Fintype.card n) // 0 < hB.neg.eigenvalues₀ i} ≃
      {i : Fin (Fintype.card n) // hB.eigenvalues₀ i < 0} :=
    { toFun := fun i => ⟨i.val.rev, by
        simpa only [eigenvalues₀_neg hB, neg_pos] using i.property⟩
      invFun := fun i => ⟨i.val.rev, by
        simpa only [eigenvalues₀_neg hB, Fin.rev_rev, neg_pos] using i.property⟩
      left_inv := fun _ => Subtype.ext (Fin.rev_rev _)
      right_inv := fun _ => Subtype.ext (Fin.rev_rev _) }
  simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using Fintype.card_congr e

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_card_pos
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_card_pos {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hi : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card < Fintype.card n) :
    (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀
      ⟨i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card, hi⟩ ≤
        hA.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  let p := (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card
  have hp : p < Fintype.card n := by dsimp [p]; omega
  have hb := eigenvalues₀_le_zero_of_card_pos_le hB ⟨p, hp⟩ (by rfl)
  have h := Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_add_le hA hB i ⟨p, hp⟩ hi
  exact h.trans (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_le_add_of_card_neg
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_le_add_of_card_neg {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hi : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => hB.eigenvalues₀ j < 0).card < Fintype.card n) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀
      ⟨i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => hB.eigenvalues₀ j < 0).card, hi⟩ ≤
        (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.neg.eigenvalues₀ j).card <
      Fintype.card n := by rwa [card_eigenvalues₀_pos_neg hB]
  have h := eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_card_pos (hA.add hB) hB.neg i hi'
  simpa only [add_neg_cancel_right, card_eigenvalues₀_pos_neg hB] using h

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_rank_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) {r : ℕ} (hBr : B.rank ≤ r)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (hi : i.val + r < Fintype.card n) :
    (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + r, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hAW⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul hA i
  have hker : Fintype.card n ≤ finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin) + r := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker B.mulVecLin
    rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at h
    change finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin) ≤ r at hBr
    omega
  apply Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_of_forall_mem (hA.add hB) _ (W ⊓ LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin)
    (card_le_finrank_inf_add hW hker)
  intro x hx
  have hxB : B *ᵥ x = 0 := hx.2
  simpa only [quadForm_def, Matrix.add_mulVec, hxB, add_zero] using hAW x hx.1

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_le_add_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_le_add_of_rank_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) {r : ℕ} (hBr : B.rank ≤ r)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (hi : i.val + r < Fintype.card n) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + r, hi⟩ ≤ (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_rank_le (hA.add hB) hB.neg
    (r := r) (by
      have hrank : (-B).rank = B.rank := by
        rw [show -B = (-1 : ℝ) • B by simp]
