        exact Matrix.rank_smul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors B
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (by norm_num))
      simpa only [hrank] using hBr) i hi
  simpa only [add_neg_cancel_right] using h

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_rank_one_add_interlacing
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_rank_one_add_interlacing {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (z : n → ℝ) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i ∧
    (∀ hi : i.val + 1 < Fintype.card n,
      (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀
        ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hA
    (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian) ?_ i, ?_⟩
  · exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr
      (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z)
  · intro hi
    exact eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_rank_le hA (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian
      (r := 1) (Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le _ _) i hi

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_rank_one_sub_interlacing
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_rank_one_sub_interlacing {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (z : n → ℝ) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∧
    (∀ hi : i.val + 1 < Fintype.card n,
      hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ ≤
        (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eigenvalues₀_rank_one_add_interlacing
    (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian) z i
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_low_rank_interlacing
statement:
theorem eigenvalue_low_rank_interlacing {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∀ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n))
      (hi : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card < Fintype.card n),
      (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀
        ⟨i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n))
      (hi : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => hB.eigenvalues₀ j < 0).card < Fintype.card n),
      hA.eigenvalues₀
        ⟨i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => hB.eigenvalues₀ j < 0).card, hi⟩ ≤
          (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ i) ∧
    (∀ r, B.rank ≤ r → ∀ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (hi : i.val + r < Fintype.card n),
      (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + r, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∧
      hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + r, hi⟩ ≤ (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ i) ∧
    (∀ z i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i ∧
      (∀ hi : i.val + 1 < Fintype.card n,
        (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀
          ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i)) ∧
    (∀ z i, (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∧ (∀ hi : i.val + 1 < Fintype.card n,
        hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ ≤
          (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i))
proof:
:=
  ⟨eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_card_pos hA hB, eigenvalues₀_le_add_of_card_neg hA hB,
    fun r hBr i hi => ⟨eigenvalues₀_add_le_of_rank_le hA hB (r := r) hBr i hi,
      eigenvalues₀_le_add_of_rank_le hA hB (r := r) hBr i hi⟩,
    eigenvalues₀_rank_one_add_interlacing hA, eigenvalues₀_rank_one_sub_interlacing hA⟩

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (sortedEigenframe hA)
proof:
:=
  (show HasOrthonormalCols (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) from
    transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA).submatrix_cols
      (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).toEmbedding

name: NLAlib.compression_sortedEigenframe_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem compression_sortedEigenframe_eq_diagonal (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ * A * sortedEigenframe hA = Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  have h := compression_submatrix_cols_eq_diagonal
    (show HasOrthonormalCols (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) from
      transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA) hA.eigenvalues
    (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA)
    (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).toEmbedding
  simpa [sortedEigenframe, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, Function.comp_def] using h

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) : HasOrthonormalCols (topEigenframe hA hk)
proof:
:=
  (hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe hA).submatrix_cols (Fin.castLEEmb hk)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_complementaryEigenframe
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_complementaryEigenframe (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) : HasOrthonormalCols (complementaryEigenframe hA hk)
proof:
:=
  (hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe hA).submatrix_cols
    (Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb (Nat.sub_le (Fintype.card n) k))

name: NLAlib.compression_topEigenframe_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem compression_topEigenframe_eq_diagonal (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (topEigenframe hA hk)ᵀ * A * topEigenframe hA hk =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE hk i))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ A
    (Fin.castLEEmb hk) (Equiv.refl n) id
  have h2 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv ((sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ * A) (sortedEigenframe hA)
    (Fin.castLEEmb hk) (Equiv.refl n) (Fin.castLEEmb hk)
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h1 h2
  rw [topEigenframe, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, h1, h2,
    compression_sortedEigenframe_eq_diagonal, Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_embedding]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.compression_complementaryEigenframe_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem compression_complementaryEigenframe_eq_diagonal (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (complementaryEigenframe hA hk)ᵀ * A * complementaryEigenframe hA hk =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n - k) =>
        hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + k, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb (Nat.sub_le (Fintype.card n) k)
  have h1 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ A e (Equiv.refl n) id
  have h2 := Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv ((sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ * A) (sortedEigenframe hA)
    e (Equiv.refl n) e
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h1 h2
  rw [complementaryEigenframe, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, h1, h2,
    compression_sortedEigenframe_eq_diagonal, Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_embedding]
  congr 1
  funext i
  change hA.eigenvalues₀ (e i) = hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + k, by omega⟩
  apply congrArg hA.eigenvalues₀
  apply Fin.ext
  simp [e, Fin.natAdd_castLEEmb, Nat.sub_sub_self hk]

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_similarity_small_upper_entries
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_similarity_small_upper_entries
    {n K : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [RCLike K]
    (T : Matrix n n K) (r : n → ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : Matrix n n K, IsUnit D ∧
      (∀ i, (D⁻¹ * T * D) i i = T i i) ∧
      (∀ i j, T i j = 0 → (D⁻¹ * T * D) i j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, r i < r j → ‖(D⁻¹ * T * D) i j‖ < ε)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : ℝ := ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖T i j‖
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => norm_nonneg _
  have hentryM (i j : n) : ‖T i j‖ ≤ M :=
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => norm_nonneg (T i k)) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => norm_nonneg (T k l))
        (Finset.mem_univ i))
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (1 + M + ε)
  have hden : 0 < 1 + M + ε := by positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε hden
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hden).mpr (by linarith)
  have hMδ : M * δ < ε := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_iff₀ hden]
    nlinarith
  have hδK : (δ : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hδ.ne'
  let D : Matrix n n K := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (δ : K) ^ r i)
  let H : Matrix n n K := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((δ : K) ^ r i)⁻¹)
  have hHD : H * D = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simp only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hδK), Matrix.diagonal_one]
  have hD : IsUnit D := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det D).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hHD)
  have hInv : D⁻¹ = H := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hHD
  have hentry (i j : n) : (D⁻¹ * T * D) i j = ((δ : K) ^ r i)⁻¹ * T i j * (δ : K) ^ r j := by
    rw [hInv]
    dsimp only [H, D]
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hentry]
    field_simp
  · intro i j hij
    rw [hentry, hij, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro i j hij
    have hnorm : ‖(D⁻¹ * T * D) i j‖ = ‖T i j‖ * δ ^ (r j - r i) := by
      rw [hentry, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow, norm_pow]
      simp only [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos hδ]
      rw [pow_sub₀ δ hδ.ne' (Nat.le_of_lt hij)]
      ring
    rw [hnorm]
    calc
      ‖T i j‖ * δ ^ (r j - r i) ≤ ‖T i j‖ * δ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_of_le_one hδ.le hδ1 (by omega)) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ M * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hentryM i j) hδ.le
      _ < ε := hMδ

name: NLAlib.exists_similarity_small_entries_of_triangular_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_similarity_small_entries_of_triangular_similarity
    {n K : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [RCLike K]
    (A S : Matrix n n K) (hS : IsUnit S) (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n)
    (htri : ∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : Matrix n n K, IsUnit R ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → (R⁻¹ * A * R) i j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm i < e.symm j → ‖(R⁻¹ * A * R) i j‖ < ε)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, _, hzero, hsmall⟩ := exists_diagonal_similarity_small_upper_entries
    (S⁻¹ * A * S) (fun i => (e.symm i).val) hε
  have hsim : (S * D)⁻¹ * A * (S * D) = D⁻¹ * (S⁻¹ * A * S) * D := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨S * D, hS.mul hD, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    rw [hsim]
    exact hzero i j (htri i j hij)
  · intro i j hij
    rw [hsim]
    exact hsmall i j hij

name: NLAlib.exists_similarity_upper_triangular_small_entries
statement:
theorem exists_similarity_upper_triangular_small_entries
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ S : Matrix n n ℂ, IsUnit S ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm i < e.symm j → ‖(S⁻¹ * A * S) i j‖ < ε)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, T, hA, htri, _⟩ := exists_unitary_schur_triangularization A e
  obtain ⟨D, hD, _, hzero, hsmall⟩ :=
    exists_diagonal_similarity_small_upper_entries T (fun i => (e.symm i).val) hε
  have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hU : IsUnit (U : Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hUt)
  have hUinv : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)⁻¹ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hUt
  let S := (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * D
  have hsim : S⁻¹ * A * S = D⁻¹ * T * D := by
    dsimp [S]
    rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hUinv, hA]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (U : Matrix n n ℂ),
      hUt, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨S, hU.mul hD, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    rw [hsim]
    exact hzero i j (htri i j hij)
  · intro i j hij
    rw [hsim]
    exact hsmall i j hij

name: NLAlib.diagonal_sqrt_gram
statement:
private theorem diagonal_sqrt_gram {ev : n → ℝ} (hev : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ev i) :
    let D
proof:
:= diagonal (fun i => (Real.sqrt (ev i) : 𝕜))
    D.conjTranspose=D ∧ D*D=diagonal (fun i => (ev i : 𝕜)) := by
  dsimp
  constructor
  · ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst j; simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    · simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]
  · rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (hev i)]

name: NLAlib.spectralGramRows_adjoint_mul
statement:
theorem spectralGramRows_adjoint_mul {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (spectralGramRows hA).conjTranspose*spectralGramRows hA=A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hD, hDD⟩ := diagonal_sqrt_gram (𝕜 := 𝕜) hA.eigenvalues_nonneg
  rw [spectralGramRows, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    hD, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (diagonal _), hDD]
  simpa only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Function.comp_def, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hA.isHermitian.spectral_theorem.symm

name: NLAlib.spectralGramRows_mul_adjoint
statement:
theorem spectralGramRows_mul_adjoint {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    spectralGramRows hA*(spectralGramRows hA).conjTranspose=
      diagonal (fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hD, hDD⟩ := diagonal_sqrt_gram (𝕜 := 𝕜) hA.eigenvalues_nonneg
  have hU : (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜).conjTranspose *
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)=1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self _
  rw [spectralGramRows, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    hD, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜).conjTranspose
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) _, hU, Matrix.one_mul]
  exact hDD

name: NLAlib.exists_common_eigenbasis_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_common_eigenbasis_of_commute (A : ι → Matrix n n K)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, IsDiagonalizable (A i))
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    ∃ (b : Basis n K (n → K)) (d : ι → n → K),
      ∀ i j, A i *ᵥ b j = d i j • b j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f (i : ι) : Module.End K (n → K) := (A i).toLin'
  have hfc : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (f i) (f j) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact (hcomm hij).map Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'.toRingHom
  have hgen (i : ι) (μ : K) : (f i).maxGenEigenspace μ = (f i).eigenspace μ :=
    (hdiag i).isSemisimple.isFinitelySemisimple.maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace μ
  have hsp (i : ι) : (⨆ μ : K, (f i).maxGenEigenspace μ) = ⊤ := by
    simp only [hgen]
    exact (isDiagonalizable_iff_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top (A i)).mp (hdiag i)
  let W (χ : ι → K) : Submodule K (n → K) := ⨅ i, (f i).eigenspace (χ i)
  have hspan : (⨆ χ : ι → K, W χ) = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [hgen] using
      Module.End.iSup_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_commute
        f hfc hsp
  have hind : iSupIndep W := by
    have hmap (i j : ι) (μ : K) : Set.MapsTo (f i)
        ((f j).maxGenEigenspace μ) ((f j).maxGenEigenspace μ) := by
      apply Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm
      rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
      · exact Commute.refl _
      · exact (hfc hij).symm
    simpa only [hgen] using
      Module.End.independent_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_of_forall_mapsTo f hmap
  have hsum : DirectSum.IsInternal W :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top hind hspan
  let c := hsum.collectedBasis (fun χ => Module.finBasis K (W χ))
  let : Fintype (Σ χ : ι → K, Fin (Module.finrank K (W χ))) :=
    FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex c
  have hcCard : Fintype.card (Σ χ : ι → K, Fin (Module.finrank K (W χ))) =
      Fintype.card n := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis c, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
  let e := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcCard
  let b : Basis n K (n → K) := c.reindex e
  refine ⟨b, fun i j => (e.symm j).1 i, fun i j => ?_⟩
  have hb : b j ∈ W (e.symm j).1 := by
    simpa only [b, Basis.reindex_apply] using
      hsum.collectedBasis_mem (fun χ => Module.finBasis K (W χ)) (e.symm j)
  exact Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp
    ((iInf_le (fun k => (f k).eigenspace ((e.symm j).1 k)) i) hb)

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_of_commute (A : ι → Matrix n n K)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, IsDiagonalizable (A i))
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    ∃ (V : Matrix n n K) (d : ι → n → K), IsUnit V ∧
      ∀ i, A i * V = V * Matrix.diagonal (d i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, d, hb⟩ := exists_common_eigenbasis_of_commute A hdiag hcomm
  let V : Matrix n n K := fun i j => b j i
  refine ⟨V, d, Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mp b.linearIndependent, ?_⟩
  intro i
  ext j k
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  change (∑ l, A i j l * b k l) = b k j * d i k
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
    congrFun (hb i k) j

name: NLAlib.commute_of_simultaneous_diagonalization
proof:
:= by
  apply hV.mul_right_cancel
  change (A * B) * V = (B * A) * V
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hB, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hA, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, hA, ← Matrix.mul_assoc B V, hB, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  exact congrArg (fun d : n → K => V * Matrix.diagonal d)
    (funext fun i => mul_comm (a i) (b i))

name: NLAlib.pairwise_commute_iff_exists_simultaneous_diagonalization
statement:
theorem pairwise_commute_iff_exists_simultaneous_diagonalization
    (A : ι → Matrix n n K) (hdiag : ∀ i, IsDiagonalizable (A i)) :
    (Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j)) ↔
      ∃ (V : Matrix n n K) (d : ι → n → K), IsUnit V ∧
        ∀ i, A i * V = V * Matrix.diagonal (d i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_simultaneous_diagonalization_of_commute A hdiag
  · rintro ⟨V, d, hV, hAV⟩ i j hij
    exact commute_of_simultaneous_diagonalization hV (hAV i) (hAV j)

name: NLAlib.linearIndependent_real_imag_of_nonreal_eigen_equations
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_real_imag_of_nonreal_eigen_equations {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (u v : n → ℝ) (huv : u ≠ 0 ∨ v ≠ 0)
    (hAu : A *ᵥ u = a • u - b • v) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = b • u + a • v) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ ![u, v]
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have hu : u = 0 := by
      have hh : b • u = 0 := by simpa only [hv, Matrix.mulVec_zero, smul_zero, add_zero] using hAv.symm
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left hb
    exact huv.elim (fun h => h hu) (fun h => h hv)
  rw [linearIndependent_fin2]
  refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
  intro c hc
  change c • v = u at hc
  have hh := congrArg (fun x : n → ℝ => A *ᵥ x) hc
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, hAv, hAu, ← hc] at hh
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hv (funext h)
  have he := congrFun hh i
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul] at he
  have hz : b * (c ^ 2 + 1) * v i = 0 := by nlinarith [he]
  have hbp : b * (c ^ 2 + 1) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hb (by positivity)
  exact (mul_ne_zero hbp hi) hz

name: NLAlib.exists_real_eigenvector_or_invariant_plane
statement:
theorem exists_real_eigenvector_or_invariant_plane {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∃ a : ℝ, ∃ u : n → ℝ, u ≠ 0 ∧ A *ᵥ u = a • u) ∨
    (∃ a b : ℝ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ X : Matrix n (Fin 2) ℝ,
      LinearIndependent ℝ X.col ∧ A * X = X * !![a, b; -b, a])
proof:
:= by
  let AC := A.map Complex.ofReal
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := Module.End.exists_eigenvalue AC.mulVecLin
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := hμ.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hAz : AC *ᵥ z = μ • z := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hz
  let u : n → ℝ := fun i => (z i).re
  let v : n → ℝ := fun i => (z i).im
  have huv : u ≠ 0 ∨ v ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hz0
    funext i
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact congrFun h.1 i
    · exact congrFun h.2 i
  have hAu : A *ᵥ u = μ.re • u - μ.im • v := by
    funext i
    have hh := congrArg Complex.re (congrFun hAz i)
    simpa only [AC, u, v, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply,
      Complex.re_sum, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hh
  have hAv : A *ᵥ v = μ.im • u + μ.re • v := by
    funext i
    have hh := congrArg Complex.im (congrFun hAz i)
    simpa only [AC, u, v, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply,
      Complex.im_sum, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, add_zero, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_comm] using hh
  by_cases hμi : μ.im = 0
  · left
    rcases huv with hu | hv
    · exact ⟨μ.re, u, hu, by simpa only [hμi, zero_smul, sub_zero] using hAu⟩
    · exact ⟨μ.re, v, hv, by simpa only [hμi, zero_smul, zero_add] using hAv⟩
  · right
    let X : Matrix n (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of (fun i => ![u i, v i])
    refine ⟨μ.re, μ.im, hμi, X, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcol : X.col = ![u, v] := by funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
      rw [hcol]
      exact linearIndependent_real_imag_of_nonreal_eigen_equations A μ.re μ.im hμi u v huv hAu hAv
    · ext i j
      fin_cases j
      · have hh := congrFun hAu i
        simpa [X, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two,
          mul_comm, sub_eq_add_neg] using hh
      · have hh := congrFun hAv i
        simpa [X, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, mul_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff_isRoot_and_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff_isRoot_and_derivative_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (p : K[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (z : K) :
    p.rootMultiplicity z = 1 ↔ p.IsRoot z ∧ p.derivative.eval z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hroot : p.IsRoot z := (rootMultiplicity_pos hp).mp (by omega)
    refine ⟨hroot, ?_⟩
    intro hd
    have := (one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot hp).mpr ⟨hroot, hd⟩
    omega
  · rintro ⟨hroot, hd⟩
    have hpos := (rootMultiplicity_pos hp).mpr hroot
    have hle : p.rootMultiplicity z ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra! hgt
      exact hd ((one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot hp).mp hgt).2
    omega

name: NLAlib.continuous_eval_derivative_charpoly_affine
statement:
theorem continuous_eval_derivative_charpoly_affine
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A E : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ((A + p.1 • E).charpoly.derivative).eval p.2)
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix n n ℂ[X] := A.map C + (X : ℂ[X]) • E.map C
  let P := M.charpoly
  have hmap (t : ℂ) : P.map (evalRingHom t) = (A + t • E).charpoly := by
    rw [← Matrix.charpoly_map]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    simp [M, Matrix.map_apply]
    ring
  have hder (t : ℂ) : P.derivative.map (evalRingHom t) =
      (A + t • E).charpoly.derivative := by
    rw [← derivative_map, hmap]
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ =>
      (P.derivative.map (evalRingHom p.1)).eval p.2) := by
    simp only [eval_map, eval₂_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum, coe_evalRingHom]
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro i _
    exact ((P.derivative.coeff i).continuous.comp continuous_fst).mul (continuous_snd.pow i)
  simpa only [hder] using hcont

name: NLAlib.eventually_rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_continuous_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem eventually_rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_continuous_eigenvalue
    {n T : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [TopologicalSpace T]
    (A E : Matrix n n ℂ) {t₀ : T} (τ φ : T → ℂ)
    (hτ : ContinuousAt τ t₀) (hφ : ContinuousAt φ t₀) (hτ₀ : τ t₀ = 0)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity (φ t₀) = 1)
    (hspec : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + τ t • E)) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, (A + τ t • E).charpoly.rootMultiplicity (φ t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : A.charpoly.derivative.eval (φ t₀) ≠ 0 :=
    ((rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff_isRoot_and_derivative_ne_zero
      A.charpoly A.charpoly_monic.ne_zero (φ t₀)).mp hμ).2
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun t => (A + τ t • E).charpoly.derivative.eval (φ t)) t₀ :=
    (continuous_eval_derivative_charpoly_affine A E).continuousAt.comp
      (hτ.prodMk hφ)
  have hnear := hc.eventually_ne (by simpa only [hτ₀, zero_smul, add_zero] using hne)
  filter_upwards [hspec, hnear] with t ht hdt
  exact (rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff_isRoot_and_derivative_ne_zero
    _ (A + τ t • E).charpoly_monic.ne_zero _).mpr
      ⟨Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp ht, hdt⟩

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_smul
statement:
theorem rectDiag_smul {m n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag (c • a) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) = c • rectDiag a
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [rectDiag_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  split <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.singularValues_neg
statement:
theorem singularValues_neg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    singularValues (-A) = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols (-1 : Matrix m m ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
  simpa using singularValues_isometry_mul hP A

name: NLAlib.singularValues_smul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem singularValues_smul_of_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (c • A) k = c * singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k < min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
  · obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    have hfact : c • A = U * (rectDiag (c • singularValues A) : Matrix _ _ ℝ) * Vᵀ := by
      rw [rectDiag_smul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
      exact congrArg (fun B => c • B) hSVD.eq
    exact singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right (fun i => mul_nonneg hc (singularValues_nonneg A i))
      (fun i j hij => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (singularValues_antitone A hij) hc) hfact hk
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (by omega),
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by omega), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_smul
statement:
theorem singularValues_smul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (c • A) k = |c| * singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : 0 ≤ c
  · rw [singularValues_smul_of_nonneg A hc, abs_of_nonneg hc]
  · have hc : c < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hc
    have hfact : c • A = -((-c) • A) := by simp
    rw [hfact, singularValues_neg, singularValues_smul_of_nonneg A (by linarith), abs_of_neg hc]

name: NLAlib.real_normal_quasi_row_eq_zero_of_pair
statement:
theorem real_normal_quasi_row_eq_zero_of_pair {k : ℕ}
    {T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hT : IsUpperQuasiTriangular T)
    (hN : T * Tᵀ = Tᵀ * T) {i j : Fin k} (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val)
    (hji : T j i ≠ 0) (l : Fin k) (hli : l ≠ i) (hlj : l ≠ j) :
    T i l = 0 ∧ T l i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hleft : l.val + 1 < i.val
  · exact ⟨hT.1 i l hleft, real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_above_superdiagonal hT hN l i hleft⟩
  by_cases hright : i.val + 1 < l.val
  · exact ⟨real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_above_superdiagonal hT hN i l hright, hT.1 l i hright⟩
  have hli' : l.val + 1 = i.val := by
    have := Fin.val_ne_of_ne hli
    have := Fin.val_ne_of_ne hlj
    omega
  have hz : T i l = 0 := (hT.2 j i l hij hli').resolve_left hji
  exact ⟨hz, real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_of_subdiagonal_eq_zero hT hN hli' hz⟩

name: NLAlib.isRealNormalForm_of_isRealSchurForm
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : ∀ i j : Fin k, i < j → T i j = -T j i := by
    intro i j hij
    by_cases hfar : i.val + 1 < j.val
    · rw [real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_above_superdiagonal hT.1 hN i j hfar,
        hT.1.1 j i hfar, neg_zero]
    have hadj : i.val + 1 = j.val := by omega
    by_cases hji : T j i = 0
    · rw [real_normal_quasi_eq_zero_of_subdiagonal_eq_zero hT.1 hN hadj hji, hji, neg_zero]
    have hdiag := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ => M i i) hN
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hdiag
    have hsum : ∑ l, (T i l * T i l - T l i * T l i) = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hdiag, sub_self]
    have hsingle : ∑ l, (T i l * T i l - T l i * T l i) =
        T i j * T i j - T j i * T j i := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
      · intro l _ hlj
        by_cases hli : l = i
        · simp only [hli, sub_self]
        · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := real_normal_quasi_row_eq_zero_of_pair hT.1 hN hadj hji l hli hlj
          rw [h₁, h₂, mul_zero, sub_self]
      · simp
    have hsquares : (T i j) ^ 2 = (T j i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsingle] at hsum
      nlinarith [hsum]
    rcases (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg).mp hsquares with heq | heq
    · have hneg := (hT.2 j i hadj hji).2
      rw [heq] at hneg
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (T j i)]
    · exact heq
  refine ⟨hT, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact hupper i j h
  · have h' := hupper j i h
    linarith

name: NLAlib.real_normal_orthogonal_conjugate
statement:
theorem real_normal_orthogonal_conjugate {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A Q : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ * A) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (Qᵀ * A * Q) * (Qᵀ * A * Q)ᵀ = (Qᵀ * A * Q)ᵀ * (Qᵀ * A * Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hQQ : Q * Qᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  calc
    _ = Qᵀ * (A * Aᵀ) * Q := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q Qᵀ, hQQ, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = Qᵀ * (Aᵀ * A) * Q := by rw [hA]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q Qᵀ, hQQ, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_real_normal_form
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_real_normal_form {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ * A) (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ Q T : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ A = Q * T * Qᵀ ∧
      IsRealNormalForm (T.submatrix order order)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, T, hQ, hAT, hT⟩ := exists_orthogonal_real_schur A order
  have hconj : Qᵀ * A * Q = T := by
    rw [hAT]
    calc
      _ = (Qᵀ * Q) * T * (Qᵀ * Q) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = T := by rw [(show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hN : T * Tᵀ = Tᵀ * T := by
    simpa only [hconj] using real_normal_orthogonal_conjugate hA hQ
  refine ⟨Q, T, hQ, hAT, isRealNormalForm_of_isRealSchurForm hT ?_⟩
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hN]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_qz_triangularization
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_qz_triangularization {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ V W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ, ∃ T₁ T₂ : Matrix n n ℂ,
      A = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * T₁ * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      B = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * T₂ * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      (∀ i j, order.symm j < order.symm i → T₁ i j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, order.symm j < order.symm i → T₂ i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a := A.toEuclideanLin
  let b := B.toEuclideanLin
  obtain ⟨e₀, f₀, hA₀, hB₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBases_pencil_upper_triangular
    (Fintype.card n) a b (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ)) (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ))
  let e : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := e₀.reindex order
  let f : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := f₀.reindex order
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ
  let V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix f.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary f⟩
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix e.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary e⟩
  let T (M : Matrix n n ℂ) := M.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix e.toBasis f.toBasis
  have hWW : (W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self W
  have hback : e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    calc
      e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
          e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) := by
            rw [hWW, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)) * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ :=
        (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
        change (e.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis * c.toBasis.toMatrix e.toBasis) * _ = _
        rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hFactor (M : Matrix n n ℂ) : M = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * T M * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    have hh := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis e.toBasis c.toBasis f.toBasis M.toEuclideanLin
    have hstd : M.toEuclideanLin.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = M :=
      LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis M
    rw [hback, hstd] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  refine ⟨V, W, T A, T B, hFactor A, hFactor B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [e, f, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using hA₀ (order.symm i) (order.symm j) hij
  · intro i j hij
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [e, f, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using hB₀ (order.symm i) (order.symm j) hij

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_qz_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_qz_upperTriangular {k : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ) :
    ∃ V W : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin k) ℂ, ∃ T₁ T₂ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ,
      A = (V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ) * T₁ * (W : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      B = (V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ) * T₂ * (W : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      T₁.IsUpperTriangular ∧ T₂.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, W, T₁, T₂, hA, hB, hT₁, hT₂⟩ :=
    exists_unitary_qz_triangularization A B (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin k))
  exact ⟨V, W, T₁, T₂, hA, hB, fun _ _ h => hT₁ _ _ h, fun _ _ h => hT₂ _ _ h⟩

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.posDef_gram_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_gap
statement:
theorem posDef_gram_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_gap
    (X : Matrix m n ℝ) (hRank : X.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : (X * Xᵀ).IsHermitian) (b : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i) :
    (Xᵀ * X - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hGpos : (Xᵀ * X).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X
  have hGdef : (Xᵀ * X).PosDef :=
    hGpos.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr (isUnit_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq hRank)
  let hG := hGpos.isHermitian
  have hEig : ∀ i, b < hG.eigenvalues i := by
    intro i
    let μ := hG.eigenvalues i
    have hμpos : 0 < μ := hGdef.eigenvalues_pos i
    have hmem : μ ∈ spectrum ℝ (Xᵀ * X) := by
      rw [hG.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hroot := (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp hmem).eq_zero
    have hpoly := congrArg (Polynomial.eval μ) (Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm' X Xᵀ)
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, hroot,
      mul_zero] at hpoly
    have hroot' : Polynomial.IsRoot (X * Xᵀ).charpoly μ := by
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hpoly).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (ne_of_gt hμpos))
    have hmem' := Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mpr hroot'
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hmem'
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmem'
    have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμpos
    rcases hgap j with hz | hb
    · exact False.elim (hμne (hj ▸ hz))
    · rwa [hj] at hb
  rw [sub_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_diagonal_mul hG b, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hG.eigenvalues i - b)).PosDef :=
    Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff.mpr fun i => sub_pos.mpr (hEig i)
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff
      (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := hG.eigenvectorUnitary))
      (x := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hG.eigenvalues i - b))).mpr hdiag

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.norm_mulVec_sq_gt_of_eigenvalues_gap
statement:
theorem norm_mulVec_sq_gt_of_eigenvalues_gap
    (X : Matrix m n ℝ) (hRank : X.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : (X * Xᵀ).IsHermitian) (b : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i)
    (a : n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    b * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X *ᵥ a)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := (posDef_gram_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_gap X hRank hA b hgap).quadForm_pos ha
  simp only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hpos
  have hgram : a ⬝ᵥ ((Xᵀ * X) *ᵥ a) = (X *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ a) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
  rw [hgram] at hpos
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.trace_conjStarAlgAut
statement:
theorem trace_conjStarAlgAut {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [StarRing R]
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι R) (A : Matrix ι ι R) :
    Matrix.trace (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut R _ U A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
    Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.IsHermitian) (n : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (R ^ n) = ∑ i, hR.eigenvalues i ^ n
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hR.spectral_theorem, ← map_pow]
  rw [trace_conjStarAlgAut,
    Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow
statement:
theorem trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hB : Bᵀ = B) (ev : ι → ℝ) (a c : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (B * (Matrix.diagonal ev) ^ a * B * (Matrix.diagonal ev) ^ c) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, B i j ^ 2 * ev j ^ a * ev i ^ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.diagonal_pow,
    Matrix.mul_assoc B (Matrix.diagonal (ev ^ a)) B]
  have hentry (i : ι) : (B * (Matrix.diagonal (ev ^ a) * B)) i i =
      ∑ j, B i j * (ev j ^ a * B j i) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    rfl
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simp_rw [hentry]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hs := congrFun (congrFun hB j) i
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at hs
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.mul_eq_mul_iff_conjTranspose_mul_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_normal_rectangular
statement:
theorem mul_eq_mul_iff_conjTranspose_mul_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_normal_rectangular
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ} {X : Matrix m n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) :
    A * X = X * B ↔ Aᴴ * X = X * Bᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ := Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B
  let N : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℂ := Matrix.fromBlocks 0 X 0 0
  have hM : M * Mᴴ = Mᴴ * M := by
    simp only [M, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero, hA, hB]
  have h := mul_eq_mul_iff_conjTranspose_mul_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_normal
    (A := M) (B := M) (X := N) hM hM
  simpa only [M, N, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_inj, true_and, and_self, and_true] using h

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_real_sylvester_of_disjoint_complex_spectrum
statement:
theorem existsUnique_real_sylvester_of_disjoint_complex_spectrum
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal))
      (spectrum ℂ (B.map Complex.ofReal))) (C : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∃! X : Matrix m n ℝ, A * X - X * B = C
proof:
:= by
  have hcop := (isCoprime_charpoly_iff_disjoint_spectrum
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal)).mpr hdisj
  have hA : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = Polynomial.map Complex.ofRealHom A.charpoly :=
    Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
  have hB : (B.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = Polynomial.map Complex.ofRealHom B.charpoly :=
    Matrix.charpoly_map B Complex.ofRealHom
  rw [hA, hB, Polynomial.isCoprime_map] at hcop
  exact existsUnique_sylvester_of_isCoprime_charpoly A B hcop C

name: NLAlib.submatrix_blockDiagonal'_mul
statement:
theorem submatrix_blockDiagonal'_mul (A : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) K)
    (X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, n i) K) (i j : ι) :
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' A * X).submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j) =
      A i * X.submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, ← Finset.univ_sigma_univ, Finset.sum_sigma]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp only [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
  · intro k hki
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne A a c hki.symm, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.submatrix_mul_blockDiagonal'
statement:
theorem submatrix_mul_blockDiagonal' (B : ∀ i, Matrix (n i) (n i) K)
    (X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, n i) K) (i j : ι) :
    (X * Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j) =
      X.submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j) * B j
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, ← Finset.univ_sigma_univ, Finset.sum_sigma]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp only [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
  · intro k hkj
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne B c b hkj, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.eq_blockDiagonal'_of_intertwines_of_disjoint_spectrum
statement:
theorem eq_blockDiagonal'_of_intertwines_of_disjoint_spectrum [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) K) (B : ∀ i, Matrix (n i) (n i) K)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (spectrum K (A i)) (spectrum K (B j)))
    {X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, n i) K}
    (hX : Matrix.blockDiagonal' A * X = X * Matrix.blockDiagonal' B) :
    X = Matrix.blockDiagonal' (Matrix.blockDiag' X) ∧
      ∀ i, A i * Matrix.blockDiag' X i = Matrix.blockDiag' X i * B i
proof:
:= by
  have hblock (i j : ι) : A i * X.submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j) =
      X.submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j) * B j := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, n i) K =>
      M.submatrix (Sigma.mk i) (Sigma.mk j)) hX
    simpa only [submatrix_blockDiagonal'_mul, submatrix_mul_blockDiagonal'] using h
  constructor
  · ext ⟨i, a⟩ ⟨j, b⟩
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
      rfl
    · rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne _ a b hij]
      exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix (m i) (n j) K => M a b)
        (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_mul_of_disjoint_spectrum (hdisj i j hij) (hblock i j))
  · exact fun i => hblock i i

name: NLAlib.commute_blockDiagonal'_iff
statement:
theorem commute_blockDiagonal'_iff [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) K)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (spectrum K (A i)) (spectrum K (A j)))
    (X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, m i) K) :
    Commute (Matrix.blockDiagonal' A) X ↔
      ∃ Y : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) K,
        X = Matrix.blockDiagonal' Y ∧ ∀ i, Commute (A i) (Y i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hX
    obtain ⟨hdiag, hcomm⟩ := eq_blockDiagonal'_of_intertwines_of_disjoint_spectrum
      A A (fun _ _ hij => hdisj hij) hX.eq
    exact ⟨Matrix.blockDiag' X, hdiag, hcomm⟩
  · rintro ⟨Y, rfl, hY⟩
    change Matrix.blockDiagonal' A * Matrix.blockDiagonal' Y =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' Y * Matrix.blockDiagonal' A
    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal'_mul, ← Matrix.blockDiagonal'_mul]
    exact congrArg Matrix.blockDiagonal' (funext fun i => (hY i).eq)

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_eq_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_eq_congruence_diagonal {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) :
    fromBlocks A 0 0 C =
      (fromBlocks (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ)ᵀ 0 0
        (hC.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ)ᵀ *
      diagonal (Sum.elim hA.eigenvalues hC.eigenvalues) *
      fromBlocks (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ)ᵀ 0 0
        (hC.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fromBlocks_diagonal, fromBlocks_transpose]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero, fromBlocks_multiply,
    Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero]
  rw [← eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA,
    ← eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hC]

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_fromBlocks_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [fromBlocks_eq_congruence_diagonal hA hC]
  rw [inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul _ (isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr
    ⟨isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hA, isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hC⟩)]
  rw [inertiaPos_diagonal, inertiaPos_eq_card_eigenvalues_pos hA,
    inertiaPos_eq_card_eigenvalues_pos hC]
  simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.inertiaNeg_fromBlocks_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [fromBlocks_eq_congruence_diagonal hA hC]
  rw [inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul _ (isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr
    ⟨isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hA, isUnit_transpose_eigenvectorUnitary hC⟩)]
  rw [inertiaNeg_diagonal, inertiaNeg_eq_card_eigenvalues_neg hA,
    inertiaNeg_eq_card_eigenvalues_neg hC]
  simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_add_inertiaNeg_eq_rank
statement:
theorem inertiaPos_add_inertiaNeg_eq_rank {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {A : Matrix k k ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : inertiaPos A + inertiaNeg A = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [inertiaPos_eq_card_eigenvalues_pos hA, inertiaNeg_eq_card_eigenvalues_neg hA,
    hA.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hu : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hA.eigenvalues i) ∪
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i < 0) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    simpa only [ne_comm] using
      (ne_iff_lt_or_gt (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := hA.eigenvalues i)).symm
  have hd : Disjoint (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hA.eigenvalues i)
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i < 0) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i hi hj
    have hi' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hj' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hi'.le) hj'
  rw [← hu, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd]

name: NLAlib.finrank_ker_eq_card_eigenvalues_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_eq_card_eigenvalues_zero {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {A : Matrix k k ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i = 0).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr : A.rank + finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) = Fintype.card k := by
    simpa only [Matrix.rank, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using
      LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker A.mulVecLin
  have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset k)) (p := fun i => hA.eigenvalues i = 0)
  have hAr : A.rank = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0).card := by
    rw [hA.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hFilter : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => ¬ hA.eigenvalues i = 0) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
  rw [hFilter] at hc
  simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hc
  omega

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul {A : Matrix m m ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C =
      (fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1)ᵀ *
      fromBlocks A 0 0 (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B) *
      fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hAu.invertible
  have hAt : (A⁻¹)ᵀ = A⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hA.inv.eq
  simpa only [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, fromBlocks_transpose,
    Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.transpose_mul, hAt] using
    Matrix.fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁ A B Bᵀ C

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_schur_complement
proof:
:= by
  apply hC.sub
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul B hA.inv

name: NLAlib.inertiaPos_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur
proof:
:= by
  rw [fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul hA hAu B C,
    inertiaPos_transpose_mul_mul _ (isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨isUnit_one, isUnit_one⟩)]
  exact inertiaPos_fromBlocks_zero hA (isHermitian_schur_complement hA hC B)

name: NLAlib.inertiaNeg_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur
proof:
:= by
  rw [fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul hA hAu B C,
    inertiaNeg_transpose_mul_mul _ (isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨isUnit_one, isUnit_one⟩)]
  exact inertiaNeg_fromBlocks_zero hA (isHermitian_schur_complement hA hC B)

name: NLAlib.posDef_fromBlocks_zero_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_fromBlocks_zero_iff (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (fromBlocks A 0 0 C).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef ∧ C.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.submatrix Sum.inl_injective, h.submatrix Sum.inr_injective⟩
  · rintro ⟨hA, hC⟩
    let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
    have hPSD : (fromBlocks A 0 0 C).PosSemidef := by
      apply (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ (0 : Matrix m n ℝ) C hA).mpr
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, sub_zero]
        using hC.posSemidef
    exact hPSD.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
      (isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨hA.isUnit, hC.isUnit⟩)

name: NLAlib.posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_schur
proof:
:= by
  rw [fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul hA hAu B C]
  have hU : IsUnit (fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1 : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℝ) :=
    isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨isUnit_one, isUnit_one⟩
  rw [show (fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1 : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℝ)ᵀ =
    star (fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1 : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) ℝ) by rfl,
    hU.posDef_star_left_conjugate_iff, posDef_fromBlocks_zero_iff]

name: NLAlib.posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_and_schur
statement:
theorem posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_and_schur
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef ∧ (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hH
    have hA : A.PosDef := hH.submatrix
      (Sum.inl_injective : Function.Injective (Sum.inl : m → m ⊕ n))
    exact (posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_schur hA.isHermitian hA.isUnit B C).mp hH
  · rintro ⟨hA, hS⟩
    exact (posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_schur hA.isHermitian hA.isUnit B C).mpr ⟨hA, hS⟩

name: NLAlib.finrank_ker_fromBlocks_eq_schur
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_fromBlocks_eq_schur {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).mulVecLin) =
      finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).mulVecLin)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).IsHermitian :=
    hA.fromBlocks (by simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]) hC
  have hS := isHermitian_schur_complement hA hC B
  have hP := inertiaPos_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur hA hAu hC B
  have hN := inertiaNeg_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur hA hAu hC B
  have hrM : (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).rank +
      finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).mulVecLin) =
        Fintype.card m + Fintype.card n := by
    simpa only [Matrix.rank, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_sum] using
      LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).mulVecLin
  have hrS : (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).rank +
      finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).mulVecLin) = Fintype.card n := by
    simpa only [Matrix.rank, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using
      LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).mulVecLin
  have hrA := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit A hAu
  have hPA := inertiaPos_add_inertiaNeg_eq_rank hA
  have hPM := inertiaPos_add_inertiaNeg_eq_rank hM
  have hPS := inertiaPos_add_inertiaNeg_eq_rank hS
  omega

name: NLAlib.haynsworth_inertia_additivity
statement:
theorem haynsworth_inertia_additivity {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    inertiaPos (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) = inertiaPos A + inertiaPos (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B) ∧
    inertiaNeg (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) = inertiaNeg A + inertiaNeg (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B) ∧
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).mulVecLin) =
      finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).mulVecLin) ∧
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef ∧ (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosDef)
proof:
:=
  ⟨inertiaPos_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur hA hAu hC B,
    inertiaNeg_fromBlocks_eq_add_schur hA hAu hC B,
    finrank_ker_fromBlocks_eq_schur hA hAu hC B,
    posDef_fromBlocks_iff_posDef_schur hA hAu B C⟩

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_apply
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_apply (x : n → 𝕜) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i = star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenvectorCoordinates, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.sum_sq_norm_eigenvectorCoordinates
statement:
theorem sum_sq_norm_eigenvectorCoordinates (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ∑ i, ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  hA.eigenvectorBasis.sum_sq_norm_inner_right _

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_injective
statement: theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_injective : Function.Injective hA.eigenvectorCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply WithLp.toLp_injective (p := 2)
  apply hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr.injective
  ext i
  simpa [eigenvectorCoordinates, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply] using congrFun h i

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_smul (c : 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (c • x) = c • hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [eigenvectorCoordinates, WithLp.toLp_smul, inner_smul_right]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_sub
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_sub (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x - y) =
      hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x - hA.eigenvectorCoordinates y
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [eigenvectorCoordinates, WithLp.toLp_sub, inner_sub_right]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_eigenvectorBasis
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_eigenvectorBasis (i j : n) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) j = if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact hA.eigenvectorBasis.inner_eq_ite j i

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec (x : n → 𝕜) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (A *ᵥ x) i =
      (hA.eigenvalues i : 𝕜) * hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA)
    (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
  have he : A.toEuclideanLin (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) =
      hA.eigenvalues i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrFun (hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i) j
  change ⟪hA.eigenvectorBasis i, A.toEuclideanLin (WithLp.toLp 2 x)⟫_𝕜 = _
  rw [← hs, he, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜), inner_smul_left]
  simp [eigenvectorCoordinates]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_sub_smul_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_sub_smul_mulVec (μ : ℝ) (x : n → 𝕜) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) *ᵥ x) i =
      ((hA.eigenvalues i - μ : ℝ) : 𝕜) * hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  simp only [eigenvectorCoordinates, WithLp.toLp_sub, WithLp.toLp_smul,
    inner_sub_right, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜), inner_smul_right]
  rw [← eigenvectorCoordinates, hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec]
  simp only [eigenvectorCoordinates, RCLike.ofReal_sub]
  ring

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.isUnit_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_ne
statement:
theorem isUnit_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_ne {μ : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ μ) : IsUnit (A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp
  intro x y hxy
  apply hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_injective
  ext i
  have h := congrArg (fun v => hA.eigenvectorCoordinates v i) hxy
  simp only [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_sub_smul_mulVec] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hμ i))) h

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.isUnit_sub_smul_one_iff_eigenvalues_ne
statement:
theorem isUnit_sub_smul_one_iff_eigenvalues_ne (μ : ℝ) :
    IsUnit (A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) ↔ ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, hA.isUnit_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_ne⟩
  intro hB i hi
  have hker : (A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis, hi, sub_self]
  have hz : ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) = (0 : n → 𝕜) :=
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hB) (by simpa using hker)
  have hn := hA.eigenvectorBasis.norm_eq_one i
  have hv : hA.eigenvectorBasis i = 0 := by ext j; exact congrFun hz j
  rw [hv, norm_zero] at hn
  exact zero_ne_one hn

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates_inv_sub_smul_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvectorCoordinates_inv_sub_smul_mulVec {μ : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ μ) (x : n → 𝕜) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x) i =
      (((hA.eigenvalues i - μ : ℝ) : 𝕜))⁻¹ * hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i
proof:
:= by
  let B := A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)
  have hB := hA.isUnit_sub_smul_one_of_eigenvalues_ne hμ
  have hBB : B *ᵥ (B⁻¹ *ᵥ x) = x := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h := hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_sub_smul_mulVec μ (B⁻¹ *ᵥ x) i
  rw [hBB] at h
  rw [h, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀
    (RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hμ i))), one_mul]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (NLAlib.quadForm A x) =
      ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.eigenvectorBasis.sum_inner_mul_inner
    (WithLp.toLp 2 x) (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x))
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm] at h
  change ∑ i, ⟪WithLp.toLp 2 x, hA.eigenvectorBasis i⟫_𝕜 *
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (A *ᵥ x) i = NLAlib.quadForm A x at h
  rw [← h, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec, ← inner_conj_symm]
  change RCLike.re (star (hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i) *
    ((hA.eigenvalues i : 𝕜) * hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i)) = _
  rw [mul_left_comm, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul,
    ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.rayleighQuotient_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates (x : n → 𝕜) :
    NLAlib.rayleighQuotient A x =
      (∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i‖ ^ 2) /
        (∑ i, ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_def, hA.re_quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates,
    hA.sum_sq_norm_eigenvectorCoordinates]
  congr 1
  rw [dotProduct_comm, ← EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 x), inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
  simp

name: CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_rectangularDilation
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_rectangularDilation (Y : Matrix m n A) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (rectangularDilation Y)
proof:
:= by

  exact NLAlib.isHermitian_dilation Y

name: CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_rowGram
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_rowGram (Y : Matrix m n A) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ))
proof:
:= by
  change (Y * Yᴴ)ᴴ = Y * Yᴴ
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_columnGram
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_columnGram (Y : Matrix m n A) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (ofMatrix (Yᴴ * Y))

:= by

name: CStarMatrix.notMem_spectrum_zero_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem notMem_spectrum_zero_of_ne_zero
    (D : Type*) [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    r ∉ spectrum ℝ (0 : CStarMatrix D D A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.notMem_iff, sub_zero]
  exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hr).map (algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix D D A))

name: CStarMatrix.mem_spectrum_real_rowGram_iff_columnGram_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_real_rowGram_iff_columnGram_of_ne_zero
    (Y : Matrix m n A) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)) ↔
      r ∈ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Yᴴ * Y))
proof:
:= by
  let U : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A := ofMatrix (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Y 0 0)
  let V : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A := ofMatrix (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 0 Yᴴ 0)
  have hUV : U * V = blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ), (0 : CStarMatrix n n A)) := by
    change Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Y 0 0 * Matrix.fromBlocks 0 0 Yᴴ 0 = Matrix.fromBlocks (Y * Yᴴ) 0 0 0
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero]
  have hVU : V * U = blockDiagonalStarAlgHom ((0 : CStarMatrix m m A), ofMatrix (Yᴴ * Y)) := by
    change Matrix.fromBlocks 0 0 Yᴴ 0 * Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Y 0 0 = Matrix.fromBlocks 0 0 0 (Yᴴ * Y)
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
  have h := spectrum.unit_mem_mul_comm (R := ℝ) (a := U) (b := V) (r := Units.mk0 r hr)
  rw [hUV, hVU,
    spectrum_real_blockDiagonal _ _ (isSelfAdjoint_rowGram Y) (by change star (0 : CStarMatrix n n A) = 0; simp),
    spectrum_real_blockDiagonal _ _ (by change star (0 : CStarMatrix m m A) = 0; simp) (isSelfAdjoint_columnGram Y)] at h
  simpa only [Units.val_mk0, Set.mem_union,
    notMem_spectrum_zero_of_ne_zero (A := A) n hr,
    notMem_spectrum_zero_of_ne_zero (A := A) m hr, or_false, false_or] using h

name: CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation_sq
statement:
theorem rectangularDilation_sq (Y : Matrix m n A) :
    rectangularDilation Y ^ 2 =
      blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ), ofMatrix (Yᴴ * Y))
proof:
:= by
  change (NLAlib.dilation Y) ^ 2 = Matrix.fromBlocks (Y * Yᴴ) 0 0 (Yᴴ * Y)
  simp only [NLAlib.dilation, pow_two, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
    Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]

name: CStarMatrix.sq_image_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation
statement:
theorem sq_image_spectrum_real_rectangularDilation (Y : Matrix m n A) :
    (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2) '' spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation Y) =
      spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Y * Yᴴ)) ∪ spectrum ℝ (ofMatrix (Yᴴ * Y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_map_spectrum (a := rectangularDilation Y) (f := fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2)
    (isSelfAdjoint_rectangularDilation Y),
    cfc_pow_id (R := ℝ) (rectangularDilation Y) 2 (isSelfAdjoint_rectangularDilation Y),
    rectangularDilation_sq]
  exact spectrum_real_blockDiagonal _ _ (isSelfAdjoint_rowGram Y) (isSelfAdjoint_columnGram Y)

name: NLAlib.exists_real_orthogonal_similarity_of_complex_unitary_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_real_orthogonal_similarity_of_complex_unitary_similarity
    (A B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)
    (hAB : ∀ i, (A i).map Complex.ofReal =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (B i).map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ ∀ i, A i = Q * B i * Qᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hUUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hmap (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
      (M.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ = Mᵀ.map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hinter (i : ι) : (A i).map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (B i).map Complex.ofReal := by
    rw [hAB i, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUUt, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hAdj (i : ι) : (A i)ᵀ.map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (B i)ᵀ.map Complex.ofReal := by
    have hsim : ((A i).map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ =
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * ((B i).map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
        Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (hAB i)
    rw [← hmap, ← hmap, hsim, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUUt, Matrix.mul_one]
  let A' : Sum ι ι → Matrix n n ℝ := Sum.elim A (fun i => (A i)ᵀ)
  let B' : Sum ι ι → Matrix n n ℝ := Sum.elim B (fun i => (B i)ᵀ)
  have hfamily (k : Sum ι ι) : (A' k).map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (B' k).map Complex.ofReal := by
    cases k with
    | inl i => exact hinter i
    | inr i => exact hAdj i
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hAT⟩ := exists_real_isUnit_intertwiner_of_complex
    (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := U)) hfamily
  have hTt : IsUnit Tᵀ := Tᵀ.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mpr
    (by simpa only [Matrix.det_transpose] using T.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hT)
  have hGram : IsUnit (Tᵀ * T) := hTt.mul hT
  let Q := polarFrame T
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q := hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame T hGram
  have hQt : Q * Qᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hAQ : A i * Q = Q * B i :=
    mul_polarFrame_eq_polarFrame_mul_of_intertwining (A i) (B i) T hGram
      (hAT (Sum.inl i)) (hAT (Sum.inr i))
  calc
    A i = A i * (Q * Qᵀ) := by rw [hQt, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = Q * B i * Qᵀ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAQ]

name: NLAlib.real_similarity_descent_properties
statement:
theorem real_similarity_descent_properties (A B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∀ S : Matrix n n ℂ, IsUnit S →
      (∀ i, (A i).map Complex.ofReal = S * (B i).map Complex.ofReal * S⁻¹) →
      ∃ T : Matrix n n ℝ, IsUnit T ∧ ∀ i, A i = T * B i * T⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
      (∀ i, (A i).map Complex.ofReal =
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (B i).map Complex.ofReal * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) →
      ∃ Q : Matrix n n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ ∀ i, A i = Q * B i * Qᵀ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ hS hAB => exists_real_similarity_of_complex_similarity hS hAB,
    fun U hAB => exists_real_orthogonal_similarity_of_complex_unitary_similarity A B U hAB⟩

name: NLAlib.isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_diagonal_congruence
statement:
theorem isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_diagonal_congruence
    {A B X : Matrix n n ℝ} {a b : n → ℝ}
    (hA : IsUnit A) (hX : IsUnit X)
    (hXA : Xᵀ * A * X = diagonal a) (hXB : Xᵀ * B * X = diagonal b) :
    IsDiagonalizable (A⁻¹ * B)
proof:
:= by
  have hXt : IsUnit Xᵀ := (Matrix.isUnit_transpose X).mpr hX
  have hDa : IsUnit (diagonal a) := hXA ▸ (hXt.mul hA).mul hX
  have hDiag : diagonal a * diagonal (fun i => (a i)⁻¹ * b i) = diagonal b := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    have hai : a i ≠ 0 := ((Matrix.isUnit_diagonal.mp hDa).apply i).ne_zero
    simp [hai]
  refine ⟨X, fun i => (a i)⁻¹ * b i, hX, ?_⟩
  apply (hXt.mul hA).mul_left_cancel
  calc
    (Xᵀ * A) * ((A⁻¹ * B) * X) = Xᵀ * B * X := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc A A⁻¹, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A
        ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = diagonal b := hXB
    _ = (Xᵀ * A) * (X * diagonal (fun i => (a i)⁻¹ * b i)) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hXA, hDiag]

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_congruence_of_isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_congruence_of_isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hT : IsDiagonalizable (A⁻¹ * B)) :
    ∃ (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n → ℝ), IsUnit X ∧
      Xᵀ * A * X = diagonal a ∧ Xᵀ * B * X = diagonal b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, d, hV, hTV⟩ := hT
  let C := Vᵀ * A * V
  let D := diagonal d
  have hC : C.IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [C, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul V hA
  have hD : D.IsHermitian := isHermitian_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun _ => star_trivial _)
  have hCD : C * D = Vᵀ * B * V := by
    calc
      C * D = Vᵀ * A * (V * D) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = Vᵀ * (A * A⁻¹) * B * V := by rw [← hTV]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Vᵀ * B * V := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hAu), Matrix.mul_one]
  have hCDsym : (C * D).IsHermitian := by
    rw [hCD]
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul V hB
  have hComm : Commute C D := (hC.commute_iff hD).mpr hCDsym
  obtain ⟨U, a, e, hU, hCU, hDU⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_congruence_diagonal_of_commute hC hD hComm
  have hUu : IsUnit U := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det U).mpr
    (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hU)
  have hUU : U * Uᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
  refine ⟨V * U, a, fun i => a i * e i, hV.mul hUu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, C] using hCU
  · calc
      (V * U)ᵀ * B * (V * U) = Uᵀ * (C * D) * U := by
        rw [hCD, Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (Uᵀ * C * U) * (Uᵀ * D * U) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc U Uᵀ, hUU, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = diagonal (fun i => a i * e i) := by
        rw [hCU, hDU, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_congruence_iff_isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_congruence_iff_isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∃ (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n → ℝ), IsUnit X ∧
      Xᵀ * A * X = diagonal a ∧ Xᵀ * B * X = diagonal b) ↔
      IsDiagonalizable (A⁻¹ * B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨X, a, b, hX, hXA, hXB⟩
    exact isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul_of_diagonal_congruence hAu hX hXA hXB
  · exact exists_diagonal_congruence_of_isDiagonalizable_inverse_mul hA hAu hB

name: NLAlib.singularValues_mul_add_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_mul_add_le {m p n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m p ℝ) (B : Matrix p n ℝ) (i j : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A * B) (i + j) ≤ singularValues A i * singularValues B j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := truncatedSVD A i * B + (A - truncatedSVD A i) * truncatedSVD B j
  have hC : C.rank ≤ i + j :=
    (rank_add_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD A i).1)
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD B j).1))
  have hdiff : A * B - C = (A - truncatedSVD A i) * (B - truncatedSVD B j) := by
    simp only [C, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub]
    abel
  calc
    singularValues (A * B) (i + j) ≤ specNorm (A * B - C) :=
      singularValues_le_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le _ _ hC
    _ = specNorm ((A - truncatedSVD A i) * (B - truncatedSVD B j)) := by rw [hdiff]
    _ ≤ specNorm (A - truncatedSVD A i) * specNorm (B - truncatedSVD B j) :=
      specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ = singularValues A i * singularValues B j := by
      rw [specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq, specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq]

name: NLAlib.normal_real_smul
statement:
theorem normal_real_smul {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (c : ℝ) :
    (c•A)*(c•A)ᴴ=(c•A)ᴴ*(c•A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_trivial, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, hA]

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_eq_sum_width
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_eq_sum_width {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    bestRankFrobSq A k =
      ∑ i : Fin n, if k ≤ (i : ℕ) then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0
  have hsum (d : ℕ) (hd : min m n ≤ d) :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, f i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), f i := by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hd)
    intro i _ hi
    have hz := singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (k := i)
      (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Fintype.card_fin] using hi)
    simp [f, hz]
  have hm := hsum m (min_le_left m n)
  have hn := hsum n (min_le_right m n)
  change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin m)), f i) = ∑ i : Fin n, f i
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f]
  exact hm.trans hn.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm
statement:
theorem exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) 𝕜) (U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜)
      (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜)
      (S₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) 𝕜),
      A = U₁ * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜) * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᴴ ∧
      HasOrthonormalCols U₂ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols V₁ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols V₂ ∧
      V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0 ∧ specNorm S₂ = singularValues A k ∧
      frobSq S₂ = bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, n = k + r := ⟨n - k, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let V₁ : Matrix (Fin (k + r)) (Fin k) 𝕜 := V.submatrix id (Fin.castAdd r)
  let V₂ : Matrix (Fin (k + r)) (Fin r) 𝕜 := V.submatrix id (Fin.natAdd k)
  let D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin (k + r)) 𝕜 := rectDiag (singularValues A)
  let S₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) 𝕜 := D.submatrix id (Fin.natAdd k)
  have hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁ := by
    change V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1
    have he : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = (Vᴴ * V).submatrix (Fin.castAdd r) (Fin.castAdd r) := rfl
    rw [he, show Vᴴ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fin.castAdd_inj]
  have hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂ := by
    change V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1
    have he : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = (Vᴴ * V).submatrix (Fin.natAdd k) (Fin.natAdd k) := rfl
    rw [he, show Vᴴ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fin.natAdd_inj]
  have hcross : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0 := by
    have he : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = (Vᴴ * V).submatrix (Fin.castAdd r) (Fin.natAdd k) := rfl
    rw [he, show Vᴴ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right]
    ext i j
    have hij : Fin.castAdd r i ≠ Fin.natAdd k j := by
      intro heq
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val heq
      simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd] at hv
      omega
    simp [hij]
  have hcomplete : V₁ * V₁ᴴ + V₂ * V₂ᴴ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (k + r)) (Fin (k + r)) 𝕜 => M i j)
      (show V * Vᴴ = 1 from h.mul_conjTranspose_right)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_add,
      Matrix.add_apply, V₁, V₂, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq] using he
  have hAV₂ : A * V₂ = U * S₂ := by
    have he : A * V₂ = (A * V).submatrix id (Fin.natAdd k) := rfl
    rw [h.mul_right] at he
    exact he
  have hA : A = (A * V₁) * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜) * V₁ᴴ + U * S₂ * V₂ᴴ := by
    calc
      A = A * (V₁ * V₁ᴴ + V₂ * V₂ᴴ) := by rw [hcomplete, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (A * V₁) * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜) * V₁ᴴ + U * S₂ * V₂ᴴ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc A V₁, ← Matrix.mul_assoc A V₂,
          hAV₂, Matrix.mul_one]
  let T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin (k + r)) 𝕜 :=
    rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then 0 else singularValues A i)
  have hST : S₂ * V₂ᴴ = T * Vᴴ := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_add]
    have hhead : ∑ a : Fin k, T i (Fin.castAdd r a) * star (V j (Fin.castAdd r a)) = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a _ => ?_
      by_cases hd : (i : ℕ) = a
      · simp [T, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hd]
      · simp [T, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hd]
    rw [hhead, zero_add]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    by_cases hd : (i : ℕ) = k + b
    · simp [S₂, D, V₂, T, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hd]
    · simp [S₂, D, V₂, T, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hd]
  have htail : U * S₂ * V₂ᴴ = A - h.truncatedMatrix k := by
    have hsplit : A = h.truncatedMatrix k + U * T * Vᴴ := h.eq_head_add_tail k
    calc U * S₂ * V₂ᴴ = U * T * Vᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hST, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (h.truncatedMatrix k + U * T * Vᴴ) - h.truncatedMatrix k := by abel
      _ = A - h.truncatedMatrix k := by rw [← hsplit]
  have hspec : specNorm S₂ = singularValues A k := by
    rw [← h.specNorm_sub_truncatedMatrix k, ← htail,
      specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV₂,
      specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_left]
  have hfrob : frobSq S₂ = bestRankFrobSq A k := by
    rw [← h.frobSq_sub_truncatedMatrix k, ← htail,
      frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV₂.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal h.conjTranspose_mul_left]
  exact ⟨r, A * V₁, U, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, h.conjTranspose_mul_left, hV₁, hV₂, hcross, hspec, hfrob⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_svd_right_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_svd_right_blocks {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) 𝕜) (U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜)
      (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜) (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜)
      (S₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) 𝕜),
      A = U₁ * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) 𝕜) * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᴴ ∧
      HasOrthonormalCols U₂ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols V₁ ∧ HasOrthonormalCols V₂ ∧
      V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0 ∧ frobSq S₂ = bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, _, hF⟩ :=
    exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm A k hkn
  exact ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, hF⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_common_mulVec_eigenvector_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_common_mulVec_eigenvector_of_commute [Nonempty n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    ∃ (x : n → ℂ) (d : ι → ℂ), x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, A i *ᵥ x = d i • x
proof:
:= by
  let f (i : ι) : Module.End ℂ (n → ℂ) := (A i).toLin'
  have hf : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (f i) (f j) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact (hcomm hij).map Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'.toRingHom
  exact exists_common_eigenvector_of_pairwise_commute f hf

name: NLAlib.exists_simultaneous_unitary_schur_triangularization
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneous_unitary_schur_triangularization
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j))
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (T : ι → Matrix n n ℂ), ∀ a,
      A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
      (∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → T a i j = 0) ∧
      (A a).charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T a i i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f (a : ι) : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := (A a).toEuclideanLin
  have hfcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (f a) (f b) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact (hcomm hab).map (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℂ n)).toRingHom
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_simultaneous_upper_triangular
    (Fintype.card n) f hfcomm (finrank_euclideanSpace (𝕜 := ℂ))
  let b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := b₀.reindex e
  let c := EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    ⟨c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis, c.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b⟩
  let T (a : ι) : Matrix n n ℂ := (f a).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hUUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hback : b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
      (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_right_inverse hUU) |>.mul_left_cancel
    change c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis =
