      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
    rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, hUU]
  refine ⟨U, T, fun a => ?_⟩
  have hA : A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    have hbasis := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      c.toBasis b.toBasis c.toBasis b.toBasis (f a)
    have hstd : (f a).toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = A a :=
      LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin c.toBasis c.toBasis (A a)
    calc
      A a = (f a).toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis := hstd.symm
      _ = c.toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis * (f a).toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis *
          b.toBasis.toMatrix c.toBasis := hbasis.symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hback]
  have htri : ∀ i j, e.symm j < e.symm i → T a i j = 0 := by
    intro i j hij
    simp only [T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
    simpa only [b, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply] using hb₀ a (e.symm i) (e.symm j) hij
  have hTfin : ((T a).submatrix e e).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    exact htri (e i) (e j) (by simpa using hij)
  have hchar : (T a).charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T a i i)) := by
    calc
      (T a).charpoly = ((T a).submatrix e e).charpoly := (Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm (T a)).symm
      _ = ∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T a (e i) (e i))) :=
        Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ hTfin
      _ = _ := e.prod_comp (fun i => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (T a i i))
  refine ⟨hA, htri, ?_⟩
  rw [hA, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUUt, Matrix.one_mul, hchar]

name: NLAlib.norm_eq_re_of_im_eq_zero_of_re_pos
statement:
theorem norm_eq_re_of_im_eq_zero_of_re_pos {z : ℂ} (hi : z.im = 0) (hr : 0 < z.re) :
    ‖z‖ = z.re
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z = (z.re : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hi]
  calc
    ‖z‖ = ‖(z.re : ℂ)‖ := congrArg norm hz
    _ = z.re := by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]

name: NLAlib.re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_strict_diagonal_dominance
statement:
theorem re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_strict_diagonal_dominance
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hdiag : ∀ i, (A i i).im = 0)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < (A i i).re)
    (hstrict : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : 0 < μ.re
proof:
:= by
  apply re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_row_radius_lt_re_diag _ hμ
  intro i
  simpa only [norm_eq_re_of_im_eq_zero_of_re_pos (hdiag i) (hpos i)] using hstrict i

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_isHermitian_of_strict_diagonal_dominance
statement:
theorem posDef_of_isHermitian_of_strict_diagonal_dominance
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < A i i)
    (hstrict : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply posDef_of_isHermitian_of_row_radius_lt_diag hA
  intro i
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hpos i)] using hstrict i

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_isHermitian_of_strict_diagonal_dominance_complex
statement:
theorem posDef_of_isHermitian_of_strict_diagonal_dominance_complex
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, (A i i).im = 0) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < (A i i).re)
    (hstrict : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos.mpr
  intro i
  have hmem : (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ A :=
    spectrum.algebraMap_mem ℂ (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
  exact re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_strict_diagonal_dominance hdiag hpos hstrict hmem

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_isHermitian_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance_complex
statement:
theorem posDef_of_isHermitian_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance_complex
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hIrred : (A.map norm).IsIrreducible)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, (A i i).im = 0) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < (A i i).re)
    (hweak : ∀ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i ≤ ‖A i i‖)
    (hstrict : ∃ i, gershgorinRowRadius A i < ‖A i i‖) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos.mpr
  intro i
  have hmem : (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ A :=
    spectrum.algebraMap_mem ℂ (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
  exact re_pos_of_mem_spectrum_of_irreducible_weak_diagonal_dominance
    hIrred hdiag hpos hweak hstrict hmem

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_mul_eq_mul_of_isCoprime_charpoly
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ := hcop
  have hB : aeval A B.charpoly * X = 0 := by
    rw [aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hX, Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly, Matrix.mul_zero]
  have heval := congrArg (aeval A) hpq
  have hid : aeval A q * aeval A B.charpoly = 1 := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul, map_one, Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly,
      Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add] using heval
  calc
    X = (aeval A q * aeval A B.charpoly) * X := by rw [hid, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hB, Matrix.mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_of_isCoprime_charpoly
statement:
theorem sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_of_isCoprime_charpoly (A : Matrix m m K)
    (B : Matrix n n K) (hcop : IsCoprime A.charpoly B.charpoly) :
    Function.Bijective (sylvesterLinearMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (sylvesterLinearMap A B) := by
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro X hX
    exact eq_zero_of_mul_eq_mul_of_isCoprime_charpoly hcop (sub_eq_zero.mp hX)
  exact ⟨hinj, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_sylvester_of_isCoprime_charpoly
statement:
theorem existsUnique_sylvester_of_isCoprime_charpoly (A : Matrix m m K)
    (B : Matrix n n K) (hcop : IsCoprime A.charpoly B.charpoly) (C : Matrix m n K) :
    ∃! X : Matrix m n K, A * X - X * B = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := (sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_of_isCoprime_charpoly A B hcop).2 C
  refine ⟨X, hX, fun Y hY => ?_⟩
  exact (sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_of_isCoprime_charpoly A B hcop).1 (hY.trans hX.symm)

name: NLAlib.isCoprime_charpoly_iff_disjoint_spectrum
statement:
theorem isCoprime_charpoly_iff_disjoint_spectrum [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    IsCoprime A.charpoly B.charpoly ↔ Disjoint (spectrum K A) (spectrum K B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Polynomial.isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed K K A.charpoly B.charpoly,
    Set.disjoint_left]
  simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval,
    Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Polynomial.IsRoot]
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    exact (h a).resolve_left (not_not.mpr ha)
  · intro h a
    by_cases ha : A.charpoly.eval a = 0
    · exact Or.inr (h ha)
    · exact Or.inl ha

name: NLAlib.sylvesterLinearMap_injective_iff_disjoint_spectrum
statement:
theorem sylvesterLinearMap_injective_iff_disjoint_spectrum [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    Function.Injective (sylvesterLinearMap A B) ↔
      Disjoint (spectrum K A) (spectrum K B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hinj
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro μ hA hB
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hA
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyB⟩ := exists_vecMul_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hB
    have hXY : sylvesterLinearMap A B (Matrix.vecMulVec x y) =
        sylvesterLinearMap A B 0 := by
      change A * Matrix.vecMulVec x y - Matrix.vecMulVec x y * B =
        A * (0 : Matrix m n K) - (0 : Matrix m n K) * B
      rw [mul_vecMulVec_eq_vecMulVec_mul hAx hyB, sub_self, Matrix.mul_zero,
        Matrix.zero_mul, sub_self]
    exact vecMulVec_ne_zero hx hy (hinj hXY)
  · intro hdisj
    exact (sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_of_isCoprime_charpoly A B
      ((isCoprime_charpoly_iff_disjoint_spectrum A B).mpr hdisj)).1

name: NLAlib.sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_iff_disjoint_spectrum
statement:
theorem sylvesterLinearMap_bijective_iff_disjoint_spectrum [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) :
    Function.Bijective (sylvesterLinearMap A B) ↔
      Disjoint (spectrum K A) (spectrum K B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.Bijective, ← LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective, and_self,
    sylvesterLinearMap_injective_iff_disjoint_spectrum]

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_sylvester_of_disjoint_spectrum
statement:
theorem existsUnique_sylvester_of_disjoint_spectrum [IsAlgClosed K]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (spectrum K A) (spectrum K B)) (C : Matrix m n K) :
    ∃! X : Matrix m n K, A * X - X * B = C
proof:
:=
  existsUnique_sylvester_of_isCoprime_charpoly A B
    ((isCoprime_charpoly_iff_disjoint_spectrum A B).mpr hdisj) C

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_mul_eq_mul_of_disjoint_spectrum
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_mul_eq_mul_of_isCoprime_charpoly
    ((isCoprime_charpoly_iff_disjoint_spectrum A B).mpr hdisj) hX

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.sum_singularTail_eq_sum_rank
statement:
private theorem sum_singularTail_eq_sum_rank (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (l N : ℕ)
    (hN : A.rank ≤ N) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, if l ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, if l ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hN)
  intro i _ hi
  have hσ := singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A
    (show A.rank ≤ i by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi)
  simp only [hσ, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), ite_self]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.bestRankFrobSq_eq_sum_width
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_eq_sum_width (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (l : ℕ) :
    bestRankFrobSq A l =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), if l ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bestRankFrobSq
  rw [sum_singularTail_eq_sum_rank A l _ A.rank_le_card_height,
    sum_singularTail_eq_sum_rank A l _ A.rank_le_card_width]

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.bestRankFrobSq_pos_of_lt_rank
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_pos_of_lt_rank (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {l : ℕ} (hl : l < A.rank) :
    0 < bestRankFrobSq A l
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : 0 < singularValues A l := (singularValues_pos_iff A l).mpr hl
  have hi : l ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card m) :=
    Finset.mem_range.mpr (hl.trans_le A.rank_le_card_height)
  have hs := Finset.single_le_sum
    (s := Finset.range (Fintype.card m))
    (f := fun i => if l ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0)
    (fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> positivity) hi
  have ht : 0 < (if l ≤ l then singularValues A l ^ 2 else 0) := by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos hσ
  exact ht.trans_le hs

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_column_embedding_posDef_gram_trace_inv_le_tail
statement:
theorem exists_column_embedding_posDef_gram_trace_inv_le_tail
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (l : ℕ) (hl : l < A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin l ↪ n,
      ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).PosDef ∧
      ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e)⁻¹.trace ≤
        (l : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n - l) / bestRankFrobSq A l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlw : l ≤ Fintype.card n := hl.le.trans A.rank_le_card_width
  obtain ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, hQ, _hQt, hR, _hUpper, hFact, _hEntry, hBudget⟩ :=
    exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks A l hl.le
  let e : Fin l ↪ n :=
    ⟨fun i => π (Sum.inl i), π.injective.comp Sum.inl_injective⟩
  let C := A.submatrix id e
  let W := Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T)
    (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - l)) (Fin l) ℝ) D
  let V := Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T)
    (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - l)) (Fin l) ℝ)
    (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - l)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - l)) ℝ)
  have hC : C = Q * Matrix.fromRows R (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - l)) (Fin l) ℝ) := by
    change (A.submatrix id π).submatrix id Sum.inl = _
    rw [hFact]
    have hprod : (Q * W).submatrix id Sum.inl = Q * (W.submatrix id Sum.inl) := rfl
    change (Q * W).submatrix id Sum.inl = _
    rw [hprod]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    cases i <;> rfl
  have hGram : Cᵀ * C = Rᵀ * R := by
    rw [hC, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᵀ Q, show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.transpose_fromRows, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows,
      Matrix.transpose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hGramUnit : IsUnit (Cᵀ * C) := by
    rw [hGram, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR).mul ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR)
  have hGramPos : (Cᵀ * C).PosDef := by
    have hp : (Cᵀ * C).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self C
    exact hp.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr hGramUnit
  have hInvTrace : (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹.trace = frobSq R⁻¹ := by
    rw [hGram, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv,
      frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  have hVRank : V.rank ≤ l := by
    have hV : V =
        Matrix.fromRows (1 : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) ℝ)
          (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - l)) (Fin l) ℝ) *
        Matrix.fromCols R (R * T) := by
      rw [Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols]
      simp only [Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul]
      rfl
    rw [hV]
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans (by simpa using
      (Matrix.fromCols R (R * T)).rank_le_card_height)
  have hTailEq : bestRankFrobSq (A.submatrix id π) l = bestRankFrobSq A l := by
    have hh := singularValues_reindex A (Equiv.refl m) π.symm
    change singularValues (A.submatrix id π) = singularValues A at hh
    simp only [bestRankFrobSq, hh]
  have hResidual : frobSq (A.submatrix id π - Q * V) = frobSq D := by
    rw [hFact]
    change frobSq (Q * W - Q * V) = _
    rw [← Matrix.mul_sub, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]
    have hdiff : W - V = Matrix.fromBlocks
        (0 : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) ℝ)
        (0 : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin (Fintype.card n - l)) ℝ)
        (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - l)) (Fin l) ℝ) D := by
      ext i j
      cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [W, V]
    rw [hdiff, frobSq_fromBlocks]
    simp only [frobSq_zero, zero_add]
  have hTail : bestRankFrobSq A l ≤ frobSq D := by
    rw [← hResidual, ← hTailEq]
    exact bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le _ _ l
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Q V).trans hVRank)
  have hE : 0 < bestRankFrobSq A l := bestRankFrobSq_pos_of_lt_rank A hl
  refine ⟨e, hGramPos, ?_⟩
  change (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹.trace ≤ _
  rw [hInvTrace]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hE).mpr
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTail (frobSq_nonneg R⁻¹)
  have hTnon : 0 ≤ frobSq T := frobSq_nonneg T
  simpa only [Nat.cast_sub hlw] using (hh.trans (by linarith :
    frobSq R⁻¹ * frobSq D ≤ (l : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n - l)))

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_linearMap
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_linearMap (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A k = (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).singularValues k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.singularValues_nonneg
statement:
theorem singularValues_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ singularValues A k
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.singularValues_nonneg _ _

name: NLAlib.singularValues_antitone
statement:
theorem singularValues_antitone (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    Antitone (singularValues A)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => LinearMap.singularValues_antitone _ h

name: NLAlib.singularValues_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem singularValues_ne_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues A k ≠ 0 ↔ k < A.rank
proof:
:= by
  unfold singularValues
  rw [← LinearMap.singularValues_pos_iff_ne_zero,
    LinearMap.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range,
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal, ← Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_pos_iff
statement:
theorem singularValues_pos_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < singularValues A k ↔ k < A.rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← singularValues_ne_zero_iff, (singularValues_nonneg A k).lt_iff_ne', ne_comm]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : A.rank ≤ k) : singularValues A k = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact absurd ((singularValues_ne_zero_iff A k).1 h) (not_lt.2 hk)

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_congr
statement:
private lemma eigenvalues_congr {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {T₁ T₂ : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (h : T₁ = T₂) (h₁ : T₁.IsSymmetric)
    (h₂ : T₂.IsSymmetric) {d : ℕ} (hd : Module.finrank 𝕜 E = d) (i : Fin d) :
    h₁.eigenvalues hd i = h₂.eigenvalues hd i
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    singularValues A i ^ 2 = (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : LinearMap.adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) ∘ₗ Matrix.toEuclideanLin A =
      Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Aᴴ * A) := by
    rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint]
    simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
  rw [singularValues_eq_linearMap,
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).sq_singularValues_of_lt finrank_euclideanSpace i.isLt]
  exact eigenvalues_congr heq _ _ finrank_euclideanSpace i

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_zero_of_height_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_zero_of_height_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Fintype.card m ≤ k) : singularValues A k = 0
proof:
:=
  singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (A.rank_le_card_height.trans hk)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Fintype.card n ≤ k) : singularValues A k = 0
proof:
:=
  singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (A.rank_le_card_width.trans hk)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ k) : singularValues A k = 0
proof:
:=
  singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A
    ((le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width).trans hk)

name: NLAlib.rank_eq_card_singularValues_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rank_eq_card_singularValues_ne_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    A.rank = ((Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))).filter
      fun k => singularValues A k ≠ 0).card
proof:
:= by
  have hr : A.rank ≤ min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) :=
    le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width
  have : ((Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))).filter
      fun k => singularValues A k ≠ 0) = Finset.range A.rank := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, singularValues_ne_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h.trans_le hr, h⟩⟩
  rw [this, Finset.card_range]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem singularValues_map_ofReal (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) k = singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k < Fintype.card n
  · have h₁ := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) ⟨k, hk⟩
    have h₂ := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hB := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
    have hG : (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜))ᴴ * A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) =
        (Aᴴ * A).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, map_sum]
    have hl : List.ofFn (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self
        (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜))).eigenvalues₀ = List.ofFn hB.eigenvalues₀ := by
      rw [← (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self _).sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀,
        ← hB.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀, hG, Matrix.charpoly_map,
        hB.splits_charpoly.roots_map]
      simp only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, RCLike.re_to_real,
        RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, RCLike.ofReal_re]
    have he := congrFun (List.ofFn_inj.mp hl) ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hs : singularValues (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) k ^ 2 = singularValues A k ^ 2 :=
      h₁.trans (he.trans h₂.symm)
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (singularValues_nonneg _ k) (singularValues_nonneg A k)).1 hs
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le _ (not_lt.1 hk),
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le _ (not_lt.1 hk)]

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_apply_ofReal
statement:
theorem rectDiag_apply_ofReal (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) i j = if (i : ℕ) = j then (σ i : 𝕜) else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_apply
statement:
theorem rectDiag_apply (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) i j = if (i : ℕ) = j then σ i else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.transpose_rectDiag
statement:
theorem transpose_rectDiag (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)ᵀ = rectDiag σ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
  · rw [h₁]
  · exact absurd h₁.symm h₂
  · exact absurd h₂.symm h₁
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_rectDiag
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_rectDiag (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)ᴴ = rectDiag σ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
  · rw [h₁, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal]
  · exact absurd h₁.symm h₂
  · exact absurd h₂.symm h₁
  · exact star_zero _

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)ᴴ * rectDiag σ =
      Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < m then ((σ j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjTranspose_rectDiag]
  ext j l
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  by_cases hjm : (j : ℕ) < m
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨j, hjm⟩]
    · by_cases hjl : j = l
      · subst hjl; simp [hjm, sq]
      · have : (j : ℕ) ≠ l := fun h => hjl (Fin.ext h)
        simp [hjl, this]
    · intro i _ hi
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hi (Fin.ext h.symm)), zero_mul]
    · simp
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · split_ifs <;> simp_all
    · intro i _
      rw [if_neg (fun (h : (j : ℕ) = i) => hjm (h ▸ i.isLt)), zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag
statement:
theorem rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag σ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) * (rectDiag σ)ᴴ =
      Matrix.diagonal fun i : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) < n then ((σ i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← conjTranspose_rectDiag (𝕜 := 𝕜) (m := n) (n := m) σ, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_add
statement:
theorem rectDiag_add (σ τ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag (σ + τ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) = rectDiag σ + rectDiag τ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Matrix.add_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_self_of_orthonormalBasis
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self_of_orthonormalBasis {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => c j i : Matrix m ι 𝕜)ᴴ * (Matrix.of fun i j => c j i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.one_apply, ← c.inner_eq_ite, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_eq_one_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_eq_one_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {p : ℕ} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜}
    (hp : Fintype.card m = p) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) : U * Uᴴ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin p ≃ m := (finCongr hp.symm).trans (Fintype.equivFin m).symm
  have h1 : (Uᴴ.submatrix e.symm (Equiv.refl m)) * U.submatrix (Equiv.refl m) e.symm = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hU, Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
  have h2 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 h1
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h2
  exact h2

name: NLAlib.card_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem card_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {p : ℕ} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜}
    (h₁ : Uᴴ * U = 1) (h₂ : U * Uᴴ = 1) : Fintype.card m = p
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.trace h₁
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, h₂, Matrix.trace_one, Matrix.trace_one, Fintype.card_fin] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: NLAlib.exists_isSVD
statement:
theorem exists_isSVD (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p q : ℕ}
    (hp : Fintype.card m = p := by first | exact Fintype.card_fin _ | rfl)
    (hq : Fintype.card n = q := by first | exact Fintype.card_fin _ | rfl) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜) (V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜), IsSVD A U V
proof:
:= by
  subst hp hq
  have hn : finrank 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) = Fintype.card n := finrank_euclideanSpace
  have hT := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self
  have hsq : ∀ j : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues A j ^ 2 = hT.eigenvalues hn j :=
    fun j => (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).sq_singularValues_of_lt hn j.isLt
  
  have key : ∀ i j, inner 𝕜 (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (hT.eigenvectorBasis hn i))
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (hT.eigenvectorBasis hn j)) =
      if i = j then ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [← LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    have := hT.apply_eigenvectorBasis hn j
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this, hsq, inner_smul_right, (hT.eigenvectorBasis hn).inner_eq_ite]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hlt : ∀ k : ℕ, singularValues A k ≠ 0 → k < Fintype.card m := fun k hk =>
    ((singularValues_ne_zero_iff A k).1 hk).trans_le A.rank_le_card_height
  have hltn : ∀ k : ℕ, singularValues A k ≠ 0 → k < Fintype.card n := fun k hk =>
    ((singularValues_ne_zero_iff A k).1 hk).trans_le A.rank_le_card_width
  generalize hσ : singularValues A = σ at hsq key hlt hltn
  generalize hT.eigenvectorBasis hn = b at key
  generalize hTdef : Matrix.toEuclideanLin A = T at key
  
  let v : Fin (Fintype.card m) → EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card n then ((σ i : 𝕜))⁻¹ • T (b ⟨i, h⟩) else 0
  let s : Set (Fin (Fintype.card m)) := {i | σ i ≠ 0}
  have hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 (s.domRestrict v) := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hi' := hltn _ hi
    have hj' := hltn _ hj
    simp only [Set.domRestrict_apply, v, dif_pos hi', dif_pos hj', inner_smul_left,
      inner_smul_right, key]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      have : (σ i : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.2 hi
      simp
      field_simp
    · have : (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card n)) ≠ ⟨j, hj'⟩ :=
        fun h => hij (Fin.ext (by simpa using h))
      simp [hij, this]
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq (by simp)
  set U : Matrix m (Fin (Fintype.card m)) 𝕜 := Matrix.of fun i j => c j i
  set V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) 𝕜 := Matrix.of fun i j => b j i
  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := conjTranspose_mul_self_of_orthonormalBasis c
  have hV : Vᴴ * V = 1 := conjTranspose_mul_self_of_orthonormalBasis b
  have hU' : U * Uᴴ = 1 := mul_conjTranspose_eq_one_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one rfl hU
  have hV' : V * Vᴴ = 1 := mul_conjTranspose_eq_one_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one rfl hV
  have hAV : A * V = U * rectDiag σ := by
    ext i j
    have hl : (A * V) i j = T (b j) i := by
      rw [← hTdef]
      simp [V, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [hl]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, U, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Matrix.of_apply, mul_ite, mul_zero]
    by_cases hj : σ j = 0
    · have h0 : T (b j) = 0 := by
        rw [← inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := 𝕜), key, if_pos rfl, hj]; simp
      rw [h0, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      · rfl
      intro k _
      split_ifs with hk
      · rw [hk, hj, RCLike.ofReal_zero, mul_zero]
      · rfl
    · have hjm := hlt j hj
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨j, hjm⟩]
      · rw [if_pos rfl, hc ⟨j, hjm⟩ hj]
        simp only [v, dif_pos j.isLt]
        have : (σ j : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.2 hj
        simp
        field_simp
      · intro k _ hk
        rw [if_neg]
        exact fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
      · simp
  refine ⟨U, V, hU, hV, ?_, hU', hV'⟩
  subst hσ
  rw [← hAV, Matrix.mul_assoc, hV', Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_eq_sum_fin_min
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro k hk; simp at hk ⊢; omega
  · intro k _ hk; exact hf k (by simp only [Finset.mem_range, min_le_iff] at hk ⊢; omega)

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.card_left
statement: theorem card_left (h : IsSVD A U V) : Fintype.card m = p
proof:
:=
  card_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one h.conjTranspose_mul_left h.mul_conjTranspose_left

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.card_right
statement: theorem card_right (h : IsSVD A U V) : Fintype.card n = q
proof:
:=
  card_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one h.conjTranspose_mul_right h.mul_conjTranspose_right

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mul_right
statement: theorem mul_right (h : IsSVD A U V) : A * V = U * rectDiag (singularValues A)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.conjTranspose_mul
statement: theorem conjTranspose_mul (h : IsSVD A U V) : Uᴴ * A = rectDiag (singularValues A) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.conjTranspose_mul_mul
statement: theorem conjTranspose_mul_mul (h : IsSVD A U V) : Uᴴ * A * V = rectDiag (singularValues A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, h.mul_right, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
    Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.conjTranspose_eq
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_eq (h : IsSVD A U V) :
    Aᴴ = V * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin p) 𝕜) * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    conjTranspose_rectDiag, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self (h : IsSVD A U V) :
    Aᴴ * A = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin q => ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin q =>
        if (j : ℕ) < p then ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin q => ((singularValues A j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
    congr 1; funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · rfl
    · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_height_le A (by rw [h.card_left]; exact not_lt.1 hj)]
      simp
  set S : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 := rectDiag (singularValues A)
  calc Aᴴ * A = (U * S * Vᴴ)ᴴ * (U * S * Vᴴ) := by rw [← h.eq]
    _ = V * (Sᴴ * (Uᴴ * U) * S) * Vᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.mul_one, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag, hd]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mul_conjTranspose_self
statement:
theorem mul_conjTranspose_self (h : IsSVD A U V) :
    A * Aᴴ = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p => ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal fun i : Fin p =>
        if (i : ℕ) < q then ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p => ((singularValues A i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
    congr 1; funext i
    split_ifs with hi
    · rfl
    · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A (by rw [h.card_right]; exact not_lt.1 hi)]
      simp
  set S : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 := rectDiag (singularValues A)
  calc A * Aᴴ = (U * S * Vᴴ) * (U * S * Vᴴ)ᴴ := by rw [← h.eq]
    _ = U * (S * (Vᴴ * V) * Sᴴ) * Uᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.mul_one, rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag, hd]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.apply
statement:
theorem apply (h : IsSVD A U V) (i : m) (j : n) :
    A i j = ∑ k : Fin (min p q), (singularValues A k : 𝕜) *
      U i (Fin.castLE (min_le_left p q) k) * star (V j (Fin.castLE (min_le_right p q) k))
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℕ → 𝕜 := fun k => if h : k < p ∧ k < q then
    (singularValues A k : 𝕜) * U i ⟨k, h.1⟩ * star (V j ⟨k, h.2⟩) else 0
  have hg : ∀ k, min p q ≤ k → g k = 0 := fun k hk => by
    simp only [g]; split_ifs
    · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by rw [h.card_left, h.card_right]; exact hk)]
      simp
    · rfl
  have rhs : ∀ k : Fin (min p q), (singularValues A k : 𝕜) *
      U i (Fin.castLE (min_le_left p q) k) * star (V j (Fin.castLE (min_le_right p q) k)) =
      g k := fun k => by
    have h1 : (k : ℕ) < p := lt_of_lt_of_le k.isLt (min_le_left p q)
    have h2 : (k : ℕ) < q := lt_of_lt_of_le k.isLt (min_le_right p q)
    simp only [g, dif_pos (And.intro h1 h2)]; rfl
  simp_rw [rhs]
  rw [← sum_fin_eq_sum_fin_min g hg]
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) < p
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨k, hk⟩]
    · simp only [g, dif_pos (And.intro hk k.isLt), if_true]; ring
    · intro l _ hl; rw [if_neg (fun e => hl (Fin.ext e)), mul_zero]
    · simp
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · simp [g, hk]
    · intro l _; rw [if_neg (fun (e : (l : ℕ) = k) => hk (e ▸ l.isLt)), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.eq_head_add_tail
statement:
theorem eq_head_add_tail (h : IsSVD A U V) (k : ℕ) :
    A = U * (rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then singularValues A i else 0) :
        Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) * Vᴴ +
      U * (rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then 0 else singularValues A i) :
        Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, ← rectDiag_add]
  convert h.eq using 4
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_eq_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_eq_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul {q : ℕ} {S : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    {W : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (hS : S.IsHermitian) {μ : Fin q → ℝ} (hμ : Antitone μ)
    (hW : Wᴴ * W = 1) (hq : Fintype.card n = q)
    (hSW : S = W * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (μ i : 𝕜)) * Wᴴ) (k : Fin q) :
    hS.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast hq.symm k) = μ k
proof:
:= by
  have hc : S.charpoly = (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (μ i : 𝕜)).charpoly := by
    rw [hSW, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm_of_le _ _
      (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, hq]), Fintype.card_fin, hq, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc, hW, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hsort := hS.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀
  rw [hc, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Polynomial.roots_prod _ _ (by
    simp [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero])] at hsort
  simp only [Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Multiset.bind_singleton, Multiset.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_re] at hsort
  have hl : List.ofFn hS.eigenvalues₀ = List.ofFn μ := by
    rw [← hsort]
    simp_rw [Fin.univ_val_map, Multiset.coe_sort]
    apply List.mergeSort_of_pairwise
    simp_rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← List.sortedGE_iff_pairwise]
    exact hμ.sortedGE_ofFn
  have := congrArg (fun l : List ℝ => l.getD k 0) hl
  have hk : (k : ℕ) < Fintype.card n := hq ▸ k.isLt
  simp [hk] at this
  exact this

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hkm : k < p := lt_of_lt_of_le hk (min_le_left p q)
  have hkn : k < q := lt_of_lt_of_le hk (min_le_right p q)
  set μ : Fin q → ℝ := fun j => if (j : ℕ) < p then τ j ^ 2 else 0
  have hμ : Antitone μ := by
    intro a b hab
    simp only [μ]
    split_ifs with hb ha ha
    · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hτ0 _) (hτ hab) 2
    · exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt (Fin.le_def.1 hab) hb) ha
    · exact sq_nonneg _
    · exact le_rfl
  have hAA : Aᴴ * A = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => (μ j : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ := by
    set Sg : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜 := rectDiag τ
    calc Aᴴ * A = (U * Sg * Vᴴ)ᴴ * (U * Sg * Vᴴ) := by rw [← hA]
      _ = V * (Sgᴴ * (Uᴴ * U) * Sg) * Vᴴ := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
        congr 3; funext j
        simp only [μ]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hH := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  have e1 := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A (Fin.cast hq.symm ⟨k, hkn⟩)
  rw [eigenvalues₀_eq_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul hH hμ hV hq hAA] at e1
  simp only [μ, if_pos hkm] at e1
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (singularValues_nonneg A k) (hτ0 k)).1 e1

name: NLAlib.eq_real_schur_block_of_charpoly
statement:
theorem eq_real_schur_block_of_charpoly {A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ}
    {a b : ℝ} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hdiag : A 0 0 = A 1 1)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = (!![a, b; -b, a] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ).charpoly) :
    A = !![a, A 0 1; A 1 0, a] ∧ A 0 1 * A 1 0 < 0
proof:
:= by
  have ht : A 0 0 + A 1 1 = a + a := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 1) hchar
    simp only [Matrix.charpoly_fin_two] at h
    simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
    linarith
  have hd : A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 = a * a + b * b := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 0) hchar
    simpa [Matrix.charpoly_fin_two, Matrix.det_fin_two] using h
  have ha0 : A 0 0 = a := by linarith
  have ha1 : A 1 1 = a := by linarith
  constructor
  · ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ha0, ha1]
  · rw [ha0, ha1] at hd
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_real_schur_plane
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_real_schur_plane {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : Module.End ℝ E) (d : Basis (Fin 2) ℝ E) (a b : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hT : T.toMatrix d d = !![a, b; -b, a]) :
    ∃ c : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ E, ∃ s t : ℝ,
      T.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = !![a, s; t, a] ∧ s * t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : finrank ℝ E = 2 := by simpa using finrank_eq_card_basis d
  let c₀ := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).reindex (finCongr hdim)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hdiag⟩ := exists_orthogonal_two_eq_diagonal (T.toMatrix c₀.toBasis c₀.toBasis)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_toMatrix_eq_conjugate c₀ Q hQ
  have hdiag' : (T.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis) 0 0 =
      (T.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis) 1 1 := by rw [hc T]; exact hdiag
  have hchar : (T.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis).charpoly =
      (!![a, b; -b, a] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ).charpoly := by
    rw [T.charpoly_toMatrix, ← T.charpoly_toMatrix d, hT]
  obtain ⟨heq, hneg⟩ := eq_real_schur_block_of_charpoly hb hdiag' hchar
  exact ⟨c, _, _, heq, hneg⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_invariant_line_or_real_schur_plane
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_line_or_real_schur_plane {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [Nontrivial E] (T : Module.End ℝ E) :
    (∃ P : Submodule ℝ E, finrank ℝ P = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P) ∨
    (∃ P : Submodule ℝ E, ∃ hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P,
      ∃ c : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ P, ∃ a s t : ℝ,
        (T.restrict hP).toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis = !![a, s; t, a] ∧ s * t < 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases exists_real_eigenline_or_plane T with ⟨a, u, hu, hTu⟩ |
      ⟨a, b, hb, u, v, huv, hTu, hTv⟩
  · left
    refine ⟨ℝ ∙ u, finrank_span_singleton hu, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
    rw [map_smul, hTu]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · right
    let P := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![u, v])
    have hu : u ∈ P := Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hv : v ∈ P := Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, rfl⟩
    have hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P := by
      intro x hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
        fin_cases i
        · change T u ∈ P
          rw [hTu]
          exact P.sub_mem (P.smul_mem _ hu) (P.smul_mem _ hv)
        · change T v ∈ P
          rw [hTv]
          exact P.add_mem (P.smul_mem _ hu) (P.smul_mem _ hv)
      | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using P.zero_mem
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using P.add_mem hx hy
      | smul c x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using P.smul_mem c hx
    let d : Basis (Fin 2) ℝ P := Basis.span huv
    have hd0' : (d 0 : E) = u := Basis.coe_span_apply huv 0
    have hd1' : (d 1 : E) = v := Basis.coe_span_apply huv 1
    have hd0 : T.restrict hP (d 0) = a • d 0 - b • d 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change T (d 0 : E) = a • (d 0 : E) - b • (d 1 : E)
      rwa [hd0', hd1']
    have hd1 : T.restrict hP (d 1) = b • d 0 + a • d 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change T (d 1 : E) = b • (d 0 : E) + a • (d 1 : E)
      rwa [hd0', hd1']
    have hmat : (T.restrict hP).toMatrix d d = !![a, b; -b, a] := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases j <;> fin_cases i <;>
        simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, hd0, hd1]
    obtain ⟨c, s, t, hct, hst⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_real_schur_plane (T.restrict hP) d a b hb hmat
    exact ⟨P, hP, c, a, s, t, hct, hst⟩

name: NLAlib.monotone_saddleEigenvaluePlus
statement: theorem monotone_saddleEigenvaluePlus : Monotone saddleEigenvaluePlus
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show 1 + 4 * x ≤ 1 + 4 * y by linarith)
  dsimp [saddleEigenvaluePlus]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.antitone_saddleEigenvalueMinus
statement: theorem antitone_saddleEigenvalueMinus : Antitone saddleEigenvalueMinus
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show 1 + 4 * x ≤ 1 + 4 * y by linarith)
  dsimp [saddleEigenvalueMinus]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.one_lt_saddleEigenvaluePlus_and_saddleEigenvalueMinus_lt_zero
statement:
theorem one_lt_saddleEigenvaluePlus_and_saddleEigenvalueMinus_lt_zero
    {mu : ℝ} (hmu : 0 < mu) :
    1 < saddleEigenvaluePlus mu ∧ saddleEigenvalueMinus mu < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 1 < Real.sqrt (1 + 4 * mu) := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  dsimp [saddleEigenvaluePlus, saddleEigenvalueMinus]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.saddle_quadratic_factor
statement:
theorem saddle_quadratic_factor {mu : ℝ} (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) :
    (X ^ 2 - X - Polynomial.C (mu : 𝕜)) =
      (X - Polynomial.C (saddleEigenvaluePlus mu : 𝕜)) *
        (X - Polynomial.C (saddleEigenvalueMinus mu : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : saddleEigenvaluePlus mu + saddleEigenvalueMinus mu = 1 := by
    dsimp [saddleEigenvaluePlus, saddleEigenvalueMinus]
    ring
  have hp : saddleEigenvaluePlus mu * saddleEigenvalueMinus mu = -mu := by
    have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + 4 * mu by positivity)
    dsimp [saddleEigenvaluePlus, saddleEigenvalueMinus]
    nlinarith
  have hsK : (saddleEigenvaluePlus mu : 𝕜) + (saddleEigenvalueMinus mu : 𝕜) = 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hs
  have hpK : (saddleEigenvaluePlus mu : 𝕜) * (saddleEigenvalueMinus mu : 𝕜) = -(mu : 𝕜) := by
    exact_mod_cast hp
  symm
  calc
    _ = X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C ((saddleEigenvaluePlus mu : 𝕜) +
          (saddleEigenvalueMinus mu : 𝕜)) * X +
        Polynomial.C ((saddleEigenvaluePlus mu : 𝕜) * (saddleEigenvalueMinus mu : 𝕜)) := by
      rw [map_add, map_mul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hsK, hpK, map_one, map_neg]; ring

name: NLAlib.roots_charpoly_kktMatrix_one
statement:
theorem roots_charpoly_kktMatrix_one (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hmn : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    let mu
proof:
:= (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self C).eigenvalues
    (kktMatrix 1 C).charpoly.roots =
      (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card m) • ({1} : Multiset 𝕜) +
        Finset.univ.val.bind (fun i : m =>
          {(saddleEigenvaluePlus (mu i) : 𝕜)} + {(saddleEigenvalueMinus (mu i) : 𝕜)}) := by
  dsimp only
  have hp := charpoly_kktMatrix_one_eq_prod C hmn
  simp_rw [saddle_quadratic_factor (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose C |>.eigenvalues_nonneg _)] at hp
  rw [hp, Polynomial.roots_mul (by rw [← hp]; exact (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).ne_zero)]
  rw [Polynomial.roots_pow, show (X - 1 : 𝕜[X]) = X - Polynomial.C 1 by simp,
    Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Polynomial.roots_prod]
  · congr 1
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [Polynomial.roots_mul (mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero _) (X_sub_C_ne_zero _)),
      Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C, Polynomial.roots_X_sub_C]
  · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ =>
      mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero _) (X_sub_C_ne_zero _)

name: NLAlib.count_one_roots_charpoly_kktMatrix_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [roots_charpoly_kktMatrix_one C hmn, Multiset.count_add]
  have hp : ∀ i, (saddleEigenvaluePlus (hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜) ≠ 1 := by
    intro i he
    have hr : saddleEigenvaluePlus (hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast he
    exact (ne_of_gt (one_lt_saddleEigenvaluePlus_and_saddleEigenvalueMinus_lt_zero
      (hC.eigenvalues_pos i)).1) hr
  have hm : ∀ i, (saddleEigenvalueMinus (hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜) ≠ 1 := by
    intro i he
    have hr : saddleEigenvalueMinus (hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast he
    have hn := (one_lt_saddleEigenvaluePlus_and_saddleEigenvalueMinus_lt_zero
      (hC.eigenvalues_pos i)).2
    linarith
  have hz : 1 ∉ Finset.univ.val.bind (fun i : m =>
      {(saddleEigenvaluePlus (hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜)} +
        {(saddleEigenvalueMinus (hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜)}) := by
    simp [hp, hm]
  rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr hz]
  simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_one_add_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_one_add_le {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (hF : specNorm F < 1) :
    specNorm (1 + F)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - specNorm F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add, specNorm_neg, one_div] using
    (specNorm_inv_one_sub_le (F := -F) (by simpa only [specNorm_neg] using hF))

name: NLAlib.add_eq_mul_one_add_inv_mul
statement:
theorem add_eq_mul_one_add_inv_mul (A E : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    A + E = A * (1 + A⁻¹ * E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.neumann_and_inverse_perturbation
statement:
theorem neumann_and_inverse_perturbation (F A E : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hF : specNorm F < 1) (hA : IsUnit A) (hE : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) < 1) :
    IsUnit (1 - F) ∧
    (1 - F)⁻¹ = ∑' k : ℕ, F ^ k ∧
    specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - specNorm F)⁻¹ ∧
    specNorm ((1 - F)⁻¹ - 1) ≤ specNorm F / (1 - specNorm F) ∧
    IsUnit (A + E) ∧
    specNorm (A + E)⁻¹ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) ∧
    specNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ - A⁻¹) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * specNorm E / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) ∧
    frobNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ - A⁻¹) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * frobNorm E / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E))
proof:
:=
  ⟨isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one hF, (hasSum_pow_inv_one_sub hF).tsum_eq.symm,
    (by simpa only [one_div] using specNorm_inv_one_sub_le hF),
    specNorm_inv_one_sub_sub_one_le hF,
    isUnit_add_of_specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one hA hE, specNorm_inv_add_le hA hE,
    specNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le hA hE, frobNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le hA hE⟩

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_projector_distance_eq_sqrt_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles
statement:
theorem frobNorm_projector_distance_eq_sqrt_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles
    {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {P Q : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    frobNorm (P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)=Real.sqrt 2*frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := frobSq_projector_distance_eq_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles hP hQ
  rw [← frobNorm_sq, ← frobNorm_sq] at hh
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 2)^2=2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hn := frobNorm_nonneg (P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)
  have hn' := frobNorm_nonneg (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)
  have heq : frobNorm (P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)^2=(Real.sqrt 2*frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q))^2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hs]; exact hh
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ hn (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hn')).mp heq

name: NLAlib.rank_sub_frame_projector_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem rank_sub_frame_projector_le_two_mul {k : ℕ} (P Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ) :
    (P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ).rank ≤ 2*k
proof:
:= by
  have heq : P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ=P*Pᵀ+(-Q)*Qᵀ := by rw [Matrix.neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [heq]
  have hP : (P*Pᵀ).rank ≤ k :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left P Pᵀ).trans (by simpa using P.rank_le_card_width)
  have hQ : ((-Q)*Qᵀ).rank ≤ k :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left (-Q) Qᵀ).trans (by simpa using (-Q).rank_le_card_width)
  exact (rank_add_le _ _).trans (by omega)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_min_div_population_gap
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_min_div_population_gap
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n)
    (hg : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)
    {Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (htop : (Qᵀ*(A+E)*Q).trace=eigenvaluePrefix (hA.add hE) k) :
    frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) Q) ≤
      min (2*Real.sqrt k*specNorm E) (Real.sqrt 2*frobNorm E)/
        (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let P := topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  let S := frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles P Q)
  let g := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols P := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := frobNorm_nonneg _
  have hdef := mul_frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_le_frobInner_perturbation hA hE hk0 hkN hQ htop
  rw [← frobNorm_sq] at hdef
  change g*S^2 ≤ frobInner (Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ) E at hdef
  have hnorm : frobNorm (Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ)=Real.sqrt 2*S := by
    rw [show Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ=-(P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ) by abel, frobNorm_neg]
    exact frobNorm_projector_distance_eq_sqrt_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles hP hQ
  have hF := frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm (Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ) E
  have hO := frobInner_le_sqrt_mul_frobNorm_mul_specNorm_of_rank_le
    (Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ) E (rank_sub_frame_projector_le_two_mul Q P)
  rw [hnorm] at hF hO
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (↑(2*k) : ℝ)=Real.sqrt 2*Real.sqrt k := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  rw [hroot] at hO
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 2)^2=2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hg).2
  change S*g ≤ min (2*Real.sqrt k*specNorm E) (Real.sqrt 2*frobNorm E)
  apply le_min
  · by_cases hS : S=0
    · simp only [hS, zero_mul]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    · have hSp : 0 < S := lt_of_le_of_ne hS0 (Ne.symm hS)
      have heq : Real.sqrt 2*Real.sqrt k*(Real.sqrt 2*S)*specNorm E =
          (2*Real.sqrt k*specNorm E)*S := by
        calc
          _ = (Real.sqrt 2)^2*(Real.sqrt k*specNorm E*S) := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hs]; ring
      rw [heq] at hO
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by nlinarith [hdef.trans hO]) hSp
  · by_cases hS : S=0
    · simp only [hS, zero_mul]; exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _)
    · have hSp : 0 < S := lt_of_le_of_ne hS0 (Ne.symm hS)
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by nlinarith [hdef.trans hF]) hSp

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_min_div_population_gap
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_min_div_population_gap
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n)
    (hg : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)
    {Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (htop : (Qᵀ*(A+E)*Q).trace=eigenvaluePrefix (hA.add hE) k) :
    frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) Q) ≤
      2*min (Real.sqrt k*specNorm E) (frobNorm E)/
        (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_min_div_population_gap hA hE hk0 hkN hg hQ htop
  apply hh.trans
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hg.le
  rw [mul_min_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  apply min_le_min
  · ring_nf; exact le_rfl
  · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (frobNorm_nonneg E)
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)]

name: NLAlib.exists_real_parameter_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple
statement:
theorem exists_real_parameter_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (E : Matrix n n ℂ) {x y : n → ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + (t : ℂ) • E)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (0, μ),
        p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + (p.1 : ℂ) • E) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique⟩ :=
    exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple E hx hy hAx hyA hμ
  have hreal : Tendsto Complex.ofReal (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto
  have hderiv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => φ t) ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 := by
    apply HasDerivAt.comp_ofReal
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero] using hφderiv
  refine ⟨fun t => φ t, by simpa using hφ₀, hderiv.continuousAt, hderiv,
    ?_, hreal.eventually hφspec, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hreal.eventually hφnear] with t ht
    exact ht.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt
  ·
    have hmap : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => ((p.1 : ℂ), p.2))
        (𝓝 ((0 : ℝ), μ)) (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ)) := by
      have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => ((p.1 : ℂ), p.2)) := by fun_prop
      simpa using (hcont.continuousAt (x := ((0 : ℝ), μ))).tendsto
    exact hmap.eventually hφunique

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (E : Matrix n n ℝ) (hAh : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} {μ : ℝ} (hxn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ (Complex.ofReal (x ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x))) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ ((A + t • E).map Complex.ofReal)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (0, (μ : ℂ)),
        p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ ((A + p.1 • E).map Complex.ofReal) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsSymm := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hAh
  have hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hxn, one_pow]
  let z : n → ℂ := Complex.ofReal ∘ x
  have hzz : z ⬝ᵥ z = 1 := by
    simpa [z, hx, Complex.ofRealHom] using (Complex.ofRealHom.map_dotProduct x x).symm
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hzz
  have hAz : (A.map Complex.ofReal) *ᵥ z = (μ : ℂ) • z := by
    funext i
    simpa [z, hAx, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealHom] using (Complex.ofRealHom.map_mulVec A x i).symm
  have hzA : z ᵥ* (A.map Complex.ofReal) = (μ : ℂ) • z := by
    have htrans : (A.map Complex.ofReal).transpose = A.map Complex.ofReal := by
      ext i j
      exact congrArg Complex.ofReal (congrFun (congrFun hA i) j)
    rw [← htrans, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
    exact hAz
  have hmult : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly.rootMultiplicity (μ : ℂ) = 1 := by
    have hchar : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = Polynomial.map Complex.ofRealHom A.charpoly :=
      Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
    rw [hchar]
    simpa only [hμ, Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe] using
      (Polynomial.eq_rootMultiplicity_map (p := A.charpoly) (f := Complex.ofRealHom)
        Complex.ofReal_injective μ).symm
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique⟩ :=
    exists_real_parameter_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple (E.map Complex.ofReal) hz hz hAz hzA hmult
  have hentry : (z ⬝ᵥ ((E.map Complex.ofReal) *ᵥ z)) / (z ⬝ᵥ z) =
      Complex.ofReal (x ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) := by
    rw [hzz, div_one]
    simp [z, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Complex.ofReal_sum]
  have hmap (t : ℝ) : (A + t • E).map Complex.ofReal =
      A.map Complex.ofReal + (t : ℂ) • E.map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j
    simp
  exact ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hentry ▸ hφderiv, hφnear, by simpa only [hmap] using hφspec,
    by simpa only [hmap] using hφunique⟩

name: NLAlib.add_sq_add_sq_le_goldenRatio_sq_mul
statement:
theorem add_sq_add_sq_le_goldenRatio_sq_mul (s t : ℝ) :
    (s+t)^2+s^2 ≤ Real.goldenRatio^2*(s^2+t^2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Real.goldenRatio*(Real.goldenRatio^2*(s^2+t^2)-((s+t)^2+s^2)) =
      (s-Real.goldenRatio*t)^2 := by
    linear_combination ((Real.goldenRatio+1)*s^2+Real.goldenRatio*t^2)*Real.goldenRatio_sq
  have hh : 0 ≤ Real.goldenRatio*(Real.goldenRatio^2*(s^2+t^2)-((s+t)^2+s^2)) :=
    heq.symm ▸ sq_nonneg _
  have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left Real.goldenRatio_pos).mp hh
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_zero_complement_block
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_zero_complement_block {Z : Matrix m n ℝ}
    {P : Matrix n n ℝ} {Q : Matrix m m ℝ}
    (hPh : P.IsHermitian) (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (hQh : Q.IsHermitian) (hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (h00 : (1-Q)*Z*(1-P)=0)
    (h11 : specNorm (Q*Z*P) ≤ d) (h12 : specNorm (Q*Z*(1-P)) ≤ d)
    (h21 : specNorm ((1-Q)*Z*P) ≤ d) : specNorm Z ≤ Real.goldenRatio*d
proof:
:= by
  have hPP : P*P=P := hPi
  have hPc : (1-P)*(1-P)=1-P := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hPP]
    abel
  have hsplit1 : Q*Z = Q*Z*P+Q*Z*(1-P) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one]; abel
  have hsplit2 : (1-Q)*Z=(1-Q)*Z*P := by
    have hh : (1-Q)*Z=(1-Q)*Z*P+(1-Q)*Z*(1-P) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one]
      abel
    simpa only [h00, add_zero] using hh
  apply specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le (mul_nonneg Real.goldenRatio_pos.le hd)
  intro x
  let s := Real.sqrt ((P*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ (P*ᵥx))
  let t := Real.sqrt (((1-P)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-P)*ᵥx))
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : s^2=(P*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ (P*ᵥx) := Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
  have ht2 : t^2=((1-P)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-P)*ᵥx) := Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
  have hbound (T : Matrix m n ℝ) (hT : specNorm T ≤ d) (v : n → ℝ) :
      Real.sqrt ((T*ᵥv) ⬝ᵥ (T*ᵥv)) ≤ d*Real.sqrt (v ⬝ᵥ v) :=
    (sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul T v).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  have hu := hbound (Q*Z*P) h11 (P*ᵥx)
  have hv := hbound (Q*Z*(1-P)) h12 ((1-P)*ᵥx)
  have hw := hbound ((1-Q)*Z*P) h21 (P*ᵥx)
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, hPP, hPc] at hu hv hw
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hu hv hw
  have hu' : Real.sqrt (((Q*Z)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((Q*Z)*ᵥx)) ≤ d*(s+t) := by
    rw [hsplit1, Matrix.add_mulVec]
    have hh := sqrt_dotProduct_add_le ((Q*Z*P)*ᵥx) ((Q*Z*(1-P))*ᵥx)
    change _ ≤ d*s at hu
    change _ ≤ d*t at hv
    nlinarith
  have hw' : Real.sqrt ((((1-Q)*Z)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ (((1-Q)*Z)*ᵥx)) ≤ d*s := by
    rw [hsplit2]
    exact hw
  have hq2 : ((Q*Z)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((Q*Z)*ᵥx) ≤ d^2*(s+t)^2 := by
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hu' 2
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _), mul_pow] at hp
    exact hp
  have hqc2 : (((1-Q)*Z)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ (((1-Q)*Z)*ᵥx) ≤ d^2*s^2 := by
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hw' 2
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _), mul_pow] at hp
    exact hp
  have hout := norm_toLp_sq_add_norm_toLp_sq_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hQh hQi (Z*ᵥx)
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at hout
  have hin := norm_toLp_sq_add_norm_toLp_sq_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem hPh hPi x
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hin
  rw [← hs2, ← ht2] at hin
  have hg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_sq_add_sq_le_goldenRatio_sq_mul s t) (sq_nonneg d)
  nlinarith [hout, hin, hg]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns
proof:
:=
  hQ.submatrix_cols (Fin.castLEEmb hk)

name: NLAlib.headColumns_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem headColumns_mul_transpose {m : Type*} {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hk : k ≤ n) :
    headColumns Q hk * (headColumns Q hk)ᵀ =
      Q * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => if (i : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * Qᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, headColumns, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    id_eq]
  have hdiag (l : Fin n) :
      (∑ a : Fin n, Q i a * (Matrix.diagonal (fun b : Fin n => if (b : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) a l) =
        Q i l * (if (l : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    exact Matrix.mul_diagonal _ Q i l
  simp_rw [hdiag]
  rw [← sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hk (fun l : Fin n => Q i l * Q j l)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l _
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: NLAlib.diagonal_prefix_mul_rectDiag
statement:
private theorem diagonal_prefix_mul_rectDiag {m n k : ℕ} (s : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
      (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) =
        rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then s i else 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul, rectDiag_apply]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_mul_diagonal_prefix
statement:
private theorem rectDiag_mul_diagonal_prefix {m n k : ℕ} (s : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) *
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
        rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then s i else 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, rectDiag_apply]
  by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
  · simp only [if_pos hij]
    rw [hij]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.transpose
statement: theorem transpose (h : IsSVD A U V) : IsSVD Aᵀ V U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.conjTranspose_mul_right, h.conjTranspose_mul_left, ?_, h.mul_conjTranspose_right,
    h.mul_conjTranspose_left⟩
  rw [singularValues_transpose]
  exact h.conjTranspose_eq

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mul_headColumns
statement:
theorem mul_headColumns (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    A * headColumns V hkn = headColumns U hkm *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ =>
    M.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn)) h.mul_right
  have hmul : A * headColumns V hkn = (A * V).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkn) := by
    simpa only [headColumns, Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv A V (id : Fin m → Fin m) (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) (Fin.castLE hkn)
  have heq : A * headColumns V hkn = (U * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)).submatrix id
      (Fin.castLE hkn) := hmul.trans hv
  rw [heq]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, rectDiag_apply, headColumns, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Fin.val_castLE]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.castLE hkm j)]
  · simp only [Fin.val_castLE, ite_true]
  · intro l _ hl
    have hlv : (l : ℕ) ≠ j := fun he => hl (Fin.ext (by simpa only [Fin.val_castLE] using he))
    rw [if_neg hlv, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.transpose_mul_headColumns
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_headColumns (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    Aᵀ * headColumns U hkm = headColumns V hkn *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [singularValues_transpose] using h.transpose.mul_headColumns hkn hkm

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.headColumns_projector_mul
statement:
theorem headColumns_projector_mul (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkm : k ≤ m) :
    (headColumns U hkm * (headColumns U hkm)ᵀ) * A = h.truncatedMatrix k
proof:
:= by
  rw [headColumns_mul_transpose]
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U, show Uᵀ * U = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.diagonal _) (rectDiag _), diagonal_prefix_mul_rectDiag]
  simp only [truncatedMatrix, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.mul_headColumns_projector
statement:
theorem mul_headColumns_projector (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    A * (headColumns V hkn * (headColumns V hkn)ᵀ) = h.truncatedMatrix k
proof:
:= by
  rw [headColumns_mul_transpose]
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᵀ V, show Vᵀ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (rectDiag _) (Matrix.diagonal _), rectDiag_mul_diagonal_prefix]
  simp only [truncatedMatrix, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.residual_headColumns_eq_sub_truncatedMatrix
statement:
theorem residual_headColumns_eq_sub_truncatedMatrix (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkm : k ≤ m) :
    projResidual (headColumns U hkm) A = A - h.truncatedMatrix k
proof:
:= by
  rw [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, h.headColumns_projector_mul hkm]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.residual_headColumns_transpose_eq_sub_truncatedMatrix_transpose
statement:
theorem residual_headColumns_transpose_eq_sub_truncatedMatrix_transpose
    (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    projResidual (headColumns V hkn) Aᵀ = (A - h.truncatedMatrix k)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrArg Matrix.transpose (h.mul_headColumns_projector hkn)
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] at hp
  rw [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hp, Matrix.transpose_sub]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_shift_sq_ge_of_eigenvalue_abs_sub_ge
statement:
theorem mulVec_shift_sq_ge_of_eigenvalue_abs_sub_ge {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {s c : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hsep : ∀ i, s ≤ |hA.eigenvalues i-c|) (x : n → ℝ) :
    s^2*(x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ ((A-c•1)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((A-c•1)*ᵥx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum hA, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  have hh : s^2 ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i-c)^2 := by
    nlinarith [hsep i, sq_abs (hA.eigenvalues i-c), abs_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i-c)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_shift_le_half_width
statement:
theorem specNorm_shift_le_half_width {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hinterval : ∀ i, a ≤ hA.eigenvalues i ∧ hA.eigenvalues i ≤ b) :
    specNorm (A-((a+b)/2)•1) ≤ (b-a)/2
proof:
:= by
  have hh := specNorm_aeval_le hA (X-C ((a+b)/2)) (by linarith : 0 ≤ (b-a)/2)
    (by intro i; simp only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]; rw [abs_le];
        have hi := hinterval i; constructor <;> linarith)
  simpa only [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hh

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_shift_mul
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_shift_mul {L : Matrix m m ℝ} (hL : L.IsHermitian)
    {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hout : ∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨ b+δ ≤ hL.eigenvalues i)
    (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ((b-a)/2+δ)*specNorm X ≤ specNorm ((L-((a+b)/2)•1)*X)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ (b-a)/2+δ := by linarith
  apply mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le hs
  apply mulVec_shift_sq_ge_of_eigenvalue_abs_sub_ge hL hs
  intro i
  rw [le_abs]
  rcases hout i with hi | hi
  · right; linarith
  · left; linarith

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hinterval : ∀ j, a ≤ hM.eigenvalues j ∧ hM.eigenvalues j ≤ b)
    (hout : ∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨ b+δ ≤ hL.eigenvalues i)
    (X : Matrix m n ℝ) : δ*specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_shift_mul hL hab hδ.le hout X
  have hm := specNorm_shift_le_half_width hM hab hinterval
  have heq : (L-((a+b)/2)•1)*X = (L*X-X*M)+X*(M-((a+b)/2)•1) := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    abel
  rw [heq] at hl
  have hu := specNorm_add_le (L*X-X*M) (X*(M-((a+b)/2)•1))
  have hp := specNorm_mul_le X (M-((a+b)/2)•1)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (specNorm_nonneg X)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_div
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_div {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hinterval : ∀ j, a ≤ hM.eigenvalues j ∧ hM.eigenvalues j ≤ b)
    (hout : ∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨ b+δ ≤ hL.eigenvalues i)
    (X : Matrix m n ℝ) : specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M)/δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2
  simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester hL hM hab hδ hinterval hout X

name: NLAlib.mul_frobSq_le_frobSq_sylvester
statement:
theorem mul_frobSq_le_frobSq_sylvester {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, δ ≤ |hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j|) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    δ^2*frobSq X ≤ frobSq (L*X-X*M)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix m m ℝ := hL.eigenvectorUnitary
  let V : Matrix n n ℝ := hM.eigenvectorUnitary
  let Z := Uᵀ*X*V
  have hUt : Uᵀ*U=1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hL
  have hU : U*Uᵀ=1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hL
  have hVt : Vᵀ*V=1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hM
  have hV : V*Vᵀ=1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hM
  have hLX : Uᵀ*L = Matrix.diagonal hL.eigenvalues*Uᵀ := by
    calc
      _ = Uᵀ*(U*Matrix.diagonal hL.eigenvalues*Uᵀ) :=
        congrArg (fun T => Uᵀ*T) (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hL)
      _ = _ := by simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUt, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hMV : M*V = V*Matrix.diagonal hM.eigenvalues := by
    calc
      _ = (V*Matrix.diagonal hM.eigenvalues*Vᵀ)*V :=
        congrArg (fun T => T*V) (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hM)
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hVt, Matrix.mul_one]
  have heq : Uᵀ*(L*X-X*M)*V =
      Matrix.diagonal hL.eigenvalues*Z-Z*Matrix.diagonal hM.eigenvalues := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ L, hLX,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ X M, Matrix.mul_assoc (Uᵀ*X) M V, hMV]
    simp only [Z, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hnorm (Y : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobSq (Uᵀ*Y*V) = frobSq Y := by
    have hUr : Uᵀᵀ*Uᵀ=1 := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hU
    have hVr : Vᵀᵀ*Vᵀ=1 := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hV
    have hh := frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal (V := Vᵀ) hVr (Uᵀ*Y)
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal (Q := Uᵀ) hUr] using hh
  have hb : δ^2*frobSq Z ≤
      frobSq (Matrix.diagonal hL.eigenvalues*Z-Z*Matrix.diagonal hM.eigenvalues) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    have hh : δ^2 ≤ (hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j)^2 := by
      nlinarith [hsep i j, sq_abs (hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j),
        abs_nonneg (hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j)]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (sq_nonneg (Z i j))
    nlinarith
  rw [← heq] at hb
  simpa only [Z, hnorm] using hb

name: NLAlib.mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester
statement:
theorem mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, δ ≤ |hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j|) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    δ*frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (L*X-X*M)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := mul_frobSq_le_frobSq_sylvester hL hM hδ.le hsep X
  rw [← frobNorm_sq X, ← frobNorm_sq (L*X-X*M), ← mul_pow] at hh
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (frobNorm_nonneg _) hh

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester_div
statement:
theorem frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester_div {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, δ ≤ |hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j|) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (L*X-X*M)/δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2
  simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester hL hM hδ hsep X

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_separation_of_interval_complement
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  have hj := hinterval j
  rw [le_abs]
  rcases hout i with hi | hi
  · right; linarith
  · left; linarith

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_one_sided
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_one_sided {L : Matrix m m ℝ}
    {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian)
    {α δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hmax : ∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ α-δ)
    (hmin : ∀ j, α ≤ hM.eigenvalues j) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    δ*specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hX : X=0 := by ext i j; exact isEmptyElim j
    simp [hX, specNorm_zero]
  | inr hn =>
    have hupper (j : n) : hM.eigenvalues j ≤ ‖hM.eigenvalues‖ := by
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm hM.eigenvalues j)
    have hab : α ≤ ‖hM.eigenvalues‖ := (hmin (Classical.arbitrary n)).trans (hupper _)
    exact mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester hL hM hab hδ
      (fun j => ⟨hmin j, hupper j⟩) (fun i => Or.inl (hmax i)) X

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_interval
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hX : X=0 := by ext i j; exact isEmptyElim j
    simp [hX, specNorm_zero]
  | inr hn =>
    have hi := hinterval (Classical.arbitrary n)
    exact mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester hL hM (hi.1.trans hi.2) hδ hinterval hout X

name: NLAlib.sylvester_separation_bounds
statement:
theorem sylvester_separation_bounds {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → (∀ i j, δ ≤ |hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j|) →
      δ*frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (L*X-X*M)) ∧
    (∀ a b δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      (∀ j, a ≤ hM.eigenvalues j ∧ hM.eigenvalues j ≤ b) →
      (∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨ b+δ ≤ hL.eigenvalues i) →
      δ*specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M) ∧ δ*frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (L*X-X*M)) ∧
    (∀ α δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → (∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ α-δ) →
      (∀ j, α ≤ hM.eigenvalues j) → δ*specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun δ hδ hsep => mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester hL hM hδ hsep X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b δ hδ hint hout
    exact ⟨mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_interval hL hM hδ hint hout X,
      mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester hL hM hδ
        (eigenvalue_separation_of_interval_complement hL hM hint hout) X⟩
  · intro α δ hδ hmax hmin
    exact mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_one_sided hL hM hδ hmax hmin X

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_sub_frame_projector_eq_sub_compressions
statement:
theorem trace_mul_sub_frame_projector_eq_sub_compressions {k : Type*} [Fintype k]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (P Q : Matrix n k ℝ) :
    (A*(P*Pᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)).trace=(Pᵀ*A*P).trace-(Qᵀ*A*Q).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub]
  congr 1 <;> rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]

name: NLAlib.mul_frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_le_trace_deficit
statement:
theorem mul_frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_le_trace_deficit (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n) {Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)*
      frobSq (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) Q) ≤
      (A*(topEigenframe hA hkN.le*(topEigenframe hA hkN.le)ᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)).trace
proof:
:= by
  let U := sortedEigenframe hA
  let w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j, (Uᵀ*Q) i j^2
  have hu : HasOrthonormalCols U := hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe hA
  have huc : U*Uᵀ=1 := sortedEigenframe_mul_transpose_eq_one hA
  have hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1 := sum_sq_overlap_row_le_one hu hQ
  have hbudget : ∑ i, w i=(k : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [w, Fintype.card_fin] using sum_sum_sq_overlap_eq_card huc hQ
  have hgap := prefix_gap_mul_deficit_le_trace_deficit hA.eigenvalues₀ w
    hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone hw0 hw1 hk0 hkN hbudget
  have hs : frobSq (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) Q) =
      (k : ℝ)-∑ i : Fin k, w (Fin.castLE hkN.le i) := by
    rw [frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_card_sub_overlap
      (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hkN.le) hQ, Fintype.card_fin,
      topEigenframe]
    change (k : ℝ)-frobSq ((U.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hkN.le))ᵀ*Q)=_
    rw [frobSq_prefix_transpose_mul_eq_sum_overlap_row_sq]
  have htrace : (A*(topEigenframe hA hkN.le*(topEigenframe hA hkN.le)ᵀ-Q*Qᵀ)).trace =
      (∑ i : Fin k, hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE hkN.le i))-∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i*w i := by
    rw [trace_mul_sub_frame_projector_eq_sub_compressions,
      trace_topEigenframe_compression_eq_prefix, eigenvaluePrefix_eq_sum_castLE hA hkN.le,
      trace_compression_eq_sum_mul_overlap_row_sq U Q hA.eigenvalues₀
        (eq_sortedEigenframe_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA)]
  rw [hs, htrace]
  exact hgap

name: NLAlib.mul_frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_le_frobInner_perturbation
statement:
theorem mul_frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_le_frobInner_perturbation
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n) {Q : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (htop : (Qᵀ*(A+E)*Q).trace=eigenvaluePrefix (hA.add hE) k) :
    (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)*
      frobSq (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) Q) ≤
      frobInner (Q*Qᵀ-topEigenframe hA hkN.le*(topEigenframe hA hkN.le)ᵀ) E
proof:
:= by
  let P := topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols P := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  have hmax : (Pᵀ*(A+E)*P).trace ≤ (Qᵀ*(A+E)*Q).trace := by
    rw [htop]
    have hh := trace_compression_le_trace_topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le hP
    rw [trace_topEigenframe_compression_eq_prefix] at hh
    exact hh
  have hgap := mul_frobSq_sinePrincipalAngles_le_trace_deficit hA hk0 hkN hQ
  have heq : frobInner (Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ) E=(E*(Q*Qᵀ-P*Pᵀ)).trace := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_sub]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  rw [heq, trace_mul_sub_frame_projector_eq_sub_compressions]
  rw [trace_mul_sub_frame_projector_eq_sub_compressions] at hgap
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.trace_add] at hmax
  change _ ≤ (Qᵀ*E*Q).trace-(Pᵀ*E*P).trace
  change _ ≤ (Pᵀ*A*P).trace-(Qᵀ*A*Q).trace at hgap
  linarith

name: NLAlib.pinv_solution_norm_pos
statement:
theorem pinv_solution_norm_pos {A : Matrix m n ℝ} (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hx : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b ≠ 0) :
    0 < ‖A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖ ∧ 0 < ‖b‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
    intro hz
    have h := congrArg (fun v => (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin v) hz
    rw [← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply,
      moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card hA, toEuclideanLin_one_apply,
      map_zero] at h
    exact hx h
  · apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
    intro hz
    apply hx
    rw [hz, map_zero]

name: NLAlib.norm_data_sq_eq_pinv_fit_sq_add_residual_sq
statement:
theorem norm_data_sq_eq_pinv_fit_sq_add_residual_sq (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    ‖b‖^2 = ‖A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖^2+
      ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_pinv_residual_sq_add_eq A b 0
  simp only [map_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub, map_neg, norm_neg] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_pinv_fit_le_norm_data
statement:
