theorem norm_pinv_fit_le_norm_data (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    ‖A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖ ≤ ‖b‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_data_sq_eq_pinv_fit_sq_add_residual_sq A b
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖,
    norm_nonneg b, norm_nonneg (A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b))]

name: NLAlib.exists_least_squares_angle
statement:
theorem exists_least_squares_angle {A : Matrix m n ℝ} (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hx : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b ≠ 0) :
    let x
proof:
:= (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
    let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < Real.pi/2 ∧
      Real.cos θ = ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖ ∧
      Real.sin θ = ‖r‖/‖b‖ ∧
      Real.tan θ = ‖r‖/‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖ := by
  intro x r
  obtain ⟨hL,hb⟩ := pinv_solution_norm_pos hA b hx
  have hcpos : 0 < ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖ := div_pos hL hb
  have hcle : ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (div_le_one hb).mpr (norm_pinv_fit_le_norm_data A b)
  let θ := Real.arccos (‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖)
  have hcos : Real.cos θ=‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖ :=
    Real.cos_arccos (by linarith) hcle
  have hsin : Real.sin θ=‖r‖/‖b‖ := by
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    apply (Real.sqrt_eq_iff_mul_self_eq
      (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖),
        mul_nonneg hcpos.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hcle)])
      (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hb.le)).mpr
    have hsq := norm_data_sq_eq_pinv_fit_sq_add_residual_sq A b
    change ‖b‖^2=‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖^2+‖r‖^2 at hsq
    field_simp [hb.ne']
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨θ, Real.arccos_nonneg _, ?_, hcos, hsin, ?_⟩
  · exact Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr hcpos
  · rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, hsin, hcos]
    field_simp [hb.ne', hL.ne']

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.headColumns_left_residual_eq_neg_mul
statement:
theorem headColumns_left_residual_eq_neg_mul {m n k : ℕ}
    {A E : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {Uhat : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ}
    {Vhat : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hhat : IsSVD (A + E) Uhat Vhat)
    (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    A * headColumns Vhat hkn - headColumns Uhat hkm *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues (A + E) i) =
        -(E * headColumns Vhat hkn)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hhat.mul_headColumns hkm hkn, Matrix.add_mul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.headColumns_right_residual_eq_neg_mul
statement:
theorem headColumns_right_residual_eq_neg_mul {m n k : ℕ}
    {A E : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {Uhat : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ}
    {Vhat : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hhat : IsSVD (A + E) Uhat Vhat)
    (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    Aᵀ * headColumns Uhat hkm - headColumns Vhat hkn *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues (A + E) i) =
        -(Eᵀ * headColumns Uhat hkm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hhat.transpose_mul_headColumns hkm hkn, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_max_perturbation_frame_div
proof:
:= headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁)) (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤
      max (specNorm (E * Vhat₁)) (specNorm (Eᵀ * Uhat₁)) /
        (singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k) := by
  have h := max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_max_residual_div hA hhat hk hδ
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  rw [hhat.headColumns_left_residual_eq_neg_mul,
    hhat.headColumns_right_residual_eq_neg_mul, specNorm_neg, specNorm_neg] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.sqrt_add_sq_frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_sqrt_add_sq_perturbation_frame_div
proof:
:= headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    Real.sqrt (frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁) ^ 2 +
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (frobNorm (E * Vhat₁) ^ 2 + frobNorm (Eᵀ * Uhat₁) ^ 2) /
        (singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k) := by
  have h := sqrt_add_sq_frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_sqrt_add_sq_residual_div hA hhat hk hδ
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  rw [hhat.headColumns_left_residual_eq_neg_mul,
    hhat.headColumns_right_residual_eq_neg_mul, frobNorm_neg, frobNorm_neg] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_specNorm_div
proof:
:= headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁)) (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤
      specNorm E / (singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k) := by
  have h := max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_max_perturbation_frame_div hA hhat hk hδ
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  apply h.trans
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hδ.le
  apply max_le
  · exact specNorm_mul_frame_le (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_right _) E
  · simpa only [specNorm_transpose] using
      specNorm_mul_frame_le (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_left _) Eᵀ

name: NLAlib.max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_specNorm_div_population_gap
proof:
:= headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁)) (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤
      2 * specNorm E / (singularValues A (k - 1) - singularValues A k) := by
  dsimp only
  let U₁ := headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  let M := max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁)) (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁))
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (specNorm_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hg).2
  by_cases hsmall : specNorm E < (singularValues A (k - 1) - singularValues A k) / 2
  · have hweyl := singularValues_le_singularValues_add_add_specNorm A E (k - 1)
    have hδ : 0 < singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k := by linarith
    have hmix := max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_specNorm_div hA hhat hk hδ
    have hmult := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mp hmix
    have hgap : (singularValues A (k - 1) - singularValues A k) / 2 ≤
        singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k := by linarith
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgap hM0
    change M * (singularValues A (k - 1) - singularValues A k) ≤ _
    change M * (singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k) ≤ _ at hmult
    nlinarith
  · have hM : M ≤ 1 := max_le
      (specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_one
        (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hA.conjTranspose_mul_left _)
        (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_left _))
      (specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_one
        (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hA.conjTranspose_mul_right _)
        (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_right _))
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM hg.le
    change M * (singularValues A (k - 1) - singularValues A k) ≤ _
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_pinv_solution_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_pinv_solution_sub_div_le (A E : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (b f : m → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε * specNorm A)
    (hf : Real.sqrt (f ⬝ᵥ f) ≤ ε * Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b))
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A * ε < 1) :
    Real.sqrt ((moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b - moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ (b + f)) ⬝ᵥ
        (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b - moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ (b + f))) /
      Real.sqrt ((moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) ≤
      moorePenroseConditionNumber A * ε / (1 - moorePenroseConditionNumber A * ε) *
        (2 + (moorePenroseConditionNumber A + 1) *
          Real.sqrt ((b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) ⬝ᵥ
            (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))) /
          (specNorm A * Real.sqrt ((moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
            (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b = 0
  · simp only [hx, dotProduct_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero, div_zero, add_zero]
    have hκ := moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A
    have hgap : 0 < 1 - moorePenroseConditionNumber A * ε := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hκ hε) hgap.le) (by norm_num)
  have hx' : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin (WithLp.toLp 2 b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hx
    exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz
  have hf' : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ≤
      ε * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ := by
    simpa only [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm] using hf
  have h := norm_least_squares_sub_div_le hA (WithLp.toLp 2 b) (WithLp.toLp 2 f)
    hx' hε hE hf' hsmall
  simpa only [norm_sub_rev, norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, WithLp.ofLp_sub, WithLp.ofLp_add,
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin, Matrix.toLin'_apply, WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using h

name: NLAlib.sqrt_pinv_residual_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_pinv_residual_sub_div_le (A E : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (b f : m → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε * specNorm A)
    (hf : Real.sqrt (f ⬝ᵥ f) ≤ ε * Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b))
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A * ε < 1) :
    Real.sqrt ((b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) -
          ((b + f) - (A + E) *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ (b + f)))) ⬝ᵥ
        (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) -
          ((b + f) - (A + E) *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ (b + f))))) /
      Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) ≤ (1 + 2 * moorePenroseConditionNumber A) * ε
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · simp only [hb, dotProduct_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, div_zero]
    have hκ := moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A
    positivity
  have hb' : (WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hb
    exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz
  have hf' : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ≤
      ε * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ := by
    simpa only [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm] using hf
  have h := norm_least_squares_residual_sub_div_le hA (WithLp.toLp 2 b)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 f) hb' hE hf' hsmall
  have h' := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (show 1 + moorePenroseConditionNumber A ≤ 1 + 2 * moorePenroseConditionNumber A by
      linarith [moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A]) hε)
  simpa only [norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, WithLp.ofLp_sub, WithLp.ofLp_add,
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin, Matrix.toLin'_apply, WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using h'

name: NLAlib.mul_le_max_sq_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_le_max_sq_of_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    a*b ≤ max (a^2) (b^2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · exact (by nlinarith : a*b ≤ b^2).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact (by nlinarith : a*b ≤ a^2).trans (le_max_left _ _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_mul_le {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q] (X : Matrix m n ℝ) (Y : Matrix n p ℝ)
    (Z : Matrix p q ℝ) : specNorm (X*Y*Z) ≤ specNorm X*specNorm Y*specNorm Z
proof:
:=
  (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_goldenRatio_max_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_goldenRatio_max_sq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      Real.goldenRatio*max (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2)
        (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2)*specNorm (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  let P := A*a
  let Q := b*B
  let e := specNorm (B-A)
  let d := max (specNorm a^2) (specNorm b^2)*e
  have hPs : P.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A
  have hPi : IsIdempotentElem P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A
  have hQs : Q.IsHermitian := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian B
  have hQi : IsIdempotentElem Q := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem B
  have hPnorm := specNorm_one_sub_projector_le_one hPs hPi
  have hQnorm := specNorm_one_sub_projector_le_one hQs hQi
  have hblk := moorePenroseInverse_sub_blocks A B
  change Q*(b-a)*P= -b*(B-A)*a ∧ Q*(b-a)*(1-P)=b*(1-P) ∧
    (1-Q)*(b-a)*P= -(1-Q)*a ∧ (1-Q)*(b-a)*(1-P)=0 at hblk
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := mul_nonneg (le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have h11 : specNorm (Q*(b-a)*P) ≤ d := by
    rw [hblk.1, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.neg_mul, specNorm_neg]
    have hbnd := specNorm_mul_mul_le b (B-A) a
    have hab := mul_le_max_sq_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg a) (specNorm_nonneg b)
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab (specNorm_nonneg (B-A))
    change _ ≤ max (specNorm a^2) (specNorm b^2)*e
    dsimp only [e] at *
    nlinarith
  have h12 : specNorm (Q*(b-a)*(1-P)) ≤ d := by
    rw [hblk.2.1, moorePenroseInverse_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq A B]
    change specNorm (b*bᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ*(1-P)) ≤ _
    have hbnd := specNorm_mul_le (b*bᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ) (1-P)
    have htrip := specNorm_mul_mul_le b bᵀ (B-A)ᵀ
    rw [specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose] at htrip
    have hcont := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPnorm (specNorm_nonneg (b*bᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ))
    have hmax := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right (specNorm a^2) (specNorm b^2)) (specNorm_nonneg (B-A))
    dsimp only [d, e]
    nlinarith
  have h21 : specNorm ((1-Q)*(b-a)*P) ≤ d := by
    rw [hblk.2.2.1, neg_complement_rowProjector_mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq A B]
    change specNorm ((1-Q)*(B-A)ᵀ*aᵀ*a) ≤ _
    have hbnd := specNorm_mul_mul_le ((1-Q)*(B-A)ᵀ) aᵀ a
    have hfirst := specNorm_mul_le (1-Q) (B-A)ᵀ
    rw [specNorm_transpose] at hfirst
    rw [specNorm_transpose] at hbnd
    have hcont := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQnorm (specNorm_nonneg (B-A))
    have hmax := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left (specNorm a^2) (specNorm b^2)) (specNorm_nonneg (B-A))
    dsimp only [d, e]
    nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg a]
  have hh := specNorm_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_zero_complement_block hPs hPi hQs hQi hd hblk.2.2.2 h11 h12 h21
  simpa only [d, e, a, b, mul_assoc] using hh

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_rank_eq
    {A B : Matrix m n ℝ} (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      Real.goldenRatio*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*specNorm (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  let PA := A*a
  let PB := B*b
  let QA := a*A
  let QB := b*B
  let d := specNorm a*specNorm b*specNorm (B-A)
  have hPAs : PA.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A
  have hPAi : IsIdempotentElem PA := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A
  have hPBs : PB.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B
  have hPBi : IsIdempotentElem PB := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B
  have hQAs : QA.IsHermitian := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A
  have hQAi : IsIdempotentElem QA := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem A
  have hQBs : QB.IsHermitian := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian B
  have hQBi : IsIdempotentElem QB := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem B
  have hblk := moorePenroseInverse_sub_blocks A B
  change QB*(b-a)*PA= -b*(B-A)*a ∧ QB*(b-a)*(1-PA)=b*(1-PA) ∧
    (1-QB)*(b-a)*PA= -(1-QB)*a ∧ (1-QB)*(b-a)*(1-PA)=0 at hblk
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have h11 : specNorm (QB*(b-a)*PA) ≤ d := by
    rw [hblk.1, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.neg_mul, specNorm_neg]
    have hh := specNorm_mul_mul_le b (B-A) a
    dsimp only [d]
    nlinarith
  have h12 : specNorm (QB*(b-a)*(1-PA)) ≤ d := by
    rw [hblk.2.1]
    have hbPB : b*PB=b := by
      simpa only [b, PB, Matrix.mul_assoc] using moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse B
    have heq : b*(1-PA)=b*(PB*(1-PA)) := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hbPB]
    rw [heq]
    have hgap : specNorm (PB*(1-PA)) ≤ specNorm (PA-PB) := by
      rw [specNorm_sub_projector_eq_max hPAs hPAi hPBs hPBi]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    have hdist : specNorm (PA-PB) ≤ specNorm a*specNorm (B-A) :=
      specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm hr
    calc
      _ ≤ specNorm b*specNorm (PB*(1-PA)) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm b*(specNorm a*specNorm (B-A)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgap.trans hdist) (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = d := by dsimp only [d]; ring
  have h21 : specNorm ((1-QB)*(b-a)*PA) ≤ d := by
    rw [hblk.2.2.1, Matrix.neg_mul, specNorm_neg]
    have hQAa : QA*a=a := moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A
    have heq : (1-QB)*a=(1-QB)*QA*a := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hQAa]
    rw [heq]
    have hgap : specNorm ((1-QB)*QA) ≤ specNorm (QA-QB) := by
      rw [specNorm_sub_projector_eq_max hQAs hQAi hQBs hQBi]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    have hdist : specNorm (QA-QB) ≤ specNorm b*specNorm (B-A) := by
      have hh := specNorm_sub_rowProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm hr
      exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    calc
      _ ≤ specNorm ((1-QB)*QA)*specNorm a := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ (specNorm b*specNorm (B-A))*specNorm a :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgap.trans hdist) (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = d := by dsimp only [d]; ring
  have hh := specNorm_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_zero_complement_block hPAs hPAi hQBs hQBi hd hblk.2.2.2 h11 h12 h21
  simpa only [d, a, b, mul_assoc] using hh

name: NLAlib.mulVec_diagonal_sq_ge
statement:
theorem mulVec_diagonal_sq_ge {t : k → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (x : k → ℝ) :
    α ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ ((Matrix.diagonal t) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((Matrix.diagonal t) *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ hα (ht j) 2
  have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (sq_nonneg (x j))
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_diagonal {t : k → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (X : Matrix m k ℝ) :
    α * specNorm X ≤ specNorm (X * Matrix.diagonal t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le hα
    (mulVec_diagonal_sq_ge hα ht) Xᵀ
  have heq : Matrix.diagonal t * Xᵀ = (X * Matrix.diagonal t)ᵀ := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose]
  rw [heq, specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_mul_diagonal {t : k → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (X : Matrix m k ℝ) :
    α * frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (X * Matrix.diagonal t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_frobSq_le_frobSq_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le (mulVec_diagonal_sq_ge hα ht) Xᵀ
  have heq : Matrix.diagonal t * Xᵀ = (X * Matrix.diagonal t)ᵀ := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose]
  rw [heq, frobSq_transpose, frobSq_transpose] at h
  rw [← frobNorm_sq, ← frobNorm_sq, ← mul_pow] at h
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (frobNorm_nonneg _) h

name: NLAlib.coupled_specNorm_component
statement:
private theorem coupled_specNorm_component {D : Matrix m n ℝ} {t : k → ℝ}
    {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (hD : specNorm D ≤ β)
    (X : Matrix m k ℝ) (Y : Matrix n k ℝ) :
    α * specNorm X ≤ β * specNorm Y + specNorm (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t)
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_diagonal hα ht X
  have heq : X * Matrix.diagonal t = D * Y - (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t) := by abel
  rw [heq] at hlow
  have htri := specNorm_sub_le (D * Y) (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t)
  have hmul := (specNorm_mul_le D Y).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD (specNorm_nonneg Y))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.coupled_frobNorm_component
statement:
private theorem coupled_frobNorm_component {D : Matrix m n ℝ} {t : k → ℝ}
    {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (hD : specNorm D ≤ β)
    (X : Matrix m k ℝ) (Y : Matrix n k ℝ) :
    α * frobNorm X ≤ β * frobNorm Y + frobNorm (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t)
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_mul_diagonal hα ht X
  have heq : X * Matrix.diagonal t = D * Y - (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t) := by abel
  rw [heq] at hlow
  have htri := frobNorm_sub_le (D * Y) (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t)
  have hmul := (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm D Y).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD (frobNorm_nonneg Y))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_max_specNorm_le_max_coupled_residual
statement:
theorem sub_mul_max_specNorm_le_max_coupled_residual {D : Matrix m n ℝ} {t : k → ℝ}
    {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (hD : specNorm D ≤ β)
    (X : Matrix m k ℝ) (Y : Matrix n k ℝ) :
    (α - β) * max (specNorm X) (specNorm Y) ≤
      max (specNorm (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t))
        (specNorm (Dᵀ * X - Y * Matrix.diagonal t))
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_mul_max_le_max_of_coupled ((specNorm_nonneg D).trans hD)
    (coupled_specNorm_component hα ht hD X Y)
  apply coupled_specNorm_component hα ht _ Y X
  simpa only [specNorm_transpose] using hD

name: NLAlib.sub_sq_mul_add_sq_frobNorm_le_add_sq_coupled_residual
statement:
theorem sub_sq_mul_add_sq_frobNorm_le_add_sq_coupled_residual
    {D : Matrix m n ℝ} {t : k → ℝ} {α β : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (ht : ∀ j, α ≤ t j) (hD : specNorm D ≤ β) (hδ : 0 ≤ α - β)
    (X : Matrix m k ℝ) (Y : Matrix n k ℝ) :
    (α - β) ^ 2 * (frobNorm X ^ 2 + frobNorm Y ^ 2) ≤
      frobNorm (D * Y - X * Matrix.diagonal t) ^ 2 +
        frobNorm (Dᵀ * X - Y * Matrix.diagonal t) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_sq_mul_add_sq_le_add_sq_of_coupled hδ ((specNorm_nonneg D).trans hD)
    (frobNorm_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _)
    (coupled_frobNorm_component hα ht hD X Y)
  apply coupled_frobNorm_component hα ht _ Y X
  simpa only [specNorm_transpose] using hD

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (x : n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) =
      ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - μ) ^ 2 * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum hA (X - C μ) x
  simpa only [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_abs_sub_le_residual
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_abs_sub_le_residual {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    ∃ i, |hA.eigenvalues i - μ| ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x))
proof:
:= by
  let w : n → ℝ := fun i => (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2
  let R := (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x)
  have hw : ∑ i, w i = 1 := (sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x).trans hx
  have hR : R = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - μ) ^ 2 * w i :=
    dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum hA x μ
  have hRn : 0 ≤ R := dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  by_contra hnot
  push Not at hnot
  change ∀ i, Real.sqrt R < |hA.eigenvalues i - μ| at hnot
  have hsome : ∃ i ∈ Finset.univ, 0 < w i := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    have hz : ∑ i, w i ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun i hi => hnone i hi
    linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hwj⟩ := hsome
  have hlt : ∑ i, R * w i < ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - μ) ^ 2 * w i := by
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
    · intro i _
      have hh : R < (hA.eigenvalues i - μ) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hRn, Real.sqrt_nonneg R, hnot i, abs_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i - μ),
          sq_abs (hA.eigenvalues i - μ)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh.le (sq_nonneg _)
    · refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
      have hh : R < (hA.eigenvalues j - μ) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hRn, Real.sqrt_nonneg R, hnot j, abs_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues j - μ),
          sq_abs (hA.eigenvalues j - μ)]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hh hwj
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hw, mul_one, ← hR] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl R hlt

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_rayleigh_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_rayleigh_residual_eq_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, hx, quadForm]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_add_sq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_add_sq (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) =
      (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) +
        (μ - quadForm A x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct,
    smul_eq_mul, hx, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ x) x, quadForm_def, star_trivial]
  ring

name: NLAlib.rayleigh_residual_le_shifted_residual
statement:
theorem rayleigh_residual_le_shifted_residual (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x))
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  rw [dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_add_sq A hx μ]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (μ - quadForm A x)]

name: NLAlib.shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_residual_iff
statement:
theorem shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_residual_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) =
      (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ↔
        μ = quadForm A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_add_sq A hx]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : (μ - quadForm A x) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this)
  · intro h
    simp [h]

name: NLAlib.rayleigh_variance_add_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem rayleigh_variance_add_mul_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (ℓ a : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i - ℓ) * (hA.eigenvalues i - a)) :
    0 ≤ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) +
      (quadForm A x - ℓ) * (quadForm A x - a)
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := quadForm A x
  let w : n → ℝ := fun i => (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2
  have hw : ∑ i, w i = 1 := (sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x).trans hx
  have hmean : ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * w i = ρ :=
    (quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA x).symm
  have hR := dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum hA x ρ
  have heq : ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - ℓ)*(hA.eigenvalues i - a)*w i =
      ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - ρ)^2*w i +
        (2*ρ-ℓ-a)*∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i*w i + (ℓ*a-ρ^2)*∑ i, w i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - ℓ)*(hA.eigenvalues i - a)*w i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hp i) (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [heq, hw, hmean, ← hR] at hsum
  change 0 ≤ (A *ᵥ x - ρ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - ρ • x) + (ρ-ℓ)*(ρ-a)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.kato_temple_eigenvalue_le
statement:
theorem kato_temple_eigenvalue_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) {α β ℓ : ℝ}
    (hαρ : α < quadForm A x) (_hρβ : quadForm A x < β)
    (hαℓ : α < ℓ) (hℓβ : ℓ < β)
    (hiso : ∀ i, α < hA.eigenvalues i → hA.eigenvalues i < β → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ) :
    ℓ ≤ quadForm A x +
      ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) /
        (quadForm A x - α)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i-ℓ)*(hA.eigenvalues i-α) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : α < hA.eigenvalues i
    · by_cases hj : hA.eigenvalues i < β
      · rw [hiso i hi hj]
        simp
      · have hj' := le_of_not_gt hj
        nlinarith
    · have hi' := le_of_not_gt hi
      nlinarith
  have hh := rayleigh_variance_add_mul_nonneg hA hx ℓ α hp
  have hd : 0 < quadForm A x-α := sub_pos.mpr hαρ
  have hdiv := (le_div_iff₀ hd).2 (show
    (ℓ-quadForm A x)*(quadForm A x-α) ≤
      (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) by nlinarith)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.kato_temple_le_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem kato_temple_le_eigenvalue {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) {α β ℓ : ℝ}
    (hαρ : α < quadForm A x) (hρβ : quadForm A x < β)
    (hαℓ : α < ℓ) (hℓβ : ℓ < β)
    (hiso : ∀ i, α < hA.eigenvalues i → hA.eigenvalues i < β → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ) :
    quadForm A x -
      ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) /
        (β - quadForm A x) ≤ ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i-ℓ)*(hA.eigenvalues i-β) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : α < hA.eigenvalues i
    · by_cases hj : hA.eigenvalues i < β
      · rw [hiso i hi hj]
        simp
      · have hj' := le_of_not_gt hj
        nlinarith
    · have hi' := le_of_not_gt hi
      nlinarith
  have hh := rayleigh_variance_add_mul_nonneg hA hx ℓ β hp
  have hd : 0 < β-quadForm A x := sub_pos.mpr hρβ
  have hdiv := (le_div_iff₀ hd).2 (show
    (quadForm A x-ℓ)*(β-quadForm A x) ≤
      (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) by nlinarith)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalue_sub_rayleigh_le_residual_sq_div
statement:
theorem abs_eigenvalue_sub_rayleigh_le_residual_sq_div {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) {ℓ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hℓ : |ℓ-quadForm A x| < δ)
    (hiso : ∀ i, |hA.eigenvalues i-quadForm A x| < δ → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ) :
    |ℓ-quadForm A x| ≤
      ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) / δ
proof:
:= by
  have hℓ' := abs_lt.mp hℓ
  have hiso' : ∀ i, quadForm A x-δ < hA.eigenvalues i →
      hA.eigenvalues i < quadForm A x+δ → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ := by
    intro i hi hj
    apply hiso i
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hu := kato_temple_eigenvalue_le hA hx (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by linarith : quadForm A x-δ < ℓ) (by linarith : ℓ < quadForm A x+δ) hiso'
  have hl := kato_temple_le_eigenvalue hA hx (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by linarith : quadForm A x-δ < ℓ) (by linarith : ℓ < quadForm A x+δ) hiso'
  have hd1 : quadForm A x-(quadForm A x-δ) = δ := by ring
  have hd2 : quadForm A x+δ-quadForm A x = δ := by ring
  rw [hd1] at hu
  rw [hd2] at hl
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.det_scalar_block_eigenvalue_pencil_eq_schur
statement:
theorem det_scalar_block_eigenvalue_pencil_eq_schur
    {l n : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ a t s : ℂ) (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F)) :
    (((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix (l ⊕ n) (l ⊕ n) ℂ) -
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
        t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
          (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F))).det =
      ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F).det *
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, s)
proof:
:= by
  let K := (μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F
  let := hK.nonempty_invertible.some
  have hBlocks : ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix (l ⊕ n) (l ⊕ n) ℂ) -
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
        t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
          (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F)) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => s - t * a))
        (-(t • Matrix.replicateRow l b)) (-(t • Matrix.replicateCol l c)) K := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, K] <;>
      split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [hBlocks, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₂₂]
  congr 1
  rw [Matrix.det_unique, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg, smul_smul,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change s - t * a - (t * t) *
    ((Matrix.replicateRow l b * Ring.inverse K * Matrix.replicateCol l c) default default) =
      s - t * a - t ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ (Ring.inverse K *ᵥ c))
  have hCouple : ((Matrix.replicateRow l b * Ring.inverse K *
      Matrix.replicateCol l c) default default) = b ⬝ᵥ (Ring.inverse K *ᵥ c) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.replicateRow_apply, Matrix.replicateCol_apply,
      dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hCouple, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero
    {l n : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ a t s : ℂ) (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F)) :
    μ + s ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
        t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
          (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F) ↔
      simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not,
    det_scalar_block_eigenvalue_pencil_eq_schur μ a t s B F b c hK]
  have hDet := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hK
  exact mul_eq_zero_iff_left hDet.ne_zero

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_sub_blocks
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_sub_blocks (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    let a
proof:
:= moorePenroseInverse A
    let b := moorePenroseInverse B
    let P := A*a
    let Q := b*B
    Q*(b-a)*P = -b*(B-A)*a ∧
    Q*(b-a)*(1-P) = b*(1-P) ∧
    (1-Q)*(b-a)*P = -(1-Q)*a ∧
    (1-Q)*(b-a)*(1-P) = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  have ha : a*A*a=a := moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A
  have hb : b*B*b=b := moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse B
  have hcA : a*(1-A*a)=0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ha, sub_self]
  have hcB : (1-b*B)*b=0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hb, sub_self]
  change (b*B)*(b-a)*(A*a) = -b*(B-A)*a ∧
    (b*B)*(b-a)*(1-A*a) = b*(1-A*a) ∧
    (1-b*B)*(b-a)*(A*a) = -(1-b*B)*a ∧
    (1-b*B)*(b-a)*(1-A*a)=0
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hb]
    have haa : a*(A*a)=a := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ha]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (b*B) a, haa]
    conv_rhs => rw [Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, neg_sub]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mul_sub (b*B) b a, Matrix.sub_mul, hb, Matrix.mul_assoc (b*B) a, hcA,
      Matrix.mul_zero, sub_zero]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mul_sub (1-b*B) b a, Matrix.sub_mul, hcB, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_sub,
      Matrix.mul_assoc (1-b*B) a, ← Matrix.mul_assoc a A, ha]
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul]
  · rw [Matrix.mul_sub (1-b*B) b a, Matrix.sub_mul, hcB, Matrix.zero_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc (1-b*B) a, hcA, Matrix.mul_zero, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    moorePenroseInverse B*(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A) =
      moorePenroseInverse B*(moorePenroseInverse B)ᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ*(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.mul_sub (moorePenroseInverse B*(moorePenroseInverse B)ᵀ) Bᵀ Aᵀ, Matrix.sub_mul,
    moorePenroseInverse_mul_transpose_mul_transpose B,
    Matrix.mul_assoc _ Aᵀ, transpose_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq_zero A,
    Matrix.mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.neg_complement_rowProjector_mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq
statement:
theorem neg_complement_rowProjector_mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    -(1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*moorePenroseInverse A =
      (1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*(B-A)ᵀ*(moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ*moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  have ha : Aᵀ*aᵀ*a=a := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, (show (moorePenroseInverse A * A)ᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A * A from
      (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq)]
    exact moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A
  rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.mul_sub,
    complement_rowProjector_mul_transpose_eq_zero B, zero_sub]
  simp only [Matrix.neg_mul]
  rw [show (1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*Aᵀ*aᵀ*a =
    (1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*(Aᵀ*aᵀ*a) by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc], ha]

name: NLAlib.complement_columnProjector_mul_columnProjector_eq
statement:
theorem complement_columnProjector_mul_columnProjector_eq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (1-B*moorePenroseInverse B)*(A*moorePenroseInverse A) =
      -((1-B*moorePenroseInverse B)*(B-A)*moorePenroseInverse A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, complement_columnProjector_mul_eq_zero B, zero_sub]
  simp only [Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp

name: NLAlib.rowProjector_mul_complement_rowProjector_eq
statement:
theorem rowProjector_mul_complement_rowProjector_eq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (moorePenroseInverse B*B)*(1-moorePenroseInverse A*A) =
      moorePenroseInverse B*(B-A)*(1-moorePenroseInverse A*A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub (moorePenroseInverse B) B A, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc (moorePenroseInverse B) A,
    mul_complement_rowProjector_eq_zero A, Matrix.mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_eq_one_div_singularValues_last
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_eq_one_div_singularValues_last [Nonempty n]
    (C : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hC : IsUnit C) :
    specNorm C⁻¹ = 1 / singularValues C (Fintype.card n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD C
  have hr : C.rank = Fintype.card n := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit C hC
  have hpos : 0 < C.rank := by rw [hr]; exact Fintype.card_pos
  have hn := h.isSingularTripletFamily.specNorm_truncatedSingularInverse hpos
  unfold truncatedSingularInverse at hn
  rw [← h.moorePenroseInverse_eq, moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit C hC, hr] at hn
  exact hn

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_shift_le_iff_spectrum_or_resolvent
statement:
theorem singularValues_last_shift_le_iff_spectrum_or_resolvent [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : ℂ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤ ε ↔
      z ∈ spectrum ℂ A ∨ 1 / ε ≤ specNorm (z • 1 - A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z ∈ spectrum ℂ A
  · have hn : ¬ IsUnit (z • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A) := by
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using spectrum.mem_iff.mp hz
    have hs : singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) = 0 := by
      have hnp : ¬ 0 < singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) :=
        fun hpos => hn ((singularValues_last_pos_iff_isUnit _).mp hpos)
      exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnp) (singularValues_nonneg _ _)
    simp [hz, hs, hε.le]
  · have hu : IsUnit (z • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A) := by
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using spectrum.notMem_iff.mp hz
    have hs := (singularValues_last_pos_iff_isUnit _).mpr hu
    rw [or_iff_right hz, specNorm_inv_eq_one_div_singularValues_last _ hu,
      one_div_le_one_div hε hs]

name: NLAlib.exists_perturbation_mem_spectrum_iff_exists_spectral_distance_le_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_perturbation_mem_spectrum_iff_exists_spectral_distance_le_of_normal
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (z : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) :
    (∃ E : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm E ≤ ε ∧ z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E)) ↔
      ∃ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖z - μ‖ ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, hE, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hdist⟩ := exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_norm_perturbation_of_normal hA hz
    refine ⟨μ, hμ, ?_⟩
    calc
      ‖z - μ‖ = ‖μ - z‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm E := hdist
      _ ≤ ε := hE
  · rintro ⟨μ, hμ, hdist⟩
    let E : Matrix n n ℂ := (z - μ) • 1
    have hbound : specNorm E ≤ ε := by
      change ‖(z - μ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ ε
      rw [norm_smul]
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖z - μ‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left specNorm_one_le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ ε := by simpa using hdist
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
    have heig : (A + E) *ᵥ v = z • v := by
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, he]
      change μ • v + ((z - μ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) *ᵥ v = z • v
      rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_smul]
      abel
    exact ⟨E, hbound, Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_isRoot_charpoly
      (isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul hv heig)⟩

name: NLAlib.mul_addGroupNorm_le_diagonal_residual
statement:
theorem mul_addGroupNorm_le_diagonal_residual (N : AddGroupNorm (n → ℂ))
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : n → ℂ), N (c • x) = ‖c‖ * N x)
    (habs : ∀ (x y : n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) → N x ≤ N y)
    (d : n → ℂ) (μ : ℂ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i, δ ≤ ‖d i - μ‖) (x : n → ℂ) :
    δ * N x ≤ N (Matrix.diagonal d *ᵥ x - μ • x)
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar : N ((δ : ℂ) • x) = δ * N x := by
    rw [hhom, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hδ]
  rw [← hscalar]
  apply habs
  intro i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← sub_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  simpa only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hδ] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsep i) (norm_nonneg (x i))

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_norm_le_residual_of_absolute_norm
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_norm_le_residual_of_absolute_norm
    (N : AddGroupNorm (n → ℂ))
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : n → ℂ), N (c • x) = ‖c‖ * N x)
    (habs : ∀ (x y : n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) → N x ≤ N y)
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Φ M)
    (haction : ∀ M x, N (M *ᵥ x) ≤ Φ M * N x)
    {A V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ * N x ≤ Φ V * Φ V⁻¹ * N (A *ᵥ x - μ • x)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => exact (hx (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
  | inr hn =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hmin⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_min_image (fun j => ‖d j - μ‖) Finset.univ_nonempty
    let y := V⁻¹ *ᵥ x
    let r := A *ᵥ x - μ • x
    have hdet := V.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hV
    have hVy : V *ᵥ y = x := by
      change V *ᵥ (V⁻¹ *ᵥ x) = x
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv V hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hDA : Matrix.diagonal d * V⁻¹ = V⁻¹ * A := by
      have hD : V⁻¹ * A * V = Matrix.diagonal d := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hA, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul V hdet,
          Matrix.one_mul]
      calc
        Matrix.diagonal d * V⁻¹ = (V⁻¹ * A * V) * V⁻¹ := by rw [hD]
        _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (V⁻¹ * A), Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv V hdet, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hres : Matrix.diagonal d *ᵥ y - μ • y = V⁻¹ *ᵥ r := by
      change Matrix.diagonal d *ᵥ (V⁻¹ *ᵥ x) - μ • (V⁻¹ *ᵥ x) =
        V⁻¹ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x)
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hDA, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    have hdiag := mul_addGroupNorm_le_diagonal_residual N hhom habs d μ
      (norm_nonneg _) (fun j => hmin j (Finset.mem_univ j)) y
    rw [hres] at hdiag
    have hxbound : N x ≤ Φ V * N y := by
      simpa only [hVy] using haction V y
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    calc
      ‖d i - μ‖ * N x ≤ ‖d i - μ‖ * (Φ V * N y) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxbound (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = Φ V * (‖d i - μ‖ * N y) := by ring
      _ ≤ Φ V * N (V⁻¹ *ᵥ r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiag (hΦ V)
      _ ≤ Φ V * (Φ V⁻¹ * N r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (haction V⁻¹ r) (hΦ V)
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_residual_div_of_absolute_norm
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_residual_div_of_absolute_norm
    (N : AddGroupNorm (n → ℂ))
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : n → ℂ), N (c • x) = ‖c‖ * N x)
    (habs : ∀ (x y : n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) → N x ≤ N y)
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Φ M)
    (haction : ∀ M x, N (M *ᵥ x) ≤ Φ M * N x)
    {A V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ ≤ (Φ V * Φ V⁻¹) * N (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) / N x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_norm_le_residual_of_absolute_norm
    N hhom habs Φ hΦ haction hV hA x hx μ
  exact ⟨i, (le_div_iff₀ (map_pos_of_ne_zero N hx)).mpr hi⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_perturbation_of_absolute_norm
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_perturbation_of_absolute_norm
    (N : AddGroupNorm (n → ℂ))
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : n → ℂ), N (c • x) = ‖c‖ * N x)
    (habs : ∀ (x y : n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) → N x ≤ N y)
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Φ M)
    (haction : ∀ M x, N (M *ᵥ x) ≤ Φ M * N x)
    {A V E : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E)) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ ≤ (Φ V * Φ V⁻¹) * Φ E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_norm_le_residual_of_absolute_norm
    N hhom habs Φ hΦ haction hV hA x hx μ
  have hres : A *ᵥ x - μ • x = -(E *ᵥ x) := by
    have h := hAx
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec] at h
    calc
      A *ᵥ x - μ • x = A *ᵥ x - (A *ᵥ x + E *ᵥ x) := by rw [h]
      _ = -(E *ᵥ x) := by abel
  rw [hres, map_neg_eq_map] at hi
  have hκ : 0 ≤ Φ V * Φ V⁻¹ := mul_nonneg (hΦ V) (hΦ V⁻¹)
  have hh := hi.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (haction E x) hκ)
  refine ⟨i, (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (map_pos_of_ne_zero N hx)).mp ?_⟩
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.exists_continuous_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 0 ∧ ContinuousAt ψ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt ψ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt ψ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ),
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c p = 0 ↔ ψ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ₀, hψcont, hψderiv, hψeq, hψunique⟩ :=
    exists_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch μ a B F b c hμ
  let D : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ - a • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ
  have hf : HasStrictFDerivAt (simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c) D 0 :=
    hasStrictFDerivAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c hμ
  have hD₂ : D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change z - a * 0 = z
    ring
  have hif : (D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hD₂]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℂ ℂ, rfl⟩
  let g := hf.implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hif
  have hgcont : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt g t :=
    eventually_continuousAt_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hf hif
  have hgraph : Tendsto (fun t : ℂ => (t, ψ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ)) := by
    change Tendsto (fun t : ℂ => (t, ψ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), 0))
    simpa only [hψ₀, id_eq] using (continuousAt_id.prodMk hψcont).tendsto
  have hgψ : g =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : ℂ)] ψ := by
    filter_upwards [hψeq,
      hgraph.eventually (hf.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hif)] with t ht hu
    apply hu.mp
    simpa [simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction] using ht
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ₀, hψcont, hψderiv, ?_, hψeq, hψunique⟩
  filter_upwards [hgcont, hgψ.eventually_nhds] with t hcont heq
  have heq' : g =ᶠ[𝓝 t] ψ := heq
  exact hcont.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq'.symm

name: NLAlib.least_squares_forward_ratio_le
statement:
theorem least_squares_forward_ratio_le {Q M a X b R ε : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hX : 0 < X) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (_hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (_hb : 0 ≤ b) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hsmall : M * a * ε < 1)
    (hb : b ≤ M * X + R)
    (hQ : Q ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * b + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) :
    Q / X ≤ M * a * ε / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (2 + (M * a + 1) * R / (M * X))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < 1 - M * a * ε := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
  have hc : 0 ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) := div_nonneg ha hd.le
  calc
    Q / X ≤ (a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * b + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) / X :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hQ hX.le
    _ ≤ (a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * (M * X + R) + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) / X := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hX.le
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hε]
    _ = _ := by field_simp [hM.ne', hX.ne', hd.ne']; ring

name: NLAlib.least_squares_forward_angle_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem least_squares_forward_angle_coefficient_le {Q M a X b R ε L : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hX : 0 < X) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hsmall : M * a * ε < 1)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hLX : L ≤ M * X) (hLb : L ≤ b)
    (hQ : Q ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * b + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) :
    Q / X ≤ ε * (2 * (M * a) / (L / b) + (M * a) ^ 2 * (R / L)) /
      (1 - M * a * ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < 1 - M * a * ε := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
  have hc : 0 ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) := div_nonneg ha hd.le
  have hbX : b / X ≤ M * b / L := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hX hL).2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLX hb.le]
  have hRX : R / X ≤ M * R / L := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hX hL).2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLX hR]
  have hMb : M ≤ M * b / L := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hL).2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLb hM.le
  calc
    Q / X ≤ (a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * b + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) / X :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hQ hX.le
    _ = a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * (b / X) + ε * M + a * ε * M * (R / X)) := by
        field_simp [hX.ne', hd.ne']
    _ ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * (M * b / L) + ε * (M * b / L) + a * ε * M * (M * R / L)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc
        exact add_le_add (add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbX hε)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMb hε))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRX (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hε) hM.le))
    _ = _ := by field_simp [hL.ne', hb.ne', hd.ne']; ring

name: NLAlib.first_order_reciprocal_bound_le
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < 1 - κ * ε := by linarith
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).2
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ κ * C * ε ^ 2 * (1 - 2 * κ * ε) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hκ hC) (sq_nonneg ε)) (by linarith)
  nlinarith [hnonneg]

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_isBestFrobRankApprox A k
  rw [← hB.frobSq_sub_eq_bestRankFrobSq]
  exact frobSq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.frobSq_sub_eq_bestRankFrobSq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_sub
statement:
private theorem sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_sub
    (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hB : B.rank ≤ k) :
    Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_isBestFrobRankApprox A k
  rw [sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_eq hC, frobNorm, frobNorm]
  exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hC.2 B hB)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_add
statement:
private theorem sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_add (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) ≤ Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq B k) + frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_isBestFrobRankApprox B k
  have hbest := sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_sub A C k hC.1
  have hsplit : A - C = (A - B) + (B - C) := by abel
  have htri := frobNorm_add_le (A - B) (B - C)
  rw [← hsplit, ← sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_eq hC] at htri
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_sub_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_sub_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) - Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq B k)| ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_add A B k
  have h2 := sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_le_add B A k
  have hnorm : frobNorm (B - A) = frobNorm (A - B) := by
    unfold frobNorm
    rw [frobSq_sub_comm]
  rw [hnorm] at h2
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.lipschitz_sqrt_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem lipschitz_sqrt_bestRankFrobSq [DecidableEq m] (k : ℕ) :
    LipschitzWith ⟨Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ), Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩
      (fun A : Matrix m n ℝ => Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k))
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro A B
  have hcompare : frobNorm (A - B) ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm (A - B) := by
    have hr : ((A - B).rank : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast (A - B).rank_le_card_width
    exact (frobNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_specNorm (A - B)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hr) (specNorm_nonneg _))
  calc
    dist (Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k)) (Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq B k)) =
        |Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) - Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq B k)| := Real.dist_eq _ _
    _ ≤ frobNorm (A - B) := abs_sqrt_bestRankFrobSq_sub_le_frobNorm A B k
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm (A - B) := hcompare
    _ = (⟨Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ), Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩ : ℝ≥0) * dist A B := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.continuous_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem continuous_bestRankFrobSq [DecidableEq m] (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun A : Matrix m n ℝ => bestRankFrobSq A k)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (lipschitz_sqrt_bestRankFrobSq (m := m) (n := n) k).continuous.pow 2
  have he : (fun A : Matrix m n ℝ => Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k)) ^ 2 =
      (fun A : Matrix m n ℝ => bestRankFrobSq A k) := by
    funext A
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (bestRankFrobSq_nonneg A k)
  rw [he] at hc
  exact hc

name: NLAlib.measurable_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem measurable_bestRankFrobSq [DecidableEq m] (k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun G : m → n → ℝ => bestRankFrobSq (Matrix.of G) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hOf : Continuous (fun G : m → n → ℝ => Matrix.of G) := continuous_id
  exact ((continuous_bestRankFrobSq k).comp hOf).measurable

name: NLAlib.analyticAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction
statement:
theorem analyticAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using spectrum.notMem_iff.mp hμ
  have hfst : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1) 0 :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ).analyticAt _
  have hsnd : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) 0 :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ).analyticAt _
  have hK : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ =>
      (μ + p.2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - p.1 • F) 0 :=
    (((analyticAt_const.add hsnd).smul analyticAt_const).sub
      analyticAt_const).sub (hfst.smul analyticAt_const)
  have hi : AnalyticAt ℂ Ring.inverse
      ((μ + (0 : ℂ × ℂ).2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - (0 : ℂ × ℂ).1 • F) := by
    simpa only [Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, add_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero,
      hunit.unit_spec] using (analyticAt_inverse (𝕜 := ℂ) hunit.unit)
  exact (hsnd.sub (hfst.mul analyticAt_const)).sub
    ((hfst.pow 2).mul (((schurResolventCoupling b c).analyticAt _).comp
      (hi.comp (f := fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (μ + p.2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - p.1 • F) hK)))

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ ψ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt ψ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ),
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c p = 0 ↔ ψ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  let f := simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c
  let D : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ - a • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ
  have hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f D 0 :=
    hasStrictFDerivAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c hμ
  have hreg : ContDiffAt ℂ ω f 0 :=
    (analyticAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c hμ).contDiffAt
  have hD₂ : D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change z - a * 0 = z
    ring
  have hif : (fderiv ℂ f 0 ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hf.hasFDerivAt.fderiv, hD₂]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℂ ℂ, rfl⟩
  let ψ := hreg.implicitFunction (by simp : (ω : ℕ∞ω) ≠ 0) hif
  have hψ₀ : ψ 0 = 0 := hreg.implicitFunction_apply_self (by simp) hif
  have hψanalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ ψ 0 :=
    (hreg.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by simp) hif).analyticAt
  have hderiv : -(fderiv ℂ f 0 ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).inverse ∘L
      (fderiv ℂ f 0 ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℂ ℂ ℂ) =
        a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ := by
    rw [hf.hasFDerivAt.fderiv, hD₂, ContinuousLinearMap.inverse_id]
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change -(0 - a * z) = a * z
    ring
  have hψderiv : HasDerivAt ψ a 0 := by
    have h := (hreg.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunction (by simp) hif).hasFDerivAt.hasDerivAt
    rw [hderiv] at h
    simpa using h
  have hf₀ : f 0 = 0 := by simp [f, simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction]
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ₀, hψanalytic, hψderiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hf₀, Prod.fst_zero] using
      hreg.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by simp) hif
  · simpa only [hf₀] using hreg.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunction (by simp) hif

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block
    {l : Type*} [Unique l] (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ φ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt φ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
          t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
            (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ₀, hψanalytic, hψderiv, hψeq, _⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch μ a B F b c hμ
  let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => μ + ψ t
  have hgraph : Tendsto (fun t : ℂ => (t, ψ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ)) := by
    change Tendsto (fun t : ℂ => (t, ψ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), 0))
    simpa only [hψ₀, id_eq] using
      (continuousAt_id.prodMk hψderiv.continuousAt).tendsto
  refine ⟨φ, by simp [φ, hψ₀], analyticAt_const.add hψanalytic,
    hψderiv.const_add μ, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hψeq,
    hgraph.eventually (eventually_isUnit_shifted_pencil μ B F hμ)] with t ht hKt
  exact (mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero μ a t (ψ t) B F b c hKt).mpr ht

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = d i ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ φ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt φ (A i i) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (Matrix.diagonal d + t • A))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := {j : n // j = i}
  let R := {j : n // j ≠ i}
  let : Unique L := ⟨⟨⟨i, rfl⟩⟩, fun j => Subtype.ext j.property⟩
  let e : L ⊕ R ≃ n := Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)
  let B : Matrix R R ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun j => d j.val)
  let F : Matrix R R ℂ := A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
  let b : R → ℂ := fun j => A i j.val
  let c : R → ℂ := fun j => A j.val i
  have hsep : d i ∉ spectrum ℂ B := by
    rw [spectrum_diagonal]
    rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact j.property (hd hj)
  have hM : (Matrix.diagonal d).submatrix e e =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : L => d i)) 0 0 B := by
    have hB : (Matrix.diagonal d).submatrix (fun j : R => j.val) (fun j : R => j.val) = B := by
      ext j k
      simp only [B, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
      exact if_congr (Subtype.val_injective.eq_iff) rfl rfl
    have h := submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_of_isolated_coordinate (Matrix.diagonal d) i (d i)
      (fun j => by by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj])
      (fun j => by by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj, Ne.symm])
    convert! h using 1
    congr 1
    exact hB.symm
  have hA : A.submatrix e e =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : L => A i i))
        (Matrix.replicateRow L b) (Matrix.replicateCol L c) F :=
    submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_scalar_row_col A i
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφanalytic, hφderiv, hφspec⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block (l := L) (d i) (A i i) B F b c hsep
  refine ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφanalytic, hφderiv, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hφspec] with t ht
  have ht' : φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ ((Matrix.diagonal d + t • A).submatrix e e) := by
    change φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ ((Matrix.diagonal d).submatrix e e + t • A.submatrix e e)
    rw [hM, hA]
    convert! ht using 1
    congr 10 <;> exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly] at ht' ⊢
  have hc := Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm (Matrix.diagonal d + t • A)
  exact hc ▸ ht'

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_diagonal_expansion
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_diagonal_expansion
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    ∃ φ g : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = d i ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ φ 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (Matrix.diagonal d + t • A)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t = d i + t * A i i + t ^ 2 * g t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφanalytic, hφderiv, hφspec⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal d hd A i
  obtain ⟨g, hga, hg⟩ := hφanalytic.exists_eventuallyEq_sum_add_pow_mul 2
  refine ⟨φ, g, hφ₀, hφanalytic, hga, hφspec, ?_⟩
  simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_one,
    hφ₀, hφderiv.deriv, smul_eq_mul] using hg

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    ∃ lam g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ lam z) ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
        lam z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + z • Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
        lam z = z * d i + A i i + z⁻¹ * g z⁻¹) ∧
      (fun z => lam z - (z * d i + A i i)) =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ] (fun z => z⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, g, _, hφa, hga, hφspec, hφeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_diagonal_expansion d hd A i
  let lam : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z * φ z⁻¹
  have hi : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z⁻¹) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv₀_cobounded
  have hnz : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, z ≠ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with z hz
    intro hzero
    norm_num [hzero] at hz
  have hlameq : ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      lam z = z * d i + A i i + z⁻¹ * g z⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [hi.eventually hφeq, hnz] with z hz hzne
    dsimp [lam]
    rw [hz]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨lam, g, hga, ?_, ?_, hlameq, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hi.eventually hφa.eventually_analyticAt, hnz] with z hz hzne
    exact analyticAt_id.mul (hz.comp (analyticAt_inv hzne))
  · filter_upwards [hi.eventually hφspec, hnz] with z hz hzne
    have hs := (spectrum.smul_mem_smul_iff (R := ℂ)
      (r := Units.mk0 z hzne) (a := Matrix.diagonal d + z⁻¹ • A) (s := φ z⁻¹)).mpr hz
    simpa only [Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0, smul_eq_mul, smul_add,
      smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hzne, one_smul, add_comm] using hs
  · have hgO : (fun z : ℂ => g z⁻¹) =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ] (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
      hga.continuousAt.isBigO.comp_tendsto hi
    have hO := (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun z : ℂ => z⁻¹)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)).mul hgO
    apply hO.congr' ?_ (by simp)
    filter_upwards [hlameq] with z hz
    rw [hz]
    ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pos_of_pinv_solution_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hfit := (pinv_solution_norm_pos hA b hx).1
  have hbound := norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le A ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)
  by_contra h
  have hz : specNorm A=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h) (specNorm_nonneg A)
  rw [hz,zero_mul] at hbound
  linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem norm_least_squares_sub_div_le {A E : Matrix m n ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hx : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b ≠ 0) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ ε*‖b‖)
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    let x
proof:
:= (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
    let y := (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f)
    let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
    ‖y-x‖/‖x‖ ≤ moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε/(1-moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε)*
      (2+(moorePenroseConditionNumber A+1)*‖r‖/(specNorm A*‖x‖)) := by
  intro x y r
  have hb : ‖b‖ ≤ specNorm A*‖x‖+‖r‖ := by
    calc
      ‖b‖ = ‖A.toEuclideanLin x+r‖ := by congr 1; dsimp only [r]; abel
      _ ≤ ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖+‖r‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm A*‖x‖+‖r‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le A x) (le_refl ‖r‖)
  have hQ := norm_least_squares_sub_le_relative_data hA hε hE b f hf hsmall
  exact least_squares_forward_ratio_le
    (specNorm_pos_of_pinv_solution_ne_zero hA b hx) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)
    (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg r) (norm_nonneg b) hε hsmall hb hQ

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_residual_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem norm_least_squares_residual_sub_div_le {A E : Matrix m n ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ ε*‖b‖)
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    let r
proof:
:= b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)
    let s := (b+f)-(A+E).toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f))
    ‖r-s‖/‖b‖ ≤ (1+moorePenroseConditionNumber A)*ε := by
  intro r s
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hb)).mpr
  exact norm_least_squares_residual_sub_le_relative_data hA hE b f hf hsmall

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_sub_div_le_angle_ratios
statement:
theorem norm_least_squares_sub_div_le_angle_ratios {A E : Matrix m n ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hx : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b ≠ 0) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ ε*‖b‖)
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    let x
proof:
:= (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
    let y := (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f)
    let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
    ‖y-x‖/‖x‖ ≤ ε*(2*moorePenroseConditionNumber A/(‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖)+
      moorePenroseConditionNumber A^2*(‖r‖/‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖))/(1-moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε) := by
  intro x y r
  obtain ⟨hL,hb⟩ := pinv_solution_norm_pos hA b hx
  exact least_squares_forward_angle_coefficient_le
    (specNorm_pos_of_pinv_solution_ne_zero hA b hx) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)
    (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg r) hb hε hsmall hL
    (norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le A x) (norm_pinv_fit_le_norm_data A b)
    (norm_least_squares_sub_le_relative_data hA hε hE b f hf hsmall)

name: NLAlib.exists_least_squares_angle_error_bound
statement:
theorem exists_least_squares_angle_error_bound {A E : Matrix m n ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hx : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b ≠ 0) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ ε*‖b‖)
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    let x
proof:
:= (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
    let y := (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f)
    let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < Real.pi/2 ∧
      Real.cos θ=‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖/‖b‖ ∧
      Real.sin θ=‖r‖/‖b‖ ∧ Real.tan θ=‖r‖/‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖ ∧
      (let C := 2*moorePenroseConditionNumber A/Real.cos θ+moorePenroseConditionNumber A^2*Real.tan θ
       ‖y-x‖/‖x‖ ≤ ε*C/(1-moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε) ∧
       (ε ≤ 1/(2*moorePenroseConditionNumber A) →
         ‖y-x‖/‖x‖ ≤ ε*C+2*moorePenroseConditionNumber A*C*ε^2)) := by
  intro x y r
  obtain ⟨θ,hθ,hθ',hc,hs,ht⟩ := exists_least_squares_angle hA b hx
  have hbound := norm_least_squares_sub_div_le_angle_ratios hA b f hx hε hE hf hsmall
  have hC : 0 ≤ 2*moorePenroseConditionNumber A/Real.cos θ+moorePenroseConditionNumber A^2*Real.tan θ := by
    have hκ := moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A
    rw [hc,ht]
    positivity
  refine ⟨θ,hθ,hθ',hc,hs,ht,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [hc,ht] using hbound
  · intro hhalf
    have hκpos : 0 < moorePenroseConditionNumber A := by
      have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        have hnorm := specNorm_pos_of_pinv_solution_ne_zero hA b hx
        rw [hz,specNorm_zero] at hnorm
        linarith
      have hκ := one_le_moorePenroseConditionNumber hA0
      linarith
    have hhalf' : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε ≤ 1/2 := by
      have h := (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) hκpos)).mp hhalf
      nlinarith
    have he := first_order_reciprocal_bound_le (moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A) hC hε hhalf'
    apply (show ‖y-x‖/‖x‖ ≤ ε*(2*moorePenroseConditionNumber A/Real.cos θ+
      moorePenroseConditionNumber A^2*Real.tan θ)/(1-moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε) from by
        simpa only [hc,ht] using hbound).trans he

name: NLAlib.eventually_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i)
    {R : ℝ} {branch : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun u => branch i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))))
    (hspec : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ →
      (∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => branch i u)) :
    ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i, branch i (conj u) = conj (branch i u)
proof:
:= by
  let d : n → ℝ := fun i => (s - b i)⁻¹
  have hd : Function.Injective d := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hb
    have heq := inv_injective hij
    linarith
  apply Complex.eventually_conj_eq_of_tendsto_affine_of_finite_matching
    branch d (fun i => -A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)) hd
  · intro i
    simpa only [d, Complex.ofReal_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hlim i
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := ℂ)).eventually_gt_atTop R]
    with u hu i
  let M : Matrix n n ℂ :=
    -(Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * A) +
      u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hM : ∀ j, branch j u ∈ spectrum ℂ M := fun j =>
    (mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff A b s hs u _).mpr ((hspec u hu).1 j)
  have hconjR : R < ‖conj u‖ := by simpa only [norm_conj] using hu
  have hc := conj_mem_spectrum_conjTranspose ((hspec (conj u) hconjR).1 i)
  have hD : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext i; simp)
  have hstar : (A - branch i (conj u) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))ᴴ =
      A - conj (branch i (conj u)) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) := by
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, hA.eq, hD.eq]
  rw [hstar] at hc
  have hc' : u - (s : ℂ) * conj (branch i (conj u)) ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (A - conj (branch i (conj u)) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) := by
    simpa using hc
  have hmem : conj (branch i (conj u)) ∈ spectrum ℂ M :=
    (mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff A b s hs u _).mpr hc'
  rw [spectrum_eq_range_of_injective_mem_spectrum _ _ (hspec u hu).2 hM] at hmem
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨j, hj.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_im_pos_iff_conj_eq
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_im_pos_iff_conj_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {u | R < ‖u‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun u => branch i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ →
        (∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
          (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i u)) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → ∀ i, 0 < (branch i u).im ↔ b i < s) ∧
      ∀ i u, R < ‖u‖ → branch i (conj u) = conj (branch i u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, hlabel⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_im_pos_iff hA b hb s hs
  have href := eventually_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq hA b hb s hs
    (fun i => (hbranch i).2) hspec
  obtain ⟨S, _, hS⟩ := Filter.hasBasis_cobounded_norm.eventually_iff.mp href
  refine ⟨max R S, hR.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), branch, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact ⟨(hbranch i).1.mono (fun u hu => (le_max_left R S).trans_lt hu), (hbranch i).2⟩
  · intro u hu
    exact hspec u ((le_max_left R S).trans_lt hu)
  · intro u hu him i
    exact hlabel u ((le_max_left R S).trans_lt hu) him i
  · intro i u hu
    exact hS ((le_max_right R S).trans hu.le) i

name: NLAlib.inverse_branch_im_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem inverse_branch_im_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) {u z : ℂ} (hu : 0 < u.im)
    (hmem : u - (s : ℂ) * z ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) : z.im ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzim
  have hzreal : (z.re : ℂ) = z := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hzim]
  have hB : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))).IsHermitian := by
    rw [Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_iff]
    intro i
    simp [IsSelfAdjoint]
  have hreal : (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))).IsHermitian := by
    rw [← hzreal]
    exact hA.sub (hB.smul (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint]))
  have him := hreal.isSelfAdjoint.im_eq_zero_of_mem_spectrum hmem
  have huim : u.im = 0 := by simpa [hzim] using him
  exact (ne_of_gt hu) huim

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_im_pos_iff
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_im_pos_iff
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {u | R < ‖u‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun u => branch i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ →
        (∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
          (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i u)) ∧
      ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → ∀ i, 0 < (branch i u).im ↔ b i < s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches A b hb s hs
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, ?_⟩
  intro u hu him i
  have hreal : ∀ v, R < ‖v‖ → 0 < v.im → (branch i v).im ≠ 0 := by
    intro v hv hvi
    exact inverse_branch_im_ne_zero hA b s hvi ((hspec v hv).1 i)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun v => branch i v - (((s - b i)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * v)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using (hbranch i).2
  simpa only [inv_pos, sub_pos] using
    Complex.im_pos_iff_slope_pos_of_tendsto_affine
      (hbranch i).1.continuousOn hreal hlim (inv_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i))) hu him

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_full_width
proof:
:= by
  have hfull : P*Pᵀ=1 :=
    (Matrix.mul_eq_one_comm_of_card_eq (m := k) (n := n) (R := ℝ)
      (A := Pᵀ) (B := P) (eq := hcard)).mp hP
  apply (frobNorm_eq_zero_iff _).mp
  rw [frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hP hQ, residual_eq_one_sub_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hfull, sub_self, Matrix.zero_mul, frobNorm_zero]

name: NLAlib.davis_kahan_bounds
statement:
theorem davis_kahan_bounds {A E : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n k ℝ} {R : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R) (hcomp : Qhat*Qhatᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1)
    {L : Matrix k k ℝ} {M : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hAQ : A*Q=Q*L) (hAR : (A+E)*R=R*M) :
    (∀ a b δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      (∀ j, a ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ∧
        (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ≤ b) →
      (∀ i, (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨
        b+δ ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i) →
      specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ ∧
      specNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ ≤ specNorm (E*Q)/δ ∧ specNorm (E*Q)/δ ≤ specNorm E/δ ∧
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ ∧
      frobNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ ≤ frobNorm (E*Q)/δ ∧ frobNorm (E*Q)/δ ≤ frobNorm E/δ ∧
      frobNorm (E*Q)/δ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card k)*specNorm E/δ) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ hj0 : 0 < j, ∀ hjN : j < Fintype.card n,
      0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩ →
      let S := sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hjN.le) (topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hjN.le)
      let δ := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩
      specNorm S ≤ specNorm E/δ ∧ frobNorm S ≤ min (Real.sqrt j*specNorm E) (frobNorm E)/δ) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ hj0 : 0 < j, ∀ hjN : j < Fintype.card n,
      0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩ →
      let S := sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hjN.le) (topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hjN.le)
      let g := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩
      specNorm S ≤ 2*specNorm E/g ∧ frobNorm S ≤ 2*min (Real.sqrt j*specNorm E) (frobNorm E)/g) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ hj : j ≤ Fintype.card n, j=0 ∨ j=Fintype.card n →
      sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hj) (topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hj)=0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b δ hδ hint hout
    have hh := sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_interval hA hE
      hQ hQhat hR hcomp hAQ hAR hδ hint hout
    have hSc := specNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hR (E*Q)
    have hFc := frobNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hR (E*Q)
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hSc hFc
    exact ⟨hh.1,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hSc hδ.le,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E) hδ.le, hh.2,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hFc hδ.le,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (frobNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E) hδ.le,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (frobNorm_mul_frame_le_sqrt_card_mul_specNorm hQ E) hδ.le⟩
  · intro j hj0 hjN hgap
    exact sinePrincipalAngles_le_perturbation_div_top_gap hA hE hj0 hjN hgap
  · intro j hj0 hjN hg
