    exact ⟨specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_specNorm_div_population_gap hA hE hj0 hjN hg,
      frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_min_div_population_gap hA hE hj0 hjN hg
        (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hjN.le)
        (trace_topEigenframe_compression_eq_prefix (hA.add hE) hjN.le)⟩
  · intro j hj hend
    rcases hend with hzero | hfull
    · ext i l
      have hi := i.isLt
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hi
      omega
    · exact sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_full_width
        (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hj)
        (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hj) (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hfull)

name: NLAlib.columnProjector_apply_pinv_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem columnProjector_apply_pinv_residual_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    (A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin
      (b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b))=0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A
  change (A*moorePenroseInverse A)*(A*moorePenroseInverse A)=A*moorePenroseInverse A at h
  rw [← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply, map_sub, ← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply, h, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.norm_pinv_apply_pinv_residual_le
proof:
:= b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)
    ‖(moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin r‖ ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A)*‖r‖ := by
  intro r
  have hz : (A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin r=0 :=
    columnProjector_apply_pinv_residual_eq_zero A b
  have he : (moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin r =
      (moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin
        ((B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin r) := by
    rw [map_sub (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (m := m) (n := m) (𝕜 := ℝ)),
      LinearMap.sub_apply, hz, sub_zero, ← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse]
  have hgap : specNorm (B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A) := by
    rw [specNorm_sub_comm]
    exact specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm hr
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*
        ‖(B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin r‖ :=
      norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*
        (specNorm (B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*‖r‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*(specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A)*‖r‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgap (norm_nonneg _))
        (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_sub_le_pinv
statement:
theorem norm_least_squares_sub_le_pinv {A E : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n)
    (hE : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E < 1)
    (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    let x
proof:
:= (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
    let y := (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f)
    let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
    ‖y-x‖ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A+E))*
      (‖f‖+specNorm E*‖x‖+specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E*‖r‖) := by
  intro x y r
  have hB := rank_add_eq_card_of_pinv_mul_specNorm_lt_one hA hE
  have hleft := moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card hB
  have hsum : b+f = (A+E).toEuclideanLin x+(f-E.toEuclideanLin x)+r := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    abel
  have he : y-x = (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (f-E.toEuclideanLin x)+
      (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin r := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [hsum, map_add, map_add, ← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply, hleft,
      toEuclideanLin_one_apply]
    abel
  have hr := norm_pinv_apply_pinv_residual_le (A := A) (B := A+E) (hA.trans hB.symm) b
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at hr
  have hf : ‖f-E.toEuclideanLin x‖ ≤ ‖f‖+specNorm E*‖x‖ :=
    (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) (norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le E x))
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (f-E.toEuclideanLin x)‖+
        ‖(moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin r‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A+E))*(‖f‖+specNorm E*‖x‖)+
        specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A+E))*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E*‖r‖ :=
      add_le_add ((norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf (specNorm_nonneg _))) hr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_residual_sub_le
proof:
:= b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)
    let s := (b+f)-B.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin (b+f))
    ‖r-s‖ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A)*‖b‖+‖f‖ := by
  intro r s
  have halg (P Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ m →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
      (b-P b)-((b+f)-Q (b+f))=(Q-P) b-(1-Q) f := by
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_add]
    abel
  have he : r-s = (B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b-
      (1-B*moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin f := by
    have h := halg (A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin
      (B*moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin
    change (b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b))-
      ((b+f)-B.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin (b+f)))=_
    rw [← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply, ← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply,
      map_sub (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (m := m) (n := m) (𝕜 := ℝ)),
      map_sub (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (m := m) (n := m) (𝕜 := ℝ))]
    convert h using 1
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, toEuclideanLin_one_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
  have hgap : specNorm (B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A) := by
    rw [specNorm_sub_comm]
    exact specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm hr
  rw [he]
  have h1 : ‖(B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b‖ ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A)*‖b‖ :=
    (norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le (B*moorePenroseInverse B-A*moorePenroseInverse A) b).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgap (norm_nonneg b))
  have h2 : ‖(1-B*moorePenroseInverse B).toEuclideanLin f‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := by
    have hbound := norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le (1-B*moorePenroseInverse B) f
    have hcontract := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (isMoorePenroseInverse B).specNorm_one_sub_mul_le (norm_nonneg f)
    exact hbound.trans (by simpa only [one_mul] using hcontract)
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add h1 h2)

name: NLAlib.rank_add_eq_card_of_moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  apply rank_add_eq_card_of_pinv_mul_specNorm_lt_one hA
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*(ε*specNorm A) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε := by unfold moorePenroseConditionNumber; ring
    _ < 1 := hsmall

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_lt_one {A E : Matrix m n ℝ}
    {ε : ℝ} (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A)
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)/(1-moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E ≤ moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε := by
    calc
      _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*(ε*specNorm A) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by unfold moorePenroseConditionNumber; ring
  exact (specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_rank_eq_card hA (hp.trans_lt hsmall)).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_nonneg _) (sub_pos.mpr hsmall)
      (sub_le_sub_left hp 1))

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_sub_le_relative_data
statement:
theorem norm_least_squares_sub_le_relative_data {A E : Matrix m n ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (_hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A) (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ ε*‖b‖) (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    let x
proof:
:= (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
    let y := (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f)
    let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
    ‖y-x‖ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)/(1-moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε)*
      (ε*‖b‖+ε*specNorm A*‖x‖+specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*ε*specNorm A*‖r‖) := by
  intro x y r
  have hp : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E < 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*(ε*specNorm A) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε := by unfold moorePenroseConditionNumber; ring
      _ < 1 := hsmall
  have ht : ‖f‖+specNorm E*‖x‖+specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E*‖r‖ ≤
      ε*‖b‖+ε*specNorm A*‖x‖+specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*ε*specNorm A*‖r‖ := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (norm_nonneg x)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (specNorm_nonneg (moorePenroseInverse A))) (norm_nonneg r)
    nlinarith
  exact (norm_least_squares_sub_le_pinv hA hp b f).trans
    (mul_le_mul (specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_lt_one hA hE hsmall) ht
      (by
        exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg f)
          (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg E) (norm_nonneg x)))
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg E)) (norm_nonneg r)))
      (div_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (sub_pos.mpr hsmall).le))

name: NLAlib.norm_least_squares_residual_sub_le_relative_data
statement:
theorem norm_least_squares_residual_sub_le_relative_data {A E : Matrix m n ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (hE : specNorm E ≤ ε*specNorm A)
    (b f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ ε*‖b‖)
    (hsmall : moorePenroseConditionNumber A*ε < 1) :
    let r
proof:
:= b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)
    let s := (b+f)-(A+E).toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse (A+E)).toEuclideanLin (b+f))
    ‖r-s‖ ≤ (1+moorePenroseConditionNumber A)*ε*‖b‖ := by
  intro r s
  have hB := rank_add_eq_card_of_moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_lt_one hA hE hsmall
  have h := norm_least_squares_residual_sub_le (A := A) (B := A+E) (hA.trans hB.symm) b f
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (specNorm_nonneg (moorePenroseInverse A))) (norm_nonneg b)
  apply h.trans
  unfold moorePenroseConditionNumber
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_of_diagonal_intertwining
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : Matrix.col V i ≠ 0 := (Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mpr hV).ne_zero i
  have hAi : A *ᵥ Matrix.col V i = d i • Matrix.col V i := by
    funext j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M j i) hA
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.col_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h
  exact Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_isRoot_charpoly (isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul hcol hAi)

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_euclidean_norm_le_residual
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_euclidean_norm_le_residual
    {A V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ≤
      specNorm V * specNorm V⁻¹ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  let N : AddGroupNorm (n → ℂ) :=
    { toFun x := ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖
      map_zero' := by simp
      add_le' x y := by
        simpa only [WithLp.toLp_add] using
          (norm_add_le (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (WithLp.toLp 2 y))
      neg' x := by simp only [WithLp.toLp_neg, norm_neg]
      eq_zero_of_map_eq_zero' x h := by
        have hzero : (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp h
        exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp hzero }
  have hhom : ∀ (c : ℂ) (z : n → ℂ), N (c • z) = ‖c‖ * N z := by
    intro c z
    exact norm_smul c (WithLp.toLp 2 z : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
  have habs : ∀ (z w : n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖z i‖ ≤ ‖w i‖) → N z ≤ N w := by
    intro z w hzw
    change ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 z : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ≤
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hzw i) 2
  have haction : ∀ (M : Matrix n n ℂ) z, N (M *ᵥ z) ≤ ‖M‖ * N z := by
    intro M z
    exact M.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 z : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
  exact exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_norm_le_residual_of_absolute_norm
    N hhom habs (fun M => ‖M‖) norm_nonneg haction hV hA x hx μ

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div
    {A V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ ≤ (specNorm V * specNorm V⁻¹) *
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ /
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_euclidean_norm_le_residual hV hA x hx μ
  have hxnorm : 0 < ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ :=
    norm_pos_iff.mpr (fun h => hx (congrArg WithLp.ofLp h))
  exact ⟨i, (le_div_iff₀ hxnorm).mpr hi⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div_of_normal
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ ν ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖ν - μ‖ ≤
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ /
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => exact (hx (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
  | inr hn =>
    obtain ⟨U, d, hUd⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
    have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
    have hAU : A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d := by
      rw [hUd, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUU, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hUinv : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)⁻¹ = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ :=
      Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hUU
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div
      (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := U)) hAU x hx μ
    refine ⟨d i, mem_spectrum_of_diagonal_intertwining (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := U)) hAU i, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hUinv, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose, CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary,
      one_mul] using hi

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_norm_perturbation_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_norm_perturbation_of_normal
    {A E : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E)) :
    ∃ ν ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖ν - μ‖ ≤ specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hbound⟩ := exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div_of_normal hA x hx μ
  have hres : A *ᵥ x - μ • x = -(E *ᵥ x) := by
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec] at hAx
    calc
      A *ᵥ x - μ • x = A *ᵥ x - (A *ᵥ x + E *ᵥ x) := by rw [hAx]
      _ = -(E *ᵥ x) := by abel
  refine ⟨ν, hν, hbound.trans ?_⟩
  rw [hres, WithLp.toLp_neg, norm_neg]
  have hxnorm : 0 < ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ :=
    norm_pos_iff.mpr (fun h => hx (congrArg WithLp.ofLp h))
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hxnorm).mpr (E.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n))

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_with_multiplicity
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_with_multiplicity
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (E : Matrix n n ℂ) {x y : n → ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + t • E)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ), p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + p.1 • E) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), (A + t • E).charpoly.rootMultiplicity (φ t) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique⟩ :=
    exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple E hx hy hAx hyA hμ
  refine ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique, ?_⟩
  exact eventually_rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_continuous_eigenvalue A E id φ
    continuousAt_id hφcont rfl (by simpa only [hφ₀] using hμ) hφspec

name: NLAlib.exists_real_parameter_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_with_multiplicity
statement:
theorem exists_real_parameter_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_with_multiplicity
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (E : Matrix n n ℂ) {x y : n → ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + (t : ℂ) • E)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (0, μ),
        p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + (p.1 : ℂ) • E) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, (A + (t : ℂ) • E).charpoly.rootMultiplicity (φ t) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique⟩ :=
    exists_real_parameter_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple E hx hy hAx hyA hμ
  refine ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique, ?_⟩
  exact eventually_rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_continuous_eigenvalue A E Complex.ofReal φ
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt hφcont Complex.ofReal_zero
    (by simpa only [hφ₀] using hμ) hφspec

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian_with_multiplicity
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian_with_multiplicity
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (E : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} {μ : ℝ} (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ (Complex.ofReal (x ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x))) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ ((A + t • E).map Complex.ofReal)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (0, (μ : ℂ)),
        p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ ((A + p.1 • E).map Complex.ofReal) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0,
        ((A + t • E).map Complex.ofReal).charpoly.rootMultiplicity (φ t) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique⟩ :=
    exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian E hA hx hAx hμ
  have hmult : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly.rootMultiplicity (φ 0) = 1 := by
    have hchar : (A.map Complex.ofReal).charpoly = Polynomial.map Complex.ofRealHom A.charpoly :=
      Matrix.charpoly_map A Complex.ofRealHom
    rw [hφ₀, hchar]
    simpa only [hμ, Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe] using
      (Polynomial.eq_rootMultiplicity_map (p := A.charpoly) (f := Complex.ofRealHom)
        Complex.ofReal_injective μ).symm
  have hmap (t : ℝ) : (A + t • E).map Complex.ofReal =
      A.map Complex.ofReal + (t : ℂ) • E.map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j
    simp
  refine ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique, ?_⟩
  simpa only [hmap] using
    eventually_rootMultiplicity_eq_one_of_continuous_eigenvalue
      (A.map Complex.ofReal) (E.map Complex.ofReal) Complex.ofReal φ
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt hφcont Complex.ofReal_zero hmult
      (by simpa only [hmap] using hφspec)

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_max_le_max_of_coupled
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hβ
    exact (show (α-β)*y ≤ g by nlinarith).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · rw [max_eq_left h]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hβ
    exact (show (α-β)*x ≤ f by nlinarith).trans (le_max_left _ _)

name: NLAlib.sub_sq_mul_add_sq_le_add_sq_of_coupled
statement:
theorem sub_sq_mul_add_sq_le_add_sq_of_coupled {α β x y f g : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ α-β) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y)
    (_hf0 : 0 ≤ f) (_hg0 : 0 ≤ g)
    (hx : α*x ≤ β*y+f) (hy : α*y ≤ β*x+g) :
    (α-β)^2*(x^2+y^2) ≤ f^2+g^2
proof:
:= by
  have hxx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx hx0
  have hyy := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy hy0
  have hdiff := mul_nonneg hβ (sq_nonneg (x-y))
  have hbase : (α-β)*(x^2+y^2) ≤ f*x+g*y := by nlinarith
  have hcs : (f*x+g*y)^2 ≤ (f^2+g^2)*(x^2+y^2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f*y-g*x)]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (α-β)*(x^2+y^2) := mul_nonneg hδ (by positivity)
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hbase 2
  by_cases hz : x^2+y^2=0
  · rw [hz, mul_zero]
    positivity
  have hs : 0 < x^2+y^2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm hz)
  have hmul : ((α-β)^2*(x^2+y^2))*(x^2+y^2) ≤ (f^2+g^2)*(x^2+y^2) := by
    nlinarith [hsq, hcs]
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hs).mp (by simpa only [mul_comm (x^2+y^2)] using hmul)

name: NLAlib.isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (hF : specNorm F < 1) :
    IsUnit (1 - F)
proof:
:=
  (Units.oneSub F hF).isUnit

name: NLAlib.inv_one_sub_eq_tsum_pow
statement:
theorem inv_one_sub_eq_tsum_pow {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (hF : specNorm F < 1) :
    (1 - F)⁻¹ = ∑' k : ℕ, F ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, geom_series_eq_inverse F hF]

name: NLAlib.hasSum_pow_inv_one_sub
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_inv_one_sub {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (hF : specNorm F < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => F ^ k) (1 - F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  exact hasSum_geom_series_inverse F hF

name: NLAlib.inv_one_sub_eq_one_add_mul
statement:
theorem inv_one_sub_eq_one_add_mul {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsUnit (1 - F)) :
    (1 - F)⁻¹ = 1 + F * (1 - F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsUnit (1 - F).det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h
  have h1 : (1 - F) * (1 - F)⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at h1
  calc (1 - F)⁻¹ = ((1 - F)⁻¹ - F * (1 - F)⁻¹) + F * (1 - F)⁻¹ := by abel
    _ = 1 + F * (1 - F)⁻¹ := by rw [h1]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_one_sub_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_one_sub_le {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (hF : specNorm F < 1) :
    specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ ≤ 1 / (1 - specNorm F)
proof:
:= by
  have hX := inv_one_sub_eq_one_add_mul (isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one hF)
  have hle : specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ ≤ 1 + specNorm F * specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ := by
    calc specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ = specNorm (1 + F * (1 - F)⁻¹) := by rw [← hX]
      _ ≤ specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + specNorm (F * (1 - F)⁻¹) := specNorm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + specNorm F * specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ :=
        add_le_add specNorm_one_le (specNorm_mul_le _ _)
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_one_sub_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_one_sub_sub_one_le {F : Matrix n n ℝ} (hF : specNorm F < 1) :
    specNorm ((1 - F)⁻¹ - 1) ≤ specNorm F / (1 - specNorm F)
proof:
:= by
  have hX := inv_one_sub_eq_one_add_mul (isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one hF)
  have he : (1 - F)⁻¹ - 1 = F * (1 - F)⁻¹ := by
    calc (1 - F)⁻¹ - 1 = (1 + F * (1 - F)⁻¹) - 1 := congrArg (· - 1) hX
      _ = F * (1 - F)⁻¹ := by abel
  rw [he]
  calc specNorm (F * (1 - F)⁻¹) ≤ specNorm F * specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm F * (1 / (1 - specNorm F)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_inv_one_sub_le hF) (specNorm_nonneg F)
    _ = specNorm F / (1 - specNorm F) := by ring

name: NLAlib.isUnit_add_of_specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_add_of_specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hE : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) < 1) : IsUnit (A + E)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA
  have h1 : IsUnit (1 - (-(A⁻¹ * E))) := by
    apply isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one
    rwa [specNorm_neg]
  have heq : A + E = A * (1 - (-(A⁻¹ * E))) := by
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [heq]
  exact hA.mul h1

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_add_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_add_le {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hE : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) < 1) :
    specNorm (A + E)⁻¹ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA
  set F : Matrix n n ℝ := -(A⁻¹ * E) with hFdef
  have hF : specNorm F < 1 := by rwa [hFdef, specNorm_neg]
  have heq : A + E = A * (1 - F) := by
    rw [hFdef, sub_neg_eq_add, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hinv : (A + E)⁻¹ = (1 - F)⁻¹ * A⁻¹ := by
    rw [heq, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  rw [hinv]
  calc specNorm ((1 - F)⁻¹ * A⁻¹) ≤ specNorm (1 - F)⁻¹ * specNorm A⁻¹ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1 / (1 - specNorm F) * specNorm A⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_inv_one_sub_le hF) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = specNorm A⁻¹ / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) := by rw [hFdef, specNorm_neg]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hE : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) < 1) :
    specNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ - A⁻¹) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * specNorm E / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E))
proof:
:= by
  have hAE := isUnit_add_of_specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one hA hE
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) := by linarith
  rw [Matrix.inv_sub_inv (iff_of_true hAE hA), sub_add_cancel_left, Matrix.mul_neg,
    Matrix.neg_mul, specNorm_neg]
  calc specNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ * E * A⁻¹)
      ≤ specNorm (A + E)⁻¹ * specNorm E * specNorm A⁻¹ := by
        refine (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) * specNorm E * specNorm A⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_inv_add_le hA hE)
          (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * specNorm E / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) := by
        field_simp

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hE : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) < 1) :
    frobNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ - A⁻¹) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * frobNorm E / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E))
proof:
:= by
  have hAE := isUnit_add_of_specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one hA hE
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) := by linarith
  rw [Matrix.inv_sub_inv (iff_of_true hAE hA), sub_add_cancel_left, Matrix.mul_neg,
    Matrix.neg_mul, frobNorm_neg]
  calc frobNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ * E * A⁻¹)
      ≤ frobNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ * E) * specNorm A⁻¹ :=
        frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ * E) A⁻¹
    _ ≤ specNorm (A + E)⁻¹ * frobNorm E * specNorm A⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm (A + E)⁻¹ E)
          (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) * frobNorm E * specNorm A⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_inv_add_le hA hE)
          (frobNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * frobNorm E / (1 - specNorm (A⁻¹ * E)) := by
        field_simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one {A E : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hE : specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E < 1) : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) < 1
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (specNorm_mul_le _ _) hE

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le_of_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le_of_mul_lt_one {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hE : specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E < 1) :
    specNorm ((A + E)⁻¹ - A⁻¹) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ ^ 2 * specNorm E / (1 - specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := specNorm_inv_add_sub_inv_le hA (specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one hE)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  have hle : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E := specNorm_mul_le _ _
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E := by linarith
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left _ hpos (by linarith)
  exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_add_le_of_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_add_le_of_mul_lt_one {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hE : specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E < 1) :
    specNorm (A + E)⁻¹ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ / (1 - specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E)
proof:
:= by
  refine (specNorm_inv_add_le hA (specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one hE)).trans ?_
  have hle : specNorm (A⁻¹ * E) ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E := specNorm_mul_le _ _
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E := by linarith
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_nonneg _) hpos (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.specNorm_one_sub_mul_le
statement:
theorem IsMoorePenroseInverse.specNorm_one_sub_mul_le [DecidableEq m]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {A' : Matrix n m ℝ} (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A A') :
    specNorm (1 - A * A') ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem
  · change (1 - A * A')ᵀ = 1 - A * A'
    rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one,
      show (A * A')ᵀ = A * A' from h.conjTranspose_mul_eq]
  · exact h.mul_isIdempotentElem.one_sub

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.specNorm_one_sub_inv_mul_le
statement:
theorem IsMoorePenroseInverse.specNorm_one_sub_inv_mul_le [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {A' : Matrix n m ℝ} (h : IsMoorePenroseInverse A A') :
    specNorm (1 - A' * A) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  h.swap.specNorm_one_sub_mul_le

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_add_sub_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_add_sub_le [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E) - moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E)) * specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) +
        specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E)) ^ 2 + specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2) *
        specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  have hW := moorePenroseInverse_sub_eq A (A + E)
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.neg_mul] at hW
  set A' := moorePenroseInverse A
  set B' := moorePenroseInverse (A + E)
  have hA := isMoorePenroseInverse A
  have hB := isMoorePenroseInverse (A + E)
  have hP := hA.specNorm_one_sub_mul_le
  have hQ := hB.specNorm_one_sub_inv_mul_le
  have ha := specNorm_nonneg A'
  have hb := specNorm_nonneg B'
  have he := specNorm_nonneg E
  rw [hW]
  have t1 : specNorm (-(B' * E * A')) ≤ specNorm B' * specNorm A' * specNorm E := by
    rw [specNorm_neg]
    calc specNorm (B' * E * A') ≤ specNorm (B' * E) * specNorm A' := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm B' * specNorm E * specNorm A' :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) ha
      _ = _ := by ring
  have t2 : specNorm (B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ * (1 - A * A')) ≤ specNorm B' ^ 2 * specNorm E := by
    have h0 := specNorm_nonneg (B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ)
    calc specNorm (B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ * (1 - A * A'))
        ≤ specNorm (B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ) * specNorm (1 - A * A') := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm (B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ) := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ specNorm (B' * B'ᵀ) * specNorm Eᵀ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm B' * specNorm B'ᵀ * specNorm Eᵀ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = specNorm B' ^ 2 * specNorm E := by
          rw [specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose]; ring
  have t3 : specNorm ((1 - B' * (A + E)) * Eᵀ * A'ᵀ * A') ≤ specNorm A' ^ 2 * specNorm E := by
    have hc : 0 ≤ specNorm Eᵀ * specNorm A'ᵀ * specNorm A' :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)) ha
    calc specNorm ((1 - B' * (A + E)) * Eᵀ * A'ᵀ * A')
        ≤ specNorm ((1 - B' * (A + E)) * Eᵀ * A'ᵀ) * specNorm A' := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm ((1 - B' * (A + E)) * Eᵀ) * specNorm A'ᵀ * specNorm A' :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) ha
      _ ≤ specNorm (1 - B' * (A + E)) * specNorm Eᵀ * specNorm A'ᵀ * specNorm A' :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _)
            (specNorm_nonneg _)) ha
      _ = specNorm (1 - B' * (A + E)) * (specNorm Eᵀ * specNorm A'ᵀ * specNorm A') := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (specNorm Eᵀ * specNorm A'ᵀ * specNorm A') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ hc
      _ = specNorm A' ^ 2 * specNorm E := by
          rw [specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose]; ring
  calc _ ≤ specNorm (-(B' * E * A') + B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ * (1 - A * A')) +
        specNorm ((1 - B' * (A + E)) * Eᵀ * A'ᵀ * A') := specNorm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm (-(B' * E * A')) + specNorm (B' * B'ᵀ * Eᵀ * (1 - A * A')) +
        specNorm ((1 - B' * (A + E)) * Eᵀ * A'ᵀ * A') :=
          add_le_add_left (specNorm_add_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ specNorm B' * specNorm A' * specNorm E + specNorm B' ^ 2 * specNorm E +
        specNorm A' ^ 2 * specNorm E := add_le_add (add_le_add t1 t2) t3
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_add_sub_le_three_mul_max
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_add_sub_le_three_mul_max [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E) - moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      3 * max (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2)
        (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E)) ^ 2) * specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  refine (specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_add_sub_le A E).trans ?_
  set a := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)
  set b := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E))
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := specNorm_nonneg _
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (specNorm_nonneg E)
  have h1 : a ^ 2 ≤ max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) := le_max_left _ _
  have h2 : b ^ 2 ≤ max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) := le_max_right _ _
  have h3 : b * a ≤ max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) := by
    rcases le_total a b with h | h
    · calc b * a ≤ b * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hb
        _ = b ^ 2 := (sq b).symm
        _ ≤ _ := h2
    · calc b * a ≤ a * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h ha
        _ = a ^ 2 := (sq a).symm
        _ ≤ _ := h1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_specNorm_div_singularValues_last
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_specNorm_div_singularValues_last (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hn : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber A = specNorm A / singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber,
    specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive A (by omega), hA,
    mul_one_div]

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_div_le_conditionNumber_mul
statement:
theorem norm_sub_div_le_conditionNumber_mul {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    {x b : n → ℝ} (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) (hb : b ≠ 0) (x' : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - x')‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ≤
      (conditionNumber A).toReal * (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x')‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
  have hd : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA
  rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hA]
  have hbpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) := sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos hb
  have hbx : Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) ≤ specNorm A * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    rw [← hx]; exact sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul A x
  have hxpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    rcases (Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ⬝ᵥ x)).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← h, mul_zero] at hbx; linarith
  have hdiff : x - x' = A⁻¹ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x') := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      ← hx, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h1 : Real.sqrt ((x - x') ⬝ᵥ (x - x')) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ * Real.sqrt ((b - A *ᵥ x') ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x')) := by
    rw [hdiff]; exact sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul _ _
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hxpos]
  set R := Real.sqrt ((b - A *ᵥ x') ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x'))
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hAi := specNorm_nonneg A⁻¹
  calc Real.sqrt ((x - x') ⬝ᵥ (x - x')) ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ * R := h1
    _ = specNorm A⁻¹ * R / Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) * Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ * R / Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) * (specNorm A * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbx (by positivity)
    _ = specNorm A * specNorm A⁻¹ * (R / Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b)) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_div_le_conditionNumber_mul_of_mulVec_add
statement:
theorem norm_div_le_conditionNumber_mul_of_mulVec_add {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : IsUnit A) {x b Δx Δb : n → ℝ} (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hΔ : A *ᵥ (x + Δx) = b + Δb) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 Δx‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ≤
      (conditionNumber A).toReal * (‖WithLp.toLp 2 Δb‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖)
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sub_div_le_conditionNumber_mul hA hx hb (x + Δx)
  have e1 : x - (x + Δx) = -Δx := by abel
  have e2 : b - A *ᵥ (x + Δx) = -Δb := by rw [hΔ]; abel
  rwa [e1, e2, WithLp.toLp_neg, WithLp.toLp_neg, norm_neg, norm_neg] at h

name: NLAlib.norm_div_le_of_add_mulVec_add
statement:
theorem norm_div_le_of_add_mulVec_add {A ΔA : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    {x b Δx Δb : n → ℝ} (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hΔ : (A + ΔA) *ᵥ (x + Δx) = b + Δb)
    (hsmall : (conditionNumber A).toReal * (specNorm ΔA / specNorm A) < 1) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 Δx‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ≤
      (conditionNumber A).toReal /
          (1 - (conditionNumber A).toReal * (specNorm ΔA / specNorm A)) *
        (specNorm ΔA / specNorm A + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 Δb‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
  have hd : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA
  rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hA] at hsmall ⊢
  have hbx : Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) ≤ specNorm A * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    rw [← hx]; exact sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul A x
  have hdx : Δx = A⁻¹ *ᵥ (Δb - ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx)) := by
    have hAdx : A *ᵥ Δx = Δb - ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx) := by
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_add A, hx] at hΔ
      rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← add_right_inj b, ← hΔ]
      abel
    rw [← hAdx, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have s1 : Real.sqrt (Δx ⬝ᵥ Δx) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ * Real.sqrt ((Δb - ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx)) ⬝ᵥ (Δb - ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx))) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hdx]
    exact sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul _ _
  have s2 := sqrt_dotProduct_sub_le Δb (ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx))
  have s3 := sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul ΔA (x + Δx)
  have s4 := sqrt_dotProduct_add_le x Δx
  set a := specNorm A⁻¹
  set α := specNorm A
  set e := specNorm ΔA
  set Nx := Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)
  set Nb := Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b)
  set Ndx := Real.sqrt (Δx ⬝ᵥ Δx)
  set Ndb := Real.sqrt (Δb ⬝ᵥ Δb)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := specNorm_nonneg _
  have he : 0 ≤ e := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hNdx : 0 ≤ Ndx := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hNdb : 0 ≤ Ndb := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hbpos : 0 < Nb := sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos hb
  have hxpos : 0 < Nx := by
    rcases (show 0 ≤ Nx from Real.sqrt_nonneg _).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← h, mul_zero] at hbx; linarith
  have hαpos : 0 < α := by
    rcases (show 0 ≤ α from specNorm_nonneg _).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← h, zero_mul] at hbx; linarith
  have hae : α * a * (e / α) = a * e := by field_simp
  rw [hae] at hsmall ⊢
  have h1 : Ndx ≤ a * (Ndb + e * Nx + e * Ndx) := by
    calc Ndx ≤ a * Real.sqrt ((Δb - ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx)) ⬝ᵥ (Δb - ΔA *ᵥ (x + Δx))) := s1
      _ ≤ a * (Ndb + e * (Nx + Ndx)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ha
          refine s2.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (s3.trans ?_))
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s4 he
      _ = a * (Ndb + e * Nx + e * Ndx) := by ring
  have hgap : 0 < 1 - a * e := by linarith
  have h2 : Ndx * (1 - a * e) ≤ a * (Ndb + e * Nx) := by nlinarith
  have h3 : Ndb / Nx ≤ α * (Ndb / Nb) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hxpos]
    calc Ndb = Ndb / Nb * Nb := by field_simp
      _ ≤ Ndb / Nb * (α * Nx) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbx (by positivity)
      _ = α * (Ndb / Nb) * Nx := by ring
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hxpos]
  have h4 : Ndx ≤ a * (Ndb + e * Nx) / (1 - a * e) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hgap]; exact h2
  calc Ndx ≤ a * (Ndb + e * Nx) / (1 - a * e) := h4
    _ = a / (1 - a * e) * (Ndb / Nx + e) * Nx := by field_simp
    _ ≤ a / (1 - a * e) * (α * (Ndb / Nb) + e) * Nx := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hxpos.le
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h3 le_rfl) (div_nonneg ha hgap.le)
    _ = α * a / (1 - a * e) * (e / α + Ndb / Nb) * Nx := by field_simp; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_mul_moorePenroseInverse_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem norm_mul_moorePenroseInverse_sub_div_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b Δb : m → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ (b + Δb) -
        (A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b)‖ /
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b)‖ ≤
      1 / leastSquaresCos A b * (‖WithLp.toLp 2 Δb‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
  set P := A * moorePenroseInverse A
  set Ny := Real.sqrt ((P *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ b))
  set Nb := Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b)
  set Ndb := Real.sqrt (Δb ⬝ᵥ Δb)
  have hP : specNorm P ≤ 1 :=
    Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A)
      (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A)
  have hdy : P *ᵥ (b + Δb) - P *ᵥ b = P *ᵥ Δb := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_add]; abel
  rw [hdy]
  have h1 : Real.sqrt ((P *ᵥ Δb) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ Δb)) ≤ Ndb :=
    (sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul P Δb).trans
      (by have := Real.sqrt_nonneg (Δb ⬝ᵥ Δb); nlinarith)
  have hcos : leastSquaresCos A b = Ny / Nb := rfl
  rw [hcos]
  rcases (show 0 ≤ Nb from Real.sqrt_nonneg _).lt_or_eq with hb | hb
  · rcases (show 0 ≤ Ny from Real.sqrt_nonneg _).lt_or_eq with hy | hy
    · have : 1 / (Ny / Nb) * (Ndb / Nb) = Ndb / Ny := by
        field_simp
      rw [this]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hy.le
    · simp only [Ny, ← hy, div_zero]
      positivity
  · simp only [Ny, Nb, ← hb, div_zero, mul_zero]
    have hb0 : b = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp ((Real.sqrt_eq_zero
      (dotProduct_self_nonneg b)).mp hb.symm)
    rw [hb0, Matrix.mulVec_zero, dotProduct_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, div_zero]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_ne_zero {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ}
    (hx : moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b ≠ 0) : A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hx
  have := congrArg (fun v => moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ v) h
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_zero] at this
  rwa [← Matrix.mul_assoc, moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse] at this

name: NLAlib.norm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem norm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_div_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b Δb : m → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ (b + Δb) - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)‖ /
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)‖ ≤
      moorePenroseConditionNumber A / (leastSquaresEta A b * leastSquaresCos A b) *
        (‖WithLp.toLp 2 Δb‖ / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
  set A' := moorePenroseInverse A
  set x := A' *ᵥ b
  set P := A * A'
  set Nx := Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)
  set Ny := Real.sqrt ((P *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ b))
  set Nb := Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b)
  set Ndb := Real.sqrt (Δb ⬝ᵥ Δb)
  have hdx : A' *ᵥ (b + Δb) - A' *ᵥ b = A' *ᵥ Δb := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_add]; abel
  rw [hdx]
  have h1 : Real.sqrt ((A' *ᵥ Δb) ⬝ᵥ (A' *ᵥ Δb)) ≤ specNorm A' * Ndb :=
    sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul A' Δb
  have hRHS : 0 ≤ moorePenroseConditionNumber A / (leastSquaresEta A b * leastSquaresCos A b) *
      (Ndb / Nb) := by
    unfold leastSquaresEta leastSquaresCos
    have := moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A
    have := specNorm_nonneg A
    positivity
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · have : Nx = 0 := by simp [Nx, hx]
    rw [this, div_zero]
    exact hRHS
  have hy : P *ᵥ b ≠ 0 := by
    have := mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_ne_zero hx
    rwa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at this
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hy (Matrix.mulVec_zero _)
  have hA : A ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hy (by simp [P])
  have hNx : 0 < Nx := sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos hx
  have hNy : 0 < Ny := sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos hy
  have hNb : 0 < Nb := sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos hb
  have hα : 0 < specNorm A := by rw [specNorm_eq_norm]; exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hA
  have hconst : moorePenroseConditionNumber A / (leastSquaresEta A b * leastSquaresCos A b) =
      specNorm A' * Nb / Nx := by
    unfold leastSquaresEta leastSquaresCos moorePenroseConditionNumber
    change specNorm A * specNorm A' / (specNorm A * Nx / Ny * (Ny / Nb)) = _
    field_simp
  rw [hconst]
  calc Real.sqrt ((A' *ᵥ Δb) ⬝ᵥ (A' *ᵥ Δb)) / Nx ≤ specNorm A' * Ndb / Nx :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hNx.le
    _ = specNorm A' * Nb / Nx * (Ndb / Nb) := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_of_diagonal
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z - z * d i) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + z • Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose φ g hφ₀ hφa hga hφspec hφeq using
    fun i => exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_diagonal_expansion d hd A i
  let branch : n → ℂ → ℂ := fun i z => z * φ i z⁻¹
  have hi : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z⁻¹) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv₀_cobounded
  have hpair : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), Function.Injective (fun i => φ i t) := by
    have hp : ∀ i j, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ i t = φ j t → i = j := by
      intro i j
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ => hij)
      · have hn : φ i 0 - φ j 0 ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hφ₀, hφ₀]
          exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hd.ne hij)
        filter_upwards [((hφa i).continuousAt.sub (hφa j).continuousAt).tendsto.eventually_ne hn]
          with t ht heq
        exact False.elim (ht (sub_eq_zero.mpr heq))
    have hp' : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ∀ i j, φ i t = φ j t → i = j := by
      simpa only [Filter.eventually_all] using hp
    exact hp'
  have hall : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ),
      ∀ i, AnalyticAt ℂ (φ i) t ∧ φ i t ∈ spectrum ℂ (Matrix.diagonal d + t • A) := by
    simp only [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro i
    exact (hφa i).eventually_analyticAt.and (hφspec i)
  have hnz : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, z ≠ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with z hz
    intro hzero
    norm_num [hzero] at hz
  have hext : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      (∀ i, AnalyticAt ℂ (branch i) z ∧
        branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + z • Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z) := by
    filter_upwards [hi.eventually hall, hi.eventually hpair, hnz] with z hz hp hzne
    refine ⟨fun i => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact analyticAt_id.mul ((hz i).1.comp (analyticAt_inv hzne))
    · have hs := (spectrum.smul_mem_smul_iff (R := ℂ)
        (r := Units.mk0 z hzne) (a := Matrix.diagonal d + z⁻¹ • A) (s := φ i z⁻¹)).mpr
          (hz i).2
      simpa only [Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0, smul_eq_mul, smul_add,
        smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hzne, one_smul, add_comm] using hs
    · intro i j hij
      apply hp
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hzne hij
  obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := Filter.hasBasis_cobounded_norm.eventually_iff.mp hext
  refine ⟨max R 1, lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _), branch, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨fun z hz => ((hR ((le_max_left R 1).trans hz.le)).1 i).1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
      ?_⟩
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => A i i + z⁻¹ * g i z⁻¹)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)) := by
      have hg := (hga i).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hi
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.add (hi.mul hg))
    apply hlim.congr'
    filter_upwards [hi.eventually (hφeq i), hnz] with z hz hzne
    dsimp [branch]
    rw [hz]
    field_simp
    ring
  · intro z hz
    have h := hR ((le_max_left R 1).trans hz.le)
    exact ⟨fun i => (h.1 i).2, h.2⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal
    (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Function.Injective (fun i => -(b i : ℂ)) :=
    neg_injective.comp (Complex.ofReal_injective.comp hb)
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_of_diagonal (fun i => -(b i : ℂ)) hd A
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨(hbranch i).1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_comm] using (hbranch i).2
  · intro z hz
    have hD : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -(b i : ℂ)) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
        -Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) := by
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij]
    simpa only [hD, smul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using hspec z hz

name: NLAlib.eventually_isUnit_shifted_pencil
statement:
theorem eventually_isUnit_shifted_pencil (μ : ℂ) (B F : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∀ᶠ p : ℂ × ℂ in 𝓝 0, IsUnit ((μ + p.2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - p.1 • F)
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using spectrum.notMem_iff.mp hμ
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ =>
      (μ + p.2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - p.1 • F) := by fun_prop
  exact (hcont.continuousAt (x := 0)).preimage_mem_nhds (by simpa using Units.isOpen.mem_nhds hunit)

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block
    {l : Type*} [Unique l] (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt φ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
          t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
            (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ), p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
          p.1 • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
            (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ₀, hψcont, hψderiv, hψnear, hψspec, hψunique⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch μ a B F b c hμ
  let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => μ + ψ t
  have hφderiv : HasDerivAt φ a 0 := hψderiv.const_add μ
  have hK := eventually_isUnit_shifted_pencil μ B F hμ
  refine ⟨φ, by simp [φ, hψ₀], hφderiv.continuousAt, hφderiv,
    hψnear.mono (fun t ht => ht.const_add μ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hgraph : Tendsto (fun t : ℂ => (t, ψ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ)) := by
      change Tendsto (fun t : ℂ => (t, ψ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), 0))
      simpa only [hψ₀, id_eq] using (continuousAt_id.prodMk hψcont).tendsto
    filter_upwards [hψspec, hgraph.eventually hK] with t ht hKt
    exact (mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero μ a t (ψ t) B F b c hKt).mpr ht
  · have hshift : Tendsto (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, p.2 - μ))
        (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ)) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ)) := by
      have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, p.2 - μ)) := by fun_prop
      change Tendsto (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, p.2 - μ))
        (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ)) (𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), 0))
      simpa using (hcont.continuousAt (x := ((0 : ℂ), μ))).tendsto
    filter_upwards [hshift.eventually hK, hshift.eventually hψunique] with p hpK hpψ
    have hs := mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero
      (l := l) μ a p.1 (p.2 - μ) B F b c hpK
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at hs
    exact hs.trans (hpψ.trans (by dsimp [φ]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h))

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (E : Matrix n n ℂ) {x y : n → ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + t • E)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ), p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + p.1 • E) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, i, hS, hcol, hrow, hright, hleft, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_simple_eigenvalue_isolated_similarity hx hy hAx hyA hμ
  let L := {j : n // j = i}
  let R := {j : n // j ≠ i}
  let : Unique L := ⟨⟨⟨i, rfl⟩⟩, fun j => Subtype.ext j.property⟩
  let e : L ⊕ R ≃ n := Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)
  let M := S⁻¹ * A * S
  let G := S⁻¹ * E * S
  let B : Matrix R R ℂ := M.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
  let F : Matrix R R ℂ := G.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
  let b : R → ℂ := fun j => G i j.val
  let c : R → ℂ := fun j => G j.val i
  have hM : M.submatrix e e =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : L => μ)) 0 0 B :=
    submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_of_isolated_coordinate M i μ hright hleft
  have hG : G.submatrix e e =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : L => G i i))
        (Matrix.replicateRow L b) (Matrix.replicateCol L c) F :=
    submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_scalar_row_col G i
  have hspec (t z : ℂ) : z ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : L => μ)) 0 0 B +
        t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : L => G i i))
          (Matrix.replicateRow L b) (Matrix.replicateCol L c) F) ↔
        z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + t • E) := by
    rw [← hM, ← hG]
    change z ∈ spectrum ℂ ((M + t • G).submatrix e e) ↔ _
    have heq : M + t • G = S⁻¹ * (A + t • E) * S := by
      simp only [M, G, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    rw [heq, Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly]
    have hchar := Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm (S⁻¹ * (A + t • E) * S)
    change ((S⁻¹ * (A + t • E) * S).submatrix e e).charpoly = _ at hchar
    rw [hchar, ← Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly]
    exact mem_spectrum_nonsing_inv_mul_mul_iff (A + t • E) S hS z
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hφderiv, hφnear, hφspec, hφunique⟩ :=
    exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block (l := L) μ (G i i) B F b c hsep
  have hentry : G i i = (y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x) :=
    nonsing_inv_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct_mulVec_div S E i x y hcol hrow
  refine ⟨φ, hφ₀, hφcont, hentry ▸ hφderiv, hφnear, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hφspec.mono
    intro t ht
    apply (hspec t (φ t)).mp
    convert! ht using 1
    congr 10 <;> exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · apply hφunique.mono
    intro p hp
    apply (hspec p.1 p.2).symm.trans
    convert! hp using 1
    apply Iff.of_eq
    congr 10 <;> exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: NLAlib.hasStrictFDerivAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ - a • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ) 0
proof:
:= by
  let K₀ : Matrix n n ℂ := μ • 1 - B
  let L : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ).smulRight 1 -
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ).smulRight F
  have hK₀ : IsUnit K₀ := by
    simpa only [K₀, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using spectrum.notMem_iff.mp hμ
  have hKfun : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (μ + p.2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - p.1 • F) =
      (fun p => K₀ + L p) := by
    funext p
    change (μ + p.2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - p.1 • F =
      (μ • 1 - B) + (p.2 • 1 - p.1 • F)
    rw [add_smul]
    abel
  have hK : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => K₀ + L p) L 0 :=
    HasStrictFDerivAt.const_add K₀ L.hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hInv : HasStrictFDerivAt Ring.inverse
      (-ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) ↑hK₀.unit⁻¹ ↑hK₀.unit⁻¹) K₀ := by
    simpa only [hK₀.unit_spec] using hasStrictFDerivAt_ringInverse (𝕜 := ℂ) hK₀.unit
  have hInv' : HasStrictFDerivAt Ring.inverse
      (-ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) ↑hK₀.unit⁻¹ ↑hK₀.unit⁻¹)
        (K₀ + L (0 : ℂ × ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [map_zero, add_zero] using hInv
  have hQ := (schurResolventCoupling b c).hasStrictFDerivAt.comp 0 (hInv'.comp 0 hK)
  have hfst : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ) 0 := hasStrictFDerivAt_fst
  have hsnd : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ) 0 := hasStrictFDerivAt_snd
  have hsq : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 ^ 2)
      (0 : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) 0 := by
    convert! hfst.mul hfst using 1 <;> first
    | rfl
    | (apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext; intro p
       change (0 : ℂ) = (0 : ℂ) * p.1 + (0 : ℂ) * p.1
       simp)
    | (funext p; simp [pow_two])
  have hquad := hsq.mul hQ
  have hbase' : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p.1 * a)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ - a • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ) 0 := by
    exact hsnd.sub (hfst.mul_const a)
  have h := hbase'.sub hquad
  have hKval (p : ℂ × ℂ) := congrFun hKfun p
  convert! h using 1 <;> first
  | rfl
  | (apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext; intro p
     simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_apply, add_apply, sub_apply]
     change p.2 - a * p.1 = (p.2 - a * p.1) -
       ((0 : ℂ) ^ 2 * _ + _ * (0 : ℂ))
     simp)
  | (funext p; simp [simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction, hKval, pow_two])

name: NLAlib.frobSq_pinv_mul_sub_mul_pinv_le_compressed
statement:
theorem frobSq_pinv_mul_sub_mul_pinv_le_compressed (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobSq (moorePenroseInverse B*(B-A)*moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2*
        frobSq ((B*moorePenroseInverse B)*(B-A)*(moorePenroseInverse A*A))
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  let C := (B*b)*(B-A)*(a*A)
  have ha : (a*A)*a=a := moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A
  have hb : b*(B*b)=b := by
    simpa only [b, Matrix.mul_assoc] using moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse B
  have heq : b*(B-A)*a = b*C*a := by
    conv_rhs =>
      dsimp only [C]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc b (B*b*(B-A)) (a*A),
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc b (B*b) (B-A), hb,
        Matrix.mul_assoc (b*(B-A)) (a*A) a, ha]
  change frobSq (b*(B-A)*a) ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq C
  rw [heq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm b^2*frobSq (C*a) := frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm b^2*(frobSq C*specNorm a^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_pinv_mul_complement_columnProjector_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_pinv_mul_complement_columnProjector_le {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    frobSq (moorePenroseInverse B*(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2*
        frobSq ((1-B*moorePenroseInverse B)*(B-A))
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  let PA := A*a
  let PB := B*b
  have hPAs : PA.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A
  have hPAi : IsIdempotentElem PA := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A
  have hPBs : PB.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B
  have hPBi : IsIdempotentElem PB := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B
  have hpr : PA.rank=PB.rank := by
    rw [rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse, rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse]
    exact hr
  have hb : b*PB=b := by
    simpa only [b, PB, Matrix.mul_assoc] using moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse B
  have heq : b*(1-PA)=b*(PB*(1-PA)) := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hb]
  change frobSq (b*(1-PA)) ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq ((1-PB)*(B-A))
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm b^2*frobSq (PB*(1-PA)) := frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq _ _
    _ = specNorm b^2*frobSq ((1-PB)*PA) := by
      rw [frobSq_projector_mul_complement_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq hPAs hPAi hPBs hPBi hpr]
    _ = specNorm b^2*frobSq ((1-PB)*(B-A)*a) := by
      rw [complement_columnProjector_mul_columnProjector_eq A B, frobSq_neg]
    _ ≤ specNorm b^2*(frobSq ((1-PB)*(B-A))*specNorm a^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_complement_rowProjector_mul_pinv_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_complement_rowProjector_mul_pinv_le {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    frobSq ((1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2*
        frobSq ((B-A)*(1-moorePenroseInverse A*A))
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  let QA := a*A
  let QB := b*B
  have hQAs : QA.IsHermitian := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A
  have hQAi : IsIdempotentElem QA := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem A
  have hQBs : QB.IsHermitian := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian B
  have hQBi : IsIdempotentElem QB := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem B
  have hqr : QA.rank=QB.rank := by
    rw [rank_moorePenroseInverse_mul, rank_moorePenroseInverse_mul]
    exact hr
  have ha : QA*a=a := moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A
  have heq : (1-QB)*a=(1-QB)*QA*a := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ha]
  change frobSq ((1-QB)*a) ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq ((B-A)*(1-QA))
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ frobSq ((1-QB)*QA)*specNorm a^2 := frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq _ _
    _ = frobSq (QB*(1-QA))*specNorm a^2 := by
      rw [← frobSq_projector_mul_complement_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq hQAs hQAi hQBs hQBi hqr]
    _ = frobSq (b*((B-A)*(1-QA)))*specNorm a^2 := by
      rw [rowProjector_mul_complement_rowProjector_eq A B, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ (specNorm b^2*frobSq ((B-A)*(1-QA)))*specNorm a^2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_two_mul_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_two_mul_of_rank_eq {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    frobSq (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2*frobSq (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  let PA := A*a
  let PB := B*b
  let QA := a*A
  let QB := b*B
  have hblk := moorePenroseInverse_sub_blocks A B
  change QB*(b-a)*PA= -b*(B-A)*a ∧ QB*(b-a)*(1-PA)=b*(1-PA) ∧
    (1-QB)*(b-a)*PA= -(1-QB)*a ∧ (1-QB)*(b-a)*(1-PA)=0 at hblk
  have hfour := frobSq_eq_four_projector_blocks
    (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian B) (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem B)
    (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A) (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A) (b-a)
  change frobSq (b-a)=frobSq (QB*(b-a)*PA)+frobSq (QB*(b-a)*(1-PA))+
    frobSq ((1-QB)*(b-a)*PA)+frobSq ((1-QB)*(b-a)*(1-PA)) at hfour
  rw [hblk.1, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.neg_mul, frobSq_neg, hblk.2.1,
    hblk.2.2.1, Matrix.neg_mul, frobSq_neg, hblk.2.2.2, frobSq_zero, add_zero] at hfour
  have h11 := frobSq_pinv_mul_sub_mul_pinv_le_compressed A B
  have h12 := frobSq_pinv_mul_complement_columnProjector_le hr
  have h21 := frobSq_complement_rowProjector_mul_pinv_le hr
  have hthree := frobSq_three_compressed_blocks_le_two_mul
    (Q := B * moorePenroseInverse B) (P := moorePenroseInverse A * A)
    (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B) (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B)
    (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A) (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem A) (B-A)
  have hcoeff : 0 ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hthree hcoeff
  change frobSq (b-a) ≤ 2*specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq (B-A)
  change frobSq (b*(B-A)*a) ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq (PB*(B-A)*QA) at h11
  change frobSq (b*(1-PA)) ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq ((1-PB)*(B-A)) at h12
  change frobSq ((1-QB)*a) ≤ specNorm a^2*specNorm b^2*frobSq ((B-A)*(1-QA)) at h21
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_sqrt_two_mul_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem frobNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_sqrt_two_mul_of_rank_eq {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    frobNorm (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      Real.sqrt 2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*frobNorm (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := frobSq_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_two_mul_of_rank_eq hr
  rw [← frobNorm_sq, ← frobNorm_sq] at hh
  have hc : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*frobNorm (B-A) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      (specNorm_nonneg _)) (frobNorm_nonneg _)
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*frobNorm (B-A))^2 =
      2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2*frobNorm (B-A)^2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero hc
  rw [hs]
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_eq_sum_eigenvalues_mul_quadForm
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have ht : (A * B).trace = (Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues * (Uᵀ * B * U)).trace := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA]
    change ((U * Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues * Uᵀ) * B).trace = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using Matrix.trace_mul_comm
      (Uᵀ * B * U) (Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues)
  rw [ht, Matrix.trace]
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.diag]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, U,
    Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply, quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_sq_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_sq_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    frobSq A = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA,
    ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ),
    frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal (V := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ))
      (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA),
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal (Q := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ))
      (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA)]
  simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.diagonal_apply]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_le_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem frobNorm_le_trace_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    frobNorm A ≤ A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hH := hA.isHermitian
  have hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hH.eigenvalues i := hA.eigenvalues_nonneg
  have htr : A.trace = ∑ i, hH.eigenvalues i := by
    simpa using hH.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
  have htr0 : 0 ≤ A.trace := htr ▸ Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hnn i
  rw [← abs_of_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg A), ← abs_of_nonneg htr0, ← sq_le_sq, frobNorm_sq,
    frobSq_eq_sum_sq_eigenvalues hH, htr]
  exact Finset.sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg fun i _ => hnn i

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_le_sum_eigenvalues₀_mul
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let P : Matrix n n ℝ :=
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ * (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
  have hP : Pᵀ * P = 1 := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ),
      eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA, Matrix.one_mul,
      transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB]
  have hPt : P * Pᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hP
  let D : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ :=
    fun i j => P (e i) (e j) ^ 2
  have hD : D ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ (Fin (Fintype.card n)) := by
    rw [mem_doublyStochastic_iff_sum]
    refine ⟨fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have h := congrArg (fun M => M (e i) (e i)) hPt
      change (∑ j, P (e i) (e j) ^ 2) = 1
      exact (e.sum_comp (fun j : n => P (e i) j ^ 2)).trans (by
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
          Matrix.one_apply_eq, ← sq] using h)
    · intro j
      have h := congrArg (fun M => M (e j) (e j)) hP
      change (∑ i, P (e i) (e j) ^ 2) = 1
      exact (e.sum_comp (fun i : n => P i (e j) ^ 2)).trans (by
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
          Matrix.one_apply_eq, ← sq] using h)
  have hexp : (A * B).trace =
      ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i * (D *ᵥ hB.eigenvalues₀) i := by
    rw [trace_mul_eq_sum_eigenvalues_mul_quadForm hA B]
    simp only [quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hB]
    rw [← e.sum_comp]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← e.sum_comp]
    simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
      Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, D, P, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
      rw [show (∑ k, ⇑(hB.eigenvectorBasis (e j)) k * ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis (e i)) k) =
        (∑ k, ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis (e i)) k * ⇑(hB.eigenvectorBasis (e j)) k) by
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_comm _ _]
      ring
  rw [hexp]
  exact sum_mul_mulVec_le_of_doublyStochastic _ _
    hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone hB.eigenvalues₀_antitone hD

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_frobSq_sub
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have hFA : frobSq A = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq_eigenvalues hA, ← e.sum_comp]
    simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hFB : frobSq B = ∑ i, hB.eigenvalues₀ i ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq_eigenvalues hB, ← e.sum_comp]
    simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have ht := trace_mul_le_sum_eigenvalues₀_mul hB hA
  have htrans : Bᵀ = B := by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hB.eq
  have hinner : frobInner B A = (B * A).trace := by rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, htrans]
  rw [← hinner] at ht
  rw [frobSq_sub, hFA, hFB]
  have hexp : (∑ i, (hB.eigenvalues₀ i - hA.eigenvalues₀ i) ^ 2) =
      (∑ i, hB.eigenvalues₀ i ^ 2) - 2 * (∑ i, hB.eigenvalues₀ i * hA.eigenvalues₀ i) +
        ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
  rw [hexp]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eigenvalues₀_add_sub_le_frobSq
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using sum_sq_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_frobSq_sub hA (hA.add hE)

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_norm_mulVec_eq_singularValues_last
statement:
theorem exists_unit_norm_mulVec_eq_singularValues_last [Nonempty n] (C : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ∃ v : n → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ = singularValues C (Fintype.card n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD C
  let j : Fin (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, by have := Fintype.card_pos (α := n); omega⟩
  have hd : (rectDiag (singularValues C) : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) 𝕜) =
      diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (singularValues C i : 𝕜)) := by
    ext i k
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst k; simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
    · have hv : i.val ≠ k.val := fun he => hik (Fin.ext he)
      simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hik, hv]
  have hcol : C *ᵥ V.col j = (singularValues C j : 𝕜) • U.col j := by
    have he := congrArg (fun M => M.col j) h.mul_right
    rw [hd] at he
    change C *ᵥ V.col j = (U * diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (singularValues C i : 𝕜))).col j at he
    rw [he]
    ext i
    simp [Matrix.col, Matrix.mul_diagonal, mul_comm]
  have hV : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (V.col j)‖ = 1 :=
    (HasOrthonormalCols.orthonormal h.conjTranspose_mul_right).norm_eq_one j
  have hU : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U.col j)‖ = 1 :=
    (HasOrthonormalCols.orthonormal h.conjTranspose_mul_left).norm_eq_one j
  refine ⟨V.col j, hV, ?_⟩
  rw [hcol, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, hU, mul_one, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
    abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg C j)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_vecMulVec_star_le_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_vecMulVec_star_le_of_norm_eq_one (u v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    specNorm (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖
proof:
:= by
  have hvsq : ∑ j, ‖v j‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 v), hv, one_pow]
  have husq : ∑ j, ‖u j‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  have hf : frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply, norm_mul,
      norm_star, mul_pow, ← Finset.mul_sum, hvsq, mul_one, husq]
  have hn : frobNorm (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ := by
    have hs := frobNorm_sq (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v))
    rw [hf] at hs
    nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)), norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 u)]
  exact (specNorm_le_frobNorm _).trans_eq hn

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_shift_le_specNorm_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem singularValues_last_shift_le_specNorm_of_mem_spectrum (A E : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E)) :
    singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤ specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := exists_mulVec_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hz
  have hres : (z • 1 - A) *ᵥ x = E *ᵥ x := by
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec] at he
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    linear_combination -he
  have hxnorm : 0 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr fun hzero =>
    hx (congrArg WithLp.ofLp hzero)
  have hlo := singularValues_last_mul_norm_le (z • 1 - A) x
  rw [hres] at hlo
  have hup := E.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hxnorm).mp (hlo.trans hup)

name: NLAlib.exists_rank_one_perturbation_minimum
statement:
theorem exists_rank_one_perturbation_minimum [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    ∃ E : Matrix n n ℂ, E.rank ≤ 1 ∧ z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E) ∧
      specNorm E = singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) ∧
      ∀ F : Matrix n n ℂ, z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + F) → specNorm E ≤ specNorm F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hres⟩ := exists_unit_norm_mulVec_eq_singularValues_last (z • 1 - A)
  let u := (z • 1 - A) *ᵥ v
  let E := Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)
  have hdot : star v ⬝ᵥ v = (1 : ℂ) := by
    have he : inner ℂ (WithLp.toLp 2 v) (WithLp.toLp 2 v) = (1 : ℂ) := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hv]; norm_num
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm] using he
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hv
  have heig : (A + E) *ᵥ v = z • v := by
    simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, E, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, hdot, MulOpposite.op_one, one_smul]
    dsimp [u]
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    abel
  have hspec : z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E) :=
    Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_isRoot_charpoly (isRoot_charpoly_of_mulVec_eq_smul hv0 heig)
  have hup : specNorm E ≤ singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) := by
    exact (specNorm_vecMulVec_star_le_of_norm_eq_one u v hv).trans_eq hres
  have heq := le_antisymm hup (singularValues_last_shift_le_specNorm_of_mem_spectrum A E z hspec)
  refine ⟨E, Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le _ _, hspec, heq, ?_⟩
  intro F hF
  rw [heq]
  exact singularValues_last_shift_le_specNorm_of_mem_spectrum A F z hF

name: NLAlib.exists_perturbation_mem_spectrum_iff_singularValues_last_le
statement:
theorem exists_perturbation_mem_spectrum_iff_singularValues_last_le [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) :
    (∃ E : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm E ≤ ε ∧ z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E)) ↔
      singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, hE, hz⟩
    exact (singularValues_last_shift_le_specNorm_of_mem_spectrum A E z hz).trans hE
  · intro hε
    obtain ⟨E, _, hz, hnorm, _⟩ := exists_rank_one_perturbation_minimum A z
    exact ⟨E, hnorm ▸ hε, hz⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_residual_le_iff_singularValues_last_le
statement:
theorem exists_unit_residual_le_iff_singularValues_last_le [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) :
    (∃ v : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((z • 1 - A) *ᵥ v)‖ ≤ ε) ↔
      singularValues (z • 1 - A) (Fintype.card n - 1) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hbound⟩
    exact (singularValues_last_le_norm_mulVec _ hv).trans hbound
  · intro hε
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := exists_unit_norm_mulVec_eq_singularValues_last (z • 1 - A)
    exact ⟨v, hv, he ▸ hε⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch
statement:
theorem exists_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 0 ∧ ContinuousAt ψ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt ψ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ),
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c p = 0 ↔ ψ p.1 = p.2)
proof:
:= by
  let D : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ - a • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ
  have hf : HasStrictFDerivAt (simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c) D 0 :=
    hasStrictFDerivAt_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c hμ
  have hD₂ : D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change z - a * 0 = z
    ring
  have hif : (D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hD₂]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℂ ℂ, rfl⟩
  let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := hf.implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hif
  have hevent := hf.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hif
  have hψ₀ : ψ 0 = 0 := hevent.self_of_nhds.mp rfl
  have hderiv : -(D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).inverse ∘L
      (D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℂ ℂ ℂ) = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ := by
    rw [hD₂, ContinuousLinearMap.inverse_id]
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change -(0 - a * z) = a * z
    ring
  have hψstrict := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hif
  have hψderiv : HasDerivAt ψ a 0 := by
    have h := hψstrict.hasFDerivAt.hasDerivAt
    rw [hderiv] at h
    simpa using h
