  have hf₀ : simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (0 : ℂ × ℂ) = 0 := by
    simp only [simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero,
      zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)]
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ₀, hψderiv.continuousAt, hψderiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := hf.eventually_apply_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hif
    rw [hf₀] at h
    convert! h using 1
  · simpa only [hf₀] using hevent

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_pos_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_pos_of_isUnit {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    0 < specNorm A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
  intro hZero
  have h := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA)
  rw [hZero, Matrix.zero_mul] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h.symm

name: NLAlib.inv_specNorm_inv_le_specNorm_of_not_isUnit_add
statement:
theorem inv_specNorm_inv_le_specNorm_of_not_isUnit_add
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) (hAE : ¬ IsUnit (A + E)) :
    1 / specNorm A⁻¹ ≤ specNorm E
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hN := specNorm_inv_pos_of_isUnit hA
  have hSmall : specNorm E < 1 / specNorm A⁻¹ := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hProd : specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm E < 1 := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ hN).mp hSmall
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  exact hAE (isUnit_add_of_specNorm_inv_mul_lt_one hA
    ((specNorm_mul_le A⁻¹ E).trans_lt hProd))

name: NLAlib.exists_not_isUnit_add_specNorm_eq_inv_specNorm_inv
statement:
theorem exists_not_isUnit_add_specNorm_eq_inv_specNorm_inv
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    ∃ E : Matrix n n ℝ, ¬ IsUnit (A + E) ∧ specNorm E = 1 / specNorm A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let e : n ≃ Fin (Fintype.card n) := Fintype.equivFin n
  let A' := A.reindex e e
  let T := truncatedSVD A' (Fintype.card n - 1)
  let E := (T - A').reindex e.symm e.symm
  have hRank : A'.rank = Fintype.card n := by
    simpa only [A', Matrix.rank_reindex] using Matrix.rank_of_isUnit A hA
  have hRankPos : 0 < A'.rank := by rw [hRank]; exact Fintype.card_pos
  have hE : A + E = T.reindex e.symm e.symm := by
    ext i j
    simp [E, A', Matrix.reindex_apply]
  refine ⟨E, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hUnit
    have hr := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit (A + E) hUnit
    rw [hE, Matrix.rank_reindex] at hr
    have hBound := (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD A' (Fintype.card n - 1)).1
    have hPos : 0 < Fintype.card n := Fintype.card_pos
    change T.rank ≤ Fintype.card n - 1 at hBound
    omega
  · have hN := specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive A' hRankPos
    rw [hRank] at hN
    have hInv : specNorm A⁻¹ = 1 / singularValues A' (Fintype.card n - 1) := by
      rw [← moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit A hA, ← specNorm_reindex _ e e,
        ← moorePenroseInverse_reindex]
      exact hN
    calc
      specNorm E = specNorm (T - A') := specNorm_reindex _ _ _
      _ = singularValues A' (Fintype.card n - 1) := by
        rw [specNorm_sub_comm]
        exact specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq A' _
      _ = 1 / specNorm A⁻¹ := by rw [hInv, one_div_one_div]

name: NLAlib.isLeast_specNorm_singular_perturbations
statement:
theorem isLeast_specNorm_singular_perturbations (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    IsLeast (specNorm '' {E : Matrix n n ℝ | ¬ IsUnit (A + E)})
      (1 / specNorm A⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hNorm⟩ := exists_not_isUnit_add_specNorm_eq_inv_specNorm_inv A hA
  refine ⟨⟨E, hE, hNorm⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
  exact inv_specNorm_inv_le_specNorm_of_not_isUnit_add hA hF

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pos_of_isUnit
statement: theorem specNorm_pos_of_isUnit {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) : 0 < specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
  intro hZero
  have h := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA)
  rw [hZero, Matrix.zero_mul] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h.symm

name: NLAlib.isLeast_relative_singular_perturbations
statement:
theorem isLeast_relative_singular_perturbations (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    IsLeast ((fun E : Matrix n n ℝ => specNorm E / specNorm A) ''
      {E | ¬ IsUnit (A + E)}) (1 / (conditionNumber A).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hNorm := specNorm_pos_of_isUnit hA
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hNormE⟩ := exists_not_isUnit_add_specNorm_eq_inv_specNorm_inv A hA
  have hRel : (1 / specNorm A⁻¹) / specNorm A = 1 / (conditionNumber A).toReal := by
    rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hA]
    ring
  constructor
  · refine ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [hNormE, hRel]
  · rintro _ ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [← hRel]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (inv_specNorm_inv_le_specNorm_of_not_isUnit_add hA hF)
      hNorm.le

name: NLAlib.conj_mem_spectrum_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem conj_mem_spectrum_conjTranspose {M : Matrix n n ℂ} {w : ℂ}
    (hw : w ∈ spectrum ℂ M) : conj w ∈ spectrum ℂ Mᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff] at hw ⊢
  have heq : algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (conj w) - Mᴴ =
      (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) w - M)ᴴ := by
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul]
  rw [heq, Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose]
  exact hw

name: NLAlib.tendsto_conj_cobounded
statement:
private theorem tendsto_conj_cobounded :
    Tendsto (conj : ℂ → ℂ) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tendsto_norm_atTop_iff_cobounded]
  simpa only [norm_conj] using (tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := ℂ))

name: NLAlib.tendsto_branch_mul_inv
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z⁻¹) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv₀_cobounded
  have ht : Tendsto (fun z => (branch z + b * z) * z⁻¹ - b)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-b)) := by
    simpa using (h.mul hi).sub_const b
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with z hz
  have hzne : z ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; norm_num [hzero] at hz
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.eventually_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) {R : ℝ} {branch : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hspec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)) :
    ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i, branch i (conj z) = conj (branch i z)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm (i : n) : Tendsto (fun z => branch i z * z⁻¹)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-(b i : ℂ))) := tendsto_branch_mul_inv (hlim i)
  have href (i : n) : Tendsto (fun z => conj (branch i (conj z)) * z⁻¹)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-(b i : ℂ))) := by
    have h := Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      ((hnorm i).comp tendsto_conj_cobounded)
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
  have hneq : ∀ i j, ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      i ≠ j → conj (branch i (conj z)) ≠ branch j z := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ h => False.elim (h hij))
    · have hn : -(b i : ℂ) - -(b j : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro heq
        exact hij (hb (Complex.ofReal_injective (neg_injective (sub_eq_zero.mp heq))))
      filter_upwards [((href i).sub (hnorm j)).eventually_ne hn] with z hz _ heq
      exact hz (by rw [heq]; ring)
  have hneq' : ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i j,
      i ≠ j → conj (branch i (conj z)) ≠ branch j z := by
    simpa only [Filter.eventually_all] using hneq
  filter_upwards [hneq', (tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := ℂ)).eventually_gt_atTop R]
    with z hz hR i
  have hs := hspec z hR
  have hcR : R < ‖conj z‖ := by simpa using hR
  have hci := conj_mem_spectrum_conjTranspose ((hspec (conj z) hcR).1 i)
  have hstar : (A - conj z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))ᴴ =
      A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) := by
    have hD : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian :=
      Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext i; simp)
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, hA.eq, hD.eq]
  rw [hstar, spectrum_eq_range_of_injective_mem_spectrum _ _ hs.2 hs.1] at hci
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hci
  have hji : i = j := by
    by_contra hij
    exact hz i j hij hj.symm
  subst j
  simpa using (congrArg conj hj).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal_conj_eq
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal_conj_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      (∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
          Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)) ∧
      ∀ i z, R < ‖z‖ → branch i (conj z) = conj (branch i z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal b hb A
  have href := eventually_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq hA b hb
    (fun i => (hbranch i).2) hspec
  obtain ⟨S, _, hS⟩ := Filter.hasBasis_cobounded_norm.eventually_iff.mp href
  refine ⟨max R S, hR.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), branch, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact ⟨(hbranch i).1.mono (fun z hz => (le_max_left R S).trans_lt hz), (hbranch i).2⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact hspec z ((le_max_left R S).trans_lt hz)
  · intro i z hz
    exact hS ((le_max_right R S).trans hz.le) i

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalues_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_eigenvalues_le_specNorm {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    |hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec A (hA.eigenvectorBasis i)
  have hm : (EuclideanSpace.equiv n ℝ).symm (A *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) =
      hA.eigenvalues i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i := by
    rw [hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis]
    rfl
  simpa only [hm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i,
    mul_one, specNorm] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalues₀_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_eigenvalues₀_le_specNorm {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : |hA.eigenvalues₀ i| ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_eigenvalues_le_specNorm hA
    (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i)
  simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_le_eigenvalues₀_zero_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [show x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = quadForm A x from rfl, quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA,
    ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
  exact hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone (show (⟨0, hcard⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card n)) ≤
    (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm i from Nat.zero_le _)

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_last_mul_le_dotProduct_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  rw [show x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = quadForm A x from rfl, quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA,
    ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
  apply hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone
  exact Nat.le_pred_of_lt ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm i).isLt

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_add_le_add_eigenvalues₀_zero
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_add_le_add_eigenvalues₀_zero {A E : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ i ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i +
      hE.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, by have
proof:
:= i.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Fin.eta] using
    Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_add_le hA hE i ⟨0, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
      (by have := i.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.add_eigenvalues₀_last_le_eigenvalues₀_add
proof:
:= i.isLt; omega⟩ ≤
      (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ i := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hAS⟩ := Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le hA i
  refine Matrix.IsHermitian.le_eigenvalues₀_of_forall_mem (hA.add hE) i S hS fun x hx => ?_
  have h₁ := hAS x hx
  have h₂ := eigenvalues₀_last_mul_le_dotProduct_mulVec hE (by have := i.isLt; omega) x
  simp only [quadForm_def, RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial] at h₁ ⊢
  rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalues₀_add_sub_le_specNorm
proof:
:= by
  have hu := eigenvalues₀_add_le_add_eigenvalues₀_zero hA hE i
  have hl := add_eigenvalues₀_last_le_eigenvalues₀_add hA hE i
  have hmax := abs_eigenvalues₀_le_specNorm hE ⟨0, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
  have hmin := abs_eigenvalues₀_le_specNorm hE ⟨Fintype.card n - 1,
    by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
  rw [abs_le] at hmax hmin ⊢
  constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_self_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_self_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (hA.cfc f *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (hA.cfc f *ᵥ x) =
      ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)^2*(⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x)^2
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : Uᵀ*U=1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  have heq : hA.cfc f = U*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues i))*Uᵀ := by
    exact cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose hA f
  rw [heq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    show ∀ y, (U *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ y) = y ⬝ᵥ y from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols (U := U) hU]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec_apply hA]
  unfold dotProduct
  ring

name: NLAlib.eigenvalueProjector_isSymm
statement:
theorem eigenvalueProjector_isSymm {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    (eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  change (eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)ᵀ=eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ
  rw [eigenvalueProjector, cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose hA]
  simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalueProjector_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem eigenvalueProjector_isIdempotentElem {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ℓ : ℝ) : IsIdempotentElem (eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  change eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ*eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ=eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ
  simp only [eigenvalueProjector, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc]
  rw [← map_mul, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_complement_eigenvalueProjector_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_complement_eigenvalueProjector_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ℓ : ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx) =
      ∑ i, if hA.eigenvalues i=ℓ then 0 else (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x)^2
proof:
:= by
  have heq : 1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ = hA.cfc (fun t => if t=ℓ then 0 else 1) := by
    let φ := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℝ) hA.eigenvectorUnitary
    change 1-φ (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if hA.eigenvalues i=ℓ then 1 else 0)) =
      φ (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if hA.eigenvalues i=ℓ then 0 else 1))
    rw [← map_one φ, ← map_sub]
    apply congrArg φ
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst j
      simp
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · simp [hij]
  rw [heq, dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_self_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.sqrt_complement_eigenvalueProjector_le_residual_div
statement:
theorem sqrt_complement_eigenvalueProjector_le_residual_div {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) {ℓ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ ℓ → δ ≤ |hA.eigenvalues i-quadForm A x|) :
    Real.sqrt (((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx)) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x) ⬝ᵥ (A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x))/δ
proof:
:= by
  have hh : δ^2*(((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx)) ≤
      (A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x) ⬝ᵥ (A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x) := by
    rw [dotProduct_complement_eigenvalueProjector_eq_sum,
      dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : hA.eigenvalues i=ℓ
    · simp only [if_pos hi, mul_zero]
      positivity
    · rw [if_neg hi]
      have hb : δ^2 ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i-quadForm A x)^2 := by
        nlinarith [hsep i hi, sq_abs (hA.eigenvalues i-quadForm A x),
          abs_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i-quadForm A x)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (sq_nonneg _)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2
  have hp := dotProduct_self_nonneg ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx)
  have hr := dotProduct_self_nonneg (A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x)
  have hpn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx))
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hp, Real.sq_sqrt hr, Real.sqrt_nonneg
    ((A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x) ⬝ᵥ (A*ᵥx-quadForm A x•x))]

name: NLAlib.mul_eigenvalueProjector_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mul_eigenvalueProjector_eq_smul {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ℓ : ℝ) : A*eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ = ℓ•eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hid : hA.cfc id=A := by rw [← hA.cfc_eq]; exact cfc_id ℝ A
  calc
    _ = hA.cfc id*eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ := congrArg (fun T => T*eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ) hid.symm
    _ = _ := by
      let φ := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℝ) hA.eigenvectorUnitary
      change φ (Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues)*
        φ (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if hA.eigenvalues i=ℓ then 1 else 0)) =
          ℓ•φ (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if hA.eigenvalues i=ℓ then 1 else 0))
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_smul]
      apply congrArg φ
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
        Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.eigenvalueProjector_mulVec_eq_self
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i-ℓ)^2*(⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x)^2=0 := by
    rw [← dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum hA x ℓ, hx, sub_self, zero_dotProduct]
  have hterm : ∀ i, (hA.eigenvalues i-ℓ)^2*(⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x)^2=0 := by
    exact fun i => (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))).mp hsum i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hc : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ ℓ → (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x)^2=0 := by
    intro i hi
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hterm i)).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero 2 (sub_ne_zero.mpr hi))
  have hz : ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx) ⬝ᵥ ((1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx)=0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_complement_eigenvalueProjector_eq_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    split_ifs with hi
    · rfl
    · exact hc i hi
  have hv : (1-eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ)*ᵥx=0 := by
    apply dotProduct_star_self_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [star_trivial] using hz
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] at hv
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hv).symm

name: NLAlib.range_eigenvalueProjector_eq_eigenspace
statement:
theorem range_eigenvalueProjector_eq_eigenspace {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LinearMap.range (eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ).mulVecLin =
      Module.End.eigenspace A.mulVecLin ℓ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change A*ᵥ(eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ*ᵥy)=ℓ•(eigenvalueProjector hA ℓ*ᵥy)
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, mul_eigenvalueProjector_eq_smul, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, eigenvalueProjector_mulVec_eq_self hA ℓ hx⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_prefix
statement:
theorem sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_prefix {N k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ N) (f : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin N, if i.val < k then f i else 0)=∑ j : Fin k, f (Fin.castLE hk j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => Fin.castLE hk j)
  · intro j _
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact j.isLt
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    exact (Fin.castLEEmb hk).injective hij
  · intro i hi
    have hik : i.val < k := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    refine ⟨⟨i.val, hik⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    exact Fin.ext rfl
  · intro j _
    rfl

name: NLAlib.antitone_sub_prefix_gap
statement:
theorem antitone_sub_prefix_gap {N k : ℕ} (a : Fin N → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a)
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < N) :
    Antitone (fun i => a i-if i.val < k then a ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-a ⟨k, hkN⟩ else 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hi : i.val < k <;> by_cases hj : j.val < k
  · simp only [if_pos hi, if_pos hj]
    exact sub_le_sub_right (ha hij) _
  · simp only [if_pos hi, if_neg hj, sub_zero]
    have hi' : i ≤ (⟨k-1, by omega⟩ : Fin N) := by change i.val ≤ k-1; omega
    have hj' : (⟨k, hkN⟩ : Fin N) ≤ j := by change k ≤ j.val; omega
    have ha1 := ha hi'
    have ha2 := ha hj'
    linarith
  · have hij' : i.val ≤ j.val := hij
    omega
  · simp only [if_neg hi, if_neg hj, sub_zero]
    exact ha hij

name: NLAlib.prefix_gap_mul_deficit_le_trace_deficit
statement:
theorem prefix_gap_mul_deficit_le_trace_deficit {N k : ℕ} (a w : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : Antitone a) (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1)
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < N) (hbudget : ∑ i, w i=(k : ℝ)) :
    (a ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-a ⟨k, hkN⟩)*
      ((k : ℝ)-∑ j : Fin k, w (Fin.castLE hkN.le j)) ≤
        (∑ j : Fin k, a (Fin.castLE hkN.le j)) - ∑ i, a i*w i
proof:
:= by
  let g := a ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-a ⟨k, hkN⟩
  let b : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => a i-if i.val < k then g else 0
  have hb : Antitone b := antitone_sub_prefix_gap a ha hk0 hkN
  have hmax := sum_mul_le_sum_ite_lt_of_antitone_of_sum_eq b w hb hw0 hw1 hkN.le hbudget
  have heq1 : (∑ i, b i*w i) = (∑ i, a i*w i)-g*∑ i : Fin N, if i.val < k then w i else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp only [b]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have heq2 : (∑ i : Fin N, if i.val < k then b i else 0) =
      (∑ i : Fin N, if i.val < k then a i else 0)-g*k := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_filter,
      show (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun i => i.val<k), b i) =
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun i => i.val<k), (a i-g) by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi; simp only [b, if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2],
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, card_filter_fin_lt hkN.le, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [heq1, heq2, sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_prefix hkN.le,
    sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_prefix hkN.le] at hmax
  change g*((k : ℝ)-∑ j : Fin k, w (Fin.castLE hkN.le j)) ≤ _
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_inversePencilUpperRootSum_extension
statement:
theorem exists_inversePencilUpperRootSum_extension
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) {R : ℝ} (branch : n → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {u | R < ‖u‖})
    (hspec : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → ∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))))
    (hroot : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im →
      inversePencilUpperRootSum A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))) u =
        ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0)
    (href : ∀ i u, R < ‖u‖ → branch i (conj u) = conj (branch i u)) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ h ({u | u.im ≠ 0} ∪ {u | R < ‖u‖}) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → h u = ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u.im → h u =
        inversePencilUpperRootSum A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))) u) ∧
      (∀ u, h (conj u) = conj (h u)) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u.im → 0 ≤ (h u).im) ∧
      ∀ u, ‖h u‖ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
        specNorm (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ)))⁻¹ *
          (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let f := inversePencilUpperRootSum A D
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0
  let axis : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => if R < ‖u‖ then g u else 0
  let h := schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f axis
  have hDu : IsUnit D := isUnit_diagonal_sub_of_ne b s hs
  have hD : D.IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext i; simp)
  have hf : ∀ u : ℂ, 0 < u.im → DifferentiableAt ℂ f u := by
    intro u hu
    exact (analyticAt_inversePencilUpperRootSum hA hD hDu (ne_of_gt hu)).differentiableAt
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {u | R < ‖u‖} := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : b i < s
    · simpa only [if_pos hi] using hdiff i
    · simpa only [if_neg hi] using (differentiableOn_const (𝕜 := ℂ) (0 : ℂ) :
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) {u | R < ‖u‖})
  have haxis : DifferentiableOn ℂ axis {u | R < ‖u‖} := by
    apply hg.congr
    intro u hu
    change R < ‖u‖ at hu
    simp only [axis, if_pos hu]
  have hupp : ∀ u : ℂ, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → f u = axis u := by
    intro u hu him
    simpa only [axis, if_pos hu] using hroot u hu him
  have hrefg : ∀ u : ℂ, R < ‖u‖ → g (conj u) = conj (g u) := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [g, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> simp [href i u hu]
  have hrefaxis : ∀ u : ℂ, R < ‖u‖ → axis (conj u) = conj (axis u) := by
    intro u hu
    simpa only [axis, norm_conj, if_pos hu] using hrefg u hu
  have hrefaxisall (u : ℂ) : axis (conj u) = conj (axis u) := by
    by_cases hu : R < ‖u‖
    · exact hrefaxis u hu
    · simp only [axis, norm_conj, if_neg hu, map_zero]
  have hgnorm (u : ℂ) (hu : R < ‖u‖) : ‖g u‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖) := by
    apply norm_sum_ite_le_card_mul_specNorm_inv_of_det_pencil_eq_zero A D hDu u
      (fun i => branch i u)
    intro i
    apply (det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul A D hDu u _).mpr
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [inv_mul_sub_smul_one_diagonal_eq A b s hs u]
    exact (mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff A b s hs u _).mpr (hspec u hu i)
  refine ⟨h, differentiableOn_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_union_exterior f axis hf haxis hupp
    hrefaxis, ?_, ?_, schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_conj_of_conj_eq_axis f axis hrefaxisall, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    simpa only [axis, if_pos hu] using
      schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_eq_of_conj_eq f axis hupp hrefaxis hu
  · intro u hu
    simp only [h, schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, if_pos hu]
    rfl
  · intro u hu
    simpa only [h, schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, if_pos hu] using
      inversePencilUpperRootSum_im_nonneg A D u
  · intro u
    have hC : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
        (add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
    dsimp only [h, schwarzHalfPlaneExtension]
    split_ifs with hpos hneg
    · exact norm_inversePencilUpperRootSum_le A D hDu u
    · simpa only [norm_conj] using norm_inversePencilUpperRootSum_le A D hDu (conj u)
    · dsimp only [axis]
      split_ifs with hu
      · exact hgnorm u hu
      · simpa only [norm_zero] using hC

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_one_sub_le_singularValues_last_of_gram_error
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_one_sub_le_singularValues_last_of_gram_error [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {N α : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (h : specNorm (Aᵀ * A - N • 1) ≤ N * max α (α ^ 2)) :
    Real.sqrt N * (1 - α) ≤ singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt α 1 with hα1 | hα1
  · apply le_singularValues_last A
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hx, one_pow]
    have hh := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (Aᵀ * A - N • 1) x
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hx', mul_one, mul_one,
      ← show (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ x) from
        star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self A x] at hh
    have hh' := (abs_le.mp (hh.trans h)).1
    have hmax : max α (α ^ 2) = α := max_eq_left (by nlinarith)
    rw [hmax] at hh'
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hN
    have hss := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self (A *ᵥ x)
    have hnon : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt N * (1 - α) := by positivity
    have hlow : (Real.sqrt N * (1 - α)) ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hs, hss]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hN (mul_nonneg hα (sub_nonneg.mpr hα1))]
    exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (norm_nonneg _) hlow
  · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.sqrt_nonneg N)
      (by linarith)).trans (singularValues_nonneg A _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_sqrt_mul_one_add_of_gram_error
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_sqrt_mul_one_add_of_gram_error (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {N α : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (h : specNorm (Aᵀ * A - N • 1) ≤ N * max α (α ^ 2)) :
    specNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt N * (1 + α)
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : 1 + max α (α ^ 2) ≤ (1 + α) ^ 2 := by
    have hm : max α (α ^ 2) ≤ (1 + α) ^ 2 - 1 :=
      max_le (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
    linarith
  have hh : specNorm A ^ 2 ≤ N * max α (α ^ 2) + N := by
    have hsq : specNorm A ^ 2 = specNorm (Aᵀ * A) := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self A
    rw [hsq]
    have hdecomp : Aᵀ * A = (Aᵀ * A - N • 1) + N • 1 := (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm
    calc _ = specNorm ((Aᵀ * A - N • 1) + N • 1) := congrArg specNorm hdecomp
      _ ≤ specNorm (Aᵀ * A - N • 1) + specNorm (N • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) :=
        specNorm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ N * max α (α ^ 2) + N := by
        gcongr
        rw [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hN, ← specNorm_eq_norm]
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_one_le (n := n)) hN).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hN
  have hnon : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt N * (1 + α) := by positivity
  have hhigh : specNorm A ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt N * (1 + α)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hs]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hupper hN]
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero hnon hhigh

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_top_gap
statement:
theorem sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_top_gap
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n)
    (hgap : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩) :
    let Q
proof:
:= topEigenframe hA hkN.le
    let Qhat := topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
    let R := complementaryEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
    let δ := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ ∧
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ := by
  dsimp only
  let Q := topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  let Qhat := topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
  let R := complementaryEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
  let a := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩
  let b := (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩
  let d : Fin k → ℝ := fun i => hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE hkN.le i)
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n-k) → ℝ := fun i => (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val+k, by omega⟩
  have hQ := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  have hQhat := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
  have hR := hasOrthonormalCols_complementaryEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
  have hcomp := topEigenframe_projector_add_complementary_eq_one (hA.add hE) hkN.le
  have hmin : ∀ j, a ≤ (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal d).eigenvalues j := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eq_eigenvalues_diagonal d j
    rw [← hi]
    apply hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone
    change i.val ≤ k-1
    omega
  have hmax : ∀ i, (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal e).eigenvalues i ≤ b := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_eq_eigenvalues_diagonal e i
    rw [← hj]
    apply (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀_antitone
    change k ≤ j.val+k
    omega
  have heq := sylvester_complement_overlap_eq hA hE
    (mul_topEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal hA hkN.le)
    (mul_complementaryEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal (hA.add hE) hkN.le)
    (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal e)
  have hS := mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_one_sided
    (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal e) (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal d) hgap
    (by intro i; change _ ≤ a-(a-b); have hh := hmax i; linarith) hmin (Rᵀ*Q)
  have hF := mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester
    (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal e) (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal d) hgap
    (by intro i j; have hi := hmax i; have hj := hmin j; rw [le_abs]; right; linarith) (Rᵀ*Q)
  rw [heq] at hS hF
  have hswap : sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat=sinePrincipalAngles Qhat Q := by
    unfold sinePrincipalAngles
    rw [principalAngles_comm]
  rw [← specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp, ← hswap] at hS
  rw [← frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp, ← hswap] at hF
  exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hgap).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hS),
    (le_div_iff₀ hgap).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hF)⟩

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_le_perturbation_div_top_gap
statement:
theorem sinePrincipalAngles_le_perturbation_div_top_gap
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n)
    (hgap : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩) :
    let S
proof:
:= sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) (topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le)
    let δ := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩
    specNorm S ≤ specNorm E/δ ∧
      frobNorm S ≤ min (Real.sqrt k*specNorm E) (frobNorm E)/δ := by
  dsimp only
  have hh := sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_top_gap hA hE hk0 hkN hgap
  have hQ := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hkN.le
  have hR := hasOrthonormalCols_complementaryEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le
  have hSc := specNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hR (E*topEigenframe hA hkN.le)
  have hFc := frobNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hR (E*topEigenframe hA hkN.le)
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hSc hFc
  refine ⟨hh.1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hgap.le),
    hh.2.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hgap.le)⟩
  · exact hSc.trans (specNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E)
  · apply le_min
    · exact hFc.trans
        (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using frobNorm_mul_frame_le_sqrt_card_mul_specNorm hQ E)
    · exact hFc.trans (frobNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_specNorm_div_population_gap
statement:
theorem specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_specNorm_div_population_gap
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < Fintype.card n)
    (hg : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩) :
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) (topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le)) ≤
      2*specNorm E/(hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let S := specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hkN.le) (topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le))
  let g := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩
  let δ := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨k-1, by omega⟩-(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨k, hkN⟩
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := specNorm_nonneg _
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hg).2
  change S*g ≤ 2*specNorm E
  by_cases hsmall : specNorm E < g/2
  · have hweyl := abs_eigenvalues₀_add_sub_le_specNorm hA hE ⟨k, hkN⟩
    rw [abs_le] at hweyl
    have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp only [δ]; change _ < g/2 at hsmall; dsimp only [g] at hsmall; linarith [hweyl.2]
    have hδg : g/2 ≤ δ := by dsimp only [δ, g] at *; linarith [hweyl.2]
    have hh := (sinePrincipalAngles_le_perturbation_div_top_gap hA hE hk0 hkN hδ).1
    have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mp hh
    change S*δ ≤ specNorm E at hmul
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδg hS0]
  · have hS : S ≤ 1 := specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_one
      (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hkN.le)
      (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe (hA.add hE) hkN.le)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS hg.le]

name: NLAlib.continuous_frobNorm_array
statement:
theorem continuous_frobNorm_array {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :
    Continuous (fun G : ι → κ → ℝ => frobNorm (Matrix.of G))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobNorm, frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.continuous_singularValues_array
statement:
theorem continuous_singularValues_array {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (k : ℕ) : Continuous (fun G : ι → κ → ℝ => singularValues (Matrix.of G) k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro G
  have hdiff : Continuous (fun H : ι → κ → ℝ =>
      frobNorm (Matrix.of H - Matrix.of G)) :=
    continuous_frobNorm_array.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun H : ι → κ → ℝ => frobNorm (Matrix.of H - Matrix.of G))
      (𝓝 G) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hh : ContinuousAt (fun H : ι → κ → ℝ =>
        frobNorm (Matrix.of H - Matrix.of G)) G := hdiff.continuousAt
    simpa only [sub_self, frobNorm_zero] using hh.tendsto
  apply Metric.continuousAt_iff'.mpr
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp hzero).2 ε hε] with H hH
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact (abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm (Matrix.of H) (Matrix.of G) k).trans_lt hH

name: NLAlib.continuous_sq_singularValues_transpose_last_array
statement:
theorem continuous_sq_singularValues_transpose_last_array {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] :
    Continuous (fun G : ι → κ → ℝ => singularValues (Matrix.of G)ᵀ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Continuous (fun G : ι → κ → ℝ => fun j i => G i j) :=
    continuous_pi fun _ => continuous_pi fun _ => (continuous_apply _).comp (continuous_apply _)
  exact ((continuous_singularValues_array (Fintype.card ι - 1)).comp ht).pow 2

name: NLAlib.exists_subseq_eigenvectorUnitary_pencil_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_subseq_eigenvectorUnitary_pencil_tendsto {C B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (h : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ U : Matrix n n ℝ, Uᵀ * U = 1 ∧ ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      Tendsto (fun ν => ((isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvectorUnitary :
        Matrix n n ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 U)
proof:
:= by
  let V : ℕ → Matrix n n ℝ := fun ν => (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h ν)).eigenvectorUnitary
  have hc := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) 1).isSeqCompact
  have hm (ν : ℕ) : V ν ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 1 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact entrywise_sup_norm_bound_of_unitary
      (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h ν)).eigenvectorUnitary.property
  obtain ⟨U, _, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := hc hm
  have hmul := (continuous_id.matrix_transpose.matrix_mul continuous_id).tendsto U |>.comp hlim
  have hmulone : Tendsto (fun ν => (V (φ ν))ᵀ * V (φ ν)) atTop (𝓝 (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) := by
    have heq : (fun ν => (V (φ ν))ᵀ * V (φ ν)) = fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
      funext ν
      exact transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν)))
    rw [heq]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  refine ⟨U, tendsto_nhds_unique hmul hmulone, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  exact hlim

name: NLAlib.col_dotProduct_self_eq_one

private theorem col_dotProduct_self_eq_one {U : Matrix n n ℝ} (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (j : n) :

proof:
:= by
