name: NLAlib.exists_subseq_eigenvalues₀_sum_difference_quotient_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_subseq_eigenvalues₀_sum_difference_quotient_tendsto
    {C B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (J : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (hhpos : ∀ ν, 0 < h ν)
    (hh : Tendsto h atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, c ≤ eigenvaluePrefix hB J.card ∧
      ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto
        (fun ν => ((∑ j ∈ J, (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvalues₀ j) -
          ∑ j ∈ J, hC.eigenvalues₀ j) / h (φ ν)) atTop (𝓝 c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  obtain ⟨U, hU, φ, hφ, hframe⟩ := exists_subseq_eigenvectorUnitary_pencil_tendsto hC hB h
  have hhφ : Tendsto (fun ν => h (φ ν)) atTop (𝓝 0) := hh.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  let u (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : n → ℝ := fun i => U i (e j)
  let v (ν : ℕ) (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : n → ℝ :=
    fun i => (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvectorUnitary i (e j)
  have hv (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : Tendsto (fun ν => v ν j) atTop (𝓝 (u j)) :=
    (continuous_col (e j)).tendsto U |>.comp hframe
  have hLambda (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : Tendsto
      (fun ν => (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvalues₀ j)
      atTop (𝓝 (hC.eigenvalues₀ j)) := by
    have hl := (continuous_eigenvalues₀_pencil hC hB j).tendsto 0 |>.comp hhφ
    change Tendsto (fun ν => (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvalues₀ j)
      atTop (𝓝 ((isHermitian_add_smul hC hB 0).eigenvalues₀ j)) at hl
    rw [eigenvalues₀_pencil_zero hC hB j] at hl
    exact hl
  have hvEig (ν : ℕ) (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
      (C + h (φ ν) • B) *ᵥ v ν j =
        (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvalues₀ j • v ν j := by
    simpa only [v, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply,
      Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
      (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).mulVec_eigenvectorBasis (e j)
  have huEig (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : C *ᵥ u j = hC.eigenvalues₀ j • u j := by
    have hlhs : Tendsto (fun ν => (C + h (φ ν) • B) *ᵥ v ν j) atTop (𝓝 (C *ᵥ u j)) :=
      by
        apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
        intro i
        change Tendsto (fun ν => ∑ k, (C i k + h (φ ν) * B i k) * v ν j k)
          atTop (𝓝 (∑ k, C i k * u j k))
        apply tendsto_finsetSum
        intro k _
        have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => C i k) atTop (𝓝 (C i k)) := tendsto_const_nhds
        have hentry : Tendsto (fun ν => C i k + h (φ ν) * B i k) atTop (𝓝 (C i k)) := by
          simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero] using hconst.add (hhφ.mul_const (B i k))
        exact hentry.mul (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp (hv j) k)
    have hrhs := (hLambda j).smul (hv j)
    have heq : (fun ν => (C + h (φ ν) • B) *ᵥ v ν j) =
        fun ν => (isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvalues₀ j • v ν j :=
      funext fun ν => hvEig ν j
    rw [heq] at hlhs
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlhs hrhs
  have hover (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : Tendsto (fun ν => u j ⬝ᵥ v ν j) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun x : n → ℝ => u j ⬝ᵥ x) := continuous_const.dotProduct continuous_id
    have hd := hc.tendsto (u j) |>.comp (hv j)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, u, col_dotProduct_self_eq_one hU] using hd
  have hquot (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : Tendsto
      (fun ν => ((isHermitian_add_smul hC hB (h (φ ν))).eigenvalues₀ j - hC.eigenvalues₀ j) /
        h (φ ν)) atTop (𝓝 (quadForm B (u j))) := by
    have hnumerator : Tendsto (fun ν => u j ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ v ν j)) atTop
        (𝓝 (u j ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ u j))) := by
      have hc : Continuous (fun x : n → ℝ => u j ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) :=
        continuous_const.dotProduct (continuous_const.matrix_mulVec continuous_id)
      exact hc.tendsto (u j) |>.comp (hv j)
    have hdivision := hnumerator.div (hover j) one_ne_zero
    simp only [div_one] at hdivision
    apply hdivision.congr'
    filter_upwards [(hover j).eventually_ne one_ne_zero] with ν hne
    have hCtrans : Cᵀ = C := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hC.eq
    have hCsym : u j ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ v ν j) = hC.eigenvalues₀ j * (u j ⬝ᵥ v ν j) := by
      rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hCtrans,
        huEig j, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
    have hEq := congrArg (fun x => u j ⬝ᵥ x) (hvEig ν j)
    simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_add,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hCsym] at hEq
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hne (ne_of_gt (hhpos (φ ν)))).mpr
    nlinarith
  let Q : Matrix n J ℝ := U.submatrix id (fun j : J => e j)
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q :=
    HasOrthonormalCols.submatrix_cols hU
      ⟨fun j : J => e j, fun i j hij => Subtype.ext (e.injective hij)⟩
  let c : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ J, quadForm B (u j)
  have hc : c ≤ eigenvaluePrefix hB J.card := by
    have htrace : (Qᵀ * B * Q).trace = c := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ j : J, quadForm B (u j) := by
          simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
            Q, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, quadForm_def, star_trivial, u, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
            Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
        _ = c := Finset.sum_coe_sort J (fun j => quadForm B (u j))
    have hbound := trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix hB hQ
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hbound
    rw [htrace] at hbound
    have hcard : Fintype.card J = J.card := Fintype.card_coe J
    simpa only [hcard] using hbound
  refine ⟨c, hc, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  have hsum := tendsto_finsetSum J (fun j _ => hquot j)
  simpa only [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, c] using hsum

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_of_isUnit {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    conditionNumber A = ENNReal.ofReal (specNorm A * specNorm A⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber, if_pos hA]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : ¬ IsUnit A) :
    conditionNumber A = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber, if_neg hA]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem conditionNumber_eq_top_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : conditionNumber A = ⊤ ↔ ¬ IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : IsUnit A
  · simp [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, hA]
  · simp [conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit hA, hA]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_ne_top_iff
statement: theorem conditionNumber_ne_top_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : conditionNumber A ≠ ⊤ ↔ IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, conditionNumber_eq_top_iff, not_not]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    (conditionNumber A).toReal = specNorm A * specNorm A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))]

name: NLAlib.one_le_specNorm_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem one_le_specNorm_of_isIdempotentElem {P : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P)
    (h0 : P ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ specNorm P
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < specNorm P := by rw [specNorm_eq_norm]; exact norm_pos_iff.mpr h0
  have h := specNorm_mul_le P P
  rw [show P * P = P from hP] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one
statement: theorem specNorm_one [Nonempty n] : specNorm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) = 1
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm specNorm_one_le (one_le_specNorm_of_isIdempotentElem (IsIdempotentElem.one)
    one_ne_zero)

name: NLAlib.one_le_conditionNumber
statement: theorem one_le_conditionNumber [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : 1 ≤ conditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : IsUnit A
  · rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, ENNReal.one_le_ofReal]
    calc (1 : ℝ) = specNorm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) := specNorm_one.symm
      _ = specNorm (A * A⁻¹) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA)]
      _ ≤ specNorm A * specNorm A⁻¹ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
  · rw [conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit hA]; exact le_top

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_eq_singularValues_ratio
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_eq_singularValues_ratio {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    conditionNumber A =
      ENNReal.ofReal (singularValues A 0 / singularValues A (Fintype.card n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hrank := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit A hA
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have h0 : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst h0
    rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le (0 : Matrix n n 𝕜)
      (by simp), zero_div, specNorm_zero, zero_mul]
  · have hpos : 0 < A.rank := by rw [hrank]; exact Fintype.card_pos
    rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, ← moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit A hA,
      specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive A hpos, hrank,
      ← singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm, mul_one_div]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_eq_eigenvalues₀_ratio
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_eq_eigenvalues₀_ratio [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    conditionNumber A = ENNReal.ofReal (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩ /
      hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
        ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt Fintype.card_pos (by decide : 0 < 1)⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber_eq_singularValues_ratio hA.isUnit,
    singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA.posSemidef ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩,
    singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA.posSemidef
      ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt Fintype.card_pos (by decide : 0 < 1)⟩]

name: Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose_iff
statement: theorem _root_.Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : IsUnit Aᴴ ↔ IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.det_conjTranspose, isUnit_star,
    ← Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    conditionNumber Aᴴ = conditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : IsUnit A
  · rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, conditionNumber_of_isUnit
      ((Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose_iff A).2 hA), ← Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,
      specNorm_conjTranspose, specNorm_conjTranspose]
  · rw [conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit hA,
      conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit ((Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose_iff A).not.2 hA)]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_inv
statement: theorem conditionNumber_inv (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : conditionNumber A⁻¹ = conditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : IsUnit A
  · rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, conditionNumber_of_isUnit (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.2 hA),
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), mul_comm]
  · rw [conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit hA,
      conditionNumber_of_not_isUnit (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.not.2 hA)]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_eq_ofReal_moorePenroseConditionNumber
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hA, moorePenroseConditionNumber,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit A hA]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_toReal_eq_moorePenroseConditionNumber
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_toReal_eq_moorePenroseConditionNumber {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : IsUnit A) : (conditionNumber A).toReal = moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hA, moorePenroseConditionNumber,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit A hA]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_zero :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [moorePenroseConditionNumber, specNorm_zero]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    0 ≤ moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.one_le_moorePenroseConditionNumber
statement:
theorem one_le_moorePenroseConditionNumber {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  have hPos : 0 < specNorm A := by rw [specNorm_eq_norm]; exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hA
  have hBound : specNorm A ≤ moorePenroseConditionNumber A * specNorm A := by
    calc
      specNorm A = specNorm (A * moorePenroseInverse A * A) :=
        congrArg specNorm (mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul A).symm
      _ ≤ specNorm (A * moorePenroseInverse A) * specNorm A := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm A * specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) * specNorm A :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = moorePenroseConditionNumber A * specNorm A := rfl
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber Aᴴ = moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose, specNorm_conjTranspose,
    specNorm_conjTranspose, moorePenroseConditionNumber]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_transpose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_transpose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber Aᵀ = moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_transpose, specNorm_transpose,
    specNorm_transpose, moorePenroseConditionNumber]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_smul
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_smul {c : 𝕜} (hc : c ≠ 0) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber (c • A) = moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [moorePenroseConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_smul, specNorm, norm_smul, norm_inv]
  have hAbs : ‖c‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hc
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_conjTranspose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber (Aᴴ * A) = moorePenroseConditionNumber A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    ← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self,
    moorePenroseConditionNumber]
  ring

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (Q : Matrix p m 𝕜)
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber (Q * A) = moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols Q A hQ,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    moorePenroseConditionNumber]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_singularValues_ratio
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_singularValues_ratio (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hr : 0 < A.rank) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber A = singularValues A 0 / singularValues A (A.rank - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber, specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive
    A hr, ← singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm, mul_one_div]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_mul_specNorm_inv
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_mul_specNorm_inv {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : IsUnit A) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber A = specNorm A * specNorm A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit A hA]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_eigenvalues₀_ratio
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_eigenvalues₀_ratio [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber A = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩ /
      hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
        ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt Fintype.card_pos (by decide : 0 < 1)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hRank := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit A hA.isUnit
  have hPos : 0 < A.rank := by rw [hRank]; exact Fintype.card_pos
  rw [moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_singularValues_ratio A hPos, hRank]
  exact congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℝ => a / b)
    (singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA.posSemidef
      ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩)
    (singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA.posSemidef
      ⟨Fintype.card n - 1, Nat.sub_lt Fintype.card_pos (by decide : 0 < 1)⟩)

name: NLAlib.pseudoinverse_perturbation_bounds
statement:
theorem pseudoinverse_perturbation_bounds (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A =
      -moorePenroseInverse B*(B-A)*moorePenroseInverse A +
      moorePenroseInverse B*(moorePenroseInverse B)ᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ*(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A) +
      (1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*(B-A)ᵀ*(moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ*moorePenroseInverse A) ∧
    (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
      Real.goldenRatio*max (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)^2)
        (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)^2)*specNorm (B-A)) ∧
    (A.rank=B.rank →
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
        Real.goldenRatio*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*specNorm (B-A)) ∧
      (frobNorm (moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A) ≤
        Real.sqrt 2*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*frobNorm (B-A)) ∧
      (specNorm (A*moorePenroseInverse A-B*moorePenroseInverse B) ≤
        min (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)) (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B))*specNorm (B-A)) ∧
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A*A-moorePenroseInverse B*B) ≤
        min (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)) (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B))*specNorm (B-A)) ∧
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A) < 1 →
        specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B) ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)/
          (1-specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A))))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨moorePenroseInverse_sub_eq A B,
    specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_goldenRatio_max_sq A B, ?_⟩
  intro hr
  exact ⟨specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_goldenRatio_mul_of_rank_eq hr,
    frobNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sub_le_sqrt_two_mul_of_rank_eq hr,
    specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm hr,
    specNorm_sub_rowProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm hr,
    fun hsmall => specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_le_div_of_rank_eq hr hsmall⟩

name: NLAlib.norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖A.toEuclideanLin x‖ ≤ specNorm A * ‖x‖
proof:
:=
  A.l2_opNorm_mulVec x

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanLin_mul_apply
statement:
theorem toEuclideanLin_mul_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n p ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ p) :
    (A*B).toEuclideanLin x = A.toEuclideanLin (B.toEuclideanLin x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 (m → ℝ)).injective
  change (A*B)*ᵥx.ofLp = A*ᵥ(B*ᵥx.ofLp)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanLin_one_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toEuclideanLin_one_apply (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).toEuclideanLin x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 (n → ℝ)).injective
  simp

name: NLAlib.mulVec_injective_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem mulVec_injective_of_rank_eq_card {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : Function.Injective A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (rank_eq_card_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero A).mp hA
  change A*ᵥ(x-y)=0
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hxy

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : moorePenroseInverse A * A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hG := isUnit_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq hA
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL A hG]
  exact pinvL_mul hG

name: NLAlib.rank_eq_card_of_left_inverse
statement:
theorem rank_eq_card_of_left_inverse {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {L : Matrix n m ℝ}
    (hL : L*A=1) : A.rank = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (Matrix.rank_le_card_width A)
  have h := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right L A
  simpa only [hL, Matrix.rank_one] using h

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_left_inverse_mul_projector
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_left_inverse_mul_projector
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {L : Matrix n m ℝ} (hL : L*A=1) :
    moorePenroseInverse A = L*(A*moorePenroseInverse A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hL, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.rank_add_eq_card_of_pinv_mul_specNorm_lt_one
statement:
theorem rank_add_eq_card_of_pinv_mul_specNorm_lt_one {A E : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hE : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E < 1) :
    (A+E).rank=Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  have hF : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A*E) < 1 :=
    (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans_lt hE
  have hU : IsUnit (1+moorePenroseInverse A*E) := by
    simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one
      (F := -(moorePenroseInverse A*E)) (by simpa only [specNorm_neg] using hF)
  apply rank_eq_card_of_left_inverse (L := (1+moorePenroseInverse A*E)⁻¹*moorePenroseInverse A)
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_add,
    moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card hA,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hU)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_rank_eq_card {A E : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hE : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E < 1) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A+E)) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)/(1-specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A*E) < 1 :=
    (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans_lt hE
  have hU : IsUnit (1+moorePenroseInverse A*E) := by
    simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using isUnit_one_sub_of_specNorm_lt_one
      (F := -(moorePenroseInverse A*E)) (by simpa only [specNorm_neg] using hF)
  have hL : ((1+moorePenroseInverse A*E)⁻¹*moorePenroseInverse A)*(A+E)=1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_add, moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card hA,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hU)]
  have hP : specNorm ((A+E)*moorePenroseInverse (A+E)) ≤ 1 :=
    Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem
      (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian _) (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem _)
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_left_inverse_mul_projector hL]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm ((1+moorePenroseInverse A*E)⁻¹*moorePenroseInverse A)*
        specNorm ((A+E)*moorePenroseInverse (A+E)) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm ((1+moorePenroseInverse A*E)⁻¹*moorePenroseInverse A)*1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (1-specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A*E))⁻¹*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) := by
      rw [mul_one]
      exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_inv_one_add_le hF) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)/(1-specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm E) := by
      rw [mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hF) (sub_pos.mpr hE)).mpr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left (specNorm_mul_le _ _) 1)
        (specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_inner_transpose
statement:
theorem inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_inner_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    inner ℝ (A.toEuclideanLin x) y =
      inner ℝ x (Aᵀ.toEuclideanLin y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Aᵀ.toEuclideanLin = A.toEuclideanLin.adjoint := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint A
  rw [h, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

name: NLAlib.transpose_apply_pinv_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_apply_pinv_residual_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    Aᵀ.toEuclideanLin (b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b))=0
proof:
:= by
  have h : Aᵀ*(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)=0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, transpose_mul_mul_moorePenroseInverse, sub_self]
  have hv := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n m ℝ => M.toEuclideanLin b) h
  simpa only [toEuclideanLin_mul_apply, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    toEuclideanLin_one_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] using hv

name: NLAlib.norm_pinv_residual_sq_add_eq
statement:
theorem norm_pinv_residual_sq_add_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin z‖^2 =
      ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖^2 +
      ‖A.toEuclideanLin (z-(moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖^2
proof:
:= by
  let x := (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
  let r := b-A.toEuclideanLin x
  have hi : inner ℝ r (A.toEuclideanLin (z-x))=0 := by
    rw [real_inner_comm, inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_inner_transpose,
      transpose_apply_pinv_residual_eq_zero, inner_zero_right]
  have he : b-A.toEuclideanLin z = r-A.toEuclideanLin (z-x) := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [map_sub]
    abel
  rw [he]
  have h := norm_sub_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_real hi
  simpa only [pow_two] using h

name: NLAlib.pinv_least_squares_unique
statement:
theorem pinv_least_squares_unique {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hA : A.rank=Fintype.card n) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin ((moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)‖ ≤
        ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin z‖) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      (∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin z‖ ≤ ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin w‖) →
        z=(moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b)
proof:
:= by
  let x := (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin b
  have hmin (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) : ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin x‖ ≤ ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin z‖ := by
    have h := norm_pinv_residual_sq_add_eq A b z
    have hn := sq_nonneg ‖A.toEuclideanLin (z-x)‖
    have h1 := norm_nonneg (b-A.toEuclideanLin x)
    have h2 := norm_nonneg (b-A.toEuclideanLin z)
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hmin, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hn := le_antisymm (hz x) (hmin z)
  have he := norm_pinv_residual_sq_add_eq A b z
  have hzero : A.toEuclideanLin (z-x)=0 := by
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    have hs : ‖A.toEuclideanLin (z-x)‖^2=0 := by
      change ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin z‖^2 = ‖b-A.toEuclideanLin x‖^2+_ at he
      rw [hn] at he
      linarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (A.toEuclideanLin (z-x))]
  have hleft := moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card hA
  have hv := congrArg (fun v => (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin v) hzero
  rw [← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply, hleft, toEuclideanLin_one_apply, map_zero] at hv
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hv

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.truncatedMatrix_transpose
statement:
theorem truncatedMatrix_transpose (h : IsSVD A U V) (k : ℕ) :
    h.transpose.truncatedMatrix k = (h.truncatedMatrix k)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [truncatedMatrix, singularValues_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose, transpose_rectDiag,
    Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_headColumns_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_headColumns_eq_zero (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    (A - h.truncatedMatrix k) * headColumns V hkn = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols (headColumns V hkn) :=
    hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns h.conjTranspose_mul_right hkn
  rw [← h.mul_headColumns_projector hkn, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc A (headColumns V hkn * (headColumns V hkn)ᵀ),
    Matrix.mul_assoc (headColumns V hkn), (show (headColumns V hkn)ᵀ * headColumns V hkn = 1 from hV), Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_residual_headColumns
statement:
theorem sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_residual_headColumns (h : IsSVD A U V)
    (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    (A - h.truncatedMatrix k) * projResidual (headColumns V hkn) Z =
      projResidual (headColumns U hkm) (A * Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_sub, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (A - h.truncatedMatrix k),
    h.sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_headColumns_eq_zero hkn, Matrix.zero_mul, sub_zero,
    ← h.residual_headColumns_eq_sub_truncatedMatrix hkm, residual_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.sub_truncatedMatrix_transpose_mul_residual_headColumns
statement:
theorem sub_truncatedMatrix_transpose_mul_residual_headColumns (h : IsSVD A U V)
    (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n) (Z : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    (A - h.truncatedMatrix k)ᵀ * projResidual (headColumns U hkm) Z =
      projResidual (headColumns V hkn) (Aᵀ * Z)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := h.transpose.sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_residual_headColumns hkn hkm Z
  rw [h.truncatedMatrix_transpose k] at hh
  simpa only [Matrix.transpose_sub] using hh

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    specNorm (A*moorePenroseInverse A-B*moorePenroseInverse B) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  let PA := A*moorePenroseInverse A
  let PB := B*moorePenroseInverse B
  have hPAs : PA.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A
  have hPAi : IsIdempotentElem PA := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A
  have hPBs : PB.IsHermitian := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B
  have hPBi : IsIdempotentElem PB := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B
  have hpr : PA.rank=PB.rank := by
    rw [rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse, rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse]
    exact hr
  change specNorm (PA-PB) ≤ _
  rw [specNorm_sub_projector_eq_complement_mul_of_rank_eq hPAs hPAi hPBs hPBi hpr]
  have hPBb : PB*B=B := mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul B
  have heq : (1-PB)*PA = -((1-PB)*(B-A)*moorePenroseInverse A) := by
    have hz : (1-PB)*B = 0 := by simp [Matrix.sub_mul, hPBb]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hz, Matrix.zero_mul,
      PA, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    abel
  rw [heq, specNorm_neg]
  have hc : specNorm (1-PB) ≤ 1 := by
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem
    · exact Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hPBs
    · change (1-PB)*(1-PB)=1-PB
      have hi : PB*PB=PB := hPBi
      simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hi]
      abel
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm ((1-PB)*(B-A))*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (1-PB)*specNorm (B-A))*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (1*specNorm (B-A))*specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (specNorm_nonneg (B-A))) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    specNorm (A*moorePenroseInverse A-B*moorePenroseInverse B) ≤
      min (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)) (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B))*specNorm (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm hr
  have hb := specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm hr.symm
  rw [specNorm_sub_comm, specNorm_sub_comm A B] at hb
  rcases le_total (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)) (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)) with h | h
  · simpa only [min_eq_left h] using ha
  · simpa only [min_eq_right h] using hb

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_rowProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_rowProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A*A-moorePenroseInverse B*B) ≤
      min (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)) (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B))*specNorm (B-A)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_min_pinv_mul_specNorm
    (A := Aᵀ) (B := Bᵀ) (by simpa only [Matrix.rank_transpose] using hr)
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_transpose, moorePenroseInverse_transpose,
    specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose, ← Matrix.transpose_sub,
    ← Matrix.transpose_mul, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, ← Matrix.transpose_sub,
    specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.rank_moorePenroseInverse_mul
statement:
theorem rank_moorePenroseInverse_mul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (moorePenroseInverse A*A).rank=A.rank
proof:
:= by
  have hh := rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse Aᵀ
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_transpose, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.rank_transpose,
    Matrix.rank_transpose] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_one_sided_frames
statement:
theorem sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_one_sided_frames
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n k ℝ} {R : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R) (hcomp : Qhat * Qhatᵀ + R * Rᵀ = 1)
    {L : Matrix k k ℝ} {M : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hAQ : A * Q = Q * L) (hAR : (A + E) * R = R * M)
    {α δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hmin : ∀ j, α ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j)
    (hmax : ∀ i,
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i ≤ α - δ) :
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ ∧
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ
proof:
:= by
  let hL := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ
  let hM := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR
  have hS := mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_one_sided hM hL hδ hmax hmin (Rᵀ * Q)
  have hF := mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester hM hL hδ
    (by intro i j; have hi := hmax i; have hj := hmin j; rw [le_abs]; right; linarith)
    (Rᵀ * Q)
  rw [sylvester_complement_overlap_eq hA hE hAQ hAR hM] at hS hF
  have hswap : sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat = sinePrincipalAngles Qhat Q := by
    unfold sinePrincipalAngles
    rw [principalAngles_comm]
  rw [← specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp,
    ← hswap] at hS
  rw [← frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp,
    ← hswap] at hF
  exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hS),
    (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hF)⟩

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_empty_or_full_frames
statement:
theorem sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_empty_or_full_frames
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hwidth : Fintype.card k = 0 ∨ Fintype.card k = Fintype.card n) :
    sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hwidth with hzero | hfull
  · ext i j
    have hi := i.isLt
    omega
  · exact sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_full_width hQ hQhat hfull

name: NLAlib.davis_kahan_top_frame_bounds
statement:
theorem davis_kahan_top_frame_bounds
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hjN : j < Fintype.card n)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n (Fin j) ℝ} {R : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R) (hcomp : Qhat * Qhatᵀ + R * Rᵀ = 1)
    {L : Matrix (Fin j) (Fin j) ℝ} {M : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hAQ : A * Q = Q * L) (hAR : (A + E) * R = R * M)
    (hmin : ∀ t, hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ ≤
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues t)
    (hmax : ∀ t,
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues t ≤
        (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩) :
    let S
proof:
:= sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat
    let δ := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩
    let g := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩
    (0 < δ →
      specNorm S ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ ∧
      specNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ ≤ specNorm (E * Q) / δ ∧
      specNorm (E * Q) / δ ≤ specNorm E / δ ∧
      frobNorm S ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ ∧
      frobNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ ≤ frobNorm (E * Q) / δ ∧
      frobNorm (E * Q) / δ ≤ min (Real.sqrt j * specNorm E) (frobNorm E) / δ) ∧
    (0 < g → specNorm S ≤ 2 * specNorm E / g) ∧
    (E = 0 → 0 < g → S = 0) := by
  dsimp only
  let S := sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat
  let δ := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - (hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩
  let g := hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩
  have hmixed (hδ : 0 < δ) :
      specNorm S ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ ∧
      frobNorm S ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) / δ := by
    apply sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_one_sided_frames
      hA hE hQ hQhat hR hcomp hAQ hAR hδ hmin
    intro t
    dsimp only [δ]
    have hh := hmax t
    linarith
  have hcompressed : specNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) ≤ specNorm (E * Q) := by
    simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc] using specNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hR (E * Q)
  have hpopulation (hg : 0 < g) : specNorm S ≤ 2 * specNorm E / g := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hg).2
    by_cases hsmall : specNorm E < g / 2
    · have hweyl := abs_eigenvalues₀_add_sub_le_specNorm hA hE ⟨j, hjN⟩
      rw [abs_le] at hweyl
      have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp only [δ, g] at *; linarith [hweyl.2]
      have hδg : g / 2 ≤ δ := by dsimp only [δ, g] at *; linarith [hweyl.2]
      have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mp (hmixed hδ).1
      have hbound := hcompressed.trans (specNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E)
      have hS0 := specNorm_nonneg S
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδg hS0]
    · have hS : specNorm S ≤ 1 := specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_one hQ hQhat
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS hg.le]
  refine ⟨?_, hpopulation, ?_⟩
  · intro hδ
    have hFcompressed : frobNorm (Rᵀ * E * Q) ≤ frobNorm (E * Q) := by
      simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc] using frobNorm_transpose_frame_mul_le hR (E * Q)
    have hFbound : frobNorm (E * Q) ≤ min (Real.sqrt j * specNorm E) (frobNorm E) :=
      le_min (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
        frobNorm_mul_frame_le_sqrt_card_mul_specNorm hQ E) (frobNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E)
    exact ⟨(hmixed hδ).1, div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcompressed hδ.le,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_frame_le hQ E) hδ.le,
      (hmixed hδ).2, div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hFcompressed hδ.le,
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hFbound hδ.le⟩
  · intro hzero hg
    have h := hpopulation hg
    rw [hzero, specNorm_zero, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact le_antisymm h (specNorm_nonneg S)

name: NLAlib.mul_transpose_eq_topEigenframe_projector_of_lower_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem mul_transpose_eq_topEigenframe_projector_of_lower_spectral_bound
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ}
    (hj0 : 0 < j) (hjN : j < Fintype.card n)
    (hg : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩)
    {Q : Matrix n (Fin j) ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    {L : Matrix (Fin j) (Fin j) ℝ} (hAQ : A * Q = Q * L)
    (hmin : ∀ t, hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ ≤
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues t) :
    Q * Qᵀ = topEigenframe hA hjN.le * (topEigenframe hA hjN.le)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let R := complementaryEigenframe hA hjN.le
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n - j) → ℝ :=
    fun i => hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + j, by omega⟩
  have hTop := hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hjN.le
  have hR := hasOrthonormalCols_complementaryEigenframe hA hjN.le
  have hAR : (A + 0) * R = R * Matrix.diagonal e := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using mul_complementaryEigenframe_eq_mul_diagonal hA hjN.le
  have hmax : ∀ t,
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add (Matrix.isHermitian_zero)) hR hAR).eigenvalues t ≤
        hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ -
          (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩) := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eq_eigenvalues_diagonal e t
    rw [← hi]
    have htail : e i ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩ := by
      apply hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone
      change j ≤ i.val + j
      omega
    linarith
  have hs := (sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_one_sided_frames
    hA Matrix.isHermitian_zero hQ hTop hR
    (topEigenframe_projector_add_complementary_eq_one hA hjN.le) hAQ hAR hg hmin hmax).1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, specNorm_zero, zero_div] at hs
  rw [specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_projector_distance hQ hTop] at hs
  have hz : Q * Qᵀ - topEigenframe hA hjN.le * (topEigenframe hA hjN.le)ᵀ = 0 := by
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact le_antisymm hs (specNorm_nonneg _)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_min_div_population_gap_of_frames
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_min_div_population_gap_of_frames
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ}
    (hj0 : 0 < j) (hjN : j < Fintype.card n)
    (hg : 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n (Fin j) ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    {L : Matrix (Fin j) (Fin j) ℝ} (hAQ : A * Q = Q * L)
    (hmin : ∀ t, hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ ≤
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues t)
    (htop : (Qhatᵀ * (A + E) * Qhat).trace = eigenvaluePrefix (hA.add hE) j) :
    frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤
      min (2 * Real.sqrt j * specNorm E) (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm E) /
        (hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ - hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨j, hjN⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hproj := mul_transpose_eq_topEigenframe_projector_of_lower_spectral_bound
    hA hj0 hjN hg hQ hAQ hmin
  have hN := frobNorm_projector_distance_eq_sqrt_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles hQ hQhat
  have hNTop := frobNorm_projector_distance_eq_sqrt_two_mul_sinePrincipalAngles
    (hasOrthonormalCols_topEigenframe hA hjN.le) hQhat
  rw [hproj] at hN
  have heq : frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) =
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles (topEigenframe hA hjN.le) Qhat) := by
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
    nlinarith [hN, hNTop]
  rw [heq]
  exact frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_min_div_population_gap hA hE hj0 hjN hg hQhat htop

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_mul_transpose_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_mul_transpose_mul_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    moorePenroseInverse A*(moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ*Aᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.transpose_mul,
    (show (A * moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ = A * moorePenroseInverse A from
      (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose_mul_eq), ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse]

name: NLAlib.complement_columnProjector_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem complement_columnProjector_mul_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.mul_complement_rowProjector_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mul_complement_rowProjector_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    A*(1-moorePenroseInverse A*A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    Aᵀ*(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg Matrix.transpose (complement_columnProjector_mul_eq_zero A)
  simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one,
    (show (A * moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ = A * moorePenroseInverse A from
      (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose_mul_eq), Matrix.transpose_zero] using hh

name: NLAlib.complement_rowProjector_mul_transpose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem complement_rowProjector_mul_transpose_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (1-moorePenroseInverse A*A)*Aᵀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg Matrix.transpose (mul_complement_rowProjector_eq_zero A)
  simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one,
    (show (moorePenroseInverse A * A)ᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A * A from
      (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq), Matrix.transpose_zero] using hh

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_sub_eq
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_sub_eq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    moorePenroseInverse B-moorePenroseInverse A =
      -moorePenroseInverse B*(B-A)*moorePenroseInverse A +
      moorePenroseInverse B*(moorePenroseInverse B)ᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ*
        (1-A*moorePenroseInverse A) +
      (1-moorePenroseInverse B*B)*(B-A)ᵀ*(moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ*
        moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  let a := moorePenroseInverse A
  let b := moorePenroseInverse B
  have hb : b*bᵀ*Bᵀ = b := moorePenroseInverse_mul_transpose_mul_transpose B
  have ha : Aᵀ*aᵀ*a = a := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, (show (moorePenroseInverse A * A)ᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A * A from
      (isMoorePenroseInverse A).conjTranspose_inv_mul_eq)]
    exact moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A
  have ha0 : Aᵀ*(1-A*a)=0 := transpose_mul_complement_columnProjector_eq_zero A
  have hb0 : (1-b*B)*Bᵀ=0 := complement_rowProjector_mul_transpose_eq_zero B
  change b-a = -b*(B-A)*a + b*bᵀ*(B-A)ᵀ*(1-A*a) + (1-b*B)*(B-A)ᵀ*aᵀ*a
  rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.mul_sub (b*bᵀ), Matrix.sub_mul,
    hb, Matrix.mul_assoc (b*bᵀ) Aᵀ, ha0, Matrix.mul_zero, sub_zero,
    Matrix.mul_sub (1-b*B), hb0, zero_sub]
  simp only [Matrix.neg_mul]
  rw [show (1-b*B)*Aᵀ*aᵀ*a = (1-b*B)*(Aᵀ*aᵀ*a) by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc], ha]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_overlap_row_le_one
proof:
:= by
  let u : m → ℝ := fun s => U s i
  have hcol : u ⬝ᵥ u=1 := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun T : Matrix n n ℝ => T i i) (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq, u, dotProduct] using hh
  have hb : (Qᵀ *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ u) ≤ u ⬝ᵥ u := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs,
      dotProduct, ← sq] using sum_norm_sq_conjTranspose_mulVec_le hQ u
  rw [hcol] at hb
  have heq : (∑ j, (Uᵀ*Q) i j^2)=(Qᵀ*ᵥu) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ*ᵥu) := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mulVec, u, ← sq]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_sq_overlap_eq_card
proof:

  have hUt : Uᵀᵀ*Uᵀ=1 := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hUc

name: NLAlib.trace_compression_eq_sum_mul_overlap_row_sq
statement:
theorem trace_compression_eq_sum_mul_overlap_row_sq {A : Matrix m m ℝ}
    (U : Matrix m n ℝ) (Q : Matrix m r ℝ) (a : n → ℝ)
    (hA : A=U*Matrix.diagonal a*Uᵀ) :
    (Qᵀ*A*Q).trace=∑ i, a i*∑ j, (Uᵀ*Q) i j^2
proof:
:= by
  let W := Uᵀ*Q
  have heq : Qᵀ*A*Q=Wᵀ*Matrix.diagonal a*W := by
    rw [hA]
    simp only [W, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [heq, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (W*Wᵀ) (Matrix.diagonal a)]
  rw [Matrix.trace]
  change (∑ i, (Matrix.diagonal a*(W*Wᵀ)) i i)=_
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, ← sq, W]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_prefix_transpose_mul_eq_sum_overlap_row_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_prefix_transpose_mul_eq_sum_overlap_row_sq {N k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ N) (U : Matrix m (Fin N) ℝ) (Q : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ) :
    frobSq ((U.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hk))ᵀ*Q)=
      ∑ i : Fin k, ∑ j, (Uᵀ*Q) (Fin.castLE hk i) j^2
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (U.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hk))ᵀ*Q=(Uᵀ*Q).submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) id := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_submatrix]
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using
      Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv Uᵀ Q (Fin.castLE hk) (Equiv.refl m) id
  rw [heq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sortedEigenframe_mul_transpose_eq_one
statement:
theorem sortedEigenframe_mul_transpose_eq_one (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    sortedEigenframe hA*(sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ=1
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.mul_eq_one_comm_of_card_eq (m := Fin (Fintype.card m)) (n := m) (R := ℝ)
    (A := (sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ) (B := sortedEigenframe hA) (eq := by simp)).mp
      (hasOrthonormalCols_sortedEigenframe hA)

name: NLAlib.eq_sortedEigenframe_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem eq_sortedEigenframe_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A=sortedEigenframe hA*Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues₀*(sortedEigenframe hA)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let U := sortedEigenframe hA
  have hu : U*Uᵀ=1 := sortedEigenframe_mul_transpose_eq_one hA
  have heq : U*(Uᵀ*A*U)*Uᵀ=A := by
    calc
      _ = (U*Uᵀ)*A*(U*Uᵀ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A := by rw [hu, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    A=U*(Uᵀ*A*U)*Uᵀ := heq.symm
    _ = _ := by rw [compression_sortedEigenframe_eq_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.trace_topEigenframe_compression_eq_prefix
statement:
theorem trace_topEigenframe_compression_eq_prefix (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card m) :
    ((topEigenframe hA hk)ᵀ*A*topEigenframe hA hk).trace=eigenvaluePrefix hA k
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.trace_compression_le_trace_topEigenframe
statement:
theorem trace_compression_le_trace_topEigenframe (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card m) {Q : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    (Qᵀ*A*Q).trace ≤ ((topEigenframe hA hk)ᵀ*A*topEigenframe hA hk).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hh := trace_compression_le_eigenvaluePrefix hA hQ
  simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Fintype.card_fin] at hh
  rw [trace_topEigenframe_compression_eq_prefix hA hk]
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_forall_sqrt_pinv_fit_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem exists_pos_forall_sqrt_pinv_fit_sub_div_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (b : m → ℝ) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ E : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm E < δ →
      Real.sqrt ((((A + E) * moorePenroseInverse (A + E)) *ᵥ b -
            (A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (((A + E) * moorePenroseInverse (A + E)) *ᵥ b -
            (A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b)) /
        Real.sqrt (((A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ ((A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b)) ≤
        (moorePenroseConditionNumber A / leastSquaresCos A b + ε) * (specNorm E / specNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  let a := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := specNorm_nonneg _
  refine ⟨1 / (a + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro E hE
  have he : 0 ≤ specNorm E := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hsmall : a * specNorm E < 1 := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (show 0 < a + 1 by positivity)).mp hE
    nlinarith
  have hB := rank_add_eq_card_of_pinv_mul_specNorm_lt_one hA hsmall
  let P := A * moorePenroseInverse A
  let Q := (A + E) * moorePenroseInverse (A + E)
  let Ny := Real.sqrt ((P *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ b))
  let Nb := Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b)
  have hRHS : 0 ≤ (moorePenroseConditionNumber A / leastSquaresCos A b + ε) *
      (specNorm E / specNorm A) := by
    unfold leastSquaresCos
    have hκ := moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A
    have hM := specNorm_nonneg A
    positivity
  by_cases hy : P *ᵥ b = 0
  · change _ / Ny ≤ _
    have hNy : Ny = 0 := by simp [Ny, hy]
    rw [hNy, div_zero]
    exact hRHS
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hy (by rw [hz, Matrix.mulVec_zero])
  have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hy (by simp [P, hz])
  have hM : 0 < specNorm A := by
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hA0
  have hNy : 0 < Ny := by
    dsimp [Ny]
    rw [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (fun hz => hy (congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz))
  have hNb : 0 < Nb := by
    dsimp [Nb]
    rw [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (fun hz => hb (congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz))
  have hgap : specNorm (Q - P) ≤ a * specNorm E := by
    rw [specNorm_sub_comm]
    have h := specNorm_sub_columnProjector_le_pinv_mul_specNorm
      (A := A) (B := A + E) (hA.trans hB.symm)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using h
  have hdiff : Q *ᵥ b - P *ᵥ b = (Q - P) *ᵥ b := (Matrix.sub_mulVec Q P b).symm
  have hbound : Real.sqrt ((Q *ᵥ b - P *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ b - P *ᵥ b)) ≤
      a * specNorm E * Nb := by
    rw [hdiff]
    exact (sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul (Q - P) b).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgap hNb.le)
  have hcoeff : a * specNorm E * Nb / Ny =
      moorePenroseConditionNumber A / leastSquaresCos A b * (specNorm E / specNorm A) := by
    unfold moorePenroseConditionNumber leastSquaresCos
    change a * specNorm E * Nb / Ny =
      specNorm A * a / (Ny / Nb) * (specNorm E / specNorm A)
    field_simp
  change _ / Ny ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ a * specNorm E * Nb / Ny := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound hNy.le
    _ = moorePenroseConditionNumber A / leastSquaresCos A b * (specNorm E / specNorm A) := hcoeff
    _ ≤ (moorePenroseConditionNumber A / leastSquaresCos A b + ε) * (specNorm E / specNorm A) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (div_nonneg he hM.le)

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_forall_sqrt_pinv_solution_sub_div_le
statement:
theorem exists_pos_forall_sqrt_pinv_solution_sub_div_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (b : m → ℝ) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ E : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm E < δ →
      Real.sqrt ((moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ b - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ b - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) /
        Real.sqrt ((moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)) ≤
        (moorePenroseConditionNumber A + moorePenroseConditionNumber A ^ 2 * leastSquaresTan A b / leastSquaresEta A b +
          ε) * (specNorm E / specNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  let a := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)
  let C := moorePenroseConditionNumber A + moorePenroseConditionNumber A ^ 2 * leastSquaresTan A b / leastSquaresEta A b
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    unfold leastSquaresTan leastSquaresEta
    have hκ := moorePenroseConditionNumber_nonneg A
    have hM := specNorm_nonneg A
    positivity
  by_cases hx : moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b = 0
  · refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
    intro E _
    simp only [hx, dotProduct_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, div_zero]
    change 0 ≤ (C + ε) * (specNorm E / specNorm A)
    exact mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hC hε.le) (div_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
  let x := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
  let r := b - A *ᵥ x
  let X := Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)
  let R := Real.sqrt (r ⬝ᵥ r)
  let Y := Real.sqrt (((A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
    ((A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b))
  have hX : 0 < X := by
    dsimp [X, x]
    rw [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (fun hz => hx (congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz))
  have hx' : (moorePenroseInverse A).toEuclideanLin (WithLp.toLp 2 b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hx (congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz)
  have hM : 0 < specNorm A := specNorm_pos_of_pinv_solution_ne_zero hA (WithLp.toLp 2 b) hx'
  have hY : 0 < Y := by
    have h := (pinv_solution_norm_pos hA (WithLp.toLp 2 b) hx').1
    simpa only [norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin,
      Matrix.toLin'_apply, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h
  have hcoeff : C = specNorm A * a + specNorm A * a ^ 2 * R / X := by
    dsimp [C]
    unfold moorePenroseConditionNumber leastSquaresTan leastSquaresEta
    have hr : b - (A * moorePenroseInverse A) *ᵥ b = r := by
      dsimp [r, x]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    rw [hr]
    change specNorm A * a + (specNorm A * a) ^ 2 * (R / Y) /
      (specNorm A * X / Y) = _
    field_simp
  refine ⟨min (1 / (2 * (a + 1))) (ε / (2 * (a + 1) * (C + ε + 1))),
    lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity), ?_⟩
  intro E hE
  let e := specNorm E
  have he : 0 ≤ e := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hsmall : a * e < 1 := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 2 * (a + 1) by positivity)).mp
      (hE.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    nlinarith
  have hgap : 0 < 1 - a * e := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
  have hprod : (C + ε) * (a * e) ≤ ε := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 2 * (a + 1) * (C + ε + 1) by positivity)).mp
      (hE.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
    have h1 : a * e ≤ (a + 1) * e := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) he
    have h2 : (C + ε) * (a * e) ≤ (C + ε + 1) * ((a + 1) * e) :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) h1 (mul_nonneg ha he) (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hden : C / (1 - a * e) ≤ C + ε := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hgap).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hdirect :
      Real.sqrt ((moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ b - x) ⬝ᵥ
        (moorePenroseInverse (A + E) *ᵥ b - x)) ≤
      specNorm (moorePenroseInverse (A + E)) * (e * X + a * e * R) := by
    have h := norm_least_squares_sub_le_pinv hA hsmall (WithLp.toLp 2 b) 0
    simpa only [add_zero, norm_zero, zero_add, norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct,
      WithLp.ofLp_sub, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin,
      Matrix.toLin'_apply, WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using h
  have hbound := hdirect.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (specNorm_pinv_add_le_of_rank_eq_card hA hsmall)
    (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg he hX.le) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha he) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))))
  have halg : (a / (1 - a * e) * (e * X + a * e * R)) / X =
      C / (1 - a * e) * (e / specNorm A) := by
    rw [hcoeff]
    field_simp
  change _ / X ≤ (C + ε) * (e / specNorm A)
  calc
    _ ≤ (a / (1 - a * e) * (e * X + a * e * R)) / X :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound hX.le
    _ = C / (1 - a * e) * (e / specNorm A) := halg
    _ ≤ (C + ε) * (e / specNorm A) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hden (div_nonneg he hM.le)

name: NLAlib.singular_subspace_perturbation_bounds
proof:

    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let T := Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues (A + E) i)
    let R := A * Vhat₁ - Uhat₁ * T
    let S := Aᵀ * Uhat₁ - Vhat₁ * T
    let δ := singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k
    let g := singularValues A (k - 1) - singularValues A k
    R = -(E * Vhat₁) ∧ S = -(Eᵀ * Uhat₁) ∧
      max (specNorm R) (specNorm S) ≤ specNorm E ∧
      (0 < δ →
        max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁))
          (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤ max (specNorm R) (specNorm S) / δ ∧
        max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁))
          (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤ specNorm E / δ ∧
        Real.sqrt (frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁) ^ 2 +
          frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁) ^ 2) ≤
            Real.sqrt (frobNorm R ^ 2 + frobNorm S ^ 2) / δ) ∧
      (0 < g → max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁))
        (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤ 2 * specNorm E / g) ∧
      (k = 0 → specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁) = 0 ∧
        specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁) = 0 ∧
        frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁) = 0 ∧
        frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁) = 0) := by
  dsimp only
  have hR := hhat.headColumns_left_residual_eq_neg_mul
    (hk.trans (min_le_left m n)) (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  have hS := hhat.headColumns_right_residual_eq_neg_mul
    (hk.trans (min_le_left m n)) (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  refine ⟨hR, hS, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hR, hS, specNorm_neg, specNorm_neg]
    apply max_le
    · exact specNorm_mul_frame_le (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_right _) E
    · simpa only [specNorm_transpose] using
        specNorm_mul_frame_le (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_left _) Eᵀ
  · intro hδ
    exact ⟨max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_max_residual_div hA hhat hk hδ,
      max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_specNorm_div hA hhat hk hδ,
      sqrt_add_sq_frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_sqrt_add_sq_residual_div hA hhat hk hδ⟩
  · exact max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_two_mul_specNorm_div_population_gap hA hhat hk
  · intro hk0
    subst k
    rw [sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_card_eq_zero _ _ (by simp),
      sinePrincipalAngles_eq_zero_of_card_eq_zero _ _ (by simp)]
    simp [specNorm_zero, frobNorm_zero]

name: NLAlib.analyticAt_inversePencilUpperRootSum
statement:
theorem analyticAt_inversePencilUpperRootSum
    {A D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hDu : IsUnit D) {u : ℂ} (hu : u.im ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (inversePencilUpperRootSum A D) u
proof:
:= by
  have heq (v : ℂ) : D⁻¹ * (A - v • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) =
      D⁻¹ * A + v • (-D⁻¹) := by
    rw [mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h := Matrix.analyticAt_sum_filter_roots_charpoly_affine_upper
    (D⁻¹ * A) (-D⁻¹) u (by
      intro z hz
      rw [← heq] at hz
      exact im_ne_zero_of_det_hermitian_pencil_eq_zero hA hD hu
        ((det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul A D hDu u z).mpr hz))
  change AnalyticAt ℂ (fun v => ((D⁻¹ * (A - v • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))).charpoly.roots.filter
    (fun z => 0 < z.im)).sum) u
  simpa only [heq] using h

    ‖inversePencilUpperRootSum A D u‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + M)

    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)))

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalues₀_pencil_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_eigenvalues₀_pencil_sub_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (s t : ℝ) :
    |(isHermitian_add_smul hA hB s).eigenvalues₀ i -
      (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB t).eigenvalues₀ i| ≤ |s - t| * specNorm B
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub
    (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB t) (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB s) i
  have hd : (A + s • B) - (A + t • B) = (s - t) • B := by
    rw [sub_smul]
    abel
  simpa only [hd, specNorm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_eigenvalues₀_pencil
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_eigenvalues₀_pencil {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    LipschitzWith ⟨specNorm B, specNorm_nonneg B⟩
      (fun t : ℝ => (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB t).eigenvalues₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  change dist _ _ ≤ specNorm B * dist s t
  simp only [Real.dist_eq]
  exact (abs_eigenvalues₀_pencil_sub_le hA hB i s t).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)

name: NLAlib.continuous_eigenvalues₀_pencil
proof:
:=
  (lipschitzWith_eigenvalues₀_pencil hA hB i).continuous

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_pencil_add

      (isHermitian_add_smul hA hB (t + h)).eigenvalues₀ i
