name: NLAlib.exists_perm_sum_le_doublyStochastic_cost
statement:
theorem exists_perm_sum_le_doublyStochastic_cost (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {W : Matrix n n ℝ} (hW : W ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ n) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, (∑ i, C i (σ i)) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, W i j * C i j
proof:
:= by
  let f : Matrix n n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun X := ∑ i, ∑ j, X i j * C i j
      map_add' X Y := by simp only [Matrix.add_apply, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' c X := by
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc,
          Finset.mul_sum] }
  have hconv : W ∈ convexHull ℝ {σ.permMatrix ℝ | σ : Equiv.Perm n} := by
    rwa [← doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix]
  obtain ⟨P, ⟨σ, rfl⟩, hP⟩ := (f.concaveOn convex_univ).exists_le_of_mem_convexHull
    (Set.subset_univ _) hconv
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  simpa [f, Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, Equiv.toPEquiv_apply] using hP

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_sum_sq_le_frobSq_of_unitary_diagonalizations
statement:
theorem exists_perm_sum_sq_le_frobSq_of_unitary_diagonalizations
    (U V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (a b : n → ℂ) {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal b * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, (∑ i, ‖a i - b (σ i)‖ ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := star U * V
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hUUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hVV : (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self V
  have hVVt : (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
  have hC : (C : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) := rfl
  have hAU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * A = Matrix.diagonal a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    rw [hA, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUUt, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hBV : B * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal b := by
    rw [hB, Matrix.mul_assoc, hVVt, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hres : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (A - B) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      Matrix.diagonal a * (C : Matrix n n ℂ) - (C : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal b := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hAU,
      Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.diagonal a) (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ,
      Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ B, hBV,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ (V : Matrix n n ℂ), ← hC]
  have hinv : frobSq ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (A - B) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) = frobSq (A - B) := by
    have hUt : (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hUU
    have hVt : (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴᴴ * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hVV
    have hh := frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hVt ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (A - B))
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hUt] using hh
  have hcost : (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖(C : Matrix n n ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 * ‖a i - b j‖ ^ 2) =
      frobSq (A - B) := by
    rw [← hinv, hres, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    have heq : a i * (C : Matrix n n ℂ) i j - (C : Matrix n n ℂ) i j * b j =
        (a i - b j) * (C : Matrix n n ℂ) i j := by ring
    rw [heq, norm_mul, mul_pow, mul_comm]
  have hCo : HasOrthonormalCols (C : Matrix n n ℂ) := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self C
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_sum_le_doublyStochastic_cost
    (Matrix.of fun i j => ‖a i - b j‖ ^ 2)
    (norm_sq_entries_mem_doublyStochastic_of_hasOrthonormalCols hCo)
  exact ⟨σ, hσ.trans_eq hcost⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_lists_perm_sum_sq_le_frobSq_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_lists_perm_sum_sq_le_frobSq_of_normal
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) :
    ∃ (a b : n → ℂ) (σ : Equiv.Perm n),
      A.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a i)) ∧
      B.charpoly = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (b i)) ∧
      (∑ i, ‖a i - b (σ i)‖ ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, a, hUa⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  obtain ⟨V, b, hVb⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hB
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_sum_sq_le_frobSq_of_unitary_diagonalizations U V a b hUa hVb
  have hchar (W : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ) :
      ((W : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ).charpoly =
        ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (d i)) := by
    have hWW : (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * (W : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self W
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hWW, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  exact ⟨a, b, σ, hUa ▸ hchar U a, hVb ▸ hchar V b, hσ⟩

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_rayleighQuotient
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_rayleighQuotient (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient
      (innerSL ℝ ((2/‖x‖^2) • (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A x -
        (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient x • x))) x
proof:
:= by
  let T := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A
  have hsym : (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n).IsSymmetric :=
    Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA
  have hnum := hsym.hasStrictFDerivAt_reApplyInnerSelf x |>.hasFDerivAt
  have hden := hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x |>.hasFDerivAt
  have hn : ‖x‖^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)
  have hh := hnum.mul ((hasFDerivAt_inv hn).comp x hden)
  convert! hh using 1
  ext y
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_left,
    ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient, ContinuousLinearMap.reApplyInnerSelf_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, T]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Qᵀ*A*Q=L := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAQ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᵀ Q, (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ), Matrix.one_mul]
  exact heq ▸ (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA : (Qᵀ * A * Q).IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.sylvester_complement_overlap_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hRT : Rᵀ*(A+E)=M*Rᵀ := by
    have hh := congrArg Matrix.transpose hAR
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_add,
      Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hA |>.eq,
      Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hE |>.eq,
      Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hM |>.eq] using hh
  have hQQ : (Rᵀ*Q)*L = Rᵀ*A*Q := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hAQ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hQQ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc M Rᵀ Q, ← hRT, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div
statement:
theorem specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n k ℝ} {R : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R) (hcomp : Qhat*Qhatᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1)
    {L : Matrix k k ℝ} {M : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hAQ : A*Q=Q*L) (hAR : (A+E)*R=R*M)
    {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hinterval : ∀ j, a ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ∧
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ≤ b)
    (hout : ∀ i, (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨
      b+δ ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i) :
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ
proof:
:= by
  let hL := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ
  let hM := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR
  have hh := specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_div hM hL hab hδ hinterval hout (Rᵀ*Q)
  rw [sylvester_complement_overlap_eq hA hE hAQ hAR hM] at hh
  have hangles : sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat = sinePrincipalAngles Qhat Q := by
    rw [sinePrincipalAngles, principalAngles_comm]
    rfl
  rw [hangles, specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp]
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n k ℝ} {R : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R) (hcomp : Qhat*Qhatᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1)
    {L : Matrix k k ℝ} {M : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hAQ : A*Q=Q*L) (hAR : (A+E)*R=R*M)
    {a b δ : ℝ} (_hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hinterval : ∀ j, a ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ∧
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ≤ b)
    (hout : ∀ i, (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨
      b+δ ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i) :
    frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ
proof:
:= by
  let hL := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ
  let hM := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR
  have hsep := eigenvalue_separation_of_interval_complement hM hL hinterval hout
  have hh := frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester_div hM hL hδ hsep (Rᵀ*Q)
  rw [sylvester_complement_overlap_eq hA hE hAQ hAR hM] at hh
  have hangles : sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat = sinePrincipalAngles Qhat Q := by
    rw [sinePrincipalAngles, principalAngles_comm]
    rfl
  rw [hangles, frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp]
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_interval
statement:
theorem sinePrincipalAngles_le_compressed_residual_div_of_interval
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    {Q Qhat : Matrix n k ℝ} {R : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQhat : HasOrthonormalCols Qhat)
    (hR : HasOrthonormalCols R) (hcomp : Qhat*Qhatᵀ+R*Rᵀ=1)
    {L : Matrix k k ℝ} {M : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hAQ : A*Q=Q*L) (hAR : (A+E)*R=R*M)
    {a b δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hinterval : ∀ j, a ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ∧
      (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ).eigenvalues j ≤ b)
    (hout : ∀ i, (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨
      b+δ ≤ (isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR).eigenvalues i) :
    specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ specNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ ∧
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat) ≤ frobNorm (Rᵀ*E*Q)/δ
proof:
:= by
  let hL := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame hA hQ hAQ
  let hM := isHermitian_of_invariant_orthonormal_frame (hA.add hE) hR hAR
  have hS := mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_sylvester_of_interval hM hL hδ hinterval hout (Rᵀ*Q)
  have hF := mul_frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester hM hL hδ
    (eigenvalue_separation_of_interval_complement hM hL hinterval hout) (Rᵀ*Q)
  rw [sylvester_complement_overlap_eq hA hE hAQ hAR hM] at hS hF
  have hswap : sinePrincipalAngles Q Qhat=sinePrincipalAngles Qhat Q := by
    unfold sinePrincipalAngles
    rw [principalAngles_comm]
  rw [← specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp, ← hswap] at hS
  rw [← frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_complement_overlap hQhat hQ hR hcomp, ← hswap] at hF
  exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hS),
    (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hF)⟩

name: NLAlib.det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum
    (A D : Matrix n n ℂ) (u z : ℂ) :
    (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + z • D).det = 0 ↔
      u ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • D)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + z • D =
      u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (A - z • D) := by abel
  rw [heq]
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]
  simp only [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.im_ne_zero_of_det_hermitian_pencil_eq_zero
statement:
theorem im_ne_zero_of_det_hermitian_pencil_eq_zero
    {A D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    {u z : ℂ} (hu : u.im ≠ 0)
    (hz : (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + z • D).det = 0) : z.im ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzim
  have hzreal : (z.re : ℂ) = z := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hzim]
  have hreal : (A - z • D).IsHermitian := by
    rw [← hzreal]
    exact hA.sub (hD.smul (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint]))
  exact hu (hreal.isSelfAdjoint.im_eq_zero_of_mem_spectrum
    ((det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum A D u z).mp hz))

name: NLAlib.det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul
statement:
theorem det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul
    (A D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) (u z : ℂ) :
    (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + z • D).det = 0 ↔
      z ∈ spectrum ℂ (D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]
  simp only [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have hfac : u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + z • D =
      D * (z • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv_cancel_left D _ (D.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hD)]
    abel
  rw [hfac, Matrix.det_mul]
  exact mul_eq_zero.trans (or_iff_right (D.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hD).ne_zero)

name: NLAlib.norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_det_pencil_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_det_pencil_eq_zero
    (A D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) {u z : ℂ}
    (hz : (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + z • D).det = 0) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have := hn
    simp at hz
  | inr hn =>
    have := hn
    have hspec :=
      (det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul A D hD u z).mp hz
    calc
      ‖z‖ ≤ ‖D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))‖ :=
        spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hspec
      _ ≤ ‖D⁻¹‖ * ‖A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖D⁻¹‖ * (‖A‖ + ‖u‖) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
        simpa only [norm_smul, norm_one, mul_one] using
          norm_sub_le A (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
      _ = _ := rfl

name: NLAlib.im_ne_zero_of_mem_roots_charpoly_inv_mul
statement:
theorem im_ne_zero_of_mem_roots_charpoly_inv_mul
    {A D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hDu : IsUnit D) {u z : ℂ} (hu : u.im ≠ 0)
    (hz : z ∈ (D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))).charpoly.roots) :
    z.im ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_isRoot_charpoly
    ((Polynomial.mem_roots (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).ne_zero).mp hz)
  exact im_ne_zero_of_det_hermitian_pencil_eq_zero hA hD hu
    ((det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul A D hDu u z).mpr hs)

name: NLAlib.norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_mem_roots_charpoly
statement:
theorem norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_mem_roots_charpoly
    (A D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) {u z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ (D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))).charpoly.roots) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_isRoot_charpoly
    ((Polynomial.mem_roots (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).ne_zero).mp hz)
  exact norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_det_pencil_eq_zero A D hD
    ((det_smul_one_sub_add_smul_eq_zero_iff_mem_spectrum_inv_mul A D hD u z).mpr hs)

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_le_card_mul_specNorm_inv_of_le_roots_charpoly
statement:
theorem norm_sum_le_card_mul_specNorm_inv_of_le_roots_charpoly
    (A D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) (u : ℂ) (roots : Multiset ℂ)
    (hroots : roots ≤ (D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))).charpoly.roots) :
    ‖roots.sum‖ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
proof:
:= by
  let C := specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hcard : roots.card ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    exact (Multiset.card_le_card hroots).trans
      ((Polynomial.card_roots' _).trans (by rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]))
  calc
    ‖roots.sum‖ ≤ (roots.map (fun z => ‖z‖)).sum := norm_multiset_sum_le roots
    _ ≤ roots.card • C := by
      simpa only [Multiset.card_map] using
        Multiset.sum_le_card_nsmul (roots.map (fun z => ‖z‖)) C (by
          intro x hx
          obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
          exact norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_mem_roots_charpoly A D hD
            (Multiset.mem_of_le hroots hz))
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * C := by
      simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard : (roots.card : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n) hC
    _ = _ := by dsimp [C]; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_ite_le_card_mul_specNorm_inv_of_det_pencil_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_sum_ite_le_card_mul_specNorm_inv_of_det_pencil_eq_zero
    (A D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) (u : ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ)
    (hev : ∀ i, (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - A + ev i • D).det = 0)
    (p : n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    ‖∑ i, if p i then ev i else 0‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
proof:
:= by
  let C := specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + ‖u‖)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
  calc
    ‖∑ i, if p i then ev i else 0‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖if p i then ev i else 0‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : n, C := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      split_ifs
      · exact norm_le_specNorm_inv_mul_of_det_pencil_eq_zero A D hD (hev i)
      · simpa only [norm_zero] using hC
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]; dsimp [C]; ring

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.continuousAt_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.continuousAt_eigenvalues₀
    (hA : ∀ y, (A y).IsHermitian)
    (hc : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => (hA y).eigenvalues₀ k) x
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hF : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => frobNorm (A y - A x)) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [sub_self, frobNorm_zero] using (continuousAt_frobNorm_sub_of_entrywise hc).tendsto
  have hsmall := hF.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hε)
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with y hy
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact ((abs_eigenvalues₀_sub_le_specNorm_sub (hA x) (hA y) k).trans
    (specNorm_le_frobNorm _)).trans_lt hy

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.coupled_residual_headColumns_left
statement:
theorem coupled_residual_headColumns_left (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Uhat : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) (Vhat : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    (A - h.truncatedMatrix k) * projResidual (headColumns V hkn) Vhat -
      projResidual (headColumns U hkm) Uhat * T =
        projResidual (headColumns U hkm) (A * Vhat - Uhat * T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.sub_truncatedMatrix_mul_residual_headColumns hkm hkn Vhat, residual_mul]
  simp only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_sub]
  abel

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.coupled_residual_headColumns_right
statement:
theorem coupled_residual_headColumns_right (h : IsSVD A U V) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Uhat : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) (Vhat : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    (A - h.truncatedMatrix k)ᵀ * projResidual (headColumns U hkm) Uhat -
      projResidual (headColumns V hkn) Vhat * T =
        projResidual (headColumns V hkn) (Aᵀ * Uhat - Vhat * T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.sub_truncatedMatrix_transpose_mul_residual_headColumns hkm hkn Uhat, residual_mul]
  simp only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_sub]
  abel

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_le
statement:
private theorem specNorm_residual_le {m n k : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype k]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq k] {Q : Matrix m k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (R : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q R) ≤ specNorm R
proof: := specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hQ R

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_residual_le
statement:
private theorem frobNorm_residual_le {m n k : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype k]
    [DecidableEq k] {Q : Matrix m k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (R : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobNorm (projResidual Q R) ≤ frobNorm R
proof: := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (frobSq_residual_le hQ R)

name: NLAlib.max_specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_max_residual_div
proof:
:= headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let T := Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues (A + E) i)
    max (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁)) (specNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁)) ≤
      max (specNorm (A * Vhat₁ - Uhat₁ * T)) (specNorm (Aᵀ * Uhat₁ - Vhat₁ * T)) /
        (singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k) := by
  dsimp only
  let U₁ := headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  let t : Fin k → ℝ := fun i => singularValues (A + E) i
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hA.conjTranspose_mul_left _
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols V₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hA.conjTranspose_mul_right _
  have hUh : HasOrthonormalCols Uhat₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_left _
  have hVh : HasOrthonormalCols Vhat₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_right _
  have ht : ∀ i : Fin k, singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) ≤ t i := by
    intro i
    exact singularValues_antitone (A + E) (by have hi := i.isLt; omega)
  have hh := sub_mul_max_specNorm_le_max_coupled_residual
    (singularValues_nonneg (A + E) (k - 1)) ht
    (hA.specNorm_sub_truncatedMatrix k).le (projResidual U₁ Uhat₁) (projResidual V₁ Vhat₁)
  rw [hA.coupled_residual_headColumns_left, hA.coupled_residual_headColumns_right] at hh
  have hcontr := max_le_max (specNorm_residual_le hU (A * Vhat₁ - Uhat₁ * Matrix.diagonal t))
    (specNorm_residual_le hV (Aᵀ * Uhat₁ - Vhat₁ * Matrix.diagonal t))
  have hb := hh.trans hcontr
  rw [← specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hU hUh,
    ← specNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hV hVh] at hb
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hb

name: NLAlib.sqrt_add_sq_frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_le_sqrt_add_sq_residual_div
proof:
:= headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
    let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
    let T := Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin k => singularValues (A + E) i)
    Real.sqrt (frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles U₁ Uhat₁) ^ 2 +
      frobNorm (sinePrincipalAngles V₁ Vhat₁) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (frobNorm (A * Vhat₁ - Uhat₁ * T) ^ 2 +
        frobNorm (Aᵀ * Uhat₁ - Vhat₁ * T) ^ 2) /
          (singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) - singularValues A k) := by
  dsimp only
  let U₁ := headColumns U (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  let V₁ := headColumns V (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  let Uhat₁ := headColumns Uhat (hk.trans (min_le_left m n))
  let Vhat₁ := headColumns Vhat (hk.trans (min_le_right m n))
  let t : Fin k → ℝ := fun i => singularValues (A + E) i
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hA.conjTranspose_mul_left _
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols V₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hA.conjTranspose_mul_right _
  have hUh : HasOrthonormalCols Uhat₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_left _
  have hVh : HasOrthonormalCols Vhat₁ := hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hhat.conjTranspose_mul_right _
  have ht : ∀ i : Fin k, singularValues (A + E) (k - 1) ≤ t i := by
    intro i
    exact singularValues_antitone (A + E) (by have hi := i.isLt; omega)
  have hh := sub_sq_mul_add_sq_frobNorm_le_add_sq_coupled_residual
    (singularValues_nonneg (A + E) (k - 1)) ht (hA.specNorm_sub_truncatedMatrix k).le hδ.le
    (projResidual U₁ Uhat₁) (projResidual V₁ Vhat₁)
  rw [hA.coupled_residual_headColumns_left, hA.coupled_residual_headColumns_right] at hh
  have hF := pow_le_pow_left₀ (frobNorm_nonneg _)
    (frobNorm_residual_le hU (A * Vhat₁ - Uhat₁ * Matrix.diagonal t)) 2
  have hG := pow_le_pow_left₀ (frobNorm_nonneg _)
    (frobNorm_residual_le hV (Aᵀ * Uhat₁ - Vhat₁ * Matrix.diagonal t)) 2
  have hb := hh.trans (add_le_add hF hG)
  rw [← frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hU hUh,
    ← frobNorm_sinePrincipalAngles_eq_residual hV hVh] at hb
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2
  apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [hb]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_diagonal_sub_of_ne
statement:
theorem isUnit_diagonal_sub_of_ne (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
  rw [Matrix.det_diagonal]
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i).symm

name: NLAlib.inv_mul_sub_smul_one_diagonal_eq
statement:
theorem inv_mul_sub_smul_one_diagonal_eq (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) (u : ℂ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ)))⁻¹ *
        (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) =
      -(Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * A) +
        u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let E : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hc (i : n) : ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i)
  have hneg (i : n) : ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ) = -((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hDE : D * (-E) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_neg]
    dsimp only [D, E]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    have hentry : (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) =
        fun _ => (-1 : ℂ) := by
      funext i
      rw [hneg, neg_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hc i)]
    rw [hentry, ← Matrix.diagonal_neg]
    simp
  have hinv : D⁻¹ = -E := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hDE
  change D⁻¹ * (A - u • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) = -(E * A) + u • E
  rw [hinv, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.neg_mul, smul_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.inversePencilUpperRootSum_eq_sum_ite_of_inverse_branches
statement:
theorem inversePencilUpperRootSum_eq_sum_ite_of_inverse_branches
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i)
    (branch : n → ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℂ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => branch i u))
    (hlabel : ∀ i, 0 < (branch i u).im ↔ b i < s) :
    inversePencilUpperRootSum A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))) u =
      ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : Matrix n n ℂ :=
    -(Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * A) +
      u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hmem : ∀ i, branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ M := fun i =>
    (mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff A b s hs u _).mpr (hspec i)
  unfold inversePencilUpperRootSum
  rw [inv_mul_sub_smul_one_diagonal_eq A b s hs u,
    Matrix.sum_filter_roots_charpoly_eq_sum_ite_of_injective_mem_spectrum M
      (fun i => branch i u) hinj hmem]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [hlabel i]

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_root_sum
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_root_sum
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {u | R < ‖u‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun u => branch i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ →
        (∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
          (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i u)) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → ∀ i, 0 < (branch i u).im ↔ b i < s) ∧
      (∀ i u, R < ‖u‖ → branch i (conj u) = conj (branch i u)) ∧
      ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im →
        inversePencilUpperRootSum A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))) u =
          ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, hlabel, href⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_im_pos_iff_conj_eq hA b hb s hs
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, hlabel, href, ?_⟩
  intro u hu him
  exact inversePencilUpperRootSum_eq_sum_ite_of_inverse_branches A b s hs branch u
    (hspec u hu).1 (hspec u hu).2 (hlabel u hu him)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_le_div_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_le_div_of_rank_eq {A B : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hr : A.rank=B.rank) (hsmall : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A) < 1) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B) ≤ specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)/
      (1-specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : A.rank=0
  · have hbz : B.rank=0 := hr ▸ hz
    rw [specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq A, if_pos hz,
      specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq B, if_pos hbz]
    simp
  have hbnz : B.rank ≠ 0 := fun h => hz (hr.trans h)
  let sa := singularValues A (A.rank-1)
  let sb := singularValues B (A.rank-1)
  have hsa : 0 < sa := by
    apply (singularValues_pos_iff A _).mpr
    omega
  have hsb : 0 < sb := by
    apply (singularValues_pos_iff B _).mpr
    omega
  have ha : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)=1/sa := by
    rw [specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq A, if_neg hz]
  have hb : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)=1/sb := by
    rw [specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq B, if_neg hbnz, ← hr]
  have hw : sa ≤ sb+specNorm (B-A) := by
    have hh := singularValues_le_singularValues_add_add_specNorm A (B-A) (A.rank-1)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel] at hh
  have haid : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*sa=1 := by rw [ha]; field_simp
  have hbid : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*sb=1 := by rw [hb]; field_simp
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw
    (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg (moorePenroseInverse A)) (specNorm_nonneg (moorePenroseInverse B)))
  have h1 := congrArg (fun v => specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B)*v) haid
  have h2 := congrArg (fun v => specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*v) hbid
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1-specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A)*specNorm (B-A))).2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanLin_euclideanJacobian
statement:
theorem toEuclideanLin_euclideanJacobian
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    (euclideanJacobian f x).toEuclideanLin = (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply _

name: NLAlib.euclideanJacobian_apply
statement:
theorem euclideanJacobian_apply
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (i : n) (j : m) :
    euclideanJacobian f x i j = (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) i
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.toLpLin (R := ℝ) 2 2).symm (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap i j = _
  simp [Matrix.toLpLin_eq_toLin,
    Matrix.toLin_symm, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, PiLp.basisFun_apply]

name: NLAlib.euclideanJacobian_apply_eq_deriv
statement:
theorem euclideanJacobian_apply_eq_deriv
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (i : n) (j : m) :
    euclideanJacobian f x i j =
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) i) 0
proof:
:= by
  let ev : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
      (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : n => ℝ)).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f y i) x := ev.differentiableAt.comp x hf
  have hF : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y i) x = ev.comp (fderiv ℝ f x) :=
    (ev.hasFDerivAt.comp x hf.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  rw [euclideanJacobian_apply]
  have h := hi.lineDeriv_eq_fderiv (v := EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
  rw [hF] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.specNorm_euclideanJacobian
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAbsCondition_eq_norm_of_hasFDerivAt hf.hasFDerivAt, specNorm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, toEuclideanLin_euclideanJacobian]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_componentRelativeMap
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_componentRelativeMap
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    HasFDerivAt (componentRelativeMap f x)
      ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap)
        (componentRelativeConditionMatrix f x)) 0
proof:
:= by
  let dx := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := m) (𝕜 := ℝ) (diagonal (fun j => x j))
  let dy := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) (diagonal (fun i => (f x i)⁻¹))
  have hin : HasFDerivAt (fun u => x + dx u) dx 0 := dx.hasFDerivAt.const_add x
  have hf₀ : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f x) (x + dx 0) := by
    simpa only [map_zero, add_zero] using hf.hasFDerivAt
  have h := dy.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 ((hf₀.comp 0 hin).sub_const (f x))
  have heq : dy.comp ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp dx) =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap)
        (componentRelativeConditionMatrix f x) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
    change dy.toLinearMap.comp ((fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap.comp dx.toLinearMap) =
      (componentRelativeConditionMatrix f x).toEuclideanLin
    change _ = Matrix.toLpLin 2 2
      (diagonal (fun i => (f x i)⁻¹) * euclideanJacobian f x * diagonal (fun j => x j))
    rw [Matrix.toLpLin_mul 2 2 2, Matrix.toLpLin_mul 2 2 2]
    rw [toEuclideanLin_euclideanJacobian]
    rfl
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.mapComponentRelativeCondition_eq_mapAbsCondition
statement:
theorem mapComponentRelativeCondition_eq_mapAbsCondition
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    mapComponentRelativeCondition f x = mapAbsCondition (componentRelativeMap f x) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAbsCondition_eq_norm_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_componentRelativeMap hf),
    mapComponentRelativeCondition, specNorm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]

name: NLAlib.componentRelativeConditionMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem componentRelativeConditionMatrix_apply
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (i : n) (j : m) :
    componentRelativeConditionMatrix f x i j =
      x j * (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) i / f x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [componentRelativeConditionMatrix, Matrix.mul_diagonal,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul, euclideanJacobian_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.mapComponentRelativeCondition_le_diagonal_scaling
statement:
theorem mapComponentRelativeCondition_le_diagonal_scaling
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ m → EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    mapComponentRelativeCondition f x ≤
      specNorm (diagonal (fun i => (f x i)⁻¹)) * mapAbsCondition f x *
        specNorm (diagonal (fun j => x j))
proof:
:= by
  unfold mapComponentRelativeCondition componentRelativeConditionMatrix
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (diagonal (fun i => (f x i)⁻¹) * euclideanJacobian f x) *
        specNorm (diagonal (fun j => x j)) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [← specNorm_euclideanJacobian hf]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanCLM_inv_apply_apply
statement:
theorem toEuclideanCLM_inv_apply_apply {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A⁻¹ (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) M x)
    (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA))
  simpa only [map_mul, map_one, mul_apply_eq_comp, one_apply_eq_self] using h

name: NLAlib.mapAbsCondition_toEuclideanCLM
statement:
theorem mapAbsCondition_toEuclideanCLM (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    mapAbsCondition (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A) x = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAbsCondition, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.mapNormRelativeCondition_toEuclideanCLM_le_conditionNumber
statement:
theorem mapNormRelativeCondition_toEuclideanCLM_le_conditionNumber
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    mapNormRelativeCondition (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A) x ≤
      (conditionNumber A).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hA]
  by_cases hx : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A x = 0
  · simp only [mapNormRelativeCondition, hx, norm_zero, div_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have hBound : ‖x‖ ≤ specNorm A⁻¹ *
      ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖x‖ = ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A⁻¹
          (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A x)‖ := by
        rw [toEuclideanCLM_inv_apply_apply hA]
      _ ≤ _ := norm_toEuclideanLin_apply_le A⁻¹ _
  rw [mapNormRelativeCondition, mapAbsCondition_toEuclideanCLM]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)).mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm A * (specNorm A⁻¹ *
        ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A x‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBound (specNorm_nonneg A)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_affine_branch_ratio
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z⁻¹) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv₀_cobounded
  have h' : Tendsto (fun z => (f z - z * d) * z⁻¹ + d)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 d) := by
    simpa using (h.mul hi).add_const d
  apply h'.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with z hz
  have hzne : z ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; norm_num [hzero] at hz
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_cobounded_of_affine_branch
statement:
private theorem tendsto_cobounded_of_affine_branch {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a d : ℂ}
    (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (h : Tendsto (fun z => f z - z * d) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 a)) :
    Tendsto f (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq := tendsto_affine_branch_ratio h
  have hfi : Tendsto (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh : Tendsto (fun z => (f z * z⁻¹)⁻¹ * z⁻¹)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using (hq.inv₀ hd).mul (tendsto_inv₀_cobounded (α := ℂ))
    apply hh.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with z hz
    have hzne : z ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; norm_num [hzero] at hz
    simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]
    calc
      z * (f z)⁻¹ * z⁻¹ = (f z)⁻¹ * (z * z⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = (f z)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hzne, mul_one]
  have hne : ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, (f z)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hq.eventually_ne hd] with z hz
    exact inv_ne_zero (by intro hf; exact hz (by simp [hf]))
  have hi := tendsto_inv₀_nhdsNE_zero.comp (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hfi, hne⟩)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, inv_inv] using hi

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) (u z : ℂ) :
    z ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (-(Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * A) +
          u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)) ↔
      u - (s : ℂ) * z ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let E : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hc : ∀ i, ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i)
  have hDE : D * E = 1 := by
    dsimp only [D, E]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simpa only [mul_inv_cancel₀ (hc _)] using (Matrix.diagonal_one :
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : n => (1 : ℂ))) = 1)
  have hD : IsUnit D := by
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det D).mpr
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.det_diagonal]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hc i))
  have heq : D * (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) z - (-(E * A) + u • E)) =
      -(algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (u - (s : ℂ) * z) -
        (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) := by
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_add, mul_neg, mul_smul_comm,
      ← mul_assoc, hDE, one_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      mul_one]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [D]
      ring
    · simp [D, hij]
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, spectrum.mem_iff]
  change (¬ IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) z - (-(E * A) + u • E))) ↔ _
  rw [← Units.isUnit_units_mul hD.unit, IsUnit.unit_spec, heq]
  rw [IsUnit.neg_iff]

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {u | R < ‖u‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun u => branch i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) ∧
      ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ →
        (∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
          (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i u)
proof:
:= by
  let E : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hd : Function.Injective (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hb
    have h := Complex.ofReal_injective (inv_injective hij)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_of_diagonal
      (fun i => ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) hd (-(E * A))
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨(hbranch i).1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, E, neg_mul, mul_neg,
      mul_comm]
      using (hbranch i).2
  · intro u hu
    exact ⟨fun i => (mem_spectrum_inverse_diagonal_pencil_iff A b s hs u _).mp
      ((hspec u hu).1 i), (hspec u hu).2⟩

name: NLAlib.eventually_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_eq
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i)
    {R S : ℝ} {forward inverse : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hforward : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => forward i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hforwardSpec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, forward i z ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => forward i z))
    (hinverse : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun u => inverse i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))))
    (hinverseSpec : ∀ u, S < ‖u‖ → ∀ i,
      u - (s : ℂ) * inverse i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - inverse i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) :
    ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      ∀ i, forward i (inverse i u) + (s : ℂ) * inverse i u = u
proof:
:= by
  have hc (i : n) : ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i)
  have hiratio (i : n) : Tendsto (fun u => inverse i u * u⁻¹)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)) := by
    exact tendsto_affine_branch_ratio (by simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hinverse i)
  have hicob (i : n) : Tendsto (inverse i) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) := by
    exact tendsto_cobounded_of_affine_branch (inv_ne_zero (hc i))
      (by simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hinverse i)
  have hneq : ∀ i j, ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      i ≠ j → u - (s : ℂ) * inverse i u ≠ forward j (inverse i u) := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ h => False.elim (h hij))
    have hres : Tendsto
        (fun u => (forward j (inverse i u) + (b j : ℂ) * inverse i u) * u⁻¹)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using ((hforward j).comp (hicob i)).mul
        (tendsto_inv₀_cobounded (α := ℂ))
    have hlim : Tendsto
        (fun u => (u - (s : ℂ) * inverse i u - forward j (inverse i u)) * u⁻¹)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)
        (𝓝 (1 + ((b j : ℂ) - (s : ℂ)) * ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)) := by
      have hh := ((hiratio i).const_mul ((b j : ℂ) - (s : ℂ))).const_add 1 |>.sub hres
      simp only [sub_zero] at hh
      apply hh.congr'
      filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with u hu
      have hune : u ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; norm_num [hzero] at hu
      field_simp
      ring
    have hlimne : 1 + ((b j : ℂ) - (s : ℂ)) * ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      have hne : (b j : ℂ) ≠ (b i : ℂ) := by
        intro heq'
        exact hij (hb (Complex.ofReal_injective heq'.symm))
      apply hne
      have hc' := hc i
      push_cast at heq hc'
      field_simp at heq
      linear_combination heq
    filter_upwards [hlim.eventually_ne hlimne] with u hu _ heq
    exact hu (by rw [sub_eq_zero.mpr heq, zero_mul])
  have hneq' : ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i j,
      i ≠ j → u - (s : ℂ) * inverse i u ≠ forward j (inverse i u) := by
    simpa only [Filter.eventually_all] using hneq
  have hlarge : ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i, R < ‖inverse i u‖ := by
    simp only [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro i
    exact ((tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := ℂ)).comp (hicob i)).eventually_gt_atTop R
  filter_upwards [hneq', hlarge,
    (tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := ℂ)).eventually_gt_atTop S] with u hne hR hS i
  have hmem := hinverseSpec u hS i
  have hspec := hforwardSpec (inverse i u) (hR i)
  rw [spectrum_eq_range_of_injective_mem_spectrum _ _ hspec.2 hspec.1] at hmem
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmem
  have hji : i = j := by
    by_contra hij
    exact hne i j hij hj.symm
  subst j
  linear_combination hj

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_hermiteSeriesOperator
statement:
theorem isHermitian_hermiteSeriesOperator (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (p : ℕ) :
    (hermiteSeriesOperator A p).IsHermitian
proof:
