name: NLAlib.hermiteSeriesOperator_eq_sum_kronecker
statement:
theorem hermiteSeriesOperator_eq_sum_kronecker
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (p : ℕ) :
    hermiteSeriesOperator A p =
      ∑ i, A i ⊗ₖ (hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteSeriesOperator, hermiteSeriesCreation, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, (hA _).eq, Matrix.kronecker_add,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: NLAlib.hermiteSeriesCreation_mul_interior
statement:
theorem hermiteSeriesCreation_mul_interior (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    hermiteSeriesCreation A p * ((1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ hermiteInterior p) =
      hermiteSeriesCreation A p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteSeriesCreation, Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one, hermiteCreation_mul_interior]

name: NLAlib.hermiteAnnihilatorStack_gram
statement:
theorem hermiteAnnihilatorStack_gram :
    (hermiteAnnihilatorStack (ι := ι) d p)ᴴ * hermiteAnnihilatorStack d p =
      (1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ hermiteNumber p
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rcases a with ⟨a₀, α⟩
  rcases b with ⟨b₀, β⟩
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hermiteAnnihilatorStack,
    Matrix.kronecker_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.one_apply]
  by_cases hab : a₀ = b₀
  · subst b₀
    simp only [apply_ite, map_mul, map_one, map_zero, star_star, ite_mul,
      mul_ite, one_mul, zero_mul, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    simp only [star_zero, ite_self, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ => M α β)
      (sum_hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose (ι := ι) (p := p))
    simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using hh
  · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab, apply_ite]

name: NLAlib.hermiteAnnihilatorStack_coefficientBlock
statement:
theorem hermiteAnnihilatorStack_coefficientBlock (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    (hermiteAnnihilatorStack (ι := ι) d p)ᴴ *
        (coefficientBlock A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ)) *
        hermiteAnnihilatorStack d p =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (A i * A j) ⊗ₖ (hermiteCreation p j * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rcases a with ⟨a₀, α⟩
  rcases b with ⟨b₀, β⟩
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hermiteAnnihilatorStack,
    coefficientBlock, Matrix.kronecker_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp only [map_mul, apply_ite, map_one, map_zero, star_star, star_zero,
    ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, zero_mul, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.sum_ite_eq,
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true, mul_one]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, ite_self]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  ring

name: NLAlib.hermiteSeriesCreation_gram_mul_interior
statement:
theorem hermiteSeriesCreation_gram_mul_interior
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (hermiteSeriesCreation A p)ᴴ * hermiteSeriesCreation A p *
        ((1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ hermiteInterior p) =
      (coefficientVariance A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ) +
        (hermiteAnnihilatorStack (ι := ι) d p)ᴴ *
          (coefficientBlock A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ)) *
          hermiteAnnihilatorStack d p) *
            ((1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ hermiteInterior p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteAnnihilatorStack_coefficientBlock]
  simp only [hermiteSeriesCreation, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker,
    (hA _).eq, Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.mul_sum, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  simp_rw [hermiteCreation_commutator, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.kronecker_add]
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  ext ⟨a, α⟩ ⟨b, β⟩
  simp [coefficientVariance, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.kronecker_apply,
    apply_ite, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.rectangularDilation_rowPair_affineCombination
statement:
theorem rectangularDilation_rowPair_affineCombination
    (A₀ Q : Matrix d d ℂ) (C : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (S : ι → A)
    (hS : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (S i)) :
    CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation
      (CStarMatrix.rowPair (CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C S)
        (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix Q))) =
      CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ
        (dilation (CStarMatrix.rowPair (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix Q)))
        (gramCoefficientDilation C) S
proof:
:= by
  have hstar (i : ι) : star (S i) = S i := (hS i).star_eq
  ext (a | (a | a)) (b | (b | b)) <;>
    simp [CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation, CStarMatrix.rowPair, CStarMatrix.affineCombination,
      CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom_apply, gramCoefficientDilation, gramCoefficientRow,
      dilation, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_add, star_sum,
      star_smul, hstar, ← algebraMap_star_comm]

name: NLAlib.positiveGramRow_scalar_shift_eq_rowPair
statement:
theorem positiveGramRow_scalar_shift_eq_rowPair
    (X : CStarMatrix d d A) (B : Matrix d d ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : specNorm B ≤ b) (δ : ℝ) :
    CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow X
        (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B)) b δ =
      CStarMatrix.rowPair X (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A)
        (CFC.sqrt (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B +
          algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix d d ℂ) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2))))
proof:
:= by
  let f := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (D := d) (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A)
  have hbn : ‖CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B‖ ≤ b := by
    simpa only [CStarMatrix.norm_ofMatrix_complex, ← specNorm_eq_norm] using hb
  have hsrc : IsSelfAdjoint (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) := by exact hB
  have hnonneg := CStarMatrix.nonneg_add_algebraMap_of_norm_le
    (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) hsrc (show ‖CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B‖ ≤ b + 4 * δ ^ 2 by nlinarith)
  have hmap := f.map_sqrt hnonneg
  have hreal : f (algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix d d ℂ) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)) =
      algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix d d A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2) :=
    (f.restrictScalars ℝ).commutes _
  rw [map_add f, hreal] at hmap
  unfold CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow
  rw [← hmap]

name: NLAlib.rectangularDilation_positiveGramRow_affineCombination
statement:
theorem rectangularDilation_positiveGramRow_affineCombination
    (A₀ B : Matrix d d ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (C : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (S : ι → A) (hS : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (S i))
    {b : ℝ} (hb : specNorm B ≤ b) (δ : ℝ) :
    CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow
      (CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C S)
      (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B)) b δ) =
      CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ
        (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm (CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation
          (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) b δ)))
        (gramCoefficientDilation C) S
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveGramRow_scalar_shift_eq_rowPair _ B hB hb δ]
  let Q : CStarMatrix d d ℂ := CFC.sqrt
    (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix d d ℂ) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2))
  have hQ : CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm Q) = Q :=
    CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.apply_symm_apply Q
  have h := rectangularDilation_rowPair_affineCombination A₀ (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm Q) C S hS
  rw [hQ] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.affineCombination_ofReal_eq_ofMatrix_real_series
statement:
theorem affineCombination_ofReal_eq_ofMatrix_real_series
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (C : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) =
      CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • C i)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [CStarMatrix.affineCombination, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
    RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.spectrum_real_ofMatrix_complex
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_ofMatrix_complex (T : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix T) = spectrum ℝ T
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq
    ((CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv (n := d) (A := ℂ)).toAlgEquiv.restrictScalars ℝ) T

name: NLAlib.spectrum_real_scalar_matrix_eq
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_scalar_matrix_eq (T : Matrix d d ℂ) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix T)) =
      spectrum ℝ T
proof:
:= by
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix T) := hT
  exact (hself.map_spectrum_real
    (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A))
    (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom_injective _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℂ A))).trans
      (spectrum_real_ofMatrix_complex T)

name: NLAlib.spectrum_shiftedGram_affineCombination_eq_of_zero_weak
statement:
theorem spectrum_shiftedGram_affineCombination_eq_of_zero_weak
    (A₀ B : Matrix d d ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (C : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hzero : bilinearSquareMass C Finset.univ = 0)
    (S : ι → A) :
    spectrum ℝ ((CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C S) *
        star (CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C S) +
        CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B)) =
      spectrum ℝ (A₀ * A₀ᴴ + B)
proof:
:= by
  have hC := (bilinearSquareMass_univ_eq_zero_iff C).mp hzero
  let f := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (D := d) (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ A)
  have hX : CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C S = f (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [CStarMatrix.affineCombination, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply, hC, f,
      Matrix.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero,
      CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom_apply, StarAlgHom.ofId_apply]
  rw [hX]
  change spectrum ℝ (f (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) * star (f (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀)) +
    f (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B)) = _
  rw [← map_star, ← map_mul, ← map_add]
  change spectrum ℝ (f (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (A₀ * A₀ᴴ + B))) = _
  exact spectrum_real_scalar_matrix_eq (A₀ * A₀ᴴ + B)
    ((Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose A₀).isHermitian.add hB)

name: NLAlib.det_symmetricBorder_eq_det_mul_schur
statement:
theorem det_symmetricBorder_eq_det_mul_schur (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hJ : IsUnit J) : (symmetricBorder J v d).det = J.det * (d - quadForm J⁻¹ v)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible J := hJ.invertible
  rw [symmetricBorder, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, schur_symmetricBorder]
  rw [Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.quadForm_single
statement:
theorem quadForm_single (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) (c : ℝ) :
    quadForm A (Pi.single i c) = c ^ 2 * A i i
proof:
:= by
  simp [quadForm, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.single_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.charpoly_symmetricBorder_single_last
statement:
theorem charpoly_symmetricBorder_single_last
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (b d : ℝ) :
    (symmetricBorder J (Pi.single (Fin.last q) b) d).charpoly =
      (X - C d) * J.charpoly - C (b ^ 2) * (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot J.charpoly_monic.ne_zero).infinite_compl.mono
  intro z hz
  have hz' : J.charpoly.eval z ≠ 0 := hz
  have hJ : IsUnit (z • 1 - J) := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    simpa only [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply, ← Matrix.diagonal_one,
      ← Matrix.diagonal_smul, Pi.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hz'
  have hshift : Matrix.scalar _ z - symmetricBorder J (Pi.single (Fin.last q) b) d =
      symmetricBorder (z • 1 - J) (-(Pi.single (Fin.last q) b)) (z - d) := by
    have hs : Matrix.scalar (Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) z = z • 1 := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [hs, smul_one_sub_symmetricBorder]
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C]
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, hshift, det_symmetricBorder_eq_det_mul_schur _ _ _ hJ]
  have hneg : (-(Pi.single (Fin.last q) b) : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) = Pi.single (Fin.last q) (-b) := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = Fin.last q <;> simp [hi]
  rw [hneg, quadForm_single, neg_sq, resolvent_last_last_eq_charpoly_leading_div_charpoly]
  have hdet : (z • 1 - J).det = J.charpoly.eval z := by
    rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  rw [hdet]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_hermiteInterior
statement: theorem isHermitian_hermiteInterior : (hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    simp [hermiteInterior, Matrix.diagonal_apply, apply_ite]
  · simp [hermiteInterior, Matrix.diagonal_apply, hab, Ne.symm hab]

name: NLAlib.hermiteInterior_mul_self
statement:
theorem hermiteInterior_mul_self :
    hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p * hermiteInterior p = hermiteInterior p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteInterior, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext a
  by_cases ha : a.degree < p <;> simp [ha]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_hermiteInterior
statement: theorem posSemidef_hermiteInterior : (hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
  intro a
  dsimp
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: NLAlib.hermiteInterior_le_one
statement:
theorem hermiteInterior_le_one :
    hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p ≤ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  have he : 1 - hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p =
      diagonal (fun a : HermiteIndex ι p => if a.degree < p then (0 : ℂ) else 1) := by
    ext a b
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b
      by_cases ha : a.degree < p <;> simp [hermiteInterior, Matrix.diagonal_apply, ha]
    · simp [hermiteInterior, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hab]
  rw [he]
  exact Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal (fun a => by dsimp; split_ifs <;> positivity)

name: NLAlib.hermiteInterior_number_le
statement:
theorem hermiteInterior_number_le :
    hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p * hermiteNumber p * hermiteInterior p ≤
      ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) • hermiteInterior p
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  have he : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) • hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p -
      hermiteInterior p * hermiteNumber p * hermiteInterior p =
      diagonal (fun a : HermiteIndex ι p => if a.degree < p then
        ((((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - a.degree : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0) := by
    ext a b
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b
      by_cases ha : a.degree < p
      · simp [hermiteInterior, hermiteNumber, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
          Matrix.diagonal_apply, ha, Complex.ofReal_sub, Algebra.smul_def,
          Matrix.natCast_apply]
      · simp [hermiteInterior, hermiteNumber, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
          Matrix.diagonal_apply, ha]
    · simp [hermiteInterior, hermiteNumber, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
        Matrix.diagonal_apply, hab]
  rw [he]
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
  intro a
  dsimp
  split_ifs with ha
  · exact_mod_cast (sub_nonneg.mpr
      (by exact_mod_cast (show a.degree ≤ p - 1 by omega)) :
      (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - a.degree)
  · exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_apply
statement:
theorem darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_apply {n : ℕ}
    (d e : ℕ → 𝕜) (i j : Fin n) :
    (darbouxLowerMatrix n e * diagonal (fun k : Fin n => d k.val) *
      (darbouxLowerMatrix n e)ᵀ) i j =
    if i.val = j.val then d i.val +
      (if i.val = 0 then 0 else e (i.val - 1) ^ 2 * d (i.val - 1))
    else if i.val + 1 = j.val then e i.val * d i.val
    else if j.val + 1 = i.val then e j.val * d j.val else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_apply]
  simp only [diagonal_mul, transpose_apply, darbouxLowerMatrix, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply]
  simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
  by_cases hij : i.val = j.val
  · have heq : i = j := Fin.ext hij
    subst j
    by_cases hi : i.val = 0
    · simp [hi]
    · have hp : 0 < i.val := by omega
      have hprev : i.val - 1 + 1 = i.val := by omega
      have hne : i.val ≠ i.val - 1 := by omega
      simp only [ite_true, dif_pos hp, if_neg hi,
        if_neg (show i.val + 1 ≠ i.val by omega), if_neg hne, if_pos hprev]
      ring
  · by_cases hsup : i.val + 1 = j.val
    · simp only [if_neg hij, if_neg (Ne.symm hij), if_pos hsup]
      by_cases hi : 0 < i.val
      · simp only [dif_pos hi, if_neg (show j.val ≠ i.val - 1 by omega),
          if_neg (show i.val - 1 + 1 ≠ j.val by omega)]
        ring
      · simp [hi, mul_comm]
    · by_cases hsub : j.val + 1 = i.val
      · have hi : 0 < i.val := by omega
        have hprev : i.val - 1 = j.val := by omega
        simp only [if_neg hij, if_neg (Ne.symm hij), if_neg hsup,
          if_pos hsub, dif_pos hi, hprev, ite_true,
          if_neg (show j.val + 1 ≠ j.val by omega)]
        ring
      · simp only [if_neg hij, if_neg (Ne.symm hij), if_neg hsup, if_neg hsub]
        by_cases hi : 0 < i.val
        · simp only [dif_pos hi, if_neg (show j.val ≠ i.val - 1 by omega),
            if_neg (show i.val - 1 + 1 ≠ j.val by omega)]
          ring
        · simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_sum_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_sum_conjTranspose_mul_self
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ ≤ specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq A Finset.univ
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : ι, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hi := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) v (WithLp.toLp 2 (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
      have heq : inner ℂ v (WithLp.toLp 2 (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)) =
          star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp) := by
        rw [← WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 v, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
      rw [heq] at hi
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
        (hi.trans (by simpa only [one_mul] using
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (norm_nonneg _))) 2
    _ ≤ _ := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sum_gram A Finset.univ w hw

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_le_sqrt_rectangular_variance_covariance
statement:
theorem sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_le_sqrt_rectangular_variance_covariance
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ))
        (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hV := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    ((bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_sum_conjTranspose_mul_self A).trans (le_max_right (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ))
      (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))))
  have hW := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientCovariance A)
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hV hW (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _), Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  simpa only [← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)] using hprod

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_gramCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem isHermitian_gramCoefficientDilation (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (i : ι) :
    (gramCoefficientDilation A i).IsHermitian
proof: := isHermitian_dilation _

name: NLAlib.coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    coefficientVariance (gramCoefficientDilation A) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ) 0 0
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i) 0 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext (a | (a | a)) (b | (b | b)) <;>
    simp [coefficientVariance, gramCoefficientDilation, gramCoefficientRow, dilation,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.sum_apply]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientVariance (gramCoefficientDilation A)) ≤
      max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ)) (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation]
  refine (specNorm_fromBlocks_diagonal_le _ _).trans (max_le (le_max_left _ _) ?_)
  refine (specNorm_fromBlocks_diagonal_le _ _).trans (max_le (le_max_right _ _) ?_)
  simpa only [specNorm_zero] using
    le_max_of_le_right (specNorm_nonneg (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))

name: NLAlib.coefficientVectorization_gram_gramCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem coefficientVectorization_gram_gramCoefficientDilation
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    (coefficientVectorization (gramCoefficientDilation A))ᴴ *
        coefficientVectorization (gramCoefficientDilation A) =
      (coefficientVectorization A)ᴴ * coefficientVectorization A +
        ((coefficientVectorization A)ᴴ * coefficientVectorization A).map star
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, coefficientVectorization,
    gramCoefficientDilation, gramCoefficientRow, dilation, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    Pi.zero_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, star_zero, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add,
    add_zero, star_star, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.map_apply, star_sum, star_mul]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · rfl
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gramCoefficientDilation A)) ≤
      2 * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gramCoefficientDilation A)) =
      specNorm ((coefficientVectorization (gramCoefficientDilation A))ᴴ *
        coefficientVectorization (gramCoefficientDilation A)) := by
    rw [coefficientCovariance, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self,
      ← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  have hA : specNorm ((coefficientVectorization A)ᴴ * coefficientVectorization A) =
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) := by
    rw [coefficientCovariance, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self,
      ← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  rw [hH, coefficientVectorization_gram_gramCoefficientDilation]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm ((coefficientVectorization A)ᴴ * coefficientVectorization A) +
        specNorm (((coefficientVectorization A)ᴴ * coefficientVectorization A).map star) :=
      specNorm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [specNorm_map_star, hA]; ring

name: NLAlib.sqrt_specNorm_coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_specNorm_coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance (gramCoefficientDilation A))) ≤
      Real.sqrt (max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ))
        (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i)))
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (specNorm_coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le A)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gramCoefficientDilation A))) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg _), mul_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg _)]
  have h := specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le A
  nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (coefficientCovariance A)]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_variance_covariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_variance_covariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance (gramCoefficientDilation A))) *
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gramCoefficientDilation A)))) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt
        (Real.sqrt (max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ))
          (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))) *
          Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hV := sqrt_specNorm_coefficientVariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le A
  have hW := sqrt_specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le A
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hV hW (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg (max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ))
      (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))))
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))]

name: NLAlib.adjugate_last_last_eq_det_leading
statement:
theorem adjugate_last_last_eq_det_leading (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) :
    J.adjugate (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q) = (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply, Matrix.det_succ_row _ (Fin.last q), sum_eq_single (Fin.last q)]
  · have hlead : (J.updateRow (Fin.last q) (Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1)).submatrix
        (Fin.last q).succAbove (Fin.last q).succAbove = J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc := by
      ext i j
      simp
    rw [hlead]
    simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self, Pi.single_eq_same, Fin.val_last, mul_one]
    rw [show q + q = 2 * q by omega, pow_mul]
    simp
  · intro j _ hj
    simp [hj]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.inv_last_last_eq_det_leading_div_det
statement:
theorem inv_last_last_eq_det_leading_div_det (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) :
    J⁻¹ (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q) = (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).det / J.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
    adjugate_last_last_eq_det_leading, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.resolvent_last_last_eq_charpoly_leading_div_charpoly
statement:
theorem resolvent_last_last_eq_charpoly_leading_div_charpoly
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (z : ℝ) :
    (z • 1 - J)⁻¹ (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q) =
      (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly.eval z / J.charpoly.eval z
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_last_last_eq_det_leading_div_det, Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have heq : (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) - J).submatrix
      Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc = z • 1 - J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [heq]
  have hscalar {d : ℕ} : Matrix.scalar (Fin d) z = z • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  rw [hscalar, hscalar]

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientVariance
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientVariance
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq A Finset.univ
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : ι, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hi := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) v (WithLp.toLp 2 (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
      have heq : inner ℂ v (WithLp.toLp 2 (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)) =
          star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp) := by
        rw [← WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 v, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
      rw [heq] at hi
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
        (hi.trans (by simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (norm_nonneg _))) 2
    _ ≤ specNorm (∑ i : ι, (A i)ᴴ * A i) :=
      sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sum_gram A Finset.univ w hw
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact congrArg (fun C => C * A i) (hA i).eq

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientCovariance
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientCovariance
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq A Finset.univ
  let U : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.vecMulVec w.ofLp (star v.ofLp)
  have htrace (i : ι) : (U * A i).trace = star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp) := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
    simp only [U, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm]
  have hF : frobSq U ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp only [U]
    rw [frobSq_vecMulVec_star, WithLp.toLp_ofLp, WithLp.toLp_ofLp]
    have hv' : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
    have hw' : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul hw' hv' (sq_nonneg ‖v‖) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ‖(U * A i).trace‖ ^ 2 := by simp only [htrace]
    _ ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) * frobSq U :=
      sum_norm_trace_mul_sq_le_coefficientCovariance_mul_frobSq A U
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF (specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientVariance_le_card_sq_mul_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientVariance_le_card_sq_mul_bilinearSquareMass
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (coefficientVariance A) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ 2 * bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (coefficientVariance A).PosSemidef := by
    change (∑ i, A i * A i).PosSemidef
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ fun i _ => by
      simpa only [(hA i).eq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (A i)
  let e (j : n) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := EuclideanSpace.single j 1
  have heval (j k : n) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
      star (e j).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (e k).ofLp) = B j k := by simp [e]
  have he (j k : n) : (∑ i : ι, ‖A i j k‖ ^ 2) ≤ bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ := by
    simpa only [heval] using sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
      (e j) (e k) (by simp [e]) (by simp [e])
  have htrace : (coefficientVariance A).trace.re =
      ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : n, ∑ k : n, ‖A i j k‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [coefficientVariance, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hsq : (A i * A i).trace.re = frobSq (A i) := by
      simpa only [(hA i).eq, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using
        (frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self (A i)).symm
    rw [hsq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  calc
    _ ≤ (coefficientVariance A).trace.re := hpos.specNorm_le_re_trace
    _ = ∑ j : n, ∑ k : n, ∑ i : ι, ‖A i j k‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [htrace, Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : n, ∑ _k : n, bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => he j k
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_le_sqrt_variance_covariance
statement:
theorem sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_le_sqrt_variance_covariance
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientVariance A hA)
  have hc := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientCovariance A)
  apply (Real.le_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr
  simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul hv hc (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_variance_le_card_mul_sqrt_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem sqrt_variance_le_card_mul_sqrt_bilinearSquareMass
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (specNorm_coefficientVariance_le_card_sq_mul_bilinearSquareMass A hA)
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg (Fintype.card n : ℝ)),
    Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card n))] using h

name: NLAlib.sqrt_variance_div_card_le_sqrt_covariance
statement:
theorem sqrt_variance_div_card_le_sqrt_covariance [Nonempty n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n)]
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) :=
      sqrt_variance_le_card_mul_sqrt_bilinearSquareMass A hA
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_le_specNorm_coefficientCovariance A)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.ClusterTree.mul_leafCount_le_size
statement:
theorem mul_leafCount_le_size (t : ClusterTree) (b : ℕ) (h : t.LeafSizeGE b) :
    b * t.leafCount ≤ t.size
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf n => simpa only [leafCount, size, mul_one, LeafSizeGE] using h
  | node l r hl hr =>
    simpa only [leafCount, size, Nat.mul_add] using Nat.add_le_add (hl h.1) (hr h.2)

name: NLAlib.ClusterTree.leafCount_pos
statement: theorem leafCount_pos (t : ClusterTree) : 0 < t.leafCount
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf n => exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  | node l r hl hr => exact Nat.add_pos_left hl _

name: NLAlib.ClusterTree.card_index
statement: @[simp] theorem card_index (t : ClusterTree) : Fintype.card t.Index = t.size
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf n => exact Fintype.card_fin n
  | node l r hl hr =>
    change Fintype.card (l.Index ⊕ r.Index) = l.size + r.size
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, hl, hr]

name: NLAlib.coefficientStack_conjTranspose_mul_identity_kronecker_apply
statement:
private theorem coefficientStack_conjTranspose_mul_identity_kronecker_apply
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (U : Matrix d d ℂ) (a : d) (ic : ι × d) :
    ((coefficientStack A)ᴴ*((1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⊗ₖU)) a ic =
      (A ic.1*U) a ic.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,coefficientStack,
    Matrix.one_apply,Fintype.sum_prod_type,(hA _).apply,apply_ite]

name: NLAlib.identity_kronecker_mul_coefficientStack_apply
statement:
private theorem identity_kronecker_mul_coefficientStack_apply
    (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ) (W : Matrix d d ℂ) (jc : κ × d) (b : d) :
    (((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ)⊗ₖW)*coefficientStack B) jc b =
      (W*B jc.1) jc.2 b
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply,coefficientStack,Matrix.one_apply,Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    ite_mul]

name: NLAlib.coefficientCrossingSum_eq_stack_compression
statement:
theorem coefficientCrossingSum_eq_stack_compression
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (U V W : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    coefficientCrossingSum A B U V W =
      ((coefficientStack A)ᴴ*((1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⊗ₖU))*
        coefficientCrossingBlock A B V*
          (((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ)⊗ₖW)*coefficientStack B)
proof:
:= by
  have hLmat : (coefficientStack A)ᴴ*((1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⊗ₖU) =
      (fun a ic => (A ic.1*U) a ic.2) := by
    funext a ic
    exact coefficientStack_conjTranspose_mul_identity_kronecker_apply A hA U a ic
  have hRmat : ((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ)⊗ₖW)*coefficientStack B =
      (fun jc b => (W*B jc.1) jc.2 b) := by
    funext jc b
    exact identity_kronecker_mul_coefficientStack_apply B W jc b
  rw [hLmat,hRmat]
  ext a b
  symm
  calc
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ y, ∑ i, ∑ x,
        (A i*U) a x*(B j*V*A i) x y*(W*B j) y b := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply,Fintype.sum_prod_type,coefficientCrossingBlock,
        Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ y, ∑ x,
        (A i*U) a x*(B j*V*A i) x y*(W*B j) y b := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, ∑ y, ∑ x,
            (A i*U) a x*(B j*V*A i) x y*(W*B j) y b := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          exact Finset.sum_comm
        _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [coefficientCrossingSum,Matrix.sum_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      calc
        _ = (((A i*U)*(B j*V*A i))*(W*B j)) a b := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply,Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCrossingSum_le_stack_vectorization
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCrossingSum_le_stack_vectorization
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (U V W : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCrossingSum A B U V W) ≤
      (specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*
        specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*specNorm (coefficientStack B))*
          (specNorm U*specNorm V*specNorm W)
proof:
:= by
  have hIι : specNorm (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) ≤ 1 := specNorm_one_le
  have hIκ : specNorm (1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ≤ 1 := specNorm_one_le
  have hL : specNorm ((coefficientStack A)ᴴ*((1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⊗ₖU)) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm U := by
    apply (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
    rw [specNorm_conjTranspose,specNorm_kronecker]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_of_le_one_left (specNorm_nonneg _) hIι) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have hR : specNorm (((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ)⊗ₖW)*coefficientStack B) ≤
      specNorm W*specNorm (coefficientStack B) := by
    apply (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
    rw [specNorm_kronecker]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_of_le_one_left (specNorm_nonneg _) hIκ) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  rw [coefficientCrossingSum_eq_stack_compression A B hA U V W]
  calc
    _ ≤ (specNorm ((coefficientStack A)ᴴ*((1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⊗ₖU))*
        specNorm (coefficientCrossingBlock A B V))*
          specNorm (((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ)⊗ₖW)*coefficientStack B) :=
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ ((specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm U)*
        (specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*specNorm V*
          specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)))*
        (specNorm W*specNorm (coefficientStack B)) := by
      have hmid := mul_le_mul hL
        (specNorm_coefficientCrossingBlock_le A B hA V)
        (specNorm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      exact mul_le_mul hmid hR (specNorm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
          (mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientStack_eq_sqrt_variance
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientStack_eq_sqrt_variance
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (coefficientStack A) = Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficientStack_gram A hA,← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Real.sqrt_sq (specNorm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCrossingSum_le_variance_covariance
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCrossingSum_le_variance_covariance
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hB : ∀ j, (B j).IsHermitian)
    (U V W : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCrossingSum A B U V W) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance B))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance B)))*
          (specNorm U*specNorm V*specNorm W)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [specNorm_coefficientStack_eq_sqrt_variance A hA,
    specNorm_coefficientStack_eq_sqrt_variance B hB,
    specNorm_coefficientVectorization_eq_sqrt_covariance] using
      specNorm_coefficientCrossingSum_le_stack_vectorization A B hA U V W

name: NLAlib.profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq
statement:
theorem profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq (k : ℕ) :
    profileCutoff k = profilePreviousCutoff k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold profileCutoff profilePreviousCutoff
  rw [← pow_mul]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.profilePreviousCutoff_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem profilePreviousCutoff_succ (k : ℕ) :
    profilePreviousCutoff (k + 1) = profileCutoff k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.profileCutoff_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem profileCutoff_succ (k : ℕ) :
    profileCutoff (k + 1) = profileCutoff k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq, profilePreviousCutoff_succ]

name: NLAlib.two_le_profilePreviousCutoff
statement: theorem two_le_profilePreviousCutoff (k : ℕ) : 2 ≤ profilePreviousCutoff k
proof:
:= by
  exact (show 2 ^ 1 ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ k) from
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.one_le_pow k 2 (by decide)))

name: NLAlib.four_le_profileCutoff
statement: theorem four_le_profileCutoff (k : ℕ) : 4 ≤ profileCutoff k
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq]
  nlinarith [two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k]

name: NLAlib.profilePreviousCutoff_le
statement: theorem profilePreviousCutoff_le (k : ℕ) : profilePreviousCutoff k ≤ profileCutoff k
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq]
  nlinarith [two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k]

name: NLAlib.monotone_profilePreviousCutoff
statement: theorem monotone_profilePreviousCutoff : Monotone profilePreviousCutoff
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hij)

name: NLAlib.strictMono_profileCutoff
statement: theorem strictMono_profileCutoff : StrictMono profileCutoff
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro k
  rw [profileCutoff_succ]
  nlinarith [four_le_profileCutoff k]

name: NLAlib.monotone_profileCutoff
statement: theorem monotone_profileCutoff : Monotone profileCutoff
proof: := strictMono_profileCutoff.monotone

name: NLAlib.monotone_profileNeighborCutoff
statement: theorem monotone_profileNeighborCutoff : Monotone profileNeighborCutoff
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact Nat.add_le_add (monotone_profileCutoff hij)
    (Nat.mul_le_mul (monotone_profileCutoff hij) (monotone_profilePreviousCutoff hij))

name: NLAlib.profileCutoff_le_neighborCutoff
statement:
theorem profileCutoff_le_neighborCutoff (k : ℕ) :
    profileCutoff k ≤ profileNeighborCutoff k
proof: := Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: NLAlib.profileNeighborCutoff_add_previous_succ_le
statement:
theorem profileNeighborCutoff_add_previous_succ_le (k : ℕ) :
    profileNeighborCutoff k + profilePreviousCutoff (k + 1) ≤ profileCutoff (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : profilePreviousCutoff k + 2 ≤ profileCutoff k := by
    rw [profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq]
    nlinarith [two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k]
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (profileCutoff k) hbase
  rw [profilePreviousCutoff_succ, profileCutoff_succ, profileNeighborCutoff]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.profileNeighborCutoff_lt_cutoff_succ
statement:
theorem profileNeighborCutoff_lt_cutoff_succ (k : ℕ) :
    profileNeighborCutoff k < profileCutoff (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := profileNeighborCutoff_add_previous_succ_le k
  have hp := two_le_profilePreviousCutoff (k + 1)
  omega

name: NLAlib.le_profileCutoff
statement: theorem le_profileCutoff (k : ℕ) : k ≤ profileCutoff k
proof: := strictMono_profileCutoff.le_apply

name: NLAlib.exists_le_profileCutoff
statement: theorem exists_le_profileCutoff (b : ℕ) : ∃ k, b ≤ profileCutoff k
proof: := ⟨b, le_profileCutoff b⟩

name: NLAlib.log_profileCutoff
statement:
theorem log_profileCutoff (k : ℕ) :
    Real.log (profileCutoff k : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [profileCutoff, Real.log_pow]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos
statement:
theorem sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
  exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) (two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k)

name: NLAlib.inv_sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos
statement:
theorem inv_sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < (Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  inv_pos.mpr (sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos k)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_profileCutoff_eq_previous
statement:
theorem sqrt_profileCutoff_eq_previous (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (profileCutoff k : ℝ) = (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileCutoff_eq_previous_sq, Nat.cast_pow, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupLeftRegularRepresentation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteGroupLeftRegularRepresentation_apply (h : G) (f : G → ℂ) (g : G) :
    finiteGroupLeftRegularRepresentation h f g = f (h⁻¹ * g)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_apply [Fintype G]
    (h : G) (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ G) (g : G) :
    finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation h f g = f (h⁻¹ * g)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.kronecker_le_kronecker_right
statement:
theorem kronecker_le_kronecker_right {A B : Matrix m m 𝕜} {C : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hAB : A ≤ B) (hC : C.PosSemidef) : A ⊗ₖ C ≤ B ⊗ₖ C
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  have he : B ⊗ₖ C - A ⊗ₖ C = (B - A) ⊗ₖ C := by
    ext a b
    simp [Matrix.kronecker_apply, sub_mul]
  rw [he]
  exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB).kronecker hC

name: Matrix.kronecker_le_kronecker_left
statement:
theorem kronecker_le_kronecker_left {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} {C : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hAB : A ≤ B) (hC : C.PosSemidef) : C ⊗ₖ A ≤ C ⊗ₖ B
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  have he : C ⊗ₖ B - C ⊗ₖ A = C ⊗ₖ (B - A) := by
    ext a b
    simp [Matrix.kronecker_apply, mul_sub]
  rw [he]
  exact hC.kronecker (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB)

name: Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_le_conjTranspose_mul
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_conjTranspose_mul {A B : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hAB : A ≤ B) (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) : Cᴴ * A * C ≤ Cᴴ * B * C
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  rw [← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub]
  exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same C

name: Matrix.real_smul_le_real_smul
statement:
theorem real_smul_le_real_smul {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hAB : A ≤ B)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : r • A ≤ r • B
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  rw [← smul_sub]
  exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB).smul hr

name: NLAlib.det_smul_one_sub_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_smul_one_sub_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) - A.map Complex.ofRealHom).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : Matrix.scalar ι z = z • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, h]
  rw [← he, ← Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_map, hA.charpoly_eq,
    Polynomial.map_prod, eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C,
    eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
  apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
  intro h
  exact hz (by simpa only [Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe, Complex.ofReal_im] using congrArg Complex.im h)

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) -
      (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹ 0 0 =
        jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ a) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ β) z (m + 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing a β with
  | zero => rw [map_jacobiMatrix, inv_apply_zero_zero, det_fin_one]; simp [jacobiFraction, jacobiMatrix]
  | succ m ih =>
    let a' := fun i => a (i + 1)
    let β' := fun i => β (i + 1)
    have hd1 := det_smul_one_sub_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (isHermitian_jacobiMatrix a' β' (m + 1)) hz
    have ih' := ih a' β'
    rw [map_jacobiMatrix, inv_apply_zero_zero,
      submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix] at ih'
    rw [map_jacobiMatrix, inv_apply_zero_zero,
      submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix, det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix,
      jacobiFraction, jacobiFraction_succ]
    change _ = 1 / (z - Complex.ofRealHom (a 0) - Complex.ofRealHom (β 1) ^ 2 *
      jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ a') (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ β') z (m + 1) 0)
    rw [← ih']
    rw [map_jacobiMatrix] at hd1
    simp only [a', β', Function.comp_def] at *
    field_simp [hd1]

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero_eq_det_ratio
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero_eq_det_ratio
    (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) -
      (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹ 0 0 =
      (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) -
        (jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m).map Complex.ofRealHom).det /
      (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) -
        (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_apply_zero_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [map_jacobiMatrix, submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix, map_jacobiMatrix]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.jacobiFraction_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem jacobiFraction_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ a) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ β) z (m + 1) 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero a β m hz,
    inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero_eq_det_ratio]
  exact div_ne_zero
    (det_smul_one_sub_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
      (isHermitian_jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m) hz)
    (det_smul_one_sub_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (isHermitian_jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)) hz)

name: NLAlib.jacobiFraction_step_denominator_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem jacobiFraction_step_denominator_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    z - Complex.ofRealHom (a 0) - Complex.ofRealHom (β 1) ^ 2 *
      jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ a) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ β) z m 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ne_zero_of_one_div_ne_zero
  simpa only [jacobiFraction, Function.comp_apply, Nat.zero_add] using
    jacobiFraction_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero a β m hz

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_trace_mul_sq_le_coefficientCovariance_mul_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_trace_mul_sq_le_coefficientCovariance_mul_frobSq
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (U : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∑ i, ‖(U*A i).trace‖^2) ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)*frobSq U
proof:
:= by
  let V : Matrix (n×n) ι ℂ := coefficientVectorization A
  let P : Matrix Unit (n×n) ℂ := fun _ ab => U ab.2 ab.1
  have he (i : ι) : (P*V) () i=(U*A i).trace := by
    change (∑ ab : n×n, U ab.2 ab.1*A i ab.1 ab.2)=_
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  have hp : frobSq P=frobSq U := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq P,frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq U]
    simp only [P,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_unique]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  have hprod : frobSq (P*V)=∑ i, ‖(U*A i).trace‖^2 := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,Fintype.sum_unique,he]
  have hv : specNorm V^2=specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) :=
    (specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self V).symm
  have hh := frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq P V
  rw [hprod,hp,hv,mul_comm] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.schur_symmetricBorder
statement:
theorem schur_symmetricBorder (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) :
    (of (fun _ _ => d) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) -
      (of (fun _ j => v j) : Matrix (Fin 1) n ℝ) * J⁻¹ *
        (of (fun i _ => v i) : Matrix n (Fin 1) ℝ) =
      of (fun _ _ => d - quadForm J⁻¹ v)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_apply, of_apply, quadForm,
    dotProduct, mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_symmetricBorder
statement:
theorem isHermitian_symmetricBorder {J : Matrix n n ℝ} (hJ : J.IsHermitian)
    (v : n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) : (symmetricBorder J v d).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  apply hJ.fromBlocks
  · ext i j
    simp only [conjTranspose_apply, of_apply, star_trivial]
  · ext i j
    simp only [conjTranspose_apply, of_apply, star_trivial]

name: NLAlib.symmetricBorder_sub_smul_one
statement:
theorem symmetricBorder_sub_smul_one (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (d z : ℝ) :
    symmetricBorder J v d - z • 1 = symmetricBorder (J - z • 1) v (d - z)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) (j | j)
  · simp [symmetricBorder, Matrix.one_apply]
  · simp [symmetricBorder]
  · simp [symmetricBorder]
  · simp [symmetricBorder, Subsingleton.elim i j]

name: NLAlib.smul_one_sub_symmetricBorder
statement:
theorem smul_one_sub_symmetricBorder (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (d z : ℝ) :
    z • 1 - symmetricBorder J v d = symmetricBorder (z • 1 - J) (-v) (z - d)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) (j | j)
  · simp [symmetricBorder, Matrix.one_apply]
  · simp [symmetricBorder]
  · simp [symmetricBorder]
  · simp [symmetricBorder, Subsingleton.elim i j]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_symmetricBorder_iff
statement:
theorem posSemidef_symmetricBorder_iff {J : Matrix n n ℝ} (hJ : J.PosDef)
    (v : n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) :
    (symmetricBorder J v d).PosSemidef ↔ quadForm J⁻¹ v ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible J := hJ.isUnit.invertible
  have h := Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ (of (fun i _ => v i) : Matrix n (Fin 1) ℝ)
    (of (fun _ _ => d) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) hJ
  have hv : (of (fun i _ => v i) : Matrix n (Fin 1) ℝ)ᴴ = of (fun _ j => v j) := by
    ext i j
    simp
  rw [hv, schur_symmetricBorder] at h
  change (symmetricBorder J v d).PosSemidef ↔ _ at h
  rw [h]
  have heq : (of (fun _ _ => d - quadForm J⁻¹ v) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) =
      diagonal (fun _ => d - quadForm J⁻¹ v) := by
    ext i j
    simp [Subsingleton.elim i j]
  rw [heq, posSemidef_diagonal_iff]
  simp only [sub_nonneg]
  exact ⟨fun h => h 0, fun h _ => h⟩

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_and_det_eq_zero_symmetricBorder_of_schur_zero
statement:
theorem posSemidef_and_det_eq_zero_symmetricBorder_of_schur_zero
    {J : Matrix n n ℝ} (hJ : J.PosDef) (v : n → ℝ) :
    (symmetricBorder J v (quadForm J⁻¹ v)).PosSemidef ∧
      (symmetricBorder J v (quadForm J⁻¹ v)).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(posSemidef_symmetricBorder_iff hJ v _).mpr le_rfl, ?_⟩
  let : Invertible J := hJ.isUnit.invertible
  rw [symmetricBorder, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁, invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, schur_symmetricBorder]
  simp

name: NLAlib.inner_finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation
statement:
theorem inner_finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation (h : G)
    (f k : EuclideanSpace ℂ G) :
    ⟪finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation h f,
      finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation h k⟫ = ⟪f, k⟫
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_apply]
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft h⁻¹) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_coefficient
statement:
theorem finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_coefficient
    (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ)) (h : G) (p : P) (a b : D p) :
    finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation h (finiteGroupCoefficient ρ ⟨p, a, b⟩) =
      ∑ c : D p, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p h) c b •
        finiteGroupCoefficient ρ ⟨p, a, c⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_apply, finiteGroupCoefficient,
    PiLp.toLp_apply, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    _root_.mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, map_mul, LinearMap.toMatrix'_mul, Matrix.mul_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => mul_comm _ _)

name: NLAlib.intertwiningMap_mem_finiteGroupCoefficientSpan
statement:
theorem intertwiningMap_mem_finiteGroupCoefficientSpan
    (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ)) (p : P)
    (f : IntertwiningMap (ρ p) (finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation (G := G)))
    (v : D p → ℂ) : f v ∈ finiteGroupCoefficientSpan ρ
proof:
:= by
  let F : (D p → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ) :=
    (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (G → ℂ)).toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap
  have he (g : G) : f v g = F (ρ p g⁻¹ v) 1 := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℂ G => w 1)
      (Representation.IntertwiningMap.isIntertwining (ρ p)
        finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation f g⁻¹ v)
    simpa [F] using hh.symm
  have hsum : f v = ∑ a : D p, ∑ b : D p,
      (LinearMap.toMatrix' F 1 a * v b) • finiteGroupCoefficient ρ ⟨p, a, b⟩ := by
    ext g
    rw [he, ← LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec F]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, ← LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec (ρ p g⁻¹),
      finiteGroupCoefficient, PiLp.toLp_apply, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
      WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun a _ => Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun b _ =>
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨p, a, b⟩, rfl⟩)))

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupCoefficientSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem finiteGroupCoefficientSpan_eq_top
    (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ)) (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) :
    finiteGroupCoefficientSpan ρ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.orthogonal_eq_bot_iff.mp
  by_contra horth
  let S := finiteGroupCoefficientOrthogonalSubrepresentation ρ
  have hS : S ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hh
    exact horth (congrArg Subrepresentation.toSubmodule hh)
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hT⟩ := Subrepresentation.exists_irreducible_le S hS
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hcomplete T.toSubmodule T.toRepresentation hT
  let f : IntertwiningMap (ρ p) finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation :=
    T.subtype.comp e.toIntertwiningMap
  have hTM : T.toSubmodule ≤ finiteGroupCoefficientSpan ρ := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := e.toLinearEquiv.surjective ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hh := intertwiningMap_mem_finiteGroupCoefficientSpan ρ p f v
    have hfv : f v = w := congrArg (fun x : T.toSubmodule =>
      (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ G)) hv
    exact hfv ▸ hh
  have hzero : T.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
    apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
    intro w hw
    have hm := hTM hw
    have ho := hTS hw
    have hz : ⟪w, w⟫ = (0 : ℂ) := ho w hm
    exact (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hz)
  have hTbot : T = ⊥ := Subrepresentation.toSubmodule_injective hzero
  exact ((Subrepresentation.isIrreducible_toRepresentation_iff T).mp hT).ne_bot hTbot

name: NLAlib.coefficientCrossingBlock_eq_covariance_compression
statement:
theorem coefficientCrossingBlock_eq_covariance_compression
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (V : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    coefficientCrossingBlock A B V =
      (coefficientCovarianceLift A)ᴴ *
        (((1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ Vᵀ) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)) *
          coefficientCovarianceSwap.permMatrix ℂ * coefficientCovarianceLift B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_mul]
  ext ia jb
  simp [coefficientCrossingBlock,coefficientCovarianceLift,coefficientVectorization,
    Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply,Fintype.sum_prod_type,coefficientCovarianceSwap,
    apply_ite,ite_mul,(hA _).apply,mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCovarianceLift_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCovarianceLift_le (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCovarianceLift A)≤specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientCovarianceLift,specNorm_kronecker]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (specNorm_nonneg _) specNorm_one_le

name: NLAlib.specNorm_kronecker_one_transpose_one_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_kronecker_one_transpose_one_le (V : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (((1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ Vᵀ) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))≤specNorm V
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_kronecker,specNorm_kronecker,specNorm_transpose]
  calc
    _ ≤ (1*specNorm V)*1 := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right specNorm_one_le (specNorm_nonneg V))
      specNorm_one_le (specNorm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg zero_le_one (specNorm_nonneg V))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCrossingBlock_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCrossingBlock_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (V : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCrossingBlock A B V)≤
      specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*specNorm V*specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)
proof:
:= by
  let LA := coefficientCovarianceLift A
  let LB := coefficientCovarianceLift B
  let T := (((1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ Vᵀ) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d ℂ))
  let P := (coefficientCovarianceSwap (d := d)).permMatrix ℂ
  have hLA : specNorm LA≤specNorm (coefficientVectorization A) :=
    specNorm_coefficientCovarianceLift_le A
  have hLB : specNorm LB≤specNorm (coefficientVectorization B) :=
    specNorm_coefficientCovarianceLift_le B
  have hT : specNorm T≤specNorm V := specNorm_kronecker_one_transpose_one_le V
  have hP : specNorm P≤1 := Matrix.permMatrix_l2_opNorm_le _
  rw [coefficientCrossingBlock_eq_covariance_compression A B hA V]
  change specNorm (LAᴴ*T*P*LB)≤_
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (LAᴴ*T*P)*specNorm LB := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((specNorm LAᴴ*specNorm T)*specNorm P)*specNorm LB := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        ((specNorm_mul_le (LAᴴ*T) P).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le LAᴴ T) (specNorm_nonneg P)))
        (specNorm_nonneg LB)
    _ ≤ ((specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*specNorm V)*1)*
        specNorm (coefficientVectorization B) := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      have hbase := mul_le_mul hLA hT (specNorm_nonneg T)
        (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientVectorization A))
      have hmid := mul_le_mul hbase hP (specNorm_nonneg P)
        (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientVectorization A)) (specNorm_nonneg V))
      exact mul_le_mul hmid hLB (specNorm_nonneg LB)
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientVectorization A)) (specNorm_nonneg V))
          zero_le_one)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientVectorization_eq_sqrt_covariance
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientVectorization_eq_sqrt_covariance
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)=Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.hilbertMatrix_eq_cauchyMatrix
statement:
theorem hilbertMatrix_eq_cauchyMatrix (n : ℕ) :
    hilbertMatrix n = cauchyMatrix (fun i : Fin n => (i.val : ℝ) + 1)
      (fun j : Fin n => (j.val : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  dsimp [hilbertMatrix, cauchyMatrix]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.pivotSchur_cauchyMatrix
statement:
private theorem pivotSchur_cauchyMatrix {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    pivotSchur (cauchyMatrix x y) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => (x i.succ - x 0) / (x i.succ + y 0)) *
        cauchyMatrix (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ) (fun j : Fin n => y j.succ) *
          Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => (y j.succ - y 0) / (x 0 + y j.succ))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [pivotSchur_apply, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
    cauchyMatrix, one_div, inv_inv]
  field_simp [hDen i.succ j.succ, hDen i.succ 0, hDen 0 j.succ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_succ
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_succ {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det = 1 / (x 0 + y 0) *
      (∏ i : Fin n, (x i.succ - x 0) / (x i.succ + y 0)) *
      (∏ j : Fin n, (y j.succ - y 0) / (x 0 + y j.succ)) *
      (cauchyMatrix (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ) (fun j : Fin n => y j.succ)).det
proof:
:= by
  have hPivot : cauchyMatrix x y 0 0 ≠ 0 := one_div_ne_zero (hDen 0 0)
  rw [det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur _ hPivot, pivotSchur_cauchyMatrix x y hDen,
    Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  dsimp [cauchyMatrix]
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_vandermonde_succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_vandermonde, Matrix.det_vandermonde, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.Ioi_zero_eq_map, Finset.prod_map, Fin.coe_succEmb, Fin.prod_Ioi_succ]

name: NLAlib.prod_denominators_succ
statement:
private theorem prod_denominators_succ (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin (n + 1), ∏ j : Fin (n + 1), (x i + y j)) =
      (x 0 + y 0) * (∏ i : Fin n, (x i.succ + y 0)) *
        (∏ j : Fin n, (x 0 + y j.succ)) *
          (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j : Fin n, (x i.succ + y j.succ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det = (Matrix.vandermonde x).det * (Matrix.vandermonde y).det /
      (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j : Fin n, (x i + y j))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hTail := ih (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ) (fun j : Fin n => y j.succ)
      (fun i j => hDen i.succ j.succ)
    rw [det_cauchyMatrix_succ x y hDen, hTail,
      det_vandermonde_succ n x, det_vandermonde_succ n y,
      prod_denominators_succ n x y, Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
    have hRow : (∏ i : Fin n, (x i.succ + y 0)) ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hDen i.succ 0)
    have hCol : (∏ j : Fin n, (x 0 + y j.succ)) ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => hDen 0 j.succ)
    have hDiag : (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j : Fin n, (x i.succ + y j.succ)) ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        (fun j _ => hDen i.succ j.succ))
    field_simp [hRow, hCol, hDiag, hDen 0 0]

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_eq_prod_differences
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_eq_prod_differences {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det =
      (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (x j - x i)) *
        (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (y j - y i)) /
          (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j : Fin n, (x i + y j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde x y hDen, Matrix.det_vandermonde, Matrix.det_vandermonde]

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_pos_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_pos_of_strictMono {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y) (hDen : ∀ i j, 0 < x i + y j) :
    0 < (cauchyMatrix x y).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_cauchyMatrix_eq_prod_differences x y (fun i j => (hDen i j).ne')]
  apply div_pos
  · apply mul_pos <;> apply Finset.prod_pos
    · intro i _
      exact Finset.prod_pos (fun j hj => sub_pos.mpr (hx (Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj)))
    · intro i _
      exact Finset.prod_pos (fun j hj => sub_pos.mpr (hy (Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj)))
  · exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => hDen i j))

name: NLAlib.det_hilbertMatrix_pos
statement: theorem det_hilbertMatrix_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < (hilbertMatrix n).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [hilbertMatrix_eq_cauchyMatrix]
  apply det_cauchyMatrix_pos_of_strictMono
  · intro i j hij
    have h : (i.val : ℝ) < j.val := by exact_mod_cast hij
    linarith
  · intro i j hij
    change (i.val : ℝ) < (j.val : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show i.val < j.val from hij)
  · intro i j
    positivity

name: NLAlib.displacementRank_le_iff_exists_generators
statement:
theorem displacementRank_le_iff_exists_generators {K m n : Type*} [RCLike K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) (X : Matrix m n K) (r : ℕ) :
    displacementRank A B X ≤ r ↔
      ∃ (M : Matrix m (Fin r) K) (N : Matrix n (Fin r) K), A * X - X * B = M * Nᴴ
proof:
:=
  rank_le_iff_exists_mul_conjTranspose (A * X - X * B) r

name: NLAlib.normalizedPartialTrace_apply_eq_trace
statement:

    (T : Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ) (a b : d) :
    normalizedPartialTrace T a b = (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹*
      (((Matrix.single b a 1 : Matrix d d ℂ)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))*T).trace
proof:

name: NLAlib.normalizedPartialTrace_kronecker_one
statement:
theorem normalizedPartialTrace_kronecker_one [Nonempty n] (Q : Matrix d d ℂ) :

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_normalizedPartialTrace
statement:

proof:

name: NLAlib.frobSq_single_kronecker_one
statement:
theorem frobSq_single_kronecker_one (a b : d) :
    frobSq ((Matrix.single a b 1 : Matrix d d ℂ)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))=
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
    Matrix.single_apply,Matrix.one_apply,ite_and,apply_ite]
  have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun x : d×n => a=x.1)=
      Finset.univ.image (fun r : n => (a,r)) := by
    ext x
    simp [Prod.ext_iff,eq_comm]
  rw [he,Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun u v h => congrArg Prod.snd h)]
  exact Finset.card_univ

name: NLAlib.normalizedPartialTraceCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedPartialTraceCLM_apply (T : Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ) :
    normalizedPartialTraceCLM T=normalizedPartialTrace T
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.specNorm_normalizedPartialTrace_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_normalizedPartialTrace_le (T : Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ) :
    specNorm (normalizedPartialTrace T)≤specNorm T
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn|hn
  · let := hn
    have he : normalizedPartialTrace T=0 := by ext a b; simp [normalizedPartialTrace]
    rw [he,specNorm_zero]
    exact specNorm_nonneg _
  · let := hn
    have hN : (Fintype.card n : ℝ)≠0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
    have he : normalizedPartialTrace T=(Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ •
        ∑ r : n, T.submatrix (fun a : d => (a,r)) (fun b : d => (b,r)) := by
      ext a b
      simp [normalizedPartialTrace,Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply]
    rw [he,specNorm_eq_norm,norm_smul,norm_inv,Complex.norm_natCast]
    calc
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹*∑ r : n,
          ‖T.submatrix (fun a : d => (a,r)) (fun b : d => (b,r))‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹*∑ _ : n, specNorm T := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro r _
        rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
        exact specNorm_submatrix_le T _ _
          (fun a b h => congrArg Prod.fst h) (fun a b h => congrArg Prod.fst h)
      _ = _ := by simp [hN]
