name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_of_hessenberg_intertwines
proof:
:= by
  have hcolumns : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), j.val = k → ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), j < i → W i j = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro j hj i hij
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · have hj0 : j = 0 := Fin.ext (by simpa only [Fin.val_zero, hk0] using hj)
        subst j
        have h := congrFun hcol i
        change W i 0 = (1 : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i 0 at h
        rw [h, Matrix.one_apply_ne (by intro hi; subst i; exact lt_irrefl _ hij)]
      · let p : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
        have hkn : k - 1 < k := by omega
        have hleft : (∑ a, G i a * W a p) = 0 := by
          apply sum_eq_zero
          intro a ha
          by_cases hak : a.val < k
          · rw [hG i a (by have := hij; omega), zero_mul]
          · rw [ih (k - 1) hkn p rfl a (by dsimp [p]; exact Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega)), mul_zero]
        have hright : (∑ a, W i a * H a p) = W i j * H j p := by
          apply sum_eq_single j
          · intro a ha haj
            by_cases hak : a.val < k
            · rw [ih a.val hak a rfl i (by have := hij; exact Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega)), zero_mul]
            · rw [hH.1 a p (by
                have hne : a.val ≠ j.val := fun h => haj (Fin.ext h)
                dsimp [p]
                omega), mul_zero]
          · simp
        have h := congrFun (congrFun hcomm i) p
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, hleft, hright] at h
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_right (hH.2 j p (by dsimp [p]; omega))
  intro i j hij
  exact hcolumns j.val j rfl i hij

name: NLAlib.exists_diagonal_sign_of_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_sign_of_isUpperTriangular {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [LinearOrder n]
    {W : Matrix n n ℝ} (hU : W.IsUpperTriangular) (hOrth : HasOrthonormalCols W) :
    ∃ d : n → ℝ, (∀ i, d i = 1 ∨ d i = -1) ∧ W = Matrix.diagonal d
proof:
:= by
  have hOrthEq : Wᵀ * W = 1 := hOrth
  have hOther : W * Wᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hOrthEq
  have hTranspose : Wᵀ.IsUpperTriangular := by
    have h := isUpperTriangular_inv hU
    rwa [Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hOther] at h
  have hdiag := eq_diagonal_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular
    (isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.mp hTranspose) hU
  refine ⟨fun i => W i i, ?_, hdiag⟩
  intro i
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hOrthEq i) i
  rw [hdiag, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal] at h
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h
  rcases le_or_gt (W i i) 0 with hnonpos | hpos
  · right
    nlinarith
  · left
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.dft_circulant_mulVec
statement:
theorem dft_circulant_mulVec (c x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ZMod.dft (Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x) = fun j => ZMod.dft c j * ZMod.dft x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fourierMatrix_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, fourierMatrix_mul_circulant,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, fourierMatrix_mulVec]
  exact funext (Matrix.mulVec_diagonal _ _)

name: NLAlib.circulant_mulVec_eq_invDFT
statement:
theorem circulant_mulVec_eq_invDFT (c x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x = ZMod.dft.symm (fun j => ZMod.dft c j * ZMod.dft x j)
proof:
:= by
  apply ZMod.dft.injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, dft_circulant_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.fourierCirculantSolve_eq_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec
statement:
theorem fourierCirculantSolve_eq_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec (c b : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierCirculantSolve c b = moorePenroseInverse (Matrix.circulant c) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_circulant, circulant_mulVec_eq_invDFT,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.fourierUnitary_mulVec
statement:
theorem fourierUnitary_mulVec (x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x = (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ • ZMod.dft x
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierUnitary, Matrix.smul_mulVec, fourierMatrix_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec
statement:
theorem norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec (x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x)‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖
proof:
:= by
  exact (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).toLinearIsometry.norm_map
    (WithLp.toLp 2 x)

name: NLAlib.fourierUnitary_circulant_mulVec
statement:
theorem fourierUnitary_circulant_mulVec (c x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierUnitary n *ᵥ (Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x) =
      fun j => ZMod.dft c j * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierUnitary_mulVec, dft_circulant_mulVec, fourierUnitary_mulVec]
  funext j
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.fourierUnitary_fourierCirculantSolve
statement:
theorem fourierUnitary_fourierCirculantSolve (c b : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierUnitary n *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b =
      fun j => (ZMod.dft c j)⁻¹ * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fourierCirculantSolve, fourierUnitary_mulVec, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  funext j
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.fourierCirculantSolve_residual_coordinates
statement:
theorem fourierCirculantSolve_residual_coordinates (c b : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierUnitary n *ᵥ (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b) =
      fun j => if ZMod.dft c j = 0 then (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, fourierUnitary_circulant_mulVec,
    fourierUnitary_fourierCirculantSolve]
  funext j
  by_cases hj : ZMod.dft c j = 0 <;> simp [hj]

name: NLAlib.fourierCirculantSolve_residual_sq
statement:
theorem fourierCirculantSolve_residual_sq (c b : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ j with ZMod.dft c j = 0, ‖(fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec, fourierCirculantSolve_residual_coordinates,
    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [apply_ite norm, norm_zero, ite_pow, zero_pow two_ne_zero,
    Finset.sum_filter]

name: NLAlib.fourierCirculantSolve_leastSquares
statement:
theorem fourierCirculantSolve_leastSquares (c b x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b)‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x)‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [fourierCirculantSolve_residual_sq, ← norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_sub, fourierUnitary_circulant_mulVec, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : ZMod.dft c j = 0
  · simp [hj]
  · simp only [hj, if_false]
    exact sq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.exists_circulant_mulVec_eq_iff
statement:
theorem exists_circulant_mulVec_eq_iff (c b : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    (∃ x, Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x = b) ↔
      ∀ j, ZMod.dft c j = 0 → ZMod.dft b j = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ j hj
    have h := congrFun (dft_circulant_mulVec c x) j
    simpa only [hx, hj, zero_mul] using h
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fourierCirculantSolve c b, ZMod.dft.injective ?_⟩
    rw [dft_circulant_mulVec]
    simp only [fourierCirculantSolve, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : ZMod.dft c j = 0 <;> simp [hj, h j]

name: NLAlib.circulant_residual_sq_eq_optimal_add
statement:
theorem circulant_residual_sq_eq_optimal_add (c b x : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b)‖ ^ 2 +
      ∑ j with ZMod.dft c j ≠ 0,
        ‖(fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j - ZMod.dft c j * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierCirculantSolve_residual_sq, ← norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_sub, fourierUnitary_circulant_mulVec, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : ZMod.dft c j = 0 <;> simp [hj]

name: NLAlib.circulant_fit_modes_of_residual_le_optimal
statement:
theorem circulant_fit_modes_of_residual_le_optimal (c b x : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b)‖) :
    ∀ j, ZMod.dft c j ≠ 0 →
      (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j = (ZMod.dft c j)⁻¹ * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j
proof:
:= by
  have he := circulant_residual_sq_eq_optimal_add c b x
  have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr hx
  have hs : (∑ j with ZMod.dft c j ≠ 0,
      ‖(fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j - ZMod.dft c j * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j‖ ^ 2) ≤ 0 := by
    linarith
  intro j hj
  have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum
    (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ZMod.dft c j ≠ 0))
    (f := fun j => ‖(fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j - ZMod.dft c j * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j‖ ^ 2)
    (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ j, hj⟩)
  have hn : ‖(fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j - ZMod.dft c j * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j‖ = 0 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((fourierUnitary n *ᵥ b) j -
      ZMod.dft c j * (fourierUnitary n *ᵥ x) j)]
  have hz := sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)
  rw [hz, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hj, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.fourierCirculantSolve_minimum_norm
statement:
theorem fourierCirculantSolve_minimum_norm (c b x : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (hx : ∀ y : ZMod n → ℂ,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ y)‖) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fourierCirculantSolve c b)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖
proof:
:= by
  have hfit := circulant_fit_modes_of_residual_le_optimal c b x (hx _)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [← norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec (fourierCirculantSolve c b),
    ← norm_fourierUnitary_mulVec x, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, fourierUnitary_fourierCirculantSolve]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : ZMod.dft c j = 0
  · simp [hj]
  · rw [PiLp.toLp_apply, PiLp.toLp_apply, hfit j hj]

name: NLAlib.circulant_mulVec_eq_iff_fourierCirculantSolve
statement:
theorem circulant_mulVec_eq_iff_fourierCirculantSolve (c b x : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ j, ZMod.dft c j ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ x = b ↔ x = fourierCirculantSolve c b
proof:
:= by
  have hsolve : Matrix.circulant c *ᵥ fourierCirculantSolve c b = b := by
    apply ZMod.dft.injective
    rw [dft_circulant_mulVec]
    simp only [fourierCirculantSolve, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    funext j
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hc j), one_mul]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit ((isUnit_circulant_iff_dft_ne_zero c).mpr hc)
      (hx.trans hsolve.symm)
  · rintro rfl
    exact hsolve

name: NLAlib.pivotSchur_jacobiMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [pivotSchur_apply, jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.val_zero,
    Fin.val_succ, jacobiSchurDiagonal]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> try omega
  all_goals simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  all_goals ring

name: NLAlib.jacobiLDLPivot_succ
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [jacobiLDLPivot, jacobiSchurDiagonal]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [jacobiLDLPivot, jacobiSchurDiagonal,
      show k + 1 ≠ 0 by omega, if_false, ← ih]

name: NLAlib.jacobiLDLPivot_pos_of_posDef
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a b k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    have ha : 0 < a 0 := by simpa [jacobiMatrix] using hJ.diag_pos (i := 0)
    have hS := ((posDef_iff_pivotSchur hJ.isHermitian).mp hJ).2
    rw [pivotSchur_jacobiMatrix] at hS
    cases k with
    | zero => exact ha
    | succ k => rw [jacobiLDLPivot_succ]; exact ih hS (by omega)

name: NLAlib.jacobiMatrix_eq_ldl_of_posDef
statement:
theorem jacobiMatrix_eq_ldl_of_posDef {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hJ : (jacobiMatrix a b n).PosDef) :
    jacobiMatrix a b n = jacobiLDLLower a b n *
      diagonal (fun i : Fin n => jacobiLDLPivot a b i.val) *
      (jacobiLDLLower a b n)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [jacobiLDLLower, darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_apply]
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  split_ifs with hij hi0 hijs hjis
  · simp [hi0, jacobiLDLPivot]
  · have hp := (jacobiLDLPivot_pos_of_posDef hJ (show i.val - 1 < n by omega)).ne'
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi0
    have hkp : jacobiLDLPivot a b k ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [hk, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hp
    simp only [hk, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, jacobiLDLPivot]
    field_simp
    ring
  · have hp := (jacobiLDLPivot_pos_of_posDef hJ i.isLt).ne'
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp, hijs]
  · have hp := (jacobiLDLPivot_pos_of_posDef hJ j.isLt).ne'
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp, hjis]
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.fourierMatrix_mulVec
statement: theorem fourierMatrix_mulVec (x : ZMod n → ℂ) : fourierMatrix n *ᵥ x = ZMod.dft x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [fourierMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, ZMod.dft_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.star_stdAddChar
statement: theorem star_stdAddChar (i : ZMod n) : star (ZMod.stdAddChar i) = ZMod.stdAddChar (-i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ZMod.toCircle (N := n)).map_neg_eq_inv i
  simpa only [ZMod.stdAddChar_apply, Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj, Complex.star_def] using
    congrArg (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) h.symm

name: NLAlib.sum_stdAddChar_mul
statement:
theorem sum_stdAddChar_mul (a : ZMod n) :
    (∑ i : ZMod n, ZMod.stdAddChar (a * i)) = if a = 0 then (n : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with ha
  · simp [ha, ZMod.card]
  · exact AddChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one (ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar n ha)

name: NLAlib.fourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem fourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose :
    fourierMatrix n * (fourierMatrix n)ᴴ = (n : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (ZMod n) (ZMod n) ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, fourierMatrix,
    star_stdAddChar, neg_neg, ← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
  have he (k : ZMod n) : -(k * i) + k * j = (j - i) * k := by ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [sum_stdAddChar_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
    sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.fourierUnitary_mem_unitaryGroup
statement: theorem fourierUnitary_mem_unitaryGroup : fourierUnitary n ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (ZMod n) ℂ
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mpr
  change fourierUnitary n * (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ = 1
  have he : (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = n := by
    exact_mod_cast Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  rw [fourierUnitary, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    fourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  simp only [star_inv₀, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hc : ((Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) * n = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_inv, ← pow_two, he, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast NeZero.ne n)]
  rw [hc, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.fourierMatrix_mul_circulant
statement:
theorem fourierMatrix_mul_circulant (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierMatrix n * Matrix.circulant c = Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c) * fourierMatrix n
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, fourierMatrix, Matrix.circulant_apply,
    ZMod.dft_apply, smul_eq_mul, sum_mul]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight j) _ _ ?_
  intro k
  simp only [Equiv.subRight_apply]
  calc
    _ = (ZMod.stdAddChar (-((k - j) * i)) * ZMod.stdAddChar (-(j * i))) * c (k - j) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.fourierUnitary_mul_circulant_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem fourierUnitary_mul_circulant_mul_conjTranspose (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    fourierUnitary n * Matrix.circulant c * (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ = Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : fourierUnitary n * (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp (fourierUnitary_mem_unitaryGroup (n := n))
  have hcomm : fourierUnitary n * Matrix.circulant c =
      Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c) * fourierUnitary n := by
    simp only [fourierUnitary, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, fourierMatrix_mul_circulant]
  rw [hcomm, Matrix.mul_assoc, hu, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols
statement: theorem fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols : HasOrthonormalCols (fourierUnitary n)
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mp (fourierUnitary_mem_unitaryGroup (n := n))

name: NLAlib.circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    Matrix.circulant c = (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c) * fourierUnitary n
proof:
:= by
  have h := fourierUnitary_mul_circulant_mul_conjTranspose c
  have hu := fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)
  calc
    Matrix.circulant c = (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ *
        (fourierUnitary n * Matrix.circulant c * (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ) * fourierUnitary n := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ (fourierUnitary n),
        hu.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [h]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_circulant_eq_norm_dft
statement:
theorem specNorm_circulant_eq_norm_dft (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.circulant c) = ‖ZMod.dft c‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal]
  have hr := specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols
      (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).conjTranspose
      ((fourierUnitary n)ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c))
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hr
  rw [hr,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
      (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).conjTranspose,
    specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_circulant_iff_dft_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_circulant_iff_dft_ne_zero (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.circulant c) ↔ ∀ i, ZMod.dft c i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu := (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).isUnit
  have hut := (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).conjTranspose.isUnit
  constructor
  · intro hc i
    have hd : IsUnit (Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c)) := by
      rw [← fourierUnitary_mul_circulant_mul_conjTranspose]
      exact (hu.mul hc).mul hut
    exact ((Matrix.isUnit_diagonal.mp hd).apply i).ne_zero
  · intro hc
    rw [circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal]
    exact (hut.mul (Matrix.isUnit_diagonal.mpr (Pi.isUnit_iff.mpr
      (fun i => isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hc i))))).mul hu

name: NLAlib.isMoorePenroseInverse_diagonal_reciprocal
statement:
theorem isMoorePenroseInverse_diagonal_reciprocal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℂ) : IsMoorePenroseInverse (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hi : d i = 0 <;> simp [hi]
  · simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hi : d i = 0 <;> simp [hi]
  · simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hi : d i = 0 <;> simp [hi]
  · simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hi : d i = 0 <;> simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_circulant_eq_fourier
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_circulant_eq_fourier (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    moorePenroseInverse (Matrix.circulant c) = (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ZMod.dft c i)⁻¹) * fourierUnitary n
proof:
:= by
  have hu := (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).conjTranspose
  have h := (isMoorePenroseInverse_diagonal_reciprocal (ZMod.dft c)).unitary_transform
    (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ (fourierUnitary n)ᴴ hu hu
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at h
  rw [← circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal] at h
  exact (isMoorePenroseInverse (Matrix.circulant c)).unique h

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_circulant
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_circulant (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    moorePenroseInverse (Matrix.circulant c) =
      Matrix.circulant (ZMod.dft.symm (fun i => (ZMod.dft c i)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_circulant_eq_fourier,
    circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_circulant_of_dft_ne_zero
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_circulant_of_dft_ne_zero (c : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ i, ZMod.dft c i ≠ 0) :
    conditionNumber (Matrix.circulant c) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖ZMod.dft c‖ * ‖fun i => (ZMod.dft c i)⁻¹‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hC := (isUnit_circulant_iff_dft_ne_zero c).mpr hc
  rw [conditionNumber_of_isUnit hC, ← moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit _ hC,
    moorePenroseInverse_circulant, specNorm_circulant_eq_norm_dft,
    specNorm_circulant_eq_norm_dft, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: NLAlib.multiset_singularValues_circulant
statement:
theorem multiset_singularValues_circulant (c : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card (ZMod n)))).val.map
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (ZMod n)) => singularValues (Matrix.circulant c) (i : ℕ)) =
    (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod n)).val.map (fun i => ‖ZMod.dft c i‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : singularValues (Matrix.circulant c) =
      singularValues (Matrix.diagonal (ZMod.dft c)) := by
    rw [circulant_eq_fourierUnitary_conjTranspose_mul_diagonal,
      singularValues_mul_unitary _ (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)),
      singularValues_isometry_mul (fourierUnitary_hasOrthonormalCols (n := n)).conjTranspose]
  rw [hs]
  exact multiset_singularValues_diagonal_complex _

name: NLAlib.coefficientCovariance_eq_sum_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem coefficientCovariance_eq_sum_vecMulVec (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    coefficientCovariance A = ∑ i,
      vecMulVec (fun ab : d × d => A i ab.1 ab.2)
        (star (fun ab : d × d => A i ab.1 ab.2))
proof:
:= by
  ext ab ce
  simp [coefficientCovariance, coefficientVectorization, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_coefficientBlock
statement:
theorem isHermitian_coefficientBlock (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (coefficientBlock A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
  intro ic je
  have he : (A ic.1 * A je.1)ᴴ = A je.1 * A ic.1 := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hA ic.1).eq, (hA je.1).eq]
  exact congrFun (congrFun he ic.2) je.2

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlock_diag_nonneg
statement:
theorem coefficientBlock_diag_nonneg (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ic : ι × d) : 0 ≤ coefficientBlock A ic ic
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (A ic.1 * A ic.1).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [(hA ic.1).eq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (A ic.1)
  exact hp.diag_nonneg

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_nonneg
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_nonneg [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    0 ≤ lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isHermitian_coefficientBlock A hA).lambdaMax_nonneg_of_trace_re_nonneg
  rw [Matrix.trace, Complex.re_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun ic _ =>
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (coefficientBlock_diag_nonneg A hA ic)).1

name: NLAlib.coefficientStack_gram
statement:
theorem coefficientStack_gram (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (coefficientStack A)ᴴ * coefficientStack A = coefficientVariance A
proof:
:= by
  ext c e
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, coefficientStack,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, coefficientVariance, Matrix.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [(hA i).apply]

name: NLAlib.rank_clusterOffRow_eq_cut
statement:
theorem rank_clusterOffRow_eq_cut {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (A : Matrix N N K) (e : I ↪ N) :
    (clusterOffRow A e).rank = (A.toBlock (fun j => j ∈ Set.range e) (fun j => j ∉ Set.range e)).rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : I ≃ {j // j ∈ Set.range e} := Equiv.ofInjective e e.injective
  let J := (clusterOffRow A e).submatrix f.symm id
  have hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range J.col) =
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (A.toBlock (fun j => j ∈ Set.range e) (fun j => j ∉ Set.range e)).col) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
      by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range e
      · have hz : J.col j = 0 := by ext i; simp [J, clusterOffRow, hj]
        rw [hz]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · have hc : J.col j = (A.toBlock (fun j => j ∈ Set.range e) (fun j => j ∉ Set.range e)).col ⟨j,hj⟩ := by
          ext i
          have hi : e (f.symm i) = i.val := congrArg Subtype.val (f.apply_symm_apply i)
          simp [J, clusterOffRow, hj, Matrix.toBlock, Matrix.col, hi]
        rw [hc]
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨j,hj⟩,rfl⟩
    · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
      have hc : (A.toBlock (fun j => j ∈ Set.range e) (fun j => j ∉ Set.range e)).col j = J.col j.val := by
        ext i
        have hi : e (f.symm i) = i.val := congrArg Subtype.val (f.apply_symm_apply i)
        simp [J, clusterOffRow, j.property, Matrix.toBlock, Matrix.col, hi]
      rw [hc]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j.val,rfl⟩
  calc
    _ = J.rank := (Matrix.rank_submatrix _ f.symm (Equiv.refl _)).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols, Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols, hspan]

name: NLAlib.HasHSSCutRanks.here
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf _ => simpa only [HasHSSCutRanks] using h
  | node _ _ => exact ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩

name: NLAlib.HasHSSCutRanks.inv
proof:
:= by
  have hrow {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (M : Matrix N N K)
      (hM : IsUnit M.det) (f : I ↪ N) : (clusterOffRow M⁻¹ f).rank = (clusterOffRow M f).rank := by
    classical
    rw [rank_clusterOffRow_eq_cut, rank_clusterOffRow_eq_cut]
    exact rank_inverse_toBlock_complement_eq M hM (fun j => j ∈ Set.range f)
  induction t with
  | leaf _ =>
    exact ⟨(hrow A hA e).trans_le h.1, by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, hrow Aᴴ (by simpa [Matrix.det_conjTranspose] using hA.star) e]
      exact h.2⟩
  | node l r hl hr =>
    exact ⟨(hrow A hA e).trans_le h.1, by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, hrow Aᴴ (by simpa [Matrix.det_conjTranspose] using hA.star) e]
      exact h.2.1, hl h.2.2.1, hr h.2.2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.profileNeighborCutoff_le_blockStart
statement:
theorem profileNeighborCutoff_le_blockStart {t u : ℕ} (htu : t + 2 ≤ u) :
    profileNeighborCutoff t ≤ profileBlockStart u
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | zero => omega
  | succ u =>
      exact (profileNeighborCutoff_lt_cutoff_succ t).le.trans
        (monotone_profileCutoff (by omega))

name: NLAlib.not_inProfileBlock_of_same_parity
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne htu with h | h
  · have hgap : t + 2 ≤ u := by omega
    have hsep := profileNeighborCutoff_le_blockStart hgap
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsep.trans hu.1)) hi.2
  · have hgap : u + 2 ≤ t := by omega
    have hsep := profileNeighborCutoff_le_blockStart hgap
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsep.trans hi.1)) hu.2

name: NLAlib.le_dim_of_inProfileBlock

name: NLAlib.profileFirstMask_iff_exists_fin
statement:
theorem profileFirstMask_iff_exists_fin {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :
    ProfileFirstMask i.val j.val ↔ ∃ t : Fin (n + 1),
      t.val % 2 = 0 ∧ InProfileBlock t i.val ∧ InProfileBlock t j.val
proof:
:= by

  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hi, hj⟩
    exact ⟨⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_dim_of_inProfileBlock i.isLt hi)⟩, ht, hi, hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hi, hj⟩

theorem profileOddBlockMask_iff_exists_fin {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.profileFirstPart_add_secondPart_add_remainderPart
proof:
:= by
