name: NLAlib.isSymm_profile_parts
statement:
theorem isSymm_profile_parts {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) :
    (profileFirstPart A).IsSymm ∧ (profileSecondPart A).IsSymm ∧
      (profileRemainderPart A).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  have h (i j) : A j i = A i j := congrFun (congrFun hA i) j
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> ext i j
  · simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, profileFirstPart, h i j]
    rw [profileFirstMask_comm j.val i.val]
  · simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, profileSecondPart, h i j]
    rw [profileSecondMask_comm j.val i.val]
  · simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, profileRemainderPart, h i j]
    rw [profileRemainderMask_comm j.val i.val]

name: NLAlib.mul_cyclicShiftMatrix_apply
statement:
private theorem mul_cyclicShiftMatrix_apply {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (A * cyclicShiftMatrix n) i j = A i (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (j + 1)]
  · simp [cyclicShiftMatrix, Matrix.circulant_apply]
  · intro k _ hkj
    have h : (1 : Fin n) ≠ k - j := by
      intro hk
      apply hkj
      have h' := sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hk.symm
      simpa only [add_comm] using h'
    simp [cyclicShiftMatrix, Matrix.circulant_apply, h]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.cyclicShiftMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
private theorem cyclicShiftMatrix_mul_apply {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (cyclicShiftMatrix n * A) i j = A (i - 1) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (i - 1)]
  · simp [cyclicShiftMatrix, Matrix.circulant_apply]
  · intro k _ hki
    have h : (1 : Fin n) ≠ i - k := by
      intro hk
      apply hki
      have h' : k = i - 1 := by rw [hk]; abel
      exact h'
    simp [cyclicShiftMatrix, Matrix.circulant_apply, h]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.eq_circulant_of_commute_cyclicShift
statement:
theorem eq_circulant_of_commute_cyclicShift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A * cyclicShiftMatrix n = cyclicShiftMatrix n * A) :
    A = Matrix.circulant (fun i => A i 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hStep (i j : Fin n) : A i (j + 1) = A (i - 1) j := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i j) hA
    simpa only [mul_cyclicShiftMatrix_apply, cyclicShiftMatrix_mul_apply] using h
  have hNat (j : ℕ) : ∀ i : Fin n, A i (j : Fin n) = A (i - (j : Fin n)) 0 := by
    induction j with
    | zero => intro i; simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro i
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, hStep, ih]
      congr 1
      abel
  ext i j
  have h := hNat j.val i
  simpa only [Fin.cast_val_eq_self, Matrix.circulant_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.commute_cyclicShift_iff_exists_circulant
statement:
theorem commute_cyclicShift_iff_exists_circulant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    A * cyclicShiftMatrix n = cyclicShiftMatrix n * A ↔
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, A = Matrix.circulant v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨_, eq_circulant_of_commute_cyclicShift A h⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact Matrix.circulant_mul_comm v _

name: NLAlib.exists_toeplitzMatrix_eq_circulant
statement:
theorem exists_toeplitzMatrix_eq_circulant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∃ t : ℤ → ℝ, toeplitzMatrix t = Matrix.circulant v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t : ℤ → ℝ := fun d => if h : ∃ i j : Fin n, (j.val : ℤ) - (i.val : ℤ) = d then
    v (h.choose - h.choose_spec.choose) else 0
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  have h : ∃ a b : Fin n, (b.val : ℤ) - (a.val : ℤ) = (j.val : ℤ) - (i.val : ℤ) :=
    ⟨i, j, rfl⟩
  change (if h : ∃ a b : Fin n, (b.val : ℤ) - (a.val : ℤ) = (j.val : ℤ) - (i.val : ℤ) then
    v (h.choose - h.choose_spec.choose) else 0) = v (i - j)
  rw [dif_pos h]
  apply congrArg v
  have hDiff := h.choose_spec.choose_spec
  have hSum : h.choose.val + j.val = i.val + h.choose_spec.choose.val := by omega
  have hG := congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (k : Fin n)) hSum
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Fin.cast_val_eq_self] at hG
  exact sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.mpr hG

name: NLAlib.exists_toeplitz_circulant_of_empty
statement:
theorem exists_toeplitz_circulant_of_empty (A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) ℝ) :
    (∃ t : ℤ → ℝ, A = toeplitzMatrix t) ∧
      (∃ v : Fin 0 → ℝ, A = Matrix.circulant v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0, ?_⟩, ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩ <;> ext i <;> exact i.elim0

name: NLAlib.exists_circulant_iff_toeplitz_and_commute
statement:
theorem exists_circulant_iff_toeplitz_and_commute {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, A = Matrix.circulant v) ↔
      (∃ t : ℤ → ℝ, A = toeplitzMatrix t) ∧
        A * cyclicShiftMatrix n = cyclicShiftMatrix n * A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_toeplitzMatrix_eq_circulant v
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht.symm⟩, Matrix.circulant_mul_comm v _⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, hComm⟩
    exact (commute_cyclicShift_iff_exists_circulant A).mp hComm

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde_fintype
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde_fintype {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (x y : n → ℝ) (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det =
      (Matrix.vandermonde (x ∘ (Fintype.equivFin n).symm)).det *
        (Matrix.vandermonde (y ∘ (Fintype.equivFin n).symm)).det /
          (∏ i : n, ∏ j : n, (x i + y j))
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  have hF := det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde (x ∘ e.symm) (y ∘ e.symm)
    (fun i j => hDen (e.symm i) (e.symm j))
  have hMatrix : cauchyMatrix (x ∘ e.symm) (y ∘ e.symm) = (cauchyMatrix x y).reindex e e := rfl
  rw [hMatrix, Matrix.det_reindex_self] at hF
  have hProd : (∏ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), ∏ j : Fin (Fintype.card n),
      (x (e.symm i) + y (e.symm j))) = ∏ i : n, ∏ j : n, (x i + y j) := by
    rw [e.symm.prod_comp (fun i : n => ∏ j : Fin (Fintype.card n), (x i + y (e.symm j)))]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => e.symm.prod_comp (fun j : n => x i + y j))
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hProd] using hF

name: NLAlib.shifted_mul_sylvesterADIHalf
statement:
theorem shifted_mul_sylvesterADIHalf (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C Y : Matrix m n K) (β : K) (hβ : IsUnit (A - β • 1).det) :
    (A - β • 1) * sylvesterADIHalf A B C Y β = Y * (B - β • 1) + C
proof:
:= by
  simp [sylvesterADIHalf, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hβ]

name: NLAlib.sylvesterADIStep_mul_shifted
statement:
theorem sylvesterADIStep_mul_shifted (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C Y : Matrix m n K) (α β : K) (hα : IsUnit (B - α • 1).det) :
    sylvesterADIStep A B C Y α β * (B - α • 1) =
      (A - α • 1) * sylvesterADIHalf A B C Y β - C
proof:
:= by
  simp [sylvesterADIStep, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hα]

name: NLAlib.shifted_inv_mul_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  have h : A - α • (1 : Matrix m m K) = (A - β • 1) + (β - α) • 1 := by module
  rw [h, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hβ]
  simp

name: NLAlib.inv_mul_shifted_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  have h : A - α • (1 : Matrix m m K) = (A - β • 1) + (β - α) • 1 := by module
  rw [h, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hβ]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sylvesterADIStep_sub
statement:
theorem sylvesterADIStep_sub (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C Y : Matrix m n K) (α β : K)
    (hβ : IsUnit (A - β • 1).det) (hα : IsUnit (B - α • 1).det) :
    sylvesterADIStep A B C Y α β - Y =
      (β - α) • ((A - β • 1)⁻¹ * sylvesterResidual A B C Y * (B - α • 1)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel : Function.Injective (fun Z : Matrix m n K => Z * (B - α • 1)) := by
    intro Z W h
    have := congrArg (fun T => T * (B - α • 1)⁻¹) h
    simpa [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hα] using this
  apply hcancel
  dsimp only
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, sylvesterADIStep_mul_shifted _ _ _ _ _ _ hα]
  rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hα, Matrix.mul_one]
  simp only [sylvesterADIHalf, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    shifted_inv_mul_decomposition _ _ _ hβ]
  have hinv : (A - β • 1)⁻¹ * A = 1 + β • (A - β • 1)⁻¹ := by
    simpa using inv_mul_shifted_decomposition A 0 β hβ
  simp only [sylvesterResidual, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
    smul_add, smul_sub]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hinv, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  module

name: NLAlib.mul_left_cancel_shifted
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun T => (A - β • 1)⁻¹ * T) h
  simpa [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hβ] using this

name: NLAlib.mul_right_cancel_shifted
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun T => T * (B - α • 1)⁻¹) h
  simpa [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hα] using this

name: NLAlib.sub_sylvesterADIHalf
statement:
theorem sub_sylvesterADIHalf (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X Y : Matrix m n K) (β : K) (hX : A * X - X * B = C)
    (hβ : IsUnit (A - β • 1).det) :
    X - sylvesterADIHalf A B C Y β = (A - β • 1)⁻¹ * (X - Y) * (B - β • 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel_shifted A β hβ
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, shifted_mul_sylvesterADIHalf _ _ _ _ _ hβ,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hβ, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [← hX]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  module

name: NLAlib.sub_sylvesterADIStep
statement:
theorem sub_sylvesterADIStep (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X Y : Matrix m n K) (α β : K) (hX : A * X - X * B = C)
    (hβ : IsUnit (A - β • 1).det) (hα : IsUnit (B - α • 1).det) :
    X - sylvesterADIStep A B C Y α β =
      ((A - α • 1) * (A - β • 1)⁻¹) * (X - Y) *
        ((B - β • 1) * (B - α • 1)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_right_cancel_shifted B α hα
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, sylvesterADIStep_mul_shifted _ _ _ _ _ _ hα]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hα, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (A - β • 1)⁻¹,
    ← sub_sylvesterADIHalf A B C X Y β hX hβ]
  rw [← hX]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  module

name: NLAlib.sub_sylvesterADI
statement:
theorem sub_sylvesterADI (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X X₀ : Matrix m n K) (α β : ℕ → K) (hX : A * X - X * B = C)
    (hβ : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - β j • 1).det) (hα : ∀ j, IsUnit (B - α j • 1).det)
    (j : ℕ) : X - sylvesterADI A B C X₀ α β j =
      sylvesterADILeft A α β j * (X - X₀) * sylvesterADIRight B α β j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [sylvesterADI, sylvesterADILeft, sylvesterADIRight]
  | succ j hj =>
    rw [sylvesterADI, sub_sylvesterADIStep _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hX (hβ j) (hα j), hj]
    simp [sylvesterADILeft, sylvesterADIRight, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_sylvesterADI_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_sylvesterADI_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X X₀ : Matrix m n K) (α β : ℕ → K) (hX : A * X - X * B = C)
    (hβ : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - β j • 1).det) (hα : ∀ j, IsUnit (B - α j • 1).det)
    (j : ℕ) : specNorm (X - sylvesterADI A B C X₀ α β j) ≤
      specNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j) * specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j) *
        specNorm (X - X₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_sylvesterADI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hX hβ hα]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j * (X - X₀)) *
        specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j) * specNorm (X - X₀)) *
        specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sub_sylvesterADI_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sub_sylvesterADI_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X X₀ : Matrix m n K) (α β : ℕ → K) (hX : A * X - X * B = C)
    (hβ : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - β j • 1).det) (hα : ∀ j, IsUnit (B - α j • 1).det)
    (j : ℕ) : frobNorm (X - sylvesterADI A B C X₀ α β j) ≤
      specNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j) * specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j) *
        frobNorm (X - X₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_sylvesterADI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hX hβ hα]
  calc
    _ ≤ frobNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j * (X - X₀)) *
        specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j) := frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j) * frobNorm (X - X₀)) *
        specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADIStep
statement:
theorem sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADIStep (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C Y : Matrix m n K) (α β : K)
    (hβ : IsUnit (A - β • 1).det) (hα : IsUnit (B - α • 1).det) :
    sylvesterResidual A B C (sylvesterADIStep A B C Y α β) =
      ((A - α • 1) * (A - β • 1)⁻¹) * sylvesterResidual A B C Y *
        ((B - β • 1) * (B - α • 1)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hstep := eq_add_of_sub_eq (sylvesterADIStep_sub A B C Y α β hβ hα)
  have hAi : A * (A - β • 1)⁻¹ = 1 + β • (A - β • 1)⁻¹ := by
    simpa using shifted_inv_mul_decomposition A 0 β hβ
  have hiB : (B - α • 1)⁻¹ * B = 1 + α • (B - α • 1)⁻¹ := by
    simpa using inv_mul_shifted_decomposition B 0 α hα
  let R := sylvesterResidual A B C Y
  have hres : sylvesterResidual A B C (sylvesterADIStep A B C Y α β) =
      R - (β - α) • (A * ((A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹)) +
        (β - α) • ((A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹ * B) := by
    rw [hstep]
    dsimp only [sylvesterResidual, R]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
      Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_add, smul_sub]
    module
  have h₁ : A * ((A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹) =
      R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹ + β • ((A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAi]
    simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  have h₂ : (A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹ * B =
      (A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R + α • ((A - β • 1)⁻¹ * R * (B - α • 1)⁻¹) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc _ (B - α • 1)⁻¹ B, hiB]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_smul]
  rw [hres, h₁, h₂, shifted_inv_mul_decomposition A α β hβ,
    shifted_inv_mul_decomposition B β α hα]
  change _ = (1 + (β - α) • (A - β • 1)⁻¹) * R *
    (1 + (α - β) • (B - α • 1)⁻¹)
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_add, smul_smul]
  module

name: NLAlib.sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADI
statement:
theorem sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADI (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X₀ : Matrix m n K) (α β : ℕ → K)
    (hβ : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - β j • 1).det) (hα : ∀ j, IsUnit (B - α j • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    sylvesterResidual A B C (sylvesterADI A B C X₀ α β j) =
      sylvesterADILeft A α β j * sylvesterResidual A B C X₀ * sylvesterADIRight B α β j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [sylvesterADI, sylvesterADILeft, sylvesterADIRight]
  | succ j hj =>
    rw [sylvesterADI, sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADIStep _ _ _ _ _ _ (hβ j) (hα j), hj]
    simp [sylvesterADILeft, sylvesterADIRight, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.rank_sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADI_le
statement:
theorem rank_sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADI_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C X₀ : Matrix m n K) (α β : ℕ → K)
    (hβ : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - β j • 1).det) (hα : ∀ j, IsUnit (B - α j • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    (sylvesterResidual A B C (sylvesterADI A B C X₀ α β j)).rank ≤
      (sylvesterResidual A B C X₀).rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADI _ _ _ _ _ _ hβ hα]
  exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)

name: NLAlib.rank_sylvesterADI_zero_le
statement:
theorem rank_sylvesterADI_zero_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (C : Matrix m n K) (α β : ℕ → K)
    (hβ : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - β j • 1).det) (hα : ∀ j, IsUnit (B - α j • 1).det)
    (r : ℕ) (hC : C.rank ≤ r) (j : ℕ) : (sylvesterADI A B C 0 α β j).rank ≤ j * r
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [sylvesterADI]
  | succ j hj =>
    have hstep := sylvesterADIStep_sub A B C (sylvesterADI A B C 0 α β j)
      (α j) (β j) (hβ j) (hα j)
    have hR : (sylvesterResidual A B C (sylvesterADI A B C 0 α β j)).rank ≤ r := by
      apply (rank_sylvesterResidual_sylvesterADI_le A B C 0 α β hβ hα j).trans
      simpa [sylvesterResidual] using hC
    have hcor : (((β j - α j) • ((A - β j • 1)⁻¹ *
        sylvesterResidual A B C (sylvesterADI A B C 0 α β j) * (B - α j • 1)⁻¹))).rank ≤ r := by
      rw [← Matrix.smul_mul, ← Matrix.smul_mul]
      exact ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)).trans hR
    rw [sylvesterADI, eq_add_of_sub_eq hstep]
    exact (rank_add_le _ _).trans (by simpa [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm] using Nat.add_le_add hcor hj)

name: NLAlib.invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal (σ : r → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, 0 < σ i) :
    invSqrtDiagonal (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ * diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) = sqrtDiagonal σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [invSqrtDiagonal, sqrtDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext i
  norm_cast
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (hσ i).le
  have hn := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hσ i)).ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.diagonal_mul_invSqrtDiagonal
statement:
theorem diagonal_mul_invSqrtDiagonal (σ : r → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, 0 < σ i) :
    diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) * invSqrtDiagonal (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ = sqrtDiagonal σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [invSqrtDiagonal, sqrtDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext i
  norm_cast
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (hσ i).le
  have hn := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hσ i)).ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.invSqrtDiagonal_isHermitian
statement:
theorem invSqrtDiagonal_isHermitian (σ : r → ℝ) :
    (invSqrtDiagonal (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [invSqrtDiagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  · simp [invSqrtDiagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]

name: NLAlib.diagonal_ofReal_isHermitian
statement:
private theorem diagonal_ofReal_isHermitian (σ : r → ℝ) :
    (diagonal fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]

name: NLAlib.invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [invSqrtDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    norm_cast
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (hσ i).le
    have hn := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hσ i)).ne'
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal_sq_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [invSqrtDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext i
  norm_cast
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (hσ i).le
  have hn := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hσ i)).ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.gramian_balancing
proof:
:= balancingTrialMap R V σ
    let Φ := balancingTestMap O U σ
    Φᴴ * Ψ = 1 ∧
      Φᴴ * (R * Rᴴ) * Φ = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) ∧
      Ψᴴ * (Oᴴ * O) * Ψ = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) := by
  let D := invSqrtDiagonal (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ
  let S := diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜))
  have hD : Dᴴ = D := invSqrtDiagonal_isHermitian σ
  have hS : (diagonal fun i => (σ i : 𝕜))ᴴ = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) :=
    diagonal_ofReal_isHermitian σ
  have hSS : Sᴴ = S := hS
  have hUV : Uᴴ * (O * R) * V = S := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, h.mul_right, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      h.left_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hleft : Uᴴ * (O * R) = S * Vᴴ := by
    have he := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h.adjoint_mul_left
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hS] using he
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · change (Oᴴ * U * D)ᴴ * (R * V * D) = 1
    calc
      _ = D * (Uᴴ * (O * R) * V) * D := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hD,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hUV]; exact invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal_mul σ h.pos
  constructor
  · change (Oᴴ * U * D)ᴴ * (R * Rᴴ) * (Oᴴ * U * D) = S
    calc
      _ = D * (Uᴴ * (O * R)) * (Uᴴ * (O * R))ᴴ * D := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hD,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = D * S * (Vᴴ * V) * S * D := by
        rw [hleft]
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hSS,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S := by
        rw [h.right_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
        exact invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal_sq_mul σ h.pos
  · change (R * V * D)ᴴ * (Oᴴ * O) * (R * V * D) = S
    calc
      _ = D * ((O * R) * V)ᴴ * ((O * R) * V) * D := by
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hD,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = D * S * (Uᴴ * U) * S * D := by
        rw [h.mul_right]
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hS, S, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S := by
        rw [h.left_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
        exact invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal_sq_mul σ h.pos

name: NLAlib.IsSingularTripletFamily.full_gramian_balancing
proof:
:= balancingTrialMap R V σ
    let Φ := balancingTestMap O U σ
    IsUnit T ∧ T⁻¹ = Φᴴ ∧
      T⁻¹ * (R * Rᴴ) * T⁻¹ᴴ = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) ∧
      Tᴴ * (Oᴴ * O) * T = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜)) ∧
      T⁻¹ * ((R * Rᴴ) * (Oᴴ * O)) * T = diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜) ^ 2) := by
  let T := balancingTrialMap R V σ
  let Φ := balancingTestMap O U σ
  obtain ⟨hcross, hP, hQ⟩ := h.gramian_balancing
  have hother : T * Φᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hcross
  have hunit : IsUnit T := ⟨⟨T, Φᴴ, hother, hcross⟩, rfl⟩
  have hinv : T⁻¹ = Φᴴ := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hcross
  have hmid : Φ * Tᴴ = 1 := by
    have hc := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hother
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one] using hc
  refine ⟨hunit, hinv, ?_, hQ, ?_⟩
  · rw [hinv, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact hP
  · rw [hinv]
    calc
      _ = (Φᴴ * (R * Rᴴ) * Φ) * (Tᴴ * (Oᴴ * O) * T) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Φ Tᴴ, hmid, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = _ := by rw [hP, hQ, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]; simp only [pow_two]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_gramian_product_mul_X
statement:
theorem charpoly_gramian_product_mul_X (R : Matrix n a 𝕜) (O : Matrix b n 𝕜) :
    Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card a * ((R * Rᴴ) * (Oᴴ * O)).charpoly =
      Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card n * ((O * R)ᴴ * (O * R)).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  have he := Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm' R (Rᴴ * Oᴴ * O)
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using he

name: NLAlib.isRoot_charpoly_gramian_product_iff
statement:
theorem isRoot_charpoly_gramian_product_iff (R : Matrix n a 𝕜) (O : Matrix b n 𝕜)
    {z : 𝕜} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ((R * Rᴴ) * (Oᴴ * O)).charpoly.IsRoot z ↔
      ((O * R)ᴴ * (O * R)).charpoly.IsRoot z
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (Polynomial.eval z) (charpoly_gramian_product_mul_X R O)
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] at he
  change _ = 0 ↔ _ = 0
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    have hprod : z ^ Fintype.card n * (((O * R)ᴴ * (O * R)).charpoly.eval z) = 0 := by
      rw [← he, hzero, mul_zero]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hz)
  · intro hzero
    have hprod : z ^ Fintype.card a * (((R * Rᴴ) * (Oᴴ * O)).charpoly.eval z) = 0 := by
      rw [he, hzero, mul_zero]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hz)

name: NLAlib.isRoot_charpoly_gramian_product_iff_sq_singularValues
statement:
theorem isRoot_charpoly_gramian_product_iff_sq_singularValues
    (R : Matrix n a 𝕜) (O : Matrix b n 𝕜) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    ((R * Rᴴ) * (Oᴴ * O)).charpoly.IsRoot (μ : 𝕜) ↔
      ∃ j : Fin (Fintype.card a), μ = singularValues (O * R) j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRoot_charpoly_gramian_product_iff R O (by exact_mod_cast hμ.ne')]
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD (O * R)
  have hchar : ((O * R)ᴴ * (O * R)).charpoly =
      (diagonal fun j : Fin (Fintype.card a) =>
        ((singularValues (O * R) j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)).charpoly := by
    rw [hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm_of_le _ Vᴴ (by simp), Fintype.card_fin,
      Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [hchar, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, sub_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨j, by exact_mod_cast hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨j, by exact_mod_cast hj⟩

name: NLAlib.scalar_kronecker_one
statement:
private theorem scalar_kronecker_one (r : ℝ) (E F : Type*)
    [Fintype E] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq E] [DecidableEq F] :
    (r • (1 : Matrix E E ℂ)) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix F F ℂ) =
      r • (1 : Matrix (E × F) (E × F) ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.smul_kronecker, Matrix.one_kronecker_one]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_hermiteSeriesCreation_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sq_hermiteSeriesCreation_le [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (p : ℕ) :
    specNorm (hermiteSeriesCreation A p) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
        ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A)
proof:
:= by
  let L := hermiteSeriesCreation A p
  let P : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) (d × HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ :=
    (1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ hermiteInterior p
  let N : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) (d × HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ :=
    (1 : Matrix d d ℂ) ⊗ₖ hermiteNumber p
  let B := hermiteAnnihilatorStack (ι := ι) d p
  let V := coefficientVariance A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ)
  let T := coefficientBlock A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ)
  let v := specNorm (coefficientVariance A)
  let t := lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A)
  let q : ℝ := (p - 1 : ℕ)
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := specNorm_nonneg _
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_nonneg A hA
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hP : Pᴴ = P := by
    simp [P, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, isHermitian_hermiteInterior.eq]
  have hPP : P * P = P := by
    simp only [P, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hermiteInterior_mul_self]
  have hP₀ : 0 ≤ P :=
    (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.kronecker posSemidef_hermiteInterior).nonneg
  have hPI : P ≤ 1 := by
    have hh := Matrix.kronecker_le_kronecker_left
      (hermiteInterior_le_one (ι := ι) (p := p)) (Matrix.PosSemidef.one (n := d) (R := ℂ))
    simpa only [P, Matrix.one_kronecker_one] using hh
  have hLP : L * P = L := hermiteSeriesCreation_mul_interior A
  have hPL : P * Lᴴ = Lᴴ := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) (d × HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ => Mᴴ) hLP
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hP] using hh
  have hGram : Lᴴ * L = P * (V + Bᴴ * T * B) * P := by
    have hh := hermiteSeriesCreation_gram_mul_interior A hA (p := p)
    change Lᴴ * L * P = (V + Bᴴ * T * B) * P at hh
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hLP] at hh
    calc Lᴴ * L = P * (Lᴴ * L) := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hPL]
         _ = P * ((V + Bᴴ * T * B) * P) := congrArg (P * ·) hh
         _ = _ := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hVh : (coefficientVariance A).IsHermitian := by
    rw [← coefficientStack_gram A hA]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).isHermitian
  have hV : V ≤ v • 1 := by
    have hh := Matrix.kronecker_le_kronecker_right hVh.le_specNorm_smul_one
      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one (n := HermiteIndex ι p) (R := ℂ))
    simpa only [V, v, scalar_kronecker_one] using hh
  have hT : T ≤ t • 1 := by
    have hh := Matrix.kronecker_le_kronecker_right
      (isHermitian_coefficientBlock A hA).le_lambdaMax_smul_one
      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one (n := HermiteIndex ι p) (R := ℂ))
    simpa only [T, t, scalar_kronecker_one] using hh
  have hB : Bᴴ * B = N := hermiteAnnihilatorStack_gram
  have hBT : Bᴴ * T * B ≤ t • N := by
    have hh := Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_le_conjTranspose_mul hT B
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hB] using hh
  have hPN : P * N * P ≤ q • P := by
    have hh := Matrix.kronecker_le_kronecker_left
      (hermiteInterior_number_le (ι := ι) (p := p)) (Matrix.PosSemidef.one (n := d) (R := ℂ))
    simpa only [P, N, q, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.kronecker_smul]
      using hh
  have hD := add_le_add hV hBT
  have hCD := Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_le_conjTranspose_mul hD P
  have hG : Lᴴ * L ≤ (v + q * t) • 1 := by
    rw [hP] at hCD
    rw [hGram]
    calc
      P * (V + Bᴴ * T * B) * P ≤ P * (v • 1 + t • N) * P := hCD
      _ = v • P + t • (P * N * P) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
          Matrix.mul_one, hPP]
      _ ≤ v • P + t • (q • P) := by
        apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
        rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← smul_sub]
        exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hPN).smul ht
      _ = (v + q * t) • P := by rw [smul_smul, ← add_smul, mul_comm t q]
      _ ≤ (v + q * t) • 1 := by
        apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
        rw [← smul_sub]
        exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hPI).smul (show 0 ≤ v + q * t by positivity)
  exact specNorm_sq_le_of_conjTranspose_mul_self_le L (by positivity) hG

name: NLAlib.specNorm_hermiteSeriesCreation_add_conjTranspose_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_hermiteSeriesCreation_add_conjTranspose_le [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (p : ℕ) :
    specNorm (hermiteSeriesCreation A p + (hermiteSeriesCreation A p)ᴴ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
        ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
proof:
:= by
  have hh := specNorm_sq_hermiteSeriesCreation_le A hA p
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
      ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A) :=
    le_trans (sq_nonneg _) hh
  have hroot : specNorm (hermiteSeriesCreation A p) ≤ Real.sqrt _ :=
    (Real.le_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg _) hnonneg).mpr hh
  calc _ ≤ specNorm (hermiteSeriesCreation A p) + specNorm ((hermiteSeriesCreation A p)ᴴ) :=
      specNorm_add_le _ _
    _ = 2 * specNorm (hermiteSeriesCreation A p) := by rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroot (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq_zero
    {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg Hᵀ)
    (hsub : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → H i j ≠ 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) {v : Fin n → ℝ} {θ : ℝ} (hv : H *ᵥ v = θ • v)
    (hv0 : v ⟨0, hn⟩ = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hall (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : v ⟨k, hk⟩ = 0 := by
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · subst k
        exact hv0
      · have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
        let i : Fin n := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
        let j : Fin n := ⟨k, hk⟩
        have hvi : v i = 0 := ih (k - 1) (by omega) i.isLt
        have hrow := congrFun hv i
        change (∑ l : Fin n, H i l * v l) = θ * v i at hrow
        rw [hvi, mul_zero, Finset.sum_eq_single j] at hrow
        · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hrow).resolve_left (hsub i j (by simp [i, j]; omega))
        · intro l _ hlj
          by_cases hl : l.val < k
          · rw [ih l.val hl l.isLt, mul_zero]
          · have hlt : i.val + 1 < l.val := by
              have hne : l.val ≠ k := fun he => hlj (Fin.ext he)
              simp only [i]
              omega
            rw [show H i l = 0 from hH l i hlt, zero_mul]
        · simp
  funext i
  exact hall i.val i.isLt

name: NLAlib.apply_zero_ne_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul
statement:
theorem apply_zero_ne_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul
    {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg Hᵀ)
    (hsub : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → H i j ≠ 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) {v : Fin n → ℝ} {θ : ℝ} (hv : H *ᵥ v = θ • v)
    (hvne : v ≠ 0) : v ⟨0, hn⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => hvne (eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq_zero hH hsub hn hv h)

name: NLAlib.eq_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq
    {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg Hᵀ)
    (hsub : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → H i j ≠ 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) {v w : Fin n → ℝ} {θ : ℝ}
    (hv : H *ᵥ v = θ • v) (hw : H *ᵥ w = θ • w)
    (h0 : v ⟨0, hn⟩ = w ⟨0, hn⟩) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq_zero hH hsub hn
  · rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hv, hw, smul_sub]
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h0

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero_ne_zero
    {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (htri : IsUpperHessenberg Hᵀ)
    (hsub : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → H i j ≠ 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) : hH.eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hn⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply apply_zero_ne_zero_of_mulVec_eq_smul htri hsub hn (hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i)
  intro hzero
  have hnorm := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hH i i
  rw [hzero] at hnorm
  simp at hnorm

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_injective_of_unreduced
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_injective_of_unreduced
    {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (htri : IsUpperHessenberg Hᵀ)
    (hsub : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → H i j ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective hH.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  have hn : 0 < n := by have := i.isLt; omega
  let z : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let v : Fin n → ℝ := hH.eigenvectorBasis i
  let w : Fin n → ℝ := hH.eigenvectorBasis j
  have hve : H *ᵥ v = hH.eigenvalues i • v := hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
  have hwe : H *ᵥ w = hH.eigenvalues i • w := by rw [hij]; exact hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j
  have heq : w z • v = v z • w := by
    apply eq_of_mulVec_eq_smul_of_apply_zero_eq htri hsub hn
    · rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, hve, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    · rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, hwe, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    · change w z * v z = v z * w z
      ring
  have hdot := congrArg (fun u : Fin n → ℝ => v ⬝ᵥ u) heq
  have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by simpa [v] using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hH i i
  have hvw : v ⬝ᵥ w = 0 := by simpa [v, w, hne] using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hH i j
  rw [dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hvv, hvw,
    mul_one, mul_zero] at hdot
  exact hH.eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero_ne_zero htri hsub hn j hdot

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.coordinate_le
statement: theorem coordinate_le (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) : a.val i ≤ p
proof:
:=
  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans a.property

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.vacuum_val
statement: @[simp] theorem vacuum_val (i : ι) : (vacuum : HermiteIndex ι p).val i = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_vacuum
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_vacuum : (vacuum : HermiteIndex ι p).degree = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree, vacuum]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.lower_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem lower_val (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i j : ι) :
    (lower a i).val j = if j = i then a.val i - 1 else a.val j
proof:
:= by
  simp [lower, Function.update_apply]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_lower
statement:
theorem degree_lower (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (hi : 0 < a.val i) :
    (lower a i).degree + 1 = a.degree
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i) a.val (a.val i - 1)
  change (∑ j, Function.update a.val i (a.val i - 1) j) + 1 = ∑ j, a.val j
  rw [hsum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  omega

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.raise_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem raise_val (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i j : ι) (h : a.degree < p) :
    (raise a i h).val j = if j = i then a.val i + 1 else a.val j
proof:
:= by
  simp [raise, Function.update_apply]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_raise
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_raise (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (h : a.degree < p) :
    (raise a i h).degree = a.degree + 1
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ j, Function.update a.val i (a.val i + 1) j) = (∑ j, a.val j) + 1
  rw [Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hi := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (a.val j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  omega

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.lower_raise
statement:
@[simp] theorem lower_raise (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (h : a.degree < p) :
    lower (raise a i h) i = a
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext j
  by_cases hij : j = i <;> simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.raise_lower
statement:
theorem raise_lower (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (hi : 0 < a.val i)
    (h : (lower a i).degree < p) : raise (lower a i) i h = a
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext j
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · subst j
    simp only [raise_val, lower_val, if_true]
    omega
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_lower_le
statement: theorem degree_lower_le (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) : (a.lower i).degree ≤ a.degree
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j; simp
  · simp [h]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.embed_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem embed_val {q : ℕ} (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (h : p ≤ q) (i : ι) :
    (a.embed h).val i = a.val i
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_embed
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_embed {q : ℕ} (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (h : p ≤ q) :
    (a.embed h).degree = a.degree
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.embed_injective
statement:
theorem embed_injective {q : ℕ} (h : p ≤ q) :
    Function.Injective (fun a : HermiteIndex ι p => a.embed h)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b he
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun c : HermiteIndex ι q => c.val) he

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.raiseNext_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem raiseNext_val (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i j : ι) :
    (a.raiseNext i).val j = if j = i then a.val i + 1 else a.val j
proof:
:= by
  simp [raiseNext]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_raiseNext
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_raiseNext (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) :
    (a.raiseNext i).degree = a.degree + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [raiseNext]

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.lower_raise_of_ne
statement:
theorem lower_raise_of_ne (a : HermiteIndex ι p) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h : a.degree < p) (h' : (a.lower i).degree < p) :
    (a.raise j h).lower i = (a.lower i).raise j h'
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext k
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst k
    simp [hij]
  · by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      simp [hki]
    · simp [hki, hkj]

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlock_eq_stack_gram_of_commute
statement:
theorem coefficientBlock_eq_stack_gram_of_commute (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hcomm : ∀ i j, Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    coefficientBlock A = coefficientStack A * (coefficientStack A)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  ext ic je
  simp only [coefficientBlock, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, coefficientStack]
  have he := congrFun (congrFun (hcomm je.1 ic.1).eq ic.2) je.2
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply] at he
  rw [he]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [(hA je.1).apply]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_coefficientBlock_of_commute
statement:
theorem posSemidef_coefficientBlock_of_commute (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hcomm : ∀ i j, Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    (coefficientBlock A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientBlock_eq_stack_gram_of_commute A hA hcomm]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientBlock_eq_variance_of_commute
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientBlock_eq_variance_of_commute (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hcomm : ∀ i j, Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    specNorm (coefficientBlock A) = specNorm (coefficientVariance A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientBlock_eq_stack_gram_of_commute A hA hcomm,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self, ← coefficientStack_gram A hA,
    ← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_eq_variance_of_commute
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_eq_variance_of_commute [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hcomm : ∀ i j, Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A) = specNorm (coefficientVariance A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(posSemidef_coefficientBlock_of_commute A hA hcomm).lambdaMax_eq_specNorm,
    specNorm_coefficientBlock_eq_variance_of_commute A hA hcomm]

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlockKappa_eq_variance_of_commute
statement:
theorem coefficientBlockKappa_eq_variance_of_commute [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (A i) (A j)) :
    coefficientBlockKappa A = Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ i j, Commute (A i) (A j) := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; exact Commute.refl _
    · exact hcomm hij
  rw [coefficientBlockKappa, lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_eq_variance_of_commute A hA hc]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_realCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem isHermitian_realCoefficientDilation (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) (i : ι) :
    (realCoefficientDilation B i).IsHermitian
proof: := isHermitian_dilation _

name: NLAlib.coefficientVariance_realCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem coefficientVariance_realCoefficientDilation (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    coefficientVariance (realCoefficientDilation B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks ((∑ i, B i * (B i)ᴴ).map Complex.ofReal) 0 0
        ((∑ i, (B i)ᴴ * B i).map Complex.ofReal)
proof:
:= by
  have h (i : ι) : realCoefficientDilation B i * realCoefficientDilation B i =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (((B i) * (B i)ᴴ).map Complex.ofReal) 0 0
        (((B i)ᴴ * B i).map Complex.ofReal) := by
    rw [realCoefficientDilation, ← sq, dilation_sq]
    ext (a | a) (b | b) <;>
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum,
        Complex.ofReal_mul]
  unfold coefficientVariance
  simp_rw [h]
  ext (a | a) (b | b) <;> simp [Matrix.sum_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_specNorm_variance_realCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_specNorm_variance_realCoefficientDilation_le
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance (realCoefficientDilation B))) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _), ?_⟩
  rw [coefficientVariance_realCoefficientDilation]
  apply (specNorm_fromBlocks_diagonal_le _ _).trans
  have hR : specNorm ((∑ i, B i * (B i)ᴴ).map Complex.ofReal) =
      specNorm (coefficientRow B) ^ 2 := by
    have hm := specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (∑ i, B i * (B i)ᴴ)
    simp only [Complex.coe_algebraMap] at hm
    exact hm.trans (specNorm_coefficientRow_sq B).symm
  have hC : specNorm ((∑ i, (B i)ᴴ * B i).map Complex.ofReal) =
      specNorm (coefficientColumn B) ^ 2 := by
    have hm := specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (∑ i, (B i)ᴴ * B i)
    simp only [Complex.coe_algebraMap] at hm
    exact hm.trans (specNorm_coefficientColumn_sq B).symm
  rw [hR, hC]
  apply max_le <;> nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (coefficientRow B),
    specNorm_nonneg (coefficientColumn B)]

name: NLAlib.coefficientVectorization_gram_realCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem coefficientVectorization_gram_realCoefficientDilation
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (coefficientVectorization (realCoefficientDilation B))ᴴ *
        coefficientVectorization (realCoefficientDilation B) =
      (2 : ℝ) • ((coefficientEntryRows B * (coefficientEntryRows B)ᴴ).map Complex.ofReal)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, coefficientVectorization,
      realCoefficientDilation, dilation, coefficientEntryRows, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    have hs : (∑ b : n, ∑ a : m, B i a b * B j a b) =
        ∑ a : m, ∑ b : n, B i a b * B j a b := Finset.sum_comm
    linarith
  · simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, coefficientVectorization,
      realCoefficientDilation, dilation, coefficientEntryRows, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientVectorization_realCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientVectorization_realCoefficientDilation
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (coefficientVectorization (realCoefficientDilation B)) =
      Real.sqrt 2 * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : specNorm (coefficientVectorization (realCoefficientDilation B)) ^ 2 =
      2 * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B) ^ 2 := by
    rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      coefficientVectorization_gram_realCoefficientDilation, specNorm_eq_norm,
      norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ← specNorm_eq_norm]
    have hm := specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (coefficientEntryRows B * (coefficientEntryRows B)ᴴ)
    simp only [Complex.coe_algebraMap] at hm
    rw [hm, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self]
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  exact hs

name: NLAlib.sqrt_specNorm_covariance_realCoefficientDilation
statement:
theorem sqrt_specNorm_covariance_realCoefficientDilation
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance (realCoefficientDilation B))) =
      Real.sqrt 2 * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientCovariance, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self,
    Real.sqrt_sq (specNorm_nonneg _), specNorm_coefficientVectorization_realCoefficientDilation]

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlock_eq_variance_swap_compression
statement:
theorem coefficientBlock_eq_variance_swap_compression (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    coefficientBlock A = (coefficientVarianceLift A)ᴴ *
      coefficientVarianceSwap.permMatrix ℂ * coefficientVarianceLift A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_mul]
  ext ic je
  simp [coefficientBlock, coefficientVarianceLift, coefficientStack,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, coefficientVarianceSwap,
    apply_ite, ite_mul, (hA _).apply]

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlock_eq_covariance_swap_compression
statement:
theorem coefficientBlock_eq_covariance_swap_compression (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    coefficientBlock A = (coefficientCovarianceLift A)ᴴ *
      coefficientCovarianceSwap.permMatrix ℂ * coefficientCovarianceLift A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_mul]
  ext ic je
  simp [coefficientBlock, coefficientCovarianceLift, coefficientVectorization,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, coefficientCovarianceSwap,
    apply_ite, (hA _).apply, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_conjTranspose_permMatrix_mul_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_conjTranspose_permMatrix_mul_le {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (F : Matrix m n ℂ) (σ : Equiv.Perm m) :
    specNorm (Fᴴ * σ.permMatrix ℂ * F) ≤ specNorm F ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hP : specNorm (σ.permMatrix ℂ) ≤ 1 := Matrix.permMatrix_l2_opNorm_le σ
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (Fᴴ * σ.permMatrix ℂ) * specNorm F := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm Fᴴ * specNorm (σ.permMatrix ℂ)) * specNorm F :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (specNorm F * 1) * specNorm F := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP (specNorm_nonneg F)) (specNorm_nonneg F)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientBlock_le_covariance
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientBlock_le_covariance [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (coefficientBlock A) ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    have hI : specNorm (1 : Matrix d d ℂ) = 1 := by simp [specNorm_eq_norm]
  rw [coefficientBlock_eq_covariance_swap_compression A hA]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovarianceLift A) ^ 2 :=
      specNorm_conjTranspose_permMatrix_mul_le _ _
    _ = specNorm (coefficientVectorization A) ^ 2 := by
      rw [coefficientCovarianceLift, specNorm_kronecker, hI, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [coefficientCovariance, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientBlock_le_variance
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientBlock_le_variance [Nonempty ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (coefficientBlock A) ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A)
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    have hI : specNorm (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = 1 := by simp [specNorm_eq_norm]
  rw [coefficientBlock_eq_variance_swap_compression A hA]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (coefficientVarianceLift A) ^ 2 :=
      specNorm_conjTranspose_permMatrix_mul_le _ _
    _ = specNorm (coefficientStack A) ^ 2 := by
      rw [coefficientVarianceLift, specNorm_kronecker, hI, one_mul]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← coefficientStack_gram A hA]
      exact specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self _

name: NLAlib.card_profileHeavyRows_le
statement:
theorem card_profileHeavyRows_le (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {b : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hb : ∀ i j, A i j * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ b) (k : ℕ) :
    (profileHeavyRows A b k).card ≤ profilePreviousCutoff k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold profileHeavyRows
  apply Finset.card_filter_le_of_imp_val_lt
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hi
  by_contra hn
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.le_div_sqrt_log_of_weighted_le (fun i => A i j)
    (fun i => hA i j) (fun i => hb i j)
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 1 < 2) (two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k))
    i (Nat.le_of_not_gt hn))) hj

name: NLAlib.card_profileHeavyNeighbors_lt
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_filter_div_sqrt_lt_of_sum_sq_le (fun i => A i j) ha (hcol j)
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) (two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k))

name: NLAlib.exists_equiv_entry_le_div_sqrt_log_and_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_entry_le_div_sqrt_log_and_div_sqrt
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hb : ∀ i j, A i j * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ b) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ Fin n, ∀ k,
      (∀ i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
        A (e i) (e j) ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k))) ∧
      (∀ i j, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val → j.val < profileCutoff k →
        A (e i) (e j) ≤ a / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let rows := profileHeavyRows A b
  let neighbors := profileHeavyNeighbors A a
  let I := Finset.heavyFlag rows neighbors profileCutoff profileNeighborCutoff
  let J := Finset.heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors profileCutoff profileNeighborCutoff
  have hrow (k : ℕ) : (rows k).card ≤ profilePreviousCutoff k :=
    card_profileHeavyRows_le A hA hb k
  have hneighbor (k : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
      (neighbors k j).card ≤ profilePreviousCutoff k :=
    (card_profileHeavyNeighbors_lt A ha hcol k j).le
  have hcards (k : ℕ) : (I k).card = min (profileCutoff k) n ∧
      (J k).card = min (profileNeighborCutoff k) n := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
      Finset.card_heavyFlag_and_heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors
        profileCutoff profileNeighborCutoff profilePreviousCutoff
        ((hrow 0).trans (profilePreviousCutoff_le 0)) hneighbor
        (fun _ => le_rfl) (fun k =>
          (Nat.add_le_add_left (hrow (k + 1)) _).trans
            (profileNeighborCutoff_add_previous_succ_le k)) k
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Finset.exists_equiv_fin_prefix_heavyFlag rows neighbors
    profileCutoff profileNeighborCutoff n
  let e' : Fin n ≃ Fin n := (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm).trans e
  have he' (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
      (e' i ∈ I k ↔ i.val < (I k).card) ∧
      (e' i ∈ J k ↔ i.val < (J k).card) := by
    exact he k hk (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i)
  refine ⟨e', ?_⟩
  intro k
  constructor
  · intro i j hi
    by_cases hk : k ≤ n
    · have hout : e' i ∉ I k := by
        rw [(he' k hk i).1, (hcards k).1]
        omega
      by_contra hlt
      apply hout
      apply Finset.subset_heavyFlag rows neighbors profileCutoff profileNeighborCutoff k
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ⟨e' j, lt_of_not_ge hlt⟩⟩
    · have hlarge := le_profileCutoff k
      omega
  · intro i j hi hj
    by_cases hk : k ≤ n
    · have hin : e' j ∈ I k := by
        rw [(he' k hk j).1, (hcards k).1]
        exact lt_min hj j.isLt
      have hout : e' i ∉ J k := by
        rw [(he' k hk i).2, (hcards k).2]
        omega
      by_contra hlt
      apply hout
      exact Finset.mem_neighborExtension hin
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_not_ge hlt⟩)
    · have hlarge := (le_profileCutoff k).trans (profileCutoff_le_neighborCutoff k)
      omega

name: NLAlib.principalTailPart_eq_mul
statement:
theorem principalTailPart_eq_mul {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    principalTailPart A r = tailCoordinateProjection n r * A * tailCoordinateProjection n r
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [tailCoordinateProjection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, principalTailPart]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.headTailRemainder_eq_add_mul
statement:
theorem headTailRemainder_eq_add_mul {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    headTailRemainder A r = headCoordinateProjection n r * A +
      tailCoordinateProjection n r * A * headCoordinateProjection n r
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [headTailRemainder, principalTailPart, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
    headCoordinateProjection, tailCoordinateProjection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: NLAlib.rank_headCoordinateProjection_le
statement:
theorem rank_headCoordinateProjection_le (n r : ℕ) :
    (headCoordinateProjection n r).rank ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [headCoordinateProjection, Matrix.rank_diagonal, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h := Finset.card_filter_le_of_imp_val_lt (fun i : Fin n => i.val < r) (fun _ hi => hi)
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < r <;> simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.rank_headTailRemainder_le
statement:
theorem rank_headTailRemainder_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    (headTailRemainder A r).rank ≤ 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [headTailRemainder_eq_add_mul]
  have hhead := rank_headCoordinateProjection_le n r
  exact (rank_add_le _ _).trans (by
    have hleft := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left (headCoordinateProjection n r) A
    have hright := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right (tailCoordinateProjection n r * A)
      (headCoordinateProjection n r)
    omega)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_tailCoordinateProjection_le_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_tailCoordinateProjection_le_one (n r : ℕ) :
    specNorm (tailCoordinateProjection n r) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_diagonal_le (by norm_num)
  intro i
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.specNorm_principalTailPart_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_principalTailPart_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    specNorm (principalTailPart A r) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalTailPart_eq_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (tailCoordinateProjection n r * A) * specNorm (tailCoordinateProjection n r) :=
      specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (tailCoordinateProjection n r) * specNorm A) *
        specNorm (tailCoordinateProjection n r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (1 * specNorm A) * 1 := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_tailCoordinateProjection_le_one n r) (specNorm_nonneg A))
      (specNorm_tailCoordinateProjection_le_one n r) (specNorm_nonneg _)
      (by simpa only [one_mul] using specNorm_nonneg A)
    _ = specNorm A := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_headTailRemainder_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_headTailRemainder_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    specNorm (headTailRemainder A r) ≤ 2 * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_sub_le A (principalTailPart A r)
  change specNorm (headTailRemainder A r) ≤ _ at h
  linarith [specNorm_principalTailPart_le A r]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_headTailRemainder_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_headTailRemainder_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (r : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (headTailRemainder A r) p ≤
      (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * (2 * specNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm _ hp).trans
  apply mul_le_mul
  · apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    · exact_mod_cast rank_headTailRemainder_le A r
    · positivity
  · exact specNorm_headTailRemainder_le A r
  · exact specNorm_nonneg _
  · positivity

name: NLAlib.isSymm_principalTailPart
statement:
theorem isSymm_principalTailPart {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) (r : ℕ) : (principalTailPart A r).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, principalTailPart, hA.apply i j, and_comm]

name: NLAlib.profileMaxRowEnergy_nonneg
statement: theorem profileMaxRowEnergy_nonneg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : 0 ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A
proof:
:=
  norm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.profileLogRowMaximum_nonneg
statement: theorem profileLogRowMaximum_nonneg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : 0 ≤ profileLogRowMaximum A
proof:
:=
  norm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.sum_row_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq
statement:
theorem sum_row_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) :
    ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hbound : Real.sqrt (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => Real.sqrt (∑ j, A i j ^ 2)) i
    simpa only [profileMaxRowEnergy, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] using h
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hn, Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ j, A i j ^ 2),
    profileMaxRowEnergy_nonneg A]

name: NLAlib.sum_column_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq
statement:
theorem sum_column_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm) (j : ι) :
    ∑ i, A i j ^ 2 ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hA.apply] using sum_row_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq A j

name: NLAlib.entry_mul_sqrt_log_le_profileLogRowMaximum
statement:
theorem entry_mul_sqrt_log_le_profileLogRowMaximum (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) :
    A (sortingEquiv (fun j => ‖A j‖) i) (sortingEquiv (fun j => ‖A j‖) j) *
      Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ profileLogRowMaximum A
proof:
:= by
  let e := sortingEquiv (fun j => ‖A j‖)
  have hentry : A (e i) (e j) ≤ ‖A (e i)‖ :=
    (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm (A (e i)) (e j))
  have hbound := norm_le_pi_norm
    (fun l : Fin (Fintype.card ι) => ‖A (e l)‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (l.val + 1))) i
  have hweighted : ‖A (e i)‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ profileLogRowMaximum A := by
    simpa only [profileLogRowMaximum, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity :
      0 ≤ ‖A (e i)‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)))] using hbound
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hentry (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans hweighted

name: NLAlib.exists_equiv_entry_le_profile_envelopes
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_entry_le_profile_envelopes
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    ∃ e : Fin (Fintype.card ι) ≃ ι, ∀ k,
      (∀ i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
        A (e i) (e j) ≤ profileLogRowMaximum A /
          Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k))) ∧
      (∀ i j, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val → j.val < profileCutoff k →
        A (e i) (e j) ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e₀ := sortingEquiv (fun j => ‖A j‖)
  let B : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun i j => A (e₀ i) (e₀ j)
  have hcol (j : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) : ∑ i, B i j ^ 2 ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A ^ 2 := by
    change (∑ i, (fun l => A l (e₀ j) ^ 2) (e₀ i)) ≤ _
    rw [e₀.sum_comp (fun l : ι => A l (e₀ j) ^ 2)]
    exact sum_column_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq A hA (e₀ j)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_equiv_entry_le_div_sqrt_log_and_div_sqrt B
    (profileMaxRowEnergy_nonneg A) (fun i j => hA0 (e₀ i) (e₀ j)) hcol
    (entry_mul_sqrt_log_le_profileLogRowMaximum A)
  refine ⟨e.trans e₀, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Equiv.trans_apply, B, Matrix.of_apply] using he

name: CStarMatrix.rowPair_gram
statement:
theorem rowPair_gram (X Q : CStarMatrix n n A) :
    ofMatrix (rowPair X Q * (rowPair X Q)ᴴ) = X * star X + Q * star Q
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [rowPair, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
    CStarMatrix.mul_apply, CStarMatrix.star_apply]

name: CStarMatrix.nonneg_add_algebraMap_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem nonneg_add_algebraMap_of_norm_le (B : CStarMatrix n n A)
    (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B) {b : ℝ} (hb : ‖B‖ ≤ b) :
    0 ≤ B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) b
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (-b) ≤ B := by
    apply (algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum hB).mpr
    intro r hr
    have hn := spectrum.norm_le_norm_mul_of_mem hr
    have hunit : ‖(1 : CStarMatrix n n A)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have hsq := CStarRing.norm_self_mul_star (x := (1 : CStarMatrix n n A))
      simp only [star_one, one_mul] at hsq
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1 : CStarMatrix n n A)]
    have hnorm : ‖r‖ ≤ ‖B‖ := hn.trans (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg B])
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
    have := (abs_le.mp hnorm).1
    linarith
  have := sub_nonneg.mpr hlow
  simpa only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] using this

name: CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow_gram
statement:
theorem positiveGramRow_gram (X B : CStarMatrix n n A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : ‖B‖ ≤ b) (δ : ℝ) :
    ofMatrix (positiveGramRow X B b δ * (positiveGramRow X B b δ)ᴴ) =
      X * star X + B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := nonneg_add_algebraMap_of_norm_le B hB hb
  have hδ : 0 ≤ algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (4 * δ ^ 2) :=
    map_nonneg (StarAlgHom.ofId ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A)) (by positivity)
  have hq : 0 ≤ B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [map_add, add_assoc] using add_nonneg hbase hδ
  have hsqstar := (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.sqrt_nonneg
    (B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)))).star_eq
  unfold positiveGramRow
  rw [rowPair_gram, hsqstar, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hq]
  simp only [add_assoc]

name: CStarMatrix.le_spectrum_positiveGramRow_gram
statement:
theorem le_spectrum_positiveGramRow_gram (X B : CStarMatrix n n A)
    (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B) {b : ℝ} (hb : ‖B‖ ≤ b) (δ : ℝ)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ spectrum ℝ
      (ofMatrix (positiveGramRow X B b δ * (positiveGramRow X B b δ)ᴴ))) :
    4 * δ ^ 2 ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := nonneg_add_algebraMap_of_norm_le B hB hb
  have hgram : algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (4 * δ ^ 2) ≤
      X * star X + B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2) := by
    rw [map_add, ← add_assoc]
    have hn : 0 ≤ X * star X + B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) b := by
      simpa only [add_assoc] using add_nonneg (mul_star_self_nonneg X) hbase
    simpa only [zero_add] using add_le_add hn
      (le_refl (algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (4 * δ ^ 2)))
  rw [positiveGramRow_gram X B hB hb δ] at hr
  exact (algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum
    ((IsSelfAdjoint.mul_star_self X).add hB |>.add ((IsSelfAdjoint.all _).algebraMap (CStarMatrix n n A)))).mp hgram r hr

name: CStarMatrix.sqrt_norm_positiveGramRow_gram_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_norm_positiveGramRow_gram_le
    (X B : CStarMatrix n n A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    {b δ : ℝ} (hb : ‖B‖ ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    Real.sqrt ‖ofMatrix (positiveGramRow X B b δ * (positiveGramRow X B b δ)ᴴ)‖ ≤
      ‖X‖ + 2 * Real.sqrt b + 2 * δ
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := (norm_nonneg B).trans hb
  rw [positiveGramRow_gram X B hB hb δ]
  have hnorm : ‖X * star X + B + algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)‖ ≤
      ‖X‖ ^ 2 + 2 * b + 4 * δ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖X * star X + B‖ + ‖algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖X * star X‖ + ‖B‖) + ‖algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ ‖X‖ ^ 2 + 2 * b + 4 * δ ^ 2 := by
        rw [CStarRing.norm_self_mul_star, norm_algebraMap', Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        nlinarith
  apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hb0
  have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg b
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg X) hs0, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg X) hδ,
    mul_nonneg hs0 hδ]

name: CStarMatrix.hausdorffDist_spectrum_shiftedGram_le_of_positiveGramRow
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_spectrum_shiftedGram_le_of_positiveGramRow
    (X BA : CStarMatrix n n A) (Z BB : CStarMatrix n n BAlg)
    (hBA : IsSelfAdjoint BA) (hBB : IsSelfAdjoint BB)
    {b δ : ℝ} (hBA_norm : ‖BA‖ ≤ b) (hBB_norm : ‖BB‖ ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : Metric.hausdorffDist
      (spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation (positiveGramRow X BA b δ)))
      (spectrum ℝ (rectangularDilation (positiveGramRow Z BB b δ))) ≤ δ) :
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X * star X + BA))
      (spectrum ℝ (Z * star Z + BB)) ≤
        4 * (‖Z‖ + Real.sqrt b) * δ + 5 * δ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hausdorffDist_spectrum_rowGram_le_of_dilation_gap
    (positiveGramRow X BA b δ) (positiveGramRow Z BB b δ) hδ
    (fun _ hr => le_spectrum_positiveGramRow_gram X BA hBA hBA_norm δ hr)
    (fun _ hr => le_spectrum_positiveGramRow_gram Z BB hBB hBB_norm δ hr) hd
  rw [positiveGramRow_gram X BA hBA hBA_norm δ,
    positiveGramRow_gram Z BB hBB hBB_norm δ] at hs
  have hshiftA : spectrum ℝ (X * star X + BA +
      algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n A) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)) =
      (fun r : ℝ => r + (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)) '' spectrum ℝ (X * star X + BA) := by
    rw [← spectrum.add_singleton_eq, Set.add_singleton]
  have hshiftB : spectrum ℝ (Z * star Z + BB +
      algebraMap ℝ (CStarMatrix n n BAlg) (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)) =
      (fun r : ℝ => r + (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)) '' spectrum ℝ (Z * star Z + BB) := by
    rw [← spectrum.add_singleton_eq, Set.add_singleton]
  rw [hshiftA, hshiftB] at hs
  have hiso : Isometry (fun r : ℝ => r + (b + 4 * δ ^ 2)) :=
    Isometry.of_dist_eq fun x y => by simp only [Real.dist_eq, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  rw [Metric.hausdorffDist_image hiso] at hs
  have hrad := sqrt_norm_positiveGramRow_gram_le Z BB hBB hBB_norm hδ.le
  rw [positiveGramRow_gram Z BB hBB hBB_norm δ] at hrad
  have hrad' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrad (show 0 ≤ 2 * δ by positivity)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg Z) hδ.le]

name: NLAlib.clusterOffRow_submatrix_embedding
statement:
theorem clusterOffRow_submatrix_embedding (A : Matrix N N K) (e : J ↪ N) (f : I ↪ J) :
    (clusterOffRow A e).submatrix f id = clusterOffRow A (f.trans e) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j => if j ∈ Set.range e then (0 : K) else 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, clusterOffRow, Matrix.mul_diagonal, id_eq]
  by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range e
  · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos hj, mul_zero]
  · have hf : j ∉ Set.range (f.trans e) := by
      rintro ⟨x,hx⟩
      exact hj ⟨f x,hx⟩
    rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj, if_neg hf, mul_one]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.range_cluster_basis_restriction_le
statement:
theorem range_cluster_basis_restriction_le (A : Matrix N N K) (e : J ↪ N) (f : I ↪ J)

    LinearMap.range (M.submatrix f id).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range (clusterOffRow A (f.trans e)).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have h := range_submatrix_rows_le_of_range_le M (clusterOffRow A e) f hM
  rw [clusterOffRow_submatrix_embedding] at h
  exact h.trans (range_mulVecLin_mul_le _ _)

name: NLAlib.det_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem det_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    (D + U * C * Vᴴ).det = D.det * (inverseReductionCore D U V).det *
      (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_add_mul (U * C) Vᴴ hD]
  have heq : 1 + Vᴴ * D⁻¹ * (U * C) =
      inverseReductionCore D U V * (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hM]
    simp only [inverseReductionCore, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    abel
  rw [heq, Matrix.det_mul, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose_iff (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    IsUnit (D + U * C * Vᴴ) ↔ IsUnit (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det,
    det_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose D U V C hD hM]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right h
  · intro h
    exact (hD.mul hM).mul h

name: NLAlib.mul_inverseReductionLeft
statement:
private theorem mul_inverseReductionLeft (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    (D + U * C * Vᴴ) * inverseReductionLeft D U V =
      U * (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : D * inverseReductionLeft D U V = U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ := by
    simp [inverseReductionLeft, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hD]
  have h₂ : Vᴴ * inverseReductionLeft D U V = 1 := by
    change Vᴴ * (D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹) = 1
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    exact Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hM
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, h₁, Matrix.mul_assoc, h₂, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_add]
  abel

name: NLAlib.inverse_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem inverse_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det)
    (hS : IsUnit (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹).det) :
    (D + U * C * Vᴴ)⁻¹ = inverseReductionLeft D U V *
      (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹)⁻¹ * inverseReductionRight D U V +
        inverseReductionRemainder D U V
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  have hE := mul_inverseReductionLeft D U V C hD hM
  have hG : (D + U * C * Vᴴ) * inverseReductionRemainder D U V =
      1 - U * inverseReductionRight D U V := by
    change (D + U * C * Vᴴ) * (D⁻¹ - inverseReductionLeft D U V * Vᴴ * D⁻¹) = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hE]
    simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hD, Matrix.mul_add,
      inverseReductionRight, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    noncomm_ring
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hE]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hS, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc U C Vᴴ, hG]
  abel

name: NLAlib.inverseReduction_projection_idempotent
statement:
theorem inverseReduction_projection_idempotent (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    IsIdempotentElem (D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ * Vᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  change (D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ * Vᴴ) *
    (D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ * Vᴴ) = _
  calc
    _ = D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ *
        (inverseReductionCore D U V * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹) * Vᴴ := by
      simp only [inverseReductionCore, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hM]; simp

name: NLAlib.rank_inverseReductionRemainder
statement:
theorem rank_inverseReductionRemainder (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    (inverseReductionRemainder D U V).rank = Fintype.card n - Fintype.card k
proof:
:= by
  let P := D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ * Vᴴ
  have hP : IsIdempotentElem P := inverseReduction_projection_idempotent D U V hM
  have htrace : P.trace = (Fintype.card k : K) := by
    calc
      P.trace = (Vᴴ * (D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹)).trace :=
        Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = (inverseReductionCore D U V * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹).trace := by
        simp only [inverseReductionCore, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hM]; simp
  have hPrank : P.rank = Fintype.card k := by
    apply Nat.cast_injective (R := K)
    rw [← trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem P hP]
    exact htrace
  have hcast : (((1 - P).rank + P.rank : ℕ) : K) = (Fintype.card n : K) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, ← trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem (1 - P) hP.one_sub,
      ← trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem P hP, ← Matrix.trace_add]
    simp
  have hdim : (1 - P).rank + P.rank = Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_injective hcast
  have hG : inverseReductionRemainder D U V = (1 - P) * D⁻¹ := by
    simp [inverseReductionRemainder, P, Matrix.sub_mul]
  rw [hG, Matrix.rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det _ _ (D.isUnit_nonsing_inv_det hD)]
  omega

name: NLAlib.inverseReduction_conformalBlockDiagonal
statement:
theorem inverseReduction_conformalBlockDiagonal {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι]
    (row : n → ι) (coarse : k → ι) (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det)
    (hDb : ConformalBlockDiagonal D row row)
    (hUb : ConformalBlockDiagonal U row coarse)
    (hVb : ConformalBlockDiagonal V row coarse) :
    ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionLeft D U V) row coarse ∧
      ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionRight D U V) coarse row ∧
      ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionRemainder D U V) row row
proof:
:= by
  have hDi := hDb.inv hD
  have hMb : ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionCore D U V) coarse coarse :=
    (hVb.conjTranspose.mul hDi).mul hUb
  have hMi := hMb.inv hM
  exact ⟨(hDi.mul hUb).mul hMi, (hMi.mul hVb.conjTranspose).mul hDi,
    hDi.sub ((((hDi.mul hUb).mul hMi).mul hVb.conjTranspose).mul hDi)⟩

name: NLAlib.minpoly_adjoinRoot_eq
statement:
private theorem minpoly_adjoinRoot_eq (hp : p.Monic) :

name: NLAlib.leftMulMatrix_adjoinRoot_eq_companionMatrix
statement:
theorem leftMulMatrix_adjoinRoot_eq_companionMatrix (hp : p.Monic) :
    Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hp).basis (AdjoinRoot.root p) =
      companionMatrix p
proof:
:= by
  have h := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hp).leftMulMatrix
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  have hij := congrArg (fun M => M i j) h
  simpa only [PowerBasis.minpolyGen_eq, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'_gen,
    minpoly_adjoinRoot_eq hp, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'_dim, Matrix.of_apply,
    companionMatrix] using hij

name: NLAlib.charpoly_companionMatrix
statement:

    (companionMatrix p).charpoly = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← leftMulMatrix_adjoinRoot_eq_companionMatrix hp]
  exact (charpoly_leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hp)).trans (minpoly_adjoinRoot_eq hp)

name: NLAlib.minpoly_companionMatrix
statement:
theorem minpoly_companionMatrix (hp : p.Monic) :
    minpoly K (companionMatrix p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← leftMulMatrix_adjoinRoot_eq_companionMatrix hp]
  exact (minpoly.algHom_eq (Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hp).basis)
    (Algebra.leftMulMatrix_injective _) (AdjoinRoot.root p)).trans (minpoly_adjoinRoot_eq hp)
