name: NLAlib.isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · intro hij; simp only [Fin.val_last] at hij; omega
    · intro hij
      simpa using hv j (by simpa using hij)
    · intro hij
      simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc] at hij
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    · intro hij
      simpa using hJ.1 i j (by simpa using hij)
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · intro hij; simp only [Fin.val_last] at hij; omega
    · intro hij
      simpa only [transpose_apply, finSymmetricBorder_castSucc_last] using hv j (by simpa using hij)
    · intro hij
      simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc] at hij
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    · intro hij
      simpa only [transpose_apply, finSymmetricBorder_castSucc_castSucc] using hJ.2 i j (by simpa using hij)

name: NLAlib.pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_corner
statement:
theorem pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_corner
    {J : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ} (hJ : IsTridiagonal J)
    {v : Fin q → ℝ} (hv : ∀ i, i.val + 1 < q → v i = 0)
    (d c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2 * q) :
    (finSymmetricBorder J v d ^ k) 0 0 = (finSymmetricBorder J v c ^ k) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  apply pow_apply_zero_eq_of_isTridiagonal_of_eq_below_add
    (isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder hJ hv d) (isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder hJ hv c)
    (Nat.succ_pos q) (2 * q) _ k hk
  intro i j
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · intro hij; simp only [Fin.val_last] at hij; omega
  · intro _; simp
  · intro _; simp
  · intro _; simp

name: NLAlib.pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_coupling
statement:
theorem pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_coupling
    {J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ} (hJ : IsTridiagonal J)
    {v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ} (hv : ∀ i, i.val < q → v i = 0)
    (d : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2 * q + 1) :
    (finSymmetricBorder J v d ^ k) 0 0 = (finSymmetricBorder J 0 d ^ k) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv' : ∀ i, i.val + 1 < q + 1 → v i = 0 := fun i hi => hv i (by omega)
  apply pow_apply_zero_eq_of_isTridiagonal_of_eq_below_add
    (isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder hJ hv' d)
    (isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder hJ (by simp) d)
    (by omega : 0 < (q + 1) + 1) (2 * q + 1) _ k hk
  intro i j
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · intro hij; simp only [Fin.val_last] at hij; omega
  · intro hij
    simpa using hv j (by simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc] at hij; omega)
  · intro hij
    simpa using hv i (by simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc] at hij; omega)
  · intro _; simp

name: NLAlib.pow_finSymmetricBorder_zero_apply_zero
statement:
theorem pow_finSymmetricBorder_zero_apply_zero
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (d : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (finSymmetricBorder J 0 d ^ k) 0 0 = (J ^ k) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv ℝ finSumFinEquiv).map_pow
    (symmetricBorder J 0 d) k
  change reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (symmetricBorder J 0 d ^ k) =
    finSymmetricBorder J 0 d ^ k at hpow
  rw [← hpow]
  have hblock : symmetricBorder J 0 d =
      fromBlocks J 0 0 (of (fun _ _ => d) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) := rfl
  rw [hblock, fromBlocks_diagonal_pow]
  change (fromBlocks (J ^ k) 0 0 ((of (fun _ _ => d) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) ^ k))
    (Sum.inl (0 : Fin (q + 1))) (Sum.inl 0) = _
  rfl

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_finSymmetricBorder
proof:
:=
  (isHermitian_symmetricBorder hJ v d).submatrix finSumFinEquiv.symm

name: NLAlib.finSymmetricBorder_superdiagonal_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finSymmetricBorder_superdiagonal_ne_zero
    {J : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ} {v : Fin q → ℝ} (d : ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ i j : Fin q, i.val + 1 = j.val → J i j ≠ 0)
    (hv : ∀ i : Fin q, i.val + 1 = q → v i ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin (q + 1), i.val + 1 = j.val → finSymmetricBorder J v d i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · intro hij; simp only [Fin.val_last] at hij; omega
  · intro hij
    simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc] at hij
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  · intro hij
    simpa using hv i (by simpa using hij)
  · intro hij
    simpa using hJ i j (by simpa using hij)

name: NLAlib.reindex_le_reindex
statement:
theorem reindex_le_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (h : A ≤ B) :
    reindex e e A ≤ reindex e e B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff] at h ⊢
  change ((B - A).submatrix e.symm e.symm).PosSemidef
  exact h.submatrix e.symm

name: NLAlib.reindex_smul_one
statement:

    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (a : ℝ) :
    reindex e e (a • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) = a • (1 : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.reindex, Matrix.one_apply, e.symm.injective.eq_iff]

name: NLAlib.profileBlockEntryBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem profileBlockEntryBound_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (t : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ profileBlockEntryBound a b t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | zero => exact ha
  | succ k => exact div_nonneg hb (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.profileBlockPart_sq_le_entryBound_sq
statement:
theorem profileBlockPart_sq_le_entryBound_sq
    {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hdom : ∀ i j, B i j ^ 2 ≤ A i j ^ 2)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hthreshold : ∀ k i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
      A i j ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k)))
    (t : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    profileBlockPart B t i j ^ 2 ≤ profileBlockEntryBound a b t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases t with
  | zero => exact (profileBlockPart_sq_le B 0 i j).trans ((hdom i j).trans
      ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ => sq_nonneg (A i l)) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
        (hrow i)))
  | succ k =>
      have hm := profileBlockEntryBound_nonneg ha hb (k + 1)
      unfold profileBlockPart
      split_ifs with hin
      · have hsmall := hthreshold k i j hin.1.1
        change B i j ^ 2 ≤ (b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k))) ^ 2
        exact (hdom i j).trans (by nlinarith [hA0 i j])
      · simp [sq_nonneg]

name: NLAlib.sum_profileBlockEntryBound_le
statement:
theorem sum_profileBlockEntryBound_le {a b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (L : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), profileBlockEntryBound a b t) ≤ a + 8 * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [profileBlockEntryBound]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have h := sum_one_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_eight L
  simp only [one_div] at h
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hb]

name: Matrix.eval_det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem eval_det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose (p m : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun ab : Fin p × Fin m => G ab.1 ab.2)
      (mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ * (mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ)ᵀ).det
      = (G * Gᵀ).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.transpose_map]
  have hX : (mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ).map
      (MvPolynomial.eval fun ab : Fin p × Fin m => G ab.1 ab.2) = G := by
    ext i j
    simp
  rw [hX]

name: Matrix.eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul
statement:
theorem eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul (p m : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun ab : Fin p × Fin m => G ab.1 ab.2)
      ((mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ)ᵀ * mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ).det
      = (Gᵀ * G).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.transpose_map]
  have hX : (mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ).map
      (MvPolynomial.eval fun ab : Fin p × Fin m => G ab.1 ab.2) = G := by
    ext i j
    simp
  rw [hX]

name: Matrix.det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose_ne_zero {k t : ℕ} (h : k ≤ t) :
    (mvPolynomialX (Fin k) (Fin t) ℝ * (mvPolynomialX (Fin k) (Fin t) ℝ)ᵀ).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  let G0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin t) ℝ := of fun i j => if j = Fin.castLE h i then 1 else 0
  have hE : G0 * G0ᵀ = 1 := by
    ext i l
    simp [G0, mul_apply, one_apply, Fin.castLE_inj, eq_comm]
  have he := eval_det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose k t G0
  rw [h0, map_zero, hE, det_one] at he
  exact zero_ne_one he

name: Matrix.det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul_ne_zero {k t : ℕ} (h : t ≤ k) :
    ((mvPolynomialX (Fin k) (Fin t) ℝ)ᵀ * mvPolynomialX (Fin k) (Fin t) ℝ).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  let G0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin t) ℝ := of fun i j => if i = Fin.castLE h j then 1 else 0
  have hE : G0ᵀ * G0 = 1 := by
    ext i l
    simp [G0, mul_apply, one_apply, Fin.castLE_inj, eq_comm]
  have he := eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul k t G0
  rw [h0, map_zero, hE, det_one] at he
  exact zero_ne_one he

name: Matrix.volume_det_mul_transpose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem volume_det_mul_transpose_eq_zero {k t : ℕ} (h : k ≤ t) :
    volume {x : Fin k × Fin t → ℝ |
      ((of fun i j => x (i, j)) * (of fun i j => x (i, j))ᵀ).det = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := MvPolynomial.volume_eval_eq_zero _ (det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose_ne_zero h)
  convert hn using 1
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  rw [← eval_det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose k t (of fun i j => x (i, j))]
  rfl

name: Matrix.volume_det_transpose_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem volume_det_transpose_mul_eq_zero {k t : ℕ} (h : t ≤ k) :
    volume {x : Fin k × Fin t → ℝ |
      ((of fun i j => x (i, j))ᵀ * (of fun i j => x (i, j))).det = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := MvPolynomial.volume_eval_eq_zero _ (det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul_ne_zero h)
  convert hn using 1
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  rw [← eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul k t (of fun i j => x (i, j))]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.pow_displacement_mem
statement:
private theorem pow_displacement_mem {r k : ℕ} (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (X : Matrix m n K) (M : Matrix m (Fin r) K) (N : Matrix (Fin r) n K)
    (hD : A * X - X * B = M * N) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (x : n → K) :
    (A ^ j * X - X * B ^ j) *ᵥ x ∈
      LinearMap.range (displacementKrylovGenerator A M k).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := LinearMap.range (displacementKrylovGenerator A M k).mulVecLin
  have hblock (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) (v : Fin r → K) : (A ^ i * M) *ᵥ v ∈ S := by
    have hcols : LinearMap.range (A ^ i * M).mulVecLin ≤ S := by
      dsimp only [S]
      rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      exact ⟨(⟨i, hi⟩, c), rfl⟩
    exact hcols ⟨v, rfl⟩
  induction j generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have hid : A ^ (j + 1) * X - X * B ^ (j + 1) =
        A ^ j * (A * X - X * B) + (A ^ j * X - X * B ^ j) * B := by
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      abel
    rw [hid, Matrix.add_mulVec, hD, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec x (A ^ j * M) N,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec x (A ^ j * X - X * B ^ j) B]
    exact S.add_mem (hblock j (by omega) (N *ᵥ x)) (ih (by omega) (B *ᵥ x))

name: NLAlib.polynomial_displacement_mem
statement:
private theorem polynomial_displacement_mem {r k : ℕ} (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (X : Matrix m n K) (M : Matrix m (Fin r) K) (N : Matrix (Fin r) n K)
    (hD : A * X - X * B = M * N) (p : K[X]) (hp : p.natDegree ≤ k) (x : n → K) :
    (aeval A p * X - X * aeval B p) *ᵥ x ∈
      LinearMap.range (displacementKrylovGenerator A M k).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have heq : aeval A p * X - X * aeval B p =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), p.coeff j • (A ^ j * X - X * B ^ j) := by
    rw [aeval_eq_sum_range' (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hp), aeval_eq_sum_range' (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hp)]
    simp [Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [heq]
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      p.coeff j • ((A ^ j * X - X * B ^ j) *ᵥ x)) ∈
      LinearMap.range (displacementKrylovGenerator A M k).mulVecLin := by
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j hj
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_displacement_mem A B X M N hD j
      (by simpa using Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) x)
  convert hsum using 1
  ext i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.rank_polynomial_displacement_le
statement:
theorem rank_polynomial_displacement_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (X : Matrix m n K) (r k : ℕ) (hD : displacementRank A B X ≤ r)
    (p q : K[X]) (hp : p.natDegree ≤ k) (hq : q.natDegree ≤ k) :
    (aeval A p * X * aeval B q - aeval A q * X * aeval B p).rank ≤ r * k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, N, hMN⟩ := (rank_le_iff_exists_mul (A * X - X * B) r).mp hD
  let T := displacementKrylovGenerator A M k
  have hcomm : aeval B p * aeval B q = aeval B q * aeval B p := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm]
  have heq : aeval A p * X * aeval B q - aeval A q * X * aeval B p =
      (aeval A p * X - X * aeval B p) * aeval B q -
        (aeval A q * X - X * aeval B q) * aeval B p := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hcomm]
    abel
  have hcols : LinearMap.range
      (aeval A p * X * aeval B q - aeval A q * X * aeval B p).mulVecLin ≤
        LinearMap.range T.mulVecLin := by
    rintro v ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change _ *ᵥ x ∈ _
    rw [heq, Matrix.sub_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (polynomial_displacement_mem A B X M N hMN p hp _)
      (polynomial_displacement_mem A B X M N hMN q hq _)
  exact (Submodule.finrank_mono hcols).trans ((Matrix.rank_le_card_width T).trans_eq
    (by simp [Nat.mul_comm]))

name: NLAlib.rank_rational_displacement_le
statement:
theorem rank_rational_displacement_le (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K)
    (X : Matrix m n K) (r k : ℕ) (hD : displacementRank A B X ≤ r)
    (p q : K[X]) (hp : p.natDegree ≤ k) (hq : q.natDegree ≤ k)
    (hqa : IsUnit (aeval A q).det) (hpb : IsUnit (aeval B p).det) :
    (X - (aeval A q)⁻¹ * aeval A p * X * aeval B q * (aeval B p)⁻¹).rank ≤ r * k
proof:
:= by
  have heq : X - (aeval A q)⁻¹ * aeval A p * X * aeval B q * (aeval B p)⁻¹ =
      (aeval A q)⁻¹ * (aeval A q * X * aeval B p - aeval A p * X * aeval B q) *
        (aeval B p)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (aeval A q)⁻¹ (aeval A q), Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hqa,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hpb, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [heq]
  exact ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)).trans
    (rank_polynomial_displacement_le A B X r k hD q p hq hp)

name: NLAlib.remainder_entry_cases
statement:
theorem remainder_entry_cases {i j k : ℕ} (hij : ProfileRemainderMask i j)
    (hi : profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i) (hi' : i < profileNeighborCutoff (k + 1)) :
    j < profileCutoff k ∨
      (i < profileCutoff (k + 1) ∧ profileNeighborCutoff (k + 1) ≤ j) ∨
      (i < profileCutoff (k + 2) ∧ profileNeighborCutoff (k + 2) ≤ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hblock : InProfileBlock (k + 1) i :=
    ⟨(profileCutoff_le_neighborCutoff k).trans hi, hi'⟩
  have hnot := not_inProfileBlock_pair_of_remainder hij hblock
  by_cases hj : j < profileCutoff k
  · exact Or.inl hj
  have hj' : profileNeighborCutoff (k + 1) ≤ j := by
    change ¬ (profileCutoff k ≤ j ∧ j < profileNeighborCutoff (k + 1)) at hnot
    omega
  by_cases hin : i < profileCutoff (k + 1)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hin, hj'⟩)
  have hi'' : i < profileCutoff (k + 2) :=
    hi'.trans (profileNeighborCutoff_lt_cutoff_succ (k + 1))
  have hblock' : InProfileBlock (k + 2) i :=
    ⟨Nat.le_of_not_gt hin, hi'.trans_le
      (monotone_profileNeighborCutoff (by omega : k + 1 ≤ k + 2))⟩
  have hnot' := not_inProfileBlock_pair_of_remainder hij hblock'
  change ¬ (profileCutoff (k + 1) ≤ j ∧ j < profileNeighborCutoff (k + 2)) at hnot'
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hi'', by
    have hlow := (profileCutoff_le_neighborCutoff (k + 1)).trans hj'
    omega⟩)

name: NLAlib.profileRemainderPart_le_div_sqrt_previous
statement:
theorem profileRemainderPart_le_div_sqrt_previous
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hcross : ∀ k i j, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val → j.val < profileCutoff k →
      A i j ≤ a / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k))
    (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) (hi : profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val)
    (hi' : i.val < profileNeighborCutoff (k + 1)) :
    profileRemainderPart A i j ≤ a / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold profileRemainderPart
  split_ifs with hij
  · rcases remainder_entry_cases hij hi hi' with hj | ⟨hi'', hj⟩ | ⟨hi'', hj⟩
    · exact hcross k i j hi hj
    · have h := hcross (k + 1) j i hj hi''
      have hsym : A j i = A i j := congrFun (congrFun hA i) j
      rw [hsym] at h
      apply h.trans
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha (sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos k)
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      exact_mod_cast monotone_profilePreviousCutoff (by omega : k ≤ k + 1)
    · have h := hcross (k + 2) j i hj hi''
      have hsym : A j i = A i j := congrFun (congrFun hA i) j
      rw [hsym] at h
      apply h.trans
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha (sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos k)
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      exact_mod_cast monotone_profilePreviousCutoff (by omega : k ≤ k + 2)
  · exact div_nonneg ha (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.entry_le_div_sqrt_log_of_inProfileBlock
statement:
theorem entry_le_div_sqrt_log_of_inProfileBlock
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {b : ℝ}
    (hrow : ∀ k i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
      A i j ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k)))
    (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) (hi : InProfileBlock (k + 1) i.val) :
    A i j ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k))
proof:
:=
  hrow k i j hi.1

name: NLAlib.two_pow_le_sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff (k : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  have h : (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 * k) ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ k) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.mul_le_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 1) k)
  have h' : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) ≤ (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm] using h'

name: NLAlib.log_le_eight_mul_sqrt_previous
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i + 1 ≤ profileCutoff (k + 2) :=
    (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi).trans
      (profileNeighborCutoff_lt_cutoff_succ (k + 1)).le
  have hlog : Real.log (i + 1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (profileCutoff (k + 2) : ℝ) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast hi'
  rw [log_profileCutoff] at hlog
  have htwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    linarith
  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2 + 1) = 8 * 2 ^ k := by
    rw [show k + 2 + 1 = k + 3 by omega, pow_add]
    norm_num
    ring
  rw [hpow] at hlog
  exact hlog.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htwo (by positivity)).trans
    (by nlinarith [two_pow_le_sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff k]))

name: NLAlib.exists_neighbor_interval
statement:
private theorem exists_neighbor_interval {i : ℕ} (hi : profileNeighborCutoff 0 ≤ i) :
    ∃ k, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i ∧ i < profileNeighborCutoff (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ t, i < profileNeighborCutoff t :=
    ⟨i + 1, (Nat.lt_succ_self i).trans_le
      ((le_profileCutoff (i + 1)).trans (profileCutoff_le_neighborCutoff (i + 1)))⟩
  have ht := Nat.find_spec hex
  have ht0 : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at ht; omega
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero ht0
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmin := Nat.find_min hex (show k < Nat.find hex by omega)
    omega
  · simpa [hk] using ht

name: NLAlib.profileRemainderPart_mul_log_le_eight_mul
statement:
theorem profileRemainderPart_mul_log_le_eight_mul
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hentry : ∀ i j, A i j ≤ a)
    (hcross : ∀ k i j, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val → j.val < profileCutoff k →
      A i j ≤ a / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k)) (i j : Fin n) :
    profileRemainderPart A i j * Real.log (i.val + 1) ≤ 8 * a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ profileRemainderPart A i j := by
    unfold profileRemainderPart
    split_ifs
    · exact hA0 i j
    · exact le_rfl
  by_cases hi : profileNeighborCutoff 0 ≤ i.val
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := exists_neighbor_interval hi
    have hdecay := (le_div_iff₀ (sqrt_profilePreviousCutoff_pos k)).mp
      (profileRemainderPart_le_div_sqrt_previous A hA ha hcross k i j hk hk')
    have hlog := log_le_eight_mul_sqrt_previous hk'
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hnonneg]
  · have hrem : profileRemainderPart A i j ≤ a := by
      unfold profileRemainderPart
      split_ifs
      · exact hentry i j
      · exact ha
    have hlog' : Real.log (i.val + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by
      have hi' : i.val + 1 ≤ profileCutoff 1 :=
        (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hi)).trans
          (profileNeighborCutoff_lt_cutoff_succ 0).le
      have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < i.val + 1)
        (show (i.val + 1 : ℝ) ≤ profileCutoff 1 by exact_mod_cast hi')
      rw [log_profileCutoff] at h
      have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
      norm_num at h hl
      linarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog' hnonneg]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_top
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_top (i : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p) (hb : ¬ b.degree < p) :
    hermiteCreation p i a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteCreation, hb]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt (i : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p)
    (hb : b.degree < p) :
    hermiteCreation p i a b =
      if a = b.raise i hb then (Real.sqrt (b.val i + 1) : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteCreation, hb]

name: NLAlib.lower_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem lower_degree_lt (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (hi : 0 < a.val i) :
    (a.lower i).degree < p
proof:
:= by
  have h := a.degree_lower i hi
  have ha := a.property
  change a.degree ≤ p at ha
  omega

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_apply
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_apply (i : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    hermiteCreation p i a b =
      if 0 < a.val i ∧ a.lower i = b then (Real.sqrt (a.val i) : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b.degree < p
  · rw [hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt _ _ _ hb]
    by_cases hab : a = b.raise i hb
    · subst a
      simp
    · have hn : ¬ (0 < a.val i ∧ a.lower i = b) := by
        rintro ⟨ha, he⟩
        have he' := a.raise_lower i ha (lower_degree_lt a i ha)
        apply hab
        subst b
        exact he'.symm
      simp [hab, hn]
  · rw [hermiteCreation_top _ _ _ hb]
    have hn : ¬ (0 < a.val i ∧ a.lower i = b) := by
      rintro ⟨ha, he⟩
      apply hb
      rw [← he]
      exact lower_degree_lt a i ha
    simp [hn]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_mulVec
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_mulVec (i : ι) (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ)
    (a : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    (hermiteCreation p i *ᵥ z) a =
      if 0 < a.val i then (Real.sqrt (a.val i) : ℂ) * z (a.lower i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hermiteCreation_apply]
  by_cases ha : 0 < a.val i
  · simp [ha, eq_comm]
  · simp [ha]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_conjTranspose_mulVec
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_conjTranspose_mulVec (i : ι) (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ)
    (a : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ *ᵥ z) a =
      if h : a.degree < p then
        (Real.sqrt (a.val i + 1) : ℂ) * z (a.raise i h) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hermiteCreation]
  by_cases ha : a.degree < p
  · simp [ha, eq_comm, apply_ite]
  · simp [ha]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_mul_interior
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_mul_interior (i : ι) :
    hermiteCreation p i * hermiteInterior p = hermiteCreation p i
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  by_cases hb : b.degree < p
  · simp [hermiteInterior, Matrix.mul_diagonal, hb]
  · simp [hermiteInterior, Matrix.mul_diagonal, hermiteCreation, hb]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose_self
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose_self (i : ι) :
    hermiteCreation p i * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ =
      diagonal (fun a : HermiteIndex ι p => (a.val i : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, hermiteCreation_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  by_cases ha : 0 < a.val i
  · have hl := lower_degree_lt a i ha
    have hr := a.raise_lower i ha hl
    have hcoeff : (a.lower i).val i + 1 = a.val i := by
      simp only [HermiteIndex.lower_val, if_true]
      omega
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (a.lower i)]
    · simp only [ha, true_and, ↓reduceIte, and_true]
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst b
        simp only [ha, true_and, eq_self_iff_true, ↓reduceIte, Complex.star_def,
          Complex.conj_ofReal, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        simp
      · have hn : ¬ (0 < b.val i ∧ b.lower i = a.lower i) := by
          rintro ⟨hb, he⟩
          have hb' := b.raise_lower i hb (lower_degree_lt b i hb)
          have he' : b = a := by
            calc b = (b.lower i).raise i (lower_degree_lt b i hb) := hb'.symm
                 _ = (a.lower i).raise i hl := by congr 1
                 _ = a := hr
          exact hab he'.symm
        simp [hn, Matrix.diagonal_apply, hab]
    · intro c _ hc
      simp [ha, Ne.symm hc]
    · intro hn
      exact (hn (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
  · have haz : a.val i = 0 := by omega
    simp [ha, Matrix.diagonal_apply, haz]

name: NLAlib.sum_hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem sum_hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose :
    (∑ i : ι, hermiteCreation p i * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) = hermiteNumber p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose_self, hermiteNumber]
  ext a b
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    simp [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, HermiteIndex.degree]
  · simp [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, hab]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_apply_of_lt
statement:
private theorem conjTranspose_mul_apply_of_lt (i j : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p)
    (hb : b.degree < p) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ * hermiteCreation p j) a b =
      star (hermiteCreation p i (b.raise j hb) a) *
        (Real.sqrt (b.val j + 1) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  simp_rw [hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt j _ b hb]
  simp [mul_ite]

name: NLAlib.mul_conjTranspose_apply
statement:
private theorem mul_conjTranspose_apply (i j : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    (hermiteCreation p j * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) a b =
      if 0 < b.val i then hermiteCreation p j a (b.lower i) *
        (Real.sqrt (b.val i) : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  simp_rw [hermiteCreation_apply i b]
  by_cases hb : 0 < b.val i
  · simp [hb, apply_ite, mul_ite, eq_comm]
  · simp [hb]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_nat_mul_self
statement:
private theorem sqrt_nat_mul_self (n : ℕ) :
    (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ) = (n : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sqrt_nat_add_one_mul_self
statement:
private theorem sqrt_nat_add_one_mul_self (n : ℕ) :
    (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℂ) = (n : ℂ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (by positivity)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_commutator_apply
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_commutator_apply (i j : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p)
    (hb : b.degree < p) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ * hermiteCreation p j) a b =
      (if i = j then (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ) a b else 0) +
        (hermiteCreation p j * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjTranspose_mul_apply_of_lt _ _ _ _ hb, mul_conjTranspose_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [hermiteCreation_apply]
    simp only [HermiteIndex.raise_val, if_true, HermiteIndex.lower_raise,
      Nat.lt_add_one_iff, Nat.zero_le, true_and, ↓reduceIte]
    by_cases hbi : 0 < b.val i
    · have hl := lower_degree_lt b i hbi
      rw [if_pos hbi, hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt _ _ _ hl, b.raise_lower i hbi hl]
      have hcoeff : ((b.lower i).val i : ℝ) + 1 = b.val i := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (b.lower i).val i + 1 = b.val i by
          simp only [HermiteIndex.lower_val, if_true]; omega)
      rw [hcoeff]
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst b
        simp only [Matrix.one_apply, if_pos rfl, apply_ite, if_true,
          Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
          sqrt_nat_mul_self, sqrt_nat_add_one_mul_self]
        ring
      · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab, Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite]
    · have hbi0 : b.val i = 0 := by omega
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst b
        simp [hbi, hbi0, Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite]
      · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab, hbi, Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite]
  · rw [if_neg hij, zero_add, hermiteCreation_apply]
    simp only [HermiteIndex.raise_val, if_neg hij]
    by_cases hbi : 0 < b.val i
    · have hl : (b.lower i).degree < p := (b.degree_lower_le i).trans_lt hb
      have hc := b.lower_raise_of_ne hij hb hl
      rw [if_pos hbi, hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt _ _ _ hl]
      simp only [hbi, true_and, hc, HermiteIndex.lower_val, if_neg (Ne.symm hij)]
      by_cases ha : a = (b.lower i).raise j hl
      · simp [ha, apply_ite, mul_comm]
      · simp [ha, Ne.symm ha, apply_ite]
    · simp [hbi]

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_commutator
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_commutator (i j : ι) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ * hermiteCreation p j) * hermiteInterior p =
      ((if i = j then 1 else 0) + hermiteCreation p j * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) *
        hermiteInterior p
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [hermiteInterior, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hb : b.degree < p
  · simp only [hb, if_true, mul_one, Matrix.add_apply]
    rw [hermiteCreation_commutator_apply _ _ _ _ hb]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · simp [hb]

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupRegularMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
theorem finiteGroupRegularMatrix_mul_apply {r : Type*} (A : Matrix G r ℂ)
    (h g : G) (t : r) :
    (finiteGroupRegularMatrix h * A) g t = A (h⁻¹ * g) t
proof:
:= by
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix' (finiteGroupLeftRegularRepresentation h) *ᵥ
    (fun k => A k t)) g = _
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.mul_finiteGroupFourierBlocks_apply
statement:
theorem mul_finiteGroupFourierBlocks_apply {r : Type*}
    (A : Matrix r (FiniteGroupFourierIndex D) ℂ) (z : G → ℂ)
    (g : r) (p : P) (a b : D p) :
    (A * finiteGroupFourierBlocks ρ z) g ⟨p, a, b⟩ =
      ∑ c : D p, A g ⟨p, a, c⟩ * finiteGroupRepresentationBlock ρ z p c b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp [finiteGroupFourierBlocks, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq,
      Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.kronecker_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
      mul_ite, ite_mul]
  · intro q _ hqp
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro t _
    rw [finiteGroupFourierBlocks, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne _ _ _ hqp, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupFourierMatrix_translate
statement:
theorem finiteGroupFourierMatrix_translate (h g : G) (p : P) (a b : D p) :
    finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ (h⁻¹ * g) ⟨p, a, b⟩ =
      ∑ c : D p, finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ g ⟨p, a, c⟩ *
        LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p h) c b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteGroupFourierMatrix, _root_.mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, map_mul,
    LinearMap.toMatrix'_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_mul_fourier
statement:
theorem finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_mul_fourier (z : G → ℂ) :
    finiteGroupCayleyMatrix z * finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ =
      finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ * finiteGroupFourierBlocks ρ z
proof:
:= by
  ext g ⟨p, a, b⟩
  rw [mul_finiteGroupFourierBlocks_apply]
  simp only [finiteGroupCayleyMatrix, Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    finiteGroupRegularMatrix_mul_apply, finiteGroupFourierMatrix_translate,
    finiteGroupRepresentationBlock, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  ring

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupFourier_conjTranspose_mul_cayley_mul_fourier
statement:
theorem finiteGroupFourier_conjTranspose_mul_cayley_mul_fourier
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (z : G → ℂ) :
    (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)ᴴ * finiteGroupCayleyMatrix z *
      finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ = finiteGroupFourierBlocks ρ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_mul_fourier, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    (finiteGroupFourierMatrix_hasOrthonormalCols ρ hu hne).conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_fourier_mul_blocks_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_fourier_mul_blocks_mul_conjTranspose
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) (z : G → ℂ) :
    finiteGroupCayleyMatrix z = finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ *
      finiteGroupFourierBlocks ρ z * (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = finiteGroupCayleyMatrix z *
        (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ * (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)ᴴ) := by
      rw [finiteGroupFourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose ρ hu hne hcomplete, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_mul_fourier]

name: NLAlib.posDef_saddle_coupling_gram
statement:
theorem posDef_saddle_coupling_gram {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hShat : Shat.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    let C
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    (C * Cᴴ).PosDef := by
  dsimp only
  rw [saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose hA]
  have hR : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hu : IsUnit (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat) :=
    ⟨⟨_, cfc Real.sqrt Shat, cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hShat,
      cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hShat⟩, rfl⟩
  simpa only [hR.eq] using (posDef_saddleSchurComplement hA hB).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hu)

name: NLAlib.saddle_coupling_gram_eq_one
statement:
theorem saddle_coupling_gram_eq_one {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    let C
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (saddleSchurComplement A B) * B *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    C * Cᴴ = 1 := by
  dsimp only
  rw [saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose hA,
    cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt (posDef_saddleSchurComplement hA hB)]

name: NLAlib.saddle_coupling_gram_order
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    a • (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) ≤ C * Cᴴ ∧ C * Cᴴ ≤ b • (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose hA]
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have he : R * Shat * R = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hShat
  have hlo := (Matrix.le_iff.mp ha).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  have hhi := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hb).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  constructor <;> apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  · simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hR.eq, he] using hlo
  · simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hR.eq, he] using hhi

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order
proof:
:= by
  let v := (hG.eigenvectorBasis i).ofLp
  have hv : G *ᵥ v = (hG.eigenvalues i) • v := hG.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
  have hn : star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    have h : (inner 𝕜 (hG.eigenvectorBasis i) (hG.eigenvectorBasis i) : 𝕜) = 1 := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hG.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i]
      simp
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm] at h
  have hlo := (Matrix.le_iff.mp ha).re_quadForm_nonneg v
  have hhi := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hb).re_quadForm_nonneg v
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    hv, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, hn, map_sub, RCLike.smul_re, RCLike.one_re,
    mul_one] at hlo hhi
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.saddle_coupling_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    ∀ i, (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self C).eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
  have h := saddle_coupling_gram_order hA hShat B ha hb
  exact eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order _ h.1 h.2

name: NLAlib.pow_sub_pow_eq_sum_mul_sub_mul
statement:
theorem pow_sub_pow_eq_sum_mul_sub_mul {R : Type*} [Ring R] (A B : R) (k : ℕ) :
    A ^ k - B ^ k = ∑ r ∈ range k, A ^ r * (A - B) * B ^ (k - 1 - r)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hmul : (A ^ k - B ^ k) * B =
        ∑ r ∈ range k, A ^ r * (A - B) * B ^ (k - r) := by
      rw [ih, sum_mul]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro r hr
      rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, show k - 1 - r + 1 = k - r by
        have := mem_range.mp hr; omega]
    rw [sum_range_succ]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one]
    rw [← hmul, pow_succ, pow_succ]
    noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.pow_apply_zero_left_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.pow_apply_zero_left_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : IsUpperHessenberg Aᵀ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (r : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (hi : r < i.val) : (A ^ r) ⟨0, hn⟩ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing i with
  | zero =>
    have hne : (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) ≠ i := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp at this; omega
    simp [hne]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : r < j.val
    · rw [ih j hj, zero_mul]
    · rw [show A j i = 0 from hA i j (by omega), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.pow_apply_zero_right_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.pow_apply_zero_right_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : IsUpperHessenberg A) (hn : 0 < n)
    (r : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (hi : r < i.val) : (A ^ r) i ⟨0, hn⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsUpperHessenberg.pow_apply_zero_left_eq_zero
    (A := Aᵀ) (by simpa only [transpose_transpose] using hA) hn r i hi
  rw [← transpose_pow] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.pow_apply_zero_eq_of_isTridiagonal_of_eq_below_add
statement:
theorem pow_apply_zero_eq_of_isTridiagonal_of_eq_below_add
    {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : IsTridiagonal A) (hB : IsTridiagonal B)
    (hn : 0 < n) (s : ℕ) (hAB : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + j.val < s → A i j = B i j)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ s) : (A ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩ = (B ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  change (A ^ k - B ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩ = 0
  rw [pow_sub_pow_eq_sum_mul_sub_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro r hr
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [sum_mul]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : r < i.val
  · rw [hA.2.pow_apply_zero_left_eq_zero hn r i hi, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  by_cases hj : k - 1 - r < j.val
  · rw [hB.1.pow_apply_zero_right_eq_zero hn (k - 1 - r) j hj, mul_zero]
  have hij : i.val + j.val < s := by have := mem_range.mp hr; omega
  rw [show (A - B) i j = 0 by simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, hAB i j hij, sub_self],
    mul_zero, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlock_kronecker_one

theorem coefficientBlock_kronecker_one (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
