name: NLAlib.finiteGroupCoefficientTransform_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem finiteGroupCoefficientTransform_mul_conjTranspose
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q))) :
    finiteGroupCoefficientTransform ρ * (finiteGroupCoefficientTransform ρ)ᴴ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (Fintype.card G : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  ext ⟨p, a, b⟩ ⟨q, c, e⟩
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    finiteGroupCoefficientTransform, star_mul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hfactor : (∑ g : G,
      ((Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (D p) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G) : ℂ) *
        LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) a b) *
      (star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ q g) c e) *
        (Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (D q) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G) : ℂ))) =
      (Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (D p) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G) : ℂ) *
        (Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (D q) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G) : ℂ) *
        ∑ g : G, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) a b *
          star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ q g) c e) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => by ring)
  refine hfactor.trans ?_
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    have hself := Representation.matrix_coefficients_orthogonality_self
      (ρ p) (hu p) a c b e
    have hsum : (∑ g : G, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) a b *
        star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) c e)) =
        (Fintype.card G : ℂ) *
          (if b = e then (Fintype.card (D p) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (if a = c then 1 else 0) else 0) := by
      calc
        _ = (Fintype.card G : ℂ) * ((Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∑ g : G, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) a b *
              star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) c e)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hN, one_mul]
        _ = _ := congrArg ((Fintype.card G : ℂ) * ·) hself
    rw [hsum]
    have hs : (Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (D p) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G) : ℂ) ^ 2 =
        (Fintype.card (D p) : ℂ) / Fintype.card G := by
      simp only [← Complex.ofReal_pow,
        Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (Fintype.card (D p) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G by positivity),
        Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
    by_cases hac : a = c <;> by_cases hbe : b = e
    · subst c; subst e
      simp only [if_pos rfl, mul_one, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.mk.injEq, and_self,
        Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, and_true, dite_true]
      rw [← pow_two, hs]
      field_simp
      simp
    · simp [hac, hbe, Matrix.one_apply]
    · simp [hac, hbe, Matrix.one_apply]
    · simp [hac, hbe, Matrix.one_apply]
  · have hcross := Representation.matrix_coefficients_orthogonality_of_inequivalent
      (ρ q) (ρ p) (hne q p (Ne.symm hpq)) (hu q) a b c e
    have hz : (∑ g : G, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) a b *
        star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ q g) c e)) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hcross).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero hN)
    rw [hz]
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, hpq]

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupFourierMatrix_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem finiteGroupFourierMatrix_hasOrthonormalCols
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q))) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have hF := finiteGroupCoefficientTransform_mul_conjTranspose ρ hu hne
  change (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)ᴴ * finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ = 1
  ext s t
  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (FiniteGroupFourierIndex D)
    (FiniteGroupFourierIndex D) ℂ => M t s) hF
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] at hh ⊢
  rw [show (∑ g : G, star (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ g s) *
      finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ g t) =
      ∑ g : G, finiteGroupCoefficientTransform ρ t g *
        star (finiteGroupCoefficientTransform ρ s g) from ?_]
  · simpa only [Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm] using hh
  · exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.inv G) _ _ (fun g => mul_comm _ _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_kronecker_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem specNorm_kronecker_of_isHermitian {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (A ⊗ₖ B) = specNorm A * specNorm B
proof:
:= by
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ) ⊗ₖ
        (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)) := hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker
    (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA) (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB)
  calc
    _ = ‖(fun ij : m × n => hA.eigenvalues ij.1 * hB.eigenvalues ij.2)‖ := by
      conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_kronecker_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA hB,
        ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
        specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hP,
        specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hP,
        specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    _ = ‖hA.eigenvalues‖ * ‖hB.eigenvalues‖ := norm_pair_mul _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [← specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hA, ← specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hB]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_kronecker
statement:
theorem specNorm_kronecker {𝕜 m n p q : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix p q 𝕜) :
    specNorm (A ⊗ₖ B) = specNorm A * specNorm B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hA⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hB⟩ := exists_isThinSVD B
  exact specNorm_kronecker_of_thinSVD hA hB

name: NLAlib.rank_eq_card_nonzero_of_orthogonal_diagonalization
proof:
:= by
  have hP : Pᵀ * P = 1 := hPo
  have hPt : P * Pᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hP
  have hunit : IsUnit P := ⟨⟨P, Pᵀ, hPt, hP⟩, rfl⟩
  have hunitT : IsUnit Pᵀ := ⟨⟨Pᵀ, P, hP, hPt⟩, rfl⟩
  have hdet := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det P).mp hunit
  have hdetT := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det Pᵀ).mp hunitT
  rw [hTd, Matrix.rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det _ _ hdetT,
    Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det _ _ hdet, Matrix.rank_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.rank_kronecker_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem rank_kronecker_of_isHermitian {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B).rank = A.rank * B.rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rank_eq_card_nonzero_of_orthogonal_diagonalization _
    (hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA)
      (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB))
    (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_kronecker_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA hB),
    hA.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs, hB.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs]
  have e : {ij : m × n // hA.eigenvalues ij.1 * hB.eigenvalues ij.2 ≠ 0} ≃
      {i : m // hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0} × {j : n // hB.eigenvalues j ≠ 0} :=
    (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun _ => mul_ne_zero_iff).trans
      (Equiv.subtypeProdEquivProd (α := m) (β := n)
        (p := fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ≠ 0) (q := fun j => hB.eigenvalues j ≠ 0))
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_prod]

name: NLAlib.rank_kronecker
statement:
theorem rank_kronecker {m n p q : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B).rank = A.rank * B.rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA : (Aᵀ * A).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  have hB : (Bᵀ * B).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B
  rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self (A ⊗ₖ B), ← Matrix.kroneckerMap_transpose,
    ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, rank_kronecker_of_isHermitian hA hB,
    Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self, Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_add_le_of_rank_sub_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_add_le_of_rank_sub_mul_mul_le
    (X : Matrix m n K) (L : Matrix m m K) (R : Matrix n n K) (r j : ℕ)
    (hD : (X - L * X * R).rank ≤ r) :
    singularValues X (j + r) ≤ specNorm L * specNorm R * singularValues X j
proof:
:= by
  let C := (X - L * X * R) + L * truncatedSVD X j * R
  have hC : C.rank ≤ j + r := by
    have hc : (L * truncatedSVD X j * R).rank ≤ j :=
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)).trans
        (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD X j).1
    exact (rank_add_le _ _).trans (by omega)
  have heq : X - C = L * (X - truncatedSVD X j) * R := by
    simp only [C, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
    abel
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (X - C) := singularValues_le_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le _ _ hC
    _ = specNorm (L * (X - truncatedSVD X j) * R) := by rw [heq]
    _ ≤ specNorm (L * (X - truncatedSVD X j)) * specNorm R := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm L * specNorm (X - truncatedSVD X j)) * specNorm R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq]; ring

name: NLAlib.singularValues_add_mul_le_rational_displacement
statement:
theorem singularValues_add_mul_le_rational_displacement
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) (X : Matrix m n K) (r k j : ℕ)
    (hD : displacementRank A B X ≤ r) (p q : K[X])
    (hp : p.natDegree ≤ k) (hq : q.natDegree ≤ k)
    (hqa : IsUnit (aeval A q).det) (hpb : IsUnit (aeval B p).det) :
    singularValues X (j + r * k) ≤
      specNorm ((aeval A q)⁻¹ * aeval A p) *
        specNorm (aeval B q * (aeval B p)⁻¹) * singularValues X j
proof:
:= by
  apply singularValues_add_le_of_rank_sub_mul_mul_le
  simpa [Matrix.mul_assoc] using rank_rational_displacement_le A B X r k hD p q hp hq hqa hpb

name: NLAlib.singularValues_add_mul_le_zolotarev
statement:
theorem singularValues_add_mul_le_zolotarev
    (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix m n ℂ) (r k j : ℕ)
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B)
    (hD : displacementRank A B X ≤ r) (E F : Set ℂ)
    (hE : IsCompact E) (hF : IsCompact F)
    (hAE : spectrum ℂ A ⊆ E) (hBF : spectrum ℂ B ⊆ F) :
    singularValues X (j + r * k) ≤ (zolotarevNumber E F k).toReal * singularValues X j
proof:
:= by
  have hpair (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) :
      ENNReal.ofReal (singularValues X (j + r * k)) ≤
        P.cost * ENNReal.ofReal (singularValues X j) := by
    have hqa : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, P.denominator.eval z ≠ 0 :=
      fun z hz => P.denominator_ne_zero z (hAE hz)
    have hpb : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ B, P.numerator.eval z ≠ 0 :=
      fun z hz => P.numerator_ne_zero z (hBF hz)
    have hleft : specNorm ((aeval A P.denominator)⁻¹ * aeval A P.numerator) ≤ P.leftSup.toReal :=
      specNorm_inv_aeval_mul_aeval_le A hA _ _ hqa ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        (fun z hz => P.norm_div_le_leftSup_toReal hE (hAE hz))
    have hright : specNorm (aeval B P.denominator * (aeval B P.numerator)⁻¹) ≤ P.rightSup.toReal :=
      specNorm_aeval_mul_inv_aeval_le B hB _ _ hpb ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        (fun z hz => P.norm_div_le_rightSup_toReal hF (hBF hz))
    have hreal := (singularValues_add_mul_le_rational_displacement A B X r k j hD
      P.numerator P.denominator P.numerator_degree P.denominator_degree
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_aeval_of_normal A hA _ hqa))
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_aeval_of_normal B hB _ hpb))).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul hleft hright (specNorm_nonneg _) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
          (singularValues_nonneg X j))
    have henn := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg),
      ENNReal.ofReal_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (P.leftSup_ne_top hE),
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (P.rightSup_ne_top hF)] at henn
    exact henn
  have henn : ENNReal.ofReal (singularValues X (j + r * k)) ≤
      zolotarevNumber E F k * ENNReal.ofReal (singularValues X j) := by
    rw [zolotarevNumber, ENNReal.iInf_mul (by simp)]
    exact le_iInf hpair
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono
    (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (zolotarevNumber_ne_top E F k) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top) henn
  simpa [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (singularValues_nonneg X _)] using hreal

name: NLAlib.exists_hss_of_cutRanks
statement:
theorem exists_hss_of_cutRanks (A : Matrix N N K) (k : ℕ) (t : ClusterTree)
    (e : t.Index ↪ N) (h : HasHSSCutRanks A k t e) :
    ∃ H : HSS K t k, H.matrix = A.submatrix e e ∧ H.RanksLE k ∧
      LinearMap.range H.rowBasis.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range (clusterOffRow A e).mulVecLin ∧
      LinearMap.range H.colBasis.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range (clusterOffRow Aᴴ e).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t with
  | leaf z =>
    obtain ⟨U,T,hT,hU⟩ := exists_mul_range_eq_of_rank_le (clusterOffRow A e) k h.1
    obtain ⟨V,S,hS,hV⟩ := exists_mul_range_eq_of_rank_le (clusterOffRow Aᴴ e) k h.2
    exact ⟨HSS.leaf (A.submatrix e e) U V, rfl, le_rfl, hU,hV⟩
  | node l r hl hr =>
    obtain ⟨L,hL,hLrank,hLU,hLV⟩ := hl (ClusterTree.leftEmbedding e) h.2.2.1
    obtain ⟨R,hR,hRrank,hRU,hRV⟩ := hr (ClusterTree.rightEmbedding e) h.2.2.2
    obtain ⟨U,T,hT,hU⟩ := exists_mul_range_eq_of_rank_le (clusterOffRow A e) k h.1
    obtain ⟨V,S,hS,hV⟩ := exists_mul_range_eq_of_rank_le (clusterOffRow Aᴴ e) k h.2.1
    let fl : l.Index ↪ (ClusterTree.node l r).Index := ⟨Sum.inl,Sum.inl_injective⟩
    let fr : r.Index ↪ (ClusterTree.node l r).Index := ⟨Sum.inr,Sum.inr_injective⟩
    have hUl : LinearMap.range (U.submatrix Sum.inl id).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range L.rowBasis.mulVecLin := by
      rw [hLU]
      exact range_cluster_basis_restriction_le A e fl U hU.le
    have hUr : LinearMap.range (U.submatrix Sum.inr id).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range R.rowBasis.mulVecLin := by
      rw [hRU]
      exact range_cluster_basis_restriction_le A e fr U hU.le
    have hVl : LinearMap.range (V.submatrix Sum.inl id).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range L.colBasis.mulVecLin := by
      rw [hLV]
      exact range_cluster_basis_restriction_le Aᴴ e fl V hV.le
    have hVr : LinearMap.range (V.submatrix Sum.inr id).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range R.colBasis.mulVecLin := by
      rw [hRV]
      exact range_cluster_basis_restriction_le Aᴴ e fr V hV.le
    obtain ⟨El,hEl⟩ := exists_mul_of_range_le L.rowBasis (U.submatrix Sum.inl id) hUl
    obtain ⟨Er,hEr⟩ := exists_mul_of_range_le R.rowBasis (U.submatrix Sum.inr id) hUr
    obtain ⟨Fl,hFl⟩ := exists_mul_of_range_le L.colBasis (V.submatrix Sum.inl id) hVl
    obtain ⟨Fr,hFr⟩ := exists_mul_of_range_le R.colBasis (V.submatrix Sum.inr id) hVr
    have hBl : LinearMap.range (A.submatrix (ClusterTree.leftEmbedding e) (ClusterTree.rightEmbedding e)).mulVecLin ≤
        LinearMap.range L.rowBasis.mulVecLin := by rw [hLU]; exact range_left_sibling_le A e
    have hBr : LinearMap.range (A.submatrix (ClusterTree.leftEmbedding e) (ClusterTree.rightEmbedding e))ᴴ.mulVecLin ≤
        LinearMap.range R.colBasis.mulVecLin := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, hRV]
      exact range_right_sibling_le Aᴴ e
    obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := exists_mul_mul_conjTranspose_of_ranges L.rowBasis R.colBasis _ hBl hBr
    have hCl : LinearMap.range (A.submatrix (ClusterTree.rightEmbedding e) (ClusterTree.leftEmbedding e)).mulVecLin ≤
        LinearMap.range R.rowBasis.mulVecLin := by rw [hRU]; exact range_right_sibling_le A e
    have hCr : LinearMap.range (A.submatrix (ClusterTree.rightEmbedding e) (ClusterTree.leftEmbedding e))ᴴ.mulVecLin ≤
        LinearMap.range L.colBasis.mulVecLin := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, hLV]
      exact range_left_sibling_le Aᴴ e
    obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := exists_mul_mul_conjTranspose_of_ranges R.rowBasis L.colBasis _ hCl hCr
    let H : HSS K (.node l r) k := HSS.node L R (Matrix.fromRows El Er) (Matrix.fromRows Fl Fr) B C
    have hrow : H.rowBasis = U := by
      change Matrix.fromBlocks L.rowBasis 0 0 R.rowBasis * Matrix.fromRows El Er = U
      rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows]
      simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero]
      rw [← hEl, ← hEr]
      ext i j
      cases i <;> rfl
    have hcol : H.colBasis = V := by
      change Matrix.fromBlocks L.colBasis 0 0 R.colBasis * Matrix.fromRows Fl Fr = V
      rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows]
      simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero]
      rw [← hFl, ← hFr]
      ext i j
      cases i <;> rfl
    refine ⟨H,?_,⟨le_rfl,hLrank,hRrank⟩,?_,?_⟩
    · change Matrix.fromBlocks L.matrix (L.rowBasis * B * R.colBasisᴴ)
        (R.rowBasis * C * L.colBasisᴴ) R.matrix = A.submatrix e e
      rw [hL,hR,← hB,← hC]
      ext i j
      cases i <;> cases j <;> rfl
    · rw [hrow]
      exact hU
    · rw [hcol]
      exact hV

name: NLAlib.HSS.matrix_clearRoot
statement:
private theorem HSS.matrix_clearRoot {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r) :
    H.clearRoot.matrix = H.matrix
proof: := by cases H <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.HSS.ranksLE_clearRoot
statement:
private theorem HSS.ranksLE_clearRoot {t : ClusterTree} {r k : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r)
    (h : H.RanksLE k) : H.clearRoot.RanksLE k
proof:
:= by
  cases H with
  | leaf _ _ _ => exact Nat.zero_le k
  | node L R E F B C => exact ⟨Nat.zero_le k,h.2.1,h.2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_hss_root_zero_of_cutRanks
statement:
theorem exists_hss_root_zero_of_cutRanks (t : ClusterTree) (A : Matrix t.Index t.Index K) (k : ℕ) (h : HasHSSCutRanks A k t (Function.Embedding.refl _)) :
    ∃ H : HSS K t 0, H.matrix = A ∧ H.RanksLE k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hRank,-,-⟩ := exists_hss_of_cutRanks A k t (Function.Embedding.refl _) h
  exact ⟨H.clearRoot, (H.matrix_clearRoot.trans hH), H.ranksLE_clearRoot hRank⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_hss_inverse_of_cutRanks
statement:
theorem exists_hss_inverse_of_cutRanks (t : ClusterTree) (A : Matrix t.Index t.Index K)
    (k : ℕ) (hA : IsUnit A.det)
    (h : HasHSSCutRanks A k t (Function.Embedding.refl _)) :
    ∃ H : HSS K t 0, H.matrix = A⁻¹ ∧ H.RanksLE k
proof:
:=
  exists_hss_root_zero_of_cutRanks t A⁻¹ k (h.inv hA)

name: NLAlib.columnSpace_finiteGroupFourierMatrix
statement:
theorem columnSpace_finiteGroupFourierMatrix (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) :
    columnSpace (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← finiteGroupCoefficientSpan_eq_top ρ hcomplete]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  let c : ℂ := Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (D t.1) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr
    exact ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos
      (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos) (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)))
  have hcol : (WithLp.toLp 2 ((finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ).col t) :
      EuclideanSpace ℂ G) ∈ columnSpace (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ) := by
    rw [columnSpace_eq_span_columns]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have he : (WithLp.toLp 2 ((finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ).col t) :
      EuclideanSpace ℂ G) = c • finiteGroupCoefficient ρ t := by
    ext g
    rfl
  rw [he] at hcol
  have hh := Submodule.smul_mem (columnSpace (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)) c⁻¹ hcol
  change finiteGroupCoefficient ρ t ∈ columnSpace (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] using hh

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupFourierBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteGroupFourierBasis_apply
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) (t : FiniteGroupFourierIndex D) :
    finiteGroupFourierBasis ρ hu hne hcomplete t =
      WithLp.toLp 2 ((finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ).col t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteGroupFourierBasis]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_card_irreducible_dimensions
statement:
theorem sum_sq_card_irreducible_dimensions
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) :
    (∑ p, Fintype.card (D p) ^ 2) = Fintype.card G
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (finiteGroupFourierBasis ρ hu hne hcomplete).toBasis
  simpa [FiniteGroupFourierIndex, Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_prod, pow_two] using hh.symm

name: NLAlib.nonempty_index_of_completeIrreducibleFamily
statement:
theorem nonempty_index_of_completeIrreducibleFamily
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) : Nonempty P
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hP
  haveI : IsEmpty P := ⟨fun p => hP ⟨p⟩⟩
  have hh := sum_sq_card_irreducible_dimensions ρ hu hne hcomplete
  have hN : Fintype.card G ≠ 0 := Fintype.card_ne_zero
  exact hN (by simpa using hh.symm)

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupFourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem finiteGroupFourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose
    [DecidableEq G]
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ) :
    finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ * (finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ)ᴴ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let B := finiteGroupFourierBasis ρ hu hne hcomplete
  ext g h
  have hh := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℂ G => x g)
    (B.sum_repr' (EuclideanSpace.single h (1 : ℂ)))
  simpa [B, finiteGroupFourierBasis_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Matrix.col,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul,
    Pi.smul_apply, PiLp.toLp_apply, EuclideanSpace.single,
    mul_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.multiset_eigenvalues_eq_of_orthogonal_diagonalization
statement:
theorem multiset_eigenvalues_eq_of_orthogonal_diagonalization {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {T P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (d : n → ℝ) (hPo : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hTd : T = P * Matrix.diagonal d * Pᵀ) :
    Finset.univ.val.map hT.eigenvalues = Finset.univ.val.map d
proof:
:= by
  have hP : Pᵀ * P = 1 := hPo
  have hc : T.charpoly = (Matrix.diagonal d).charpoly := by
    rw [hTd, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Pᵀ P, hP, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hroots := hT.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues
  rw [hc, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Polynomial.roots_prod] at hroots
  · simpa using hroots.symm
  · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _ _ => Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker {𝕜 m n p q : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q] {U : Matrix m n 𝕜} {V : Matrix p q 𝕜}
    (hUo : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hVo : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (U ⊗ₖ V)
proof:
:= by
  change (U ⊗ₖ V)ᴴ * (U ⊗ₖ V) = 1
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
    hUo.conjTranspose_mul_self, hVo.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.one_kronecker_one]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_kronecker
statement:
theorem isHermitian_kronecker {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hA.eq, hB.eq]

name: NLAlib.eq_eigenvectorUnitary_kronecker_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem eq_eigenvectorUnitary_kronecker_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    A ⊗ₖ B =
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ) ⊗ₖ (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun ij => hA.eigenvalues ij.1 * hB.eigenvalues ij.2) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ) ⊗ₖ (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ))ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA,
    eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hB]
  rw [Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
    Matrix.diagonal_kronecker_diagonal, Matrix.kroneckerMap_transpose]

name: NLAlib.multiset_eigenvalues_kronecker
statement:
theorem multiset_eigenvalues_kronecker {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Finset.univ.val.map (isHermitian_kronecker hA hB).eigenvalues =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (m × n)).val.map (fun ij => hA.eigenvalues ij.1 * hB.eigenvalues ij.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply multiset_eigenvalues_eq_of_orthogonal_diagonalization _ _
    (hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA)
      (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB))
  exact eq_eigenvectorUnitary_kronecker_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA hB

name: NLAlib.multiset_eigenvalues_kronecker_sum
statement:
theorem multiset_eigenvalues_kronecker_sum {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Finset.univ.val.map
      ((isHermitian_kronecker hA Matrix.isHermitian_one).add
        (isHermitian_kronecker Matrix.isHermitian_one hB)).eigenvalues =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (m × n)).val.map (fun ij => hA.eigenvalues ij.1 + hB.eigenvalues ij.2)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix m m ℝ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  let V : Matrix n n ℝ := hB.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  have hV : Vᵀ * V = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB
  have hU' : U * Uᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
  have hV' : V * Vᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hV
  apply multiset_eigenvalues_eq_of_orthogonal_diagonalization _ _
    (hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker hU hV)
  have hleft : A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) = (U ⊗ₖ V) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun ij => hA.eigenvalues ij.1) * (U ⊗ₖ V)ᵀ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA, ← hV']
    rw [← Matrix.mul_one V, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
      Matrix.kroneckerMap_transpose]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_one]
    change ((U ⊗ₖ V) * (Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) *
      (U ⊗ₖ V)ᵀ = _
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_kronecker_diagonal]
    simp only [mul_one]
  have hright : (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) ⊗ₖ B = (U ⊗ₖ V) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun ij => hB.eigenvalues ij.2) * (U ⊗ₖ V)ᵀ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hB, ← hU']
    rw [← Matrix.mul_one U, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
      Matrix.kroneckerMap_transpose]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_one]
    change ((U ⊗ₖ V) * ((1 : Matrix m m ℝ) ⊗ₖ Matrix.diagonal hB.eigenvalues)) *
      (U ⊗ₖ V)ᵀ = _
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_kronecker_diagonal]
    simp only [one_mul]
  rw [hleft, hright, ← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.diagonal_add]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlock_variance_covariance_bounds
statement:
theorem coefficientBlock_variance_covariance_bounds [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (coefficientBlock A).IsHermitian ∧ 0 ≤ lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A) ∧
      specNorm (coefficientBlock A) ≤
        min (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) ∧
      coefficientBlockKappa A ≤
        min (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)))
          (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hH := isHermitian_coefficientBlock A hA
  have hV := specNorm_coefficientBlock_le_variance A hA
  have hC := specNorm_coefficientBlock_le_covariance A hA
  refine ⟨hH, lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_nonneg A hA, le_min hV hC, le_min ?_ ?_⟩
  · exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hH.lambdaMax_le_specNorm.trans hV)
  · exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hH.lambdaMax_le_specNorm.trans hC)

name: NLAlib.card_profileBlockCoordinates_le
statement:
theorem card_profileBlockCoordinates_le (n t : ℕ) :
    (profileBlockCoordinates n t).card ≤ profileNeighborCutoff t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.card_filter_le_of_imp_val_lt
  exact fun _ h => h.2

name: NLAlib.profileBlockPart_sq_le
statement:
theorem profileBlockPart_sq_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (t : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) : profileBlockPart A t i j ^ 2 ≤ A i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold profileBlockPart
  split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]

name: NLAlib.profile_parts_sq_le
statement:
theorem profile_parts_sq_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    profileFirstPart A i j ^ 2 ≤ A i j ^ 2 ∧
      profileSecondPart A i j ^ 2 ≤ A i j ^ 2 ∧
      profileRemainderPart A i j ^ 2 ≤ A i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · unfold profileFirstPart; split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]
  constructor
  · unfold profileSecondPart; split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]
  · unfold profileRemainderPart; split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]

name: NLAlib.isSymm_profileBlockPart
statement:
theorem isSymm_profileBlockPart {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) (t : ℕ) : (profileBlockPart A t).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, profileBlockPart, hA.apply i j, and_comm]

name: NLAlib.profileBlockPart_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem profileBlockPart_eq_zero_of_not_mem {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (t : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∉ profileBlockCoordinates n t) (j : Fin n) :
    profileBlockPart A t i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : ¬ InProfileBlock t i.val := by simpa [profileBlockCoordinates] using hi
  simp [profileBlockPart, hn]

name: NLAlib.sum_row_sq_profileBlockPart_le
statement:
theorem sum_row_sq_profileBlockPart_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (t : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    (∑ j, profileBlockPart A t i j ^ 2) ≤ ∑ j, A i j ^ 2
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => profileBlockPart_sq_le A t i j

name: NLAlib.ClusterMatrix.frobSq_matrix_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_matrix_eq {t : ClusterTree} (E : ClusterMatrix K t) :
    frobSq E.matrix = E.blockFrobSq
proof:
:= by
  induction E with
  | leaf D => rfl
  | node dl dr B C hl hr =>
    change frobSq (Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix B C dr.matrix) = _
    rw [frobSq_fromBlocks, hl, hr]
    change _ = dl.blockFrobSq + dr.blockFrobSq + frobSq B + frobSq C
    ring

name: NLAlib.ClusterMatrix.specNorm_matrix_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrix_le {t : ClusterTree} (E : ClusterMatrix K t)
    (εD : ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (_hD : 0 ≤ εD) (hε : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ε j)
    (depth L : ℕ) (hL : t.height ≤ L) (hE : E.ErrorsLE εD ε depth) :
    specNorm E.matrix ≤ εD + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ε (depth + j)
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing t depth with
  | zero =>
    cases E with
    | leaf D => simpa [matrix, ErrorsLE] using hE
    | node dl dr B C => simp [ClusterTree.height] at hL
  | succ L hrec =>
    cases E with
    | leaf D =>
      exact hE.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hε _))
    | @node l r dl dr B C =>
      rcases hE with ⟨hB, hC, hdl, hdr⟩
      have hlL : l.height ≤ L := by simp only [ClusterTree.height] at hL; omega
      have hrL : r.height ≤ L := by simp only [ClusterTree.height] at hL; omega
      have hl := hrec dl (depth + 1) hlL hdl
      have hr := hrec dr (depth + 1) hrL hdr
      have hsplit : Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix B C dr.matrix = Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix 0 0 dr.matrix +
          Matrix.fromBlocks 0 B C 0 := by ext i j; cases i <;> cases j <;> simp
      change specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix B C dr.matrix) ≤ _
      rw [hsplit]
      calc
        _ ≤ specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix 0 0 dr.matrix) +
            specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 B C 0) := specNorm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ max (specNorm dl.matrix) (specNorm dr.matrix) + max (specNorm B) (specNorm C) :=
          add_le_add (specNorm_fromBlocks_diagonal_le _ _) (specNorm_fromBlocks_offDiagonal_le _ _)
        _ ≤ (εD + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ε (depth + 1 + j)) + ε depth :=
          add_le_add (max_le hl hr) (max_le hB hC)
        _ = _ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
          simp only [Nat.add_zero, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm 1 depth]
          ring

name: NLAlib.HODLR.matrix_error
statement:
theorem HODLR.matrix_error {K : Type*} [RCLike K] {t : ClusterTree}
    (H H' : HODLR K t) : (H.error H').matrix = H.matrix - H'.matrix
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D => cases H'; rfl
  | node dl dr p q U V W Z hl hr =>
    cases H' with
    | node dl' dr' p' q' U' V' W' Z' =>
      simp only [HODLR.error, ClusterMatrix.matrix, HODLR.matrix, hl, hr]
      ext i j; cases i <;> cases j <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
theorem darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_apply {n : ℕ} (e : ℕ → 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (i j : Fin n) :
    (darbouxLowerMatrix n e * B) i j = B i j +
      if hi : 0 < i.val then e (i.val-1) * B ⟨i.val-1, by omega⟩ j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [darbouxLowerMatrix, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  congr 1
  by_cases hi : 0 < i.val
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    let k : Fin n := ⟨i.val-1, by omega⟩
    rw [sum_eq_single k]
    · simp [k, show i.val-1+1 = i.val by omega]
    · intro l _ hlk
      have hne : l.val+1 ≠ i.val := by intro h; apply hlk; apply Fin.ext; simp [k]; omega
      simp [hne]
    · simp
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    have hne : k.val+1 ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [hne]

name: NLAlib.darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
private theorem darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_apply {n : ℕ} (q : ℕ → 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (i j : Fin n) :
    (darbouxUpperMatrix n q * B) i j = q i.val * B i j +
      if hi : i.val+1 < n then B ⟨i.val+1, hi⟩ j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [darbouxUpperMatrix, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_apply, diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_apply]
  congr 1
  by_cases hi : i.val+1 < n
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    let k : Fin n := ⟨i.val+1, hi⟩
    rw [sum_eq_single k]
    · simp [k]
    · intro l _ hlk
      have hne : i.val+1 ≠ l.val := by intro h; apply hlk; apply Fin.ext; exact h.symm
      simp [hne]
    · simp
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    have hne : i.val+1 ≠ k.val := by omega
    simp [hne]

name: NLAlib.darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_darbouxUpperMatrix
statement:
theorem darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_darbouxUpperMatrix (n : ℕ) (q e : ℕ → 𝕜) :
    darbouxLowerMatrix n e * darbouxUpperMatrix n q =
      monicJacobiMatrix n (fun i => q i + if i=0 then 0 else e (i-1))
        (fun i => q (i-1) * e (i-1))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_apply]
  simp only [darbouxUpperMatrix, monicJacobiMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, diagonal_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [Fin.ext_iff] <;> try omega
  all_goals split_ifs
  all_goals try simp_all
  all_goals try omega
  all_goals ring

name: NLAlib.darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix
statement:
theorem darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix (n : ℕ) (q e : ℕ → 𝕜) :
    darbouxUpperMatrix n q * darbouxLowerMatrix n e =
      monicJacobiMatrix n
        (fun i => q i + if i+1<n then e i else 0)
        (fun i => q i * e (i-1))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_apply]
  simp only [darbouxLowerMatrix, monicJacobiMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, diagonal_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [Fin.ext_iff] <;> try omega
  all_goals split_ifs
  all_goals try simp_all
  all_goals try omega
  all_goals have hidx : i.val-1 = j.val := by omega
  all_goals simp only [hidx]

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_eq_darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix_add_boundary
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_eq_darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix_add_boundary
    (n : ℕ) (q e : ℕ → 𝕜) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n (fun i => q i + e i) (fun i => q i * e (i-1)) =
      darbouxUpperMatrix n q * darbouxLowerMatrix n e +
        e (n-1) • terminalCoordinateMatrix n
proof:
:= by
  rw [darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix]
  ext i j
  simp only [monicJacobiMatrix, terminalCoordinateMatrix, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, diagonal_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [Fin.ext_iff] <;> try omega
  all_goals split_ifs
  all_goals try simp_all
  all_goals have hidx : n-1 = j.val := by omega
  all_goals rw [hidx]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.dmdOperator_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [dmdOperator, h.moorePenroseInverse_eq, dmdModeMap]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sub_dmdOperator_mul
statement:
theorem sub_dmdOperator_mul (X Y : Matrix n m 𝕜) :
    Y - dmdOperator X Y * X = Y * (1 - moorePenroseInverse X * X)
proof:
:= by
  simp [dmdOperator, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.dmdOperator_mul_eq_iff
statement:
theorem dmdOperator_mul_eq_iff (X Y : Matrix n m 𝕜) :
    dmdOperator X Y * X = Y ↔
      LinearMap.ker X.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker Y.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h v hv
    change X *ᵥ v = 0 at hv
    change Y *ᵥ v = 0
    rw [← h, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hv, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
  · intro h
    apply Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec.mpr
    intro v
    have hx : X *ᵥ (v - (moorePenroseInverse X * X) *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul, sub_self]
    have hy : Y *ᵥ (v - (moorePenroseInverse X * X) *ᵥ v) = 0 := h hx
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub] at hy
    simpa [dmdOperator, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using
      (sub_eq_zero.mp hy).symm

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_dmdOperator_of_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hv
  change F *ᵥ (X *ᵥ u) = dmdOperator X Y *ᵥ (X *ᵥ u)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hF,
    (dmdOperator_mul_eq_iff X Y).mpr h]

name: NLAlib.dmdOperator_pow_mulVec_snapshot
statement:
theorem dmdOperator_pow_mulVec_snapshot {m : ℕ} (x : ℕ → n → 𝕜)
    (hc : LinearMap.ker (Matrix.mulVecLin (fun i (j : Fin m) => x j i)) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (Matrix.mulVecLin (fun i (j : Fin m) => x (j + 1) i)))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    (dmdOperator (fun i (j : Fin m) => x j i)
      (fun i (j : Fin m) => x (j + 1) i)) ^ j *ᵥ x 0 = x j
proof:
:= by
  let A := dmdOperator (fun i (j : Fin m) => x j i)
    (fun i (j : Fin m) => x (j + 1) i)
  have hfit := (dmdOperator_mul_eq_iff (fun i (j : Fin m) => x j i)
    (fun i (j : Fin m) => x (j + 1) i)).mpr hc
  have hstep (k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) : A *ᵥ x k = x (k + 1) := by
    funext i
    exact congr_fun (congr_fun hfit i) (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin m)
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih (by omega)]
    exact hstep j (by omega)

name: NLAlib.charpoly_mul_conjTranspose_eq
statement:
theorem charpoly_mul_conjTranspose_eq (B U : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hr : Fintype.card r ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (B * Uᴴ).charpoly = Polynomial.X ^ (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card r) *
      (Uᴴ * B).charpoly
proof:
:=
  Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm_of_le B Uᴴ hr

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eigenvector_lift
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have : μ • w = 0 := by rw [← he, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hz, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    exact hw ((smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hμ)
  · rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec w Uᴴ B, he, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eigenvector_reduce
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have : μ • v = 0 := by rw [← he, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hz, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    exact hv ((smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hμ)
  · rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec v B Uᴴ, he, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_projected_mode_sub
statement:
theorem mulVec_projected_mode_sub {B U : Matrix n r 𝕜} {w : r → 𝕜} {μ : 𝕜}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (he : (Uᴴ * B) *ᵥ w = μ • w) :
    (B * Uᴴ) *ᵥ (U *ᵥ w) - μ • (U *ᵥ w) =
      (1 - U * Uᴴ) *ᵥ (B *ᵥ w)
proof:
:= by
  have hUU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := hU
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUU, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec w Uᴴ B, he, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.posDef_saddleSchurComplement
statement:
theorem posDef_saddleSchurComplement {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    (saddleSchurComplement A B).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hi := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr
    (isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card B hB)
  have hbi : Function.Injective Bᴴ.mulVec := by
    intro v w hv
    apply hi
    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hv]
  simpa only [saddleSchurComplement, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
    hA.inv.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hbi

name: NLAlib.symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq
statement:
theorem symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hS : Shat.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    let R
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 Shat)
    let C := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    R * kktMatrix A B * R = kktMatrix 1 C := by
  dsimp only
  rw [(cfc_fromBlocks A Shat hA.isHermitian hS.isHermitian _).2.2]
  have hRA : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRS : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  simp only [kktMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
    zero_add, add_zero, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hRA.eq, hRS.eq,
    cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hA, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜) :
    let C
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    C * Cᴴ = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * saddleSchurComplement A B *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat := by
  dsimp only
  have hRA : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRS : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hRA.eq, hRS.eq,
    saddleSchurComplement, inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hA]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.triangular_saddle_preconditioning_eq
statement:
theorem triangular_saddle_preconditioning_eq {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 B (-saddleSchurComplement A B))⁻¹ * kktMatrix A B =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * Bᴴ) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have hS := posDef_saddleSchurComplement hA hB
  have ht : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 B (-saddleSchurComplement A B)) :=
    Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₁₂.mpr ⟨hA.isUnit, hS.isUnit.neg⟩
  have he : Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 B (-saddleSchurComplement A B) *
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * Bᴴ) 0 1 = kktMatrix A B := by
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero,
      Matrix.mul_one, add_zero, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA.isUnit), Matrix.one_mul, saddleSchurComplement,
      add_neg_cancel, kktMatrix]
  rw [← he, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp ht), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.triangular_saddle_preconditioning_sub_one_sq
statement:
theorem triangular_saddle_preconditioning_sub_one_sq {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    ((Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 B (-saddleSchurComplement A B))⁻¹ * kktMatrix A B - 1) ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [triangular_saddle_preconditioning_eq hA hB, ← Matrix.fromBlocks_one,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_sub, sub_self, sub_zero, sub_self,
    pow_two, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [sub_self, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_zero]

name: NLAlib.kktMatrix_one_annihilator
statement:
theorem kktMatrix_one_annihilator {C : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hC : C * Cᴴ = 1) :
    (kktMatrix 1 C - 1) * ((kktMatrix 1 C) ^ 2 - kktMatrix 1 C - 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (kktMatrix 1 C) ^ 2 - kktMatrix 1 C - 1 =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Cᴴ * C - 1) 0 0 0 := by
    simp only [kktMatrix, pow_two, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, hC,
      ← Matrix.fromBlocks_one, Matrix.fromBlocks_sub, sub_self, sub_zero]
    congr 1
    abel
  rw [hs, kktMatrix, ← Matrix.fromBlocks_one, Matrix.fromBlocks_sub,
    sub_self, sub_zero, zero_sub, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [sub_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero, Matrix.mul_sub,
    Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc C Cᴴ, hC, Matrix.one_mul, sub_self,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_zero]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_kronecker
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_kronecker (U : Matrix m r 𝕜) (V : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (P : Matrix p s 𝕜) (Q : Matrix q s 𝕜) (f : r → ℝ) (g : s → ℝ) :
    thinSingularMatrix U V f ⊗ₖ thinSingularMatrix P Q g =
      thinSingularMatrix (U ⊗ₖ P) (V ⊗ₖ Q) (fun ij => f ij.1 * g ij.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [thinSingularMatrix, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
    Matrix.diagonal_kronecker_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, RCLike.ofReal_mul]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_kronecker_of_thinSVD
proof:
:= by
  have hAf : A = thinSingularMatrix U V f := hA.eq
  have hBg : B = thinSingularMatrix P Q g := hB.eq
  rw [hAf, hBg, thinSingularMatrix_kronecker,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix _ _ (hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker hA.left_orth hB.left_orth)
      (hasOrthonormalCols_kronecker hA.right_orth hB.right_orth), norm_pair_mul,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix U V hA.left_orth hA.right_orth,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix P Q hB.left_orth hB.right_orth]

name: NLAlib.jacobiFraction_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem jacobiFraction_zero {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (x : 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    jacobiFraction a β x 0 k = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.jacobiFraction_succ
statement:
theorem jacobiFraction_succ {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (x : 𝕜) (m k : ℕ) :
    jacobiFraction a β x m (k + 1) =
      jacobiFraction (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) x m k
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => simp only [jacobiFraction, ih (k + 1)]

name: NLAlib.submatrix_succ_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem submatrix_succ_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) :
    (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)

name: NLAlib.submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) (x : 𝕜) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) 𝕜) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).submatrix
        Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) -
        jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← submatrix_succ_jacobiMatrix]
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) (x : 𝕜) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) 𝕜) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 2)).det =
      (x - a 0) * (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) 𝕜) -
          jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) (m + 1)).det -
        β 1 ^ 2 * (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) -
          jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 2)) (fun i => β (i + 2)) m).det
proof:
:= by
  set N := x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) 𝕜) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 2)
  have hN : ∀ i j : Fin (m + 2),
      N i j = (if i = j then x else 0) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 2) i j :=
    fun i j => by simp [N, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hsub1 := submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1) x
  have hsub2 : N.submatrix (fun k => Fin.succ (Fin.succ k)) (fun k => Fin.succ (Fin.succ k)) =
      x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) -
        jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 2)) (fun i => β (i + 2)) m := by
    rw [← submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)),
      ← hsub1, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix]
    rfl
  
  have hminor : (N.submatrix Fin.succ (Fin.succ (0 : Fin (m + 1))).succAbove).det =
      N (Fin.succ 0) 0 *
        (N.submatrix (fun k => Fin.succ (Fin.succ k)) fun k => Fin.succ (Fin.succ k)).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_succ_column_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fintype.sum_eq_zero]
    · simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, add_zero, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        Matrix.submatrix_submatrix, Fin.succAbove_zero, Fin.succ_succAbove_zero]
      congr 2
    · intro i
      rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Fin.succ_succAbove_zero, hN]
      simp [jacobiMatrix, Fin.succ_ne_zero]
  have hzero : ∀ j : Fin m, (-1) ^ ((Fin.succ (Fin.succ j) : Fin (m + 2)) : ℕ) *
      N 0 (Fin.succ (Fin.succ j)) *
        (N.submatrix Fin.succ (Fin.succ (Fin.succ j)).succAbove).det = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [hN]
    simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ,
      if_neg (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm, show (0 : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) + 1 + 1 by omega,
      show 0 + 1 ≠ (j : ℕ) + 1 + 1 by omega, show (j : ℕ) + 1 + 1 + 1 ≠ 0 by omega, if_false,
      sub_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [Matrix.det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ hzero,
    hminor, Fin.succAbove_zero, hsub1, hsub2, hN, hN, hN]
  simp [jacobiMatrix]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem isHermitian_jacobiMatrix (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    (jacobiMatrix a β m).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [jacobiMatrix]
  have hv : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
    if_neg hv, if_neg hv.symm]
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 = j
  · have hj : (j : ℕ) + 1 ≠ i := by omega
    simp [hi, hj]
  · by_cases hj : (j : ℕ) + 1 = i <;> simp [hi, hj]

name: NLAlib.map_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem map_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 𝕜' : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Field 𝕜']
    (f : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜') (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) :
    (jacobiMatrix a β m).map f = jacobiMatrix (f ∘ a) (f ∘ β) m
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_kronecker_one_of_ensemble_entry_invariant
statement:
theorem exists_eq_kronecker_one_of_ensemble_entry_invariant
    {𝕜 d n : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [CharZero 𝕜] [DecidableEq n]
    (M : Matrix (d × n) (d × n) 𝕜)
    (hperm : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm n) (a b : d) (r s : n),
      M (a,σ r) (b,σ s) = M (a,r) (b,s))
    (hflip : ∀ (t : n) (a b : d) (r s : n),
      M (a,r) (b,s) = (if r=t then (-1 : 𝕜) else 1)*M (a,r) (b,s)*
        (if s=t then (-1 : 𝕜) else 1)) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix d d 𝕜, M = Q⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn|hn
  · let : IsEmpty n := hn
    refine ⟨0,?_⟩
    ext ab ce
    exact isEmptyElim ab.2
  · let r₀ : n := Classical.choice hn
    let Q : Matrix d d 𝕜 := fun a b => M (a,r₀) (b,r₀)
    have hoff (a b : d) (r s : n) (hrs : r≠s) : M (a,r) (b,s)=0 := by
      have h := hflip r a b r s
      have h' : M (a,r) (b,s) = -M (a,r) (b,s) := by simpa [hrs.symm] using h
      linear_combination (1/2 : 𝕜)*h'
    have hdiag (a b : d) (r : n) : M (a,r) (b,r)=Q a b := by
      simpa only [Equiv.swap_apply_left] using hperm (Equiv.swap r₀ r) a b r₀ r₀
    refine ⟨Q,?_⟩
    ext ab ce
    rcases ab with ⟨a,r⟩
    rcases ce with ⟨b,s⟩
    by_cases hrs : r=s
    · subst s
      simpa only [Matrix.kronecker_apply,Matrix.one_apply_eq,mul_one] using hdiag a b r
    · simp only [Matrix.kronecker_apply,Matrix.one_apply_ne hrs,mul_zero,hoff a b r s hrs]

name: NLAlib.HODLR.denseAccumulate_eq
statement:
theorem denseAccumulate_eq {m n : Type*} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n K)
    (x : n → K) (y : m → K) : denseAccumulate A x y = y + A *ᵥ x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.HODLR.apply_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem apply_eq_mulVec {t : ClusterTree} (H : HODLR K t) (x : t.Index → K) :
    H.apply x = H.matrix *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D =>
      funext i
      change 0 + ∑ j, D i j * x j = ∑ j, D i j * x j
      simp
  | node dl dr p q U V W Z hl hr =>
      change Sum.elim _ _ = (Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix (U * Vᴴ) (W * Zᴴ) dr.matrix) *ᵥ x
      rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec]
      rw [hl, hr]
      simp only [denseAccumulate_eq, zero_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rw [add_comm (dr.matrix *ᵥ (x ∘ Sum.inr))]

name: NLAlib.HODLR.actions_eq_two_mul_storage
statement:
theorem actions_eq_two_mul_storage {t : ClusterTree} (H : HODLR K t) :
    H.actions = 2 * H.storage
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D => simp only [actions, storage]; ring
  | node dl dr p q U V W Z hl hr => simp only [actions, storage, hl, hr]; ring

name: NLAlib.HODLR.storage_le
statement:
theorem storage_le {t : ClusterTree} (H : HODLR K t) (b k L : ℕ)
    (hb : t.LeafSizeLE b) (hk : H.RanksLE k) (hL : t.height ≤ L) :
    H.storage ≤ t.size * b + 2 * t.size * k * L
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : H.storage ≤ t.size * b + 2 * t.size * k * t.height by
    exact h.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hL) _)
  clear hL L
  induction H with
  | leaf D => simpa [storage, ClusterTree.size, ClusterTree.height] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb
  | @node l r dl dr p q U V W Z hl hr =>
      rcases hk with ⟨hp, hq, hdl, hdr⟩
      have hleft := hl hb.1 hdl
      have hright := hr hb.2 hdr
      have hlh : l.height ≤ max l.height r.height := le_max_left _ _
      have hrh : r.height ≤ max l.height r.height := le_max_right _ _
      have hleft' : dl.storage ≤ l.size * b + 2 * l.size * k * max l.height r.height :=
        hleft.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlh) _)
      have hright' : dr.storage ≤ r.size * b + 2 * r.size * k * max l.height r.height :=
        hright.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hrh) _)
      have hpq : (p + q) * (l.size + r.size) ≤ (2 * k) * (l.size + r.size) := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
      simp only [storage, ClusterTree.size, ClusterTree.height]
      nlinarith

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_of_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem isUpperHessenberg_of_isUpperTriangular {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hU : U.IsUpperTriangular) : IsUpperHessenberg U
proof:
:=
  fun i j hij => hU (show j < i by rw [Fin.lt_def]; omega)

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.mul_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.mul_isUpperTriangular {H U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H) (hU : U.IsUpperTriangular) : IsUpperHessenberg (H * U)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) + 1 < i
  · rw [hH i k hk, zero_mul]
  · rw [hU (show j < k by rw [Fin.lt_def]; omega), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.isUpperTriangular_mul
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.isUpperTriangular_mul {H U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H) (hU : U.IsUpperTriangular) : IsUpperHessenberg (U * H)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) < i
  · rw [hU (Fin.lt_def.2 hk), zero_mul]
  · rw [hH k j (by omega), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H) (hS : H.IsHermitian) : IsTridiagonal H
proof:
:=
  ⟨hH, by rw [(Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hS).eq]; exact hH⟩

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.sub_smul_one
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.sub_smul_one {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H)
    (μ : ℝ) : IsUpperHessenberg (H - μ • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : i ≠ j := fun h => by subst h; omega
  simp [hH i j hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne hne]

name: NLAlib.IsUpperHessenberg.add_smul_one
statement:
theorem IsUpperHessenberg.add_smul_one {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H)
    (μ : ℝ) : IsUpperHessenberg (H + μ • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : i ≠ j := fun h => by subst h; omega
  simp [hH i j hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne hne]

name: NLAlib.submatrix_borderedUpper_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem submatrix_borderedUpper_transpose_mul_mul
    (B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ((borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U)ᵀ * B * borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U).submatrix
      Fin.succ Fin.succ = Uᵀ * B.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ * U
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U)ᵀ = borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) Uᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      conjTranspose_borderedUpper_one U
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hU]

name: NLAlib.borderedUpper_transpose_mul_mul_succ_zero
statement:
theorem borderedUpper_transpose_mul_mul_succ_zero
    (B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) :
    ((borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U)ᵀ * B * borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U) i.succ 0 =
      (Uᵀ *ᵥ fun j => B j.succ 0) i
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U)ᵀ = borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) Uᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      conjTranspose_borderedUpper_one U
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    hU]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.kronecker_factorization
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.eq, hB.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial V,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q]
  rw [Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.kroneckerMap_transpose]

name: NLAlib.multiset_singularValues_eq_sqrt_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem multiset_singularValues_eq_sqrt_eigenvalues {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).val.map
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => singularValues A (i : ℕ)) =
    (Finset.univ : Finset n).val.map
      (fun i => Real.sqrt ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  have hG := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  have hs : (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => singularValues A (i : ℕ)) =
      fun i => Real.sqrt (hG.eigenvalues₀ i) := by
    funext i
    rw [← sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A i,
      Real.sqrt_sq (singularValues_nonneg A _)]
  rw [hs]
  have he : (Finset.univ : Finset n).val.map hG.eigenvalues =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).val.map hG.eigenvalues₀ := by
    simpa using hG.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues.symm.trans hG.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀
  simpa only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
    (congrArg (Multiset.map Real.sqrt) he).symm

name: NLAlib.map_product_maps
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SProd.sprod, Multiset.product, Multiset.map_bind, Multiset.bind_map,
    Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def]

name: NLAlib.multiset_singularValues_kronecker
statement:
theorem multiset_singularValues_kronecker {m n p q : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card (n × q)))).val.map
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (n × q)) => singularValues (A ⊗ₖ B) (i : ℕ)) =
    (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).val.map
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => singularValues A (i : ℕ))) ×ˢ
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card q))).val.map
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card q) => singularValues B (i : ℕ)))).map (fun xy => xy.1 * xy.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hA := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  let hB := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B
  let hT := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (A ⊗ₖ B)
  have hGram : (A ⊗ₖ B)ᴴ * (A ⊗ₖ B) = (Aᴴ * A) ⊗ₖ (Bᴴ * B) := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul]
  have heig : (Finset.univ : Finset (n × q)).val.map hT.eigenvalues =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (n × q)).val.map
        (fun ij => hA.eigenvalues ij.1 * hB.eigenvalues ij.2) := by
    have hc : hT.eigenvalues = (isHermitian_kronecker hA hB).eigenvalues := by
      rw [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues_iff]
      rw [hGram]
    rw [hc]
    exact multiset_eigenvalues_kronecker hA hB
  rw [multiset_singularValues_eq_sqrt_eigenvalues,
    multiset_singularValues_eq_sqrt_eigenvalues,
    multiset_singularValues_eq_sqrt_eigenvalues,
    map_product_maps]
  have hsqrt := congrArg (Multiset.map Real.sqrt) heig
  simp only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def] at hsqrt
  calc
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (n × q)).val.map
        (fun ij => Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues ij.1 * hB.eigenvalues ij.2)) := hsqrt
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (n × q)).val.map
        (fun ij => Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues ij.1) * Real.sqrt (hB.eigenvalues ij.2)) := by
      congr 1
      funext ij
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Matrix.eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_self_nonneg A ij.1)]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.product_val, Finset.univ_product_univ]

name: NLAlib.card_walshIndex
statement: @[simp] theorem card_walshIndex (b : ℕ) : Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) = 2 ^ b
proof:
:= by
  simp [WalshIndex]

name: NLAlib.walshBitSign_add
statement:
theorem walshBitSign_add (a b : ZMod 2) :
    walshBitSign (a + b) = walshBitSign a * walshBitSign b
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ a : ZMod 2, a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by decide
  have hone : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
  rcases hc a with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hc b with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [walshBitSign, hone]

name: NLAlib.walshBitSign_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem walshBitSign_sq (a : ZMod 2) : walshBitSign a ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold walshBitSign
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.sum_walshBitSign_mul
statement:
theorem sum_walshBitSign_mul (a : ZMod 2) :
    (∑ b : ZMod 2, walshBitSign (a * b)) = if a = 0 then 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ a : ZMod 2, a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by decide
  rcases hc a with rfl | rfl
  · simp [walshBitSign]
  · rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2)) = {0, 1} by decide]
    norm_num [walshBitSign]

name: NLAlib.walshCharacter_comm
statement:
theorem walshCharacter_comm {b : ℕ} (a c : WalshIndex b) :
    walshCharacter a c = walshCharacter c a
proof: := by simp [walshCharacter, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.walshCharacter_add_left
statement:
theorem walshCharacter_add_left {b : ℕ} (a c z : WalshIndex b) :
    walshCharacter (a + c) z = walshCharacter a z * walshCharacter c z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [walshCharacter, Pi.add_apply, add_mul, walshBitSign_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: NLAlib.walshCharacter_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem walshCharacter_sq {b : ℕ} (a c : WalshIndex b) : walshCharacter a c ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [walshCharacter, ← Finset.prod_pow]

name: NLAlib.walshIndex_add_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem walshIndex_add_eq_zero_iff {b : ℕ} (a c : WalshIndex b) : a + c = 0 ↔ a = c
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ z : WalshIndex b, z + z = 0 := by
    intro z
    ext i
    exact CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero (z i)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := congrArg (fun z : WalshIndex b => z + c) h
    simpa only [add_assoc, hc, add_zero, zero_add] using hh
  · rintro rfl
    exact hc a

name: NLAlib.sum_walshCharacter
statement:
theorem sum_walshCharacter {b : ℕ} (a : WalshIndex b) :
    (∑ c, walshCharacter a c) = if a = 0 then (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha, walshCharacter, walshBitSign]
  · rw [if_neg ha]
    unfold walshCharacter
    rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun i : Fin b => fun c : ZMod 2 => walshBitSign (a i * c))]
    simp_rw [sum_walshBitSign_mul]
    have hex : ∃ i, a i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hh
      push Not at hh
      exact ha (funext hh)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (if_neg hi)

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_walshCharacter
statement:
theorem sum_mul_walshCharacter {b : ℕ} (a c : WalshIndex b) :
    (∑ z, walshCharacter a z * walshCharacter c z) =
      if a = c then (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← walshCharacter_add_left]
  rw [sum_walshCharacter]
  simp only [walshIndex_add_eq_zero_iff]

name: NLAlib.walshMatrix_transpose
statement: @[simp] theorem walshMatrix_transpose (b : ℕ) : (walshMatrix b)ᵀ = walshMatrix b
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  exact congrArg ((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ))⁻¹ * ·) (walshCharacter_comm c a)

name: NLAlib.walshMatrix_mul_self
statement: theorem walshMatrix_mul_self (b : ℕ) : walshMatrix b * walshMatrix b = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hs : Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hn).ne'
  ext a c
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, walshMatrix, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hsum : (∑ z,
      (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ))⁻¹ * walshCharacter a z *
        ((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ))⁻¹ * walshCharacter z c)) =
      (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (WalshIndex b) : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ∑ z, walshCharacter a z * walshCharacter c z := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    rw [walshCharacter_comm z c]
    ring
  rw [hsum, sum_mul_walshCharacter]
  split_ifs
  · have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hn.le
    field_simp
    exact hs2.symm
  · simp

name: NLAlib.walshMatrix_transpose_mul_self
statement: @[simp] theorem walshMatrix_transpose_mul_self (b : ℕ) : (walshMatrix b)ᵀ * walshMatrix b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [walshMatrix_transpose, walshMatrix_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.walshMatrix_apply_sq
statement:
theorem walshMatrix_apply_sq (b : ℕ) (a c : WalshIndex b) :
    walshMatrix b a c ^ 2 = 1 / (2 ^ b : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [walshMatrix, mul_pow, walshCharacter_sq, mul_one, inv_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _), card_walshIndex]
  simp

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_of_det_sub_smul_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_of_det_sub_smul_one_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {a : ℝ}
    (h : (A - a • 1).det = 0) : a ∈ spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.mem_iff, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  have heq : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℝ) a - A = -(A - a • 1) := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact neg_sub _ _ |>.symm
  rw [heq, Matrix.det_neg, h, mul_zero]
  simp

name: NLAlib.symmetricBorder_le_symmetricBorder
statement:
theorem symmetricBorder_le_symmetricBorder (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ)
    {d e : ℝ} (hde : d ≤ e) : symmetricBorder J v d ≤ symmetricBorder J v e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  have heq : symmetricBorder J v e - symmetricBorder J v d =
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 0 (diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => e - d)) := by
    ext (i | i) (j | j)
    · simp [symmetricBorder]
    · simp [symmetricBorder]
    · simp [symmetricBorder]
    · simp [symmetricBorder, Subsingleton.elim i j]
  rw [heq]
  apply posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag Matrix.PosSemidef.zero
  rw [posSemidef_diagonal_iff]
  exact fun _ => sub_nonneg.mpr hde

name: NLAlib.leftRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem leftRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum
    (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (hJ : (J - a • 1).PosDef) :
    (symmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a) - a • 1).PosSemidef ∧
      a ∈ spectrum ℝ (symmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a))
proof:
:= by
  have h := posSemidef_and_det_eq_zero_symmetricBorder_of_schur_zero hJ v
  have heq : symmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a) - a • 1 =
      symmetricBorder (J - a • 1) v (quadForm (J - a • 1)⁻¹ v) := by
    rw [symmetricBorder_sub_smul_one, leftRadauCorner, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [← heq] at h
  exact ⟨h.1, mem_spectrum_of_det_sub_smul_one_eq_zero h.2⟩

name: NLAlib.rightRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem rightRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum
    (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hJ : (c • 1 - J).PosDef) :
    (c • 1 - symmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c)).PosSemidef ∧
      c ∈ spectrum ℝ (symmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c))
proof:
:= by
  have h := posSemidef_and_det_eq_zero_symmetricBorder_of_schur_zero hJ (-v)
  have hv : quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ (-v) = quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ v := by
    simpa using quadForm_smul (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ (-1 : ℝ) v
  have heq : c • 1 - symmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c) =
      symmetricBorder (c • 1 - J) (-v) (quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ (-v)) := by
    rw [smul_one_sub_symmetricBorder, rightRadauCorner, sub_sub_cancel, hv]
  rw [← heq] at h
  refine ⟨h.1, mem_spectrum_of_det_sub_smul_one_eq_zero ?_⟩
  rw [← neg_sub, Matrix.det_neg, h.2, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.leftRadauBorder_le_original_le_rightRadauBorder
statement:
theorem leftRadauBorder_le_original_le_rightRadauBorder
    (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (d a c : ℝ)
    (hJa : (J - a • 1).PosDef) (hJc : (c • 1 - J).PosDef)
    (hMa : (symmetricBorder J v d - a • 1).PosSemidef)
    (hMc : (c • 1 - symmetricBorder J v d).PosSemidef) :
    a • 1 ≤ symmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a) ∧
      symmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a) ≤ symmetricBorder J v d ∧
      symmetricBorder J v d ≤ symmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c) ∧
      symmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c) ≤ c • 1
proof:
:= by
  have hda : leftRadauCorner J v a ≤ d := by
    rw [symmetricBorder_sub_smul_one] at hMa
    have h := (posSemidef_symmetricBorder_iff hJa v (d - a)).mp hMa
    dsimp only [leftRadauCorner]
    linarith
  have hdc : d ≤ rightRadauCorner J v c := by
    rw [smul_one_sub_symmetricBorder] at hMc
    have h := (posSemidef_symmetricBorder_iff hJc (-v) (c - d)).mp hMc
    have hv : quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ (-v) = quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ v := by
      simpa using quadForm_smul (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ (-1 : ℝ) v
    rw [hv] at h
    dsimp only [rightRadauCorner]
    linarith
  exact ⟨(Matrix.le_iff).mpr (leftRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum J v a hJa).1,
    symmetricBorder_le_symmetricBorder J v hda,
    symmetricBorder_le_symmetricBorder J v hdc,
    (Matrix.le_iff).mpr (rightRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum J v c hJc).1⟩

name: NLAlib.frobSq_kronecker
statement:
theorem frobSq_kronecker (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    frobSq (A ⊗ₖ B) = frobSq A * frobSq B
proof:
:= by

  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.IsMoorePenroseInverse.kronecker
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_kronecker
statement:

statement:

name: NLAlib.specNorm_finiteGroupRepresentationBlock_eq_normalized

name: NLAlib.specNorm_finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_max_normalized_blocks

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_fourier_normalized_blocks

theorem finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_fourier_normalized_blocks

name: NLAlib.cyclicPadMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem cyclicPadMatrix_apply {n L : ℕ} (j : Fin n) (k : ZMod L) :
    cyclicPadMatrix n L k j = if k = (j.val : ZMod L) then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.cyclicPadMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem cyclicPadMatrix_mulVec {n L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (hnL : n ≤ L)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) (k : ZMod L) :
    (cyclicPadMatrix n L *ᵥ x) k = if h : k.val < n then x ⟨k.val, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k.val < n
  · rw [dif_pos hk]
    change (∑ j : Fin n, (if k = (j.val : ZMod L) then 1 else 0) * x j) = _
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨k.val, hk⟩ : Fin n)]
    · simp only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, if_true, one_mul]
    · intro j _ hj
      have he : k ≠ (j.val : ZMod L) := by
        intro he
        have hv := congrArg ZMod.val he
        rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hnL)] at hv
        exact hj (Fin.ext hv.symm)
      simp only [if_neg he, zero_mul]
    · simp
  · rw [dif_neg hk]
    change (∑ j : Fin n, (if k = (j.val : ZMod L) then 1 else 0) * x j) = 0
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    have he : k ≠ (j.val : ZMod L) := by
      intro he
      have hv := congrArg ZMod.val he
      rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hnL)] at hv
      exact hk (hv ▸ j.isLt)
    simp only [if_neg he, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.residue_difference_val
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ((j : ZMod L) - (i : ZMod L)).val = j - i := by
    simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hi, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hj] using
      (ZMod.val_sub (a := (j : ZMod L)) (b := (i : ZMod L)) (by
        simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hi, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hj] using hij.le))
  have hn : (j : ZMod L) - (i : ZMod L) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
    rw [hp, ZMod.val_zero] at hv
    omega
  rw [show (i : ZMod L) - (j : ZMod L) = -((j : ZMod L) - (i : ZMod L)) by ring,
    ZMod.neg_val, if_neg hn, hp]

name: NLAlib.toeplitzCirculantColumn_sub
statement:
theorem toeplitzCirculantColumn_sub {m n L : ℕ} [NeZero L]
    (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hL : m + n - 1 ≤ L)
    (t : ℤ → ℂ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    toeplitzCirculantColumn m n L t ((i.val : ZMod L) - (j.val : ZMod L)) =
      t ((j.val : ℤ) - (i.val : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.val < L := by have := i.isLt; omega
  have hj : j.val < L := by have := j.isLt; omega
  by_cases hij : j.val ≤ i.val
  · have hv : ((i.val : ZMod L) - (j.val : ZMod L)).val = i.val - j.val := by
      simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hi, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hj] using
        (ZMod.val_sub (a := (i.val : ZMod L)) (b := (j.val : ZMod L)) (by
          simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hi, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hj] using hij))
    have hfirst : i.val - j.val < m := by have := i.isLt; omega
    rw [toeplitzCirculantColumn, hv, if_pos hfirst, Int.natCast_sub hij]
    congr 1
    ring
  · have hij' : i.val < j.val := by omega
    have hv := residue_difference_val hi hj hij'
    have hfirst : ¬ L - (j.val - i.val) < m := by have := j.isLt; omega
    have hsecond : L - (L - (j.val - i.val)) < n := by have := j.isLt; omega
    rw [toeplitzCirculantColumn, hv, if_neg hfirst, if_pos hsecond]
    congr 1
    rw [Nat.sub_sub_self (by omega : j.val - i.val ≤ L), Int.natCast_sub hij'.le]

name: NLAlib.toeplitzMatrix_eq_crop_circulant_pad
statement:
theorem toeplitzMatrix_eq_crop_circulant_pad {m n L : ℕ} [NeZero L]
    (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hL : m + n - 1 ≤ L) (t : ℤ → ℂ) :
    toeplitzMatrix (m := m) (n := n) t = cyclicCropMatrix m L *
      Matrix.circulant (toeplitzCirculantColumn m n L t) * cyclicPadMatrix n L
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, cyclicCropMatrix, cyclicPadMatrix,
    ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true,
    mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Matrix.circulant_apply, toeplitzMatrix]
  exact (toeplitzCirculantColumn_sub hm hn hL t i j).symm

name: NLAlib.toeplitzMatrix_mulVec_eq_invDFT
statement:
theorem toeplitzMatrix_mulVec_eq_invDFT {m n L : ℕ} [NeZero L]
    (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hL : m + n - 1 ≤ L)
    (t : ℤ → ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    toeplitzMatrix (m := m) t *ᵥ x = cyclicCropMatrix m L *ᵥ
      ZMod.dft.symm (fun j => ZMod.dft (toeplitzCirculantColumn m n L t) j *
        ZMod.dft (cyclicPadMatrix n L *ᵥ x) j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toeplitzMatrix_eq_crop_circulant_pad (L := L) hm hn hL,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, circulant_mulVec_eq_invDFT]
