name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {J : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hJ : J.IsHermitian)
    {a c : ℝ} (ha : a • 1 ≤ J) (hc : J ≤ c • 1) (i : ι) : hJ.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c
proof:
:= by
  let v : ι → ℝ := hJ.eigenvectorBasis i
  have hv : J *ᵥ v = hJ.eigenvalues i • v := hJ.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
  have hn : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hJ i i |>.trans (by simp)
  have hlo := ((Matrix.le_iff).mp ha).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
  have hhi := ((Matrix.le_iff).mp hc).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hv, star_trivial,
    dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hn, mul_one, mul_one] at hlo
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hv, star_trivial,
    dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hn, mul_one, mul_one] at hhi
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.finLobattoSchurBorder_bounds_and_endpoints
proof:
:= finSymmetricBorder J (Real.sqrt (lobattoCouplingSq J e a c) • e) (lobattoCorner J e a c)
    a • 1 ≤ B ∧ B ≤ c • 1 ∧ a ∈ spectrum ℝ B ∧ c ∈ spectrum ℝ B := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨ha, hc, hsa, hsc⟩ := lobattoSchurBorder_bounds_and_endpoints hac hJa hJc he
  have hla := reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv ha
  have hlc := reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv hc
  rw [reindex_smul_one] at hla hlc
  refine ⟨hla, hlc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [finSymmetricBorder, lobattoSchurBorder, spectrum_reindex] using hsa
  · simpa only [finSymmetricBorder, lobattoSchurBorder, spectrum_reindex] using hsc

name: NLAlib.finRadauSchurBorders_bounds_and_endpoints
statement:
theorem finRadauSchurBorders_bounds_and_endpoints {q : ℕ}
    (J : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ) (v : Fin q → ℝ) (d a c : ℝ)
    (hJa : (J - a • 1).PosDef) (hJc : (c • 1 - J).PosDef)
    (hMa : (symmetricBorder J v d - a • 1).PosSemidef)
    (hMc : (c • 1 - symmetricBorder J v d).PosSemidef) :
    let Ra
proof:
:= finSymmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a)
    let Rc := finSymmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c)
    a • 1 ≤ Ra ∧ Ra ≤ finSymmetricBorder J v d ∧
      finSymmetricBorder J v d ≤ Rc ∧ Rc ≤ c • 1 ∧
      a ∈ spectrum ℝ Ra ∧ c ∈ spectrum ℝ Rc := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨ha, haM, hMc', hc⟩ := leftRadauBorder_le_original_le_rightRadauBorder J v d a c hJa hJc hMa hMc
  have hla := reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv ha
  have hlc := reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv hc
  rw [reindex_smul_one] at hla hlc
  refine ⟨hla, reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv haM,
    reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv hMc', hlc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := (leftRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum J v a hJa).2
    simpa only [finSymmetricBorder, spectrum_reindex] using h
  · have h := (rightRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum J v c hJc).2
    simpa only [finSymmetricBorder, spectrum_reindex] using h

name: NLAlib.rank_inverse_toBlock_complement_eq
statement:
theorem rank_inverse_toBlock_complement_eq {K n : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n K) (hA : IsUnit A.det)
    (p : n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (A⁻¹.toBlock p (fun i => ¬p i)).rank = (A.toBlock p (fun i => ¬p i)).rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := card_columns_sub_rank_toBlock_eq_inverse_complement A hA p (fun i => ¬p i)
  have heq : (A⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => ¬¬p i) (fun i => ¬p i)).rank =
      (A⁻¹.toBlock p (fun i => ¬p i)).rank := by
    let e : {i // p i} ≃ {i // ¬¬p i} :=
      ⟨fun i => ⟨i, not_not.mpr i.property⟩, fun i => ⟨i, not_not.mp i.property⟩,
        fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
    exact (Matrix.rank_submatrix _ e (Equiv.refl _)).symm
  rw [heq] at h
  have h₁ := (A.toBlock p (fun i => ¬p i)).rank_le_card_width
  have h₂ := (A⁻¹.toBlock p (fun i => ¬p i)).rank_le_card_width
  omega

name: NLAlib.lobattoCouplingSq_and_corner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio
statement:
theorem lobattoCouplingSq_and_corner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio {q : ℕ}
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (a c : ℝ)
    (hJa : (J - a • 1).PosDef) (hJc : (c • 1 - J).PosDef) :
    let e : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ
proof:
:= Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1
    let r := fun z => (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly.eval z / J.charpoly.eval z
    lobattoCouplingSq J e a c = (c - a) / (r c - r a) ∧
      lobattoCorner J e a c = a - lobattoCouplingSq J e a c * r a ∧
      lobattoCorner J e a c = c - lobattoCouplingSq J e a c * r c := by
  dsimp only
  let e : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1
  let r := fun z => (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly.eval z / J.charpoly.eval z
  have hunit : IsUnit (a • 1 - J) := by
    rw [← neg_sub J (a • 1)]
    exact hJa.isUnit.neg
  have hqa : quadForm (J - a • 1)⁻¹ e = -r a := by
    have h := leftRadauCorner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio J 1 a hunit
    simp only [leftRadauCorner, one_pow, one_mul] at h
    dsimp only [e, r]
    linarith
  have hqc : quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ e = r c := by
    rw [quadForm_single, one_pow, one_mul, resolvent_last_last_eq_charpoly_leading_div_charpoly]
  have he : e ≠ 0 := by intro hz; have h := congrFun hz (Fin.last q); simp [e] at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [lobattoCouplingSq, hqa, hqc]
    congr 1
    ring
  · rw [lobattoCorner, hqa]
    ring
  · rw [lobattoCorner_eq_right hJa hJc he, hqc]

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupNormalizedBlock_apply
statement:
theorem finiteGroupNormalizedBlock_apply
    (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ)) (z : G → ℂ)
    (p : P) (a b : D p) :
    finiteGroupNormalizedBlock ρ z p a b =
      (finiteGroupCoefficientTransform ρ *ᵥ z) ⟨p, a, b⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteGroupNormalizedBlock, finiteGroupRepresentationBlock,
    Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul,
    smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, finiteGroupCoefficientTransform,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  simp only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sqrt_card_div_smul_finiteGroupNormalizedBlock
statement:
theorem sqrt_card_div_smul_finiteGroupNormalizedBlock
    [∀ p, Nonempty (D p)] (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ))
    (z : G → ℂ) (p : P) :
    Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card G : ℝ) / Fintype.card (D p)) •
      finiteGroupNormalizedBlock ρ z p = finiteGroupRepresentationBlock ρ z p
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (Fintype.card G : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hd : (Fintype.card (D p) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [finiteGroupNormalizedBlock, smul_smul, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
  have hh : ((Fintype.card G : ℝ) / Fintype.card (D p)) *
      ((Fintype.card (D p) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G) = 1 := by field_simp
  rw [hh, Real.sqrt_one, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.size_eq_two_pow
statement: theorem size_eq_two_pow (s : ℕ) : size s = 2 ^ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ s ih => rw [size, ih, Nat.pow_succ]; omega

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.size_pos
statement: theorem size_pos (s : ℕ) : 0 < size s
proof: := by rw [size_eq_two_pow]; positivity

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_zero
statement:
theorem run_zero (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (size 0) → ℂ) :
    (run 0 ζ x).value = x ∧ (run 0 ζ x).mulCount = 0 ∧ (run 0 ζ x).addCount = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_mulCount_succ
statement:
theorem run_mulCount_succ (s : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (size (s + 1)) → ℂ) :
    (run (s + 1) ζ x).mulCount =
      (run s (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (evenIndex j))).mulCount +
      (run s (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (oddIndex j))).mulCount + size s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [run, butterfly, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_addCount_succ
statement:
theorem run_addCount_succ (s : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (size (s + 1)) → ℂ) :
    (run (s + 1) ζ x).addCount =
      (run s (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (evenIndex j))).addCount +
      (run s (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (oddIndex j))).addCount + 2 * size s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [run, butterfly, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_mulCount_succ_eq
statement:
theorem run_mulCount_succ_eq (s : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (size (s + 1)) → ℂ) :
    (run (s + 1) ζ x).mulCount = (s + 1) * 2 ^ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing ζ with
  | zero => norm_num [run, butterfly, size]
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [run_mulCount_succ, ih, ih, size_eq_two_pow, Nat.pow_succ]
    ring

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_addCount_eq
statement:
theorem run_addCount_eq (s : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (size s) → ℂ) :
    (run s ζ x).addCount = s * 2 ^ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing ζ with
  | zero => simp [run]
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [run_addCount_succ, ih, ih, size_eq_two_pow, Nat.pow_succ]
    ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_profileFirstPart_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_profileFirstPart_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hB : ∀ t ≤ n, t % 2 = 0 → specNorm (profileBlockPart A t) ≤ c) :
    specNorm (profileFirstPart A) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := {t : Fin (n + 1) // t.val % 2 = 0}
  refine specNorm_le_of_disjoint_block_bounds (profileFirstPart A)
    (fun t : T => fun i => InProfileBlock t.val i.val)
    (fun i k l => unique_profile_block i k l) ?_
    (fun t => profileBlockPart A t.val) ?_ hc ?_
  · intro i j hij
    have hm : ProfileFirstMask i.val j.val := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hij (by simp [profileFirstPart, hn])
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hi, hj⟩ := (profileFirstMask_iff_exists_fin i j).mp hm
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hi, hj⟩
  · intro t i j hi hj
    have hm : ProfileFirstMask i.val j.val := ⟨t.val, t.property, hi, hj⟩
    simp [profileFirstPart, profileBlockPart, hm, hi, hj]
  · intro t
    exact hB t.val (Nat.le_of_lt_succ t.val.isLt) t.property

name: NLAlib.specNorm_profileSecondPart_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_profileSecondPart_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hB : ∀ t ≤ n, t % 2 = 1 →
      specNorm (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t) ≤ c) :
    specNorm (profileSecondPart A) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := {t : Fin (n + 1) // t.val % 2 = 1}
  refine specNorm_le_of_disjoint_block_bounds (profileSecondPart A)
    (fun t : T => fun i => InProfileBlock t.val i.val)
    (fun i k l => unique_profile_block i k l) ?_
    (fun t => profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val) ?_ hc ?_
  · intro i j hij
    have hm : ProfileSecondMask i.val j.val := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hij (by simp [profileSecondPart, hn])
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hi, hj⟩ := (profileOddBlockMask_iff_exists_fin i j).mp hm.1
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hi, hj⟩
  · intro t i j hi hj
    simp [profileBlockPart, hi, hj]
  · intro t
    exact hB t.val (Nat.le_of_lt_succ t.val.isLt) t.property

name: NLAlib.toeplitzFFTProduct_value
statement:
theorem toeplitzFFTProduct_value {m n s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : m + n - 1 ≤ size s) (t : ℤ → ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (toeplitzFFTProduct m n s (ZMod.dft (toeplitzCirculantColumn m n (size s) t)) x).value =
      toeplitzMatrix (m := m) t *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toeplitzFFTProduct, inverseTransform_value_eq_invDFT, transform_value_eq_dft]
  exact (toeplitzMatrix_mulVec_eq_invDFT hm hn hL t x).symm

name: NLAlib.toeplitzFFTProduct_cost
statement:
theorem toeplitzFFTProduct_cost (m n s : ℕ) (columnDFT : ZMod (size s) → ℂ)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (toeplitzFFTProduct m n s columnDFT x).mulCount = s * size s + 2 * size s ∧
      (toeplitzFFTProduct m n s columnDFT x).addCount = 2 * s * size s
proof:
:= by
  let forward := transform s (cyclicPadMatrix n (size s) *ᵥ x)
  let multiplied := fun j => columnDFT j * forward.value j
  have hf := transform_mulCount_twice s (cyclicPadMatrix n (size s) *ᵥ x)
  have hb := transform_mulCount_twice s multiplied
  constructor
  · change forward.mulCount + size s + ((transform s multiplied).mulCount + size s) = _
    change 2 * forward.mulCount = _ at hf
    omega
  · change forward.addCount + (transform s multiplied).addCount = _
    dsimp only [forward]
    rw [transform_addCount, transform_addCount, size_eq_two_pow]
    ring

name: NLAlib.toeplitzFFTProduct_totalCost
statement:
theorem toeplitzFFTProduct_totalCost (m n s : ℕ) (columnDFT : ZMod (size s) → ℂ)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (toeplitzFFTProduct m n s columnDFT x).mulCount +
      (toeplitzFFTProduct m n s columnDFT x).addCount = (3 * s + 2) * 2 ^ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [(toeplitzFFTProduct_cost m n s columnDFT x).1,
    (toeplitzFFTProduct_cost m n s columnDFT x).2, size_eq_two_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.sum_even_odd
statement:
private theorem sum_even_odd {N : ℕ} {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : Fin (N + N) → R) :
    (∑ j, f j) = ∑ j : Fin N, (f (evenIndex j) + f (oddIndex j))
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin N × Fin 2 ≃ Fin (N + N) :=
    finProdFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (Nat.mul_two N))
  have he := Fintype.sum_equiv e (fun j => f (e j)) f (fun _ => rfl)
  rw [← he, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> apply Fin.ext <;>
    simp [e, evenIndex, oddIndex, finProdFinEquiv, Nat.add_comm]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.polynomialDFT_even_odd
statement:
theorem polynomialDFT_even_odd {N : ℕ} (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (N + N) → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    polynomialDFT ζ x k = polynomialDFT (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (evenIndex j)) k +
      ζ ^ k * polynomialDFT (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (oddIndex j)) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialDFT, sum_even_odd]
  simp only [polynomialDFT, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have he : ζ ^ ((2 * j.val) * k) = (ζ ^ 2) ^ (j.val * k) := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    ring
  have ho : ζ ^ ((2 * j.val + 1) * k) = (ζ ^ 2) ^ (j.val * k) * ζ ^ k := by
    rw [show (2 * j.val + 1) * k = 2 * (j.val * k) + k by ring, pow_add, pow_mul]
  change ζ ^ ((2 * j.val) * k) * x (evenIndex j) +
    ζ ^ ((2 * j.val + 1) * k) * x (oddIndex j) = _
  rw [he, ho]
  ring

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.polynomialDFT_add_period
statement:
theorem polynomialDFT_add_period {N : ℕ} {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1)
    (x : Fin N → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : polynomialDFT ζ x (k + N) = polynomialDFT ζ x k
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hp : ζ ^ (j.val * N) = 1 := by rw [Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul, hζ, one_pow]
  rw [Nat.mul_add, pow_add, hp, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_value_eq_polynomialDFT
statement:
theorem run_value_eq_polynomialDFT (s : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (x : Fin (size s) → ℂ)
    (hζ : HasRootSchedule s ζ) (k : Fin (size s)) :
    (run s ζ x).value k = polynomialDFT ζ x k.val
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing ζ with
  | zero =>
    change (Fin 1 → ℂ) at x
    change Fin 1 at k
    have hk : k = (0 : Fin 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst k
    change x 0 = ∑ j : Fin 1, ζ ^ (j.val * 0) * x j
    simp
  | succ s ih =>
    change (Fin (size s + size s) → ℂ) at x
    change Fin (size s + size s) at k
    have hhalf : ζ ^ size s = -1 := hζ.1
    have hchild : HasRootSchedule s (ζ ^ 2) := hζ.2
    have hperiod : (ζ ^ 2) ^ size s = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm 2, pow_mul, hhalf]
      norm_num
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) k
    · simp only [run, Fin.addCases_left, butterfly, Fin.val_castAdd]
      rw [ih _ _ hchild, ih _ _ hchild]
      exact (polynomialDFT_even_odd (N := size s) ζ x j.val).symm
    · simp only [run, Fin.addCases_right, butterfly, Fin.val_natAdd]
      rw [ih _ _ hchild, ih _ _ hchild]
      change polynomialDFT (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (evenIndex j)) j.val -
        ζ ^ j.val * polynomialDFT (ζ ^ 2) (fun j => x (oddIndex j)) j.val =
          polynomialDFT (N := size s + size s) ζ x (size s + j.val)
      rw [polynomialDFT_even_odd (N := size s) ζ x (size s + j.val)]
      rw [Nat.add_comm (size s), polynomialDFT_add_period hperiod,
        polynomialDFT_add_period hperiod, pow_add, hhalf]
      ring

name: NLAlib.jacobiContinuant_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem jacobiContinuant_zero {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) :

name: NLAlib.eval_jacobiContinuant_eq_det
statement:
theorem eval_jacobiContinuant_eq_det {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (x : 𝕜) : (jacobiContinuant a β n).eval x =
      (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) - jacobiMatrix a β n).det
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction generalizing a β with
  | zero => simp [jacobiContinuant]
  | one => simp [jacobiContinuant, jacobiMatrix]
  | more n ih ih1 =>
    simp only [jacobiContinuant, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C,
      ih, ih1, det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_jacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiContinuant

theorem charpoly_jacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiContinuant {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Infinite 𝕜]
    (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (n : ℕ) : (jacobiMatrix a β n).charpoly = jacobiContinuant a β n
proof:

  intro x

name: NLAlib.monic_jacobiContinuant

theorem monic_jacobiContinuant {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Infinite 𝕜]

proof:

  ⟨hJa.inv.quadForm_pos he, hJc.inv.quadForm_pos he⟩

name: NLAlib.lobattoCouplingSq_pos
proof:

name: NLAlib.lobattoCorner_eq_right
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := endpoint_inverse_quadForm_pos hJa hJc he
  have hsum : quadForm (J - a • 1)⁻¹ e + quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ e ≠ 0 := (add_pos ha hc).ne'
  dsimp only [lobattoCorner, lobattoCouplingSq]

name: NLAlib.lobattoSchurBorder_bounds_and_endpoints
statement:
theorem lobattoSchurBorder_bounds_and_endpoints {J : Matrix n n ℝ} {e : n → ℝ} {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hJa : (J - a • 1).PosDef) (hJc : (c • 1 - J).PosDef) (he : e ≠ 0) :
    a • 1 ≤ lobattoSchurBorder J e a c ∧ lobattoSchurBorder J e a c ≤ c • 1 ∧
      a ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoSchurBorder J e a c) ∧
      c ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoSchurBorder J e a c)
proof:
:= by
  let v := Real.sqrt (lobattoCouplingSq J e a c) • e
  have hγ := lobattoCouplingSq_pos hac hJa hJc he
  have hqa : quadForm (J - a • 1)⁻¹ v =
      lobattoCouplingSq J e a c * quadForm (J - a • 1)⁻¹ e := by
    dsimp only [v]
    rw [quadForm_smul, star_trivial, ← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt hγ.le]
  have hqc : quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ v =
      lobattoCouplingSq J e a c * quadForm (c • 1 - J)⁻¹ e := by
    dsimp only [v]
    rw [quadForm_smul, star_trivial, ← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt hγ.le]
  have ha : lobattoSchurBorder J e a c = symmetricBorder J v (leftRadauCorner J v a) := by
    simp only [lobattoSchurBorder, leftRadauCorner, hqa, lobattoCorner, v]
  have hc : lobattoSchurBorder J e a c = symmetricBorder J v (rightRadauCorner J v c) := by
    rw [lobattoSchurBorder, lobattoCorner_eq_right hJa hJc he]
    simp only [rightRadauCorner, hqc, v]
  obtain ⟨hpa, hsa⟩ := leftRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum J v a hJa
  obtain ⟨hpc, hsc⟩ := rightRadauBorder_posSemidef_shift_and_mem_spectrum J v c hJc
  exact ⟨ha ▸ (Matrix.le_iff).mpr hpa, hc ▸ (Matrix.le_iff).mpr hpc, ha ▸ hsa, hc ▸ hsc⟩

name: NLAlib.coefficientVariance_kronecker
statement:
theorem coefficientVariance_kronecker
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    coefficientVariance (fun ik : ι×κ => A ik.1⊗ₖB ik.2) =
      coefficientVariance A⊗ₖcoefficientVariance B
proof:
:= by
  ext ab ce
  simp only [coefficientVariance,Matrix.sum_apply,Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,Finset.sum_mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.coefficientCovariance_kronecker_reindex
statement:
theorem coefficientCovariance_kronecker_reindex
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (coefficientCovariance (fun ik : ι×κ => A ik.1⊗ₖB ik.2)).reindex
      (Equiv.prodProdProdComm d n d n) (Equiv.prodProdProdComm d n d n) =
        coefficientCovariance A⊗ₖcoefficientCovariance B
proof:
:= by
  ext abrs cetu
  simp only [coefficientCovariance,coefficientVectorization,Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,Matrix.reindex_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Equiv.prodProdProdComm_symm,Equiv.prodProdProdComm_apply,Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type,star_mul,Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCovariance (fun ik : ι×κ => A ik.1⊗ₖB ik.2)) =
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)*specNorm (coefficientCovariance B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← specNorm_reindex _ (Equiv.prodProdProdComm d n d n)
    (Equiv.prodProdProdComm d n d n),coefficientCovariance_kronecker_reindex,
    specNorm_kronecker]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientVariance_kronecker
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientVariance_kronecker
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientVariance (fun ik : ι×κ => A ik.1⊗ₖB ik.2)) =
      specNorm (coefficientVariance A)*specNorm (coefficientVariance B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientVariance_kronecker,specNorm_kronecker]

name: NLAlib.log_profilePreviousCutoff
statement:
theorem log_profilePreviousCutoff (k : ℕ) :
    Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [profilePreviousCutoff, Real.log_pow]

name: NLAlib.log_profilePreviousCutoff_pos
statement:
theorem log_profilePreviousCutoff_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.log_pos
  exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 1 < 2) (two_le_profilePreviousCutoff k)

name: NLAlib.half_le_log_two
statement: private theorem half_le_log_two : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.sqrt_two_pow_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_four
statement:
theorem sqrt_two_pow_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_four (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt ((2 ^ (k + 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) /
      Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ)) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (log_profilePreviousCutoff_pos k))).mpr
  have hp : ((2 ^ (k + 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      16 * Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ) := by
    rw [log_profilePreviousCutoff, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_add]
    norm_num
    have hpow : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left half_le_log_two (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k)]
  have h := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hp
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 16),
    show (16 : ℝ) = 4 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.profileCutoff_succ_eq_two_pow_two_mul
statement:
theorem profileCutoff_succ_eq_two_pow_two_mul (t : ℕ) :
    profileCutoff (t + 1) = 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold profileCutoff
  rw [show t + 1 + 1 = (t + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
  congr 1
  omega

name: NLAlib.one_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem one_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_two_mul_pow (k : ℕ) :
    1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hroot : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log 2) :=
    Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith [half_le_log_two])
  have hinv : 1 / Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2))).mpr
    have h : (4 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
    linarith
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simp only [profilePreviousCutoff, pow_zero, pow_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)))).mpr
      linarith
  | succ k ih =>
      have hlog : Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff (k + 1) : ℝ) =
          2 * Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ) := by
        rw [log_profilePreviousCutoff, log_profilePreviousCutoff, pow_succ]
        ring
      rw [hlog, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ← one_div_mul_one_div_rev]
      calc
        _ ≤ (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k) * (3 / 4) := mul_le_mul ih hinv
          (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.sum_one_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_eight
statement:
theorem sum_one_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_eight (L : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range L, 1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k : ℝ))) ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  have hgeom : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range L, (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k) ≤ 4 := by
    rw [geom_sum_eq (by norm_num : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
    have hpow : 0 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ L := by positivity
    apply (div_le_iff_of_neg (by norm_num : (3 / 4 : ℝ) - 1 < 0)).mpr
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range L, 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => one_div_sqrt_log_previous_le_two_mul_pow k
    _ = 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range L, (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ 8 := by linarith

name: Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec_star_mulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mulVec_star_mulVec {m : Type*} [Fintype m]
    (S : Matrix m d 𝕜) (x : d → 𝕜) :
    vecMulVec (S *ᵥ x) (star (S *ᵥ x)) = S * vecMulVec x (star x) * Sᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_mul, star_mulVec]

name: Matrix.neg_one_le_vecMulVec_sub_one
statement:
theorem neg_one_le_vecMulVec_sub_one (x : d → 𝕜) :
    -(1 : Matrix d d 𝕜) ≤ vecMulVec x (star x) - 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zero_sub] using sub_le_sub_right
    (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star x).nonneg (1 : Matrix d d 𝕜)

name: Matrix.one_sub_vecMulVec_le_one
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_le_one (x : d → 𝕜) :
    (1 : Matrix d d 𝕜) - vecMulVec x (star x) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  sub_le_self _ (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star x).nonneg

name: Matrix.inv_neg_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.inv_neg_of_isUnit {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A) : (-A)⁻¹ = -A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [neg_mul_neg]
  exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA)

name: NLAlib.leftRadauCorner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio
statement:
theorem leftRadauCorner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio {q : ℕ}
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (b a : ℝ)
    (hJ : IsUnit (a • 1 - J)) :
    leftRadauCorner J (Pi.single (Fin.last q) b) a =
      a - b ^ 2 * (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly.eval a / J.charpoly.eval a
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (J - a • 1)⁻¹ = -(a • 1 - J)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← neg_sub (a • 1) J, Matrix.inv_neg_of_isUnit hJ]
  rw [leftRadauCorner, hi, quadForm_single, Matrix.neg_apply,
    resolvent_last_last_eq_charpoly_leading_div_charpoly]
  ring

name: NLAlib.rightRadauCorner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio
statement:
theorem rightRadauCorner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio {q : ℕ}
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (b c : ℝ) :
    rightRadauCorner J (Pi.single (Fin.last q) b) c =
      c - b ^ 2 * (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly.eval c / J.charpoly.eval c
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightRadauCorner, quadForm_single, resolvent_last_last_eq_charpoly_leading_div_charpoly]
  ring

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.hasRootSchedule_of_isPrimitiveRoot
statement:
theorem hasRootSchedule_of_isPrimitiveRoot (s : ℕ) {ζ : ℂ}
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (size s)) : HasRootSchedule s ζ
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing ζ with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ s ih =>
    have hpow : (ζ ^ size s) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_two]
      exact hζ.pow_eq_one
    have hne : ζ ^ size s ≠ 1 := hζ.pow_ne_one_of_pos_of_lt (size_pos s).ne' (by
      change size s < size s + size s
      have hs := size_pos s
      omega)
    have hhalf : ζ ^ size s = -1 := (sq_eq_one_iff.mp hpow).resolve_left hne
    have hprod : size (s + 1) = 2 * size s := by simp only [size]; omega
    exact ⟨hhalf, ih (IsPrimitiveRoot.pow (size_pos (s + 1)) hζ hprod)⟩

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.standardRoot_pow
statement:
theorem standardRoot_pow {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (k : ℕ) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-1 : ZMod n) ^ k = ZMod.stdAddChar (-(k : ZMod n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow]
  congr 1
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_neg, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.isPrimitiveRoot_standardRoot
statement:
theorem isPrimitiveRoot_standardRoot {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (ZMod.stdAddChar (-1 : ZMod n)) n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [standardRoot_pow]
    simp
  · intro k hk
    have hchar : ZMod.stdAddChar (-(k : ZMod n)) = ZMod.stdAddChar (0 : ZMod n) := by
      rw [← standardRoot_pow, hk, AddChar.map_zero_eq_one]
    have hzero : (k : ZMod n) = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp (ZMod.injective_stdAddChar hchar)
    exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff k n).mp hzero

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.hasRootSchedule_standardRoot
statement:
theorem hasRootSchedule_standardRoot (s : ℕ) :
    HasRootSchedule s (ZMod.stdAddChar (-1 : ZMod (size s)))
proof:
:=
  hasRootSchedule_of_isPrimitiveRoot s isPrimitiveRoot_standardRoot

name: NLAlib.ConformalBlockDiagonal.mul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i j hij
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro t _
  change A i t * B t j = 0
  by_cases hit : row i = mid t
  · rw [hB t j (by simpa [← hit] using hij), mul_zero]
  · rw [hA i t hit, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.ConformalBlockDiagonal.conjTranspose
statement:
theorem conjTranspose {A : Matrix m n K} (hA : ConformalBlockDiagonal A row mid) :
    ConformalBlockDiagonal Aᴴ mid row
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hA j i hij.symm]

name: NLAlib.ConformalBlockDiagonal.sub
statement:
theorem sub {A B : Matrix m n K} (hA : ConformalBlockDiagonal A row mid)
    (hB : ConformalBlockDiagonal B row mid) : ConformalBlockDiagonal (A - B) row mid
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  simp [hA i j hij, hB i j hij]

name: NLAlib.ConformalBlockDiagonal.inv
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr hunit).invertible
  have hu : Matrix.BlockTriangular A row := fun i j h => hA i j (ne_of_gt h)
  have hd : Matrix.BlockTriangular A (fun i => OrderDual.toDual (row i)) :=
    fun i j h => hA i j (ne_of_lt h)
  have hui := Matrix.blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular hu
  have hdi := Matrix.blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular hd
  intro i j hij
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact hdi h
  · exact hui h

name: NLAlib.HSS.cacheValue_upwardPass
statement:
theorem cacheValue_upwardPass {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r) (x : t.Index → K) :
    H.cacheValue (H.upwardPass x) = H.upward x
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D U V => rfl
  | node dl dr E F B C hl hr =>
    change HODLR.denseAccumulate Fᴴ
      (Sum.elim (dl.cacheValue (dl.upwardPass (x ∘ Sum.inl)))
        (dr.cacheValue (dr.upwardPass (x ∘ Sum.inr)))) 0 =
      HODLR.denseAccumulate Fᴴ
        (Sum.elim (dl.upward (x ∘ Sum.inl)) (dr.upward (x ∘ Sum.inr))) 0
    rw [hl, hr]

name: NLAlib.HSS.downwardPass_upwardPass
statement:
theorem downwardPass_upwardPass {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r)
    (x : t.Index → K) (z : Fin r → K) :
    H.downwardPass (H.upwardPass x) x z = H.downward x z
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D U V => rfl
  | node dl dr E F B C hl hr =>
    simp [downwardPass, upwardPass, cacheValue_upwardPass, downward, hl, hr]

name: NLAlib.HSS.rank_le_of_ranksLE
statement:
theorem rank_le_of_ranksLE {t : ClusterTree} {r k : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r)
    (h : H.RanksLE k) : r ≤ k
proof:
:= by cases H with
  | leaf D U V => exact h
  | node dl dr E F B C => exact h.1

name: NLAlib.HSS.upward_eq
statement:
theorem upward_eq {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r) (x : t.Index → K) :
    H.upward x = H.colBasisᴴ *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D U V => simp [upward, colBasis, HODLR.denseAccumulate_eq]
  | node dl dr E F B C hl hr =>
      change HODLR.denseAccumulate Fᴴ
        (Sum.elim (dl.upward (x ∘ Sum.inl)) (dr.upward (x ∘ Sum.inr))) 0 =
          (Matrix.fromBlocks dl.colBasis 0 0 dr.colBasis * F)ᴴ *ᵥ x
      rw [HODLR.denseAccumulate_eq, zero_add, hl, hr, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
        Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec,
        Matrix.zero_mulVec, add_zero, zero_add]

name: NLAlib.HSS.downward_eq
statement:
theorem downward_eq {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r)
    (x : t.Index → K) (z : Fin r → K) :
    H.downward x z = H.matrix *ᵥ x + H.rowBasis *ᵥ z
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D U V => simp [downward, matrix, rowBasis, HODLR.denseAccumulate_eq]
  | node dl dr E F B C hl hr =>
      change (HSS.node dl dr E F B C).downward x z =
        Matrix.fromBlocks dl.matrix (dl.rowBasis * B * dr.colBasisᴴ)
          (dr.rowBasis * C * dl.colBasisᴴ) dr.matrix *ᵥ x +
        (Matrix.fromBlocks dl.rowBasis 0 0 dr.rowBasis * E) *ᵥ z
      simp only [downward, HODLR.denseAccumulate_eq, zero_add, hl, hr, upward_eq]
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec z, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec]
      funext i
      cases i <;> simp [Pi.add_apply, Function.comp_def, Matrix.mulVec_add,
        ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        add_left_comm, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.HSS.downward_zero_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem downward_zero_eq_mulVec {t : ClusterTree} (H : HSS K t 0) (x : t.Index → K) :
    H.downward x 0 = H.matrix *ᵥ x
proof: := by rw [downward_eq]; simp

name: NLAlib.HSS.downwardPass_upwardPass_zero_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem downwardPass_upwardPass_zero_eq_mulVec {t : ClusterTree} (H : HSS K t 0)
    (x : t.Index → K) : H.downwardPass (H.upwardPass x) x 0 = H.matrix *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [downwardPass_upwardPass, downward_zero_eq_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.HSS.actions_eq_two_mul_storage
statement:
theorem actions_eq_two_mul_storage {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r) :
    H.actions = 2 * H.storage
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D U V => simp only [actions, storage]; ring
  | node dl dr E F B C hl hr => simp only [actions, storage, hl, hr]; ring

name: NLAlib.HSS.storage_le
statement:
theorem storage_le {t : ClusterTree} {r : ℕ} (H : HSS K t r) (b k : ℕ)
    (hb : t.LeafSizeLE b) (hk : H.RanksLE k) :
    H.storage ≤ t.size * b + 2 * t.size * k + 6 * k ^ 2 * (t.leafCount - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | leaf D U V =>
      simp only [storage, ClusterTree.size, ClusterTree.leafCount, Nat.sub_self,
        mul_zero, add_zero]
      exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hk)
  | @node l r p q s dl dr E F B C hl hr =>
      rcases hk with ⟨hs, hdl, hdr⟩
      have hp : p ≤ k := dl.rank_le_of_ranksLE hdl
      have hq : q ≤ k := dr.rank_le_of_ranksLE hdr
      have hlc : 1 ≤ l.leafCount := l.leafCount_pos
      have hrc : 1 ≤ r.leafCount := r.leafCount_pos
      have hcost : 2 * (p + q) * s + 2 * p * q ≤ 6 * k ^ 2 := by
        calc
          _ ≤ 2 * (k + k) * k + 2 * k * k := by gcongr
          _ = _ := by ring
      have hleft := hl hb.1 hdl
      have hright := hr hb.2 hdr
      simp only [storage, ClusterTree.size, ClusterTree.leafCount]
      have hc : l.leafCount + r.leafCount - 1 = (l.leafCount - 1) + (r.leafCount - 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hc]
      nlinarith

name: NLAlib.HSS.storage_le_ten_mul_size_mul_rank
statement:
theorem storage_le_ten_mul_size_mul_rank {t : ClusterTree} (H : HSS K t 0) (k : ℕ)
    (_hkpos : 1 ≤ k) (hlower : t.LeafSizeGE k) (hupper : t.LeafSizeLE (2 * k))
    (hk : H.RanksLE k) : H.storage ≤ 10 * t.size * k
proof:
:= by
  have h := H.storage_le (2 * k) k hupper hk
  have hleaves := t.mul_leafCount_le_size k hlower
  have hsub : t.leafCount - 1 ≤ t.leafCount := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hbudget : 6 * k ^ 2 * (t.leafCount - 1) ≤ 6 * t.size * k := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 6 * k ^ 2 * t.leafCount := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsub
      _ = (6 * k) * (k * t.leafCount) := by ring
      _ ≤ (6 * k) * t.size := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hleaves
      _ = _ := by ring
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.blockHankel_zero_eq
statement:
theorem blockHankel_zero_eq (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜) (C : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (s t : ℕ) : blockHankel A B C s t 0 =
      observabilityArray A C s * controllabilityArray A B t
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change (C * A ^ (i.1.val + j.1.val + 0) * B) i.2 j.2 =
    ((C * A ^ i.1.val) * (A ^ j.1.val * B)) i.2 j.2
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, pow_add, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.blockHankel_one_eq
statement:
theorem blockHankel_one_eq (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜) (C : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (s t : ℕ) : blockHankel A B C s t 1 =
      observabilityArray A C s * A * controllabilityArray A B t
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hp : A ^ (i.1.val + j.1.val + 1) = A ^ i.1.val * A * A ^ j.1.val := by
    rw [← pow_succ, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  change (C * A ^ (i.1.val + j.1.val + 1) * B) i.2 j.2 =
    (((C * A ^ i.1.val) * A) * (A ^ j.1.val * B)) i.2 j.2
  rw [hp]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.controllabilityArray_mul_firstBlockInput
statement:
theorem controllabilityArray_mul_firstBlockInput (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) : controllabilityArray A B t * firstBlockInput t ht = B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, firstBlockInput, controllabilityArray,
    Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.firstBlockOutput_mul_observabilityArray
statement:
theorem firstBlockOutput_mul_observabilityArray (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (C : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) : firstBlockOutput s hs * observabilityArray A C s = C
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, firstBlockOutput, observabilityArray,
    Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.era_similarity
proof:
:= balancingTrialMap (controllabilityArray A B t) V σ
    IsUnit T ∧
      eraStateMatrix (blockHankel A B C s t 1) U V σ = T⁻¹ * A * T ∧
      eraInputMatrix V σ (firstBlockInput t ht) = T⁻¹ * B ∧
      eraOutputMatrix U σ (firstBlockOutput s hs) = C * T := by
  let O := observabilityArray A C s
  let R := controllabilityArray A B t
  let D := invSqrtDiagonal (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ
  let S := diagonal (fun i => (σ i : 𝕜))
  have hh : IsThinSVD (O * R) U V σ := by
    simpa only [O, R, ← blockHankel_zero_eq] using h
  have hp := hh.isSingularTripletFamily
  obtain ⟨hunit, hinv, -, -, -⟩ := hp.full_gramian_balancing
  have hD : Dᴴ = D := invSqrtDiagonal_isHermitian σ
  have hinv' : (balancingTrialMap R V σ)⁻¹ = D * Uᴴ * O := by
    rw [hinv]
    simp only [balancingTestMap, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      (invSqrtDiagonal_isHermitian σ).eq, D, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨hunit, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [blockHankel_one_eq, hinv']
    simp only [eraStateMatrix, balancingTrialMap, O, R, D, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  · have hleft : Uᴴ * (O * R) = S * Vᴴ := by
      have hS : Sᴴ = S := by
        ext i j
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst j; simp [S, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
        · simp [S, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]
      have he := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hp.adjoint_mul_left
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at he
      change Uᴴ * (O * R) = Sᴴ * Vᴴ at he
      rwa [hS] at he
    rw [hinv', ← controllabilityArray_mul_firstBlockInput A B t ht]
    change sqrtDiagonal σ * Vᴴ * firstBlockInput t ht =
      D * Uᴴ * O * (R * firstBlockInput t ht)
    calc
      _ = (D * S) * Vᴴ * firstBlockInput t ht := by
        rw [invSqrtDiagonal_mul_diagonal σ hh.pos]
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc D S Vᴴ, ← hleft]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  · change firstBlockOutput s hs * U * sqrtDiagonal σ =
      C * (R * V * D)
    have hOT : O * (R * V * D) = U * sqrtDiagonal σ := by
      calc
        _ = ((O * R) * V) * D := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = (U * S) * D := by rw [hp.mul_right]
        _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, diagonal_mul_invSqrtDiagonal σ hh.pos]
    rw [← firstBlockOutput_mul_observabilityArray A C s hs]
    change firstBlockOutput (p := p) s hs * U * sqrtDiagonal σ =
      firstBlockOutput (p := p) s hs * O * (R * V * D)
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (firstBlockOutput (p := p) s hs) O, hOT, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.markovParameter_eq_of_similarity
statement:
theorem markovParameter_eq_of_similarity (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜)
    (C : Matrix p n 𝕜) {T : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hT : IsUnit T) (j : ℕ) :
    (C * T) * (T⁻¹ * A * T) ^ j * (T⁻¹ * B) = C * A ^ j * B
proof:
:= by
  have hl : T⁻¹ * T = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hT)
  have hr : T * T⁻¹ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hl
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, (T⁻¹ * A * T) ^ j = T⁻¹ * A ^ j * T := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp [hl]
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, ih, pow_succ]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc T T⁻¹, hr, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [hpow]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc T T⁻¹, hr, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc T T⁻¹, hr, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.rank_blockHankel_le
statement:
theorem rank_blockHankel_le (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜) (C : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (s t : ℕ) : (blockHankel A B C s t 0).rank ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockHankel_zero_eq]
  exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_le_card_width _)

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.era_markovParameter
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.era_markovParameter {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {B : Matrix n q 𝕜}
    {C : Matrix p n 𝕜} {s t : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t)
    {U : Matrix (Fin s × p) n 𝕜} {V : Matrix (Fin t × q) n 𝕜} {σ : n → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD (blockHankel A B C s t 0) U V σ) (j : ℕ) :
    eraOutputMatrix U σ (firstBlockOutput s hs) *
      eraStateMatrix (blockHankel A B C s t 1) U V σ ^ j *
        eraInputMatrix V σ (firstBlockInput t ht) = C * A ^ j * B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hT, hA, hB, hC⟩ := h.era_similarity hs ht
  rw [hA, hB, hC]
  exact markovParameter_eq_of_similarity A B C hT j

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.card_le_of_markovParameters_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hH : blockHankel A B C s t 0 = blockHankel A' B' C' s t 0 := by
    ext i j
    exact congr_fun (congr_fun (hdata (i.1.val + j.1.val)
      (by have hi := i.1.isLt; have hj := j.1.isLt; omega)) i.2) j.2
  calc
    Fintype.card n = (blockHankel A B C s t 0).rank := h.rank_eq_card.symm
    _ = (blockHankel A' B' C' s t 0).rank := congrArg Matrix.rank hH
    _ ≤ Fintype.card k := rank_blockHankel_le A' B' C' s t

name: ZMod.finEquiv_apply_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem finEquiv_apply_eq_natCast {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (j : Fin n) :
    finEquiv n j = (j.val : ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact (NeZero.ne 0 rfl).elim
  | succ n =>
    have hv : (finEquiv (n + 1) j).val = j.val := rfl
    rw [← hv]
    exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _).symm

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.run_value_eq_dft
statement:
theorem run_value_eq_dft (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size s) → ℂ) (k : Fin (size s)) :
    (run s (ZMod.stdAddChar (-1 : ZMod (size s)))
      (fun j => x (ZMod.finEquiv (size s) j))).value k =
      ZMod.dft x (ZMod.finEquiv (size s) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_value_eq_polynomialDFT _ _ _ (hasRootSchedule_standardRoot s),
    polynomialDFT, ZMod.dft_apply]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (ZMod.finEquiv (size s)).toEquiv
  intro j
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, standardRoot_pow, RingEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe,
    EquivLike.coe_coe, ZMod.finEquiv_apply_eq_natCast,
    Nat.cast_mul]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.transform_value_eq_dft
statement:
theorem transform_value_eq_dft (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size s) → ℂ) :
    (transform s x).value = ZMod.dft x
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simpa only [transform, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
    run_value_eq_dft s x ((ZMod.finEquiv (size s)).symm k)

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.transform_mulCount_succ
statement:
theorem transform_mulCount_succ (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size (s + 1)) → ℂ) :
    (transform (s + 1) x).mulCount = (s + 1) * 2 ^ s
proof:
:= by
  exact run_mulCount_succ_eq s (ZMod.stdAddChar (-1 : ZMod (size (s + 1))))
    (fun j => x (ZMod.finEquiv (size (s + 1)) j))

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.transform_addCount
statement:
theorem transform_addCount (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size s) → ℂ) :
    (transform s x).addCount = s * 2 ^ s
proof:
:=
  run_addCount_eq s _ _

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.transform_mulCount_twice
statement:
theorem transform_mulCount_twice (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size s) → ℂ) :
    2 * (transform s x).mulCount = s * size s
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | zero => simp [transform, run]
  | succ s => rw [transform_mulCount_succ, size_eq_two_pow, Nat.pow_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.inverseTransform_value_eq_invDFT
statement:
theorem inverseTransform_value_eq_invDFT (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size s) → ℂ) :
    (inverseTransform s x).value = ZMod.dft.symm x
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [inverseTransform, transform_value_eq_dft, ZMod.invDFT_apply', smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.RadixTwoFFT.inverseTransform_cost
statement:
theorem inverseTransform_cost (s : ℕ) (x : ZMod (size s) → ℂ) :
    (inverseTransform s x).mulCount = (transform s x).mulCount + size s ∧
      (inverseTransform s x).addCount = (transform s x).addCount
proof: := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.walshMatrixFin_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem walshMatrixFin_transpose_mul_self (b : ℕ) :
    (walshMatrixFin b)ᵀ * walshMatrixFin b = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  let e := walshIndexEquivFin b
  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (WalshIndex b) (WalshIndex b) ℝ =>
    M (e.symm a) (e.symm c)) (walshMatrix_transpose_mul_self b)
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hh ⊢
  change (∑ j : Fin (2 ^ b), walshMatrix b (e.symm j) (e.symm a) *
    walshMatrix b (e.symm j) (e.symm c)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : WalshIndex b, walshMatrix b j (e.symm a) * walshMatrix b j (e.symm c) :=
      e.symm.sum_comp (fun j => walshMatrix b j (e.symm a) * walshMatrix b j (e.symm c))
    _ = (1 : Matrix (WalshIndex b) (WalshIndex b) ℝ) (e.symm a) (e.symm c) := hh
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.one_apply, e.symm.injective.eq_iff]

name: NLAlib.walshMatrixFin_apply_sq
statement:
theorem walshMatrixFin_apply_sq (b : ℕ) (i j : Fin (2 ^ b)) :
    walshMatrixFin b i j ^ 2 = 1 / ((2 ^ b : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [walshMatrixFin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    walshMatrix_apply_sq b ((walshIndexEquivFin b).symm i) ((walshIndexEquivFin b).symm j)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_trailing_le_sqrt_budget_mul
statement:
theorem singularValues_trailing_le_sqrt_budget_mul {k r q : ℕ}
    (R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (D : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin q) ℝ) (hR : IsUnit R) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hBudget : frobSq T + frobSq R⁻¹ * frobSq D ≤ b) (j : ℕ) :
    singularValues D j ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + b) *
      singularValues (Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D) (k + j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < q
  swap
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le D
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hj)]
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (singularValues_nonneg _ _)
  let s := singularValues D j
  let M := Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) (0 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) D
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := singularValues_nonneg D j
  have hb1 : 0 < 1 + b := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + b) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hb1
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdim, hY⟩ := exists_submodule_sq_singularValues_mul_le_mulVec_dotProduct D
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hj)
  let tail : ((Fin k ⊕ Fin q) → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ) :=
    { toFun := fun z a => z (Sum.inr a)
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  let S := Y.comap tail
  let e : S ≃ₗ[ℝ] ((Fin k → ℝ) × Y) :=
    { toFun := fun z => (fun a => z.val (Sum.inl a), ⟨tail z.val, z.property⟩)
      invFun := fun z => ⟨Sum.elim z.1 z.2.val, z.2.property⟩
      left_inv := by intro z; apply Subtype.ext; funext a; cases a <;> rfl
      right_inv := by intro z; apply Prod.ext <;> rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have hSdim : k + j + 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ S := by
    rw [e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card,
      Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hLower : s / Real.sqrt (1 + b) ≤ singularValues M (k + j) := by
    apply le_singularValues_of_forall_mem M (k + j) S hSdim
    intro z hz
    let x : Fin k → ℝ := fun a => z (Sum.inl a)
    let y : Fin q → ℝ := fun a => z (Sum.inr a)
    let u := R *ᵥ (x + T *ᵥ y)
    let v := D *ᵥ y
    have hy : y ∈ Y := hz
    have hYv : s ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v := hY y hy
    have hu : R⁻¹ *ᵥ u = x + T *ᵥ y := by
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul R ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR), Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hScaled : Matrix.fromCols (s • R⁻¹) (-T) *ᵥ Sum.elim u (s • y) = s • x := by
      rw [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec_sumElim, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.neg_mulVec,
        Matrix.mulVec_smul, hu, smul_add, add_neg_cancel_right]
    have hFrob := mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_le_frobSq_mul
      (Matrix.fromCols (s • R⁻¹) (-T)) (Sum.elim u (s • y))
    rw [hScaled, frobSq_fromCols, frobSq_smul, frobSq_neg,
      sumElim_dotProduct_sumElim, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul] at hFrob
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hFrob
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 * frobSq R⁻¹ + frobSq T :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg s) (frobSq_nonneg R⁻¹)) (frobSq_nonneg T)
    have hMono := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYv ha0
    have hMain : s ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x + y ⬝ᵥ y) ≤
        (1 + s ^ 2 * frobSq R⁻¹ + frobSq T) * (u ⬝ᵥ u + v ⬝ᵥ v) := by
      nlinarith [dotProduct_self_nonneg u]
    have hsF : s ^ 2 ≤ frobSq D := by
      have hsd := singularValues_le_specNorm D j
      have hsn := singularValues_nonneg D j
      have hf := specNorm_sq_le_frobSq D
      dsimp only [s]
      nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg D]
    have hCoef : 1 + s ^ 2 * frobSq R⁻¹ + frobSq T ≤ 1 + b := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsF (frobSq_nonneg R⁻¹)
      nlinarith
    have hMono' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCoef
      (add_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg u) (dotProduct_self_nonneg v))
    have hzSplit : z = Sum.elim x y := by funext a; cases a <;> rfl
    have hImage : M *ᵥ z = Sum.elim u v := by
      rw [hzSplit, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec]
      simp only [Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
        Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_add, u, v, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, star_trivial]
    rw [hImage, hzSplit, sumElim_dotProduct_sumElim, sumElim_dotProduct_sumElim,
      div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hb1.le, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hb1]
    nlinarith
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hc).mp hLower |>.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)

name: NLAlib.hasRowInclusion_of_prefix_kernel
statement:
theorem hasRowInclusion_of_prefix_kernel {A : Matrix n n K}
    (hA : ∀ i : n, ∀ x : n → K, (∀ j : n, ¬j < i → x j = 0) →
      (∀ j : n, j < i → (A *ᵥ x) j = 0) → (A *ᵥ x) i = 0) :
    HasRowInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let I := {j : n // j < i}
  have hsum (f : I → K) :
      (∑ j : n, if h : j < i then f ⟨j, h⟩ else 0) = ∑ j : I, f j := by
    have hh := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (fun j : n => j < i)
      (fun j => if h : j < i then f ⟨j, h⟩ else 0)
    have hleft : (∑ j : I, if h : (j : n) < i then f ⟨j, h⟩ else 0) = ∑ j : I, f j := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [dif_pos j.property]
    have hright : (∑ j : {j : n // ¬j < i},
        if h : (j : n) < i then f ⟨j, h⟩ else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j _
      rw [dif_neg j.property]
    rw [hleft, hright, add_zero] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  let L : I → (I → K) →ₗ[K] K := fun j => dotProductBilin K K (fun k : I => A j k)
  let T : (I → K) →ₗ[K] K := dotProductBilin K K (fun k : I => A i k)
  have hker : (⨅ j, LinearMap.ker (L j)) ≤ LinearMap.ker T := by
    intro x hx
    let y : n → K := fun k => if h : k < i then x ⟨k, h⟩ else 0
    have hy (k : n) : (A *ᵥ y) k = ∑ j : I, A k j * x j := by
      change (∑ j : n, A k j * y j) = _
      have heq : (fun j => A k j * y j) =
          fun j => if h : j < i then A k j * x ⟨j, h⟩ else 0 := by
        funext j
        dsimp only [y]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [heq]
      exact hsum (fun j : I => A k j * x j)
    have hz : (A *ᵥ y) i = 0 := hA i y (fun j hj => by simp [y, hj]) (by
      intro j hj
      have hh := ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp hx) (⟨j, hj⟩ : I)
      rw [hy]
      exact hh)
    rw [hy] at hz
    exact hz
  have hT : T ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range L) := mem_span_of_iInf_ker_le_ker hker
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mp hT
  let c₀ : n → K := fun j => if h : j < i then c ⟨j, h⟩ else 0
  refine ⟨c₀, fun j hj => by simp [c₀, hj], ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have heval := congrArg (fun f : (I → K) →ₗ[K] K => f (Pi.single ⟨k, hk⟩ 1)) hc
  have hcoeff : (∑ j : I, c j * A j k) = A i k := by
    simpa [L, T, dotProductBilin, dotProduct_single_one] using heval
  have heq : (fun j : n => c₀ j * A j k) =
      fun j => if h : j < i then c ⟨j, h⟩ * A j k else 0 := by
    funext j
    dsimp only [c₀]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [heq]
  exact hcoeff.symm.trans (hsum (fun j : I => c j * A j k)).symm

name: NLAlib.modifiedGramSchmidtState_eq
statement:
theorem modifiedGramSchmidtState_eq (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∀ k ≤ n, ∀ j : Fin n, modifiedGramSchmidtState A k j =
      if (j : ℕ) < k then gramSchmidtCol A j
      else A.col j - ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin n => (l : ℕ) < k),
        (gramSchmidtCol A l ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A l
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _ j; simp [modifiedGramSchmidtState]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hkn j
    have hk : k < n := hkn
    set K : Fin n := ⟨k, hk⟩ with hK
    have hfilt : Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin n => (l : ℕ) < k) = Finset.Iio K := by
      ext l; simp [Fin.lt_def, hK]
    have hw : modifiedGramSchmidtState A k K = gramSchmidtResidual A K := by
      rw [ih hk.le, if_neg (lt_irrefl _), hfilt, gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum]
    have hq : (√(modifiedGramSchmidtState A k K ⬝ᵥ modifiedGramSchmidtState A k K))⁻¹ •
        modifiedGramSchmidtState A k K = gramSchmidtCol A K := by
      rw [hw, gramSchmidtCol_eq, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
    simp only [modifiedGramSchmidtState, dif_pos hk]
    rw [← hK, hq]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (j : ℕ) k with hjk | hjk | hjk
    · rw [if_pos hjk, ih hk.le, if_pos hjk, if_pos (by omega)]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos hjk, if_pos (by omega)]
      rw [show j = K from Fin.ext hjk]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), ih hk.le, if_neg (by omega)]
      have hfilt' : Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin n => (l : ℕ) < k + 1) =
          insert K (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin n => (l : ℕ) < k)) := by
        ext l; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert, hK,
          Fin.ext_iff]; omega
      have hnot : K ∉ Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin n => (l : ℕ) < k) := by simp [hK]
      have hdot : gramSchmidtCol A K ⬝ᵥ (A.col j - ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun l : Fin n => (l : ℕ) < k), (gramSchmidtCol A l ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A l) =
          gramSchmidtCol A K ⬝ᵥ A.col j := by
        rw [dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero, sub_zero]
        intro l hl
        rw [dotProduct_smul, gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_ne A, smul_zero]
        intro hKl; rw [← hKl] at hl; exact hnot hl
      rw [hdot, hfilt', Finset.sum_insert hnot]
      abel

name: NLAlib.modifiedGramSchmidt_eq
statement:
theorem modifiedGramSchmidt_eq (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) :
    modifiedGramSchmidtQ A = gramSchmidtQ A ∧ modifiedGramSchmidtR A = gramSchmidtR A
proof:
:= by
  have hres : ∀ i : Fin n, modifiedGramSchmidtState A i i = gramSchmidtResidual A i := by
    intro i
    rw [modifiedGramSchmidtState_eq A i i.isLt.le, if_neg (lt_irrefl _),
      gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum]
    congr 2
    ext l
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iio]
    exact Fin.lt_def.symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · ext r j
    simp only [modifiedGramSchmidtQ, gramSchmidtQ, of_apply]
    rw [modifiedGramSchmidtState_eq A n le_rfl j, if_pos j.isLt]
  · ext i j
    simp only [modifiedGramSchmidtR, gramSchmidtR, of_apply]
    split_ifs with hij hij'
    · rw [modifiedGramSchmidtState_eq A _ i.isLt, if_pos (Nat.lt_succ_self _),
        modifiedGramSchmidtState_eq A i i.isLt.le, if_neg (by have := Fin.lt_def.1 hij; omega),
        dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero, sub_zero]
      intro l hl
      rw [dotProduct_smul, gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_ne A, smul_zero]
      intro hil; rw [← hil] at hl; simp at hl
    · subst hij'; rw [hres]
    · rfl

name: NLAlib.isQR_modifiedGramSchmidt
statement:
theorem isQR_modifiedGramSchmidt {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} (h : GramSchmidtSucceeds A) :
    IsQR A (modifiedGramSchmidtQ A) (modifiedGramSchmidtR A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(modifiedGramSchmidt_eq A).1, (modifiedGramSchmidt_eq A).2]
  exact isQR_gramSchmidt h

name: NLAlib.IsLU.eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem IsLU.eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [LinearOrder n]
    {A L U : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsLU A L U) (hA : A.IsSymm) :
    A = L * diagonal (fun i => U i i) * Lᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hL : IsUnit L.det := by rw [h.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one]; exact isUnit_one
  let B := L⁻¹ * A * (L⁻¹)ᵀ
  have hBu : B = U * (L⁻¹)ᵀ := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [h.eq_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul L hL, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hBs : B.IsSymm := by
    change Bᵀ = B
    dsimp [B]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hA.eq]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hLt : ((L⁻¹)ᵀ).IsUpperTriangular :=
    isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.mpr h.isUnitLowerTriangular.inv.isLowerTriangular
  have hBuT : B.IsUpperTriangular := by rw [hBu]; exact BlockTriangular.mul h.isUpperTriangular hLt
  have hBlT : B.IsLowerTriangular := by
    rw [← hBs.eq]
    exact isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff.mpr hBuT
  have hBd : B = diagonal (fun i => U i i) := by
    rw [eq_diagonal_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular hBlT hBuT]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [hBu, mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular h.isUpperTriangular hLt]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, h.isUnitLowerTriangular.inv.apply_self, mul_one]
  have hback : L * B * Lᵀ = A := by
    dsimp [B]
    calc
      L * (L⁻¹ * A * (L⁻¹)ᵀ) * Lᵀ = (L * L⁻¹) * A * ((L⁻¹)ᵀ * Lᵀ) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A := by rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv L hL,
        Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hBd] at hback
  exact hback.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_full_qr_completion
statement:
theorem exists_full_qr_completion {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {A Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hFactor : Q * R = A) (e : n ↪ m) :
    ∃ W : Matrix m m ℝ, ∃ T : Matrix m n ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols W ∧ W.submatrix id e = Q ∧
        W * T = A ∧ T.submatrix e id = R ∧ (∀ i ∉ Set.range e, ∀ j, T i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let J : Matrix m n ℝ := (1 : Matrix m m ℝ).submatrix id e
  have hJ : HasOrthonormalCols J := by
    have hOne : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
    exact hOne.submatrix_cols e
  have hGram : Qᵀ * Q = Jᵀ * J := (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ).trans hJ.symm
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWQ⟩ := exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq Q J hGram
  refine ⟨W, J * R, hW, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change W * (1 : Matrix m m ℝ).submatrix (Equiv.refl m) e = Q at hWQ
    rw [Matrix.mul_submatrix_one] at hWQ
    exact hWQ
  · rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hWQ, hFactor]
  · ext i j
    simp [J, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, e.injective.eq_iff]
  · intro i hi j
    have hNe (k : n) : i ≠ e k := by
      intro h
      exact hi ⟨k, h.symm⟩
    simp [J, Matrix.mul_apply, hNe]

name: NLAlib.exists_full_qr_of_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_full_qr_of_embedding {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [LinearOrder n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (e : n ↪ m) :
    ∃ W : Matrix m m ℝ, ∃ R : Matrix n n ℝ, ∃ T : Matrix m n ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols W ∧ R.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ R i i) ∧
        W * T = A ∧ T.submatrix e id = R ∧ (∀ i ∉ Set.range e, ∀ j, T i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, R, ⟨hFactor, hQ, hUpper⟩, hDiag⟩ :=
    exists_isQR A (Fintype.card_le_of_injective e e.injective)
  replace hFactor := hFactor.symm
  obtain ⟨W, T, hW, _, hFullFactor, hCorner, hZero⟩ := exists_full_qr_completion hQ hFactor e
  exact ⟨W, R, T, hW, hUpper, hDiag, hFullFactor, hCorner, hZero⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_full_qr
statement:
theorem exists_full_qr {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hCard : n ≤ m) :
    ∃ W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ, ∃ R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
      ∃ T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ,
        HasOrthonormalCols W ∧ R.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ R i i) ∧ W * T = A ∧
          (∀ i j, T (Fin.castLE hCard i) j = R i j) ∧
          (∀ i j, n ≤ i.val → T i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin n ↪ Fin m := ⟨Fin.castLE hCard, Fin.castLE_injective hCard⟩
  obtain ⟨W, R, T, hW, hUpper, hDiag, hFactor, hCorner, hZero⟩ :=
    exists_full_qr_of_embedding A e
  refine ⟨W, R, T, hW, hUpper, hDiag, hFactor, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    exact congrFun (congrFun hCorner i) j
  · intro i j hi
    apply hZero i _ j
    rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hk
    have hlt := k.isLt
    change k.val = i.val at hv
    omega

name: NLAlib.exists_coefficients_supported_prefix
statement:
private theorem exists_coefficients_supported_prefix {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n)
    (a : Fin k → ℝ) :
    ∃ c : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ j : Fin n, ¬j.val < k → c j = 0) ∧
      ∀ f : Fin n → ℝ, ∑ j : Fin n, c j * f j = ∑ j : Fin k, a j * f (Fin.castLE hk j)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => if h : j.val < k then a ⟨j.val, h⟩ else 0
  refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj; simp [c, hj]
  · intro f
    have h : (fun j : Fin n => c j * f j) =
        fun j => if j.val < k then c j * f j else 0 := by
      funext j
      dsimp [c]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [h, sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_castLE hk]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp [c, j.isLt]

name: NLAlib.rowInclusion_of_leading_minors_through_rank
statement:
theorem rowInclusion_of_leading_minors_through_rank {n k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hRank : A.rank = k)
    (hMinors : ∀ j ≤ k, leadingMinor A j ≠ 0) :
    HasRowInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k ≤ n := by simpa only [hRank] using A.rank_le_width
  have hRows : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j : Fin k => A (Fin.castLE hk j)) := by
    let restrict : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin k → ℝ) := LinearMap.funLeft ℝ ℝ (Fin.castLE hk)
    apply LinearIndependent.of_comp restrict
    have hdet : (A.submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk)).det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← leadingMinor_fin A hk]; exact hMinors k le_rfl
    exact Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_of_det_ne_zero hdet
  let S := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun j : Fin k => A (Fin.castLE hk j)))
  let T := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range A.row)
  have hST : S ≤ T := Submodule.span_mono (by rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact ⟨Fin.castLE hk j, rfl⟩)
  have hDimS : Module.finrank ℝ S = k := by
    simpa only [S, Set.finrank, Fintype.card_fin] using
      (linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.mp hRows).symm
  have hDimT : Module.finrank ℝ T = k := by
    rw [← Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row]
    exact hRank
  have hEq : S = T := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hST (hDimS.trans hDimT.symm)
  intro i
  by_cases hik : i.val < k
  · let j := i.val
    have hj : j ≤ n := i.isLt.le
    let M := A.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)
    have hM : IsUnit Mᵀ := by
      apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
      rw [Matrix.det_transpose]
      refine isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ?_
      rw [← leadingMinor_fin A hj]; exact hMinors j (by omega)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.mpr hM
      (fun t : Fin j => A i (Fin.castLE hj t))
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hSum⟩ := exists_coefficients_supported_prefix hj a
    refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      exact hc t (by simpa only [j, Fin.lt_def] using ht)
    · intro t hti
      rw [hSum]
      have h := congrFun ha (⟨t.val, by simpa only [j, Fin.lt_def] using hti⟩ : Fin j)
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply,
        M, Matrix.submatrix_apply] at h
      simpa only [Fin.castLE, mul_comm] using h.symm
  · have hiRow : A i ∈ S := by
      rw [hEq]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hiRow
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hSum⟩ := exists_coefficients_supported_prefix hk a
    refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t hti
      apply hc t
      change ¬ t.val < i.val at hti
      omega
    · intro t _
      rw [hSum]
      have h := congrFun ha t
      simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_triangular_factorizations_of_leading_minors_through_rank
statement:
theorem exists_unit_triangular_factorizations_of_leading_minors_through_rank {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hMinors : ∀ j, 0 < j → j ≤ A.rank → leadingMinor A j ≠ 0) :
    (∃ L U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, IsLU A L U) ∧
      (∃ L U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
        L.IsLowerTriangular ∧ IsUnitUpperTriangular U ∧ A = L * U)
proof:
:= by
  have hAll : ∀ j ≤ A.rank, leadingMinor A j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hr
    by_cases h0 : j = 0
    · subst j; simp
    · exact hMinors j (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0) hr
  have hRows := rowInclusion_of_leading_minors_through_rank A rfl hAll
  have hAllT : ∀ j ≤ Aᵀ.rank, leadingMinor Aᵀ j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hr
    rw [leadingMinor_transpose]
    exact hAll j (by simpa only [Matrix.rank_transpose] using hr)
  have hCols := rowInclusion_of_leading_minors_through_rank Aᵀ rfl hAllT
  exact ⟨(exists_isLU_iff_rowInclusion A).mpr hRows,
    (exists_lower_unitUpper_iff_columnInclusion A).mpr hCols⟩

name: NLAlib.isUnit_of_mul_transpose_eq_posDef
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_mul_transpose_eq_posDef {A L : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hFactor : L * Lᵀ = A) : IsUnit L
proof:
:= by
  have hDet := congrArg Matrix.det hFactor
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose] at hDet
  have hNe : L.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hDet
    have hp := hA.det_pos
    linarith
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det L).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hNe)

name: NLAlib.diag_pos_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  have hDet : L.det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det L).mp hUnit)
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular L hLower] at hDet
  intro i
  have hNe : L i i ≠ 0 := (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hDet) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hDiag i) hNe.symm

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_cholesky_of_posDef
statement:
theorem existsUnique_cholesky_of_posDef (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    ∃! L : Matrix n n ℝ, L.IsLowerTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 < L i i) ∧ L * Lᵀ = A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hLower, hDiag, hFactor'⟩ := exists_eq_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef hA.posSemidef
  have hFactor := hFactor'.symm
  have hPositive := diag_pos_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUnit hLower
    (isUnit_of_mul_transpose_eq_posDef hA hFactor) hDiag
  refine ⟨L, ⟨hLower, hPositive, hFactor⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro M ⟨hMLower, hMPositive, hMFactor⟩
  exact IsCholesky.unique ⟨hMLower, hMPositive, hMFactor.symm⟩ ⟨hLower, hPositive, hFactor.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.det_eq_prod_sq_diag_of_cholesky
statement:
theorem det_eq_prod_sq_diag_of_cholesky (A L : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hLower : L.IsLowerTriangular) (hFactor : L * Lᵀ = A) : A.det = ∏ i, L i i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hFactor, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular L hLower]
  simp only [sq, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitLower_mul_upper_of_rowInclusion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose c hc hRows using hA
  let C : Matrix n n ℝ := c
  let H : Matrix n n ℝ := 1 - C
  have hH : IsUnitLowerTriangular H := by
    constructor
    · apply isLowerTriangular_iff.mpr
      intro i j hij
      change (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j - c i j = 0
      rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne hij.ne, hc i j hij.not_gt, sub_self]
    · intro i
      change (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i i - c i i = 1
      rw [Matrix.one_apply_eq, hc i i (lt_irrefl i), sub_zero]
  refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
  apply isUpperTriangular_iff.mpr
  intro i k hki
  rw [show H * A = A - C * A by simp [H, Matrix.sub_mul]]
  change A i k - ∑ j : n, c i j * A j k = 0
  rw [hRows i k hki, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.exists_isLU_iff_rowInclusion
statement:
theorem exists_isLU_iff_rowInclusion (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∃ L U : Matrix n n ℝ, IsLU A L U) ↔ HasRowInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, U, hLU⟩
    let H := L⁻¹
    let C := 1 - H
    have hH : IsUnitLowerTriangular H := hLU.isUnitLowerTriangular.inv
    have hHL : H * L = 1 := by
      apply Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul
      rw [hLU.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one]
      exact isUnit_one
    have hHA : H * A = U := by rw [hLU.eq_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hHL, Matrix.one_mul]
    intro i
    refine ⟨C i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hij
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j; simp [C, hH.apply_self, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
      · have hlt : i < j := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hij) (Ne.symm hji)
        simp [C, isLowerTriangular_iff.mp hH.isLowerTriangular i j hlt, Ne.symm hji]
    · intro k hki
      have hZero : (H * A) i k = 0 := by rw [hHA]; exact hLU.isUpperTriangular hki
      have hCA : C * A = A - H * A := by simp [C, Matrix.sub_mul]
      change A i k = (C * A) i k
      rw [hCA]
      change A i k = A i k - (H * A) i k
      rw [hZero, sub_zero]
  · intro hA
    obtain ⟨H, hH, hUpper⟩ := exists_unitLower_mul_upper_of_rowInclusion hA
    refine ⟨H⁻¹, H * A, hH.inv, hUpper, ?_⟩
    have hInv : H⁻¹ * H = 1 := by
      apply Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul
      rw [hH.det_eq_one]
      exact isUnit_one
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hInv, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_lower_unitUpper_iff_columnInclusion
statement:
theorem exists_lower_unitUpper_iff_columnInclusion (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∃ L U : Matrix n n ℝ, L.IsLowerTriangular ∧ IsUnitUpperTriangular U ∧ A = L * U) ↔
      HasColumnInclusion A
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasColumnInclusion, ← exists_isLU_iff_rowInclusion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, U, hL, hU, hA⟩
    refine ⟨Uᵀ, Lᵀ, isUnitLowerTriangular_transpose_iff.mpr hU,
      isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.mpr hL, ?_⟩
    rw [hA, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  · rintro ⟨L, U, hLU⟩
    refine ⟨Uᵀ, Lᵀ, isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff.mpr hLU.isUpperTriangular,
      isUnitUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.mpr hLU.isUnitLowerTriangular, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose hLU.eq_mul
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks_of_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks_of_embedding {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (e : Fin k ↪ n)
    (hCpos : 0 < ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det)
    (hMax : ∀ f : Fin k → n, ((A.submatrix id f)ᵀ * A.submatrix id f).det ≤
      ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det) :
    ∃ π : (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ≃ n,
    ∃ Q : Matrix m (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ,
    ∃ T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ D : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
      (∀ i, π (Sum.inl i) = e i) ∧
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ Q * Qᵀ = 1 ∧ IsUnit R ∧ R.IsUpperTriangular ∧
      A.submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D ∧
      (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      frobSq T + frobSq R⁻¹ * frobSq D ≤ (k : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n - k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hkm : k ≤ Fintype.card m := hk.trans A.rank_le_card_height
  have hkn : k ≤ Fintype.card n := hk.trans A.rank_le_card_width
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_equiv_sum_extending_embedding
    (q := Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) e (by simpa using Nat.add_sub_of_le hkn)
  let C := A.submatrix id e
  let B := A.submatrix id (fun j => π (Sum.inr j))
  have hA : A.submatrix id π = Matrix.fromCols C B := by
    ext i j
    cases j with
    | inl j => simp [C, Matrix.submatrix_apply, hπ]
    | inr j => rfl
  obtain ⟨L, R, ⟨hLR, hL, hUpper⟩, -⟩ := exists_isQR C (by simpa using hkm)
  replace hLR := hLR.symm
  have hGram : Cᵀ * C = Rᵀ * R := by
    rw [← hLR, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Lᵀ L R, show Lᵀ * L = 1 from hL, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hRdet : IsUnit R.det := by
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hz
    change 0 < (Cᵀ * C).det at hCpos
    rw [hGram, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hz, zero_mul] at hCpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hCpos
  have hR : IsUnit R := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mpr hRdet
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQt, hFirst⟩ := exists_unitary_sum_completion
    (q := Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) L hL (by simpa using Nat.add_sub_of_le hkm)
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hQt
  let K := Q.submatrix id Sum.inr
  have hQform : Q = Matrix.fromCols L K := by
    ext i j
    cases j with
    | inl j => exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ => M i j) hFirst
    | inr j => rfl
  have hK : HasOrthonormalCols K := hQ.submatrix_cols ⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩
  have hCross : Lᵀ * K = 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₁₂ (show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ)
    rw [hQform, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols] at hh
    simpa only [Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₁₂,
      show (1 : Matrix (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - k))
        (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) ℝ).toBlocks₁₂ = 0 by
        ext i j; simp [Matrix.toBlocks₁₂]] using hh
  have hComplete : L * Lᵀ + K * Kᵀ = 1 := by
    simpa only [hQform, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows] using hQt
  let T := R⁻¹ * (Lᵀ * B)
  let D := Kᵀ * B
  have hRT : R * T = Lᵀ * B := by
    dsimp only [T]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R hRdet, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hCT : C * T = L * (Lᵀ * B) := by rw [← hLR, Matrix.mul_assoc, hRT]
  have hReconstruct : C * T + K * D = B := by
    rw [hCT]
    change L * (Lᵀ * B) + K * (Kᵀ * B) = B
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.add_mul,
      hComplete, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hOrth : Cᵀ * (K * D) = 0 := by
    rw [← hLR, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Lᵀ K D, hCross, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero]
  have hExchange (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) :
      ((C.updateCol i ((C * T + K * D).col j))ᵀ *
        C.updateCol i ((C * T + K * D).col j)).det ≤ (Cᵀ * C).det := by
    rw [hReconstruct]
    have heq : C.updateCol i (B.col j) =
        A.submatrix id (Function.update e i (π (Sum.inr j))) := by
      ext a b
      by_cases hb : b = i
      · subst b
        simp [C, B, Matrix.col]
      · simp [C, B, Matrix.updateCol_ne hb, Function.update_of_ne hb]
    rw [heq]
    exact hMax _
  obtain ⟨hEntry, hBudget⟩ := frobSq_add_trace_inv_gram_mul_frobSq_le_of_maximum_volume
    C T (K * D) hCpos hOrth hExchange
  have hInvTrace : (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹.trace = frobSq R⁻¹ := by
    rw [hGram, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv,
      frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  rw [hInvTrace, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hK] at hBudget
  refine ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, hπ, hQ, hQt, hR, hUpper, ?_, hEntry, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA, hQform, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero,
      hLR, ← Matrix.mul_assoc L R T, hLR, hReconstruct]
  · simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_sub hkn] using hBudget

name: NLAlib.exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ π : (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ≃ n,
    ∃ Q : Matrix m (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ,
    ∃ T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ D : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ Q * Qᵀ = 1 ∧ IsUnit R ∧ R.IsUpperTriangular ∧
      A.submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D ∧
      (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      frobSq T + frobSq R⁻¹ * frobSq D ≤ (k : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n - k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hpos, hmax⟩ := exists_maximum_volume_column_embedding A k hk
  obtain ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, _, hrest⟩ :=
    exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks_of_embedding A k hk e hpos hmax
  exact ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, hrest⟩

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_iff
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} :
    A.IsUpperTriangular ↔ ∀ i j, j < i → A i j = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ hij => h hij, fun h i j hij => h i j hij⟩

name: NLAlib.isLowerTriangular_iff
statement:
theorem isLowerTriangular_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} :
    A.IsLowerTriangular ↔ ∀ i j, i < j → A i j = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ hij => h hij, fun h i j hij => h i j hij⟩

name: NLAlib.isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff
statement:
theorem isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} :
    Aᵀ.IsLowerTriangular ↔ A.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLowerTriangular_iff, isUpperTriangular_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h i j hij => h j i hij, fun h i j hij => h j i hij⟩

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} :
    Aᵀ.IsUpperTriangular ↔ A.IsLowerTriangular
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLowerTriangular_iff, isUpperTriangular_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h i j hij => h j i hij, fun h i j hij => h j i hij⟩

name: NLAlib.eq_diagonal_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | rfl | h
  · rw [isLowerTriangular_iff.1 hL i j h, Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ h.ne]
  · simp
  · rw [isUpperTriangular_iff.1 hU i j h, Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ h.ne']

name: NLAlib.isUnitLowerTriangular_one
statement: theorem isUnitLowerTriangular_one : IsUnitLowerTriangular (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨blockTriangular_one, fun _ => Matrix.one_apply_eq _⟩

name: NLAlib.isUnitUpperTriangular_one
statement: theorem isUnitUpperTriangular_one : IsUnitUpperTriangular (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨blockTriangular_one, fun _ => Matrix.one_apply_eq _⟩

name: NLAlib.isUnitUpperTriangular_transpose_iff
statement:
theorem isUnitUpperTriangular_transpose_iff {L : Matrix n n ℝ} :
    IsUnitUpperTriangular Lᵀ ↔ IsUnitLowerTriangular L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.1 h.1, h.2⟩,
    fun h => ⟨isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.2 h.1, h.2⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.isUnitLowerTriangular_transpose_iff
statement:
theorem isUnitLowerTriangular_transpose_iff {U : Matrix n n ℝ} :
    IsUnitLowerTriangular Uᵀ ↔ IsUnitUpperTriangular U
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff.1 h.1, h.2⟩,
    fun h => ⟨isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff.2 h.1, h.2⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.eq_one_of_isUnitLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_isUnitLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : IsUnitLowerTriangular A) (hU : A.IsUpperTriangular) : A = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_diagonal_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular hL.1 hU]
  simp [hL.2]

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_inv
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_inv {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsUpperTriangular) :
    A⁻¹.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsUnit A.det
  · have := A.invertibleOfIsUnitDet h
    exact blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular hA
  · rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit A h]
    exact blockTriangular_zero

name: NLAlib.isLowerTriangular_inv
statement:
theorem isLowerTriangular_inv {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsLowerTriangular) :
    A⁻¹.IsLowerTriangular
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsUnit A.det
  · have := A.invertibleOfIsUnitDet h
    exact blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular hA
  · rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit A h]
    exact blockTriangular_zero

name: NLAlib.isUnit_det_iff_of_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem isUnit_det_iff_of_isUpperTriangular {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsUpperTriangular) :
    IsUnit A.det ↔ ∀ i, A i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
