  rw [det_of_isUpperTriangular hA, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  simp

name: NLAlib.isUnit_det_iff_of_isLowerTriangular
statement:
theorem isUnit_det_iff_of_isLowerTriangular {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsLowerTriangular) :
    IsUnit A.det ↔ ∀ i, A i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_of_isLowerTriangular A hA, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  simp

name: NLAlib.inv_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem inv_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hd : ∀ i, A i i ≠ 0) (i : n) : A⁻¹ i i = (A i i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit A.det := (isUnit_det_iff_of_isUpperTriangular hA).2 hd
  have h1 := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hu) i) i
  rw [mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular hA (isUpperTriangular_inv hA), Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    at h1
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1

name: NLAlib.inv_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular
statement:
theorem inv_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsLowerTriangular)
    (hd : ∀ i, A i i ≠ 0) (i : n) : A⁻¹ i i = (A i i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit A.det := (isUnit_det_iff_of_isLowerTriangular hA).2 hd
  have h1 := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hu) i) i
  rw [mul_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular hA (isLowerTriangular_inv hA), Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    at h1
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1

name: NLAlib.IsUnitLowerTriangular.mul
statement:
theorem IsUnitLowerTriangular.mul {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnitLowerTriangular A)
    (hB : IsUnitLowerTriangular B) : IsUnitLowerTriangular (A * B)
proof:
:=
  ⟨BlockTriangular.mul hA.1 hB.1, fun i => by
    rw [mul_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular hA.1 hB.1, hA.2, hB.2, one_mul]⟩

name: NLAlib.IsUnitUpperTriangular.mul
statement:
theorem IsUnitUpperTriangular.mul {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnitUpperTriangular A)
    (hB : IsUnitUpperTriangular B) : IsUnitUpperTriangular (A * B)
proof:
:=
  ⟨BlockTriangular.mul hA.1 hB.1, fun i => by
    rw [mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular hA.1 hB.1, hA.2, hB.2, one_mul]⟩

name: NLAlib.IsUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : IsUnitLowerTriangular L) :
    L.det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_of_isLowerTriangular L hL.1]
  simp [hL.2]

name: NLAlib.IsUnitUpperTriangular.det_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsUnitUpperTriangular.det_eq_one {U : Matrix n n ℝ} (hU : IsUnitUpperTriangular U) :
    U.det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_of_isUpperTriangular hU.1]
  simp [hU.2]

name: NLAlib.IsUnitLowerTriangular.inv
statement:
theorem IsUnitLowerTriangular.inv {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : IsUnitLowerTriangular L) :
    IsUnitLowerTriangular L⁻¹
proof:
:=
  ⟨isLowerTriangular_inv hL.1, fun i => by
    rw [inv_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular hL.1 (fun j => by simp [hL.2]), hL.2, inv_one]⟩

name: NLAlib.IsUnitUpperTriangular.inv
statement:
theorem IsUnitUpperTriangular.inv {U : Matrix n n ℝ} (hU : IsUnitUpperTriangular U) :
    IsUnitUpperTriangular U⁻¹
proof:
:=
  ⟨isUpperTriangular_inv hU.1, fun i => by
    rw [inv_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular hU.1 (fun j => by simp [hU.2]), hU.2, inv_one]⟩

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedMatrix_zero_zero (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    borderedMatrix a r c M 0 0 = a
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedMatrix_zero_succ (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (j : Fin n) : borderedMatrix a r c M 0 j.succ = r j
proof:
:= by
  simp [borderedMatrix]

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_succ_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedMatrix_succ_zero (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) : borderedMatrix a r c M i.succ 0 = c i
proof:
:= by
  simp [borderedMatrix]

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedMatrix_succ_succ (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin n) : borderedMatrix a r c M i.succ j.succ = M i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [borderedMatrix]

name: NLAlib.submatrix_succ_borderedMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem submatrix_succ_borderedMatrix (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (borderedMatrix a r c M).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = M
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_eta
statement:
theorem borderedMatrix_eta (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    borderedMatrix (A 0 0) (fun j => A 0 j.succ) (fun i => A i.succ 0)
      (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j <;> simp

name: NLAlib.borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix
statement:
theorem borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix (a a' : ℝ) (r c r' c' : Fin n → ℝ)
    (M M' : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    borderedMatrix a r c M * borderedMatrix a' r' c' M' =
      borderedMatrix (a * a' + r ⬝ᵥ c') (a • r' + r ᵥ* M') (a' • c + M *ᵥ c')
        (vecMulVec c r' + M * M')
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, dotProduct, vecMul, mulVec, vecMulVec_apply,
      mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.transpose_borderedMatrix
statement:
theorem transpose_borderedMatrix (a : ℝ) (r c : Fin n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (borderedMatrix a r c M)ᵀ = borderedMatrix a c r Mᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j <;> simp

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isUpperTriangular_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨funext fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
    · simpa using h i.succ 0 (Fin.succ_pos i)
    · simpa using h i.succ j.succ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.2 hij)
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hM⟩ i j hij
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact absurd hij (Fin.not_lt_zero j)
    | succ i =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => simp
      | succ j => simpa using hM i j (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.1 hij)

name: NLAlib.isLowerTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff, transpose_borderedMatrix,
    isUpperTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff, isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff]

name: NLAlib.det_borderedMatrix_of_left_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_borderedMatrix_of_left_eq_zero (a : ℝ) (r : Fin n → ℝ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : (borderedMatrix a r 0 M).det = a * M.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_succ_column_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, borderedMatrix_zero_zero, Fin.succAbove_zero,
    borderedMatrix_succ_zero, Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero,
    add_zero, submatrix_succ_borderedMatrix]

name: NLAlib.det_borderedMatrix_of_top_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_borderedMatrix_of_top_eq_zero (a : ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : (borderedMatrix a 0 c M).det = a * M.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [← det_transpose, transpose_borderedMatrix, det_borderedMatrix_of_left_eq_zero,
    det_transpose]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_forwardSubst
statement:
theorem mulVec_forwardSubst {n : ℕ} {L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hL : L.IsLowerTriangular)
    (hd : ∀ i, L i i ≠ 0) (b : Fin n → ℝ) : L *ᵥ forwardSubst L b = b
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => ext i; exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    have hL' : (L.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).IsLowerTriangular :=
      isLowerTriangular_iff.2 fun i j hij =>
        isLowerTriangular_iff.1 hL _ _ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.2 hij)
    have hrow : ∀ j : Fin n, L 0 j.succ = 0 := fun j =>
      isLowerTriangular_iff.1 hL _ _ (Fin.succ_pos j)
    have ih' := ih hL' (fun i => hd i.succ)
      (fun i => b i.succ - L i.succ 0 * (b 0 / L 0 0))
    ext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · simp [forwardSubst, mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hrow, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hd 0)]
    · have := congrFun ih' i
      simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, submatrix_apply] at this
      simp only [forwardSubst, mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ, cons_val_zero,
        cons_val_succ]
      rw [this]
      ring

name: NLAlib.mulVec_backSubst
statement:
theorem mulVec_backSubst {n : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hU : U.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hd : ∀ i, U i i ≠ 0) (b : Fin n → ℝ) : U *ᵥ backSubst U b = b
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (U.submatrix Fin.rev Fin.rev).IsLowerTriangular :=
    isLowerTriangular_iff.2 fun i j hij =>
      isUpperTriangular_iff.1 hU _ _ (Fin.rev_lt_rev.2 hij)
  have h := mulVec_forwardSubst hL (fun i => hd i.rev) (b ∘ Fin.rev)
  ext i
  have hi := congrFun h i.rev
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, submatrix_apply, Function.comp_apply, Fin.rev_rev] at hi
  rw [← hi]
  simp only [backSubst, mulVec, dotProduct, Function.comp_apply]
  exact (Fintype.sum_equiv Fin.revPerm _ _ fun j => by simp).symm

name: NLAlib.prod_le_eliminationTraceProduct
statement:
theorem prod_le_eliminationTraceProduct {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (l : List n) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j < l.length, 0 ≤ b j)
    (hLower : ∀ j < l.length, b j ≤ RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A (l.take j)).trace) :
    (∏ j : Fin l.length, b j) ≤ eliminationTraceProduct A l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A b with
  | nil => simp [eliminationTraceProduct]
  | cons i l ih =>
    have hHead := hLower 0 (by simp)
    simp only [List.take_zero, eliminationListResidual, List.foldl_nil] at hHead
    have hRest := ih (posSemidef_eliminationStep hA i) (fun j => b (j + 1))
      (fun j hj => hb (j + 1) (by simpa only [List.length_cons] using Nat.succ_lt_succ hj))
      (by
        intro j hj
        have hh := hLower (j + 1) (by simpa only [List.length_cons] using Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)
        simpa only [List.take_succ_cons, eliminationListResidual, List.foldl_cons] using hh)
    rw [List.length_cons, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    exact mul_le_mul hHead hRest
      (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hb (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ j.isLt))
      (re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA)

name: NLAlib.prod_fin_ite_lt_eq_mul_pow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hr
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_add]
  simp only [Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [if_pos j.isLt]
  · have hNo : ∀ j : Fin s, ¬ r + (j : ℕ) < r := fun _ => by omega
    simp only [hNo, ↓reduceIte, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.prod_spectralTraceTail_mul_pow_le_eliminationTraceProduct
statement:
theorem prod_spectralTraceTail_mul_pow_le_eliminationTraceProduct
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (l : List n) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ l.length)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hFinal : c ≤ RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A l).trace) :
    (∏ j : Fin r, spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian j) * c ^ (l.length - r) ≤
      eliminationTraceProduct A l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_fin_ite_lt_eq_mul_pow _ c hr]
  apply prod_le_eliminationTraceProduct hA l
    (fun j => if j < r then spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian j else c)
  · intro j hj
    split_ifs
    · exact spectralTraceTail_nonneg hA j
    · exact hc
  · intro j hj
    split_ifs with hjr
    · exact spectralTraceTail_le_re_trace_of_rank_sub_le hA
        (posSemidef_eliminationListResidual hA (l.take j))
        ((rank_sub_eliminationListResidual_le_length A (l.take j)).trans (List.length_take_le _ _))
    · have hMono := re_trace_eliminationListResidual_le
        (posSemidef_eliminationListResidual hA (l.take j)) (l.drop j)
      rw [← eliminationListResidual_append, List.take_append_drop] at hMono
      exact hFinal.trans hMono

name: NLAlib.transpose_planeRotation
statement:
theorem transpose_planeRotation (u v : n → ℝ) (c s : ℝ) :
    (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ = planeRotation u v c (-s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [planeRotation, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.transpose_one,
    Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_vecMulVec, neg_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: NLAlib.givens_apply
proof:
:= by
  simp only [givens, planeRotation, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Pi.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hai : a = i <;> by_cases haj : a = j <;> by_cases hbi : b = i <;>
    by_cases hbj : b = j <;> subst_vars <;> simp_all [eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.givens_mulVec_apply_left
statement:
theorem givens_mulVec_apply_left {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (givens i j c s *ᵥ x) i = c * x i + s * x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [givens, planeRotation_mulVec]
  simp [single_dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, hij.symm]
  ring

name: NLAlib.givens_mulVec_apply_right
statement:
theorem givens_mulVec_apply_right {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (givens i j c s *ᵥ x) j = -s * x i + c * x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [givens, planeRotation_mulVec]
  simp [single_dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, hij]
  ring

name: NLAlib.givens_mulVec_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem givens_mulVec_apply_of_ne {i j a : n} (hai : a ≠ i) (haj : a ≠ j) (c s : ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) : (givens i j c s *ᵥ x) a = x a
proof:
:= by
  rw [givens, planeRotation_mulVec]
  simp [single_dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, hai, haj]

name: NLAlib.transpose_givens
statement: theorem transpose_givens (i j : n) (c s : ℝ) : (givens i j c s)ᵀ = givens i j c (-s)
proof:
:=
  transpose_planeRotation _ _ c s

name: NLAlib.givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_left
statement:
theorem givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_left {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ((givens i j c s)ᵀ *ᵥ x) i = c * x i - s * x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_givens, givens_mulVec_apply_left hij]; ring

name: NLAlib.givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_right
statement:
theorem givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_right {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ((givens i j c s)ᵀ *ᵥ x) j = s * x i + c * x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_givens, givens_mulVec_apply_right hij]; ring

name: NLAlib.givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne {i j a : n} (hai : a ≠ i) (haj : a ≠ j) (c s : ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) : ((givens i j c s)ᵀ *ᵥ x) a = x a
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_givens, givens_mulVec_apply_of_ne hai haj]

name: NLAlib.givens_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem givens_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) {x : n → ℝ}
    (hi : x i = 0) (hj : x j = 0) : givens i j c s *ᵥ x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  by_cases hai : a = i
  · subst hai; rw [givens_mulVec_apply_left hij, hi, hj]; ring
  by_cases haj : a = j
  · subst haj; rw [givens_mulVec_apply_right hij, hi, hj]; ring
  exact givens_mulVec_apply_of_ne hai haj c s x

name: NLAlib.givens_transpose_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem givens_transpose_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c s : ℝ) {x : n → ℝ}
    (hi : x i = 0) (hj : x j = 0) : (givens i j c s)ᵀ *ᵥ x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_givens]; exact givens_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero hij c (-s) hi hj

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_givens
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_givens {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) {c s : ℝ} (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (givens i j c s)
proof:
:= by
  refine hasOrthonormalCols_planeRotation _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ c s hcs
  · show ‖EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)‖ = 1
    simp
  · show ‖EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)‖ = 1
    simp
  · simp [single_dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, hij]

name: NLAlib.givens_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem givens_transpose_mul_self {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) {c s : ℝ} (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (givens i j c s)ᵀ * givens i j c s = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasOrthonormalCols_givens hij hcs).conjTranspose_mul_self
  rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h

name: NLAlib.givens_mul_transpose_self
statement:
theorem givens_mul_transpose_self {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) {c s : ℝ} (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    givens i j c s * (givens i j c s)ᵀ = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_eq_one_comm.mp (givens_transpose_mul_self hij hcs)

name: NLAlib.sq_add_sq_eq_zero
statement: private lemma sq_add_sq_eq_zero {a b : ℝ} (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b], by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]⟩

name: NLAlib.givensCos_sq_add_givensSin_sq
statement: theorem givensCos_sq_add_givensSin_sq (a b : ℝ) : givensCos a b ^ 2 + givensSin a b ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold givensCos givensSin
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := sq_add_sq_eq_zero h; simp
  · have hpos : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm h)
    rw [div_pow, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, neg_sq, ← add_div, div_self h]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_givensRotation
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_givensRotation {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (x : n → ℝ) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (givensRotation i j x)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_givens hij (givensCos_sq_add_givensSin_sq _ _)

name: NLAlib.givensRotation_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem givensRotation_transpose_mul_self {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (givensRotation i j x)ᵀ * givensRotation i j x = 1
proof:
:=
  givens_transpose_mul_self hij (givensCos_sq_add_givensSin_sq _ _)

name: NLAlib.givensRotation_mul_transpose_self
statement:
theorem givensRotation_mul_transpose_self {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (x : n → ℝ) :
    givensRotation i j x * (givensRotation i j x)ᵀ = 1
proof:
:=
  givens_mul_transpose_self hij (givensCos_sq_add_givensSin_sq _ _)

name: NLAlib.givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_right
statement:
theorem givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_right {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ((givensRotation i j x)ᵀ *ᵥ x) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [givensRotation, givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_right hij]
  unfold givensCos givensSin
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨-, hb⟩ := sq_add_sq_eq_zero h; simp [hb]
  · ring

name: NLAlib.givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_left
statement:
theorem givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_left {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ((givensRotation i j x)ᵀ *ᵥ x) i = √(x i ^ 2 + x j ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [givensRotation, givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_left hij]
  unfold givensCos givensSin
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := sq_add_sq_eq_zero h; simp [ha, hb]
  · have hpos : 0 < √(x i ^ 2 + x j ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_pos.2 (lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm h))
    field_simp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne {i j a : n} (hai : a ≠ i) (haj : a ≠ j)
    (x y : n → ℝ) : ((givensRotation i j x)ᵀ *ᵥ y) a = y a
proof:
:=
  givens_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne hai haj _ _ y

name: NLAlib.IsQR.mul_eq_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem IsQR.mul_eq_transpose_mul_mul {H Q R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (h : IsQR H Q R) :
    R * Q = Qᵀ * H * Q
proof:
:= by
  have hR : Qᵀ * H = R := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q] using h.conjTranspose_mul_eq
  rw [hR]

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_mul_of_isQR
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit R.det := h.isUnit_det_iff.2 hR
  have hQ : Q = H * R⁻¹ := by
    rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.mul_one]
  have := R.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hdet
  have hRinv : R⁻¹.IsUpperTriangular := blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular h.upper
  rw [hQ]
  exact (hH.mul_isUpperTriangular hRinv).isUpperTriangular_mul h.upper

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_mul_of_isQR
statement:
theorem isHermitian_mul_of_isQR {H Q R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hS : H.IsHermitian)
    (h : IsQR H Q R) : (R * Q).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.mul_eq_transpose_mul_mul, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hS

name: NLAlib.isTridiagonal_mul_of_isQR
statement:
theorem isTridiagonal_mul_of_isQR {H Q R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hS : H.IsHermitian)
    (hT : IsTridiagonal H) (h : IsQR H Q R) (hR : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0) :
    IsTridiagonal (R * Q)
proof:
:=
  (isUpperHessenberg_mul_of_isQR hT.1 h hR).isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian
    (isHermitian_mul_of_isQR hS h)

name: NLAlib.givensQRStep_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem givensQRStep_transpose_mul_self (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (givensQRStep W k)ᵀ * givensQRStep W k = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold givensQRStep
  split_ifs with h
  · exact givensRotation_transpose_mul_self (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) _
  · simp

name: NLAlib.givensQRStep_mul_transpose_self
statement:
theorem givensQRStep_mul_transpose_self (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    givensQRStep W k * (givensQRStep W k)ᵀ = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_eq_one_comm.mp (givensQRStep_transpose_mul_self W k)

name: NLAlib.givensQRQ_mul_givensQRState
statement:
theorem givensQRQ_mul_givensQRState (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    givensQRQ H k * givensQRState H k = H
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [givensQRQ, givensQRState]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [givensQRQ, givensQRState, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc _ (givensQRStep _ k)ᵀ,
      givensQRStep_mul_transpose_self, Matrix.one_mul, ih]

name: NLAlib.givensQRQ_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem givensQRQ_transpose_mul_self (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (givensQRQ H k)ᵀ * givensQRQ H k = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [givensQRQ]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [givensQRQ, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (givensQRQ H k)ᵀ, ih, Matrix.one_mul,
      givensQRStep_transpose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_givensQRQ
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_givensQRQ (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (givensQRQ H k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact givensQRQ_transpose_mul_self H k

name: NLAlib.givensQRState_invariant
statement:
theorem givensQRState_invariant {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H)
    (k : ℕ) : IsUpperHessenberg (givensQRState H k) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin n, (i : ℕ) = j + 1 → (j : ℕ) < k → givensQRState H k i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨hH, fun _ _ _ h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih
    by_cases hk : k + 1 < n
    · set W := givensQRState H k with hWdef
      set K : Fin n := ⟨k, by omega⟩ with hK
      set K1 : Fin n := ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ with hK1
      have hKK : K ≠ K1 := by simp [hK, hK1, Fin.ext_iff]
      have happ : ∀ a b, givensQRState H (k + 1) a b =
          ((givensRotation K K1 (W.col K))ᵀ *ᵥ W.col b) a := by
        intro a b
        simp only [givensQRState, givensQRStep, dif_pos hk]
        rfl
      
      have hcol : ∀ j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) < k → ∀ a, givensQRState H (k + 1) a j = W a j := by
        intro j hj a
        rw [happ, givensRotation, givens_transpose_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero hKK]
        · rfl
        · show W K j = 0
          by_cases hj' : (j : ℕ) + 1 < k
          · exact ih1 K j hj'
          · exact ih2 K j (by simp [hK]; omega) hj
        · exact ih1 K1 j (by simp [hK1]; omega)
      refine ⟨fun i j hij => ?_, fun i j hij hj => ?_⟩
      · by_cases hj : (j : ℕ) < k
        · rw [hcol j hj]; exact ih1 i j hij
        · rw [happ, givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne (by simp [hK, Fin.ext_iff]; omega)
            (by simp [hK1, Fin.ext_iff]; omega)]
          exact ih1 i j hij
      · by_cases hjk : (j : ℕ) < k
        · rw [hcol j hjk]; exact ih2 i j hij hjk
        · obtain rfl : j = K := Fin.ext (by simp [hK]; omega)
          obtain rfl : i = K1 := Fin.ext (by simp [hK1]; omega)
          rw [happ]
          exact givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_right hKK _
    · have hstep : givensQRState H (k + 1) = givensQRState H k := by
        simp only [givensQRState, givensQRStep, dif_neg hk, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul]
      rw [hstep]
      exact ⟨ih1, fun i j hij _ => ih2 i j hij (by have := i.isLt; omega)⟩

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_givensQR_snd
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_givensQR_snd {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H) : (givensQR H).2.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := givensQRState_invariant hH (n - 1)
  intro i j hij
  change j < i at hij
  have hij' := Fin.lt_def.1 hij
  by_cases h : (j : ℕ) + 1 < i
  · exact h1 i j h
  · exact h2 i j (by omega) (by have := i.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.isQR_givensQR
statement:
theorem isQR_givensQR {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H) :
    IsQR H (givensQR H).1 (givensQR H).2 where
  eq
proof:
:= (givensQRQ_mul_givensQRState H (n - 1)).symm
  orth := hasOrthonormalCols_givensQRQ H (n - 1)
  upper := isUpperTriangular_givensQR_snd hH

name: NLAlib.givensQRQ_invariant
statement:
theorem givensQRQ_invariant (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    IsUpperHessenberg (givensQRQ H k) ∧
      ∀ a b : Fin n, k < (b : ℕ) → givensQRQ H k a b = if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      simp only [givensQRQ, Matrix.one_apply]
      rw [if_neg (by intro h; subst b; omega)]
    · intro a b _
      simp only [givensQRQ, Matrix.one_apply]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨ihH, ihI⟩ := ih
    by_cases hk : k + 1 < n
    · let K : Fin n := ⟨k, by omega⟩
      let K1 : Fin n := ⟨k + 1, hk⟩
      let W := givensQRState H k
      let Q := givensQRQ H k
      have hKK : K ≠ K1 := by simp [K, K1, Fin.ext_iff]
      have happ (a b : Fin n) : givensQRQ H (k + 1) a b =
          ((givensRotation K K1 (W.col K))ᵀ *ᵥ Q.row a) b := by
        simp only [givensQRQ, givensQRStep, dif_pos hk, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
          Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.row]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro l _
        exact mul_comm _ _
      have hunchanged (a b : Fin n) (hbK : b ≠ K) (hbK1 : b ≠ K1) :
          givensQRQ H (k + 1) a b = Q a b := by
        rw [happ, givensRotation_transpose_mulVec_apply_of_ne hbK hbK1]
        rfl
      have hzeros (a : Fin n) (ha : k + 1 < a.val) : Q a K = 0 ∧ Q a K1 = 0 := by
        refine ⟨ihH a K (by simpa [K] using ha), ?_⟩
        change givensQRQ H k a K1 = 0
        rw [ihI a K1 (by simp [K1])]
        rw [if_neg (by intro he; have := congrArg Fin.val he; simp [K1] at this; omega)]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a b hab
        by_cases hbK : b = K
        · subst b
          have hz := hzeros a (by simpa [K] using hab)
          rw [happ, givensRotation, givens_transpose_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero hKK]
          · exact hz.1
          · exact hz.1
          · exact hz.2
        by_cases hbK1 : b = K1
        · subst b
          have hz := hzeros a (by simp [K1] at hab; omega)
          rw [happ, givensRotation, givens_transpose_mulVec_of_apply_eq_zero hKK]
          · exact hz.2
          · exact hz.1
          · exact hz.2
        · rw [hunchanged a b hbK hbK1]
          exact ihH a b hab
      · intro a b hb
        rw [hunchanged a b (by intro h; subst b; simp [K] at hb)
          (by intro h; subst b; simp [K1] at hb)]
        exact ihI a b (by omega)
    · have hsame : givensQRQ H (k + 1) = givensQRQ H k := by
        simp only [givensQRQ, givensQRStep, dif_neg hk, Matrix.mul_one]
      rw [hsame]
      exact ⟨ihH, fun a b hb => ihI a b (by omega)⟩

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_fst
statement:
theorem isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_fst (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    IsUpperHessenberg (givensQR H).1
proof:
:=
  (givensQRQ_invariant H (n - 1)).1

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_snd_mul_fst
statement:
theorem isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_snd_mul_fst {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hH : IsUpperHessenberg H) : IsUpperHessenberg ((givensQR H).2 * (givensQR H).1)
proof:
:=
  (isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_fst H).isUpperTriangular_mul (isUpperTriangular_givensQR_snd hH)

name: NLAlib.isTridiagonal_givensQR_snd_mul_fst
statement:
theorem isTridiagonal_givensQR_snd_mul_fst {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hS : H.IsHermitian)
    (hT : IsTridiagonal H) : IsTridiagonal ((givensQR H).2 * (givensQR H).1)
proof:
:=
  (isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_snd_mul_fst hT.1).isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian
    (isHermitian_mul_of_isQR hS (isQR_givensQR hT.1))

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_rectDiag_one
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_rectDiag_one {m n : ℕ} (hCard : n ≤ m) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (rectDiag (fun _ => 1) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
  ext i j
  simp only [one_pow]
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < m := i.isLt.trans_le hCard
  simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hi]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_one_of_hasOrthonormalCols
proof:
:= by
  let J : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ := rectDiag (fun _ => 1)
  have hJ := hasOrthonormalCols_rectDiag_one hCard
  have hGram : Uᴴ * U = Jᴴ * J := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    rw [(show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), (show Jᵀ * J = 1 from hJ)]
  have h := singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq U J hGram k
  change singularValues U k = singularValues J k at h
  rw [h]
  exact singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
    (U := (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) (V := (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
    (τ := fun _ => 1) (by simp) (by simp) (fun _ => zero_le_one) (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl)
    (by simp [J]) (by simpa only [min_eq_right hCard] using hk)

name: NLAlib.exists_svd_polar_with_distance
statement:
private theorem exists_svd_polar_with_distance {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hCard : n ≤ m) (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ (Fin m) (Fin n)) :
    ∃ U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols U ∧
      U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A ∧
      ν.seminorm (A - U) = ν.seminorm (rectangularDiagonal
        (fun i : Fin (min m n) => singularValues A i - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, R, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let J : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ := rectDiag (fun _ => 1)
  let U := L * J * Rᵀ
  let Q := R * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) * Rᵀ
  have hJ := hasOrthonormalCols_rectDiag_one hCard
  have hL : HasOrthonormalCols L := hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hRt : HasOrthonormalCols Rᵀ := by
    change Rᵀᵀ * Rᵀ = 1
    rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact hSVD.mul_conjTranspose_right
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := by
    change (L * J * Rᵀ)ᵀ * (L * J * Rᵀ) = 1
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Lᵀ L (J * Rᵀ), (show Lᵀ * L = 1 from hL), Matrix.one_mul,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Jᵀ J Rᵀ, (show Jᵀ * J = 1 from hJ), Matrix.one_mul,
      show R * Rᵀ = 1 from hSVD.mul_conjTranspose_right]
  have hQ : Q.PosSemidef := by
    have hD : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i)).PosSemidef :=
      Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => singularValues_nonneg A i)
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      hD.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  have hJD : J * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) =
      rectDiag (singularValues A) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, J, rectDiag_apply]
    split_ifs with hij <;> simp_all
  have hA : U * Q = A := by
    dsimp [U, Q]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Rᵀ R (Matrix.diagonal _ * Rᵀ),
      show Rᵀ * R = 1 from hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right,
      Matrix.one_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc J _ Rᵀ, hJD]
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      (show A = L * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * Rᵀ from hSVD.eq).symm
  have hRoot := eq_sqrt_gram_of_isometry_mul_eq hU hQ hA
  refine ⟨U, hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [← hRoot]
  · have hDiag : rectDiag (singularValues A) - J = rectangularDiagonal
        (fun i : Fin (min m n) => singularValues A i - 1) := by
      ext i j
      simp only [rectangularDiagonal, J, rectDiag_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
      by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
      · have hi : (i : ℕ) < min m n := by omega
        have hj : (j : ℕ) < min m n := by omega
        simp [hij, hj]
      · simp [hij]
    have hDiff : A - U = L * (rectDiag (singularValues A) - J) * Rᵀ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
        ← show A = L * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * Rᵀ from hSVD.eq]
    rw [hDiff, ν.right_invariant _ Rᵀ hRt, ν.left_invariant _ L hL, hDiag]

name: NLAlib.invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_isometry_fin
statement:
private theorem invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_isometry_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ (Fin m) (Fin n)) (A U V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hCard : n ≤ m) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hA : U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    ν.seminorm (A - U) ≤ ν.seminorm (A - V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀, hA₀, hDistance⟩ := exists_svd_polar_with_distance A hCard ν
  have hGram : (A - U)ᵀ * (A - U) = (A - U₀)ᵀ * (A - U₀) := by
    have hDiff : A - U = U * (CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) - 1) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hA, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hDiff₀ : A - U₀ = U₀ * (CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) - 1) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hA₀, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hDiff, hDiff₀, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U _, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc U₀ᵀ U₀ _, (show U₀ᵀ * U₀ = 1 from hU₀), Matrix.one_mul]
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hEq⟩ := exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq (A - U) (A - U₀) hGram
  have hNorm : ν.seminorm (A - U) = ν.seminorm (A - U₀) := by
    rw [← hEq, ν.left_invariant _ O hO]
  rw [hNorm, hDistance]
  have hWeak := weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub V (A - V)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hWeak
  rw [show V + (A - V) = A by abel] at hWeak
  have hσ : (fun i : Fin (min m n) => singularValues V i) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext i
    exact singularValues_eq_one_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV hCard
      (i.isLt.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  change WeaklyMajorized (fun i : Fin (min m n) =>
    |singularValues A i - (fun j : Fin (min m n) => singularValues V j) i|) _ at hWeak
  rw [hσ] at hWeak
  have h := ν.toSymmetricGaugeFin.value_le_of_weaklyMajorized
    (fun i => abs_nonneg (singularValues A i - 1)) hWeak
  rw [SymmetricGauge.value_abs, ν.value_toSymmetricGaugeFin,
    ← ν.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGaugeFin_singularValues] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_isometry
statement:
theorem invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_isometry {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n) (A U V : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hA : U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    ν.seminorm (A - U) ≤ ν.seminorm (A - V)
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  let AF := A.reindex em en
  let UF := U.reindex em en
  let VF := V.reindex em en
  let QF := (CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A)).reindex en en
  have hUF : HasOrthonormalCols UF := hU.reindex em en
  have hVF : HasOrthonormalCols VF := hV.reindex em en
  have hQF : QF.PosSemidef := by
    exact (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Aᵀ * A))).submatrix en.symm
  have hAF : UF * QF = AF := by
    rw [← mul_reindex, hA]
  have hRoot := eq_sqrt_gram_of_isometry_mul_eq hUF hQF hAF
  have h := invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_isometry_fin (ν.reindex em en) AF UF VF
    hCard hUF (by rwa [← hRoot]) hVF
  have hBack (M N : Matrix m n ℝ) :
      ((M.reindex em en - N.reindex em en).reindex em.symm en.symm) = M - N := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.reindex_apply]
  simpa only [UnitarilyInvariantNorm.reindex_seminorm_apply, AF, UF, VF,
    hBack] using h

name: NLAlib.invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_coisometry
statement:
theorem invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_coisometry {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n) (A U V : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card n) (hU : U * Uᵀ = 1)
    (hA : CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) * U = A) (hV : V * Vᵀ = 1) :
    ν.seminorm (A - U) ≤ ν.seminorm (A - V)
proof:
:= by
  have hUt : HasOrthonormalCols Uᵀ := by
    simpa only [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hU
  have hVt : HasOrthonormalCols Vᵀ := by
    simpa only [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hV
  have hSym : (CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ))ᵀ = CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (A * Aᵀ)).star_eq
  have hAt : Uᵀ * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀᵀ * Aᵀ) = Aᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hSym] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose hA
  have h := invariantNorm_sub_polar_le_sub_isometry ν.transpose Aᵀ Uᵀ Vᵀ hCard hUt hAt hVt
  change ν.seminorm (Aᵀ - Uᵀ)ᵀ ≤ ν.seminorm (Aᵀ - Vᵀ)ᵀ at h
  simpa only [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_maximum_volume_triangular_qr_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_maximum_volume_triangular_qr_blocks {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ π : (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ≃ n,
    ∃ Q : Matrix m (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ,
    ∃ T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ D : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ Q * Qᵀ = 1 ∧ IsUnit R ∧ R.IsUpperTriangular ∧
      IsUpperTrapezoidal D ∧
      A.submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D ∧
      (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      frobSq T + frobSq R⁻¹ * frobSq D ≤ (k : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n - k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, hQ, hQt, hR, hUpper, hFact, hEntry, hBudget⟩ :=
    exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks A k hk
  let Z := householderQ D
  let D' := householderR D
  have hQR : IsFullQR D Z D' := isFullQR_householderQR D
  let K := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) 0 0 Z
  have hK : HasOrthonormalCols K := by
    change (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) 0 0 Z)ᵀ *
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 Z = 1
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.transpose_zero,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      add_zero, zero_add, show Zᵀ * Z = 1 from hQR.orth, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  refine ⟨π, Q * K, R, T, D', hQ.mul hK, ?_, hR, hUpper, hQR.upper, ?_, hEntry, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc K Kᵀ Qᵀ,
      show K * Kᵀ = 1 from mul_eq_one_comm.mp hK, Matrix.one_mul, hQt]
  · rw [hFact, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    simp only [K, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
      Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, ← hQR.eq]
  · have hD : frobSq D = frobSq D' := by
      rw [hQR.eq, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQR.orth]
    rwa [hD] at hBudget

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtResidual_apply
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtResidual_apply (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) (i : m) :
    gramSchmidtResidual A j i =
      A i j - ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio j, (gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) * gramSchmidtCol A k i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtResidual, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply,
    Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finset.Iio j)
      (fun k => ((gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A k) i)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtCol_eq
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtCol_eq (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    gramSchmidtCol A j =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (gramSchmidtResidual A j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖⁻¹ •
        gramSchmidtResidual A j
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, gramSchmidtCol]; rfl

name: NLAlib.norm_smul_gramSchmidtCol
statement:
theorem norm_smul_gramSchmidtCol (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (gramSchmidtResidual A j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ • gramSchmidtCol A j =
      gramSchmidtResidual A j
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, gramSchmidtCol_eq, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self,
    smul_smul]
  by_cases h : √(gramSchmidtResidual A j ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtResidual A j) = 0
  · rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)] at h
    rw [dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h, smul_zero]
  · rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ h, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_gramSchmidtR
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_gramSchmidtR (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (gramSchmidtR A).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  change j < i at hij
  simp only [gramSchmidtR, of_apply]
  rw [if_neg (not_lt.2 hij.le), if_neg (ne_of_gt hij)]

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtR_apply_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtR_apply_self_nonneg (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ gramSchmidtR A j j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gramSchmidtR, of_apply, lt_irrefl, if_false, if_true]
  exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtR_apply_self_pos
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtR_apply_self_pos {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} (h : GramSchmidtSucceeds A)
    (j : Fin n) : 0 < gramSchmidtR A j j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gramSchmidtR, of_apply, lt_irrefl, if_false, if_true]
  refine Real.sqrt_pos.2 (lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) ?_)
  exact fun h0 => h j (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h0.symm)

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtQ_mul_gramSchmidtR
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtQ_mul_gramSchmidtR (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) :
    gramSchmidtQ A * gramSchmidtR A = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hv := congrFun (norm_smul_gramSchmidtCol A j) i
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self] at hv
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, gramSchmidtResidual_apply] at hv
  simp only [mul_apply, gramSchmidtQ, gramSchmidtR, of_apply, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero,
    Finset.filter_filter]
  have h1 : Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin n => k < j) = Finset.Iio j := by
    ext k; simp
  have h2 : Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin n => ¬k < j ∧ k = j) = {j} := by
    ext k; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h ▸ lt_irrefl _, h⟩⟩
  rw [h1, h2, Finset.sum_singleton]
  linear_combination hv + (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _ :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio j, gramSchmidtCol A k i * (gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio j, (gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) * gramSchmidtCol A k i)

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    gramSchmidtResidual A j =
      A.col j - ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio j, (gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtResidual,
    Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finset.Iio j)
      (fun k => (gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A k)]

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_self (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    gramSchmidtCol A j ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtCol A j = if gramSchmidtResidual A j = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtCol_eq, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · have hpos : 0 < gramSchmidtResidual A j ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtResidual A j :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (fun h0 => h (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h0.symm))
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_inv, ← sq, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_lt
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_lt (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) :
    gramSchmidtCol A i ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtCol A j = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) < k → i < j →
      gramSchmidtCol A i ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtCol A j = 0 from H _ i j (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hij
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i j hj; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i j hj hij
    have hprev : ∀ a b : Fin n, a < j → b < j → a ≠ b →
        gramSchmidtCol A a ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtCol A b = 0 := by
      intro a b ha hb hab
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
      · exact ih a b (by have := Fin.lt_def.1 hb; omega) h
      · rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact ih b a (by have := Fin.lt_def.1 ha; omega) h
    rw [gramSchmidtCol_eq A j, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    suffices hv : gramSchmidtCol A i ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtResidual A j = 0 by rw [hv, mul_zero]
    rw [gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sum]
    simp_rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_Iio.2 hij) fun b hb hbi =>
      by rw [hprev i b hij (Finset.mem_Iio.1 hb) (Ne.symm hbi), mul_zero],
      gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_self]
    split_ifs with h
    · have : gramSchmidtCol A i = 0 := by rw [gramSchmidtCol_eq, h, smul_zero]
      simp [this]
    · simp

name: NLAlib.transpose_gramSchmidtQ_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_gramSchmidtQ_mul_self (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (gramSchmidtQ A)ᵀ * gramSchmidtQ A =
      diagonal fun j => if gramSchmidtResidual A j = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hij : ((gramSchmidtQ A)ᵀ * gramSchmidtQ A) i j = gramSchmidtCol A i ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtCol A j :=
    rfl
  rw [hij]
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | rfl | h
  · rw [gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_lt A h, diagonal_apply_ne _ h.ne]
  · rw [gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_self, diagonal_apply_eq]
  · rw [dotProduct_comm, gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_lt A h, diagonal_apply_ne _ h.ne']

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_gramSchmidtQ
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_gramSchmidtQ {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} (h : GramSchmidtSucceeds A) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (gramSchmidtQ A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    transpose_gramSchmidtQ_mul_self]
  simp [h _]

name: NLAlib.isQR_gramSchmidt
statement:
theorem isQR_gramSchmidt {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} (h : GramSchmidtSucceeds A) :
    IsQR A (gramSchmidtQ A) (gramSchmidtR A) where
  eq
proof:
:= (gramSchmidtQ_mul_gramSchmidtR A).symm
  orth := hasOrthonormalCols_gramSchmidtQ h
  upper := isUpperTriangular_gramSchmidtR A

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtCol_mem_span
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtCol_mem_span (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    gramSchmidtCol A j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (A.col '' Set.Iic j)
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) < k →
      gramSchmidtCol A j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (A.col '' Set.Iic j) from H _ j (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro j hj; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro j hj
    rw [gramSchmidtCol_eq, gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ ?_ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l hl => ?_))
    · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, Set.mem_Iic.2 le_rfl, rfl⟩
    · have hlj := Finset.mem_Iio.1 hl
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.span_mono ?_ (ih l ?_))
      · exact Set.image_mono (Set.Iic_subset_Iic.2 hlj.le)
      · have := Fin.lt_def.1 hlj; omega

name: NLAlib.mem_span_of_gramSchmidtResidual_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum, sub_eq_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l hl => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun x hx =>
    Set.mem_Iio.2 (lt_of_le_of_lt (Set.mem_Iic.1 hx) (Finset.mem_Iio.1 hl)))
    (gramSchmidtCol_mem_span A l)

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_ne
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_ne (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    gramSchmidtCol A i ⬝ᵥ gramSchmidtCol A j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_lt A h
  · rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_lt A h

name: NLAlib.col_mem_span_gramSchmidtCol
statement:
theorem col_mem_span_gramSchmidtCol (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    A.col j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidtCol A '' Set.Iic j)
proof:
:= by
  have h : A.col j = gramSchmidtResidual A j +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio j, (gramSchmidtCol A k ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A k := by
    rw [gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum]; abel
  rw [← norm_smul_gramSchmidtCol A j, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self] at h
  rw [h]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, Set.mem_Iic.2 le_rfl, rfl⟩))
    (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l hl => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, Set.mem_Iic.2 (Finset.mem_Iio.1 hl).le, rfl⟩))

name: NLAlib.eq_sum_of_mem_span_gramSchmidtCol
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem l (Finset.mem_Iio.2 hl) fun k _ hkl => by
      rw [gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_of_ne A hkl, zero_smul], gramSchmidtCol_dotProduct_self]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [gramSchmidtCol_eq, h, smul_zero, zero_smul]
    · rw [one_smul]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    simp_rw [dotProduct_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [← hy, ← hz]
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    simp_rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum]
    rw [← hy]

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtResidual_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtResidual_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    gramSchmidtResidual A j = 0 ↔ A.col j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (A.col '' Set.Iio j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_span_of_gramSchmidtResidual_eq_zero, fun hj => ?_⟩
  have hle : Submodule.span ℝ (A.col '' Set.Iio j) ≤
      Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidtCol A '' Set.Iio j) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun x hx =>
      Set.mem_Iio.2 (lt_of_le_of_lt (Set.mem_Iic.1 hx) (Set.mem_Iio.1 hl)))
      (col_mem_span_gramSchmidtCol A l)
  rw [gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum, sub_eq_zero]
  exact eq_sum_of_mem_span_gramSchmidtCol A j (hle hj)

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtSucceeds_iff_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtSucceeds_iff_linearIndependent (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) :
    GramSchmidtSucceeds A ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ A.col
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hQR := isQR_gramSchmidt h
    have hdet : IsUnit (gramSchmidtR A).det :=
      hQR.isUnit_det_iff.2 fun j => (gramSchmidtR_apply_self_pos h j).ne'
    have key : ((gramSchmidtR A)⁻¹ * (gramSchmidtQ A)ᵀ) * A = 1 := by
      have hR : (gramSchmidtQ A)ᵀ * A = gramSchmidtR A := by
        simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial (gramSchmidtQ A)] using
          hQR.conjTranspose_mul_eq
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hR, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff]
    intro x y hxy
    have := congrArg (fun z => ((gramSchmidtR A)⁻¹ * (gramSchmidtQ A)ᵀ) *ᵥ z) hxy
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, key, Matrix.one_mulVec] using this
  · intro hA j hj
    exact hA.notMem_span_image (lt_irrefl j) (mem_span_of_gramSchmidtResidual_eq_zero hj)

name: NLAlib.range_castLE_eq_image_Iic
statement:
theorem range_castLE_eq_image_Iic {α : Type*} (f : Fin n → α) (k : Fin n) :
    Set.range (fun j : Fin (k + 1) => f (Fin.castLE k.isLt j)) = f '' Set.Iic k
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, Fin.le_def.2 (by simp only [Fin.val_castLE]; omega), rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, by have := Fin.le_def.1 hi; omega⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.span_gramSchmidtCol_image_Iic
statement:
theorem span_gramSchmidtCol_image_Iic (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidtCol A '' Set.Iic k) =
      Submodule.span ℝ (A.col '' Set.Iic k)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [Submodule.span_le] <;> rintro _ ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
  · exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (Set.Iic_subset_Iic.2 hl))
      (gramSchmidtCol_mem_span A l)
  · exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (Set.Iic_subset_Iic.2 hl))
      (col_mem_span_gramSchmidtCol A l)

name: NLAlib.span_gramSchmidtQ_castLE
statement:
theorem span_gramSchmidtQ_castLE (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun j : Fin (k + 1) => (gramSchmidtQ A).col (Fin.castLE k.isLt j)) =
      Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun j : Fin (k + 1) => A.col (Fin.castLE k.isLt j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_castLE_eq_image_Iic (gramSchmidtQ A).col, range_castLE_eq_image_Iic A.col]
  exact span_gramSchmidtCol_image_Iic A k

name: NLAlib.isGradedColumnBasis_gramSchmidtQ
statement:
theorem isGradedColumnBasis_gramSchmidtQ {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} (h : GramSchmidtSucceeds A) :
    IsGradedColumnBasis A (gramSchmidtQ A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasOrthonormalCols_gramSchmidtQ h, span_gramSchmidtQ_castLE A⟩

name: NLAlib.col_mul_mem_span_image_Iic
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Q * T).col j = ∑ i, T i j • Q.col i := by
    ext r; simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_apply, mul_comm]
  rw [h]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hij : i ≤ j
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hij, rfl⟩)
  · rw [hT (lt_of_not_ge hij), zero_smul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: NLAlib.IsQR.isGradedColumnBasis
statement:
theorem IsQR.isGradedColumnBasis {A Q : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} {R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (h : IsQR A Q R) (hR : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0) : IsGradedColumnBasis A Q
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit R.det := h.isUnit_det_iff.2 hR
  have hQ : Q = A * R⁻¹ := by
    rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hinv : R⁻¹.IsUpperTriangular := by
    have := R.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hdet; exact blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular h.upper
  refine ⟨h.orth, fun k => ?_⟩
  rw [range_castLE_eq_image_Iic Q.col, range_castLE_eq_image_Iic A.col]
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [Submodule.span_le] <;> rintro _ ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
  · refine Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (Set.Iic_subset_Iic.2 hl)) ?_
    rw [hQ]; exact col_mul_mem_span_image_Iic hinv l
  · refine Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (Set.Iic_subset_Iic.2 hl)) ?_
    rw [h.eq]; exact col_mul_mem_span_image_Iic h.upper l

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtCol_eq_gramSchmidtNormed
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtCol_eq_gramSchmidtNormed (A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    gramSchmidtCol A j =
      (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (fun k => WithLp.toLp 2 (A.col k)) j).ofLp
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ m := fun k => WithLp.toLp 2 (A.col k)
  suffices h : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin n, j.val < k →
      gramSchmidtCol A j = (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f j).ofLp from
    h (j.val + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro j hj; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro j hj
    have hprev : ∀ i : Fin n, i < j →
        WithLp.toLp 2 (gramSchmidtCol A i) = InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i := by
      intro i hij
      rw [ih i (by have := Fin.lt_def.mp hij; omega), WithLp.toLp_ofLp]
    have hres : WithLp.toLp 2 (gramSchmidtResidual A j) = InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f j := by
      rw [gramSchmidtResidual_eq_sum, WithLp.toLp_sub, WithLp.toLp_sum,
        InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_def]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [starProjection_singleton_eq_inner_normalized_smul]
      change WithLp.toLp 2 ((gramSchmidtCol A i ⬝ᵥ A.col j) • gramSchmidtCol A i) =
        (inner ℝ (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i) (f j)) •
          InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i
      rw [WithLp.toLp_smul, ← hprev i (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi)]
      simp only [f, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, star_trivial]
      rw [dotProduct_comm]
    have hnorm : ‖InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f j‖ =
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (gramSchmidtResidual A j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ := by
      rw [← hres]
    rw [gramSchmidtCol_eq, InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed, hnorm, ← hres,
      WithLp.ofLp_smul, WithLp.ofLp_toLp]
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]

name: NLAlib.projectionPivotResidual_nil
statement:
theorem projectionPivotResidual_nil {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    projectionPivotResidual Q [] = Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  change Qᴴ * (Q * Qᴴ) = Qᴴ
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.projectionPivotResidual_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem projectionPivotResidual_conjTranspose_mul_self {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n) :
    (projectionPivotResidual Q l)ᴴ * projectionPivotResidual Q l =
      eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l
proof:
:= by
  let K := Q * Qᴴ
  let R := eliminationListResidual K l
  have hK : K.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Q
  have hKp : IsIdempotentElem K := hQ.isIdempotentElem_mul_conjTranspose
  have hR : R.IsHermitian :=
    (posSemidef_eliminationListResidual (hK.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hKp) l).isHermitian
  have hRR : R * R = R := isIdempotentElem_eliminationListResidual_of_projector hK hKp l
  have hRK : R * K = R := eliminationListResidual_mul_of_mul_eq hKp l
  change (Qᴴ * R)ᴴ * (Qᴴ * R) = R
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  calc
    _ = (R * K) * R := by simp only [K, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = R := by rw [hRK, hRR]

name: NLAlib.norm_projectionPivotResidual_col_sq
statement:
theorem norm_projectionPivotResidual_col_sq {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n) (i : n) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((projectionPivotResidual Q l).col i)‖ ^ 2 =
      RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l i i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, ← conjTranspose_mul_self_apply,
    projectionPivotResidual_conjTranspose_mul_self hQ l]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projectionPivotResidual
statement:
theorem frobSq_projectionPivotResidual {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n) :
    frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q l) =
      RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    projectionPivotResidual_conjTranspose_mul_self hQ l]

name: NLAlib.choleskyPivotProbability_projectionPivotResidual
statement:
theorem choleskyPivotProbability_projectionPivotResidual {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n)
    (ht : frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q l) ≠ 0) (i : n) :
    choleskyPivotProbability (eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l) i =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((projectionPivotResidual Q l).col i)‖ ^ 2 /
        frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_projectionPivotResidual hQ l] at ht
  rw [choleskyPivotProbability, if_neg ht, norm_projectionPivotResidual_col_sq hQ l,
    frobSq_projectionPivotResidual hQ l]

name: NLAlib.projectionPivotResidual_append_singleton
proof:
:= projectionPivotResidual Q l
    let u := M.col i
    projectionPivotResidual Q (l ++ [i]) =
      (1 - (((‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))⁻¹ •
        Matrix.vecMulVec u (star u)) * M := by
  let R := eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l
  let M := projectionPivotResidual Q l
  have hPSD := posSemidef_eliminationListResidual (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose Q) l
  have hGram : Mᴴ * M = R := projectionPivotResidual_conjTranspose_mul_self hQ l
  have hrow : star (M.col i) ᵥ* M = fun j => R i j := by
    funext j
    exact congrFun (congrFun hGram i) j
  have hcol : Qᴴ *ᵥ (fun j => R j i) = M.col i := by
    funext j
    rfl
  have hnorm : ((‖WithLp.toLp 2 (M.col i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) = R i i := by
    rw [norm_projectionPivotResidual_col_sq hQ l]
    exact (diag_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef hPSD i).symm
  change Qᴴ * eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) (l ++ [i]) = _
  rw [eliminationListResidual_append_singleton]
  change Qᴴ * eliminationStep R i =
    (1 - (((‖WithLp.toLp 2 (M.col i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))⁻¹ •
      Matrix.vecMulVec (M.col i) (star (M.col i))) * M
  rw [hnorm, eliminationStep, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec,
    hcol, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, hrow]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_eq_card_sub_length
statement:
theorem frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_eq_card_sub_length {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n)
    (hl : eliminationPivotProduct (Q * Qᴴ) l ≠ 0) :
    frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q l) = ((Fintype.card d - l.length : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_projectionPivotResidual hQ l,
    trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ (isIdempotentElem_eliminationListResidual_of_projector
      (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Q) (hQ.isIdempotentElem_mul_conjTranspose) l), RCLike.natCast_re]
  have h := rank_eliminationListResidual_add_length_eq_of_pivotProduct_ne_zero (Q * Qᴴ) l hl
  rw [Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose, hQ.rank_eq_card] at h
  congr 1
  omega

name: NLAlib.choleskyPivotProbability_projectionPivotResidual_eq_div_card_sub_length
statement:
theorem choleskyPivotProbability_projectionPivotResidual_eq_div_card_sub_length
    {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n)
    (hl : eliminationPivotProduct (Q * Qᴴ) l ≠ 0) (ht : l.length < Fintype.card d) (i : n) :
    choleskyPivotProbability (eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l) i =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((projectionPivotResidual Q l).col i)‖ ^ 2 /
        ((Fintype.card d - l.length : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_eq_card_sub_length hQ l hl
  have hn : frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q l) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hnorm]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt ht).ne'
  rw [choleskyPivotProbability_projectionPivotResidual hQ l hn i, hnorm]

name: NLAlib.projectionPivotResidual_mul_conjTranspose_projector
statement:
theorem projectionPivotResidual_mul_conjTranspose_projector {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n) :
    (projectionPivotResidual Q l * (projectionPivotResidual Q l)ᴴ).IsHermitian ∧
      IsIdempotentElem (projectionPivotResidual Q l * (projectionPivotResidual Q l)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  let M := projectionPivotResidual Q l
  let R := eliminationListResidual (Q * Qᴴ) l
  have hGram : Mᴴ * M = R := projectionPivotResidual_conjTranspose_mul_self hQ l
  have hRR : R * R = R := isIdempotentElem_eliminationListResidual_of_projector
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Q) (hQ.isIdempotentElem_mul_conjTranspose) l
  refine ⟨Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self M, ?_⟩
  change (M * Mᴴ) * (M * Mᴴ) = M * Mᴴ
  calc
    _ = (M * (Mᴴ * M)) * Mᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (M * R) * Mᴴ := by rw [hGram]
    _ = _ := by
      have hMR : M * R = M := by
        change (Qᴴ * R) * R = Qᴴ * R
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hRR]
      rw [hMR]

name: NLAlib.projectionPivotProjector_certificate
statement:
theorem projectionPivotProjector_certificate {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n) :
    (projectionPivotProjector Q l).IsHermitian ∧
      IsIdempotentElem (projectionPivotProjector Q l) ∧
      projectionPivotResidual Q l * (projectionPivotResidual Q l)ᴴ =
        1 - projectionPivotProjector Q l
proof:
:= by
  have h := projectionPivotResidual_mul_conjTranspose_projector hQ l
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub h.1
  · exact (one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem h.1 h.2).2
  · unfold projectionPivotProjector
    abel

name: NLAlib.rank_projectionPivotProjector_eq_length
statement:
theorem rank_projectionPivotProjector_eq_length {Q : Matrix n d 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (l : List n)
    (hl : eliminationPivotProduct (Q * Qᴴ) l ≠ 0) :
    (projectionPivotProjector Q l).rank = l.length
proof:
:= by
  have hCert := projectionPivotProjector_certificate hQ l
  have hRank := rank_eliminationListResidual_add_length_eq_of_pivotProduct_ne_zero (Q * Qᴴ) l hl
  rw [Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose, hQ.rank_eq_card] at hRank
  have ht := congrArg RCLike.re (trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem
    (projectionPivotProjector Q l) hCert.2.1)
  have hM : RCLike.re (projectionPivotResidual Q l * (projectionPivotResidual Q l)ᴴ).trace =
      frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q l) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  simp only [projectionPivotProjector, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_one, map_sub,
    RCLike.natCast_re, hM, frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_eq_card_sub_length hQ l hl] at ht
  have hlen : l.length ≤ Fintype.card d := by omega
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hlen] at ht
  change (Fintype.card d : ℝ) - ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) - (l.length : ℝ)) =
    ((projectionPivotProjector Q l).rank : ℝ) at ht
  exact_mod_cast (by linarith : ((projectionPivotProjector Q l).rank : ℝ) = l.length)

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_mul_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_mul_of_mul_eq {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hAB : A * B = A) (i : n) : eliminationStep A i * B = eliminationStep A i
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (fun j => A i j) ᵥ* B = fun j => A i j := by
    funext j
    exact congrFun (congrFun hAB i) j
  rw [eliminationStep, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, hv,
    hAB]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_mul_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_mul_of_isIdempotentElem {P : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (i : n) : eliminationStep P i * P = eliminationStep P i
proof:
:=
  eliminationStep_mul_of_mul_eq hP i

name: NLAlib.isIdempotentElem_eliminationStep_of_projector
proof:
:= by
  have hPSD := hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp
  have hmul := eliminationStep_mul_of_isIdempotentElem hp i
  have hv : eliminationStep P i *ᵥ (fun j => P j i) = 0 := by
    have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M *ᵥ Pi.single i 1) hmul
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_single_one, Matrix.mulVec_single_one] at he
    change eliminationStep P i *ᵥ P.col i = 0
    rw [he]
    funext j
    exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right hPSD i j
  change eliminationStep P i * eliminationStep P i = eliminationStep P i
  conv_lhs => rhs; rw [eliminationStep]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, hv,
    Matrix.zero_vecMulVec, smul_zero, sub_zero, hmul]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_eliminationStep_of_projector
proof:
:= by
  have he := isIdempotentElem_eliminationStep_of_projector hs hp i
  rw [trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ he,
    trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ hp, RCLike.natCast_re, RCLike.natCast_re]
  have hr := rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq hi
  have hr' : ((eliminationStep P i).rank : ℝ) + 1 = P.rank := by exact_mod_cast hr
  linarith

name: NLAlib.eliminationTraceProduct_eq_descFactorial_of_projector
statement:
theorem eliminationTraceProduct_eq_descFactorial_of_projector {P : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (l : List n)
    (hz : eliminationPivotProduct P l ≠ 0) :
    eliminationTraceProduct P l = (P.rank.descFactorial l.length : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing P with
  | nil => simp [eliminationTraceProduct]
  | cons i l ih =>
    have hzi : P i i ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hz).1
    have hzl : eliminationPivotProduct (eliminationStep P i) l ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hz).2
    have heS := isHermitian_eliminationStep hs i
    have heP := isIdempotentElem_eliminationStep_of_projector hs hp i
    have hr := rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq hzi
    rw [eliminationTraceProduct, ih heS heP hzl,
      trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem P hp, RCLike.natCast_re, ← hr,
      List.length_cons, Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]

name: NLAlib.isIdempotentElem_eliminationListResidual_of_projector
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing P with
  | nil => exact hp
  | cons i l ih =>
    exact ih (isHermitian_eliminationStep hs i)
      (isIdempotentElem_eliminationStep_of_projector hs hp i)

name: NLAlib.eliminationListResidual_mul_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem eliminationListResidual_mul_of_mul_eq {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hAB : A * B = A) (l : List n) : eliminationListResidual A l * B = eliminationListResidual A l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => exact hAB
  | cons i l ih => exact ih (eliminationStep_mul_of_mul_eq hAB i)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_of_qr
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  apply singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq R A
  exact conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr hQ hFactor

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_of_qr
statement:
theorem moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_of_qr [DecidableEq m] {A Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} {R : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hFactor : Q * R = A) : moorePenroseConditionNumber R = moorePenroseConditionNumber A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hFactor, moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols Q R hQ]

name: NLAlib.eliminationListResidual_append
statement:
theorem eliminationListResidual_append (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l r : List n) :
    eliminationListResidual A (l ++ r) = eliminationListResidual (eliminationListResidual A l) r
proof:
:= by
  simp [eliminationListResidual, List.foldl_append]

name: NLAlib.eliminationListResidual_append_singleton
statement:
theorem eliminationListResidual_append_singleton (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l : List n) (i : n) :
    eliminationListResidual A (l ++ [i]) = eliminationStep (eliminationListResidual A l) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [eliminationListResidual, List.foldl_append]

name: NLAlib.eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton
statement:
theorem eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l : List n) (i : n) :
    eliminationPivotProduct A (l ++ [i]) =
      eliminationPivotProduct A l * eliminationListResidual A l i i
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => simp [eliminationPivotProduct, eliminationListResidual]
  | cons j l ih => simp [eliminationPivotProduct, eliminationListResidual, ih, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.eliminationTraceProduct_append_singleton
statement:
theorem eliminationTraceProduct_append_singleton (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l : List n) (i : n) :
    eliminationTraceProduct A (l ++ [i]) =
      eliminationTraceProduct A l * RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A l).trace
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => simp [eliminationTraceProduct, eliminationListResidual]
  | cons j l ih => simp [eliminationTraceProduct, eliminationListResidual, ih, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_eliminationListResidual
statement:
theorem posSemidef_eliminationListResidual {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (l : List n) : (eliminationListResidual A l).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => exact hA
  | cons i l ih => exact ih (posSemidef_eliminationStep hA i)

name: NLAlib.eliminationListResidual_le
statement:
theorem eliminationListResidual_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (l : List n) :
    eliminationListResidual A l ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons i l ih => exact (ih (posSemidef_eliminationStep hA i)).trans (eliminationStep_le hA i)

name: NLAlib.re_trace_eliminationListResidual_le
statement:
theorem re_trace_eliminationListResidual_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (l : List n) :
    RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A l).trace ≤ RCLike.re A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hn := re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp (eliminationListResidual_le hA l))
  rw [Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub] at hn
  linarith

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_cons_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem det_submatrix_cons_of_ne_zero (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) {k : ℕ}
    (i : n) (h : Fin k → n) (hi : A i i ≠ 0) :
    (A.submatrix (Fin.cons i h) (Fin.cons i h)).det =
      A i i * ((eliminationStep A i).submatrix h h).det
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) 𝕜 := Matrix.diagonal fun _ => A i i
  let R : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin k) 𝕜 := fun _ j => A i (h j)
  let C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin 1) 𝕜 := fun j _ => A (h j) i
  have hD : IsUnit D := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det D).mpr (by
    simpa [D, Matrix.det_unique] using isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi)
  let := hD.invertible
  have he : (A.submatrix (Fin.cons i h) (Fin.cons i h)).submatrix
      (finOneSumEquiv k) (finOneSumEquiv k) = Matrix.fromBlocks D R C (A.submatrix h h) := by
    ext a b
    cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [D, R, C, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.diagonal, Fin.eq_zero]
  rw [← Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self (finOneSumEquiv k), he, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁]
  have hs : A.submatrix h h - C * ⅟D * R = (eliminationStep A i).submatrix h h := by
    rw [Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, show D⁻¹ = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => (A i i)⁻¹) by
      simp [D]]
    ext a b
    change A (h a) (h b) - _ = A (h a) (h b) - _
    congr 1
    change (∑ x : Fin 1, (∑ y : Fin 1, A (h a) i *
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => (A i i)⁻¹)) y x) * A i (h b)) =
        (A i i)⁻¹ * (A (h a) i * A i (h b))
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
    ring
  rw [hs]
  simp [D, Matrix.det_unique]

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_cons_eq_mul_det_eliminationStep
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_cons_eq_mul_det_eliminationStep {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ} (i : n) (h : Fin k → n) :
    (A.submatrix (Fin.cons i h) (Fin.cons i h)).det =
      A i i * ((eliminationStep A i).submatrix h h).det
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : A i i = 0
  · rw [hi, zero_mul]
    apply Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero 0
    intro j
    simpa using apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero' hA hi
      ((Fin.cons i h : Fin (k + 1) → n) j)
  · exact det_submatrix_cons_of_ne_zero A i h hi

name: NLAlib.det_submatrix_eq_eliminationPivotProduct
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing A with
  | zero => simp [eliminationPivotProduct]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail h, List.ofFn_cons, eliminationPivotProduct,
      det_submatrix_cons_eq_mul_det_eliminationStep hA]
    rw [ih (posSemidef_eliminationStep hA (h 0))]

name: NLAlib.eliminationTraceProduct_nonneg
statement:
theorem eliminationTraceProduct_nonneg {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (l : List n) : 0 ≤ eliminationTraceProduct A l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => exact zero_le_one
  | cons i l ih =>
    exact mul_nonneg (re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA)
      (ih (posSemidef_eliminationStep hA i))

name: NLAlib.re_eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton
statement:
theorem re_eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (l : List n) (i : n) :
    RCLike.re (eliminationPivotProduct A (l ++ [i])) =
      RCLike.re (eliminationPivotProduct A l) *
        RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A l i i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton,
    diag_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef (posSemidef_eliminationListResidual hA l) i]
  simp

name: NLAlib.rank_le_rank_eliminationStep_add_one
statement:
theorem rank_le_rank_eliminationStep_add_one (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (i : n) :
    A.rank ≤ (eliminationStep A i).rank + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : A i i = 0
  · rw [eliminationStep_eq_self_of_apply_self_eq_zero hi]
    omega
  · exact (rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq hi).ge

name: NLAlib.rank_le_rank_eliminationListResidual_add_length
statement:
theorem rank_le_rank_eliminationListResidual_add_length (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l : List n) :
    A.rank ≤ (eliminationListResidual A l).rank + l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons i l ih =>
    have hOne := rank_le_rank_eliminationStep_add_one A i
    have hRest := ih (eliminationStep A i)
    change A.rank ≤ (eliminationListResidual (eliminationStep A i) l).rank + (l.length + 1)
    omega

name: NLAlib.eliminationTraceProduct_pos
statement:
theorem eliminationTraceProduct_pos {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (l : List n) (hl : l.length ≤ A.rank) : 0 < eliminationTraceProduct A l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => exact zero_lt_one
  | cons i l ih =>
    have hRank : 0 < A.rank := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp : 0 < (i :: l).length) hl
    have hTrace : 0 < RCLike.re A.trace := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA) ?_
      intro hz
      have hZero := (re_trace_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef hA).mp hz.symm
      simp [hZero] at hRank
    have hOne := rank_le_rank_eliminationStep_add_one A i
    have hLen : l.length ≤ (eliminationStep A i).rank := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hl; omega
    exact mul_pos hTrace (ih (posSemidef_eliminationStep hA i) hLen)

name: NLAlib.rank_sub_eliminationStep_le_one
statement:
theorem rank_sub_eliminationStep_le_one (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (i : n) :
    (A - eliminationStep A i).rank ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eliminationStep, sub_sub_cancel, ← Matrix.smul_vecMulVec]
  exact Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le _ _

name: NLAlib.rank_sub_eliminationListResidual_le_length
statement:
theorem rank_sub_eliminationListResidual_le_length (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l : List n) :
    (A - eliminationListResidual A l).rank ≤ l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => simp [eliminationListResidual]
  | cons i l ih =>
    have he : A - eliminationListResidual A (i :: l) =
        (A - eliminationStep A i) +
          (eliminationStep A i - eliminationListResidual (eliminationStep A i) l) := by
      change A - eliminationListResidual (eliminationStep A i) l = _
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact (rank_add_le _ _).trans
      ((add_le_add (rank_sub_eliminationStep_le_one A i) (ih _)).trans (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega))

name: NLAlib.rank_eliminationListResidual_add_length_eq_of_pivotProduct_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rank_eliminationListResidual_add_length_eq_of_pivotProduct_ne_zero
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (l : List n) (hl : eliminationPivotProduct A l ≠ 0) :
    (eliminationListResidual A l).rank + l.length = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing A with
  | nil => simp [eliminationListResidual]
  | cons i l ih =>
    have hp : A i i ≠ 0 ∧ eliminationPivotProduct (eliminationStep A i) l ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hl
    have hOne := rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq hp.1
    have hRest := ih (eliminationStep A i) hp.2
    change (eliminationListResidual (eliminationStep A i) l).rank + (l.length + 1) = A.rank
    omega

name: NLAlib.exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq
statement:
theorem exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) :
    ∃ U : Matrix m n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A
proof:
:= by
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ Aᵀ * A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).nonneg
  have hSym : (CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A))ᵀ = CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Aᵀ * A)).star_eq
  apply exists_isometry_mul_eq_of_gram_eq (CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A)) A hCard
  rw [hSym, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hNonneg]

name: NLAlib.eq_sqrt_gram_of_isometry_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique _ hQ.nonneg
  rw [← hA, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  have hSym : Qᵀ = Q := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hQ.isHermitian.eq
  rw [hSym, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U Q, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_sqrt_rowGram_mul_coisometry_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sqrt_rowGram_mul_coisometry_eq [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card m ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    ∃ U : Matrix m n ℝ, U * Uᵀ = 1 ∧ CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) * U = A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hEq⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq Aᵀ hCard
  refine ⟨Vᵀ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Vᵀ * V = 1
    exact hV
  · have hSym : (CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ))ᵀ = CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) := by
      simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (A * Aᵀ)).star_eq
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose hEq
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul, hSym] using h

name: NLAlib.eq_polarFrame_of_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hGram : IsUnit (Aᵀ * A) := by
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    apply det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq
    rwa [Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self]
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ Aᵀ * A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
