      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).nonneg
  have hSqrt := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff _ hNonneg).mpr hGram
  have hInv := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hSqrt)
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => M * (CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A))⁻¹) hA
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, hInv, Matrix.mul_one, polarFrame] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_ne_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq_of_rank_lt
statement:
theorem exists_ne_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq_of_rank_lt {A U : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hA : U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A)
    (hRank : A.rank < Fintype.card n) :
    ∃ V : Matrix m n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols V ∧
      V * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A ∧ V ≠ U
proof:
:= by
  let Q := CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A)
  let P := Q * moorePenroseInverse Q
  let T := P + P - 1
  have hP : P * P = P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem Q
  have hPs : Pᵀ = P := (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian Q).eq
  have hT : Tᵀ * T = 1 := by
    dsimp [T]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_one, hPs,
      Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_sub,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hP]
    abel
  have hPQ : P * Q = Q := mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul Q
  have hTQ : T * Q = Q := by
    dsimp [T]
    simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hPQ]
    abel
  refine ⟨U * T, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (U * T)ᵀ * (U * T) = 1
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U T,
      (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul, hT]
  · change (U * T) * Q = A
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hTQ]
    exact hA
  · intro hEq
    have hTI : T = 1 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => Uᵀ * M) hEq
      rwa [← Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul] at h
    have hPI : P = 1 := by
      ext i j
      have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M i j) hTI
      change P i j + P i j - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j = (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j at h
      linarith
    have hQRank : Q.rank = Fintype.card n := by
      have h := rank_mul_moorePenroseInverse Q
      change P.rank = Q.rank at h
      rw [hPI, Matrix.rank_one] at h
      exact h.symm
    have hLeft : Q = Uᵀ * A := by
      rw [← hA, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul]
    have hBound : Q.rank ≤ A.rank := by
      rw [hLeft]
      exact Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _
    omega

name: NLAlib.polar_isometry_unique_iff_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem polar_isometry_unique_iff_rank_eq_card {A U : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hA : U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A) :
    (∀ V : Matrix m n ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols V →
      V * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A → V = U) ↔ A.rank = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hRank
    have hlt := lt_of_le_of_ne A.rank_le_card_width hRank
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVA, hVU⟩ := exists_ne_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq_of_rank_lt hU hA hlt
    exact hVU (h V hV hVA)
  · intro hRank V _ hVA
    exact (eq_polarFrame_of_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq hRank hVA).trans
      (eq_polarFrame_of_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq hRank hA).symm

name: NLAlib.sqrt_rowGram_mul_eq_of_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq
proof:
:= by
  let Q := CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A)
  let P := U * Q * Uᵀ
  have hAQ : U * Q = A := hA
  have hQ : Q.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hP : P.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      hQ.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U
  have hQs : Qᵀ = Q := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hQ.isHermitian.eq
  have hSq : P * P = A * Aᵀ := by
    change (U * Q * Uᵀ) * (U * Q * Uᵀ) = A * Aᵀ
    calc
      _ = U * Q * Q * Uᵀ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U (Q * Uᵀ), (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = A * Aᵀ := by
        rw [← hAQ]
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, hQs, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hRoot : CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) = P := CFC.sqrt_unique hSq hP.nonneg
  rw [hRoot]
  change (U * Q * Uᵀ) * U = A
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.mul_one]
  exact hA

name: NLAlib.polar_coisometry_unique_iff_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem polar_coisometry_unique_iff_rank_eq_card [DecidableEq m]
    {A U : Matrix m n ℝ} (hU : U * Uᵀ = 1)
    (hA : CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) * U = A) :
    (∀ V : Matrix m n ℝ, V * Vᵀ = 1 →
      CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) * V = A → V = U) ↔ A.rank = Fintype.card m
proof:
:= by
  have hSym : (CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ))ᵀ = CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (A * Aᵀ)).star_eq
  have hUt : HasOrthonormalCols Uᵀ := by
    simpa only [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hAt : Uᵀ * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀᵀ * Aᵀ) = Aᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, hSym, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose hA
  rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose A, ← polar_isometry_unique_iff_rank_eq_card hUt hAt]
  constructor
  · intro h V hV hVA
    apply Matrix.transpose_injective
    have hVr : Vᵀ * Vᵀᵀ = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using (show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hV)
    have hVar : CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) * Vᵀ = A := by
      simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hSym] using
        congrArg Matrix.transpose hVA
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using h Vᵀ hVr hVar
  · intro h V hV hVA
    apply Matrix.transpose_injective
    have hVt : HasOrthonormalCols Vᵀ := by
      simpa only [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hV
    apply h Vᵀ hVt
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hSym] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose hVA

name: NLAlib.sum_choleskyPivotProbability
statement:
theorem sum_choleskyPivotProbability [Nonempty n] (R : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : RCLike.re R.trace = 0
  · simp only [choleskyPivotProbability, if_pos ht, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_one_div_cancel (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero)
  · simp only [choleskyPivotProbability, if_neg ht, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [show (∑ i, RCLike.re (R i i)) = RCLike.re R.trace by simp [Matrix.trace, map_sum]]
    exact div_self ht

name: NLAlib.choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg
statement:
theorem choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg {R : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hR : R.PosSemidef) (i : n) :
    0 ≤ choleskyPivotProbability R i
proof:
:= by
  unfold choleskyPivotProbability
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · exact div_nonneg (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hR.diag_nonneg).1 (re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef hR)

name: NLAlib.choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : RCLike.re R.trace = 0
  · have hz := (re_trace_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef hR).mp ht
    simp [hz, choleskyPivotProbability]
  · simp [choleskyPivotProbability, ht]

name: NLAlib.sum_choleskyPivotProbability_smul_eliminationStep_eq
statement:
theorem sum_choleskyPivotProbability_smul_eliminationStep_eq [Nonempty n]
    {R : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hR : R.PosSemidef) (ht : RCLike.re R.trace ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i • eliminationStep R i) =
      R - (RCLike.re R.trace)⁻¹ • (R * R)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag : ∀ i, ((RCLike.re (R i i) : ℝ) : 𝕜) = R i i := fun i =>
    (diag_eq_ofReal_re_of_posSemidef hR i).symm
  have hc : ∀ i j k, ((RCLike.re (R i i) / RCLike.re R.trace) : ℝ) •
      ((R i i)⁻¹ * (R j i * R i k)) = (RCLike.re R.trace)⁻¹ • (R j i * R i k) := by
    intro i j k
    by_cases hi : R i i = 0
    · rw [hi, apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hR hi j]
      simp
    · rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, RCLike.ofReal_div,
        RCLike.ofReal_inv, hdiag]
      field_simp
  ext j k
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, eliminationStep_apply, smul_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Matrix.sub_apply]
  have hp : ∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i • R j k = R j k := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_smul, sum_choleskyPivotProbability, one_smul]
  rw [hp]
  simp only [choleskyPivotProbability, if_neg ht, hc, ← Finset.smul_sum, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.sum_choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace_eliminationStep_eq
statement:
theorem sum_choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace_eliminationStep_eq [Nonempty n]
    {R : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hR : R.PosSemidef) :
    (∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i * RCLike.re (eliminationStep R i).trace) =
      RCLike.re R.trace - RCLike.re (R * R).trace / RCLike.re R.trace
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : RCLike.re R.trace = 0
  · have hz : R = 0 := (re_trace_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef hR).mp ht
    rw [hz]
    simp
  · have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re M.trace)
      (sum_choleskyPivotProbability_smul_eliminationStep_eq hR ht)
    simpa only [Matrix.trace_sum, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, map_sum,
      RCLike.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_le_norm_deimPivot
statement:
theorem norm_le_norm_deimPivot [Nonempty n] (v : n → 𝕜) (i : n) :
    ‖v i‖ ≤ ‖v (deimPivot v)‖
proof:
:=
  (Finset.exists_max_image univ (fun i => ‖v i‖) univ_nonempty).choose_spec.2 i (mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.deimPivot_ne_zero
statement:
theorem deimPivot_ne_zero [Nonempty n] {v : n → 𝕜} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    v (deimPivot v) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  apply hv
  funext i
  have hi := norm_le_norm_deimPivot v i
  rw [hz, norm_zero] at hi
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hi (norm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.deimResidual_apply_indices
statement:
theorem deimResidual_apply_indices {U : Matrix n (Fin r) 𝕜} {k : ℕ} (hk : k < r)
    (indices : Fin k → n) (hM : IsUnit (deimSampleMatrix U k hk.le indices)) (i : Fin k) :
    deimResidual U k hk indices (indices i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hright : deimSampleMatrix U k hk.le indices *
      (deimSampleMatrix U k hk.le indices)⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hM)
  have he := congr_fun (congrArg (fun M => M *ᵥ (fun j => U (indices j) ⟨k, hk⟩)) hright) i
  simp only [Matrix.one_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at he
  change U (indices i) ⟨k, hk⟩ - _ = 0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr he.symm

name: NLAlib.deimResidual_ne_zero
statement:
theorem deimResidual_ne_zero {U : Matrix n (Fin r) 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < r) (indices : Fin k → n) : deimResidual U k hk indices ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have he : U.col ⟨k, hk⟩ = deimPrefix U k hk.le *ᵥ
      ((deimSampleMatrix U k hk.le indices)⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun i => U (indices i) ⟨k, hk⟩)) :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  apply hU.linearIndependent_col.notMem_span ⟨k, hk⟩
  rw [he, mulVec_eq_sum_smul_col]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i hi
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨Fin.castLE hk.le i, ?_, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  intro heq
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val heq
  simp only [Fin.val_castLE] at hv
  have := i.isLt
  omega

name: NLAlib.isUnit_deimSampleMatrix_snoc
statement:
theorem isUnit_deimSampleMatrix_snoc {U : Matrix n (Fin r) 𝕜}
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < r) (indices : Fin k → n)
    (hM : IsUnit (deimSampleMatrix U k hk.le indices)) (pivot : n)
    (hp : deimResidual U k hk indices pivot ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (deimSampleMatrix U (k + 1) (by omega) (Fin.snoc indices pivot))
proof:
:= by
  let M := deimSampleMatrix U k hk.le indices
  let B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin 1) 𝕜 := fun i _ => U (indices i) ⟨k, hk⟩
  let C : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin k) 𝕜 := fun _ j => U pivot (Fin.castLE hk.le j)
  let D : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) 𝕜 := fun _ _ => U pivot ⟨k, hk⟩
  let S₁ : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) 𝕜 := Matrix.of fun _ _ => deimResidual U k hk indices pivot
  let e : Fin k ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin (k + 1) := finSumFinEquiv
  have hcast (i : Fin k) : Fin.castAdd 1 i = i.castSucc := rfl
  have hlast : Fin.natAdd k (0 : Fin 1) = Fin.last k := rfl
  have hcolLast : Fin.castLE (by omega : k + 1 ≤ r) (Fin.last k) = (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin r) :=
    Fin.ext rfl
  have hblock : (deimSampleMatrix U (k + 1) (by omega) (Fin.snoc indices pivot)).submatrix e e =
      Matrix.fromBlocks M B C D := by
    ext i j
    rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
    · simp [deimSampleMatrix, M, e, finSumFinEquiv, hcast]
    · have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst j
      simp [deimSampleMatrix, B, e, finSumFinEquiv, hcast, hlast, hcolLast]
    · have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      simp [deimSampleMatrix, C, e, finSumFinEquiv, hcast, hlast]
    · have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i j
      simp [deimSampleMatrix, D, e, finSumFinEquiv, hcast, hlast, hcolLast]
  letI : Invertible M := hM.invertible
  have hschur : D - C * ⅟M * B = S₁ := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv]
    simp only [D, C, B, deimResidual, deimPrefix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.col, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rfl
  have hscalar : IsUnit S₁ := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]
    simpa [S₁, Matrix.det_unique] using (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp)
  have hbig : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks M B C D) :=
    Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₁₁.mpr (hschur ▸ hscalar)
  rw [← hblock] at hbig
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_submatrix_equiv e e).mp hbig

name: NLAlib.isUnit_deimSampleMatrix_deimIndices
statement:
theorem isUnit_deimSampleMatrix_deimIndices [Nonempty n]
    {U : Matrix n (Fin r) 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ r) :
    IsUnit (deimSampleMatrix U k hk (deimIndices U k hk))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have he : deimSampleMatrix U 0 hk (deimIndices U 0 hk) = 1 := by
      ext i; exact i.elim0
    rw [he]
    exact isUnit_one
  | succ k ih =>
    apply isUnit_deimSampleMatrix_snoc (by omega) _ (ih (by omega))
    exact deimPivot_ne_zero (deimResidual_ne_zero hU (by omega) _)

name: NLAlib.deimIndices_injective
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact fun i => i.elim0
  | succ k ih =>
    let previous := deimIndices U k (by omega)
    let residual := deimResidual U k (by omega) previous
    have hp : residual (deimPivot residual) ≠ 0 :=
      deimPivot_ne_zero (deimResidual_ne_zero hU (by omega) previous)
    have hnew : ∀ i, previous i ≠ deimPivot residual := by
      intro i hi
      apply hp
      rw [← hi]
      exact deimResidual_apply_indices (by omega) previous
        (isUnit_deimSampleMatrix_deimIndices hU k (by omega)) i
    change Function.Injective (Fin.snoc previous (deimPivot residual))
    apply Fin.snoc_injective_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨ih (by omega), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact hnew i hi

name: NLAlib.det_gram_updateCol_eq_det_mul
statement:
theorem det_gram_updateCol_eq_det_mul {m p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq p]
    (C : Matrix m p ℝ) (hC : IsUnit (Cᵀ * C).det) (i : p) (t : p → ℝ) (d : m → ℝ)
    (hd : Cᵀ *ᵥ d = 0) :
    ((C.updateCol i (C *ᵥ t + d))ᵀ * C.updateCol i (C *ᵥ t + d)).det =
      (Cᵀ * C).det * (t i ^ 2 + ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 d : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2 * (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ i i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  let K := (1 : Matrix p p ℝ).updateCol i t
  let M := C * K
  let R := (0 : Matrix m p ℝ).updateCol i d
  have hM : M = C.updateCol i (C *ᵥ t) := by
    simp only [M, K, Matrix.mul_updateCol, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hUpdate : C.updateCol i (C *ᵥ t + d) = M + R := by
    rw [hM]
    ext a b
    by_cases hb : b = i
    · subst b
      simp [R]
    · simp [R, Matrix.updateCol_ne hb]
  have hCR : Cᵀ * R = 0 := by
    simp only [R, Matrix.mul_updateCol, Matrix.mul_zero, hd, Matrix.updateCol_zero_zero]
  have hMR : Mᵀ * R = 0 := by
    rw [show Mᵀ = Kᵀ * Cᵀ from Matrix.transpose_mul C K,
      Matrix.mul_assoc, hCR, Matrix.mul_zero]
  have hRM : Rᵀ * M = 0 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose hMR
  have hRR : Rᵀ * R = Matrix.single i i (d ⬝ᵥ d) := by
    change ((0 : Matrix m p ℝ).updateCol i d)ᵀ * (0 : Matrix m p ℝ).updateCol i d = _
    rw [← Matrix.updateRow_transpose, Matrix.transpose_zero,
      Matrix.updateRow_zero_mul_updateCol_zero]
  have hGram : (M + R)ᵀ * (M + R) = Mᵀ * M + Matrix.single i i (d ⬝ᵥ d) := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_add,
      hMR, hRM, hRR, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hMinor : ((Mᵀ * M).updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)).det =
      ((Cᵀ * C).updateCol i (Pi.single i 1)).det := by
    apply det_updateCol_single_eq_of_complement_eq
    intro a b ha hb
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [hM, Matrix.updateCol_ne ha, Matrix.updateCol_ne hb]
  have hKdet : K.det = t i := by
    change ((1 : Matrix p p ℝ).updateCol i t).det = t i
    rw [← Matrix.cramer_apply, Matrix.cramer_one]
    rfl
  have hMdet : (Mᵀ * M).det = (Cᵀ * C).det * t i ^ 2 := by
    have heq : Mᵀ * M = Kᵀ * (Cᵀ * C) * K := by
      simp only [M, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [heq, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hKdet]
    ring
  rw [hUpdate, hGram, det_add_single_diagonal, hMinor,
    det_updateCol_single_eq_det_mul_inv _ hC, hMdet]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm_of_polar
proof:
:= by
  let Q := CFC.sqrt (Mᵀ * M)
  have hQs : Qᵀ = Q := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Mᵀ * M)).star_eq
  have hMQ : U * Q = M := hM
  have hPair : frobInner M U = Q.trace := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    nth_rw 1 [← hMQ]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU), Matrix.mul_one, hQs]
  exact hPair.trans (nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_gram M).symm

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_eq_frobInner_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_eq_frobInner_mul_transpose (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix m m ℝ) :
    frobInner A (U * B) = frobInner (A * Bᵀ) U
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    Matrix.trace_mul_cycle']
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_mul_eq_of_cross_polar
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_mul_eq_of_cross_polar (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix m m ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hPolar : U * CFC.sqrt ((A * Bᵀ)ᵀ * (A * Bᵀ)) = A * Bᵀ) :
    frobSq (A - U * B) = frobSq A + frobSq B - 2 * nuclearNorm (A * Bᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU,
    frobInner_mul_eq_frobInner_mul_transpose, frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm_of_polar hU hPolar]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_add_frobSq_sub_two_nuclearNorm_le_sub_mul
statement:
theorem frobSq_add_frobSq_sub_two_nuclearNorm_le_sub_mul
    (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix m m ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    frobSq A + frobSq B - 2 * nuclearNorm (A * Bᵀ) ≤ frobSq (A - U * B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one (A * Bᵀ) U
    (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU)
  rw [frobSq_sub, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU,
    frobInner_mul_eq_frobInner_mul_transpose]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.isLeast_frobSq_sub_orthogonal_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hPolar⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq (A * Bᵀ) le_rfl
  refine ⟨⟨U, hU, frobSq_sub_mul_eq_of_cross_polar A B U hU hPolar⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩
  exact frobSq_add_frobSq_sub_two_nuclearNorm_le_sub_mul A B V hV

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_nuclearNorm_iff_posSemidef
statement:
theorem trace_eq_nuclearNorm_iff_posSemidef (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    M.trace = nuclearNorm M ↔ M.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hTrace
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hM⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq M le_rfl
    let Q := CFC.sqrt (Mᵀ * M)
    let H := CFC.sqrt Q
    have hQ : Q.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hHs : Hᵀ = H := by
      simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        (CFC.sqrt_nonneg Q).star_eq
    have hHH : H * H = Q := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hQ.nonneg
    have hMQ : U * Q = M := hM
    have hNorm : frobSq H = Q.trace := by
      rw [frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hHs, hHH]
    have hPair : frobInner H (U * H) = M.trace := by
      rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hHs, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hHH, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, hMQ]
    have hFrob : frobSq (H - U * H) = 0 := by
      rw [frobSq_sub, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU, hNorm, hPair,
        hTrace, nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_gram]
      change Q.trace - 2 * Q.trace + Q.trace = 0
      ring
    have hHU : H = U * H := sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp hFrob)
    have hEqual : M = Q := by
      rw [← hMQ, ← hHH, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hHU]
    rwa [hEqual]
  · intro hM
    exact (nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef hM).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_isNormalizedGSVD
statement:
theorem exists_isNormalizedGSVD (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (L : Matrix p n 𝕜) :
    ∃ X c s, IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, a, b, hX, hA, hL, ha, hb, hab⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_psd_pair_congruence
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A) (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self L)
  refine ⟨X, fun i => Real.sqrt (a i), fun i => Real.sqrt (b i), hX, ?_, ?_,
    fun i => Real.sqrt_nonneg _, fun i => Real.sqrt_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (ha _)] using hA
  · simpa only [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hb _)] using hL
  · simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (ha _), Real.sq_sqrt (hb _)] using hab

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.stack_gram
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.stack_gram {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜}
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ} (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) :
    Xᴴ * ((Matrix.fromRows A L)ᴴ * Matrix.fromRows A L) * X =
      diagonal (fun i => ((c i ^ 2 + s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromRows_eq_fromCols_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows,
    Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, h.left_gram, h.right_gram, Matrix.diagonal_add]
  simp only [map_add, map_pow]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.rank_stack_eq_card_active
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he := congrArg Matrix.rank h.stack_gram
  rw [Matrix.rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det X _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det X).mp h.invertible),
    Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det Xᴴ _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det Xᴴ).mp
      ((Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose X).mpr h.invertible)), Matrix.rank_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.rank_diagonal] at he
  convert he using 1
  apply Fintype.card_congr
  apply Equiv.subtypeEquivRight
  intro i
  rcases h.normalized i with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.common_kernel_iff
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.common_kernel_iff {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜}
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ} (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) (y : n → 𝕜) :
    (A *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0 ∧ L *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0) ↔
      ∀ i, c i ^ 2 + s i ^ 2 = 1 → y i = 0
proof:
:= by
  let C := Matrix.fromRows A L
  have hstack : (A *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0 ∧ L *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0) ↔ C *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0 := by
    change (A *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0 ∧ L *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0) ↔
      Matrix.fromRows A L *ᵥ (X *ᵥ y) = 0
    rw [Matrix.fromRows_mulVec]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hA, hL⟩; ext i; cases i <;> simp [hA, hL]
    · intro hh
      constructor
      · ext i; exact congrFun hh (Sum.inl i)
      · ext i; exact congrFun hh (Sum.inr i)
  rw [hstack, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_mulVec_eq_zero C]
  have hi : Function.Injective Xᴴ.mulVec := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr
    ((Matrix.isUnit_conjTranspose X).mpr h.invertible)
  rw [← hi.eq_iff]
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_zero, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h.stack_gram]
  rw [funext_iff]
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.zero_apply]
  constructor
  · intro hh i hi
    simpa only [hi, RCLike.ofReal_one, one_mul] using hh i
  · intro hh i
    rcases h.normalized i with hi | hi
    · rw [hi, RCLike.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
    · rw [hi, RCLike.ofReal_one, one_mul, hh i hi]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.left_orthonormal
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.left_orthonormal {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜}
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ} (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.of (fun i (j : {j // 0 < c j}) =>
      (A * X) i j / (c j : 𝕜)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hg : (A * X)ᴴ * (A * X) = diagonal (fun i => (c i ^ 2 : 𝕜)) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using h.left_gram
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M i j) hg
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply] at hij
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.of_apply,
    star_div₀, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, div_mul_div_comm,
    ← Finset.sum_div, Matrix.one_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.star_def] at hij
  by_cases he : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [ite_true] at hij ⊢
    rw [hij]
    have hc : (c i : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt i.property
    push_cast
    field_simp
  · have hv : i.val ≠ j.val := fun hh => he (Subtype.ext hh)
    simp only [hv, ite_false] at hij
    rw [hij]
    simp [he]

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.right_orthonormal
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedGSVD.right_orthonormal {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {L : Matrix p n 𝕜}
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c s : n → ℝ} (h : IsNormalizedGSVD A L X c s) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.of (fun i (j : {j // 0 < s j}) =>
      (L * X) i j / (s j : 𝕜)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsNormalizedGSVD L A X s c :=
    ⟨h.invertible, h.right_gram, h.left_gram, h.right_nonneg, h.left_nonneg,
      fun i => by simpa only [add_comm] using h.normalized i⟩
  exact hs.left_orthonormal

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.left_col_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hg : (A * X)ᴴ * (A * X) = diagonal (fun i => (c i ^ 2 : 𝕜)) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using h.left_gram
  have he : ((A * X)ᴴ * (A * X)) *ᵥ Pi.single i 1 = 0 := by
    rw [hg, Matrix.diagonal_mulVec_single]
    simp [hi]
  have hh := (Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_mulVec_eq_zero (A * X) (Pi.single i 1)).mp he
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_single, MulOpposite.op_one, one_smul] using hh

name: NLAlib.IsNormalizedGSVD.right_col_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsNormalizedGSVD L A X s c :=
    ⟨h.invertible, h.right_gram, h.left_gram, h.right_nonneg, h.left_nonneg,
      fun i => by simpa only [add_comm] using h.normalized i⟩
  exact hs.left_col_eq_zero i hi

name: NLAlib.cholesky_first_diag_eq_sqrt
statement:
theorem cholesky_first_diag_eq_sqrt {n : ℕ}
    (A L : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hLower : L.IsLowerTriangular) (hDiag : 0 ≤ L 0 0) (hFactor : L * Lᵀ = A) :
    L 0 0 = Real.sqrt (A 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hZero (i : Fin n) : L 0 i.succ = 0 := by
    have hLt : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) < i.succ := by
      simpa only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ] using Nat.succ_pos i.val
    exact hLower hLt
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hFactor 0) 0
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    hZero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at h
  rw [← h, Real.sqrt_mul_self hDiag]

name: NLAlib.cholesky_first_col_eq_div
statement:
theorem cholesky_first_col_eq_div {n : ℕ}
    (A L : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hLower : L.IsLowerTriangular) (hDiag : 0 < L 0 0) (hFactor : L * Lᵀ = A)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : L i 0 = A i 0 / L 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have hZero (j : Fin n) : L 0 j.succ = 0 := by
    have hLt : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) < j.succ := by
      simpa only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ] using Nat.succ_pos j.val
    exact hLower hLt
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hFactor i) 0
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    hZero, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact (eq_div_iff hDiag.ne').mpr h

name: NLAlib.cholesky_trailing_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem cholesky_trailing_mul_transpose {n : ℕ}
    (A L : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hLower : L.IsLowerTriangular) (hDiag : 0 < L 0 0) (hFactor : L * Lᵀ = A) :
    L.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ * (L.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ)ᵀ =
      pivotSchur A
proof:
:= by
  have hZero (j : Fin n) : L 0 j.succ = 0 := by
    have hLt : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) < j.succ := by
      simpa only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ] using Nat.succ_pos j.val
    exact hLower hLt
  have hPivot := congrFun (congrFun hFactor 0) 0
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    hZero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at hPivot
  have hFirst (i : Fin n) : L i.succ 0 * L 0 0 = A i.succ 0 := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hFactor i.succ) 0
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      hZero, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] using h
  have hRow (j : Fin n) : L 0 0 * L j.succ 0 = A 0 j.succ := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hFactor 0) j.succ
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      hZero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] using h
  have hCorrection (i j : Fin n) : (A 0 0)⁻¹ * (A i.succ 0 * A 0 j.succ) =
      L i.succ 0 * L j.succ 0 := by
    rw [← hPivot, ← hFirst i, ← hRow j]
    field_simp [hDiag.ne']
  ext i j
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hFactor i.succ) j.succ
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.submatrix,
    pivotSchur_apply, hCorrection]
  change (∑ k : Fin n, L i.succ k.succ * L j.succ k.succ) =
    A i.succ j.succ - L i.succ 0 * L j.succ 0
  linarith

name: NLAlib.frobSq_add_trace_inv_gram_mul_frobSq_le_of_maximum_volume
statement:
theorem frobSq_add_trace_inv_gram_mul_frobSq_le_of_maximum_volume
    {m p q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (C : Matrix m p ℝ) (T : Matrix p q ℝ) (D : Matrix m q ℝ)
    (hC : 0 < (Cᵀ * C).det) (hOrth : Cᵀ * D = 0)
    (hMax : ∀ i j, ((C.updateCol i ((C * T + D).col j))ᵀ *
      C.updateCol i ((C * T + D).col j)).det ≤ (Cᵀ * C).det) :
    (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      frobSq T + (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹.trace * frobSq D ≤ (Fintype.card p : ℝ) * Fintype.card q
proof:
:= by
  have hUnit : IsUnit (Cᵀ * C).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hC.ne'
  have hPSD : (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self C).inv
  have hEntry (i : p) (j : q) :
      T i j ^ 2 + (∑ a, D a j ^ 2) * (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ i i ≤ 1 := by
    have hd : Cᵀ *ᵥ D.col j = 0 := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix p q ℝ => M.col j) hOrth
      exact hh
    have hReplace : C *ᵥ T.col j + D.col j = (C * T + D).col j := rfl
    have hx := det_gram_updateCol_eq_det_mul C hUnit i (T.col j) (D.col j) hd
    rw [hReplace, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hx
    have hle := hMax i j
    rw [hx] at hle
    have he := (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hC).mp (show
        (Cᵀ * C).det * (T.col j i ^ 2 + (D.col j ⬝ᵥ D.col j) * (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ i i) ≤
          (Cᵀ * C).det * 1 by simpa only [mul_one] using hle)
    simpa only [Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, dotProduct, pow_two] using he
  constructor
  · intro i j
    have hn : 0 ≤ (∑ a, D a j ^ 2) * (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ i i :=
      mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)) hPSD.diag_nonneg
    have he := hEntry i j
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  · have hsum : (∑ i : p, ∑ j : q,
        (T i j ^ 2 + (∑ a : m, D a j ^ 2) * (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ i i)) ≤
        ∑ _i : p, ∑ _j : q, (1 : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hEntry i j
    have hD : (∑ j : q, ∑ a : m, D a j ^ 2) = frobSq D := by
      rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_comm]
    have hCalc : (∑ i : p, ∑ j : q,
        (T i j ^ 2 + (∑ a : m, D a j ^ 2) * (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ i i)) =
        frobSq T + (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹.trace * frobSq D := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib), Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
      congr 1
      simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hD]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    rw [hCalc] at hsum
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hsum

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_smul_polar_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub, frobInner_smul_right, frobSq_smul,
    frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm_of_polar hU hA, frobSq_frame_eq_card hU]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_nuclearNorm_sq_div_card_le_sub_smul
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_nuclearNorm_sq_div_card_le_sub_smul
    (A U : Matrix n n ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (c : ℝ)
    (hCard : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    frobSq A - nuclearNorm A ^ 2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≤ frobSq (A - c • U)
proof:
:= by
  have hPos := frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one A U
    (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU)
  have hNeg := frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one A (-U)
    (by simpa only [specNorm_neg] using specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU)
  have hAbs : |frobInner A U| ≤ nuclearNorm A := by
    rw [frobInner_neg_right] at hNeg
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hPos⟩
  have hBound : frobInner A U ^ 2 ≤ nuclearNorm A ^ 2 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg (frobInner A U)) hAbs 2
    simpa only [sq_abs] using h
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast hCard
  rw [frobSq_sub, frobInner_smul_right, frobSq_smul, frobSq_frame_eq_card hU]
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hN
  have hDiv : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (nuclearNorm A ^ 2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) =
      nuclearNorm A ^ 2 := by field_simp
  rw [mul_sub, hDiv]
  have hSq := sq_nonneg ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * c - frobInner A U)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_avg_smul_polar_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_avg_smul_polar_eq {A U : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hA : U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A)
    (hCard : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    frobSq (A - (nuclearNorm A / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) • U) =
      frobSq A - nuclearNorm A ^ 2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub_smul_polar_eq hU hA]
  have hN : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hCard
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.isLeast_frobSq_sub_scaled_orthogonal
statement:
theorem isLeast_frobSq_sub_scaled_orthogonal (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hCard : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    IsLeast {z : ℝ | ∃ (c : ℝ) (U : Matrix n n ℝ),
      HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ frobSq (A - c • U) = z}
      (frobSq A - nuclearNorm A ^ 2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hA⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq A le_rfl
  refine ⟨⟨nuclearNorm A / (Fintype.card n : ℝ), U, hU,
    frobSq_sub_avg_smul_polar_eq hU hA hCard⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨c, V, hV, rfl⟩
  exact frobSq_sub_nuclearNorm_sq_div_card_le_sub_smul A V hV c hCard

name: NLAlib.isLeast_frobSq_sub_scaled_orthogonal_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem isLeast_frobSq_sub_scaled_orthogonal_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    IsLeast {z : ℝ | ∃ (c : ℝ) (U : Matrix n n ℝ),
      HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ frobSq (A - c • U) = z} 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0, 1, by simp [HasOrthonormalCols], ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have hA : A = 0 := by ext i; exact isEmptyElim i
    simp [hA, frobSq_zero]
  · rintro z ⟨c, U, _, rfl⟩
    exact frobSq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_trace_rowGram_avg_smul_leftPolar_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_trace_rowGram_avg_smul_leftPolar_eq {A U : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hA : CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ) * U = A)
    (hCard : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    frobSq (A - ((CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ)).trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) • U) =
      frobSq A - nuclearNorm A ^ 2 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hSym (M : Matrix n n ℝ) : (CFC.sqrt M)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt M := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg M).star_eq
  have hAt : Uᵀ * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀᵀ * Aᵀ) = Aᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hSym] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose hA
  have hRight : U * CFC.sqrt (Aᵀ * A) = A := by
    have h := sqrt_rowGram_mul_eq_of_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq hU.conjTranspose hAt
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, hSym] using congrArg Matrix.transpose h
  rw [← nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_rowGram]
  exact frobSq_sub_avg_smul_polar_eq hU hRight hCard

name: NLAlib.one_le_sq_singularValue_mul_frobSq_inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := singularValues_mul_le_specNorm_mul R⁻¹ R i
  rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul R ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR)] at h
  rw [singularValues_eq_one_of_hasOrthonormalCols (by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]) le_rfl hi] at h
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) h 2
  have hf := specNorm_sq_le_frobSq R⁻¹
  have hs := singularValues_nonneg R i
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf (sq_nonneg (singularValues R i))]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_upper_block_le_sqrt_budget_mul
statement:
theorem singularValues_upper_block_le_sqrt_budget_mul {k : ℕ} {r q : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq r] [DecidableEq q]
    (R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin k) q ℝ) (D : Matrix r q ℝ)
    (hR : IsUnit R) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hBudget : frobSq T + frobSq R⁻¹ * frobSq D ≤ b) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < k) :
    singularValues (Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D) i ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 + b) * singularValues R i
proof:
:= by
  let Ri := truncatedSVD R i
  let B := Matrix.fromBlocks Ri (Ri * T) (0 : Matrix r (Fin k) ℝ) (0 : Matrix r q ℝ)
  have hBForm : B = Matrix.fromRows (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (0 : Matrix r (Fin k) ℝ) *
      Ri * Matrix.fromCols (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) T := by
    simp only [B, Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul,
      Matrix.mul_fromCols, Matrix.fromCols_fromRows_eq_fromBlocks, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hB : B.rank ≤ i := by
    rw [hBForm]
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD R i).1)
  have hDiff : Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D - B =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (R - Ri) ((R - Ri) * T) 0 D := by
    ext a c
    cases a <;> cases c <;> simp [B, Matrix.sub_mul]
  have hZ := specNorm_upper_block_sq_le (R - Ri) T D
  have hErr : specNorm (R - Ri) = singularValues R i := specNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq R i
  rw [hErr] at hZ
  have hInv := one_le_sq_singularValue_mul_frobSq_inv R hR hi
  have hDle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hInv (frobSq_nonneg D)
  have hBle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBudget (sq_nonneg (singularValues R i))
  have hSq : specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks (R - Ri) ((R - Ri) * T) 0 D) ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.sqrt (1 + b) * singularValues R i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + b)]
    nlinarith
  have hNorm := (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (singularValues_nonneg R i))).mp hSq
  exact (singularValues_le_specNorm_sub_of_rank_le _ B hB).trans
    (by simpa only [hDiff] using hNorm)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_eq_sum_singularValues_sub_sq_iff
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_eq_sum_singularValues_sub_sq_iff (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobSq (A - B) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      (singularValues A i - singularValues B i) ^ 2 ↔
    frobInner A B = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i * singularValues B i
proof:
:= by
  have hExpand : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      (singularValues A i - singularValues B i) ^ 2) =
      frobSq A - 2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i * singularValues B i) + frobSq B := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues,
      frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues, Finset.mul_sum,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
  rw [frobSq_sub, hExpand]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_mul_transpose_le_sum_singularValues_mul
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_mul_transpose_le_sum_singularValues_mul (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm (A * Bᵀ) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i * singularValues B i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hPolar⟩ := exists_isometry_mul_sqrt_gram_eq (A * Bᵀ) le_rfl
  have hPair : frobInner A (U * B) = nuclearNorm (A * Bᵀ) := by
    rw [frobInner_mul_eq_frobInner_mul_transpose,
      frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm_of_polar hU hPolar]
  have h := (le_abs_self (frobInner A (U * B))).trans
    (abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A (U * B))
  simpa only [hPair, ← singularValues_eq_linearMap, singularValues_isometry_mul hU B] using h

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_mul_transpose_of_frobInner_eq_sum_singularValues_mul
statement:
theorem posSemidef_mul_transpose_of_frobInner_eq_sum_singularValues_mul
    (A B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hEq : frobInner A B = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i * singularValues B i) :
    (A * Bᵀ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply (trace_eq_nuclearNorm_iff_posSemidef _).mp
  have hNuclear := nuclearNorm_mul_transpose_le_sum_singularValues_mul A B
  have hLower := frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one (A * Bᵀ)
    (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) (specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal (by simp))
  have hTrace : frobInner (A * Bᵀ) (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) = (A * Bᵀ).trace := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_transpose]
  rw [hTrace] at hLower
  rw [frobInner_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose, RCLike.re_to_real,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hEq
  linarith

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_cross_products_of_frobSq_sub_eq_sum_singularValues_sub_sq
statement:
theorem posSemidef_cross_products_of_frobSq_sub_eq_sum_singularValues_sub_sq
    (A B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hEq : frobSq (A - B) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      (singularValues A i - singularValues B i) ^ 2) :
    (A * Bᵀ).PosSemidef ∧ (Bᵀ * A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hPair := (frobSq_sub_eq_sum_singularValues_sub_sq_iff A B).mp hEq
  refine ⟨posSemidef_mul_transpose_of_frobInner_eq_sum_singularValues_mul A B hPair, ?_⟩
  have hPairT : frobInner Bᵀ Aᵀ =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card m)),
        singularValues Bᵀ i * singularValues Aᵀ i := by
    simpa only [frobInner_transpose, frobInner_comm B A,
      ← singularValues_eq_linearMap, singularValues_transpose, min_comm, mul_comm] using hPair
  simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
    posSemidef_mul_transpose_of_frobInner_eq_sum_singularValues_mul Bᵀ Aᵀ hPairT

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_pair_attaining_singularValue_pairing
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_pair_attaining_singularValue_pairing (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix m m ℝ) (T : Matrix n n ℝ), HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ HasOrthonormalCols T ∧
      frobInner A (U * B * T) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i * singularValues B i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨LA, RA, hA⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  obtain ⟨LB, RB, hB⟩ := exists_isSVD B
  let U := LA * LBᵀ
  let T := RB * RAᵀ
  have hLA : HasOrthonormalCols LA := hA.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hRA : HasOrthonormalCols RA := hA.conjTranspose_mul_right
  have hLB : HasOrthonormalCols LB := hB.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hRB : HasOrthonormalCols RB := hB.conjTranspose_mul_right
  have hLBt : HasOrthonormalCols LBᵀ := by
    change LBᵀᴴ * LBᵀ = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact hB.mul_conjTranspose_left
  have hRAt : HasOrthonormalCols RAᵀ := by
    change RAᵀᴴ * RAᵀ = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact hA.mul_conjTranspose_right
  refine ⟨U, T, hLA.mul hLBt, hRB.mul hRAt, ?_⟩
  have hAligned : U * B * T = LA *
      (rectDiag (singularValues B) :
        Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ) * RAᵀ := by
    dsimp [U, T]
    nth_rw 1 [hB.eq]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc LBᵀ LB _, show LBᵀ * LB = 1 from hB.conjTranspose_mul_left,
      Matrix.one_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc RBᵀ RB _,
      show RBᵀ * RB = 1 from hB.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [hAligned]
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    hA.frobInner_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose (singularValues B)

name: NLAlib.isLeast_frobSq_sub_orthogonal_mul_mul
statement:
theorem isLeast_frobSq_sub_orthogonal_mul_mul (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    IsLeast {z : ℝ | ∃ (U : Matrix m m ℝ) (T : Matrix n n ℝ),
      HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ HasOrthonormalCols T ∧ frobSq (A - U * B * T) = z}
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        (singularValues A i - singularValues B i) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hσ (U : Matrix m m ℝ) (T : Matrix n n ℝ)
      (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hT : HasOrthonormalCols T) (i : ℕ) :
      singularValues (U * B * T) i = singularValues B i := by
    rw [singularValues_mul_unitary _ hT, singularValues_isometry_mul hU]
  obtain ⟨U, T, hU, hT, hPair⟩ := exists_orthogonal_pair_attaining_singularValue_pairing A B
  refine ⟨⟨U, T, hU, hT, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have h := (frobSq_sub_eq_sum_singularValues_sub_sq_iff A (U * B * T)).mpr
      (by simpa only [hσ U T hU hT] using hPair)
    simpa only [hσ U T hU hT] using h
  · rintro z ⟨V, W, hV, hW, rfl⟩
    have h := sum_sq_singularValues_add_sub_le_frobSq (V * B * W) (A - V * B * W)
    rw [show V * B * W + (A - V * B * W) = A by abel] at h
    simpa only [hσ V W hV hW] using h

name: NLAlib.householder_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem householder_zero : householder (0 : m → ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [householder]

name: NLAlib.householder_mulVec
statement:
theorem householder_mulVec (v x : m → ℝ) :
    householder v *ᵥ x = x - (2 * (v ⬝ᵥ x) / ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ ^ 2) • v
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, householder, sub_mulVec, one_mulVec, smul_mulVec,
    vecMulVec_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, MulOpposite.unop_op,
    smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.householder_transpose
statement: theorem householder_transpose (v : m → ℝ) : (householder v)ᵀ = householder v
proof:
:= by
  rw [householder, transpose_sub, transpose_one, transpose_smul, transpose_vecMulVec]

name: NLAlib.two_div_sq_mul
statement: private lemma two_div_sq_mul (t : ℝ) : (2 / t) * (2 / t) * t = 2 * (2 / t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · simp [ht]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.householder_mul_self
statement: theorem householder_mul_self (v : m → ℝ) : householder v * householder v = 1
proof:
:= by
  set c := 2 / (v ⬝ᵥ v)
  have hP : vecMulVec v v * vecMulVec v v = (v ⬝ᵥ v) • vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_smul]
  have hc : c * c * (v ⬝ᵥ v) = 2 * c := two_div_sq_mul _
  rw [householder, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, hP, smul_smul, smul_smul, hc]
  module

name: NLAlib.householder_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem householder_transpose_mul_self (v : m → ℝ) :
    (householder v)ᵀ * householder v = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [householder_transpose, householder_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_householder
statement: theorem hasOrthonormalCols_householder (v : m → ℝ) : HasOrthonormalCols (householder v)
proof:
:=
  householder_transpose_mul_self v

name: NLAlib.householder_mulVec_self
statement: theorem householder_mulVec_self (v : m → ℝ) : householder v *ᵥ v = -v
proof:
:= by
  rw [householder_mulVec, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  by_cases hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 0
  · rw [dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 hv]; simp
  · rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self hv, mul_one, two_smul]; abel

name: NLAlib.householder_mulVec_of_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem householder_mulVec_of_dotProduct_eq_zero {v w : m → ℝ} (h : v ⬝ᵥ w = 0) :
    householder v *ᵥ w = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [householder_mulVec, h]; simp

name: NLAlib.householderSign_sq
statement: theorem householderSign_sq (t : ℝ) : householderSign t ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold householderSign; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.householderSign_mul_self
statement: theorem householderSign_mul_self (t : ℝ) : householderSign t * t = |t|
proof:
:= by
  unfold householderSign; split_ifs with h
  · rw [one_mul, abs_of_nonneg h]
  · rw [abs_of_neg (not_le.1 h)]; ring

name: NLAlib.householder_mulVec_householderVector
statement:
theorem householder_mulVec_householderVector (x : m → ℝ) (i₀ : m) :
    householder (householderVector x i₀) *ᵥ x =
      (-(householderSign (x i₀) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖)) • Pi.single i₀ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  set σ := householderSign (x i₀)
  set ν := √(x ⬝ᵥ x)
  set v := householderVector x i₀
  have hν : ν ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x := Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg x)
  have hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1 := householderSign_sq _
  have hvx : v ⬝ᵥ x = x ⬝ᵥ x + σ * ν * x i₀ := by
    simp only [v, householderVector, add_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct, single_dotProduct,
      smul_eq_mul, one_mul, σ, ν]
  have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    have e : v = x + (σ * ν) • Pi.single i₀ 1 := rfl
    have ha : (σ * ν) * (σ * ν) = x ⬝ᵥ x := by rw [← hν, ← mul_one (ν ^ 2), ← hσ]; ring
    rw [hvx, e]
    simp only [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      single_dotProduct, dotProduct_single, smul_eq_mul, one_mul, mul_one, Pi.add_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same]
    linear_combination ha
  rw [householder_mulVec, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  by_cases h0 : v ⬝ᵥ x = 0
  · have hv0 : v = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 (by rw [hvv, h0, mul_zero])
    have hx : x = (-(σ * ν)) • Pi.single i₀ 1 := by
      have : x + (σ * ν) • Pi.single i₀ (1 : ℝ) = 0 := hv0
      rw [neg_smul, ← sub_eq_zero, sub_neg_eq_add, this]
    rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_div, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    exact hx
  · rw [hvv, div_self (by simpa using h0), one_smul]
    simp only [v, householderVector, neg_smul]
    abel

name: NLAlib.householder_vecCons_zero
statement:
theorem householder_vecCons_zero (w : Fin m → ℝ) :
    householder (vecCons 0 w) = borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) (householder w)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp [householder]
    | succ j => simp [householder, (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm]
  | succ i =>
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp [householder]
    | succ j => simp [householder, vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.length_householderQR_fst
statement:
theorem length_householderQR_fst (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (householderQR A).1.length = min m n
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing n with
  | zero => simp [householderQR]
  | succ m ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [householderQR]
    | succ n => simp [householderQR, ih, Nat.succ_min_succ]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_list_prod
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_list_prod {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    (l : List (Matrix k k ℝ)) (hl : ∀ M ∈ l, HasOrthonormalCols M) :
    HasOrthonormalCols l.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
  | cons M l ih =>
    have hM : Mᵀ * M = 1 := by
      have h := (hl M List.mem_cons_self).conjTranspose_mul_self
      rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
    have hl' : l.prodᵀ * l.prod = 1 := by
      have h := (ih fun N hN => hl N (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hN)).conjTranspose_mul_self
      rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
    rw [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, List.prod_cons,
      Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Mᵀ, hM, Matrix.one_mul, hl']

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_householderQ
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_householderQ (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (householderQ A)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_list_prod _ fun M hM => by
    obtain ⟨v, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hM
    exact hasOrthonormalCols_householder v

name: NLAlib.householderQ_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem householderQ_transpose_mul_self (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (householderQ A)ᵀ * householderQ A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasOrthonormalCols_householderQ A).conjTranspose_mul_self
  rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h

name: NLAlib.isUpperTrapezoidal_householderR
statement:
theorem isUpperTrapezoidal_householderR (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    IsUpperTrapezoidal (householderR A)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing n with
  | zero => exact fun i => i.elim0
  | succ m ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact fun _ j => j.elim0
    | succ n => exact isUpperTrapezoidal_borderedUpper _ (ih _)

name: NLAlib.prod_map_householder_map_vecCons_zero
statement:
theorem prod_map_householder_map_vecCons_zero (l : List (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    ((l.map (vecCons 0)).map householder).prod =
      borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) ((l.map householder).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [borderedUpper_one_one]
  | cons w l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ih, householder_vecCons_zero,
      borderedUpper_one_mul_borderedUpper, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]

name: NLAlib.householderQ_succ_succ
statement:
theorem householderQ_succ_succ (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    householderQ A = householder (householderVector (A.col 0) 0) *
      borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) (householderQ
        ((householder (householderVector (A.col 0) 0) * A).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [householderQ, householderQR, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
    prod_map_householder_map_vecCons_zero]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.isFullQR_householderQR
statement:
theorem isFullQR_householderQR : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ),
    IsFullQR A (householderQ A) (householderR A)
  | 0, _, A => ⟨by simp [householderQ, householderR, householderQR],
      householderQ_transpose_mul_self A, isUpperTrapezoidal_householderR A⟩
  | _ + 1, 0, A => ⟨by simp [householderQ, householderR, householderQR],
      householderQ_transpose_mul_self A, isUpperTrapezoidal_householderR A⟩
  | m + 1, n + 1, A => by
    set H
proof:
:= householder (householderVector (A.col 0) 0) with hHdef
    have hW : HasOrthonormalCols H := hasOrthonormalCols_householder _
    have hB : ∀ i : Fin m, (Hᵀ * A) i.succ 0 = 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [hHdef, householder_transpose]
      have := congrFun (householder_mulVec_householderVector (A.col 0) 0) i.succ
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i), smul_zero] at this
      exact this
    have key := isFullQR_mul_borderedUpper hW hB
      (isFullQR_householderQR ((Hᵀ * A).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ))
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at key
    rw [hHdef, householder_transpose] at key
    rw [householderQ_succ_succ]
    exact key

name: NLAlib.householderQ_mul_householderR
statement:
theorem householderQ_mul_householderR (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    householderQ A * householderR A = A
proof:
:=
  (isFullQR_householderQR A).eq.symm

name: NLAlib.isQR_householderQR
statement:
theorem isQR_householderQR (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    IsQR A ((householderQ A).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hnm))
      ((householderR A).submatrix (Fin.castLE hnm) id)
proof:
:=
  (isFullQR_householderQR A).isQR_castLE hnm

name: NLAlib.exists_column_embedding_gram_det_pos
statement:
theorem exists_column_embedding_gram_det_pos {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ n, 0 < ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hEx : ∃ f : Fin A.rank → (m → ℝ), (∀ i, f i ∈ Set.range A.col) ∧
      LinearIndependent ℝ f := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, _, hli⟩ := Submodule.exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq ℝ (Set.range A.col)
    have hdim := Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols A
    exact hdim.symm ▸ ⟨f, hf, hli⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hli⟩ := hEx
  choose a ha using hf
  have hai : Function.Injective a := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hli.injective
    rw [← ha i, ← ha j, hij]
  let e : Fin k ↪ n := ⟨fun i => a (Fin.castLE hk i), hai.comp (Fin.castLE_injective hk)⟩
  have hCols : LinearIndependent ℝ (A.submatrix id e).col := by
    have heq : (A.submatrix id e).col = f ∘ Fin.castLE hk := by
      funext i
      exact ha (Fin.castLE hk i)
    rw [heq]
    exact hli.comp _ (Fin.castLE_injective hk)
  have hRank : (A.submatrix id e).rank = Fintype.card (Fin k) := by
    rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols]
    exact finrank_span_eq_card hCols
  have hUnit := isUnit_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq hRank
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (A.submatrix id e)).det_nonneg
  exact ⟨e, lt_of_le_of_ne hNonneg
    (Ne.symm ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hUnit).ne_zero)⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_maximum_volume_column_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_maximum_volume_column_embedding {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ n,
      0 < ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det ∧
      ∀ f : Fin k → n,
        ((A.submatrix id f)ᵀ * A.submatrix id f).det ≤
          ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_column_embedding_gram_det_pos A k hk
  let volume := fun f : Fin k → n => ((A.submatrix id f)ᵀ * A.submatrix id f).det
  obtain ⟨f, _, hf⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ volume
    ⟨(e₀ : Fin k → n), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hpos : 0 < volume f := he₀.trans_le (hf e₀ (Finset.mem_univ _))
  have hfi : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    apply hpos.ne'
    apply Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq hne
    intro a
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
    rw [hij]
  exact ⟨⟨f, hfi⟩, hpos, fun g => hf g (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

name: NLAlib.posDef_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem posDef_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq_card {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : (Aᵀ * A).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hPSD : (Aᵀ * A).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  apply hPSD.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  apply det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq
  rwa [Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  apply det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq
  have hGram : Rᵀ * R = Aᵀ * A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial R,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A] using
      conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr hQ hFactor
  rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self R, hGram,
    Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self A, hRank]

name: NLAlib.diag_pos_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem diag_pos_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card {A Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hUpper : R.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, 0 ≤ R i i) (hFactor : Q * R = A)
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : ∀ i, 0 < R i i
proof:
:= by
  have hGram : (Aᵀ * A).PosDef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A] using
      posDef_transpose_mul_self_of_rank_eq_card hRank
  have hFactorT : Rᵀ * (Rᵀ)ᵀ = Aᵀ * A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial R,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A] using
      conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr hQ hFactor
  exact diag_pos_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUnit (L := Rᵀ) hUpper.transpose
    (isUnit_of_mul_transpose_eq_posDef hGram hFactorT) hDiag

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_qr_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem existsUnique_qr_of_rank_eq_card (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) :
    ∃! qr : Matrix m n ℝ × Matrix n n ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols qr.1 ∧ qr.2.IsUpperTriangular ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < qr.2 i i) ∧ qr.1 * qr.2 = A
proof:
:= by
  have hCard : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m := by
    rw [← hRank]
    exact Matrix.rank_le_card_height A
  obtain ⟨Q, R, ⟨hFactor, hQ, hUpper⟩, hDiag⟩ := exists_isQR A hCard
  replace hFactor := hFactor.symm
  have hPositive := diag_pos_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card hQ hUpper hDiag hFactor hRank
  refine ⟨(Q, R), ⟨hQ, hUpper, hPositive, hFactor⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨Q', R'⟩ ⟨hQ', hUpper', hDiag', hFactor'⟩
  obtain ⟨hQEq, hREq⟩ :=
    IsQR.eq_of_diag_pos ⟨hFactor'.symm, hQ', hUpper'⟩ ⟨hFactor.symm, hQ, hUpper⟩ hDiag' hPositive
  exact Prod.ext hQEq hREq

name: NLAlib.mul_transpose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem mul_transpose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card
    {A Q : Matrix m n ℝ} {R : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hFactor : Q * R = A)
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : Q * Qᵀ = A * moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hUnit := isUnit_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card hQ hFactor hRank
  have hDet := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hUnit
  rw [← hFactor, moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols Q R hQ,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit R hUnit]
  calc
    Q * Qᵀ = Q * (R * R⁻¹) * Qᵀ := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hDet, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = Q * R * (R⁻¹ * Qᵀ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.IsLU.det_eq_prod
statement: theorem IsLU.det_eq_prod {A L U : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsLU A L U) : A.det = ∏ i, U i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.eq_mul, det_mul, h.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one, one_mul,
    det_of_isUpperTriangular h.isUpperTriangular]

name: NLAlib.IsLU.unique
statement:
theorem IsLU.unique {A L U L' U' : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A.det) (h₁ : IsLU A L U)
    (h₂ : IsLU A L' U') : L = L' ∧ U = U'
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsUnit U.det := by
    rwa [h₁.eq_mul, det_mul, h₁.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one, one_mul] at hA
  have hL : IsUnit L.det := by rw [h₁.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one]; exact isUnit_one
  have hL' : IsUnit L'.det := by rw [h₂.isUnitLowerTriangular.det_eq_one]; exact isUnit_one
  have hLU : L * U = L' * U' := h₁.eq_mul.symm.trans h₂.eq_mul
  have key : L'⁻¹ * L = U' * U⁻¹ := by
    calc L'⁻¹ * L = L'⁻¹ * L * (U * U⁻¹) := by rw [mul_nonsing_inv U hU, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = L'⁻¹ * (L * U) * U⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = L'⁻¹ * (L' * U') * U⁻¹ := by rw [hLU]
      _ = U' * U⁻¹ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul L' hL', Matrix.one_mul]
  have hup : (L'⁻¹ * L).IsUpperTriangular := by
    rw [key]; exact BlockTriangular.mul h₂.isUpperTriangular
      (isUpperTriangular_inv h₁.isUpperTriangular)
  have h1 : L'⁻¹ * L = 1 := eq_one_of_isUnitLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular
    (h₂.isUnitLowerTriangular.inv.mul h₁.isUnitLowerTriangular) hup
  have hLL : L = L' := by
    calc L = L' * (L'⁻¹ * L) := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_nonsing_inv L' hL', Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = L' := by rw [h1, Matrix.mul_one]
  refine ⟨hLL, ?_⟩
  have hLU' : L * U = L * U' := by rw [hLU, hLL]
  calc U = L⁻¹ * (L * U) := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul L hL, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = L⁻¹ * (L * U') := by rw [hLU']
    _ = U' := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul L hL, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsLU.leadingSubmatrix
statement:
theorem IsLU.leadingSubmatrix {A L U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (h : IsLU A L U) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ n) :
    IsLU (leadingSubmatrix A k) (leadingSubmatrix L k) (leadingSubmatrix U k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingSubmatrix_fin A hk, leadingSubmatrix_fin L hk, leadingSubmatrix_fin U hk]
  have hL := isLowerTriangular_iff.1 h.isUnitLowerTriangular.isLowerTriangular
  have hU := isUpperTriangular_iff.1 h.isUpperTriangular
  refine ⟨⟨isLowerTriangular_iff.2 fun i j hij => hL _ _ ((Fin.castLE_lt_castLE_iff hk).2 hij),
    fun i => h.isUnitLowerTriangular.apply_self _⟩,
    isUpperTriangular_iff.2 fun i j hij => hU _ _ ((Fin.castLE_lt_castLE_iff hk).2 hij), ?_⟩
  ext i j
  simp only [submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, h.eq_mul]
  symm
  have hmap : (∑ l : Fin k, L (Fin.castLE hk i) (Fin.castLE hk l) * U (Fin.castLE hk l)
      (Fin.castLE hk j)) = ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.map (Fin.castLEEmb hk),
        L (Fin.castLE hk i) l * U l (Fin.castLE hk j) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_map]; rfl
  rw [hmap]
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) fun l _ hl => ?_
  have hkl : k ≤ (l : ℕ) := by
    by_contra hlt
    exact hl (Finset.mem_map.2 ⟨⟨l, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩)
  rw [hL _ _ (by simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castLE]; omega), zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsLU.leadingMinor_eq_prod
statement:
theorem IsLU.leadingMinor_eq_prod {A L U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (h : IsLU A L U) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ n) :
    leadingMinor A k = ∏ i : Fin k, U (Fin.castLE hk i) (Fin.castLE hk i)
proof:
:= by
  have := (h.leadingSubmatrix k hk).det_eq_prod
  rwa [leadingSubmatrix_fin U hk] at this

name: NLAlib.pivotSchur_leadingSubmatrix
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingSubmatrix_fin A hk, leadingSubmatrix_fin (pivotSchur A) (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk)]
  have h0 : Fin.castLE hk 0 = 0 := rfl
  have hs : ∀ i : Fin k, Fin.castLE hk i.succ = (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk) i).succ :=
    fun i => rfl
  ext i j
  simp [h0, hs]

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_one
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_one (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    leadingMinor A 1 = A 0 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor_fin A (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)), det_fin_one]; rfl

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_succ_eq_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_succ_eq_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0) {k : ℕ} (hk : k + 1 ≤ n + 1) :
    leadingMinor A (k + 1) = A 0 0 * leadingMinor (pivotSchur A) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingMinor, leadingMinor, ← pivotSchur_leadingSubmatrix A hk, leadingSubmatrix_fin A hk]
  exact det_eq_mul_det_pivotSchur _ ha

name: NLAlib.isUnitLowerTriangular_lu_fst
statement:
theorem isUnitLowerTriangular_lu_fst {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    IsUnitLowerTriangular (lu A).1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact isUnitLowerTriangular_one
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := ih (pivotSchur A)
    refine ⟨isLowerTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff.2 ⟨rfl, h.isLowerTriangular⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · simp [lu]
    · simpa [lu] using h.apply_self i

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_lu_snd
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_lu_snd {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (lu A).2.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun i => i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    exact isUpperTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff.2 ⟨rfl, ih (pivotSchur A)⟩

name: NLAlib.luSucceeds_iff_forall_lu_snd_apply_self_ne_zero
statement:
theorem luSucceeds_iff_forall_lu_snd_apply_self_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : LUSucceeds A ↔ ∀ i, (lu A).2 i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [LUSucceeds]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [LUSucceeds, ih, Fin.forall_fin_succ]
    simp [lu]

name: NLAlib.isLU_lu
statement:
theorem isLU_lu {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (h : LUSucceeds A) :
    IsLU A (lu A).1 (lu A).2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨isUnitLowerTriangular_lu_fst A, isUpperTriangular_lu_snd A, by ext i; exact i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hS⟩ := h
    have hLU := (ih hS).eq_mul
    refine ⟨isUnitLowerTriangular_lu_fst A, isUpperTriangular_lu_snd A, ?_⟩
    simp only [lu]
    rw [borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix, ← hLU]
    conv_lhs => rw [← borderedMatrix_eta A]
    congr 1
    · simp
    · ext j; simp
    · ext i; simp [ha]
    · ext i j; simp [pivotSchur, vecMulVec_apply]

name: NLAlib.luSucceeds_iff_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem luSucceeds_iff_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    LUSucceeds A ↔ ∀ k ≤ n, leadingMinor A k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [LUSucceeds, true_iff]
    intro k hk
    obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [LUSucceeds, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, hS⟩ k hk
      rcases k with _ | k
      · simp
      · rw [leadingMinor_succ_eq_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur A ha hk]
        exact mul_ne_zero ha (hS k (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk))
    · intro h
      have ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0 := by
        have := h 1 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n))
        rwa [leadingMinor_one] at this
      refine ⟨ha, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      have := h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)
      rw [leadingMinor_succ_eq_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur A ha (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)] at this
      exact right_ne_zero_of_mul this

name: NLAlib.isLU_lu_of_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨isUnitLowerTriangular_lu_fst A, isUpperTriangular_lu_snd A, by ext i; exact i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ⟨isUnitLowerTriangular_lu_fst A, isUpperTriangular_lu_snd A, ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · ext i j
      obtain rfl : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega)
      obtain rfl : j = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega)
      simp [lu, Matrix.mul_apply]
    · have ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0 := by
        have := h 1 (by omega)
        rwa [leadingMinor_one] at this
      have hS : ∀ k < n, leadingMinor (pivotSchur A) k ≠ 0 := by
        intro k hk
        have := h (k + 1) (by omega)
        rw [leadingMinor_succ_eq_mul_leadingMinor_pivotSchur A ha (by omega)] at this
        exact right_ne_zero_of_mul this
      have hLU := (ih hS).eq_mul
      simp only [lu]
      rw [borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix, ← hLU]
      conv_lhs => rw [← borderedMatrix_eta A]
      congr 1
      · simp
      · ext j; simp
      · ext i; simp [ha]
      · ext i j; simp [pivotSchur, vecMulVec_apply]

name: NLAlib.IsLU.submatrix
statement:
theorem IsLU.submatrix {A L U : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsLU A L U) (e : m ≃o n) :
    IsLU (A.submatrix e e) (L.submatrix e e) (U.submatrix e e) where
  isUnitLowerTriangular
proof:
:=
    ⟨isLowerTriangular_iff.2 fun _ _ hij =>
        isLowerTriangular_iff.1 h.isUnitLowerTriangular.isLowerTriangular _ _ (e.strictMono hij),
      fun i => h.isUnitLowerTriangular.apply_self (e i)⟩
  isUpperTriangular := isUpperTriangular_iff.2 fun _ _ hij =>
    isUpperTriangular_iff.1 h.isUpperTriangular _ _ (e.strictMono hij)
  eq_mul := by rw [h.eq_mul]; exact (Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv L U e e.toEquiv e).symm

name: NLAlib.leadingMinor_submatrix_monoEquivOfFin
statement:
theorem leadingMinor_submatrix_monoEquivOfFin (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    leadingMinor (A.submatrix (monoEquivOfFin n rfl) (monoEquivOfFin n rfl)) k =
      leadingMinor A k
proof:
:= by
  unfold leadingMinor
  congr 1
  ext i j
  by_cases h : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card n ∧ (j : ℕ) < Fintype.card n
  · have hi' : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card n)) := by simpa using h.1
    have hj' : (j : ℕ) < Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card n)) := by simpa using h.2
    rw [leadingSubmatrix_apply _ i j hi' hj', leadingSubmatrix_apply A i j h.1 h.2]
    have e : monoEquivOfFin (Fin (Fintype.card n)) rfl =
        Fin.castOrderIso (Fintype.card_fin _) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [e]
    rfl
  · have h' : Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ≤ i ∨ Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ≤ j := by
      rw [not_and_or, not_lt, not_lt] at h; simpa using h
    rw [not_and_or, not_lt, not_lt] at h
    rw [leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le _ _ _ h', leadingSubmatrix_apply_of_card_le _ _ _ h]

name: NLAlib.exists_isLU_of_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_isLU_of_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (h : ∀ k < Fintype.card n, leadingMinor A k ≠ 0) : ∃ L U, IsLU A L U
proof:
:= by
  let e := monoEquivOfFin n rfl
  have h' : ∀ k < Fintype.card n, leadingMinor (A.submatrix e e) k ≠ 0 := fun k hk => by
    rw [leadingMinor_submatrix_monoEquivOfFin]; exact h k hk
  have hLU := (isLU_lu_of_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero h').submatrix e.symm
  have hA : (A.submatrix e e).submatrix e.symm e.symm = A := by ext i j; simp
  rw [hA] at hLU
  exact ⟨_, _, hLU⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_isLU_iff_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_isLU_iff_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A.det) :
    (∃ L U, IsLU A L U) ↔ ∀ k ≤ Fintype.card n, leadingMinor A k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, U, h⟩ k hk
    have hd : ∀ i, U i i ≠ 0 := by
      intro i hi
      rw [h.det_eq_prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero (f := fun j => U j j) (Finset.mem_univ i) hi] at hA
      exact not_isUnit_zero hA
    rw [← leadingMinor_submatrix_monoEquivOfFin,
      (h.submatrix (monoEquivOfFin n rfl)).leadingMinor_eq_prod k hk]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun i _ => hd _
  · intro h
    exact exists_isLU_of_forall_leadingMinor_ne_zero A fun k hk => h k hk.le

name: NLAlib.IsPLU.permMatrix_mul_eq
statement:
theorem IsPLU.permMatrix_mul_eq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [LinearOrder n] {A L U : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {σ : Equiv.Perm n} (h : IsPLU A σ L U) : Equiv.Perm.permMatrix ℝ σ * A = L * U
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_mul]; exact h.eq_mul

name: NLAlib.abs_le_abs_absArgmax
statement:
theorem abs_le_abs_absArgmax {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    |v i| ≤ |v (absArgmax v)|
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [show i = absArgmax v from Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; have := (absArgmax v).isLt; omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := ih (fun i => v i.succ)
    simp only [absArgmax]
    split_ifs with hk
    · exact Fin.cases le_rfl (fun i => (h i).trans hk) i
    · exact Fin.cases (not_le.1 hk).le (fun i => h i) i

name: NLAlib.abs_partialPivotSwap_le
statement:
theorem abs_partialPivotSwap_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : |partialPivotSwap A i 0| ≤ |partialPivotSwap A 0 0|
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialPivotSwap, submatrix_apply, id, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  exact abs_le_abs_absArgmax (fun i => A i 0) _

name: NLAlib.submatrix_decomposeFin_symm
statement:
theorem submatrix_decomposeFin_symm {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (p : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    A.submatrix (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, τ)) id =
      borderedMatrix (A p 0) (fun j => A p j.succ) (fun i => A (Equiv.swap 0 p (τ i).succ) 0)
        (fun i j => A (Equiv.swap 0 p (τ i).succ) j.succ)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← borderedMatrix_eta (A.submatrix _ id)]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · ext j; simp
  · ext i; simp
  · ext i j; simp

name: NLAlib.isPLU_luPartialPivot
statement:
theorem isPLU_luPartialPivot {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    IsPLU A (luPartialPivot A).1 (luPartialPivot A).2.1 (luPartialPivot A).2.2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨isUnitLowerTriangular_one, fun i => i.elim0, by ext i; exact i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨hL1, hL2⟩, hU, hLU⟩ := ih (pivotSchur (partialPivotSwap A))
    have hcol : partialPivotSwap A 0 0 = 0 → ∀ i, partialPivotSwap A i 0 = 0 := fun h0 i =>
      abs_nonpos_iff.1 ((abs_partialPivotSwap_le A i).trans (by rw [h0, abs_zero]))
    refine ⟨⟨isLowerTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff.2 ⟨rfl, hL1⟩, fun i => ?_⟩,
      isUpperTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff.2 ⟨rfl, hU⟩, ?_⟩
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · simp [luPartialPivot]
      · simpa [luPartialPivot] using hL2 i
    · simp only [luPartialPivot]
      rw [submatrix_decomposeFin_symm, borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix, ← hLU]
      congr 1
      · simp [partialPivotSwap]
      · ext j; simp [partialPivotSwap]
      · ext i
        have hc := hcol
        simp only [partialPivotSwap, submatrix_apply, id, Equiv.swap_apply_left] at hc ⊢
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mulVec_zero, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero]
        by_cases h0 : A (absArgmax fun i => A i 0) 0 = 0
        · rw [h0, hc h0]; simp
        · field_simp
      · ext i j
        simp [partialPivotSwap, pivotSchur, vecMulVec_apply]
        ring

name: NLAlib.abs_luPartialPivot_lower_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_luPartialPivot_lower_le_one {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    |(luPartialPivot A).2.1 i j| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · simp [luPartialPivot]
    · simp [luPartialPivot]
    · simp only [luPartialPivot, borderedMatrix_succ_zero, abs_mul, abs_inv]
      by_cases h0 : partialPivotSwap A 0 0 = 0
      · simp [h0]
      · rw [inv_mul_le_one₀ (abs_pos.2 h0)]
        exact abs_partialPivotSwap_le A _
    · simpa [luPartialPivot] using ih (pivotSchur (partialPivotSwap A)) i j

name: NLAlib.luPartialPivotSucceeds_iff_isUnit_det
statement:
theorem luPartialPivotSucceeds_iff_isUnit_det {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    LUPartialPivotSucceeds A ↔ IsUnit A.det
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag : ∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ),
      LUPartialPivotSucceeds A ↔ ∀ i, (luPartialPivot A).2.2 i i ≠ 0 := by
    intro m A
    induction m with
    | zero => simp [LUPartialPivotSucceeds]
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [LUPartialPivotSucceeds, ih, Fin.forall_fin_succ]
      simp [luPartialPivot]
  have hdet := (isPLU_luPartialPivot A).det_eq_prod
  rw [det_permute] at hdet
  rw [hdiag, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h hA
    rw [hA, mul_zero, eq_comm] at hdet
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 (fun i _ => h i) hdet
  · intro hA i hi
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (f := fun j => (luPartialPivot A).2.2 j j) (Finset.mem_univ i) hi]
      at hdet
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign (luPartialPivot A).1) with hs | hs <;>
      simp [hs, hA] at hdet

name: NLAlib.exists_isPLU_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_isPLU_abs_le_one {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∃ σ L U, IsPLU A σ L U ∧ ∀ i j, |L i j| ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, _, _, isPLU_luPartialPivot A, abs_luPartialPivot_lower_le_one A⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_luPartialPivot_upper_le
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM 0 0)
    have hB : ∀ i j, |partialPivotSwap A i j| ≤ M := fun i j => hM _ _
    have hS : ∀ i j, |pivotSchur (partialPivotSwap A) i j| ≤ 2 * M := by
      intro i j
      rw [pivotSchur_apply, two_mul]
      refine (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add (hB _ _) ?_)
      rw [← mul_assoc, abs_mul]
      by_cases h0 : partialPivotSwap A 0 0 = 0
      · simp [h0, hM0]
      · have hl : |(partialPivotSwap A 0 0)⁻¹ * partialPivotSwap A i.succ 0| ≤ 1 := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_inv, inv_mul_le_one₀ (abs_pos.2 h0)]
          exact abs_partialPivotSwap_le A _
        calc _ ≤ 1 * M := mul_le_mul hl (hB _ _) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = M := one_mul M
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
