    · simpa [luPartialPivot] using hB 0 0
    · simpa [luPartialPivot] using hB 0 j.succ
    · simp only [luPartialPivot, borderedMatrix_succ_zero, Pi.zero_apply, abs_zero]
      positivity
    · have := ih hS i j
      simp only [luPartialPivot, borderedMatrix_succ_succ, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ]
      linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_luPartialPivot_upper_le_two_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM i i)
  refine (abs_luPartialPivot_upper_le hM i j).trans ?_
  gcongr
  · norm_num
  · omega

name: NLAlib.exists_rank_adapted_maximum_volume_qr
statement:
theorem exists_rank_adapted_maximum_volume_qr {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∃ π : (Fin A.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - A.rank)) ≃ n,
    ∃ Q : Matrix m (Fin A.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - A.rank)) ℝ,
    ∃ R : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin A.rank) ℝ,
    ∃ T : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin (Fintype.card n - A.rank)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ Q * Qᵀ = 1 ∧ IsUnit R ∧ R.IsUpperTriangular ∧
      A.submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 0 ∧
      (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      frobSq T ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n - A.rank)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, hQ, hQt, hR, hUpper, _, hFact, hEntry, hBudget⟩ :=
    exists_maximum_volume_triangular_qr_blocks A A.rank le_rfl
  have hRankA : (A.submatrix id π).rank = A.rank := by
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl] using Matrix.rank_submatrix A (Equiv.refl m) π
  have hRankBlock : A.rank = (Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D).rank := by
    exact hRankA.symm.trans ((congrArg Matrix.rank hFact).trans (rank_isometry_mul_eq hQ _))
  have hRankD : D.rank = 0 := by
    have hAdd := rank_fromBlocks_eq_rank_add_rank_schur R (R * T)
      (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - A.rank)) (Fin A.rank) ℝ) D
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR)
    simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, sub_zero, Matrix.rank_of_isUnit R hR, Fintype.card_fin] at hAdd
    omega
  have hD : D = 0 := by
    apply (frobSq_eq_zero_iff D).mp
    apply le_antisymm _ (frobSq_nonneg D)
    have hh := frobSq_le_rank_mul_specNorm_sq D
    simpa only [hRankD, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] using hh
  refine ⟨π, Q, R, T, hQ, hQt, hR, hUpper, ?_, hEntry, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hD] using hFact
  · simpa only [hD, frobSq_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] using hBudget

name: NLAlib.deimProjector_properties
statement:
theorem deimProjector_properties (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (indices : r → n)
    (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id)) :
    deimProjector U indices * U = U ∧
      (coordinateFrame indices)ᴴ * deimProjector U indices = (coordinateFrame indices)ᴴ ∧
      IsIdempotentElem (deimProjector U indices)
proof:
:= by
  have hPU : IsUnit ((coordinateFrame indices)ᴴ * U) :=
    (coordinateFrame_conjTranspose_mul indices U).symm ▸ hM
  have hl := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hPU)
  have hr := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hPU)
  have hfix : deimProjector U indices * U = U := by
    rw [deimProjector, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hl, Matrix.mul_one]
  refine ⟨hfix, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [deimProjector, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hr, Matrix.one_mul]
  · change deimProjector U indices * deimProjector U indices = deimProjector U indices
    conv_lhs => arg 2; rw [deimProjector]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hfix]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.specNorm_deimProjector
statement:
theorem specNorm_deimProjector (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (indices : r → n) (hi : Function.Injective indices) :
    specNorm (deimProjector U indices) = specNorm ((U.submatrix indices id)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deimProjector,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols
      (hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame hi),
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU, coordinateFrame_conjTranspose_mul]

name: NLAlib.rank_deimProjector
statement:
theorem rank_deimProjector (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (indices : r → n) (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id)) :
    (deimProjector U indices).rank = Fintype.card r
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : U.rank = Fintype.card r := by
    have he := rank_isometry_mul_eq hU (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜)
    simpa using he
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [deimProjector]
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans
      ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans U.rank_le_card_width)
  · calc
      _ = U.rank := hrank.symm
      _ = (deimProjector U indices * U).rank :=
        congrArg Matrix.rank (deimProjector_properties U indices hM).1.symm
      _ ≤ _ := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _

name: NLAlib.deimProjector_eq_one_of_card_eq
statement:
theorem deimProjector_eq_one_of_card_eq (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (indices : r → n) (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id))
    (hr : Fintype.card r = Fintype.card n) : deimProjector U indices = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (deimProjector_properties U indices hM).2.2
  have hrank := rank_deimProjector U hU indices hM
  have htop : LinearMap.range (deimProjector U indices).mulVecLin = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    simpa [Matrix.rank, hr] using hrank
  have hunit : IsUnit (deimProjector U indices) :=
    Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.mp (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp htop)
  have hi := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hunit)
  have he := congrArg (fun M => (deimProjector U indices)⁻¹ * M) hP.eq
  simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hi, Matrix.one_mul] using he

name: NLAlib.one_sub_deimProjector_mul_one_sub_projector
statement:
theorem one_sub_deimProjector_mul_one_sub_projector (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (indices : r → n)
    (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id)) :
    (1 - deimProjector U indices) * (1 - U * Uᴴ) = 1 - deimProjector U indices
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, (deimProjector_properties U indices hM).1]
  abel

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_deimProjector_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_deimProjector_mulVec_le (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (indices : r → n)
    (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id)) (f : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (f - deimProjector U indices *ᵥ f)‖ ≤
      specNorm (1 - deimProjector U indices) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - U * Uᴴ) *ᵥ f)‖
proof:
:= by
  have he : f - deimProjector U indices *ᵥ f =
      (1 - deimProjector U indices) *ᵥ ((1 - U * Uᴴ) *ᵥ f) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, one_sub_deimProjector_mul_one_sub_projector U indices hM,
      Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [he]
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    exact (1 - deimProjector U indices).l2_opNorm_mulVec
      (WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - U * Uᴴ) *ᵥ f))

name: NLAlib.real_deimProjector_norm_and_error
statement:
theorem real_deimProjector_norm_and_error (U : Matrix n r ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (indices : r → n) (hi : Function.Injective indices) (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id))
    (hr : 0 < Fintype.card r) (hn : Fintype.card r < Fintype.card n) :
    specNorm (1 - deimProjector U indices) = specNorm ((U.submatrix indices id)⁻¹) ∧
      ∀ f : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (f - deimProjector U indices *ᵥ f)‖ ≤
        specNorm ((U.submatrix indices id)⁻¹) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - U * Uᴴ) *ᵥ f)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := specNorm_one_sub_eq_of_idempotent_of_rank_pos_lt
    (deimProjector_properties U indices hM).2.2
    (by rwa [rank_deimProjector U hU indices hM])
    (by rwa [rank_deimProjector U hU indices hM])
  rw [specNorm_deimProjector U hU indices hi] at hcomp
  exact ⟨hcomp, fun f => hcomp ▸ norm_sub_deimProjector_mulVec_le U indices hM f⟩

name: NLAlib.complex_deimProjector_norm_and_error
statement:
theorem complex_deimProjector_norm_and_error (U : Matrix n r ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (indices : r → n) (hi : Function.Injective indices) (hM : IsUnit (U.submatrix indices id))
    (hr : 0 < Fintype.card r) (hn : Fintype.card r < Fintype.card n) :
    specNorm (1 - deimProjector U indices) = specNorm ((U.submatrix indices id)⁻¹) ∧
      ∀ f : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (f - deimProjector U indices *ᵥ f)‖ ≤
        specNorm ((U.submatrix indices id)⁻¹) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((1 - U * Uᴴ) *ᵥ f)‖
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    have hcomp := (complex_idempotent_complement_norm_properties
      (deimProjector U indices) (deimProjector_properties U indices hM).2.2).1
      (by rwa [rank_deimProjector U hU indices hM])
      (by rwa [rank_deimProjector U hU indices hM])
    change specNorm (1 - deimProjector U indices) = specNorm (deimProjector U indices) at hcomp
    rw [specNorm_deimProjector U hU indices hi] at hcomp
    exact ⟨hcomp, fun f => hcomp ▸ norm_sub_deimProjector_mulVec_le U indices hM f⟩

name: NLAlib.deimProjector_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem deimProjector_eq_zero_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty r] (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (indices : r → n) :
    deimProjector U indices = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [deimProjector, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.deim_empty_error
statement:
theorem deim_empty_error [IsEmpty r] (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (indices : r → n) (f : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (f - deimProjector U indices *ᵥ f)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 f‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [deimProjector_eq_zero_of_isEmpty, Matrix.zero_mulVec, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.exists_strong_rank_revealing_qr
statement:
theorem exists_strong_rank_revealing_qr {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (f : ℝ) (hf : 1 ≤ f) :
    ∃ π : (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ≃ n,
    ∃ Q : Matrix m (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ R₁₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ,
    ∃ R₁₂ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
    ∃ R₂₂ : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ Q * Qᵀ = 1 ∧ IsUnit R₁₁ ∧ R₁₁.IsUpperTriangular ∧
      IsUpperTrapezoidal R₂₂ ∧ A.submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks R₁₁ R₁₂ 0 R₂₂ ∧
      (∀ i < k, singularValues A i /
        Real.sqrt (1 + f ^ 2 * k * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k)) ≤ singularValues R₁₁ i) ∧
      (∀ j, singularValues R₂₂ j ≤ singularValues A (k + j) *
        Real.sqrt (1 + f ^ 2 * k * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k))) ∧
      (∀ i j, |(R₁₁⁻¹ * R₁₂) i j| ≤ f) ∧
      (k = A.rank → R₂₂ = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, Q, R, T, D, hQ, hQt, hR, hUpper, hDUpper, hFact, hEntry, hBudget⟩ :=
    exists_maximum_volume_triangular_qr_blocks A k hk
  let b : ℝ := (k : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k)
  let c := Real.sqrt (1 + f ^ 2 * k * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k))
  have hkn : k ≤ Fintype.card n := hk.trans A.rank_le_card_width
  have hnk : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k := sub_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkn)
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hnk
  have hf2 : 1 ≤ f ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hConst : 1 + b ≤ 1 + f ^ 2 * k * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf2 hb
    dsimp only [b] at hh ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hc : 0 < c := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : 0 < 1 + b) hConst)
  have hSmall : Real.sqrt (1 + b) ≤ c := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hConst
  have hSpec (i : ℕ) : singularValues (Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D) i =
      singularValues A i := by
    have hh := congrFun (singularValues_reindex A (Equiv.refl m) π.symm) i
    change singularValues (A.submatrix id π) i = _ at hh
    rw [hFact, singularValues_isometry_mul hQ] at hh
    exact hh
  refine ⟨π, Q, R, R * T, D, hQ, hQt, hR, hUpper, hDUpper, hFact, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hc).mpr
    calc
      _ = singularValues (Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T) 0 D) i := (hSpec i).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + b) * singularValues R i :=
        singularValues_upper_block_le_sqrt_budget_mul R T D hR b hb hBudget hi
      _ ≤ c * singularValues R i :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSmall (singularValues_nonneg R i)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  · intro j
    have hh := singularValues_trailing_le_sqrt_budget_mul R T D hR b hb hBudget j
    rw [hSpec] at hh
    exact hh.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSmall
      (singularValues_nonneg _ _)).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _))
  · intro i j
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul R ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR),
      Matrix.one_mul]
    exact (hEntry i j).trans hf
  · intro hr
    have hRankA : (A.submatrix id π).rank = A.rank := by
      simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl] using Matrix.rank_submatrix A (Equiv.refl m) π
    rw [hFact, rank_isometry_mul_eq hQ] at hRankA
    have hAdd := rank_fromBlocks_eq_rank_add_rank_schur R (R * T)
      (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin k) ℝ) D
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR)
    simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, sub_zero, Matrix.rank_of_isUnit R hR, Fintype.card_fin] at hAdd
    have hRankD : D.rank = 0 := by omega
    apply (frobSq_eq_zero_iff D).mp
    apply le_antisymm _ (frobSq_nonneg D)
    simpa only [hRankD, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] using frobSq_le_rank_mul_specNorm_sq D

name: NLAlib.mul_polarFrame_eq_polarFrame_mul_of_intertwining
statement:
theorem mul_polarFrame_eq_polarFrame_mul_of_intertwining
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (T : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hT : IsUnit (Tᵀ * T)) (hAT : A * T = T * B) (hAdj : Aᵀ * T = T * Bᵀ) :
    A * polarFrame T = polarFrame T * B
proof:
:= by
  let G := Tᵀ * T
  let Q := CFC.sqrt G
  have hAdjT : Tᵀ * A = B * Tᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
      congrArg Matrix.transpose hAdj
  have hComm : Commute G B := by
    change (Tᵀ * T) * B = B * (Tᵀ * T)
    calc
      _ = Tᵀ * (T * B) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = Tᵀ * (A * T) := by rw [hAT]
      _ = (Tᵀ * A) * T := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hAdjT, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hQComm : Commute Q B := hComm.cfcₙ_nnreal NNReal.sqrt
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ G := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self T).nonneg
  have hQUnit : IsUnit Q := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff _ hNonneg).mpr hT
  have hQDet := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det Q).mp hQUnit
  have hQl : Q⁻¹ * Q = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Q hQDet
  have hQr : Q * Q⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv Q hQDet
  have hFrame : polarFrame T * Q = T := by
    change T * Q⁻¹ * Q = T
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hQl, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hEq : (A * polarFrame T) * Q = (polarFrame T * B) * Q := by
    calc
      _ = A * T := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hFrame]
      _ = T * B := hAT
      _ = polarFrame T * (Q * B) :=
        (congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => M * B) hFrame).symm.trans (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _)
      _ = _ := by rw [hQComm.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => M * Q⁻¹) hEq
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, hQr, Matrix.mul_one] using h

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.mul_transpose_self
statement: theorem mul_transpose_self (h : IsHessenbergForm A Q H) : Q * Qᵀ = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_eq_one_comm.mp h.orth

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.transpose_mul_mul_eq
statement: theorem transpose_mul_mul_eq (h : IsHessenbergForm A Q H) : Qᵀ * A * Q = H
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.mul_one,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.isHermitian
statement: theorem isHermitian (h : IsHessenbergForm A Q H) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : H.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.transpose_mul_mul_eq, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.isTridiagonal
statement: theorem isTridiagonal (h : IsHessenbergForm A Q H) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : IsTridiagonal H
proof:
:=
  h.hess.isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian (h.isHermitian hA)

name: NLAlib.length_hessenbergReflectors
statement:
theorem length_hessenbergReflectors : ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
    (hessenbergReflectors A).length = n - 2
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | 1, _ => rfl
  | 2, _ => rfl
  | k + 3, A => by
    simp only [hessenbergReflectors, List.length_cons, List.length_map,
      length_hessenbergReflectors]
    omega

name: NLAlib.apply_zero_of_mem_hessenbergReflectors
statement:
theorem apply_zero_of_mem_hessenbergReflectors :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (u : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      u ∈ hessenbergReflectors A → u 0 = 0
  | 0, _, _, hu => by simp [hessenbergReflectors] at hu
  | 1, _, _, hu => by simp [hessenbergReflectors] at hu
  | k + 2, A, u, hu => by
    simp only [hessenbergReflectors, List.mem_cons, List.mem_map] at hu
    rcases hu with rfl | ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.hessenbergQ_mulVec_single_zero
statement:
theorem hessenbergQ_mulVec_single_zero (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    hessenbergQ A *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 = Pi.single 0 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold hessenbergQ
  have key : ∀ l : List (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ), (∀ u ∈ l, u 0 = 0) →
      (l.map householder).prod *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 = Pi.single 0 1 := by
    intro l hl
    induction l with
    | nil => rw [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    | cons u l ih =>
      rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        ih fun v hv => hl v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv)]
      apply householder_mulVec_of_dotProduct_eq_zero
      rw [dotProduct_single, hl u List.mem_cons_self, zero_mul]
  exact key _ (apply_zero_of_mem_hessenbergReflectors A)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_hessenbergQ
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_hessenbergQ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (hessenbergQ A)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_list_prod _ fun M hM => by
    obtain ⟨v, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hM
    exact hasOrthonormalCols_householder v

name: NLAlib.hessenbergQ_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem hessenbergQ_transpose_mul_self (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (hessenbergQ A)ᵀ * hessenbergQ A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasOrthonormalCols_hessenbergQ A).conjTranspose_mul_self
  rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h

name: NLAlib.hessenbergQ_add_three
statement:
theorem hessenbergQ_add_three (k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) :
    hessenbergQ A =
      householder (vecCons 0 (householderVector (fun i : Fin (k + 2) => A i.succ 0) 0)) *
      borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) (hessenbergQ
        ((householder (vecCons 0 (householderVector (fun i : Fin (k + 2) => A i.succ 0) 0)) *
          A * householder (vecCons 0
            (householderVector (fun i : Fin (k + 2) => A i.succ 0) 0))).submatrix
          Fin.succ Fin.succ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hessenbergQ, hessenbergReflectors, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
    prod_map_householder_map_vecCons_zero]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_hessenbergH
statement:
theorem isUpperHessenberg_hessenbergH : ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
    IsUpperHessenberg (hessenbergH A)
  | 0, _ => by intro i; exact i.elim0
  | 1, _ => by intro i j hij; have
proof:
:= i.isLt; omega
  | 2, _ => by intro i j hij; have := i.isLt; omega
  | k + 3, A => by
    let x : Fin (k + 2) → ℝ := fun i => A i.succ 0
    let w := householderVector x 0
    let P := householder (vecCons 0 w)
    let B := P * A * P
    let U := hessenbergQ (B.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ)
    let D := borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) U
    have hQ : hessenbergQ A = P * D := hessenbergQ_add_three k A
    have hform : hessenbergH A = Dᵀ * B * D := by
      rw [hessenbergH, hQ, Matrix.transpose_mul]
      change (Dᵀ * Pᵀ) * A * (P * D) = Dᵀ * (P * A * P) * D
      rw [show Pᵀ = P from householder_transpose _]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hBcol : (fun i : Fin (k + 2) => B i.succ 0) =
        (-(householderSign (x 0) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖)) • Pi.single 0 1 := by
      calc
        _ = householder w *ᵥ x := by
          ext i
          simp [B, P, householder_vecCons_zero, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec,
            dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ, x]
        _ = _ := householder_mulVec_householderVector x 0
    have hU : U *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 = Pi.single 0 1 :=
      hessenbergQ_mulVec_single_zero _
    have hUt : Uᵀ *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 = Pi.single 0 1 := by
      calc
        _ = Uᵀ *ᵥ (U *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1) := by rw [hU]
        _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
          show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hessenbergQ_transpose_mul_self _, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have htail : (hessenbergH A).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
        hessenbergH (B.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ) := by
      rw [hform, submatrix_borderedUpper_transpose_mul_mul]
      rfl
    intro i j hij
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp at hij
    | succ i =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
        rw [hform, borderedUpper_transpose_mul_mul_succ_zero, hBcol,
          Matrix.mulVec_smul, hUt, Pi.smul_apply]
        rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (show i ≠ 0 by intro h; subst i; simp at hij), smul_zero]
      | succ j =>
        have he := congrFun (congrFun htail i) j
        change hessenbergH A i.succ j.succ = _ at he
        rw [he]
        exact isUpperHessenberg_hessenbergH _ i j (by simpa using hij)

name: NLAlib.isHessenbergForm_hessenbergReduction
statement:
theorem isHessenbergForm_hessenbergReduction (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    IsHessenbergForm A (hessenbergReduction A).1 (hessenbergReduction A).2 where
  orth
proof:
:= hessenbergQ_transpose_mul_self A
  eq := by
    have hQQ : hessenbergQ A * (hessenbergQ A)ᵀ = 1 :=
      mul_eq_one_comm.mp (hessenbergQ_transpose_mul_self A)
    simp only [hessenbergReduction, hessenbergH]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQQ, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hQQ,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  hess := isUpperHessenberg_hessenbergH A

name: NLAlib.exists_isHessenbergForm
statement:
theorem exists_isHessenbergForm (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∃ Q H, IsHessenbergForm A Q H
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, _, isHessenbergForm_hessenbergReduction A⟩

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.exists_sign
statement:
theorem IsHessenbergForm.exists_sign {A Q₁ H₁ Q₂ H₂ : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ}
    (h₁ : IsHessenbergForm A Q₁ H₁) (h₂ : IsHessenbergForm A Q₂ H₂)
    (hcol : Q₁.col 0 = Q₂.col 0) (hH : IsUnreducedHessenberg H₁) :
    ∃ d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, (∀ i, d i = 1 ∨ d i = -1) ∧ d 0 = 1 ∧
      Q₂ = Q₁ * diagonal d ∧ H₂ = diagonal d * H₁ * diagonal d
proof:
:= by
  let W := Q₂ᵀ * Q₁
  have hWOrth : HasOrthonormalCols W := by
    change Wᵀ * W = 1
    dsimp [W]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q₂ Q₂ᵀ Q₁, h₂.mul_transpose_self, Matrix.one_mul]
    exact h₁.orth
  have hleft : Q₂ᵀ * A = H₂ * Q₂ᵀ := by
    rw [h₂.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      show Q₂ᵀ * Q₂ = 1 from h₂.orth, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hright : A * Q₁ = Q₁ * H₁ := by
    rw [h₁.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      show Q₁ᵀ * Q₁ = 1 from h₁.orth, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hcomm : H₂ * W = W * H₁ := by
    dsimp [W]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hleft, Matrix.mul_assoc, hright, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hWcol : W.col 0 = (1 : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).col 0 := by
    ext i
    change (Q₂ᵀ * Q₁) i 0 = (1 : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i 0
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
    have hcols : ∀ k, Q₁ k 0 = Q₂ k 0 := fun k => congrFun hcol k
    simp_rw [hcols]
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (show Q₂ᵀ * Q₂ = 1 from h₂.orth) i) 0
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  have hWU := isUpperTriangular_of_hessenberg_intertwines h₂.hess hH hcomm hWcol
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdiag⟩ := exists_diagonal_sign_of_isUpperTriangular hWU hWOrth
  have hd0 : d 0 = 1 := by
    have h := congrFun hWcol 0
    rw [hdiag] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.col_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq] using h
  have hDsq : Matrix.diagonal d * Matrix.diagonal d = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rcases hd i with h | h <;> simp [h]
    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne hij]
  have hQ₁ : Q₁ = Q₂ * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [← hdiag]
    dsimp [W]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, h₂.mul_transpose_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hQ₂ : Q₂ = Q₁ * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [hQ₁, Matrix.mul_assoc, hDsq, Matrix.mul_one]
  refine ⟨d, hd, hd0, hQ₂, ?_⟩
  rw [← h₂.transpose_mul_mul_eq, hQ₂, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose]
  have heq : (Matrix.diagonal d * Q₁ᵀ) * A * (Q₁ * Matrix.diagonal d) =
      Matrix.diagonal d * (Q₁ᵀ * A * Q₁) * Matrix.diagonal d := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [heq, h₁.transpose_mul_mul_eq]

name: NLAlib.absArgmax_eq_zero_of_forall
statement:
theorem absArgmax_eq_zero_of_forall {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ |v 0|) : absArgmax v = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n => simp only [absArgmax, if_pos (h _)]

name: NLAlib.wilkinsonMatrix_first
statement:
private theorem wilkinsonMatrix_first (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t i 0 = if i = 0 then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wilkinsonMatrix, Fin.val_zero, if_neg (by omega : ¬ (0 : ℕ) = n + 1)]
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · simp [hi]
  · simp [hi, Fin.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi]

name: NLAlib.partialPivotSwap_wilkinsonMatrix
statement:
private theorem partialPivotSwap_wilkinsonMatrix (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    partialPivotSwap (wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t) = wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t
proof:
:= by
  have hp : absArgmax (fun i => wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t i 0) = 0 := by
    apply absArgmax_eq_zero_of_forall
    intro i
    simp only [wilkinsonMatrix_first]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  simp [partialPivotSwap, hp]

name: NLAlib.pivotSchur_wilkinsonMatrix
statement:
private theorem pivotSchur_wilkinsonMatrix (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    pivotSchur (wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t) = wilkinsonMatrix n (2 * t)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h0 : wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t 0 0 = 1 := by
    simp [wilkinsonMatrix_first]
  have hc : wilkinsonMatrix (n + 1) t i.succ 0 = -1 := by
    simp [wilkinsonMatrix_first]
  simp only [pivotSchur, h0, hc, inv_one, one_mul, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  simp only [wilkinsonMatrix, Fin.val_succ, Fin.succ_inj, Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff,
    Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]
  by_cases hj : (j : ℕ) = n
  · simp [hj]
    ring
  · have hj0 : ¬ (0 : Fin (n + 2)) = j.succ := Fin.succ_ne_zero j |>.symm
    simp [hj, hj0, show ¬ j.succ < (0 : Fin (n + 2)) from not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _)]

name: NLAlib.luPartialPivot_wilkinsonMatrix_last
statement:
theorem luPartialPivot_wilkinsonMatrix_last (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (luPartialPivot (wilkinsonMatrix n t)).2.2 (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n) = 2 ^ n * t
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing t with
  | zero => simp [luPartialPivot, partialPivotSwap, absArgmax, wilkinsonMatrix, borderedMatrix]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [luPartialPivot, partialPivotSwap_wilkinsonMatrix, pivotSchur_wilkinsonMatrix]
    change (luPartialPivot (wilkinsonMatrix n (2 * t))).2.2 (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ]
    ring

name: NLAlib.abs_wilkinsonMatrix_one_le
statement:
theorem abs_wilkinsonMatrix_one_le (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    |wilkinsonMatrix n 1 i j| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wilkinsonMatrix]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.exists_luPartialPivot_growth_eq_two_pow
statement:
theorem exists_luPartialPivot_growth_eq_two_pow (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ,
      (∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      |(luPartialPivot A).2.2 (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n)| = 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨wilkinsonMatrix n 1, abs_wilkinsonMatrix_one_le n, ?_⟩
  rw [luPartialPivot_wilkinsonMatrix_last, mul_one, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]

name: NLAlib.IsCholesky.isUnit_det
statement: theorem IsCholesky.isUnit_det {A L : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsCholesky A L) : IsUnit L.det
proof:
:=
  (isUnit_det_iff_of_isLowerTriangular h.isLowerTriangular).2 fun i => (h.apply_self_pos i).ne'

name: NLAlib.IsCholesky.posDef
statement: theorem IsCholesky.posDef {A L : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsCholesky A L) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hL : IsUnit L := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det L).2 h.isUnit_det
  have := PosDef.mul_conjTranspose_self L (vecMul_injective_iff_isUnit.2 hL)
  rwa [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, ← h.eq_mul_transpose] at this

name: NLAlib.IsCholesky.unique
statement:
theorem IsCholesky.unique {A L L' : Matrix n n ℝ} (h : IsCholesky A L) (h' : IsCholesky A L') :
    L = L'
proof:
:= by
  have hL := h.isUnit_det
  have hL' := h'.isUnit_det
  have hLt : IsUnit Lᵀ.det := by rwa [det_transpose]
  have hLL : L * Lᵀ = L' * L'ᵀ := h.eq_mul_transpose.symm.trans h'.eq_mul_transpose
  set D := L'⁻¹ * L with hD
  have hDlow : D.IsLowerTriangular :=
    BlockTriangular.mul (isLowerTriangular_inv h'.isLowerTriangular) h.isLowerTriangular
  have hD2 : D = L'ᵀ * (Lᵀ)⁻¹ := by
    calc D = L'⁻¹ * L * (Lᵀ * (Lᵀ)⁻¹) := by rw [mul_nonsing_inv _ hLt, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = L'⁻¹ * (L * Lᵀ) * (Lᵀ)⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = L'⁻¹ * (L' * L'ᵀ) * (Lᵀ)⁻¹ := by rw [hLL]
      _ = L'ᵀ * (Lᵀ)⁻¹ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul _ hL', Matrix.one_mul]
  have hDup : D.IsUpperTriangular := by
    rw [hD2]
    exact BlockTriangular.mul (isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.2 h'.isLowerTriangular)
      (isUpperTriangular_inv (isUpperTriangular_transpose_iff.2 h.isLowerTriangular))
  have hdiag : ∀ i, D i i = (L' i i)⁻¹ * L i i := fun i => by
    rw [hD, mul_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular (isLowerTriangular_inv h'.isLowerTriangular)
      h.isLowerTriangular, inv_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular h'.isLowerTriangular
      (fun j => (h'.apply_self_pos j).ne')]
  have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < D i i := fun i => by
    rw [hdiag]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.2 (h'.apply_self_pos i)) (h.apply_self_pos i)
  have hL't : IsUnit L'ᵀ.det := by rwa [det_transpose]
  have hDD : D * Dᵀ = 1 := by
    calc D * Dᵀ = L'⁻¹ * (L * Lᵀ) * (L'⁻¹)ᵀ := by
          rw [hD, transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = L'⁻¹ * (L' * L'ᵀ) * (L'ᵀ)⁻¹ := by rw [hLL, transpose_nonsing_inv]
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul _ hL', Matrix.one_mul, mul_nonsing_inv _ hL't]
  have hone : ∀ i, D i i = 1 := fun i => by
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hDD i) i
    rw [mul_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular hDlow (isLowerTriangular_transpose_iff.2 hDup),
      transpose_apply, one_apply_eq] at h1
    have hp := hpos i
    nlinarith
  have hD1 : D = 1 := by
    rw [eq_diagonal_of_isLowerTriangular_of_isUpperTriangular hDlow hDup]
    simp [hone]
  calc L = L' * (L'⁻¹ * L) := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_nonsing_inv _ hL', Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = L' := by rw [← hD, hD1, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.isLowerTriangular_cholesky
statement:
theorem isLowerTriangular_cholesky {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (cholesky A).IsLowerTriangular
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun i => i.elim0
  | succ n ih => exact isLowerTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff.2 ⟨rfl, ih _⟩

name: NLAlib.cholesky_apply_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem cholesky_apply_self_nonneg {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ cholesky A i i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · simp [cholesky]
    · simpa [cholesky] using ih _ i

name: NLAlib.choleskySucceeds_iff_forall_cholesky_apply_self_pos
statement:
theorem choleskySucceeds_iff_forall_cholesky_apply_self_pos {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : CholeskySucceeds A ↔ ∀ i, 0 < cholesky A i i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [CholeskySucceeds]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [CholeskySucceeds, ih, Fin.forall_fin_succ]
    simp [cholesky, Real.sqrt_pos]

name: NLAlib.eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_pivotSchur
statement:
theorem eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_pivotSchur {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ha : 0 ≤ A 0 0)
    (hc : A 0 0 = 0 → ∀ i : Fin n, A i.succ 0 = 0)
    (hS : pivotSchur A = cholesky (pivotSchur A) * (cholesky (pivotSchur A))ᵀ) :
    A = cholesky A * (cholesky A)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : ∀ j : Fin n, A 0 j.succ = A j.succ 0 := fun j => by
    simpa using hA.apply j.succ 0
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (A 0 0) * Real.sqrt (A 0 0) = A 0 0 := Real.mul_self_sqrt ha
  have hcol : ∀ i : Fin n,
      Real.sqrt (A 0 0) * ((Real.sqrt (A 0 0))⁻¹ * A i.succ 0) = A i.succ 0 := by
    intro i
    rcases ha.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero
    · rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos).ne', one_mul]
    · rw [hc hzero.symm i, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  have hinv : (Real.sqrt (A 0 0))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (A 0 0))⁻¹ = (A 0 0)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← mul_inv, hsq]
  simp only [cholesky]
  rw [transpose_borderedMatrix, borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix, ← hS]
  conv_lhs => rw [← borderedMatrix_eta A]
  congr 1
  · simp [hsq]
  · ext j; simp [hcol, hsym]
  · ext i; simp [hcol]
  · ext i j
    simp only [pivotSchur_apply, vecMulVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, submatrix_apply,
      Matrix.add_apply]
    rw [hsym j]
    linear_combination (A i.succ 0 * A j.succ 0) * hinv.symm

name: NLAlib.isCholesky_cholesky
statement:
theorem isCholesky_cholesky {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (h : CholeskySucceeds A) : IsCholesky A (cholesky A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isLowerTriangular_cholesky A,
    (choleskySucceeds_iff_forall_cholesky_apply_self_pos A).1 h, ?_⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => ext i; exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hS⟩ := h
    exact eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_pivotSchur hA ha.le (fun h0 => absurd h0 ha.ne')
      (ih (isHermitian_pivotSchur hA) hS)

name: NLAlib.choleskySucceeds_iff_posDef
statement:
theorem choleskySucceeds_iff_posDef {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    CholeskySucceeds A ↔ A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [CholeskySucceeds, true_iff]
    refine posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.2 ⟨?_, fun x hx => absurd (Subsingleton.elim x 0) hx⟩
    ext i; exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [CholeskySucceeds, ih (isHermitian_pivotSchur hA), posDef_iff_pivotSchur hA]

name: NLAlib.isCholesky_cholesky_of_posDef
statement:
theorem isCholesky_cholesky_of_posDef {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    IsCholesky A (cholesky A)
proof:
:=
  isCholesky_cholesky hA.isHermitian ((choleskySucceeds_iff_posDef hA.isHermitian).2 hA)

name: NLAlib.eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : A = cholesky A * (cholesky A)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => ext i; exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    exact eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_pivotSchur hA.isHermitian (hA.diag_nonneg)
      (fun h0 i => apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA h0 i.succ)
      (ih (posSemidef_pivotSchur hA))

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_mul_transpose_submatrix
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mul_transpose_submatrix {A L : Matrix n n ℝ} (P : ℝ → Prop)
    (hL : L.IsLowerTriangular) (hP : ∀ i, P (L i i)) (hA : A = L * Lᵀ) (e : m ≃o n) :
    ∃ L' : Matrix m m ℝ, L'.IsLowerTriangular ∧ (∀ i, P (L' i i)) ∧
      A.submatrix e e = L' * L'ᵀ
proof:
:=
  ⟨L.submatrix e e, isLowerTriangular_iff.2 fun _ _ hij =>
      isLowerTriangular_iff.1 hL _ _ (e.strictMono hij),
    fun i => hP (e i), by
      rw [hA, Matrix.transpose_submatrix]
      exact (Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv L Lᵀ e e.toEquiv e).symm⟩

name: NLAlib.submatrix_monoEquivOfFin_symm
statement:
theorem submatrix_monoEquivOfFin_symm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (A.submatrix (monoEquivOfFin n rfl) (monoEquivOfFin n rfl)).submatrix
      (monoEquivOfFin n rfl).symm (monoEquivOfFin n rfl).symm = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp

name: NLAlib.exists_isCholesky_iff_posDef
statement: theorem exists_isCholesky_iff_posDef (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : (∃ L, IsCholesky A L) ↔ A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h.posDef, fun hA => ?_⟩
  let e := monoEquivOfFin n rfl
  have hA' : (A.submatrix e e).PosDef := hA.submatrix e.injective
  obtain ⟨hlow, hpos, heq⟩ := isCholesky_cholesky_of_posDef hA'
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hP, hLL⟩ := exists_eq_mul_transpose_submatrix (fun x => 0 < x) hlow hpos heq e.symm
  rw [submatrix_monoEquivOfFin_symm] at hLL
  exact ⟨L, hL, hP, hLL⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ L : Matrix n n ℝ, L.IsLowerTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ L i i) ∧ A = L * Lᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let e := monoEquivOfFin n rfl
  have hA' : (A.submatrix e e).PosSemidef := hA.submatrix e
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hP, hLL⟩ := exists_eq_mul_transpose_submatrix (fun x => 0 ≤ x)
    (isLowerTriangular_cholesky _) (cholesky_apply_self_nonneg _)
    (eq_cholesky_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef hA') e.symm
  rw [submatrix_monoEquivOfFin_symm] at hLL
  exact ⟨L, hL, hP, hLL⟩

name: NLAlib.submatrix_decomposeFin_symm_self
statement:
theorem submatrix_decomposeFin_symm_self {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (p : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    A.submatrix (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, τ)) (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, τ)) =
      borderedMatrix (A p p) (fun j => A p (Equiv.swap 0 p (τ j).succ))
        (fun i => A (Equiv.swap 0 p (τ i).succ) p)
        (fun i j => A (Equiv.swap 0 p (τ i).succ) (Equiv.swap 0 p (τ j).succ))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← borderedMatrix_eta (A.submatrix _ _)]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · ext j; simp
  · ext i; simp
  · ext i j; simp

name: NLAlib.isPivotedCholesky_choleskyPivoted
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun i => i.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, by ext i; exact i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hB : (diagPivotSwap A).PosSemidef := hA.submatrix _
    obtain ⟨hL, hd, hLL⟩ := ih (posSemidef_pivotSchur hB)
    have hsym : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i := fun i j => by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hA.isHermitian j) i
      simpa using this
    refine ⟨isLowerTriangular_borderedMatrix_iff.2 ⟨rfl, hL⟩, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · simp [choleskyPivoted]
      · simpa [choleskyPivoted] using hd i
    · set p := absArgmax fun i => A i i with hp
      have ha : 0 ≤ A p p := hA.diag_nonneg
      have hsq : Real.sqrt (A p p) * Real.sqrt (A p p) = A p p := Real.mul_self_sqrt ha
      have hinv : (Real.sqrt (A p p))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (A p p))⁻¹ = (A p p)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← mul_inv, hsq]
      have hcol : ∀ x, Real.sqrt (A p p) * ((Real.sqrt (A p p))⁻¹ * A x p) = A x p := by
        intro x
        rcases ha.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero
        · rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos).ne', one_mul]
        · rw [apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA hzero.symm x, mul_zero,
            mul_zero]
      simp only [choleskyPivoted]
      rw [submatrix_decomposeFin_symm_self, transpose_borderedMatrix,
        borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix, ← hLL]
      simp only [diagPivotSwap, ← hp]
      congr 1
      · simp [hsq]
      · ext j; simp [hcol, hsym p]
      · ext i; simp [hcol]
      · ext i j
        simp only [pivotSchur_apply, vecMulVec_apply, submatrix_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
          Equiv.swap_apply_left]
        rw [hsym p (Equiv.swap 0 p _)]
        linear_combination
          (A (Equiv.swap 0 p ((choleskyPivoted (pivotSchur (A.submatrix (Equiv.swap 0 p)
            (Equiv.swap 0 p)))).1 i).succ) p *
          A (Equiv.swap 0 p ((choleskyPivoted (pivotSchur (A.submatrix (Equiv.swap 0 p)
            (Equiv.swap 0 p)))).1 j).succ) p) * hinv.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_choleskyPivoted_positive_prefix
statement:
theorem exists_choleskyPivoted_positive_prefix {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ r ≤ n, (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < r → 0 < (choleskyPivoted A).2 i i) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin n, r ≤ j.val → (choleskyPivoted A).2 i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun i => i.elim0, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    let B := diagPivotSwap A
    have hB : B.PosSemidef := hA.submatrix _
    by_cases hpos : 0 < B 0 0
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hprefix, hzero⟩ := ih (posSemidef_pivotSchur hB)
      refine ⟨r + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
        · intro hi
          simpa only [choleskyPivoted, borderedMatrix_zero_zero] using Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
        · intro hi
          simpa only [choleskyPivoted, borderedMatrix_succ_succ] using hprefix i (by simpa using hi)
      · intro i j
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
        · intro hj
          simp only [Fin.val_zero] at hj
          omega
        · intro hj
          refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
          · simp only [choleskyPivoted, borderedMatrix_zero_succ, Pi.zero_apply]
          · simpa only [choleskyPivoted, borderedMatrix_succ_succ] using hzero i j (by simpa using hj)
    · let p := absArgmax (fun i => A i i)
      have hpivot : B 0 0 = A p p := by simp only [p, B, diagPivotSwap, submatrix_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
      have hp : A p p = 0 := by have hnonneg := hA.diag_nonneg (i := p); linarith
      have hA0 : A = 0 := by
        ext i j
        have hmax := abs_le_abs_absArgmax (fun k => A k k) j
        change |A j j| ≤ |A p p| at hmax
        rw [hp, abs_zero] at hmax
        have hj : A j j = 0 := abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hmax (abs_nonneg _))
        exact apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA hj i
      have hfactor := isPivotedCholesky_choleskyPivoted hA
      have hgram : (choleskyPivoted A).2 * (choleskyPivoted A).2ᵀ = 0 := by
        rw [← hfactor.submatrix_eq, hA0]
        simp
      have hL0 : (choleskyPivoted A).2 = 0 := by
        ext i j
        have h := congrFun (congrFun hgram i) i
        have hrow : (fun k => (choleskyPivoted A).2 i k) ⬝ᵥ (fun k => (choleskyPivoted A).2 i k) = 0 := by
          simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, dotProduct] using h
        exact congrFun (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hrow) j
      refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun i hi => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hi), ?_⟩
      intro i j hj
      rw [hL0]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.rank_choleskyPivoted_eq_prefix
statement:
theorem rank_choleskyPivoted_eq_prefix {n r : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hr : r ≤ n)
    (hpos : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < r → 0 < (choleskyPivoted A).2 i i)
    (hzero : ∀ i j : Fin n, r ≤ j.val → (choleskyPivoted A).2 i j = 0) : A.rank = r
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor := isPivotedCholesky_choleskyPivoted hA
  calc
    A.rank = (A.submatrix (choleskyPivoted A).1 (choleskyPivoted A).1).rank :=
      (Matrix.rank_submatrix _ _ _).symm
    _ = ((choleskyPivoted A).2 * (choleskyPivoted A).2ᵀ).rank := by rw [hfactor.submatrix_eq]
    _ = (choleskyPivoted A).2.rank := Matrix.rank_self_mul_transpose _
    _ = r := Matrix.rank_eq_of_lowerTriangular_positive_prefix hr _ hfactor.isLowerTriangular hpos hzero

name: NLAlib.choleskyPivoted_apply_self_pos_iff_lt_rank
statement:
theorem choleskyPivoted_apply_self_pos_iff_lt_rank {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (i : Fin n) : 0 < (choleskyPivoted A).2 i i ↔ (i : ℕ) < A.rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hpos, hzero⟩ := exists_choleskyPivoted_positive_prefix hA
  rw [rank_choleskyPivoted_eq_prefix hA hr hpos hzero]
  constructor
  · intro hi
    by_contra hnot
    have hz := hzero i i (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
    rw [hz] at hi
    exact lt_irrefl _ hi
  · exact hpos i

name: NLAlib.choleskyPivoted_apply_eq_zero_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem choleskyPivoted_apply_eq_zero_of_rank_le {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (i j : Fin n) (hj : A.rank ≤ (j : ℕ)) : (choleskyPivoted A).2 i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hpos, hzero⟩ := exists_choleskyPivoted_positive_prefix hA
  rw [rank_choleskyPivoted_eq_prefix hA hr hpos hzero] at hj
  exact hzero i j hj

name: NLAlib.qr_decomposition
statement:
theorem qr_decomposition {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [LinearOrder n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hCard : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix m n ℝ, ∃ R : Matrix n n ℝ,
      IsQR A Q R ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ R i i) ∧
        Rᵀ * R = Aᵀ * A ∧
        (∀ k, singularValues R k = singularValues A k) ∧
        moorePenroseConditionNumber R = moorePenroseConditionNumber A ∧
        (∀ e : n ↪ m, ∃ W : Matrix m m ℝ, ∃ T : Matrix m n ℝ,
          HasOrthonormalCols W ∧ W * Wᵀ = 1 ∧ W.submatrix id e = Q ∧
            W * T = A ∧ T.submatrix e id = R ∧
              (∀ i ∉ Set.range e, ∀ j, T i j = 0)) ∧
        (A.rank = Fintype.card n → (∀ i, 0 < R i i) ∧
          Q * Qᵀ = A * moorePenroseInverse A ∧
          ∀ (Q' : Matrix m n ℝ) (R' : Matrix n n ℝ),
            IsQR A Q' R' → (∀ i, 0 < R' i i) → Q' = Q ∧ R' = R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, R, hQR, hDiag⟩ := exists_isQR A hCard
  obtain ⟨hFactor, hQ, hUpper⟩ := hQR
  replace hFactor := hFactor.symm
  refine ⟨Q, R, ⟨hFactor.symm, hQ, hUpper⟩, hDiag,
    conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr hQ hFactor,
    congrFun (singularValues_eq_of_qr hQ hFactor),
    moorePenroseConditionNumber_eq_of_qr hQ hFactor, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e
    obtain ⟨W, T, hW, hCols, hFullFactor, hCorner, hZero⟩ :=
      exists_full_qr_completion hQ hFactor e
    exact ⟨W, T, hW, mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW, hCols, hFullFactor, hCorner, hZero⟩
  · intro hRank
    have hPositive := diag_pos_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card hQ hUpper hDiag hFactor hRank
    refine ⟨hPositive,
      mul_transpose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse_of_qr_of_rank_eq_card hQ hFactor hRank, ?_⟩
    intro Q' R' hQR' hDiag'
    exact hQR'.eq_of_diag_pos ⟨hFactor.symm, hQ, hUpper⟩ hDiag' hPositive

name: NLAlib.exists_isQR
statement:
theorem exists_isQR (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hCard : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) :
    ∃ Q R, IsQR A Q R ∧ ∀ i, 0 ≤ R i i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hGramPSD : (Aᵀ * A).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  obtain ⟨L, hLower, hDiag, hFactor'⟩ := exists_eq_mul_transpose_of_posSemidef hGramPSD
  have hFactor := hFactor'.symm
  let R := Lᵀ
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_hasOrthonormalCols_of_card_le hCard
  have hJGram : Jᵀ * J = 1 := hJ
  have hGram : Aᵀ * A = (J * R)ᵀ * (J * R) := by
    calc
      Aᵀ * A = Rᵀ * R := by simpa only [R, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hFactor.symm
      _ = Rᵀ * (Jᵀ * J) * R := by rw [hJGram, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (J * R)ᵀ * (J * R) := by simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUFactor⟩ := exists_orthogonal_mul_eq_of_gram_eq A (J * R) hGram
  refine ⟨U * J, R, ⟨?_, ?_, hLower.transpose⟩, hDiag⟩
  · simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hUFactor.symm
  · show (U * J)ᵀ * (U * J) = 1
    have hUGram : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU
    calc
      (U * J)ᵀ * (U * J) = Jᵀ * (Uᵀ * U) * J := by
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hUGram, Matrix.mul_one, hJGram]

name: NLAlib.exists_isQR_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem exists_isQR_of_isUnit {A : Matrix m n ℝ} (hA : IsUnit (Aᵀ * A)) :
    ∃ Q R, IsQR A Q R ∧ ∀ i, 0 < R i i
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m := by
    have h1 := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hA
    rw [Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self] at h1
    exact h1 ▸ Matrix.rank_le_card_height A
  obtain ⟨Q, R, h, hpos⟩ := exists_isQR A hn
  exact ⟨Q, R, h, fun i => lt_of_le_of_ne (hpos i)
    (h.isUnit_conjTranspose_mul_self_iff.1 hA i).symm⟩

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.sqrt_gram_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (σ i : ℂ)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => by
      exact_mod_cast (h.pos i).le)
  have hS : (thinSingularMatrix V V σ).PosSemidef :=
    hD.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same V
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique _ hS.nonneg
  change thinSingularMatrix V V σ * thinSingularMatrix V V σ = Aᴴ * A
  rw [thinSingularMatrix_mul V V V h.right_orth]
  rw [h.eq]
  change thinSingularMatrix V V (fun i => σ i * σ i) =
    (thinSingularMatrix U V σ)ᴴ * thinSingularMatrix U V σ
  rw [thinSingularMatrix_gram U V h.left_orth]
  simp only [pow_two]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.canonicalPartialPolar_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hS : IsThinSVD (CFC.sqrt (Aᴴ * A)) V V σ :=
    ⟨h.right_orth, h.right_orth, h.pos, h.sqrt_gram_eq⟩
  rw [canonicalPartialPolar, hS.moorePenroseInverse_eq, h.eq]
  simp only [← RCLike.ofReal_inv]
  change thinSingularMatrix U V σ * thinSingularMatrix V V (fun i => (σ i)⁻¹) = _
  rw [thinSingularMatrix_mul U V V h.right_orth]
  have hc : (fun i => σ i * (σ i)⁻¹) = (fun _ : r => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    funext i
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (h.pos i).ne'
  rw [hc]
  simp [thinSingularMatrix]

name: NLAlib.canonicalPartialPolar_eq_mul_inv_sqrt
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalPartialPolar, moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit _
    ((CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff _ (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).nonneg).mpr hA)]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_gram_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem isUnit_gram_of_rank_eq_card {A : Matrix m n ℂ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : IsUnit (Aᴴ * A)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.isUnit_of_rank_eq_card
  rwa [Matrix.rank_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.right_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL A (isUnit_gram_of_rank_eq_card hA),
    pinvL_mul (isUnit_gram_of_rank_eq_card hA)]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_canonicalPartialPolar_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_canonicalPartialPolar_of_rank_eq_card {A : Matrix m n ℂ}
    (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : HasOrthonormalCols (canonicalPartialPolar A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  have hGram := isUnit_gram_of_rank_eq_card hA
  rw [h.canonicalPartialPolar_eq, hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U Vᴴ, h.left_orth.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [← h.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq, moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL A hGram, pinvL_mul hGram]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eliminationStep_apply (A : Matrix n n K) (t i j : n) :
    eliminationStep A t i j = A i j - (A t t)⁻¹ * (A i t * A t j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eliminationStep, vecMulVec_apply]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eliminationStep_zero (t : n) : eliminationStep (0 : Matrix n n K) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_eq_self_of_apply_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_eq_self_of_apply_self_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n K} {t : n}
    (ht : A t t = 0) : eliminationStep A t = A
proof:
:= by
  simp [eliminationStep, ht]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply_pivot_left_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_apply_pivot_left_of_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n K} {t : n} (ht : A t t ≠ 0)
    (j : n) : eliminationStep A t t j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eliminationStep_apply, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht, one_mul, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right_of_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n K} {t : n} (ht : A t t ≠ 0)
    (i : n) : eliminationStep A t i t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eliminationStep_apply, mul_comm (A i t), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht, one_mul, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_row
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_row {A : Matrix n n K} {u : n} (hu : ∀ j, A u j = 0)
    (t j : n) : eliminationStep A t u j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hu]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_col
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_col {A : Matrix n n K} {u : n} (hu : ∀ i, A i u = 0)
    (t i : n) : eliminationStep A t i u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hu]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_mulVec_eq (A : Matrix n n K) (t : n) (x : n → K) :
    eliminationStep A t *ᵥ x = A *ᵥ (x - ((A *ᵥ x) t / A t t) • Pi.single t 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eliminationStep, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
  ext j
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, op_smul_eq_smul, Matrix.col,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mulVec, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.ker_mulVecLin_le_ker_eliminationStep
statement:
theorem ker_mulVecLin_le_ker_eliminationStep (A : Matrix n n K) (t : n) :
    LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker (eliminationStep A t).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change A *ᵥ x = 0 at hx
  change eliminationStep A t *ᵥ x = 0
  rw [eliminationStep_mulVec_eq, hx]
  simp [hx]

name: NLAlib.ker_eliminationStep_eq_sup_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    let a := (A *ᵥ x) t / A t t
    have hy : x - a • Pi.single t (1 : K) ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin := by
      change A *ᵥ (x - a • Pi.single t (1 : K)) = 0
      rw [← eliminationStep_mulVec_eq]
      exact hx
    have he : a • Pi.single t (1 : K) ∈ Submodule.span K {Pi.single t (1 : K)} :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
    exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨_, hy, _, he, by abel⟩
  · apply sup_le (ker_mulVecLin_le_ker_eliminationStep A t)
    apply (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr
    change eliminationStep A t *ᵥ Pi.single t 1 = 0
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
    ext j
    exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right_of_ne_zero ht j

name: NLAlib.rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq
statement:
theorem rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq {A : Matrix n n K} {t : n} (ht : A t t ≠ 0) :
    (eliminationStep A t).rank + 1 = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  have he : Pi.single t (1 : K) ∉ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin := by
    intro hz
    have hh := congrFun hz t
    apply ht
    simpa using hh
  have hker := Submodule.finrank_sup_span_singleton he
  rw [← ker_eliminationStep_eq_sup_span_singleton ht] at hker
  have hA := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker A.mulVecLin
  have hS := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (eliminationStep A t).mulVecLin
  change A.rank + Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) = _ at hA
  change (eliminationStep A t).rank +
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (eliminationStep A t).mulVecLin) = _ at hS
  omega

name: NLAlib.rank_eliminationStep_lt
statement:
theorem rank_eliminationStep_lt {A : Matrix n n K} {t : n} (ht : A t t ≠ 0) :
    (eliminationStep A t).rank < A.rank
proof:
:= by
  have := rank_eliminationStep_add_one_eq ht
  omega

name: NLAlib.star_dotProduct_eliminationStep_mulVec
statement:
theorem star_dotProduct_eliminationStep_mulVec (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (t : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    star x ⬝ᵥ eliminationStep A t *ᵥ x =
      star x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x - (A t t)⁻¹ * ((∑ i, star (x i) * A i t) * ∑ j, A t j * x j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, eliminationStep_apply, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Pi.star_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_eliminationStep
statement:
theorem isHermitian_eliminationStep {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (t : n) :
    (eliminationStep A t).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hr : star (fun j => A t j) = fun i => A i t := by funext j; exact hA.apply j t
  have hc : star (fun i => A i t) = fun j => A t j := by funext j; exact hA.apply t j
  show (eliminationStep A t)ᴴ = eliminationStep A t
  simp only [eliminationStep, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, hA.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,
    star_inv₀, hA.apply t t, Matrix.conjTranspose_vecMulVec, hr, hc]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_eliminationStep
statement:
theorem posSemidef_eliminationStep {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : n) :
    (eliminationStep A t).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : A t t = 0
  · rw [eliminationStep_eq_self_of_apply_self_eq_zero ht]
    exact hA
  let e : n → 𝕜 := Pi.single t 1
  let M : Matrix n n 𝕜 := 1 - (A t t)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec e (fun j => A t j)
  have hAM : A * M = eliminationStep A t := by
    change A * (1 - (A t t)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec e (fun j => A t j)) = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec]
    simp only [e, Matrix.mulVec_single_one, eliminationStep]
    rfl
  have hMA : Mᴴ * A = eliminationStep A t := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hAM
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hA.isHermitian.eq,
      (isHermitian_eliminationStep hA.isHermitian t).eq] using h
  have hSe : eliminationStep A t *ᵥ e = 0 := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
    ext j
    exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right_of_ne_zero ht j
  have hSM : eliminationStep A t * M = eliminationStep A t := by
    change eliminationStep A t * (1 - (A t t)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec e (fun j => A t j)) = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec,
      hSe, Matrix.zero_vecMulVec, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hf : Mᴴ * A * M = eliminationStep A t := by rw [hMA, hSM]
  rw [← hf]
  exact hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same M

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_le
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : n) :
    eliminationStep A t ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  have hc : (fun j => A t j) = star fun i => A i t := by
    funext j; exact (hA.isHermitian.apply t j).symm
  have hd : ((RCLike.re (A t t) : ℝ) : 𝕜) = A t t :=
    RCLike.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (hA.isHermitian.apply t t)
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (A t t) := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hA.diag_nonneg).1
  have hinv : 0 ≤ (A t t)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← hd, ← RCLike.ofReal_inv]
    exact RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr (inv_nonneg.mpr hd0)
  have he : A - eliminationStep A t =
      (A t t)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (fun i => A i t) (star fun i => A i t) := by
    rw [eliminationStep, hc]
    abel
  rw [he]
  exact (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star _).smul hinv

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply_pivot_left
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_apply_pivot_left {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t j : n) :
    eliminationStep A t t j = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : A t t = 0
  · rw [eliminationStep_eq_self_of_apply_self_eq_zero h]
    exact apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero' hA h j
  · exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_left_of_ne_zero h j

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t i : n) :
    eliminationStep A t i t = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : A t t = 0
  · rw [eliminationStep_eq_self_of_apply_self_eq_zero h]
    exact apply_eq_zero_of_posSemidef_of_apply_self_eq_zero hA h i
  · exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right_of_ne_zero h i

name: NLAlib.isUpperTrapezoidal_iff_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem isUpperTrapezoidal_iff_isUpperTriangular {α : Type*} [Zero α]
    (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) α) :
    IsUpperTrapezoidal R ↔ R.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ hij => h _ _ hij, fun h _ _ hij => h (Fin.lt_def.2 hij)⟩

name: NLAlib.IsFullQR.mul_conjTranspose_self
statement:
theorem IsFullQR.mul_conjTranspose_self {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} {Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜}
    {R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} (h : IsFullQR A Q R) : Q * Qᴴ = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_eq_one_comm.mp h.orth

name: NLAlib.IsFullQR.conjTranspose_mul_eq
statement:
theorem IsFullQR.conjTranspose_mul_eq {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} {Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜}
    {R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} (h : IsFullQR A Q R) : Qᴴ * A = R
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, show Qᴴ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsFullQR.isQR_castLE
statement:
theorem IsFullQR.isQR_castLE {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} {Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜}
    {R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜} (h : IsFullQR A Q R) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    IsQR A (Q.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hnm)) (R.submatrix (Fin.castLE hnm) id) where
  eq
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, m = n + r := ⟨m - n, by omega⟩
    rw [h.eq]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    have hz : ∑ k : Fin r, Q i (Fin.natAdd n k) * R (Fin.natAdd n k) j = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => by
        rw [h.upper _ _ (by simp only [Fin.val_natAdd]; omega), mul_zero]
    rw [hz, add_zero]
    rfl
  orth := by
    change (Q.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hnm))ᴴ * Q.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hnm) = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, ← Matrix.submatrix_mul _ _ _ _ _ Function.bijective_id,
      show Qᴴ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.submatrix_one _ (Fin.castLE_injective hnm)]
  upper := fun i j hij => h.upper (Fin.castLE hnm i) j hij

name: NLAlib.borderedUpper_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedUpper_zero (r : Fin (n + 1) → 𝕜) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    borderedUpper r M 0 j = r j
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.borderedUpper_succ_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedUpper_succ_zero (r : Fin (n + 1) → 𝕜) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (i : Fin m) : borderedUpper r M i.succ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [borderedUpper]

name: NLAlib.borderedUpper_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem borderedUpper_succ_succ (r : Fin (n + 1) → 𝕜) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : borderedUpper r M i.succ j.succ = M i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [borderedUpper]

name: NLAlib.isUpperTrapezoidal_borderedUpper
statement:
theorem isUpperTrapezoidal_borderedUpper (r : Fin (n + 1) → 𝕜) {M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hM : IsUpperTrapezoidal M) : IsUpperTrapezoidal (borderedUpper r M)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp at hij
  | succ i =>
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => simpa using hM i j (by simpa using hij)

name: NLAlib.borderedUpper_one_mul_borderedUpper
statement:
theorem borderedUpper_one_mul_borderedUpper {k : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜)
    (r : Fin (k + 1) → 𝕜) (N : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) 𝕜) :
    borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) M * borderedUpper r N = borderedUpper r (M * N)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  | succ i =>
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    | succ j => simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: NLAlib.borderedUpper_one_one
statement: theorem borderedUpper_one_one : borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => simp [Matrix.one_apply_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm]
  | succ i =>
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => simp [Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_borderedUpper_one
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_borderedUpper_one (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) :
    (borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) M)ᴴ = borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) Mᴴ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => induction j using Fin.cases <;> simp
  | succ i => induction j using Fin.cases <;> simp

name: NLAlib.isFullQR_mul_borderedUpper
proof:
:= by
    have hblock : borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) Q' * borderedUpper ((Wᴴ * A) 0) R' = Wᴴ * A := by
      rw [borderedUpper_one_mul_borderedUpper, ← h'.eq]
      ext i j
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i =>
        induction j using Fin.cases with
        | zero => rw [borderedUpper_succ_zero, hB]
        | succ j => rw [borderedUpper_succ_succ]; rfl
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hblock, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_eq_one_comm.mp (show Wᴴ * W = 1 from hW),
      Matrix.one_mul]
  orth := by
    change (W * borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) Q')ᴴ * (W * borderedUpper (vecCons 1 0) Q') = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Wᴴ, show Wᴴ * W = 1 from hW,
      Matrix.one_mul,
      conjTranspose_borderedUpper_one, borderedUpper_one_mul_borderedUpper,
      show Q'ᴴ * Q' = 1 from h'.orth, borderedUpper_one_one]
  upper := isUpperTrapezoidal_borderedUpper _ h'.upper

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr {A Q : Matrix m n 𝕜} {R : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hFactor : Q * R = A) : Rᴴ * R = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hFactor, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  have hGram : Qᴴ * Q = 1 := hQ
  calc
    Rᴴ * R = Rᴴ * (Qᴴ * Q) * R := by rw [hGram, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = Rᴴ * Qᴴ * (Q * R) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.IsQR.conjTranspose_mul_eq
statement: theorem conjTranspose_mul_eq (h : IsQR A Q R) : Qᴴ * A = R
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, show Qᴴ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsQR.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq
statement: theorem conjTranspose_mul_self_eq (h : IsQR A Q R) : Aᴴ * A = Rᴴ * R
proof:
:=
  (conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_of_qr h.orth h.eq.symm).symm

name: NLAlib.IsQR.det_eq
statement: theorem det_eq (h : IsQR A Q R) : R.det = ∏ i, R i i
proof:
:=
  det_of_isUpperTriangular h.upper

name: NLAlib.IsQR.isUnit_det_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_det_iff (h : IsQR A Q R) : IsUnit R.det ↔ ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.det_eq, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  simp

name: NLAlib.IsQR.isUnit_conjTranspose_mul_self_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_conjTranspose_mul_self_iff (h : IsQR A Q R) :
    IsUnit (Aᴴ * A) ↔ ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, h.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq, Matrix.det_mul,
    Matrix.det_conjTranspose, IsUnit.mul_iff, isUnit_star, and_self, h.isUnit_det_iff]

name: NLAlib.IsQR.range_mulVecLin_eq
statement:
theorem range_mulVecLin_eq (h : IsQR A Q R) (hR : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit R.det := h.isUnit_det_iff.2 hR
  have hQ : Q = A * R⁻¹ := by rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet,
    Matrix.mul_one]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [h.eq, Matrix.mulVecLin_mul]; exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _
  · rw [hQ, Matrix.mulVecLin_mul]; exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: NLAlib.IsQR.diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem diagonal_mul (h : IsQR A Q R) (d : n → 𝕜) (hd : ∀ i, star (d i) * d i = 1) :
    IsQR A (Q * diagonal d) (diagonal (star ∘ d) * R) where
  eq
proof:
:= by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (diagonal d), diagonal_mul_diagonal,
      show (fun i => d i * (star ∘ d) i) = fun _ => 1 from funext fun i => by
        simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_comm] using hd i,
      diagonal_one, Matrix.one_mul, h.eq]
  orth := by
    change (Q * diagonal d)ᴴ * (Q * diagonal d) = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, diagonal_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ,
      show Qᴴ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.one_mul, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    exact (congrArg diagonal (funext hd)).trans diagonal_one
  upper := (blockTriangular_diagonal (star ∘ d)).mul h.upper

name: NLAlib.IsQR.submatrix_rows
statement:
theorem submatrix_rows (h : IsQR A Q R) {m' : Type*} [Fintype m'] (e : m' ≃ m) :
    IsQR (A.submatrix e id) (Q.submatrix e id) R where
  eq
proof:
:= by
    rw [h.eq, Matrix.submatrix_mul _ _ _ id _ Function.bijective_id, Matrix.submatrix_id_id]
  orth := by
    change (Q.submatrix e id)ᴴ * Q.submatrix e id = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, ← Matrix.submatrix_mul _ _ _ _ _ e.bijective,
      show Qᴴ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.submatrix_id_id]
  upper := h.upper

name: NLAlib.pinvL_eq_of_isQR
statement: theorem pinvL_eq_of_isQR (h : IsQR A Q R) (hR : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0) : pinvL A = R⁻¹ * Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : IsUnit R.det := h.isUnit_det_iff.2 hR
  have hdetT : IsUnit Rᴴ.det := by simpa only [Matrix.det_conjTranspose, isUnit_star] using hdet
  rw [pinvL]
  rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Rᴴ⁻¹, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdetT, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_of_isQR
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_of_isQR (h : IsQR A Q R) (hR : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0) :
    moorePenroseInverse A = R⁻¹ * Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL A (h.isUnit_conjTranspose_mul_self_iff.2 hR),
    pinvL_eq_of_isQR h hR]

name: NLAlib.IsQR.mul_conjTranspose_eq
statement:
theorem IsQR.mul_conjTranspose_eq (h : IsQR A Q R) (hR : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0) :
    Q * Qᴴ = A * moorePenroseInverse A
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_of_isQR h hR, h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc R,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (h.isUnit_det_iff.2 hR), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_transpose_mul_apply_succ_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_transpose_mul_apply_succ_zero_eq_zero {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    ∃ W : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols W ∧
      ∀ i : Fin m, (Wᵀ * A) i.succ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : A.col 0 ⬝ᵥ A.col 0 = 0
  · refine ⟨1, by simp [HasOrthonormalCols], fun i => ?_⟩
    have h0 := congrFun (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 ha) i.succ
    simpa using h0
  · have hnn : 0 ≤ A.col 0 ⬝ᵥ A.col 0 := by
      unfold dotProduct; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
    set c := √(A.col 0 ⬝ᵥ A.col 0) with hcdef
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hcdef, Real.sqrt_ne_zero hnn]; exact ha
    have hc2 : c * c = A.col 0 ⬝ᵥ A.col 0 := Real.mul_self_sqrt hnn
    let V : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin 1) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i _ => A i 0 / c
    have hV : Vᵀ * V = 1 := by
      ext a b
      rw [Subsingleton.elim a 0, Subsingleton.elim b 0, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, transpose_apply, V, of_apply]
      rw [show ∑ k, A k 0 / c * (A k 0 / c) = (A.col 0 ⬝ᵥ A.col 0) / (c * c) by
        rw [dotProduct, Finset.sum_div]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by simp only [col_apply]; ring]
      rw [hc2, div_self ha]
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hWV⟩ := exists_unitary_completion V hV
      ⟨fun _ => 0, fun a b _ => Subsingleton.elim a b⟩
    refine ⟨W, hW, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hA : ∀ k, A k 0 = c * W k 0 := fun k => by
      rw [show W k 0 = V k 0 from hWV k 0]
      simp only [V, of_apply]
      field_simp
    have hWW := congrFun (congrFun (show Wᵀ * W = 1 from hW) i.succ) 0
    rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i), Matrix.mul_apply] at hWW
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp_rw [hA]
    rw [show ∑ k, Wᵀ i.succ k * (c * W k 0) = c * ∑ k, Wᵀ i.succ k * W k 0 by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring, hWW, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.exists_isFullQR
statement:
theorem exists_isFullQR : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ), ∃ Q R, IsFullQR A Q R
  | 0, _, A => ⟨1, A, ⟨by simp, by simp [HasOrthonormalCols], fun i => i.elim0⟩⟩
  | _ + 1, 0, A => ⟨1, A, ⟨by simp, by simp [HasOrthonormalCols], fun _ j => j.elim0⟩⟩
  | _ + 1, _ + 1, A => by
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hB⟩
proof:
:= exists_transpose_mul_apply_succ_zero_eq_zero A
    obtain ⟨Q', R', h'⟩ := exists_isFullQR ((Wᵀ * A).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ)
    exact ⟨_, _, isFullQR_mul_borderedUpper hW hB h'⟩

name: NLAlib.IsQR.eq_of_diag_pos
statement:
theorem IsQR.eq_of_diag_pos {m : Type*} [Fintype m] {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [LinearOrder n]
    {A Q₁ Q₂ : Matrix m n ℝ} {R₁ R₂ : Matrix n n ℝ} (h₁ : IsQR A Q₁ R₁) (h₂ : IsQR A Q₂ R₂)
    (hR₁ : ∀ i, 0 < R₁ i i) (hR₂ : ∀ i, 0 < R₂ i i) : Q₁ = Q₂ ∧ R₁ = R₂
proof:
:= by
  have hd₁ : IsUnit R₁.det := h₁.isUnit_det_iff.2 fun i => (hR₁ i).ne'
  have hd₂ : IsUnit R₂.det := h₂.isUnit_det_iff.2 fun i => (hR₂ i).ne'
  set T := Q₂ᵀ * Q₁ with hTdef
  have hT : T * R₁ = R₂ := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← h₁.eq]
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using h₂.conjTranspose_mul_eq
  have hT' : Tᵀ * R₂ = R₁ := by
    rw [hTdef, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← h₂.eq]
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using h₁.conjTranspose_mul_eq
  have hinv₁ : R₁⁻¹.IsUpperTriangular := by
    have := R₁.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hd₁; exact blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular h₁.upper
  have hinv₂ : R₂⁻¹.IsUpperTriangular := by
    have := R₂.invertibleOfIsUnitDet hd₂; exact blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular h₂.upper
  have hTu : T.IsUpperTriangular := by
    have : T = R₂ * R₁⁻¹ := by
      rw [← hT, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd₁, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [this]; exact h₂.upper.mul hinv₁
  have hTl : Tᵀ.IsUpperTriangular := by
    have : Tᵀ = R₁ * R₂⁻¹ := by
      rw [← hT', Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd₂, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [this]; exact h₁.upper.mul hinv₂
  have hdiag : ∀ i, T i i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have e1 := mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular hTu h₁.upper i
    have e2 := mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular hTl h₂.upper i
    rw [hT] at e1; rw [hT', Matrix.transpose_apply] at e2
    have hpos : 0 < T i i := by
      have := hR₂ i; rw [e1] at this; exact pos_of_mul_pos_left this (hR₁ i).le
    have hsq : T i i * T i i = 1 := by
      have : T i i * T i i * R₁ i i = 1 * R₁ i i := by
        rw [one_mul, mul_assoc, ← e1, ← e2]
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ (hR₁ i).ne' this
    nlinarith
  have hT1 : T = 1 := by
    ext i j
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | rfl | h
    · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne h.ne]
      exact hTl h
    · rw [hdiag, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne h.ne', hTu h]
  have hR : R₁ = R₂ := by rw [← hT, hT1, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, hR⟩
  have hQ : ∀ {Q R}, IsQR A Q R → IsUnit R.det → Q = A * R⁻¹ := fun h hd => by
    rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hQ h₁ hd₁, hQ h₂ hd₂, hR]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_inverse_add_below_matrixKTransform_trace_support
statement:
theorem isUnit_inverse_add_below_matrixKTransform_trace_support
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (G : ℂ → M) (u : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t)
    (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z)
    (hGpos : (G u).PosDef) :
    ∀ T ∈ ν.support, IsUnit ((α⁻¹•G u)⁻¹+T.val)
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℂ → M := fun z => α⁻¹•G z
  let Q : ℂ → M := fun z => (S z)⁻¹
  have hSpos : (S u).PosDef := hGpos.smul (inv_pos.mpr hα)
  have hSa : AnalyticAt ℂ S (u : ℂ) := hGa.const_smul (c := α⁻¹)
  have hQa : AnalyticAt ℂ Q (u : ℂ) := by
    have hh := analyticAt_inverse (𝕜 := ℂ) hSpos.isUnit.unit
    rw [hSpos.isUnit.unit_spec] at hh
    simpa only [Q,Function.comp_def,← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using hh.comp (f := S) hSa
  have hQupper (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : Q z=(F z)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [Q,S,hGN z hz,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
  obtain ⟨C,U,hU,hLip⟩ := hQa.hasStrictDerivAt.hasStrictFDerivAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (u : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I
  have hφ : Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
    have hc : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
    simpa only [φ,Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] using
      (hc.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbound⟩ := exists_uniform_matrixKResolvent_defect_bound_below_trace_support
    ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ u hu
  intro T hT
  apply isUnit_add_of_bounded_inverse_sandwich_boundary
    ((S u)⁻¹) T.val (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hSpos.isUnit) T.property
    (fun y => (F (φ y))⁻¹) α C B hα C.property hB
  filter_upwards [hφ.eventually hU,self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hyp
  have hypos : 0<y := hyp
  have hz : 0<(φ y).im := by simpa [φ] using hypos
  have hFS := (hF (φ y) hz).1
  have hFSunit : IsUnit (F (φ y)) := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hFS
  have hden : IsUnit (1+F (φ y)*T.val) :=
    isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (F (φ y)) T.val hFS T.property
  have hcoercive : (α*y)•(1 : M)≤ -(imaginaryPart ((F (φ y))⁻¹) : M) := by
    have hh := (matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα
      ((φ y)•1) (F (φ y)) hFS (hF (φ y) hz).2).2
    have hIm : (imaginaryPart ((φ y)•(1 : M)) : M)=y•1 := by
      have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
      simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one,φ]
    simpa only [map_neg,NegMemClass.coe_neg,hIm,smul_smul] using hh
  have hdist : ‖φ y-(u : ℂ)‖=y := by
    simp only [φ,add_sub_cancel_left,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg hypos.le]
  have hpert : ‖(F (φ y))⁻¹-(S u)⁻¹‖≤(C : ℝ)*y := by
    rw [← hQupper _ hz]
    simpa only [Q,hdist] using lipschitzOnWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mp hLip hy (mem_of_mem_nhds hU)
  refine ⟨isUnit_inverse_add_of_isUnit_matrixKDenominator _ _ hFSunit hden,
    hcoercive,hpert,?_⟩
  rw [← matrixKResolvent_defect_eq_inverse_sandwich _ _ hFSunit hden]
  exact hbound T hT (φ y) hz (by simp [φ])

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich
statement:
theorem integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (Y : M) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef) :
    Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val)
      ν.support := by
    intro T hT
    have hi : ContinuousAt (fun U : selfAdjoint M => (Y + U.val)⁻¹) T :=
      (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (Y + T.val) (hgap T hT).isUnit).continuousAt.comp
        (f := fun U : selfAdjoint M => Y + U.val)
        (continuous_const.add continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt
    exact ((continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.mul hi).mul
      continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.inverse_concavity_sum_gap
statement:
private theorem inverse_concavity_sum_gap
    (Y Z T : M) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1)
    (hY : (Y + T).PosDef) (hZ : (Z + T).PosDef) :
    (a • Y + b • Z + T).PosDef ∧
      (a • Y + b • Z + T)⁻¹ ≤ a • (Y + T)⁻¹ + b • (Z + T)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have he : a • (Y + T) + b • (Z + T) = a • Y + b • Z + T := by
    calc
      _ = a • Y + b • Z + (a + b) • T := by module
      _ = _ := by rw [hab, one_smul]
  have hp := CStarAlgebra.convexOn_ringInverse.1
    hY.isStrictlyPositive hZ.isStrictlyPositive ha hb hab
  have hi := CStarAlgebra.convexOn_ringInverse.2
    hY.isStrictlyPositive hZ.isStrictlyPositive ha hb hab
  rw [he] at hp hi
  exact ⟨hp.posDef, by simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using hi⟩

name: NLAlib.posDef_add_samples_of_convex_combination
statement:
theorem posDef_add_samples_of_convex_combination
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (Y Z : M)
    (hY : Y.PosDef) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    (a • Y + b • Z).PosDef ∧
      ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (a • Y + b • Z + T.val).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hp := inverse_concavity_sum_gap Y Z 0 ha hb hab
    (by simpa using hY) (by simpa using hZ)
  exact ⟨by simpa only [add_zero] using hp.1,
    fun T hT => (inverse_concavity_sum_gap Y Z T.val ha hb hab (hgapY T hT) (hgapZ T hT)).1⟩

name: NLAlib.smul_add_smul_matrixKTransform_inverse_le
statement:
theorem smul_add_smul_matrixKTransform_inverse_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (Y Z : M) (hY : Y.PosDef) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef)
