    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • matrixKTransform ν α Y⁻¹ + b • matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹ ≤
      matrixKTransform ν α (a • Y + b • Z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let W := a • Y + b • Z
  obtain ⟨hW, hgapW⟩ := posDef_add_samples_of_convex_combination
    ν Y Z hY hZ hgapY hgapZ ha hb hab
  have hiY := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν Y hgapY
  have hiZ := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν Z hgapZ
  have hiW := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν W hgapW
  have hiYa : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => a • (T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val)) ν := hiY.smul a
  have hiZb : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => b • (T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val)) ν := hiZ.smul b
  have hI : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (W + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν) ≤
      a • (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν) +
        b • (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν) := by
    rw [← integral_smul, ← integral_smul, ← integral_add hiYa hiZb]
    apply integral_mono_ae hiW (hiYa.add hiZb)
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    have hinv := (inverse_concavity_sum_gap Y Z T.val ha hb hab (hgapY T hT) (hgapZ T hT)).2
    have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hinv).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hTH.eq, W, Pi.add_apply] using hp
  rw [matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Y hY hgapY,
    matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Z hZ hgapZ,
    matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α W hW hgapW]
  let E := ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν
  let RY := ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν
  let RZ := ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν
  let RW := ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (W + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν
  have hE : a • E + b • E = E := by rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
  change a • (E - RY - α⁻¹ • Y) + b • (E - RZ - α⁻¹ • Z) ≤ E - RW - α⁻¹ • W
  calc
    _ = (a • E + b • E) - (a • RY + b • RZ) - α⁻¹ • W := by dsimp only [W]; module
    _ = E - (a • RY + b • RZ) - α⁻¹ • W := by rw [hE]
    _ ≤ E - RW - α⁻¹ • W := sub_le_sub_right (sub_le_sub_left hI E) _

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (t : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * Real.exp ((H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum)
proof:
:= by
  apply (schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm _ hp).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_sum_norm H hH
    (z := 1 + (t : ℂ) * I) (by simp)

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_sum_norm_le_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right
statement:
theorem exp_neg_sum_norm_le_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right [Nonempty n]
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum) ≤
      schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_le_schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) hp
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm] at h
  exact (exp_neg_sum_norm_le_norm_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH t).trans h

name: NLAlib.abs_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le [Nonempty n]
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (t : ℝ) :
    |Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)| ≤
      (H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum + |Real.log ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p))|
proof:
:= by
  have hl := exp_neg_sum_norm_le_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH hp t
  have hu := schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le H hH hp t
  have hpos : 0 < schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p :=
    (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hl
  have hdim : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos) _
  have hlogl := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hl
  rw [Real.log_exp] at hlogl
  have hlogu := Real.log_le_log hpos hu
  rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hdim) (Real.exp_ne_zero _), Real.log_exp] at hlogu
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)))]
  · linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)))]

name: NLAlib.continuous_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right
statement:
theorem continuous_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right [Nonempty n]
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (orderedMatrixExp H) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun z => (analyticAt_orderedMatrixExp H z).continuousAt)
  apply ((continuous_schattenNormReal hp).comp (hc.comp (by fun_prop))).log
  intro t
  exact ne_of_gt ((Real.exp_pos _).trans_le
    (exp_neg_sum_norm_le_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH hp t))

name: NLAlib.differentiable_schattenDualTestMatrix
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem differentiable_schattenDualTestMatrix
    (U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) (r p : ℝ)
    (w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p w)
proof:
:= by
  let L : (Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    { toFun := fun d => V * Matrix.diagonal d * Uᴴ
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        change V * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => a i + b i) * Uᴴ = _
        rw [← Matrix.diagonal_add, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c d
        simp only [Matrix.diagonal_smul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
          RingHom.id_apply] }
  have hc : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) =>
      schattenDualTestCoefficient r p (w i) z) :=
    differentiable_pi.mpr fun i => differentiable_schattenDualTestCoefficient r p (w i)
  have hL : Differentiable ℂ (fun d : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℂ =>
      V * Matrix.diagonal d * Uᴴ) := by
    convert! L.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiable using 1
  exact hL.comp hc

name: NLAlib.continuous_schattenDualTestMatrix
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_schattenDualTestMatrix
    (U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) (r p : ℝ)
    (w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) :
    Continuous (schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p w)
proof:
:=
  (differentiable_schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p w).continuous

name: NLAlib.specNorm_schattenDualTestMatrix_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenDualTestMatrix,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV,
    specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun i =>
    norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_le_one hr hp (hw i) hz

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_schattenDualTestMatrix_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [← schattenNormReal_one, schattenDualTestMatrix,
    schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose hV hU,
    schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
  simp only [Real.rpow_one, one_div_one]
  simp_rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_left hr hp (hw _) t]
  exact hpower

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_schattenDualTestMatrix_right
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_schattenDualTestMatrix_right
    {U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) {r p q : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q)
    {w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hpower : ∑ i, w i ^ (p / r) = 1) (t : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p w (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) q = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenDualTestMatrix, schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose hV hU,
    schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
  simp_rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_right_rpow hr hpq (hw _) t]
  rw [hpower, Real.one_rpow]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.trace_schattenDualTestMatrix_center_mul
statement:
theorem IsSVD.trace_schattenDualTestMatrix_center_mul
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ}
    (h : IsSVD A U V) {r p : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hpr : r < p) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    ((schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p
      (fun i => singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A (p / r)) (r : ℂ)) * A).trace =
      (schattenNormReal A (p / r) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => (singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A (p / r)) ^ (p / r - 1)
  have hα : 1 < p / r := (one_lt_div hr).mpr hpr
  have hC := schattenNormReal_pos A (lt_trans zero_lt_one hα) hA
  have hdiag : Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) =>
      schattenDualTestCoefficient r p (singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A (p / r)) (r : ℂ)) =
      (rectDiag b : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, ↓reduceIte]
      exact schattenDualTestCoefficient_center hr hpr
        (div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hC.le)
    · have hval : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun he => hij (Fin.ext he)
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, if_neg hval]
  have hcenter : schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p
      (fun i => singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A (p / r)) (r : ℂ) =
      (U * (rectDiag b : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) * Vᴴ)ᴴ := by
    rw [schattenDualTestMatrix, hdiag, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_rectDiag, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hcenter]
  have htr := congrArg star (h.trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose b)
  rw [← Matrix.trace_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal] at htr
  rw [htr]
  have hs := sum_singularValues_mul_normalized_rpow_eq_schattenNormReal A hα hA
  convert! congrArg Complex.ofReal hs using 1

name: NLAlib.real_inner_toEuclideanLin
statement:
theorem real_inner_toEuclideanLin (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) = (quadForm A x.ofLp).re
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, quadForm, dotProduct, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  convert! real_inner_eq_re_inner ℂ (x.ofLp i) ((A *ᵥ x.ofLp) i) using 1
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.real_inner_le_of_selfAdjointPart_le
statement:
theorem real_inner_le_of_selfAdjointPart_le {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {c : ℝ}
    (hA : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ c • 1)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).re_quadForm_nonneg x.ofLp
  have he := quadForm_selfAdjointPart A x.ofLp
  have hn : (star x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp).re = ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
    (norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct x.ofLp).symm
  rw [real_inner_toEuclideanLin]
  change 0 ≤ (quadForm (c • 1 - (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ)) x.ofLp).re at h
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, Complex.sub_re, Complex.real_smul] at h
  change (quadForm A x.ofLp).re ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ 2
  change 0 ≤ ((c : ℂ) * (star x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp)).re -
    (quadForm (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) x.ofLp).re at h
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero] at h
  change 0 ≤ c * (star x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp).re -
    (quadForm (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) x.ofLp).re at h
  rw [he, Complex.ofReal_re, hn] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_of_selfAdjointPart_le
statement:

name: NLAlib.selfAdjointPart_le_matrixLogarithmicNorm
statement:
theorem selfAdjointPart_le_matrixLogarithmicNorm (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ matrixLogarithmicNorm A • 1
proof:
:= by
  have hH : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian :=
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
  have h : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤
      algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (matrixLogarithmicNorm A) :=
    (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hH.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
      (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ hH le_rfl)
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← Complex.coe_smul] using h

name: NLAlib.matrixKCoefficient_eq_sqrt_congruence
statement:
theorem matrixKCoefficient_eq_sqrt_congruence (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) :
    matrixKCoefficient S T = cfc Real.sqrt S * matrixKResolvent S T * cfc Real.sqrt S
proof:
:= by
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt S
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
  have hQR : Q * R = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS
  have hRQ : R * Q = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS
  rw [matrixKResolvent_eq_inv_sqrt_congruence S T hS]
  change _ = Q * (R * matrixKCoefficient S T * R) * Q
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQR, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, hRQ, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_kResolvent_support
proof:
:= by
  intro T hT
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolvent S T.val) T :=
    (continuousAt_matrixKResolvent S T.val (hden T hT)).comp
      (f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (S,T.val))
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt
  exact hc.continuousWithinAt

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixK_kernels
statement:
theorem integrable_matrixK_kernels (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    Integrable (fun T => matrixKResolventDeriv S T.val) ν ∧
    Integrable (fun T => ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)
      (matrixKCoefficient S T.val) (matrixKCoefficient S T.val)) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hden := fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgap T hT)
  have hR := continuousOn_kResolvent_support ν S hden
  have hC : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKCoefficient S T.val) ν.support := by
    simp_rw [matrixKCoefficient_eq_sqrt_congruence S _ hS]
    exact (continuous_const.continuousOn.mul hR).mul continuous_const.continuousOn
  have hRC := ((ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).continuous.comp_continuousOn hR).clm_apply hR
  have hCC := ((ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).continuous.comp_continuousOn hC).clm_apply hC
  have hiR := hRC.neg.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hiC := hCC.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have heq : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rw [IntegrableOn, heq] at hiR hiC
  exact ⟨hiR,hiC⟩

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_apply (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹ * Δ * S⁻¹) -
      ∫ T, T.val * (1 + S * T.val)⁻¹ * Δ * (1 + T.val * S)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (integrable_matrixK_kernels ν hν S hS hgap).1
  unfold matrixKTransformDeriv
  rw [add_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hi Δ]
  simp only [matrixKResolventDeriv, neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply]
  rw [integral_neg]
  have he : (∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ * matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) =
      ∫ T, T.val * (1 + S * T.val)⁻¹ * Δ * (1 + T.val * S)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hHerm : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    nth_rw 2 [matrixKResolvent_eq_right S T.val hS hHerm (hgap T hT)]
    unfold matrixKResolvent
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [he]
  abel

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_exponential_decay_of_lyapunov
statement:
theorem exists_pos_exponential_decay_of_lyapunov {A X : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hX : X.PosDef) (hAX : A * X + X * A.conjTranspose + 1 = 0) :
    ∃ C γ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < γ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ C * Real.exp (-γ * t)
proof:
:= by
  let S := cfc Real.sqrt X
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) X
  let B := R * A * S
  have hS : S.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hSR : S * R = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hX
  have hRS : R * S = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hX
  have hSS : S * S = X := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hX
  have hRX : R * X = S := by rw [← hSS, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hRS, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hXR : X * R = S := by rw [← hSS, Matrix.mul_assoc, hSR, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hi : X⁻¹ = R * R := inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hX
  have hsum : B + B.conjTranspose = -(R * R) := by
    have hAX' : A * X + X * A.conjTranspose = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hAX
    calc
      _ = R * (A * X + X * A.conjTranspose) * R := by
        dsimp [B]
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.eq, hS.eq]
        calc
          _ = R * A * (X * R) + (R * X) * A.conjTranspose * R := by
            rw [hXR, hRX]
            noncomm_ring
          _ = _ := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hAX']; noncomm_ring
  let K : Matrix n n ℂ := -(selfAdjointPart ℝ B : Matrix n n ℂ)
  have hK : K = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • X⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [K]
    rw [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hsum, ← hi]
    simp only [smul_neg, neg_neg, invOf_eq_inv]
  have hKpos : K.PosDef := by rw [hK]; exact hX.inv.smul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2⁻¹)
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hgap⟩ :=
    (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff hKpos.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
      (fun x hx => hKpos.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx)
  have hgap' : γ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ K := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← Complex.coe_smul] using hgap
  have hB : (selfAdjointPart ℝ B : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (-γ) • 1 := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    have hp := Matrix.le_iff.mp hgap'
    convert! hp using 1
    dsimp [K]
    module
  have hinter : S * B = A * S := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hSR, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hExp (t : ℝ) : matrixExp (t • A) = S * matrixExp (t • B) * R := by
    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
    have h : SemiconjBy S (t • B) (t • A) := by
      change S * (t • B) = (t • A) * S
      rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hinter]
    have he := h.exp_right
    change S * matrixExp (t • B) = matrixExp (t • A) * S at he
    calc
      _ = matrixExp (t • A) * (S * R) := by rw [hSR, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = _ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← he]
  refine ⟨1 + specNorm S * specNorm R, γ,
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg zero_lt_one (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)),
    hγ, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hnorm := specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_of_selfAdjointPart_le hB ht
  have hs : specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤
      specNorm S * specNorm (matrixExp (t • B)) * specNorm R := by
    rw [hExp]
    exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
  have heq : t * -γ = -γ * t := mul_comm _ _
  rw [heq] at hnorm
  have hbound := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (specNorm_nonneg S)) (specNorm_nonneg R))
  exact (hs.trans hbound).trans (by nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-γ * t)])

name: NLAlib.IsHurwitz.exists_pos_exponential_decay
statement:
theorem IsHurwitz.exists_pos_exponential_decay {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsHurwitz A) :
    ∃ C γ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < γ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ C * Real.exp (-γ * t)
proof:
:=
  exists_pos_exponential_decay_of_lyapunov
    (posDef_lyapunovCayleySolution A 1 hA Matrix.PosDef.one)
    (lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A 1 hA)

name: NLAlib.abs_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    |specNorm (resolvent A ζ) - specNorm (resolvent B ζ)| ≤
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2 * specNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAr : ζ ∈ resolventSet ℂ A := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) ζ - A)
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
  have hBr : ζ ∈ resolventSet ℂ B := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) ζ - B)
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hB.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (resolvent A ζ - resolvent B ζ) := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le (resolvent A ζ) (resolvent B ζ)
    _ = specNorm (resolvent A ζ * (A - B) * resolvent B ζ) := by
      rw [spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent hAr hBr]
    _ ≤ (specNorm (resolvent A ζ) * specNorm (A - B)) * specNorm (resolvent B ζ) :=
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹ * specNorm (A - B)) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
      exact mul_le_mul
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ) (specNorm_nonneg _))
        (hB.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ) (specNorm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.abs_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem abs_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    |specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ) -
      specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) ζ)| ≤
      (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (D + ∑ i, x i • A i).IsHermitian :=
    hD.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hy : (D + ∑ i, y i • A i).IsHermitian :=
    hD.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hd : (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) - (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) =
      ∑ i, (x i - y i) • A i := by
    simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    abel
  calc
    _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2 * specNorm ((D + ∑ i, x i • A i) - (D + ∑ i, y i • A i)) :=
      abs_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le _ _ hx hy ζ hζ
    _ = (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, (x i - y i) • A i) := by rw [hd]
    _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2 * (σ * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (specNorm_sum_smul_le_of_quadratic_energy A hA hσ henergy (fun i => x i - y i))
        (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.invSquare_scalarShift_le
proof:
:= by
  have hQ2 : (Q*Q).PosDef := by
    apply (show (Q*Q).PosSemidef by
      simpa only [hQ.isHermitian.eq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self Q).posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
    exact hQ.isUnit.mul hQ.isUnit
  have he : (Q+t•1)*(Q+t•1)-Q*Q = (2*t)•Q+(t*t)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.one_mul]
    module
  have hle : Q*Q ≤ (Q+t•1)*(Q+t•1) := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    rw [he]
    exact (hQ.posSemidef.smul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*t)).add
      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul (mul_nonneg ht ht))
  simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse,Matrix.mul_inv_rev] using
    CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hle hQ2.isStrictlyPositive

name: NLAlib.inv_mul_weight_inv_add_smul_le
statement:
theorem inv_mul_weight_inv_add_smul_le (A B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (A+t•B)⁻¹*B*(A+t•B)⁻¹ ≤ A⁻¹*B*A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
  let V := cfc Real.sqrt B
  let Q := R*A*R
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := (posDef_invSqrt_congruence_iff B hB A).mpr hA
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRV : R*V=1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hB
  have hVR : V*R=1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hB
  have hVB : V*V=B := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hB
  have hVi : V⁻¹=R := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hVR
  have hback : V*Q*V=A := sqrt_invSqrt_congruence B hB A
  have hshift : V*(Q+t•1)*V=A+t•B := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,hback,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one,hVB]
  have hInv : (A+t•B)⁻¹=R*(Q+t•1)⁻¹*R := by
    rw [← hshift,Matrix.mul_inv_rev,Matrix.mul_inv_rev,hVi]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hInv0 : A⁻¹=R*Q⁻¹*R := by
    rw [← hback,Matrix.mul_inv_rev,Matrix.mul_inv_rev,hVi]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hRB : R*B*R=1 := by
    rw [← hVB,← Matrix.mul_assoc,hRV,Matrix.one_mul,hVR]
  have hfactor (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
      (R*X*R)*B*(R*X*R)=R*(X*X)*Rᴴ := by
    rw [hR.eq]
    calc
      _ = R*X*(R*B*R)*X*R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hRB]; simp only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hInv,hInv0,hfactor,hfactor]
  have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp (invSquare_scalarShift_le Q hQ ht)).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul] using hp

name: NLAlib.isUnit_aeval_of_normal
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_of_normal (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A)
    (q : ℂ[X]) (hq : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, q.eval z ≠ 0) : IsUnit (aeval A q)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  rw [← cfc_polynomial q A]
  exact (isUnit_cfc_iff _ _ q.continuous.continuousOn).mpr hq

name: NLAlib.cfc_inv_polynomial_mul_polynomial
statement:
theorem cfc_inv_polynomial_mul_polynomial (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (p q : ℂ[X])
    (hq : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, q.eval z ≠ 0) :
    cfc (fun z => (q.eval z)⁻¹ * p.eval z) A = (aeval A q)⁻¹ * aeval A p
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  have hcq : ContinuousOn (fun z => (q.eval z)⁻¹) (spectrum ℂ A) :=
    q.continuous.continuousOn.inv₀ hq
  rw [cfc_mul _ _ A hcq p.continuous.continuousOn, cfc_inv q.eval A hq,
    cfc_polynomial q A, cfc_polynomial p A, ← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_aeval_mul_aeval_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_aeval_mul_aeval_le (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (p q : ℂ[X])
    (hq : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, q.eval z ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖p.eval z / q.eval z‖ ≤ c) :
    specNorm ((aeval A q)⁻¹ * aeval A p) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  rw [← cfc_inv_polynomial_mul_polynomial A hA p q hq, specNorm_eq_norm]
  apply norm_cfc_le hc
  intro z hz
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hbound z hz

name: NLAlib.specNorm_aeval_mul_inv_aeval_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_aeval_mul_inv_aeval_le (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (p q : ℂ[X])
    (hq : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, q.eval z ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖p.eval z / q.eval z‖ ≤ c) :
    specNorm (aeval A p * (aeval A q)⁻¹) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  have hcalc : cfc (fun z => p.eval z / q.eval z) A = aeval A p * (aeval A q)⁻¹ := by
    rw [cfc_map_div p.eval q.eval A hq, cfc_polynomial p A, cfc_polynomial q A,
      ← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  rw [← hcalc, specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact norm_cfc_le hc hbound

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrix_inv
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrix_inv {A : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {A' : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hA : HasDerivAt A A' t)
    (hunit : IsUnit (A t)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => (A x)⁻¹) (-(A t)⁻¹ * A' * (A t)⁻¹) t
proof:
:= by
  rcases hunit with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hi := hasFDerivAt_ringInverse (𝕜 := ℝ) u
  rw [hu] at hi
  have hi' := hi.comp_hasDerivAt t hA
  convert! hi' using 1
  · funext x
    exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse (A x)
  · rw [← hu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, Ring.inverse_unit]
    change -(↑(u⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι ℝ) * A' * (↑(u⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι ℝ) =
      -((↑(u⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι ℝ) * A' * (↑(u⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι ℝ))
    simp only [neg_mul]

name: NLAlib.trace_power_derivative_sum
statement:
theorem trace_power_derivative_sum (C B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, C ^ (n.pred - i) * B * C ^ i) =
      (n : ℝ) * Matrix.trace (B * C ^ (n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n; simp
  · rw [Matrix.trace_sum]
    have hterm (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Finset.range n) :
        Matrix.trace (C ^ (n.pred - i) * B * C ^ i) =
          Matrix.trace (B * C ^ (n - 1)) := by
      rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm (C ^ (n.pred - i) * B) (C ^ i),
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (C ^ i * C ^ (n.pred - i)) B,
        ← pow_add]
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
      rw [show i + (n - 1 - i) = n - 1 by omega]
    calc _ = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, Matrix.trace (B * C ^ (n - 1)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi; exact hterm i hi
      _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_pow
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_pow {A : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {A' : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hA : HasDerivAt A A' t) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => Matrix.trace (A x ^ n))
      ((n : ℝ) * Matrix.trace (A' * A t ^ (n - 1))) t
proof:
:= by
  let tr : Matrix ι ι ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Matrix.traceLinearMap ι ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t tr).clm_apply (hA.fun_pow' n)
  simp only [_root_.zero_apply, zero_add] at htrace
  convert! htrace using 1
  · exact (trace_power_derivative_sum (A t) A' n).symm

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow {A : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {A' : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hA : HasDerivAt A A' t)
    (hunit : IsUnit (A t)) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => Matrix.trace ((A x)⁻¹ ^ n))
      (-(n : ℝ) * Matrix.trace ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * A')) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_pow (hasDerivAt_matrix_inv hA hunit) n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simpa [hn] using h
  · have htrace : Matrix.trace ((-(A t)⁻¹ * A' * (A t)⁻¹) * (A t)⁻¹ ^ (n - 1)) =
        -Matrix.trace ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * A') := by
      simp only [neg_mul, Matrix.trace_neg]
      rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle ((A t)⁻¹ * A') (A t)⁻¹ ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n - 1)),
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n - 1) * (A t)⁻¹) A' (A t)⁻¹,
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', ← pow_succ]
      rw [show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega]
    rw [htrace] at h
    simpa only [mul_neg, neg_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.trace_inv_power_derivative_sum
statement:
theorem trace_inv_power_derivative_sum (R B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      R ^ ((n + 1).pred - i) * (-R * B * R) * R ^ i) * B) =
      -∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        Matrix.trace (R ^ (n - i + 1) * B * R ^ (i + 1) * B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Nat.pred_succ, neg_mul, mul_neg, Matrix.trace_neg]
  apply congrArg (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℝ => -Matrix.trace M)
  calc R ^ (n - i) * (R * B * R) * R ^ i * B
      = (R ^ (n - i) * R) * B * (R * R ^ i) * B := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_succ, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_mul
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_mul {A D : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {D' : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hA : HasDerivAt A (D t) t)
    (hD : HasDerivAt D D' t) (hunit : IsUnit (A t)) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => Matrix.trace ((A x)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * D x))
      ((-∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Matrix.trace ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n - i + 1) *
        D t * (A t)⁻¹ ^ (i + 1) * D t)) + Matrix.trace ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * D')) t
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := (hasDerivAt_matrix_inv hA hunit).fun_pow' (n + 1)
  let tr : Matrix ι ι ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Matrix.traceLinearMap ι ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t tr).clm_apply (hpow.mul hD)
  simp only [_root_.zero_apply, zero_add] at htrace
  convert! htrace using 1
  · simp only [tr, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap']
    change _ = Matrix.trace (_ + _)
    rw [Matrix.trace_add, trace_inv_power_derivative_sum]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_mul_const
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_mul_const (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hunit : IsUnit (A + t • B)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => Matrix.trace ((A + x • B)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * B))
      (-∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        Matrix.trace ((A + t • B)⁻¹ ^ (n - i + 1) * B *
          (A + t • B)⁻¹ ^ (i + 1) * B)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hline : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => A + x • B) B t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const B).const_add A
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.trace_zero, add_zero] using
    hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_mul hline (hasDerivAt_const t B) hunit n

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_first
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_first (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hunit : IsUnit (A + t • B)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => -(n : ℝ) * Matrix.trace ((A + x • B)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * B))
      ((n : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        Matrix.trace ((A + t • B)⁻¹ ^ (n - i + 1) * B *
          (A + t • B)⁻¹ ^ (i + 1) * B)) t
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg] using
    (hasDerivAt_matrix_trace_inv_pow_mul_const A B n t hunit).const_mul (-(n : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.inverseVariable_integrable_continuous
statement:
private theorem inverseVariable_integrable_continuous
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    {f : selfAdjoint M → M} (hf : Continuous f) : Integrable f ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_sub_hermitian
statement:
private theorem imaginaryPart_sub_hermitian (X T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    (imaginaryPart (X-T) : M)=(imaginaryPart X : M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.inverseVariable_sub_isUnit
statement:
private theorem inverseVariable_sub_isUnit (X T : M)
    (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian) : IsUnit (X-T)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
  rwa [imaginaryPart_sub_hermitian X T hT]

name: NLAlib.posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse
statement:
theorem posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse (X : M)
    (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) : (imaginaryPart (-X⁻¹) : M).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hX
  have hXu : IsUnit (-X⁻¹) := (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hu).neg
  have hXs : IsUnit (-X⁻¹)ᴴ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hXu.star
  have he : X*(-X⁻¹)= -1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  rw [Matrix.imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one he]
  have hp := (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hXs).mpr hX
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hp

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_neg_inverse_eq
statement:
theorem matrixKResolvent_neg_inverse_eq (X T : M)
    (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    matrixKResolvent (-X⁻¹) T=T+T*(X-T)⁻¹*T
proof:
:= by
  have hXu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hX
  have hAu := inverseVariable_sub_isUnit X T hX hT
  have hD : 1+(-X⁻¹)*T=X⁻¹*(X-T) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hXu)]
    simp only [Matrix.neg_mul,sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hDi : (1+(-X⁻¹)*T)⁻¹=(X-T)⁻¹*X := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    calc
      _ = X⁻¹*((X-T)*(X-T)⁻¹)*X := by rw [hD]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hAu),
          Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hXu)]
  rw [matrixKResolvent,hDi,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  calc
    _ = T*((X-T)⁻¹*((X-T)+T)) := congrArg (fun Y => T*((X-T)⁻¹*Y)) (by abel)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_add,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hAu),Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.continuous_inverseVariable_resolvent
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro T
  exact (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (X-T.val)
    (inverseVariable_sub_isUnit X T.val hX T.property)).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun T : selfAdjoint M => X-T.val)
      (continuous_const.sub continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (X : M) (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransform ν α (-X⁻¹)=
      (∫ T, T.val ∂ν)+(∫ T, T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)+α⁻¹•X
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hX
  have hiX : (-X⁻¹)⁻¹= -X := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.mul_neg,neg_neg,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  have hiT : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val) ν :=
    inverseVariable_integrable_continuous ν hν continuous_subtype_val
  have hiR : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val) ν :=
    inverseVariable_integrable_continuous ν hν
      ((continuous_subtype_val.mul (continuous_inverseVariable_resolvent X hX)).mul
        continuous_subtype_val)
  have hker : (∫ T, matrixKResolvent (-X⁻¹) T.val ∂ν)=
      (∫ T, T.val ∂ν)+(∫ T, T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν) := by
    rw [← integral_add hiT hiR]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ fun T => matrixKResolvent_neg_inverse_eq X T.val hX T.property
  rw [matrixKTransform,hker,hiX,smul_neg,sub_neg_eq_add]

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq_iff_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq_iff_fixedPoint
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α≠0) (Z X : M) (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransform ν α (-X⁻¹)=Z ↔ X=matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq ν hν α X hX]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun Y : M => α•Y) h
    simp only [smul_add,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα,one_smul] at he
    unfold matrixKInverseVariableMap
    rw [smul_sub,smul_sub,← he]
    abel
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun Y : M => α⁻¹•Y) h
    simp only [matrixKInverseVariableMap,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα,one_smul] at he
    rw [he]
    abel

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inverseVariable_resolvent_le_inv
statement:
theorem specNorm_inverseVariable_resolvent_le_inv
    (X T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hX : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M)) :
    specNorm ((X-T)⁻¹)≤η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hXpos : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef :=
    ((Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hη).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hX).posDef
  have hu := inverseVariable_sub_isUnit X T hXpos hT
  have he : (X-T)*(-(X-T)⁻¹)= -1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  have hc : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart (X-T) : M) := by
    rwa [imaginaryPart_sub_hermitian X T hT]
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,norm_neg] using
    Matrix.norm_le_inv_of_mul_eq_neg_one_of_imaginaryPart_ge hη he hc

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_hermitian_sandwich
statement:
private theorem imaginaryPart_hermitian_sandwich (T R : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    (imaginaryPart (T*R*T) : M)=T*(imaginaryPart R : M)*T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul]
  congr 1
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.le_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap
statement:
theorem le_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (Z X : M) (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) :
    α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)≤(imaginaryPart (matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X) : M)
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hL (Y : M) : L Y=(imaginaryPart Y : M) := rfl
  let f (T : selfAdjoint M) := T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val
  have hiT : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val) ν :=
    inverseVariable_integrable_continuous ν hν continuous_subtype_val
  have hif : Integrable f ν := inverseVariable_integrable_continuous ν hν
    ((continuous_subtype_val.mul (continuous_inverseVariable_resolvent X hX)).mul
      continuous_subtype_val)
  have hmean : L (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)=0 := by
    rw [← L.integral_comp_comm hiT]
    have hz (T : selfAdjoint M) : L T.val=0 := by
      rw [hL]
      have hh : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
      simp only [hh.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
    simp_rw [hz]
    exact integral_zero _ _
  have hnonpos (T : selfAdjoint M) : L (f T)≤0 := by
    have hA : (imaginaryPart (X-T.val) : M).PosDef := by
      rwa [imaginaryPart_sub_hermitian X T.val T.property]
    have hR := (posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse (X-T.val) hA).posSemidef
    have hT : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    have hsand : (-(imaginaryPart (f T) : M)).PosSemidef := by
      change (-(imaginaryPart (T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val) : M)).PosSemidef
      rw [imaginaryPart_hermitian_sandwich T.val (X-T.val)⁻¹ hT]
      have he : (imaginaryPart (-(X-T.val)⁻¹) : M)=
          -(imaginaryPart ((X-T.val)⁻¹) : M) := by rw [map_neg]; rfl
      rw [he] at hR
      simpa only [hT.eq,Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.neg_mul] using
        hR.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    rw [hL]
    exact neg_nonneg.mp (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr hsand)
  have hI : L (∫ T,f T ∂ν)≤0 := by
    rw [← L.integral_comp_comm hif]
    exact integral_nonpos_of_ae (ae_of_all _ hnonpos)
  have he : (imaginaryPart (matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X) : M)-
      α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)= -(α•L (∫ T,f T ∂ν)) := by
    change L (α•(Z-(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-(∫ T,f T ∂ν)))-α•L Z=_
    rw [map_smul,map_sub,map_sub,hmean,sub_zero]
    module
  apply sub_nonneg.mp
  rw [he]
  exact neg_nonneg.mpr (smul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hα hI)

name: NLAlib.half_smul_inverseCayley_add_inv
statement:
theorem half_smul_inverseCayley_add_inv (T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hm : IsUnit (1-T)) (hp : IsUnit (1+T)) :
    (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (inverseCayley T + (inverseCayley T)⁻¹) = inverseCayley (T^2)
proof:
:= by
  let R := bicommutantAlgebra T
  let t : R := ⟨T, self_mem_bicommutantAlgebra T⟩
  let d : R := bicommutantInverse (1-t)
  let e : R := bicommutantInverse (1+t)
  let c : R := algebraMap ℂ R ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hd : (1-t)*d=1 := Subtype.ext (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hm))
  have he : (1+t)*e=1 := Subtype.ext (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hp))
  have hc : c*2=1 := by
    change algebraMap ℂ R ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) * algebraMap ℂ R 2 = 1
    rw [← map_mul]
    norm_num
  have hxi : (inverseCayley T)⁻¹ = (e*(1-t) : R).val := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (CommRing.cayley_value_mul_inverse t d e hd he)
  have hdi : (1-T^2)⁻¹ = (d*e : R).val := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (CommRing.one_sub_sq_mul_inverse_product t d e hd he)
  have hh := congrArg Subtype.val (CommRing.half_mul_cayley_add_inverse t d e c hd he hc)
  rw [hxi]
  change (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((1-T)⁻¹*(1+T)+(e*(1-t) : R).val) = (1-T^2)⁻¹*(1+T^2)
  rw [hdi]
  simpa [c, d, e, t, bicommutantInverse, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.smul_mul] using hh

name: NLAlib.tendsto_neg_matrix_pow_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero] at h ⊢
  have he (k : ℕ) : ‖(-T)^k‖=‖T^k‖ := by
    by_cases hk : Even k
    · rw [hk.neg_pow]
    · rw [(Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hk).neg_pow, norm_neg]
  simpa only [he] using h

name: NLAlib.isUnit_one_sub_and_add_matrix_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (T^m)^k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => m*k) atTop atTop := by
      simpa using (tendsto_id.nsmul_atTop hm : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => m • k) atTop atTop)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, pow_mul] using h.comp ht
  constructor
  · exact isUnit_one_sub_of_matrix_spectralRadius_lt_one
      (spectralRadius_lt_one_of_tendsto_matrix_pow_zero hp)
  · simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using isUnit_one_sub_of_matrix_spectralRadius_lt_one
      (spectralRadius_lt_one_of_tendsto_matrix_pow_zero (tendsto_neg_matrix_pow_zero hp))

name: NLAlib.isUnit_inverseCayley
statement:
theorem isUnit_inverseCayley {T : Matrix n n ℂ}

name: NLAlib.inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord
statement:
theorem inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord (ζ : ℂ) (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ i, |((mixedResolventWord (n := n) ζ p) i).1.im|⁻¹ = |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp only [mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_left]
  · simp only [mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_right, Complex.star_def,
      Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]

name: NLAlib.prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one
statement:
theorem prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one (ζ : ℂ) (p : ℕ) :
    (∏ i, ‖((mixedResolventWord (n := n) ζ p) i).2‖) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_le_one (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
  intro i _
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
  · simpa only [mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_left, specNorm_eq_norm] using (specNorm_one_le (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))
  · simpa only [mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_right, specNorm_eq_norm] using (specNorm_one_le (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le_word
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le_word
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p k : ℕ) (y : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) y‖ ≤
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (mixedResolventWord ζ p)) y‖
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [T, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_restrictScalars] using
      (norm_toContinuousLinearMap_normalizedTraceLinearMap_le_one (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))
  have hc := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA
    (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) (r := ⊤)
  have heq : (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) =
        T ∘ hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (mixedResolventWord ζ p) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, T, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
      LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
      hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed]
  rw [heq]
  exact (T.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hc.contDiffAt (by simp)).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq (one_mul _))

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (y : E) :
    ‖normalizedTrace (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p *
      resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA (mixedResolventWord ζ p)
    (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _))
    (fun i => (inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord ζ p i).le) y
  have ht := norm_iteratedFDeriv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le_word
    A hA ζ hζ p 0 y
  simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at ht
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := ht.trans hb
    _ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (p + p) * 1 := by
      gcongr
      exact prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one (n := n) ζ p
    _ = _ := by rw [two_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (y : E) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) y‖ ≤
        (2 * p : ℕ) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 1) * ‖L‖
proof:
:= by
  have hb := norm_fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA (mixedResolventWord ζ p)
    (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _))
    (fun i => (inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord ζ p i).le) y
  have ht := norm_iteratedFDeriv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le_word
    A hA ζ hζ p 1 y
  simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at ht
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := ht.trans hb
    _ ≤ ((p + p : ℕ) : ℝ) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (p + p + 1) * 1 * ‖L‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one (n := n) ζ p
    _ = _ := by simp only [two_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (y : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) y‖ ≤
        (2 * p : ℕ) * (2 * p + 1 : ℕ) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 2) * ‖L‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb := norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA
    (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) (fun i => (inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord ζ p i).le) y
  have ht := norm_iteratedFDeriv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le_word
    A hA ζ hζ p 2 y
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := ht.trans hb
    _ ≤ ((p + p : ℕ) : ℝ) * (p + p + 1) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (p + p + 2) * 1 * ‖L‖ ^ 2 := by
      gcongr <;> first
      | exact prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one (n := n) ζ p
      | norm_num
    _ = _ := by simp only [two_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (y : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) y‖ ≤
        (2 * p : ℕ) * (2 * p + 1 : ℕ) * (2 * p + 2 : ℕ) *
          |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 3) * ‖L‖ ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hb := norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA
    (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) (fun i => (inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord ζ p i).le) y
  have ht := norm_iteratedFDeriv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le_word
    A hA ζ hζ p 3 y
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := ht.trans hb
    _ ≤ ((p + p : ℕ) : ℝ) * (p + p + 1) * (p + p + 2) *
        |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (p + p + 3) * 1 * ‖L‖ ^ 3 := by
      gcongr <;> first
      | exact prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one (n := n) ζ p
      | norm_num
    _ = _ := by simp only [two_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply_le
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    (y : E) (h : Fin 3 → E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) y h‖ ≤
      ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p + 3) * ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [T, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_restrictScalars] using
      (norm_toContinuousLinearMap_normalizedTraceLinearMap_le_one (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))
  have hc := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA
    (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) (r := ⊤)
  have heq : (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) =
        T ∘ hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (mixedResolventWord ζ p) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, T, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
      LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
      hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed]
  rw [heq, T.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hc.contDiffAt (by simp)]
  change ‖T (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3
    (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (mixedResolventWord ζ p)) y h)‖ ≤ _
  have hb := norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply_le A hA
    (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) (fun i => (inv_abs_im_mixedResolventWord ζ p i).le) y h
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3
        (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (mixedResolventWord ζ p)) y h‖ :=
      (T.le_opNorm _).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq (one_mul _))
    _ ≤ _ := hb
    _ ≤ ((p + p : ℕ) : ℝ) * (p + p + 1) * (p + p + 2) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (p + p + 3) *
        1 * ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖ := by
      gcongr <;> first
      | exact prod_norm_snd_mixedResolventWord_le_one (n := n) ζ p
      | norm_num
    _ = _ := by simp only [two_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.norm_resolvent_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.norm_resolvent_mul_lt_one
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : specNorm H < |z.im|) :
    ‖resolvent A z * H‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < |z.im| := abs_pos.mpr hz
  calc
    ‖resolvent A z * H‖ ≤ specNorm (resolvent A z) * specNorm H := norm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ |z.im|⁻¹ * specNorm H :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hz) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ < |z.im|⁻¹ * |z.im| := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hH (inv_pos.mpr hpos)
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne'

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.hasSum_resolvent_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.hasSum_resolvent_add
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : specNorm H < |z.im|) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (resolvent A z * H) ^ k * resolvent A z)
      (resolvent (A + H) z)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : z ∈ resolventSet ℂ A := by
    simpa only [spectrum.mem_resolventSet_iff, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz
  exact spectrum.hasSum_resolvent_add_of_norm_mul_lt_one hu
    (hA.norm_resolvent_mul_lt_one hz hH)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.summable_norm_resolvent_add_series
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.summable_norm_resolvent_add_series
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : specNorm H < |z.im|) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖(resolvent A z * H) ^ k * resolvent A z‖)
proof:
:=
  spectrum.summable_norm_resolvent_add_series (hA.norm_resolvent_mul_lt_one hz hH)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.summable_norm_and_hasSum_resolventWord_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.summable_norm_and_hasSum_resolventWord_add
    {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (w : Fin m → ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ) (hw : ∀ j, (w j).1.im ≠ 0)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : ∀ j, specNorm H < |(w j).1.im|) :
    Summable (fun t : Fin m → ℕ =>
      ‖(List.ofFn (fun j =>
        (resolvent A (w j).1 * H) ^ (t j) * resolvent A (w j).1 * (w j).2)).prod‖) ∧
    HasSum (fun t : Fin m → ℕ =>
      (List.ofFn (fun j =>
        (resolvent A (w j).1 * H) ^ (t j) * resolvent A (w j).1 * (w j).2)).prod)
      (List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A + H) (w j).1 * (w j).2)).prod
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin m → ℕ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun j k =>
    (resolvent A (w j).1 * H) ^ k * resolvent A (w j).1 * (w j).2
  let x : Fin m → Matrix n n ℂ := fun j => resolvent (A + H) (w j).1 * (w j).2
  have hs : ∀ j, HasSum (f j) (x j) := by
    intro j
    exact (hA.hasSum_resolvent_add (hw j) (hH j)).mul_right (w j).2
  have hn : ∀ j, Summable (fun k => ‖f j k‖) := by
    intro j
    have ht := (hA.summable_norm_resolvent_add_series (hw j) (hH j)).mul_right ‖(w j).2‖
    exact ht.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ => norm_mul_le _ _)
  exact ⟨summable_norm_list_prod_of_summable_norm f hn,
    hasSum_list_prod_of_summable_norm f x hs hn⟩

name: NLAlib.loewnerDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem loewnerDerivative_apply (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    loewnerDerivative f ev U H = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      ((loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal ⊙
        ((U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * H * U)) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.frechetDerivative_eq_loewnerDerivative
statement:
theorem frechetDerivative_eq_loewnerDerivative (p : ℝ[X]) (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) : p.frechetDerivative A = loewnerDerivative p.eval ev U
proof:
:= by
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) U
  have hU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose = 1 :=
    Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro H
  let K := (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * H * U
  have hK : E K = H := by
    change (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * ((U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * H * U) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose = H
    calc
      _ = ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) * H *
        ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = H := by rw [hU, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hEA : E (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) = A := hA.symm
  calc
    _ = E (p.frechetDerivative (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) K) := by
      have hm : E (p.frechetDerivative (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) K) =
          p.frechetDerivative (E (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)))) (E K) :=
        Polynomial.map_frechetDerivative_apply E.toAlgEquiv.toAlgHom p _ K
      rw [hEA, hK] at hm
      exact hm.symm
    _ = E (Matrix.of (fun i j =>
        (((p.dividedDifference (ev i)).eval (ev j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * K i j)) := by
      rw [frechetDerivative_diagonal_apply]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [loewnerDerivative_apply]
      change (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * _ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose = _
      congr 2
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.hadamard_apply, Matrix.map_apply, loewnerMatrix,
        dslope_polynomial_eq_eval_dividedDifference]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.loewnerDerivative_eq_of_values_deriv
statement:
theorem loewnerDerivative_eq_of_values_deriv (p : ℝ[X]) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hv : ∀ i, p.eval (ev i) = f (ev i))
    (hd : ∀ i, p.derivative.eval (ev i) = deriv f (ev i)) :
    loewnerDerivative p.eval ev U = loewnerDerivative f ev U
proof:
:= by
  have heq : loewnerMatrix p.eval ev = loewnerMatrix f ev := by
    ext i j
    change dslope p.eval (ev i) (ev j) = dslope f (ev i) (ev j)
    by_cases hij : ev i = ev j
    · rw [hij, dslope_same, dslope_same, (p.hasDerivAt (ev j)).deriv, hd]
    · rw [dslope_of_ne _ (Ne.symm hij), dslope_of_ne _ (Ne.symm hij)]
      simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, hv]
  ext H
  simp only [loewnerDerivative_apply, heq]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (x : J → ℝ) :
    (hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  change ((selfAdjointPart ℝ (matrixRealCoordinates.symm x) : selfAdjoint M) : M).IsHermitian
  have h : IsSelfAdjoint ((selfAdjointPart ℝ (matrixRealCoordinates.symm x) : selfAdjoint M) : M) :=
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ (matrixRealCoordinates.symm x)).property
  exact h.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates
    {A : M} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (matrixRealCoordinates A) = A
proof:
:= by
  change (selfAdjointPart ℝ (matrixRealCoordinates.symm (matrixRealCoordinates A)) : M) = A
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact hA.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ

name: NLAlib.sum_matrixRealCoordinates_smul_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem sum_matrixRealCoordinates_smul_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates
    {A : M} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ j : J, matrixRealCoordinates A j •
      hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (Pi.single j 1)) = A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← map_smul]
  rw [← map_sum]
  have he : (∑ j : J, matrixRealCoordinates A j • Pi.single j (1 : ℝ)) =
      matrixRealCoordinates A := by
    ext k
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  rw [he]
  exact hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p L : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hL : 2 * p - 1 ≤ L) :
    (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ L)).re ≤
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (L - (2 * p - 1)) *
        resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_le_pow_mul_moment_rpow
    (resolvent A ζ) (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ)
    (k := 2 * p - 1) (j := 2 * p) (by omega) (by omega) hL
  rw [re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul] at h
  simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, resolventEvenMoment] using h

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_two_mul_add_three_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_two_mul_add_three_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (ell : ℕ) :
    (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ (2 * p + 3 + ell))).re ≤
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (4 + ell) *
        resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [show 2 * p + 3 + ell - (2 * p - 1) = 4 + ell by omega] using
    hA.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_le hζ hp (L := 2 * p + 3 + ell) (by omega)

name: NLAlib.trace_sandwich_power_rotate
statement:
private theorem trace_sandwich_power_rotate
    (R S H : M) (hRS : Commute R S) (u v b : ℕ) :
    (R^u*(R*H*R)*R^v*S^b).trace=(H*R^(u+v+2)*S^b).trace
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (R^(u+1)*(H*R^(v+1)*S^b)).trace := by
      congr 1
      rw [pow_succ R u,pow_succ' R v]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = ((H*R^(v+1)*S^b)*R^(u+1)).trace := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
    _ = (H*R^(v+1)*(R^(u+1)*S^b)).trace := by
      congr 1
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [(hRS.symm.pow_pow b (u+1)).eq]
    _ = (H*R^((v+1)+(u+1))*S^b).trace := by
      congr 1
      simp only [pow_add,Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [show (v+1)+(u+1)=u+v+2 by omega]

name: NLAlib.trace_left_power_sandwich_rotate
statement:
private theorem trace_left_power_sandwich_rotate
    (R S H : M) (hRS : Commute R S) (a u v : ℕ) :
    (R^a*(S^u*(S*H*S)*S^v)).trace=(H*R^a*S^(u+v+2)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm,trace_sandwich_power_rotate S R H hRS.symm]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [(hRS.symm.pow_pow (u+v+2) a).eq]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_trace_mixed_powers_of_sandwich
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_trace_mixed_powers_of_sandwich
    {R S : ℝ → M} {t : ℝ} (H : M)
    (hR : HasDerivAt R (R t*H*R t) t)
    (hS : HasDerivAt S (S t*H*S t) t)
    (hRS : Commute (R t) (S t)) (a b : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (R u^a*S u^b).trace)
      ((a : ℝ) • (H*R t^(a+1)*S t^b).trace+
       (b : ℝ) • (H*R t^a*S t^(b+1)).trace) t
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ := (Matrix.traceLinearMap d ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have ht := T.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t ((hR.fun_pow' a).mul (hS.fun_pow' b))
  have ha : ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, R t^(a.pred-i)*(R t*H*R t)*R t^i)*S t^b).trace=
      (a : ℝ) • (H*R t^(a+1)*S t^b).trace := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul,Matrix.trace_sum]
    have hh (i : ℕ) (hi : i∈Finset.range a) :
        (R t^(a.pred-i)*(R t*H*R t)*R t^i*S t^b).trace=
          (H*R t^(a+1)*S t^b).trace := by
      rw [trace_sandwich_power_rotate _ _ _ hRS]
      rw [show a.pred-i+i+2=a+1 by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi; simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]; omega]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hh]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul,Complex.real_smul]
  have hb : (R t^a*(∑ i ∈ Finset.range b, S t^(b.pred-i)*(S t*H*S t)*S t^i)).trace=
      (b : ℝ) • (H*R t^a*S t^(b+1)).trace := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,Matrix.trace_sum]
    have hh (i : ℕ) (hi : i∈Finset.range b) :
        (R t^a*(S t^(b.pred-i)*(S t*H*S t)*S t^i)).trace=
          (H*R t^a*S t^(b+1)).trace := by
      rw [trace_left_power_sandwich_rotate _ _ _ hRS]
      rw [show b.pred-i+i+2=b+1 by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi; simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]; omega]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hh]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul,Complex.real_smul]
  simpa only [T,Function.comp_def,LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
    Matrix.traceLinearMap_apply,Matrix.trace_add,Pi.mul_apply,Pi.pow_apply,ha,hb] using ht

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_curve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_curve
    {X : ℝ → M} {H : M} {t : ℝ} (hX : HasDerivAt X H t)
    (hXt : (X t).IsHermitian) (ζ ω : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (hω : ω.im≠0)
    (a b : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => normalizedTrace (resolvent (X u) ζ^a*resolvent (X u) ω^b))
      ((a : ℝ) • normalizedTrace (H*resolvent (X t) ζ^(a+1)*resolvent (X t) ω^b)+
       (b : ℝ) • normalizedTrace (H*resolvent (X t) ζ^a*resolvent (X t) ω^(b+1))) t
proof:
:= by
  have hR : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => resolvent (X u) ζ)
      (resolvent (X t) ζ*H*resolvent (X t) ζ) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars'] using
      (((hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian ζ (X t) hXt hζ).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt t hX)
  have hS : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => resolvent (X u) ω)
      (resolvent (X t) ω*H*resolvent (X t) ω) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars'] using
      (((hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian ω (X t) hXt hω).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt t hX)
  have ht := hasDerivAt_trace_mixed_powers_of_sandwich H hR hS
    (commute_resolvent (X t) ζ ω) a b
  simpa only [normalizedTrace,mul_add,mul_smul_comm] using
    ht.const_mul (Fintype.card d : ℂ)⁻¹

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_of_sandwich
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_of_sandwich
    {R S : ℝ → M} {t : ℝ} (H : M)
    (hR : HasDerivAt R (R t*H*R t) t)
    (hS : HasDerivAt S (S t*H*S t) t) (a b : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => R u^a*S u^b)
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, R t^(a-i)*H*R t^(i+1)*S t^b)+
       ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, R t^a*S t^(b-j)*H*S t^(j+1)) t
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (hR.fun_pow' a).mul (hS.fun_pow' b)
  apply ht.congr_deriv
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply congrArg₂ (fun U V : M => U+V)
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i<a := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    rw [show a-i=(a.pred-i)+1 by simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]; omega,
      pow_succ (R t) (a.pred-i),pow_succ' (R t) i]
    noncomm_ring
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj' : j<b := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    rw [show b-j=(b.pred-j)+1 by simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]; omega,
      pow_succ (S t) (b.pred-j),pow_succ' (S t) j]
    noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.posDef_map_of_positive_unital
statement:
theorem posDef_map_of_positive_unital
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) (hΦ : Φ 1 = 1)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) : (Φ A).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hA1 : A = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hA1, hΦ]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one
  | inr hn =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcA⟩ :=
      (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff hA.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
        (fun x hx => hA.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx)
    have hgap := Φ.monotone hcA
    have hmap : Φ (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) c) =
        c • (1 : Matrix m m ℂ) := by
      simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← Complex.coe_smul, map_smul, hΦ]
    change Φ (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) c) ≤ Φ A at hgap
    rw [hmap] at hgap
    have hp := (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hc).add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hgap)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hp

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_reciprocal_fromBlocks
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℂ := Real.sqrt t
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by dsimp [a]; exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht).ne'
  have haa : a * a = (t : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact_mod_cast Real.mul_self_sqrt ht.le
  have hstar : star a = a := by simp [a]
  have hstari : star (a⁻¹) = a⁻¹ := by simp [a]
  have hi : a⁻¹ * a⁻¹ = (t : ℂ)⁻¹ := by rw [← _root_.mul_inv_rev, haa]
  simpa only [hstar, hstari, haa, hi, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul] using posSemidef_scalar_gram_fromBlocks hB a a⁻¹

name: NLAlib.inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector
statement:
theorem inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hu : IsUnit A) :
    A⁻¹ = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)⁻¹ •
      unitarySpectralProjector hA.eigenvectorUnitary i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    A⁻¹ = Ring.inverse A := Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse A
    _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) A :=
      (cfc_ringInverse_id (R := ℝ) A hu hA).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [cfc_eq_sum_smul_unitarySpectralProjector hA]
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_inv]

name: NLAlib.posDef_map_and_inv_le_map_inv
statement:
theorem posDef_map_and_inv_le_map_inv
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) (hΦ : Φ 1 = 1)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (Φ A).PosDef ∧ (Φ A)⁻¹ ≤ Φ A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hΦA := posDef_map_of_positive_unital Φ hΦ hA
  refine ⟨hΦA, ?_⟩
  let P := unitarySpectralProjector hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let B : n → Matrix m m ℂ := fun i => Φ (P i)
  let ev : n → ℝ := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  have hB (i : n) : (B i).PosSemidef := posSemidef_map_unitarySpectralProjector Φ _ i
  have hsum : ∑ i, B i = 1 := by
    dsimp [B, P]
    rw [← map_sum, sum_unitarySpectralProjector, hΦ]
  have hfirst : ∑ i, (ev i : ℂ) • B i = Φ A := by
    rw [sum_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector hA.isHermitian, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rfl
  have hsecond : ∑ i, (ev i : ℂ)⁻¹ • B i = Φ A⁻¹ := by
    rw [inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector hA.isHermitian hA.isUnit,
      map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rfl
  have hblocks (i : n) :
      (fromBlocks ((ev i : ℂ) • B i) (B i) (B i) ((ev i : ℂ)⁻¹ • B i)).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_reciprocal_fromBlocks (hB i) (hA.eigenvalues_pos i)
  have hH := Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hblocks i)
  have heq : (∑ i, fromBlocks ((ev i : ℂ) • B i) (B i) (B i)
      ((ev i : ℂ)⁻¹ • B i)) =
      fromBlocks (∑ i, (ev i : ℂ) • B i) (∑ i, B i) (∑ i, B i)
        (∑ i, (ev i : ℂ)⁻¹ • B i) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Matrix.sum_apply, fromBlocks]
  rw [heq, hsum, hfirst, hsecond] at hH
  let : Invertible (Φ A) := hΦA.isUnit.invertible
  have h := (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ (1 : Matrix m m ℂ) (Φ A⁻¹) hΦA).mp
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_one] using hH)
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one] using h)

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_matrixKStabilityMap
statement:
theorem posSemidef_matrixKStabilityMap
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    {P : Matrix n n ℂ} (hP : P.PosSemidef) :
    (matrixKStabilityMap ν α S P).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKStabilityMap_apply ν hν α S hS hgap P]
  apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
  apply smul_nonneg hα
  apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
  filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
  have hC := isHermitian_matrixKCoefficient S T.val hS T.property (hgap T hT)
  change (matrixKCoefficient S T.val * P * matrixKCoefficient S T.val - (0 : Matrix n n ℂ)).PosSemidef
  rw [sub_zero]
  simpa only [hC.eq] using hP.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (matrixKCoefficient S T.val)

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_matrixKStabilityMap
statement:
theorem isHermitian_matrixKStabilityMap
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    (matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,N,hP,hN,hH',_,_⟩ := exists_posSemidef_parts hH
  rw [hH',map_sub]
  exact (posSemidef_matrixKStabilityMap ν hν α hα S hS hgap hP).isHermitian.sub
    (posSemidef_matrixKStabilityMap ν hν α hα S hS hgap hN).isHermitian

name: NLAlib.frobInner_matrixKStabilityMap_comm
statement:
theorem frobInner_matrixKStabilityMap_comm
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    frobInner A (matrixKStabilityMap ν α S B) =
      frobInner (matrixKStabilityMap ν α S A) B
proof:
:= by
  have hi0 := (integrable_matrixK_kernels ν hν S hS hgap).2
  have hi (H : Matrix n n ℂ) : Integrable
      (fun T => matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val) ν := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply] using hi0.apply_continuousLinearMap H
  rw [matrixKStabilityMap_apply ν hν α S hS hgap B,
    matrixKStabilityMap_apply ν hν α S hS hgap A,
    frobInner_smul_right,frobInner_smul_left]
  congr 1
  have hleft := (frobInnerCLM A).integral_comp_comm (hi B)
  have hright := (frobInnerCLM B).integral_comp_comm (hi A)
  change (∫ T, frobInner A (matrixKCoefficient S T.val * B * matrixKCoefficient S T.val) ∂ν) =
    frobInner A (∫ T, matrixKCoefficient S T.val * B * matrixKCoefficient S T.val ∂ν) at hleft
  change (∫ T, frobInner B (matrixKCoefficient S T.val * A * matrixKCoefficient S T.val) ∂ν) =
    frobInner B (∫ T, matrixKCoefficient S T.val * A * matrixKCoefficient S T.val ∂ν) at hright
  rw [← hleft,frobInner_comm _ B,← hright]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
  rw [frobInner_hermitian_congruence _ A B
    (isHermitian_matrixKCoefficient S T.val hS T.property (hgap T hT)),frobInner_comm]

name: NLAlib.sumTraceWordMultilinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sumTraceWordMultilinear_apply {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {k : ℕ} (Z : ι → Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) (Y : Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    sumTraceWordMultilinear Z Y =
      ∑ i, (List.ofFn (fun l => Z i l * Y l)).prod.trace
