name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_cyclic_trace_cut_le
statement:
private theorem specNorm_sum_cyclic_trace_cut_le {ι n : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {m : ℕ}
    (Z : ι → Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i l, (Z i l).IsHermitian) {R M : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ i l, specNorm (Z i l) ≤ R)
    (hMass : ∀ l, specNorm (∑ i, Z i l ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n ℂ) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    specNorm (∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) * cyclicTraceWordMiddle (Z i) Y j * Z i j) ≤
      (R ^ m * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)) * M
proof:
:= by
  let r := R ^ m * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR m)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun l _ => specNorm_nonneg (Y l))
  have hC (i : ι) : ‖cyclicTraceWordMiddle (Z i) Y j‖ ≤ r := by
    simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using specNorm_cyclicTraceWordMiddle_le (Z i) Y hR (hZ i) j
  have hA : (∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) * star (Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j))) =
      ∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, (hHerm i _).eq, pow_two]
  have hB : (∑ i, star (Z i j) * Z i j) = ∑ i, Z i j ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, (hHerm i j).eq, pow_two]
  have hn := CStarAlgebra.norm_sum_mul_mul_le
    (fun i => Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j))
    (fun i => cyclicTraceWordMiddle (Z i) Y j) (fun i => Z i j) hr hC
  rw [hA, hB] at hn
  simp only [← specNorm_eq_norm] at hn
  calc
    _ ≤ r / 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) ^ 2) +
        specNorm (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2)) := hn
    _ ≤ r / 2 * (M + M) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (add_le_add (hMass _) (hMass j)) (div_nonneg hr (by norm_num))
    _ = r * M := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint_aux
statement:
private theorem norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint_aux {ι n : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {m : ℕ}
    (Z : ι → Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i l, (Z i l).IsHermitian) {R M : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ i l, specNorm (Z i l) ≤ R)
    (hMass : ∀ l, specNorm (∑ i, Z i l ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n ℂ) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ‖sumTraceWordMultilinear Z Y‖ ≤
      R ^ m * M * nuclearNorm (Y j) * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : sumTraceWordMultilinear Z Y =
      ((∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) * cyclicTraceWordMiddle (Z i) Y j * Z i j) * Y j).trace := by
    rw [sumTraceWordMultilinear_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut (Z i) Y j
  have hN : 0 ≤ nuclearNorm (Y j) := by
    simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using schattenNormReal_nonneg (Y j) 1
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) * cyclicTraceWordMiddle (Z i) Y j * Z i j) *
        nuclearNorm (Y j) := by
      apply (norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm _).trans
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using
        schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul
          (∑ i, Z i (finRotate (m + 2) j) * cyclicTraceWordMiddle (Z i) Y j * Z i j)
          (Y j) (p := 1) zero_lt_one
    _ ≤ ((R ^ m * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)) * M) * nuclearNorm (Y j) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_sum_cyclic_trace_cut_le Z hHerm hR hZ hMass Y j) hN
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint
statement:
theorem norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint {ι n : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (Z : ι → Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) (hHerm : ∀ i l, (Z i l).IsHermitian)
    {R M : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i l, specNorm (Z i l) ≤ R)
    (hMass : ∀ l, specNorm (∑ i, Z i l ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (Y : Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) (j : Fin k) :
    ‖sumTraceWordMultilinear Z Y‖ ≤
      R ^ (k - 2) * M * nuclearNorm (Y j) * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 2 := ⟨k - 2, by omega⟩
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
    norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint_aux Z hHerm hR hZ hMass Y j

name: NLAlib.norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm
statement:
theorem norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm {ι n : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (Z : ι → Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) (hHerm : ∀ i l, (Z i l).IsHermitian)
    {R M : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i l, specNorm (Z i l) ≤ R)
    (hMass : ∀ l, specNorm (∑ i, Z i l ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (p : Fin k → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ l, 1 ≤ p l)
    (hsum : ∑ l, ((p l)⁻¹).toReal = 1) (Y : Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ‖sumTraceWordMultilinear Z Y‖ ≤
      R ^ (k - 2) * M * ∏ l, schattenNorm (Y l) (p l)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    let j : Fin k := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    exact (specNorm_nonneg (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2)).trans (hMass j)
  exact norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm_of_endpoints (sumTraceWordMultilinear Z)
    (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR _) hM)
    (fun j Y => norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint hk Z hHerm hR hZ hMass Y j)
    p hp hsum Y

name: NLAlib.exists_symmetric_profile_power_factors
statement:
theorem exists_symmetric_profile_power_factors
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p q θ c : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : Matrix n n ℝ) (ha : a.IsSymm) (ha0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j)
    (hrow : (∑ i, (∑ j, a i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤ 1)
    (hentry : c ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ U V : Matrix n n ℝ,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ U i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ V i j) ∧ U.IsSymm ∧ V.IsSymm ∧
      (∀ i j, a i j = U i j ^ (1 - θ) * V i j ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, U i j ^ 2) ≤ 4 ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, V i j ^ 2) ^ (q / 2)) ≤ 1 ∧
      c ^ q * (∑ i, ∑ j, V i j ^ q) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : n → ℝ := fun i => Real.sqrt (∑ j, a i j ^ 2)
  have hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i := fun _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsq (i : n) : ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 = s i ^ 2 :=
    (Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)).symm
  have hsp : (∑ i, s i ^ p) = ∑ i, (∑ j, a i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
    ring
  obtain ⟨ur, vr, hur, hvr, hfr, hlr, hrr⟩ :=
    exists_row_power_factors hp hq hθ hexp a s ha0 hs hsq
  obtain ⟨ue, ve, hue, hve, hfe, hle, hre⟩ :=
    exists_weighted_scalar_power_factors (by linarith : 0 < p) hq hθ hc hexp
      (fun ij : n × n => a ij.1 ij.2) (fun ij => ha0 ij.1 ij.2)
  have hlr' : (∑ i, ∑ j, ur i j ^ 2) ≤ 1 := hlr.trans_le (hsp.trans_le hrow)
  have hle' : (∑ ij, ue ij ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hle, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    exact hentry
  let us : Bool × Bool → n × n → ℝ := fun l ij =>
    if l.1 then (if l.2 then ue (ij.2, ij.1) else ue ij)
    else (if l.2 then ur ij.2 ij.1 else ur ij.1 ij.2)
  let vs : Bool × Bool → n × n → ℝ := fun l ij =>
    if l.1 then (if l.2 then ve (ij.2, ij.1) else ve ij)
    else (if l.2 then vr ij.2 ij.1 else vr ij.1 ij.2)
  have hus (l : Bool × Bool) (ij : n × n) : 0 ≤ us l ij := by
    rcases l with ⟨l, r⟩
    cases l <;> cases r <;> dsimp [us] <;> first | exact hur _ _ | exact hue _
  have hvs (l : Bool × Bool) (ij : n × n) : 0 ≤ vs l ij := by
    rcases l with ⟨l, r⟩
    cases l <;> cases r <;> dsimp [vs] <;> first | exact hvr _ _ | exact hve _
  have hfs (l : Bool × Bool) (ij : n × n) :
      a ij.1 ij.2 = us l ij ^ (1 - θ) * vs l ij ^ θ := by
    rcases l with ⟨l, r⟩
    cases l <;> cases r
    · exact hfr _ _
    · change a ij.1 ij.2 = ur ij.2 ij.1 ^ (1 - θ) * vr ij.2 ij.1 ^ θ
      exact (ha.apply ij.2 ij.1).trans (hfr ij.2 ij.1)
    · exact hfe _
    · change a ij.1 ij.2 = ue (ij.2, ij.1) ^ (1 - θ) * ve (ij.2, ij.1) ^ θ
      exact (ha.apply ij.2 ij.1).trans (hfe (ij.2, ij.1))
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hfactor, hUsq, hVle, hVeq⟩ :=
    exists_common_power_factors_with_right_eq hθ (fun ij : n × n => a ij.1 ij.2) us vs
      (fun ij => ha0 ij.1 ij.2) hus hvs hfs
  have hUsq' (i j : n) : U (i, j) ^ 2 = ur i j ^ 2 + ur j i ^ 2 +
      ue (i, j) ^ 2 + ue (j, i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hUsq]
    simp [us, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    ring
  have hUsym (i j : n) : U (j, i) = U (i, j) := by
    nlinarith [hUsq' i j, hUsq' j i, hU (i, j), hU (j, i)]
  have hVsym (i j : n) : V (j, i) = V (i, j) := by
    rw [hVeq, hVeq, hUsym, ha.apply j i]
  have hVrow (i j : n) : V (i, j) ≤ vr i j := hVle (false, false) (i, j)
  have hVentry (i j : n) : V (i, j) ≤ ve (i, j) := hVle (true, false) (i, j)
  refine ⟨fun i j => U (i, j), fun i j => V (i, j), fun i j => hU (i, j),
    fun i j => hV (i, j), ?_, ?_, fun i j => hfactor (i, j), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i j
    exact hUsym i j
  · ext i j
    exact hVsym i j
  · have hsum : (∑ i, ∑ j, U (i, j) ^ 2) =
        2 * (∑ i, ∑ j, ur i j ^ 2) + 2 * (∑ ij, ue ij ^ 2) := by
      simp_rw [hUsq', Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [show (∑ i, ∑ j, ur j i ^ 2) = ∑ i, ∑ j, ur i j ^ 2 from Finset.sum_comm,
        show (∑ i, ∑ j, ue (j, i) ^ 2) = ∑ i, ∑ j, ue (i, j) ^ 2 from Finset.sum_comm,
        Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      ring
    rw [hsum]
    linarith
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (∑ j, vr i j ^ 2) ^ (q / 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _ (by positivity)
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (hV (i, j)) (hVrow i j) 2
      _ = ∑ i, s i ^ p := hrr
      _ ≤ 1 := hsp.trans_le hrow
  · calc
      _ ≤ c ^ q * (∑ ij, ve ij ^ q) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _)
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (hV (i, j)) (hVentry i j) hq.le
      _ = c ^ (θ * p) * ∑ ij : n × n, a ij.1 ij.2 ^ p := hre
      _ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] using hentry

name: NLAlib.re_trace_derivative_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
  have hterm (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Finset.range p) :
      (C ^ (p.pred - i) * H * C ^ i).trace = (H * C ^ (p - 1)).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm (C ^ (p.pred - i) * H),
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (C ^ i * C ^ (p.pred - i)) H,
      ← pow_add]
    simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
    rw [show i + (p - 1 - i) = p - 1 by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega]
  calc
    _ = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range p, (H * C ^ (p - 1)).trace.re := by
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => congrArg Complex.re (hterm i hi)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_reTracePowerAlong
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_reTracePowerAlong (p : ℕ) (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (reTracePowerAlong p A H) (reTracePowerFirst p A H t) t
proof:
:= by
  have haff : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => A + r • H) H t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const H).const_add A
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t
    (reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).clm_apply (haff.fun_pow' p)
  convert! htrace using 1
  · simp only [_root_.zero_apply, zero_add, reTraceCLM_apply,
      re_trace_derivative_sum, reTracePowerFirst]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_reTracePowerFirst
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_reTracePowerFirst (p : ℕ) (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (reTracePowerFirst p A H) (reTracePowerSecond p A H t) t
proof:
:= by
  have haff : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => A + r • H) H t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const H).const_add A
  have hmul := (hasDerivAt_const t H).mul (haff.fun_pow' (p - 1))
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t
    (reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).clm_apply hmul
  have hscaled := htrace.const_mul (p : ℝ)
  convert! hscaled using 1
  · simp only [_root_.zero_apply, zero_mul, zero_add, reTraceCLM_apply,
      Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      reTracePowerSecond]

name: NLAlib.reTracePowerSecond_le_trace_sq_mul
statement:
theorem reTracePowerSecond_le_trace_sq_mul (p : ℕ) (hp : Even p) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p)
    (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    reTracePowerSecond p A H t ≤
      (p : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * (H ^ 2 * (A + t • H) ^ (p - 2)).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hB : (A + t • H).IsHermitian := hA.add (hH.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t))
  have hm : Even (p - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (hi : i ∈ Finset.range (p - 1)) => by
    have hi' : i ≤ p - 2 := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega
    have hpred : (p - 1).pred = p - 2 := by simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]; omega
    have h := re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow H (A + t • H) hH hB
      hm (show (p - 1).pred - i ≤ p - 2 by rw [hpred]; omega)
    have he : p - 2 - ((p - 1).pred - i) = i := by rw [hpred]; omega
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (Nat.cast_nonneg p : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p)
  simpa only [reTracePowerSecond, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
    Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ p by omega), Nat.cast_one, mul_assoc] using h

name: NLAlib.reTracePowerSecond_le_even_moments
statement:
theorem reTracePowerSecond_le_even_moments (p : ℕ) (hp : Even p) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p)
    (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    reTracePowerSecond p A H t ≤
      (p : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * reTracePowerAlong p A H t ^ (1 - 2 / (p : ℝ)) *
        (H ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hB : (A + t • H).IsHermitian := hA.add (hH.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t))
  have h := re_trace_sq_mul_pow_le_even_moments H (A + t • H) hH hB hp hp2
  have hc : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp2
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
  exact (reTracePowerSecond_le_trace_sq_mul p hp hp2 A H hA hH t).trans
    (by simpa only [reTracePowerAlong, mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hc)

name: NLAlib.operator_jensen
statement:
theorem NLAlib.operator_jensen {d m n : ℕ} [NeZero d] [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn I f)
    (A₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (A₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hA₁ : A₁.IsHermitian) (hA₂ : A₂.IsHermitian)
    (hA₁I : spectrum ℝ A₁ ⊆ I) (hA₂I : spectrum ℝ A₂ ⊆ I)
    (K₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin d) ℂ) (K₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hK : K₁.conjTranspose * K₁ + K₂.conjTranspose * K₂ = 1) :
    (cfc f (K₁.conjTranspose * A₁ * K₁ + K₂.conjTranspose * A₂ * K₂)) ≤
      (K₁.conjTranspose * cfc f A₁ * K₁ +
        K₂.conjTranspose * cfc f A₂ * K₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hAB, hspec, hcalc⟩ := cfc_fromBlocks A₁ A₂ hA₁ hA₂ f
  have hdomain : spectrum ℝ (Matrix.fromBlocks A₁ 0 0 A₂) ⊆ I := by
    rw [hspec]
    exact Set.union_subset hA₁I hA₂I
  have hisometry : (Matrix.fromRows K₁ K₂).conjTranspose * Matrix.fromRows K₁ K₂ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromRows_eq_fromCols_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows] using hK
  have h := OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le I f hf
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A₁ 0 0 A₂) hAB hdomain (Matrix.fromRows K₁ K₂) hisometry
  simpa only [hcalc, Matrix.conjTranspose_fromRows_eq_fromCols_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows, Matrix.zero_mul,
    add_zero, zero_add, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_global_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem exists_global_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → M,
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian) ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ, (∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t) →
        AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧ (G u).PosDef ∧ (deriv G (u : ℂ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : ℂ → M := fun z => α•F z
  have hNa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ N {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} :=
    fun z hz => (hFa z hz).const_smul (c := α)
  have hNp : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (N z) : M).PosSemidef := by
    intro z hz
    have hp := ((hF z hz).1.smul hα).posSemidef
    simpa only [N,map_smul,selfAdjoint.val_smul] using hp
  obtain ⟨R0,hR0⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  let R := max R0 1
  have hR : 0<R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R := by
    intro T hT
    have hn : specNorm T.val≤R0 := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using hR0 T hT
    exact hn.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  let κ := 4*(α+1)*R/α
  have hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ<a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → a≤|z.re| →
      ‖(imaginaryPart (N z) : M)‖≤C*z.im := by
    intro a ha
    refine ⟨2*α^2*(((α+1)*R)⁻¹)^2,?_⟩
    intro z hz hza
    have ha' : 4*(α+1)*R<a*α := (div_lt_iff₀ hα).mp ha
    have hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|z.re| := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hza hα.le]
    exact norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior ν hν α R hα hR F
      hFa hF hbound z hz hfar
  have hs (v : n → ℂ) :=
    (Matrix.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_quadratic_stieltjes_eq N hNa hNp
      (tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixKTransform_solution ν hν α hα F hF) κ hb v).exists
  choose ρ hρ using hs
  have hrep (v : n → ℂ) : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ v : Measure ℝ) := (hρ v).2.2
  have hcompact (v : n → ℂ) : IsCompact (ρ v : Measure ℝ).support :=
    isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset (ρ v : Measure ℝ).isClosed_support
      ((ρ v : Measure ℝ).support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc (hρ v).2.1)
  have hsupp (v : n → ℂ) : (ρ v : Measure ℝ).support⊆(μ : Measure ℝ).support :=
    Matrix.support_quadratic_stieltjes_subset_trace_support N hNp μ (ρ v) v hμ (hrep v)
  have hmass (v : n → ℂ) (hv : v≠0) : (ρ v : Measure ℝ)≠0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hm : (ρ v).mass=0 := by
      apply ENNReal.coe_injective
      rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hzero]
      simp
    rw [(hρ v).1] at hm
    have hp : 0<((quadraticProbeMass v : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [ofReal_quadraticProbeMass]
      exact Matrix.PosDef.one.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    simp only [hm,NNReal.coe_zero,Complex.ofReal_zero,lt_self_iff_false] at hp
  obtain ⟨G,hGa,hGN,hreal⟩ := Matrix.exists_global_real_matrix_extension_of_quadratic_stieltjes
    N ρ hrep hcompact
  refine ⟨G,hGN,hreal,?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hgap (v : n → ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t∈(ρ v : Measure ℝ).support) : u<t :=
    hu t (hsupp v ht)
  have hGau := hGa u (fun v t ht => (hgap v t ht).ne')
  obtain ⟨hG,hGd⟩ := Matrix.posDef_real_extension_and_deriv_of_quadratic_stieltjes
    N G ρ hrep hcompact hmass u hgap hGau hGN hreal
  exact ⟨hGau,hG,hGd⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem exists_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → M, AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian) ∧ (G u).PosDef ∧ (deriv G (u : ℂ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hGN,hreal,hG⟩ :=
    exists_global_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ
  exact ⟨G,(hG u hu).1,hGN,hreal,(hG u hu).2⟩

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (r : ℕ) :
    (A ^ r).trace.re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i ^ r
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem]
  rw [← map_pow, trace_conjStarAlgAut,
    Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp only [Complex.re_sum, Pi.pow_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  change ((hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ^ r).re = _
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (ev : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℕ) :
    (C * (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ a * C *
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ b).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖C i j‖ ^ 2 * ev j ^ a * ev i ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.diagonal_pow,
    Matrix.mul_assoc C (Matrix.diagonal ((fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) ^ a)) C]
  have hentry (i : ι) :
      (C * (Matrix.diagonal ((fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) ^ a) * C)) i i =
        ∑ j, C i j * ((ev j : ℂ) ^ a * C j i) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]; rfl
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Complex.re_sum]
  simp_rw [hentry, Finset.sum_mul, Complex.re_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have hs : C j i = star (C i j) := by
    have hh := congrFun (congrFun hC j) i
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using hh.symm
  rw [hs]
  change (C i j * ((ev j : ℂ) ^ a * star (C i j)) * (ev i : ℂ) ^ b).re = _
  have he : C i j * ((ev j : ℂ) ^ a * star (C i j)) * (ev i : ℂ) ^ b =
      (C i j * star (C i j)) * ((ev j ^ a * ev i ^ b : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hn : C i j * star (C i j) = ((‖C i j‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using! Complex.mul_conj (C i j)
  rw [he, hn, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
  ring

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_pow_mul_mul_pow_conjStarAlgAut
statement:
theorem trace_mul_pow_mul_mul_pow_conjStarAlgAut
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (C H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (a b : ℕ) :
    let E
proof:
:= Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
    (E C * E H ^ a * E C * E H ^ b).trace = (C * H ^ a * C * H ^ b).trace := by
  dsimp only
  rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    trace_conjStarAlgAut]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_le
statement:
theorem re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_le
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (ev : ι → ℝ)
    {m l : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hl : l ≤ m) :
    (C * (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ l * C *
      (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ (m - l)).trace.re ≤
        (C ^ 2 * (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ m).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  let T (a b : ℕ) := ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖C i j‖ ^ 2 * ev j ^ a * ev i ^ b
  have hs (i j) : ‖C i j‖ = ‖C j i‖ := by
    have hh := congrFun (congrFun hC j) i
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, norm_star] using congrArg norm hh
  have hsym (a b) : T a b = T b a := by
    dsimp [T]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [hs j i]
    ring
  have hbound : T l (m - l) + T (m - l) l ≤ T m 0 + T 0 m := by
    have hb : ∀ i j,
        ‖C i j‖ ^ 2 * (ev j ^ l * ev i ^ (m - l) + ev j ^ (m - l) * ev i ^ l) ≤
          ‖C i j‖ ^ 2 * (ev j ^ m + ev i ^ m) := by
      intro i j
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
      calc ev j ^ l * ev i ^ (m - l) + ev j ^ (m - l) * ev i ^ l ≤
          |ev j| ^ l * |ev i| ^ (m - l) + |ev j| ^ (m - l) * |ev i| ^ l := by
            apply add_le_add
            · simpa only [abs_mul, abs_pow] using le_abs_self (ev j ^ l * ev i ^ (m - l))
            · simpa only [abs_mul, abs_pow] using le_abs_self (ev j ^ (m - l) * ev i ^ l)
        _ ≤ |ev j| ^ m + |ev i| ^ m := mixed_pow_add_mixed_pow_le (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _) hl
        _ = ev j ^ m + ev i ^ m := by rw [hm.pow_abs, hm.pow_abs]
    have h := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) => hb i j
    simpa only [T, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_assoc, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul] using h
  rw [hsym (m - l) l, hsym m 0] at hbound
  have hscalar : T l (m - l) ≤ T 0 m := by linarith
  rw [re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow C hC]
  have he : C ^ 2 * (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ m =
      C * (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ 0 * C *
        (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ m := by simp [pow_two]
  rw [he, re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow C hC]
  exact hscalar

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
    (C H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {m l : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hl : l ≤ m) :
    (C * H ^ l * C * H ^ (m - l)).trace.re ≤ (C ^ 2 * H ^ m).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  let U := star hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
  have hEC : (E C).IsHermitian := by
    change ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * C * star (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)).IsHermitian
    exact Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose _ hC
  have hdiag : E H = diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) :=
    hH.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
  have hleft := trace_mul_pow_mul_mul_pow_conjStarAlgAut U C H l (m - l)
  have hright := trace_mul_pow_mul_mul_pow_conjStarAlgAut U C H 0 m
  dsimp only at hleft hright
  rw [hdiag] at hleft hright
  simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.mul_one, ← pow_two] at hright
  rw [← hleft, ← hright]
  exact re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_le (E C) hEC hH.eigenvalues hm hl

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.disjoint_neg
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.disjoint_neg {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {B : Matrix m m ℂ}
    (hA : IsPositiveStable A) (hB : IsPositiveStable B) :
    Disjoint (spectrum ℂ A) (spectrum ℂ (-B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hz hz'
  have hn : -z ∈ spectrum ℂ B := by
    rw [← spectrum.neg_eq] at hz'
    exact Set.mem_neg.mp hz'
  have ha := hA z hz
  have hb := hB (-z) hn
  simp only [Complex.neg_re] at hb
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.eq
statement:
theorem IsMatrixSign.eq {A S T : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : IsMatrixSign A S) (hT : IsMatrixSign A T) : S = T
proof:
:= by
  have hs : S * S = 1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hS.1
  have ht : T * T = 1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hT.1
  have hsep := hS.2.2.disjoint_neg hT.2.2
  have heq : (S * A) * (S - T) = (S - T) * (-(T * A)) := by
    have hSA : A * S = S * A := hS.2.1.eq
    have hTA : A * T = T * A := hT.2.1.eq
    calc
      _ = S * (A * S) - S * (A * T) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (S * S) * A - S * T * A := by rw [hSA, hTA]; noncomm_ring
      _ = A - S * T * A := by rw [hs, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = (S - T) * (-(T * A)) := by
        calc
          _ = -(S * T * A) + (T * T) * A := by rw [ht, Matrix.one_mul]; abel
          _ = _ := by noncomm_ring
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_mul_of_disjoint_spectrum hsep heq)

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.projectors
statement:
theorem IsMatrixSign.projectors {A S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : IsMatrixSign A S) :
    let P
proof:
:= (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 + S)
    let Q := (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 - S)
    P * P = P ∧ Q * Q = Q ∧ P * Q = 0 ∧ Q * P = 0 ∧ P + Q = 1 := by
  dsimp
  have hs : S * S = 1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hS.1
  constructor
  · simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [show (1 + S) * (1 + S) = (2 : ℂ) • (1 + S) by
      simp only [add_mul, mul_add, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hs]
      module]
    simp [smul_smul]
  constructor
  · simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [show (1 - S) * (1 - S) = (2 : ℂ) • (1 - S) by
      simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hs]
      module]
    simp [smul_smul]
  constructor
  · simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [show (1 + S) * (1 - S) = 0 by noncomm_ring [hs], smul_zero]
  constructor
  · simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [show (1 - S) * (1 + S) = 0 by noncomm_ring [hs], smul_zero]
  · rw [← smul_add]
    have heq : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + S + (1 - S) = (2 : ℂ) • 1 := by module
    rw [heq, smul_smul]
    norm_num

name: NLAlib.energy_bound_of_specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le
statement:
theorem energy_bound_of_specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (c : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ Real.exp (t * c))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let z (s : ℝ) := (matrixExp (s • A)).toEuclideanLin x
  have hz0 : z 0 = x := by simp [z, matrixExp, Matrix.toEuclideanLin]
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ‖z s‖ ^ 2)
      (2 * inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x)) 0 := by
    convert! (hasDerivAt_matrixExp_orbit A x 0).norm_sq using 1
    change 2 * inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) =
      2 * inner ℝ (z 0) (A.toEuclideanLin (z 0))
    rw [hz0]
  have hh : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (s * c) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
      (2 * c * ‖x‖ ^ 2) 0 := by
    convert! ((((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).mul_const c).exp).pow 2).mul_const (‖x‖ ^ 2) using 1
    norm_num
  have hle : 2 * inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) ≤ 2 * c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hg.tendsto_slope_zero_right hh.tendsto_slope_zero_right
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have hs' : 0 < s := hs
    have hn : ‖z s‖ ≤ Real.exp (s * c) * ‖x‖ := by
      have h := (matrixExp (s • A)).l2_opNorm_mulVec x
      exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA s hs'.le) (norm_nonneg _))
    have hsq : ‖z s‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (s * c) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [mul_pow] using
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (norm_nonneg _))).mpr hn
    simp only [zero_add, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, one_pow, one_mul, hz0]
    exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_right hsq _) (inv_pos.mpr hs').le
  linarith

name: NLAlib.matrixLogarithmicNorm_le_of_energy_bound
proof:
:= by
  let H : Matrix n n ℂ := selfAdjointPart ℝ A
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := (selfAdjointPart ℝ A).property
  have hm : lambdaMax H ∈ Set.range hH.eigenvalues := by
    rw [← hH.range_eigenvalues₀, lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero hH]
    exact ⟨⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hm
  let x := hH.eigenvectorBasis i
  have hn : ‖x‖ = 1 := hH.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i
  have he : inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) = hH.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [real_inner_toEuclideanLin]
    have h := quadForm_selfAdjointPart A x.ofLp
    have heig := hH.eigenvalues_eq i
    change hH.eigenvalues i = (quadForm H x.ofLp).re at heig
    have hreal := congrArg Complex.re h
    rw [Complex.ofReal_re] at hreal
    exact hreal.symm.trans heig.symm
  have hb := hA x
  rw [he, hn, one_pow, mul_one, hi] at hb
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.isLeast_matrixLogarithmicNorm
statement:
theorem isLeast_matrixLogarithmicNorm (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ Real.exp (t * c)} (matrixLogarithmicNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ht => specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_exp_logarithmicNorm A ht, ?_⟩
  intro c hc
  exact matrixLogarithmicNorm_le_of_energy_bound (energy_bound_of_specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le A c hc)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_one_iff_selfAdjointPart_nonpos
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_one_iff_selfAdjointPart_nonpos (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ 1) ↔
      (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    have he : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ Real.exp (t * 0) := by simpa only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    have hc := matrixLogarithmicNorm_le_of_energy_bound
      (energy_bound_of_specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le A 0 he)
    have hn : matrixLogarithmicNorm A • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ 0 :=
      smul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc zero_le_one
    exact (selfAdjointPart_le_matrixLogarithmicNorm A).trans hn
  · intro hA t ht
    have h : (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (0 : ℝ) • 1 := by
      simpa only [zero_smul] using hA
    simpa only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero] using
      specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_of_selfAdjointPart_le h ht

name: NLAlib.matrix_exponential_logarithmic_norm
statement:
theorem matrix_exponential_logarithmic_norm (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ Real.exp (t * c)} (matrixLogarithmicNorm A) ∧
    ((∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ 1) ↔
      (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isLeast_matrixLogarithmicNorm A, specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_one_iff_selfAdjointPart_nonpos A⟩

name: NLAlib.summable_stein_of_power_bound
statement:
theorem summable_stein_of_power_bound (A Q : Matrix n n K) (C r : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, specNorm (A ^ j) ≤ C * r ^ j) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded
    ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (sq_nonneg r) hr2).mul_left (C ^ 2 * specNorm Q))
  intro j
  rw [← specNorm_eq_norm, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_pow]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (A ^ j * Q) * specNorm (A ^ j)ᴴ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (A ^ j) * specNorm Q) * specNorm (A ^ j) := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (C * r ^ j * specNorm Q) * (C * r ^ j) :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpow j) (specNorm_nonneg _)) (hpow j)
        (specNorm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg hr j)) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 j, pow_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose (A Q : Matrix n n K)
    (hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) :
    steinGramian A Q - A * steinGramian A Q * Aᴴ = Q
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (steinPartialSum A Q) atTop (𝓝 (steinGramian A Q)) :=
    hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun N => Q - steinPartialSum A Q N + A * steinPartialSum A Q N * Aᴴ)
      atTop (𝓝 (Q - steinGramian A Q + A * steinGramian A Q * Aᴴ)) :=
    (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hlim).add ((tendsto_const_nhds.mul hlim).mul_const _)
  have hright : Tendsto (fun N => Q - steinPartialSum A Q N + A * steinPartialSum A Q N * Aᴴ)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [steinPartialSum_residual] using hs.tendsto_atTop_zero
  have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hleft hright
  apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
  have hid : steinGramian A Q - A * steinGramian A Q * Aᴴ - Q =
      -(Q - steinGramian A Q + A * steinGramian A Q * Aᴴ) := by abel
  rw [hid, heq, neg_zero]

name: NLAlib.steinGramian_sub_partialSum
statement:
theorem steinGramian_sub_partialSum (A Q : Matrix n n K)
    (hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) (N : ℕ) :
    steinGramian A Q - steinPartialSum A Q N = A ^ N * steinGramian A Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N
proof:
:=
  sub_steinPartialSum_eq A Q _ (steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose A Q hs) N

name: NLAlib.eq_steinGramian_of_solution
statement:
theorem eq_steinGramian_of_solution (A Q X : Matrix n n K)
    (hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j))
    (hp : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hX : X - A * X * Aᴴ = Q) : X = steinGramian A Q
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (steinPartialSum A Q) atTop (𝓝 (steinGramian A Q)) :=
    hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have hstar : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (Aᴴ) ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n K => Mᴴ) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Matrix.conjTranspose_pow, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using
      hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hp
  have hzero := (hp.mul_const X).mul hstar
  simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero] at hzero
  have hid : (fun N => A ^ N * X * (Aᴴ) ^ N) = fun N => X - steinPartialSum A Q N := by
    funext N
    exact (sub_steinPartialSum_eq A Q X hX N).symm
  rw [hid] at hzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hlim) hzero)

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_steinGramian
statement:
theorem posSemidef_steinGramian (A Q : Matrix n n K) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef)
    (hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) : (steinGramian A Q).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (steinPartialSum A Q) atTop (𝓝 (steinGramian A Q)) :=
    hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n K => Mᴴ) := by fun_prop
  have ht := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim
  have hherm : (fun N => (steinPartialSum A Q N)ᴴ) = steinPartialSum A Q :=
    funext fun N => (posSemidef_steinPartialSum A Q hQ N).isHermitian.eq
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at ht
  rw [hherm] at ht
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (tendsto_nhds_unique ht hlim)
  intro x
  have hcont : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n K => star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)) := by
    unfold Matrix.mulVec dotProduct
    fun_prop
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds (hcont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun N => (posSemidef_steinPartialSum A Q hQ N).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x)

name: NLAlib.summable_stein_of_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_stein_of_spectralRadius_lt_one (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ A < 1) : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : (spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal < 1 :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top A) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hA
  let r := ((spectralRadius ℂ A).toReal + 1) / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_norm_matrix_pow_le_growth A hr (by dsimp [r]; linarith)
  exact summable_stein_of_power_bound A Q _ r
    (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant A hr N)) hr.le hr1 hN

name: NLAlib.summable_real_stein_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_real_stein_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) < 1) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  let AC := A.map Complex.ofReal
  have hρ : (spectralRadius ℂ AC).toReal < 1 :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top AC) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hA
  let ε := (1 - (spectralRadius ℂ AC).toReal) / 2
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_prefix_specNorm_real_matrix_pow_le_complex_spectralRadius_add A hε
  have hr : 0 < (spectralRadius ℂ AC).toReal + ε :=
    add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hε
  exact summable_stein_of_power_bound A Q _ _
    (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_matrixPowerBoundConstant AC hr N)) hr.le
    (by dsimp [ε]; linarith) hN

name: NLAlib.posDef_steinGramian
statement:
theorem posDef_steinGramian (A Q : Matrix n n K) (hQ : Q.PosDef)
    (hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) : (steinGramian A Q).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hG := posSemidef_steinGramian A Q hQ.posSemidef hs
  have heq := steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose A Q hs
  rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq heq]
  exact hQ.add_posSemidef (hG.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same A)

name: NLAlib.norm_lt_one_of_posDef_stein
statement:
theorem norm_lt_one_of_posDef_stein (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : X.PosDef)
    (hR : (X - A * X * Aᴴ).PosDef) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ A) : ‖μ‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyA⟩ := exists_vecMul_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hx : star y ≠ 0 := by simpa only [star_ne_zero] using hy
  have hAx : Aᴴ *ᵥ star y = star μ • star y := by
    rw [← Matrix.star_vecMul, hyA, star_smul]
  have hquad : quadForm (A * X * Aᴴ) (star y) =
      (‖μ‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) * quadForm X (star y) := by
    have hc := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul X Aᴴ (star y)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hAx, quadForm_smul] at hc
    have hstar : star (star μ) * star μ = (‖μ‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [star_star]
      exact RCLike.mul_conj μ
    simpa only [hstar] using hc
  have hXp : 0 < (quadForm X (star y)).re := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hX.quadForm_pos hx)).1
  have hRp := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hR.quadForm_pos hx)).1
  change 0 < (quadForm (X - A * X * Aᴴ) (star y)).re at hRp
  have hreal : (quadForm (X - A * X * Aᴴ) (star y)).re =
      (1 - ‖μ‖ ^ 2) * (quadForm X (star y)).re := by
    rw [quadForm_def, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
    change (quadForm X (star y) - quadForm (A * X * Aᴴ) (star y)).re = _
    rw [hquad]
    simp [Complex.mul_re, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, sub_mul]
  rw [hreal] at hRp
  have hcoef : 0 < 1 - ‖μ‖ ^ 2 := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hXp).mp hRp
  have hnorm : 0 ≤ ‖μ‖ := norm_nonneg μ
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.spectralRadius_lt_one_iff_exists_posDef_stein
statement:
theorem spectralRadius_lt_one_iff_exists_posDef_stein (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    spectralRadius ℂ A < 1 ↔ ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ (X - A * X * Aᴴ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    have hs := summable_stein_of_spectralRadius_lt_one A 1 hA
    refine ⟨steinGramian A 1, posDef_steinGramian A 1 Matrix.PosDef.one hs, ?_⟩
    rw [steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose A 1 hs]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hR⟩
    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
    | inl hn =>
      have hz : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hz, spectrum.spectralRadius_zero]
      exact zero_lt_one
    | inr hn =>
      apply spectrum.spectralRadius_lt_of_forall_lt_of_nonempty (spectrum.nonempty A)
      intro μ hμ
      exact_mod_cast norm_lt_one_of_posDef_stein A X hX hR hμ

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_coordinatePinch
statement:
private theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_coordinatePinch {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (h : Fin d → ℝ) (X : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hX : X.PosDef) (k : Fin d) :
    (coordinatePinch k X).PosDef ∧
      traceExp (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog X) ≤
        traceExp (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog (coordinatePinch k X))
proof:
:= by
  let H := diagonal fun i => (h i : ℂ)
  let R := coordinateReflection k
  have hR : Rᴴ = R := conjTranspose_coordinateReflection k
  have hR2 : R * R = 1 := coordinateReflection_mul_self k
  have hRX : (R * X * R).PosDef := (posDef_reflection_conj_iff R X hR hR2).2 hX
  have hc := lieb_concavity H
    (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) (by ext i; simp))
  have hp := hc.1 hX hRX (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num) (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = 1 by norm_num)
  have he := hc.2 hX hRX (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num) (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = 1 by norm_num)
  have hinv := traceExp_add_matrixLog_reflection_conj_of_conj_eq R H X hR hR2
    hX.isHermitian (coordinateReflection_mul_diagonal_mul k _)
  change (coordinatePinch k X).PosDef at hp
  change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * traceExp (H + matrixLog X) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * traceExp (H + matrixLog (R * X * R)) ≤
      traceExp (H + matrixLog (coordinatePinch k X)) at he
  rw [hinv] at he
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  change traceExp (H + matrixLog X) ≤ _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_coordinatePinched
statement:
private theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_coordinatePinched {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (h : Fin d → ℝ) (X : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hX : X.PosDef)
    (s : Finset (Fin d)) :
    (coordinatePinched s X).PosDef ∧
      traceExp (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog X) ≤
        traceExp (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog (coordinatePinched s X))
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using And.intro hX (le_refl (traceExp
      (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog X)))
  | @insert k s _ ih =>
    rw [coordinatePinched_insert]
    obtain ⟨hp, he⟩ := traceExp_add_matrixLog_coordinatePinch h _ ih.1 k
    exact ⟨hp, ih.2.trans he⟩

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_diagonal_endpoint
statement:
private theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_diagonal_endpoint
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (h : ι → ℝ) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hX : X.PosDef) :
    traceExp (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog (diagonal fun i => X i i)) =
      (Matrix.trace (matrixExp (diagonal fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * X)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hr (i : ι) : ((X i i).re : ℂ) = X i i := by
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (hX.isHermitian.apply i i)
  have hx (i : ι) : 0 < (X i i).re := (Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.diag_pos).1
  have hd : diagonal (fun i => X i i) = diagonal (fun i => ((X i i).re : ℂ)) := by
    congr 1
    exact (funext hr).symm
  have hl : matrixLog (diagonal fun i => X i i) =
      diagonal (fun i => (Real.log (X i i).re : ℂ)) := by
    rw [hd, matrixLog, cfc_diagonal_real]
  rw [traceExp_complex, hl, diagonal_add]
  simp only [← Complex.ofReal_add]
  rw [matrixExp_diagonal_real, matrixExp_diagonal_real]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (hx i)]

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_diagonal_le {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (h : Fin d → ℝ) (X : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hX : X.PosDef) :
    traceExp (diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) + matrixLog X) ≤
      (Matrix.trace (matrixExp (diagonal fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * X)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (traceExp_add_matrixLog_coordinatePinched h X hX Finset.univ).2
  rw [coordinatePinched_univ, traceExp_add_matrixLog_diagonal_endpoint h X hX] at hp
  exact hp

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_le_fin
statement:
private theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_le_fin {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (H X : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hX : X.PosDef) :
    traceExp (H + matrixLog X) ≤ (Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * X)).re
proof:
:= by
  let U := star hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hD : (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) * H * (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)ᴴ =
      diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) :=
    hH.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
  have hp := traceExp_add_matrixLog_diagonal_le hH.eigenvalues
    ((U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) * X * (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)ᴴ)
    ((posDef_unitary_conj_iff U X).2 hX)
  rw [← hD, traceExp_add_matrixLog_unitary_conj U H X hX.isHermitian,
    re_trace_matrixExp_mul_unitary_conj U H X] at hp
  exact hp

name: NLAlib.golden_thompson_fin
statement:
private theorem golden_thompson_fin {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (H K : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hK : K.IsHermitian) :
    traceExp (H + K) ≤ (Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * matrixExp K)).re
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hX, hlog⟩ := posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp K hK
  simpa only [hlog] using traceExp_add_matrixLog_le_fin H (matrixExp K) hH hX

name: NLAlib.golden_thompson
statement:
theorem golden_thompson {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (H K : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hK : K.IsHermitian) :
    traceExp (H + K) ≤ (Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * matrixExp K)).re
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl hi =>
    let := hi
    simp [traceExp, Matrix.trace]
  | inr hi =>
    let := hi
    let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
    let E := reindexStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := ℂ) e
    have hf := golden_thompson_fin (E H) (E K) (hH.reindex e) (hK.reindex e)
    have ha : E H + E K = E (H + K) := (map_add E H K).symm
    have he : matrixExp (E H) = E (matrixExp H) := matrixExp_reindex e H
    have heK : matrixExp (E K) = E (matrixExp K) := matrixExp_reindex e K
    rw [ha, he, heK, ← map_mul E] at hf
    change traceExp (Matrix.reindex e e (H + K)) ≤
      (Matrix.trace (Matrix.reindex e e (matrixExp H * matrixExp K))).re at hf
    simpa only [traceExp_reindex, trace_reindex] using hf

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_im_eq_zero_of_isHermitian
statement:
private theorem trace_mul_im_eq_zero_of_isHermitian {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (Matrix.trace (A * B)).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : star (Matrix.trace (A * B)) = Matrix.trace (A * B) := by
    rw [← Matrix.trace_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hB.eq, hA.eq,
      Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hs

name: NLAlib.golden_thompson_trace
statement:
theorem golden_thompson_trace {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (H K : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hK : K.IsHermitian) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixExp (H + K)) ≤ Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * matrixExp K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.le_def.mpr
  refine ⟨golden_thompson H K hH hK, ?_⟩
  have hleft : (Matrix.trace (matrixExp (H + K))).im = 0 := by
    have he : (matrixExp (H + K)).IsHermitian := (hH.add hK).exp
    have hs : star (Matrix.trace (matrixExp (H + K))) =
        Matrix.trace (matrixExp (H + K)) := by
      rw [← Matrix.trace_conjTranspose, he.eq]
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hs
  exact hleft.trans (trace_mul_im_eq_zero_of_isHermitian _ _ hH.exp hK.exp).symm

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_le
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (H X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hX : X.PosDef) :
    traceExp (H + matrixLog X) ≤ (Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * X)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (matrixLog X).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate Real.log X
  have he : matrixExp (matrixLog X) = X := CFC.exp_log X hX.isStrictlyPositive
  simpa only [he] using golden_thompson H (matrixLog X) hH hl

name: NLAlib.frobSq_krausMap_unital_defect_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
statement:
theorem frobSq_krausMap_unital_defect_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hcap : Real.exp (-eps) ≤ operatorCapacity (krausMap A)) :
    frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) +
      frobSq (krausMap (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose) 1 - 1) ≤ 6 * eps
proof:
:= by
  have hA' : krausMap (fun i => ((A i).conjTranspose).conjTranspose) 1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hA
  have hcap' : Real.exp (-eps) ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose)) := by
    rw [← operatorCapacity_krausMap_conjTranspose A]
    exact hcap
  have h := frobSq_krausMap_defect_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
    (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose) hA' heps hcap'
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.aeval_diagonal_ofReal
statement:
theorem aeval_diagonal_ofReal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    aeval (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (d i : 𝕜)) p =
      Matrix.diagonal fun i => ((p.eval (d i) : ℝ) : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (d i : 𝕜)) =
      (Algebra.ofId ℝ 𝕜).mapMatrix (Matrix.diagonal d) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, Algebra.ofId_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [h₁, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, Algebra.ofId_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_rectDiag_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_rectDiag_le {m n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hs : ∀ i, i < min m n → |s i| ≤ b) :
    specNorm (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hb).mp
  rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag,
    specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg b)).2
  intro j
  split_ifs with hj
  · rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    have h := hs j (lt_min hj j.isLt)
    simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hb).2 h
  · simpa using sq_nonneg b

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_mul_aeval_gram
statement:
theorem rectDiag_mul_aeval_gram (s : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) {m n : ℕ} :
    (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) *
      aeval ((rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)ᴴ *
        (rectDiag s : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)) p =
      rectDiag (fun i => s i * p.eval (s i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag,
    show (Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => if (j : ℕ) < m then ((s j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) =
      Matrix.diagonal fun j : Fin n => ((if (j : ℕ) < m then s j ^ 2 else 0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) by
      congr 1; funext j; split_ifs <;> simp,
    aeval_diagonal_ofReal]
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
  by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
  · simp [← hij, i.isLt]
  · simp only [if_neg hij, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.aeval_gram_diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one
statement:
theorem aeval_gram_diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    (s : k → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) (hne : ∀ i, p.eval (s i ^ 2) ≠ 0) :
    aeval ((Matrix.diagonal fun i => (s i : 𝕜))ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal fun i => (s i : 𝕜)) p *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (((p.eval (s i ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose,
    show star (fun i => (s i : 𝕜)) = fun i => (s i : 𝕜) by
      funext i; simp [Pi.star_apply, RCLike.conj_ofReal],
    Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal,
    show (fun i => (s i : 𝕜) * (s i : 𝕜)) = fun i => ((s i ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) by
      funext i; simp [sq],
    aeval_diagonal_ofReal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [← RCLike.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hne i), RCLike.ofReal_one]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_diagonal_inv_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_diagonal_inv_le {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    (s : k → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ i, c ≤ |p.eval (s i ^ 2)|) :
    specNorm (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (((p.eval (s i ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜)) ≤ 1 / c
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2
  intro i
  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, ← one_div]
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hc (hmin i)

name: NLAlib.exists_hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_affine
statement:
theorem exists_hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_affine
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (U H : M) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ)
    (hU : U + t • H ∈ (matrixKTransform ν α) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α) :
    ∃ B : M, B.IsHermitian ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + r • H)) B t ∧
      matrixKTransformDeriv ν α (matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + t • H)) B = H
proof:
:= by
  let S := matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + t • H)
  obtain ⟨hS, hKS⟩ := matrixKStableInverse_mem_and_transform_eq ν α hU
  obtain ⟨G, B, _hGa, _hG0, _hGd, hGR, hBH, hDB, hGeq, hstable⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_affine_branch ν hν α hα S hS H hH
  have hshift : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r - t) (𝓝 t) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => r - t) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [sub_self] using hc.tendsto t
  have hshiftC : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ((r - t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (𝓝 t) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_zero] using
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hshift
  have hevent : (fun r : ℝ => matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + r • H)) =ᶠ[𝓝 t]
      (fun r : ℝ => G ((r - t : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hshift.eventually hstable, hshiftC.eventually hGeq] with r hr hsolve
    have hsm : ((r - t : ℝ) : ℂ) • H = (r - t) • H :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ (r - t) H
    have hK : matrixKTransform ν α (G ((r - t : ℝ) : ℂ)) = U + r • H := by
      calc
        _ = matrixKTransform ν α S + ((r - t : ℝ) : ℂ) • H := hsolve.2
        _ = U + t • H + (r - t) • H := by rw [hKS, hsm]
        _ = U + r • H := by module
    rw [← hK]
    exact matrixKStableInverse_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα _ hr
  have hGR0 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => G v) B (t - t) := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using hGR
  have hGshift : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => G ((r - t : ℝ) : ℂ)) B t := by
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r - t) 1 t := by
      simpa only [id_eq] using (hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const t
    convert! hGR0.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (f := fun r : ℝ => r - t) hd using 1; simp
  exact ⟨B, hBH, hGshift.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent, hDB⟩

name: eval_mono

proof:

proof:

name: NLAlib.convexOn_relativeEntropy
statement:
theorem NLAlib.convexOn_relativeEntropy {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] :
    ConvexOn ℝ {P : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ |
      P.1.PosDef ∧ P.2.PosDef} (fun P => relativeEntropy P.1 P.2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro P hP Q hQ a b ha hb hab
    exact ⟨pd_combo _ _ hP.1 hQ.1 a b ha hb hab, pd_combo _ _ hP.2 hQ.2 a b ha hb hab⟩
  · intro P hP Q hQ a b ha hb hab
    have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
    have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hpers := matrixPerspective_jointly_operatorConvex (fun x => -Real.log x)
      operatorConvexOn_neg_log (jointTensorLeft P.1) (jointTensorLeft Q.1)
      (jointTensorRight P.2) (jointTensorRight Q.2)
      (left_pos _ hP.1) (left_pos _ hQ.1) (right_pos _ hP.2) (right_pos _ hQ.2)
      a ha ha1
    rw [← hb', ← left_combo, ← right_combo] at hpers
    have he := eval_mono _ _ hpers
    rw [eval_combo] at he
    change relativeEntropy (a • P.1 + b • Q.1) (a • P.2 + b • Q.2) ≤
      a * relativeEntropy P.1 P.2 + b * relativeEntropy Q.1 Q.2
    rw [relativeEntropy_eq_jointTensorEval_sub_trace _ _ (pd_combo _ _ hP.1 hQ.1 a b ha hb hab)
      (pd_combo _ _ hP.2 hQ.2 a b ha hb hab),
      relativeEntropy_eq_jointTensorEval_sub_trace _ _ hP.1 hP.2,
      relativeEntropy_eq_jointTensorEval_sub_trace _ _ hQ.1 hQ.2]
    have ht : (Matrix.trace (a • P.1 + b • Q.1 - (a • P.2 + b • Q.2))).re =
        a * (Matrix.trace (P.1 - P.2)).re + b * (Matrix.trace (Q.1 - Q.2)).re := by
      simp [Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.mul_re]
      ring
    rw [ht]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_le
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    specNorm (z • X + 1) ≤ specNorm A * specNorm X + ‖S‖ * specNorm X ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : z • X + 1 = A * X - S X * X := by
    have h := heq
    simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at h
    calc
      z • X + 1 = (z • X - A * X + S X * X) + A * X - S X * X + 1 := by abel
      _ = -1 + A * X - S X * X + 1 := by rw [h]
      _ = A * X - S X * X := by abel
  have hSX : ‖S X‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖X‖ := S.le_opNorm X
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖A * X‖ + ‖S X * X‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖X‖ + ‖S X‖ * ‖X‖ := add_le_add (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_mul_le _ _)
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖X‖ + (‖S‖ * ‖X‖) * ‖X‖ :=
      by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_mul_I_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_mul_I_le
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    specNorm (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • X + 1) ≤
      specNorm A * y⁻¹ + ‖S‖ * (y⁻¹) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hz : 0 < ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
  have hX : specNorm X ≤ y⁻¹ := by
    simpa using specNorm_le_inv_im_of_matrixDyson A hA S hS hz X hpos heq
  apply (specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_le A S _ X heq).trans
  have hnX : 0 ≤ specNorm X := by simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]; positivity
  have hsq : specNorm X ^ 2 ≤ (y⁻¹) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hnX hX 2
  exact add_le_add
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX (by simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]; positivity))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (norm_nonneg S))

name: NLAlib.tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixDyson
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixDyson
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero
  have hbound : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => specNorm A * y⁻¹ + ‖S‖ * (y⁻¹) ^ 2)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), add_zero] using
      (hinv.const_mul (specNorm A)).add ((hinv.pow 2).const_mul ‖S‖)
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ =>
      ‖((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 1‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)) ?_ hbound
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    have hz : 0 < ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
    exact specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_mul_I_le A hA S hS hy _
      (hpos _ hz) (heq _ hz)
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using hnorm

name: NLAlib.eq_real_stieltjes_extension_at_stable_matrixKTransform_solution
statement:
theorem eq_real_stieltjes_extension_at_stable_matrixKTransform_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (G : ℂ → M) (u : ℝ) (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z)
    (S : M) (hS : S∈matrixKStableDomain ν α)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1) : G u=α•S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H,C,hHa,hH0,hlocal⟩ := exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stable_branch_agrees_upper
    ν hν α hα F hF S hS.1 hS.2.1 hS.2.2 u hK
  let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (u : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I
  have hφc : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
  have hφ : Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [φ,Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] using
      (hφc.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have he : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, G (φ y)=α•H (φ y) := by
    filter_upwards [hφ.eventually hlocal,self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hyp
    have hz : 0<(φ y).im := by simpa [φ] using (show 0<y from hyp)
    rw [hGN _ hz,(hy hz).1]
  have hGlim := hGa.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hφ
  have hHlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => α•H (φ y)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (α•S)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,hH0] using
      (hHa.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hφ).const_smul α
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hGlim (hHlim.congr' (he.mono fun y hy => hy.symm))

name: NLAlib.exists_matrixKTransform_stable_scalar_stieltjes_seed
statement:
theorem exists_matrixKTransform_stable_scalar_stieltjes_seed
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (G : ℂ → M)
    (hGa : ∀ u : ℝ, (∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t) → AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z) :
    ∃ (u : ℝ) (S : M),
      (∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u+1≤t) ∧
      S∈matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧ matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1 ∧ G u=α•S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S0,hS0⟩ := (isConnected_matrixKStableDomain ν hν α hα).nonempty
  have hdom : S0∈matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS0.1.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S0 T.val hS0.1 (hS0.2.1 T hT)⟩
  have hKH : (matrixKTransform ν α S0).IsHermitian := by
    have hs := matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α S0 hdom
    rw [hS0.1.isHermitian.eq] at hs
    exact hs.symm
  let u := lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S0)-1
  let H : M := matrixKTransform ν α S0-(u : ℂ)•1
  have hH : H.PosDef := hKH.posDef_sub_smul_one_of_lt_lambdaMin (by
    change lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S0)-1 < lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S0)
    linarith)
  have hYS : S0∈(fun Y : selfAdjoint M => Y.val⁻¹) '' matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α := by
    rwa [image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
  obtain ⟨Y,hY,hYS⟩ := hYS
  change Y.val⁻¹=S0 at hYS
  obtain ⟨Z,_hZY,hZ,hKZ⟩ :=
    exists_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution ν hν α hα Y hY H hH
  have hst : Z.val⁻¹∈matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    rw [← image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
    exact ⟨Z,hZ,rfl⟩
  have hscalar : matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹=(u : ℂ)•1 := by
    rw [hKZ,hYS]
    dsimp only [H]
    abel
  have hmargin : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u+1≤t := by
    intro t ht
    have hh := support_subset_Ici_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_of_stable
      ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ S0 hS0 ht
    change lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S0)≤t at hh
    change lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S0)-1+1≤t
    linarith
  have hgap : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t := by
    intro t ht
    linarith [hmargin t ht]
  refine ⟨u,Z.val⁻¹,hmargin,hst,hscalar,?_⟩
  exact eq_real_stieltjes_extension_at_stable_matrixKTransform_solution
    ν hν α hα F hF G u (hGa u hgap) hGN Z.val⁻¹ hst hscalar

statement: private lemma cfc_continuousOn (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ A)
proof:
:= by

  exact (Set.finite_range _).continuousOn f

name: NLAlib.spectrum_pos'
statement: private lemma spectrum_pos' {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℝ A) : 0 < x
proof:
:=
  hA.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx

name: NLAlib.cfc_sqrt_mul_self
statement: theorem cfc_sqrt_mul_self : cfc Real.sqrt A * cfc Real.sqrt A = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_mul _ _ A (cfc_continuousOn hA _) (cfc_continuousOn hA _)]
  calc
    cfc (fun x => Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt x) A = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A :=
      cfc_congr fun x hx => Real.mul_self_sqrt (spectrum_pos' hA hx).le
    _ = A := cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt
statement: theorem cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt : cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A * cfc Real.sqrt A = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_mul _ _ A (cfc_continuousOn hA _) (cfc_continuousOn hA _)]
  calc
    cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹ * Real.sqrt x) A = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => 1) A :=
      cfc_congr fun x hx => inv_mul_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (spectrum_pos' hA hx)).ne'
    _ = 1 := cfc_one ℝ A hA.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt
statement: theorem cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt : cfc Real.sqrt A * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_mul _ _ A (cfc_continuousOn hA _) (cfc_continuousOn hA _)]
  calc
    cfc (fun x => Real.sqrt x * (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => 1) A :=
      cfc_congr fun x hx => mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (spectrum_pos' hA hx)).ne'
    _ = 1 := cfc_one ℝ A hA.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {R r u : ℝ} (s : ℝ)
    (hbranch : DifferentiableOn ℂ branch {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hr : 0 < r) (hu : 0 < u) (hRr : R < r) (hRu : R < u) :
    (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z)) =
      ∮ z in C(0, u), exp (branch z + s * z)
proof:
:=
  circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
    (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn
      (hbranch.add (differentiableOn_id.const_mul (s : ℂ)))) hr hu hRr hRu

name: NLAlib.traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
statement:
theorem traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ} {R r u : ℝ}
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hr : 0 < r) (hu : 0 < u) (hRr : R < r) (hRu : R < u) (s : ℝ) :
    traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s = traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a u s
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · rw [circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior s
      (hbranch i) hr hu hRr hRu]
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_div_sub_eq
statement:
theorem two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_div_sub_eq
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {a b t : ℂ} {R r : ℝ}
    (hbranch : DifferentiableOn ℂ branch {z | R < ‖z‖}) (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r)
    (htr : ‖t‖ < r) (hlim : Tendsto (fun z => branch z + b * z) (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 a)) :
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + b * z) / (z - t)) = exp a
proof:
:= by
  apply NLAlib.two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_div_sub_eq_of_tendsto
    (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn (hbranch.add (differentiableOn_id.const_mul b)))
    hr hRr htr
  exact Complex.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {a b t r : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hbranch : ContinuousOn branch (sphere 0 r)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun s => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z))))
      volume a b
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun s z => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * exp (branch z + s * z)
  have hF : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) (Icc a b ×ˢ sphere 0 r) := by
    have hb : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => branch p.2) (Icc a b ×ˢ sphere 0 r) :=
      hbranch.comp continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun _ hp => hp.2)
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · fun_prop
    · apply Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
      exact hb.add (by fun_prop)
  have heq : (fun s : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z)))) =
      (fun s => (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), F s z)) := by
    funext s
    dsimp [F]
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact (intervalIntegrable_circleIntegral_and_integral_circleIntegral_eq hab hr hF).1.const_mul _

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {l u t r : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (branch i) (sphere 0 r)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun s => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) volume l u
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i : ι) : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => if a i < s then
      exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z))) else 0) volume l u := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hlu]
    have h := intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul hlu hr (hbranch i)
      (t := t)
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hlu] at h
    have hi' : Integrable _ (volume.restrict (Ioc l u)) := h
    have hpoint : ((Ioi (a i)).indicator (fun s : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
        ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z))))) =
        (fun s : ℝ => if a i < s then exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z))) else 0) := by
      funext s
      by_cases hs : a i < s <;> simp [Set.indicator, hs]
    rw [← hpoint]
    exact hi'.indicator measurableSet_Ioi
  simp only [traceExponentialCircleDensity, Finset.mul_sum, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  exact (IntervalIntegrable.sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hi i)).congr
    (fun s _ => by simp only [Finset.sum_apply])

name: NLAlib.integral_ite_lt_eq_integral_lower
statement:
private theorem integral_ite_lt_eq_integral_lower
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {l a u : ℝ} (hla : l ≤ a) (hau : a ≤ u) :
    (∫ s in l..u, if a < s then f s else 0) = ∫ s in a..u, f s
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ s in l..u, (Ioi a).indicator f s) = _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (hla.trans hau), intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hau,
    integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi, Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_Ioi]
  have hset : Ioi a ∩ Ioc l u = Ioc a u := by
    ext s
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · exact fun hs => ⟨hs.1, hs.2.2⟩
    · exact fun hs => ⟨hs.1, hla.trans_lt hs.1, hs.2⟩
  rw [hset]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_sum_integral
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_sum_integral
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {l u t r : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u) (hla : ∀ i, l ≤ a i) (hau : ∀ i, a i ≤ u)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbranch : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (branch i) (sphere 0 r)) :
    (∫ s in l..u, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) =
      ∑ i, ∫ s in a i..u, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
        ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z)))
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i : ι) : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => if a i < s then
      exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z))) else 0) volume l u := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hlu]
    have h := intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul hlu hr (hbranch i)
      (t := t)
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hlu] at h
    have hi' : Integrable _ (volume.restrict (Ioc l u)) := h
    have hpoint : ((Ioi (a i)).indicator (fun s : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
        ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z))))) =
        (fun s : ℝ => if a i < s then exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z))) else 0) := by
      funext s
      by_cases hs : a i < s <;> simp [Set.indicator, hs]
    rw [← hpoint]
    exact hi'.indicator measurableSet_Ioi
  simp only [traceExponentialCircleDensity, Finset.mul_sum, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => hi i)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact integral_ite_lt_eq_integral_lower (hla i) (hau i)

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {a b t r : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ContinuousOn branch (sphere 0 r)) :
    (∫ s in a..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z)))) =
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r),
      exp (branch z) * (exp ((z - t) * b) - exp ((z - t) * a)) / (z - t))
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun s z => exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * exp (branch z + s * z)
  have hF : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) (Icc a b ×ˢ sphere 0 r) := by
    have hbranch' : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => branch p.2) (Icc a b ×ˢ sphere 0 r) :=
      hbranch.comp continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun _ hp => hp.2)
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · fun_prop
    · apply Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
      exact hbranch'.add (by fun_prop)
  have hswap := integral_circleIntegral_eq_circleIntegral_integral hab hr hF
  have hkernel (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ sphere 0 r) :
      (∫ s in a..b, F s z) =
        exp (branch z) * (exp ((z - t) * b) - exp ((z - t) * a)) / (z - t) := by
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    have hne : z - (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      have : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ = r := by simpa only [sub_eq_zero.mp heq] using hz'
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact htr.ne this
    have heq (s : ℝ) : F s z = exp (branch z) * exp ((z - t) * s) := by
      dsimp [F]
      rw [← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    simp_rw [heq]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_complex hne]
    ring
  calc
    _ = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∫ s in a..b, ∮ z in C(0, r), F s z) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      dsimp [F]
      rw [circleIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      ring
    _ = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ z in C(0, r), ∫ s in a..b, F s z) := by rw [hswap]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      exact circleIntegral.integral_congr hr hkernel

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_sub_atom
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_sub_atom
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {q : ℂ} {a b t R r : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : DifferentiableOn ℂ branch {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun z => branch z + (a : ℂ) * z) (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 q)) :
    (∫ s in a..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z)))) =
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + (z - t) * b) / (z - t)) -
        exp (q - (t : ℂ) * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ {z | R < ‖z‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    exact hRr.trans_eq hz'.symm
  have hc : ContinuousOn branch (sphere 0 r) := hbranch.continuousOn.mono hsub
  have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ sphere 0 r) : z - (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    have ht : |t| = r := by simpa [sub_eq_zero.mp heq] using hz'
    exact htr.ne ht
  have hci (s : ℝ) : CircleIntegrable
      (fun z => exp (branch z + (z - t) * s) / (z - t)) 0 r := by
    apply ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hr.le
    apply ContinuousOn.div _ (by fun_prop) hne
    apply Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
    exact hc.add (by fun_prop)
  have hsplit : (∮ z in C(0, r),
      exp (branch z) * (exp ((z - t) * b) - exp ((z - t) * a)) / (z - t)) =
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + (z - t) * b) / (z - t)) -
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + (z - t) * a) / (z - t)) := by
    rw [← circleIntegral.integral_sub (hci b) (hci a)]
    apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hr.le
    intro z _
    simp only [Complex.exp_add]
    ring
  have htail : (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + (z - t) * a) / (z - t)) =
        exp (q - (t : ℂ) * a) := by
    have heq (z : ℂ) : exp (branch z + (z - t) * a) / (z - t) =
        exp (-(t : ℂ) * a) * (exp (branch z + a * z) / (z - t)) := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring
    simp_rw [heq]
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    calc
      _ = exp (-(t : ℂ) * a) * ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + a * z) / (z - t))) := by ring
      _ = exp (-(t : ℂ) * a) * exp q := by
        rw [two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_div_sub_eq
          hbranch hr hRr (by simpa using htr) hlim]
      _ = exp (q - (t : ℂ) * a) := by rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  rw [integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul hab hr.le htr hc, hsplit, mul_sub, htail]

name: NLAlib.sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_sub_atoms
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {q : ι → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {b t R r : ℝ} (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b) (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
      (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (q i))) :
    (∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), (∑ i, exp (branch i z)) * exp ((z - t) * b) / (z - t)) -
        ∑ i, exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ {z | R < ‖z‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
