    exact hRr.trans_eq hz'.symm
  have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ sphere 0 r) : z - (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    have ht : |t| = r := by simpa [sub_eq_zero.mp heq] using hz'
    exact htr.ne ht
  have hci (i : ι) : CircleIntegrable
      (fun z => exp (branch i z + (z - t) * b) / (z - t)) 0 r := by
    apply ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hr.le
    apply ContinuousOn.div _ (by fun_prop) hne
    apply Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
    exact ((hbranch i).continuousOn.mono hsub).add (by fun_prop)
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + (z - t) * b) / (z - t)) -
          exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_sub_atom
        (hab i) hr hRr htr (hbranch i) (hlim i)
    _ = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ z in C(0, r), ∑ i, exp (branch i z + (z - t) * b) / (z - t)) -
          ∑ i, exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
        circleIntegral.integral_fun_sum (fun i _ => hci i)]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 2
      apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hr.le
      intro z _
      simp only [Complex.exp_add, Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_of_trace
statement:
theorem sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_of_trace
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {q : ι → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {T : ℂ → ℂ} {b t R r : ℝ} (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
      (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (q i)))
    (hT : DifferentiableOn ℂ T (closedBall 0 r))
    (htrace : ∀ z ∈ sphere 0 r, (∑ i, exp (branch i z)) = T z) :
    (∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =
      T t - ∑ i, exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_sub_atoms
    hab hr hRr htr hbranch hlim]
  congr 1
  let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => T z * exp ((z - t) * b)
  have hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (closedBall 0 r) :=
    hT.mul (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn
      ((differentiableOn_id.sub_const (t : ℂ)).mul_const (b : ℂ)))
  have ht : (t : ℂ) ∈ ball 0 r := by simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using htr
  have hcauchy : (∮ z in C(0, r), F z / (z - t)) =
      (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ) * T t := by
    simpa [F, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hF.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul ht
  calc
    _ = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), F z / (z - t)) := by
      congr 1
      apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hr.le
      intro z hz
      dsimp only [F]
      rw [htrace z hz]
    _ = T t := by
      rw [hcauchy, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (by simp [Real.pi_ne_zero])]

name: NLAlib.differentiable_trace_matrixExp_sub_smul
statement:
theorem differentiable_trace_matrixExp_sub_smul
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - z • B)))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => A - z • B) :=
    (differentiable_const A).sub (differentiable_id.smul_const B)
  have he : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => matrixExp (A - z • B)) := by
    intro z
    exact (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℂ) (A - z • B)).differentiableAt.comp z (hp z)
  exact (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.differentiable.comp he

name: NLAlib.sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype ι]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {q : ι → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {b t R r : ℝ} (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b) (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
      (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (q i)))
    (htrace : ∀ z ∈ sphere 0 r,
      (∑ i, exp (branch i z)) = Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - z • B))) :
    (∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • B)) - ∑ i, exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_of_trace hab hr hRr htr hbranch hlim
    (differentiable_trace_matrixExp_sub_smul A B).differentiableOn htrace

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype ι]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {q : ι → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {l u t R r : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u) (hla : ∀ i, l ≤ a i) (hau : ∀ i, a i ≤ u)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
      (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (q i)))
    (htrace : ∀ z ∈ sphere 0 r,
      (∑ i, exp (branch i z)) = Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - z • B))) :
    (∫ s in l..u, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • B)) - ∑ i, exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  have hc (i : ι) : ContinuousOn (branch i) (sphere 0 r) := by
    apply (hbranch i).continuousOn.mono
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    exact hRr.trans_eq hz'.symm
  rw [integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_sum_integral hlu hla hau hr.le hc]
  exact sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    A B hau hr hRr htr hbranch hlim htrace

name: NLAlib.contDiff_traceExp
statement:
theorem contDiff_traceExp {k : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ k (traceExp : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : ContDiff ℝ k (NormedSpace.exp : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    (show AnalyticOnNhd ℝ NormedSpace.exp Set.univ from
      fun A _ => NormedSpace.exp_analytic A).contDiff
  exact Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp
    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.contDiff.comp he)

name: NLAlib.iteratedDeriv_traceExp_add_smul_eq_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_traceExp_add_smul_eq_iteratedFDeriv
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k traceExp (A + t • H) (fun _ => H)
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℝ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ H
  have h := L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right
    (f := fun B => traceExp (A + B))
    (contDiff_traceExp.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id) : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) _)
    t (i := k) le_rfl
  have he := congrArg (fun T => T (fun _ : Fin k => (1 : ℝ))) h
  simpa only [L, iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, Function.comp_def,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, one_smul,
    iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left] using he

name: NLAlib.deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_fderiv
statement:
theorem deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_fderiv
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    deriv (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 = fderiv ℝ traceExp A H
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [iteratedDeriv_one, zero_smul, add_zero, iteratedFDeriv_one_apply] using
    iteratedDeriv_traceExp_add_smul_eq_iteratedFDeriv A H 1 0

name: NLAlib.iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_hessian
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_hessian
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 =
      traceExpHessian A H H
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_traceExp_add_smul_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, traceExpHessian, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv,
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_apply,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply]
  congr 1
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp

name: NLAlib.iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_smul_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_smul_zero
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (c : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • (c • H))) 0 =
      c ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_hessian,
    iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_hessian]
  simp only [map_smul, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem isHermitian_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ).IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) hA

name: NLAlib.spectrum_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem spectrum_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    spectrum ℝ ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) = spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U).toAlgEquiv A

name: NLAlib.cfc_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem cfc_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    cfc f ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) =
      (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * cfc f A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl h =>
      let := h
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | inr h =>
      let := h
      let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
      symm
      change E (cfc f A) = cfc f (E A)
      exact StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc E f A (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn f)
        E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional hA
        (isHermitian_unitary_conj U A hA)

name: NLAlib.matrixLog_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem matrixLog_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    matrixLog ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) =
      (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * matrixLog A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:=
  cfc_unitary_conj U Real.log A hA

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem matrixExp_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    matrixExp ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) =
      (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * matrixExp A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
  symm
  change E (NormedSpace.exp A) = NormedSpace.exp (E A)
  exact NormedSpace.map_exp_of_mem_ball (𝕂 := ℂ) E
    E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional A
    ((NormedSpace.expSeries_radius_eq_top ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ)).symm ▸ edist_lt_top _ _)

name: NLAlib.trace_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem trace_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
  simp only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.traceExp_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem traceExp_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    traceExp ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) = traceExp A
proof:
:= by
  unfold traceExp
  rw [matrixExp_unitary_conj, trace_unitary_conj]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_unitary_conj_iff
statement:
theorem posSemidef_unitary_conj_iff (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ).PosSemidef ↔ A.PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  Matrix.IsUnit.posSemidef_star_right_conjugate_iff (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := U))

name: NLAlib.posDef_unitary_conj_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_unitary_conj_iff (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef
proof:
:=
  Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := U))

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    (H A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceExp ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * H * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ +
      matrixLog ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ)) =
        traceExp (H + matrixLog A)
proof:
:= by
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
  change traceExp (E H + matrixLog (E A)) = _
  have hlog : matrixLog (E A) = E (matrixLog A) := matrixLog_unitary_conj U A hA
  rw [hlog, ← map_add E]
  exact traceExp_unitary_conj U _

name: NLAlib.trace_matrixExp_mul_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem trace_matrixExp_mul_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    (H A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixExp ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * H * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) *
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ)) =
        Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * A)
proof:
:= by
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
  change Matrix.trace (matrixExp (E H) * E A) = _
  have hexp : matrixExp (E H) = E (matrixExp H) := matrixExp_unitary_conj U H
  rw [hexp, ← map_mul E]
  exact trace_unitary_conj U _

name: NLAlib.re_trace_matrixExp_mul_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem re_trace_matrixExp_mul_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ))
    (H A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (Matrix.trace (matrixExp ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * H * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) *
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ))).re =
        (Matrix.trace (matrixExp H * A)).re
proof:
:=
  congrArg Complex.re (trace_matrixExp_mul_unitary_conj U H A)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_unitary_conj_of_conj_eq
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_unitary_conj_of_conj_eq
    (U : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (H A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * H * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ = H) :
    traceExp (H + matrixLog ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ)) =
      traceExp (H + matrixLog A)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    traceExp (H + matrixLog ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ)) =
        traceExp ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * (H + matrixLog A) * (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ) := by
      rw [matrixLog_unitary_conj U A hA, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hH]
    _ = traceExp (H + matrixLog A) := traceExp_unitary_conj U _

name: NLAlib.reflection_mem_unitary
statement:
private theorem reflection_mem_unitary (R : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) : R ∈ unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hR] using hR2

name: NLAlib.matrixLog_reflection_conj
statement:
theorem matrixLog_reflection_conj (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    matrixLog (R * A * R) = R * matrixLog A * R
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using
    matrixLog_unitary_conj ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ A hA

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_reflection_conj
statement:
theorem matrixExp_reflection_conj (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) :
    matrixExp (R * A * R) = R * matrixExp A * R
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using
    matrixExp_unitary_conj ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ A

name: NLAlib.traceExp_reflection_conj
statement:
theorem traceExp_reflection_conj (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) :
    traceExp (R * A * R) = traceExp A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using
    traceExp_unitary_conj ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ A

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_reflection_conj
statement:
theorem isHermitian_reflection_conj (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (R * A * R).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose R hA

name: NLAlib.spectrum_reflection_conj
statement:
theorem spectrum_reflection_conj (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) :
    spectrum ℝ (R * A * R) = spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using spectrum_unitary_conj ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ A

name: NLAlib.cfc_reflection_conj
statement:
theorem cfc_reflection_conj (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f (R * A * R) = R * cfc f A * R
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using cfc_unitary_conj ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ f A hA

name: NLAlib.posDef_reflection_conj_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_reflection_conj_iff (R A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) :
    (R * A * R).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using
    posDef_unitary_conj_iff ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ A

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_matrixLog_reflection_conj_of_conj_eq
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_matrixLog_reflection_conj_of_conj_eq (R H A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ = R) (hR2 : R * R = 1) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : R * H * R = H) :
    traceExp (H + matrixLog (R * A * R)) = traceExp (H + matrixLog A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hR] using
    traceExp_add_matrixLog_unitary_conj_of_conj_eq
      ⟨R, reflection_mem_unitary R hR hR2⟩ H A hA (by simpa only [hR] using hH)

name: NLAlib.cfc_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem cfc_diagonal_real (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    cfc f (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : ℂ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal fun i => (f (x i) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let := IsStarNormal.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := ι → ℂ)
  let := IsSelfAdjoint.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := ι → ℂ)
  let z : ι → ℂ := fun i => (x i : ℂ)
  have hx : IsSelfAdjoint z := by ext; simp [z]
  have hd : IsSelfAdjoint (diagonalStarAlgHom z) := hx.map diagonalStarAlgHom
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ z) := by
    rw [Pi.spectrum_eq]
    have heq : (⋃ i, spectrum ℝ (z i)) = Set.range x := by
      change (⋃ i, spectrum ℝ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ (x i))) = _
      simp only [spectrum.scalar_eq, Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range]
    rw [heq]
    exact Set.Finite.continuousOn (Set.finite_range _) _
  have heq := diagonalStarAlgHom.map_cfc (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := IsSelfAdjoint) f z hc
    (by change Continuous (fun z : ι → ℂ => Matrix.diagonal z); fun_prop) hx hd
  rw [cfc_map_pi (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := fun _ => IsSelfAdjoint) (S := ℂ) f z
    (by rwa [← Pi.spectrum_eq]) hx (fun i => by
      change star (x i : ℂ) = (x i : ℂ); simp)] at heq
  change Matrix.diagonal (fun i => cfc f (algebraMap ℝ ℂ (x i))) =
    cfc f (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : ℂ)) at heq
  simp only [cfc_algebraMap] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem matrixExp_diagonal_real (h : ι → ℝ) :
    matrixExp (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (h i : ℂ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal fun i => (Real.exp (h i) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (h i : ℂ)).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext i; simp)
  rw [matrixExp, ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hh]
  exact cfc_diagonal_real Real.exp h

name: NLAlib.trace_reindex
statement:
theorem trace_reindex {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (Matrix.reindex e e A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  exact Equiv.sum_comp e.symm (fun i => A i i)

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_reindex
statement:
theorem matrixExp_reindex {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    matrixExp (Matrix.reindex e e A) = Matrix.reindex e e (matrixExp A)
proof:
:= by
  let E := reindexStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := ℂ) e
  symm
  change E (NormedSpace.exp A) = NormedSpace.exp (E A)
  exact NormedSpace.map_exp_of_mem_ball (𝕂 := ℂ) E
    E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional A
    ((NormedSpace.expSeries_radius_eq_top ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ)).symm ▸ edist_lt_top _ _)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_reindex
statement:
theorem traceExp_reindex {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    traceExp (Matrix.reindex e e A) = traceExp A
proof:
:= by
  unfold traceExp
  rw [matrixExp_reindex, trace_reindex]

name: NLAlib.posDef_reindex_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_reindex_iff {n r : Type*} (e : n ≃ r) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (Matrix.reindex e e A).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  change (A.submatrix e.symm e.symm).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := h.submatrix e.injective
    have heq : (A.submatrix e.symm e.symm).submatrix e e = A := by
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [heq] at h'
    exact h'
  · intro h
    exact h.submatrix e.symm.injective

name: NLAlib.cfc_reindex_of_isHermitian
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl h =>
      have : IsEmpty r := e.symm.isEmpty
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | inr h =>
      let E := reindexStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := ℂ) e
      have hc : Continuous E :=
        E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
      symm
      change E (cfc f A) = cfc f (E A)
      exact StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := IsSelfAdjoint) E f A
        (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn f) hc hA (hA.reindex e)

name: NLAlib.matrixLog_reindex_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem matrixLog_reindex_of_isHermitian {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (e : n ≃ r) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    matrixLog (Matrix.reindex e e A) = Matrix.reindex e e (matrixLog A)
proof:
:= by
  let E := reindexStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := ℂ) e
  have hc : Continuous E := E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
  have hf : ContinuousOn Real.log (spectrum ℝ A) := by
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.finite_range _).continuousOn _
  symm
  change E (cfc Real.log A) = cfc Real.log (E A)
  exact StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := IsSelfAdjoint) E Real.log A
    hf hc hA (hA.reindex e)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem traceExp_diagonal_real (a : ι → ℝ) :
    traceExp (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ))) = ∑ i, Real.exp (a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceExp_complex, matrixExp_diagonal_real]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq,
    Complex.re_sum, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.mem_real_spectrum_of_orthonormal_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem mem_real_spectrum_of_orthonormal_congruence_diagonal
    (H U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (b : ι → ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hH : Uᴴ * H * U = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) (i : ι) :
    b i ∈ spectrum ℝ H
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : Uᴴ * U = 1 := hU
  have hright : U * Uᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hleft
  let V : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ) :=
    ⟨Uᴴ, by simpa only [Unitary.mem_iff, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
      using And.intro hright hleft⟩
  have hs := spectrum_unitary_conj V H
  have hdiag : (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * H * (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j => (b j : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [V, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hH
  rw [hdiag] at hs
  rw [← hs]
  apply (spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff ℂ).mp
  rw [spectrum_diagonal]
  exact ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_eq_one_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_eq_one_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty n]
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    operatorCapacity T = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold operatorCapacity
  have hset :
      {d : ℝ | ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re} =
        {1} := by
    ext d
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨X, hXpos, hXdet, hd⟩
      rw [hd]
      rw [Matrix.det_isEmpty]
      rfl
    · intro hd
      refine ⟨1, Matrix.PosDef.one, Matrix.det_one, ?_⟩
      rw [Matrix.det_isEmpty, hd]
      rfl
  rw [hset]
  exact csInf_singleton 1

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_krausMap_eq_trace_mul_krausMap_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem trace_mul_krausMap_eq_trace_mul_krausMap_conjTranspose
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (Y * krausMap A X).trace = (X * krausMap (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose) Y).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [krausMap_apply, krausMap_apply]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i hi
  calc
    (Y * (A i * X * (A i).conjTranspose)).trace
        = ((Y * A i) * X * (A i).conjTranspose).trace := by
          simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((A i).conjTranspose * Y * A i * X).trace := by
          simpa [Matrix.mul_assoc] using Matrix.trace_mul_cycle (Y * A i) X
            (A i).conjTranspose
    _ = (X * (A i).conjTranspose * Y * A i).trace := by
          simpa [Matrix.mul_assoc] using Matrix.trace_mul_comm
            ((A i).conjTranspose * Y * A i) X
    _ = (X * ((A i).conjTranspose * Y * ((A i).conjTranspose).conjTranspose)).trace := by
          simp [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_le_of_trace_eq
statement:
private theorem operatorCapacity_le_of_trace_eq
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T S : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)
    (hS : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (S X).PosSemidef)
    (htrace : ∀ X Y, (Y * T X).trace = (X * S Y).trace) :
    operatorCapacity T ≤ operatorCapacity S
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csInf (operatorCapacity_attainable_nonempty S)
  rintro d ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, rfl⟩
  apply ((hS Y hY.posSemidef).isGLB_determinantTraceObjectiveSet hN).2
  rintro v ⟨X, hX, hXdet, rfl⟩
  calc
    operatorCapacity T ≤ (T X).det.re :=
      csInf_le (operatorCapacity_attainable_bddBelow T hT) ⟨X, hX, hXdet, rfl⟩
    _ ≤ (RCLike.re (Y * T X).trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n :=
      (hT X hX.posSemidef).re_det_le_objective_of_det_one hN hY hYdet
    _ = (RCLike.re (X * S Y).trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n := by
      rw [htrace X Y]

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_eq_of_trace_eq
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_eq_of_trace_eq
    (T S : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)
    (hS : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (S X).PosSemidef)
    (htrace : ∀ X Y, (Y * T X).trace = (X * S Y).trace) :
    operatorCapacity T = operatorCapacity S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hN : 0 < Fintype.card n
  · exact le_antisymm
      (operatorCapacity_le_of_trace_eq hN T S hT hS htrace)
      (operatorCapacity_le_of_trace_eq hN S T hS hT fun X Y => (htrace Y X).symm)
  · have hcard0 : Fintype.card n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hN
    have : IsEmpty n := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hcard0
    rw [operatorCapacity_eq_one_of_isEmpty T, operatorCapacity_eq_one_of_isEmpty S]

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_conjTranspose
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap A) = operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose))
proof:
:= by
  exact operatorCapacity_eq_of_trace_eq (krausMap A) (krausMap (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose))
    (krausMap_posSemidef A) (krausMap_posSemidef (fun i => (A i).conjTranspose))
    (fun X Y => trace_mul_krausMap_eq_trace_mul_krausMap_conjTranspose A X Y)

name: NLAlib.nonneg_of_mem_real_spectrum_of_posSemidef
statement:
private theorem nonneg_of_mem_real_spectrum_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℝ A) : 0 ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i

name: NLAlib.posDef_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator
statement:
theorem posDef_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator (n : ℕ) {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : (aeval A (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_polynomial (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n) A hA.isHermitian]
  apply Matrix.IsStrictlyPositive.posDef
  apply (cfc_isStrictlyPositive_iff _ A (by fun_prop) hA.isHermitian).mpr
  intro x hx
  exact reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos n
    (nonneg_of_mem_real_spectrum_of_posSemidef hA hx)

name: NLAlib.inv_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eq_cfc
statement:
private theorem inv_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eq_cfc (n : ℕ)
    {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (aeval A (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n))⁻¹ =
      cfc (fun x => ((reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x)⁻¹) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_polynomial (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n) A hA.isHermitian,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  symm
  exact cfc_inv (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval A
    (fun x hx => (reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos n
    (nonneg_of_mem_real_spectrum_of_posSemidef hA hx)).ne')
      (by fun_prop) hA.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixExp_neg_sub_inv_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixExp_neg_sub_inv_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le
    (n : ℕ) {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    specNorm (matrixExp (-A) - (aeval A (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n))⁻¹) ≤
      Real.sqrt (40/21)/3^n
proof:
:= by
  let _ := normedAlgebraRealMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) (d := ι)
  have hpole : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => (reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos n
      (nonneg_of_mem_real_spectrum_of_posSemidef hA hx)).ne'
  have hcont : ContinuousOn
      (fun x => ((reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x)⁻¹) (spectrum ℝ A) :=
    (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).continuous.continuousOn.inv₀ hpole
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, show -A = (-1:ℝ) • A by simp,
    matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc A hA.isHermitian,
    inv_aeval_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eq_cfc n hA,
    ← cfc_sub (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-1*x))
      (fun x => ((reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x)⁻¹) A
      (by fun_prop) hcont]
  apply norm_cfc_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (a := A) (by positivity)
  intro x hx
  simpa only [neg_one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le n
      (nonneg_of_mem_real_spectrum_of_posSemidef hA hx)

name: NLAlib.exists_isMatrixSign_nonempty
statement:
private theorem exists_isMatrixSign_nonempty {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, z.re ≠ 0) : ∃ S, IsMatrixSign A S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hfg, hcop, hfr, hgr⟩ :=
    Polynomial.exists_coprime_factors_roots_partition A.charpoly A.charpoly_monic
      (fun z : ℂ => 0 < z.re)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hcop
  let P := aeval A (b * g)
  let Q := aeval A (a * f)
  have hsum : P + Q = 1 := by
    change aeval A (b * g) + aeval A (a * f) = 1
    rw [← map_add, add_comm (b * g), hab, map_one]
  have hzero : aeval A (f * g) = 0 := by rw [hfg, Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly]
  have hPQ : P * Q = 0 := by
    change aeval A (b * g) * aeval A (a * f) = 0
    calc
      _ = aeval A ((f * g) * (a * b)) := by rw [← map_mul]; congr 1; ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [map_mul, hzero, Matrix.zero_mul]
  have hQP : Q * P = 0 := by
    have hc := (Commute.all (a * f) (b * g)).map (aeval A)
    exact hc.eq.trans hPQ
  have hPP : P * P = P := by
    calc
      _ = P * P + P * Q := by rw [hPQ, add_zero]
      _ = P * (P + Q) := (Matrix.mul_add _ _ _).symm
      _ = P := by rw [hsum, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hQQ : Q * Q = Q := by
    calc
      _ = Q * P + Q * Q := by rw [hQP, zero_add]
      _ = Q * (P + Q) := (Matrix.mul_add _ _ _).symm
      _ = Q := by rw [hsum, Matrix.mul_one]
  refine ⟨P - Q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      (P - Q) ^ 2 = P * P - P * Q - Q * P + Q * Q := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hPP, hQQ, hPQ, hQP, sub_zero, sub_zero, hsum]
  · have hc := (Commute.all (X : ℂ[X]) (b * g - a * f)).map (aeval A)
    simpa only [map_sub, aeval_X] using hc
  · intro z hz
    have heq : (P - Q) * A = aeval A ((b * g - a * f) * X) := by
      simp only [map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, P, Q]
    rw [heq, spectrum.map_polynomial_aeval] at hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
    have hwroot : w ∈ A.charpoly.roots :=
      (Polynomial.mem_roots A.charpoly_monic.ne_zero).mpr
        (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp hw)
    have hbez : a.eval w * f.eval w + b.eval w * g.eval w = 1 := by
      simpa only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_one] using congrArg (eval w) hab
    by_cases hwpos : 0 < w.re
    · have hfw : f.eval w = 0 := (Polynomial.mem_roots hf.ne_zero).mp
        (by rw [hfr, Multiset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hwroot, hwpos⟩)
      have hbg : b.eval w * g.eval w = 1 := by simpa only [hfw, mul_zero, zero_add] using hbez
      simpa only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, hfw, mul_zero, hbg, sub_zero, one_mul] using hwpos
    · have hgw : g.eval w = 0 := (Polynomial.mem_roots hg.ne_zero).mp
        (by rw [hgr, Multiset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hwroot, hwpos⟩)
      have haf : a.eval w * f.eval w = 1 := by simpa only [hgw, mul_zero, add_zero] using hbez
      have hwneg : w.re < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hwpos) (hA w hw)
      simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, hgw, mul_zero, haf, zero_sub, neg_one_mul,
        Complex.neg_re]
      linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_isMatrixSign
statement:
theorem exists_isMatrixSign {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, z.re ≠ 0) : ∃ S, IsMatrixSign A S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    let := hn
    refine ⟨1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · exact Commute.one_right A
    · intro z hz
      simp only [spectrum.of_subsingleton, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at hz
  | inr hn =>
    let := hn
    exact exists_isMatrixSign_nonempty hA

name: NLAlib.isMatrixSign_matrixSign
statement:
theorem isMatrixSign_matrixSign {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, z.re ≠ 0) : IsMatrixSign A (matrixSign A)
proof:
:=
  Classical.epsilon_spec (exists_isMatrixSign hA)

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.eq_matrixSign
proof: := hS.eq (isMatrixSign_matrixSign hA)

name: NLAlib.kDenominator_swap_unit
statement:
private theorem kDenominator_swap_unit (S T : M) (hS : IsUnit S)
    (hL : IsUnit (1+S*T)) : IsUnit (1+T*S)
proof:
:= by
  have he : 1+T*S=S⁻¹*(1+S*T)*S := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)]
    simp only [Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [he]
  exact ((Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hS).mul hL).mul hS

name: NLAlib.kResolvent_adjoint_upper
proof:
:= by
  have hL := isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart S T hS hT
  have hR := kDenominator_swap_unit S T (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS) hL
  have hLa : IsUnit (1+Sᴴ*T) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hR.star
  have hRa : IsUnit (1+T*Sᴴ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hL.star
  have ht : (1+T*Sᴴ)*T=T*(1+Sᴴ*T) := by noncomm_ring
  have he : (1+T*Sᴴ)*matrixKResolvent Sᴴ T=T := by
    unfold matrixKResolvent
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,ht,Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hLa),Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    _ = (1+T*Sᴴ)⁻¹*((1+T*Sᴴ)*matrixKResolvent Sᴴ T) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hRa),
        Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = (1+T*Sᴴ)⁻¹*T := by rw [he]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [matrixKResolvent,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,hT.eq]

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent_dual
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent_dual (S T : M)
    (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    (imaginaryPart (matrixKResolvent S T) : M) =
      -((matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart S : M)*matrixKResolvent S T)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart S T hS hT
  have hR := kDenominator_swap_unit S T (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS) hL
  have hLa : IsUnit (1+Sᴴ*T) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hR.star
  have ha := kResolvent_adjoint_upper S T hS hT
  have hd := matrixKResolvent_sub_matrixKResolvent Sᴴ S T hLa hL
  rw [ha,show Sᴴ-S=-(S-Sᴴ) by abel,Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.neg_mul,neg_neg] at hd
  have he : matrixKResolvent S T-(matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ =
      -((matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ*(S-Sᴴ)*matrixKResolvent S T) := by
    calc
      _ = -((matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ-matrixKResolvent S T) := by abel
      _ = _ := congrArg Neg.neg hd
  simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  rw [he]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_neg]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixKResolvent_le_inv_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixKResolvent_le_inv_imaginaryPart (S T : M)
    (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (matrixKResolvent S T)≤specNorm ((imaginaryPart S : M)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let B : M := imaginaryPart S
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt B
  let U := matrixKResolvent S T
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hQ : Q.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRn : specNorm R^2=specNorm B⁻¹ := by
    rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self,hR.eq,
      ← inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hS]
  have hgram : (Q*U)ᴴ*(Q*U)=-(imaginaryPart U : M) := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hQ.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q Q,cfc_sqrt_mul_self hS]
    have hh := imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent_dual S T hS hT
    change (imaginaryPart U : M)=-(Uᴴ*B*U) at hh
    rw [hh,neg_neg]
    simp only [B,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hQU : specNorm (Q*U)^2≤specNorm U := by
    rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self,hgram,specNorm_neg]
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, ← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using imaginaryPart.norm_le U
  have hU : specNorm U≤specNorm R*specNorm (Q*U) := by
    calc
      _ = specNorm (R*(Q*U)) := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS,Matrix.one_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
  have hsquare : specNorm U^2≤specNorm B⁻¹*specNorm U := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (specNorm R*specNorm (Q*U))^2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg U) hU 2
      _ = specNorm B⁻¹*specNorm (Q*U)^2 := by rw [mul_pow,hRn]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQU (specNorm_nonneg B⁻¹)
  change specNorm U≤specNorm B⁻¹
  by_cases hz : specNorm U=0
  · simpa only [hz] using specNorm_nonneg B⁻¹
  · have hpos : 0<specNorm U := (specNorm_nonneg U).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hz)
    exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hpos).mp (by simpa only [pow_two,mul_comm] using hsquare)

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_inv_dual
statement:
private theorem imaginaryPart_inv_dual (S : M) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    (imaginaryPart S⁻¹ : M) = -(S⁻¹ᴴ*(imaginaryPart S : M)*S⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : S⁻¹ᴴ*Sᴴ=1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
  have hd : S⁻¹ᴴ*(S-Sᴴ)*S⁻¹=S⁻¹ᴴ-S⁻¹ := by
    calc
      _ = S⁻¹ᴴ*(S*S⁻¹)-(S⁻¹ᴴ*Sᴴ)*S⁻¹ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),hleft]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.one_mul]
  simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [hd]
  module

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_dual
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_dual
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef) :
    (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S) : M) =
      α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹ᴴ*(imaginaryPart S : M)*S⁻¹) -
        ∫ T, (matrixKResolvent S T.val)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart S : M)*matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hL (A : M) : L A=(imaginaryPart A : M) := rfl
  have hi := integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain ν hν
    (mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν hS)
  have he : L (∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) =
      -(∫ T, (matrixKResolvent S T.val)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart S : M)*matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) := by
    have heT (T : selfAdjoint M) : L (matrixKResolvent S T.val) =
        -((matrixKResolvent S T.val)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart S : M)*matrixKResolvent S T.val) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent_dual S T.val hS T.property
    rw [← L.integral_comp_comm hi]
    simp_rw [heT]
    rw [integral_neg]
  change L ((∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν)-α⁻¹•S⁻¹)=_
  rw [map_sub,map_smul,he,hL,imaginaryPart_inv_dual S (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS),
    smul_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.orderedMatrixExp_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem orderedMatrixExp_nil (z : ℂ) :
    orderedMatrixExp ([] : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) z = 1
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.orderedMatrixExp_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem orderedMatrixExp_cons (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    orderedMatrixExp (A :: H) z = matrixExp (z • A) * orderedMatrixExp H z
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.orderedMatrixExp_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem orderedMatrixExp_zero (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) : orderedMatrixExp H 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons A H ih => simp [orderedMatrixExp_cons, matrixExp, ih]

name: NLAlib.analyticAt_orderedMatrixExp
statement:
theorem analyticAt_orderedMatrixExp (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (orderedMatrixExp H) z
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | nil => exact analyticAt_const
  | cons A H ih =>
    change AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => matrixExp (w • A) * orderedMatrixExp H w) z
    have he : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => matrixExp (w • A)) z := by
      have hs : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w • A) z := analyticAt_id.smul analyticAt_const
      have hx : AnalyticAt ℂ (NormedSpace.exp : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (z • A) :=
        NormedSpace.exp_analytic _
      exact hx.comp (f := fun w : ℂ => w • A) hs
    exact he.mul ih

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orderedMatrixExp_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orderedMatrixExp_zero (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    HasDerivAt (orderedMatrixExp H) H.sum (0 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | nil =>
    convert! hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) using 1
  | cons A H ih =>
    have he := hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const A (0 : ℂ)
    have hp := he.mul ih
    convert! hp using 1
    simp only [List.sum_cons, zero_smul, NormedSpace.exp_zero,
      orderedMatrixExp_zero, one_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_orderedMatrixExp
statement:
theorem isUnit_orderedMatrixExp (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    IsUnit (orderedMatrixExp H z)
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  induction H with
  | nil => exact isUnit_one
  | cons A H ih => exact (NormedSpace.isUnit_exp (z • A)).mul ih

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_imaginary_smul_mem_unitary
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  apply NormedSpace.exp_mem_unitary_of_mem_skewAdjoint
  rw [skewAdjoint.mem_iff]
  simp [star_smul, hA.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq, mul_smul]

name: NLAlib.orderedMatrixExp_imaginary_mem_unitary
statement:
theorem orderedMatrixExp_imaginary_mem_unitary (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    orderedMatrixExp H ((t : ℂ) * I) ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | nil => exact (unitary _).one_mem
  | cons A H ih =>
    exact (unitary _).mul_mem (matrixExp_imaginary_smul_mem_unitary (hH A (by simp)) t)
      (ih (fun B hB => hH B (by simp [hB])))

name: NLAlib.selfAdjointPart_complex_smul_of_isHermitian
proof:
:= by
  simp only [selfAdjointPart_apply_coe, star_smul, hA.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]
  rw [← add_smul, Complex.star_def, Complex.add_conj]
  simp [← Complex.coe_smul, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.norm_matrixExp_complex_smul_le
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsSelfAdjoint (z.re • A) := (IsSelfAdjoint.all z.re).smul hA.isSelfAdjoint
  have hup : (selfAdjointPart ℝ (z • A) : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (|z.re| * ‖A‖) • 1 := by
    rw [selfAdjointPart_complex_smul_of_isHermitian hA]
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      hs.le_algebraMap_norm_self
  have h := specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_of_selfAdjointPart_le hup (t := 1) (by norm_num)
  simpa only [one_smul, one_mul, specNorm_eq_norm] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_orderedMatrixExp_le
statement:
theorem norm_orderedMatrixExp_le (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖orderedMatrixExp H z‖ ≤ Real.exp (|z.re| * (H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum)
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hn : Nonempty n
    · let := hn
      simp
    · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
      have hzero : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp [hzero]
  | cons A H ih =>
    simp only [orderedMatrixExp_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖matrixExp (z • A)‖ * ‖orderedMatrixExp H z‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ Real.exp (|z.re| * ‖A‖) * Real.exp (|z.re| * (H.map (fun B => ‖B‖)).sum) :=
        mul_le_mul (norm_matrixExp_complex_smul_le (hH A (by simp)) z)
          (ih (fun B hB => hH B (by simp [hB]))) (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.orderedMatrixExp_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem orderedMatrixExp_append (H K : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    orderedMatrixExp (H ++ K) z = orderedMatrixExp H z * orderedMatrixExp K z
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedMatrixExp, List.map_append, List.prod_append]

name: NLAlib.orderedMatrixExp_reverse_neg_mul
statement:
theorem orderedMatrixExp_reverse_neg_mul (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    orderedMatrixExp H.reverse (-z) * orderedMatrixExp H z = 1
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  induction H with
  | nil => simp
  | cons A H ih =>
    have hcancel : matrixExp ((-z) • A) * matrixExp (z • A) = 1 := by
      simp only [matrixExp, neg_smul]
      rw [← NormedSpace.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.refl (z • A)).neg_left,
        neg_add_cancel, NormedSpace.exp_zero]
    rw [List.reverse_cons, orderedMatrixExp_append]
    simp only [orderedMatrixExp_cons, orderedMatrixExp_nil, mul_one]
    calc
      _ = orderedMatrixExp H.reverse (-z) *
          ((matrixExp ((-z) • A) * matrixExp (z • A)) * orderedMatrixExp H z) := by
        simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hcancel, one_mul, ih]

name: NLAlib.norm_orderedMatrixExp_imaginary_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_orderedMatrixExp_imaginary_le_one (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖orderedMatrixExp H ((t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using norm_orderedMatrixExp_le H hH ((t : ℂ) * I)

name: NLAlib.norm_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_sum_norm
statement:
theorem norm_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_sum_norm (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.re| ≤ 1) :
    ‖orderedMatrixExp H z‖ ≤ Real.exp ((H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ (H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum := by
    apply List.sum_nonneg
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨A, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact norm_nonneg _
  apply (norm_orderedMatrixExp_le H hH z).trans
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_sum_norm_le_norm_orderedMatrixExp_right
statement:
theorem exp_neg_sum_norm_le_norm_orderedMatrixExp_right [Nonempty n]
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum) ≤
      ‖orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hrev : ∀ A ∈ H.reverse, A.IsHermitian := by simpa using hH
  have hInv := norm_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_sum_norm H.reverse hrev
    (z := -(1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) (by simp)
  rw [List.map_reverse, List.sum_reverse] at hInv
  have hprod := norm_mul_le (orderedMatrixExp H.reverse (-(1 + (t : ℂ) * I)))
    (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I))
  rw [orderedMatrixExp_reverse_neg_mul, norm_one] at hprod
  have he : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum) *
      ‖orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ :=
    hprod.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hInv (norm_nonneg _))
  rw [Real.exp_neg, ← one_div]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using he)

name: NLAlib.matrixKStabilityFrobenius_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixKStabilityFrobenius_apply
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) (x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) :
    hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα S hS hgap x) =
      matrixKStabilityMap ν α S (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.isSymmetric_matrixKStabilityFrobenius
statement:
theorem isSymmetric_matrixKStabilityFrobenius
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    (matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα S hS hgap).IsSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  change frobInner (matrixKStabilityMap ν α S (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x))
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n y) = frobInner (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x)
    (matrixKStabilityMap ν α S (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n y))
  exact (frobInner_matrixKStabilityMap_comm ν hν α S hS hgap _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_matrixKStabilityFrobenius
statement:
theorem posSemidef_matrixKStabilityFrobenius
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (hx : (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef) :
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα S hS hgap x)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKStabilityFrobenius_apply]
  exact posSemidef_matrixKStabilityMap ν hν α hα S hS hgap hx

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_matrixKTransformDeriv
statement:
theorem isHermitian_matrixKTransformDeriv
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    {Δ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hΔ : Δ.IsHermitian) :
    (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hH : (R*Δ*R).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [hR.eq] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose R hΔ
  have hD := hH.sub (isHermitian_matrixKStabilityMap ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap hH)
  rw [matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence ν hν α (ne_of_gt hα) S hS hgap Δ]
  have hh : (R * (R*Δ*R-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S (R*Δ*R)) * R).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [hR.eq] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose R hD
  exact hh.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all (α⁻¹))

name: NLAlib.re_det_eq_prod_eigenvalues
statement:
private theorem re_det_eq_prod_eigenvalues {M : Matrix n n ℂ} (hM : M.IsHermitian) :
    M.det.re = ∏ i, hM.eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by
  rw [hM.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues, ← RCLike.ofReal_prod]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.pow_one_sub_sqrt_le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_of_adjoint_normalized
statement:
theorem pow_one_sub_sqrt_le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_of_adjoint_normalized
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) ≤ ε)
    (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1)) :
    (1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ε)) ^ Fintype.card n ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap A)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csInf (operatorCapacity_attainable_nonempty (krausMap A))
  rintro d ⟨X, hX, hXdet, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hcol, hrow, heig⟩ := exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues A hA hX.posSemidef
  have hprod : ∏ i, hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues i = 1 := by
    rw [← re_det_eq_prod_eigenvalues hX.isHermitian, hXdet]
    rfl
  have hbound := Matrix.mul_prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_col_sum_one
    W hW hcol (hrow.trans hε) hεsmall hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues
      (fun i => hX.eigenvalues_pos i)
  rw [hprod, mul_one, heig] at hbound
  simpa only [re_det_eq_prod_eigenvalues
    (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX.posSemidef).isHermitian] using hbound

name: NLAlib.pow_one_sub_sqrt_le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_of_unital
statement:
theorem pow_one_sub_sqrt_le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_of_unital
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ≤ ε)
    (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1)) :
    (1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ε)) ^ Fintype.card n ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [operatorCapacity_krausMap_conjTranspose A]
  apply pow_one_sub_sqrt_le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_of_adjoint_normalized
    (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) ?_ hε hεsmall
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hA

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileRadius_nonneg
statement:
theorem varianceProfileRadius_nonneg (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    0 ≤ varianceProfileRadius B v i
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileRadius_sq
statement:
theorem varianceProfileRadius_sq (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    varianceProfileRadius B v i ^ 2 = ∑ j, B i j * v j ^ 2
proof:
:=
  Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hB i j) (sq_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm
statement:
theorem varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    varianceProfileRadius B v i =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * v j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * v j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hB i _)] at hsq
  have hr := varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB v i
  nlinarith [varianceProfileRadius_nonneg B v i,
    norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * v j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)]

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileRadius_add_le
statement:
theorem varianceProfileRadius_add_le (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (v w : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    varianceProfileRadius B (v + w) i ≤ varianceProfileRadius B v i + varianceProfileRadius B w i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm B hB]
  have hv : (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * (v + w) j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * v j) +
        WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * w j) := by
    rw [WithLp.ext_iff]
    funext j
    simp only [WithLp.ofLp_add, Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  rw [hv]
  exact norm_add_le _ _

name: NLAlib.abs_varianceProfileRadius_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_varianceProfileRadius_sub_le
    (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (v w : n → ℝ) (i : n)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hrow : ∀ j, B i j ≤ L ^ 2) :
    |varianceProfileRadius B v i - varianceProfileRadius B w i| ≤
      L * Real.sqrt (∑ j, (v j - w j) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff :
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * v j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) -
        WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * w j) =
          WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * (v - w) j) := by
    rw [WithLp.ext_iff]
    funext j
    simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hnorm := abs_norm_sub_norm_le
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * v j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * w j))
  rw [hdiff, ← varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm B hB,
    ← varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm B hB, ← varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm B hB] at hnorm
  apply hnorm.trans
  have hsq : varianceProfileRadius B (v - w) i ^ 2 ≤
      (L * Real.sqrt (∑ j, (v j - w j) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB, mul_pow,
      Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _), Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrow j) (sq_nonneg _)
  nlinarith [varianceProfileRadius_nonneg B (v - w) i,
    mul_nonneg hL (Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ j, (v j - w j) ^ 2))]

name: NLAlib.squareDifferenceForm_eq_radius_sum
statement:
private theorem squareDifferenceForm_eq_radius_sum
    (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (v w : n → ℝ) :
    varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w =
      ∑ i, (v i ^ 2 - w i ^ 2) *
        (varianceProfileRadius B v i ^ 2 - varianceProfileRadius B w i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm, varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_mul_varianceProfileRadius_add_sq_add_form_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_mul_varianceProfileRadius_add_sq_add_form_le
    (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (v w : n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * varianceProfileRadius B (v + w) i ^ 2) +
        varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w ≤
      4 * (∑ i, (varianceProfileDeformation B v i - varianceProfileDeformation B w i) ^ 2) -
        varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w
proof:
:= by
  have htri : (∑ i, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * varianceProfileRadius B (v + w) i ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ i, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * (varianceProfileRadius B v i + varianceProfileRadius B w i) ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (varianceProfileRadius_nonneg _ _ _)
        (varianceProfileRadius_add_le B hB v w i) 2) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hcoord (i : n) :
      (v i - w i) ^ 2 * (varianceProfileRadius B v i + varianceProfileRadius B w i) ^ 2 +
          2 * ((v i ^ 2 - w i ^ 2) *
            (varianceProfileRadius B v i ^ 2 - varianceProfileRadius B w i ^ 2)) ≤
        4 * (varianceProfileDeformation B v i - varianceProfileDeformation B w i) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [varianceProfileDeformation]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((v i + w i) * (varianceProfileRadius B v i - varianceProfileRadius B w i))]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n)) => hcoord i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    ← squareDifferenceForm_eq_radius_sum B hB] at hsum
  linarith

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_eq_radius_add_form
statement:
theorem varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_eq_radius_add_form
    (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (v w : n → ℝ) :
    varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq B v w =
      (∑ i, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * varianceProfileRadius B (v + w) i ^ 2) +
        varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : (∑ i, ∑ j, (v j - w j) ^ 2 * B i j * (v i + w i) ^ 2) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * B i j * (v j + w j) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [hsymm.apply j i]
  have hpoint : (2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, B i j * (v i * v j - w i * w j) ^ 2) =
      ((∑ i, ∑ j, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * B i j * (v j + w j) ^ 2) +
        (∑ i, ∑ j, (v j - w j) ^ 2 * B i j * (v i + w i) ^ 2)) / 2 +
        varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w := by
    simp only [varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  rw [varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq, hpoint, hswap]
  have hradius : (∑ i, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * varianceProfileRadius B (v + w) i ^ 2) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i - w i) ^ 2 * B i j * (v j + w j) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB, Finset.mul_sum, Pi.add_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  rw [hradius]
  ring

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_le_deformation
statement:
theorem varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_le_deformation
    (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (v w : n → ℝ) :
    varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq B v w ≤
      4 * (∑ i, (varianceProfileDeformation B v i - varianceProfileDeformation B w i) ^ 2) -
        varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_eq_radius_add_form B hB hsymm]
  exact sum_sq_mul_varianceProfileRadius_add_sq_add_form_le B hB v w

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_varianceProfileDeformation_le
statement:
theorem sum_mul_varianceProfileDeformation_le
    (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (v g : n → ℝ)
    (hv : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ 1) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hrows : ∀ j, ∑ i, B i j * g i ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2) :
    ∑ i, g i * varianceProfileDeformation B v i ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∑ i, (g i * varianceProfileRadius B v i) ^ 2) ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    simp only [mul_pow, varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB, Finset.mul_sum]
    have heq : (∑ i, ∑ j, g i ^ 2 * (B i j * v j ^ 2)) =
        ∑ j, v j ^ 2 * ∑ i, B i j * g i ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    rw [heq]
    calc _ ≤ ∑ j, v j ^ 2 * R ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrows j) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (∑ j, v j ^ 2) * R ^ 2 := (Finset.sum_mul ..).symm
      _ ≤ R ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg R]
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ v
    (fun i => g i * varianceProfileRadius B v i)
  have he0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (g i * varianceProfileRadius B v i) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hprod : (∑ i, v i ^ 2) * (∑ i, (g i * varianceProfileRadius B v i) ^ 2) ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ i, (g i * varianceProfileRadius B v i) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ R ^ 2 := he
  have heq : (∑ i, g i * varianceProfileDeformation B v i) =
      ∑ i, v i * (g i * varianceProfileRadius B v i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp [varianceProfileDeformation]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith [hcs.trans hprod]

name: NLAlib.inSquareMassBall_convex
statement:
private theorem inSquareMassBall_convex {r M t : ℝ} {U V : ι → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hU : InSquareMassBall r M U) (hV : InSquareMassBall r M V)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    InSquareMassBall r M (fun i => (1 - t) • U i + t • V i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ((hU.1 i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)).add
    ((hV.1 i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(1 - t) • U i‖ + ‖t • V i‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = (1 - t) * specNorm (U i) + t * specNorm (V i) := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1), abs_of_nonneg ht0]
        rfl
      _ ≤ (1 - t) * r + t * r := add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hU.2.1 i) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hV.2.1 i) ht0)
      _ = r := by ring
  · calc
      _ ≤ (1 - t) * specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + t * specNorm (∑ i, V i ^ 2) :=
        specNorm_sum_one_sub_smul_add_smul_sq_le U V hU.1 hV.1 ht0 ht1
      _ ≤ (1 - t) * M + t * M := add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hU.2.2 (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV.2.2 ht0)
      _ = M := by ring

name: NLAlib.inSquareMassBall_zero
statement:
private theorem inSquareMassBall_zero {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    InSquareMassBall r M (fun _ : ι => (0 : Matrix n n ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => Matrix.isHermitian_zero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [specNorm_zero] using hr
  · simpa only [zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero, specNorm_zero] using hM

name: NLAlib.inSquareMassBall_neg
statement:
private theorem inSquareMassBall_neg {r M : ℝ} {U : ι → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hU : InSquareMassBall r M U) : InSquareMassBall r M (fun i => -U i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => (hU.1 i).neg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_neg] using hU.2.1 i
  · simpa only [neg_sq] using hU.2.2

name: NLAlib.norm_and_specNorm_sum_sq_copy_directions_le
statement:
theorem norm_and_specNorm_sum_sq_copy_directions_le
    (Z : Fin 3 → ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hHerm : ∀ s i, (Z s i).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ s i, specNorm (Z s i) ≤ R)
    {u v a : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    let M
proof:
:= 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, Z 0 i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, Z 1 i ^ 2) +
      specNorm (∑ i, Z 2 i ^ 2))
    let D := fun i => Z 0 i - Z 1 i
    let E := fun i => (Z 1 i - Z 2 i) + u • (Z 0 i - Z 1 i)
    let H := fun i => a • ((1 - v) • Z 2 i + (v * (1 - u)) • Z 1 i +
      (u * v) • Z 0 i - Z 0 i)
    ((∀ i, (D i).IsHermitian) ∧ (∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ 2 * R) ∧ specNorm (∑ i, D i ^ 2) ≤ M) ∧
      ((∀ i, (E i).IsHermitian) ∧ (∀ i, specNorm (E i) ≤ 2 * R) ∧ specNorm (∑ i, E i ^ 2) ≤ M) ∧
      ((∀ i, (H i).IsHermitian) ∧ (∀ i, specNorm (H i) ≤ 2 * R) ∧ specNorm (∑ i, H i ^ 2) ≤ M) := by
  let M := 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, Z 0 i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, Z 1 i ^ 2) +
    specNorm (∑ i, Z 2 i ^ 2))
  have hm (s : Fin 3) : 0 ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z s i ^ 2) := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp only [M]; linarith [hm 0, hm 1, hm 2]
  have hdiff (s t : Fin 3)
      (hst : 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, Z s i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, Z t i ^ 2)) ≤ M) :
      InSquareMassBall (2 * R) M (fun i => Z s i - Z t i) := by
    refine ⟨fun i => (hHerm s i).sub (hHerm t i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have h := (specNorm_sub_le (Z s i) (Z t i)).trans (add_le_add (hZ s i) (hZ t i))
      linarith
    · exact (specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le (Z s) (Z t) (hHerm s) (hHerm t)).trans hst
  have h01 := hdiff 0 1 (by dsimp only [M]; linarith [hm 2])
  have h12 := hdiff 1 2 (by dsimp only [M]; linarith [hm 0])
  have h02 := hdiff 0 2 (by dsimp only [M]; linarith [hm 1])
  have hZero := inSquareMassBall_zero (ι := ι) (n := n) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * R) hM
  have hE := inSquareMassBall_convex h12 h02 hu0 hu1
  have hInner := inSquareMassBall_convex (inSquareMassBall_neg h01) hZero hu0 hu1
  have hOuter := inSquareMassBall_convex (inSquareMassBall_neg h02) hInner hv0 hv1
  have hH := inSquareMassBall_convex hZero hOuter ha0 ha1
  have hEeq : (fun i => (1 - u) • (Z 1 i - Z 2 i) + u • (Z 0 i - Z 2 i)) =
      (fun i => (Z 1 i - Z 2 i) + u • (Z 0 i - Z 1 i)) := by funext i; module
  have hHeq : (fun i => (1 - a) • (0 : Matrix n n ℂ) +
      a • ((1 - v) • (-(Z 0 i - Z 2 i)) + v •
        ((1 - u) • (-(Z 0 i - Z 1 i)) + u • (0 : Matrix n n ℂ)))) =
      (fun i => a • ((1 - v) • Z 2 i + (v * (1 - u)) • Z 1 i +
        (u * v) • Z 0 i - Z 0 i)) := by funext i; module
  rw [hEeq] at hE
  rw [hHeq] at hH
  exact ⟨h01, hE, hH⟩

name: NLAlib.normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {R r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hRr : R < r)
    (href : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ → branch (conj z) = conj (branch z)) (s : ℝ) :
    ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + (s : ℂ) * z))).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply circleIntegral.normalized_im_eq_zero_of_conj_eq
  intro z hz
  have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, abs_of_nonneg hr] using hz
  rw [href z (hRr.trans_eq hz'.symm), ← Complex.exp_conj]
  congr 1
  simp

name: NLAlib.sum_ite_normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_ite_normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] {branch : n → ℂ → ℂ} {R r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hRr : R < r)
    (href : ∀ i z, R < ‖z‖ → branch i (conj z) = conj (branch i z))
    (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, if b i < s then (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + (s : ℂ) * z)) else 0).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Complex.im_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · exact normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero hr hRr (href i) s
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_real_circle_density
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_real_circle_density
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      (∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
          Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R < r → ∀ s : ℝ,
        (∑ i, if b i < s then (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + (s : ℂ) * z)) else 0).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, href⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal_conj_eq hA b hb
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, ?_⟩
  intro r hr s
  exact sum_ite_normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
    (hR.trans hr).le hr href b s

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_re_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_re_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {branch : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hspec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z))
    {r : ℝ} (hRr : R < r) {l u : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u)
    (hbu : ∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) (t : ℝ) :
          IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) volume l u ∧
          (∫ s in l..u, Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
            traceExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) -
              ∑ i, Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont (i : n) : ContinuousOn (branch i) (sphere 0 r) := by
    apply (hbranch i).1.continuousOn.mono
    intro z hz
    have heq : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    change R < ‖z‖
    rwa [heq]
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s) volume l u :=
    intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity hlu (hR.trans hRr).le hcont
  let v : ℝ := max r |t| + 1
  have hrv : r < v := by dsimp [v]; linarith [le_max_left r |t|]
  have htv : |t| < v := by dsimp [v]; linarith [le_max_right r |t|]
  have hRv : R < v := hRr.trans hrv
  have hrad (s : ℝ) : traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s =
      traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b v s :=
    traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
      (fun i => (hbranch i).1) (hR.trans hRr) (hR.trans hRv) hRr hRv s
  have hcomplex : (∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) -
        ∑ i, Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * b i) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b v s := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s _
        dsimp only
        rw [hrad s]
      _ = _ := by
        apply integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
          A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) hlu
          (fun i => (hbu i).1) (fun i => (hbu i).2)
          (hR.trans hRv) hRv htv (fun i => (hbranch i).1) (fun i => (hbranch i).2)
        intro z hz
        have heq : ‖z‖ = v := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
        have hs := hspec z (hRv.trans_eq heq.symm)
        exact (trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_injective_mem_spectrum _ _ hs.2 hs.1).symm
  have hweight (s : ℝ) :
      (Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re =
      Real.exp (-t * s) * (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re := by
    have he : Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) = (Real.exp (-t * s) : ℂ) := by
      simp
    simp only [he, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  have hintre : IntervalIntegrable (fun s =>
      (Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re)
      volume l u := ⟨hint.1.re, hint.2.re⟩
  refine ⟨by simpa only [hweight] using hintre, ?_⟩
  have hreInt : (∫ s in l..u,
      (Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
      (∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
        traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re :=
    intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_re hint
  have hres := hreInt.trans (congrArg Complex.re hcomplex)
  have hatom (i : n) : (Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * b i)).re =
      Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i) := by
    have hdiag : ((A i i).re : ℂ) = A i i := Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (hA.apply i i)
    rw [← hdiag]
    simpa using Complex.exp_ofReal_re ((A i i).re - t * b i)
  simpa only [hweight, Complex.sub_re, Complex.re_sum, hatom, traceExp_complex] using hres

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_integral_real_circleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_integral_real_circleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R < r →
        (∀ s : ℝ, (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).im = 0) ∧
        ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) → ∀ t : ℝ,
          IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) volume l u ∧
          (∫ s in l..u, Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
            traceExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) -
              ∑ i, Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec, hreal⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_real_circle_density hA b hb
  exact ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, fun r hr => ⟨hreal r hr,
    fun _ _ hlu hbu t => integral_exp_mul_re_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
      hA b hR hbranch hspec hr hlu hbu t⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_apply
statement:
theorem coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_apply
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (Y : Fin 4 → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y =
      (coefficientCrossingSum A B (Y 0) (Y 1) (Y 2)*Y 3).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear,sumTraceWordMultilinear_apply,
    coefficientCrossingSum,List.ofFn_succ,Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type,Matrix.trace_sum,Finset.sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.trace_crossing_rotate
statement:
private theorem trace_crossing_rotate (A B U V W Z : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    (A*U*B*V*A*W*B*Z).trace = (B*V*A*W*B*Z*A*U).trace
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using
    Matrix.trace_mul_comm (A*U) (B*V*A*W*B*Z)

name: NLAlib.coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_rotate
statement:
theorem coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_rotate
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (Y : Fin 4 → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y =
      coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear B A ![Y 1,Y 2,Y 3,Y 0]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_apply,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    coefficientCrossingSum,Finset.sum_mul,Matrix.trace_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact trace_crossing_rotate _ _ _ _ _ _

name: NLAlib.norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_last_le
statement:
private theorem norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_last_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (Y : Fin 4 → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      (specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*
        specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*specNorm (coefficientStack B))*
          nuclearNorm (Y 3)*(specNorm (Y 0)*specNorm (Y 1)*specNorm (Y 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_apply]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (coefficientCrossingSum A B (Y 0) (Y 1) (Y 2))*
        nuclearNorm (Y 3) := by
      apply (norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm _).trans
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using
        schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul
          (coefficientCrossingSum A B (Y 0) (Y 1) (Y 2)) (Y 3) (p := 1) zero_lt_one
    _ ≤ ((specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*
        specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*specNorm (coefficientStack B))*
        (specNorm (Y 0)*specNorm (Y 1)*specNorm (Y 2)))*nuclearNorm (Y 3) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (specNorm_coefficientCrossingSum_le_stack_vectorization A B hA _ _ _)
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using schattenNormReal_nonneg (Y 3) 1
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint
statement:
theorem norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hB : ∀ j, (B j).IsHermitian)
    (Y : Fin 4 → Matrix d d ℂ) (j : Fin 4) :
    ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      (specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*
        specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*specNorm (coefficientStack B))*
          nuclearNorm (Y j)*∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)
proof:
:= by
  let C := specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*
    specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*specNorm (coefficientStack B)
  have hswap : specNorm (coefficientStack B)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*
      specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*specNorm (coefficientStack A)=C := by
    dsimp [C]
    ring
  have h1 := norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_last_le B A hB ![Y 1,Y 2,Y 3,Y 0]
  have h2 := norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_last_le A B hA ![Y 2,Y 3,Y 0,Y 1]
  have h3 := norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_last_le B A hB ![Y 3,Y 0,Y 1,Y 2]
  have h4 := norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_last_le A B hA Y
  have hr1 := coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_rotate A B Y
  have hr2 := coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_rotate B A ![Y 1,Y 2,Y 3,Y 0]
  have hr3 := coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_rotate A B ![Y 2,Y 3,Y 0,Y 1]
  simp at h1 h2 h3 hr2 hr3
  fin_cases j
  · change ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      C*nuclearNorm (Y 0)*∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 0, specNorm (Y l)
    have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 0 = {1,2,3} := by decide
    rw [he]
    rw [hr1]
    simpa [hswap,C,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using h1
