  · change ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      C*nuclearNorm (Y 1)*∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 1, specNorm (Y l)
    have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 1 = {0,2,3} := by decide
    rw [he]
    rw [hr1,hr2]
    simpa [C,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using h2
  · change ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      C*nuclearNorm (Y 2)*∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 2, specNorm (Y l)
    have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 2 = {0,1,3} := by decide
    rw [he]
    rw [hr1,hr2,hr3]
    simpa [hswap,C,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using h3
  · change ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      C*nuclearNorm (Y 3)*∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 3, specNorm (Y l)
    have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)).erase 3 = {0,1,2} := by decide
    rw [he]
    simpa [C,mul_assoc] using h4

name: NLAlib.norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm
statement:
theorem norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hB : ∀ j, (B j).IsHermitian)
    (p : Fin 4 → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ l, 1 ≤ p l)
    (hsum : ∑ l, ((p l)⁻¹).toReal = 1) (Y : Fin 4 → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B Y‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance B))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance B)))*
          ∏ l, schattenNorm (Y l) (p l)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ specNorm (coefficientStack A)*specNorm (coefficientVectorization A)*
      specNorm (coefficientVectorization B)*specNorm (coefficientStack B) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have h := norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm_of_endpoints
    (coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B) hC
    (fun j Y => norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_le_nuclear_endpoint A B hA hB Y j)
    p hp hsum Y
  simpa only [specNorm_coefficientStack_eq_sqrt_variance A hA,
    specNorm_coefficientStack_eq_sqrt_variance B hB,
    specNorm_coefficientVectorization_eq_sqrt_covariance] using h

name: NLAlib.re_normalizedTrace_eq_div_card
statement:
private theorem re_normalizedTrace_eq_div_card (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (normalizedTrace B).re = B.trace.re / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ =
      (((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
  rw [normalizedTrace, hc]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    mul_zero, sub_zero, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (p : ℕ) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p =
      (normalizedTrace (resolvent A ζ ^ p * resolvent A (star ζ) ^ p)).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolventEvenMoment, hA.conjTranspose_resolvent]
  rw [(commute_resolvent A (star ζ) ζ).mul_pow,
    normalizedTrace_mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
statement:
private theorem resolventEvenMoment_eq_zero_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) (p : ℕ) : resolventEvenMoment A ζ p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [resolventEvenMoment, normalizedTrace]

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p =
      schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p) /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram (resolvent A ζ) hp
  change schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p) =
    (((resolvent A ζ)ᴴ * resolvent A ζ) ^ p).trace.re at hm
  unfold resolventEvenMoment
  rw [re_normalizedTrace_eq_div_card, ← hm]

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) : 0 ≤ resolventEvenMoment A ζ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card A ζ hp]
  exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.resolventEvenMoment_pos
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.resolventEvenMoment_pos [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) : 0 < NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment A ζ p
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ζ ∈ resolventSet ℂ A := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) ζ - A)
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
  have hR : resolvent A ζ ≠ 0 := (spectrum.isUnit_resolvent.mp hu).ne_zero
  rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card A ζ hp]
  apply div_pos
  · apply pow_pos
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
    intro hz
    exact hR ((schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff _
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos (by decide : 0 < 2) hp)).mp hz.symm)
  · exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_eq_schattenNormReal_div
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_eq_schattenNormReal_div
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) (2 * p : ℕ) /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card A ζ hp,
    Real.div_rpow (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
    ← Real.rpow_natCast, one_div,
    Real.rpow_rpow_inv (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) hk.ne']

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_specNorm
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      specNorm (resolvent A ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz : resolvent A ζ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [resolventEvenMoment_eq_zero_of_isEmpty A ζ p, hz, specNorm_zero,
      Real.zero_rpow (one_div_ne_zero hk.ne'), le_refl]
  | inr hn =>
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    have hdroot : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd _
    rw [resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_eq_schattenNormReal_div A ζ hp]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hdroot).mpr
      (by simpa only [mul_comm] using
        schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm (resolvent A ζ) hk)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
statement:
theorem specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    specNorm (resolvent A ζ) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz : resolvent A ζ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [resolventEvenMoment_eq_zero_of_isEmpty A ζ p, hz, specNorm_zero,
      Real.zero_rpow (one_div_ne_zero hk.ne'), mul_zero, le_refl]
  | inr hn =>
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    have hdroot : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd _
    rw [resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_eq_schattenNormReal_div A ζ hp]
    calc
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) (2 * p : ℕ) :=
        specNorm_le_schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) hk
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hdroot]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resolvent_pow_le_card_mul_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem specNorm_resolvent_pow_le_card_mul_resolventEvenMoment
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    specNorm (resolvent A ζ) ^ (2 * p) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * resolventEvenMoment A ζ p
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz : resolvent A ζ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [hz, specNorm_zero, zero_pow (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0),
      resolventEvenMoment_eq_zero_of_isEmpty, mul_zero, le_refl]
  | inr hn =>
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card A ζ hp]
    calc
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p) :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _)
          (specNorm_le_schattenNormReal (resolvent A ζ) hk) _
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hd]

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_le_specNorm_pow
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_le_specNorm_pow
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ≤ specNorm (resolvent A ζ) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_zero_of_isEmpty A ζ p]
    exact pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
  | inr hn =>
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    have hSp := schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm (resolvent A ζ) hk
    have hpower := pow_le_pow_left₀ (schattenNormReal_nonneg (resolvent A ζ) _) hSp (2 * p)
    have hdim : ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ (2 * p) =
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hd.le hk.ne']
    rw [mul_pow, hdim] at hpower
    rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_schattenNormReal_pow_div_card A ζ hp, div_le_iff₀ hd]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hpower

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_le_inv_abs_im_pow
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_le_inv_abs_im_pow
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:=
  (resolventEvenMoment_le_specNorm_pow A ζ hp).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ) _)

name: NLAlib.resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_inv_abs_im
statement:
theorem resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_inv_abs_im
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_specNorm A ζ hp).trans
    (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ)

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_unitarySpectralProjector
statement:
theorem posSemidef_unitarySpectralProjector (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (i : n) :
    (unitarySpectralProjector U i).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun j => by
    by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h])

name: NLAlib.diagonal_eq_sum_smul_coordinateProjector
statement:
theorem diagonal_eq_sum_smul_coordinateProjector (a : n → ℂ) :
    diagonal a = ∑ i, a i • (diagonal (Pi.single i 1) : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst k
    simp [diagonal, Pi.single_apply]
  · simp [diagonal, h]

name: NLAlib.unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum
statement:
theorem unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (a : n → ℂ) :
    (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ =
      ∑ i, a i • unitarySpectralProjector U i
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonal_eq_sum_smul_coordinateProjector, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, unitarySpectralProjector]

name: NLAlib.sum_unitarySpectralProjector
statement:
theorem sum_unitarySpectralProjector (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    ∑ i, unitarySpectralProjector U i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum U (fun _ => 1)
  simpa [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.sum_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  exact unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum _ _

name: NLAlib.pow_eq_sum_eigenvalue_pow_smul_unitarySpectralProjector
statement:
theorem pow_eq_sum_eigenvalue_pow_smul_unitarySpectralProjector
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) :
    A ^ k = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ^ k •
      unitarySpectralProjector hA.eigenvectorUnitary i
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem]
  rw [← map_pow, Matrix.diagonal_pow, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  exact unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum _ _

name: NLAlib.cfc_eq_sum_smul_unitarySpectralProjector
statement:
theorem cfc_eq_sum_smul_unitarySpectralProjector {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f A = ∑ i, (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : ℂ) •
      unitarySpectralProjector hA.eigenvectorUnitary i
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  exact unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum _ _

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace_mul_resolventSquareSecondDifference_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace_mul_resolventSquareSecondDifference_le
    (ζ : ℂ) (A B C D H K : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H K)‖ ≤
      3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^4 * schattenNormReal D 3 * schattenNormReal H 3 *
        schattenNormReal K 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let RA := resolvent A ζ
  let RB := resolvent B ζ
  let RC := resolvent C ζ
  let c := |ζ.im|⁻¹
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)
  have hRA : specNorm RA ≤ c := hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hRB : specNorm RB ≤ c := hB.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hRC : specNorm RC ≤ c := hC.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  let b := c^4 * schattenNormReal D 3 * schattenNormReal H 3 *
    schattenNormReal K 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  have h₁ : ‖normalizedTrace (D*RA^2*H*RB*K*RC)‖ ≤ b := by
    simpa only [pow_two,Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      norm_normalizedTrace_word_pair_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul D RA RA H RB K RC
        hc hRA hRA hRB hRC
  have h₂ : ‖normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB^2*K*RC)‖ ≤ b := by
    have he : normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB^2*K*RC) =
        normalizedTrace (H*RB*RB*K*RC*D*RA) := by
      calc
        _ = normalizedTrace ((D*RA)*(H*RB^2*K*RC)) := congrArg normalizedTrace (by noncomm_ring)
        _ = normalizedTrace ((H*RB^2*K*RC)*(D*RA)) := normalizedTrace_mul_comm _ _
        _ = _ := congrArg normalizedTrace (by noncomm_ring)
    calc
      _ = ‖normalizedTrace (H*RB*RB*K*RC*D*RA)‖ := congrArg norm he
      _ ≤ (c^4 * schattenNormReal H 3 * schattenNormReal K 3 * schattenNormReal D 3) /
          (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
        norm_normalizedTrace_word_pair_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul H RB RB K RC D RA
          hc hRB hRB hRC hRA
      _ = b := by dsimp [b]; ring
  have h₃ : ‖normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB*K*RC^2)‖ ≤ b := by
    have he : normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB*K*RC^2) =
        normalizedTrace (K*RC*RC*D*RA*H*RB) := by
      calc
        _ = normalizedTrace ((D*RA*H*RB)*(K*RC^2)) := congrArg normalizedTrace (by noncomm_ring)
        _ = normalizedTrace ((K*RC^2)*(D*RA*H*RB)) := normalizedTrace_mul_comm _ _
        _ = _ := congrArg normalizedTrace (by noncomm_ring)
    calc
      _ = ‖normalizedTrace (K*RC*RC*D*RA*H*RB)‖ := congrArg norm he
      _ ≤ (c^4 * schattenNormReal K 3 * schattenNormReal D 3 * schattenNormReal H 3) /
          (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
        norm_normalizedTrace_word_pair_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul K RC RC D RA H RB
          hc hRC hRC hRA hRB
      _ = b := by dsimp [b]; ring
  have hs : normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H K) =
      normalizedTrace (D*RA^2*H*RB*K*RC) + normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB^2*K*RC) +
        normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB*K*RC^2) := by
    have hm : D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H K =
        D*RA^2*H*RB*K*RC + D*RA*H*RB^2*K*RC + D*RA*H*RB*K*RC^2 := by
      dsimp [resolventSquareSecondDifference,RA,RB,RC]
      noncomm_ring
    rw [hm,normalizedTrace_add,normalizedTrace_add]
  rw [hs]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖normalizedTrace (D*RA^2*H*RB*K*RC)‖ +
        ‖normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB^2*K*RC)‖ + ‖normalizedTrace (D*RA*H*RB*K*RC^2)‖ :=
      (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
    _ ≤ b+b+b := add_le_add (add_le_add h₁ h₂) h₃
    _ = _ := by dsimp [b,c]; ring

name: NLAlib.operatorConvexOn_neg_log
statement:
theorem NLAlib.operatorConvexOn_neg_log :
    OperatorConvexOn (Set.Ioi 0) (fun x => -Real.log x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ioi 0, ?_⟩
  intro d A H hA hH hAsp hHsp t ht₀ ht₁
  have hAp : IsStrictlyPositive A :=
    CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_iff_isSelfAdjoint_and_spectrum_pos.mpr
      ⟨hA, hAsp⟩
  have hHp : IsStrictlyPositive H :=
    CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_iff_isSelfAdjoint_and_spectrum_pos.mpr
      ⟨hH, hHsp⟩
  have hc := CFC.concaveOn_log.2 hAp hHp ht₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr ht₁)
    (show t + (1 - t) = 1 by ring)
  change cfc (fun x => -Real.log x) (t • A + (1 - t) • H) ≤
    t • cfc (fun x => -Real.log x) A + (1 - t) • cfc (fun x => -Real.log x) H
  simp only [cfc_neg, smul_neg, ← neg_add]
  exact neg_le_neg hc

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_normalizedPartialTrace_resolvent_sandwich_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_normalizedPartialTrace_resolvent_sandwich_sq_le
    (C : κ → Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ)
    {X : Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ} (hX : X.IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (a b : d) :
    (∑ k, ‖normalizedPartialTrace (resolvent X ζ*C k*resolvent X ζ) a b‖^2) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance C)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn|hn
  · let := hn
    simp [normalizedPartialTrace,Fintype.card_eq_zero]
  · let := hn
    have hN : (Fintype.card n : ℝ)≠0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
    let R := resolvent X ζ
    let P := (Matrix.single b a 1 : Matrix d d ℂ)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
    let U := R*P*R
    have hR : specNorm R≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ := hX.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
    have hF : frobSq U≤(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ frobSq (R*P)*specNorm R^2 := frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq _ _
        _ ≤ (specNorm R^2*frobSq P)*specNorm R^2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq R P) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*specNorm R^4 := by
          rw [show frobSq P=(Fintype.card n : ℝ) from frobSq_single_kronecker_one b a]
          ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hR _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    have he (k : κ) :
        normalizedPartialTrace (R*C k*R) a b=(Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹*(U*C k).trace := by
      rw [normalizedPartialTrace_apply_eq_trace]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [U]
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using Matrix.trace_mul_cycle' P (R*C k) R
    have hsum : (∑ k, ‖normalizedPartialTrace (R*C k*R) a b‖^2) =
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹^2*(∑ k, ‖(U*C k).trace‖^2) := by
      simp_rw [he,norm_mul,norm_inv,Complex.norm_natCast,mul_pow]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hsum]
    calc
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹^2*(specNorm (coefficientCovariance C)*frobSq U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (sum_norm_trace_mul_sq_le_coefficientCovariance_mul_frobSq C U) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹^2*
          (specNorm (coefficientCovariance C)*((Fintype.card n : ℝ)*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF (specNorm_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by field_simp [hN]

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixEval_sub
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixEval_sub (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) :
    rationalMatrixEval P Q A - rationalMatrixEval P Q B =
      rationalBlockDifference P Q A B (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  let M := upperBlockTwo A (A - B) B
  let S : Matrix n (n ⊕ n) 𝕜 := Matrix.fromCols 1 1
  have hi : A * S = S * M := by
    simp [S, M, upperBlockTwo, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks, Matrix.mul_fromCols]
  have hf := rationalMatrixEval_mul_eq_mul_rationalMatrixEval P Q hi hA
    (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo Q A B (A - B) hA hB)
  rw [show M = upperBlockTwo A (A - B) B from rfl,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q A B (A - B) hA hB] at hf
  have he := congrArg Matrix.toCols₂ hf
  simp [S, Matrix.mul_fromCols, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks] at he
  exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mpr he

name: NLAlib.rationalBlockDifference_sub_right
statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_sub_right (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B C H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hC : IsUnit (aeval C Q)) :
    rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H - rationalBlockDifference P Q A C H =
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C H (B - C)
proof:
:= by
  let M := upperBlockThree A H B (B - C) C
  let S : Matrix ((n ⊕ n) ⊕ n) (n ⊕ n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.fromRows 1 (Matrix.fromCols 0 (-1))
  have hi : M * S = S * upperBlockTwo A H C := by
    simp only [M, S, upperBlockThree, upperBlockTwo, Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows,
      Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks, Matrix.mul_fromCols,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
      zero_add, add_zero, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
    ext ((i | i) | i) (j | j) <;> simp
  have hf := rationalMatrixEval_mul_eq_mul_rationalMatrixEval P Q hi
    (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockThree Q A B C H (B - C) hA hB hC)
    (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo Q A C H hA hC)
  rw [show M = upperBlockThree A H B (B - C) C from rfl,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree P Q A B C H (B - C) hA hB hC,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q A C H hA hC] at hf
  simp only [S, Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows, Matrix.fromRows_mul,
    Matrix.mul_fromCols, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero,
    Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul] at hf
  ext i j
  have he := congrArg (fun D => D (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)) hf
  simp at he
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply]
  have he' : rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H i j -
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C H (B - C) i j =
      rationalBlockDifference P Q A C H i j := by simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using he
  exact sub_eq_of_eq_add (by simpa only [add_comm] using sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp he')

name: NLAlib.rationalBlockDifference_sub_left
statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_sub_left (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B C H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hC : IsUnit (aeval C Q)) :
    rationalBlockDifference P Q A C H - rationalBlockDifference P Q B C H =
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C (A - B) H
proof:
:= by
  let M := upperBlockThree A (A - B) B H C
  let S : Matrix (n ⊕ n) ((n ⊕ n) ⊕ n) 𝕜 :=
    Matrix.fromCols (Matrix.fromRows (Matrix.fromCols 1 1) 0)
      (Matrix.fromRows 0 1)
  have hi : upperBlockTwo A H C * S = S * M := by
    simp only [M, S, upperBlockThree, upperBlockTwo, Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows,
      Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks, Matrix.mul_fromCols,
      Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
      zero_add, add_zero]
    ext (i | i) ((j | j) | j) <;> simp
  have hf := rationalMatrixEval_mul_eq_mul_rationalMatrixEval P Q hi
    (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo Q A C H hA hC)
    (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockThree Q A B C (A - B) H hA hB hC)
  rw [show M = upperBlockThree A (A - B) B H C from rfl,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree P Q A B C (A - B) H hA hB hC,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q A C H hA hC] at hf
  simp only [S, Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows, Matrix.fromRows_mul,
    Matrix.mul_fromCols, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks,
    Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows] at hf
  simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
    zero_add, add_zero] at hf
  ext i j
  have he := congrArg (fun D => D (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j)) hf
  simp at he
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply]
  exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mpr he

name: NLAlib.norm_square_le_square_norm

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resolventSquareDifference_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_resolventSquareDifference_le (ζ : ℂ) (A B H : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm (resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H) ≤ 2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^3 * specNorm H
proof:
:= by
  let c := |ζ.im|⁻¹
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)
  have hRA : ‖resolvent A ζ‖ ≤ c := hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hRB : ‖resolvent B ζ‖ ≤ c := hB.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hRA2 : ‖(resolvent A ζ)^2‖ ≤ c^2 :=
    (norm_square_le_square_norm _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hRA 2)
  have hRB2 : ‖(resolvent B ζ)^2‖ ≤ c^2 :=
    (norm_square_le_square_norm _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hRB 2)
  have h₁ : ‖(resolvent A ζ)^2 * H * resolvent B ζ‖ ≤ c^3 * ‖H‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖(resolvent A ζ)^2‖ * ‖H‖) * ‖resolvent B ζ‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (c^2 * ‖H‖) * c := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h₂ : ‖resolvent A ζ * H * (resolvent B ζ)^2‖ ≤ c^3 * ‖H‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖resolvent A ζ‖ * ‖H‖) * ‖(resolvent B ζ)^2‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (c * ‖H‖) * c^2 := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(resolvent A ζ)^2 * H * resolvent B ζ‖ +
        ‖resolvent A ζ * H * (resolvent B ζ)^2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ c^3 * ‖H‖ + c^3 * ‖H‖ := add_le_add h₁ h₂
    _ = _ := by simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]; dsimp [c]; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_rationalBlockMap_resolvent_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_rationalBlockMap_resolvent_sq_le (ζ : ℂ) (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖rationalBlockMap 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) A A‖ ≤ 2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^3
proof:
:= by
  apply opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro H
  rw [rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ A A H hA hA hζ]
  exact specNorm_resolventSquareDifference_le ζ A A H hA hA hζ

name: NLAlib.norm_traceResolventDerivative_le
statement:
theorem norm_traceResolventDerivative_le (ζ : ℂ) (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖traceResolventDerivative ζ A‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹^2
proof:
:= by
  apply opNorm_le_bound _ (sq_nonneg _)
  intro H
  rw [traceResolventDerivative_apply]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (H*(resolvent A ζ)^2) := norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm _
    _ ≤ specNorm H * specNorm ((resolvent A ζ)^2) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm H * |ζ.im|⁻¹^2 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (specNorm_nonneg H)
      exact (norm_square_le_square_norm _).trans
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ) 2)
    _ = _ := mul_comm _ _

theorem hermitianCoordinateTraceResolventDerivative_apply (ζ : ℂ) (x h : J → ℝ) :
    hermitianCoordinateTraceResolventDerivative ζ x h =
      hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct h (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ x)
proof:
:= by
  have he : hermitianCoordinateTraceResolventDerivative ζ x h =
      traceResolventDerivative ζ (L x) (L h) := rfl
  rw [he,traceResolventDerivative_apply]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative_apply (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    (x h : J → ℝ) :
    hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ x h =
      resolventSquareDifference ζ (L x) (L x) (L h)
proof:
:= by
  have he : hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ x h =
      rationalBlockMap 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) (L x) (L x) (L h) := rfl
  rw [he,rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ (L x) (L x) (L h)
    (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x)
    (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x) hζ]

name: trace_mul_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  let S := CFC.sqrt A
  have hS : Sᴴ = S := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).isSelfAdjoint
  have hSS : S * S = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg
  have hp := (hB.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same S).trace_nonneg
  have ht : Matrix.trace (S * B * Sᴴ) = Matrix.trace (A * B) := by
    rw [hS, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hSS]
  rw [ht] at hp
  exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hp).1

name: NLAlib.traceExp_le_traceExp
statement:
theorem NLAlib.traceExp_le_traceExp {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (A H : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hAH : A ≤ H) :
    traceExp A ≤ traceExp H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hEA, hLA⟩ := posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp A hA
  obtain ⟨hEH, hLH⟩ := posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp H hH
  have he := relativeEntropy_nonneg (matrixExp A) (matrixExp H) hEA hEH
  have hp := trace_mul_nonneg (matrixExp A) (H - A) hEA.posSemidef hAH
  simp only [relativeEntropy_complex, hLA, hLH, mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub,
    Complex.sub_re] at he hp
  rw [traceExp_complex, traceExp_complex]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.convex_setOf_posDef
statement: theorem convex_setOf_posDef : Convex ℝ {A : Matrix n n ℝ | A.PosDef}
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA B hB a b ha hb hab
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ha with ha | ha
  · exact (hA.smul ha).add_posSemidef (hB.posSemidef.smul hb)
  · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
    simp only [← ha, hb1, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    exact hB

name: NLAlib.strictConcaveOn_log_det
statement:
theorem strictConcaveOn_log_det :
    StrictConcaveOn ℝ {A : Matrix n n ℝ | A.PosDef} (fun A => Real.log A.det)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_setOf_posDef, ?_⟩
  intro A hA B hB hAB a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_positive_definite_pair_congruence hA hB
  have hAi : Real.log A.det = Real.log (S.det ^ 2) := by
    rw [hAA, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, ← sq]
  have hBi : Real.log B.det = Real.log (S.det ^ 2) + ∑ i, Real.log (d i) := by
    rw [hBB]
    exact log_det_congruence_diagonal hS d hd
  have hCi : Real.log (a • A + b • B).det =
      Real.log (S.det ^ 2) + ∑ i, Real.log (a + b * d i) := by
    rw [smul_add_smul_eq_congruence_diagonal hAA hBB]
    exact log_det_congruence_diagonal hS _ (fun i => add_pos ha (mul_pos hb (hd i)))
  have hle (i : n) : b * Real.log (d i) ≤ Real.log (a + b * d i) := by
    have h := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.concaveOn.2
      (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 from zero_lt_one)) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (hd i)) ha.le hb.le hab
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, Real.log_one, mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one] using h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, d i ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    apply hAB
    have hd1 : d = fun _ => 1 := funext hnone
    rw [hAA, hBB, hd1, Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hlt : b * Real.log (d i) < Real.log (a + b * d i) := by
    have h := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.2
      (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 from zero_lt_one)) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (hd i)) hi.symm ha hb hab
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, Real.log_one, mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one] using h
  have hsum := Finset.sum_lt_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n))
    (fun i _ => hle i) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hlt⟩
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hAi, hBi, hCi]
  have hscale := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t * Real.log (S.det ^ 2)) hab
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.log_det_smul_add_ge
statement:
theorem log_det_smul_add_ge {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a * Real.log A.det + b * Real.log B.det ≤ Real.log (a • A + b • B).det
proof:
:=
  strictConcaveOn_log_det.concaveOn.2 hA hB ha hb hab

name: NLAlib.log_det_smul_add_eq_iff
statement:
theorem log_det_smul_add_eq_iff {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    Real.log (a • A + b • B).det = a * Real.log A.det + b * Real.log B.det ↔ A = B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_contra hne
    have h := strictConcaveOn_log_det.2 hA hB hne ha hb hab
    change a * Real.log A.det + b * Real.log B.det < Real.log (a • A + b • B).det at h
    linarith
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.det_smul_add_ge_rpow_mul_and_eq_iff_aux
statement:
private theorem det_smul_add_ge_rpow_mul_and_eq_iff_aux {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a + b = 1) :
    A.det ^ a * B.det ^ b ≤ (a • A + b • B).det ∧
      ((a • A + b • B).det = A.det ^ a * B.det ^ b ↔ A = B)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (a • A + b • B).PosDef := convex_setOf_posDef hA hB ha.le hb.le hab
  have hlog : Real.log (A.det ^ a * B.det ^ b) = a * Real.log A.det + b * Real.log B.det := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hA.det_pos a).ne'
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hB.det_pos b).ne', Real.log_rpow hA.det_pos, Real.log_rpow hB.det_pos]
  have hprod : 0 < A.det ^ a * B.det ^ b := mul_pos
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hA.det_pos a) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hB.det_pos b)
  constructor
  · apply (Real.log_le_log_iff hprod hC.det_pos).mp
    rw [hlog]
    exact log_det_smul_add_ge hA hB ha.le hb.le hab
  · rw [← Real.log_injOn_pos.eq_iff hC.det_pos hprod, hlog]
    exact log_det_smul_add_eq_iff hA hB ha hb hab

name: NLAlib.det_rpow_mul_le_det_smul_add
statement:
theorem det_rpow_mul_le_det_smul_add {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a + b = 1) :
    A.det ^ a * B.det ^ b ≤ (a • A + b • B).det
proof:
:=
  (det_smul_add_ge_rpow_mul_and_eq_iff_aux hA hB ha hb hab).1

name: NLAlib.det_smul_add_eq_rpow_mul_iff
statement:
theorem det_smul_add_eq_rpow_mul_iff {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a + b = 1) :
    (a • A + b • B).det = A.det ^ a * B.det ^ b ↔ A = B
proof:
:=
  (det_smul_add_ge_rpow_mul_and_eq_iff_aux hA hB ha hb hab).2

name: NLAlib.coefficient_mul_indicator_le
statement:
private theorem coefficient_mul_indicator_le {c w : ℝ} {keep : Bool}
    (hw : w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hneg : c < 0 → keep = true) (hpos : 0 < c → keep = false) :
    c * (if keep then 1 else 0) ≤ c * w
proof:
:= by
  cases hk : keep with
  | false =>
    have hc : 0 ≤ c := by
      by_contra hn
      have ht := hneg (lt_of_not_ge hn)
      simp [hk] at ht
    simpa [hk] using mul_nonneg hc hw.1
  | true =>
    have hc : c ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      have ht := hpos (lt_of_not_ge hn)
      simp [hk] at ht
    simpa [hk] using mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hw.2 hc

name: NLAlib.sum_coefficient_mul_indicator_le
statement:
private theorem sum_coefficient_mul_indicator_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (c w : ι → ℝ) (keep : ι → Bool) (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hneg : ∀ i, c i < 0 → keep i = true) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < c i → keep i = false) :
    (∑ i, c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0)) ≤ ∑ i, c i * w i
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => coefficient_mul_indicator_le (hw i) (hneg i) (hpos i)

name: NLAlib.eq_indicator_of_sum_coefficient_mul_le
statement:
private theorem eq_indicator_of_sum_coefficient_mul_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (c w : ι → ℝ) (keep : ι → Bool) (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hneg : ∀ i, c i < 0 → keep i = true) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < c i → keep i = false)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0)
    (hle : (∑ i, c i * w i) ≤ ∑ i, c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0)) :
    ∀ i, w i = if keep i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn (i) : 0 ≤ c i * w i - c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0) :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr (coefficient_mul_indicator_le (hw i) (hneg i) (hpos i))
  have hsum : (∑ i, (c i * w i - c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0))) = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_nonpos] using hle
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hn i
  intro i
  have hi := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hn i)).mp hsum i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hp : c i * (w i - (if keep i then 1 else 0)) = 0 := by nlinarith [hi]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left (hc i))

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.projector_coordinates_are_projector
statement:
private theorem IsSVD.projector_coordinates_are_projector {p q : ℕ} {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD Y U V)
    {P : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    (Uᴴ * P * U).IsHermitian ∧ IsIdempotentElem (Uᴴ * P * U)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change (Uᴴ * P * U)ᴴ = Uᴴ * P * U
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hs.eq,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  · change (Uᴴ * P * U) * (Uᴴ * P * U) = Uᴴ * P * U
    calc
      _ = Uᴴ * (P * (U * Uᴴ) * P) * U := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [h.mul_conjTranspose_left, Matrix.mul_one, show P * P = P from hp]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rankPenaltyObjective_rangeProjector_eq
statement:
private theorem IsSVD.rankPenaltyObjective_rangeProjector_eq {p q : ℕ}
    {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜}
    (h : IsSVD Y U V) (μ : ℝ) (X : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X = 1 / 2 * frobSq Y +
      (∑ i : Fin p, (μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2) *
        RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U) i i)) +
      1 / 2 * frobSq (rangeProjector X * Y - X)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := rangeProjector_isHermitian X
  have hp := rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem X
  have hError := frobSq_sub_eq_projector_error_add hs hp Y X (rangeProjector_mul X)
  have hCapture := h.frobSq_projector_mul_eq_sum hs hp
  have hTrace : (∑ i : Fin p, RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U) i i)) = (X.rank : ℝ) := by
    rw [h.re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul, trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ hp,
      rank_rangeProjector, RCLike.natCast_re]
  have hSum : (∑ i : Fin p, (μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2) *
      RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U) i i)) =
      μ * (∑ i : Fin p, RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U) i i)) -
        1 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin p, singularValues Y i ^ 2 *
          RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U) i i) := by
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [rankPenaltyObjective, hError, hSum, hTrace, ← hCapture]
  ring

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rankPenaltyObjective_projector_mul_le
proof:
:= by
  have hCapture := h.frobSq_projector_mul_eq_sum hs hp
  have hTrace : (∑ i : Fin p, RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * P * U) i i)) = (P.rank : ℝ) := by
    rw [h.re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul, trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem _ hp,
      RCLike.natCast_re]
  have hPyth := frobSq_projector_mul_add_complement hs hp Y
  have hRes : (1 - P) * Y = Y - P * Y := by rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [hRes] at hPyth
  have hSum : (∑ i : Fin p, (μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2) *
      RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * P * U) i i)) =
      μ * (∑ i : Fin p, RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * P * U) i i)) -
        1 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin p, singularValues Y i ^ 2 * RCLike.re ((Uᴴ * P * U) i i) := by
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [rankPenaltyObjective, hSum, hTrace, ← hCapture]
  have hr : ((P * Y).rank : ℝ) ≤ (P.rank : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Matrix.rank_mul_le_left P Y
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr hμ
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rankPenaltyObjective_selected_le_sum
proof:
:= by
  have hUpper := h.rankPenaltyObjective_projector_mul_le hμ
    (singularDirectionProjector_isHermitian U keep)
    (HasOrthonormalCols.isIdempotentElem_singularDirectionProjector h.conjTranspose_mul_left keep)
  rw [HasOrthonormalCols.conjTranspose_mul_singularDirectionProjector_mul h.conjTranspose_mul_left] at hUpper
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] at hUpper
  have hRe : ∀ i : Fin p, RCLike.re (if keep i then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) =
      if keep i then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by intro i; split_ifs <;> simp
  simp only [hRe] at hUpper
  exact hUpper

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.rankPenaltyObjective_selected_le
statement:
theorem IsSVD.rankPenaltyObjective_selected_le {p q : ℕ}
    {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜}
    (h : IsSVD Y U V) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (keep : Fin p → Bool)
    (hneg : ∀ i : Fin p, μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2 < 0 → keep i = true)
    (hpos : ∀ i : Fin p, 0 < μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2 → keep i = false)
    (X : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularDirectionProjector U keep * Y) ≤
      rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin p → ℝ := fun i => μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2
  let R := Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U
  have hR := h.projector_coordinates_are_projector (rangeProjector_isHermitian X)
    (rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem X)
  have hw : ∀ i, RCLike.re (R i i) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem R hR.1 hR.2
  have hbox := sum_coefficient_mul_indicator_le c (fun i => RCLike.re (R i i)) keep hw hneg hpos
  have hUpper := h.rankPenaltyObjective_selected_le_sum hμ keep
  rw [h.rankPenaltyObjective_rangeProjector_eq μ X]
  have hrem := frobSq_nonneg (rangeProjector X * Y - X)
  change (∑ i, c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0)) ≤ ∑ i, c i * RCLike.re (R i i) at hbox
  change rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularDirectionProjector U keep * Y) ≤
    1 / 2 * frobSq Y + ∑ i, c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0) at hUpper
  change rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularDirectionProjector U keep * Y) ≤
    1 / 2 * frobSq Y + (∑ i, c i * RCLike.re (R i i)) +
      1 / 2 * frobSq (rangeProjector X * Y - X)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.eq_selected_of_rankPenaltyObjective_le
statement:
theorem IsSVD.eq_selected_of_rankPenaltyObjective_le {p q : ℕ}
    {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜} {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜}
    (h : IsSVD Y U V) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (keep : Fin p → Bool)
    (hneg : ∀ i : Fin p, μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2 < 0 → keep i = true)
    (hpos : ∀ i : Fin p, 0 < μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2 → keep i = false)
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin p, μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hX : rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X ≤
      rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularDirectionProjector U keep * Y)) :
    X = singularDirectionProjector U keep * Y
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin p → ℝ := fun i => μ - 1 / 2 * singularValues Y i ^ 2
  let R := Uᴴ * rangeProjector X * U
  have hR := h.projector_coordinates_are_projector (rangeProjector_isHermitian X)
    (rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem X)
  have hw : ∀ i, RCLike.re (R i i) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem R hR.1 hR.2
  have hLower := sum_coefficient_mul_indicator_le c (fun i => RCLike.re (R i i)) keep hw hneg hpos
  have hUpper := h.rankPenaltyObjective_selected_le_sum hμ keep
  have hObj := h.rankPenaltyObjective_rangeProjector_eq μ X
  change rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X = 1 / 2 * frobSq Y +
    (∑ i, c i * RCLike.re (R i i)) + 1 / 2 * frobSq (rangeProjector X * Y - X) at hObj
  change rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularDirectionProjector U keep * Y) ≤
    1 / 2 * frobSq Y + ∑ i, c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0) at hUpper
  have hrem := frobSq_nonneg (rangeProjector X * Y - X)
  have hCost : (∑ i, c i * RCLike.re (R i i)) ≤
      ∑ i, c i * (if keep i then 1 else 0) := by linarith
  have hSq : frobSq (rangeProjector X * Y - X) ≤ 0 := by linarith
  have hFit : rangeProjector X * Y = X :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp (le_antisymm hSq hrem))
  have hdiag := eq_indicator_of_sum_coefficient_mul_le c
    (fun i => RCLike.re (R i i)) keep hw hneg hpos hc hCost
  have hRdiag := hR.1.eq_diagonal_of_isIdempotentElem_of_re_diag hR.2 keep hdiag
  change R = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if keep i then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) at hRdiag
  have hP : rangeProjector X = singularDirectionProjector U keep := by
    calc
      _ = (U * Uᴴ) * rangeProjector X * (U * Uᴴ) := by
        rw [h.mul_conjTranspose_left, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = U * R * Uᴴ := by simp only [R, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hRdiag]; rfl
  rw [← hFit, hP]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.singularValueHardThreshold_eq
statement:
theorem IsSVD.singularValueHardThreshold_eq {p q : ℕ} {Y : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD Y U V) (μ : ℝ) :
    singularValueHardThreshold μ Y = U *
      (rectDiag (fun i => if Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < singularValues Y i then singularValues Y i else 0) :
        Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  exact h.singularValueTransform_eq
    (φ := fun s => if Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < s then s else 0)
    (by split_ifs <;> rfl)

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.singularDirectionProjector_mul_eq_hardThreshold
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.singularValueHardThreshold_eq μ]
  conv_lhs => rhs; rw [h.eq]
  simp only [singularDirectionProjector, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U, h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin p =>
      if decide (Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < singularValues Y i) then (1 : 𝕜) else 0)) *
      (rectDiag (singularValues Y) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) =
      rectDiag (fun i => if Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < singularValues Y i then singularValues Y i else 0) := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, decide_eq_true_eq]
    by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j
    · rw [if_pos hij, if_pos hij]
      by_cases ht : Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < singularValues Y i
      · simp only [if_pos ht, one_mul]
      · simp only [if_neg ht, zero_mul, RCLike.ofReal_zero]
    · simp only [if_neg hij, mul_zero]
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun M => U * M * Vᴴ) hd

name: NLAlib.hardThresholdMask_sign
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * μ)
  have hθsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * μ by positivity)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have ht : Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < s := by nlinarith
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using ht
  · intro h
    have ht : ¬Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < s := by nlinarith
    simpa only [decide_eq_false_iff_not] using ht

name: NLAlib.hardThreshold_coefficient_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hθ := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * μ)
  have hθsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * μ by positivity)
  apply hne
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.rankPenaltyObjective_hardThreshold_le
statement:
theorem rankPenaltyObjective_hardThreshold_le (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) :
    rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularValueHardThreshold μ Y) ≤ rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD Y
  have hp := h.rankPenaltyObjective_selected_le hμ
    (fun i => decide (Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < singularValues Y i))
    (fun i => (hardThresholdMask_sign (singularValues_nonneg Y i) hμ).1)
    (fun i => (hardThresholdMask_sign (singularValues_nonneg Y i) hμ).2) X
  rwa [h.singularDirectionProjector_mul_eq_hardThreshold μ] at hp

name: NLAlib.eq_hardThreshold_of_rankPenaltyObjective_le
statement:
theorem eq_hardThreshold_of_rankPenaltyObjective_le (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hNoTie : ∀ i, singularValues Y i ≠ Real.sqrt (2 * μ))
    (hX : rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X ≤
      rankPenaltyObjective μ Y (singularValueHardThreshold μ Y)) :
    X = singularValueHardThreshold μ Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD Y
  have hp := h.eq_selected_of_rankPenaltyObjective_le hμ.le
    (fun i => decide (Real.sqrt (2 * μ) < singularValues Y i))
    (fun i => (hardThresholdMask_sign (singularValues_nonneg Y i) hμ.le).1)
    (fun i => (hardThresholdMask_sign (singularValues_nonneg Y i) hμ.le).2)
    (fun i => hardThreshold_coefficient_ne_zero (singularValues_nonneg Y i) hμ.le (hNoTie i)) X
    (by simpa only [h.singularDirectionProjector_mul_eq_hardThreshold μ] using hX)
  rwa [h.singularDirectionProjector_mul_eq_hardThreshold μ] at hp

name: NLAlib.rankPenaltyObjective_hardThreshold_minimizer_iff
statement:
theorem rankPenaltyObjective_hardThreshold_minimizer_iff (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hNoTie : ∀ i, singularValues Y i ≠ Real.sqrt (2 * μ)) :
    (∀ Z, rankPenaltyObjective μ Y X ≤ rankPenaltyObjective μ Y Z) ↔
      X = singularValueHardThreshold μ Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact eq_hardThreshold_of_rankPenaltyObjective_le Y X hμ hNoTie (h _)
  · rintro rfl
    exact fun Z => rankPenaltyObjective_hardThreshold_le Y Z hμ.le

name: NLAlib.rankPenaltyObjective_zero_minimizer_iff
statement:
theorem rankPenaltyObjective_zero_minimizer_iff (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    (∀ Z, rankPenaltyObjective 0 Y X ≤ rankPenaltyObjective 0 Y Z) ↔ X = Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hY := h Y
    simp only [rankPenaltyObjective, sub_self, frobSq_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hY
    have hzero : frobSq (Y - X) = 0 := by nlinarith [frobSq_nonneg (Y - X)]
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp hzero)).symm
  · rintro rfl Z
    simp only [rankPenaltyObjective, sub_self, frobSq_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.singularValueHardThreshold_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem singularValueHardThreshold_zero (Y : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    singularValueHardThreshold 0 Y = Y
proof:
:= by
  exact (rankPenaltyObjective_zero_minimizer_iff Y _).mp
    (fun Z => rankPenaltyObjective_hardThreshold_le Y Z le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.three_slot_telescope
statement:
private theorem three_slot_telescope {𝔸 : Type*} [Ring 𝔸]
    (A B C H U V : 𝔸) :
    A * U * B * V * C - H * U * H * V * H =
      (A - H) * U * B * V * C + H * U * (B - H) * V * C +
        H * U * H * V * (C - H)
proof:
:= by
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.mul_sub_mul_eq_smul_add_smul_sq
statement:
private theorem mul_sub_mul_eq_smul_add_smul_sq
    {𝔸 : Type*} [Ring 𝔸] [Algebra ℝ 𝔸]
    (R₀ R₁ R₂ D E F : 𝔸) (a : ℝ)
    (h₀₁ : R₀ - R₁ = a • (R₀ * D * R₁))
    (h₀₂ : R₀ - R₂ = a • (R₀ * F * R₂))
    (h₁₂ : R₁ - R₂ = a • (R₁ * E * R₂)) :
    R₀ * D * R₀ - R₁ * D * R₁ =
      a • ((2 : ℝ) • (R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₂)) +
        a ^ 2 •
          (R₀ * F * R₂ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ +
            R₂ * D * R₁ * E * R₂ * D * R₀ +
            R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₀ * F * R₂ +
            R₁ * E * R₂ * D * R₀ * D * R₁ +
            R₂ * D * R₀ * F * R₂ * D * R₁ +
            R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₁ * E * R₂)
proof:
:= by
  let T := R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₂
  let X := R₀ * F * R₂ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ +
    R₂ * D * R₁ * E * R₂ * D * R₀ +
    R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₀ * F * R₂
  let Y := R₁ * E * R₂ * D * R₀ * D * R₁ +
    R₂ * D * R₀ * F * R₂ * D * R₁ +
    R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₁ * E * R₂
  have hfirst : R₀ * D * R₀ - R₁ * D * R₁ =
      a • (R₀ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ + R₁ * D * R₀ * D * R₁) := by
    calc
      _ = (R₀ - R₁) * D * R₀ + R₁ * D * (R₀ - R₁) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [h₀₁]
        simp only [smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
  have hleft : R₀ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ - T = a • X := by
    dsimp only [T, X]
    calc
      _ = (R₀ - R₂) * D * R₁ * D * R₀ + R₂ * D * (R₁ - R₂) * D * R₀ +
          R₂ * D * R₂ * D * (R₀ - R₂) := three_slot_telescope R₀ R₁ R₀ R₂ D D
      _ = _ := by
        rw [h₀₂, h₁₂]
        simp only [smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
  have hright : R₁ * D * R₀ * D * R₁ - T = a • Y := by
    dsimp only [T, Y]
    calc
      _ = (R₁ - R₂) * D * R₀ * D * R₁ + R₂ * D * (R₀ - R₂) * D * R₁ +
          R₂ * D * R₂ * D * (R₁ - R₂) := three_slot_telescope R₁ R₀ R₁ R₂ D D
      _ = _ := by
        rw [h₁₂, h₀₂]
        simp only [smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
  have ht : R₀ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ + R₁ * D * R₀ * D * R₁ =
      (2 : ℝ) • T + a • (X + Y) := by
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp hleft, sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp hright]
    simp only [two_smul, smul_add]
    abel
  have hsum : X + Y =
      R₀ * F * R₂ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ +
        R₂ * D * R₁ * E * R₂ * D * R₀ +
        R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₀ * F * R₂ +
        R₁ * E * R₂ * D * R₀ * D * R₁ +
        R₂ * D * R₀ * F * R₂ * D * R₁ +
        R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₁ * E * R₂ := by dsimp [X, Y]; abel
  calc
    _ = a • (R₀ * D * R₁ * D * R₀ + R₁ * D * R₀ * D * R₁) := hfirst
    _ = a • ((2 : ℝ) • T + a • (X + Y)) := congrArg (fun q : 𝔸 => a • q) ht
    _ = a • ((2 : ℝ) • T) + a • (a • (X + Y)) := smul_add a _ _
    _ = a • ((2 : ℝ) • T) + a ^ 2 • (X + Y) := by
      rw [smul_smul a a (X + Y), pow_two]
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [T] using
        congrArg (fun q : 𝔸 => a • ((2 : ℝ) • T) + a ^ 2 • q) hsum

name: NLAlib.resolvent_mul_resolvent_sub_eq_smul_add_smul_sq
statement:
theorem resolvent_mul_resolvent_sub_eq_smul_add_smul_sq
    (A₀ D F : M) (a : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    let R₀
proof:
:= resolvent A₀ ζ
    let R₁ := resolvent (A₀ - a • D) ζ
    let R₂ := resolvent (A₀ - a • F) ζ
    R₀ * D * R₀ - R₁ * D * R₁ =
      a • ((2 : ℝ) • (R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₂)) +
        a ^ 2 • resolventCubicRemainder A₀ D F a ζ := by
  dsimp only
  have h₀₁ : resolvent A₀ ζ - resolvent (A₀ - a • D) ζ =
      a • (resolvent A₀ ζ * D * resolvent (A₀ - a • D) ζ) := by
    have h := resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_mul_resolvent A₀ D a ζ hA₀ hD hζ
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using (eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp h).symm
  have h₀₂ : resolvent A₀ ζ - resolvent (A₀ - a • F) ζ =
      a • (resolvent A₀ ζ * F * resolvent (A₀ - a • F) ζ) := by
    have h := resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_mul_resolvent A₀ F a ζ hA₀ hF hζ
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using (eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp h).symm
  have hbase : (A₀ - a • D) - a • (F - D) = A₀ - a • F := by
    simp only [smul_sub]
    abel
  have h₁₂ : resolvent (A₀ - a • D) ζ - resolvent (A₀ - a • F) ζ =
      a • (resolvent (A₀ - a • D) ζ * (F - D) * resolvent (A₀ - a • F) ζ) := by
    have h := resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_mul_resolvent (A₀ - a • D) (F - D) a ζ
      (hA₀.sub (hD.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial a)))) (hF.sub hD) hζ
    rw [hbase] at h
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using (eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp h).symm
  exact mul_sub_mul_eq_smul_add_smul_sq _ _ _ D (F - D) F a h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le
statement:
private theorem specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le
    (A : M) (Z T U V W H K : ι → M) (α β r : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hZ : ∀ i, (Z i).IsHermitian)
    (hT : ∀ i, (T i).IsHermitian) (hU : ∀ i, (U i).IsHermitian)
    (hW : ∀ i, (W i).IsHermitian) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hUnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (U i) ≤ r) (hVnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (V i) ≤ r)
    (hWnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (W i) ≤ r)
    (hH : ∀ i, specNorm (H i) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹)
    (hK : ∀ i, specNorm (K i) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm (∑ i, resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ * U i * H i * V i * K i * W i *
      resolvent (A - β • T i) ζ) ≤
      r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 * (specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, W i ^ 2)) +
        r ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6 *
          (α ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, Z i ^ 2) + β ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, T i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)
  have hmid : ∀ i, specNorm (H i * V i * K i) ≤ r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    calc
      _ ≤ (specNorm (H i) * specNorm (V i)) * specNorm (K i) :=
        (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹ * r) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hH i) (hVnorm i) (specNorm_nonneg _) hc)
          (hK i) (specNorm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hc hr)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h := specNorm_sum_resolvent_mul_mul_resolvent_le A Z T U
    (fun i => H i * V i * K i) W α β r (r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2) ζ
    hA hZ hT hU hW hr (by positivity) hUnorm hmid hWnorm hζ
  have h' : specNorm (∑ i, resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ * U i * H i * V i * K i * W i *
      resolvent (A - β • T i) ζ) ≤
      (r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        (specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, W i ^ 2)) +
      (r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2) * r ^ 2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 *
        (α ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, Z i ^ 2) + β ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, T i ^ 2)) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using h
  exact h'.trans_eq (by ring)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_resolventCubicRemainder_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_resolventCubicRemainder_le
    (A : M) (D F : ι → M) (a r : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hD : ∀ i, (D i).IsHermitian)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i).IsHermitian) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hDnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ r) (hFnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (F i) ≤ r)
    (hEnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (F i - D i) ≤ r) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm (∑ i, resolventCubicRemainder A (D i) (F i) a ζ) ≤
      r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 *
        (8 * specNorm (∑ i, D i ^ 2) + 2 * specNorm (∑ i, (F i - D i) ^ 2) +
          2 * specNorm (∑ i, F i ^ 2)) +
        a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6 *
          (3 * specNorm (∑ i, D i ^ 2) + 6 * specNorm (∑ i, F i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  let E : ι → M := fun i => F i - D i
  let R₀ : ι → M := fun _ => resolvent A ζ
  let R₁ : ι → M := fun i => resolvent (A - a • D i) ζ
  let R₂ : ι → M := fun i => resolvent (A - a • F i) ζ
  let w₁ : ι → M := fun i => R₀ i * F i * R₂ i * D i * R₁ i * D i * R₀ i
  let w₂ : ι → M := fun i => R₂ i * D i * R₁ i * E i * R₂ i * D i * R₀ i
  let w₃ : ι → M := fun i => R₂ i * D i * R₂ i * D i * R₀ i * F i * R₂ i
  let w₄ : ι → M := fun i => R₁ i * E i * R₂ i * D i * R₀ i * D i * R₁ i
  let w₅ : ι → M := fun i => R₂ i * D i * R₀ i * F i * R₂ i * D i * R₁ i
  let w₆ : ι → M := fun i => R₂ i * D i * R₂ i * D i * R₁ i * E i * R₂ i
  have hE (i : ι) : (E i).IsHermitian := (hF i).sub (hD i)
  have hR₀ (i : ι) : specNorm (R₀ i) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ := hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hR₁ (i : ι) : specNorm (R₁ i) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (hA.sub ((hD i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial a)))).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hR₂ (i : ι) : specNorm (R₂ i) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (hA.sub ((hF i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial a)))).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have h₁ := specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le A (fun _ : ι => 0) (fun _ : ι => 0)
    F D D R₂ R₁ 0 0 r ζ hA (fun _ => Matrix.isHermitian_zero)
    (fun _ => Matrix.isHermitian_zero) hF hD hr hFnorm hDnorm hDnorm hR₂ hR₁ hζ
  have h₂ := specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le A F (fun _ : ι => 0)
    D E D R₁ R₂ a 0 r ζ hA hF (fun _ => Matrix.isHermitian_zero)
    hD hD hr hDnorm hEnorm hDnorm hR₁ hR₂ hζ
  have h₃ := specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le A F F
    D D F R₂ R₀ a a r ζ hA hF hF hD hF hr hDnorm hDnorm hFnorm hR₂ hR₀ hζ
  have h₄ := specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le A D D
    E D D R₂ R₀ a a r ζ hA hD hD hE hD hr hEnorm hDnorm hDnorm hR₂ hR₀ hζ
  have h₅ := specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le A F D
    D F D R₀ R₂ a a r ζ hA hF hD hD hD hr hDnorm hFnorm hDnorm hR₀ hR₂ hζ
  have h₆ := specNorm_sum_resolvent_seven_factors_le A F F
    D D E R₂ R₁ a a r ζ hA hF hF hD hE hr hDnorm hDnorm hEnorm hR₂ hR₁ hζ
  simp only [zero_smul, sub_zero] at h₁ h₂
  change specNorm (∑ i, w₁ i) ≤ _ at h₁
  change specNorm (∑ i, w₂ i) ≤ _ at h₂
  change specNorm (∑ i, w₃ i) ≤ _ at h₃
  change specNorm (∑ i, w₄ i) ≤ _ at h₄
  change specNorm (∑ i, w₅ i) ≤ _ at h₅
  change specNorm (∑ i, w₆ i) ≤ _ at h₆
  have hsum : (∑ i, resolventCubicRemainder A (D i) (F i) a ζ) =
      (∑ i, w₁ i) + (∑ i, w₂ i) + (∑ i, w₃ i) +
        (∑ i, w₄ i) + (∑ i, w₅ i) + (∑ i, w₆ i) := by
    change (∑ i, (w₁ i + w₂ i + w₃ i + w₄ i + w₅ i + w₆ i)) = _
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have htri : specNorm ((∑ i, w₁ i) + (∑ i, w₂ i) + (∑ i, w₃ i) +
        (∑ i, w₄ i) + (∑ i, w₅ i) + (∑ i, w₆ i)) ≤
      specNorm (∑ i, w₁ i) + specNorm (∑ i, w₂ i) + specNorm (∑ i, w₃ i) +
        specNorm (∑ i, w₄ i) + specNorm (∑ i, w₅ i) + specNorm (∑ i, w₆ i) := by
    have ht₂ := specNorm_add_le (∑ i, w₁ i) (∑ i, w₂ i)
    have ht₃ := specNorm_add_le ((∑ i, w₁ i) + (∑ i, w₂ i)) (∑ i, w₃ i)
    have ht₄ := specNorm_add_le ((∑ i, w₁ i) + (∑ i, w₂ i) + (∑ i, w₃ i)) (∑ i, w₄ i)
    have ht₅ := specNorm_add_le ((∑ i, w₁ i) + (∑ i, w₂ i) + (∑ i, w₃ i) +
      (∑ i, w₄ i)) (∑ i, w₅ i)
    have ht₆ := specNorm_add_le ((∑ i, w₁ i) + (∑ i, w₂ i) + (∑ i, w₃ i) +
      (∑ i, w₄ i) + (∑ i, w₅ i)) (∑ i, w₆ i)
    linarith only [ht₂, ht₃, ht₄, ht₅, ht₆]
  have hbound := add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add h₁ h₂) h₃) h₄) h₅) h₆
  rw [hsum]
  exact htri.trans (hbound.trans_eq (by dsimp only [E]; ring))

name: NLAlib.norm_le_one_of_posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem norm_le_one_of_posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks {D : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (h : (fromBlocks 1 D D.conjTranspose 1).PosSemidef) : ‖D‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := invertibleOne
  have hp := (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ D (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) Matrix.PosDef.one).mp h
  have hle : D.conjTranspose * D ≤ 1 := Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    (by simpa only [inv_one, Matrix.mul_one] using hp)
  have hn : ‖D.conjTranspose * D‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_one_iff_of_nonneg _
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self D).nonneg).mpr hle
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self] at hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg D]

name: NLAlib.norm_le_of_posSemidef_equal_fromBlocks
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  let t : ℝ := ‖S‖ + ε
  have ht : 0 < t := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (norm_nonneg _) hε
  have hSt : S ≤ t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    have hS' := hS.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self
    have htt : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) ‖S‖ ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) t := by
      simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
      exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [t]; linarith) zero_le_one
    exact hS'.trans (by simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using htt)
  have hG : (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - S).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hSt
  have hp := h.add (posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag hG hG)
  have heq : fromBlocks S D D.conjTranspose S +
      fromBlocks (t • 1 - S) 0 0 (t • 1 - S) =
      fromBlocks (t • 1) D D.conjTranspose (t • 1) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [fromBlocks]
  rw [heq] at hp
  have hp' := hp.smul (inv_pos.mpr ht).le
  have heq' : t⁻¹ • fromBlocks (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) D D.conjTranspose (t • 1) =
      fromBlocks 1 (t⁻¹ • D) (t⁻¹ • D).conjTranspose 1 := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [fromBlocks, ht.ne', Matrix.conjTranspose_smul]
  rw [heq'] at hp'
  have hn := norm_le_one_of_posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks hp'
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr ht).le] at hn
  simpa only [mul_one] using (inv_mul_le_iff₀ ht).mp hn

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks_of_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks_of_specNorm_le_one {C : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hC : specNorm C ≤ 1) : (fromBlocks 1 C Cᴴ 1).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := invertibleOne
  apply (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ C (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) Matrix.PosDef.one).mpr
  rw [inv_one, Matrix.mul_one]
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mp
  apply (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_one_iff_of_nonneg _
    (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self C).nonneg).mp
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm] at hC
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg C]

name: NLAlib.matrixGeometricMean_eq

    (cfc Real.sqrt A).PosSemidef

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_matrixGeometricMean

    (matrixGeometricMean A B).PosSemidef
proof:

name: NLAlib.cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt
statement:
theorem cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A * A *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A *
        (cfc Real.sqrt A * cfc Real.sqrt A) *
        cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A := by
      rw [cfc_sqrt_mul_self hA]
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hA, one_mul,
        cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA]

name: NLAlib.matrixGeometricMean_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixGeometricMean_self {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    matrixGeometricMean A A = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixGeometricMean_eq, cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hA]
  have hs : cfc Real.sqrt (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) = 1 := by simp
  rw [hs, Matrix.mul_one, cfc_sqrt_mul_self hA]

name: NLAlib.relativeEntropy_nonneg
statement:
theorem NLAlib.relativeEntropy_nonneg {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (A H : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.PosDef) (hH : H.PosDef) :
    0 ≤ relativeEntropy A H
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ := ![fun a => a * Real.log a - a, fun a => -a, fun _ => 1]
  let g : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ := ![fun _ => 1, Real.log, id]
  have hp (M : Matrix d d ℂ) (hM : M.PosDef) :
      spectrum ℝ M ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
    rw [hM.1.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hM.eigenvalues_pos i
  have hf : ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∀ h ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      0 ≤ ∑ i, f i a * g i h := by
    intro a ha h hh
    change 0 < a at ha
    change 0 < h at hh
    have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hh ha)
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hh) (ne_of_gt ha)] at hlog
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (le_of_lt ha)
    have hd : a * (h / a - 1) = h - a := by field_simp [ne_of_gt ha]
    rw [hd] at hm
    simp [f, g, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    nlinarith
  have hk := generalized_klein (Set.Ioi 0) (convex_Ioi 0) f g hf A H hA.1 hH.1
    (hp A hA) (hp H hH)
  have hc (M : Matrix d d ℂ) (hM : M.IsHermitian) (q : ℝ → ℝ) :
      ContinuousOn q (spectrum ℝ M) := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    fun_prop
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, f, g, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ,
    Matrix.cons_val_fin_one] at hk
  simp only [cfc_sub _ _ A (hc A hA.1 _) (hc A hA.1 _),
    cfc_mul _ _ A (hc A hA.1 _) (hc A hA.1 _), cfc_neg (fun x : ℝ => x) A,
    cfc_id' ℝ A hA.1.isSelfAdjoint, cfc_id ℝ H hH.1.isSelfAdjoint,
    cfc_const (1 : ℝ) A hA.1.isSelfAdjoint, cfc_const (1 : ℝ) H hH.1.isSelfAdjoint, map_one, mul_one, one_mul,
    neg_mul] at hk
  simpa [relativeEntropy_complex, matrixLog, mul_sub, mul_add, mul_neg, Matrix.trace_sub,
    Matrix.trace_neg, Matrix.trace_add, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.neg_re, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hk

name: NLAlib.exists_uniform_matrixKResolvent_defect_bound_below_trace_support
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_matrixKResolvent_defect_bound_below_trace_support
    (ν : Measure Tspace) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0≤B ∧ ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → z.re=u →
      ‖normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)‖≤B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hGa,hGN,hreal,hGpos,_hGderiv⟩ :=
    exists_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ u hu
  let S : ℂ → M := fun z => α⁻¹•G z
  let Q : ℂ → M := fun z => (S z)⁻¹
  have hSpos : (S u).PosDef := hGpos.smul (inv_pos.mpr hα)
  have hSa : AnalyticAt ℂ S (u : ℂ) := hGa.const_smul (c := α⁻¹)
  have hQa : AnalyticAt ℂ Q (u : ℂ) := by
    have hh := analyticAt_inverse (𝕜 := ℂ) hSpos.isUnit.unit
    rw [hSpos.isUnit.unit_spec] at hh
    simpa only [Q,Function.comp_def,← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using hh.comp (f := S) hSa
  have hQreal : ∀ x : ℝ, (Q x).IsHermitian :=
    fun x => ((hreal x).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all α⁻¹)).inv
  have hQupper (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : Q z=(F z)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [Q,S,hGN z hz,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hQbound⟩ := Matrix.exists_eventually_norm_imaginaryPart_le_height_of_real_analytic
    Q u hQa (Eventually.of_forall hQreal)
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hηbound⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hQbound
  let ε := η/4
  have hε : 0<ε := div_pos hη (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨ρ,B,_hmassExact,hmass,hrep,hcont,hmean⟩ :=
    exists_matrixKResolvent_defect_measure_family ν hν α hα F hFa hF
  have hET : (∫ T : Tspace, T.val ∂ν).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_integral (Eventually.of_forall fun T => T.property)
  have havg : ∀ x ∈ ball u ε, ∀ γ : NNReal, γ≠0 → (γ : ℝ)<ε →
      (∫ T : Tspace,
        (normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F ((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)) T.val)).im ∂ν)≤
          (1+α⁻¹*C)*(γ : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx γ hγ hsmall
    have hγpos : 0<(γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
    let z : ℂ := (x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I
    have hz : 0<z.im := by simpa [z] using hγpos
    have hzγ : z.im=(γ : ℝ) := by simp [z]
    have hxu : |x-u|<ε := by simpa only [mem_ball,Real.dist_eq] using hx
    have hdist : dist z (u : ℂ)<η := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have he : z-(u : ℂ)=((x-u : ℝ) : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I := by
        dsimp only [z]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [he]
      have hn := norm_add_le (((x-u : ℝ) : ℂ)) (((γ : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)
      rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hγpos] at hn
      dsimp only [ε] at *
      exact hn.trans_lt (by linarith)
    have hQnorm : ‖(imaginaryPart (Q z) : M)‖≤C*(γ : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [hzγ] using hηbound hdist hz
    have hi : Integrable
        (fun T : Tspace => normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)) ν := by
      have hh := (hcont z hz).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
      have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
      rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hh
    have him : (∫ T : Tspace, normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val) ∂ν).im=
        ∫ T : Tspace, (normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)).im ∂ν :=
      (integral_im hi).symm
    change (∫ T : Tspace, (normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)).im ∂ν)≤_
    rw [← him,hmean z hz,← hQupper z hz]
    let A : M := (∫ T : Tspace, T.val ∂ν)-z•1-α⁻¹•Q z
    have hImScalar : (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)=z.im•1 := by
      have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
      simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one]
    have hImScale : (imaginaryPart (α⁻¹•Q z) : M)=α⁻¹•(imaginaryPart (Q z) : M) := by
      rw [map_smul]
      rfl
    have hAI : (imaginaryPart A : M)= -((γ : ℝ)•(1 : M))-α⁻¹•(imaginaryPart (Q z) : M) := by
      dsimp only [A]
      rw [map_sub,map_sub,hET.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart]
      simp only [zero_sub,NegMemClass.coe_neg,AddSubgroup.coe_sub]
      rw [hImScalar,hImScale,hzγ]
    have hnorm : ‖(imaginaryPart A : M)‖≤(1+α⁻¹*C)*(γ : ℝ) := by
      rw [hAI]
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖-((γ : ℝ)•(1 : M))‖+‖α⁻¹•(imaginaryPart (Q z) : M)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = (γ : ℝ)+α⁻¹*‖(imaginaryPart (Q z) : M)‖ := by
          rw [norm_neg,norm_smul,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hγpos.le,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le),norm_one,mul_one]
        _ ≤ (γ : ℝ)+α⁻¹*(C*(γ : ℝ)) :=
          add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQnorm (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le))
        _ = _ := by ring
    have htrace : (normalizedTrace A).im≤‖(imaginaryPart A : M)‖ := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using im_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm_imaginaryPart A
    exact htrace.trans hnorm
  have hmeas (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : Tspace × ℝ => (normalizedTrace (p.1.val-
        matrixKResolvent (F ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)) p.1.val)).im) (ν.prod volume) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.comp (continuous_matrixKResolvent_defect_fixed_height
      F hFa (fun z hz => (hF z hz).1) γ hγ)).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact exists_uniform_stieltjes_bound_on_support_of_local_average_im_bound ν ρ
    (fun T z => normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)) hrep hcont B hmass hmeas
      u ε ε (1+α⁻¹*C) hε hε havg

name: NLAlib.normalization_neg_inverse_involutive
statement:
private theorem normalization_neg_inverse_involutive (S : M) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    -(-S⁻¹)⁻¹=S
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (-S⁻¹)⁻¹= -S := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.mul_neg,neg_neg,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)]
  rw [hi,neg_neg]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_matrixKResolvent_of_solution_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_matrixKResolvent_of_solution_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Z S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=Z) (η R : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hZ : η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)) :
    specNorm (∫ T,matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν)≤R+R^2*η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let X := -S⁻¹
  have hXpos : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef := posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse S hS
  have hXcoercive : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M) := hZ.trans
    (matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα Z S hS hK).2
  have hinvol : -X⁻¹=S := normalization_neg_inverse_involutive S
    (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS)
  have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν, ‖matrixKResolvent S T.val‖≤R+R^2*η⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTN : ‖T.val‖≤R := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
    have hRN : ‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖≤η⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
        specNorm_inverseVariable_resolvent_le_inv X T.val T.property η hη hXcoercive
    have hR0 : 0≤R := (norm_nonneg T.val).trans hTN
    have hker : matrixKResolvent S T.val=T.val+T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val := by
      rw [← hinvol]
      exact matrixKResolvent_neg_inverse_eq X T.val hXpos T.property
    rw [hker]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖T.val‖+‖T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T.val‖+‖T.val‖*‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ :=
        add_le_add le_rfl ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)))
      _ ≤ R+R*η⁻¹*R := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,probReal_univ,mul_one] using
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_normalization_error_identity
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_normalization_error_identity
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (α : ℝ) (hα : α≠0) (z : ℂ) (S : M)
    (hS : IsUnit S) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=z•1) :
    z•(α•S)+1=α•((∫ T,matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν)*S)
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun Y : M => α•(Y*S)) hK
  rw [matrixKTransform,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_sub,smul_smul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hα,one_smul,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),
    Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.one_mul] at he
  rw [← smul_comm α z S]
  rw [← he]
  abel

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixKTransform_normalization_error_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixKTransform_normalization_error_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (z : ℂ) (S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=z•1) (η R : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hZ : η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)) :
    specNorm (z•(α•S)+1)≤α*((R+R^2*η⁻¹)*η⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hI := specNorm_integral_matrixKResolvent_of_solution_le ν hν α hα
    (z•1) S hS hK η R hη hbound hZ
  have hSN := specNorm_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le_inv ν hν α hα (z•1) S hS hK η hη hZ
  rw [matrixKTransform_normalization_error_identity ν α hα.ne' z S
    (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS) hK,specNorm_eq_norm,norm_smul,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le]
  have hIN : ‖∫ T,matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν‖≤R+R^2*η⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hI
  have hSNorm : ‖S‖≤η⁻¹ := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hSN
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul hIN hSNorm (norm_nonneg S) ((norm_nonneg _).trans hIN))) hα.le

name: NLAlib.tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixKTransform_solution
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixKTransform_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•(α•F ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  have hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R := by
    intro T hT
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using hR T hT
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (α*y)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hα tendsto_id)
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => α*((R+R^2*(α*y)⁻¹)*(α*y)⁻¹))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero] using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds.add (hinv.const_mul (R^2))).mul hinv).const_mul α
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ‖((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•
      (α•F ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))+1‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hlimit
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    have hz : 0<((y : ℂ)*Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
    have hη : 0<α*y := mul_pos hα hy
    have hZ : (α*y)•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart (((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•(1 : M)) : M) := by
      have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
      simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one,smul_smul]
    exact specNorm_matrixKTransform_normalization_error_le ν hν α hα
      ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I) (F _) (hF _ hz).1 (hF _ hz).2 (α*y) R hη hbound hZ
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using hnorm

name: NLAlib.matrixPerspective_jointly_operatorConvex
statement:
theorem NLAlib.matrixPerspective_jointly_operatorConvex {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn (Set.Ioi 0) f)
    (A₁ A₂ H₁ H₂ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hA₁ : A₁.PosDef) (hA₂ : A₂.PosDef) (hH₁ : H₁.PosDef) (hH₂ : H₂.PosDef)
    (t : ℝ) (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1) :
    (matrixPerspective f (t • A₁ + (1 - t) • A₂) (t • H₁ + (1 - t) • H₂)) ≤
      (t • matrixPerspective f A₁ H₁ + (1 - t) • matrixPerspective f A₂ H₂)
proof:
:= by
  have htbar : 0 ≤ 1 - t := sub_nonneg.mpr ht₁
  let A := t • A₁ + (1 - t) • A₂
  have hA : A.PosDef := by
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · simpa [A, ht] using hA₂
    · exact (hA₁.smul (lt_of_le_of_ne ht₀ (Ne.symm ht))).add_posSemidef
        (hA₂.posSemidef.smul htbar)
  let S := cfc Real.sqrt A
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
  let S₁ := cfc Real.sqrt A₁
  let R₁ := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A₁
  let S₂ := cfc Real.sqrt A₂
  let R₂ := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A₂
  have hS : S.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ A
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ A
  have hSS := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hA
  have hRS := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hA
  have hSR := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA
  have hS₁ : S₁.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ A₁
  have hR₁ : R₁.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ A₁
  have hSS₁ := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hA₁
  have hRS₁ := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hA₁
  have hSR₁ := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA₁
  have hS₂ : S₂.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ A₂
  have hR₂ : R₂.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ A₂
  have hSS₂ := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hA₂
  have hRS₂ := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hA₂
  have hSR₂ := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA₂
  change S.IsHermitian at hS
  change R.IsHermitian at hR
  change S * S = A at hSS
  change R * S = 1 at hRS
  change S * R = 1 at hSR
  change S₁.IsHermitian at hS₁
  change R₁.IsHermitian at hR₁
  change S₁ * S₁ = A₁ at hSS₁
  change R₁ * S₁ = 1 at hRS₁
  change S₁ * R₁ = 1 at hSR₁
  change S₂.IsHermitian at hS₂
  change R₂.IsHermitian at hR₂
  change S₂ * S₂ = A₂ at hSS₂
  change R₂ * S₂ = 1 at hRS₂
  change S₂ * R₂ = 1 at hSR₂
  let B₁ := R₁ * H₁ * R₁
