  let B₂ := R₂ * H₂ * R₂
  have hB₁ : B₁.PosDef := by
    have hu : IsUnit R₁ := ⟨⟨R₁, S₁, hRS₁, hSR₁⟩, rfl⟩
    simpa only [B₁, hR₁.eq] using hH₁.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (B := R₁) (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hu)
  have hB₂ : B₂.PosDef := by
    have hu : IsUnit R₂ := ⟨⟨R₂, S₂, hRS₂, hSR₂⟩, rfl⟩
    simpa only [B₂, hR₂.eq] using hH₂.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
      (B := R₂) (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hu)
  let K₁ := Real.sqrt t • (S₁ * R)
  let K₂ := Real.sqrt (1 - t) • (S₂ * R)
  have hK₁ : K₁.conjTranspose = Real.sqrt t • (R * S₁) := by
    simp [K₁, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.eq, hS₁.eq]
  have hK₂ : K₂.conjTranspose = Real.sqrt (1 - t) • (R * S₂) := by
    simp [K₂, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.eq, hS₂.eq]
  have hK : K₁.conjTranspose * K₁ + K₂.conjTranspose * K₂ = 1 := by
    rw [hK₁, hK₂]
    dsimp only [K₁, K₂]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul,
      Real.mul_self_sqrt ht₀, Real.mul_self_sqrt htbar]
    calc
      t • (R * S₁ * (S₁ * R)) + (1 - t) • (R * S₂ * (S₂ * R)) =
          R * (t • (S₁ * S₁) + (1 - t) • (S₂ * S₂)) * R := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
          Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = R * A * R := by rw [hSS₁, hSS₂]
      _ = 1 := by rw [← hSS]; simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hRS, Matrix.one_mul, hSR]
  have hn (Sj Rj Hj : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
      (hij : Sj * Rj = 1) (hji : Rj * Sj = 1) :
      R * Sj * (Rj * Hj * Rj) * (Sj * R) = R * Hj * R := by
    calc
      _ = R * (Sj * Rj) * Hj * (Rj * Sj) * R := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hij, hji]; simp
  have hnorm : K₁.conjTranspose * B₁ * K₁ + K₂.conjTranspose * B₂ * K₂ =
      R * (t • H₁ + (1 - t) • H₂) * R := by
    rw [hK₁, hK₂]
    dsimp only [K₁, K₂, B₁, B₂]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul,
      Real.mul_self_sqrt ht₀, Real.mul_self_sqrt htbar, hn S₁ R₁ H₁ hSR₁ hRS₁,
      hn S₂ R₂ H₂ hSR₂ hRS₂, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  have hj := operator_jensen (Set.Ioi 0) f hf B₁ B₂ hB₁.isHermitian hB₂.isHermitian
    (fun x hx => hB₁.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx)
    (fun x hx => hB₂.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hx) K₁ K₂ hK
  have hc := hj.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same S
  change (S * (_ - _) * S.conjTranspose).PosSemidef at hc
  rw [hS.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hnorm] at hc
  have hsand (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (Sj F : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :
      S * ((Real.sqrt r • (R * Sj)) * F * (Real.sqrt r • (Sj * R))) * S =
        r • (Sj * F * Sj) := by
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, Real.mul_self_sqrt hr]
    congr 1
    calc
      _ = (S * R) * Sj * F * Sj * (R * S) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hSR, hRS]; simp
  change (S * cfc f (R * (t • H₁ + (1 - t) • H₂) * R) * S) ≤
    (t • (S₁ * cfc f B₁ * S₁) +
      (1 - t) • (S₂ * cfc f B₂ * S₂))
  simpa only [Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hK₁, hK₂, K₁, K₂,
    hsand t ht₀ S₁ (cfc f B₁),
    hsand (1 - t) htbar S₂ (cfc f B₂)] using hc

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_power_eq_trace_rpow
statement:
private theorem schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_power_eq_trace_rpow
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (a b L : ℕ)
    (hL : 0<L) (hab : 0<a+b) :
    schattenNorm (resolvent X ζ^a*resolvent X (star ζ)^b)
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((L : ℝ)/(a+b : ℕ))) =
        (CFC.abs (resolvent X ζ)^L).trace.re ^ (((a+b : ℕ) : ℝ)/L)
proof:
:= by
  have hab' : (0 : ℝ)<(a+b : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hab
  rw [schattenNorm_ofReal _ (by positivity),
    schattenNormReal_resolvent_pow_mul_resolvent_star_pow_eq_sum hX]
  have he : ((a+b : ℕ) : ℝ)*((L : ℝ)/(a+b : ℕ))=(L : ℝ) :=
    mul_div_cancel₀ _ hab'.ne'
  rw [he,one_div_div,← RCLike.re_eq_complex_re,re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues]
  simp only [Real.rpow_natCast]

name: NLAlib.prod_schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_powers_le_sum_trace
statement:
theorem prod_schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_powers_le_sum_trace
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (X : κ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hX : ∀ j, (X j).IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (a b : κ → ℕ)
    {L : ℕ} (hL : ∑ j, (a j+b j)=L) (hLpos : 0<L)
    (hArc : ∀ j, 0<a j+b j) :
    (∏ j, schattenNorm (resolvent (X j) ζ^a j*resolvent (X j) (star ζ)^b j)
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((L : ℝ)/(a j+b j : ℕ)))) ≤
        ∑ j, (((a j+b j : ℕ) : ℝ)/L)*(CFC.abs (resolvent (X j) ζ)^L).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ)<L := by exact_mod_cast hLpos
  have hw : ∑ j, (((a j+b j : ℕ) : ℝ)/L)=1 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div,show (∑ j, ((a j+b j : ℕ) : ℝ))=(L : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hL,
      div_self hL0.ne']
  simp_rw [schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_power_eq_trace_rpow (hX _) ζ _ _ _ hLpos (hArc _)]
  apply Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
  · intro j _
    positivity
  · exact hw
  · intro j _
    rw [← RCLike.re_eq_complex_re,re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) _

name: NLAlib.norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_resolvent_le_sum_trace
statement:
theorem norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_resolvent_le_sum_trace
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hB : ∀ j, (B j).IsHermitian)
    (X : Fin 4 → Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : ∀ j, (X j).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (a b : Fin 4 → ℕ) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : ∑ j, (a j+b j)=L) (hLpos : 0<L) (hArc : ∀ j, 0<a j+b j) :
    ‖coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B
      (fun j => resolvent (X j) ζ^a j*resolvent (X j) (star ζ)^b j)‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance B))*
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance B)))*
          ∑ j, (((a j+b j : ℕ) : ℝ)/L)*(CFC.abs (resolvent (X j) ζ)^L).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hsSum : ∑ j, ((a j+b j : ℕ) : ℝ)=(L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ)<L := by exact_mod_cast hLpos
  have hs0 (j : Fin 4) : (0 : ℝ)<(a j+b j : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hArc j
  obtain ⟨hp,hsum⟩ := ENNReal.one_le_ofReal_div_and_sum_inv_toReal_eq_one
    (fun j => ((a j+b j : ℕ) : ℝ)) hsSum hL0 hs0
  exact (norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm A B hA hB
    (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal ((L : ℝ)/(a j+b j : ℕ))) hp hsum _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (prod_schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_powers_le_sum_trace X hX ζ a b hL hLpos hArc)
        (by positivity))

name: Matrix.card_nonzero_le_card_nonzero_mulVec_of_perm_pos
statement:
theorem card_nonzero_le_card_nonzero_mulVec_of_perm_pos (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (σ : Equiv.Perm n) (hσ : ∀ i, 0 < C i (σ i))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    Fintype.card {j // x j ≠ 0} ≤ Fintype.card {i // (C *ᵥ x) i ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : {j // x j ≠ 0} → {i // (C *ᵥ x) i ≠ 0} := fun j =>
    ⟨σ.symm j, by
      have hxpos : 0 < x j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hx j) j.property.symm
      have hterm : 0 < C (σ.symm j) (σ (σ.symm j)) * x (σ (σ.symm j)) :=
        mul_pos (hσ _) (by simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hxpos)
      have hle : C (σ.symm j) (σ (σ.symm j)) * x (σ (σ.symm j)) ≤
          (C *ᵥ x) (σ.symm j) := by
        change _ ≤ ∑ k, C (σ.symm j) k * x k
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hC (σ.symm j) k) (hx k))
          (Finset.mem_univ (σ (σ.symm j)))
      exact (hterm.trans_le hle).ne'⟩
  apply Fintype.card_le_of_injective f
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply σ.symm.injective
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hab

name: NLAlib.card_mul_lt_one_of_le_div_card_add_one
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hbound := (le_div_iff₀
    (show (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)).mp hεsmall
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hε0 with hzero | hpos
  · simp [← hzero]
  · nlinarith

name: NLAlib.rank_le_rank_krausMap_of_adjoint_normalized
statement:
theorem rank_le_rank_krausMap_of_adjoint_normalized
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) ≤ ε)
    (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1))
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    X.rank ≤ (krausMap A X).rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hcol, hrow, heig⟩ := exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues A hA hX
  have hε0 := (frobSq_nonneg (krausMap A 1 - 1)).trans hε
  have hdef : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
      ∑ i, ((∑ j, W i j) - 1) ^ 2 < 1 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrow.trans hε) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).trans_lt
      (card_mul_lt_one_of_le_div_card_add_one hε0 hεsmall)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Matrix.exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_row_sub_lt_one W hW hcol hdef
  have hcard := Matrix.card_nonzero_le_card_nonzero_mulVec_of_perm_pos
    W hW σ hσ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues hX.eigenvalues_nonneg
  rw [heig] at hcard
  rw [hX.isHermitian.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs,
    (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs]
  exact hcard

name: NLAlib.rank_le_rank_krausMap_of_unital
statement:
theorem rank_le_rank_krausMap_of_unital
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ≤ ε)
    (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1))
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    X.rank ≤ (krausMap A X).rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hrow, hcol, heig⟩ := exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_of_unital A hA hX
  have hε0 := (frobSq_nonneg (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1)).trans hε
  have hdef : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
      ∑ j, ((∑ i, W i j) - 1) ^ 2 < 1 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcol.trans hε) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).trans_lt
      (card_mul_lt_one_of_le_div_card_add_one hε0 hεsmall)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Matrix.exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_lt_one W hW hrow hdef
  have hcard := Matrix.card_nonzero_le_card_nonzero_mulVec_of_perm_pos
    W hW σ hσ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues hX.eigenvalues_nonneg
  rw [heig] at hcard
  rw [hX.isHermitian.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs,
    (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs]
  exact hcard

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct_squaredResolvent_affine_remainder
statement:
theorem hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct_squaredResolvent_affine_remainder
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (x₀ x₁ x₂ d e f : J → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) (h₀₁ : x₀-x₁ = a • d) (h₁₂ : x₁-x₂ = a • e)
    (h₀₂ : x₀-x₂ = a • f) :
    hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct d
        (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ x₀ - hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ x₁) =
      a • hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct d
        (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ x₂ d) +
      a^2 • normalizedTrace (L d *
        (resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (L x₀) (L x₁) (L x₂) (L d) (L e) +
          resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (L x₀) (L x₂) (L x₂) (L f) (L d)))
proof:
:= by
  have hA := isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x₀
  have hB := isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x₁
  have hC := isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x₂
  have hAB : L x₀-L x₁ = a • L d := by rw [← map_sub,h₀₁,map_smul]
  have hBC : L x₁-L x₂ = a • L e := by rw [← map_sub,h₁₂,map_smul]
  have hAC : L x₀-L x₂ = a • L f := by rw [← map_sub,h₀₂,map_smul]
  have hsec : hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ x₀ - hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ x₁ =
      a • resolventSquareDifference ζ (L x₀) (L x₁) (L d) :=
    resolvent_sq_sub_resolvent_sq_of_sub_eq_smul ζ (L x₀) (L x₁) (L d) hA hB hζ a hAB
  have hdiff := resolventSquareDifference_sub_self_of_sub_eq_smul ζ (L x₀) (L x₁) (L x₂)
    (L d) (L e) (L f) hA hB hC hζ a hBC hAC
  have hbase : resolventSquareDifference ζ (L x₀) (L x₁) (L d) =
      hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ x₂ d +
        a • (resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (L x₀) (L x₁) (L x₂) (L d) (L e) +
          resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (L x₀) (L x₂) (L x₂) (L f) (L d)) := by
    rw [hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative_apply ζ hζ]
    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp hdiff
  rw [hsec,hbase]
  simp only [map_smul,map_add,smul_add,smul_smul,pow_two,
    hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct_apply,Matrix.mul_add,normalizedTrace_add]

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_real_stieltjes_extension_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_real_stieltjes_extension_eq
    (F G : ℂ → M) (α : ℝ) (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → normalizedTrace (α • F z) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u < t)
    (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → G z = α • F z) :
    normalizedTrace (G u) = ((∫ t : ℝ, (t - u)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (u : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hφ : Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
    have hc : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
    simpa only [φ, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using
      (hc.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  let L : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => normalizedTrace (G (φ y)))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (normalizedTrace (G u))) :=
    L.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hGa.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hφ)
  have hca := analyticAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
    (μ : Measure ℝ) hcompact (u : ℂ) (by
      intro t ht he
      exact (hu t ht).ne (Complex.ofReal_injective he).symm)
  have hright := hca.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hφ
  have he : (fun y : ℝ => normalizedTrace (G (φ y))) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] 0]
      (fun y : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - φ y)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy
    have hz : 0 < (φ y).im := by simpa [φ] using (show 0 < y from hy)
    rw [hGN _ hz, hμ _ hz]
  have hlim := tendsto_nhds_unique hleft (hright.congr' (he.mono fun _ h => h.symm))
  rw [hlim]
  simp only [← Complex.ofReal_sub, ← Complex.ofReal_inv]
  exact integral_complex_ofReal

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_stable_matrixKTransform_solution_eq_stieltjes
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_stable_matrixKTransform_solution_eq_stieltjes
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z) = z • 1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → normalizedTrace (α • F z) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u < t)
    (S : M) (hS : S ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    α * (normalizedTrace S).re = ∫ t : ℝ, (t - u)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hGa, hGN, _hreal, _hGp, _hGdp⟩ :=
    exists_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ u hu
  have hGS := eq_real_stieltjes_extension_at_stable_matrixKTransform_solution
    ν hν α hα F hF G u hGa hGN S hS hK
  have h := normalizedTrace_real_stieltjes_extension_eq F G α μ hcompact hμ u hu hGa hGN
  rw [hGS] at h
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
  have hsm : normalizedTrace (α • S) = (α : ℂ) * normalizedTrace S := by
    rw [← normalizedTrace_smul]
    congr 1
  simpa only [hsm, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    zero_mul, sub_zero] using hr

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_solution_path
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_solution_path
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (S : ℝ → M) (B : M) (u : ℝ)
    (hpath : HasDerivAt S B u) (hS : (S u).PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ((S u)⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α (S u) = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α v (S v))
      (-α * (S u).trace.re) u
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℝ] ℝ := Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htr : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (S v).trace.re) B.trace.re u :=
    L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt u hpath
  have hzero : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α u (S v)) 0 u := by
    have h := (hasFDerivAt_matrixKPotential ν hν α u hα (S u) hS hgap).comp_hasDerivAt u hpath
    change HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α u (S v))
      (α * ((matrixKTransform ν α (S u) - (u : ℂ) • 1) * B).trace.re) u at h
    simpa only [hK, sub_self, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.trace_zero, Complex.zero_re,
      mul_zero] using h
  have hc := (((hasDerivAt_id u).sub_const u).mul htr).const_mul α
  have hd := hzero.sub hc
  convert! hd using 1
  · ext v
    dsimp only [matrixKPotential, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, id_eq]
    ring
  · simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_potential_below_trace_support
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_potential_below_trace_support
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z) = z • 1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass = 1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → normalizedTrace (α • F z) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u < t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α v
      (matrixKStableInverse ν α ((v : ℂ) • 1)) / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
      (-(∫ t : ℝ, (t - u)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))) u
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar (r : ℝ) : (r : ℂ) • (1 : M) = r • (1 : M) :=
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ r (1 : M)
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hK₀⟩ :=
    exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
      ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hmass hcompact hμ u hu
  have hU : (u : ℂ) • (1 : M) ∈ matrixKTransform ν α '' matrixKStableDomain ν α :=
    ⟨S₀, hS₀, hK₀⟩
  obtain ⟨hS, hK⟩ := matrixKStableInverse_mem_and_transform_eq ν α hU
  obtain ⟨B, _hBH, hd, _hDB⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_affine
    ν hν α hα 0 1 Matrix.isHermitian_one u (by simpa only [zero_add, ← hscalar] using hU)
  have hpath : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKStableInverse ν α ((v : ℂ) • 1)) B u := by
    simpa only [zero_add, ← hscalar] using hd
  have hpot := (hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_solution_path ν hν α hα.ne'
    (fun v : ℝ => matrixKStableInverse ν α ((v : ℂ) • 1)) B u hpath hS.1 hS.2.1 hK).div_const
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  have ht := normalizedTrace_stable_matrixKTransform_solution_eq_stieltjes
    ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hcompact hμ u hu _ hS hK
  have hreal (A : M) : (normalizedTrace A).re = A.trace.re / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    have hc : (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ = (((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
    rw [normalizedTrace, hc]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      mul_zero, sub_zero, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  convert! hpot using 1
  rw [← ht, hreal]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_increase
statement:
theorem exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_increase
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (S : M) (hS : S ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α) :
    ∃ (ε : ℝ) (Q : M), 0 < ε ∧ Q ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α Q = matrixKTransform ν α S + ε • (1 : M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, B, hGa, hG0, _hB, _hGd, hGH, hGeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_decreasing_affine_branch ν hν α hα
      S hS.1 hS.2.1 hS.2.2 1 Matrix.PosDef.one
  have hx : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero] using Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 : ℝ)
  have hGlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => G t) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hG0] using hGa.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx
  let Ssa : selfAdjoint M := ⟨S, hS.1.isHermitian⟩
  have hpartS : selfAdjointPart ℝ S = Ssa :=
    Subtype.ext (hS.1.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ)
  have hRlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => selfAdjointPart ℝ (G t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 Ssa) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hpartS] using
      (continuous_selfAdjointPart ℝ M).tendsto S |>.comp hGlim
  have hstay := hRlim.eventually
    ((isOpen_matrixKStableDomain_hermitian ν hν α hα).mem_nhds hS)
  have hstable : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, G t ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    filter_upwards [hstay, hGH] with t ht hHt
    change (selfAdjointPart ℝ (G t) : M) ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α at ht
    rwa [hHt.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ] at ht
  have hneg : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => -t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [neg_zero] using (continuous_neg.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hnegC : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_zero] using
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hneg
  have he : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < t ∧
      G ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (G ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ)) = matrixKTransform ν α S + t • (1 : M) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hneg.eventually hstable, hnegC.eventually hGeq]
      with t ht hst hsolve
    refine ⟨ht, hst, ?_⟩
    have hsm : (t : ℂ) • (1 : M) = t • (1 : M) := IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ t 1
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_neg, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, hsm] using hsolve.2
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst, hsolve⟩ := he.exists
  exact ⟨t, G ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ), ht, hst, hsolve⟩

name: NLAlib.convex_image_matrixKTransform_stableDomain
statement:
theorem convex_image_matrixKTransform_stableDomain
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    Convex ℝ ((matrixKTransform ν α) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α)
proof:
:= by
  rintro U ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ V ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨ε, P, hε, hP, hKP⟩ := exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_increase
    ν hν α hα S hS
  obtain ⟨η, R, hη, hR, hKR⟩ := exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_increase
    ν hν α hα Q hQ
  let Y := P⁻¹
  let Z := R⁻¹
  have hY : Y.PosDef := hP.1.inv
  have hZ : Z.PosDef := hR.1.inv
  have hYY : Y⁻¹ = P := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hP.1.isUnit)
  have hZZ : Z⁻¹ = R := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR.1.isUnit)
  have hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef := hP.2.1
  have hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef := hR.2.1
  obtain ⟨hW, hgapW⟩ := posDef_add_samples_of_convex_combination
    ν Y Z hY hZ hgapY hgapZ ha hb hab
  let W : selfAdjoint M := ⟨a • Y + b • Z, hW.isHermitian⟩
  let L := a • matrixKTransform ν α S + b • matrixKTransform ν α Q
  have hδ : 0 < a * ε + b * η := by
    rcases ha.eq_or_lt with ha0 | ha0
    · have hae : a = 0 := ha0.symm
      have hbe : b = 1 := by linarith
      simpa only [hae, hbe, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_add] using hη
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos ha0 hε) (mul_nonneg hb hη.le)
  have hconc := smul_add_smul_matrixKTransform_inverse_le
    ν hν α Y Z hY hZ hgapY hgapZ ha hb hab
  rw [hYY, hZZ, hKP, hKR] at hconc
  have he : a • (matrixKTransform ν α S + ε • (1 : M)) +
      b • (matrixKTransform ν α Q + η • (1 : M)) = L + (a * ε + b * η) • (1 : M) := by
    dsimp only [L]
    module
  rw [he] at hconc
  have hle : (a * ε + b * η) • (1 : M) ≤ matrixKTransform ν α W.val⁻¹ - L := by
    convert sub_le_sub_right hconc L using 1; abel
  have hdec : (matrixKTransform ν α W.val⁻¹ - L).PosDef :=
    ((Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hδ).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef
  obtain ⟨J, _horder, hJ, hKJ⟩ :=
    exists_stable_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution_of_strict_subsolution ν hν α hα
      W hW hgapW L hdec
  have hst : J.val⁻¹ ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    rw [← image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
    exact ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨J.val⁻¹, hst, hKJ⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_of_isHermitian
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective hB.eigenvalues) :
    let E
proof:
:= Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star hB.eigenvectorUnitary)
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (hB.eigenvalues i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 ((E A) i i))) ∧
      ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, hB.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc l u) →
        ∀ r : ℝ, R < r → ∀ t : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch hB.eigenvalues r s) volume l u ∧
        (∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch hB.eigenvalues r s) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • B)) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp ((E A) i i - (t : ℂ) * hB.eigenvalues i) := by
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star hB.eigenvectorUnitary)
  have hEB : E B = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hB.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [E, Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal] using
      hB.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hformula⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
      hB.eigenvalues hsimple (E A)
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, ?_⟩
  intro l u hlu hau r hRr t
  have hpencil : E A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hB.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) =
      E (A - (t : ℂ) • B) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, hEB]
  have htrace : Matrix.trace (matrixExp
      (E A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hB.eigenvalues i : ℂ)))) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • B)) := by
    rw [hpencil]
    have hh := congrArg Matrix.trace
      (matrixExp_unitary_conj (star hB.eigenvectorUnitary) (A - (t : ℂ) • B))
    rw [trace_unitary_conj] at hh
    exact hh
  simpa only [htrace] using hformula l u hlu hau r hRr t

name: NLAlib.hermitianNeumannInverse_eq_inverse
statement:
theorem hermitianNeumannInverse_eq_inverse
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (hL : ‖L‖<1) :
    hermitianNeumannInverse L = Ring.inverse (1-L)
proof: := geom_series_eq_inverse L hL

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_hermitianNeumannInverse
statement:
theorem posSemidef_hermitianNeumannInverse
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n)
    (hL : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L x)).PosSemidef)
    (hnorm : ‖L‖<1) {x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n}
    (hx : (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef) :
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (hermitianNeumannInverse L x)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := (hermitianFrobeniusMatrixLinear : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hp (j : ℕ) : (Φ ((L^j) x)).PosSemidef := by
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      change (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef
      exact hx
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ']
      exact hL _ ih
  have hsum := (Φ.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply' (HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (RingHom.id ℝ) x)).hasSum
    (summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hnorm).hasSum
  have hclosed : IsClosed {A : Matrix n n ℂ | A.PosSemidef} := by
    simpa only [Set.Ici,Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef] using
      (isClosed_Ici : IsClosed (Set.Ici (0 : Matrix n n ℂ)))
  apply hclosed.mem_of_tendsto hsum.tendsto_sum_nat
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun j => Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun i _ => hp i)

name: NLAlib.hermitianNeumannInverse_sub_map
statement:
theorem hermitianNeumannInverse_sub_map
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (hnorm : ‖L‖<1)
    (x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) :
    hermitianNeumannInverse L x - L (hermitianNeumannInverse L x) = x
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun A : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n => A x)
    (mul_neg_geom_series L hnorm)

name: NLAlib.one_le_hermitianNeumannInverse_one
statement:
theorem one_le_hermitianNeumannInverse_one
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n)
    (hL : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L x)).PosSemidef) (hnorm : ‖L‖<1) :
    let I
proof:
:= toHermitianFrobenius (Matrix.isHermitian_one : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian)
    (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (hermitianNeumannInverse L I) := by
  dsimp only
  let I := toHermitianFrobenius (Matrix.isHermitian_one : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian)
  let Y := hermitianNeumannInverse L I
  have hY := posSemidef_hermitianNeumannInverse L hL hnorm (x:=I) Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  have he := congrArg (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n) (hermitianNeumannInverse_sub_map L hnorm I)
  change hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y-hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y)=1 at he
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  have hh : hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y-1=hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y) := by
    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr (eq_add_of_sub_eq' he)
  rw [hh]
  exact hL Y hY

name: NLAlib.exists_posDef_supersolution_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_posDef_supersolution_of_norm_lt_one
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n)
    (hL : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L x)).PosSemidef)
    (hnorm : ‖L‖<1) :
    ∃ Y : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n,
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y).PosDef ∧
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Y-L Y)).PosDef ∧
      (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y
proof:
:= by
  let I : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n :=
    (hermitianFrobeniusEquiv ℂ n).symm ⟨1,Matrix.isHermitian_one⟩
  let Y := hermitianNeumannInverse L I
  have hI : hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n I = 1 := rfl
  have hY := posSemidef_hermitianNeumannInverse L hL hnorm (x:=I)
    (hI ▸ Matrix.PosSemidef.one)
  have hEq : Y-L Y=I := by
    have h := congrArg (fun A : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n => A I)
      (mul_neg_geom_series L hnorm)
    exact h
  have hdiff : hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y - 1 = hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y) := by
    have h := congrArg (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n) hEq
    change hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y - hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y) = 1 at h
    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr (eq_add_of_sub_eq' h)
  have hge : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    rw [hdiff]
    exact hL Y hY
  refine ⟨Y,?_,?_,hge⟩
  · have hh := Matrix.PosDef.one.add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hge)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hh
  · rw [hEq,hI]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one

name: NLAlib.trace_cfc_abs_pow_le_sqrt_trace_even_pow
statement:
theorem trace_cfc_abs_pow_le_sqrt_trace_even_pow {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) :
    (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ k) A).trace ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A ^ (2 * (k / 2))).trace * (A ^ (2 * ((k + 1) / 2))).trace)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA, trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA,
    trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  have hpar : k / 2 + (k + 1) / 2 = k := by omega
  have he (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : (|x| ^ j) ^ 2 = x ^ (2 * j) := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm j 2, pow_mul, sq_abs, ← pow_mul]
  have hs : ∑ i, |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ k =
      ∑ i, |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ (k / 2) * |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ ((k + 1) / 2) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← pow_add, hpar]
  rw [hs]
  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  simpa only [he] using Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ
    (fun i => |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ (k / 2))
    (fun i => |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ ((k + 1) / 2))

name: NLAlib.div_trace_cfc_abs_pow_le_sqrt_div_trace_even_pow
statement:
theorem div_trace_cfc_abs_pow_le_sqrt_div_trace_even_pow {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ k) A).trace / c ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A ^ (2 * (k / 2))).trace / c) *
        Real.sqrt ((A ^ (2 * ((k + 1) / 2))).trace / c)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := trace_pow_nonneg_of_even hA (even_two_mul (k / 2))
  have hb := trace_pow_nonneg_of_even hA (even_two_mul ((k + 1) / 2))
  rw [Real.sqrt_div ha, Real.sqrt_div hb, div_mul_div_comm,
    Real.mul_self_sqrt hc.le, ← Real.sqrt_mul ha]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (trace_cfc_abs_pow_le_sqrt_trace_even_pow hA k) hc.le

name: NLAlib.matrixRealPart_complexification
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixRealPart_complexification (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    matrixRealPart (realMatrixComplexification A) = A
proof: := by ext i j; rfl

name: NLAlib.complexification_injective
statement:
private theorem complexification_injective :
    Function.Injective (realMatrixComplexification (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective matrixRealPart_complexification

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_matrixExp
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_matrixExp (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (matrixExp A) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      matrixExp (realMatrixComplexification A)
proof:
:= by
  exact NormedSpace.map_exp_of_mem_ball (𝕂 := ℝ) realMatrixComplexification
    continuous_realMatrixComplexification A (by
      rw [NormedSpace.expSeries_radius_eq_top]
      exact edist_lt_top _ _)

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_lyapunovIntegrand
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_lyapunovIntegrand (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (realLyapunovIntegrand A Q t) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      lyapunovIntegrand (realMatrixComplexification A) (realMatrixComplexification Q) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold realLyapunovIntegrand lyapunovIntegrand
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, realMatrixComplexification_matrixExp, map_smul]
  have hstar : (realMatrixComplexification (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (realMatrixComplexification (matrixExp (t • A)))ᴴ := map_star realMatrixComplexification _
  rw [hstar, realMatrixComplexification_matrixExp, map_smul]

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_realLyapunovIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrableOn_realLyapunovIntegrand (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    IntegrableOn (realLyapunovIntegrand A Q) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := matrixRealPart.integrable_comp
    (integrableOn_lyapunovIntegrand (realMatrixComplexification A) (realMatrixComplexification Q) hA)
  have heq : (fun t => matrixRealPart (lyapunovIntegrand (realMatrixComplexification A)
      (realMatrixComplexification Q) t)) = realLyapunovIntegrand A Q := by
    funext t
    rw [← realMatrixComplexification_lyapunovIntegrand, matrixRealPart_complexification]
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_realLyapunovGramian
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_realLyapunovGramian (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (realLyapunovGramian A Q) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      lyapunovGramian (realMatrixComplexification A) (realMatrixComplexification Q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (realMatrixComplexification (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  have h := F.integral_comp_comm (integrableOn_realLyapunovIntegrand A Q hA)
  change (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), realMatrixComplexification (realLyapunovIntegrand A Q t)) =
    realMatrixComplexification (realLyapunovGramian A Q) at h
  rw [← h]
  simp only [realMatrixComplexification_lyapunovIntegrand, lyapunovGramian]

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_complexification_posDef
statement:
private theorem posDef_of_complexification_posDef (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef) : A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply ((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff A).mp hA.posSemidef).posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hzero
  have hn := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA.isUnit
  apply (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hn)
  change (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).det = 0
  have hd := (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).map_det A
  rw [hzero, map_zero] at hd
  exact hd.symm

name: NLAlib.realLyapunovGramian_equation_unique
statement:
theorem realLyapunovGramian_equation_unique (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    A * realLyapunovGramian A Q + realLyapunovGramian A Q * Aᴴ + Q = 0 ∧
      ∀ X : Matrix n n ℝ, A * X + X * Aᴴ + Q = 0 → X = realLyapunovGramian A Q
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : (realMatrixComplexification Aᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (realMatrixComplexification A)ᴴ := map_star realMatrixComplexification A
  have he := (existsUnique_lyapunov_of_hurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A)
    (realMatrixComplexification Q) hA)
  have hG := realMatrixComplexification_realLyapunovGramian A Q hA
  have hEq : (realMatrixComplexification A) * lyapunovGramian (realMatrixComplexification A) (realMatrixComplexification Q) +
      lyapunovGramian (realMatrixComplexification A) (realMatrixComplexification Q) * (realMatrixComplexification A)ᴴ +
      realMatrixComplexification Q = 0 := by
    rw [lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution _ _ _ hA (lyapunovCayleySolution_equation _ _ hA)]
    exact lyapunovCayleySolution_equation _ _ hA
  constructor
  · apply complexification_injective
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul, hstar, hG, map_zero] using hEq
  · intro X hX
    apply complexification_injective
    rw [hG]
    exact lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution _ _ _ hA (by
      have h := congrArg (realMatrixComplexification (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)) hX
      simpa only [map_add, map_mul, hstar, map_zero] using h) |>.symm

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_realLyapunovGramian
statement:
theorem posSemidef_realLyapunovGramian (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) :
    (realLyapunovGramian A Q).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) _).mp
  rw [realMatrixComplexification_realLyapunovGramian A Q hA]
  exact posSemidef_lyapunovGramian _ _ hA ((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff Q).mpr hQ)

name: NLAlib.posDef_realLyapunovGramian
statement:
theorem posDef_realLyapunovGramian (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) (hQ : Q.PosDef) :
    (realLyapunovGramian A Q).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply posDef_of_complexification_posDef
  rw [realMatrixComplexification_realLyapunovGramian A Q hA]
  exact posDef_lyapunovGramian _ _ hA (posDef_realMatrixComplexification hQ)

name: NLAlib.isHurwitz_complexification_iff_exists_real_posDef_lyapunov
statement:
theorem isHurwitz_complexification_iff_exists_real_posDef_lyapunov (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ) ↔
      ∃ X : Matrix n n ℝ, X.PosDef ∧ (-(A * X + X * Aᴴ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    let X := realLyapunovGramian A 1
    have heq := (realLyapunovGramian_equation_unique A 1 hA).1
    refine ⟨X, posDef_realLyapunovGramian A 1 hA Matrix.PosDef.one, ?_⟩
    have hsum : A * X + X * Aᴴ = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left heq
    rw [hsum, neg_neg]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hR⟩
    apply isHurwitz_of_posDef_lyapunov _ (realMatrixComplexification X) (posDef_realMatrixComplexification hX)
    have h := posDef_realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ) hR
    have hstar : (realMatrixComplexification Aᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) =
        (realMatrixComplexification A)ᴴ := map_star realMatrixComplexification A
    simpa only [map_neg, map_add, map_mul, hstar] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight_rpow
statement:
private theorem norm_finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight_rpow
    {w p₀ p₁ s : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hp₁ : 0 < p₁) (hs : 0 < s)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : (1 - z.re) / p₀ + z.re / p₁ = 1 / s) :
    ‖finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight w p₀ p₁ z‖ ^ s = w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight, norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_of_pos
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hwpos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hwpos _),
      ← Real.rpow_mul hw, ← Real.rpow_mul hw, ← Real.rpow_add hwpos,
      ← Real.rpow_mul hw]
    have he : ((1 / p₀) * (1 - z.re) + (1 / p₁) * z.re) * s = 1 := by
      calc
        _ = ((1 - z.re) / p₀ + z.re / p₁) * s := by ring
        _ = 1 := by rw [hz]; field_simp
    rw [he, Real.rpow_one]
  · have hwzero := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    simp [finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight, powerInterpolationCoefficient,
      Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero hp₀.ne'), Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero hp₁.ne'),
      Real.zero_rpow hs.ne']

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_schattenNormReal_rpow_root_le_of_finite_boundary_bounds
statement:
theorem sum_mul_schattenNormReal_rpow_root_le_of_finite_boundary_bounds
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    {θ p₀ p₁ p M₀ M₁ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hp₀ : 1 < p₀) (hp₁ : 1 < p₁) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / p₀ + θ / p₁)
    (G : ι → ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hG : ∀ i, DiffContOnCl ℂ (G i) (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (B : ι → ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ i z, z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 →
      specNorm (G i z) ≤ B i)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∑ i, w i * schattenNormReal (G i ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) p₀ ^ p₀) ^ (1 / p₀) ≤ M₀)
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∑ i, w i * schattenNormReal (G i (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) p₁ ^ p₁) ^ (1 / p₁) ≤ M₁) :
    (∑ i, w i * schattenNormReal (G i (θ : ℂ)) p ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤
      M₀ ^ (1 - θ) * M₁ ^ θ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp₀0 : 0 < p₀ := zero_lt_one.trans hp₀
  have hp₁0 : 0 < p₁ := zero_lt_one.trans hp₁
  have hp0 : 0 < p := zero_lt_one.trans hp
  let c : ι → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight (w i) p₀ p₁
  let F : ℂ → ι → Matrix n n ℂ := fun z i => c i z • G i z
  let H : ℂ → Matrix (n × ι) (n × ι) ℂ := fun z => Matrix.blockDiagonal (F z)
  have hc (i : ι) : Differentiable ℂ (c i) :=
    differentiable_powerInterpolationCoefficient _ _
  have hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    refine ⟨differentiableOn_pi.mpr fun i => ?_, continuousOn_pi.mpr fun i => ?_⟩
    · exact (hc i).differentiableOn.smul (hG i).differentiableOn
    · exact (hc i).continuous.continuousOn.smul (hG i).continuousOn
  let D : (ι → Matrix n n ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (n × ι) (n × ι) ℂ :=
    { toFun := Matrix.blockDiagonal
      map_add' := Matrix.blockDiagonal_add
      map_smul' := fun a f => Matrix.blockDiagonal_smul a f }
  have hH : DiffContOnCl ℂ H (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    exact ⟨D.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hF.differentiableOn,
      D.toContinuousLinearMap.continuous.comp_continuousOn hF.continuousOn⟩
  have hnorm {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {z : ℂ}
      (hz : (1 - z.re) / p₀ + z.re / p₁ = 1 / s) :
      schattenNormReal (H z) s = (∑ i, w i * schattenNormReal (G i z) s ^ s) ^ (1 / s) := by
    rw [show H z = Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun i => c i z • G i z) from rfl,
      schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_complex _ hs]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [schattenNormReal_smul_complex _ _ hs,
      Real.mul_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _),
      show ‖c i z‖ ^ s = w i from
        norm_finiteMeasureInterpolationWeight_rpow (hw i) hp₀0 hp₁0 hs hz]
  let C : ι → ℝ := fun i => max (w i ^ (1 / p₀)) (w i ^ (1 / p₁)) *
    (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * |B i|
  have hmax (i : ι) : 0 ≤ max (w i ^ (1 / p₀)) (w i ^ (1 / p₁)) :=
    le_max_of_le_left (Real.rpow_nonneg (hw i) _)
  have hFbound {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (i : ι) : schattenNormReal (F z i) 2 ≤ C i := by
    have hci : ‖c i z‖ ≤ max (w i ^ (1 / p₀)) (w i ^ (1 / p₁)) :=
      norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_le_max (Real.rpow_nonneg (hw i) _)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (hw i) _) hz
    have hGi := (schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm (G i z) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hbound i z hz).trans (le_abs_self _)) (by positivity))
    rw [show F z i = c i z • G i z from rfl, schattenNormReal_smul_complex _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    exact (mul_le_mul hci hGi (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) (hmax i)).trans_eq (by dsimp [C]; ring)
  have hHbound : ∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
      specNorm (H z) ≤ (∑ i, C i ^ 2) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro z hz
    apply (specNorm_le_schattenNormReal (H z) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).trans
    rw [show H z = Matrix.blockDiagonal (F z) from rfl,
      schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_complex _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _) _ (by positivity)
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    simpa only [Real.rpow_two] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) (hFbound hz i) 2
  rw [← hnorm hp0 (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using hexp.symm)]
  apply schattenNormReal_le_rpow_mul_rpow_of_finite_boundary_bounds hθ hp₀ hp₁ hp hexp hH hHbound
  · intro t
    rw [hnorm hp₀0 (by simp)]
    exact hleft t
  · intro t
    rw [hnorm hp₁0 (by simp)]
    exact hright t

name: NLAlib.frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef {P Q : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hP : P.PosSemidef) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ frobInner P Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, hP.isHermitian.eq]
  exact Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef hP hQ) |>.1

name: NLAlib.exists_posSemidef_parts
statement:
theorem exists_posSemidef_parts {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ P N : Matrix n n ℂ, P.PosSemidef ∧ N.PosSemidef ∧
      H=P-N ∧ frobInner P N=0 ∧ frobSq (P+N)=frobSq H
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max x 0
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (-x) 0
  have hf : Continuous f := continuous_id.max continuous_const
  have hg : Continuous g := continuous_neg.max continuous_const
  let P := cfc f H
  let N := cfc g H
  have hP : P.PosSemidef := posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues hH (fun i => le_max_right _ _)
  have hN : N.PosSemidef := posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues hH (fun i => le_max_right _ _)
  have hfg (x : ℝ) : f x-g x=x := by
    dsimp [f,g]
    by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
    · rw [max_eq_left hx, max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)]; ring
    · rw [max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hx), max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ -x)]; ring
  have hfg0 (x : ℝ) : f x*g x=0 := by
    dsimp [f,g]
    by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
    · rw [max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hx), mul_zero]
    · rw [max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hx), zero_mul]
  have hdiff : P-N=H := by
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun x => f x-g x) H := (cfc_sub f g H hf.continuousOn hg.continuousOn).symm
      _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) H := cfc_congr (fun x _ => hfg x)
      _ = H := cfc_id ℝ H hH
  have hPN : P*N=0 := by
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun x => f x*g x) H := (cfc_mul f g H hf.continuousOn hg.continuousOn).symm
      _ = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => 0) H := cfc_congr (fun x _ => hfg0 x)
      _ = 0 := cfc_zero ℝ H
  have hi : frobInner P N=0 := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, hP.isHermitian.eq, hPN, Matrix.trace_zero, map_zero]
  refine ⟨P,N,hP,hN,hdiff.symm,hi,?_⟩
  rw [← hdiff, frobSq_add, frobSq_sub, hi]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_posSemidef_rayleigh_majorant
statement:
theorem exists_posSemidef_rayleigh_majorant
    (L : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hL : ∀ P : Matrix n n ℂ, P.PosSemidef → (L P).PosSemidef)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ K : Matrix n n ℂ, K.PosSemidef ∧ frobSq K=frobSq H ∧
      |frobInner H (L H)| ≤ frobInner K (L K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,N,hP,hN,hH,hi,hnorm⟩ := exists_posSemidef_parts hH
  refine ⟨P+N,hP.add hN,hnorm,?_⟩
  rw [hH, map_sub, map_add]
  simp only [frobInner_add_left, frobInner_add_right, frobInner_sub_left, frobInner_sub_right]
  have hPP := frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef hP (hL P hP)
  have hPN := frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef hP (hL N hN)
  have hNP := frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef hN (hL P hP)
  have hNN := frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef hN (hL N hN)
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.frobInner_pos_of_posSemidef_posDef
statement:
theorem frobInner_pos_of_posSemidef_posDef {P Y : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hP : P.PosSemidef) (hP0 : P≠0) (hY : Y.PosDef) : 0 < frobInner P Y
proof:
:= by
  have hn := frobInner_nonneg_of_posSemidef hP hY.posSemidef
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hn
  intro hz
  have hz' : (P*Y).trace=0 := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · have he : frobInner P Y = 0 := hz.symm
      rw [frobInner_eq_trace,hP.isHermitian.eq] at he
      exact he
    · exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef hP hY.posSemidef)).2.symm
  have hPY := (trace_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef hP hY.posSemidef).mp hz'
  apply hP0
  calc
    P = P*(Y*Y⁻¹) := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY.isUnit)]; simp
    _ = 0 := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,hPY,Matrix.zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.inner_sub_map_pos_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem inner_sub_map_pos_of_norm_lt_one
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (L : E→L[ℝ]E) (hL : ‖L‖<1) {x : E} (hx : x≠0) :
    0 < inner ℝ x (x-L x)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : inner ℝ x (L x) ≤ ‖L‖*‖x‖^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖x‖*‖L x‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖x‖*(‖L‖*‖x‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (L.le_opNorm x) (norm_nonneg x)
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [inner_sub_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hp : 0<‖x‖^2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.inner_sub_map_pos_iff_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem inner_sub_map_pos_iff_norm_lt_one [Nonempty n]
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (hsym : L.IsSymmetric)
    (hcone : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L x)).PosSemidef) :
    (∀ x≠0, 0 < inner ℝ x (x-L x)) ↔ ‖L‖<1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨x,hx,_,heig⟩ := exists_posSemidef_norm_eigenvector L hsym hcone
    have hp := h x hx
    rw [heig,inner_sub_right,inner_smul_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hp
    have hn : 0<‖x‖^2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)
    nlinarith
  · exact fun h x hx => inner_sub_map_pos_of_norm_lt_one L h hx

name: NLAlib.norm_lt_one_of_posDef_supersolution
statement:
theorem norm_lt_one_of_posDef_supersolution [Nonempty n]
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (hsym : L.IsSymmetric)
    (hcone : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L x)).PosSemidef)
    {Y : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n} (hY : (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y).PosDef)
    (hgap : (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Y-L Y)).PosDef) : ‖L‖<1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hP,heig⟩ := exists_posSemidef_norm_eigenvector L hsym hcone
  have hx0 : hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hx
    apply (hermitianFrobeniusEquiv ℂ n).injective
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have hp := frobInner_pos_of_posSemidef_posDef hP hx0 hgap
  have hq := frobInner_pos_of_posSemidef_posDef hP hx0 hY
  change 0 < inner ℝ x (Y-L Y) at hp
  change 0 < inner ℝ x Y at hq
  have hs := hsym x Y
  change inner ℝ (L x) Y = inner ℝ x (L Y) at hs
  rw [heig,inner_smul_left] at hs
  rw [inner_sub_right,← hs] at hp
  simp only [starRingEnd_apply,star_trivial] at hp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.positiveCone_stability_iff
statement:
theorem positiveCone_stability_iff [Nonempty n]
    (L : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) (hsym : L.IsSymmetric)
    (hcone : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L x)).PosSemidef) :
    ((∀ x≠0,0 < inner ℝ x (x-L x)) ↔ ‖L‖<1) ∧
    (‖L‖<1 ↔ ∃Y, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y).PosDef ∧
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Y-L Y)).PosDef)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inner_sub_map_pos_iff_norm_lt_one L hsym hcone,?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨Y,hY,hg,_⟩ := exists_posDef_supersolution_of_norm_lt_one L hcone h
    exact ⟨Y,hY,hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨Y,hY,hg⟩
    exact norm_lt_one_of_posDef_supersolution L hsym hcone hY hg

name: NLAlib.transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ * (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using this

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self
statement:
theorem eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) * (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_eq_one_comm.1 (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA)

name: NLAlib.eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) * Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues *
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem]
  simp [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.aeval_diagonal
statement:
theorem aeval_diagonal (d : n → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    aeval (Matrix.diagonal d) p = Matrix.diagonal fun i => p.eval (d i)
proof:
:= by
  have := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (Matrix.diagonalAlgHom ℝ (n := n) (α := ℝ)) d p
  simp only [Matrix.diagonalAlgHom_apply] at this
  rw [this]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [aeval_pi_apply₂, coe_aeval_eq_eval]

name: NLAlib.aeval_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_mul_diagonal_mul {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    aeval A p = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i)) *
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n ℝ := ↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  have hU' : U * Uᵀ = 1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA
  
  let f : Matrix n n ℝ →ₐ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun M => U * M * Uᵀ
      map_one' := by simp [hU']
      map_mul' := fun M N => by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U, hU, Matrix.one_mul]
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := fun M N => by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
      commutes' := fun r => by
        simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, hU'] }
  have hA' : aeval A p = aeval (f (Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues)) p :=
    congrArg (fun M => aeval M p) (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA)
  rw [hA', Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_diagonal]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec_apply {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ *ᵥ v) i = ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem aeval_mulVec_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X]) (v : n → ℝ) :
    aeval A p *ᵥ v =
      ∑ i, (p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v)) •
        ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_eq_mul_diagonal_mul hA p, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  ext j
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Finset.sum_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun k _ hk => by simp [Ne.symm hk]) (by simp)]
  simp only [if_true]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (v : n → ℝ) : ∑ i, (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2 = v ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n ℝ := ↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have h : (Uᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ v) = v ⬝ᵥ ((Uᵀᵀ * Uᵀ) *ᵥ v) :=
    star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self Uᵀ v
  rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose, eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA,
    Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  rw [← h, mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_sq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X])
    (v : n → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ v) =
      ∑ i, p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA p v, dotProduct_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm v]
  ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (v : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm A v = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA X v
  simp only [aeval_X, eval_X] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.transpose_aeval
statement:
theorem transpose_aeval {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (aeval A p)ᵀ = aeval A p
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_eq_mul_diagonal_mul hA p]
  simp [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X])
    (v : n → ℝ) :
    (aeval A p *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ v) =
      ∑ i, p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (aeval A p *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ v) = v ⬝ᵥ (((aeval A p)ᵀ * aeval A p) *ᵥ v) from
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self _ v, transpose_aeval hA, ← map_mul,
    dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA]
  simp [sq]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem quadForm_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X])
    (v : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm A (aeval A p *ᵥ v) =
      ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 *
        (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hP : quadForm A (aeval A p *ᵥ v) = v ⬝ᵥ (aeval A (p * X * p) *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial, map_mul, map_mul, aeval_X, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec v (aeval A p), ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, transpose_aeval hA p]
  rw [hP, dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_X]
  ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_nonneg_of_eigenvalues_nonneg
statement:
theorem quadForm_nonneg_of_eigenvalues_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hpsd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) (x : n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ quadForm A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hpsd i) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_aeval_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_aeval_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (p : ℝ[X]) {M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (h : ∀ i, |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i)| ≤ M) : specNorm (aeval A p) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) :=
    transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  rw [aeval_eq_mul_diagonal_mul hA p, specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hM).2 fun i => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h i

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {p : ℝ[X]}
    {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S) (hp : ∀ x ∈ S, |p.eval x| ≤ M)
    (v : n → ℝ) :
    (aeval A p *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ v) ≤ M ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum hA, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA v,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sq_nonneg _)
  have h := hp _ (hspec i)
  exact sq_le_sq' (by linarith [neg_abs_le (p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i))])
    ((le_abs_self _).trans h)

name: NLAlib.quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (g p : ℝ[X]) (v : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (aeval A g) (aeval A p *ᵥ v) =
      ∑ i, g.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 *
        (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hP : quadForm (aeval A g) (aeval A p *ᵥ v) = v ⬝ᵥ (aeval A (p * g * p) *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial, map_mul, map_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec v (aeval A p), ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, transpose_aeval hA p]
  rw [hP, dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp only [eval_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g p : ℝ[X]}
    {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S) (hg : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ g.eval x)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ S, |p.eval x| ≤ M) (v : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (aeval A g) (aeval A p *ᵥ v) ≤ M ^ 2 * quadForm (aeval A g) v
proof:
:= by
  have hv : quadForm (aeval A g) v = quadForm (aeval A g) (aeval A (1 : ℝ[X]) *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [map_one, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hv, quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA, quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  have hgi : 0 ≤ g.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) := hg _ (hspec i)
  have h := hp _ (hspec i)
  have hsq : p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (by linarith [neg_abs_le (p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i))]) ((le_abs_self _).trans h)
  have hc := sq_nonneg (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v)
  simp only [eval_one, one_pow, mul_one]
  calc g.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 *
        (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
      ≤ g.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * M ^ 2 * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2 := by gcongr
    _ = M ^ 2 * (g.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2) := by ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_aeval_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem quadForm_aeval_mulVec_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {p : ℝ[X]}
    {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hS : S ⊆ Set.Ici 0) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ S, |p.eval x| ≤ M) (v : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm A (aeval A p *ᵥ v) ≤ M ^ 2 * quadForm A v
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_le hA (g := X) hspec
    (fun x hx => by simpa using hS hx) hp v
  rwa [aeval_X] at h

name: NLAlib.frechetDerivative_diagonal_apply
statement:
theorem frechetDerivative_diagonal_apply (p : ℝ[X]) (ev : n → ℝ) (H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    p.frechetDerivative (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) H =
      Matrix.of (fun i j => (((p.dividedDifference (ev i)).eval (ev j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * H i j)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => ext i j; simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [Polynomial.frechetDerivative_add, _root_.add_apply, hp, hq]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Polynomial.dividedDifference_add,
      Polynomial.eval_add, Complex.ofReal_add, add_mul]
  | monomial k a ih =>
    let p : ℝ[X] := C a * X ^ k
    have hpoly : C a * X ^ (k + 1) = p * X := by dsimp [p]; rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [hpoly, Polynomial.frechetDerivative_mul, Polynomial.frechetDerivative_X,
      Polynomial.aeval_X]
    change aeval (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) p * H +
      (p.frechetDerivative (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) H) *
        diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) = _
    have hdiag : aeval (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) p =
        diagonal (fun i => ((p.eval (ev i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      aeval_diagonal_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) ev p
    rw [ih, hdiag]
    ext i j
    rw [show p * X = X * p from mul_comm _ _]
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.of_apply,
      Polynomial.dividedDifference_X_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel_zero
statement:
theorem continuousAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel_zero
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) :
    ContinuousAt (fun X : M => ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, matrixKLogDetKernel X T.val ∂ν) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun T : selfAdjoint M => (T : M)) :=
    (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtypeL.contDiff
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => 1 + p.2.val * p.1) :=
    contDiff_const.add ((hval.comp contDiff_snd).mul contDiff_fst)
  have hdet : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re) :=
    Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp ((Matrix.contDiff_det 1).comp hA)
  let U : Set (M × selfAdjoint M) := {p | (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re ≠ 0}
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun hdet.continuous continuous_const
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1
      (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => Real.log (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re) U :=
    hdet.contDiffOn.log (fun _ hp => hp)
  have hp (T : selfAdjoint M) (_hT : T ∈ ν.support) : ((0 : M), T) ∈ U := by simp [U]
  exact (differentiableAt_integral_of_contDiffOn_compact_support ν hν
    (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => Real.log (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re) U hU hF 0 hp).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_matrixKInverseSandwich_le_of_le
statement:
theorem norm_integral_matrixKInverseSandwich_le_of_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (Y Z : M) (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z) :
    ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν‖ ≤
      ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν‖
proof:
:= by
  have hiY := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν Y hgapY
  have hiZ := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν Z hgapZ
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    have hp := (hgapZ T hT).inv.posSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (by simpa only [hTH.eq] using hp)
  apply CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le hnonneg
  apply integral_mono_ae hiZ hiY
  filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
  have hle : Y + T.val ≤ Z + T.val := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
  have hinv : (Z + T.val)⁻¹ ≤ (Y + T.val)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using
      CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hle (hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive
  have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
  have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hinv).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hTH.eq] using hp

name: NLAlib.norm_inverse_add_scalar_le_of_matrixKTransform_eq
statement:
theorem norm_inverse_add_scalar_le_of_matrixKTransform_eq
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (Y Z : M) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z)
    (u : ℝ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹ = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    ‖Z + (α * u) • (1 : M)‖ ≤ α *
      (‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν‖ +
        ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hfix := matrixKInverseIteration_eq_add_transform ν hν α hα.ne' ((u : ℂ) • 1) Z hZ hgapZ
  rw [hK, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero] at hfix
  have he : Z + (α * u) • (1 : M) = α •
      ((∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν) -
        (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν)) := by
    have hsm : (u : ℂ) • (1 : M) = u • (1 : M) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ u (1 : M)
    rw [matrixKInverseIteration, hsm] at hfix
    calc
      _ = (α • ((∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν) -
          (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν) - u • 1)) +
          (α * u) • (1 : M) := congrArg (fun W : M => W + (α * u) • 1) hfix.symm
      _ = _ := by module
  rw [he, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hα]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hα.le
  have hn := norm_integral_matrixKInverseSandwich_le_of_le ν hν Y Z hgapY hgapZ hYZ
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.exists_eventually_norm_inverse_add_scalar_le
statement:
theorem exists_eventually_norm_inverse_add_scalar_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (S : ℝ → M)
    (hsol : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atBot, S u ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (S u) = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atBot, ‖(S u)⁻¹ + (α * u) • (1 : M)‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u₀, hS₀, hK₀⟩ := hsol.exists
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYS⟩ : ∃ Y : selfAdjoint M,
      Y ∈ matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α ∧ Y.val⁻¹ = S u₀ := by
    have hmem : S u₀ ∈ (fun Y : selfAdjoint M => Y.val⁻¹) ''
        matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α := by
      rw [image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
      exact hS₀
    exact hmem
  refine ⟨α * (‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν‖ +
    ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y.val + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν‖), ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hsol, eventually_lt_atBot u₀] with u hu huu
  have hH : (((u₀ - u : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : M)).PosDef := by
    rw [show (((u₀ - u : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : M)) = (u₀ - u) • (1 : M) from
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ (u₀ - u) (1 : M)]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (sub_pos.mpr huu)
  obtain ⟨Z, hZY, hZ, hKZ⟩ :=
    exists_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution ν hν α hα Y hY
      (((u₀ - u : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : M)) hH
  have hKZ' : matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹ = (u : ℂ) • (1 : M) := by
    rw [hYS, hK₀, Complex.ofReal_sub, sub_smul] at hKZ
    convert hKZ using 1
    module
  have hSZ : S u = Z.val⁻¹ := by
    have hZst : Z.val⁻¹ ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
      rw [← image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
      exact ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
    exact (matrixKTransform_eq_iff_eq_of_quadratic_pos ν hν α hα (S u) Z.val⁻¹
      hu.1.1 hZst.1 hu.1.2.1 hZst.2.1 hu.1.2.2 hZst.2.2).mp (hu.2.trans hKZ'.symm)
  rw [hSZ, Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hZ.1.isUnit)]
  exact norm_inverse_add_scalar_le_of_matrixKTransform_eq ν hν α hα Y.val Z.val hZ.1
    hY.2.1 hZ.2.1 (Matrix.le_iff.mpr hZY.posSemidef) u hKZ'

name: NLAlib.tendsto_neg_mul_smul_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution
statement:
theorem tendsto_neg_mul_smul_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (S : ℝ → M)
    (hsol : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atBot, S u ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (S u) = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (-α * u) • S u) atBot (𝓝 (1 : M))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_eventually_norm_inverse_add_scalar_le ν hν α hα S hsol
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (-α * u)⁻¹) atBot (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atBot_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos hα))
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (-α * u)⁻¹ •
      ((S u)⁻¹ + (α * u) • (1 : M))) atBot (𝓝 (0 : M)) :=
    hinv.zero_smul_isBoundedUnder_le ⟨C, hC⟩
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (-α * u)⁻¹ • (S u)⁻¹) atBot (𝓝 (1 : M)) := by
    have ht := hzero.add_const (1 : M)
    simp only [zero_add] at ht
    apply ht.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_lt_atBot (0 : ℝ)] with u hu
    have hne : -α * u ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hα.ne') hu.ne
    have he : (-α * u)⁻¹ * (α * u) = -1 := by field_simp [hα.ne', hu.ne]
    simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, he, neg_one_smul]
    abel
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun X : M => X⁻¹) (1 : M) :=
    (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (1 : M) isUnit_one).continuousAt
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => ((-α * u)⁻¹ • (S u)⁻¹)⁻¹) atBot (𝓝 (1 : M)) := by
    simpa only [inv_one, Function.comp_def] using hcont.tendsto.comp hnorm
  apply hlim.congr'
  filter_upwards [hsol, eventually_lt_atBot (0 : ℝ)] with u hu hup
  have hne : -α * u ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hα.ne') hup.ne
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu.1.1.isUnit), mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_zero
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (S : ℝ → M)
    (hsol : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atBot, S u ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (S u) = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    Tendsto S atBot (𝓝 (0 : M))
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := tendsto_neg_mul_smul_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution ν hν α hα S hsol
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (-α * u)⁻¹) atBot (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atBot_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos hα))
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (-α * u)⁻¹ • ((-α * u) • S u))
      atBot (𝓝 (0 : M)) := by simpa only [zero_smul] using hinv.smul hnorm
  apply hzero.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_lt_atBot (0 : ℝ)] with u hu
  rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hα.ne') hu.ne), one_smul]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_matrixKPotential_scalar_solution_sub_log
statement:
theorem tendsto_matrixKPotential_scalar_solution_sub_log
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (S : ℝ → M)
    (hsol : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atBot, S u ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (S u) = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α u (S u) / Fintype.card n - Real.log (-u))
      atBot (𝓝 (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let Z : ℝ → M := fun u => (-α * u) • S u
  have hZ : Tendsto Z atBot (𝓝 (1 : M)) :=
    tendsto_neg_mul_smul_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution ν hν α hα S hsol
  have hSzero := tendsto_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_zero ν hν α hα S hsol
  have hI : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, matrixKLogDetKernel (S u) T.val ∂ν)
      atBot (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, matrixKLogDetKernel, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero,
      Matrix.det_one, Complex.one_re, Real.log_one, integral_zero] using
      (continuousAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel_zero ν hν).tendsto.comp hSzero
  have hdet : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (Z u).det.re) atBot (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, Matrix.det_one, Complex.one_re] using
      (Complex.continuous_re.comp (continuous_id.matrix_det : Continuous (fun X : M => X.det))).tendsto
        (1 : M) |>.comp hZ
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (Z u).det.re) atBot (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using hdet.log one_ne_zero
  have htrace : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (Z u).trace.re) atBot (𝓝 (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, Matrix.trace_one, Complex.natCast_re] using
      (Complex.continuous_re.comp (continuous_id.matrix_trace : Continuous (fun X : M => X.trace))).tendsto
        (1 : M) |>.comp hZ
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => ((Z u).trace.re - (Fintype.card n : ℝ) +
      α * (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, matrixKLogDetKernel (S u) T.val ∂ν) -
      Real.log (Z u).det.re) / Fintype.card n) atBot (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero, zero_div] using
      (((htrace.sub_const (Fintype.card n : ℝ)).add (hI.const_mul α)).sub hlog).div_const
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  apply hlim.congr'
  filter_upwards [hsol, eventually_lt_atBot (0 : ℝ)] with u hu hup
  have hc : 0 < -α * u := mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos hα) hup
  have hd : 0 < (S u).det.re := (Complex.pos_iff.mp hu.1.1.det_pos).1
  have hdetZ : (Z u).det.re = (-α * u) ^ Fintype.card n * (S u).det.re := by
    dsimp only [Z]
    rw [Matrix.det_smul_of_tower]
    simp only [Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  have hlogZ : Real.log (Z u).det.re =
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (Real.log α + Real.log (-u)) + Real.log (S u).det.re := by
    rw [hdetZ, Real.log_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hc.ne') hd.ne', Real.log_pow]
    rw [show -α * u = α * (-u) by ring,
      Real.log_mul hα.ne' (neg_pos.mpr hup).ne']
  have htrZ : (Z u).trace.re = (-α * u) * (S u).trace.re := by
    simp only [Z, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  have hk : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  dsimp only [matrixKPotential]
  rw [htrZ, hlogZ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (r : ℂ)) (p / r) ≤
      Real.exp (r * ∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t *
        Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  by_cases hn : Nonempty n
  · let := hn
    have hcont : Continuous (orderedMatrixExp H) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun z => (analyticAt_orderedMatrixExp H z).continuousAt)
    have hdiff : DiffContOnCl ℂ (orderedMatrixExp H)
        (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) :=
      ⟨fun z _ => (analyticAt_orderedMatrixExp H z).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        hcont.continuousOn⟩
    have hb (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1) :
        specNorm (orderedMatrixExp H z) ≤ Real.exp ((H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum) := by
      rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
      apply norm_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_sum_norm H hH
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hz.1], hz.2⟩
    have hl (t : ℝ) : specNorm (orderedMatrixExp H ((t : ℂ) * I)) ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_orderedMatrixExp_imaginary_le_one H hH t
    have hright (t : ℝ) :
        schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p ≤
          Real.exp (Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_log ((Real.exp_pos _).trans_le
        (exp_neg_sum_norm_le_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH hp0 t))]
    have h := schattenNormReal_le_exp_hirschman_of_left_contractions hr hp hdiff hb
      (fun t => Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
      (continuous_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH hp0).measurable
      (abs_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le H hH hp0) hl hright
    simpa only [mul_assoc, integral_const_mul] using h
  · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    have hz : orderedMatrixExp H (r : ℂ) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, schattenNormReal_zero (div_pos hp0 hr.1)]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.inverseConvexity_integrable_samples
statement:
private theorem inverseConvexity_integrable_samples
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) :
    Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich
statement:
private theorem inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich
