    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (Y : M) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val) ν.support := by
    intro T hT
    have hi : ContinuousAt (fun U : selfAdjoint M => (Y+U.val)⁻¹) T :=
      (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (Y+T.val) (hgap T hT).isUnit).continuousAt.comp
        (f := fun U : selfAdjoint M => Y+U.val)
        (continuous_const.add continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt
    exact ((continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.mul hi).mul
      continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_inverse_eq
statement:
theorem matrixKResolvent_inverse_eq (Y T : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgap : (Y+T).PosDef) :
    matrixKResolvent Y⁻¹ T=T-T*(Y+T)⁻¹*T
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Y⁻¹⁻¹=Y := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY.isUnit)
  have hden : 1+Y⁻¹*T=Y⁻¹*(Y+T) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY.isUnit)]
  rw [matrixKResolvent,hden,Matrix.mul_inv_rev,hi]
  calc
    _ = T*(Y+T)⁻¹*Y := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = T*(Y+T)⁻¹*((Y+T)-T) := congrArg (fun W : M => T*(Y+T)⁻¹*W) (by abel)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hgap.isUnit),Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_inverse_eq
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_inverse_eq
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (Y : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransform ν α Y⁻¹=(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)-α⁻¹•Y
proof:
:= by
  have hiT := inverseConvexity_integrable_samples ν hν
  have hiR := inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich ν hν Y hgap
  have hI : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,matrixKResolvent Y⁻¹ T.val ∂ν)=
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν) := by
    rw [← integral_sub hiT hiR]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    exact matrixKResolvent_inverse_eq Y T.val hY (hgap T hT)
  rw [matrixKTransform,hI,Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY.isUnit)]

name: NLAlib.smul_matrixKTransform_inverse_sub_le_inverseStability_defect
statement:
theorem smul_matrixKTransform_inverse_sub_le_inverseStability_defect
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y Z : M) (hY : Y.PosDef) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z+T.val).PosDef) :
    α•(matrixKTransform ν α Y⁻¹-matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹)≤
      Z-Y-matrixKInverseStability ν α Z (Z-Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hiY := inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich ν hν Y hgapY
  have hiZ := inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich ν hν Z hgapZ
  have hiD := integrable_matrixKInverseStability_kernel ν hν Z (Z-Y) hgapZ
  have hI : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*(Z-Y)*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)≤
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)-
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν) := by
    rw [← integral_sub hiY hiZ]
    apply integral_mono_ae hiD (hiY.sub hiZ)
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have ht := (hgapY T hT).inv_tangent_le (hgapZ T hT)
    have hP := (Matrix.le_iff.mp ht).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    convert! hP using 1;
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply,show (Z+T.val)-(Y+T.val)=Z-Y by abel,
        Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,hTH.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hmono := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hI hα.le
  rw [matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Y hY hgapY,
    matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Z hZ hgapZ,matrixKInverseStability]
  simp only [smul_sub,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
  convert! sub_le_sub_left hmono (Z-Y) using 1; module

name: NLAlib.posDef_sub_and_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain_of_ordered_transform_decrease
statement:
theorem posDef_sub_and_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain_of_ordered_transform_decrease
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y Z : selfAdjoint M) (hY : Y.val.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y.val+T.val).PosDef) (hYZ : Y.val≤Z.val)
    (hK : (matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹).PosDef) :
    (Z.val-Y.val).PosDef ∧ Z∈matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : Z.val.PosDef := (hY.isStrictlyPositive.of_le hYZ).posDef
  have hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z.val+T.val).PosDef := by
    intro T hT
    have hle : Y.val+T.val≤Z.val+T.val := by
      simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
    exact ((hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef
  have hiY := inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich ν hν Y.val hgapY
  have hiZ := inverseConvexity_integrable_sandwich ν hν Z.val hgapZ
  have hI : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z.val+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)≤
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν) := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hiZ hiY
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hinv : (Z.val+T.val)⁻¹≤(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹ := by
      have hle : Y.val+T.val≤Z.val+T.val := by
        simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
      simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using
        CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hle
          (hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive
    have hP := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hinv).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,hTH.eq] using hP
  have hsec : α•(matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹)≤Z.val-Y.val := by
    rw [matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Y.val hY hgapY,
      matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Z.val hZ hgapZ]
    simp only [smul_sub,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
    have hp := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hI hα.le
    convert! add_le_add_left hp (Z.val-Y.val-
      α•(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)) using 1 <;> module
  have hC : (Z.val-Y.val).PosDef := ((hK.smul hα).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hsec).posDef
  have hdef : (Z.val-Y.val-matrixKInverseStability ν α Z.val (Z.val-Y.val)).PosDef :=
    ((hK.smul hα).isStrictlyPositive.of_le
      (smul_matrixKTransform_inverse_sub_le_inverseStability_defect ν hν α hα
        Y.val Z.val hY hZ hgapY hgapZ)).posDef
  exact ⟨hC,hZ,hgapZ,Z.val-Y.val,hC,hdef⟩

name: NLAlib.pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq
proof:

proof:

  | monomial j c =>

name: NLAlib.continuous_matrixExp_smul
statement:
private theorem continuous_matrixExp_smul (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => matrixExp (t • A))
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun t : ℝ => NormedSpace.exp (t • A))
  exact continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun t => (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const A t).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_lyapunovIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrableOn_lyapunovIntegrand (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A) :
    IntegrableOn (lyapunovIntegrand A Q) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz : lyapunovIntegrand A Q = 0 := by funext t; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz]
    exact integrable_zero ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))
  | inr hn =>
    obtain ⟨C, γ, hC, hγ, hbound⟩ := hA.exists_pos_exponential_decay
    have hmajor := (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -2 * γ < 0) (0 : ℝ)).const_mul
      (C ^ 2 * specNorm Q)
    apply hmajor.mono'
    · have hc : Continuous (lyapunovIntegrand A Q) := by
        unfold lyapunovIntegrand
        exact ((continuous_matrixExp_smul A).mul_const Q).mul
          ((show Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => Mᴴ) by fun_prop).comp (continuous_matrixExp_smul A))
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
      dsimp [lyapunovIntegrand]
      have hE := hbound t ht.le
      calc
        _ ≤ specNorm (matrixExp (t • A) * Q) * specNorm (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
        _ ≤ (C * Real.exp (-γ * t) * specNorm Q) * (C * Real.exp (-γ * t)) := by
          rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
          exact mul_le_mul
            ((specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (specNorm_nonneg Q)))
            hE (specNorm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC.le (Real.exp_pos _).le) (specNorm_nonneg Q))
        _ = (C ^ 2 * specNorm Q) * (Real.exp (-γ * t) * Real.exp (-γ * t)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 2 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_lyapunovIntegrand_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_lyapunovIntegrand_zero (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A) :
    Tendsto (lyapunovIntegrand A X) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => exact tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  | inr hn =>
    obtain ⟨C, γ, hC, hγ, hbound⟩ := hA.exists_pos_exponential_decay
    have hexp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => matrixExp (t • A)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
      apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
      · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound t ht
      · have he := Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
          (tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (by linarith : -γ < 0))
        simpa using he.const_mul C
    have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => Mᴴ) := by fun_prop
    have hstar := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hexp
    convert! (hexp.mul_const X).mul hstar using 1
    simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_lyapunovIntegrand
proof:
:= by
  have he : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => matrixExp (s • A)) (matrixExp (t • A) * A) t :=
    hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const A t
  have h := (he.mul_const X).mul he.star
  have hAX : A * X + X * Aᴴ = -Q := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hX
  convert! h using 1
  change -(matrixExp (t • A) * Q * (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ) =
      (matrixExp (t • A) * A * X) * (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ +
        (matrixExp (t • A) * X) * (matrixExp (t • A) * A)ᴴ
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  calc
    _ = matrixExp (t • A) * (A * X + X * Aᴴ) * (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ := by rw [hAX]; simp
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution
statement:
theorem lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution (A Q X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A)
    (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + Q = 0) : lyapunovGramian A Q = X
proof:
:= by
  have hFTC := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto'
    (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_lyapunovIntegrand A X Q hX t)
    (integrableOn_lyapunovIntegrand A Q hA).neg (tendsto_lyapunovIntegrand_zero A X hA)
  have hzero : lyapunovIntegrand A X 0 = X := by simp [lyapunovIntegrand, matrixExp]
  rw [integral_neg, hzero, zero_sub] at hFTC
  exact neg_injective hFTC

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_lyapunov_of_hurwitz
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lyapunov_of_hurwitz (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A) :
    ∃! X : Matrix n n ℂ, A * X + X * Aᴴ + Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨lyapunovCayleySolution A Q, lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A Q hA, ?_⟩
  intro Y hY
  exact (lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution A Q Y hA hY).symm.trans
    (lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution A Q _ hA (lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A Q hA))

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_lyapunovGramian

theorem posSemidef_lyapunovGramian (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A)
    (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) : (lyapunovGramian A Q).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution A Q _ hA (lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A Q hA)]
  exact posSemidef_lyapunovCayleySolution A Q hA hQ

name: NLAlib.posDef_lyapunovGramian

theorem posDef_lyapunovGramian (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A)

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.inv_smul_one_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem inv_smul_one_of_ne_zero (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ = c⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv ?_
  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_smul]
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.trace_inv_smul_one
statement:
private theorem trace_inv_smul_one (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ((c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) / c
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_smul_one_of_ne_zero c hc, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_weights_barriers_of_potential_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_weights_barriers_of_potential_bounds [Nonempty n]
    (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (u0 l0 deltaU deltaL epsU epsL : ℝ)
    (hu0 : 0 < u0) (hl0 : l0 < 0)
    (hδU : 0 < deltaU) (hδL : 0 < deltaL)
    (hU0 : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) / u0 ≤ epsU)
    (hL0 : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) / (-l0) ≤ epsL)
    (hcap0 : deltaL * epsL < 1)
    (hpot0 : 1 / deltaU + epsU ≤ 1 / deltaL - epsL) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧
      (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      (let A := ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)
       let u := u0 + (k : ℝ) * deltaU
       let l := l0 + (k : ℝ) * deltaL
       (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).PosDef ∧
       ((u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A)⁻¹).trace ≤ epsU ∧
       (A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef ∧
       ((A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace ≤ epsL)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        simp
      · have hsup : Function.support (fun _ : I => (0 : ℝ)) = ∅ := by
          ext i
          simp
        rw [hsup]
        simp
      · have hUpos0 : (u0 • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef := by
          simpa using (Matrix.PosDef.smul Matrix.PosDef.one hu0)
        have hUtr0 : ((u0 • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace ≤ epsU := by
          rw [trace_inv_smul_one u0 hu0.ne.symm]
          exact hU0
        have hLpos0 : (-(l0 • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))).PosDef := by
          rw [← neg_smul]
          exact (Matrix.PosDef.smul Matrix.PosDef.one (neg_pos.mpr hl0))
        have hLtr0 : ((-(l0 • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)))⁻¹).trace ≤ epsL := by
          have htr : ((-l0 • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace =
              (Fintype.card n : ℝ) / (-l0) :=
            trace_inv_smul_one (-l0) (neg_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hl0))
          rw [← neg_smul]
          rwa [htr]
        dsimp
        constructor
        · simpa using hUpos0
        · constructor
          · simpa using hUtr0
          · constructor
            · simpa using hLpos0
            · simpa using hLtr0
  | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨s, hs_nonneg, hs_card, hs_barriers⟩ := ih
      let A : Matrix n n ℝ := ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)
      let u : ℝ := u0 + (k : ℝ) * deltaU
      let l : ℝ := l0 + (k : ℝ) * deltaL
      have hUpos : (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).PosDef := by
        simpa [A, u] using hs_barriers.1
      have hUtr : ((u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A)⁻¹).trace ≤ epsU := by
        simpa [A, u] using hs_barriers.2.1
      have hLpos : (A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef := by
        simpa [A, l] using hs_barriers.2.2.1
      have hLtr : ((A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace ≤ epsL := by
        simpa [A, l] using hs_barriers.2.2.2
      let MU : Matrix n n ℝ := u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A
      let ML : Matrix n n ℝ := A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
      have hMU : MU.PosDef := by simpa [MU] using hUpos
      have hML : ML.PosDef := by simpa [ML] using hLpos
      have hcap : deltaL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1 := by
        have hle : deltaL * ML⁻¹.trace ≤ deltaL * epsL := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa [ML] using hLtr) hδL.le
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hcap0
      have hUtrMU : MU⁻¹.trace ≤ epsU := by simpa [MU] using hUtr
      have hLtrML : ML⁻¹.trace ≤ epsL := by simpa [ML] using hLtr
      have hpot : 1 / deltaU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / deltaL - ML⁻¹.trace := by
        calc
          1 / deltaU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / deltaU + epsU := by
            simpa [add_comm] using (add_le_add_left hUtrMU (1 / deltaU))
          _ ≤ 1 / deltaL - epsL := hpot0
          _ ≤ 1 / deltaL - ML⁻¹.trace := by
            exact sub_le_sub_left hLtrML (1 / deltaL)
      obtain ⟨i, hvi, t, ht, hUpos1, hUtr1, hLpos1, hLtr1⟩ :=
        exists_updates_of_frame (I := I) (n := n) v hframe MU hMU ML hML
          deltaU deltaL hδU hδL hcap hpot
      let s' : I → ℝ := fun j => s j + if j = i then t else 0
      let A' : Matrix n n ℝ := ∑ j, s' j • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j)
      let u' : ℝ := u0 + (k + 1 : ℕ) * deltaU
      let l' : ℝ := l0 + (k + 1 : ℕ) * deltaL
      have hs'_nonneg : ∀ j, 0 ≤ s' j := by
        intro j
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          dsimp [s']
          simp [add_nonneg (hs_nonneg i) ht.le]
        · dsimp [s']
          rw [if_neg hji]
          simpa using hs_nonneg j
      have hsupport : Function.support s' ⊆ insert i (Function.support s) := by
        intro j hj
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · left
          exact hji
        · right
          have hs0 : s' j = s j := by
            dsimp [s']
            rw [if_neg hji, add_zero]
          change s' j ≠ 0 at hj
          rw [hs0] at hj
          exact hj
      have hcard : (Function.support s').ncard ≤ k + 1 := by
        calc
          (Function.support s').ncard ≤ (insert i (Function.support s)).ncard := by
            exact Set.ncard_mono hsupport
          _ ≤ (Function.support s).ncard + 1 := by
            exact Set.ncard_insert_le i (Function.support s)
          _ ≤ k + 1 := by
            exact Nat.add_le_add_right hs_card 1
      have hstep : ∑ j, (if j = i then t else 0) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j) =
          t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
        classical
        calc
          ∑ j, (if j = i then t else 0) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j)
              = ∑ j, (if j = i then t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j) else 0) := by
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
                intro j hj
                by_cases hji : j = i
                · simp [hji]
                · simp [hji]
          _ = t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.univ : Finset I) i
                  (fun j => t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j))]
                simp
      have hA' : A' = A + t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
        dsimp [A', s']
        calc
          ∑ j, (s j + (if j = i then t else 0)) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j)
              = ∑ j, (s j • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j) +
                  (if j = i then t else 0) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j)) := by
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
                intro j hj
                rw [add_smul]
          _ = ∑ j, s j • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j) +
              ∑ j, (if j = i then t else 0) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v j) (v j) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          _ = A + t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
                rw [hstep]
      have hu' : u' = u + deltaU := by
        dsimp [u', u]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hl' : l' = l + deltaL := by
        dsimp [l', l]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hUnew : u' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A' =
          MU + deltaU • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
        rw [hA', hu', add_smul]
        dsimp [MU]
        abel
      have hLnew : A' - l' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) =
          ML - deltaL • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
        rw [hA', hl', add_smul]
        dsimp [ML]
        abel
      have hUpos' : (u' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A').PosDef := by
        rw [hUnew]
        exact hUpos1
      have hUtr' : ((u' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A')⁻¹).trace ≤ epsU := by
        rw [hUnew]
        exact le_trans hUtr1 hUtr
      have hLpos' : (A' - l' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef := by
        rw [hLnew]
        exact hLpos1
      have hLtr' : ((A' - l' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace ≤ epsL := by
        rw [hLnew]
        exact le_trans hLtr1 hLtr
      refine ⟨s', hs'_nonneg, hcard, ?_⟩
      change (u' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A').PosDef ∧
        ((u' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A')⁻¹).trace ≤ epsU ∧
        (A' - l' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef ∧
        ((A' - l' • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace ≤ epsL
      exact ⟨hUpos', hUtr', hLpos', hLtr'⟩

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_sq_budget
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_sq_budget [Nonempty n]
    (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (a : ℝ) (ha1 : 1 < a) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : (q : ℝ) = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * a ^ 2) :
    ∃ sFinal : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ sFinal i) ∧
      (Function.support sFinal).ncard ≤ q ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤
        ∑ i, sFinal i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, sFinal i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤
        ((a + 1) ^ 2 / (a - 1) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card n
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    dsimp [N]
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ‹Nonempty n›)
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_trans (by norm_num) ha1
  have ha_sub_pos : 0 < a - 1 := sub_pos.mpr ha1
  have ha_add_pos : 0 < a + 1 := by linarith
  have ha_ne0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha_pos
  let deltaL : ℝ := 1
  let epsL : ℝ := 1 / a
  let l0 : ℝ := -(N * a)
  let deltaU : ℝ := (a + 1) / (a - 1)
  let epsU : ℝ := (a - 1) / (a * (a + 1))
  let u0 : ℝ := N * a * (a + 1) / (a - 1)
  have hu0 : 0 < u0 := by
    dsimp [u0]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hNpos ha_pos) ha_add_pos) ha_sub_pos
  have hl0 : l0 < 0 := by
    dsimp [l0]
    rw [neg_lt_zero]
    exact mul_pos hNpos ha_pos
  have hδL : 0 < deltaL := by
    dsimp [deltaL]
    norm_num
  have hδU : 0 < deltaU := by
    dsimp [deltaU]
    exact div_pos ha_add_pos ha_sub_pos
  have hU0e : N / u0 = epsU := by
    dsimp [u0, epsU]
    field_simp [hNpos.ne', ha_ne0, ha_add_pos.ne', ha_sub_pos.ne']
  have hL0e : N / (-l0) = epsL := by
    dsimp [l0, epsL]
    field_simp [hNpos.ne', ha_ne0]
  have hcap0 : deltaL * epsL < 1 := by
    dsimp [deltaL, epsL]
    rw [one_mul]
    exact (div_lt_one ha_pos).mpr ha1
  have hpot0e : 1 / deltaU + epsU = 1 / deltaL - epsL := by
    dsimp [deltaU, epsU, deltaL, epsL]
    field_simp [ha_ne0, ha_add_pos.ne', ha_sub_pos.ne']
  obtain ⟨s, hs_nonneg, hs_card, hs_barriers⟩ :=
    exists_weights_barriers_of_potential_bounds (I := I) (n := n) v hframe
      u0 l0 deltaU deltaL epsU epsL hu0 hl0 hδU hδL
      (le_of_eq hU0e) (le_of_eq hL0e) hcap0 (le_of_eq hpot0e) q
  let A : Matrix n n ℝ := ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)
  let u : ℝ := u0 + (q : ℝ) * deltaU
  let l : ℝ := l0 + (q : ℝ) * deltaL
  have hu_pos : (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).PosDef := by
    simpa [A, u] using hs_barriers.1
  have hl_pos : (A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef := by
    simpa [A, l] using hs_barriers.2.2.1
  have hlq : l = N * a * (a - 1) := by
    dsimp [l, l0, deltaL, N]
    rw [hq]
    ring
  have huq : u = N * a * (a + 1) ^ 2 / (a - 1) := by
    dsimp [u, u0, deltaU, N]
    rw [hq]
    field_simp [ha_sub_pos.ne', ha_add_pos.ne', ha_ne0, hNpos.ne']
    ring_nf
  have hlq_pos : 0 < l := by
    rw [hlq]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hNpos ha_pos) ha_sub_pos
  have hl_psd : (A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef := hl_pos.posSemidef
  have hu_psd : (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).PosSemidef := hu_pos.posSemidef
  have hsc_l : (1 / l) • (A - l • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) =
      (1 / l) • A - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    rw [smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hlq_pos), one_smul]
  have hl_scaled : ((1 / l) • A - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← hsc_l]
    exact Matrix.PosSemidef.smul hl_psd (le_of_lt (div_pos zero_lt_one hlq_pos))
  have hLower : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ (1 / l) • A := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    simpa using hl_scaled
  have hsc_u : (1 / l) • (u • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A) =
      (u / l) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - (1 / l) • A := by
    rw [smul_sub]
    congr 1
    rw [smul_smul]
    ring
  have hu_scaled : ((u / l) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - (1 / l) • A).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← hsc_u]
    exact Matrix.PosSemidef.smul hu_psd (le_of_lt (div_pos zero_lt_one hlq_pos))
  have hratio : u / l = (a + 1) ^ 2 / (a - 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [huq, hlq]
    field_simp [ha_sub_pos.ne', ha_add_pos.ne', ha_ne0, hNpos.ne']
  have hUpper : (1 / l) • A ≤
      ((a + 1) ^ 2 / (a - 1) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    simpa [hratio] using hu_scaled
  let sFinal : I → ℝ := fun i => (1 / l) * s i
  have hsFinal_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ sFinal i := by
    intro i
    dsimp [sFinal]
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (div_pos zero_lt_one hlq_pos)) (hs_nonneg i)
  have hsupp : Function.support sFinal ⊆ Function.support s := by
    intro i hi
    change (1 / l) * s i ≠ 0 at hi
    exact fun hzero => hi (by rw [hzero, mul_zero])
  have hcardFinal : (Function.support sFinal).ncard ≤ q := by
    exact le_trans (Set.ncard_mono hsupp) hs_card
  have hASum : ∑ i, sFinal i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) =
      (1 / l) • A := by
    dsimp [sFinal, A]
    simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  have hLowerFinal : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤
      ∑ i, sFinal i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
    rw [hASum]
    exact hLower
  have hUpperFinal : ∑ i, sFinal i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤
      ((a + 1) ^ 2 / (a - 1) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    rw [hASum]
    exact hUpper
  exact ⟨sFinal, hsFinal_nonneg, hcardFinal, hLowerFinal, hUpperFinal⟩

name: NLAlib.sSup_support_eq_neg_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_map_neg
statement:
theorem sSup_support_eq_neg_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_map_neg
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass=1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    sSup (μ : Measure ℝ).support =
      -sSup ((fun S : M => lambdaMin (matrixKTransform
        (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α S)) ''
          matrixKStableDomain (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α)
proof:
:= by
  let η : Measure (selfAdjoint M) := ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)
  let ρ : FiniteMeasure ℝ := μ.map (fun t : ℝ => -t)
  have hηs : η.support=(fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T) '' ν.support :=
    Measure.support_map_homeomorph ν (Homeomorph.neg (selfAdjoint M))
  have hρs : (ρ : Measure ℝ).support=(fun t : ℝ => -t) '' (μ : Measure ℝ).support :=
    Measure.support_map_homeomorph (μ : Measure ℝ) (Homeomorph.neg ℝ)
  have hηc : IsCompact η.support := by rw [hηs]; exact hν.image continuous_neg
  have hρc : IsCompact (ρ : Measure ℝ).support := by rw [hρs]; exact hcompact.image continuous_neg
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure η := ν.isProbabilityMeasure_map continuous_neg.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hρmass : ρ.mass=1 := by
    apply ENNReal.coe_injective
    rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,FiniteMeasure.toMeasure_map,
      Measure.map_apply continuous_neg.measurable MeasurableSet.univ,preimage_univ,
      ← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hmass]
  obtain ⟨H,hHa,hH,_hreflect,hrep⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_reflected_stieltjes_branch ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ
  have hlower := sInf_support_eq_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform
    η hηc α hα H hHa hH ρ hρmass hρc hrep
  have hedge : sInf (ρ : Measure ℝ).support= -sSup (μ : Measure ℝ).support := by
    rw [hρs,Set.image_neg_eq_neg,Real.sInf_neg]
  rw [hedge] at hlower
  exact (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg).mp hlower

name: NLAlib.exists_matrixKTransform_law_variational_support_edges
statement:
theorem exists_matrixKTransform_law_variational_support_edges
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) ∧
      ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass=1 ∧ IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
          ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) ∧
        (sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support =
          sSup ((fun S : M => lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S)) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α)) ∧
        (0<sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support ↔
          ∃ S B : M, S.PosDef ∧ B.PosDef ∧
            (∀ T∈ν.support,(S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) ∧
            (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransform ν α S).PosDef) ∧
        sSup (μ : Measure ℝ).support =
          -sSup ((fun S : M => lambdaMin (matrixKTransform
            (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α S)) ''
              matrixKStableDomain (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F,hFa,hF,μ,hμ,_huniq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_compact_stieltjes_probability_measure ν hν α hα
  exact ⟨F,hFa,hF,μ,hμ.1,hμ.2.1,hμ.2.2,
    sInf_support_eq_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ.1 hμ.2.1 hμ.2.2,
    sInf_support_pos_iff_exists_matrixKTransform_posDef_witness ν hν α hα F hFa hF
      μ hμ.1 hμ.2.1 hμ.2.2,
    sSup_support_eq_neg_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_map_neg ν hν α hα F hF
      μ hμ.1 hμ.2.1 hμ.2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar
statement:
private theorem upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar (z : ℂ) :
    (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)=z.im•1
proof:
:= by
  have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
  simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one]

name: NLAlib.upperExistence_norm_scalar
statement: private theorem upperExistence_norm_scalar (z : ℂ) : specNorm (z•(1 : M))≤‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  have hI : ‖(1 : M)‖≤1 := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using specNorm_one_le (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,norm_smul,mul_one] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (norm_nonneg z)

name: NLAlib.upperExistence_eventually_posDef
statement:
private theorem upperExistence_eventually_posDef
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : Y → M} {x : Y}
    (hf : ContinuousAt f x) (hfx : (f x).PosDef)
    (hH : ∀ y, (f y).IsHermitian) : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (f y).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδf⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ•(1 : M)≤f x := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff hfx.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
        (fun r hr => hfx.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hr)
  have hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ‖f y-f x‖<δ :=
    ((hf.sub_const (f x)).norm).eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simpa using hδ)
  filter_upwards [hs] with y hy
  have hneg : (-‖f y-f x‖)•(1 : M)≤f y-f x := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,neg_smul] using
      ((hH y).sub hfx.isHermitian).isSelfAdjoint.neg_algebraMap_norm_le_self
  have hle : (δ-‖f y-f x‖)•(1 : M)≤f y := by
    convert! add_le_add hδf hneg using 1 <;> module
  exact ((Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (sub_pos.mpr hy)).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef

name: NLAlib.upperExistence_solvable_isOpen
statement:
private theorem upperExistence_solvable_isOpen
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) : IsOpen (upperKSolvableSet ν α)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  rintro z ⟨S,hS,hK⟩
  have hKpos : (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S) : M).PosDef := by
    rw [hK,upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul z.property
  obtain ⟨G,hGa,hG0,hGeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_of_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα S hS hKpos z.val hK
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hGpos : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z.val, (imaginaryPart (G w) : M).PosDef :=
    upperExistence_eventually_posDef (L.continuous.continuousAt.comp hGa.continuousAt)
      (by rwa [hG0])
      (fun w => (imaginaryPart (G w)).property)
  have hcoe : Tendsto (fun w : H => w.val) (𝓝 z) (𝓝 z.val) := continuous_subtype_val.tendsto z
  filter_upwards [hcoe.eventually hGpos,hcoe.eventually hGeq] with w hwpos hweq
  exact ⟨G w.val,hwpos,hweq.2⟩

name: NLAlib.upperExistence_solvable_isClosed
statement:
private theorem upperExistence_solvable_isClosed
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (R : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R) :
    IsClosed (upperKSolvableSet ν α)
proof:
:= by
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro u z hu huz
  have hSol (j : ℕ) : ∃ S : M, (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α S=(u j).val•1 := hu j
  choose S hS hKS using hSol
  let Xseq : ℕ → M := fun j => -(S j)⁻¹
  let η : ℝ := α*z.val.im/2
  have hη : 0<η := div_pos (mul_pos hα z.property) (by norm_num)
  have hzseq : Tendsto (fun j => (u j).val) atTop (𝓝 z.val) :=
    (continuous_subtype_val.tendsto z).comp huz
  have hlimIm : Tendsto (fun j => α*(u j).val.im) atTop (𝓝 (α*z.val.im)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto z.val |>.comp hzseq)
  have hηlt : η<α*z.val.im := by
    dsimp only [η]
    linarith [mul_pos hα z.property]
  have hηevent : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, η≤α*(u j).val.im :=
    (hlimIm.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hηlt)).mono fun _ h => h.le
  have hnormevent : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ‖(u j).val‖≤‖z.val‖+1 :=
    (hzseq.norm.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by linarith : ‖z.val‖<‖z.val‖+1))).mono fun _ h => h.le
  have htarget (j : ℕ) (hj : η≤α*(u j).val.im) :
      η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart ((u j).val•(1 : M)) : M) := by
    rw [upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar,smul_smul]
    exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right hj (show (0 : M)≤1 from zero_le_one)
  have hcoercive : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart (Xseq j) : M) := by
    filter_upwards [hηevent] with j hj
    exact (htarget j hj).trans
      (matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα ((u j).val•1) (S j) (hS j) (hKS j)).2
  let C : ℝ := α*(‖z.val‖+1+R+R^2*η⁻¹)
  have hbounded : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ‖Xseq j‖≤C := by
    filter_upwards [hηevent,hnormevent] with j hjη hjn
    have hb := specNorm_inverse_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le ν hν α hα
      ((u j).val•1) (S j) (hS j) (hKS j) η R hη hbound (htarget j hjη)
    change ‖-(S j)⁻¹‖≤C
    rw [norm_neg]
    calc
      _ = specNorm (S j)⁻¹ := (specNorm_eq_norm _).symm
      _ ≤ α*(specNorm ((u j).val•(1 : M))+R+R^2*η⁻¹) := hb
      _ ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; gcongr; exact (upperExistence_norm_scalar _).trans hjn
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ j in atTop, Xseq j∈closedBall (0 : M) C :=
    (hbounded.mono fun j hj => by simpa only [mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using hj).frequently
  obtain ⟨X,_hXC,φ,hφ,hXlim⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : M) C).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in hfreq
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hclosed : IsClosed {Y : M | η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart Y : M)} :=
    isClosed_Ici.preimage L.continuous
  have hXcoercive : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M) :=
    hclosed.mem_of_tendsto hXlim (hφ.tendsto_atTop.eventually hcoercive)
  have hXpos : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef :=
    ((Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hη).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hXcoercive).posDef
  have hSXpos := posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse X hXpos
  have hSinvlim : Tendsto (fun j => -((Xseq ∘ φ) j)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 (-X⁻¹)) :=
    ((hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse X (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hXpos)).continuousAt.neg.tendsto).comp hXlim
  have hKlim := ((hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α
    (mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν hSXpos)).continuousAt.tendsto).comp hSinvlim
  have hKXseq (j : ℕ) : matrixKTransform ν α (-(Xseq j)⁻¹)=(u j).val•1 := by
    have hXjpos : (imaginaryPart (Xseq j) : M).PosDef := posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse (S j) (hS j)
    exact (matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq_iff_fixedPoint ν hν α hα.ne' ((u j).val•1)
      (Xseq j) hXjpos).mpr
        (matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα ((u j).val•1) (S j) (hS j) (hKS j)).1
  have hKlim' : Tendsto (fun j => (u (φ j)).val•(1 : M)) atTop
      (𝓝 (matrixKTransform ν α (-X⁻¹))) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,hKXseq] using hKlim
  have hZlim : Tendsto (fun j => (u (φ j)).val•(1 : M)) atTop (𝓝 (z.val•(1 : M))) :=
    (hzseq.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop).smul_const 1
  exact ⟨-X⁻¹,hSXpos,tendsto_nhds_unique hKlim' hZlim⟩

name: NLAlib.upperExistence_solvable_nonempty
statement:
private theorem upperExistence_solvable_nonempty
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (R : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R) :
    (upperKSolvableSet ν α).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let η : ℝ := α*R^2+1
  have hη : 0<η := by dsimp only [η]; positivity
  have hsmall : α*R^2*(η⁻¹)^2<1 := by
    have hs : α*R^2<η^2 := by dsimp only [η]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α*R^2)]
    calc
      _ = (α*R^2)/(η^2) := by rw [inv_pow,div_eq_mul_inv]
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos hη)).mpr hs
  let z : ℂ := ((η/α : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I
  have hz : 0<z.im := by simp only [z,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_im,
    Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,add_zero]; exact div_pos hη hα
  have htarget : η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M) := by
    rw [upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar,smul_smul]
    have he : α*z.im=η := by
      simp only [z,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,add_zero]
      field_simp [hα.ne']
    rw [he]
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hKS,_⟩ := exists_matrixKTransform_solution_of_imaginary_coercive_contraction
    ν hν α hα (z•1) η R hη hbound htarget hsmall
  exact ⟨⟨z,hz⟩,S,hS,hKS⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem exists_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) :
    ∃ S : M, (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef ∧ matrixKTransform ν α S=z•1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  have hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R := by
    intro T hT
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using hR T hT
  let : PreconnectedSpace H := Subtype.preconnectedSpace (convex_halfSpace_im_gt 0).isPreconnected
  have he : upperKSolvableSet ν α=univ :=
    (show IsClopen (upperKSolvableSet ν α) from
      ⟨upperExistence_solvable_isClosed ν hν α hα R hbound,
        upperExistence_solvable_isOpen ν hν α hα⟩).eq_univ
          (upperExistence_solvable_nonempty ν hν α hα R hbound)
  have hm : (⟨z,hz⟩ : H)∈upperKSolvableSet ν α := by rw [he]; trivial
  exact hm

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem existsUnique_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) :
    ∃! S : M, (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef ∧ matrixKTransform ν α S=z•1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hK⟩ := exists_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα z hz
  refine ⟨S,⟨hS,hK⟩,?_⟩
  rintro Q ⟨hQ,hKQ⟩
  have hZ : (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M).PosDef := by
    rw [upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hz
  exact matrixKTransform_solution_unique_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα (z•1) Q S hZ hQ hS hKQ hK

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_upperHalfPlane_solution
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_upperHalfPlane_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1 ∧ specNorm (F z)≤(α*z.im)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℂ → M := fun z => if hz : 0<z.im then
    Classical.choose (exists_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα z hz) else 0
  have hF (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) :
      (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧ matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1 := by
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [dif_pos hz]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_matrixKTransform_solution_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα z hz)
  have hHopen : IsOpen {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
  have hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} := by
    intro z hz
    have hZpos : (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M).PosDef := by
      rw [upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar]
      exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hz
    have hKpos : (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α (F z)) : M).PosDef := by
      rw [(hF z hz).2]
      exact hZpos
    obtain ⟨G,hGa,hG0,hGeq⟩ :=
      exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_of_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα
        (F z) (hF z hz).1 hKpos z (hF z hz).2
    let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
      (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
    have hGpos : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, (imaginaryPart (G w) : M).PosDef :=
      upperExistence_eventually_posDef (L.continuous.continuousAt.comp hGa.continuousAt)
        (by rw [hG0]; exact (hF z hz).1) (fun w => (imaginaryPart (G w)).property)
    apply hGa.congr
    filter_upwards [hGpos,hGeq,hHopen.mem_nhds hz] with w hwpos hweq hwH
    have hW : (imaginaryPart (w•(1 : M)) : M).PosDef := by
      rw [upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar]
      exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hwH
    exact matrixKTransform_solution_unique_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα (w•1) (G w) (F w)
      hW hwpos (hF w hwH).1 hweq.2 (hF w hwH).2
  refine ⟨F,hFa,fun z hz => ⟨(hF z hz).1,(hF z hz).2,?_⟩⟩
  have hη : 0<α*z.im := mul_pos hα hz
  have hZ : (α*z.im)•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M) := by
    rw [upperExistence_imaginaryPart_scalar,smul_smul]
  exact specNorm_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le_inv ν hν α hα (z•1) (F z)
    (hF z hz).1 (hF z hz).2 (α*z.im) hη hZ

name: NLAlib.abs_log_add_le
statement:
private theorem abs_log_add_le {x C δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hC : x ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    |Real.log (x + δ)| ≤ |Real.log δ| + |Real.log (C + δ)|
proof:
:= by
  have hlo : Real.log δ ≤ Real.log (x + δ) :=
    Real.log_le_log hδ (by linarith)
  have hhi : Real.log (x + δ) ≤ Real.log (C + δ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor
  · linarith [neg_abs_le (Real.log δ), abs_nonneg (Real.log (C + δ))]
  · linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log (C + δ)), abs_nonneg (Real.log δ)]

name: NLAlib.continuous_log_schatten_ordered_add
statement:
private theorem continuous_log_schatten_ordered_add
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p δ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Real.log
      (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.log
  · exact ((continuous_schattenNormReal hp).comp
      (continuous_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right L hL)).add continuous_const
  · intro t
    exact ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) hδ)

name: NLAlib.integrable_hirschman_log_schatten_ordered_add
statement:
private theorem integrable_hirschman_log_schatten_ordered_add
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r δ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.hirschmanDensity r t * Real.log
      (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded hr
    (continuous_log_schatten_ordered_add L hL hp hδ).measurable
  intro t
  exact abs_log_add_le (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
    (schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le L hL hp t) hδ

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_rpow_le_exp_hirschman_of_posDef
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_rpow_le_exp_hirschman_of_posDef
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosDef)
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ)) (p / r) ^ (1 / r) ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t * Real.log
        (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
proof:
:= by
  have h := schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman
    (L.map matrixLog) (isHermitian_mem_map_matrixLog L) hp hr
  simp_rw [← orderedMatrixComplexPower_eq_orderedMatrixExp_log L hL] at h
  have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) h (one_div_nonneg.mpr hr.1.le)
  rw [← Real.exp_mul] at hpow
  have heq (x : ℝ) : (r * x) * (1 / r) = x := by field_simp [hr.1.ne']
  rw [heq] at hpow
  exact hpow

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_rpow_le_exp_log_add_of_posDef
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_rpow_le_exp_log_add_of_posDef
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosDef)
    {p r δ : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ)) (p / r) ^ (1 / r) ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t * Real.log
        (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ))
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  by_cases hn : Nonempty n
  · let := hn
    apply (schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_rpow_le_exp_hirschman_of_posDef
      L hL hp hr).trans
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hH := isHermitian_mem_map_matrixLog L
    have hint := Real.integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded hr
      (continuous_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right _ hH hp0).measurable
      (abs_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le _ hH hp0)
    simp_rw [← orderedMatrixComplexPower_eq_orderedMatrixExp_log L hL] at hint
    apply integral_mono hint
      (integrable_hirschman_log_schatten_ordered_add L (fun A hA => (hL A hA).posSemidef)
        hp0 hr hδ)
    intro t
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le
    have hpos : 0 < schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p := by
      rw [orderedMatrixComplexPower_eq_orderedMatrixExp_log L hL]
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le
        (exp_neg_sum_norm_le_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right _ hH hp0 t)
    exact Real.log_le_log hpos (by linarith)
  · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    have hz : orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, schattenNormReal_zero (div_pos hp0 hr.1), Real.zero_rpow (one_div_ne_zero hr.1.ne')]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.tendsto_integral_hirschman_log_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_hirschman_log_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r δ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : ∀ k, ε k ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => ∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t * Real.log
      (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower (regularizeMatrixList L (ε k))
        (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t * Real.log
        (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ)))
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * (L.map (fun A => ‖A‖ + 1)).prod
  let D : ℝ := |Real.log δ| + |Real.log (C + δ)|
  apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun t => D * Real.hirschmanDensity r t)
  · intro k
    have hm := (continuous_log_schatten_ordered_add (regularizeMatrixList L (ε k))
      (posSemidef_mem_regularizeMatrixList L hL (hε k).1) hp hδ).measurable
    exact ((Real.continuous_hirschmanDensity hr).measurable.mul hm).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact (Real.integrable_hirschmanDensity hr).const_mul D
  · intro k
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.hirschmanDensity_pos hr t),
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (abs_log_add_le (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
          (schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le L hL hp (hε k) t)
          hδ) (Real.hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      have hm := (continuousAt_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize L
        (fun A hA => (hL A hA).isHermitian) (z := 1 + (t : ℂ) * I)
        (by simp)).tendsto.comp hεlim
      simp only [Function.comp_def, regularizeMatrixList_zero] at hm
      have hn := ((continuous_schattenNormReal hp).tendsto _).comp hm
      have hl := (Real.continuousAt_log
        (ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) hδ))).tendsto.comp
          (hn.add_const δ)
      exact hl.const_mul _

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_exp_log_add
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_exp_log_add
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r δ : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ))) (1 / r)) p ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t * Real.log
        (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ))
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hεpos (k : ℕ) : 0 < ε k := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  have hε (k : ℕ) : ε k ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · exact (hεpos k).le
    · dsimp [ε]
      exact (div_le_one (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)).mpr
        (by linarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg k])
  have hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hc := continuousAt_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize L
    (fun A hA => (hL A hA).isHermitian) (z := (r : ℂ)) (by simpa using hr.1)
  have hf := ((continuous_schattenNormReal (div_pos hp0 hr.1)).continuousAt.comp hc).rpow_const
    (Or.inr (one_div_nonneg.mpr hr.1.le))
  have hfl := hf.tendsto.comp hεlim
  simp only [Function.comp_def, regularizeMatrixList_zero] at hfl
  have hgl := Real.continuous_exp.tendsto _ |>.comp
    (tendsto_integral_hirschman_log_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize L hL hp0 hr hδ hε hεlim)
  rw [schattenNormReal_rpow_abs _ hp0 hr.1]
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hfl hgl
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun k =>
    schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_rpow_le_exp_log_add_of_posDef
      (regularizeMatrixList L (ε k)) (posDef_mem_regularizeMatrixList L hL (hεpos k)) hp hr hδ

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_exp_log_add_measure
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_exp_log_add_measure
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r δ : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ))) (1 / r)) p ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, Real.log
        (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p + δ)
          ∂Real.hirschmanMeasure r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.integral_hirschmanMeasure hr]
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
    schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_exp_log_add L hL hp hr hδ

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_geometricMean
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_geometricMean
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal
      (schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ))) (1 / r)) p) ≤
        geometricMean (Real.hirschmanMeasure r)
          (fun t : ℝ => schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (Real.hirschmanMeasure r) :=
    Real.isProbabilityMeasure_hirschmanMeasure hr
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p
  let C : ℝ := (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * (L.map (fun A => ‖A‖ + 1)).prod
  have hg : Measurable g := ((continuous_schattenNormReal hp0).comp
    (continuous_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right L hL)).measurable
  have hb (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ g t ∧ g t ≤ C :=
    ⟨schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _, schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le L hL hp0 t⟩
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (hb 0).1.trans (hb 0).2
  change _ ≤ geometricMean (Real.hirschmanMeasure r) g
  apply le_geometricMean_of_le_exp_integral_log_add hg hC hb
  intro δ hδ
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_exp_log_add_measure L hL hp hr hδ)

name: NLAlib.log_schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_extendedLogIntegral
statement:
theorem log_schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_extendedLogIntegral
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal
      (schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (r : ℂ))) (1 / r)) p)) ≤
        extendedLogIntegral (Real.hirschmanMeasure r)
          (fun t : ℝ => schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.log_le_log
    (schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_geometricMean L hL hp hr)
  simpa only [geometricMean, EReal.log_exp] using h

name: NLAlib.log_schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_prod_rpow_le_extendedLogIntegral
statement:
theorem log_schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_prod_rpow_le_extendedLogIntegral
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal
      (schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs ((L.map (fun A => CFC.rpow A r)).prod)) (1 / r)) p)) ≤
        extendedLogIntegral (Real.hirschmanMeasure r)
          (fun t : ℝ => schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)

    log_schattenNormReal_abs_rpow_orderedMatrixComplexPower_le_extendedLogIntegral L hL hp hr

name: NLAlib.circlePoint_mul_star
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1 - s ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by
      have hs' := abs_le.mp hs
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs'.2) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + s)])
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im] <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_average_of_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_average_of_specNorm_le_one {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hA : specNorm A ≤ 1) :
    ∃ U V : unitary (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      A = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) + V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, R, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let s (i : Fin n) : ℝ := singularValues A i
  let z (i : Fin n) : ℂ := (s i : ℂ) + Complex.I * Real.sqrt (1 - s i ^ 2)
  have hz (i : Fin n) : z i * star (z i) = 1 := circlePoint_mul_star (s i) (by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i)]
    exact (singularValues_le_specNorm A i).trans hA)
  have hd : diagonal z ∈ unitary (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) := by
    constructor <;> ext i j <;> by_cases hij : i = j
    all_goals first
    | subst j
      simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.one_apply, mul_comm] using hz i
    | simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hij]
  let Lu : unitary (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :=
    ⟨L, ⟨h.conjTranspose_mul_left, h.mul_conjTranspose_left⟩⟩
  let Ru : unitary (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :=
    ⟨R, ⟨h.conjTranspose_mul_right, h.mul_conjTranspose_right⟩⟩
  let Du : unitary (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) := ⟨diagonal z, hd⟩
  let U := Lu * Du * star Ru
  let V := Lu * star Du * star Ru
  refine ⟨U, V, ?_⟩
  change A = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (L * diagonal z * R.conjTranspose +
    L * (diagonal z).conjTranspose * R.conjTranspose)
  rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add]
  have heq : (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (L * (diagonal z + (diagonal z).conjTranspose) * R.conjTranspose) =
      L * ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (diagonal z + (diagonal z).conjTranspose)) * R.conjTranspose := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [heq]
  rw [h.eq]
  congr 2
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, z]
    ring
  · simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hij, Fin.val_injective.ne hij]

name: NLAlib.exteriorImaginary_scalar_im
statement:
private theorem exteriorImaginary_scalar_im (z : ℂ) :
    (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)=z.im•1
proof:
:= by
  have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
  simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α R : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (hR : 0<R) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) (hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|z.re|) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart (α•F z) : M)‖≤
      (2*α^2*(((α+1)*R)⁻¹)^2)*z.im
proof:
:= by
  let X := -(F z)⁻¹
  let q := ((α+1)*R)⁻¹
  have hq : 0≤q := by dsimp only [q]; positivity
  have hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef :=
    posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse (F z) (hF z hz).1
  have hnorm := norm_inverseVariable_resolvents_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior
    ν hν α R hα hR F hFa hF hbound z hz hfar
  have hN := norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap_le ν hν α hα.le
    (z•1) X hX R q hR.le hq hbound hnorm.2
  have hfixed := (matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα
    (z•1) (F z) (hF z hz).1 (hF z hz).2).1
  rw [← hfixed] at hN
  have hscalar : ‖(imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)‖≤z.im := by
    rw [exteriorImaginary_scalar_im,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hz.le]
    simpa only [mul_one,specNorm_eq_norm] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_one_le (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)) hz.le
  have hRq : R*q=(α+1)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp only [q]
    field_simp [hR.ne',(by linarith : α+1≠0)]
  have hc : α*(R^2*q^2)≤1/2 := by
    rw [← mul_pow,hRq,inv_pow,← div_eq_mul_inv]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith : 0<α+1))).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg α]
  have hNB : ‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖≤α*z.im+(1/2)*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ α*‖(imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)‖+
          α*(R^2*q^2*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖) := hN
      _ ≤ α*z.im+(α*(R^2*q^2))*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖ := by
        rw [mul_assoc α]
        exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscalar hα.le) le_rfl
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (norm_nonneg _))
  have hB : ‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖≤2*α*z.im := by linarith
  have hunit := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (hF z hz).1
  have he : X*F z= -1 := by
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hunit)]
  have hIm := Matrix.imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one he
  have hstar : ‖(F z)ᴴ‖≤q := by
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,norm_star] using hnorm.1
  have hSF : ‖(imaginaryPart (F z) : M)‖≤q^2*(2*α*z.im) := by
    rw [hIm]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(F z)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)‖*‖F z‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖(F z)ᴴ‖*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖*‖F z‖ := by
        gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ q*(2*α*z.im)*q := by gcongr; exact hnorm.1
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hscale : (imaginaryPart (α•F z) : M)=α•(imaginaryPart (F z) : M) := by
    rw [map_smul]; rfl
  rw [hscale,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le]
  calc
    _ ≤ α*(q^2*(2*α*z.im)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSF hα.le
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_coordinateReflection
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_coordinateReflection (k : ι) :
    (coordinateReflection k)ᴴ = coordinateReflection k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateReflection, diagonal_conjTranspose]
  congr 1
  ext i
  by_cases h : i = k <;> simp [h]

name: NLAlib.coordinateReflection_mul_self
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_mul_self (k : ι) :
    coordinateReflection k * coordinateReflection k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateReflection, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = k <;> simp [diagonal, h, one_apply]

name: NLAlib.coordinateReflection_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_mul_diagonal_mul (k : ι) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    coordinateReflection k * diagonal a * coordinateReflection k = diagonal a
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateReflection, diagonal_mul_diagonal, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  ext i
  by_cases h : i = k <;> simp [h]

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinch_apply
statement:
theorem coordinatePinch_apply (k : ι) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i j : ι) :
    coordinatePinch k X i j = if i = j ∨ i ≠ k ∧ j ≠ k then X i j else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinatePinch, coordinateReflection, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Complex.real_smul]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    by_cases hik : i = k <;> simp [hik] <;> ring
  · by_cases hik : i = k <;> by_cases hjk : j = k <;>
      simp_all [eq_comm]
    ring

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePinched_empty (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    coordinatePinched ∅ X = X
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [coordinatePinched]

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_insert
statement:
theorem coordinatePinched_insert (s : Finset ι) (k : ι) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    coordinatePinched (insert k s) X = coordinatePinch k (coordinatePinched s X)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [coordinatePinch_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [coordinatePinched]
  · by_cases hik : i = k <;> by_cases hjk : j = k <;>
      by_cases his : i ∈ s <;> by_cases hjs : j ∈ s <;>
      simp_all [coordinatePinched, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePinched_univ (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    coordinatePinched Finset.univ X = diagonal (fun i => X i i)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [coordinatePinched, diagonal]
  · simp [coordinatePinched, diagonal, hij]

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePinched_apply_self (s : Finset ι) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i : ι) :
    coordinatePinched s X i i = X i i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinatePinched]

name: NLAlib.ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ * (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ)ᵀ = ridgeKernel A ρ
proof:
:= by
  let T := cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ)
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hTs : Tᵀ = T := hT.eq
  have hi : (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ = T * T :=
    inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ)
  change (A * T) * (A * T)ᵀ = A * (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ * Aᵀ
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hTs]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc T T Aᵀ, ← hi]

name: NLAlib.norm_ridgeWhitenedRows_row_sq
statement:
theorem norm_ridgeWhitenedRows_row_sq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (i : m) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m m ℝ => M i i) (ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_transpose A hρ)
  simpa only [dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.trace_transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul
statement:
theorem trace_transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ((ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ)ᵀ * ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ).trace = ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_transpose A hρ,
    ← ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_trace]

name: NLAlib.transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul
statement:
theorem transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ)ᵀ * ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ = ridgeKernel Aᵀ ρ
proof:
:= by
  let T := cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ)
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hTs : Tᵀ = T := hT.eq
  have hi : (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ = T * T :=
    inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ)
  have hn : T * ridgeGram A ρ * T = 1 :=
    cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ)
  have hg : Aᵀ * A = ridgeGram A ρ - ρ • 1 := by
    unfold ridgeGram
    abel
  rw [ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv Aᵀ hρ, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  change (A * T)ᵀ * (A * T) = 1 - ρ • (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hTs]
  calc
    T * Aᵀ * (A * T) = T * (Aᵀ * A) * T := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = T * (ridgeGram A ρ - ρ • 1) * T := by rw [hg]
    _ = 1 - ρ • (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hn, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one,
        Matrix.smul_mul, ← hi]

name: NLAlib.transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_le_one
statement:
theorem transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_le_one [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ)ᵀ * ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul A hρ]
  exact ridgeKernel_le_one Aᵀ hρ

name: NLAlib.ridgeGram_bounds_of_specNorm_whitened_sub_le
statement:
theorem ridgeGram_bounds_of_specNorm_whitened_sub_le {k : Type*} [Fintype k]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix k n ℝ) {ρ ε : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hbound : specNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ) *
      (Bᵀ * B - Aᵀ * A) * cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ)) ≤ ε) :
    (1 - ε) • ridgeGram A ρ ≤ ridgeGram B ρ ∧
      ridgeGram B ρ ≤ (1 + ε) • ridgeGram A ρ
proof:
:= by
  let H := ridgeGram A ρ
  let T := cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) H
  let S := cfc Real.sqrt H
  let D := Bᵀ * B - Aᵀ * A
  let E := T * D * T
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hS : S.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hD : D.IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B).sub (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
  have hE : E.IsHermitian := by
    change Eᴴ = E
    simp only [E, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hT.eq, hD.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hST : S * T = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ)
  have hTS : T * S = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ)
  have hSS : S * S = H := cfc_sqrt_mul_self (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ)
  have hSE : S * E * S = D := by
    calc
      _ = (S * T) * D * (T * S) := by dsimp only [E]; noncomm_ring
      _ = D := by rw [hST, hTS, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hcong (X Y : Matrix n n ℝ) (h : X ≤ Y) : S * X * S ≤ S * Y * S := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [hS.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul] using
      (Matrix.le_iff.mp h).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same S
  have hsand := (hE.specNorm_le_iff_sandwich hε).mp hbound
  have hlow : -(ε • H) ≤ D := by
    have h := hcong _ _ hsand.1
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.smul_mul, hSS, hSE] using h
  have hupp : D ≤ ε • H := by
    have h := hcong _ _ hsand.2
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hSS, hSE] using h
  have hB : ridgeGram B ρ = H + D := by
    dsimp only [H, D, ridgeGram]
    abel
  rw [hB, sub_smul, add_smul, one_smul]
  exact ⟨by simpa only [H, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using add_le_add_left hlow H,
    by simpa only [H, add_comm] using add_le_add_left hupp H⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_unitary_row
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_unitary_row (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (i : ι) :
    ∑ j, ‖(U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U) i) i
  have hs : ∀ j, (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j *
      star ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j) = ((‖(U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro j
    simpa only [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using! Complex.mul_conj ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j)
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.star_apply,
    hs, Matrix.one_apply_eq, Complex.re_sum, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.one_re] using congrArg Complex.re h

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_unitary_col
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_unitary_col (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (j : ι) :
    ∑ i, ‖(U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.star_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, norm_star]
    using sum_norm_sq_unitary_row (star U) j

name: NLAlib.re_trace_diagonal_mul_conj_diagonal
statement:
theorem re_trace_diagonal_mul_conj_diagonal
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    (diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)) *
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => (b j : ℂ)) *
        star (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖(U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 * a i * b j
proof:
:= by
  have hentry (i : ι) : (diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)) *
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => (b j : ℂ)) *
        star (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))) i i =
      (a i : ℂ) * ∑ j, (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j * (b j : ℂ) *
        star ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.star_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, hentry, Finset.mul_sum, Complex.re_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have hn : (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j * star ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j) =
      ((‖(U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using! Complex.mul_conj ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j)
  have he : (a i : ℂ) * ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j * (b j : ℂ) *
      star ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j)) =
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j * star ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j)) *
        (((a i * b j : ℝ)) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, hn, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
  ring

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap
statement:
theorem re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap
    (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (r s : ℕ) :
    (A ^ r * B ^ s).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        ‖((star hA.eigenvectorUnitary * hB.eigenvectorUnitary :
          Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 *
          hA.eigenvalues i ^ r * hB.eigenvalues j ^ s
proof:
:= by
  let UA := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  let UB := hB.eigenvectorUnitary
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ := star UA * UB
  have hAp : A ^ r = (UA : Matrix ι ι ℂ) *
      diagonal (fun i => ((hA.eigenvalues i ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (UA : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem]
    rw [← map_pow, Matrix.diagonal_pow]
    simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Complex.ofReal_pow]
    rfl
  have hBp : B ^ s = (UB : Matrix ι ι ℂ) *
      diagonal (fun j => ((hB.eigenvalues j ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (UB : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hB.spectral_theorem]
    rw [← map_pow, Matrix.diagonal_pow]
    simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Complex.ofReal_pow]
    rfl
  rw [hAp, hBp]
  have ht : (((UA : Matrix ι ι ℂ) *
      diagonal (fun i => ((hA.eigenvalues i ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (UA : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) *
      ((UB : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => ((hB.eigenvalues j ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        star (UB : Matrix ι ι ℂ))).trace =
      (diagonal (fun i => ((hA.eigenvalues i ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        ((W : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => ((hB.eigenvalues j ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          star (W : Matrix ι ι ℂ))).trace := by
    simp only [W, Submonoid.coe_mul, Unitary.coe_star, star_mul, star_star,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm (UA : Matrix ι ι ℂ)]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [ht, re_trace_diagonal_mul_conj_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even
statement:
theorem re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : Even r) : 0 ≤ (A ^ r).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow A hA]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hr.pow_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i)

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_posSemidef (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (A ^ r).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow A hA.isHermitian]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) r

name: NLAlib.nat_mul_mul_re_trace_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem nat_mul_mul_re_trace_mul_pow_le
    (V H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hV : V.PosSemidef) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (p : ℝ) * (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) * (V * H ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * (V ^ p).trace.re +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * (H ^ (2 * p)).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ := star hV.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary * hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  let w (i j : ι) := ‖(W : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2
  have hrow (i) : ∑ j, w i j = 1 := sum_norm_sq_unitary_row W i
  have hcol (j) : ∑ i, w i j = 1 := sum_norm_sq_unitary_col W j
  have hev (i) : 0 ≤ hV.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := hV.eigenvalues_nonneg i
  have hpow (j) : (hH.eigenvalues j ^ 2) ^ (p - 1) = hH.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p - 2) := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hpow' (j) : (hH.eigenvalues j ^ 2) ^ p = hH.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p) := by rw [← pow_mul]
  have hpoint (i j) :
      (p : ℝ) * (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) * hV.isHermitian.eigenvalues i *
        hH.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p - 2) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * hV.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ p +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * hH.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p) := by
    have h := nat_mul_mul_pow_le_pow_add
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * p - 1)) (hev i)) (sq_nonneg (hH.eigenvalues j)) hp
    simpa only [hpow, hpow', mul_pow, mul_assoc] using h
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint i j) (sq_nonneg ‖(W : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖)
  have hright :
      (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * ((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * hV.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ p +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * hH.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p))) =
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * (∑ i, hV.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ p) +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * (∑ j, hH.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p)) := by
    simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    · simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, one_mul]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hcol, one_mul]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [show V * H ^ (2 * p - 2) = V ^ 1 * H ^ (2 * p - 2) by rw [pow_one],
    re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap V H hV.isHermitian hH]
  rw [re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow V hV.isHermitian,
    re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow H hH]
  simpa only [w, W, pow_one, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, Finset.mul_sum, hright] using hsum

name: NLAlib.det_one_add_mul_eq_det_one_add_matrixKWhitened
statement:
theorem det_one_add_mul_eq_det_one_add_matrixKWhitened
    (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) :
    (1 + T * S).det = (1 + matrixKWhitened S T).det
proof:
:= by
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt S
  have hQQ : Q * Q = S := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hS
  calc
    (1 + T * S).det = (1 + (T * Q) * Q).det := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hQQ]
    _ = (1 + Q * (T * Q)).det := Matrix.det_one_add_mul_comm _ _
    _ = _ := by simp only [matrixKWhitened, Q, Matrix.mul_assoc]

statement:
