name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrixKLogDetKernel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrixKLogDetKernel
    {S : ℝ → Matrix n n ℂ} {Δ : Matrix n n ℂ} {t : ℝ}
    (hpath : HasDerivAt S Δ t) (T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : (S t).PosDef) (hgap : ((S t)⁻¹ + T).PosDef) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => matrixKLogDetKernel (S v) T)
      ((matrixKResolvent (S t) T * Δ).trace.re) t
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (hpath.const_mul T).const_add 1
  have h := hA.log_re_matrix_det (det_one_add_mul_pos_of_matrixK_admissible (S t) T hS hgap)
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := by
    have hg := hgap.isHermitian
    have hi := hS.inv.isHermitian
    convert hg.sub hi using 1
    abel
  have hr := matrixKResolvent_eq_right (S t) T hS hT hgap
  simpa only [matrixKLogDetKernel, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hr, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixKLogDetKernel
statement:
theorem integrable_matrixKLogDetKernel
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    Integrable (fun T => matrixKLogDetKernel S T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) =>
      matrixKLogDetKernel S T.val) ν.support := by
    apply (Complex.continuous_re.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)).matrix_det).continuousOn.log
    intro T hT
    exact (Complex.pos_iff.mp
      (det_one_add_mul_pos_of_matrixK_admissible S T.val hS (hgap T hT))).1.ne'
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (S Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => ∫ T, matrixKLogDetKernel (S + v • Δ) T.val ∂ν)
      (∫ T, (matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ).trace.re ∂ν) 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ :=
    fun v T => 1 + T.val * (S + v • Δ)
  let F : ℝ → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) → ℝ := fun v T => Real.log (A v T).det.re
  let q : ℝ → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) → ℝ :=
    fun v T => ((A v T).adjugate * (T.val * Δ)).trace.re / (A v T).det.re
  let D : ℝ → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) → ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    fun v T => q v T • (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  let U : Set (ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) := {p | (A p.1 p.2).det.re ≠ 0}
  have hA : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => A p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [A]
    fun_prop
  have hdet : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (A p.1 p.2).det.re) :=
    Complex.continuous_re.comp hA.matrix_det
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun hdet continuous_const
  have hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => F p.1 p.2) U :=
    hdet.continuousOn.log (fun _ hp => hp)
  have hq : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => q p.1 p.2) U := by
    apply (Complex.continuous_re.comp
      ((hA.matrix_adjugate.mul
        ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)).matrix_trace)).continuousOn.div
      hdet.continuousOn
    exact fun _ hp => hp
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => D p.1 p.2) U :=
    hq.smul continuousOn_const
  have hline (v : ℝ) (T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
      HasDerivAt (fun v => A v T) (T.val * Δ) v := by
    simpa only [A, id_eq, one_smul] using
      ((((hasDerivAt_id v).smul_const Δ).const_add S).const_mul T.val).const_add 1
  have hd (p : ℝ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hp : p ∈ U) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun v => F v p.2) (D p.1 p.2) p.1 := by
    have h := (hline p.1 p.2).matrix_det
    have hr := (Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt p.1 h).log hp
    convert! hr.hasFDerivAt using 1
    ext
    simp [D, q]
  have hpoint (T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hT : T ∈ ν.support) : (0,T) ∈ U := by
    change (1 + T.val * (S + (0 : ℝ) • Δ)).det.re ≠ 0
    simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using (Complex.pos_iff.mp
      (det_one_add_mul_pos_of_matrixK_admissible S T.val hS (hgap T hT))).1.ne'
  have hI := NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support ν hν F D U hU hF hD hd 0 hpoint
  have hDi : Integrable (D 0) ν := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (q 0) ν.support := by
      apply hq.comp (f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => ((0 : ℝ),T))
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
      exact hpoint
    have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
    have hre : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
    rw [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi
    exact hi.smul_const (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  have h := hI.hasDerivAt
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hDi] at h
  have hq₀ : (fun T => D 0 T 1) =ᵐ[ν]
      (fun T => (matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ).trace.re) := by
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have h₁ := (hd (0,T) (hpoint T hT)).hasDerivAt
    have hpath₀ : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => S + v • Δ) Δ 0 := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const Δ).const_add S)
    have h₂ := hasDerivAt_matrixKLogDetKernel hpath₀ T.val
      (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hS)
      (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hgap T hT)
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h₂
    exact h₁.unique (by convert! h₂ using 1)
  rw [integral_congr_ae hq₀] at h
  convert! h using 1

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_line
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_line
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α u : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (S Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α u (S + v • Δ))
      (α * ((matrixKTransform ν α S - (u : ℂ) • 1) * Δ).trace.re) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hline : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => S + v • Δ) Δ 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const Δ).const_add S
  let L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (S + v • Δ).trace.re) Δ.trace.re 0 := by
    convert! L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hline using 1
  have hlog := hline.log_re_matrix_det (by simpa using hS.det_pos)
  have hI := hasDerivAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel ν hν S Δ hS hgap
  have h := (((htrace.const_mul (-α * u)).add (hI.const_mul α)).sub hlog).sub_const
    (Fintype.card n * (Real.log α + 1))
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolvent S T.val)
      ν.support := by
    intro T hT
    exact ((continuousAt_matrixKResolvent S T.val
      (isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgap T hT))).comp
        (f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (S,T.val))
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hRi : Integrable (fun T => matrixKResolvent S T.val) ν := by
    have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
    have hre : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
    rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi
  have hRΔ : Integrable (fun T => matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ) ν :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).flip Δ).integrable_comp hRi
  have htraceI : (∫ T, (matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ).trace.re ∂ν) =
      ((∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) * Δ).trace.re := by
    have hh := Matrix.re_trace_integral hRΔ
    rw [integral_mul_const_of_integrable hRi] at hh
    simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using hh.symm
  convert! h using 1
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at *
  rw [htraceI]
  simp only [matrixKTransform, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.sub_re, Complex.smul_re,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, zero_mul, sub_zero,
    smul_eq_mul, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re]
  field_simp [hα]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_line_zero_of_eq
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_line_zero_of_eq
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α u : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (S Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => matrixKPotential ν α u (S + v • Δ)) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hK, sub_self, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.trace_zero, Complex.zero_re, mul_zero]
    using hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_line ν hν α u hα S Δ hS hgap

name: NLAlib.mixedResolventSplit_lengths
statement:
theorem mixedResolventSplit_lengths (a b : ℕ) (i : Fin (a + b)) :
    0 < (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).1 + (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).2 ∧
    0 < (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).1 + (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).2 ∧
    (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).1 + (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).2 +
      ((mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).1 + (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).2) = a + b + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp only [mixedResolventSplitLeft, mixedResolventSplitRight, Fin.append_left]
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega
  · simp only [mixedResolventSplitLeft, mixedResolventSplitRight, Fin.append_right]
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega

name: NLAlib.mixedResolventCrossingPowers_lengths
statement:
theorem mixedResolventCrossingPowers_lengths (a b c e : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (a + b)) (j : Fin (c + e)) :
    (∀ r : Fin 4, 0 < mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers a b c e i j r +
      mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers a b c e i j r) ∧
    (∑ r : Fin 4, (mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers a b c e i j r +
      mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers a b c e i j r)) = a + b + c + e + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi := mixedResolventSplit_lengths a b i
  have hj := mixedResolventSplit_lengths c e j
  have hisum := hi.2.2
  have hjsum := hj.2.2
  constructor
  · intro r
    fin_cases r
    · simpa [mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers, mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers] using hi.1
    · simpa [mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers, mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers] using hi.2.1
    · simpa [mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers, mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers] using hj.1
    · simpa [mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers, mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers] using hj.2.1
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers,
      mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ,
      Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero]
    omega

name: NLAlib.mixed_power_insertion_sum_eq_sum_split
statement:
theorem mixed_power_insertion_sum_eq_sum_split (R S H : M) (a b : ℕ) :
    ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, R ^ (a - i) * H * R ^ (i + 1) * S ^ b) +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, R ^ a * S ^ (b - j) * H * S ^ (j + 1)) =
      ∑ i : Fin (a + b),
        (R ^ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).1 * S ^ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).2) * H *
          (R ^ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).1 * S ^ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_add, mixedResolventSplitLeft, mixedResolventSplitRight,
    Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, pow_zero, one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun i : ℕ => R ^ (a - i) * (H * (R ^ (i + 1) * S ^ b))) a,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun j : ℕ => R ^ a * (S ^ (b - j) * (H * S ^ (j + 1)))) b]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_eq_sum_split
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_eq_sum_split
    {R S : ℝ → M} {t : ℝ} (H : M)
    (hR : HasDerivAt R (R t * H * R t) t)
    (hS : HasDerivAt S (S t * H * S t) t) (a b : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => R u ^ a * S u ^ b)
      (∑ i : Fin (a + b),
        (R t ^ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).1 * S t ^ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b i).2) * H *
          (R t ^ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).1 * S t ^ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b i).2)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hd := hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_of_sandwich H hR hS a b
  exact hd.congr_deriv (mixed_power_insertion_sum_eq_sum_split (R t) (S t) H a b)

name: NLAlib.sum_trace_sandwich_sums_eq_sum_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear
statement:
theorem sum_trace_sandwich_sums_eq_sum_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear
    {ι κ α β : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : ι → M) (B : κ → M) (U V : α → M) (W Z : β → M) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (A i * (∑ l, U l * B j * V l) * A i *
      (∑ m, W m * B j * Z m)).trace) =
      ∑ l, ∑ m, coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B ![U l, V l, W m, Z m]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum,
    coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_apply, coefficientCrossingSum,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ m, ∑ l, (A i * (U l * (B j * (V l * (A i * (W m * (B j * Z m))))))).trace)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m,
          (A i * (U l * (B j * (V l * (A i * (W m * (B j * Z m))))))).trace := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _
      = ∑ i, ∑ l, ∑ j, ∑ m,
          (A i * (U l * (B j * (V l * (A i * (W m * (B j * Z m))))))).trace := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ m,
        (A i * (U l * (B j * (V l * (A i * (W m * (B j * Z m))))))).trace := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ i, ∑ m, ∑ j,
        (A i * (U l * (B j * (V l * (A i * (W m * (B j * Z m))))))).trace := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ m, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (A i * (U l * (B j * (V l * (A i * (W m * (B j * Z m))))))).trace := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.sum_normalizedTrace_sandwich_sums_eq_inv_card_mul_sum_crossing
statement:
theorem sum_normalizedTrace_sandwich_sums_eq_inv_card_mul_sum_crossing
    {ι κ α β : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : ι → M) (B : κ → M) (U V : α → M) (W Z : β → M) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, normalizedTrace (A i * (∑ l, U l * B j * V l) * A i *
      (∑ m, W m * B j * Z m))) =
      (Fintype.card d : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ l, ∑ m, coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B ![U l, V l, W m, Z m]
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_trace_sandwich_sums_eq_sum_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B U V W Z
  simpa only [normalizedTrace, Finset.mul_sum] using
    congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (Fintype.card d : ℂ)⁻¹ * z) h

name: NLAlib.norm_inv_card_mul_coefficientCrossingTrace_resolvent_le_sum_normalizedTrace
statement:
theorem norm_inv_card_mul_coefficientCrossingTrace_resolvent_le_sum_normalizedTrace
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : ι → M) (B : κ → M) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hB : ∀ j, (B j).IsHermitian) (X : Fin 4 → M) (hX : ∀ j, (X j).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (a b : Fin 4 → ℕ) {L : ℕ} (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L)
    (hLpos : 0 < L) (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) :
    ‖(Fintype.card d : ℂ)⁻¹ * coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear A B
      (fun j => resolvent (X j) ζ ^ a j * resolvent (X j) (star ζ) ^ b j)‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance B)) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance B))) *
        ∑ j, (((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / L) *
          (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent (X j) ζ) ^ L)).re
proof:
:= by
  have htrace (j : Fin 4) : (CFC.abs (resolvent (X j) ζ) ^ L).trace.re /
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) = (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent (X j) ζ) ^ L)).re := by
    have h := re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_div_card (resolvent (X j) ζ) L
    rw [← re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues (resolvent (X j) ζ) L] at h
    simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using h.symm
  rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast, mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (norm_coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear_resolvent_le_sum_trace
      A B hA hB X hX ζ a b hL hLpos hArc) (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (Fintype.card d))
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc, Finset.sum_div, htrace] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_smul_le_sum_norm_mul_one_add_norm
statement:
theorem norm_sum_smul_le_sum_norm_mul_one_add_norm
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    ‖∑ i, x i • A i‖ ≤ (∑ i, ‖A i‖) * (1 + ‖x‖)
proof:
:= by
  calc _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖x i • A i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖A i‖ * (1 + ‖x‖) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
      have h := norm_le_pi_norm x i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      linarith
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.continuous_re_trace_series_product
statement:
theorem continuous_re_trace_series_product
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s).trace.re)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun x : κ → ℝ => reTraceCLM
    (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s))
  apply reTraceCLM.continuous.comp
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.abs_re_trace_series_product_le
statement:
theorem abs_re_trace_series_product_le
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    |(B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s).trace.re| ≤
      (‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * ‖B‖ * ‖C‖ *
        (∑ i, ‖A i‖) ^ (r + s)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  let Y := ∑ i, x i • A i
  classical
  have hpower (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ‖M ^ k‖ ≤ ‖M‖ ^ k := by
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      simp only [pow_zero]
      rw [Matrix.cstar_norm_def, map_one]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
    | succ k => exact norm_pow_le' M (Nat.succ_pos k)
  have hnorm := norm_sum_smul_le_sum_norm_mul_one_add_norm A x
  have htrace := reTraceCLM.le_opNorm (B * Y ^ r * C * Y ^ s)
  rw [reTraceCLM_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at htrace
  calc _ ≤ ‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * ‖B * Y ^ r * C * Y ^ s‖ := htrace
    _ ≤ ‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
        (‖B‖ * ‖Y‖ ^ r * ‖C‖ * ‖Y‖ ^ s) := by
      gcongr
      exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul
        ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpower _ _) (norm_nonneg _)))
          (norm_nonneg _))) (hpower _ _) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
    _ ≤ ‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
        (‖B‖ * ((∑ i, ‖A i‖) * (1 + ‖x‖)) ^ r * ‖C‖ *
          ((∑ i, ‖A i‖) * (1 + ‖x‖)) ^ s) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, pow_add, pow_add]; ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_sum_smul_update
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sum_smul_update
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (x : κ → ℝ) (i : κ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => ∑ j, Function.update x i y j • A j) (A i) t
proof:
:= by
  let L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] Matrix ι ι ℂ :=
    ∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j).smulRight (A j)
  have h := L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hasDerivAt_update x i t)
  convert! h using 1
  · funext y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, L, _root_.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
  · simp [L, Pi.single_apply]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_re_trace_mul_series_pow_update
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_re_trace_mul_series_pow_update
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (x : κ → ℝ)
    (i : κ) (t : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun y => (B * (∑ j, Function.update x i y j • A j) ^ q).trace.re)
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range q,
        (B * (∑ j, Function.update x i t j • A j) ^ (q.pred - l) *
          A i * (∑ j, Function.update x i t j • A j) ^ l).trace.re) t
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (hasDerivAt_sum_smul_update A x i t).fun_pow' q
  have hmul := (hasDerivAt_const t B).mul hp
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t
    (reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).clm_apply hmul
  convert! htrace using 1
  · simp only [_root_.zero_apply, zero_mul, zero_add, reTraceCLM_apply, Finset.mul_sum,
      Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_sub_sum_smul_update_neg
statement:
theorem sum_smul_sub_sum_smul_update_neg
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (x : κ → ℝ) (i : κ) :
    (∑ j, x j • A j) - (∑ j, Function.update x i (-x i) j • A j) =
      (2 * x i) • A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hpoint (j : κ) : x j • A j - Function.update x i (-x i) j • A j =
      if j = i then (2 * x i) • A i else 0 := by
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [Function.update_self, if_true, ← sub_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hji, hji, if_false, sub_self]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  simp

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    (∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ)) ↔
    (∀ x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n, x≠0 →
      0 < inner ℝ x (x-matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap x))
proof:
:= by
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt S
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
  have hQ : Q.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    let H := hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x
    let Δ := Q*H*Q
    have hΔ : Δ.IsHermitian := by
      simpa only [hQ.eq] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose Q
        (isHermitian_hermitianFrobeniusMatrix x)
    have hΔ0 : Δ≠0 := by
      intro hz
      have he : R*Δ*R=H := invSqrt_sqrt_congruence S hS H
      rw [hz,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at he
      apply hx
      apply (hermitianFrobeniusEquiv ℂ n).injective
      exact Subtype.ext he.symm
    have hp := h Δ hΔ hΔ0
    have he := frobInner_matrixKTransformDeriv ν hν α (ne_of_gt hα) S hS hgap Δ
    dsimp only at he
    rw [invSqrt_sqrt_congruence S hS H] at he
    rw [he] at hp
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (inv_pos.mpr hα)).mp hp
  · intro h Δ hΔ hΔ0
    let H := R*Δ*R
    have hH : H.IsHermitian := by
      simpa only [hR.eq] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose R hΔ
    let x := toHermitianFrobenius hH
    have hx : x≠0 := by
      intro hz
      have hh := congrArg (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n) hz
      change H=0 at hh
      have he : Q*H*Q=Δ := sqrt_invSqrt_congruence S hS Δ
      rw [hh,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at he
      exact hΔ0 he.symm
    have hp := h x hx
    rw [frobInner_matrixKTransformDeriv ν hν α (ne_of_gt hα) S hS hgap Δ]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hα) hp

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    (∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ)) ↔
    ‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap‖<1
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff ν hν α hα S hS hgap]
  exact inner_sub_map_pos_iff_norm_lt_one _
    (isSymmetric_matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap)
    (posSemidef_matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap)

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    ‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap‖<1 ↔
    ∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S Y).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have he := (positiveCone_stability_iff
    (matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap)
    (isSymmetric_matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap)
    (posSemidef_matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap)).2
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Y,hY,hg⟩
    exact ⟨hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y,hY,hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨Y,hY,hg⟩
    exact ⟨toHermitianFrobenius hY.isHermitian,hY,hg⟩

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    (∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S Y).PosDef) ↔
    ∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Y,hY,hg⟩
    refine ⟨cfc Real.sqrt S*Y*cfc Real.sqrt S,
      (posDef_sqrt_congruence_iff S hS Y).mpr hY,?_⟩
    rw [posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_iff ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
      invSqrt_sqrt_congruence S hS Y]
    exact hg
  · rintro ⟨B,hB,hg⟩
    exact ⟨_,(posDef_invSqrt_congruence_iff S hS B).mpr hB,
      (posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_iff ν hν α hα S hS hgap B).mp hg⟩

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_stability_iff
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_stability_iff [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hS : S.val.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    ((∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S.val Δ)) ↔
      ‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap‖<1) ∧
    (‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap‖<1 ↔
      ∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S.val Y).PosDef) ∧
    ((∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S.val Y).PosDef) ↔
      ∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S.val B).PosDef)
proof:
:=
  ⟨matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S.val hS hgap,
    matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα S.val hS hgap,
    matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S.val hS hgap⟩

name: NLAlib.normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix_apply (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (r : n) (j : Fin (M+1)) :
    normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix H b M r j = (normalizedChebyshevWeight j : ℂ) *
      ((aeval H (Chebyshev.T ℂ (j : ℤ))) *ᵥ b) r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix, normalizedChebyshevPolynomial,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Chebyshev.map_T, map_mul, aeval_C,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul,

name: NLAlib.eventually_circleDensity_eq_neg_circleIntegral_of_exterior_inverse_branches
statement:
theorem eventually_circleDensity_eq_neg_circleIntegral_of_exterior_inverse_branches
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i)
    {R S ρ : ℝ} {forward inverse : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hforward : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (forward i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
      Tendsto (fun z => forward i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hforwardSpec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, forward i z ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => forward i z))
    (hinverse : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (inverse i) {u | S < ‖u‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun u => inverse i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))))
    (hinverseSpec : ∀ u, S < ‖u‖ → ∀ i,
      u - (s : ℂ) * inverse i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - inverse i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRρ : R < ρ) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop,
        traceExponentialCircleDensity forward b ρ s =
          -(2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * ∑ i, if b i < s then inverse i u else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomp := eventually_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_eq A b hb s hs
    (fun i => (hforward i).2) hforwardSpec (fun i => (hinverse i).2)
    hinverseSpec
  have hmoment : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop,
      (∮ z in C(0, ρ), exp (forward i z + (s : ℂ) * z)) =
        -(∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * inverse i u) := by
    intro i
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun u => inverse i u - (((s - b i)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * u)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using (hinverse i).2
    apply Complex.eventually_circleIntegral_exp_eq_neg_circleIntegral_exp_mul_of_inverse
      ((hforward i).1.add (differentiableOn_id.const_mul (s : ℂ))) (hinverse i).1
      (inv_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i))) hlim _ hρ hRρ
    exact hcomp.mono (fun u hu => hu i)
  have hmoment' : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop, ∀ i,
      (∮ z in C(0, ρ), exp (forward i z + (s : ℂ) * z)) =
        -(∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * inverse i u) := by
    simpa only [Filter.eventually_all] using hmoment
  filter_upwards [hmoment', eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ), eventually_gt_atTop S]
    with r hmoment hr hSr
  have hc : sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ {u : ℂ | S < ‖u‖} := by
    intro u hu
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ = r := by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm] using hu
    change S < ‖u‖
    simpa only [hnorm] using hSr
  have hci (i : n) : CircleIntegrable
      (fun u => exp u * (if b i < s then inverse i u else 0)) 0 r := by
    by_cases hi : b i < s
    · simpa only [if_pos hi] using
        (Complex.continuous_exp.continuousOn.fun_mul
          ((hinverse i).1.continuousOn.mono hc)).circleIntegrable hr.le
    · simp only [if_neg hi, mul_zero]
      exact circleIntegrable_const 0 0 r
  have hsum : (∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * ∑ i, if b i < s then inverse i u else 0) =
      ∑ i, ∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * (if b i < s then inverse i u else 0) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    simpa using
      circleIntegral.integral_fun_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hci i)
  rw [hsum, Finset.mul_sum]
  unfold traceExponentialCircleDensity
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : b i < s
  · simp only [if_pos hi]
    rw [hmoment i]
    ring
  · simp [hi, circleIntegral]

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_inverse_branches_circleDensity_eq_neg_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_inverse_branches_circleDensity_eq_neg_circleIntegral
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i)
    {R ρ : ℝ} {forward : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hforward : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (forward i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
      Tendsto (fun z => forward i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hforwardSpec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, forward i z ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => forward i z))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRρ : R < ρ) :
    ∃ S : ℝ, 0 < S ∧ ∃ inverse : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (inverse i) {u | S < ‖u‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun u => inverse i u - u / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-A i i / ((s - b i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) ∧
      (∀ u, S < ‖u‖ →
        (∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * inverse i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
          (A - inverse i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => inverse i u)) ∧
      ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop,
        traceExponentialCircleDensity forward b ρ s =
          -(2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * ∑ i, if b i < s then inverse i u else 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, inverse, hinverse, hinverseSpec⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches A b hb s hs
  exact ⟨S, hS, inverse, hinverse, hinverseSpec,
    eventually_circleDensity_eq_neg_circleIntegral_of_exterior_inverse_branches
      A b hb s hs hforward hforwardSpec hinverse
      (fun u hu => (hinverseSpec u hu).1) hρ hRρ⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_diagonal_simple
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_diagonal_simple
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hsimple : ∀ (C : Matrix n n ℂ), C.IsHermitian →
      ∀ (b : n → ℝ), Function.Injective b → ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u →
        (∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) → ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
          (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (C + t • diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) l u) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
      (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have := hn
    exact exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_commute A H hA hH
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  | inr hn =>
    have := hn
    let l := lambdaMin H
    let u := lambdaMax H
    have hfin : (spectrum ℝ H).Finite := by
      rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
      exact finite_range _
    have hbmem (i : n) : hH.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc l u := by
      have hi := hH.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i
      exact ⟨csInf_le hfin.bddBelow hi, le_csSup hfin.bddAbove hi⟩
    let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star hH.eigenvectorUnitary)
    have hEH : E H = diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) := by
      simpa only [E, Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal,
        Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply] using
        hH.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
    have hlu : l ≤ u := by
      obtain ⟨i⟩ := hn
      exact (hbmem i).1.trans (hbmem i).2
    by_cases hsame : l = u
    · have hscalar : H = (l : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
        apply E.injective
        change E H = E ((l : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
        rw [hEH, map_smul, map_one]
        have heig (i : n) : hH.eigenvalues i = l := by
          have hi := hbmem i
          rw [← hsame] at hi
          exact le_antisymm hi.2 hi.1
        ext i j
        by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, heig, Complex.real_smul]
      apply exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_commute A H hA hH
      rw [hscalar]
      exact (Commute.one_right A).smul_right l
    have hlt : l < u := lt_of_le_of_ne hlu hsame
    let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
    have hb0mem (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : hH.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Icc l u := by
      simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hbmem (e i)
    obtain ⟨v, hvstrict, hvmem, hvlim⟩ :=
      Fin.exists_strictAnti_tendsto_mem_Icc hH.eigenvalues₀_antitone hlt hb0mem
    let b : ℕ → n → ℝ := fun k i => v k (e.symm i)
    have hbinj (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (b k) :=
      (hvstrict k).injective.comp e.symm.injective
    have hbinterval (k : ℕ) (i : n) : b k i ∈ Icc l u := hvmem k (e.symm i)
    have hblim : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 hH.eigenvalues) := by
      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
      intro i
      exact (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hvlim) (e.symm i)
    let K : ℕ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun k => diagonal (fun i => (b k i : ℂ))
    have hKlim : Tendsto K atTop (𝓝 (E H)) := by
      rw [hEH]
      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
      intro i
      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
      intro j
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        simpa only [K, diagonal_apply_eq, Function.comp_def] using
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ((tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hblim) i)
      · simpa only [K, diagonal_apply_ne _ hij] using
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    have hEA : (E A).IsHermitian :=
      isHermitian_unitary_conj (star hH.eigenvectorUnitary) A hA
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_tendsto
      (fun _ : ℕ => E A) K (E A) (E H) l u tendsto_const_nhds hKlim
      (Eventually.of_forall fun k => hsimple (E A) hEA (b k) (hbinj k) l u hlu (hbinterval k))
    refine ⟨ν, ?_⟩
    convert hν using 1
    funext t
    rw [← map_smul E, ← map_add E]
    exact (traceExp_unitary_conj (star hH.eigenvectorUnitary) (A + t • H)).symm

name: NLAlib.tendsto_natCast_smul_orderedMatrixExp_sub_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_natCast_smul_orderedMatrixExp_sub_one (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) • (orderedMatrixExp H (k : ℂ)⁻¹ - 1)) atTop (𝓝 H.sum)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℂ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hne : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, (k : ℂ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with k hk
    exact inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))
  have hparam : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℂ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝[≠] 0) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hzero, hne⟩
  have h := (hasDerivAt_orderedMatrixExp_zero H).tendsto_slope_zero.comp hparam
  simp only [zero_add, orderedMatrixExp_zero, inv_inv, Function.comp_def] at h
  simpa only [← Complex.coe_smul, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using h

name: NLAlib.tendsto_nsmul_abs_orderedMatrixExp_sub_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_nsmul_abs_orderedMatrixExp_sub_one (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => k • (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixExp H (k : ℂ)⁻¹) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 H.sum)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => orderedMatrixExp H (k : ℂ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have h := (analyticAt_orderedMatrixExp H 0).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      (tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℂ))
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, orderedMatrixExp_zero] using h
  have hsum : IsSelfAdjoint H.sum := by
    clear hp
    induction H with
    | nil => change star (0 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 0; simp
    | cons A H ih =>
      exact (hH A (by simp)).isSelfAdjoint.add (ih (fun B hB => hH B (by simp [hB])))
  have h := CFC.tendsto_smul_abs_sub_one_of_tendsto_smul_sub_one hp
    (tendsto_natCast_smul_orderedMatrixExp_sub_one H) hsum
  simpa only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using h

name: NLAlib.tendsto_abs_orderedMatrixExp_pow
statement:
theorem tendsto_abs_orderedMatrixExp_pow
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixExp H (k : ℂ)⁻¹)) ^ k) atTop
      (𝓝 (matrixExp H.sum))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : Nonempty n
  · let := hn
    apply NormedSpace.tendsto_pow_exp_of_tangent
    simpa only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using tendsto_nsmul_abs_orderedMatrixExp_sub_one H hH
  · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    have heq : (fun k : ℕ => (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixExp H (k : ℂ)⁻¹)) ^ k) =
        (fun _ : ℕ => matrixExp H.sum) := funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [heq]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds

name: NLAlib.exterior_lt_of_eventually_lt_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hlarge : C≤f y := le_of_not_gt h
  obtain ⟨Y,hY,hsmall⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop y).and hevent).exists
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hft⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hY

name: NLAlib.exterior_neg_inverse_involutive
statement:
private theorem exterior_neg_inverse_involutive (S : M) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    -(-S⁻¹)⁻¹=S
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (-S⁻¹)⁻¹= -S := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv

      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)]

name: NLAlib.exterior_kernel_inverse_bound
statement:
private theorem exterior_kernel_inverse_bound
    (α R : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (hR : 0<R) (z : ℂ) (X T : M)
    (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (hTN : ‖T‖≤R) (hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|z.re|)
    (hsmall : ‖X-α•(z•1)‖≤2*α*R) :
    ‖(X-T)⁻¹‖≤((α+1)*R)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (X-T) := by
    apply Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
    simpa only [map_sub,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,sub_zero] using hX
  have herror : ‖(X-T)-(α•z)•1‖≤(2*α+1)*R := by
    calc
      _ = ‖(X-α•(z•1))-T‖ := by rw [smul_assoc]; congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖X-α•(z•1)‖+‖T‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith
  have hw : α*|z.re|≤‖α•z‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Complex.abs_re_le_norm z) hα.le
  have hgap : (2*α+1)*R<‖α•z‖ := by nlinarith
  have hbound := Matrix.norm_nonsing_inv_le_of_sub_smul_one_le
    (X-T) (α•z) ((2*α+1)*R) hunit herror hgap
  refine hbound.trans ?_
  have hpos : 0<(α+1)*R := mul_pos (by linarith) hR
  have hle : (α+1)*R≤‖α•z‖-(2*α+1)*R := by nlinarith
  simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos hle

name: NLAlib.exterior_averaged_kernel_bound
statement:
private theorem exterior_averaged_kernel_bound
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (α R : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (hR : 0<R) (z : ℂ) (S : M)
    (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|z.re|)
    (hsmall : ‖-S⁻¹-α•(z•1)‖≤2*α*R) :
    ‖∫ T,matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν‖≤R+R^2*((α+1)*R)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let X := -S⁻¹
  have hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef := posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse S hS
  have hinv : -X⁻¹=S := exterior_neg_inverse_involutive S
    (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS)
  have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν,
      ‖matrixKResolvent S T.val‖≤R+R^2*((α+1)*R)⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTN : ‖T.val‖≤R := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
    have hRN := exterior_kernel_inverse_bound α R hα hR z X T.val hX T.property hTN hfar hsmall
    have hker : matrixKResolvent S T.val=T.val+T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val := by
      rw [← hinv]
      exact matrixKResolvent_neg_inverse_eq X T.val hX T.property
    rw [hker]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖T.val‖+‖T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T.val‖+‖T.val‖*‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ :=
        add_le_add le_rfl ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)))
      _ ≤ R+R*((α+1)*R)⁻¹*R := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt

name: NLAlib.exterior_inverse_center_identity
statement:
private theorem exterior_inverse_center_identity
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (α : ℝ) (hα : α≠0) (z : ℂ) (S : M)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=z•1) :
    -S⁻¹-α•(z•1)= -(α•(∫ T,matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν))
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun Y : M => α•Y) hK
  rw [matrixKTransform,smul_sub,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα,one_smul] at he
  rw [← he]
  abel

name: NLAlib.norm_neg_inverse_sub_scalar_matrixKTransform_solution_lt
statement:
theorem norm_neg_inverse_sub_scalar_matrixKTransform_solution_lt
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α R : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (hR : 0<R) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (x : ℝ) (hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|x|) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0<y) :
    ‖-(F ((x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I))⁻¹-
      α•(((x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•1)‖<2*α*R
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (x : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*Complex.I
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖-(F (z t))⁻¹-α•((z t)•1)‖
  have hzc : Continuous z := continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
  have hz (t : ℝ) : (z t).im=t := by simp [z]
  have hzr (t : ℝ) : (z t).re=x := by simp [z]
  have hgc : ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) := by
    intro t ht
    have hft := hFa (z t) (by change 0<(z t).im; rwa [hz])
    have hfu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (hF (z t) (by rwa [hz])).1
    have hFc : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => F (z s)) t :=
      hft.continuousAt.comp (f := z) hzc.continuousAt
    have hinv : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => (F (z s))⁻¹) t :=
      (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (F (z t)) hfu).continuousAt.comp
        (f := fun s : ℝ => F (z s)) hFc
    have hscalar : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => α•((z s)•(1 : M))) t :=
      have hs : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => (z s)•(1 : M)) t :=
        hzc.continuousAt.smul continuousAt_const
      hs.const_smul α
    exact (hinv.neg.sub hscalar).norm.continuousWithinAt
  have heq (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t) :
      g t=α*‖∫ T,matrixKResolvent (F (z t)) T.val ∂ν‖ := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [exterior_inverse_center_identity ν α hα.ne' (z t) (F (z t))
      (hF (z t) (by rwa [hz])).2,norm_neg,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => α*(R+R^2*(α*t)⁻¹)) atTop (𝓝 (α*R)) := by
    have hi := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hα tendsto_id)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,id_eq,mul_zero,add_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.add (hi.const_mul (R^2))).const_mul α
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, g t<2*α*R := by
    have hlt : α*R<2*α*R := by nlinarith
    filter_upwards [hlim.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hlt),eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht htp
    have hη := mul_pos hα htp
    have htarget : (α*t)•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart ((z t)•(1 : M)) : M) := by
      rw [exterior_scalar_im,hz,smul_smul]
    have hN := specNorm_integral_matrixKResolvent_of_solution_le ν hν α hα
      ((z t)•1) (F (z t)) (hF _ (by rwa [hz])).1 (hF _ (by rwa [hz])).2
      (α*t) R hη hbound htarget
    rw [heq t htp]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hN) hα.le).trans_lt ht
  apply exterior_lt_of_eventually_lt_of_ne hgc hev ?_ hy
  intro t ht hlevel
  have hS := (hF (z t) (by rwa [hz])).1
  have hsmall : ‖-(F (z t))⁻¹-α•((z t)•1)‖≤2*α*R := hlevel.le
  have hN := exterior_averaged_kernel_bound ν α R hα hR (z t) (F (z t)) hS
    hbound (by rwa [hzr]) hsmall
  have hnorm : 2*α*R≤α*(R+R^2*((α+1)*R)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← hlevel,heq t ht]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN hα.le
  have hr : R^2*((α+1)*R)⁻¹<R := by
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos (by linarith : 0<α+1) hR)).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_pos hα (sq_pos_of_pos hR)]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_inverseVariable_resolvents_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior
statement:
theorem norm_inverseVariable_resolvents_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α R : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (hR : 0<R) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) (hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|z.re|) :
    ‖F z‖≤((α+1)*R)⁻¹ ∧
      ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ‖(-((F z)⁻¹)-T.val)⁻¹‖≤((α+1)*R)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall : ‖-(F z)⁻¹-α•(z•1)‖≤2*α*R := by
    have h := norm_neg_inverse_sub_scalar_matrixKTransform_solution_lt ν hν α R hα hR F hFa hF
      hbound z.re hfar hz
    simpa only [Complex.re_add_im] using h.le
  let X := -(F z)⁻¹
  have hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef :=
    posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse (F z) (hF z hz).1
  have hinv : -X⁻¹=F z := exterior_neg_inverse_involutive (F z)
    (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (hF z hz).1)
  constructor
  · have h0 := exterior_kernel_inverse_bound α R hα hR z X 0 hX Matrix.isHermitian_zero
      (by simpa only [norm_zero] using hR.le) hfar hsmall
    calc
      _ = ‖X⁻¹‖ := by rw [← hinv,norm_neg]
      _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [sub_zero] using h0
  · intro T hT
    exact exterior_kernel_inverse_bound α R hα hR z X T.val hX T.property
      (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT) hfar hsmall

name: NLAlib.isOpen_rationalMatrixDomain
statement:
theorem isOpen_rationalMatrixDomain (Q : 𝕜[X]) :
    IsOpen {A : M | IsUnit (aeval A Q)}
proof:
:=
  Units.isOpen.preimage (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    (fun A => (Q.hasFDerivAt_aeval_noncomm A).continuousAt))

name: NLAlib.eventually_isUnit_aeval
statement:
theorem eventually_isUnit_aeval (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : M) (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) :
    ∀ᶠ B in 𝓝 A, IsUnit (aeval B Q)
