:=
  (isOpen_rationalMatrixDomain (n := n) Q).mem_nhds hA

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_rationalMatrixEval
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_rationalMatrixEval (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) :
    HasFDerivAt (rationalMatrixEval P Q) (rationalBlockMap P Q A A) A
proof:
:= by
  apply hasFDerivAt_of_continuous_secant (L := fun B => rationalBlockMap P Q B A)
  · simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      (continuousAt_rationalBlockMap P Q A A hA hA).comp
        (x := A) (f := fun B : M => (B,A)) (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt
  · filter_upwards [eventually_isUnit_aeval Q A hA] with B hB
    simpa only [rationalBlockMap_apply] using rationalMatrixEval_sub P Q B A hB hA

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixHessian_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalMatrixHessian_apply (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A G H : M) :
    rationalMatrixHessian P Q A G H = rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A A A G H +
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A A A H G
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalMatrixHessian]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_rationalBlockMap_diagonal
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_rationalBlockMap_diagonal (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : M => rationalBlockMap P Q B B) (rationalMatrixHessian P Q A) A
proof:
:= by
  let L : M → M →L[𝕜] M →L[𝕜] M := fun B =>
    rationalSecondBlockMap P Q B A B + (rationalSecondBlockMap P Q A B A).flip
  change HasFDerivAt _ (L A) A
  apply hasFDerivAt_of_continuous_secant
  · have h₁ : ContinuousAt (fun B : M => rationalSecondBlockMap P Q B A B) A := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (continuousAt_rationalSecondBlockMap P Q A A A hA hA hA).comp
          (x := A) (f := fun B : M => (B,A,B))
          (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).continuousAt
    have h₂ : ContinuousAt (fun B : M => rationalSecondBlockMap P Q A B A) A := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (continuousAt_rationalSecondBlockMap P Q A A A hA hA hA).comp
          (x := A) (f := fun B : M => (A,B,A))
          (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).continuousAt
    exact h₁.add (continuous_flip_matrixBilinear.continuousAt.comp h₂)
  · filter_upwards [eventually_isUnit_aeval Q A hA] with B hB
    ext H i j
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun D : M => D i j)
      (rationalBlockDifference_sub_left P Q B A B H hB hA hB)
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun D : M => D i j)
      (rationalBlockDifference_sub_right P Q A B A H hA hB hA)
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply] at h₁ h₂
    simp only [sub_apply, rationalBlockMap_apply, L, add_apply, flip_apply,
      rationalSecondBlockMap_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
    calc
      _ = (rationalBlockDifference P Q B B H i j - rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H i j) +
          (rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H i j - rationalBlockDifference P Q A A H i j) := by abel
      _ = _ := by rw [h₁, h₂]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_fderiv_rationalMatrixEval
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_fderiv_rationalMatrixEval (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : M => fderiv 𝕜 (rationalMatrixEval P Q) B)
      (rationalMatrixHessian P Q A) A
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasFDerivAt_rationalBlockMap_diagonal P Q A hA).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [eventually_isUnit_aeval Q A hA] with B hB
  exact (hasFDerivAt_rationalMatrixEval P Q B hB).fderiv

name: NLAlib.fderiv_rationalMatrixEval_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_rationalMatrixEval_apply (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A H : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (rationalMatrixEval P Q) A H = rationalBlockDifference P Q A A H
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_rationalMatrixEval P Q A hA).fderiv, rationalBlockMap_apply]

name: NLAlib.fderiv_fderiv_rationalMatrixEval_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_fderiv_rationalMatrixEval_apply (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A G H : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (fun B : M => fderiv 𝕜 (rationalMatrixEval P Q) B) A G H =
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A A A G H +
        rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A A A H G
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_fderiv_rationalMatrixEval P Q A hA).fderiv,
    rationalMatrixHessian_apply]

name: NLAlib.isClosed_image_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse
statement:
theorem isClosed_image_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    IsClosed ((fun Z : M => matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹) '' Ici Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_norm_bound_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse ν hν α hα Y hY hgapY
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro u U hu huU
  have hsol (j : ℕ) : ∃ Z : M, Y≤Z ∧ matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹=u j := hu j
  choose Z hYZ hKZ using hsol
  have htarget : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ‖u j‖≤‖U‖+1 :=
    (huU.norm.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by linarith : ‖U‖<‖U‖+1))).mono fun _ h => h.le
  have hbounded : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ‖Z j‖≤α*(‖U‖+1+C) := by
    filter_upwards [htarget] with j hj
    exact (hbound (Z j) (hYZ j)).trans (by rw [hKZ]; gcongr)
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ j in atTop, Z j∈closedBall (0 : M) (α*(‖U‖+1+C)) :=
    (hbounded.mono fun j hj => by simpa only [mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using hj).frequently
  obtain ⟨Z0,_hball,φ,hφ,hZlim⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : M) (α*(‖U‖+1+C))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in hfreq
  have hYZ0 : Y≤Z0 := isClosed_Ici.mem_of_tendsto hZlim
    (Eventually.of_forall fun j => hYZ (φ j))
  have hZ0 : Z0.PosDef := (hY.isStrictlyPositive.of_le hYZ0).posDef
  have hgapZ0 : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z0+T.val).PosDef := by
    intro T hT
    have hle : Y+T.val≤Z0+T.val := by
      simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ0 T.val
    exact ((hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef
  have hZZ : Z0⁻¹⁻¹=Z0 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hZ0.isUnit)
  have hdom : Z0⁻¹∈matrixKTransformDomain ν := by
    refine ⟨hZ0.inv.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator Z0⁻¹ T.val hZ0.inv ?_⟩
    simpa only [hZZ] using hgapZ0 T hT
  have hInvlim := (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse Z0 hZ0.isUnit).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hZlim
  have hKlim := (hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hInvlim
  have hKlim' : Tendsto (fun j => u (φ j)) atTop (𝓝 (matrixKTransform ν α Z0⁻¹)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,hKZ] using hKlim
  have hU : matrixKTransform ν α Z0⁻¹=U := tendsto_nhds_unique hKlim' (huU.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
  exact ⟨Z0,hYZ0,hU⟩

name: NLAlib.traceFunction_eq_sum
statement:
theorem traceFunction_eq_sum {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (φ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceFunction φ A = ∑ i, φ (hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceFunction, hA.cfc_eq]
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_le_norm
statement:
private lemma eigenvalue_le_norm {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : Fin d) :
    hA.eigenvalues i ≤ ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa using h)

name: NLAlib.trace_fromBlocks_diag
statement:
private lemma trace_fromBlocks_diag (P : Matrix m m ℂ) (Q : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace (fromBlocks P 0 0 Q) = trace P + trace Q
proof:
:= by
  simp [trace, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.scalar
statement:
private lemma scalar {t₁ t₂ n₁ n₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : 0 ≤ t₁) (ht₂ : 0 ≤ t₂) (hn₁ : 0 ≤ n₁) (hn₂ : 0 ≤ n₂)
    (h₁ : n₁ = 0 → t₁ = 0) (h₂ : n₂ = 0 → t₂ = 0) :
    min (t₁ / n₁) (t₂ / n₂) ≤ (t₁ + t₂) / max n₁ n₂ ∧
      (t₁ + t₂) / max n₁ n₂ ≤ t₁ / n₁ + t₂ / n₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn₁.eq_or_lt with e₁ | p₁
  · subst e₁
    have := h₁ rfl; subst this
    rw [max_eq_right hn₂]; simp
  rcases hn₂.eq_or_lt with e₂ | p₂
  · subst e₂
    have := h₂ rfl; subst this
    rw [max_eq_left hn₁]; simp
  rcases le_total n₂ n₁ with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_left h, add_div]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg ht₂ hn₁))
    · gcongr
  · rw [max_eq_right h, add_div]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (div_nonneg ht₁ hn₂))
    · gcongr

name: NLAlib.traceFunction_le_intrinsicDimension_mul
statement:
theorem NLAlib.traceFunction_le_intrinsicDimension_mul {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hConvex : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) φ) (hZero : φ 0 = 0)
    (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hPSD : A.PosSemidef) :
    traceFunction φ A ≤ intrinsicDimension A * φ (‖A‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsHermitian := hPSD.isHermitian
  rw [traceFunction_eq_sum φ A hA]
  have htr : (Matrix.trace A).re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    simp
  have hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i := fun i => hPSD.eigenvalues_nonneg i
  have hle : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ ‖A‖ :=
    eigenvalue_le_norm A hA
  set N := ‖A‖ with hN
  rw [intrinsicDimension, ← hN, htr]
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := le_trans (hnn ⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)⟩) (hle _)
  rcases hN0.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
  · have : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 := fun i => le_antisymm (h0 ▸ hle i) (hnn i)
    simp [this, hZero, ← h0]
  · have key : ∀ i, φ (hA.eigenvalues i) ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i / N) * φ N := by
      intro i
      set x := hA.eigenvalues i
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ x / N := div_nonneg (hnn i) hpos.le
      have hb1 : x / N ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hpos).mpr (hle i)
      have h := hConvex.2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr (le_refl (0:ℝ))) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hpos.le)
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x / N) hb0 (by ring : 1 - x / N + x / N = 1)
      have hx : (1 - x / N) • (0 : ℝ) + (x / N) • N = x := by
        simp [smul_eq_mul]; field_simp
      rw [hx, hZero] at h
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
    calc ∑ i, φ (hA.eigenvalues i) ≤ ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i / N) * φ N :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => key i)
      _ = (∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i) / N * φ N := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_div]

name: NLAlib.intrinsicDimension_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem NLAlib.intrinsicDimension_fromBlocks {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (V₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hV₁ : V₁.PosSemidef) (hV₂ : V₂.PosSemidef) :
    let V
proof:
:= Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂
    V.PosSemidef ∧
    ‖V‖ = max (‖V₁‖) (‖V₂‖) ∧
    intrinsicDimension V =
      ((Matrix.trace V₁).re + (Matrix.trace V₂).re) /
        max (‖V₁‖) (‖V₂‖) ∧
    min (intrinsicDimension V₁) (intrinsicDimension V₂) ≤ intrinsicDimension V ∧
    intrinsicDimension V ≤ intrinsicDimension V₁ + intrinsicDimension V₂ := by
  intro V
  have hnorm : ‖V‖ = max (‖V₁‖) (‖V₂‖) :=
    norm_fromBlocks_diag V₁ V₂
  have hdim : intrinsicDimension V =
      ((Matrix.trace V₁).re + (Matrix.trace V₂).re) /
        max (‖V₁‖) (‖V₂‖) := by
    unfold intrinsicDimension
    rw [hnorm, show V = Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂ from rfl, trace_fromBlocks_diag,
      Complex.add_re]
  have hz : ∀ {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ), ‖A‖ = 0 →
      (Matrix.trace A).re = 0 := by
    intro k A h
    have : A = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp h
    simp [this]
  have hs := scalar (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hV₁.trace_nonneg).1
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hV₂.trace_nonneg).1
    (norm_nonneg V₁) (norm_nonneg V₂) (hz V₁) (hz V₂)
  refine ⟨posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag hV₁ hV₂, hnorm, hdim, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hdim]; exact hs.1
  · rw [hdim]; exact hs.2

name: NLAlib.norm_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution_le
statement:
theorem norm_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y Z U : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) (hYZ : Y≤Z)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹=U) (R q : ℝ) (hR : 0≤R) (hq : 0≤q)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hbase : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ‖(Y+T.val)⁻¹‖≤q) :
    ‖Z‖≤α*(‖U‖+R+R^2*q)
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : Z.PosDef := (hY.isStrictlyPositive.of_le hYZ).posDef
  have hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z+T.val).PosDef := by
    intro T hT
    have hle : Y+T.val≤Z+T.val := by simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
    exact ((hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef
  have hET : ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν‖≤R := by
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν, ‖T.val‖≤R := by
      filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt
  have hER : ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖≤R^2*q := by
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν, ‖T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val‖≤R^2*q := by
      filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
      have hle : Y+T.val≤Z+T.val := by simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
      have hinv : (Z+T.val)⁻¹≤(Y+T.val)⁻¹ := by
        simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using
          CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hle (hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive
      have hRN : ‖(Z+T.val)⁻¹‖≤q :=
        (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le
          (hgapZ T hT).inv.posSemidef.nonneg hinv).trans (hbase T hT)
      have hTN : ‖T.val‖≤R := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖T.val‖*‖(Z+T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ := (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ R*q*R := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by ring
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt
  have hz := congrArg (fun W : M => α•W) hK
  rw [matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Z hZ hgapZ] at hz
  simp only [smul_sub,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul] at hz
  have hEq : Z=α•((∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)-U) := by
    rw [smul_sub,smul_sub]
    apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hz).symm
  rw [hEq,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hα.le
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-
        (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)‖+‖U‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν‖+
        ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(Z+T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖+‖U‖ :=
      add_le_add (norm_sub_le _ _) le_rfl
    _ ≤ R+R^2*q+‖U‖ := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_bound_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse
statement:
theorem exists_norm_bound_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ Z : M, Y≤Z →
      ‖Z‖≤α*(‖matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹‖+C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R0,hR0⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  let R := max R0 1
  have hR : 0≤R := zero_le_one.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R := by
    intro T hT
    have hb : specNorm T.val≤R0 := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using hR0 T hT
    exact hb.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint M => (Y+T.val)⁻¹) ν.support := by
    intro T hT
    exact ((hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (Y+T.val) (hgapY T hT).isUnit).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun T : selfAdjoint M => Y+T.val)
      (continuous_const.add continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨q0,hq0⟩ := (hν.image_of_continuousOn hc).isBounded.exists_norm_le
  let q := max q0 1
  have hq : 0≤q := zero_le_one.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbase : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ‖(Y+T.val)⁻¹‖≤q := by
    intro T hT
    exact (hq0 _ ⟨T,hT,rfl⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨R+R^2*q,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro Z hZ
  simpa only [add_assoc] using norm_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution_le ν hν α hα
    Y Z (matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹) hY hgapY hZ rfl R q hR hq hbound hbase

name: NLAlib.kernelMeasure_defect_eq
statement:
private theorem kernelMeasure_defect_eq (S T : M) (hu : IsUnit (1+S*T)) :
    T-matrixKResolvent S T=T*(1+S*T)⁻¹*S*T
proof:
:= by
  have hcan : (1+S*T)⁻¹*(1+S*T)=1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)
  have he : T*(1+S*T)⁻¹*(S*T)=T-T*(1+S*T)⁻¹ := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun X : M => T*X) hcan
    exact eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr (by
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_assoc,add_comm] using hh)
  simpa only [matrixKResolvent,Matrix.mul_assoc] using he.symm

name: NLAlib.kernelMeasure_trace_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (T*T).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [hT.eq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self T
  have ht := Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hp.trace_nonneg
  have hd : (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹=(((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_inv,Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  have he : normalizedTrace (T*T)=
      (((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹*(T*T).trace.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [normalizedTrace,hd]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,mul_zero,add_zero,sub_zero,ht.2.symm]
  rw [he]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
  exact ⟨mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) ht.1,trivial⟩

name: NLAlib.kernelMeasure_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem kernelMeasure_tendsto_zero
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => F ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_
    (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hα tendsto_id))
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
  have hz : 0<((y : ℂ)*Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
  have hZ : (α*y)•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart (((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•(1 : M)) : M) := by
    have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
    simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one,smul_smul]
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,Function.comp_def,id_eq] using specNorm_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le_inv ν hν α hα
    (((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•1) (F _) (hF _ hz).1 (hF _ hz).2 (α*y) (mul_pos hα hy) hZ

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_stieltjes_measure_matrixKResolvent_defect
statement:
theorem existsUnique_stieltjes_measure_matrixKResolvent_defect
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    ∃! ρ : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      (ρ.mass : ℝ)=α⁻¹*(normalizedTrace (T*T)).re ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (T-matrixKResolvent (F z) T)=
        ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let Dfn : ℂ → M := fun z => T-matrixKResolvent (F z) T
  let L : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  let f : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => L (Dfn z)
  have hunit (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : IsUnit (1+F z*T) :=
    isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (F z) T (hF z hz).1 hT
  have hNa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Dfn {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} := by
    intro z hz
    have hden : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => 1+F w*T) z :=
      analyticAt_const.add ((hFa z hz).mul analyticAt_const)
    have hi : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => Ring.inverse (1+F w*T)) z := by
      have hh := analyticAt_inverse (𝕜 := ℂ) (hunit z hz).unit
      rw [(hunit z hz).unit_spec] at hh
      exact hh.comp (f := fun w : ℂ => 1+F w*T) hden
    have hi' : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (1+F w*T)⁻¹) z := by
      simpa only [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using hi
    exact analyticAt_const.sub (analyticAt_const.mul hi')
  have hfa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} :=
    fun z hz => (L.analyticAt (Dfn z)).comp (hNa z hz)
  have hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → 0≤(f z).im := by
    intro z hz
    have he : (imaginaryPart (Dfn z) : M)=
        matrixKResolvent (F z) T*(imaginaryPart (F z) : M)*(matrixKResolvent (F z) T)ᴴ := by
      dsimp only [Dfn]
      rw [map_sub,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,zero_sub]
      simp only [NegMemClass.coe_neg,
        imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent (F z) T (hF z hz).1 hT,neg_neg]
    have hp : (imaginaryPart (Dfn z) : M).PosSemidef := by
      rw [he]
      exact (hF z hz).1.posSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same _
    exact im_normalizedTrace_nonneg_of_posSemidef_imaginaryPart (Dfn z) hp
  have hFzero := kernelMeasure_tendsto_zero ν hν α hα F hF
  have hdenlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => 1+F ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)*T) atTop (𝓝 (1 : M)) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.zero_mul,add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add (hFzero.mul_const T)
  have hInvlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (1+F ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)*T)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 (1 : M)) := by
    simpa only [inv_one,Function.comp_def] using
      (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (1 : M) isUnit_one).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hdenlim
  have hscale : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•F ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(α⁻¹•(1 : M)))) := by
    have hh := (tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixKTransform_solution ν hν α hα F hF).const_smul (α⁻¹)
    simpa only [smul_comm α⁻¹,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα.ne',mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul,smul_neg] using hh
  have hNlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)•Dfn ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(α⁻¹•(T*T)))) := by
    have hh := ((hInvlim.const_mul T).mul hscale).mul_const T
    have he : T*(1 : M)*(-(α⁻¹•(1 : M)))*T= -(α⁻¹•(T*T)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,
        Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [he] at hh
    apply hh.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    have hz : 0<((y : ℂ)*Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
    dsimp only [Dfn]
    rw [kernelMeasure_defect_eq (F _) T (hunit _ hz)]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  obtain ⟨htr,htrReal⟩ := kernelMeasure_trace_sq T hT
  let c : NNReal := ⟨α⁻¹*(normalizedTrace (T*T)).re,mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le) htr⟩
  have hflim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)*Complex.I*f ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(c : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    have hh := (L.continuous.tendsto (-(α⁻¹•(T*T)))).comp hNlim
    have he : L (-(α⁻¹•(T*T)))= (-(c : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hscaleTrace : L (α⁻¹•(T*T))=((α⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)*normalizedTrace (T*T) := by
        simpa only [Complex.real_smul,L,ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
          LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply] using
          map_smul (L.restrictScalars ℝ) (α⁻¹) (T*T)
      rw [map_neg,hscaleTrace]
      calc
        _ = -(((α⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)*((normalizedTrace (T*T)).re : ℂ)) :=
          congrArg (fun w : ℂ => -(((α⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)*w)) htrReal
        _ = _ := by change _ = -((α⁻¹*(normalizedTrace (T*T)).re : ℝ) : ℂ); rw [Complex.ofReal_mul]
    rw [he] at hh
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,map_smul,smul_eq_mul] using hh
  obtain ⟨ρ,hρ,huniq⟩ := hfa.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq hpos c hflim
  refine ⟨ρ,⟨congrArg (fun r : NNReal => (r : ℝ)) hρ.1,hρ.2⟩,?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  apply huniq σ
  refine ⟨?_,hσ.2⟩
  apply NNReal.coe_injective
  exact hσ.1

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.quadForm_vecMulVec_self_eq_sq
statement:
private theorem quadForm_vecMulVec_self_eq_sq (v x : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x = (dotProduct v x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [star_trivial, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, dotProduct_comm] using quadForm_vecMulVec_star_self v x

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.quadForm_smul_vecMulVec_self
statement:
private theorem quadForm_smul_vecMulVec_self (t : ℝ) (v x : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x = t * (dotProduct v x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_def, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  change t * quadForm (Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x = t * (dotProduct v x) ^ 2
  rw [quadForm_vecMulVec_self_eq_sq]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.quadForm_sub_smul_vecMulVec
statement:
private theorem quadForm_sub_smul_vecMulVec (M : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (v x : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (M - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x =
      quadForm M x - t * (dotProduct v x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_def, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
  change quadForm M x - quadForm (t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x =
      quadForm M x - t * (dotProduct v x) ^ 2
  rw [quadForm_smul_vecMulVec_self]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.cauchy_sq_le_smul_quadForm
proof:
:= by
  let y : n → ℝ := M⁻¹.mulVec v
  have hdet : IsUnit M.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (A := M)).mp hM.isUnit
  have hy : M.mulVec y = v := by
    simp [y, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hdet]
  have hQy : quadForm M y = q := by
    rw [hq, quadForm_def, hy, quadForm_def]
    simp
    rw [dotProduct_comm]
  have hcs := sq_bilinear_le_quadForm_mul_of_posSemidef hM.posSemidef x y
  simpa only [hy, hQy, dotProduct_comm, mul_comm] using hcs

name: Matrix.PosDef.sub_smul_vecMulVec_self
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.sub_smul_vecMulVec_self {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hM : M.PosDef) {v : n → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hlt : t * quadForm M⁻¹ v < 1) :
    (M - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · subst v
    simpa using hM
  · let q : ℝ := quadForm M⁻¹ v
    have hq : 0 < q := by
      exact (hM.inv).quadForm_pos hv
    have hlt' : t * q < 1 := by
      simpa [q] using hlt
    have hcauchy : ∀ x : n → ℝ, (dotProduct v x) ^ 2 ≤ q * quadForm M x := by
      intro x
      exact cauchy_sq_le_smul_quadForm hM rfl x
    have hqq : ∀ x : n → ℝ,
        quadForm (M - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x =
          quadForm M x - t * (dotProduct v x) ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      exact quadForm_sub_smul_vecMulVec M t v x
    have hvvherm : (Matrix.vecMulVec v v).IsHermitian := by
      rw [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, mul_comm]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
      (hM.isHermitian.sub (Matrix.IsHermitian.smul hvvherm (IsSelfAdjoint.all t)))
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [← quadForm_def]
        have hmain : 0 < (1 - t * q) * quadForm M x := by
          exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlt') (hM.quadForm_pos hx)
        calc
          0 < (1 - t * q) * quadForm M x := hmain
          _ ≤ quadForm M x - t * (dotProduct v x) ^ 2 := by
            nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcauchy x) ht]
          _ = quadForm (M - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v) x := (hqq x).symm)

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.quadForm_sq_pos_of_posDef
statement:
private theorem quadForm_sq_pos_of_posDef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {v : n → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < quadForm (A ^ 2) v
proof:
:= by
  have hAinj : Function.Injective A.mulVec :=
    Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hA.isUnit
  have hsq : (A ^ 2).PosDef := by
    simpa only [pow_two, hA.isHermitian.eq] using
      Matrix.PosDef.conjTranspose_mul_self A hAinj
  exact hsq.quadForm_pos hv

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_upperScore_le
statement:
theorem posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_upperScore_le [Nonempty n]
    {MU : Matrix n n ℝ} (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    {δU : ℝ} (hδU : 0 < δU) {v : n → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hscore : upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) v ≤ 1 / t) :
    (MU + δU • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosDef ∧
      ((MU + δU • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace ≤
        MU⁻¹.trace
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Matrix n n ℝ := MU + δU • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) with hSdef
  set R : Matrix n n ℝ := S⁻¹ with hRdef
  set D : ℝ := upperGap MU δU with hDdef
  set q : ℝ := quadForm R v with hqdef
  set q2 : ℝ := quadForm (R ^ 2) v with hq2def
  have hS : S.PosDef := by
    rw [hSdef]
    exact hMU.add_smul_one_posDef hδU
  have hR : R.PosDef := by
    rw [hRdef]
    exact hS.inv
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    rw [hDdef]
    exact upperGap_pos MU hMU hδU
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    rw [hqdef]
    exact hR.quadForm_pos hv
  have hq2 : 0 < q2 := by
    rw [hq2def]
    exact quadForm_sq_pos_of_posDef hR hv
  have hscore' : quadForm (R ^ 2) v / D + quadForm R v ≤ 1 / t := by
    simpa [upperScore, upperMatrix, upperGap, hRdef] using hscore
  have hsc4 : t * q2 + t * q * D ≤ D := by
    have h0 : (t * D) * (quadForm (R ^ 2) v / D + quadForm R v) ≤
        (t * D) * (1 / t) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscore' (mul_pos ht hD).le
    have hR0 : (t * D) * (1 / t) = D := by
      field_simp [ht.ne']
    have hL0 : (t * D) * (quadForm (R ^ 2) v / D + quadForm R v) =
        t * quadForm (R ^ 2) v + t * quadForm R v * D := by
      field_simp [hD.ne']
    have h01 : t * quadForm (R ^ 2) v + t * quadForm R v * D ≤ D := by
      rw [hL0, hR0] at h0
      exact h0
    rwa [← hq2def, ← hqdef] at h01
  have htq : t * q < 1 := by
    have hpos2 : 0 < t * q2 := mul_pos ht hq2
    have hm : t * q * D < D := by
      nlinarith [hsc4, hpos2]
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (by simpa [one_mul] using hm) hD.le
  have hsc5 : t * q2 ≤ (1 - t * q) * D := by
    nlinarith [hsc4]
  have hsub : (S - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosDef := by
    exact hS.sub_smul_vecMulVec_self ht.le (by
      rw [← hRdef, ← hqdef]
      exact htq)
  have hSdet : IsUnit S.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (A := S)).mp hS.isUnit
  have hvd : dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v) = q := by
    rw [← hRdef]
    dsimp [q]
    rw [quadForm_def]
    simp
  have hvd2 : dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v) = q2 := by
    rw [← hRdef]
    dsimp [q2]
    rw [quadForm_def, pow_two]
    simp
  have hden : 1 + (-t) * q = 1 - t * q := by ring
  have hd : 1 + (-t) * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hvd, hden]
    exact ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr htq)
  have htr := Matrix.trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self (M := S) (H := 1)
    v (-t) hSdet hd
  have htr1 : ((S - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace =
      S⁻¹.trace - ((-t) / (1 + (-t) * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)))) *
        (dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v)) := by
    calc
      ((S - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace
          = (1 * (S + (-t) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace := by
            rw [Matrix.one_mul, show S + (-t) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v =
                S - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v by
              ext i j
              simp [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul]]
      _ = S⁻¹.trace - ((-t) / (1 + (-t) * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)))) *
            (dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v)) := by
            rw [htr]
            simp
  have htr' : ((S - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace =
      S⁻¹.trace + (t / (1 - t * q)) * q2 := by
    calc
      ((S - t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace
          = S⁻¹.trace - ((-t) / (1 + (-t) * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)))) *
              (dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v)) := htr1
      _ = S⁻¹.trace - ((-t) / (1 - t * q)) * q2 := by
            rw [hvd, hvd2, hden]
      _ = S⁻¹.trace + (t / (1 - t * q)) * q2 := by
            ring
  have htrS : S⁻¹.trace = MU⁻¹.trace - D := by
    rw [hSdef]
    unfold D upperGap upperMatrix
    ring
  have hdenpos : 0 < 1 - t * q := sub_pos.mpr htq
  have hcore : t * q2 / (1 - t * q) ≤ D :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using hsc5)
  refine ⟨hsub, ?_⟩
  rw [htr']
  calc
    S⁻¹.trace + (t / (1 - t * q)) * q2
        = (MU⁻¹.trace - D) + (t / (1 - t * q)) * q2 := by
          rw [htrS]
    _ = MU⁻¹.trace - D + t * q2 / (1 - t * q) := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    _ ≤ MU⁻¹.trace - D + D := by
          nlinarith [hcore]
    _ = MU⁻¹.trace := by
          ring

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_le_lowerScore
statement:
theorem posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_le_lowerScore [Nonempty n]
    {ML : Matrix n n ℝ} (hML : ML.PosDef)
    {δL : ℝ} (hδL : 0 < δL) (hcap : δL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1) {v : n → ℝ}
    (hv : v ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hscore : 1 / t ≤ lowerScore (lowerMatrix ML δL) (lowerGap ML δL) v) :
    (ML - δL • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosDef ∧
      ((ML - δL • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace ≤
        ML⁻¹.trace
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Matrix n n ℝ := ML - δL • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) with hSdef
  set R : Matrix n n ℝ := S⁻¹ with hRdef
  set D : ℝ := lowerGap ML δL with hDdef
  set q : ℝ := quadForm R v with hqdef
  set q2 : ℝ := quadForm (R ^ 2) v with hq2def
  have hS : S.PosDef := by
    rw [hSdef]
    exact hML.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδL hcap
  have hR : R.PosDef := by
    rw [hRdef]
    exact hS.inv
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    rw [hqdef]
    exact hR.quadForm_pos hv
  have hq2 : 0 < q2 := by
    rw [hq2def]
    exact quadForm_sq_pos_of_posDef hR hv
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    rw [hDdef]
    exact lowerGap_pos ML hML hδL hcap
  have hscore' : 1 / t ≤ quadForm (R ^ 2) v / D - quadForm R v := by
    simpa [lowerScore, lowerMatrix, lowerGap, hRdef] using hscore
  have hsc4 : D ≤ t * q2 - t * q * D := by
    have h0 : (t * D) * (1 / t) ≤
        (t * D) * (quadForm (R ^ 2) v / D - quadForm R v) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscore' (mul_pos ht hD).le
    have hR0 : (t * D) * (1 / t) = D := by
      field_simp [ht.ne']
    have hL0 : (t * D) * (quadForm (R ^ 2) v / D - quadForm R v) =
        t * quadForm (R ^ 2) v - t * quadForm R v * D := by
      field_simp [hD.ne']
    have h01 : D ≤ t * quadForm (R ^ 2) v - t * quadForm R v * D := by
      rw [hR0, hL0] at h0
      exact h0
    rwa [← hq2def, ← hqdef] at h01
  have hsc5 : (1 + t * q) * D ≤ t * q2 := by
    nlinarith [hsc4]
  have hvpsd : (t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosSemidef := by
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v).smul (a := t) ht.le
  have hadd : (S + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosDef := hS.add_posSemidef hvpsd
  have hSdet : IsUnit S.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (A := S)).mp hS.isUnit
  have hvd : dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v) = q := by
    rw [← hRdef]
    dsimp [q]
    rw [quadForm_def]
    simp
  have hvd2 : dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v) = q2 := by
    rw [← hRdef]
    dsimp [q2]
    rw [quadForm_def, pow_two]
    simp
  have hdenpos : 0 < 1 + t * q := add_pos zero_lt_one (mul_pos ht hq)
  have hd : 1 + t * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hvd]
    exact ne_of_gt hdenpos
  have htr := Matrix.trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self (M := S) (H := 1)
    v t hSdet hd
  have htr1 : ((S + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace =
      S⁻¹.trace - (t / (1 + t * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)))) *
        (dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v)) := by
    calc
      ((S + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace
          = (1 * (S + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace := by
            rw [Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = S⁻¹.trace - (t / (1 + t * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)))) *
            (dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v)) := by
            rw [htr]
            simp
  have htr' : ((S + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace =
      S⁻¹.trace - (t / (1 + t * q)) * q2 := by
    calc
      ((S + t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace
          = S⁻¹.trace - (t / (1 + t * (dotProduct v (S⁻¹.mulVec v)))) *
              (dotProduct v ((S⁻¹ * S⁻¹).mulVec v)) := htr1
      _ = S⁻¹.trace - (t / (1 + t * q)) * q2 := by
            rw [hvd, hvd2]
  have htrS : S⁻¹.trace = ML⁻¹.trace + D := by
    rw [hSdef]
    unfold D lowerGap lowerMatrix
    ring
  have hcore : D ≤ t * q2 / (1 + t * q) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hdenpos).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using hsc5)
  refine ⟨by simpa [hSdef] using hadd, ?_⟩
  rw [htr']
  calc
    S⁻¹.trace - (t / (1 + t * q)) * q2
        = (ML⁻¹.trace + D) - (t / (1 + t * q)) * q2 := by
          rw [htrS]
    _ = ML⁻¹.trace + D - t * q2 / (1 + t * q) := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    _ ≤ ML⁻¹.trace := by
          linarith [hcore]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_updates_of_frame
statement:
theorem exists_updates_of_frame {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty n]
    (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (MU : Matrix n n ℝ) (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    (δU δL : ℝ) (hδU : 0 < δU) (hδL : 0 < δL)
    (hcap : δL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1)
    (hpot : 1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace) :
    ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧
      (MU + δU • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).PosDef ∧
      ((MU + δU • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i))⁻¹).trace ≤
        MU⁻¹.trace ∧
      (ML - δL • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).PosDef ∧
      ((ML - δL • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + t • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i))⁻¹).trace ≤
        ML⁻¹.trace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hvi, t, ht, hUle, hLge⟩ :=
    exists_candidate_inverse v hframe MU hMU ML hML δU δL hδU hδL hcap hpot
  refine ⟨i, hvi, t, ht, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_upperScore_le hMU hδU hvi ht hUle).1
  · exact (posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_upperScore_le hMU hδU hvi ht hUle).2
  · exact (posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_le_lowerScore hML hδL hcap hvi ht hLge).1
  · exact (posDef_and_trace_inv_le_of_le_lowerScore hML hδL hcap hvi ht hLge).2

name: NLAlib.trace_insertionWord_of_count_true_eq_one
statement:
theorem trace_insertionWord_of_count_true_eq_one (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 1) :
    (insertionWord A X w).trace = (A ^ w.count false * X).trace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ks, _, hl, hs, ht⟩ := exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul A X w (by omega)
  rw [hw] at hl
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hl
  simp only [List.sum_singleton] at hs
  simpa only [List.map_singleton, List.prod_singleton, hs] using ht

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
    (C A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {n l : ℕ} (hn : Even n) (hl : l ≤ n) :
    (C * A ^ l * C * A ^ (n - l)).trace ≤ (C ^ 2 * A ^ n).trace
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ →+* ℂ := Complex.ofRealHom
  have hCm : (C.map f).IsHermitian := hC.map f (by intro x; simp [f])
  have hAm : (A.map f).IsHermitian := hA.map f (by intro x; simp [f])
  have hb := re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow (C.map f) (A.map f) hCm hAm hn hl
  have htrace (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : (B.map f).trace.re = B.trace := by
    simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, f]
  simp only [← Matrix.map_pow, ← Matrix.map_mul, htrace] at hb
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.trace_insertionWord_le_of_count_true_eq_two
statement:
theorem trace_insertionWord_le_of_count_true_eq_two
    (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hX : X.IsHermitian)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 2) (hn : Even (w.count false)) :
    (insertionWord A X w).trace ≤ (A ^ w.count false * X ^ 2).trace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ks, _, hl, hs, ht⟩ := exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul A X w (by omega)
  rw [hw] at hl
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_two.mp hl
  simp only [List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero] at hs
  rw [ht]
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hb := trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow X A hX hA hn
    (show b ≤ w.count false by omega)
  rw [show w.count false - b = a by omega, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (X ^ 2)] at hb
  calc
    _ = (X * A ^ b * X * A ^ a).trace := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ _ := hb

name: NLAlib.trace_neg_one_pow_mul
statement:
private theorem trace_neg_one_pow_mul (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (((-1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) ^ n) * B).trace = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * B.trace
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_mul, Matrix.trace_neg, ih,
      pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_mul]

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one_le_sum
statement:
theorem abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one_le_sum
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ) (w : List Bool) :
    |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y - 1) w).trace| ≤
      ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
        (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
          vecMulVec y y ^ v.2.count true).trace).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertionWord_sub_one_eq_sum]
  have hsum : ∀ ls : List (ℕ × List Bool),
      (ls.map fun v => (-1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) ^ v.1 *
        insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) v.2).sum.trace =
      (ls.map fun v => (-1 : ℝ) ^ v.1 *
        (insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) v.2).trace).sum := by
    intro ls
    induction ls with
    | nil => simp
    | cons v ls ih => simp [ih, Matrix.trace_add, trace_neg_one_pow_mul]
  rw [hsum]
  have hbound : ∀ ls : List (ℕ × List Bool), (∀ v ∈ ls, v ∈ subInsertionWords w) →
      |(ls.map fun v => (-1 : ℝ) ^ v.1 *
        (insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) v.2).trace).sum| ≤
      (ls.map fun v => (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec y y ^ v.2.count true).trace).sum := by
    intro ls
    induction ls with
    | nil => intro _; simp
    | cons v ls ih =>
      intro hmem
      have hv := (counts_of_mem_subInsertionWords (hmem v (by simp))).1
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      apply (abs_add_le _ _).trans
      apply add_le_add _ (ih fun u hu => hmem u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
      simpa only [hv] using abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le_trace_mul_pow hA y v.2
  exact hbound _ (fun _ h => h)

name: NLAlib.isOpen_matrixKTransformDomain
statement:
theorem isOpen_matrixKTransformDomain
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) (hν : IsCompact ν.support) :
    IsOpen (matrixKTransformDomain ν)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  intro S hS
  let U : Set (Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
    {p | IsUnit (1 + p.1 * p.2.val)}
  have hU : IsOpen U := Units.isOpen.preimage
    (continuous_const.add (continuous_fst.mul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)))
  obtain ⟨V,W,hVo,_hWo,hSV,hνW,hVW⟩ := generalized_tube_lemma
    (isCompact_singleton (x := S)) hν hU
      (by rintro ⟨X,T⟩ ⟨rfl,hT⟩; exact hS.2 T hT)
  have hV : V ∩ {X : Matrix n n ℂ | IsUnit X} ∈ 𝓝 S :=
    inter_mem (hVo.mem_nhds (hSV (by simp))) (Units.isOpen.mem_nhds hS.1)
  apply mem_of_superset hV
  intro X hX
  refine ⟨hX.2,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  have ht : (X,T) ∈ U := hVW ⟨hX.1,hνW hT⟩
  exact ht

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolventDerivComplex_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem matrixKResolventDerivComplex_restrictScalars (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) :

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S).restrictScalars ℝ = matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S
proof:
:= by
  let L := ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalarsIsometry ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (Matrix n n ℂ) ℝ ℝ
  have hI := L.integral_comp_comm (μ := ν) (fun T => matrixKResolventDerivComplex S T.val)
  change L ((∫ T, matrixKResolventDerivComplex S T.val ∂ν) +
    α⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) S⁻¹ S⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_add, map_smul, ← hI]
  change (∫ T, (matrixKResolventDerivComplex S T.val).restrictScalars ℝ ∂ν) + _ = _
  simp_rw [matrixKResolventDerivComplex_restrictScalars]
  unfold matrixKTransformDeriv
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]

    (hS : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S) S
proof:
:= by
  exact hasFDerivAt_of_restrictScalars ℝ
    (hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform ν hν α S hS.1 hS.2)
    (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α S)

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_matrixKResolventDerivComplex
statement:
private theorem continuousAt_matrixKResolventDerivComplex (S T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (h : IsUnit (1 + S * T)) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ =>
      matrixKResolventDerivComplex p.1 p.2) (S,T)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := continuousAt_matrixKResolvent S T h
  have hleft := (ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ)).continuous.continuousAt.comp hr
  exact (hleft.clm_apply hr).neg

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_matrixKTransformDerivComplex
statement:
theorem continuousAt_matrixKTransformDerivComplex
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) {S : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    ContinuousAt (matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α) S
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
    {p | IsUnit (1 + p.1 * p.2.val)}
  have hU : IsOpen U := Units.isOpen.preimage
    (continuous_const.add (continuous_fst.mul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)))
  obtain ⟨V,W,hVo,_hWo,hSV,hνW,hVW⟩ := generalized_tube_lemma
    (isCompact_singleton (x := S)) hν hU
      (by rintro ⟨X,T⟩ ⟨rfl,hT⟩; exact hS.2 T hT)
  obtain ⟨C,hCc,hSC,hCV⟩ := exists_compact_subset (x := S) hVo (hSV (by simp))
  have hCU : C ×ˢ ν.support ⊆ U := fun p hp => hVW ⟨hCV hp.1,hνW hp.2⟩
  have hDc : ContinuousOn (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) =>
      matrixKResolventDerivComplex p.1 p.2.val) (C ×ˢ ν.support) := by
    intro p hp
    exact ((continuousAt_matrixKResolventDerivComplex p.1 p.2.val (hCU hp)).comp
      (f := fun q : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (q.1,q.2.val))
      (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hI := (continuousOn_integral_of_continuousOn_compact_support ν hν hCc
    (F := fun X T => matrixKResolventDerivComplex X T.val) (by convert! hDc)).continuousAt
    (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hSC)
  have hi := (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse S hS.1).continuousAt
  have hleft := (ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ)).continuous.continuousAt.comp hi
  have hInv := (hleft.clm_apply hi).const_smul α⁻¹
  exact hI.add hInv

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_matrixKTransform_complex
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_matrixKTransform_complex
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) {S : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    ContDiffAt ℂ 1 (matrixKTransform ν α) S
proof:
:= by
  refine contDiffAt_one_iff.mpr ⟨matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α,
    matrixKTransformDomain ν, (isOpen_matrixKTransformDomain ν hν).mem_nhds hS,?_,?_⟩
  · intro X hX
    exact (continuousAt_matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν hν α hX).continuousWithinAt
  · intro X hX
    exact hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hX

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.cfc_le
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
    Matrix.reindex e e
  have h := hf (Fintype.card n) (R A) (R B) (hA.reindex e) (hB.reindex e)
    (by rwa [spectrum_reindex]) (by rwa [spectrum_reindex])
    (by simpa [R, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.submatrix_sub] using
      ((Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB).submatrix e.symm))
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, cfc_reindex_of_isHermitian e f A hA,
    cfc_reindex_of_isHermitian e f B hB] at h
  simpa [R, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix,
    Matrix.submatrix_sub] using h.submatrix e

name: NLAlib.spectrum_subset_of_order_interval
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : lambdaMin A ∈ spectrum ℝ A := by
    rw [lambdaMin, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.range_nonempty _).csInf_mem (Set.finite_range _)
  have hmax : lambdaMax B ∈ spectrum ℝ B := by
    rw [lambdaMax, hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.range_nonempty _).csSup_mem (Set.finite_range _)
  have hlow : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (lambdaMin A) ≤ A := by
    apply (algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum hA).mpr
    intro x hx
    exact csInf_le (by rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]; exact (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow) hx
  have hupp : B ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (lambdaMax B) := by
    apply (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hB).mpr
    intro x hx
    exact le_csSup (by rw [hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]; exact (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove) hx
  intro x hx
  exact hI.ordConnected.out (hAI hmin) (hBI hmax)
    ⟨(algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum hC).mp (hlow.trans hAC) x hx,
      (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hC).mp (hCB.trans hupp) x hx⟩

name: NLAlib.length_cyclicTraceCutIndices
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicTraceCutIndices]

name: NLAlib.length_cyclicTraceCutMiddle
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyclicTraceCutMiddle, List.length_take, List.length_drop, length_cyclicTraceCutIndices]
  omega

name: NLAlib.cyclicTraceCutIndices_first
statement:
private theorem cyclicTraceCutIndices_first {m : ℕ} (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    (cyclicTraceCutIndices j)[0]'(by simp) = finRotate (m + 2) j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cyclicTraceCutIndices, List.getElem_rotate]
  apply Fin.ext
  rw [finRotate_apply]
  simp [Fin.add_def, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 < m + 2 by omega)]

name: NLAlib.cyclicTraceCutIndices_last
statement:
private theorem cyclicTraceCutIndices_last {m : ℕ} (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    (cyclicTraceCutIndices j)[m + 1]'(by simp) = j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cyclicTraceCutIndices, List.getElem_rotate]
  apply Fin.ext
  have h : m + 1 + (j.val + 1) = (m + 2) + j.val := by omega
  simp [h, Nat.add_mod_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]

name: NLAlib.cyclicTraceCutIndices_eq
proof:
:= by
  let L := cyclicTraceCutIndices j
  have hlen : L.length = m + 2 := length_cyclicTraceCutIndices j
  have hfirst : L[0]'(by omega) = finRotate (m + 2) j :=
    cyclicTraceCutIndices_first j
  have hlast : L[m + 1]'(by omega) = j := cyclicTraceCutIndices_last j
  have hdrop : (L.drop 1).drop m = [j] := by
    rw [List.drop_drop, Nat.add_comm 1 m,
      List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (show m + 1 < L.length by omega), hlast]
    simp [hlen]
  have htail : L.drop 1 = cyclicTraceCutMiddle j ++ [j] := by
    simpa only [cyclicTraceCutMiddle, ← hdrop] using
      (List.take_append_drop m (L.drop 1)).symm
  calc
    L = L[0]'(by omega) :: L.drop 1 := by
      simpa using (List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (show 0 < L.length by omega))
    _ = _ := by rw [hfirst, htail]

name: NLAlib.cyclicTraceCutIndices_perm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cyclicTraceCutIndices_eq]
  exact List.rotate_perm _ _

name: NLAlib.prod_cyclicTraceCutMiddle
statement:
private theorem prod_cyclicTraceCutMiddle {S : Type*} [CommMonoid S] {m : ℕ}
    (f : Fin (m + 2) → S) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    f (finRotate (m + 2) j) * ((cyclicTraceCutMiddle j).map f).prod =
      ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, f l
proof:
:= by
  let T := finRotate (m + 2) j :: cyclicTraceCutMiddle j
  have hp : (j :: T).Perm (List.finRange (m + 2)) := by
    have hc : ([j] ++ T).Perm (T ++ [j]) := List.perm_append_comm
    exact hc.trans (by simpa only [T, List.cons_append] using cyclicTraceCutIndices_perm j)
  have he := hp.trans (List.perm_cons_erase (by simp : j ∈ List.finRange (m + 2)))
  have ht : T.Perm ((List.finRange (m + 2)).erase j) := he.cons_inv
  calc
    _ = (T.map f).prod := rfl
    _ = (((List.finRange (m + 2)).erase j).map f).prod := (ht.map f).prod_eq
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← List.prod_toFinset f (List.Nodup.erase j (List.nodup_finRange _))]
      congr 1
      ext l
      simp [(List.nodup_finRange (m + 2)).mem_erase_iff]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_list_alternating_prod_le
statement:
private theorem specNorm_list_alternating_prod_le {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {m : ℕ} (Z Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ l, NLAlib.specNorm (Z l) ≤ R) (L : List (Fin (m + 2))) :
    NLAlib.specNorm ((L.map (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod) ≤
      R ^ L.length * ((L.map (fun l => NLAlib.specNorm (Y l))).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simpa only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, List.length_nil, pow_zero, one_mul] using
      (specNorm_one_le (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n))
  | cons l L ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    have hfac : specNorm (Z l * Y l) ≤ R * specNorm (Y l) :=
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hZ l) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    calc
      _ ≤ specNorm (Z l * Y l) * specNorm ((L.map (fun a => Z a * Y a)).prod) :=
        specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ (R * specNorm (Y l)) *
          (R ^ L.length * (L.map (fun a => specNorm (Y a))).prod) :=
        mul_le_mul hfac ih (specNorm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hR (specNorm_nonneg _))
      _ = _ := by simp only [List.length_cons, pow_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_cyclicTraceWordMiddle_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_cyclicTraceWordMiddle_le {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {m : ℕ} (Z Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ l, specNorm (Z l) ≤ R) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    specNorm (cyclicTraceWordMiddle Z Y j) ≤
      R ^ m * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := specNorm_list_alternating_prod_le Z Y hR hZ (cyclicTraceCutMiddle j)
  rw [length_cyclicTraceCutMiddle] at hp
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (Y (finRotate (m + 2) j)) *
        specNorm (((cyclicTraceCutMiddle j).map (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod) :=
      specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm (Y (finRotate (m + 2) j)) *
        (R ^ m * ((cyclicTraceCutMiddle j).map (fun l => specNorm (Y l))).prod) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = R ^ m * (specNorm (Y (finRotate (m + 2) j)) *
        ((cyclicTraceCutMiddle j).map (fun l => specNorm (Y l))).prod) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [prod_cyclicTraceCutMiddle (fun l => specNorm (Y l)) j]

name: NLAlib.continuous_cyclicTraceWordMiddle
statement:
theorem continuous_cyclicTraceWordMiddle {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {m : ℕ} (Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    Continuous (fun Z => cyclicTraceWordMiddle Z Y j)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod (L : List (Fin (m + 2))) :
      Continuous (fun Z : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜 =>
        (L.map (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod) := by
    induction L with
    | nil => simpa only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil] using continuous_const
    | cons l L ih =>
      change Continuous (fun Z : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜 =>
        (Z l * Y l) * (L.map (fun a => Z a * Y a)).prod)
      exact Continuous.mul (f := fun Z : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜 => Z l * Y l)
        (g := fun Z => (L.map (fun a => Z a * Y a)).prod)
        ((continuous_apply l).mul continuous_const) ih
  exact continuous_const.mul (hprod (cyclicTraceCutMiddle j))

name: NLAlib.trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut_aux
statement:
private theorem trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut_aux
    {R n : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {m : ℕ}
    (Z Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n R) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    (List.ofFn (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod.trace =
      (Z (finRotate (m + 2) j) *
        (Y (finRotate (m + 2) j) *
          ((cyclicTraceCutMiddle j).map (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod) * Z j * Y j).trace
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n R := fun l => Z l * Y l
  calc
    (List.ofFn f).prod.trace =
        (((cyclicTraceCutIndices j).map f).prod).trace := by
      rw [cyclicTraceCutIndices, List.map_rotate, ← List.ofFn_eq_map]
      exact (Matrix.trace_list_prod_rotate _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [cyclicTraceCutIndices_eq]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_append, List.map_nil,
        List.prod_cons, List.prod_append, List.prod_nil, Matrix.mul_one, f, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut
statement:
theorem trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut
    {S n : Type*} [CommSemiring S] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {m : ℕ}
    (Z Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n S) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    (List.ofFn (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod.trace =
      (Z (finRotate (m + 2) j) * cyclicTraceWordMiddle Z Y j * Z j * Y j).trace
proof:
:=
  trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut_aux Z Y j

name: NLAlib.cyclicTraceCutMiddle_zero
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem cyclicTraceCutMiddle_zero (j : Fin 2) : cyclicTraceCutMiddle j = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicTraceCutMiddle]

name: NLAlib.trace_alternating_two_pairs_eq_cyclic_cut
statement:
theorem trace_alternating_two_pairs_eq_cyclic_cut
    {R n : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (Z Y : Fin 2 → Matrix n n R) (j : Fin 2) :
    (List.ofFn (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod.trace =
      (Z (finRotate 2 j) * Y (finRotate 2 j) * Z j * Y j).trace
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [cyclicTraceCutMiddle_zero, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, Matrix.mul_one] using
    trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut_aux Z Y j

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_posDef_le
statement:
theorem posDef_of_posDef_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    B.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB)
  have hEq : A + (B - A) = B := by abel
  rw [hEq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.cfc_rpow_le_cfc_rpow
statement:
theorem cfc_rpow_le_cfc_rpow {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hAB : A ≤ B) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ r) A ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ r) B
proof:
:= by
  have hB : B.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (hA.nonneg.trans hAB)
  have hAc : 0 ≤ (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) A :=
    (((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) A).mpr hA).nonneg
  have hBc : 0 ≤ (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) B :=
    (((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) B).mpr hB).nonneg
  apply ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ _).mp
  rw [(realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hA.isHermitian,
    (realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hB.isHermitian]
  simpa only [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hAc, CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hBc] using
    (CFC.rpow_le_rpow hr (((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) A B).mpr hAB))

name: NLAlib.inv_le_inv_of_posDef
statement:
theorem inv_le_inv_of_posDef {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    B⁻¹ ≤ A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hAc := (posDef_realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) hA
  have hABc := ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) A B).mpr hAB
  have hB : IsUnit B := (posDef_of_posDef_le hA hAB).isUnit
  apply ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ _).mp
  rw [(realMatrixComplexification_inv (𝕜 := ℂ)) hB, (realMatrixComplexification_inv (𝕜 := ℂ)) hA.isUnit]
  simpa only [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using
    CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hABc hAc.isStrictlyPositive

name: NLAlib.cfc_log_le_cfc_log
statement:
theorem cfc_log_le_cfc_log {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    cfc Real.log A ≤ cfc Real.log B
proof:
:= by
  have hB : B.PosDef := posDef_of_posDef_le hA hAB
  apply ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ _).mp
  rw [(realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hA.isHermitian,
    (realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hB.isHermitian]
  exact CFC.log_le_log (((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) A B).mpr hAB)
    ((posDef_realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) hA).isStrictlyPositive

name: NLAlib.concaveOn_cfc_rpow
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro A hA B hB a b ha hb _
    exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
      (add_nonneg (smul_nonneg ha hA.nonneg) (smul_nonneg hb hB.nonneg))
  · intro A hA B hB a b ha hb hab
    have hAc : 0 ≤ (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) A :=
      (((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) A).mpr hA).nonneg
    have hBc : 0 ≤ (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) B :=
      (((posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) B).mpr hB).nonneg
    have hC : (a • A + b • B).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
      (add_nonneg (smul_nonneg ha hA.nonneg) (smul_nonneg hb hB.nonneg))
    have hCC : 0 ≤ a • (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) A + b • (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) B :=
      add_nonneg (smul_nonneg ha hAc) (smul_nonneg hb hBc)
    have hEmbedding : (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) (a • A + b • B) =
        a • (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) A + b • (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ)) B := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    have h := (CFC.concaveOn_rpow (A := Matrix n n ℂ) hr).2 hAc hBc ha hb hab
    dsimp only at h
    rw [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hAc, CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hBc,
      CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hCC, ← hEmbedding] at h
    apply ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ _).mp
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, (realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hA.isHermitian,
      (realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hB.isHermitian,
      (realMatrixComplexification_cfc (𝕜 := ℂ)) _ hC.isHermitian]
    exact h

name: NLAlib.loewner_heinz_real
statement:
theorem loewner_heinz_real {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ r) A)
      {A | A.PosSemidef} ∧
    ConcaveOn ℝ {A : Matrix n n ℝ | A.PosSemidef}
      (fun A => cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ r) A) ∧
    (∀ A B : Matrix n n ℝ, A.PosDef → A ≤ B →
      B⁻¹ ≤ A⁻¹ ∧ cfc Real.log A ≤ cfc Real.log B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun A hA B _ hAB => cfc_rpow_le_cfc_rpow hA hAB hr,
    concaveOn_cfc_rpow hr, ?_⟩
  intro A B hA hAB
  exact ⟨inv_le_inv_of_posDef hA hAB, cfc_log_le_cfc_log hA hAB⟩

name: NLAlib.continuous_matrixKResolvent_defect_fixed_height
statement:
theorem continuous_matrixKResolvent_defect_fixed_height
    (F : ℂ → M) (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hFpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef)
    (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) :
    Continuous (fun p : Tspace × ℝ => normalizedTrace (p.1.val-
      matrixKResolvent (F ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)) p.1.val))
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hγpos : 0<(γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
  have hZ : Continuous (fun p : Tspace × ℝ => (p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I) := by fun_prop
  have hT : Continuous (fun p : Tspace × ℝ => p.1.val) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro p
  have hz : 0<((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I).im := by simpa using hγpos
  have hcF := (hFa _ hz).continuousAt.comp
    (f := fun p : Tspace × ℝ => (p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I) hZ.continuousAt
  have harg : ContinuousAt (fun p : Tspace × ℝ =>
      (F ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I),p.1.val)) p := hcF.prodMk hT.continuousAt
  have hη := (continuousAt_matrixKResolvent (F ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)) p.1.val
    (isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (F _) p.1.val
      (hFpos _ hz) p.1.property)).comp
        (f := fun p : Tspace × ℝ => (F ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I),p.1.val)) harg
  exact L.continuous.continuousAt.comp (hT.continuousAt.sub hη)

name: NLAlib.exists_matrixKResolvent_defect_measure_family
statement:
theorem exists_matrixKResolvent_defect_measure_family
    (ν : Measure Tspace) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) :
    ∃ ρ : Tspace → FiniteMeasure ℝ, ∃ B : NNReal,
      (∀ T : Tspace, ((ρ T).mass : ℝ)=α⁻¹*(normalizedTrace (T.val*T.val)).re) ∧
      (∀ᵐ T ∂ν, (ρ T).mass≤B) ∧
      (∀ T : Tspace, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace
        (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)=
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ T : Measure ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → Continuous
        (fun T : Tspace => normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val))) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im →
        (∫ T : Tspace, normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val) ∂ν)=
          normalizedTrace ((∫ T : Tspace, T.val ∂ν)-z•1-α⁻¹•(F z)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs (T : Tspace) :=
    (existsUnique_stieltjes_measure_matrixKResolvent_defect ν hν α hα F hFa hF T.val T.property).exists
  choose ρ hρ using hs
  obtain ⟨R0,hR0⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  let R := max R0 0
  have hR : 0≤R := le_max_right _ _
  let B : NNReal := ⟨α⁻¹*R^2,by positivity⟩
  have hmass : ∀ᵐ T ∂ν, (ρ T).mass≤B := by
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
    rw [(hρ T).1]
    have hTN : ‖T.val‖≤R := by
      have hh := (hR0 T hT).trans (le_max_left R0 0)
      simpa only [← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using hh
    have hsq : (normalizedTrace (T.val*T.val)).re≤R^2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖normalizedTrace (T.val*T.val)‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
        _ ≤ ‖T.val*T.val‖ := by
          simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm (T.val*T.val)
        _ ≤ ‖T.val‖*‖T.val‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
        _ ≤ R^2 := by simpa only [sq] using mul_self_le_mul_self (norm_nonneg T.val) hTN
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le)
  have hcont (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : Continuous
      (fun T : Tspace => normalizedTrace (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val)) := by
    let L : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
    have hc : Continuous (fun T : Tspace => matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val) := by
      apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
      intro T
      exact (continuousAt_matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val
        (isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (F z) T.val (hF z hz).1 T.property)).comp
          (f := fun T : Tspace => (F z,T.val))
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt
    exact L.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.sub hc)
  refine ⟨ρ,B,fun T => (hρ T).1,hmass,fun T => (hρ T).2,hcont,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hdom : F z∈matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (hF z hz).1,fun T _ =>
      isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (F z) T.val (hF z hz).1 T.property⟩
  have hη := integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain ν hν hdom
  have hT : Integrable (fun T : Tspace => T.val) ν := by
    have hi := continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
    have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
    rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi
  let L : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hmean : (∫ T : Tspace, T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val ∂ν)=
      (∫ T : Tspace, T.val ∂ν)-z•1-α⁻¹•(F z)⁻¹ := by
    have hK := (hF z hz).2
    unfold matrixKTransform at hK
    rw [integral_sub hT hη,sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hK]
    abel
  have hh := L.integral_comp_comm (hT.sub hη)
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hh
  change (∫ T : Tspace, L (T.val-matrixKResolvent (F z) T.val) ∂ν)=L _
  rw [hh,hmean]

name: NLAlib.exists_entire_symmetric_profile_family
statement:
theorem exists_entire_symmetric_profile_family
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p q θ c : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (hb : b.IsSymm)
    (hrow : (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤ 1)
    (hentry : c ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (F : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : ℝ),
      Differentiable ℂ F ∧ (∀ z, (F z).IsSymm) ∧ F (θ : ℂ) = b ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, specNorm (F z) ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ 2) ≤ 4) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (q / 2)) ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, c ^ q * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ q) ≤ 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : Matrix n n ℝ := fun i j => ‖b i j‖
  have ha : a.IsSymm := by
    ext i j
    change ‖b j i‖ = ‖b i j‖
    rw [hb.apply i j]
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hUsym, hVsym, hfactor, hleft, hright, hrightEntry⟩ :=
    exists_symmetric_profile_power_factors hp hq hθ hc hexp a ha (fun i j => norm_nonneg _) hrow hentry
  let phase : Matrix n n ℂ := fun i j => if b i j = 0 then 0 else b i j / (‖b i j‖ : ℂ)
  have hphase (i j : n) : ‖phase i j‖ ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hz : b i j = 0
    · simp [phase, hz]
    · simp [phase, hz]
  let F : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun z i j =>
    phase i j * powerInterpolationCoefficient (U i j) (V i j) z
  let L : (n × n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    { toFun := fun x i j => x (i, j)
      map_add' := by intros; rfl
      map_smul' := by intros; rfl }
  have hF : Differentiable ℂ F := by
    have hh : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => fun ij : n × n =>
        phase ij.1 ij.2 * powerInterpolationCoefficient (U ij.1 ij.2) (V ij.1 ij.2) z) := by
      apply differentiable_pi.mpr
      intro ij
      exact differentiable_const _ |>.mul (differentiable_powerInterpolationCoefficient _ _)
    exact L.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiable.comp hh
  have hentrybound (i j : n) (z : ℂ) (C : ℝ)
      (hh : ‖powerInterpolationCoefficient (U i j) (V i j) z‖ ≤ C) :
      ‖F z i j‖ ≤ C := by
    dsimp [F]
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hphase i j) (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq (one_mul _)).trans hh
  have hFleft (i j : n) (t : ℝ) : ‖F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ≤ U i j :=
    hentrybound i j _ _ (norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_boundaries (hU i j) (hV i j) t).1
  have hFright (i j : n) (t : ℝ) : ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ≤ V i j :=
    hentrybound i j _ _ (norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_boundaries (hU i j) (hV i j) t).2
  let B : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, max (U i j) (V i j) ^ 2)
  refine ⟨F, B, hF, ?_, ?_, Real.sqrt_nonneg _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    ext i j
    change phase j i * powerInterpolationCoefficient (U j i) (V j i) z =
      phase i j * powerInterpolationCoefficient (U i j) (V i j) z
    rw [hUsym.apply i j, hVsym.apply i j]
    simp only [phase, hb.apply i j]
  · ext i j
    change phase i j * powerInterpolationCoefficient (U i j) (V i j) (θ : ℂ) = b i j
    rw [powerInterpolationCoefficient_real (hU i j) (hV i j) hθ, ← hfactor i j]
    by_cases hz : b i j = 0
    · simp [phase, a, hz]
    · dsimp [phase, a]
      rw [if_neg hz]
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz))
  · intro z hz
    apply (specNorm_le_frobNorm (F z)).trans
    change Real.sqrt (frobSq (F z)) ≤ _
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      (hentrybound i j z _ (norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_le_max (hU i j) (hV i j) hz)) 2
  · intro t
    apply le_trans _ hleft
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hFleft i j t) 2
  · intro t
    apply le_trans _ hright
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _ (by positivity)
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hFright i j t) 2
  · intro t
    apply le_trans _ hrightEntry
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _)
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (hFright i j t) hq.le

name: NLAlib.integrable_hirschmanDensityZero_mul_log_orderedMatrixExp
statement:
theorem integrable_hirschmanDensityZero_mul_log_orderedMatrixExp
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.hirschmanDensityZero t *
      Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : Nonempty n
  · let := hn
    apply Real.integrable_hirschmanDensityZero.mul_bdd
      (continuous_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH hp).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all _ (fun t => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      abs_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le H hH hp t)
  · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    have hz (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [hz _, schattenNormReal_zero hp, Real.log_zero, mul_zero]
    exact integrable_zero _ _ _

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_rpow_abs_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_rpow_abs_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixExp H (r : ℂ))) (1 / r)) p ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensity r t *
        Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  rw [schattenNormReal_rpow_abs _ hp0 hr.1]
  apply (Real.rpow_le_rpow (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
    (schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman H hH hp hr)
    (one_div_nonneg.mpr hr.1.le)).trans_eq
  rw [← Real.exp_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_comm r _, mul_assoc, one_div, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.1.ne', mul_one]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_matrixExp_sum_le_exp_integral_log_orderedMatrixExp
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_matrixExp_sum_le_exp_integral_log_orderedMatrixExp
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenNormReal (matrixExp H.sum) p ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensityZero t *
        Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p))
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  by_cases hn : Nonempty n
  · let := hn
    let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
      Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)
    have hf : Continuous f := continuous_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right H hH hp0
    have hb : ∀ᵐ t, ‖f t‖ ≤
        (H.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).sum + |Real.log ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p))| :=
      ae_of_all _ (fun t => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        abs_log_schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixExp_right_le H hH hp0 t)
    have hparam : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_nhdsGT_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have hi := (Real.tendsto_integral_hirschmanDensity_smul_zero hf.aestronglyMeasurable hb).comp hparam
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_def] at hi
    have hright := Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hi
    have hleft := (continuous_schattenNormReal hp0).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      (tendsto_abs_orderedMatrixExp_pow H hH)
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hleft hright
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with k hk
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hr : (k : ℝ)⁻¹ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨inv_pos.mpr (by linarith), inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hk1⟩
    have h := schattenNormReal_rpow_abs_orderedMatrixExp_le_exp_hirschman H hH hp hr
    have hco : (((k : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) = (k : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
    rw [hco] at h
    simp only [one_div, inv_inv] at h
    rw [CFC.rpow_eq_pow,
      CFC.rpow_natCast (CFC.abs (orderedMatrixExp H (k : ℂ)⁻¹)) k (CFC.abs_nonneg _)] at h
    exact h
  · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    have hz : matrixExp H.sum = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, schattenNormReal_zero hp0]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.log_schattenNormReal_matrixExp_sum_le_integral_log_orderedMatrixExp
statement:
theorem log_schattenNormReal_matrixExp_sum_le_integral_log_orderedMatrixExp
    (H : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hH : ∀ A ∈ H, A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Real.log (schattenNormReal (matrixExp H.sum) p) ≤
      ∫ t : ℝ, Real.hirschmanDensityZero t *
        Real.log (schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixExp H (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  by_cases hn : Nonempty n
  · let := hn
    have hun : IsUnit (matrixExp H.sum) := by
      let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
      exact NormedSpace.isUnit_exp H.sum
    have hnorm : 0 < schattenNormReal (matrixExp H.sum) p :=
      schattenNormReal_pos _ hp0 hun.ne_zero
    exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hnorm).mpr
      (schattenNormReal_matrixExp_sum_le_exp_integral_log_orderedMatrixExp H hH hp)
  · let : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    have hz (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [hz _, schattenNormReal_zero hp0, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, integral_zero, le_rfl]

name: NLAlib.integrable_continuous_compact_support
statement:
private theorem integrable_continuous_compact_support
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    {f : selfAdjoint M → M} (hf : Continuous f) : Integrable f ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

proof:

  intro T

    (isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart S T.val hS T.property)).comp
