name: NLAlib.upperRowKernel_gram
statement:
private theorem upperRowKernel_gram (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (P B U : M) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    upperRowKernel α P B U*(upperRowKernel α P B U)ᴴ =
      α • ((cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*P)*(U*B*Uᴴ)*
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*P)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hQ : (cfc Real.sqrt B).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  simp only [upperRowKernel,Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,star_trivial,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    hR.eq,hQ.eq,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,smul_smul]
  rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hα]
  congr 1
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg
    (fun X => cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*P*U*X*Uᴴ*Pᴴ*
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B) (cfc_sqrt_mul_self hB)

name: NLAlib.upperRowKernel_defect
statement:
private theorem upperRowKernel_defect
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (P B H : M) (hP : IsUnit P) (hB : B.PosDef) (hH : H.PosDef)
    (U : selfAdjoint M → M) (hU : Continuous U)
    (hidentity : H=α⁻¹ • (P⁻¹*B*P⁻¹ᴴ)-∫ T,U T*B*(U T)ᴴ ∂ν) :
    (1-∫ T,upperRowKernel α P B (U T)*(upperRowKernel α P B (U T))ᴴ ∂ν).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
  let L := R*P
  let f (T : selfAdjoint M) := U T*B*(U T)ᴴ
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hi : Integrable f ν := integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν (by
    dsimp only [f]; fun_prop)
  have he : (∫ T,upperRowKernel α P B (U T)*(upperRowKernel α P B (U T))ᴴ ∂ν) =
      α • (L*(∫ T,f T ∂ν)*Lᴴ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ T,α • (L*f T*Lᴴ) ∂ν := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun T => upperRowKernel_gram α hα.le P B (U T) hB
      _ = _ := by
        rw [integral_smul]
        congr 1
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ M L Lᴴ).integral_comp_comm hi
  have hbase : α • (L*(α⁻¹ • (P⁻¹*B*P⁻¹ᴴ))*Lᴴ)=1 := by
    have hb : R*B*R=1 := by
      rw [← cfc_sqrt_mul_self hB]
      change R*(cfc Real.sqrt B*cfc Real.sqrt B)*R=1
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hB,Matrix.one_mul,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hB]
    have hPstar : IsUnit Pᴴ := by simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hP.star
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul,
      L,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hR.eq,Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv]
    calc
      _ = R*(P*P⁻¹)*B*((Pᴴ)⁻¹*Pᴴ)*R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hP),
          Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hPstar)]
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.one_mul] using hb
  have heq : (1-∫ T,upperRowKernel α P B (U T)*(upperRowKernel α P B (U T))ᴴ ∂ν) =
      α • (L*H*Lᴴ) := by
    rw [he,hidentity,Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,smul_sub,hbase]
  rw [heq]
  apply (posDef_real_smul_iff α hα _).mpr
  exact (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff
    ((isUnit_cfc_invSqrt B hB).mul hP)).mpr hH

name: NLAlib.upperRowKernel_mixed
statement:
private theorem upperRowKernel_mixed
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (S Q B C U V Δ : M) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef) :
    upperRowKernel α S B U*
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*Δ*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C)*
          (upperRowKernel α Qᴴ C Vᴴ)ᴴ =
      α • ((cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S)*(U*Δ*V)*
        (Q*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C))
proof:
:= by
  have hR : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hQ : (cfc Real.sqrt C).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  simp only [upperRowKernel,Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,star_trivial,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,hR.eq,hQ.eq,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,smul_smul]
  rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hα]
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S*U*
        (cfc Real.sqrt B*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B)*Δ*
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C*cfc Real.sqrt C)*V*Q*
        cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hB,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hC]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_solution_unique_upperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_solution_unique_upperHalfPlane
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Z S Q : M)
    (hZ : (imaginaryPart Z : M).PosDef)
    (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef) (hQ : (imaginaryPart Q : M).PosDef)
    (hKS : matrixKTransform ν α S=Z) (hKQ : matrixKTransform ν α Q=Z) : S=Q
proof:
:= by
  let B : M := imaginaryPart S
  let C : M := imaginaryPart Q
  let RB := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
  let RC := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C
  let Y := RB*(S-Q)*RC
  let U (T : selfAdjoint M) := matrixKResolvent S T.val
  let V (T : selfAdjoint M) := matrixKResolvent Q T.val
  let A (T : selfAdjoint M) := upperRowKernel α S B (U T)
  let D (T : selfAdjoint M) := upperRowKernel α Qᴴ C (V T)ᴴ
  let f (T : selfAdjoint M) := U T*(S-Q)*V T
  have hSu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS
  have hQu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hQ
  have hQstar : IsUnit Qᴴ := by simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hQu.star
  have hcU : Continuous U := continuous_kResolvent_upper S hS
  have hcV : Continuous V := continuous_kResolvent_upper Q hQ
  have hcA : Continuous A := by dsimp only [A,upperRowKernel]; fun_prop
  have hcD : Continuous D := by dsimp only [D,upperRowKernel]; fun_prop
  have hiAA : Integrable (fun T => A T*(A T)ᴴ) ν :=
    integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν (hcA.mul hcA.star)
  have hiDD : Integrable (fun T => D T*(D T)ᴴ) ν :=
    integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν (hcD.mul hcD.star)
  have hiAD : Integrable (fun T => A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ) ν :=
    integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν ((hcA.mul continuous_const).mul hcD.star)
  have hif : Integrable f ν :=
    integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν ((hcU.mul continuous_const).mul hcV)
  have hIdS := imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform ν hν α S hS
  rw [hKS] at hIdS
  have hIdQ := imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_dual ν hν α Q hQ
  rw [hKQ] at hIdQ
  have hdefS : (1-∫ T,A T*(A T)ᴴ ∂ν).PosDef :=
    upperRowKernel_defect ν hν α hα S B (imaginaryPart Z) hSu hS hZ U hcU hIdS
  have hdual : (imaginaryPart Z : M) =
      α⁻¹ • ((Qᴴ)⁻¹*C*((Qᴴ)⁻¹)ᴴ)-∫ T,(V T)ᴴ*C*((V T)ᴴ)ᴴ ∂ν := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hIdQ
  have hdefQ : (1-∫ T,D T*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν).PosDef :=
    upperRowKernel_defect ν hν α hα Qᴴ C (imaginaryPart Z) hQstar hQ hZ
      (fun T => (V T)ᴴ) hcV.star hdual
  have hdiff := matrixKTransform_sub_matrixKTransform ν hν α
    (mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν hS)
    (mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν hQ)
  rw [hKS,hKQ,sub_self] at hdiff
  have heq : α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*(S-Q)*Q⁻¹)=∫ T,f T ∂ν := sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff.symm
  have hcross : (∫ T,A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν) =
      α • ((RB*S)*(∫ T,f T ∂ν)*(Q*RC)) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ T,α • ((RB*S)*f T*(Q*RC)) ∂ν := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun T => upperRowKernel_mixed α hα.le S Q B C (U T) (V T) (S-Q) hS hQ
      _ = _ := by
        rw [integral_smul]
        congr 1
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ M (RB*S) (Q*RC)).integral_comp_comm hif
  have hfix : Y=∫ T,A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν := by
    rw [hcross,← heq,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_smul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
    change RB*(S-Q)*RC=(RB*S)*(S⁻¹*(S-Q)*Q⁻¹)*(Q*RC)
    calc
      _ = RB*(S*S⁻¹)*(S-Q)*(Q⁻¹*Q)*RC := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hSu),
          Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hQu)]
        simp
      _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hzero := eq_zero_of_integral_cross_kernel_fixedPoint A D Y hiAA hiDD hiAD hdefS hdefQ hfix
  have hh := congrArg (fun X => cfc Real.sqrt B*X*cfc Real.sqrt C) hzero
  change cfc Real.sqrt B*(RB*(S-Q)*RC)*cfc Real.sqrt C=
    cfc Real.sqrt B*0*cfc Real.sqrt C at hh
  have hcan : cfc Real.sqrt B*(RB*(S-Q)*RC)*cfc Real.sqrt C=S-Q := by
    change cfc Real.sqrt B*(cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*(S-Q)*
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C)*cfc Real.sqrt C=S-Q
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS,Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hQ,Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hcan,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at hh
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hh

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_integral_upper
statement:
private theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_integral_upper
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (S Δ : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*Δ*S⁻¹) -
      ∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val*Δ*matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hU := continuous_kResolvent_upper S hS
  have hi : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => matrixKResolventDeriv S T.val) ν := by
    have hRC := ((ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ M).continuous.comp hU).clm_apply hU
    have hh := hRC.neg.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
    have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
    rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hh
  unfold matrixKTransformDeriv
  rw [_root_.add_apply,_root_.smul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hi Δ]
  simp only [matrixKResolventDeriv,_root_.neg_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply,
    integral_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_upperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_upperHalfPlane
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M)
    (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hK : (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S) : M).PosDef) :
    Function.Injective (matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero (Δ : M) (hΔ : matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S Δ=0) : Δ=0 := by
    let B : M := imaginaryPart S
    let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
    let Y := R*Δ*R
    let U (T : selfAdjoint M) := matrixKResolvent S T.val
    let A (T : selfAdjoint M) := upperRowKernel α S B (U T)
    let D (T : selfAdjoint M) := upperRowKernel α Sᴴ B (U T)ᴴ
    let f (T : selfAdjoint M) := U T*Δ*U T
    have hSu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS
    have hSstar : IsUnit Sᴴ := by simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hSu.star
    have hcU : Continuous U := continuous_kResolvent_upper S hS
    have hcA : Continuous A := by dsimp only [A,upperRowKernel]; fun_prop
    have hcD : Continuous D := by dsimp only [D,upperRowKernel]; fun_prop
    have hiAA : Integrable (fun T => A T*(A T)ᴴ) ν :=
      integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν (hcA.mul hcA.star)
    have hiDD : Integrable (fun T => D T*(D T)ᴴ) ν :=
      integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν (hcD.mul hcD.star)
    have hiAD : Integrable (fun T => A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ) ν :=
      integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν ((hcA.mul continuous_const).mul hcD.star)
    have hif : Integrable f ν :=
      integrable_continuous_compact_support ν hν ((hcU.mul continuous_const).mul hcU)
    have hIdS := imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform ν hν α S hS
    have hIdD := imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_dual ν hν α S hS
    have hdefA : (1-∫ T,A T*(A T)ᴴ ∂ν).PosDef :=
      upperRowKernel_defect ν hν α hα S B (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S))
        hSu hS hK U hcU hIdS
    have hdual : (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S) : M) =
        α⁻¹ • ((Sᴴ)⁻¹*B*((Sᴴ)⁻¹)ᴴ)-∫ T,(U T)ᴴ*B*((U T)ᴴ)ᴴ ∂ν := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hIdD
    have hdefD : (1-∫ T,D T*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν).PosDef :=
      upperRowKernel_defect ν hν α hα Sᴴ B (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S))
        hSstar hS hK (fun T => (U T)ᴴ) hcU.star hdual
    have hDreal : matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ=0 := by
      have he := congrArg (fun L : M →L[ℝ] M => L Δ)
        (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α S)
      exact he.symm.trans hΔ
    have heq : α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*Δ*S⁻¹)=∫ T,f T ∂ν := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      exact (matrixKTransformDeriv_integral_upper ν hν α S Δ hS).symm.trans hDreal
    have hcross : (∫ T,A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν) =
        α • ((R*S)*(∫ T,f T ∂ν)*(S*R)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ T,α • ((R*S)*f T*(S*R)) ∂ν := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          exact ae_of_all _ fun T => upperRowKernel_mixed α hα.le S S B B (U T) (U T) Δ hS hS
        _ = _ := by
          rw [integral_smul]
          congr 1
          exact (ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ M (R*S) (S*R)).integral_comp_comm hif
    have hfix : Y=∫ T,A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν := by
      rw [hcross,← heq,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
      change R*Δ*R=(R*S)*(S⁻¹*Δ*S⁻¹)*(S*R)
      calc
        _ = R*(S*S⁻¹)*Δ*(S⁻¹*S)*R := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hSu),
            Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hSu)]
          simp
        _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hy := eq_zero_of_integral_cross_kernel_fixedPoint A D Y hiAA hiDD hiAD hdefA hdefD hfix
    have hh := congrArg (fun X => cfc Real.sqrt B*X*cfc Real.sqrt B) hy
    change cfc Real.sqrt B*(R*Δ*R)*cfc Real.sqrt B=
      cfc Real.sqrt B*0*cfc Real.sqrt B at hh
    have hcan : cfc Real.sqrt B*(R*Δ*R)*cfc Real.sqrt B=Δ := by
      change cfc Real.sqrt B*(cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*Δ*
        cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B)*cfc Real.sqrt B=Δ
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS,Matrix.one_mul,
        Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS,Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hcan,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  intro X Y hXY
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero (X-Y) (by rw [map_sub,hXY,sub_self]))

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_of_upperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_of_upperHalfPlane
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hKpos : (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S) : M).PosDef)
    (u : ℂ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=u•1) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → M, AnalyticAt ℂ G u ∧ G u=S ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, G z ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (G z)=z•1
proof:
:= by
  have hdomain := mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν hS
  let D := matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S
  have hinj : Function.Injective D :=
    injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα S hS hKpos
  let e : M ≃L[ℂ] M := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective D.toLinearMap
    ⟨hinj,LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (e : M →L[ℂ] M) S := by
    convert! hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdomain using 1
  have hc := contDiffAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdomain
  let Q := hc.localInverse hderiv one_ne_zero
  let G : ℂ → M := fun z => Q (z•1)
  have hQ := hc.to_localInverse hderiv one_ne_zero
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℂ 1 G u := by
    apply ContDiffAt.comp u (g := Q) (f := fun z : ℂ => z•(1 : M))
    · rwa [← hK]
    · exact contDiffAt_id.smul contDiffAt_const
  have hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G u :=
    Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mpr
      ((hG.eventually (by simp)).mono fun _ h => h.differentiableAt one_ne_zero)
  have hG₀ : G u=S := by
    change Q (u•1)=S
    rw [← hK]
    exact hc.localInverse_apply_image hderiv one_ne_zero
  refine ⟨G,hGa,hG₀,?_⟩
  have hcont : Filter.Tendsto G (𝓝 u) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [hG₀] using hGa.continuousAt.tendsto
  have heq := (hc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hderiv one_ne_zero).eventually_right_inverse
  have hZ : Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z•(1 : M))
      (𝓝 u) (𝓝 (matrixKTransform ν α S)) := by
    rw [hK]
    exact (continuous_id.smul continuous_const).continuousAt
  filter_upwards [hcont.eventually ((isOpen_matrixKTransformDomain ν hν).mem_nhds hdomain),
    hZ.eventually heq] with z hz hsolve
  exact ⟨hz,hsolve⟩

name: NLAlib.matrixKInverseIteration_eq_add_transform
statement:
theorem matrixKInverseIteration_eq_add_transform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (U Y : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef) :
    matrixKInverseIteration ν α U Y = Y + α • (matrixKTransform ν α Y⁻¹ - U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransform_inverse_eq ν hν α Y hY hgap]
  simp only [matrixKInverseIteration, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hα, one_smul]
  module

name: NLAlib.inverseIteration_gap_of_le
statement:
private theorem inverseIteration_gap_of_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (Y Z : M)
    (hY : Y.PosDef) (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z) :
    Z.PosDef ∧ ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(hY.isStrictlyPositive.of_le hYZ).posDef, ?_⟩
  intro T hT
  have hle : Y + T.val ≤ Z + T.val := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
  exact ((hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef

name: NLAlib.matrixKInverseIteration_le_of_le
statement:
theorem matrixKInverseIteration_le_of_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (U Y Z : M)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapZ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Z + T.val).PosDef) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z) :
    matrixKInverseIteration ν α U Y ≤ matrixKInverseIteration ν α U Z
proof:
:= by
  have hiY := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν Y hgapY
  have hiZ := integrable_matrixKInverseSandwich ν hν Z hgapZ
  have hI : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Z + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν) ≤
      ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hiZ hiY
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hle : Y + T.val ≤ Z + T.val := by
      simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hYZ T.val
    have hinv : (Z + T.val)⁻¹ ≤ (Y + T.val)⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using
        CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hle
          (hgapY T hT).isStrictlyPositive
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hinv).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hTH.eq] using hp
  exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left
    (sub_le_sub_right (sub_le_sub_left hI (∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν)) U) hα

name: NLAlib.matrixKInverseIteration_le_upper
statement:
theorem matrixKInverseIteration_le_upper
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (U Y : M)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y + T.val).PosDef) :
    matrixKInverseIteration ν α U Y ≤ α • ((∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν) - U)
proof:
:= by
  have hI : 0 ≤ ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val * (Y + T.val)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    have hp := (hgap T hT).inv.posSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
    exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (by simpa only [hTH.eq] using hp)
  exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left
    (sub_le_sub_right (sub_le_self _ hI) U) hα

name: NLAlib.exists_stable_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution_of_strict_subsolution
statement:
theorem exists_stable_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution_of_strict_subsolution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (Y : selfAdjoint M) (hY : Y.val.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y.val + T.val).PosDef)
    (U : M) (hdec : (matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹ - U).PosDef) :
    ∃ Z : selfAdjoint M, (Z.val - Y.val).PosDef ∧
      Z ∈ matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α ∧ matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹ = U
proof:
:= by
  let F := matrixKInverseIteration ν α U
  let B := α • ((∫ T : selfAdjoint M, T.val ∂ν) - U)
  let K := Icc Y.val B
  have hsub : Y.val ≤ F Y.val := by
    have he := matrixKInverseIteration_eq_add_transform ν hν α hα.ne' U Y.val hY hgapY
    have hp : (F Y.val - Y.val).PosDef := by
      rw [show F Y.val = Y.val + α • (matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹ - U) from he]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hdec.smul hα
    exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr hp.posSemidef
  have hYB : Y.val ≤ B := hsub.trans (matrixKInverseIteration_le_upper ν α hα.le U Y.val hgapY)
  have hmap : MapsTo F K K := by
    intro Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hZpos, hgapZ⟩ := inverseIteration_gap_of_le ν Y.val Z hY hgapY hZ.1
    exact ⟨hsub.trans (matrixKInverseIteration_le_of_le ν hν α hα.le U Y.val Z hgapY hgapZ hZ.1),
      matrixKInverseIteration_le_upper ν α hα.le U Z hgapZ⟩
  have hmono : MonotoneOn F K := by
    intro Z hZ W hW hZW
    exact matrixKInverseIteration_le_of_le ν hν α hα.le U Z W
      (inverseIteration_gap_of_le ν Y.val Z hY hgapY hZ.1).2
      (inverseIteration_gap_of_le ν Y.val W hY hgapY hW.1).2 hZW
  have hcont : ContinuousOn F K := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn
        (fun Z : M => Z + α • (matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹ - U)) K := by
      intro Z hZ
      obtain ⟨hZpos, hgapZ⟩ := inverseIteration_gap_of_le ν Y.val Z hY hgapY hZ.1
      have hZZ : Z⁻¹⁻¹ = Z := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
        ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hZpos.isUnit)
      have hdom : Z⁻¹ ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
        ⟨hZpos.inv.isUnit, fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator Z⁻¹ T.val hZpos.inv
          (by simpa only [hZZ] using hgapZ T hT)⟩
      have hi := (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse Z hZpos.isUnit).continuousAt
      have hk := (hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom).continuousAt.comp hi
      change ContinuousAt (fun V : M => matrixKTransform ν α V⁻¹) Z at hk
      have hcA : ContinuousAt (fun V : M => V + α • (matrixKTransform ν α V⁻¹ - U)) Z :=
        continuousAt_id.add ((continuousAt_const (y := α)).smul
          (hk.sub (continuousAt_const (y := U))))
      exact hcA.continuousWithinAt
    apply hc.congr
    intro Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hZpos, hgapZ⟩ := inverseIteration_gap_of_le ν Y.val Z hY hgapY hZ.1
    exact matrixKInverseIteration_eq_add_transform ν hν α hα.ne' U Z hZpos hgapZ
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hfix, _hiterates⟩ := (CStarAlgebra.isCompact_Icc Y.val B).exists_fixedPoint_of_monotoneOn
    hcont hmap hmono (show Y.val ∈ K from ⟨le_rfl, hYB⟩) hsub
  obtain ⟨hZpos, hgapZ⟩ := inverseIteration_gap_of_le ν Y.val Z hY hgapY hZ.1
  have he := matrixKInverseIteration_eq_add_transform ν hν α hα.ne' U Z hZpos hgapZ
  have hzero : α • (matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹ - U) = 0 := by
    change matrixKInverseIteration ν α U Z = Z at hfix
    rw [he] at hfix
    exact add_left_cancel (a := Z) (by simpa only [add_zero] using hfix)
  have hKZ : matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹ = U :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((smul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hα.ne')
  let Zsa : selfAdjoint M := ⟨Z, hZpos.isHermitian⟩
  have hsec : (matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹ - matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹).PosDef := by
    rw [hKZ]
    exact hdec
  obtain ⟨hstrict, hstable⟩ :=
    posDef_sub_and_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain_of_ordered_transform_decrease ν hν α hα
      Y Zsa hY hgapY hZ.1 hsec
  exact ⟨Zsa, hstrict, hstable, hKZ⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    (a : n → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ b : ℝ, (∀ i, a i ≤ b) → ∀ t r : ℝ, R < r → |t| < r →
        (∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (∮ z in C(0, r), Complex.exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)))) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hspec⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal a ha A
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, ?_⟩
  intro b hab t r hRr htr
  apply sum_integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ))) hab (hR.trans hRr) hRr htr
    (fun i => (hbranch i).1) (fun i => (hbranch i).2)
  intro z hz
  have hzr : R < ‖z‖ := by
    have heq : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    simpa only [heq] using hRr
  exact (trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_injective_mem_spectrum _ _
    (hspec z hzr).2 (hspec z hzr).1).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_fixed_circle
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_fixed_circle
    (a : n → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ b : ℝ, (∀ i, a i ≤ b) → ∀ t r : ℝ, R < r →
        (∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (∮ z in C(0, r), Complex.exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)))) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hformula⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms a ha A
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, ?_⟩
  intro b hab t r hRr
  let u : ℝ := max r |t| + 1
  have hru : r < u := by dsimp [u]; linarith [le_max_left r |t|]
  have htu : |t| < u := by dsimp [u]; linarith [le_max_right r |t|]
  have hRu : R < u := hRr.trans hru
  have hrad (i : n) (s : ℝ) :
      (∮ z in C(0, r), Complex.exp (branch i z + s * z)) =
        ∮ z in C(0, u), Complex.exp (branch i z + s * z) := by
    apply circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
      (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn
        ((hbranch i).1.add (differentiableOn_id.const_mul (s : ℂ))))
      (hR.trans hRr) (hR.trans hRu) hRr hRu
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
        ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (∮ z in C(0, u), Complex.exp (branch i z + s * z))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      dsimp only
      rw [hrad i s]
    _ = _ := hformula b hab t u hRu htu

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    (a : n → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, a i ∈ Set.Icc l u) → ∀ r : ℝ, R < r → ∀ t : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) volume l u ∧
        (∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)))) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * a i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hformula⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_fixed_circle a ha A
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, ?_⟩
  intro l u hlu hau r hRr t
  have hcont (i : n) : ContinuousOn (branch i) (sphere 0 r) := by
    apply (hbranch i).1.continuousOn.mono
    intro z hz
    have heq : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    change R < ‖z‖
    rwa [heq]
  refine ⟨intervalIntegrable_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity hlu
    (hR.trans hRr).le hcont, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_sum_integral hlu
    (fun i => (hau i).1) (fun i => (hau i).2) (hR.trans hRr).le hcont]
  exact hformula u (fun i => (hau i).2) t r hRr

name: NLAlib.range_half_involution_eq_eigenspace
statement:
theorem range_half_involution_eq_eigenspace {S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : S^2=1)
    (a : ℂ) (ha : a^2=1) :
    LinearMap.range ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1+a • S)).toLin' = Module.End.eigenspace S.toLin' a
proof:
:= by
  have hs (v : n → ℂ) : S *ᵥ (S *ᵥ v)=v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_two, hS, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have haa : a*a=1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using ha
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    apply Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
    change S *ᵥ (((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1+a • S)) *ᵥ w) =
      a • (((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1+a • S)) *ᵥ w)
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_add, hs]
    rw [smul_comm a ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹)]
    congr 1
    simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, haa, one_smul]
    abel
  · intro hv
    have he : S *ᵥ v = a • v := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    change ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1+a • S)) *ᵥ v = v
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, he,
      smul_smul, haa, one_smul]
    rw [← two_smul ℂ v, smul_smul]
    norm_num

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.eigenspace_eq_spectralSubspace
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Commute A.toLin' S.toLin' := by
    change A.toLin' * S.toLin' = S.toLin' * A.toLin'
    simpa only [Matrix.toLin'_mul, Module.End.mul_eq_comp] using
      congrArg Matrix.toLin' hS.2.1.eq
  have hss : S.toLin'^2=1 := by
    calc
      _ = (S^2).toLin' := (Matrix.toLin'_pow S 2).symm
      _ = (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).toLin' := congrArg Matrix.toLin' hS.1
      _ = 1 := by rw [Matrix.toLin'_one]; rfl
  apply Module.End.eigenspace_eq_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_of_stable_involution
    A.toLin' S.toLin' hc hss _ a ha
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := hz.exists_hasEigenvector
  apply hS.2.2 z (Matrix.mem_spectrum_of_mulVec_eq_smul hv0 _)
  have h := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv
  change S *ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = z • v at h
  rwa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h

name: NLAlib.matrixSign_spectral_projectors
proof:
:= matrixSign A
    let P := (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1+S)
    let Q := (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1-S)
    IsMatrixSign A S ∧ P*P=P ∧ Q*Q=Q ∧ P*Q=0 ∧ Q*P=0 ∧ P+Q=1 ∧
      LinearMap.range P.toLin' = matrixSpectralSubspace A {z | 0 < z.re} ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toLin' = matrixSpectralSubspace A {z | z.re < 0} := by
  dsimp
  have hs := isMatrixSign_matrixSign hA
  obtain ⟨hp, hq, hpq, hqp, hsum⟩ := hs.projectors
  refine ⟨hs, hp, hq, hpq, hqp, hsum, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using (range_half_involution_eq_eigenspace hs.1 1 (by norm_num)).trans
      (hs.eigenspace_eq_spectralSubspace 1 (by norm_num))
  · have h := (range_half_involution_eq_eigenspace hs.1 (-1) (by norm_num)).trans
      (hs.eigenspace_eq_spectralSubspace (-1) (by norm_num))
    simpa only [neg_one_smul, add_neg_cancel_right, ← sub_eq_add_neg,
      neg_one_mul, Complex.neg_re, neg_pos] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenbasis_of_injective_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_eigenbasis_of_injective_mem_spectrum
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ) (hev : Function.Injective ev)
    (hmem : ∀ i, ev i ∈ spectrum ℂ M) :
    ∃ b : Module.Basis n ℂ (n → ℂ), ∀ i, M *ᵥ b i = ev i • b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heig : ∀ i, Module.End.HasEigenvalue M.toLin' (ev i) := by
    intro i
    apply Module.End.HasEigenvalue.of_mem_spectrum
    simpa using hmem i
  choose v hv using fun i => (heig i).exists_hasEigenvector
  have hli := Module.End.eigenvectors_linearIndependent' M.toLin' ev hev v hv
  let b := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' v hli
    (Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card ℂ).symm
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro i
  change M.toLin' (b i) = ev i • b i
  simpa only [b, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'] using
    (hv i).apply_eq_smul

name: NLAlib.spectrum_eq_range_of_injective_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem spectrum_eq_range_of_injective_mem_spectrum
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ) (hev : Function.Injective ev)
    (hmem : ∀ i, ev i ∈ spectrum ℂ M) : spectrum ℂ M = Set.range ev
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_eigenbasis_of_injective_mem_spectrum M ev hev hmem
  have hD : LinearMap.toMatrix b b M.toLin' = Matrix.diagonal ev := by
    ext i j
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply, hb]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hij]
  rw [← Matrix.spectrum_toLin' M, ← LinearMap.spectrum_toMatrix M.toLin' b,
    hD, spectrum_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_eigenbasis
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ) (b : Module.Basis n ℂ (n → ℂ))
    (hb : ∀ i, M *ᵥ b i = ev i • b i) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixExp M) = ∑ i, Complex.exp (ev i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Pi.basisFun ℂ n
  let U : (Matrix n n ℂ)ˣ :=
    ⟨e.toMatrix b, b.toMatrix e, e.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip b,
      b.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip e⟩
  have hD : LinearMap.toMatrix b b M.toLin' = Matrix.diagonal ev := by
    ext i j
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply, hb]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hij]
  have hM : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal ev * (↑(U⁻¹) : Matrix n n ℂ) = M := by
    change e.toMatrix b * Matrix.diagonal ev * b.toMatrix e = M
    rw [← hD, basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix]
    simp [e]
  rw [← hM, matrixExp, Matrix.exp_units_conj, Matrix.trace_units_conj,
    Matrix.exp_diagonal, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp [← Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]

name: NLAlib.trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_injective_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_injective_mem_spectrum
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ) (hev : Function.Injective ev)
    (hmem : ∀ i, ev i ∈ spectrum ℂ M) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixExp M) = ∑ i, Complex.exp (ev i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_eigenbasis_of_injective_mem_spectrum M ev hev hmem
  exact trace_matrixExp_eq_sum_exp_of_eigenbasis M ev b hb

name: NLAlib.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich
    (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (d : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) :
    ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧
      ((Function.support s).ncard : ℝ) ≤ d * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤
        ((d + 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt d) / (d + 1 - 2 * Real.sqrt d)) •
          (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : ℕ := Fintype.card n
  have hN : 0 < N := Fintype.card_pos
  let k : ℕ := Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ))
  obtain ⟨r, q, hbudget, hratio⟩ := exists_nat_budget_ratio_tendsto N hN d hd
  let beta : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    rankOneSparsificationFactor ((q m : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)))
  have hbeta : Tendsto beta atTop (nhds (rankOneSparsificationFactor d)) :=
    (continuousAt_rankOneSparsificationFactor hd).tendsto.comp hratio
  have hseq : ∀ m, ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) := by
    intro m
    have hr : 0 < r m := (hbudget m).1
    have : Nonempty (Fin (r m)) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
    let V : I × Fin (r m) → n × Fin (r m) → ℝ := frameBlockVector v (r m)
    have hV : ∑ p, Matrix.vecMulVec (V p) (V p) = 1 :=
      sum_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_one v (r m) hframe
    have hq : Fintype.card (n × Fin (r m)) < q m := by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] using (hbudget m).2.2.1
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hcard, hlow, hupp⟩ :=
      RankOneBarrier.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_card_lt_budget
        (I := I × Fin (r m)) (n := n × Fin (r m)) V hV (q m) hq
    have hcard' : (Function.support w).ncard < r m * (k + 1) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt hcard (hbudget m).2.2.2
    have hupp' :
        (∑ p, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v (r m) p)
          (frameBlockVector v (r m) p)) ≤
          beta m • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin (r m)) (n × Fin (r m)) ℝ) := by
      simpa only [V, beta, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_mul] using hupp
    exact exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_block_sum v (r m) hr k
      (beta m) w hw hcard' hlow hupp'
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcard, hlow, hupp⟩ :=
    exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_tendsto
      v k beta (rankOneSparsificationFactor d) hbeta hseq
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_, hlow, ?_⟩
  · have hcard' : ((Function.support s).ncard : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcard
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ d * (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    exact hcard'.trans (Nat.floor_le hnonneg)
  · exact hupp

name: NLAlib.sandwichBoundary_imaginaryPart
statement:
private theorem sandwichBoundary_imaginaryPart (U T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (hu : IsUnit (U+T)) :
    (imaginaryPart (T*(U+T)⁻¹*T) : M)=
      ((U+T)⁻¹*T)ᴴ*(-(imaginaryPart U : M))*((U+T)⁻¹*T)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : (U+T)*(-(U+T)⁻¹)= -1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  have hi := Matrix.imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one hmul
  have hIA : (imaginaryPart (U+T) : M)=(imaginaryPart U : M) := by
    rw [map_add,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,add_zero]
  have hInv : (imaginaryPart (U+T)⁻¹ : M)=
      ((U+T)⁻¹)ᴴ*(-(imaginaryPart U : M))*(U+T)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [map_neg,NegMemClass.coe_neg,Matrix.conjTranspose_neg,Matrix.mul_neg,
      Matrix.neg_mul,neg_neg,hIA] using congrArg Neg.neg hi
  have hs : (imaginaryPart (T*(U+T)⁻¹*T) : M)=
      T*(imaginaryPart (U+T)⁻¹ : M)*T := by
    simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      hT.eq,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul]
    congr 1
    noncomm_ring
  rw [hs,hInv]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_add_of_bounded_inverse_sandwich_boundary
statement:
theorem isUnit_add_of_bounded_inverse_sandwich_boundary
    (Y T : M) (hY : IsUnit Y) (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (U : ℝ → M) (δ C B : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) (hC : 0≤C) (hB : 0≤B)
    (hboundary : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      IsUnit (U y+T) ∧ (δ*y)•(1 : M)≤ -(imaginaryPart (U y) : M) ∧
      ‖U y-Y‖≤C*y ∧ ‖normalizedTrace (T*(U y+T)⁻¹*T)‖≤B) :
    IsUnit (Y+T)
proof:
:= by
  let E : ℝ → M := fun y => (U y-Y)*((U y+T)⁻¹*T)
  let D : ℝ := C^2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*B/δ
  have hD : 0≤D := by dsimp only [D]; positivity
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ‖E y‖^2≤D*y := by
    filter_upwards [hboundary,self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hyp
    have hypos : 0<y := hyp
    let R := (U y+T)⁻¹*T
    let A := T*(U y+T)⁻¹*T
    have hGram : (Rᴴ*R).PosSemidef := Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self R
    have hGramScale : ((δ*y)•(Rᴴ*R)).PosSemidef := hGram.smul (mul_nonneg hδ.le hypos.le)
    have hle : (δ*y)•(Rᴴ*R)≤(imaginaryPart A : M) := by
      apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
      have hh := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hy.2.1).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same R
      rw [sandwichBoundary_imaginaryPart (U y) T hT hy.1]
      convert! hh using 1;
        simp only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,
          Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rfl
    have hApos : (imaginaryPart A : M).PosSemidef :=
      (hGramScale.nonneg.trans hle).posSemidef
    have hnorm : δ*y*‖R‖^2≤(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*B := by
      calc
        _ = ‖(δ*y)•(Rᴴ*R)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hδ.le hypos.le),
            ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self]
          ring
        _ ≤ ‖(imaginaryPart A : M)‖ :=
          CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le hGramScale.nonneg hle
        _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(normalizedTrace A).im :=
          Matrix.norm_imaginaryPart_le_card_mul_im_normalizedTrace A hApos
        _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*‖normalizedTrace A‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Complex.im_le_norm _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2.2.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    have he : ‖E y‖≤C*y*‖R‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy.2.2.1 (norm_nonneg R))
    have he2 : ‖E y‖^2≤C^2*y^2*‖R‖^2 := by
      convert! (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr he using 1; ring
    have hdelta : δ*‖E y‖^2≤C^2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*B*y := by
      calc
        _ ≤ δ*(C^2*y^2*‖R‖^2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he2 hδ.le
        _ = C^2*y*(δ*y*‖R‖^2) := by ring
        _ ≤ C^2*y*((Fintype.card n : ℝ)*B) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg C) hypos.le)
        _ = _ := by ring
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr (by nlinarith only [hdelta])
  have hEzero : Tendsto E (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    have ht : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (D*y)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero,Real.sqrt_zero,Function.comp_def,id_eq] using
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto (D*0)).comp
          (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds))
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun y => norm_nonneg (E y)) ?_ ht
    filter_upwards [hsmall,self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hyp
    exact (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hD hyp.le)).mpr hy
  have hUnitNhds : ∀ᶠ A : M in 𝓝 Y, IsUnit A := Units.isOpen.mem_nhds hY
  have hYlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => Y+E y) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 Y) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add hEzero
  have hUnits : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, IsUnit (Y+E y) := hYlim.eventually hUnitNhds
  have heq : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      (Y+T)*(1-(U y+T)⁻¹*T)=Y+E y := by
    filter_upwards [hboundary] with y hy
    have hh := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (U y+T) ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hy.1)
    calc
      _ = Y+(U y-Y)*((U y+T)⁻¹*T)+(T-((U y+T)*(U y+T)⁻¹)*T) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = Y+E y := by rw [hh,Matrix.one_mul,sub_self,add_zero]
  obtain ⟨y,hyunit,hyeq⟩ := (hUnits.and heq).exists
  have hProd : IsUnit ((Y+T)*(1-(U y+T)⁻¹*T)) := by rwa [hyeq]
  have hdet : IsUnit ((Y+T).det*(1-(U y+T)⁻¹*T).det) := by
    rw [← Matrix.det_mul]
    exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hProd
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hdet)

name: NLAlib.posDef_add_of_bounded_inverse_sandwich_boundary
statement:
theorem posDef_add_of_bounded_inverse_sandwich_boundary
    (Y T : M) (hY : IsUnit Y) (hT : T.IsHermitian) (hPSD : (Y+T).PosSemidef)
    (U : ℝ → M) (δ C B : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) (hC : 0≤C) (hB : 0≤B)
    (hboundary : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      IsUnit (U y+T) ∧ (δ*y)•(1 : M)≤ -(imaginaryPart (U y) : M) ∧
      ‖U y-Y‖≤C*y ∧ ‖normalizedTrace (T*(U y+T)⁻¹*T)‖≤B) :
    (Y+T).PosDef
proof:
:=
  hPSD.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr (isUnit_add_of_bounded_inverse_sandwich_boundary
    Y T hY hT U δ C B hδ hC hB hboundary)

name: NLAlib.inverseImaginary_integrable_continuous
statement:
private theorem inverseImaginary_integrable_continuous
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    {f : selfAdjoint M → M} (hf : Continuous f) : Integrable f ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.inverseImaginary_unit
statement:

:= by
