name: NLAlib.inverseImaginary_sandwich
statement:
private theorem inverseImaginary_sandwich (X T : M)
    (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    (imaginaryPart (T*(X-T)⁻¹*T) : M)=
      -(T*((X-T)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T)⁻¹*T)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := inverseImaginary_unit X T hX hT
  have hm : (X-T)*(-(X-T)⁻¹)= -1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  have hi := Matrix.imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one hm
  have him : (imaginaryPart (X-T) : M)=(imaginaryPart X : M) := by
    rw [map_sub,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,sub_zero]
  simp only [map_neg,NegMemClass.coe_neg,Matrix.conjTranspose_neg,
    Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.mul_neg,neg_neg,him] at hi
  have hs : (imaginaryPart (T*(X-T)⁻¹*T) : M)=
      T*(imaginaryPart ((X-T)⁻¹) : M)*T := by
    simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul]
    congr 1
    noncomm_ring
  have hIm : (imaginaryPart ((X-T)⁻¹) : M)=
      -(((X-T)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T)⁻¹) := neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp hi
  rw [hs,hIm]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (Z X : M) (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) :
    (imaginaryPart (matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X) : M)=
      α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)+
      α•(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,
        T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hL (Y : M) : L Y=(imaginaryPart Y : M) := rfl
  let f (T : selfAdjoint M) := T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val
  have hiT : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val) ν :=
    inverseImaginary_integrable_continuous ν hν continuous_subtype_val
  have hif : Integrable f ν := inverseImaginary_integrable_continuous ν hν
    ((continuous_subtype_val.mul (inverseImaginary_continuous_resolvent X hX)).mul
      continuous_subtype_val)
  have hmean : L (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)=0 := by
    rw [← L.integral_comp_comm hiT]
    have hz (T : selfAdjoint M) : L T.val=0 := by
      rw [hL]
      have hh : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
      simp only [hh.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
    simp_rw [hz]
    exact integral_zero _ _
  have hIp : L (∫ T,f T ∂ν)=
      -(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,
        T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν) := by
    rw [← L.integral_comp_comm hif]
    have hp (T : selfAdjoint M) : L (f T)=
        -(T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val) :=
      inverseImaginary_sandwich X T.val hX T.property
    simp_rw [hp]
    rw [integral_neg]
  change L (α•(Z-(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-(∫ T,f T ∂ν)))=_
  rw [map_smul,map_sub,map_sub,hmean,hIp,sub_zero,sub_neg_eq_add,smul_add,hL]

name: NLAlib.norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (Z X : M) (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef)
    (R q : ℝ) (hR : 0≤R) (hq : 0≤q)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hres : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖≤q) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart (matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X) : M)‖≤
      α*‖(imaginaryPart Z : M)‖+α*(R^2*q^2*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν,
      ‖T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val‖≤
        R^2*q^2*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖ := by
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTN : ‖T.val‖≤R := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
    have hRN := hres T hT
    have hRS : ‖((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ‖≤q := by
      simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,norm_star] using hRN
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)‖*‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ := by
        gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ‖*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖*‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ := by
        gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T.val‖*‖((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ‖*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖*‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ := by
        gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ R*q*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖*q*R := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hI : ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,
      T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖≤
        R^2*q^2*‖(imaginaryPart X : M)‖ := by
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt
  rw [imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap ν hν α Z X hX]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)‖+‖α•(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,
        T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = α*‖(imaginaryPart Z : M)‖+α*‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,
        T.val*((X-T.val)⁻¹)ᴴ*(imaginaryPart X : M)*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα]
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hα)

name: NLAlib.posDef_ridgeGram
statement:
theorem posDef_ridgeGram (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (ridgeGram A ρ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (ρ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hρ
  have h := hi.add_posSemidef (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
  rw [add_comm] at h
  simpa only [ridgeGram, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    h

name: NLAlib.ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply
statement:
theorem ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (i : m) :
    ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i = ridgeKernel A ρ i i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ridgeLeverageScore, ridgeKernel, quadForm, star_trivial, dotProduct,
    Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_trace
statement:
theorem ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_trace (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ = (ridgeKernel A ρ).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ridgeEffectiveDimension, ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply,
    Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_ridgeKernel
statement:
theorem posSemidef_ridgeKernel (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (ridgeKernel A ρ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ridgeKernel, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ).inv.posSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same A

name: NLAlib.ridgeLeverageScore_nonneg
statement:
theorem ridgeLeverageScore_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (i : m) :
    0 ≤ ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i
proof:
:=
  (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ).inv.posSemidef.quadForm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.ridgeLeverageScore_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem ridgeLeverageScore_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (i : m) :
    ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i = 0 ↔ A i = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    by_contra hrow
    have hp := (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ).inv.quadForm_pos hrow
    change 0 < ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i at hp
    rw [hzero] at hp
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp
  · intro hrow
    simp only [ridgeLeverageScore, hrow, quadForm_zero_right]

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_nonneg
statement:
theorem ridgeEffectiveDimension_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    0 ≤ ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => ridgeLeverageScore_nonneg A hρ i

name: NLAlib.ridgeGram_mono
statement:
theorem ridgeGram_mono (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ μ : ℝ} (hρμ : ρ ≤ μ) :
    ridgeGram A ρ ≤ ridgeGram A μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  have heq : ridgeGram A μ - ridgeGram A ρ = (μ - ρ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    simp only [ridgeGram, sub_smul]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  exact Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul (sub_nonneg.mpr hρμ)

name: NLAlib.ridgeKernel_antitone
statement:
theorem ridgeKernel_antitone (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ μ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρμ : ρ ≤ μ) : ridgeKernel A μ ≤ ridgeKernel A ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hi := inv_le_inv_of_posDef (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ) (ridgeGram_mono A hρμ)
  have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hi).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same A
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  simpa only [ridgeKernel, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul] using hp

name: NLAlib.ridgeLeverageScore_antitone
proof:
:= by
  rw [ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply, ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply]
  have hd : 0 ≤ (ridgeKernel A ρ - ridgeKernel A μ) i i :=
    (Matrix.le_iff.mp (ridgeKernel_antitone A hρ hρμ)).diag_nonneg
  simpa only [Matrix.sub_apply, sub_nonneg] using hd

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_antitone
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ridgeLeverageScore_antitone A hρ hρμ i

name: NLAlib.ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv
statement:
theorem ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeKernel A ρ = 1 - ρ • (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (posDef_ridgeGram A hρ).isUnit
  have hr := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (posDef_ridgeGram Aᵀ hρ).isUnit
  have hcomm : ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ * A = A * ridgeGram A ρ := by
    simp only [ridgeGram, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add,
      Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hprod : ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ * ridgeKernel A ρ = A * Aᵀ := by
    calc
      ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ * ridgeKernel A ρ =
          (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ * A) * (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ * Aᵀ := by
        simp only [ridgeKernel, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (A * ridgeGram A ρ) * (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ * Aᵀ := by rw [hcomm]
      _ = A * Aᵀ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc A, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hc, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hK : ridgeKernel A ρ = (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹ * (A * Aᵀ) := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun X => (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹ * X) hprod
    simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hr, Matrix.one_mul] using hh
  have hrow : A * Aᵀ = ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ - ρ • 1 := by
    simp only [ridgeGram, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    abel
  rw [hK, hrow, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hr,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.ridgeKernel_le_one
statement:
theorem ridgeKernel_le_one [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeKernel A ρ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv A hρ]
  have heq : (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) - (1 - ρ • (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹) =
      ρ • (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹ := by abel
  rw [heq]
  exact (posDef_ridgeGram Aᵀ hρ).inv.posSemidef.smul hρ.le

name: NLAlib.ridgeLeverageScore_le_one
statement:
theorem ridgeLeverageScore_le_one (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (i : m) : ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply]
  have hd : 0 ≤ (1 - ridgeKernel A ρ) i i :=
    (Matrix.le_iff.mp (ridgeKernel_le_one A hρ)).diag_nonneg
  simpa only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_true, sub_nonneg] using hd

name: NLAlib.isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (H : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) :
    IsUnit (aeval (upperBlockTwo A H B) Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_upperBlockTwo]
  exact Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨hA, hB⟩

name: NLAlib.isUnit_aeval_upperBlockThree
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_upperBlockThree (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (H : Matrix n o 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hC : IsUnit (aeval C Q)) :
    IsUnit (aeval (upperBlockThree A G B H C) Q)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo Q _ _ _ (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo Q A B G hA hB) hC

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (H : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) :
    rationalMatrixEval P Q (upperBlockTwo A H B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (rationalMatrixEval P Q A) (rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H)
        0 (rationalMatrixEval P Q B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rationalMatrixEval
  rw [aeval_upperBlockTwo, aeval_upperBlockTwo,
    Matrix.inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff _ _ _ ⟨fun _ => hB, fun _ => hA⟩,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
  congr 1
  simp [rationalBlockDifference, rationalMatrixEval, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (H : Matrix n o 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hC : IsUnit (aeval C Q)) :
    rationalMatrixEval P Q (upperBlockThree A G B H C) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (rationalMatrixEval P Q A) (rationalBlockDifference P Q A B G)
          0 (rationalMatrixEval P Q B))
        (Matrix.fromRows (rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C G H)
          (rationalBlockDifference P Q B C H)) 0 (rationalMatrixEval P Q C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperBlockThree, rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q _ _ _
    (isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo Q A B G hA hB) hC,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q A B G hA hB]
  congr 1
  unfold rationalBlockDifference
  rw [polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo, polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q A B G hA hB,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add]
  have hsub (D₁ D₂ : Matrix m o 𝕜) (E₁ E₂ : Matrix n o 𝕜) :
      Matrix.fromRows D₁ E₁ - Matrix.fromRows D₂ E₂ =
        Matrix.fromRows (D₁ - D₂) (E₁ - E₂) := by
    ext (i | i) j <;> simp
  rw [hsub, Matrix.fromRows_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [rationalSecondBlockDifference, sub_sub]

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixEval_mul_eq_mul_rationalMatrixEval
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixEval_mul_eq_mul_rationalMatrixEval (P Q : 𝕜[X])
    {A : Matrix m m 𝕜} {B : Matrix n n 𝕜} {S : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (h : A * S = S * B) (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) :
    rationalMatrixEval P Q A * S = S * rationalMatrixEval P Q B
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq h Q
  have hP := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq h P
  have hAd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA
  have hBd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB
  have hi : (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * S = S * (aeval B Q)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      _ = (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * S * (aeval B Q) * (aeval B Q)⁻¹ := by
        simp [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hBd]
      _ = (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * (aeval A Q * S) * (aeval B Q)⁻¹ := by rw [hQ]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = S * (aeval B Q)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hAd, Matrix.one_mul]
  simp only [rationalMatrixEval, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hi, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hP, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_sq_mul_pow_le_even_moments
statement:
theorem re_trace_sq_mul_pow_le_even_moments
    (H A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : Even p) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) :
    (H ^ 2 * A ^ (p - 2)).trace.re ≤
      (A ^ p).trace.re ^ (1 - 2 / (p : ℝ)) *
        (H ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases heq : p = 2
  · subst p
    simp
  have hpgt : (2 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by linarith
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < p - 2 := by linarith
  have hsub : ((p - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) - 2 := by norm_cast
  have hpq : ((p : ℝ) / 2).HolderConjugate ((p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 2)) := by
    apply Real.holderConjugate_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · linarith
    · field_simp
      ring
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ := star hH.eigenvectorUnitary * hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  let w (z : ι × ι) := norm ((W : Matrix ι ι ℂ) z.1 z.2) ^ 2
  let f (z : ι × ι) := |hH.eigenvalues z.1| ^ 2
  let g (z : ι × ι) := |hA.eigenvalues z.2| ^ (p - 2)
  have hpowH (i : ι) : (|hH.eigenvalues i| ^ 2) ^ ((p : ℝ) / 2) =
      hH.eigenvalues i ^ p := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg _)]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have he : (2 : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) / 2) = p := by ring
    rw [he, Real.rpow_natCast, hp.pow_abs]
  have hpowA (j : ι) : (|hA.eigenvalues j| ^ (p - 2)) ^
      ((p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 2)) = hA.eigenvalues j ^ p := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg _), hsub]
    have he : ((p : ℝ) - 2) * ((p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 2)) = p := by field_simp
    rw [he, Real.rpow_natCast, hp.pow_abs]
  have hrow (i : ι) : ∑ j, w (i,j) = 1 := sum_norm_sq_unitary_row W i
  have hcol (j : ι) : ∑ i, w (i,j) = 1 := sum_norm_sq_unitary_col W j
  have hS : (∑ z : ι × ι, w z * f z ^ ((p : ℝ) / 2)) = (H ^ p).trace.re := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow H hH]
    simp only [f, hpowH]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, one_mul]
  have hT : (∑ z : ι × ι, w z * g z ^ ((p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 2))) =
      (A ^ p).trace.re := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm, re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow A hA]
    simp only [g, hpowA]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hcol, one_mul]
  have h := sum_mul_mul_le_rpow_sum_mul_rpow Finset.univ w f g hpq
    (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (fun _ _ => pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
  have hmEven : Even (p - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hp
    have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
    exact ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have hleft : (∑ z : ι × ι, w z * f z * g z) =
      (H ^ 2 * A ^ (p - 2)).trace.re := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap H A hH hA]
    simp only [w, f, g, Even.pow_abs even_two, hmEven.pow_abs, W]
  rw [hleft, hS, hT] at h
  have he1 : 1 / ((p : ℝ) / 2) = 2 / (p : ℝ) := by field_simp
  have he2 : 1 / ((p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 2)) = 1 - 2 / (p : ℝ) := by field_simp
  simpa only [he1, he2, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.relativeEntropy_complex
statement:
theorem relativeEntropy_complex {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (A H : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    relativeEntropy A H = (Matrix.trace (A * (matrixLog A - matrixLog H) - (A - H))).re
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_smul_eq_sum_of_diagonalization
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_smul_eq_sum_of_diagonalization
    (A H U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (a b : ι → ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hA : Uᴴ * A * U = diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)))
    (hH : Uᴴ * H * U = diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) (t : ℝ) :
    traceExp (A + t • H) = ∑ i, Real.exp (a i + t * b i)
proof:
:= by
  let V : unitary (Matrix ι ι ℂ) :=
    ⟨Uᴴ, by simpa only [Unitary.mem_iff, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
      using And.intro hU.mul_conjTranspose_self hU.conjTranspose_mul_self⟩
  have hconj : (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * (A + t • H) *
      (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)ᴴ = diagonal (fun i => ((a i + t * b i : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    change Uᴴ * (A + t • H) * Uᴴᴴ = _
    rw [conjTranspose_conjTranspose, mul_add, add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.smul_mul, hA, hH]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, Complex.ofReal_add,
      Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.real_smul]
  rw [← traceExp_unitary_conj V, hconj, traceExp_diagonal_real]

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_commute
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_commute
    (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hAH : Commute A H) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
      (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, a, b, hU, hUA, hUH⟩ :=
    exists_unitary_congruence_diagonal_of_commute hA hH hAH
  have hb (i : ι) : b i ∈ Icc (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H) := by
    have hi := mem_real_spectrum_of_orthonormal_congruence_diagonal H U b hU hUH i
    have hfin : (spectrum ℝ H).Finite := by
      rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
      exact finite_range _
    exact ⟨csInf_le hfin.bddBelow hi, le_csSup hfin.bddAbove hi⟩
  refine ⟨exponentialAtomicMeasure a b, ?_⟩
  have hr := isCompactExpRepresentation_exponentialAtomicMeasure a b hb
  convert hr using 1
  funext t
  exact traceExp_add_smul_eq_sum_of_diagonalization A H U a b hU hUA hUH t

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_tendsto
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    (Aₙ Hₙ : I → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hA : Filter.Tendsto Aₙ l (𝓝 A)) (hH : Filter.Tendsto Hₙ l (𝓝 H))
    (hrep : ∀ᶠ k in l, ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
      (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (Aₙ k + t • Hₙ k)) a b) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
      (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) a b
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_of_tendsto a b _ _ hrep
  intro t
  exact continuous_traceExp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (hA.add (Filter.Tendsto.smul tendsto_const_nhds hH))

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_adiScalarProduct
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_adiScalarProduct {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (α β : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hβ : ∀ i z, z ∈ spectrum ℂ A → z ≠ β i) (j : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (adiScalarProduct α β j) (spectrum ℂ A)
proof:
:= by
  unfold adiScalarProduct
  apply continuousOn_finsetProd
  intro i _
  exact (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.div
    (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn (fun z hz => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hβ i z hz))

name: NLAlib.cfc_shifted_ratio
statement:
private theorem cfc_shifted_ratio {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (α β : ℂ)
    (hβ : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, z ≠ β) :
    cfc (fun z => (z - α) / (z - β)) A = (A - α • 1) * (A - β • 1)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  have hcalc := cfc_map_div (fun z : ℂ => z - α) (fun z => z - β) A
    (fun z hz => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hβ z hz))
  have ha : cfc (fun z : ℂ => z - α) A = A - α • 1 := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun z : ℂ => z) (fun _ => α) A, cfc_id' ℂ A, cfc_const α A]
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have hb : cfc (fun z : ℂ => z - β) A = A - β • 1 := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun z : ℂ => z) (fun _ => β) A, cfc_id' ℂ A, cfc_const β A]
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [ha, hb, ← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] at hcalc
  exact hcalc

name: NLAlib.sylvesterADILeft_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem sylvesterADILeft_eq_cfc {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (α β : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hβ : ∀ i z, z ∈ spectrum ℂ A → z ≠ β i) (j : ℕ) :
    sylvesterADILeft A α β j = cfc (adiScalarProduct α β j) A
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    change 1 = cfc (fun _ : ℂ => 1) A
    rw [cfc_const_one ℂ A]
  | succ j hj =>
    have hscalar : adiScalarProduct α β (j + 1) =
        fun z => ((z - α j) / (z - β j)) * adiScalarProduct α β j z := by
      funext z
      change (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (z - α i) / (z - β i)) = _
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, mul_comm]
      rfl
    rw [sylvesterADILeft, hj, hscalar, cfc_mul
      (fun z : ℂ => (z - α j) / (z - β j)) (adiScalarProduct α β j) A
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.div
        (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun z hz => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hβ j z hz)))
      (continuousOn_adiScalarProduct A α β hβ j), cfc_shifted_ratio A hA _ _ (hβ j)]

name: NLAlib.sylvesterADIRight_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem sylvesterADIRight_eq_cfc {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) (α β : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hα : ∀ i z, z ∈ spectrum ℂ B → z ≠ α i) (j : ℕ) :
    sylvesterADIRight B α β j = cfc (adiScalarProduct β α j) B
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal B := ⟨hB.symm⟩
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    change 1 = cfc (fun _ : ℂ => 1) B
    rw [cfc_const_one ℂ B]
  | succ j hj =>
    have hscalar : adiScalarProduct β α (j + 1) =
        fun z => adiScalarProduct β α j z * ((z - β j) / (z - α j)) := by
      funext z
      exact Finset.prod_range_succ _ j
    rw [sylvesterADIRight, hj, hscalar, cfc_mul (adiScalarProduct β α j)
      (fun z : ℂ => (z - β j) / (z - α j)) B
      (continuousOn_adiScalarProduct B β α hα j)
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.div
        (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun z hz => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hα j z hz))), cfc_shifted_ratio B hB _ _ (hα j)]

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_norm_adiScalarProduct_left
statement:
theorem isGreatest_norm_adiScalarProduct_left {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (α β : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hβ : ∀ i z, z ∈ spectrum ℂ A → z ≠ β i) (j : ℕ) :
    IsGreatest ((fun z => ‖adiScalarProduct α β j z‖) '' spectrum ℂ A)
      (specNorm (sylvesterADILeft A α β j))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  rw [sylvesterADILeft_eq_cfc A hA α β hβ, specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact IsGreatest.norm_cfc _ _ (continuousOn_adiScalarProduct A α β hβ j)

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_norm_adiScalarProduct_right
statement:
theorem isGreatest_norm_adiScalarProduct_right {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B * Bᴴ = Bᴴ * B) (α β : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hα : ∀ i z, z ∈ spectrum ℂ B → z ≠ α i) (j : ℕ) :
    IsGreatest ((fun z => ‖adiScalarProduct β α j z‖) '' spectrum ℂ B)
      (specNorm (sylvesterADIRight B α β j))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsStarNormal B := ⟨hB.symm⟩
  rw [sylvesterADIRight_eq_cfc B hB α β hα, specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact IsGreatest.norm_cfc _ _ (continuousOn_adiScalarProduct B β α hα j)

name: NLAlib.support_subset_Ici_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_of_stable
statement:
theorem support_subset_Ici_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_of_stable
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (S : M) (hS : S∈matrixKStableDomain ν α) :
    (μ : Measure ℝ).support⊆Ici (lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S))
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : S∈matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS.1.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS.1 (hS.2.1 T hT)⟩
  have hKH : (matrixKTransform ν α S).IsHermitian := by
    have hs := matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α S hdom
    rw [hS.1.isHermitian.eq] at hs
    exact hs.symm
  obtain ⟨Y,hY,hYS⟩ := (show S∈
    (fun Y : selfAdjoint M => Y.val⁻¹) '' matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α by
      rwa [image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα])
  change Y.val⁻¹=S at hYS
  intro x hx
  by_contra hn
  have hlt : x<lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S) := lt_of_not_ge hn
  let H : M := matrixKTransform ν α S-(x : ℂ)•1
  have hH : H.PosDef := by
    have hp := hKH.posDef_sub_smul_one_of_lt_lambdaMin hlt
    exact hp
  obtain ⟨Z,_hZY,hZ,hKZ⟩ :=
    exists_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution ν hν α hα Y hY H hH
  have hst : Z.val⁻¹∈matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    rw [← image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
    exact ⟨Z,hZ,rfl⟩
  have hscalar : matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹=(x : ℂ)•1 := by
    rw [hKZ,hYS]
    dsimp only [H]
    abel
  exact (notMem_support_of_matrixKTransform_stable_solution ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ
    Z.val⁻¹ hst.1 hst.2.1 hst.2.2 x hscalar) hx

name: NLAlib.exists_compact_matrixKTransform_law_lower_edge_bound
statement:
theorem exists_compact_matrixKTransform_law_lower_edge_bound
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) ∧
      ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass=1 ∧ IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
          ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) ∧
        ∀ S : M, S∈matrixKStableDomain ν α →
          lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S)≤sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F,hFa,hF,μ,hμ,_huniq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_compact_stieltjes_probability_measure ν hν α hα
  have hne : (μ : Measure ℝ)≠0 := by
    intro hz
    have hm : μ.mass=0 := by
      apply ENNReal.coe_injective
      rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hz]
      simp
    rw [hμ.1] at hm
    exact one_ne_zero hm
  refine ⟨F,hFa,hF,μ,hμ.1,hμ.2.1,hμ.2.2,?_⟩
  intro S hS
  exact le_csInf (Measure.nonempty_support hne) fun x hx =>
    support_subset_Ici_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_of_stable ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ.2.2 S hS hx

name: NLAlib.adjoint_unit_reverse_denominator
statement:
private theorem adjoint_unit_reverse_denominator (S T : M) (h : IsUnit (1+S*T)) :
    IsUnit (1+T*S)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
  rw [Matrix.det_one_add_mul_comm]
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h

name: NLAlib.adjoint_kernel_pushThrough
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (1+T*S)*T=T*(1+S*T) := by noncomm_ring
  have hmul : (1+T*S)*matrixKResolvent S T=T := by
    unfold matrixKResolvent
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,ht,Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hL),Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    _ = ((1+T*S)⁻¹*(1+T*S))*matrixKResolvent S T := by
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hR),Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,hmul]

name: NLAlib.adjoint_kernel
statement:
private theorem adjoint_kernel (S T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (hL : IsUnit (1+S*T)) : matrixKResolvent Sᴴ T=(matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hR := adjoint_unit_reverse_denominator S T hL
  have hLa : IsUnit (1+Sᴴ*T) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hR.star
  have hRa : IsUnit (1+T*Sᴴ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hL.star
  rw [adjoint_kernel_pushThrough Sᴴ T hLa hRa]
  simp only [matrixKResolvent,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,hT.eq]

name: NLAlib.mem_matrixKTransformDomain_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem mem_matrixKTransformDomain_conjTranspose
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (S : M) (hS : S∈matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    Sᴴ∈matrixKTransformDomain ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hS.1.star
  · intro T hT
    have h := (adjoint_unit_reverse_denominator S T.val (hS.2 T hT)).star
    have hherm : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hherm.eq] using h

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_conjTranspose
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (α : ℝ) (S : M) (hS : S∈matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    matrixKTransform ν α Sᴴ=(matrixKTransform ν α S)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hI : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,matrixKResolvent Sᴴ T.val ∂ν)=
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν)ᴴ := by
    rw [← Matrix.integral_conjTranspose]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    exact adjoint_kernel S T.val T.property (hS.2 T hT)
  simp only [matrixKTransform,hI,Matrix.conjTranspose_sub,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,star_trivial]

name: NLAlib.posDef_of_posDef_le_complex
statement:
private theorem posDef_of_posDef_le_complex {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hAB : A ≤ B) : B.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hp := hA.add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB)
  convert! hp using 1; abel

name: NLAlib.inv_real_smul_one
statement:
private theorem inv_real_smul_one {c : ℝ} (hc : c≠0) :
    (c•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))⁻¹ = c⁻¹•1
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.one_mul,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hc,one_smul]

name: NLAlib.norm_inv_le_of_scalar_gap
statement:
private theorem norm_inv_le_of_scalar_gap {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0<c) (hgap : c•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ A) : ‖A⁻¹‖ ≤ c⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hI : (c•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hc
  have hA := posDef_of_posDef_le_complex hI hgap
  have hle : A⁻¹ ≤ c⁻¹•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    have hh := CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hgap hI.isStrictlyPositive
    simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse,inv_real_smul_one hc.ne'] using hh
  apply (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_iff_le_algebraMap A⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hc).le
    hA.inv.posSemidef.nonneg).mpr
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hle

name: NLAlib.posDef_one_sub_of_isHermitian_norm_lt_one
statement:
private theorem posDef_one_sub_of_isHermitian_norm_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAn : ‖A‖<1) : (1-A).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hle : A ≤ ‖A‖•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hA.isSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self
  have hp := (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (sub_pos.mpr hAn)).add_posSemidef
    (Matrix.le_iff.mp hle)
  convert! hp using 1; module

name: NLAlib.scalar_lower_bound_of_posDef
statement:
private theorem scalar_lower_bound_of_posDef (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (‖B⁻¹‖+1)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0<‖B⁻¹‖+1 := by positivity
  have hle : B⁻¹ ≤ (‖B⁻¹‖+1)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    have h1 := hB.inv.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self
    have h1' : B⁻¹ ≤ ‖B⁻¹‖•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using h1
    have h2 : ‖B⁻¹‖•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (‖B⁻¹‖+1)•1 :=
      smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) zero_le_one
    exact h1'.trans h2
  have hi := CStarAlgebra.ringInverse_le_ringInverse hle hB.inv.isStrictlyPositive
  simpa only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse,inv_real_smul_one hb.ne',
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB.isUnit)] using hi

name: NLAlib.far_core_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain
statement:
private theorem far_core_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (α M c : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (hM : 0≤M) (hc : 0<c)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ‖T.val‖≤M)
    (hsmall : α*(M*c⁻¹)^2<1)
    (Y : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hY : (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ Y.val) :
    Y ∈ matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α
proof:
:= by
  have hYpos : Y.val.PosDef := posDef_of_posDef_le_complex
    (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (by linarith : 0<M+c)) hY
  have hgaple (T) (hT : T ∈ ν.support) : c•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ Y.val+T.val := by
    have hneg : (-M)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ T.val := by
      have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
      have hh := hTH.isSelfAdjoint.neg_algebraMap_norm_le_self
      have hm : (-M)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (-‖T.val‖)•1 :=
        smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hbound T hT]) zero_le_one
      exact hm.trans (by simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,neg_smul] using hh)
    have hh := add_le_add hY hneg
    convert! hh using 1; module
  have hgap (T) (hT : T ∈ ν.support) : (Y.val+T.val).PosDef :=
    posDef_of_posDef_le_complex (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hc) (hgaple T hT)
  let f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) =>
    T.val*(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹*(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)*(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹*T.val
  have hnorm : ∀ᵐ T ∂ν, ‖f T‖ ≤ (M*c⁻¹)^2 := by
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hi := norm_inv_le_of_scalar_gap hc (hgaple T hT)
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [Matrix.mul_one]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖T.val‖*‖(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹‖*‖(Y.val+T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)))
            (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ M*c⁻¹*c⁻¹*M := by gcongr <;> exact hbound T hT
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hi : ‖∫ T, f T ∂ν‖ ≤ (M*c⁻¹)^2 := by
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hnorm
  have hH : (matrixKInverseStability ν α Y.val 1).IsHermitian := by
    unfold matrixKInverseStability
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.smul ?_ (IsSelfAdjoint.all α)
    apply Matrix.isHermitian_integral
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
    simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
      hTH.eq,(hgap T hT).inv.isHermitian.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hnormF : ‖matrixKInverseStability ν α Y.val 1‖<1 := by
    rw [matrixKInverseStability,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hα).trans_lt hsmall
  exact ⟨hYpos,hgap,1,Matrix.PosDef.one,
    posDef_one_sub_of_isHermitian_norm_lt_one hH hnormF⟩

name: NLAlib.isConnected_matrixKInverseStableDomain
statement:
theorem isConnected_matrixKInverseStableDomain
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0≤α) :
    IsConnected (matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hbound⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  let c := α*M^2+1
  have hc : 0<c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hsmall : α*(M*c⁻¹)^2<1 := by
    have he : α*(M*c⁻¹)^2=α*M^2/c^2 := by ring
    rw [he]
    apply (div_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos hc)).mpr
    dsimp [c]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α*M^2),mul_nonneg hα (sq_nonneg M)]
  let core : Set (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
    {Y | (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ Y.val}
  let base : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) := (M+c)•1
  have hbase : base ∈ core := by
    change (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
    exact le_refl _
  have hcoreSub : core ⊆ matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α := by
    intro Y hY
    exact far_core_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α M c hα hM.le hc
      (fun T hT => hbound T hT) hsmall Y hY
  have hcoreConvex : Convex ℝ core := by
    intro Y hY Z hZ a b ha hb hab
    change (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ Y.val at hY
    change (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ Z.val at hZ
    change (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ a•Y.val+b•Z.val
    have hh := add_le_add (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hY ha)
      (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hZ hb)
    rw [← add_smul,hab,one_smul] at hh
    exact hh
  refine ⟨⟨base,hcoreSub hbase⟩,?_⟩
  apply isPreconnected_of_forall base
  intro Y hY
  obtain ⟨hYpos,hgap,B,hB,hdef⟩ := hY
  let β : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) := ⟨B,hB.isHermitian⟩
  let γ : ℝ → selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) := fun t => Y+t•β
  let ray := γ '' Ici (0 : ℝ)
  have hray : IsPreconnected ray := isPreconnected_Ici.image γ (by fun_prop)
  have hYray : Y ∈ ray := ⟨0,by simp,by simp [γ]⟩
  have hraySub : ray ⊆ matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α := by
    rintro _ ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
    exact matrixKInverseStableDomain_certificate_ray ν hν hα Y hYpos hgap B hB hdef ht
  let t := (M+c)*(‖B⁻¹‖+1)
  have ht : 0≤t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have hhit : γ t ∈ core := by
    have hh := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (scalar_lower_bound_of_posDef B hB) ht
    have he : t*((‖B⁻¹‖+1)⁻¹)=M+c := by
      dsimp [t]
      rw [mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity : ‖B⁻¹‖+1≠0),mul_one]
    rw [smul_smul,he] at hh
    change (M+c)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ Y.val+t•B
    exact hh.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hYpos.posSemidef.nonneg)
  have hmeet : (ray ∩ core).Nonempty := ⟨γ t,⟨t,ht,rfl⟩,hhit⟩
  exact ⟨ray ∪ core,union_subset hraySub hcoreSub,Or.inr hbase,Or.inl hYray,
    IsPreconnected.union' hmeet hray hcoreConvex.isPreconnected⟩

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_sandwich_comp
statement:
private theorem hasFDerivAt_sandwich_comp
    {V W R : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W]
    [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R]
    (f : V → R) (D : V →L[ℝ] R) (L : W →L[ℝ] R) (y : V)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f D y) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w => (mulLeftRight ℝ R (f w) (f w)).comp L)
      (((compL ℝ W R R).flip L).comp
        (((mulLeftRight ℝ R (f y)).comp D) + ((mulLeftRight ℝ R).comp D).flip (f y))) y
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : HasFDerivAt (fun w => mulLeftRight ℝ R (f w))
      ((mulLeftRight ℝ R).comp D) y :=
    by
      apply HasFDerivAt.comp (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V) (F := R)
        (G := R →L[ℝ] R →L[ℝ] R) y (f := f) (f' := D) ?_ hf
      convert! (mulLeftRight ℝ R).hasFDerivAt
  have hT := hleft.clm_apply hf
  exact ((compL ℝ W R R).flip L).hasFDerivAt.comp y hT

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply (A : M) (ζ : ℂ) (y h : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y h =
      hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L h * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', rationalBlockMap_apply,
    rationalBlockDifference_resolvent, hermitianCoordinateResolvent]

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_eq
statement:
private theorem hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_eq (A : M) (ζ : ℂ) (y : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y =
      (mulLeftRight ℝ M (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y)
        (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y)).comp L
proof:
:= by
  ext h i j
  simp only [hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolvent
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolvent (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ)
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y) y
proof:
:= by
  have hH := hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates y)
  have hr := (hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian ζ (A + L y) hH hζ).restrictScalars ℝ
  have ha : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E => A + L w) L y := (L).hasFDerivAt.const_add A
  simpa only [hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv, hermitianCoordinateResolvent,
    Function.comp_def] using! hr.comp y ha

name: NLAlib.continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent
statement:
theorem continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y =>
    (hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA ζ hζ y).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv
statement:
theorem continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hR := continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA ζ hζ
  simp_rw [show hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ = fun y =>
    (mulLeftRight ℝ M (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y)
      (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y)).comp L from
    funext (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_eq A ζ)]
  exact (((mulLeftRight ℝ M).continuous.comp hR).clm_apply hR).clm_comp_const L

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ)
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y) y
proof:
:= by
  have hr := hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA ζ hζ y
  have h := hasFDerivAt_sandwich_comp
    (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ) (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y) L y
    (by simpa only using! hr)
  simpa only [← hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_eq,
    hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv] using! h

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_apply
    (A : M) (ζ : ℂ) (y k h : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y k h =
      hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L h * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y *
          L k * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y +
        hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L k * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y *
          L h * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply,
    add_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply]
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv
statement:
theorem continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hR := continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA ζ hζ
  have hD := continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A hA ζ hζ
  have hleft : Continuous (fun y =>
      (mulLeftRight ℝ M (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y)).comp
        (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y)) :=
    ((mulLeftRight ℝ M).continuous.comp hR).clm_comp hD
  have hflip : Continuous (fun y =>
      ((mulLeftRight ℝ M).comp (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y)).flip) :=
    by simpa only [coe_flipₗᵢ] using!
      (flipₗᵢ ℝ E M (M →L[ℝ] M)).continuous.comp
        (hD.const_clm_comp (mulLeftRight ℝ M))
  exact (hleft.add (hflip.clm_apply hR)).const_clm_comp ((compL ℝ E M M).flip L)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    specNorm (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates y)).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ

name: NLAlib.norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_le (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖L‖
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le A hA ζ hζ y
  rw [hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_eq]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg _)
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mulLeftRight_apply_apply_le ℝ M _ _).trans
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y), abs_nonneg ζ.im]

name: NLAlib.norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_le (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y‖ ≤
      2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 3 * ‖L‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le A hA ζ hζ y
  apply opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro k
  apply opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro h
  rw [hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_apply]
  apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
  have hb (h k : E) :
      ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L h * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y *
          L k * hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ ≤
        |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 3 * ‖L‖ ^ 2 * ‖k‖ * ‖h‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ * ‖L h‖ *
          ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ * ‖L k‖ *
          ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ := by
        calc
          _ ≤ ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L h *
              hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L k‖ *
              ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ (‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L h *
              hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ * ‖L k‖) *
              ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ ((‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y * L h‖ *
              ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖) * ‖L k‖) *
              ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ * (‖L‖ * ‖h‖) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ * (‖L‖ * ‖k‖) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
        gcongr <;> exact (L).le_opNorm _
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    _ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 3 * ‖L‖ ^ 2 * ‖k‖ * ‖h‖ +
        |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 3 * ‖L‖ ^ 2 * ‖h‖ * ‖k‖ := add_le_add (hb h k) (hb k h)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_real_stieltjes_extension_eq
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_real_stieltjes_extension_eq
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (G : ℂ → M) (u : ℝ) (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z)
    (hGpos : (G u).PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ((α⁻¹•G u)⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransform ν α (α⁻¹•G u)=(u : ℂ)•1
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℂ → M := fun z => α⁻¹•G z
  have hSp : (S u).PosDef := hGpos.smul (inv_pos.mpr hα)
  have hdom : S u∈matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hSp.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator (S u) T.val hSp (hgap T hT)⟩
  let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (u : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I
  have hφ : Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
    have hc : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
    simpa only [φ,Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] using
      (hc.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hSc : ContinuousAt S (u : ℂ) := (hGa.const_smul (c := α⁻¹)).continuousAt
  have hKlim := ((hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (hSc.tendsto.comp hφ))
  have htarget : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (φ y)•(1 : M)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 ((u : ℂ)•1)) :=
    hφ.smul_const (1 : M)
  have he : (fun y : ℝ => matrixKTransform ν α (S (φ y))) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] 0]
      (fun y : ℝ => (φ y)•(1 : M)) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hyp
    have hz : 0<(φ y).im := by simpa [φ] using (show 0<y from hyp)
    have hs : S (φ y)=F (φ y) := by
      simp only [S,hGN _ hz,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
    rw [hs,hF _ hz]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hKlim (htarget.congr' (he.mono fun y hy => hy.symm))

name: NLAlib.exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
statement:
theorem exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass=1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t) :
    ∃ S : M, S∈matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧ matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hGN,_hreal,hGu⟩ :=
    exists_posDef_sample_gap_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα F hFa hF
      μ hmass hcompact hμ
  let S : ℂ → M := fun z => α⁻¹•G z
  have hK (x : ℝ) (hx : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, x<t) :
      matrixKTransform ν α (S x)=(x : ℂ)•1 :=
    matrixKTransform_real_stieltjes_extension_eq ν hν α hα F (fun z hz => (hF z hz).2)
      G x (hGu x hx).1 hGN (hGu x hx).2.1 (hGu x hx).2.2.2
  have hG := hGu u hu
  have hSp : (S u).PosDef := hG.2.1.smul (inv_pos.mpr hα)
  have hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ((S u)⁻¹+T.val).PosDef := hG.2.2.2
  let B : M := α⁻¹•deriv G (u : ℂ)
  have hB : B.PosDef := hG.2.2.1.smul (inv_pos.mpr hα)
  have hSd : HasDerivAt S B (u : ℂ) := hG.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.const_smul α⁻¹
  have hcoe : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) 1 u := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt
  have hSC : HasFDerivAt S
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ B).restrictScalars ℝ) (u : ℂ) :=
    hSd.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hSdR : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => S (t : ℂ)) B u := by
    convert! hSC.comp_hasDerivAt u hcoe using 1
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
      ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,one_smul]
  have hchain := (hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform ν hν α (S u) hSp.isUnit
    (fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator (S u) T.val hSp (hgap T hT))).comp_hasDerivAt u hSdR
  have hne : (μ : Measure ℝ)≠0 := by
    intro hz
    have hm : μ.mass=0 := by
      apply ENNReal.coe_injective
      rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hz]
      simp
    rw [hmass] at hm
    exact one_ne_zero hm
  let a : ℝ := sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support
  have ha : a∈(μ : Measure ℝ).support := hcompact.sInf_mem (Measure.nonempty_support hne)
  have hua : u<a := hu a ha
  have he : (fun t : ℝ => matrixKTransform ν α (S (t : ℂ))) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
      (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)•(1 : M)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hua] with x hx
    exact hK x (fun t ht => lt_of_lt_of_le hx (csInf_le hcompact.bddBelow ht))
  have htarget : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)•(1 : M)) 1 u := by
    simpa only [one_smul] using hcoe.smul_const (1 : M)
  have hD : matrixKTransformDeriv ν α (S u) B=1 :=
    hchain.unique (htarget.congr_of_eventuallyEq he)
  have hw : ∃ B : M, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α (S u) B).PosDef :=
    ⟨B,hB,by rw [hD]; exact Matrix.PosDef.one⟩
  have hstable : S u∈matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    refine ⟨hSp,hgap,?_⟩
    rw [matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα (S u) hSp hgap,
      matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα (S u) hSp hgap,
      matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα (S u) hSp hgap]
    exact hw
  exact ⟨S u,hstable,hK u hu⟩

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_zero_of_spectral_vanishing
statement:
theorem hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_zero_of_spectral_vanishing
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ i, g (hA.eigenvalues i) = 0)
    (hg' : ∀ i, HasDerivAt g 0 (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    HasFDerivWithinAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => cfc g B)
      (0 : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) {B | B.IsHermitian} A
proof:
:= by
  have hgA : cfc g A = 0 := by
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    apply le_antisymm ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    apply norm_cfc_le le_rfl
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ hx
    simp only [hg i, norm_zero, le_refl]
  apply HasFDerivWithinAt.of_isLittleO
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hnear (i : n) : ∀ᶠ B : Matrix n n ℂ in 𝓝 A,
      ∀ x : ℝ, ‖x - hA.eigenvalues i‖ ≤ ‖B - A‖ →
        ‖g x‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - hA.eigenvalues i‖ := by
    have hs := (hg' i).isLittleO.bound hε
    simp only [hg i, smul_zero, sub_zero] at hs
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hs
    have hn : ∀ᶠ B : Matrix n n ℂ in 𝓝 A, ‖B - A‖ < δ := by
      have hc : ContinuousAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => ‖B - A‖) A := by fun_prop
      have ht := hc.tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero] using hδ))
      exact ht
    filter_upwards [hn] with B hB
    intro x hx
    exact hbound (by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hx.trans_lt hB)
  have hnearall : ∀ᶠ B : Matrix n n ℂ in 𝓝 A,
      ∀ i x, ‖x - hA.eigenvalues i‖ ≤ ‖B - A‖ →
        ‖g x‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - hA.eigenvalues i‖ := Filter.eventually_all.mpr hnear
  filter_upwards [hnearall.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with B hB hherm
  simp only [hgA, sub_zero, zero_apply]
  apply norm_cfc_le (mul_nonneg hε.le (norm_nonneg _))
  intro x hx
  have hBH : B.IsHermitian := hherm
  have hxc : (x : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ B := by
    rw [hBH.spectrum_eq_image_range]
    exact ⟨x, hBH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ hx, rfl⟩
  have hnormal : A * A.conjTranspose = A.conjTranspose * A := by rw [hA.eq]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdist⟩ := exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_norm_perturbation_of_normal
    (E := B - A) hnormal (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hxc)
  rw [hA.spectrum_eq_image_range] at hz
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
  have hd : ‖x - hA.eigenvalues i‖ ≤ ‖B - A‖ := by
    change ‖(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) - (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖B - A‖ at hdist
    have heq : (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) - (x : ℂ) = ((hA.eigenvalues i - x : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      (Complex.ofReal_sub _ _).symm
    rw [heq, Complex.norm_real] at hdist
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm, specNorm_eq_norm] using hdist
  exact (hB i x hd).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hε.le)

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun X : Matrix n n ℂ => X⁻¹)
      (-ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) S⁻¹ S⁻¹) S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hS
  have h := hasFDerivAt_ringInverse (𝕜 := ℝ) u
  rw [hu] at h
  convert! h using 1
  · funext X
    exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse X
  · rw [← hu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, Ring.inverse_unit]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixKResolvent
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixKResolvent (S T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (h : IsUnit (1 + S * T)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun X => matrixKResolvent X T) (matrixKResolventDeriv S T) S
proof:
:= by
  have hlin := ((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) S).mul_const' T).const_add 1
  have hi := (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (1 + S * T) h).comp S hlin
  have hk := hi.const_mul T
  convert! hk using 1
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro X
  simp only [matrixKResolventDeriv, neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop,
    MulOpposite.unop_op, matrixKResolvent, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_neg]

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_matrixKResolvent
statement:
theorem continuousAt_matrixKResolvent (S T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (h : IsUnit (1 + S * T)) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => matrixKResolvent p.1 p.2) (S,T)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (1 + S * T) h).continuousAt
  have harg : ContinuousAt (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => 1 + p.1 * p.2) (S,T) := by fun_prop
  have hi' : ContinuousAt (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => (1 + p.1 * p.2)⁻¹) (S,T) := hi.comp (f := fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => 1 + p.1 * p.2) harg
  have hmul : ContinuousAt (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => p.2 * (1 + p.1 * p.2)⁻¹) (S,T) :=
    continuous_snd.continuousAt.mul hi'
  simpa only [matrixKResolvent] using hmul

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_matrixKResolventDeriv
statement:
theorem continuousAt_matrixKResolventDeriv (S T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (h : IsUnit (1 + S * T)) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => matrixKResolventDeriv p.1 p.2) (S,T)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := continuousAt_matrixKResolvent S T h
  have hleft := (ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).continuous.continuousAt.comp hr
  exact (hleft.clm_apply hr).neg

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : IsUnit S) (hden : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, IsUnit (1 + S * T.val)) :
    HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S) S
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) := {p | IsUnit (1 + p.1 * p.2.val)}
  have hproj : Continuous (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (p.1,p.2.val)) :=
    continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)
  have hU : IsOpen U := Units.isOpen.preimage
    (continuous_const.add (continuous_fst.mul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)))
  have hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolvent p.1 p.2.val) U := by
    intro p hp
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun q : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolvent q.1 q.2.val) p :=
      (continuousAt_matrixKResolvent p.1 p.2.val hp).comp (f := fun q : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (q.1,q.2.val)) hproj.continuousAt
    exact hc.continuousWithinAt
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolventDeriv p.1 p.2.val) U := by
    intro p hp
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun q : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolventDeriv q.1 q.2.val) p :=
      (continuousAt_matrixKResolventDeriv p.1 p.2.val hp).comp (f := fun q : Matrix n n ℂ × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (q.1,q.2.val)) hproj.continuousAt
    exact hc.continuousWithinAt
  have hI := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support ν hν
    (fun X T => matrixKResolvent X T.val) (fun X T => matrixKResolventDeriv X T.val)
    U hU hF hD (fun p hp => hasFDerivAt_matrixKResolvent p.1 p.2.val hp) S hden
  have hInv := (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse S hS).const_smul α⁻¹
  convert! hI.sub hInv using 1
  simp only [matrixKTransformDeriv, smul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_apply_resolvent
statement:
private theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_apply_resolvent
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹ * Δ * S⁻¹) -
      ∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ * matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (integrable_matrixK_kernels ν hν S hS hgap).1
  unfold matrixKTransformDeriv
  rw [add_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hi Δ]
  simp only [matrixKResolventDeriv, neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply]
  rw [integral_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.matrixKStabilityMap_apply
statement:
theorem matrixKStabilityMap_apply (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) (H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H = α • ∫ T, matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  unfold matrixKStabilityMap
  rw [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply (integrable_matrixK_kernels ν hν S hS hgap).2 H]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence
statement:
theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    let R
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
    let H := R * Δ * R
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (R * (H - matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H) * R) := by
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
  let H := R * Δ * R
  change matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (R * (H - matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H) * R)
  have hi0 := (integrable_matrixK_kernels ν hν S hS hgap).2
  have hi : Integrable (fun T => matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val) ν := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply] using hi0.apply_continuousLinearMap H
  let F := ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) R R
  have htransport := F.integral_comp_comm hi
  change (∫ T, R * (matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val) * R ∂ν) =
    R * (∫ T, matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val ∂ν) * R at htransport
  have hkernel : (∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val * Δ * matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) =
      R * (∫ T, matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val ∂ν) * R := by
    rw [← htransport]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun T => by
      dsimp only
      rw [matrixKResolvent_eq_inv_sqrt_congruence S T.val hS]
      simp only [H,R,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hfirst : S⁻¹ * Δ * S⁻¹ = R * H * R := by
    rw [inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hS]
    simp only [R,H,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [matrixKTransformDeriv_apply_resolvent ν hν α S hS hgap Δ,hkernel,hfirst,
    matrixKStabilityMap_apply ν hν α S hS hgap H]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,
    smul_sub,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα,one_smul]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_hermitian_congruence
statement:
theorem frobInner_hermitian_congruence (R A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hR : R.IsHermitian) :
    frobInner A (R * B * R) = frobInner (R * A * R) B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace,frobInner_eq_trace,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hR.eq]
  congr 1
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using Matrix.trace_mul_comm (Aᴴ * R * B) R

name: NLAlib.frobInner_matrixKTransformDeriv
statement:
theorem frobInner_matrixKTransformDeriv (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    let R
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
    let H := R * Δ * R
    frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ) = α⁻¹ * frobInner H (H - matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H) := by
  rw [matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence ν hν α hα S hS hgap Δ,frobInner_smul_right,
    frobInner_hermitian_congruence]
  exact cfc_predicate _ _

name: NLAlib.cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose

name: NLAlib.re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues

theorem re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.mul_card_le_re_trace_cfc_of_le
statement:
theorem mul_card_le_re_trace_cfc_of_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : ∀ i, b ≤ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues

name: NLAlib.convex_set_isHermitian
statement:
theorem convex_set_isHermitian {d : ℕ} :
    Convex ℝ {H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ | H.IsHermitian}
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.convexOn_traceExp_isHermitian
statement:
theorem convexOn_traceExp_isHermitian {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] :
    ConvexOn ℝ {H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ | H.IsHermitian} traceExp
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : matrixLog (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) = 0 := by
    simp [matrixLog]
  have hvar : ∀ H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ, H.IsHermitian →
      IsGreatest {r : ℝ | ∃ T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
        T.PosDef ∧ r = (T * H).trace.re + (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).trace.re -
          relativeEntropy T 1} (traceExp H) := by
    intro H hH
    simpa only [hlog, add_zero] using
      isGreatest_variational_traceExp H 1 hH Matrix.PosDef.one
  refine ⟨convex_set_isHermitian, ?_⟩
  intro H hH K hK a b ha hb hab
  have hM : (a • H + b • K).IsHermitian :=
    (hH.smul (.of_nonneg ha)).add (hK.smul (.of_nonneg hb))
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hscore⟩ := (hvar (a • H + b • K) hM).1
  have hHscore := (hvar H hH).2 ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
  have hKscore := (hvar K hK).2 ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
  have heq : (T * (a • H + b • K)).trace.re +
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).trace.re - relativeEntropy T 1 =
      a * ((T * H).trace.re + (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).trace.re - relativeEntropy T 1) +
      b * ((T * K).trace.re + (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).trace.re - relativeEntropy T 1) := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_smul,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
    have hc : (a + b) * ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).trace.re - relativeEntropy T 1) =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).trace.re - relativeEntropy T 1 := by rw [hab, one_mul]
    nlinarith only [hc]
  rw [hscore, heq]
  exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHscore ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hKscore hb)

name: NLAlib.sum_twice_inserted_mixed_resolvent_trace_eq_cyclicHessian
statement:
theorem sum_twice_inserted_mixed_resolvent_trace_eq_cyclicHessian
    (X : M) (hX : X.IsHermitian) (H : M) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (p + p), ∑ k : Fin (p + p + 1), normalizedTrace
      (((List.ofFn (resolventWordInsert
        (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord (n := d) ζ p) j H) k H)).map
          (fun b => resolvent X b.1 * b.2)).prod)) =
      cyclicMixedResolventHessian X ζ p H
proof:
:= by
  let h : E := matrixRealCoordinates H
  have hh : L h = H := hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hH
  let g : E → ℂ := fun y => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (X + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (X + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hw := im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord (n := d) ζ hζ p
  have hc := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord X hX (mixedResolventWord ζ p) hw (r := ⊤)
  have heq : g = T ∘ hermitianCoordinateResolventWord X (mixedResolventWord ζ p) := by
    funext y
    simp only [g, T, Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
      LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
      hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed]
  have hsum : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g (0 : E) ![h, h] =
      ∑ j : Fin (p + p), ∑ k : Fin (p + p + 1), normalizedTrace
        (((List.ofFn (resolventWordInsert
          (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord (n := d) ζ p) j H) k H)).map
            (fun b => resolvent X b.1 * b.2)).prod) := by
    rw [heq, T.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hc.contDiffAt (by simp)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply X hX
      (mixedResolventWord ζ p) hw]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hh, map_sum, T,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
      normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventWord,
      hermitianCoordinateResolvent, map_zero, add_zero]
  have hcyclic : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g (0 : E) ![h, h] =
      cyclicMixedResolventHessian X ζ p H := by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply (𝕜 := ℝ)]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    have hc' := fderiv_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_cyclic_apply
      X hX ζ (star ζ) hζ (by simpa only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hζ)
      p p (0 : E) h h
    simpa only [g, hh, map_zero, add_zero, cyclicMixedResolventHessian] using hc'
  exact hsum.symm.trans hcyclic

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_sub_matrixKResolvent
statement:
theorem matrixKResolvent_sub_matrixKResolvent
    (S Q T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : IsUnit (1 + S * T)) (hQ : IsUnit (1 + Q * T)) :
    matrixKResolvent S T - matrixKResolvent Q T =
      -(matrixKResolvent S T * (S-Q) * matrixKResolvent Q T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKResolvent, matrixKResolvent, ← Matrix.mul_sub,
    Matrix.inv_sub_inv ⟨fun _ => hQ,fun _ => hS⟩]
  have he : (1 + Q*T) - (1 + S*T) = -(S-Q)*T := by noncomm_ring
  rw [he]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain
statement:
theorem integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) {S : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    Integrable (fun T => matrixKResolvent S T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolvent S T.val)
      ν.support := by
    intro T hT
    exact ((continuousAt_matrixKResolvent S T.val (hS.2 T hT)).comp
      (f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (S,T.val))
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_sub_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_sub_matrixKTransform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) {S Q : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν) (hQ : Q ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν) :
    matrixKTransform ν α S - matrixKTransform ν α Q =
      α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹ * (S-Q) * Q⁻¹) -
        ∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val * (S-Q) * matrixKResolvent Q T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hiS := integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain ν hν hS
  have hiQ := integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain ν hν hQ
  have hR : (∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) - (∫ T, matrixKResolvent Q T.val ∂ν) =
      -(∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val * (S-Q) * matrixKResolvent Q T.val ∂ν) := by
    rw [← integral_sub hiS hiQ, ← integral_neg]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
    exact matrixKResolvent_sub_matrixKResolvent S Q T.val (hS.2 T hT) (hQ.2 T hT)
  have hInv : S⁻¹ - Q⁻¹ = -(S⁻¹ * (S-Q) * Q⁻¹) := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_sub_inv ⟨fun _ => hQ.1,fun _ => hS.1⟩]
    rw [show Q-S = -(S-Q) by abel]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
  calc
    matrixKTransform ν α S - matrixKTransform ν α Q =
        ((∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) - (∫ T, matrixKResolvent Q T.val ∂ν)) -
          α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹-Q⁻¹) := by unfold matrixKTransform; module
    _ = _ := by rw [hR,hInv,smul_neg]; abel

name: NLAlib.mul_cayleyTransform_one
statement:
private theorem mul_cayleyTransform_one (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsUnit (A - 1).det) :
    (A - 1) * cayleyTransform A 1 = A + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cayleyTransform_eq_one_add A 1 (by simpa using hP)]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul, mul_one, Matrix.mul_add,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hP]
  module

name: NLAlib.cayley_congruence_identity
statement:
private theorem cayley_congruence_identity (A X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hP : IsUnit (A - 1).det) :
    (A - 1) * (X - cayleyTransform A 1 * X * (cayleyTransform A 1)ᴴ) * (A - 1)ᴴ =
      -(2 : ℂ) • (A * X + X * Aᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hT := mul_cayleyTransform_one A hP
  have hstar : (cayleyTransform A 1)ᴴ * (A - 1)ᴴ = (A + 1)ᴴ := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hT]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
  have hterm : (A - 1) * (cayleyTransform A 1 * X * (cayleyTransform A 1)ᴴ) * (A - 1)ᴴ =
      (A + 1) * X * (A + 1)ᴴ := by
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at *
    rw [hT]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc _ (cayleyTransform A 1)ᴴ (A - 1)ᴴ, hstar]
  rw [hterm]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
    Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one]
  module

name: NLAlib.lyapunovCayleySolution_equation
statement:
theorem lyapunovCayleySolution_equation (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A) :
    A * lyapunovCayleySolution A Q + lyapunovCayleySolution A Q * Aᴴ + Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hP : IsUnit (A - 1).det := by
    simpa using (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (hA.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one 1 zero_lt_one)
  have hT := hA.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one 1 zero_lt_one
  have hs := summable_stein_of_spectralRadius_lt_one (cayleyTransform A 1)
    ((2 : ℂ) • ((A - 1)⁻¹ * Q * ((A - 1)⁻¹)ᴴ)) hT
  have heq := steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose _ _ hs
  change lyapunovCayleySolution A Q - cayleyTransform A 1 * lyapunovCayleySolution A Q *
    (cayleyTransform A 1)ᴴ = (2 : ℂ) • ((A - 1)⁻¹ * Q * ((A - 1)⁻¹)ᴴ) at heq
  have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => (A - 1) * M * (A - 1)ᴴ) heq
  rw [cayley_congruence_identity A _ hP] at he
  have hright : (A - 1) * ((2 : ℂ) • ((A - 1)⁻¹ * Q * ((A - 1)⁻¹)ᴴ)) * (A - 1)ᴴ =
      (2 : ℂ) • Q := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hP, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hP,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hright, neg_smul] at he
  have hzero : (2 : ℂ) • (A * lyapunovCayleySolution A Q + lyapunovCayleySolution A Q * Aᴴ + Q) = 0 := by
    rw [smul_add, ← he]
    abel
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_lyapunovCayleySolution
statement:
theorem posSemidef_lyapunovCayleySolution (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz A) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) : (lyapunovCayleySolution A Q).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply posSemidef_steinGramian
  · exact (hQ.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (A - 1)⁻¹).smul (by norm_num : (0 : ℂ) ≤ 2)
  · exact summable_stein_of_spectralRadius_lt_one _ _
      (hA.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one 1 zero_lt_one)

name: NLAlib.posDef_lyapunovCayleySolution
statement:
theorem posDef_lyapunovCayleySolution (A Q : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz A) (hQ : Q.PosDef) : (lyapunovCayleySolution A Q).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hP : IsUnit (A - 1) := by simpa using hA.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one 1 zero_lt_one
  have hPi : IsUnit (A - 1)⁻¹ := Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hP
  have hforce : (((2 : ℂ) • ((A - 1)⁻¹ * Q * ((A - 1)⁻¹)ᴴ))).PosDef :=
    ((Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hPi).mpr hQ).smul (by norm_num : (0 : ℂ) < 2)
  exact posDef_steinGramian _ _ hforce
    (summable_stein_of_spectralRadius_lt_one _ _ (hA.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one 1 zero_lt_one))

name: NLAlib.polarSchulzStep_thinSingularMatrix
statement:

proof:

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖σ‖ < Real.sqrt 3 := by
    rwa [h.eq, ← thinSingularMatrix, specNorm_thinSingularMatrix U V h.left_orth h.right_orth] at hA
  have hs : σ i < Real.sqrt 3 :=

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.tendsto_polarSchulzIterate
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.tendsto_polarSchulzIterate {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ} (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ)
    (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) :
    Tendsto (polarSchulzIterate A) atTop (𝓝 (canonicalPartialPolar A))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Tendsto (fun k i => polarSchulzScalar (σ i) k) atTop (𝓝 (fun _ : r => (1 : ℝ))) :=
    tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr (fun i => tendsto_polarSchulzScalar (h.pos i)
      (h.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three hA i))
  have hc : Continuous (fun f : r → ℝ => thinSingularMatrix U V f) := by
    unfold thinSingularMatrix
    fun_prop
  have ht := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hs
  have he : (fun k => thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => polarSchulzScalar (σ i) k)) =
      polarSchulzIterate A := funext (fun k => (h.polarSchulzIterate_eq k).symm)
  change Tendsto (fun k => thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => polarSchulzScalar (σ i) k))
    atTop (𝓝 (thinSingularMatrix U V (fun _ => 1))) at ht
  rw [he] at ht
  simpa only [thinSingularMatrix, RCLike.ofReal_one, Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one,
    ← h.canonicalPartialPolar_eq] using ht

proof:
