name: NLAlib.traceExponentialCircleDensity_re_nonneg_of_exterior_branches
statement:
theorem traceExponentialCircleDensity_re_nonneg_of_exterior_branches
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    {R ρ : ℝ} {forward : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hforward : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (forward i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
      Tendsto (fun z => forward i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hforwardSpec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, forward i z ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => forward i z))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRρ : R < ρ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) :
    0 ≤ (traceExponentialCircleDensity forward b ρ s).re
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS, inverse, hinverse, hinverseSpec, _, href, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_inverse_eigenvalue_branches_root_sum hA b hb s hs
  obtain ⟨h, hdiff, hext, _, hconj, him, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_inversePencilUpperRootSum_extension hA b s hs inverse
      (fun i => (hinverse i).1) (fun u hu => (hinverseSpec u hu).1) hroot href
  have hmoment := eventually_circleDensity_eq_neg_circleIntegral_of_exterior_inverse_branches
    A b hb s hs hforward hforwardSpec hinverse (fun u hu => (hinverseSpec u hu).1) hρ hRρ
  obtain ⟨M, hmoment, hMS, hM⟩ :=
    (hmoment.and ((eventually_gt_atTop S).and (eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)))).exists
  let D : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let C := (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm D⁻¹ * (specNorm A + (M + 1))
  have hball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ M + 1 → ‖h z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro z hz
    exact (hbound z).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)))
  have hpositive := Complex.neg_normalized_exp_circleIntegral_re_nonneg hM hMS
    hdiff hconj him hball
  have hdensity : traceExponentialCircleDensity forward b ρ s =
      -(2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ u in C(0, M), exp u * h u) := by
    rw [hmoment]
    congr 1
    apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hM.le
    intro u hu
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ = M := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hu
    dsimp only
    rw [hext u (by rwa [hnorm])]
  rw [hdensity]
  simpa only [neg_mul] using hpositive

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_diagonal_of_injective
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_diagonal_of_injective
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    {l u : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u) (hbu : ∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
      (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) l u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, forward, hforward, hspec, _⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal_conj_eq hA b hb
  have hr : 0 < R + 1 := by linarith
  have hRr : R < R + 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, _⟩ :=
    exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg_off_slopes
      A b forward (R + 1) l u hlu hbu
      (fun t => integral_exp_mul_re_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
        hA b hR hforward hspec hRr hlu hbu t) (by
        intro s _ hs
        exact traceExponentialCircleDensity_re_nonneg_of_exterior_branches hA b hb
          hforward hspec hr hRr s (fun i heq => hs ⟨i, heq.symm⟩))
  exact ⟨ν, hν⟩

proof:
:= by
  unfold rationalMatrixEval
  simp only [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  exact (P.hasFDerivAt_aeval_noncomm A).continuousAt.mul
    ((differentiableAt_inverse (𝕜 := 𝕜) (R := M) hA).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun X : M => aeval X Q)

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_rationalBlockMap
statement:
theorem continuousAt_rationalBlockMap (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) :
    ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M => rationalBlockMap P Q Z.1 Z.2) (A, B)
proof:
:= by
  have hfa : ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M => rationalMatrixEval P Q Z.1) (A,B) :=
    by simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      (continuousAt_rationalMatrixEval P Q A hA).comp
        (f := fun Z : M × M => Z.1) continuous_fst.continuousAt
  have hinvB : ContinuousAt (fun X : M => Ring.inverse (aeval X Q)) B :=
    (differentiableAt_inverse (𝕜 := 𝕜) (R := M) hB).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun X : M => aeval X Q)
      (Q.hasFDerivAt_aeval_noncomm B).continuousAt
  have hqb : ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M => Ring.inverse (aeval Z.2 Q)) (A,B) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hinvB.comp
      (x := (A,B)) (f := fun Z : M × M => Z.2) continuous_snd.continuousAt
  simp only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] at hqb
  unfold rationalBlockMap
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_rationalSecondBlockMap
statement:
theorem continuousAt_rationalSecondBlockMap (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B C : M)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hC : IsUnit (aeval C Q)) :
    ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M × M => rationalSecondBlockMap P Q Z.1 Z.2.1 Z.2.2)
      (A, B, C)
proof:
:= by
  have hfa : ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M × M => rationalMatrixEval P Q Z.1) (A,B,C) :=
    by simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      (continuousAt_rationalMatrixEval P Q A hA).comp
        (f := fun Z : M × M × M => Z.1) continuous_fst.continuousAt
  have hinvC : ContinuousAt (fun X : M => Ring.inverse (aeval X Q)) C :=
    (differentiableAt_inverse (𝕜 := 𝕜) (R := M) hC).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun X : M => aeval X Q)
      (Q.hasFDerivAt_aeval_noncomm C).continuousAt
  have hqc : ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M × M => Ring.inverse (aeval Z.2.2 Q)) (A,B,C) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hinvC.comp
      (x := (A,B,C)) (f := fun Z : M × M × M => Z.2.2) (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
  simp only [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] at hqc
  have hfirst : ContinuousAt (fun Z : M × M × M => rationalBlockMap P Q Z.1 Z.2.1)
      (A,B,C) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      (continuousAt_rationalBlockMap P Q A B hA hB).comp
        (x := (A,B,C)) (f := fun Z : M × M × M => (Z.1,Z.2.1))
        (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).continuousAt
  unfold rationalSecondBlockMap bilinearComp
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_smul_of_pos
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_smul_of_pos (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    lambdaMax (c • A) = c * lambdaMax A
proof:
:= by
  have h := spectrum.unit_smul_eq_smul (R := ℝ) A (Units.mk0 c hc.ne')
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0] at h
  rw [lambdaMax, h, Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0, Real.sSup_smul_of_nonneg hc.le, smul_eq_mul,
    lambdaMax]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_smul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_smul_of_nonneg [Nonempty d] (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    lambdaMax (c • A) = c * lambdaMax A
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with hzero | hpos
  · rw [← hzero]
    simp [lambdaMax, spectrum.zero_eq]
  · exact lambdaMax_smul_of_pos A hpos

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_smul_of_pos
statement:
theorem lambdaMin_smul_of_pos (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    lambdaMin (c • A) = c * lambdaMin A
proof:
:= by
  have h := spectrum.unit_smul_eq_smul (R := ℝ) A (Units.mk0 c hc.ne')
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0] at h
  rw [lambdaMin, h, Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hc.le, smul_eq_mul,
    lambdaMin]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem lambdaMax_neg (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) : lambdaMax (-A) = -lambdaMin A
proof:

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem lambdaMin_neg (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) : lambdaMin (-A) = -lambdaMax A

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_one
statement: @[simp] theorem lambdaMax_one [Nonempty d] : lambdaMax (1 : Matrix d d 𝕜) = 1
proof:

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_one
statement: @[simp] theorem lambdaMin_one [Nonempty d] : lambdaMin (1 : Matrix d d 𝕜) = 1
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {d : Type*} [Fintype d]
    [DecidableEq d] [Nonempty d] {P : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hP : P.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ lambdaMin P
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMin, hP.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  exact le_csInf (Set.range_nonempty _) (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hP.eigenvalues_nonneg i)

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_le_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_le_trace_of_posSemidef {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {d : Type*} [Fintype d]
    [DecidableEq d] [Nonempty d] {P : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hP : P.PosSemidef) :
    lambdaMax P ≤ RCLike.re P.trace
proof:
:= by
  have htrace : RCLike.re P.trace = ∑ i, hP.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hP.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    simp
  rw [lambdaMax, hP.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, htrace]
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hP.eigenvalues_nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.lambdaMin_le_or_le_lambdaMax_of_le_norm_sub_one
statement:
theorem lambdaMin_le_or_le_lambdaMax_of_le_norm_sub_one
    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] [Nonempty d]
    {H : Matrix d d ℂ} (hH : H.IsHermitian) {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ε ≤ ‖H - 1‖) :
    lambdaMin H ≤ 1 - ε ∨ 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax H
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∀ q : ℝ, q ∈ spectrum ℝ (H - 1) → q + 1 ∈ spectrum ℝ H := by
    intro q hq
    rw [spectrum.mem_iff] at hq ⊢
    have heq : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix d d ℂ) (q + 1) - H =
        algebraMap ℝ (Matrix d d ℂ) q - (H - 1) := by
      rw [map_add, map_one]
      abel
    rwa [heq]
  have hfin : (spectrum ℝ H).Finite := by
    rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact Set.finite_range _
  rcases CStarAlgebra.norm_or_neg_norm_mem_spectrum (hH.sub Matrix.isHermitian_one).isSelfAdjoint
      with hp | hm
  · right
    have hh := le_csSup hfin.bddAbove (hshift _ hp)
    change ε ≤ ‖H - 1‖ at h
    change ‖H - 1‖ + 1 ≤ lambdaMax H at hh
    linarith
  · left
    have hh := csInf_le hfin.bddBelow (hshift _ hm)
    change ε ≤ ‖H - 1‖ at h
    change lambdaMin H ≤ -‖H - 1‖ + 1 at hh
    linarith

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.iteratedFDeriv_resolvent_apply
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.iteratedFDeriv_resolvent_apply
    {A : M} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {k : ℕ} (H : Fin k → M) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℂ k (fun B : M => resolvent B ζ) A H =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (List.ofFn (fun i => resolvent A ζ * H (σ i))).prod * resolvent A ζ
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.iteratedFDeriv_resolvent_apply
  change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ M ζ - A)
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
    hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ

name: NLAlib.isUnit_aeval_shift
statement:
private theorem isUnit_aeval_shift (ζ : ℂ) (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) : IsUnit (aeval A (C ζ-X))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_sub,aeval_C,aeval_X,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
    hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian (ζ : ℂ) (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : M => resolvent B ζ) (rationalBlockMap 1 (C ζ-X) A A) A
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasFDerivAt_rationalMatrixEval 1 (C ζ-X) A (isUnit_aeval_shift ζ A hA hζ)
  have he : (rationalMatrixEval 1 (C ζ-X) : M → M) = fun B => resolvent B ζ :=
    funext (rationalMatrixEval_resolvent ζ)
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_resolvent_sq_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_resolvent_sq_of_isHermitian (ζ : ℂ) (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : M => (resolvent B ζ)^2)
      (rationalBlockMap 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) A A) A
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : IsUnit (aeval A ((C ζ-X)^2)) := by
    simpa only [map_pow] using (isUnit_aeval_shift ζ A hA hζ).pow 2
  have h := hasFDerivAt_rationalMatrixEval 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) A hQ
  have he : (rationalMatrixEval 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) : M → M) =
      fun B => (resolvent B ζ)^2 := funext (rationalMatrixEval_resolvent_sq ζ)
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.fderiv_resolvent_sq_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_resolvent_sq_apply (ζ : ℂ) (A H : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    fderiv ℂ (fun B : M => (resolvent B ζ)^2) A H =
      resolventSquareDifference ζ A A H
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_resolvent_sq_of_isHermitian ζ A hA hζ).fderiv,
    rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ A A H hA hA hζ]

name: NLAlib.traceResolventDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem traceResolventDerivative_apply (ζ : ℂ) (A H : M) :
    traceResolventDerivative ζ A H = normalizedTrace (H * (resolvent A ζ)^2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [traceResolventDerivative,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,rationalBlockMap_apply]
  rw [rationalBlockDifference_resolvent]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,normalizedTrace_mul_comm (resolvent A ζ) (H*resolvent A ζ),
    pow_two,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_normalizedTrace_resolvent
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_normalizedTrace_resolvent (ζ : ℂ) (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : M => normalizedTrace (resolvent B ζ))
      (traceResolventDerivative ζ A) A
proof:
:= by
  exact ((normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt).comp A
    (hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian ζ A hA hζ)

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_normalizedTrace_resolvent_real
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_normalizedTrace_resolvent_real (ζ : ℂ) (A : M)

    HasFDerivAt (fun B : M => normalizedTrace (resolvent B ζ))

  (hasFDerivAt_normalizedTrace_resolvent ζ A hA hζ).restrictScalars ℝ

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_decreasing_affine_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_decreasing_affine_branch
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (H : M) (hH : H.PosDef) :
    ∃ (G : ℂ → M) (B : M), AnalyticAt ℂ G 0 ∧ G 0=S ∧ B.PosDef ∧
      HasDerivAt G (-B) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, (G t).IsHermitian) ∧
      ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, G z∈matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (G z)=matrixKTransform ν α S-z•H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, B, hGa, hG0, hGd, _hGR, _hBH, hDB, hGeq, hstable⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_affine_branch ν hν α hα S ⟨hS,hgap,hpos⟩
      (-H) hH.isHermitian.neg
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hDC⟩ := exists_posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_preimage ν hν α hα
    S hS hgap hpos H hH
  have hDE (X : M) : matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S X = matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S X :=
    congrArg (fun L : M →L[ℝ] M => L X)
      (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α S)
  have hB : matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S B = -H := by rw [hDE,hDB]
  have hCneg : matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S (-C) = -H := by rw [map_neg,hDE,hDC]
  have he : B = -C :=
    injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos
      (hB.trans hCneg.symm)
  refine ⟨G,C,hGa,hG0,hC,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [he] using hGd
  · exact hstable.mono fun _ ht => ht.1.isHermitian
  · simpa only [smul_neg,sub_eq_add_neg] using hGeq

name: cfc_diag
statement:
private theorem cfc_diag {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    cfc f (diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ))) = diagonal (fun i => (f (x i) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  let := IsStarNormal.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := n → ℂ)
  let := IsSelfAdjoint.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := n → ℂ)
  let z : n → ℂ := fun i => (x i : ℂ)
  have hx : IsSelfAdjoint z := by ext; simp [z]
  have hdiag : IsSelfAdjoint (diagHom z) := hx.map diagHom
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ z) := by
    rw [Pi.spectrum_eq]
    have heq : (⋃ i, spectrum ℝ (z i)) = Set.range x := by
      change (⋃ i, spectrum ℝ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ (x i))) = _
      simp only [spectrum.scalar_eq, Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range]
    rw [heq]
    exact Set.Finite.continuousOn (Set.finite_range _) _
  have heq := (diagHom (n := n)).map_cfc (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := IsSelfAdjoint) f z hc
    (by change Continuous (fun z : n → ℂ => diagonal z); fun_prop) hx hdiag
  rw [cfc_map_pi (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := fun _ => IsSelfAdjoint) (S := ℂ) f z (by rwa [← Pi.spectrum_eq]) hx (fun i => by change star (x i : ℂ) = (x i : ℂ); simp)] at heq
  change diagonal (fun i => cfc f (algebraMap ℝ ℂ (x i))) = cfc f (diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ))) at heq
  simp only [cfc_algebraMap] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: cfc_diag_conj
statement:
private theorem cfc_diag_conj {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    cfc f ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (f (x i) : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U
  have hd : IsSelfAdjoint (diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ))) := by
    change (diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)))ᴴ = _
    simp [diagonal_conjTranspose]
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ (diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)))) := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    fun_prop
  have heq := StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc (p := IsSelfAdjoint) (q := IsSelfAdjoint)
    φ f _ hc (by change Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * M * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)); fun_prop) hd (hd.map φ)
  rw [cfc_diag] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: conj_diag_mul
statement:
private theorem conj_diag_mul {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (x y : n → ℝ) :
    ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) *
      ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (y i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) =
    (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => ((x i * y i : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  change (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U) _ * (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U) _ = _
  rw [← map_mul, diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rfl

name: perspective_diag
statement:
private theorem perspective_diag {n : ℕ} (U : unitary (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
    (a h : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hh : ∀ i, 0 < h i) :
    matrixPerspective (fun x => -Real.log x)
      ((U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ))
      ((U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) =
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) *
      diagonal (fun i => ((a i * (Real.log (a i) - Real.log (h i)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixPerspective, cfc_diag_conj, conj_diag_mul]
  congr 2
  apply congrArg diagonal
  funext i
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (ha i).le
  have hsn := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (ha i)
  have heq : (Real.sqrt (a i))⁻¹ * h i * (Real.sqrt (a i))⁻¹ = h i / a i := by
    field_simp [hsn.ne', (ha i).ne']
    rw [hs, mul_comm]
  rw [heq, Real.log_div (hh i).ne' (ha i).ne']
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = (Real.sqrt (a i))^2 * (Real.log (a i) - Real.log (h i)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hs]

name: tensor_conj
statement:
private theorem tensor_conj {d : ℕ} (U V : unitary (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ))
    (a b : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (tensorU U V : Matrix _ _ ℂ) *
      diagonal (fun i => ((a (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).1 * b (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      star (tensorU U V : Matrix _ _ ℂ) =
    (((U : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => (a j : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) ⊗ₖ
      ((V : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => (b j : ℂ)) * star (V : Matrix _ _ ℂ))).submatrix
      finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorU, star_eq_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_submatrix, conjTranspose_kronecker]
  rw [mul_kronecker_mul, mul_kronecker_mul, ← submatrix_mul_equiv _ _ _ finProdFinEquiv.symm,
    ← submatrix_mul_equiv _ _ _ finProdFinEquiv.symm]
  congr 2
  rw [diagonal_kronecker_diagonal]
  rw [submatrix_diagonal_equiv]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: conj_diag_sub
statement:
private theorem conj_diag_sub {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (x y : n → ℝ) :
    ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) -
      ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (y i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) =
    (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => ((x i - y i : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sub_mul, ← mul_sub, ← diagonal_sub, Complex.ofReal_sub]

name: perspective_tensor_diag
statement:
private theorem perspective_tensor_diag {d : ℕ} (U V : unitary (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ))
    (a h : Fin d → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hh : ∀ i, 0 < h i) :
    matrixPerspective (fun x => -Real.log x)
      ((((U : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) ⊗ₖ 1).submatrix
        finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm)
      ((1 ⊗ₖ ((V : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * star (V : Matrix _ _ ℂ))).submatrix
        finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm) =
    ((((U : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => ((a i * Real.log (a i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) ⊗ₖ 1) -
       (((U : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ)) ⊗ₖ
        ((V : Matrix _ _ ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (Real.log (h i) : ℂ)) * star (V : Matrix _ _ ℂ)))).submatrix
          finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) * diagonal (fun _ => ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix _ _ ℂ) = 1 := by simp
  have hv : (V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) * diagonal (fun _ => ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * star (V : Matrix _ _ ℂ) = 1 := by simp
  have he1 := tensor_conj U V a (fun _ => 1)
  have he2 := tensor_conj U V (fun _ => 1) h
  have he3 := tensor_conj U V (fun i => a i * Real.log (a i)) (fun _ => 1)
  have he4 := tensor_conj U V a (fun i => Real.log (h i))
  simp only [mul_one, hu, hv, one_mul] at he1 he2 he3
  rw [← he1, ← he2, perspective_diag (tensorU U V) _ _
    (fun i => ha _) (fun i => hh _), submatrix_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ← he3, ← he4, conj_diag_sub]
  congr 2
  apply congrArg diagonal
  funext i
  congr 1
  ring

name: perspective_tensor
statement:
private theorem perspective_tensor {d : ℕ}
    (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    matrixPerspective (fun x => -Real.log x)
      ((A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).submatrix finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm)
      (((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ⊗ₖ B).submatrix finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm) =
    (((A * matrixLog A) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) - (A ⊗ₖ matrixLog B)).submatrix
      finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm
proof:
:= by
  have he := perspective_tensor_diag hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary hB.1.eigenvectorUnitary
    hA.1.eigenvalues hB.1.eigenvalues hA.eigenvalues_pos hB.eigenvalues_pos
  have ha := hA.1.spectral_theorem
  have hb := hB.1.spectral_theorem
  have hla := hA.1.cfc_eq Real.log
  have hlb := hB.1.cfc_eq Real.log
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal] at ha hb hla hlb
  change cfc Real.log A = _ at hla
  have hal : A * matrixLog A =
      (hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix _ _ ℂ) *
        diagonal (fun i => ((hA.1.eigenvalues i * Real.log (hA.1.eigenvalues i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        star (hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix _ _ ℂ) := by
    rw [matrixLog, hla]
    conv_lhs => lhs; rw [ha]
    exact conj_diag_mul hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary _ _
  simpa only [← ha, ← hb, ← hal, ← hlb, matrixLog] using he

name: jointTensor_contraction
proof:
:= by
  unfold jointTensorEval
  congr 1
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv]
  simp only [finProdFinEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp [jointTensorVec, Matrix.kroneckerMap, Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diag]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  change (∑ x, ∑ y, if (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (x,y))).1 =
    (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (x,y))).2 then
    A i (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (x,y))).1 *
    H (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (x,y))).2 i else 0) = _
  simp

name: finish
statement:
private theorem finish {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (A H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.PosDef) (hH : H.PosDef)
    (ht : matrixLog H.transpose = (matrixLog H).transpose) :
    relativeEntropy A H =
      jointTensorEval (matrixPerspective (fun x => -Real.log x)
        (jointTensorLeft A) (jointTensorRight H)) - (Matrix.trace (A - H)).re
proof:
:= by
  have he := perspective_tensor A H.transpose hA hH.transpose
  unfold jointTensorLeft jointTensorRight
  rw [he, ht]
  have hsub :
      (((A * matrixLog A) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) - (A ⊗ₖ (matrixLog H).transpose)).submatrix
        finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm =
      (((A * matrixLog A) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).submatrix
        finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm) -
      ((A ⊗ₖ (matrixLog H).transpose).submatrix finProdFinEquiv.symm finProdFinEquiv.symm) := rfl
  rw [hsub, eval_sub, jointTensor_contraction]
  have hc := jointTensor_contraction (A * matrixLog A) (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
  simp only [transpose_one, mul_one] at hc
  rw [hc]
  simp [relativeEntropy_complex, mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, Complex.sub_re]

name: cfc_transpose
proof:
:= by
  let U := hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  let V := Matrix.UnitaryGroup.map_star U
  have ht (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
      ((U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) * star (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).transpose =
        (V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) * star (V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) := by
    simp only [transpose_mul, diagonal_transpose, star_eq_conjTranspose]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    congr 2
    change (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).transpose = ((U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ).map star).conjTranspose
    ext i j
    simp
  have hs := hH.spectral_theorem
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal] at hs
  rw [hs, ht, cfc_diag_conj, cfc_diag_conj, ht]

name: NLAlib.relativeEntropy_eq_jointTensorEval_sub_trace
statement:
theorem NLAlib.relativeEntropy_eq_jointTensorEval_sub_trace {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (A H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.PosDef) (hH : H.PosDef) :
    relativeEntropy A H =
      jointTensorEval (matrixPerspective (fun x => -Real.log x)
        (jointTensorLeft A) (jointTensorRight H)) - (Matrix.trace (A - H)).re
proof:
:= by
  exact finish A H hA hH (cfc_transpose H hH.1 Real.log)

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_lt_one
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_lt_one
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank]
  apply (pi_norm_lt_iff (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).mpr
  intro i
  have he := polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem (h.pos i)
    (h.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three hA i) k
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg he.1] using he.2

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_step_le
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_step_le
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 2))) ≤
      specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank, h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)).mpr
  intro i
  have hi := h.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three hA i
  have he := polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem (h.pos i) hi (k + 1)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg he.1]
  exact (polarSchulzScalar_defect_step_le (h.pos i) hi k).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem (h.pos i) hi k).1
      ((le_abs_self _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun i => 1 - polarSchulzScalar (σ i) (k + 1) ^ 2) i)) 2)

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzIterate_sub_polar_le_defect
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzIterate_sub_polar_le_defect
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1) - canonicalPartialPolar A) ≤
      specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : canonicalPartialPolar A = thinSingularMatrix U V (fun _ => 1) := by
    rw [h.canonicalPartialPolar_eq]
    simp [thinSingularMatrix]
  rw [h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank, h.polarSchulzIterate_eq,
    hQ, thinSingularMatrix_sub,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix U V h.left_orth h.right_orth]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).mpr
  intro i
  exact (abs_polarSchulzScalar_sub_one_le_defect (h.pos i)
    (h.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three hA i) k).trans
      ((le_abs_self _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun i => 1 - polarSchulzScalar (σ i) (k + 1) ^ 2) i))

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_le
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_le
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) ≤
      specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank, h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)).mpr
  intro i
  have hi := h.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three hA i
  have he := polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem (h.pos i) hi k
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg he.1]
  exact (polarSchulzScalar_defect_le (h.pos i) hi k).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem (h.pos i) hi 0).1
      ((le_abs_self _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun i => 1 - polarSchulzScalar (σ i) 1 ^ 2) i)) (2 ^ k))

name: NLAlib.polarSchulz_defect_and_error_bounds
statement:
theorem polarSchulz_defect_and_error_bounds (A : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) (k : ℕ) :
    (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))).PosSemidef ∧
    (1 - polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))).PosDef ∧
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) < 1 ∧
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 2))) ≤
      specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) ^ 2 ∧
    specNorm (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1) - canonicalPartialPolar A) ≤
      specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) ∧
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))) ≤
      specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  obtain ⟨hp, hi⟩ := h.polarSchulzDefect_posSemidef_and_sub_posDef hRank hA k
  exact ⟨hp, hi, h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_lt_one hRank hA k,
    h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_step_le hRank hA k,
    h.specNorm_polarSchulzIterate_sub_polar_le_defect hRank hA k,
    h.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_le hRank hA k⟩

name: NLAlib.inverseContraction_posDef
statement:
private theorem inverseContraction_posDef (X : M) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hX : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M)) : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef
proof:
:=
  ((Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hη).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hX).posDef

name: NLAlib.inverseContraction_sub_isUnit
statement:
private theorem inverseContraction_sub_isUnit (X T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η) (hX : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M)) : IsUnit (X-T)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
  rw [map_sub,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,sub_zero]
  exact inverseContraction_posDef X η hη hX

name: NLAlib.inverseContraction_kernel_integrable
statement:
private theorem inverseContraction_kernel_integrable
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (X : M) (hX : (imaginaryPart X : M).PosDef) :
    Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hiT : Integrable (fun T : selfAdjoint M => T.val) ν := by
    have hi := continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
    have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
    rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi
  have hiη := integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain ν hν
    (mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν
      (posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse X hX))
  apply (hiη.sub hiT).congr
  exact ae_of_all _ fun T => by
    change matrixKResolvent (-X⁻¹) T.val-T.val=T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val
    rw [matrixKResolvent_neg_inverse_eq X T.val hX T.property]
    abel

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inverseVariable_kernel_sub_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inverseVariable_kernel_sub_le
    (X Y T : M) (hT : T.IsHermitian) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hX : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M))
    (hY : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart Y : M)) :
    specNorm (T*(X-T)⁻¹*T-T*(Y-T)⁻¹*T)≤
      specNorm T^2*(η⁻¹)^2*specNorm (X-Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hXu := inverseContraction_sub_isUnit X T hT η hη hX
  have hYu := inverseContraction_sub_isUnit Y T hT η hη hY
  have hd : (X-T)⁻¹-(Y-T)⁻¹=(X-T)⁻¹*(Y-X)*(Y-T)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_sub_inv ⟨fun _ => hYu,fun _ => hXu⟩]
    congr 2
    abel
  have hXR := specNorm_inverseVariable_resolvent_le_inv X T hT η hη hX
  have hYR := specNorm_inverseVariable_resolvent_le_inv Y T hT η hη hY
  have hleft : specNorm (T*(X-T)⁻¹)≤specNorm T*η⁻¹ :=
    (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXR (specNorm_nonneg T))
  have hright : specNorm ((Y-T)⁻¹*T)≤η⁻¹*specNorm T :=
    (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hYR (specNorm_nonneg T))
  have hdiff : T*(X-T)⁻¹*T-T*(Y-T)⁻¹*T=
      (T*(X-T)⁻¹)*(Y-X)*((Y-T)⁻¹*T) := by
    rw [← Matrix.sub_mul,← Matrix.mul_sub,hd]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  calc
    _ = specNorm ((T*(X-T)⁻¹)*(Y-X)*((Y-T)⁻¹*T)) := by rw [hdiff]
    _ ≤ specNorm (T*(X-T)⁻¹)*specNorm (Y-X)*specNorm ((Y-T)⁻¹*T) :=
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (specNorm T*η⁻¹)*specNorm (Y-X)*(η⁻¹*specNorm T) := by
      have hNT := specNorm_nonneg T
      have hNXY := specNorm_nonneg (Y-X)
      have hNYT := specNorm_nonneg ((Y-T)⁻¹*T)
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [specNorm_sub_comm Y X]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixKInverseVariableMap_sub_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixKInverseVariableMap_sub_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (Z X Y : M) (η R : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hX : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M))
    (hY : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart Y : M)) :
    specNorm (matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X-matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z Y)≤
      (α*R^2*(η⁻¹)^2)*specNorm (X-Y)
proof:
:= by
  let f (X : M) (T : selfAdjoint M) := T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val
  have hiX : Integrable (f X) ν := inverseContraction_kernel_integrable ν hν X
    (inverseContraction_posDef X η hη hX)
  have hiY : Integrable (f Y) ν := inverseContraction_kernel_integrable ν hν Y
    (inverseContraction_posDef Y η hη hY)
  have he : matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X-matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z Y=
      -(α•∫ T,f X T-f Y T ∂ν) := by
    rw [integral_sub hiX hiY]
    unfold matrixKInverseVariableMap
    module
  have hI : specNorm (∫ T,f X T-f Y T ∂ν)≤R^2*(η⁻¹)^2*specNorm (X-Y) := by
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ T ∂ν, ‖f X T-f Y T‖≤R^2*(η⁻¹)^2*specNorm (X-Y) := by
      filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
      rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
      exact (specNorm_inverseVariable_kernel_sub_le X Y T.val T.property η hη hX hY).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg T.val) (hbound T hT) 2) (sq_nonneg η⁻¹))
          (specNorm_nonneg (X-Y)))
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,probReal_univ,mul_one] using
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt
  calc
    _ = α*specNorm (∫ T,f X T-f Y T ∂ν) := by
      rw [he,specNorm_eq_norm,norm_neg,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα,specNorm_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ α*(R^2*(η⁻¹)^2*specNorm (X-Y)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hα
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.exists_matrixKTransform_solution_of_imaginary_coercive_contraction
statement:
theorem exists_matrixKTransform_solution_of_imaginary_coercive_contraction
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Z : M) (η R : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hZ : η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart Z : M))
    (hsmall : α*R^2*(η⁻¹)^2<1) :
    ∃ S : M, (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef ∧ matrixKTransform ν α S=Z ∧
      specNorm S≤η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  let U : Set M := {X | η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M)}
  let Φ : M → M := matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z
  have hUc : IsClosed U := isClosed_Ici.preimage L.continuous
  have hmap : MapsTo Φ U U := by
    intro X hX
    exact hZ.trans (le_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap ν hν α hα.le Z X
      (inverseContraction_posDef X η hη hX))
  let K : ℝ≥0 := ⟨α*R^2*(η⁻¹)^2,by positivity⟩
  have hKcoe : (K : ℝ)=α*R^2*(η⁻¹)^2 := rfl
  have hcontract : ContractingWith K (hmap.restrict Φ U U) := by
    refine ⟨?_,LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun X Y => ?_⟩
    · exact hsmall
    · change dist (Φ X.val) (Φ Y.val)≤(K : ℝ)*dist X.val Y.val
      rw [hKcoe]
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm,specNorm_eq_norm,Φ] using
        specNorm_matrixKInverseVariableMap_sub_le ν hν α hα.le Z X.val Y.val
          η R hη hbound X.property Y.property
  let X0 : M := ((η : ℂ)*Complex.I)•1
  have hX0 : X0∈U := by
    have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
    change η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart (((η : ℂ)*Complex.I)•(1 : M)) : M)
    simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one]
  obtain ⟨X,hX,hfix,_,_⟩ := ContractingWith.exists_fixedPoint' hUc.isComplete hmap hcontract hX0
    (edist_ne_top X0 (Φ X0))
  have hXpos := inverseContraction_posDef X η hη hX
  refine ⟨-X⁻¹,posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse X hXpos,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq_iff_fixedPoint ν hν α hα.ne' Z X hXpos).mpr hfix.eq.symm
  · have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hXpos
    have he : X*(-X⁻¹)= -1 := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
      Matrix.norm_le_inv_of_mul_eq_neg_one_of_imaginaryPart_ge hη he hX

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_eq_eigenvector_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_eq_eigenvector_mul_diagonal
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ →+* 𝕜) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ i, z ≠ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) - A.map f)⁻¹ =
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).map f *
        diagonal (fun i => (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))⁻¹) *
          ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).map f)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).map f
  have hUtU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := by
    change (((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ)ᵀ).map f) * _ = _
    rw [← Matrix.map_mul, transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA,
      Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero f) (map_one f)]
  have hUUt : U * Uᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hUtU
  let φ : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 →+* Matrix ι ι 𝕜 :=
    { toFun := fun M => U * M * Uᵀ
      map_one' := by simp [hUUt]
      map_mul' := fun M N => by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U, hUtU, Matrix.one_mul]
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := fun M N => by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul] }
  have hAmap : A.map f = φ (diagonal (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues i))) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA]
    simp only [Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.diagonal_map (map_zero f)]
    rfl
  have hscalar : φ (z • 1) = z • 1 := by
    change U * (z • 1) * Uᵀ = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hUUt]
  have hdiag : z • (1 : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) - diagonal (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues i)) =
      diagonal (fun i => z - f (hA.eigenvalues i)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne hij]
  have hres : z • 1 - A.map f = φ (diagonal (fun i => z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))) := by
    rw [← hdiag, map_sub, hscalar, hAmap]
  have hprod : diagonal (fun i => z - f (hA.eigenvalues i)) *
      diagonal (fun i => (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))⁻¹) = (1 : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    have hentry (i : ι) : (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i)) * (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))⁻¹ = 1 :=
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz i))
    simp only [hentry, Matrix.diagonal_one]
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  change (z • 1 - A.map f) * φ (diagonal (fun i => (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))⁻¹)) = 1
  rw [hres, ← map_mul, hprod, map_one]

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_apply_eq_sum {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (f : ℝ →+* 𝕜) {z : 𝕜} (hz : ∀ i, z ≠ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) (r s : ι) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) - A.map f)⁻¹ r s =
      ∑ i, f ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) r) *
        f ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) s) / (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_smul_one_sub_map_eq_eigenvector_mul_diagonal hA f hz,
    Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
    Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.matrixKPotential_le_of_stable_scalar_solution
statement:
theorem matrixKPotential_le_of_stable_scalar_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (u : ℝ) (S : M)
    (hS : S ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α)
    (hKS : matrixKTransform ν α S = (u : ℂ) • 1)
    (Q : M) (hQ : Q ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α) :
    matrixKPotential ν α u S ≤ matrixKPotential ν α u Q
proof:
:= by
  let U : M := (u : ℂ) • 1
  let H : M := matrixKTransform ν α Q - U
  have hU : U.IsHermitian := by simp [U, Matrix.IsHermitian]
  have hKQ : (matrixKTransform ν α Q).IsHermitian := by
    have hdom : Q ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
      ⟨hQ.1.isUnit, fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator Q T.val hQ.1 (hQ.2.1 T hT)⟩
    unfold Matrix.IsHermitian
    rw [← matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α Q hdom, hQ.1.isHermitian.eq]
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := hKQ.sub hU
  have hUm : U ∈ (matrixKTransform ν α) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α := ⟨S, hS, hKS⟩
  have heUH : U + H = matrixKTransform ν α Q := by dsimp only [H]; abel
  have hUH : U + H ∈ (matrixKTransform ν α) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    rw [heUH]; exact mem_image_of_mem (matrixKTransform ν α) hQ
  have hpath (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      U + t • H ∈ (matrixKTransform ν α) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α :=
    (convex_image_matrixKTransform_stableDomain ν hν α hα).add_smul_mem hUm hUH ht
  let P : ℝ → M := fun t => matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + t • H)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => matrixKPotential ν α u (P t)
  have hD (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      ∃ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt f d t ∧ 0 ≤ d := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hPd, hDB⟩ :=
      exists_hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_affine ν hν α hα U H hH t (hpath t ht)
    obtain ⟨hPt, hKPt⟩ := matrixKStableInverse_mem_and_transform_eq ν α (hpath t ht)
    have hp := (hasFDerivAt_matrixKPotential ν hν α u hα.ne' (P t)
      hPt.1 hPt.2.1).comp_hasDerivAt t hPd
    have hdiff : matrixKTransform ν α (P t) - (u : ℂ) • 1 = t • H := by
      rw [hKPt]; change U + t • H - U = t • H; abel
    have hd : HasDerivAt f (α * t * (H * B).trace.re) t := by
      change HasDerivAt (fun r => matrixKPotential ν α u (P r))
        (α * ((matrixKTransform ν α (P t) - (u : ℂ) • 1) * B).trace.re) t at hp
      convert! hp using 1
      rw [hdiff, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul]
      simp only [Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (H * B).trace.re := by
      by_cases hB0 : B = 0
      · simp only [hB0, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.trace_zero, Complex.zero_re, le_refl]
      · have hpos := hPt.2.2 B hB hB0
        rw [hDB, frobInner_eq_trace, hB.eq, Matrix.trace_mul_comm] at hpos
        exact hpos.le
    exact ⟨_, hd, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα.le ht.1) hnonneg⟩
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := fun t ht =>
    (hD t ht).choose_spec.1.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (interior (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := fun t ht =>
    (hD t (interior_subset ht)).choose_spec.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hm : MonotoneOn f (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 1) hc hd fun t ht => by
      obtain ⟨d, hdt, hd0⟩ := hD t (interior_subset ht)
      rwa [hdt.deriv]
  have hend := hm (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 by constructor <;> norm_num)
    (show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 by constructor <;> norm_num) zero_le_one
  have hP0 : P 0 = S := by
    change matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + (0 : ℝ) • H) = S
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero, show U = matrixKTransform ν α S from hKS.symm]
    exact matrixKStableInverse_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα S hS
  have hP1 : P 1 = Q := by
    change matrixKStableInverse ν α (U + (1 : ℝ) • H) = Q
    rw [one_smul, heUH]
    exact matrixKStableInverse_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα Q hQ
  simpa only [f, hP0, hP1] using hend

name: NLAlib.le_cfc_sqrt_sq
statement:
theorem le_cfc_sqrt_sq {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hX : X.IsHermitian) :
    X ≤ cfc Real.sqrt (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    X = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) X := (cfc_id' ℝ X hX).symm
    _ ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (x ^ 2)) X := by
      exact cfc_mono (fun x _ => by
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
        exact le_abs_self x) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    _ = cfc Real.sqrt (X ^ 2) := cfc_comp_pow Real.sqrt 2 X (by fun_prop) hX

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_fromBlocks_matrixGeometricMean
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have hG := (posSemidef_matrixGeometricMean A B).isHermitian
  have h := Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ (matrixGeometricMean A B) B hA
  rw [hG.eq] at h
  apply h.mpr
  rw [matrixGeometricMean_mul_inv_mul hA hB, sub_self]
  exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

name: NLAlib.le_matrixGeometricMean_of_sqrt_mono
statement:
private theorem le_matrixGeometricMean_of_sqrt_mono
    (hmono : ∀ {C D : Matrix n n 𝕜}, C.PosSemidef → C ≤ D →
      cfc Real.sqrt C ≤ cfc Real.sqrt D)
    {A B X : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hX : X.IsHermitian) (hblock : (Matrix.fromBlocks A X X B).PosSemidef) :
    X ≤ matrixGeometricMean A B
proof:
:= by
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
  let S := cfc Real.sqrt A
  let Y := R * X * R
  let C := R * B * R
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hS : S.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hY : Y.IsHermitian := by
    dsimp [Y]
    simpa only [hR.eq] using Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose R hX
  have hRS : R * S = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hA
  have hSR : S * R = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA
  have hi : A⁻¹ = R * R := inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hA
  let : Invertible A := hA.isUnit.invertible
  have hschur := (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ X B hA).mp
    (by simpa only [hX.eq] using hblock)
  have hcong := hschur.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  have heq : R * (B - X.conjTranspose * A⁻¹ * X) * R.conjTranspose = C - Y ^ 2 := by
    rw [hX.eq, hR.eq, hi]
    dsimp [C, Y]
    noncomm_ring
  rw [heq] at hcong
  have hYY : (Y ^ 2).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [hY.eq, pow_two] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self Y
  have hYC : Y ≤ cfc Real.sqrt C :=
    (le_cfc_sqrt_sq hY).trans (hmono hYY (Matrix.le_iff.mpr hcong))
  have hfinal := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hYC).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same S
  have heq' : S * (cfc Real.sqrt C - Y) * S.conjTranspose = matrixGeometricMean A B - X := by
    rw [hS.eq]
    change S * (cfc Real.sqrt C - R * X * R) * S =
      S * cfc Real.sqrt C * S - X
    calc
      _ = S * cfc Real.sqrt C * S - (S * R) * X * (R * S) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hSR, hRS, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr (heq' ▸ hfinal)

name: NLAlib.matrixGeometricMean_block_maximum_real
statement:
theorem matrixGeometricMean_block_maximum_real {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A (matrixGeometricMean A B) (matrixGeometricMean A B) B).PosSemidef ∧
      ∀ X : Matrix n n ℝ, X.IsHermitian → (Matrix.fromBlocks A X X B).PosSemidef →
        X ≤ matrixGeometricMean A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨posSemidef_fromBlocks_matrixGeometricMean hA hB, fun X hX hblock => ?_⟩
  apply le_matrixGeometricMean_of_sqrt_mono (fun hC hCD => ?_) hA hX hblock
  rw [show Real.sqrt = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) from funext Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact cfc_rpow_le_cfc_rpow hC hCD
    (r := (1 : ℝ) / 2) (by constructor <;> norm_num)

name: NLAlib.matrixGeometricMean_block_maximum_complex
statement:
theorem matrixGeometricMean_block_maximum_complex {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A (matrixGeometricMean A B) (matrixGeometricMean A B) B).PosSemidef ∧
      ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.IsHermitian → (Matrix.fromBlocks A X X B).PosSemidef →
        X ≤ matrixGeometricMean A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨posSemidef_fromBlocks_matrixGeometricMean hA hB, fun X hX hblock => ?_⟩
  apply le_matrixGeometricMean_of_sqrt_mono (fun {C D} hC hCD => ?_) hA hX hblock
  have hD : D.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (hC.nonneg.trans hCD)
  have h := CFC.sqrt_le_sqrt C D hCD
  simpa only [CFC.sqrt_eq_real_sqrt C hC.nonneg, CFC.sqrt_eq_real_sqrt D hD.nonneg,
    cfcₙ_eq_cfc (hf0 := Real.sqrt_zero)] using h

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrix_inv
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : IsUnit Sᴴ := by simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hS.star
  have hdiff : S⁻¹*(S-Sᴴ)*S⁻¹ᴴ=S⁻¹ᴴ-S⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hstar),Matrix.mul_one]
  simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [hdiff]
  module

name: NLAlib.neg_imaginaryPart_matrix_inv_posDef
statement:
private theorem neg_imaginaryPart_matrix_inv_posDef
    {S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : (imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef) :
    (-(imaginaryPart S⁻¹ : Matrix n n ℂ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS
  rw [imaginaryPart_matrix_inv S hu,neg_neg]
  exact (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff
    (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hu)).mpr hS

name: NLAlib.isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
    (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef)
    (hT : T.IsHermitian) : IsUnit (1+S*T)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS
  have him : (imaginaryPart (-(S⁻¹+T)) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      -(imaginaryPart S⁻¹ : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    rw [map_neg,map_add,hT.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,add_zero]
    rfl
  have hA : IsUnit (S⁻¹+T) := by
    have hp : (imaginaryPart (-(S⁻¹+T)) : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef := by
      rw [him]
      exact neg_imaginaryPart_matrix_inv_posDef hS
    simpa only [neg_neg] using (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hp).neg
  have he : 1+S*T=S*(S⁻¹+T) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  rw [he]
  exact hu.mul hA

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_pushThrough
statement:
private theorem matrixKResolvent_pushThrough
    (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : IsUnit (1+S*T)) (hT : IsUnit (1+T*S)) :
    matrixKResolvent S T=(1+T*S)⁻¹*T
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (1+T*S)*T=T*(1+S*T) := by noncomm_ring
  have hmul : (1+T*S)*matrixKResolvent S T=T := by
    unfold matrixKResolvent
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,ht,Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    _ = ((1+T*S)⁻¹*(1+T*S))*matrixKResolvent S T := by
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hT),Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,hmul]

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_adjoint
statement:
private theorem matrixKResolvent_adjoint
    (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hT : T.IsHermitian)
    (hL : IsUnit (1+S*T)) (hR : IsUnit (1+T*S)) :
    matrixKResolvent Sᴴ T=(matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hLa : IsUnit (1+Sᴴ*T) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hR.star
  have hRa : IsUnit (1+T*Sᴴ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hL.star
  rw [matrixKResolvent_pushThrough Sᴴ T hLa hRa]
  simp only [matrixKResolvent,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,hT.eq]

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent
    (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef)
    (hT : T.IsHermitian) :
    (imaginaryPart (matrixKResolvent S T) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      -(matrixKResolvent S T*(imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ)*(matrixKResolvent S T)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart S T hS hT
  have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS
  have hR : IsUnit (1+T*S) := by
    have he : 1+T*S=S⁻¹*(1+S*T)*S := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
      simp only [Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [he]
    exact ((Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hu).mul hL).mul hu
  have hLa : IsUnit (1+Sᴴ*T) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hT.eq] using hR.star
  have ha := matrixKResolvent_adjoint S T hT hL hR
  have hd := matrixKResolvent_sub_matrixKResolvent S Sᴴ T hL hLa
  rw [ha] at hd
  simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe,Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  rw [hd]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_neg]

name: NLAlib.mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
proof:
:=
  ⟨Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS,fun T _ =>
    isUnit_matrixKDenominator_of_posDef_imaginaryPart S T.val hS T.property⟩

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : (imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef) :
    (imaginaryPart (matrixKTransform ν α S) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*(imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ)*S⁻¹ᴴ) -
        ∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val*(imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ)*
          (matrixKResolvent S T.val)ᴴ ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    (((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).subtype).comp imaginaryPart).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hL (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : L A=(imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) := rfl
  have hi := integrable_matrixKResolvent_of_mem_domain ν hν
    (mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν hS)
  have he : L (∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν) =
      -(∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val*(imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ)*
        (matrixKResolvent S T.val)ᴴ ∂ν) := by
    have heT (T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) : L (matrixKResolvent S T.val) =
        -(matrixKResolvent S T.val*(imaginaryPart S : Matrix n n ℂ)*
          (matrixKResolvent S T.val)ᴴ) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact imaginaryPart_matrixKResolvent S T.val hS T.property
    rw [← L.integral_comp_comm hi]
    simp_rw [heT]
    rw [integral_neg]
  change L ((∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν)-α⁻¹•S⁻¹)=_
  rw [map_sub,map_smul,he,hL,imaginaryPart_matrix_inv S (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS),smul_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.opNorm_le_of
statement:
private lemma opNorm_le_of {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    (M : Matrix p q ℂ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ x : q → ℂ, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (M *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ p)‖ ≤
      c * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ q)‖) : ‖M‖ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc fun x => ?_
  simpa [Matrix.toLpLin_apply] using h (WithLp.ofLp x)

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_le
statement:
private lemma norm_mulVec_le {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    (M : Matrix p q ℂ) (x : q → ℂ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (M *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ p)‖ ≤
      ‖M‖ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ q)‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec M (WithLp.toLp 2 x)

name: NLAlib.norm_sq_elim
statement:
private lemma norm_sq_elim {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (u : m → ℂ) (w : n → ℂ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Sum.elim u w) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (m ⊕ n))‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℂ m)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian
statement: private lemma isHermitian {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) : (dilation A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  unfold dilation
  simp [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.neg_mem_spectrum
statement:
private lemma neg_mem_spectrum {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ spectrum ℝ (dilation A)) : -r ∈ spectrum ℝ (dilation A)
proof:
:= by
  set S : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) ℂ := Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 (-1) with hS
  have hSS : S * S = 1 := by
    simp [hS, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  let u : (Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) ℂ)ˣ := ⟨S, S, hSS, hSS⟩
  have hconj : (u : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) ℂ) * dilation A *
      (↑(u⁻¹) : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) ℂ) = -dilation A := by
    show S * dilation A * S = -dilation A
    simp [hS, dilation, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_neg]
  have h1 : spectrum ℝ (-dilation A) = spectrum ℝ (dilation A) := by
    rw [← hconj, spectrum.units_conjugate]
  rw [← h1, ← spectrum.neg_eq, Set.mem_neg, neg_neg]
  exact hr

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_eq
statement:
private lemma lambdaMax_eq {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    lambdaMax (dilation A) = ‖dilation A‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsa : IsSelfAdjoint (dilation A) := isHermitian A
  have hmem : ‖dilation A‖ ∈ spectrum ℝ (dilation A) := by
    rcases CStarAlgebra.norm_or_neg_norm_mem_spectrum hsa with h | h
    · exact h
    · simpa using neg_mem_spectrum A h
  unfold lambdaMax
  refine IsGreatest.csSup_eq ⟨hmem, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hx
  exact (le_abs_self x).trans (by simpa using this)

name: NLAlib.norm_dilation_eq
statement:
private lemma norm_dilation_eq {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ‖dilation A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine opNorm_le_of _ (norm_nonneg _) fun x => ?_
    have hx : x = Sum.elim (x ∘ Sum.inl) (x ∘ Sum.inr) := by
      ext i; cases i <;> rfl
    have hHx : dilation A *ᵥ x = Sum.elim (A *ᵥ (x ∘ Sum.inr)) (Aᴴ *ᵥ (x ∘ Sum.inl)) := by
      simp [dilation, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec]
    rw [hHx]
    have h1 := norm_mulVec_le A (x ∘ Sum.inr)
    have h2 := norm_mulVec_le Aᴴ (x ∘ Sum.inl)
    rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at h2
    refine (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp ?_
    rw [norm_sq_elim, mul_pow, hx, norm_sq_elim]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at h1 h2 ⊢
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ fun i => x (Sum.inr i)) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)),
      norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (Aᴴ *ᵥ fun i => x (Sum.inl i)) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)),
      mul_le_mul h1 h1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity),
      mul_le_mul h2 h2 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)]
  · refine opNorm_le_of _ (norm_nonneg _) fun y => ?_
    have h := norm_mulVec_le (dilation A) (Sum.elim 0 y)
    have hHy : dilation A *ᵥ Sum.elim 0 y = Sum.elim (A *ᵥ y) 0 := by
      ext i; cases i <;> simp [dilation,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [hHy] at h
    have e1 : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Sum.elim (A *ᵥ y) 0) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m ⊕ Fin n))‖ =
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m))‖ := by
      rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), norm_sq_elim]; simp
    have e2 : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Sum.elim 0 y) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m ⊕ Fin n))‖ =
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n))‖ := by
      rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), norm_sq_elim]; simp
    rwa [e1, e2] at h

name: NLAlib.dilation_identities
statement:
theorem NLAlib.dilation_identities {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    (dilation A).IsHermitian ∧
    (dilation A) ^ 2 = Matrix.fromBlocks (A * A.conjTranspose) 0 0
      (A.conjTranspose * A) ∧
    lambdaMax (dilation A) = ‖dilation A‖ ∧
    ‖dilation A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:=
  ⟨isHermitian A, dilation_sq A,
    lambdaMax_eq A, norm_dilation_eq A⟩

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_inverseSchulz_step
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_inverseSchulz_step (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    1 - A * (X * (2 • 1 - A * X)) = (1 - A * X) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [two_smul]
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_inverseSchulzIterate
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_inverseSchulzIterate (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    1 - A * inverseSchulzIterate A X k = (1 - A * X) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [inverseSchulzIterate]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [inverseSchulzIterate, one_sub_mul_inverseSchulz_step, ih,
      ← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_of_spectralRadius_inverseSchulz_residual_lt_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_spectralRadius_inverseSchulz_residual_lt_one
    {A X : Matrix n n ℂ} (h : spectralRadius ℂ (1 - A * X) < 1) : IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  have hAX : IsUnit (A * X) := by
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using
      isUnit_one_sub_of_matrix_spectralRadius_lt_one h
  apply A.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mpr
  have hd := (A * X).isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hAX
  rw [Matrix.det_mul] at hd
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hd

name: NLAlib.inverseSchulzIterate_sub_inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_sub_mul_inverseSchulzIterate]
  have hi := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A (A.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hA)
  calc
    _ = A⁻¹ * (A * inverseSchulzIterate A X k) - A⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hi, one_mul]
    _ = _ := by noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_inverseSchulzIterate_inv
proof:
:= by
  have hA := isUnit_of_spectralRadius_inverseSchulz_residual_lt_one h
  have hpow := (tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one h).comp
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2))
  have ht := hpow.const_mul (-A⁻¹)
  have he : inverseSchulzIterate A X =
      fun k => -A⁻¹ * (1 - A * X) ^ (2 ^ k) + A⁻¹ := by
    funext k
    rw [← inverseSchulzIterate_sub_inv hA k, sub_add_cancel]
  rw [he]
  simpa using ht.add_const A⁻¹

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inverseSchulzIterate_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inverseSchulzIterate_sub_inv_le [Nonempty n] {A X : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsUnit A) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (inverseSchulzIterate A X k - A⁻¹) ≤
      specNorm A⁻¹ * specNorm (1 - A * X) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inverseSchulzIterate_sub_inv hA]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (-A⁻¹) * specNorm ((1 - A * X) ^ (2 ^ k)) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [specNorm_neg]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_pow_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.aeval_diagonal_eval₂
statement:
private theorem aeval_diagonal_eval₂ {R 𝕜 : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [CommSemiring 𝕜] [Algebra R 𝕜] (d : n → 𝕜) (p : R[X]) :
    aeval (Matrix.diagonal d) p = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => p.eval₂ (algebraMap R 𝕜) (d i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (Matrix.diagonalAlgHom R (n := n) (α := 𝕜)) d p
  simp only [Matrix.diagonalAlgHom_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [aeval_pi_apply₂, aeval_def]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_aeval_le_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp only [Subsingleton.elim (aeval A p) 0, Subsingleton.elim V 0,
      specNorm_zero, zero_mul, le_refl]
  · let i : n := Classical.choice hn
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM i)
    have hWV : W * V = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hVW
    have hAV : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d := by
      rw [hA, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hWV, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hpoly := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hAV p
    have hpA : aeval A p = V * Matrix.diagonal
        (fun j => p.eval₂ (algebraMap R 𝕜) (d j)) * W := by
      rw [← aeval_diagonal_eval₂, ← hpoly, Matrix.mul_assoc, hVW, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hD : specNorm (Matrix.diagonal (fun j => p.eval₂ (algebraMap R 𝕜) (d j))) ≤ M := by
      rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
      exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hM0).mpr hM
    rw [hpA]
    calc
      _ ≤ (specNorm V * specNorm (Matrix.diagonal
          (fun j => p.eval₂ (algebraMap R 𝕜) (d j)))) * specNorm W :=
        (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (specNorm V * M) * specNorm W :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_aeval_le_of_normal
statement:
theorem specNorm_aeval_le_of_normal {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (p : ℝ[X]) {M : ℝ} (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) z‖ ≤ M) :
    specNorm (aeval A p) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, d, hAd⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix n n ℂ) := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hUd : A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [hAd, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hpoly := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hUd p
  have hpA : aeval A p = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i => p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (d i)) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    rw [← aeval_diagonal_eval₂, ← hpoly, Matrix.mul_assoc, hUU, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hs : spectrum ℂ A = Set.range d := by
    rw [hAd]
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, spectrum_diagonal]
      using Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal d) (U := U)
  rw [hpA, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hM0).mpr (fun i => hM (d i) (by rw [hs]; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩))

name: NLAlib.map_ofReal_aeval
statement:
theorem map_ofReal_aeval (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (aeval A p).map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) = aeval (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)) p
proof:
:= by
  let φ : Matrix n n ℝ →ₐ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    { toRingHom := (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).mapMatrix
      commutes' := by
        intro c
        ext i j
        by_cases hij : i = j <;>
          simp [Matrix.algebraMap_eq_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal, Matrix.map_apply, hij] }
  exact (Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply φ A p).symm

name: Matrix.support_quadratic_stieltjes_subset_trace_support
statement:
theorem support_quadratic_stieltjes_subset_trace_support
    (N : ℂ → M)
    (hN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (N z) : M).PosSemidef)
    (μ ρ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (v : n → ℂ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → NLAlib.normalizedTrace (N z)=
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (hρ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z)=
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ : Measure ℝ)) :
    (ρ : Measure ℝ).support⊆(μ : Measure ℝ).support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (μ : Measure ℝ).isClosed_support.isOpen_compl x hnot
  let r := ε/2
  have hr : 0<r := half_pos hε
  have hsepx : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), ε≤|ξ-x| := by
    filter_upwards [(μ : Measure ℝ).support_mem_ae] with ξ hξ
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hh
    have hball : ξ∈ball x ε := by simpa only [mem_ball,Real.dist_eq] using hh
    exact (hεsub hball) hξ
  apply (notMem_support_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul (ρ : Measure ℝ) x r
    (‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*
      (r⁻¹)^2*(μ.mass : ℝ)) hr ?_) hx
  intro y hy γ hγ
  have hγpos : 0<(γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
  let z : ℂ := (y : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I
  have hz : 0<z.im := by simpa [z] using hγpos
  have hsep : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), r≤|ξ-y| := by
    filter_upwards [hsepx] with ξ hξ
    have hy' : |y-x|<r := by simpa only [mem_ball,Real.dist_eq] using hy
    have htri : |ξ-x|≤|ξ-y|+|y-x| := by
      simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using abs_add_le (ξ-y) (y-x)
    dsimp only [r] at *
    linarith
  have hmuBound := im_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le_of_ae_dist_ge (μ : Measure ℝ) y r hr γ hγ hsep
  have hmuBound' : (NLAlib.normalizedTrace (N z)).im≤
      (r⁻¹)^2*(μ.mass : ℝ)*(γ : ℝ) := by
    rw [hμ z hz]
    have hm : (μ : Measure ℝ).real univ=(μ.mass : ℝ) := by
      rw [Measure.real,← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,ENNReal.coe_toReal]
    rw [hm] at hmuBound
    convert! hmuBound using 1
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,inv_pow]
    ring
  rw [← hρ z hz,im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v (imaginaryPart (N z) : M)‖ := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖*‖(imaginaryPart (N z) : M)‖ :=
      (matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v).le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖*((Fintype.card n : ℝ)*
        (NLAlib.normalizedTrace (N z)).im) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_imaginaryPart_le_card_mul_im_normalizedTrace (N z) (hN z hz))
        (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖*((Fintype.card n : ℝ)*
        ((r⁻¹)^2*(μ.mass : ℝ)*(γ : ℝ))) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) :
    matrixExp (s • A) = cfc (fun x => Real.exp (s * x)) A
proof:
:= by
  letI := normedAlgebraRealMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) (d := d)
  rw [matrixExp, ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp
    (hA.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial s))),
    ← cfc_comp_const_mul s Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint]

name: NLAlib.traceExp_smul_eq_sum
statement:
theorem traceExp_smul_eq_sum (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (θ : ℝ) :
    traceExp (θ • A) = ∑ i, Real.exp (θ * hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  letI := normedAlgebraRealMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) (d := d)
  rw [traceExp, matrixExp,
    ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp (hA.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial θ)))]
  rw [← cfc_comp_const_mul θ Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint, hA.cfc_eq]
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp

name: NLAlib.le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le
statement:
theorem le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {L : ℝ}
    (hb : lambdaMax A ≤ L) : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, x ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hfin : (spectrum ℝ A).Finite := by
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]; exact Set.finite_range _
  exact (le_csSup hfin.bddAbove hx).trans hb

name: NLAlib.abs_le_norm_of_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem abs_le_norm_of_mem_spectrum [Nonempty d] (B : Matrix d d 𝕜) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℝ B) : |x| ≤ ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  have h : algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 x ∈ spectrum 𝕜 B := (spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff 𝕜).mpr hx
  have := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem h
  simpa using this

name: NLAlib.one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_eq_cfc (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (θ c : ℝ) :
    1 + θ • A + c • A ^ 2 = cfc (fun x => 1 + θ * x + c * x ^ 2) A
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := cfc_add A (fun x => 1 + θ * x) (fun x => c * x ^ 2)
  have e2 := cfc_const_add 1 (fun x => θ * x) A
  rw [e1, e2, cfc_const_mul_id θ A, cfc_const_mul c (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) A,
    cfc_pow_id A 2 hA.isSelfAdjoint, map_one]

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_smul_le_one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_of_spectrum_le
statement:
theorem matrixExp_smul_le_one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_of_spectrum_le
    (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {θ c : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, Real.exp (θ * x) ≤ 1 + θ * x + c * x ^ 2) :
    matrixExp (θ • A) ≤ 1 + θ • A + c • A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc A hA θ, one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_eq_cfc A hA θ c]
  exact cfc_mono hb

name: NLAlib.one_add_le_matrixExp_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem one_add_le_matrixExp_of_isHermitian (B : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    1 + B ≤ matrixExp B
proof:
:= by
  letI := normedAlgebraRealMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) (d := d)
  have e1 : 1 + B = cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) B := by
    rw [cfc_const_add (1 : ℝ) (fun x : ℝ => x) B, cfc_id' ℝ B hB.isSelfAdjoint, map_one]
  rw [matrixExp, ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hB, e1]
  exact cfc_mono (fun x _ => by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x])

name: NLAlib.norm_reindex
statement: theorem norm_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) : ‖Matrix.reindex e e A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← specNorm_eq_norm, ← specNorm_eq_norm, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.spectrum_reindex
statement:
theorem spectrum_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) :
    spectrum ℝ (Matrix.reindex e e A) = spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  have h := AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℝ 𝕜 e) A
  rwa [Matrix.coe_reindexAlgEquiv] at h

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_reindex
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) :
    lambdaMax (Matrix.reindex e e A) = lambdaMax A
proof:
:= by
  unfold lambdaMax
  rw [spectrum_reindex]

@[simp]
theorem dilationLinearMap_apply {m n : Type*} (X : Matrix m n 𝕜) :

proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.dilation_sq
statement:

    dilation X ^ 2 = fromBlocks (X * Xᴴ) 0 0 (Xᴴ * X)
proof:
