name: NLAlib.fromBlocks₁₁CLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fromBlocks₁₁CLM_apply (P : Matrix m m 𝕜) :
    fromBlocks₁₁CLM n P = fromBlocks P 0 0 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks₂₂CLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fromBlocks₂₂CLM_apply (Q : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    fromBlocks₂₂CLM m Q = fromBlocks 0 0 0 Q
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag
proof:
:= by
  refine PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    (IsHermitian.fromBlocks hP.1 (by simp) hQ.1) fun x => ?_
  have e : star x ⬝ᵥ (fromBlocks P 0 0 Q *ᵥ x) =
      star (x ∘ Sum.inl) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ (x ∘ Sum.inl)) +
        star (x ∘ Sum.inr) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ (x ∘ Sum.inr)) := by
    rw [fromBlocks_mulVec]
    simp [dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  rw [e]
  exact add_nonneg (hP.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg _) (hQ.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.norm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem norm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {E : Matrix k m 𝕜} (hE : HasOrthonormalCols E) (M : Matrix k k 𝕜) :
    ‖Eᴴ * M * E‖ ≤ ‖M‖
proof:
:= by
  have hE1 : ‖E‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : ‖(1 : Matrix m m 𝕜)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← diagonal_one, l2_opNorm_diagonal]
      exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun _ => by simp
    have h2 : ‖E‖ * ‖E‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, hE.conjTranspose_mul_self]; exact h1
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg E]
  calc ‖Eᴴ * M * E‖ ≤ ‖Eᴴ * M‖ * ‖E‖ := l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ ‖Eᴴ‖ * ‖M‖ * ‖E‖ := by gcongr; exact l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖M‖ * 1 := by
      rw [l2_opNorm_conjTranspose]; gcongr
    _ = ‖M‖ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_fromBlocks_diag
statement:
theorem norm_fromBlocks_diag (P : Matrix m m 𝕜) (Q : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ‖fromBlocks P 0 0 Q‖ = max ‖P‖ ‖Q‖
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [cstar_norm_def]
    set c := max ‖P‖ ‖Q‖
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _)) fun x => ?_
    let x₁ : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (Sum.inl i))
    let x₂ : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (Sum.inr i))
    have h1 := l2_opNorm_mulVec P x₁
    have h2 := l2_opNorm_mulVec Q x₂
    have hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖x₂‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_sum_type, x₁, x₂]
    have hT : ‖toEuclideanCLM (n := m ⊕ n) (𝕜 := 𝕜) (fromBlocks P 0 0 Q) x‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv m 𝕜).symm (P *ᵥ x₁)‖ ^ 2 +
          ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv n 𝕜).symm (Q *ᵥ x₂)‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
      simp [fromBlocks_mulVec, Fintype.sum_sum_type, x₁, x₂, Function.comp_def]
    have hP : ‖P‖ ≤ c := le_max_left _ _
    have hQ : ‖Q‖ ≤ c := le_max_right _ _
    refine (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp ?_
    rw [hT, mul_pow, hx, mul_add]
    gcongr
    · calc _ ≤ (‖P‖ * ‖x₁‖) ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ _ := by rw [mul_pow]; gcongr
    · calc _ ≤ (‖Q‖ * ‖x₂‖) ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ _ := by rw [mul_pow]; gcongr
  · apply max_le
    · have h := norm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le (E := fromRows (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) (0 : Matrix n m 𝕜))
        (by ext i j; simp [mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, one_apply, eq_comm])
        (fromBlocks P 0 0 Q)
      have heq : P = (fromRows (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) (0 : Matrix n m 𝕜))ᴴ * fromBlocks P 0 0 Q *
          (fromRows (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) (0 : Matrix n m 𝕜)) := by
        ext i j; simp [mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, one_apply]
      exact (congrArg norm heq).trans_le h
    · have h := norm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le (E := fromRows (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))
        (by ext i j; simp [mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, one_apply, eq_comm])
        (fromBlocks P 0 0 Q)
      have heq : Q = (fromRows (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))ᴴ * fromBlocks P 0 0 Q *
          (fromRows (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) := by
        ext i j; simp [mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, one_apply]
      exact (congrArg norm heq).trans_le h

name: NLAlib.cfc_eq_sum_smul_eigenvectorProjector
statement:
theorem cfc_eq_sum_smul_eigenvectorProjector {A : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f A = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i) • eigenvectorProjector hA i
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,
    ← Matrix.sum_single_eq_diagonal, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have : Matrix.single i i ((RCLike.ofReal ∘ f ∘ hA.eigenvalues) i : 𝕜)
      = f (hA.eigenvalues i) • (Matrix.single i i (1 : 𝕜)) := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_single]; simp [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
  rw [this, eigenvectorProjector, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

name: NLAlib.smul_sq_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem smul_sq_eq_cfc (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    c • A ^ 2 = cfc (fun x => c * x ^ 2) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_const_mul c (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) A, cfc_pow_id A 2 hA.isSelfAdjoint]

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_smul_sq_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem matrixExp_smul_sq_eq_cfc (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    matrixExp (c • A ^ 2) = cfc (fun x => Real.exp (c * x ^ 2)) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc (A ^ 2) (hA.pow 2) c,
    ← cfc_comp_pow (fun y => Real.exp (c * y)) 2 A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint]

name: NLAlib.ridgeKernel_le_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem ridgeKernel_le_rangeProjector (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeKernel A ρ ≤ rangeProjector A
proof:
:= by
  let P := rangeProjector A
  have hP : P.IsHermitian := rangeProjector_isHermitian A
  have hPP : P * P = P := rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem A
  have hK : (ridgeKernel A ρ).IsHermitian := (posSemidef_ridgeKernel A hρ).isHermitian
  have hPK : P * ridgeKernel A ρ = ridgeKernel A ρ := by
    calc
      P * ridgeKernel A ρ = (P * A) * (ridgeGram A ρ)⁻¹ * Aᵀ := by
        simp only [ridgeKernel, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = ridgeKernel A ρ := by
        rw [show P * A = A from rangeProjector_mul A]
        rfl
  have hKP : ridgeKernel A ρ * P = ridgeKernel A ρ := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hPK
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hP.eq, hK.eq] using h
  have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp (ridgeKernel_le_one A hρ)).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same P
  have heq : P * (1 - ridgeKernel A ρ) * Pᴴ = P - ridgeKernel A ρ := by
    rw [hP.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.sub_mul, hPP, hPK, hKP]
  rw [heq] at hp
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr hp

name: NLAlib.one_sub_rangeProjector_le_smul_inv_ridgeGram
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  have hp := Matrix.le_iff.mp (ridgeKernel_le_rangeProjector A hρ)
  rw [ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv A hρ] at hp
  convert hp using 1
  abel

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank_add_div_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank_add_div_bestRankFrobSq (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (k : ℕ) :
    ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ ≤ (k : ℝ) + bestRankFrobSq A k / ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hopt0 : 0 ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k := by
    unfold bestRankFrobSq
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> positivity
  by_cases hk : k ≤ Fintype.card m
  · let f := fun i : ℕ => singularValues A i ^ 2 / (singularValues A i ^ 2 + ρ)
    have hsplit : ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ =
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (Fintype.card m), f i := by
      rw [ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_sum_singularValues A hρ]
      exact (Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico f hk).symm
    have hhead : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
      calc
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          exact (div_le_one (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _) hρ)).2 (by linarith)
        _ = (k : ℝ) := by simp
    have hopt : bestRankFrobSq A k =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (Fintype.card m), singularValues A i ^ 2 := by
      unfold bestRankFrobSq
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hk]
      have hz : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
          if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i hi
        exact if_neg (not_le.mpr (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
      rw [hz, zero_add]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact if_pos (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1
    have htail : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (Fintype.card m), f i ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k / ρ := by
      calc
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (Fintype.card m), f i ≤
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (Fintype.card m), singularValues A i ^ 2 / ρ := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) hρ
            (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _))
        _ = bestRankFrobSq A k / ρ := by rw [← Finset.sum_div, hopt]
    rw [hsplit]
    exact add_le_add hhead htail
  · have hr : (A.rank : ℝ) ≤ k := by
      exact_mod_cast A.rank_le_card_height.trans (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hk))
    exact (ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank A hρ).trans
      (hr.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hopt0 hρ.le)))

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_tail_div_rank_le_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hρ : 0 < bestRankFrobSq A k / k := div_pos htail hk0
  have h := ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank_add_div_bestRankFrobSq A hρ k
  have he : bestRankFrobSq A k / (bestRankFrobSq A k / k) = (k : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt htail, ne_of_gt hk0]
  simpa only [he, two_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_piRing_le
statement:
private theorem norm_piRing_le {κ V : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (D : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] V) :
    ‖ContinuousLinearEquiv.piRing (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V) κ D‖ ≤ ‖D‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg D)).mpr
  intro j
  change ‖D (Pi.single j 1)‖ ≤ ‖D‖
  simpa only [Pi.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one] using D.le_opNorm (Pi.single j 1)

name: NLAlib.opNorm_piRing_le
statement:
private theorem opNorm_piRing_le {κ V : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] :
    ‖(ContinuousLinearEquiv.piRing (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V) κ).toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro D
  simpa only [one_mul] using! norm_piRing_le D

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_piRing_comp
statement:
private theorem hasFDerivAt_piRing_comp
    {κ V W : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W]
    (f : W → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] V) (D : W →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] V) (y : W)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f D y) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w => ContinuousLinearEquiv.piRing (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V) κ (f w))
      ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.piRing (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V) κ).toContinuousLinearMap.comp D) y
proof:
:= by
  exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.piRing (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V) κ).toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp y hf

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_apply (h : E) (v : F) :
    hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing h v = (T).symm v h
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficients
statement:
@[simp] theorem hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficients
    (A : M) (ζ : ℂ) (y h : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing h (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ y) =
      hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y h
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients,
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_sub_coefficients
statement:
theorem hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_sub_coefficients
    (A : M) (ζ : ℂ) (y z h : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing h
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ y-hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ z) =
        hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y h-hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ z h
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficients,
    hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficients]

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficientsDeriv
statement:
@[simp] theorem hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficientsDeriv
    (A : M) (ζ : ℂ) (y k h : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing h (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A ζ y k) =
      hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y k h
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_apply]
  change (T).symm (T (hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y k)) h = _
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ)
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A ζ y) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasFDerivAt_piRing_comp
    (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ) (hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y) y
    (by simpa only using! hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A hA ζ hζ y)
  exact h

name: NLAlib.continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients
statement:
theorem continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ)
proof:
:=
  (T).continuous.comp (continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A hA ζ hζ)

name: NLAlib.continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv
statement:
theorem continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A ζ)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A hA ζ hζ).const_clm_comp (T).toContinuousLinearMap

name: NLAlib.norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients_le
statement:
theorem norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients_le (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ y‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹^2 * ‖L‖
proof:
:=
  (norm_piRing_le _).trans (norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_le A hA ζ hζ y)

name: NLAlib.norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv_le (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (y : E) :
    ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A ζ y‖ ≤ 2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^3 * ‖L‖^2
proof:
:= by
  apply (opNorm_comp_le _ _).trans
  have hT := opNorm_piRing_le (κ := J) (V := M)
  calc
    ‖(T).toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y‖ ≤
        1 * (2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^3 * ‖L‖^2) :=
      mul_le_mul hT (norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_le A hA ζ hζ y)
        (norm_nonneg (hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv A ζ y)) zero_le_one
    _ = _ := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_smul_one_eq_exp_smul_one
statement:
theorem matrixExp_smul_one_eq_exp_smul_one (t : ℝ) :
    matrixExp (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) = Real.exp t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)
  rw [matrixExp, ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp ht]
  have heq : t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) t := by
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [heq, cfc_algebraMap]
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_smul_one_eq_exp_mul
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_smul_one_eq_exp_mul (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    traceExp (A + t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) = Real.exp t * traceExp A
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  have hc : Commute A (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) := (Commute.one_right A).smul_right t
  have he : matrixExp (A + t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) =
      matrixExp A * matrixExp (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) := NormedSpace.exp_add_of_commute hc
  rw [traceExp_complex, traceExp_complex, he, matrixExp_smul_one_eq_exp_smul_one, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_smul]
  simp only [Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.traceExp_le_exp_mul_traceExp_of_norm_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  have hd : A - B ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) δ := by
    apply le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le _ (hA.sub hB)
    intro x hx
    have hnorm : |x| ≤ ‖A - B‖ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hx
    exact (le_abs_self x).trans (hnorm.trans hδ)
  have hle : A ≤ B + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, add_comm] using sub_le_iff_le_add.mp hd
  have hh : (B + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).IsHermitian :=
    hB.add (Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  exact (traceExp_le_traceExp A _ hA hh hle).trans_eq
    (traceExp_add_smul_one_eq_exp_mul B δ)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    0 ≤ traceExp A
proof:
:= by
  have h := (posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp A hA).1.posSemidef.trace_nonneg
  exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp h).1

name: NLAlib.traceExp_smul_one_eq_card_mul_exp
statement:
theorem traceExp_smul_one_eq_card_mul_exp (t : ℝ) :
    traceExp (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) = Fintype.card n * Real.exp t
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceExp_complex, matrixExp_smul_one_eq_exp_smul_one, Matrix.trace_smul]
  simp only [Matrix.trace_one, Complex.smul_re, Complex.natCast_re, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul
statement:
theorem exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    [Nonempty d] (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (θ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ traceExp (θ • A) ∧
    (0 < θ → Real.exp (θ * lambdaMax A) ≤ traceExp (θ • A)) ∧
    (θ < 0 → Real.exp (θ * lambdaMin A) ≤ traceExp (θ • A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceExp_smul_eq_sum A hA θ]
  have hn : (Set.range hA.eigenvalues).Nonempty := Set.range_nonempty _
  have hf : (Set.range hA.eigenvalues).Finite := Set.finite_range _
  have hmax : lambdaMax A ∈ Set.range hA.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [lambdaMax, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hn.csSup_mem hf
  have hmin : lambdaMin A ∈ Set.range hA.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [lambdaMin, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hn.csInf_mem hf
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  constructor
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmax
    rw [← hi]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => (Real.exp_pos (θ * hA.eigenvalues j)).le) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmin
    rw [← hi]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => (Real.exp_pos (θ * hA.eigenvalues j)).le) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_le_card_mul_exp_lambdaMax
statement:
theorem traceExp_le_card_mul_exp_lambdaMax (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceExp A ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lambdaMax A)
proof:
:= by
  have he := traceExp_smul_eq_sum A hA 1
  rw [one_smul] at he
  rw [he]
  simp only [one_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : n, Real.exp (lambdaMax A) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le A hA le_rfl _
        (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.traceExp_pos_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem traceExp_pos_of_isHermitian {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] [Nonempty d]
    (H : Matrix d d ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) : 0 < traceExp H
proof:
:= by
  have h := traceExp_smul_eq_sum H hH 1
  rw [one_smul] at h
  rw [h]
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: NLAlib.traceExp_smul_le_mul_exp_mul_norm
statement:
theorem traceExp_smul_le_mul_exp_mul_norm {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) : traceExp (c • B) ≤ d * Real.exp (c * ‖B‖)
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceExp_smul_eq_sum B hB c]
  calc ∑ i, Real.exp (c * hB.eigenvalues i) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin d, Real.exp (c * ‖B‖) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (abs_le_norm_of_mem_spectrum B (hB.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i))
    _ = d * Real.exp (c * ‖B‖) := by simp

name: NLAlib.norm_matrixExp_sum_le_prod
statement:
theorem norm_matrixExp_sum_le_prod {d N : ℕ}
    (A : Fin N → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian) :
    ‖matrixExp (∑ k, A k)‖ ≤ ∏ k, (1 + ‖matrixExp (A k)‖)
proof:
:= by
  let b : Fin N → ℝ := fun k => Real.log (1 + ‖matrixExp (A k)‖)
  have hb (k : Fin N) : A k ≤ algebraMap ℝ _ (b k) := by
    apply le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le _ (hA k)
    intro x hx
    apply Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by positivity) |>.2
    have hx' := norm_apply_le_norm_cfc Real.exp (A k) hx Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn (hA k)
    rw [CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp (hA k)] at hx'
    have hx'' : Real.exp x ≤ ‖matrixExp (A k)‖ := by
      simpa [matrixExp, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos x)] using hx'
    exact hx''.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
  have hsum : (∑ k, A k).IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hA k)
  have hsumle : (∑ k, A k) ≤ algebraMap ℝ _ (∑ k, b k) := by
    simpa only [map_sum] using Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.univ) => hb k)
  calc
    ‖matrixExp (∑ k, A k)‖ = ‖cfc Real.exp (∑ k, A k)‖ := by
      rw [CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hsum, matrixExp]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (∑ k, b k) := by
      apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
      intro x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos x)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hsum).1 hsumle x hx)
    _ = ∏ k, (1 + ‖matrixExp (A k)‖) := by
      rw [Real.exp_sum]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      exact Real.exp_log (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.continuous_traceExp
statement: theorem continuous_traceExp : Continuous (traceExp : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  exact Complex.continuous_re.comp
    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.continuous.comp NormedSpace.exp_continuous)

name: NLAlib.exp_sub_le_traceExp_compensated_of_crossing
statement:
theorem exp_sub_le_traceExp_compensated_of_crossing (Y W : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hY : Y.IsHermitian) (hW : W.IsHermitian) {θ g t v : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hg : 0 ≤ g) (ht : t ≤ lambdaMax Y) (hv : ‖W‖ ≤ v) :
    Real.exp (θ * t - g * v) ≤ traceExp (θ • Y - g • W)
proof:
:= by
  have hWUpper : W ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) v := by
    apply le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le _ hW
    intro x hx
    have hnorm : |x| ≤ ‖W‖ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hx
    exact (le_abs_self x).trans (hnorm.trans hv)
  have hscale := matrix_smul_le_smul_of_nonneg hWUpper hg
  have hscale' : g • W ≤ (g * v) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_smul] using hscale
  have hLoewner : θ • Y - (g * v) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ θ • Y - g • W :=
    sub_le_sub_left hscale' _
  have hleft : (θ • Y - (g * v) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).IsHermitian :=
    (hY.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)).sub (Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hright : (θ • Y - g • W).IsHermitian :=
    (hY.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)).sub (hW.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hmono := traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hleft hright hLoewner
  have hshift : traceExp (θ • Y - (g * v) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) =
      Real.exp (-(g * v)) * traceExp (θ • Y) := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul] using traceExp_add_smul_one_eq_exp_mul (θ • Y) (-(g * v))
  rw [hshift] at hmono
  calc
    Real.exp (θ * t - g * v) = Real.exp (-(g * v)) * Real.exp (θ * t) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(g * v)) * Real.exp (θ * lambdaMax Y) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(g * v)) * traceExp (θ • Y) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul Y hY θ).2.1 hθ) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ ≤ traceExp (θ • Y - g • W) := hmono

name: NLAlib.convexOn_traceExp_smul_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem convexOn_traceExp_smul_selfAdjoint {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (θ : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ
      (fun A : selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) => traceExp (θ • A.val))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro A _ B _ a b ha hb hab
  have hA : (θ • A.val).IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSelfAdjoint.mpr selfAdjoint.isSelfAdjoint).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)
  have hB : (θ • B.val).IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSelfAdjoint.mpr selfAdjoint.isSelfAdjoint).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)
  have hh := (convexOn_traceExp_isHermitian (d := d)).2 hA hB ha hb hab
  simpa only [selfAdjoint.val_smul, AddSubgroup.coe_add, smul_add, smul_smul,
    mul_comm θ] using hh

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_cross_kernel_fromBlocks
statement:
private theorem posSemidef_cross_kernel_fromBlocks
    (A B X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : specNorm X ≤ 1) :
    (fromBlocks (A * Aᴴ) (A * X * Bᴴ) (A * X * Bᴴ)ᴴ (B * Bᴴ)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have h := (posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks_of_specNorm_le_one hX).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
    (fromBlocks A 0 0 B)
  convert! h using 1
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero,
    Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_one, add_zero, zero_add,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_integral_cross_kernel_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem posSemidef_integral_cross_kernel_fromBlocks
    (A B : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hAA : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * (A ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hBB : Integrable (fun ω => B ω * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hAB : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hX : specNorm X ≤ 1) :
    (fromBlocks (∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)
      (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)ᴴ (∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let F : Ω → Matrix (n ⊕ n) (n ⊕ n) ℂ := fun ω =>
    fromBlocks (A ω * (A ω)ᴴ) (A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ)
      (A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ)ᴴ (B ω * (B ω)ᴴ)
  have hABstar : Integrable (fun ω => (A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ)ᴴ) μ := by
    let L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
      (starₗᵢ ℝ : Matrix n n ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
    exact L.integrable_comp hAB
  have hF : Integrable F μ := by
    apply Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
    · exact (Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mp hAA) i j
    · exact (Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mp hAB) i j
    · exact (Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mp hABstar) i j
    · exact (Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mp hBB) i j
  have hFpos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ F ω := ae_of_all _ fun ω =>
    (posSemidef_cross_kernel_fromBlocks (A ω) (B ω) X hX).nonneg
  have hInt : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (integral_nonneg_of_ae hFpos)
  have he : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) =
      fromBlocks (∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)
        (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)ᴴ (∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) := by
    rw [← Matrix.integral_conjTranspose]
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.integral_apply hF]
    rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
    · exact (Matrix.integral_apply hAA i j).symm
    · exact (Matrix.integral_apply hAB i j).symm
    · exact (Matrix.integral_apply hABstar i j).symm
    · exact (Matrix.integral_apply hBB i j).symm
  rw [he] at hInt
  exact hInt

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_cross_kernel_le_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_cross_kernel_le_one
    (A B : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hAA : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * (A ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hBB : Integrable (fun ω => B ω * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hAB : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hA : (∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) ≤ 1)
    (hB : (∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) ≤ 1)
    (hX : specNorm X ≤ 1) :
    specNorm (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hInt := posSemidef_integral_cross_kernel_fromBlocks A B X hAA hBB hAB hX
  have hdiag := posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA) (Matrix.le_iff.mp hB)
  have hsum := hInt.add hdiag
  have hsumEq :
      fromBlocks (∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)
          (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)ᴴ (∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) +
        fromBlocks (1 - ∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) 0 0 (1 - ∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) =
      fromBlocks 1 (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)
        (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)ᴴ 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_add]
    simp
  rw [hsumEq] at hsum
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact norm_le_one_of_posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks hsum

name: NLAlib.posDef_cross_diag
statement:
private theorem posDef_cross_diag {P Q : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hP : P.PosDef) (hQ : Q.PosDef) : (fromBlocks P 0 0 Q).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply (posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag hP.posSemidef hQ.posSemidef).posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
  exact Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.mpr ⟨hP.isUnit,hQ.isUnit⟩

name: NLAlib.norm_lt_one_of_posDef_complex_identity_fromBlocks
statement:
private theorem norm_lt_one_of_posDef_complex_identity_fromBlocks
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : (fromBlocks 1 X Xᴴ 1).PosDef) : ‖X‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := norm_le_one_of_posSemidef_identity_fromBlocks hX.posSemidef
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hle
  intro he
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have hz : X = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hz] at he
  · have hs := CStarAlgebra.norm_mem_spectrum_of_nonneg
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X).nonneg
    rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self,he,one_mul] at hs
    have hu : IsUnit (1-Xᴴ*X) := by
      apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
      have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hX.isUnit
      rwa [Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁] at hd
    apply (spectrum.mem_iff.mp hs)
    simpa only [map_one] using hu

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_cross_kernel_lt_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_cross_kernel_lt_one
    (A B : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hAA : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * (A ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hBB : Integrable (fun ω => B ω * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hAB : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hA : (1-∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ).PosDef)
    (hB : (1-∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ).PosDef)
    (hX : specNorm X ≤ 1) :
    specNorm (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hInt := posSemidef_integral_cross_kernel_fromBlocks A B X hAA hBB hAB hX
  have hdiag := posDef_cross_diag hA hB
  have hsum := Matrix.PosDef.posSemidef_add hInt hdiag
  have he :
      fromBlocks (∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)
          (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)ᴴ (∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) +
        fromBlocks (1-∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ) 0 0
          (1-∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) =
      fromBlocks 1 (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)
        (∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ)ᴴ 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_add]
    simp
  rw [he] at hsum
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  exact norm_lt_one_of_posDef_complex_identity_fromBlocks hsum

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_integral_cross_kernel_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_integral_cross_kernel_fixedPoint
    (A B : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hAA : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * (A ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hBB : Integrable (fun ω => B ω * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hAB : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ) μ)
    (hA : (1-∫ ω, A ω * (A ω)ᴴ ∂μ).PosDef)
    (hB : (1-∫ ω, B ω * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ).PosDef)
    (hfix : X = ∫ ω, A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) : X = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hz
  have hn : 0 < specNorm X := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
  let Y := (specNorm X)⁻¹ • X
  have hkernel : (fun ω => A ω * Y * (B ω)ᴴ) =
      (fun ω => (specNorm X)⁻¹ • (A ω * X * (B ω)ᴴ)) := by
    funext ω
    simp [Y]
  have hY : specNorm Y = 1 := by
    change specNorm ((specNorm X)⁻¹ • X) = 1
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le),
      ← specNorm_eq_norm,inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
  have hYi : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * Y * (B ω)ᴴ) μ := by
    rw [hkernel]
    exact hAB.smul ((specNorm X)⁻¹ : ℝ)
  have hYfix : (∫ ω, A ω * Y * (B ω)ᴴ ∂μ) = Y := by
    rw [hkernel,integral_smul,← hfix]
  have hlt := specNorm_integral_cross_kernel_lt_one A B Y hAA hBB hYi hA hB hY.le
  rw [hYfix,hY] at hlt
  exact (lt_irrefl (1 : ℝ)) hlt

name: NLAlib.isUnit_inverse_add_of_isUnit_matrixKDenominator
statement:
theorem isUnit_inverse_add_of_isUnit_matrixKDenominator
    (S T : M) (hS : IsUnit S) (hD : IsUnit (1+S*T)) : IsUnit (S⁻¹+T)
proof:
:= by
  have he : S⁻¹*(1+S*T)=S⁻¹+T := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_one,← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [← he]
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hS).mul hD

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_defect_eq_inverse_sandwich
statement:
theorem matrixKResolvent_defect_eq_inverse_sandwich
    (S T : M) (hS : IsUnit S) (hD : IsUnit (1+S*T)) :
    T-matrixKResolvent S T=T*(S⁻¹+T)⁻¹*T
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : S⁻¹*(1+S*T)=S⁻¹+T := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_one,← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS),Matrix.one_mul]
  have hInv : (S⁻¹+T)⁻¹=(1+S*T)⁻¹*S := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    calc
      _ = S⁻¹*(((1+S*T)*(1+S*T)⁻¹)*S) := by rw [← hleft]; noncomm_ring
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hD),Matrix.one_mul,
          Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)]
  have hcan : (1+S*T)⁻¹*(1+S*T)=1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hD)
  have he : T*(1+S*T)⁻¹*(S*T)=T-T*(1+S*T)⁻¹ := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun X : M => T*X) hcan
    exact eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr (by
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_assoc,add_comm] using hh)
  simpa only [matrixKResolvent,hInv,Matrix.mul_assoc] using he.symm

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_snd_sum
statement:
private theorem lyapunovADI_snd_sum (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j,
      (2 * p i : K) • (lyapunovADIUpdateFactor A B p i * (lyapunovADIUpdateFactor A B p i)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [lyapunovADI]
  | succ j hj => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← hj]; rfl

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADIFactor_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem lyapunovADIFactor_mul_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 < p j) (j : ℕ) :
    lyapunovADIFactor A B p j * (lyapunovADIFactor A B p j)ᴴ = (lyapunovADI A B p j).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [lyapunovADI_snd_sum, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  ext a b
  rw [Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, lyapunovADIFactor,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [star_mul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (2 * p i) : K) ^ 2 = (2 * p i : K) := by
    exact_mod_cast Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) (hp i).le)
  calc
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * p i) : K) ^ 2 *
        (lyapunovADIUpdateFactor A B p i a c * (starRingEnd K) (lyapunovADIUpdateFactor A B p i b c)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hs]

name: NLAlib.rank_lyapunovADIUpdateFactor_le
statement:
theorem rank_lyapunovADIUpdateFactor_le (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    (lyapunovADIUpdateFactor A B p j).rank ≤ B.rank
proof:
:= by
  unfold lyapunovADIUpdateFactor lyapunovADISolve
  exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans
    ((congrArg Matrix.rank (lyapunovADI_fst A B p hP j)).le.trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _))

name: NLAlib.rank_lyapunovADI_snd_le
statement:
theorem rank_lyapunovADI_snd_le (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    (lyapunovADI A B p j).2.rank ≤ j * B.rank
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [lyapunovADI]
  | succ j hj =>
    let V := lyapunovADIUpdateFactor A B p j
    change ((lyapunovADI A B p j).2 + (2 * p j : K) • (V * Vᴴ)).rank ≤ _
    have hinc : ((2 * p j : K) • (V * Vᴴ)).rank ≤ B.rank := by
      have he : (2 * p j : K) • (V * Vᴴ) = ((2 * p j : K) • (1 : Matrix n n K)) * (V * Vᴴ) := by simp
      rw [he]
      exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans
        (rank_lyapunovADIUpdateFactor_le A B p hP j))
    exact (rank_add_le _ _).trans (by nlinarith)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_lyapunovADI_residual
statement:
theorem specNorm_lyapunovADI_residual [DecidableEq s] (A : Matrix n n K)
    (B : Matrix n s K) (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    specNorm (A * (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 + (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ) =
      specNorm (lyapunovADI A B p j).1 ^ 2
proof:

  rw [lyapunovADI_residual A B p hP, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_lyapunovADI_residual
statement:
theorem frobNorm_lyapunovADI_residual (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    frobNorm (A * (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 + (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ) =
      frobNorm ((lyapunovADI A B p j).1ᴴ * (lyapunovADI A B p j).1)
proof:

name: NLAlib.sInf_support_eq_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem sInf_support_eq_sSup_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass=1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support =
      sSup ((fun S : M => lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S)) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (μ : Measure ℝ)≠0 := by
    intro hz
    have hm : μ.mass=0 := by
      apply ENNReal.coe_injective
      rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hz]
      simp
    rw [hmass] at hm
    exact one_ne_zero hm
  let a : ℝ := sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support
  let A : Set ℝ := (fun S : M => lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S)) '' matrixKStableDomain ν α
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    (isConnected_matrixKStableDomain ν hν α hα).nonempty.image _
  have hupper : ∀ x∈A,x≤a := by
    rintro x ⟨S,hS,rfl⟩
    exact le_csInf (Measure.nonempty_support hne) fun t ht =>
      support_subset_Ici_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_of_stable ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ S hS ht
  have hAb : BddAbove A := ⟨a,hupper⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨S,hS,hK⟩ := exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
      ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hmass hcompact hμ u
        (fun t ht => lt_of_lt_of_le hu (csInf_le hcompact.bddBelow ht))
    have he : lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S)=u := by rw [hK,lambdaMin_real_smul_one]
    exact le_csSup hAb ⟨S,hS,he⟩
  · exact csSup_le hAne hupper

name: NLAlib.sInf_support_pos_iff_exists_matrixKTransform_posDef_witness
statement:
theorem sInf_support_pos_iff_exists_matrixKTransform_posDef_witness
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass=1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    0<sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support ↔
      ∃ S B : M, S.PosDef ∧ B.PosDef ∧
        (∀ T∈ν.support,(S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) ∧
        (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransform ν α S).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    let u := sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support/2
    have hu : 0<u := half_pos ha
    obtain ⟨S,hS,hK⟩ := exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
      ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hmass hcompact hμ u
        (fun t ht => lt_of_lt_of_le (half_lt_self ha) (csInf_le hcompact.bddBelow ht))
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hD⟩ := (matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S hS.1 hS.2.1).mp
      ((matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα S hS.1 hS.2.1).mp
        ((matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S hS.1 hS.2.1).mp hS.2.2))
    refine ⟨S,B,hS.1,hB,hS.2.1,hD,?_⟩
    rw [hK]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (Complex.zero_lt_real.mpr hu)
  · rintro ⟨S,B,hS,hB,hgap,hD,hK⟩
    have hst : S∈matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
      refine ⟨hS,hgap,?_⟩
      rw [matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
        matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
        matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S hS hgap]
      exact ⟨B,hB,hD⟩
    have hne : (μ : Measure ℝ)≠0 := by
      intro hz
      have hm : μ.mass=0 := by
        apply ENNReal.coe_injective
        rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hz]
        simp
      rw [hmass] at hm
      exact one_ne_zero hm
    have hlow : lambdaMin (matrixKTransform ν α S)≤sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support :=
      le_csInf (Measure.nonempty_support hne) fun t ht =>
        support_subset_Ici_lambdaMin_matrixKTransform_of_stable ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ S hst ht
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lambdaMin_pos_of_posDef hK) hlow

name: NLAlib.ridgeKernel_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem ridgeKernel_eq_cfc (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeKernel A ρ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x / (x + ρ)) (A * Aᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  let G := A * Aᵀ
  have hG : G.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [G, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self Aᵀ
  have hfin (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ G) := by
    rw [hG.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.finite_range _).continuousOn f
  have hshift : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x + ρ) G = ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ := by
    have hs := cfc_add_const ρ (fun x : ℝ => x) G (hfin _) hG.isHermitian
    calc
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => x + ρ) G =
          cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) G + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix m m ℝ) ρ := hs
      _ = G + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix m m ℝ) ρ :=
        congrArg (fun X : Matrix m m ℝ => X + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix m m ℝ) ρ)
          (cfc_id' ℝ G hG.isHermitian)
      _ = ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ := by
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, G, ridgeGram, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hprod : ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ * cfc (fun x : ℝ => x / (x + ρ)) G = G := by
    rw [← hshift, ← cfc_mul _ _ G (hfin _) (hfin _)]
    calc
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => (x + ρ) * (x / (x + ρ))) G = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) G := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro x hx
        rw [hG.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
        have hden : hG.isHermitian.eigenvalues i + ρ ≠ 0 :=
          ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (hG.eigenvalues_nonneg i) hρ)
        field_simp
      _ = G := cfc_id' ℝ G hG.isHermitian
  have hi := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (posDef_ridgeGram Aᵀ hρ).isUnit
  have hK : ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ * ridgeKernel A ρ = G := by
    rw [ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv A hρ, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hi]
    simp only [ridgeGram, Matrix.transpose_transpose, G]
    abel
  have hh := congrArg (fun X => (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹ * X) (hK.trans hprod.symm)
  simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hi, Matrix.one_mul] using hh

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_sum_singularValues
statement:
theorem ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_sum_singularValues (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card m),
        singularValues A i ^ 2 / (singularValues A i ^ 2 + ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (A * Aᵀ).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self A
  rw [ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_trace, ridgeKernel_eq_cfc A hρ,
    trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hG]
  have h := sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues Aᵀ (fun x : ℝ => x / (x + ρ))
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    singularValues_transpose, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq] using h

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank
statement:
theorem ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ ≤ (A.rank : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun i : ℕ => singularValues A i ^ 2 / (singularValues A i ^ 2 + ρ)
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, f i =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card m), f i := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono A.rank_le_card_height)
    intro i _ hi
    have hr : A.rank ≤ i := by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi
    simp only [f, singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A hr, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
      zero_div]
  rw [ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_sum_singularValues A hρ, ← hsum]
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, f i ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact (div_le_one (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _) hρ)).2 (by linarith)
    _ = (A.rank : ℝ) := by simp

name: NLAlib.ridgeEffectiveDimension_transpose
statement:
theorem ridgeEffectiveDimension_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ridgeEffectiveDimension Aᵀ ρ = ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_sum_singularValues Aᵀ hρ,
    ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_sum_singularValues A hρ]
  simp only [singularValues_transpose]
  let f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 / (x ^ 2 + ρ)
  have hf : f 0 = 0 := by simp [f]
  have hn := sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A f hf
    (N := Fintype.card n) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hm := sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A f hf
    (N := Fintype.card m) (min_le_left _ _)
  exact hn.trans hm.symm

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_inverseStabilityKernel
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_inverseStabilityKernel
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) (Y B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) =>
      T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*B*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val) ν.support
proof:
:= by
  intro T hT
  have hi : ContinuousAt (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (Y+T.val)⁻¹) T :=
    (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (Y+T.val) (hgap T hT).isUnit).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => Y+T.val)
      (continuous_const.add continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt
  exact ((((continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.mul hi).mul continuous_const.continuousAt).mul
    hi).mul continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixKInverseStability_kernel
statement:
theorem integrable_matrixKInverseStability_kernel
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (Y B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    Integrable (fun T => T.val*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*B*(Y+T.val)⁻¹*T.val) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (continuousOn_inverseStabilityKernel ν Y B hgap).integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support=ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.matrixKInverseStability_add_smul_le
statement:
theorem matrixKInverseStability_add_smul_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (Y B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    matrixKInverseStability ν α (Y+t•B) B ≤ matrixKInverseStability ν α Y B
proof:
:= by
  have hgap' (T) (hT : T ∈ ν.support) : (Y+t•B+T.val).PosDef := by
    have h := (hgap T hT).add_posSemidef (hB.posSemidef.smul ht)
    convert! h using 1; abel
  unfold matrixKInverseStability
  apply smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left _ hα
  apply integral_mono_ae
    (integrable_matrixKInverseStability_kernel ν hν _ _ hgap')
    (integrable_matrixKInverseStability_kernel ν hν _ _ hgap)
  filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
  have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp
    (inv_mul_weight_inv_add_smul_le (Y+T.val) B (hgap T hT) hB ht)).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same T.val
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  convert! hp using 1
  have hTH : T.val.IsHermitian := T.property
  simp only [show (Y+T.val)+t•B=(Y+t•B)+T.val by abel,
    Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,hTH.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.matrixKInverseStableDomain_certificate_ray
statement:
theorem matrixKInverseStableDomain_certificate_ray
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (Y : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hY : Y.val.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y.val+T.val).PosDef)
    (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hdef : (B-matrixKInverseStability ν α Y.val B).PosDef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Y+t•(⟨B,hB.isHermitian⟩ : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) ∈
      matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hY.add_posSemidef (hB.posSemidef.smul ht),?_,B,hB,?_⟩
  · intro T hT
    change (Y.val+t•B+T.val).PosDef
    have h := (hgap T hT).add_posSemidef (hB.posSemidef.smul ht)
    convert! h using 1; abel
  · have hle := matrixKInverseStability_add_smul_le ν hν hα Y.val B hB hgap ht
    have hp := hdef.add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hle)
    convert! hp using 1; abel

name: NLAlib.signNewtonIterate_inverseCayley
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [signNewtonIterate]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hp⟩ := isUnit_one_sub_and_add_matrix_pow hG (pow_pos (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ)) k)
    rw [signNewtonIterate, ih, half_smul_inverseCayley_add_inv _ hm hp,
