name: NLAlib.tendsto_inverseCayley_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_inverseCayley_one {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {G : ι → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hG : Tendsto G l (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun k => inverseCayley (G k)) l (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousAt (Ring.inverse : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) 1 :=
    NormedRing.inverse_continuousAt (1 : (Matrix n n ℂ)ˣ)
  have hd : Tendsto (fun k => (1-G k)⁻¹) l (𝓝 1) := by
    have hsub : Tendsto (fun k => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)-G k) l (𝓝 1) := by
      simpa only [sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hG)
    have h := hc.tendsto.comp hsub
    have hh : Tendsto (fun k => Ring.inverse (1-G k)) l (𝓝 1) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, Ring.inverse_one] using h
    convert! hh using 1
    funext k
    exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse _
  have hadd : Tendsto (fun k => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+G k) l (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds.add hG)
  simpa only [inverseCayley, mul_one] using hd.mul hadd

name: NLAlib.tendsto_signNewtonIterate_inverseCayley
proof:
:= by
  convert! tendsto_inverseCayley_one (hG.comp
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ)<2))) using 1
  funext k
  exact signNewtonIterate_inverseCayley hG k

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.isHurwitz_neg
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.isHurwitz_neg {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsPositiveStable A) :
    IsHurwitz (-A)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz' : -z ∈ spectrum ℂ A := by
    rw [← spectrum.neg_eq] at hz
    exact Set.mem_neg.mp hz
  have h := hA (-z) hz'
  simpa only [Complex.neg_re, neg_pos] using h

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.isUnit_add_one
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.isUnit_add_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsPositiveStable A) :
    IsUnit (A+1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hA.isHurwitz_neg.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one 1 zero_lt_one).neg
  simpa [sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.spectralRadius_positiveCayley_lt_one
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.spectralRadius_positiveCayley_lt_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsPositiveStable A) : spectralRadius ℂ (positiveCayley A)<1
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA.isUnit_add_one
  have hi : (-(A+1))⁻¹ = -(A+1)⁻¹ := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    simp only [neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd]
  have he : cayleyTransform (-A) 1 = positiveCayley A := by
    simp only [cayleyTransform, positiveCayley, RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul]
    rw [show -A-1=-(A+1) by abel, hi, show -A+1=-(A-1) by abel]
    noncomm_ring
  rw [← he]
  exact hA.isHurwitz_neg.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one 1 zero_lt_one

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.inverseCayley_positiveCayley
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.inverseCayley_positiveCayley {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsPositiveStable A) : inverseCayley (positiveCayley A)=A
proof:
:= by
  let R := bicommutantAlgebra A
  let a : R := ⟨A, self_mem_bicommutantAlgebra A⟩
  let e : R := bicommutantInverse (a+1)
  have he : (a+1)*e=1 := Subtype.ext (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA.isUnit_add_one))
  have hh := congrArg Subtype.val (CommRing.one_sub_cayley_mul a e he)
  have hc : (1-positiveCayley A)*A=1+positiveCayley A := hh
  have hu := isUnit_one_sub_of_matrix_spectralRadius_lt_one hA.spectralRadius_positiveCayley_lt_one
  rw [inverseCayley, ← hc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.signNewtonIterate_eq_and_isUnit
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.signNewtonIterate_eq_and_isUnit {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsPositiveStable A) (k : ℕ) :
    signNewtonIterate A k=inverseCayley ((positiveCayley A)^(2^k)) ∧
      IsUnit (signNewtonIterate A k)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA.spectralRadius_positiveCayley_lt_one
  have he := signNewtonIterate_inverseCayley hp k
  rw [hA.inverseCayley_positiveCayley] at he
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  rw [he]
  obtain ⟨hm, hp⟩ := isUnit_one_sub_and_add_matrix_pow hp (pow_pos (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ)) k)
  exact isUnit_inverseCayley hm hp

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.tendsto_signNewtonIterate
statement:
theorem IsPositiveStable.tendsto_signNewtonIterate {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsPositiveStable A) : Tendsto (signNewtonIterate A) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_signNewtonIterate_inverseCayley
    (tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hA.spectralRadius_positiveCayley_lt_one)
  rwa [hA.inverseCayley_positiveCayley] at h

name: NLAlib.insertionWordGaps_length_sum
statement:
theorem insertionWordGaps_length_sum (w : List Bool) :
    (insertionWordGaps w).1.length = w.count true ∧
      (insertionWordGaps w).1.sum + (insertionWordGaps w).2 = w.count false
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [insertionWordGaps]
  | cons b w ih =>
    cases h : insertionWordGaps w with
    | mk ks t =>
      rw [h] at ih
      cases b <;> cases ks <;> simp_all [insertionWordGaps]
      omega

name: NLAlib.count_false_add_count_true_eq_length
statement:
theorem count_false_add_count_true_eq_length (w : List Bool) :
    w.count false + w.count true = w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b w ih => cases b <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: NLAlib.insertionWord_eq_prod_gaps_mul_pow
statement:
theorem insertionWord_eq_prod_gaps_mul_pow (A X : R) (w : List Bool) :
    insertionWord A X w =
      ((insertionWordGaps w).1.map fun k => A ^ k * X).prod *
        A ^ (insertionWordGaps w).2
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [insertionWordGaps, insertionWord]
  | cons b w ih =>
    cases h : insertionWordGaps w with
    | mk ks t =>
      rw [h] at ih
      cases b <;> cases ks <;>
        simp_all [insertionWordGaps, insertionWord, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul
statement:
theorem exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : 0 < w.count true) :
    ∃ ks : List ℕ, ks ≠ [] ∧ ks.length = w.count true ∧ ks.sum = w.count false ∧
      (insertionWord A X w).trace = (ks.map fun k => A ^ k * X).prod.trace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hl, hs⟩ := insertionWordGaps_length_sum w
  cases h : insertionWordGaps w with
  | mk ks t =>
    rw [h] at hl hs
    cases ks with
    | nil => simp only [List.length_nil] at hl; omega
    | cons k ks =>
      refine ⟨(t + k) :: ks, by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [List.length_cons] using hl
      · simp only [List.sum_cons] at hs ⊢
        omega
      · rw [insertionWord_eq_prod_gaps_mul_pow, h]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
        rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ (A ^ t), pow_add]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero
statement:
theorem insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 0) :
    insertionWord A X w = A ^ w.count false
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hl, hs⟩ := insertionWordGaps_length_sum w
  rw [hw] at hl
  have he := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl
  rw [insertionWord_eq_prod_gaps_mul_pow, he]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [he] at hs
  simpa using congrArg (fun k => A ^ k) hs

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_pow_le_trace_cfc_abs_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA, trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA]
  simpa only [abs_pow, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id] using
    Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun i => hA.eigenvalues i ^ k)

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : 0 < w.count true) :
    |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) w).trace| ≤
      (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ (w.count true - 1) *
        (y ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *ᵥ y))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ks, hne, hl, hs, ht⟩ :=
    exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul A (vecMulVec y y) w hw
  rw [ht]
  simpa only [hl, hs] using abs_trace_prod_pow_mul_vecMulVec_le hA y ks hne

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le_trace_mul_pow
statement:
theorem abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le_trace_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ) (w : List Bool) :
    |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) w).trace| ≤
      (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec y y ^ w.count true).trace
proof:
:= by
  cases h : w.count true with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Matrix.mul_one, insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero _ _ _ h]
    exact abs_trace_pow_le_trace_cfc_abs_pow hA _
  | succ p =>
    rw [trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ]
    simpa only [h, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
      abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le hA y w (by omega)

name: NLAlib.polynomialBlockDifference_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialBlockDifference_C (c : 𝕜) (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialBlockDifference (C c) A B H = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialBlockDifference, monomialBlockDifference]

name: NLAlib.polynomialSecondBlockDifference_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialSecondBlockDifference_C (c : 𝕜) (A B D G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialSecondBlockDifference (C c) A B D G H = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialSecondBlockDifference]

name: NLAlib.polynomialBlockDifference_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialBlockDifference_one (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialBlockDifference 1 A B H = 0
proof: := polynomialBlockDifference_C 1 A B H

name: NLAlib.polynomialSecondBlockDifference_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialSecondBlockDifference_one (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialSecondBlockDifference 1 A B C G H = 0
proof:
:=
  polynomialSecondBlockDifference_C 1 A B C G H

name: NLAlib.polynomialBlockDifference_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialBlockDifference_X (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialBlockDifference X A B H = H
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialBlockDifference, monomialBlockDifference, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: NLAlib.polynomialSecondBlockDifference_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialSecondBlockDifference_X (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialSecondBlockDifference X A B C G H = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialSecondBlockDifference, monomialBlockDifference, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: NLAlib.polynomialBlockDifference_sub
statement:
theorem polynomialBlockDifference_sub (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialBlockDifference (P - Q) A B H =
      polynomialBlockDifference P A B H - polynomialBlockDifference Q A B H
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrArg (fun D : Matrix (n ⊕ n) (n ⊕ n) 𝕜 => D (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j))
    (map_sub (aeval (upperBlockTwo A H B)) P Q)
  simpa only [aeval_upperBlockTwo, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂] using h

name: NLAlib.polynomialSecondBlockDifference_sub
statement:
theorem polynomialSecondBlockDifference_sub (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    polynomialSecondBlockDifference (P - Q) A B C G H =
      polynomialSecondBlockDifference P A B C G H - polynomialSecondBlockDifference Q A B C G H
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrArg (fun D : Matrix ((n ⊕ n) ⊕ n) ((n ⊕ n) ⊕ n) 𝕜 =>
    D (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)) (map_sub (aeval (upperBlockThree A G B H C)) P Q)
  simpa only [aeval_upperBlockThree, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
    Matrix.fromRows_apply_inl] using h

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixEval_mul
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixEval_mul (P Q R S : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    rationalMatrixEval (P * R) (Q * S) A =
      rationalMatrixEval P Q A * rationalMatrixEval R S A
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Commute (aeval A R) (aeval A Q)⁻¹ :=
    ((Commute.all R Q).map (aeval A).toRingHom).matrix_inv_right
  rw [show Q * S = S * Q from mul_comm Q S]
  simp only [rationalMatrixEval, map_mul, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  calc
    _ = aeval A P * (aeval A R * (aeval A Q)⁻¹) * (aeval A S)⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hc.eq]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.rationalBlockDifference_mul
statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_mul (P Q R S : 𝕜[X]) (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hQA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hQB : IsUnit (aeval B Q))
    (hSA : IsUnit (aeval A S)) (hSB : IsUnit (aeval B S)) :
    rationalBlockDifference (P * R) (Q * S) A B H =
      rationalMatrixEval P Q A * rationalBlockDifference R S A B H +
        rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H * rationalMatrixEval R S B
proof:
:= by
  have h := rationalMatrixEval_mul P Q R S (upperBlockTwo A H B)
  rw [rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo P Q A B H hQA hQB,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo R S A B H hSA hSB,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockTwo (P * R) (Q * S) A B H
      (by simpa only [map_mul] using hQA.mul hSA) (by simpa only [map_mul] using hQB.mul hSB),
    Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply] at h
  exact congrArg Matrix.toBlocks₁₂ h

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_mul
statement:
theorem rationalSecondBlockDifference_mul (P Q R S : 𝕜[X]) (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hQA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hQB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hQC : IsUnit (aeval C Q))
    (hSA : IsUnit (aeval A S)) (hSB : IsUnit (aeval B S)) (hSC : IsUnit (aeval C S)) :
    rationalSecondBlockDifference (P * R) (Q * S) A B C G H =
      rationalMatrixEval P Q A * rationalSecondBlockDifference R S A B C G H +
      rationalBlockDifference P Q A B G * rationalBlockDifference R S B C H +
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C G H * rationalMatrixEval R S C
proof:
:= by
  have h := rationalMatrixEval_mul P Q R S (upperBlockThree A G B H C)
  rw [rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree P Q A B C G H hQA hQB hQC,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree R S A B C G H hSA hSB hSC,
    rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree (P * R) (Q * S) A B C G H
      (by simpa only [map_mul] using hQA.mul hSA) (by simpa only [map_mul] using hQB.mul hSB)
      (by simpa only [map_mul] using hQC.mul hSC), Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows, Matrix.fromRows_mul] at h
  ext i j
  have he := congrArg (fun D => D (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)) h
  simpa using he

name: NLAlib.rationalBlockDifference_one
statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_one (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    rationalBlockDifference 1 Q A B H =
      -((aeval A Q)⁻¹ * polynomialBlockDifference Q A B H * (aeval B Q)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalBlockDifference, rationalMatrixEval,
    Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_one
statement:
theorem rationalSecondBlockDifference_one (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    rationalSecondBlockDifference 1 Q A B C G H =
      (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * polynomialBlockDifference Q A B G * (aeval B Q)⁻¹ *
        polynomialBlockDifference Q B C H * (aeval C Q)⁻¹ -
      (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * polynomialSecondBlockDifference Q A B C G H * (aeval C Q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalSecondBlockDifference, rationalBlockDifference_one, rationalMatrixEval,
    Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent
statement:
theorem rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent (ζ : 𝕜) (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    rationalSecondBlockDifference 1 (Polynomial.C ζ - X) A B C G H =
      (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - A)⁻¹ * G * (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - B)⁻¹ * H *
        (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - C)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalSecondBlockDifference_one]
  simp [polynomialBlockDifference_sub, polynomialSecondBlockDifference_sub,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_continuousOn_support
statement:
private theorem integrable_of_continuousOn_support
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) {f : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f ν.support) : Integrable f ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hf.integrableOn_compact (μ := ν) hν
  have hre : ν.restrict ν.support = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem ν.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_resolvent_support
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_resolvent_support
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) (S : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKResolvent S T.val)
      ν.support
proof:
:= by
  intro T hT
  exact ((continuousAt_matrixKResolvent S T.val
    (isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgap T hT))).comp
      (f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => (S,T.val))
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_resolvent_integral
statement:
private theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_resolvent_integral
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B = α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹) -
      ∫ T, matrixKResolvent S T.val * B * matrixKResolvent S T.val ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (integrable_matrixK_kernels ν hν S hS hgap).1
  unfold matrixKTransformDeriv
  rw [_root_.add_apply,_root_.smul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hi B]
  simp only [matrixKResolventDeriv,_root_.neg_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply,
    integral_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_stabilityRowKernel
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_stabilityRowKernel
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) (α : ℝ) (S B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    ContinuousOn (fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val)
      ν.support
proof:
:= by
  unfold stabilityRowKernel
  exact ((continuous_const.continuousOn.mul
    (continuousOn_resolvent_support ν S hS hgap)).mul continuous_const.continuousOn).const_smul
      (Real.sqrt α)

name: NLAlib.stabilityRowKernel_gram
statement:
private theorem stabilityRowKernel_gram
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (S B T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hT : T.IsHermitian) (hgap : (S⁻¹+T).PosDef) :
    stabilityRowKernel α S B T * (stabilityRowKernel α S B T)ᴴ =
      α • ((cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S) *
        (matrixKResolvent S T*B*matrixKResolvent S T) *
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  have hRB : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hQB : (cfc Real.sqrt B).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hR := isHermitian_matrixKResolvent S T hS hT hgap
  simp only [stabilityRowKernel,Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,star_trivial,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hRB.eq,hQB.eq,hS.isHermitian.eq,hR.eq,
    Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,smul_smul]
  rw [show Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt α = α by exact Real.mul_self_sqrt hα]
  congr 1
  have hBB := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hB
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg
    (fun X => cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S*matrixKResolvent S T*X*
      matrixKResolvent S T*S*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B) hBB

name: NLAlib.stabilityRowKernel_defect
statement:
private theorem stabilityRowKernel_defect
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hD : (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef) :
    (1-∫ T, stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val *
      (stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val)ᴴ ∂ν).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
  let P := R*S
  let f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) =>
    matrixKResolvent S T.val * B * matrixKResolvent S T.val
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hi : Integrable f ν := integrable_of_continuousOn_support ν hν
    (((continuousOn_resolvent_support ν S hS hgap).mul continuous_const.continuousOn).mul
      (continuousOn_resolvent_support ν S hS hgap))
  have he : (∫ T, stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val *
      (stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val)ᴴ ∂ν) = α • (P*(∫ T, f T ∂ν)*Pᴴ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ T, α • (P*f T*Pᴴ) ∂ν := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
        exact stabilityRowKernel_gram α hα.le S B T.val hS hB T.property (hgap T hT)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [integral_smul]
        congr 1
        let L := ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) P Pᴴ
        exact L.integral_comp_comm hi
  have hbase : α • (P*(α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹))*Pᴴ) = 1 := by
    have hb : R*B*R = 1 := by
      rw [← cfc_sqrt_mul_self hB]
      change R*(cfc Real.sqrt B*cfc Real.sqrt B)*R=1
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hB,Matrix.one_mul,
        cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hB]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul,
      P,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hR.eq,hS.isHermitian.eq]
    calc
      _ = R*(S*S⁻¹)*B*(S⁻¹*S)*R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit),
          Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit)]
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.one_mul] using hb
  have heq : (1-∫ T, stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val *
      (stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val)ᴴ ∂ν) =
      α • (P*matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B*Pᴴ) := by
    rw [he,matrixKTransformDeriv_resolvent_integral ν hν α S B hS hgap,
      Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,smul_sub,hbase]
  rw [heq]
  apply (posDef_real_smul_iff α hα _).mpr
  exact (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff
    ((isUnit_cfc_invSqrt B hB).mul hS.isUnit)).mpr hD

name: NLAlib.stabilityRowKernel_mixed
statement:
private theorem stabilityRowKernel_mixed
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (S Q B C T : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hQ : Q.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : C.PosDef)
    (hT : T.IsHermitian) (hgap : (Q⁻¹+T).PosDef) (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    stabilityRowKernel α S B T *
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*Δ*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C) *
          (stabilityRowKernel α Q C T)ᴴ =
      α • ((cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S) *
        (matrixKResolvent S T*Δ*matrixKResolvent Q T) *
        (Q*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C))
proof:
:= by
  have hRC : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hQC : (cfc Real.sqrt C).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hR := isHermitian_matrixKResolvent Q T hQ hT hgap
  simp only [stabilityRowKernel,Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,star_trivial,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hRC.eq,hQC.eq,hQ.isHermitian.eq,hR.eq,
    Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,smul_smul]
  rw [show Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt α = α by exact Real.mul_self_sqrt hα]
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*S*matrixKResolvent S T*
        (cfc Real.sqrt B*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B)*Δ*
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C*cfc Real.sqrt C)*
        matrixKResolvent Q T*Q*cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hB,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hC]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_eq_iff_eq_of_derivative_witness
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_eq_iff_eq_of_derivative_witness
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hQ : Q.PosDef)
    (hgapS : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapQ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Q⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hwS : ∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef)
    (hwQ : ∃ C : Matrix n n ℂ, C.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α Q C).PosDef) :
    matrixKTransform ν α S = matrixKTransform ν α Q ↔ S=Q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hDB⟩ := hwS
    obtain ⟨C,hC,hDC⟩ := hwQ
    let RB := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B
    let RC := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C
    let Y := RB*(S-Q)*RC
    let A := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => stabilityRowKernel α S B T.val
    let D := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => stabilityRowKernel α Q C T.val
    let f := fun T : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) =>
      matrixKResolvent S T.val*(S-Q)*matrixKResolvent Q T.val
    have hcA := continuousOn_stabilityRowKernel ν α S B hS hgapS
    have hcD := continuousOn_stabilityRowKernel ν α Q C hQ hgapQ
    have hiAA : Integrable (fun T => A T*(A T)ᴴ) ν :=
      integrable_of_continuousOn_support ν hν (hcA.mul hcA.star)
    have hiDD : Integrable (fun T => D T*(D T)ᴴ) ν :=
      integrable_of_continuousOn_support ν hν (hcD.mul hcD.star)
    have hiAD : Integrable (fun T => A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ) ν :=
      integrable_of_continuousOn_support ν hν
        ((hcA.mul continuous_const.continuousOn).mul hcD.star)
    have hif : Integrable f ν := integrable_of_continuousOn_support ν hν
      (((continuousOn_resolvent_support ν S hS hgapS).mul continuous_const.continuousOn).mul
        (continuousOn_resolvent_support ν Q hQ hgapQ))
    have hdiff := matrixKTransform_sub_matrixKTransform ν hν α
      ⟨hS.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgapS T hT)⟩
      ⟨hQ.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator Q T.val hQ (hgapQ T hT)⟩
    rw [hK,sub_self] at hdiff
    have heq : α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹*(S-Q)*Q⁻¹) = ∫ T, f T ∂ν :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff.symm
    have hcross : (∫ T, A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν) =
        α • ((RB*S)*(∫ T, f T ∂ν)*(Q*RC)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ T, α • ((RB*S)*f T*(Q*RC)) ∂ν := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
          exact stabilityRowKernel_mixed α hα.le S Q B C T.val hQ hB hC
            T.property (hgapQ T hT) (S-Q)
        _ = _ := by
          rw [integral_smul]
          congr 1
          let L := ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) (RB*S) (Q*RC)
          exact L.integral_comp_comm hif
    have hfix : Y = ∫ T, A T*Y*(D T)ᴴ ∂ν := by
      rw [hcross,← heq,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
      change RB*(S-Q)*RC = (RB*S)*(S⁻¹*(S-Q)*Q⁻¹)*(Q*RC)
      calc
        _ = RB*(S*S⁻¹)*(S-Q)*(Q⁻¹*Q)*RC := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit),
            Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hQ.isUnit)]
          simp
        _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hzero := eq_zero_of_integral_cross_kernel_fixedPoint A D Y hiAA hiDD hiAD
      (stabilityRowKernel_defect ν hν α hα S B hS hB hgapS hDB)
      (stabilityRowKernel_defect ν hν α hα Q C hQ hC hgapQ hDC) hfix
    have hh := congrArg (fun X => cfc Real.sqrt B*X*cfc Real.sqrt C) hzero
    change cfc Real.sqrt B*(RB*(S-Q)*RC)*cfc Real.sqrt C =
      cfc Real.sqrt B*0*cfc Real.sqrt C at hh
    have hcan : cfc Real.sqrt B*(RB*(S-Q)*RC)*cfc Real.sqrt C = S-Q := by
      change cfc Real.sqrt B*(cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) B*(S-Q)*
        cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) C)*cfc Real.sqrt C = S-Q
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hB,
        Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hC,Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hcan,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at hh
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hh
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_eq_iff_eq_of_quadratic_pos
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_eq_iff_eq_of_quadratic_pos [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hQ : Q.PosDef)
    (hgapS : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hgapQ : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Q⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hstS : ∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ))
    (hstQ : ∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α Q Δ)) :
    matrixKTransform ν α S = matrixKTransform ν α Q ↔ S=Q
proof:
:= by
  have hwS := (matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S hS hgapS).mp
    ((matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα S hS hgapS).mp
      ((matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S hS hgapS).mp hstS))
  have hwQ := (matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα Q hQ hgapQ).mp
    ((matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα Q hQ hgapQ).mp
      ((matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα Q hQ hgapQ).mp hstQ))
  exact matrixKTransform_eq_iff_eq_of_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S Q hS hQ
    hgapS hgapQ hwS hwQ

name: NLAlib.spectrum_fromBlocks_zero₂₁
statement:
theorem spectrum_fromBlocks_zero₂₁ (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    spectrum ℂ (fromBlocks A C 0 B) = spectrum ℂ A ∪ spectrum ℂ B
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly, Matrix.charpoly_fromBlocks_zero₂₁,
    Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_mul, mul_eq_zero, Set.mem_union]

name: NLAlib.IsPositiveStable.fromBlocks
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [spectrum_fromBlocks_zero₂₁] at hz
  exact hz.elim (hA z) (hB z)

name: NLAlib.matrixSign_fromBlocks_sylvester
statement:
theorem matrixSign_fromBlocks_sylvester
    {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsPositiveStable A)
    (hB : IsPositiveStable B) {C X : Matrix m n ℂ} (hX : A * X + X * B = C) :
    matrixSign (fromBlocks A C 0 (-B)) = fromBlocks 1 ((2 : ℂ) • X) 0 (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsep : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ (fromBlocks A C 0 (-B)), z.re ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [spectrum_fromBlocks_zero₂₁] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · exact (hA z hz).ne'
    · have hn : -z ∈ spectrum ℂ B := by
        rw [← spectrum.neg_eq] at hz
        exact Set.mem_neg.mp hz
      have hh := hB (-z) hn
      simp only [Complex.neg_re] at hh
      linarith
  symm
  apply IsMatrixSign.eq_matrixSign hsep
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [pow_two, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp only [Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero,
      Matrix.mul_neg, neg_neg, add_zero, zero_add, add_neg_cancel,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  · change fromBlocks A C 0 (-B) * fromBlocks 1 ((2 : ℂ) • X) 0 (-1) =
      fromBlocks 1 ((2 : ℂ) • X) 0 (-1) * fromBlocks A C 0 (-B)
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, neg_neg, add_zero, zero_add, smul_zero]
    congr 1
    rw [← hX]
    module
  · have heq : fromBlocks 1 ((2 : ℂ) • X) 0 (-1) * fromBlocks A C 0 (-B) =
        fromBlocks A (C - (2 : ℂ) • (X * B)) 0 B := by
      simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.smul_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [heq]
    exact hA.fromBlocks hB _

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_sylvester_of_positiveStable
statement:
theorem existsUnique_sylvester_of_positiveStable
    {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsPositiveStable A)
    (hB : IsPositiveStable B) (C : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ∃! X : Matrix m n ℂ, A * X + X * B = C
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] using
    existsUnique_sylvester_of_disjoint_spectrum A (-B) (hA.disjoint_neg hB) C

name: NLAlib.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_tendsto
    (v : I → n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (beta : ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hbeta : Tendsto beta atTop (nhds b))
    (hseq : ∀ m, ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) :
    ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : (I → ℝ) → Matrix n n ℝ := fun s => ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)
  choose S₀ hS₀ using hseq
  let T : ℕ → I → ℝ := fun m i => if v i = 0 then 0 else S₀ m i
  have hS₀₂ : ∀ m, ∀ i, 0 ≤ S₀ m i := fun m => (hS₀ m).1
  have hS₀_card : ∀ m, (Function.support (S₀ m)).ncard ≤ k := fun m => (hS₀ m).2.1
  have hS₀_lower : ∀ m, (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A (S₀ m) := fun m => (hS₀ m).2.2.1
  have hS₀_upper : ∀ m, A (S₀ m) ≤ beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := fun m => (hS₀ m).2.2.2
  have hT_nonneg : ∀ m i, 0 ≤ T m i := by
    intro m i
    dsimp [T]
    by_cases hvi : v i = 0
    · simp [hvi]
    · simp [hvi, hS₀₂ m i]
  have hT_support : ∀ m, Function.support (T m) ⊆ Function.support (S₀ m) := by
    intro m i hi
    dsimp [T] at hi
    by_cases hvi : v i = 0
    · simp [hvi] at hi
    · simpa [hvi] using hi
  have hT_eqA : ∀ m, A (T m) = A (S₀ m) := by
    intro m
    unfold A
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    by_cases hvi : v i = 0
    · simp [T, hvi]
    · simp [T, hvi]
  have hT_lower : ∀ m, (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A (T m) := by
    intro m
    rw [hT_eqA]
    exact hS₀_lower m
  have hT_upper : ∀ m, A (T m) ≤ beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    intro m
    rw [hT_eqA]
    exact hS₀_upper m
  
  have hA_diag : ∀ m j, A (T m) j j = ∑ i, T m i * (v i j)^2 := by
    intro m j
    dsimp [A]
    rw [Matrix.sum_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, pow_two]
  
  have hbdd : ∃ a, a ∈ upperBounds (Set.range beta) := hbeta.bddAbove_range
  obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ := hbdd
  let K : ℝ := max K₀ 0
  have hbeta_le_K : ∀ m, beta m ≤ K := by
    intro m
    exact (hK₀ ⟨m, rfl⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hK_nonneg : 0 ≤ K := le_max_right _ _
  
  have hcoords : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0 → ∃ j : n, v i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hvi
    by_contra hnot
    apply hvi
    funext j
    by_contra hj
    exact hnot ⟨j, hj⟩
  let c : I → ℝ := fun i =>
    if h : v i = 0 then 0 else K / (v i (Classical.choose (hcoords i h)))^2
  have hT_le_c : ∀ m i, T m i ≤ c i := by
    intro m i
    dsimp [T, c]
    by_cases hvi : v i = 0
    · simp [hvi]
    · let j₀ : n := Classical.choose (hcoords i hvi)
      have hvi₀ : v i j₀ ≠ 0 := Classical.choose_spec (hcoords i hvi)
      have hPSD_upper : ∀ m, (beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A (T m)).PosSemidef := by
        intro m
        rw [← Matrix.le_iff]
        exact hT_upper m
      have hdiag : ∀ m, ∑ i, T m i * (v i j₀)^2 ≤ beta m := by
        intro m
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A (T m)) j₀ j₀ :=
          (hPSD_upper m).diag_nonneg
        have h1 : (beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) j₀ j₀ = beta m := by simp
        have hnonneg' : 0 ≤ beta m - (∑ i, T m i * (v i j₀)^2) := by
          rw [Matrix.sub_apply] at hnonneg
          simpa [h1, hA_diag m j₀] using hnonneg
        linarith
      have hterm : ∀ m, T m i * (v i j₀)^2 ≤ ∑ l, T m l * (v l j₀)^2 := by
        intro m
        have hnonneg_terms : ∀ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I), 0 ≤ T m l * (v l j₀)^2 := by
          intro l hl
          exact mul_nonneg (hT_nonneg m l) (sq_nonneg _)
        have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum hnonneg_terms (Finset.mem_univ i)
        simpa using hsingle
      have hTi_le : ∀ m, S₀ m i ≤ K / (v i j₀)^2 := by
        intro m
        have hpos : 0 < (v i j₀)^2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hvi₀
        have hle : S₀ m i * (v i j₀)^2 ≤ K := by
          have hTid : T m i = S₀ m i := by simp [T, hvi]
          rw [← hTid]
          exact le_trans (le_trans (hterm m) (hdiag m)) (hbeta_le_K m)
        exact (le_div_iff₀ hpos).2 hle
      simpa [T, c, hvi, j₀] using hTi_le m
  have hbox : ∀ m, T m ∈ Set.Icc (0 : I → ℝ) c := by
    intro m
    exact ⟨fun i => hT_nonneg m i, fun i => hT_le_c m i⟩
  have hbox_compact : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : I → ℝ) c) := isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨t, ht_in, phi, hphi_mono, hphi_tendsto⟩ :=
    IsCompact.tendsto_subseq hbox_compact hbox
  have ht_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i := fun i => (ht_in.1 i)
  
  have hcoord_conv : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun m => T (phi m) i) atTop (nhds (t i)) := by
    intro i
    exact (continuous_apply i).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphi_tendsto
  have hnev : ∀ i, t i ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ m in atTop, T (phi m) i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hti
    exact (hcoord_conv i).eventually_ne hti
  have hfall : ∀ᶠ m in atTop, ∀ i, t i ≠ 0 → T (phi m) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eventually_all]
    intro i
    by_cases hti : t i ≠ 0
    · exact (hnev i hti).mono (fun m hm _ => hm)
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun m hi => False.elim (hti hi))
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hfall.exists
  have hsup : Function.support t ⊆ Function.support (T (phi m)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact hm i hi
  have hcard : (Function.support t).ncard ≤ k := by
    calc
      (Function.support t).ncard ≤ (Function.support (T (phi m))).ncard := Set.ncard_mono hsup
      _ ≤ (Function.support (S₀ (phi m))).ncard := Set.ncard_mono (hT_support (phi m))
      _ ≤ k := hS₀_card (phi m)
  
  have hcontA : Continuous A := by
    unfold A
    refine continuous_finsetSum (Finset.univ : Finset I) (fun i _ => ?_)
    exact (continuous_apply i).smul continuous_const
  have hphi_atTop : Tendsto phi atTop atTop := hphi_mono.tendsto_atTop
  
  have hL_psd : ∀ m, (A (T (phi m)) - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
    intro m
    rw [← Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hT_lower (phi m)
  have hL_tendsto : Tendsto (fun m => A (T (phi m)) - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (A t - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) := by
    exact (hcontA.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphi_tendsto).sub tendsto_const_nhds
  have hL_psd' : (A t - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_of_tendsto (l := atTop) hL_psd hL_tendsto
  have hLower : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A t := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hL_psd'
  
  have hU_psd : ∀ m, (beta (phi m) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A (T (phi m))).PosSemidef := by
    intro m
    rw [← Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hT_upper (phi m)
  have hbeta_tendsto : Tendsto (fun m => beta (phi m)) atTop (nhds b) :=
    hbeta.comp hphi_atTop
  have hU_tendsto : Tendsto (fun m => beta (phi m) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A (T (phi m))) atTop
      (nhds (b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A t)) := by
    exact (hbeta_tendsto.smul tendsto_const_nhds).sub (hcontA.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphi_tendsto)
  have hU_psd' : (b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A t).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_of_tendsto (l := atTop) hU_psd hU_tendsto
  have hUpper : A t ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hU_psd'
  refine ⟨t, ht_nonneg, hcard, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [A] using hLower
  · simpa [A] using hUpper

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_blockDiagonal
statement:
lemma sum_smul_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_blockDiagonal (v : I → n → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (w : I × Fin r → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : I × Fin r, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p))
      = Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun a : Fin r =>
          ∑ i : I, w (i, a) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ⟨x, a⟩ ⟨y, b⟩
  rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    simp only [frameBlockVector, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    have hcond : ∀ p : I × Fin r,
        w p * ((if p.2 = a then v p.1 x else 0) * (if p.2 = a then v p.1 y else 0))
          = if p.2 = a then w p * (v p.1 x * v p.1 y) else 0 := by
      intro p
      by_cases hp : p.2 = a
      · simp [hp]
      · simp [hp]
    have himg : (Finset.univ : Finset I).image (fun i : I => (i, a))
        = (Finset.univ : Finset (I × Fin r)).filter (fun p => p.2 = a) := by
      ext p
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact (congrArg Prod.snd hi).symm
      · intro hp
        refine ⟨p.1, ?_⟩
        ext <;> simp [hp]
    have himj : Set.InjOn (fun i : I => (i, a)) (↑(Finset.univ : Finset I)) := by
      intro i hi j hj hij
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hij
    have hmap' : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I).image (fun i : I => (i, a)),
        w p * (v p.1 x * v p.1 y))
        = ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I), w (i, a) * (v i x * v i y) :=
      Finset.sum_image himj
    calc
      (∑ p : I × Fin r, w p * ((if p.2 = a then v p.1 x else 0) * (if p.2 = a then v p.1 y else 0)))
          = ∑ p : I × Fin r, (if p.2 = a then w p * (v p.1 x * v p.1 y) else 0) := by
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => hcond p)
      _ = (∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (I × Fin r)).filter (fun p => p.2 = a),
            w p * (v p.1 x * v p.1 y)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      _ = ∑ i : I, w (i, a) * (v i x * v i y) := by
              rw [← himg]
              exact hmap'.trans (by simp)
  · simp only [frameBlockVector, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    have hsum : (∑ p : I × Fin r,
        w p * ((if p.2 = a then v p.1 x else 0) * (if p.2 = b then v p.1 y else 0))) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro p hp
      by_cases hpa : p.2 = a
      · have hpb : p.2 ≠ b := by
          intro hb
          exact hab (hpa.symm.trans hb)
        rw [if_pos hpa, if_neg hpb]
        ring
      · rw [if_neg hpa]
        ring
    simpa [hab] using hsum

name: NLAlib.sum_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_one
statement:
lemma sum_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_one (v : I → n → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1) :
    ∑ p : I × Fin r, Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' : (∑ p : I × Fin r,
      (1 : ℝ) • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p)) = 1 := by
    rw [sum_smul_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_blockDiagonal v r (fun _ : I × Fin r => 1)]
    ext ⟨x, a⟩ ⟨y, b⟩
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b
      have he := congr_fun (congr_fun hframe x) y
      simpa [Matrix.one_apply, one_smul] using he
    · have hz : (∑ p : I × Fin r,
          Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p)) (x, a) (y, b) = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.sum_apply]
        simp only [frameBlockVector, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro p hp
        by_cases hpa : p.2 = a
        · have hpb : p.2 ≠ b := by
            intro hb
            exact hab (hpa.symm.trans hb)
          rw [if_pos hpa, if_neg hpb]
          ring
        · rw [if_neg hpa]
          ring
      simp [hab] at *
  simpa using h'

name: NLAlib.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_block_sum
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_block_sum
    (v : I → n → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (_hr : 0 < r) (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (w : I × Fin r → ℝ)
    (hw_nonneg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ w p)
    (hw_card : (Function.support w).ncard < r * (k + 1))
    (hw_lower : (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) ≤
        ∑ p, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p))
    (hw_upper : (∑ p, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p)) ≤
        B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)) :
    ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset (I × Fin r) := (Finset.univ.filter fun p => w p ≠ 0)
  have hmem_S : ∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ w p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p
    simp [S]
  have hS_card : S.card < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)).card * (k + 1) := by
    have hw : (Function.support w).ncard = S.card := by
      dsimp [S]
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
      congr 1
      ext p
      simp [Function.support]
    rw [← hw]
    simpa [Fintype.card_fin]
  obtain ⟨a₀, -, hfiber⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_card_fiber_lt_of_card_lt_mul
      (s := S) (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)))
      (f := fun p : I × Fin r => p.2) (n := k + 1) hS_card
  have hfib_card : (S.filter fun p => p.2 = a₀).card < k + 1 := hfiber
  have hfib_ncard : {p : I × Fin r | p ∈ S ∧ p.2 = a₀}.ncard < k + 1 := by
    have hc : {p : I × Fin r | p ∈ S ∧ p.2 = a₀}.ncard = (S.filter fun p => p.2 = a₀).card := by
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
      congr 1
      ext p
      simp
    rwa [hc]
  have hfib_set : {p : I × Fin r | p ∈ S ∧ p.2 = a₀}
      = (fun i : I => (i, a₀)) '' (Function.support fun i => w (i, a₀)) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hpS, h₂⟩
      have hw : w p ≠ 0 := (hmem_S p).1 hpS
      refine ⟨p.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hpair : (p.1, a₀) = p := by ext <;> simp [h₂]
        simpa [hpair] using hw
      · ext <;> simp [h₂]
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(hmem_S (i, a₀)).2 hi, rfl⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : I => (i, a₀)) := by
    intro i j h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  have hcard_block : (Function.support fun i => w (i, a₀)).ncard ≤ k := by
    have hcard_eq : (Function.support fun i => w (i, a₀)).ncard
        = {p : I × Fin r | p ∈ S ∧ p.2 = a₀}.ncard := by
      rw [hfib_set]
      exact (Set.ncard_image_of_injective (Function.support fun i => w (i, a₀)) hinj).symm
    have hlt : (Function.support fun i => w (i, a₀)).ncard < k + 1 := by
      rwa [hcard_eq]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt
  let V : I × Fin r → n × Fin r → ℝ := fun p => frameBlockVector v r p
  let A : (I × Fin r → ℝ) → Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ :=
    fun w => ∑ p, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (V p) (V p)
  let e : n → n × Fin r := fun j => (j, a₀)
  have hinj_e : Function.Injective e := by
    intro j₁ j₂ h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  have hPSD_low : ((A w - (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)).submatrix e e).PosSemidef := by
    have hPSD : (A w - (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
      rw [← Matrix.le_iff]
      exact hw_lower
    exact hPSD.submatrix e
  have hsub_1 : ((1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ).submatrix e e) = 1 := by
    exact Matrix.submatrix_one e hinj_e
  have hsub_A : (A w).submatrix e e = ∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
    dsimp [A, V]
    rw [sum_smul_vecMulVec_frameBlockVector_eq_blockDiagonal v r w]
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply_eq]
  have h1_e : ∀ i j, (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) (e i) (e j)
      = (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j := by
    intro i j
    rw [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp
    · have hne : e i ≠ e j := by
        intro h
        exact hij (congrArg Prod.fst h)
      simp [hne, hij]
  have hsub_B : (B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)).submatrix e e = B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply]
    rw [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
    rw [h1_e]
  have hsub_diff : ((A w - (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)).submatrix e e)
      = (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    change A w (e i) (e j) - (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) (e i) (e j)
      = (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) i j - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j
    have hiA : A w (e i) (e j) = (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) i j := by
      simpa [Matrix.submatrix_apply] using congr_fun (congr_fun hsub_A i) j
    have hi1 : (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) (e i) (e j) = (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) i j := by
      have h := congr_fun (congr_fun hsub_1 i) j
      simpa [Matrix.submatrix_apply] using h
    rw [hiA, hi1]
  have hblock_psd : ((∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [hsub_diff] using hPSD_low
  have hblock_lower : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hblock_psd
  have hPSD_up : (B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) - A w).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hw_upper
  have hPSD_up_sub : ((B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) - A w).submatrix e e).PosSemidef :=
    hPSD_up.submatrix e
  have hsub_updiff : ((B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) - A w).submatrix e e)
      = B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) := by
    ext i j
    change (B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)) (e i) (e j) - A w (e i) (e j)
      = (B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) i j - (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) i j
    have hiB : (B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)) (e i) (e j) = (B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) i j := by
      have h := congr_fun (congr_fun hsub_B i) j
      simpa [Matrix.submatrix_apply] using h
    have hiA : A w (e i) (e j) = (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) i j := by
      simpa [Matrix.submatrix_apply] using congr_fun (congr_fun hsub_A i) j
    rw [hiB, hiA]
  have hblock_up_psd : (B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i))).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [hsub_updiff] using hPSD_up_sub
  have hblock_upper : (∑ i, w (i, a₀) • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ≤ B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    exact hblock_up_psd
  refine ⟨fun i => w (i, a₀), ?_, hcard_block, hblock_lower, hblock_upper⟩
  exact fun i => hw_nonneg (i, a₀)

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (branch : n → ℂ → ℂ) (r l u : ℝ)
    (hlu : l ≤ u) (hbu : ∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u)
    (htransform : ∀ t : ℝ,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (-t * s) *
        (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) volume l u ∧
      (∫ s in l..u, Real.exp (-t * s) *
        (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
        traceExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) -
          ∑ i, Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i))
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Icc l u),
      0 ≤ (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
        (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) l u ∧
      (ν : Measure ℝ) =
        (volume.restrict (Icc l u)).withDensity
          (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) +
          (exponentialAtomicMeasure (fun i => (A i i).re) b : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re
  have hρint : IntervalIntegrable ρ volume l u := by
    simpa only [neg_zero, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] using (htransform 0).1
  have hρ : IntegrableOn ρ (Icc l u) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hlu).mp hρint
  let νc : FiniteMeasure ℝ := intervalDensityMeasure ρ l u hρ
  let νa : FiniteMeasure ℝ := exponentialAtomicMeasure (fun i => (A i i).re) b
  have hrep := (isCompactExpRepresentation_intervalDensityMeasure hlu hρ hpos).add
    (isCompactExpRepresentation_exponentialAtomicMeasure (fun i => (A i i).re) b hbu)
  refine ⟨νc + νa, ?_, rfl⟩
  convert hrep using 1
  funext t
  have ht := (htransform (-t)).2
  simp only [neg_neg, neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, Complex.ofReal_neg, neg_smul] at ht
  dsimp only [ρ]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_isCompactExpRepresentation_of_circleDensity_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_isCompactExpRepresentation_of_circleDensity_nonneg
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R < r →
        (∀ s : ℝ, (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).im = 0) ∧
        ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) →
          (∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Icc l u),
            0 ≤ (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) →
          ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
            IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
              (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + (t : ℂ) •
                Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) l u ∧
            (ν : Measure ℝ) =
              (volume.restrict (Icc l u)).withDensity
                (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) +
                (exponentialAtomicMeasure (fun i => (A i i).re) b : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, hrep⟩ :=
    exists_exterior_branches_integral_real_circleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms hA b hb
  refine ⟨R, hR, branch, hbranch, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, htransform⟩ := hrep r hr
  refine ⟨hreal, ?_⟩
  intro l u hlu hbu hpos
  exact exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg
    A b branch r l u hlu hbu (htransform l u hlu hbu) hpos

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg_off_slopes
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg_off_slopes
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℝ) (branch : n → ℂ → ℂ) (r l u : ℝ)
    (hlu : l ≤ u) (hbu : ∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u)
    (htransform : ∀ t : ℝ,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (-t * s) *
        (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) volume l u ∧
      (∫ s in l..u, Real.exp (-t * s) *
        (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
        traceExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) -
          ∑ i, Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i))
    (hpos : ∀ s ∈ Icc l u, s ∉ Set.range b →
      0 ≤ (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
        (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) l u ∧
      (ν : Measure ℝ) =
        (volume.restrict (Icc l u)).withDensity
          (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) +
          (exponentialAtomicMeasure (fun i => (A i i).re) b : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_circleDensity_nonneg
    A b branch r l u hlu hbu htransform
  have hoff : ∀ᵐ s : ℝ, s ∉ Set.range b := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    convert (Set.finite_range b).measure_zero volume using 1
    congr 1
    ext s
    simp
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc, ae_restrict_of_ae hoff] with s hs hsb
  exact hpos s hs hsb

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_le_det_apply
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_le_det_apply
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef) (hdet : X.det = 1) :
    operatorCapacity T ≤ (T X).det.re
proof:
:= by
  exact csInf_le (operatorCapacity_attainable_bddBelow T hT) ⟨X, hX, hdet, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_le_det_apply_one
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_le_det_apply_one
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef) :
    operatorCapacity T ≤ (T 1).det.re
proof:
:=
  operatorCapacity_le_det_apply T hT Matrix.PosDef.one Matrix.det_one

name: NLAlib.frobSq_apply_one_sub_one_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
statement:
theorem frobSq_apply_one_sub_one_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)
    (htr : (T 1).trace.re = (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hcap : Real.exp (-eps) ≤ operatorCapacity T) :
    frobSq (T 1 - 1) ≤ 6 * eps
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : Real.exp (-eps) ≤ (T 1).det.re :=
    hcap.trans (operatorCapacity_le_det_apply_one T hT)
  have hdetpos : 0 < (T 1).det.re := (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hdet
  have hne : (T 1).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hdetpos
  have hpos : (T 1).PosDef :=
    (hT 1 Matrix.PosSemidef.one).posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr hne
  exact hpos.frobSq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_det eps htr heps hdet

name: NLAlib.trace_krausMap_eq_of_adjoint_normalized
statement:
theorem trace_krausMap_eq_of_adjoint_normalized
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap (fun i => (A i)ᴴ) 1 = 1) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (krausMap A X).trace = X.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i = 1 := by
    simpa only [krausMap_apply, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
      using hA
  calc
    (krausMap A X).trace = ∑ i, (A i * X * (A i)ᴴ).trace := by
      rw [krausMap_apply, Matrix.trace_sum]
    _ = ∑ i, ((A i)ᴴ * A i * X).trace :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Matrix.trace_mul_cycle _ _ _
    _ = ((∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i) * X).trace := by
      rw [Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum]
    _ = X.trace := by rw [hsum, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_krausMap_defect_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
statement:
theorem frobSq_krausMap_defect_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap (fun i => (A i)ᴴ) 1 = 1)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hcap : Real.exp (-eps) ≤ operatorCapacity (krausMap A)) :
    frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) +
      frobSq (krausMap (fun i => (A i)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ≤ 6 * eps
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA, sub_self, frobSq_zero, add_zero]
  apply frobSq_apply_one_sub_one_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
    (krausMap A) (krausMap_posSemidef A) _ heps hcap
  rw [trace_krausMap_eq_of_adjoint_normalized A hA 1]
  simp

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_le_one_of_trace_apply_one
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_le_one_of_trace_apply_one
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)
    (htr : (T 1).trace.re = (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) :
    operatorCapacity T ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  calc
    operatorCapacity T ≤ (T 1).det.re := operatorCapacity_le_det_apply_one T hT
    _ ≤ ((T 1).trace.re / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n :=
      (hT 1 Matrix.PosSemidef.one).re_det_le_pow_re_trace_div_card hN
    _ = 1 := by rw [htr, div_self hcard, one_pow]

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_le_one_of_unital
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_le_one_of_unital
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hA, Matrix.det_one, Complex.one_re] using
    operatorCapacity_le_det_apply_one (krausMap A) (krausMap_posSemidef A)

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_le_one_of_adjoint_normalized
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_le_one_of_adjoint_normalized
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply operatorCapacity_le_one_of_trace_apply_one hN
    (krausMap A) (krausMap_posSemidef A)
  rw [trace_krausMap_eq_of_adjoint_normalized A hA 1]
  simp
