name: NLAlib.planeRotation_mem_unitary
statement:
private theorem planeRotation_mem_unitary {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hab : a+b=1) : planeRotation a b ∈ unitary (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsa := Real.sq_sqrt ha
  have hsb := Real.sq_sqrt hb
  constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals apply Complex.ext <;> simp [planeRotation, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]; all_goals nlinarith

name: NLAlib.diagonal_completion_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let v : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![1, -(D 0 1)/ε]
  have hv := (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v).smul hε.le
  have he : diagonal ![D 0 0 + ε, D 1 1 + (D 0 1)^2/ε] - D =
      ε • vecMulVec v (star v) := by
    have hd : D 1 0 = D 0 1 := by simpa using hD.apply 0 1
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal, v, vecMulVec, hd]
    all_goals field_simp
  rwa [← he] at hv

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.concaveOn_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ici _, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  let R : unitary (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
    ⟨planeRotation a b, planeRotation_mem_unitary ha hb hab⟩
  let D := (R : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) * diagonal (fun i : Fin 2 => ((![x,y] i : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
    (R : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ).conjTranspose
  have hdiag : (diagonal (fun i : Fin 2 => ((![x,y] i : ℝ) : ℂ))).PosSemidef := by
    apply posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using (RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr hx : (0 : ℂ) ≤ (x : ℂ))
    · simpa using (RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr hy : (0 : ℂ) ≤ (y : ℂ))
  have hD : D.PosSemidef := hdiag.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same _
  have hsa := Real.sq_sqrt ha
  have hsb := Real.sq_sqrt hb
  let Dreal : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
    !![a*x+b*y, Real.sqrt a*Real.sqrt b*(x-y);
       Real.sqrt a*Real.sqrt b*(x-y), b*x+a*y]
  have hreal : D = Dreal.map Complex.ofReal := by
    ext i j
    simp only [D, R, planeRotation, Dreal, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.map_apply]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    all_goals apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
    all_goals nlinarith [congrArg (fun z => z*x) hsa, congrArg (fun z => z*y) hsa,
      congrArg (fun z => z*x) hsb, congrArg (fun z => z*y) hsb]
  have hDr : Dreal.PosSemidef := (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff Dreal).mp (hreal ▸ hD)
  have hDf : (cfc f D) 0 0 = ((a*f x+b*f y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [D]
    rw [cfc_unitary_conj R f _ hdiag.isHermitian, cfc_diagonal_real]
    simp only [R, planeRotation, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun z => z*f x) hsa, congrArg (fun z => z*f y) hsb]
  have hbound (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : a*f x+b*f y ≤ f (a*x+b*y+ε) := by
    let ev : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Dreal 0 0 + ε, Dreal 1 1 + (Dreal 0 1)^2/ε]
    let E := diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))
    have hDE : D ≤ E := by
      rw [Matrix.le_iff, hreal]
      have h := (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) _).mpr
        (diagonal_completion_posSemidef Dreal hDr.isHermitian hε)
      change (realMatrixComplexification
        (diagonal ![Dreal 0 0 + ε, Dreal 1 1 + (Dreal 0 1)^2/ε] - Dreal) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ).PosSemidef at h
      rw [map_sub] at h
      convert! h using 1
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [E, ev, Matrix.diagonal, hij, realMatrixComplexification]
    have hE : E.PosSemidef := (hD.nonneg.trans hDE).posSemidef
    have hm' := hm.cfc_le hD.isHermitian hE.isHermitian
      (fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hD.nonneg hx)
      (fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hE.nonneg hx) hDE
    have hd := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hm').diag_nonneg (i := (0 : Fin 2))
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, hDf, show cfc f E = diagonal (fun i => (f (ev i) : ℂ)) from
      cfc_diagonal_real f ev] at hd
    have hh := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hd).1
    simpa [ev, Dreal] using hh
  have hz : 0 ≤ a*x+b*y := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hx) (mul_nonneg hb hy)
  have ht : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => a*x+b*y+ε) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[Ici 0] (a*x+b*y)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨by simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.add (tendsto_id.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0))), ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    exact add_nonneg hz (le_of_lt hε)
  have hh := ge_of_tendsto ((hf _ hz).tendsto.comp ht)
    (Eventually.mono self_mem_nhdsWithin fun ε hε => hbound ε hε)
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_one_add_of_matrixDyson
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_one_add_of_matrixDyson
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    {z : ℂ} (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≤ |z.re|) :
    (c - specNorm A) * specNorm X ≤ 1 + ‖S‖ * specNorm X ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : z • X - A * X + S X * X = -1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul] using heq
  have hzX : z • X = -1 + A * X - S X * X := by
    calc
      _ = (z • X - A * X + S X * X) + A * X - S X * X := by abel
      _ = _ := by rw [hsum]
  have hnorm : ‖z‖ * ‖X‖ ≤ 1 + ‖A‖ * ‖X‖ + ‖S‖ * ‖X‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ = ‖z • X‖ := (norm_smul z X).symm
      _ = ‖-1 + A * X - S X * X‖ := congrArg norm hzX
      _ ≤ ‖-1 + A * X‖ + ‖S X * X‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖(-1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ + ‖A * X‖ + ‖S X * X‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ 1 + ‖A‖ * ‖X‖ + (‖S‖ * ‖X‖) * ‖X‖ := by
        gcongr
        · simp
        · exact norm_mul_le _ _
        · exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (S.le_opNorm X) (norm_nonneg X))
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hc' : c ≤ ‖z‖ := hc.trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm z)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc' (norm_nonneg X)
  change (c - ‖A‖) * ‖X‖ ≤ 1 + ‖S‖ * ‖X‖ ^ 2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.tendsto_specNorm_matrixDyson_vertical
statement:
theorem tendsto_specNorm_matrixDyson_vertical
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1)
    (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => specNorm (M ((x : ℂ) + y * Complex.I))) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ tendsto_inv_atTop_zero
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
  have hz : 0 < ((x : ℂ) + y * Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
  simpa using specNorm_le_inv_im_of_matrixDyson A hA S hS hz _ (hpos _ hz) (heq _ hz)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_lt_two_div_of_matrixDyson_exterior
statement:
theorem specNorm_lt_two_div_of_matrixDyson_exterior
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ContinuousOn M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : specNorm A + 2 * Real.sqrt ‖S‖ < c)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (hcz : c ≤ |z.re|) :
    specNorm (M z) < 2 / (c - specNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : 0 < c - specNorm A := by
    have := Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖S‖
    linarith
  have hgap : 4 * ‖S‖ < (c - specNorm A) ^ 2 := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg S)
    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖S‖
    nlinarith
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => specNorm (M ((z.re : ℂ) + y * Complex.I))) (Ioi 0) := by
    apply (hM.comp (by fun_prop) (fun y hy => by simpa using hy)).norm
  have hb := hf.lt_two_div_of_quadratic
    (tendsto_specNorm_matrixDyson_vertical A hA S hS M hpos heq z.re)
    hδ hgap (fun y hy => mul_specNorm_le_one_add_of_matrixDyson A S
      (M ((z.re : ℂ) + y * Complex.I)) (heq _ (by simpa using hy)) (by simpa using hcz)) hz
  simpa only [Complex.re_add_im] using hb

name: NLAlib.norm_imaginaryPart_le_matrixDyson_quadratic
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_le_matrixDyson_quadratic
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 ≤ z.im) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤
      specNorm X ^ 2 * (z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hid := imaginaryPart_eq_matrixDyson_congruence A hA S hS z X heq
  calc
    _ = ‖Xᴴ * (z.im • 1 + S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)) * X‖ := congrArg norm hid
    _ ≤ (‖Xᴴ‖ * ‖z.im • 1 + S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖) * ‖X‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg X))
    _ ≤ (‖X‖ * (z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖)) * ‖X‖ := by
      rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose]
      gcongr
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖z.im • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ + ‖S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := by
          simpa [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hz] using
            add_le_add_left (S.le_opNorm (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)) z.im
    _ = _ := by dsimp [specNorm]; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_imaginaryPart_le_of_matrixDyson_exterior
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_le_of_matrixDyson_exterior
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ContinuousOn M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : specNorm A + 2 * Real.sqrt ‖S‖ < c)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (hcz : c ≤ |z.re|) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤
      (4 / ((c - specNorm A) ^ 2 - 4 * ‖S‖)) * z.im
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : 0 < c - specNorm A := by
    have := Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖S‖
    linarith
  have hgap : 0 < (c - specNorm A) ^ 2 - 4 * ‖S‖ := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg S)
    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖S‖
    nlinarith
  have hr := specNorm_lt_two_div_of_matrixDyson_exterior A hA S hS M hM hpos heq hc hz hcz
  have hsq : specNorm (M z) ^ 2 ≤ 4 / (c - specNorm A) ^ 2 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg (M z)) hr.le 2
    simpa only [div_pow, show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 4 by norm_num] using h
  have hq := norm_imaginaryPart_le_matrixDyson_quadratic A hA S hS hz.le (M z) (heq z hz)
  have hb : ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤
      (4 / (c - specNorm A) ^ 2) *
        (z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖) :=
    hq.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by positivity))
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg (c - specNorm A))
  have he : (c - specNorm A) ^ 2 *
      ((4 / (c - specNorm A) ^ 2) *
        (z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖)) =
      4 * (z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖) := by
    field_simp
  rw [he] at hm
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hgap]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_stieltjes_probability_measure_of_matrixKTransform_solution
statement:
theorem existsUnique_stieltjes_probability_measure_of_matrixKTransform_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) :
    ∃! μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass=1 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let N : ℂ → M := fun z => α•F z
  let L : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  let f : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => L (N z)
  have hfa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} := by
    intro z hz
    exact (L.analyticAt (N z)).comp ((hFa z hz).const_smul (c := α))
  have hfp : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → 0≤(f z).im := by
    intro z hz
    have hNpos : (imaginaryPart (N z) : M).PosSemidef := by
      have hp := ((hF z hz).1.smul hα).posSemidef
      simpa only [N,map_smul,selfAdjoint.val_smul] using hp
    exact im_normalizedTrace_nonneg_of_posSemidef_imaginaryPart (N z) hNpos
  have hnorm := tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixKTransform_solution ν hν α hα F hF
  have hflim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)*Complex.I*f ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    have ht := (L.continuous.tendsto (-1)).comp hnorm
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,map_smul,smul_eq_mul,map_neg,L,
      LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
      normalizedTrace_one,f,N,Complex.ofReal_one] using ht
  have hμ := hfa.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq hfp 1 hflim
  simpa only [f,N,L,LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply] using hμ

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stieltjes_probability_measure
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stieltjes_probability_measure
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) ∧
      ∃! μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass=1 ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
          ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F,hFa,hF⟩ := exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_upperHalfPlane_solution ν hν α hα
  have hF0 : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1 := fun z hz => ⟨(hF z hz).1,(hF z hz).2.1⟩
  exact ⟨F,hFa,hF0,
    existsUnique_stieltjes_probability_measure_of_matrixKTransform_solution ν hν α hα F hFa hF0⟩

name: NLAlib.krausMap_mul_mul_apply
statement:
theorem krausMap_mul_mul_apply (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B C X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    krausMap (fun a => B * A a * C) X =
      B * krausMap A (C * X * Cᴴ) * Bᴴ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [krausMap_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.krausTransition_nonneg
statement:
theorem krausTransition_nonneg (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (i j : n) :
    0 ≤ krausTransition A i j
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.re_diag_krausMap_diagonal
statement:
theorem re_diag_krausMap_diagonal (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (x : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    (krausMap A (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (x j : ℂ)) i i).re =
      (krausTransition A *ᵥ x) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [krausMap_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal_apply, mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
    if_true, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.re_sum,
    krausTransition, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  rw [mul_right_comm, Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_conj]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sum_row_krausTransition
statement:
theorem sum_row_krausTransition (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    (∑ j, krausTransition A i j) = (krausMap A 1 i i).re
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one, Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_one]
    using (re_diag_krausMap_diagonal A (fun _ => 1) i).symm

name: NLAlib.sum_col_krausTransition
statement:
theorem sum_col_krausTransition (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (j : n) :
    (∑ i, krausTransition A i j) =
      (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 j j).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_row_krausTransition]
  simp only [krausTransition, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.star_def,
    Complex.normSq_conj]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_re_diag_le_frobSq
statement:
private theorem sum_sq_re_diag_le_frobSq (M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∑ i, (M i i).re ^ 2) ≤ frobSq M
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  calc
    (M i i).re ^ 2 ≤ ‖M i i‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [← pow_two, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using Complex.re_sq_le_normSq (M i i)
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ‖M i j‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖M i j‖) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_sum_row_krausTransition_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sum_row_krausTransition_sub_one_le (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ j, krausTransition A i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  convert sum_sq_re_diag_le_frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) using 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [sum_row_krausTransition]
  simp

name: NLAlib.exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_with_marginals
statement:
theorem exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_with_marginals
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ W : Matrix n n ℝ,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) ∧
      (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1 → ∀ j, ∑ i, W i j = 1) ∧
      (krausMap A 1 = 1 → ∀ i, ∑ j, W i j = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) ∧
      (∑ j, (∑ i, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ∧
      W *ᵥ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues =
        (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  let hY := krausMap_posSemidef A X hX
  let u := hX.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let v := hY.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let U : Matrix n n ℂ := u
  let V : Matrix n n ℂ := v
  let B : ι → Matrix n n ℂ := fun a => Vᴴ * A a * U
  have hUU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    simpa only [U, Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_mul_star_self u
  have hU'U : Uᴴ * U = 1 := by
    simpa only [U, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_star_mul_self u
  have hVV : V * Vᴴ = 1 := by
    simpa only [V, Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_mul_star_self v
  have hV'V : Vᴴ * V = 1 := by
    simpa only [V, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.coe_star_mul_self v
  have hB_one : krausMap B 1 = Vᴴ * krausMap A 1 * V := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [krausMap_mul_mul_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_one, hUU, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hB_adj : krausMap (fun a => (B a)ᴴ) 1 =
      Uᴴ * krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 * U := by
    have hfamily : (fun a => (B a)ᴴ) = (fun a => Uᴴ * (A a)ᴴ * V) := by
      funext a
      simp only [B, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
        Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hfamily, krausMap_mul_mul_apply, Matrix.mul_one, hVV,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hXspec : X = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => (hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues j : ℂ)) * Uᴴ := by
    convert hX.isHermitian.spectral_theorem using 1
    simp [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Function.comp_def, U, u]
  have hYspec : Vᴴ * krausMap A X * V =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) := by
    convert hY.isHermitian.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary using 1 <;>
    simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Function.comp_def, V, v]
  have hBeig : krausMap B (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues j : ℂ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hY.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) := by
    rw [show krausMap B (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues j : ℂ)) =
      Vᴴ * krausMap A
        (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => (hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues j : ℂ)) * Uᴴ) * V by
          simpa only [B, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
            krausMap_mul_mul_apply A Vᴴ U
              (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues j : ℂ))]
    rw [← hXspec, hYspec]
  refine ⟨krausTransition B, krausTransition_nonneg B, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hA j
    rw [sum_col_krausTransition, hB_adj, hA, Matrix.mul_one, hU'U]
    simp
  · intro hA i
    rw [sum_row_krausTransition, hB_one, hA, Matrix.mul_one, hV'V]
    simp
  · have hdef : krausMap B 1 - 1 = Vᴴ * (krausMap A 1 - 1) * V := by
      rw [hB_one]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hV'V]
    have hV' : (Vᴴ)ᴴ * Vᴴ = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hVV
    calc
      _ ≤ frobSq (krausMap B 1 - 1) := sum_sq_sum_row_krausTransition_sub_one_le B
      _ = frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) := by
        rw [hdef, Matrix.mul_assoc, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hV']
        simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
          frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV' (krausMap A 1 - 1)
  · have hdef : krausMap (fun a => (B a)ᴴ) 1 - 1 =
        Uᴴ * (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) * U := by
      rw [hB_adj]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hU'U]
    have hU' : (Uᴴ)ᴴ * Uᴴ = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hUU
    have hrow := sum_sq_sum_row_krausTransition_sub_one_le (fun a => (B a)ᴴ)
    have hcols : (∑ j, (∑ i, krausTransition B i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (B a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) := by
      simpa only [krausTransition, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.star_def,
        Complex.normSq_conj] using hrow
    calc
      _ ≤ frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (B a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) := hcols
      _ = frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) := by
        rw [hdef, Matrix.mul_assoc, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU']
        simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
          frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hU' (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1)
  · funext i
    rw [← re_diag_krausMap_diagonal, hBeig]
    simp

name: NLAlib.exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1)
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ W : Matrix n n ℝ, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, W i j = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) ∧
      W *ᵥ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues =
        (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hc, _, hr, _, heig⟩ :=
    exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_with_marginals A hX
  exact ⟨W, hW, hc hA, hr, heig⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_of_unital
statement:
theorem exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_of_unital
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1)
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ W : Matrix n n ℝ, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, W i j = 1) ∧
      (∑ j, (∑ i, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ∧
      W *ᵥ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues =
        (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, _, hr, _, hc, heig⟩ :=
    exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues_with_marginals A hX
  exact ⟨W, hW, hr hA, hc, heig⟩

name: NLAlib.sqrt_invSqrt_congruence
statement:
theorem sqrt_invSqrt_congruence (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    cfc Real.sqrt S * (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S * X *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S) * cfc Real.sqrt S = X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS,Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS,Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.invSqrt_sqrt_congruence
statement:
theorem invSqrt_sqrt_congruence (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S * (cfc Real.sqrt S * X * cfc Real.sqrt S) *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S = X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS,Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS,Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_cfc_invSqrt
statement:
theorem isUnit_cfc_invSqrt (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) :
    IsUnit (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨_,cfc Real.sqrt S,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS⟩,rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.posDef_invSqrt_congruence_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_invSqrt_congruence_iff (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S * X * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S).PosDef ↔ X.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hR : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,hR.eq] using
    Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff (isUnit_cfc_invSqrt S hS) (x:=X)

name: NLAlib.posDef_sqrt_congruence_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_sqrt_congruence_iff (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (cfc Real.sqrt S * X * cfc Real.sqrt S).PosDef ↔ X.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (cfc Real.sqrt S).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hi : IsUnit (cfc Real.sqrt S) :=
    ⟨⟨_,_,cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS,cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS⟩,rfl⟩
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,hQ.eq] using
    Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hi (x:=X)

name: NLAlib.posDef_real_smul_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_real_smul_iff (a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (a•X).PosDef ↔ X.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := h.smul (inv_pos.mpr ha)
    simpa only [smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt ha),one_smul] using hh
  · exact fun h => h.smul ha

name: NLAlib.posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_iff
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ).PosDef ↔
      (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S * Δ * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S -
        matrixKStabilityMap ν α S (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S * Δ *
          cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence ν hν α (ne_of_gt hα) S hS hgap Δ]
  rw [posDef_real_smul_iff _ (inv_pos.mpr hα),posDef_invSqrt_congruence_iff S hS]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_real_sub_pos_of_hurwitz_complexification
statement:
theorem isUnit_real_sub_pos_of_hurwitz_complexification (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) : IsUnit (A - p • 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isUnit_realMatrixComplexification_iff _).mp
  have h := hA.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one p hp
  have he : (realMatrixComplexification (A - p • 1) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      realMatrixComplexification A - (p : ℂ) • 1 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, map_one]
    congr 1
  rw [he]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_cayleyTransform (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (p : ℝ)
    (hP : IsUnit (A - p • 1)) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (cayleyTransform A p) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      cayleyTransform (realMatrixComplexification A) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold cayleyTransform
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  rw [map_mul, realMatrixComplexification_inv hP]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, map_one]
  rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ)]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_real_cayleyTransform_pow_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_real_cayleyTransform_pow_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => cayleyTransform A p ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tendsto_real_matrix_pow_zero_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one _).mpr
  change spectralRadius ℂ (realMatrixComplexification (cayleyTransform A p) : Matrix n n ℂ) < 1
  rw [realMatrixComplexification_cayleyTransform A p (isUnit_real_sub_pos_of_hurwitz_complexification A hA p hp)]
  exact hA.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one p hp

name: NLAlib.tendsto_real_lyapunovADI_snd_const
statement:
theorem tendsto_real_lyapunovADI_snd_const (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix n s ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun j => (lyapunovADI A B (fun _ => p) j).2) atTop
      (𝓝 (realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)))
proof:
:= by
  let X := realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)
  have hEq : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0 := (realLyapunovGramian_equation_unique A _ hA).1
  have hP : ∀ j : ℕ, IsUnit (A - ((fun _ : ℕ => p) j) • 1).det := fun _ =>
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_real_sub_pos_of_hurwitz_complexification A hA p hp)
  have ht := tendsto_real_cayleyTransform_pow_zero A hA p hp
  have hstar : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (cayleyTransform A p ^ j)ᴴ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => Mᴴ) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  have he := (ht.mul_const X).mul hstar
  simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero] at he
  have herror : (fun j => cayleyTransform A p ^ j * X * (cayleyTransform A p ^ j)ᴴ) =
      fun j => X - (lyapunovADI A B (fun _ => p) j).2 := by
    funext j
    rw [sub_lyapunovADI_snd A X B _ hP hEq]
    have hconst (j : ℕ) : lyapunovADIPropagator A (fun _ => p) j = cayleyTransform A p ^ j := by
      induction j with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ j hj => rw [lyapunovADIPropagator, hj, pow_succ']
    rw [hconst]
  rw [herror] at he
  have hh := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := X) (f := atTop)).sub he
  simpa only [sub_sub_cancel, sub_zero] using hh

name: NLAlib.mixedResolventTraceInsertion_eq_sum_split
statement:
theorem mixedResolventTraceInsertion_eq_sum_split
    (X H : Matrix d d ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) (a b : ℕ) :
    mixedResolventTraceInsertion X H H ζ (star ζ) a b =
      ∑ j : Fin (a + b), normalizedTrace
        (H * (resolvent X ζ ^ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).1 *
          resolvent X (star ζ) ^ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).2) * H *
            (resolvent X ζ ^ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).1 *
              resolvent X (star ζ) ^ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun U : Matrix d d ℂ => normalizedTrace (H * U))
    (mixed_power_insertion_sum_eq_sum_split (resolvent X ζ) (resolvent X (star ζ)) H a b)
  simpa only [mixedResolventTraceInsertion, Matrix.mul_add, Finset.mul_sum,
    normalizedTrace, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sum, mul_add,
    Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_assoc] using h

name: NLAlib.steinPartialSum_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem steinPartialSum_zero (A Q : Matrix n n K) : steinPartialSum A Q 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [steinPartialSum]

name: NLAlib.steinPartialSum_succ
statement:
theorem steinPartialSum_succ (A Q : Matrix n n K) (N : ℕ) :
    steinPartialSum A Q (N + 1) = steinPartialSum A Q N + A ^ N * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_range_succ _ _

name: NLAlib.steinPartialSum_add
statement:
theorem steinPartialSum_add (A Q : Matrix n n K) (M N : ℕ) :
    steinPartialSum A Q (M + N) = steinPartialSum A Q M +
      A ^ M * steinPartialSum A Q N * (Aᴴ) ^ M
proof:
:= by
  unfold steinPartialSum
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [pow_add, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [pow_mul_comm (Aᴴ) j M]

name: NLAlib.sub_steinPartialSum_eq
statement:
theorem sub_steinPartialSum_eq (A Q X : Matrix n n K) (hX : X - A * X * Aᴴ = Q) (N : ℕ) :
    X - steinPartialSum A Q N = A ^ N * X * (Aᴴ) ^ N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N hN =>
    rw [steinPartialSum_succ, ← sub_sub, hN, ← hX, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ']
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    abel

name: NLAlib.steinPartialSum_residual
statement:
theorem steinPartialSum_residual (A Q : Matrix n n K) (N : ℕ) :
    Q - steinPartialSum A Q N + A * steinPartialSum A Q N * Aᴴ =
      A ^ N * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N hN =>
    rw [steinPartialSum_succ]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
    have heq : Q - (steinPartialSum A Q N + A ^ N * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N) +
        (A * steinPartialSum A Q N * Aᴴ + A * (A ^ N * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N) * Aᴴ) =
        (Q - steinPartialSum A Q N + A * steinPartialSum A Q N * Aᴴ) -
          A ^ N * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N + A * (A ^ N * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ N) * Aᴴ := by abel
    rw [heq, hN, sub_self, zero_add, pow_succ', pow_succ]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_steinPartialSum
statement:
theorem posSemidef_steinPartialSum (A Q : Matrix n n K) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) (N : ℕ) :
    (steinPartialSum A Q N).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
  intro j _
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_pow] using hQ.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (A ^ j)

name: NLAlib.monotone_steinPartialSum
statement:
theorem monotone_steinPartialSum (A Q : Matrix n n K) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) :
    Monotone (steinPartialSum A Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro N
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, steinPartialSum_succ, add_sub_cancel_left]
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_pow] using hQ.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (A ^ N)

name: NLAlib.smithDoubling_eq
statement:
theorem smithDoubling_eq (A Q : Matrix n n K) (j : ℕ) :
    smithDoubling A Q j = (A ^ (2 ^ j), steinPartialSum A Q (2 ^ j))
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [smithDoubling, steinPartialSum]
  | succ j hj =>
    rw [smithDoubling, hj]
    simp only [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
    rw [pow_add, steinPartialSum_add]
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_pow]

name: NLAlib.smithDoubling_factor_step
statement:
theorem smithDoubling_factor_step {s : Type*} [Fintype s] (P : Matrix n n K)
    (Z : Matrix n s K) :
    Z * Zᴴ + P * (Z * Zᴴ) * Pᴴ =
      Matrix.fromCols Z (P * Z) * (Matrix.fromCols Z (P * Z))ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromCols_eq_fromRows_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows]
  simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.trace_pow_nonneg_of_even
statement:
theorem trace_pow_nonneg_of_even {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : Even n) : 0 ≤ (A ^ n).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _hi => hn.pow_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pow_two_mul_le_trace_pow
statement:
theorem specNorm_pow_two_mul_le_trace_pow {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) : specNorm A ^ (2 * q) ≤ (A ^ (2 * q)).trace
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl hι =>
      have hzero : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst A
      simp [specNorm_eq_norm, Nat.ne_of_gt hq]
  | inr hι =>
      rw [specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hA, trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA]
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm hA.eigenvalues).1
      rw [← hi]
      calc
        ‖hA.eigenvalues i‖ ^ (2 * q) = hA.eigenvalues i ^ (2 * q) := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← abs_pow]
          exact abs_of_nonneg ((even_two_mul q).pow_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i))
        _ ≤ ∑ j, hA.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * q) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum
            (fun j _hj => (even_two_mul q).pow_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues j))
            (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.differentiableAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X : M => ∫ T : selfAdjoint M, matrixKLogDetKernel X T.val ∂ν) S
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun T : selfAdjoint M => (T : M)) :=
    (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ M).subtypeL.contDiff
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => 1 + p.2.val * p.1) :=
    contDiff_const.add ((hval.comp contDiff_snd).mul contDiff_fst)
  have hdet : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re) :=
    Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp ((Matrix.contDiff_det 1).comp hA)
  let U : Set (M × selfAdjoint M) := {p | (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re ≠ 0}
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun hdet.continuous continuous_const
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1
      (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => Real.log (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re) U :=
    hdet.contDiffOn.log (fun _ hp => hp)
  have hpoint (T : selfAdjoint M) (hT : T ∈ ν.support) : (S, T) ∈ U :=
    (Complex.pos_iff.mp (det_one_add_mul_pos_of_matrixK_admissible S T.val hS (hgap T hT))).1.ne'
  exact differentiableAt_integral_of_contDiffOn_compact_support ν hν
    (fun p : M × selfAdjoint M => Real.log (1 + p.2.val * p.1).det.re) U hU hF S hpoint

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixKPotential
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixKPotential
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α u : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    HasFDerivAt (matrixKPotential ν α u)
      (α • ((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M (matrixKTransform ν α S - (u : ℂ) • 1)))) S
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℝ := Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X : M => X.trace.re) S := T.differentiableAt
  have hI := differentiableAt_integral_matrixKLogDetKernel ν hν S hS hgap
  have hdet : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X : M => X.det.re) S :=
    Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp S ((Matrix.contDiff_det 1).differentiable one_ne_zero S)
  have hlog := hdet.log (Complex.pos_iff.mp hS.det_pos).1.ne'
  have hpot : DifferentiableAt ℝ (matrixKPotential ν α u) S := by
    convert! (((htrace.const_mul (-α * u)).add (hI.const_mul α)).sub hlog).sub_const
      ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (Real.log α + 1)) using 1
  have hD := hpot.hasFDerivAt
  have he : fderiv ℝ (matrixKPotential ν α u) S =
      α • ((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M (matrixKTransform ν α S - (u : ℂ) • 1))) := by
    ext H
    change fderiv ℝ (matrixKPotential ν α u) S H =
      α * ((matrixKTransform ν α S - (u : ℂ) • 1) * H).trace.re
    have hline : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => S + t • H) H 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const H).const_add S
    have hDA : HasFDerivAt (matrixKPotential ν α u)
        (fderiv ℝ (matrixKPotential ν α u) S) (S + (0 : ℝ) • H) := by
      simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hD
    have h₁ := hDA.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hline
    have h₂ := hasDerivAt_matrixKPotential_line ν hν α u hα S H hS hgap
    exact h₁.unique h₂
  rwa [he] at hD

name: NLAlib.re_trace_block_diag
statement:
private theorem re_trace_block_diag (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B).trace.re = A.trace.re + B.trace.re
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_even_moment_smoothness
statement:
theorem re_trace_even_moment_smoothness (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : Even p) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) :
    ((((A + H) ^ p).trace.re + ((A - H) ^ p).trace.re) / 2) ^ (2 / (p : ℝ)) ≤
      (A ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ)) +
        ((p : ℝ) - 1) * (H ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let B : Matrix (ι ⊕ ι) (ι ⊕ ι) ℂ := Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 A
  let D : Matrix (ι ⊕ ι) (ι ⊕ ι) ℂ := Matrix.fromBlocks H 0 0 (-H)
  have hB : B.IsHermitian := hA.fromBlocks (by simp) hA
  have hD : D.IsHermitian := hH.fromBlocks (by simp) hH.neg
  have hzero : reTracePowerFirst p B D 0 = 0 := by
    simp only [reTracePowerFirst, zero_smul, add_zero, B, D,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal_pow, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero,
      Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, neg_mul, neg_zero]
    rw [re_trace_block_diag]
    simp
  have h := rpow_le_of_moment_second_derivative_le
    (f := reTracePowerAlong p B D) (f' := reTracePowerFirst p B D)
    (f'' := reTracePowerSecond p B D)
    (p := (p : ℝ)) (K := (D ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ)))
    (by exact_mod_cast hp2)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even D hD hp) _)
    (fun t => re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even (B + t • D)
      (hB.add (hD.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t))) hp)
    (hasDerivAt_reTracePowerAlong p B D) (hasDerivAt_reTracePowerFirst p B D)
    hzero (reTracePowerSecond_le_even_moments p hp hp2 B D hB hD)
  have hBpow : (B ^ p).trace.re = 2 * (A ^ p).trace.re := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal_pow, re_trace_block_diag]
    ring
  have hDpow : (D ^ p).trace.re = 2 * (H ^ p).trace.re := by
    dsimp [D]
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal_pow, re_trace_block_diag, hp.neg_pow]
    ring
  have hline : B + D = Matrix.fromBlocks (A + H) 0 0 (A - H) := by
    ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> simp [B, D, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h1 : reTracePowerAlong p B D 1 =
      ((A + H) ^ p).trace.re + ((A - H) ^ p).trace.re := by
    simp only [reTracePowerAlong, one_smul, hline, Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal_pow,
      re_trace_block_diag]
  have h0 : reTracePowerAlong p B D 0 = 2 * (A ^ p).trace.re := by
    simpa only [reTracePowerAlong, zero_smul, add_zero] using hBpow
  rw [h1, h0, hDpow] at h
  have ha := re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even A hA hp
  have hh := re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even H hH hp
  have hplus := re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even (A + H) (hA.add hH) hp
  have hminus := re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even (A - H) (hA.sub hH) hp
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) ha,
    Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hh] at h
  rw [Real.div_rpow (add_nonneg hplus hminus) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) _)).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_variational_traceExp
statement:
theorem NLAlib.isGreatest_variational_traceExp {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (H A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (_hA : A.PosDef) :
    IsGreatest {r : ℝ | ∃ T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
      T.PosDef ∧ r = (Matrix.trace (T * H)).re + (Matrix.trace A).re -
        relativeEntropy T A}
      (traceExp (H + matrixLog A))
proof:
:= by
  have hHerm : (H + matrixLog A).IsHermitian := hH.add (cfc_predicate Real.log A)
  obtain ⟨hPD, hLog⟩ := posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp (H + matrixLog A) hHerm
  have hVar := isGreatest_variational_trace (matrixExp (H + matrixLog A)) hPD
  have score (T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :
      (Matrix.trace (T * matrixLog (matrixExp (H + matrixLog A)) - T * matrixLog T + T)).re =
        (Matrix.trace (T * H)).re + (Matrix.trace A).re - relativeEntropy T A := by
    rw [hLog]
    simp only [relativeEntropy_complex, mul_add, mul_sub, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re]
    ring
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨T,hT,hEq⟩ := hVar.1
    exact ⟨T,hT,hEq.trans (score T)⟩
  · rintro r ⟨T,hT,rfl⟩
    rw [← score T]
    exact hVar.2 ⟨T,hT,rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.matrix_map_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem matrix_map_imaginaryPart (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ) = (imaginaryPart (S X) : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:=
  map_imaginaryPart (matrixPositiveMap S hS) X

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixDysonCoefficient
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixDysonCoefficient
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (imaginaryPart (z • 1 - A + S X) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      z.im • 1 + S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
  rw [matrix_map_imaginaryPart S hS]
  simp [map_add, map_sub, imaginaryPart_smul, hA.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,
    hI.imaginaryPart, realPart_one]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_inv_im_of_matrixDyson
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_inv_im_of_matrixDyson
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) : specNorm X ≤ z.im⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.norm_le_inv_of_mul_eq_neg_one_of_imaginaryPart_ge hz heq
  rw [imaginaryPart_matrixDysonCoefficient A hA S hS]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hS _ hpos)

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_eq_matrixDyson_congruence
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_eq_matrixDyson_congruence
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      Xᴴ * (z.im • 1 + S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)) * X
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = Xᴴ * (imaginaryPart (z • 1 - A + S X) : Matrix n n ℂ) * X :=
      Matrix.imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one heq
    _ = _ := by rw [imaginaryPart_matrixDysonCoefficient A hA S hS]

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_traceExp_add_matrixLog
statement:
theorem continuousOn_traceExp_add_matrixLog {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (H : Matrix d d ℂ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun A => traceExp (H + matrixLog A))
      {A : Matrix d d ℂ | A.PosDef}
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix d d ℂ) := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  have hl : ContinuousOn (matrixLog : Matrix d d ℂ → _)
      {A : Matrix d d ℂ | A.PosDef} :=
    CFC.continuousOn_log.mono (fun A hA => ⟨hA.isHermitian, hA.isUnit⟩)
  have he : ContinuousOn (fun A => matrixExp (H + matrixLog A))
      {A : Matrix d d ℂ | A.PosDef} :=
    NormedSpace.exp_continuous.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.add hl)
  exact Complex.continuous_re.comp_continuousOn
    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap d ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.continuous.comp_continuousOn he)

name: NLAlib.realLyapunovGramian_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem realLyapunovGramian_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix n s ℝ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) (v : n → ℝ) :
    realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) *ᵥ v = 0 ↔
      ∀ j < Fintype.card n, Bᴴ *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let G := realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)
  have hX : G.PosSemidef := posSemidef_realLyapunovGramian A _ hA (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose B)
  have heq : A * G + G * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0 := (realLyapunovGramian_equation_unique A _ hA).1
  constructor
  · intro hv
    change G *ᵥ v = 0 at hv
    have hker (j : ℕ) : G *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
      induction j with
      | zero => simpa only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec] using hv
      | succ j hj =>
        rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
        exact (kernel_lyapunov_invariant A B G hX heq _ hj).2
    intro j _
    exact (kernel_lyapunov_invariant A B G hX heq _ (hker j)).1
  · intro hv
    have hall := mulVec_pow_zero_of_lt_card Aᴴ Bᴴ v hv
    have he (t : ℝ) : Bᴴ *ᵥ ((matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
      have hstar : (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ = matrixExp (t • Aᴴ) := by
        change star (NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) = NormedSpace.exp (t • star A)
        rw [NormedSpace.star_exp, star_smul, star_trivial]
      rw [hstar]
      exact mulVec_matrixExp_zero_of_pow_zero Aᴴ Bᴴ v hall t
    let F : Matrix n n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] n → ℝ := (LinearMap.applyₗ v).comp Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap
    have hi := F.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (integrableOn_realLyapunovIntegrand A (B * Bᴴ) hA)
    change (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), realLyapunovIntegrand A (B * Bᴴ) t *ᵥ v) =
      realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) *ᵥ v at hi
    rw [← hi]
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      change realLyapunovIntegrand A (B * Bᴴ) t *ᵥ v = 0
      simp only [realLyapunovIntegrand, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, he, Matrix.mulVec_zero]

name: NLAlib.rank_realLyapunovGramian_eq_rank_controllabilityMatrix
statement:
theorem rank_realLyapunovGramian_eq_rank_controllabilityMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (B : Matrix n s ℝ) (hA : IsHurwitz (realMatrixComplexification A : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    (realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).rank = (controllabilityMatrix A B).rank
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.ker (controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ.mulVecLin := by
    ext v
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, realLyapunovGramian_mulVec_eq_zero_iff A B hA]
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext j
      have hj := h j.1 j.1.isLt
      have he : ((controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ *ᵥ v) j =
          (Bᴴ *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ (j.1 : ℕ) *ᵥ v)) j.2 := by
        change (((A ^ (j.1 : ℕ) * B)ᴴ) *ᵥ v) j.2 = _
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_pow, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rw [he, hj]
      rfl
    · intro h j hj
      ext a
      change (Bᴴ *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ j *ᵥ v)) a = 0
      have he := congrFun h (⟨j, hj⟩, a)
      change (((A ^ j * B)ᴴ) *ᵥ v) a = 0 at he
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_pow, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using he
  have h₁ := (realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have h₂ := (controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hker] at h₁
  change (realLyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).rank + _ = _ at h₁
  change (controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ.rank + _ = _ at h₂
  rw [Matrix.rank_conjTranspose] at h₂
  omega

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_sum
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_sum {ι : Type*} (U : Matrix m r ℂ) (V : Matrix n r ℂ)
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → r → ℝ) :
    thinSingularMatrix U V (fun j => ∑ i ∈ s, f i j) = ∑ i ∈ s, thinSingularMatrix U V (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [thinSingularMatrix]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [sum_insert hi]
    rw [← thinSingularMatrix_add, ih]

name: NLAlib.thinSingularMatrix_mul_gram_pow
statement:
theorem thinSingularMatrix_mul_gram_pow (U : Matrix m r ℂ) (V : Matrix n r ℂ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (f : r → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    thinSingularMatrix U V f * ((thinSingularMatrix U V f)ᴴ * thinSingularMatrix U V f) ^ j =
      thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => f i ^ (2 * j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ih,
      thinSingularMatrix_gram U V hU, thinSingularMatrix_mul U V V hV]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1

name: NLAlib.oddMatrixUpdate_thinSingularMatrix
statement:
theorem oddMatrixUpdate_thinSingularMatrix (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (U : Matrix m r ℂ) (V : Matrix n r ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (f : r → ℝ) :
    oddMatrixUpdate q a (thinSingularMatrix U V f) =
      thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => oddScalarUpdate q a (f i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [oddMatrixUpdate, thinSingularMatrix_mul_gram_pow U V hU hV,
    thinSingularMatrix_smul]
  exact (thinSingularMatrix_sum U V (range (q + 1))
    (fun j i => a j * f i ^ (2 * j + 1))).symm

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.oddMatrixIterate_eq
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.oddMatrixIterate_eq {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ} (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ)
    (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    oddMatrixIterate q a A k =
      thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => oddScalarComposition q a (σ i) k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact h.eq
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [oddMatrixIterate, ih,
      oddMatrixUpdate_thinSingularMatrix q (a k) U V h.left_orth h.right_orth]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_eq
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_eq
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate q a A k) =
      ‖fun i => 1 - oddScalarComposition q a (σ i) k‖
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : canonicalPartialPolar A = thinSingularMatrix U V (fun _ => 1) := by
    rw [h.canonicalPartialPolar_eq]
    simp [thinSingularMatrix]
  rw [hQ, h.oddMatrixIterate_eq, thinSingularMatrix_sub,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix U V h.left_orth h.right_orth]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_le
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_le
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    {l u ε : ℝ} (hσ : ∀ i, σ i ∈ Set.Icc l u) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hscalar : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc l u, |1 - oddScalarComposition q a x k| ≤ ε) :
    specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate q a A k) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_eq]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hε).mpr
  exact fun i => hscalar (σ i) (hσ i)

name: NLAlib.isUnit_matrixKDenominator
statement:
theorem isUnit_matrixKDenominator (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : (S⁻¹ + T).PosDef) : IsUnit (1 + S * T)
proof:
:= by
  have he : 1 + S * T = S * (S⁻¹ + T) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit)]
  rw [he]
  exact hS.isUnit.mul hgap.isUnit

name: NLAlib.posDef_one_add_matrixKWhitened
statement:
theorem posDef_one_add_matrixKWhitened (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : (S⁻¹ + T).PosDef) : (1 + matrixKWhitened S T).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt S
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
  have hQR : Q * R = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS
  have hRQ : R * Q = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS
  have hQi : IsUnit Q := ⟨⟨Q,R,hQR,hRQ⟩,rfl⟩
  have hQ : Q.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hInv : S⁻¹ = R * R := inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hS
  have he : 1 + matrixKWhitened S T = Q * (S⁻¹ + T) * Qᴴ := by
    rw [hQ.eq, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hInv]
    change 1 + Q * T * Q = Q * (R * R) * Q + Q * T * Q
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQR, Matrix.one_mul, hRQ]
  rw [he]
  exact (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hQi).mpr hgap

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_matrixKCoefficient
statement:
theorem isHermitian_matrixKCoefficient (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hT : T.IsHermitian) (hgap : (S⁻¹ + T).PosDef) : (matrixKCoefficient S T).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : (matrixKWhitened S T).IsHermitian := by
    have hQ : (cfc Real.sqrt S).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
    simp only [matrixKWhitened, Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hQ.eq, hT.eq,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hP := posDef_one_add_matrixKWhitened S T hS hgap
  have he : matrixKCoefficient S T = 1 - (1 + matrixKWhitened S T)⁻¹ := by
    unfold matrixKCoefficient
    have hZeq : matrixKWhitened S T = (1 + matrixKWhitened S T) - 1 := by abel
    calc
      _ = ((1 + matrixKWhitened S T) - 1) * (1 + matrixKWhitened S T)⁻¹ := by rw [← hZeq]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hP.isUnit), Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [he]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hP.inv.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_eq_inv_sqrt_congruence
statement:
theorem matrixKResolvent_eq_inv_sqrt_congruence (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) :
    matrixKResolvent S T = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S * matrixKCoefficient S T *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
proof:
:= by
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt S
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
  let Z := matrixKWhitened S T
  have hQR : Q * R = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hS
  have hRQ : R * Q = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hS
  have hQQ : Q * Q = S := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hS
  have hden : 1 + S * T = Q * (1 + Z) * R := by
    dsimp only [Z, matrixKWhitened]
    change 1 + S * T = Q * (1 + Q * T * Q) * R
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hz : Q * (Q * T * Q) * R = S * T := by
      calc
        _ = (Q * Q) * T * (Q * R) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [hQQ,hQR,Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [hQR,hz]
  have hQi : Q⁻¹ = R := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hQR
  have hRi : R⁻¹ = Q := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hRQ
  unfold matrixKResolvent
  rw [hden, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hQi,hRi]
  change T * (Q * ((1+Z)⁻¹ * R)) = R * (Z * (1+Z)⁻¹) * R
  have hRZ : R * Z = T * Q := by
    change R * (Q * T * Q) = T * Q
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hRQ, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc R Z, hRZ]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_matrixKResolvent
statement:
theorem isHermitian_matrixKResolvent (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hT : T.IsHermitian) (hgap : (S⁻¹ + T).PosDef) : (matrixKResolvent S T).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKResolvent_eq_inv_sqrt_congruence S T hS]
  have hR : (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hC := isHermitian_matrixKCoefficient S T hS hT hgap
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hR.eq,hC.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.matrixKResolvent_eq_right
statement:
theorem matrixKResolvent_eq_right (S T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hT : T.IsHermitian) (hgap : (S⁻¹ + T).PosDef) :
    matrixKResolvent S T = (1 + T * S)⁻¹ * T
proof:
:= by
  have hR := (isHermitian_matrixKResolvent S T hS hT hgap).eq
  simpa only [matrixKResolvent, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,hT.eq,hS.isHermitian.eq] using hR.symm

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_of_posDef
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_of_posDef
    (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hS : S.val.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S.val⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) :
    HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S.val) S.val
proof:
:=
  hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform ν hν α S.val hS.isUnit
    (fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S.val T.val hS (hgap T hT))

name: NLAlib.mem_real_spectrum_of_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem mem_real_spectrum_of_unitary_diagonalization (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) (i : n) : ev i ∈ spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (ev i : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ A := by
    rw [hA]
    change (ev i : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ
      ((Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U) (diagonal (fun j => (ev j : ℂ))))
    rw [AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq, spectrum_diagonal]
    exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact (spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff ℂ).mp hc

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner
statement:
theorem hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (hA.eigenvalues i))
    (ev : n → ℝ) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hdiag : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) :
    HasFDerivWithinAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => cfc f B)
      (loewnerDerivative f ev U) {B | B.IsHermitian} A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hv, hd, hp⟩ := exists_hermite_polynomial_hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc hA hf
  have hnodes (i : n) : ∃ j, hA.eigenvalues j = ev i := by
    have hi := mem_real_spectrum_of_unitary_diagonalization ev U hdiag i
    rwa [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hi
  have hv' (i : n) : p.eval (ev i) = f (ev i) := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hnodes i
    rw [← hj]
    exact hv j
  have hd' (i : n) : p.derivative.eval (ev i) = deriv f (ev i) := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hnodes i
    rw [← hj]
    exact hd j
  rw [frechetDerivative_eq_loewnerDerivative p ev U hdiag,
    loewnerDerivative_eq_of_values_deriv p f ev U hv' hd'] at hp
  exact hp

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_cfc_hermitian_loewner
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_cfc_hermitian_loewner
    (A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f ((show (A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian from A.property).eigenvalues i))
    (ev : n → ℝ) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hdiag : (A : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) => cfc f (B : Matrix n n ℂ))
      ((loewnerDerivative f ev U).comp (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).subtypeL) A
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner (show (A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian from A.property)
    hf ev U hdiag
  exact h.comp_hasFDerivAt A (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).subtypeL.hasFDerivAt
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun B : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) => B.property)

name: NLAlib.exists_seq_det_tendsto_operatorCapacity
statement:
theorem exists_seq_det_tendsto_operatorCapacity
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef) :
    ∃ X : ℕ → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ k, (X k).PosDef) ∧ (∀ k, (X k).det = 1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => (T (X k)).det.re) atTop (𝓝 (operatorCapacity T))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, _, hlim, hmem⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto_sInf
    (operatorCapacity_attainable_nonempty T) (operatorCapacity_attainable_bddBelow T hT)
  choose X hX hdet hd using hmem
  refine ⟨X, hX, hdet, ?_⟩
  have hfun : (fun k => (T (X k)).det.re) = d := funext fun k => (hd k).symm
  rw [hfun]
  exact hlim

name: NLAlib.krausMap_kronecker_apply
statement:
theorem krausMap_kronecker_apply (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (Y : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2) (X ⊗ₖ Y) =
      krausMap A X ⊗ₖ krausMap B Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [krausMap_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker,
    ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul]
  ext ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨j, l⟩
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, Finset.sum_mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.re_det_kronecker
proof:
:= by
  have hXi : X.det.im = 0 := (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hX.det_nonneg).2.symm
  have hYi : Y.det.im = 0 := (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hY.det_nonneg).2.symm
  have hXreal : X.det = (X.det.re : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hXi]
  have hYreal : Y.det = (Y.det.re : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hYi]
  rw [Matrix.det_kronecker, hXreal, hYreal, ← Complex.ofReal_pow,
    ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
  simp

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_le
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_le
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)) ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hXdet, hXlim⟩ :=
    exists_seq_det_tendsto_operatorCapacity (krausMap A) (krausMap_posSemidef A)
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, hYlim⟩ :=
    exists_seq_det_tendsto_operatorCapacity (krausMap B) (krausMap_posSemidef B)
  apply ge_of_tendsto ((hXlim.pow (Fintype.card m)).mul (hYlim.pow (Fintype.card n)))
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro k
  have hdet : (X k ⊗ₖ Y k).det = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_kronecker, hXdet, hYdet]
    simp
  have hbound := operatorCapacity_le_det_apply
    (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2))
    (krausMap_posSemidef _) ((hX k).kronecker (hY k)) hdet
  rw [krausMap_kronecker_apply,
    re_det_kronecker (krausMap_posSemidef A _ (hX k).posSemidef)
      (krausMap_posSemidef B _ (hY k).posSemidef)] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.frobSq_kronecker_complex
statement:
private theorem frobSq_kronecker_complex (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (Y : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    frobSq (X ⊗ₖ Y) = frobSq X * frobSq Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
    norm_mul, mul_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_complex
statement: private theorem frobSq_one_complex : frobSq (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frobNorm_sq] using (frobNorm_one_sq (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_one_eq_sub_card
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : frobInner X 1 = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, hX.eq, Matrix.mul_one, htr]
    simp
  rw [frobSq_sub, hinner, frobSq_one_complex]
