name: NLAlib.krausMap_kronecker_one
statement:
theorem krausMap_kronecker_one (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2) 1 =
      krausMap A 1 ⊗ₖ krausMap B 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.one_kronecker_one] using krausMap_kronecker_apply A B 1 1

name: NLAlib.krausMap_kronecker_one_eq_one
statement:
theorem krausMap_kronecker_one_eq_one
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1) (hB : krausMap B 1 = 1) :
    krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [krausMap_kronecker_one, hA, hB, Matrix.one_kronecker_one]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_adjoint_krausMap_kronecker_sub_one
statement:
theorem frobSq_adjoint_krausMap_kronecker_sub_one
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1) (hB : krausMap B 1 = 1) :
    frobSq (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => (A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)ᴴ) 1 - 1) =
      (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) +
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * frobSq (krausMap (fun b => (B b)ᴴ) 1 - 1) +
      frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) *
        frobSq (krausMap (fun b => (B b)ᴴ) 1 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let X : Matrix n n ℂ := krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1
  let Y : Matrix m m ℂ := krausMap (fun b => (B b)ᴴ) 1
  have hX : X.PosSemidef := krausMap_posSemidef _ _ Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  have hY : Y.PosSemidef := krausMap_posSemidef _ _ Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  have hXtr : X.trace = (Fintype.card n : ℂ) := by
    have hAn : krausMap (fun a => ((A a)ᴴ)ᴴ) 1 = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hA
    simpa only [X, Matrix.trace_one] using
      trace_krausMap_eq_of_adjoint_normalized (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) hAn 1
  have hYtr : Y.trace = (Fintype.card m : ℂ) := by
    have hBn : krausMap (fun b => ((B b)ᴴ)ᴴ) 1 = 1 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hB
    simpa only [Y, Matrix.trace_one] using
      trace_krausMap_eq_of_adjoint_normalized (fun b => (B b)ᴴ) hBn 1
  have hXYtr : (X ⊗ₖ Y).trace = (Fintype.card (n × m) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_kronecker, hXtr, hYtr, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
  have hmap : krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => (A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)ᴴ) 1 = X ⊗ₖ Y := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, X, Y] using
      krausMap_kronecker_one (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) (fun b => (B b)ᴴ)
  rw [hmap, frobSq_sub_one_eq_sub_card (hX.kronecker hY).isHermitian hXYtr,
    frobSq_kronecker_complex,
    frobSq_sub_one_eq_sub_card hX.isHermitian hXtr,
    frobSq_sub_one_eq_sub_card hY.isHermitian hYtr,
    Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_scaled_krausMap_kronecker
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_scaled_krausMap_kronecker
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : 0 < Fintype.card m)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (L R : Matrix n n ℂ) (P Q : Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hL : IsUnit L) (hR : IsUnit R) (hP : IsUnit P) (hQ : IsUnit Q) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap
      (fun p : ι × κ => (L * A p.1 * R) ⊗ₖ (P * B p.2 * Q))) =
      (Complex.normSq L.det * Complex.normSq R.det) ^ Fintype.card m *
      (Complex.normSq P.det * Complex.normSq Q.det) ^ Fintype.card n *
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2))
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : 0 < Fintype.card (n × m) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_prod]
    exact Nat.mul_pos hN hM
  have hfamily :
      (fun p : ι × κ => (L * A p.1 * R) ⊗ₖ (P * B p.2 * Q)) =
      (fun p : ι × κ => (L ⊗ₖ P) * (A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2) * (R ⊗ₖ Q)) := by
    funext p
    rw [← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul]
  have hscale := operatorCapacity_congruence_scaling hdim
    (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2))
    (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => (L * A p.1 * R) ⊗ₖ (P * B p.2 * Q)))
    (krausMap_posSemidef _) (L ⊗ₖ P) (R ⊗ₖ Q) (hL.kronecker hP)
    (hR.kronecker hQ) (fun X => by rw [hfamily, krausMap_mul_mul_apply])
  rw [hscale]
  simp only [Matrix.det_kronecker, map_mul, map_pow, mul_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_seq_unital_krausMap_scaling
statement:
theorem exists_seq_unital_krausMap_scaling
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hcap : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A)) :
    ∃ L R : ℕ → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ k, IsUnit (L k)) ∧ (∀ k, IsUnit (R k)) ∧
      (∀ k, krausMap (fun a => L k * A a * R k) 1 = 1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => Complex.normSq (L k).det * Complex.normSq (R k).det)
        atTop (𝓝 ((operatorCapacity (krausMap A))⁻¹)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => frobSq
        (krausMap (fun a => (L k * A a * R k)ᴴ) 1 - 1)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hXdet, hXlim⟩ :=
    exists_seq_det_tendsto_operatorCapacity (krausMap A) (krausMap_posSemidef A)
  choose L R hL hR hS hfactor using fun k =>
    exists_isUnit_unital_scaling_of_operatorCapacity_pos A hcap (hX k) (hXdet k)
  let S : ℕ → ι → Matrix n n ℂ := fun k a => L k * A a * R k
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Complex.normSq (L k).det * Complex.normSq (R k).det
  have hflim : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 ((operatorCapacity (krausMap A))⁻¹)) := by
    convert hXlim.inv₀ hcap.ne' using 1
    funext k
    exact hfactor k
  have hScap (k : ℕ) : operatorCapacity (krausMap (S k)) =
      f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A) := by
    exact operatorCapacity_congruence_scaling hN (krausMap A) (krausMap (S k))
      (krausMap_posSemidef A) (L k) (R k) (hL k) (hR k)
      (fun Y => krausMap_mul_mul_apply A (L k) (R k) Y)
  have hqpos (k : ℕ) : 0 < f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A) := by
    have hdpos : 0 < (krausMap A (X k)).det.re :=
      hcap.trans_le (operatorCapacity_le_det_apply (krausMap A)
        (krausMap_posSemidef A) (hX k) (hXdet k))
    exact mul_pos (by rw [show f k = _ from hfactor k]; exact inv_pos.mpr hdpos) hcap
  have hqlim : Tendsto (fun k => f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel₀ hcap.ne'] using hflim.mul_const (operatorCapacity (krausMap A))
  have hδlim : Tendsto (fun k => -Real.log (f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hlog := (Real.continuousAt_log (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).tendsto.comp hqlim
    simpa only [Real.log_one, neg_zero, Function.comp_def] using hlog.neg
  have hδsmall : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      -Real.log (f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A)) ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    exact (hδlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 6))).mono
      (fun k hk => hk.le)
  refine ⟨L, R, hL, hR, hS, hflim, ?_⟩
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k => frobSq_nonneg _) ?_
    (show Tendsto (fun k => 6 * (-Real.log (f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A))))
      atTop (𝓝 0) by simpa only [mul_zero] using hδlim.const_mul 6)
  filter_upwards [hδsmall] with k hk
  have hS1 : krausMap (S k) 1 = 1 := hS k
  have hbound := frobSq_krausMap_unital_defect_le_of_exp_neg_le_operatorCapacity
    (S k) hS1 hk (show Real.exp (-(-Real.log (f k * operatorCapacity (krausMap A)))) ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (S k)) by
        rw [neg_neg, Real.exp_log (hqpos k), hScap])
  simpa only [hS1, sub_self, frobSq_zero, zero_add] using hbound

name: NLAlib.le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_of_pos
statement:
theorem le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_of_pos
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : 0 < Fintype.card m)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hcapA : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A))
    (hcapB : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap B)) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, R, hL, hR, hS, hflim, ha⟩ := exists_seq_unital_krausMap_scaling hN A hcapA
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hT, hglim, hb⟩ := exists_seq_unital_krausMap_scaling hM B hcapB
  let S : ℕ → ι → Matrix n n ℂ := fun k a => L k * A a * R k
  let T : ℕ → κ → Matrix m m ℂ := fun k b => P k * B b * Q k
  let e : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => frobSq
    (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => (S k p.1 ⊗ₖ T k p.2)ᴴ) 1 - 1)
  have heq : e = fun k =>
      (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (S k a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) +
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * frobSq (krausMap (fun b => (T k b)ᴴ) 1 - 1) +
      frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (S k a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) *
        frobSq (krausMap (fun b => (T k b)ᴴ) 1 - 1) := by
    funext k
    exact frobSq_adjoint_krausMap_kronecker_sub_one (S k) (T k) (hS k) (hT k)
  have helim : Tendsto e atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [mul_zero, zero_add] using
      ((ha.const_mul (Fintype.card m : ℝ)).add
        (hb.const_mul (Fintype.card n : ℝ))).add (ha.mul hb)
  have hesmall : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      e k ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card (n × m) : ℝ) + 1) := by
    exact (helim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity :
      (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((Fintype.card (n × m) : ℝ) + 1)))).mono fun k hk => hk.le
  have hrootlim : Tendsto
      (fun k => (1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (n × m) : ℝ) * e k)) ^
        Fintype.card (n × m)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have hroot := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp
      (show Tendsto (fun k => (Fintype.card (n × m) : ℝ) * e k) atTop (𝓝 0) by
        simpa only [mul_zero] using helim.const_mul (Fintype.card (n × m) : ℝ))
    have hone : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_zero, sub_zero, one_pow] using
      (hone.sub hroot).pow (Fintype.card (n × m))
  have hprodlim := ((hflim.pow (Fintype.card m)).mul (hglim.pow (Fintype.card n))).mul_const
    (operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)))
  have hlim := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hrootlim hprodlim
    (show ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      (1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card (n × m) : ℝ) * e k)) ^ Fintype.card (n × m) ≤
        (Complex.normSq (L k).det * Complex.normSq (R k).det) ^ Fintype.card m *
        (Complex.normSq (P k).det * Complex.normSq (Q k).det) ^ Fintype.card n *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)) by
      filter_upwards [hesmall] with k hk
      have hunital := krausMap_kronecker_one_eq_one (S k) (T k) (hS k) (hT k)
      have hlow := pow_one_sub_sqrt_le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_of_unital
        (fun p : ι × κ => S k p.1 ⊗ₖ T k p.2) hunital (le_refl (e k)) hk
      rw [operatorCapacity_scaled_krausMap_kronecker hN hM A B
        (L k) (R k) (P k) (Q k) (hL k) (hR k) (hP k) (hQ k)] at hlow
      exact hlow)
  have hpos : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
      operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n :=
    mul_pos (pow_pos hcapA _) (pow_pos hcapB _)
  have hdiv : 1 ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)) /
      (operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n) := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, inv_pow, mul_comm] using hlim
  simpa only [one_mul] using (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mp hdiv

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : 0 < Fintype.card m)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)) =
      operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_le A B) ?_
  have hA0 := operatorCapacity_krausMap_nonneg A
  have hB0 := operatorCapacity_krausMap_nonneg B
  by_cases hAz : operatorCapacity (krausMap A) = 0
  · simpa only [hAz, zero_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hM), zero_mul] using
      operatorCapacity_krausMap_nonneg (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)
  by_cases hBz : operatorCapacity (krausMap B) = 0
  · simpa only [hBz, zero_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hN), mul_zero] using
      operatorCapacity_krausMap_nonneg (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)
  exact le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_of_pos hN hM A B
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hA0 (Ne.symm hAz)) (lt_of_le_of_ne hB0 (Ne.symm hBz))

name: NLAlib.orderedContinuation_real_smul
statement:
private theorem orderedContinuation_real_smul (t : ℝ) (H : M) :
    (t : ℂ)•H=t•H
proof: := IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ t H

name: NLAlib.orderedContinuation_inverse_branch
statement:
private theorem orderedContinuation_inverse_branch
    (G : ℂ → M) (S B : M) (hG0 : G 0=S) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hGd : HasDerivAt G (-B) 0) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hGH : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, (G t).IsHermitian) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (G t)⁻¹) (S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹) 0 ∧
      (S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹).PosDef ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ((G t)⁻¹).IsHermitian)
proof:
:= by
  have hGR : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => G t) (-B) 0 := by
    have hcoe : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) 0 := by
      convert! (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := (0 : ℝ))) using 1
    have hGC : HasFDerivAt G
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ (-B)).restrictScalars ℝ) ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero] using hGd.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ
    convert! hGC.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hcoe using 1
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
      one_smul]
  have hInv : HasFDerivAt (fun X : M => X⁻¹)
      (-ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ M S⁻¹ S⁻¹) (G (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero,hG0] using hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse S hS.isUnit
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · convert! hInv.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hGR using 1
    simp only [_root_.neg_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply,
      Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.neg_mul,neg_neg]
  · simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,hS.inv.isHermitian.eq] using
      (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hS.inv.isUnit (x := B)).mpr hB
  · exact hGH.mono fun t ht => ht.inv

name: NLAlib.orderedContinuation_solvable_isClosed
statement:
private theorem orderedContinuation_solvable_isClosed
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y H : M) (hY : Y.PosDef)
    (hgapY : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (Y+T.val).PosDef) :
    IsClosed (orderedKSolvableSet ν α Y H)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : J => matrixKTransform ν α Y⁻¹-(t.val : ℂ)•H) := by fun_prop
  exact (isClosed_image_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse ν hν α hα Y hY hgapY).preimage hc

name: NLAlib.orderedContinuation_solvable_nonempty
statement:
private theorem orderedContinuation_solvable_nonempty
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y : selfAdjoint M) (hY : Y∈matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α)
    (H : M) (hH : H.PosDef) : (orderedKSolvableSet ν α Y.val H).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hst : Y.val⁻¹∈matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    rw [← image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
    exact ⟨Y,hY,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G,B,hGa,hG0,hB,hGd,hGH,hGeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_decreasing_affine_branch ν hν α hα Y.val⁻¹
      hst.1 hst.2.1 hst.2.2 H hH
  have hYY : Y.val⁻¹⁻¹=Y.val := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY.1.isUnit)
  obtain ⟨hInv,hPos,hInvH⟩ := orderedContinuation_inverse_branch G Y.val⁻¹ B hG0 hst.1 hGd hB hGH
  have hinc := Matrix.eventually_posDef_sub_of_posDef_deriv (fun t : ℝ => (G t)⁻¹)
    (Y.val⁻¹⁻¹*B*Y.val⁻¹⁻¹) hInv hPos hInvH
  have hx : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    have hx0 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero] using Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 : ℝ)
    exact hx0.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have he : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, 0<t ∧ Y.val≤(G t)⁻¹ ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α ((G t)⁻¹)⁻¹=matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-(t : ℂ)•H := by
    filter_upwards [hinc,hx.eventually hGeq,self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht hte htp
    refine ⟨htp,?_,?_⟩
    · have hpd : ((G t)⁻¹-Y.val).PosDef := by
        simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero,hG0,hYY] using ht
      exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr hpd.posSemidef
    · rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
        ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hte.1.1)]
      exact hte.2
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hord,heq⟩ := he.exists
  exact ⟨⟨t,ht⟩,(G t)⁻¹,hord,heq⟩

name: NLAlib.orderedContinuation_solvable_isOpen
statement:
private theorem orderedContinuation_solvable_isOpen
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y : selfAdjoint M) (hY : Y∈matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α)
    (H : M) (hH : H.PosDef) : IsOpen (orderedKSolvableSet ν α Y.val H)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  rintro t ⟨Z,hYZ,hKZ⟩
  have hZ : Z.PosDef := (hY.1.isStrictlyPositive.of_le hYZ).posDef
  let Zsa : selfAdjoint M := ⟨Z,hZ.isHermitian⟩
  have hdec : (matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹).PosDef := by
    rw [hKZ,sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [orderedContinuation_real_smul]
    exact hH.smul t.property
  obtain ⟨hstrict,hZstable⟩ :=
    posDef_sub_and_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain_of_ordered_transform_decrease ν hν α hα
      Y Zsa hY.1 hY.2.1 hYZ hdec
  have hst : Z⁻¹∈matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    rw [← image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα]
    exact ⟨Zsa,hZstable,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G,B,hGa,hG0,hB,hGd,hGH,hGeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_decreasing_affine_branch ν hν α hα Z⁻¹
      hst.1 hst.2.1 hst.2.2 H hH
  have hZZ : Z⁻¹⁻¹=Z := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hZ.isUnit)
  obtain ⟨hInv,_hB,hInvH⟩ := orderedContinuation_inverse_branch G Z⁻¹ B hG0 hst.1 hGd hB hGH
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (G r)⁻¹-Y.val) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (Z-Y.val)) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero,hG0,hZZ] using hInv.continuousAt.tendsto.sub_const Y.val
  have hlimH : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ((G r)⁻¹-Y.val).IsHermitian :=
    hInvH.mono fun _ hr => hr.sub Y.property
  have hp := hstrict.eventually_of_tendsto hlim hlimH
  have hx : Tendsto (fun u : J => ((u.val-t.val : ℝ) : ℂ)) (𝓝 t) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    have hcont : Continuous (fun u : J => ((u.val-t.val : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [sub_self,Complex.ofReal_zero] using hcont.tendsto t
  have hr : Tendsto (fun u : J => u.val-t.val) (𝓝 t) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hcont : Continuous (fun u : J => u.val-t.val) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [sub_self] using hcont.tendsto t
  filter_upwards [hr.eventually hp,hx.eventually hGeq] with u hu hsolve
  refine ⟨(G ((u.val-t.val : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹,Matrix.le_iff.mpr hu.posSemidef,?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hsolve.1.1),hsolve.2,hKZ,Complex.ofReal_sub,sub_smul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.exists_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_matrixKTransform_inverse_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Y : selfAdjoint M) (hY : Y∈matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α)
    (H : M) (hH : H.PosDef) :
    ∃ Z : selfAdjoint M, (Z.val-Y.val).PosDef ∧ Z∈matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α Z.val⁻¹=matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-H
proof:
:= by
  let : PreconnectedSpace J := Subtype.preconnectedSpace (isPreconnected_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ)))
  have he : orderedKSolvableSet ν α Y.val H=univ :=
    (show IsClopen (orderedKSolvableSet ν α Y.val H) from
      ⟨orderedContinuation_solvable_isClosed ν hν α hα Y.val H hY.1 hY.2.1,
        orderedContinuation_solvable_isOpen ν hν α hα Y hY H hH⟩).eq_univ
          (orderedContinuation_solvable_nonempty ν hν α hα Y hY H hH)
  have hm : (⟨1,zero_lt_one⟩ : J)∈orderedKSolvableSet ν α Y.val H := by rw [he]; trivial
  obtain ⟨Z,hYZ,hKZ⟩ := hm
  have hZ : Z.PosDef := (hY.1.isStrictlyPositive.of_le hYZ).posDef
  let Zsa : selfAdjoint M := ⟨Z,hZ.isHermitian⟩
  have hKZ' : matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹=matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-H := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_smul] using hKZ
  have hdiff : (matrixKTransform ν α Y.val⁻¹-matrixKTransform ν α Z⁻¹).PosDef := by
    rw [hKZ',sub_sub_cancel]
    exact hH
  obtain ⟨hstrict,hstable⟩ :=
    posDef_sub_and_mem_matrixKInverseStableDomain_of_ordered_transform_decrease ν hν α hα
      Y Zsa hY.1 hY.2.1 hYZ hdiff
  exact ⟨Zsa,hstrict,hstable,hKZ'⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_posDef_sample_gap_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform
statement:
theorem exists_posDef_sample_gap_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass=1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → M,
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=α•F z) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian) ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ, (∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t) →
        AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧ (G u).PosDef ∧ (deriv G (u : ℂ)).PosDef ∧
          ∀ T ∈ ν.support, ((α⁻¹•G u)⁻¹+T.val).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hGN,hreal,hGu⟩ :=
    exists_global_posDef_real_stieltjes_extension_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ
  have hne : (μ : Measure ℝ)≠0 := by
    intro hz
    have hm : μ.mass=0 := by
      apply ENNReal.coe_injective
      rw [FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,hz]
      simp
    rw [hmass] at hm
    exact one_ne_zero hm
  let a : ℝ := sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support
  have ha : a∈(μ : Measure ℝ).support := hcompact.sInf_mem (Measure.nonempty_support hne)
  have hbelow (u : ℝ) : u<a ↔ ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, u<t := by
    constructor
    · intro hu t ht
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hu (csInf_le hcompact.bddBelow ht)
    · intro hu
      exact hu a ha
  let X := Iio a
  let : PreconnectedSpace X := Subtype.preconnectedSpace (convex_Iio a).isPreconnected
  let S : X → M := fun x => α⁻¹•G (x.val : ℂ)
  have hSp (x : X) : (S x).PosDef :=
    ((hGu x.val ((hbelow x.val).mp x.property)).2.1).smul (inv_pos.mpr hα)
  have hSc : Continuous S := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro x
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x : X => G (x.val : ℂ)) x :=
      ((hGu x.val ((hbelow x.val).mp x.property)).1).continuousAt.comp
        (f := fun x : X => (x.val : ℂ))
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt)
    exact hc.const_smul α⁻¹
  have hYc : Continuous (fun x : X => (S x)⁻¹) := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro x
    exact (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse (S x) (hSp x).isUnit).continuousAt.comp hSc.continuousAt
  obtain ⟨u0,S0,hmargin,hS0,_hK0,hG0⟩ :=
    exists_matrixKTransform_stable_scalar_stieltjes_seed ν hν α hα F hF μ hμ G
      (fun u hu => (hGu u hu).1) hGN
  have hu0 : u0<a := by linarith [hmargin a ha]
  let x0 : X := ⟨u0,hu0⟩
  have hS0eq : S x0=S0 := by
    simp only [S,x0,hG0,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul]
  have hgap (T : selfAdjoint M) (hT : T∈ν.support) :
      ∀ x : X, ((S x)⁻¹+T.val).PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.posDef_everywhere_of_preconnected_isUnit
      (fun x : X => (S x)⁻¹+T.val) (hYc.add continuous_const)
    · intro x
      exact (hSp x).inv.isHermitian.add T.property
    · intro x
      exact isUnit_inverse_add_below_matrixKTransform_trace_support ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ
        G x.val ((hbelow x.val).mp x.property) (hGu x.val ((hbelow x.val).mp x.property)).1
          hGN (hGu x.val ((hbelow x.val).mp x.property)).2.1 T hT
    · exact ⟨x0,by rw [hS0eq]; exact hS0.2.1 T hT⟩
  refine ⟨G,hGN,hreal,?_⟩
  intro u hu
  exact ⟨(hGu u hu).1,(hGu u hu).2.1,(hGu u hu).2.2,
    fun T hT => hgap T hT ⟨u,(hbelow u).mpr hu⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.cfc_diagonal
statement:
theorem cfc_diagonal (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    cfc f (Matrix.diagonal x) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (x i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := (Set.finite_range x).toFinset
  let p : ℝ[X] := Lagrange.interpolate s id f
  have hp : ∀ y ∈ Set.range x, p.eval y = f y := by
    intro y hy
    exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (s := s) (v := id) (i := y) f
      Function.injective_id.injOn (by simpa [s] using hy)
  have heq : cfc f (Matrix.diagonal x) = cfc p.eval (Matrix.diagonal x) := by
    apply cfc_congr
    intro y hy
    rw [spectrum_diagonal] at hy
    exact (hp y hy).symm
  rw [heq, cfc_polynomial p _ (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal x).isSelfAdjoint,
    aeval_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact hp (x i) ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.diagonal_pow
statement:
theorem diagonal_pow (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal x) ^ k = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => x i ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using aeval_diagonal x (X ^ k)

name: NLAlib.exists_hermite_polynomial_hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc
statement:
theorem exists_hermite_polynomial_hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], (∀ i, p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = f (hA.eigenvalues i)) ∧
      (∀ i, p.derivative.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = deriv f (hA.eigenvalues i)) ∧
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => cfc f B)
        (p.frechetDerivative A) {B | B.IsHermitian} A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := Finset.univ.image hA.eigenvalues
  let p := Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate s id f (deriv f)
  have hv (i : n) : p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = f (hA.eigenvalues i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node (fun _ _ _ _ h => h) f (deriv f)
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  have hd (i : n) : p.derivative.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = deriv f (hA.eigenvalues i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteInterpolate_at_node (fun _ _ _ _ h => h) f (deriv f)
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨p, hv, hd, ?_⟩
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => f x - p.eval x
  have hg (i : n) : g (hA.eigenvalues i) = 0 := by dsimp [g]; rw [hv, sub_self]
  have hg' (i : n) : HasDerivAt g 0 (hA.eigenvalues i) := by
    have h := (hf i).hasDerivAt.sub (p.hasDerivAt (hA.eigenvalues i))
    convert! h using 1
    exact (sub_self _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z => deriv f (hA.eigenvalues i) - z) (hd i).symm)
  have h := (hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_zero_of_spectral_vanishing hA hg hg').add
    (p.hasFDerivAt_aeval_noncomm A).hasFDerivWithinAt
  simp only [zero_add] at h
  have heq (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
      cfc f B = cfc g B + aeval B p := by
    have hsub : cfc g B = cfc f B - cfc p.eval B :=
      cfc_sub f p.eval B (B.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn f)
        (B.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn p.eval)
    have hp : cfc p.eval B = aeval B p := cfc_polynomial p B hB
    calc
      _ = (cfc f B - cfc p.eval B) + cfc p.eval B := by abel
      _ = _ := by rw [← hsub, hp]
  exact h.congr (fun B hB => heq B hB) (heq A hA)

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.cfc_le_real
proof:
:= by
  apply (realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) _ _).mp
  rw [realMatrixComplexification_cfc f hA.isHermitian,
    realMatrixComplexification_cfc f hB.isHermitian]
  have hAc := (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) A).mpr hA
  have hBc := (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) B).mpr hB
  exact hm.cfc_le hAc.isHermitian hBc.isHermitian
    (fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hAc.nonneg hx)
    (fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hBc.nonneg hx)
    ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff A B).mpr hAB)

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.monotoneOn_nonneg
statement:
theorem OperatorMonotoneOn.monotoneOn_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hm : OperatorMonotoneOn (Ici 0) f) : MonotoneOn f (Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  have hX : (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => x)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun _ => hx)
  have hY : (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => y)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun _ => hy)
  have hXY : Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) ≤ Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => y) := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_sub]
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun _ => sub_nonneg.mpr hxy)
  have h := hm.cfc_le_real hX hY hXY
  rw [cfc_diagonal, cfc_diagonal] at h
  have hd := (Matrix.le_iff.mp h).diag_nonneg (i := (0 : Fin 1))
  exact sub_nonneg.mp (by simpa only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] using hd)

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.antitone_comp_eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by

  exact hm.monotoneOn_nonneg (eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA j)
    (eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA i) (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone hij)

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow_le_of_ordered_eigenbases
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow_le_of_ordered_eigenbases
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hAB : B ≤ A)
    (U V : Matrix n n ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hAU : spectralBasisMatrix U hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ = A)
    (hBV : spectralBasisMatrix V hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ = B)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < Fintype.card n) {p ε : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hm : OperatorMonotoneOn (Ici 0) f)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ici 0)) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x)
    (hdeficit : schattenNormReal A p ^ p -
        schattenNormReal (spectralFunctionTruncation V hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ id k) p ^ p ≤
      (1 + ε) * schattenNormReal
        (A - spectralFunctionTruncation U hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ id k) p ^ p) :
    schattenNormReal (cfc f A - spectralFunctionTruncation V hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ f k) p ^ p ≤
      (1 + ε) * schattenNormReal
        (cfc f A - spectralFunctionTruncation U hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ f k) p ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let a := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
  let b := hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  have ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA
  have hb0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i := eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hB
  have hba : ∀ i, b i ≤ a i :=
    Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hB.isHermitian hA.isHermitian hAB
  have hApower : schattenNormReal A p ^ p = ∑ i, a i ^ p := by
    calc
      _ = schattenNormReal (spectralBasisMatrix U a) p ^ p :=
        congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => schattenNormReal M p ^ p) hAU.symm
      _ = _ := schattenNormReal_spectralBasisMatrix_rpow U hU a ha0 hp0
  have hBhead : schattenNormReal (spectralFunctionTruncation V b id k) p ^ p =
      ∑ i, if i.val < k then b i ^ p else 0 := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      schattenNormReal_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow V hV b id k hb0 hp0
  have hAid : cfc id (spectralBasisMatrix U a) = A :=
    (cfc_id' ℝ _ (posSemidef_spectralBasisMatrix U a ha0).isHermitian).trans hAU
  have hAtail : schattenNormReal (A - spectralFunctionTruncation U a id k) p ^ p =
      ∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then a i ^ p else 0 := by
    have ht := schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow U hU a id k ha0 hp0
    simpa only [hAid, id_eq] using ht
  have hscalar : (∑ i, f (a i) ^ p) - (∑ i, if i.val < k then f (b i) ^ p else 0) ≤
      (1 + ε) * (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) ^ p else 0) := by
    apply (hm.concaveOn_nonneg hf).sum_rpow_sub_prefix_le a b
      hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone ha0 hb0 hba hk hp0 hε hfn
    rwa [hApower, hBhead, hAtail] at hdeficit
  have hAf : cfc f A = spectralBasisMatrix U (f ∘ a) := by
    calc
      _ = cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix U a) := congrArg (cfc f) hAU.symm
      _ = _ := cfc_spectralBasisMatrix U hU a f
  have hAfPower : schattenNormReal (cfc f A) p ^ p = ∑ i, f (a i) ^ p := by
    rw [hAf]
    exact schattenNormReal_spectralBasisMatrix_rpow U hU (f ∘ a)
      (fun i => hfn _ (ha0 i)) hp0
  have hBfHead : schattenNormReal (spectralFunctionTruncation V b f k) p ^ p =
      ∑ i, if i.val < k then f (b i) ^ p else 0 :=
    schattenNormReal_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow V hV b f k (fun i => hfn _ (hb0 i)) hp0
  have hAfTail : schattenNormReal (cfc f A - spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k) p ^ p =
      ∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) ^ p else 0 := by
    have ht := schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow U hU a f k
      (fun i => hfn _ (ha0 i)) hp0
    have he : cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix U a) = cfc f A := congrArg (cfc f) hAU
    rwa [he] at ht
  have hBfPSD : (spectralFunctionTruncation V b f k).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_spectralFunctionTruncation V b f k (fun i => hfn _ (hb0 i))
  have hBfLe : spectralFunctionTruncation V b f k ≤ cfc f A := by
    calc
      _ ≤ cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix V b) :=
        spectralFunctionTruncation_le_cfc V hV b f k (fun i => hfn _ (hb0 i))
      _ = cfc f B := congrArg (cfc f) hBV
      _ ≤ cfc f A := hm.cfc_le_real hB hA hAB
  have herr := schattenNormReal_sub_rpow_le hBfPSD hBfLe hp
  rw [hAfPower, hBfHead] at herr
  change schattenNormReal (cfc f A - spectralFunctionTruncation V b f k) p ^ p ≤
    (1 + ε) * schattenNormReal (cfc f A - spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k) p ^ p
  rw [hAfTail]
  exact herr.trans hscalar

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow_le
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hAB : B ≤ A)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < Fintype.card n) {p ε : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hm : OperatorMonotoneOn (Ici 0) f)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ici 0)) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x)
    (hdeficit : schattenNormReal A p ^ p -
        schattenNormReal (hB.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation id k) p ^ p ≤
      (1 + ε) * schattenNormReal (A - hA.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation id k) p ^ p) :
    schattenNormReal (cfc f A - hB.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation f k) p ^ p ≤
      (1 + ε) * schattenNormReal (cfc f A - hA.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation f k) p ^ p
proof:
:= by
  exact schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow_le_of_ordered_eigenbases
    hA hB hAB (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian)
    (transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB.isHermitian)
    (spectralBasisMatrix_eigenvectorUnitary hA.isHermitian)
    (spectralBasisMatrix_eigenvectorUnitary hB.isHermitian)
    hk hp hε hm hf hfn hdeficit

name: NLAlib.eq_of_schatten_trace_deficit_of_tail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_of_schatten_trace_deficit_of_tail_eq_zero
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hAB : B ≤ A)
    (k : ℕ) {p ε : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (htail : schattenNormReal (A - hA.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation id k) p ^ p = 0)
    (hdeficit : schattenNormReal A p ^ p -
        schattenNormReal (hB.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation id k) p ^ p ≤
      (1 + ε) * schattenNormReal (A - hA.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation id k) p ^ p) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  let V : Matrix n n ℝ := hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let b := hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
  let BK := hB.isHermitian.spectralFunctionTruncation id k
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols V := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB.isHermitian
  have hb0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i := eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hB
  have hBK : BK.PosSemidef := posSemidef_spectralFunctionTruncation V b id k hb0
  have hId : cfc id (spectralBasisMatrix V b) = B :=
    (cfc_id' ℝ _ (posSemidef_spectralBasisMatrix V b hb0).isHermitian).trans
      (spectralBasisMatrix_eigenvectorUnitary hB.isHermitian)
  have hBKB : BK ≤ B := by
    have h := spectralFunctionTruncation_le_cfc V hV b id k hb0
    rwa [hId] at h
  have herr := schattenNormReal_sub_rpow_le hBK (hBKB.trans hAB) hp
  rw [htail, mul_zero] at hdeficit
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  have hzero : schattenNormReal (A - BK) p ^ p = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (herr.trans hdeficit)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg (A - BK) p) p)
  have hn : schattenNormReal (A - BK) p = 0 :=
    (Real.rpow_eq_zero (schattenNormReal_nonneg (A - BK) p) hp0.ne').mp hzero
  have he : A = BK := sub_eq_zero.mp ((schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff (A - BK) hp0).mp hn)
  exact le_antisymm (he.symm ▸ hBKB) hAB

name: NLAlib.inverseStability_defect_eq_smul_derivative
statement:
private theorem inverseStability_defect_eq_smul_derivative
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : α≠0)
    (S B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹-matrixKInverseStability ν α S⁻¹ (S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹) =
      α • matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransformDeriv_apply ν hν α S hS hgap B]
  simp only [smul_sub,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hα,one_smul,matrixKInverseStability]
  apply congrArg (fun X : Matrix n n ℂ => S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹-α•X)
  apply integral_congr_ae
  apply ae_of_all
  intro T
  dsimp only
  have hleft : 1+S*T.val=S*(S⁻¹+T.val) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit)]
  have hright : 1+T.val*S=(S⁻¹+T.val)*S := by
    rw [Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit)]
  rw [hleft,hright,Matrix.mul_inv_rev,Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.posDef_sandwich
statement:
private theorem posDef_sandwich (S B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (S*B*S).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,hS.isHermitian.eq] using
    (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hS.isUnit (x := B)).mpr hB

name: NLAlib.derivative_witness_iff_inverse_witness
statement:
private theorem derivative_witness_iff_inverse_witness
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    (∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef) ↔
      ∃ C : Matrix n n ℂ, C.PosDef ∧ (C-matrixKInverseStability ν α S⁻¹ C).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨B,hB,hD⟩
    refine ⟨S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹,posDef_sandwich S⁻¹ B hS.inv hB,?_⟩
    rw [inverseStability_defect_eq_smul_derivative ν hν α hα.ne' S B hS hgap]
    exact (posDef_real_smul_iff α hα _).mpr hD
  · rintro ⟨C,hC,hdef⟩
    let B := S*C*S
    have hcan : S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹=C := by
      dsimp [B]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit),
        Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit),Matrix.mul_one]
    refine ⟨B,posDef_sandwich S C hS hC,?_⟩
    apply (posDef_real_smul_iff α hα _).mp
    rw [← inverseStability_defect_eq_smul_derivative ν hν α hα.ne' S B hS hgap,hcan]
    exact hdef

name: NLAlib.quadratic_pos_iff_inverse_witness
statement:
private theorem quadratic_pos_iff_inverse_witness [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    (∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ)) ↔
      ∃ C : Matrix n n ℂ, C.PosDef ∧ (C-matrixKInverseStability ν α S⁻¹ C).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
    matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
    matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S hS hgap]
  exact derivative_witness_iff_inverse_witness ν hν α hα S hS hgap

name: NLAlib.image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain
statement:
theorem image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    (fun Y : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => Y.val⁻¹) '' matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α =
      matrixKStableDomain ν α
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Y,⟨hY,hgap,hw⟩,rfl⟩
    have hYY : Y.val⁻¹⁻¹=Y.val :=
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hY.isUnit)
    refine ⟨hY.inv,?_,?_⟩
    · simpa only [hYY] using hgap
    · apply (quadratic_pos_iff_inverse_witness ν hν α hα Y.val⁻¹ hY.inv
        (by simpa only [hYY] using hgap)).mpr
      simpa only [hYY] using hw
  · rintro ⟨hS,hgap,hquad⟩
    let Y : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) := ⟨S⁻¹,hS.inv.isHermitian⟩
    refine ⟨Y,⟨hS.inv,hgap,?_⟩,?_⟩
    · exact (quadratic_pos_iff_inverse_witness ν hν α hα S hS hgap).mp hquad
    · exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS.isUnit)

name: NLAlib.isConnected_matrixKStableDomain
statement:
theorem isConnected_matrixKStableDomain [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    IsConnected (matrixKStableDomain ν α)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun Y : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => Y.val⁻¹)
      (matrixKInverseStableDomain ν α) := by
    intro Y hY
    exact ((hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse Y.val hY.1.isUnit).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun Y : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => Y.val)
      continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hh := (isConnected_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν hα.le).image _ hc
  rwa [image_inverse_matrixKInverseStableDomain ν hν α hα] at hh

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_cfc_of_antitone
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_cfc_of_antitone (f : ℝ → ℝ) {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hf : Antitone (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)))
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    (show (cfc f A).IsHermitian from cfc_predicate f A).eigenvalues₀ i = f (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (cfc f A).IsHermitian := cfc_predicate f A
  have hMult : Finset.univ.val.map hA.eigenvalues = Finset.univ.val.map hA.eigenvalues₀ := by
    have h := congrArg (Multiset.map (RCLike.re : 𝕜 → ℝ))
      (hA.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues.symm.trans hA.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀)
    simpa [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def] using h
  have hRoots : (cfc f A).charpoly.roots =
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun j => (f (hA.eigenvalues₀ j) : 𝕜)) := by
    rw [hA.charpoly_cfc_eq f, Polynomial.roots_prod]
    · simpa [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
        congrArg (Multiset.map (fun x : ℝ => (f x : 𝕜))) hMult
    · simp [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero]
  have hList : List.ofFn hC.eigenvalues₀ = List.ofFn (fun j => f (hA.eigenvalues₀ j)) := by
    rw [← hC.sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues₀, hRoots]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, RCLike.ofReal_re, Fin.univ_val_map,
      Multiset.map_coe, List.map_ofFn, Multiset.coe_sort]
    apply List.mergeSort_of_pairwise
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, ← List.sortedGE_iff_pairwise] using hf.sortedGE_ofFn
  exact congrFun (List.ofFn_inj.mp hList) i

name: NLAlib.singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    singularValues A (i : ℕ) = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i
proof:
:= by
  have hNonneg (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : 0 ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ j := by
    let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
    have h := hA.eigenvalues_nonneg (e j)
    simpa only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h
  have hAnti : Antitone (fun j => hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ j ^ 2) := by
    intro j k hjk
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hNonneg k) (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone hjk) 2
  have hCfc : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 : ℕ)) A = Aᴴ * A := by
    calc
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 : ℕ)) A = A ^ 2 := cfc_pow_id (R := ℝ) A 2 hA.isHermitian
      _ = Aᴴ * A := by rw [pow_two, hA.isHermitian.eq]
  have hE := eigenvalues₀_cfc_of_antitone (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 : ℕ)) hA.isHermitian hAnti i
  have hSq := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ A i
  have h : (singularValues A (i : ℕ)) ^ 2 =
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i) ^ 2 := hSq.trans
        ((congrFun (eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq _ _ hCfc.symm) i).trans hE)
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (singularValues_nonneg A _) (hNonneg i)).mp h

name: Matrix.PosDef.add_smul_one_posDef
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.add_smul_one_posDef {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (A + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  exact hA.add (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (a := δ) hδ)

name: NLAlib.mul_diagonal_mul_mul_diagonal_mul_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (U * D * Uᵀ) * (U * D' * Uᵀ)
        = U * (D * (Uᵀ * U) * D') * Uᵀ := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = U * (D * D') * Uᵀ := by
          rw [hU2]
          simp
    _ = U * Uᵀ := by
          rw [hDD]
          simp
    _ = 1 := hU1

name: NLAlib.inv_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  exact mul_diagonal_mul_mul_diagonal_mul_eq_one hU1 hU2 hDD

name: NLAlib.mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_pow_two
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  calc
    (U * D * Uᵀ) * (U * D * Uᵀ)
        = U * (D * (Uᵀ * U) * D) * Uᵀ := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = U * (D * D) * Uᵀ := by
          rw [hU2]
          simp
    _ = U * D ^ 2 * Uᵀ := by
          rw [pow_two]

name: NLAlib.add_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
private lemma add_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    A + c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) =
      (↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i + c) *
        (↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i + c) =
      Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues + c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij]
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA]
  rw [hd]
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul,
    eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA]

name: NLAlib.sub_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose
statement:
private lemma sub_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    A - c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) =
      (↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - c) *
        (↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - c) =
      Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues - c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij]
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA]
  rw [hd]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul,
    eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA]

name: NLAlib.diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one_of_pos
statement:
private lemma diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one_of_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i + δ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i + δ)⁻¹) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (add_pos (hA.eigenvalues_pos i) hδ))]
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.diagonal_sub_smul_one_diagonal_inv_eq_one
statement:
private lemma diagonal_sub_smul_one_diagonal_inv_eq_one {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {δ : ℝ} (hδlt : ∀ i, δ < hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) :
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i - δ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i - δ)⁻¹) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (hδlt i)))]
  · simp [hij]

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A⁻¹.trace = ∑ i, 1 / hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by
  have hU1 : (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA.isHermitian
  have hU2 : (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ *
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 :=
    transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian
  have hD : Matrix.diagonal hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (hA.eigenvalues_pos i))]
    · simp [hij]
  have hinv : A⁻¹ =
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) *
        (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA.isHermitian]
    exact inv_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hU1 hU2 hD
  rw [hinv, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
  simp [hU2, Matrix.trace_diagonal, one_div]

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_add_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_add_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_add
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ((A + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace =
      ∑ i, 1 / (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i + δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hU1 : (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA.isHermitian
  have hU2 : (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ *
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 :=
    transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian
  have hD := diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one_of_pos hA hδ
  have hinv : (A + δ • 1)⁻¹ =
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i + δ)⁻¹) *
        (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ := by
    rw [add_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA.isHermitian δ]
    exact inv_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hU1 hU2 hD
  rw [hinv, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
  simp [hU2, Matrix.trace_diagonal, one_div]

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_add_smul_one_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_add_smul_one_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq_add
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (((A + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) ^ 2).trace =
      ∑ i, (1 / (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i + δ)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hU1 : (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) *
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hA.isHermitian
  have hU2 : (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ *
      (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) = 1 :=
    transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA.isHermitian
  have hD := diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one_of_pos hA hδ
  have hinv : (A + δ • 1)⁻¹ =

    rw [add_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA.isHermitian δ]
    exact inv_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hU1 hU2 hD
  rw [hinv, mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_pow_two hU2, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_sub
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_sub
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδlt : ∀ i, δ < hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) :

  have hD := diagonal_sub_smul_one_diagonal_inv_eq_one hA hδlt

  rw [hinv, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq_sub
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq_sub
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) {δ : ℝ} (hδlt : ∀ i, δ < hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) :

name: Matrix.PosDef.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_eigenvalues_gt
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsUnit (↑hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) :=
    Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary)
  rw [sub_smul_one_eq_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA.isHermitian δ]
  have hpos : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i - δ)).PosDef := by
    exact Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => sub_pos.mpr (hδlt i))
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    (Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff hU
      (x := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i - δ))).mpr hpos

name: Matrix.PosDef.lt_eigenvalues_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.lt_eigenvalues_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one
    {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : δ * M⁻¹.trace < 1) :
    ∀ i, δ < hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hsingle : 1 / hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≤
      ∑ j, 1 / hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues j := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j _ => (one_div_pos.mpr (hM.eigenvalues_pos j)).le)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hδinv : δ * (1 / hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) < 1 := by
    have hcap' := hcap
    rw [hM.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues] at hcap'
    nlinarith [hcap', hsingle, hδ]
  have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδinv (hM.eigenvalues_pos i)
  simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (hM.eigenvalues_pos i))] using h

name: Matrix.PosDef.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one
    {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : δ * M⁻¹.trace < 1) :
    (M - δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef
proof:
:=
  hM.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_eigenvalues_gt
    (hM.lt_eigenvalues_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδ hcap)

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_inv_sub_trace_add_smul_one_inv_pos
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_inv_sub_trace_add_smul_one_inv_pos
    [Nonempty n] {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    0 < M⁻¹.trace - ((M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [hM.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues,
    hM.trace_add_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_add hδ]
  simpa [Real.reciprocalBarrierGap] using
    (Real.reciprocalBarrierGap_pos hδ (hM.eigenvalues_pos))

name: Matrix.PosDef.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sub_trace_inv_pos
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sub_trace_inv_pos
    [Nonempty n] {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : δ * M⁻¹.trace < 1) :
    0 < ((M - δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace - M⁻¹.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hδlt := hM.lt_eigenvalues_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδ hcap
  rw [hM.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues,
    hM.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_sub hδlt]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => ?_) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hlt : hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i - δ < hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i :=
    sub_lt_self (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) hδ
  have hdiv : 1 / hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i <
      1 / (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i - δ) :=
    one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr (hδlt i)) hlt
  linarith

name: Matrix.PosDef.reciprocal_barrier_upper_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.reciprocal_barrier_upper_le
    [Nonempty n] {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (((M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) ^ 2).trace /
        (M⁻¹.trace - ((M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace) +
      ((M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace ≤
    1 / δ + M⁻¹.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [hM.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues,
    hM.trace_add_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_add hδ,
    hM.trace_add_smul_one_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq_add hδ]
  exact Real.reciprocal_barrier_upper_le (I := n) hδ (hM.eigenvalues_pos)

name: Matrix.PosDef.reciprocal_barrier_lower_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.reciprocal_barrier_lower_le
    [Nonempty n] {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : δ * M⁻¹.trace < 1) :
    1 / δ - M⁻¹.trace ≤
      (((M - δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) ^ 2).trace /
        (((M - δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace - M⁻¹.trace) -
      ((M - δ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hδlt := hM.lt_eigenvalues_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδ hcap
  have hcap_sum : δ * (∑ i, 1 / hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) ≤ 1 := by
    have hcap' := hcap
    rw [hM.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues] at hcap'
    exact le_of_lt hcap'
  rw [hM.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv_eigenvalues,
    hM.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_eq_sum_inv_sub hδlt,
    hM.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq_sub hδlt]
  exact Real.reciprocal_barrier_lower_le (I := n) hδ hδlt hcap_sum

name: NLAlib.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_coordinateRankOneMatrix
statement:
theorem specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_coordinateRankOneMatrix
    (i₀ : m) (j₀ : n) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar (coordinateRankOneMatrix i₀ j₀ x) -
      oddMatrixIterate q a (coordinateRankOneMatrix i₀ j₀ x) T) =
        |1 - oddScalarComposition q a x T|
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isThinSVD_coordinateRankOneMatrix i₀ j₀ hx).specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_eq]
  simp

name: NLAlib.oddMatrixIterate_uniform_error_iff
statement:
theorem oddMatrixIterate_uniform_error_iff [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) {l u ε : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) :
    (∀ A : Matrix m n ℂ,
      (∀ k, 0 < singularValues A k → singularValues A k ∈ Set.Icc l u) →
        specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate q a A T) ≤ ε) ↔
      0 ≤ ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc l u, |1 - oddScalarComposition q a x T| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hzero := h 0 (by
      intro k hk
      rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le _ (by simp)] at hk
      exact (lt_irrefl _ hk).elim)
    refine ⟨(specNorm_nonneg _).trans hzero, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    let i₀ : m := Classical.choice inferInstance
    let j₀ : n := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hl.trans_le hx.1
    have hm := h (coordinateRankOneMatrix i₀ j₀ x) (fun k hk => by
      rwa [singularValues_coordinateRankOneMatrix_of_pos i₀ j₀ hx0 hk])
    rwa [specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_coordinateRankOneMatrix i₀ j₀ hx0] at hm
  · rintro ⟨hε, hb⟩ A hA
    obtain ⟨U, V, ht⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
    exact ht.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_le q a T
      (fun i => hA i (ht.pos i)) hε hb

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_gram_mul
