name: NLAlib.bilinear_move_left
statement:
private theorem bilinear_move_left (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℂ) (x : n → ℂ) :
    star v ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x) = star (Bᴴ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.star_mulVec, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.sum_posPart_sq_le_of_resolvent_expansion
statement:
private theorem sum_posPart_sq_le_of_resolvent_expansion [Fintype ι]
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (T D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {c R : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hS : specNorm S ≤ c)
    (hT : ∀ i, specNorm (T i) ≤ c) (hD : ∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ 2 * R)
    (hexp : ∀ i, S - T i = S * D i * S - S * D i * T i * D i * S) :
    ∑ i, max (specNorm S - specNorm (T i)) 0 ^ 2 ≤
      2 * c ^ 4 * bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ +
        8 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 6 * specNorm (∑ i, (D i)ᴴ * D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hprobe⟩ := exists_unitBall_bilinear_eq_specNorm S
  let p : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 (Sᴴ *ᵥ v.ofLp)
  let q : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ w.ofLp)
  let a : ι → ℝ := fun i => ‖star p.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)‖
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i => ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((S * D i * T i * D i * S) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖
  have hp : ‖p‖ ≤ c := by
    exact ((Sᴴ).l2_opNorm_mulVec v).trans
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (specNorm_nonneg _)).trans
        (by simpa only [mul_one, specNorm_conjTranspose] using hS))
  have hq : ‖q‖ ≤ c := by
    exact (S.l2_opNorm_mulVec w).trans
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (specNorm_nonneg _)).trans
        (by simpa only [mul_one] using hS))
  have hleading (i : ι) :
      star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((S * D i * S) *ᵥ w.ofLp) =
        star p.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp) := by
    dsimp [p, q]
    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    rw [bilinear_move_left S]
  have hdiff (i : ι) : max (specNorm S - specNorm (T i)) 0 ≤ a i + b i := by
    apply max_le _ (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
    have hsmall := norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (T i) v w hv hw
    have hrev := norm_sub_norm_le
      (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ w.ofLp)) (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (T i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
    have hchange : star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ w.ofLp) -
        star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (T i *ᵥ w.ofLp) =
      star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((S * D i * S) *ᵥ w.ofLp) -
        star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((S * D i * T i * D i * S) *ᵥ w.ofLp) := by
      rw [← dotProduct_sub, ← Matrix.sub_mulVec, hexp i, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
    rw [hprobe, hchange, hleading] at hrev
    exact (by linarith : specNorm S - specNorm (T i) ≤
      ‖star p.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp) -
        star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((S * D i * T i * D i * S) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖).trans
          (norm_sub_le _ _)
  have hb (i : ι) : b i ≤ 2 * R * c ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)‖ := by
    let x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 ((D i)ᴴ *ᵥ p.ofLp)
    let y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 (T i *ᵥ (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp))
    have he : star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((S * D i * T i * D i * S) *ᵥ w.ofLp) = inner ℂ x y := by
      have hi : inner ℂ x y = star x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (T i *ᵥ (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)) :=
        by rw [← WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 x, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
      rw [hi]
      dsimp [x, p, q]
      simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rw [bilinear_move_left S, bilinear_move_left (D i)]
    have hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * R * c :=
      ((D i)ᴴ.l2_opNorm_mulVec p).trans (by
        rw [← specNorm_eq_norm, specNorm_conjTranspose]
        exact mul_le_mul (hD i) hp (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
    have hy : ‖y‖ ≤ c * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)‖ :=
      (T i).l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)) |>.trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hT i) (norm_nonneg _))
    dsimp [b]
    rw [he]
    exact (norm_inner_le_norm x y).trans
      ((mul_le_mul hx hy (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).trans_eq (by ring))
  have hpoint (i : ι) : max (specNorm S - specNorm (T i)) 0 ^ 2 ≤
      2 * (a i) ^ 2 + 8 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := (sq_le_sq₀ (le_max_right _ _)
      (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mpr (hdiff i)
    have h2 : (a i + b i) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (a i) ^ 2 + 2 * (b i) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a i - b i)]
    have h3 := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _))).mpr (hb i)
    nlinarith
  have ha := sum_bilinear_sq_le_mul_bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ p q hc hp hq
  have hgram := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_gram_mul D Finset.univ q
  have hq2 := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg q) hc.le).mpr hq
  have hu := hgram.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq2 (specNorm_nonneg _))
  calc _ ≤ ∑ i, (2 * (a i) ^ 2 +
      8 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hpoint i)
    _ = 2 * (∑ i, (a i) ^ 2) + 8 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 *
        (∑ i, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ q.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 2 * (c ^ 4 * bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ) +
        8 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * (specNorm (∑ i, (D i)ᴴ * D i) * c ^ 2) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (by norm_num))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (by positivity))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.sum_posPart_sq_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le_resolventVarianceProxy
statement:
theorem sum_posPart_sq_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le_resolventVarianceProxy [Fintype ι]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hD : ∀ i, (D i).IsHermitian) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hbound : ∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ 2 * R) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, max (specNorm (resolvent A ζ) - specNorm (resolvent (A - D i) ζ)) 0 ^ 2 ≤
      resolventVarianceProxy D Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
proof:
:= by
  let S := resolvent A ζ
  let T : ι → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i => resolvent (A - D i) ζ
  have hr (B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) : ζ ∈ resolventSet ℂ B := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) ζ - B)
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      hB.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
  have hdiff (i : ι) : S - T i = S * D i * T i := by
    dsimp [S, T]
    rw [spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent (hr A hA) (hr (A - D i) (hA.sub (hD i)))]
    have he : A - (A - D i) = D i := by abel
    rw [he]
  have hrev (i : ι) : S - T i = T i * D i * S := by
    have h := spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent (hr (A - D i) (hA.sub (hD i))) (hr A hA)
    change T i - S = T i * ((A - D i) - A) * S at h
    have he : (A - D i) - A = -D i := by abel
    rw [he, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul] at h
    have := congrArg Neg.neg h
    simpa only [neg_sub, neg_neg] using this
  have hexp (i : ι) : S - T i = S * D i * S - S * D i * T i * D i * S := by
    calc S - T i = S * D i * T i := hdiff i
      _ = S * D i * S - S * D i * (S - T i) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hrev i]; noncomm_ring
  have h := sum_posPart_sq_le_of_resolvent_expansion S T D
    (inv_pos.mpr (abs_pos.mpr hζ)) hR (hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ)
    (fun i => (hA.sub (hD i)).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ) hbound hexp
  simpa only [S, T, resolventVarianceProxy, matrixVarianceProxy, div_eq_mul_inv,
    inv_pow] using h

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_neumann_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_neumann_of_norm_lt_one
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hS : S.val.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hnorm : ‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap‖<1) :
    let L
proof:
:= matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap
    let I := toHermitianFrobenius (Matrix.isHermitian_one : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian)
    let Y := Ring.inverse (1-L) I
    (∀ x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Ring.inverse (1-L) x)).PosSemidef) ∧
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y).PosDef ∧
      (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y ∧
      hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Y-L Y)=1 := by
  let L := matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap
  let I := toHermitianFrobenius (Matrix.isHermitian_one : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian)
  have hc := posSemidef_matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap
  change (∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Ring.inverse (1-L) x)).PosSemidef) ∧
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Ring.inverse (1-L) I)).PosDef ∧
    (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Ring.inverse (1-L) I) ∧
    hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Ring.inverse (1-L) I-L (Ring.inverse (1-L) I))=1
  rw [← hermitianNeumannInverse_eq_inverse L hnorm]
  have hge := one_le_hermitianNeumannInverse_one L hc hnorm
  have hpd : (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (hermitianNeumannInverse L I)).PosDef := by
    have hp := Matrix.PosDef.one.add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hge)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hp
  refine ⟨fun x hx => posSemidef_hermitianNeumannInverse L hc hnorm hx,hpd,hge,?_⟩
  rw [hermitianNeumannInverse_sub_map L hnorm I]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.eventually_posDef_of_continuousAt
statement:
private theorem eventually_posDef_of_continuousAt
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → Matrix n n ℂ} {x : X}
    (hf : ContinuousAt f x) (hfx : (f x).PosDef)
    (hH : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (f y).IsHermitian) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (f y).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδf⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ f x := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff hfx.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
        (fun r hr => hfx.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hr)
  have hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ‖f y-f x‖<δ :=
    ((hf.sub_const (f x)).norm).eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simpa using hδ)
  filter_upwards [hs,hH] with y hy hHy
  have hneg : (-‖f y-f x‖)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ f y-f x := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,neg_smul] using
      (hHy.sub hfx.isHermitian).isSelfAdjoint.neg_algebraMap_norm_le_self
  have hle : (δ-‖f y-f x‖)•(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ f y := by
    convert! add_le_add hδf hneg using 1 <;> module
  exact ((Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (sub_pos.mpr hy)).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle).posDef

name: NLAlib.eventually_matrixK_positive_gaps
statement:
private theorem eventually_matrixK_positive_gaps
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hS : S.val.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    ∀ᶠ X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) in 𝓝 S,
      X.val.PosDef ∧ ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (X.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ᶠ X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) in 𝓝 S, X.val.PosDef :=
    eventually_posDef_of_continuousAt continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt hS
      (Eventually.of_forall fun X => X.property)
  have hg : ∀ᶠ X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) in 𝓝 S,
      ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (X.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef := by
    apply hν.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
    intro T hT
    have hi : ContinuousAt
        (fun p : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => p.1.val⁻¹)
        (S,T) :=
      (hasFDerivAt_matrixInverse S.val hS.isUnit).continuousAt.comp
        (f := fun p : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) × selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => p.1.val)
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).continuousAt
    have hf := hi.add (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
    apply eventually_posDef_of_continuousAt hf (hgap T hT)
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p =>
      (show p.1.val.IsHermitian from p.1.property).inv.add p.2.property
  exact hp.and hg

name: NLAlib.quadratic_pos_iff_derivative_witness
statement:
private theorem quadratic_pos_iff_derivative_witness
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    (∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0<frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ)) ↔
    ∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
    matrixKTransform_norm_iff_supersolution ν hν α hα S hS hgap,
    matrixKTransform_supersolution_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S hS hgap]

name: NLAlib.isOpen_matrixKStableDomain_hermitian
statement:
theorem isOpen_matrixKStableDomain_hermitian
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    IsOpen {S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) | S.val ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α}
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hDB⟩ :=
    (quadratic_pos_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα S.val hS.1 hS.2.1).mp hS.2.2
  have hd : S.val ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS.1.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S.val T.val hS.1 (hS.2.1 T hT)⟩
  have hg := eventually_matrixK_positive_gaps ν hν S hS.1 hS.2.1
  have hc : ContinuousAt
      (fun X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKTransformDeriv ν α X.val B) S := by
    have hh := ((continuousAt_matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν hν α hd).comp
      (f := fun X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => X.val)
      continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt).clm_apply (continuousAt_const (y := B))
    change ContinuousAt
      (fun X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α X.val B) S at hh
    have he : (fun X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α X.val B) =
        (fun X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) => matrixKTransformDeriv ν α X.val B) := by
      funext X
      exact congrArg (fun D : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ => D B)
        (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α X.val)
    rwa [he] at hh
  have hHerm : ∀ᶠ X : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) in 𝓝 S,
      (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α X.val B).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [hg] with X hX
    exact isHermitian_matrixKTransformDeriv ν hν α hα X.val hX.1 hX.2 hB.isHermitian
  have hpos := eventually_posDef_of_continuousAt hc hDB hHerm
  filter_upwards [hg,hpos] with X hX hDX
  exact ⟨hX.1,hX.2,
    (quadratic_pos_iff_derivative_witness ν hν α hα X.val hX.1 hX.2).mpr ⟨B,hB,hDX⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pair
statement:
private theorem re_trace_pair (U V : Matrix d d 𝕜) (a b : d → ℝ) :
    RCLike.re (trace ((U * diagonal (fun j => (a j : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ) *
      (V * diagonal (fun k => (b k : 𝕜)) * Vᴴ))) =
    ∑ j, ∑ k, a j * b k * ‖(Uᴴ * V) j k‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let W := Uᴴ * V
  have hw : Vᴴ * U = Wᴴ := by simp [W, conjTranspose_mul]
  calc
    _ = RCLike.re (trace (diagonal (fun j => (a j : 𝕜)) * W *
       diagonal (fun k => (b k : 𝕜)) * Wᴴ)) := by
      simp only [W, ← hw]
      congr 1
      simp only [mul_assoc]
      rw [trace_mul_comm U]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      change RCLike.re (trace (diagonal (fun j => (a j : 𝕜)) * W *
        diagonal (fun k => (b k : 𝕜)) * Wᴴ)) = ∑ j, ∑ k, a j * b k * ‖W j k‖ ^ 2
      simp only [trace, diag_apply, mul_apply, diagonal, of_apply, ite_mul, mul_ite, zero_mul,
        mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true,
        conjTranspose_apply, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [show (a j : 𝕜) * W j k * (b k : 𝕜) * star (W j k)
          = ((a j * b k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * (W j k * star (W j k)) by push_cast; ring,
        RCLike.star_def, RCLike.mul_conj, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul,
        RCLike.ofReal_re, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.generalized_klein
statement:
theorem generalized_klein {N : ℕ}
    (I : Set ℝ) (_hI : Convex ℝ I) (f g : Fin N → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ a ∈ I, ∀ h ∈ I, 0 ≤ ∑ i, f i a * g i h)
    (A H : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I) (hHI : spectrum ℝ H ⊆ I) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i, RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (cfc (f i) A * cfc (g i) H))
proof:
:= by
  have heq (i : Fin N) :
      RCLike.re (trace (cfc (f i) A * cfc (g i) H)) =
      ∑ j, ∑ k, f i (hA.eigenvalues j) * g i (hH.eigenvalues k) *
        ‖(((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix d d 𝕜)ᴴ *
          (hH.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix d d 𝕜)) j k)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [hA.cfc_eq, hH.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc,
      Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Function.comp_def, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
    exact re_trace_pair _ _ _ _
  simp_rw [heq]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k _
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg (hfg _ (hAI (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real j)) _
    (hHI (hH.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real k))) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.re_trace_sub_sq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_sub_sq_mul_pow (H K : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    ((H - K) ^ 2 * H ^ m).trace.re =
      (H ^ (m + 2)).trace.re + (H ^ m * K ^ 2).trace.re -
        2 * (H ^ (m + 1) * K).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : H * H * H ^ m = H ^ (m + 2) := by
    rw [← pow_two, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hcross : (H * K * H ^ m).trace = (H ^ (m + 1) * K).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, ← pow_succ]
  have hcross' : (K * H * H ^ m).trace = (H ^ (m + 1) * K).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  have hkk : (K * K * H ^ m).trace = (H ^ m * K ^ 2).trace := by
    rw [← pow_two, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  rw [pow_two]
  simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, hpow, hcross, hcross', hkk]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re]
  ring

name: NLAlib.re_trace_sub_mul_sub_pow_le
statement:
theorem re_trace_sub_mul_sub_pow_le
    (H K : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hK : K.IsHermitian)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Even m) :
    ((H - K) * (H ^ (m + 1) - K ^ (m + 1))).trace.re ≤
      ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 *
        ((H - K) ^ 2 * (H ^ m + K ^ m)).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  let W : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ := star hH.eigenvectorUnitary * hK.eigenvectorUnitary
  let w (i j : ι) := ‖(W : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2
  let a := hH.eigenvalues
  let b := hK.eigenvalues
  have hrow (i) : ∑ j, w i j = 1 := sum_norm_sq_unitary_row W i
  have hcol (j) : ∑ i, w i j = 1 := sum_norm_sq_unitary_col W j
  have hleft (r : ℕ) : (H ^ r).trace.re = ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * a i ^ r := by
    rw [re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow H hH]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, one_mul, a]
  have hright (r : ℕ) : (K ^ r).trace.re = ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * b j ^ r := by
    rw [re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow K hK, Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hcol, one_mul, b]
  have hprod (r s : ℕ) : (H ^ r * K ^ s).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * a i ^ r * b j ^ s :=
    re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap H K hH hK r s
  have hprodH (r : ℕ) : (H ^ r * K).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * a i ^ r * b j := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using hprod r 1
  have hprodK (r : ℕ) : (K ^ r * H).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * a i * b j ^ r := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
    simpa only [pow_one] using hprod 1 r
  have hL : ((H - K) * (H ^ (m + 1) - K ^ (m + 1))).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * ((a i - b j) * (a i ^ (m + 1) - b j ^ (m + 1))) := by
    have hh : (H * H ^ (m + 1)).trace = (H ^ (m + 2)).trace := by rw [← pow_succ']
    have hk : (K * K ^ (m + 1)).trace = (K ^ (m + 2)).trace := by rw [← pow_succ']
    have hhk : (H * K ^ (m + 1)).trace.re =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * a i * b j ^ (m + 1) := by
      simpa only [pow_one] using hprod 1 (m + 1)
    have hkh : (K * H ^ (m + 1)).trace.re =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * a i ^ (m + 1) * b j := by
      rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      exact hprodH (m + 1)
    rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_sub,
      Matrix.trace_sub, hh, hk]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re]
    rw [hleft, hright, hhk, hkh]
    have he (x y : ℝ) : (x - y) * (x ^ (m + 1) - y ^ (m + 1)) =
        x ^ (m + 2) - x * y ^ (m + 1) - x ^ (m + 1) * y + y ^ (m + 2) := by
      rw [pow_succ x (m + 1), pow_succ y (m + 1)]
      ring
    simp_rw [he, mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_assoc]
    ring
  have hR : ((H - K) ^ 2 * (H ^ m + K ^ m)).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * ((a i - b j) ^ 2 * (a i ^ m + b j ^ m)) := by
    have heq : (H - K) ^ 2 = (K - H) ^ 2 := by
      rw [show H - K = -(K - H) by abel, neg_sq]
    rw [mul_add, Matrix.trace_add, Complex.add_re, re_trace_sub_sq_mul_pow]
    rw [heq, re_trace_sub_sq_mul_pow]
    rw [hleft, hright, hprod, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (K ^ m) (H ^ 2), hprod,
      hprodH, hprodK]
    have he (x y : ℝ) : (x - y) ^ 2 * (x ^ m + y ^ m) =
        x ^ (m + 2) + x ^ m * y ^ 2 - 2 * (x ^ (m + 1) * y) +
        (y ^ (m + 2) + x ^ 2 * y ^ m - 2 * (x * y ^ (m + 1))) := by
      rw [pow_add x m 2, pow_add y m 2, pow_succ x m, pow_succ y m]
      ring
    simp_rw [he, mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_assoc]
    simp only [mul_left_comm, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  rw [hL, hR]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_mul_sub_pow_le_of_even hm (a i) (b j))
        (sq_nonneg ‖(W : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖)
  simpa only [w, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, Finset.mul_sum] using hsum

name: NLAlib.norm_map_unitary_le_norm_map_one
statement:
theorem norm_map_unitary_le_norm_map_one
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    ‖Φ U‖ ≤ ‖Φ 1‖
proof:
:= by
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose = 1 :=
    Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hU'U : (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * U = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U
  obtain ⟨V, d, hd⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal (hUU.trans hU'U.symm)
  let D := star V * U * V
  have hD : (D : Matrix n n ℂ) = diagonal d := by
    change (V : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * U * V = diagonal d
    rw [hd]
    have hV : (V : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * V = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
    calc
      _ = ((V : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * V) * diagonal d *
        ((V : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * V) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hV, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hz (i : n) : d i * star (d i) = 1 := by
    have h := D.property.2
    change (D : Matrix n n ℂ) * (D : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose = 1 at h
    rw [hD] at h
    simpa using congrFun (congrFun h i) i
  let B (i : n) := Φ (unitarySpectralProjector V i)
  have hB (i : n) : (B i).PosSemidef := posSemidef_map_unitarySpectralProjector Φ V i
  have hsum : ∑ i, B i = Φ 1 := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [← map_sum, sum_unitarySpectralProjector]
  have hfirst : ∑ i, d i • B i = Φ U := by
    rw [hd, unitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose_eq_sum, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rfl
  have hsecond : ∑ i, star (d i) • B i = (Φ U).conjTranspose := by
    rw [← hfirst, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, (hB i).isHermitian.eq]
  have hb (i : n) : (fromBlocks (B i) (d i • B i) (star (d i) • B i) (B i)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [star_one, mul_one, one_mul, one_smul, hz] using
      posSemidef_scalar_gram_fromBlocks (hB i) (d i) 1
  have hp := Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hb i)
  have heq : (∑ i, fromBlocks (B i) (d i • B i) (star (d i) • B i) (B i)) =
      fromBlocks (∑ i, B i) (∑ i, d i • B i) (∑ i, star (d i) • B i) (∑ i, B i) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Matrix.sum_apply, fromBlocks]
  rw [heq, hsum, hfirst, hsecond] at hp
  exact norm_le_of_posSemidef_equal_fromBlocks
    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (Φ.map_nonneg zero_le_one)) hp

name: NLAlib.norm_map_le_norm_map_one_of_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_map_le_norm_map_one_of_specNorm_le_one {a b : ℕ}
    (Φ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) ℂ)
    {A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) ℂ} (hA : specNorm A ≤ 1) :
    ‖Φ A‖ ≤ ‖Φ 1‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_unitary_average_of_specNorm_le_one A hA
  rw [h, map_smul, map_add, norm_smul]
  have hn : ‖(2 : ℂ)⁻¹‖ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by norm_num
  rw [hn]
  have hUV := (norm_add_le (Φ U) (Φ V)).trans
    (add_le_add (norm_map_unitary_le_norm_map_one Φ U)
      (norm_map_unitary_le_norm_map_one Φ V))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_norm_map_unitBall
statement:
theorem isGreatest_norm_map_unitBall {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (Φ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) ℂ) :
    IsGreatest ((fun A => ‖Φ A‖) '' {A | specNorm A ≤ 1}) ‖Φ 1‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨1, (specNorm_one_le (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := Fin a)), rfl⟩
  · rintro x ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    exact norm_map_le_norm_map_one_of_specNorm_le_one Φ hA

name: NLAlib.im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert
statement:
theorem im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) (i : Fin m) (H : M) :
    ∀ j, (resolventWordInsert w i H j).1.im ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i.castSucc ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simpa only [resolventWordInsert, Fin.insertNth_apply_same] using hw i
  · simpa only [resolventWordInsert, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove] using hw k

name: NLAlib.contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolvent
statement:
theorem contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolvent (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ)
proof:
:= by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro y
  have hu : IsUnit (ζ • (1 : M) - (A + L y)) :=
    (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates y)).isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
  have hi := contDiffAt_ringInverse (n := r) ℝ hu.unit
  rw [hu.unit_spec] at hi
  have ha : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun x : E => ζ • (1 : M) - (A + L x)) y :=
    contDiffAt_const.sub (contDiffAt_const.add (L).contDiff.contDiffAt)
  convert! hi.comp y ha using 1
  funext x
  simp [hermitianCoordinateResolvent, resolvent, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord
statement:
theorem contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord {m : ℕ} (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have heq : hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w = fun _ : E => (1 : M) := by
      funext y
      simp [hermitianCoordinateResolventWord]
    rw [heq]
    exact contDiff_const
  | succ m ih =>
    have heq : hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w = fun y =>
        (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A (w 0).1 y * (w 0).2) *
          hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (Fin.tail w) y := by
      funext y
      simp only [hermitianCoordinateResolventWord, List.ofFn_succ, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact ((contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA (w 0).1 (hw 0)).mul
      contDiff_const).mul (ih (Fin.tail w) (fun i => hw i.succ))

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_insert_eq
statement:
private theorem hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_insert_eq {m : ℕ}
    (A : M) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M) (y : E) (i : Fin m) (H : M) :
    hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (resolventWordInsert w i H) y =
      (((List.ofFn w).take i).map
        (fun b => hermitianCoordinateResolvent A b.1 y * b.2)).prod *
        (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A (w i).1 y * H *
          hermitianCoordinateResolvent A (w i).1 y * (w i).2) *
      (((List.ofFn w).drop (i + 1)).map
        (fun b => hermitianCoordinateResolvent A b.1 y * b.2)).prod
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermitianCoordinateResolventWord resolventWordInsert
  rw [List.ofFn_insertNth_eq_take_cons_drop]
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < (List.ofFn w).length := by simp
  simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi]
  simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.prod_append,
    List.prod_cons, List.getElem_ofFn, Fin.eta]
  simp only [mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply {m : ℕ}
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) (y h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y h =
      ∑ i : Fin m, hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
        (resolventWordInsert w i (L h)) y
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ℂ × M) → E → M := fun b x => hermitianCoordinateResolvent A b.1 x * b.2
  let D : (ℂ × M) → E →L[ℝ] M := fun b =>
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M).flip b.2).comp
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A b.1 y)
  have hf (b : ℂ × M) (hb : b ∈ List.ofFn w) : HasFDerivAt (f b) (D b) y := by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hb
    simpa only [f, D, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, Function.comp_def,
      ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using!
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M).flip (w i).2).hasFDerivAt.comp y
        (hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA (w i).1 (hw i) y)
  have hp := HasFDerivAt.list_prod' hf
  change fderiv ℝ (fun x => ((List.ofFn w).map (fun b => f b x)).prod) y h = _
  rw [hp.fderiv]
  simp only [sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, op_smul_eq_mul]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (List.length_ofFn (f := w))) _ _ (fun i => ?_)
  rw [hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_insert_eq]
  simp only [D, Fin.getElem_fin, List.getElem_ofFn, finCongr_apply_coe,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',
    hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply, mul_assoc]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply {m : ℕ}
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) (y : E) (h : Fin 2 → E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y h =
      ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1),
        hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 1))) j (L (h 0))) y
proof:
:= by
  have hc := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA w hw (r := ⊤)
  have hh := hc.contDiffAt.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (x := y) (m := 1) (by exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _)
  rw [hh.iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left' (m := h)]
  have heq : (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) x
      (Fin.tail h)) = fun x => ∑ i : Fin m,
        hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 1))) x := by
    funext x
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA w hw]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  have hs := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ =>
    ((contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA _
      (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L (h 1))) (r := ⊤)).differentiable
        (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt (x := y))
  rw [hs.fderiv]
  simp only [sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA _
    (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L (h 1))) y (h 0)

name: NLAlib.iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply {m : ℕ}
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) (y : E) (h : Fin 3 → E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y h =
      ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), ∑ k : Fin (m + 2),
        hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
              k (L (h 0))) y
proof:
:= by
  have hc := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA w hw (r := ⊤)
  have hh := hc.contDiffAt.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (x := y) (m := 2) (by exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _)
  rw [hh.iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left' (m := h)]
  have heq : (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) x
      (Fin.tail h)) = fun x => ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1),
        hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1))) x := by
    funext x
    convert! iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA w hw x
      (Fin.tail h) using 1
  rw [heq]
  have hs := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ =>
    HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ =>
      ((contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA _
        (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert _
          (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
          (r := ⊤)).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt (x := y)))
  rw [hs.fderiv]
  simp only [sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA _
    (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert _
      (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1))) y (h 0)

name: NLAlib.card_third_resolvent_word_insertions
statement:
theorem card_third_resolvent_word_insertions (m : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin (m + 1) × Fin (m + 2)) = m * (m + 1) * (m + 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Fintype.card_prod, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.iteratedFDeriv_three_comp_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_three_comp_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {m : ℕ}
    (T : M →L[ℝ] F) (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) (y : E) (h : Fin 3 → E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (fun x => T (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w x)) y h =
      ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), ∑ k : Fin (m + 2),
        T (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
              k (L (h 0))) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA w hw (r := ⊤)
  change (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (T ∘ hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y) h = _
  rw [T.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hc.contDiffAt (by simp)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA w hw]
  simp only [map_sum]

name: NLAlib.posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp
statement:
theorem NLAlib.posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (matrixExp A).PosDef ∧ matrixLog (matrixExp A) = A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [matrixExp, ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hA.isSelfAdjoint]
    apply Matrix.IsStrictlyPositive.posDef
    exact (cfc_isStrictlyPositive_iff Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
      (fun x _ => Real.exp_pos x)
  · exact CFC.log_exp A hA.isSelfAdjoint

name: NLAlib.gram_spectralAbsoluteFactor
statement:
private theorem gram_spectralAbsoluteFactor {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    spectralAbsoluteFactor hB * (spectralAbsoluteFactor hB)ᵀ =
      (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) * Matrix.diagonal (fun k => |hB.eigenvalues k|) *
        (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [spectralAbsoluteFactor, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose,
    Matrix.mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  simp only [Real.mul_self_sqrt (abs_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_gram_spectralAbsoluteFactor_add
proof:
:= by
  rw [gram_spectralAbsoluteFactor hB]
  conv =>
    arg 1
    rhs
    rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hB]
  rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.diagonal_add]
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun k => |hB.eigenvalues k| + hB.eigenvalues k)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr fun k => by linarith [neg_abs_le (hB.eigenvalues k)]
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    using hdiag.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ

name: NLAlib.neg_quadForm_le_sum_sq_spectralAbsoluteFactor
proof:
:= by
  have h := (posSemidef_gram_spectralAbsoluteFactor_add hB).quadForm_nonneg x
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add] at h
  change 0 ≤ quadForm (spectralAbsoluteFactor hB * (spectralAbsoluteFactor hB)ᵀ) x +
    quadForm B x at h
  have hg : quadForm (spectralAbsoluteFactor hB * (spectralAbsoluteFactor hB)ᵀ) x =
      ∑ k, (∑ i, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * x i) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.transpose_apply, sq]
      using quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self (spectralAbsoluteFactor hB)ᵀ x
  rw [hg] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_spectralAbsoluteFactor_row_le
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℝ := hB.eigenvectorUnitary
  let d : n → ℝ := hB.eigenvalues
  have hUU : U * Uᵀ = 1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hB
  have hUtU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hB
  have hspec : B = U * Matrix.diagonal d * Uᵀ :=
    eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hB
  have hrow : ∑ k, U i k ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M i i) hUU
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq, ← sq] using h
  have hgram : (U * Matrix.diagonal d) * (U * Matrix.diagonal d)ᵀ = B * Bᵀ := by
    rw [hspec]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U (Matrix.diagonal d * Uᵀ), hUtU, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hrow2 : ∑ k, (U i k * |d k|) ^ 2 = ∑ j, B i j ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M i i) hgram
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, ← sq] at h
    change (∑ k, (U * Matrix.diagonal d) i k ^ 2) = ∑ j, B i j ^ 2 at h
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_diagonal,
      ← sq, mul_pow, sq_abs] using h
  have hfactor : (∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k ^ 2) = ∑ k, U i k * (U i k * |d k|) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    simp only [spectralAbsoluteFactor, Matrix.mul_diagonal, mul_pow,
      Real.sq_sqrt (abs_nonneg _)]
    dsimp [U, d]
    ring
  rw [hfactor]
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (fun k => U i k)
    (fun k => U i k * |d k|)
  rw [hrow, hrow2, one_mul] at hcs
  exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hcs

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart
statement:
theorem isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (matrixHermitianPart A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [matrixHermitianPart, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul,
    mul_add, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.matrixSkewHermitianPart_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem matrixSkewHermitianPart_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (matrixSkewHermitianPart A)ᴴ = -matrixSkewHermitianPart A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [matrixSkewHermitianPart, matrixHermitianPart, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
  field_simp
  norm_num only [RCLike.ofReal_ofNat]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobInner_eq_zero_of_skewHermitian_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem frobInner_eq_zero_of_skewHermitian_of_isHermitian {K X : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hK : Kᴴ = -K) (hX : X.IsHermitian) : frobInner K X = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := frobInner_conjTranspose K X
  rw [hK, hX.eq, frobInner_neg_left] at he
  linarith

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.spectralClip_properties
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.spectralClip_properties {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (δ : ℝ) :
    (hH.spectralClip δ - δ • 1).PosSemidef ∧
      (hH.spectralClip δ - H).PosSemidef ∧
      (hH.spectralClip δ - H) * (hH.spectralClip δ - δ • 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  let d := hH.eigenvalues
  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hUU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hHrep : H = U * diagonal (fun i => (d i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      U, d, Function.comp_def] using hH.spectral_theorem
  have hPrep : hH.spectralClip δ = U * diagonal (fun i => ((max δ (d i) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ :=
    cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose hH _
  have hshift : hH.spectralClip δ - δ • 1 =
      U * diagonal (fun i => (max δ (d i) - δ : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    rw [hPrep, ← Matrix.diagonal_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [show diagonal (fun _ : n => (δ : 𝕜)) = δ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) by
      ext i j; by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]]
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hUU]
  have hcorrection : hH.spectralClip δ - H =
      U * diagonal (fun i => (max δ (d i) - d i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    rw [hPrep, hHrep, ← Matrix.diagonal_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
  have hp1 : (diagonal (fun i => (max δ (d i) - δ : 𝕜))).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left δ (d i))
  have hp2 : (diagonal (fun i => (max δ (d i) - d i : 𝕜))).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast le_max_right δ (d i))
  refine ⟨hshift ▸ hp1.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U,
    hcorrection ▸ hp2.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U, ?_⟩
  rw [hshift, hcorrection]
  calc
    _ = U * ((diagonal fun i => (max δ (d i) - d i : 𝕜)) *
        (Uᴴ * U) * diagonal (fun i => (max δ (d i) - δ : 𝕜))) * Uᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
      have hz : (diagonal fun i => (max δ (d i) - d i : 𝕜) * (max δ (d i) - δ)) = 0 := by
        ext i j
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst j
          rcases le_total δ (d i) with hi | hi <;> simp [max_eq_left hi, max_eq_right hi]
        · simp [hij]
      rw [hz, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.isHermitian_spectralClip
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.isHermitian_spectralClip {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (δ : ℝ) : (hH.spectralClip δ).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (hH.spectralClip_properties δ).2.1.isHermitian
  have he : hH.spectralClip δ = (hH.spectralClip δ - H) + H := by abel
  rw [he]
  exact hp.add hH

name: NLAlib.frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero
statement:
theorem frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ)
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hX : X.IsHermitian) (hfloor : (X - δ • 1).PosSemidef) :
    frobInner (A - nearestPSD A δ) (X - nearestPSD A δ) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  let H := matrixHermitianPart A
  let hH := isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart A
  let P := nearestPSD A δ
  have hP : P.IsHermitian := hH.isHermitian_spectralClip δ
  have hR : (P - H).PosSemidef := (hH.spectralClip_properties δ).2.1
  have hcomp : (P - H) * (P - δ • 1) = 0 := (hH.spectralClip_properties δ).2.2
  have htrace : 0 ≤ frobInner (P - H) (X - δ • 1) := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, hR.isHermitian.eq]
    exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef hR hfloor)).1
  have hzero : frobInner (P - H) (P - δ • 1) = 0 := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, hR.isHermitian.eq, hcomp, Matrix.trace_zero, map_zero]
  have hskew : frobInner (A - H) (X - P) = 0 :=
    frobInner_eq_zero_of_skewHermitian_of_isHermitian (matrixSkewHermitianPart_conjTranspose A)
      (hX.sub hP)
  have hsplit : A - P = (A - H) - (P - H) := by abel
  change frobInner (A - P) (X - P) ≤ 0
  rw [hsplit, frobInner_sub_left, hskew]
  have he : frobInner (P - H) (X - P) =
      frobInner (P - H) (X - δ • 1) - frobInner (P - H) (P - δ • 1) := by
    rw [← frobInner_sub_right]
    congr 1
    abel
  rw [he, hzero]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.nearestPSD_unique_minimizer
statement:
theorem nearestPSD_unique_minimizer (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ) :
    (nearestPSD A δ).IsHermitian ∧ (nearestPSD A δ - δ • 1).PosSemidef ∧
      ∀ X : Matrix n n 𝕜, X.IsHermitian → (X - δ • 1).PosSemidef →
        frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) ≤ frobSq (A - X) ∧
          (frobSq (A - X) ≤ frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) → X = nearestPSD A δ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart A).isHermitian_spectralClip δ,
    ((isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart A).spectralClip_properties δ).1, ?_⟩
  intro X hX hfloor
  have hv := frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero A δ hX hfloor
  have he : A - X = (A - nearestPSD A δ) - (X - nearestPSD A δ) := by abel
  have hdiff : frobSq (A - X) = frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) -
      2 * frobInner (A - nearestPSD A δ) (X - nearestPSD A δ) +
        frobSq (X - nearestPSD A δ) := by rw [he, frobSq_sub]
  have hn := frobSq_nonneg (X - nearestPSD A δ)
  constructor
  · linarith
  · intro hle
    have hz : frobSq (X - nearestPSD A δ) = 0 := by linarith
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_nearestPSD_sub_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_nearestPSD_sub_le (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ) :
    frobNorm (nearestPSD A δ - nearestPSD B δ) ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  let P := nearestPSD A δ
  let Q := nearestPSD B δ
  have hp := nearestPSD_unique_minimizer A δ
  have hq := nearestPSD_unique_minimizer B δ
  have hv1 := frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero A δ hq.1 hq.2.1
  have hv2 := frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero B δ hp.1 hp.2.1
  have hpair : frobSq (P - Q) ≤ frobInner (A - B) (P - Q) := by
    change frobInner (A - P) (Q - P) ≤ 0 at hv1
    change frobInner (B - Q) (P - Q) ≤ 0 at hv2
    have hrev : Q - P = -(P - Q) := by abel
    rw [hrev, frobInner_neg_right] at hv1
    have he : frobInner (A - B) (P - Q) - frobSq (P - Q) =
        frobInner (A - P) (P - Q) - frobInner (B - Q) (P - Q) := by
      simp only [frobInner_sub_left, frobSq]
      ring
    linarith
  have hCS := frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm (A - B) (P - Q)
  have hsq := frobNorm_sq (P - Q)
  have hn := frobNorm_nonneg (P - Q)
  have hm := frobNorm_nonneg (A - B)
  change frobNorm (P - Q) ≤ _
  nlinarith

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.frobSq_spectralClip_sub
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.frobSq_spectralClip_sub {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (δ : ℝ) :
    frobSq (hH.spectralClip δ - H) =
      ∑ i, max (δ - hH.eigenvalues i) 0 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n 𝕜 := hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self hH.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hHrep : H = U * diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      U, Function.comp_def] using hH.spectral_theorem
  have hPrep : hH.spectralClip δ =
      U * diagonal (fun i => ((max δ (hH.eigenvalues i) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ :=
    cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose hH _
  have he : hH.spectralClip δ - H =
      U * diagonal (fun i => ((max δ (hH.eigenvalues i) - hH.eigenvalues i : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ := by
    calc
      _ = U * diagonal (fun i => ((max δ (hH.eigenvalues i) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ -
          U * diagonal (fun i => (hH.eigenvalues i : 𝕜)) * Uᴴ :=
        congrArg₂ (· - ·) hPrep hHrep
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [RCLike.ofReal_sub, ← Matrix.diagonal_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
  rw [he, frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hU, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU,
    frobSq_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_max_right δ (hH.eigenvalues i)))]
  congr 1
  rcases le_total δ (hH.eigenvalues i) with hle | hle
  · rw [max_eq_right hle, sub_self, max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hle)]
  · rw [max_eq_left hle, max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_nearestPSD_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_nearestPSD_eq (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ) :
    frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) = frobSq (matrixSkewHermitianPart A) +
      ∑ i, max (δ - (isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart A).eigenvalues i) 0 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let H := matrixHermitianPart A
  let hH := isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart A
  have hP := hH.isHermitian_spectralClip δ
  have he : A - nearestPSD A δ = matrixSkewHermitianPart A - (nearestPSD A δ - H) := by
    dsimp [matrixSkewHermitianPart, H]
    abel
  have horth : frobInner (matrixSkewHermitianPart A) (nearestPSD A δ - H) = 0 :=
    frobInner_eq_zero_of_skewHermitian_of_isHermitian (matrixSkewHermitianPart_conjTranspose A)
      (hP.sub hH)
  rw [he, frobSq_sub_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _ horth]
  exact congrArg (fun q => frobSq (matrixSkewHermitianPart A) + q)
    (hH.frobSq_spectralClip_sub δ)

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.polarNewtonIterate_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact h.eq
  | succ k ih =>

      ⟨h.left_orth, h.right_orth, fun i => polarNewtonScalar_pos (h.pos i) k, rfl⟩

theorem IsThinSVD.polarNewtonIterate_closed_form {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ}

    polarNewtonIterate A k = thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i =>
      (1 + ((σ i - 1) / (σ i + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)) /
        (1 - ((σ i - 1) / (σ i + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)))

name: NLAlib.polarNewtonRadius_lt_one

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarNewtonIterate_sub_polar_le
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarNewtonIterate_sub_polar_le
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (polarNewtonIterate A k - canonicalPartialPolar A) ≤
      2 * polarNewtonRadius σ ^ (2 ^ k) / (1 - polarNewtonRadius σ ^ (2 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 ≤ polarNewtonRadius σ := norm_nonneg _
  have hr1 := polarNewtonRadius_lt_one h.pos
  have hp : polarNewtonRadius σ ^ (2 ^ k) < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hr hr1 (by positivity)
  have hQ : canonicalPartialPolar A = thinSingularMatrix U V (fun _ => 1) := by
    rw [h.canonicalPartialPolar_eq]
    simp [thinSingularMatrix]
  rw [h.polarNewtonIterate_eq, hQ, thinSingularMatrix_sub,
    specNorm_thinSingularMatrix U V h.left_orth h.right_orth]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr
  intro i
  apply abs_polarNewtonScalar_sub_one_le (h.pos i) hr hr1
  exact norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => (σ i - 1) / (σ i + 1)) i

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.tendsto_polarNewtonIterate
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Tendsto (fun k i => polarNewtonScalar (σ i) k) atTop (𝓝 (fun _ : r => (1 : ℝ))) :=
    tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr (fun i => tendsto_polarNewtonScalar (h.pos i))
  have hc : Continuous (fun f : r → ℝ => thinSingularMatrix U V f) := by
    unfold thinSingularMatrix
    fun_prop
  have ht := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hs
  have he : (fun k => thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => polarNewtonScalar (σ i) k)) =
      polarNewtonIterate A := funext (fun k => (h.polarNewtonIterate_eq k).symm)
  change Tendsto (fun k => thinSingularMatrix U V (fun i => polarNewtonScalar (σ i) k))
    atTop (𝓝 (thinSingularMatrix U V (fun _ => 1))) at ht
  rw [he] at ht
  simpa only [thinSingularMatrix, RCLike.ofReal_one, Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one,
    ← h.canonicalPartialPolar_eq] using ht

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_compact_stieltjes_probability_measure
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_compact_stieltjes_probability_measure
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1) ∧
      ∃! μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass=1 ∧ IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
          ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F,hFa,hF,μ,hμ,huniq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stieltjes_probability_measure ν hν α hα
  obtain ⟨R0,hR0⟩ := hν.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  let R := max R0 1
  have hR : 0<R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R := by
    intro T hT
    have hTN : specNorm T.val≤R0 := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using hR0 T hT
    exact hTN.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  let κ := 4*(α+1)*R/α
  let C := 2*α^2*(((α+1)*R)⁻¹)^2
  have hsupp : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x∈Icc (-κ) κ := by
    apply ae_mem_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul (μ : Measure ℝ) κ
    intro a ha
    refine ⟨C,?_⟩
    intro z hz hza
    have ha' : 4*(α+1)*R<a*α := (div_lt_iff₀ hα).mp ha
    have hfar : 4*(α+1)*R<α*|z.re| := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hza hα.le]
    rw [← hμ.2 z hz]
    have htrace : (normalizedTrace (α•F z)).im≤‖(imaginaryPart (α•F z) : M)‖ := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using im_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm_imaginaryPart (α•F z)
    exact htrace.trans
      (norm_imaginaryPart_matrixKTransform_solution_le_exterior ν hν α R hα hR F
        hFa hF hbound z hz hfar)
  have hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support :=
    isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset (μ : Measure ℝ).isClosed_support
      ((μ : Measure ℝ).support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc hsupp)
  refine ⟨F,hFa,hF,μ,⟨hμ.1,hcompact,hμ.2⟩,?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  exact huniq σ ⟨hσ.1,hσ.2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.geomKernel_nonneg_of_odd
statement:
theorem geomKernel_nonneg_of_odd {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) (x y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ geomKernel n x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold geomKernel
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | hxy | hxy
  · have hpow : x ^ n < y ^ n := hn.strictMono_pow hxy
    have hgeom := (Commute.all x y).mul_geom_sum₂ n
    nlinarith

  · subst y
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hn
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [← pow_add]
    have hexp : i + (2 * k + 1 - 1 - i) = 2 * k := by omega
    rw [hexp, pow_mul]
    positivity
  · have hpow : y ^ n < x ^ n := hn.strictMono_pow hxy
    have hgeom := (Commute.all x y).mul_geom_sum₂ n
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_tracePowerAlong
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_tracePowerAlong {d p : ℕ}
    (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (tracePowerAlong p A B)
      ((p : ℝ) * Matrix.trace (B * (A + t • B) ^ (p - 1))) t
proof:
:= by
  have haff : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ A + r • B) B t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const B).const_add A
  let : NormedAddCommGroup ℝ := standardRealNormedAddCommGroup
  let : NormedSpace ℝ ℝ := standardRealNormedSpace
  have hpow := haff.fun_pow' p
  let tr : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t tr).clm_apply hpow
  simp only [zero_apply, zero_add] at htrace
  change HasDerivAt (fun y ↦ Matrix.trace ((A + y • B) ^ p))
    (Matrix.trace
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p,
        (A + t • B) ^ (p.pred - i) * B * (A + t • B) ^ i)) t at htrace
  rw [trace_power_derivative_sum] at htrace
  exact htrace

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_tracePowerFirst
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_tracePowerFirst {d p : ℕ}
    (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun r ↦ (p : ℝ) *
        Matrix.trace (B * (A + r • B) ^ (p - 1)))
      (tracePowerSecondAlong p A B t) t
proof:
:= by
  have haff : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ A + r • B) B t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const B).const_add A
  let : NormedAddCommGroup ℝ := standardRealNormedAddCommGroup
  let : NormedSpace ℝ ℝ := standardRealNormedSpace
  have hpow := haff.fun_pow' (p - 1)
  have hleft := hpow.const_mul B
  let tr : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace := (hasDerivAt_const t tr).clm_apply hleft
  simp only [zero_apply, zero_add] at htrace
  change HasDerivAt
    (fun y ↦ Matrix.trace (B * (A + y • B) ^ (p - 1)))
    (Matrix.trace
      (B * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p - 1),
        (A + t • B) ^ ((p - 1).pred - i) * B * (A + t • B) ^ i)) t at htrace
  have hscaled := htrace.const_mul (p : ℝ)
  have hsecond :
      Matrix.trace
          (B * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p - 1),
            (A + t • B) ^ ((p - 1).pred - i) * B * (A + t • B) ^ i) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p - 1),
          Matrix.trace
            (B * (A + t • B) ^ ((p - 1).pred - i) * B *
              (A + t • B) ^ i) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hsecond] at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: NLAlib.traceHessianKernel_eq_spectral
statement:
theorem traceHessianKernel_eq_spectral {d p : ℕ}
    (C B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hC : C.transpose = C) (hB : B.transpose = B) :
    let hCh : C.IsHermitian
proof:
:= Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr hC
    let U := star hCh.eigenvectorUnitary
    let B' := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B
    traceHessianKernel p C B =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (p - 1), ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (B' i j) ^ 2 * (hCh.eigenvalues j) ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) *
          (hCh.eigenvalues i) ^ k := by
  dsimp only
  let hCh : C.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr hC
  let U := star hCh.eigenvectorUnitary
  let phi := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) U
  let B' := phi B
  have hdiag : phi C = Matrix.diagonal hCh.eigenvalues := by
    dsimp only [phi, U]
    simpa using hCh.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
  have hBh : B.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr hB
  have hB'h : B'.IsHermitian := hBh.isSelfAdjoint.map phi |>.isHermitian
  have hB' : B'.transpose = B' :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hB'h
  unfold traceHessianKernel
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  calc
    Matrix.trace (B * C ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) * B * C ^ k) =
        Matrix.trace
          (phi (B * C ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) * B * C ^ k)) := by
      exact (trace_conjStarAlgAut U _).symm
    _ = Matrix.trace
          (B' * (Matrix.diagonal hCh.eigenvalues) ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) *
            B' * (Matrix.diagonal hCh.eigenvalues) ^ k) := by
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, B', hdiag]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j,
          (B' i j) ^ 2 * (hCh.eigenvalues j) ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) *
            (hCh.eigenvalues i) ^ k :=
      trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow B' hB'
        hCh.eigenvalues _ _

name: NLAlib.spectral_traceHessian_nonneg
statement:
theorem spectral_traceHessian_nonneg {d p : ℕ} (hp : Even p) (hp0 : p ≠ 0)
    (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (lambda : Fin d → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (p - 1), ∑ i, ∑ j,
      (B i j) ^ 2 * lambda j ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) * lambda i ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp0
  have hn : Odd (p - 1) := Nat.Even.sub_odd hp1 hp odd_one
  have hlocal (i j : Fin d) :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (p - 1),
          (B i j) ^ 2 * lambda j ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) * lambda i ^ k) =
        (B i j) ^ 2 * geomKernel (p - 1) (lambda i) (lambda j) := by
    unfold geomKernel
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
    ring
  have hsum :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (p - 1), ∑ i, ∑ j,
          (B i j) ^ 2 * lambda j ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) * lambda i ^ k) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j,
          (B i j) ^ 2 * geomKernel (p - 1) (lambda i) (lambda j) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    exact hlocal i j
  rw [hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (geomKernel_nonneg_of_odd hn _ _)

name: NLAlib.traceHessianKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem traceHessianKernel_nonneg {d p : ℕ} (hp : Even p)
    (C B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hC : C.transpose = C) (hB : B.transpose = B) :
    0 ≤ traceHessianKernel p C B
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp [traceHessianKernel]
  · rw [traceHessianKernel_eq_spectral C B hC hB]
    exact spectral_traceHessian_nonneg hp hp0 _ _

name: NLAlib.tracePowerSecondAlong_nonneg
statement:
theorem tracePowerSecondAlong_nonneg {d p : ℕ} (hp : Even p)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hA : A.transpose = A) (hB : B.transpose = B) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ tracePowerSecondAlong p A B t
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (A + t • B).transpose = A + t • B := by
    ext i j
    have ha := congrFun (congrFun hA i) j
    have hb := congrFun (congrFun hB i) j
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply] at ha hb ⊢
    rw [ha, hb]
  change 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) * traceHessianKernel p (A + t • B) B
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p)
    (traceHessianKernel_nonneg hp (A + t • B) B hC hB)

name: NLAlib.convexOn_tracePowerAlong
statement:
theorem convexOn_tracePowerAlong {d p : ℕ} (hp : Even p)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hA : A.transpose = A) (hB : B.transpose = B) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (tracePowerAlong p A B)
proof:
:= by
  let first : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    (p : ℝ) * Matrix.trace (B * (A + t • B) ^ (p - 1))
  let second : ℝ → ℝ := tracePowerSecondAlong p A B
  apply convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg (D := Set.univ)
    (f' := first) (f'' := second) convex_univ
  · intro t _
    exact (hasDerivAt_tracePowerAlong A B t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro t _
    exact (hasDerivAt_tracePowerAlong A B t).hasDerivWithinAt
  · intro t _
    exact (hasDerivAt_tracePowerFirst A B t).hasDerivWithinAt
  · intro t _
    exact tracePowerSecondAlong_nonneg hp A B hA hB t

name: NLAlib.convexOn_traceEvenPower
statement:
theorem convexOn_traceEvenPower (d q : ℕ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (traceEvenPower (d := d) q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro X _ Y _ a b ha hb hab
  let A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := X
  let B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Y
  have hA : A.transpose = A := X.property
  have hB : B.transpose = B := Y.property
  have hdir : (B - A).transpose = B - A := by
    ext i j
    have ha' := congrFun (congrFun hA i) j
    have hb' := congrFun (congrFun hB i) j
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.sub_apply] at ha' hb' ⊢
    rw [ha', hb']
  have hline := convexOn_tracePowerAlong (even_two_mul q) A (B - A) hA hdir
  have hineq := hline.2 (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ (1 : ℝ))
    ha hb hab
  have hend : A + (B - A) = B := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hcombo : A + b • (B - A) = a • A + b • B := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    calc
      A i j + b * (B i j - A i j) =
          (a + b) * A i j + b * (B i j - A i j) := by rw [hab]; ring
      _ = a * A i j + b * B i j := by ring
  simp only [tracePowerAlong, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add,
    zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero] at hineq
  rw [hend, hcombo] at hineq
  simpa only [traceEvenPower, Submodule.coe_add,
    Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, smul_eq_mul] using hineq

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν
      (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_of_diagonal_simple A H hA hH
  intro C hC b hb l u hlu hbu
  have heq (t : ℝ) : C + t • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) =
      C + (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) := by
    congr 1
  simpa only [heq] using
    exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_diagonal_of_injective hC b hb hlu hbu

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_with_derivatives
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_with_derivatives
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      IsCompactExpRepresentation ν (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H))
        (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H) ∧
      (ν : Measure ℝ).real Set.univ = traceExp A ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t =
          ∫ x, x ^ k * Real.exp (t * x) ∂(ν : Measure ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ Real.exp (t * lambdaMin H) *
          iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 ∧
        Real.exp (t * lambdaMin H) *
          iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 ≤
          iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t ∧
        iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t ≤
          Real.exp (t * lambdaMax H) *
            iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp A H hA hH
  refine ⟨ν, hν, ?_, hν.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hν.measureReal_univ_eq
  · intro r t ht
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hν.iteratedDeriv_even_nonneg r 0),
      hν.exp_mul_iteratedDeriv_even_zero_le r ht, hν.iteratedDeriv_even_le_exp_mul_zero r ht⟩

name: NLAlib.cfc_complex_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem cfc_complex_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (f : ℂ → ℂ)
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsStarNormal A) :
    cfc f ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * cfc f A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U
    symm
    change E (cfc f A) = cfc f (E A)
    exact StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc E f A (A.finite_spectrum.continuousOn f)
      E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional hA (hA.map E)

name: NLAlib.matrixComplexPower_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem matrixComplexPower_unitary_conj (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsStarNormal A) (z : ℂ) :
    matrixComplexPower ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) z =
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * matrixComplexPower A z * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:=
  cfc_complex_unitary_conj U _ A hA

name: NLAlib.cfc_diagonal_complex
statement:
theorem cfc_diagonal_complex (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x : n → ℂ) :
    cfc f (Matrix.diagonal x) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (x i))
proof:
:= by
  let := IsStarNormal.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := n → ℂ)
  have hx : IsStarNormal x := by infer_instance
  have hd : IsStarNormal (diagonalStarAlgHom x) := hx.map diagonalStarAlgHom
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℂ x) := by
    rw [Pi.spectrum_eq]
    have heq : (⋃ i, spectrum ℂ (x i)) = Set.range x := by
      change (⋃ i, spectrum ℂ (algebraMap ℂ ℂ (x i))) = _
      simp only [spectrum.scalar_eq, Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range]
    rw [heq]
    exact Set.Finite.continuousOn (Set.finite_range _) _
  have heq := diagonalStarAlgHom.map_cfc (p := IsStarNormal) (q := IsStarNormal) f x hc
    (by change Continuous (fun z : n → ℂ => Matrix.diagonal z); fun_prop) hx hd
  rw [cfc_map_pi (p := IsStarNormal) (q := fun _ => IsStarNormal) (S := ℂ) f x
    (by rwa [← Pi.spectrum_eq]) hx (fun _ => inferInstance)] at heq
  change Matrix.diagonal (fun i => cfc f (algebraMap ℂ ℂ (x i))) =
    cfc f (Matrix.diagonal x) at heq
  have hh (i : n) : cfc f (x i) = f (x i) := cfc_algebraMap (R := ℂ) (A := ℂ) (x i) f
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, hh] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: NLAlib.cfc_complex_eq_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem cfc_complex_eq_eigenbasis {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    cfc f A = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) *
        (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem]
  rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    cfc_complex_unitary_conj, cfc_diagonal_complex]
  · rfl
  · exact (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _
      (by ext i; simp)).isSelfAdjoint.isStarNormal

name: NLAlib.matrixComplexPower_eq_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem matrixComplexPower_eq_eigenbasis {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (z : ℂ) :
    matrixComplexPower A z = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ^ z) *
        (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:=
  cfc_complex_eq_eigenbasis hA _

name: NLAlib.add_ofReal_smul_one_eq_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem add_ofReal_smul_one_eq_eigenbasis {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ε : ℝ) :
    A + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((hA.eigenvalues i + ε : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((hA.eigenvalues i + ε : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) +
        (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hij]
  change A + (ε : ℂ) • 1 = E _
  rw [hd, map_add, map_smul, map_one]
  congr 1
  exact hA.spectral_theorem

name: NLAlib.matrixComplexPower_add_ofReal_smul_one
statement:
theorem matrixComplexPower_add_ofReal_smul_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ε : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    matrixComplexPower (A + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) z =
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((hA.eigenvalues i + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ z) *
          (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_ofReal_smul_one_eq_eigenbasis hA ε, matrixComplexPower_unitary_conj]
  · exact congrArg (fun X : Matrix n n ℂ =>
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * X *
        (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
      (cfc_diagonal_complex (fun w => w ^ z) _)
  · exact (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _
      (by ext i; simp)).isSelfAdjoint.isStarNormal

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_matrixComplexPower_add_ofReal_smul_one
statement:
theorem continuousAt_matrixComplexPower_add_ofReal_smul_one
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    ContinuousAt (fun ε : ℝ => matrixComplexPower
      (A + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) z) 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [matrixComplexPower_add_ofReal_smul_one hA]
  have hc : Continuous (fun ε : ℝ => fun i : n =>
      ((hA.eigenvalues i + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ z) := by
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal_cpow_const hz).comp (by fun_prop)
  apply ContinuousAt.mul
  · apply ContinuousAt.mul continuousAt_const
    exact ((Matrix.diagonalLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp hc).continuousAt
  · exact continuousAt_const

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_diagonal_complex
statement:
theorem matrixExp_diagonal_complex (x : n → ℂ) :
    matrixExp (Matrix.diagonal x) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Complex.exp (x i))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsStarNormal (Matrix.diagonal x) := by
    let := IsStarNormal.instContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := n → ℂ)
    exact (show IsStarNormal x from inferInstance).map diagonalStarAlgHom
  rw [matrixExp, ← CFC.complex_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hd, cfc_diagonal_complex]

name: NLAlib.matrixComplexPower_eq_matrixExp_smul_log
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : matrixLog A = (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (Real.log (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)) *
        (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    rw [matrixLog, hA.isHermitian.cfc_eq]
    rfl
  rw [matrixComplexPower_eq_eigenbasis hA.isHermitian, hlog]
  rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_smul_comm, matrixExp_unitary_conj,
    ← Matrix.diagonal_smul, matrixExp_diagonal_complex]
  apply congrArg (fun X : Matrix n n ℂ =>
    (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * X *
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
  apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
  funext i
  have hpos : 0 < hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := hA.eigenvalues_pos i
  rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hpos.ne'),
    ← Complex.ofReal_log hpos.le]
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.matrixComplexPower_ofReal_eq_rpow
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixComplexPower_eq_eigenbasis hA.isHermitian,
    show CFC.rpow A r = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ r) A from
      CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.nonneg, hA.isHermitian.cfc_eq]
  change _ = (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ
  apply congrArg (fun X : Matrix n n ℂ =>
    (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * X *
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
  apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
  funext i
  exact (Complex.ofReal_cpow (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) r).symm

name: NLAlib.posDef_add_ofReal_smul_one
statement:
theorem posDef_add_ofReal_smul_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (A + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).PosDef
proof:
:=
  Matrix.PosDef.posSemidef_add hA (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (by exact_mod_cast hε))

name: NLAlib.norm_matrixComplexPower_le_of_re_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_cfc_le (norm_nonneg A)
  intro w hw
  rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_eq_image_range] at hw
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hw
  let : Nonempty n := ⟨i⟩
  change ‖(hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ^ z‖ ≤ ‖A‖
  have hi : (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ A :=
    (spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff ℂ).mpr (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
  have h := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hi
  calc
    _ = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ z.re :=
      Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (by rw [hz]; norm_num)
    _ = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by rw [hz, Real.rpow_one]
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ := by simpa [abs_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)] using h

name: NLAlib.continuous_matrixComplexPower_right
statement:
theorem continuous_matrixComplexPower_right {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => matrixComplexPower A (1 + (t : ℂ) * I))
proof:
:= by
  have hc (i : n) : Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ^ (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro t
    have ht : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ =>
        (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i, 1 + (s : ℂ) * I)) t := by fun_prop
    have hfull := Complex.continuousAt_ofReal_cpow (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)
      (1 + (t : ℂ) * I) (Or.inl (by simp))
    have hcomp := ContinuousAt.comp
      (f := fun s : ℝ => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i, 1 + (s : ℂ) * I))
      (g := fun p : ℝ × ℂ => (p.1 : ℂ) ^ p.2) hfull ht
    exact hcomp
  simp_rw [matrixComplexPower_eq_eigenbasis hA.isHermitian]
  have hpi : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => fun i : n =>
      (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ^ (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) := continuous_pi hc
  exact (continuous_const.mul
    ((Matrix.diagonalLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp hpi)).mul
      continuous_const

name: Matrix.PosDef.frobSq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_det
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.frobSq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_det
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (eps : ℝ)
    (htr : RCLike.re A.trace = (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
    (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6) (hdet : Real.exp (-eps) ≤ RCLike.re A.det) :
    frobSq (A - 1) ≤ 6 * eps
proof:
:= by
  let eig : n → ℝ := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  have heig_pos : ∀ i, 0 < eig i := hA.eigenvalues_pos
  have htr_sum : ∑ i, eig i = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    have hre : RCLike.re A.trace = ∑ i, eig i := by
      rw [hA.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
      simp [eig]
    rwa [hre] at htr
  have hdet_prod : RCLike.re A.det = ∏ i, eig i := by
    rw [hA.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues, ← RCLike.ofReal_prod,
      RCLike.ofReal_re]
  have hscalar := Real.sum_sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_prod
    eig eps heig_pos htr_sum heps (hdet_prod ▸ hdet)
  have hsum : (∑ i, (eig i - 1) ^ 2) =
      (∑ i, eig i ^ 2) - 2 * (∑ i, eig i) + (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (∑ i, (eig i - 1) ^ 2) = ∑ i, (eig i ^ 2 - 2 * eig i + 1) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
      _ = (∑ i, eig i ^ 2) - 2 * (∑ i, eig i) + (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        simp
  have hA2 : frobSq A = ∑ i, eig i ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, hA.isHermitian.eq, ← pow_two]
    conv_lhs => rw [hA.isHermitian.spectral_theorem, ← map_pow]
    rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
      Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, one_mul, Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
    simp [eig]
  have htr1 : frobInner A (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.mul_one, hA.isHermitian.eq]
    exact htr
  have h1 : frobSq (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [frobNorm_sq] using (frobNorm_one_sq (n := n) (𝕜 := 𝕜))
  calc
    frobSq (A - 1) = (∑ i, eig i ^ 2) -
        2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
      rw [frobSq_sub, hA2, htr1, h1]
    _ = ∑ i, (eig i - 1) ^ 2 := by rw [hsum, htr_sum]
    _ ≤ 6 * eps := hscalar

name: NLAlib.polarSchulzDefect_step
statement:
theorem polarSchulzDefect_step (X : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzStep X) =
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) • (polarSchulzDefect X ^ 2 * ((3 : ℝ) • 1 + polarSchulzDefect X))
proof:
:= by
  let S := Xᴴ * X
  let L := (3 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - S
  have hS : Sᴴ = S := by simp [S]
  have hL : Lᴴ = L := by simp [L, hS]
  have hG : (polarSchulzStep X)ᴴ * polarSchulzStep X = (1 / 4 : ℝ) • (L * S * L) := by
    change ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X * L))ᴴ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X * L)) = _
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hL,
      star_trivial, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
    norm_num only [show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2) = 1 / 4 by norm_num]
    simp only [S, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [polarSchulzDefect, hG]
  calc
    _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ((4 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - L * S * L) := by module
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      dsimp only [L, S, polarSchulzDefect]
      noncomm_ring
      module

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.polarSchulzDefect_eq
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.polarSchulzDefect_eq {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ} (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ)
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (k : ℕ) :
    polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A k) =
      thinSingularMatrix V V (fun i => 1 - polarSchulzScalar (σ i) k ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hI : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = thinSingularMatrix V V (fun _ => 1) := by
    simp only [thinSingularMatrix, RCLike.ofReal_one, Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one]
    exact (h.right_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one_of_rank_eq_card hRank).symm
  rw [polarSchulzDefect, h.polarSchulzIterate_eq, thinSingularMatrix_gram U V h.left_orth,
    hI, thinSingularMatrix_sub]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polarSchulzDefect_eq {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ} (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ)
    (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n) (k : ℕ) :
    specNorm (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A k)) =
      ‖fun i => 1 - polarSchulzScalar (σ i) k ^ 2‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank, specNorm_thinSingularMatrix V V h.right_orth h.right_orth]

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.polarSchulzDefect_posSemidef_and_sub_posDef
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.polarSchulzDefect_posSemidef_and_sub_posDef
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (h : IsThinSVD A U V σ) (hRank : A.rank = Fintype.card n)
    (hA : specNorm A < Real.sqrt 3) (k : ℕ) :
    (polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))).PosSemidef ∧
      (1 - polarSchulzDefect (polarSchulzIterate A (k + 1))).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [h.polarSchulzDefect_eq hRank]
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
    apply Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr
    intro i
    change (0 : ℂ) ≤ ((1 - polarSchulzScalar (σ i) (k + 1) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
