    exact_mod_cast (polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem (h.pos i)
      (h.sq_lt_three_of_specNorm_lt_sqrt_three hA i) k).1
  · simp only [polarSchulzDefect, sub_sub_cancel]
    apply (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr
    apply isUnit_gram_of_rank_eq_card
    rw [h.rank_polarSchulzIterate hA, hRank]

name: NLAlib.loewnerMatrix_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem loewnerMatrix_apply_self {ι : Type*} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (nodes : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : loewnerMatrix f nodes i i = deriv f (nodes i)
proof:
:=
  dslope_same _ _

name: NLAlib.loewnerMatrix_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem loewnerMatrix_apply_of_ne {ι : Type*} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (nodes : ι → ℝ)
    (i j : ι) (h : nodes i ≠ nodes j) :
    loewnerMatrix f nodes i j = (f (nodes i) - f (nodes j)) / (nodes i - nodes j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [loewnerMatrix, dslope_of_ne f (Ne.symm h)]
  simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.dslope_swap
statement: theorem dslope_swap (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x y : ℝ) : dslope f x y = dslope f y x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x = y
  · subst y; rfl
  rw [dslope_of_ne f (Ne.symm h), dslope_of_ne f h]
  simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.loewnerMatrix_isSymm
statement:
theorem loewnerMatrix_isSymm {ι : Type*} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (nodes : ι → ℝ) :
    (loewnerMatrix f nodes).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact dslope_swap f _ _

name: NLAlib.dslope_polynomial_eq_eval_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem dslope_polynomial_eq_eval_dividedDifference (p : Polynomial ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
    dslope (fun t => p.eval t) x y = (p.dividedDifference x).eval y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : y = x
  · subst y
    rw [dslope_same, Polynomial.eval_dividedDifference_self]
    exact p.deriv
  rw [dslope_of_ne _ h, Polynomial.eval_dividedDifference_of_ne p h]
  simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.singularValueTransform_eq
statement:
theorem IsSVD.singularValueTransform_eq {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V)
    {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : φ 0 = 0) :
    singularValueTransform φ A =
      U * (rectDiag (fun i => φ (singularValues A i)) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [singularValueTransform, h.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    cfc_isometric_conj V h.conjTranspose_mul_right h.mul_conjTranspose_right _ _
      (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext; simp)), cfc_diagonal_ofReal]
  conv_lhs => lhs; rw [h.eq]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V, h.conjTranspose_mul_right, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hd : (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin q =>
        ((φ (Real.sqrt (singularValues A j ^ 2)) /
          Real.sqrt (singularValues A j ^ 2) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) =
      rectDiag (fun i => φ (singularValues A i)) := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    simp only [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Real.sqrt_sq (singularValues_nonneg A _)]
    split_ifs with hij
    · rw [hij]
      rw [← RCLike.ofReal_mul]
      congr 1
      by_cases hz : singularValues A j = 0
      · simp [hz, hφ]
      · field_simp
    · simp
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun M => U * M * Vᴴ) hd

name: NLAlib.singularValueTransform_unitary_mul
statement:
theorem singularValueTransform_unitary_mul (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (U : Matrix m m 𝕜) (V : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    singularValueTransform φ (U * A * Vᴴ) = U * singularValueTransform φ A * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hGram : (U * A * Vᴴ)ᴴ * (U * A * Vᴴ) = V * (Aᴴ * A) * Vᴴ := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [singularValueTransform, hGram,
    cfc_isometric_conj V hV (mul_eq_one_comm.mp hV.conjTranspose_mul_self) _ _
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A), singularValueTransform]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V, hV.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_singularValueTransform
statement:
theorem singularValues_singularValueTransform (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {φ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hφ : φ 0 = 0) (hφ0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ φ s)
    (hφmono : MonotoneOn φ (Set.Ici 0)) (i : ℕ) :
    singularValues (singularValueTransform φ A) i = φ (singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  by_cases hi : i < min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
  · exact singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul h.conjTranspose_mul_left
      h.conjTranspose_mul_right (fun j => hφ0 _ (singularValues_nonneg A j))
      (fun j k hjk => hφmono (singularValues_nonneg A k) (singularValues_nonneg A j)
        (singularValues_antitone A hjk)) (h.singularValueTransform_eq hφ) hi
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le _ (not_lt.mp hi),
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (not_lt.mp hi), hφ]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.singularValueSoftThreshold_eq
statement:
theorem IsSVD.singularValueSoftThreshold_eq {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    singularValueSoftThreshold τ A =
      U * (rectDiag (fun i => max (singularValues A i - τ) 0) :
        Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) 𝕜) * Vᴴ
proof:
:= by
  exact h.singularValueTransform_eq (max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hτ))

name: NLAlib.singularValues_singularValueSoftThreshold
statement:
theorem singularValues_singularValueSoftThreshold (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (i : ℕ) :
    singularValues (singularValueSoftThreshold τ A) i = max (singularValues A i - τ) 0
proof:
:= by
  exact singularValues_singularValueTransform A (φ := fun s => max (s - τ) 0)
    (max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hτ))
    (fun s _ => le_max_right _ _) (fun a _ b _ hab => max_le_max (sub_le_sub_right hab τ) le_rfl) i

name: NLAlib.singularValueSoftThreshold_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem singularValueSoftThreshold_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    singularValueSoftThreshold 0 A = A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  rw [h.singularValueSoftThreshold_eq le_rfl]
  simpa only [sub_zero, max_eq_left (singularValues_nonneg A _)] using h.eq.symm

name: Matrix.PosDef.exists_isUnit_whitening
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_whitening
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    {K : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hK : K.PosDef) :
    ∃ S : Matrix d d 𝕜, IsUnit S ∧ S * K * Sᴴ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := cfc (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹) K
  let T := cfc Real.sqrt K
  have hST : S * T = 1 := NLAlib.cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hK
  have hTS : T * S = 1 := NLAlib.cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hK
  have hS : IsUnit S := ⟨⟨S, T, hST, hTS⟩, rfl⟩
  have hSherm : S.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  exact ⟨S, hS, by rw [hSherm.eq]; exact NLAlib.cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hK⟩

name: NLAlib.matrixKStableInverse_potential_eq_logarithmicPotential
statement:
theorem matrixKStableInverse_potential_eq_logarithmicPotential
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hFa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z) = z • 1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hmass : μ.mass = 1)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → normalizedTrace (α • F z) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : u < sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support) :
    matrixKPotential ν α u (matrixKStableInverse ν α ((u : ℂ) • 1)) /
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) = logarithmicPotential (μ : Measure ℝ) u
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ : Measure ℝ) := ⟨by
    rw [← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass, hmass]; rfl⟩
  let a := sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support
  have ha : ∀ t ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support, a ≤ t := fun t ht => csInf_le hcompact.bddBelow ht
  let S : ℝ → M := fun v => matrixKStableInverse ν α ((v : ℂ) • 1)
  have hsol (v : ℝ) (hv : v < a) : S v ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (S v) = (v : ℂ) • 1 := by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hKQ⟩ := exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
      ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hmass hcompact hμ v (fun t ht => lt_of_lt_of_le hv (ha t ht))
    exact matrixKStableInverse_mem_and_transform_eq ν α ⟨Q, hQ, hKQ⟩
  have hn := tendsto_matrixKPotential_scalar_solution_sub_log ν hν α hα S
    ((eventually_lt_atBot a).mono fun v hv => hsol v hv)
  have hd (v : ℝ) (hv : v < a) :=
    hasDerivAt_matrixKStableInverse_potential_below_trace_support
      ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hmass hcompact hμ v (fun t ht => lt_of_lt_of_le hv (ha t ht))
  exact eqOn_logarithmicPotential_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto (μ : Measure ℝ) hcompact a ha
    (fun v => matrixKPotential ν α v (S v) / Fintype.card n) hd hn hu

name: NLAlib.exists_matrixKTransform_law_variational_logarithmicPotential
statement:
theorem exists_matrixKTransform_law_variational_logarithmicPotential
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (F z) = z • 1) ∧
      ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass = 1 ∧ IsCompact (μ : Measure ℝ).support ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → normalizedTrace (α • F z) =
          ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) ∧
        ∀ u < sInf (μ : Measure ℝ).support, ∃ S : M,
          S ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α ∧ matrixKTransform ν α S = (u : ℂ) • 1 ∧
          logarithmicPotential (μ : Measure ℝ) u = matrixKPotential ν α u S / Fintype.card n ∧
          (∀ Q ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α, matrixKPotential ν α u S ≤ matrixKPotential ν α u Q) ∧
          ∀ T ∈ ν.support, 0 < (1 + T.val * S).det
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hFa, hF, μ, hμ, _huniq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_compact_stieltjes_probability_measure ν hν α hα
  refine ⟨F, hFa, hF, μ, hμ.1, hμ.2.1, hμ.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hKS⟩ := exists_stable_matrixKTransform_scalar_solution_below_trace_support
    ν hν α hα F hFa hF μ hμ.1 hμ.2.1 hμ.2.2 u
      (fun t ht => lt_of_lt_of_le hu (csInf_le hμ.2.1.bddBelow ht))
  refine ⟨S, hS, hKS, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have he := matrixKStableInverse_potential_eq_logarithmicPotential ν hν α hα
      F hFa hF μ hμ.1 hμ.2.1 hμ.2.2 u hu
    rw [← hKS, matrixKStableInverse_matrixKTransform ν hν α hα S hS] at he
    exact he.symm
  · exact fun Q hQ => matrixKPotential_le_of_stable_scalar_solution ν hν α hα u S hS hKS Q hQ
  · exact fun T hT => det_one_add_mul_pos_of_matrixK_admissible S T.val hS.1 (hS.2.1 T hT)

name: Matrix.PosDef.detNormalizeScaling_pos
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.detNormalizeScaling_pos {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef) :
    0 < detNormalizeScaling X
proof:
:= by
  unfold detNormalizeScaling
  exact inv_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).1 _)

name: NLAlib.det_normalize_scaling_pow_card
proof:
:= by
  have hre_pos : 0 < X.det.re := (Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).1
  have hN_ne : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  unfold detNormalizeScaling
  rw [inv_pow]
  congr 1
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul hre_pos.le]
  rw [one_div_mul_cancel hN_ne, Real.rpow_one]

name: Matrix.PosDef.det_smul_detNormalizeScaling_eq_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.det_smul_detNormalizeScaling_eq_one {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    (detNormalizeScaling X • X).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hre_pos : 0 < X.det.re := (Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).1
  have hpow_card : detNormalizeScaling X ^ Fintype.card n = (X.det.re)⁻¹ :=
    det_normalize_scaling_pow_card X hX hN
  have hre_smul (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : (r • z).re = r * z.re := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Complex.re_ofReal_mul r z
  have him_smul (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : (r • z).im = r * z.im := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Complex.im_ofReal_mul r z
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Matrix.det_smul_of_tower, hpow_card, hre_smul]
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hre_pos)]
    rfl
  · rw [Matrix.det_smul_of_tower, hpow_card, him_smul]
    rw [(Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).2.symm]
    simp

name: Matrix.PosDef.exists_det_eq_one_re_det_map_eq_div
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.exists_det_eq_one_re_det_map_eq_div {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ Y, Y.PosDef ∧ Y.det = 1 ∧ (T Y).det.re = (T X).det.re / X.det.re
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨detNormalizeScaling X • X, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hX.smul (hX.detNormalizeScaling_pos)
  · exact hX.det_smul_detNormalizeScaling_eq_one hN
  · have hpow_card : detNormalizeScaling X ^ Fintype.card n = (X.det.re)⁻¹ :=
      det_normalize_scaling_pow_card X hX hN
    have hre_smul (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : (r • z).re = r * z.re := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def]
      exact Complex.re_ofReal_mul r z
    rw [T.map_smul]
    rw [Matrix.det_smul_of_tower]
    rw [hpow_card, hre_smul]
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.detRatio_attainable_sets_eq
statement:
theorem detRatio_attainable_sets_eq (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re} =
      {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ d = (T X).det.re / X.det.re}
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hXdet, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨X, hX, ?_⟩
    have hXdet_re : X.det.re = 1 := by rw [hXdet]; simp
    rw [hXdet_re]
    simp
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hd⟩
    rcases hX.exists_det_eq_one_re_det_map_eq_div hN T with ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, hYT⟩
    refine ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, ?_⟩
    rw [hd, hYT]

name: NLAlib.detRatio_normalized_sInf_eq
statement:
theorem detRatio_normalized_sInf_eq (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    sInf {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re} =
      sInf {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ d = (T X).det.re / X.det.re}
proof:
:= by
  rw [detRatio_attainable_sets_eq hN T]

name: NLAlib.monomialBlockDifference_succ
statement:
theorem monomialBlockDifference_succ (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (H : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    monomialBlockDifference A B H (k + 1) =
      A ^ k * H + monomialBlockDifference A B H k * B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomialBlockDifference, Nat.pred_succ]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', add_comm]
  simp only [tsub_zero, pow_zero, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.sum_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have he : k - (j + 1) = k.pred - j := by
    simp [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.add_comm]
  rw [he, pow_succ]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.upperBlockTwo_pow
statement:
theorem upperBlockTwo_pow (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (H : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    upperBlockTwo A H B ^ k =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (A ^ k) (monomialBlockDifference A B H k) 0 (B ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [upperBlockTwo, monomialBlockDifference, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  | succ k hk =>
    rw [pow_succ, hk, upperBlockTwo, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, ← pow_succ,
      monomialBlockDifference_succ]

name: NLAlib.aeval_upperBlockTwo
statement:
theorem aeval_upperBlockTwo (p : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (H : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    aeval (upperBlockTwo A H B) p =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (aeval A p) (polynomialBlockDifference p A B H) 0 (aeval B p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [aeval_eq_sum_range, upperBlockTwo_pow, polynomialBlockDifference]
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]

name: NLAlib.polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo
statement:
theorem polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo (p : 𝕜[X])
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (H : Matrix n o 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) :
    polynomialBlockDifference p (upperBlockTwo A G B) C (Matrix.fromRows 0 H) =
      Matrix.fromRows (polynomialSecondBlockDifference p A B C G H)
        (polynomialBlockDifference p B C H)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialBlockDifference, monomialBlockDifference, upperBlockTwo_pow,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_mul_fromRows, Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add,
    Matrix.fromRows_mul]
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;>
    simp only [polynomialSecondBlockDifference, monomialBlockDifference,
      Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.fromRows_apply_inl,
      Matrix.fromRows_apply_inr, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.aeval_upperBlockThree
statement:
theorem aeval_upperBlockThree (p : 𝕜[X])
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (H : Matrix n o 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) :
    aeval (upperBlockThree A G B H C) p =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (aeval A p) (polynomialBlockDifference p A B G) 0 (aeval B p))
        (Matrix.fromRows (polynomialSecondBlockDifference p A B C G H)
          (polynomialBlockDifference p B C H)) 0 (aeval C p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [upperBlockThree, aeval_upperBlockTwo, polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_mul_mul_conjTranspose_le
statement:
private theorem norm_sum_mul_mul_conjTranspose_le
    (G : M) (S Z U : ι → M) (α c R : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (hG : ‖G‖ ≤ c)
    (hS : ∀ i, ‖S i‖ ≤ c) (hU : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ ≤ R)
    (heq : ∀ i, S i = G - α • (G * Z i * S i)) :
    ‖∑ i, (S i * U i) * (S i * U i)ᴴ‖ ≤
      2 * c ^ 2 * ‖∑ i, U i * (U i)ᴴ‖ +
        2 * α ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * ‖∑ i, Z i * (Z i)ᴴ‖
proof:
:= by
  let X : M := ∑ i, U i * (U i)ᴴ
  let Y : M := ∑ i, Z i * (Z i)ᴴ
  let E : ι → M := fun i => S i * U i
  have hE (i : ι) : E i * (E i)ᴴ ≤ (c * R) ^ 2 • (1 : M) := by
    have hn : ‖E i‖ ≤ c * R := (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
      (mul_le_mul (hS i) (hU i) (norm_nonneg _) hc)
    have h := CStarAlgebra.mul_star_le_algebraMap_norm_sq (a := E i)
    refine h.trans ?_
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn 2)
        (show (0 : M) ≤ 1 from zero_le_one)
  have hterm (i : ι) :
      (E i) * (E i)ᴴ ≤
        (2 : ℝ) • (G * (U i * (U i)ᴴ) * Gᴴ) +
        (2 * α ^ 2 * (c * R) ^ 2) • (G * (Z i * (Z i)ᴴ) * Gᴴ) := by
    have he : E i = G * U i + (-α) • (G * Z i * E i) := by
      dsimp [E]
      nth_rw 1 [heq i]
      simp only [add_mul, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul, mul_assoc]
    have h := CStarAlgebra.add_mul_star_add_le (G * U i) ((-α) • (G * Z i * E i))
    rw [← he] at h
    change E i * (E i)ᴴ ≤ (2 : ℝ) • ((G * U i) * (G * U i)ᴴ) +
      (2 : ℝ) • (((-α) • (G * Z i * E i)) * ((-α) • (G * Z i * E i))ᴴ) at h
    have horder := star_right_conjugate_le_conjugate (hE i) (G * Z i)
    have hscaled := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left horder (show 0 ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 by positivity)
    have heq1 : (G * U i) * (G * U i)ᴴ = G * (U i * (U i)ᴴ) * Gᴴ := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, mul_assoc]
    have heq2 : (2 : ℝ) • (((-α) • (G * Z i * E i)) *
        ((-α) • (G * Z i * E i))ᴴ) =
        (2 * α ^ 2) • ((G * Z i) * (E i * (E i)ᴴ) * (G * Z i)ᴴ) := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_trivial,
        smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
      congr 1 <;> noncomm_ring
    rw [heq1, heq2] at h
    refine h.trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_smul, mul_assoc] using hscaled
  have hsum : (∑ i, E i * (E i)ᴴ) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) • (G * X * Gᴴ) +
        (2 * α ^ 2 * (c * R) ^ 2) • (G * Y * Gᴴ) := by
    convert Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hterm i) using 1
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum,
        ← Matrix.mul_sum, ← Matrix.sum_mul, X, Y]
  have hnorm := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_star_self_nonneg (E i)) hsum
  have hsand (A : M) : ‖G * A * Gᴴ‖ ≤ c ^ 2 * ‖A‖ := by
    have h := (norm_mul_le (G * A) Gᴴ).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le G A) (norm_nonneg Gᴴ))
    rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at h
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖G‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖G‖ := h
      _ = ‖G‖ ^ 2 * ‖A‖ := by ring
      _ ≤ c ^ 2 * ‖A‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg G) hG 2) (norm_nonneg A)
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(2 : ℝ) • (G * X * Gᴴ) +
        (2 * α ^ 2 * (c * R) ^ 2) • (G * Y * Gᴴ)‖ := hnorm
    _ ≤ 2 * ‖G * X * Gᴴ‖ +
        (2 * α ^ 2 * (c * R) ^ 2) * ‖G * Y * Gᴴ‖ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖(2 : ℝ) • (G * X * Gᴴ)‖ +
            ‖(2 * α ^ 2 * (c * R) ^ 2) • (G * Y * Gᴴ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [norm_smul_of_nonneg (by positivity), norm_smul_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    _ ≤ 2 * (c ^ 2 * ‖X‖) +
        (2 * α ^ 2 * (c * R) ^ 2) * (c ^ 2 * ‖Y‖) := by
      gcongr <;> exact hsand _
    _ = _ := by dsimp [X, Y]; ring

name: NLAlib.resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_mul_resolvent
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_mul_resolvent (A Z : M) (α : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hZ : Z.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resolvent (A - α • Z) ζ = resolvent A ζ -
      α • (resolvent A ζ * Z * resolvent (A - α • Z) ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := hA.sub (hZ.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial α)))
  have h := Matrix.inv_sub_inv (A := ζ • (1 : M) - A)
    (B := ζ • (1 : M) - (A - α • Z))
    ⟨fun _ => hB.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ,
      fun _ => hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ⟩
  have he : (ζ • (1 : M) - (A - α • Z)) - (ζ • (1 : M) - A) = α • Z := by abel
  rw [he, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    ← resolvent_matrix_eq_inv, ← resolvent_matrix_eq_inv] at h
  apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
  simpa only [add_comm] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h).symm

name: NLAlib.resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_resolvent_mul
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_resolvent_mul (A Z : M) (α : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hZ : Z.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resolvent (A - α • Z) ζ = resolvent A ζ -
      α • (resolvent (A - α • Z) ζ * Z * resolvent A ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := hA.sub (hZ.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial α)))
  have h := Matrix.inv_sub_inv (A := ζ • (1 : M) - (A - α • Z))
    (B := ζ • (1 : M) - A)
    ⟨fun _ => hA.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ,
      fun _ => hB.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ⟩
  have he : (ζ • (1 : M) - A) - (ζ • (1 : M) - (A - α • Z)) = (-α) • Z := by
    simp only [neg_smul]
    abel
  rw [he, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    ← resolvent_matrix_eq_inv, ← resolvent_matrix_eq_inv, neg_smul] at h
  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h |>.trans (by abel)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_resolvent_mul_mul_resolvent_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_resolvent_mul_mul_resolvent_le
    (A : M) (Z T U B W : ι → M) (α β R b : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hZ : ∀ i, (Z i).IsHermitian)
    (hT : ∀ i, (T i).IsHermitian) (hU : ∀ i, (U i).IsHermitian)
    (hW : ∀ i, (W i).IsHermitian) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hUnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (U i) ≤ R) (hBnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (B i) ≤ b)
    (hWnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (W i) ≤ R) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm (∑ i, resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ * U i * B i * W i *
      resolvent (A - β • T i) ζ) ≤
      b * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, W i ^ 2)) +
        b * R ^ 2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 *
          (α ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, Z i ^ 2) + β ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, T i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := |ζ.im|⁻¹
  let G : M := resolvent A ζ
  let S : ι → M := fun i => resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ
  let Q : ι → M := fun i => resolvent (A - β • T i) ζ
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)
  have hG : ‖G‖ ≤ c := hA.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hS (i : ι) : ‖S i‖ ≤ c :=
    (hA.sub ((hZ i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial α)))).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hQ (i : ι) : ‖Q i‖ ≤ c :=
    (hA.sub ((hT i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial β)))).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hleft := norm_sum_mul_mul_conjTranspose_le G S Z U α c R hc hR hG hS hUnorm
    (fun i => resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_mul_resolvent A (Z i) α ζ hA (hZ i) hζ)
  have hright := norm_sum_mul_mul_conjTranspose_le Gᴴ (fun i => (Q i)ᴴ) T W β c R
    hc hR (by simpa only [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] using hG)
    (fun i => by simpa only [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] using hQ i)
    hWnorm (fun i => by
      have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose
        (resolvent_sub_smul_eq_sub_resolvent_mul A (T i) β ζ hA (hT i) hζ)
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_trivial,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hT i).eq, Matrix.mul_assoc] using h)
  have hsquares (F : ι → M) (hF : ∀ i, (F i).IsHermitian) :
      (∑ i, F i * (F i)ᴴ) = ∑ i, F i ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [(hF i).eq, pow_two]
  rw [hsquares U hU, hsquares Z hZ] at hleft
  rw [hsquares W hW, hsquares T hT] at hright
  have hright' : ‖∑ i, (W i * Q i)ᴴ * (W i * Q i)‖ ≤
      2 * c ^ 2 * ‖∑ i, W i ^ 2‖ +
        2 * β ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * ‖∑ i, T i ^ 2‖ := by
    convert hright using 1
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      (hW i).eq, mul_assoc]
  have he : (∑ i, resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ * U i * B i * W i *
      resolvent (A - β • T i) ζ) = ∑ i, (S i * U i) * B i * (W i * Q i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    dsimp [S, Q]
    noncomm_ring
  rw [he, specNorm_eq_norm]
  calc
    _ ≤ b / 2 * (‖∑ i, (S i * U i) * (S i * U i)ᴴ‖ +
        ‖∑ i, (W i * Q i)ᴴ * (W i * Q i)‖) :=
      CStarAlgebra.norm_sum_mul_mul_le (A := M) (ι := ι)
        (fun i => S i * U i) B (fun i => W i * Q i) hb hBnorm
    _ ≤ b / 2 * ((2 * c ^ 2 * ‖∑ i, U i ^ 2‖ +
        2 * α ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * ‖∑ i, Z i ^ 2‖) +
        (2 * c ^ 2 * ‖∑ i, W i ^ 2‖ +
        2 * β ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * c ^ 4 * ‖∑ i, T i ^ 2‖)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hleft hright') (div_nonneg hb (by norm_num))
    _ = _ := by simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]; dsimp [c]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_resolvent_cubic_word_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_resolvent_cubic_word_le
    (A : M) (Z U V W : ι → M) (α R : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hZ : ∀ i, (Z i).IsHermitian)
    (hU : ∀ i, (U i).IsHermitian) (hW : ∀ i, (W i).IsHermitian)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hUnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (U i) ≤ R)
    (hVnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (V i) ≤ R) (hWnorm : ∀ i, specNorm (W i) ≤ R)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ.im) :
    let S : ι → M
proof:
:= fun i => resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ
    specNorm (∑ i, S i * U i * S i * V i * S i * W i * S i) ≤
      R / ζ.im ^ 4 * (specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, W i ^ 2)) +
        2 * α ^ 2 * R ^ 3 / ζ.im ^ 6 * specNorm (∑ i, Z i ^ 2) := by
  let S : ι → M := fun i => resolvent (A - α • Z i) ζ
  have hS (i : ι) : specNorm (S i) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (hA.sub ((hZ i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial α)))).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ.ne'
  have hb : ∀ i, specNorm (S i * V i * S i) ≤ R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    calc
      _ ≤ (specNorm (S i) * specNorm (V i)) * specNorm (S i) :=
        (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹ * R) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
        gcongr <;> first | exact specNorm_nonneg _ | exact hS i | exact hVnorm i
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h := specNorm_sum_resolvent_mul_mul_resolvent_le A Z Z U
    (fun i => S i * V i * S i) W α α R (R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2) ζ
    hA hZ hZ hU hW hR (by positivity) hUnorm hb hWnorm hζ.ne'
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, abs_of_pos hζ] at h ⊢
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_variational_trace
statement:
theorem NLAlib.isGreatest_variational_trace {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hM : M.PosDef) :
    IsGreatest {r : ℝ | ∃ T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
      T.PosDef ∧ r = (Matrix.trace (T * matrixLog M - T * matrixLog T + T)).re}
      (Matrix.trace M).re
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨M, hM, by simp⟩
  · rintro r ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    have h := relativeEntropy_nonneg T M hT hM
    simp only [relativeEntropy_complex, mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, Complex.sub_re] at h
    simp only [Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re]
    linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_rpow_of_reciprocal
statement:
private theorem norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_rpow_of_reciprocal
    {p s t w : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hst : Real.HolderConjugate s t)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.re = 1 / s) :
    ‖schattenDualTestCoefficient (1 / p) 1 w z‖ ^ t = w ^ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos hwpos, hz, ← Real.rpow_mul hw]
    congr 1
    have hst' := hst.sub_one_mul_conj
    field_simp [hp.ne', hst.ne_zero]
    nlinarith
  · have hwzero : w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    simp [schattenDualTestCoefficient, Real.zero_rpow hst.symm.ne_zero,
      Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_schattenDualTestMatrix_eq_one_of_reciprocal
statement:
private theorem schattenNormReal_schattenDualTestMatrix_eq_one_of_reciprocal
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    {p s t : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hst : Real.HolderConjugate s t)
    {w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hpower : ∑ i, w i ^ p = 1) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.re = 1 / s) :
    schattenNormReal (schattenDualTestMatrix U V (1 / p) 1 w z) t = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenDualTestMatrix, schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose hV hU,
    schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
  simp_rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_rpow_of_reciprocal hp hst (hw _) hz]
  rw [hpower, Real.one_rpow]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_rpow_mul_rpow_of_finite_boundary_bounds
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_le_rpow_mul_rpow_of_finite_boundary_bounds
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {θ p₀ p₁ p M₀ M₁ B : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hp₀ : 1 < p₀) (hp₁ : 1 < p₁) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / p₀ + θ / p₁)
    {G : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hG : DiffContOnCl ℂ G (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, specNorm (G z) ≤ B)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ, schattenNormReal (G ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) p₀ ≤ M₀)
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ, schattenNormReal (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) p₁ ≤ M₁) :
    schattenNormReal (G (θ : ℂ)) p ≤ M₀ ^ (1 - θ) * M₁ ^ θ
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := zero_lt_one.trans hp
  by_cases hA : G (θ : ℂ) = 0
  · rw [hA, schattenNormReal_zero hp0]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (Real.rpow_nonneg ((schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _).trans (hleft 0)) _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg ((schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _).trans (hright 0)) _)
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD (G (θ : ℂ))
  let w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ := fun i =>
    singularValues (G (θ : ℂ)) i / schattenNormReal (G (θ : ℂ)) p
  let a : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (1 - z) / (p₀ : ℂ) + z / (p₁ : ℂ)
  let T : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun z => schattenDualTestMatrix U V (1 / p) 1 w (a z)
  have hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := fun i =>
    singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_mem_Icc _ hp0 hA i
  have hpower : ∑ i, w i ^ p = 1 := by
    change (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n),
      (singularValues (G (θ : ℂ)) i / schattenNormReal (G (θ : ℂ)) p) ^ p) = 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i =>
      (singularValues (G (θ : ℂ)) i / schattenNormReal (G (θ : ℂ)) p) ^ p)]
    simpa only [min_self] using
      sum_singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_one (G (θ : ℂ)) hp0 hA
  have ha : Differentiable ℂ a := by dsimp [a]; fun_prop
  have hTdiff : Differentiable ℂ T :=
    (differentiable_schattenDualTestMatrix U V (1 / p) 1 w).comp ha
  have hare (z : ℂ) : (a z).re = (1 - z.re) / p₀ + z.re / p₁ := by
    dsimp [a]
    simp [Complex.div_re]
    field_simp [(zero_lt_one.trans hp₀).ne', (zero_lt_one.trans hp₁).ne']
  have hTnorm {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1) :
      specNorm (T z) ≤ 1 := by
    apply specNorm_schattenDualTestMatrix_le_one hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right (one_div_pos.mpr hp0) (by norm_num) hw
    rw [hare]
    have h₀ : 1 / p₀ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (zero_lt_one.trans hp₀)).mpr hp₀.le
    have h₁ : 1 / p₁ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (zero_lt_one.trans hp₁)).mpr hp₁.le
    have hh₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr hz.2)
    have hh₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ hz.1
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_one] at *
    nlinarith
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (T z * G z).trace
  let L := (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact L.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn
        (hTdiff.differentiableOn.mul hG.differentiableOn)
    · exact L.continuous.comp_continuousOn
        (hTdiff.continuous.continuousOn.mul hG.continuousOn)
  have hbounded : BddAbove ((norm ∘ g) ''
      Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1) := by
    refine ⟨(Fintype.card n : ℝ) * B, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hTnuclear : nuclearNorm (T z) ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
      have h := schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm (T z) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      simp only [schattenNormReal_one, one_div_one, Real.rpow_one] at h
      calc
        nuclearNorm (T z) ≤ ((T z).rank : ℝ) * specNorm (T z) := h
        _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul (by exact_mod_cast Matrix.rank_le_card_width (T z)) (hTnorm hz)
            (specNorm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    calc
      ‖g z‖ ≤ nuclearNorm (T z) * specNorm (G z) := by
        simpa only [schattenNorm_one, schattenNorm_top] using
          norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex (T z) (G z) (p := 1) (q := ∞)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hTnuclear (hbound z hz) (specNorm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hboundary {s M : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) {z : ℂ}
      (hz : (a z).re = 1 / s) (hGs : schattenNormReal (G z) s ≤ M) : ‖g z‖ ≤ M := by
    have hst := Real.HolderConjugate.conjExponent hs
    have hT := schattenNormReal_schattenDualTestMatrix_eq_one_of_reciprocal
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right hp0 hst
      (fun i => (hw i).1) hpower hz
    have hh := norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex (T z) (G z) hst.symm
    change schattenNormReal (T z) s.conjExponent = 1 at hT
    rw [hT, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh.trans hGs
  have hgl : ∀ z ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' {(0 : ℝ)}, ‖g z‖ ≤ M₀ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz0 : z.re = 0 := hz
    have heq : z = (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hz0]
    apply hboundary hp₀
    · rw [hare, hz0]; simp
    · simpa only [← heq] using hleft z.im
  have hgr : ∀ z ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' {(1 : ℝ)}, ‖g z‖ ≤ M₁ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz1 : z.re = 1 := hz
    have heq : z = 1 + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hz1]
    apply hboundary hp₁
    · rw [hare, hz1]; simp
    · simpa only [← heq] using hright z.im
  have hacenter : a (θ : ℂ) = ((1 / p : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact_mod_cast hexp.symm
  have hcenter : ‖g (θ : ℂ)‖ = schattenNormReal (G (θ : ℂ)) p := by
    have hh := hSVD.trace_schattenDualTestMatrix_center_mul (r := 1 / p) (p := 1)
      (one_div_pos.mpr hp0) ((div_lt_one hp0).mpr hp) hA
    simp only [one_div_one_div] at hh
    change (schattenDualTestMatrix U V (1 / p) 1 w ((1 / p : ℝ) : ℂ) * G (θ : ℂ)).trace = _ at hh
    change ‖(T (θ : ℂ) * G (θ : ℂ)).trace‖ = _
    rw [show T (θ : ℂ) = schattenDualTestMatrix U V (1 / p) 1 w ((1 / p : ℝ) : ℂ) from
      congrArg (schattenDualTestMatrix U V (1 / p) 1 w) hacenter, hh,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)]
  rw [← hcenter]
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using
    Complex.HadamardThreeLines.norm_le_interp_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip₀₁' g
      (z := (θ : ℂ)) ⟨by simpa using hθ.1.le, by simpa using hθ.2.le⟩ hg hbounded hgl hgr

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants
    {r p B H : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    {G : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hG : DiffContOnCl ℂ G (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, specNorm (G z) ≤ B)
    (h₀ h₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (hm₀ : Measurable h₀) (hm₁ : Measurable h₁)
    (hb₀ : ∀ t, |h₀ t| ≤ H) (hb₁ : ∀ t, |h₁ t| ≤ H)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ, specNorm (G ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤ Real.exp (h₀ t))
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ,
      schattenNormReal (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) p ≤ Real.exp (h₁ t)) :
    schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r) ≤ Real.exp (
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((1 - r) * Real.hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) * h₀ t) +
      ∫ t : ℝ, (r * Real.hirschmanDensity r t) * h₁ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  have hα : 0 < p / r := div_pos hp0 hr.1
  by_cases hA : G (r : ℂ) = 0
  · rw [hA, schattenNormReal_zero hα]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD (G (r : ℂ))
  let w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ := fun i =>
    singularValues (G (r : ℂ)) i / schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r)
  let T := schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p w
  have hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := fun i =>
    singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_mem_Icc _ hα hA i
  have hpower : ∑ i, w i ^ (p / r) = 1 := by
    change (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n),
      (singularValues (G (r : ℂ)) i / schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r)) ^ (p / r)) = 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i =>
      (singularValues (G (r : ℂ)) i / schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r)) ^ (p / r))]
    simpa only [min_self] using
      sum_singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_one (G (r : ℂ)) hα hA
  have hTdiff : Differentiable ℂ T := differentiable_schattenDualTestMatrix U V r p w
  have hTnorm {z : ℂ} (hz : z.re ≤ 1) : specNorm (T z) ≤ 1 :=
    specNorm_schattenDualTestMatrix_le_one hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right hr.1 hp hw hz
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (T z * G z).trace
  let L := (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact L.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn (hTdiff.differentiableOn.mul hG.differentiableOn)
    · exact L.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hTdiff.continuous.continuousOn.mul hG.continuousOn)
  have hg_bound : ∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
      ‖g z‖ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * B := by
    intro z hz
    have hzre : z.re ≤ 1 := hz.2
    have hTnuclear : nuclearNorm (T z) ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
      have h := schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm (T z) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      simp only [schattenNormReal_one, one_div_one, Real.rpow_one] at h
      calc
        nuclearNorm (T z) ≤ ((T z).rank : ℝ) * specNorm (T z) := h
        _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul (by exact_mod_cast Matrix.rank_le_card_width (T z)) (hTnorm hzre)
            (specNorm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    calc
      ‖g z‖ ≤ nuclearNorm (T z) * specNorm (G z) := by
        simpa only [schattenNorm_one, schattenNorm_top] using
          norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex (T z) (G z) (p := 1) (q := ∞)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hTnuclear (hbound z hz) (specNorm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hg_left (t : ℝ) : ‖g ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (h₀ t) := by
    have hTl := nuclearNorm_schattenDualTestMatrix_left hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
      hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right hr.1 hp0 (fun i => (hw i).1) hpower t
    have h := norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex
      (T ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (G ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (p := 1) (q := ∞)
    change ‖g ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ _ at h
    simp only [schattenNorm_one, schattenNorm_top, T, hTl, one_mul] at h
    exact h.trans (hleft t)
  have hg_right (t : ℝ) : ‖g (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (h₁ t) := by
    by_cases hp1 : p = 1
    · subst p
      have h := norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex
        (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (p := ∞) (q := 1)
      simp only [schattenNorm_one, schattenNorm_top] at h
      apply h.trans
      calc
        _ ≤ 1 * nuclearNorm (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hTnorm (by simp))
            (by simpa only [← schattenNormReal_one] using
              schattenNormReal_nonneg (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) 1)
        _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [one_mul, schattenNormReal_one] using hright t
    · have hp1' : 1 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp (Ne.symm hp1)
      have hpq := Real.HolderConjugate.conjExponent hp1'
      have hTr := schattenNormReal_schattenDualTestMatrix_right hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
        hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right hr.1 hpq (fun i => (hw i).1) hpower t
      have h := norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex
        (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) hpq.symm
      simp only [T, hTr, one_mul] at h
      exact h.trans (hright t)
  have hcenter : ‖g (r : ℂ)‖ = schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r) := by
    have htr := hSVD.trace_schattenDualTestMatrix_center_mul hr.1
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hr.2 hp) hA
    change g (r : ℂ) = (schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r) : ℂ) at htr
    rw [htr, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)]
  rw [← hcenter]
  exact Complex.norm_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants hr hg hg_bound
    h₀ h₁ hm₀ hm₁ hb₀ hb₁ hg_left hg_right

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_exp_hirschman_of_left_contractions
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_le_exp_hirschman_of_left_contractions
    {r p B H : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    {G : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hG : DiffContOnCl ℂ G (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, specNorm (G z) ≤ B)
    (h₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (hm₁ : Measurable h₁) (hb₁ : ∀ t, |h₁ t| ≤ H)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ, specNorm (G ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤ 1)
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ,
      schattenNormReal (G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) p ≤ Real.exp (h₁ t)) :
    schattenNormReal (G (r : ℂ)) (p / r) ≤
      Real.exp (∫ t : ℝ, (r * Real.hirschmanDensity r t) * h₁ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : 0 ≤ H := (abs_nonneg (h₁ 0)).trans (hb₁ 0)
  simpa only [mul_zero, integral_zero, zero_add] using
    schattenNormReal_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants hr hp hG hbound
      (fun _ => 0) h₁ measurable_const hm₁ (fun _ => by simpa using hH) hb₁
      (fun t => by simpa only [Real.exp_zero] using hleft t) hright

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_mul_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mul_mul_vecMulVec (y : ι → ℝ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    vecMulVec y y * B * vecMulVec y y =
      (y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)) • vecMulVec y y
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecMulVec_mul, vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_smul,
    ← dotProduct_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_pow_succ
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_pow_succ (y : ι → ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    vecMulVec y y ^ (p + 1) = (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ p • vecMulVec y y
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, smul_mul_assoc, vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_smul,
      smul_smul, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ
statement:
theorem trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (y : ι → ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    (C * vecMulVec y y ^ (p + 1)).trace =
      (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ p * (y ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecMulVec_pow_succ, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_smul, mul_vecMulVec,
    trace_vecMulVec, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [dotProduct_comm (C *ᵥ y) y]

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_mul_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mul_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec (y : ι → ℝ)
    (Bs : List (Matrix ι ι ℝ)) :
    vecMulVec y y * (Bs.map fun B => B * vecMulVec y y).prod =
      (Bs.map fun B => y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)).prod • vecMulVec y y
proof:
:= by
  induction Bs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons B Bs ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, vecMulVec_mul_mul_vecMulVec,
      smul_mul_assoc, ih, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.trace_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem trace_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec (y : ι → ℝ)
    (Bs : List (Matrix ι ι ℝ)) (hne : Bs ≠ []) :
    (Bs.map fun B => B * vecMulVec y y).prod.trace =
      (Bs.map fun B => y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)).prod
proof:
:= by
  cases Bs with
  | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
  | cons B Bs =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, vecMulVec_mul_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_smul, mul_vecMulVec, trace_vecMulVec,
      dotProduct_comm]
    exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_le_sum_abs_eigenvalues_pow
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_le_sum_abs_eigenvalues_pow
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |y ⬝ᵥ (A ^ k *ᵥ y)| ≤
      ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ y) ^ 2 * |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have he := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA (fun x => x ^ k) y
  rw [cfc_pow_id (ha := hA.isSelfAdjoint)] at he
  rw [he]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  simp only [abs_mul, abs_pow, sq_abs, mul_comm]
  exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_prod_pow_mul_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem abs_trace_prod_pow_mul_vecMulVec_le
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ)
    (ks : List ℕ) (hne : ks ≠ []) :
    |(ks.map fun k => A ^ k * vecMulVec y y).prod.trace| ≤
      (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ (ks.length - 1) *
        (y ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ ks.sum) A *ᵥ y))
proof:
:= by
  let w (i : ι) := ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ y) ^ 2
  have hw (i : ι) : 0 ≤ w i := sq_nonneg _
  have htrace : (ks.map fun k => A ^ k * vecMulVec y y).prod.trace =
      (ks.map fun k => y ⬝ᵥ (A ^ k *ᵥ y)).prod := by
    simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
      trace_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec y (ks.map fun k => A ^ k) (by simpa using hne)
  have hprod : ∀ ls : List ℕ, |(ls.map fun k => y ⬝ᵥ (A ^ k *ᵥ y)).prod| ≤
      (ls.map fun k => ∑ i, w i * |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ k).prod := by
    intro ls
    induction ls with
    | nil => simp
    | cons k ks ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (abs_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_le_sum_abs_eigenvalues_pow hA y k)
        ih (abs_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i)
          (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _))
  rw [htrace]
  refine (hprod ks).trans ?_
  have hb := prod_list_sum_mul_pow_le w (fun i => |hA.eigenvalues i|) hw
    (fun i => abs_nonneg _) ks hne
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i) = y ⬝ᵥ y := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA y
  rw [hsum] at hb
  rw [dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA]
  simpa only [w, mul_comm] using hb

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_loewnerDerivative
statement:
theorem posSemidef_loewnerDerivative {f : ℝ → ℝ} {ev : n → ℝ}
    (hL : (loewnerMatrix f ev).PosSemidef) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.PosSemidef) :
    (loewnerDerivative f ev U H).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hLc : ((loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal).PosSemidef :=
    (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (loewnerMatrix f ev)).mpr hL
  exact (hLc.hadamard (hH.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (U : Matrix n n ℂ))).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same _

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.posSemidef_loewnerDerivative
statement:
theorem OperatorMonotoneOn.posSemidef_loewnerDerivative {I : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hm : OperatorMonotoneOn I f) (hI : IsOpen I) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ f I)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I)
    (ev : n → ℝ) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hdiag : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose)
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.PosSemidef) :
    (loewnerDerivative f ev U H).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hfd := hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner hA
    (fun i => (hf _ (hAI (hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ ⟨i, rfl⟩))).differentiableAt
      (hI.mem_nhds (hAI (hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ ⟨i, rfl⟩)))) ev U hdiag
  have hpath : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A + t • H) H 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const H).const_add A
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => cfc f (A + t • H))
      (loewnerDerivative f ev U H) 0 := by
    exact hfd.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hpath
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => hA.add (hH.isHermitian.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t))) (by simp)
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, spectrum ℝ (A + t • H) ⊆ I :=
    hpath.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds ((isOpen_setOf_real_spectrum_subset hI).mem_nhds (by simpa using hAI))
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      (t⁻¹ • (cfc f (A + t • H) - cfc f A)).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hnear.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht ht0
    have hm' := hm.cfc_le hA (hA.add (hH.isHermitian.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t))) hAI ht
      (by rw [Matrix.le_iff, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hH.smul (le_of_lt ht0))
    exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hm').smul (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt ht0))
  have hclosed : IsClosed {M : Matrix n n ℂ | M.PosSemidef} := by
    simpa only [Set.Ici, Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef] using
      (isClosed_Ici : IsClosed (Set.Ici (0 : Matrix n n ℂ)))
  apply hclosed.mem_of_tendsto _ hpos
  simpa only [zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero] using hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (i j : n) :
    (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hA.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := orthonormal_iff_ite.1 hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal i j
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at h
  simpa [dotProduct_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ v) =
      p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA p v, dotProduct_sum]
  simp [dotProduct_smul, eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hA]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_eq_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_eq_dotProduct_mulVec {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvalues i =
      (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [dotProduct_comm] using hA.eigenvalues_eq i

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (v : n → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v) =
      ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i) * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.cfc_eq, IsHermitian.cfc, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
  have h1 : v ᵥ* (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) =
      fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v := by
    ext i; simp [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, mul_comm]
  have h2 : (star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)) *ᵥ v =
      fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v := by
    ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.star_apply]
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id,
    id]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.mul_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mulVec_of_eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA id x
  rw [cfc_id ℝ A] at h
  rw [h, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ha i) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_le_mul_dotProduct_of_eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA id x
  rw [cfc_id ℝ A] at h
  rw [h, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA x, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc i) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA g v, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA v,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_sq]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg i) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.cfc_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_polynomial p A hA.isSelfAdjoint]
  refine cfc_congr fun x hx => ?_
  rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact (h i).symm

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolate_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (i : n) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate (Finset.univ.image hA.eigenvalues) id f).eval (hA.eigenvalues i) =
      f (hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:=
  Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (v := id) f (Set.injOn_id _)
    (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: NLAlib.cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate
statement:
theorem cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f A = aeval A (Lagrange.interpolate (Finset.univ.image hA.eigenvalues) id f)
proof:
:=
  cfc_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq hA (eval_interpolate_eigenvalues hA f)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_self_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate hA g]
  refine dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_le hA (S := Set.range hA.eigenvalues) (fun i => ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    ?_ v
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [eval_interpolate_eigenvalues hA g]
  exact hg _ (hspec i)

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADISolve_equation
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => M * W) (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hP)
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.one_mul] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, lyapunovADISolve] using h

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_factor_step
proof:
:= by
  rw [cayleyTransform_eq_one_add A p hP]
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, lyapunovADISolve]

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_fst
statement:
theorem lyapunovADI_fst (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K) (p : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    (lyapunovADI A B p j).1 = lyapunovADIPropagator A p j * B
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [lyapunovADI, lyapunovADIPropagator]
  | succ j hj =>
    change (lyapunovADI A B p j).1 + (2 * p j : K) •
      lyapunovADISolve A (p j) (lyapunovADI A B p j).1 = _
    rw [lyapunovADI_factor_step A (p j) _ (hP j), hj, lyapunovADIPropagator, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_residual
statement:
theorem lyapunovADI_residual (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K) (p : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (j : ℕ) :
    A * (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 + (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ =
      (lyapunovADI A B p j).1 * (lyapunovADI A B p j).1ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [lyapunovADI]
  | succ j hj =>
    let X := (lyapunovADI A B p j).2
    let W := (lyapunovADI A B p j).1
    let V := lyapunovADISolve A (p j) W
    have hAV : A * V = W + (p j : K) • V := lyapunovADISolve_equation A (p j) W (hP j)
    have hVA : Vᴴ * Aᴴ = Wᴴ + (p j : K) • Vᴴ := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,
        RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal] using congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hAV
    change A * (X + (2 * p j : K) • (V * Vᴴ)) +
      (X + (2 * p j : K) • (V * Vᴴ)) * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ =
      (W + (2 * p j : K) • V) * (W + (2 * p j : K) • V)ᴴ
    change A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = W * Wᴴ at hj
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_mul, star_ofNat,
      RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc A V Vᴴ, hAV, Matrix.mul_assoc V Vᴴ Aᴴ, hVA]
    simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul]
    have hAX : A * X = W * Wᴴ - X * Aᴴ - B * Bᴴ := by rw [← hj]; abel
    rw [hAX]
    module

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_lyapunovADI_increment
statement:
theorem posSemidef_lyapunovADI_increment (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 < p j) (j : ℕ) :
    ((lyapunovADI A B p (j + 1)).2 - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  change ((lyapunovADI A B p j).2 + (2 * p j : K) • _ - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2).PosSemidef
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose _).smul (by exact_mod_cast mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) (hp j).le)

name: NLAlib.monotone_lyapunovADI_snd
statement:
theorem monotone_lyapunovADI_snd (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 < p j) : Monotone (fun j => (lyapunovADI A B p j).2)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro j
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mpr (posSemidef_lyapunovADI_increment A B p hp j)

name: NLAlib.mul_cayleyTransform
proof:
:= by
  rw [cayleyTransform_eq_one_add A p hP]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hP]
  module

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_error_step
statement:
private theorem lyapunovADI_error_step (A E : Matrix n n K) (W : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℝ) (hP : IsUnit (A - (p : K) • 1).det)
    (hE : A * E + E * Aᴴ + W * Wᴴ = 0) :
    E - (2 * p : K) • (lyapunovADISolve A p W * (lyapunovADISolve A p W)ᴴ) =
      cayleyTransform A p * E * (cayleyTransform A p)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let P := A - (p : K) • (1 : Matrix n n K)
  have hPu : IsUnit P := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr hP
  apply hPu.mul_left_cancel
  apply hPu.star.mul_right_cancel
  have hc := cayley_congruence_identity A E p hP
  have hR : A * E + E * Aᴴ = -(W * Wᴴ) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hE
  rw [hR, smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg] at hc
  have hV : P * lyapunovADISolve A p W = W := by
    simp only [P, lyapunovADISolve, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hP, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hGram : P * (lyapunovADISolve A p W * (lyapunovADISolve A p W)ᴴ) * Pᴴ = W * Wᴴ := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hV, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hV]
  change P * (E - (2 * p : K) • _) * Pᴴ = P * (_ * E * _) * Pᴴ
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [hGram]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul] at hc
  change P * E * Pᴴ - P * (cayleyTransform A p * E * (cayleyTransform A p)ᴴ) * Pᴴ =
    (2 * p : K) • (W * Wᴴ) at hc
  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
  rw [add_comm]
  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hc

name: NLAlib.sub_lyapunovADI_snd
statement:
theorem sub_lyapunovADI_snd (A X : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K) (p : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det)
    (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    X - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 =
      lyapunovADIPropagator A p j * X * (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [lyapunovADI, lyapunovADIPropagator]
  | succ j hj =>
    have hR := lyapunovADI_residual A B p hP j
    have hE : A * (X - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2) +
        (X - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2) * Aᴴ +
        (lyapunovADI A B p j).1 * (lyapunovADI A B p j).1ᴴ = 0 := by
      rw [← hR, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
      have he : A * (X - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2) =
        A * X - A * (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 := Matrix.mul_sub _ _ _
      convert hX using 1; abel
    change X - ((lyapunovADI A B p j).2 + (2 * p j : K) • _) = _
    rw [← sub_sub, lyapunovADI_error_step A _ _ (p j) (hP j) hE, hj,
      lyapunovADIPropagator, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_snd_nonneg_le_solution
statement:
theorem lyapunovADI_snd_nonneg_le_solution (A X : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 < p j)
    (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : K) • 1).det) (hX : X.PosSemidef)
    (hEq : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 ∧ (lyapunovADI A B p j).2 ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, Matrix.le_iff.mpr ?_⟩
  · simpa only [lyapunovADI] using monotone_lyapunovADI_snd A B p hp (Nat.zero_le j)
  · rw [sub_lyapunovADI_snd A X B p hP hEq]
    exact hX.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same _

name: NLAlib.isometry_reflection_identities
statement:
theorem NLAlib.isometry_reflection_identities
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (K : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hK : K.conjTranspose * K = 1)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    let U
proof:
:= Matrix.fromBlocks (1 - K * K.conjTranspose) K K.conjTranspose 0
    U.IsHermitian ∧ U * U = 1 ∧
      (U * Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B * U).toBlocks₂₂ = K.conjTranspose * A * K := by
  let P := 1 - K * K.conjTranspose
  have hP : P.IsHermitian := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hPK : P * K = 0 := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hK, Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]
  have hKP : K.conjTranspose * P = 0 := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hK, Matrix.one_mul, sub_self]
  have hPP : P * P + K * K.conjTranspose = 1 := by
    calc
      P * P + K * K.conjTranspose = P - (P * K) * K.conjTranspose + K * K.conjTranspose := by
        rw [show P * P = P * (1 - K * K.conjTranspose) from rfl,
          Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hPK]; simp [P]
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hP.fromBlocks rfl (Matrix.isHermitian_zero), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    change Matrix.fromBlocks (P * P + K * K.conjTranspose) (P * K + K * 0)
      (K.conjTranspose * P + 0 * K.conjTranspose) (K.conjTranspose * K + 0 * 0) = 1
    simp only [hPP, hPK, hKP, hK, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact Matrix.fromBlocks_one
  · simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₂₂,
      Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_matrixExp
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixExp (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    HasFDerivAt matrixExp (fderiv 𝕜 matrixExp A) A
proof:
:= by
  exact (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := 𝕜) A).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt

name: NLAlib.matrixExp_sub_matrixExp_eq_integral
statement:
theorem matrixExp_sub_matrixExp_eq_integral (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    matrixExp A - matrixExp B =
      ∫ t : ℝ in 0..1, matrixExp ((1-t) • A) * (A-B) * matrixExp (t • B)
proof:
:= by
  let F (t : ℝ) := matrixExp ((1-t) • A) * matrixExp (t • B)
  let G (t : ℝ) := matrixExp ((1-t) • A) * (A-B) * matrixExp (t • B)
  have hder (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (-G t) t := by
    have hleft := (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const A (1-t)).scomp t
      ((hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t))
    have hright := hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const' B t
    convert! hleft.mul hright using 1
    change -G t = _
    simp only [G, neg_smul, one_smul, zero_sub]
    noncomm_ring
  have hcont : Continuous G := by
    dsimp [G, matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (fun t _ => hder t) (hcont.neg.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  simp only [F, zero_smul, sub_zero, one_smul, sub_self, matrixExp,
    NormedSpace.exp_zero, one_mul, mul_one, intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hi
  change NormedSpace.exp A - NormedSpace.exp B = _
  exact neg_injective (by simpa only [neg_sub] using hi.symm)

name: NLAlib.fderiv_matrixExp_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_matrixExp_apply (A E : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    fderiv 𝕜 matrixExp A E =
      ∫ s : ℝ in 0..1, matrixExp ((1-s) • A) * E * matrixExp (s • A)
proof:
:= by
  let J (t : ℝ) := ∫ s : ℝ in 0..1,
    matrixExp ((1-s) • (A + t • E)) * E * matrixExp (s • A)
  have hc : Continuous J := by
    apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' (a₀ := 0) (b₀ := 1)
    dsimp [Function.uncurry, matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hpath : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A + t • E) E 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const E).const_add A
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => matrixExp (A + t • E))
      (fderiv 𝕜 matrixExp A E) 0 := by
    exact ((hasFDerivAt_matrixExp A).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hpath (by simp)
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ • (matrixExp (A + (0+t) • E) - matrixExp (A + (0 : ℝ) • E)))
      =ᶠ[𝓝[>] 0] J := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
    simp only [zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero]
    rw [matrixExp_sub_matrixExp_eq_integral]
    have he : A + t • E - A = t • E := by abel
    rw [he]
    have hint : (∫ s : ℝ in 0..1, matrixExp ((1-s) • (A + t • E)) *
        (t • E) * matrixExp (s • A)) = t • J t := by
      simp only [J, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
    rw [hint, inv_smul_smul₀ ht0]
  have hj : Tendsto J (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (J 0)) := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hlim := hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right.congr' heq
  have he := tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hj
  simpa [J] using he

name: NLAlib.differentiable_schattenDualTestCoefficient
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem differentiable_schattenDualTestCoefficient (r p w : ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (schattenDualTestCoefficient r p w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold schattenDualTestCoefficient
  split_ifs
  · fun_prop
  · exact differentiable_const _

name: NLAlib.continuous_schattenDualTestCoefficient
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_schattenDualTestCoefficient (r p w : ℝ) :
    Continuous (schattenDualTestCoefficient r p w)
proof:
:=
  (differentiable_schattenDualTestCoefficient r p w).continuous

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos
statement:
theorem norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w)
    (r p : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖schattenDualTestCoefficient r p w z‖ = w ^ ((p - z.re) / r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenDualTestCoefficient, if_pos hw, Complex.norm_exp, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hw]
  congr 1
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero, mul_zero]
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_le_one
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos hwpos]
    exact Real.rpow_le_one hw.1 hw.2 (div_nonneg (by linarith) hr.le)
  · simp only [schattenDualTestCoefficient, if_neg hwpos, norm_zero, zero_le_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_left
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos hwpos]
    simp
  · have hwzero : w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    simp [schattenDualTestCoefficient, Real.zero_rpow (div_pos hp hr).ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenDualTestCoefficient_center
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [schattenDualTestCoefficient, if_pos hwpos, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hwpos,
      Complex.ofReal_exp]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    have hrC : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
    field_simp [hrC]
  · have hwzero : w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    have hexp : 0 < p / r - 1 := by rw [sub_pos, one_lt_div hr]; exact hpr
    simp [schattenDualTestCoefficient, Real.zero_rpow hexp.ne']

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_right_rpow
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos hwpos]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, add_zero]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hw]
    congr 1
    have heq := hpq.sub_one_mul_conj
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  · have hwzero : w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    simp [schattenDualTestCoefficient, Real.zero_rpow hpq.symm.ne_zero,
      Real.zero_rpow (div_pos hpq.pos hr).ne']

name: NLAlib.historyMarkedCount_taggedWordInsert

name: NLAlib.historyMarkedCount_thirdTaggedWord

name: NLAlib.evaluateTaggedWord_insert
statement:
private theorem evaluateTaggedWord_insert {n κ : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {N : ℕ}
    (z : ℂ) (C : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) (w : Fin N → HistoryBlock κ)
    (i : Fin N) (tag : κ) :
    evaluateTaggedWord z C (taggedWordInsert w i tag) =
      resolventWordInsert (evaluateTaggedWord z C w) i (C tag)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i.castSucc ?_ (fun l => ?_) j
  · simp [evaluateTaggedWord, taggedWordInsert, resolventWordInsert]
  · simp [evaluateTaggedWord, taggedWordInsert, resolventWordInsert]

name: NLAlib.evaluateTaggedWord_initial
statement:
private theorem evaluateTaggedWord_initial {n κ : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (z : ℂ) (C : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℕ) :

proof:

  · simp only [evaluateTaggedWord, initialTaggedWord, mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_left]
    rfl
  · simp only [evaluateTaggedWord, initialTaggedWord, mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_right]
