name: NLAlib.evaluateTaggedWord_third
statement:
private theorem evaluateTaggedWord_third {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (z : ℂ) (C : Fin 3 → Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + p))
    (j : Fin (p + p + 1)) (k : Fin (p + p + 1 + 1)) :
    evaluateTaggedWord z C (thirdTaggedWord p i j k) =
      resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
        (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord z p) i (C 2)) j (C 1)) k (C 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [thirdTaggedWord, evaluateTaggedWord_insert, evaluateTaggedWord_insert,
    evaluateTaggedWord_insert, evaluateTaggedWord_initial]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_neumann_profile_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_neumann_profile_le
    {ι n κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → Bool × Option κ)
    (hMarked : ((List.ofFn w).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length = 3)
    (m : Fin N → ℕ) (C : ι → κ → Matrix n n ℂ) (H : ι → Fin N → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHermC : ∀ i t, (C i t).IsHermitian) (hHermH : ∀ i j, (H i j).IsHermitian)
    {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hC : ∀ i t, specNorm (C i t) ≤ r) (hH : ∀ i j, specNorm (H i j) ≤ r)
    (hMassC : ∀ t, specNorm (∑ i, C i t ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (hMassH : ∀ j, specNorm (∑ i, H i j ^ 2) ≤ M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hN : N = 2 * p + 3) :
    ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
      (resolvent A (if (w j).1 then star z else z) * H i j) ^ m j *
        resolvent A (if (w j).1 then star z else z) * (w j).2.elim 1 (C i))).prod)‖ ≤
      r ^ (1 + ∑ j, m j) * M * (|z.im|⁻¹) ^ (4 + ∑ j, m j) *
        resolventEvenMoment A z p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  have hMarkedPos : 0 < ((List.ofFn w).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length := by omega
  let S := List.cyclicProfileArcs w m
  obtain ⟨hLen, hDegree, hArc⟩ := List.cyclicProfileArcs_spec w m hMarkedPos
  have hLen' : S.length = 3 + ∑ j, m j := by simpa only [hMarked] using hLen
  let a : Fin S.length → ℕ := fun j => (S.get j).2.1
  let b : Fin S.length → ℕ := fun j => (S.get j).2.2
  let Z : ι → Fin S.length → Matrix n n ℂ :=
    fun i j => Sum.elim (C i) (H i) (S.get j).1
  have hHerm (i : ι) (j : Fin S.length) : (Z i j).IsHermitian := by
    dsimp only [Z]
    cases (S.get j).1 with
    | inl t => exact hHermC i t
    | inr t => exact hHermH i t
  have hBound (i : ι) (j : Fin S.length) : specNorm (Z i j) ≤ r := by
    dsimp only [Z]
    cases (S.get j).1 with
    | inl t => exact hC i t
    | inr t => exact hH i t
  have hMass (j : Fin S.length) : specNorm (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2) ≤ M := by
    dsimp only [Z]
    cases (S.get j).1 with
    | inl t => exact hMassC t
    | inr t => exact hMassH t
  have hPos (j : Fin S.length) : 0 < a j + b j := hArc _ (List.get_mem S j)
  have hSum : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = N + ∑ j, m j := by
    rw [← Fin.sum_ofFn]
    have ht := congrArg (List.map (fun t : (κ ⊕ Fin N) × (ℕ × ℕ) => t.2.1 + t.2.2))
      (List.ofFn_get S)
    rw [List.map_ofFn] at ht
    have ht' : List.ofFn (fun j => a j + b j) = S.map (fun t => t.2.1 + t.2.2) := ht
    rw [ht']
    exact hDegree
  have hWord (i : ι) :
      normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
        (resolvent A (if (w j).1 then star z else z) * H i j) ^ m j *
          resolvent A (if (w j).1 then star z else z) * (w j).2.elim 1 (C i))).prod) =
        normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j => Z i j *
          (resolvent A z ^ a j * resolvent A (star z) ^ b j))).prod) := by
    have ht := Matrix.trace_profile_word_eq_cyclicProfileArcs
      (commute_resolvent A z (star z)) w m hMarkedPos (C i) (H i)
    have hMode (mode : Bool) : (if mode then resolvent A (star z) else resolvent A z) =
        resolvent A (if mode then star z else z) := by cases mode <;> rfl
    simp_rw [hMode] at ht
    have hList := congrArg (List.map (fun t : (κ ⊕ Fin N) × (ℕ × ℕ) =>
      Sum.elim (C i) (H i) t.1 * (resolvent A z ^ t.2.1 * resolvent A (star z) ^ t.2.2)))
      (List.ofFn_get S)
    rw [List.map_ofFn] at hList
    change List.ofFn (fun j => Z i j *
      (resolvent A z ^ a j * resolvent A (star z) ^ b j)) = _ at hList
    rw [hList]
    unfold normalizedTrace
    exact congrArg (fun t : ℂ => (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ * t) ht
  have hNorm := norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_resolventEvenMoment
    (by omega : 2 ≤ S.length) Z hHerm hr hBound hMass hA hz a b hp hSum (by omega) hPos
  have hk : S.length - 2 = 1 + ∑ j, m j := by omega
  have hL : N + ∑ j, m j - (2 * p - 1) = 4 + ∑ j, m j := by omega
  have hSumWord := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun i _ => hWord i)
  rw [hSumWord]
  simpa only [hk, hL] using hNorm

name: NLAlib.historyMarkedCount_eq_length_filter
proof:
:= by
  have hlist (t : List (HistoryBlock κ)) :
      (t.filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length =
        (t.map (fun b => if b.2.isSome then 1 else 0)).sum := by
    induction t with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b t ih =>
      obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
      cases c with
      | none => simp [ih]
      | some tag =>
        simp [ih]
        omega
  rw [hlist, List.map_ofFn, Fin.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_normalizedTrace_third_resolventWord_neumann_profile_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_normalizedTrace_third_resolventWord_neumann_profile_le
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (i₀ : Fin (p + p))
    (i₁ : Fin (p + p + 1)) (i₂ : Fin (p + p + 1 + 1))
    (m : Fin (p + p + 1 + 1 + 1) → ℕ)
    (C : ι → Fin 3 → Matrix n n ℂ) (H : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHermC : ∀ i t, (C i t).IsHermitian) (hHermH : ∀ i, (H i).IsHermitian)
    {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hC : ∀ i t, specNorm (C i t) ≤ r) (hH : ∀ i, specNorm (H i) ≤ r)
    (hMassC : ∀ t, specNorm (∑ i, C i t ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (hMassH : specNorm (∑ i, H i ^ 2) ≤ M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace (let w := resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
        (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord z p) i₀ (C i 2)) i₁ (C i 1)) i₂ (C i 0)
      (List.ofFn (fun j => (resolvent A (w j).1 * H i) ^ m j *
        resolvent A (w j).1 * (w j).2)).prod)‖ ≤
      r ^ (1 + ∑ j, m j) * M * (|z.im|⁻¹) ^ (4 + ∑ j, m j) *
        resolventEvenMoment A z p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  have hMarked : ((List.ofFn (thirdTaggedWord p i₀ i₁ i₂)).filter
      (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length = 3 := by
    rw [← historyMarkedCount_eq_length_filter, historyMarkedCount_thirdTaggedWord]
  have ht := norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_neumann_profile_le
    (thirdTaggedWord p i₀ i₁ i₂) hMarked m C (fun i _ => H i)
    hHermC (fun i _ => hHermH i) hr hC (fun i _ => hH i)
    hMassC (fun _ => hMassH) hA hz hp (by omega)
  change ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
    (resolvent A ((evaluateTaggedWord z (C i) (thirdTaggedWord p i₀ i₁ i₂)) j).1 * H i) ^ m j *
      resolvent A ((evaluateTaggedWord z (C i) (thirdTaggedWord p i₀ i₁ i₂)) j).1 *
        ((evaluateTaggedWord z (C i) (thirdTaggedWord p i₀ i₁ i₂)) j).2)).prod)‖ ≤ _ at ht
  simpa only [evaluateTaggedWord_third] using ht

name: NLAlib.abs_im_insertNth
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i.castSucc ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simpa only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same] using hw i
  · simpa only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove] using hw k

name: NLAlib.abs_im_mixedResolventWord
statement:
private theorem abs_im_mixedResolventWord {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    (z : ℂ) (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, |((mixedResolventWord (n := n) z p) j).1.im| = |z.im|
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  refine Fin.addCases (fun k => ?_) (fun k => ?_) j
  · simp only [mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_left]
  · simp only [mixedResolventWord, Fin.append_right, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_normalizedTrace_third_resolventWord_add_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_normalizedTrace_third_resolventWord_add_le
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (i₀ : Fin (p + p))
    (i₁ : Fin (p + p + 1)) (i₂ : Fin (p + p + 1 + 1))
    (C : ι → Fin 3 → Matrix n n ℂ) (H : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHermC : ∀ i t, (C i t).IsHermitian) (hHermH : ∀ i, (H i).IsHermitian)
    {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hC : ∀ i t, specNorm (C i t) ≤ r) (hH : ∀ i, specNorm (H i) ≤ r)
    (hMassC : ∀ t, specNorm (∑ i, C i t ^ 2) ≤ M)
    (hMassH : specNorm (∑ i, H i ^ 2) ≤ M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (hsmall : 8 * (p : ℝ) * r ≤ |z.im|) :
    ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace (let w := resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
        (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord z p) i₀ (C i 2)) i₁ (C i 1)) i₂ (C i 0)
      (List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A + H i) (w j).1 * (w j).2)).prod)‖ ≤
      3 * r * M * (|z.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 *
        resolventEvenMoment A z p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  let N := p + p + 1 + 1 + 1
  let W (i : ι) : Fin N → ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ :=
    resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
      (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord z p) i₀ (C i 2)) i₁ (C i 1)) i₂ (C i 0)
  let η : ℝ := |z.im|
  let ρ : ℝ := r / η
  let E : ℝ := resolventEvenMoment A z p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
  let B : ℝ := r * M * (η⁻¹) ^ 4 * E
  have hη : 0 < η := abs_pos.mpr hz
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hpr : r ≤ (p : ℝ) * r := by nlinarith
  have hrη : r < η := by dsimp only [η]; nlinarith
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := div_nonneg hr hη.le
  have hρ1 : ρ < 1 := (div_lt_one hη).mpr hrη
  have hNreal : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (p : ℝ) + 3 := by dsimp only [N]; push_cast; ring
  have hNle : (N : ℝ) ≤ 5 * (p : ℝ) := by rw [hNreal]; nlinarith
  have htotal : (N : ℝ) * ρ ≤ 2 / 3 := by
    dsimp only [ρ]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hη).mpr
    have hNr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNle hr
    change 8 * (p : ℝ) * r ≤ η at hsmall
    nlinarith
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := (specNorm_nonneg (∑ i, C i 0 ^ 2)).trans (hMassC 0)
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := Real.rpow_nonneg (resolventEvenMoment_nonneg A z hp) _
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr hM) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hη.le) _)) hE
  have hheight (i : ι) : ∀ j, |((W i) j).1.im| = η := by
    dsimp only [W, resolventWordInsert]
    apply abs_im_insertNth
    apply abs_im_insertNth
    apply abs_im_insertNth
    exact abs_im_mixedResolventWord z p
  have hshift (i : ι) (j : Fin N) : ((W i) j).1.im ≠ 0 :=
    abs_pos.mp (by rw [hheight]; exact hη)
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hSeries (i : ι) :
      HasSum (fun m : Fin N → ℕ => normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
        (resolvent A ((W i) j).1 * H i) ^ m j * resolvent A ((W i) j).1 * ((W i) j).2)).prod))
        (normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A + H i) ((W i) j).1 * ((W i) j).2)).prod)) := by
    have hHsmall (j : Fin N) : specNorm (H i) < |((W i) j).1.im| := by
      rw [hheight]
      exact (hH i).trans_lt hrη
    have hs := (hA.summable_norm_and_hasSum_resolventWord_add (W i) (hshift i) hHsmall).2
    have ht := T.hasSum hs
    simpa only [T, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply] using ht
  have hAll :
      HasSum (fun m : Fin N → ℕ => ∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
        (resolvent A ((W i) j).1 * H i) ^ m j * resolvent A ((W i) j).1 * ((W i) j).2)).prod))
        (∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A + H i) ((W i) j).1 * ((W i) j).2)).prod)) :=
    hasSum_sum (fun i _ => hSeries i)
  have hProfile (m : Fin N → ℕ) :
      ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
        (resolvent A ((W i) j).1 * H i) ^ m j * resolvent A ((W i) j).1 * ((W i) j).2)).prod)‖ ≤
        B * ρ ^ (∑ j, m j) := by
    have ht := norm_sum_normalizedTrace_third_resolventWord_neumann_profile_le
      hp i₀ i₁ i₂ m C H hHermC hHermH hr hC hH hMassC hMassH hA hz
    calc
      _ ≤ r ^ (1 + ∑ j, m j) * M * (|z.im|⁻¹) ^ (4 + ∑ j, m j) * E := ht
      _ = B * ρ ^ (∑ j, m j) := by
        dsimp only [B, E, ρ, η]
        simp only [pow_add, pow_one, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
        ring
  have hg := (Real.hasSum_pow_sum_fin hρ0 hρ1 N).mul_left B
  have hBound := hAll.norm_le_of_bounded hg hProfile
  have hCorrection := Real.inv_one_sub_pow_le_three hρ0 N htotal
  change ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
    resolvent (A + H i) ((W i) j).1 * ((W i) j).2)).prod)‖ ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ B * ((1 - ρ)⁻¹ ^ N) := hBound
    _ ≤ B * 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCorrection hB
    _ = _ := by dsimp only [B, E, η]; ring

name: NLAlib.isHurwitz_of_posDef_lyapunov
statement:
theorem isHurwitz_of_posDef_lyapunov (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : X.PosDef)
    (hR : (-(A * X + X * Aᴴ)).PosDef) : IsHurwitz A
proof:
:= by
  intro μ hμ
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyA⟩ := exists_vecMul_eq_smul_of_mem_spectrum hμ
  have hx : star y ≠ 0 := by simpa only [star_ne_zero] using hy
  have hAx : Aᴴ *ᵥ star y = star μ • star y := by rw [← Matrix.star_vecMul, hyA, star_smul]
  have hquad : quadForm (A * X + X * Aᴴ) (star y) =
      (μ + star μ) * quadForm X (star y) := by
    unfold quadForm
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (star (star y)) A,
      star_star, hyA, hAx]
    simp only [smul_dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      ]
    ring
  have hXp : 0 < (quadForm X (star y)).re := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hX.quadForm_pos hx)).1
  have hRp := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hR.quadForm_pos hx)).1
  change 0 < (quadForm (-(A * X + X * Aᴴ)) (star y)).re at hRp
  have hreal : (quadForm (-(A * X + X * Aᴴ)) (star y)).re =
      -(2 * μ.re * (quadForm X (star y)).re) := by
    have hn : quadForm (-(A * X + X * Aᴴ)) (star y) =
        -quadForm (A * X + X * Aᴴ) (star y) := by
      simp only [quadForm, Matrix.neg_mulVec, dotProduct_neg]
    have hμ : μ + star μ = ((2 * μ.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [RCLike.star_def] <;> ring
    rw [hn, hquad, hμ]
    simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero]
  rw [hreal] at hRp
  by_contra h
  have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ.re := le_of_not_gt h
  have hprod : 0 ≤ 2 * μ.re * (quadForm X (star y)).re :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hμ0) hXp.le
  linarith

name: NLAlib.isHurwitz_iff_exists_posDef_lyapunov
statement:
theorem isHurwitz_iff_exists_posDef_lyapunov (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    IsHurwitz A ↔ ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ (-(A * X + X * Aᴴ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    let X := lyapunovCayleySolution A 1
    have heq := lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A 1 hA
    refine ⟨X, posDef_lyapunovCayleySolution A 1 hA Matrix.PosDef.one, ?_⟩
    have hsum : A * X + X * Aᴴ = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left heq
    rw [hsum, neg_neg]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hR⟩
    exact isHurwitz_of_posDef_lyapunov A X hX hR

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_matrixDyson
statement:
theorem existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_matrixDyson
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1) :
    ∃! P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n,
      P Set.univ = 1 ∧
      (∀ E : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet E →
        E ⊆ (Icc (-matrixDysonRadius A S) (matrixDysonRadius A S))ᶜ → P E = 0) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ∀ i j : n, P.entryStieltjesTransform z i j = M z i j
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_stieltjes_eq M hM
    (fun z hz => (hpos z hz).posSemidef)
    (tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixDyson A hA S hS M hpos heq) (matrixDysonRadius A S)
  intro c hc
  refine ⟨4 / ((c - specNorm A) ^ 2 - 4 * ‖S‖), ?_⟩
  intro z hz hcz
  exact norm_imaginaryPart_le_of_matrixDyson_exterior A hA S hS M hM.continuousOn
    hpos heq hc hz hcz

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_and_specNorm_le_of_matrixDyson_inverse
statement:
theorem existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_and_specNorm_le_of_matrixDyson_inverse
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : DifferentiableOn ℂ M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef)
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → -(M z)⁻¹ = z • 1 - A + S (M z)) :
    (∃! P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n,
      P Set.univ = 1 ∧
      (∀ E : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet E →
        E ⊆ (Icc (-matrixDysonRadius A S) (matrixDysonRadius A S))ᶜ → P E = 0) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ∀ i j : n, P.entryStieltjesTransform z i j = M z i j) ∧
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → specNorm (M z) ≤ z.im⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hpol : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1 :=
    fun z hz => Matrix.mul_eq_neg_one_of_neg_inv_eq_of_posDef_imaginaryPart (hpos z hz) (heq z hz)
  have hp : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    fun z hz => (hpos z hz).posSemidef.nonneg
  have ha : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im)).mpr hM
  exact ⟨existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_matrixDyson A hA S hS M ha hp hpol,
    fun z hz => specNorm_le_inv_im_of_matrixDyson A hA S hS hz (M z) (hp z hz) (hpol z hz)⟩

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_matrixExp_orbit
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_matrixExp_orbit (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (matrixExp (s • A)).toEuclideanLin x)
      (A.toEuclideanLin ((matrixExp (t • A)).toEuclideanLin x)) t
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n :=
    ((LinearMap.applyₗ x).comp Matrix.toEuclideanLin.toLinearMap).restrictScalars ℝ
  have h := L.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const' A t)
  convert! h using 1
  change WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ ((NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) *ᵥ x.ofLp)) =
    WithLp.toLp 2 ((A * NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) *ᵥ x.ofLp)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_of_energy_bound
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixExp_smul_le_of_energy_bound (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (c : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n,
      inner ℝ x (A.toEuclideanLin x) ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : specNorm (matrixExp (t • A)) ≤ Real.exp (t * c)
proof:
:= by
  have horbit (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
      ‖(NormedSpace.exp (t • A) : Matrix n n ℂ).toEuclideanLin x‖ ≤
        Real.exp (t * c) * ‖x‖ := by
    let L : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n :=
      ((LinearMap.applyₗ x).comp Matrix.toEuclideanLin.toLinearMap).restrictScalars ℝ
    let z (s : ℝ) := L (NormedSpace.exp (s • A))
    have hz (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt z (A.toEuclideanLin (z s)) s := by
      exact hasDerivAt_matrixExp_orbit A x s
    let F (s : ℝ) := Real.exp (-2 * c * s) * ‖z s‖ ^ 2
    let D (s : ℝ) := Real.exp (-2 * c * s) *
      (2 * inner ℝ (z s) (A.toEuclideanLin (z s)) - 2 * c * ‖z s‖ ^ 2)
    have hF (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (D s) s := by
      have h := (((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (-2 * c)).exp).mul (hz s).norm_sq
      convert! h using 1
      dsimp [D]
      ring
    have hanti : Antitone F := antitone_of_hasDerivAt_nonpos hF (fun s => by
      dsimp [D]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le (by nlinarith [hA (z s)]))
    have he := hanti ht
    have hz0 : z 0 = x := by
      change (NormedSpace.exp ((0 : ℝ) • A) : Matrix n n ℂ).toEuclideanLin x = x
      simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin]
    change Real.exp (-2 * c * t) * ‖z t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (-2 * c * 0) * ‖z 0‖ ^ 2 at he
    rw [hz0] at he
    simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] at he
    have hex : Real.exp (-2 * c * t) * (Real.exp (t * c) * ‖x‖) ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
      have heq : -2 * c * t + 2 * (t * c) = 0 := by ring
      rw [heq, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
    have hsq : ‖z t‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp (t * c) * ‖x‖) ^ 2 :=
      (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (Real.exp_pos (-2 * c * t))).mp (he.trans_eq hex.symm)
    have hn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (t * c) * ‖x‖ := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (norm_nonneg _)
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn).mp hsq
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  intro x
  exact horbit x

name: NLAlib.smithDoublingFactor_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem smithDoublingFactor_mul_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K) (j : ℕ) :
    smithDoublingFactor A B j * (smithDoublingFactor A B j)ᴴ =
      (smithDoubling A (B * Bᴴ) j).2
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j hj =>
    rw [smithDoublingFactor, ← smithDoubling_factor_step, hj]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.card_smithFactorIndex
statement: theorem card_smithFactorIndex (j : ℕ) : Fintype.card (SmithFactorIndex s j) = 2 ^ j * Fintype.card s
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => change Fintype.card s = 2 ^ 0 * Fintype.card s; simp
  | succ j hj =>
    change Fintype.card (Sum (SmithFactorIndex s j) (SmithFactorIndex s j)) = _
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, hj, pow_succ]
    ring

name: NLAlib.cfc_diagonal_ofReal
statement:
theorem cfc_diagonal_ofReal {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    cfc f (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : 𝕜)) =
      Matrix.diagonal fun i => (f (x i) : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := (Set.finite_range x).toFinset
  let p : ℝ[X] := Lagrange.interpolate s id f
  have hp : ∀ y ∈ Set.range x, p.eval y = f y := by
    intro y hy
    exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (s := s) (v := id) (i := y) f
      Function.injective_id.injOn (by simpa [s] using hy)
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : 𝕜)).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_of_self_adjoint _ (by ext; simp)
  have heq : cfc f (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : 𝕜)) =
      cfc p.eval (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : 𝕜)) := by
    apply cfc_congr
    intro y hy
    have hy' : (y : 𝕜) ∈ spectrum 𝕜 (Matrix.diagonal fun i => (x i : 𝕜)) :=
      (spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff 𝕜).mpr hy
    rw [spectrum_diagonal] at hy'
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hy'
    exact (hp y ⟨i, RCLike.ofReal_injective hi⟩).symm
  rw [heq, cfc_polynomial p _ hdiag.isSelfAdjoint]
  have ha := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply
    (Matrix.diagonalAlgHom ℝ (n := n) (α := 𝕜)) (fun i => (x i : 𝕜)) p
  simp only [Matrix.diagonalAlgHom_apply] at ha
  rw [ha]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_pi_apply₂]
  change Polynomial.aeval (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (x i)) p = (f (x i) : 𝕜)
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval, hp (x i) ⟨i, rfl⟩]

name: NLAlib.cfc_isometric_conj
statement:
theorem cfc_isometric_conj {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (U : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hU' : U * Uᴴ = 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    cfc f (U * A * Uᴴ) = U * cfc f A * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let E : Matrix n n 𝕜 →⋆ₐ[ℝ] Matrix m m 𝕜 :=
    { toFun := fun M => U * M * Uᴴ
      map_one' := by simp [hU']
      map_mul' := fun M N => by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := fun M N => by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
      commutes' := fun r => by simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, hU']
      map_star' := fun M => by simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
        Matrix.mul_assoc] }
  symm
  change E (cfc f A) = cfc f (E A)
  exact StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc E f A (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn f)
    E.toAlgHom.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional hA
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose U hA)

name: NLAlib.IsThinSVD.specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le
statement:
theorem IsThinSVD.specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U : Matrix m r ℂ} {V : Matrix n r ℂ} {σ : r → ℝ}
    (hA : IsThinSVD A U V σ) {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u) (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell < 1)
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ i ∈ Set.Icc ell 1) {T : ℕ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate q c A T) ≤ 1 - l T ∧
      1 - l T ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ T)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := h.composition_error_le hell hell1.le hT ⟨le_rfl, hell1.le⟩
  have hE : 0 ≤ 1 - l T := (abs_nonneg _).trans hx.1
  refine ⟨hA.specNorm_polar_sub_oddMatrixIterate_le q c T hσ hE ?_, hx.2⟩
  intro x hx
  exact (h.composition_error_le hell hell1.le hT hx).1

name: NLAlib.specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le (A : Matrix m n ℂ)
    {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u) (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell < 1)
    (hA : ∀ k, 0 < singularValues A k → singularValues A k ∈ Set.Icc ell 1)
    {T : ℕ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate q c A T) ≤ 1 - l T ∧
      1 - l T ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, ht⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  exact ht.specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le h hell hell1
    (fun i => hA i (ht.pos i)) hT

name: NLAlib.tendsto_greedyOddMatrixIterate
statement:
theorem tendsto_greedyOddMatrixIterate (A : Matrix m n ℂ)
    {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax (q + 1) ell c l u) (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell < 1)
    (hA : ∀ k, 0 < singularValues A k → singularValues A k ∈ Set.Icc ell 1) :
    Tendsto (oddMatrixIterate (q + 1) c A) atTop (𝓝 (canonicalPartialPolar A))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ell ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hb1 : 1 - ell ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hell]
  have hp := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hb0 hb1).comp
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by omega : (1 : ℕ) < (q + 1) + 1))
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      ‖canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate (q + 1) c A T‖ ≤
        (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ (((q + 1) + 1) ^ T) := by
    apply Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr
    refine ⟨1, fun T hT => ?_⟩
    have he := specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le A h hell hell1 hA hT
    exact he.1.trans he.2
  have ht := squeeze_zero_norm' hbound hp
  have hf := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := canonicalPartialPolar A)).sub ht
  have he : (fun T => canonicalPartialPolar A -
      (canonicalPartialPolar A - oddMatrixIterate (q + 1) c A T)) =
        oddMatrixIterate (q + 1) c A := by funext T; abel
  rw [he] at hf
  simpa only [sub_zero] using hf

name: NLAlib.exists_greedy_polarPolynomialHorner_guarantee
statement:
theorem exists_greedy_polarPolynomialHorner_guarantee (q : ℕ) {ell : ℝ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell < 1) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (l u : ℕ → ℝ), IsGreedyOddMinimax (q + 1) ell c l u ∧
      ∀ (A : Matrix m n ℂ),
        (∀ k, 0 < singularValues A k → singularValues A k ∈ Set.Icc ell 1) →
        ∀ T, 1 ≤ T →
        specNorm (canonicalPartialPolar A - (polarPolynomialHornerIterate (q + 1) c A T).value) ≤
          1 - l T ∧ 1 - l T ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ (((q + 1) + 1) ^ T) ∧
          (polarPolynomialHornerIterate (q + 1) c A T).products = ((q + 1) + 1) * T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, l, u, hg⟩ := exists_isGreedyOddMinimax (q + 1) hell hell1.le
  refine ⟨c, l, u, hg, fun A hA T hT => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨he, hr⟩ := specNorm_polar_sub_greedyOddMatrixIterate_le A hg hell hell1 hA hT
  rw [← polarPolynomialHornerIterate_value] at he
  exact ⟨he, hr, polarPolynomialHornerIterate_products q c A T⟩

name: NLAlib.prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_succAbove _ i.castSucc]
  simp only [resolventWordInsert, Fin.insertNth_apply_same,
    Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]

name: NLAlib.inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i.castSucc ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simpa only [resolventWordInsert, Fin.insertNth_apply_same] using hc i
  · simpa only [resolventWordInsert, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove] using hc k

name: NLAlib.norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le
statement:
theorem norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le {m : ℕ} (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcb : ∀ i, |(w i).1.im|⁻¹ ≤ c) (y : E) :
    ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w y‖ ≤ c ^ m * ∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    let := hn
    have hz : hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, norm_zero]
    positivity
  | inr hn =>
    let := hn
    calc
      _ ≤ ((((List.ofFn w).map
          (fun b => hermitianCoordinateResolvent A b.1 y * b.2)).map norm).prod) :=
        List.norm_prod_le _
      _ = ∏ i : Fin m, ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A (w i).1 y * (w i).2‖ := by
        simp only [List.map_ofFn, List.prod_ofFn, Function.comp_apply]
      _ ≤ ∏ i : Fin m, c * ‖(w i).2‖ := by
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
        intro i _
        have hr : ‖hermitianCoordinateResolvent A (w i).1 y‖ ≤ c := by
          simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
            (specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le A hA (w i).1 (hw i) y).trans (hcb i)
        exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
          Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.norm_fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le {m : ℕ} (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcb : ∀ i, |(w i).1.im|⁻¹ ≤ c) (y : E) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y‖ ≤
      (m : ℝ) * c ^ (m + 1) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro h
  rw [fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA w hw]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
        (resolventWordInsert w i (L h)) y‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin m, c ^ (m + 1) * ‖L h‖ * ∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      convert! norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA
        (resolventWordInsert w i (L h)) (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L h))
        hc (inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert w hcb i (L h)) y using 1
      rw [prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert]
      ring
    _ = (m : ℝ) * c ^ (m + 1) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L h‖ := by simp; ring
    _ ≤ ((m : ℝ) * c ^ (m + 1) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖)) * (‖L‖ * ‖h‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((L).le_opNorm h) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le {m : ℕ} (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcb : ∀ i, |(w i).1.im|⁻¹ ≤ c) (y : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y‖ ≤
      (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * c ^ (m + 2) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (by positivity)
  intro h
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA w hw]
  have hb (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
      ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
        (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 1))) j (L (h 0))) y‖ ≤
        c ^ (m + 2) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ := by
    have hw1 := im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L (h 1))
    have hc1 := inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert w hcb i (L (h 1))
    convert! norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA _
      (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert _ hw1 j (L (h 0))) hc
      (inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert _ hc1 j (L (h 0))) y using 1
    rw [prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert, prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert]
    ring
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1),
        ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 1))) j (L (h 0))) y‖ := by
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => norm_sum_le _ _)
    _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin m, ∑ _ : Fin (m + 1),
        c ^ (m + 2) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hb i j
    _ = (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * c ^ (m + 2) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
        ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ := by simp; ring
    _ ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * c ^ (m + 2) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
        (‖L‖ * ‖h 0‖) * (‖L‖ * ‖h 1‖) := by
      gcongr <;> exact (L).le_opNorm _
    _ = _ := by simp [Fin.prod_univ_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply_le {m : ℕ} (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcb : ∀ i, |(w i).1.im|⁻¹ ≤ c) (y : E) (h : Fin 3 → E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y h‖ ≤
      (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * (m + 2) * c ^ (m + 3) *
        (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A hA w hw]
  have hb (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (k : Fin (m + 2)) :
      ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
        (resolventWordInsert
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
            k (L (h 0))) y‖ ≤
        c ^ (m + 3) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
          ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖ := by
    have hw1 := im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert w hw i (L (h 2))
    have hc1 := inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert w hcb i (L (h 2))
    have hw2 := im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert _ hw1 j (L (h 1))
    have hc2 := inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert _ hc1 j (L (h 1))
    convert! norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A hA _
      (im_ne_zero_resolventWordInsert _ hw2 k (L (h 0))) hc
      (inv_abs_im_le_resolventWordInsert _ hc2 k (L (h 0))) y using 1
    rw [prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert, prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert,
      prod_norm_snd_resolventWordInsert]
    ring
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), ∑ k : Fin (m + 2),
        ‖hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
              k (L (h 0))) y‖ := by
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ =>
        (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => norm_sum_le _ _))
    _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin m, ∑ _ : Fin (m + 1), ∑ _ : Fin (m + 2),
        c ^ (m + 3) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
          ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖ := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hb i j k
    _ = (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * (m + 2) * c ^ (m + 3) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
        ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖ := by simp; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le {m : ℕ} (A : M)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : Fin m → ℂ × M)
    (hw : ∀ i, (w i).1.im ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcb : ∀ i, |(w i).1.im|⁻¹ ≤ c) (y : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A w) y‖ ≤
      (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * (m + 2) * c ^ (m + 3) *
        (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) * ‖L‖ ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (by positivity)
  intro h
  have hb := norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply_le
    A hA w hw hc hcb y h
  calc
    _ ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * (m + 2) * c ^ (m + 3) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
        ‖L (h 0)‖ * ‖L (h 1)‖ * ‖L (h 2)‖ := hb
    _ ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * (m + 2) * c ^ (m + 3) * (∏ i, ‖(w i).2‖) *
        (‖L‖ * ‖h 0‖) * (‖L‖ * ‖h 1‖) * (‖L‖ * ‖h 2‖) := by
      gcongr <;> exact (L).le_opNorm _
    _ = _ := by simp [Fin.prod_univ_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pow_le_pow
statement:
private theorem specNorm_pow_le_pow {A : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ} (hA : specNorm A ≤ q)
    (j : ℕ) : specNorm (A ^ j) ≤ q ^ j
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz : A ^ j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, specNorm_zero]
    exact pow_nonneg ((specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA) j
  | inr hn =>
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm] at *
    exact (norm_pow_le A j).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg A) hA j)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_steinTerm_le
statement:
private theorem specNorm_steinTerm_le {A Q : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ} (hA : specNorm A ≤ q)
    (j : ℕ) : specNorm (A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j) ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ j * specNorm Q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := (specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_pow]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (A ^ j * Q) * specNorm (A ^ j)ᴴ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (q ^ j * specNorm Q) * q ^ j := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact mul_le_mul
        ((specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (specNorm_pow_le_pow hA j) (specNorm_nonneg Q)))
        (specNorm_pow_le_pow hA j) (specNorm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq _) (specNorm_nonneg Q))
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 j, pow_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_steinTerm_le
statement:
private theorem frobNorm_steinTerm_le {A Q : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ} (hA : specNorm A ≤ q)
    (j : ℕ) : frobNorm (A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j) ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ j * frobNorm Q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := (specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_pow]
  calc
    _ ≤ frobNorm (A ^ j * Q) * specNorm (A ^ j)ᴴ := frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _
    _ ≤ (q ^ j * frobNorm Q) * q ^ j := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact mul_le_mul
        ((frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (specNorm_pow_le_pow hA j) (frobNorm_nonneg Q)))
        (specNorm_pow_le_pow hA j) (specNorm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq _) (frobNorm_nonneg Q))
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 j, pow_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_steinGramian_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_steinGramian_le {A Q : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ}
    (hA : specNorm A ≤ q) (hq : q < 1) : specNorm (steinGramian A Q) ≤ specNorm Q / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := (specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA
  have hq2 : |q ^ 2| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg q)]; nlinarith
  have hgeo := (summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq2).mul_right (specNorm Q)
  have hn : Summable (fun j : ℕ => specNorm (A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _) (fun j => specNorm_steinTerm_le hA j) hgeo
  have hnorm : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j‖) := by simpa [specNorm_eq_norm] using hn
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ‖A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, (q ^ 2) ^ j * specNorm Q :=
      hnorm.tsum_le_tsum (by simpa [specNorm_eq_norm] using (fun j => specNorm_steinTerm_le (Q := Q) hA j)) hgeo
    _ = _ := by rw [tsum_mul_right, tsum_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq2]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_steinGramian_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_steinGramian_le {A Q : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ}
    (hA : specNorm A ≤ q) (hq : q < 1) : frobNorm (steinGramian A Q) ≤ frobNorm Q / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := (specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA
  have hq2 : |q ^ 2| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg q)]; nlinarith
  have hgeo := (summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq2).mul_right (frobNorm Q)
  have hn : Summable (fun j : ℕ => frobNorm (A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => frobNorm_nonneg _) (fun j => frobNorm_steinTerm_le hA j) hgeo
  have hnorm : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j‖) := by simpa [frobNorm_eq_norm] using hn
  rw [frobNorm_eq_norm]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ‖A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, (q ^ 2) ^ j * frobNorm Q :=
      hnorm.tsum_le_tsum (by simpa [frobNorm_eq_norm] using (fun j => frobNorm_steinTerm_le (Q := Q) hA j)) hgeo
    _ = _ := by rw [tsum_mul_right, tsum_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq2]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_steinGramian_sub_partialSum_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_steinGramian_sub_partialSum_le {A Q : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ}
    (hA : specNorm A ≤ q) (hq : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    specNorm (steinGramian A Q - steinPartialSum A Q N) ≤
      q ^ (2 * N) * specNorm Q / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := (specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA
  have hs := summable_stein_of_power_bound A Q 1 q zero_le_one hq0 hq
    (by simpa using specNorm_pow_le_pow hA)
  rw [steinGramian_sub_partialSum A Q hs N]
  calc
    _ ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ N * specNorm (steinGramian A Q) := specNorm_steinTerm_le hA N
    _ ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ N * (specNorm Q / (1 - q ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_steinGramian_le hA hq) (pow_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) _)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_steinGramian_sub_partialSum_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_steinGramian_sub_partialSum_le {A Q : Matrix n n K} {q : ℝ}
    (hA : specNorm A ≤ q) (hq : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    frobNorm (steinGramian A Q - steinPartialSum A Q N) ≤
      q ^ (2 * N) * frobNorm Q / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := (specNorm_nonneg A).trans hA
  have hs := summable_stein_of_power_bound A Q 1 q zero_le_one hq0 hq
    (by simpa using specNorm_pow_le_pow hA)
  rw [steinGramian_sub_partialSum A Q hs N]
  calc
    _ ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ N * frobNorm (steinGramian A Q) := frobNorm_steinTerm_le hA N
    _ ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ N * (frobNorm Q / (1 - q ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (frobNorm_steinGramian_le hA hq) (pow_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) _)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul]; ring

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.re_det_le_pow_re_trace_div_card
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.re_det_le_pow_re_trace_div_card
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
    RCLike.re M.det ≤ (RCLike.re M.trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let eig : n → ℝ := hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  let p : ℝ := ∏ i, eig i
  let s : ℝ := ∑ i, eig i
  have heig_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ eig i := fun i => hM.eigenvalues_nonneg i
  have hp_nonneg : 0 ≤ p := by
    dsimp [p]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => heig_nonneg i
  have hcard_ne : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  have htr : RCLike.re M.trace = s := by
    dsimp [s, eig]
    rw [hM.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    exact (congrArg RCLike.re
      (RCLike.ofReal_sum (Finset.univ : Finset n) eig)).symm.trans
      (RCLike.ofReal_re (∑ i, eig i))
  have hdet : M.det = (p : K) := by
    dsimp [p, eig]
    rw [hM.isHermitian.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues]
    exact (RCLike.ofReal_prod (Finset.univ : Finset n) eig).symm
  have ham := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n))
      (w := fun _ : n => (1 : ℝ)) (z := eig)
      (by intro i hi; norm_num)
      (by simpa using (show 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hN))
      (fun i hi => heig_nonneg i)
  have hmain : p ^ ((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ s / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    simpa [p, s] using ham
  have hpownat :
      (p ^ ((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ Fintype.card n ≤
        (s / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg hp_nonneg _) hmain (Fintype.card n)
  have hpowid :
      (p ^ ((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ Fintype.card n = p := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hp_nonneg, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcard_ne,
      Real.rpow_one]
  calc
    RCLike.re M.det = RCLike.re (∏ i, (eig i : K)) := by
          rw [hdet]
          dsimp [p]
          exact congrArg RCLike.re
            (RCLike.ofReal_prod (Finset.univ : Finset n) eig)
    _ = p := by
          dsimp [p]
          exact (congrArg RCLike.re
            (RCLike.ofReal_prod (Finset.univ : Finset n) eig)).symm.trans
            (RCLike.ofReal_re (∏ i, eig i))
    _ ≤ (s / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n := by
          rw [← hpowid]
          exact hpownat
    _ ≤ (RCLike.re M.trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n := by
          rw [htr]

name: NLAlib.determinantTraceObjectiveSet_nonempty
statement:
theorem determinantTraceObjectiveSet_nonempty (M : Matrix n n K) :
    (determinantTraceObjectiveSet M).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨_, 1, Matrix.PosDef.one, Matrix.det_one, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.re_det_le_objective_of_det_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.re_det_le_objective_of_det_one
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosSemidef)
    {Y : Matrix n n K} (hY : Y.PosDef) (hYdet : Y.det = 1) :
    RCLike.re M.det ≤
      (RCLike.re (Y * M).trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Matrix n n K := CFC.sqrt Y
  have hS_herm : S.IsHermitian := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg Y).posSemidef.isHermitian
  have hSM : (S * M * S).PosSemidef := by
    simpa [hS_herm.eq] using hM.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same S
  have hdetS : S.det = 1 := by
    rw [hY.posSemidef.det_sqrt, hYdet]
    simp
  have hdetSMS : (S * M * S).det = M.det := by
    calc
      (S * M * S).det = S.det * M.det * S.det := by
        rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul]
      _ = M.det := by
        rw [hdetS]
        simp
  have htrSMS : (S * M * S).trace = (Y * M).trace := by
    calc
      (S * M * S).trace = (S * S * M).trace := by
        rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
      _ = (Y * M).trace := by
        rw [CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self Y hY.posSemidef.nonneg]
  rw [← hdetSMS, ← htrSMS]
  exact hSM.re_det_le_pow_re_trace_div_card hN

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.re_det_mem_lowerBounds_determinantTraceObjectiveSet
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.re_det_mem_lowerBounds_determinantTraceObjectiveSet
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
    RCLike.re M.det ∈ lowerBounds (determinantTraceObjectiveSet M)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, rfl⟩
  exact hM.re_det_le_objective_of_det_one hN hY hYdet

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.determinantTraceObjectiveSet_bddBelow
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.determinantTraceObjectiveSet_bddBelow
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
    BddBelow (determinantTraceObjectiveSet M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨RCLike.re M.det, hM.re_det_mem_lowerBounds_determinantTraceObjectiveSet hN⟩

name: Matrix.PosDef.exists_det_one_objective_eq_re_det
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.exists_det_one_objective_eq_re_det
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosDef) :
    ∃ Y : Matrix n n K, Y.PosDef ∧ Y.det = 1 ∧
      RCLike.re M.det =
        (RCLike.re (Y * M).trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  let d : ℝ := RCLike.re M.det ^ (1 / c)
  let Y : Matrix n n K := d • M⁻¹
  have hre_pos : 0 < RCLike.re M.det := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hM.det_pos).1
  have him_zero : RCLike.im M.det = 0 := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hM.det_pos).2
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  have hd_pos : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hre_pos _
  have hd_pow : d ^ Fintype.card n = RCLike.re M.det := by
    dsimp [d]
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hre_pos.le, one_div_mul_cancel hc_ne,
      Real.rpow_one]
  have hdet_real : M.det = algebraMap ℝ K (RCLike.re M.det) := by
    refine (RCLike.ext_iff.mpr ?_).symm
    constructor
    · simp
    · simp [him_zero]
  refine ⟨Y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hM.inv.smul hd_pos
  · dsimp [Y]
    rw [Matrix.det_smul_of_tower, hd_pow, Algebra.smul_def, ← hdet_real]
    rw [mul_comm, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv_mul_det (A := M)]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM.det_pos.ne'
  · have hMinvM : M⁻¹ * M = 1 :=
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (A := M) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM.det_pos.ne')
    have hYM : Y * M = d • (1 : Matrix n n K) := by
      calc
        Y * M = (d • M⁻¹) * M := rfl
        _ = d • (M⁻¹ * M) := by rw [Matrix.smul_mul]
        _ = d • (1 : Matrix n n K) := by rw [hMinvM]
    have htr_re : RCLike.re (Y * M).trace = d * c := by
      rw [hYM]
      rw [Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one]
      rw [RCLike.smul_re]
      simp [c]
    have hObj : (RCLike.re (Y * M).trace / c) ^ Fintype.card n =
        RCLike.re M.det := by
      rw [htr_re]
      calc
        (d * c / c) ^ Fintype.card n = d ^ Fintype.card n := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self hc_ne, mul_one]
        _ = RCLike.re M.det := hd_pow
    exact hObj.symm

name: Matrix.PosDef.isLeast_determinantTraceObjectiveSet
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.isLeast_determinantTraceObjectiveSet
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosDef) :
    IsLeast (determinantTraceObjectiveSet M) (RCLike.re M.det)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, hobj⟩ := hM.exists_det_one_objective_eq_re_det hN
  exact ⟨⟨Y, hY, hYdet, hobj⟩,
    hM.posSemidef.re_det_mem_lowerBounds_determinantTraceObjectiveSet hN⟩

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.isGLB_determinantTraceObjectiveSet
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.isGLB_determinantTraceObjectiveSet
    {M : Matrix n n K} (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
    IsGLB (determinantTraceObjectiveSet M) (RCLike.re M.det)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hM.re_det_mem_lowerBounds_determinantTraceObjectiveSet hN, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  have hbound (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
      b ≤ RCLike.re (M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n K)).det := by
    have hreg : (M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n K)).PosDef :=
      Matrix.PosDef.posSemidef_add hM (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hδ)
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, hobj⟩ :=
      hreg.exists_det_one_objective_eq_re_det hN
    have htr_nonneg : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (Y * M).trace :=
      (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef hY.posSemidef hM)).1
    have horder : M ≤ M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n K) :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (smul_nonneg hδ.le zero_le_one)
    have htr_le : RCLike.re (Y * M).trace ≤
        RCLike.re (Y * (M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n K))).trace :=
      RCLike.re_le_re (trace_mul_le_trace_mul_of_posSemidef hY.posSemidef horder)
    have hbY : b ≤
        (RCLike.re (Y * M).trace / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ Fintype.card n :=
      hb ⟨Y, hY, hYdet, rfl⟩
    exact hbY.trans ((pow_le_pow_left₀
      (div_nonneg htr_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right htr_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (Fintype.card n)).trans_eq hobj.symm)
  have hcont : Continuous
      (fun δ : ℝ => RCLike.re (M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n K)).det) :=
    RCLike.continuous_re.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).matrix_det
  have hlim : Tendsto
      (fun δ : ℝ => RCLike.re (M + δ • (1 : Matrix n n K)).det)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (RCLike.re M.det)) := by
    simpa using (hcont.continuousAt (x := (0 : ℝ))).tendsto.mono_left
      (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)
  exact ge_of_tendsto hlim
    (Eventually.mono self_mem_nhdsWithin fun δ hδ => hbound δ hδ)

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_map_neg_neg
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_map_neg_neg
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) (α : ℝ) (S : M) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    matrixKTransform (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α (-S)=
      -matrixKTransform ν α S
proof:
:= by
  have hInv : (-S)⁻¹= -S⁻¹ := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [neg_mul_neg,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)]
  have hmap : (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,matrixKResolvent (-S) T.val
      ∂ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T))=
      ∫ T : selfAdjoint M,matrixKResolvent (-S) (-T).val ∂ν := by
    exact integral_map_equiv (Homeomorph.neg (selfAdjoint M)).toMeasurableEquiv _
  have hker (T : selfAdjoint M) : matrixKResolvent (-S) (-T).val= -matrixKResolvent S T.val := by
    simp only [matrixKResolvent,AddSubgroup.coe_neg,neg_mul_neg,Matrix.neg_mul]
  simp only [matrixKTransform,hmap,hker,integral_neg,hInv,smul_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_reflected_stieltjes_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_reflected_stieltjes_branch
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ H : ℂ → M, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (H z) : M).PosDef ∧
        matrixKTransform (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α (H z)=z•1) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → H z= -(F (-star z))ᴴ) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•H z)=
        ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ.map (fun t : ℝ => -t) : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let η : Measure (selfAdjoint M) := ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)
  have hηc : IsCompact η.support := by
    have hs := Measure.support_map_homeomorph ν (Homeomorph.neg (selfAdjoint M))
    change η.support=(fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T) '' ν.support at hs
    rw [hs]
    exact hν.image continuous_neg
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure η := ν.isProbabilityMeasure_map continuous_neg.measurable.aemeasurable
  obtain ⟨H,hHa,hH0⟩ := exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_upperHalfPlane_solution η hηc α hα
  have hH (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : (imaginaryPart (H z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform η α (H z)=z•1 := ⟨(hH0 z hz).1,(hH0 z hz).2.1⟩
  have heq (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : H z= -(F (-star z))ᴴ := by
    let w : ℂ := -star z
    have hw : 0<w.im := by simpa [w,Complex.star_def] using hz
    have hFdom := mem_matrixKTransformDomain_of_posDef_imaginaryPart ν (hF w hw).1
    have hFstar : IsUnit (F w)ᴴ := by
      simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hFdom.1.star
    have hcandidate : (imaginaryPart (-(F w)ᴴ) : M).PosDef := by
      rw [imaginaryPart_neg_conjTranspose]
      exact (hF w hw).1
    have hK : matrixKTransform η α (-(F w)ᴴ)=z•1 := by
      change matrixKTransform (ν.map (fun T : selfAdjoint M => -T)) α (-(F w)ᴴ)=z•1
      rw [matrixKTransform_map_neg_neg ν α _ hFstar,
        matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α (F w) hFdom,(hF w hw).2]
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,w]
      simp [neg_smul]
    have hZ : (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M).PosDef := by
      have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
      have he : (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)=z.im•1 := by
        simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one]
      rw [he]
      exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hz
    exact matrixKTransform_solution_unique_upperHalfPlane η hηc α hα
      (z•1) (H z) (-(F w)ᴴ) hZ (hH z hz).1 hcandidate (hH z hz).2 hK
  refine ⟨H,hHa,hH,heq,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let w : ℂ := -star z
  have hw : 0<w.im := by simpa [w,Complex.star_def] using hz
  rw [heq z hz,normalizedTrace_real_smul_neg_conjTranspose,hμ w hw]
  have hmap : (∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ.map (fun t : ℝ => -t) : Measure ℝ))=
      ∫ t : ℝ, (((-t : ℝ) : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) :=
    integral_map_equiv (Homeomorph.neg ℝ).toMeasurableEquiv _
  rw [hmap,Complex.star_def,← integral_conj,← integral_neg]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
    simp only [Complex.star_def,map_inv₀,map_sub,Complex.conj_ofReal,w,
      map_neg,Complex.conj_conj,Complex.ofReal_neg]
    rw [← inv_neg]
    congr 1
    ring

name: NLAlib.injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos
statement:
theorem injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : Matrix n n ℂ, H.IsHermitian → H ≠ 0 →
      0 < frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H)) :
    Function.Injective (matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S)
proof:
:= by
  let D := matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S
  have hD (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : D X = matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S X :=
    congrArg (fun L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ => L X)
      (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α S)
  have hherm {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.IsHermitian) : (D H).IsHermitian := by
    rw [hD]
    exact isHermitian_matrixKTransformDeriv ν hν α hα S hS hgap hH
  have hzero (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : D X = 0) : X = 0 := by
    let H : Matrix n n ℂ := realPart X
    let K : Matrix n n ℂ := imaginaryPart X
    have hH : H.IsHermitian := (realPart X).property
    have hK : K.IsHermitian := (imaginaryPart X).property
    have hDH := hherm hH
    have hDK := hherm hK
    have hs : D H + Complex.I • D K = 0 := by
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_add]
      exact (congrArg D (realPart_add_I_smul_imaginaryPart X)).trans hX
    have hsstar := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hs
    have hstarI : star Complex.I = -Complex.I := by simp
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,
      hDH.eq, hDK.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, hstarI] at hsstar
    have hDH₀ : D H = 0 := by
      ext i j
      have h₁ := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i j) hs
      have h₂ := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i j) hsstar
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h₁ h₂
      simp only [Matrix.zero_apply]
      linear_combination (1/2 : ℂ) * h₁ + (1/2 : ℂ) * h₂
    have hDK₀ : D K = 0 := by
      rw [hDH₀, zero_add] at hs
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left Complex.I_ne_zero
    have hH₀ : H = 0 := by
      by_contra hh
      have hp := hpos H hH hh
      rw [← hD H, hDH₀, frobInner_zero_right] at hp
      exact lt_irrefl _ hp
    have hK₀ : K = 0 := by
      by_contra hh
      have hp := hpos K hK hh
      rw [← hD K, hDK₀, frobInner_zero_right] at hp
      exact lt_irrefl _ hp
    have hdec : H + Complex.I • K = X := realPart_add_I_smul_imaginaryPart X
    rw [hH₀,hK₀,smul_zero,add_zero] at hdec
    exact hdec.symm
  intro X Y hXY
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero (X-Y) (by rw [map_sub,hXY,sub_self]))

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : Matrix n n ℂ, H.IsHermitian → H ≠ 0 →
      0 < frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (u : ℝ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S = (u : ℂ) • 1) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧ G u = S ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), G z ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (G z) = z • 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdomain : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS.isUnit, fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgap T hT)⟩
  let D := matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S
  have hinj : Function.Injective D :=
    injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos
  let e : Matrix n n ℂ ≃L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective D.toLinearMap
      ⟨hinj, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (e : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ) S := by
    convert! hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdomain using 1
  have hc := contDiffAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdomain
  let Q := hc.localInverse hderiv one_ne_zero
  let G : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun z => Q (z • 1)
  have hQ := hc.to_localInverse hderiv one_ne_zero
  have hQc : ContinuousAt Q ((u : ℂ) • 1) := by
    rw [← hK]
    exact hQ.continuousAt
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℂ 1 G (u : ℂ) := by
    apply ContDiffAt.comp (u : ℂ) (g := Q) (f := fun z : ℂ => z • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
    · rwa [← hK]
    · exact contDiffAt_id.smul contDiffAt_const
  have hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) :=
    Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mpr
      ((hG.eventually (by simp)).mono fun _ h => h.differentiableAt one_ne_zero)
  have hG₀ : G u = S := by
    change Q ((u : ℂ) • 1) = S
    rw [← hK]
    exact hc.localInverse_apply_image hderiv one_ne_zero
  refine ⟨G,hGa,hG₀,?_⟩
  have hcont : Tendsto G (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [hG₀] using hGa.continuousAt.tendsto
  have heq := (hc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hderiv one_ne_zero).eventually_right_inverse
  have hZ : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
      (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) (𝓝 (matrixKTransform ν α S)) := by
    rw [hK]
    exact (continuous_id.smul continuous_const).continuousAt
  filter_upwards [hcont.eventually ((isOpen_matrixKTransformDomain ν hν).mem_nhds hdomain),
    hZ.eventually heq] with z hz hsolve
  exact ⟨hz,hsolve⟩

name: operatorConvexOn_finite
statement:
private lemma operatorConvexOn_finite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn I f)
    (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hAsp : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I) (hHsp : spectrum ℝ H ⊆ I)
    (t : ℝ) (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1) :
    (cfc f (t • A + (1-t) • H)) ≤
      (t • cfc f A + (1-t) • cfc f H)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let R : Matrix ι ι ℂ → Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) ℂ :=
    Matrix.reindex e e
  have h := hf.2 (Fintype.card ι) (R A) (R H)
    (hA.reindex e) (hH.reindex e) (by rwa [spectrum_reindex]) (by rwa [spectrum_reindex])
    t ht₀ ht₁
  have hmix : (t • A + (1-t) • H).IsHermitian :=
    (hA.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t)).add (hH.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all (1-t)))
  change (t • cfc f (R A) + (1-t) • cfc f (R H) - cfc f (t • R A + (1-t) • R H)).PosSemidef at h
  have hm : t • R A + (1-t) • R H = R (t • A + (1-t) • H) := by
    simp [R, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_add, Matrix.submatrix_smul]
  rw [hm, cfc_reindex_of_isHermitian e f A hA, cfc_reindex_of_isHermitian e f H hH,
    cfc_reindex_of_isHermitian e f _ hmix] at h
  have hh := h.submatrix e
  simpa [R, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix,
    Matrix.submatrix_add, Matrix.submatrix_sub, Matrix.submatrix_smul] using hh

name: pinching
statement:
private lemma pinching {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ]
    (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn I f)
    (X : Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) ℂ) (hX : X.IsHermitian)
    (hXI : spectrum ℝ X ⊆ I) :
    (cfc f (X.submatrix Sum.inr Sum.inr)) ≤
      ((cfc f X).submatrix Sum.inr Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  let V : Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) ℂ := Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 (-1)
  have hV : V.conjTranspose = V := by simp [V, Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose]
  have hV2 : V * V = 1 := by
    simp [V, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, ← Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  have hh := operatorConvexOn_finite I f hf X (V * X * V) hX
    (isHermitian_reflection_conj V X hV hX) hXI (by rwa [spectrum_reflection_conj V X hV hV2])
    (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hmid : (1/2 : ℝ) • X + (1 - (1/2 : ℝ)) • (V * X * V) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (X.submatrix Sum.inl Sum.inl) 0 0 (X.submatrix Sum.inr Sum.inr) := by
    rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks X]
    simp only [V, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, one_mul, mul_one, neg_mul, mul_neg]
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp <;> ring
  rw [Matrix.le_iff] at hh
  rw [hmid, (cfc_fromBlocks _ _ (hX.submatrix _) (hX.submatrix _) f).2.2] at hh
  have hr := hh.submatrix Sum.inr
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  convert hr using 1
  rw [cfc_reflection_conj V X hV hV2 hX f]
  ext i j
  simp [V, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.one_apply]
  ring

name: isometry_reflection_identities
statement:
private theorem isometry_reflection_identities
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (K : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hK : K.conjTranspose * K = 1)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    let U
proof:
:= Matrix.fromBlocks (1 - K * K.conjTranspose) K K.conjTranspose 0
    U.IsHermitian ∧ U * U = 1 ∧
      (U * Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B * U).toBlocks₂₂ = K.conjTranspose * A * K := by
  let P := 1 - K * K.conjTranspose
  have hP : P.IsHermitian := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hPK : P * K = 0 := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hK, Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]
  have hKP : K.conjTranspose * P = 0 := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hK, Matrix.one_mul, sub_self]
  have hPP : P * P + K * K.conjTranspose = 1 := by
    calc
      P * P + K * K.conjTranspose = P - (P * K) * K.conjTranspose + K * K.conjTranspose := by
        rw [show P * P = P * (1 - K * K.conjTranspose) from rfl,
          Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hPK]; simp [P]
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hP.fromBlocks rfl (Matrix.isHermitian_zero), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    change Matrix.fromBlocks (P * P + K * K.conjTranspose) (P * K + K * 0)
      (K.conjTranspose * P + 0 * K.conjTranspose) (K.conjTranspose * K + 0 * 0) = 1
    simp only [hPP, hPK, hKP, hK, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact Matrix.fromBlocks_one
  · simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.toBlocks_fromBlocks₂₂,
      Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn I f)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I)
    (K : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hK : K.conjTranspose * K = 1) :
    (cfc f (K.conjTranspose * A * K)) ≤
      (K.conjTranspose * cfc f A * K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.spectrum_nonempty (R := ℝ) A hA
  let B : Matrix κ κ ℂ := algebraMap ℝ _ c
  have hB : B.IsHermitian := by
    change (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix κ κ ℂ) c).IsHermitian
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all c)
  let D := Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B
  have hD := cfc_fromBlocks A B hA hB f
  have hDI : spectrum ℝ D ⊆ I := by
    rw [hD.2.1]
    apply Set.union_subset hAI
    change spectrum ℝ (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix κ κ ℂ) c) ⊆ I
    rw [spectrum.scalar_eq]
    exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (hAI hc)
  let U := Matrix.fromBlocks (1 - K * K.conjTranspose) K K.conjTranspose 0
  have hr := isometry_reflection_identities K hK A B
  have hu : U.conjTranspose = U := hr.1
  have hu2 : U * U = 1 := hr.2.1
  have hp := pinching I f hf (U * D * U) (isHermitian_reflection_conj U D hu hD.1)
    (by rwa [spectrum_reflection_conj U D hu hu2])
  have hcorner : (U * D * U).submatrix Sum.inr Sum.inr = K.conjTranspose * A * K := hr.2.2
  rw [hcorner, cfc_reflection_conj U D hu hu2 hD.1 f] at hp
  have hcfc : (U * cfc f D * U).submatrix Sum.inr Sum.inr =
      K.conjTranspose * cfc f A * K := by
    rw [show cfc f D = Matrix.fromBlocks (cfc f A) 0 0 (cfc f B) from hD.2.2]
    exact (isometry_reflection_identities K hK (cfc f A) (cfc f B)).2.2
  rw [hcfc] at hp
  exact hp

name: NLAlib.polarGramHorner_value
statement:
theorem polarGramHorner_value (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (polarGramHorner q a S).value = ∑ j ∈ range (q + 1), a j • S ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Nat.twoStepInduction generalizing a with
  | zero => simp [polarGramHorner]
  | one => simp [polarGramHorner, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  | more q _ ih =>
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    rw [polarGramHorner, ih]
    simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul, ← pow_succ']
    rw [add_comm]

name: NLAlib.polarGramHorner_products
statement:
theorem polarGramHorner_products (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (polarGramHorner (q + 1) a S).products = q
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing a with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ q ih => simp only [polarGramHorner, ih]

name: NLAlib.polarPolynomialHorner_value
statement:
theorem polarPolynomialHorner_value (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (X : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (polarPolynomialHorner q a X).value = oddMatrixUpdate q a X
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polarPolynomialHorner, polarGramHorner_value, oddMatrixUpdate,
    Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul]

name: NLAlib.polarPolynomialHorner_products
statement:
theorem polarPolynomialHorner_products (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (X : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (polarPolynomialHorner (q + 1) a X).products = (q + 1) + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polarPolynomialHorner, polarGramHorner_products]

name: NLAlib.polarPolynomialHornerIterate_value
statement:
theorem polarPolynomialHornerIterate_value (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (polarPolynomialHornerIterate q a A k).value = oddMatrixIterate q a A k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [polarPolynomialHornerIterate, polarPolynomialHorner_value, ih, oddMatrixIterate]

name: NLAlib.polarPolynomialHornerIterate_products
statement:
theorem polarPolynomialHornerIterate_products (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (polarPolynomialHornerIterate (q + 1) a A k).products = ((q + 1) + 1) * k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [polarPolynomialHornerIterate]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [polarPolynomialHornerIterate, polarPolynomialHorner_products, ih]
    ring

name: cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate_on_finset
statement:
private theorem cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate_on_finset
    {𝕜 τ : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ]
    (M : Matrix τ τ 𝕜) (hM : M.IsHermitian) (s : Finset ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hm : spectrum ℝ M ⊆ (s : Set ℝ)) :
    cfc f M = Polynomial.aeval M (Lagrange.interpolate s id f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← cfc_polynomial _ M hM]
  exact cfc_congr fun x hx => (Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node
    (v := id) f (Set.injOn_id _) (hm hx)).symm

name: NLAlib.cfc_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem NLAlib.cfc_fromBlocks
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (B : Matrix κ κ 𝕜)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B).IsHermitian ∧
    spectrum ℝ (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) = spectrum ℝ A ∪ spectrum ℝ B ∧
    cfc f (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (cfc f A) 0 0 (cfc f B)
proof:
:= by
  have hblock := hA.fromBlocks (B := (0 : Matrix ι κ 𝕜)) (C := 0) (by simp) hB
  have hspec : spectrum ℝ (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) = spectrum ℝ A ∪ spectrum ℝ B := by
    ext r
    have heq : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) 𝕜) r -
        Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B =
        Matrix.fromBlocks (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix ι ι 𝕜) r - A) 0 0
          (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix κ κ 𝕜) r - B) := by
      ext i j
      cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Matrix.algebraMap_eq_diagonal, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.diagonal]
    simp only [Set.mem_union, spectrum.mem_iff, heq, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det,
      Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, mul_ne_zero_iff, not_and_or]
  refine ⟨hblock, hspec, ?_⟩
  classical
  let s := Finset.univ.image hA.eigenvalues ∪ Finset.univ.image hB.eigenvalues
  let p := Lagrange.interpolate s id f
  have hs : spectrum ℝ A ∪ spectrum ℝ B = (s : Set ℝ) := by
    simp only [s, Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ,
      Set.image_univ, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues,
      hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  rw [cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate_on_finset _ hblock s f (by rw [hspec, hs]),
    cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate_on_finset A hA s f (by rw [← hs]; exact Set.subset_union_left),
    cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate_on_finset B hB s f (by rw [← hs]; exact Set.subset_union_right)]
  have hp := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply
    ((blockHom (𝕜 := 𝕜) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).toAlgHom.restrictScalars ℝ) (A, B) p
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_prod_apply] at hp
  exact hp

name: ConcaveOn.apply_add_le_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsum : x+y=0
  · have hx0 : x=0 := by linarith
    have hy0 : y=0 := by linarith
    simp [hx0, hy0, hf0]
  have hs : 0 < x+y := lt_of_le_of_ne (add_nonneg hx hy) (Ne.symm hsum)
  have hab : x/(x+y)+y/(x+y)=1 := by rw [← add_div, div_self hsum]
  have heq₁ : (x/(x+y)) • (x+y) + (y/(x+y)) • (0 : ℝ) = x := by simp [smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsum]
  have heq₂ : (y/(x+y)) • (x+y) + (x/(x+y)) • (0 : ℝ) = y := by simp [smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsum]
  have h₁ := hf.2 hs.le (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 0 by norm_num)
    (div_nonneg hx hs.le) (div_nonneg hy hs.le) hab
  have h₂ := hf.2 hs.le (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 0 by norm_num)
    (div_nonneg hy hs.le) (div_nonneg hx hs.le) (by linarith : y/(x+y)+x/(x+y)=1)
  rw [heq₁, hf0, smul_zero, add_zero] at h₁
  rw [heq₂, hf0, smul_zero, add_zero] at h₂
  have h := add_le_add h₁ h₂
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.le_algebraMap_norm_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem le_algebraMap_norm_of_isHermitian {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    H ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) ‖H‖
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl he => exact (Subsingleton.elim H (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) ‖H‖)).le
  | inr hn =>
    apply (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hH).mpr
    intro x hx
    exact (le_abs_self x).trans (spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hx)

name: NLAlib.norm_le_of_isHermitian_of_order_bounds
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_isHermitian_of_order_bounds {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hl : algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) (-c) ≤ H)
    (hu : H ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) c) : ‖H‖ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) H‖ ≤ c := by
    apply norm_cfc_le hc
    intro x hx
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨(algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum hH).mp hl x hx,
      (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hH).mp hu x hx⟩
  calc
    ‖H‖ = ‖cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) H‖ := by congr 1; exact (cfc_id' ℝ H hH).symm
    _ ≤ c := hn

name: NLAlib.norm_cfc_sub_le_of_monotone_concave
statement:
private theorem norm_cfc_sub_le_of_monotone_concave {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f) (hf0 : f 0=0) (hfn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ f t)
    (hm : ∀ A B : Matrix n n 𝕜, A.PosSemidef → B.PosSemidef → A ≤ B → cfc f A ≤ cfc f B)
    {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    ‖cfc f A - cfc f B‖ ≤ f ‖A-B‖
proof:
:= by
  have hup (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
      cfc f A ≤ cfc f B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) (f ‖A-B‖) := by
    let t := ‖A-B‖
    have hfin (q : ℝ → ℝ) : ContinuousOn q (spectrum ℝ B) := B.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn q
    have ht : 0 ≤ t := norm_nonneg _
    have hBt : (B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) t).PosSemidef :=
      hB.add ((show (0 : Matrix n n 𝕜) ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) t from
        by simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
          (show (0 : Matrix n n 𝕜) ≤ t • 1 from smul_nonneg ht zero_le_one)).posSemidef)
    have hcmp : A ≤ B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) t := by
      have h := le_algebraMap_norm_of_isHermitian (hA.isHermitian.sub hB.isHermitian)
      exact (sub_le_iff_le_add').mp h
    have hshift : cfc f (B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) t) = cfc (fun x => f (x+t)) B := by
      have hi : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x+t) B = B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) t := by
        calc
          _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) t :=
            cfc_add_const t _ B (hfin _) hB.isHermitian
          _ = _ := by congr 1; exact cfc_id' ℝ B hB.isHermitian
      calc
        _ = cfc f (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x+t) B) := congrArg (cfc f) hi.symm
        _ = _ := (cfc_comp f (fun x : ℝ => x+t) B hB.isHermitian
          ((B.finite_real_spectrum.image _).continuousOn _) (hfin _)).symm
    have hscalar : cfc (fun x => f (x+t)) B ≤ cfc f B + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) (f t) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ cfc (fun x => f x + f t) B := by
          apply cfc_mono (hf := hfin _) (hg := hfin _)
          intro x hx
          exact hc.apply_add_le_of_nonneg hf0 (spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hB.nonneg hx) ht
        _ = _ := cfc_add_const (f t) f B (hfin _) hB.isHermitian
    exact (hm A _ hA hBt hcmp).trans (hshift ▸ hscalar)
  apply norm_le_of_isHermitian_of_order_bounds
    ((show (cfc f A).IsHermitian from cfc_predicate _ _).sub (cfc_predicate _ _))
    (hfn _ (norm_nonneg _))
  · have h := hup B A hB hA
    rw [norm_sub_rev B A] at h
    rw [map_neg]
    exact (neg_le_sub_iff_le_add).mpr h
  · exact (sub_le_iff_le_add').mpr (hup A B hA hB)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_cfc_sub_le_of_operatorMonotoneOn_nonneg
statement:
theorem specNorm_cfc_sub_le_of_operatorMonotoneOn_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hm : OperatorMonotoneOn (Ici 0) f) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ici 0))
    (hf0 : f 0=0) (hfn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ f t)
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    specNorm (cfc f A-cfc f B) ≤ f (specNorm (A-B))
proof:
:= by
  change ‖cfc f A-cfc f B‖ ≤ f ‖A-B‖
  have hmono (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
      (hAB : A ≤ B) : cfc f A ≤ cfc f B := by
    apply hm.cfc_le hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian _ _ hAB
    · exact fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hA.nonneg hx
    · exact fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hB.nonneg hx
  convert! norm_cfc_sub_le_of_monotone_concave (𝕜 := ℂ) (hm.concaveOn_nonneg hf) hf0 hfn
    hmono hA hB using 1

name: NLAlib.specNorm_cfc_sub_le_of_operatorMonotoneOn_nonneg_real
statement:
theorem specNorm_cfc_sub_le_of_operatorMonotoneOn_nonneg_real {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hm : OperatorMonotoneOn (Ici 0) f) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ici 0))
    (hf0 : f 0=0) (hfn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ f t)
    {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    specNorm (cfc f A-cfc f B) ≤ f (specNorm (A-B))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
  apply norm_cfc_sub_le_of_monotone_concave (hm.concaveOn_nonneg hf) hf0 hfn ?_ hA hB
  intro A B hA hB hAB
  apply (realMatrixComplexification_le_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) _ _).mp
  rw [realMatrixComplexification_cfc f hA.isHermitian,
    realMatrixComplexification_cfc f hB.isHermitian]
  have hAc := (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) A).mpr hA
  have hBc := (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (𝕜 := ℂ) B).mpr hB
  exact hm.cfc_le hAc.isHermitian hBc.isHermitian
    (fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hAc.nonneg hx)
    (fun _ hx => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hBc.nonneg hx)
    ((realMatrixComplexification_le_iff A B).mpr hAB)

name: NLAlib.traceWordMultilinear_apply

theorem traceWordMultilinear_apply {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

name: NLAlib.norm_traceWordMultilinear_le_of_bound
statement:
theorem norm_traceWordMultilinear_le_of_bound {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {k : ℕ} (Z : Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ) {R : ℝ}
    (hZ : ∀ j, specNorm (Z j) ≤ R) :
    ‖traceWordMultilinear Z‖ ≤ ‖traceWordMultilinearCoefficients (n := n) k‖ * R ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have h := (traceWordMultilinearCoefficients (n := n) k).le_opNorm_mul_prod_of_le
    (b := fun _ => R) (fun j => by simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using hZ j)
