name: NLAlib.coefficientSandwichSum_apply
statement:
theorem coefficientSandwichSum_apply (A : ι → M) (x : M) :
    coefficientSandwichSum A x=∑ i, A i*x*(A i)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientSandwichSum]

name: NLAlib.norm_coefficientSandwichSum_le
statement:
theorem norm_coefficientSandwichSum_le (A : ι → M) :
    ‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖≤∑ i, specNorm (A i)^2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ M (A i) (A i)ᴴ‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖A i‖*‖(A i)ᴴ‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mulLeftRight_apply_apply_le ℂ M _ _
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose, pow_two]; rfl

name: NLAlib.coefficientSandwichSum_apply_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem coefficientSandwichSum_apply_of_isHermitian
    (A : ι → M) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (x : M) :
    coefficientSandwichSum A x=∑ i, A i*x*A i
proof:

name: NLAlib.coefficientSandwichSum_nonneg

theorem coefficientSandwichSum_nonneg (A : ι → M) {x : M} (hx : 0≤x) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.strictConvexOn_trace_inv
statement:
theorem strictConvexOn_trace_inv :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ {A : Matrix n n ℝ | A.PosDef} (fun A => A⁻¹.trace)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_setOf_posDef, ?_⟩
  intro A hA B hB hAB a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨S, d, hS, hAA, hBB, hd⟩ := exists_positive_definite_pair_congruence hA hB
  let L := Sᵀ⁻¹
  let w : n → ℝ := fun i => (Lᵀ * L) i i
  have hLu : IsUnit L := Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr ((Matrix.isUnit_transpose S).mpr hS)
  have hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i := by
    have hG : (Lᵀ * L).PosDef := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        Matrix.PosDef.conjTranspose_mul_self L (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hLu)
    exact fun i => hG.diag_pos (i := i)
  have hLt : Lᵀ = S⁻¹ := by simp only [L, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hAi : A⁻¹.trace = ∑ i, w i := by
    have he : A⁻¹ = L * Lᵀ := by rw [hAA, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hLt]
    rw [he, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hBi : B⁻¹.trace = ∑ i, (d i)⁻¹ * w i := by
    rw [hBB, inv_congruence_diagonal S d (fun i => (hd i).ne')]
    change (L * diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹) * S⁻¹).trace = _
    rw [← hLt, trace_congruence_diagonal]
  have hCi : (a • A + b • B)⁻¹.trace = ∑ i, (a + b * d i)⁻¹ * w i := by
    rw [smul_add_smul_eq_congruence_diagonal hAA hBB,
      inv_congruence_diagonal S _ (fun i => (add_pos ha (mul_pos hb (hd i))).ne')]
    change (L * diagonal (fun i => (a + b * d i)⁻¹) * S⁻¹).trace = _
    rw [← hLt, trace_congruence_diagonal]
  have hle (i : n) : (a + b * d i)⁻¹ * w i ≤ a * w i + b * ((d i)⁻¹ * w i) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (a + b * (d i)⁻¹) * w i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (inv_affine_le_affine_inv_and_lt_of_ne ha hb hab (hd i)).1 (hw i).le
      _ = _ := by ring
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, d i ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    apply hAB
    have hd1 : d = fun _ => 1 := funext hnone
    rw [hAA, hBB, hd1, Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hlt : (a + b * d i)⁻¹ * w i < a * w i + b * ((d i)⁻¹ * w i) := by
    calc
      _ < (a + b * (d i)⁻¹) * w i := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
        ((inv_affine_le_affine_inv_and_lt_of_ne ha hb hab (hd i)).2 hi) (hw i)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hsum := Finset.sum_lt_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n))
    (fun i _ => hle i) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hlt⟩
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hAi, hBi, hCi]
  simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] using hsum

name: NLAlib.trace_inv_smul_add_le
statement:
theorem trace_inv_smul_add_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    (a • A + b • B)⁻¹.trace ≤ a * A⁻¹.trace + b * B⁻¹.trace
proof:
:=
  strictConvexOn_trace_inv.convexOn.2 hA hB ha hb hab

name: NLAlib.trace_inv_smul_add_eq_iff
statement:
theorem trace_inv_smul_add_eq_iff {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    (a • A + b • B)⁻¹.trace = a * A⁻¹.trace + b * B⁻¹.trace ↔ A = B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_contra hne
    have h := strictConvexOn_trace_inv.2 hA hB hne ha hb hab
    change (a • A + b • B)⁻¹.trace < a * A⁻¹.trace + b * B⁻¹.trace at h
    linarith
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_left_mul_mixed_resolvent_curve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_left_mul_mixed_resolvent_curve
    {X : ℝ → M} {H : M} {t : ℝ} (hX : HasDerivAt X H t)
    (hXt : (X t).IsHermitian) (C : M) (ζ ω : ℂ)
    (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (hω : ω.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => normalizedTrace
      (C * resolvent (X u) ζ ^ a * resolvent (X u) ω ^ b))
      (mixedResolventTraceInsertion (X t) C H ζ ω a b) t
proof:
:= by
  have hr (r : ℂ) (hr : r.im ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt
      (fun u : ℝ => resolvent (X u) r)
      (resolvent (X t) r * H * resolvent (X t) r) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, rationalBlockMap_apply, rationalBlockDifference_resolvent,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars'] using
      (((hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian r (X t) hXt hr).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt t hX)
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    ((normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M C)
  have hd := T.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    (hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_of_sandwich H (hr ζ hζ) (hr ω hω) a b)
  simpa only [T, Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
    normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',
    mixedResolventTraceInsertion, Matrix.mul_add, Finset.mul_sum, normalizedTrace,
    Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sum, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hd

name: NLAlib.contDiff_mixed_resolvent_coordinate
statement:
private theorem contDiff_mixed_resolvent_coordinate (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ ω : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (hω : ω.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun y : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ a * resolvent (A + L y) ω ^ b))
proof:
:= by
  let w : Fin (a + b) → ℂ × M :=
    Fin.append (fun _ : Fin a => (ζ, 1)) (fun _ : Fin b => (ω, 1))
  have hw : ∀ j, (w j).1.im ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun _ => ?_) (fun _ => ?_) j
    · simpa only [w, Fin.append_left] using hζ
    · simpa only [w, Fin.append_right] using hω
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
  simpa only [T, Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
    hermitianCoordinateResolventWord, hermitianCoordinateResolvent, w,
    List.ofFn_fin_append, List.map_append, List.prod_append, List.ofFn_const,
    List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate, mul_one] using
      T.contDiff.comp (contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA w hw)

name: NLAlib.fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_cyclic_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_cyclic_apply
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ ω : ℂ)
    (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (hω : ω.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) (y h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ a * resolvent (A + L x) ω ^ b)) y h =
      (a : ℝ) • normalizedTrace
        (L h * resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ (a + 1) * resolvent (A + L y) ω ^ b) +
      (b : ℝ) • normalizedTrace
        (L h * resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ a * resolvent (A + L y) ω ^ (b + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • h) h 0 := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const h |>.const_add y
  have hX : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A + L (y + t • h)) (L h) 0 :=
    ((L).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hl).const_add A
  have hd := hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_curve hX
    (by simpa using hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates y)) ζ ω hζ hω a b
  have hc := contDiff_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ ω hζ hω a b
  have he := (hc.differentiable (by simp) (y + (0 : ℝ) • h)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hl
  have hu := he.unique (by simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hd)
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hu

name: NLAlib.fderiv_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_cyclic_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_cyclic_apply
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ ω : ℂ)
    (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (hω : ω.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) (y h k : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ a * resolvent (A + L x) ω ^ b))) y k h =
      (a : ℝ) • mixedResolventTraceInsertion (A + L y) (L h) (L k) ζ ω (a + 1) b +
      (b : ℝ) • mixedResolventTraceInsertion (A + L y) (L h) (L k) ζ ω a (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let f : E → ℂ := fun x => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ a * resolvent (A + L x) ω ^ b)
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f := contDiff_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ ω hζ hω a b
  have hdfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fderiv ℝ f) := hc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • k) k 0 := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const k |>.const_add y
  have hX : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A + L (y + t • k)) (L k) 0 :=
    ((L).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hl).const_add A
  have hXt : (A + L (y + (0 : ℝ) • k)).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates y)
  have h₁ := hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_left_mul_mixed_resolvent_curve hX hXt
    (L h) ζ ω hζ hω (a + 1) b
  have h₂ := hasDerivAt_normalizedTrace_left_mul_mixed_resolvent_curve hX hXt
    (L h) ζ ω hζ hω a (b + 1)
  let ev : (E →L[ℝ] ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℂ h
  have hv := (ev.hasFDerivAt.comp (y + (0 : ℝ) • k)
    (hdfc.differentiable (by simp) (y + (0 : ℝ) • k)).hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt 0 hl
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => ev (fderiv ℝ f (y + t • k))) =
      fun t : ℝ => (a : ℝ) • normalizedTrace
        (L h * resolvent (A + L (y + t • k)) ζ ^ (a + 1) * resolvent (A + L (y + t • k)) ω ^ b) +
        (b : ℝ) • normalizedTrace
        (L h * resolvent (A + L (y + t • k)) ζ ^ a * resolvent (A + L (y + t • k)) ω ^ (b + 1)) := by
    funext t
    exact fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_cyclic_apply A hA ζ ω hζ hω a b _ h
  have hv' : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ev (fderiv ℝ f (y + t • k)))
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y k h) 0 := by
    simpa only [ev, Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply, zero_smul, add_zero] using hv
  have hd := (h₁.const_smul (a : ℝ)).add (h₂.const_smul (b : ℝ))
  have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ev (fderiv ℝ f (y + t • k)))
      ((a : ℝ) • mixedResolventTraceInsertion (A + L y) (L h) (L k) ζ ω (a + 1) b +
       (b : ℝ) • mixedResolventTraceInsertion (A + L y) (L h) (L k) ζ ω a (b + 1)) 0 := by
    rw [heq]
    simpa +instances only [Pi.add_def, Pi.smul_def, Function.comp_def, zero_smul, add_zero] using! hd
  exact hv'.unique hd'

name: NLAlib.eventually_isHermitian_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch
statement:
theorem eventually_isHermitian_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (u : ℝ) (G : ℂ → M) (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ)) (hG0 : G u=S)
    (hGeq : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), G z∈matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (G z)=z•1) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝 u, (G x).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : S∈matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgap T hT)⟩
  let D := matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S
  have hinj : Function.Injective D :=
    injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos
  let e : M ≃L[ℂ] M := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective D.toLinearMap
    ⟨hinj,LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (e : M →L[ℂ] M) S := by
    convert! hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom using 1
  have hc := contDiffAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom
  have hs := hc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hderiv one_ne_zero
  let Q := hs.localInverse (matrixKTransform ν α) e S
  have hleft : ∀ᶠ X in 𝓝 S, Q (matrixKTransform ν α X)=X := hs.eventually_left_inverse
  have hx : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) (𝓝 u) (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto u
  have hGlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => G x) (𝓝 u) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [hG0,Function.comp_def] using hGa.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx
  have hGstar : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (G x)ᴴ) (𝓝 u) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,hS.isHermitian.eq] using hGlim.star
  filter_upwards [hGlim.eventually hleft,hGstar.eventually hleft,hx.eventually hGeq]
    with x hx1 hx2 hsolve
  change (G x)ᴴ=G x
  calc
    _ = Q (matrixKTransform ν α (G x)ᴴ) := hx2.symm
    _ = Q (matrixKTransform ν α (G x)) := by
      rw [matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α (G x) hsolve.1,hsolve.2]
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
        Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_ofReal]
    _ = _ := hx1

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (u : ℝ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1) :
    ∃ (G : ℂ → M) (B : M), AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧ G u=S ∧ B.PosDef ∧
      HasDerivAt G B (u : ℂ) ∧
      (∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝 u, (G x).IsHermitian) ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), G z∈matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (G z)=z•1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,B,hGa,hG0,hB,hGd,hGeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_posDef_deriv ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos u hK
  exact ⟨G,B,hGa,hG0,hB,hGd,
    eventually_isHermitian_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos
      u G hGa hG0 hGeq,hGeq⟩

name: NLAlib.matrix_norm_one_le
statement: private theorem matrix_norm_one_le : ‖(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    have hz : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hz]
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    simp

name: NLAlib.norm_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le
statement:
theorem norm_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ (L.map (fun A => ‖A‖)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simpa using (matrix_norm_one_le (n := n))
  | cons A L ih =>
    rw [orderedMatrixComplexPower_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul
      (norm_matrixComplexPower_le_of_re_eq_one (hL A (by simp)) (by simp))
      (ih (fun B hB => hL B (by simp [hB]))) (norm_nonneg _ ) (norm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.continuous_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right
statement:
theorem continuous_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I))
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact continuous_const
  | cons A L ih =>
    exact (continuous_matrixComplexPower_right (hL A (by simp))).mul
      (ih (fun B hB => hL B (by simp [hB])))

    ∀ A ∈ regularizeMatrixList L ε, A.PosDef
proof:
:= by

:= by

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize
statement:
theorem continuousAt_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    ContinuousAt (fun ε : ℝ => orderedMatrixComplexPower (regularizeMatrixList L ε) z) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact continuousAt_const
  | cons A L ih =>
    exact (continuousAt_matrixComplexPower_add_ofReal_smul_one (hL A (by simp)) hz).mul
      (ih (fun B hB => hL B (by simp [hB])))

name: NLAlib.norm_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le
statement:
theorem norm_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖orderedMatrixComplexPower (regularizeMatrixList L ε) (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      (L.map (fun A => ‖A‖ + 1)).prod
proof:
:= by
  apply (norm_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le _
    (posSemidef_mem_regularizeMatrixList L hL hε.1) t).trans
  unfold regularizeMatrixList
  rw [List.map_map]
  apply List.prod_map_le_prod_map₀ _ _ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
  intro A hA
  have hn : ‖A + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖A‖ + 1 := by
    apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
    apply add_le_add le_rfl
    rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hε.1]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left matrix_norm_one_le hε.1).trans (by simpa using hε.2)
  exact hn

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p ε : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hε : ε ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower (regularizeMatrixList L ε)
      (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p ≤
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * (L.map (fun A => ‖A‖ + 1)).prod
proof:
:= by
  apply (schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm _ hp).trans
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (norm_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le L hL hε t)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_right_le
    (L : List (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, A.PosSemidef)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (t : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (orderedMatrixComplexPower L (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) p ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * (L.map (fun A => ‖A‖ + 1)).prod
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [regularizeMatrixList_zero] using
    schattenNormReal_orderedMatrixComplexPower_regularize_right_le L hL hp
      (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 by constructor <;> norm_num) t

name: NLAlib.rankOneSparsificationFactor_eq_sq_div_sq
statement:
theorem rankOneSparsificationFactor_eq_sq_div_sq {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    rankOneSparsificationFactor d =
      (Real.sqrt d + 1) ^ 2 / (Real.sqrt d - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold rankOneSparsificationFactor
  have hnum : d + 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt d = (Real.sqrt d + 1) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hd]
  have hden : d + 1 - 2 * Real.sqrt d = (Real.sqrt d - 1) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hd]
  rw [hnum, hden]

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_rankOneSparsificationFactor
statement:
theorem continuousAt_rankOneSparsificationFactor {d : ℝ} (hd : 1 < d) :
    ContinuousAt rankOneSparsificationFactor d
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt_gt : 1 < Real.sqrt d := by
    simpa using Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) hd
  have hden_eq : d + 1 - 2 * Real.sqrt d = (Real.sqrt d - 1) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ d by linarith)]
  have hden_pos : 0 < d + 1 - 2 * Real.sqrt d := by
    rw [hden_eq]
    exact sq_pos_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hsqrt_gt)
  have hid : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x) d := continuousAt_id
  have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) d := continuousAt_const
  have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => (2 : ℝ)) d := continuousAt_const
  have hsqrt : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt x) d :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt
  have hnum1 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x + 1) d := ContinuousAt.add hid hc1
  have hnum2 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => 2 * Real.sqrt x) d :=
    ContinuousAt.mul hc2 hsqrt
  have hden1 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x + 1) d := ContinuousAt.add hid hc1
  have hden2 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => 2 * Real.sqrt x) d :=
    ContinuousAt.mul hc2 hsqrt
  have hn_cont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x + 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt x) d :=
    ContinuousAt.add hnum1 hnum2
  have hd_cont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x + 1 - 2 * Real.sqrt x) d :=
    ContinuousAt.sub hden1 hden2
  unfold rankOneSparsificationFactor
  exact ContinuousAt.div hn_cont hd_cont hden_pos.ne'

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_card_lt_budget
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_card_lt_budget [Nonempty n]
    (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : Fintype.card n < q) :
    ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧
      (Function.support s).ncard ≤ q ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤
        rankOneSparsificationFactor ((q : ℝ) / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) •
          (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card n
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    dsimp [N]
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ‹Nonempty n›)
  have hq_nat : 0 < q := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hq
  have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq_nat
  have hqN_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) / N := div_pos hq_pos hNpos
  let a : ℝ := Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) / N)
  have ha1 : 1 < a := by
    dsimp [a]
    have hlt : 1 < (q : ℝ) / N := by
      rw [one_lt_div hNpos]
      dsimp [N]
      exact_mod_cast hq
    simpa using Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) hlt
  have hq' : (q : ℝ) = N * a ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [a]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hqN_pos)]
    rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ (q : ℝ) hNpos.ne']
  obtain ⟨s, hs_nonneg, hs_card, hs_lower, hs_upper⟩ :=
    exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_sq_budget (I := I) (n := n)
      v hframe a ha1 q hq'
  have hfac : rankOneSparsificationFactor ((q : ℝ) / N) =
      (a + 1) ^ 2 / (a - 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hf := rankOneSparsificationFactor_eq_sq_div_sq (d := (q : ℝ) / N)
      (hd := le_of_lt hqN_pos)
    simpa [a] using hf
  refine ⟨s, hs_nonneg, hs_card, hs_lower, ?_⟩
  rw [hfac]
  exact hs_upper

name: NLAlib.exists_nat_budget_ratio_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_nat_budget_ratio_tendsto (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 1 < d) :
    ∃ r q : ℕ → ℕ,
      (∀ m,
        0 < r m ∧
        q m = Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)) ∧
        N * r m < q m ∧
        q m < r m * (Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ)) + 1)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => (q m : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ))) atTop (nhds d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ((N : ℝ) * (d - 1)))
  have hNd_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) * (d - 1) :=
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hN) (sub_pos.mpr hd)
  have hR_pos : 0 < (R : ℝ) :=
    lt_trans (div_pos (by norm_num) hNd_pos) hR
  have hR_nat : 0 < R := by
    exact_mod_cast hR_pos
  have hR_mul : 1 < (N : ℝ) * (d - 1) * (R : ℝ) := by
    have hdiv := (div_lt_iff₀ hNd_pos).mp hR
    nlinarith [hdiv]
  let r : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => m + R
  let q : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ))
  have hN_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hN
  have hr_pos : ∀ m, 0 < r m := by
    intro m
    dsimp [r]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hR_nat (Nat.le_add_left R m)
  have hr_pos_real : ∀ m, 0 < (r m : ℝ) := by
    intro m
    exact_mod_cast hr_pos m
  have hden_pos : ∀ m, 0 < (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) :=
    fun m => mul_pos hN_pos (hr_pos_real m)
  have hden_ne : ∀ m, (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    fun m => ne_of_gt (hden_pos m)
  have hsub : ∀ m, (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) < d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) - 1 := by
    intro m
    have hprod_mul : 1 < (N : ℝ) * (d - 1) * (r m : ℝ) := by
      have hrr : (R : ℝ) ≤ (r m : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [r]
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_add_left R m)
      have hmul : (N : ℝ) * (d - 1) * (R : ℝ) ≤
          (N : ℝ) * (d - 1) * (r m : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrr (le_of_lt hNd_pos)
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hR_mul hmul
    have hprod_eq : (N : ℝ) * (d - 1) * (r m : ℝ) =
        d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) - (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) := by
      ring
    rw [hprod_eq] at hprod_mul
    linarith
  have hq_gt : ∀ m, d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) - 1 < (q m : ℝ) := by
    intro m
    simpa [q] using (Nat.sub_one_lt_floor (d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)))
  have hstep : ∀ m, (d - 1 / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ))) * ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)) =
      d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) - 1 := by
    intro m
    rw [sub_mul, one_div_mul_cancel (hden_ne m)]
    ring
  have hlow : ∀ m, d - 1 / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)) <
      (q m : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)) := by
    intro m
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (hden_pos m)]
    rw [hstep m]
    exact hq_gt m
  have hup : ∀ m, (q m : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ)) ≤ d := by
    intro m
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (hden_pos m)]
    have hd_pos : 0 < d := lt_trans (by norm_num) hd
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) := by
      positivity
    have hfloor_le : (q m : ℝ) ≤ d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) := by
      simpa [q] using (Nat.floor_le hnonneg)
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hfloor_le
  refine ⟨r, q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    refine ⟨hr_pos m, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hreal : (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) < (q m : ℝ) :=
        lt_trans (hsub m) (hq_gt m)
      exact_mod_cast hreal
    · have hk : d * (N : ℝ) < (Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ)) : ℝ) + 1 := by
        exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one (d * (N : ℝ))
      have hk_mul : d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) <
          (r m : ℝ) * ((Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ)) : ℝ) + 1) := by
        have hkm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hk (hr_pos_real m)
        simpa [mul_comm, mul_assoc] using hkm
      have hd_pos : 0 < d := lt_trans (by norm_num) hd
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) := by
        positivity
      have hfloor_le : (q m : ℝ) ≤ d * (N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ) := by
        simpa [q] using (Nat.floor_le hnonneg)
      have hquot : (q m : ℝ) <
          (r m : ℝ) * ((Nat.floor (d * (N : ℝ)) : ℝ) + 1) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hfloor_le hk_mul
      exact_mod_cast hquot
  · have hZ : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 1 / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hcomp : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (1 / (N : ℝ)) / ((m + R : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
        (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (1 / (N : ℝ))).comp
          (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat R)
      simpa only [r, div_div] using hcomp
    have hL : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => d - 1 / ((N : ℝ) * (r m : ℝ))) atTop
        (nhds d) := by
      have hc : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => d) atTop (nhds d) := tendsto_const_nhds
      have := hc.sub hZ
      simpa only [sub_zero] using this
    have hU : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => d) atTop (nhds d) := tendsto_const_nhds
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hL hU ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards with m
      exact le_of_lt (hlow m)
    · filter_upwards with m
      exact hup m

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_attainable_nonempty
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_attainable_nonempty (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ({d : ℝ | ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re}).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(T (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).det.re, 1, Matrix.PosDef.one, Matrix.det_one, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_attainable_bddBelow
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_attainable_bddBelow
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef) :
    BddBelow {d : ℝ | ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rintro d ⟨X, hX, -, rfl⟩
  exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (Matrix.PosSemidef.det_nonneg (hT X hX.posSemidef))).1

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_nonneg
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_nonneg (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ operatorCapacity T
proof:
:= by
  unfold operatorCapacity
  exact le_csInf (operatorCapacity_attainable_nonempty T)
    (by
      rintro d ⟨X, hX, -, rfl⟩
      exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (Matrix.PosSemidef.det_nonneg (hT X hX.posSemidef))).1)

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_eq_sInf_ratio
proof:
:= by
  unfold operatorCapacity
  exact detRatio_normalized_sInf_eq hN T

name: NLAlib.det_congr_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
private theorem det_congr_mul_conjTranspose (U X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (U * X * U.conjTranspose).det = det U * X.det * star (det U)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (U * X * U.conjTranspose).det = det (U * X) * det (U.conjTranspose) := by
      rw [Matrix.det_mul]
    _ = det U * X.det * star (det U) := by
      rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.det_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq
statement:
private theorem det_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq (U X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (U * X * U.conjTranspose).det = (Complex.normSq (det U) : ℂ) * X.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_congr_mul_conjTranspose]
  have hns : (Complex.normSq (det U) : ℂ) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (det U) * det U :=
    Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self
  rw [hns]
  simp_rw [Complex.star_def]
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_re_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq
statement:
private theorem det_re_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq (U X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (U * X * U.conjTranspose).det.re = Complex.normSq (det U) * X.det.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq U X]
  exact Complex.re_ofReal_mul (Complex.normSq (det U)) X.det

name: NLAlib.re_det_map_congr
statement:
private theorem re_det_map_congr (T S : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (B C : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : ∀ X, S X = B * T (C * X * C.conjTranspose) * B.conjTranspose)
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (S X).det.re = Complex.normSq (det B) * (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (S X).det.re = (B * T (C * X * C.conjTranspose) * B.conjTranspose).det.re := by
      rw [hS X]
    _ = (det B * (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det * star (det B)).re := by
      congr 1
      rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose]
    _ = ((Complex.normSq (det B) : ℂ) * (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det).re := by
      congr 1
      have hns : (Complex.normSq (det B) : ℂ) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (det B) * det B :=
        Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self
      rw [hns]
      simp_rw [Complex.star_def]
      ring
    _ = Complex.normSq (det B) * (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re := by
      exact Complex.re_ofReal_mul (Complex.normSq (det B)) (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det

name: NLAlib.ratio_eq_scaled
statement:
private theorem ratio_eq_scaled (B C X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (T S : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hC : IsUnit C)
    (hS : ∀ X, S X = B * T (C * X * C.conjTranspose) * B.conjTranspose)
    (hX : X.PosDef) :
    (S X).det.re / X.det.re =
      (Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C)) *
        ((T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re / (C * X * C.conjTranspose).det.re)
proof:
:= by
  have hCdet_ne : det C ≠ 0 := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det C).mp hC |>.ne_zero
  have hCnsq_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq (det C) := Complex.normSq_pos.2 hCdet_ne
  have hCnsq_ne : Complex.normSq (det C) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hCnsq_pos
  have hXdet_re_pos : 0 < X.det.re := (Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).1
  have hXdet_re_ne : X.det.re ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hXdet_re_pos
  have hYdet := det_re_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq C X
  have hYdet_re_ne : (C * X * C.conjTranspose).det.re ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hYdet]
    exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos hCnsq_pos hXdet_re_pos)
  have hv : (S X).det.re = Complex.normSq (det B) * (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re :=
    re_det_map_congr T S B C hS X
  calc
    (S X).det.re / X.det.re
        = (Complex.normSq (det B) * (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re) / X.det.re := by
          rw [hv]
    _ = Complex.normSq (det B) * ((T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re / X.det.re) := by
          ring
    _ = Complex.normSq (det B) * (Complex.normSq (det C) *
          ((T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re / (C * X * C.conjTranspose).det.re)) := by
          rw [hYdet]
          have hfrac :
              (T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re / X.det.re =
                Complex.normSq (det C) *
                  ((T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re /
                    (Complex.normSq (det C) * X.det.re)) := by
            field_simp [hXdet_re_ne, hCnsq_ne]
          rw [hfrac]
    _ = (Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C)) *
          ((T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re / (C * X * C.conjTranspose).det.re) := by
          ring

name: NLAlib.ratio_eq_scaled_preimage
statement:
private theorem ratio_eq_scaled_preimage (B C Y : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (T S : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hC : IsUnit C)
    (hS : ∀ X, S X = B * T (C * X * C.conjTranspose) * B.conjTranspose)
    (hY : Y.PosDef) :
    (Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C)) * ((T Y).det.re / Y.det.re) =
      (S (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose)).det.re /
        (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re
proof:
:= by
  have hCdet_ne : det C ≠ 0 := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det C).mp hC |>.ne_zero
  have hCnsq_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq (det C) := Complex.normSq_pos.2 hCdet_ne
  have hCnsq_ne : Complex.normSq (det C) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hCnsq_pos
  have hCinv : IsUnit C⁻¹ := (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff).2 hC
  have hX : (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).PosDef := by
    simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using (hCinv.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff).mpr hY
  have hXdet_re_pos : 0 < (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re :=
    (Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).1
  have hXdet_re_ne : (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hXdet_re_pos
  have hCong : C * (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose) * C.conjTranspose = Y := by
    have hCdet : IsUnit C.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det C).mp hC
    calc
      C * (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose) * C.conjTranspose
          = (C * C⁻¹) * Y * ((C⁻¹).conjTranspose * C.conjTranspose) := by
            simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (C * C⁻¹) * Y * (C * C⁻¹).conjTranspose := by
            rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
      _ = Y := by
            rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv C hCdet]
            simp
  have hYdet : Y.det.re = Complex.normSq (det C) * (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re := by
    calc
      Y.det.re = (C * (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose) * C.conjTranspose).det.re := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← hCong]
      _ = Complex.normSq (det C) * (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re :=
        det_re_congr_mul_conjTranspose_normSq C (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose)
  have hYdet_re_ne : Y.det.re ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hYdet]
    exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos hCnsq_pos hXdet_re_pos)
  have hv : (S (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose)).det.re =
      Complex.normSq (det B) * (T Y).det.re := by
    rw [re_det_map_congr T S B C hS (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose)]
    rw [hCong]
  calc
    (Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C)) * ((T Y).det.re / Y.det.re)
        = Complex.normSq (det B) * (Complex.normSq (det C) * ((T Y).det.re / Y.det.re)) := by
          ring
    _ = Complex.normSq (det B) * ((T Y).det.re / (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re) := by
          have hfrac :
              Complex.normSq (det C) * ((T Y).det.re / Y.det.re) =
                (T Y).det.re / (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re := by
            rw [hYdet]
            field_simp [hXdet_re_ne, hYdet_re_ne, hCnsq_ne]
          rw [hfrac]
    _ = (Complex.normSq (det B) * (T Y).det.re) / (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re := by
          ring
    _ = (S (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose)).det.re /
          (C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose).det.re := by
          rw [hv]

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_congruence_scaling
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_congruence_scaling (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T S : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)
    (B C : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : IsUnit B) (hC : IsUnit C)
    (hS : ∀ X, S X = B * T (C * X * C.conjTranspose) * B.conjTranspose) :
    operatorCapacity S = Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C) * operatorCapacity T
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ := {d | ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ d = (T X).det.re / X.det.re}
  let A' : Set ℝ := {d | ∃ X : Matrix n n ℂ, X.PosDef ∧ d = (S X).det.re / X.det.re}
  let a : ℝ := Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C)
  have hBdet_ne : det B ≠ 0 := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det B).mp hB |>.ne_zero
  have hCdet_ne : det C ≠ 0 := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det C).mp hC |>.ne_zero
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := by
    exact mul_pos (Complex.normSq_pos.2 hBdet_ne) (Complex.normSq_pos.2 hCdet_ne)
  let e : ℝ ≃o ℝ := OrderIso.mulLeft₀ a ha_pos
  have hTcap : operatorCapacity T = sInf A := by
    rw [operatorCapacity_eq_sInf_ratio hN T]
  have hScap : operatorCapacity S = sInf A' := by
    rw [operatorCapacity_eq_sInf_ratio hN S]
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨((T (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)).det.re / ((1 : Matrix n n ℂ).det.re)),
      1, Matrix.PosDef.one, rfl⟩
  have hAbdd : BddBelow A := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro d ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩
    exact div_nonneg
      ((Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (Matrix.PosSemidef.det_nonneg (hT X hX.posSemidef))).1)
      ((Complex.pos_iff.mp hX.det_pos).1).le
  have hA'_eq : A' = e '' A := by
    ext d
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨X, hX, hd⟩
      refine ⟨(T (C * X * C.conjTranspose)).det.re / (C * X * C.conjTranspose).det.re,
          ⟨C * X * C.conjTranspose, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using (hC.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff).mpr hX
      · dsimp [e]
        rw [hd]
        exact (ratio_eq_scaled B C X T S hC hS hX).symm
    · intro hmem
      rcases hmem with ⟨y, ⟨hy, hed⟩⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩
      let X : Matrix n n ℂ := C⁻¹ * Y * (C⁻¹).conjTranspose
      have hX : X.PosDef := by
        have hCinv : IsUnit C⁻¹ := (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff).2 hC
        dsimp [X]
        simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using (hCinv.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff).mpr hY
      refine ⟨X, hX, ?_⟩
      rw [← hed]
      dsimp [e, X]
      exact ratio_eq_scaled_preimage B C Y T S hC hS hY
  have hes : e (sInf A) = sInf (e '' A) := e.map_csInf' hAne hAbdd
  calc
    operatorCapacity S = sInf A' := hScap
    _ = sInf (e '' A) := by rw [hA'_eq]
    _ = e (sInf A) := hes.symm
    _ = a * sInf A := by simp [e]
    _ = Complex.normSq (det B) * Complex.normSq (det C) * operatorCapacity T := by
      rw [← hTcap]
      try dsimp [a]
      try ring

name: NLAlib.krausMap_apply
statement:
theorem krausMap_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    krausMap A X = ∑ i, A i * X * (A i).conjTranspose
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.krausMap_posSemidef
statement:
theorem krausMap_posSemidef {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    (krausMap A X).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [krausMap_apply]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => by
    simpa using (hX.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (A i).conjTranspose))

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_nonneg
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    0 ≤ operatorCapacity (krausMap A)
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_scalar_gram_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem posSemidef_scalar_gram_fromBlocks {B : Matrix m m ℂ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (a b : ℂ) :
    (fromBlocks ((a * star a) • B) ((a * star b) • B)
      ((b * star a) • B) ((b * star b) • B)).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have h := hB.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
    (fromRows (a • (1 : Matrix m m ℂ)) (b • (1 : Matrix m m ℂ)))
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromRows_eq_fromCols_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_smul,
    mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_map_unitarySpectralProjector
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_unitarySpectralProjector
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (i : n) :
    (Φ (unitarySpectralProjector U i)).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  (Φ.map_nonneg (posSemidef_unitarySpectralProjector U i).nonneg).posSemidef

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_map_of_positive
statement:
theorem isHermitian_map_of_positive (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : (Φ A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector hA, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul]
  apply isSelfAdjoint_sum
  intro i _
  exact (posSemidef_map_unitarySpectralProjector Φ _ i).isHermitian.smul
    (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint])

name: NLAlib.map_sq_le_of_positive_unital
statement:
theorem map_sq_le_of_positive_unital
    (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₚ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) (hΦ : Φ 1 = 1)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : (Φ A) ^ 2 ≤ Φ (A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let P := unitarySpectralProjector hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  let B : n → Matrix m m ℂ := fun i => Φ (P i)
  let ev : n → ℂ := fun i => hA.eigenvalues i
  have hB (i : n) : (B i).PosSemidef := posSemidef_map_unitarySpectralProjector Φ _ i
  have hsum : ∑ i, B i = 1 := by
    dsimp [B, P]
    rw [← map_sum, sum_unitarySpectralProjector, hΦ]
  have hfirst : ∑ i, ev i • B i = Φ A := by
    rw [sum_eigenvalue_smul_unitarySpectralProjector hA, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rfl
  have hsecond : ∑ i, (ev i) ^ 2 • B i = Φ (A ^ 2) := by
    rw [pow_eq_sum_eigenvalue_pow_smul_unitarySpectralProjector hA 2, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rfl
  have hblocks (i : n) :
      (fromBlocks (B i) (ev i • B i) (ev i • B i) (ev i ^ 2 • B i)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa [ev, pow_two] using posSemidef_scalar_gram_fromBlocks (hB i) 1 (ev i)
  have hH := Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hblocks i)
  have heq : (∑ i, fromBlocks (B i) (ev i • B i) (ev i • B i)
      (ev i ^ 2 • B i)) =
      fromBlocks (∑ i, B i) (∑ i, ev i • B i) (∑ i, ev i • B i)
        (∑ i, ev i ^ 2 • B i) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Matrix.sum_apply, fromBlocks]
  rw [heq, hsum, hfirst, hsecond] at hH
  let : Invertible (1 : Matrix m m ℂ) := invertibleOne
  have h := (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ (Φ A) (Φ (A ^ 2))
    (Matrix.PosDef.one : (1 : Matrix m m ℂ).PosDef))
  rw [(isHermitian_map_of_positive Φ hA).eq] at h
  have hres := h.mp hH
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  simpa only [inv_one, Matrix.mul_one, ← pow_two] using hres

name: NLAlib.rank_spectralFunctionTruncation_le
statement:
theorem rank_spectralFunctionTruncation_le (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k).rank ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : n => (e.symm i).val < k)
  let d := fun i : n => if (e.symm i).val < k then f (a (e.symm i)) else 0
  have hsupport : Function.support (Matrix.diagonal d).row ⊆ H := by
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro i hi
    change i ∉ H at hi
    have hik : ¬ (e.symm i).val < k := by
      intro hh
      exact hi (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hh⟩)
    ext j
    change Matrix.diagonal d i j = 0
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, d, if_neg hik]
    · exact Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij
  have hcard : H.card ≤ k := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (s := H) (t := Finset.range k)
      (fun i : n => (e.symm i).val)
      (fun i hi => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2)
      (fun i _ j _ hij => e.symm.injective (Fin.ext hij))
    simpa only [Finset.card_range] using h
  have hD := Matrix.rank_le_card_of_support_subset (Matrix.diagonal d) H hsupport
  change (U * Matrix.diagonal d * Uᵀ).rank ≤ k
  exact ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)).trans (hD.trans hcard)

name: NLAlib.spectralBasisMatrix_sub
statement:
theorem spectralBasisMatrix_sub (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) :
    spectralBasisMatrix U a - spectralBasisMatrix U b = spectralBasisMatrix U (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i : n => (a - b) (e.symm i)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i : n => a (e.symm i)) - Matrix.diagonal (fun i : n => b (e.symm i)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal, hij, Pi.sub_apply]
  change U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => a (e.symm i)) * Uᵀ -
    U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => b (e.symm i)) * Uᵀ =
    U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a - b) (e.symm i)) * Uᵀ
  rw [hd, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_spectralBasisMatrix
statement:
theorem posSemidef_spectralBasisMatrix (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) : (spectralBasisMatrix U a).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hd := Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr
    (fun i : n => ha ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm i))
  exact hd.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U

name: NLAlib.spectralBasisMatrix_mono
statement:
theorem spectralBasisMatrix_mono (U : Matrix n n ℝ) {a b : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ}
    (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i) : spectralBasisMatrix U a ≤ spectralBasisMatrix U b
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  rw [spectralBasisMatrix_sub]
  exact posSemidef_spectralBasisMatrix U _ (fun i => sub_nonneg.mpr (hab i))

name: NLAlib.cfc_spectralBasisMatrix
statement:
theorem cfc_spectralBasisMatrix (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix U a) = spectralBasisMatrix U (f ∘ a)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl h => exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    let V : unitary (Matrix n n ℝ) := ⟨U, ⟨hU, mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU⟩⟩
    let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix n n ℝ) V
    let d := fun i : n => a ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm i)
    have hD : (Matrix.diagonal d).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal d
    have hC : (E (Matrix.diagonal d)).IsHermitian :=
      Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose U hD
    have he := StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc E f (Matrix.diagonal d)
      ((Matrix.diagonal d).finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn f)
      E.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional hD hC
    have hDcalc : cfc f (Matrix.diagonal d) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (d i)) := cfc_diagonal f d
    rw [hDcalc] at he
    change cfc f (E (Matrix.diagonal d)) = E (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (d i)))
    exact he.symm

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_spectralBasisMatrix_rpow
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_spectralBasisMatrix_rpow (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (spectralBasisMatrix U a) p ^ p = ∑ i, a i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hUt : HasOrthonormalCols Uᵀ := by
    change Uᵀᵀ * Uᵀ = 1
    rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
  rw [spectralBasisMatrix, schattenNormReal_mul_orthogonal _ hUt,
    schattenNormReal_orthogonal_mul _ hU, schattenNormReal_diagonal_real]
  simp_rw [abs_of_nonneg (ha _)]
  rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (ha _) _) hp.ne']
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  rw [← e.sum_comp (fun i : n => a (e.symm i) ^ p)]
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_eq
statement:
theorem cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_eq (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix U a) - spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k =
      spectralBasisMatrix U (fun i => if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_spectralBasisMatrix U hU, spectralFunctionTruncation, spectralBasisMatrix_sub]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  by_cases hi : i.val < k
  · simp only [if_pos hi, if_neg (not_le.mpr hi), sub_self]
  · simp only [if_neg hi, if_pos (not_lt.mp hi), sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_spectralFunctionTruncation
statement:
theorem posSemidef_spectralFunctionTruncation (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f (a i)) :
    (spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  posSemidef_spectralBasisMatrix U _ (fun i => by split_ifs; exacts [hf i, le_rfl])

name: NLAlib.spectralFunctionTruncation_le_cfc
statement:
theorem spectralFunctionTruncation_le_cfc (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f (a i)) :
    spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k ≤ cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix U a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_spectralBasisMatrix U hU]
  apply spectralBasisMatrix_mono
  intro i
  change (if i.val < k then f (a i) else 0) ≤ f (a i)
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact hf i

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f (a i)) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k) p ^ p =
      ∑ i, if i.val < k then f (a i) ^ p else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectralFunctionTruncation, schattenNormReal_spectralBasisMatrix_rpow U hU _
    (fun i => by split_ifs; exacts [hf i, le_rfl]) hp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_rpow (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f (a i)) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (cfc f (spectralBasisMatrix U a) - spectralFunctionTruncation U a f k) p ^ p =
      ∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) ^ p else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_sub_spectralFunctionTruncation_eq U hU a f k, schattenNormReal_spectralBasisMatrix_rpow U hU _
    (fun i => by split_ifs; exacts [hf i, le_rfl]) hp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.spectralBasisMatrix_eigenvectorUnitary
statement:
theorem spectralBasisMatrix_eigenvectorUnitary {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    spectralBasisMatrix (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) hA.eigenvalues₀ = A
proof:
:= by
  exact (eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA).symm

name: NLAlib.spectralFunctionTruncation_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem spectralFunctionTruncation_zero (U : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (a : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : spectralFunctionTruncation U a f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [spectralFunctionTruncation, spectralBasisMatrix]

name: NLAlib.commute_signNewtonIterate
statement:
theorem commute_signNewtonIterate {A S : Matrix n n ℂ} (h : Commute S A) (k : ℕ) :
    Commute S (signNewtonIterate A k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ k ih =>
    change S*((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (_+_))=((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (_+_))*S
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul,
      ih.eq, ih.matrix_inv_right.eq]

name: NLAlib.involution_mul_signNewtonIterate
proof:
:= by
  have hSi : S⁻¹=S := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv (by simpa only [pow_two] using hS)
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [signNewtonIterate, signNewtonIterate, ← ih, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hSi]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_add, (commute_signNewtonIterate h k).matrix_inv_right.eq]

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.cayley_eq_positiveCayley
statement:
theorem IsMatrixSign.cayley_eq_positiveCayley {A S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : IsMatrixSign A S) :
    (A-S)*(A+S)⁻¹=positiveCayley (S*A)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : S*S=1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hS.1
  have hSi : S⁻¹=S := Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hs
  have hSA : A*S=S*A := hS.2.1.eq
  have hc : Commute S (S*A) := by change S*(S*A)=(S*A)*S; noncomm_ring [hSA, hs]
  have hm : A-S=S*(S*A-1) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hs, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hp : A+S=S*(S*A+1) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hs, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hm, hp, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hSi]
  have ht : Commute S ((S*A-1)*(S*A+1)⁻¹) :=
    (hc.sub_right (Commute.one_right _)).mul_right ((hc.add_right (Commute.one_right _)).matrix_inv_right)
  change S*(S*A-1)*((S*A+1)⁻¹*S)=(S*A-1)*(S*A+1)⁻¹
  calc
    _ = S*((S*A-1)*(S*A+1)⁻¹)*S := by noncomm_ring
    _ = ((S*A-1)*(S*A+1)⁻¹)*(S*S) := by rw [ht.eq]; noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hs, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.spectralRadius_cayley_lt_one
statement:
theorem IsMatrixSign.spectralRadius_cayley_lt_one {A S : Matrix n n ℂ} (hS : IsMatrixSign A S) :
    spectralRadius ℂ ((A-S)*(A+S)⁻¹)<1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hS.cayley_eq_positiveCayley]
  exact hS.2.2.spectralRadius_positiveCayley_lt_one

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.signNewtonIterate_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hs : S*S=1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hS.1
  have hi := involution_mul_signNewtonIterate hS.2.1.symm hS.1 k
  have he := (hS.2.2.signNewtonIterate_eq_and_isUnit k).1
  have hm : signNewtonIterate A k=S*inverseCayley ((positiveCayley (S*A))^(2^k)) := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun X => S*X) (hi.trans he)
    simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hs, Matrix.one_mul] using hh
  have hc : Commute S (signNewtonIterate A k) := commute_signNewtonIterate hS.2.1.symm k
  have hv : S*signNewtonIterate A k=inverseCayley ((positiveCayley (S*A))^(2^k)) := hi.trans he
  rw [hS.cayley_eq_positiveCayley, ← hv, hc.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, hs, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.isUnit_signNewtonIterate
statement:
theorem IsMatrixSign.isUnit_signNewtonIterate {A S : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : IsMatrixSign A S) (k : ℕ) : IsUnit (signNewtonIterate A k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hS.signNewtonIterate_eq]
  have hp := tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hS.spectralRadius_cayley_lt_one
  obtain ⟨hm, hp⟩ := isUnit_one_sub_and_add_matrix_pow hp (pow_pos (by norm_num : 0<(2 : ℕ)) k)
  have hSu : IsUnit S := ⟨⟨S,S,by simpa only [pow_two] using hS.1,
    by simpa only [pow_two] using hS.1⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (isUnit_inverseCayley hm hp).mul hSu

name: NLAlib.IsMatrixSign.tendsto_signNewtonIterate
statement:
theorem IsMatrixSign.tendsto_signNewtonIterate {A S : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hS : IsMatrixSign A S) : Tendsto (signNewtonIterate A) atTop (𝓝 S)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one hS.spectralRadius_cayley_lt_one
  have ht := (tendsto_inverseCayley_one (hp.comp
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ)<2)))).mul_const S
  convert! ht using 1
  · funext k; exact hS.signNewtonIterate_eq k
  · simp

name: NLAlib.half_smul_add_inv_sub_involution
proof:
:= by
  have hi := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hX)
  have hs : S*S=1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hS
  have hp : (X-S)^2=X*X-(2 : ℂ) • (X*S)+1 := by
    simp only [two_smul]
    noncomm_ring [← hc.eq, hs]
  have hq : X⁻¹*(X-S)^2=X+X⁻¹-(2 : ℂ) • S := by
    rw [hp]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      hi, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    abel
  rw [hq, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.matrix_sign_newton
proof:
:= matrixSign A
    let G := (A-S)*(A+S)⁻¹
    spectralRadius ℂ G<1 ∧
      (∀ k, IsUnit (signNewtonIterate A k) ∧
        signNewtonIterate A k=inverseCayley (G^(2^k))*S) ∧
      Tendsto (signNewtonIterate A) atTop (𝓝 S) ∧
      ∀ k, signNewtonIterate A (k+1)-S=
        (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((signNewtonIterate A k)⁻¹*(signNewtonIterate A k-S)^2) ∧
        specNorm (signNewtonIterate A (k+1)-S) ≤
          (1/2 : ℝ)*specNorm ((signNewtonIterate A k)⁻¹)*specNorm (signNewtonIterate A k-S)^2 := by
  dsimp
  have hs := isMatrixSign_matrixSign hA
  refine ⟨hs.spectralRadius_cayley_lt_one, fun k =>
    ⟨hs.isUnit_signNewtonIterate k, hs.signNewtonIterate_eq k⟩, hs.tendsto_signNewtonIterate, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have he := half_smul_add_inv_sub_involution (hs.isUnit_signNewtonIterate k) hs.1
    (commute_signNewtonIterate hs.2.1.symm k).symm
  change signNewtonIterate A (k+1)-matrixSign A=_ at he
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  rw [he, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul]
  have hn : ‖(2 : ℂ)⁻¹‖=(1/2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [hn]
  calc
    _ ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)*(specNorm ((signNewtonIterate A k)⁻¹)*specNorm ((signNewtonIterate A k-matrixSign A)^2)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_mul_le _ _) (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc, specNorm_eq_norm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_pow_le (signNewtonIterate A k-matrixSign A) 2)
          (specNorm_nonneg ((signNewtonIterate A k)⁻¹))) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤1/2)

name: NLAlib.hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed

name: NLAlib.contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate
statement:
theorem contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (fun y : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p))
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hc := T.contDiff.comp (contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A hA
    (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) (r := r))
  simpa only [T, Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,

name: NLAlib.contDiff_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate
statement:
theorem contDiff_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (fun y : E => resolventEvenMoment (A + L y) ζ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p (r := r))
  have heq : (fun y : E => resolventEvenMoment (A + L y) ζ p) =
      fun y : E => (normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)).re := by
    funext y
    exact resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
      (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates y)) ζ p
  rw [heq]
  exact hc

name: NLAlib.iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    (y : E) (h : Fin 3 → E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (fun x : E => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) y h =
      ∑ i : Fin (p + p), ∑ j : Fin (p + p + 1), ∑ k : Fin (p + p + 2),
        normalizedTrace (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert
            (resolventWordInsert
              (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
                k (L (h 0))) y)
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
  have he := iteratedFDeriv_three_comp_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
    T A hA (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) y h
  simpa only [T, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
    hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed] using! he

name: NLAlib.iteratedFDeriv_three_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_three_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate_apply
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    (y : E) (h : Fin 3 → E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (fun x : E => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p) y h =
      ∑ i : Fin (p + p), ∑ j : Fin (p + p + 1), ∑ k : Fin (p + p + 2),
        (normalizedTrace (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert
            (resolventWordInsert
              (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) i (L (h 2))) j (L (h 1)))
                k (L (h 0))) y)).re
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℝ] ℝ := Complex.reCLM.comp
    ((normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ)
  have he := iteratedFDeriv_three_comp_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply
    T A hA (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) y h
  have heq : (fun x : E => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p) =
      fun x : E => T (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A (mixedResolventWord ζ p) x) := by
    funext x
    rw [resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
      (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x)),
      hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [T, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
    normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply] using! he
