name: NLAlib.continuous_resolventMomentTaylorKernel
statement:
theorem continuous_resolventMomentTaylorKernel (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun t : E × E × E => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun y => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let K : ((E × E × E) × ℝ) × ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Φ
      (t.1.1.1 - a • t.1.1.2.2 + t.2 • (a • (t.1.1.2.2 + t.1.2 • t.1.1.2.1)))
      ![t.1.1.2.2 + t.1.2 • t.1.1.2.1, t.1.1.2.1, t.1.1.2.1]
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 3 Φ := contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p
  have hthird := hΦ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv'
  have hpath : Continuous (fun t : ((E × E × E) × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      t.1.1.1 - a • t.1.1.2.2 + t.2 • (a • (t.1.1.2.2 + t.1.2 • t.1.1.2.1))) := by fun_prop
  have hdirs : Continuous (fun t : ((E × E × E) × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      ![t.1.1.2.2 + t.1.2 • t.1.1.2.1, t.1.1.2.1, t.1.1.2.1]) := by fun_prop
  have hK : Continuous K := continuous_eval.comp ((hthird.comp hpath).prodMk hdirs)
  have hv := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := volume)
    (f := fun q : (E × E × E) × ℝ => fun v : ℝ => K (q, v)) hK
    (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1))
  have hu := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := volume)
    (f := fun q : E × E × E => fun u : ℝ => ∫ v in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, K ((q, u), v)) hv
    (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1))
  simpa only [resolventMomentTaylorKernel, K, Φ,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num),
    integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc] using hu

name: NLAlib.norm_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_le
statement:
theorem norm_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_le (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (x D V : E)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hD : ‖L D‖ ≤ r) (hV : ‖L V‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a x D V‖ ≤
      2 * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p + 3) * r ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := 2 * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p + 3) * r ^ 3
  have hdir (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) : ‖L (V + u • D)‖ ≤ 2 * r := by
    rw [map_add, map_smul]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖L V‖ + ‖u • L D‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖L V‖ + u * ‖L D‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu.1.le]
      _ ≤ r + u * r := add_le_add hV (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD hu.1.le)
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hu.2) hr]
  have hb (u v : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (fun y : E => normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p))
        (x - a • V + v • (a • (V + u • D))) ![V + u • D, D, D]‖ ≤ C := by
    have h := norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply_le
      A hA ζ hζ p (x - a • V + v • (a • (V + u • D))) ![V + u • D, D, D]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] at h
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := h
      _ ≤ ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p + 3) * (2 * r) * r * r := by
        gcongr
        exact hdir u hu
      _ = C := by dsimp only [C]; ring
  unfold resolventMomentTaylorKernel
  apply (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := C) ?_).trans_eq
    (by simp [C])
  intro u hu
  have hu' : u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] using hu
  exact (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := C)
    (fun v _ => hb u v hu')).trans_eq (by simp)

name: NLAlib.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
statement:
theorem fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    (x D V : E) (a : ℝ) :
    let Φ : E → ℂ
proof:
:= fun y => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
    (fderiv ℝ Φ (x + a • D) - fderiv ℝ Φ x) D -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x - a • V) ![D, D] =
      a ^ 2 • resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a x D V := by
  have hc := contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p (r := 3)
  exact hc.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_smul_sq_integral_three x D V a

name: NLAlib.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_sum
statement:
theorem fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_sum
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    (x D V : E) (a : ℝ) :
    let Φ : E → ℂ
proof:
:= fun y => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
    (fderiv ℝ Φ (x + a • D) - fderiv ℝ Φ x) D -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x - a • V) ![D, D] =
      a ^ 2 • ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        ∑ i : Fin (p + p), ∑ j : Fin (p + p + 1), ∑ k : Fin (p + p + 2),
          normalizedTrace (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
              (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) i (L D)) j (L D))
                k (L (V + u • D)))
            (x - a • V + v • (a • (V + u • D)))) := by
  dsimp only
  have hc := contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p (r := 3)
  have h := hc.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_smul_sq_integral_three x D V a
  simp_rw [iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply A hA ζ hζ p] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_preimage
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (H : M) (hH : H.PosDef) :
    ∃ B : M, B.PosDef ∧ matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B=H
proof:
:= by
  let Q := cfc Real.sqrt S
  let L := matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap
  have hnorm : ‖L‖<1 :=
    (matrixKTransform_quadratic_iff_norm_lt_one ν hν α hα S hS hgap).mp hpos
  let C := α•(Q*H*Q)
  have hC : C.PosDef := ((posDef_sqrt_congruence_iff S hS H).mpr hH).smul hα
  let x := toHermitianFrobenius hC.isHermitian
  let Y := hermitianNeumannInverse L x
  let HY := hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y
  have hL : ∀ v : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n,
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n v).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L v)).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S hS hgap
  have hY : HY.PosSemidef := posSemidef_hermitianNeumannInverse L hL hnorm hC.posSemidef
  have hLY : (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y)).PosSemidef := hL Y hY
  have he := congrArg (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n)
    (hermitianNeumannInverse_sub_map L hnorm x)
  have heq : HY-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S HY=C := by
    change HY-hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y)=C at he
    exact he
  have hHY : HY.PosDef := by
    have hd : HY=C+hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y) := by
      change HY-hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (L Y)=C at he
      exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp he
    rw [hd]
    exact hC.add_posSemidef hLY
  let B := Q*HY*Q
  refine ⟨B,(posDef_sqrt_congruence_iff S hS HY).mpr hHY,?_⟩
  rw [matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence ν hν α hα.ne' S hS hgap B]
  change α⁻¹•(cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S *
    (cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S*(Q*HY*Q)*cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S-
      matrixKStabilityMap ν α S
        (cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S*(Q*HY*Q)*cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S))*
    cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S)=H
  rw [invSqrt_sqrt_congruence S hS HY,heq]
  change α⁻¹•(cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S *
    (α•(Q*H*Q))*cfc (fun r => (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹) S)=H
  rw [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hα.ne',one_smul,
    invSqrt_sqrt_congruence S hS H]

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_posDef_deriv
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch_posDef_deriv
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (u : ℝ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1) :
    ∃ (G : ℂ → M) (B : M), AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧ G u=S ∧ B.PosDef ∧
      HasDerivAt G B (u : ℂ) ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), G z∈matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (G z)=z•1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hDB⟩ := exists_posDef_matrixKTransformDeriv_preimage ν hν α hα
    S hS hgap hpos 1 Matrix.PosDef.one
  obtain ⟨G,hGa,hG0,hGeq⟩ := exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch ν hν α hα
    S hS hgap hpos u hK
  let D := matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S
  have hD (X : M) : D X=matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S X :=
    congrArg (fun L : M →L[ℝ] M => L X)
      (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α S)
  have hGd : HasDerivAt G (deriv G (u : ℂ)) (u : ℂ) := hGa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hdom : S∈matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS.isUnit,fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS (hgap T hT)⟩
  have hKd : HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) D (G u) := by
    rw [hG0]
    exact hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom
  have hcomp := hKd.comp_hasDerivAt (u : ℂ) hGd
  have hEq : (fun z : ℂ => matrixKTransform ν α (G z))=ᶠ[𝓝 (u : ℂ)]
      (fun z : ℂ => z•(1 : M)) := hGeq.mono fun _ h => h.2
  have hscalar : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z•(1 : M)) 1 (u : ℂ) := by
    convert! (hasDerivAt_id (u : ℂ)).smul_const (1 : M) using 1
    simp only [one_smul]
  have hd : D (deriv G (u : ℂ))=1 := (hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq.symm).unique hscalar
  have hderiv : deriv G (u : ℂ)=B :=
    injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos
      (hd.trans ((hD B).trans hDB).symm)
  refine ⟨G,B,hGa,hG0,hB,?_,hGeq⟩
  rwa [hderiv] at hGd

name: NLAlib.softThreshold_scalar_objective_le
statement:
private theorem softThreshold_scalar_objective_le {x y τ : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    1 / 2 * (max (y - τ) 0 - y) ^ 2 + τ * max (y - τ) 0 ≤
      1 / 2 * (x - y) ^ 2 + τ * x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : τ ≤ y
  · rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr h)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - (y - τ))]
  · rw [max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr (le_of_not_ge h))]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, mul_nonneg hx (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_ge h))]

name: NLAlib.sum_softThreshold_objective
statement:
private theorem sum_softThreshold_objective {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (x y : ι → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (1 / 2 * (x i - y i) ^ 2 + τ * x i)) =
      1 / 2 * (∑ i ∈ s, x i ^ 2) - (∑ i ∈ s, x i * y i) +
        1 / 2 * (∑ i ∈ s, y i ^ 2) + τ * ∑ i ∈ s, x i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, (1 / 2 * x i ^ 2 - x i * y i + 1 / 2 * y i ^ 2 + τ * x i) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.singular_value_objective_le
statement:
private theorem singular_value_objective_le (τ : ℝ) (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      (1 / 2 * (singularValues X i - singularValues Y i) ^ 2 + τ * singularValues X i)) ≤
        nuclearProxObjective τ Y X
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_softThreshold_objective, nuclearProxObjective, frobSq_sub,
    frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues X, frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues Y,
    nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range]
  have h := frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul X Y
  linarith

name: NLAlib.nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_eq
statement:
private theorem nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_eq (Y : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    nuclearProxObjective τ Y (singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        (1 / 2 * (max (singularValues Y i - τ) 0 - singularValues Y i) ^ 2 +
          τ * max (singularValues Y i - τ) 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD Y
  have hInner : frobInner (singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y) Y =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        max (singularValues Y i - τ) 0 * singularValues Y i := by
    rw [frobInner_comm, h.singularValueSoftThreshold_eq hτ,
      h.frobInner_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  rw [nuclearProxObjective, frobSq_sub, hInner,
    frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues, frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues,
    nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range, sum_softThreshold_objective]
  simp only [singularValues_singularValueSoftThreshold Y hτ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_le
statement:
theorem nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_le (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    nuclearProxObjective τ Y (singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y) ≤ nuclearProxObjective τ Y X
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_eq Y hτ]
  exact (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
    softThreshold_scalar_objective_le (singularValues_nonneg X i)).trans
      (singular_value_objective_le τ Y X)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_midpoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_add, frobSq_smul, frobSq_smul, frobInner_smul_left,
    frobInner_smul_right, frobSq_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.eq_singularValueSoftThreshold_of_nuclearProxObjective_le
statement:
theorem eq_singularValueSoftThreshold_of_nuclearProxObjective_le (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (hX : nuclearProxObjective τ Y X ≤
      nuclearProxObjective τ Y (singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y)) :
    X = singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y
proof:
:= by
  let D := singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y
  let M := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • X + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • D
  have hMid := nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_le Y M hτ
  have hNuc := (convexOn_nuclearNorm (𝕜 := 𝕜) (m := m) (n := n)).2
    (show X ∈ Set.univ from Set.mem_univ X) (show D ∈ Set.univ from Set.mem_univ D)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = 1)
  have hM : M - Y = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - Y) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D - Y) := by
    dsimp [M]
    module
  have hDiff : (X - Y) - (D - Y) = X - D := by abel
  have hQuad : frobSq (M - Y) =
      1 / 2 * frobSq (X - Y) + 1 / 2 * frobSq (D - Y) - 1 / 4 * frobSq (X - D) := by
    rw [hM, frobSq_midpoint, hDiff]
  have hNuc' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNuc hτ
  change nuclearNorm M ≤ _ at hNuc
  change nuclearProxObjective τ Y D ≤ nuclearProxObjective τ Y M at hMid
  change nuclearProxObjective τ Y X ≤ nuclearProxObjective τ Y D at hX
  have hSq : frobSq (X - D) ≤ 0 := by
    unfold nuclearProxObjective at hMid hX
    rw [hQuad] at hMid
    change τ * nuclearNorm M ≤ τ * (1 / 2 * nuclearNorm X + 1 / 2 * nuclearNorm D) at hNuc'
    nlinarith
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp (le_antisymm hSq (frobSq_nonneg _)))

name: NLAlib.nuclearProxObjective_minimizer_iff
statement:
theorem nuclearProxObjective_minimizer_iff (Y X : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    (∀ Z, nuclearProxObjective τ Y X ≤ nuclearProxObjective τ Y Z) ↔
      X = singularValueSoftThreshold τ Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact eq_singularValueSoftThreshold_of_nuclearProxObjective_le Y X hτ (h _)
  · rintro rfl
    exact fun Z => nuclearProxObjective_softThreshold_le Y Z hτ

name: NLAlib.cfc_sqrt_mul_self_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem cfc_sqrt_mul_self_of_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    cfc Real.sqrt A * cfc Real.sqrt A = A
proof:
:= by
  have hc (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ A) := by
    rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.finite_range _).continuousOn f
  rw [← cfc_mul _ _ A (hc _) (hc _)]
  calc
    cfc (fun x => Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt x) A = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A := by
      apply cfc_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact Real.mul_self_sqrt (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)
    _ = A := cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian

name: NLAlib.inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self
statement:
theorem inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A⁻¹ = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  calc
    _ = (cfc Real.sqrt A * cfc Real.sqrt A) *
        (cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A) := by
      rw [cfc_sqrt_mul_self hA]
    _ = cfc Real.sqrt A * (cfc Real.sqrt A * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A) *
        cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA, Matrix.mul_one, cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA]

name: NLAlib.matrixGeometricMean_mul_inv_mul
proof:
:= by
  let S := cfc Real.sqrt A
  let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
  let C := R * B * R
  let T := cfc Real.sqrt C
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hC : C.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [C, hR.eq] using hB.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  have hTT : T * T = C := cfc_sqrt_mul_self_of_posSemidef hC
  have hSR : S * R = 1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hA
  have hRS : R * S = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hA
  have hi : A⁻¹ = R * R := inv_eq_cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self hA
  change (S * T * S) * A⁻¹ * (S * T * S) = B
  calc
    _ = S * T * (S * R) * (R * S) * T * S := by rw [hi]; noncomm_ring
    _ = S * (T * T) * S := by rw [hSR, hRS]; noncomm_ring
    _ = (S * R) * B * (R * S) := by rw [hTT]; dsimp [C]; noncomm_ring
    _ = B := by rw [hSR, hRS, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.realMatrixComplexification_steinGramian
statement:
theorem realMatrixComplexification_steinGramian (A Q : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j)) :
    (realMatrixComplexification (steinGramian A Q) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      steinGramian (realMatrixComplexification A) (realMatrixComplexification Q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (realMatrixComplexification (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  have h := F.map_tsum hs
  change realMatrixComplexification (steinGramian A Q) = _ at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  funext j
  change realMatrixComplexification (A ^ j * Q * (Aᴴ) ^ j) = _
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow]
  have hstar : (realMatrixComplexification Aᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      (realMatrixComplexification A)ᴴ := map_star realMatrixComplexification A
  rw [hstar]

name: NLAlib.complex_spectralRadius_lt_one_iff_exists_real_posDef_stein
statement:
theorem complex_spectralRadius_lt_one_iff_exists_real_posDef_stein (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal) < 1 ↔
      ∃ X : Matrix n n ℝ, X.PosDef ∧ (X - A * X * Aᴴ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    have hs := summable_real_stein_of_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one A 1 hA
    refine ⟨steinGramian A 1, posDef_steinGramian A 1 Matrix.PosDef.one hs, ?_⟩
    rw [steinGramian_sub_mul_mul_conjTranspose A 1 hs]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one
  · rintro ⟨X, hX, hR⟩
    apply (spectralRadius_lt_one_iff_exists_posDef_stein (A.map Complex.ofReal)).mpr
    refine ⟨realMatrixComplexification X, posDef_realMatrixComplexification hX, ?_⟩
    have hc := posDef_realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ) hR
    have hstar : (realMatrixComplexification Aᴴ : Matrix n n ℂ) =
        (realMatrixComplexification A)ᴴ := map_star realMatrixComplexification A
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, hstar] at hc
    exact hc

name: NLAlib.OperatorMonotoneOn.posSemidef_loewnerMatrix
proof:
:= by
  let A := diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))
  have hA : A.IsHermitian := by
    change (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))).IsHermitian
    exact isHermitian_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => by change star (ev i : ℂ) = _; simp)
  have hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : (x : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ A := (spectrum.algebraMap_mem_iff ℂ).mpr hx
    rw [spectrum_diagonal] at hx'
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx'
    exact Complex.ofReal_injective hi ▸ hev i
  let J : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.of fun _ _ => 1
  have hJ : J.PosSemidef := by
    simpa [J, vecMulVec] using posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (fun _ : n => (1 : ℂ))
  have h := hm.posSemidef_loewnerDerivative hI hf hA hAI ev 1
    (by simp [A]) hJ
  have hc : ((loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal).PosSemidef := by
    change ((1 : Matrix n n ℂ) * ((loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal ⊙
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * J * 1)) * (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose).PosSemidef at h
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] at h
    have hj : (loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal ⊙ J =
        (loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal := by ext i j; simp [J]
    rwa [hj] at h
  exact (posSemidef_realMatrixComplexification_iff (loewnerMatrix f ev)).mp hc

name: NLAlib.cfc_le_of_posSemidef_loewnerMatrices
statement:
theorem cfc_le_of_posSemidef_loewnerMatrices {I : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hI : IsOpen I) (hcI : Convex ℝ I) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ f I)
    (hL : ∀ ev : n → ℝ, (∀ i, ev i ∈ I) → (loewnerMatrix f ev).PosSemidef)
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I) (hBI : spectrum ℝ B ⊆ I) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    cfc f A ≤ cfc f B
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl he => exact (show cfc f A = cfc f B from Subsingleton.elim _ _).le
  | inr hn =>
    let D := B - A
    have hD : D.PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB
    let C (t : ℝ) := A + t • D
    have hC (t : ℝ) : (C t).IsHermitian := hA.add (hD.isHermitian.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t))
    have hCI (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) : spectrum ℝ (C t) ⊆ I := by
      apply spectrum_subset_of_order_interval hcI hA hB (hC t) hAI hBI
      · rw [Matrix.le_iff, show C t - A = t • D by dsimp [C]; abel]
        exact hD.smul ht.1
      · rw [Matrix.le_iff, show B - C t = (1-t) • D by dsimp [C, D]; module]
        exact hD.smul (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)
    let L (t : ℝ) := loewnerDerivative f (hC t).eigenvalues (hC t).eigenvectorUnitary
    have hd (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
        HasDerivAt (fun s => cfc f (C s)) (L t D) t := by
      have hi (i : n) : (hC t).eigenvalues i ∈ I :=
        hCI t ht ((hC t).spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      have hfd := hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner (hC t)
        (fun i => (hf _ (hi i)).differentiableAt (hI.mem_nhds (hi i)))
        (hC t).eigenvalues (hC t).eigenvectorUnitary (hC t).spectral_theorem
      exact hfd.comp_hasDerivAt t (by simpa [C] using (((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const D).const_add A))
        (Eventually.of_forall fun s => hC s)
    have hp (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) : (L t D).PosSemidef :=
      posSemidef_loewnerDerivative (hL _ fun i =>
        hCI t ht ((hC t).spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ ⟨i, rfl⟩)) _ hD
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    have hdiff : (cfc f B - cfc f A).IsHermitian :=
      (show (cfc f B).IsHermitian from cfc_predicate _ _).sub (cfc_predicate _ _)
    refine ⟨hdiff, fun x => ?_⟩
    have hq (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :=
      (reQuadFormCLM x).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hd t ht)
    have hm := monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      (fun t ht => (hq t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => (hq t (interior_subset ht)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => by rw [(hq t (interior_subset ht)).deriv]; exact (hp t (interior_subset ht)).re_quadForm_nonneg x)
    have hv := hm (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 by norm_num)
      (show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 by norm_num) zero_le_one
    have hreal : 0 ≤ (quadForm (cfc f B - cfc f A) x).re := by
      simpa [reQuadFormCLM, C, D, quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub] using sub_nonneg.mpr hv
    change 0 ≤ quadForm (cfc f B - cfc f A) x
    rw [← hdiff.ofReal_re_quadForm x]
    exact RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr hreal

name: NLAlib.operatorMonotoneOn_iff_posSemidef_loewnerMatrix
statement:
theorem operatorMonotoneOn_iff_posSemidef_loewnerMatrix {I : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hI : IsOpen I) (hcI : Convex ℝ I) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ f I) :
    OperatorMonotoneOn I f ↔ ∀ (d : ℕ) (ev : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ i, ev i ∈ I) → (loewnerMatrix f ev).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm d ev hev
    exact hm.posSemidef_loewnerMatrix hI hf ev hev
  · intro hL d A B hA hB hAI hBI hAB
    exact cfc_le_of_posSemidef_loewnerMatrices hI hcI hf (hL d) hA hB hAI hBI hAB

name: lieb_concavity_fin
statement:
private theorem lieb_concavity_fin {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ {A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ | A.PosDef}
      (fun A => traceExp (H + matrixLog A))
proof:
:= by
  have hj := convexOn_relativeEntropy (d := d)
  have hc : Convex ℝ {A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ | A.PosDef} := by
    intro A hA B hB a b ha hb hab
    exact (hj.1 (show (A,A) ∈ _ from ⟨hA,hA⟩)
      (show (B,B) ∈ _ from ⟨hB,hB⟩) ha hb hab).1
  refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
  intro A hA B hB a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hTA⟩ := (isGreatest_variational_traceExp H A hH hA).1
  obtain ⟨U,hU,hUB⟩ := (isGreatest_variational_traceExp H B hH hB).1
  have hAB := hc hA hB ha hb hab
  have hTU := hc hT hU ha hb hab
  have hentropy := hj.2 (show (T,A) ∈ _ from ⟨hT,hA⟩)
    (show (U,B) ∈ _ from ⟨hU,hB⟩) ha hb hab
  change relativeEntropy (a • T + b • U) (a • A + b • B) ≤
    a * relativeEntropy T A + b * relativeEntropy U B at hentropy
  have hmax := (isGreatest_variational_traceExp H (a • A + b • B) hH hAB).2
    ⟨a • T + b • U,hTU,rfl⟩
  have htrace (C D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :
      (Matrix.trace (a • C + b • D)).re = a * (Matrix.trace C).re + b * (Matrix.trace D).re := by
    simp
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, htrace, htrace] at hmax
  change a * traceExp (H + matrixLog A) + b * traceExp (H + matrixLog B) ≤ _
  rw [hTA,hUB]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.lieb_concavity
statement:
theorem lieb_concavity {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ {A : Matrix n n ℂ | A.PosDef} (fun A => traceExp (H + matrixLog A))
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have : Subsingleton (Matrix n n ℂ) := ⟨fun A B => Matrix.ext fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩
    refine ⟨Set.subsingleton_of_subsingleton.convex, ?_⟩
    intro A _ B _ a b _ _ hab
    rw [Subsingleton.elim B A, Subsingleton.elim (a • A + b • A) A, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  have : NeZero (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
  let E := reindexStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := ℂ) e
  let L := (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℝ ℂ e e).toLinearMap
  have h := (lieb_concavity_fin (E H) (hH.reindex e)).comp_linearMap L
  have hdomain : L ⁻¹' {A | A.PosDef} = {A : Matrix n n ℂ | A.PosDef} := by
    ext A
    exact posDef_reindex_iff e A
  rw [hdomain] at h
  apply h.congr
  intro A hA
  change traceExp (E H + matrixLog (E A)) = traceExp (H + matrixLog A)
  have hlog : matrixLog (E A) = E (matrixLog A) := matrixLog_reindex_of_isHermitian e A hA.1
  rw [hlog]
  have ha : E H + E (matrixLog A) = E (H + matrixLog A) := (map_add E _ _).symm
  rw [ha]
  exact traceExp_reindex e _

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_affine_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_affine_branch
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (S : M) (hS : S ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α)
    (H : M) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ (G : ℂ → M) (B : M), AnalyticAt ℂ G 0 ∧ G 0 = S ∧
      HasDerivAt G B 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => G t) B 0 ∧ B.IsHermitian ∧
      matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B = H ∧
      (∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, G z ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
        matrixKTransform ν α (G z) = matrixKTransform ν α S + z • H) ∧
      ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, G t ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : S ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν :=
    ⟨hS.1.isUnit, fun T hT => isUnit_matrixKDenominator S T.val hS.1 (hS.2.1 T hT)⟩
  let D := matrixKTransformDerivComplex ν α S
  have hinj : Function.Injective D :=
    injective_matrixKTransformDerivComplex_of_quadratic_pos ν hν α hα S hS.1 hS.2.1 hS.2.2
  let e : M ≃L[ℂ] M := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective D.toLinearMap
    ⟨hinj, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) (e : M →L[ℂ] M) S := by
    convert! hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom using 1
  have hc := contDiffAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom
  let Q := hc.localInverse hderiv one_ne_zero
  let P : ℂ → M := fun z => matrixKTransform ν α S + z • H
  let G : ℂ → M := fun z => Q (P z)
  have hP0 : P 0 = matrixKTransform ν α S := by simp only [P, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hQc := hc.to_localInverse hderiv one_ne_zero
  have hGc : ContDiffAt ℂ 1 G 0 := by
    apply ContDiffAt.comp 0 (g := Q) (f := P)
    · rwa [hP0]
    · exact contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_id.smul contDiffAt_const)
  have hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G 0 := Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mpr
    ((hGc.eventually (by simp)).mono fun _ h => h.differentiableAt one_ne_zero)
  have hG0 : G 0 = S := by
    change Q (P 0) = S
    rw [hP0]
    exact hc.localInverse_apply_image hderiv one_ne_zero
  have hcont : Tendsto G (𝓝 0) (𝓝 S) := by simpa only [hG0] using hGa.continuousAt.tendsto
  have hright := (hc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hderiv one_ne_zero).eventually_right_inverse
  have hleft : ∀ᶠ X in 𝓝 S, Q (matrixKTransform ν α X) = X :=
    (hc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hderiv one_ne_zero).eventually_left_inverse
  have hPc : Tendsto P (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (matrixKTransform ν α S)) := by
    rw [← hP0]
    exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).continuousAt
  have hGeq : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, G z ∈ matrixKTransformDomain ν ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (G z) = P z := by
    filter_upwards [hcont.eventually ((isOpen_matrixKTransformDomain ν hν).mem_nhds hdom),
      hPc.eventually hright] with z hz hsolve
    exact ⟨hz, hsolve⟩
  let B := deriv G 0
  have hGd : HasDerivAt G B 0 := hGa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hKd : HasFDerivAt (matrixKTransform ν α) D (G 0) := by
    rw [hG0]
    exact hasFDerivAt_matrixKTransform_complex ν hν α hdom
  have hcomp := hKd.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℂ) hGd
  have hPd : HasDerivAt P H 0 := by
    convert! ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).smul_const H).const_add
      (matrixKTransform ν α S) using 1
    simp only [one_smul]
  have hDE (X : M) : D X = matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S X :=
    congrArg (fun L : M →L[ℝ] M => L X)
      (matrixKTransformDerivComplex_restrictScalars ν α S)
  have hDB : matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B = H := by
    have hEq : (fun z : ℂ => matrixKTransform ν α (G z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : ℂ)] P :=
      hGeq.mono fun _ h => h.2
    have hh := (hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq.symm).unique hPd
    rwa [hDE] at hh
  have hU : (matrixKTransform ν α S).IsHermitian := by
    have hs := matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α S hdom
    rw [hS.1.isHermitian.eq] at hs
    exact hs.symm
  have hx : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero] using Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 : ℝ)
  have hGreallim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => G t) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hcont.comp hx
  have hGstarlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (G t)ᴴ) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 S) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hS.1.isHermitian.eq] using hGreallim.star
  have hreal : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, (G t).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [hGreallim.eventually hleft, hGstarlim.eventually hleft, hx.eventually hGeq]
      with t ht1 ht2 hsolve
    have hPt : (P t).IsHermitian := hU.add (hH.smul (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint]))
    change (G t)ᴴ = G t
    calc
      _ = Q (matrixKTransform ν α (G t)ᴴ) := ht2.symm
      _ = Q (matrixKTransform ν α (G t)) := by
        rw [matrixKTransform_conjTranspose ν α (G t) hsolve.1, hsolve.2, hPt.eq]
      _ = _ := ht1
  have hGR : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => G t) B 0 := by
    have hi : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) 0 := by
      convert! (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := (0 : ℝ))) using 1
    have hh : HasFDerivAt G ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ B).restrictScalars ℝ) (0 : ℂ) :=
      hGd.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ
    convert! hh.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) (f := fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) hi using 1
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, one_smul]
  have hBH : B.IsHermitian := by
    have hs := hGR.star
    have heq : (fun t : ℝ => star (G t)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ => G t) :=
      hreal.mono fun _ h => h.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
    exact (hs.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq.symm).unique hGR
  let Ssa : selfAdjoint M := ⟨S, hS.1.isHermitian⟩
  have hpartS : selfAdjointPart ℝ S = Ssa :=
    Subtype.ext (hS.1.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ)
  have hRlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => selfAdjointPart ℝ (G t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 Ssa) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hpartS] using
      (continuous_selfAdjointPart ℝ M).tendsto S |>.comp hGreallim
  have hstay := hRlim.eventually
    ((isOpen_matrixKStableDomain_hermitian ν hν α hα).mem_nhds hS)
  have hstable : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, G t ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α := by
    filter_upwards [hstay, hreal] with t ht hHt
    change (selfAdjointPart ℝ (G t) : M) ∈ matrixKStableDomain ν α at ht
    rwa [hHt.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ] at ht
  exact ⟨G, B, hGa, hG0, hGd, hGR, hBH, hDB, hGeq, hstable⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_double_intervalIntegral_of_continuous
statement:
private theorem sum_double_intervalIntegral_of_continuous
    (f : ι → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (fun t : ℝ × ℝ => f i t.1 t.2)) :
    (∑ i, ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, f i u v) =
      ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i, f i u v
proof:
:= by
  have hinner (i : ι) : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, f i u v) := by
    have h := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := volume)
      (f := f i) (hf i) (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1))
    simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num),
      integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc] using h
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => (hinner i).intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro u _
  exact (intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ =>
    ((hf i).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)).symm

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_first_copy_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_first_copy_le
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (x₀ : E) (z : Fin 3 → ι → E)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ s i, specNorm (L (z s i)) ≤ R)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (p : ℝ) * R ≤ |ζ.im|) :
    let mass
proof:
:= 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, L (z 0 i) ^ 2) +
      specNorm (∑ i, L (z 1 i) ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, L (z 2 i) ^ 2))
    ‖∑ i, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
      (x₀ - a • (z 0 i - z 1 i)) (z 0 i - z 1 i) (z 1 i - z 2 i)‖ ≤
      ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        3 * (2 * R) * mass * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 *
          resolventEvenMoment (A + L x₀) ζ p ^
            (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ)) := by
  classical
  let mass := 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, L (z 0 i) ^ 2) +
    specNorm (∑ i, L (z 1 i) ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, L (z 2 i) ^ 2))
  let D : ι → E := fun i => z 0 i - z 1 i
  let V : ι → E := fun i => z 1 i - z 2 i
  let X : ι → ℝ → ℝ → E := fun i u v =>
    (x₀ - a • D i) - a • V i + v • (a • (V i + u • D i))
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun y => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let f : ι → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun i u v =>
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Φ (X i u v) ![V i + u • D i, D i, D i]
  let B : ℝ := 3 * (2 * R) * mass * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 *
    resolventEvenMoment (A + L x₀) ζ p ^
      (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
  let T : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * B
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ 3 Φ := contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p
  have hfc (i : ι) : Continuous (fun t : ℝ × ℝ => f i t.1 t.2) := by
    have hpath : Continuous (fun t : ℝ × ℝ => X i t.1 t.2) := by dsimp only [X]; fun_prop
    have hdirs : Continuous (fun t : ℝ × ℝ => ![V i + t.1 • D i, D i, D i]) := by fun_prop
    exact continuous_eval.comp ((hc.continuous_iteratedFDeriv'.comp hpath).prodMk hdirs)
  have hsum : (∑ i, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
      (x₀ - a • D i) (D i) (V i)) =
        ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i, f i u v := by
    exact sum_double_intervalIntegral_of_continuous f hfc
  have hpoint (u v : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) :
      ‖∑ i, f i u v‖ ≤ T := by
    let Z : Fin 3 → ι → M := fun s i => L (z s i)
    let C : ι → Fin 3 → M := fun i => ![L (V i + u • D i), L (D i), L (D i)]
    let H : ι → M := fun i => a • ((1 - v) • Z 2 i +
      (v * (1 - u)) • Z 1 i + (u * v) • Z 0 i - Z 0 i)
    have hb := norm_and_specNorm_sum_sq_copy_directions_le Z
      (fun s i => isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (z s i)) hR hZ
      hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1 ha0 ha1
    change _ ∧ _ ∧ _ at hb
    rcases hb with ⟨hD, hE, hH⟩
    have hDeq (i : ι) : L (D i) = Z 0 i - Z 1 i := by simp only [D, Z, map_sub]
    have hEeq (i : ι) : L (V i + u • D i) =
        (Z 1 i - Z 2 i) + u • (Z 0 i - Z 1 i) := by
      simp only [V, D, Z, map_add, map_sub, map_smul]
    have hCeq (i : ι) (t : Fin 3) :
        C i t = if t = 0 then (Z 1 i - Z 2 i) + u • (Z 0 i - Z 1 i)
          else Z 0 i - Z 1 i := by
      fin_cases t <;> simp [C, hDeq, hEeq]
    have hHermC (i : ι) (t : Fin 3) : (C i t).IsHermitian := by
      rw [hCeq]
      split_ifs <;> first | exact hE.1 i | exact hD.1 i
    have hBoundC (i : ι) (t : Fin 3) : specNorm (C i t) ≤ 2 * R := by
      rw [hCeq]
      split_ifs <;> first | exact hE.2.1 i | exact hD.2.1 i
    have hMassC (t : Fin 3) : specNorm (∑ i, C i t ^ 2) ≤ mass := by
      simp_rw [hCeq]
      by_cases ht : t = 0
      · simpa only [ht, if_true] using hE.2.2
      · simpa only [ht, if_false] using hD.2.2
    have hpath (i : ι) : A + L (X i u v) = (A + L x₀) + H i := by
      simp only [X, V, D, H, Z, map_sub, map_add, map_smul]
      module
    have hword (i₀ : Fin (p + p)) (i₁ : Fin (p + p + 1))
        (i₂ : Fin (p + p + 2)) :
        ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
            (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) i₀ (L (D i))) i₁ (L (D i)))
              i₂ (L (V i + u • D i))) (X i u v))‖ ≤ B := by
      have hheight : 8 * (p : ℝ) * (2 * R) ≤ |ζ.im| := by nlinarith
      have hh := norm_sum_normalizedTrace_third_resolventWord_add_le hp i₀ i₁ i₂ C H
        hHermC hH.1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R) hBoundC hH.2.1 hMassC hH.2.2
        (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x₀)) hζ hheight
      simpa only [C, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, hermitianCoordinateResolventWord,
        List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, hermitianCoordinateResolvent, hpath, B] using hh
    have heq : (∑ i, f i u v) =
        ∑ i₀ : Fin (p + p), ∑ i₁ : Fin (p + p + 1), ∑ i₂ : Fin (p + p + 2),
          ∑ i, normalizedTrace (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
              (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) i₀ (L (D i))) i₁ (L (D i)))
                i₂ (L (V i + u • D i))) (X i u v)) := by
      simp only [f, Φ, iteratedFDeriv_three_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_apply
        A hA ζ hζ p, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i₀ _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i₁ _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i₀ : Fin (p + p), ‖∑ i₁ : Fin (p + p + 1),
          ∑ i₂ : Fin (p + p + 2), ∑ i, normalizedTrace (hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert
              (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) i₀ (L (D i))) i₁ (L (D i)))
                i₂ (L (V i + u • D i))) (X i u v))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i₀ : Fin (p + p), ∑ i₁ : Fin (p + p + 1), ∑ i₂ : Fin (p + p + 2), B := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i₀ _
        exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i₁ _ =>
          (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i₂ _ => hword i₀ i₁ i₂))
      _ = T := by simp [T]; ring
  rw [hsum]
  have hn := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (f := fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i, f i u v)
    (C := T) (fun u hu => by
    have hu' : u ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] using hu
    have hn' := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (f := fun v => ∑ i, f i u v) (C := T) (fun v hv => by
      have hv' : v ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] using hv
      exact hpoint u v hu'.1.le hu'.2 hv'.1.le hv'.2)
    simpa only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] using hn')
  simpa only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one, T, B, D, V, mass, mul_assoc] using hn

name: NLAlib.posDef_krausMap_of_operatorCapacity_pos
statement:
theorem posDef_krausMap_of_operatorCapacity_pos
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hcap : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A))
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef) (hdet : X.det = 1) :
    (krausMap A X).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (krausMap A X).det.re :=
    hcap.trans_le (operatorCapacity_le_det_apply (krausMap A) (krausMap_posSemidef A) hX hdet)
  apply (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX.posSemidef).posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hzero
  simp only [hzero, Complex.zero_re, lt_self_iff_false] at hpos

name: NLAlib.exists_isUnit_unital_scaling_of_operatorCapacity_pos
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_unital_scaling_of_operatorCapacity_pos
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hcap : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A))
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef) (hdet : X.det = 1) :
    ∃ L R : Matrix n n ℂ, IsUnit L ∧ IsUnit R ∧
      krausMap (fun a => L * A a * R) 1 = 1 ∧
      Complex.normSq L.det * Complex.normSq R.det = ((krausMap A X).det.re)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let Y := krausMap A X
  have hY : Y.PosDef := posDef_krausMap_of_operatorCapacity_pos A hcap hX hdet
  let R : Matrix n n ℂ := cfc Real.sqrt X
  let Rinv : Matrix n n ℂ := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) X
  let L : Matrix n n ℂ := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Y
  let Linv : Matrix n n ℂ := cfc Real.sqrt Y
  have hR : IsUnit R :=
    ⟨⟨R, Rinv, cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hX, cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hX⟩, rfl⟩
  have hL : IsUnit L :=
    ⟨⟨L, Linv, cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_sqrt hY, cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hY⟩, rfl⟩
  have hRH : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hLH : L.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRX : R * 1 * Rᴴ = X := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_one, hRH.eq]
    exact cfc_sqrt_mul_self hX
  have hLY : L * Y * Lᴴ = 1 := by
    rw [hLH.eq]
    exact cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hY
  have hRdet : (Complex.normSq R.det : ℂ) = X.det := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.det hRX
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one, mul_one,
      Matrix.det_conjTranspose] at h
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
    simpa only [Complex.star_def, mul_comm] using h
  have hRdet1 : Complex.normSq R.det = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re hRdet
    simpa only [hdet, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.one_re] using h
  have hLdet : (Complex.normSq L.det : ℂ) * Y.det = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.det hLY
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose, Matrix.det_one] at h
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
    simpa only [Complex.star_def, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h
  have hLdetre : Complex.normSq L.det * Y.det.re = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re hLdet
    simpa only [Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.one_re] using h
  refine ⟨L, R, hL, hR, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [krausMap_mul_mul_apply, hRX]
    exact hLY
  · rw [hRdet1, mul_one]
    exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hLdetre

name: NLAlib.stableGap_scalar_im
statement:
private theorem stableGap_scalar_im (z : ℂ) :
    (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M)=z.im•1
proof:
:= by
  have hI : IsSelfAdjoint (1 : M) := IsSelfAdjoint.one _
  simp [imaginaryPart_smul,hI.imaginaryPart,realPart_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stable_branch_agrees_upper
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stable_branch_agrees_upper
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (u : ℝ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1) :
    ∃ (G : ℂ → M) (C : ℝ), AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧ G u=S ∧
      ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), 0<z.im → G z=F z ∧
        ‖(imaginaryPart (α•F z) : M)‖≤C*z.im
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,B,hGa,hG0,hB,hGd,hreal,hGeq⟩ :=
    exists_analytic_real_matrixKTransform_inverse_branch ν hν α hα S hS hgap hpos u hK
  obtain ⟨C,hupper⟩ := Matrix.eventually_posDef_imaginaryPart_of_posDef_deriv
    G u B hGa hGd hB hreal
  refine ⟨G,α*C,hGa,hG0,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hupper,hGeq] with z hzG hzK
  intro hz
  have hZ : (imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M).PosDef := by
    rw [stableGap_scalar_im]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hz
  have he := matrixKTransform_solution_unique_upperHalfPlane ν hν α hα
    (z•1) (G z) (F z) hZ (hzG hz).1 (hF z hz).1 hzK.2 (hF z hz).2
  refine ⟨he,?_⟩
  have hscale : (imaginaryPart (α•F z) : M)=α•(imaginaryPart (F z) : M) := by
    rw [map_smul]; rfl
  rw [hscale,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le,← he]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hzG hz).2 hα.le).trans_eq (mul_assoc α C z.im).symm

name: NLAlib.notMem_support_of_matrixKTransform_stable_solution
statement:
theorem notMem_support_of_matrixKTransform_stable_solution
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (F : ℂ → M)
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → (imaginaryPart (F z) : M).PosDef ∧
      matrixKTransform ν α (F z)=z•1)
    (μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → normalizedTrace (α•F z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ))
    (S : M) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hpos : ∀ H : M, H.IsHermitian → H≠0 →
      0<frobInner H (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S H))
    (u : ℝ) (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=(u : ℂ)•1) :
    u∉(μ : Measure ℝ).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,C,hGa,hG0,hlocal⟩ := exists_analytic_matrixKTransform_stable_branch_agrees_upper
    ν hν α hα F hF S hS hgap hpos u hK
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hεlocal⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hlocal
  let r := ε/4
  have hr : 0<r := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  apply notMem_support_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul (μ : Measure ℝ) u r (max C ((r⁻¹)^2)) hr
  intro x hx γ hγ
  have hg : 0<(γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
  let z : ℂ := (x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I
  have hz : 0<z.im := by simpa only [z,Complex.add_im,Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,
    zero_mul,add_zero,zero_add] using hg
  rw [← hμ z hz]
  by_cases hsmall : (γ : ℝ)<r
  · have hxN : |x-u|<r := by simpa only [mem_ball,Real.dist_eq] using hx
    have hdist : dist z (u : ℂ)<ε := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have he : z-(u : ℂ)=((x-u : ℝ) : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I := by
        dsimp only [z]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [he]
      have hn := norm_add_le (((x-u : ℝ) : ℂ)) (((γ : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)
      rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hg] at hn
      have hrε : 2*r<ε := by dsimp only [r]; linarith
      exact hn.trans_lt (by linarith)
    have hN := (hεlocal hdist hz).2
    have htrace := im_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm_imaginaryPart (α•F z)
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm] at htrace
    have hzγ : z.im=(γ : ℝ) := by simp [z]
    apply (htrace.trans hN).trans
    rw [hzγ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hg.le
  · have hrg : r≤(γ : ℝ) := le_of_not_gt hsmall
    have htarget : (α*(γ : ℝ))•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart (z•(1 : M)) : M) := by
      rw [stableGap_scalar_im,smul_smul]
      simp only [z,Complex.add_im,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,
        add_zero,zero_add,le_refl]
    have hFN := specNorm_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le_inv ν hν α hα (z•1)
      (F z) (hF z hz).1 (hF z hz).2 (α*(γ : ℝ)) (mul_pos hα hg) htarget
    have hN : ‖α•F z‖≤(γ : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα.le]
      calc
        _ ≤ α*(α*(γ : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hFN) hα.le
        _ = _ := by field_simp [hα.ne',hg.ne']
    have htail : (γ : ℝ)⁻¹≤(r⁻¹)^2*(γ : ℝ) := by
      rw [inv_pow]
      calc
        _ = 1/(γ : ℝ) := by rw [one_div]
        _ ≤ (γ : ℝ)/r^2 := (div_le_div_iff₀ hg (sq_pos_of_pos hr)).mpr (by
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul hrg hrg hr.le hg.le])
        _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖normalizedTrace (α•F z)‖ := Complex.im_le_norm _
      _ ≤ ‖α•F z‖ := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm (α•F z)
      _ ≤ (γ : ℝ)⁻¹ := hN
      _ ≤ (r⁻¹)^2*(γ : ℝ) := htail
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hg.le

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.conjTranspose_resolvent
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.conjTranspose_resolvent
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : 𝕜) :
    (resolvent A ζ)ᴴ = resolvent A (star ζ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hA.eq] using star_resolvent A ζ

name: NLAlib.resolvent_matrix_eq_inv
statement:
theorem resolvent_matrix_eq_inv (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) :
    resolvent A ζ = (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)-A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent,←Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.shifted_hermitian_diagonalization
statement:
private theorem shifted_hermitian_diagonalization {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) :
    ζ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)-A = Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hA.eigenvectorUnitary
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) =
      ζ • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)-Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hA.eigenvalues) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply,Matrix.one_apply,hij]
  rw [hd,map_sub,map_smul,map_one,←hA.spectral_theorem]

name: NLAlib.shifted_eigenvalue_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem shifted_eigenvalue_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (i : n) : ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im heq
  exact hζ (by simpa using hi)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [shifted_hermitian_diagonalization hA]
  apply IsUnit.map _
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_diagonal,Pi.isUnit_iff]
  exact fun i => isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (shifted_eigenvalue_ne_zero hA hζ i)

name: NLAlib.resolvent_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_conj_diagonal
statement:
theorem resolvent_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_conj_diagonal {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resolvent A ζ = Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hA.eigenvectorUnitary
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent_matrix_eq_inv]
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  rw [shifted_hermitian_diagonalization hA,←map_mul]
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simp [shifted_eigenvalue_ne_zero hA hζ]
  rw [hd,map_one]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_resolvent_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_conj_diagonal hA hζ]
  unfold NLAlib.specNorm
  rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  change ‖(hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))⁻¹) *
    ((star hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [CStarRing.norm_mul_coe_unitary,CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary_mul,Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _))).mpr
  intro i
  rw [norm_inv]
  have hi : |ζ.im| ≤ ‖ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (ζ-(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ))
  simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (abs_pos.mpr hζ) hi

name: NLAlib.mulVec_pow_zero_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem mulVec_pow_zero_of_lt_card {K : Type*} [RCLike K] (A : Matrix n n K) (L : Matrix s n K)
    (v : n → K) (h : ∀ j < Fintype.card n, L *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    L *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  | inr hn =>
    let p : K[X] := (X ^ j) %ₘ A.charpoly
    have hchar : A.charpoly ≠ 1 := by
      intro hc
      have hd := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hc
      rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, natDegree_one] at hd
      exact (Fintype.card_pos.ne' hd)
    have hp : p.natDegree < Fintype.card n := by
      simpa only [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim] using natDegree_modByMonic_lt (X ^ j) A.charpoly_monic hchar
    rw [Matrix.pow_eq_aeval_mod_charpoly]
    change L *ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ v) = 0
    rw [aeval_eq_sum_range' hp, Matrix.sum_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_smul, h i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi), smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_matrixExp_zero_of_pow_zero
statement:
theorem mulVec_matrixExp_zero_of_pow_zero {K : Type*} [RCLike K] (A : Matrix n n K) (L : Matrix s n K)
    (v : n → K) (h : ∀ j : ℕ, L *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    L *ᵥ (matrixExp (t • A) *ᵥ v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let F : Matrix n n K →ₗ[K] s → K :=
    L.mulVecLin.comp ((LinearMap.applyₗ v).comp Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap)
  have hs := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := K) (t • A)).map
    F.toContinuousLinearMap F.toContinuousLinearMap.continuous
  have hz : (F.toContinuousLinearMap ∘ fun j : ℕ => (((j.factorial : K)⁻¹) • (t • A) ^ j)) = 0 := by
    funext j
    change F (((j.factorial : K)⁻¹) • (t • A) ^ j) = 0
    change L *ᵥ ((((j.factorial : K)⁻¹) • (t • A) ^ j) *ᵥ v) = 0
    rw [smul_pow, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
      Matrix.mulVec_smul, h j, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  change HasSum _ (L *ᵥ (matrixExp (t • A) *ᵥ v)) at hs
  rw [hz] at hs
  exact hs.unique hasSum_zero

name: NLAlib.kernel_lyapunov_invariant
statement:
theorem kernel_lyapunov_invariant {K : Type*} [RCLike K] (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)
    (X : Matrix n n K) (hX : X.PosSemidef) (heq : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0)
    (v : n → K) (hv : X *ᵥ v = 0) : Bᴴ *ᵥ v = 0 ∧ X *ᵥ (Aᴴ *ᵥ v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : star v ᵥ* X = 0 := by
    have h := Matrix.star_mulVec X v
    rw [hv, star_zero, hX.isHermitian.eq] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hq := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => star v ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v)) heq
  simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add, Matrix.zero_mulVec,
    dotProduct_zero] at hq
  have h₁ : star v ⬝ᵥ ((A * X) *ᵥ v) = 0 := by rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hv]; simp
  have h₂ : star v ⬝ᵥ ((X * Aᴴ) *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hrow]
    simp
  rw [h₁, h₂, zero_add, zero_add] at hq
  have hBB : (B * Bᴴ) *ᵥ v = 0 :=
    ((Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose B).dotProduct_mulVec_zero_iff v).mp hq
  have hB : Bᴴ *ᵥ v = 0 := (Matrix.self_mul_conjTranspose_mulVec_eq_zero B v).mp hBB
  refine ⟨hB, ?_⟩
  have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n K => M *ᵥ v) heq
  simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hv, hB, Matrix.mulVec_zero,
    Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_add, add_zero] at he
  exact he

name: NLAlib.lyapunovGramian_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem lyapunovGramian_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (B : Matrix n s ℂ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz A) (v : n → ℂ) :
    lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) *ᵥ v = 0 ↔
      ∀ j < Fintype.card n, Bᴴ *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let G := lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)
  have hX : G.PosSemidef := posSemidef_lyapunovGramian A _ hA (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose B)
  have heq : A * G + G * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0 := by
    change A * lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) + lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0
    rw [lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution A _ _ hA (lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A _ hA)]
    exact lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A _ hA
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hker (j : ℕ) : G *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ j *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
      induction j with
      | zero => simpa using hv
      | succ j hj =>
        rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
        exact (kernel_lyapunov_invariant A B G hX heq _ hj).2
    intro j _
    exact (kernel_lyapunov_invariant A B G hX heq _ (hker j)).1
  · intro hv
    have hall := mulVec_pow_zero_of_lt_card Aᴴ Bᴴ v hv
    have he (t : ℝ) : Bᴴ *ᵥ ((matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
      have hstar : (matrixExp (t • A))ᴴ = matrixExp (t • Aᴴ) := by
        change star (NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) = NormedSpace.exp (t • star A)
        rw [NormedSpace.star_exp, star_smul, star_trivial]
      rw [hstar]
      exact mulVec_matrixExp_zero_of_pow_zero Aᴴ Bᴴ v hall t
    let F : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] n → ℂ := (LinearMap.applyₗ v).comp Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap
    have hi := F.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (integrableOn_lyapunovIntegrand A (B * Bᴴ) hA)
    change (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), lyapunovIntegrand A (B * Bᴴ) t *ᵥ v) =
      lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) *ᵥ v at hi
    rw [← hi]
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      change lyapunovIntegrand A (B * Bᴴ) t *ᵥ v = 0
      simp only [lyapunovIntegrand, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, he, Matrix.mulVec_zero]

name: NLAlib.rank_lyapunovGramian_eq_rank_controllabilityMatrix
statement:
theorem rank_lyapunovGramian_eq_rank_controllabilityMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (B : Matrix n s ℂ) (hA : IsHurwitz A) :
    (lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).rank = (controllabilityMatrix A B).rank
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.ker (controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ.mulVecLin := by
    ext v
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, lyapunovGramian_mulVec_eq_zero_iff A B hA]
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext j
      have hj := h j.1 j.1.isLt
      have he : ((controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ *ᵥ v) j =
          (Bᴴ *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ (j.1 : ℕ) *ᵥ v)) j.2 := by
        change (((A ^ (j.1 : ℕ) * B)ᴴ) *ᵥ v) j.2 = _
        rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_pow, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rw [he, hj]
      rfl
    · intro h j hj
      ext a
      change (Bᴴ *ᵥ ((Aᴴ) ^ j *ᵥ v)) a = 0
      have he := congrFun h (⟨j, hj⟩, a)
      change (((A ^ j * B)ᴴ) *ᵥ v) a = 0 at he
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_pow, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using he
  have h₁ := (lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have h₂ := (controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hker] at h₁
  change (lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)).rank + _ = _ at h₁
  change (controllabilityMatrix A B)ᴴ.rank + _ = _ at h₂
  rw [Matrix.rank_conjTranspose] at h₂
  omega

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_trace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_cfcAbs_trace
statement:
theorem norm_sum_trace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_cfcAbs_trace
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (Z : ι → Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i j, (Z i j).IsHermitian) {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hZ : ∀ i j, specNorm (Z i j) ≤ r)
    (hMass : ∀ j, specNorm (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2) ≤ M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ)
    (a b : Fin k → ℕ) {L : ℕ} (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L)
    (hLpos : 0 < L) (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) :
    ‖∑ i, (List.ofFn (fun j => Z i j *
      (resolvent A ζ ^ a j * resolvent A (star ζ) ^ b j))).prod.trace‖ ≤
      r ^ (k - 2) * M * (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ L).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hsSum : ∑ j, ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) = (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hLpos
  have hs0 (j : Fin k) : (0 : ℝ) < (a j + b j : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hArc j
  obtain ⟨hp, hsum⟩ := ENNReal.one_le_ofReal_div_and_sum_inv_toReal_eq_one
    (fun j => ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ)) hsSum hL0 hs0
  have h := norm_sumTraceWordMultilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm hk Z hHerm hr hZ hMass
    (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal ((L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ))) hp hsum
    (fun j => resolvent A ζ ^ a j * resolvent A (star ζ) ^ b j)
  rw [prod_schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow hA ζ a b hL hLpos hArc] at h
  simpa only [sumTraceWordMultilinear_apply, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_normalizedTrace_eq_div_card
statement:
private theorem norm_sum_normalizedTrace_eq_div_card
    (W : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace (W i)‖ = ‖∑ i, (W i).trace‖ / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedTrace, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_cfcAbs_trace
statement:
theorem norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_cfcAbs_trace
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (Z : ι → Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i j, (Z i j).IsHermitian) {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hZ : ∀ i j, specNorm (Z i j) ≤ r)
    (hMass : ∀ j, specNorm (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2) ≤ M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ)
    (a b : Fin k → ℕ) {L : ℕ} (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L)
    (hLpos : 0 < L) (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) :
    ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j => Z i j *
      (resolvent A ζ ^ a j * resolvent A (star ζ) ^ b j))).prod)‖ ≤
      r ^ (k - 2) * M * (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ L)).re
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sum_trace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_cfcAbs_trace
    hk Z hHerm hr hZ hMass hA ζ a b hL hLpos hArc
  have htrace : (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ L).trace.re / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) =
      (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ L)).re := by
    have ht := re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_div_card (resolvent A ζ) L
    rw [← re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues (resolvent A ζ) L] at ht
    simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using ht.symm
  rw [norm_sum_normalizedTrace_eq_div_card]
  calc
    _ ≤ (r ^ (k - 2) * M * (CFC.abs (resolvent A ζ) ^ L).trace.re) /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [← htrace, mul_div_assoc]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_resolventEvenMoment
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (Z : ι → Fin k → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i j, (Z i j).IsHermitian) {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hZ : ∀ i j, specNorm (Z i j) ≤ r)
    (hMass : ∀ j, specNorm (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2) ≤ M)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    (a b : Fin k → ℕ) {p L : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L) (hLp : 2 * p - 1 ≤ L)
    (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) :
    ‖∑ i, normalizedTrace ((List.ofFn (fun j => Z i j *
      (resolvent A ζ ^ a j * resolvent A (star ζ) ^ b j))).prod)‖ ≤
      r ^ (k - 2) * M * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (L - (2 * p - 1)) *
        resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by omega
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    let j : Fin k := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    exact (specNorm_nonneg (∑ i, Z i j ^ 2)).trans (hMass j)
  have h := norm_sum_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_word_le_cfcAbs_trace
    hk Z hHerm hr hZ hMass hA ζ a b hL hLpos hArc
  have hmoment := hA.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_le hζ hp hLp
  have hC : 0 ≤ r ^ (k - 2) * M := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hr _) hM
  exact h.trans (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment hC)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    traceExp (A + H) = traceExp A +
      deriv (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 +
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
        iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) :=
    (contDiff_traceExp (n := n) : ContDiff ℝ 2 _).comp
      (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const))
  simpa only [one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero] using
    eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two hsmooth

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : lambdaMax H ≤ R) :
    traceExp (A + H) ≤ traceExp A +
      deriv (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 +
      iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 *
        expSecondRemainderCoefficient R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp A H hA hH
  simpa only [one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero] using
    (hν.mono le_rfl hR).le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient_of_le
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient_of_le
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : H ≤ R • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    traceExp (A + H) ≤ traceExp A +
      deriv (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 +
      iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 *
        expSecondRemainderCoefficient R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have := hn
    have hzero (B : Matrix n n ℂ) : traceExp B = 0 := by
      simp [traceExp, Matrix.trace]
    simp [hzero]
  | inr hn =>
    have := hn
    apply traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient A H hA hH
    have hs : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ H, x ≤ R := by
      apply (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hH.isSelfAdjoint).mp
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hR
    unfold lambdaMax
    apply csSup_le _ hs
    rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact Set.range_nonempty _

name: NLAlib.two_mul_traceExp_add_iteratedDeriv_two_le_add_traceExp
statement:
theorem two_mul_traceExp_add_iteratedDeriv_two_le_add_traceExp
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    2 * traceExp A + iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 ≤
      traceExp (A + H) + traceExp (A - H)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp A H hA hH
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul, neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    hν.two_mul_zero_add_iteratedDeriv_two_le_add

name: NLAlib.exists_posSemidef_norm_eigenvector
statement:
theorem exists_posSemidef_norm_eigenvector
    (T : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n →L[ℝ] HermitianFrobenius ℂ n)
    (hT : T.IsSymmetric)
    (hpos : ∀ x, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (T x)).PosSemidef) :
    ∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef ∧ T x=‖T‖ • x
proof:
:= by
  let E := (hermitianFrobeniusEquiv ℂ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))
  let L := hermitianFrobeniusMatrixLinear.comp (T.toLinearMap.comp E)
  have hE (x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) : E (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x)=x := by
    apply (hermitianFrobeniusEquiv ℂ n).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (selfAdjointPart ℝ (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x) : Matrix n n ℂ)=
      hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x
    exact (isHermitian_hermitianFrobeniusMatrix x).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ
  have hL (x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n) :
      L (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x)=hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (T x) := by
    change hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (T (E (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x)))=_
    rw [hE]
  have hLP (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : P.PosSemidef) : (L P).PosSemidef := by
    have hh := hpos (toHermitianFrobenius hP.isHermitian) hP
    rwa [← hL, hermitianFrobeniusMatrix_toHermitianFrobenius] at hh
  apply T.exists_norm_eigenvector_of_rayleigh_majorants hT
    (fun x => (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef)
  intro x
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hKn,hKQ⟩ := exists_posSemidef_rayleigh_majorant L hLP
    (isHermitian_hermitianFrobeniusMatrix x)
  let y := toHermitianFrobenius hK.isHermitian
  refine ⟨y,hK,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [norm_hermitianFrobenius, norm_hermitianFrobenius]
    change frobNorm K=frobNorm (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x)
    exact congrArg Real.sqrt hKn
  · have hLy : L K=hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (T y) := hL y
    rw [hLy] at hKQ
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.reApplyInnerSelf_apply, RCLike.re_to_real,
      inner_hermitianFrobenius, frobInner_comm, hL,
      hermitianFrobeniusMatrix_toHermitianFrobenius, y] using hKQ

name: NLAlib.IsHurwitz.lyapunovADI_admissible
statement:
theorem IsHurwitz.lyapunovADI_admissible {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : IsHurwitz A)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 < p j) (j : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (A - (p j : ℂ) • 1).det
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (hA.isUnit_sub_pos_smul_one (p j) (hp j))

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_lyapunovADI_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_lyapunovADI_le (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) (B : Matrix n s ℂ)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : ℂ) • 1).det)
    (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    specNorm (X - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2) ≤
      specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j) ^ 2 * specNorm X
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_lyapunovADI_snd A X B p hP hX]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j * X) * specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j)ᴴ := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j) * specNorm X) * specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j) := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sub_lyapunovADI_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sub_lyapunovADI_le (A X : Matrix n n ℂ) (B : Matrix n s ℂ)
    (p : ℕ → ℝ) (hP : ∀ j, IsUnit (A - (p j : ℂ) • 1).det)
    (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    frobNorm (X - (lyapunovADI A B p j).2) ≤
      specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j) ^ 2 * frobNorm X
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_lyapunovADI_snd A X B p hP hX]
  calc
    _ ≤ frobNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j * X) * specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j)ᴴ := frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j) * frobNorm X) * specNorm (lyapunovADIPropagator A p j) := by
      rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADIPropagator_const
statement:
theorem lyapunovADIPropagator_const (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lyapunovADIPropagator A (fun _ => p) j = cayleyTransform A p ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j hj => rw [lyapunovADIPropagator, hj, pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.tendsto_lyapunovADI_snd_const
statement:
theorem tendsto_lyapunovADI_snd_const (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (B : Matrix n s ℂ)
    (hA : IsHurwitz A) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun j => (lyapunovADI A B (fun _ => p) j).2) atTop
      (𝓝 (lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)))
proof:
:= by
  let X := lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ)
  have hEq : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0 := by
    change A * lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) + lyapunovGramian A (B * Bᴴ) * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0
    rw [lyapunovGramian_eq_of_solution A _ _ hA (lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A _ hA)]
    exact lyapunovCayleySolution_equation A _ hA
  have ht := tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_of_spectralRadius_lt_one (hA.spectralRadius_cayleyTransform_lt_one p hp)
  have hstar : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (cayleyTransform A p ^ j)ᴴ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => Mᴴ) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  have he := (ht.mul_const X).mul hstar
  simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero] at he
  have herror : (fun j => cayleyTransform A p ^ j * X * (cayleyTransform A p ^ j)ᴴ) =
      fun j => X - (lyapunovADI A B (fun _ => p) j).2 := by
    funext j
    rw [sub_lyapunovADI_snd A X B _ (hA.lyapunovADI_admissible _ (fun _ => hp)) hEq,
      lyapunovADIPropagator_const]
  rw [herror] at he
  have hh := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := X) (f := atTop)).sub he
  simpa only [sub_sub_cancel, sub_zero] using hh

theorem prod_schattenNorm_resolvent_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)

    rationalMatrixEval 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) A =
        rationalMatrixEval 1 (C ζ-X) A * rationalMatrixEval 1 (C ζ-X) A := by
