name: NLAlib.rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq
statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq (ζ : ℂ) (A B H : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    rationalBlockDifference 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) A B H = resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H
proof:
:= by
  have hQA := isUnit_aeval_shift hA hζ
  have hQB := isUnit_aeval_shift hB hζ
  have h := rationalBlockDifference_mul (1 : ℂ[X]) (C ζ-X) 1 (C ζ-X) A B H
    hQA hQB hQA hQB
  simp only [one_mul,←pow_two,one_pow,rationalMatrixEval_resolvent,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent] at h
  rw [h]
  unfold resolventSquareDifference
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent_sq
statement:
theorem rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent_sq (ζ : ℂ) (A B C H K : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    rationalSecondBlockDifference 1 ((Polynomial.C ζ-X)^2) A B C H K =
      resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H K
proof:
:= by
  have hQA := isUnit_aeval_shift hA hζ
  have hQB := isUnit_aeval_shift hB hζ
  have hQC := isUnit_aeval_shift hC hζ
  have h := rationalSecondBlockDifference_mul (1 : ℂ[X]) (Polynomial.C ζ-X) 1
    (Polynomial.C ζ-X) A B C H K hQA hQB hQC hQA hQB hQC
  simp only [one_mul,←pow_two,one_pow,rationalMatrixEval_resolvent,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent,
    rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent,←resolvent_matrix_eq_inv] at h
  rw [h]
  unfold resolventSquareSecondDifference
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.resolvent_sq_sub_resolvent_sq
statement:
theorem resolvent_sq_sub_resolvent_sq (ζ : ℂ) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    (resolvent A ζ)^2-(resolvent B ζ)^2 = resolventSquareDifference ζ A B (A-B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := rationalMatrixEval_sub 1 ((C ζ-X)^2) A B
    (by simpa only [map_pow] using (isUnit_aeval_shift hA hζ).pow 2)
    (by simpa only [map_pow] using (isUnit_aeval_shift hB hζ).pow 2)
  simpa only [rationalMatrixEval_resolvent_sq,
    rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ A B (A-B) hA hB hζ] using h

name: NLAlib.resolventSquareDifference_sub_self
statement:
theorem resolventSquareDifference_sub_self (ζ : ℂ) (A B C H : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H-resolventSquareDifference ζ C C H =
      resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H (B-C) +
        resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A C C (A-C) H
proof:
:= by
  have hQA : IsUnit (aeval A ((Polynomial.C ζ-X)^2)) := by
    simpa only [map_pow] using (isUnit_aeval_shift hA hζ).pow 2
  have hQB : IsUnit (aeval B ((Polynomial.C ζ-X)^2)) := by
    simpa only [map_pow] using (isUnit_aeval_shift hB hζ).pow 2
  have hQC : IsUnit (aeval C ((Polynomial.C ζ-X)^2)) := by
    simpa only [map_pow] using (isUnit_aeval_shift hC hζ).pow 2
  have hr := rationalBlockDifference_sub_right 1 ((Polynomial.C ζ-X)^2) A B C H hQA hQB hQC
  have hl := rationalBlockDifference_sub_left 1 ((Polynomial.C ζ-X)^2) A C C H hQA hQC hQC
  simp only [rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ _ _ _ hA hB hζ,
    rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ _ _ _ hA hC hζ,
    rationalBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ _ _ _ hC hC hζ,
    rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ _ _ _ _ _ hA hB hC hζ,
    rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent_sq ζ _ _ _ _ _ hA hC hC hζ] at hr hl
  rw [←hr,←hl]
  abel

name: NLAlib.resolventSquareDifference_smul
statement:
theorem resolventSquareDifference_smul (ζ : ℂ) (A B H : Matrix n n ℂ) (a : ℝ) :
    resolventSquareDifference ζ A B (a • H) = a • resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resolventSquareDifference,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_add]

name: NLAlib.resolventSquareSecondDifference_smul_left
statement:
theorem resolventSquareSecondDifference_smul_left (ζ : ℂ) (A B C H K : Matrix n n ℂ) (a : ℝ) :
    resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C (a • H) K =
      a • resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resolventSquareSecondDifference,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_add]

name: NLAlib.resolventSquareSecondDifference_smul_right
statement:
theorem resolventSquareSecondDifference_smul_right (ζ : ℂ) (A B C H K : Matrix n n ℂ) (a : ℝ) :
    resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H (a • K) =
      a • resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resolventSquareSecondDifference,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,smul_add]

name: NLAlib.resolvent_sq_sub_resolvent_sq_of_sub_eq_smul
statement:
theorem resolvent_sq_sub_resolvent_sq_of_sub_eq_smul
    (ζ : ℂ) (A B H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a : ℝ) (hAB : A-B = a • H) :
    (resolvent A ζ)^2-(resolvent B ζ)^2 = a • resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent_sq_sub_resolvent_sq ζ A B hA hB hζ,hAB,resolventSquareDifference_smul]

name: NLAlib.resolventSquareDifference_sub_self_of_sub_eq_smul
statement:
theorem resolventSquareDifference_sub_self_of_sub_eq_smul
    (ζ : ℂ) (A B C H E F : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    (a : ℝ) (hBC : B-C = a • E) (hAC : A-C = a • F) :
    resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H - resolventSquareDifference ζ C C H =
      a • (resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H E +
        resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A C C F H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolventSquareDifference_sub_self ζ A B C H hA hB hC hζ,hBC,hAC,
    resolventSquareSecondDifference_smul_left,resolventSquareSecondDifference_smul_right,smul_add]

name: NLAlib.inverseBounds_neg_inverse_involutive
statement:
private theorem inverseBounds_neg_inverse_involutive (S : M) (hS : IsUnit S) :
    -(-S⁻¹)⁻¹=S
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (-S⁻¹)⁻¹= -S := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.mul_neg,neg_neg,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hS)]
  rw [hi,neg_neg]

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Z S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=Z) :
    -S⁻¹=matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z (-S⁻¹) ∧
      α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)≤(imaginaryPart (-S⁻¹) : M)
proof:
:= by
  have hX := posDef_imaginaryPart_neg_matrixInverse S hS
  have hinvol := inverseBounds_neg_inverse_involutive S
    (Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS)
  have hKX : matrixKTransform ν α (-(-S⁻¹)⁻¹)=Z := by rwa [hinvol]
  have hfixed := (matrixKTransform_neg_inverse_eq_iff_fixedPoint ν hν α hα.ne' Z (-S⁻¹) hX).mp hKX
  refine ⟨hfixed,?_⟩
  have hi := le_imaginaryPart_matrixKInverseVariableMap ν hν α hα.le Z (-S⁻¹) hX
  rwa [← hfixed] at hi

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixKInverseVariableMap_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixKInverseVariableMap_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (Z X : M) (η R : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hX : η•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart X : M)) :
    specNorm (matrixKInverseVariableMap ν α Z X)≤α*(specNorm Z+R+R^2*η⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hET : ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν‖≤R := by
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν, ‖T.val‖≤R := by
      filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt
  have hER : ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖≤R^2*η⁻¹ := by
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ T : selfAdjoint M ∂ν, ‖T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val‖≤R^2*η⁻¹ := by
      filter_upwards [ν.support_mem_ae] with T hT
      have hTN : ‖T.val‖≤R := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound T hT
      have hRN : ‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖≤η⁻¹ := by
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
          specNorm_inverseVariable_resolvent_le_inv X T.val T.property η hη hX
      have hR0 : 0≤R := (norm_nonneg T.val).trans hTN
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖T.val‖*‖(X-T.val)⁻¹‖*‖T.val‖ :=
          (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ R*η⁻¹*R := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by ring
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := ν) hpt
  have htriangle : ‖Z-(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)-
      (∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν)‖≤‖Z‖+R+R^2*η⁻¹ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖Z-(∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν)‖+
          ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖Z‖+‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val ∂ν‖)+
          ‖∫ T : selfAdjoint M,T.val*(X-T.val)⁻¹*T.val ∂ν‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_sub_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  unfold matrixKInverseVariableMap
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hα] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htriangle hα

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inverse_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_inverse_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Z S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=Z) (η R : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hbound : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, specNorm T.val≤R)
    (hZ : η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)) :
    specNorm S⁻¹≤α*(specNorm Z+R+R^2*η⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfixed,hcoercive⟩ := matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα Z S hS hK
  have hn := specNorm_matrixKInverseVariableMap_le ν α hα.le Z (-S⁻¹) η R hη hbound
    (hZ.trans hcoercive)
  rwa [← hfixed,specNorm_neg] at hn

name: NLAlib.specNorm_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le_inv
statement:
theorem specNorm_of_matrixKTransform_solution_le_inv
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint M)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) (Z S : M) (hS : (imaginaryPart S : M).PosDef)
    (hK : matrixKTransform ν α S=Z) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η)
    (hZ : η•(1 : M)≤α•(imaginaryPart Z : M)) :
    specNorm S≤η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hcoercive := (matrixKTransform_solution_inverse_variable ν hν α hα Z S hS hK).2
  have hu := Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hS
  have he : (-S⁻¹)*S= -1 := by
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)]
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
    Matrix.norm_le_inv_of_mul_eq_neg_one_of_imaginaryPart_ge hη he (hZ.trans hcoercive)

name: NLAlib.sum_dot_mulVec_eq_trace_of_frame
statement:
private theorem sum_dot_mulVec_eq_trace_of_frame (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (R : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ∑ i, (v i ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec (v i)) = R.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hstep (i : I) : v i ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec (v i) =
      (R * Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm]
  calc
    ∑ i, (v i ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec (v i)) =
        ∑ i, (R * Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).trace := by
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hstep i)
    _ = (R * ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).trace := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
    _ = R.trace := by
      rw [hframe, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.sum_quadForm_eq_trace_of_frame
statement:
theorem sum_quadForm_eq_trace_of_frame (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ∑ i, quadForm A (v i) = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  simpa [quadForm_def, star_trivial] using
    sum_dot_mulVec_eq_trace_of_frame v hframe A

name: NLAlib.exists_ne_zero_of_frame
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := ‹Nonempty n›
  have hsum : (∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero ?_
    intro i hi
    simp [h i]
  have hjj : (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    simpa [hsum] using congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M j j) hframe
  norm_num at hjj

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.upperMatrix_posDef
statement:
theorem upperMatrix_posDef (MU : Matrix n n ℝ) (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : (upperMatrix MU δ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperMatrix
  exact (hMU.add_smul_one_posDef hδ).inv

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.lowerMatrix_posDef
statement:
theorem lowerMatrix_posDef (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : δ * ML⁻¹.trace < 1) :
    (lowerMatrix ML δ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerMatrix
  exact (hML.sub_smul_one_posDef_of_mul_trace_inv_lt_one hδ hcap).inv

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.upperGap_pos
statement:
theorem upperGap_pos [Nonempty n] (MU : Matrix n n ℝ) (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : 0 < upperGap MU δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperGap upperMatrix
  exact hMU.trace_inv_sub_trace_add_smul_one_inv_pos hδ

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.lowerGap_pos
statement:
theorem lowerGap_pos [Nonempty n] (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : δ * ML⁻¹.trace < 1) :
    0 < lowerGap ML δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerGap lowerMatrix
  exact hML.trace_sub_smul_one_inv_sub_trace_inv_pos hδ hcap

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.upperScore_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem upperScore_pos_of_ne_zero {RU : Matrix n n ℝ} (hRU : RU.PosDef)
    {DU : ℝ} (hDU : 0 < DU) {v : n → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < upperScore RU DU v
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperScore
  have hq2 : 0 ≤ quadForm (RU ^ 2) v :=
    (hRU.posSemidef.pow 2).quadForm_nonneg v
  have hq1 : 0 < quadForm RU v := hRU.quadForm_pos hv
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ quadForm (RU ^ 2) v / DU := div_nonneg hq2 hDU.le
  linarith

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.upperScore_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperScore_zero (RU : Matrix n n ℝ) (DU : ℝ) :
    upperScore RU DU 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [upperScore]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.lowerScore_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem lowerScore_zero (RL : Matrix n n ℝ) (DL : ℝ) :
    lowerScore RL DL 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lowerScore]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.sum_upperScore_eq
statement:
theorem sum_upperScore_eq (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (RU : Matrix n n ℝ) (DU : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, upperScore RU DU (v i) =
      (RU ^ 2).trace / DU + RU.trace
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperScore
  calc
    ∑ i, (quadForm (RU ^ 2) (v i) / DU + quadForm RU (v i))
        = (∑ i, quadForm (RU ^ 2) (v i)) / DU +
            ∑ i, quadForm RU (v i) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          congr 1
          simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = (RU ^ 2).trace / DU + RU.trace := by
          rw [sum_quadForm_eq_trace_of_frame v hframe (RU ^ 2),
            sum_quadForm_eq_trace_of_frame v hframe RU]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.sum_lowerScore_eq
statement:
theorem sum_lowerScore_eq (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (RL : Matrix n n ℝ) (DL : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, lowerScore RL DL (v i) =
      (RL ^ 2).trace / DL - RL.trace
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerScore
  calc
    ∑ i, (quadForm (RL ^ 2) (v i) / DL - quadForm RL (v i))
        = (∑ i, quadForm (RL ^ 2) (v i)) / DL -
            ∑ i, quadForm RL (v i) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          congr 1
          simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = (RL ^ 2).trace / DL - RL.trace := by
          rw [sum_quadForm_eq_trace_of_frame v hframe (RL ^ 2),
            sum_quadForm_eq_trace_of_frame v hframe RL]

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_candidate
statement:
theorem exists_candidate [Nonempty n] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (MU : Matrix n n ℝ) (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    (δU δL : ℝ) (hδU : 0 < δU) (hδL : 0 < δL)
    (hcap : δL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1)
    (hpot : 1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace) :
    ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) ∧
      upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) ≤
        lowerScore (lowerMatrix ML δL) (lowerGap ML δL) (v i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set RU : Matrix n n ℝ := upperMatrix MU δU with hRUdef
  set RL : Matrix n n ℝ := lowerMatrix ML δL with hRLdef
  set DU : ℝ := upperGap MU δU with hDUdef
  set DL : ℝ := lowerGap ML δL with hDLdef
  have hRU : RU.PosDef := by
    rw [hRUdef]
    exact (hMU.add_smul_one_posDef hδU).inv
  have hDU : 0 < DU := by
    rw [hDUdef]
    exact hMU.trace_inv_sub_trace_add_smul_one_inv_pos hδU
  have hUbar : (RU ^ 2).trace / DU + RU.trace ≤
      1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace := by
    rw [hRUdef, hDUdef]
    simpa [upperMatrix, upperGap] using hMU.reciprocal_barrier_upper_le hδU
  have hLbar : 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace ≤
      (RL ^ 2).trace / DL - RL.trace := by
    rw [hRLdef, hDLdef]
    simpa [lowerMatrix, lowerGap] using hML.reciprocal_barrier_lower_le hδL hcap
  have hsum_le :
      ∑ i, upperScore RU DU (v i) ≤ ∑ i, lowerScore RL DL (v i) := by
    calc
      ∑ i, upperScore RU DU (v i)
          = (RU ^ 2).trace / DU + RU.trace :=
            sum_upperScore_eq v hframe RU DU
      _ ≤ 1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace := hUbar
      _ ≤ 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace := hpot
      _ ≤ (RL ^ 2).trace / DL - RL.trace := hLbar
      _ = ∑ i, lowerScore RL DL (v i) :=
            (sum_lowerScore_eq v hframe RL DL).symm
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_frame v hframe
  by_contra hbad
  have hgt : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0 →
      lowerScore RL DL (v i) < upperScore RU DU (v i) := by
    intro i hv
    have hpos : 0 < upperScore RU DU (v i) :=
      upperScore_pos_of_ne_zero hRU hDU hv
    have hnot : ¬ (0 < upperScore RU DU (v i) ∧
        upperScore RU DU (v i) ≤ lowerScore RL DL (v i)) := by
      intro h
      exact hbad ⟨i, hv, h⟩
    have hnotle : ¬ upperScore RU DU (v i) ≤ lowerScore RL DL (v i) := by
      intro hle
      exact hnot ⟨hpos, hle⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge hnotle
  have hle : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I),
      lowerScore RL DL (v i) ≤ upperScore RU DU (v i) := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hv : v i = 0
    · simp [hv]
    · exact le_of_lt (hgt i hv)
  have hlt : ∃ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I),
      lowerScore RL DL (v i) < upperScore RU DU (v i) :=
    ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, hgt j hj⟩
  have hsum_lt : (∑ i, lowerScore RL DL (v i)) <
      ∑ i, upperScore RU DU (v i) :=
    Finset.sum_lt_sum hle hlt
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hsum_le) hsum_lt

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_candidate_inverse
statement:
theorem exists_candidate_inverse [Nonempty n] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (MU : Matrix n n ℝ) (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    (δU δL : ℝ) (hδU : 0 < δU) (hδL : 0 < δL)
    (hcap : δL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1)
    (hpot : 1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace) :
    ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧
      upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) ≤ 1 / t ∧
      1 / t ≤ lowerScore (lowerMatrix ML δL) (lowerGap ML δL) (v i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hvec, hpos, hle⟩ :=
    exists_candidate v hframe MU hMU ML hML δU δL hδU hδL hcap hpot
  let t : ℝ := (upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i))⁻¹
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    unfold t
    exact inv_pos.mpr hpos
  have ht_eq : 1 / t =
      upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) := by
    unfold t
    rw [one_div, inv_inv]
  refine ⟨i, hvec, t, ht_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ht_eq]
  · rw [ht_eq]
    exact hle

name: NLAlib.measurable_specNorm_of_entries
statement:
theorem measurable_specNorm_of_entries {γ m n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace γ]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    {f : γ → Matrix m n ℝ} (hf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => f z i j) :
    Measurable fun z => specNorm (f z)
proof:
:= by
  exact continuous_norm.measurable.comp (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hf)

name: NLAlib.measurable_specNorm_residual_of
statement:
theorem measurable_specNorm_residual_of {γ m n q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace γ]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {Q : γ → Matrix m q ℝ}
    (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => Q z i j) :
    Measurable fun z => specNorm (projResidual (Q z) A)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_specNorm_of_entries
  intro i j
  simp only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.measurable_mul_entry_of
statement:
theorem measurable_mul_entry_of {a b c : Type*} [Fintype b] {f : γ → Matrix a b ℝ}
    {g : γ → Matrix b c ℝ} (hf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => f z i j)
    (hg : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => g z i j) (i : a) (j : c) :
    Measurable fun z => (f z * g z) i j
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp
    ((Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hf).matrix_mul (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hg))

name: NLAlib.measurable_inv_entry_of
proof:
:= by
  have hA' : Measurable A := Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hA
  have hdet : Measurable fun x => (A x).det := continuous_id.matrix_det.measurable.comp hA'
  have hadj : Measurable fun x => (A x).adjugate i j :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate.matrix_elem i j).measurable.comp hA'
  simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact hdet.inv.mul hadj

name: NLAlib.measurable_pow_entry_of
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing i j with
  | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [pow_succ]
    exact measurable_mul_entry_of (fun a b => ih a b) hA i j

name: NLAlib.measurable_trace_of_entries
statement:
theorem measurable_trace_of_entries {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {A : γ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => A x i j) : Measurable fun x => Matrix.trace (A x)
proof:
:=
  Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => hA i i

name: NLAlib.measurable_pinvL_entry_of
statement:
theorem measurable_pinvL_entry_of {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq b]
    {f : γ → Matrix a b ℝ} (hf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => f z i j) (i : b) (j : a) :
    Measurable fun z => pinvL (f z) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hF : Measurable f := Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hf
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix a b ℝ => Gᵀ * G :=
    continuous_id.matrix_transpose.matrix_mul continuous_id
  have hdet : Measurable fun z => ((f z)ᵀ * f z).det := hc.matrix_det.measurable.comp hF
  have hadj : ∀ a' b', Measurable fun z => ((f z)ᵀ * f z).adjugate a' b' := fun a' b' =>
    (hc.matrix_adjugate.matrix_elem a' b').measurable.comp hF
  simp only [pinvL, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun l _ => ?_
  have h1 := hadj i l
  have h2 := hf j l
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq_residual_of
statement:
theorem measurable_frobSq_residual_of {m n q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {Qf : γ → Matrix m q ℝ} (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => Qf z i j) :
    Measurable fun z => frobSq (projResidual (Qf z) A)
proof:
:= by
  have hQt : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => (Qf z)ᵀ i j := fun i j => hQ j i
  have hA : ∀ i j, Measurable fun _ : γ => A i j := fun _ _ => measurable_const
  have hD := measurable_mul_entry_of hQ (measurable_mul_entry_of hQt hA)
  have hR : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => projResidual (Qf z) A i j := fun i j => by
    simp only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.sub_apply]
    exact measurable_const.sub (hD i j)
  unfold frobSq; simp only [frobInner_eq_sum_mul]
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ =>
    (hR i j).mul (hR i j)

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq_of_entries
statement:
theorem measurable_frobSq_of_entries {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {f : γ → Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => f z i j) :
    Measurable fun z => frobSq (f z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq; simp only [frobInner_eq_sum_mul]
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ =>
    (hf i j).mul (hf i j)

name: NLAlib.measurable_pinvR_entry
statement:
theorem measurable_pinvR_entry {k t : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype t] [DecidableEq k] (i : t)
    (j : k) : Measurable fun G : Matrix k t ℝ => pinvR G i j
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix k t ℝ => G * Gᵀ :=
    continuous_id.matrix_mul continuous_id.matrix_transpose
  have hdet : Measurable fun G : Matrix k t ℝ => (G * Gᵀ).det :=
    hc.matrix_det.measurable
  have hadj : ∀ a b, Measurable fun G : Matrix k t ℝ => (G * Gᵀ).adjugate a b := fun a b =>
    (hc.matrix_adjugate.matrix_elem a b).measurable
  simp only [pinvR, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun l _ => ?_
  exact (Matrix.measurable_entry l i).mul (hdet.inv.mul (hadj l j))

name: NLAlib.measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply
statement:
theorem measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply {r k : Type*} [Fintype r] [Fintype k]
    [DecidableEq r] (i j : r) :
    Measurable (fun G : Matrix r k ℝ => (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i j)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun G : Matrix r k ℝ => G * Gᵀ) :=
    Continuous.matrix_mul continuous_id (Continuous.matrix_transpose continuous_id)
  simp_rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact (hc.matrix_det.measurable.inv).mul (hc.matrix_adjugate.matrix_elem i j).measurable

name: NLAlib.measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose {r k : Type*} [Fintype r] [Fintype k]
    [DecidableEq r] :
    Measurable (fun G : Matrix r k ℝ => specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Measurable (fun G : Matrix r k ℝ => (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹) :=
    Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply
  exact continuous_norm.measurable.comp h1

name: NLAlib.measurable_specNorm_pinvR
statement:
theorem measurable_specNorm_pinvR {r k : Type*} [Fintype r] [Fintype k] [DecidableEq r]
    [DecidableEq k] :
    Measurable (fun G : Matrix r k ℝ => specNorm (pinvR G))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Measurable (fun G : Matrix r k ℝ => pinvR G) :=
    Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun j i => measurable_pinvR_entry j i
  exact continuous_norm.measurable.comp h1

name: NLAlib.measurable_cfc_of_spectrum_subset
statement:
theorem measurable_cfc_of_spectrum_subset {M : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hM : Measurable M) (hH : ∀ ω, (M ω).IsHermitian)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : IsCompact s) (hS : ∀ ω, spectrum ℝ (M ω) ⊆ s)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f s) :
    Measurable (fun ω => cfc f (M ω))

name: NLAlib.measurable_cfc_of_specNorm_le
statement:
theorem measurable_cfc_of_specNorm_le {M : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hM : Measurable M) (hH : ∀ ω, (M ω).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ ω, specNorm (M ω) ≤ R)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (-R) R)) :
    Measurable (fun ω => cfc f (M ω))
proof:
:= by
  let _ := normedAlgebraRealMatrix (𝕜 := 𝕜) (d := n)
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have he : (fun ω => cfc f (M ω)) = fun _ => (0 : Matrix n n 𝕜) :=
      funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [he]
    exact measurable_const
  apply measurable_cfc_of_spectrum_subset hM hH isCompact_Icc (fun ω x hx => ?_) f hf
  have h := (spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hx).trans (by simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using hR ω)
  exact abs_le.mp (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h)

name: NLAlib.measurable_matrix_inv
statement:
theorem measurable_matrix_inv [DecidableEq n] :
    Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n 𝕜 => A⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun i j => ?_
  have hdet : Measurable fun A : Matrix n n 𝕜 => A.det :=
    continuous_id.matrix_det.measurable
  have hadj : Measurable fun A : Matrix n n 𝕜 => A.adjugate i j :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate.matrix_elem i j).measurable
  simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact hdet.inv.mul hadj

name: NLAlib.measurable_pinvR
statement: theorem measurable_pinvR [DecidableEq m] : Measurable (pinvR : Matrix m n 𝕜 → Matrix n m 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinvR
  exact Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.matrix_mul
    (measurable_matrix_inv.comp (measurable_id.matrix_mul Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose))

name: NLAlib.measurable_pinvL
statement: theorem measurable_pinvL [DecidableEq n] : Measurable (pinvL : Matrix m n 𝕜 → Matrix n m 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinvL
  exact (measurable_matrix_inv.comp
    (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.matrix_mul measurable_id)).matrix_mul
      Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq
statement: theorem measurable_frobSq : Measurable (frobSq : Matrix m n 𝕜 → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change Measurable (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => frobSq A)
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ =>
    ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).norm).pow_const 2

name: NLAlib.rank_eq_card_iff_isUnit_rowGram
statement:
private theorem rank_eq_card_iff_isUnit_rowGram [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    A.rank = Fintype.card m ↔ IsUnit (A * Aᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card A, fun h => ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm A.rank_le_card_height
  calc
    Fintype.card m = (A * Aᴴ).rank := (Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ h).symm
    _ ≤ A.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_setOf_full_row_rank
statement:
theorem measurableSet_setOf_full_row_rank [DecidableEq m] :
    MeasurableSet {A : Matrix m n 𝕜 | A.rank = Fintype.card m}
proof:
:= by
  have he : {A : Matrix m n 𝕜 | A.rank = Fintype.card m} =
      {A : Matrix m n 𝕜 | (A * Aᴴ).det ≠ 0} := by
    ext A
    change (A.rank = Fintype.card m) ↔ (A * Aᴴ).det ≠ 0
    rw [rank_eq_card_iff_isUnit_rowGram, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  rw [he]
  exact (measurableSet_eq_fun
    (continuous_id.matrix_mul continuous_id.matrix_conjTranspose).matrix_det.measurable
    measurable_const).compl

name: NLAlib.measurable_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem measurable_moorePenroseInverse [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] :
    Measurable (moorePenroseInverse : Matrix m n 𝕜 → Matrix n m 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  let β := fun j : ℕ => 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)
  have hβ : Filter.Tendsto β Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun j => ?_⟩
    change 0 < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)
    positivity
  have hm (j : ℕ) : Measurable (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => tikhonovInverse A (β j)) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => tikhonovNormal A (β j)) := by
      unfold tikhonovNormal
      fun_prop
    change Measurable (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => (tikhonovNormal A (β j))⁻¹ * Aᴴ)
    exact (measurable_matrix_inv.comp hc.measurable).matrix_mul Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose
  refine Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun i j => ?_
  exact measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable
    (fun l => (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp (hm l))
    (tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr fun A => (continuous_apply_apply i j).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      ((tendsto_tikhonovInverse_zero A).comp hβ))

name: NLAlib.measurable_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem measurable_rangeProjector [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] :
    Measurable (rangeProjector : Matrix m n 𝕜 → Matrix m m 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  change Measurable (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => A * moorePenroseInverse A)
  exact measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_moorePenroseInverse

name: NLAlib.sum_det_updateRow_eq_trace_adjugate_mul
statement:
theorem sum_det_updateRow_eq_trace_adjugate_mul (A H : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∑ i : n, (A.updateRow i (H i)).det) = (A.adjugate * H).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Matrix.cramer_transpose_apply, Matrix.cramer_eq_adjugate_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.adjugate_transpose]
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag,
    Matrix.mul_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_det
proof:
:= by
  have h := (detRowsContinuous.hasFDerivAt (A t)).comp_hasDerivAt t hA
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => (A s).det) (detRowsContinuous.linearDeriv (A t) H) t at h
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.linearDeriv_apply] at h
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => (A s).det) (∑ i : n, ((A t).updateRow i (H i)).det) t at h
  rwa [sum_det_updateRow_eq_trace_adjugate_mul] at h

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_log_det
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_det hA).log hDet.ne'
  have hTrace : ((A t)⁻¹ * H).trace = ((A t).adjugate * H).trace / (A t).det := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
  rwa [← hTrace] at h

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (s • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).det)
      (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).adjugate.trace t
proof:
:= by
  have hA : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A) 1 t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).sub_const A
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_one] using hasDerivAt_det hA

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub_sum_principal_minors
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub_sum_principal_minors {k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (s • (1 : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℝ) - A).det)
      (∑ i : Fin (k + 1),
        ((t • (1 : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℝ) - A).submatrix
          i.succAbove i.succAbove).det) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub A t
  have hTrace : (t • (1 : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℝ) - A).adjugate.trace =
      ∑ i : Fin (k + 1),
        ((t • (1 : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℝ) - A).submatrix
          i.succAbove i.succAbove).det := by
    simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul]
  rwa [hTrace] at h

name: NLAlib.adjugate_apply_self_eq_det_complement
statement:
theorem adjugate_apply_self_eq_det_complement (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) :
    A.adjugate i i = (A.submatrix
      (Subtype.val : {j : n // j ≠ i} → n) (Subtype.val : {j : n // j ≠ i} → n)).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := {j : n // j ≠ i}
  let e : I ⊕ Unit ≃ n :=
    { toFun := Sum.elim Subtype.val (fun _ => i)
      invFun := fun j => if h : j = i then Sum.inr () else Sum.inl ⟨j, h⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro j
        cases j with
        | inl j => simp [j.property]
        | inr j => cases j; simp
      right_inv := by intro j; dsimp; split_ifs with h <;> simp_all }
  let B := A.updateRow i (Pi.single i 1)
  have hBlock : B.reindex e.symm e.symm = Matrix.fromBlocks
      (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : I → n) (Subtype.val : I → n))
      (fun j (_ : Unit) => A j.val i)
      (0 : Matrix Unit I ℝ) (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) := by
    ext j k
    cases j with
    | inl j =>
      cases k with
      | inl k => simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, e, B, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.updateRow_apply,
          j.property]
      | inr k => simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, e, B, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.updateRow_apply,
          j.property]
    | inr j =>
      cases k with
      | inl k => simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, e, B, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.updateRow_apply,
          k.property]
      | inr k => simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, e, B, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.updateRow_apply,
          ]
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  change B.det = _
  rw [← Matrix.det_reindex_self e.symm B, hBlock,
    Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub_sum_complement_minors
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub_sum_complement_minors (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (s • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).det)
      (∑ i : n, ((t • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) - A).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : {j : n // j ≠ i} → n)
        (Subtype.val : {j : n // j ≠ i} → n)).det) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasDerivAt_det_smul_one_sub A t
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, adjugate_apply_self_eq_det_complement] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_complex
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) p =
      (∑ l, schattenNormReal (A l) p ^ p) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose U V h using fun l => exists_isSVD (A l)
  let D : ι → Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ := fun l =>
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (singularValues (A l) i : ℂ))
  have hD (l : ι) : (rectDiag (singularValues (A l)) :
      Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) = D l := by
    ext i j
    simp only [D, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.blockDiagonal U) := by
    change (Matrix.blockDiagonal U)ᴴ * Matrix.blockDiagonal U = 1
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
    simp only [(h _).conjTranspose_mul_left]
    exact Matrix.blockDiagonal_one
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.blockDiagonal V) := by
    change (Matrix.blockDiagonal V)ᴴ * Matrix.blockDiagonal V = 1
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
    simp only [(h _).conjTranspose_mul_right]
    exact Matrix.blockDiagonal_one
  have hA : Matrix.blockDiagonal A = Matrix.blockDiagonal U *
      Matrix.blockDiagonal D * (Matrix.blockDiagonal V)ᴴ := by
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul,
      ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
    congr 1
    funext l
    simpa only [← hD l] using (h l).eq
  have hnorm : schattenNormReal (Matrix.blockDiagonal U * Matrix.blockDiagonal D *
      (Matrix.blockDiagonal V)ᴴ) p = schattenNormReal (Matrix.blockDiagonal D) p := by
    simp only [schattenNormReal, singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose hV,
      singularValues_isometry_mul hU, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hpower (l : ι) : schattenNormReal (A l) p ^ p =
      ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues (A l) i ^ p := by
    rw [schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum (A l) hp, min_self,
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues (A l) i ^ p)]
  rw [hA, hnorm]
  change schattenNormReal (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun l =>
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (singularValues (A l) i : ℂ))) p = _
  rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_diagonal, schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
  congr 1
  simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ _), Fintype.sum_prod_type, hpower]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_real
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_real
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) p =
      (∑ l, schattenNormReal (A l) p ^ p) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := schattenNormReal_blockDiagonal_complex (fun l => (A l).map Complex.ofReal) hp
  rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_map _ Complex.ofReal (by simp)] at hh
  have hs (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
      singularValues (B.map Complex.ofReal) i = singularValues B i :=
    singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) B i
  have hsD (i : ℕ) : singularValues ((Matrix.blockDiagonal A).map Complex.ofReal) i =
      singularValues (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) i :=
    singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) i
  simpa only [schattenNormReal, hs, hsD] using hh

name: NLAlib.measurable_rowMixedNorm
statement:
theorem measurable_rowMixedNorm {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Measurable (fun A : Matrix m n ℝ => rowMixedNorm A p)
proof:
:= by
  have hrow (i : m) : Measurable (fun A : Matrix m n ℝ => Real.sqrt (rowSq A i)) := by
    unfold rowSq
    fun_prop
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    simp_rw [rowMixedNorm_top]
    exact Measurable.iSup hrow
  · have hpr : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos
      (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpt
    simp_rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum _ hpr]
    fun_prop

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    |A.trace| ≤ Fintype.card n * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  calc |A.trace| ≤ ∑ i, |A i i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : n, specNorm A := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => abs_apply_le_specNorm A i i
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le_of_hasOrthonormalCols
    {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    specNorm (Qᴴ * A * Q) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hQnorm := specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hQstar : specNorm Qᴴ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [specNorm_conjTranspose] using hQnorm
  calc specNorm (Qᴴ * A * Q) ≤ specNorm (Qᴴ * A) * specNorm Q := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (1 * specNorm A) * 1 := by
      apply mul_le_mul
      · exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQstar (specNorm_nonneg A))
      · exact hQnorm
      · exact specNorm_nonneg _
      · exact mul_nonneg zero_le_one (specNorm_nonneg A)
    _ = specNorm A := by ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_one_sub_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_one_sub_le
    {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    specNorm ((1 - Q * Qᴴ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᴴ)) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hleft (B : Matrix n n ℝ) : specNorm ((1 - Q * Qᴴ) * B) ≤ specNorm B := by
    simpa only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using
      specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self B
  have hright : specNorm (A * (1 - Q * Qᴴ)) ≤ specNorm A := by
    calc
      specNorm (A * (1 - Q * Qᴴ)) = specNorm ((1 - Q * Qᴴ) * Aᴴ) := by
        rw [← specNorm_conjTranspose (A * (1 - Q * Qᴴ)), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
      _ ≤ specNorm Aᴴ := hleft _
      _ = specNorm A := specNorm_conjTranspose _
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using (hleft (A * (1 - Q * Qᴴ))).trans hright

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le
statement:
theorem abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (w : n → ℝ) :
    |(Qᵀ * A * Q).trace + quadForm ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) w| ≤
      specNorm A * (Fintype.card n + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcompression : |(Qᵀ * A * Q).trace| ≤ Fintype.card n * specNorm A := by
    calc |(Qᵀ * A * Q).trace| ≤ Fintype.card r * specNorm (Qᵀ * A * Q) :=
        abs_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm _
      _ ≤ Fintype.card n * specNorm A := by
        apply mul_le_mul
        · exact_mod_cast card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ
        · exact specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ A
        · exact specNorm_nonneg _
        · positivity
  have hresidual : |quadForm ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) w| ≤
      specNorm A * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc |quadForm ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) w| ≤
        specNorm ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) * (w ⬝ᵥ w) :=
          abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm _ _
      _ ≤ specNorm A * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (specNorm_one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_one_sub_le hQ A)
          (dotProduct_self_nonneg w)
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans ((add_le_add hcompression hresidual).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose
    {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    {U : Matrix m (Fin (Fintype.card m)) 𝕜}
    {V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) 𝕜}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (A : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) 𝕜) (p : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (U * A * Vᴴ) p = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schattenNormReal, singularValues_mul_isometry_conjTranspose hV,
    singularValues_isometry_mul hU, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_apply_castLE
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectangularDiagonal_apply_castLE {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (min m n)) :
    rectangularDiagonal x (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) i) (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) j) =
      if i = j then x i else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.val < m ∧ i.val < n := lt_min_iff.mp i.isLt
  simp [rectangularDiagonal, rectDiag_apply, Fin.val_inj, hi.1, hi.2]

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_injective
statement:
theorem rectangularDiagonal_injective {m n : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (rectangularDiagonal (m := m) (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  funext i
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ =>
    M (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) i) (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) i)) hxy
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonalLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectangularDiagonalLinear_apply {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) :
    rectangularDiagonalLinear m n x = rectangularDiagonal x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_diagonal_of_abs_eq_one
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_diagonal_of_abs_eq_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ε : ι → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) : HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.diagonal ε)
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.diagonal ε)ᵀ * Matrix.diagonal ε = 1
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    have h := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (hε i)
    have hsq : ε i ^ 2 = 1 := by simpa only [sq_abs, one_pow] using h
    simpa only [pow_two] using hsq
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_sign
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_sign {m n : ℕ}
    (x ε : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) :
    ∃ U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols U ∧
      U * rectangularDiagonal x = rectangularDiagonal (fun i => ε i * x i)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Fin m → ℝ := fun i => if hi : i.val < min m n then ε ⟨i.val, hi⟩ else 1
  refine ⟨Matrix.diagonal s, hasOrthonormalCols_diagonal_of_abs_eq_one s (fun i => ?_), ?_⟩
  · dsimp [s]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact hε _
    · norm_num
  · ext i j
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    simp only [rectangularDiagonal, rectDiag_apply, s]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_permMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_permMatrix {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) : HasOrthonormalCols (σ.permMatrix ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change (σ.permMatrix ℝ)ᵀ * σ.permMatrix ℝ = 1
  rw [Matrix.transpose_permMatrix, ← Matrix.permMatrix_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Matrix.permMatrix_one]

name: NLAlib.prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt {k m : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : i.val < k) :
    prefixPermutation σ hk i = Fin.castLE hk (σ ⟨i.val, hi⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (Fin.castLEEmb hk) (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Fin k) = i := Fin.ext rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [prefixPermutation, ← he, Equiv.Perm.viaFintypeEmbedding_apply_image]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.prefixPermutation_apply_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem prefixPermutation_apply_of_not_lt {k m : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : ¬ i.val < k) : prefixPermutation σ hk i = i
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.Perm.viaFintypeEmbedding_apply_notMem_range
  rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
  exact hi (by rw [← hj]; exact j.isLt)

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_le_nuclearNorm_sq_div
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_le_nuclearNorm_sq_div (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    bestRankFrobSq A k ≤ nuclearNorm A ^ 2 / k
proof:
:= by
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have htotal : nuclearNorm A = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), singularValues A j := by
    rw [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range, min_self]
  have hpos := singularValues_nonneg A
  by_cases hkN : k ≤ Fintype.card n
  · have hhead : (k : ℝ) * singularValues A k ≤ nuclearNorm A := by
      rw [htotal]
      calc
        _ = ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A k := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A j := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj =>
          singularValues_antitone A (Finset.mem_range.mp hj).le
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hkN)
          (fun j _ _ => hpos j)
    have htail : bestRankFrobSq A k ≤ singularValues A k * nuclearNorm A := by
      rw [bestRankFrobSq, htotal, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      split_ifs with hkj
      · have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (singularValues_antitone A hkj) (hpos j)
        nlinarith
      · exact mul_nonneg (hpos k) (hpos j)
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hkR).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhead (nuclearNorm_nonneg A),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hkR.le]
  · have hz : bestRankFrobSq A k = 0 := by
      unfold bestRankFrobSq
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j hj
      have hjN := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    rw [hz]
    positivity

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_le_trace_sq_div
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_le_trace_sq_div {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) : bestRankFrobSq A k ≤ A.trace ^ 2 / k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef hA] using
    bestRankFrobSq_le_nuclearNorm_sq_div A hk

name: NLAlib.specNorm_eq_norm

theorem specNorm_eq_norm [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm A = ‖A‖
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.specNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem specNorm_nonneg [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : 0 ≤ specNorm A

:=
  norm_nonneg A

name: NLAlib.norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct
statement: theorem norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) : ‖v‖ = Real.sqrt (v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ v.ofLp)
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  simp [dotProduct, sq]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm
statement:
theorem sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm (v : m → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (v ⬝ᵥ v) = ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖
proof:
:=
  (norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct _).symm

name: NLAlib.norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq
statement:
theorem norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    ‖u‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ j, u j ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos
statement:
theorem sqrt_dotProduct_self_pos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < Real.sqrt (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg v)
    (Ne.symm (fun h => hv (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h))))

name: NLAlib.sqrt_dotProduct_add_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_dotProduct_add_le (u v : m → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt ((u + v) ⬝ᵥ (u + v)) ≤ Real.sqrt (u ⬝ᵥ u) + Real.sqrt (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm,
    WithLp.toLp_add]
  exact norm_add_le _ _

name: NLAlib.sqrt_dotProduct_sub_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_dotProduct_sub_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt ((u - v) ⬝ᵥ (u - v)) ≤ Real.sqrt (u ⬝ᵥ u) + Real.sqrt (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sqrt_dotProduct_add_le u (-v)
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_dotProduct, dotProduct_neg, neg_neg] using h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_conjTranspose
statement: theorem specNorm_conjTranspose [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm Aᴴ = specNorm A
proof:
:=
  Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose A

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ∑ i, ‖(A *ᵥ x) i‖ ^ 2 ≤ specNorm A ^ 2 * ∑ j, ‖x j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := A.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
  have h2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
  rw [mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq] at h2
  simpa [specNorm] using h2

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, (A *ᵥ x) i ^ 2 ≤ specNorm A ^ 2 * ∑ j, x j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq A x

name: NLAlib.specNorm_map_star_le
statement: theorem specNorm_map_star_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (A.map star) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg A) fun x => ?_
  have h := A.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 (star x.ofLp))
  have hx : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (star x.ofLp) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  have hv : A.map star *ᵥ x.ofLp = star (A *ᵥ star x.ofLp) := by
    ext i
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, star_sum]
  have hy : ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) (A.map star) x‖ =
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv m 𝕜).symm (A *ᵥ star x.ofLp)‖ := by
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    change ‖(A.map star *ᵥ x.ofLp) i‖ ^ 2 = ‖(A *ᵥ star x.ofLp) i‖ ^ 2
    rw [hv, Pi.star_apply, norm_star]
  rw [hy, ← hx]
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_map_star
statement: theorem specNorm_map_star (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (A.map star) = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (specNorm_map_star_le A) ?_
  have h := specNorm_map_star_le (A.map star)
  have hA : (A.map star).map star = A := by ext i j; simp
  rwa [hA] at h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_transpose
statement: theorem specNorm_transpose [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm Aᵀ = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h : Aᵀ = Aᴴ.map star := by ext i j; simp
  rw [h, specNorm_map_star, specNorm_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_zero
statement: theorem specNorm_zero : specNorm (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) = 0
proof:
:=
  norm_zero

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_le [DecidableEq p] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    specNorm (A * B) ≤ specNorm A * specNorm B
proof:
:=
  Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul A B

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq
statement:
theorem frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A * B) ≤ specNorm A ^ 2 * frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_comm,
    Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => ‖B i j‖ ^ 2), Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  have := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq A (fun k => B k j)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using this

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq [DecidableEq p] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A * B) ≤ frobSq A * specNorm B ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul, ← frobSq_transpose A, ← specNorm_transpose B,
    mul_comm]
  exact frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq Bᵀ Aᵀ

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobNorm (A * B) ≤ specNorm A * frobNorm B
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero
    (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg A) (frobNorm_nonneg B)) ?_
  rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq]
  exact frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq A B

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm [DecidableEq p] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobNorm (A * B) ≤ frobNorm A * specNorm B
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero
    (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg A) (specNorm_nonneg B)) ?_
  rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq]
  exact frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq A B

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one_le
statement: theorem specNorm_one_le : specNorm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, ← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).2 fun i => by simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal {P : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hP : Pᴴ * P = 1) :
    specNorm P ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  have h : ‖P‖ * ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self P
    rw [hP] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    exact specNorm_one_le
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg P]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_eq_mul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP1 : specNorm P ≤ 1 := specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hP
  have hPt : specNorm Pᴴ ≤ 1 := by rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]; exact hP1
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc specNorm (Pᴴ * X) ≤ specNorm Pᴴ * specNorm X := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * specNorm X := by gcongr; exact specNorm_nonneg _
      _ = specNorm X := one_mul _
  · calc specNorm X = specNorm (P * (Pᴴ * X)) := by rw [← hX]
      _ ≤ specNorm P * specNorm (Pᴴ * X) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * specNorm (Pᴴ * X) := by gcongr; exact specNorm_nonneg _
      _ = specNorm (Pᴴ * X) := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_frobNorm
statement: theorem specNorm_le_frobNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm A ≤ frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (frobNorm_nonneg A) fun x => ?_
  have h := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq A x.ofLp
  have hx : ∑ j, ‖x.ofLp j‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq x).symm
  have hy : ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) A x‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ‖(A *ᵥ x.ofLp) i‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]; rfl
  rw [hx, ← frobNorm_sq, ← mul_pow, ← hy] at h
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg A) (norm_nonneg x)) h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_le_frobSq
statement: theorem specNorm_sq_le_frobSq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm A ^ 2 ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobNorm_sq]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg A) (specNorm_le_frobNorm A) 2

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_mul_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A * B) ≤ frobSq A * frobSq B
proof:
:=
  (frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq A B).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_sq_le_frobSq A) (frobSq_nonneg B))

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    frobNorm (A * B) ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B
proof:
:=
  (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm A B).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_le_frobNorm A) (frobNorm_nonneg B))

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (M : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    |x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)| ≤ specNorm M * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  have h := M.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
  have hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]; simp [dotProduct, sq]
  have hcs :=
    abs_real_inner_le_norm (WithLp.toLp 2 x) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv n ℝ).symm (M *ᵥ x))
  have hi : inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 x) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv n ℝ).symm (M *ᵥ x)) =
      x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) := by
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]
  rw [hi] at hcs
  calc |x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)| ≤ _ := hcs
    _ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ * (‖M‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖) := by gcongr
    _ = ‖M‖ * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by rw [← hx]; ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_add_le
statement: theorem specNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (A + B) ≤ specNorm A + specNorm B
proof:
:=
  norm_add_le A B

name: NLAlib.specNorm_neg
statement: theorem specNorm_neg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (-A) = specNorm A
proof: := norm_neg A

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_comm
statement: theorem specNorm_sub_comm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (A - B) = specNorm (B - A)
proof:
:=
  norm_sub_rev A B

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_le
statement: theorem specNorm_sub_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (A - B) ≤ specNorm A + specNorm B
proof:
:=
  norm_sub_le A B

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (A * Aᴴ) = specNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self Aᴴ
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at h
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, h, sq, ← specNorm_eq_norm, specNorm_conjTranspose]

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem {P : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) : specNorm P ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self P
  rw [hs.eq, show P * P = P from hp] at h
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  have h0 := norm_nonneg P
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le [DecidableEq p] {Q : Matrix m p 𝕜}
    (hQ : Qᴴ * Q = 1) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : specNorm (A - Q * (Qᴴ * A)) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Matrix m m 𝕜 := 1 - Q * Qᴴ with hP
  have hs : P.IsHermitian := by
    simp [hP, Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  have hp : IsIdempotentElem P := by
    change P * P = P
    have hQQ : Q * Qᴴ * (Q * Qᴴ) = Q * Qᴴ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ, hQ, Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [hP, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.one_mul, hQQ]
    abel
  have hPA : A - Q * (Qᴴ * A) = P * A := by
    rw [hP, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hPA]
  calc specNorm (P * A) ≤ specNorm P * specNorm A := specNorm_mul_le P A
    _ ≤ 1 * specNorm A :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hs.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem hp)
        (specNorm_nonneg A)
    _ = specNorm A := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem specNorm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero {X Y : Matrix m n 𝕜} (h : X * Yᴴ = 0) :
    specNorm (X + Y) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm X ^ 2 + specNorm Y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' : Y * Xᴴ = 0 := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose (Y * Xᴴ), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, h, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero]
  have hG : (X + Y) * (X + Y)ᴴ = X * Xᴴ + Y * Yᴴ := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_add, h, h']
    abel
  rw [← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self, ← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self,
    ← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self, hG]
  exact specNorm_add_le _ _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_add_sq_le_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem specNorm_add_sq_le_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero {X Y : Matrix m n 𝕜} (h : Xᴴ * Y = 0) :
    specNorm (X + Y) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm X ^ 2 + specNorm Y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' : Xᴴ * Yᴴᴴ = 0 := by rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]; exact h
  have := specNorm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero h'
  rwa [← Matrix.conjTranspose_add, specNorm_conjTranspose, specNorm_conjTranspose,
    specNorm_conjTranspose] at this

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 = RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜), EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self (x : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self (x : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = √(x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.abs_re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (H : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    |RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (H *ᵥ x))| ≤ specNorm H *
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  have hin : inner 𝕜 (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (H *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) = star x ⬝ᵥ (H *ᵥ x) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
  have hh := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) (WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (H *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
  rw [hin] at hh
  calc _ ≤ ‖star x ⬝ᵥ (H *ᵥ x)‖ := RCLike.abs_re_le_norm _
    _ ≤ _ := hh
    _ ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ *
        (‖H‖ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖) := by
      gcongr
      exact H.l2_opNorm_mulVec (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_specNorm_gram_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem norm_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_specNorm_gram_sub_one_le (T : Matrix m n 𝕜) {ε : ℝ}
    (h : specNorm (Tᴴ * T - 1) ≤ ε) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    (1 - ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 + ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq : RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ ((Tᴴ * T - 1) *ᵥ x)) =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ^ 2 -
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.one_mulVec, map_sub,
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose, star_star]
  have hh := (abs_re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (Tᴴ * T - 1) x).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg _))
  rw [hq, abs_le] at hh
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_ofReal_eq
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_ofReal_eq (x : n → ℝ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (x j)) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  simp only [RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, RCLike.norm_ofReal, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm A ≤ specNorm (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
  intro x
  have h := (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)).l2_opNorm_mulVec
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (x.ofLp j)) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)
  have hv : A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) *ᵥ (fun j => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (x.ofLp j)) =
      fun i => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 ((A *ᵥ x.ofLp) i) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, map_sum, map_mul]
  rw [hv] at h
  change ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 ((A *ᵥ x.ofLp) i)) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)‖ ≤
    ‖A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)‖ *
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (x.ofLp j)) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)‖ at h
  rw [norm_toLp_ofReal_eq, norm_toLp_ofReal_eq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg
statement:
theorem matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι)
    {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) : 0 ≤ matrixVarianceProxy D s α β
proof:
:=
  add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg D s))
    (mul_nonneg hβ (specNorm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.matrixVarianceProxy_mono
proof:
:=
  add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bilinearSquareMass_mono D hst) hα)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_sum_gram_mono D hst) hβ)

name: NLAlib.continuous_matrixVarianceProxy
statement:
theorem continuous_matrixVarianceProxy (s : Finset ι) (α β : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => matrixVarianceProxy D s α β)
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : Continuous (fun D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ =>
      specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i)) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_bilinearSquareMass s)).add
    (continuous_const.mul hgram)

name: NLAlib.measurable_matrixVarianceProxy
statement:
theorem measurable_matrixVarianceProxy [Fintype ι] (s : Finset ι) (α β : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => matrixVarianceProxy D s α β)
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  exact (continuous_matrixVarianceProxy s α β).measurable

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_sub_matrixVarianceProxy_erase_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sub_matrixVarianceProxy_erase_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {R α β : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hD : ∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ 2 * R) :
    ∑ i, (matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β -
      matrixVarianceProxy D (Finset.univ.erase i) α β) ^ 2 ≤
        8 * R ^ 2 * (α + β) * matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hV, hVgap⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_erase_gap_le D
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hU, hUgap⟩ := exists_specNorm_sum_gram_erase_gap_le D
  let x : ι → ℝ := fun i => ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2
  let y : ι → ℝ := fun i => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2
  have hx0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ x i := sq_nonneg _
  have hy0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ y i := sq_nonneg _
  have hxb (i : ι) : x i ≤ 4 * R ^ 2 := by
    have hinner := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) v (WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
    have heq : inner ℂ v (WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)) =
        star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp) := by
      rw [← WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 v, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
    rw [heq] at hinner
    have hmv := (D i).l2_opNorm_mulVec w
    have hprobe : ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
      calc _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ := hinner
        _ ≤ ‖v‖ * (specNorm (D i) * ‖w‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmv (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 * (specNorm (D i) * ‖w‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ specNorm (D i) := by
          simpa only [one_mul, mul_one] using
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (specNorm_nonneg (D i))
        _ ≤ _ := hD i
    have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hR)).mpr hprobe
    simpa only [x, mul_pow, show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 4 by norm_num] using hsq
  have hyb (i : ι) : y i ≤ 4 * R ^ 2 := by
    have hmv := (D i).l2_opNorm_mulVec u
    have hprobe : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
      apply hmv.trans
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (specNorm_nonneg _)).trans
        (by simpa only [mul_one] using hD i)
    have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hR)).mpr hprobe
    simpa only [y, mul_pow, show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 4 by norm_num] using hsq
  have hpoint (i : ι) :
      (matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β -
        matrixVarianceProxy D (Finset.univ.erase i) α β) ^ 2 ≤
      8 * R ^ 2 * (α ^ 2 * x i + β ^ 2 * y i) := by
    have hδ0 := sub_nonneg.mpr
      (matrixVarianceProxy_mono D (Finset.erase_subset i Finset.univ) hα hβ)
    have hδ : matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β -
        matrixVarianceProxy D (Finset.univ.erase i) α β ≤ α * x i + β * y i := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hVgap i) hα
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hUgap i) hβ
      dsimp [matrixVarianceProxy, x, y] at *
      linarith
    have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ hδ0 (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα (hx0 i))
      (mul_nonneg hβ (hy0 i)))).mpr hδ
    have hsum : (α * x i + β * y i) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * α ^ 2 * (x i) ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 * (y i) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α * x i - β * y i)]
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hxb i) (hx0 i)
    have hy := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hyb i) (hy0 i)
    have hxs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (show 0 ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 by positivity)
    have hys := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy (show 0 ≤ 2 * β ^ 2 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hs : ∑ i, (matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β -
      matrixVarianceProxy D (Finset.univ.erase i) α β) ^ 2 ≤
        8 * R ^ 2 * (α ^ 2 * bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ +
          β ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, (D i)ᴴ * D i)) := by
    apply (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hpoint i)).trans_eq
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      ← hV, ← hU]
  have hc : α ^ 2 * bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ +
      β ^ 2 * specNorm (∑ i, (D i)ᴴ * D i) ≤
      (α + β) * matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β := by
    have hcross : 0 ≤ α * β *
        (bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ + specNorm (∑ i, (D i)ᴴ * D i)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα hβ)
        (add_nonneg (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg D _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    dsimp [matrixVarianceProxy]
    nlinarith
  exact hs.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (by positivity)).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_sub_resolventVarianceProxy_erase_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sub_resolventVarianceProxy_erase_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hD : ∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ 2 * R) :
    ∑ i, (resolventVarianceProxy D Finset.univ R η -
      resolventVarianceProxy D (Finset.univ.erase i) R η) ^ 2 ≤
      (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) *
        resolventVarianceProxy D Finset.univ R η
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_sq_sub_matrixVarianceProxy_erase_le D hR
    (α := 2 / η ^ 4) (β := 8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6) (by positivity) (by positivity) hD
  have hc : 8 * R ^ 2 * (2 / η ^ 4 + 8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6) =
      16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6 := by ring
  simpa only [resolventVarianceProxy, hc] using h

name: NLAlib.matrixVarianceProxy_congr
statement:
theorem matrixVarianceProxy_congr {D E : ι → Matrix n n ℂ} (s : Finset ι)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, D i = E i) (α β : ℝ) :
    matrixVarianceProxy D s α β = matrixVarianceProxy E s α β
proof:
:= by
  have hg : (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) = ∑ i ∈ s, (E i)ᴴ * E i := by
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by rw [h i hi])
  simp only [matrixVarianceProxy, bilinearSquareMass_congr s h, hg]

name: NLAlib.matrixVarianceProxy_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem matrixVarianceProxy_le_card_mul [Fintype ι]
    (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {R α β : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hD : ∀ i, specNorm (D i) ≤ 2 * R) :
    matrixVarianceProxy D Finset.univ α β ≤ (α + β) * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (4 * R ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (∑ i, specNorm (D i) ^ 2) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (4 * R ^ 2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, (4 * R ^ 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R)).mpr (hD i)
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by simp
  have h1 := (bilinearSquareMass_le_sum_specNorm_sq D Finset.univ).trans hs
  have h2 := (specNorm_sum_gram_le_sum_specNorm_sq D Finset.univ).trans hs
  dsimp only [matrixVarianceProxy]
  have h := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hα)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hβ)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : nuclearNorm A = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuclearNorm, kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]
  rw [min_self, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues A i)]
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues A i) =
        ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA i)
    _ = A.trace := (trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ hA.isHermitian).symm

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_single_columns
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_single_columns {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobSq A = ∑ j, frobSq (A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.dilation_reindex
statement:
theorem dilation_reindex {m n p q : Type*} (A : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    dilation (A.reindex em en) =
      (dilation A).reindex (em.sumCongr en) (em.sumCongr en)
proof:
:= by
  ext (a | a) (b | b) <;>
    simp [dilation, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_dilation
statement:
theorem specNorm_dilation {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    specNorm (dilation A) = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  haveI : NeZero (Fintype.card m) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
  haveI : NeZero (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
  have h := (dilation_identities (A.reindex em en)).2.2.2
  simp only [← specNorm_eq_norm, dilation_reindex, specNorm_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenNorm (A + B) p ≤ schattenNorm A p + schattenNorm B p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ∞
  · simp only [hpt, schattenNorm_top]
    exact specNorm_add_le A B
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt,
      schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt]
    exact schattenNormReal_add_le A B (by simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_one] using ENNReal.toReal_mono hpt hp)

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_smul
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_smul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenNorm (c • A) p = |c| * schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ∞
  · simp only [hpt, schattenNorm_top]
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt]
    exact schattenNormReal_smul A c (ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpt)

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenNorm A p = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ∞
  · rw [hpt, schattenNorm_top, specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact norm_eq_zero
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt]
    exact schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff A (ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpt)

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_orthogonal_mul
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ∞
  · simp only [hpt, schattenNorm_top]
    exact specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU A
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt]
    exact schattenNormReal_orthogonal_mul A hU _

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_mul_orthogonal
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ∞
  · simp only [hpt, schattenNorm_top]
    have hVt : HasOrthonormalCols Vᵀ := by
      change Vᵀᵀ * Vᵀ = 1
      rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
      exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hV
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := Vᵀ) hVt A
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt]
    exact schattenNormReal_mul_orthogonal A hV _

name: NLAlib.schattenInvariantNorm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenInvariantNorm_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (schattenInvariantNorm p hp).seminorm A = schattenNorm A p
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_smul_le_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_smul_le_of_quadratic_energy
