    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ≤ σ * Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hB : (∑ i, x i • A i).IsHermitian :=
    isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  rw [hB.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hσ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).mpr
  intro j
  let u : n → ℂ := fun k => hB.eigenvectorBasis j k
  have hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 := by
    simpa only [u, WithLp.toLp_ofLp] using hB.eigenvectorBasis.norm_eq_one j
  have hq : (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re =
      ∑ i, x i * (quadForm (A i) u).re := by
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum,
      Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, Complex.real_smul,
      Complex.re_sum, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hB.eigenvalues_eq]
  change |(quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re| ≤ _
  rw [hq]
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ x
    (fun i => (quadForm (A i) u).re)
  have hsx : 0 ≤ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (henergy u hu) hsx
  have ht := hcs.trans hb
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hσ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hsx]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using ht

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix m n K) (X : Matrix n p K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) : frobNorm (U * X) = frobNorm X
proof:
:= by
  have hs : frobNorm (U * X) ^ 2 = frobNorm X ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U X, hU, Matrix.one_mul]
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (U * X), frobNorm_nonneg X]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_right_unitary
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_right_unitary (X : Matrix m n K) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) :
    frobNorm (X * (U : Matrix n n K)) = frobNorm X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobNorm_conjTranspose (X * (U : Matrix n n K)), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    frobNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols _ Xᴴ, frobNorm_conjTranspose]
  change ((U : Matrix n n K)ᴴ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n K)ᴴ = 1
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  exact Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_left_unitary
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_left_unitary (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) (X : Matrix n p K) :
    frobNorm ((U : Matrix n n K) * X) = frobNorm X
proof:
:=
  frobNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols _ _ (Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U)

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le {T : Matrix m n ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ x : n → ℝ, c ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ (T *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ x))
    (X : Matrix n p ℝ) : c * specNorm X ≤ specNorm (T * X)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc0 : c = 0
  · simp [hc0, specNorm_nonneg]
  have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hc0)
  have hb : specNorm X ≤ specNorm (T * X) / c := by
    apply specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le (div_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) hc)
    intro x
    have hh := h (X *ᵥ x)
    have hu := sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (T * X) x
    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at hu
    have hu' : (T *ᵥ (X *ᵥ x)) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ (X *ᵥ x)) ≤
        specNorm (T * X) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
      simpa [dotProduct, sq, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hu
    have hh' := hh.trans hu'
    rw [div_pow, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hcpos)).2
    nlinarith [hh']
  have := (le_div_iff₀ hcpos).1 hb
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.mul_frobSq_le_frobSq_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq,
    Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => X i j ^ 2),
    Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => (T * X) i j ^ 2), Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
    simpa [dotProduct, sq, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec] using h (fun i => X i j)

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem norm_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ‖A.trace‖ ≤ Fintype.card n * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖A.trace‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖A i i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : n, specNorm A := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => norm_apply_le_specNorm A i i
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ‖normalizedTrace A‖ ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalizedTrace]
  by_cases h : Fintype.card n = 0
  · simp [h,specNorm_nonneg]
  · have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using norm_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm A)

name: NLAlib.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_normalizedTraceLinearMap_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_toContinuousLinearMap_normalizedTraceLinearMap_le_one :
    ‖(normalizedTraceLinearMap : Matrix n n 𝕜 →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜).toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro A
  simpa only [LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply,
    one_mul, specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm A

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.convex_sublevel
statement: theorem convex_sublevel (c : ℝ) : Convex ℝ {x : ι → ℝ | Φ.value x ≤ c}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.sep_univ, value] using Φ.seminorm.convexOn.convex_le c

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.value_le_of_majorized
statement: theorem value_le_of_majorized {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : Majorized x y) : Φ.value x ≤ Φ.value y
proof:
:= by
  apply convexHull_min (s := Set.range fun σ : Equiv.Perm ι => y ∘ σ)
    (t := {x : ι → ℝ | Φ.value x ≤ Φ.value y}) _ (Φ.convex_sublevel _) hxy.mem_convexHull_permutations
  rintro z ⟨σ, rfl⟩
  exact (Φ.permutation_invariant y σ).le

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.value_le_of_nonneg_of_le
statement:
theorem value_le_of_nonneg_of_le {x y : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hxy : x ≤ y) : Φ.value x ≤ Φ.value y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Set (ι → ℝ) := Set.univ.pi (fun i => ({-y i, y i} : Set ℝ))
  have hxV : x ∈ convexHull ℝ V := by
    apply mem_convexHull_pi
    intro i _
    rw [convexHull_pair, segment_eq_Icc (show -y i ≤ y i by linarith [hy i])]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hx i, hy i], hxy i⟩
  have hV : V ⊆ {z : ι → ℝ | Φ.value z ≤ Φ.value y} := by
    intro z hz
    let ε : ι → ℝ := fun i => if z i = y i then 1 else -1
    have heps (i : ι) : |ε i| = 1 := by dsimp [ε]; split <;> norm_num
    have hzε : z = fun i => ε i * y i := by
      funext i
      have hi := hz i (Set.mem_univ i)
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hi
      rcases hi with hi | hi
      · dsimp [ε]
        split_ifs with h
        · simpa using h
        · simpa using hi
      · simp [ε, hi]
    rw [hzε]
    exact (Φ.sign_invariant y ε heps).le
  exact convexHull_min hV (Φ.convex_sublevel _) hxV

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.value_le_of_weaklyMajorized
statement:
theorem value_le_of_weaklyMajorized {x y : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y) : Φ.value x ≤ Φ.value y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzy⟩ := hxy.exists_le_majorized
  have hz (i : ι) : 0 ≤ z i := (hx i).trans (hxz i)
  exact (Φ.value_le_of_nonneg_of_le hx hz hxz).trans (Φ.value_le_of_majorized hzy)

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.value_abs
statement: theorem value_abs (x : ι → ℝ) : Φ.value (fun i => |x i|) = Φ.value x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ε : ι → ℝ := fun i => if 0 ≤ x i then 1 else -1
  have heps (i : ι) : |ε i| = 1 := by dsimp [ε]; split <;> norm_num
  have h : (fun i => |x i|) = fun i => ε i * x i := by
    funext i
    dsimp [ε]
    split_ifs with hi
    · simp [abs_of_nonneg hi]
    · simp [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hi)]
  rw [h]
  exact Φ.sign_invariant x ε heps

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_iff_sandwich
proof:
:= by
  have hHi : cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A = r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - A := by
    calc
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => r) A - cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A :=
        cfc_sub _ _ A continuousOn_const continuousOn_id
      _ = algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) r - A :=
        congrArg₂ (fun X Y : Matrix n n 𝕜 => X - Y) (cfc_const r A hA) (cfc_id' ℝ A hA)
      _ = r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - A := by rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have hLo : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x + r) A = A + r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) := by
    calc
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => x + r) A =
          cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) r :=
        cfc_add_const r _ A continuousOn_id hA
      _ = A + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) r :=
        congrArg (fun X : Matrix n n 𝕜 => X + algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) r) (cfc_id' ℝ A hA)
      _ = A + r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) := by rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have hUpper : A ≤ r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) ↔ ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ r := by
    constructor
    · intro hb i
      have hp : 0 ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A := by
        rw [hHi]
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr hb
      exact sub_nonneg.mp ((cfc_nonneg_iff (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A (by fun_prop)
        hA).mp hp _ (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i))
    · intro hb
      have hp : 0 ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A := by
        apply (cfc_nonneg_iff (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A (by fun_prop) hA).mpr
        intro x hx
        rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hb i)
      rw [hHi] at hp
      exact sub_nonneg.mp hp
  have hLower : -(r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) ≤ A ↔ ∀ i, -r ≤ hA.eigenvalues i := by
    constructor
    · intro hb i
      have hp : 0 ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => x + r) A := by
        rw [hLo]
        exact neg_le_iff_add_nonneg.mp hb
      have hi := (cfc_nonneg_iff (fun x : ℝ => x + r) A (by fun_prop)
        hA).mp hp _ (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
      linarith
    · intro hb
      have hp : 0 ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => x + r) A := by
        apply (cfc_nonneg_iff (fun x : ℝ => x + r) A (by fun_prop) hA).mpr
        intro x hx
        rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
        linarith [hb i]
      rw [hLo] at hp
      exact neg_le_iff_add_nonneg.mpr hp
  rw [hA.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues, hLower, hUpper]
  simp only [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hr, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le, forall_and]

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.specNorm_le_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hD : cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A = r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - A := by
    calc
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => r) A - cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A :=
        cfc_sub _ _ A continuousOn_const continuousOn_id
      _ = algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) r - A :=
        congrArg₂ (fun X Y : Matrix n n 𝕜 => X - Y)
          (cfc_const r A hA.isHermitian) (cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian)
      _ = r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - A := by rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [hA.isHermitian.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues]
  constructor
  · intro hnorm
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    rw [← hD]
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    apply (cfc_nonneg_iff _ _ (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id) hA.isHermitian).mpr
    intro x hx
    rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr
      (((Real.le_norm_self _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)).trans hnorm)
  · intro horder
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hr).mpr
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)]
    have hp : 0 ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => r - x) A := by
      rw [hD]
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr horder
    have hs := (cfc_nonneg_iff _ _ (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id)
      hA.isHermitian).mp hp
    exact sub_nonneg.mp (hs _ (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i))

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.le_specNorm_smul_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.le_specNorm_smul_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A ≤ specNorm A • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
    hA.isSelfAdjoint.le_algebraMap_norm_self

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.le_lambdaMax_smul_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.le_lambdaMax_smul_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A ≤ lambdaMax A • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  apply le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le (a := A)
  intro x hx
  exact le_csSup (by
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove) hx

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_le_of_conjTranspose_mul_self_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sq_le_of_conjTranspose_mul_self_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ r • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) :
    specNorm A ^ 2 ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).specNorm_le_iff hr |>.mpr hA

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le (U V : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ i, (U i).IsHermitian) (hV : ∀ i, (V i).IsHermitian) :
    specNorm (∑ i, (U i - V i) ^ 2) ≤
      2 * (specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, V i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsq (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : 0 ≤ A ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [hA.eq, pow_two] using (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).nonneg
  have hle : (∑ i, (U i - V i) ^ 2) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) • ((∑ i, U i ^ 2) + ∑ i, V i ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [← sub_nonneg]
    convert hsq (U i + V i) ((hU i).add (hV i)) using 1
    simp only [pow_two, two_smul]
    noncomm_ring
  have hn := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hsq _ ((hU i).sub (hV i)))) hle
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(2 : ℝ) • ((∑ i, U i ^ 2) + ∑ i, V i ^ 2)‖ := hn
    _ = 2 * ‖(∑ i, U i ^ 2) + ∑ i, V i ^ 2‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul]
      norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (norm_add_le (∑ i, U i ^ 2) (∑ i, V i ^ 2)) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_univ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_univ_eq_zero_iff (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ = 0 ↔ ∀ i, A i = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero i
    ext a b
    let v : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single a 1)
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single b 1)
    have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by simp [v]
    have hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := by simp [w]
    have hs := sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ v w hv hw
    rw [hzero] at hs
    have hprobe (j : ι) : star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A j *ᵥ w.ofLp) = A j a b := by
      change star (Pi.single a (1 : ℂ)) ⬝ᵥ (A j *ᵥ Pi.single b 1) = _
      rw [Pi.star_single, star_one, Matrix.mulVec_single_one, single_one_dotProduct]
      rfl
    have he : ∑ j, ‖A j a b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      simpa only [hprobe] using hs
    have hi : ‖A i a b‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, ‖A j a b‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖A j a b‖) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hn : ‖A i a b‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (A i a b)]
    simpa only [Matrix.zero_apply] using norm_eq_zero.mp hn
  · intro hzero
    obtain ⟨v, w, _, _, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq A Finset.univ
    rw [he]
    simp only [hzero, Matrix.zero_mulVec, dotProduct_zero, norm_zero,
      zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: Matrix.norm_imaginaryPart_le_card_mul_im_normalizedTrace
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_le_card_mul_im_normalizedTrace
    (A : M) (hA : (imaginaryPart A : M).PosSemidef) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart A : M)‖≤(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(NLAlib.normalizedTrace A).im
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹=(((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_inv,Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  have hh := congrArg Complex.re (NLAlib.normalizedTrace_imaginaryPart A)
  rw [NLAlib.normalizedTrace,hd] at hh
  simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,sub_zero] at hh
  have hcard : (Fintype.card n : ℝ)≠0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have ht : (imaginaryPart A : M).trace.re=
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(NLAlib.normalizedTrace A).im := by
    rw [← hh]
    field_simp [hcard]
  have hn : ‖(imaginaryPart A : M)‖≤(imaginaryPart A : M).trace.re := by
    simpa only [NLAlib.specNorm_eq_norm] using hA.specNorm_le_re_trace
  exact hn.trans_eq ht

name: NLAlib.specNorm_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem specNorm_map_ofReal {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [RCLike 𝕜] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm, ← singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm]
  exact singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := 𝕜) A 0

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul_fin
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A B
  have hneg := frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A (-B)
  rw [frobInner_neg_right, singularValues_neg] at hneg
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hpos hneg
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul
statement:
theorem abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    |frobInner A B| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i * singularValues B i
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
    (B.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
  simp only [frobInner_reindex, singularValues_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_schattenNormReal_mul
statement:
theorem abs_frobInner_le_schattenNormReal_mul (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) {p q : ℝ}
    (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) : |frobInner A B| ≤ schattenNormReal A p * schattenNormReal B q
proof:
:= by
  apply (abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A B).trans
  exact Real.inner_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
    (Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)))
    (f := singularValues A) (g := singularValues B) hpq
    (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i) (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i)

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_specNorm (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    |frobInner A B| ≤ nuclearNorm A * specNorm B
proof:
:= by
  calc
    |frobInner A B| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i * singularValues B i :=
      abs_frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A B
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i * specNorm B :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (singularValues_le_specNorm B i) (singularValues_nonneg _ i)
    _ = nuclearNorm A * specNorm B := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range]

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_specNorm_mul_nuclearNorm
statement:
theorem abs_frobInner_le_specNorm_mul_nuclearNorm (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    |frobInner A B| ≤ specNorm A * nuclearNorm B
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frobInner_comm B A, mul_comm] using abs_frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_specNorm B A

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_eq_sum
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_eq_sum (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 0 < p.toReal) :
    rowMixedNorm A p = (∑ i, Real.sqrt (rowSq A i) ^ p.toReal) ^ (1 / p.toReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowMixedNorm
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_sum hp]
  simp only [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, rowSq]

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_top
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_top (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    rowMixedNorm A ⊤ = ⨆ i, Real.sqrt (rowSq A i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowMixedNorm
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_ciSup]
  simp only [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, rowSq]

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem rowMixedNorm_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (p : ℝ≥0∞) : 0 ≤ rowMixedNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · subst p
    rw [rowMixedNorm, PiLp.norm_eq_card]
    positivity
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    exact norm_nonneg _
  rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A (ENNReal.toReal_pos hp0 hpt)]
  exact Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _) _

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_zero
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_zero {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    rowMixedNorm (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨hp⟩
  exact norm_zero

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    rowMixedNorm (A + B) p ≤ rowMixedNorm A p + rowMixedNorm B p
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨hp⟩
  exact norm_add_le
    (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => A i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)))
    (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => B i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)))

name: NLAlib.abs_rowMixedNorm_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rowMixedNorm_sub_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    |rowMixedNorm A p - rowMixedNorm B p| ≤ rowMixedNorm (A - B) p
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨hp⟩
  exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le
    (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => A i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)))
    (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => B i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)))

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_two
statement: theorem rowMixedNorm_two (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : rowMixedNorm A 2 = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowMixedNorm
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2]
  simp only [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Real.sq_sqrt
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  simp only [frobNorm, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_le_frobNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    rowMixedNorm A p ≤ frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    rw [rowMixedNorm_top]
    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with
    | inl h => simp [frobNorm_nonneg]
    | inr h =>
        apply ciSup_le
        intro i
        apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
        change (∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2) ≤ frobSq A
        rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => sq_nonneg (‖A j k‖))
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p.toReal := by
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat] using ENNReal.toReal_mono hpt hp
    rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A (by linarith)]
    have h := sum_rpow_root_le_sum_rpow_root Finset.univ
      (fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq A i)) (fun i _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hp2
    apply h.trans_eq
    rw [← rowMixedNorm_two A, rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A (by norm_num)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.abs_rowMixedNorm_sub_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_rowMixedNorm_sub_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    |rowMixedNorm A p - rowMixedNorm B p| ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:=
  (abs_rowMixedNorm_sub_le A B (le_trans (by norm_num) hp)).trans
    (rowMixedNorm_le_frobNorm _ hp)

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_le_schattenNorm
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_le_schattenNorm [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    rowMixedNorm A p ≤ schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    rw [rowMixedNorm_top, schattenNorm_top]
    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with
    | inl h => simp [specNorm_nonneg]
    | inr h =>
        apply ciSup_le
        intro i
        exact (Real.sqrt_le_left (specNorm_nonneg _)).mpr (rowSq_le_specNorm_sq A i)
  · have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p.toReal := by
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat] using ENNReal.toReal_mono hpt hp
    rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A (by linarith), schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top A hpt]
    exact rowNorm_sum_rpow_div_p_le_schattenNormReal A hp2

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_submatrix_equiv
    {m' n' : Type*} [Fintype m'] [Fintype n']
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (e : m' ≃ m) (f : n' ≃ n)
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : rowMixedNorm (A.submatrix e f) p = rowMixedNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  have hrow (i : m') : rowSq (A.submatrix e f) i = rowSq A (e i) :=
    f.sum_comp (fun j => ‖A (e i) j‖ ^ 2)
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    simp only [rowMixedNorm_top, hrow]
    exact e.iSup_congr fun _ => rfl
  · have hpr : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos
      (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpt
    rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum _ hpr, rowMixedNorm_eq_sum _ hpr]
    simp only [hrow]
    rw [e.sum_comp (fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq A i) ^ p.toReal)]

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_ofReal_eq_sum_rowSq
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_ofReal_eq_sum_rowSq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    rowMixedNorm A (ENNReal.ofReal p) = (∑ i, rowSq A i ^ (p / 2)) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A (by simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le] using hp)]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hrow : 0 ≤ rowSq A i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hrow]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_ofReal_rpow
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_ofReal_rpow (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    rowMixedNorm A (ENNReal.ofReal p) ^ p = ∑ i, rowSq A i ^ (p / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A (by simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le] using hp)]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le, one_div]
  rw [Real.rpow_inv_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _) hp.ne']
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hrow : 0 ≤ rowSq A i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hrow]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_le_of_rowSq_le
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    rw [rowMixedNorm_top, rowMixedNorm_top]
    exact ciSup_mono (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove fun i => Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hrow i)
  · have hpr : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos
      (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpt
    rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_sum A hpr, rowMixedNorm_eq_sum B hpr]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _) _ (by positivity)
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hrow i)) hpr.le

name: NLAlib.rowMixedNorm_top_le
statement:
theorem rowMixedNorm_top_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    rowMixedNorm A ⊤ ≤ rowMixedNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨hp⟩
  rw [rowMixedNorm_top]
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with
  | inl h => simp [rowMixedNorm_nonneg]
  | inr h =>
      apply ciSup_le
      intro i
      have hi := PiLp.norm_apply_le
        (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => A i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))) i
      unfold rowMixedNorm
      simpa only [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, rowSq] using hi

name: NLAlib.norm_entry_le_rowMixedNorm
statement:
theorem norm_entry_le_rowMixedNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (i : m) (j : n) : ‖A i j‖ ≤ rowMixedNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨hp⟩
  have hrow := PiLp.norm_apply_le
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => A i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) j
  have hout := PiLp.norm_apply_le
    (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => A i j) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n))) i
  exact hrow.trans hout

name: NLAlib.monotone_convexOn_rpow_max_zero
statement:
theorem monotone_convexOn_rpow_max_zero {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Monotone (fun u : ℝ => max u 0 ^ p) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun u : ℝ => max u 0 ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := le_trans zero_le_one hp
  have hm : Monotone (fun u : ℝ => max u 0) := fun u v huv => max_le_max huv le_rfl
  have hc : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun u : ℝ => max u 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using (monotone_convexOn_max_sub 0).2
  have him : (fun u : ℝ => max u 0) '' Set.univ = Set.Ici 0 := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, _, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_Ici.mpr (le_max_right u (0 : ℝ))
    · intro hz
      exact ⟨z, Set.mem_univ z, max_eq_left hz⟩
  have hpow : ConvexOn ℝ ((fun u : ℝ => max u 0) '' Set.univ) (fun u : ℝ => u ^ p) := by
    rw [him]
    exact convexOn_rpow hp
  have hpowm : MonotoneOn (fun u : ℝ => u ^ p) ((fun u : ℝ => max u 0) '' Set.univ) := by
    rw [him]
    exact Real.monotoneOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_nonneg hp0
  refine ⟨fun u v huv => Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_max_right u 0) (hm huv) hp0, ?_⟩
  exact hpow.comp hc hpowm

name: NLAlib.WeaklyMajorized.sum_rpow_le
statement:
theorem WeaklyMajorized.sum_rpow_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : WeaklyMajorized x y) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : (∑ i, x i ^ p) ≤ ∑ i, y i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have h := hxy.sum_monotone_convex_le (monotone_convexOn_rpow_max_zero hp).1
    (monotone_convexOn_rpow_max_zero hp).2
  simpa only [max_eq_left (hx _), max_eq_left (hy _)] using h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_add_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_add_le (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenNormReal (A + B) p ≤ schattenNormReal A p + schattenNormReal B p
proof:
:= by
  let N := min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
  have hsum := (weaklyMajorized_singularValues_add A B).sum_rpow_le
    (fun i => singularValues_nonneg _ i)
    (fun i => add_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) (singularValues_nonneg _ i)) hp
  have hroot := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun (i : Fin N) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
    Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg (A + B) i) p)) hsum
      (one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hp))
  have htri := Real.Lp_add_le_of_nonneg (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N))
    (f := fun i => singularValues A i) (g := fun i => singularValues B i) hp
    (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i) (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i)
  have h := hroot.trans htri
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues (A + B) i ^ p) N,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues A i ^ p) N,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues B i ^ p) N] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_smul
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_smul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (c • A) p = |c| * schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p)
  unfold schattenNormReal
  simp_rw [singularValues_smul, Real.mul_rpow (abs_nonneg c) (singularValues_nonneg _ _),
    ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) p) hsum,
    one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (abs_nonneg c) hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_zero
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_zero {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNormReal, singularValues_eq_linearMap, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne',
    Real.zero_rpow (show p⁻¹ ≠ 0 from inv_ne_zero hp.ne')]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal A p = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hsum0 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i ^ p) = 0 :=
      (Real.rpow_eq_zero (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p) (by positivity)).mp h
    have hi (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))) :
        singularValues A i = 0 := by
      have hpw : singularValues A i ^ p = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ =>
          Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ j) p)).mp hsum0 i hi
      exact (Real.rpow_eq_zero (singularValues_nonneg _ i) hp.ne').mp hpw
    apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    apply (LinearMap.singularValues_eq_zero_iff (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A)).mp
    ext i
    change singularValues A i = 0
    by_cases him : i < min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
    · exact hi i (Finset.mem_range.mpr him)
    · exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (not_lt.mp him)
  · rintro rfl
    exact schattenNormReal_zero hp

name: NLAlib.schattenSeminorm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenSeminorm_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenSeminorm p hp A = schattenNormReal A p
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.schattenSeminorm_apply_eq_schattenNorm
statement:
theorem schattenSeminorm_apply_eq_schattenNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenSeminorm p hp A = schattenNorm A (ENNReal.ofReal p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenSeminorm_apply, schattenNorm_ofReal A (le_trans zero_le_one hp)]

name: NLAlib.inner_eq_star_dotProduct
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 v, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]

name: NLAlib.norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ≤ ‖v‖ * specNorm A * ‖w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hi := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) v (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ w.ofLp))
  rw [inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at hi
  calc _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ := hi
    _ ≤ ‖v‖ * (specNorm A * ‖w‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (A.l2_opNorm_mulVec w) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  calc _ ≤ ‖v‖ * specNorm A * ‖w‖ := norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le A v w
    _ ≤ 1 * specNorm A * ‖w‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (specNorm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [one_mul, mul_one] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (specNorm_nonneg A)

name: NLAlib.norm_inner_normalize
statement:
private theorem norm_inner_normalize (z : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    ‖inner ℂ (NormedSpace.normalize z) z‖ = ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · simp [hz]
  have hn : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
  unfold NormedSpace.normalize
  rw [← algebraMap_smul ℂ (‖z‖⁻¹) z, RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal,
    inner_smul_real_left, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg z)), norm_pow, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
    abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg z)]
  field_simp [hn]

name: NLAlib.exists_unitBall_bilinear_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_bilinear_eq_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := exists_specNorm_sum_gram_eq (fun _ : Unit => A) Finset.univ
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_unique, one_nsmul] at he
  let z : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)
  have hz : ‖z‖ = specNorm A := by
    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg z) (specNorm_nonneg A)).mp
    simpa only [← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self] using he.symm
  by_cases hzero : z = 0
  · refine ⟨0, w, by simp, hw, ?_⟩
    have hA : specNorm A = 0 := by rw [← hz, hzero, norm_zero]
    simp [hA]
  · refine ⟨NormedSpace.normalize z, w, (NormedSpace.norm_normalize hzero).le, hw, ?_⟩
    rw [← inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    exact (norm_inner_normalize z).trans hz

name: NLAlib.norm_bilinear_smul_real
statement:
private theorem norm_bilinear_smul_real (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (a b : ℝ) :
    ‖star (a • v).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (b • w).ofLp)‖ =
      |a| * |b| * ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_smul, Matrix.mulVec_smul, star_smul, star_trivial,
    smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_bilinear_sq_le_mul_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem sum_bilinear_sq_le_mul_bilinearSquareMass
    (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ c) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ c) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      c ^ 4 * bilinearSquareMass D s
proof:
:= by
  let v' : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := c⁻¹ • v
  let w' : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := c⁻¹ • w
  have hv' : ‖v'‖ ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [v']
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc), inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_le_one hc).mpr hv
  have hw' : ‖w'‖ ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [w']
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc), inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_le_one hc).mpr hw
  have hve : c • v' = v := by dsimp [v']; rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul]
  have hwe : c • w' = w := by dsimp [w']; rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul]
  have hi (i : ι) : ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 =
      c ^ 4 * ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hve, ← hwe, norm_bilinear_smul_real, abs_of_pos hc]
    ring
  calc
    _ = c ^ 4 * (∑ i ∈ s, ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) := by
      simp_rw [hi]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass D s v' w' hv' hw') (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp
  have hd : (fun i : m => RCLike.re ((A * A.conjTranspose) i i)) =
      fun i => rowSq A i := by
    funext i
    simp only [rowSq, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, RCLike.star_def,
      RCLike.mul_conj, map_sum, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  have hm := (majorized_diagonal_eigenvalues
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self A)).1
  rw [hd] at hm
  have hp2 : 1 ≤ p / 2 := by linarith
  have hs := hm.sum_rpow_le (p := p / 2)
    (by intro i; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (fun i => Matrix.eigenvalues_self_mul_conjTranspose_nonneg A i)
    hp2
  have hterm (i : ℕ) :
      (singularValues A i ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) = singularValues A i ^ p := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul (singularValues_nonneg A i) 2 (p / 2)]
    congr 1
    ring
  have heig :
      (∑ i, ((Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self A).eigenvalues i) ^
        (p / 2)) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
          singularValues A i ^ p := by
    rw [sum_eigenvalues_mul_adjoint_eq_adjoint_mul A (fun x => x ^ (p / 2))
      (Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt (div_pos hp0 (by norm_num))))]
    rw [sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues A (fun x => x ^ (p / 2))]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    exact sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A (fun x => x ^ p)
      (by simp [Real.zero_rpow hp0.ne']) (min_le_right (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))
  rw [heig, (schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum A hp0).symm] at hs
  exact hs

name: NLAlib.sum_rowNorm_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow
proof:
:= by
  have hs := sum_rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow A hp
  have hterm (i : m) : (√(rowSq A i) : ℝ) ^ p = rowSq A i ^ (p / 2) := by
    have hx : 0 ≤ rowSq A i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_comm, mul_one_div]
  simpa [hterm] using hs

name: NLAlib.rowSq_sum_rpow_div_p_le_schattenNormReal
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp
  have h := sum_rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow A hp
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, rowSq A i ^ (p / 2) := by
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _
  have hroot :
      (∑ i, rowSq A i ^ (p / 2)) ^ (1 / p) ≤
        (schattenNormReal A p ^ p) ^ (1 / p) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hnonneg h
      (one_div_nonneg.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp).le)
  exact hroot.trans_eq (by
    rw [one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p) hp0.ne'])

name: NLAlib.rowNorm_sum_rpow_div_p_le_schattenNormReal
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp
  have h := sum_rowNorm_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow A hp
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (√(rowSq A i) : ℝ) ^ p := by
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _
  have hroot :
      (∑ i, (√(rowSq A i) : ℝ) ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤
        (schattenNormReal A p ^ p) ^ (1 / p) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hnonneg h
      (one_div_nonneg.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp).le)
  exact hroot.trans_eq (by
    rw [one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p) hp0.ne'])

name: NLAlib.rowNorm_sum_rpow_div_p_le_schattenNorm
statement:
theorem rowNorm_sum_rpow_div_p_le_schattenNorm (A : Matrix m n K) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, (√(rowSq A i) : ℝ) ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤
      schattenNorm A (ENNReal.ofReal p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hp
  rw [schattenNorm_ofReal A hp0]
  exact rowNorm_sum_rpow_div_p_le_schattenNormReal A hp

name: NLAlib.rowSq_le_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem rowSq_le_specNorm_sq (A : Matrix m n K) (i : m) :
    rowSq A i ≤ specNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : m → K := Pi.single i (1 : K)
  have h := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq A.conjTranspose e
  have hsingle : (∑ j, ‖e j‖ ^ 2) = 1 := by
    subst e
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [hj]
    · intro hi
      simp at hi
  rw [specNorm_conjTranspose, hsingle, mul_one] at h
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_single_one] at h
  simpa only [rowSq, Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, norm_star] using h

name: NLAlib.rowNorm_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem rowNorm_le_specNorm (A : Matrix m n K) (i : m) :
    Real.sqrt (rowSq A i) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.sqrt_le_left (specNorm_nonneg A)).2 (rowSq_le_specNorm_sq A i)

name: NLAlib.pi_norm_rowSq_le_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem pi_norm_rowSq_le_specNorm_sq (A : Matrix m n K) :
    ‖(fun i => rowSq A i)‖ ≤ specNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  intro i
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg]
  · exact rowSq_le_specNorm_sq A i
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.pi_norm_rowNorm_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem pi_norm_rowNorm_le_specNorm (A : Matrix m n K) :
    ‖(fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq A i))‖ ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg A)]
  intro i
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg]
  · exact rowNorm_le_specNorm A i
  · exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_eq_restrictedMinimum
statement:
theorem exists_norm_eq_restrictedMinimum (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ T, ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x‖ = restrictedMinimum A T
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x‖) :=
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.norm
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hmin⟩ := hT.exists_isMinOn hne hc.continuousOn
  refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
  symm
  exact (show IsLeast ((fun x => ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x‖) '' T)
    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x‖ from
    ⟨⟨x,hx,rfl⟩, by rintro _ ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩; exact hmin hy⟩).csInf_eq

name: NLAlib.restrictedMinimum_le_norm
statement:
theorem restrictedMinimum_le_norm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} {x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n} (hx : x ∈ T) :
    restrictedMinimum A T ≤ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x‖
proof:
:= by
  exact csInf_le ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩ ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.restrictedMinimum_nonneg
statement:
theorem restrictedMinimum_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} (hne : T.Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ restrictedMinimum A T
proof:
:=
  le_csInf (hne.image _) (by rintro _ ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_specNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    |restrictedMinimum A T - restrictedMinimum B T| ≤ specNorm (A-B)
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ A B : Matrix m n 𝕜,
      restrictedMinimum A T - restrictedMinimum B T ≤ specNorm (A-B) := by
    intro A B
    obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := exists_norm_eq_restrictedMinimum B hT hne
    have ha := restrictedMinimum_le_norm A hx
    let Φ := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) (A-B)
    have hd : ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x - Matrix.toEuclideanLin B x‖ ≤ specNorm (A-B) := by
      have heq : Φ x = Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x - Matrix.toEuclideanLin B x := by
        change Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A-B) x = _
        rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
      rw [← heq]
      exact (Φ.le_opNorm x).trans (by
        change specNorm (A-B) * ‖x‖ ≤ specNorm (A-B)
        nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (A-B), hunit x hx])
    have hn := norm_sub_norm_le (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B x)
    linarith
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨hstep A B, by
    have heq : specNorm (B-A) = specNorm (A-B) := by
      rw [show B-A = -(A-B) by abel, specNorm_neg]
    simpa only [heq] using hstep B A⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    |restrictedMinimum A T - restrictedMinimum B T| ≤ frobNorm (A-B)
proof:
:=
  (abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_specNorm A B hT hne hunit).trans (specNorm_le_frobNorm _)

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_add_le_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_add_le_complex (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    schattenNormReal (A + B) p ≤ schattenNormReal A p + schattenNormReal B p
proof:
:= by
  have h := schattenNormReal_add_le (matrixRealification A) (matrixRealification B) hp
  rw [← matrixRealification_add, schattenNormReal_matrixRealification,
    schattenNormReal_matrixRealification, schattenNormReal_matrixRealification,
    ← mul_add] at h
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) _)).mp h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_real_smul_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_real_smul_complex (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (c : ℝ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (c • A) p = |c| * schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have h := schattenNormReal_smul (matrixRealification A) c hp
  rw [← matrixRealification_smul, schattenNormReal_matrixRealification,
    schattenNormReal_matrixRealification] at h
  have hc := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (1 / p)).ne'
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hc)
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * schattenNormReal (c • A) p =
        |c| * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * schattenNormReal A p) := h
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_smul_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_smul_complex (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (c : ℂ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal (c • A) p = ‖c‖ * schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hA⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let d : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℂ := fun i => (singularValues A i : ℂ)
  have hd : (rectDiag (singularValues A) :
      Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [d, rectDiag_apply_ofReal]
    · have hval : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
      simp [d, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hij, hval]
  have hnorm : schattenNormReal A p =
      (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hA.eq, hd]
    rw [schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose hA.conjTranspose_mul_left
      hA.conjTranspose_mul_right, schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
    simp only [d, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ _)]
  have hscale : c • A = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => c * d i) * Vᴴ := by
    calc
      c • A = c • (U * rectDiag (singularValues A) * Vᴴ) := congrArg (c • ·) hA.eq
      _ = U * (c • rectDiag (singularValues A)) * Vᴴ := by
        rw [← Matrix.smul_mul, ← Matrix.mul_smul]
      _ = _ := by rw [hd, ← Matrix.diagonal_smul]; rfl
  rw [hscale, schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose hA.conjTranspose_mul_left
    hA.conjTranspose_mul_right, schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
  simp_rw [norm_mul, d, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A _),
    Real.mul_rpow (norm_nonneg c) (singularValues_nonneg A _), ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) p)
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A _) _),
    one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (norm_nonneg c) hp.ne', hnorm, one_div]

name: NLAlib.sum_schattenDualCoefficients_rpow_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 0 < schattenNormReal A p := lt_of_le_of_ne (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p)
    (Ne.symm (fun h => hA ((schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff A hpq.pos).mp h)))
  have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) p)
  have hpow : schattenNormReal A p ^ p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i ^ p := by
    simp only [schattenNormReal, Fintype.card_fin]
    change ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (1 / p)) ^ p = _
    rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hS hpq.ne_zero]
  have hden : (schattenNormReal A p ^ (p - 1)) ^ q = schattenNormReal A p ^ p := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hN.le, hpq.sub_one_mul_conj]
  simp only [schattenDualCoefficients]
  change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n),
    (singularValues A i ^ (p - 1) / schattenNormReal A p ^ (p - 1)) ^ q) = 1
  simp_rw [Real.div_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A _) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hN.le _),
    ← Real.rpow_mul (singularValues_nonneg A _), hpq.sub_one_mul_conj, hden]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hpow, div_self (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN p).ne']

name: NLAlib.sum_singularValues_mul_schattenDualCoefficients_eq
statement:
theorem sum_singularValues_mul_schattenDualCoefficients_eq {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i * schattenDualCoefficients A p i) =
      schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 0 < schattenNormReal A p := lt_of_le_of_ne (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p)
    (Ne.symm (fun h => hA ((schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff A hpq.pos).mp h)))
  have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) p)
  have hpow : schattenNormReal A p ^ p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i ^ p := by
    simp only [schattenNormReal, Fintype.card_fin]
    change ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (1 / p)) ^ p = _
    rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hS hpq.ne_zero]
  have hterm (i : ℕ) : singularValues A i * schattenDualCoefficients A p i =
      singularValues A i ^ p / schattenNormReal A p ^ (p - 1) := by
    change singularValues A i * (singularValues A i ^ (p - 1) / _) = _
    have hprod : singularValues A i * singularValues A i ^ (p - 1) = singularValues A i ^ p := by
      calc
        _ = singularValues A i ^ (1 : ℝ) * singularValues A i ^ (p - 1) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
        _ = singularValues A i ^ (1 + (p - 1)) :=
          (Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
            hpq.sub_one_pos.le).symm
        _ = _ := by congr 1; ring
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, hprod]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hpow, Real.rpow_sub hN, Real.rpow_one]
  field_simp [(Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN p).ne']

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.schattenDualCoefficients_attain
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ schattenDualCoefficients A p i := fun i =>
    div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p) _)
  have hb : Antitone (schattenDualCoefficients A p) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (singularValues_nonneg A j) (singularValues_antitone A hij) hpq.sub_one_pos.le)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p) _)
  constructor
  · rw [schattenNormReal_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose h.conjTranspose_mul_left h.conjTranspose_mul_right
      _ hb0 hb, sum_schattenDualCoefficients_rpow_eq_one A hpq hA, Real.one_rpow]
  · rw [h.frobInner_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose,
      sum_singularValues_mul_schattenDualCoefficients_eq A hpq hA]

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_frobInner_eq_fin
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst A
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [schattenNormReal_zero hpq.symm.pos]; norm_num
    · rw [frobInner_zero_left, schattenNormReal_zero hpq.pos]
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    have hb := h.schattenDualCoefficients_attain hpq hA
    exact ⟨_, hb.1.le, hb.2⟩

name: NLAlib.polarSingularCoefficients_nonneg
statement: theorem polarSingularCoefficients_nonneg (r i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ polarSingularCoefficients r i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polarSingularCoefficients]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.polarSingularCoefficients_antitone
statement: theorem polarSingularCoefficients_antitone (r : ℕ) : Antitone (polarSingularCoefficients r)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hj : j < r
  · have hi : i < r := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
    simp [polarSingularCoefficients, hi, hj]
  · simp only [polarSingularCoefficients, if_neg hj]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_rectDiag_polarSingularCoefficients_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_eq_card_singularValues_ne_zero, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hfilter : ((Finset.range (min m n)).filter fun i =>
      singularValues (U * (rectDiag (polarSingularCoefficients r) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * Vᵀ) i ≠ 0) =
      Finset.range r := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hi, hne⟩
      rw [singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
        (A := U * (rectDiag (polarSingularCoefficients r) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * Vᵀ)
        (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU) (show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hV) (polarSingularCoefficients_nonneg r)
        (polarSingularCoefficients_antitone r) rfl hi] at hne
      by_contra hir
      simp [polarSingularCoefficients, hir] at hne
    · intro hi
      have him : i < min m n := hi.trans_le hr
      refine ⟨him, ?_⟩
      rw [singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
        (A := U * (rectDiag (polarSingularCoefficients r) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) * Vᵀ)
        (show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU) (show Vᵀ * V = 1 from hV) (polarSingularCoefficients_nonneg r)
        (polarSingularCoefficients_antitone r) rfl him]
      simp [polarSingularCoefficients, hi]
  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_range]

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_rectDiag_leadingSingularCoefficients_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  have heq : leadingSingularCoefficients = polarSingularCoefficients 1 := by
    funext i
    simp [leadingSingularCoefficients, polarSingularCoefficients]
  rw [heq]
  exact rank_mul_rectDiag_polarSingularCoefficients_mul_transpose hU hV hN

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.leadingSingularCoefficients_attain
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : singularValues A 0 = specNorm A := by
    exact singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm A
  have hN : 0 < min m n := by
    by_contra hn
    have hs : singularValues A 0 = 0 :=
      singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]; omega)
    have hzero : specNorm A = 0 := hfirst.symm.trans hs
    exact hA (norm_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hzero))
  have hb0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ leadingSingularCoefficients i := by
    intro i
    simp only [leadingSingularCoefficients]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hb : Antitone leadingSingularCoefficients := by
    intro i j hij
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst j
      have hi : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hij
      simp [hi]
    · simp only [leadingSingularCoefficients, if_neg hj]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  constructor
  · rw [← schattenNormReal_one, schattenNormReal_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose
      h.conjTranspose_mul_left h.conjTranspose_mul_right _ hb0 hb]
    simp [leadingSingularCoefficients, hN]
  · rw [h.frobInner_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose]
    simpa [leadingSingularCoefficients, hN] using hfirst

name: NLAlib.exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_specNorm_fin
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst A
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [nuclearNorm, kyFanNorm_zero_matrix]; norm_num
    · simp [specNorm]
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    have hb := h.leadingSingularCoefficients_attain hA
    exact ⟨_, hb.1.le, hb.2⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_frobInner_eq
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  obtain ⟨Bf, hBn, hBpair⟩ := exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_frobInner_eq_fin (A.reindex em en) hpq
  let B := Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm
  have hBr : B.reindex em en = Bf := by ext i j; simp [B, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change schattenNormReal (Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm) q ≤ 1
    rwa [schattenNormReal_reindex]
  · have h := frobInner_reindex A B em en
    rw [hBr, hBpair, schattenNormReal_reindex] at h
    exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_specNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n ℝ, nuclearNorm B ≤ 1 ∧ frobInner A B = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  obtain ⟨Bf, hBn, hBpair⟩ := exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_specNorm_fin (A.reindex em en)
  let B := Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm
  have hBr : B.reindex em en = Bf := by ext i j; simp [B, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change nuclearNorm (Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm) ≤ 1
    rwa [nuclearNorm_reindex]
  · have h := frobInner_reindex A B em en
    rw [hBr, hBpair, specNorm_reindex] at h
    exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq
statement:
theorem exists_schattenNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n ℝ, schattenNorm B q ≤ 1 ∧ frobInner A B = schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTop : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hq : q = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique ∞ q 1 q).symm
    subst q
    simp only [schattenNorm_top]
    simp only [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ (show (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ by simp),
      ENNReal.toReal_one, schattenNormReal_one]
    exact exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_specNorm A
  · by_cases hqTop : q = ∞
    · subst q
      have hp : p = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique p ∞ 1 p).symm
      subst p
      simp only [schattenNorm_top]
      simp only [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ (show (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ by simp),
        ENNReal.toReal_one, schattenNormReal_one]
      exact exists_specNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm A
    · simp only [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop,
        schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hqTop]
      exact exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_frobInner_eq A
        (ENNReal.HolderConjugate.toReal_of_ne_top hpTop hqTop)

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_schattenNorm_frobInner
statement:
theorem isGreatest_schattenNorm_frobInner (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    IsGreatest {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Matrix m n ℝ, schattenNorm B q ≤ 1 ∧ frobInner A B = z}
      (schattenNorm A p)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_schattenNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq A, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
  calc
    frobInner A B ≤ |frobInner A B| := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ schattenNorm A p * schattenNorm B q :=
      abs_frobInner_le_schattenNorm_mul A B
    _ ≤ schattenNorm A p * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (schattenNorm_nonneg A p)
    _ = _ := mul_one _

name: NLAlib.sSup_frobInner_schattenNorm_unitBall
statement:
theorem sSup_frobInner_schattenNorm_unitBall (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    sSup {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Matrix m n ℝ, schattenNorm B q ≤ 1 ∧ frobInner A B = z} =
      schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  have h := isGreatest_schattenNorm_frobInner A (p := p) (q := q)
  exact h.isLUB.csSup_eq ⟨_, h.1⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_entry_rpow_le_row_profiles
statement:
theorem sum_entry_rpow_le_row_profiles
    (b : Matrix m n ℝ) (hb : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ≤
      (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ (2 / p) *
        (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ (1 - 2 / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp2 : p = 2
  · subst p
    norm_num only [div_self (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), sub_self, Real.rpow_one,
      Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, Real.rpow_two]
    exact le_rfl
  have hpgt : 2 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp (Ne.symm hp2)
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_trans (by norm_num) hpgt
  have hpm : 0 < p - 2 := sub_pos.mpr hpgt
  have hdeg (i : m) : 0 ≤ ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hentry (i : m) (j : n) : b i j ^ p ≤ b i j ^ 2 * ‖b i‖ ^ (p - 2) := by
    have hcap : b i j ≤ ‖b i‖ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hb i j)] using norm_le_pi_norm (b i) j
    have hpow : b i j ^ p = b i j ^ 2 * b i j ^ (p - 2) := by
      have hx := Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg (hb i j) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hpm.le
      have he : (2 : ℝ) + (p - 2) = p := by ring
      simpa only [he, Real.rpow_two] using hx
    rw [hpow]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow (hb i j) hcap hpm.le) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hfirst : (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ≤
      ∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) * ‖b i‖ ^ (p - 2) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hentry i j
  have hh : Real.HolderConjugate (p / 2) (p / (p - 2)) :=
    Real.holderConjugate_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by field_simp; ring⟩
  have hholder := Real.inner_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg (Finset.univ : Finset m)
    (f := fun i => ∑ j, b i j ^ 2) (g := fun i => ‖b i‖ ^ (p - 2)) hh
    (fun i _ => hdeg i) (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  have hterm (i : m) : (‖b i‖ ^ (p - 2)) ^ (p / (p - 2)) = ‖b i‖ ^ p := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hterm] at hholder
  have he₁ : 1 / (p / 2) = 2 / p := by field_simp
  have he₂ : 1 / (p / (p - 2)) = 1 - 2 / p := by field_simp
  rw [he₁, he₂] at hholder
  exact hfirst.trans hholder

name: NLAlib.sum_entry_rpow_root_le_row_profiles
statement:
theorem sum_entry_rpow_root_le_row_profiles
    (b : Matrix m n ℝ) (hb : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹) ^ (2 / p) *
        ((∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹) ^ (1 - 2 / p)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) _
  have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hb i j) _)
    (sum_entry_rpow_le_row_profiles b hb hp) (inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p))
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hD _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _),
    ← Real.rpow_mul hD, ← Real.rpow_mul hS] at h
  simpa only [← Real.rpow_mul hD, ← Real.rpow_mul hS, mul_comm p⁻¹] using h

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_sum_entry_rpow_root_le_two_row_profiles
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_sum_entry_rpow_root_le_two_row_profiles
    (b : Matrix m n ℝ) (hb : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      2 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let A := (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹
  let B := (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := Real.rpow_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) _) _
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Real.rpow_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) _
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hw : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 / p := sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one hp0).mpr hp)
  have hagm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hp0.le) hw
    hA hB (by ring : 2 / p + (1 - 2 / p) = 1)
  have h := (sum_entry_rpow_root_le_row_profiles b hb hp).trans hagm
  have hrootp : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt p := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p)
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt p) ^ 2 = p := Real.sq_sqrt hp0.le
  have hcoef : Real.sqrt p * (2 / p) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hp0]
    nlinarith
  have hbcoef : Real.sqrt p * (1 - 2 / p) ≤ Real.sqrt p := by
    nlinarith [div_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hp0.le, Real.sqrt_nonneg p]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Real.sqrt_nonneg p)
  change Real.sqrt p * _ ≤ 2 * (A + Real.sqrt p * B)
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt p * ((2 / p) * A + (1 - 2 / p) * B) := hh
    _ ≤ 2 * A + Real.sqrt p * B := by
      calc
        _ = (Real.sqrt p * (2 / p)) * A + (Real.sqrt p * (1 - 2 / p)) * B := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hA) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbcoef hB)
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg p) hB]

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_mulVec_eq_re_quadForm_sum_gram
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_mulVec_eq_re_quadForm_sum_gram
    (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 =
      (quadForm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) u.ofLp).re
proof:
:= by
  have he : quadForm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) u.ofLp =
      ∑ i ∈ s, quadForm ((D i)ᴴ * D i) u.ofLp := by
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum]
  rw [he, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sum_gram
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sum_gram
    (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_norm_sq_mulVec_eq_re_quadForm_sum_gram]
  calc _ ≤ ‖quadForm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) u.ofLp‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
    _ ≤ specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [WithLp.toLp_ofLp] using
        norm_quadForm_le_specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) u.ofLp
    _ ≤ specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) := by
      have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg u) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mpr hu
      nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i)]

name: NLAlib.exists_specNorm_sum_gram_eq
statement:
theorem exists_specNorm_sum_gram_eq (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) =
        ∑ i ∈ s, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
      let := hn
      have he : (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) = (0 : Matrix n n ℂ) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp [he, specNorm]⟩
  | inr hn =>
      let := hn
      let G : Matrix n n ℂ := ∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i
      have hG : G.PosSemidef :=
        Matrix.posSemidef_sum s (fun i _ => Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (D i))
      have hreal : specNorm G ∈ spectrum ℝ G := by
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using CStarAlgebra.norm_mem_spectrum_of_nonneg hG.nonneg
      have hcomplex : (specNorm G : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ G := spectrum.algebraMap_mem ℂ hreal
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hq⟩ := spectrum_subset_numericalRange G hcomplex
      refine ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 x, hx.le, ?_⟩
      rw [sum_norm_sq_mulVec_eq_re_quadForm_sum_gram]
      change specNorm G = (quadForm G x).re
      rw [hq, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_gram_mono
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_gram_mono (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {s t : Finset ι} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) ≤ specNorm (∑ i ∈ t, (D i)ᴴ * D i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_sum s (fun i _ => Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (D i))
  have hle : (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (D i)ᴴ * D i :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hst
      (fun i _ _ => (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (D i)).nonneg)
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
    CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le hpos.nonneg hle

name: NLAlib.exists_specNorm_sum_gram_erase_gap_le
statement:
theorem exists_specNorm_sum_gram_erase_gap_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      specNorm (∑ i, (D i)ᴴ * D i) = ∑ i, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∀ i, specNorm (∑ j, (D j)ᴴ * D j) -
        specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (D j)ᴴ * D j) ≤
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := exists_specNorm_sum_gram_eq D Finset.univ
  refine ⟨u, hu, he, fun i => ?_⟩
  have h := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sum_gram D (Finset.univ.erase i) u hu
  have hsum := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
    (fun j => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D j *ᵥ u.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_gram_le_sum_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_gram_le_sum_specNorm_sq (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) :
    specNorm (∑ i ∈ s, (D i)ᴴ * D i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, specNorm (D i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, specNorm ((D i)ᴴ * D i) := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_sum_le s (fun i => (D i)ᴴ * D i)
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ =>
      (specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (D i)).symm)

name: NLAlib.norm_le_of_simplex_tube_vertices
statement:
private theorem norm_le_of_simplex_tube_vertices
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ) (hg : Differentiable ℂ g) {C B : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hB : ∀ z : ι → ℂ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ (z i).re) → ‖g z‖ ≤ B)
    (θ : ι → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i) (hsum : ∑ i, θ i = 1)
    (hvertex : ∀ j, θ j ≠ 0 → ∀ t : ι → ℝ,
      ‖g (fun i => (((Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t i : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖g (fun i => (θ i : ℂ))‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (ι → ℝ) := {a | (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) ∧ ∀ t : ι → ℝ,
    ‖g (fun i => (a i : ℂ) + (t i : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C}
  have hconvex : Convex ℝ S := by
    intro a ha b hb x y hx hy hxy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hx (ha.1 i)) (mul_nonneg hy (hb.1 i))
    · intro t
      let Γ : ℂ → ι → ℂ := fun z i =>
        (1 - z) * (a i : ℂ) + z * (b i : ℂ) + (t i : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let f : ℂ → ℂ := g ∘ Γ
      have hΓ : Differentiable ℂ Γ := by
        dsimp [Γ]
        fun_prop
      have hf : Differentiable ℂ f := hg.comp hΓ
      have hbounded : BddAbove ((norm ∘ f) ''
          Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1) := by
        refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        apply hB
        intro i
        dsimp [Γ]
        simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re,
          Complex.one_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
        exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hz.2) (ha.1 i))
          (mul_nonneg hz.1 (hb.1 i))
      have hleft : ∀ z ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' {(0 : ℝ)}, ‖f z‖ ≤ C := by
        intro z hz
        have hz0 : z.re = 0 := hz
        have he : Γ z = fun i => (a i : ℂ) +
            ((t i + z.im * (b i - a i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          ext i
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Γ, hz0]
          ring
        simpa only [f, Function.comp_apply, he] using
          ha.2 (fun i => t i + z.im * (b i - a i))
      have hright : ∀ z ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' {(1 : ℝ)}, ‖f z‖ ≤ C := by
        intro z hz
        have hz1 : z.re = 1 := hz
        have he : Γ z = fun i => (b i : ℂ) +
            ((t i + z.im * (b i - a i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          ext i
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Γ, hz1]
          ring
        simpa only [f, Function.comp_apply, he] using
          hb.2 (fun i => t i + z.im * (b i - a i))
      have hy1 : y ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have hstrip : (y : ℂ) ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 :=
        ⟨by simpa using hy, by simpa using hy1⟩
      have h := Complex.HadamardThreeLines.norm_le_interp_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip₀₁'
        f hstrip ⟨hf.differentiableOn, hf.continuous.continuousOn⟩ hbounded hleft hright
      have hc : C ^ (1 - y) * C ^ y = C := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg hC (sub_nonneg.mpr hy1) hy]
        simp
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, hc] at h
      have he : Γ (y : ℂ) = fun i =>
          (((x • a + y • b) i : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t i : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        ext i
        have hxa : x = 1 - y := by linarith
        subst x
        simp [Γ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      simpa only [f, Function.comp_apply, he] using h
  let T : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => θ j ≠ 0)
  have hv : ∀ j ∈ T, (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ) ∈ S := by
    intro j hj
    refine ⟨fun i => by simp [Pi.single_apply]; split_ifs <;> norm_num, ?_⟩
    exact hvertex j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
  have hsumT : ∑ j ∈ T, θ j = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j, θ j := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        intro j _ hj
        have hz : θ j = 0 := by simpa [T] using hj
        exact hz
      _ = 1 := hsum
  have hcomb := hconvex.sum_mem (t := T) (w := θ)
    (fun i _ => hθ i) hsumT hv
  have hfull : (∑ j ∈ T, θ j • (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ)) =
      ∑ j, θ j • (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    intro j _ hj
    have hz : θ j = 0 := by simpa [T] using hj
    simp [hz]
  rw [hfull] at hcomb
  have he : (∑ j, θ j • (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ)) = θ := by
    ext i
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  rw [he] at hcomb
  simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using
    hcomb.2 (0 : ι → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.differentiable_schattenSimplexCoefficient
statement:
private theorem differentiable_schattenSimplexCoefficient (p w : ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (schattenSimplexCoefficient p w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold schattenSimplexCoefficient
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenSimplexCoefficient, norm_schattenDualTestCoefficient_of_pos hw]
  congr 1
  simp

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_le_one
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_of_pos hwpos]
    exact Real.rpow_le_one hw.1 hw.2 (mul_nonneg hp hz)
  · simp [schattenSimplexCoefficient, schattenDualTestCoefficient, hwpos]

name: NLAlib.norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_one
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_of_pos hwpos, hz, mul_one]
  · have hwzero : w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    simp [schattenSimplexCoefficient, schattenDualTestCoefficient, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenSimplexCoefficient_center
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwpos : 0 < w
  · rw [schattenSimplexCoefficient, schattenDualTestCoefficient, if_pos hwpos]
    have hpC : (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, Complex.ofReal_one]
    have he : ((0 : ℂ) - (-(p : ℂ) * ((1 / p : ℝ) : ℂ))) / 1 = 1 := by
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [he, one_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log hwpos]
  · have hwzero : w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwpos) hw
    subst w
    simp [schattenSimplexCoefficient, schattenDualTestCoefficient]

name: NLAlib.differentiable_schattenSimplexMatrix
statement:
private theorem differentiable_schattenSimplexMatrix
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) (p : ℝ)
    (w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (schattenSimplexMatrix U V p w)
proof:
:= by
  change Differentiable ℂ (fun z => schattenDualTestMatrix V U 1 0 w (-(p : ℂ) * z))
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.specNorm_schattenSimplexMatrix_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenSimplexMatrix, specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun l =>
    norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_le_one hp (hw l) hz

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_schattenSimplexMatrix_one
statement:
private theorem nuclearNorm_schattenSimplexMatrix_one
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) {w : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ} (hw : ∀ l, 0 ≤ w l)
    (hpower : ∑ l, w l ^ p = 1) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.re = 1) :
    nuclearNorm (schattenSimplexMatrix U V p w z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← schattenNormReal_one, schattenSimplexMatrix,
    schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose hU hV,
    schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
  simp only [Real.rpow_one, one_div_one]
  simp_rw [norm_schattenSimplexCoefficient_one hp (hw _) hz]
  exact hpower

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.schattenSimplexMatrix_center
statement:
private theorem IsSVD.schattenSimplexMatrix_center
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {U V : Matrix n (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ}
    (h : IsSVD A U V) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenSimplexMatrix U V p
      (fun l => singularValues A l / schattenNormReal A p) ((1 / p : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((schattenNormReal A p : ℂ)⁻¹) • A
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun l : Fin (Fintype.card n) =>
      schattenSimplexCoefficient p (singularValues A l / schattenNormReal A p)
        ((1 / p : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ((schattenNormReal A p : ℂ)⁻¹) •
        (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.smul_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [schattenSimplexCoefficient_center hp
        (div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _))]
      push_cast
      exact mul_comm _ _
    · have hv : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun he => hij (Fin.ext he)
      simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hij, Matrix.smul_apply,
        rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hv, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [schattenSimplexMatrix, hd, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, ← h.eq]

name: NLAlib.norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm_of_endpoints
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (F : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => Matrix n n ℂ) ℂ)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hendpoint : ∀ j (M : ι → Matrix n n ℂ),
      ‖F M‖ ≤ C * nuclearNorm (M j) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (M i))
    (p : ι → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hsum : ∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal = 1) (M : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ‖F M‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, schattenNorm (M i) (p i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let θ : ι → ℝ := fun i => ((p i)⁻¹).toReal
  let q : ι → ℝ := fun i => (p i).toReal
  have hq (i : ι) (hi : p i ≠ ∞) : 1 ≤ q i := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_one] using ENNReal.toReal_mono hi (hp i)
  have hq0 (i : ι) (hi : p i ≠ ∞) : 0 < q i := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hq i hi)
  have hθtop (i : ι) (hi : p i = ∞) : θ i = 0 := by simp [θ, hi]
  have hθq (i : ι) : θ i = 1 / q i := by simp [θ, q, ENNReal.toReal_inv, one_div]
  by_cases hzero : ∃ i, M i = 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hzero
    rw [F.map_coord_zero i hi, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => schattenNorm_nonneg _ _)
  have hM : ∀ i, M i ≠ 0 := by simpa using hzero
  choose U V hUV using (fun i => exists_isSVD (M i))
