  let s : ι → ℝ := fun i => schattenNorm (M i) (p i)
  have hsfinite (i : ι) (hi : p i ≠ ∞) : s i = schattenNormReal (M i) (q i) :=
    schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top (M i) hi
  have hstop (i : ι) (hi : p i = ∞) : s i = specNorm (M i) := by
    simp only [s, hi, schattenNorm_top]
  have hs (i : ι) : 0 < s i := by
    by_cases hi : p i = ∞
    · rw [hstop i hi, specNorm_eq_norm]
      exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (hM i)
    · rw [hsfinite i hi]
      exact schattenNormReal_pos (M i) (hq0 i hi) (hM i)
  let w : ι → Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ := fun i l => singularValues (M i) l / s i
  let A : ι → ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i z =>
    if p i = ∞ then ((s i : ℂ)⁻¹) • M i
    else schattenSimplexMatrix (U i) (V i) (q i) (w i) z
  have hw (i : ι) (hi : p i ≠ ∞) (l : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : w i l ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    rw [show w i l = singularValues (M i) l / schattenNormReal (M i) (q i) by
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [hsfinite i hi]]
    exact singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_mem_Icc (M i) (hq0 i hi) (hM i) l
  have hpower (i : ι) (hi : p i ≠ ∞) : ∑ l, w i l ^ q i = 1 := by
    have h := sum_singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_one (M i) (hq0 i hi) (hM i)
    simpa only [min_self, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, w, hsfinite i hi] using h
  have hAnorm (i : ι) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 ≤ z.re) : specNorm (A i z) ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hi : p i = ∞
    · simp only [A, if_pos hi, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv,
        Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hs i).le]
      rw [← specNorm_eq_norm, ← hstop i hi]
      exact (inv_mul_cancel₀ (hs i).ne').le
    · simp only [A, if_neg hi]
      exact specNorm_schattenSimplexMatrix_le_one (hUV i).conjTranspose_mul_left
        (hUV i).conjTranspose_mul_right (hq0 i hi).le (hw i hi) hz
  have hAnuclear (i : ι) (hi : p i ≠ ∞) (z : ℂ) (hz : z.re = 1) :
      nuclearNorm (A i z) = 1 := by
    simp only [A, if_neg hi]
    exact nuclearNorm_schattenSimplexMatrix_one (hUV i).conjTranspose_mul_left
      (hUV i).conjTranspose_mul_right (hq0 i hi) (fun l => (hw i hi l).1)
      (hpower i hi) hz
  let g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ := fun z => F (fun i => A i (z i))
  have hg : Differentiable ℂ g := by
    have hF : Differentiable ℂ F := fun x => (F.hasFDerivAt x).differentiableAt
    apply hF.comp
    apply differentiable_pi.mpr
    intro i
    by_cases hi : p i = ∞
    · simp only [A, if_pos hi]
      exact differentiable_const _
    · simp only [A, if_neg hi]
      exact (differentiable_schattenSimplexMatrix (U i) (V i) (q i) (w i)).comp
        (differentiable_apply i)
  have hB : ∀ z : ι → ℂ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ (z i).re) → ‖g z‖ ≤ ‖F‖ := by
    intro z hz
    simpa only [Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one] using
      F.le_opNorm_mul_prod_of_le (b := fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
        (fun i => by simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using hAnorm i (z i) (hz i))
  have hvertex : ∀ j, θ j ≠ 0 → ∀ t : ι → ℝ,
      ‖g (fun i => (((Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t i : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro j hj t
    have hjfin : p j ≠ ∞ := fun ht => hj (hθtop j ht)
    let X : ι → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i =>
      A i ((((Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : ι → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t i : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hX (i : ι) : specNorm (X i) ≤ 1 := by
      apply hAnorm
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hjn : nuclearNorm (X j) = 1 := by
      apply hAnuclear j hjfin
      simp
    calc
      _ ≤ C * nuclearNorm (X j) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (X i) := hendpoint j X
      _ = C * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (X i) := by rw [hjn, mul_one]
      _ ≤ C * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Finset.prod_le_one (fun i _ => specNorm_nonneg _) (fun i _ => hX i)) hC
      _ = C := mul_one _
  have hcenter := norm_le_of_simplex_tube_vertices g hg hC hB θ
    (fun i => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) hsum hvertex
  have hAcenter (i : ι) : A i (θ i : ℂ) = ((s i : ℂ)⁻¹) • M i := by
    by_cases hi : p i = ∞
    · simp only [A, if_pos hi]
    · simp only [A, if_neg hi, hθq]
      simpa only [w, hsfinite i hi] using (hUV i).schattenSimplexMatrix_center (hq0 i hi)
  have heval : g (fun i => (θ i : ℂ)) = (∏ i, ((s i : ℂ)⁻¹)) • F M := by
    simp only [g, hAcenter]
    exact F.map_smul_univ _ _
  rw [heval, norm_smul, norm_prod] at hcenter
  have hnorm (i : ι) : ‖((s i : ℂ)⁻¹)‖ = (s i)⁻¹ := by
    rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hs i).le]
  simp_rw [hnorm] at hcenter
  rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib] at hcenter
  have hprod : 0 < ∏ i, s i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => hs i
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hprod).mp
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hcenter

name: NLAlib.norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNormReal_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNormReal_of_endpoints
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (F : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => Matrix n n ℂ) ℂ)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hendpoint : ∀ j (M : ι → Matrix n n ℂ),
      ‖F M‖ ≤ C * nuclearNorm (M j) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (M i))
    (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i) (hsum : ∑ i, 1 / p i = 1)
    (M : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ‖F M‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, schattenNormReal (M i) (p i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ p i := le_trans zero_le_one (hp i)
  have hp' (i : ι) : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (p i) := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_one] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hp i)
  have hsum' : ∑ i, ((ENNReal.ofReal (p i))⁻¹).toReal = 1 := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp0 _), one_div] using hsum
  have h := norm_multilinear_le_prod_schattenNorm_of_endpoints F hC hendpoint
    (fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (p i)) hp' hsum' M
  simpa only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ (hp0 _)] using h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_linearMap_mul_le_card_sq_mul_entry_second_moment
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_linearMap_mul_le_card_sq_mul_entry_second_moment
    (S : Matrix d d ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix d d ℂ)
    (D : Ω → Matrix d d ℂ) (hD : AEStronglyMeasurable D μ)
    (hDi : ∀ a b, Integrable (fun x => ‖D x a b‖^2) μ)
    (V : ℝ) (hV : ∀ a b, (∫ x, ‖D x a b‖^2 ∂μ)≤V) :
    specNorm (∫ x, S (D x)*D x ∂μ)≤(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*‖S‖*V
proof:
:= by
  have hFi : Integrable (fun x => frobSq (D x)) μ := by
    simp_rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hDi a b
  have hb (x : Ω) : ‖S (D x)*D x‖≤‖S‖*frobSq (D x) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖S (D x)‖*‖D x‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖S‖*‖D x‖)*‖D x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (S.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖S‖*‖D x‖^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_sq_le_frobSq (D x)) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => S (D x)*D x) μ :=
    (hFi.const_mul ‖S‖).mono'
      ((S.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hD).mul hD) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖S (D x)*D x‖ ∂μ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖S‖*frobSq (D x) ∂μ := integral_mono hi.norm (hFi.const_mul _) hb
    _ = ‖S‖*∑ a, ∑ b, ∫ x, ‖D x a b‖^2 ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      simp_rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hDi a b]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      exact integral_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hDi a b
    _ ≤ ‖S‖*∑ _a : d, ∑ _b : d, V := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hV a b
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenNorm_top {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : schattenNorm A ∞ = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNorm]

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : p ≠ ∞) :
    schattenNorm A p = schattenNormReal A p.toReal
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNorm, hp]

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_ofReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenNorm_ofReal {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    schattenNorm A (ENNReal.ofReal p) = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNorm, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp]

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenNorm_coe {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (p : ℝ≥0) :
    schattenNorm A (p : ℝ≥0∞) = schattenNormReal A (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNorm]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_nonneg
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_nonneg {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (p : ℝ) : 0 ≤ schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p) _

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_nonneg {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (p : ℝ≥0∞) : 0 ≤ schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = ∞
  · subst p
    exact specNorm_nonneg A
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hp]
    exact schattenNormReal_nonneg A _

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_reindex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_reindex {m n r s : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [Fintype s]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq s] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (em : m ≃ r) (en : n ≃ s) (p : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (A.reindex em en) p = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schattenNormReal, singularValues_reindex,
    ← Fintype.card_congr em, ← Fintype.card_congr en]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenNormReal_one {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : schattenNormReal A 1 = nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNormReal, nuclearNorm, kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range]

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenNorm_one {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : schattenNorm A 1 = nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNorm]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_two_fin
statement:
private theorem schattenNormReal_two_fin {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal A 2 = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schattenNormReal, Real.rpow_two, one_div]
  change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card (Fin m)) (Fintype.card (Fin n))),
    singularValues A i ^ 2) ^ ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) = _
  rw [← frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues, ← one_div (2 : ℝ), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_two
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_two {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : schattenNormReal A 2 = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← schattenNormReal_reindex A (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n),
    schattenNormReal_two_fin, frobNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_two
statement:
@[simp] theorem schattenNorm_two {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : schattenNorm A 2 = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp [schattenNorm, schattenNormReal_two]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_orthogonal_mul (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {U : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (p : ℝ) : schattenNormReal (U * A) p = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : singularValues (U * A) = singularValues A := funext <|
    singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq (U * A) A (by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U A,
        hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul])
  simp only [schattenNormReal, hσ]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_orthogonal
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_mul_orthogonal (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {V : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (p : ℝ) : schattenNormReal (A * V) p = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have hVV : V * Vᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 hV.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hσ : singularValues (A * V) = singularValues A := funext <|
    singularValues_eq_of_gram_charpoly_eq (A * V) A (by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm,
        Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hVV, Matrix.mul_one])
  simp only [schattenNormReal, hσ]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (p : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal Aᴴ p = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schattenNormReal, singularValues_conjTranspose, min_comm]

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    schattenNorm Aᴴ p = schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = ∞
  · simp only [hp, schattenNorm_top, specNorm_conjTranspose]
  · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hp, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hp,
      schattenNormReal_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.continuous_bilinearSquareMass_integrand
statement:
private theorem continuous_bilinearSquareMass_integrand (s : Finset ι) :
    Continuous (fun p : (ι → Matrix n n ℂ) ×
        (EuclideanSpace ℂ n × EuclideanSpace ℂ n) =>
      ∑ i ∈ s, ‖star p.2.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (p.1 i *ᵥ p.2.2.ofLp)‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : Continuous (fun p : (ι → Matrix n n ℂ) ×
      (EuclideanSpace ℂ n × EuclideanSpace ℂ n) => p.2.1.ofLp) :=
    (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 (fun _ : n => ℂ)).comp continuous_snd.fst
  have hw : Continuous (fun p : (ι → Matrix n n ℂ) ×
      (EuclideanSpace ℂ n × EuclideanSpace ℂ n) => p.2.2.ofLp) :=
    (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 (fun _ : n => ℂ)).comp continuous_snd.snd
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  exact (hv.star.dotProduct (((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst).matrix_mulVec hw)).norm.pow 2

name: NLAlib.continuous_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem continuous_bilinearSquareMass (s : Finset ι) :
    Continuous (fun D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => bilinearSquareMass D s)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1).prod
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1)).continuous_sSup
      (continuous_bilinearSquareMass_integrand s)

name: NLAlib.measurable_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem measurable_bilinearSquareMass [Fintype ι] (s : Finset ι) :
    Measurable (fun D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => bilinearSquareMass D s)
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  exact (continuous_bilinearSquareMass s).measurable

name: NLAlib.exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq
statement:
theorem exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∃ v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      bilinearSquareMass D s = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1 ×ˢ
      Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1).Nonempty := ⟨(0, 0), by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨v, w⟩, hvw, he⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1).prod
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1)).exists_sSup_image_eq hne
      (((continuous_bilinearSquareMass_integrand s).comp
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).continuousOn)
  exact ⟨v, w, by simpa using hvw.1, by simpa using hvw.2, he⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι)
    (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤ bilinearSquareMass D s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csSup
  · exact (((isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1).prod
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) 1)).image
        ((continuous_bilinearSquareMass_integrand s).comp
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))).bddAbove
  · exact ⟨(v, w), ⟨by simpa using hv, by simpa using hw⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_nonneg (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) :
    0 ≤ bilinearSquareMass D s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq D s
  rw [he]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_le_sum_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_le_sum_specNorm_sq [DecidableEq n] (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) :
    bilinearSquareMass D s ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, specNorm (D i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq D s
  rw [he]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hinner := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) v (WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
  have hmv := (D i).l2_opNorm_mulVec w
  have heq : inner ℂ v (WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)) =
      star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp) := by
    rw [← WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 v, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm]
  rw [heq] at hinner
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)).mpr
  calc _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ := hinner
    _ ≤ ‖v‖ * (specNorm (D i) * ‖w‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmv (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ 1 * (specNorm (D i) * ‖w‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ specNorm (D i) := by
      simpa only [one_mul, mul_one] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (specNorm_nonneg (D i))

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_mono
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_mono (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {s t : Finset ι} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    bilinearSquareMass D s ≤ bilinearSquareMass D t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq D s
  rw [he]
  apply le_trans _ (sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass D t v w hv hw)
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hst
    (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)

name: NLAlib.exists_bilinearSquareMass_erase_gap_le
statement:
theorem exists_bilinearSquareMass_erase_gap_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (D : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ = ∑ i, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∀ i, bilinearSquareMass D Finset.univ - bilinearSquareMass D (Finset.univ.erase i) ≤
        ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq D Finset.univ
  refine ⟨v, w, hv, hw, by simpa using he, fun i => ?_⟩
  have h := sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass D (Finset.univ.erase i) v w hv hw
  have hsum := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
    (fun j => ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D j *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_congr
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_congr {D E : ι → Matrix n n ℂ} (s : Finset ι)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, D i = E i) : bilinearSquareMass D s = bilinearSquareMass E s
proof:
:= by
  unfold bilinearSquareMass
  apply congrArg sSup
  apply Set.image_congr
  intro p _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [h i hi]

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_sub_le
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_sub_le (D E : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (s : Finset ι) :
    bilinearSquareMass (fun i => D i - E i) s ≤
      2 * bilinearSquareMass D s + 2 * bilinearSquareMass E s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq (fun i => D i - E i) s
  rw [he]
  have hpoint (i : ι) :
      ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((D i - E i) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 +
        2 * ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
    have h := norm_sub_le (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
      (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp))
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp) -
      star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp)),
      norm_nonneg (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)),
      norm_nonneg (star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp)),
      sq_nonneg (‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ -
        ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (2 * ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 +
        2 * ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hpoint i
    _ = 2 * (∑ i ∈ s, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (D i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) +
        2 * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (E i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass D s v w hv hw) (by norm_num))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass E s v w hv hw) (by norm_num))

name: NLAlib.specNorm_add_add_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_add_add_le {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B C : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (A + B + C) ≤ specNorm A + specNorm B + specNorm C
proof:
:=
  (specNorm_add_le (A + B) C).trans (add_le_add (specNorm_add_le A B) le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_fiber_compressions_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_fiber_compressions_le
    {𝕜 ι κ : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (label : ι → κ)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, label i ≠ label j → A i j = 0) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hblock : ∀ k, specNorm (A.submatrix
      (fun i : {i // label i = k} => i.val)
      (fun j : {j // label j = k} => j.val)) ≤ c) :
    specNorm A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv label
  let B (k : κ) : Matrix {i // label i = k} {j // label j = k} 𝕜 :=
    A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
  have hrep : A.reindex e.symm e.symm = Matrix.blockDiagonal' B := by
    ext ⟨k, i⟩ ⟨l, j⟩
    by_cases h : k = l
    · subst l
      simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, e, Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv, B]
    · rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne _ _ _ h]
      change A i.val j.val = 0
      apply hzero
      intro hlabel
      exact h (i.property.symm.trans (hlabel.trans j.property))
  calc
    specNorm A = specNorm (A.reindex e.symm e.symm) := (specNorm_reindex _ _ _).symm
    _ = specNorm (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B) := congrArg specNorm hrep
    _ ≤ c := specNorm_blockDiagonal'_le B hc hblock

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_fiber_block_bounds
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_fiber_block_bounds
    {𝕜 ι κ : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (label : ι → κ)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, label i ≠ label j → A i j = 0)
    (B : κ → Matrix ι ι 𝕜)
    (heq : ∀ k i j, label i = k → label j = k → A i j = B k i j)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hB : ∀ k, specNorm (B k) ≤ c) :
    specNorm A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_le_of_fiber_compressions_le A label hzero hc
  intro k
  have hrep : A.submatrix (fun i : {i // label i = k} => i.val)
      (fun j : {j // label j = k} => j.val) =
      (B k).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val := by
    ext i j
    exact heq k i.val j.val i.property j.property
  rw [hrep]
  exact (specNorm_submatrix_le (B k) Subtype.val Subtype.val
    Subtype.val_injective Subtype.val_injective).trans (hB k)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_disjoint_block_bounds
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_disjoint_block_bounds
    {𝕜 ι κ : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (P : κ → ι → Prop)
    (hunique : ∀ i k l, P k i → P l i → k = l)
    (hsupport : ∀ i j, A i j ≠ 0 → ∃ k, P k i ∧ P k j)
    (B : κ → Matrix ι ι 𝕜)
    (heq : ∀ k i j, P k i → P k j → A i j = B k i j)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hB : ∀ k, specNorm (B k) ≤ c) :
    specNorm A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let label (i : ι) : Option κ := if h : ∃ k, P k i then some (Classical.choose h) else none
  have hsome {i : ι} {k : κ} (hi : P k i) : label i = some k := by
    have hex : ∃ l, P l i := ⟨k, hi⟩
    simp only [label, dif_pos hex]
    exact congrArg some (hunique i _ k (Classical.choose_spec hex) hi)
  have hmem {i : ι} {k : κ} (hi : label i = some k) : P k i := by
    dsimp [label] at hi
    split_ifs at hi with h
    exact (Option.some.inj hi) ▸ Classical.choose_spec h
  let B' : Option κ → Matrix ι ι 𝕜 := fun k => k.elim 0 B
  refine specNorm_le_of_fiber_block_bounds A label ?_ B' ?_ hc ?_
  · intro i j hne
    by_contra hij
    obtain ⟨k, hi, hj⟩ := hsupport i j hij
    exact hne ((hsome hi).trans (hsome hj).symm)
  · intro k i j hi hj
    cases k with
    | none =>
        change A i j = 0
        by_contra hij
        obtain ⟨l, hil, _⟩ := hsupport i j hij
        have h := (hsome hil).symm.trans hi
        cases h
    | some k => exact heq k i j (hmem hi) (hmem hj)
  · intro k
    cases k with
    | none => simpa [B', specNorm_zero] using hc
    | some k => exact hB k

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    |u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)| ≤ √(u ⬝ᵥ u) * (specNorm A * √(x ⬝ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm (WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x))
  have hi : inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)) =
      u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]
  rw [hi] at hcs
  calc |u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)| ≤ _ := hcs
    _ ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ *
          (specNorm A * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖) := by
        gcongr
        exact norm_toLp_mulVec_le A x
    _ = _ := by rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, ← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_forall_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_forall_sqrt_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (h : ∀ y : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → √((A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) ≤ K) : specNorm A ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hK fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.toLpLin_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp
  have hxn : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hx
  let y : n → ℝ := ‖x‖⁻¹ • x.ofLp
  have hy : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 := by
    have h1 : √(x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp) = ‖x‖ := (norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct x).symm
    have h2 : x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← h1, Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)]
    simp only [y, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, h2]
    field_simp
  have hAy := h y hy
  rw [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm] at hAy
  have hscale : (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) =
      ‖x‖⁻¹ • (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) := by
    simp only [y, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    rfl
  rw [hscale, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_le_iff₀ hxn] at hAy
  linarith [mul_comm K ‖x‖]

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_abs_quadForm_eq_specNorm
proof:
:= by
  have hH : B.IsHermitian := hB
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm hH.eigenvalues).1
  dsimp only at hi
  let v : n → ℝ := (hH.eigenvectorBasis i).ofLp
  have hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    have hn := hH.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i
    have hs := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) hn
    rw [norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _), one_pow] at hs
    exact hs
  refine ⟨v, by rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, hv, Real.sqrt_one], ?_⟩
  have hBv : B *ᵥ v = hH.eigenvalues i • v := hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
  rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial, hBv, dotProduct_smul, hv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hH,
    ← hi, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_div_of_net
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_div_of_net (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (N : Finset (n → ℝ)) {ε M : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hN : ∀ y : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y) ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ N, √((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤ M) :
    specNorm A ≤ M / (1 - ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := specNorm_nonneg A
  have key : specNorm A ≤ M + specNorm A * ε := by
    refine specNorm_le_of_forall_sqrt_le A (by positivity) fun y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hxN, hxy⟩ := hN y hy
    have hd : √((x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y)) ≤ ε := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hε0]; exact hxy
    rw [sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]
    have hsplit : (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) =
        WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) - WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, ← WithLp.toLp_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [hsplit]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ +
          ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ M + specNorm A * ε := by
        gcongr
        · rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]; exact hM x hxN
        · calc _ ≤ specNorm A * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ :=
                norm_toLp_mulVec_le A _
            _ ≤ specNorm A * ε := by rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm]; gcongr
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_div_of_net_bilinear
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_div_of_net_bilinear (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (N : Finset (n → ℝ))
    (N' : Finset (m → ℝ)) {ε M : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1 / 2) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hN'unit : ∀ y ∈ N', y ⬝ᵥ y = 1)
    (hN : ∀ x : n → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 → ∃ x₀ ∈ N, (x₀ - x) ⬝ᵥ (x₀ - x) ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hN' : ∀ y : m → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ y₀ ∈ N', (y₀ - y) ⬝ᵥ (y₀ - y) ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N', y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) ≤ M) :
    specNorm A ≤ M / (1 - 2 * ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := specNorm_nonneg A
  
  have hpair : ∀ x : n → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 → ∀ y : m → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 →
      y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) ≤ M + 2 * ε * specNorm A := by
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀N, hx₀⟩ := hN x hx
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀N, hy₀⟩ := hN' y hy
    have hdx : √((x₀ - x) ⬝ᵥ (x₀ - x)) ≤ ε := by rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hε0]; exact hx₀
    have hdy : √((y₀ - y) ⬝ᵥ (y₀ - y)) ≤ ε := by rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hε0]; exact hy₀
    have hsplit : y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = y₀ ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x₀) - (y₀ - y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) -
        y₀ ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - x)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub]
      ring
    have h1 := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le A (y₀ - y) x
    have h2 := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le A y₀ (x₀ - x)
    rw [hx, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one] at h1
    rw [hN'unit y₀ hy₀N, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul] at h2
    have h1' : |(y₀ - y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)| ≤ ε * specNorm A :=
      h1.trans (by nlinarith)
    have h2' : |y₀ ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - x))| ≤ ε * specNorm A :=
      h2.trans (by nlinarith)
    rw [hsplit]
    have := hM x₀ hx₀N y₀ hy₀N
    linarith [neg_abs_le ((y₀ - y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)), neg_abs_le (y₀ ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - x)))]
  have key : specNorm A ≤ M + 2 * ε * specNorm A := by
    refine specNorm_le_of_forall_sqrt_le A (by positivity) fun x hx => ?_
    set v := A *ᵥ x
    rcases (dotProduct_self_nonneg v).eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, Real.sqrt_zero]; positivity
    have hs : 0 < √(v ⬝ᵥ v) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos
    let y : m → ℝ := (√(v ⬝ᵥ v))⁻¹ • v
    have hy : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 := by
      simp only [y, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
    have hyv : y ⬝ᵥ v = √(v ⬝ᵥ v) := by
      simp only [y, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_eq_iff hs.ne', Real.mul_self_sqrt hpos.le]
    rw [← hyv]
    exact hpair x hx y hy
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (N : Finset (n → ℝ)) {ε M : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1 / 2) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hNunit : ∀ x ∈ N, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1)
    (hN : ∀ y : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y)‖ ≤ ε)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ N, |quadForm B x| ≤ M) :
    specNorm B ≤ M / (1 - 2 * ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hNunit' : ∀ x ∈ N, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 := fun x hx => by
    rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hNunit x hx, one_pow]
  have hN' : ∀ y : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y) ≤ ε ^ 2 := fun y hy => by
    obtain ⟨x, hxN, hxy⟩ := hN y (by rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, hy, Real.sqrt_one])
    exact ⟨x, hxN, by
      rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hxy 2⟩
  have hBn := specNorm_nonneg B
  have hunit : ∀ y : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → |quadForm B y| ≤ M + 2 * ε * specNorm B := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxN, hxy⟩ := hN' y hy
    have hd : √((x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y)) ≤ ε := by rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hε0]; exact hxy
    have hsplit : quadForm B y = quadForm B x - (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x) - y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (x - y)) := by
      simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_sub, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub]
      ring
    have h1 := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le B (x - y) x
    have h2 := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le B y (x - y)
    rw [hNunit' x hxN, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one] at h1
    rw [hy, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul] at h2
    have h1' : |(x - y) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)| ≤ ε * specNorm B := h1.trans (by nlinarith)
    have h2' : |y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (x - y))| ≤ ε * specNorm B := h2.trans (by nlinarith)
    rw [hsplit]
    have := hM x hxN
    have := abs_sub (quadForm B x - (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) (y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (x - y)))
    have := abs_sub (quadForm B x) ((x - y) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x))
    linarith
  have key : specNorm B ≤ M + 2 * ε * specNorm B := by
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
    · have : B = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [this, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_zero]; positivity
    obtain ⟨v, hv, heig⟩ := exists_unit_abs_quadForm_eq_specNorm hB
    exact heig.symm.le.trans (hunit v (by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hv, one_pow]))
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.card_le_of_separated
statement:
private theorem card_le_of_separated {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (S : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ = 1)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → ε < dist x y) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  set d := Fintype.card ι
  have hfin : Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) = d := finrank_euclideanSpace
  set V := (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) (ball 0 1)
  have hV0 : V ≠ 0 := (measure_ball_pos volume (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) one_pos).ne'
  have hVt : V ≠ ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have hdisj : (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).PairwiseDisjoint fun x => ball x (ε / 2) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    exact ball_disjoint_ball (by linarith [hsep x hx y hy hxy])
  have hsub : (⋃ x ∈ S, ball x (ε / 2)) ⊆ ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (1 + ε / 2) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hz⟩ := hz
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    rw [mem_ball] at hz
    calc ‖z‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + dist z x := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith [norm_le_insert' z x, norm_sub_rev z x]
      _ < 1 + ε / 2 := by rw [hS x hx]; linarith
  have hmeas := measure_mono (μ := (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))) hsub
  rw [measure_biUnion_finset hdisj (fun _ _ => measurableSet_ball)] at hmeas
  simp only [Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε / 2),
    Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ε / 2), hfin,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hmeas
  rw [← mul_assoc] at hmeas
  have h2 := (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left hV0 hVt).1 hmeas
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity)] at h2
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (ε / 2) ^ d := by positivity
  rw [← le_div_iff₀ hpos, ← div_pow] at h2
  calc (S.card : ℝ) ≤ ((1 + ε / 2) / (ε / 2)) ^ d := h2
    _ = (1 + 2 / ε) ^ d := by congr 1; field_simp; ring

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_sphere_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_sphere_net (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset (ι → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ N, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card ι ∧
      ∀ y : ι → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y) ≤ ε ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · refine ⟨∅, by simp, by simp, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    simp [dotProduct] at hy
  
  have hcov : ∃ S : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → ε < dist x y) ∧
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, ‖y‖ = 1 → ∃ x ∈ S, dist x y ≤ ε := by
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    have hall : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ S : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → ε < dist x y) ∧ S.card = k := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp, rfl⟩
      | succ k ih =>
        obtain ⟨S, hS1, hS2, hS3⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := hne S hS1 hS2
        have hyS : y ∉ S := fun hyS => by
          have := hy2 y hyS
          rw [dist_self] at this
          linarith
        refine ⟨insert y S, ?_, ?_, by rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hyS, hS3]⟩
        · intro x hx
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
          · exact hy1
          · exact hS1 x hx
        · intro a ha b hb hab
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 ha with rfl | ha' <;>
            rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hb with rfl | hb'
          · exact absurd rfl hab
          · rw [dist_comm]; exact hy2 b hb'
          · exact hy2 a ha'
          · exact hS2 a ha' b hb' hab
    obtain ⟨S, hS1, hS2, hS3⟩ := hall (⌊(1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card ι⌋₊ + 1)
    have hb := card_le_of_separated S hε hS1 hS2
    rw [hS3] at hb
    have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card ι)
    push_cast at hb
    linarith
  obtain ⟨S, hS1, hS2, hS3⟩ := hcov
  have hnorm : ∀ v : ι → ℝ, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ ^ 2 = v ⬝ᵥ v := by
    intro v
    rw [norm_eq_sqrt_dotProduct, Real.sq_sqrt (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)]
  refine ⟨S.image WithLp.ofLp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hx
    rw [← hnorm, WithLp.toLp_ofLp, hS1 z hz, one_pow]
  · exact (Nat.cast_le.2 Finset.card_image_le).trans (card_le_of_separated S hε hS1 hS2)
  · intro y hy
    have hy1 : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ = 1 := by
      have := hnorm y
      rw [hy] at this
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hS3 _ hy1
    refine ⟨x.ofLp, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx, ?_⟩
    rw [← hnorm, WithLp.toLp_sub, WithLp.toLp_ofLp, ← dist_eq_norm]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg hxy 2

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_net_specNorm_le
statement:
theorem exists_finset_net_specNorm_le (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ε : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ∃ N : Finset (n → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ N, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card n ∧
      ∀ (m : Type*) [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
        (∀ x ∈ N, √((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤ M) → specNorm A ≤ M / (1 - ε)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN1, hN2, hN3⟩ := exists_finset_sphere_net n hε0
  exact ⟨N, hN1, hN2, fun m _ _ A M hM0 hM =>
    specNorm_le_div_of_net A N hε0.le hε1 hM0 hN3 hM⟩

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.matrixValue_add_le
statement:
theorem matrixValue_add_le (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    Φ.matrixValue (A + B) ≤ Φ.matrixValue A + Φ.matrixValue B
proof:
:= by
  have hweak := weaklyMajorized_singularValues_add A B
  have h := Φ.value_le_of_weaklyMajorized (fun i => singularValues_nonneg _ i) hweak
  exact h.trans (map_add_le_add Φ.seminorm
    (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues A i)
    (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues B i))

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.matrixValue_smul
statement: theorem matrixValue_smul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Φ.matrixValue (c • A) = |c| * Φ.matrixValue A
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues (c • A) i) =
      |c| • (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues A i) := by
    funext i
    exact singularValues_smul A c i
  rw [matrixValue, hσ, value, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.eq_zero_of_matrixValue_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_matrixValue_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : Φ.matrixValue A = 0) : A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues A i) = 0 :=
    Φ.eq_zero_of_map_eq_zero _ hA
  apply (nuclearNorm_eq_zero_iff A).mp
  rw [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range]
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues A i)]
  rw [hσ]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.matrixSeminorm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem matrixSeminorm_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : Φ.matrixSeminorm A = Φ.matrixValue A
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SymmetricGauge.toUnitarilyInvariantNorm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toUnitarilyInvariantNorm_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    Φ.toUnitarilyInvariantNorm.seminorm A = Φ.matrixValue A
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_orthonormal {m n k : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {V : Matrix n k 𝕜} (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (A B : Matrix m k 𝕜) :
    frobInner (A * Vᴴ) (B * Vᴴ) = frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobInner_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    frobInner_mul_left_of_orthonormal hV, frobInner_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.trace_conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag
statement:
theorem trace_conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag {m n : ℕ} (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ((rectDiag a : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)ᴴ * rectDiag b).trace =
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), a i * b i : ℝ) : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  have hcols : ((rectDiag a : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)ᴴ * rectDiag b).trace =
      ∑ j : Fin n, if j.val < m then ((a j * b j : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : j.val < m
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨j.val, hj⟩ : Fin m)]
      · simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hj, RCLike.star_def]
      · intro i _ hi
        have hij : i.val ≠ j.val := fun he => hi (Fin.ext he)
        simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hij]
      · simp
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      · simp [hj]
      · intro i _
        have hij : i.val ≠ j.val := fun he => hj (he ▸ i.isLt)
        simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hij]
  rw [hcols, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun j => if j < m then ((a j * b j : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) n, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hfilter : (Finset.range n).filter (fun j => j < m) = Finset.range (min m n) := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, lt_min_iff]
    tauto
  rw [hfilter]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_sum]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_rectDiag_rectDiag
statement:
theorem frobInner_rectDiag_rectDiag {m n : ℕ} (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    frobInner (rectDiag a : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (rectDiag b) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), a i * b i
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, trace_conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  unfold schattenNormReal
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
    (A := U * (rectDiag b : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) * Vᴴ)
    hU hV hb0 hb rfl (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U, h.conjTranspose_mul_left, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (rectDiag (singularValues A))ᴴ (rectDiag b),
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc V, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, h.conjTranspose_mul_right,
    Matrix.one_mul, trace_conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobInner_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, h.trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose,
    RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_left
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_left (A : Matrix m p 𝕜) (X : Matrix p n 𝕜) (Y : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (A * X) Y = frobInner X (Aᴴ * Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_right
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_right (X : Matrix m p 𝕜) (B : Matrix n p 𝕜) (Y : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (X * Bᴴ) Y = frobInner X (Y * B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm B,
    Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_mul_conjTranspose (V : Matrix m p 𝕜) (T : Matrix p q 𝕜)
    (W : Matrix n q 𝕜) (R : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (V * T * Wᴴ) R = frobInner T (Vᴴ * R * W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_mul_right, frobInner_mul_left, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sum_range_singularValues_rpow_eq_of_min_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_singularValues_rpow_eq_of_min_le {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ N) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)), singularValues A i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hN)
  intro i _ hi
  rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by
    simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi), Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ N) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal A p = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_range_singularValues_rpow_eq_of_min_le A hN hp]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul
proof:
:= by
  let N := max (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))
    (max (min (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card q)) (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card q)))
  have hNA : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ N := le_max_left _ _
  have hNB : min (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card q) ≤ N := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hNAB : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card q) ≤ N := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hp := hpsr.left_pos
  have hs := hpsr.right_pos
  have hr := hpsr.pos'
  have hpow := (sum_range_singularValues_mul_rpow_le A B N hr).trans
    (Real.Lr_rpow_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg (Finset.range N) hpsr
      (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i) (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i))
  have hSA : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p)
  have hSB : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues B i ^ s :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) s)
  rw [schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le (A * B) hNAB hr,
    schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le A hNA hp, schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le B hNB hs]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (r / p) *
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues B i ^ s) ^ (r / s)) ^ (1 / r) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) r) hpow (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hSA _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hSB _),
        ← Real.rpow_mul hSA, ← Real.rpow_mul hSB]
      congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> field_simp

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm
statement:
theorem norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) : ‖A.trace‖ ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U,V,h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let Q := Vᴴ * U
  have hQ : Qᴴ * Q = 1 := by
    dsimp [Q]
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [←Matrix.mul_assoc V Vᴴ,h.mul_conjTranspose_right,Matrix.one_mul,h.conjTranspose_mul_left]
  have hspec : specNorm Q ≤ 1 := by
    have hb : specNorm Q ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have heq : specNorm (Qᴴ*Q) = specNorm Q ^ 2 := by
        simpa only [specNorm,pow_two] using Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self Q
      rw [←heq,hQ]
      exact specNorm_one_le
    nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg Q]
  have htrace : A.trace = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), (singularValues A i : 𝕜) * Q i i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [h.eq,Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    change (Q * (rectDiag (singularValues A) : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n))
      (Fin (Fintype.card n)) 𝕜)).trace = _
    simp [Matrix.trace,Matrix.mul_apply,rectDiag_apply_ofReal,Fin.val_inj,mul_comm]
  rw [htrace]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), ‖(singularValues A i : 𝕜) * Q i i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues A i := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [norm_mul,RCLike.norm_ofReal,abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i)]
      have hi : ‖Q i i‖ ≤ 1 := (norm_apply_le_specNorm Q i i).trans hspec
      nlinarith [singularValues_nonneg A i]
    _ = nuclearNorm A := by
      rw [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range,min_self,Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (singularValues A)]

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ‖normalizedTrace A‖ = ‖A.trace‖ / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedTrace,norm_mul,norm_inv,RCLike.norm_natCast,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace_le_nuclearNorm_div_card
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace_le_nuclearNorm_div_card {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    ‖normalizedTrace A‖ ≤ nuclearNorm A / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalizedTrace]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm A) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobInner_eq_sum_mul
statement: theorem frobInner_eq_sum_mul (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobInner A B = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * B i j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.frobInner_eq_sum_re
statement:
theorem frobInner_eq_sum_re (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A B = ∑ i, ∑ j, RCLike.re (star (A i j) * B i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobInner, map_sum]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_comm
statement: theorem frobInner_comm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobInner A B = frobInner B A
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [← RCLike.conj_re (star (B i j) * A i j), ← RCLike.star_def, star_mul, star_star]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_eq_trace
statement:
theorem frobInner_eq_trace (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A B = RCLike.re (Aᴴ * B).trace
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner Matrix.trace
  simp only [Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem frobInner_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A B = RCLike.re (A * Bᴴ).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_add_left
statement:
theorem frobInner_add_left (A B C : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (A + B) C = frobInner A C + frobInner B C
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner
  simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_add_right
statement:
theorem frobInner_add_right (A B C : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A (B + C) = frobInner A B + frobInner A C
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_add_left, frobInner_comm B, frobInner_comm C]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_sub_left
statement:
theorem frobInner_sub_left (A B C : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (A - B) C = frobInner A C - frobInner B C
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner
  simp [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_sub_right
statement:
theorem frobInner_sub_right (A B C : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A (B - C) = frobInner A B - frobInner A C
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_sub_left, frobInner_comm B, frobInner_comm C]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_smul_left
statement:
theorem frobInner_smul_left (c : ℝ) (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (c • A) B = c * frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner
  rw [← RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Matrix.smul_apply, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, star_mul', RCLike.star_def,
    RCLike.conj_ofReal, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_smul_right
statement:
theorem frobInner_smul_right (c : ℝ) (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A (c • B) = c * frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_smul_left, frobInner_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_neg_left
statement: theorem frobInner_neg_left (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobInner (-A) B = -frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner; simp [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_neg_right
statement: theorem frobInner_neg_right (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobInner A (-B) = -frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_neg_left, frobInner_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem frobInner_zero_left (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) B = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner; simp

name: NLAlib.frobInner_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem frobInner_zero_right (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner; simp

name: NLAlib.frobInner_transpose
statement: theorem frobInner_transpose (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobInner Aᵀ Bᵀ = frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobInner
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_conjTranspose
statement: theorem frobInner_conjTranspose (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobInner Aᴴ Bᴴ = frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    frobInner_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq
statement: theorem frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq A = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq frobInner
  simp only [map_sum, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_sq
statement: theorem frobSq_eq_sum_sq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobSq A = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_nonneg
statement: theorem frobSq_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : 0 ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.frobSq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem frobSq_zero : frobSq (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq; simp

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem frobSq_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq A = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
    (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖A i j‖)]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_implies]
  constructor
  · intro h; ext i j
    have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖A i j‖)).1 (h i) j
      (Finset.mem_univ _)
    simpa using this
  · rintro rfl; simp

name: NLAlib.frobSq_neg
statement: theorem frobSq_neg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq (-A) = frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq; rw [frobInner_neg_left, frobInner_neg_right, neg_neg]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_comm
statement: theorem frobSq_sub_comm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq (A - B) = frobSq (B - A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_neg, neg_sub]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_smul
statement: theorem frobSq_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq (c • A) = c ^ 2 * frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq; rw [frobInner_smul_left, frobInner_smul_right]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_smul_eq_norm_sq_mul
statement:
theorem frobSq_smul_eq_norm_sq_mul (c : 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (c • A) = ‖c‖ ^ 2 * frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, mul_pow,
    Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_add
statement:
theorem frobSq_add (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A + B) = frobSq A + 2 * frobInner A B + frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq
  rw [frobInner_add_left, frobInner_add_right, frobInner_add_right, frobInner_comm B A]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A - B) = frobSq A - 2 * frobInner A B + frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobSq
  rw [frobInner_sub_left, frobInner_sub_right, frobInner_sub_right, frobInner_comm B A]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero
statement:
theorem frobSq_add_of_frobInner_eq_zero (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : frobInner A B = 0) :
    frobSq (A + B) = frobSq A + frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_add, h]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_of_frobInner_eq_zero
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_of_frobInner_eq_zero (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : frobInner A B = 0) :
    frobSq (A - B) = frobSq A + frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_sub, h]; ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_transpose
statement: theorem frobSq_transpose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq Aᵀ = frobSq A
proof:
:=
  frobInner_transpose A A

name: NLAlib.frobSq_conjTranspose
statement: theorem frobSq_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobSq Aᴴ = frobSq A
proof:
:=
  frobInner_conjTranspose A A

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem frobNorm_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : 0 ≤ frobNorm A
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sq
statement: theorem frobNorm_sq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm A ^ 2 = frobSq A
proof:
:=
  Real.sq_sqrt (frobSq_nonneg A)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem frobNorm_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm A = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, Real.sqrt_eq_zero (frobSq_nonneg A), frobSq_eq_zero_iff]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem frobNorm_zero : frobNorm (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_transpose
statement: theorem frobNorm_transpose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm Aᵀ = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobSq_transpose, frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_conjTranspose
statement: theorem frobNorm_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm Aᴴ = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobSq_conjTranspose, frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_neg
statement: theorem frobNorm_neg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm (-A) = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobSq_neg, frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_smul
statement: theorem frobNorm_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm (c • A) = |c| * frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobSq_smul, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_smul_eq_norm_mul
statement:
theorem frobNorm_smul_eq_norm_mul (c : 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobNorm (c • A) = ‖c‖ * frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobSq_smul_eq_norm_sq_mul, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _),
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg c), frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_one_sq
statement: theorem frobNorm_one_sq [DecidableEq n] : frobNorm (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) ^ 2 = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  simp [Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite (fun x : 𝕜 => ‖x‖ ^ 2)]

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_diag_sq_le_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_diag_sq_le_frobSq (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (∑ i, ‖A i i‖ ^ 2) ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖A i j‖ ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.sum_diag_sq_le_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_diag_sq_le_frobSq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∑ i, A i i ^ 2) ≤ frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sum_norm_diag_sq_le_frobSq A

name: NLAlib.sum_diag_sq_le_frobNorm_sq
statement:
theorem sum_diag_sq_le_frobNorm_sq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (∑ i, A i i ^ 2) ≤ frobNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm_sq]
  exact sum_diag_sq_le_frobSq A

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_nonneg
statement: theorem dotProduct_self_nonneg (v : n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (v i)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_re_star_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_re_star_dotProduct_self (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A = ∑ i, RCLike.re (star (A i) ⬝ᵥ A i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [frobSq, frobInner, dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_sq
statement:
theorem mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_sq [Fintype m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = ∑ i, (A i ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, sq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self
statement:
theorem star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    star (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = star x ⬝ᵥ ((Aᴴ * A) *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (star x) Aᴴ, Matrix.star_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A = RCLike.re (Aᴴ * A).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_col
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_col (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A = ∑ j, frobSq (A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_diagonal
statement:
theorem frobSq_diagonal [DecidableEq n] (d : n → 𝕜) :
    frobSq (Matrix.diagonal d) = ∑ i, ‖d i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => by simp [Ne.symm hj]) (fun h => (h (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ∑ i, ‖(A *ᵥ x) i‖ ^ 2 ≤ frobSq A * ∑ j, ‖x j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  have h1 : ‖(A *ᵥ x) i‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ * ‖x j‖ := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq (by simp only [norm_mul]))
  calc ‖(A *ᵥ x) i‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j, ‖A i j‖ * ‖x j‖) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    _ ≤ (∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j, ‖x j‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, (A *ᵥ x) i ^ 2 ≤ frobSq A * ∑ j, x j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq A x

name: NLAlib.mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_le_frobSq_mul
statement:
theorem mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_le_frobSq_mul (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (B *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x) ≤ frobSq B * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq B x
  simpa [dotProduct, sq] using h

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm
statement:
theorem frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner A B ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases hA : frobSq A = 0
  · have : A = 0 := (frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).1 hA
    subst this; simp
  · have hApos : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm hA)
    set t := frobInner A B / frobSq A with ht
    have h0 : 0 ≤ frobSq (t • A - B) := frobSq_nonneg _
    rw [frobSq_sub, frobInner_smul_left, frobSq_smul] at h0
    have key : frobInner A B ^ 2 ≤ frobSq A * frobSq B := by
      have : t ^ 2 * frobSq A - 2 * (t * frobInner A B) + frobSq B =
          frobSq B - frobInner A B ^ 2 / frobSq A := by
        rw [ht]; field_simp; ring
      rw [this] at h0
      have := (sub_nonneg.1 h0)
      rwa [div_le_iff₀ hApos, mul_comm] at this
    have hprod : frobNorm A * frobNorm B = Real.sqrt (frobSq A * frobSq B) := by
      unfold frobNorm; rw [Real.sqrt_mul (frobSq_nonneg A)]
    rw [hprod]
    calc frobInner A B ≤ |frobInner A B| := le_abs_self _
      _ = Real.sqrt (frobInner A B ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (frobSq A * frobSq B) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt key

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    |frobInner A B| ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have := frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm (-A) B
    rw [frobInner_neg_left, frobNorm_neg] at this
    linarith
  · exact frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm A B

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_add_le
statement: theorem frobNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm (A + B) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B := add_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg A) (frobNorm_nonneg B)
  rw [frobNorm, Real.sqrt_le_left hs, frobSq_add, add_sq, frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq]
  have := frobInner_le_frobNorm_mul_frobNorm A B
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sub_le
statement: theorem frobNorm_sub_le (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm (A - B) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← frobNorm_neg B]; exact frobNorm_add_le A (-B)

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_mul
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_mul (P : Matrix m p 𝕜) (X : Matrix p n 𝕜)
    (Q : Matrix m p 𝕜) (Y : Matrix p n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (P * X) (Q * Y) = frobInner X (Pᴴ * Q * Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem frobInner_mul_mul_eq_zero {p' : Type*} [Fintype p']
    (P : Matrix m p 𝕜) (X : Matrix p n 𝕜) (Q : Matrix m p' 𝕜) (Y : Matrix p' n 𝕜)
    (h : Pᴴ * Q = 0) : frobInner (P * X) (Q * Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_eq_trace, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Pᴴ, h]
  simp

name: NLAlib.frobInner_mul_left_of_orthonormal
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobInner_mul_mul, hQ, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal [DecidableEq p] {Q : Matrix m p 𝕜}
    (hQ : Qᴴ * Q = 1) (X : Matrix p n 𝕜) : frobSq (Q * X) = frobSq X
proof:
:=
  frobInner_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ X X

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal [DecidableEq p] {V : Matrix n p 𝕜}
    (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1) (X : Matrix m p 𝕜) : frobSq (X * Vᴴ) = frobSq X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hV, frobSq_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq {m n 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    ‖A‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.frobenius_norm_def]
  simp_rw [Real.rpow_two, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_eq_norm
statement: theorem frobNorm_eq_norm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : frobNorm A = ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, ← frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq,
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg A)]

name: NLAlib.norm_left_restriction_le
statement:
private theorem norm_left_restriction_le (v : F) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : d => v (.inl a)) : E)‖ ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  have hm : 0 ≤ ∑ a : d, ‖v (.inr (.inl a))‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hr : 0 ≤ ∑ a : d, ‖v (.inr (.inr a))‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_middle_restriction_le
statement:
private theorem norm_middle_restriction_le (v : F) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : d => v (.inr (.inl a))) : E)‖ ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  have hl : 0 ≤ ∑ a : d, ‖v (.inl a)‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hr : 0 ≤ ∑ a : d, ‖v (.inr (.inr a))‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gramDilation_bilinear_eq
statement:
private theorem gramDilation_bilinear_eq
    (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (v w : F) :
    star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (dilation (gramCoefficientRow A) *ᵥ w.ofLp) =
      (star (fun a : d => v (.inl a)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (fun a => w (.inr (.inl a))))) +
      star (star (fun a : d => w (.inl a)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (fun a => v (.inr (.inl a)))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dilation, gramCoefficientRow, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    Pi.star_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, star_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero,
    add_zero, zero_add, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, star_sum, star_mul, star_star]
  rw [add_comm]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · rfl
  · simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    bilinearSquareMass (gramCoefficientDilation A) Finset.univ ≤
      4 * bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq
    (gramCoefficientDilation A) Finset.univ
  let vL : E := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : d => v (.inl a))
  let vM : E := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : d => v (.inr (.inl a)))
  let wL : E := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : d => w (.inl a))
  let wM : E := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : d => w (.inr (.inl a)))
  have hL := sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ vL wM
    ((norm_left_restriction_le v).trans hv) ((norm_middle_restriction_le w).trans hw)
  have hM := sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ wL vM
    ((norm_left_restriction_le w).trans hw) ((norm_middle_restriction_le v).trans hv)
  have hpoint (i : ι) :
      ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (gramCoefficientDilation A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * ‖star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 +
        2 * ‖star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
    change ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (dilation (gramCoefficientRow (A i)) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
    rw [gramDilation_bilinear_eq]
    change ‖(star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)) +
      star (star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp))‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
    have hn := norm_add_le (star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp))
      (star (star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp)))
    rw [norm_star] at hn
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)) +
        star (star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp))),
      norm_nonneg (star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)),
      norm_nonneg (star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp)),
      sq_nonneg (‖star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)‖ -
        ‖star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp)‖)]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, (2 * ‖star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 +
        2 * ‖star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hpoint i
    _ = 2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, ‖star vL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ wM.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) +
        2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, ‖star wL.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ vM.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_gramCoefficientDilation_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_gramCoefficientDilation_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass (gramCoefficientDilation A) Finset.univ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _), mul_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)]
  norm_num only
  exact bilinearSquareMass_gramCoefficientDilation_le A

name: NLAlib.trace_conjTranspose_mul_reindex
statement:
theorem trace_conjTranspose_mul_reindex (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    ((A.reindex em en)ᴴ * B.reindex em en).trace = (Aᴴ * B).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  calc
    (∑ j : q, ∑ i : p, star (A (em.symm i) (en.symm j)) * B (em.symm i) (en.symm j)) =
        ∑ j : n, ∑ i : p, star (A (em.symm i) j) * B (em.symm i) j :=
      en.symm.sum_comp (fun j => ∑ i : p, star (A (em.symm i) j) * B (em.symm i) j)
    _ = ∑ j : n, ∑ i : m, star (A i j) * B i j :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => em.symm.sum_comp (fun i => star (A i j) * B i j))

name: NLAlib.frobInner_reindex
statement:
theorem frobInner_reindex (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    frobInner (A.reindex em en) (B.reindex em en) = frobInner A B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobInner, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  congr 1
  calc
    (∑ i : p, ∑ j : q, star (A (em.symm i) (en.symm j)) * B (em.symm i) (en.symm j)) =
        ∑ i : m, ∑ j : q, star (A i (en.symm j)) * B i (en.symm j) :=
      em.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ∑ j : q, star (A i (en.symm j)) * B i (en.symm j))
    _ = ∑ i : m, ∑ j : n, star (A i j) * B i j :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => en.symm.sum_comp (fun j => star (A i j) * B i j))

name: NLAlib.frobSq_reindex
statement:
theorem frobSq_reindex (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    frobSq (A.reindex em en) = frobSq A
proof:
:=
  frobInner_reindex A A em en

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_reindex
statement:
theorem frobNorm_reindex (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    frobNorm (A.reindex em en) = frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm, frobNorm, frobSq_reindex]

name: NLAlib.reindex_frame_orth
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
  simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_id_id, Matrix.mul_one] using
    Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜) (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜)
      id em.symm id

name: NLAlib.specNorm_reindex
statement:
theorem specNorm_reindex [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    specNorm (A.reindex em en) = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let P : Matrix p m 𝕜 := (1 : Matrix m m 𝕜).submatrix em.symm id
  let Q : Matrix q n 𝕜 := (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix en.symm id
  have hP : Pᴴ * P = 1 := reindex_frame_orth em
  have hQ : Qᴴ * Q = 1 := reindex_frame_orth en
  have hleft : P * A = A.submatrix em.symm id := by
    simpa only [P, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, Function.id_comp, Function.comp_id] using
      Matrix.one_submatrix_mul em.symm (Equiv.refl m) A
  have hright : (A.submatrix em.symm id) * Qᴴ = A.reindex em en := by
    rw [show Qᴴ = (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜).submatrix id en.symm by
      simp only [Q, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]]
    simpa only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl,
      Function.id_comp, Function.comp_id] using
      Matrix.mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl n) en.symm (A.submatrix em.symm id)
  rw [← hright, ← hleft,
    specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ,
    specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hP]

name: NLAlib.mul_reindex
statement:
theorem mul_reindex {m n p m' n' p' : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype n']
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n p ℝ)
    (em : m ≃ m') (en : n ≃ n') (ep : p ≃ p') :
    (A * B).reindex em ep = A.reindex em en * B.reindex en ep
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]

name: NLAlib.norm_apply_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem norm_apply_le_specNorm {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i : m) (j : n) :
    ‖A i j‖ ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let e : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n := EuclideanSpace.single j 1
  let y : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m := WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec A e.ofLp)
  have hcoord : ‖y i‖ ≤ ‖y‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le y i
  have hop : ‖y‖ ≤ specNorm A * ‖e‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec A e
  calc
    ‖A i j‖ = ‖y i‖ := by simp [y,e]
    _ ≤ ‖y‖ := hcoord
    _ ≤ specNorm A * ‖e‖ := hop
    _ = specNorm A := by simp [e]

name: NLAlib.abs_apply_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_apply_le_specNorm {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (i : m) (j : n) : |A i j| ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_apply_le_specNorm A i j

name: NLAlib.UnitarilyInvariantNorm.value_toSymmetricGaugeFin
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.UnitarilyInvariantNorm.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGaugeFin_singularValues
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hVt : HasOrthonormalCols Vᵀ := by
    change Vᵀᵀ * Vᵀ = 1
    rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact hSVD.mul_conjTranspose_right
  calc
    ν.seminorm A = ν.seminorm (U * rectDiag (singularValues A) * Vᵀ) := congrArg ν.seminorm hSVD.eq
    _ = ν.seminorm (rectDiag (singularValues A)) := by
      rw [ν.right_invariant _ Vᵀ hVt, ν.left_invariant _ U hU]
    _ = _ := by rw [value_toSymmetricGaugeFin, rectangularDiagonal_singularValues_eq_rectDiag]

name: NLAlib.UnitarilyInvariantNorm.reindex_seminorm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindex_seminorm_apply {m n p q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) (A : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    (ν.reindex em en).seminorm A = ν.seminorm (A.reindex em.symm en.symm)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.UnitarilyInvariantNorm.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGauge_matrixValue
statement:
theorem seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGauge_matrixValue {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n) (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ν.seminorm A = ν.toSymmetricGauge.matrixValue A
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  calc
    ν.seminorm A = (ν.reindex em en).seminorm (A.reindex em en) := by
      rw [reindex_seminorm_apply]
      congr 1
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.reindex_apply]
    _ = (ν.reindex em en).toSymmetricGaugeFin.value
        (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues (A.reindex em en) i) :=
      seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGaugeFin_singularValues _ _
    _ = ν.toSymmetricGauge.matrixValue A := by
      apply congrArg (ν.reindex em en).toSymmetricGaugeFin.value
      funext i
      exact congrFun (singularValues_reindex A em en) i

name: NLAlib.UnitarilyInvariantNorm.value_toSymmetricGauge
statement:
theorem UnitarilyInvariantNorm.value_toSymmetricGauge {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n)
    (x : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) → ℝ) :
    ν.toSymmetricGauge.value x = ν.seminorm (rectangularDiagonalMatrix x)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (d : n → ℂ) (p : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (Matrix.diagonal d) p = (∑ i, ‖d i‖^p)^(1/p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun s : Multiset ℝ => (s.map (fun x => x^p)).sum)
    (multiset_singularValues_diagonal_complex d)
  simp only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_map_val] at h
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => singularValues (Matrix.diagonal d) i ^ p)
    (Fintype.card n)] at h
  simpa only [schattenNormReal,min_self] using congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x^(1/p)) h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_diagonal_real {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (d : n → ℝ) (p : ℝ) :
