    schattenNormReal (Matrix.diagonal d) p = (∑ i, |d i|^p)^(1/p)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (Matrix.diagonal d).map Complex.ofReal = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (d i : ℂ)) := by
    simp
  have h := schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex (fun i => (d i : ℂ)) p
  rw [←heq] at h
  have hs (i : ℕ) : singularValues ((Matrix.diagonal d).map Complex.ofReal) i
      = singularValues (Matrix.diagonal d) i :=
    singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (Matrix.diagonal d) i
  simpa only [schattenNormReal,hs,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) : schattenNormReal (A * B) p ≤ schattenNormReal A p * specNorm B
proof:
:= by
  let N := max (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card q))
  have hNA : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ N := le_max_left _ _
  have hNAB : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card q) ≤ N := le_max_right _ _
  have hSA : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p
  have hpow : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues (A * B) i ^ p) ≤
      specNorm B ^ p * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    calc
      _ ≤ (singularValues A i * specNorm B) ^ p :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (singularValues_nonneg _ i)
          (singularValues_mul_le_mul_specNorm A B i) hp.le
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.mul_rpow (singularValues_nonneg _ i) (specNorm_nonneg B)]; ring
  rw [schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le (A * B) hNAB hp,
    schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le A hNA hp]
  calc
    _ ≤ (specNorm B ^ p * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p) hpow (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg B) p) hSA, one_div,
        Real.rpow_rpow_inv (specNorm_nonneg B) hp.ne', mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n q 𝕜)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) : schattenNormReal (A * B) p ≤ specNorm A * schattenNormReal B p
proof:
:= by
  let N := max (min (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card q)) (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card q))
  have hNB : min (Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card q) ≤ N := le_max_left _ _
  have hNAB : min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card q) ≤ N := le_max_right _ _
  have hSB : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues B i ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p
  have hpow : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues (A * B) i ^ p) ≤
      specNorm A ^ p * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues B i ^ p := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    calc
      _ ≤ (specNorm A * singularValues B i) ^ p :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (singularValues_nonneg _ i)
          (singularValues_mul_le_specNorm_mul A B i) hp.le
      _ = _ := Real.mul_rpow (specNorm_nonneg A) (singularValues_nonneg _ i)
  rw [schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le (A * B) hNAB hp,
    schattenNormReal_eq_sum_range_rpow_of_min_le B hNB hp]
  calc
    _ ≤ (specNorm A ^ p * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, singularValues B i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p) hpow (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg A) p) hSB, one_div,
        Real.rpow_rpow_inv (specNorm_nonneg A) hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_mul_le_mul
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_mul_le_mul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n q ℝ)
    {p s r : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderTriple p s r] (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (_hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    schattenNorm (A * B) r ≤ schattenNorm A p * schattenNorm B s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTop : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hr : r = s := ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique ∞ s r s
    subst r
    rw [schattenNorm_top]
    by_cases hsTop : s = ∞
    · subst s
      simp only [schattenNorm_top]
      exact specNorm_mul_le A B
    · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hsTop, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hsTop]
      exact schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul A B (ENNReal.toReal_pos
        (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hs)) hsTop)
  · by_cases hsTop : s = ∞
    · subst s
      have hr : r = p := ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique p ∞ r p
      subst r
      rw [schattenNorm_top, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop,
        schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop]
      exact schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm A B (ENNReal.toReal_pos
        (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpTop)
    · have hp0 := ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpTop
      have hs0 := ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hs)) hsTop
      have hreal := ENNReal.HolderTriple.toReal r hp0 hs0
      have hrTop : r ≠ ∞ := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mp hreal.pos').2.ne
      rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hrTop, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop,
        schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hsTop]
      exact schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul A B hreal

name: NLAlib.abs_frobInner_le_schattenNorm_mul
statement:
theorem abs_frobInner_le_schattenNorm_mul (A B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {p s : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p s] :
    |frobInner A B| ≤ schattenNorm A p * schattenNorm B s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTop : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hs : s = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique ∞ s 1 s).symm
    subst s
    simp only [schattenNorm_top]
    rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ (by simp), ENNReal.toReal_one, schattenNormReal_one]
    exact abs_frobInner_le_specNorm_mul_nuclearNorm A B
  · by_cases hsTop : s = ∞
    · subst s
      have hp : p = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique p ∞ 1 p).symm
      subst p
      simp only [schattenNorm_top]
      rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ (by simp), ENNReal.toReal_one, schattenNormReal_one]
      exact abs_frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_specNorm A B
    · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hsTop]
      exact abs_frobInner_le_schattenNormReal_mul A B
        (ENNReal.HolderConjugate.toReal_of_ne_top hpTop hsTop)

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_matrixRealification_fin
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,V,h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := h.conjTranspose_mul_left
  have hVT : HasOrthonormalCols Vᴴ := by
    rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact h.mul_conjTranspose_right
  have hRVT : HasOrthonormalCols (matrixRealification V)ᵀ := by
    simpa only [matrixRealification_conjTranspose] using hVT.realification
  have hc : schattenNormReal A p = (∑ i : Fin n, singularValues A i ^ p)^(1/p) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
    rw [schattenNormReal_mul_orthogonal _ hVT,
      schattenNormReal_orthogonal_mul _ h.conjTranspose_mul_left,
      rectDiag_square_eq_diagonal,schattenNormReal_diagonal_complex]
    simp only [RCLike.norm_ofReal,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ _)]
  calc
    schattenNormReal (matrixRealification A) p
      = (∑ i : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, |Sum.elim (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i)
          (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) i|^p)^(1/p) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h.eq]
        rw [matrixRealification_mul,matrixRealification_mul,matrixRealification_conjTranspose,
          schattenNormReal_mul_orthogonal _ hRVT,
          schattenNormReal_orthogonal_mul _ hU.realification,
          rectDiag_square_eq_diagonal]
        have hd : matrixRealification (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => (singularValues A i : ℂ)))
            = Matrix.diagonal (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i)
              (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i)) :=
          matrixRealification_diagonal_ofReal (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i)
        change schattenNormReal (matrixRealification
          (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n => (singularValues A i : ℂ)))) p = _
        rw [hd,schattenNormReal_diagonal_real]
    _ = (2 * ∑ i : Fin n, singularValues A i ^ p)^(1/p) := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
        simp only [Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr,abs_of_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ _)]
        congr 1
        ring
    _ = 2^(1/p) * schattenNormReal A p := by
        have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, singularValues A i ^ p :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) p
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hsum,hc]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_matrixRealification
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_matrixRealification {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (p : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (matrixRealification A) p = 2^(1/p) * schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have h := schattenNormReal_matrixRealification_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin n) (Fintype.equivFin n)) p
  rw [matrixRealification_reindex,schattenNormReal_reindex,schattenNormReal_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_conjTranspose_eq_conjTranspose_mul (W : Matrix m n K) :
    frobNorm (W * Wᴴ) = frobNorm (Wᴴ * W)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Matrix.trace ((W * Wᴴ)ᴴ * (W * Wᴴ)) =
      Matrix.trace ((Wᴴ * W)ᴴ * (Wᴴ * W)) := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    calc
      _ = Matrix.trace (W * (Wᴴ * W * Wᴴ)) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace ((Wᴴ * W * Wᴴ) * W) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hs : frobNorm (W * Wᴴ) ^ 2 = frobNorm (Wᴴ * W) ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, ht]
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (W * Wᴴ), frobNorm_nonneg (Wᴴ * W)]

name: NLAlib.cfc_abs_pow_three_le_smul_sq
statement:
theorem cfc_abs_pow_three_le_smul_sq {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {c : ℝ} (hAc : specNorm A ≤ c) :
    cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) A ≤ c • A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_pow_id (R := ℝ) A 2, ← cfc_smul c (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) A]
  refine (cfc_le_iff (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) (fun x : ℝ => c • x ^ 2) A
    (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hA).mpr ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hi : |hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ c := by
    apply le_trans _ hAc
    rw [hA.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues]
    exact norm_le_pi_norm hA.eigenvalues i
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (sq_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i))
  have he : |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ 3 = |hA.eigenvalues i| * hA.eigenvalues i ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_succ, sq_abs, mul_comm]
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, he] using hh

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_pow_three_le_specNorm_mul_re_trace_sq
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_pow_three_le_specNorm_mul_re_trace_sq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    schattenNormReal A 3 ^ 3 ≤ specNorm A * (A ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (3 : ℝ) = (3 : ℕ) by norm_num,
    schattenNormReal_pow_nat_eq_re_trace_cfc_abs hA (by norm_num : 0 < (3 : ℕ)),
    re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA, re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow A hA,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  have hi : |hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ specNorm A := by
    rw [hA.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues]
    exact norm_le_pi_norm hA.eigenvalues i
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (sq_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i))
  have he : |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ 3 = |hA.eigenvalues i| * hA.eigenvalues i ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_succ, sq_abs, mul_comm]
  simpa only [he] using hh

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_eq_sum_rank_rpow
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_eq_sum_rank_rpow (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal A p = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A i ^ p) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold schattenNormReal
  congr 1
  symm
  have hr : A.rank ≤ min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) :=
    le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hr)
  intro i _ hi
  rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (by
    simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi), Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_schattenNormReal
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_schattenNormReal (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    specNorm A ≤ schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : singularValues A 0 = specNorm A := singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm A
  have hsum : specNorm A ^ p ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i ^ p := by
    by_cases hN : 0 < min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
    · rw [← hfirst]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hN)
    · have hs : specNorm A = 0 := by
        rw [← hfirst]
        exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by omega)
      rw [hs, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p)
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg A) p) hsum
    (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)
  rw [one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (specNorm_nonneg A) hp.ne'] at h
  simpa only [schattenNormReal, one_div] using h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_schattenNormReal_of_le
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_le_schattenNormReal_of_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) : schattenNormReal A q ≤ schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:=
  sum_rpow_root_le_sum_rpow_root _ _ (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i) hp hpq

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_schattenNormReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal_eq_sum_rank_rpow A hp,
    schattenNormReal_eq_sum_rank_rpow A (hp.trans_le hpq)]
  simpa only [Finset.card_range] using sum_rpow_root_le_card_rpow_mul (Finset.range A.rank)
    (singularValues A) (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg _ i) hp hpq

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal A p ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal_eq_sum_rank_rpow A hp]
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A i ^ p) ≤
      (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A ^ p := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, specNorm A ^ p :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Real.rpow_le_rpow (singularValues_nonneg _ i)
          (singularValues_le_specNorm A i) hp.le
      _ = _ := by simp
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ i) p) hsum (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg A.rank) (Real.rpow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg A) p),
    one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (specNorm_nonneg A) hp.ne'] at h
  simpa only [one_div] using h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal A p ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  apply (schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm A hp).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (specNorm_nonneg A)
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast Matrix.rank_le_card_width A)
    (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_le_of_le
statement:
theorem schattenNorm_le_of_le (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p q : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) : schattenNorm A q ≤ schattenNorm A p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTop : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hq : q = ∞ := top_le_iff.mp hpq
    subst q
    exact le_rfl
  · have hp0 : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le hp)) hpTop
    by_cases hqTop : q = ∞
    · subst q
      rw [schattenNorm_top, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop]
      exact specNorm_le_schattenNormReal A hp0
    · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hqTop]
      exact schattenNormReal_le_schattenNormReal_of_le A hp0 (ENNReal.toReal_mono hqTop hpq)

name: NLAlib.schattenNorm_le_rank_rpow_mul
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTop : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hq : q = ∞ := top_le_iff.mp hpq
    subst q
    simp
  · have hp0 : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le hp)) hpTop
    by_cases hqTop : q = ∞
    · subst q
      simp only [ENNReal.inv_top, ENNReal.toReal_zero, sub_zero, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
        schattenNorm_top]
      rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop]
      simpa only [one_div] using schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm A hp0
    · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpTop, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hqTop]
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_inv, one_div] using
        schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_schattenNormReal A hp0 (ENNReal.toReal_mono hqTop hpq)

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_of_gram_eq (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (hGram : Aᵀ * A = Bᵀ * B) :
    nuclearNorm A = nuclearNorm B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq A B
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hGram) i

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_gram
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_gram (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm M = (CFC.sqrt (Mᵀ * M)).trace
proof:
:= by
  let Q := CFC.sqrt (Mᵀ * M)
  have hQ : Q.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hQs : Qᵀ = Q := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hQ.isHermitian.eq
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ Mᵀ * M := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self M).nonneg
  have hGram : Mᵀ * M = Qᵀ * Q := by
    rw [hQs]
    exact (CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hNonneg).symm
  rw [nuclearNorm_eq_of_gram_eq M Q hGram, nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef hQ]

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_rowGram
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_rowGram (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm A = (CFC.sqrt (A * Aᵀ)).trace
proof:
:= by
  have h := nuclearNorm_eq_trace_sqrt_gram Aᵀ
  simpa only [nuclearNorm_transpose, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using h

name: NLAlib.hermitian_sq_nonneg
statement: private theorem hermitian_sq_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : 0 ≤ A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hA.eq, pow_two] using (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A).nonneg

name: NLAlib.hermitian_convex_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_nonneg]
  have hn : 0 ≤ (t * (1 - t)) • (A - B) ^ 2 :=
    smul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)) (hermitian_sq_nonneg (hA.sub hB))
  convert hn using 1
  simp only [pow_two, mul_add, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
    mul_sub, sub_mul]
  module

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_one_sub_smul_add_smul_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_one_sub_smul_add_smul_sq_le
    (U V : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hU : ∀ i, (U i).IsHermitian)
    (hV : ∀ i, (V i).IsHermitian) {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    specNorm (∑ i, ((1 - t) • U i + t • V i) ^ 2) ≤
      (1 - t) * specNorm (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + t * specNorm (∑ i, V i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hMix (i : ι) : ((1 - t) • U i + t • V i).IsHermitian :=
    ((hU i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)).add ((hV i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hle : (∑ i, ((1 - t) • U i + t • V i) ^ 2) ≤
      (1 - t) • (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + t • (∑ i, V i ^ 2) := by
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hermitian_convex_sq_le (hU i) (hV i) ht0 ht1
  have hn := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hermitian_sq_nonneg (hMix i))) hle
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(1 - t) • (∑ i, U i ^ 2) + t • (∑ i, V i ^ 2)‖ := hn
    _ ≤ ‖(1 - t) • (∑ i, U i ^ 2)‖ + ‖t • (∑ i, V i ^ 2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1), abs_of_nonneg ht0]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_frobNorm_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem continuousAt_frobNorm_of_entrywise
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => frobNorm (A y)) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobNorm, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  apply Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.comp
  apply tendsto_finsetSum
  intro i _
  apply tendsto_finsetSum
  intro j _
  exact (hA i j).norm.pow 2

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_frobNorm_sub_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem continuousAt_frobNorm_sub_of_entrywise
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => frobNorm (A y - A x)) x
proof:
:=
  continuousAt_frobNorm_of_entrywise (fun i j => (hA i j).sub continuousAt_const)

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_specNorm_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem continuousAt_specNorm_of_entrywise [DecidableEq n]
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => specNorm (A y)) x
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hF : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => frobNorm (A y - A x)) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [sub_self, frobNorm_zero] using (continuousAt_frobNorm_sub_of_entrywise hA).tendsto
  have hsmall := hF.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hε)
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with y hy
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact (abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm (A y) (A x)).trans_lt hy

name: NLAlib.specNorm_fromCols_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_fromCols_sq_le {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m p ℝ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromCols A B) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm A ^ 2 + specNorm B ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows,
    ← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self A, ← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self B,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact specNorm_add_le _ _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_fromRows_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_fromRows_sq_le {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m p ℝ) (B : Matrix n p ℝ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromRows A B) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm A ^ 2 + specNorm B ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_fromCols_sq_le Aᵀ Bᵀ
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_fromRows, specNorm_transpose, specNorm_transpose,
    specNorm_transpose] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_fromRows_zero_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_fromRows_zero_sq {m n p : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    (A : Matrix m p ℝ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromRows A (0 : Matrix n p ℝ)) ^ 2 = specNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Matrix.transpose_fromRows, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows, Matrix.transpose_zero,
    Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    ← specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_fromRows
statement:
theorem frobSq_fromRows {m n p : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p]
    (A : Matrix m p ℝ) (B : Matrix n p ℝ) :
    frobSq (Matrix.fromRows A B) = frobSq A + frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromRows_apply_inl,
    Matrix.fromRows_apply_inr]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_fromCols
statement:
theorem frobSq_fromCols {m n p : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m p ℝ) :
    frobSq (Matrix.fromCols A B) = frobSq A + frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobSq_transpose, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, frobSq_fromRows,
    frobSq_transpose, frobSq_transpose]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_upper_block_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_upper_block_sq_le {p q r : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q] [DecidableEq r]
    (F : Matrix p p ℝ) (T : Matrix p q ℝ) (D : Matrix r q ℝ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks F (F * T) 0 D) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm F ^ 2 * (1 + frobSq T) + frobSq D
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_fromCols_sq_le
    (Matrix.fromRows F (0 : Matrix r p ℝ)) (Matrix.fromRows (F * T) D)
  rw [Matrix.fromCols_fromRows_eq_fromBlocks, specNorm_fromRows_zero_sq] at h
  have hF := specNorm_sq_le_frobSq (Matrix.fromRows (F * T) D)
  rw [frobSq_fromRows] at hF
  have hFT := frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq F T
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_div_card
statement:
theorem re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_div_card (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (L : ℕ) :
    RCLike.re (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs B ^ L)) =
      (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues B i ^ L) /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (Fintype.card n : 𝕜)⁻¹ =
      (((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) := by simp
  rw [normalizedTrace, hc]
  simp only [RCLike.mul_re, RCLike.ofReal_re, RCLike.ofReal_im,
    zero_mul, sub_zero, re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_le_pow_mul_moment_rpow
statement:
theorem re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_le_pow_mul_moment_rpow
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hB : specNorm B ≤ r)
    {k j L : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hkL : k ≤ L) :
    RCLike.re (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs B ^ L)) ≤
      r ^ (L - k) *
        RCLike.re (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs B ^ j)) ^ ((k : ℝ) / j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_div_card]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
    Real.sum_pow_div_card_le_pow_mul_rpow_sum_pow_div_card
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => singularValues B i)
      (fun i => singularValues_nonneg B i) hr
      (fun i => (singularValues_le_specNorm B i).trans hB) hk hkj hkL

name: NLAlib.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul
statement:
theorem re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (p : ℕ) :
    RCLike.re (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs B ^ (2 * p))) =
      RCLike.re (normalizedTrace ((Bᴴ * B) ^ p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul, CFC.abs_sq, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_sum
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_sum (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    nuclearNorm (A - truncatedSVD A k) =
      ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), if k ≤ (i : ℕ) then singularValues A i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U := (exists_isSVD A).choose
  let V := (exists_isSVD A).choose_spec.choose
  have h : IsSVD A U V := (exists_isSVD A).choose_spec.choose_spec
  let D : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal fun i => if (i : ℕ) < k then 0 else singularValues A i
  have hD : (rectDiag (fun i => if i < k then 0 else singularValues A i) :
      Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℝ) = D := by
    ext i j
    simp only [D, rectDiag_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hsplit : A = h.truncatedMatrix k + U * D * Vᴴ := by
    unfold IsSVD.truncatedMatrix
    simpa only [hD] using h.eq_head_add_tail k
  have herr : A - truncatedSVD A k = U * D * Vᴴ := by
    change A - h.truncatedMatrix k = _
    calc
      A - h.truncatedMatrix k =
          (h.truncatedMatrix k + U * D * Vᴴ) - h.truncatedMatrix k :=
        congrArg (fun X => X - h.truncatedMatrix k) hsplit
      _ = U * D * Vᴴ := by abel
  have hDp : D.PosSemidef := Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr fun i => by
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact singularValues_nonneg A i
  have hinv : nuclearNorm (U * D * Vᴴ) = nuclearNorm D := by
    simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using
      schattenNormReal_isometry_mul_mul_conjTranspose h.conjTranspose_mul_left
        h.conjTranspose_mul_right D 1
  rw [herr, hinv, nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef hDp]
  simp only [D, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hik : (i : ℕ) < k
  · simp only [if_pos hik, if_neg (not_le.mpr hik)]
  · simp only [if_neg hik, if_pos (not_lt.mp hik)]

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_sqrt_eq_nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (CFC.sqrt A)ᴴ = CFC.sqrt A :=
    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A)).isHermitian.eq
  have hGram : (CFC.sqrt A)ᴴ * CFC.sqrt A = A := by
    rw [hS, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg]
  have hσ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
      singularValues (CFC.sqrt A) i ^ 2 = singularValues A i := by
    have h := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (CFC.sqrt A) i
    have he := congrFun (eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (CFC.sqrt A)) hA.isHermitian hGram) i
    exact h.trans (he.trans (singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA i).symm)
  rw [bestRankFrobSq, nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_sum,
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if k ≤ i then singularValues (CFC.sqrt A) i ^ 2 else 0)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> simp only [hσ]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_rpow_of_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  change singularValues (A ^ s) (i : ℕ) = _
  rw [CFC.rpow_eq_cfc_real hA.nonneg]
  have hEig (j : Fin (Fintype.card n)) : 0 ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ j := by
    rw [← singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA j]
    exact singularValues_nonneg A j
  have hc : (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) A).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues hA.isHermitian
      (fun j => Real.rpow_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg j) s)
  rw [singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hc,
    eigenvalues₀_cfc_of_antitone (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) hA.isHermitian
      (fun j k hjk => Real.rpow_le_rpow (hEig k) (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone hjk) hs),
    singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_rpow_of_posSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), singularValues (CFC.rpow A s) i ^ p) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), singularValues A i ^ (p * s) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [singularValues_rpow_of_posSemidef hA hs.le ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mp hi⟩,
      ← Real.rpow_mul (singularValues_nonneg A i), mul_comm s p]
  simp only [schattenNormReal, min_self]
  rw [hsum, ← Real.rpow_mul
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) (p * s))]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.singularValues_cfcAbs
statement:
theorem singularValues_cfcAbs (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    singularValues (CFC.abs A) = singularValues A
proof:
:= by
  have hAbs : (CFC.abs A).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.abs_nonneg A)
  apply funext
  intro i
  apply singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq
  rw [hAbs.isHermitian.eq, CFC.abs_mul_abs]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_cfcAbs
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_cfcAbs (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (p : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (CFC.abs A) p = schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schattenNormReal, singularValues_cfcAbs]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_rpow_abs
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_rpow_abs (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) {p r : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) :
    schattenNormReal (CFC.rpow (CFC.abs A) (1 / r)) p =
      schattenNormReal A (p / r) ^ (1 / r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal_rpow_of_posSemidef
    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.abs_nonneg A)) hp (one_div_pos.mpr hr),
    schattenNormReal_cfcAbs, ← div_eq_mul_one_div]

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_mul_three_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
statement:
theorem norm_trace_mul_three_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul (A B C : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ‖(A*B*C).trace‖ ≤ schattenNormReal A 3 * schattenNormReal B 3 * schattenNormReal C 3
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Real.HolderTriple 3 3 (3/2) := by constructor <;> norm_num
  have hq : Real.HolderTriple (3/2) 3 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
  calc
    _ ≤ schattenNormReal (A*B*C) 1 := by
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm (A*B*C)
    _ ≤ schattenNormReal (A*B) (3/2) * schattenNormReal C 3 :=
      schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_complex (A*B) C hq
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_complex A B hp)
      (schattenNormReal_nonneg C 3)

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_word_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
statement:
theorem norm_trace_word_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul (R₀ H₁ R₁ H₂ R₂ H₃ R₃ : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hR₀ : specNorm R₀ ≤ c) (hR₁ : specNorm R₁ ≤ c)
    (hR₂ : specNorm R₂ ≤ c) (hR₃ : specNorm R₃ ≤ c) :
    ‖(R₀*H₁*R₁*H₂*R₂*H₃*R₃).trace‖
      ≤ c^4 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 * schattenNormReal H₂ 3 * schattenNormReal H₃ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : schattenNormReal (R₀*H₁*R₁) 3 ≤ c^2 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal (R₀*H₁) 3 * specNorm R₁ :=
        schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm (R₀*H₁) R₁ (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ (specNorm R₀ * schattenNormReal H₁ 3) * c :=
        mul_le_mul (schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul R₀ H₁ (by norm_num))
          hR₁ (specNorm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _))
      _ ≤ (c * schattenNormReal H₁ 3) * c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR₀ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)) hc
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h₂ : schattenNormReal (H₂*R₂) 3 ≤ c * schattenNormReal H₂ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal H₂ 3 * specNorm R₂ :=
        schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm H₂ R₂ (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal H₂ 3 * c :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR₂ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have h₃ : schattenNormReal (H₃*R₃) 3 ≤ c * schattenNormReal H₃ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal H₃ 3 * specNorm R₃ :=
        schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm H₃ R₃ (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal H₃ 3 * c :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR₃ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have hprod : schattenNormReal (R₀*H₁*R₁) 3 * schattenNormReal (H₂*R₂) 3 *
      schattenNormReal (H₃*R₃) 3 ≤
      (c^2*schattenNormReal H₁ 3) * (c*schattenNormReal H₂ 3) *
      (c*schattenNormReal H₃ 3) := by
    apply mul_le_mul _ h₃ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _))
        (mul_nonneg hc (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)))
    exact mul_le_mul h₁ h₂ (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)
      (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _))
  have htrace := norm_trace_mul_three_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
    (R₀*H₁*R₁) (H₂*R₂) (H₃*R₃)
  have halg : c^2 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 * (c * schattenNormReal H₂ 3) *
      (c * schattenNormReal H₃ 3) =
      c^4 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 * schattenNormReal H₂ 3 * schattenNormReal H₃ 3 := by ring
  have hfin := htrace.trans (hprod.trans_eq halg)
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using hfin

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace_word_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace_word_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
    (R₀ H₁ R₁ H₂ R₂ H₃ R₃ : Matrix n n ℂ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hR₀ : specNorm R₀ ≤ c) (hR₁ : specNorm R₁ ≤ c)
    (hR₂ : specNorm R₂ ≤ c) (hR₃ : specNorm R₃ ≤ c) :
    ‖normalizedTrace (R₀*H₁*R₁*H₂*R₂*H₃*R₃)‖
      ≤ (c^4 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 * schattenNormReal H₂ 3 * schattenNormReal H₃ 3)
        / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalizedTrace]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (norm_trace_word_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul R₀ H₁ R₁ H₂ R₂ H₃ R₃ hc hR₀ hR₁ hR₂ hR₃)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.norm_normalizedTrace_word_pair_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
statement:
theorem norm_normalizedTrace_word_pair_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul
    (H₀ R₀ R₁ H₁ R₂ H₂ R₃ : Matrix n n ℂ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hR₀ : specNorm R₀ ≤ c) (hR₁ : specNorm R₁ ≤ c)
    (hR₂ : specNorm R₂ ≤ c) (hR₃ : specNorm R₃ ≤ c) :
    ‖normalizedTrace (H₀*R₀*R₁*H₁*R₂*H₂*R₃)‖ ≤
      (c^4 * schattenNormReal H₀ 3 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 * schattenNormReal H₂ 3) /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : normalizedTrace (H₀*R₀*R₁*H₁*R₂*H₂*R₃) =
      normalizedTrace (R₁*H₁*R₂*H₂*R₃*H₀*R₀) := by
    calc
      _ = normalizedTrace ((H₀*R₀)*(R₁*H₁*R₂*H₂*R₃)) :=
        congrArg normalizedTrace (by noncomm_ring)
      _ = normalizedTrace ((R₁*H₁*R₂*H₂*R₃)*(H₀*R₀)) := normalizedTrace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = _ := congrArg normalizedTrace (by noncomm_ring)
  calc
    _ = ‖normalizedTrace (R₁*H₁*R₂*H₂*R₃*H₀*R₀)‖ := congrArg norm he
    _ ≤ (c^4 * schattenNormReal H₁ 3 * schattenNormReal H₂ 3 * schattenNormReal H₀ 3) /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
      norm_normalizedTrace_word_le_schattenNormReal_three_mul R₁ H₁ R₂ H₂ R₃ H₀ R₀
        hc hR₁ hR₂ hR₃ hR₀
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_schattenNormReal_finitePartitionMean_rpow_le_integral
statement:
theorem sum_mul_schattenNormReal_finitePartitionMean_rpow_le_integral
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    (cell : Ω → ι) (hcell : Measurable cell)
    {f : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ} (hf : Integrable f μ)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hfm : Integrable (fun ω => schattenNormReal (f ω) p ^ q) μ) :
    (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) *
      schattenNormReal (finitePartitionMean μ cell f i) p ^ q) ≤
        ∫ ω, schattenNormReal (f ω) p ^ q ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] WithComplexSchatten p hp n :=
    WithComplexSchatten.matrixContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  have h := sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_le_integral cell hcell (f := T ∘ f)
    (T.integrable_comp hf) hq (by exact hfm)
  simp_rw [finitePartitionMean_comp_continuousLinearMap cell hf T] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_rpow_root_le_of_finitePartitionMean_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_rpow_root_le_of_finitePartitionMean_le
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) {f : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hf : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hfinite : ∀ (k : ℕ) (cell : Ω → Fin k), Measurable cell →
      (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) *
        schattenNormReal (finitePartitionMean μ cell f i) p ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ C) :
    (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (f ω) p ^ p ∂μ) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] WithComplexSchatten p hp n :=
    WithComplexSchatten.matrixContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hF : MemLp (T ∘ f) (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ := hf.continuousLinearMap_comp T
  have h := integral_norm_rpow_root_le_of_finitePartitionMean_le hp (f := T ∘ f) hF C hC ?_
  · exact h
  · intro k cell hcell
    simp_rw [finitePartitionMean_comp_continuousLinearMap cell
      (hf.integrable (by simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hp)) T]
    exact hfinite k cell hcell

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_sum_rank_singularValues
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_sum_rank_singularValues {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range, Fintype.card_fin]
  change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min m n), singularValues A i) = _
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (le_min A.rank_le_height A.rank_le_width))
  intro i _ hi
  exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hi)

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_nonneg {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) : 0 ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg A i

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_le_rank_mul_specNorm_fin
statement:
private theorem nuclearNorm_le_rank_mul_specNorm_fin {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm A ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_rank_singularValues]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A i) ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, specNorm A :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => singularValues_le_specNorm A i
    _ = (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A := by simp

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_le_nuclearNorm_fin
statement:
private theorem frobNorm_le_nuclearNorm_fin {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    frobNorm A ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hf : frobNorm A ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A i ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_rank_singularValues_sq]
  have hs := Finset.sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg
    (s := Finset.range A.rank) (fun i _ => singularValues_nonneg A i)
  rw [← hf, ← nuclearNorm_eq_sum_rank_singularValues A] at hs
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg A, nuclearNorm_nonneg A]

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_frobNorm_fin
statement:
private theorem nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_frobNorm_fin {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt A.rank * frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hf : frobNorm A ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A i ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_rank_singularValues_sq]
  have hs := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := Finset.range A.rank) (f := singularValues A)
  rw [Finset.card_range, ← nuclearNorm_eq_sum_rank_singularValues A, ← hf] at hs
  have hsq : nuclearNorm A ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt A.rank * frobNorm A) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg A.rank)]
    exact hs
  have hn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt A.rank * frobNorm A := mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg A)
  nlinarith [nuclearNorm_nonneg A]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one_fin
proof:
:= by
  exact frobInner_le_kyFanNorm_of_rank_le_of_specNorm_le_one A B
    (by simpa using le_min B.rank_le_height B.rank_le_width) hB

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_reindex
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_reindex {m n p q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    nuclearNorm (A.reindex em en) = nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nuclearNorm, kyFanNorm_reindex, ← Fintype.card_congr em, ← Fintype.card_congr en]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_le_nuclearNorm
statement: theorem frobNorm_le_nuclearNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : frobNorm A ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobNorm_le_nuclearNorm_fin (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
  rwa [frobNorm_reindex, nuclearNorm_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_nuclearNorm
statement: theorem specNorm_le_nuclearNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : specNorm A ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:=
  (specNorm_le_frobNorm A).trans (frobNorm_le_nuclearNorm A)

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_le_rank_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_le_rank_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm A ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h := nuclearNorm_le_rank_mul_specNorm_fin (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
  rwa [nuclearNorm_reindex, Matrix.rank_reindex, specNorm_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_frobNorm
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_frobNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt A.rank * frobNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have h := nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_frobNorm_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n))
  rwa [nuclearNorm_reindex, Matrix.rank_reindex, frobNorm_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    nuclearNorm (A + B) ≤ nuclearNorm A + nuclearNorm B
proof: := kyFanNorm_add_le A B _

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_smul
statement: theorem nuclearNorm_smul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ) : nuclearNorm (c • A) = |c| * nuclearNorm A
proof:
:=
  kyFanNorm_smul A c _

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem nuclearNorm_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : nuclearNorm A = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hn : specNorm A = 0 := le_antisymm (by simpa [h] using specNorm_le_nuclearNorm A)
      (specNorm_nonneg A)
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hn)
  · rintro rfl
    exact kyFanNorm_zero_matrix _

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_orthogonal_mul
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_orthogonal_mul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {U : Matrix m m ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) : nuclearNorm (U * A) = nuclearNorm A
proof: := kyFanNorm_orthogonal_mul A hU _

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_mul_orthogonal
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_mul_orthogonal (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {V : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) : nuclearNorm (A * V) = nuclearNorm A
proof: := kyFanNorm_mul_orthogonal A hV _

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_transpose
statement: theorem nuclearNorm_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : nuclearNorm Aᵀ = nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuclearNorm, nuclearNorm, kyFanNorm_transpose, min_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one
statement:
theorem frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) (hB : specNorm B ≤ 1) :
    frobInner A B ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  have hBn : specNorm (B.reindex em en) ≤ 1 := by rwa [specNorm_reindex]
  have h := frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one_fin (A.reindex em en) (B.reindex em en) hBn
  rwa [frobInner_reindex, nuclearNorm_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.exists_specNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm
statement:
theorem exists_specNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm B ≤ 1 ∧ frobInner A B = nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, htrace⟩ := exists_trace_twoSided_compression_eq_kyFanNorm A le_rfl
  refine ⟨U * Vᵀ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change specNorm (U * Vᴴ) ≤ 1
    rw [specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV]
    exact specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU
  · rw [frobInner_comm, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      ← Matrix.trace_mul_cycle Uᵀ A V]
    simpa only [nuclearNorm] using htrace

name: NLAlib.isGreatest_nuclearNorm_frobInner
statement:
theorem isGreatest_nuclearNorm_frobInner (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    IsGreatest {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Matrix m n ℝ, specNorm B ≤ 1 ∧ frobInner A B = z} (nuclearNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_specNorm_le_one_frobInner_eq_nuclearNorm A, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
  exact frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_specNorm_le_one A B hB

name: NLAlib.nuclearSeminorm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem nuclearSeminorm_apply (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : nuclearSeminorm A = nuclearNorm A
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.specNorm_real_smul
statement:
theorem specNorm_real_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (c•A)=|c| * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜), specNorm_eq_norm,
    norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_smul_le_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_smul_le_one {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {S : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S) : specNorm (S⁻¹•A) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_real_smul, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hS.le)]
  calc
    _ ≤ S⁻¹*S := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (inv_nonneg.mpr hS.le)
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hS.ne'

name: NLAlib.cfcAbs_pow_of_commute_conjTranspose
statement:
private theorem cfcAbs_pow_of_commute_conjTranspose {B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hB : Commute B Bᴴ) (a : ℕ) : CFC.abs (B ^ a) = CFC.abs B ^ a
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, CFC.abs_one]
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, (Commute.pow_self B a).cfcAbs_mul_eq
      (by simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hB.pow_left a), ih, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.cfcAbs_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : Commute Bᴴ (Bᴴ)ᴴ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hB.symm
  have hnormal : IsStarNormal B := ⟨by simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hB.symm⟩
  have hAbsStar : CFC.abs Bᴴ = CFC.abs B := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using CFC.abs_star B hnormal
  have hcross : Commute (B ^ a) (star (Bᴴ ^ b)) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_pow,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using Commute.pow_pow_self B a b
  rw [(hB.pow_pow a b).cfcAbs_mul_eq hcross,
    cfcAbs_pow_of_commute_conjTranspose hB a,
    cfcAbs_pow_of_commute_conjTranspose hstar b, hAbsStar, ← pow_add]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (CFC.abs B).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.abs_nonneg B)
  have hp := singularValues_rpow_of_posSemidef hP
    (s := ((a + b : ℕ) : ℝ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) i
  change singularValues ((CFC.abs B) ^ ((a + b : ℕ) : ℝ)) i = _ at hp
  rw [CFC.rpow_natCast (CFC.abs B) (a + b) (CFC.abs_nonneg B)] at hp
  calc
    _ = singularValues (CFC.abs (B ^ a * Bᴴ ^ b)) i :=
      (congrFun (singularValues_cfcAbs (B ^ a * Bᴴ ^ b)) i).symm
    _ = singularValues (CFC.abs B ^ (a + b)) i := by
      rw [cfcAbs_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow hB]
    _ = _ := by simpa only [singularValues_cfcAbs, Real.rpow_natCast] using hp

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum {B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hB : Commute B Bᴴ) (a b : ℕ) (q : ℝ) :
    schattenNormReal (B ^ a * Bᴴ ^ b) q =
      (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n),
        singularValues B i ^ (((a + b : ℕ) : ℝ) * q)) ^ (1 / q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schattenNormReal, min_self, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [singularValues_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow hB a b i,
    ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (singularValues_nonneg B i)]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues
statement:
theorem re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (L : ℕ) :
    RCLike.re (CFC.abs B ^ L).trace =
      ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues B i ^ L
proof:
:= by
  let P := CFC.abs B
  have hP : P.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.abs_nonneg B)
  have htrace : RCLike.re (P ^ L).trace = ∑ i : n, hP.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ L := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hP.isHermitian.spectral_theorem]
    rw [← map_pow, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
      Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
    simp only [map_sum, Pi.pow_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  rw [htrace]
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  rw [← e.sum_comp (fun i : n => hP.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ^ L)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [← singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hP i]
  simp only [P, singularValues_cfcAbs]

name: NLAlib.prod_schattenNormReal_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow
statement:
theorem prod_schattenNormReal_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : Commute B Bᴴ)
    (a b : ι → ℕ) {L : ℕ} (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L)
    (hLpos : 0 < L) (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) :
    (∏ j, schattenNormReal (B ^ a j * Bᴴ ^ b j)
      ((L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ))) = RCLike.re (CFC.abs B ^ L).trace
proof:
:= by
  let T : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), singularValues B i ^ (L : ℝ)
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg B i) _
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hLpos
  have hs0 (j : ι) : (0 : ℝ) < (a j + b j : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hArc j
  have hsSum : ∑ j, ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) = (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hfactor (j : ι) :
      schattenNormReal (B ^ a j * Bᴴ ^ b j) ((L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ)) =
        T ^ (((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / L) := by
    rw [schattenNormReal_mul_pow_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum hB]
    have hexp : ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ)) = L := by
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ (L : ℝ) (hs0 j).ne'
    have hinv : 1 / ((L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ)) = ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / L := by
      rw [one_div_div]
    rw [hexp, hinv]
  have hweights : ∑ j, ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / L = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, hsSum, div_self hL0.ne']
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_nonneg hT (fun j _ => div_nonneg (hs0 j).le hL0.le),
    hweights, Real.rpow_one, re_trace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_singularValues]
  simp only [T, Real.rpow_natCast]

name: NLAlib.prod_schattenNorm_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow
statement:
theorem prod_schattenNorm_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow
    {𝕜 n ι : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype ι]
    {B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : Commute B Bᴴ) (a b : ι → ℕ) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L) (hLpos : 0 < L)
    (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) :
    (∏ j, schattenNorm (B ^ a j * Bᴴ ^ b j)
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ)))) =
      RCLike.re (CFC.abs B ^ L).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 (j : ι) : 0 ≤ (L : ℝ) / (a j + b j : ℕ) :=
    div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  simpa only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ (hp0 _)] using
    prod_schattenNormReal_mixed_powers_eq_re_trace_cfcAbs_pow hB a b hL hLpos hArc

name: NLAlib.specNorm_fromBlocks_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem specNorm_fromBlocks_conjTranspose (Z : Matrix l k 𝕜) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Zᴴ Z 0) = specNorm Z
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa only [specNorm_conjTranspose, max_self] using
      specNorm_fromBlocks_offDiagonal_le Zᴴ Z
  · apply specNorm_le_of_sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le (specNorm_nonneg _)
    intro x
    have h := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Zᴴ Z 0)
      (Sum.elim x (0 : l → 𝕜))
    simpa only [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Matrix.zero_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_zero,
      Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      Pi.zero_apply, ← Pi.zero_def, Matrix.mulVec_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0),
      Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.rank_fromBlocks_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem rank_fromBlocks_conjTranspose (Z : Matrix l k 𝕜) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Zᴴ Z 0).rank = 2 * Z.rank
proof:
:= by
  have he : (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Zᴴ Z 0).reindex (Equiv.refl (k ⊕ l))
      (Equiv.sumComm k l) = Matrix.fromBlocks Zᴴ 0 0 Z := by
    ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> rfl
  rw [← Matrix.rank_reindex (Equiv.refl (k ⊕ l)) (Equiv.sumComm k l), he,
    rank_fromBlocks_zero_zero_eq, Matrix.rank_conjTranspose]
  omega

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_mul_conjTranspose_of_hasOrthonormalCols
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)
  · have he : Vᴴ * (V * D * Vᴴ) * V = D := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V, hV.conjTranspose_mul_self,
        Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    calc D.rank = (Vᴴ * (V * D * Vᴴ) * V).rank := congrArg Matrix.rank he.symm
         _ ≤ (Vᴴ * (V * D * Vᴴ)).rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _
         _ ≤ (V * D * Vᴴ).rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_fromCols_of_orthogonal
proof:
:= by
  have hUV : Uᴴ * V = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hVU
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using h
  change (Matrix.fromCols V U)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols V U = 1
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_fromCols_eq_fromRows_conjTranspose, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols, hV.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, hVU, hUV, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalCoupling_eq_fromCols
statement:
theorem orthogonalCoupling_eq_fromCols (V : Matrix n k 𝕜) (U : Matrix n l 𝕜)
    (Z : Matrix l k 𝕜) :
    U * Z * Vᴴ + V * Zᴴ * Uᴴ = Matrix.fromCols V U *
      Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Zᴴ Z 0 * (Matrix.fromCols V U)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks, Matrix.conjTranspose_fromCols_eq_fromRows_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows, Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.norms_and_rank_orthogonalCoupling
statement:
theorem norms_and_rank_orthogonalCoupling {V : Matrix n k 𝕜} {U : Matrix n l 𝕜}
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hVU : Vᴴ * U = 0)
    (Z : Matrix l k 𝕜) :
    frobSq (U * Z * Vᴴ + V * Zᴴ * Uᴴ) = 2 * frobSq Z ∧
      specNorm (U * Z * Vᴴ + V * Zᴴ * Uᴴ) = specNorm Z ∧
      (U * Z * Vᴴ + V * Zᴴ * Uᴴ).rank = 2 * Z.rank
proof:
:= by
  have hW := hasOrthonormalCols_fromCols_of_orthogonal hV hU hVU
  rw [orthogonalCoupling_eq_fromCols]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hW.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hW.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      frobSq_fromBlocks, frobSq_conjTranspose]
    simp only [frobSq_zero]
    ring
  · rw [specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hW,
      specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hW, specNorm_fromBlocks_conjTranspose]
  · rw [rank_mul_mul_conjTranspose_of_hasOrthonormalCols hW, rank_fromBlocks_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.norm_coefficient_bilinear_real_smul
statement:
private theorem norm_coefficient_bilinear_real_smul
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (v w : E) (a b : ℝ) :
    ‖star (a • v).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (b • w).ofLp)‖ =
      |a| * |b| * ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_smul, Matrix.mulVec_smul, star_smul, star_trivial,
    smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.bilinearSquareMass_le_of_unitSphere
statement:
theorem bilinearSquareMass_le_of_unitSphere
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h : ∀ v w : E, ‖v‖ = 1 → ‖w‖ = 1 →
      (∑ i, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) ≤ B) :
    bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq A Finset.univ
  rw [he]
  by_cases hv0 : v = 0
  · simpa only [hv0, WithLp.ofLp_zero, star_zero, zero_dotProduct, norm_zero,
      zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero] using hB
  by_cases hw0 : w = 0
  · simpa only [hw0, WithLp.ofLp_zero, Matrix.mulVec_zero, dotProduct_zero, norm_zero,
      zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero] using hB
  let v' := NormedSpace.normalize v
  let w' := NormedSpace.normalize w
  have hs : (‖v‖ * ‖w‖) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by positivity)
    (by simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul hv hw (norm_nonneg w) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1))
  have hscale (i : ι) : ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 =
      (‖v‖ * ‖w‖) ^ 2 * ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hi := norm_coefficient_bilinear_real_smul (A i) v' w' ‖v‖ ‖w‖
    simp only [v', w', NormedSpace.norm_smul_normalize, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at hi
    rw [hi]
    ring
  calc
    _ = (‖v‖ * ‖w‖) ^ 2 * ∑ i, ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp_rw [hscale]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_left (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) hs
    _ ≤ B := h v' w' (NormedSpace.norm_normalize hv0) (NormedSpace.norm_normalize hw0)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_eq_sSup_unitSphere
statement:
theorem sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_eq_sSup_unitSphere [Nonempty n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) =
      sSup ((fun q : E × E => Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖ ^ 2)) ''
        {q | ‖q.1‖ = 1 ∧ ‖q.2‖ = 1})
proof:
:= by
  let S := ((fun q : E × E => Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A i *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖ ^ 2)) ''
    {q | ‖q.1‖ = 1 ∧ ‖q.2‖ = 1})
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_norm_eq E (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
    exact ⟨_, ⟨(v, v), ⟨hv, hv⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  have hLUB : IsLUB S (Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)) := by
    constructor
    · rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
        q.1 q.2 hq.1.le hq.2.le)
    · intro B hB
      have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hSne
        have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
          rcases hr with ⟨q, _, rfl⟩
          exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        exact hr0.trans (hB hr)
      apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨hB0, ?_⟩
      apply bilinearSquareMass_le_of_unitSphere A (sq_nonneg B)
      intro v w hv hw
      exact (Real.sqrt_le_iff.mp (hB ⟨(v, w), ⟨hv, hw⟩, rfl⟩)).2
  exact (hLUB.csSup_eq hSne).symm

name: NLAlib.sum_re_quadForm_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem sum_re_quadForm_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (u : n → ℂ) (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
    (∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2) ≤ bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans _ (sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
    (WithLp.toLp 2 u) (WithLp.toLp 2 u) hu.le hu.le)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  simpa only [quadForm, WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using
    (show (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ ‖quadForm (A i) u‖ ^ 2 by
      nlinarith [Complex.sq_norm_sub_sq_re (quadForm (A i) u), sq_nonneg (quadForm (A i) u).im])

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_sub_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_sub_le (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    {U V : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    frobNorm (Uᴴ * A * U - Vᴴ * A * V) ≤ 2 * specNorm A * frobNorm (U - V)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Uᴴ * A * U - Vᴴ * A * V =
      Uᴴ * (A * (U - V)) + (U - V)ᴴ * (A * V) := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
    abel
  have hUt : specNorm Uᴴ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
    exact specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU
  have hAv : specNorm (A * V) ≤ specNorm A := by
    exact (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (by
      nlinarith [specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hV, specNorm_nonneg A])
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ frobNorm (Uᴴ * (A * (U - V))) + frobNorm ((U - V)ᴴ * (A * V)) := frobNorm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ specNorm Uᴴ * frobNorm (A * (U - V)) + frobNorm (U - V)ᴴ * specNorm (A * V) :=
      add_le_add (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm _ _) (frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _)
    _ ≤ frobNorm (A * (U - V)) + frobNorm (U - V) * specNorm A := by
      rw [frobNorm_conjTranspose]
      exact add_le_add (by nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (A * (U - V))])
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAv (frobNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ _ := by
      nlinarith [frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm A (U - V)]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_pow_nat_eq_re_trace_cfc_gram
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_pow_nat_eq_re_trace_cfc_gram (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    schattenNormReal A (k : ℝ)^k =
      RCLike.re (cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)^k) (Aᴴ*A)).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i ^ (k : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) _
  rw [schattenNormReal,←Real.rpow_natCast,one_div,Real.rpow_inv_rpow hsum hp.ne',
    re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A),
    sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues A (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)^k)]
  simp only [Real.sqrt_sq (singularValues_nonneg _ _),Real.rpow_natCast]
  symm
  exact sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A (fun x => x^k)
    (by simp [hk.ne']) (min_le_right _ _)

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_pow_nat_eq_re_trace_cfc_abs
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_pow_nat_eq_re_trace_cfc_abs {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    schattenNormReal A (k : ℝ)^k =
      RCLike.re (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x|^k) A).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal_pow_nat_eq_re_trace_cfc_gram A hk,hA.eq,←pow_two]
  have heq : cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (x^2))^k) A =
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)^k) (A^2) :=
    cfc_comp_pow (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)^k) 2 A (by fun_prop) hA
  calc
    _ = RCLike.re (cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (x^2))^k) A).trace :=
      congrArg (fun B : Matrix n n 𝕜 => RCLike.re B.trace) heq.symm
    _ = _ := by simp only [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_replicateCol
statement:
theorem specNorm_sq_replicateCol {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (v : n → 𝕜) :
    specNorm (Matrix.replicateCol Unit v) ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (Matrix.replicateCol Unit v)ᴴ * Matrix.replicateCol Unit v =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Unit => (‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ : 𝕜) ^ 2) := by
    ext i j
    cases i
    cases j
    have hinner := inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K (𝕜 := 𝕜) (WithLp.toLp 2 v)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm] at hinner
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct] using hinner
  rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, hG, specNorm_eq_norm,
    Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  simp only [pi_norm_const, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_rank_singularValues_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_rank_singularValues_sq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq_singularValues]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · exact Finset.range_mono (le_min A.rank_le_card_height A.rank_le_card_width)
  · intro k _ hk
    rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] using hk)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.frobSq_le_rank_mul_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_le_rank_mul_specNorm_sq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq A ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    frobSq A = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range A.rank, singularValues A k ^ 2 :=
      frobSq_eq_sum_rank_singularValues_sq A
    _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range A.rank, specNorm A ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => pow_le_pow_left₀
        (singularValues_nonneg A k) (singularValues_le_specNorm A k) 2)
    _ = (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A ^ 2 := by simp

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_specNorm
statement:
theorem frobNorm_le_sqrt_rank_mul_specNorm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt (A.rank : ℝ) * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (frobNorm_nonneg A)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg A))).mp
  rw [frobNorm_sq, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg A.rank)]
  exact frobSq_le_rank_mul_specNorm_sq A

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inverse_rectDiag_sq
statement:
private theorem specNorm_inverse_rectDiag_sq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (rectDiag (fun k => (singularValues A k)⁻¹) :
        Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card m)) 𝕜) ^ 2 =
      ‖(fun i : Fin (Fintype.card m) => (singularValues A i)⁻¹ ^ 2)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
  have he : (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card m) =>
      if (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card n then (((singularValues A i)⁻¹ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) =
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card m) => (((singularValues A i)⁻¹ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hin : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card n
    · simp only [if_pos hin]
    · rw [if_neg hin, singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A (not_lt.mp hin)]
      simp
  rw [he, specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  simp only [Pi.norm_def]
  congr 2
  funext i
  ext
  simp only [coe_nnnorm, RCLike.norm_ofReal, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive
statement:
theorem specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hr : 0 < A.rank) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) = 1 / singularValues A (A.rank - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let r := A.rank - 1
  have hrrank : r < A.rank := by dsimp [r]; omega
  have hrm : r < Fintype.card m := lt_of_lt_of_le hrrank A.rank_le_card_height
  have hs : 0 < singularValues A r := (singularValues_pos_iff A r).mpr hrrank
  have hmax : ‖(fun i : Fin (Fintype.card m) => (singularValues A i)⁻¹ ^ 2)‖ =
      (singularValues A r)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)).mpr
      intro i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      by_cases hir : (i : ℕ) < A.rank
      · have hir' : (i : ℕ) ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; omega
        have hsi := singularValues_antitone A hir'
        have hiinv : (singularValues A i)⁻¹ ≤ (singularValues A r)⁻¹ := by
          simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hs hsi
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr (singularValues_nonneg A i)) hiinv 2
      · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (not_lt.mp hir), inv_zero, zero_pow (by decide)]
        exact sq_nonneg _
    · have hlower := norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card m) => (singularValues A i)⁻¹ ^ 2) ⟨r, hrm⟩
      change ‖(singularValues A r)⁻¹ ^ 2‖ ≤
        ‖(fun i : Fin (Fintype.card m) => (singularValues A i)⁻¹ ^ 2)‖ at hlower
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ((singularValues A r)⁻¹))] at hlower
      exact hlower
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  have hn : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) =
      specNorm (rectDiag (fun k => (singularValues A k)⁻¹) :
        Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card m)) 𝕜) := by
    rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_svd hSVD,
      specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_left,
      specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hSVD.conjTranspose_mul_right]
  have hsq : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 = (singularValues A r)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hn, specNorm_inverse_rectDiag_sq, hmax]
  have he := (sq_eq_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg (moorePenroseInverse A))
    (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le)).mp hsq
  simpa only [r, one_div] using he

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_of_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_of_rank_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hr : A.rank = 0) :
    moorePenroseInverse A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : ∀ k : ℕ, singularValues A k = 0 := fun k =>
    singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A (by rw [hr]; exact Nat.zero_le k)
  obtain ⟨U, V, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_svd hSVD]
  have hd : (rectDiag (fun k => (singularValues A k)⁻¹) :
      Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card m)) 𝕜) = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simp [rectDiag_apply_ofReal, hσ]
  rw [hd, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : A.rank = 0
  · rw [if_pos hr, moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_of_rank_eq_zero A hr]
    exact specNorm_zero
  · rw [if_neg hr]
    exact specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_singularValues_last_positive A
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    specNorm A ≤ ε ↔ ∀ x : n → ℝ, |x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)| ≤ ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    exact (abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm A x).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (dotProduct_self_nonneg x))
  · intro hquad
    let T : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n :=
      Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A
    have hT : (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n).IsSymmetric := by
      change (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).IsSymmetric
      exact Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA
    change ‖T‖ ≤ ε
    rw [T.norm_eq_iSup_rayleighQuotient hT]
    apply ciSup_le
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · simpa [hx] using hε
    · have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient,
        ContinuousLinearMap.reApplyInnerSelf_apply, abs_div,
        abs_of_nonneg hxpos.le]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hxpos).2
      have hnorm : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
        simp [dotProduct, sq]
      simpa [T, real_inner_comm, Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM,
        hnorm] using hquad x.ofLp

name: NLAlib.sumLargest_singularValues_eq_kyFanNorm
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (show Antitone (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues A i) from
    fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone A hij)]
  rw [sum_fin_ite_lt_eq_sum_range hk (singularValues A)]
  exact (kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range A k).symm

name: NLAlib.forall_invariantNorm_le_iff_weaklyMajorized
statement:
theorem forall_invariantNorm_le_iff_weaklyMajorized (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (∀ ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n, ν.seminorm A ≤ ν.seminorm B) ↔
      WeaklyMajorized (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues A i)
        (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) => singularValues B i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h k hk
    have hkN : k ≤ min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) := by simpa using hk
    rw [sumLargest_singularValues_eq_kyFanNorm A hkN,
      sumLargest_singularValues_eq_kyFanNorm B hkN]
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · simp [hk0]
    · exact h (kyFanInvariantNorm k (by omega))
  · intro h ν
    rw [ν.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGauge_matrixValue A, ν.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGauge_matrixValue B]
    exact ν.toSymmetricGauge.value_le_of_weaklyMajorized
      (fun i => singularValues_nonneg _ i) h

name: NLAlib.UnitarilyInvariantNorm.exists_symmetricGauge_representation
statement:
theorem UnitarilyInvariantNorm.exists_symmetricGauge_representation
    (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n) :
    ∃ Φ : SymmetricGauge (Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))),
      ∀ A : Matrix m n ℝ, ν.seminorm A = Φ.matrixValue A
proof:
:=
  ⟨ν.toSymmetricGauge, ν.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGauge_matrixValue⟩

name: NLAlib.invariantNorm_rectangularDiagonal_singularValues_add_sub_le
statement:
theorem invariantNorm_rectangularDiagonal_singularValues_add_sub_le
    (ν : UnitarilyInvariantNorm ℝ m n) (A E : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ν.seminorm (rectangularDiagonalMatrix (fun i : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) =>
      singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i)) ≤ ν.seminorm E
proof:
:= by
  let d : Fin (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)) → ℝ := fun i =>
    singularValues (A + E) i - singularValues A i
  have h := ν.toSymmetricGauge.value_le_of_weaklyMajorized
    (fun i => abs_nonneg (d i)) (weaklyMajorized_abs_singularValues_add_sub A E)
  change ν.toSymmetricGauge.value (fun i => |d i|) ≤ ν.toSymmetricGauge.matrixValue E at h
  rw [ν.toSymmetricGauge.value_abs, ν.value_toSymmetricGauge,
    ← ν.seminorm_eq_toSymmetricGauge_matrixValue E] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_conjTranspose_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex
statement:
theorem norm_trace_conjTranspose_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {p q : ℝ}
    (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) :
    ‖(Aᴴ * B).trace‖ ≤ schattenNormReal A p * schattenNormReal B q
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ schattenNormReal (Aᴴ * B) 1 := by
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm (Aᴴ * B)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_conjTranspose] using
        schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_complex Aᴴ B hpq

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_conjTranspose_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex
statement:
theorem norm_trace_conjTranspose_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    ‖(Aᴴ * B).trace‖ ≤ schattenNorm A p * schattenNorm B q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hq : q = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique ∞ q 1 q).symm
    subst q
    simp only [schattenNorm_top, schattenNorm_one]
    apply (norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm (Aᴴ * B)).trans
    simpa only [schattenNormReal_one, specNorm_conjTranspose] using
      schattenNormReal_mul_le_specNorm_mul Aᴴ B (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  · by_cases hq : q = ∞
    · subst q
      have hp' : p = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique p ∞ 1 p).symm
      subst p
      simp only [schattenNorm_top, schattenNorm_one]
      apply (norm_trace_le_nuclearNorm (Aᴴ * B)).trans
      have h := schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_specNorm Aᴴ B (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      rw [schattenNormReal_conjTranspose] at h
      simpa only [schattenNormReal_one] using h
    · rw [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hp, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hq]
      exact norm_trace_conjTranspose_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex A B
        (ENNReal.HolderConjugate.toReal_of_ne_top hp hq)

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex
statement:
theorem norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {p q : ℝ}
    (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) :
    ‖(A * B).trace‖ ≤ schattenNormReal A p * schattenNormReal B q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, schattenNormReal_conjTranspose] using
    norm_trace_conjTranspose_mul_le_schattenNormReal_mul_complex Aᴴ B hpq

name: NLAlib.norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex
statement:
theorem norm_trace_mul_le_schattenNorm_mul_complex
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    ‖(A * B).trace‖ ≤ schattenNorm A p * schattenNorm B q
proof:
:= by
