name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_fin
statement:
private theorem exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) :
    ∃ B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜,
      schattenNormReal B q ≤ 1 ∧ (Aᴴ * B).trace = (schattenNormReal A p : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst A
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [schattenNormReal_zero hpq.symm.pos]; norm_num
    · simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.trace_zero,
        schattenNormReal_zero hpq.pos, RCLike.ofReal_zero]
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    refine ⟨U * (rectDiag (schattenDualCoefficients A p) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) * Vᴴ,
      (h.schattenDualCoefficients_attain hpq hA).1.le, ?_⟩
    rw [h.trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose,
      sum_singularValues_mul_schattenDualCoefficients_eq A hpq hA]

name: NLAlib.exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_specNorm_fin
statement:
private theorem exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_specNorm_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) :
    ∃ B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜,
      nuclearNorm B ≤ 1 ∧ (Aᴴ * B).trace = (specNorm A : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst A
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← schattenNormReal_one, schattenNormReal_zero (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)]
      norm_num
    · simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.trace_zero,
        specNorm_zero, RCLike.ofReal_zero]
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    refine ⟨U * (rectDiag leadingSingularCoefficients : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) * Vᴴ,
      (h.leadingSingularCoefficients_attain hA).1.le, ?_⟩
    have hpair := (h.leadingSingularCoefficients_attain hA).2
    rw [h.frobInner_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose] at hpair
    rw [h.trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose, hpair]

name: NLAlib.exists_specNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_nuclearNorm_fin
statement:
private theorem exists_specNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_nuclearNorm_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) :
    ∃ B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜,
      specNorm B ≤ 1 ∧ (Aᴴ * B).trace = (nuclearNorm A : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst A
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [specNorm]
    · simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.trace_zero]
      rw [← schattenNormReal_one, schattenNormReal_zero (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1),
        RCLike.ofReal_zero]
  · obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
    have hN : 0 < min m n := by
      by_contra hn
      have hs := singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A
        (show min (Fintype.card (Fin m)) (Fintype.card (Fin n)) ≤ 0 by
          simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using not_lt.mp hn)
      rw [singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm] at hs
      exact hA (norm_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hs))
    let B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜 :=
      U * (rectDiag (fun _ => 1) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) * Vᴴ
    refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hs : singularValues B 0 = 1 := singularValues_eq_of_eq_mul_rectDiag_mul
        h.conjTranspose_mul_left h.conjTranspose_mul_right (fun _ => zero_le_one)
        (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl) rfl hN
      rw [singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm] at hs
      exact hs.le
    · change (Aᴴ * (U * (rectDiag (fun _ => 1) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) * Vᴴ)).trace = _
      rw [h.trace_conjTranspose_mul_mul_rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose]
      simp only [mul_one]
      congr 1
      simp only [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n 𝕜,
      schattenNormReal B q ≤ 1 ∧ (Aᴴ * B).trace = (schattenNormReal A p : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  let em := Fintype.equivFin m
  let en := Fintype.equivFin n
  obtain ⟨Bf, hBn, hBpair⟩ :=
    exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_fin (A.reindex em en) hpq
  let B := Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm
  have hBr : B.reindex em en = Bf := by ext i j; simp [B, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [B, schattenNormReal_reindex] using hBn
  · have h := trace_conjTranspose_mul_reindex A B em en
    rw [hBr, hBpair, schattenNormReal_reindex] at h
    exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_schattenNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n 𝕜,
      schattenNorm B q ≤ 1 ∧ (Aᴴ * B).trace = (schattenNorm A p : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = ∞
  · subst p
    have hq : q = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique ∞ q 1 q).symm
    subst q
    simp only [schattenNorm_top, schattenNorm_one]
    let em := Fintype.equivFin m
    let en := Fintype.equivFin n
    obtain ⟨Bf, hBn, hBpair⟩ :=
      exists_nuclearNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_specNorm_fin (A.reindex em en)
    let B := Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm
    have hBr : B.reindex em en = Bf := by ext i j; simp [B, Matrix.reindex_apply]
    refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← schattenNormReal_one] at hBn ⊢
      simpa only [B, schattenNormReal_reindex] using hBn
    · have h := trace_conjTranspose_mul_reindex A B em en
      rw [hBr, hBpair, specNorm_reindex] at h
      exact h.symm
  · by_cases hq : q = ∞
    · subst q
      have hp' : p = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderTriple.unique p ∞ 1 p).symm
      subst p
      simp only [schattenNorm_top, schattenNorm_one]
      let em := Fintype.equivFin m
      let en := Fintype.equivFin n
      obtain ⟨Bf, hBn, hBpair⟩ :=
        exists_specNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq_nuclearNorm_fin (A.reindex em en)
      let B := Bf.reindex em.symm en.symm
      have hBr : B.reindex em en = Bf := by ext i j; simp [B, Matrix.reindex_apply]
      refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [B, specNorm_reindex] using hBn
      · have h := trace_conjTranspose_mul_reindex A B em en
        rw [hBr, hBpair, ← schattenNormReal_one, schattenNormReal_reindex,
          schattenNormReal_one] at h
        exact h.symm
    · simp only [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hp, schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hq]
      exact exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq A
        (ENNReal.HolderConjugate.toReal_of_ne_top hp hq)

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_mul_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : Real.HolderConjugate p q) :
    ∃ T : Matrix n m 𝕜,
      schattenNormReal T q ≤ 1 ∧ (T * A).trace = (schattenNormReal A p : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hBn, hpair⟩ := exists_schattenNormReal_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq A hpq
  refine ⟨Bᴴ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [schattenNormReal_conjTranspose] using hBn
  · have h := congrArg star hpair
    rw [← Matrix.trace_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_schattenNorm_le_one_trace_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_schattenNorm_le_one_trace_mul_eq (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p q : ℝ≥0∞} [ENNReal.HolderConjugate p q] :
    ∃ T : Matrix n m 𝕜, schattenNorm T q ≤ 1 ∧ (T * A).trace = (schattenNorm A p : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hBn, hpair⟩ := exists_schattenNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq A (p := p) (q := q)
  refine ⟨Bᴴ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [schattenNorm_conjTranspose] using hBn
  · have h := congrArg star hpair
    rw [← Matrix.trace_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_submatrix_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_submatrix_le {𝕜 m n r s : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [Fintype s]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r] [DecidableEq s]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (f : r → m) (g : s → n)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    specNorm (A.submatrix f g) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let P : Matrix m r 𝕜 := coordinateFrame f
  let Q : Matrix n s 𝕜 := coordinateFrame g
  have hP : specNorm Pᴴ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]
    exact specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal (hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame hf)
  have hQ : specNorm Q ≤ 1 :=
    specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal (hasOrthonormalCols_coordinateFrame hg)
  have he : Pᴴ * A * Q = A.submatrix f g := by
    dsimp [P, Q, coordinateFrame]
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
    have hl := Matrix.one_submatrix_mul f (Equiv.refl m) A
    simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Equiv.refl_symm, Function.id_comp] at hl
    rw [hl]
    have hr := Matrix.mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl n) g (A.submatrix f id)
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_refl, Equiv.refl_symm, Function.id_comp,
      Matrix.submatrix_submatrix, Function.comp_id] using hr
  rw [← he]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (Pᴴ * A) * specNorm Q := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm Pᴴ * specNorm A) * specNorm Q :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (1 * specNorm A) * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (specNorm_nonneg _)) hQ
        (specNorm_nonneg _) (by simpa only [one_mul] using specNorm_nonneg A)
    _ = specNorm A := by ring

name: NLAlib.blockDiagonal'_mulVec_apply
statement:
theorem blockDiagonal'_mulVec_apply (B : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (n i) 𝕜)
    (x : (Σ i, n i) → 𝕜) (i : ι) (a : m i) :
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B *ᵥ x) ⟨i, a⟩ = (B i *ᵥ fun b => x ⟨i, b⟩) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp only [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
  · intro j hj hji
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne B a b hji.symm, zero_mul]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_blockDiagonal'_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_blockDiagonal'_le (B : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (n i) 𝕜)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hB : ∀ i, specNorm (B i) ≤ c) :
    specNorm (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_le_of_sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le hc
  intro x
  simp only [Fintype.sum_sigma, blockDiagonal'_mulVec_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  exact (sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (B i) (fun b => x ⟨i, b⟩)).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (hB i) 2)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.specNorm_block_le_blockDiagonal'
statement:
theorem specNorm_block_le_blockDiagonal' (B : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (n i) 𝕜) (i : ι) :
    specNorm (B i) ≤ specNorm (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_submatrix_le (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B)
    (fun a : m i => (⟨i, a⟩ : Σ j, m j)) (fun b : n i => (⟨i, b⟩ : Σ j, n j))
    (by intro a b h; exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).2)
    (by intro a b h; exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).2)
  have he : (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).submatrix
      (fun a : m i => (⟨i, a⟩ : Σ j, m j)) (fun b : n i => (⟨i, b⟩ : Σ j, n j)) = B i := by
    ext a b
    exact Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq B i a b
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_blockDiagonal'_eq_max
statement:
theorem specNorm_blockDiagonal'_eq_max [Nonempty ι]
    (B : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (n i) 𝕜) :
    specNorm (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B) =
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => specNorm (B i))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply specNorm_blockDiagonal'_le
    · let i : ι := Classical.choice inferInstance
      exact (specNorm_nonneg (B i)).trans
        (Finset.le_sup' (fun j => specNorm (B j)) (Finset.mem_univ i))
    · intro i
      exact Finset.le_sup' (fun j => specNorm (B j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro i hi
    exact specNorm_block_le_blockDiagonal' B i

name: NLAlib.specNorm_blockDiagonal'_one_kronecker_eq_max
statement:
theorem specNorm_blockDiagonal'_one_kronecker_eq_max [Nonempty ι]
    {r : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (r i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (r i)] [∀ i, Nonempty (r i)]
    (B : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (n i) 𝕜) :
    specNorm (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => (1 : Matrix (r i) (r i) 𝕜) ⊗ₖ B i)) =
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => specNorm (B i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_blockDiagonal'_eq_max]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [specNorm_kronecker]
  have hI : specNorm (1 : Matrix (r i) (r i) 𝕜) = 1 := by
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, ← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    simp
  rw [hI, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_imaginaryPart (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    normalizedTrace (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)=((normalizedTrace A).im : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have he := map_imaginaryPart (Matrix.tracePositiveLinearMap n ℂ ℂ) A
  simp only [Matrix.tracePositiveLinearMap_apply,Complex.coe_imaginaryPart] at he
  have hd : (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹=(((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_inv,Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  simp only [normalizedTrace,he,hd,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,add_zero,Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: NLAlib.im_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem im_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm_imaginaryPart (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (normalizedTrace A).im≤specNorm (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ |(normalizedTrace A).im| := le_abs_self _
    _ = ‖normalizedTrace (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [normalizedTrace_imaginaryPart,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ _ := norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm _

name: NLAlib.im_normalizedTrace_nonneg_of_posSemidef_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem im_normalizedTrace_nonneg_of_posSemidef_imaginaryPart
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosSemidef) :
    0≤(normalizedTrace A).im
proof:
:= by
  have he := map_imaginaryPart (Matrix.tracePositiveLinearMap n ℂ ℂ) A
  simp only [Matrix.tracePositiveLinearMap_apply,Complex.coe_imaginaryPart] at he
  have htrace : 0≤A.trace.im := by
    have hn := hA.trace_nonneg
    rw [he] at hn
    exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hn).1
  have hd : (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹=(((Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_inv,Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  rw [normalizedTrace,hd]
  simp only [Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,add_zero]
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) htrace

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le {K m n : Type*} [RCLike K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m n K} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ x : n → K,
      ∑ i, norm ((A *ᵥ x) i) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 * ∑ j, ‖x j‖ ^ 2) : specNorm A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc
  intro x
  have hx := h x.ofLp
  change ∑ i, ‖(A *ᵥ x.ofLp) i‖ ^ 2 ≤ _ at hx
  have hx' : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (c * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow] using hx
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.ofLp)‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.ofLp)), mul_nonneg hc (norm_nonneg x)]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_fromBlocks_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_fromBlocks_diagonal_le (A : Matrix m m K) (D : Matrix n n K) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D) ≤ max (specNorm A) (specNorm D)
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_le_of_sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le (le_max_of_le_left (specNorm_nonneg A))
  intro x
  have hA := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq A (x ∘ Sum.inl)
  have hD := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq D (x ∘ Sum.inr)
  have hAm : specNorm A ^ 2 ≤ max (specNorm A) (specNorm D) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg A) (le_max_left _ _) 2
  have hDm : specNorm D ^ 2 ≤ max (specNorm A) (specNorm D) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg D) (le_max_right _ _) 2
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_add, add_zero,
    Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  have hposA : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖x (Sum.inl i)‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hposD : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖x (Sum.inr i)‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  dsimp [Function.comp_def] at *
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAm hposA, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDm hposD]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_fromBlocks_offDiagonal_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_fromBlocks_offDiagonal_le (B : Matrix m n K) (C : Matrix n m K) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 B C 0) ≤ max (specNorm B) (specNorm C)
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_le_of_sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le (le_max_of_le_left (specNorm_nonneg B))
  intro x
  have hB := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq B (x ∘ Sum.inr)
  have hC := sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq C (x ∘ Sum.inl)
  have hBm : specNorm B ^ 2 ≤ max (specNorm B) (specNorm C) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg B) (le_max_left _ _) 2
  have hCm : specNorm C ^ 2 ≤ max (specNorm B) (specNorm C) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg C) (le_max_right _ _) 2
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_add, add_zero,
    Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  have hposB : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖x (Sum.inr i)‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hposC : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖x (Sum.inl i)‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  dsimp [Function.comp_def] at *
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBm hposB, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCm hposC]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem frobSq_fromBlocks {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (A : Matrix m p K) (B : Matrix m q K) (C : Matrix n p K) (D : Matrix n q K) :
    frobSq (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D) = frobSq A + frobSq B + frobSq C + frobSq D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁,
    Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gram_orthogonal_diagonalization
statement:
theorem gram_orthogonal_diagonalization {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (d : n → ℝ) :
    (P * Matrix.diagonal d * Pᵀ)ᵀ * (P * Matrix.diagonal d * Pᵀ) =
      P * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => d i ^ 2) * Pᵀ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = P * Matrix.diagonal d * (Pᵀ * P) * Matrix.diagonal d * Pᵀ := by
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_transpose,
        Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = P * (Matrix.diagonal d * Matrix.diagonal d) * Pᵀ := by
      rw [(show Pᵀ * P = 1 from hP), Matrix.mul_one]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
      simp only [pow_two]

name: NLAlib.gram_cfc_abs_eq
statement:
theorem gram_cfc_abs_eq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (cfc (abs : ℝ → ℝ) A)ᴴ * cfc (abs : ℝ → ℝ) A = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  have hP : HasOrthonormalCols (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) :=
    transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hA
  rw [hA.cfc_eq, cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose hA (abs : ℝ → ℝ),
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    gram_orthogonal_diagonalization hP]
  conv_rhs => rw [eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hA]
  rw [gram_orthogonal_diagonalization hP]
  congr 2
  apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
  funext i
  exact sq_abs (hA.eigenvalues i)

name: NLAlib.singularValues_cfc_abs
statement:
theorem singularValues_cfc_abs {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) :
    singularValues (cfc (abs : ℝ → ℝ) A) k = singularValues A k
proof:
:=
  singularValues_eq_of_gram_eq _ _ (gram_cfc_abs_eq hA) k

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues₀ {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    nuclearNorm A = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), |hA.eigenvalues₀ i|
proof:
:= by
  have hAbs : (cfc (abs : ℝ → ℝ) A).PosSemidef :=
    posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues hA (fun i => abs_nonneg _)
  calc
    nuclearNorm A = nuclearNorm (cfc (abs : ℝ → ℝ) A) := by
      simp only [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range]
      simp_rw [singularValues_cfc_abs hA]
    _ = (cfc (abs : ℝ → ℝ) A).trace := nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef hAbs
    _ = ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), |hA.eigenvalues₀ i| := by
      rw [trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA (abs : ℝ → ℝ)]
      exact sum_eigenvalues_eq_sum_sorted hA (abs : ℝ → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_eigenvalues₀_add_sub_le_nuclearNorm
statement:
theorem sum_abs_eigenvalues₀_add_sub_le_nuclearNorm {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A E : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n), |(hA.add hE).eigenvalues₀ i - hA.eigenvalues₀ i|) ≤ nuclearNorm E
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ ((abs : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    convert! (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))) using 1
  have h := (majorized_eigenvalues₀_add_sub hA hE).sum_convex_le hconv
  rw [nuclearNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues₀ hE]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.prefixPermutation_apply_lt_iff
statement:
theorem prefixPermutation_apply_lt_iff {k m : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (i : Fin m) : (prefixPermutation σ hk i).val < k ↔ i.val < k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val < k
  · rw [prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt σ hk i hi]
    exact ⟨fun _ => hi, fun _ => (σ ⟨i.val, hi⟩).isLt⟩
  · rw [prefixPermutation_apply_of_not_lt σ hk i hi]

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_submatrix_prefixPermutation
statement:
theorem rectangularDiagonal_submatrix_prefixPermutation {m n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (min m n))) :
    (rectangularDiagonal x).submatrix (prefixPermutation σ (min_le_left m n))
      (prefixPermutation σ (min_le_right m n)) = rectangularDiagonal (x ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i.val < min m n
  · by_cases hj : j.val < min m n
    · let i0 : Fin (min m n) := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
      let j0 : Fin (min m n) := ⟨j.val, hj⟩
      have hie : i = Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) i0 := Fin.ext rfl
      have hje : j = Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) j0 := Fin.ext rfl
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt σ (min_le_left m n) i hi,
        prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt σ (min_le_right m n) j hj]
      rw [rectangularDiagonal_apply_castLE]
      conv_rhs => rw [hie, hje, rectangularDiagonal_apply_castLE]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, σ.injective.eq_iff]
      rfl
    · rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, rectangularDiagonal_apply_eq_zero_of_not_lt_right
        x _ _ (by simpa only [prefixPermutation_apply_lt_iff] using hj),
        rectangularDiagonal_apply_eq_zero_of_not_lt_right (x ∘ σ) i j hj]
  · rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, rectangularDiagonal_apply_eq_zero_of_not_lt_left
      x _ _ (by simpa only [prefixPermutation_apply_lt_iff] using hi),
      rectangularDiagonal_apply_eq_zero_of_not_lt_left (x ∘ σ) i j hi]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_perm
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_perm {m n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (min m n))) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ U * rectangularDiagonal x * V =
        rectangularDiagonal (x ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  let α := prefixPermutation σ (min_le_left m n)
  let β := prefixPermutation σ (min_le_right m n)
  have hβ := hasOrthonormalCols_permMatrix β
  have hβt : HasOrthonormalCols (β.permMatrix ℝ)ᵀ := by
    change ((β.permMatrix ℝ)ᵀ)ᵀ * (β.permMatrix ℝ)ᵀ = 1
    rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hβ
  refine ⟨α.permMatrix ℝ, (β.permMatrix ℝ)ᵀ, hasOrthonormalCols_permMatrix α, hβt, ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.transpose_permMatrix]
  simp only [Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_mul,
    PEquiv.mul_toMatrix_toPEquiv, Matrix.submatrix_submatrix, Function.id_comp,
    Function.comp_id, Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_symm]
  exact rectangularDiagonal_submatrix_prefixPermutation x σ

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_eq_eigenvalue_sum
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hA.spectral_theorem]
  rw [← map_pow]
  rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
    Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp only [map_sum, Pi.pow_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    schattenNormReal A (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) = RCLike.re ((Aᴴ * A) ^ r).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * r : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i ^ ((2 * r : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) _
  rw [schattenNormReal, ← Real.rpow_natCast, one_div,
    Real.rpow_inv_rpow hsum hp.ne']
  rw [re_trace_pow_eq_eigenvalue_sum _ (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A),
    sum_eigenvalues_gram_eq_sum_singularValues A (fun x => x ^ r)]
  simp only [← pow_mul, Real.rpow_natCast]
  symm
  exact sum_range_singularValues_map_eq_of_min_le A (fun x => x ^ (2 * r))
    (by simp [show 2 * r ≠ 0 by omega]) (min_le_right _ _)

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    schattenNormReal A (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r) = RCLike.re (A ^ (2 * r)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram A hr,
    hA.eq, ← pow_two, ← pow_mul]

name: NLAlib.dilation_pow_even
statement:
theorem dilation_pow_even (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (r : ℕ) :
    dilation A ^ (2 * r) = Matrix.fromBlocks ((A * Aᴴ) ^ r) 0 0 ((Aᴴ * A) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul, dilation_sq, Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal_pow]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_dilation_pow_even
statement:
theorem re_trace_dilation_pow_even (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    RCLike.re (dilation A ^ (2 * r)).trace =
      2 * schattenNormReal A (2 * r : ℕ) ^ (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilation_pow_even]
  have htrace : (Matrix.fromBlocks ((A * Aᴴ) ^ r) 0 0 ((Aᴴ * A) ^ r)).trace =
      ((A * Aᴴ) ^ r).trace + ((Aᴴ * A) ^ r).trace := by
    simp [Matrix.trace, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  rw [htrace, map_add,
    re_trace_pow_eq_eigenvalue_sum _ (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self A),
    re_trace_pow_eq_eigenvalue_sum _ (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A),
    sum_eigenvalues_mul_adjoint_eq_adjoint_mul A (fun x => x ^ r) (by simp [hr.ne'])]
  rw [schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram A hr,
    re_trace_pow_eq_eigenvalue_sum _ (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.rank_one_coeff_ineq
statement:
private theorem rank_one_coeff_ineq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (u u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
    (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hu' : ‖u'‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hv' : ‖v'‖ = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * u j - v' i * u' j) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (u j - u' j) ^ 2 + ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have su : ∑ j, u j ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, hu, one_pow]
  have su' : ∑ j, u' j ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, hu', one_pow]
  have sv : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, hv, one_pow]
  have sv' : ∑ i, v' i ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, hv', one_pow]
  set α := ∑ j, u j * u' j with hαdef
  set β := ∑ i, v i * v' i with hβdef
  have hL : ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * u j - v' i * u' j) ^ 2
      = (∑ i, v i ^ 2) * (∑ j, u j ^ 2) - 2 * (β * α) + (∑ i, v' i ^ 2) * (∑ j, u' j ^ 2) := by
    rw [hαdef, hβdef, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hRu : ∑ j, (u j - u' j) ^ 2 = ∑ j, u j ^ 2 - 2 * α + ∑ j, u' j ^ 2 := by
    rw [hαdef, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hRv : ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2 = ∑ i, v i ^ 2 - 2 * β + ∑ i, v' i ^ 2 := by
    rw [hβdef, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    ring
  have hα : α ≤ 1 := by
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ j, (u j - u' j) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hβ : β ≤ 1 := by
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  rw [hL, hRu, hRv, su, su', sv, sv']
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hα) (sub_nonneg.2 hβ)]

name: NLAlib.rank_one_coeff_same
statement:
private theorem rank_one_coeff_same {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
    (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * u j - v' i * u j) ^ 2 = ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have su : ∑ j, u j ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, hu, one_pow]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have : ∀ j, (v i * u j - v' i * u j) ^ 2 = (v i - v' i) ^ 2 * u j ^ 2 := fun j => by ring
  simp_rw [this]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, su, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_le_norm_sq_add
statement:
theorem frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_le_norm_sq_add {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (u u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hu' : ‖u'‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hv' : ‖v'‖ = 1) :
    frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec v.ofLp u.ofLp - Matrix.vecMulVec v'.ofLp u'.ofLp)
      ≤ ‖u-u'‖ ^ 2 + ‖v-v'‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, PiLp.sub_apply] using
    rank_one_coeff_ineq u u' v v' hu hu' hv hv'

name: NLAlib.frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_same_eq_norm_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_same_eq_norm_sq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec v.ofLp u.ofLp - Matrix.vecMulVec v'.ofLp u.ofLp)
      = ‖v-v'‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, PiLp.sub_apply] using
    rank_one_coeff_same u v v' hu

name: NLAlib.frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_spectral_contraction
statement:
private theorem frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_spectral_contraction
    (A T : Matrix m n 𝕜) (hT : specNorm T ≤ 1) : frobInner A T ≤ nuclearNorm A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    frobInner A T ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
        singularValues A i * singularValues T i := frobInner_le_sum_singularValues_mul A T
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)), singularValues A i :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_of_le_one_right (singularValues_nonneg A i)
        ((singularValues_le_specNorm T i).trans hT)
    _ = nuclearNorm A := (nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range A).symm

name: NLAlib.convexOn_nuclearNorm
statement: theorem convexOn_nuclearNorm : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (nuclearNorm : Matrix m n 𝕜 → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro A _ B _ a b ha hb _
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hpair⟩ := exists_schattenNorm_le_one_trace_conjTranspose_mul_eq
    (a • A + b • B) (p := 1) (q := ∞)
  rw [schattenNorm_top] at hT
  rw [schattenNorm_one] at hpair
  have hInner : frobInner (a • A + b • B) T = nuclearNorm (a • A + b • B) := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, hpair, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  rw [← hInner, frobInner_add_left, frobInner_smul_left, frobInner_smul_left]
  exact add_le_add
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_spectral_contraction A T hT) ha)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (frobInner_le_nuclearNorm_of_spectral_contraction B T hT) hb)

name: NLAlib.kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    kyFanNorm A k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, singularValues A i
proof:
:= by
  set N := min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) with hN
  rw [kyFanNorm, sumLargest_eq_prefix_of_antitone _ (fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone A hij),
    show (∑ i : Fin N, if (i : ℕ) < k then singularValues A i else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (if i < k then singularValues A i else 0) from
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if i < k then singularValues A i else 0) N,
    Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  have hfilt : (Finset.range N).filter (fun i => i < k) = Finset.range (min N k) := by
    ext i; simp [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  rw [hfilt]
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (min_le_right _ _))
  intro i hi hni
  simp only [Finset.mem_range, lt_min_iff, not_and] at hi hni
  exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (by rw [← hN]; omega)

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_eq_sum_range (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    nuclearNorm A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i
proof:
:=
  kyFanNorm_eq_sum_range A _

name: NLAlib.WithComplexSchatten.measurable_ofMatrix
statement:
theorem measurable_ofMatrix :

:=

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_complex_condExp_rpow_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_complex_condExp_rpow_le
    {n Ω : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {s : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω}
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    {f : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ} (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hfm : Integrable (fun ω => schattenNormReal (f ω) p ^ q) μ) :
    (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (μ[f | s] ω) p ^ q ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ ω, schattenNormReal (f ω) p ^ q ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] WithComplexSchatten p hp n :=
    WithComplexSchatten.matrixContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hcomm := T.comp_condExp_comm (m := s) hf
  have h := integral_norm_condExp_rpow_le (m := s) hq (f := T ∘ f) (by exact hfm)
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, ‖μ[T ∘ f | s] ω‖ ^ q ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hcomm] with ω hω
      change ‖T (μ[f | s] ω)‖ ^ q = _
      exact congrArg (fun A : WithComplexSchatten p hp n => ‖A‖ ^ q)
        (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hω)
    _ ≤ _ := h

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_pos
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_pos (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    0 < schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (schattenNormReal_nonneg A p)
    (Ne.symm (fun h => hA ((schattenNormReal_eq_zero_iff A hp).mp h)))

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    schattenNormReal A p ^ p =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)), singularValues A i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [schattenNormReal, one_div]
  exact Real.rpow_inv_rpow
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      Real.rpow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) p) hp.ne'

name: NLAlib.singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_mem_Icc (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hA : A ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) :
    singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hC := schattenNormReal_pos A hp hA
  exact ⟨div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hC.le,
    (div_le_one hC).mpr ((singularValues_le_specNorm A i).trans (specNorm_le_schattenNormReal A hp))⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_one
statement:
theorem sum_singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_one (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      (singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A p) ^ p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hC := schattenNormReal_pos A hp hA
  simp_rw [Real.div_rpow (singularValues_nonneg A _) hC.le]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_sum A hp,
    div_self (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hC p).ne']

name: NLAlib.sum_singularValues_mul_normalized_rpow_eq_schattenNormReal
statement:
theorem sum_singularValues_mul_normalized_rpow_eq_schattenNormReal
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)),
      singularValues A i * (singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A p) ^ (p - 1)) =
      schattenNormReal A p
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 := lt_trans zero_lt_one hp
  have hC := schattenNormReal_pos A hp0 hA
  have hterm (i : ℕ) :
      singularValues A i * (singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A p) ^ (p - 1) =
        schattenNormReal A p * (singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A p) ^ p := by
    let w := singularValues A i / schattenNormReal A p
    have hw : 0 ≤ w := div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hC.le
    have hσ : singularValues A i = schattenNormReal A p * w := by dsimp [w]; field_simp
    have hprod : w * w ^ (p - 1) = w ^ p := by
      calc
        _ = w ^ (1 : ℝ) * w ^ (p - 1) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
        _ = w ^ (1 + (p - 1)) :=
          (Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg hw zero_le_one (sub_nonneg.mpr hp.le)).symm
        _ = _ := by congr 1; ring
    change singularValues A i * w ^ (p - 1) = schattenNormReal A p * w ^ p
    rw [hσ, mul_assoc, hprod]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_singularValues_div_schattenNormReal_rpow_eq_one A hp0 hA, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul
statement:
theorem sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤ specNorm A * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec A (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
  have hnAx : ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv m ℝ).symm (A *ᵥ x)‖ =
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    congr 1
    simp [dotProduct, sq]
  simpa only [hnAx, ← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, specNorm] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le

theorem abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm

theorem abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
proof:
:= by
  have hP' : Pᴴ * P = 1 := hP.conjTranspose_mul_self

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p] {P : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P)
    (A : Matrix p n 𝕜) : specNorm (A * Pᴴ) = specNorm A
proof:

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols

theorem specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols {p : Type*} [Fintype p]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ x : n → ℝ, (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) ≤ c ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    specNorm A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc fun x => ?_
  have hh := h x.ofLp
  have hx : x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ x.ofLp = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa [dotProduct, sq] using (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq x).symm
  have hy : ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) A x‖ ^ 2 =
      (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.ofLp) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [dotProduct, sq]
    rfl
  rw [hx, ← hy, ← mul_pow] at hh
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (mul_nonneg hc (norm_nonneg x)) hh

name: NLAlib.specNorm_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_diagonal_le {v : n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hv : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ c) :
    specNorm (Matrix.diagonal v) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hc).2 fun i => by simpa using hv i

name: NLAlib.specNorm_blockDiagonal_const_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_blockDiagonal_const_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun _ : κ => A)) ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  refine specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le (specNorm_nonneg A) fun x => ?_
  simp only [dotProduct, ← sq]
  have hD : ∀ i k, (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun _ : κ => A) *ᵥ x) (i, k) =
      (A *ᵥ fun j => x (j, k)) i := fun i k => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k
      (fun l _ hl => by simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, Ne.symm hl]) (by simp)]
    simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, hD]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_comm (f := fun j k => x (j, k) ^ 2), Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq A _

name: NLAlib.abs_diag_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_diag_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) :
    |A i i| ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ n := EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)
  have hcoord :
      |A i i| ≤ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A e‖ := by
    have h :=
      PiLp.norm_apply_le
        (x := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A e) i
    simpa [e, Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp, Matrix.mulVec_single_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      using h
  have hop :=
    (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A).le_opNorm e
  have he_norm : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
    simp [e]
  calc
    |A i i| ≤ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A e‖ := hcoord
    _ ≤ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) A‖ * ‖e‖ := hop
    _ = specNorm A := by
      rw [he_norm, mul_one]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_complex
statement:
theorem schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul_complex {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {p s r : ℝ} (hpsr : Real.HolderTriple p s r) :
    schattenNormReal (A*B) r ≤ schattenNormReal A p * schattenNormReal B s
proof:
:= by
  have h := schattenNormReal_mul_le_mul (matrixRealification A) (matrixRealification B) hpsr
  rw [←matrixRealification_mul,schattenNormReal_matrixRealification,
    schattenNormReal_matrixRealification,schattenNormReal_matrixRealification] at h
  have heq : (2 : ℝ)^(1/r) = 2^(1/p) * 2^(1/s) := by
    rw [←Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    congr 1
    simpa only [one_div] using hpsr.inv_add_inv_eq_inv.symm
  rw [heq] at h
  have hpos : 0 < (2 : ℝ)^(1/p) * 2^(1/s) := by positivity
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hpos).mp
  nlinarith [h]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pow_two_mul_le_re_trace_pow
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty d with
  | inl hd =>
    have hzero : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst A
    simp [specNorm_zero, Nat.ne_of_gt hp]
  | inr hd =>
    rw [hA.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues, re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow A hA]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm hA.eigenvalues).1
    rw [← hi]
    calc
      ‖hA.eigenvalues i‖ ^ (2 * p) = hA.eigenvalues i ^ (2 * p) := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← abs_pow]
        exact abs_of_nonneg ((even_two_mul p).pow_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ∑ j, hA.eigenvalues j ^ (2 * p) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => (even_two_mul p).pow_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_singularValues
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_singularValues (i : ℕ) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => singularValues A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro A B
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq,dist_eq_norm,one_mul,NNReal.coe_one,specNorm_eq_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    abs_singularValues_sub_le_specNorm A B i

name: NLAlib.continuous_schattenNormReal
statement:
theorem continuous_schattenNormReal {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Continuous (fun A : Matrix m n 𝕜 => schattenNormReal A p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold schattenNormReal
  apply Continuous.rpow_const
  · apply continuous_finset_sum
    intro i hi
    exact (lipschitzWith_singularValues i).continuous.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hp.le)
  · intro A
    exact Or.inr (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevResidual_def
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevResidual_def (a b : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevResidual a b q =
      C (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).comp (C ((b + a) / (b - a)) - C (2 / (b - a)) * X)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevAmplifier_def
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevAmplifier_def (α γ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevAmplifier α γ q =
      C (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ)) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).comp (C (1 / α) * X)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevResidual
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevResidual (a b : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (chebyshevResidual a b q).eval x =
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a) - 2 / (b - a) * x) /
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevResidual_def, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_X]
  rw [one_div_mul_eq_div]

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevAmplifier
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevAmplifier (α γ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).eval x =
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (x / α) / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevAmplifier_def, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_X]
  rw [one_div_mul_eq_div, one_div_mul_eq_div]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevZero_mem_Icc
statement: theorem chebyshevZero_mem_Icc (q : ℕ) (k : Fin q) : chebyshevZero q k ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨Real.neg_one_le_cos _, Real.cos_le_one _⟩

name: NLAlib.chebyshevZero_injective
statement: theorem chebyshevZero_injective (q : ℕ) : Function.Injective (chebyshevZero q)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have h := (Finset.range q).nodup_map_iff_injOn.mp (Chebyshev.roots_T_real_nodup q)
  exact Fin.ext (h (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_range.mpr i.2))
    (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_range.mpr j.2)) hij)

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : K[X]} {q : ℕ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) : ∃ s : K[X], s.degree < q ∧ 1 - p = X * s
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : X ∣ 1 - p := by
    rw [X_dvd_iff, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, eval_sub, hp0, eval_one, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hdvd
  refine ⟨s, ?_, hs⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne s 0 with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0, degree_zero]; exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
  · have hdeg : (1 - p).degree ≤ q :=
      (degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (degree_one_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le q)) hp)
    rw [hs, mul_comm, degree_mul_X] at hdeg
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree h0] at hdeg ⊢
    have : s.natDegree + 1 ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hdeg
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : s.natDegree < q)

name: NLAlib.degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : K[X]} {q : ℕ} :
    p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ↔ ∃ s : K[X], s.degree < q ∧ p = 1 - X * s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hp0⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one hp hp0
    exact ⟨s, hs, by rw [← h]; ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_), by simp⟩
    · exact degree_one_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le q)
    · rw [mul_comm]
      rcases eq_or_ne s 0 with h0 | h0
      · simp [h0]
      · rw [degree_mul_X, degree_eq_natDegree h0] at *
        have : s.natDegree < q := by exact_mod_cast hs
        exact_mod_cast (by omega : s.natDegree + 1 ≤ q)

name: NLAlib.eval_U_node_succ_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem eval_U_node_succ_eq_zero {k j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < k + 1) :
    (U ℝ k).eval (node (k + 1) j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 < (j : ℝ) * Real.pi / (k + 1) := by positivity
  have ht1 : (j : ℝ) * Real.pi / (k + 1) < Real.pi := by
    have h : (j : ℝ) < k + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hj
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) < k + 1 := by positivity
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hn).mpr
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have h := U_real_cos ((j : ℝ) * Real.pi / (k + 1)) (k : ℤ)
  have ht : ((k : ℤ) + 1 : ℝ) * ((j : ℝ) * Real.pi / (k + 1)) = j * Real.pi := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [ht, sin_nat_mul_pi, mul_eq_zero] at h
  simpa [node] using h.resolve_right (ne_of_gt (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi ht0 ht1))

name: NLAlib.nodal_node_succ
statement:
theorem nodal_node_succ (k : ℕ) :
    Lagrange.nodal (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1)) =
      C (1 / 2 ^ k : ℝ) * ((X ^ 2 - 1) * U ℝ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hXdeg : ((X : ℝ[X]) ^ 2 - 1).degree = 2 := by
    simpa using degree_X_pow_sub_C (R := ℝ) (n := 2) (by decide) 1
  have hXlead : ((X : ℝ[X]) ^ 2 - 1).leadingCoeff = 1 := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.Monic, C_1] using monic_X_pow_sub_C (R := ℝ) 1 (n := 2) (by decide)
  have hdeg : (C (1 / 2 ^ k : ℝ) * ((X ^ 2 - 1) * U ℝ k)).degree = ((k + 2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_C_mul (by positivity), degree_mul,
      hXdeg,
      degree_U_natCast]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hlead : (C (1 / 2 ^ k : ℝ) * ((X ^ 2 - 1) * U ℝ k)).leadingCoeff = 1 := by
    rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, leadingCoeff_mul,
      hXlead,
      leadingCoeff_U_natCast]
    field_simp
  apply eq_of_degree_le_of_eval_index_eq (range (k + 2)) (strictAntiOn_node (k + 1)).injOn
  · simp
  · simpa using hdeg.symm
  · have hnod : (Lagrange.nodal (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1))).leadingCoeff = 1 :=
      Lagrange.nodal_monic
    rw [hnod, hlead]
  · intro j hj
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node hj, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_pow,
      eval_X, eval_one]
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · simp [hj0, node_eq_one]
    by_cases hjn : j = k + 1
    · rw [hjn, node_eq_neg_one (n := k + 1) (by omega)]
      norm_num
    rw [eval_U_node_succ_eq_zero (by omega) (by simpa using (show j < k + 1 by
      have h := mem_range.mp hj
      omega)), mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.eval_derivative_nodal_node_succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodal_node_succ, derivative_C_mul, derivative_mul]
  simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_X_pow, derivative_one, sub_zero,
    eval_mul, eval_C, eval_add, eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_one]
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [node_eq_one, U_eval_one]
    simp
    ring
  by_cases hjn : j = k + 1
  · subst j
    rw [node_eq_neg_one (n := k + 1) (by omega), U_eval_neg_one]
    simp only [Int.cast_negOnePow_natCast, Int.cast_natCast]
    simp [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [if_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨hj0, hjn⟩), mul_one,
    eval_U_node_succ_eq_zero (by omega) (by have h := mem_range.mp hj; omega), mul_zero,
    zero_add]
  have h := congrArg (fun P : ℝ[X] => P.eval (node (k + 1) j))
    (add_one_mul_T_eq_poly_in_U (R := ℝ) k)
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_add, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_X, eval_pow, eval_natCast,
    Int.cast_natCast] at h
  rw [show (k : ℤ) + 1 = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega,
    eval_T_real_node (by simpa using (show j ≤ k + 1 by
      have h := mem_range.mp hj
      omega)), eval_U_node_succ_eq_zero (by omega)
        (by have h := mem_range.mp hj; omega), mul_zero] at h
  linear_combination -(1 / 2 ^ k : ℝ) * h

name: NLAlib.nodalWeight_node_succ
statement:
theorem nodalWeight_node_succ (k j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range (k + 2)) :
    Lagrange.nodalWeight (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1)) j =
      (2 ^ k / (k + 1) : ℝ) * (-1) ^ j * (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lagrange.nodalWeight_eq_eval_derivative_nodal hj, eval_derivative_nodal_node_succ k j hj]
  have hn : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hs : (-1 : ℝ) ^ j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero j (by norm_num)
  have hsq : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm j 2, pow_mul]; norm_num
  split_ifs <;> field_simp [hn, hs] <;> nlinarith [hsq]

name: NLAlib.nodal_node_succ_eq_sub_T
statement:
theorem nodal_node_succ_eq_sub_T (k : ℕ) :
    Lagrange.nodal (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1)) =
      C (1 / 2 ^ (k + 1) : ℝ) * (T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 2) - T ℝ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 2) - T ℝ k = 2 * ((X ^ 2 - 1) * U ℝ k) := by
    have h1 := T_sub_one ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 1)
    have h2 := T_eq_X_mul_T_sub_pol_U ℝ k
    rw [show (k : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = k by omega,
      show (k : ℤ) + 1 + 1 = k + 2 by omega] at h1
    linear_combination -h1 + 2 * h2
  rw [nodal_node_succ, hdiff, ← C_ofNat]
  rw [← mul_assoc (C (1 / 2 ^ (k + 1) : ℝ)) (C (2 : ℝ)), ← Polynomial.C_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolate_node_succ_eq_barycentric
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_node_succ_eq_barycentric (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ j ∈ range (k + 2), x ≠ node (k + 1) j) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1)) f).eval x =
      (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) *
        (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹ * f j) /
      (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) *
        (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lagrange.eval_interpolate_not_at_node' f (strictAntiOn_node (k + 1)).injOn
    (by simp) hx]
  have hw (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range (k + 2)) := nodalWeight_node_succ k j hj
  have hnum := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => congrArg
    (fun w : ℝ => w * (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹ * f j) (hw j hj))
  have hden := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => congrArg
    (fun w : ℝ => w * (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹) (hw j hj))
  rw [hnum, hden]
  have hN : (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (2 ^ k / (k + 1) : ℝ) * (-1) ^ j *
      (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) * (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹ * f j) =
      (2 ^ k / (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (-1) ^ j *
      (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) * (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹ * f j) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  have hD : (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (2 ^ k / (k + 1) : ℝ) * (-1) ^ j *
      (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) * (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹) =
      (2 ^ k / (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (-1) ^ j *
      (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) * (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  rw [hN, hD, mul_div_mul_left]
  positivity

name: NLAlib.derivative_chebyshev_primitive
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivative_sub, derivative_C_mul, derivative_C_mul, T_derivative_eq_U,
    T_derivative_eq_U]
  simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_ofNat, Int.cast_one]
  rw [show (k : ℤ) + 3 - 1 = k + 2 by omega,
    show (k : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = k by omega]
  have h1 : C (1 / (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 3))) * ((k : ℝ[X]) + 3) = C (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← C_eq_natCast, ← C_ofNat, ← C_add, ← Polynomial.C_mul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have h2 : C (1 / (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1))) * ((k : ℝ[X]) + 1) = C (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← C_eq_natCast, ← C_1, ← C_add, ← Polynomial.C_mul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [← mul_assoc, h1, ← mul_assoc, h2, ← mul_sub,
    ← two_mul_T_eq_U_sub_U, ← mul_assoc, ← C_ofNat, ← Polynomial.C_mul]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_T_add_two
statement:
private theorem integral_eval_T_add_two (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 2)).eval x) =
      (1 - (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 3)) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 3)) -
      (1 - (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let P := C (1 / (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 3))) * T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 3) -
      C (1 / (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1))) * T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 1)
  have hd : derivative P = T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 2) := derivative_chebyshev_primitive k
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
    (fun x _ => hd ▸ P.hasDerivAt x) ((T ℝ ((k : ℤ) + 2)).continuous.intervalIntegrable _ _)
  rw [h]
  simp only [P, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, T_eval_one, mul_one, T_eval_neg_one]
  rw [show (k : ℤ) + 3 = ((k + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega,
    show (k : ℤ) + 1 = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega,
    Int.cast_negOnePow_natCast, Int.cast_negOnePow_natCast]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_T
statement:
theorem integral_eval_T (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (T ℝ k).eval x) =
      if Even k then 2 / (1 - (k : ℝ) ^ 2) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with _ | _ | k
  · norm_num [T_zero]
  · norm_num [T_one, integral_id]
  · rw [show ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 2 by omega, integral_eval_T_add_two]
    by_cases hk : Even (k + 2)
    · have hk1 : Odd (k + 1) := by simpa using (show Even k by simpa [Nat.even_add] using hk).add_one
      have hk3 : Odd (k + 3) := by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hk1.add_even (show Even 2 by decide)
      rw [if_pos hk, hk1.neg_one_pow, hk3.neg_one_pow]
      push_cast
      norm_num only [sub_neg_eq_add, one_add_one_eq_two]
      rw [show (k : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = k + 2 by ring]
      have h0 : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h1 : (k : ℝ) + 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : 1 - ((k : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]
      field_simp [h0, h1, h2]
      ring
    · have hk1 : Even (k + 1) := by simpa [Nat.even_add] using hk
      have hk3 : Even (k + 3) := by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hk1.add (show Even 2 by decide)
      rw [if_neg hk, hk1.neg_one_pow, hk3.neg_one_pow]
      simp

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem integral_sum_mul_eval_T {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (k : ι → ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i ∈ s, c i * (T ℝ (k i)).eval x) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, if Even (k i) then 2 * c i / (1 - (k i : ℝ) ^ 2) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_eval_T]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  · intro i hi
    exact (continuous_const.mul (T ℝ (k i)).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one {q k : ℕ}
    {p : ℝ[X]} {x : ℝ} (hdeg : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval t| ≤ 1) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    |(derivative^[k] p).eval x| ≤ (derivative^[k] (T ℝ q)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one (k := k) hx hdeg hb
  have h2 := eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one (k := k) (P := -p) hx
    (by simpa only [degree_neg] using hdeg) (fun t ht => by simpa using hb t ht)
  rw [iterate_derivative_neg, eval_neg] at h2
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, h1⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_iterate_derivative_le_mul_of_forall_abs_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_iterate_derivative_le_mul_of_forall_abs_le {q k : ℕ}
    {p : ℝ[X]} {M x : ℝ} (hdeg : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval t| ≤ M) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    |(derivative^[k] p).eval x| ≤ M * (derivative^[k] (T ℝ q)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
  by_cases hM : M = 0
  · have hp := eq_zero_of_forall_abs_eval_le_of_nonpos (le_of_eq hM) hb
    simp [hp, hM]
  · have hMpos := lt_of_le_of_ne hM0 (Ne.symm hM)
    have hd : (C M⁻¹ * p).degree ≤ q := by
      exact ((congrArg degree (C_mul' _ _)).trans_le (degree_smul_le _ _)).trans hdeg
    have hnorm : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(C M⁻¹ * p).eval t| ≤ 1 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hMpos),
        inv_mul_le_iff₀ hMpos, mul_one]
      exact hb t ht
    have h := abs_eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one (k := k) hd hnorm hx
    rw [iterate_derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hMpos), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hMpos] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.abs_leadingCoeff_le_of_forall_abs_le_one
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := leadingCoeff_le_of_forall_abs_le_one hdeg hb
  have h2 := leadingCoeff_le_of_forall_abs_le_one (P := -p)
    (by simpa only [degree_neg] using hdeg) (fun t ht => by simpa using hb t ht)
  rw [leadingCoeff_neg] at h2
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, h1⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_leadingCoeff_le_mul_of_forall_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
  by_cases hM : M = 0
  · have hp := eq_zero_of_forall_abs_eval_le_of_nonpos (le_of_eq hM) hb
    simp [hp, hM]
  · have hMpos := lt_of_le_of_ne hM0 (Ne.symm hM)
    have hd : (C M⁻¹ * p).degree ≤ q := by
      exact ((congrArg degree (C_mul' _ _)).trans_le (degree_smul_le _ _)).trans hdeg
    have hnorm : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(C M⁻¹ * p).eval t| ≤ 1 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hMpos),
        inv_mul_le_iff₀ hMpos, mul_one]
      exact hb t ht
    have h := abs_leadingCoeff_le_of_forall_abs_le_one hd hnorm
    rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hMpos), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hMpos] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.abs_coeff_le_mul_of_forall_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : p.natDegree = q
  · have h := abs_leadingCoeff_le_mul_of_forall_abs_le (q := q) hdeg hb
    simpa only [← hq, coeff_natDegree] using h
  · have hpq : p.natDegree < q := lt_of_le_of_ne (natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hdeg) hq
    rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hpq, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg ((abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.coeff_U_two_mul_eq_zero_of_not_two_dvd
statement:
theorem coeff_U_two_mul_eq_zero_of_not_two_dvd (k j : ℕ) (hj : ¬ 2 ∣ j) :
    (U ℝ (2 * k : ℕ)).coeff j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (U ℝ (2 * k : ℕ)).comp (-X) = U ℝ (2 * k : ℕ) := by
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro x
    simp only [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X, U_eval_neg]
    have hEven : Even ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      exact ⟨(k : ℤ), by push_cast; ring⟩
    rw [Int.negOnePow_even _ hEven]
    simp
  have hCoeff := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.coeff j) he
  have hOdd : Odd j := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp (by
    simpa only [even_iff_two_dvd] using hj)
  rw [show (-X : ℝ[X]) = C (-1) * X by simp,
    comp_C_mul_X_coeff, hOdd.neg_one_pow] at hCoeff
  linarith

name: NLAlib.expand_contract_U_two_mul
statement:
theorem expand_contract_U_two_mul (k : ℕ) :
    expand ℝ 2 (contract 2 (U ℝ (2 * k : ℕ))) = U ℝ (2 * k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [coeff_expand (by norm_num : 0 < 2)]
  by_cases hj : 2 ∣ j
  · rw [if_pos hj, coeff_contract (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0),
      Nat.div_mul_cancel hj]
  · rw [if_neg hj, coeff_U_two_mul_eq_zero_of_not_two_dvd k j hj]

name: NLAlib.natDegree_evenChebyshevFilter_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_evenChebyshevFilter_le (k : ℕ) :
    (evenChebyshevFilter k).natDegree ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  apply (natDegree_mul_le ..).trans
  simp only [natDegree_C, zero_add]
  apply natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro j hj
  rw [coeff_contract (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  apply coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
  rw [natDegree_U_natCast]
  omega

name: NLAlib.eval_evenChebyshevFilter
statement:
theorem eval_evenChebyshevFilter {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) :
    (evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x =
      (U ℝ (2 * k : ℕ)).eval (Real.sqrt x) / ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval (Real.sqrt x)) (expand_contract_U_two_mul k)
  rw [expand_eq_comp_X_pow, eval_comp, eval_pow, eval_X, Real.sq_sqrt hx] at h
  simp only [evenChebyshevFilter, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [h]
  ring

name: NLAlib.eval_evenChebyshevFilter_one
statement: theorem eval_evenChebyshevFilter_one (k : ℕ) : (evenChebyshevFilter k).eval 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_evenChebyshevFilter (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  simp only [Real.sqrt_one, U_eval_one]
  push_cast
  apply div_self
  positivity

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_le_one {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (k : ℕ) :
    |(evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : |Real.sqrt x| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg x)]
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_one).mpr hx.2
  have h := abs_eval_U_real_le hs (2 * k)
  rw [eval_evenChebyshevFilter hx.1, abs_div,
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))]
  apply (div_le_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))).mpr
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h

name: NLAlib.one_sub_sq_mul_eval_U_sq_le_one
statement:
theorem one_sub_sq_mul_eval_U_sq_le_one {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    (1 - x ^ 2) * (U ℝ j).eval x ^ 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := abs_le.mp hx
  have hc := Real.cos_arccos hx'.1 hx'.2
  have h := U_real_cos (Real.arccos x) (j : ℤ)
  rw [hc] at h
  have hsq := congrArg (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) h
  rw [mul_pow] at hsq
  have hTrig := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (Real.arccos x)
  rw [hc] at hTrig
  have hSin := Real.sin_sq_le_one (((j : ℤ) + 1) * Real.arccos x)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_sq_le
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_sq_le {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - x) * (evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x ^ 2 ≤
      (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hs : |Real.sqrt x| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg x)]
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_one).mpr hx.2
  have h := one_sub_sq_mul_eval_U_sq_le_one hs (2 * k)
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hx.1] at h
  rw [eval_evenChebyshevFilter hx.1, div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc]
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg _)).trans_eq (one_div _)

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_pow_sq_le
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_pow_sq_le {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (k : ℕ) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) :
    (1 - x) * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x ^ ℓ) ^ 2 ≤
      (2 / (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x ^ ℓ) ^ 2 +
      (2 / (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ
proof:
:= by
  let C := ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2
  let u := (evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x ^ 2
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := sq_nonneg _
  have hw : (1 - x) * u ≤ 1 / C := by
    simpa only [u, C, one_div] using one_sub_mul_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_sq_le hx k
  have he : ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval x ^ ℓ) ^ 2 = u ^ ℓ := by
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [he]
  change (1 - x) * u ^ ℓ ≤ 2 / C * u ^ ℓ + 2 / C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ
  by_cases hs : 1 - x ≤ 2 / C
  · have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (pow_nonneg hu ℓ)
    have hz : 0 ≤ 2 / C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by positivity
    linarith
  · have hs' : 0 < 1 - x := lt_trans (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 / C) (lt_of_not_ge hs)
    have huHalf : u ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_not_ge hs) hu
      have hh : 2 / C * u ≤ 1 / C := ht.trans hw
      apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hC).mp
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hC.le
      field_simp [hC.ne'] at this ⊢
      linarith
    have hPow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hu huHalf (ℓ - 1)
    have hBound : (1 - x) * u ^ ℓ ≤ 2 / C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
      rw [show ℓ = 1 + (ℓ - 1) by omega, pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc]
      have ht := mul_le_mul hw hPow (pow_nonneg hu _) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / C)
      refine ht.trans_eq ?_
      rw [pow_add, pow_one]
      ring
    exact hBound.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (pow_nonneg hu ℓ)))

name: NLAlib.exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), c j • T ℝ (j : ℤ)) = p
proof:
:= by
  let S := chebyshevTsequence ℝ
  have hCoeff : ∀ i ≤ n, IsUnit (S i).leadingCoeff := by
    intro i hi
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (S.ne_zero i))
  have hmem : p ∈ Polynomial.degreeLE ℝ n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLE.mpr hp
  rw [← S.span_degreeLE hCoeff] at hmem
  have hset : Set.Iic n = (range (n + 1) : Set ℕ) := by ext i; simp
  rw [hset] at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun' ℝ).mp hmem
  exact ⟨c, hc⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_cosine_expansion_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem exists_cosine_expansion_of_degree_le {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      p.eval (cos t) = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), c j * cos ((j : ℝ) * t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le hp
  refine ⟨c, fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [← hc, eval_finsetSum]
  simp only [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, T_real_cos, Int.cast_natCast]

name: NLAlib.Markov.angle_mem
statement:
private lemma angle_mem {q k : ℕ} (hk : k < q) :
    0 < (2 * k + 1) * π / (2 * q) ∧ (2 * k + 1) * π / (2 * q) < π
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk)
  have hk' : (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) < 2 * q := by
    have : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hk
    linarith
  constructor
  · positivity
  · rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [pi_pos]

name: NLAlib.Markov.eval_derivative_T
statement:
private lemma eval_derivative_T (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (derivative (T ℝ q)).eval x = q * (U ℝ ((q : ℤ) - 1)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_derivative_eq_U, eval_mul]
  simp

name: NLAlib.Markov.sin_angle_eq_sqrt
statement:
private lemma sin_angle_eq_sqrt {q : ℕ} (k : Fin q) :
    sin ((2 * ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * π / (2 * q)) = √(1 - chebyshevZero q k ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  sin_eq_sqrt_one_sub_cos_sq (angle_mem k.isLt).1.le (angle_mem k.isLt).2.le

name: NLAlib.Markov.abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sqrt
statement:
lemma abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sqrt {q : ℕ} (k : Fin q) :
    |(derivative (T ℝ q)).eval (chebyshevZero q k)| * √(1 - chebyshevZero q k ^ 2) = q
proof:
:= by
  set θ := (2 * ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * π / (2 * q) with hθ
  have hU := U_real_cos θ ((q : ℤ) - 1)
  have hT := T_real_cos θ (q : ℤ)
  have h0 : (T ℝ q).eval (cos θ) = 0 := eval_T_real_chebyshevZero q k
  rw [h0] at hT
  have hsin : |sin ((q : ℝ) * θ)| = 1 := by
    have := sin_sq_add_cos_sq ((q : ℝ) * θ)
    push_cast at hT
    rw [← hT] at this
    have h1 : sin ((q : ℝ) * θ) ^ 2 = 1 := by simpa using this
    rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp h1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hpos : 0 ≤ sin θ :=
    sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (angle_mem k.isLt).1.le (angle_mem k.isLt).2.le
  rw [← sin_angle_eq_sqrt k, eval_derivative_T]
  change |(q : ℝ) * (U ℝ ((q : ℤ) - 1)).eval (cos θ)| * sin θ = q
  rw [← abs_of_nonneg hpos, ← abs_mul, mul_assoc, hU]
  push_cast
  rw [sub_add_cancel, abs_mul, hsin]
  simp

name: NLAlib.Markov.zero_le_zero_zero
statement:
private lemma zero_le_zero_zero {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (k : Fin q) :
    chebyshevZero q k ≤ chebyshevZero q ⟨0, hq⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := angle_mem hq
  have hk' := angle_mem k.isLt
  unfold chebyshevZero
  apply cos_le_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi h0.1.le hk'.2.le
  push_cast
  gcongr
  linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg (k : ℕ) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℕ))]

name: NLAlib.Markov.eval_basis_eq
statement:
private lemma eval_basis_eq {q : ℕ} {i : Fin q} (hi : i ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin q))) (y : ℝ) :
    (Lagrange.basis univ (chebyshevZero q) i).eval y =
      Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (chebyshevZero q) i *
        (Lagrange.nodal (univ.erase i) (chebyshevZero q)).eval y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lagrange.basis_eq_prod_sub_inv_mul_nodal_div hi, ← Lagrange.nodal_erase_eq_nodal_div hi,
    eval_mul, eval_C]

name: NLAlib.Markov.abs_eval_le_of_zero_le
proof:
:= by
  set s : Finset (Fin q) := univ
  set v := chebyshevZero q
  set N := Lagrange.nodal s v
  set c : ℝ := 2 ^ (q - 1) with hc
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by
    have := hM 0 (by norm_num)
    simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, sub_zero, sqrt_one,
      one_mul] at this
    exact (abs_nonneg _).trans this
  have hN : N = C (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1)) * T ℝ q := nodal_chebyshevZero q
  have hderiv : ∀ x, (derivative (T ℝ q)).eval x = c * (derivative N).eval x := by
    intro x
    rw [hN, derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, ← mul_assoc, hc,
      mul_one_div_cancel (by positivity), one_mul]
  have hinterp : r = Lagrange.interpolate s v (fun i => r.eval (v i)) :=
    Lagrange.eq_interpolate (chebyshevZero_injective q).injOn (by simpa [s] using hr)
  
  have hNi : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ (Lagrange.nodal (s.erase i) v).eval y := by
    intro i _
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    refine Finset.prod_nonneg fun j hj => ?_
    linarith [zero_le_zero_zero hq j]
  
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ s,
      |r.eval (v i)| * |Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i| ≤ c * M / q := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Lagrange.nodalWeight_eq_eval_derivative_nodal hi, abs_inv]
    have hT := abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sqrt i
    rw [hderiv, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hcpos] at hT
    set D := |(derivative N).eval (v i)|
    set S := √(1 - chebyshevZero q i ^ 2)
    have hDpos : D ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, mul_zero, zero_mul] at hT
      exact hqpos.ne' hT.symm
    have hinv : D⁻¹ = c * S / q := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hqpos.ne', ← hT]
      field_simp
    rw [hinv]
    have hSi : S * |r.eval (v i)| ≤ M := hM _ (chebyshevZero_mem_Icc q i)
    calc |r.eval (v i)| * (c * S / q) = c * (S * |r.eval (v i)|) / q := by ring
      _ ≤ c * M / q := by gcongr
  have hsum : (derivative N).eval y = ∑ i ∈ s, (Lagrange.nodal (s.erase i) v).eval y := by
    rw [Lagrange.derivative_nodal, eval_finsetSum]
  have hy : |y| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor
    · have : -1 ≤ chebyshevZero q ⟨0, hq⟩ := (chebyshevZero_mem_Icc q ⟨0, hq⟩).1
      linarith
    · exact hy1
  rw [hinterp, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum]
  calc |∑ i ∈ s, (C (r.eval (v i)) * Lagrange.basis s v i).eval y|
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, |(C (r.eval (v i)) * Lagrange.basis s v i).eval y| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, |r.eval (v i)| * |Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i| *
          (Lagrange.nodal (s.erase i) v).eval y := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
        rw [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_basis_eq hi, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hNi i hi),
          mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, c * M / q * (Lagrange.nodal (s.erase i) v).eval y :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hterm i hi) (hNi i hi)
    _ = M / q * (derivative (T ℝ q)).eval y := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← hsum, hderiv]; ring
    _ ≤ M / q * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        gcongr
        exact (abs_le.mp (abs_eval_derivative_T_real_le hy q)).2
    _ = q * M := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.Markov.abs_eval_le_of_abs_le_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  set α := (2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * π / (2 * q) with hα
  have hα0 : 0 ≤ α := (angle_mem hq).1.le
  have hαeq : α = π / 2 * (1 / q) := by rw [hα]; push_cast; ring
  have hαle : α ≤ π / 2 := by
    rw [hαeq]
    have : 1 / (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one hqpos]; exact_mod_cast hq
    nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hsin : 1 / (q : ℝ) ≤ sin α := by
    have := mul_le_sin hα0 hαle
    calc 1 / (q : ℝ) = 2 / π * α := by rw [hαeq]; field_simp
      _ ≤ _ := this
  have hcos : 0 ≤ cos α := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], hαle⟩
  have hy2 : y ^ 2 ≤ cos α ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs y]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg y) hy 2
  have hsqrt : sin α ≤ √(1 - y ^ 2) := by
    rw [← sqrt_sq (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hα0 (by linarith [pi_pos]))]
    apply sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq α]
  have hyI : y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have : chebyshevZero q ⟨0, hq⟩ ≤ 1 := (chebyshevZero_mem_Icc q ⟨0, hq⟩).2
    exact ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le y], by linarith [le_abs_self y]⟩
  have h1 : 1 / (q : ℝ) * |r.eval y| ≤ M :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsin.trans hsqrt) (abs_nonneg _)).trans (hM y hyI)
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hqpos] at h1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_le_mul_of_forall_sqrt_one_sub_sq_mul_abs_eval_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_le_mul_of_forall_sqrt_one_sub_sq_mul_abs_eval_le {q : ℕ} {r : ℝ[X]} {M x : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : r.degree < q)
    (hM : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - y ^ 2) * |r.eval y| ≤ M)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : |r.eval x| ≤ q * M
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (chebyshevZero q ⟨0, hq⟩) x with h | h
  · exact abs_eval_le_of_zero_le hq hr hM h hx.2
  rcases le_or_gt x (-chebyshevZero q ⟨0, hq⟩) with h' | h'
  · 
    have hr' : (r.comp (-X)).degree < q := by
      rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with h0 | h0
      · simp [h0]
      have hnat : r.natDegree < q := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h0).mpr hr
      refine degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt ?_
      have : (r.comp (-X)).natDegree ≤ r.natDegree := by
        have := natDegree_comp_le (p := r) (q := -X)
        simpa using this
      exact_mod_cast this.trans_lt hnat
    have hM' : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - y ^ 2) * |(r.comp (-X)).eval y| ≤ M := by
      intro y hy
      have := hM (-y) ⟨by linarith [hy.2], by linarith [hy.1]⟩
      simpa using this
    have := abs_eval_le_of_zero_le (y := -x) hq hr' hM' (by linarith) (by linarith [hx.1])
    simpa using this
  · exact abs_eval_le_of_abs_le_zero hq hM (abs_le.mpr ⟨h'.le, h.le⟩)

name: NLAlib.Markov.eval_add_eq_sum_hasseDeriv
statement:
private lemma eval_add_eq_sum_hasseDeriv (p : ℝ[X]) (c w : ℝ) :
    p.eval (c + w) = ∑ k ∈ range (p.natDegree + 1), (hasseDeriv k p).eval c * w ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, ← taylor_eval, eval_eq_sum_range, natDegree_taylor]
  simp [taylor_coeff]

name: NLAlib.Markov.eval_oddPart
proof:
:= by
  unfold oddPart
  rw [eval_neg, eval_finsetSum]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> simp [eval_comp]

name: NLAlib.Markov.eval_sub_eval_eq_two_mul_oddPart
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg (a * y) (b * s), eval_add_eq_sum_hasseDeriv, eval_add_eq_sum_hasseDeriv,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, eval_oddPart, mul_neg, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hk
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hk
    rw [Odd.neg_pow ⟨m, rfl⟩, show (2 * m + 1) / 2 = m by omega, ← hs]
    ring
  · rw [Even.neg_pow (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mp hk)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.Markov.eval_oddPart_one
statement:
private lemma eval_oddPart_one {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) (a b : ℝ) :
    (oddPart p a b).eval 1 = -(b * (derivative p).eval a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_oddPart, Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
  · simp [hasseDeriv_one]
  · intro k _ hk1
    split_ifs with hk
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hk
      have hm : (2 * m + 1) / 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [zero_pow hm]
    · rfl
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h

name: NLAlib.Markov.natDegree_oddPart_le
statement:
private lemma natDegree_oddPart_le (p : ℝ[X]) (a b : ℝ) :
    (oddPart p a b).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold oddPart
  rw [natDegree_neg]
  refine natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun k hk => ?_
  have hkd : k ≤ p.natDegree := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  split_ifs with hodd
  · have h1 : ((hasseDeriv k p).comp (C a * X)).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - k := by
      refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
      rw [natDegree_hasseDeriv]
      have : (C a * X).natDegree ≤ 1 := by compute_degree
      calc (p.natDegree - k) * (C a * X).natDegree ≤ (p.natDegree - k) * 1 :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this
        _ = p.natDegree - k := mul_one _
    have h2 : ((1 - X ^ 2 : ℝ[X]) ^ (k / 2)).natDegree ≤ k / 2 * 2 := by
      refine natDegree_pow_le.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_)
      compute_degree
    refine (natDegree_mul_le).trans ?_
    refine (add_le_add ((natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans h1) h2).trans ?_
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hodd
    omega
  · simp

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_derivative_le_div_sqrt_of_forall_abs_eval_le
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 < 1 := by
    rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
  set b := √(1 - x ^ 2) with hbdef
  have hb : 0 < b := sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 = 1 - x ^ 2 := sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.natDegree with hd | hd
  · rw [derivative_of_natDegree_zero hd, eval_zero, abs_zero]
    positivity
  have hqd : p.natDegree ≤ q := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp
  have hq : 0 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le hd hqd
  set r := oddPart p x b
  have hr : r.degree < q := by
