    refine degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt ?_
    have : r.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - 1 := natDegree_oddPart_le p x b
    exact_mod_cast (show r.natDegree < q by omega)
  have hrM : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - y ^ 2) * |r.eval y| ≤ M := by
    intro y hy
    have hy2 : 0 ≤ 1 - y ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hy.1, hy.2]
    set s := √(1 - y ^ 2)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := sqrt_nonneg _
    have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 - y ^ 2 := sq_sqrt hy2
    have key := eval_sub_eval_eq_two_mul_oddPart p x b hs2
    have hid : ∀ e : ℝ, e ^ 2 = 1 → (x * y + e * (b * s)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      intro e he
      have : (x * y + e * (b * s)) ^ 2 + (e * (x * s) - b * y) ^ 2 =
          (x ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (y ^ 2 + s ^ 2) := by
        linear_combination (b ^ 2 * s ^ 2 + x ^ 2 * s ^ 2) * he
      rw [hb2, hs2] at this
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (e * (x * s) - b * y)]
    have hmem : ∀ e : ℝ, e ^ 2 = 1 → x * y + e * (b * s) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro e he
      have := hid e he
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x * y + e * (b * s) - 1),
        sq_nonneg (x * y + e * (b * s) + 1)]
    have h1 := hM _ (hmem (-1) (by norm_num))
    have h2 := hM _ (hmem 1 (by norm_num))
    simp only [neg_mul, one_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at h1 h2
    have : |2 * s * r.eval y| ≤ 2 * M := by
      rw [← key]
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0] at this
    norm_num at this
    linarith
  have hS := abs_eval_le_mul_of_forall_sqrt_one_sub_sq_mul_abs_eval_le hq hr hrM
    (x := 1) ⟨by norm_num, le_rfl⟩
  rw [eval_oddPart_one hd, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hb] at hS
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hb]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_derivative_le_sq_mul_of_forall_abs_eval_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_le_sq_mul_of_forall_abs_eval_le {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} {M x : ℝ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hM : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval y| ≤ M)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(derivative p).eval x| ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * M
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
  · have : p.natDegree = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp (natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp)
    rw [derivative_of_natDegree_zero this]
    simp
  have hr : (derivative p).degree < q := by
    rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with h0 | h0
    · simp [h0]
    · exact (degree_derivative_lt h0).trans_le hp
  have hrM : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - y ^ 2) * |(derivative p).eval y| ≤ q * M := by
    intro y hy
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (abs_le.mpr ⟨hy.1, hy.2⟩) with hy1 | hy1
    · have hpos : 0 < √(1 - y ^ 2) := by
        apply sqrt_pos.mpr
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg y, sq_abs y]
      have := abs_eval_derivative_le_div_sqrt_of_forall_abs_eval_le hp hM hy1
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos] at this
      linarith
    · have : 1 - y ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [← sq_abs, hy1]; norm_num
      rw [this, sqrt_zero, zero_mul]
      positivity
  have := abs_eval_le_mul_of_forall_sqrt_one_sub_sq_mul_abs_eval_le hq hr hrM hx
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_derivative_le_two_mul_sq_div_mul_of_forall_abs_eval_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_le_two_mul_sq_div_mul_of_forall_abs_eval_le {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    {a b M x : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hM : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, |p.eval y| ≤ M) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    |(derivative p).eval x| ≤ 2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (b - a) * M
proof:
:= by
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  set L : ℝ[X] := C ((a + b) / 2) + C ((b - a) / 2) * X
  have hL : ∀ t : ℝ, L.eval t = (a + b) / 2 + (b - a) / 2 * t := fun t => by simp [L]
  set P := p.comp L
  have hP : P.degree ≤ q := by
    refine degree_le_of_natDegree_le ?_
    refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
    have h1 : L.natDegree ≤ 1 := by simp only [L]; compute_degree
    have h2 : p.natDegree ≤ q := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp
    calc p.natDegree * L.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree * 1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1
      _ ≤ q := by rw [mul_one]; exact h2
  have hPM : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |P.eval t| ≤ M := by
    intro t ht
    rw [eval_comp, hL]
    apply hM
    constructor <;> nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  set t₀ := (2 * x - a - b) / (b - a)
  have ht₀ : L.eval t₀ = x := by
    rw [hL]; simp only [t₀]; field_simp; ring
  have ht₀mem : t₀ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    simp only [t₀, Set.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hba]; linarith [hx.1]
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hba]; linarith [hx.2]
  have hmk := abs_eval_derivative_le_sq_mul_of_forall_abs_eval_le hP hPM ht₀mem
  have hder : (derivative P).eval t₀ = (b - a) / 2 * (derivative p).eval x := by
    simp only [P, derivative_comp, eval_mul, eval_comp, ht₀]
    simp [L]
  rw [hder, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (b - a) / 2)] at hmk
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hba]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.chebyshevAliasIndex_le
statement: theorem chebyshevAliasIndex_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (k : ℕ) : chebyshevAliasIndex N k ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt k (show 0 < 2 * N by omega)
  unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
  omega

name: NLAlib.eval_T_node_eq_eval_T_alias
statement:
theorem eval_T_node_eq_eval_T_alias {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (k j : ℕ) :
    (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j) =
      (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex N k : ℤ)).eval (node N j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [node, T_real_cos, T_real_cos]
  norm_cast
  let v := k % (2 * N)
  let m := k / (2 * N)
  have hk : k = v + 2 * N * m := by
    dsimp [v, m]
    exact (Nat.mod_add_div k (2 * N)).symm
  have hmod : v < 2 * N := Nat.mod_lt k (by omega)
  have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  have hangle : (k : ℝ) * (j * Real.pi / N) = (v : ℝ) * (j * Real.pi / N) +
      (m * j : ℕ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [hk]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [hangle, cos_add_nat_mul_two_pi]
  rcases le_or_gt v N with hv | hv
  · have hidx : chebyshevAliasIndex N k = v := by unfold chebyshevAliasIndex; dsimp [v] at hv ⊢; omega
    rw [hidx]
  · have hidx : chebyshevAliasIndex N k = 2 * N - v := by
      unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
      change min v (2 * N - v) = 2 * N - v
      omega
    rw [hidx]
    have hangle' : (v : ℝ) * (j * Real.pi / N) =
        (j : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) - ((2 * N - v : ℕ) : ℝ) * (j * Real.pi / N) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hmod.le]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hangle', cos_nat_mul_two_pi_sub]

name: NLAlib.chebyshev_node_injOn
statement: theorem chebyshev_node_injOn (N : ℕ) : Set.InjOn (node N) (Finset.range (N + 1) : Set ℕ)
proof:
:=
  (strictAntiOn_node N).injOn

name: NLAlib.interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_alias
statement:
theorem interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_alias {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (k : ℕ) :
    Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
      (fun j => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j)) = T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex N k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ (chebyshev_node_injOn N) ?_ ?_
  · rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast, card_range]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (chebyshevAliasIndex_le hN k))
  · intro j hj
    exact (eval_T_node_eq_eval_T_alias hN k j).symm

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_interpolate_eval_T_node_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_eval_interpolate_eval_T_node_le_one {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (k : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
      (fun j => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j))).eval x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_alias hN]
  exact abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx)

name: NLAlib.eval_T_real_eq_of_one_le
statement:
theorem eval_T_real_eq_of_one_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    (T ℝ q).eval x = ((x + √(x ^ 2 - 1)) ^ q + (x - √(x ^ 2 - 1)) ^ q) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < x + √(x ^ 2 - 1) := by positivity
  have h := T_real_cosh (arcosh x) (q : ℤ)
  rw [cosh_arcosh hx] at h
  rw [h, arcosh, ← add_sqrt_self_sq_sub_one_inv hx, Int.cast_natCast, ← Real.log_pow,
    cosh_log (pow_pos hs q), inv_pow]

name: NLAlib.pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real
statement:
theorem pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    (x + √(x ^ 2 - 1)) ^ q / 2 ≤ (T ℝ q).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_T_real_eq_of_one_le hx]
  have : 0 ≤ x - √(x ^ 2 - 1) := by
    rw [← add_sqrt_self_sq_sub_one_inv hx]; positivity
  have := pow_nonneg this q
  linarith

name: NLAlib.eval_T_real_le_pow
statement:
theorem eval_T_real_le_pow {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    (T ℝ q).eval x ≤ (x + √(x ^ 2 - 1)) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_T_real_eq_of_one_le hx]
  have h1 : 1 ≤ x + √(x ^ 2 - 1) := by have := Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ^ 2 - 1); linarith
  have h0 : 0 ≤ x - √(x ^ 2 - 1) := by
    rw [← add_sqrt_self_sq_sub_one_inv hx]; positivity
  have h2 : x - √(x ^ 2 - 1) ≤ x + √(x ^ 2 - 1) := by
    have := Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ^ 2 - 1); linarith
  have := pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 h2 q
  linarith

name: NLAlib.monotoneOn_eval_T_real
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_eval_T_real (q : ℕ) :
    MonotoneOn (fun x => (T ℝ q).eval x) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Set.mem_Ici] at hx hy
  simp only
  rw [← cosh_arcosh hx, ← cosh_arcosh hy, T_real_cosh, T_real_cosh, cosh_le_cosh]
  have ha : arcosh x ≤ arcosh y := (arcosh_le_arcosh (by linarith) (by linarith)).2 hxy
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (arcosh_nonneg hx), abs_of_nonneg (arcosh_nonneg hy)]; exact ha)
    (abs_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.one_add_sqrt_two_mul_pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real
statement:
theorem one_add_sqrt_two_mul_pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (q : ℕ) :
    (1 + √(2 * γ)) ^ q / 2 ≤ (T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ (pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real (by linarith) q)
  have hs : √(2 * γ) ≤ √((1 + γ) ^ 2 - 1) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
  have : 1 + √(2 * γ) ≤ 1 + γ + √((1 + γ) ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith
  have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) this q
  linarith

name: NLAlib.add_div_sub_add_sqrt_sq_sub_one_eq
statement:
theorem add_div_sub_add_sqrt_sq_sub_one_eq {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    (b + a) / (b - a) + √(((b + a) / (b - a)) ^ 2 - 1) = (√b + √a) / (√b - √a)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s < t →
      (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) / (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2) + √(((t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) / (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2)) ^ 2 - 1) =
        (t + s) / (t - s) := by
    intro s t hs hst
    have hd : 0 < t ^ 2 - s ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hts : 0 < t - s := by linarith
    have hsq : ((t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) / (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2)) ^ 2 - 1 = (2 * t * s / (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp; ring
    have ht : 0 < t := by linarith
    rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_sq (div_nonneg (by positivity) hd.le)]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h := key (√a) (√b) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 ha) (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt ha.le hab)
  rwa [Real.sq_sqrt ha.le, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)] at h

name: NLAlib.sqrt_add_div_sqrt_sub_pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real
statement:
theorem sqrt_add_div_sqrt_sub_pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ((√b + √a) / (√b - √a)) ^ q / 2 ≤ (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_div_sub_add_sqrt_sq_sub_one_eq ha hab]
  exact pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith) q

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_U_real_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_U_real_le {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (q : ℕ) :
    |(U ℝ q).eval x| ≤ q + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_iterate_derivative_T_real_le ((q : ℤ) + 1) 1 hx
  simp only [Function.iterate_one, T_derivative_eq_U, eval_mul, add_sub_cancel_right,
    U_eval_one] at h
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, eval_add, eval_natCast, eval_one]
    at h
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hq] at h
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hq

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_derivative_T_real_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_T_real_le {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (q : ℕ) :
    |(derivative (T ℝ q)).eval x| ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_iterate_derivative_T_real_le (q : ℤ) 1 hx
  simp only [Function.iterate_one] at h
  rwa [derivative_T_eval_one, Int.cast_natCast] at h

name: NLAlib.linearIndependent_aeval_T_adjoinRoot
statement:
private theorem linearIndependent_aeval_T_adjoinRoot {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : Fin p.natDegree => aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ i))
proof:
:= by
  apply linearIndependent_iff'.mpr
  intro s c hzero i hi
  let P : ℝ[X] := ∑ j ∈ s, c j • T ℝ (j : ℤ)
  have hPdeg : P.degree < p.natDegree := by
    apply mem_degreeLT.mp
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j hj
    apply Submodule.smul_mem
    apply mem_degreeLT.mpr
    rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast j.isLt
  have hPeval : aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) P = 0 := by
    simpa only [P, map_sum, map_smul] using hzero
  have hPzero : P = 0 := by
    by_contra hP
    have hmin := minpoly.degree_le_of_ne_zero ℝ (AdjoinRoot.root p) hP hPeval
    rw [AdjoinRoot.minpoly_root hp, degree_mul, degree_C (inv_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp)),
      add_zero, degree_eq_natDegree hp] at hmin
    exact (not_le_of_gt hPdeg) hmin
  have hlin : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j : Fin p.natDegree => T ℝ (j : ℤ)) :=
    (chebyshevTsequence ℝ).linearIndependent.comp Fin.val Fin.val_injective
  exact linearIndependent_iff'.mp hlin s c hPzero i hi

name: NLAlib.chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i : Fin p.natDegree) :
    chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp i = aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chebyshevQuotientBasis]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_colleagueMatrix
statement:
theorem charpoly_colleagueMatrix (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (colleagueMatrix p hp).charpoly = p * C p.leadingCoeff⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite ℝ (AdjoinRoot p) := Module.Finite.of_basis (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hp).basis
  let : Module.Free ℝ (AdjoinRoot p) := Module.Free.of_basis (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hp).basis
  rw [colleagueMatrix, Matrix.charpoly_transpose, leftMulMatrix_apply,
    LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix]
  have h := charpoly_leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hp)
  rw [leftMulMatrix_apply, LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix,
    AdjoinRoot.minpoly_powerBasis_gen hp] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_apply (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (j k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp j k = (chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp).repr
      (AdjoinRoot.root p * chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp j) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [colleagueMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_zero_row
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_zero_row (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hn : 2 ≤ p.natDegree)
    (k : Fin p.natDegree) : colleagueMatrix p hp ⟨0, by omega⟩ k =
      if k.val = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [colleagueMatrix_apply, chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, T_zero, map_one, mul_one]
  have hroot : AdjoinRoot.root p = chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp ⟨1, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
    simp
  rw [hroot, Basis.repr_self]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_interior_row
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_interior_row (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (j k : Fin p.natDegree) (hj0 : 0 < j.val) (hjn : j.val + 1 < p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp j k = (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      ((if j.val - 1 = k.val then 1 else 0) + (if j.val + 1 = k.val then 1 else 0))
proof:
:= by
  let prev : Fin p.natDegree := ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩
  let next : Fin p.natDegree := ⟨j.val + 1, hjn⟩
  have hbprev : chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp prev =
      aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ ((j.val : ℤ) - 1)) := by
    rw [chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
    congr 2
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ j.val by omega) :
      ((j.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = j.val - 1)
  have hbnext : chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp next =
      aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ ((j.val : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    rw [chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
    congr 1
  have hrec : (2 : ℝ[X]) * X * T ℝ (j.val : ℤ) =
      T ℝ ((j.val : ℤ) - 1) + T ℝ ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) := by
    have h := T_add_two ℝ ((j.val : ℤ) - 1)
    rw [sub_add_cancel, show (j.val : ℤ) - 1 + 2 = j.val + 1 by omega] at h
    linear_combination -h
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) • (AdjoinRoot.root p * chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp j) =
      chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp prev + chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp next := by
    rw [hbprev, hbnext, chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
    simpa only [map_mul, map_add, aeval_X, map_ofNat, Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc] using
      congrArg (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p)) hrec
  have hmul := congrArg (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • y) h2
  simp only [smul_smul, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 = 1 by norm_num, one_smul] at hmul
  rw [colleagueMatrix_apply, hmul, map_smul, map_add, Basis.repr_self, Basis.repr_self]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff,
    smul_eq_mul, prev, next]

name: NLAlib.leadingCoeff_eq_pow_mul_of_chebyshev_expansion
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_eq_pow_mul_of_chebyshev_expansion (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ)) :
    p.leadingCoeff = 2 ^ (p.natDegree - 1) * a p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (fun P : ℝ[X] => P.coeff p.natDegree) ha
  change p.coeff p.natDegree = _
  rw [hc, finsetSum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single p.natDegree]
  · rw [coeff_smul]
    have hT : (T ℝ (p.natDegree : ℤ)).coeff p.natDegree = 2 ^ (p.natDegree - 1) := by
      have hnd : (T ℝ (p.natDegree : ℤ)).natDegree = p.natDegree := by
        simp only [natDegree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
      calc
        _ = (T ℝ (p.natDegree : ℤ)).coeff (T ℝ (p.natDegree : ℤ)).natDegree := by rw [hnd]
        _ = (T ℝ (p.natDegree : ℤ)).leadingCoeff := coeff_natDegree
        _ = _ := by rw [leadingCoeff_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    rw [hT, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  · intro j hj hjn
    rw [coeff_smul, coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt, smul_zero]
    rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast (show j < p.natDegree by have h := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega)
  · simp

name: NLAlib.repr_aeval_T_natDegree
statement:
private theorem repr_aeval_T_natDegree (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))
    (han : a p.natDegree ≠ 0) (k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    (chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp).repr (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ p.natDegree)) k =
      -a k.val / a p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hpzero : aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) p = 0 := by rw [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self]
  have hzero := (congrArg (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p)) ha).symm.trans hpzero
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, map_add, map_sum, map_smul] at hzero
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree,
      aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))) =
      ∑ j : Fin p.natDegree, a j.val • chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp j := by
    symm
    simpa only [chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply, map_smul] using
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun j => aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))) p.natDegree
  rw [hsum] at hzero
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun y => (chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp).repr y k) hzero
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, map_zero, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    Finsupp.smul_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hcoord
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true] at hcoord
  apply (eq_div_iff han).mpr
  linear_combination hcoord

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_last_row
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_last_row (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))
    (han : a p.natDegree ≠ 0) (hn : 2 ≤ p.natDegree) (k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp ⟨p.natDegree - 1, by omega⟩ k =
      (if p.natDegree - 2 = k.val then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else 0) - a k.val / (2 * a p.natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin p.natDegree := ⟨p.natDegree - 1, by omega⟩
  let prev : Fin p.natDegree := ⟨p.natDegree - 2, by omega⟩
  have hrec : (2 : ℝ[X]) * X * T ℝ ((p.natDegree - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      T ℝ ((p.natDegree - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + T ℝ p.natDegree := by
    have h := T_add_two ℝ ((p.natDegree - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    rw [show ((p.natDegree - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 2 = p.natDegree by omega,
      show ((p.natDegree - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = ((p.natDegree - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega] at h
    linear_combination -h
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) • (AdjoinRoot.root p * chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp last) =
      chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp prev + aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ p.natDegree) := by
    rw [chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply, chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
    simpa only [map_mul, map_add, aeval_X, map_ofNat, Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc] using
      congrArg (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p)) hrec
  have hmul := congrArg (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • y) h2
  simp only [smul_smul, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 = 1 by norm_num, one_smul] at hmul
  change colleagueMatrix p hp last k = _
  rw [colleagueMatrix_apply, hmul, map_smul, map_add, Basis.repr_self]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff,
    smul_eq_mul, prev]
  rw [repr_aeval_T_natDegree p hp a ha han k]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_degree_one
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_degree_one (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))
    (han : a p.natDegree ≠ 0) (hn : p.natDegree = 1) (j k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp j k = -a 0 / a 1
proof:
:= by
  have hj : j.val = 0 := by have h := j.isLt; omega
  have hk : k.val = 0 := by have h := k.isLt; omega
  rw [colleagueMatrix_apply, chebyshevQuotientBasis_apply]
  simp only [hj, Nat.cast_zero, T_zero, map_one, mul_one]
  have hroot : AdjoinRoot.root p = aeval (AdjoinRoot.root p) (T ℝ p.natDegree) := by
    rw [hn]
    simp
  rw [hroot, repr_aeval_T_natDegree p hp a ha han k, hk, hn]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_colleagueMatrix_of_chebyshev_expansion
statement:
theorem charpoly_colleagueMatrix_of_chebyshev_expansion (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ)) :
    (colleagueMatrix p hp).charpoly = C (1 / (2 ^ (p.natDegree - 1) * a p.natDegree)) * p
proof:
:= by
  rw [charpoly_colleagueMatrix, leadingCoeff_eq_pow_mul_of_chebyshev_expansion p a ha]
  simp only [one_div, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.cost_one_le
statement: theorem cost_one_le (E F : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ) : (one E F k).cost ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold cost
  have h₁ : (⨆ z : E, (‖(one E F k).numerator.eval (z : ℂ) /
      (one E F k).denominator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ 1 := by simp [one]
  have h₂ : (⨆ z : F, (‖(one E F k).denominator.eval (z : ℂ) /
      (one E F k).numerator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ 1 := by simp [one]
  simpa using mul_le_mul' h₁ h₂

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.cost_restrict_le
statement:
theorem cost_restrict_le (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (hE : E' ⊆ E) (hF : F' ⊆ F) :
    (P.restrict hE hF).cost ≤ P.cost
proof:
:= by
  unfold cost
  apply mul_le_mul'
  · apply iSup_le; intro z
    exact le_iSup_of_le (⟨z, hE z.property⟩ : E) le_rfl
  · apply iSup_le; intro z
    exact le_iSup_of_le (⟨z, hF z.property⟩ : F) le_rfl

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.cost_mul_le
statement:
theorem cost_mul_le (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (Q : ZolotarevPair E F l) :
    (P.mul Q).cost ≤ P.cost * Q.cost
proof:
:= by
  let a := ⨆ z : E, (‖P.numerator.eval (z : ℂ) / P.denominator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
  let b := ⨆ z : F, (‖P.denominator.eval (z : ℂ) / P.numerator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
  let c := ⨆ z : E, (‖Q.numerator.eval (z : ℂ) / Q.denominator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
  let d := ⨆ z : F, (‖Q.denominator.eval (z : ℂ) / Q.numerator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
  have hleft : (⨆ z : E, (‖(P.numerator * Q.numerator).eval (z : ℂ) /
      (P.denominator * Q.denominator).eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ a * c := by
    dsimp only [a, c]
    apply iSup_le; intro z
    simp only [eval_mul, ← div_mul_div_comm, nnnorm_mul, ENNReal.coe_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul'
      (le_iSup (fun w : E => (‖P.numerator.eval (w : ℂ) / P.denominator.eval (w : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) z)
      (le_iSup (fun w : E => (‖Q.numerator.eval (w : ℂ) / Q.denominator.eval (w : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) z)
  have hright : (⨆ z : F, (‖(P.denominator * Q.denominator).eval (z : ℂ) /
      (P.numerator * Q.numerator).eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ b * d := by
    dsimp only [b, d]
    apply iSup_le; intro z
    simp only [eval_mul, ← div_mul_div_comm, nnnorm_mul, ENNReal.coe_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul'
      (le_iSup (fun w : F => (‖P.denominator.eval (w : ℂ) / P.numerator.eval (w : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) z)
      (le_iSup (fun w : F => (‖Q.denominator.eval (w : ℂ) / Q.numerator.eval (w : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) z)
  exact (mul_le_mul' hleft hright).trans_eq (by dsimp [cost, mul, a, b, c, d]; ac_rfl)

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.cost_ne_top
statement:
theorem cost_ne_top (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (hE : IsCompact E) (hF : IsCompact F) :
    P.cost ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : (⨆ z : E, (‖P.numerator.eval (z : ℂ) /
      P.denominator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) < ⊤ := by
    apply ENNReal.iSup_coe_lt_top.mpr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hE.bddAbove_image
      ((P.numerator.continuous.continuousOn.div P.denominator.continuous.continuousOn
        P.denominator_ne_zero).nnnorm)
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact hc ⟨z, z.property, rfl⟩
  have hright : (⨆ z : F, (‖P.denominator.eval (z : ℂ) /
      P.numerator.eval (z : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) < ⊤ := by
    apply ENNReal.iSup_coe_lt_top.mpr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hF.bddAbove_image
      ((P.denominator.continuous.continuousOn.div P.numerator.continuous.continuousOn
        P.numerator_ne_zero).nnnorm)
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact hc ⟨z, z.property, rfl⟩
  exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top hleft.ne hright.ne

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.leftSup_ne_top
statement: theorem leftSup_ne_top (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (hE : IsCompact E) : P.leftSup ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply ne_of_lt
  apply ENNReal.iSup_coe_lt_top.mpr
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hE.bddAbove_image
    ((P.numerator.continuous.continuousOn.div P.denominator.continuous.continuousOn
      P.denominator_ne_zero).nnnorm)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact hc ⟨z, z.property, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.rightSup_ne_top
statement: theorem rightSup_ne_top (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (hF : IsCompact F) : P.rightSup ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  P.swap.leftSup_ne_top hF

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.norm_div_le_leftSup_toReal
statement:
theorem norm_div_le_leftSup_toReal (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (hE : IsCompact E)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ E) : ‖P.numerator.eval z / P.denominator.eval z‖ ≤ P.leftSup.toReal
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono (P.leftSup_ne_top hE)
    (le_iSup (fun w : E => (‖P.numerator.eval (w : ℂ) / P.denominator.eval (w : ℂ)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)) ⟨z, hz⟩)
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.norm_div_le_rightSup_toReal
statement:
theorem norm_div_le_rightSup_toReal (P : ZolotarevPair E F k) (hF : IsCompact F)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ F) : ‖P.denominator.eval z / P.numerator.eval z‖ ≤ P.rightSup.toReal
proof:
:=
  P.swap.norm_div_le_leftSup_toReal hF hz

name: NLAlib.ZolotarevPair.cost_degree_zero
statement:
theorem cost_degree_zero (P : ZolotarevPair E F 0) (hE : E.Nonempty) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    P.cost = 1
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty E := hE.to_subtype
  let : Nonempty F := hF.to_subtype
  obtain ⟨a, hp⟩ : ∃ a : ℂ, P.numerator = C a :=
    ⟨_, eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero P.numerator_degree⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hq⟩ : ∃ b : ℂ, P.denominator = C b :=
    ⟨_, eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero P.denominator_degree⟩
  have hpn : a ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hF
    simpa only [hp, eval_C] using P.numerator_ne_zero z hz
  have hqn : b ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hE
    simpa only [hq, eval_C] using P.denominator_ne_zero z hz
  unfold cost
  simp only [hp, hq, eval_C, iSup_const, ← ENNReal.coe_mul]
  have hnorm : ‖a / b‖₊ * ‖b / a‖₊ = 1 := by
    have hab : a / b * (b / a) = 1 := by field_simp
    rw [← nnnorm_mul, hab, nnnorm_one]
  rw [hnorm, ENNReal.coe_one]

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_nonneg
statement: theorem zolotarevNumber_nonneg (E F : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ zolotarevNumber E F k
proof: := bot_le

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_le_one
statement: theorem zolotarevNumber_le_one (E F : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ) : zolotarevNumber E F k ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (iInf_le _ (ZolotarevPair.one E F k)).trans (ZolotarevPair.cost_one_le E F k)

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_ne_top
statement: theorem zolotarevNumber_ne_top (E F : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ) : zolotarevNumber E F k ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (zolotarevNumber_le_one E F k)

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_zero
statement:
theorem zolotarevNumber_zero (E F : Set ℂ) (hE : E.Nonempty) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    zolotarevNumber E F 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (zolotarevNumber_le_one E F 0)
  apply le_iInf
  intro P
  exact (P.cost_degree_zero hE hF).ge

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_antitone
statement: theorem zolotarevNumber_antitone (E F : Set ℂ) : Antitone (zolotarevNumber E F)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l h
  apply le_iInf; intro P
  exact iInf_le_of_le (P.enlarge h) le_rfl

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_mono_sets
statement:
theorem zolotarevNumber_mono_sets {E F E' F' : Set ℂ} (hE : E' ⊆ E) (hF : F' ⊆ F) (k : ℕ) :
    zolotarevNumber E' F' k ≤ zolotarevNumber E F k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_iInf; intro P
  exact (iInf_le _ (P.restrict hE hF)).trans (P.cost_restrict_le hE hF)

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_symm
statement:
theorem zolotarevNumber_symm (E F : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    zolotarevNumber E F k = zolotarevNumber F E k
proof:
:= by
  have h (E F : Set ℂ) : zolotarevNumber E F k ≤ zolotarevNumber F E k := by
    apply le_iInf; intro P
    exact iInf_le_of_le P.swap (by dsimp [ZolotarevPair.cost, ZolotarevPair.swap]; rw [mul_comm])
  exact le_antisymm (h E F) (h F E)

name: NLAlib.zolotarevNumber_add_le
statement:
theorem zolotarevNumber_add_le (E F : Set ℂ) (k l : ℕ) :
    zolotarevNumber E F (k + l) ≤ zolotarevNumber E F k * zolotarevNumber E F l
proof:
:= by
  apply ENNReal.le_iInf_mul_iInf
    ⟨ZolotarevPair.one E F k, ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (ZolotarevPair.cost_one_le E F k)⟩
    ⟨ZolotarevPair.one E F l, ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (ZolotarevPair.cost_one_le E F l)⟩
  intro P Q
  exact (iInf_le _ (P.mul Q)).trans (P.cost_mul_le Q)

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_eq {q : ℕ}
    {a b x : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {v : Fin q → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      f x - (Lagrange.hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b (f a) (f b) v
        (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial *
          ((x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b (f a) (f b) v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  let π := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  let ω := (X - C a) * (X - C b) * π ^ 2
  have hav (i : Fin q) : a ≠ v i := (hva i).1.ne
  have hbv (i : Fin q) : b ≠ v i := (hva i).2.ne'
  have hHa : H.eval a = f a := Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hav
  have hHb : H.eval b = f b :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hab.ne hav hbv
  have hHnode (i : Fin q) : H.eval (v i) = f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hHderiv (i : Fin q) : H.derivative.eval (v i) = deriv f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hπnode (i : Fin q) : π.eval (v i) = 0 := Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i)
  by_cases hωx : ω.eval x = 0
  · have hxroot : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ ∃ i, x = v i := by
      have heq : (x - a) * (x - b) * π.eval x ^ 2 = 0 := by simpa [ω] using hωx
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp heq with h | h
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h))
      · have hπ : π.eval x = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h
        rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_eq_zero_iff] at hπ
        obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hπ
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, sub_eq_zero.mp hi⟩)
    refine ⟨(a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    change f x - H.eval x = _ * ((x - a) * (x - b) * π.eval x ^ 2)
    rcases hxroot with rfl | rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rw [hHa]; ring
    · rw [hHb]; ring
    · rw [hHnode, hπnode]; ring
  let z : Multiset ℝ := (univ : Finset (Fin q)).val.map v
  let m : Multiset ℝ := z + z + {a} + {b}
  have hznd : z.Nodup := Multiset.Nodup.map hv univ.nodup
  have hzi (i : Fin q) : v i ∈ z := Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, by simp, rfl⟩
  have hza : a ∉ z := by
    intro h; obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h; exact hav i hi.symm
  have hzb : b ∉ z := by
    intro h; obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h; exact hbv i hi.symm
  have hzc (i : Fin q) : z.count (v i) = 1 := Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem hznd (hzi i)
  have hmca : m.count a = 1 := by simp [m, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hza, hab.ne]
  have hmcb : m.count b = 1 := by simp [m, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hzb, hab.ne.symm]
  have hmci (i : Fin q) : m.count (v i) = 2 := by simp [m, hzc i, (hav i).symm, (hbv i).symm]
  have hmcard : m.card = 2 * q + 2 := by simp [m, z]; omega
  have hωmon : ω.Monic := ((monic_X_sub_C a).mul (monic_X_sub_C b)).mul
    (Lagrange.nodal_monic.pow 2)
  have hωdeg : ω.natDegree = m.card := by
    dsimp only [ω]
    rw [natDegree_mul ((monic_X_sub_C a).mul (monic_X_sub_C b)).ne_zero
      (Lagrange.nodal_monic.pow 2).ne_zero,
      natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C a).ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C b).ne_zero]
    simp only [natDegree_X_sub_C, natDegree_pow, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal,
      card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ m, y ∈ Icc a b := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hya : y = a
    · subst y; exact ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩
    by_cases hyb : y = b
    · subst y; exact ⟨hab.le, le_rfl⟩
    have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hya, hyb] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
    exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hva i)
  have hrep : ∀ y ∈ m, 1 < m.count y → y ∈ Ioo a b := by
    intro y hy hc
    have hya : y ≠ a := by intro h; subst y; rw [hmca] at hc; omega
    have hyb : y ≠ b := by intro h; subst y; rw [hmcb] at hc; omega
    have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hya, hyb] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
    exact hva i
  have hωjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y, (derivative^[k] ω).eval y = 0 := by
    intro y hy k hk
    by_cases hya : y = a
    · subst y
      rw [hmca] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simp [hk0, ω]
    by_cases hyb : y = b
    · subst y
      rw [hmcb] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simp [hk0, ω]
    have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hya, hyb] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
    rw [hmci i] at hk
    rcases (show k = 0 ∨ k = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
    · simp [ω, hπnode i]
    · simp [ω, derivative_mul, derivative_pow, hπnode i]
  have hjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y,
      iteratedDeriv k f y = (derivative^[k] H).eval y := by
    intro y hy k hk
    by_cases hya : y = a
    · subst y
      rw [hmca] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simpa [hk0] using hHa.symm
    by_cases hyb : y = b
    · subst y
      rw [hmcb] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simpa [hk0] using hHb.symm
    have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hya, hyb] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
    rw [hmci i] at hk
    rcases (show k = 0 ∨ k = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using (hHnode i).symm
    · simpa using (hHderiv i).symm
  have hHdegree : H.degree < m.card := by
    rw [hmcard]
    exact Lagrange.degree_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_lt _ _ _ _ hv _ _
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_sub_eval_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_of_multiset m
    (by rw [hmcard]; omega) hmem hrep hHdegree hωmon hωdeg hωjet hjet hf
    (by simpa only [hmcard] using hf') hx hωx
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [H, hmcard, ω, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow] using he

name: NLAlib.quadrature_error_bounds_and_continuous_convergence
statement:
theorem quadrature_error_bounds_and_continuous_convergence
    {ι : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, Fintype (ι n)] [∀ n, DecidableEq (ι n)]
    (hcard : ∀ n, Fintype.card (ι n) = n + 1)
    (v : ∀ n, ι n → ℝ) (hv : ∀ n, Function.Injective (v n))
    (hvI : ∀ n i, v n i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ n (p : ℝ[X]), p.degree < Fintype.card (ι n) →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ (v n)).eval x * p.eval x = 0)
    {A : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hAd : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖A z‖ ≤ M)
    {ν : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (A x).re) - clenshawCurtisRule n (fun x => (A x).re)| ≤
        (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (n - 1) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (A x).re) -
        ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ (v n) i).eval x) * (A (v n i)).re| ≤
          (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (2 * n) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ν < n → 2 ≤ n →
      |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) - clenshawCurtisRule n (F 0)| ≤
        32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ν < 2 * n + 1 →
      |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) -
        ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ (v n) i).eval x) * F 0 (v n i)| ≤
          32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν) ^ ν)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, quadratureBvThreshold ν ≤ n →
      |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) - clenshawCurtisRule n (F 0)| ≤
        32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν) ^ ν)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => clenshawCurtisRule n f) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1,
      (Lagrange.basis univ (v n) i).eval x) * f (v n i)) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    exact abs_integral_re_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hAd hM hn
  · intro n hn
    exact abs_integral_re_sub_gauss_lebesgue_le_of_open_ellipse hn (hcard n)
      (v n) (hv n) (hvI n) (horth n) hρ hAd hM
  · intro n hn hn2
    exact abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_of_bv hν hn hn2 hAC hderiv hBV hV
  · intro n hn hnν
    exact abs_integral_sub_gauss_lebesgue_le_of_bv hn hν hnν (hcard n)
      (v n) (hv n) (hvI n) (horth n) hAC hderiv hBV hV
  · intro n hn
    exact abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_eventual_of_bv hν hn hAC hderiv hBV hV
  · exact tendsto_clenshawCurtisRule_of_continuousOn hf
  · exact tendsto_gauss_lebesgue_of_continuousOn hcard v hv hvI horth hf

name: NLAlib.endpointNodeFamily_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · simp
  · intro h
    exact (ha _ h).elim
  · intro h
    exact (ha _ h.symm).elim
  · intro h
    exact congrArg Fin.succ (hv h)

name: NLAlib.nodal_endpointNodeFamily
statement:
theorem nodal_endpointNodeFamily {q : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : Fin q → ℝ) :
    Lagrange.nodal univ (endpointNodeFamily a v) = (X - C a) * Lagrange.nodal univ v
proof:
:= by
  simp [Lagrange.nodal_eq, Fin.prod_univ_succ, endpointNodeFamily]

name: NLAlib.nodal_twoEndpointNodeFamily
statement:
theorem nodal_twoEndpointNodeFamily {q : ℕ} (a b : ℝ) (v : Fin q → ℝ) :
    Lagrange.nodal univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v) =
      (X - C a) * (X - C b) * Lagrange.nodal univ v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twoEndpointNodeFamily, nodal_endpointNodeFamily, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_modified_orthogonality
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_modified_orthogonality
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : Fin q → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i)
    (horth : ∀ r : ℝ[X], r.degree < q →
      (∫ x, (x - a) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * r.eval x ∂μ) = 0)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i : Fin (q + 1),
      (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis univ (endpointNodeFamily a v) i).eval x ∂μ) *
        p.eval (endpointNodeFamily a v i)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (integral_eq_quadrature_iff hμ
    (s := univ) (show (univ : Finset (Fin (q + 1))).Nonempty from ⟨0, mem_univ _⟩)
    (endpointNodeFamily_injective hv ha).injOn
    (fun i => ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis univ (endpointNodeFamily a v) i).eval x ∂μ) q).mpr
    ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, by
      intro r hr
      simp only [nodal_endpointNodeFamily, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      exact horth r hr⟩
  have hp' : p.degree < ((univ : Finset (Fin (q + 1))).card + q : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, show q + 1 + q = 2 * q + 1 by omega] using hp
  simpa using he p hp'

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_modified_orthogonality
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_modified_orthogonality
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) (hb : ∀ i, b ≠ v i)
    (horth : ∀ r : ℝ[X], r.degree < q →
      (∫ x, (x - a) * (b - x) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * r.eval x ∂μ) = 0)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i : Fin (q + 2),
      (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v) i).eval x ∂μ) *
        p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v) :=
    endpointNodeFamily_injective (endpointNodeFamily_injective hv hb)
      (fun i => Fin.cases hab ha i)
  have he := (integral_eq_quadrature_iff hμ
    (s := univ) (show (univ : Finset (Fin (q + 2))).Nonempty from ⟨0, mem_univ _⟩)
    hinj.injOn
    (fun i => ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v) i).eval x ∂μ) q).mpr
    ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, by
      intro r hr
      have heq : (fun x => (Lagrange.nodal univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v)).eval x * r.eval x) =
          fun x => -((x - a) * (b - x) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * r.eval x) := by
        funext x
        simp only [nodal_twoEndpointNodeFamily, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
        ring
      rw [heq, integral_neg, horth r hr, neg_zero]⟩
  have hp' : p.degree < ((univ : Finset (Fin (q + 2))).card + q : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, show q + 2 + q = 2 * q + 2 by omega] using hp
  simpa using he p hp'

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_eval_T_eq_zero_of_symmetric
statement:
private theorem sum_mul_eval_T_eq_zero_of_symmetric {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (v w : ι → ℝ) (σ : ι ≃ ι) (hv : ∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) (hw : ∀ i, w (σ i) = w i)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k) : ∑ i, w i * (T ℝ k).eval (v i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := σ.sum_comp (fun i => w i * (T ℝ k).eval (v i))
  simp only [hv, hw, T_eval_neg, Int.cast_negOnePow_natCast, hk.neg_one_pow,
    neg_one_mul, mul_neg] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_sum_mul_eval_T_le_two
statement:
private theorem abs_sum_mul_eval_T_le_two {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hmass : ∑ i, w i = 2) (k : ℕ) : |∑ i, w i * (T ℝ k).eval (v i)| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc _ ≤ ∑ i, |w i * (T ℝ k).eval (v i)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i, w i * |(T ℝ k).eval (v i)| := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hw i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, w i := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hw i) (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr (hv i)))
    _ = 2 := hmass

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_even_tail
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_even_tail
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hmass : ∑ i, w i = 2)
    (σ : ι ≃ ι) (hvσ : ∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) (hwσ : ∀ i, w (σ i) = w i)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x)) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i)| ≤
      (32 / 15 : ℝ) * ∑' k, if 2 * n + 1 < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ∑ i, w i * (T ℝ k).eval (v i)
  let u := fun k => c k * (chebyshevMoment k - Q k)
  let tail := fun k => if 2 * n + 1 < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0
  have hQ : HasSum (fun k => c k * Q k) (∑ i, w i * f (v i)) := by
    have h := hasSum_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i hi => (hf (v i) (hv i)).mul_left (w i))
    convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
    funext k
    dsimp [Q]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  have he : HasSum u ((∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i)) := by
    have h := (hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_of_hasSum hs hf).sub hQ
    convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
    funext k
    dsimp [u]
    ring
  have ht : Summable tail := hs.of_nonneg_of_le (by intro k; dsimp [tail]; split_ifs <;> positivity)
    (by intro k; dsimp [tail]; split_ifs <;> simp)
  have hb (k : ℕ) : ‖u k‖ ≤ (32 / 15 : ℝ) * tail k := by
    by_cases hkn : 2 * n + 1 < k
    · by_cases hk : Even k
      · have hk4 : 4 ≤ k := by omega
        have h1 := abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two_div_fifteen hk4
        have h2 := abs_sum_mul_eval_T_le_two v w hv hw hmass k
        have hmode : |chebyshevMoment k - Q k| ≤ 32 / 15 := by
          have h := abs_sub (chebyshevMoment k) (Q k)
          dsimp [Q] at h ⊢
          linarith
        dsimp [u, tail]
        rw [if_pos ⟨hkn, hk⟩, abs_mul]
        calc |c k| * |chebyshevMoment k - Q k| ≤ |c k| * (32 / 15) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmode (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
      · have hko : Odd k := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hk
        have hodd := sum_mul_eval_T_eq_zero_of_symmetric v w σ hvσ hwσ hko
        simp [u, Q, tail, chebyshevMoment, hk, hodd]
    · have hdeg : (T ℝ k).degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) := by
        rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
        exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ 2 * n + 1 by omega)
      have h := hexact (T ℝ k) hdeg
      rw [integral_eval_T] at h
      change chebyshevMoment k = Q k at h
      simp [u, tail, hkn, h]
  have hnorm : Summable (fun k => ‖u k‖) := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _) hb
    (ht.mul_left (32 / 15 : ℝ))
  have hnormle := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
  rw [he.tsum_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnormle
  refine hnormle.trans ?_
  calc (∑' k, ‖u k‖) ≤ ∑' k, (32 / 15 : ℝ) * tail k :=
      Summable.tsum_le_tsum hb hnorm (ht.mul_left (32 / 15 : ℝ))
    _ = _ := by rw [tsum_mul_left]

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_geometric
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_geometric
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hmass : ∑ i, w i = 2)
    (σ : ι ≃ ι) (hvσ : ∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) (hwσ : ∀ i, w (σ i) = w i)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x))
    {q M : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hc : ∀ k, 0 < k → |c k| ≤ 2 * M * q ^ k) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i)| ≤
      (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M * q ^ (2 * n + 2) / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_geometric hs hq0 hq1 hM hc (2 * n + 1)
  refine (abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_even_tail v w hv hw hmass σ hvσ hwσ hn hexact hs hf).trans ?_
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 32 / 15)
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_re_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_integral_re_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_of_open_ellipse
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hmass : ∑ i, w i = 2)
    (σ : ι ≃ ι) (hvσ : ∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) (hwσ : ∀ i, w (σ i) = w i)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (F x).re) - ∑ i, w i * (F (v i)).re| ≤
      (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (2 * n) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans
    (abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM)
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < ρ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hρ0
  have hq1 : ρ⁻¹ < 1 := (inv_lt_one₀ hρ0).mpr hρ
  have hc (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| ≤ 2 * M * (ρ⁻¹) ^ k := by
    have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hk
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using h
  have hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k|) := by
    apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => abs_nonneg _) ?_
      ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0.le hq1).mul_left (2 * M))
    intro k
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM
      simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using h.trans (by linarith : M ≤ 2 * M)
    · exact hc k hk
  have h := abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_geometric v w hv hw hmass σ hvσ hwσ hn hexact hs
    (fun x hx => hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hx)
    hq0 hq1 hM0 hc
  have heq : (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * n + 2) / (1 - (ρ⁻¹) ^ 2) =
      (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (2 * n) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1)) := by
    rw [pow_add]
    simp only [inv_pow]
    have hsq : ρ ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hρ0, hsq]
  exact h.trans_eq heq

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_power_envelope
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_power_envelope
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hcS : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x))
    {n p : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hp : 2 ≤ p) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hc : ∀ k, n < k → |c k| ≤ A / (k : ℝ) ^ p) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - clenshawCurtisRule n f| ≤ 7 * A / (n : ℝ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let u := fun k => c k * (chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k))
  have he : HasSum u ((∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - clenshawCurtisRule n f) := by
    have h := (hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_of_hasSum hcS hf).sub
      (hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_of_hasSum hcS hf (by omega : 0 < n))
    convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
    funext k
    dsimp [u]
    ring
  have hu (k : ℕ) : ‖u k‖ ≤ 4 * |c k| := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, show u k = c k * (chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)) by rfl,
      abs_mul]
    have hdiff : |chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)| ≤ 4 := by
      have h := abs_sub (chebyshevMoment k) (chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k))
      have h1 := abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two k
      have h2 := abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)
      linarith
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiff (abs_nonneg (c k))
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  have huS : Summable (fun k => ‖u k‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _) hu (hcS.mul_left 4)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j) := by intro a b h; dsimp only at h; omega
  have hsup : Function.support (fun k => ‖u k‖) ⊆ Set.range (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j) := by
    intro k hk
    have hkE : Even k := by
      by_contra hkE
      have hka : ¬ Even (chebyshevAliasIndex n k) :=
        fun h => hkE ((even_chebyshevAliasIndex_iff (by omega) k).mp h)
      have hz : u k = 0 := by simp [u, chebyshevMoment, hkE, hka]
      exact hk (by simp [hz])
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hkE
    exact ⟨j, by dsimp only; omega⟩
  let a := fun j : ℕ => if n < 2 * j then |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)| else 0
  let b := fun j : ℕ => if n < 2 * j then
    |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))| else 0
  have hs (v : ℕ → ℕ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (m : ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ k, |m k| ≤ 2) :
      Summable (fun j => if n < v j then |c (v j)| * |m (v j)| else 0) := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => by split_ifs <;> positivity) ?_
      ((hcS.comp_injective hv).mul_left 2)
    intro j
    split_ifs
    · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm (v j)) (abs_nonneg (c (v j)))
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using h
    · dsimp only [Function.comp_def]; positivity
  have haS : Summable a := hs _ hinj chebyshevMoment abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two
  have hbS : Summable b := hs _ hinj (fun k => chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k))
    (fun k => abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two _)
  have hbound (j : ℕ) : ‖u (2 * j)‖ ≤ a j + b j := by
    by_cases hk : n < 2 * j
    · dsimp [u, a, b]
      rw [if_pos hk, if_pos hk, abs_mul, ← mul_add]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sub _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
    · have halias : chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j) = 2 * j := by
        unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega), min_eq_left (by omega)]
      simp [u, a, b, hk, halias]
  have hsum := (huS.comp_injective hinj).tsum_le_tsum hbound (haS.add hbS)
  rw [haS.tsum_add hbS] at hsum
  have hnorm := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm huS
  rw [he.tsum_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hinj.tsum_eq hsup] at hnorm
  have ha := tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_even_tail_le hcS (show 0 < n by omega) hA hc
  have hb := tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_even_tail_le hcS hn hp hA hc
  exact (hnorm.trans hsum).trans ((add_le_add ha hb).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_stronger_rate_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_stronger_rate_of_bv
    {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hnν : ν ≤ n) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hs : (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2 < n + 1)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) - clenshawCurtisRule n (F 0)| ≤
      14 * V / (Real.pi * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1)) * (n : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hd : 0 < 1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1) :=
    sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr hs)
  have hcS := summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv hν hAC hderiv hBV hV
  have hf : ContinuousOn (F 0) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by simpa using (hAC 0 hν).continuousOn
  have hc (k : ℕ) (hk : n < k) := abs_le_power_envelope_of_descFactorial hV0 hnν hk hs
    (abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial hAC hderiv hBV hV (show ν + 1 ≤ k by omega))
  have h := abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_power_envelope hcS
    (fun x hx => hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hcS hx) hn2 (show 2 ≤ ν + 1 by omega)
    (show 0 ≤ 2 * V / (Real.pi * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1))) by positivity) hc
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_eventual_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_eventual_of_bv
    {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : quadratureBvThreshold ν ≤ n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) - clenshawCurtisRule n (F 0)| ≤
      32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hνR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ν := by exact_mod_cast hν
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ ν := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have ht := mul_pow_le_sub_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le hn
  have hb : (105 / 16 : ℝ) ≤ (105 / 16 : ℝ) * ν * 2 ^ ν := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (Nat.cast_nonneg ν : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ν)
    nlinarith
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2 := by positivity
    exact_mod_cast (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ n by linarith)
  have hnν : ν ≤ n := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (ν : ℝ) ≤ n by nlinarith)
  have hs : (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2 < n + 1 := by linarith
  exact (abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_stronger_rate_of_bv hν hnν hn2 hs hAC hderiv hBV hV).trans
    (bv_stronger_rate_le_eventual_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le (by omega) hn hV0)

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_radau_degree_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_radau_degree_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (ht : t = a ∨ t = b) {q : ℕ}
    (v w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvi : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b) (hvt : t ∈ Set.range v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ u : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective u ∧ (∀ i, u i ∈ Icc a b) ∧ (∀ i, t ≠ u i) ∧
        (∀ i, v (e i) = endpointNodeFamily t u i) ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i) =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ u).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hboth : a ∈ Set.range v ∧ b ∈ Set.range v
  · have he (g : ℝ → ℝ) := integral_eq_radau_degree_rule_of_both_endpoints
      hab hμ v w hv hvi hboth.1 hboth.2 hexact g
    obtain ⟨e, u, hu, heu⟩ := exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily v hv hvt
    have hui (i : Fin q) : u i ∈ Icc a b := by
      simpa only [heu, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_succ] using hvi (e i.succ)
    have htu (i : Fin q) : t ≠ u i := by
      intro h
      have hid := e.injective (hv ((heu 0).trans (h.trans (heu i.succ).symm)))
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hid
      simp at hval
    let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ u).eval x ^ 2
    have hW (i : Fin (q + 1)) : W (v i) = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := e.surjective i
      rw [heu j]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · simp [W, endpointNodeFamily]
      · simp [W, endpointNodeFamily, Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ j)]
    have hz : (∫ x, W x ∂μ) = 0 := by simpa only [hW, mul_zero, sum_const_zero] using he W
    refine ⟨e, u, hu, hui, htu, heu, (a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [he f, sub_self]
    change 0 = _ * ∫ x, W x ∂μ
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · have hint (i : Fin (q + 1)) (hne : v i ≠ t) : v i ∈ Ioo a b := by
      have ha : v i ≠ a := by
        intro h
        rcases ht with ht | ht
        · exact hne (h.trans ht.symm)
        · exact hboth ⟨⟨i, h⟩, by simpa only [ht] using hvt⟩
      have hb : v i ≠ b := by
        intro h
        rcases ht with ht | ht
        · exact hboth ⟨by simpa only [ht] using hvt, ⟨i, h⟩⟩
        · exact hne (h.trans ht.symm)
      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne (hvi i).1 ha.symm, lt_of_le_of_ne (hvi i).2 hb⟩
    obtain ⟨e, u, hu, hui, heu, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
      exists_integral_sub_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_endpoint hab hμ ht v w hv hvt hint hexact hf hf' hD
    have htu (i : Fin q) : t ≠ u i := by
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · exact (hui i).1.ne
      · exact (hui i).2.ne'
    exact ⟨e, u, hu, fun i => ⟨(hui i).1.le, (hui i).2.le⟩, htu, heu, ξ, hξ, herr⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_gaussRule_of_support_encard
statement:
theorem integral_eq_gaussRule_of_support_encard {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : μ.support.encard = (n : ℕ∞)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    let hMom
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hMom n i * f (gaussNodes μ hMom n i) := by
  dsimp only
  let hMom := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ
  have hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := hn.ge
  have hfinite := Set.finite_of_encard_eq_coe hn
  have hncard : hfinite.toFinset.card = n := by
    exact_mod_cast (hfinite.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card.symm.trans hn)
  have hzero := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_zero_of_finite_support μ hMom hfinite
  rw [hncard] at hzero
  have hnodalzero : (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ (gaussNodes μ hMom n)).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
    rw [nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hMom hs]
    simpa only [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow] using hzero
  exact integral_eq_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_sq_eq_zero hμ hn0
    (gaussNodes μ hMom n) (gaussWeights μ hMom n) (gaussNodes_injective hMom hs)
    (fun p hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hMom hn0 hs hp) hnodalzero f

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_leading
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_leading (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1)).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc =
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.isTridiagonal_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem isTridiagonal_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ q, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    IsTridiagonal (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q)
proof:
:= by
  have hH := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    have hs : orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q i j =
        orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q j i := by
      have h := congrFun (congrFun hH i) j
      simpa only [conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial] using h.symm
    rw [hs]
    exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL j i hij
  · intro i j hij
    exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL j i hij

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_finSymmetricBorder
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_finSymmetricBorder
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) =
      finSymmetricBorder (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q) (momentJacobiLastCoupling L q)
        (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · simp
  · rw [finSymmetricBorder_last_castSucc]
    change L (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L q) =
      L (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L q * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val)
    exact congrArg L (by ac_rfl)
  · rw [finSymmetricBorder_castSucc_last]
    rfl
  · rw [finSymmetricBorder_castSucc_castSucc]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_radauJacobiMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_radauJacobiMatrix_pow {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a c : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 2 * q) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    (∫ x : ℝ, x ^ k ∂μ) = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a ^ k) 0 0 ∧
    (∫ x : ℝ, x ^ k ∂μ) = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c ^ k) 0 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  have hL (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ q + 1) : hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ ((by exact_mod_cast hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ q + 1).trans hs)
  have hv (i : Fin q) (hi : i.val + 1 < q) : momentJacobiLastCoupling L q i = 0 :=
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL i.castSucc (Fin.last q) hi
  have htri := isTridiagonal_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q (fun j hj => hL j (by omega))
  have hm := integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_pow hμ
    (Nat.succ_pos q) hs (by omega : k < 2 * (q + 1))
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_finSymmetricBorder] at hm
  have hl := pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_corner htri hv
    (leftRadauCorner (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q) (momentJacobiLastCoupling L q) a)
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q)) k hk
  have hr := pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_corner htri hv
    (rightRadauCorner (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q) (momentJacobiLastCoupling L q) c)
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q)) k hk
  exact ⟨hm.trans (congrArg (fun x => (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * x) hl.symm),
    hm.trans (congrArg (fun x => (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * x) hr.symm)⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_lobattoJacobiMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_lobattoJacobiMatrix_pow {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a c : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 2 * q + 1) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    (∫ x : ℝ, x ^ k ∂μ) = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c ^ k) 0 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1)
  let e : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1
  have hL (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ q + 1) : hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ ((by exact_mod_cast hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ q + 1).trans hs)
  have hv (i : Fin (q + 1)) (hi : i.val < q) :
      (Real.sqrt (lobattoCouplingSq J e a c) • e) i = 0 := by
    have hne : i ≠ Fin.last q := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp at this; omega
    simp [e, hne]
  have htri := isTridiagonal_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) hL
  have hm := integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_pow hμ
    (Nat.succ_pos q) hs (by omega : k < 2 * (q + 1))
  have hl := pow_finSymmetricBorder_apply_zero_eq_of_coupling htri hv (lobattoCorner J e a c) k hk
  rw [pow_finSymmetricBorder_zero_apply_zero] at hl
  exact hm.trans (by congr 1; exact hl.symm)

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_sub_sum_gaussWeights_le_of_polynomial_approx
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sub_sum_gaussWeights_le_of_polynomial_approx
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) {p : ℂ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2*n : ℕ))
    {ε : ℝ} (happrox : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ‖f x - p.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖(∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i)‖ ≤ 2 * μ.real univ * ε
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  have hint : Integrable f μ := by
    refine (hf.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx hnot
    exact (hnot hx).elim
  have hexact := integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn hp
  have heq : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) =
      (∫ x, f x - p.eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ) -
        ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
          (f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) - p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)) := by
    rw [integral_sub hint (hμ.integrable_complex_eval p)]
    simp only [mul_sub, sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hexact]
    ring
  have hb1 : ‖∫ x, f x - p.eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ‖ ≤ ε * μ.real univ :=
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (by filter_upwards [hs] with x hx; exact happrox x hx)
  have hb2 : ‖∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      (f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) - p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))‖ ≤ μ.real univ * ε := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, ‖(gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
          (f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) - p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hμ n i * ε := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (gaussWeights_pos hμ hn i)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (happrox _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i))
          (gaussWeights_pos hμ hn i).le
      _ = μ.real univ * ε := by rw [← sum_mul, sum_gaussWeights_eq_measure_univ hμ hn0 hn]; rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by nlinarith [hb1, hb2])

name: NLAlib.norm_stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_le_geometric
statement:
theorem norm_stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_le_geometric
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hRI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |x| ≤ R) {z : ℂ} (hz : R < ‖z‖) :
    ‖stieltjesTransform μ z -
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖ ≤
      2 * μ.real univ * R^(2*n) / (‖z‖^(2*n) * (‖z‖-R))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (hR.trans_lt hz)
  have hzI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx heq
    have hnz : ‖z‖ = |x| := by rw [heq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hRI x hx)) (hnz ▸ hz)
  have happrox (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :
      ‖(z-(x:ℂ))⁻¹ - (geometricResolventPolynomial z (2*n)).eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤
        R^(2*n)/(‖z‖^(2*n)*(‖z‖-R)) := by
    rw [inv_sub_eval_geometricResolventPolynomial_eq hz0 (hzI x hx), norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow,
      norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hden : ‖z‖-R ≤ ‖z-(x:ℂ)‖ := by
      have h := norm_sub_norm_le z (x : ℂ)
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      linarith [hRI x hx]
    calc
      _ ≤ R^(2*n)/(‖z‖^(2*n)*‖z-(x:ℂ)‖) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hRI x hx) _)
          (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg hR _)
        (mul_pos (pow_pos (hR.trans_lt hz) _) (sub_pos.mpr hz))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hden (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
  rw [eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div hμ hs hn0 hn hzI]
  have he := norm_integral_sub_sum_gaussWeights_le_of_polynomial_approx hμ hs hn0 hn
    ((continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal).continuousOn.inv₀
      (fun x hx => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hzI x hx)))
    (degree_geometricResolventPolynomial_lt z (2*n)) happrox
  simpa only [stieltjesTransform, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_div_assoc, mul_assoc,
    Pi.inv_apply, Pi.sub_apply] using he

name: NLAlib.moment_hierarchy_of_le_support
statement:
private theorem moment_hierarchy_of_le_support {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {N : ℕ} (hs : (N : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    (∀ k ≤ N, hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ k < N, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun k hk => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ N).trans hs),
    fun k hk => orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ N).trans hs)⟩

name: NLAlib.radau_border_shape_and_superdiagonal
statement:
private theorem radau_border_shape_and_superdiagonal {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (d : ℝ) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q
    let v := momentJacobiLastCoupling L q
    IsTridiagonal (finSymmetricBorder J v d) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin (q + 1), i.val + 1 = j.val → finSymmetricBorder J v d i j ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  obtain ⟨hL, hH⟩ := moment_hierarchy_of_le_support hμ hs
  have hLq (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := hL k (by change k ≤ q + 1; omega)
  have hHq (k : ℕ) (hk : k < q) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k := hH k (by change k < q + 1; omega)
  have htri := isTridiagonal_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q hLq
  have hv (i : Fin q) (hi : i.val + 1 < q) : momentJacobiLastCoupling L q i = 0 :=
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL i.castSucc (Fin.last q) hi
  refine ⟨isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder htri hv d,
    finSymmetricBorder_superdiagonal_ne_zero d ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_pos L hLq hHq i j hij).ne'
  · intro i hi
    exact (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_pos L hL hH i.castSucc
      (Fin.last q) hi).ne'

name: NLAlib.radauNodes_injective_and_weights_pos
statement:
theorem radauNodes_injective_and_weights_pos {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a c : ℝ) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    Function.Injective (leftRadauNodes L q a) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < leftRadauWeights L q a i) ∧
      Function.Injective (rightRadauNodes L q c) ∧ ∀ i, 0 < rightRadauWeights L q c i := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  have hmass : 0 < L 1 := by
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_one] using integral_one_pos_of_one_le_support_encard
      hμ ((by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ q + 1 by omega) : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ q + 1).trans hs)
  obtain ⟨hltri, hlsub⟩ := radau_border_shape_and_superdiagonal hμ hs
    (leftRadauCorner (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q) (momentJacobiLastCoupling L q) a)
  obtain ⟨hrtri, hrsub⟩ := radau_border_shape_and_superdiagonal hμ hs
    (rightRadauCorner (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q) (momentJacobiLastCoupling L q) c)
  obtain ⟨hln, hlw⟩ := rootedMatrixRule_nodes_injective_and_weights_pos (Nat.succ_pos q)
    (isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) hltri hlsub hmass
  obtain ⟨hrn, hrw⟩ := rootedMatrixRule_nodes_injective_and_weights_pos (Nat.succ_pos q)
    (isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) hrtri hrsub hmass
  exact ⟨hln, hlw, hrn, hrw⟩

name: NLAlib.lobattoNodes_injective_and_weights_pos
statement:
theorem lobattoNodes_injective_and_weights_pos {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a c : ℝ) (hac : a < c)
    (hJa : (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1) - a • 1).PosDef)
    (hJc : (c • 1 - orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1)).PosDef) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    Function.Injective (lobattoNodes L q a c) ∧ ∀ i, 0 < lobattoWeights L q a c i := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1)
  let e : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1
  let v := Real.sqrt (lobattoCouplingSq J e a c) • e
  have he : e ≠ 0 := by intro hz; have := congrFun hz (Fin.last q); simp [e] at this
  have hγ := lobattoCouplingSq_pos hac hJa hJc he
  have hv (i : Fin (q + 1)) (hi : i.val + 1 < q + 1) : v i = 0 := by
    have hne : i ≠ Fin.last q := by intro hz; have := congrArg Fin.val hz; simp at this; omega
    simp [v, e, hne]
  obtain ⟨hL, hH⟩ := moment_hierarchy_of_le_support hμ hs
  have htri := isTridiagonal_finSymmetricBorder
    (isTridiagonal_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) hL) hv (lobattoCorner J e a c)
  have hsub := finSymmetricBorder_superdiagonal_ne_zero (lobattoCorner J e a c)
    (fun i j hij => (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_pos L hL hH i j hij).ne')
    (v := v) (by
      intro i hi
      have hilast : i = Fin.last q := Fin.ext (by simpa using (show i.val = q by omega))
      subst i
      simpa only [v, e, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one] using
        (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hγ).ne')
  have hmass : 0 < L 1 := by
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_one] using integral_one_pos_of_one_le_support_encard
      hμ ((by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ q + 1 by omega) : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ q + 1).trans hs)
  exact rootedMatrixRule_nodes_injective_and_weights_pos (by omega : 0 < q + 2)
    (isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) htri hsub hmass

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_stieltjesTransform_of_compact_off_Icc
statement:
theorem continuousOn_stieltjesTransform_of_compact_off_Icc
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hoff : ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    ContinuousOn (stieltjesTransform μ) K
proof:
:= by
  have hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc a b := μ.support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc hs
  apply continuousOn_integral_of_continuousOn_compact_support μ
    (μ.isCompact_support_of_subset_Icc hsupport) hK
  exact (continuous_fst.continuousOn.sub
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn).inv₀
      (fun p hp => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff p.1 hp.1 p.2 (hsupport hp.2)))

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_gaussRemainderKernel_of_compact_off_Icc
statement:
theorem continuousOn_gaussRemainderKernel_of_compact_off_Icc
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hoff : ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    ContinuousOn (gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n) K
proof:
:= by
  have hS := continuousOn_stieltjesTransform_of_compact_off_Icc hs hK hoff
  have hG : ContinuousOn (fun z => ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) /
      (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) K := by
    apply continuousOn_finsetSum
    intro i _
    exact continuousOn_const.div (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const)
      (fun z hz => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff z hz _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i)))
  apply (hS.sub hG).congr
  intro z hz
  exact (stieltjesTransform_sub_sum_gaussWeights_eq_gaussRemainderKernel hμ hs hn (hoff z hz)).symm

name: NLAlib.polynomial_gauss_exactness_iff
statement:
theorem polynomial_gauss_exactness_iff (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) {v : ι → 𝕜} (hv : InjOn v s) (w : ι → 𝕜) :
    (∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) →
      L p = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i = L (Lagrange.basis s v i)) ∧
        IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L s.card (Lagrange.nodal s v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 * s.card = s.card + s.card by omega,
    Lagrange.linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_iff L hs hv]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hw, ho⟩
    exact ⟨hw, Lagrange.nodal_monic, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, ho⟩
  · rintro ⟨hw, ho⟩
    exact ⟨hw, ho.orthogonal⟩

name: Lagrange.not_linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_of_nodal_sq_pos
statement:
theorem not_linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_of_nodal_sq_pos
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hpos : 0 < L (nodal s v ^ 2)) :
    ¬ (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * s.card : ℕ) →
      L p = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hdeg : (nodal s v ^ 2).degree ≤ (2 * s.card : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_pow, degree_nodal]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    exact le_rfl
  have hz := h (nodal s v ^ 2) hdeg
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * (nodal s v ^ 2).eval (v i)) = 0 := by
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [eval_pow, eval_nodal_at_node hi]
    simp
  rw [hsum] at hz
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hz

name: Lagrange.weight_eq_linearMap_basis_sq_of_exact
statement:
theorem weight_eq_linearMap_basis_sq_of_exact
