    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) →
      L p = ∑ j ∈ s, w j * p.eval (v j)) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    w i = L (Lagrange.basis s v i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < s.card := (card_pos.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩)
  have hd : (Lagrange.basis s v i ^ 2).degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_pow, degree_basis hv hi]
    simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      (show ((2 * (s.card - 1) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) < (2 * s.card : ℕ)
        from Nat.cast_lt.mpr (by omega))
  have he := h (Lagrange.basis s v i ^ 2) hd
  rw [sum_eq_single i] at he
  · simpa only [eval_pow, eval_basis_self hv hi, one_pow, mul_one] using he.symm
  · intro j hj hji
    rw [eval_pow, eval_basis_of_ne hji.symm hj]
    simp
  · exact fun hnot => (hnot hi).elim

name: NLAlib.polynomial_gauss_rule_eq_up_to_permutation
statement:
theorem polynomial_gauss_rule_eq_up_to_permutation {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (v u w a : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hu : Function.Injective u)
    (hL : ∀ r : ℝ[X], r.degree < n → r ≠ 0 → L (r ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    (ha : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) → L p = ∑ i, a i * p.eval (u i)) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (∀ i, u (e i) = v i) ∧ (∀ i, a (e i) = w i)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have hw' : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * (univ : Finset (Fin n)).card : ℕ) →
      L p = ∑ i ∈ univ, w i * p.eval (v i) := by simpa using hw
  have ha' : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * (univ : Finset (Fin n)).card : ℕ) →
      L p = ∑ i ∈ univ, a i * p.eval (u i) := by simpa using ha
  obtain ⟨hweights, hp⟩ := (polynomial_gauss_exactness_iff L hs hv.injOn w).mp hw'
  obtain ⟨_, hq⟩ := (polynomial_gauss_exactness_iff L hs hu.injOn a).mp ha'
  have heq : Lagrange.nodal univ v = Lagrange.nodal univ u :=
    hp.eq_of_nonzero_sq hq (by simpa using hL)
  have hnode : ∀ i, ∃ j, u j = v i := by
    intro i
    have hz : (Lagrange.nodal univ u).eval (v i) = 0 := by
      rw [← heq, Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i)]
    simp only [Lagrange.nodal, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at hz
    obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
    exact ⟨j, (sub_eq_zero.mp hj).symm⟩
  choose g hg using hnode
  have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hv
    rw [← hg i, ← hg j, hij]
  let e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) := Equiv.ofBijective g
    ⟨hginj, (Finite.injective_iff_surjective).mp hginj⟩
  have he : ∀ i, u (e i) = v i := hg
  refine ⟨e, he, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hdeg : (Lagrange.basis univ v i).degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    rw [Lagrange.degree_basis hv.injOn (mem_univ i)]
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < 2 * n by omega)
  have h := ha (Lagrange.basis univ v i) hdeg
  rw [sum_eq_single (e i)] at h
  · rw [he i, Lagrange.eval_basis_self hv.injOn (mem_univ i), mul_one] at h
    exact h.symm.trans (hweights i (mem_univ i)).symm
  · intro j hj hji
    have hjv : u j = v (e.symm j) := by simpa using he (e.symm j)
    have hne : i ≠ e.symm j := by
      intro hij
      apply hji
      rw [hij, e.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hjv, Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hne (mem_univ _), mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q d : ℕ}
    (hs : (q + d : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {w : ℝ[X]} (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hd : w.degree ≤ d) (hnon : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w.eval x) :
    hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) w) q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le (n := q) _ le_rfl
  apply (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos _ q).mpr
  intro p hp hp0
  have hpN : p.natDegree < q := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
  have hprod : (w * p).degree < (q + d : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
    calc w.degree + p.degree ≤ (d : ℕ) + (p.natDegree : ℕ) := add_le_add hd degree_le_natDegree
         _ < (q + d : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show d + p.natDegree < q + d by omega)
  simpa only [polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_pow] using
    integral_eval_mul_sq_pos_of_le_support_encard hμ hs hw hp0 hprod hnon

name: NLAlib.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_endpoint_exact
statement:
theorem isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_endpoint_exact
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (t : ℝ)
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (htv : ∀ i, t ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily t v i)) :
    IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (X - C t))
      q (Lagrange.nodal univ v)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull := (integral_eq_quadrature_iff hμ (s := univ) (⟨0, mem_univ _⟩ :
    (univ : Finset (Fin (q + 1))).Nonempty) (endpointNodeFamily_injective hv htv).injOn w q).mp (by
      simpa [show q + 1 + q = 2 * q + 1 by omega] using hexact)
  refine ⟨Lagrange.nodal_monic, by simp [Lagrange.natDegree_nodal], ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  simpa only [polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, polynomialIntegral_apply,
    nodal_endpointNodeFamily, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, mul_assoc] using hfull.2 r hr

name: NLAlib.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_twoEndpoint_exact
statement:
theorem isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_twoEndpoint_exact
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hav : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) (hbv : ∀ i, b ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)) :
    IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) ((X - C a) * (C b - X)))
      q (Lagrange.nodal univ v)
proof:
:= by
  have hvall := endpointNodeFamily_injective (endpointNodeFamily_injective hv hbv)
    (fun i => Fin.cases hab hav i)
  have hfull := (integral_eq_quadrature_iff hμ (s := univ) (⟨0, mem_univ _⟩ :
    (univ : Finset (Fin (q + 2))).Nonempty) hvall.injOn w q).mp (by
      simpa [twoEndpointNodeFamily,
        show q + 2 + q = 2 * q + 2 by omega] using hexact)
  refine ⟨Lagrange.nodal_monic, by simp [Lagrange.natDegree_nodal], ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have h := hfull.2 r hr
  change (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v)).eval x * r.eval x ∂μ) = 0 at h
  have heq : (fun x => (((X - C a) * (C b - X)) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v * r)).eval x) =
      fun x => -((Lagrange.nodal univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v)).eval x * r.eval x) := by
    funext x
    simp only [nodal_twoEndpointNodeFamily, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    ring
  rw [polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, polynomialIntegral_apply, heq, integral_neg, h, neg_zero]

name: NLAlib.nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_leftEndpoint_exact
statement:
theorem nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_leftEndpoint_exact
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hμab : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ} (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hav : ∀ i, a ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily a v i)) :
    Lagrange.nodal univ v = monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (X - C a)) q
proof:
:= by
  have hnd := hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard hμ hs
    (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) (by simp : (X - C a : ℝ[X]).degree ≤ (1 : ℕ)) (by
      filter_upwards [hμab] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)
  exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_endpoint_exact hμ a v w hv hav hexact).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ hnd) hnd

name: NLAlib.nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_rightEndpoint_exact
statement:
theorem nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_rightEndpoint_exact
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hμab : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ} (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hbv : ∀ i, b ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily b v i)) :
    Lagrange.nodal univ v = monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (C b - X)) q
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : (C b - X : ℝ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← neg_sub X (C b)]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (X_sub_C_ne_zero b)
  have hwd : (C b - X : ℝ[X]).degree ≤ (1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [← neg_sub X (C b), degree_neg]
    simp
  have hnd := hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard hμ hs hw0 hwd (by
    filter_upwards [hμab] with x hx
    simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2)
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_endpoint_exact hμ b v w hv hbv hexact
  have hp' : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (C b - X)) q (Lagrange.nodal univ v) := by
    refine ⟨hp.monic, hp.natDegree_eq, ?_⟩
    intro r hr
    change (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) ((C b - X) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v * r)) = 0
    rw [show (C b - X) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v * r) =
        -((X - C b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v * r)) by ring, map_neg]
    have hz := hp.orthogonal r hr
    change (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) ((X - C b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v * r)) = 0 at hz
    rw [hz, neg_zero]
  exact hp'.eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ hnd) hnd

name: NLAlib.nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_twoEndpoint_exact
statement:
theorem nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_twoEndpoint_exact
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμab : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ} (hs : (q + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hav : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) (hbv : ∀ i, b ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)) :
    Lagrange.nodal univ v = monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) ((X - C a) * (C b - X))) q
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (C b - X : ℝ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← neg_sub X (C b)]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (X_sub_C_ne_zero b)
  have hwd : ((X - C a) * (C b - X) : ℝ[X]).degree ≤ (2 : ℕ) := by
    rw [← neg_sub X (C b), mul_neg, degree_neg]
    rw [degree_mul, degree_X_sub_C, degree_X_sub_C]
    norm_num
  have hnd := hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard hμ hs
    (mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) hb0) hwd (by
      filter_upwards [hμab] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2))
  exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_nodal_of_twoEndpoint_exact hμ a b hab.ne v w hv hav hbv hexact).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ hnd) hnd

name: NLAlib.chebyshevAliasIndex_two_mul_add_mul
statement:
theorem chebyshevAliasIndex_two_mul_add_mul {n : ℕ} (_hn : 0 < n) (l r : ℕ) :
    chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * (l * n + r)) = chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
  have hmod : 2 * (l * n + r) % (2 * n) = 2 * r % (2 * n) := by
    rw [show 2 * (l * n + r) = 2 * r + l * (2 * n) by ring,
      Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
  rw [hmod]

name: NLAlib.tsum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ_le_one
statement:
theorem tsum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ_le_one :
    (∑' j : ℕ, |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))|) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le (fun j => abs_nonneg _)
  intro m
  rw [sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ]
  exact sub_le_self _ (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ
statement:
theorem summable_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ => |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))|)
proof:
:= by
  apply summable_of_sum_range_le (c := 1) (fun j => abs_nonneg _)
  intro m
  rw [sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ]
  exact sub_le_self _ (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_even_tail_le
statement:
theorem tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_even_tail_le
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} (hcS : Summable (fun k => |c k|)) {n p : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hc : ∀ k, n < k → |c k| ≤ A / (k : ℝ) ^ p) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, if n < 2 * j then |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)| else 0) ≤
      A / (n : ℝ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let t := fun j : ℕ => if n < 2 * j then |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)| else 0
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hc2S : Summable (fun j => |c (2 * j)|) := by
    exact hcS.comp_injective (show Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j) by intro a b h; dsimp only at h; omega)
  have ht : Summable t := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => by dsimp [t]; split_ifs <;> positivity) ?_ (hc2S.mul_left 2)
    intro j
    dsimp [t]
    split_ifs
    · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two (2 * j)) (abs_nonneg (c (2 * j)))
      simpa only [mul_comm] using h
    · positivity
  have hb (j : ℕ) : t (j + 1) ≤ A / (n : ℝ) ^ p * |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))| := by
    dsimp [t]
    split_ifs with hk
    · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
      refine (hc _ hk).trans ?_
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (by positivity)
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hnR.le
      exact_mod_cast hk.le
    · positivity
  have h := (ht.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective).tsum_le_tsum hb
    (summable_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ.mul_left (A / (n : ℝ) ^ p))
  rw [tsum_mul_left] at h
  have hmass := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left tsum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ_le_one
    (show 0 ≤ A / (n : ℝ) ^ p by positivity)
  change (∑' j, t j) ≤ _
  rw [ht.tsum_eq_zero_add, show t 0 = 0 by simp [t], zero_add]
  exact h.trans (by simpa only [mul_one] using hmass)

name: NLAlib.tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_even_tail_le
statement:
theorem tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_even_tail_le
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} (hcS : Summable (fun k => |c k|)) {n p : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hp : 2 ≤ p) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hc : ∀ k, n < k → |c k| ≤ A / (k : ℝ) ^ p) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, if n < 2 * j then
      |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))| else 0) ≤
        6 * A / (n : ℝ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  let t := fun j : ℕ => if n < 2 * j then
    |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))| else 0
  have ht0 (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ t j := by dsimp [t]; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hc2S : Summable (fun j => |c (2 * j)|) := by
    exact hcS.comp_injective (show Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j) by intro a b h; dsimp only at h; omega)
  have ht : Summable t := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ht0 ?_ (hc2S.mul_left 2)
    intro j
    dsimp [t]
    split_ifs
    · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))) (abs_nonneg (c (2 * j)))
      simpa only [mul_comm] using h
    · positivity
  let B := fun l : ℕ => ∑ r : Fin n, t (l * n + r)
  have : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have htP : Summable (fun z : ℕ × Fin n => t (z.1 * n + z.2)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Nat.divModEquiv_symm_apply] using ht.comp_injective (Nat.divModEquiv n).symm.injective
  have hB : Summable B := by
    simpa only [B, tsum_fintype] using htP.prod
  have htot : (∑' j, t j) = ∑' l, B l := by
    have he := (Nat.divModEquiv n).symm.tsum_eq t
    simp only [Nat.divModEquiv_symm_apply] at he
    rw [← he, htP.tsum_prod]
    simp only [B, tsum_fintype]
  have hmass : (∑ r : Fin n, |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * r))|) ≤ 4 := by
    rw [sum_fin_eq_sum_range]
    convert sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_alias_two_mul_le_four hn0 using 1
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    rw [dif_pos (mem_range.mp hr)]
  have hblock (l : ℕ) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
      (hDk : ∀ r : Fin n, n < 2 * (l * n + r) → |c (2 * (l * n + r))| ≤ D) :
      B l ≤ 4 * D := by
    calc
      B l ≤ ∑ r : Fin n, D * |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * r))| := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro r hr
        dsimp [t]
        split_ifs with hk
        · rw [chebyshevAliasIndex_two_mul_add_mul hn0]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hDk r hk) (abs_nonneg _)
        · positivity
      _ = D * ∑ r : Fin n, |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * r))| := by rw [mul_sum]
      _ ≤ D * 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass hD
      _ = 4 * D := mul_comm _ _
  have hB0 : B 0 ≤ 4 * A / (n : ℝ) ^ p := by
    have h := hblock 0 (A / (n : ℝ) ^ p) (by positivity) (by
      intro r hr
      refine (hc _ hr).trans ?_
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (by positivity)
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hnR.le
      exact_mod_cast hr.le)
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using h
  have hBs (l : ℕ) : B (l + 1) ≤
      (4 * A / (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ p) * (((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p)⁻¹ := by
    have hlR : (0 : ℝ) < (l + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    have h := hblock (l + 1) (A / (2 * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * n) ^ p) (by positivity) (by
      intro r hr
      refine (hc _ hr).trans ?_
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (by positivity)
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
      exact_mod_cast (show 2 * (l + 1) * n ≤ 2 * ((l + 1) * n + (r : ℕ)) by rw [Nat.mul_assoc]; omega))
    refine h.trans_eq ?_
    rw [show 2 * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * n = 2 * n * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) by ring, mul_pow]
    ring
  have hg : Summable (fun l : ℕ => (((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p)⁻¹) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (Real.summable_nat_pow_inv.mpr (show 1 < p by omega)).comp_injective Nat.succ_injective
  have htail := (hB.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective).tsum_le_tsum hBs (hg.mul_left _)
  rw [tsum_mul_left] at htail
  have hg2 := tsum_inv_pow_nat_succ_le_two hp
  have htail2 : (∑' l, B (l + 1)) ≤ 8 * A / (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ p := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg2 (show 0 ≤ 4 * A / (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ p by positivity)
    refine htail.trans (hmul.trans_eq ?_)
    ring
  have hpow : (4 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hp
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have htail3 : 8 * A / (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ p ≤ 2 * A / (n : ℝ) ^ p := by
    rw [mul_pow]
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (show 0 ≤ 2 * A * (n : ℝ) ^ p by positivity)
    nlinarith
  change (∑' j, t j) ≤ _
  rw [htot, hB.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  have h := add_le_add hB0 (htail2.trans htail3)
  exact h.trans_eq (by ring)

name: NLAlib.measure_hankel_nonzero
proof:
:=
  hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
    ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn)

name: NLAlib.measure_norm_pos
proof:
:=
  orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
    ((by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk) : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn)

name: NLAlib.gaussNodes_injective
statement:
theorem gaussNodes_injective {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) : Function.Injective (gaussNodes μ hμ n)
proof:
:=
  eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_injective _
    (measure_hankel_nonzero hμ hn) (measure_norm_pos hμ hn)

name: NLAlib.nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    Lagrange.nodal univ (gaussNodes μ hμ n) =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← charpoly_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix _
    (measure_hankel_nonzero hμ hn) (measure_norm_pos hμ hn)]
  simpa [Lagrange.nodal_eq, gaussNodes, momentGaussNodes] using
    (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).charpoly_eq.symm

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (x : ℝ) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).eval x = 0 ↔
      ∃ i : Fin n, gaussNodes μ hμ n i = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hμ hn]
  simp only [Lagrange.nodal_eq, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (sub_eq_zero.mp hi).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, sub_eq_zero.mpr hi.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hμ n i * p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (polynomial_gauss_exactness_iff (polynomialIntegral μ hμ)
    (s := univ) (by exact ⟨⟨0, hn0⟩, mem_univ _⟩)
    (gaussNodes_injective hμ hn).injOn (gaussWeights μ hμ n)).mpr
    ⟨fun i _ => rfl, by
      rw [nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hμ hn]
      simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
        isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ hn⟩
  simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using he p (by simpa using hp)

name: NLAlib.gaussWeights_pos
statement:
theorem gaussWeights_pos {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (i : Fin n) : 0 < gaussWeights μ hμ n i
proof:
:=
  quadrature_weight_pos_of_gauss_exact hμ hn (gaussNodes_injective hμ hn) _
    (fun _ hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ (by have := i.isLt; omega) hn hp) i

name: NLAlib.sum_gaussWeights_eq_measure_univ
statement:
theorem sum_gaussWeights_eq_measure_univ {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hμ n i) = (μ univ).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn (p := 1) (by
    simp only [degree_one]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 * n by omega))
  simpa [measureReal_def] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.rule_eq_gaussNodes_gaussWeights_of_moments
statement:
theorem rule_eq_gaussNodes_gaussWeights_of_moments {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hm : ∀ k < 2 * n, (∫ x, x ^ k ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * v i ^ k) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (∀ i, v (e i) = gaussNodes μ hμ n i) ∧
      (∀ i, w (e i) = gaussWeights μ hμ n i)
proof:
:= by
  apply quadrature_rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments hμ hn0 hn
    (gaussNodes μ hμ n) v (gaussWeights μ hμ n) w (gaussNodes_injective hμ hn) hv
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [eval_pow, eval_X] using
      integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn (p := X ^ k) (by
        rw [degree_X_pow]
        exact_mod_cast hk)
  · exact hm

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_gaussWeights_div_sub_le
statement:
private theorem norm_sum_gaussWeights_div_sub_le
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z w : ℂ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, δ ≤ ‖z-(x:ℂ)‖)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, δ ≤ ‖w-(x:ℂ)‖) :
    ‖(∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ)/(z-(gaussNodes μ hμ n i:ℂ))) -
      (∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ)/(w-(gaussNodes μ hμ n i:ℂ)))‖ ≤
        μ.real univ / δ^2 * ‖z-w‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, ‖(gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ)/(z-(gaussNodes μ hμ n i:ℂ)) -
        (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ)/(w-(gaussNodes μ hμ n i:ℂ))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hμ n i * (‖z-w‖/δ^2) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      let t := gaussNodes μ hμ n i
      have ht := gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i
      have hz0 : z-(t:ℂ) ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (hδ.trans_le (hz t ht))
      have hw0 : w-(t:ℂ) ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (hδ.trans_le (hw t ht))
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (gaussWeights_pos hμ hn i)]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (gaussWeights_pos hμ hn i).le
      change ‖(z-(t:ℂ))⁻¹-(w-(t:ℂ))⁻¹‖ ≤ _
      rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_inv_inv₀ hz0 hw0, dist_sub_right, dist_eq_norm]
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos hδ)
      simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul (hz t ht) (hw t ht) hδ.le (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← sum_mul, sum_gaussWeights_eq_measure_univ hμ hn0 hn]
      simp only [measureReal_def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc]

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (hinf : μ.support.Infinite) {K : Set ℂ}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hoff : ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z =>
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (n+1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (n+1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z)
      (stieltjesTransform μ) atTop K
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  by_cases hKne : K.Nonempty
  · have hI : (Icc a b).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hinf.nonempty
      exact ⟨x, Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc hs hx⟩
    have hcompact := hK.prod (isCompact_Icc (a:=a) (b:=b))
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hmin⟩ := hcompact.exists_isMinOn (hKne.prod hI)
      (show ContinuousOn (fun zx : ℂ × ℝ => ‖zx.1-(zx.2:ℂ)‖) (K ×ˢ Icc a b) by fun_prop)
    let δ := ‖u.1-(u.2:ℂ)‖
    have hδ : 0 < δ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff u.1 hu.1 u.2 hu.2))
    have hgap (z : K) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) : δ ≤ ‖(z:ℂ)-(x:ℂ)‖ :=
      (isMinOn_iff.mp hmin) ((z:ℂ),x) ⟨z.2,hx⟩
    let F : ℕ → K → ℂ := fun n z =>
      ∑ i : Fin (n+1), (gaussWeights μ hμ (n+1) i : ℂ) /
        ((z:ℂ)-(gaussNodes μ hμ (n+1) i:ℂ))
    let C := μ.real univ/δ^2
    have hbound (z w : K) (n : ℕ) : dist (F n z) (F n w) ≤ C * dist z w := by
      simpa only [F, C, dist_eq_norm, Subtype.dist_eq] using
        norm_sum_gaussWeights_div_sub_le hμ hs (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
          (by rw [hinf.encard_eq]; simp) hδ (hgap z) (hgap w)
    have hequi : Equicontinuous F := Metric.equicontinuous_of_continuity_modulus
      (fun t : ℝ => C*t)
      (by simpa only [mul_zero] using
        (show Continuous (fun t : ℝ => C*t) from continuous_const.mul continuous_id).tendsto (0:ℝ)) F hbound
    let : CompactSpace K := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK
    have hpoint : Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 (fun z : K => stieltjesTransform μ z)) := by
      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
      intro z
      have h := tendsto_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform hμ hs hinf (hoff z z.2)
      convert! h using 1
      funext n
      exact (eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div hμ hs (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
        (by rw [hinf.encard_eq]; simp) (hoff z z.2)).symm
    have huniform := (hequi.tendsto_uniformFun_iff_pi atTop
      (fun z : K => stieltjesTransform μ z)).mpr hpoint
    have huniform' := UniformFun.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp huniform
    rw [tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_restrict]
    convert! huniform' using 1
    funext n z
    exact eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div hμ hs (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
      (by rw [hinf.encard_eq]; simp) (hoff z z.2)
  · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hKne]
    exact tendstoUniformlyOn_empty

name: NLAlib.stieltjesTransform_sub_sum_gaussWeights_eq_gaussRemainderKernel
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_sub_sum_gaussWeights_eq_gaussRemainderKernel
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    stieltjesTransform μ z - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) /
      (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)) = gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n z
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn0
  · simp [gaussRemainderKernel, stieltjesTransform]
  · rw [← eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div hμ hs hn0 hn hz]
    exact stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral hμ hs hn0 hn hz

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_transform_kernel
statement:
theorem integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_transform_kernel
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = 1) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * cubicalCurveIntegral
        (fun z => f z * (stieltjesTransform μ z - ∑ i : Fin n,
          (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)))) Γ
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  have hC (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :=
    two_pi_i_inv_mul_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub_eq_of_isNullHomologous
      hΩ hf (hI x hx) Γ hΓ (fun γ hγ r => hoff γ hγ r x hx) hnull (hw x hx)
  have hμformula : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * cubicalCurveIntegral
      (fun z => f z * stieltjesTransform μ z) Γ = ∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ := by
    change (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * cubicalCurveIntegral
      (fun z => f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) Γ = _
    rw [← integral_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub hs Γ hΓ hoff hf.continuousOn,
      ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    exact hC x hx
  have hnode (γ : C(I, Ω)) (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) (i : Fin n) :
      CurveIntegrable (fun z => (f z / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) •
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
    have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ range (cubicalPath γ)) :
        z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff γ hγ r _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i))
    exact ((hf.continuousOn.mono (by rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact (γ r).property)).div
      (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) hne).smul continuousOn_const
      |>.curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hΓ γ hγ) (fun r => mem_range_self r)
  have hweighted (γ : C(I, Ω)) (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) (i : Fin n) :
      CurveIntegrable (fun z => ((gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        (f z / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
    have he : (fun z => ((gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        (f z / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) =
        (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) • (fun z =>
          (f z / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) := by
      funext z
      exact mul_smul _ _ _
    rw [he]
    exact (hnode γ hγ i).smul
  have hsum : (fun z => f z * ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) /
      (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) =
      fun z => ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        (f z / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) := by
    funext z
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hGformula : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * cubicalCurveIntegral
      (fun z => f z * ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) /
        (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) Γ =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) * f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) := by
    rw [hsum, cubicalCurveIntegral_sum Γ _ hweighted]
    simp_rw [cubicalCurveIntegral_const_mul]
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    calc
      _ = (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) Γ) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hC _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i)]
  have hFint (γ : C(I, Ω)) (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) :
      CurveIntegrable (fun z => (f z * stieltjesTransform μ z) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (cubicalPath γ) :=
    (curveIntegrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub hs (cubicalPath γ) (hΓ γ hγ)
      (fun t ht x hx => by rw [(cubicalPath γ).extend_apply ht]; exact hoff γ hγ ⟨t, ht⟩ x hx)
      (hf.continuousOn.mono (by rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact (γ r).property))).1
  have hGint (γ : C(I, Ω)) (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) :
      CurveIntegrable (fun z => (f z * ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) /
        (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
    have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ range (cubicalPath γ)) (i : Fin n) :
        z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff γ hγ r _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i))
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun z => f z * ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) /
        (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))) (range (cubicalPath γ)) :=
      (hf.continuousOn.mono (by rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact (γ r).property)).mul
        (continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_const.div
          (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) (fun z hz => hne z hz i)))
    exact (hc.smul continuousOn_const).curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hΓ γ hγ)
      (fun r => mem_range_self r)
  have heq : (fun z => f z * (stieltjesTransform μ z - ∑ i : Fin n,
      (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)))) =
      fun z => f z * stieltjesTransform μ z - f z * ∑ i : Fin n,
        (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)) := by
    funext z
    ring
  rw [heq, cubicalCurveIntegral_sub Γ _ _ hFint hGint, mul_sub, hμformula, hGformula]

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_gaussRemainderKernel
statement:
theorem integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_gaussRemainderKernel
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    (∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * cubicalCurveIntegral
        (fun z => f z * gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n z) Γ := by
  dsimp only
  rw [integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_transform_kernel
    (hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs) hs hn hΩ hf hI Γ hΓ hoff hnull hw]
  congr 1
  apply cubicalCurveIntegral_congr
  intro γ hγ r
  rw [stieltjesTransform_sub_sum_gaussWeights_eq_gaussRemainderKernel _ hs hn (hoff γ hγ r)]

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_bounds
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_bounds
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = 1)
    {K F : ℝ} (hF0 : 0 ≤ F)
    (hK : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r,
      ‖gaussRemainderKernel μ (hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs) n (γ r : ℂ)‖ ≤ K)
    (hF : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ‖f (γ r : ℂ)‖ ≤ F) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    ‖(∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)‖ ≤ cubicalLength Γ / (2 * Real.pi) * K * F := by
  dsimp only
  rw [integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_gaussRemainderKernel hs hn hΩ hf hI Γ hΓ hoff hnull hw]
  have h := norm_two_pi_i_inv_mul_cubicalCurveIntegral_le_length_mul Γ
    (fun z => f z * gaussRemainderKernel μ (hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs) n z) hΓ
    (C := F * K) (fun γ hγ r => by
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hF γ hγ r) (hK γ hγ r) (norm_nonneg _) hF0)
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_momentGaussWeights
statement:
theorem continuousAt_momentGaussWeights
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) k) (i : Fin n) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => momentGaussWeights (L y) n i) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold momentGaussWeights
  apply continuousAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt (d := n)
  · intro y
    apply (Lagrange.degree_basis_le_of_mem _ (mem_univ i)).trans_lt
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < n by have := i.isLt; omega)
  · intro k
    apply Lagrange.continuousAt_coeff_basis
    · exact continuousAt_eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix hL
        (fun k hk => hn k hk.le) hh
    · exact mem_univ i
    · exact (eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_injective (L x) hn hh).injOn
  · exact fun k => (hL k.val).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily
statement:
theorem exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily {q : ℕ} (t : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (ht : Function.Injective t) {a : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Set.range t) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, t (e i) = endpointNodeFamily a v i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ia, hia⟩ := ha
  let e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)) := Equiv.swap 0 ia
  let v : Fin q → ℝ := fun i => t (e i.succ)
  refine ⟨e, v, fun i j hij => Fin.succ_injective _ (e.injective (ht hij)), ?_⟩
  intro i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · simpa only [e, Equiv.swap_apply_left, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_zero] using hia
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_twoEndpointNodeFamily
statement:
theorem exists_perm_twoEndpointNodeFamily {q : ℕ} (t : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ)
    (ht : Function.Injective t) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (htab : ∀ i, t i ∈ Icc a b) (ha : a ∈ Set.range t) (hb : b ∈ Set.range t) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 2)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) ∧
        ∀ i, t (e i) = twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ia, hia⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨ib, hib⟩ := hb
  let e₀ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 2)) := Equiv.swap 0 ia
  let j := e₀.symm ib
  let one : Fin (q + 2) := Fin.succ 0
  have hone : one ≠ 0 := by simp [one]
  have hj : j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hj
    have hid : ib = ia := by
      calc ib = e₀ j := (e₀.apply_symm_apply ib).symm
        _ = e₀ 0 := by rw [hj]
        _ = ia := Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _
    exact hab.ne (hia.symm.trans ((congrArg t hid).symm.trans hib))
  let e := (Equiv.swap one j).trans e₀
  have he0 : t (e 0) = a := by
    simp only [e, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Ne.symm hone) (Ne.symm hj)]
    simpa only [e₀, Equiv.swap_apply_left] using hia
  have he1 : t (e one) = b := by
    simp only [e, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_left, j, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hib]
  let v : Fin q → ℝ := fun i => t (e i.succ.succ)
  have hv : Function.Injective v := by
    intro i k hik
    exact Fin.succ_injective _ (Fin.succ_injective _ (e.injective (ht hik)))
  have hvi (i : Fin q) : v i ∈ Ioo a b := by
    have ha0 : v i ≠ a := by
      intro h
      have hi := e.injective (ht (h.trans he0.symm))
      have hi' := congrArg Fin.val hi
      simp at hi'
    have hb0 : v i ≠ b := by
      intro h
      have hi := e.injective (ht (h.trans he1.symm))
      have hi' := congrArg Fin.val hi
      simp [one] at hi'
    exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne (htab _).1 ha0.symm, lt_of_le_of_ne (htab _).2 hb0⟩
  refine ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, ?_⟩
  intro i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i) i
  · exact he0
  · exact he1
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily_mem_Icc {q : ℕ} {a b t : ℝ}
    (v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvi : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b) (hvt : t ∈ Set.range v) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ u : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective u ∧ (∀ i, u i ∈ Icc a b) ∧ (∀ i, t ≠ u i) ∧
        ∀ i, v (e i) = endpointNodeFamily t u i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, hu, heu⟩ := exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily v hv hvt
  have hui (i : Fin q) : u i ∈ Icc a b := by
    simpa only [heu, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_succ] using hvi (e i.succ)
  have htu (i : Fin q) : t ≠ u i := by
    intro h
    have hid := e.injective (hv ((heu 0).trans (h.trans (heu i.succ).symm)))
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val hid
    simp at hval
  exact ⟨e, u, hu, hui, htu, heu⟩

name: NLAlib.endpointLinearWeights_nonneg
statement:
theorem endpointLinearWeights_nonneg {μ : Measure ℝ} {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (i : Fin 2) : 0 ≤ endpointLinearWeights μ a c i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hac.le)
  · apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hac.le)

name: NLAlib.integrable_endpointCardinals
statement:
private theorem integrable_endpointCardinals {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {a c : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) :
    Integrable (fun x => (c - x) / (c - a)) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun x => (x - a) / (c - a)) μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · convert integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ (C ((c - a)⁻¹) * (C c - X)) using 1
    funext x
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  · convert integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ (C ((c - a)⁻¹) * (X - C a)) using 1
    funext x
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_endpointLinearWeights_mul_eval
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_endpointLinearWeights_mul_eval {μ : Measure ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ 1) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = endpointLinearWeights μ a c 0 * p.eval a +
      endpointLinearWeights μ a c 1 * p.eval c
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : ℝ) : p.eval x = (c - x) / (c - a) * p.eval a +
      (x - a) / (c - a) * p.eval c := by
    rw [eq_X_add_C_of_degree_le_one hp]
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hac)]
    ring
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := integrable_endpointCardinals hμ
  conv_lhs => rw [show p.eval = (fun x => (c - x) / (c - a) * p.eval a +
    (x - a) / (c - a) * p.eval c) from funext he]
  rw [integral_add (ha.mul_const _) (hc.mul_const _), integral_mul_const, integral_mul_const]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_endpointLinearWeights
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_eval_eq_endpointLinearWeights_mul_eval hac hμ
    (p := 1) (by simp : (1 : ℝ[X]).degree ≤ 1)
  simpa only [eval_one, mul_one, Fin.sum_univ_two] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.endpointLinearWeights_zero
statement: theorem endpointLinearWeights_zero (a c : ℝ) : endpointLinearWeights 0 a c = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [endpointLinearWeights]

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_mass_mul_of_ae_mem_singleton_interval
proof:
:= by
  have he : f =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => f a := by
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    rw [le_antisymm hx.2 hx.1]
  rw [integral_congr_ae he]
  simp only [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_fixed_denominator_partial_fractions
statement:
theorem existsUnique_fixed_denominator_partial_fractions
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (hv : Function.Injective v) (s : ι → ℕ)
    {d : ℕ} (hmd : (∑ i, s i) ≤ d) {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree < d) :
    ∃! qc : 𝕜[X] × ((i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜),
      qc.1.degree < (d - ∑ i, s i : ℕ) ∧
      p = qc.1 * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s qc.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨qc, hqc, huniq⟩ := existsUnique_eq_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder v hv s p
  have hd := (degree_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder_lt_iff v s hmd qc.1 qc.2).mp
    (hqc ▸ hp)
  exact ⟨qc, ⟨hd, hqc⟩, fun qc' h => huniq qc' h.2⟩

name: NLAlib.degree_fixed_denominator_partial_fractions_lt_iff
statement:
theorem degree_fixed_denominator_partial_fractions_lt_iff
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) {d : ℕ} (hmd : (∑ i, s i) ≤ d)
    (q : 𝕜[X]) (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) :
    (q*linearPoleProduct v s+linearPoleRemainder v s c).degree < d ↔
      q.degree < (d-∑ i, s i : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  degree_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder_lt_iff v s hmd q c

name: NLAlib.eval_div_linearPoleProduct_eq_partial_fractions
statement:
theorem eval_div_linearPoleProduct_eq_partial_fractions
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) (q : 𝕜[X])
    (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) {t : 𝕜} (ht : ∀ i, t ≠ v i) :
    (q * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s c).eval t /
        (linearPoleProduct v s).eval t =
      q.eval t + ∑ i, ∑ j : Fin (s i), c i j / (t-v i)^(s i-j.val)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (∏ i, (t-v i)^(s i)) ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    (fun i _ => pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht i)))
  have hden : (linearPoleProduct v s).eval t = ∏ i, (t-v i)^(s i) := by
    simp only [linearPoleProduct, eval_prod, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
  rw [eval_add, eval_mul, add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (hden ▸ hprod),
    linearPoleRemainder, eval_finsetSum, Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [eval_finsetSum, Finset.sum_div]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_prod, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X]
  have herase : (∏ k ∈ univ.erase i, (t-v k)^(s k)) ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    (fun k _ => pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht k)))
  have hsplit : (∏ k, (t-v k)^(s k)) = (t-v i)^(s i) *
      (∏ k ∈ univ.erase i, (t-v k)^(s k)) := (mul_prod_erase _ _ (mem_univ i)).symm
  have hpow : (t-v i)^(s i) = (t-v i)^j.val * (t-v i)^(s i-j.val) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le j.isLt.le]
  rw [hden, hsplit, hpow]
  field_simp [herase, sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht i)]

name: NLAlib.one_add_C_mul_X_eq_C_mul_pole
statement:
theorem one_add_C_mul_X_eq_C_mul_pole {ζ : 𝕜} (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) :
    1 + C ζ*X = C ζ*(X-C (-ζ⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_sub, ← map_mul, mul_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ hζ, map_neg, C_1]
  ring

name: NLAlib.prod_one_add_C_mul_X_pow_eq_C_mul_linearPoleProduct
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_C_mul_X_pow_eq_C_mul_linearPoleProduct
    (ζ : ι → 𝕜) (hζ : ∀ i, ζ i ≠ 0) (s : ι → ℕ) :
    (∏ i, (1+C (ζ i)*X)^(s i)) =
      C (∏ i, (ζ i)^(s i)) * linearPoleProduct (fun i => -(ζ i)⁻¹) s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [one_add_C_mul_X_eq_C_mul_pole (hζ _), mul_pow]
  rw [prod_mul_distrib]
  simp only [← map_pow, ← map_prod, linearPoleProduct]

name: NLAlib.div_pole_pow_eq_mul_div_one_add_mul_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : 1+ζ*t = ζ*(t-(-ζ⁻¹)) := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, mul_add, mul_inv_cancel₀ hζ]; ring
  rw [hbase, mul_pow]
  exact (mul_div_mul_right _ _ (pow_ne_zero _ hζ)).symm.trans (by ring)

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_pos_of_zero_imp_eval_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eval_pos_of_zero_imp_eval_zero {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {p r : ℝ[X]} (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hp : p.degree < n)
    (hr : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ r.eval x) (hzero : ∀ x, r.eval x = 0 → p.eval x = 0) :
    0 < ∫ x, r.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (integral_nonneg_of_ae hr)
  intro he
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, r.eval x = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [(integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hr (hμ r)).mp he.symm] with x hx
    exact hx
  have hpint : (∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    simp only [hzero x hx, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply]
  exact (integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn hp0 hp (hμ.integrable_sq p)).ne' hpint

name: NLAlib.endpoint_quadrature_weight_pos_of_exact
statement:
theorem endpoint_quadrature_weight_pos_of_exact {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (hn : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (v w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (he : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) (i : Fin (q + 1)) : 0 < w i
proof:
:= by
  let B := Lagrange.basis univ v i
  have hBdeg : B.degree = (q : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [B, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
      Lagrange.degree_basis hv.injOn (mem_univ i)
  have hB0 : B ≠ 0 := Lagrange.basis_ne_zero hv.injOn (mem_univ i)
  have hp : (B ^ 2).degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_pow, hBdeg, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q < 2 * q + 1 by omega)
  have hw : (∫ x, (B.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) = w i := by
    have h := he (B ^ 2) hp
    simp only [eval_pow] at h
    rw [h, sum_eq_single i]
    · simp only [B, Lagrange.eval_basis_self hv.injOn (mem_univ i), one_pow, mul_one]
    · intro j _ hji
      simp only [B, Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hji.symm (mem_univ j), zero_pow
        (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero]
    · simp
  rw [← hw]
  apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn hB0 _ (hμ.integrable_sq B)
  rw [hBdeg]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self q

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_mul_sq_pos_of_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem integral_eval_mul_sq_pos_of_le_support_encard {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {l p : ℝ[X]} (hl0 : l ≠ 0) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hp : (l * p).degree < n)
    (hl : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ l.eval x) :
    0 < ∫ x, l.eval x * (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_eval_pos_of_zero_imp_eval_zero hμ hn (mul_ne_zero hl0 hp0) hp
    (r := l * p ^ 2) (by
      filter_upwards [hl] with x hx
      simp only [eval_mul, eval_pow]
      exact mul_nonneg hx (sq_nonneg _)) (by
      intro x hx
      simp only [eval_mul, eval_pow] at hx ⊢
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx
      · rw [hx, zero_mul]
      · rw [sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hx, mul_zero])
  simpa only [eval_mul, eval_pow] using h

name: NLAlib.twoEndpoint_quadrature_weight_pos_of_exact
statement:
theorem twoEndpoint_quadrature_weight_pos_of_exact {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμab : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (hn : (q + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (v : Fin q → ℝ)
    (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (he : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i))
    (j : Fin (q + 2)) : 0 < w j
proof:
:= by
  let u := twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v
  let P := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  have hPdeg : P.natDegree = q := by simp only [P, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal,
    card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hPa : P.eval a ≠ 0 := Lagrange.eval_nodal_not_at_node fun i _ => (hva i).1.ne
  have hPb : P.eval b ≠ 0 := Lagrange.eval_nodal_not_at_node fun i _ => (hva i).2.ne'
  have hPv (i : Fin q) : P.eval (v i) = 0 := Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i)
  have hdeg {p : ℝ[X]} {d : ℕ} (hp : p.natDegree < d) : p.degree < d :=
    degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hp)
  have htest (i : Fin (q + 2)) (r : ℝ[X]) (hr : r.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ))
      (hri : 0 < r.eval (u i)) (hrj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → r.eval (u j) = 0)
      (hI : 0 < ∫ x, r.eval x ∂μ) : 0 < w i := by
    have h := he r hr
    rw [sum_eq_single i] at h
    · rw [h] at hI
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hI hri.le
    · intro j _ hji
      rw [hrj j hji, mul_zero]
    · simp
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j) j
  · let l : ℝ[X] := -(X - C b)
    have hldeg : l.natDegree = 1 := by
      dsimp only [l]
      rw [natDegree_neg, natDegree_X_sub_C]
    have hl : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ l.eval x := by
      filter_upwards [hμab] with x hx
      simp only [l, eval_neg, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      linarith [hx.2]
    have hp : (l * P).degree < (q + 2 : ℕ) := by
      apply hdeg
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := l) (q := P)
      rw [hldeg, hPdeg] at h
      omega
    have hi := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos_of_le_support_encard hμ hn
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr (X_sub_C_ne_zero b)) Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero hp hl
    apply htest 0 (l * P ^ 2)
    · apply hdeg
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := l) (q := P ^ 2)
      rw [hldeg, natDegree_pow, hPdeg] at h
      omega
    · simpa only [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_zero,
        eval_mul, eval_neg, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow, l] using
        mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < -(a - b)) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hPa)
    · intro k
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) k) k
      · intro hk; exact (hk rfl).elim
      · intro _
        change (l * P ^ 2).eval b = 0
        simp [l]
      · intro _; simp [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, hPv]
    · simpa only [eval_mul, eval_pow] using hi
  · let l : ℝ[X] := X - C a
    have hldeg : l.natDegree = 1 := natDegree_X_sub_C a
    have hl : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ l.eval x := by
      filter_upwards [hμab] with x hx
      simpa only [l, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1
    have hp : (l * P).degree < (q + 2 : ℕ) := by
      apply hdeg
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := l) (q := P)
      rw [hldeg, hPdeg] at h
      omega
    have hi := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos_of_le_support_encard hμ hn
      (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero hp hl
    apply htest (Fin.succ 0) (l * P ^ 2)
    · apply hdeg
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := l) (q := P ^ 2)
      rw [hldeg, natDegree_pow, hPdeg] at h
      omega
    · simpa only [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_succ,
        Fin.cases_zero, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow, l] using
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hPb)
    · intro k
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) k) k
      · intro _; simp [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, l]
      · intro hk; exact (hk rfl).elim
      · intro _; simp [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, hPv]
    · simpa only [eval_mul, eval_pow] using hi
  · let B := Lagrange.basis univ v i
    let l : ℝ[X] := (X - C a) * -(X - C b)
    have hBdeg : B.natDegree = q - 1 := by
      simpa only [B, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using Lagrange.natDegree_basis hv.injOn (mem_univ i)
    have hq : 0 < q := by have := i.isLt; omega
    have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) (neg_ne_zero.mpr (X_sub_C_ne_zero b))
    have hB0 : B ≠ 0 := Lagrange.basis_ne_zero hv.injOn (mem_univ i)
    have hldeg : l.natDegree ≤ 2 := by
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := (X - C a : ℝ[X])) (q := -(X - C b))
      rw [natDegree_neg, natDegree_X_sub_C, natDegree_X_sub_C] at h
      exact h
    have hl : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ l.eval x := by
      filter_upwards [hμab] with x hx
      simp only [l, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_neg, eval_X, eval_C]
      exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (by linarith [hx.2])
    have hp : (l * B).degree < (q + 2 : ℕ) := by
      apply hdeg
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := l) (q := B)
      rw [hBdeg] at h
      omega
    have hi := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos_of_le_support_encard hμ hn hl0 hB0 hp hl
    apply htest i.succ.succ (l * B ^ 2)
    · apply hdeg
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := l) (q := B ^ 2)
      rw [natDegree_pow, hBdeg] at h
      omega
    · simpa only [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_succ,
        eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_neg, l, B,
        Lagrange.eval_basis_self hv.injOn (mem_univ i), one_pow, mul_one] using
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hva i).1) (by simpa using sub_pos.mpr (hva i).2)
    · intro k
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) k) k
      · intro _
        change (l * B ^ 2).eval a = 0
        simp [l]
      · intro _
        change (l * B ^ 2).eval b = 0
        simp [l]
      · intro hk
        have hki : i ≠ k := by intro h; subst k; exact hk rfl
        simp [u, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, B,
          Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hki (mem_univ k)]
    · simpa only [eval_mul, eval_pow] using hi

name: NLAlib.endpoint_quadrature_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem endpoint_quadrature_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily a v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x) :
    ∑ i, w i * f (endpointNodeFamily a v i) ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    hab hμ (Or.inl rfl) v w hv hva hexact hf hf' hD
  have hW : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (x - a) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (hDpos ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 1).factorial)) hW
  rw [← he] at hE
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hE

name: NLAlib.integral_le_endpoint_quadrature_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_le_endpoint_quadrature_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily b v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∑ i, w i * f (endpointNodeFamily b v i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    hab hμ (Or.inr rfl) v w hv hva hexact hf hf' hD
  have hW : (∫ x, (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 0 := by
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
    (div_nonneg (hDpos ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 1).factorial)) hW
  rw [← he] at hE
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hE

name: NLAlib.integral_le_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_le_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f x) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∑ i, w i * f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_twoEndpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    hab hμ v w hv hva hexact hf hf' hD
  have hW : (∫ x, (x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 0 := by
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
    (div_nonneg (hDpos ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 2).factorial)) hW
  rw [← he] at hE
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hE

name: NLAlib.integral_hermiteInterpolate_eq_quadrature
statement:
theorem integral_hermiteInterpolate_eq_quadrature {μ : Measure ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (v w : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, (Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, w i * f (v i)
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : (Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).degree <
      (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
      Lagrange.degree_hermiteInterpolate_lt
        (show (univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty from ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, mem_univ _⟩) hv.injOn _ _
  rw [hexact _ hdeg]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
    rw [Lagrange.eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn _ _ (mem_univ i)]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_nodal_sq
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_nodal_sq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (v w : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i) =
      iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial *
        ∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  have hHdeg : H.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    simpa [H] using Lagrange.degree_hermiteInterpolate_lt
      (show (univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty from ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, mem_univ _⟩) hv.injOn _ _
  have hHnode (i : Fin n) : H.eval (v i) = f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn _ _ (mem_univ i)
  have hHintegral : (∫ x, H.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (v i) := by
    rw [hexact H hHdeg]
    simp only [hHnode]
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := by
    refine (hf.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx hnot
    exact (hnot hx).elim
  have hHi := integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ H
  have hWi : Integrable (fun x => (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2) μ := by
    have hp : (Lagrange.nodal univ v ^ 2).eval =
        fun x => (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 := by funext x; exact eval_pow 2
    rw [← hp]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ _
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hmean⟩ := exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise
    (s := Set.Ioo a b) (D := fun ξ => iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial)
    (hfi.sub hHi) hWi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    (Set.nonempty_Ioo.mpr hab) isPreconnected_Ioo (hD.div_const (2 * n).factorial)
    (by
      filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
      exact exists_sub_eval_hermiteInterpolate_eq hn hab hv hva hx hf hf')
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, integral_sub hfi hHi, hHintegral] using hmean

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_sq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eq_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_sq_eq_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (v w : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    (hz : (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (v i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (fun _ => 0)
  have hHdeg : H.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    simpa [H] using Lagrange.degree_hermiteInterpolate_lt
      (show (univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty from ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, mem_univ _⟩) hv.injOn _ _
  have hHnode (i : Fin n) : H.eval (v i) = f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn _ _ (mem_univ i)
  have hWi : Integrable (fun x => (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2) μ := by
    have hp : (Lagrange.nodal univ v ^ 2).eval =
        fun x => (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 := by funext x; exact eval_pow 2
    rw [← hp]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ _
  have hzero := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _) hWi).mp hz
  have hfeq : f =ᵐ[μ] H.eval := by
    filter_upwards [hzero] with x hx
    have hxzero : (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x = 0 := by
      simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, sq_eq_zero_iff] using hx
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_eq_zero_iff] at hxzero
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hxzero
    have hxi : x = v i := sub_eq_zero.mp hi
    rw [hxi, hHnode]
  rw [integral_congr_ae hfeq, hexact H hHdeg]
  simp only [hHnode]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_gauss_lebesgue_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem tendsto_gauss_lebesgue_of_continuousOn
    {ι : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, Fintype (ι n)] [∀ n, DecidableEq (ι n)]
    (hcard : ∀ n, Fintype.card (ι n) = n + 1)
    (v : ∀ n, ι n → ℝ) (hv : ∀ n, Function.Injective (v n))
    (hvI : ∀ n i, v n i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ n (p : ℝ[X]), p.degree < Fintype.card (ι n) →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ (v n)).eval x * p.eval x = 0)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1,
      (Lagrange.basis univ (v n) i).eval x) * f (v n i)) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let w := fun n i => ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ (v n) i).eval x
  have hprops (n : ℕ) := gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
    (hcard n) (v n) (hv n) (hvI n) (horth n)
  let vn := fun n i => (⟨v n i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hvI n i)⟩ : Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
  let Q : ℕ → (C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := fun n =>
    { toFun := fun g => ∑ i, w n i * g (vn n i)
      map_add' := by
        intro g h
        simp only [ContinuousMap.add_apply, mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c g
        simp only [ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, mul_sum]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        ring }
  have hbound (n : ℕ) (g : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) : |Q n g| ≤ 2 * ‖g‖ := by
    change |∑ i, w n i * g (vn n i)| ≤ _
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, |w n i * g (vn n i)| := abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ = ∑ i, w n i * |g (vn n i)| := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ((hprops n).1 i).le]
      _ ≤ ∑ i, w n i * ‖g‖ := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ((hprops n).1 i).le
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using g.norm_coe_le_norm (vn n i)
      _ = 2 * ‖g‖ := by rw [← sum_mul, (hprops n).2.1]
  have hexact (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
      Q n (p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x := by
    have hp : p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) := p.degree_le_natDegree.trans (by
      exact_mod_cast (hn.trans (show n ≤ 2 * n + 1 by omega)))
    exact ((hprops n).2.2.1 p hp).symm
  let fc : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ) := ⟨fun x => f x, hf.domRestrict⟩
  have h := tendsto_quadrature_of_bound_and_polynomial_exact Q 2 (by norm_num) hbound hexact fc
  have hInt : unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap fc = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    rw [uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hx
    rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx]
    rfl
  rw [hInt] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (ht : t = a ∨ t = b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily t v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (endpointNodeFamily t v i) =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
          ∫ x, (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have htv (i : Fin q) : t ≠ v i := by
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hva i).1.ne
    · exact (hva i).2.ne'
  have htmem : t ∈ Icc a b := by rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteEndpointInterpolate t (f t) v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  have hHnode (i : Fin (q + 1)) : H.eval (endpointNodeFamily t v i) =
      f (endpointNodeFamily t v i) := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_endpoint _ _ _ _ _ htv
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hHintegral : (∫ x, H.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (endpointNodeFamily t v i) := by
    rw [hexact H (Lagrange.degree_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_lt _ _ hv _ _)]
    simp only [hHnode]
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := by
    refine (hf.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx hnot
    exact (hnot hx).elim
  have hHi := integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ H
  let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2
  have hWi : Integrable W μ := by
    have heq : ((X - C t) * Lagrange.nodal univ v ^ 2).eval = W := by
      funext x
      simp only [W, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow]
    rw [← heq]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ _
  have hWsign : (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ W x) ∨ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, W x ≤ 0) := by
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · left
      filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
      exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sq_nonneg _)
    · right
      filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2) (sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise_of_weight_constant_sign
    (s := Set.Ioo a b) (D := fun ξ => iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial)
    (hfi.sub hHi) hWi hWsign (Set.nonempty_Ioo.mpr hab) isPreconnected_Ioo
    (hD.div_const _) (by
      filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
      exact exists_sub_eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_eq hab htmem hv hva htv hx hf hf')
  exact ⟨ξ, hξ, by simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, integral_sub hfi hHi, hHintegral] using he⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_twoEndpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_twoEndpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial *
          ∫ x, (x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b (f a) (f b) v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  have hav (i : Fin q) : a ≠ v i := (hva i).1.ne
  have hbv (i : Fin q) : b ≠ v i := (hva i).2.ne'
  have hHnode (i : Fin (q + 2)) : H.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) =
      f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i) i
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hav
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hab.ne hav hbv
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hHintegral : (∫ x, H.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) := by
    rw [hexact H (Lagrange.degree_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_lt _ _ _ _ hv _ _)]
    simp only [hHnode]
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := by
    refine (hf.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx hnot
    exact (hnot hx).elim
  have hHi := integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ H
  let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2
  have hWi : Integrable W μ := by
    have heq : ((X - C a) * (X - C b) * Lagrange.nodal univ v ^ 2).eval = W := by
      funext x
      simp only [W, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow]
    rw [← heq]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ _
  have hWsign : (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, W x ≤ 0) := by
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)) (sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise_of_weight_constant_sign
    (s := Set.Ioo a b) (D := fun ξ => iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial)
    (hfi.sub hHi) hWi (Or.inr hWsign) (Set.nonempty_Ioo.mpr hab) isPreconnected_Ioo
    (hD.div_const _) (by
      filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
      exact exists_sub_eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_eq hab hv hva hx hf hf')
  exact ⟨ξ, hξ, by simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, integral_sub hfi hHi, hHintegral] using he⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (p : ℝ[X]) : Integrable p.eval μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (p.continuous.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc (a := a) (b := b))).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
  filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx hnot
  exact (hnot hx).elim

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_eval_pos_of_degree_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2) μ := by
    have hpow : (p ^ 2).eval = fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2 := by
      funext x
      exact eval_pow 2
    rw [← hpow]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ (p ^ 2)
  have hnon : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hnon
  intro heq
  have hae : (fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2) =ᵐ[μ] 0 :=
    (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _) hi).mp heq.symm
  have hs : μ.support ⊆ {x | p.eval x = 0} := by
    apply Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed (isClosed_eq p.continuous continuous_const)
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, sq_eq_zero_iff] using hx
  exact hp0 (eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero s hu hp
    (fun i hi => hs (huμ i hi)))

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_degree_lt
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : InjOn v s)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < s.card) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i ∈ s, (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) * p.eval (v i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpI := Lagrange.eq_interpolate hv hp
  conv_lhs => rw [hpI]
  simp only [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [integral_finsetSum s (fun i hi =>
    (integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ (Lagrange.basis s v i)).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_orthogonal_nodal
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : InjOn v s)
    (horth : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < s.card →
      ∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * q.eval x ∂μ = 0)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i ∈ s, (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) * p.eval (v i)
proof:
:= by
  let l := Lagrange.nodal s v
  let Q := p /ₘ l
  let R := p %ₘ l
  have hQ : Q.degree < s.card := by
    by_cases hQ0 : Q = 0
    · simp [hQ0]
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [Q, h] at hQ0
    have hn := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hQ0]
    have hqn : Q.natDegree = p.natDegree - s.card := by
      simp only [Q, natDegree_divByMonic p Lagrange.nodal_monic, l, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal]
    rw [hqn]
    exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree - s.card < s.card by omega)
  have hR : R.degree < s.card := by
    simpa only [R, l, Lagrange.degree_nodal] using
      degree_modByMonic_lt p (Lagrange.nodal_monic (s := s) (v := v))
  have hdiv : p = R + l * Q := (modByMonic_add_div p l).symm
  have hInt : (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∫ x, R.eval x ∂μ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hdiv]
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul]
    rw [integral_add (integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ R)
      (by simpa only [eval_mul] using integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ (l * Q)),
      horth Q hQ, add_zero]
  rw [hInt, integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_degree_lt hμ s v hv hR]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hnode : R.eval (v i) = p.eval (v i) := by
    rw [hdiv, eval_add, eval_mul, Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node hi, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [hnode]

name: NLAlib.integral_basis_eq_integral_sq_basis_of_orthogonal_nodal
statement:
theorem integral_basis_eq_integral_sq_basis_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : InjOn v s)
    (horth : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < s.card →
      ∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * q.eval x ∂μ = 0) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, ((Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < s.card := card_pos.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hdeg : ((Lagrange.basis s v i) ^ 2).degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_pow, Lagrange.degree_basis hv hi]
    simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      (show ((2 * (s.card - 1) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) < ((2 * s.card : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
        from Nat.cast_lt.mpr (by omega))
