  have h := integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_orthogonal_nodal hμ s v hv horth hdeg
  have hpow : ((Lagrange.basis s v i) ^ 2).eval =
      fun x => ((Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x) ^ 2 := by
    funext x
    exact eval_pow 2
  rw [hpow] at h
  simp only [eval_pow] at h
  rw [sum_eq_single i] at h
  · simpa only [Lagrange.eval_basis_self hv hi, one_pow, mul_one] using h.symm
  · intro j hj hji
    rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hji.symm hj, zero_pow (by decide), mul_zero]
  · exact fun hnot => (hnot hi).elim

name: NLAlib.gauss_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
statement:
theorem gauss_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : InjOn v s)
    (horth : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < s.card →
      ∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * q.eval x ∂μ = 0)
    (hsupport : ∃ u : ι → ℝ, InjOn u s ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, u i ∈ μ.support) :
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) ∧
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) = (μ univ).toReal ∧
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) →
        (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) =
          ∑ i ∈ s, (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) * p.eval (v i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huμ⟩ := hsupport
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun p hp =>
    integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_orthogonal_nodal hμ s v hv horth hp⟩
  · intro i hi
    rw [integral_basis_eq_integral_sq_basis_of_orthogonal_nodal hμ s v hv horth hi]
    apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_degree_lt hμ s hu huμ
    · rw [Lagrange.degree_basis hv hi]
      exact_mod_cast (show s.card - 1 < s.card by have h := hs.card_pos; omega)
    · exact Lagrange.basis_ne_zero hv hi
  · have hdeg : (1 : ℝ[X]).degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) := by
      simp only [degree_one]
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 * s.card by have h := hs.card_pos; omega)
    have h := integral_eval_eq_sum_integral_basis_mul_eval_of_orthogonal_nodal
      hμ s v hv horth hdeg
    simpa only [eval_one, mul_one, integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, measureReal_def] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_gaussRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_gaussRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    let hMom
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hMom n i * f (gaussNodes μ hMom n i) =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial *
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hMom) n := by
  dsimp only
  let hMom := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ
  have hv := gaussNodes_injective hMom hn
  have hexact := fun p hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hMom hn0 hn
    (p := p) hp
  have hnorm : (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ (gaussNodes μ hMom n)).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hMom) n := by
    change _ = ∫ x, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hMom) n ^ 2).eval x ∂μ
    simp_rw [nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hMom hn, eval_pow]
  by_cases hnplus : (n + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard
  · obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_nodal_sq
      hab hμ hn0 (gaussNodes μ hMom n) (gaussWeights μ hMom n) hv
      (gaussNodes_mem_Ioo hMom hμ hnplus) hexact hf hf' hD
    rw [hnorm] at he
    exact ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩
  · have hcard : μ.support.encard = (n : ℕ∞) := by
      apply le_antisymm _ hn
      exact ENat.lt_natCast_add_one_iff.mp (not_le.mp hnplus)
    have hfinite := Set.finite_of_encard_eq_coe hcard
    have hncard : hfinite.toFinset.card = n := by
      exact_mod_cast (hfinite.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card.symm.trans hcard)
    have hzero := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_zero_of_finite_support μ hMom hfinite
    rw [hncard] at hzero
    have hnodalzero : (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ (gaussNodes μ hMom n)).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 :=
      hnorm.trans hzero
    have he := integral_eq_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_sq_eq_zero hμ hn0
      (gaussNodes μ hMom n) (gaussWeights μ hMom n) hv hexact hnodalzero f
    exact ⟨(a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by simp [he, hzero]⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_leftRadauNodes_eq_endpoint_modified_roots
statement:
theorem exists_leftRadauNodes_eq_endpoint_modified_roots {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c)
    (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a c) ∧ (∀ i, a ≠ v i) ∧
        (∀ i, leftRadauNodes L q a (e i) = endpointNodeFamily a v i) ∧
          Lagrange.nodal univ v = monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C a)) q := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  obtain ⟨ha, ham, hmc, hc, hsa, _⟩ := radauJacobiMatrices_bounds_and_endpoints hμ hμac q hs
  have hH := isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a
  have hn : ∀ i, leftRadauNodes L q a i ∈ Icc a c := hH.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order ha (ham.trans (hmc.trans hc))
  have hna : a ∈ Set.range (leftRadauNodes L q a) := by
    change a ∈ spectrum ℝ (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) at hsa
    simpa only [leftRadauNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsa
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hav, hev⟩ := exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily_mem_Icc
    (leftRadauNodes L q a) (radauNodes_injective_and_weights_pos hμ q hs a c).1 hn hna
  refine ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hav, hev, ?_⟩
  apply nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_leftEndpoint_exact hμ hμac hs v
    (leftRadauWeights L q a ∘ e) hv hav
  intro p hp
  have he := integral_eval_eq_sum_leftRadauWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs a hp
  calc _ = ∑ i, leftRadauWeights L q a i * p.eval (leftRadauNodes L q a i) := he
       _ = ∑ i, leftRadauWeights L q a (e i) * p.eval (leftRadauNodes L q a (e i)) :=
         (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
       _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, hev i]

name: NLAlib.exists_rightRadauNodes_eq_endpoint_modified_roots
statement:
theorem exists_rightRadauNodes_eq_endpoint_modified_roots {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c)
    (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a c) ∧ (∀ i, c ≠ v i) ∧
        (∀ i, rightRadauNodes L q c (e i) = endpointNodeFamily c v i) ∧
          Lagrange.nodal univ v = monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (C c - X)) q := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  obtain ⟨ha, ham, hmc, hc, _, hsc⟩ := radauJacobiMatrices_bounds_and_endpoints hμ hμac q hs
  have hH := isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c
  have hn : ∀ i, rightRadauNodes L q c i ∈ Icc a c := hH.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order (ha.trans (ham.trans hmc)) hc
  have hnc : c ∈ Set.range (rightRadauNodes L q c) := by
    change c ∈ spectrum ℝ (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) at hsc
    simpa only [rightRadauNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsc
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hcv, hev⟩ := exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily_mem_Icc
    (rightRadauNodes L q c) (radauNodes_injective_and_weights_pos hμ q hs a c).2.2.1 hn hnc
  refine ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hcv, hev, ?_⟩
  apply nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_rightEndpoint_exact hμ hμac hs v
    (rightRadauWeights L q c ∘ e) hv hcv
  intro p hp
  have he := integral_eval_eq_sum_rightRadauWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs c hp
  calc _ = ∑ i, rightRadauWeights L q c i * p.eval (rightRadauNodes L q c i) := he
       _ = ∑ i, rightRadauWeights L q c (e i) * p.eval (rightRadauNodes L q c (e i)) :=
         (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
       _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, hev i]

name: NLAlib.exists_lobattoNodes_eq_twoEndpoint_modified_roots
statement:
theorem exists_lobattoNodes_eq_twoEndpoint_modified_roots {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 2)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a c) ∧
        (∀ i, lobattoNodes L q a c (e i) = twoEndpointNodeFamily a c v i) ∧
          Lagrange.nodal univ v = monicOrthogonalPolynomial
            (polynomialWeightedFunctional L ((X - C a) * (C c - X))) q := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  have hs' : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard :=
    ((by exact_mod_cast (show q + 1 ≤ q + 2 by omega) : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ q + 2).trans hs)
  obtain ⟨ha, hc, hsa, hsc⟩ := lobattoJacobiMatrix_bounds_and_endpoints hμ hac hμac q hs
  obtain ⟨hJa, hJc⟩ := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posDef hμ hμac (q + 1) (by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] using hs)
  have hH := isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c
  have hn : ∀ i, lobattoNodes L q a c i ∈ Icc a c := hH.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order ha hc
  have hna : a ∈ Set.range (lobattoNodes L q a c) := by
    change a ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) at hsa
    simpa only [lobattoNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsa
  have hnc : c ∈ Set.range (lobattoNodes L q a c) := by
    change c ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) at hsc
    simpa only [lobattoNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsc
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hev⟩ := exists_perm_twoEndpointNodeFamily (lobattoNodes L q a c)
    (lobattoNodes_injective_and_weights_pos hμ q hs' a c hac hJa hJc).1 hac hn hna hnc
  refine ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hev, ?_⟩
  apply nodal_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_twoEndpoint_exact hμ hac hμac hs v
    (lobattoWeights L q a c ∘ e) hv (fun i => (hvi i).1.ne) (fun i => (hvi i).2.ne')
  intro p hp
  have he := integral_eval_eq_sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs' a c hp
  calc _ = ∑ i, lobattoWeights L q a c i * p.eval (lobattoNodes L q a c i) := he
       _ = ∑ i, lobattoWeights L q a c (e i) * p.eval (lobattoNodes L q a c (e i)) :=
         (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
       _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, hev i]

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisLinearMap_apply_eq_rule
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisLinearMap_apply_eq_rule (n : ℕ) (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    clenshawCurtisLinearMap n f =
      clenshawCurtisRule n (IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clenshawCurtisRule_eq_sum_weights]
  change (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), clenshawCurtisWeight n j *
    f ⟨node n j, node_mem_Icc⟩) = _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ node_mem_Icc]

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisRule_polynomial_exact
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisRule_polynomial_exact {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    clenshawCurtisRule n p.eval = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : p.degree < (Finset.range (n + 1)).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_range]
    exact p.degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hp)
  have hpoly := Lagrange.eq_interpolate (v := node n) (chebyshev_node_injOn n) hdeg
  rw [clenshawCurtisRule]
  have hvalues : p.eval ∘ node n = fun j => p.eval (node n j) := rfl
  rw [hvalues, ← hpoly]

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisLinearMap_polynomial_exact
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisLinearMap_polynomial_exact (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    clenshawCurtisLinearMap n (p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) =
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← clenshawCurtisRule_polynomial_exact hp, clenshawCurtisRule_eq_sum_weights]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.tendsto_clenshawCurtisLinearMap
statement:
theorem tendsto_clenshawCurtisLinearMap (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => clenshawCurtisLinearMap n f) atTop (𝓝 (unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap f))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_quadrature_of_bound_and_polynomial_exact clenshawCurtisLinearMap 2 (by norm_num)
    abs_clenshawCurtisLinearMap_le clenshawCurtisLinearMap_polynomial_exact f

name: NLAlib.tendsto_clenshawCurtisRule_of_continuousOn
proof:
:= by
  let fc : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ) := ⟨fun x => f x, hf.domRestrict⟩
  have hrule : ∀ n, clenshawCurtisLinearMap n fc = clenshawCurtisRule n f := by
    intro n
    rw [clenshawCurtisRule_eq_sum_weights]
    rfl
  have hint : unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap fc = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    rw [uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hx
    rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx]
    rfl
  have h := tendsto_clenshawCurtisLinearMap fc
  simp only [hrule, hint] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.gaussWeights_eq_secondKindPolynomial_div_derivative
statement:
theorem gaussWeights_eq_secondKindPolynomial_div_derivative
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (i : Fin n) :
    gaussWeights μ hμ n i =
      (secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) /
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).derivative.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i)
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by have := i.isLt; omega
  have hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k ≠ 0 := fun k hk =>
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn)
  have hnum := eval_secondKindPolynomial_at_node (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n hn0 hL
    (gaussNodes μ hμ n) (gaussWeights μ hμ n) (gaussNodes_injective hμ hn)
    (fun j => (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨j,rfl⟩)
    (fun p hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn
      (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ 2*n by omega)))) i
  have hder : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).derivative.eval
      (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hμ hn]
    have h := Lagrange.nodalWeight_ne_zero (gaussNodes_injective hμ hn).injOn (mem_univ i)
    rw [Lagrange.nodalWeight_eq_eval_derivative_nodal (mem_univ i)] at h
    intro hd
    rw [hd, inv_zero] at h
    exact h rfl
  rw [hnum, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hder]

name: NLAlib.nodal_eq_neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem nodal_eq_neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_of_orthogonal
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : InjOn v s)
    (hvI : ∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < s.card →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * p.eval x = 0) :
    Lagrange.nodal s v = C ((-1 : ℝ) ^ s.card) * (Lagrange.nodal s v).comp (-X)
proof:
:= by
  let q := Lagrange.nodal s v
  let r := C ((-1 : ℝ) ^ s.card) * q.comp (-X)
  have hq : q.Monic := Lagrange.nodal_monic
  have hr : r.Monic := by
    have h := hq.neg_one_pow_natDegree_mul_comp_neg_X
    simpa only [r, q, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, C_pow, C_neg, C_1] using h
  have hdeg : r.degree = q.degree := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [degree_C_mul (by positivity), degree_comp_neg_X]
  have hd : (q - r).degree < s.card := by
    have h := degree_sub_lt_left hdeg.symm hq.ne_zero (hq.trans hr.symm)
    simpa only [q, Lagrange.degree_nodal] using h
  have hrorth (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < s.card) :
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, r.eval x * p.eval x = 0 := by
    have hP := horth (p.comp (-X)) (by simpa only [degree_comp_neg_X] using hp)
    have href := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
      (fun x => q.eval x * p.eval (-x))
    simp only [neg_neg, q] at href
    have hneg : (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, q.eval (-x) * p.eval x) = 0 := by
      rw [href]
      simpa only [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X] using hP
    dsimp [r]
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X, mul_assoc]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hneg, mul_zero]
  have hz : (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, ((q - r).eval x) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    have h1 := horth (q - r) hd
    have h2 := hrorth (q - r) hd
    have heq : (fun x => ((q - r).eval x) ^ 2) =
        fun x => q.eval x * (q - r).eval x - r.eval x * (q - r).eval x := by
      funext x
      simp only [eval_sub]
      ring
    rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      (f := fun x => q.eval x * (q - r).eval x)
      (g := fun x => r.eval x * (q - r).eval x)
      ((q.continuous.mul (q - r).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((r.continuous.mul (q - r).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _), h1, h2, sub_self]
  have heq : q - r = 0 := by
    by_contra hd0
    let μ := volume.restrict (Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    have hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (μ := volume) measurableSet_Ioc] with x hx
      exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self hx
    have hsupp : ∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ μ.support := by
      intro i hi
      apply Measure.interior_inter_support
      exact ⟨by rw [interior_Ioc]; exact hvI i hi, by rw [Measure.support_eq_univ]; trivial⟩
    have hpos := integral_sq_eval_pos_of_degree_lt hμ s hv hsupp hd hd0
    have hInt : (∫ x, ((q - r).eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
        ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, ((q - r).eval x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    rw [hInt, hz] at hpos
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp heq

name: NLAlib.exists_reflection_equiv_of_orthogonal_nodal
statement:
theorem exists_reflection_equiv_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvI : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < Fintype.card ι →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * p.eval x = 0) :
    ∃ σ : ι ≃ ι, (∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) ∧
      ∀ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v (σ i)).eval x) =
        ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvS : InjOn v (univ : Finset ι) := fun i hi j hj h => hv h
  have hq := nodal_eq_neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_of_orthogonal univ v hvS
    (fun i hi => hvI i) (by simpa only [card_univ] using horth)
  have hroot (i : ι) : ∃ j, v j = -v i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval (-v i)) hq
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X, neg_neg,
      Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i), mul_zero] at h
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_eq_zero_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hzero⟩ := h
    exact ⟨j, (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm⟩
  let τ : ι → ι := fun i => Classical.choose (hroot i)
  have hτ (i : ι) : v (τ i) = -v i := Classical.choose_spec (hroot i)
  have hτinj : Function.Injective τ := by
    intro i j h
    apply hv
    have he := congrArg v h
    rw [hτ, hτ] at he
    exact neg_injective he
  let σ := Equiv.ofBijective τ hτinj.bijective_of_finite
  have hσ (i : ι) : v (σ i) = -v i := hτ i
  refine ⟨σ, hσ, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hpol : (Lagrange.basis univ v (σ i)).comp (-X) = Lagrange.basis univ v i := by
    have hc : 0 < Fintype.card ι := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩
    apply eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq univ hvS
    · rw [degree_comp_neg_X, Lagrange.degree_basis hvS (mem_univ _), card_univ]
      exact_mod_cast (show Fintype.card ι - 1 < Fintype.card ι by omega)
    · rw [Lagrange.degree_basis hvS (mem_univ _), card_univ]
      exact_mod_cast (show Fintype.card ι - 1 < Fintype.card ι by omega)
    · intro j hj
      rw [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X, ← hσ j]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_self hvS (mem_univ _), Lagrange.eval_basis_self hvS (mem_univ _)]
      · rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne (fun h => hij (σ.injective h)) (mem_univ _),
          Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hij (mem_univ _)]
  have heval := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval) hpol
  have href := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
    (Lagrange.basis univ v (σ i)).eval
  simp only [neg_neg] at href
  have hcomp : (fun x => (Lagrange.basis univ v (σ i)).eval (-x)) =
      (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval := by
    funext x
    simpa only [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X] using congrFun heval x
  rw [hcomp] at href
  exact href.symm

name: NLAlib.sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval_mul_eval_eq_integral
statement:
theorem sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval_mul_eval_eq_integral {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a c : ℝ) {p r : ℝ[X]} (hpr : p.degree + r.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ)) :
    (∑ i, lobattoWeights (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c i *
      p.eval (lobattoNodes (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c i) *
      r.eval (lobattoNodes (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c i)) =
      ∫ x, p.eval x * r.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [eval_mul, mul_assoc] using
    (integral_eval_eq_sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs a c (p := p * r)
      (by simpa only [degree_mul] using hpr)).symm

name: NLAlib.abs_unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap_le
statement:
theorem abs_unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap_le (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    |unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap f| ≤ 2 * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
    (f := IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f) (C := ‖f‖) (fun x hx => by
      have hx' := uIoc_subset_uIcc hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hx'
      rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx']
      exact f.norm_coe_le_norm ⟨x, hx'⟩)
  simpa only [unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_neg_eq_add, one_add_one_eq_two, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
    mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap_polynomial
statement:
theorem unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap_polynomial (p : ℝ[X]) :
    unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap (p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) =
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro x hx
  rw [uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hx
  rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.tendsto_quadrature_of_bound_and_polynomial_exact
statement:
theorem tendsto_quadrature_of_bound_and_polynomial_exact
    (Q : ℕ → (C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbound : ∀ n f, |Q n f| ≤ B * ‖f‖)
    (hexact : ∀ (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ), p.natDegree ≤ n →
      Q n (p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x)
    (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => Q n f) atTop (𝓝 (unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap f))
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hden : 0 < B + 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_polynomial_near_continuousMap (-1) 1 f
    (ε / (B + 2)) (div_pos hε hden)
  refine ⟨p.natDegree, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  let pc := p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
  have hQ : Q n pc = unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap pc :=
    (hexact p n hn).trans (unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap_polynomial p).symm
  have heq : Q n f - unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap f =
      Q n (f - pc) - unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap (f - pc) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hQ]
    ring
  rw [Real.dist_eq, heq]
  calc
    |Q n (f - pc) - unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap (f - pc)| ≤
        |Q n (f - pc)| + |unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap (f - pc)| := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_sub_le (Q n (f - pc)) (unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap (f - pc))
    _ ≤ (B + 2) * ‖f - pc‖ := by
      have hq := hbound n (f - pc)
      have hi := abs_unitIntervalIntegralLinearMap_le (f - pc)
      nlinarith
    _ < (B + 2) * (ε / (B + 2)) := by
      apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hden
      simpa only [pc, norm_sub_rev] using hp
    _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε hden.ne'

name: NLAlib.cast_half_mul_succ
statement:
private theorem cast_half_mul_succ (ν : ℕ) :
    ((ν * (ν + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have he := Nat.even_iff.mp (Nat.even_mul_succ_self ν)
  have h := Nat.div_add_mod (ν * (ν + 1)) 2
  rw [he, add_zero] at h
  have hR := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) h
  push_cast at hR
  linarith

name: NLAlib.mul_pow_le_sub_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 105 * ν * 2 ^ ν ≤ 16 * ((105 * ν * 2 ^ ν + 15) / 16) := by omega
  have hs : ν * (ν + 1) / 2 ≤ n := by unfold quadratureBvThreshold at hn; omega
  have hN : 105 * ν * 2 ^ ν ≤ 16 * (n - ν * (ν + 1) / 2) := by
    unfold quadratureBvThreshold at hn
    omega
  have hR := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (Nat.sub_add_cancel hs)
  push_cast at hR
  have hCast : (105 : ℝ) * ν * 2 ^ ν ≤ 16 * ((n : ℝ) - ((ν * (ν + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hN
  rw [cast_half_mul_succ] at hCast
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_le_power_envelope_of_descFactorial
statement:
theorem abs_le_power_envelope_of_descFactorial {ν n k : ℕ} {V a : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hnν : ν ≤ n) (hk : n < k)
    (hs : (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2 < n + 1)
    (ha : |a| ≤ 2 * V / (Real.pi * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ))) :
    |a| ≤ (2 * V / (Real.pi * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1)))) /
      (k : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let s := (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by dsimp [s]; positivity
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hkn : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (show n + 1 ≤ k by omega)
  have hd : 0 < 1 - s / (n + 1) := sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_one hn0).mpr hs)
  have hdiv : s / k ≤ s / (n + 1) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hs0 hn0 hkn
  have hprod := pow_mul_one_sub_le_cast_descFactorial (show ν < k by omega)
  have hlow : (k : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1) * (1 - s / (n + 1)) ≤
      (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := by
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hdiv 1) (pow_nonneg hk0.le _)).trans hprod
  have hlpos : 0 < (k : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1) * (1 - s / (n + 1)) := by positivity
  have hdp : 0 < (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := hlpos.trans_le hlow
  refine ha.trans ?_
  have hle := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (show 0 ≤ 2 * V by positivity)
    (mul_pos Real.pi_pos hlpos) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow Real.pi_pos.le)
  convert hle using 1
  dsimp [s]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.bv_stronger_rate_le_eventual_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le
statement:
theorem bv_stronger_rate_le_eventual_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le {ν n : ℕ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 1 ≤ ν) (hn : quadratureBvThreshold ν ≤ n) (hV : 0 ≤ V) :
    14 * V / (Real.pi * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1)) * (n : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1)) ≤
      32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  let s := (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2
  let d := 1 - s / (n + 1)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by dsimp [s]; positivity
  have hνR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ν := by exact_mod_cast hν
  have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ ν := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hbig : (105 / 16 : ℝ) ≤ (105 / 16 : ℝ) * ν * 2 ^ ν := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Nat.cast_nonneg ν : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ν)
    nlinarith
  have hc := mul_pow_le_sub_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le hn
  change (105 / 16 : ℝ) * ν * 2 ^ ν ≤ (n : ℝ) - s at hc
  have hn2R : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by linarith
  have hsn : s < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
  have hnνR : (ν : ℝ) ≤ n := by dsimp [s] at hc; nlinarith
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hn1 : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by linarith
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; exact sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_one hn1).mpr hsn)
  have hident : (n : ℝ) * d = n - s + s / (n + 1) := by
    dsimp [d]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hcn : (105 / 16 : ℝ) * ν * 2 ^ ν ≤ (n : ℝ) * d := by
    rw [hident]
    exact hc.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hs0 hn1.le))
  have hbase : 0 < 2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν := by linarith
  change 14 * V / (Real.pi * d * (n : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1)) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ 32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ ν) := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < Real.pi * d * (n : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1))
        (by positivity : 0 < 15 * Real.pi * (ν : ℝ) * (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ ν)).mpr
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcn
        (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 32 * V * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) ^ ν by positivity)
      rw [mul_pow, pow_succ]
      convert h using 1 <;> ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (show 0 ≤ 32 * V by positivity) (by positivity)
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ 15 * Real.pi * (ν : ℝ))
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase.le
      linarith

name: NLAlib.polynomial_rule_exact_iff_moments
statement:
theorem polynomial_rule_exact_iff_moments (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (v w : ι → ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d → L p = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ k < d, L (X ^ k) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * v i ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun p => ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)
      map_add' := by intro p q; simp [mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c p
        simp only [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        rw [mul_sum]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        ring }
  simpa only [Q, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, eval_pow, eval_X] using
    Polynomial.linearMap_eq_of_degree_lt_iff_pow L Q d

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_quadrature_iff
statement:
theorem integral_eq_quadrature_iff {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s) (w : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (s.card + k : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i = ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) ∧
        (∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < k →
          (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * q.eval x ∂μ) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul] using
    Lagrange.linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_iff (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) hs hv w k

name: NLAlib.not_integral_eq_quadrature_degree_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < polynomialIntegral μ hμ (Lagrange.nodal univ v ^ 2) := by
    simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow]
    apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero
    · rw [Lagrange.degree_nodal]
      simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n
    · exact hμ.integrable_sq _
  simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
    Lagrange.not_linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_of_nodal_sq_pos
      (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) univ v w hpos

name: NLAlib.quadrature_weight_pos_of_gauss_exact
statement:
theorem quadrature_weight_pos_of_gauss_exact {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {v : Fin n → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v) (w : Fin n → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) (i : Fin n) : 0 < w i
proof:
:= by
  have hw := Lagrange.weight_eq_linearMap_basis_sq_of_exact
    (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) hv.injOn w (by simpa using he) (mem_univ i)
  rw [hw, polynomialIntegral_apply]
  simp only [eval_pow]
  apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn (Lagrange.basis_ne_zero hv.injOn (mem_univ i))
  · rw [Lagrange.degree_basis hv.injOn (mem_univ i)]
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < n by have := i.isLt; omega)
  · exact hμ.integrable_sq _

name: NLAlib.quadrature_rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments
statement:
theorem quadrature_rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (v u w a : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hu : Function.Injective u)
    (hw : ∀ k < 2 * n, (∫ x, x ^ k ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * v i ^ k)
    (ha : ∀ k < 2 * n, (∫ x, x ^ k ∂μ) = ∑ i, a i * u i ^ k) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (∀ i, u (e i) = v i) ∧ (∀ i, a (e i) = w i)
proof:
:= by
  apply polynomial_gauss_rule_eq_up_to_permutation hn0 (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) v u w a hv hu
  · intro r hr hr0
    simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow] using
      (integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn hr0 hr (hμ.integrable_sq r)).ne'
  · apply (polynomial_rule_exact_iff_moments (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) univ v w (2 * n)).mpr
    simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, eval_X] using hw
  · apply (polynomial_rule_exact_iff_moments (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) univ u a (2 * n)).mpr
    simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, eval_X] using ha

name: NLAlib.integral_dividedPolynomialMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_dividedPolynomialMeasure (μ : Measure ℝ) (ω : ℝ[X])
    (hω : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω) = ∫ x, f x / ω.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [dividedPolynomialMeasure, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    (by fun_prop) (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hω] with x hx
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (inv_nonneg.mpr hx.le), smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.polynomial_exactness_iff_rational_exactness
statement:
theorem polynomial_exactness_iff_rational_exactness (μ : Measure ℝ) (ω : ℝ[X])
    (hω : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x) {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i ∈ s, ω.eval (v i) ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d →
        (∫ x, p.eval x / ω.eval x ∂μ) =
          ∑ i ∈ s, (w i * ω.eval (v i)) * (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i)))
proof:
:= by
  have he (p : ℝ[X]) : (∑ i ∈ s, (w i * ω.eval (v i)) *
      (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i))) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    field_simp [hv i hi]
  simp_rw [integral_dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω hω, he]

name: NLAlib.rational_exactness_iff_divided_weights_exactness
statement:
theorem rational_exactness_iff_divided_weights_exactness (μ : Measure ℝ) (ω : ℝ[X])
    (hω : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x) {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i ∈ s, ω.eval (v i) ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d → (∫ x, p.eval x / ω.eval x ∂μ) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, w i * (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i))) ↔
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d →
        (∫ x, p.eval x ∂dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω) =
          ∑ i ∈ s, (w i / ω.eval (v i)) * p.eval (v i))
proof:
:= by
  have he := polynomial_exactness_iff_rational_exactness μ ω hω s v
    (fun i => w i / ω.eval (v i)) hv d
  have hw : ∀ i ∈ s, (w i / ω.eval (v i)) * ω.eval (v i) = w i := by
    intro i hi
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hv i hi)
  have hsum (p : ℝ[X]) :
      (∑ i ∈ s, ((w i / ω.eval (v i)) * ω.eval (v i)) *
        (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i))) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, w i * (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i)) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hw i hi]
  simpa only [hsum] using he.symm

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_of_bv {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν < n) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) - clenshawCurtisRule n (F 0)| ≤
      32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hcS := summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv hν hAC hderiv hBV hV
  have hf : ContinuousOn (F 0) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by simpa using (hAC 0 hν).continuousOn
  have htail := tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_descFactorial hcS hν hn
    (show 0 ≤ 2 * V / Real.pi by positivity) (fun k hk => by
      have h := abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial hAC hderiv hBV hV hk
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h)
  have h := abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_even_tail hcS
    (fun x hx => hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hcS hx) hn2
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 32 / 15)
  convert hmul using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_of_bv
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hmass : ∑ i, w i = 2)
    (σ : ι ≃ ι) (hvσ : ∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) (hwσ : ∀ i, w (σ i) = w i)
    {n ν : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hν : 0 < ν) (hnν : ν < 2 * n + 1)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) - ∑ i, w i * F 0 (v i)| ≤
      32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hcS := summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv hν hAC hderiv hBV hV
  have hf : ContinuousOn (F 0) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by simpa using (hAC 0 hν).continuousOn
  have htail := tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_descFactorial hcS hν hnν
    (show 0 ≤ 2 * V / Real.pi by positivity) (fun k hk => by
      have h := abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial hAC hderiv hBV hV hk
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h)
  have h := abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_even_tail v w hv hw hmass σ hvσ hwσ hn hexact hcS
    (fun x hx => hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hcS hx)
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 32 / 15)
  push_cast at hmul
  convert hmul using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_one_extra_exact
statement:
theorem integral_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_one_extra_exact
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ} (v : Fin q → ℝ)
    (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hav : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) (hbv : ∀ i, b ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 3 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i))
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  let W : ℝ[X] := (X - C a) * (X - C b) * P ^ 2
  have hP : P.natDegree = q := by simp only [P, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hWd : W.degree < (2 * q + 3 : ℕ) := by
    apply degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt
    have h₁ := natDegree_mul_le (p := (X - C a : ℝ[X])) (q := X - C b)
    have h₂ := natDegree_mul_le (p := (X - C a : ℝ[X]) * (X - C b)) (q := P ^ 2)
    rw [natDegree_X_sub_C, natDegree_X_sub_C] at h₁
    rw [natDegree_pow, hP] at h₂
    exact_mod_cast (show W.natDegree < 2 * q + 3 by dsimp only [W]; omega)
  have hzero : (∫ x, (x - a) * (x - b) * P.eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
    have h := hexact W hWd
    have hn (i : Fin (q + 2)) : W.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) = 0 := by
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i) i
      · change W.eval a = 0
        simp [W]
      · change W.eval b = 0
        simp [W]
      · simp [W, twoEndpointNodeFamily, endpointNodeFamily, P,
          Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i)]
    simpa only [W, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow, hn, mul_zero,
      sum_const_zero] using h
  exact integral_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero hab hμ v w hv hav hbv
    (fun p hp => hexact p (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q + 2 ≤ 2 * q + 3 by omega))))
    hzero f

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_radau_degree_rule_of_both_endpoints
statement:
theorem integral_eq_radau_degree_rule_of_both_endpoints
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ} (v w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hvi : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b)
    (hva : a ∈ Set.range v) (hvb : b ∈ Set.range v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (v i)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hva
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hvb
    have hij : i = j := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)
    exact (hab.ne (hi.symm.trans ((congrArg v hij).trans hj))).elim
  | succ q =>
    obtain ⟨e, u, hu, hui, heu⟩ := exists_perm_twoEndpointNodeFamily v hv hab hvi hva hvb
    have hsum (g : ℝ → ℝ) : (∑ i, w i * g (v i)) =
        ∑ i, w (e i) * g (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b u i) := by
      calc _ = ∑ i, w (e i) * g (v (e i)) := (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
           _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [heu i]
    have he := integral_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_one_extra_exact hab hμ u (w ∘ e) hu
      (fun i => (hui i).1.ne) (fun i => (hui i).2.ne') (by
        intro p hp
        have hd : p.degree < (2 * (q + 1) + 1 : ℕ) := by
          simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.add_assoc] using hp
        exact (hexact p hd).trans (hsum p.eval)) f
    exact he.trans (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using (hsum f).symm)

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_leftRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_leftRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c)) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a c) ∧ (∀ i, a ≠ v i) ∧
        (∀ i, leftRadauNodes L q a (e i) = endpointNodeFamily a v i) ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a c,
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - L 1 * cfc f (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) 0 0 =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - a) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  obtain ⟨ha, ham, hmc, hc, hsa, hsc⟩ := radauJacobiMatrices_bounds_and_endpoints hμ hμac q hs
  have hH := isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a
  have hn : ∀ i, leftRadauNodes L q a i ∈ Icc a c := hH.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order ha (ham.trans (hmc.trans hc))
  have hna : a ∈ Set.range (leftRadauNodes L q a) := by
    change a ∈ spectrum ℝ (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) at hsa
    simpa only [leftRadauNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsa
  have hni := (radauNodes_injective_and_weights_pos hμ q hs a c).1
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hav, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_radau_degree_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hac hμac (Or.inl rfl)
      (leftRadauNodes L q a) (leftRadauWeights L q a) hni hn hna
      (fun p hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_leftRadauWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs a hp) hf hf' hD
  rw [← mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum L q a f] at herr
  exact ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hav, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_rightRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_rightRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c)) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a c) ∧ (∀ i, c ≠ v i) ∧
        (∀ i, rightRadauNodes L q c (e i) = endpointNodeFamily c v i) ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a c,
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - L 1 * cfc f (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) 0 0 =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - c) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  obtain ⟨ha, ham, hmc, hc, hsa, hsc⟩ := radauJacobiMatrices_bounds_and_endpoints hμ hμac q hs
  have hH := isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c
  have hn : ∀ i, rightRadauNodes L q c i ∈ Icc a c := hH.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order (ha.trans (ham.trans hmc)) hc
  have hnc : c ∈ Set.range (rightRadauNodes L q c) := by
    change c ∈ spectrum ℝ (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) at hsc
    simpa only [rightRadauNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsc
  have hni := (radauNodes_injective_and_weights_pos hμ q hs a c).2.2.1
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hcv, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_radau_degree_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hac hμac (Or.inr rfl)
      (rightRadauNodes L q c) (rightRadauWeights L q c) hni hn hnc
      (fun p hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_rightRadauWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs c hp) hf hf' hD
  rw [← mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum L q c f] at herr
  exact ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hcv, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x) :
    (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) 1 * cfc f (leftRadauJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a) 0 0 ≤
      ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hav, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_leftRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hμ hac hμac q hs hf hf' hD
  have hw : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (x - a) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (hDpos ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 1).factorial)) hw
  rw [← herr] at hE
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hE

name: NLAlib.integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) 1 *
      cfc f (rightRadauJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q c) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hcv, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_rightRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hμ hac hμac q hs hf hf' hD
  have hw : (∫ x, (x - c) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 0 := by
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
    (div_nonneg (hDpos ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 1).factorial)) hw
  rw [← herr] at hE
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hE

name: NLAlib.gaussWeights_eq_mass_mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero
statement:
theorem gaussWeights_eq_mass_mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (i : Fin n) :
    gaussWeights μ hμ n i = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) *
      (((isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).eigenvectorBasis i :
        Fin n → ℝ) ⟨0, hn⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let hJ := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let p := Lagrange.basis univ (gaussNodes μ hμ n) i
  have hd : p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    rw [Lagrange.degree_basis (gaussNodes_injective hμ hs).injOn (mem_univ i), card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < 2 * n by omega)
  have hm := functional_eq_mass_mul_aeval_jacobi_apply_zero_zero L hn
    (fun j hj => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hs))
    (fun j hj => orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj : (j + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hs)) hd
  have hc := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hJ p (Pi.single ⟨0, hn⟩ 1)
  rw [dotProduct_comm, dotProduct_single_one, Matrix.mulVec_single_one] at hc
  simp only [dotProduct_single_one] at hc
  change (aeval (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n) p) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩ = _ at hc
  have hnodes : hJ.eigenvalues = gaussNodes μ hμ n := rfl
  rw [hnodes] at hc
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i] at hc
  · rw [show p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) = 1 from
      Lagrange.eval_basis_self (gaussNodes_injective hμ hs).injOn (mem_univ i), one_mul] at hc
    rw [hc] at hm
    simpa only [L, p, gaussWeights, momentGaussWeights, gaussNodes, momentGaussNodes,
      polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_one] using hm
  · intro j _ hji
    rw [show p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n j) = 0 from
      Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hji.symm (mem_univ j), zero_mul]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_of_multiset
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_of_multiset
    {a b x : ℝ} (m : Multiset ℝ) (hm : 0 < m.card)
    (hmem : ∀ y ∈ m, y ∈ Icc a b)
    (hrep : ∀ y ∈ m, 1 < m.count y → y ∈ Ioo a b)
    {H ω : ℝ[X]} (hH : H.degree < m.card) (hω : ω.Monic) (hωdeg : ω.natDegree = m.card)
    (hωjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y, (derivative^[k] ω).eval y = 0)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y,
      iteratedDeriv k f y = (derivative^[k] H).eval y)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < m.card, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hωx : ω.eval x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, f x - H.eval x =
      iteratedDeriv m.card f ξ / m.card.factorial * ω.eval x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := (f x - H.eval x) / ω.eval x
  let p := H + C K * ω
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => f y - p.eval y
  have heq := iteratedDeriv_sub_eval_eqOn isOpen_Ioo p hf'
  have hxnot : x ∉ m := by
    intro hxmem
    exact hωx (by simpa using hωjet x hxmem 0 (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hxmem))
  have hgx : g x = 0 := by
    dsimp [g, p, K]
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hgjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y, iteratedDeriv k g y = 0 := by
    intro y hy k hk
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · subst k
      have h₁ := hjet y hy 0 hk
      have h₂ := hωjet y hy 0 hk
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] at h₂
      simpa [g, p, h₂] using sub_eq_zero.mpr h₁
    · have hyi := hrep y hy (by omega)
      have hkcard : k < m.card := hk.trans_le (Multiset.count_le_card _ _)
      have he := heq k hkcard.le hyi
      change iteratedDeriv k g y = iteratedDeriv k f y - (derivative^[k] p).eval y at he
      dsimp only [p] at he
      rw [iterate_map_add, iterate_derivative_C_mul, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C,
        hωjet y hy k hk, mul_zero, add_zero, ← hjet y hy k hk, sub_self] at he
      exact he
  let m' : Multiset ℝ := m + {x}
  have hcard : m'.card = (m.card - 1) + 2 := by simp [m']; omega
  have hcount (y : ℝ) (hyx : y ≠ x) : m'.count y = m.count y := by simp [m', hyx]
  have hcountx : m'.count x = 1 := by simp [m', Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hxnot]
  have hdistinct : ∃ y ∈ m', ∃ t ∈ m', y ≠ t := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mp hm
    exact ⟨x, by simp [m'], y, by simp [m', hy], fun h => hxnot (h.symm ▸ hy)⟩
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_multiset_multiplicities
    m' hcard hdistinct
    (by intro y hy; rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hy with hy | hy
        · exact hmem y hy
        · have hyx := Multiset.mem_singleton.mp hy
          simpa only [hyx] using hx)
    (by
      intro y hy hc
      have hyx : y ≠ x := by intro h; subst y; rw [hcountx] at hc; omega
      have hym : y ∈ m := by simpa [m', hyx] using hy
      rw [hcount y hyx] at hc
      exact hrep y hym hc)
    (hf.sub (Polynomial.continuous _).continuousOn)
    (fun k hk => ((hf' (k + 1) (by omega)).continuousOn.sub
      (Polynomial.continuous _).continuousOn).congr (heq (k + 1) (by omega)))
    (by
      intro y hy k hk
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst y
        rw [hcountx] at hk
        have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
        simpa [hk0] using hgx
      · have hym : y ∈ m := by simpa [m', hyx] using hy
        rw [hcount y hyx] at hk
        exact hgjet y hym k hk)
  rw [show m.card - 1 + 1 = m.card by omega] at hξ0
  change iteratedDeriv m.card g ξ = 0 at hξ0
  have hpderiv : (derivative^[m.card] p).eval ξ = K * m.card.factorial := by
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [iterate_map_add, iterate_derivative_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hH, zero_add,
      iterate_derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, ← hωdeg,
      eval_iterate_derivative_natDegree, hω.leadingCoeff, mul_one]
  have hh := heq m.card le_rfl hξ
  change iteratedDeriv m.card g ξ = iteratedDeriv m.card f ξ -
    (derivative^[m.card] p).eval ξ at hh
  rw [hξ0, hpderiv] at hh
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  rw [show iteratedDeriv m.card f ξ = K * m.card.factorial by linarith]
  dsimp [K]
  have hfac : (m.card.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_hermiteInterpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_hermiteInterpolate_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a b x : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {v : Fin n → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      f x - (Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial *
          (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  let π := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  have hHnode (i : Fin n) : H.eval (v i) = f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn _ _ (mem_univ i)
  have hHderiv (i : Fin n) : H.derivative.eval (v i) = deriv f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn _ _ (mem_univ i)
  have hπnode (i : Fin n) : π.eval (v i) = 0 := Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i)
  by_cases hnode : ∃ i, x = v i
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hnode
    refine ⟨(a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    change f (v i) - H.eval (v i) = _ * π.eval (v i) ^ 2
    rw [hHnode, hπnode]
    ring
  have hnx (i : Fin n) : x ≠ v i := fun h => hnode ⟨i, h⟩
  have hπx : π.eval x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    exact prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hnx i)
  let K := (f x - H.eval x) / π.eval x ^ 2
  let p := H + C K * π ^ 2
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => f t - p.eval t
  have heq := iteratedDeriv_sub_eval_eqOn isOpen_Ioo p hf'
  have hgx : g x = 0 := by
    dsimp [g, p, K]
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hgnode (i : Fin n) : g (v i) = 0 := by
    simp [g, p, hHnode i, hπnode i]
  have hgderiv (i : Fin n) : deriv g (v i) = 0 := by
    have hh := heq 1 (by omega) (hva i)
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_one, Function.iterate_one] at hh
    change deriv g (v i) = deriv f (v i) - p.derivative.eval (v i) at hh
    simpa [p, derivative_add, derivative_C_mul, derivative_pow,
      hπnode i, hHderiv i] using hh
  let z : Multiset ℝ := (univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map v
  let m : Multiset ℝ := z + z + {x}
  have hznd : z.Nodup := Multiset.Nodup.map hv univ.nodup
  have hzi (i : Fin n) : v i ∈ z := Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, by simp, rfl⟩
  have hzx : x ∉ z := by
    intro hxz
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hxz
    exact hnx i hi.symm
  have hzc (i : Fin n) : z.count (v i) = 1 := Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem hznd (hzi i)
  have hmcx : m.count x = 1 := by simp [m, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hzx]
  have hmci (i : Fin n) : m.count (v i) = 2 := by simp [m, hzc i, (hnx i).symm]
  have hmcard : m.card = (2 * n - 1) + 2 := by simp [m, z]; omega
  have hmdistinct : ∃ y ∈ m, ∃ t ∈ m, y ≠ t := by
    exact ⟨x, by simp [m], v ⟨0, hn⟩, by simp [m, hzi], hnx _⟩
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ m, y ∈ Icc a b := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyx : y = x
    · simpa [hyx] using hx
    · have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyx] using hy
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
      exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hva i)
  have hrep : ∀ y ∈ m, 1 < m.count y → y ∈ Ioo a b := by
    intro y hy hc
    have hyx : y ≠ x := by intro h; subst y; rw [hmcx] at hc; omega
    have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyx] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
    exact hva i
  have hjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y, iteratedDeriv k g y = 0 := by
    intro y hy k hk
    by_cases hyx : y = x
    · subst y
      rw [hmcx] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simpa [hk0] using hgx
    · have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyx] using hy
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
      rw [hmci i] at hk
      rcases (show k = 0 ∨ k = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
      · simpa using hgnode i
      · simpa using hgderiv i
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_multiset_multiplicities
    m hmcard hmdistinct hmem hrep (hf.sub (Polynomial.continuous _).continuousOn)
    (fun k hk => ((hf' (k + 1) (by omega)).continuousOn.sub
      (Polynomial.continuous _).continuousOn).congr (heq (k + 1) (by omega))) hjet
  rw [show 2 * n - 1 + 1 = 2 * n by omega] at hξ0
  have hHdegree : H.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    simpa [H] using Lagrange.degree_hermiteInterpolate_lt
      (show (univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty from ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, mem_univ _⟩)
      hv.injOn (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  have hπdegree : (π ^ 2).natDegree = 2 * n := by
    simp [π, natDegree_pow, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, mul_comm]
  have hπmonic : (π ^ 2).leadingCoeff = 1 := (Lagrange.nodal_monic.pow 2)
  have hpderiv : (derivative^[2 * n] p).eval ξ = K * (2 * n).factorial := by
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [iterate_map_add, iterate_derivative_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hHdegree, zero_add,
      iterate_derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, ← hπdegree,
      eval_iterate_derivative_natDegree, hπmonic, mul_one]
  have hh := heq (2 * n) le_rfl hξ
  change iteratedDeriv (2 * n) g ξ =
    iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ - (derivative^[2 * n] p).eval ξ at hh
  change iteratedDeriv (2 * n) g ξ = 0 at hξ0
  rw [hξ0, hpderiv] at hh
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  change f x - H.eval x = iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial * π.eval x ^ 2
  rw [show iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ = K * (2 * n).factorial by linarith]
  dsimp [K]
  have hfac : ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.tendsto_sum_gaussWeights_mul_of_continuousOn
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  let η := ε / (2 * μ.real univ + 1)
  have hm : 0 ≤ μ.real univ := measureReal_nonneg
  have hη : 0 < η := div_pos hε (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_complex_polynomial_near_of_continuousOn hf hη
  refine ⟨p.natDegree, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hnμ : (n+1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := by rw [hinf.encard_eq]; simp
  have hdeg : p.degree < (2*(n+1) : ℕ) :=
    p.degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree < 2*(n+1) by omega))
  have he := norm_integral_sub_sum_gaussWeights_le_of_polynomial_approx hμ hs
    (Nat.zero_lt_succ n) hnμ hf hdeg (fun x hx => (hp x hx).le)
  rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
  apply he.trans_lt
  have hd : 0 < 2*μ.real univ+1 := by positivity
  change 2*μ.real univ*(ε/(2*μ.real univ+1)) < ε
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.tendsto_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform
statement:
theorem tendsto_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (hinf : μ.support.Infinite) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n =>
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (n+1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (n+1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z)
      atTop (𝓝 (stieltjesTransform μ z))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  have h := tendsto_sum_gaussWeights_mul_of_continuousOn hμ hs hinf
    ((continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal).continuousOn.inv₀
      (fun x hx => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz x hx)))
  convert! h using 1
  funext n
  rw [eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div hμ hs
    (Nat.zero_lt_succ n) (by rw [hinf.encard_eq]; simp) hz]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Pi.inv_apply, Pi.sub_apply]

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_gauss_eq_curveIntegral_concat_of_positive_orientation
statement:
theorem integral_sub_gauss_eq_curveIntegral_concat_of_positive_orientation
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    {k : ℕ} (p : Fin (k + 1) → Ω)
    (γ : (i : Fin k) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hp : p (Fin.last k) = p 0)
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ i r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ((γ i) r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace (Cubical.pathChain p γ)) ⊆ Ω)
    {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Icc a b)
    (hpos : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - (x₀ : ℂ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    (∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        curveIntegral (fun z => (f z * gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n z) •
          ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val) := by
  have hw := cubicalWindingIntegral_pathChain_eq_one_of_curveIntegral_eq p γ hp hγ hx₀ hoff hpos
  have hI (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) : (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω := by
    apply hfill
    apply mem_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_of_winding_ne_zero (Cubical.pathChain p γ)
      (Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero p γ hp)
      (contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hγ)
    rw [hw x hx]
    exact one_ne_zero
  exact integral_sub_gauss_eq_curveIntegral_concat_of_boundedComplementFill_subset hs hn hΩ hf hI
    p γ hp hγ hoff hfill hw

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_length_mul_maxNorm_of_positive_orientation
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_length_mul_maxNorm_of_positive_orientation
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    {k : ℕ} (p : Fin (k + 1) → Ω)
    (γ : (i : Fin k) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hp : p (Fin.last k) = p 0)
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ i r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ((γ i) r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace (Cubical.pathChain p γ)) ⊆ Ω)
    {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Icc a b)
    (hpos : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - (x₀ : ℂ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    ‖(∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)‖ ≤
        (∑ i : Fin k, ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          ‖derivWithin ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I t‖) / (2 * Real.pi) *
        cubicalMaxNorm (Cubical.pathChain p γ) (gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n) *
          cubicalMaxNorm (Cubical.pathChain p γ) f := by
  have hw := cubicalWindingIntegral_pathChain_eq_one_of_curveIntegral_eq p γ hp hγ hx₀ hoff hpos
  have hI (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) : (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω := by
    apply hfill
    apply mem_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_of_winding_ne_zero (Cubical.pathChain p γ)
      (Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero p γ hp)
      (contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hγ)
    rw [hw x hx]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hchainoff : ∀ q ∈ (Cubical.pathChain p γ).support, ∀ r,
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (q r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Cubical.exists_piece_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hq
    exact hoff i
  rw [← cubicalLength_pathChain_eq_sum p γ]
  exact norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_maxNorm_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
    hs hn hΩ hf hI (Cubical.pathChain p γ) (Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero p γ hp)
    (contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hγ) hchainoff hfill hw

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_endpoint
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_endpoint
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (ht : t = a ∨ t = b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvt : t ∈ Set.range v) (hvi : ∀ i, v i ≠ t → v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)), ∃ u : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective u ∧ (∀ i, u i ∈ Ioo a b) ∧
        (∀ i, v (e i) = endpointNodeFamily t u i) ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i) =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ u).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, hu, heu⟩ := exists_perm_endpointNodeFamily v hv hvt
  have hui (i : Fin q) : u i ∈ Ioo a b := by
    have hne : v (e i.succ) ≠ t := by
      intro h
      have he0 : v (e 0) = t := heu 0
      have hid := e.injective (hv (h.trans he0.symm))
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hid
      simp at hval
    have h := hvi (e i.succ) hne
    simpa only [heu, endpointNodeFamily, Fin.cases_succ] using h
  have hsum (g : ℝ → ℝ) : (∑ i, w i * g (v i)) =
      ∑ i, w (e i) * g (endpointNodeFamily t u i) := by
    calc _ = ∑ i, w (e i) * g (v (e i)) := (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
      _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [heu i]
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    hab hμ ht u (w ∘ e) hu hui (by intro p hp; exact (hexact p hp).trans (hsum p.eval)) hf hf' hD
  exact ⟨e, u, hu, hui, heu, ξ, hξ, by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, ← hsum] using he⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_twoEndpoint
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_twoEndpoint
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvi : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b) (hva : a ∈ Set.range v) (hvb : b ∈ Set.range v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 2)), ∃ u : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective u ∧ (∀ i, u i ∈ Ioo a b) ∧
        (∀ i, v (e i) = twoEndpointNodeFamily a b u i) ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i) =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ u).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, hu, hui, heu⟩ := exists_perm_twoEndpointNodeFamily v hv hab hvi hva hvb
  have hsum (g : ℝ → ℝ) : (∑ i, w i * g (v i)) =
      ∑ i, w (e i) * g (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b u i) := by
    calc _ = ∑ i, w (e i) * g (v (e i)) := (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
      _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [heu i]
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_twoEndpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    hab hμ u (w ∘ e) hu hui (by intro p hp; exact (hexact p hp).trans (hsum p.eval)) hf hf' hD
  exact ⟨e, u, hu, hui, heu, ξ, hξ, by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, ← hsum] using he⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ (j : ℕ) :
    |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))| = 1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (2 * j + 3)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevMoment
  rw [if_pos (by simp : Even (2 * (j + 1))), abs_div,
    abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := Nat.cast_nonneg j
  push_cast
  rw [abs_of_neg (by nlinarith : 1 - (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 < 0)]
  have h0 : (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h1 : (2 * (j : ℝ) + 3) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [show -(1 - (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) = (2 * j + 1) * (2 * j + 3) by ring]
  field_simp [h0, h1]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ
statement:
theorem sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range m, |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))|) = 1 - 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ]
  have h : (∑ j ∈ range m,
      (1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))) =
      1 - 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    simpa using sum_range_sub' (fun j => 1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) m
  convert h using 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  push_cast
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_alias_two_mul_le_four
statement:
theorem sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_alias_two_mul_le_four {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))|) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun j => |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))|
  have hf0 : f 0 = 2 := by simp [f, chebyshevAliasIndex, chebyshevMoment]
  have hsplit : (∑ j ∈ range n, f j) = 2 + ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 n, f j := by
    rw [sum_Ico_eq_sub f hn, show (∑ j ∈ range 1, f j) = 2 by simpa using hf0]
    ring
  have hterm (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Ico 1 n) :
      f j ≤ |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)| + |chebyshevMoment (2 * (n - j))| := by
    have hjn : j < n := (mem_Ico.mp hj).2
    have halias : chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j) = min (2 * j) (2 * (n - j)) := by
      unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega), Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
    dsimp [f]
    rw [halias]
    rcases le_or_gt (2 * j) (2 * (n - j)) with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)
    · rw [min_eq_right h.le]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _)
  have hrefl : (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 n, |chebyshevMoment (2 * (n - j))|) =
      ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 n, |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)| := by
    simpa using sum_Ico_reflect (fun j => |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)|) 1 (m := n) (n := n) (by omega)
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 n, |chebyshevMoment (2 * j)|) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
    have heq : (∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), |chebyshevMoment (2 * (1 + j))|) =
        ∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))| := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [Nat.add_comm 1 j]
    rw [heq, sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ]
    exact sub_le_self _ (by positivity)
  change (∑ j ∈ range n, f j) ≤ 4
  rw [hsplit]
  have hbound := sum_le_sum hterm
  rw [sum_add_distrib, hrefl] at hbound
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_lobattoJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_lobattoJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (hJa : (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1) - a • 1).PosDef)
    (hJc : (c • 1 - orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1)).PosDef)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a c)) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 2)), ∃ v : Fin q → ℝ,
      Function.Injective v ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a c) ∧
        (∀ i, lobattoNodes L q a c (e i) = twoEndpointNodeFamily a c v i) ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a c,
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - L 1 * cfc f (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) 0 0 =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - a) * (x - c) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1)
  let e : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1
  have he : e ≠ 0 := by intro hz; have := congrFun hz (Fin.last q); simp [e] at this
  obtain ⟨ha, hc, hsa, hsc⟩ := finLobattoSchurBorder_bounds_and_endpoints hac hJa hJc he
  change a • 1 ≤ lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c at ha
  change lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c ≤ c • 1 at hc
  change a ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) at hsa
  change c ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) at hsc
  have hH := isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c
  have hnode : ∀ i, lobattoNodes L q a c i ∈ Icc a c := hH.eigenvalues_mem_Icc_of_order ha hc
  have hna : a ∈ Set.range (lobattoNodes L q a c) := by
    simpa only [lobattoNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsa
  have hnc : c ∈ Set.range (lobattoNodes L q a c) := by
    simpa only [lobattoNodes, hH, hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hsc
  have hni := (lobattoNodes_injective_and_weights_pos hμ q hs a c hac hJa hJc).1
  obtain ⟨e', v, hv, hvi, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ := exists_integral_sub_rule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_twoEndpoint
    hac hμac (lobattoNodes L q a c) (lobattoWeights L q a c) hni hnode hna hnc
    (fun p hp => integral_eval_eq_sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval hμ q hs a c hp) hf hf' hD
  have hsum := mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_eq_sum L q a c f
  rw [← hsum] at herr
  exact ⟨e', v, hv, hvi, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (hJa : (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1) - a • 1).PosDef)
    (hJc : (c • 1 - orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1)).PosDef)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f x) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) 1 *
      cfc f (lobattoJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_lobattoJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hμ hac hμac q hs hJa hJc hf hf' hD
  have hw : (∫ x, (x - a) * (x - c) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 0 := by
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
    (div_nonneg (hDpos ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 2).factorial)) hw
  rw [← herr] at hE
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hE

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_eq {q : ℕ}
    {a b t x : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (ht : t ∈ Icc a b) {v : Fin q → ℝ}
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) (htv : ∀ i, t ≠ v i)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      f x - (Lagrange.hermiteEndpointInterpolate t (f t) v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
          ((x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteEndpointInterpolate t (f t) v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)
  let π := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  let ω := (X - C t) * π ^ 2
  have hHt : H.eval t = f t := Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_endpoint _ _ _ _ _ htv
  have hHnode (i : Fin q) : H.eval (v i) = f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hHderiv (i : Fin q) : H.derivative.eval (v i) = deriv f (v i) :=
    Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hπnode (i : Fin q) : π.eval (v i) = 0 := Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i)
  by_cases hωx : ω.eval x = 0
  · have hxroot : x = t ∨ ∃ i, x = v i := by
      have heq : (x - t) * π.eval x ^ 2 = 0 := by simpa [ω] using hωx
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp heq with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
      · have hπ : π.eval x = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h
        rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_eq_zero_iff] at hπ
        obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hπ
        exact Or.inr ⟨i, sub_eq_zero.mp hi⟩
    refine ⟨(a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    change f x - H.eval x = _ * ((x - t) * π.eval x ^ 2)
    rcases hxroot with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rw [hHt]; ring
    · rw [hHnode, hπnode]; ring
  let z : Multiset ℝ := (univ : Finset (Fin q)).val.map v
  let m : Multiset ℝ := z + z + {t}
  have hznd : z.Nodup := Multiset.Nodup.map hv univ.nodup
  have hzi (i : Fin q) : v i ∈ z := Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, by simp, rfl⟩
  have hzt : t ∉ z := by
    intro htmem
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp htmem
    exact htv i hi.symm
  have hzc (i : Fin q) : z.count (v i) = 1 := Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem hznd (hzi i)
  have hmct : m.count t = 1 := by simp [m, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hzt]
  have hmci (i : Fin q) : m.count (v i) = 2 := by simp [m, hzc i, (htv i).symm]
  have hmcard : m.card = 2 * q + 1 := by simp [m, z]; omega
  have hωmon : ω.Monic := (monic_X_sub_C t).mul (Lagrange.nodal_monic.pow 2)
  have hωdeg : ω.natDegree = m.card := by
    dsimp only [ω]
    rw [natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C t).ne_zero (Lagrange.nodal_monic.pow 2).ne_zero]
    simp only [natDegree_X_sub_C, natDegree_pow, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal,
      card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ m, y ∈ Icc a b := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyt : y = t
    · simpa only [hyt] using ht
    · have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyt] using hy
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
      exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hva i)
  have hrep : ∀ y ∈ m, 1 < m.count y → y ∈ Ioo a b := by
    intro y hy hc
    have hyt : y ≠ t := by intro h; subst y; rw [hmct] at hc; omega
    have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyt] using hy
