    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
    exact hva i
  have hωjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y, (derivative^[k] ω).eval y = 0 := by
    intro y hy k hk
    by_cases hyt : y = t
    · subst y
      rw [hmct] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simp [hk0, ω]
    · have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyt] using hy
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
      rw [hmci i] at hk
      rcases (show k = 0 ∨ k = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
      · simp [ω, hπnode i]
      · simp [ω, derivative_mul, derivative_pow, hπnode i]
  have hjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y,
      iteratedDeriv k f y = (derivative^[k] H).eval y := by
    intro y hy k hk
    by_cases hyt : y = t
    · subst y
      rw [hmct] at hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      simpa [hk0] using hHt.symm
    · have hyz : y ∈ z := by simpa [m, hyt] using hy
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hyz
      rw [hmci i] at hk
      rcases (show k = 0 ∨ k = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
      · simpa using (hHnode i).symm
      · simpa using (hHderiv i).symm
  have hHdegree : H.degree < m.card := by
    rw [hmcard]
    exact Lagrange.degree_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_lt _ _ hv _ _
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_sub_eval_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_of_multiset m
    (by rw [hmcard]; omega) hmem hrep hHdegree hωmon hωdeg hωjet hjet hf
    (by simpa only [hmcard] using hf') hx hωx
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [H, hmcard, ω, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow] using he

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_measureT
statement: theorem hasPolynomialMoments_measureT : HasPolynomialMoments measureT
proof:
:=
  fun p => integrable_measureT p.continuous.continuousOn

name: NLAlib.integral_lobattoCardinal_measureT
statement:
theorem integral_lobattoCardinal_measureT {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (j : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, (lobattoCardinal N j).eval x ∂measureT) = π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral measureT hasPolynomialMoments_measureT
  have hL0 : L 1 = π := by
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, T_zero] using integral_eval_T_real_measureT_zero
  have hLT (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) : L (T ℝ k) = 0 :=
    integral_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  change L (lobattoCardinal N j) = _
  simp only [lobattoCardinal, map_smul, map_add, map_sum, smul_eq_mul, hL0,
    hLT N hN.ne', hLT _ (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), mul_zero, sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevLobattoWeight_pos
statement:
theorem chebyshevLobattoWeight_pos {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N
proof:
:= by
  apply div_pos _ (by exact_mod_cast hN)
  apply mul_pos pi_pos
  unfold lobattoEndpointWeight
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_measureT_eq_chebyshevLobattoRule
statement:
theorem integral_eval_measureT_eq_chebyshevLobattoRule {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * N : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂measureT) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), (π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N) * p.eval (node N j)
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral measureT hasPolynomialMoments_measureT
  let Q : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun p => ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1),
        (π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N) * p.eval (node N j)
      map_add' := by intro p q; simp [mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c p
        simp only [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        rw [mul_sum]
        exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring }
  have hcard (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range (N + 1)) :
      L (Lagrange.basis (range (N + 1)) (node N) j) = π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N := by
    rw [← lobattoCardinal_eq_basis hN (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega)]
    exact integral_lobattoCardinal_measureT hN j
  have hLT (k : ℕ) : L (T ℝ k) = if k = 0 then π else 0 := by
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      exact integral_eval_T_real_measureT_zero
    · rw [if_neg hk]
      exact integral_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  have hLQ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < 2 * N) : L (T ℝ k) = Q (T ℝ k) := by
    have hinterp : L (Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
        (fun j => (T ℝ k).eval (node N j))) = Q (T ℝ k) := by
      simp only [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, C_mul', map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      change (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), (T ℝ k).eval (node N j) *
        L (Lagrange.basis (range (N + 1)) (node N) j)) = _
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [hcard j hj]
      ring
    rw [interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_alias hN] at hinterp
    rw [← hinterp, hLT, hLT]
    have hzero : chebyshevAliasIndex N k = 0 ↔ k = 0 := by
      unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk]
      omega
    simp only [hzero]
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  have hp' : p.degree ≤ (2 * N - 1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp0] at hp ⊢
    have hd : p.natDegree < 2 * N := by exact_mod_cast hp
    exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree ≤ 2 * N - 1 by omega)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le hp'
  change L p = Q p
  rw [← hc, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [map_smul, map_smul, hLQ k (by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega)]

name: NLAlib.sum_chebyshevLobattoWeight
statement:
theorem sum_chebyshevLobattoWeight {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N) = π
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_eval_measureT_eq_chebyshevLobattoRule hN (p := 1) (by
    simpa only [degree_one] using (show (0 : WithBot ℕ) < (2 * N : ℕ) by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 * N by omega)))
  have hm : (∫ x, (1 : ℝ[X]).eval x ∂measureT) = π := by
    simpa only [T_zero] using integral_eval_T_real_measureT_zero
  simpa only [eval_one, mul_one] using h.symm.trans hm

name: NLAlib.sum_chebyshevLobattoWeight_mul_eval_T_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem sum_chebyshevLobattoWeight_mul_eval_T_mul_eval_T {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (i k : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ N) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), (π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N) *
      (T ℝ i).eval (node N j) * (T ℝ k).eval (node N j)) =
      if i = k then (if i = 0 ∨ i = N then π else π / 2) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htop : i = N ∧ k = N
  · rw [htop.1, htop.2]
    simp only [ite_true, or_true]
    have hs (j : ℕ) : (T ℝ N).eval (node N j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [node, T_real_cos]
      norm_cast
      rw [show (N : ℝ) * (j * π / N) = j * π by
        have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN.ne'
        field_simp]
      have h := cos_sq_add_sin_sq ((j : ℝ) * π)
      rw [sin_nat_mul_pi, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), add_zero] at h
      exact h
    calc _ = ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N := by
          apply sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_two, hs j, mul_one]
      _ = π := sum_chebyshevLobattoWeight hN
  · have hdegree : (T ℝ i * T ℝ k).degree < (2 * N : ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_mul, degree_T, degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast, Int.natAbs_natCast]
      exact_mod_cast (show i + k < 2 * N by omega)
    have h := integral_eval_measureT_eq_chebyshevLobattoRule hN hdegree
    simp only [eval_mul] at h
    rw [show (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N *
        (T ℝ i).eval (node N j) * (T ℝ k).eval (node N j)) =
        ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), π * lobattoEndpointWeight N j / N *
          ((T ℝ i).eval (node N j) * (T ℝ k).eval (node N j)) from
        sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_assoc _ _ _]
    rw [← h]
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst k
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      by_cases hi0 : i = 0
      · subst i
        rw [if_pos (Or.inl rfl)]
        exact integral_eval_T_real_mul_self_measureT_zero
      · rw [if_neg (by aesop)]
        exact integral_T_real_mul_self_measureT_of_ne_zero hi0
    · rw [if_neg hik]
      exact integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne hik

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (ht : t = a ∨ t = b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (htv : ∀ i, t ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily t v i))
    (hzero : (∫ x, (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (endpointNodeFamily t v i)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (x - t) * P.eval x ^ 2
  have hWi : Integrable W μ := by
    have hp : ((X - C t) * P ^ 2).eval = W := by funext x; simp [W]
    rw [← hp]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ _
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, W x = 0 := by
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · have hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ W x := by
        filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
        exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sq_nonneg _)
      filter_upwards [(integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hw hWi).mp hzero] with x hx
      exact hx
    · have hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ -W x := by
        filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
        exact neg_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2) (sq_nonneg _))
      have hz : (∫ x, -W x ∂μ) = 0 := by rw [integral_neg]; exact neg_eq_zero.mpr hzero
      filter_upwards [(integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hw hWi.neg).mp hz] with x hx
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp hx
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteEndpointInterpolate t (f t) v (f ∘ v) 0
  have hHnode (i : Fin (q + 1)) : H.eval (endpointNodeFamily t v i) = f (endpointNodeFamily t v i) := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_endpoint _ _ _ _ _ htv
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hfH : f =ᵐ[μ] H.eval := by
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx
    · have hxt : x = t := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
      subst x
      exact (Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_endpoint _ _ _ _ _ htv).symm
    · have hp : P.eval x = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hx
      simp only [P, Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_eq_zero_iff] at hp
      obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hp
      have hxi : x = v i := sub_eq_zero.mp hi
      subst x
      exact (hHnode i.succ).symm
  rw [integral_congr_ae hfH, hexact H (Lagrange.degree_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_lt _ _ hv _ _)]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hHnode i]

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eq_twoEndpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hav : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) (hbv : ∀ i, b ≠ v i)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i))
    (hzero : (∫ x, (x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Lagrange.nodal univ v
  let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (x - a) * (x - b) * P.eval x ^ 2
  have hWi : Integrable W μ := by
    have hp : ((X - C a) * (X - C b) * P ^ 2).eval = W := by funext x; simp [W]
    rw [← hp]
    exact integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ _
  have hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ -W x := by
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact neg_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)) (sq_nonneg _))
  have hz : (∫ x, -W x ∂μ) = 0 := by rw [integral_neg]; exact neg_eq_zero.mpr hzero
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, W x = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [(integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hw hWi.neg).mp hz] with x hx
    exact neg_eq_zero.mp hx
  let H := Lagrange.hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b (f a) (f b) v (f ∘ v) 0
  have hHnode (i : Fin (q + 2)) : H.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) = f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i) i
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hav
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hab.ne hav hbv
    · exact Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node _ _ _ _ hv _ _ i
  have hfH : f =ᵐ[μ] H.eval := by
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx
      · have hxa : x = a := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
        subst x
        exact (Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hav).symm
      · have hxb : x = b := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
        subst x
        exact (Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hab.ne hav hbv).symm
    · have hp : P.eval x = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hx
      simp only [P, Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_eq_zero_iff] at hp
      obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hp
      have hxi : x = v i := sub_eq_zero.mp hi
      subst x
      exact (hHnode i.succ.succ).symm
  rw [integral_congr_ae hfH, hexact H (Lagrange.degree_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_lt _ _ _ _ hv _ _)]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hHnode i]

name: NLAlib.integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
statement:
theorem integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hDneg : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x ≤ 0) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) 1 *
      cfc f (leftRadauJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hav, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_leftRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hμ hac hμac q hs hf hf' hD
  have hw : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (x - a) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hDneg ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 1).factorial)) hw
  rw [← herr] at hE
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hE

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
statement:
theorem mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hDneg : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x ≤ 0) :
    (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) 1 * cfc f (rightRadauJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q c) 0 0 ≤
      ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hcv, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_rightRadauJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hμ hac hμac q hs hf hf' hD
  have hw : (∫ x, (x - c) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 0 := by
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
    (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hDneg ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 1).factorial)) hw
  rw [← herr] at hE
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hE

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
statement:
theorem mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ}
    (hac : a < c) (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (hJa : (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1) - a • 1).PosDef)
    (hJc : (c • 1 - orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (q + 1)).PosDef)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hDneg : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f x ≤ 0) :
    (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) 1 * cfc f (lobattoJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c) 0 0 ≤
      ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hv, hvi, hev, ξ, hξ, herr⟩ :=
    exists_integral_sub_lobattoJacobiRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul hμ hac hμac q hs hJa hJc hf hf' hD
  have hw : (∫ x, (x - a) * (x - c) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 0 := by
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
    (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hDneg ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * q + 2).factorial)) hw
  rw [← herr] at hE
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hE

name: NLAlib.even_chebyshevAliasIndex_iff
statement:
theorem even_chebyshevAliasIndex_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) :
    Even (chebyshevAliasIndex n k) ↔ Even k
proof:
:= by
  have hmod : (k % (2 * n)) % 2 = k % 2 := Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd k (by omega)
  have heven : Even (k % (2 * n)) ↔ Even k := by rw [Nat.even_iff, Nat.even_iff, hmod]
  have hlt : k % (2 * n) < 2 * n := Nat.mod_lt k (by omega)
  unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
  rcases le_or_gt (k % (2 * n)) n with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left (by omega)]
    exact heven
  · rw [min_eq_right (by omega), Nat.even_sub hlt.le]
    simpa using heven

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisRule_eval_T
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisRule_eval_T {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) :
    clenshawCurtisRule n (T ℝ k).eval = chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clenshawCurtisRule]
  have h := interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_alias hn k
  change (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.interpolate (range (n + 1)) (node n)
    (fun j => (T ℝ k).eval (node n j))).eval x) = _
  rw [h, integral_eval_T]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two
statement: theorem abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two (k : ℕ) : |chebyshevMoment k| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevMoment
  by_cases hk : Even k
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · subst k
      norm_num
    have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by have h := Nat.one_lt_of_ne_zero_of_even hk0 hk; omega
    have hkR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk2
    have hden : 1 - (k : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), abs_of_nonpos hden]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by nlinarith : 0 < -(1 - (k : ℝ) ^ 2))).mpr
    nlinarith
  · simp [hk]

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two_div_fifteen
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two_div_fifteen {k : ℕ} (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    |chebyshevMoment k| ≤ 2 / 15
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevMoment
  split_ifs
  · have hkR : (4 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hden : 1 - (k : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), abs_of_nonpos hden]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by nlinarith : 0 < -(1 - (k : ℝ) ^ 2))).mpr
    nlinarith
  · norm_num

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_T_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_eq_zero_of_odd
proof:
:= by
  have hke : ¬ Even k := by rw [Nat.even_iff]; obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hk; omega
  rw [integral_eval_T, clenshawCurtisRule_eval_T hn, chebyshevMoment,
    if_neg hke, if_neg (fun h => hke ((even_chebyshevAliasIndex_iff hn k).mp h)), sub_self]

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_eval_T_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le
proof:
:= by
  have hk4 : 4 ≤ k := by
    have he := Nat.even_iff.mp hke
    omega
  rw [clenshawCurtisRule_eval_T (by omega), integral_eval_T]
  change |chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)| ≤ _
  have h := abs_sub (chebyshevMoment k) (chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k))
  have h1 := abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two_div_fifteen hk4
  have h2 := abs_chebyshevMoment_le_two (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_of_hasSum
statement:
theorem hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_of_hasSum {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x)) :
    HasSum (fun k => c k * chebyshevMoment k) (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (μ := volume)
    (F := fun k x => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f := f) (fun k _ => |c k|)
    (fun k => (continuous_const.mul (T ℝ k).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (fun k => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => by
      have hI : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
        have hxI : x ∈ Set.Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] using hx
        exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hxI
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hI))))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hs))
    (intervalIntegrable_const)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hf x (by
      have hxI : x ∈ Set.Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] using hx
      exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hxI)))
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_eval_T, chebyshevMoment] using h

name: NLAlib.hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_of_hasSum
statement:
theorem hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_of_hasSum {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasSum (fun k => c k * chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)) (clenshawCurtisRule n f)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Lagrange.interpolate (range (n + 1)) (node n) (f ∘ node n)
  have hP (x : ℝ) : HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)).eval x) (P.eval x) := by
    have hj : ∀ j ∈ range (n + 1), HasSum (fun k =>
        c k * (T ℝ k).eval (node n j) * (Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (node n) j).eval x)
      (f (node n j) * (Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (node n) j).eval x) := by
      intro j hj
      exact (hf (node n j) node_mem_Icc).mul_right _
    have hsum := hasSum_sum hj
    convert hsum using 1
    · funext k
      rw [← interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_alias hn k]
      simp only [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring
    · simp only [P, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, Function.comp_apply]
  have h := intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (μ := volume)
    (F := fun k x => c k * (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)).eval x) (f := P.eval) (fun k _ => |c k|)
    (fun k => (continuous_const.mul (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (fun k => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => by
      have hI : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
        have hxI : x ∈ Set.Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] using hx
        exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hxI
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hI))))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hs))
    (intervalIntegrable_const)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hP x))
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_eval_T, chebyshevMoment,
    clenshawCurtisRule, P] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_even_tail
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_even_tail {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - clenshawCurtisRule n f| ≤
      (32 / 15 : ℝ) * ∑' k, if n < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0
proof:
:= by
  let u := fun k => c k * (chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k))
  let tail := fun k => if n < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0
  have he : HasSum u ((∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - clenshawCurtisRule n f) := by
    have h := (hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_of_hasSum hs hf).sub
      (hasSum_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_of_hasSum hs hf (by omega : 0 < n))
    convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
    funext k
    dsimp [u]
    ring
  have ht : Summable tail := hs.of_nonneg_of_le (by intro k; dsimp [tail]; split_ifs <;> positivity)
    (by intro k; dsimp [tail]; split_ifs <;> simp)
  have hb (k : ℕ) : ‖u k‖ ≤ (32 / 15 : ℝ) * tail k := by
    by_cases hkn : n < k
    · by_cases hk : Even k
      · dsimp [u, tail]
        rw [if_pos ⟨hkn, hk⟩, abs_mul]
        have h := abs_integral_eval_T_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le hn hkn hk
        rw [clenshawCurtisRule_eval_T (by omega), integral_eval_T] at h
        change |chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)| ≤ 32 / 15 at h
        calc |c k| * |chebyshevMoment k - chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)| ≤
            |c k| * (32 / 15) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
      · have hka : ¬ Even (chebyshevAliasIndex n k) :=
          fun h => hk ((even_chebyshevAliasIndex_iff (by omega) k).mp h)
        simp [u, tail, chebyshevMoment, hk, hka]
    · have halias : chebyshevAliasIndex n k = k := by
        unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega), min_eq_left (by omega)]
      simp [u, tail, hkn, halias]
  have hnorm : Summable (fun k => ‖u k‖) := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _) hb
    (ht.mul_left (32 / 15 : ℝ))
  have hnormle := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
  rw [he.tsum_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnormle
  refine hnormle.trans ?_
  calc (∑' k, ‖u k‖) ≤ ∑' k, (32 / 15 : ℝ) * tail k :=
      Summable.tsum_le_tsum hb hnorm (ht.mul_left (32 / 15 : ℝ))
    _ = _ := by rw [tsum_mul_left]

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_geometric
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_geometric {c : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasSum (fun k => c k * (T ℝ k).eval x) (f x))
    {q M : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hc : ∀ k, 0 < k → |c k| ≤ 2 * M * q ^ k) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x) - clenshawCurtisRule n f| ≤
      (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M * q ^ (n + 1) / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_geometric hs hq0 hq1 hM hc n
  refine (abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_even_tail hs hf hn).trans ?_
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 32 / 15)
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_re_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_integral_re_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (F x).re) - clenshawCurtisRule n (fun x => (F x).re)| ≤
      (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (n - 1) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans
    (abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM)
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < ρ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hρ0
  have hq1 : ρ⁻¹ < 1 := (inv_lt_one₀ hρ0).mpr hρ
  have hc (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| ≤ 2 * M * (ρ⁻¹) ^ k := by
    have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hk
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using h
  have hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k|) := by
    apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => abs_nonneg _) ?_
      ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0.le hq1).mul_left (2 * M))
    intro k
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM
      simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using h.trans (by linarith : M ≤ 2 * M)
    · exact hc k hk
  have h := abs_integral_sub_clenshawCurtisRule_le_geometric hs
    (fun x hx => hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hx)
    hq0 hq1 hM0 hc hn
  have hpow : n + 1 = (n - 1) + 2 := by omega
  have heq : (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (n + 1) / (1 - (ρ⁻¹) ^ 2) =
      (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (n - 1) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1)) := by
    rw [hpow, pow_add]
    simp only [inv_pow]
    have hsq : ρ ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hρ0, hsq]
  exact h.trans_eq heq

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_maxNorm
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_maxNorm
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    ‖(∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)‖ ≤ cubicalLength Γ / (2 * Real.pi) *
        cubicalMaxNorm Γ (gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n) * cubicalMaxNorm Γ f := by
  have htraceOff (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ cubicalTrace Γ) : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ) := by
    obtain ⟨γ, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    obtain ⟨hγ, r, rfl⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact hoff γ hγ r
  have hK := continuousOn_gaussRemainderKernel_of_compact_off_Icc
    (hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs) hs hn (isCompact_cubicalTrace Γ) htraceOff
  have hF := hf.continuousOn.mono (cubicalTrace_subset Γ)
  exact norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_bounds hs hn hΩ hf hI Γ hΓ hoff hnull hw
    (cubicalMaxNorm_nonneg Γ hF)
    (fun γ hγ r => norm_le_cubicalMaxNorm Γ hK (mem_cubicalTrace hγ r))
    (fun γ hγ r => norm_le_cubicalMaxNorm Γ hF (mem_cubicalTrace hγ r))

name: NLAlib.cfc_apply_zero_zero_eq_sum
statement:
theorem cfc_apply_zero_zero_eq_sum {N : ℕ} (hn : 0 < N)
    {J : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hJ : J.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f J ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩ =
      ∑ i, (hJ.eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hn⟩) ^ 2 * f (hJ.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hJ f (Pi.single ⟨0, hn⟩ 1)
  simpa only [dotProduct_single, single_dotProduct, one_mul, Matrix.mulVec_single,
    dotProduct_smul, op_smul_eq_mul, Matrix.col_apply, one_mul, mul_one, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_mass_mul_cfc_of_rooted_moments
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_mass_mul_cfc_of_rooted_moments {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {N : ℕ} (hn : 0 < N)
    {J : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hJ : J.IsHermitian) (d : ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ k < d, (∫ x : ℝ, x ^ k ∂μ) =
      (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * (J ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < d) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * cfc p.eval J ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let Q : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun p => (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) * (aeval J p) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
      map_add' := by intro p q; simp [mul_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c p
        simp only [map_smul, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        ring }
  have heq := (Polynomial.linearMap_eq_of_degree_lt_iff_pow L Q d).mpr (by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [L, Q, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, eval_X, LinearMap.coe_mk,
      AddHom.coe_mk, map_pow, aeval_X] using hm k hk)
  have h := heq p hp
  simpa only [L, Q, polynomialIntegral_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    cfc_polynomial p J hJ.isSelfAdjoint] using h

name: NLAlib.rootedMatrixRule_nodes_injective_and_weights_pos
statement:
theorem rootedMatrixRule_nodes_injective_and_weights_pos {N : ℕ} (hn : 0 < N)
    {J : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hJ : J.IsHermitian) (htri : IsTridiagonal J)
    (hsub : ∀ i j : Fin N, i.val + 1 = j.val → J i j ≠ 0)
    {mass : ℝ} (hmass : 0 < mass) :
    Function.Injective hJ.eigenvalues ∧
      ∀ i, 0 < mass * (hJ.eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hn⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hJ.eigenvalues_injective_of_unreduced htri.2 hsub,
    fun i => mul_pos hmass (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (hJ.eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero_ne_zero htri.2 hsub hn i))⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero {N : ℕ} (hn : 0 < N)
    {J : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hJ : J.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, (hJ.eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hn⟩) ^ 2) = 1
proof:

name: NLAlib.integral_one_pos_of_one_le_support_encard
proof:
