name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisRule_eq_sum_weights
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisRule_eq_sum_weights (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    clenshawCurtisRule n f = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), clenshawCurtisWeight n j * f (node n j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clenshawCurtisRule, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul,
    eval_C, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum]
  · apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, clenshawCurtisWeight, mul_comm]
  · intro j _
    exact (continuous_const.mul (Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (node n) j).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisWeight_eq_cosine_sum
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisWeight_eq_cosine_sum {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    clenshawCurtisWeight n j = (lobattoEndpointWeight n j / n) *
      (2 + ∑ k ∈ range (n - 1),
        (2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n))) * chebyshevMoment (k + 1) +
        cos ((n : ℝ) * (j * π / n)) * chebyshevMoment n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clenshawCurtisWeight, ← lobattoCardinal_eq_basis hn hj]
  simp only [lobattoCardinal, eval_smul, eval_add, eval_one, eval_finsetSum, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add (by
      exact (show Continuous (fun x : ℝ => 1 + ∑ k ∈ range (n - 1),
        (2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n))) * (T ℝ (k + 1 : ℕ)).eval x) by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (by exact (continuous_const.mul (T ℝ n).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _),
    intervalIntegral.integral_add (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _) (by
      exact (show Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∑ k ∈ range (n - 1),
        (2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n))) * (T ℝ (k + 1 : ℕ)).eval x) by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _),
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (f := fun k x =>
      (2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n))) * (T ℝ (k + 1 : ℕ)).eval x) (fun k _ =>
      (continuous_const.mul (T ℝ (k + 1 : ℕ)).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _),
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_eval_T]
  simp only [chebyshevMoment]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.chebyshevMoment_two_mul_add_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevMoment_two_mul_add_one (j : ℕ) :
    chebyshevMoment (2 * j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevMoment
  rw [if_neg (by simp : ¬ Even (2 * j + 1))]

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_succ_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_succ_two_mul (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (2 * m), |chebyshevMoment (k + 1)|) =
      ∑ j ∈ range m, |chebyshevMoment (2 * (j + 1))|
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (m + 1) = (2 * m + 1) + 1 by omega, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ,
      sum_range_succ, ih, chebyshevMoment_two_mul_add_one]
    simp only [abs_zero, add_zero]
    congr 2

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_succ_le
statement:
theorem sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_succ_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range n, |chebyshevMoment (k + 1)|) ≤ 1 - 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ range (2 * n), |chebyshevMoment (k + 1)| :=
      sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (range_mono (by omega)) (fun _ _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_succ_two_mul, sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_two_mul_succ]

name: NLAlib.neg_abs_le_cos_mul
statement: theorem neg_abs_le_cos_mul (t u : ℝ) : -|u| ≤ cos t * u
proof:
:= by
  have h : |cos t * u| ≤ |u| := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_cos_le_one t) (abs_nonneg u)
  linarith [neg_abs_le (cos t * u)]

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisWeight_pos
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisWeight_pos {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    0 < clenshawCurtisWeight n j
proof:
:= by
  rw [clenshawCurtisWeight_eq_cosine_sum hn hj]
  apply mul_pos
  · apply div_pos _ (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    unfold lobattoEndpointWeight
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · have hsum : -2 * (∑ k ∈ range (n - 1), |chebyshevMoment (k + 1)|) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range (n - 1),
          (2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n))) * chebyshevMoment (k + 1) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro k _
      nlinarith [neg_abs_le_cos_mul ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n)) (chebyshevMoment (k + 1))]
    have hend := neg_abs_le_cos_mul ((n : ℝ) * (j * π / n)) (chebyshevMoment n)
    have hfull : (∑ k ∈ range n, |chebyshevMoment (k + 1)|) =
        (∑ k ∈ range (n - 1), |chebyshevMoment (k + 1)|) + |chebyshevMoment n| := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ n by omega), sum_range_succ]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ n by omega)]
    have hbound := sum_abs_chebyshevMoment_succ_le n
    rw [hfull] at hbound
    have hmargin : 0 < 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (chebyshevMoment n)]

name: NLAlib.sum_clenshawCurtisWeight
statement:
theorem sum_clenshawCurtisWeight (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), clenshawCurtisWeight n j) = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clenshawCurtisWeight]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (f := fun j x =>
    (Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (node n) j).eval x) (fun j _ =>
      (Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (node n) j).continuous.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  have hp := Lagrange.sum_basis (chebyshev_node_injOn n)
    (show (range (n + 1)).Nonempty from ⟨0, by simp⟩)
  simp_rw [← eval_finsetSum, hp, eval_one]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisWeight_zero_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem clenshawCurtisWeight_zero_zero : clenshawCurtisWeight 0 0 = 2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [clenshawCurtisWeight, range_one, Lagrange.basis_singleton]

name: NLAlib.clenshawCurtisWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem clenshawCurtisWeight_nonneg (n j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    0 ≤ clenshawCurtisWeight n j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
    subst j
    rw [clenshawCurtisWeight_zero_zero]
    norm_num
  · exact (clenshawCurtisWeight_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hj).le

name: NLAlib.abs_clenshawCurtisLinearMap_le
statement:
theorem abs_clenshawCurtisLinearMap_le (n : ℕ) (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    |clenshawCurtisLinearMap n f| ≤ 2 * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  change |∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), clenshawCurtisWeight n j * f ⟨node n j, node_mem_Icc⟩| ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), |clenshawCurtisWeight n j * f ⟨node n j, node_mem_Icc⟩| :=
      abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), clenshawCurtisWeight n j * ‖f‖ := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      have hw := clenshawCurtisWeight_nonneg n j (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hj))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (f.norm_coe_le_norm ⟨node n j, node_mem_Icc⟩) hw
    _ = 2 * ‖f‖ := by rw [← sum_mul, sum_clenshawCurtisWeight]

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    L 1 * cfc f (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) 0 0 =
      ∑ i, leftRadauWeights L q a i * f (leftRadauNodes L q a i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cfc_apply_zero_zero_eq_sum (Nat.succ_pos q) (isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) f
  calc _ = L 1 * ∑ i, ((isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a).eigenvectorBasis i 0) ^ 2 *
      f ((isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a).eigenvalues i) := congrArg (fun x => L 1 * x) h
       _ = _ := ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by dsimp [leftRadauWeights, leftRadauNodes]; ring

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    L 1 * cfc f (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) 0 0 =
      ∑ i, rightRadauWeights L q c i * f (rightRadauNodes L q c i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cfc_apply_zero_zero_eq_sum (Nat.succ_pos q) (isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) f
  calc _ = L 1 * ∑ i, ((isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c).eigenvectorBasis i 0) ^ 2 *
      f ((isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c).eigenvalues i) := congrArg (fun x => L 1 * x) h
       _ = _ := ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by dsimp [rightRadauWeights, rightRadauNodes]; ring

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_eq_sum (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (a c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    L 1 * cfc f (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) 0 0 =
      ∑ i, lobattoWeights L q a c i * f (lobattoNodes L q a c i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cfc_apply_zero_zero_eq_sum (by omega : 0 < q + 2) (isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) f
  calc _ = L 1 * ∑ i, ((isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c).eigenvectorBasis i 0) ^ 2 *
      f ((isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c).eigenvalues i) := congrArg (fun x => L 1 * x) h
       _ = _ := ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by dsimp [lobattoWeights, lobattoNodes]; ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_sum_leftRadauWeights_mul_eval
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_sum_leftRadauWeights_mul_eval {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a : ℝ) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, leftRadauWeights (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a i *
      p.eval (leftRadauNodes (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (integral_eval_eq_mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix hμ q hs a hp).trans
    (by simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_one] using
      mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a p.eval)

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_sum_rightRadauWeights_mul_eval
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_sum_rightRadauWeights_mul_eval {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (c : ℝ) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, rightRadauWeights (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q c i *
      p.eval (rightRadauNodes (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q c i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (integral_eval_eq_mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix hμ q hs c hp).trans
    (by simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_one] using
      mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_eq_sum (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q c p.eval)

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_eq_sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval
statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_sum_lobattoWeights_mul_eval {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (a c : ℝ) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, lobattoWeights (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c i *
      p.eval (lobattoNodes (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (integral_eval_eq_mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix hμ q hs a c hp).trans
    (by simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_one] using
      mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_eq_sum (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) q a c p.eval)

name: NLAlib.sum_endpointJacobiWeights
statement:
theorem sum_endpointJacobiWeights (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (q : ℕ) (a c : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, leftRadauWeights L q a i) = L 1 ∧
      (∑ i, rightRadauWeights L q c i) = L 1 ∧ (∑ i, lobattoWeights L q a c i) = L 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [leftRadauWeights, ← mul_sum]
    have h : (∑ i, ((isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a).eigenvectorBasis i 0) ^ 2) = 1 :=
      sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero (Nat.succ_pos q) (isHermitian_leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a)
    rw [h, mul_one]
  constructor
  · simp only [rightRadauWeights, ← mul_sum]
    have h : (∑ i, ((isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c).eigenvectorBasis i 0) ^ 2) = 1 :=
      sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero (Nat.succ_pos q) (isHermitian_rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c)
    rw [h, mul_one]
  · simp only [lobattoWeights, ← mul_sum]
    have h : (∑ i, ((isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c).eigenvectorBasis i 0) ^ 2) = 1 :=
      sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero (by omega : 0 < q + 2) (isHermitian_lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c)
    rw [h, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.HasPolynomialMoments.integrable_complex_eval
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.as_sum_range' (p.natDegree + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
  simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_monomial]
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  have hm : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ) ^ i) μ := by
    have h : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) μ :=
      ((hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_pow μ).mp hμ i).ofReal
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_pow] using h
  exact hm.const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_of_real_exact
statement:
theorem integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_of_real_exact {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v w : ι → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < m → (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {p : ℂ[X]} (hp : p.degree < m) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ) = ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * p.eval (v i : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin m → ℂ := fun j => p.coeff j.val
  have heq : p = ∑ j : Fin m, monomial j.val (c j) := eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp
  have hint (j : Fin m) : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ) ^ j.val) μ := by
    have h : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ j.val : ℝ) : ℂ)) μ :=
      ((hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_pow μ).mp hμ j.val).ofReal
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_pow] using h
  have hmom (j : Fin m) : (∫ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ^ j.val ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * (v i : ℂ) ^ j.val := by
    have h := hexact (X ^ j.val) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast j.isLt)
    simp only [eval_pow, eval_X] at h
    have h' := congrArg Complex.ofReal h
    rw [← integral_complex_ofReal] at h'
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_pow] using h'
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ) = ∑ j : Fin m, c j * (∫ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ^ j.val ∂μ) := by
      rw [heq]
      simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_monomial]
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (hint j).const_mul (c j))]
      simp only [integral_const_mul]
    _ = ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * p.eval (v i : ℂ) := by
      simp only [hmom, mul_sum]
      rw [sum_comm]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [heq]
      simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_monomial, mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring

name: NLAlib.integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval
statement:
theorem integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {p : ℂ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) * p.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)
proof:
:=
  integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_of_real_exact hμ _ _ (2 * n)
    (fun _ hd => integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn hd) hp

name: NLAlib.support_dividedPolynomialMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem support_dividedPolynomialMeasure_eq {μ : Measure ℝ} {ω : ℝ[X]}
    (hω : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x) : (dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω).support = μ.support
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous μ _).support_mono
  · apply (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous' (by fun_prop) ?_).support_mono
    filter_upwards [hω] with x hx
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (inv_pos.mpr hx)).ne'

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs (fun x hx => (hω x hx).ne')
  intro p
  apply (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' (by fun_prop)
    (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)).mpr
  apply (hdiv p).congr
  filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (inv_nonneg.mpr (hω x hx).le), smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.rational_gauss_rule_of_positive_denominator
proof:
:= dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hω
    (∀ i : Fin n, gaussNodes ν hν n i ∈ Icc a b ∧
      0 < gaussWeights ν hν n i * ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2*n : ℕ) → (∫ x, p.eval x/ω.eval x ∂μ) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights ν hν n i * ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)) *
        (p.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)/ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i))) := by
  dsimp only
  let ν := dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hω
  have hωae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x := by filter_upwards [hs] with x hx; exact hω x hx
  have hsν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Icc a b := (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous μ _).ae_le hs
  have hnν : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ν.support.encard := by rw [support_dividedPolynomialMeasure_eq hωae]; exact hn
  have hnodes (i : Fin n) : gaussNodes ν hν n i ∈ Icc a b := gaussNodes_mem_Icc hν hsν hnν i
  refine ⟨fun i => ⟨hnodes i, mul_pos (gaussWeights_pos hν hnν i) (hω _ (hnodes i))⟩, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  rw [← integral_dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω hωae, integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hν hn0 hnν hp]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change gaussWeights ν hν n i * p.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i) =
    (gaussWeights ν hν n i * ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)) *
      (p.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)/ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i))
  field_simp [(hω _ (hnodes i)).ne']

name: NLAlib.rational_rule_eq_divided_measure_gauss_of_exactness
statement:
theorem rational_rule_eq_divided_measure_gauss_of_exactness
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {ω : ℝ[X]}
    (hω : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < ω.eval x) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (v w : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2*n : ℕ) → (∫ x, p.eval x/ω.eval x ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, w i * (p.eval (v i)/ω.eval (v i))) :
    let ν
proof:
:= dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hω
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (∀ i, v (e i) = gaussNodes ν hν n i) ∧
      (∀ i, w (e i)/ω.eval (v (e i)) = gaussWeights ν hν n i) := by
  dsimp only
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hω
  have hωae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x := by filter_upwards [hs] with x hx; exact hω x hx
  apply rule_eq_gaussNodes_gaussWeights_of_moments hν hn0
    (by rw [support_dividedPolynomialMeasure_eq hωae]; exact hn) v (fun i => w i/ω.eval (v i)) hv
  intro k hk
  rw [integral_dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω hωae]
  have h := hexact (X^k) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast hk)
  simp only [eval_pow, eval_X] at h
  rw [h]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.radauJacobiMatrices_bounds_and_endpoints
statement:
theorem radauJacobiMatrices_bounds_and_endpoints {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c)
    (q : ℕ) (hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    a • 1 ≤ leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a ∧
      leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a ≤ orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) ∧
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) ≤ rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c ∧
      rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c ≤ c • 1 ∧
      a ∈ spectrum ℝ (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) ∧
      c ∈ spectrum ℝ (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L q
  let v := momentJacobiLastCoupling L q
  let d := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) (Fin.last q) (Fin.last q)
  obtain ⟨hJa, hJc⟩ := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posDef hμ hμac q hs
  obtain ⟨hMa, hMc⟩ := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posSemidef hμ hμac (q + 1) hs
  have ha := reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv.symm ((Matrix.le_iff).mpr hMa)
  have hc := reindex_le_reindex finSumFinEquiv.symm ((Matrix.le_iff).mpr hMc)
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_finSymmetricBorder] at ha hc
  simp only [finSymmetricBorder, ← Matrix.reindex_symm,
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at ha hc
  rw [Matrix.reindex_symm, reindex_smul_one] at ha hc
  have h := finRadauSchurBorders_bounds_and_endpoints J v d a c hJa hJc
    ((Matrix.le_iff).mp ha) ((Matrix.le_iff).mp hc)
  simpa only [leftRadauJacobiMatrix, rightRadauJacobiMatrix, J, v, d,
    ← orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_finSymmetricBorder] using h

name: NLAlib.lobattoJacobiMatrix_bounds_and_endpoints
statement:
theorem lobattoJacobiMatrix_bounds_and_endpoints {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    a • 1 ≤ lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c ∧ lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c ≤ c • 1 ∧
      a ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) ∧
      c ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posDef hμ hμac (q + 1) (by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] using hs)
  exact finLobattoSchurBorder_bounds_and_endpoints hac ha hc (by
    intro h
    have hz := congrFun h (Fin.last q)
    simp at hz)

name: NLAlib.gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
statement:
theorem gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ} (hcard : Fintype.card ι = n + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hvI : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < Fintype.card ι →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * p.eval x = 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 < ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) ∧
    (∑ i, ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) = 2 ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) =
        ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) * p.eval (v i)) ∧
    (∃ σ : ι ≃ ι, (∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) ∧
      ∀ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v (σ i)).eval x) =
        ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let μ := volume.restrict (Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
  have hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (μ := volume) measurableSet_Ioc] with x hx
    exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self hx
  have hvS : InjOn v (univ : Finset ι) := fun i hi j hj h => hv h
  have hsupp : ∀ i ∈ (univ : Finset ι), v i ∈ μ.support := by
    intro i hi
    apply Measure.interior_inter_support
    exact ⟨by rw [interior_Ioc]; exact hvI i, by rw [Measure.support_eq_univ]; trivial⟩
  have hInt (f : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, f x := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  have hcardpos : 0 < Fintype.card ι := by omega
  have hnon : (univ : Finset ι).Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by simpa only [card_univ] using hcardpos)
  have hrule := gauss_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal hμ univ hnon v hvS
    (fun p hp => by rw [hInt]; exact horth p (by simpa only [card_univ] using hp))
    ⟨v, hvS, hsupp⟩
  have hexact (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ)) :
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) =
        ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) * p.eval (v i) := by
    have hdegree : p.degree < (2 * (univ : Finset ι).card : ℕ) := by
      refine hp.trans_lt ?_
      rw [card_univ, hcard]
      exact_mod_cast (show 2 * n + 1 < 2 * (n + 1) by omega)
    simpa only [hInt] using hrule.2.2 p hdegree
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hexact, exists_reflection_equiv_of_orthogonal_nodal v hv hvI horth⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [hInt] using hrule.1 i (mem_univ _)
  · have h := hexact 1 (by rw [degree_one]; exact_mod_cast (show 0 ≤ 2 * n + 1 by omega))
    simpa only [eval_one, mul_one, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_neg_eq_add,
      smul_eq_mul, one_add_one_eq_two, mul_one] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_re_sub_gauss_lebesgue_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_integral_re_sub_gauss_lebesgue_le_of_open_ellipse
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = n + 1) (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvI : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < Fintype.card ι →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * p.eval x = 0)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (F x).re) -
      ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) * (F (v i)).re| ≤
        (64 / 15 : ℝ) * M / (ρ ^ (2 * n) * (ρ ^ 2 - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hmass, hexact, σ, hvσ, hwσ⟩ :=
    gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal hcard v hv hvI horth
  exact abs_integral_re_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_of_open_ellipse v
    (fun i => ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x)
    (fun i => Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hvI i)) (fun i => (hpos i).le)
    hmass σ hvσ hwσ hn hexact hρ hFd hM

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_gauss_lebesgue_le_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_gauss_lebesgue_le_of_bv
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n ν : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hnν : ν < 2 * n + 1) (hcard : Fintype.card ι = n + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hvI : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < Fintype.card ι →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * p.eval x = 0)
    {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, F 0 x) -
      ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) * F 0 (v i)| ≤
        32 * V / (15 * Real.pi * ν * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hmass, hexact, σ, hvσ, hwσ⟩ :=
    gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal hcard v hv hvI horth
  exact abs_integral_sub_symmetric_quadrature_le_of_bv v
    (fun i => ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x)
    (fun i => Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hvI i)) (fun i => (hpos i).le)
    hmass σ hvσ hwσ hn hν hnν hexact hAC hderiv hBV hV

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
statement:
theorem integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace Γ) ⊆ Ω)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    (∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z * gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n z) Γ := by
  exact integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_gaussRemainderKernel hs hn hΩ hf hI Γ hΓ
    hoff (isNullHomologous_of_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_subset hΩ Γ hc hΓ hfill) hw

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_maxNorm_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_maxNorm_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace Γ) ⊆ Ω)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    ‖(∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)‖ ≤ cubicalLength Γ / (2 * Real.pi) *
        cubicalMaxNorm Γ (gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n) * cubicalMaxNorm Γ f := by
  exact norm_integral_sub_gauss_le_cubicalLength_mul_maxNorm hs hn hΩ hf hI Γ hΓ hoff
    (isNullHomologous_of_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_subset hΩ Γ hc hΓ hfill) hw

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_gauss_eq_curveIntegral_concat_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
statement:
theorem integral_sub_gauss_eq_curveIntegral_concat_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω) {k : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (k + 1) → Ω) (γ : (i : Fin k) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hp : p (Fin.last k) = p 0)
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ i r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ((γ i) r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace (Cubical.pathChain p γ)) ⊆ Ω)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral (Cubical.pathChain p γ) (x : ℂ) = 1) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    (∫ x : ℝ, f (x : ℂ) ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
        f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        curveIntegral (fun z => (f z * gaussRemainderKernel μ hμ n z) •
          ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val) := by
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
  have hchainoff : ∀ q ∈ (Cubical.pathChain p γ).support, ∀ r,
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (q r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Cubical.exists_piece_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hq
    exact hoff i
  have he := integral_sub_gauss_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral_of_boundedComplementFill_subset hs hn hΩ hf hI
    (Cubical.pathChain p γ) (Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero p γ hp)
    (contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hγ) hchainoff hfill hw
  dsimp only at he ⊢
  rw [cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_curveIntegral_concat] at he
  · exact he
  · intro i
    have hK := continuousOn_gaussRemainderKernel_of_compact_off_Icc hμ hs hn
      (isCompact_range ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).continuous) (by
        rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩
        exact hoff i r)
    have hF := hf.continuousOn.mono (show range ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val) ⊆ Ω from by
      rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩
      exact ((γ i) r).property)
    exact ((hF.mul hK).smul continuousOn_const).curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hγ i)
      (fun r => mem_range_self r)

name: NLAlib.mem_interiorNodeSimplex_of_gap_ge
statement:
theorem mem_interiorNodeSimplex_of_gap_ge {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (ht : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ε ≤
      canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) :
    t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
  intro i
  exact sub_pos.mp (hε.trans_le (ht i))

name: NLAlib.isCompact_setOf_canonical_gap_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed {t : Fin n → ℝ | ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ε ≤
      canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc} := by
    have heq : {t : Fin n → ℝ | ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ε ≤
        canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc} =
        ⋂ i : Fin (n + 1), {t | ε ≤
          canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc} := by
      ext t
      simp
    rw [heq]
    exact isClosed_iInter (fun i => isClosed_le continuous_const
      ((continuous_canonicalIntervalNodes n i.succ).sub
        (continuous_canonicalIntervalNodes n i.castSucc)))
  have hbox : IsCompact (Icc (fun _ : Fin n => (-1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) := isCompact_Icc
  apply hbox.of_isClosed_subset hclosed
  intro t ht
  have htu := mem_interiorNodeSimplex_of_gap_ge hε ht
  constructor
  · intro j
    have hj := (canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc htu j.castSucc.succ).1
    simpa only [canonicalIntervalNodes_interior] using hj
  · intro j
    have hj := (canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc htu j.castSucc.succ).2
    simpa only [canonicalIntervalNodes_interior] using hj

name: NLAlib.isCompact_setOf_norm_interpolationPeakDifference_le
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / (2 ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) * (2 * R + 1))
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  let S : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {t | ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ε ≤
    canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc}
  have hS := isCompact_setOf_canonical_gap_ge n hε
  have : CompactSpace S := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hS
  have hSU : S ⊆ interiorNodeSimplex n := fun _ ht => mem_interiorNodeSimplex_of_gap_ge hε ht
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : S => ‖interpolationPeakDifference n t‖) :=
    continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp (hc.norm.mono hSU)
  have hsubclosed : IsClosed {t : S | ‖interpolationPeakDifference n t‖ ≤ R} :=
    isClosed_le hcont continuous_const
  have himage := hsubclosed.isCompact.image (continuous_subtype_val : Continuous (fun t : S => (t : Fin n → ℝ)))
  convert himage using 1
  ext t
  constructor
  · intro ht
    have htS : t ∈ S := fun i => canonicalIntervalNodes_gap_ge_of_norm_difference_le ht.1 hR ht.2 i
    exact ⟨⟨t, htS⟩, ht.2, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hSU u.property, hu⟩

name: NLAlib.isProperMap_interpolationPeakDifference
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : interiorNodeSimplex n => interpolationPeakDifference n t) :=
    continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hc
  apply isProperMap_iff_isCompact_preimage.mpr
  refine ⟨hcont, ?_⟩
  intro K hK
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hKR⟩ := hK.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  have hsub : IsCompact {t : interiorNodeSimplex n | ‖interpolationPeakDifference n t‖ ≤ R} := by
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.isCompact_iff.mpr
    convert isCompact_setOf_norm_interpolationPeakDifference_le hc hR.le using 1
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨u.property, hu⟩
    · rintro ⟨ht, hnorm⟩
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hnorm, rfl⟩
  exact hsub.of_isClosed_subset (hK.isClosed.preimage hcont)
    (fun t ht => hKR _ ht)

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_affine
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_affine {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (v : ι → ℝ) (x α β : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    lebesgueFunction (fun j => α * v j + β) (α * x + β) = lebesgueFunction v x
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [eval_lagrange_basis_affine univ v j x α β hα]

name: NLAlib.lebesgueConstant_subset_le
statement:
theorem lebesgueConstant_subset_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {s t : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] [CompactSpace t] (v : ι → ℝ) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    lebesgueConstant s v ≤ lebesgueConstant t v
proof:
:=
  lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall v (norm_nonneg _)
    (fun _ hx => lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant v (hst hx))

name: NLAlib.lebesgueConstant_affine_interval
statement:
theorem lebesgueConstant_affine_interval {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (v : ι → ℝ) (a b α β : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    lebesgueConstant (Icc (α * a + β) (α * b + β)) (fun j => α * v j + β) =
      lebesgueConstant (Icc a b) v
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall _ (norm_nonneg _)
    intro y hy
    have hx : (y - β) / α ∈ Icc a b := by
      constructor
      · apply (le_div_iff₀ hα).mpr
        linarith [hy.1]
      · apply (div_le_iff₀ hα).mpr
        linarith [hy.2]
    have heq : α * ((y - β) / α) + β = y := by field_simp; ring
    rw [← heq, lebesgueFunction_affine _ _ _ _ hα.ne']
    exact lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ hx
  · apply lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall _ (norm_nonneg _)
    intro x hx
    have hy : α * x + β ∈ Icc (α * a + β) (α * b + β) := by
      constructor
      · linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 hα.le]
      · linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hα.le]
    rw [← lebesgueFunction_affine v x α β hα.ne']
    exact lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ hy

name: NLAlib.exists_canonical_nodes_affine
statement:
theorem exists_canonical_nodes_affine {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ)
    (hv : StrictMono v) :
    ∃ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n, ∃ α > 0, ∃ β : ℝ,
      ∀ j, α * canonicalIntervalNodes n t j + β = v j
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := v 0
  let b : ℝ := v (Fin.last (n + 1))
  have hab : a < b := hv (by simp [Fin.lt_def])
  let α : ℝ := (b - a) / 2
  let β : ℝ := (a + b) / 2
  have hα : 0 < α := by dsimp [α]; linarith
  let u : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ := fun j => (v j - β) / α
  have hrep (j : Fin (n + 2)) : α * u j + β = v j := by
    dsimp [u]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hu0 : u 0 = -1 := by
    apply (div_eq_iff hα.ne').mpr
    change v 0 - β = -1 * α
    dsimp [α, β, a, b]
    ring
  have hulast : u (Fin.last (n + 1)) = 1 := by
    apply (div_eq_iff hα.ne').mpr
    change v (Fin.last (n + 1)) - β = 1 * α
    dsimp [α, β, a, b]
    ring
  have humono : StrictMono u := fun i j hij =>
    div_lt_div_of_pos_right (sub_lt_sub_right (hv hij) β) hα
  let t : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => u j.castSucc.succ
  have hcan : canonicalIntervalNodes n t = u := by
    funext j
    refine Fin.cases (by simp [hu0]) (fun i => ?_) j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · rw [show (Fin.last n).succ = Fin.last (n + 1) by rfl]
      rw [canonicalIntervalNodes_last, hulast]
    · exact canonicalIntervalNodes_interior n t k
  refine ⟨t, ?_, α, hα, β, ?_⟩
  · change StrictMono (canonicalIntervalNodes n t)
    rw [hcan]
    exact humono
  · intro j
    rw [hcan]
    exact hrep j

name: NLAlib.exists_canonical_nodes_le_lebesgueConstant
statement:
theorem exists_canonical_nodes_le_lebesgueConstant {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ)
    (hv : StrictMono v) (hvI : ∀ j, v j ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n,
      lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) ≤
        lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, α, hα, β, hrep⟩ := exists_canonical_nodes_affine v hv
  have hleft : α * -1 + β = v 0 := by simpa using hrep 0
  have hright : α * 1 + β = v (Fin.last (n + 1)) := by
    simpa using hrep (Fin.last (n + 1))
  have hnodes : (fun j => α * canonicalIntervalNodes n t j + β) = v := funext hrep
  have hnorm := lebesgueConstant_affine_interval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) (-1) 1 α β hα
  rw [hleft, hright, hnodes] at hnorm
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  rw [← hnorm]
  exact lebesgueConstant_subset_le v (Icc_subset_Icc (hvI 0).1 (hvI (Fin.last _)).2)

name: NLAlib.exists_rational_direction
statement:
theorem exists_rational_direction {s : Set ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation s m n r) {H : ℝ[X]}
    (hH : H.degree ≤ rationalAlternationDegree m n r) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ m ∧ Q.degree ≤ n ∧ P * r.denom - r.num * Q = H
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · subst r
    exact ⟨H, 0, by simpa [rationalAlternationDegree] using hH, by simp, by simp⟩
  · apply exists_degree_le_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_isCoprime (RatFunc.num_ne_zero hr0)
      (RatFunc.denom_ne_zero r) (RatFunc.isCoprime_num_denom r) hr.1 hr.2.1
    simpa [rationalAlternationDegree, hr0] using hH

name: NLAlib.exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    (hbest : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f)
    (hE : 0 < ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖) :
    ∃ v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b,
      StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)| =
        ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 1),
        (f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc)) *
          (f (v i.succ) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.succ)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  let g := f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2
  let e : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM g
  let E := ‖g‖
  let N := rationalAlternationDegree m n r
  have heval : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Icc a b), e x = g ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    fun x hx => ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem hx
  let K := Icc a b ∩ (fun x => |e x|) ⁻¹' {E}
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.inter_right
    (isClosed_singleton.preimage (e.continuous.abs))
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hlt : ‖g‖ < E := (ContinuousMap.norm_lt_iff g hE).mpr (by
      intro x
      have hne : |g x| ≠ E := by
        intro hx
        exact hnone ⟨x, x.property, by change |e x| = E; rw [heval _ x.property]; exact hx⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (g.norm_coe_le_norm x) hne)
    exact lt_irrefl E hlt
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hK.exists_isLeast hKne
  have hcab : c ∈ Icc a b := hc.1.1
  have hcE : |e c| = E := hc.1.2
  rcases exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation N e E c b
      e.continuous hE hcab.2 hcE with ⟨H, hH, hHsign, _⟩ | ⟨v, hv, hvext, hvsign⟩
  · obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hnum⟩ := exists_rational_direction r hr hH
    have hsign : ∀ x : Icc a b,
        |f x - r.num.eval (x : ℝ) / r.denom.eval (x : ℝ)| = E →
        0 < (f x - r.num.eval (x : ℝ) / r.denom.eval (x : ℝ)) *
          (P * r.denom - r.num * Q).eval (x : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      have hex : |e x| = E := by rw [heval _ x.property]; exact hx
      have hcx : c ≤ x := hc.2 ⟨x.property, hex⟩
      have hpos := hHsign x ⟨hcx, x.property.2⟩ hex
      rw [hnum]
      simpa [heval _ x.property, g, rationalContinuousMap] using hpos
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hstep⟩ := exists_pos_rational_perturbation_error_lt f r.num r.denom P Q
      (fun x => hr.2.2 x x.property) hE (fun x => g.norm_coe_le_norm x) hsign
    have hPnew : (r.num + t • P).degree ≤ m := mem_degreeLE.mp
      ((degreeLE ℝ m).add_mem (mem_degreeLE.mpr hr.1)
        ((degreeLE ℝ m).smul_mem t (mem_degreeLE.mpr hP)))
    have hQnew : (r.denom + t • Q).degree ≤ n := mem_degreeLE.mp
      ((degreeLE ℝ n).add_mem (mem_degreeLE.mpr hr.2.1)
        ((degreeLE ℝ n).smul_mem t (mem_degreeLE.mpr hQ)))
    have hQ0 : r.denom + t • Q ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have ha := (hstep ⟨a, le_rfl, hab.le⟩).1
      simp [hzero] at ha
    let s := algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) (r.num + t • P) /
      algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) (r.denom + t • Q)
    let hs := isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div _ _ hPnew hQnew hQ0
      (fun x hx => (hstep ⟨x, hx⟩).1)
    have hnorm : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) s hs.2.2‖ < E := by
      apply (ContinuousMap.norm_lt_iff _ hE).mpr
      intro x
      have heq := rationalContinuousMap_div_apply_eq _ _ hPnew hQnew hQ0
        (fun x hx => (hstep ⟨x, hx⟩).1) x
      change |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) s hs.2.2 x| < E
      rw [heq]
      exact (hstep x).2
    have hbound := rationalMinimaxError_le_norm_sub m n f ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    rw [← hbest] at hbound
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbound hnorm).elim
  · let w : Fin (N + 2) → Icc a b := fun i =>
      ⟨v i, hcab.1.trans (hvext i).1.1, (hvext i).1.2⟩
    refine ⟨w, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have hext := (hvext i).2
      rw [heval _ (w i).property] at hext
      exact hext
    · intro i
      have hsig := hvsign i
      rw [heval _ (w i.castSucc).property, heval _ (w i.succ).property] at hsig
      exact hsig

name: NLAlib.exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    (hbest : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f) :
    ∃ (v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
      StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
      ∀ i, f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) =
        σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖
proof:
:= by
  let g := f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2
  by_cases hE : ‖g‖ = 0
  · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_strictMono_mem_Ioo hab (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2)
    let w : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b :=
      fun i => ⟨v i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (v i).property⟩
    refine ⟨w, 1, hv, by norm_num, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hzero := norm_eq_zero.mp hE
    have hval : g (w i) = 0 := congrArg (fun e : C(Icc a b, ℝ) => e (w i)) hzero
    change g (w i) = 1 * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖g‖
    rw [hE, mul_zero]
    exact hval
  · have hEpos := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hE)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, habs, hsign⟩ :=
      exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError hab f r hr hbest hEpos
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hosc⟩ := exists_sign_of_alternating_abs_eq hEpos
      (fun i => f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)) habs hsign
    exact ⟨v, σ, hv, hσ, hosc⟩

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_of_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_of_equioscillation {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    {v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b}
    (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ))) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : |σ| = 1)
    (hosc : ∀ i, f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) =
      σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖) :
    ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (rationalMinimaxError_le_norm_sub m n f ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
  by_cases hE : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = 0
  · rw [hE]; exact rationalMinimaxError_nonneg m n f
  · have hEpos := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hE)
    have habs : ∀ i, |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)| =
        ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ := by
      intro i
      rw [hosc, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, hσ]
      simp [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    apply le_rationalMinimaxError_of_alternation hab f r hr hv ?_ (fun i => (habs i).ge)
    intro i
    have hnext : f (v i.succ) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.succ) =
        -(f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc)) := by
      rw [hosc, hosc]
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hne : f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have := habs i.castSucc
      rw [hzero, abs_zero] at this
      linarith
    rw [hnext]
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hne]

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_iff_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_iff_equioscillation {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r) :
    ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f ↔
      ∃ (v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
        StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
        ∀ i, f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) =
          σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError hab f r hr
  · rintro ⟨v, σ, hv, hσ, hosc⟩
    exact norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_of_equioscillation hab f r hr hv hσ hosc

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_vecMul_interpolationGapJacobian_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pos_vecMul_interpolationGapJacobian_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) :
    ∃ w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      w ᵥ* interpolationGapJacobian n t = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hπsum, hpoly⟩ := exists_pos_sum_smul_gapDirection_eq_zero hn ht
  let ω := fun i => (Lagrange.nodal univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t)).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)
  let a := fun i => π i / |ω i|
  have hω : ∀ i, ω i ≠ 0 := eval_nodal_interpolationGapCriticalPoint_ne_zero hn ht
  have ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i := fun i => div_pos (hπ i) (abs_pos.mpr (hω i))
  have hmul : ∀ i, a i * ω i = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * π i) := by
    intro i
    have hsign := eval_nodal_gap_eq_sign_mul_abs ht i (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht i).1
    change ω i = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * |ω i| at hsign
    dsimp [a]
    nth_rw 2 [hsign]
    have hden : |ω i| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr (hω i)
    field_simp
  have hker : a ᵥ* interpolationGapJacobian n t = 0 := by
    ext j
    have heval := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval (t j)) hpoly
    simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_zero] at heval
    change (∑ i, a i * interpolationGapJacobian n t i j) = 0
    have hterm : ∀ i, a i * interpolationGapJacobian n t i j =
        (Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) *
          (((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * π i) * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (t j)) := by
      intro i
      dsimp [interpolationGapJacobian]
      change a i * (ω i * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ *
        (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (t j)) = _
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hmul]
      ring
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [← mul_sum, heval, mul_zero]
  have hasum : 0 < ∑ i, a i := sum_pos (fun i hi => ha i) univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨fun i => a i / ∑ k, a k, fun i => div_pos (ha i) hasum, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← sum_div]
    exact div_self hasum.ne'
  · ext j
    change (∑ i, (a i / ∑ k, a k) * interpolationGapJacobian n t i j) = 0
    simp only [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← sum_div]
    rw [show (∑ i, a i * interpolationGapJacobian n t i j) = 0 from congrFun hker j, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.det_interpolationGapJacobian_difference_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hsum, hker⟩ := exists_pos_vecMul_interpolationGapJacobian_eq_zero hn ht
  apply det_row_difference_ne_zero (interpolationGapJacobian n t) ?_ w hsum hker
  have hdet := det_interpolationGapJacobian_minor_ne_zero hn ht (0 : Fin (n + 1))
  have heq : (interpolationGapJacobian n t).submatrix (0 : Fin (n + 1)).succAbove id =
      (fun i j : Fin n => interpolationGapJacobian n t i.succ j) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Fin.succAbove_zero, id_eq]
  rw [heq] at hdet
  exact hdet

name: NLAlib.exists_equal_interpolation_peaks_with_convex_combination
statement:
theorem exists_equal_interpolation_peaks_with_convex_combination {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n,
      (∀ i, interpolationGapPeak n t i = interpolationGapPeak n t 0) ∧
      ∀ u ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n, ∃ w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ,
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i = 1) ∧
        interpolationGapPeak n t 0 = ∑ i, w i * interpolationGapPeak n u i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ := fun i t => interpolationGapPeak n t i
  let L : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun i t =>
    ∑ j, interpolationGapJacobian n t i j • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j
  have hM : ∀ i t, t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n → HasFDerivAt (M i) (L i t) t :=
    fun i t ht => hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak_jacobian hn ht i
  have hΓ : ∀ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n,
      ∃ e : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ),
        HasStrictFDerivAt (interpolationPeakDifference n) (e : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) t := by
    intro t ht
    let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
      fun i j => interpolationGapJacobian n t i.succ j - interpolationGapJacobian n t 0 j
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_continuousLinearEquiv_apply_eq_mulVec A
      (det_interpolationGapJacobian_difference_ne_zero hn ht)
    have heL : (e : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) =
        ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => L i.succ t - L 0 t) := by
      ext v i
      change (e v) i = (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => L i.succ t - L 0 t)) v i
      rw [he]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply, sub_apply, L,
        _root_.sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, A, sub_mul, sum_sub_distrib]
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (interpolationPeakDifference n)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => L i.succ t - L 0 t)) t := by
      apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
      intro i
      exact (hM i.succ t ht).sub (hM 0 t ht)
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (interpolationPeakDifference n) t :=
      contDiffAt_pi.mpr (fun i => (contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak hn ht i.succ).sub
        (contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak hn ht 0))
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    rw [heL]
    exact hc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hd one_ne_zero
  let D : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) := fun t =>
    if ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n then (hΓ t ht).choose else ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ _
  have hD : ∀ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n,
      HasStrictFDerivAt (interpolationPeakDifference n) (D t : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) t := by
    intro t ht
    simpa only [D, dif_pos ht] using (hΓ t ht).choose_spec
  have hW : ∀ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n, ∃ w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i = 1) ∧ ∀ v, ∑ i, w i * L i t v = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hs, hk⟩ := exists_pos_vecMul_interpolationGapJacobian_eq_zero hn ht
    refine ⟨w, fun i => (hw i).le, hs, fun v => ?_⟩
    simp only [L, _root_.sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
    simp_rw [mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [sum_comm]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    rw [← sum_mul]
    have he : (∑ i, w i * interpolationGapJacobian n t i j) = 0 := congrFun hk j
    rw [he, zero_mul]
  let W : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun t =>
    if ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n then (hW t ht).choose else fun _ => 0
  have hWspec : ∀ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ W t i) ∧ (∑ i, W t i = 1) ∧ ∀ v, ∑ i, W t i * L i t v = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    simpa only [W, dif_pos ht] using (hW t ht).choose_spec
  have hc : ContinuousOn (interpolationPeakDifference n) (interiorNodeSimplex n) := by
    intro t ht
    exact (hD t ht).hasFDerivAt.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  let : Nonempty (interiorNodeSimplex n) := (nonempty_interiorNodeSimplex n).to_subtype
  let : PreconnectedSpace (interiorNodeSimplex n) :=
    Subtype.preconnectedSpace (convex_interiorNodeSimplex n).isPreconnected
  exact exists_equal_peaks_with_convex_combination (isOpen_interiorNodeSimplex n) hM hD
    (isProperMap_interpolationPeakDifference hc)
    (fun t ht => (hWspec t ht).1) (fun t ht => (hWspec t ht).2.1)
    (fun t ht => (hWspec t ht).2.2)

name: NLAlib.bernsteinDegreeTransferDecay_pos
statement:
theorem bernsteinDegreeTransferDecay_pos {α : ℝ} (hα1 : α < 1) :
    0 < bernsteinDegreeTransferDecay α
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 0 < (1 - α) / 2 := by linarith
  exact mul_pos ht (sub_pos.mpr (Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)))

name: NLAlib.sinh_le_mul_exp
statement: private theorem sinh_le_mul_exp (t : ℝ) : Real.sinh t ≤ t * Real.exp t
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (2 * t)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (Real.exp_pos t).le
  have he : Real.exp (- (2 * t)) * Real.exp t = Real.exp (-t) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he] at hmul
  rw [Real.sinh_eq]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.degree_transfer_exponent_le
statement:
private theorem degree_transfer_exponent_le {α : ℝ} (hα1 : α < 1) :
    α * Real.sinh ((1 - α) / 2) - (1 - α) / 2 ≤ -bernsteinDegreeTransferDecay α
proof:
:= by
  let t := (1 - α) / 2
  have ht : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have hα : α ≤ Real.exp (-(2 * t)) := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (2 * t)
    dsimp [t] at h
    linarith
  have hs := sinh_le_mul_exp t
  have h := mul_le_mul hα hs (Real.sinh_nonneg_iff.mpr ht.le)
    (Real.exp_pos (-(2 * t))).le
  have he : Real.exp (-(2 * t)) * (t * Real.exp t) = t * Real.exp (-t) := by
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he] at h
  change α * Real.sinh t - t ≤ -(t * (1 - Real.exp (-t)))
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.mul_absoluteMinimaxError_le_degreeTransfer
statement:
theorem mul_absoluteMinimaxError_le_degreeTransfer {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α)
    (hα1 : α < 1) {N m : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hthreshold : 2 * max 1 ((α * N * Real.cosh ((1 - α) / 2))^2) ≤
      ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
    (N : ℝ) * absoluteMinimaxError N ≤
      ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m) / α +
        bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder α N
proof:
:= by
  let t := (1 - α) / 2
  let A := α * (N : ℝ)
  let R := A * Real.cosh t
  let n : ℝ := (2 * m : ℕ)
  have ht : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have hNp : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hA : 0 < A := mul_pos hα0 hNp
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := mul_nonneg hA.le (Real.cosh_pos t).le
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by nlinarith [le_max_left (1 : ℝ) (R^2)]
  have hn : 0 < n := by linarith
  have hπ : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hRA : A ≤ R := le_mul_of_one_le_right hA.le (Real.one_le_cosh t)
  have hRmax : R ≤ max 1 (R^2) := by
    by_cases hR1 : R ≤ 1
    · exact hR1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact (by nlinarith : R ≤ R^2).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hAn : A ≤ n := by linarith
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hbest⟩ := exists_degree_le_absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m)
  have herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |(|x|) - p.eval x| ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)) :=
    fun x hx => (hbest x hx).trans (absoluteMinimaxError_even_le m)
  let r := (n / A) • p.comp (C (A / n) * X)
  let M := 6 * (1 + R^2) / (Real.pi * A) * Real.exp (A * Real.sinh t + 1)
  have hF : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse (Real.exp t),
      ‖(r.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖ ≤ M := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hznorm, hzim⟩ := norm_le_cosh_and_abs_im_le_sinh_of_mem_openBernsteinEllipse ht hz
    have haznorm : ‖(A : ℂ) * z‖ ≤ R := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hA]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hznorm hA.le
    have hazim : |((A : ℂ) * z).im| ≤ A * Real.sinh t := by
      simpa only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        zero_mul, add_zero, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hA] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzim hA.le
    have hg := norm_scaled_absolute_approximant_le hp herr hR hthreshold haznorm
    have heval : (r.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z = (A : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * (p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval
          ((A : ℂ) * z / ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ))) := by
      simp only [r, smul_eq_C_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_comp,
        Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_X,
        Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe, Complex.ofReal_div]
      have harg : ((A : ℂ) / (n : ℂ)) * z = (A : ℂ) * z / ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
        simp only [n, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
        ring
      rw [harg]
      simp only [n, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
      ring
    rw [heval, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hA]
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (inv_nonneg.mpr hA.le)).trans ?_
    change A⁻¹ * (6 * (1 + R^2) / Real.pi * Real.exp (|((A : ℂ) * z).im| + 1)) ≤ M
    calc
      A⁻¹ * (6 * (1 + R^2) / Real.pi * Real.exp (|((A : ℂ) * z).im| + 1)) =
          (6 * (1 + R^2) / (Real.pi * A)) * Real.exp (|((A : ℂ) * z).im| + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith : |((A : ℂ) * z).im| + 1 ≤ A * Real.sinh t + 1))
        (by positivity)
  have hmatch : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      (r.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ) = ((r.eval x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x _
    rw [show (x : ℂ) = Complex.ofRealHom x by rfl, eval_map_apply]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hrq⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr ht) (r.map Complex.ofRealHom).differentiable.differentiableOn hF
    (f := fun x : ℝ => r.eval x) hmatch N
  have hscaled : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |(|x|) - r.eval x| ≤ n / A * absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m) := by
    intro x hx
    have hy : A / n * x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have hc : 0 ≤ A / n := div_nonneg hA.le hn.le
      have hc1 : A / n ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hn).mpr hAn
      constructor <;> nlinarith [hx.1, hx.2]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbest (A / n * x) hy)
      (div_nonneg hn.le hA.le)
    have he : |(|x|) - r.eval x| = n / A * |(|A / n * x|) - p.eval (A / n * x)| := by
      simp only [r, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_comp, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X,
        abs_mul, abs_of_pos (div_pos hA hn)]
      have he : |x| - n / A * p.eval (A / n * x) =
          n / A * (A / n * |x| - p.eval (A / n * x)) := by field_simp
      rw [he, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (div_pos hn hA)]
    rw [he]
    exact h
  have hEN : absoluteMinimaxError N ≤ n / A * absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m) +
      2 * M / (Real.exp t)^N / (Real.exp t - 1) := by
    apply absoluteMinimaxError_le_of_degree_le hq
    intro x hx
    exact (abs_sub_le |x| (r.eval x) (q.eval x)).trans (add_le_add (hscaled x hx) (hrq x hx))
  have hNbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEN hNp.le
  have hρ : 0 < Real.exp t - 1 := sub_pos.mpr (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr ht)
  have hmain : (N : ℝ) * (n / A * absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m)) =
      n * absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m) / α := by dsimp [A]; field_simp
  have htail : (N : ℝ) * (2 * M / (Real.exp t)^N / (Real.exp t - 1)) =
      12 * Real.exp 1 * (1 + R^2) / (Real.pi * α * (Real.exp t - 1)) *
        Real.exp ((α * Real.sinh t - t) * (N : ℝ)) := by
    have he : Real.exp (A * Real.sinh t + 1) / Real.exp ((N : ℝ) * t) =
        Real.exp 1 * Real.exp ((α * Real.sinh t - t) * (N : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_sub, ← Real.exp_add]
      dsimp [A]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc
      (N : ℝ) * (2 * M / (Real.exp t)^N / (Real.exp t - 1)) =
          (12 * N * (1 + R^2) / (Real.pi * A * (Real.exp t - 1))) *
            (Real.exp (A * Real.sinh t + 1) / Real.exp ((N : ℝ) * t)) := by
        dsimp only [M]
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [he]
        dsimp only [A]
        field_simp
  rw [mul_add, hmain, htail] at hNbound
  have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (degree_transfer_exponent_le hα1) hNp.le)
  have htailBound :
      12 * Real.exp 1 * (1 + R^2) / (Real.pi * α * (Real.exp t - 1)) *
          Real.exp ((α * Real.sinh t - t) * (N : ℝ)) ≤
        bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder α N := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)
  exact hNbound.trans (add_le_add le_rfl htailBound)

name: NLAlib.contDiff_canonicalIntervalNodes
statement:
theorem contDiff_canonicalIntervalNodes (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)) (r : ℕ∞ω) :
    ContDiff ℝ r (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => canonicalIntervalNodes n t j)
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases (by simp only [canonicalIntervalNodes_zero]; fun_prop) (fun k => ?_) j
  refine Fin.lastCases (by simpa using (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ r (fun _ : Fin n → ℝ => (1 : ℝ))))
    (fun k => ?_) k
  simpa only [canonicalIntervalNodes_interior] using (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k : ContDiff ℝ r (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => t k))

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_sum_prod
statement:
theorem eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_sum_prod (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval x = ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), interpolationGapSign n i j *
      ∏ k ∈ univ.erase j, (x - canonicalIntervalNodes n t k) /
        (canonicalIntervalNodes n t j - canonicalIntervalNodes n t k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [interpolationGapPolynomial, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C,
    eval_lagrange_basis_eq_prod_div]

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  have hn (j : Fin (n + 2)) : ContDiffAt ℝ r
      (fun u : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => canonicalIntervalNodes n u.1 j) (t, x) :=
    (contDiff_canonicalIntervalNodes n j r).contDiffAt.comp (t, x) contDiffAt_fst
  simp_rw [eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_sum_prod]
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro j _
  apply contDiffAt_const.mul
  apply contDiffAt_prod
  intro k hk
  apply (contDiffAt_snd.sub (hn k)).div ((hn j).sub (hn k))
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => (mem_erase.mp hk).1 (ht.injective h.symm))

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_eval_derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_eval_derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) (r : ℕ∞ω) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun u : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).derivative.eval u.2) (t, x)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := contDiffAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i x (r + 1)
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ (r + 1) (fun p : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n p.1.1 i).eval p.2) ((t, x), x) := by
    exact hbase.comp ((t, x), x) (contDiffAt_fst.fst.prodMk contDiffAt_snd)
  have hd := ContDiffAt.fderiv_succ
    (f := fun (u : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (y : ℝ) => (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).eval y)
    (g := fun u : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => u.2) (x₀ := (t, x)) (m := r) hf contDiffAt_snd
  have heval := hd.clm_apply (contDiffAt_const (c := (1 : ℝ)))
  have heq : (fun u : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).eval y) u.2) 1) =
      (fun u => (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).derivative.eval u.2) := by
    funext u
    rw [(interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).hasFDerivAt u.2 |>.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
      one_smul]
  rw [heq] at heval
  exact heval

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := signed_nodalWeight_pos (n := n + 1) hv k
  have habs : |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v k| =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - k.val) * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v k := by
    simpa only [abs_mul, abs_neg_one_pow, one_mul] using abs_of_pos hpos
  rw [habs]
  unfold interpolationGapSign
  split_ifs with hki
  · have he : i.val + n + 1 = (i.val - k.val) + (n + 1 - k.val) + 2 * k.val := by omega
    rw [he, pow_add, pow_add, pow_mul]
    have hp : (-1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [hp, one_pow, mul_one]
    have hs : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - k.val)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    calc
      _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val - k.val) * (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - k.val)) ^ 2 * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v k) := by rw [hs, one_mul]
      _ = _ := by ring
  · have he : i.val + n + 1 = (k.val - i.val - 1) + (n + 1 - k.val) + (2 * i.val + 1) := by omega
    rw [he, pow_add, pow_add, pow_add, pow_mul]
    have hp : (-1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [hp, one_pow, one_mul, pow_one]
    have hs : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - k.val)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    calc
      _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k.val - i.val - 1) * (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - k.val)) ^ 2 * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v k) := by rw [hs, one_mul]
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapSign_relative
statement:
theorem interpolationGapSign_relative {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : Fin (n + 2)) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val - i.val) * interpolationGapSign n j k =
      if i.val < k.val ∧ k.val ≤ j.val then -interpolationGapSign n i k
        else interpolationGapSign n i k
proof:
:= by
  have hw : Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v k ≠ 0 := Lagrange.nodalWeight_ne_zero hv.injective.injOn (mem_univ k)
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hw
  let s : ℝ := (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val - i.val)
  have hs : s ^ 2 = 1 := by dsimp [s]; rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]; norm_num
  have he : j.val + n + 1 = (i.val + n + 1) + (j.val - i.val) := by have := hij; omega
  have hcommon : s * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + n + 1) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) := by
    rw [he, pow_add]
    change s * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) * s) = _
    calc
      _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) * s ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hs, mul_one]
  rw [mul_assoc, interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight hv j k, ← mul_assoc, hcommon]
  by_cases hki : k.val ≤ i.val
  · have hkj : k.val ≤ j.val := by have := hij; omega
    rw [if_pos hkj, if_neg (by omega), interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight hv i k, if_pos hki]
  · by_cases hkj : k.val ≤ j.val
    · rw [if_pos hkj, if_pos (by omega), neg_mul, interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight hv i k, if_neg hki]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg hkj, if_neg (by omega), interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight hv i k, if_neg hki]

name: NLAlib.isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_inv_polynomial
statement:
theorem isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_inv_polynomial {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ n) (hpole : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → p.eval x ≠ 0) :
    IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Ici 0) 0 n
      ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by intro h; have := hpole 0 le_rfl; simp [h] at this
  have hnum : ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹).num ∣ (1:ℝ[X]) := by
    simpa only [map_one, one_div] using RatFunc.num_div_dvd (1:ℝ[X]) hp0
  have hden : ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹).denom ∣ p := by
    simpa only [map_one, one_div] using RatFunc.denom_div_dvd (1:ℝ[X]) p
  refine ⟨?_, (degree_le_of_dvd hden hp0).trans hp, ?_⟩
  · simpa using degree_le_of_dvd hnum (one_ne_zero : (1:ℝ[X]) ≠ 0)
  · intro x hx hzero
    exact hpole x hx (eval_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval_eq_zero hden hzero)

name: NLAlib.eval_inv_polynomial_of_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_inv_polynomial_of_eval_ne_zero {p : ℝ[X]} {x : ℝ} (hp : p.eval x ≠ 0) :
    ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹).eval (RingHom.id ℝ) x = (p.eval x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hp
  let r : RatFunc ℝ := (algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹
  have hden : r.denom.eval x ≠ 0 := by
    have hdvd : r.denom ∣ p := by
      simpa only [r, map_one, one_div] using RatFunc.denom_div_dvd (1:ℝ[X]) p
    exact fun h => hp (eval_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval_eq_zero hdvd h)
  have hcross : r.num*p = r.denom := by
    have h := (RatFunc.num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff hp0).mpr
      (show r = algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) (1:ℝ[X]) /
        algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p by simp [r])
    simpa only [one_mul] using h
  have hv := congrArg (Polynomial.eval x) hcross
  rw [eval_mul] at hv
  change r.eval (RingHom.id ℝ) x = _
  rw [RatFunc.eval, eval₂_id, eval₂_id]
  field_simp
  exact hv

name: NLAlib.type_zero_rational_exp_error_ge_geometric_lower_bound
statement:
theorem type_zero_rational_exp_error_ge_geometric_lower_bound
    {n : ℕ} {r : RatFunc ℝ} (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Ici 0) 0 n r)
    {E : ℝ} (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x)-r.eval (RingHom.id ℝ) x| ≤ E) :
    1/(6*Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n)*3^n) ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  have hnum := r.num.eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hr.1
  let c : ℝ := r.num.coeff 0
  by_cases hc : c=0
  · have hr0 : r=0 := RatFunc.num_eq_zero_iff.mp (by
      rw [hnum]
      change C c = 0
      rw [hc, C_0])
    have hE : 1 ≤ E := by simpa [hr0] using herr 0 le_rfl
    have hbound := reciprocal_exp_neg_error_ge_geometric_lower_bound
      (p := C 1) (degree_C_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n))
      (E := 1) (by simp) (by
        intro x hx
        have he : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 := by
          simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)
        simp only [eval_C, inv_one]
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by have := Real.exp_pos (-x); linarith, by linarith⟩)
    exact hbound.trans hE
  · let p : ℝ[X] := c⁻¹ • r.denom
    have hp : p.degree ≤ n := (degree_smul_le _ _).trans hr.2.1
    have hpole : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → p.eval x ≠ 0 := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [p, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hc) (hr.2.2 x hx)
    have heval (x : ℝ) : r.eval (RingHom.id ℝ) x = (p.eval x)⁻¹ := by
      rw [RatFunc.eval, eval₂_id, eval₂_id, hnum, eval_C]
      simp only [p, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      change c/r.denom.eval x = (c⁻¹*r.denom.eval x)⁻¹
      rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    apply reciprocal_exp_neg_error_ge_geometric_lower_bound hp hpole
    intro x hx
    simpa only [← heval x] using herr x hx

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds_nonempty
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds_nonempty (n : ℕ) :
    (reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds n).Nonempty

:= by

  · refine ⟨by simp, ?_, by simp⟩
    simp only [RatFunc.denom_zero, degree_one]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n
  · intro x hx
    simp only [RatFunc.eval_zero, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds_bddBelow
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds_bddBelow (n : ℕ) :
    BddBelow (reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds n)

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound (n : ℕ) :
    1/(6*Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n)*3^n) ≤
      reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csInf (reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds_nonempty n)
  rintro E ⟨r, hr, herr⟩

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_le_geometric_upper_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_le_geometric_upper_bound (n : ℕ) :
    reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n ≤ Real.sqrt (40/21)/3^n
proof:
:= by
  apply csInf_le (reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds_bddBelow n)
  refine ⟨(algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n))⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_inv_polynomial
    · exact degree_le_of_natDegree_le (by rw [natDegree_reciprocalExponentialDenominator])
    · exact fun x hx => (reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos n hx).ne'
  · intro x hx
    rw [eval_inv_polynomial_of_eval_ne_zero
      (reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos n hx).ne']
    exact abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le n hx

name: NLAlib.pow_two_div_four_mul_sq_lt_lebesgueConstant_equispaced
statement:
theorem pow_two_div_four_mul_sq_lt_lebesgueConstant_equispaced {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ n / (4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) < lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
      (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => -1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / n)
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hα : (2 / (n : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (by norm_num) hnreal.ne'
  have hcard (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      |(Lagrange.basis univ (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => -1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) / n) j).eval (-1 + (1 : ℝ) / n)| =
      |(Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j).eval (1 / 2)| := by
    have h := eval_lagrange_basis_affine univ (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => (k : ℝ)) j
      (1 / 2) (2 / n) (-1) hα
    have hv : (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => (2 / (n : ℝ)) * (k : ℝ) + -1) =
        (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => -1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) / n) := by funext k; ring
    have hx : (2 / (n : ℝ)) * (1 / 2) + -1 = -1 + 1 / n := by ring
    rw [hv, hx, lagrange_basis_univ_fin_eq_range] at h
    exact congrArg abs h
  have hsum : lebesgueFunction (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => -1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / n) (-1 + (1 : ℝ) / n) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1),
        |(Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j).eval (1 / 2)| := by
    unfold lebesgueFunction
    simp_rw [hcard]
    exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ =>
      |(Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j).eval (1 / 2)|) (n + 1)
  have hx : (-1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    constructor
    · linarith [div_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hnreal.le]
    · have hdiv : (1 : ℝ) / n ≤ 2 := (div_le_iff₀ hnreal).mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
  have h := pow_two_div_four_mul_sq_lt_sum_abs_lagrange_basis hn
  rw [← hsum] at h
  exact h.trans_le (lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ hx)
