name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_le_gap_mul_of_far
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_le_gap_mul_of_far {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ))
    (hy : ∀ j, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ |y - canonicalIntervalNodes n t j|) :
    lebesgueFunction (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) x ≤
      (2 ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) *
        (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc)) *
      lebesgueFunction (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) y
proof:
:= by
  let v := canonicalIntervalNodes n t
  let δ := v i.succ - v i.castSucc
  have hi : v i.castSucc < v i.succ := ht Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
  have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := sub_nonneg.mpr hi.le
  have hxI : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨(canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc ht i.castSucc).1.trans hx.1,
      hx.2.trans (canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc ht i.succ).2⟩
  have hxa : |x - v i.castSucc| ≤ δ := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)]
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith [hx.2]
  have hxb : |x - v i.succ| ≤ δ := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)]
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith [hx.1]
  have hxB (j : Fin (n + 2)) : |x - v j| ≤ 2 := by
    have hj := canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc ht j
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hxI.1, hj.2], by linarith [hxI.2, hj.1]⟩
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hfactor : δ * (2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (n + 1) =
      2 ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) * δ := by
    rw [one_div, inv_pow, div_inv_eq_mul]
    ring
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  rw [mul_sum]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  have h := abs_eval_lagrange_basis_le_gap_mul univ v
    (a := i.castSucc) (b := i.succ) (j := j) (x := x) (y := y)
    (δ := δ) (B := 2) (r := 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (mem_univ _) (mem_univ _)
    (ne_of_lt Fin.castSucc_lt_succ) (mem_univ _) hδ (by norm_num) hr hxa hxb
    (fun j _ => hxB j) (fun j _ => hy j)
  simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
    show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega, hfactor, v, δ] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_canonicalIntervalNodes_gaps
statement:
theorem sum_canonicalIntervalNodes_gaps (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ -
      canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Fin.sum_univ_succ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t)
  have h1 := Fin.sum_univ_castSucc (canonicalIntervalNodes n t)
  rw [sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [canonicalIntervalNodes_zero, canonicalIntervalNodes_last] at h0 h1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_gap_midpoint_far
statement:
theorem exists_gap_midpoint_far {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) :
    ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ y ∈ Icc (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc)
      (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ),
      ∀ j, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ |y - canonicalIntervalNodes n t j|
proof:
:= by
  let v := canonicalIntervalNodes n t
  let gap : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => v i.succ - v i.castSucc
  obtain ⟨i, _, hmax⟩ := exists_max_image univ gap univ_nonempty
  have hsum : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * gap i := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j, gap j := (sum_canonicalIntervalNodes_gaps n t).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (n + 1), gap i := sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hmax j (mem_univ j))
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hfar : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ gap i / 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr
    nlinarith [hsum]
  have hi : v i.castSucc < v i.succ := ht Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
  let y : ℝ := (v i.castSucc + v i.succ) / 2
  refine ⟨i, y, ⟨by dsimp [y]; linarith, by dsimp [y]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
  intro j
  rcases le_or_gt j i.castSucc with hj | hj
  · have hvj : v j ≤ v i.castSucc := ht.monotone hj
    have hdist : gap i / 2 ≤ |y - v j| := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by dsimp [y]; linarith)]
      dsimp [gap, y]
      linarith
    exact hfar.trans hdist
  · have hij : i.succ ≤ j := by
      simp only [Fin.le_def, Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at *
      omega
    have hvj : v i.succ ≤ v j := ht.monotone hij
    have hdist : gap i / 2 ≤ |y - v j| := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by dsimp [y]; linarith)]
      dsimp [gap, y]
      linarith
    exact hfar.trans hdist

name: NLAlib.one_le_interpolationGapPeak
proof:
:= by
  have hi : canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc ≤ canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ :=
    (ht Fin.castSucc_lt_succ).le
  exact (one_le_lebesgueFunction _ ht.injective (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc)).trans
    (lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ (left_mem_Icc.mpr hi))

name: NLAlib.exists_gap_peak_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_gap_peak_ratio {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) :
    ∃ l : Fin (n + 1), ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), interpolationGapPeak n t i ≤
      (2 ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) *
        (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc)) *
      interpolationGapPeak n t l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, y, hy, hfar⟩ := exists_gap_midpoint_far ht
  refine ⟨l, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) *
      (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) := by
    have hi := ht (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := i))
    positivity
  have hpeak : 0 ≤ interpolationGapPeak n t l := norm_nonneg _
  apply lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall _ (mul_nonneg hcoef hpeak)
  intro x hx
  exact (lebesgueFunction_le_gap_mul_of_far ht i hx hfar).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ hy) hcoef)

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapPeak_sub_le_of_norm_difference_le
statement:
theorem interpolationGapPeak_sub_le_of_norm_difference_le {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hbound : ‖interpolationPeakDifference n t‖ ≤ R)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    interpolationGapPeak n t i - interpolationGapPeak n t j ≤ 2 * R
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst (k : Fin (n + 1)) : |interpolationGapPeak n t k - interpolationGapPeak n t 0| ≤ R := by
    refine Fin.cases (by simpa using hR) (fun l => ?_) k
    exact (norm_le_pi_norm (interpolationPeakDifference n t) l).trans hbound
  have hi := (abs_le.mp (hfirst i)).2
  have hj := (abs_le.mp (hfirst j)).1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.canonicalIntervalNodes_gap_ge_of_norm_difference_le
statement:
theorem canonicalIntervalNodes_gap_ge_of_norm_difference_le {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hbound : ‖interpolationPeakDifference n t‖ ≤ R) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    1 / (2 ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) * (2 * R + 1)) ≤
      canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hratio⟩ := exists_gap_peak_ratio ht
  let C : ℝ := 2 ^ n * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1)
  let δ : ℝ := canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ - canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc
  let q : ℝ := C * δ
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := sub_pos.mpr (ht Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := (mul_pos hC hδ).le
  have hpeak := one_le_interpolationGapPeak ht i
  have hdiff := interpolationGapPeak_sub_le_of_norm_difference_le hR hbound l i
  have hrat : interpolationGapPeak n t i ≤ q * interpolationGapPeak n t l := hratio i
  have hscaled : interpolationGapPeak n t i ≤ q * (interpolationGapPeak n t i + 2 * R) :=
    hrat.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith :
      interpolationGapPeak n t l ≤ interpolationGapPeak n t i + 2 * R) hq)
  have hprod : 1 ≤ q * (2 * R + 1) := by
    by_cases hqone : 1 ≤ q
    · exact hqone.trans (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hq hR])
    · have hlow := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpeak (show 0 ≤ 1 - q by linarith)
      nlinarith [hlow, hscaled]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < C * (2 * R + 1) by positivity)).mpr
  change 1 ≤ δ * (C * (2 * R + 1))
  simpa only [q, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hprod

name: NLAlib.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_sawtoothError
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_sawtoothError (n : ℕ) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (sawtoothError n) 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => (sawtoothSineInterp n).eval x) := by
    simpa using (sawtoothSineInterp n).contDiff_aeval (𝕜 := ℝ) 1
  have hτ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (sawtoothApprox n) :=
    Real.contDiff_sin.mul (hp.comp Real.contDiff_cos)
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => Real.pi - t) := contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id
  exact (hB.sub hτ).contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval

name: NLAlib.sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_eq_integral
statement:
theorem sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_eq_integral {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (hper : Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    g x - jacksonPeriodicApprox n g x = -(2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, sawtoothError n t * deriv (fun s : ℝ => g (x - s)) t
proof:
:= by
  let gx : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => g (x - t)
  have hgx := lipschitzWith_comp_const_sub hg x
  have hgAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval gx 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    hgx.lipschitzOnWith.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval
  have hIB := (absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_sawtoothError n).integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hgAC
  have hzero : sawtoothError n 0 = Real.pi := by simp [sawtoothError]
  have hlast : sawtoothError n (2 * Real.pi) = -Real.pi := by
    have h := sawtoothError_two_pi_sub n 0
    simpa only [sub_zero, hzero] using h
  have hgzero : gx 0 = g x := by simp [gx]
  have hglast : gx (2 * Real.pi) = g x := hper.sub_eq x
  rw [hlast, hzero, hgzero, hglast] at hIB
  have hder : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv (sawtoothError n) t =
      -(sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos t) :=
    fun t => (hasDerivAt_sawtoothError n t).deriv
  simp_rw [hder, neg_mul] at hIB
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hIB
  unfold jacksonPeriodicApprox
  have hπ : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
  change g x - (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
    (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos t) * gx t) =
    -(2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, sawtoothError n t * deriv gx t)
  field_simp [hπ]
  nlinarith [hIB]

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_le {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (hper : Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |g x - jacksonPeriodicApprox n g x| ≤ Real.pi * (L : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hgx := lipschitzWith_comp_const_sub hg x
  have hpoint : ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖sawtoothError n t * deriv (fun s : ℝ => g (x - s)) t‖ ≤ |sawtoothError n t| * (L : ℝ) := by
    intro t
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_deriv_le_of_lipschitz hgx) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hbound : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => |sawtoothError n t| * (L : ℝ))
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := ((continuous_sawtoothError n).abs.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le Real.two_pi_pos.le
    (ae_of_all volume (fun t _ => hpoint t)) hbound
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const] at hI
  rw [sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_eq_integral hg hper n x, abs_mul, abs_neg,
    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos)]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (show 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ by positivity)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hh
  refine hh.trans_eq ?_
  rw [integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_rational_perturbation_error_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pos_rational_perturbation_error_lt {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (f : C(s, ℝ)) (p q P Q : ℝ[X])
    (hq : ∀ x : s, q.eval (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 < E)
    (hbound : ∀ x : s, |f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ E)
    (hsign : ∀ x : s, |f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)| = E →
      0 < (f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)) * (P * q - p * Q).eval (x : ℝ)) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∀ x : s,
      (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 ∧
      |f x - (p + t • P).eval (x : ℝ) / (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ)| < E
proof:
:= by
  let e : s → ℝ := fun x => f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)
  let A : s → ℝ := fun x => f x * q.eval (x : ℝ) - p.eval (x : ℝ)
  let C : s → ℝ := fun x => f x * Q.eval (x : ℝ) - P.eval (x : ℝ)
  let D : ℝ × s → ℝ := fun z => q.eval (z.2 : ℝ) + z.1 * Q.eval (z.2 : ℝ)
  let M : ℝ × s → ℝ := fun z =>
    (A z.2 + z.1 * C z.2) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 * (D z) ^ 2
  let B : ℝ × s → ℝ := fun z =>
    2 * A z.2 * C z.2 - 2 * E ^ 2 * q.eval (z.2 : ℝ) * Q.eval (z.2 : ℝ) +
      z.1 * ((C z.2) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 * (Q.eval (z.2 : ℝ)) ^ 2)
  have hA : ∀ x, A x = e x * q.eval (x : ℝ) := by
    intro x; dsimp [A, e]; field_simp [hq x]
  have hMzero : ∀ x : s, M (0, x) ≤ 0 := by
    intro x
    have hb : (e x) ^ 2 ≤ E ^ 2 := by
      have hx := hbound x
      nlinarith [sq_abs (e x), abs_nonneg (e x)]
    have hprod := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg (q.eval (x : ℝ)))
      (sub_nonpos.mpr hb)
    dsimp [M, D]
    rw [hA]
    nlinarith
  have hDcont : Continuous D := by dsimp [D]; fun_prop
  have hMcont : Continuous M := by dsimp [M, A, C, D]; fun_prop
  have hBcont : Continuous B := by dsimp [B, A, C]; fun_prop
  have hlocal : ∀ x : s, ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × s in 𝓝 (0, x),
      D z ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < z.1 → M z < 0) := by
    intro x
    have hDne : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × s in 𝓝 (0, x), D z ≠ 0 :=
      ((isOpen_ne : IsOpen {y : ℝ | y ≠ 0}).preimage hDcont).mem_nhds
        (by simpa [D] using hq x)
    by_cases hx : |e x| = E
    · have he2 : (e x) ^ 2 = E ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs (e x)]
      have hdir := hsign x hx
      change 0 < e x * (P * q - p * Q).eval (x : ℝ) at hdir
      have hC : q.eval (x : ℝ) * C x = e x * q.eval (x : ℝ) * Q.eval (x : ℝ) -
          (P * q - p * Q).eval (x : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [C, e]
        simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul]
        field_simp [hq x]
        ring
      have hBneg : B (0, x) < 0 := by
        dsimp [B]
        rw [hA]
        have heq : 2 * (e x * q.eval (x : ℝ)) * C x -
            2 * E ^ 2 * q.eval (x : ℝ) * Q.eval (x : ℝ) =
            -2 * e x * (P * q - p * Q).eval (x : ℝ) := by
          calc
            _ = 2 * e x * (q.eval (x : ℝ) * C x) -
                2 * E ^ 2 * q.eval (x : ℝ) * Q.eval (x : ℝ) := by ring
            _ = _ := by
              rw [hC]
              linear_combination 2 * q.eval (x : ℝ) * Q.eval (x : ℝ) * he2
        simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
        rw [heq]
        nlinarith
      have hBne : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × s in 𝓝 (0, x), B z < 0 :=
        (isOpen_lt hBcont continuous_const).mem_nhds hBneg
      filter_upwards [hDne, hBne] with z hzD hzB
      refine ⟨hzD, fun ht => ?_⟩
      have hprod := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ht hzB
      have hzero := hMzero z.2
      have heq : M z = M (0, z.2) + z.1 * B z := by dsimp [M, B, D]; ring
      rw [heq]
      linarith
    · have hxlt : |e x| < E := lt_of_le_of_ne (hbound x) hx
      have he2 : (e x) ^ 2 < E ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_abs (e x), abs_nonneg (e x)]
      have hprod := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (hq x))
        (sub_neg.mpr he2)
      have hMneg : M (0, x) < 0 := by dsimp [M, D]; rw [hA]; nlinarith
      have hMne : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × s in 𝓝 (0, x), M z < 0 :=
        (isOpen_lt hMcont continuous_const).mem_nhds hMneg
      filter_upwards [hDne, hMne] with z hzD hzM
      exact ⟨hzD, fun _ => hzM⟩
  have huniform : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ∀ x : s,
      D (t, x) ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < t → M (t, x) < 0) :=
    isCompact_univ.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually (fun x _ => hlocal x) |>.mono
      (fun _ ht x => ht x (Set.mem_univ x))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hstep⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp huniform
  let t := δ / 2
  have ht : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have hnear : dist t (0 : ℝ) < δ := by rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ht]; dsimp [t]; linarith
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hD := (hstep hnear x).1
  have hM := (hstep hnear x).2 ht
  have hDpoly : (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ) = D (t, x) := by simp [D, eval_smul]
  have hNpoly : f x * (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ) - (p + t • P).eval (x : ℝ) =
      A x + t * C x := by simp [A, C, eval_smul]; ring
  refine ⟨by rw [hDpoly]; exact hD, ?_⟩
  have hDpos : 0 < |D (t, x)| := abs_pos.mpr hD
  have hNlt : |A x + t * C x| < E * |D (t, x)| := by
    have hpos := mul_pos hE hDpos
    change (A x + t * C x) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 * (D (t, x)) ^ 2 < 0 at hM
    nlinarith [sq_abs (A x + t * C x), sq_abs (D (t, x)), abs_nonneg (A x + t * C x)]
  have herr : f x - (p + t • P).eval (x : ℝ) / (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ) =
      (A x + t * C x) / D (t, x) := by
    rw [← hNpoly, ← hDpoly]
    field_simp [hDpoly, hD]
  rw [herr, abs_div]
  exact (div_lt_iff₀ hDpos).mpr hNlt

name: NLAlib.sawtoothGridAngle_two_mul
statement:
theorem sawtoothGridAngle_two_mul (n : ℕ) :
    sawtoothGridAngle n (2 * (n + 1)) = 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  unfold sawtoothGridAngle
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.sawtoothGridAngle_reflection
statement:
theorem sawtoothGridAngle_reflection (n j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * (n + 1)) :
    sawtoothGridAngle n (2 * (n + 1) - j) = 2 * Real.pi - sawtoothGridAngle n j
proof:
:= by
  unfold sawtoothGridAngle
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hj]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc_full
statement:
theorem sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc_full {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2 * (n + 1)) :
    sawtoothGridAngle n j ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold sawtoothGridAngle; positivity
  · have h := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).monotone hj
    rwa [sawtoothGridAngle_two_mul] at h

name: NLAlib.abs_sawtoothError_eq_sign_sin_mul_on_full_grid_cell
statement:
theorem abs_sawtoothError_eq_sign_sin_mul_on_full_grid_cell (n j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < 2 * (n + 1)) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n j) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1))) :
    |sawtoothError n t| = Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sawtoothError n t
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt j n with hjn | hjn
  · exact abs_sawtoothError_eq_sign_sin_mul_on_grid_cell n j hjn ht
  · let k := 2 * (n + 1) - 1 - j
    have hk : k ≤ n := by dsimp [k]; omega
    have hk0 : k = 2 * (n + 1) - (j + 1) := by dsimp [k]; omega
    have hk1 : k + 1 = 2 * (n + 1) - j := by dsimp [k]; omega
    have hleft : sawtoothGridAngle n k = 2 * Real.pi - sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1) := by
      rw [hk0]
      exact sawtoothGridAngle_reflection n (j + 1) (by omega)
    have hright : sawtoothGridAngle n (k + 1) = 2 * Real.pi - sawtoothGridAngle n j := by
      rw [hk1]
      exact sawtoothGridAngle_reflection n j hj.le
    have hmirror : 2 * Real.pi - t ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n k) (sawtoothGridAngle n (k + 1)) := by
      rw [hleft, hright]
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have h := abs_sawtoothError_eq_sign_sin_mul_on_grid_cell n k hk hmirror
    rw [sawtoothError_two_pi_sub, sign_sin_nat_two_pi_sub, abs_neg, neg_mul_neg] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_sawtooth_grid_cell
proof:
:= by
  apply hf.mono_set'
  rw [uIoc_of_le (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n (show j < j + 1 by omega)).le,
    uIoc_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le]
  exact Ioc_subset_Ioc (sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc_full hj.le).1
    (sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc_full (by omega)).2

name: NLAlib.sum_integral_sawtooth_grid_eq
statement:
theorem sum_integral_sawtooth_grid_eq {f : ℝ → ℝ} (n : ℕ)
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (2 * (n + 1)), ∫ t in sawtoothGridAngle n j..sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1), f t) =
      ∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, f t
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
    (a := sawtoothGridAngle n) (n := 2 * (n + 1))
    (fun j hj => intervalIntegrable_sawtooth_grid_cell hf hj)
  rw [sawtoothGridAngle_two_mul] at h
  simpa only [sawtoothGridAngle, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_div] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq_signed
statement:
theorem integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq_signed (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, |sawtoothError n t|) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
        Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sawtoothError n t
proof:
:= by
  have hAbs : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => |sawtoothError n t|) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ((continuous_sawtoothError n).abs).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hSigned := (intervalIntegrable_sign_sin (n + 1)).mul_continuousOn
    (continuous_sawtoothError n).continuousOn
  rw [← sum_integral_sawtooth_grid_eq n hAbs, ← sum_integral_sawtooth_grid_eq n hSigned]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_Ioo_of_le
    (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n (show j < j + 1 by omega)).le
  intro t ht
  exact abs_sawtoothError_eq_sign_sin_mul_on_full_grid_cell n j (mem_range.mp hj) ht

name: NLAlib.integral_signed_sawtoothError_eq_affine
statement:
theorem integral_signed_sawtoothError_eq_affine (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sawtoothError n t) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * (Real.pi - t)
proof:
:= by
  have hσ := intervalIntegrable_sign_sin (n + 1)
  have hcB : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Real.pi - t) := continuous_const.sub continuous_id
  have hB := hσ.mul_continuousOn hcB.continuousOn
  have hcτ : Continuous (sawtoothApprox n) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => (hasDerivAt_sawtoothApprox n t).continuousAt)
  have hστ := hσ.mul_continuousOn hcτ.continuousOn
  have hterm : ∀ t : ℝ,
      Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sawtoothError n t =
        Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * (Real.pi - t) -
          Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sawtoothApprox n t := by
    intro t
    unfold sawtoothError
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hB hστ, integral_sign_sin_mul_sawtoothApprox_eq_zero, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_sign_sin_mul_pi_sub_eq
statement:
theorem integral_sign_sin_mul_pi_sub_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * (Real.pi - t)) =
      Real.pi ^ 2 / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcB : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Real.pi - t) := continuous_const.sub continuous_id
  have hf := (intervalIntegrable_sign_sin (n + 1)).mul_continuousOn hcB.continuousOn
  rw [← sum_integral_sawtooth_grid_eq n hf]
  let h := Real.pi / (n + 1)
  have hangle : ∀ j : ℕ, sawtoothGridAngle n j = (j : ℝ) * h := by
    intro j
    unfold sawtoothGridAngle
    dsimp [h]
    ring
  have hcell : ∀ j ∈ range (2 * (n + 1)),
      (∫ t : ℝ in sawtoothGridAngle n j..sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1),
        Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * (Real.pi - t)) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (Real.pi * h - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h ^ 2) := by
    intro j hj
    have heq := intervalIntegral.integral_congr_Ioo_of_le (μ := volume)
      (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n (show j < j + 1 by omega)).le
      (fun t ht => congrArg (fun s : ℝ => s * (Real.pi - t))
        (sign_sin_mul_eq_neg_one_pow_of_between_grid n j ht))
    rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub (f := fun _ : ℝ => Real.pi) (g := fun t : ℝ => t)
        (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (continuous_id.intervalIntegrable _ _), intervalIntegral.integral_const, integral_id]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hangle, hangle]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcell]
  rw [sum_alternating_affine_two_mul]
  dsimp [h]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq
statement:
theorem integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, |sawtoothError n t|) = Real.pi ^ 2 / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq_signed, integral_signed_sawtoothError_eq_affine,
    integral_sign_sin_mul_pi_sub_eq]

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pi_mul_integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq
statement:
theorem inv_two_pi_mul_integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, |sawtoothError n t|) =
      Real.pi / (2 * (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_abs_sawtoothError_eq]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo {N : ℕ} (j : Fin N) :
    ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N ∈ Ioo 0 π
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt j.isLt)
  have hj : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast j.isLt
  constructor
  · positivity
  · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN]
    nlinarith [pi_pos]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index
statement:
theorem chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index {N : ℕ} (j : Fin N) :
    chebyshevZero N j = cos (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevZero
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sin
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sin {N : ℕ} (j : Fin N) :
    |(derivative (T ℝ N)).eval (chebyshevZero N j)| *
      sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) = N
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo j
  have hsqrt : sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) = √(1 - chebyshevZero N j ^ 2) := by
    rw [chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index]
    exact sin_eq_sqrt_one_sub_cos_sq hθ.1.le hθ.2.le
  rw [hsqrt]
  exact Markov.abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sqrt j

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_basis_chebyshevZero_cos_nat_mul_pi_div
statement:
theorem abs_eval_basis_chebyshevZero_cos_nat_mul_pi_div {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (k : ℕ) (j : Fin N) :
    |(Lagrange.basis univ (chebyshevZero N) j).eval (cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N))| =
      sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
        ((N : ℝ) * |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - chebyshevZero N j|)
proof:
:= by
  let y := cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N)
  let c : ℝ := 1 / 2 ^ (N - 1)
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hT : |(T ℝ N).eval y| = 1 := by
    rw [eval_T_real_cos_int_mul_pi_div (Nat.ne_of_gt hN), Int.cast_negOnePow_natCast, abs_neg_one_pow]
  have hy : y ≠ chebyshevZero N j := by
    intro h
    rw [h, eval_T_real_chebyshevZero] at hT
    norm_num at hT
  have hd := abs_eval_derivative_T_zero_mul_sin j
  have hθ := chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo j
  have hs : 0 < sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθ.1 hθ.2
  have hd0 : |(derivative (T ℝ N)).eval (chebyshevZero N j)| ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hd
    exact hNR.ne' hd.symm
  have hdiff : |y - chebyshevZero N j| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hy)
  rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_not_at_node (mem_univ j) hy,
    Lagrange.nodalWeight_eq_eval_derivative_nodal (mem_univ j), nodal_chebyshevZero,
    derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_inv,
    abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc, hT, mul_one]
  change c * ((c * |(derivative (T ℝ N)).eval (chebyshevZero N j)|)⁻¹ * |y - chebyshevZero N j|⁻¹) = _
  have hf (d s t : ℝ) (hd0 : d ≠ 0) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hds : d * s = N) :
      c * ((c * d)⁻¹ * t⁻¹) = s / ((N : ℝ) * t) := by
    field_simp [hc.ne', hd0, ht0, hNR.ne']
    exact hds.symm
  exact hf _ _ _ hd0 hdiff hd

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_cos_nat_mul_pi_div
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_cos_nat_mul_pi_div {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (k : ℕ) :
    lebesgueFunction (chebyshevZero N) (cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N)) =
      (1 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin N, sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
        |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - cos (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  rw [mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [abs_eval_basis_chebyshevZero_cos_nat_mul_pi_div hN k j, chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  ring

name: NLAlib.differentiableAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  have hinput : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun s : Fin n → ℝ => (s, x)) t :=
    contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const
  exact ((contDiffAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i x 1).comp t hinput).differentiableAt_one

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak_fixed_criticalPoint
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak_fixed_criticalPoint {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {t : Fin n → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun s => interpolationGapPeak n s i)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)) t) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdiff, hτgap, hτcrit, hevent⟩ := exists_contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak_chart hn ht i
  have hτself : τ t = interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i :=
    (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht i).2.2.2.2.2 (τ t) hτgap hτcrit
  let H : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).eval u.2
  let D := fderiv ℝ H (t, τ t)
  have hH : HasFDerivAt H D (t, τ t) :=
    (contDiffAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i (τ t) 1).differentiableAt_one.hasFDerivAt
  have hspace := hH.comp (τ t) (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (𝕜 := ℝ) t (τ t))
  have hz : ∀ y : ℝ, D (0, y) = 0 := by
    have heq := hspace.unique ((interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).hasFDerivAt (τ t))
    intro y
    have h := congrArg (fun L : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L y) heq
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self, hτcrit, smul_zero] using h
  have hfix := hH.comp t (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) t (τ t))
  have hfixeq := hfix.fderiv
  have hinput := (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) t).prodMk hτdiff.differentiableAt_one.hasFDerivAt
  have hloc := hH.comp t hinput
  have heq : D ∘L (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)).prod (fderiv ℝ τ t) =
      D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ := by
    ext h
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
    rw [show (h, fderiv ℝ τ t h) = (h, 0) + (0, fderiv ℝ τ t h) by ext <;> simp,
      map_add, hz, add_zero]
  rw [heq, ← hfixeq] at hloc
  have hpeak := hloc.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hevent.mono (fun s hs => hs.2.2.2))
  simpa only [hτself, H, Function.comp_def] using hpeak

name: NLAlib.fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node_apply {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) (h : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t j)) t h =
      -(interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t j) *
        fderiv ℝ (fun s => canonicalIntervalNodes n s j) t h
proof:
:= by
  let v := canonicalIntervalNodes n t
  let H : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).eval u.2
  let D := fderiv ℝ H (t, v j)
  let N := fderiv ℝ (fun s => canonicalIntervalNodes n s j) t
  have hH : HasFDerivAt H D (t, v j) :=
    (contDiffAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i (v j) 1).differentiableAt_one.hasFDerivAt
  have hN : HasFDerivAt (fun s => canonicalIntervalNodes n s j) N t :=
    (contDiff_canonicalIntervalNodes n j 1).contDiffAt.differentiableAt_one.hasFDerivAt
  have hnodal := hH.comp t ((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) t).prodMk hN)
  have hevent : (fun _ : Fin n → ℝ => interpolationGapSign n i j) =ᶠ[𝓝 t]
      (fun s => H (s, canonicalIntervalNodes n s j)) := by
    filter_upwards [(isOpen_interiorNodeSimplex n).mem_nhds ht] with s hs
    exact (eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node hs i j).symm
  have hzero := (hnodal.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent).unique
    (hasFDerivAt_const (𝕜 := ℝ) (interpolationGapSign n i j) t)
  have hspace := hH.comp (v j) (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (𝕜 := ℝ) t (v j))
  have hspaceeq := hspace.unique ((interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).hasFDerivAt (v j))
  have hfix := hH.comp t (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) t (v j))
  have hfixeq := hfix.fderiv
  simp only [H, v, Function.comp_def] at hfixeq
  rw [hfixeq]
  change D (h, 0) = _
  have hn0 := congrArg (fun L : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hzero
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, zero_apply] at hn0
  have hnx := congrArg (fun L : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (N h)) hspaceeq
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self, smul_eq_mul] at hnx
  have hadd : D (h, N h) = D (h, 0) + D (0, N h) := by
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    ext <;> simp
  change D (h, 0) = -(interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (v j) * N h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_apply_eq_sum {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) (h : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval x) t h =
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (Lagrange.basis univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j).eval x *
        fderiv ℝ (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t j)) t h
proof:
:= by
  let v := canonicalIntervalNodes n t
  have hevent : (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval x) =ᶠ[𝓝 t]
      (fun s => ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval (v j) *
        (Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x) := by
    filter_upwards [(isOpen_interiorNodeSimplex n).mem_nhds ht] with s hs
    have hd : (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).degree < (univ : Finset (Fin (n + 2))).card :=
      Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (s := univ) (interpolationGapSign n i) hs.injective.injOn
    have hp := Lagrange.eq_interpolate (v := v) ht.injective.injOn hd
    conv_lhs => rw [hp]
    rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum]
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_C]
  have hsum := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (univ : Finset (Fin (n + 2)))) (fun j _ =>
    (differentiableAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i (v j)).hasFDerivAt.mul_const
      ((Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x))
  have hactual := hsum.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent
  have heq := congrArg (fun L : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hactual.fderiv
  simpa only [v, _root_.sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using heq

name: NLAlib.fderiv_canonicalIntervalNodes_interior
statement:
theorem fderiv_canonicalIntervalNodes_interior (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :

      ContinuousLinearMap.proj j

name: NLAlib.fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_apply {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) (h : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval x) t h =
      ∑ j : Fin n, (-(interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (t j) *
        (Lagrange.basis univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ).eval x) * h j
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_apply_eq_sum ht i x h]
  simp_rw [fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node_apply ht i]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp_rw [fderiv_canonicalIntervalNodes_interior]
  simp only [fderiv_canonicalIntervalNodes_zero,
    show (Fin.last n).succ = Fin.last (n + 1) by rfl,
    fderiv_canonicalIntervalNodes_last, zero_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, canonicalIntervalNodes_interior]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun s => interpolationGapPeak n s i)
      (∑ j : Fin n, (-(interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (t j) *
        (Lagrange.basis univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ).eval
          (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)) •
            (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak_fixed_criticalPoint hn ht i
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval
      (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)) t =
      ∑ j : Fin n, (-(interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (t j) *
        (Lagrange.basis univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ).eval
          (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)) •
            (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    ext h
    simp only [_root_.sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
    exact fderiv_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_apply ht i _ h
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.polynomialSupNorm_mono
statement:
theorem polynomialSupNorm_mono {s t : Set ℂ} (hst : s ⊆ t) (p : ℝ[X]) :

proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro z
  apply iSup_le
  intro hz
  exact le_iSup_of_le z (le_iSup_of_le (hst hz) le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.residualMinimaxError_le
proof:
:=
  iInf_le_of_le p (iInf_le_of_le hp (iInf_le_of_le hp0 le_rfl))

statement:
theorem residualMinimaxError_antitone (s : Set ℂ) :
    Antitone (residualMinimaxError s)
proof:
:= by

  apply le_iInf
  intro p
  apply le_iInf
  intro hp

  intro hp0
  exact residualMinimaxError_le (hp.trans (by exact_mod_cast hkl)) hp0

name: NLAlib.residualMinimaxError_mono
statement:
theorem residualMinimaxError_mono {s t : Set ℂ} (hst : s ⊆ t) (k : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  apply le_iInf
  intro p
  apply le_iInf
  intro hp
  apply le_iInf
  intro hp0
  exact (residualMinimaxError_le hp hp0).trans (polynomialSupNorm_mono hst p)

name: NLAlib.residualMinimaxError_le_one
statement:
theorem residualMinimaxError_le_one (s : Set ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    residualMinimaxError s k ≤ 1
proof:
:= by

  apply iSup_le

name: NLAlib.residualMinimaxError_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem residualMinimaxError_empty (k : ℕ) :

    residualMinimaxError_le (s := ∅) (p := (1 : ℝ[X])) (by simp) (by simp)

statement:

:= by

statement:
theorem mem_residualPolynomialDirections_iff (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) :

proof:
