name: NLAlib.polynomialSupNorm_eq_enorm
statement:
theorem polynomialSupNorm_eq_enorm {s : Set ℂ} [CompactSpace s] (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialSupNorm s p = ‖complexPolynomialRestriction s p‖ₑ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ContinuousMap.enorm_eq_iSup_enorm]
  simp only [polynomialSupNorm, complexPolynomialRestriction_apply]
  exact (iSup_subtype'' s (fun z => ‖aeval z p‖ₑ)).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomialSupNorm_eq_residualMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_polynomialSupNorm_eq_residualMinimaxError {s : Set ℂ} [CompactSpace s]
    (k : ℕ) : ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ k ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
      polynomialSupNorm s p = residualMinimaxError s k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional
    (residualEvaluationDirections s k) (1 : C(s, ℂ))
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hg
  obtain ⟨hqdeg, hq0⟩ := (mem_residualPolynomialDirections_iff k q).mp hq
  have hpdeg : (1 - q).degree ≤ k := (degree_sub_le _ _).trans
    (max_le (by simp) hqdeg)
  have hp0 : (1 - q).eval 0 = 1 := by simp [hq0]
  refine ⟨1 - q, hpdeg, hp0, le_antisymm ?_ (residualMinimaxError_le hpdeg hp0)⟩
  apply le_iInf
  intro p
  apply le_iInf
  intro hp
  apply le_iInf
  intro hp0'
  rw [polynomialSupNorm_eq_enorm, polynomialSupNorm_eq_enorm]
  have hd : 1 - p ∈ residualPolynomialDirections k := by
    apply (mem_residualPolynomialDirections_iff _ _).mpr
    exact ⟨(degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) hp), by simp [hp0']⟩
  have hle := Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := (1 : C(s, ℂ)))
    (Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨1 - p, hd, rfl⟩ :
      complexPolynomialRestriction s (1 - p) ∈ residualEvaluationDirections s k)
  change Metric.infDist (1 : C(s, ℂ)) (residualEvaluationDirections s k) ≤
    dist 1 (complexPolynomialRestriction s (1 - p)) at hle
  rw [← hbest, dist_eq_norm] at hle
  have heq : complexPolynomialRestriction s (1 - q) =
      1 - complexPolynomialRestriction s q := by ext z; simp
  have heq' : (1 : C(s, ℂ)) - complexPolynomialRestriction s (1 - p) =
      complexPolynomialRestriction s p := by ext z; simp
  rw [heq'] at hle
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [← ofReal_norm] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle

name: NLAlib.residualMinimaxError_real_interval
statement:
theorem residualMinimaxError_real_interval {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (k : ℕ) :
    residualMinimaxError ((algebraMap ℝ ℂ) '' Set.Icc a b) k =
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)))
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℂ := (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) '' Set.Icc a b
  have hs : IsCompact s := isCompact_Icc.image Complex.continuous_ofReal
  have : CompactSpace s := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hs
  have heval (p : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
      ‖aeval (algebraMap ℝ ℂ x) p‖ = |p.eval x| := by
    rw [aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval]
    change ‖Complex.ofReal (p.eval x)‖ = |p.eval x|
    simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hcheb := (isLeast_chebyshev_minimax k ha hab).1
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hbound⟩ := hcheb
    apply (residualMinimaxError_le hp hp0).trans
    apply iSup_le
    intro z
    apply iSup_le
    rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [← ofReal_norm, heval]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound x hx)
  · apply le_iInf
    intro p
    apply le_iInf
    intro hp
    apply le_iInf
    intro hp0
    have hfinite : polynomialSupNorm s p ≠ ∞ := by
      rw [polynomialSupNorm_eq_enorm]
      exact enorm_ne_top
    apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hfinite).mpr
    apply (isLeast_chebyshev_minimax k ha hab).2
    refine ⟨p, hp, hp0, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hpoint : ‖aeval (algebraMap ℝ ℂ x) p‖ₑ ≤ polynomialSupNorm s p :=
      le_iSup_of_le (algebraMap ℝ ℂ x) (le_iSup_of_le ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ le_rfl)
    have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite hpoint
    simpa only [toReal_enorm, heval] using hreal

name: NLAlib.logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_canonical
statement:
theorem logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_canonical {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {u : Fin n → ℝ} (hu : u ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) :
    (2 / π) * (log (n + 2 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
      lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (canonicalIntervalNodes n u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hcompare⟩ := exists_equal_interpolation_peaks_with_convex_combination hn
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlower⟩ := exists_canonical_reference_grid_logarithmic_lower_lt_peaks n
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hs, heq⟩ := hcompare r hr
  have hpositive : 0 < ∑ i, w i := by rw [hs]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hwi⟩ := (sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)).mp hpositive
  have href : (2 / π) * (log (n + 2 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
      interpolationGapPeak n t 0 := by
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, w i * ((2 / π) * (log (n + 2 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π))) := by
        rw [← sum_mul, hs, one_mul]
      _ < _ := sum_lt_sum
        (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlower j).le (hw j))
        ⟨i, hi, mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hlower i) hwi⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, has, heu⟩ := hcompare u hu
  have hpeak : ∀ i, interpolationGapPeak n u i ≤
      lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (canonicalIntervalNodes n u) := by
    intro i
    exact lebesgueConstant_subset_le _
      (Icc_subset_Icc (canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc hu i.castSucc).1
        (canonicalIntervalNodes_mem_Icc hu i.succ).2)
  apply href.trans_le
  rw [heu]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, a i * lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (canonicalIntervalNodes n u) :=
      sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpeak i) (ha i))
    _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul, has, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_ordered_add_two
statement:
theorem logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_ordered_add_two {n : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (hv : StrictMono v) (hvI : ∀ j, v j ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (2 / π) * (log (n + 2 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
      lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 0 < n
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hnorm⟩ := exists_canonical_nodes_le_lebesgueConstant v hv hvI
    exact (logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_canonical hn ht).trans_le hnorm
  · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
    subst n
    have hone : 1 ≤ lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) v :=
      (one_le_lebesgueFunction v hv.injective 0).trans
        (lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant v (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    exact logarithmic_interpolation_lower_two_lt_one.trans_le hone

name: NLAlib.logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_ordered
statement:
theorem logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_ordered {n : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hv : StrictMono v) (hvI : ∀ j, v j ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (2 / π) * (log (n + 1 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
      lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) v
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    have hone : 1 ≤ lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) v :=
      (one_le_lebesgueFunction v hv.injective 0).trans
        (lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant v (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    simpa using logarithmic_interpolation_lower_one_lt_one.trans_le hone
  | succ n => exact logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_ordered_add_two v hv hvI

name: NLAlib.lebesgueConstant_logarithmic_and_equispaced_lower_bounds
statement:
theorem lebesgueConstant_logarithmic_and_equispaced_lower_bounds :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ), StrictMono v →
      (∀ j, v j ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      (2 / π) * (log (n + 1 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
        lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) v) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n / (4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) <
        lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => -1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / n))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ v hv hvI => logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueConstant_ordered v hv hvI,
    fun _ hn => pow_two_div_four_mul_sq_lt_lebesgueConstant_equispaced hn⟩

name: NLAlib.degree_lobattoCardinal_le
statement: theorem degree_lobattoCardinal_le (n j : ℕ) : (lobattoCardinal n j).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
  refine (degree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
  · refine (degree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · exact (show (1 : ℝ[X]).degree ≤ n by simp)
    · apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans
      apply Finset.sup_le
      intro k hk
      apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
      rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
      exact_mod_cast (show k + 1 ≤ n by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega)
  · apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
    rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]

name: NLAlib.eval_lobattoCardinal_cos
statement:
theorem eval_lobattoCardinal_cos (n j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (lobattoCardinal n j).eval (cos t) = lobattoEndpointWeight n j *
      (lobattoKernel n (t - j * π / n) + lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lobattoCardinal, eval_smul, eval_add, eval_one, eval_finsetSum,
    smul_eq_mul, T_real_cos, Int.cast_natCast]
  dsimp [lobattoKernel]
  simp only [mul_sub, mul_add, cos_sub, cos_add]
  have hsum : ∀ k : ℕ,
      2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n)) * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * t) =
      cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * t) * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n)) +
        sin ((k + 1 : ℕ) * t) * sin ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n)) +
      (cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * t) * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n)) -
        sin ((k + 1 : ℕ) * t) * sin ((k + 1 : ℕ) * (j * π / n))) := by
    intro k; ring
  simp_rw [hsum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: NLAlib.kernel_grid_sub
statement:
private theorem kernel_grid_sub {n i j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    lobattoKernel n ((i : ℝ) * π / n - j * π / n) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hij
  · simp [hij, lobattoKernel_zero hn]
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
    · have hd : j - i < 2 * n := by omega
      have hd0 : 0 < j - i := by omega
      rw [show (i : ℝ) * π / n - j * π / n = -((j - i : ℕ) * π / n) by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]; ring, lobattoKernel_neg]
      exact lobattoKernel_grid_zero hn hd0 hd
    · rw [show (i : ℝ) * π / n - j * π / n = (i - j : ℕ) * π / n by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hgt.le]; ring]
      exact lobattoKernel_grid_zero hn (by omega) (by omega)

name: NLAlib.kernel_grid_add
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  by_cases hz : i + j = 0
  · have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
    have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
    simp [hi0, hj0, lobattoKernel_zero hn]
  by_cases htop : i + j = 2 * n
  · have hin : i = n := by omega
    have hjn : j = n := by omega
    have ha : (n : ℝ) * π / n + n * π / n = 2 * π := by field_simp; ring
    rw [hin, hjn, ha]
    simpa only [zero_add, lobattoKernel_zero hn, true_and, or_true, ite_true] using lobattoKernel_periodic n 0
  · rw [show (i : ℝ) * π / n + j * π / n = (i + j : ℕ) * π / n by push_cast; ring,
      lobattoKernel_grid_zero hn (by omega) (by omega)]
    have hne : ¬(i = j ∧ (j = 0 ∨ j = n)) := by
      rintro ⟨hij, h0 | hn'⟩ <;> omega
    simp [hne]

name: NLAlib.eval_lobattoCardinal_node
statement:
theorem eval_lobattoCardinal_node {n i j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    (lobattoCardinal n j).eval (node n i) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [node, eval_lobattoCardinal_cos, kernel_grid_sub hn hi hj, kernel_grid_add hn hi hj]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · rw [if_pos hij]
    simp only [hij, true_and, lobattoEndpointWeight]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.lobattoCardinal_eq_basis
statement:
theorem lobattoCardinal_eq_basis {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    lobattoCardinal n j = Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (node n) j
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq (range (n + 1)) (chebyshev_node_injOn n)
  · exact (degree_lobattoCardinal_le n j).trans_lt (by rw [card_range]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  · rw [Lagrange.degree_basis (chebyshev_node_injOn n) (by simpa using hj), card_range]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n
  · intro i hi
    rw [eval_lobattoCardinal_node hn (by simpa using hi) hj]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst i
      exact (Lagrange.eval_basis_self (chebyshev_node_injOn n) hi).symm
    · exact (Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne (Ne.symm hij) hi).symm

name: NLAlib.injective_chebyshev_extrema_fin
statement:
theorem injective_chebyshev_extrema_fin (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => node n j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  exact chebyshev_node_injOn n (by simpa using i.isLt) (by simpa using j.isLt) hij

name: NLAlib.lobattoCardinal_eq_basis_fin
statement:
theorem lobattoCardinal_eq_basis_fin {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    lobattoCardinal n j = Lagrange.basis univ (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => node n i) j
proof:
:= by
  have hv := (injective_chebyshev_extrema_fin n).injOn (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))))
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq univ hv
  · exact (degree_lobattoCardinal_le n j).trans_lt (by simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  · rw [Lagrange.degree_basis hv (mem_univ j), card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (show n + 1 - 1 < n + 1 by omega)
  · intro i hi
    rw [eval_lobattoCardinal_node hn (by omega) (by omega)]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl, Lagrange.eval_basis_self hv (mem_univ j)]
    · rw [if_neg (by exact fun h => hij (Fin.ext h))]
      exact (Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne (v := fun i : Fin (n + 1) => node n i) (Ne.symm hij) hi).symm

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_pos (n : ℕ) :
    0 < reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n
proof:
:= by
  have ha := reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_gt_two n
  exact (div_pos zero_lt_one (by positivity)).trans_le
    (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound n)

name: NLAlib.tendsto_log_reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_div_nat
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 0 < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  convert Real.tendsto_log_affine_nat_div_nat
    (show 0 < 4*Real.log 3 by positivity) (4*Real.log 3+Real.log 4) using 1
  funext n
  congr 2
  dsimp [reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff]
  ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_log_reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_div_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_div_nat :
    Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n)/(n:ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (-Real.log 3))
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    -(Real.log 6/(n:ℝ)+(1/2:ℝ)*(Real.log (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n)/(n:ℝ))) -
      Real.log 3
  let U : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.log (Real.sqrt (40/21))/(n:ℝ)-Real.log 3
  have hL : Tendsto L atTop (𝓝 (-Real.log 3)) := by
    simpa only [L, add_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero, zero_sub] using
      ((tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (Real.log 6)).add
        (tendsto_log_reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_div_nat.const_mul (1/2:ℝ))).neg.sub_const
          (Real.log 3)
  have hU : Tendsto U atTop (𝓝 (-Real.log 3)) := by
    simpa only [U, zero_sub] using
      (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (Real.log (Real.sqrt (40/21)))).sub_const
        (Real.log 3)
  have hlo : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L n ≤
      Real.log (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n)/(n:ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    have hn0 : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show n≠0 by omega)
    have ha : 0 < reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n :=
      (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2).trans (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_gt_two n)
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity :
      0 < 1/(6*Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n)*3^n))
      (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound n)
    rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_one,
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_sqrt ha.le,
      Real.log_pow] at h
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    dsimp [L]
    convert! hdiv using 1
    field_simp
    ring
  have hhi : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n)/(n:ℝ) ≤ U n := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    have hn0 : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show n≠0 by omega)
    have h := Real.log_le_log (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_pos n)
      (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_le_geometric_upper_bound n)
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow] at h
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    dsimp [U]
    convert! hdiv using 1
    field_simp
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hL hU hlo hhi

name: NLAlib.tendsto_rpow_reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_inv_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_rpow_reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_inv_nat :
    Tendsto (fun n => (reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n) ^ (1/(n:ℝ)))
      atTop (𝓝 (1/3:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.tendsto_rpow_inv_nat_of_log_div_tendsto reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_pos
    tendsto_log_reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_div_nat
  simpa only [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3), one_div] using h

name: NLAlib.sawtoothError_ne_zero_of_between_grid
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hleft := sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc (n := n) (j := j) (by omega)
  have hright := sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc (n := n) (j := j + 1) (by omega)
  have hg := mem_sawtoothZeroGrid_of_sawtoothError_eq_zero
    ⟨hleft.1.trans ht.1.le, ht.2.le.trans hright.2⟩ hzero
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkt⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg
  rw [← hkt] at ht
  have h1 := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).lt_iff_lt.mp ht.1
  have h2 := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).lt_iff_lt.mp ht.2
  omega

name: NLAlib.mul_sawtoothError_pos_of_pos_on_cell
statement:
theorem mul_sawtoothError_pos_of_pos_on_cell {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) {s x y : ℝ}
    (hs : s ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n j) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)))
    (hy : y ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n j) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)))
    (hpos : 0 < s * sawtoothError n x) : 0 < s * sawtoothError n y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hn : s * sawtoothError n y ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hc : Continuous (fun t => s * sawtoothError n t) :=
    continuous_const.mul (continuous_sawtoothError n)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzero⟩ := isPreconnected_Ioo.intermediate_value hy hx hc.continuousOn ⟨hn, hpos.le⟩
  exact mul_ne_zero hs (sawtoothError_ne_zero_of_between_grid hj hz) hzero

name: NLAlib.sawtoothError_pos_on_first_cell
statement:
theorem sawtoothError_pos_on_first_cell (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n 0) (sawtoothGridAngle n 1)) : 0 < sawtoothError n t
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by simpa [sawtoothGridAngle] using ht.1
  by_contra hnot
  have hn : sawtoothError n t ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have h0 : sawtoothError n 0 = Real.pi := by simp [sawtoothError]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzero⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' ht0.le (continuous_sawtoothError n).continuousOn
    (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (sawtoothError n t) (sawtoothError n 0) by rw [h0]; exact ⟨hn, Real.pi_pos.le⟩)
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hz.1 with hzeq | hzeq
    · rw [← hzeq, h0] at hzero
      exact (Real.pi_ne_zero hzero).elim
    · exact hzeq
  have hcell : z ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n 0) (sawtoothGridAngle n 1) :=
    ⟨by simpa [sawtoothGridAngle] using hzpos, hz.2.trans_lt ht.2⟩
  exact sawtoothError_ne_zero_of_between_grid (Nat.zero_le n) hcell hzero

name: NLAlib.mul_sawtoothError_pos_on_grid_cell
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ∀ t ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n j) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)),
      0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * sawtoothError n t := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro hj t ht
      simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul] using sawtoothError_pos_on_first_cell n ht
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj t ht
      by_contra hnot
      let s := (-1 : ℝ) ^ j
      have hs : s ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      have hsame : 0 < s * sawtoothError n t := by
        have hnn : s * sawtoothError n t ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hs (sawtoothError_ne_zero_of_between_grid hj ht)
        have hle := le_of_not_gt hnot
        rw [pow_succ] at hle
        have hge : 0 ≤ s * sawtoothError n t := by dsimp [s]; nlinarith
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm hnn)
      have hnew : ∀ y ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 2)),
          0 < s * sawtoothError n y :=
        fun y hy => mul_sawtoothError_pos_of_pos_on_cell hj hs ht hy hsame
      have hnode : sawtoothError n (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)) = 0 :=
        sawtoothError_grid_eq_zero (by omega) (by omega)
      have hlocal : IsLocalMin (fun y => s * sawtoothError n y) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)) := by
        change ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)),
          s * sawtoothError n (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)) ≤ s * sawtoothError n y
        refine Filter.mem_of_superset (Ioo_mem_nhds
          (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n (show j < j + 1 by omega))
          (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n (show j + 1 < j + 2 by omega))) ?_
        intro y hy
        rw [hnode, mul_zero]
        rcases lt_trichotomy y (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)) with hleft | rfl | hright
        · exact (ih (by omega) y ⟨hy.1, hleft⟩).le
        · simp [hnode]
        · exact (hnew y ⟨hright, hy.2⟩).le
      have hder := (hasDerivAt_sawtoothError n (sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1))).const_mul s
      have hzero := hlocal.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hder
      exact mul_ne_zero hs (neg_ne_zero.mpr (eval_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_grid_ne_zero (by omega))) hzero
  exact hall j hj t ht

name: NLAlib.abs_sawtoothError_eq_mul_on_grid_cell
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_of_pos (mul_sawtoothError_pos_on_grid_cell n j hj ht)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_neg_one_pow, one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.sawtoothApprox_two_pi_sub
statement:
theorem sawtoothApprox_two_pi_sub (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    sawtoothApprox n (2 * Real.pi - t) = -sawtoothApprox n t
proof:
:= by
  simp [sawtoothApprox, sin_two_pi_sub, cos_two_pi_sub]

name: NLAlib.sawtoothError_two_pi_sub
statement:
theorem sawtoothError_two_pi_sub (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    sawtoothError n (2 * Real.pi - t) = -sawtoothError n t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sawtoothError
  rw [sawtoothApprox_two_pi_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.degree_le_zero_of_uniform_exp_neg_error
statement:
theorem degree_le_zero_of_uniform_exp_neg_error {p : ℝ[X]} {E : ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x) - p.eval x| ≤ E) : p.degree ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (p.isBoundedUnder_abs_atTop_iff).mp
  refine ⟨E + 1, eventually_map.mpr ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
  have h := abs_le.mp (hE x hx)
  have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-x)
  have hle : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 := by simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.one_half_le_uniform_exp_neg_error
statement:
theorem one_half_le_uniform_exp_neg_error {p : ℝ[X]} {E : ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x) - p.eval x| ≤ E) : 1 / 2 ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  have hp := p.eq_C_of_degree_le_zero (degree_le_zero_of_uniform_exp_neg_error hE)
  have h0 := hE 0 le_rfl
  rw [hp] at h0
  simp only [eval_C, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero] at h0
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => |Real.exp (-x) - p.coeff 0|) atTop
      (𝓝 |p.coeff 0|) := by
    have h := (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot).sub_const (p.coeff 0)
    simpa using h.abs
  have hc : |p.coeff 0| ≤ E := le_of_tendsto hlim (by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
    have hb := hE x hx
    rw [hp, eval_C] at hb
    exact hb)
  have h0' := (abs_le.mp h0).2
  have hc' := (abs_le.mp hc).2
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_neg_sub_one_half_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_neg_sub_one_half_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (-x) - 1 / 2| ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-x)
  have hle : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 := by simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.isLeast_uniform_polynomial_exp_neg_error
statement:
theorem isLeast_uniform_polynomial_exp_neg_error (n : ℕ) :
    IsLeast {E : ℝ | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x) - p.eval x| ≤ E} (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨C (1 / 2), ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact degree_C_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n)
  · simpa only [eval_C] using fun x hx => abs_exp_neg_sub_one_half_le hx
  · rintro E ⟨p, _, hE⟩
    exact one_half_le_uniform_exp_neg_error hE

name: NLAlib.one_half_le_uniform_exp_error_negative_halfLine
statement:
theorem one_half_le_uniform_exp_error_negative_halfLine {p : ℝ[X]} {E : ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → |Real.exp x - p.eval x| ≤ E) : 1/2 ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  apply one_half_le_uniform_exp_neg_error (p := p.comp (-X))
  intro x hx
  simpa only [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X] using hE (-x) (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)

name: NLAlib.isLeast_uniform_polynomial_exp_error_negative_halfLine
statement:
theorem isLeast_uniform_polynomial_exp_error_negative_halfLine (n : ℕ) :
    IsLeast {E : ℝ | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → |Real.exp x - p.eval x| ≤ E} (1/2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨C (1/2), degree_C_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    simpa only [neg_neg, eval_C] using abs_exp_neg_sub_one_half_le (neg_nonneg.mpr hx)
  · rintro E ⟨p, _, hE⟩
    exact one_half_le_uniform_exp_error_negative_halfLine hE

name: NLAlib.degree_rational_difference_numerator_le
statement:
theorem degree_rational_difference_numerator_le {s : Set ℝ} {m n : ℕ}
    (r u : RatFunc ℝ) (hu : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation s m n u) :
    (if r = 0 then u.num else u.num * r.denom - r.num * u.denom).degree ≤
      rationalAlternationDegree m n r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · simp only [hr0, if_pos, rationalAlternationDegree]
    exact hu.1
  · simp only [rationalAlternationDegree, if_neg hr0]
    apply (degree_sub_le _ _).trans
    apply max_le
    · calc
        (u.num * r.denom).degree ≤ u.num.degree + r.denom.degree := degree_mul_le _ _
        _ ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ) + r.denom.natDegree := add_le_add hu.1 degree_le_natDegree
        _ ≤ ↑(max (m + r.denom.natDegree) (n + r.num.natDegree)) := by
          norm_cast; exact le_max_left _ _
    · calc
        (r.num * u.denom).degree ≤ r.num.degree + u.denom.degree := degree_mul_le _ _
        _ ≤ (r.num.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) + n := add_le_add degree_le_natDegree hu.2.1
        _ ≤ ↑(max (m + r.denom.natDegree) (n + r.num.natDegree)) := by
          norm_cast; omega

name: NLAlib.ratFunc_eq_of_difference_numerator_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ratFunc_eq_of_difference_numerator_eq_zero (r u : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hzero : (if r = 0 then u.num else u.num * r.denom - r.num * u.denom) = 0) : u = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · rw [if_pos hr0] at hzero
    exact (RatFunc.num_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero).trans hr0.symm
  · rw [if_neg hr0] at hzero
    have heq := (RatFunc.num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff (RatFunc.denom_ne_zero r)).mp
      (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero)
    exact heq.trans (RatFunc.num_div_denom r)

name: NLAlib.difference_numerator_eval_eq_zero_of_rationalContinuousMap_eq
statement:
theorem difference_numerator_eval_eq_zero_of_rationalContinuousMap_eq {s : Set ℝ}
    (r u : RatFunc ℝ) (hr : ∀ x ∈ s, r.denom.eval x ≠ 0)
    (hu : ∀ x ∈ s, u.denom.eval x ≠ 0) (x : s)
    (heq : rationalContinuousMap s u hu x = rationalContinuousMap s r hr x) :
    (if r = 0 then u.num else u.num * r.denom - r.num * u.denom).eval (x : ℝ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · rw [if_pos hr0]
    have hval : u.num.eval (x : ℝ) / u.denom.eval (x : ℝ) = 0 := by
      simpa [rationalContinuousMap, hr0] using heq
    exact (div_eq_zero_iff).mp hval |>.resolve_right (hu x x.property)
  · rw [if_neg hr0, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_mul]
    change u.num.eval (x : ℝ) / u.denom.eval (x : ℝ) =
      r.num.eval (x : ℝ) / r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) at heq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr ((div_eq_div_iff (hu x x.property) (hr x x.property)).mp heq)

name: NLAlib.exists_abs_sub_rationalContinuousMap_ge_of_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_abs_sub_rationalContinuousMap_ge_of_alternation {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    {v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b}
    (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)))
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.succ)) < 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ∀ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)|)
    (u : RatFunc ℝ) (hu : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n u) :
    ∃ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 (v i)|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  by_contra! hbeat
  let g := rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2
  let gg : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM g
  have hgv : ∀ i, gg (v i) = g (v i) := fun i =>
    ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem (v i).property
  have hgsign : ∀ i : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 1),
      gg (v i.castSucc) * gg (v i.succ) < 0 := by
    intro i
    have hi := mul_sub_mul_sub_neg_of_abs_lt (hsign i)
      ((hbeat i.castSucc).trans_le (hε i.castSucc))
      ((hbeat i.succ).trans_le (hε i.succ))
    simpa only [hgv, g, ContinuousMap.sub_apply, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left] using hi
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hczero⟩ := exists_strictMono_eq_zero_of_mul_neg hv
    gg.continuous.continuousOn hgsign
  let H := if r = 0 then u.num else u.num * r.denom - r.num * u.denom
  have hH : H.degree ≤ rationalAlternationDegree m n r :=
    degree_rational_difference_numerator_le r u hu
  have hHzero : H = 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero
      (s := Finset.univ) (v := c) hc.injective.injOn
    · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hH.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self (rationalAlternationDegree m n r))
    · intro i _
      have hcI : c i ∈ Icc a b :=
        ⟨(v i.castSucc).property.1.trans (hczero i).1.1.le,
          (hczero i).1.2.le.trans (v i.succ).property.2⟩
      have hzero := (hczero i).2
      rw [ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem hcI] at hzero
      have heq : rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 ⟨c i, hcI⟩ =
          rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 ⟨c i, hcI⟩ := sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
      exact difference_numerator_eval_eq_zero_of_rationalContinuousMap_eq r u hr.2.2 hu.2.2 _ heq
  have hur := ratFunc_eq_of_difference_numerator_eq_zero r u hHzero
  subst u
  exact not_lt_of_ge (hε 0) (hbeat 0)

name: NLAlib.le_rationalMinimaxError_of_alternation
statement:
theorem le_rationalMinimaxError_of_alternation {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ}
    (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    {v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b}
    (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)))
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.succ)) < 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ∀ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)|) :
    ε ≤ rationalMinimaxError m n f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError hab m n f
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_abs_sub_rationalContinuousMap_ge_of_alternation hab f r hr hv hsign hε u hu
  exact hi.trans (by
    simpa [hbest] using (f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2).norm_coe_le_norm (v i))

name: NLAlib.abs_inv_sub_inv_le_of_relative_error
statement:
private theorem abs_inv_sub_inv_le_of_relative_error {f h δ : ℝ}
    (hf : 0 < f) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (herr : |f-h| ≤ δ*f^2) (hsmall : δ*f ≤ 1/2) :
    |f⁻¹-h⁻¹| ≤ 2*δ
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : f/2 ≤ h := by
    have habs := le_abs_self (f-h)
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hf.le
    nlinarith
  have heq : |f⁻¹-h⁻¹| = |f-h|/(f*h) := by
    rw [show f⁻¹-h⁻¹ = -(f-h)/(f*h) by field_simp; ring]
    rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hf, abs_of_pos hh]
  rw [heq, div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hf hh)]
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf (mul_nonneg hδ hf.le)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_neg_quarter_sub_inv_eval_le_of_value_bound
statement:
theorem abs_exp_neg_quarter_sub_inv_eval_le_of_value_bound
    (p : ℝ[X]) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < 1/2)
    (hp : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 0 < p.eval x)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn p.eval (Ici 0))
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      |Real.exp (x/4)-p.eval x| ≤ δ*Real.exp (x/2))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (-x/4) - (p.eval x)⁻¹| ≤ 4*δ
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := -4*Real.log (2*δ)
  have h2δ : 0 < 2*δ := by positivity
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    have := Real.log_neg h2δ (by linarith : 2*δ < 1)
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  have hea : Real.exp (a/4) = (2*δ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [show a/4 = -Real.log (2*δ) by dsimp [a]; ring,
      Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log h2δ]
  have heneg (y : ℝ) : Real.exp (-y/4) = (Real.exp (y/4))⁻¹ := by
    rw [show -y/4 = -(y/4) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
  have hehalf (y : ℝ) : Real.exp (y/2) = (Real.exp (y/4))^2 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hlocal (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hya : y ≤ a) :
      |Real.exp (-y/4)-(p.eval y)⁻¹| ≤ 2*δ := by
    rw [heneg]
    apply abs_inv_sub_inv_le_of_relative_error (Real.exp_pos _) (hp y hy) hδ.le
    · simpa only [hehalf] using herr y hy
    · have hle : Real.exp (y/4) ≤ (2*δ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← hea]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hδ.le
      have heq : δ*(2*δ)⁻¹ = (1/2:ℝ) := by field_simp
      rwa [heq] at this
  by_cases hxa : x ≤ a
  · exact (hlocal x hx hxa).trans (by linarith)
  · have hax : a ≤ x := le_of_not_ge hxa
    have haerror := herr a ha.le
    rw [hehalf, hea] at haerror
    have haabs := le_abs_self ((2*δ)⁻¹-p.eval a)
    have hhalf : (2*δ)⁻¹/2 ≤ p.eval a := by
      have hid : δ*((2*δ)⁻¹)^2 = (2*δ)⁻¹/2 := by field_simp
      rw [hid] at haerror
      linarith
    have hpa : (2*δ)⁻¹/2 ≤ p.eval x :=
      hhalf.trans (hmono ha.le hx hax)
    have hinv : (p.eval x)⁻¹ ≤ 4*δ := by
      have hid : ((2*δ)⁻¹/2)⁻¹ = 4*δ := by field_simp; ring
      rw [← hid]
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ (hp x hx) (by positivity)).mpr hpa
    have he : Real.exp (-x/4) ≤ 2*δ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-a/4) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = 2*δ := by rw [heneg, hea, inv_inv]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by have := Real.exp_pos (-x/4); linarith,
      by have := inv_pos.mpr (hp x hx); linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.natDegree_reciprocalExponentialDenominator
statement:
@[simp] theorem natDegree_reciprocalExponentialDenominator (n : ℕ) :
    (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n=0
  · simp [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, hn]
  · rw [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, if_neg hn, natDegree_comp,
      natDegree_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator,
      natDegree_C_mul (by norm_num : (4:ℝ) ≠ 0), natDegree_X, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialDenominator_eval_pos (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 < (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n=0
  · simp [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, hn]
  · simp only [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, if_neg hn, eval_comp, eval_mul,
      eval_C, eval_X]
    exact (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_halfLine (by omega)
      (show 0 ≤ 4*x by positivity)).1

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialDenominator_derivative_eval_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialDenominator_derivative_eval_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 < (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, if_neg (by omega : n≠0),
    derivative_comp, derivative_mul, derivative_C, derivative_X, zero_mul,
    zero_add, mul_one, eval_mul, eval_comp, eval_C, eval_X]
  exact mul_pos (by norm_num) ((doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_halfLine hn
    (show 0 ≤ 4*x by positivity)).2)

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialDenominator_strictMonoOn_halfLine
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialDenominator_strictMonoOn_halfLine {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) :
    StrictMonoOn (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval (Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_pos (convex_Ici _)
    (reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).continuous.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => ((reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).hasDerivAt x).hasDerivWithinAt)
  intro x hx
  exact reciprocalExponentialDenominator_derivative_eval_pos hn (interior_subset hx)

name: NLAlib.four_smoothingValueConstant_eq
statement:
private theorem four_smoothingValueConstant_eq :
    4 * Real.sqrt (5/42) = Real.sqrt (40/21)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 5/42)
  have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 40/21)
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (5/42), Real.sqrt_nonneg (40/21)]

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (-x)-((reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x)⁻¹| ≤
      Real.sqrt (40/21) / 3^n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n=0
  · simp only [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, hn, if_true, eval_one,
      inv_one, pow_zero, div_one]
    have he : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 := by
      simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)
    have hs : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (40/21) := by
      have := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 40/21)
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (40/21)]
    exact (abs_le.mpr ⟨by have := Real.exp_pos (-x); linarith, by linarith⟩).trans hs
  · let δ : ℝ := Real.sqrt (5/42) / 3^n
    have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
    have hδsmall : δ < 1/2 := by
      have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3^n := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have hs : Real.sqrt (5/42) < 1/2 := by
        have := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 5/42)
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (5/42)]
      have hle : δ ≤ Real.sqrt (5/42) := by
        dsimp [δ]
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 3^n)).mpr
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (5/42)]
      exact hle.trans_lt hs
    have h := abs_exp_neg_quarter_sub_inv_eval_le_of_value_bound
      (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n) hδ hδsmall
      (fun t ht => (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_halfLine (by omega) ht).1)
      (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_monotoneOn_halfLine (by omega))
      (fun t ht => abs_exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le n ht)
      (show 0 ≤ 4*x by positivity)
    have hrhs : 4*δ = Real.sqrt (40/21)/3^n := by
      dsimp [δ]
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, four_smoothingValueConstant_eq]
    rw [hrhs, show -(4*x)/4 = -x by ring] at h
    simpa only [reciprocalExponentialDenominator, if_neg hn, eval_comp, eval_mul,
      eval_C, eval_X] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le_sqrt_two
statement:
theorem abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le_sqrt_two (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (-x)-((reciprocalExponentialDenominator n).eval x)⁻¹| ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 / 3^n
proof:
:= by
  apply (abs_exp_neg_sub_inv_reciprocalExponentialDenominator_le n hx).trans
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by norm_num)) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.not_forall_eval_mul_eval_neg_of_degree_le
proof:
:= by
  intro hsign
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hczero⟩ := exists_strictMono_eq_zero_of_mul_neg hv
    p.continuous.continuousOn hsign
  have hpzero : p = 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero
      (s := Finset.univ) (v := c) hc.injective.injOn
    · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    · intro i _; exact (hczero i).2
  simpa [hpzero] using hsign 0

name: NLAlib.exists_abs_sub_eval_ge_of_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_abs_sub_eval_ge_of_alternation {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ)) < 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ∀ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - p.eval (v i)|)
    (q : ℝ[X]) (hq : q.degree ≤ n) :
    ∃ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - q.eval (v i)|
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hbeat
  have hd : (q - p).degree ≤ n := (degree_sub_le q p).trans (max_le hq hp)
  apply not_forall_eval_mul_eval_neg_of_degree_le hd hv
  intro i
  have hi := mul_sub_mul_sub_neg_of_abs_lt (hsign i)
    ((hbeat i.castSucc).trans_le (hε i.castSucc))
    ((hbeat i.succ).trans_le (hε i.succ))
  simpa only [eval_sub, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left] using hi

name: NLAlib.le_minimaxError_of_alternation
statement:
theorem le_minimaxError_of_alternation {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(s, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {v : Fin (n + 2) → s}
    (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)))
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ : ℝ)) < 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ∀ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ)|) :
    ε ≤ minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => if hx : x ∈ s then f ⟨x, hx⟩ else 0
  have hgv : ∀ i, g (v i) = f (v i) := by intro i; simp [g, (v i).property]
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hbest⟩ := exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError n f
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_abs_sub_eval_ge_of_alternation g hp hv
    (by simpa only [hgv] using hsign) (by simpa only [hgv] using hε) q hq
  rw [hgv] at hi
  have hnorm := (f - q.toContinuousMapOn s).norm_coe_le_norm (v i)
  rw [hbest] at hnorm
  exact hi.trans hnorm

name: NLAlib.shifted_rate_density_eq
statement:
private theorem shifted_rate_density_eq (s x t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-s*(t-x)) * Real.exp t = Real.exp (s*x) * Real.exp ((1-s)*t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_shifted_rate_density
statement:
private theorem integrableOn_shifted_rate_density {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-s*(t-x)) * Real.exp t) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [shifted_rate_density_eq]
  exact (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 1-s < 0) x).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_shifted_rate_density
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [shifted_rate_density_eq]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 1-s < 0)]
  have hc : -Real.exp ((1-s)*x)/(1-s) = Real.exp ((1-s)*x)/(s-1) := by
    field_simp [show 1-s ≠ 0 by linarith, show s-1 ≠ 0 by linarith]
    ring
  rw [hc, ← mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: NLAlib.two_rate_sq_density
statement:
private theorem two_rate_sq_density (A B x t : ℝ) :
    (A*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + B*Real.exp (-4*(t-x)))^2 * Real.exp t =
      A^2 * (Real.exp (-(3/2)*(t-x)) * Real.exp t) +
      (2*A*B) * (Real.exp (-(19/4)*(t-x)) * Real.exp t) +
      B^2 * (Real.exp (-8*(t-x)) * Real.exp t)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)))^2 = Real.exp (-(3/2)*(t-x)) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hb : (Real.exp (-4*(t-x)))^2 = Real.exp (-8*(t-x)) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hab : Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) * Real.exp (-4*(t-x)) =
      Real.exp (-(19/4)*(t-x)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  calc
    _ = A^2 * ((Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)))^2 * Real.exp t) +
      (2*A*B) * ((Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) * Real.exp (-4*(t-x))) * Real.exp t) +
      B^2 * ((Real.exp (-4*(t-x)))^2 * Real.exp t) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [ha, hab, hb]

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_two_rate_sq_density
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [two_rate_sq_density]
  exact (((integrableOn_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : 1 < (3:ℝ)/2) x).const_mul _).add
    ((integrableOn_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : 1 < (19:ℝ)/4) x).const_mul _)).add
    ((integrableOn_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 8) x).const_mul _)

name: NLAlib.integral_two_rate_sq_density
statement:
private theorem integral_two_rate_sq_density (A B x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x,
      (A*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + B*Real.exp (-4*(t-x)))^2 * Real.exp t) =
      Real.exp x * (2*A^2 + (8/15)*A*B + (1/7)*B^2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [two_rate_sq_density]
  have hA := (integrableOn_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : 1 < (3:ℝ)/2) x).const_mul (A^2)
  have hAB := (integrableOn_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : 1 < (19:ℝ)/4) x).const_mul (2*A*B)
  have hB := (integrableOn_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 8) x).const_mul (B^2)
  have hadd := integral_add (hA.add hAB) hB
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hadd
  rw [hadd, integral_add hA hAB]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : 1 < (3:ℝ)/2),
    integral_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : 1 < (19:ℝ)/4),
    integral_shifted_rate_density (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 8)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_exponentialSmoothingKernel_sq
statement:
theorem integrableOn_exponentialSmoothingKernel_sq (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (exponentialSmoothingKernel (t-x))^2 * Real.exp t) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
    ((integrableOn_two_rate_sq_density 1 (-1) x).const_mul ((15/26 : ℝ)^2))
    ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  dsimp [exponentialSmoothingKernel]
  ring

theorem integrableOn_exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel_sq (x : ℝ) :

proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
    ((integrableOn_two_rate_sq_density (3/4) (-4) x).const_mul ((15/26 : ℝ)^2))
    ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  dsimp [exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_exponentialSmoothingKernel_sq
statement:
theorem integral_exponentialSmoothingKernel_sq (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, (exponentialSmoothingKernel (t-x))^2 * Real.exp t) =
      (15/28)*Real.exp x
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => (exponentialSmoothingKernel (t-x))^2 * Real.exp t) =
      (fun t : ℝ => (15/26 : ℝ)^2 *
        ((1*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + (-1)*Real.exp (-4*(t-x)))^2 * Real.exp t)) := by
    funext t
    dsimp [exponentialSmoothingKernel]

name: NLAlib.integral_exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel_sq
statement:

proof:

      (fun t : ℝ => (15/26 : ℝ)^2 *

    funext t
    dsimp [exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel]
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_const_mul, integral_two_rate_sq_density]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_interpolate_eq_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_interpolate_eq_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → Ioo a b, StrictMono (fun i => (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩ = p.eval (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i => (c i : ℝ))
        (fun i => f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩) = p
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  by_cases hE : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = 0
  · have hden : (0 : ℝ) < n + 2 := by positivity
    let c : Fin (n + 1) → Ioo a b := fun i =>
      ⟨a + (b - a) * ((i : ℕ) + 1) / (n + 2), by
        have hinum : (0 : ℝ) < (i : ℕ) + 1 := by positivity
        have hi : ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) < n + 2 := by exact_mod_cast (show (i : ℕ) + 1 < n + 2 by omega)
        constructor
        · exact lt_add_of_pos_right a (div_pos (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) hinum) hden)
        · have hpart : (b - a) * ((i : ℕ) + 1) / (n + 2) < b - a :=
            (div_lt_iff₀ hden).mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hi (sub_pos.mpr hab))
          linarith⟩
    have hval : ∀ i, f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩ = p.eval (c i : ℝ) := by
      intro i
      have hzero := norm_eq_zero.mp hE
      have hi := congrArg (fun g : C(Icc a b, ℝ) =>
        g ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩) hzero
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hi
    have hc : StrictMono (fun i => (c i : ℝ)) := by
      intro i j hij
      have hijR : ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) < (j : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (show (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ) + 1 by omega)
      have hdiv := div_lt_div_of_pos_right
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hijR (sub_pos.mpr hab)) hden
      dsimp [c]; linarith
    refine ⟨c, hc, hval, ?_⟩
    apply (Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ hc.injective.injOn ?_ ?_).symm
    · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    · intro i _; exact (hval i).symm
  · have hEpos := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hE)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, _, hsign⟩ :=
      exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError hab f hp hbest hEpos
    let g : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM f
    have hgv : ∀ i, g (v i) = f (v i) := fun i =>
      ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem (v i).property
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcI, hcval, hcinterp⟩ := exists_interpolate_eq_of_alternation g
      g.continuous.continuousOn hp hv (fun i => (v i).property)
      (by simpa only [hgv] using hsign)
    let w : Fin (n + 1) → Ioo a b := fun i => ⟨c i, hcI i⟩
    have hgval : ∀ i, g (c i) = f ⟨w i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (w i).property⟩ :=
      fun i => ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hcI i))
    refine ⟨w, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i; rw [← hgval]; exact hcval i
    · simpa only [Function.comp_def, hgval] using hcinterp

name: NLAlib.phase_cot_pair_le
statement:
private theorem phase_cot_pair_le {h u α : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhπ : h ≤ π / 2)
    (hu : h / 2 ≤ u) (huπ : u ≤ π / 2) (hα : α ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    sin (π * α) * (Real.cot (u + h * (α - 1 / 2)) +
      Real.cot (u - h * (α - 1 / 2))) ≤ 2 * Real.cot u
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (1 / 2 : ℝ) α with ha | ha
  · have hs : α - 1 / 2 ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) := by constructor <;> linarith [hα.2]
    have hsin : sin (π * α) = cos (π * (α - 1 / 2)) := by
      rw [show π * α = π * (α - 1 / 2) + π / 2 by ring, sin_add_pi_div_two]
    rw [hsin]
    exact cos_mul_cot_pair_le hh hhπ hu huπ hs
  · have hs : 1 / 2 - α ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) := by constructor <;> linarith [hα.1]
    have hsin : sin (π * α) = cos (π * (1 / 2 - α)) := by
      rw [show π * (1 / 2 - α) = -(π * (α - 1 / 2)) by ring, cos_neg,
        ← sin_add_pi_div_two]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hsin, show α - 1 / 2 = -(1 / 2 - α) by ring, mul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm]
    exact cos_mul_cot_pair_le hh hhπ hu huπ hs

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernelSum_phase_le
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℝ := π / (2 * n)
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hh : 0 < h := by dsimp [h]; positivity
  have hhπ : h ≤ π / 2 := by dsimp [h]; rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * n)]; nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hnh : (n : ℝ) * h = π / 2 := by dsimp [h]; field_simp
  have hpair : ∀ j ∈ range n, sin (π * α) *
      (Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + α) * π / (2 * n)) +
        Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 - α) * π / (2 * n))) ≤
      2 * Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * n)) := by
    intro j hj
    have hjn : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast mem_range.mp hj
    have hu : h / 2 ≤ ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h := by nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ j by positivity]
    have huπ : ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h ≤ π / 2 := by nlinarith
    have hb := phase_cot_pair_le hh hhπ hu huπ hα
    have heq1 : ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h + h * (α - 1 / 2) = ((j : ℝ) + α) * π / (2 * n) := by dsimp [h]; ring
    have heq2 : ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h - h * (α - 1 / 2) = ((j : ℝ) + 1 - α) * π / (2 * n) := by dsimp [h]; ring
    rw [heq1, heq2] at hb
    simpa only [h, mul_div_assoc] using hb
  have hsum := sum_le_sum hpair
  simp only [← mul_sum] at hsum
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (show 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * n : ℝ) by positivity)
  rw [lobattoKernelSum_phase hn hα]
  dsimp [lobattoCotangentConstant]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc] at hb
  have hl : (1 / (2 * n) : ℝ) * sin (π * α) = sin (π * α) / (2 * n) := by ring
  have hr : (1 / (2 * n) : ℝ) * 2 = 1 / n := by ring
  rw [hl, hr] at hb
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernelSum_le_log
statement:
theorem lobattoKernelSum_le_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    lobattoKernelSum n t ≤ 1 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := (lobattoKernelSum_periodic hn).exists_mem_Ico₀
    (show 0 < π / n by positivity) t
  rw [heq]
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · rw [hy0, lobattoKernelSum_zero hn]
    have hlog : 0 ≤ log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := log_nonneg (by
      have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := by positivity
      linarith)
    have hpos : 0 ≤ (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hlog
    linarith
  let α : ℝ := y * n / π
  have hα : α ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · exact div_pos (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne hy.1 (Ne.symm hy0)) hn0) pi_pos
    · dsimp [α]
      rw [div_lt_one pi_pos, ← lt_div_iff₀ hn0]
      exact hy.2
  have hangle : α * π / n = y := by dsimp [α]; field_simp
  rw [← hangle]
  exact (lobattoKernelSum_phase_le hn hα).trans (lobattoCotangentConstant_le_log hn)

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_nonneg
statement: theorem lebesgueFunction_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ lebesgueFunction v x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.one_le_lebesgueFunction
statement:
theorem one_le_lebesgueFunction [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (x : ℝ) : 1 ≤ lebesgueFunction v x
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval x)
    (Lagrange.sum_basis hv.injOn (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).Nonempty))
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_one] at hsum
  calc
    1 = |∑ j, (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ v j).eval x| := by rw [hsum]; norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _

name: NLAlib.lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (v : ι → ℝ)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hbound : ∀ x ∈ s, lebesgueFunction v x ≤ L) :
    lebesgueConstant s v ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueConstant
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ hL).mpr
  intro x
  change |lebesgueFunction v (x : ℝ)| ≤ L
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (lebesgueFunction_nonneg _ _)]
  exact hbound x x.property

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (v : ι → ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    lebesgueFunction v x ≤ lebesgueConstant s v
proof:
:= by
  let g : C(s, ℝ) := ⟨fun x : s => lebesgueFunction v x,
    by unfold lebesgueFunction; fun_prop⟩
  exact g.apply_le_norm ⟨x, hx⟩

name: NLAlib.interpolationLinearMap_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem interpolationLinearMap_apply_eq_sum {s : Set ℝ} (v : ι → s)
    (f : C(s, ℝ)) (x : s) :
    interpolationLinearMap s v f x =
      ∑ i, f (v i) * (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) i).eval (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolationLinearMap_apply, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum]

name: NLAlib.abs_interpolationLinearMap_apply_le
statement:
theorem abs_interpolationLinearMap_apply_le {s : Set ℝ} (v : ι → s)
    (f : C(s, ℝ)) (x : s) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, |f (v i)| ≤ M) :
    |interpolationLinearMap s v f x| ≤ lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) x * M
proof:
:= by
  rw [interpolationLinearMap_apply_eq_sum]
  calc
    |∑ i, f (v i) * (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) i).eval (x : ℝ)| ≤
        ∑ i, |f (v i) * (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) i).eval (x : ℝ)| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |(Lagrange.basis Finset.univ (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) i).eval (x : ℝ)| * M := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) x * M := by
      rw [lebesgueFunction, Finset.sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.norm_interpolationLinearMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_interpolationLinearMap_le {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (v : ι → s) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    ‖interpolationLinearMap s v f‖ ≤ lebesgueConstant s (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mpr
  intro x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact (abs_interpolationLinearMap_apply_le v f x ‖f‖
    (fun i => f.norm_coe_le_norm (v i))).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ x.property)
        (norm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.interpolationOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem interpolationOperator_apply {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (v : ι → s) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    interpolationOperator v f = interpolationLinearMap s v f
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_le_one_interpolation_apply_eq_lebesgueFunction
statement:
theorem exists_norm_le_one_interpolation_apply_eq_lebesgueFunction
    {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (v : ι → s) (hv : Function.Injective v) (x : s) :
    ∃ f : C(s, ℝ), ‖f‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      interpolationLinearMap s v f x = lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  let w : ι → ℝ := fun i => (v i : ℝ)
  have hw : Function.Injective w := fun i j h => hv (Subtype.ext h)
  let d : ι → ℝ := fun i => if (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ w i).eval (x : ℝ) < 0 then -1 else 1
  let p : ℝ[X] := Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ w d
  let f : C(s, ℝ) := ⟨fun y => max (-1) (min 1 (p.eval y)), by fun_prop⟩
  have hd : ∀ i, d i = -1 ∨ d i = 1 := by
    intro i; dsimp [d]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hnode : ∀ i, f (v i) = d i := by
    intro i
    have heval : p.eval (v i : ℝ) = d i :=
      Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ hw.injOn (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp only [f, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, heval]
    rcases hd i with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mpr
    intro y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    exact ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  · rw [interpolationLinearMap_apply_eq_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [hnode]
    dsimp [d, w]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [abs_of_neg h]; ring
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt h), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.norm_interpolationOperator_eq_lebesgueConstant
statement:
theorem norm_interpolationOperator_eq_lebesgueConstant {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (v : ι → s) (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    ‖interpolationOperator v‖ = lebesgueConstant s (fun i => (v i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
      (norm_interpolationLinearMap_le v)
  · let g : C(s, ℝ) := ⟨fun x : s => lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) x,
      by unfold lebesgueFunction; fun_prop⟩
    change ‖g‖ ≤ ‖interpolationOperator v‖
    apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le g (norm_nonneg (interpolationOperator v))).mpr
    intro x
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfx⟩ := exists_norm_le_one_interpolation_apply_eq_lebesgueFunction v hv x
    change ‖lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) (x : ℝ)‖ ≤ ‖interpolationOperator v‖
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (lebesgueFunction_nonneg _ _)]
    calc
      lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) x = interpolationOperator v f x := hfx.symm
      _ ≤ ‖interpolationOperator v f‖ := (interpolationOperator v f).apply_le_norm x
      _ ≤ ‖interpolationOperator v‖ * ‖f‖ := (interpolationOperator v).le_opNorm f
      _ ≤ ‖interpolationOperator v‖ := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf (norm_nonneg (interpolationOperator v))

name: NLAlib.one_le_lebesgueConstant
statement:
theorem one_le_lebesgueConstant {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] [Nonempty ι]
    (v : ι → s) (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    1 ≤ lebesgueConstant s (fun i => (v i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let i := Classical.arbitrary ι
  have hw : Function.Injective (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) := fun i j h => hv (Subtype.ext h)
  have hsum := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval (v i : ℝ))
    (Lagrange.sum_basis hw.injOn (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).Nonempty))
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_one] at hsum
  calc
    1 = |∑ j, (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) j).eval (v i : ℝ)| := by
      rw [hsum]; norm_num
    _ ≤ lebesgueFunction (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) (v i) := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ lebesgueConstant s (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) :=
      lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ (v i).property

name: NLAlib.interpolationLinearMap_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem interpolationLinearMap_eq_of_mem {s : Set ℝ} [Nonempty ι]
    (v : ι → s) (hv : Function.Injective v) {f : C(s, ℝ)}
    (hf : f ∈ polynomialApproximationSpace s (Fintype.card ι - 1)) :
    interpolationLinearMap s v f = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mp hf
  have hw : Function.Injective (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) := fun i j h => hv (Subtype.ext h)
  rw [interpolationLinearMap_apply]
  congr 1
  apply (Lagrange.eq_interpolate hw.injOn ?_).symm
  have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card ι := Fintype.card_pos
  exact hp.trans_lt (by simp only [Finset.card_univ]; exact_mod_cast Nat.pred_lt hcard.ne')

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_interpolationLinearMap_le_minimaxError
statement:
theorem norm_sub_interpolationLinearMap_le_minimaxError {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → s) (hv : Function.Injective v) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    ‖f - interpolationLinearMap s v f‖ ≤
      (1 + lebesgueConstant s (fun i => (v i : ℝ))) * minimaxError (Fintype.card ι - 1) f
proof:
:=
  norm_sub_projection_le_minimaxError _ _ _
    (fun _ hp => interpolationLinearMap_eq_of_mem v hv hp)
    (norm_interpolationLinearMap_le v) f

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a c : ℝ}
    {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a c,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hca : 0 < c - a := sub_pos.mpr hac
  let ℓ : NNReal := ⟨(c - a) / 2, by positivity⟩
  let m : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2
  have hmap : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, m t ∈ Icc a c := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp [m]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.1 hca.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.2 hca.le]
  have hLip : LipschitzOnWith (L * ℓ) (fun t => f (m t)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x hx y hy
    have hdist : dist (m x) (m y) = (c - a) / 2 * dist x y := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
      have heq : m x - m y = ((c - a) / 2) * (x - y) := by dsimp [m]; ring
      rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (c - a) / 2)]
    have h := hf.dist_le_mul (m x) (hmap x hx) (m y) (hmap y hy)
    rw [hdist] at h
    change dist (f (m x)) (f (m y)) ≤ ((L : ℝ) * ((c - a) / 2)) * dist x y
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hE⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_unit hLip n
  let s : ℝ[X] := C (2 / (c - a)) * X - C ((c + a) / (c - a))
  refine ⟨p.comp s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
    refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
    have hpN := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp
    have hs : s.natDegree ≤ 1 := by
      refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
      · exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans natDegree_X_le
      · simp
    nlinarith
  · intro x hx
    let t := 2 / (c - a) * x - (c + a) / (c - a)
    have ht : t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have htform : t = (2 * x - c - a) / (c - a) := by dsimp [t]; ring
      rw [htform]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hca]
        nlinarith [hx.1]
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hca]
        nlinarith [hx.2]
    have heq : m t = x := by
      dsimp [m, t]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hca]
      ring
    have h := hE t ht
    rw [heq] at h
    have hrate : Real.pi * ((L * ℓ : NNReal) : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1)) =
        Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * (n + 1)) := by
      change Real.pi * ((L : ℝ) * ((c - a) / 2)) / (2 * (n + 1)) = _
      field_simp
      norm_num
    rw [hrate] at h
    simpa only [eval_comp, s, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, t] using h

name: NLAlib.jacksonSquareWaveCircle_coe_eq
statement:
theorem jacksonSquareWaveCircle_coe_eq (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = Real.sign (Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacksonSquareWaveCircle, im_fourier_nat_coe_eq_sin]

name: NLAlib.measurable_jacksonSquareWaveCircle
statement: theorem measurable_jacksonSquareWaveCircle (N : ℕ) : Measurable (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => (fourier (N : ℤ) t).im) :=
    Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp (fourier (N : ℤ)).continuous.measurable
  unfold jacksonSquareWaveCircle Real.sign
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt hm measurable_const) measurable_const
    (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hm) measurable_const measurable_const)

name: NLAlib.abs_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_le_one (N : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    |jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold jacksonSquareWaveCircle
  rcases Real.sign_apply_eq (fourier (N : ℤ) t).im with h | h | h <;>
    rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.integrable_jacksonSquareWaveCircle
statement:
theorem integrable_jacksonSquareWaveCircle (N : ℕ) :
    Integrable (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N) AddCircle.haarAddCircle
proof:
:= by
  have hm : MemLp (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N) 1 AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    MemLp.of_bound (measurable_jacksonSquareWaveCircle N).aestronglyMeasurable 1
      (ae_of_all _ fun t => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using abs_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_le_one N t)
  exact hm.integrable le_rfl

name: NLAlib.jacksonSquareWaveCircle_add_div_period
statement:
theorem jacksonSquareWaveCircle_add_div_period (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t + ((2 * Real.pi / N : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) =
      jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacksonSquareWaveCircle, fourier_apply_add, fourier_nat_div_period_eq_one N hN, mul_one]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.fourierCoeff_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_eq_zero {N k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hkN : k < N) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let a : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) := (2 * Real.pi / N : ℝ)
  let f : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℂ := fun t =>
    fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t • (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t : ℂ)
  have hc : fourier (-(k : ℤ)) a ≠ 1 := by
    rw [fourier_neg]
    intro heq
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) heq
    exact fourier_nat_div_period_ne_one hk hkN (by simpa [a] using h)
  have hshift : ∀ t, f (t + a) = fourier (-(k : ℤ)) a * f t := by
    intro t
    change fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (t + a) * (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t + a) : ℂ) =
      fourier (-(k : ℤ)) a * (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t * (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t : ℂ))
    rw [fourier_apply_add, jacksonSquareWaveCircle_add_div_period N (hk.trans hkN)]
    ring
  have h := MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self f a (μ := AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
  simp_rw [hshift] at h
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul] at h
  change fourier (-(k : ℤ)) a * fourierCoeff (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) =>
    (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ) =
    fourierCoeff (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ) at h
  have hzero : (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) a - 1) *
      fourierCoeff (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ) = 0 := by
    linear_combination h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hc)

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_fourier_mul_jacksonSquareWaveCircle
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_fourier_mul_jacksonSquareWaveCircle (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => fourier k (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
      (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  apply (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le).mpr
  have hc : Measurable (fun t : ℝ => fourier k (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) :=
    ((fourier k).continuous.comp (by fun_prop)).measurable
  have hs : Measurable (fun t : ℝ => (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp ((measurable_jacksonSquareWaveCircle N).comp (by fun_prop))
  apply Integrable.of_bound (hc.mul hs).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
    change ‖fourier k (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
      (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1
    rw [norm_mul, show ‖fourier k (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))‖ = 1 from Circle.norm_coe _, one_mul]
    simpa [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      abs_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_le_one N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_sign_sin
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_sign_sin (N : ℕ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.sign (Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * t))) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegrable_fourier_mul_jacksonSquareWaveCircle N 0
  have hreal : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      (fourier 0 (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
        (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)).re)
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp h.1, Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp h.2⟩
  simpa only [fourier_zero, one_mul, Complex.ofReal_re, jacksonSquareWaveCircle_coe_eq] using hreal

name: NLAlib.integral_sign_sin_mul_sin_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_sign_sin_mul_sin_eq_zero {N k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hkN : k < N) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, Real.sign (Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * t)) * Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * t)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
    (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)
  have hcoef := fourierCoeff_jacksonSquareWaveCircle_eq_zero hk hkN
  rw [fourierCoeff_eq_intervalIntegral _ _ 0, zero_add] at hcoef
  simp only [Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hcoef
  have hfactor : (((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by positivity : (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  have hInt : (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, f t) = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoef).resolve_left hfactor
  have hf := intervalIntegrable_fourier_mul_jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (-(k : ℤ))
  have hproj := Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hf
  change (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, (f t).im) = (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, f t).im at hproj
  rw [hInt, Complex.zero_im] at hproj
  have hterm : ∀ t : ℝ, (f t).im =
      -(Real.sign (Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * t)) * Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * t)) := by
    intro t
    change (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
      (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)).im = _
    rw [fourier_neg]
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.conj_im,
      im_fourier_nat_coe_eq_sin, jacksonSquareWaveCircle_coe_eq, mul_zero, zero_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at hproj
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hproj
  exact neg_eq_zero.mp hproj

name: NLAlib.strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle
statement: theorem strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle (n : ℕ) : StrictMono (sawtoothGridAngle n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  unfold sawtoothGridAngle
  exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by exact_mod_cast hij) Real.pi_pos)
    (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n + 1) :
    sawtoothGridAngle n j ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold sawtoothGridAngle; positivity
  · have h := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).monotone hj
    have hlast : sawtoothGridAngle n (n + 1) = Real.pi := by
      unfold sawtoothGridAngle
      push_cast
      field_simp
    rwa [hlast] at h

name: NLAlib.sawtoothError_grid_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sawtoothError_grid_eq_zero {n j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hj : j ≤ n + 1) :
    sawtoothError n (sawtoothGridAngle n j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hj with rfl | hj
  · have hlast : sawtoothGridAngle n (n + 1) = Real.pi := by
      unfold sawtoothGridAngle
      push_cast
      field_simp
    simp [sawtoothError, hlast]
  · have hidx : j - 1 + 1 = j := by omega
    have h := sawtoothApprox_grid_eq (n := n) (j := j - 1) (by omega)
    rw [hidx] at h
    unfold sawtoothError sawtoothGridAngle
    rw [h]
    ring

name: NLAlib.continuous_sawtoothError
statement: theorem continuous_sawtoothError (n : ℕ) : Continuous (sawtoothError n)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => (hasDerivAt_sawtoothError n t).continuousAt)

name: NLAlib.exists_sawtoothCriticalPoint
statement:
theorem exists_sawtoothCriticalPoint (n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n (j.val + 1)) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j.val + 2)),
      (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlt := strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n (show j.val + 1 < j.val + 2 by omega)
  have hzero1 := sawtoothError_grid_eq_zero (n := n) (j := j.val + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hzero2 := sawtoothError_grid_eq_zero (n := n) (j := j.val + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hder⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero hlt (continuous_sawtoothError n).continuousOn
    (hzero1.trans hzero2.symm) (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_sawtoothError n t)
  exact ⟨t, ht, neg_eq_zero.mp hder⟩

name: NLAlib.sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec
statement:
theorem sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec (n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    sawtoothCriticalPoint n j ∈ Ioo (sawtoothGridAngle n (j.val + 1)) (sawtoothGridAngle n (j.val + 2)) ∧
      (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos (sawtoothCriticalPoint n j)) = 0
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_sawtoothCriticalPoint n j)

name: NLAlib.sawtoothCriticalPoint_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem sawtoothCriticalPoint_mem_Ioo (n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    sawtoothCriticalPoint n j ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have h := (sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec n j).1
  have h1 := sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc (n := n) (j := j.val + 1) (by omega)
  have h2 := sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc (n := n) (j := j.val + 2) (by omega)
  exact ⟨h1.1.trans_lt h.1, h.2.trans_le h2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.strictMono_sawtoothCriticalPoint
statement: theorem strictMono_sawtoothCriticalPoint (n : ℕ) : StrictMono (sawtoothCriticalPoint n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hi := (sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec n i).1.2
  have hj := (sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec n j).1.1
  have hm := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).monotone (show i.val + 2 ≤ j.val + 1 by
    have hh : i.val < j.val := hij
    omega)
  exact hi.trans_le hm |>.trans hj

name: NLAlib.injective_cos_sawtoothCriticalPoint
statement:
theorem injective_cos_sawtoothCriticalPoint (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : Fin n => cos (sawtoothCriticalPoint n j))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : StrictAnti (fun j : Fin n => cos (sawtoothCriticalPoint n j)) := by
    intro i j hij
    have hi := sawtoothCriticalPoint_mem_Ioo n i
    have hj := sawtoothCriticalPoint_mem_Ioo n j
    exact strictAntiOn_cos ⟨hi.1.le, hi.2.le⟩ ⟨hj.1.le, hj.2.le⟩
      (strictMono_sawtoothCriticalPoint n hij)
  exact ha.injective

name: NLAlib.card_sawtoothCriticalCosines
statement: theorem card_sawtoothCriticalCosines (n : ℕ) : (sawtoothCriticalCosines n).card = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sawtoothCriticalCosines, card_image_of_injective _ (injective_cos_sawtoothCriticalPoint n)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sawtoothCriticalCosines_subset_roots
statement:
theorem sawtoothCriticalCosines_subset_roots (n : ℕ) :
    sawtoothCriticalCosines n ⊆ (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).roots.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
  rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_ne_zero n)]
  exact (sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec n j).2

name: NLAlib.sawtoothCriticalCosines_eq_roots
statement:
theorem sawtoothCriticalCosines_eq_roots (n : ℕ) :
    sawtoothCriticalCosines n = (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).roots.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (sawtoothCriticalCosines_subset_roots n)
  have h1 := Multiset.toFinset_card_le (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).roots
  have h2 := Polynomial.card_roots' (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n)
  have h3 := natDegree_le_of_degree_le (degree_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_le n)
  rw [card_sawtoothCriticalCosines]
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: NLAlib.exists_sawtoothCriticalPoint_eq_of_eval_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hr : cos t ∈ (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).roots.toFinset := by
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_ne_zero n)]
    exact hroot
  rw [← sawtoothCriticalCosines_eq_roots, sawtoothCriticalCosines] at hr
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hcos⟩ := mem_image.mp hr
  have hj' := sawtoothCriticalPoint_mem_Ioo n j
  exact ⟨j, strictAntiOn_cos.injOn ht ⟨hj'.1.le, hj'.2.le⟩ hcos.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_grid_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_grid_ne_zero {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n + 1) :
    (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos (sawtoothGridAngle n j)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_sawtoothCriticalPoint_eq_of_eval_eq_zero (sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc hj) hzero
  have hpoint := (sawtoothCriticalPoint_spec n i).1
  rw [← hi] at hpoint
  have h1 := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).lt_iff_lt.mp hpoint.1
  have h2 := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).lt_iff_lt.mp hpoint.2
  omega

name: NLAlib.card_sawtoothCriticalAngles
statement: theorem card_sawtoothCriticalAngles (n : ℕ) : (sawtoothCriticalAngles n).card = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sawtoothCriticalAngles, card_image_of_injective _ (strictMono_sawtoothCriticalPoint n).injective]
  simp

name: NLAlib.card_le_succ_of_sawtoothError_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : s.card ≤ (sawtoothCriticalAngles n \ s).card + 1 := by
    apply Finset.card_le_sdiff_of_interleaved
    intro x hx y hy hxy _
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hd⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero hxy (continuous_sawtoothError n).continuousOn
      ((hz x hx).trans (hz y hy).symm) (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_sawtoothError n t)
    have ht' : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := ⟨(hs x hx).1.trans ht.1.le, ht.2.le.trans (hs y hy).2⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_sawtoothCriticalPoint_eq_of_eval_eq_zero ht' (neg_eq_zero.mp hd)
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ht⟩
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨j, mem_univ _, hj.symm⟩
  have hdiff := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.sdiff_subset : sawtoothCriticalAngles n \ s ⊆ sawtoothCriticalAngles n)
  rw [card_sawtoothCriticalAngles] at hdiff
  omega

name: NLAlib.card_sawtoothZeroGrid
statement: theorem card_sawtoothZeroGrid (n : ℕ) : (sawtoothZeroGrid n).card = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j => sawtoothGridAngle n (j + 1)) := by
    intro i j hij
    have h := (strictMono_sawtoothGridAngle n).injective hij
    omega
  rw [sawtoothZeroGrid, card_image_of_injective _ hinj, card_range]

name: NLAlib.mem_sawtoothZeroGrid_of_sawtoothError_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_sawtoothZeroGrid_of_sawtoothError_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) (hz : sawtoothError n t = 0) : t ∈ sawtoothZeroGrid n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hcard := card_le_succ_of_sawtoothError_eq_zero (s := insert t (sawtoothZeroGrid n))
    (fun z hz' => by
      rcases mem_insert.mp hz' with rfl | hgrid
      · exact ht
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hgrid
        exact sawtoothGridAngle_mem_Icc (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega))
    (fun z hz' => by
      rcases mem_insert.mp hz' with rfl | hgrid
      · exact hz
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hgrid
        exact sawtoothError_grid_eq_zero (by omega) (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega))
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnot, card_sawtoothZeroGrid] at hcard
  omega
