name: NLAlib.exists_expQuarterWeightedError_minimizer
statement:
theorem exists_expQuarterWeightedError_minimizer {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n ∧
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n → expQuarterWeightedError a q ≤ expQuarterWeightedError a p) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, a ≤ x →
        0 < q.eval x ∧ q.eval x ≤ Real.exp (x/4) ∧ 0 ≤ q.derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hbest⟩ :=
    exists_degree_le_weighted_norm_sub_minimal n (expQuarterOn a) (expHalfWeightOn a)
  have hw : ∀ x : Icc 0 a, 0 < expHalfWeightOn a x := fun x => Real.exp_pos _
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hval, _⟩ := exists_interpolate_eq_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal
    ha (expQuarterOn a) (expHalfWeightOn a) hw hq hbest
  refine ⟨q, hq, hbest, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have h := eval_pos_le_exp_and_derivative_nonneg_of_interpolation hq hc
    (by norm_num : 0 < (1:ℝ)/4) (fun i => (c i).property)
    (by intro i; simpa [expQuarterOn, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using (hval i).symm) hx
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.expQuarterWeightedError_le_iff
statement:
private theorem expQuarterWeightedError_le_iff {a : ℝ}
    (p : ℝ[X]) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
    expQuarterWeightedError a p ≤ E ↔
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ a →
        |Real.exp (-x/2) * (Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x)| ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  unfold expQuarterWeightedError
  rw [ContinuousMap.norm_le _ hE]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx hxa
    exact h ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩
  · intro h x
    exact h x x.property.1 x.property.2

name: NLAlib.reciprocal_polynomial_pos
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_polynomial_pos {p : ℝ[X]} {E : ℝ} (hE : E < 1)
    (hpole : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → p.eval x ≠ 0)
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x/4) - (p.eval x)⁻¹| ≤ E) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 0 < p.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (abs_le.mp (herr 0 le_rfl)).2
  simp only [neg_zero, zero_div, Real.exp_zero] at h0
  have hinv : 0 < (p.eval 0)⁻¹ := by linarith
  have hp0 : 0 < p.eval 0 := inv_pos.mp hinv
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hpx : p.eval x < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hnot) (hpole x hx)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hx p.continuous.continuousOn
    ⟨hpx.le, hp0.le⟩
  exact hpole y hy.1 hy0

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_quarter_sub_eval_le_of_reciprocal_error
statement:
private theorem abs_exp_quarter_sub_eval_le_of_reciprocal_error
    {p : ℝ[X]} {E a x : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hp : 0 < p.eval x)
    (hxa : x ≤ a)
    (hsmall : E * Real.exp (a/4) < 1/2)
    (herr : |Real.exp (-x/4) - (p.eval x)⁻¹| ≤ E) :
    |Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x| ≤ 2*E*Real.exp (x/2)
proof:
:= by
  let f := Real.exp (x/4)
  have hf : 0 < f := Real.exp_pos _
  have hsmallx : E*f < 1/2 := lt_of_le_of_lt
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) hE) hsmall
  have hexp : Real.exp (-x/4) = f⁻¹ := by
    rw [show -x/4 = -(x/4) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
  rw [hexp] at herr
  have hlower := (abs_le.mp herr).2
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlower (mul_pos hf hp).le
  have hc1 : f⁻¹ * (f * p.eval x) = p.eval x := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hf.ne', one_mul]
  have hc2 : (p.eval x)⁻¹ * (f * p.eval x) = f := by
    rw [mul_comm f, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp.ne', one_mul]
  rw [sub_mul, hc1, hc2] at hm
  have hsmallmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmallx.le hp.le
  have hpf : p.eval x ≤ 2*f := by nlinarith
  have hinv : f⁻¹ - (p.eval x)⁻¹ = (p.eval x - f) / (f*p.eval x) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hinv, abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hf hp)] at herr
  have habs := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hf hp)).mp herr
  have hright := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpf (mul_nonneg hE hf.le)
  have hsq : f^2 = Real.exp (x/2) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [abs_sub_comm]
  calc
    |p.eval x - f| ≤ E * (f*p.eval x) := habs
    _ ≤ 2*E*f^2 := by nlinarith
    _ = 2*E*Real.exp (x/2) := by rw [hsq]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_le
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_le {a M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : expQuarterWeightedError a q ≤ M)
    (htail : ∀ x : ℝ, a ≤ x → 0 < q.eval x ∧ q.eval x ≤ Real.exp (x/4)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) ≤
      a*M^2 + 2*Real.exp (-a/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hweighted := (expQuarterWeightedError_le_iff q hM).mp hq
  have hsq := integrableOn_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg q
  have hIoc := hsq.mono_set (show Ioc 0 a ⊆ Ioi 0 from Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)
  have hIoi := hsq.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi ha.le)
  have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => M^2) (Ioc 0 a) :=
    integrableOn_const (by simp)
  have hleft : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioc 0 a,
      (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) ≤ a*M^2 := by
    have h := setIntegral_mono_on hIoc hconst measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => by
      have hw := hweighted x hx.1.le hx.2
      have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hM).mpr hw
      have hexp : (Real.exp (-x/2))^2 = Real.exp (-x) := by
        rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [sq_abs, mul_pow, hexp] at hs
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hs)
    simpa only [setIntegral_const, measureReal_def, Real.volume_Ioc,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ha.le, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] using h
  have hexpInt : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-x/2)) (Ioi a) := by
    convert! integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-1/2 : ℝ) < 0) a using 1
    funext x
    congr 1
    ring
  have hright : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi a,
      (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) ≤ 2*Real.exp (-a/2) := by
    have h := setIntegral_mono_on hIoi hexpInt measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨hpos, hle⟩ := htail x hx.le
      have hf := Real.exp_pos (x/4)
      have hs : (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 ≤ (Real.exp (x/4))^2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr hle) hf.le).mpr (by linarith)
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (Real.exp_pos (-x)).le
      have he : (Real.exp (x/4))^2 * Real.exp (-x) = Real.exp (-x/2) := by
        rw [pow_two, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      rwa [he] at hm)
    have hint : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi a, Real.exp (-x/2)) = 2*Real.exp (-a/2) := by
      have heq : (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-x/2)) = (fun x => Real.exp ((-1/2)*x)) := by
        funext x
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [heq, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-1/2 : ℝ) < 0)]
      rw [show (-1/2 : ℝ)*a = -a/2 by ring]
      ring
    rwa [hint] at h
  have hsplit : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) =
      (∫ x : ℝ in Ioc 0 a, (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) +
        ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi a, (Real.exp (x/4) - q.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x) := by
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi ha.le]
    exact setIntegral_union
      (disjoint_left.mpr (fun x hx hy => not_lt_of_ge hx.2 hy))
      measurableSet_Ioi hIoc hIoi
  rw [hsplit]
  exact add_le_add hleft hright

name: NLAlib.laguerreResidual_le_reciprocal_error_truncation_bound
statement:
theorem laguerreResidual_le_reciprocal_error_truncation_bound
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {a E : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hpole : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → p.eval x ≠ 0)
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x/4) - (p.eval x)⁻¹| ≤ E)
    (hsmall : E*Real.exp (a/4) < 1/2) :
    2 / 3^(2*n+2) ≤ 4*a*E^2 + 2*Real.exp (-a/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := (abs_nonneg _).trans (herr 0 le_rfl)
  have hExp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (a/4) := Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity)
  have hE1 : E < 1 := by have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hExp hE; nlinarith
  have hpos := reciprocal_polynomial_pos hE1 hpole herr
  have hpweighted : expQuarterWeightedError a p ≤ 2*E := by
    apply (expQuarterWeightedError_le_iff p (by positivity)).mpr
    intro x hx hxa
    have habs := abs_exp_quarter_sub_eval_le_of_reciprocal_error hE (hpos x hx)
      hxa hsmall (herr x hx)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have he : Real.exp (-x/2) * Real.exp (x/2) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, show -x/2+x/2 = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-x/2) * (2*E*Real.exp (x/2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = 2*E * (Real.exp (-x/2) * Real.exp (x/2)) := by ring
      _ = 2*E := by rw [he, mul_one]
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hmin, htail⟩ := exists_expQuarterWeightedError_minimizer ha n
  have hqweighted := (hmin p hp).trans hpweighted
  have hupper := integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_le ha (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*E)
    hqweighted (fun x hx => ⟨(htail x hx).1, (htail x hx).2.1⟩)
  have hlower := laguerreResidual_le_integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq hq
  have h := hlower.trans hupper
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_gt_two
statement:
theorem reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_gt_two (n : ℕ) :
    2 < reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 1 < Real.log 3 :=
    (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num)).mpr Real.exp_one_lt_three
  have h4 : 0 < Real.log 4 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  dsimp [reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exp_half_reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff
statement:
private theorem exp_half_reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff (n : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n / 2) = 2 * (3 : ℝ)^(2*n+2)
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : Real.exp (Real.log 4 / 2) = 2 := by
    have hs : (Real.exp (Real.log 4 / 2))^2 = 4 := by
      rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add, show Real.log 4/2+Real.log 4/2 = Real.log 4 by ring,
        Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (Real.log 4/2)]
  rw [show reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n / 2 =
      ((2*n+2 : ℕ) : ℝ)*Real.log 3 + Real.log 4/2 by
        dsimp [reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff]; push_cast; ring,
    Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num), h4, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.reciprocal_exp_quarter_error_ge_laguerre_lower_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocal_exp_quarter_error_ge_laguerre_lower_bound
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {E : ℝ}
    (hpole : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → p.eval x ≠ 0)
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x/4) - (p.eval x)⁻¹| ≤ E) :
    1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n) * 3^(n+1)) ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  let a := reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n
  have ha2 : 2 < a := reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff_gt_two n
  have ha : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := (abs_nonneg _).trans (herr 0 le_rfl)
  have hP : 0 < (3 : ℝ)^(n+1) := by positivity
  have hpow : (3 : ℝ)^(2*n+2) = ((3 : ℝ)^(n+1))^2 := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hexp : (Real.exp (a/4))^2 = 2 * ((3 : ℝ)^(n+1))^2 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add, show a/4+a/4 = a/2 by ring,
      exp_half_reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff, hpow]
  have htail : 2*Real.exp (-a/2) = 1 / (3 : ℝ)^(2*n+2) := by
    rw [show -a/2 = -(a/2) by ring, Real.exp_neg,
      exp_half_reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff]
    field_simp
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : E < 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt a * (3 : ℝ)^(n+1)) := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hden : 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt a * (3 : ℝ)^(n+1) := by positivity
  have hEprod := (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp hlt
  have hExpLt : Real.exp (a/4) < Real.sqrt a * (3 : ℝ)^(n+1) := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)).mp
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ha.le, hexp]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ha2 (sq_pos_of_pos hP)
  have hsmall : E*Real.exp (a/4) < 1/2 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hExpLt.le hE
    nlinarith
  have hGram := laguerreResidual_le_reciprocal_error_truncation_bound hp ha hpole herr hsmall
  rw [htail] at hGram
  have hE2 : E^2 < (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt a * (3 : ℝ)^(n+1)))^2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hE (by positivity)).mpr hlt
  have h4 : 4*a*E^2 < 1 / (3 : ℝ)^(2*n+2) := by
    calc
      _ < 4*a*(1 / (2 * Real.sqrt a * (3 : ℝ)^(n+1)))^2 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hE2 (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hpow]
        field_simp
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt ha.le]
        ring
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) / 3^(2*n+2) = 2 * (1 / 3^(2*n+2)) by ring] at hGram
  linarith

name: NLAlib.reciprocal_exp_neg_error_ge_geometric_lower_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocal_exp_neg_error_ge_geometric_lower_bound
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {E : ℝ}
    (hpole : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → p.eval x ≠ 0)
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → |Real.exp (-x) - (p.eval x)⁻¹| ≤ E) :
    1 / (6 * Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n) * 3^n) ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  let q := p.comp (C (1/4) * X)
  have hq : q.degree ≤ n := by
    apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
    have h := natDegree_comp_le (p := p) (q := C (1/4) * X)
    have hlin : (C (1/4 : ℝ) * X).natDegree = 1 := by
      rw [natDegree_C_mul (by norm_num), natDegree_X]
    rw [hlin, mul_one] at h
    exact h.trans (natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp)
  have heval (x : ℝ) : q.eval x = p.eval (x/4) := by
    simp only [q, eval_comp, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h := reciprocal_exp_quarter_error_ge_laguerre_lower_bound hq
    (by intro x hx; rw [heval]; exact hpole (x/4) (by positivity))
    (by intro x hx; rw [heval]; simpa [show -(x/4) = -x/4 by ring] using herr (x/4) (by positivity))
  have heq : 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n) * (3 : ℝ)^(n+1)) =
      1 / (6 * Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n) * (3 : ℝ)^n) := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    congr 1
    ring
  rwa [heq] at h

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_sum_smul_gapDirection_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  let d : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k.succAbove j).val * c j
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∑ j, c j • interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove j)
  have hdet := det_interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian_minor_ne_zero hn ht k
  have hdker : ((interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian n t).submatrix k.succAbove k.succAbove) *ᵥ d = 0 := by
    ext r
    let a := k.succAbove r
    have heval : p.eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t a) = 0 := by rw [show p = 0 from hc, eval_zero]
    change (∑ j, interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian n t a (k.succAbove j) * d j) = 0
    calc
      _ = (|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t) a| * (-1 : ℝ) ^ a.val) *
          p.eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t a) := by
        dsimp [p]
        rw [eval_finsetSum, mul_sum]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        simp only [interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian, d, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, pow_add]
        have hs : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (k.succAbove j).val) ^ 2 = 1 := by
          rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
          norm_num
        calc
          _ = (|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t) a| * (-1 : ℝ) ^ a.val) *
            (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (k.succAbove j).val) ^ 2) *
            (c j * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove j)).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t a)) := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hs, mul_one]
      _ = 0 := by rw [heval, mul_zero]
  have hd : d = 0 := Matrix.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hdet hdker
  ext j
  have h := congrFun hd j
  change (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k.succAbove j).val * c j = 0 at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))

name: NLAlib.degree_sum_smul_deleted_gapDirection_lt
proof:
:= by
  apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
  apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe n)).mpr
  intro j hj
  exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt (degree_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_lt hn ht _)

name: NLAlib.det_eval_gapDirection_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_eval_gapDirection_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    Matrix.det (fun r j : Fin n =>
      (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove j)).eval (v r)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hker⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∑ j, c j • interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove j)
  have hp : p = 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero univ hv.injOn
      (by simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using degree_sum_smul_deleted_gapDirection_lt hn ht k c)
    intro r hr
    have h := congrFun hker r
    simpa only [p, eval_finsetSum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.zero_apply, mul_comm] using h
  exact hc (eq_zero_of_sum_smul_gapDirection_eq_zero hn ht k c hp)

name: NLAlib.det_gapDirection_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_gapDirection_eval_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin n =>
      (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove i)).eval (v j)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := det_eval_gapDirection_ne_zero hn ht k v hv
  let M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := fun r j =>
    (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove j)).eval (v r)
  have htrans : M.transpose.det ≠ 0 := by rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact h
  exact htrans

name: NLAlib.cuspCosineMoment_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [cuspCosineMoment, integral_re_fourier_mul_comp_sub_eq_re_fourier_mul_coeff
    (continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf) (even_realChebyshevCircleFunction f)]
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf, if_neg hk.ne']
  ring

name: NLAlib.cuspCosineMoment_abs_even
statement:
private theorem cuspCosineMoment_abs_even {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * j) = - (2 / (Real.pi * (4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cuspCosineMoment_eq (by fun_prop) (by omega), re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos,
    show ((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2) = (j : ℝ) * Real.pi by push_cast; ring,
    Real.cos_nat_mul_pi, chebyshevCoeff_abs_even hj]
  have hpow : (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) = -1 := by
    rw [← pow_add, show j + (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 by omega, pow_add, pow_mul]
    simp
  calc _ = (4 / Real.pi / (4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / 2) *
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) := by ring
       _ = _ := by rw [hpow]; simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]; ring

name: NLAlib.cusp_integrable
proof:
:=
  ((Complex.continuous_re.comp (fourier (k : ℤ)).continuous).mul
    ((continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf).comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)

name: NLAlib.absoluteFejerDual_eq_sum
statement:
theorem absoluteFejerDual_eq_sum {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (K : ℕ) :
    absoluteFejerDual K f = (K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (K + 1),
      (cuspCosineMoment f (4 * K) + ∑ j ∈ range m,
        (cuspCosineMoment f (4 * K + 2 * (j + 1)) +
          cuspCosineMoment f (4 * K - 2 * (j + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let g : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℝ := fun t => realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t)
  let S : ℕ → AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℝ := fun m t =>
    (fourier ((4 * K : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * g t + ∑ j ∈ range m,
      ((fourier ((4 * K + 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * g t +
        (fourier ((4 * K - 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * g t)
  have hterm (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : modulatedFejerCircleKernel K t * g t =
      (K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (K + 1), S m t := by
    rw [modulatedFejerCircleKernel_eq_sum, mul_assoc, sum_mul]
    congr 1
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    simp only [S, add_mul, sum_mul]
  have hS (m : ℕ) : Integrable (S m) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    (cusp_integrable hf _).add (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j hj =>
      (cusp_integrable hf _).add (cusp_integrable hf _)))
  change (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), modulatedFejerCircleKernel K t * g t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = _
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun m hm => hS m)]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  dsimp only [S, g]
  have his : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => ∑ j ∈ range m,
      ((fourier ((4 * K + 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t) +
        (fourier ((4 * K - 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t)))
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j hj =>
        (cusp_integrable hf _).add (cusp_integrable hf _))
  rw [integral_add (cusp_integrable hf (4 * K)) his,
    integral_finsetSum (f := fun (j : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) =>
      (fourier ((4 * K + 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t) +
        (fourier ((4 * K - 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t))
      _ (fun j hj => (cusp_integrable hf _).add (cusp_integrable hf _))]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [integral_add (cusp_integrable hf _) (cusp_integrable hf _)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.absoluteFejerDual_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem absoluteFejerDual_eval_eq_zero {n K : ℕ} (hK : n < 2 * K)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) : absoluteFejerDual K p.eval = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmoment (k : ℕ) (hk : n < k) : cuspCosineMoment p.eval k = 0 := by
    rw [cuspCosineMoment_eq p.continuous.continuousOn (by omega),
      chebyshevCoeff_eval_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hp hk, mul_zero, zero_div]
  rw [absoluteFejerDual_eq_sum p.continuous.continuousOn]
  have hterm (m : ℕ) (hm : m ∈ range (K + 1)) :
      cuspCosineMoment p.eval (4 * K) + ∑ j ∈ range m,
        (cuspCosineMoment p.eval (4 * K + 2 * (j + 1)) +
          cuspCosineMoment p.eval (4 * K - 2 * (j + 1))) = 0 := by
    rw [hmoment _ (by omega)]
    apply zero_add _ |>.trans
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have := mem_range.mp hm
    have := mem_range.mp hj
    rw [hmoment _ (by omega), hmoment _ (by omega), add_zero]
  rw [sum_eq_zero hterm, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.abs_absoluteFejerDual_le
statement:
theorem abs_absoluteFejerDual_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (K : ℕ) {E : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f x| ≤ E) :
    |absoluteFejerDual K f| ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Continuous (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) =>
      realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t)) :=
    (continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf).comp (by fun_prop)
  have hi : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => |modulatedFejerCircleKernel K t *
      realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t)|) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    ((continuous_modulatedFejerCircleKernel K).mul hg).abs.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hF : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => fejerCircleKernel K (2 • t) * E)
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle := (((continuous_fejerCircleKernel K).comp (continuous_id.nsmul 2)).mul
    continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  apply (abs_integral_le_integral_abs).trans
  have hm := integral_mono hi hF (fun t => ?_)
  · rw [integral_mul_const, integral_fejerCircleKernel_two_nsmul_eq_one, one_mul] at hm
    exact hm
  · rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (abs_modulatedFejerCircleKernel_le K t)
      (hbound _ (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc _)) (abs_nonneg _) (fejerCircleKernel_nonneg _ _)

name: NLAlib.sum_one_add_two_mul
statement:
private theorem sum_one_add_two_mul (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ range N, (1 + 2 * (m : ℝ))) = (N : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

name: NLAlib.cuspCosineMoment_abs_even_le_neg
proof:
:= by
  rw [cuspCosineMoment_abs_even hj]
  apply neg_le_neg
  have hKR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hjR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hjKR : (j : ℝ) ≤ 3 * K := by exact_mod_cast hjK
  have hDj : 0 < Real.pi * (4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) :=
    mul_pos Real.pi_pos (by nlinarith)
  have hDK : 0 < 18 * Real.pi * (K : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hDK hDj).mpr
  have hsmall : 4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 ≤ 36 * (K : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall Real.pi_pos.le
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.div_le_neg_absoluteFejerDual_abs
statement:
theorem div_le_neg_absoluteFejerDual_abs {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (K + 1 : ℝ) / (18 * Real.pi * (K : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ -absoluteFejerDual K (fun x : ℝ => |x|)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (18 * Real.pi * (K : ℝ) ^ 2)
  have hb : cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (4 * K) ≤ -c := by
    simpa only [show 2 * (2 * K) = 4 * K by omega] using
      cuspCosineMoment_abs_even_le_neg hK (by omega : 0 < 2 * K) (by omega : 2 * K ≤ 3 * K)
  have hm (m : ℕ) (hm : m ∈ range (K + 1)) :
      cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (4 * K) + ∑ j ∈ range m,
        (cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (4 * K + 2 * (j + 1)) +
          cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (4 * K - 2 * (j + 1))) ≤ -c * (1 + 2 * (m : ℝ)) := by
    have hterm (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range m) :
        cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (4 * K + 2 * (j + 1)) +
          cuspCosineMoment (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (4 * K - 2 * (j + 1)) ≤ -2 * c := by
      have hmK := mem_range.mp hm
      have hjm := mem_range.mp hj
      have hp := cuspCosineMoment_abs_even_le_neg hK
        (by omega : 0 < 2 * K + (j + 1)) (by omega : 2 * K + (j + 1) ≤ 3 * K)
      have hn := cuspCosineMoment_abs_even_le_neg hK
        (by omega : 0 < 2 * K - (j + 1)) (by omega : 2 * K - (j + 1) ≤ 3 * K)
      rw [show 2 * (2 * K + (j + 1)) = 4 * K + 2 * (j + 1) by omega] at hp
      rw [show 2 * (2 * K - (j + 1)) = 4 * K - 2 * (j + 1) by omega] at hn
      change _ ≤ -c at hp hn
      linarith
    have hsum := sum_le_sum hterm
    simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    linarith
  have hsum := sum_le_sum hm
  rw [← mul_sum, sum_one_add_two_mul] at hsum
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity : 0 ≤ (K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
  rw [← absoluteFejerDual_eq_sum (by fun_prop) K] at h
  have heq : (K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (-c * ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) = -(K + 1 : ℝ) * c := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [heq] at h
  change (K + 1 : ℝ) / (18 * Real.pi * (K : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ _
  dsimp only [c] at h
  simp only [mul_one_div, neg_div] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.absoluteFejerDual_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hi (h : ℝ → ℝ) (hh : ContinuousOn h (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
      Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => modulatedFejerCircleKernel K t *
        realChebyshevCircleFunction h ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) - t)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    ((continuous_modulatedFejerCircleKernel K).mul ((continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hh).comp
      (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  simp only [absoluteFejerDual, realChebyshevCircleFunction, mul_sub]
  exact integral_sub (hi f hf) (hi g hg)

name: NLAlib.one_div_eighteen_pi_mul_succ_le_absoluteMinimaxError
statement:
theorem one_div_eighteen_pi_mul_succ_le_absoluteMinimaxError (n : ℕ) :
    1 / (18 * Real.pi * (n + 1)) ≤ absoluteMinimaxError n
proof:
:= by
  let K := n / 2 + 1
  have hK : 0 < K := by dsimp only [K]; omega
  have hKn : n < 2 * K := by dsimp only [K]; omega
  obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := exists_degree_le_absoluteMinimaxError n
  have hd := abs_absoluteFejerDual_le (by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => |x| - p.eval x) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) K he
  rw [absoluteFejerDual_sub (by fun_prop) p.continuous.continuousOn K,
    absoluteFejerDual_eval_eq_zero hKn hp, sub_zero] at hd
  have hl := (div_le_neg_absoluteFejerDual_abs hK).trans ((neg_le_abs _).trans hd)
  apply le_trans _ hl
  have hKR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hKN : (K : ℝ) ≤ n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (show K ≤ n + 1 by dsimp only [K]; omega)
  have hD₁ : 0 < 18 * Real.pi * (n + 1) := by positivity
  have hD₂ : 0 < 18 * Real.pi * (K : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hD₁ hD₂).mpr
  have hpoly : (K : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (K + 1) * (n + 1) := by nlinarith
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly (by positivity : 0 ≤ 18 * Real.pi)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_inv_polynomial_on
statement:
private theorem isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_inv_polynomial_on {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ∈ s) {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hpole : ∀ x ∈ s, p.eval x ≠ 0) :
    IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation s 0 n ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by intro h; have := hpole 0 hs; simp [h] at this
  have hnum : ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹).num ∣ (1 : ℝ[X]) := by
    simpa only [map_one, one_div] using RatFunc.num_div_dvd (1 : ℝ[X]) hp0
  have hden : ((algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹).denom ∣ p := by
    simpa only [map_one, one_div] using RatFunc.denom_div_dvd (1 : ℝ[X]) p
  refine ⟨?_, (degree_le_of_dvd hden hp0).trans hp, ?_⟩
  · simpa using degree_le_of_dvd hnum (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ[X]) ≠ 0)
  · intro x hx hzero
    exact hpole x hx (eval_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval_eq_zero hden hzero)

name: NLAlib.exists_reflected_type_zero_rational
proof:
:= by
  have hnum := r.num.eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hr.1
  let c : ℝ := r.num.coeff 0
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · have hr0 : r = 0 := RatFunc.num_eq_zero_iff.mp (by
      rw [hnum]
      change C c = 0
      rw [hc, C_0])
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨by simp, ?_, by simp⟩
      simp only [RatFunc.denom_zero, degree_one]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n
    · intro x _
      simp only [hr0, RatFunc.eval_zero]
  · let p : ℝ[X] := c⁻¹ • r.denom.comp (-X)
    have hp : p.degree ≤ n := by
      exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans (by rw [degree_comp_neg_X]; exact hr.2.1)
    have hpole : ∀ x ∈ t, p.eval x ≠ 0 := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [p, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X]
      exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hc) (hr.2.2 (-x) (hreflect x hx))
    refine ⟨(algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p)⁻¹,
      isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_inv_polynomial_on ht hp hpole, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [eval_inv_polynomial_of_eval_ne_zero (hpole x hx), RatFunc.eval,
      eval₂_id, eval₂_id, hnum, eval_C]
    simp only [p, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X]
    rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.negativeHalfLineExponentialUniformErrorBounds_eq
statement:
theorem negativeHalfLineExponentialUniformErrorBounds_eq (n : ℕ) :
    negativeHalfLineExponentialUniformErrorBounds n = reciprocalExponentialUniformErrorBounds n
proof:
:= by
  ext E
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, herr⟩
    obtain ⟨r', hr', heval⟩ := exists_reflected_type_zero_rational
      (s := Iic 0) (t := Ici 0) (by simp)
      (by intro x hx; change (0 : ℝ) ≤ x at hx; change -x ≤ (0 : ℝ)
          exact neg_nonpos.mpr hx) hr
    refine ⟨r', hr', fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [heval x hx]
    exact herr (-x) (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, herr⟩
    obtain ⟨r', hr', heval⟩ := exists_reflected_type_zero_rational
      (s := Ici 0) (t := Iic 0) (by simp)
      (by intro x hx; change x ≤ (0 : ℝ) at hx; change (0 : ℝ) ≤ -x
          exact neg_nonneg.mpr hx) hr
    refine ⟨r', hr', fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [heval x hx]
    simpa only [neg_neg] using herr (-x) (neg_nonneg.mpr hx)

name: NLAlib.negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_eq
statement:
theorem negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_eq (n : ℕ) :
    negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError n = reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError n
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError, reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError,
    negativeHalfLineExponentialUniformErrorBounds_eq]

name: NLAlib.negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound
statement:
theorem negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound (n : ℕ) :
    1 / (6 * Real.sqrt (reciprocalExponentialLowerCutoff n) * 3^n) ≤
      negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError n
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_eq]
  exact reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_ge_geometric_lower_bound n

name: NLAlib.negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_le_geometric_upper_bound
statement:
theorem negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_le_geometric_upper_bound (n : ℕ) :
    negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError n ≤ Real.sqrt (40 / 21) / 3^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_eq]
  exact reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_le_geometric_upper_bound n

name: NLAlib.tendsto_rpow_negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_inv_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_rpow_negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_inv_nat :
    Tendsto (fun n => (negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError n) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)))
      atTop (𝓝 (1 / 3 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [negativeHalfLineExponentialMinimaxError_eq]
  exact tendsto_rpow_reciprocalExponentialMinimaxError_inv_nat

name: NLAlib.mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff {s : Set ℝ} {n : ℕ} {f : C(s, ℝ)} :
    f ∈ polynomialApproximationSpace s n ↔
      ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ p.toContinuousMapOn s = f
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialApproximationSpace, Submodule.mem_map, mem_degreeLE]

name: NLAlib.interpolationLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem interpolationLinearMap_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Set ℝ) (v : ι → s) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    interpolationLinearMap s v f =
      (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) (fun i => f (v i))).toContinuousMapOn
        s
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.rationalContinuousMap_apply_eq_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalContinuousMap_apply_eq_eval (s : Set ℝ) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hpole : ∀ x ∈ s, r.denom.eval x ≠ 0) (x : s) :
    rationalContinuousMap s r hpole x = r.eval (RingHom.id ℝ) x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalContinuousMap, RatFunc.eval]

name: NLAlib.polynomialApproximationSpace_mono
statement:
theorem polynomialApproximationSpace_mono {s : Set ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    polynomialApproximationSpace s m ≤ polynomialApproximationSpace s n
proof:
:= by
  exact Submodule.map_mono (degreeLE_mono (by exact_mod_cast hmn))

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_nonneg
statement:
theorem minimaxError_nonneg {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (n : ℕ) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ minimaxError n f
proof: := Metric.infDist_nonneg

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_le_norm_sub
proof:
:= by
  simpa [minimaxError, dist_eq_norm] using (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := f) hp)

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_le_norm
statement:
theorem minimaxError_le_norm {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (n : ℕ) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    minimaxError n f ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa using minimaxError_le_norm_sub f (polynomialApproximationSpace s n).zero_mem

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_antitone
statement:
theorem minimaxError_antitone {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    Antitone (fun n => minimaxError n f)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  exact Metric.infDist_le_infDist_of_subset (polynomialApproximationSpace_mono hmn)
    ⟨0, (polynomialApproximationSpace s m).zero_mem⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (n : ℕ) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ = minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional
    (polynomialApproximationSpace s n) f
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mp hg
  exact ⟨p, hp, hbest⟩

name: NLAlib.isLeast_minimaxError
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hbest⟩ := exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError n f
  refine ⟨⟨p, hp, hbest.le⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro E ⟨q, hq, hE⟩
  exact (minimaxError_le_norm_sub f
    (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩)).trans hE

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_eq_sInf
proof:
:=
  (isLeast_minimaxError n f).csInf_eq.symm

name: NLAlib.isLeast_minimaxError_pointwise
statement:
theorem isLeast_minimaxError_pointwise {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ)
    (f : C(Set.Icc a b, ℝ)) :
    IsLeast {E : ℝ | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ x : Set.Icc a b, |f x - p.eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ E} (minimaxError n f)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {E : ℝ | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ x : Set.Icc a b, |f x - p.eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ E} =
      {E : ℝ | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
        ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Set.Icc a b)‖ ≤ E} := by
    ext E
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpoint⟩
      have hEnonneg : 0 ≤ E := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hpoint ⟨a, le_rfl, hab⟩)
      exact ⟨p, hp, (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ hEnonneg).mpr hpoint⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hnorm⟩
      exact ⟨p, hp, fun x => ((f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Set.Icc a b)).norm_coe_le_norm x).trans hnorm⟩
  rw [hset]
  exact isLeast_minimaxError n f

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_add_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  let S := polynomialApproximationSpace s n
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional S f
    have := minimaxError_le_norm_sub (f + p) (S.add_mem hq hp)
    simpa [S, minimaxError, hbest] using this
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional S (f + p)
    have := minimaxError_le_norm_sub f (S.sub_mem hq hp)
    have heq : f - (q - p) = f + p - q := by abel
    simpa [heq, S, minimaxError, hbest] using this

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_add_le
statement:
theorem minimaxError_add_le {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (n : ℕ) (f g : C(s, ℝ)) :
    minimaxError n (f + g) ≤ minimaxError n f + minimaxError n g
proof:
:= by
  let S := polynomialApproximationSpace s n
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional S f
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hgq⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional S g
  have heq : f + g - (p + q) = (f - p) + (g - q) := by abel
  calc
    minimaxError n (f + g) ≤ ‖f + g - (p + q)‖ :=
      minimaxError_le_norm_sub _ (S.add_mem hp hq)
    _ ≤ ‖f - p‖ + ‖g - q‖ := by rw [heq]; exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ = minimaxError n f + minimaxError n g := by rw [hfp, hgq]; rfl

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_smul
statement:
theorem minimaxError_smul {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    minimaxError n (c • f) = |c| * minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  let S := polynomialApproximationSpace s n
  have hle : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : C(s, ℝ)),
      minimaxError n (c • f) ≤ |c| * minimaxError n f := by
    intro c f
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional S f
    calc
      minimaxError n (c • f) ≤ ‖c • f - c • p‖ :=
        minimaxError_le_norm_sub _ (S.smul_mem c hp)
      _ = |c| * minimaxError n f := by rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hfp]; rfl
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · subst c
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa using hle 0 f
    · simp [minimaxError_nonneg]
  · apply le_antisymm (hle c f)
    have hi := hle c⁻¹ (c • f)
    rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hc] at hi
    have ha : 0 < |c| := abs_pos.mpr hc
    have hi' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi ha.le
    simpa [abs_inv, hc, ha.ne', mul_assoc] using hi'

name: NLAlib.tendsto_minimaxError_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_minimaxError_atTop {a b : ℝ} (f : C(Set.Icc a b, ℝ)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => minimaxError n f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_polynomial_near_continuousMap a b f ε hε
  refine ⟨p.natDegree, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (minimaxError_nonneg n f)]
  have hpdeg : p.degree ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ) :=
    p.degree_le_natDegree.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (minimaxError_le_norm_sub f
    (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨p, hpdeg, rfl⟩))
      (by simpa [norm_sub_rev] using hp)

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_projection_le_minimaxError
statement:
theorem norm_sub_projection_le_minimaxError {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (n : ℕ) (L : C(s, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(s, ℝ)) (B : ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ p ∈ polynomialApproximationSpace s n, L p = p)
    (hB : ∀ g, ‖L g‖ ≤ B * ‖g‖) (f : C(s, ℝ)) :
    ‖f - L f‖ ≤ (1 + B) * minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError n f
  have hLp := hL _ (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  have heq : f - L f = (f - p.toContinuousMapOn s) - L (f - p.toContinuousMapOn s) := by
    rw [map_sub, hLp]; abel
  calc
    ‖f - L f‖ ≤ ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ + ‖L (f - p.toContinuousMapOn s)‖ :=
      by rw [heq]; exact norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ (1 + B) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ := by
      have := hB (f - p.toContinuousMapOn s); nlinarith
    _ = (1 + B) * minimaxError n f := by rw [hfp]

name: NLAlib.le_on_Icc_of_le_ne
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxz : x = z
  · subst x
    have hclosed : IsClosed {x | F x ≤ G x} := isClosed_le hF hG
    by_cases hzb : z < b
    · have hsub : Ioo z b ⊆ {x | F x ≤ G x} := by
        intro x hxi
        exact hle x ⟨hx.1.trans hxi.1.le, hxi.2.le⟩ (ne_of_gt hxi.1)
      apply closure_minimal hsub hclosed
      rw [closure_Ioo hzb.ne]
      exact ⟨le_rfl, hzb.le⟩
    · have hza : a < z := hab.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hzb)
      have hsub : Ioo a z ⊆ {x | F x ≤ G x} := by
        intro x hxi
        exact hle x ⟨hxi.1.le, hxi.2.le.trans hx.2⟩ (ne_of_lt hxi.2)
      apply closure_minimal hsub hclosed
      rw [closure_Ioo hza.ne]
      exact ⟨hza.le, le_rfl⟩
  · exact hle x hx hxz

name: NLAlib.exists_denominator_ne_zero_of_cross_error_le
statement:
theorem exists_denominator_ne_zero_of_cross_error_le {a b E : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (p q : ℝ[X]) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (herror : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |f x * q.eval x - p.eval x| ≤ E * |q.eval x|) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ p.degree ∧ Q.degree ≤ q.degree ∧ q * P = p * Q ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, Q.eval x ≠ 0 ∧
        |f x * Q.eval x - P.eval x| ≤ E * |Q.eval x|
proof:
:= by
  induction hd : q.natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing p q with
  | h d ih =>
    by_cases hpoles : ∃ z ∈ Icc a b, q.eval z = 0
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, hqz⟩ := hpoles
      have hpz : p.eval z = 0 := by
        have he := herror z hz
        rw [hqz, mul_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_zero, mul_zero] at he
        exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm he (abs_nonneg _))
      obtain ⟨P₀, hp0⟩ := (dvd_iff_isRoot (p := p) (a := z)).mpr hpz
      obtain ⟨Q₀, hq0⟩ := (dvd_iff_isRoot (p := q) (a := z)).mpr hqz
      have hfactor : (X - C z : ℝ[X]) ≠ 0 := X_sub_C_ne_zero z
      have hQ0 : Q₀ ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; rw [hq0, hzero, mul_zero] at hq; exact hq rfl
      have hqd : Q₀.natDegree < d := by
        rw [hq0, natDegree_mul hfactor hQ0, natDegree_X_sub_C] at hd
        omega
      have herr0 : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
          |f x * Q₀.eval x - P₀.eval x| ≤ E * |Q₀.eval x| := by
        apply le_on_Icc_of_le_ne (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hab
        intro x hx hxz
        have hb := herror x hx
        rw [hp0, hq0, eval_mul, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at hb
        have heq : f x * ((x - z) * Q₀.eval x) - (x - z) * P₀.eval x =
            (x - z) * (f x * Q₀.eval x - P₀.eval x) := by ring
        rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_mul] at hb
        have hpos : 0 < |x - z| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxz)
        have hb' : |x - z| * |f x * Q₀.eval x - P₀.eval x| ≤
            |x - z| * (E * |Q₀.eval x|) := by nlinarith [hb]
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb' hpos
      obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hrel, hbound⟩ :=
        ih Q₀.natDegree hqd P₀ Q₀ hQ0 herr0 rfl
      refine ⟨P, Q, hP.trans ?_, hQ.trans ?_, ?_, hbound⟩
      · rw [hp0, mul_comm]
        exact degree_le_mul_left P₀ hfactor
      · rw [hq0, mul_comm]
        exact degree_le_mul_left Q₀ hfactor
      · rw [hp0, hq0]
        linear_combination (X - C z) * hrel
    · push Not at hpoles
      exact ⟨p, q, le_rfl, le_rfl, by ring, fun x hx => ⟨hpoles x hx, herror x hx⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_nodal_interpolationGapCriticalPoint_ne_zero
proof:
:=
  eval_nodal_in_gap_ne_zero ht i (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht i).1

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapJacobian_eq_nodal_derivative
statement:
theorem interpolationGapJacobian_eq_nodal_derivative {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    interpolationGapJacobian n t i j = -(interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (t j) *
      (Lagrange.basis univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ).eval
        (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)
proof:
:= by
  let τ := interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i
  have hnon : τ ≠ canonicalIntervalNodes n t j.castSucc.succ := by
    intro heq
    have hω := eval_nodal_interpolationGapCriticalPoint_ne_zero hn ht i
    rw [show interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i = canonicalIntervalNodes n t j.castSucc.succ from heq,
      Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ _)] at hω
    exact hω rfl
  rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_not_at_node (mem_univ _) hnon]
  have hf := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval (t j)) (mul_interpolationGapDividedDerivative hn ht i)
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at hf
  rw [← hf, canonicalIntervalNodes_interior]
  dsimp [interpolationGapJacobian]
  change _ = -((t j - τ) * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (t j)) *
    ((Lagrange.nodal univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t)).eval τ *
      (Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ * (τ - t j)⁻¹))
  have hneq : τ - t j ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa only [canonicalIntervalNodes_interior] using hnon)
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak_jacobian
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak_jacobian {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun s => interpolationGapPeak n s i)
      (∑ j : Fin n, interpolationGapJacobian n t i j •
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [interpolationGapJacobian_eq_nodal_derivative hn ht i]
  exact hasFDerivAt_interpolationGapPeak hn ht i

name: NLAlib.det_interpolationGapJacobian_minor_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  let R : Fin n → ℝ := fun i =>
    (Lagrange.nodal univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t)).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t (k.succAbove i))
  let Cw : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) j.castSucc.succ
  let Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := fun i j =>
    (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t (k.succAbove i)).eval (t j)
  have htinj : Function.Injective t := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    have hnodes : canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc.succ = canonicalIntervalNodes n t j.castSucc.succ := by
      simpa only [canonicalIntervalNodes_interior] using hij
    have heq := ht.injective hnodes
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val heq
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hval
    omega
  have hQ : Q.det ≠ 0 := det_gapDirection_eval_ne_zero hn ht k t htinj
  have hR : (∏ i, R i) ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi =>
    eval_nodal_interpolationGapCriticalPoint_ne_zero hn ht _
  have hC : (∏ j, Cw j) ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj =>
    Lagrange.nodalWeight_ne_zero ht.injective.injOn (mem_univ _)
  have hmatrix : (interpolationGapJacobian n t).submatrix k.succAbove id =
      Matrix.diagonal R * Q * Matrix.diagonal Cw := by
    ext i j
    simp only [submatrix_apply, id_eq, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    dsimp [interpolationGapJacobian, R, Q, Cw]
    ring
  rw [hmatrix, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hR hQ) hC

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec
proof:
:= interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i
    τ ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ) ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval τ = 0 ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.derivative.eval τ < 0 ∧
      1 < (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      interpolationGapPeak n t i = (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ),
        (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval y = 0 → y = τ) := by
  classical
  simp only [interpolationGapCriticalPoint, dif_pos (show 0 < n ∧ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n from ⟨hn, ht⟩)]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_interpolationGapPeak_nondegenerate hn ht i)

name: NLAlib.strictMono_interpolationGapCriticalPoint
statement:
theorem strictMono_interpolationGapCriticalPoint {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) : StrictMono (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hi := (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht i).1
  have hj := (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht j).1
  have hnodes := ht.monotone (show i.succ ≤ j.castSucc by have h := hij; exact Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by omega))
  exact hi.2.trans_le hnodes |>.trans hj.1

name: NLAlib.mul_interpolationGapDividedDerivative
statement:
theorem mul_interpolationGapDividedDerivative {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (X - C (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)) * interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i =
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.mpr (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht i).2.1

name: NLAlib.degree_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).degree ≤ (n + 1 : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [interpolationGapPolynomial, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega] using
      Lagrange.degree_interpolate_le (s := univ) (interpolationGapSign n i) ht.injective.injOn
  have hnat := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hdeg
  have hder : (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.degree ≤ n :=
    degree_le_of_natDegree_le ((natDegree_derivative_le _).trans (by omega))
  exact (degree_divByMonic_lt _ _ (derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial_ne_zero hn ht i)
    (by rw [degree_X_sub_C]; exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 1 by omega))).trans_le hder

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_self
statement:
theorem eval_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_self {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i) =
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.derivative.eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.derivative.eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t i))
    (mul_interpolationGapDividedDerivative hn ht i)
  simpa only [derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C, sub_zero,
    eval_add, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_self, zero_mul, eval_one, one_mul, add_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_self_neg
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_self hn ht i]
  exact (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht i).2.2.1

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_offdiag_pos
statement:
theorem eval_interpolationGapDividedDerivative_offdiag_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t j)
proof:
:= by
  let τ := interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t
  have hfactor := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval (τ j)) (mul_interpolationGapDividedDerivative hn ht i)
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at hfactor
  have hjcrit := (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht j).2.1
  have hjpos : 0 < (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j) :=
    zero_lt_one.trans (interpolationGapCriticalPoint_spec hn ht j).2.2.2.1
  have hτ := strictMono_interpolationGapCriticalPoint hn ht
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · have h := interpolationGapPolynomial_wronskian_sign ht i j hlt (τ j)
    rw [hjcrit, mul_zero, sub_zero, ← hfactor] at h
    have hpow : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val - i.val) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) := by
      rw [show i.val + j.val = j.val - i.val + 2 * i.val by have := hlt; omega, pow_add, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    rw [hpow] at h
    have hd : 0 < (τ j - τ i) * (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j) :=
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hτ hlt)) hjpos
    have hrew : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        ((τ j - τ i) * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (τ j) *
          (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j)) =
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (τ j)) *
          ((τ j - τ i) * (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j)) := by ring
    rw [hrew] at h
    exact (mul_pos_iff.mp h).resolve_right (by intro hh; linarith [hh.2]) |>.1
  · have h := interpolationGapPolynomial_wronskian_sign ht j i hgt (τ j)
    rw [hjcrit, zero_mul, zero_sub, ← hfactor] at h
    have hpow : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val - j.val) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) := by
      rw [show i.val + j.val = i.val - j.val + 2 * j.val by have := hgt; omega, pow_add, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    rw [hpow] at h
    have hd : 0 < (τ i - τ j) * (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j) :=
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hτ hgt)) hjpos
    have hrew : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        (-((interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j) *
          ((τ j - τ i) * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (τ j)))) =
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (τ j)) *
          ((τ i - τ j) * (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval (τ j)) := by ring
    rw [hrew] at h
    exact (mul_pos_iff.mp h).resolve_right (by intro hh; linarith [hh.2]) |>.1

name: NLAlib.sin_lobatto_step_lower
statement:
private theorem sin_lobatto_step_lower {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    π / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ sin (π / (2 * n))
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hp2 : π ^ 2 ≤ 10 := by nlinarith [pi_lt_d2, pi_pos]
  have hN2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hnum : 0 ≤ 24 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 - π ^ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp2 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1)]
  have hidentity : π / (2 * n) - (π / (2 * n)) ^ 3 / 6 - π / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) =
      π * (24 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 - π ^ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) /
        (48 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ π / (2 * n) - (π / (2 * n)) ^ 3 / 6 - π / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [hidentity]
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg pi_pos.le hnum) (by positivity)
  have hsin := sin_ge_sub_cube (x := π / (2 * n)) (by positivity)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.lobattoCotangentConstant_le_log_sin
statement:
theorem lobattoCotangentConstant_le_log_sin {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    lobattoCotangentConstant n ≤ (2 / π) * (2 - log (sin (π / (2 * n))))
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℝ := π / (2 * n)
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hh : 0 < h := by dsimp [h]; positivity
  have hnh : (n : ℝ) * h = π / 2 := by dsimp [h]; field_simp
  have hhπ : h ≤ π / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hcont : ContinuousOn Real.cot (Icc h (π / 2)) := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hasDerivAt_cot (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (hh.trans_le hx.1)
      (by linarith [hx.2, pi_pos])).ne').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hcell : ∀ j ∈ range (n - 1),
      h * Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * h) ≤
        ∫ x in ((j : ℝ) + 1) * h..((j : ℝ) + 2) * h, Real.cot x := by
    intro j hj
    have hjn : j + 2 ≤ n := by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega
    have hjn' : (j : ℝ) + 2 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hjn
    have hsubset : Icc (((j : ℝ) + 1) * h) (((j : ℝ) + 2) * h) ⊆ Ioc 0 (π / 2) := by
      intro x hx
      constructor
      · nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ j by positivity, hx.1]
      · nlinarith [hx.2]
    have hcc : ConvexOn ℝ (Icc (((j : ℝ) + 1) * h) (((j : ℝ) + 2) * h)) Real.cot :=
      convexOn_cot.subset hsubset (convex_Icc _ _)
    have hc : ContinuousOn Real.cot (Icc (((j : ℝ) + 1) * h) (((j : ℝ) + 2) * h)) :=
      fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_cot (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (hsubset hx).1
        (by linarith [(hsubset hx).2, pi_pos])).ne').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    convert mul_midpoint_le_integral_of_convexOn (by nlinarith :
      ((j : ℝ) + 1) * h ≤ ((j : ℝ) + 2) * h) hc hcc using 1; ring
  have hsum := sum_le_sum hcell
  have hintegral : ∑ j ∈ range (n - 1),
      ∫ x in ((j : ℝ) + 1) * h..((j : ℝ) + 2) * h, Real.cot x =
        ∫ x in h..π / 2, Real.cot x := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
      (a := fun k : ℕ => ((k : ℝ) + 1) * h) (f := Real.cot)
      (μ := volume) (n := n - 1) (by
        intro k hk
        apply hcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hhπ |>.mono_set
        rw [uIcc_of_le hhπ]
        have hk' : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (show k + 2 ≤ n by omega)
        have hle : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * h ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * h := by push_cast; nlinarith
        rw [uIcc_of_le hle]
        intro x hx
        constructor <;> push_cast at hx <;> nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ k by positivity, hx.1, hx.2])
    have hnsub : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = n := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel hn)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_mul, hnsub, hnh, show ∀ j : ℕ, (j : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by intro j; ring] using h
  simp only [← mul_sum] at hsum
  rw [hintegral, integral_cot_eq_log_sin hh hhπ le_rfl, sin_pi_div_two, log_one,
    zero_sub] at hsum
  have hfirst := cot_le_one_div (x := h / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hfirst' : h * Real.cot (h / 2) ≤ 2 := by
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfirst hh.le
    calc
      h * Real.cot (h / 2) ≤ h * (1 / (h / 2)) := hb
      _ = 2 := by field_simp
  have hsplit : (∑ j ∈ range n, Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h)) =
      Real.cot (h / 2) + ∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * h) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, sum_range_succ']
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    ring
  have hscaled : h * ∑ j ∈ range n, Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h) ≤ 2 - log (sin h) := by
    rw [hsplit, mul_add]
    linarith
  have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscaled (show 0 ≤ 2 / π by positivity)
  dsimp [lobattoCotangentConstant]
  have harg : ∀ j : ℕ, ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * n) = ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h := by
    intro j; dsimp [h]; ring
  simp_rw [harg]
  have hfac : (1 / n : ℝ) = (2 / π) * h := by dsimp [h]; field_simp
  rw [hfac, mul_assoc]
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.lobattoCotangentConstant_le_log
statement:
theorem lobattoCotangentConstant_le_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    lobattoCotangentConstant n ≤ 1 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hslo := sin_lobatto_step_lower hn
  have hpdiv : 0 < π / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by positivity
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpdiv hslo
  have hlogeq : log (π / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) = -log (2 / π) - log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    rw [show π / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = (2 / π)⁻¹ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) by field_simp,
      log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), log_inv]
  rw [hlogeq] at hlog
  calc
    lobattoCotangentConstant n ≤ (2 / π) * (2 - log (sin (π / (2 * n)))) :=
      lobattoCotangentConstant_le_log_sin hn
    _ ≤ (2 / π) * (2 + log (2 / π)) + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (show 0 ≤ 2 / π by positivity)
      linarith
    _ ≤ 1 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith [cotangent_log_remainder_le_one]

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_one_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem re_fourier_one_mem_Icc (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (fourier 1 t).re ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : |(fourier 1 t).re| ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [show ‖fourier 1 t‖ = (1 : ℝ) from Circle.norm_coe _] using
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm (fourier 1 t)
  exact abs_le.mp h

name: NLAlib.continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) : Continuous (realChebyshevCircleFunction f)
proof:
:=
  hf.comp_continuous (Complex.continuous_re.comp (fourier 1).continuous)
    re_fourier_one_mem_Icc

name: NLAlib.even_realChebyshevCircleFunction
statement:
theorem even_realChebyshevCircleFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    realChebyshevCircleFunction f (-t) = realChebyshevCircleFunction f t
proof:
:= by
  have h : fourier 1 (-t) = conj (fourier 1 t) := by
    have hs := fourier_apply_sub 1 0 t
    simpa only [zero_sub, fourier_eval_zero, one_mul, fourier_neg] using hs
  unfold realChebyshevCircleFunction
  rw [h, Complex.conj_re]

name: NLAlib.realChebyshevCircleFunction_coe
statement:
theorem realChebyshevCircleFunction_coe (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    realChebyshevCircleFunction f (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = f (cos t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold realChebyshevCircleFunction
  rw [show (fourier 1 (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = cos t by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 t]

name: NLAlib.eval_T_re_fourier_one
statement:
theorem eval_T_re_fourier_one (k : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((fourier 1 t).re) = (fourier (k : ℤ) t).re
proof:
:= by
  induction t using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with | H t =>
    rw [show (fourier 1 (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = cos t by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 t,
      re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos k t]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Int.cast_natCast] using T_real_cos t (k : ℤ)

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_circle_convolution
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_circle_convolution {K : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hK : K.degree ≤ n)
    {g : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (heven : ∀ t, g (-t) = g t) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ a : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
      (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), K.eval ((fourier 1 t).re) * g (a - t)
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = p.eval ((fourier 1 a).re)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le hK
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1),
    (c k * (fourierCoeff (fun t => (g t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)).re) • T ℝ (k : ℤ)
  refine ⟨p, ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun k hk => ?_)
    refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)
  · have hI : ∀ k ∈ range (n + 1), Integrable
        (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => c k * (fourier (k : ℤ) t).re * g (a - t))
        AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
      intro k hk
      apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport _ (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
      exact (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_re.comp (fourier (k : ℤ)).continuous)).mul
        (hg.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
    have hterm : ∀ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
        K.eval ((fourier 1 t).re) * g (a - t) =
          ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), c k * (fourier (k : ℤ) t).re * g (a - t) := by
      intro t
      rw [← hc, eval_finsetSum, Finset.sum_mul]
      simp only [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_T_re_fourier_one]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum _ hI]
    unfold p
    rw [eval_finsetSum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [show (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => c k * (fourier (k : ℤ) t).re * g (a - t)) =
        (fun t => c k * ((fourier (k : ℤ) t).re * g (a - t))) by funext t; ring]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      integral_re_fourier_mul_comp_sub_eq_re_fourier_mul_coeff hg heven,
      eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_T_re_fourier_one]
    ring

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_comp_cos
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_comp_cos {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) : LipschitzWith L (fun t : ℝ => f (cos t))
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  exact (hf.dist_le_mul (cos x) ⟨neg_one_le_cos x, cos_le_one x⟩
    (cos y) ⟨neg_one_le_cos y, cos_le_one y⟩).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using
        Real.lipschitzWith_cos.dist_le_mul x y) L.coe_nonneg)

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_jacksonPeriodicApprox
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_jacksonPeriodicApprox {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
      jacksonPeriodicApprox n (fun t => f (cos t)) x = p.eval (cos x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, heq⟩ := exists_polynomial_circle_convolution
    (degree_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_le n)
    (continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf) (even_realChebyshevCircleFunction f)
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h := heq (x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
  rw [integral_haarAddCircle_eq_inv_mul_intervalIntegral] at h
  have hterm : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval ((fourier 1 (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re) *
        realChebyshevCircleFunction f ((x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) - (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) =
      (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos t) * f (cos (x - t)) := by
    intro t
    rw [← AddCircle.coe_sub, realChebyshevCircleFunction_coe]
    rw [show (fourier 1 (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = cos t by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 t]
  simp_rw [hterm] at h
  rw [show (fourier 1 (x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = cos x by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 x] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_unit
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_unit {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ Real.pi * (L : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, heq⟩ := exists_polynomial_jacksonPeriodicApprox hf.continuousOn n
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hper : Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => f (cos t)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro t
    simp only [cos_add_two_pi]
  have h := abs_sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_le (lipschitzWith_comp_cos hf) hper n (arccos x)
  rw [heq, cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_eq_rootCotangentSample
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 0 < N := by omega
  rw [lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_cos_nat_mul_pi_div hN]
  have heq : (∑ j : Fin N, sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
      |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - cos (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)|) =
      ∑ j ∈ range N, sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
        |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - cos (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)| := by
    rw [sum_fin_eq_sum_range]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [dif_pos (mem_range.mp hj)]
  rw [heq]
  exact sum_sin_div_abs_cos_sub_eq_rootCotangentSample hk0 hkN

name: NLAlib.logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_sample
statement:
theorem logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_sample {N k : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hk0 : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k < N) :
    (2 / π) * (log (N : ℝ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
      lebesgueFunction (chebyshevZero N) (cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N))
proof:
:= by
  have h := logarithmic_lower_lt_central_cotangent_sum hN
  rw [← rootCotangentSample_center_eq hN] at h
  rw [lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_eq_rootCotangentSample (show 0 < k by omega) hkN]
  exact h.trans_le (rootCotangentSample_center_le hN hk0 hkN)

name: NLAlib.cos_nat_mul_pi_div_mem_chebyshevZero_gap
statement:
theorem cos_nat_mul_pi_div_mem_chebyshevZero_gap {N k : ℕ} (hk0 : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k < N) :
    cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) ∈
      Ioo (chebyshevZero N ⟨k, hkN⟩) (chebyshevZero N ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have hkNR : (k : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hkN
  have hφ : (k : ℝ) * π / N ∈ Icc 0 π := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hNR]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hθ := chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo (⟨k, hkN⟩ : Fin N)
  have hprev := chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo (⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin N)
  rw [chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index, chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index]
  constructor
  · apply strictAntiOn_cos hφ ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2.le⟩
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hNR]
    dsimp only
    nlinarith [pi_pos]
  · apply strictAntiOn_cos ⟨hprev.1.le, hprev.2.le⟩ hφ
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hNR]
    simp only [Nat.cast_sub hk0, Nat.cast_one]
    nlinarith [pi_pos]

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_chebyshevZero_gap_logarithmic_lower_lt
statement:
theorem exists_mem_chebyshevZero_gap_logarithmic_lower_lt {N k : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hk0 : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k < N) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioo (chebyshevZero N ⟨k, hkN⟩) (chebyshevZero N ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩),
      (2 / π) * (log (N : ℝ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
        lebesgueFunction (chebyshevZero N) x
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N), cos_nat_mul_pi_div_mem_chebyshevZero_gap hk0 hkN,
    logarithmic_lower_lt_lebesgueFunction_chebyshevZero_sample hN hk0 hkN⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (e : ℝ → ℝ) (E a b : ℝ), Continuous e → 0 < E → a ≤ b → |e a| = E →
      (∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |e x| = E → 0 < e x * p.eval x) ∧
        (∀ x ≤ a, 0 < e a * p.eval x)) ∨
      (∃ v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ, StrictMono v ∧
        (∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b ∧ |e (v i)| = E) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), e (v i.castSucc) * e (v i.succ) < 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro e E a b he hE hab hEa
    have hea : e a ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hEa; linarith
    by_cases hopp : ∃ y ∈ Icc a b, e y = -e a
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hey⟩ := hopp
      have hay : a < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hy.1 (by intro h; rw [← h] at hey; exact hea (by linarith))
      right
      refine ⟨![a, y], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Fin.strictMono_cons.mpr ⟨by intro i; fin_cases i; exact hay, by intro i j hij; omega⟩
      · intro i; fin_cases i
        · exact ⟨⟨le_rfl, hab⟩, hEa⟩
        · exact ⟨hy, by change |e y| = E; rw [hey, abs_neg, hEa]⟩
      · intro i; fin_cases i; change e a * e y < 0; rw [hey]
        nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hea]
    · left
      refine ⟨C (e a), degree_C_le, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx hext
        rcases abs_eq_abs.mp (hext.trans hEa.symm) with h | h
        · simp only [eval_C, h]; exact mul_self_pos.mpr hea
        · exact (hopp ⟨x, hx, h⟩).elim
      · intro x _; simp only [eval_C]; exact mul_self_pos.mpr hea
  | succ n ih =>
    intro e E a b he hE hab hEa
    have hea : e a ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hEa; linarith
    by_cases hopp : ∃ y ∈ Icc a b, e y = -e a
    · let B := Icc a b ∩ e ⁻¹' {-e a}
      have hB : IsCompact B := isCompact_Icc.inter_right (isClosed_singleton.preimage he)
      have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hey⟩ := hopp
        exact ⟨y, hy, hey⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hB.exists_isLeast hBne
      have hyab : y ∈ Icc a b := hy.1.1
      have hey : e y = -e a := hy.1.2
      have hay : a < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hyab.1 (by intro h; rw [← h] at hey; exact hea (by linarith))
      let A := Icc a y ∩ e ⁻¹' {e a}
      have hA : IsCompact A := isCompact_Icc.inter_right (isClosed_singleton.preimage he)
      have haA : a ∈ A := ⟨⟨le_rfl, hay.le⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hA.exists_isGreatest ⟨a, haA⟩
      have hua : a ≤ u := hu.2 haA
      have huy : u < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1.1.2 (by
        intro h
        have heu : e u = e a := hu.1.2
        rw [h, hey] at heu
        exact hea (by linarith))
      let z := (u + y) / 2
      have huz : u < z := by dsimp [z]; linarith
      have hzy : z < y := by dsimp [z]; linarith
      have haz : a < z := hua.trans_lt huz
      have hprefix : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |e x| = E → x < y → e x = e a ∧ x ≤ u := by
        intro x hx hext hxy
        have hex : e x = e a := by
          rcases abs_eq_abs.mp (hext.trans hEa.symm) with h | h
          · exact h
          · have hmem : x ∈ B := ⟨hx, h⟩
            exact (not_lt_of_ge (hy.2 hmem) hxy).elim
        exact ⟨hex, hu.2 ⟨⟨hx.1, hxy.le⟩, hex⟩⟩
      rcases ih e E y b he hE hyab.2 (by rw [hey, abs_neg, hEa]) with
        ⟨p, hp, hpsign, hpleft⟩ | ⟨v, hv, hvext, hvsign⟩
      · left
        refine ⟨(X - C z) * p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · calc
            ((X - C z) * p).degree ≤ (X - C z : ℝ[X]).degree + p.degree := degree_mul_le _ _
            _ ≤ 1 + (n : WithBot ℕ) := by rw [degree_X_sub_C]; exact add_le_add le_rfl hp
            _ = ↑(n + 1) := by norm_cast; omega
        · intro x hx hext
          simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
          by_cases hxy : x < y
          · obtain ⟨hex, hxu⟩ := hprefix x hx hext hxy
            have hneg : e x * p.eval x < 0 := by
              have hpos := hpleft x hxy.le
              rw [hey, ← hex] at hpos
              linarith
            have hxz : x - z < 0 := by linarith
            nlinarith [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hxz hneg]
          · have hpos := hpsign x ⟨le_of_not_gt hxy, hx.2⟩ hext
            have hxz : 0 < x - z := by linarith
            nlinarith [mul_pos hxz hpos]
        · intro x hxa
          simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
          have hneg : e a * p.eval x < 0 := by
            have hpos := hpleft x (hxa.trans hay.le)
            rw [hey] at hpos; linarith
          have hxz : x - z < 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hxz hneg]
      · right
        have hv0 : y ≤ v 0 := (hvext 0).1.1
        have hv0ext : |e (v 0)| = |e a| := (hvext 0).2.trans hEa.symm
        obtain ⟨r, hrab, hrv, hersign, hrext⟩ : ∃ r ∈ Icc a b,
            r < v 0 ∧ e r * e (v 0) < 0 ∧ |e r| = E := by
          rcases abs_eq_abs.mp hv0ext with h | h
          · refine ⟨y, hyab, lt_of_le_of_ne hv0 ?_, ?_, by rw [hey, abs_neg, hEa]⟩
            · intro hyeq; rw [← hyeq, hey] at h; exact hea (by linarith)
            · rw [hey, h]; nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hea]
          · refine ⟨a, ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩, hay.trans_le hv0, ?_, hEa⟩
            rw [h]; nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hea]
        refine ⟨Fin.cons r v, Fin.strictMono_cons.mpr ⟨?_, hv⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i; exact hrv.trans_le (hv.monotone (Fin.zero_le i))
        · intro i
          refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
          · exact ⟨hrab, hrext⟩
          · exact ⟨⟨hay.le.trans (hvext j).1.1, (hvext j).1.2⟩, (hvext j).2⟩
        · intro i
          refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
          · simpa using hersign
          · simpa using hvsign j
    · left
      refine ⟨C (e a), (degree_C_le).trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (n + 1)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx hext
        rcases abs_eq_abs.mp (hext.trans hEa.symm) with h | h
        · simp only [eval_C, h]; exact mul_self_pos.mpr hea
        · exact (hopp ⟨x, hx, h⟩).elim
      · intro x _; simp only [eval_C]; exact mul_self_pos.mpr hea

name: NLAlib.oddScalarUpdate_single_zero
statement:
theorem oddScalarUpdate_single_zero (q : ℕ) (t x : ℝ) :
    oddScalarUpdate q (Pi.single 0 t) x = t * x
proof:
:= by
  unfold oddScalarUpdate
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro j hj hj0; simp [Pi.single_apply, hj0]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.abs_one_sub_two_div_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_one_sub_two_div_mul_le {a b x : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :
    |1 - (2 / (a + b)) * x| ≤ (b - a) / (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < a + b := by linarith
  have hlo : 1 - (b - a) / (a + b) = (2 / (a + b)) * a := by field_simp; ring
  have hhi : 1 + (b - a) / (a + b) = (2 / (a + b)) * b := by field_simp; ring
  have hca : (2 / (a + b)) * a ≤ (2 / (a + b)) * x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 (by positivity)
  have hcb : (2 / (a + b)) * x ≤ (2 / (a + b)) * b :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 (by positivity)
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.IsOddMinimaxOn.error_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < a + b := by linarith
  have hr : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (a + b) := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab) hs.le
  have he : oddUniformError q (Pi.single 0 (2 / (a + b))) a b ≤ (b - a) / (a + b) := by
    apply oddUniformError_le_of_forall hr
    intro x hx
    rw [oddScalarUpdate_single_zero]
    exact abs_one_sub_two_div_mul_le ha hab hx
  exact ((h _).trans he).trans_lt ((div_lt_one hs).mpr (by linarith))

name: NLAlib.exists_oddScalarUpdate_interval_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_oddScalarUpdate_interval_bounds (q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ m M : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Icc a b, m ≤ oddScalarUpdate q c x ∧ oddScalarUpdate q c x ≤ M) ∧
      (∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = m) ∧
      (∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn (nonempty_Icc.mpr hab)
    (continuous_oddScalarUpdate q c).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmax⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (nonempty_Icc.mpr hab)
    (continuous_oddScalarUpdate q c).continuousOn
  exact ⟨oddScalarUpdate q c x, oddScalarUpdate q c y,
    fun z hz => ⟨hmin hz, hmax hz⟩, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.IsOddMinimaxOn.interval_image_normalized
statement:
theorem IsOddMinimaxOn.interval_image_normalized {q : ℕ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {a b m M : ℝ}
    (h : IsOddMinimaxOn q c a b) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounds : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, m ≤ oddScalarUpdate q c x ∧ oddScalarUpdate q c x ≤ M)
    (hm : ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = m)
    (hM : ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = M) :
    0 < m ∧ m ≤ M ∧ m + M = 2 ∧ oddUniformError q c a b = 1 - m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xm, hxm, hxmval⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨xM, hxM, hxMval⟩ := hM
  have hem : |1 - m| ≤ oddUniformError q c a b := by
    simpa only [hxmval] using abs_one_sub_oddScalarUpdate_le q c a b xm hxm
  have heM : |1 - M| ≤ oddUniformError q c a b := by
    simpa only [hxMval] using abs_one_sub_oddScalarUpdate_le q c a b xM hxM
  have hE := h.error_lt_one ha hab
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by have hh := (abs_le.mp hem).2; linarith
  have hmM : m ≤ M := by simpa only [hxmval] using (hbounds xm hxm).2
  have hs : 0 < m + M := by linarith
  have hscaled : oddUniformError q (fun j => (2 / (m + M)) * c j) a b ≤
      (M - m) / (m + M) := by
    apply oddUniformError_le_of_forall (div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmM) hs.le)
    intro x hx
    rw [oddScalarUpdate_smul_coeff]
    exact abs_one_sub_two_div_mul_le hmpos hmM (hbounds x hx)
  have hratio : oddUniformError q c a b * (m + M) ≤ M - m :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp ((h _).trans hscaled)
  have hcenter : m + M = 2 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy (m + M) 2 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have hlo : 1 - m ≤ oddUniformError q c a b := (le_abs_self _).trans hem
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo hs.le
      nlinarith
    · exact heq
    · have hhi : M - 1 ≤ oddUniformError q c a b := by
        have hh := (neg_le_abs (1 - M)).trans heM
        linarith
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhi hs.le
      have hMpos : 0 < M := hmpos.trans_le hmM
      nlinarith
  have hnorm : oddUniformError q c a b ≤ 1 - m := by
    apply oddUniformError_le_of_forall (by linarith)
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hbounds x hx
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  exact ⟨hmpos, hmM, hcenter, le_antisymm hnorm ((le_abs_self _).trans hem)⟩

name: NLAlib.sign_sin_mul_eq_neg_one_pow_of_between_grid
proof:
:= by
  let u := ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t - (j : ℝ) * Real.pi
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hleft := ht.1
  have hright := ht.2
  simp only [sawtoothGridAngle, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hleft hright
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN] at hleft
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ hN] at hright
  have hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
    dsimp [u]
    push_cast
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hs := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hu.1 hu.2
  have hphase : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t = u + (j : ℝ) * Real.pi := by dsimp [u]; ring
  rw [hphase, sin_add_nat_mul_pi]
  rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℝ j with h | h
  · rw [h, one_mul, Real.sign_of_pos hs]
  · rw [h, neg_one_mul, Real.sign_neg, Real.sign_of_pos hs]

name: NLAlib.abs_sawtoothError_eq_sign_sin_mul_on_grid_cell
