name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_sign_sin_mul_sin
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_sign_sin_mul_sin (N k : ℕ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.sign (sin ((N : ℝ) * t)) * sin ((k : ℝ) * t))
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegrable_fourier_mul_jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (-(k : ℤ))
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
        (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)).im)
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨Complex.imCLM.integrable_comp h.1, Complex.imCLM.integrable_comp h.2⟩
  have hterm : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
        (jacksonSquareWaveCircle N (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)).im =
        -(Real.sign (sin ((N : ℝ) * t)) * sin ((k : ℝ) * t)) := by
    intro t
    rw [fourier_neg]
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.conj_im,
      im_fourier_nat_coe_eq_sin, jacksonSquareWaveCircle_coe_eq, mul_zero, zero_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at hi
  have hneg := hi.neg
  change IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => -(-(Real.sign (sin ((N : ℝ) * t)) * sin ((k : ℝ) * t))))
    volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) at hneg
  simpa only [neg_neg] using hneg

name: NLAlib.integral_sign_sin_mul_sawtoothApprox_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_sign_sin_mul_sawtoothApprox_eq_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sawtoothApprox n t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sine_expansion_sawtoothApprox n
  simp_rw [hc, mul_sum]
  have hfun : ∀ j ∈ range n, (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * (c j * sin (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t))) =
      (fun t : ℝ => c j * (Real.sign (sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) * sin (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t))) := by
    intro j hj
    funext t
    ring
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j hj => by
    rw [hfun j hj]
    exact (intervalIntegrable_sign_sin_mul_sin (n + 1) (j + 1)).const_mul (c j))]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro j hj
  rw [hfun j hj, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    integral_sign_sin_mul_sin_eq_zero (by omega) (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.resolvent_smoothing_coefficient_pos

proof:

name: NLAlib.doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_on_tail
statement:
theorem doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_on_tail {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 4*(n:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    0 < (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).eval x ∧
      0 < (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg (r : ℕ) :
      0 ≤ ((derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).eval x :=
    iterate_derivative_laguerreExponentialProjection_eval_nonneg n r hx
  rw [doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_sum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · rw [eval_finsetSum]
    apply mul_pos (by norm_num)
    have hterm (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (((4/3:ℝ)^(r+1)-(1/4:ℝ)^(r+1)) •
        (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).eval x := by
      rw [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_nonneg (resolvent_smoothing_coefficient_pos r).le (hnonneg r)
    have h0 : 0 < (((4/3:ℝ)^(0+1)-(1/4:ℝ)^(0+1)) •
        (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[0] (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).eval x := by
      rw [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
      exact mul_pos (resolvent_smoothing_coefficient_pos 0)
        (laguerreExponentialProjection_eval_pos n hx)
    exact h0.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum (fun r _ => hterm r)
      (show 0 ∈ Finset.range (n+1) by simp))
  · rw [derivative_smul, map_sum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_finsetSum]
    apply mul_pos (by norm_num)
    have hterm (r : ℕ) :
        0 ≤ (derivative (((4/3:ℝ)^(r+1)-(1/4:ℝ)^(r+1)) •
          (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] (laguerreExponentialProjection n))).eval x := by
      rw [derivative_smul, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using
        mul_nonneg (resolvent_smoothing_coefficient_pos r).le (hnonneg (r+1))
    have h0 :
        0 < (derivative (((4/3:ℝ)^(0+1)-(1/4:ℝ)^(0+1)) •
          (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[0] (laguerreExponentialProjection n))).eval x := by
      rw [derivative_smul, Function.iterate_zero_apply, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_pos (resolvent_smoothing_coefficient_pos 0)
        (laguerreExponentialProjection_derivative_eval_pos hn hx)
    exact h0.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum (fun r _ => hterm r)
      (show 0 ∈ Finset.range (n+1) by simp))

name: NLAlib.doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_halfLine

  have hterm : ∀ r, interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian n t r i =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + i.val) *
        ((interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t r) *
          Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t) r) := by

        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (r.val + i.val) *
          (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t r)) =
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (r.val + i.val) * |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t) r|) *
          (interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i).eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t r) by ring,
      neg_one_pow_mul_abs_nodalWeight hτ r i.val]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm]

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_sum_smul_gapDirection_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pos_sum_smul_gapDirection_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) :
    ∃ π : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < π i) ∧ (∑ i, π i) = 1 ∧
      (∑ i, ((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * π i) • interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hsum, hker⟩ := strictColumnLaplacian_exists_pos_kernel_sum_one
    (interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian n t) (interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian_offdiag_pos hn ht)
    (sum_interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian_col hn ht)
  refine ⟨π, hπ, hsum, ?_⟩
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∑ i, ((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * π i) • interpolationGapDividedDerivative n t i
  have hp := degree_sum_smul_gapDirection_lt hn ht (fun i => (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * π i)
  have hτ := strictMono_interpolationGapCriticalPoint hn ht
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero univ hτ.injective.injOn
    (hp.trans_le (by simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n))
  intro r hr
  have hb : |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t) r| ≠ 0 :=
    abs_ne_zero.mpr (Lagrange.nodalWeight_ne_zero hτ.injective.injOn hr)
  have hs : (-1 : ℝ) ^ r.val ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have hrow := congrFun hker r
  have heq : (∑ i, interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian n t r i * π i) =
      (|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t) r| * (-1 : ℝ) ^ r.val) *
        p.eval (interpolationGapCriticalPoint n t r) := by
    dsimp [p]
    rw [eval_finsetSum, mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp only [interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, pow_add]
    ring
  change (∑ i, interpolationGapEvaluationLaplacian n t r i * π i) = 0 at hrow
  rw [heq] at hrow
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hrow).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hb hs)

name: NLAlib.abs_prod_eq_neg_one_pow_filter_mul
statement:
private theorem abs_prod_eq_neg_one_pow_filter_mul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    |∏ k ∈ s, f k| = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (s.filter (fun k => f k < 0)).card * ∏ k ∈ s, f k
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ k, |f k| = (if f k < 0 then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) * f k := by
    intro k
    split_ifs with hk
    · rw [abs_of_neg hk]; ring
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hk), one_mul]
  rw [abs_prod]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [prod_mul_distrib, prod_ite]
  simp only [prod_const, one_pow, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.eval_lagrange_basis_eq_prod_div
statement:
theorem eval_lagrange_basis_eq_prod_div {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → ℝ) (j : Fin m) (x : ℝ) :
    (Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x =
      ∏ k ∈ univ.erase j, (x - v k) / (v j - v k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lagrange.basis, eval_prod, Lagrange.basisDivisor, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X]
  apply prod_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapSign_mul_eval_basis_eq_abs
statement:
theorem interpolationGapSign_mul_eval_basis_eq_abs {n : ℕ}
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) :
    interpolationGapSign n i j * (Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x =
      |(Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x|
proof:
:= by
  have hleft (k : Fin (n + 2)) (hk : k.val ≤ i.val) : v k < x :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (hv.monotone (by exact hk)) hx.1
  have hright (k : Fin (n + 2)) (hk : i.val < k.val) : x < v k :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 (hv.monotone (by change i.val + 1 ≤ k.val; omega))
  rw [eval_lagrange_basis_eq_prod_div]
  rw [abs_prod_eq_neg_one_pow_filter_mul]
  congr 1
  unfold interpolationGapSign
  split_ifs with hji
  · have hfilter : (univ.erase j).filter (fun k => (x - v k) / (v j - v k) < 0) =
        Finset.Ioc j i.castSucc := by
      ext k
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_Ioc]
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst k
        simp
      · by_cases hki : k.val ≤ i.val
        · have hnum : 0 < x - v k := sub_pos.mpr (hleft k hki)
          by_cases hjk : j < k
          · have hden : v j - v k < 0 := sub_neg.mpr (hv hjk)
            have hneg := div_neg_of_pos_of_neg hnum hden
            simp only [hneg]
            exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨hjk, hki⟩, fun _ => ⟨hkj, trivial⟩⟩
          · have hkj' : k < j := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hjk) hkj
            have hpos := div_pos hnum (sub_pos.mpr (hv hkj'))
            have hnot : ¬ (x - v k) / (v j - v k) < 0 := not_lt_of_ge hpos.le
            simp only [hnot, hjk, false_and, and_false]
        · have hnum : x - v k < 0 := sub_neg.mpr (hright k (by omega))
          have hjk : j < k := by change j.val < k.val; omega
          have hpos := div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hnum (sub_neg.mpr (hv hjk))
          have hnot : ¬ (x - v k) / (v j - v k) < 0 := not_lt_of_ge hpos.le
          have hkI : ¬ k ≤ i.castSucc := by exact hki
          simp only [hnot, hkI, and_false]
    rw [hfilter, Fin.card_Ioc]
    rfl
  · have hij : i.val < j.val := by omega
    have hfilter : (univ.erase j).filter (fun k => (x - v k) / (v j - v k) < 0) =
        Finset.Ioo i.castSucc j := by
      ext k
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_Ioo]
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst k
        simp
      · by_cases hki : k.val ≤ i.val
        · have hnum : 0 < x - v k := sub_pos.mpr (hleft k hki)
          have hkj' : k < j := by change k.val < j.val; omega
          have hpos := div_pos hnum (sub_pos.mpr (hv hkj'))
          have hnot : ¬ (x - v k) / (v j - v k) < 0 := not_lt_of_ge hpos.le
          have hkI : ¬ i.castSucc < k := by change ¬ i.val < k.val; omega
          simp only [hnot, hkI, false_and, and_false]
        · have hnum : x - v k < 0 := sub_neg.mpr (hright k (by omega))
          by_cases hkj' : k < j
          · have hneg := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hnum (sub_pos.mpr (hv hkj'))
            have hkI : i.castSucc < k := by change i.val < k.val; omega
            simp only [hneg]
            exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨hkI, hkj'⟩, fun _ => ⟨hkj, trivial⟩⟩
          · have hjk : j < k := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hkj') (Ne.symm hkj)
            have hpos := div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hnum (sub_neg.mpr (hv hjk))
            have hnot : ¬ (x - v k) / (v j - v k) < 0 := not_lt_of_ge hpos.le
            simp only [hnot, hkj', and_false]
    rw [hfilter, Fin.card_Ioo]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction
proof:
:= by
  simp only [interpolationGapPolynomial, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul,
    eval_C, lebesgueFunction]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact interpolationGapSign_mul_eval_basis_eq_abs ht i j hx

name: NLAlib.eval_basis_ne_zero_on_gap
statement:
theorem eval_basis_ne_zero_on_gap {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) :
    (Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_lagrange_basis_eq_prod_div]
  apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro k hk
  have hkj : k ≠ j := (mem_erase.mp hk).1
  apply div_ne_zero
  · apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
    by_cases hki : k.val ≤ i.val
    · exact (lt_of_le_of_lt (hv.monotone (show k ≤ i.castSucc from hki)) hx.1).ne'
    · exact (lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 (hv.monotone (show i.succ ≤ k by change i.val + 1 ≤ k.val; omega))).ne
  · exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hkj (hv.injective h.symm))

name: NLAlib.exists_negative_eval_basis_on_gap
statement:
theorem exists_negative_eval_basis_on_gap {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (i : Fin (n + 1)) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) :
    ∃ j : Fin (n + 2), (Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsign : ∃ j : Fin (n + 2), interpolationGapSign n i j = -1 := by
    by_cases hi : i.val = 0
    · refine ⟨⟨2, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [interpolationGapSign, hi]
    · refine ⟨⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      have hle : i.val - 1 ≤ i.val := by omega
      have hsub : i.val - (i.val - 1) = 1 := by omega
      simp only [interpolationGapSign, hle, if_true, hsub, pow_one]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsign
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  have heq := interpolationGapSign_mul_eval_basis_eq_abs hv i j hx
  rw [hj, neg_one_mul] at heq
  have hne := eval_basis_ne_zero_on_gap hv i j hx
  have ha : 0 < |(Lagrange.basis univ v j).eval x| := abs_pos.mpr hne
  linarith

name: NLAlib.one_lt_lebesgueFunction_on_gap
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_negative_eval_basis_on_gap hn hv i hx
  have hsum : (∑ k : Fin (n + 2), (Lagrange.basis univ v k).eval x) = 1 := by
    rw [← eval_finsetSum, Lagrange.sum_basis hv.injective.injOn (by simp), eval_one]
  rw [← hsum, lebesgueFunction]
  apply sum_lt_sum (fun k _ => le_abs_self _) ⟨j, mem_univ j, ?_⟩
  rw [abs_of_neg hj]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node
statement:
theorem eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t j) =
      interpolationGapSign n i j
proof:
:= by
  exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ (ht.injective.injOn) (mem_univ j)

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_gap_endpoints
statement:
theorem eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_gap_endpoints {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) = 1 ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node ht, interpolationGapSign, Fin.val_castSucc,
    Fin.val_succ, le_refl, if_true, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, Nat.not_succ_le_self,
    if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.one_lt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction ht i hx]
  exact one_lt_lebesgueFunction_on_gap hn ht i hx

name: NLAlib.derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {t : Fin n → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  let a := canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc
  let b := canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ
  have hab : a < b := ht (show i.castSucc < i.succ from Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)
  have hmid : (a + b) / 2 ∈ Ioo a b := by constructor <;> linarith
  have hval := one_lt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial hn ht i hmid
  have ha := (eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_gap_endpoints ht i).1
  rw [eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero hc, eval_C] at hval ha
  linarith

name: NLAlib.nodePartition
statement:
private theorem nodePartition {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Disjoint (outsideNodes i j) (insideNodes i j) ∧ outsideNodes i j ∪ insideNodes i j = univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro k hk hk'
    simp only [outsideNodes, insideNodes, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hk hk'
    omega
  · ext k
    simp only [outsideNodes, insideNodes, mem_union, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hk; trivial
    · intro hk
      by_cases hki : k.val ≤ i.val
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hki)
      · by_cases hkj : j.val < k.val
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hkj)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

name: NLAlib.gap_pair_cross_coefficient_pos
statement:
private theorem gap_pair_cross_coefficient_pos {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i < j)
    {a b : Fin (n + 2)} (ha : a ∈ outsideNodes i j) (hb : b ∈ insideNodes i j) :
    0 < interpolationGapSign n i a * interpolationGapSign n i b *
      Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a *
      Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b *
      (canonicalIntervalNodes n t a - canonicalIntervalNodes n t b)
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : StrictMono (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) := ht
  have hwa : 0 < |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| := abs_pos.mpr
    (Lagrange.nodalWeight_ne_zero hmono.injective.injOn (mem_univ a))
  have hwb : 0 < |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b| := abs_pos.mpr
    (Lagrange.nodalWeight_ne_zero hmono.injective.injOn (mem_univ b))
  have heps : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  simp only [outsideNodes, insideNodes, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at ha hb
  have hbni : ¬b.val ≤ i.val := by omega
  have hrewrite : interpolationGapSign n i a * interpolationGapSign n i b *
      Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a *
      Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b =
    (interpolationGapSign n i a * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a) *
    (interpolationGapSign n i b * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b) := by ring
  rw [hrewrite, interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight hmono i a,
    interpolationGapSign_mul_nodalWeight hmono i b, if_neg hbni]
  rcases ha with hale | halt
  · rw [if_pos hale]
    have hab : a < b := by exact Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega)
    have hd := sub_neg.mpr (hmono hab)
    have hscalar : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) *
        |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| *
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) * -|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b|) =
        -(|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| *
          |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b|) := by
      calc
        _ = -(((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1)) ^ 2) *
          (|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| *
            |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b|) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [heps]; ring
    rw [hscalar]
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos (mul_pos hwa hwb)) hd
  · have hani : ¬a.val ≤ i.val := by have := hij; omega
    rw [if_neg hani]
    have hba : b < a := by exact Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega)
    have hd := sub_pos.mpr (hmono hba)
    have hscalar : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) *
        -|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| *
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1) * -|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b|) =
        |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| *
          |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b| := by
      calc
        _ = (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + n + 1)) ^ 2) *
          (|Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) a| *
            |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) b|) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [heps, one_mul]
    rw [hscalar]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hwa hwb) hd

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapPolynomial_wronskian_sign
statement:
theorem interpolationGapPolynomial_wronskian_sign {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i < j) (x : ℝ) :
    0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val - i.val) *
      ((interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval x * (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).eval x -
        (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval x * (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j).derivative.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  let nodes := canonicalIntervalNodes n t
  let f := fun k => C (interpolationGapSign n i k) * Lagrange.basis univ nodes k
  let U : ℝ[X] := ∑ k ∈ outsideNodes i j, f k
  let V : ℝ[X] := ∑ k ∈ insideNodes i j, f k
  let s : ℝ := (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val - i.val)
  have hv : StrictMono nodes := ht
  have hpart := nodePartition i j
  have hUn : (outsideNodes i j).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [outsideNodes]⟩
  have hVn : (insideNodes i j).Nonempty := ⟨i.succ, by
    simp only [insideNodes, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Fin.val_succ]
    have hij' : i.val < j.val := hij
    omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < (Polynomial.wronskian U V).eval x :=
    wronskian_lagrange_partition_pos nodes hv.injective _ _ hpart.1 hpart.2 hUn hVn
      (interpolationGapSign n i) (interpolationGapSign n i)
      (fun a ha b hb => gap_pair_cross_coefficient_pos ht i j hij ha hb) x
  have hi : interpolationGapPolynomial n t i = U + V := by
    unfold interpolationGapPolynomial
    rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply]
    change (∑ k ∈ univ, f k) = U + V
    rw [← hpart.2, sum_union hpart.1]
  have hj : C s * interpolationGapPolynomial n t j = U - V := by
    unfold interpolationGapPolynomial
    rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, mul_sum]
    have hc : ∀ k, C s * (C (interpolationGapSign n j k) * Lagrange.basis univ nodes k) =
        if k ∈ insideNodes i j then -f k else f k := by
      intro k
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, interpolationGapSign_relative hv i j hij.le k]
      simp only [insideNodes, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      split_ifs <;> simp [f, map_neg]
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => hc k), ← hpart.2, sum_union hpart.1]
    have hout : ∀ k ∈ outsideNodes i j, (if k ∈ insideNodes i j then -f k else f k) = f k := by
      intro k hk
      exact if_neg (disjoint_left.mp hpart.1 hk)
    have hin : ∀ k ∈ insideNodes i j, (if k ∈ insideNodes i j then -f k else f k) = -f k := by
      intro k hk; exact if_pos hk
    rw [sum_congr rfl hout, sum_congr rfl hin, sum_neg_distrib, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hidentity : C s * Polynomial.wronskian (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i)
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j) = -C (2 : ℝ) * Polynomial.wronskian U V := by
    have hconst := wronskian_C_mul_C_mul (1 : ℝ) s
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i) (interpolationGapPolynomial n t j)
    simp only [map_one, one_mul] at hconst
    rw [← hconst, hi, hj]
    simp only [Polynomial.wronskian, derivative_add, derivative_sub, map_ofNat]
    ring
  have heval := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.eval x) hidentity
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_neg, Polynomial.wronskian, eval_sub] at heval
  have hpos' : 0 < U.eval x * V.derivative.eval x - U.derivative.eval x * V.eval x := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.wronskian, eval_sub, eval_mul] using hpos
  change 0 < s * _
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_of_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_of_equioscillation {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    {n : ℕ} (f : C(s, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → s} (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)))
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : |σ| = 1)
    (hosc : ∀ i, f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ) =
      σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖) :
    ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ = minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  have hupper := minimaxError_le_norm_sub f
    (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  apply le_antisymm ?_ hupper
  by_cases hE : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ = 0
  · rw [hE]; exact minimaxError_nonneg n f
  · have hEpos : 0 < ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hE)
    have habs : ∀ i, |f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ)| = ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ := by
      intro i
      rw [hosc, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, hσ]
      simp [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    apply le_minimaxError_of_alternation f hp hv ?_ (fun i => (habs i).ge)
    intro i
    have hnext : f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ : ℝ) =
        -(f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hosc, hosc]
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hne : f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have := habs i.castSucc
      rw [hzero, abs_zero] at this
      linarith
    rw [hnext]
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hne]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_sawtoothApprox
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sawtoothApprox (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (sawtoothApprox n) ((sawtoothDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos t)) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_sin t).mul
    (((sawtoothSineInterp n).hasDerivAt (cos t)).comp t (hasDerivAt_cos t))
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  simp only [sawtoothDerivativePolynomial, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_one, eval_pow,
    Function.comp_apply]
  linear_combination (sawtoothSineInterp n).derivative.eval (cos t) * sin_sq_add_cos_sq t

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_sawtoothError
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sawtoothError (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.pi - t - sawtoothApprox n t)
      (-(sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).eval (cos t)) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const t Real.pi).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).sub
    (hasDerivAt_sawtoothApprox n t)
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  simp [sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial]
  ring

name: NLAlib.degree_sawtoothDerivativePolynomial_le
statement:
theorem degree_sawtoothDerivativePolynomial_le (n : ℕ) :
    (sawtoothDerivativePolynomial n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp [sawtoothDerivativePolynomial, sawtoothSineInterp]
  · let p := sawtoothSineInterp n
    have hp : p.natDegree < n := by
      rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with hp0 | hp0
      · simpa [hp0] using hn
      · exact (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr (degree_sawtoothSineInterp_lt n)
    change (X * p - (1 - X ^ 2) * p.derivative).natDegree ≤ n
    have hX : (X * p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 + p.natDegree := by
      simpa only [natDegree_X] using (natDegree_mul_le (p := (X : ℝ[X])) (q := p))
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.natDegree with hp0 | hp0
    · rw [Polynomial.derivative_eq_zero.mpr hp0, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      omega
    · have hquadratic : (1 - X ^ 2 : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 2 := by
        refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_) <;> simp
      have hD : ((1 - X ^ 2) * p.derivative : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 2 + (p.natDegree - 1) :=
        (natDegree_mul_le (p := 1 - X ^ 2) (q := p.derivative)).trans
          (Nat.add_le_add hquadratic (natDegree_derivative_le p))
      exact (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (by omega) (by omega))

name: NLAlib.degree_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_le
statement:
theorem degree_sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_le (n : ℕ) :
    (sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial
  refine (degree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ (degree_sawtoothDerivativePolynomial_le n))
  exact degree_one_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n)

name: NLAlib.sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial_ne_zero (n : ℕ) :
    sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (sawtoothApprox n) := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    (fun t => (hasDerivAt_sawtoothApprox n t).continuousAt)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hd⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero Real.pi_pos hc.continuousOn
    (by simp) (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_sawtoothApprox n t)
  intro hzero
  have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (cos t)) hzero
  simp only [sawtoothErrorDerivativePolynomial, eval_add, eval_one, eval_zero, hd] at h
  norm_num at h

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_comp_equiv {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (v : ι → ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) (x : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction (v ∘ e) x = lebesgueFunction v x
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  simp_rw [lagrange_basis_univ_comp_equiv]
  exact e.sum_comp (fun i => |(Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x|)

name: NLAlib.strictAnti_chebyshevZero
statement: theorem strictAnti_chebyshevZero (N : ℕ) : StrictAnti (chebyshevZero N)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt)
  have hθi := chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo i
  have hθj := chebyshev_root_angle_mem_Ioo j
  rw [chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index, chebyshevZero_eq_cos_half_index]
  apply strictAntiOn_cos ⟨hθi.1.le, hθi.2.le⟩ ⟨hθj.1.le, hθj.2.le⟩
  apply div_lt_div_of_pos_right _ hNR
  apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ pi_pos
  have hijR : (i : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hij
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_canonical_reference_grid_logarithmic_lower_lt_peaks
statement:
theorem exists_canonical_reference_grid_logarithmic_lower_lt_peaks (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n, ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (2 / π) * (log (n + 2 : ℕ) + eulerMascheroniConstant + log (4 / π)) <
        interpolationGapPeak n t i
proof:
:= by
  let v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ := fun j => chebyshevZero (n + 2) j.rev
  have hv : StrictMono v := by
    intro i j hij
    exact strictAnti_chebyshevZero (n + 2) (Fin.rev_strictAnti hij)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, α, hα, β, hrep⟩ := exists_canonical_nodes_affine v hv
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun i => ?_⟩
  let k := n + 1 - (i : ℕ)
  have hk0 : 1 ≤ k := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hkN : k < n + 2 := by dsimp [k]; omega
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hbound⟩ := exists_mem_chebyshevZero_gap_logarithmic_lower_lt
    (show 2 ≤ n + 2 by omega) hk0 hkN
  have hleft : v i.castSucc = chebyshevZero (n + 2) ⟨k, hkN⟩ := by
    change chebyshevZero (n + 2) i.castSucc.rev = _
    apply congrArg (chebyshevZero (n + 2))
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_castSucc]
    dsimp [k]
    omega
  have hright : v i.succ = chebyshevZero (n + 2) ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ := by
    change chebyshevZero (n + 2) i.succ.rev = _
    apply congrArg (chebyshevZero (n + 2))
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_succ]
    dsimp [k]
    omega
  have hyv : y ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) := by rwa [hleft, hright]
  let z := (y - β) / α
  have hz : z ∈ Icc (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ) := by
    have hL := hrep i.castSucc
    have hR := hrep i.succ
    constructor
    · apply (le_div_iff₀ hα).mpr
      linarith [hyv.1]
    · apply (div_le_iff₀ hα).mpr
      linarith [hyv.2]
  have hleb : lebesgueFunction (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) z = lebesgueFunction (chebyshevZero (n + 2)) y := by
    have hnodes : (fun j => α * canonicalIntervalNodes n t j + β) = v := funext hrep
    have heq : α * z + β = y := by dsimp [z]; field_simp; ring
    have h := lebesgueFunction_affine (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) z α β hα.ne'
    rw [hnodes, heq] at h
    have hreindex := lebesgueFunction_comp_equiv (chebyshevZero (n + 2)) Fin.revPerm y
    change lebesgueFunction v y = lebesgueFunction (chebyshevZero (n + 2)) y at hreindex
    exact h.symm.trans hreindex
  calc
    _ < lebesgueFunction (canonicalIntervalNodes n t) z := by rw [hleb]; exact hbound
    _ ≤ interpolationGapPeak n t i := lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ hz

name: NLAlib.exists_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_degree_le_add_natDegree
statement:
theorem exists_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_degree_le_add_natDegree {m n : ℕ} {p q H : ℝ[X]}
    (hcop : IsCoprime p q) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hpdeg : p.degree ≤ m) (hqdeg : q.degree ≤ n)
    (hH : H.degree ≤ ↑(m + q.natDegree)) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ m ∧ Q.degree ≤ n ∧ P * q - p * Q = H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := hcop
  let Q := (-A * H) % q
  let P := B * H - p * ((-A * H) / q)
  have hmod : q * ((-A * H) / q) + Q = -A * H := EuclideanDomain.div_add_mod _ _
  have hrel : P * q - p * Q = H := by
    dsimp [P]
    linear_combination H * hAB - p * hmod
  have hQ : Q.degree ≤ n := (degree_mod_lt (-A * H) hq).le.trans hqdeg
  have hQq : Q.degree ≤ (q.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) :=
    (degree_mod_lt (-A * H) hq).le.trans degree_le_natDegree
  have hmul : (p * Q).degree ≤ ↑(m + q.natDegree) := by
    calc
      (p * Q).degree ≤ p.degree + Q.degree := degree_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ) + q.natDegree := add_le_add hpdeg hQq
      _ = ↑(m + q.natDegree) := by simp
  have hPq : (P * q).degree ≤ ↑(m + q.natDegree) := by
    have heq : P * q = H + p * Q := by linear_combination hrel
    rw [heq]
    exact (degree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le hH hmul)
  refine ⟨P, Q, ?_, hQ, hrel⟩
  by_cases hP : P = 0
  · simp [hP]
  · have hn : (P * q).natDegree ≤ m + q.natDegree :=
      natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hPq
    rw [natDegree_mul hP hq] at hn
    exact degree_le_natDegree.trans (by exact_mod_cast (show P.natDegree ≤ m by omega))

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_isCoprime {m n : ℕ} {p q H : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hcop : IsCoprime p q)
    (hpdeg : p.degree ≤ m) (hqdeg : q.degree ≤ n)
    (hH : H.degree ≤ ↑(max (m + q.natDegree) (n + p.natDegree))) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ m ∧ Q.degree ≤ n ∧ P * q - p * Q = H
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (n + p.natDegree) (m + q.natDegree) with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_left h] at hH
    exact exists_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_degree_le_add_natDegree hcop hq hpdeg hqdeg hH
  · rw [max_eq_right h] at hH
    obtain ⟨Q, P, hQ, hP, hrel⟩ := exists_mul_sub_mul_eq_of_degree_le_add_natDegree
      hcop.symm hp hqdeg hpdeg (H := -H) (by simpa using hH)
    refine ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, ?_⟩
    linear_combination -hrel

name: NLAlib.add_sub_min_sub_eq_max_add
statement:
theorem add_sub_min_sub_eq_max_add {m n μ ν : ℕ} (hμ : μ ≤ m) (hν : ν ≤ n) :
    m + n - min (m - μ) (n - ν) = max (m + ν) (n + μ)
proof: := by omega

name: NLAlib.abs_interpolationGapSign
statement:
theorem abs_interpolationGapSign (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    |interpolationGapSign n i j| = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolationGapSign
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapSign_succ_eq_neg
statement:
theorem interpolationGapSign_succ_eq_neg {n : ℕ} (i k : Fin (n + 1)) (hki : k ≠ i) :
    interpolationGapSign n i k.succ = -interpolationGapSign n i k.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolationGapSign
  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
  by_cases hk : k.val < i.val
  · have h0 : k.val ≤ i.val := by omega
    have h1 : k.val + 1 ≤ i.val := by omega
    rw [if_pos h0, if_pos h1]
    have he : i.val - k.val = (i.val - (k.val + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, pow_succ]
    ring
  · have hik : i.val < k.val := by
      have hne : k.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hki (Fin.ext h)
      omega
    have h0 : ¬ k.val ≤ i.val := by omega
    have h1 : ¬ k.val + 1 ≤ i.val := by omega
    rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h1]
    have he : k.val + 1 - i.val - 1 = (k.val - i.val - 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, pow_succ]
    ring

name: NLAlib.exists_root_interpolationGapPolynomial_other_gap
statement:
theorem exists_root_interpolationGapPolynomial_other_gap {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i k : Fin (n + 1)) (hki : k ≠ i) :
    ∃ r ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.succ),
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval r = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := interpolationGapPolynomial n t i
  let a := canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.castSucc
  let b := canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.succ
  have hab : a < b := ht (show k.castSucc < k.succ from Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)
  have ha : p.eval a = interpolationGapSign n i k.castSucc := eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node ht i _
  have hb : p.eval b = -p.eval a := by
    rw [show p.eval b = interpolationGapSign n i k.succ from eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_node ht i _,
      interpolationGapSign_succ_eq_neg i k hki, ha]
  have h0 : 0 ∈ uIcc (p.eval a) (p.eval b) := by
    by_cases hpa : 0 ≤ p.eval a
    · exact mem_uIcc_of_ge (by rw [hb]; linarith) hpa
    · exact mem_uIcc_of_le (le_of_not_ge hpa) (by rw [hb]; linarith)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hroot⟩ := intermediate_value_uIcc p.continuousOn h0
  rw [uIcc_of_le hab.le] at hr
  have ha0 : p.eval a ≠ 0 := by
    have h := abs_interpolationGapSign n i k.castSucc
    rw [← ha] at h
    intro hz
    rw [hz, abs_zero] at h
    norm_num at h
  have hb0 : p.eval b ≠ 0 := by rw [hb]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0
  have hra : a < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr.1 (fun he => ha0 (he ▸ hroot))
  have hrb : r < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hr.2 (fun he => hb0 (he ▸ hroot))
  exact ⟨r, ⟨hra, hrb⟩, hroot⟩

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapPolynomial_splits
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J := {k : Fin (n + 1) // k ∈ (univ.erase i : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))}
  have hex : ∀ k : J, ∃ r ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.val.castSucc)
      (canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.val.succ), (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval r = 0 := by
    intro k
    exact exists_root_interpolationGapPolynomial_other_gap ht i k.val (mem_erase.mp k.property).1
  choose r hr hroot using hex
  have hinj : Function.Injective r := by
    intro k l hkl
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply le_antisymm
    · by_contra hnot
      have hlk : l.val < k.val := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hnodes : canonicalIntervalNodes n t l.val.succ ≤ canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.val.castSucc :=
        ht.monotone (by change l.val.val + 1 ≤ k.val.val; omega)
      have hrlk : r l < r k := (hr l).2.trans_le hnodes |>.trans (hr k).1
      exact hrlk.ne hkl.symm
    · by_contra hnot
      have hkl' : k.val < l.val := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hnodes : canonicalIntervalNodes n t k.val.succ ≤ canonicalIntervalNodes n t l.val.castSucc :=
        ht.monotone (by change k.val.val + 1 ≤ l.val.val; omega)
      have hrkl : r k < r l := (hr k).2.trans_le hnodes |>.trans (hr l).1
      exact hrkl.ne hkl
  let s : Finset ℝ := univ.image r
  have hcard : s.card = n := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
    simp only [card_univ, J, Fintype.card_coe, card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ i), card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hp0 : interpolationGapPolynomial n t i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp0
    apply derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial_ne_zero hn ht i
    rw [hp0, derivative_zero]
  apply polynomial_splits_of_natDegree_le_card_add_one hp0 s
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    exact hroot k
  · rw [hcard]
    have hd := Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (s := univ) (interpolationGapSign n i) ht.injective.injOn
    have hnat : (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).natDegree < n + 2 := by
      apply (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr
      simpa only [interpolationGapPolynomial, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hd
    omega

name: NLAlib.exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f)
    (hE : 0 < ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖) :
    ∃ v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b, StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, |f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ)| = ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ)) *
          (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ : ℝ)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  let g := f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)
  let e : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM g
  let E := ‖g‖
  have heval : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Icc a b), e x = g ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    fun x hx => ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem hx
  let K := Icc a b ∩ (fun x => |e x|) ⁻¹' {E}
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.inter_right
    (isClosed_singleton.preimage (e.continuous.abs))
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hlt : ‖g‖ < E := (ContinuousMap.norm_lt_iff g hE).mpr (by
      intro x
      have hne : |g x| ≠ E := by
        intro hx
        exact hnone ⟨x, x.property, by
          change |e x| = E
          rw [heval _ x.property]; exact hx⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (g.norm_coe_le_norm x) hne)
    exact lt_irrefl E hlt
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hK.exists_isLeast hKne
  have hcab : c ∈ Icc a b := hc.1.1
  have hcE : |e c| = E := hc.1.2
  rcases exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation n e E c b
      e.continuous hE hcab.2 hcE with ⟨q, hq, hqsign, _⟩ | ⟨v, hv, hvext, hvsign⟩
  · let h : C(Icc a b, ℝ) := q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)
    have hsign : ∀ x : Icc a b, |g x| = ‖g‖ → 0 < g x * h x := by
      intro x hx
      have hex : |e x| = E := by rw [heval _ x.property]; exact hx
      have hcx : c ≤ x := hc.2 ⟨x.property, hex⟩
      have hpos := hqsign x ⟨hcx, x.property.2⟩ hex
      simpa [heval _ x.property, h] using hpos
    obtain ⟨t, ht, himprove⟩ := exists_pos_norm_sub_smul_lt_of_extremal_sign g h hE hsign
    have hnew : (p + t • q).degree ≤ n :=
      mem_degreeLE.mp ((degreeLE ℝ n).add_mem (mem_degreeLE.mpr hp)
        ((degreeLE ℝ n).smul_mem t (mem_degreeLE.mpr hq)))
    have heq : f - (p + t • q).toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b) = g - t • h := by
      ext x
      simp [g, h, eval_smul]
      ring
    have hbound := minimaxError_le_norm_sub f
      (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨p + t • q, hnew, rfl⟩)
    rw [heq, ← hbest] at hbound
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbound himprove).elim
  · let w : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b := fun i =>
      ⟨v i, hcab.1.trans (hvext i).1.1, (hvext i).1.2⟩
    refine ⟨w, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have hext := (hvext i).2
      rw [heval _ (w i).property] at hext
      exact hext
    · intro i
      have hsig := hvsign i
      rw [heval _ (w i.castSucc).property, heval _ (w i.succ).property] at hsig
      exact hsig

name: NLAlib.eq_neg_of_abs_eq_abs_of_mul_neg
statement:
private lemma eq_neg_of_abs_eq_abs_of_mul_neg {x y : ℝ}
    (habs : |y| = |x|) (hxy : x * y < 0) : y = -x
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_eq_abs.mp habs with h | h
  · rw [h] at hxy
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (mul_self_nonneg x) hxy).elim
  · exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f) :
    ∃ (v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
      StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
      ∀ i, f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ) =
        σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖
proof:
:= by
  let g := f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)
  let E := ‖g‖
  by_cases hE : E = 0
  · have hden : (0 : ℝ) < n + 2 := by positivity
    let v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b := fun i =>
      ⟨a + (b - a) * (i : ℕ) / (n + 2), by
        constructor
        · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
        · have hi : (i : ℝ) ≤ n + 2 := by exact_mod_cast i.isLt.le
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (sub_pos.mpr hab).le
          have hpart : (b - a) * (i : ℕ) / (n + 2) ≤ b - a :=
            (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr hmul
          linarith⟩
    refine ⟨v, 1, ?_, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      have hijR : (i : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hij
      dsimp [v]
      have hdiv := div_lt_div_of_pos_right
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hijR (sub_pos.mpr hab)) hden
      linarith
    · intro i
      have hval : g (v i) = 0 := by
        have := g.norm_coe_le_norm (v i)
        change ‖g (v i)‖ ≤ E at this
        rw [hE] at this
        exact norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm this (norm_nonneg _))
      simpa [g, E, hE] using hval
  · have hEpos : 0 < E := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hE)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvabs, hvsign⟩ :=
      exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError hab f hp hbest hEpos
    let σ := (f (v 0) - p.eval (v 0 : ℝ)) / E
    refine ⟨v, σ, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [σ]
      rw [abs_div, hvabs 0, abs_of_pos hEpos]
      exact div_self hEpos.ne'
    · intro i
      refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun j hj => ?_) i
      · simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
        change f (v 0) - p.eval (v 0 : ℝ) =
          (f (v 0) - p.eval (v 0 : ℝ)) / E * E
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hEpos.ne']
      · have hnext := eq_neg_of_abs_eq_abs_of_mul_neg
          ((hvabs j.succ).trans (hvabs j.castSucc).symm) (hvsign j)
        rw [hnext, hj]
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, pow_succ]
        ring

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_iff_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_iff_equioscillation {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f ↔
      ∃ (v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
        StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
        ∀ i, f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ) =
          σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError hab f hp
  · rintro ⟨v, σ, hv, hσ, hosc⟩
    exact norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_of_equioscillation f hp hv hσ hosc

name: NLAlib.eq_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem eq_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p q : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) (hq : q.degree ≤ n)
    (hfp : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f)
    (hfq : ‖f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ[X] := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p + q)
  have hr : r.degree ≤ n := mem_degreeLE.mp
    ((degreeLE ℝ n).smul_mem (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      ((degreeLE ℝ n).add_mem (mem_degreeLE.mpr hp) (mem_degreeLE.mpr hq)))
  have heq : f - r.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) •
      ((f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)) + (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))) := by
    ext x; simp [r, eval_smul]; ring
  have hrupper : ‖f - r.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ ≤ minimaxError n f := by
    rw [heq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    norm_num
    have ht := norm_add_le (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))
      (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))
    rw [hfp, hfq] at ht
    linarith
  have hrbest : ‖f - r.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f :=
    le_antisymm hrupper (minimaxError_le_norm_sub f
      (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩))
  obtain ⟨v, σ, hv, hσ, hosc⟩ :=
    exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError hab f hr hrbest
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_index_eq (s := Finset.univ)
    (v := fun i => (v i : ℝ)) hv.injective.injOn
  · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact ((degree_sub_le p q).trans (max_le hp hq)).trans_lt
      (by exact_mod_cast (show n < n + 2 by omega))
  · intro i _
    have hpb : |f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ)| ≤ minimaxError n f := by
      have hb := (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)).norm_coe_le_norm (v i)
      rwa [hfp] at hb
    have hqb : |f (v i) - q.eval (v i : ℝ)| ≤ minimaxError n f := by
      have hb := (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)).norm_coe_le_norm (v i)
      rwa [hfq] at hb
    have hrabs : |f (v i) - r.eval (v i : ℝ)| = minimaxError n f := by
      rw [hosc, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, hσ]
      simp [hrbest, abs_of_nonneg (minimaxError_nonneg n f)]
    have hmid : 2 * (f (v i) - r.eval (v i : ℝ)) =
        (f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ)) + (f (v i) - q.eval (v i : ℝ)) := by
      simp [r, eval_smul]; ring
    have hpb' := abs_le.mp hpb
    have hqb' := abs_le.mp hqb
    have hrabs' : |f (v i) - r.eval (v i : ℝ)| = |minimaxError n f| :=
      hrabs.trans (abs_of_nonneg (minimaxError_nonneg n f)).symm
    rcases abs_eq_abs.mp hrabs' with h | h <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.moment_laguerrePolynomial_three_quarters
proof:
:= by
  rw [exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial (by norm_num)]
  rw [laguerreExponentialCoefficient, show (3 : ℝ)/4 - 1 = (-1)/4 by norm_num]
  rw [div_pow, div_pow, pow_succ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le
statement:
theorem degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerreExponentialProjection n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_degreeLE.mp
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro j _
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  apply mem_degreeLE.mpr
  rw [degree_laguerrePolynomial]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt

name: NLAlib.coeff_laguerreExponentialProjection_self
statement:
theorem coeff_laguerreExponentialProjection_self (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerreExponentialProjection n).coeff n = 4 / (3^(n+1) * (n ! : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerreExponentialProjection, finsetSum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last n)]
  · simp only [coeff_smul, Fin.val_last, smul_eq_mul, coeff_laguerrePolynomial_self,
      laguerreExponentialCoefficient]
    have hsign : (-1 : ℝ)^n * (-1 : ℝ)^n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hsign]
  · intro j _ hj
    have hjn : j.val < n := by
      have hjne : j.val ≠ n := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
      omega
    rw [coeff_smul, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by simpa using hjn), smul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1
      (laguerreExponentialProjection n * laguerrePolynomial i.val) =
      laguerreExponentialCoefficient i.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerreExponentialProjection, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  simp_rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul,
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial]
  simp [← Fin.ext_iff]

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul_eq
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (laguerreExponentialProjection n * p) =
      exponentialPolynomialMoment (3/4) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_sum_smul_laguerrePolynomial hp
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul,
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul,
    moment_laguerrePolynomial_three_quarters]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_laguerreExponentialCoefficient
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [laguerreExponentialCoefficient]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
    have hsign : ((-1 : ℝ)^(n+1))^2 = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    simp only [laguerreExponentialCoefficient, div_pow, mul_pow, hsign]
    have hpow : (3 : ℝ)^(2*(n+1)+2) = 9 * 3^(2*n+2) := by
      rw [show 2*(n+1)+2 = (2*n+2)+2 by omega, pow_add]
      norm_num
      ring
    have hpow' : ((3 : ℝ)^(n+1+1))^2 = 3^(2*n+2)*9 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, show (n+1+1)*2 = (2*n+2)+2 by omega, pow_add]
      norm_num
    rw [hpow, hpow']
    field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_sq
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_sq (n : ℕ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 ((laguerreExponentialProjection n)^2) =
      2 - 2 / 3^(2*n+2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  rw [show laguerreExponentialProjection n * laguerreExponentialProjection n =
    laguerreExponentialProjection n *
      (∑ j : Fin (n+1), laguerreExponentialCoefficient j.val • laguerrePolynomial j.val)
    by rfl]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul,
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [← pow_two]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => (laguerreExponentialCoefficient j)^2) (n+1)]
  exact sum_sq_laguerreExponentialCoefficient n

name: NLAlib.exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg
statement:
private theorem exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg (p : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    (Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x) =
      Real.exp (-((1/2)*x)) - 2 * (p.eval x * Real.exp (-((3/4)*x))) +
        (p^2).eval x * Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Real.exp (x/4))^2 * Real.exp (-x) = Real.exp (-((1/2)*x)) := by
    rw [pow_two, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h2 : Real.exp (x/4) * Real.exp (-x) = Real.exp (-((3/4)*x)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [Polynomial.eval_pow]
  calc
    _ = (Real.exp (x/4))^2 * Real.exp (-x) -
        2 * (p.eval x * (Real.exp (x/4) * Real.exp (-x))) +
        (p.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [h1, h2]

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem integrableOn_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg (p : ℝ[X]) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x))
      (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := integrableOn_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi 0 (by norm_num : 0 < (1:ℝ)/2)
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at h0
  have h1 := (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p
    (by norm_num : 0 < (3:ℝ)/4)).const_mul 2
  have h2 := integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (p^2) zero_lt_one
  simp only [one_mul] at h2
  exact ((h0.sub h1).add h2).congr_fun
    (fun x _ => (exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg p x).symm) measurableSet_Ioi

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) =
      2 - 2 * exponentialPolynomialMoment (3/4) p +
        exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (p^2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg]
  have h0 := integrableOn_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi 0 (by norm_num : 0 < (1:ℝ)/2)
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at h0
  have h1 := (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p
    (by norm_num : 0 < (3:ℝ)/4)).const_mul 2
  have h2 := integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (p^2) zero_lt_one
  simp only [one_mul] at h2
  have hadd := integral_add (h0.sub h1) h2
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hadd
  rw [hadd]
  have hsub := integral_sub h0 h1
  rw [hsub, integral_const_mul]
  have he : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, Real.exp (-((1/2)*x))) = 2 := by
    simpa using integral_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi 0 (by norm_num : 0 < (1:ℝ)/2)
  rw [he, integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p (by norm_num)]
  rw [show (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (p^2).eval x * Real.exp (-x)) =
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (p^2) by
    simpa only [one_mul] using integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (p^2) zero_lt_one]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_eq_laguerreResidual_add
statement:
theorem integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_eq_laguerreResidual_add
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) =
      2 / 3^(2*n+2) +
        ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (p.eval x - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval x)^2 *
          Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg]
  have hpoly : (p - laguerreExponentialProjection n)^2 = p^2 -
      (2 : ℝ) • (laguerreExponentialProjection n * p) +
      (laguerreExponentialProjection n)^2 := by
    simp only [smul_eq_C_mul, map_ofNat]
    ring
  have hint : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0,
      (p.eval x - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)) =
      exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 ((p - laguerreExponentialProjection n)^2) := by
    have h := integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ((p - laguerreExponentialProjection n)^2)
      zero_lt_one
    simp_rw [Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub, one_mul] at h
    exact h
  rw [hint, hpoly, map_add, map_sub, map_smul,
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_mul_eq hp,
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreExponentialProjection_sq]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.laguerreResidual_le_integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq
statement:
theorem laguerreResidual_le_integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    2 / 3^(2*n+2) ≤
      ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (x/4) - p.eval x)^2 * Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_eq_laguerreResidual_add hp]
  apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  positivity

name: NLAlib.degree_coefficientPolynomial_le
statement:
private theorem degree_coefficientPolynomial_le (k : ℕ) (u : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) :
    (coefficientPolynomial k u).degree ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  have h : coefficientPolynomial k u ∈ degreeLT ℝ (k + 1) :=
    ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ (k + 1)).symm u).property
  rw [degreeLT_succ_eq_degreeLE] at h
  exact mem_degreeLE.mp h

name: NLAlib.eval_coefficientPolynomial
statement:
private theorem eval_coefficientPolynomial (k : ℕ) (u : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (coefficientPolynomial k u).eval x = ∑ i, u i * x ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eval_eq_sum_degreeLTEquiv ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ (k + 1)).symm u).property x
  simpa [coefficientPolynomial] using h

name: NLAlib.coefficientPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem coefficientPolynomial_eq_zero_iff (k : ℕ) (u : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) :
    coefficientPolynomial k u = 0 ↔ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have heq : (degreeLTEquiv ℝ (k + 1)).symm u = 0 := Subtype.ext h
    have hmap := congrArg (degreeLTEquiv ℝ (k + 1)) heq
    simpa using hmap
  · rintro rfl; simp [coefficientPolynomial]

name: NLAlib.coefficientPolynomial_smul
statement:
private theorem coefficientPolynomial_smul (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (u : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) :
    coefficientPolynomial k (c • u) = c • coefficientPolynomial k u
proof:
:= by
  unfold coefficientPolynomial
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.continuous_eval_coefficientPolynomial
statement:
private theorem continuous_eval_coefficientPolynomial (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun u : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ => (coefficientPolynomial k u).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eval_coefficientPolynomial]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.exists_cross_error_le_of_forall_pos
statement:
theorem exists_cross_error_le_of_forall_pos {m n : ℕ} {a b E : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (happrox : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ p q : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ m ∧ q.degree ≤ n ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |f x * q.eval x - p.eval x| ≤ (E + ε) * |q.eval x|) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ m ∧ Q.degree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, Q.eval x ≠ 0 ∧
        |f x * Q.eval x - P.eval x| ≤ E * |Q.eval x|
proof:
:= by
  choose p q hp hq hqzero herr using
    (fun j : ℕ => happrox (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) (by positivity))
  let pc : ℕ → degreeLT ℝ (m + 1) := fun j =>
    ⟨p j, by rw [degreeLT_succ_eq_degreeLE]; exact mem_degreeLE.mpr (hp j)⟩
  let qc : ℕ → degreeLT ℝ (n + 1) := fun j =>
    ⟨q j, by rw [degreeLT_succ_eq_degreeLE]; exact mem_degreeLE.mpr (hq j)⟩
  let V := (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) × (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
  let w : ℕ → V := fun j => (degreeLTEquiv ℝ (m + 1) (pc j),
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ (n + 1) (qc j))
  have hpolyP : ∀ j, coefficientPolynomial m (w j).1 = p j := by
    intro j; simp [coefficientPolynomial, w, pc]
  have hpolyQ : ∀ j, coefficientPolynomial n (w j).2 = q j := by
    intro j; simp [coefficientPolynomial, w, qc]
  have hnorm : ∀ j, 0 < ‖w j‖ := by
    intro j
    apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
    intro hw
    have hqcoord : (w j).2 = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd hw
    have hqpoly := (coefficientPolynomial_eq_zero_iff n (w j).2).mpr hqcoord
    rw [hpolyQ] at hqpoly
    exact hqzero j hqpoly
  let u : ℕ → V := fun j => ‖w j‖⁻¹ • w j
  have hunorm : ∀ j, ‖u j‖ = 1 := by
    intro j
    dsimp [u]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg (w j)),
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (hnorm j).ne']
  have huerr : ∀ j x, x ∈ Icc a b →
      |f x * (coefficientPolynomial n (u j).2).eval x -
        (coefficientPolynomial m (u j).1).eval x| ≤
        (E + 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * |(coefficientPolynomial n (u j).2).eval x| := by
    intro j x hx
    have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (herr j x hx) (abs_nonneg ‖w j‖⁻¹)
    change |f x * (coefficientPolynomial n (‖w j‖⁻¹ • (w j).2)).eval x -
        (coefficientPolynomial m (‖w j‖⁻¹ • (w j).1)).eval x| ≤
        (E + 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * |(coefficientPolynomial n (‖w j‖⁻¹ • (w j).2)).eval x|
    simp only [coefficientPolynomial_smul, hpolyP,
      hpolyQ, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have heq : f x * (‖w j‖⁻¹ * (q j).eval x) - ‖w j‖⁻¹ * (p j).eval x =
        ‖w j‖⁻¹ * (f x * (q j).eval x - (p j).eval x) := by ring
    rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    nlinarith [hscale]
  obtain ⟨v, hv, φ, hφ, huv⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : V) 1).tendsto_subseq
    (fun j => by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hunorm j)
  let P := coefficientPolynomial m v.1
  let Q := coefficientPolynomial n v.2
  have hvnorm : ‖v‖ = 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hv
  have hlimit : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |f x * Q.eval x - P.eval x| ≤ E * |Q.eval x| := by
    intro x hx
    have hP : Tendsto (fun j => (coefficientPolynomial m (u (φ j)).1).eval x)
        atTop (𝓝 (P.eval x)) :=
      ((continuous_eval_coefficientPolynomial m x).comp continuous_fst).continuousAt.tendsto.comp huv
    have hQ : Tendsto (fun j => (coefficientPolynomial n (u (φ j)).2).eval x)
        atTop (𝓝 (Q.eval x)) :=
      ((continuous_eval_coefficientPolynomial n x).comp continuous_snd).continuousAt.tendsto.comp huv
    have hε : Tendsto (fun j => E + 1 / ((φ j : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 E) := by
      simpa only [add_zero, Function.comp_def] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := E)).add
        (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' ((tendsto_const_nhds.mul hQ).sub hP).abs
      (hε.mul hQ.abs) (fun j => huerr (φ j) x hx)
  have hQzero : Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hQ0
    have hPeval : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, P.eval x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hb := hlimit x hx
      simp only [hQ0, eval_zero, mul_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_zero] at hb
      exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hb (abs_nonneg _))
    have hP0 : P = 0 := Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot P
      ((Icc_infinite hab).mono (fun x hx => hPeval x hx))
    have hvfst : v.1 = 0 := (coefficientPolynomial_eq_zero_iff m v.1).mp hP0
    have hvsnd : v.2 = 0 := (coefficientPolynomial_eq_zero_iff n v.2).mp hQ0
    have hv0 : v = 0 := Prod.ext hvfst hvsnd
    rw [hv0, norm_zero] at hvnorm
    norm_num at hvnorm
  obtain ⟨P', Q', hP', hQ', _, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_denominator_ne_zero_of_cross_error_le hab f hf P Q hQzero hlimit
  exact ⟨P', Q', hP'.trans (degree_coefficientPolynomial_le m v.1),
    hQ'.trans (degree_coefficientPolynomial_le n v.2), hbound⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_oddUpdatePolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_oddUpdatePolynomial (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (oddUpdatePolynomial q a).eval x = oddScalarUpdate q a x
proof:
:= by
  simp [oddUpdatePolynomial, oddScalarUpdate, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]

name: NLAlib.continuous_oddScalarUpdate
statement: theorem continuous_oddScalarUpdate (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) : Continuous (oddScalarUpdate q a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold oddScalarUpdate
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.oddScalarUpdate_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem oddScalarUpdate_zero (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) : oddScalarUpdate q a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [oddScalarUpdate]

name: NLAlib.oddScalarUpdate_neg
statement:
theorem oddScalarUpdate_neg (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    oddScalarUpdate q a (-x) = -oddScalarUpdate q a x
proof:
:= by
  simp [oddScalarUpdate, pow_add, pow_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: NLAlib.continuous_oddScalarComposition
statement:
theorem continuous_oddScalarComposition (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun x => oddScalarComposition q a x k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact continuous_id
  | succ k ih => exact (continuous_oddScalarUpdate q (a k)).comp ih

name: NLAlib.oddScalarComposition_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddScalarComposition_zero (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    oddScalarComposition q a 0 k = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [oddScalarComposition, ih]

name: NLAlib.absoluteMinimaxError_nonneg
statement: theorem absoluteMinimaxError_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ absoluteMinimaxError n
proof:
:=
  minimaxError_nonneg n absoluteValueOnUnitInterval

name: NLAlib.absoluteMinimaxError_antitone
statement: theorem absoluteMinimaxError_antitone : Antitone absoluteMinimaxError
proof:
:=
  minimaxError_antitone absoluteValueOnUnitInterval

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_absoluteMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_absoluteMinimaxError (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |(|x|) - p.eval x| ≤ absoluteMinimaxError n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, heq⟩ := exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError n
    absoluteValueOnUnitInterval
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  exact ((absoluteValueOnUnitInterval - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).norm_coe_le_norm
    ⟨x, hx⟩).trans_eq heq

name: NLAlib.absoluteMinimaxError_le_of_degree_le
proof:
:= by
  exact (isLeast_minimaxError_pointwise (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) n
    absoluteValueOnUnitInterval).2 ⟨p, hp, fun x => hE x x.property⟩

name: NLAlib.absoluteMinimaxError_even_le
statement:
theorem absoluteMinimaxError_even_le (m : ℕ) :
    absoluteMinimaxError (2 * m) ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  exact absoluteMinimaxError_le_of_degree_le
    (degree_chebyshevTrunc_le _ _) (fun _ hx => abs_abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le m hx)

name: NLAlib.coeff_comp_neg_X
statement:
private theorem coeff_comp_neg_X (p : ℝ[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    (p.comp (-X)).coeff k = (-1:ℝ)^k * p.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [add_comp, coeff_add, hp, hq]; ring
  | monomial j c =>
    rw [monomial_comp, neg_pow, ← mul_assoc,
      show (-1:ℝ[X])^j = C ((-1:ℝ)^j) by simp, ← C_mul,
      C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
    simp only [coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst j
      ring
    · simp

name: NLAlib.absoluteMinimaxError_odd_eq_even
statement:
theorem absoluteMinimaxError_odd_eq_even (m : ℕ) :
    absoluteMinimaxError (2*m+1) = absoluteMinimaxError (2*m)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (absoluteMinimaxError_antitone (by omega))
  obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := exists_degree_le_absoluteMinimaxError (2*m+1)
  let q := (1/2:ℝ) • (p+p.comp (-X))
  have hqbound : q.degree ≤ (2*m+1:ℕ) :=
    (degree_smul_le _ _).trans (degree_add_le_of_degree_le hp (by simpa using hp))
  have hq : q.degree ≤ (2*m:ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_le_iff_coeff_zero _ _).mpr
    intro k hk
    have hkNat : 2*m < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    by_cases hkEq : k = 2*m+1
    · subst k
      simp only [q, coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul, coeff_add, coeff_comp_neg_X,
        pow_add, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (hqbound.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2*m+1<k by omega)))
  apply absoluteMinimaxError_le_of_degree_le hq
  intro x hx
  have hneg : -x ∈ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hx.2], by linarith [hx.1]⟩
  have hsum := (abs_add_le (|x|-p.eval x) (|x|-p.eval (-x))).trans
    (add_le_add (he x hx) (by simpa only [abs_neg] using he (-x) hneg))
  have heval : |x|-q.eval x = (1/2:ℝ)*((|x|-p.eval x)+(|x|-p.eval (-x))) := by
    simp only [q, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_add, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X]
    ring
  rw [heval, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.one_div_sqrt_one_sub_le
statement:
private theorem one_div_sqrt_one_sub_le {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ 1 / 4) :
    1 / Real.sqrt (1 - q) ≤ 1 + 2 * q
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 1 - q := by linarith
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - q) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hp.le
  have hl : 1 - q ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - q) := by nlinarith
  refine (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hp hl).trans ?_
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.two_mul_cube_le_sq_of_threshold
statement:
private theorem two_mul_cube_le_sq_of_threshold {R n : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hthreshold : 2 * max 1 (R^2) ≤ n) : 2 * R^3 ≤ n^2
proof:
:= by
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by nlinarith [le_max_left (1 : ℝ) (R^2)]
  have hnR : 2 * R^2 ≤ n := by nlinarith [le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (R^2)]
  by_cases hR1 : R ≤ 1
  · have hR2 : R^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hR3 : R^3 ≤ 1 := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR1 (sq_nonneg R)
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  · have hR1' : 1 ≤ R := le_of_not_ge hR1
    have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R^2) hnR 2
    have hR3 : 0 ≤ R^3 := by positivity
    have hm := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hR1') hR3
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_sin_eq_scaled_of_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_sin_eq_scaled_of_threshold {R n : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hthreshold : 2 * max 1 (R^2) ≤ n) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ∃ u : ℂ, Complex.sin u = z / (n : ℂ) ∧
      n * ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * R ∧ n * |u.im| ≤ |z.im| + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by nlinarith [le_max_left (1 : ℝ) (R^2)]
  have hn : 0 < n := by linarith
  have hRmax : R ≤ max 1 (R^2) := by
    by_cases hR1 : R ≤ 1
    · exact hR1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hR1' : 1 ≤ R := le_of_not_ge hR1
      exact (by nlinarith : R ≤ R^2).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hnR : 2 * R ≤ n := by linarith
  have hnorm : ‖z / (n : ℂ)‖ = ‖z‖ / n := by
    rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hn]
  have hr : 0 ≤ ‖z‖ / n := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hn.le
  have hrh : ‖z‖ / n ≤ 1 / 2 := (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hzhalf : ‖z / (n : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hnorm]; exact hrh
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hunorm, hum⟩ := Complex.exists_sin_eq_of_norm_le_half hzhalf
  have hnormu : n * ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
    rw [hnorm] at hunorm
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hunorm hn.le
    have he : n * (2 * (‖z‖ / n)) = 2 * ‖z‖ := by field_simp
    rw [he] at h
    exact h.trans (by linarith)
  let q := (‖z‖ / n)^2
  have hq : q ≤ 1 / 4 := by dsimp [q]; nlinarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := sq_nonneg _
  have hinv := one_div_sqrt_one_sub_le hq0 hq
  have him : n * |u.im| ≤ |z.im| / Real.sqrt (1 - q) := by
    rw [hnorm, Complex.div_ofReal_im, abs_div, abs_of_pos hn] at hum
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hum hn.le
    have he : n * (|z.im| / n / Real.sqrt (1 - q)) =
        |z.im| / Real.sqrt (1 - q) := by field_simp
    exact h.trans_eq he
  have him' : n * |u.im| ≤ |z.im| * (1 + 2 * q) :=
    him.trans (by simpa only [mul_one_div] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv (abs_nonneg z.im))
  have hcorr : |z.im| * (2 * q) ≤ 1 := by
    have hy : |z.im| ≤ R := (Complex.abs_im_le_norm z).trans hz
    have hz2 : ‖z‖^2 ≤ R^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hz 2
    have hmult := mul_le_mul hy hz2 (sq_nonneg _) hR
    have hcube := two_mul_cube_le_sq_of_threshold hR hthreshold
    dsimp [q]
    rw [div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc, ← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hn 2)).mpr
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨u, hu, hnormu, ?_⟩
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_scaled_absolute_approximant_le
statement:
theorem norm_scaled_absolute_approximant_le {m : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ (2 * m : ℕ))
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |(|x|) - p.eval x| ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hthreshold : 2 * max 1 (R^2) ≤ (2 * m : ℕ))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * (p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (z / ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
      6 * (1 + R^2) / Real.pi * Real.exp (|z.im| + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℝ := (2 * m : ℕ)
  let S := chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * m)
  have hnc : 2 * (m : ℝ) = n := by simp [n]
  rw [hnc] at herr
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by
    dsimp [n]
    nlinarith [le_max_left (1 : ℝ) (R^2)]
  have hn : 0 < n := by linarith
  have hπ : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hunorm, hum⟩ := exists_sin_eq_scaled_of_threshold hR hthreshold hz
  have hdiff : ((p - S).map Complex.ofRealHom).degree ≤ (2 * m : ℕ) :=
    (degree_map_le).trans ((degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le hp (degree_chebyshevTrunc_le _ _)))
  have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖((p - S).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 4 / (Real.pi * n) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [show (x : ℂ) = Complex.ofRealHom x by rfl, eval_map_apply,
      Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, eval_sub]
    have hS := abs_abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le m hx
    rw [hnc] at hS
    change |(|x|) - S.eval x| ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (n + 1)) at hS
    have he : |p.eval x - S.eval x| ≤ 4 / (Real.pi * (n + 1)) := by
      have h := abs_sub_le (p.eval x) |x| (S.eval x)
      rw [abs_sub_comm (p.eval x) |x|] at h
      calc
        |p.eval x - S.eval x| ≤ |(|x|) - p.eval x| + |(|x|) - S.eval x| := h
        _ ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (n + 1)) + 2 / (Real.pi * (n + 1)) :=
          add_le_add (herr x hx) hS
        _ = 4 / (Real.pi * (n + 1)) := by ring
    exact he.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num)
      (mul_pos hπ hn) (by nlinarith))
  let c := Real.exp (n * |u.im|)
  have hc : 0 < c := Real.exp_pos _
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (mul_nonneg hn.le (abs_nonneg _))
  have hdiffNorm := norm_eval_sin_le_mul_exp_abs_im hdiff hbound u
  have hdiffScaled : n * ‖((p - S).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      4 / Real.pi * c := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiffNorm hn.le
    change n * ‖((p - S).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      n * (4 / (Real.pi * n) * c) at h
    have he : n * (4 / (Real.pi * n) * c) = 4 / Real.pi * c := by field_simp
    exact h.trans_eq he
  have hcomp := norm_eval_chebyshevTrunc_abs_even_sin_le m u
  rw [hnc] at hcomp
  have hcompScaled : n * ‖(S.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      (2 / Real.pi + 16 * R^2 / (3 * Real.pi)) * c := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcomp hn.le
    have hconst : n * (2 / (Real.pi * (n + 1))) ≤ 2 / Real.pi := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hπ).mpr
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    have hsq : (n * ‖u‖)^2 ≤ (2 * R)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hunorm 2
    have hquad : n * (8 * m / (3 * Real.pi) * ‖u‖^2 * c) ≤
        16 * R^2 / (3 * Real.pi) * c := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (show 0 ≤ 4 / (3 * Real.pi) * c by positivity)
      calc
        n * (8 * m / (3 * Real.pi) * ‖u‖^2 * c) =
            (n * ‖u‖)^2 * (4 / (3 * Real.pi) * c) := by
          dsimp only [n]
          push_cast
          ring
        _ ≤ (2 * R)^2 * (4 / (3 * Real.pi) * c) := h
        _ = 16 * R^2 / (3 * Real.pi) * c := by ring
    change n * ‖(S.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      n * (2 / (Real.pi * (n + 1)) + 8 * m / (3 * Real.pi) * ‖u‖^2 * c) at h
    have hconstc : n * (2 / (Real.pi * (n + 1))) ≤ 2 / Real.pi * c :=
      hconst.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hc1)
    nlinarith
  have htriangle : n * ‖(p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      n * ‖((p - S).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ +
        n * ‖(S.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ := by
    have he : (p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u) =
        ((p - S).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u) +
          (S.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u) := by
      rw [Polynomial.map_sub, eval_sub]
      ring
    rw [he]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_add_le _ _) hn.le).trans_eq (mul_add _ _ _)
  have hpoly : n * ‖(p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      6 * (1 + R^2) / Real.pi * c := by
    have hconst : 4 / Real.pi + (2 / Real.pi + 16 * R^2 / (3 * Real.pi)) ≤
        6 * (1 + R^2) / Real.pi := by
      field_simp
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg R]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconst hc.le
    nlinarith
  rw [hu] at hpoly
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
  refine hpoly.trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hum

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_le_eval_T_real_of_one_le
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one (k := 0) hx hP hb
  have h2 := eval_iterate_derivative_le_of_forall_abs_le_one (k := 0) (P := -P) hx
    (by rwa [degree_neg]) (fun y hy => by simpa using hb y hy)
  simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, eval_neg] at h1 h2
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, h1⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_le_abs_eval_T_real_of_forall_abs_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with h0 | h0
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg h0] at hx
    exact (abs_eval_le_eval_T_real_of_one_le hP hb hx).trans (le_abs_self _)
  · rw [abs_of_neg h0] at hx
    have hQ : (P.comp (-X)).degree ≤ q := by
      refine (degree_le_natDegree).trans ?_
      have : (P.comp (-X)).natDegree ≤ q := by
        refine (natDegree_comp_le).trans ?_
        rw [natDegree_neg, natDegree_X, mul_one]
        exact natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hP
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hQb : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(P.comp (-X)).eval y| ≤ 1 := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X]
      exact hb (-y) ⟨by linarith [hy.2], by linarith [hy.1]⟩
    have := abs_eval_le_eval_T_real_of_one_le hQ hQb hx
    simp only [eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X, neg_neg] at this
    refine this.trans ?_
    rw [← neg_neg x, T_eval_neg, neg_neg]
    refine (le_abs_self _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_unit_intCast, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_le_mul_abs_eval_T_real_of_forall_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt M 0 with hM | hM
  · have h0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
    rw [eq_zero_of_forall_abs_eval_le_of_nonpos hM hb]
    simpa using mul_nonneg h0 (abs_nonneg ((T ℝ q).eval x))
  · have hQ : (C M⁻¹ * P).degree ≤ q :=
      ((congrArg degree (C_mul' _ _)).trans_le (degree_smul_le _ _)).trans hP
    have hQb : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(C M⁻¹ * P).eval y| ≤ 1 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hM), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hM, mul_one]
      exact hb y hy
    have := abs_eval_le_abs_eval_T_real_of_forall_abs_le_one hQ hQb hx
    rwa [eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hM), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hM] at this

name: NLAlib.one_le_div_sub
statement: private lemma one_le_div_sub {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) : 1 ≤ (b + a) / (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_le_div (by linarith)]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.one_le_eval_T_real_div_sub
statement:
private lemma one_le_eval_T_real_div_sub {a b : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    1 ≤ (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:=
  one_le_eval_T_real _ (one_le_div_sub ha.le hab)

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevResidual_zero
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevResidual_zero {a b : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    (chebyshevResidual a b q).eval 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_le_eval_T_real_div_sub (q := q) ha hab
  simp only [chebyshevResidual_def, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_X, mul_zero,
    sub_zero]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevResidual_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevResidual_le (a b : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevResidual a b q).degree ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevResidual_def]
  refine ((congrArg degree (C_mul' _ _)).trans_le (degree_smul_le _ _)).trans
    (degree_le_natDegree.trans ?_)
  have : ((T ℝ q).comp (C ((b + a) / (b - a)) - C (2 / (b - a)) * X)).natDegree ≤ q := by
    refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
    rw [natDegree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    calc q * (C ((b + a) / (b - a)) - C (2 / (b - a)) * X).natDegree ≤ q * 1 := by
          gcongr
          refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) ?_)
          exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (by simp)
      _ = q := mul_one q
  exact_mod_cast this

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le {a b x : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    |(chebyshevResidual a b q).eval x| ≤ 1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_le_eval_T_real_div_sub (q := q) ha hab
  have hba : 0 < b - a := by linarith
  have hy : |(b + a) / (b - a) - 2 / (b - a) * x| ≤ 1 := by
