    have he : (b + a) / (b - a) - 2 / (b - a) * x = (b + a - 2 * x) / (b - a) := by
      field_simp
    rw [he, abs_le, le_div_iff₀ hba, div_le_iff₀ hba]
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  simp only [chebyshevResidual_def, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_X]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)))]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ hy)

name: NLAlib.inv_eval_T_real_le_of_forall_abs_eval_le
statement:
theorem inv_eval_T_real_le_of_forall_abs_eval_le {a b M : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hab : a < b) (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |p.eval x| ≤ M) :
    1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hba : 0 < b - a := by linarith
  have hs := one_le_div_sub ha.le hab
  have hT := one_le_eval_T_real_div_sub (q := q) ha hab
  set L : ℝ[X] := C ((b + a) / 2) - C ((b - a) / 2) * X with hL
  have hLe : ∀ t, L.eval t = (b + a) / 2 - (b - a) / 2 * t := fun t => by
    simp [hL]
  have hP : (p.comp L).degree ≤ q := by
    refine degree_le_natDegree.trans ?_
    have : (p.comp L).natDegree ≤ q := by
      refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
      calc p.natDegree * L.natDegree ≤ q * 1 := by
            gcongr
            · exact natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hp
            · refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) ?_)
              exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (by simp)
        _ = q := mul_one q
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hPb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(p.comp L).eval t| ≤ M := by
    intro t ht
    rw [eval_comp, hLe]
    refine hb _ ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hPs : (p.comp L).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) = 1 := by
    rw [eval_comp, hLe, ← hp0]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  have := abs_eval_le_mul_abs_eval_T_real_of_forall_abs_le hP hPb
    (show 1 ≤ |(b + a) / (b - a)| from hs.trans (le_abs_self _))
  rw [hPs, abs_one, abs_of_pos (by linarith)] at this
  rwa [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]

name: NLAlib.isLeast_chebyshev_minimax
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨chebyshevResidual a b q, degree_chebyshevResidual_le a b q,
      eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab, fun _ hx => abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le ha hab hx⟩,
    fun _ ⟨_, hp, hp0, hb⟩ => inv_eval_T_real_le_of_forall_abs_eval_le ha hab hp hp0 hb⟩

name: NLAlib.monic_inv_two_pow_mul_T
statement: theorem monic_inv_two_pow_mul_T (q : ℕ) : (C (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1) : ℝ) * T ℝ q).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, leadingCoeff_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.natDegree_inv_two_pow_mul_T
statement: theorem natDegree_inv_two_pow_mul_T (q : ℕ) : (C (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1) : ℝ) * T ℝ q).natDegree = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDegree_C_mul (by positivity), natDegree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_inv_two_pow_mul_T_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_inv_two_pow_mul_T_le {q : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(C (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1) : ℝ) * T ℝ q).eval x| ≤ 1 / 2 ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx))

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_le_of_monic_of_forall_abs_eval_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_le_of_monic_of_forall_abs_eval_le {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} {M : ℝ} (hp : p.Monic)
    (hdeg : p.natDegree = q) (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval x| ≤ M) :
    1 / 2 ^ (q - 1) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    by_contra hM
    exact hp.ne_zero (eq_zero_of_forall_abs_eval_le_of_nonpos (not_lt.mp hM) hb)
  have hQ : (C M⁻¹ * p).degree ≤ q := by
    refine ((congrArg degree (C_mul' _ _)).trans_le (degree_smul_le _ _)).trans ?_
    rw [← hdeg]
    exact degree_le_natDegree
  have hQb : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(C M⁻¹ * p).eval y| ≤ 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hM), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hM, mul_one]
    exact hb y hy
  have := leadingCoeff_le_of_forall_abs_le_one hQ hQb
  rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, hp.leadingCoeff, mul_one] at this
  rw [one_div]
  exact inv_le_of_inv_le₀ hM this

name: NLAlib.isLeast_chebyshev_monic_minimax
statement:
theorem isLeast_chebyshev_monic_minimax (q : ℕ) :
    IsLeast {M | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.Monic ∧ p.natDegree = q ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval x| ≤ M} (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨_, monic_inv_two_pow_mul_T q, natDegree_inv_two_pow_mul_T q,
      fun _ hx => abs_eval_inv_two_pow_mul_T_le hx⟩,
    fun _ ⟨_, hp, hdeg, hb⟩ => inv_two_pow_le_of_monic_of_forall_abs_eval_le hp hdeg hb⟩

name: NLAlib.isInvertible_smulRight_one
statement:
private theorem isInvertible_smulRight_one {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight c).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsInvertible.of_inverse
    (g := (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight c⁻¹)
  · ext
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      one_apply_eq_self, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    field_simp
  · ext
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      one_apply_eq_self, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    field_simp

name: NLAlib.exists_contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak_chart
statement:
theorem exists_contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak_chart {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {t : Fin n → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ τ : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 τ t ∧
      τ t ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ) ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval (τ t) = 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, s ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n ∧
        τ s ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n s i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n s i.succ) ∧
        (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).derivative.eval (τ s) = 0 ∧
        interpolationGapPeak n s i = (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval (τ s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀, hc, hcc, _, _, _⟩ := exists_interpolationGapPeak_nondegenerate hn ht i
  let G : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (interpolationGapPolynomial n u.1 i).derivative.eval u.2
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 G (t, τ₀) := contDiffAt_eval_derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i τ₀ 1
  have hinr : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (t, y)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ) τ₀ := by
    have hd := (hasFDerivAt_const (𝕜 := ℝ) t τ₀).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) τ₀)
    have heq : (0 : ℝ →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) =
        ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ := by ext y <;> simp
    rw [heq] at hd
    exact hd
  have hpartial := hG.differentiableAt_one.hasFDerivAt.comp τ₀ hinr
  have heq : fderiv ℝ G (t, τ₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ =
      (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight ((interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.derivative.eval τ₀) :=
    hpartial.unique ((interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.hasFDerivAt τ₀)
  have hinvert : (fderiv ℝ G (t, τ₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ).IsInvertible := by
    rw [heq]
    exact isInvertible_smulRight_one hcc.ne
  let τ := hG.implicitFunction (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ∞ω) ≠ 0) hinvert
  have hτself : τ t = τ₀ := hG.implicitFunction_apply_self (by norm_num) hinvert
  have hτdiff : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 τ t := hG.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinvert
  have hτcrit : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).derivative.eval (τ s) = 0 := by
    have h := hG.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinvert
    change ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, G (s, τ s) = G (t, τ₀) at h
    simpa only [G, hc] using h
  have hs : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, s ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n := (isOpen_interiorNodeSimplex n).mem_nhds ht
  have hl : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, canonicalIntervalNodes n s i.castSucc < τ s :=
    (continuous_canonicalIntervalNodes n i.castSucc).continuousAt.eventually_lt hτdiff.continuousAt
      (by rw [hτself]; exact hτ₀.1)
  have hr : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, τ s < canonicalIntervalNodes n s i.succ :=
    hτdiff.continuousAt.eventually_lt (continuous_canonicalIntervalNodes n i.succ).continuousAt
      (by rw [hτself]; exact hτ₀.2)
  refine ⟨τ, hτdiff, by rwa [hτself], by rwa [hτself], ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hs, hl, hr, hτcrit] with s hs hl hr hc
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, _, _, _, hpeak, huniq⟩ := exists_interpolationGapPeak_nondegenerate hn hs i
  have hτξ : τ s = ξ := huniq (τ s) ⟨hl, hr⟩ hc
  exact ⟨hs, ⟨hl, hr⟩, hc, by rw [hτξ]; exact hpeak⟩

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdiff, _, _, hevent⟩ := exists_contDiffAt_interpolationGapPeak_chart hn ht i
  have heval := contDiffAt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial ht i (τ t) 1
  have hinput : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun s : Fin n → ℝ => (s, τ s)) t := contDiffAt_id.prodMk hτdiff
  have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun s => (interpolationGapPolynomial n s i).eval (τ s)) t := by
    exact heval.comp t hinput
  exact hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hevent.mono (fun s hs => hs.2.2.2))

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_weighted_norm_sub_minimal
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_weighted_norm_sub_minimal {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (n : ℕ) (f w : C(s, ℝ)) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n →
      ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn s)‖ ≤ ‖w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn s)‖
proof:
:= by
  let L : C(s, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(s, ℝ) :=
    { toFun := fun g => w * g
      map_add' := by intro g h; ext x; simp [mul_add]
      map_smul' := by intro a g; ext x; simp }
  let S := (polynomialApproximationSpace s n).map L
  have : FiniteDimensional ℝ S := by dsimp [S]; infer_instance
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional S (w*f)
  obtain ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hg
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mp hh
  have heq (q : ℝ[X]) : w*f - L (q.toContinuousMapOn s) =
      w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn s) := by ext x; simp [L, mul_sub]
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun q hq => ?_⟩
  rw [← heq p, hbest, ← heq q]
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := w*f)
    (show L (q.toContinuousMapOn s) ∈ S from
      Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨q.toContinuousMapOn s,
        mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, rfl⟩))

name: NLAlib.exists_alternating_extrema_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal
statement:
theorem exists_alternating_extrema_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f w : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n →
      ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖ ≤
        ‖w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖)
    (hE : 0 < ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖) :
    ∃ v : Fin (n+2) → Icc a b, StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, |w (v i) * (f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ))| =
        ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (n+1), (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ : ℝ)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  let g := w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))
  let e : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM g
  let E := ‖g‖
  have heval : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Icc a b), e x = g ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    fun x hx => ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem hx
  let K := Icc a b ∩ (fun x => |e x|) ⁻¹' {E}
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.inter_right
    (isClosed_singleton.preimage e.continuous.abs)
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hlt : ‖g‖ < E := (ContinuousMap.norm_lt_iff g hE).mpr (by
      intro x
      have hne : |g x| ≠ E := by
        intro hx
        exact hnone ⟨x, x.property, by change |e x| = E; rw [heval _ x.property]; exact hx⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (g.norm_coe_le_norm x) hne)
    exact lt_irrefl E hlt
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hK.exists_isLeast hKne
  have hcab : c ∈ Icc a b := hc.1.1
  have hcE : |e c| = E := hc.1.2
  rcases exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation n e E c b
      e.continuous hE hcab.2 hcE with ⟨q, hq, hqsign, _⟩ | ⟨v, hv, hvext, hvsign⟩
  · let h : C(Icc a b, ℝ) := w * q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)
    have hsign : ∀ x : Icc a b, |g x| = ‖g‖ → 0 < g x * h x := by
      intro x hx
      have hex : |e x| = E := by rw [heval _ x.property]; exact hx
      have hcx : c ≤ x := hc.2 ⟨x.property, hex⟩
      have hpos := hqsign x ⟨hcx, x.property.2⟩ hex
      rw [heval _ x.property] at hpos
      change 0 < g x * (w x * q.eval (x : ℝ))
      simpa only [mul_left_comm] using mul_pos (hw x) hpos
    obtain ⟨t, _, himprove⟩ := exists_pos_norm_sub_smul_lt_of_extremal_sign g h hE hsign
    have hnew : (p + t • q).degree ≤ n :=
      mem_degreeLE.mp ((degreeLE ℝ n).add_mem (mem_degreeLE.mpr hp)
        ((degreeLE ℝ n).smul_mem t (mem_degreeLE.mpr hq)))
    have heq : w * (f - (p + t • q).toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)) = g - t • h := by
      ext x
      simp [g, h, eval_smul]
      ring
    have hb := hbest (p+t•q) hnew
    rw [heq] at hb
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hb himprove).elim
  · let v' : Fin (n+2) → Icc a b := fun i =>
      ⟨v i, hcab.1.trans (hvext i).1.1, (hvext i).1.2⟩
    refine ⟨v', hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have hext := (hvext i).2
      rw [heval _ (v' i).property] at hext
      exact hext
    · intro i
      have hs := hvsign i
      rw [heval _ (v' i.castSucc).property, heval _ (v' i.succ).property] at hs
      change (w (v' i.castSucc) * (f (v' i.castSucc) - p.eval (v' i.castSucc : ℝ))) *
        (w (v' i.succ) * (f (v' i.succ) - p.eval (v' i.succ : ℝ))) < 0 at hs
      by_contra hnone
      have hn := le_of_not_gt hnone
      have hm := mul_nonneg (mul_pos (hw (v' i.castSucc)) (hw (v' i.succ))).le hn
      have heq : (w (v' i.castSucc) * w (v' i.succ)) *
          ((f (v' i.castSucc) - p.eval (v' i.castSucc : ℝ)) *
            (f (v' i.succ) - p.eval (v' i.succ : ℝ))) =
          (w (v' i.castSucc) * (f (v' i.castSucc) - p.eval (v' i.castSucc : ℝ))) *
            (w (v' i.succ) * (f (v' i.succ) - p.eval (v' i.succ : ℝ))) := by ring
      rw [heq] at hm
      exact not_lt_of_ge hm hs

name: NLAlib.exists_interpolate_eq_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal
statement:
theorem exists_interpolate_eq_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f w : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n →
      ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖ ≤
        ‖w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n+1) → Ioo a b, StrictMono (fun i => (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩ = p.eval (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i => (c i : ℝ))
        (fun i => f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩) = p
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  by_cases hE : ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖ = 0
  · have hden : (0 : ℝ) < n+2 := by positivity
    let c : Fin (n+1) → Ioo a b := fun i =>
      ⟨a + (b-a) * ((i : ℕ)+1) / (n+2), by
        have hinum : (0 : ℝ) < (i : ℕ)+1 := by positivity
        have hi : ((i : ℕ)+1 : ℝ) < n+2 := by exact_mod_cast (show (i:ℕ)+1<n+2 by omega)
        constructor
        · exact lt_add_of_pos_right a (div_pos (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) hinum) hden)
        · have hpart : (b-a) * ((i:ℕ)+1) / (n+2) < b-a :=
            (div_lt_iff₀ hden).mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hi (sub_pos.mpr hab))
          linarith⟩
    have hval : ∀ i, f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩ = p.eval (c i : ℝ) := by
      intro i
      have hzero := norm_eq_zero.mp hE
      let x : Icc a b := ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩
      have hi := congrArg (fun g : C(Icc a b, ℝ) => g x) hzero
      change w x * (f x - p.eval (x : ℝ)) = 0 at hi
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_left (hw x).ne')
    have hc : StrictMono (fun i => (c i : ℝ)) := by
      intro i j hij
      have hijR : ((i:ℕ)+1 : ℝ) < (j:ℕ)+1 := by exact_mod_cast (show (i:ℕ)+1<(j:ℕ)+1 by omega)
      have hdiv := div_lt_div_of_pos_right
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hijR (sub_pos.mpr hab)) hden
      dsimp [c]
      linarith
    refine ⟨c, hc, hval, ?_⟩
    apply (Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ hc.injective.injOn ?_ ?_).symm
    · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    · intro i _
      exact (hval i).symm
  · have hEpos := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hE)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, _, hsign⟩ :=
      exists_alternating_extrema_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal hab f w hw hp hbest hEpos
    let g : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM f
    have hgv : ∀ i, g (v i) = f (v i) := fun i =>
      ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem (v i).property
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcI, hcval, hcinterp⟩ := exists_interpolate_eq_of_alternation g
      g.continuous.continuousOn hp hv (fun i => (v i).property)
      (by simpa only [hgv] using hsign)
    let c' : Fin (n+1) → Ioo a b := fun i => ⟨c i, hcI i⟩
    have hgval : ∀ i, g (c i) = f ⟨c' i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c' i).property⟩ :=
      fun i => ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hcI i))
    refine ⟨c', hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [← hgval]
      exact hcval i
    · simpa only [Function.comp_def, hgval] using hcinterp

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.positive_intervals
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa only [h.lower_zero, h.upper_zero] using And.intro hell hell1
  | succ k ih =>
    have hh := (h.minimax k).interval_image_normalized ih.1 ih.2
      (h.bounds k) (h.attain_lower k) (h.attain_upper k)
    exact ⟨hh.1, hh.2.1⟩

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.normalized_images
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.normalized_images {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}
    {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ} (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    l (k + 1) + u (k + 1) = 2 ∧ oddUniformError q (c k) (l k) (u k) = 1 - l (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := h.positive_intervals hell hell1 k
  exact ((h.minimax k).interval_image_normalized hi.1 hi.2
    (h.bounds k) (h.attain_lower k) (h.attain_upper k)).2.2

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.composition_mem_interval
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.composition_mem_interval {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}
    {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ} (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc ell 1) (k : ℕ) :
    oddScalarComposition q c x k ∈ Icc (l k) (u k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa only [oddScalarComposition, h.lower_zero, h.upper_zero] using hx
  | succ k ih => exact h.bounds k _ ih

name: NLAlib.eq_of_weighted_error_abs_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := (abs_nonneg x).trans hx
  have hx' := abs_le.mp hx
  have hy' := abs_le.mp hy
  have hz' : z = E ∨ z = -E := abs_eq_abs.mp (hz.trans (abs_of_nonneg hE).symm)
  rcases hz' with hz' | hz'
  · have hxe : x = E := by
      apply le_antisymm hx'.2
      by_contra hnot
      have hpos := mul_pos hA (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hnot))
      have hnonneg := mul_nonneg hB.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hy'.2)
      rw [hz'] at hsum
      nlinarith
    have hye : y = E := by rw [hxe, hz'] at hsum; nlinarith
    exact ⟨hxe.trans hz'.symm, hye.trans hz'.symm⟩
  · have hxe : x = -E := by
      apply le_antisymm ?_ hx'.1
      by_contra hnot
      have hpos := mul_pos hA (show 0 < x + E by linarith)
      have hnonneg := mul_nonneg hB.le (show 0 ≤ y + E by linarith)
      rw [hz'] at hsum
      nlinarith
    have hye : y = -E := by rw [hxe, hz'] at hsum; nlinarith
    exact ⟨hxe.trans hz'.symm, hye.trans hz'.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.eq_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem eq_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ}
    (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r u : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    (hu : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n u)
    (hfr : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f)
    (hfu : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f) : r = u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let α := r.denom.eval a
  let β := u.denom.eval a
  let P := α • r.num + β • u.num
  let Q := α • r.denom + β • u.denom
  let E := rationalMinimaxError m n f
  have hA : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < α * r.denom.eval x := fun x hx =>
    mul_pos_of_continuousOn_ne_zero r.denom.continuous.continuousOn hr.2.2 ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩ hx
  have hB : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < β * u.denom.eval x := fun x hx =>
    mul_pos_of_continuousOn_ne_zero u.denom.continuous.continuousOn hu.2.2 ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩ hx
  have hQeval : ∀ x, Q.eval x = α * r.denom.eval x + β * u.denom.eval x := by
    intro x; simp [Q, eval_smul]
  have hQpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < Q.eval x := by
    intro x hx; rw [hQeval]; exact add_pos (hA x hx) (hB x hx)
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; have ha := hQpos a ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩; simp [hzero] at ha
  have hPdeg : P.degree ≤ m := mem_degreeLE.mp
    ((degreeLE ℝ m).add_mem ((degreeLE ℝ m).smul_mem α (mem_degreeLE.mpr hr.1))
      ((degreeLE ℝ m).smul_mem β (mem_degreeLE.mpr hu.1)))
  have hQdeg : Q.degree ≤ n := mem_degreeLE.mp
    ((degreeLE ℝ n).add_mem ((degreeLE ℝ n).smul_mem α (mem_degreeLE.mpr hr.2.1))
      ((degreeLE ℝ n).smul_mem β (mem_degreeLE.mpr hu.2.1)))
  let w := algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) P / algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) Q
  let hw := isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div P Q hPdeg hQdeg hQ0
    (fun x hx => (hQpos x hx).ne')
  have hwval : ∀ x : Icc a b,
      rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 x = P.eval (x : ℝ) / Q.eval (x : ℝ) :=
    rationalContinuousMap_div_apply_eq P Q hPdeg hQdeg hQ0 (fun x hx => (hQpos x hx).ne')
  have hweighted : ∀ x : Icc a b,
      Q.eval (x : ℝ) * (f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 x) =
        α * r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) * (f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 x) +
        β * u.denom.eval (x : ℝ) * (f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 x) := by
    intro x
    rw [hwval]
    dsimp [rationalContinuousMap]
    simp only [P, Q, eval_add, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hden : α * r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) + β * u.denom.eval (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hQeval]; exact (hQpos x x.property).ne'
    field_simp [hr.2.2 x x.property, hu.2.2 x x.property, hden]
    ring
  have hrbound : ∀ x : Icc a b,
      |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 x| ≤ E := by
    intro x
    simpa [hfr] using (f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2).norm_coe_le_norm x
  have hubound : ∀ x : Icc a b,
      |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 x| ≤ E := by
    intro x
    simpa [hfu] using (f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2).norm_coe_le_norm x
  have hwupper : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2‖ ≤ E := by
    apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (rationalMinimaxError_nonneg m n f)).mpr
    intro x
    change |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 x| ≤ E
    have hb : |Q.eval (x : ℝ) * (f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 x)| ≤
        Q.eval (x : ℝ) * E := by
      rw [hweighted]
      calc
        _ ≤ |α * r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) * (f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 x)| +
            |β * u.denom.eval (x : ℝ) * (f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 x)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = α * r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) * |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 x| +
            β * u.denom.eval (x : ℝ) * |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 x| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (hA x x.property), abs_mul, abs_of_pos (hB x x.property)]
        _ ≤ Q.eval (x : ℝ) * E := by
          have ha := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrbound x) (hA x x.property).le
          have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hubound x) (hB x x.property).le
          rw [hQeval]; nlinarith
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (hQpos x x.property)] at hb
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb (hQpos x x.property)
  have hwbest : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2‖ = E :=
    le_antisymm hwupper (rationalMinimaxError_le_norm_sub m n f ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨v, σ, hv, hσ, hosc⟩ := exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError hab f w hw hwbest
  have hext : ∀ i, |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 (v i)| = E := by
    intro i
    rw [hosc, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, hσ]
    simp only [abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), hwbest]
  have hsamples : ∀ i,
      rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) = rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 (v i) ∧
      rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 (v i) = rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 (v i) := by
    intro i
    have hwgt := hweighted (v i)
    rw [hQeval] at hwgt
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := eq_of_weighted_error_abs_eq (hA _ (v i).property) (hB _ (v i).property)
      (hrbound (v i)) (hubound (v i)) (hext i) hwgt
    constructor <;> linarith
  have heq : ∀ (s : RatFunc ℝ) (hs : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n s),
      (∀ i, rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) s hs.2.2 (v i) =
        rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) w hw.2.2 (v i)) → s = w := by
    intro s hs hsval
    let H := if w = 0 then s.num else s.num * w.denom - w.num * s.denom
    have hH : H.degree ≤ rationalAlternationDegree m n w := degree_rational_difference_numerator_le w s hs
    have hHzero : H = 0 := by
      apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero (s := Finset.univ)
        (v := fun i => (v i : ℝ)) hv.injective.injOn
      · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact hH.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show rationalAlternationDegree m n w < rationalAlternationDegree m n w + 2 by omega))
      · intro i _
        exact difference_numerator_eval_eq_zero_of_rationalContinuousMap_eq w s hw.2.2 hs.2.2 _ (hsval i)
    exact ratFunc_eq_of_difference_numerator_eq_zero w s hHzero
  exact (heq r hr (fun i => (hsamples i).1)).trans (heq u hu (fun i => (hsamples i).2)).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_unique_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_unique_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (m n : ℕ)
    (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) :
    ∃! r : RatFunc ℝ, ∃ hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r,
      ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hfr⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError hab m n f
  refine ⟨r, ⟨hr, hfr⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro u ⟨hu, hfu⟩
  exact eq_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError hab f u r hu hr hfu hfr

name: NLAlib.smoothingDerivative_error_factor_lt_one
statement:
private theorem smoothingDerivative_error_factor_lt_one (n : ℕ) (hn : 5 ≤ n) :
    4 * Real.sqrt (15/112) * (Real.exp 1 / 3)^n < 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : Real.exp 1 / 3 ≤ (11/12 : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  have hpow := (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 / 3) he n).trans
    (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 11/12)
      (by norm_num : (11/12:ℝ) ≤ 1) hn)
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (15/112))^2 = (15/112 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsmall : (4 * Real.sqrt (15/112) * (11/12:ℝ)^5)^2 < 1 := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hs]
    norm_num
  have hfactor : 4 * Real.sqrt (15/112) * (11/12:ℝ)^5 < 1 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (4 * Real.sqrt (15/112) * (11/12:ℝ)^5)]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)).trans_lt hfactor

name: NLAlib.smoothingValue_error_factor_lt_one
statement:
private theorem smoothingValue_error_factor_lt_one (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (5/42) * (Real.exp 1 / 3)^n < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (Real.exp 1 / 3)^n ≤ 1 :=
    pow_le_one₀ (by positivity) (by have := Real.exp_one_lt_three; linarith)
  have hs : Real.sqrt (5/42) < 1 := by
    have := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 5/42)
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (5/42)]
  exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hp).trans_lt hs

name: NLAlib.exp_quarter_le_exp_one_pow
statement:
private theorem exp_quarter_le_exp_one_pow {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 4*n) :
    Real.exp (x/4) ≤ (Real.exp 1)^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_one]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.eval_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_of_le_four_mul
statement:
theorem eval_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_of_le_four_mul
    {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxn : x ≤ 4*n) :
    0 < (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le n hx
  have hfactor : Real.sqrt (5/42) / 3^n * Real.exp (x/4) < 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (5/42) / 3^n * (Real.exp 1)^n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_quarter_le_exp_one_pow hxn) (by positivity)
      _ = Real.sqrt (5/42) * (Real.exp 1 / 3)^n := by rw [div_pow]; ring
      _ < 1 := smoothingValue_error_factor_lt_one n
  have hexp : Real.exp (x/2) = Real.exp (x/4) * Real.exp (x/4) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp] at h
  have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfactor (Real.exp_pos (x/4))
  have habs := le_abs_self (Real.exp (x/4) -
    (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).eval x)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_small_degrees
statement:
theorem doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_small_degrees :
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator 1 = C (215/216) + C (60/216)*X ∧
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator 2 =
      C (7745/7776) + C (1860/7776)*X + C (360/7776)*X^2 ∧
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator 3 =
      C (280055/279936) + C (70620/279936)*X + C (6840/279936)*X^2 + C (1440/279936)*X^3 ∧
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator 4 =
      C (10075985/10077696) + C (2513220/10077696)*X + C (341640/10077696)*X^2 +
        C (10080/10077696)*X^3 + C (4320/10077696)*X^4
proof:
:= by
  simp only [doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_sum]
  norm_num [laguerreExponentialProjection, laguerreExponentialCoefficient,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, laguerrePolynomial,
    Function.iterate_succ_apply', laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply, derivative_sub,
    derivative_smul, derivative_X_pow, derivative_C, derivative_add,
    derivative_mul, derivative_X, derivative_one, smul_eq_C_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro x
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_neg, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X,
      eval_one]
    ring

name: NLAlib.derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_of_le_four_mul
statement:
theorem derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_of_le_four_mul
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 5 ≤ n) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxn : x ≤ 4*n) :
    0 < (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_exp_quarter_div_four_sub_derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le n hx
  have hfactor : 4 * (Real.sqrt (15/112) / 3^n * Real.exp (x/4)) < 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 4 * (Real.sqrt (15/112) / 3^n * (Real.exp 1)^n) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_quarter_le_exp_one_pow hxn) (by positivity))
          (by norm_num)
      _ = 4 * Real.sqrt (15/112) * (Real.exp 1 / 3)^n := by rw [div_pow]; ring
      _ < 1 := smoothingDerivative_error_factor_lt_one n hn
  have hexp : Real.exp (x/2) = Real.exp (x/4) * Real.exp (x/4) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp] at h
  have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfactor (Real.exp_pos (x/4))
  have habs := le_abs_self (Real.exp (x/4)/4 -
    (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_small_degrees
statement:
theorem doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_pos_small_degrees
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hn4 : n ≤ 4) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 < (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).eval x ∧
      0 < (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_small_degrees
  rcases (show n=1 ∨ n=2 ∨ n=3 ∨ n=4 by omega) with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals
    first | rw [h1] | rw [h2] | rw [h3] | rw [h4]
    constructor
    · simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, eval_pow]
      positivity
    · simp only [derivative_add, derivative_mul, derivative_C, derivative_X,
        derivative_X_pow, zero_mul, mul_one, zero_add,
        eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, eval_pow]
      positivity

name: NLAlib.one_div_eighteen_pi_le_bernsteinConstant
statement:
theorem one_div_eighteen_pi_le_bernsteinConstant :
    1/(18*Real.pi) ≤ bernsteinConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hL : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1/(18*Real.pi))*((n:ℝ)/(n+1)))
      atTop (𝓝 (1/(18*Real.pi))) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (tendsto_natCast_div_add_atTop (1:ℝ)).const_mul (1/(18*Real.pi))
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hL tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro n
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (one_div_eighteen_pi_mul_succ_le_absoluteMinimaxError n) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  have heq : (1/(18*Real.pi))*((n:ℝ)/(n+1)) =
      (n:ℝ)*(1/(18*Real.pi*(n+1))) := by
    field_simp
  change (1/(18*Real.pi))*((n:ℝ)/(n+1)) ≤ (n:ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError n
  rwa [heq]

name: NLAlib.bernsteinConstant_pos
statement: theorem bernsteinConstant_pos : 0 < bernsteinConstant
proof:
:=
  (div_pos zero_lt_one (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)).trans_le
    one_div_eighteen_pi_le_bernsteinConstant

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_pos_tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError :
    ∃ β : ℝ, 0 < β ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError n) atTop (𝓝 β)
proof:
:=
  ⟨bernsteinConstant, bernsteinConstant_pos, tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError⟩

name: NLAlib.bernsteinConstant_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem bernsteinConstant_mem_Icc :
    bernsteinConstant ∈ Set.Icc (1/(18*Real.pi)) (2/Real.pi)
proof:
:=
  ⟨one_div_eighteen_pi_le_bernsteinConstant, bernsteinConstant_le_two_div_pi⟩

name: NLAlib.natDegree_polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial_le (q : ℕ) :
    (polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial q).natDegree ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro j hj
  have hjq : j ≤ q := by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hj
  apply (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le.trans
  have hd : (1 - X : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le (1 : ℝ[X]) X)
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left j hd).trans (by simpa using hjq)

name: NLAlib.oddScalarUpdate_polarTaylor_coeff
statement:
theorem oddScalarUpdate_polarTaylor_coeff (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    oddScalarUpdate q (polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial q).coeff x = polarTaylorUpdate q x
proof:
:= by
  have he := Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range'
    (p := polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial q)
    (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (natDegree_polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial_le q)) (x ^ 2)
  have heval : (polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial q).eval (x ^ 2) =
      polarTaylorSum q (1 - x ^ 2) := by
    simp [polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial, polarTaylorSum, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  rw [heval] at he
  rw [polarTaylorUpdate, he, Finset.mul_sum, oddScalarUpdate]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [pow_add, pow_one, pow_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_oddScalarUpdate_eq_polarTaylorUpdate
statement:
theorem exists_oddScalarUpdate_eq_polarTaylorUpdate (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ x, oddScalarUpdate q c x = polarTaylorUpdate q x
proof:
:=
  ⟨(polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial q).coeff, oddScalarUpdate_polarTaylor_coeff q⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_oddScalarUpdate_interval_competitor
statement:
theorem exists_oddScalarUpdate_interval_competitor (q : ℕ) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      Real.sqrt (1 - (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)) ≤ oddScalarUpdate q c x ∧
        oddScalarUpdate q c x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := ha.trans_le hab
  let d := (polarTaylorCoefficientPolynomial q).coeff
  refine ⟨fun j => d j / b ^ (2 * j + 1), fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hx0 : 0 < x / b := div_pos (ha.trans_le hx.1) hb
  have hx1 : x / b ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hb).mpr hx.2
  have hp := polarTaylorUpdate_pos_le_one q hx0 hx1
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a / b := (div_pos ha hb).le
  have halx : a / b ≤ x / b := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hb).mpr hx.1
  have hg : 0 ≤ 1 - (x / b) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hgap : 1 - (x / b) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - (a / b) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsq := one_sub_pow_le_polarTaylorUpdate_sq q ⟨hx0.le, hx1⟩
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hg hgap (q + 1)
  have hlower : 1 - (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1) ≤ polarTaylorUpdate q (x / b) ^ 2 := by
    linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (1 - (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)) ≤
      polarTaylorUpdate q (x / b) := (Real.sqrt_le_left hp.1.le).mpr hlower
  have he : oddScalarUpdate q (fun j => d j / b ^ (2 * j + 1)) x =
      polarTaylorUpdate q (x / b) := by
    simpa only [one_mul, oddScalarUpdate_polarTaylor_coeff, d] using
      oddScalarUpdate_rescale q d 1 b x
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨hsqrt, hp.2⟩

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorCoeff_pos
statement: theorem polarTaylorCoeff_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < polarTaylorCoeff j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => norm_num [polarTaylorCoeff]
  | succ j ih =>
    simp only [polarTaylorCoeff]
    exact mul_pos (div_pos (by positivity) (by positivity)) ih

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorCoeff_recurrence
statement:
theorem polarTaylorCoeff_recurrence (j : ℕ) :
    (2 * (j : ℝ) + 2) * polarTaylorCoeff (j + 1) =
      (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * polarTaylorCoeff j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polarTaylorCoeff, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorUpdate_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem polarTaylorUpdate_zero (q : ℕ) : polarTaylorUpdate q 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [polarTaylorUpdate]

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorUpdate_one
statement: @[simp] theorem polarTaylorUpdate_one (q : ℕ) : polarTaylorUpdate q 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polarTaylorUpdate, polarTaylorSum, one_pow, sub_self, one_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp [polarTaylorCoeff]
  · intro j hj hj0
    rw [zero_pow hj0, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorUpdate_succ
statement:
theorem polarTaylorUpdate_succ (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    polarTaylorUpdate (q + 1) x = polarTaylorUpdate q x +
      polarTaylorCoeff (q + 1) * x * (1 - x ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polarTaylorUpdate, polarTaylorSum, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_polarTaylorUpdate
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polarTaylorUpdate (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (polarTaylorUpdate q)
      ((2 * (q : ℝ) + 1) * polarTaylorCoeff q * (1 - x ^ 2) ^ q) x
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    have hf : polarTaylorUpdate 0 = id := by
      funext y
      simp [polarTaylorUpdate, polarTaylorSum, polarTaylorCoeff, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    rw [hf]
    simpa [polarTaylorCoeff] using! hasDerivAt_id x
  | succ q ih =>
    have hu : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 - y ^ 2) (-(2 * x)) x := by
      simpa using! (hasDerivAt_const x (1 : ℝ)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2)
    have ht := (((hasDerivAt_id x).mul (hu.pow (q + 1))).const_mul (polarTaylorCoeff (q + 1)))
    have hh := ih.add ht
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      one_mul] at hh
    have hf : polarTaylorUpdate q + (fun y => polarTaylorCoeff (q + 1) *
        (y * (1 - y ^ 2) ^ (q + 1))) = polarTaylorUpdate (q + 1) := by
      funext y
      change polarTaylorUpdate q y + polarTaylorCoeff (q + 1) *
        (y * (1 - y ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)) = polarTaylorUpdate (q + 1) y
      rw [polarTaylorUpdate_succ]
      ring
    rw [hf] at hh
    convert! hh using 1
    rw [pow_succ]
    push_cast
    have hc := polarTaylorCoeff_recurrence q
    linear_combination (1 - x ^ 2) ^ q * hc

name: NLAlib.continuous_polarTaylorUpdate
statement: theorem continuous_polarTaylorUpdate (q : ℕ) : Continuous (polarTaylorUpdate q)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hasDerivAt_polarTaylorUpdate q x).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorSum_monotoneOn
statement: theorem polarTaylorSum_monotoneOn (q : ℕ) : MonotoneOn (polarTaylorSum q) (Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j hj
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hu huv j) (polarTaylorCoeff_pos j).le

name: NLAlib.polarTaylorUpdate_pos_le_one
statement:
theorem polarTaylorUpdate_pos_le_one (q : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    0 < polarTaylorUpdate q x ∧ polarTaylorUpdate q x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 ≤ 1 - x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hs : 1 ≤ polarTaylorSum q (1 - x ^ 2) := by
    calc
      1 = polarTaylorCoeff 0 * (1 - x ^ 2) ^ 0 := by simp [polarTaylorCoeff]
      _ ≤ polarTaylorSum q (1 - x ^ 2) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j hj => mul_nonneg (polarTaylorCoeff_pos j).le (pow_nonneg hu j))
          (by simp)
  have hmono : MonotoneOn (polarTaylorUpdate q) (Icc 0 1) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 1) (continuous_polarTaylorUpdate q).continuousOn
    · intro y hy; exact (hasDerivAt_polarTaylorUpdate q y).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      rw [(hasDerivAt_polarTaylorUpdate q y).deriv]
      have hyI : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := interior_subset hy
      have hnon : 0 ≤ 1 - y ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hyI.1, hyI.2]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (polarTaylorCoeff_pos q).le) (pow_nonneg hnon q)
  refine ⟨mul_pos hx (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hs), ?_⟩
  simpa only [polarTaylorUpdate_one] using hmono ⟨hx.le, hx1⟩ (by simp) hx1

name: NLAlib.one_sub_pow_le_polarTaylorUpdate_sq
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_le_polarTaylorUpdate_sq (q : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    1 - (1 - x ^ 2) ^ (q + 1) ≤ polarTaylorUpdate q x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let K := (2 * (q : ℝ) + 1) * polarTaylorCoeff q
  let B := fun y : ℝ => K * polarTaylorSum q (1 - y ^ 2) - (q + 1)
  let F := fun y : ℝ => polarTaylorUpdate q y ^ 2 - 1 + (1 - y ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (polarTaylorCoeff_pos q).le
  have hB : AntitoneOn B (Icc 0 1) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    have hu' : 0 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hu.1, hu.2]
    have hv' : 0 ≤ 1 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hv.1, hv.2]
    have he : 1 - v ^ 2 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hu.1, hv.1]
    dsimp only [B]
    exact sub_le_sub_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (polarTaylorSum_monotoneOn q hv' hu' he) hK) _
  have hF (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (2 * y * (1 - y ^ 2) ^ q * B y) y := by
    have hu : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t ^ 2) (-(2 * y)) y := by
      simpa using! (hasDerivAt_const y (1 : ℝ)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 2)
    have hh := (((hasDerivAt_polarTaylorUpdate q y).pow 2).sub_const 1).add (hu.pow (q + 1))
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.pow_apply, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_one] at hh
    convert! hh using 1
    dsimp only [B, K, polarTaylorUpdate]
    rw [pow_succ]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hFcont : Continuous F := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (hF y).continuousAt
  have hFzero : F 0 = 0 := by simp [F]
  have hFone : F 1 = 0 := by simp [F]
  have hnon : 0 ≤ F x := by
    by_cases hBx : 0 ≤ B x
    · have hm : MonotoneOn F (Icc 0 x) := by
        apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 x) hFcont.continuousOn
        · intro y hy; exact (hF y).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        · intro y hy
          rw [(hF y).deriv]
          have hyI : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) x := interior_subset hy
          have hy1 : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hyI.1, hyI.2.trans hx.2⟩
          have hby : 0 ≤ B y := hBx.trans (hB hy1 hx hyI.2)
          have hu : 0 ≤ 1 - y ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hy1.1, hy1.2]
          exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hyI.1) (pow_nonneg hu q)) hby
      have hh := hm ⟨le_rfl, hx.1⟩ ⟨hx.1, le_rfl⟩ hx.1
      rwa [hFzero] at hh
    · have hm : AntitoneOn F (Icc x 1) := by
        apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc x 1) hFcont.continuousOn
        · intro y hy; exact (hF y).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        · intro y hy
          rw [(hF y).deriv]
          have hyI : y ∈ Icc x (1 : ℝ) := interior_subset hy
          have hy0 : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx.1.trans hyI.1, hyI.2⟩
          have hby : B y ≤ 0 := (hB hx hy0 hyI.1).trans (le_of_not_ge hBx)
          have hu : 0 ≤ 1 - y ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hy0.1, hy0.2]
          exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hy0.1) (pow_nonneg hu q)) hby
      have hh := hm ⟨le_rfl, hx.2⟩ ⟨hx.2, le_rfl⟩ hx.2
      rwa [hFone] at hh
  dsimp only [F] at hnon
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_sum_smul_U_eq_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem exists_sum_smul_U_eq_of_degree_lt {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree < n) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, (∑ j ∈ range n, c j • U ℝ (j : ℤ)) = p
proof:
:= by
  let S := chebyshevUSequence
  have hCoeff : ∀ i < n, IsUnit (S i).leadingCoeff := by
    intro i hi
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (S.ne_zero i))
  have hmem : p ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp
  rw [← S.span_degreeLT hCoeff] at hmem
  have hset : Set.Iio n = (range n : Set ℕ) := by ext i; simp
  rw [hset] at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun' ℝ).mp hmem
  exact ⟨c, hc⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_sine_expansion_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem exists_sine_expansion_of_degree_lt {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree < n) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      sin t * p.eval (cos t) = ∑ j ∈ range n, c j * sin (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_U_eq_of_degree_lt hp
  refine ⟨c, fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [← hc, eval_finsetSum, mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  rw [eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h := U_real_cos t (j : ℤ)
  have heq : sin t * (c j * (U ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (cos t)) =
      c j * ((U ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (cos t) * sin t) := by ring
  rw [heq, h]
  norm_cast

name: NLAlib.exists_sine_expansion_sawtoothApprox
statement:
theorem exists_sine_expansion_sawtoothApprox (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      sawtoothApprox n t = ∑ j ∈ range n, c j * sin (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)
proof:
:=
  exists_sine_expansion_of_degree_lt (degree_sawtoothSineInterp_lt n)

name: NLAlib.oddUniformError_nonneg
statement:
theorem oddUniformError_nonneg (q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ oddUniformError q c a b
proof: := norm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.abs_one_sub_oddScalarUpdate_le
statement:
theorem abs_one_sub_oddScalarUpdate_le (q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (a b x : ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) : |1 - oddScalarUpdate q c x| ≤ oddUniformError q c a b
proof:
:= by
  exact ((1 : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) - oddUpdateOn q c a b).norm_coe_le_norm ⟨x, hx⟩

name: NLAlib.oddUniformError_le_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ hE).mpr
  intro x
  exact h x x.property

name: NLAlib.exists_isOddMinimaxOn
statement: theorem exists_isOddMinimaxOn (q : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) : ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, IsOddMinimaxOn q c a b
proof:
:= by
  let L : (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(Icc a b, ℝ) :=
    { toFun := fun c =>
        ⟨fun x => ∑ j : Fin (q + 1), c j * (x : ℝ) ^ (2 * (j : ℕ) + 1), by fun_prop⟩
      map_add' := by
        intro c d
        ext x
        simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro t c
        ext x
        simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc] }
  have : FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range L) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hbest⟩ := exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional
    (LinearMap.range L) (1 : C(Icc a b, ℝ))
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hf
  let c' : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => if hj : j < q + 1 then c ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0
  have hmap (d : ℕ → ℝ) : L (fun j : Fin (q + 1) => d j) = oddUpdateOn q d a b := by
    ext x
    change (∑ j : Fin (q + 1), d j * (x : ℝ) ^ (2 * (j : ℕ) + 1)) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (q + 1), d j * (x : ℝ) ^ (2 * j + 1)
    simpa only using (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => d j * (x : ℝ) ^ (2 * j + 1)) (q + 1))
  have hc : (fun j : Fin (q + 1) => c' j) = c := by
    funext j
    dsimp only [c']
    rw [dif_pos j.isLt]
  refine ⟨c', fun d => ?_⟩
  have hp : oddUpdateOn q c' a b = L c := by rw [← hmap, hc]
  rw [oddUniformError, hp, hbest]
  simpa only [oddUniformError, dist_eq_norm, hmap] using
    (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := (1 : C(Icc a b, ℝ)))
      (show L (fun j : Fin (q + 1) => d j) ∈ LinearMap.range L from ⟨_, rfl⟩))

name: NLAlib.oddScalarUpdate_smul_coeff
statement:
theorem oddScalarUpdate_smul_coeff (q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (t x : ℝ) :
    oddScalarUpdate q (fun j => t * c j) x = t * oddScalarUpdate q c x
proof:
:= by
  simp [oddScalarUpdate, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.oddScalarUpdate_rescale
statement:
theorem oddScalarUpdate_rescale (q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (t b x : ℝ) :
    oddScalarUpdate q (fun j => t * c j / b ^ (2 * j + 1)) x =
      t * oddScalarUpdate q c (x / b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [oddScalarUpdate, div_pow, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: NLAlib.interval_squared_ratio_gap_mem
statement:
theorem interval_squared_ratio_gap_mem {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    1 - (a / b) ^ 2 ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := ha.trans_le hab
  have hr : 0 < a / b := div_pos ha hb
  have hr1 : a / b ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hb).mpr hab
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsOddMinimaxOn.squared_ratio_contraction
statement:
theorem IsOddMinimaxOn.squared_ratio_contraction {q : ℕ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {a b m M : ℝ}
    (h : IsOddMinimaxOn q c a b) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounds : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, m ≤ oddScalarUpdate q c x ∧ oddScalarUpdate q c x ≤ M)
    (hm : ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = m)
    (hM : ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = M) :
    1 - (m / M) ^ 2 ≤ (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1) ∧
      oddUniformError q c a b ≤ (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let D := (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)
  let r := Real.sqrt (1 - D)
  have hd := interval_squared_ratio_gap_mem ha hab
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := pow_nonneg hd.1 _
  have hD1 : D < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hd.1 hd.2 (by omega)
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by dsimp only [D]; exact sub_pos.mpr hD1)
  have hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - D := Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hD1.le)
  have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hD0]
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_oddScalarUpdate_interval_competitor q ha hab
  have hscaled : oddUniformError q (fun j => (2 / (r + 1)) * d j) a b ≤ (1 - r) / (r + 1) := by
    apply oddUniformError_le_of_forall (div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr1) (by positivity))
    intro x hx
    rw [oddScalarUpdate_smul_coeff]
    exact abs_one_sub_two_div_mul_le hr hr1 (hd x hx)
  have hE : oddUniformError q c a b ≤ (1 - r) / (r + 1) := (h _).trans hscaled
  have hE0 := oddUniformError_nonneg q c a b
  have hEmul : oddUniformError q c a b * (r + 1) ≤ 1 - r :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < r + 1)).mp hE
  obtain ⟨hm0, hmM, hcenter, hEnorm⟩ := h.interval_image_normalized ha hab hbounds hm hM
  have hM0 : 0 < M := hm0.trans_le hmM
  have hrmul : r * M ≤ m := by rw [hEnorm] at hEmul; nlinarith
  have hratio : r ≤ m / M := (le_div_iff₀ hM0).mpr hrmul
  have hsquare : r ^ 2 ≤ (m / M) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hratio 2
  constructor
  · change 1 - (m / M) ^ 2 ≤ D
    nlinarith
  · change oddUniformError q c a b ≤ D
    have hEr : oddUniformError q c a b ≤ 1 - r := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hE0 hr.le]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.squared_ratio_gap_le
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.squared_ratio_gap_le {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}
    {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ} (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    1 - (l k / u k) ^ 2 ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [h.lower_zero, h.upper_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hi := h.positive_intervals hell hell1 k
    have hgap := (interval_squared_ratio_gap_mem hi.1 hi.2).1
    have hc := ((h.minimax k).squared_ratio_contraction hi.1 hi.2
      (h.bounds k) (h.attain_lower k) (h.attain_upper k)).1
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 - (l k / u k) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1) := hc
      _ ≤ ((1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ k)) ^ (q + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hgap ih _
      _ = (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ (k + 1)) := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.uniform_error_le
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.uniform_error_le {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}
    {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ} (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    oddUniformError q (c k) (l k) (u k) ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hi := h.positive_intervals hell hell1 k
  have hgap := (interval_squared_ratio_gap_mem hi.1 hi.2).1
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 - (l k / u k) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1) :=
      ((h.minimax k).squared_ratio_contraction hi.1 hi.2
        (h.bounds k) (h.attain_lower k) (h.attain_upper k)).2
    _ ≤ ((1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ k)) ^ (q + 1) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hgap (h.squared_ratio_gap_le hell hell1 k) _
    _ = (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ (k + 1)) := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.composition_error_le
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.composition_error_le {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}
    {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ} (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) {T : ℕ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc ell 1) :
    |1 - oddScalarComposition q c x T| ≤ 1 - l T ∧
      1 - l T ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : T ≠ 0)
  have he := abs_one_sub_oddScalarUpdate_le q (c k) (l k) (u k)
    (oddScalarComposition q c x k) (h.composition_mem_interval hx k)
  have hnorm := (h.normalized_images hell hell1 k).2
  rw [hnorm] at he
  exact ⟨he, hnorm ▸ h.uniform_error_le hell hell1 k⟩

name: NLAlib.tendsto_bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder
statement:
theorem tendsto_bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder {α : ℝ} (hα1 : α < 1) :
    Tendsto (bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder α) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let c := bernsteinDegreeTransferDecay α
  let t := (1-α)/2
  let C := 12*Real.exp 1/(Real.pi*α*(Real.exp t-1))
  have hc : 0 < c := bernsteinDegreeTransferDecay_pos hα1
  have h0 : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.exp (-c*N)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul] using!
      (tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_atTop_nhds_zero 0 c hc).comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N:ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-c*N)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.rpow_two] using!
      (tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_atTop_nhds_zero 2 c hc).comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have h := (h0.add (h2.const_mul ((α*Real.cosh t)^2))).const_mul C
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at h
  convert! h using 1
  funext N
  dsimp [bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder, c, C, t]
  ring

name: NLAlib.scaled_absoluteMinimaxError_even_le
statement:
private theorem scaled_absoluteMinimaxError_even_le (m : ℕ) :
    ((2*m:ℕ):ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError (2*m) ≤ 2/Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have h := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<Real.pi*(2*m+1))).mp
    (absoluteMinimaxError_even_le m)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mpr
  have hp := mul_nonneg (absoluteMinimaxError_nonneg (2*m)) Real.pi_pos.le
  push_cast
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.absoluteMinimaxError_degreeTransfer_eventually
statement:
private theorem absoluteMinimaxError_degreeTransfer_eventually :
    ∀ α : ℝ, 0<α → α<1 → ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 1≤N → ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
        (N:ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError N ≤
          ((2*m:ℕ):ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError (2*m)/α+r N
proof:
:= by
  intro α hα0 hα1
  refine ⟨bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder α, tendsto_bernsteinDegreeTransferRemainder hα1, ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have hm : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ((2*m:ℕ):ℝ)) atTop atTop := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)
  filter_upwards [hm.eventually_ge_atTop
    (2*max 1 ((α*N*Real.cosh ((1-α)/2))^2))] with m hthreshold
  exact mul_absoluteMinimaxError_le_degreeTransfer hα0 hα1 hN hthreshold

name: NLAlib.tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError
statement:
theorem tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError n) atTop (𝓝 bernsteinConstant)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_nat_mul_of_even_tendsto absoluteMinimaxError_antitone
  exact tendsto_even_sequence_of_degree_transfer
    (fun n => (n:ℝ)*absoluteMinimaxError n)
    (fun n => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (absoluteMinimaxError_nonneg _))
    scaled_absoluteMinimaxError_even_le absoluteMinimaxError_degreeTransfer_eventually

name: NLAlib.bernsteinConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem bernsteinConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ bernsteinConstant
proof:
:=
  le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (absoluteMinimaxError_nonneg n))

name: NLAlib.bernsteinConstant_le_two_div_pi
statement: theorem bernsteinConstant_le_two_div_pi : bernsteinConstant ≤ 2/Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*n) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n : ℕ => by dsimp; omega) tendsto_id
  have h := tendsto_nat_mul_absoluteMinimaxError.comp ht
  exact le_of_tendsto h (Eventually.of_forall scaled_absoluteMinimaxError_even_le)

name: NLAlib.nonempty_greedyOddStep
statement:
private theorem nonempty_greedyOddStep (q : ℕ) (I : PositiveInterval) :
    Nonempty (GreedyOddStep q I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_isOddMinimaxOn q I.val.1 I.val.2
  obtain ⟨m, M, hb, hm, hM⟩ := exists_oddScalarUpdate_interval_bounds q c I.property.2
  have hn := hc.interval_image_normalized I.property.1 I.property.2 hb hm hM
  exact ⟨⟨c, ⟨(m, M), hn.1, hn.2.1⟩, hc, hb, hm, hM⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_isGreedyOddMinimax
statement:
theorem exists_isGreedyOddMinimax (q : ℕ) {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (l u : ℕ → ℝ), IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let chooseStep : (I : PositiveInterval) → GreedyOddStep q I :=
    fun I => Classical.choice (nonempty_greedyOddStep q I)
  let initial : PositiveInterval := ⟨(ell, 1), hell, hell1⟩
  let intervals : ℕ → PositiveInterval :=
    Nat.rec initial (fun _ I => (chooseStep I).next)
  let c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (chooseStep (intervals k)).coefficients
  let l : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (intervals k).val.1
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (intervals k).val.2
  refine ⟨c, l, u, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    exact (chooseStep (intervals k)).minimax
  · intro k x hx
    exact (chooseStep (intervals k)).bounds x hx
  · intro k
    exact (chooseStep (intervals k)).attain_lower
  · intro k
    exact (chooseStep (intervals k)).attain_upper

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_comp_le_of_affine
statement:
theorem minimaxError_comp_le_of_affine {s t : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] [CompactSpace t]
    (n : ℕ) (f : C(t, ℝ)) (h : C(s, t)) (α β : ℝ)
    (haff : ∀ x : s, (h x : ℝ) = α * (x : ℝ) + β) :
    minimaxError n (f.comp h) ≤ minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError n f
  let q : ℝ[X] := p.comp (C α * X + C β)
  have hlin : (C α * X + C β : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    exact natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le
      ((natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans natDegree_X_le) (by simp)
  have hpn : p.natDegree ≤ n := natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hp
  have hq : q.degree ≤ n := by
    apply degree_le_natDegree.trans
    exact_mod_cast (natDegree_comp_le.trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul hpn hlin)).trans (by simp : n * 1 ≤ n)
  have herr : ‖f.comp h - q.toContinuousMapOn s‖ ≤ ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn t‖ := by
    apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (norm_nonneg _)).mpr
    intro x
    convert (f - p.toContinuousMapOn t).norm_coe_le_norm (h x) using 1
    simp [q, haff]
  exact (minimaxError_le_norm_sub (f.comp h)
    (mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩)).trans (herr.trans_eq hfp)

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_comp_homeomorph_of_affine
statement:
theorem minimaxError_comp_homeomorph_of_affine {s t : Set ℝ}
    [CompactSpace s] [CompactSpace t] (n : ℕ) (f : C(t, ℝ)) (h : s ≃ₜ t)
    (α β : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (haff : ∀ x : s, (h x : ℝ) = α * (x : ℝ) + β) :
    minimaxError n (f.comp ⟨h, h.continuous⟩) = minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (minimaxError_comp_le_of_affine n f ⟨h, h.continuous⟩ α β haff)
  have hinv : ∀ y : t, (h.symm y : ℝ) = α⁻¹ * (y : ℝ) + (-β / α) := by
    intro y
    have heq := haff (h.symm y)
    simp only [h.apply_symm_apply] at heq
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hle := minimaxError_comp_le_of_affine n (f.comp ⟨h, h.continuous⟩)
    ⟨h.symm, h.symm.continuous⟩ α⁻¹ (-β / α) hinv
  have heq : (f.comp ⟨h, h.continuous⟩).comp ⟨h.symm, h.symm.continuous⟩ = f := by ext y; simp
  rwa [heq] at hle

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_comp_affine_interval
statement:
theorem minimaxError_comp_affine_interval (n : ℕ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (f : C(Set.Icc a b, ℝ)) :
    minimaxError n
      (f.comp ⟨((iccHomeoI (-1 : ℝ) 1 (by norm_num)).trans
        (iccHomeoI a b hab).symm), Homeomorph.continuous _⟩) = minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  apply minimaxError_comp_homeomorph_of_affine n f _ ((b - a) / 2) ((a + b) / 2)
  · exact div_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.ne') (by norm_num)
  · intro x
    simp only [Homeomorph.trans_apply, iccHomeoI_symm_apply_coe, iccHomeoI_apply_coe]
    ring

name: NLAlib.isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div
statement:
theorem isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div {s : Set ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hp : p.degree ≤ m) (hq : q.degree ≤ n) (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hpole : ∀ x ∈ s, q.eval x ≠ 0) :
    IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation s m n
      (algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p / algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, (degree_le_of_dvd (RatFunc.denom_div_dvd p q) hq0).trans hq, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · simp [hp0]
    · exact (degree_le_of_dvd (RatFunc.num_div_dvd p hq0) hp0).trans hp
  · intro x hx hzero
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := RatFunc.denom_div_dvd p q
    apply hpole x hx
    rw [ha, eval_mul, hzero, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.rationalContinuousMap_div_apply_eq
statement:
theorem rationalContinuousMap_div_apply_eq {s : Set ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hp : p.degree ≤ m) (hq : q.degree ≤ n) (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hpole : ∀ x ∈ s, q.eval x ≠ 0) (x : s) :
    rationalContinuousMap s
      (algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p / algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) q)
      (isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div p q hp hq hq0 hpole).2.2 x =
      p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let r := algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) p / algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) q
  have hr := isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div p q hp hq hq0 hpole
  have hrel : r.num * q = p * r.denom :=
    (RatFunc.num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff hq0).mpr rfl
  have hev : r.num.eval (x : ℝ) * q.eval (x : ℝ) =
      p.eval (x : ℝ) * r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [eval_mul] using congrArg (fun P : ℝ[X] => P.eval (x : ℝ)) hrel
  change r.num.eval (x : ℝ) / r.denom.eval (x : ℝ) = _
  exact (div_eq_div_iff (hr.2.2 x x.property) (hpole x x.property)).mpr hev

name: NLAlib.isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_zero
statement:
theorem isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_zero (s : Set ℝ) (m n : ℕ) :
    IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation s m n 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · simp only [RatFunc.denom_zero, degree_one]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n
  · simp

name: NLAlib.rationalApproximationSpace_nonempty
statement:
theorem rationalApproximationSpace_nonempty (s : Set ℝ) (m n : ℕ) :
    (rationalApproximationSpace s m n).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨rationalContinuousMap s 0 (isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_zero s m n).2.2,
    0, isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_zero s m n, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.rationalMinimaxError_nonneg
statement:
theorem rationalMinimaxError_nonneg {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (m n : ℕ) (f : C(s, ℝ)) : 0 ≤ rationalMinimaxError m n f
proof: := Metric.infDist_nonneg

name: NLAlib.rationalMinimaxError_le_norm_sub
statement:
theorem rationalMinimaxError_le_norm_sub {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] (m n : ℕ)
    (f : C(s, ℝ)) {g : C(s, ℝ)} (hg : g ∈ rationalApproximationSpace s m n) :
    rationalMinimaxError m n f ≤ ‖f - g‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rationalMinimaxError, dist_eq_norm] using (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := f) hg)

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (m n : ℕ)
    (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) :
    ∃ (r : RatFunc ℝ) (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r),
      ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (a ≤ b) := ⟨hab.le⟩
  let ff : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM f
  let E := rationalMinimaxError m n f
  have hnear : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ p q : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ m ∧ q.degree ≤ n ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |ff x * q.eval x - p.eval x| ≤ (E + ε) * |q.eval x| := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hdist⟩ := (Metric.infDist_lt_iff
      (rationalApproximationSpace_nonempty (Icc a b) m n)).mp
        (show Metric.infDist f (rationalApproximationSpace (Icc a b) m n) < E + ε by
          change E < E + ε; linarith)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrg⟩ := hg
    have hnorm : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ < E + ε := by
      simpa [← hrg, dist_eq_norm] using hdist
    refine ⟨r.num, r.denom, hr.1, hr.2.1, RatFunc.denom_ne_zero r, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hpoint : |ff x - r.num.eval x / r.denom.eval x| ≤ E + ε := by
      have hb := (f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2).norm_coe_le_norm ⟨x, hx⟩
      have hval : ff x = f ⟨x, hx⟩ := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem hx
      change |f ⟨x, hx⟩ - r.num.eval x / r.denom.eval x| ≤ _ at hb
      rw [← hval] at hb
      exact hb.trans hnorm.le
    have heq : ff x * r.denom.eval x - r.num.eval x =
        r.denom.eval x * (ff x - r.num.eval x / r.denom.eval x) := by
      field_simp [hr.2.2 x hx]
    rw [heq, abs_mul]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint (abs_nonneg (r.denom.eval x))]
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_cross_error_le_of_forall_pos hab ff ff.continuous hnear
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have ha := (hbound a ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩).1
    simp [hzero] at ha
  let r := algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) P / algebraMap ℝ[X] (RatFunc ℝ) Q
  let hr := isPoleFreeRationalApproximation_div P Q hP hQ hQ0 (fun x hx => (hbound x hx).1)
  have hnorm : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ ≤ E := by
    apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (rationalMinimaxError_nonneg m n f)).mpr
    intro x
    have hval : ff x = f x := ContinuousMap.IccExtendCM_of_mem x.property
    have heval := rationalContinuousMap_div_apply_eq P Q hP hQ hQ0
      (fun x hx => (hbound x hx).1) x
    change |f x - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 x| ≤ E
    rw [heval, ← hval]
    have hb := (hbound x x.property).2
    have heq : ff x * Q.eval (x : ℝ) - P.eval (x : ℝ) =
        Q.eval (x : ℝ) * (ff x - P.eval (x : ℝ) / Q.eval (x : ℝ)) := by
      field_simp [(hbound x x.property).1]
    rw [heq, abs_mul] at hb
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := |Q.eval (x : ℝ)|)
      (by nlinarith [hb]) (abs_pos.mpr (hbound x x.property).1)
  exact ⟨r, hr, le_antisymm hnorm
    (rationalMinimaxError_le_norm_sub m n f ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)⟩

name: NLAlib.tendsto_eval_mul_exp_neg
statement:
private theorem tendsto_eval_mul_exp_neg (p : ℝ[X]) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x * Real.exp (-x)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simpa only [eval_add, add_mul, add_zero] using hp.add hq
  | monomial n a =>
    simpa only [eval_monomial, mul_assoc, mul_zero] using
      (Real.tendsto_pow_mul_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero n).const_mul a

name: NLAlib.sumIDeriv_eval_mul_exp_neg_eq_integral_Ioi
statement:
theorem sumIDeriv_eval_mul_exp_neg_eq_integral_Ioi (p : ℝ[X]) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (sumIDeriv p).eval x * Real.exp (-x) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, p.eval t * Real.exp (-t)
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => (sumIDeriv p).eval t * Real.exp (-t))
      (-(p.eval t * Real.exp (-t))) t := by
    have h := (sumIDeriv p).hasDerivAt t |>.mul ((hasDerivAt_neg t).exp)
    have he := congrArg (fun q : ℝ[X] => q.eval t) (sumIDeriv_eq_self_add p)
    simp only [eval_add] at he
    have ht := congrArg (fun a : ℝ => a * Real.exp (-t)) he
    have hd : (sumIDeriv p).derivative.eval t * Real.exp (-t) +
        (sumIDeriv p).eval t * (Real.exp (-t) * -1) =
        -(p.eval t * Real.exp (-t)) := by nlinarith
    rw [hd] at h
    convert! h using 1
  have hint0 : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => p.eval t * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p zero_lt_one
  have hint := hint0.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  have h := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun t _ => hderiv t)
    hint.neg (tendsto_eval_mul_exp_neg (sumIDeriv p))
  rw [integral_neg, zero_sub] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_neg_Ioi
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_neg_Ioi (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, Real.exp (-t)) = Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  exact _root_.integral_exp_neg_Ioi x

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_Ioi
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-t)) =
      (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp ((-3/4)*t)) := by
    funext t
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have h := integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-3/4 : ℝ) < 0) x
  rw [h]
  norm_num
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_Ioi
statement:
private theorem integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_Ioi (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
    (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-3/4 : ℝ) < 0) x)
    ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  change Real.exp ((-3/4)*t) = Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-t)
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.resolvent_error_eq_tail_integral
statement:
private theorem resolvent_error_eq_tail_integral (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (x/4) - (laguerreExponentialResolvent n).eval x =
      ((3/4) * Real.exp x) *
        ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x,
          (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t) * Real.exp (-t)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : IntegrableOn
      (fun t : ℝ => (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (laguerreExponentialProjection n) zero_lt_one
  have hp := hp0.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  simp_rw [sub_mul]
  rw [integral_sub (integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_Ioi x) hp,
    integral_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_Ioi,
    ← sumIDeriv_eval_mul_exp_neg_eq_integral_Ioi _ hx,
    laguerreExponentialResolvent, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h1 : Real.exp x * Real.exp (-((3/4)*x)) = Real.exp (x/4) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h2 : Real.exp x * Real.exp (-x) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  calc
    _ = (Real.exp x * Real.exp (-((3/4)*x))) -
        (3/4) * (sumIDeriv (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).eval x *
          (Real.exp x * Real.exp (-x)) := by rw [h1, h2]; ring
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.degree_laguerreExponentialResolvent_le
statement:
theorem degree_laguerreExponentialResolvent_le (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerreExponentialResolvent n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : (sumIDeriv (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).degree ≤ n := by
    rw [sumIDeriv_apply]
    apply mem_degreeLE.mp
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j _
    apply mem_degreeLE.mpr
    have h : ∀ k : ℕ, ((derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k]
        (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).degree ≤ (laguerreExponentialProjection n).degree := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        exact degree_derivative_le.trans ih
    exact (h j).trans (degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le n)
  exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans hdeg

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_quarter_sub_laguerreExponentialResolvent_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_quarter_sub_laguerreExponentialResolvent_le (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (x/4) - (laguerreExponentialResolvent n).eval x| ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 / (4 * 3^n) * Real.exp (x/2)
proof:
:= by
  let p := laguerreExponentialProjection n
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t
  have hp0 : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => p.eval t * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p zero_lt_one
  have hp := hp0.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  have hr : IntegrableOn (fun t => r t * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi x) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_Ioi x).sub hp)
      ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
    intro t _
    change Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-t) - p.eval t * Real.exp (-t) =
      (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t) * Real.exp (-t)
    ring
  have hsq0 : IntegrableOn (fun t => (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi 0) :=
    integrableOn_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg p
  have hsq := hsq0.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  have hC := sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_mul_integral
    (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi x)) (fun t => (Real.exp_pos (-t)).le)
    hr hsq (integrableOn_exp_neg_Ioi x)
  rw [integral_exp_neg_Ioi] at hC
  have htotal : (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) = 2 / 3^(2*n+2) := by
    have h := integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_eq_laguerreResidual_add
      (degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le n)
    simp only [sub_self, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), zero_mul,
      integral_zero, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have htail : (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) ≤ 2 / 3^(2*n+2) := by
    rw [← htotal]
    apply setIntegral_mono_set hsq0
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun t => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  have hC' := hC.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htail (Real.exp_pos (-x)).le)
  have hfactor := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC' (sq_nonneg ((3/4) * Real.exp x))
  have herror := resolvent_error_eq_tail_integral n hx
  have hcancel : Real.exp x * Real.exp (-x) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  have hsqexpHalf : (Real.exp (x/2))^2 = Real.exp x := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hpow : (3 : ℝ)^(2*n+2) = ((3 : ℝ)^n)^2 * 9 := by
    rw [pow_add, show 2*n = n*2 by omega, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hbound : (((3/4) * Real.exp x)^2 *
      ((2 : ℝ) / 3^(2*n+2) * Real.exp (-x))) =
      (Real.sqrt 2 / (4 * 3^n) * Real.exp (x/2))^2 := by
    simp only [mul_pow, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2),
      hsqexpHalf, hpow]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hcancel]
  rw [hbound] at hfactor
  have hsquared : (Real.exp (x/4) - (laguerreExponentialResolvent n).eval x)^2 ≤
      (Real.sqrt 2 / (4 * 3^n) * Real.exp (x/2))^2 := by
    rw [herror, mul_pow]
    exact hfactor
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 / (4 * 3^n) * Real.exp (x/2) := by positivity
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hnonneg).mp (by simpa only [sq_abs] using hsquared)

name: NLAlib.sum_range_endpoints
statement:
private theorem sum_range_endpoints {f : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), f j) = f 0 + (∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), f (j + 1)) + f n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_range_succ]
  have hs : (∑ j ∈ range n, f j) = (∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), f (j + 1)) + f 0 := by
    simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn] using sum_range_succ' f (n - 1)
  rw [hs]
  ring

name: NLAlib.weighted_kernel_sum
statement:
private theorem weighted_kernel_sum {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), lobattoEndpointWeight n j *
      (|lobattoKernel n (t - j * π / n)| + |lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n)|)) =
        lobattoKernelSum n t
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun j : ℕ => lobattoEndpointWeight n j *
    (|lobattoKernel n (t - j * π / n)| + |lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n)|)
  have hf0 : f 0 = |lobattoKernel n t| := by dsimp [f, lobattoEndpointWeight]; simp; ring
  have hmidd : lobattoKernel n (t + π) = lobattoKernel n (t - π) := by
    have hp := lobattoKernel_periodic n (t - π)
    rw [show t - π + 2 * π = t + π by ring] at hp
    exact hp
  have hncast : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hfn : f n = |lobattoKernel n (t - π)| := by
    dsimp [f, lobattoEndpointWeight]
    simp only [or_true, ite_true, mul_div_cancel_left₀ π hncast, hmidd]
    ring
  have hfi : ∀ j ∈ range (n - 1), f (j + 1) =
      |lobattoKernel n (t - (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)| +
        |lobattoKernel n (t + (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)| := by
    intro j hj
    have hne : ¬(j + 1 = 0 ∨ j + 1 = n) := by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [show lobattoEndpointWeight n (j + 1) = 1 from if_neg hne, one_mul]
  change (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), f j) = _
  rw [sum_range_endpoints hn, hf0, hfn, sum_congr rfl hfi, sum_add_distrib,
    lobattoKernelSum_eq_paired hn]
  have hplus : (∑ j ∈ range n, |lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n)|) =
      (∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), |lobattoKernel n (t + (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)|) + |lobattoKernel n t| := by
    simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero] using
      sum_range_succ' (fun j : ℕ => |lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n)|) (n - 1)
  have hminus : (∑ j ∈ range n, |lobattoKernel n (t - (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)|) =
      (∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), |lobattoKernel n (t - (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)|) + |lobattoKernel n (t - π)| := by
    simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, mul_div_cancel_left₀ π hncast] using
      sum_range_succ (fun j : ℕ => |lobattoKernel n (t - (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)|) (n - 1)
  rw [hplus, hminus]
  ring

name: NLAlib.injective_chebyshevExtrema
statement: theorem injective_chebyshevExtrema (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (chebyshevExtrema n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact injective_chebyshev_extrema_fin n (congrArg Subtype.val hij)

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_chebyshev_le_kernelSum
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_chebyshev_le_kernelSum {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => node n j) (cos t) ≤ lobattoKernelSum n t
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  simp_rw [← lobattoCardinal_eq_basis_fin hn]
  rw [show (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), |(lobattoCardinal n j).eval (cos t)|) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), |(lobattoCardinal n j).eval (cos t)| from
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ => |(lobattoCardinal n j).eval (cos t)|) (n + 1)]
  have hpoint : ∀ j ∈ range (n + 1), |(lobattoCardinal n j).eval (cos t)| ≤
      lobattoEndpointWeight n j *
        (|lobattoKernel n (t - j * π / n)| + |lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n)|) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [eval_lobattoCardinal_cos, abs_mul]
    have hw : 0 ≤ lobattoEndpointWeight n j := by unfold lobattoEndpointWeight; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hw]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_add_le _ _) hw
  exact (sum_le_sum hpoint).trans_eq (weighted_kernel_sum hn t)

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_chebyshev_le_log
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_chebyshev_le_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    lebesgueFunction (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => node n j) x ≤
      1 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2]
  exact (lebesgueFunction_chebyshev_le_kernelSum hn (arccos x)).trans (lobattoKernelSum_le_log hn _)

name: NLAlib.lebesgueConstant_chebyshev_le_log
statement:
theorem lebesgueConstant_chebyshev_le_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => node n j) ≤
      1 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 ≤ log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := log_nonneg (by
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := by positivity
    linarith)
  unfold lebesgueConstant
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (by positivity)).mpr
  intro x
  change ‖lebesgueFunction (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => node n j) (x : ℝ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (lebesgueFunction_nonneg _ _)]
  exact lebesgueFunction_chebyshev_le_log hn x.property

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshev_interpolationOperator_le_log
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshev_interpolationOperator_le_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ‖interpolationOperator (chebyshevExtrema n)‖ ≤ 1 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_interpolationOperator_eq_lebesgueConstant _ (injective_chebyshevExtrema n)]
