  exact lebesgueConstant_chebyshev_le_log hn

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_chebyshev_interpolation_le_minimaxError
statement:
theorem norm_sub_chebyshev_interpolation_le_minimaxError {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    ‖f - interpolationLinearMap (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (chebyshevExtrema n) f‖ ≤
      (2 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  have hnear := norm_sub_interpolationLinearMap_le_minimaxError (chebyshevExtrema n)
    (injective_chebyshevExtrema n) f
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hnear
  apply hnear.trans
  have hbound := lebesgueConstant_chebyshev_le_log hn
  have hB : 1 + lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (fun i => (chebyshevExtrema n i : ℝ)) ≤
      2 + (2 / π) * log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    change 1 + lebesgueConstant (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => node n i) ≤ _
    linarith
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (minimaxError_nonneg n f)

name: NLAlib.doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_sum
statement:
theorem doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_sum (n : ℕ) :
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n = (15/26 : ℝ) •
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        ((4/3 : ℝ)^(r+1) - (1/4 : ℝ)^(r+1)) •
          (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] (laguerreExponentialProjection n)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := natDegree_le_of_degree_le (degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le n)
  rw [doubleResolventExponentialDenominator,
    derivativeResolvent_apply_of_le hn (3/4), derivativeResolvent_apply_of_le hn 4]
  rw [show ((3/4 : ℝ)⁻¹) = 4/3 by norm_num, show ((4 : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1/4 by norm_num]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [← sub_smul]

name: NLAlib.degree_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le
statement:
theorem degree_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le (n : ℕ) :
    (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
  have hn := natDegree_le_of_degree_le (degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le n)
  apply (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans
  apply (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
  exact max_le ((natDegree_derivativeResolvent_le _ _).trans hn)
    ((natDegree_derivativeResolvent_le _ _).trans hn)

name: NLAlib.coeff_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_self
statement:
theorem coeff_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_self (n : ℕ) :
    (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).coeff n =
      (5/8 : ℝ) * (4 / (3^(n+1) * (n ! : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := natDegree_le_of_degree_le (degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le n)
  rw [doubleResolventExponentialDenominator, coeff_smul, coeff_sub,
    coeff_derivativeResolvent_of_natDegree_le (by norm_num : (3/4 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hn,
    coeff_derivativeResolvent_of_natDegree_le (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hn,
    coeff_laguerreExponentialProjection_self, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.natDegree_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator
statement:
theorem natDegree_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator (n : ℕ) :
    (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (natDegree_le_of_degree_le (degree_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le n))
  apply le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
  rw [coeff_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_self]
  positivity

name: NLAlib.shifted_exp_residual_eq
proof:
:= by
  have he : Real.exp (-a*(t-x)) = Real.exp (a*x) * Real.exp (-(a*t)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_weighted_exp_residual
statement:
private theorem integrableOn_weighted_exp_residual {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 < a)
    (p : ℝ[X]) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t) * Real.exp (-(a*t))) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p (by linarith : 0 < a)).mono_set
    (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha x).sub hp)
    ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  change Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-(a*t)) - p.eval t * Real.exp (-(a*t)) = _
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_shifted_exp_residual
statement:
private theorem integrableOn_shifted_exp_residual {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 < a)
    (p : ℝ[X]) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-a*(t-x)) *
      (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [shifted_exp_residual_eq]
  exact (integrableOn_weighted_exp_residual ha p hx).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_two_rate_residual
statement:
private theorem integral_two_rate_residual (A B x : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x,
      (A*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + B*Real.exp (-4*(t-x))) *
        (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t)) =
      A*(Real.exp (x/4)/(3/4-1/4) - (derivativeResolvent (3/4) p).eval x) +
      B*(Real.exp (x/4)/(4-1/4) - (derivativeResolvent 4 p).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ =>
      (A*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + B*Real.exp (-4*(t-x))) *
        (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t)) =
      (fun t => A*(Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x))*(Real.exp (t/4)-p.eval t)) +
        B*(Real.exp (-4*(t-x))*(Real.exp (t/4)-p.eval t))) := by funext t; ring
  rw [heq, integral_add
    ((integrableOn_shifted_exp_residual (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/4 < 3/4) p hx).const_mul A)
    ((integrableOn_shifted_exp_residual (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/4 < 4) p hx).const_mul B)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, shifted_exp_residual_eq]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    ← derivativeResolvent_error_eq_exp_tail_integral (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/4 < 3/4) p hx,
    ← derivativeResolvent_error_eq_exp_tail_integral (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/4 < 4) p hx]

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_two_rate_residual
statement:
private theorem integrableOn_two_rate_residual (A B x : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      (A*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + B*Real.exp (-4*(t-x))) *
        (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
    (((integrableOn_shifted_exp_residual (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/4 < 3/4) p hx).const_mul A).add
      ((integrableOn_shifted_exp_residual (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/4 < 4) p hx).const_mul B))
    ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  change A*(Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x))*(Real.exp (t/4)-p.eval t)) +
    B*(Real.exp (-4*(t-x))*(Real.exp (t/4)-p.eval t)) = _
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_kernel_laguerreResidual_le
statement:
private theorem abs_integral_kernel_laguerreResidual_le (n : ℕ) {x c : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (K : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hKi : IntegrableOn (fun t => K (t-x)^2 * Real.exp t) (Ioi x))
    (hKn : (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, K (t-x)^2 * Real.exp t) = c*Real.exp x)
    (hKr : IntegrableOn (fun t => K (t-x) *
      (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t)) (Ioi x)) :
    |∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, K (t-x) *
      (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t)| ≤
        Real.sqrt (2*c/9) / 3^n * Real.exp (x/2)
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => r t * Real.exp (-t/2)
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => K (t-x) * Real.exp (t/2)
  have hfg : (fun t => F t * G t) = (fun t => K (t-x) * r t) := by
    funext t
    have he : Real.exp (-t/2) * Real.exp (t/2) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, show -t/2+t/2 = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    dsimp [F, G]
    calc
      _ = (K (t-x)*r t) * (Real.exp (-t/2)*Real.exp (t/2)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [he, mul_one]
  have hF : (fun t => (F t)^2) = (fun t => (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) := by
    funext t
    dsimp [F]
    rw [mul_pow, pow_two (Real.exp (-t/2)), ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hG : (fun t => (G t)^2) = (fun t => K (t-x)^2 * Real.exp t) := by
    funext t
    dsimp [G]
    rw [mul_pow, pow_two (Real.exp (t/2)), ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hs0 := integrableOn_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_mul_exp_neg (laguerreExponentialProjection n)
  have hs : IntegrableOn (fun t => (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) (Ioi x) :=
    hs0.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  have hfgInt : IntegrableOn (fun t => F t * G t) (Ioi x) := by rw [hfg]; exact hKr
  have hFInt : IntegrableOn (fun t => (F t)^2) (Ioi x) := by rw [hF]; exact hs
  have hGInt : IntegrableOn (fun t => (G t)^2) (Ioi x) := by rw [hG]; exact hKi
  have hCS := sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_integral_sq hfgInt hFInt hGInt
  rw [hfg, hF, hG, hKn] at hCS
  have htotal : (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) = 2/3^(2*n+2) := by
    have h := integral_exp_quarter_sub_eval_sq_eq_laguerreResidual_add
      (degree_laguerreExponentialProjection_le n)
    simp only [sub_self, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), zero_mul,
      integral_zero, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have htail : (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, (r t)^2 * Real.exp (-t)) ≤ 2/3^(2*n+2) := by
    rw [← htotal]
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hs0
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx))
  have hsq := hCS.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htail (mul_nonneg hc (Real.exp_pos x).le))
  have hpow : (3 : ℝ)^(2*n+2) = ((3 : ℝ)^n)^2 * 9 := by
    rw [pow_add, show 2*n = n*2 by omega, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hbound : ((2 : ℝ)/3^(2*n+2))*(c*Real.exp x) =
      (Real.sqrt (2*c/9) / 3^n * Real.exp (x/2))^2 := by
    have he : (Real.exp (x/2))^2 = Real.exp x := by
      rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [mul_pow, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), he, hpow]
    field_simp
  rw [hbound] at hsq
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp (by simpa only [sq_abs] using hsq)

name: NLAlib.exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_integral
statement:
theorem exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_integral
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (x/4) - (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).eval x =
      ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, exponentialSmoothingKernel (t-x) *
        (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => exponentialSmoothingKernel (t-x) *
      (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t)) =
      (fun t => (15/26 : ℝ) *
        ((1*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + (-1)*Real.exp (-4*(t-x))) *
          (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t))) := by
    funext t
    dsimp [exponentialSmoothingKernel]
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_const_mul, integral_two_rate_residual _ _ _ _ hx,
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator, eval_smul, eval_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exp_quarter_div_four_sub_derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_integral
statement:
theorem exp_quarter_div_four_sub_derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_integral
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (x/4)/4 - (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x =
      ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel (t-x) *
        (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel (t-x) *
      (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t)) =
      (fun t => (15/26 : ℝ) *
        (((3/4)*Real.exp (-(3/4)*(t-x)) + (-4)*Real.exp (-4*(t-x))) *
          (Real.exp (t/4) - (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval t))) := by
    funext t
    dsimp [exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel]
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_const_mul, integral_two_rate_residual _ _ _ _ hx,
    doubleResolventExponentialDenominator, derivative_smul, derivative_sub,
    derivative_derivativeResolvent (by norm_num : (3/4 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
    derivative_derivativeResolvent (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [eval_smul, eval_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (x/4) - (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).eval x| ≤
      Real.sqrt (5/42) / 3^n * Real.exp (x/2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_quarter_sub_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_integral n hx]
  apply (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ)*(15/28)/9 = 5/42) ▸
    abs_integral_kernel_laguerreResidual_le n hx (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 15/28)
      exponentialSmoothingKernel (integrableOn_exponentialSmoothingKernel_sq x)
      (integral_exponentialSmoothingKernel_sq x) ?_
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
    ((integrableOn_two_rate_residual 1 (-1) x (laguerreExponentialProjection n) hx).const_mul
      (15/26 : ℝ)) ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  dsimp [exponentialSmoothingKernel]
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_quarter_div_four_sub_derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_quarter_div_four_sub_derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_le
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (x/4)/4 - (doubleResolventExponentialDenominator n).derivative.eval x| ≤
      Real.sqrt (15/112) / 3^n * Real.exp (x/2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_quarter_div_four_sub_derivative_doubleResolventExponentialDenominator_eq_integral n hx]
  apply (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ)*(135/224)/9 = 15/112) ▸
    abs_integral_kernel_laguerreResidual_le n hx (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 135/224)
      exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel (integrableOn_exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel_sq x)
      (integral_exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel_sq x) ?_
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
    ((integrableOn_two_rate_residual (3/4) (-4) x (laguerreExponentialProjection n) hx).const_mul
      (15/26 : ℝ)) ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  dsimp [exponentialSmoothingDerivativeKernel]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sawtooth_angle_mem_Ioo
statement:

proof:

name: NLAlib.degree_sawtoothSineInterp_lt
statement: theorem degree_sawtoothSineInterp_lt (n : ℕ) : (sawtoothSineInterp n).degree < n
proof:

  have h := Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt
    (fun j => (Real.pi - (j + 1 : ℕ) * Real.pi / (n + 1)) / sin ((j + 1 : ℕ) * Real.pi / (n + 1)))
    (sawtooth_node_injOn n)

name: NLAlib.sawtoothApprox_grid_eq
statement:
theorem sawtoothApprox_grid_eq {n j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    sawtoothApprox n (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.pi / (n + 1)) =
      Real.pi - ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.pi / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node
    (fun j => (Real.pi - (j + 1 : ℕ) * Real.pi / (n + 1)) / sin ((j + 1 : ℕ) * Real.pi / (n + 1)))
    (sawtooth_node_injOn n) (mem_range.mpr hj)
  change (sawtoothSineInterp n).eval (node (n + 1) (j + 1)) = _ at h
  unfold sawtoothApprox
  simp only [node, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h ⊢
  rw [h]
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using (sin_sawtooth_angle_pos hj).ne')

name: NLAlib.exists_interpolate_eq_of_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_interpolate_eq_of_alternation {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (hvab : ∀ i, v i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ)) < 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, StrictMono c ∧ (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Ioo a b) ∧
      (∀ i, f (c i) = p.eval (c i)) ∧
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ c (f ∘ c) = p
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Set.Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _)) ⊆ Set.Icc a b :=
    Set.Icc_subset_Icc (hvab 0).1 (hvab _).2
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hczero⟩ := exists_strictMono_eq_zero_of_mul_neg hv
    ((hf.sub p.continuous.continuousOn).mono hsub) hsign
  have hcval : ∀ i, f (c i) = p.eval (c i) := fun i => sub_eq_zero.mp (hczero i).2
  refine ⟨c, hc, fun i => ?_, hcval, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨(hvab i.castSucc).1.trans_lt (hczero i).1.1,
      (hczero i).1.2.trans_le (hvab i.succ).2⟩
  · apply (Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq (f ∘ c) hc.injective.injOn ?_ ?_).symm
    · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    · intro i _; exact (hcval i).symm

name: NLAlib.lebesgueFunction_at_node
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_at_node {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v) (j : ι) : lebesgueFunction v (v j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ k : ι, |(Lagrange.basis univ v k).eval (v j)| = if k = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_self hv.injOn (mem_univ j)]
      simp
    · rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne hkj (mem_univ j)]
      simp [hkj]
  simp only [lebesgueFunction, hterm]
  simp

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction_closed
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx.1 with hleft | hleft
  · rw [← hleft, (eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_gap_endpoints ht i).1,
      lebesgueFunction_at_node ht.injective]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx.2 with hright | hright
  · rw [hright, (eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_gap_endpoints ht i).2,
      lebesgueFunction_at_node ht.injective]
  exact eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction ht i ⟨hleft, hright⟩

name: NLAlib.interpolationGapPeak_eq_eval_of_isMaxOn
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply lebesgueConstant_le_of_forall
    · rw [eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction_closed ht i hτ]
      exact lebesgueFunction_nonneg _ _
    · intro x hx
      rw [← eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction_closed ht i hx]
      exact hmax hx
  · rw [eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_eq_lebesgueFunction_closed ht i hτ]
    exact lebesgueFunction_le_lebesgueConstant _ hτ

name: NLAlib.exists_interpolationGapPeak_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem exists_interpolationGapPeak_nondegenerate {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ τ ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ),
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval τ = 0 ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.derivative.eval τ < 0 ∧
      1 < (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      interpolationGapPeak n t i = (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ),
        (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval y = 0 → y = τ)
proof:
:= by
  let p := interpolationGapPolynomial n t i
  let a := canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc
  let b := canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ
  have hab : a < b := ht (show i.castSucc < i.succ from Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)
  have hmid : (a + b) / 2 ∈ Ioo a b := by constructor <;> linarith
  have hmidval : 1 < p.eval ((a + b) / 2) := one_lt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial hn ht i hmid
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hmax⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
    (show (Icc a b).Nonempty from ⟨a, left_mem_Icc.mpr hab.le⟩) p.continuousOn
  have hval : 1 < p.eval τ := hmidval.trans_le (hmax ⟨hmid.1.le, hmid.2.le⟩)
  have hend := eval_interpolationGapPolynomial_gap_endpoints ht i
  have hτa : a < τ := lt_of_le_of_ne hτ.1 (fun he => by rw [← he, hend.1] at hval; linarith)
  have hτb : τ < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hτ.2 (fun he => by rw [he, hend.2] at hval; linarith)
  have hτo : τ ∈ Ioo a b := ⟨hτa, hτb⟩
  have hcrit : p.derivative.eval τ = 0 := by
    have hc := (hmax.isLocalMax (Icc_mem_nhds hτa hτb)).deriv_eq_zero
    rw [p.deriv] at hc
    exact hc
  have hs := interpolationGapPolynomial_splits hn ht i
  have hnconst := derivative_interpolationGapPolynomial_ne_zero hn ht i
  refine ⟨τ, hτo, hcrit, polynomial_second_derivative_neg_of_splits hs hnconst (by linarith) hcrit,
    hval, interpolationGapPeak_eq_eval_of_isMaxOn ht i hτ hmax, ?_⟩
  intro y hy hyc
  exact eq_of_polynomial_critical_of_splits hs hnconst
    (fun x hx => lt_trans zero_lt_one (one_lt_eval_interpolationGapPolynomial hn ht i hx))
    hy hτo hyc hcrit

    Continuous (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => canonicalIntervalNodes n t i)
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases (by simp only [canonicalIntervalNodes_zero]; fun_prop) (fun j => ?_) i
  refine Fin.lastCases (by simpa using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Fin n → ℝ => (1 : ℝ))))
    (fun k => ?_) j

name: NLAlib.isOpen_interiorNodeSimplex
statement: theorem isOpen_interiorNodeSimplex (n : ℕ) : IsOpen (interiorNodeSimplex n)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : interiorNodeSimplex n = ⋂ i : Fin (n + 2), ⋂ j : Fin (n + 2),
      ⋂ (_ : i < j), {t | canonicalIntervalNodes n t i < canonicalIntervalNodes n t j} := by
    ext t
    simp only [interiorNodeSimplex, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iInter, StrictMono]
  rw [heq]
  apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
  intro i
  apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
  intro j
  apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
  intro _
  exact isOpen_lt (continuous_canonicalIntervalNodes n i) (continuous_canonicalIntervalNodes n j)

name: NLAlib.canonicalIntervalNodes_convex_combination
statement:
theorem canonicalIntervalNodes_convex_combination (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin n → ℝ)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + b = 1) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    canonicalIntervalNodes n (a • t + b • u) i =
      a * canonicalIntervalNodes n t i + b * canonicalIntervalNodes n u i
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases (by simp; linarith) (fun j => ?_) i
  refine Fin.lastCases (by simp; linarith) (fun k => ?_) j
  simp

name: NLAlib.convex_interiorNodeSimplex
statement: theorem convex_interiorNodeSimplex (n : ℕ) : Convex ℝ (interiorNodeSimplex n)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht u hu a b ha hb hab i j hij
  rw [canonicalIntervalNodes_convex_combination n t u a b hab i,
    canonicalIntervalNodes_convex_combination n t u a b hab j]
  have hti := ht hij
  have hui := hu hij
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with ha0 | ha0
  · have hbpos : 0 < b := by linarith
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hui hbpos
    simp only [← ha0, zero_mul, zero_add]
    exact h
  · have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hti ha0
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hui.le hb
    linarith

name: NLAlib.canonicalIntervalNodes_equispaced
statement:
theorem canonicalIntervalNodes_equispaced (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    canonicalIntervalNodes n (fun i => -1 + 2 * ((i : ℝ) + 1) / (n + 1)) j =
      -1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  refine Fin.cases (by simp) (fun i => ?_) j
  refine Fin.lastCases (by simp; field_simp; ring) (fun k => ?_) i
  simp only [canonicalIntervalNodes_interior, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: NLAlib.nonempty_interiorNodeSimplex
statement: theorem nonempty_interiorNodeSimplex (n : ℕ) : (interiorNodeSimplex n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => -1 + 2 * ((i : ℝ) + 1) / (n + 1), ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  rw [canonicalIntervalNodes_equispaced, canonicalIntervalNodes_equispaced]
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hijreal : (i : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hij
  exact add_lt_add_right (div_lt_div_of_pos_right
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hijreal (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)) hn) (-1)

name: NLAlib.laguerreExponentialCoefficient_smul_eq_monic
statement:
theorem laguerreExponentialCoefficient_smul_eq_monic (j : ℕ) :
    laguerreExponentialCoefficient j • laguerrePolynomial j =
      (4 / ((3:ℝ)^(j+1) * (j ! :ℝ))) • monicLaguerrePolynomial j
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicLaguerrePolynomial, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  dsimp [laguerreExponentialCoefficient]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate
statement:
theorem shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ k, 0 ≤ ((laguerreExponentialProjection n).comp (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff k) ∧
    0 < ((laguerreExponentialProjection n).comp (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff 0 ∧
    (0 < n → 0 < ((laguerreExponentialProjection n).comp (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hP (j : Fin (n+1)) := shifted_laguerre_recurrence_coeff_certificate
    monicLaguerrePolynomial monicLaguerrePolynomial_zero monicLaguerrePolynomial_succ_eq
    n j.val (by omega)
  have hterm (j : Fin (n+1)) (k : ℕ) :
      0 ≤ ((laguerreExponentialCoefficient j.val • laguerrePolynomial j.val).comp
        (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff k := by
    rw [laguerreExponentialCoefficient_smul_eq_monic, smul_comp, coeff_smul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) ((hP j).1 k)
  have hterm0 (j : Fin (n+1)) :
      0 < ((laguerreExponentialCoefficient j.val • laguerrePolynomial j.val).comp
        (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff 0 := by
    rw [laguerreExponentialCoefficient_smul_eq_monic, smul_comp, coeff_smul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos (by positivity) (hP j).2.2.1
  have heq (k : ℕ) : ((laguerreExponentialProjection n).comp
      (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff k = ∑ j : Fin (n+1),
        ((laguerreExponentialCoefficient j.val • laguerrePolynomial j.val).comp
          (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff k := by
    simp only [laguerreExponentialProjection, sum_comp, finsetSum_coeff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    rw [heq]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hterm j k)
  · rw [heq]
    exact (hterm0 0).trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm j 0)
      (Finset.mem_univ 0))
  · intro hn
    let j : Fin (n+1) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
    have hterm1 :
        0 < ((laguerreExponentialCoefficient j.val • laguerrePolynomial j.val).comp
          (X+C (4*(n:ℝ)))).coeff 1 := by
      rw [laguerreExponentialCoefficient_smul_eq_monic, smul_comp, coeff_smul,
        smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_pos (by positivity) ((hP j).2.2.2 (by norm_num [j]))
    rw [heq]
    exact hterm1.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm j 1)
      (Finset.mem_univ j))

name: NLAlib.iterate_derivative_laguerreExponentialProjection_eval_nonneg
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_laguerreExponentialProjection_eval_nonneg
    (n r : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 4*(n:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ ((derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] (laguerreExponentialProjection n)).eval x
proof:
:=
  iterate_derivative_eval_nonneg_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
    (shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate n).1 hx r

name: NLAlib.laguerreExponentialProjection_eval_pos
statement:
theorem laguerreExponentialProjection_eval_pos (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 4*(n:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    0 < (laguerreExponentialProjection n).eval x
proof:
:=
  eval_pos_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
    (shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate n).1
    (shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate n).2.1 hx

name: NLAlib.laguerreExponentialProjection_derivative_eval_pos
statement:
theorem laguerreExponentialProjection_derivative_eval_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 4*(n:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    0 < (laguerreExponentialProjection n).derivative.eval x
proof:
:=
  derivative_eval_pos_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
    (shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate n).1
    ((shifted_laguerreExponentialProjection_coeff_certificate n).2.2 hn) hx

name: NLAlib.degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, degree_C_mul (inv_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hH).ne'),
    degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_norm_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
statement:
theorem sqrt_norm_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) :
    C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hH).ne', C_1, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.functional_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem functional_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : hankelMomentDet L i ≠ 0) (hj : hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hHi : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i) (hHj : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) :
    L (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, orthonormalMomentPolynomial]
  rw [show C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹ * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i *
      (C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j))⁻¹ * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) =
      C ((Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹ *
        (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j))⁻¹) *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) by
      rw [C_mul]; ring, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    rw [← pow_two (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i)]
    change (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹ *
      (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹ * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i = 1
    rw [← mul_inv, ← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt hHi.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hHi.ne']
  · rw [functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero_of_ne L hi hj hij,
      if_neg hij, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_pow_of_integrable_abs_pow
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_norm_iff (f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ j) (by fun_prop)).mp
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow] using hμ j hj

name: NLAlib.integrable_eval_of_degree_lt_of_abs_moments
proof:
:= by
  have he : p.eval = fun x => ∑ i : Fin d, p.coeff i.val * x ^ i.val := by
    funext x
    nth_rw 1 [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp]
    simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_monomial]
  rw [he]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
    (integrable_pow_of_integrable_abs_pow hμ i.isLt).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.finiteMomentFunctional_integral_apply
statement:
theorem finiteMomentFunctional_integral_apply {μ : Measure ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < d, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < d) :
    finiteMomentFunctional (fun i : Fin d => ∫ x, x ^ i.val ∂μ) p = ∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteMomentFunctional_apply]
  have he : p.eval = fun x => ∑ i : Fin d, p.coeff i.val * x ^ i.val := by
    funext x
    nth_rw 1 [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp]
    simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_monomial]
  rw [he, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
    (integrable_pow_of_integrable_abs_pow hμ i.isLt).const_mul _)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [integral_const_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply
statement:
theorem finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply {μ : Measure ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < 2 * n) :
    finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n p = ∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  finiteMomentFunctional_integral_apply hμ hp

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional {μ : Measure ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ)
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) n).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rw [posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos]
  intro p hp hp0
  have hpdeg := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
  have hsquare : (p ^ 2).degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_pow, degree_eq_natDegree hp0, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * p.natDegree < 2 * n by omega)
  rw [finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply hμ hsquare]
  simp only [eval_pow]
  apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hs hp0 hp
  simpa only [eval_pow] using integrable_eval_of_degree_lt_of_abs_moments hμ hsquare

name: NLAlib.integral_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMeasure_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMeasure_mul_eq_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ)
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (hk : k ≤ n)
    {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : q.degree < k) :
    ∫ x, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) k).eval x *
      q.eval x ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let L := finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n
  have hpos := posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional hμ hs
  have horth := (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hpos hk)).orthogonal q hq
  by_cases hq0 : q = 0
  · simp [hq0]
  have hqd := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hq0).mpr hq
  have hprod : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k * q).degree < (2 * n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, degree_eq_natDegree hq0]
    exact_mod_cast (show k + q.natDegree < 2 * n by omega)
  rw [finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply hμ hprod] at horth
  simpa only [eval_mul] using horth

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_small_iff_full
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraint_small_iff_full
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) (n : ℕ) (P : 𝕜[X])
    (horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ) → L (P*q) = 0) :
    (∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T u (min n v.natDegree) i P = 0) ↔
      (∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T u n i P = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu,
    rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hdiv, hsmall⟩
    refine ⟨hdiv, ?_⟩
    intro r
    by_cases hnm : n ≤ v.natDegree
    · exact hsmall ⟨r.val, by simpa only [min_eq_left hnm] using r.isLt⟩
    have hmn : v.natDegree ≤ n := (Nat.le_of_not_ge hnm)
    let a := (X^r.val) / v
    let b := (X^r.val) % v
    have hb : b.degree < (min n v.natDegree : ℕ) := by
      rw [min_eq_right hmn]
      exact (degree_mod_lt _ hv).trans_eq (degree_eq_natDegree hv)
    have ha : a.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ) := by
      by_cases ha0 : a = 0
      · rw [ha0, degree_zero]
        exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
      have hle : v.degree ≤ (X^r.val : 𝕜[X]).degree :=
        le_of_not_gt (mt (Polynomial.div_eq_zero_iff hv).mpr ha0)
      have hdeg := degree_add_div hv hle
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hv, degree_X_pow, degree_eq_natDegree ha0] at hdeg
      have heq : v.natDegree+a.natDegree = r.val := by exact_mod_cast hdeg
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree ha0]
      exact_mod_cast (show a.natDegree < n-v.natDegree by have := r.isLt; omega)
    have hbT : T (P*b) = 0 := functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests T hsmall hb
    have haT : T (P*(v*a)) = 0 := by
      rw [show P*(v*a) = v*(P*a) by ring, hTv, horth a ha]
    have hdivpoly : (X^r.val : 𝕜[X]) = v*a+b := (EuclideanDomain.div_add_mod _ _).symm
    rw [hdivpoly, mul_add, map_add, haT, hbT, add_zero]
  · rintro ⟨hdiv, hfull⟩
    refine ⟨hdiv, ?_⟩
    intro r
    exact hfull ⟨r.val, r.isLt.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationSmallMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationSmallMatrix_ne_zero
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j < u.natDegree+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hMc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hzero
  let P : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree),
    c j • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val)
  have hindex (j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree)) :
      n-v.natDegree+j.val < u.natDegree+n := by
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  have hPdeg : P.degree < (u.natDegree+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hindex j
  have horth (q : 𝕜[X]) (hq : q.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ)) : L (P*q) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [P]
    rw [sum_mul, map_sum]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul,
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ (hindex j))).orthogonal q
        (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (n-v.natDegree) j.val)), smul_zero]
  have hsmall (i : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree)) :
      rationalModificationConstraint T u (min n v.natDegree) i P = 0 := by
    have h := congrFun hMc i
    simpa only [P, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      rationalModificationSmallMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm, Pi.zero_apply] using h
  have hP0 := eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T hu hn hPdeg
    ((rationalModificationConstraint_small_iff_full L T hu hv hTv n P horth).mp hsmall)
  have hlin : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (fun j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree) =>
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val)) :=
    (monicMomentPolynomialSequence L).linearIndependent.comp _
      (fun i j hij => Fin.ext (Nat.add_left_cancel hij))
  exact hc (funext (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hlin c hP0))

name: NLAlib.small_border_det_eq
statement:
private theorem small_border_det_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u v : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ)
    (hdet : (rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n).det =
      C (rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n) -
          ∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree),
            C (((rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n)⁻¹ *ᵥ
              rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints L T u v n) j) *
                monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val))
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n
  have hunit : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  let : Invertible (M.map C) :=
    { invOf := (M⁻¹).map C
      invOf_mul_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.nonsing_inv_mul hunit]; simp
      mul_invOf_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.mul_nonsing_inv hunit]; simp }
  rw [rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix, det_fromBlocks₁₁,
    det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
  rw [show (M.map C).det = C M.det from (RingHom.map_det C M).symm]
  congr 1
  change monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n) -
      ∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree),
        (∑ i : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree),
          monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+i.val) * C (M⁻¹ i j)) *
            C (rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints L T u v n j) =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n) -
        ∑ i : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree),
          C (∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree), M⁻¹ i j *
            rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints L T u v n j) *
              monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+i.val)
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, sum_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ u.natDegree+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n).det =
      C ((rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det/u.leadingCoeff) *
        u * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n
  let b := rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints L T u v n
  let c := M⁻¹ *ᵥ b
  let lower : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree),
    C (c j) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val)
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n) - lower
  have hdet : M.det ≠ 0 := det_rationalModificationSmallMatrix_ne_zero L T hu hv hTv
    (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn
  have hMc : M *ᵥ c = b := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), one_mulVec]
  have hindex (j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree)) :
      n-v.natDegree+j.val < u.natDegree+n := by have := j.isLt; omega
  have hlower : lower.degree < (u.natDegree+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hindex j
  have htop : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n)).degree =
      ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).sub_of_left (hlower.trans_eq htop.symm)
  have hPdeg : P.degree = ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) :=
    (degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (hlower.trans_eq htop.symm)).trans htop
  have hPC (i : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree)) :
      rationalModificationConstraint T u (min n v.natDegree) i P = 0 := by
    have hi := congrFun hMc i
    simp only [M, c, b, rationalModificationSmallMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] at hi
    dsimp only [P, lower]
    rw [map_sub, map_sum]
    simp only [C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [show (∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + min n v.natDegree), c j *
        rationalModificationConstraint T u (min n v.natDegree) i
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val))) = b i by
      simpa only [M, rationalModificationSmallMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using congrFun hMc i]
    simp only [b, rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints, sub_self]
  have horth (q : 𝕜[X]) (hq : q.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ)) : L (P*q) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [P, lower]
    rw [sub_mul, map_sub,
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ le_rfl)).orthogonal q
        (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n-v.natDegree ≤ u.natDegree+n by omega))),
      sum_mul, map_sum]
    simp only [C_mul', smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
    rw [sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by
      rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ (hindex j).le)).orthogonal q
        (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (n-v.natDegree) j.val)), smul_zero])]
    simp
  have hfull := (rationalModificationConstraint_small_iff_full L T hu hv hTv n P horth).mp hPC
  let π := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
  have hπ := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn
  have hπm : π.Monic := hπ.monic
  have hUdeg : (u*π).degree = ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_eq_natDegree hu, degree_eq_natDegree hπ.monic.ne_zero,
      hπ.natDegree_eq, Nat.cast_add]
  have hNdeg : (C u.leadingCoeff*P).degree = ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_C_mul (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu), hPdeg]
  have hdiff : (C u.leadingCoeff*P-u*π).degree < (u.natDegree+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sub_lt_left (hNdeg.trans hUdeg.symm)
      (mul_ne_zero (C_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)) hPmonic.ne_zero) ?_).trans_eq hNdeg
    simp only [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, hPmonic.leadingCoeff, hπm.leadingCoeff, mul_one]
  have hπC : ∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (u*π) = 0 := by
    apply (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu n _).mpr
    refine ⟨dvd_mul_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro r
    simpa only [π, polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_assoc] using
      functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn r
  have heq : C u.leadingCoeff*P = u*π := sub_eq_zero.mp
    (eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T hu hn hdiff (by
      intro i
      rw [map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, hfull i, smul_zero, hπC i, sub_self]))
  rw [small_border_det_eq L T u v n hdet]
  change C M.det * P = _
  rw [mul_assoc, ← heq, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)]

name: NLAlib.mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_small_expansion
statement:
theorem mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_small_expansion
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ u.natDegree+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    u*monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n =
      C u.leadingCoeff * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n) -
        ∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree),
          C (((rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n)⁻¹ *ᵥ
            rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints L T u v n) j) *
              monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val))
proof:
:= by
  have hdet := det_rationalModificationSmallMatrix_ne_zero L T hu hv hTv (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn
  have he := small_border_det_eq L T u v n hdet
  rw [det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_eq L T hu hv hTv hL hn, mul_assoc] at he
  have h := congrArg (fun p : 𝕜[X] => C u.leadingCoeff*p) he
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul,
    mul_div_cancel₀ _ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)] at h
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (C_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
  exact h.trans (by ring)

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalModificationConstraint_apply (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    (u P : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (u.natDegree + n)) :
    rationalModificationConstraint T u n i P =
      if i.val < u.natDegree then (P % u).coeff i.val
      else T (X ^ (i.val - u.natDegree) * P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rationalModificationConstraint
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (P : 𝕜[X]) :
    (∀ i : Fin (u.natDegree + n), rationalModificationConstraint T u n i P = 0) ↔
      u ∣ P ∧ ∀ r : Fin n, T (P * X ^ r.val) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hrem : P % u = 0 := by
      apply Polynomial.ext
      intro k
      simp only [coeff_zero]
      by_cases hk : k < u.natDegree
      · let i : Fin (u.natDegree + n) := ⟨k, by omega⟩
        have hi := h i
        rw [rationalModificationConstraint_apply, if_pos hk] at hi
        exact hi
      · apply coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
        exact ((degree_mod_lt P hu).trans_eq (degree_eq_natDegree hu)).trans_le
          (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk))
    refine ⟨EuclideanDomain.mod_eq_zero.mp hrem, ?_⟩
    intro r
    let i : Fin (u.natDegree + n) := ⟨u.natDegree + r.val, by have := r.isLt; omega⟩
    have hi := h i
    rw [rationalModificationConstraint_apply, if_neg (by dsimp [i]; omega)] at hi
    simpa only [i, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, mul_comm] using hi
  · rintro ⟨hdiv, hmoment⟩ i
    rw [rationalModificationConstraint_apply]
    split_ifs with hi
    · rw [EuclideanDomain.mod_eq_zero.mpr hdiv, coeff_zero]
    · let r : Fin n := ⟨i.val - u.natDegree, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
      simpa only [r, mul_comm] using hmoment r

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_sum_monomial_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraint_sum_monomial_eq_mulVec
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (u.natDegree + n) → 𝕜) (i : Fin (u.natDegree + n)) :
    rationalModificationConstraint T u n i
      (∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree + n), monomial j.val (c j)) =
        (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n *ᵥ c) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [rationalModificationConstraintMatrix, mulVec, dotProduct]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, ← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0)
    {P : 𝕜[X]} (hP : P.degree < (u.natDegree + n : ℕ))
    (hC : ∀ i : Fin (u.natDegree + n), rationalModificationConstraint T u n i P = 0) :
    P = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdiv, hmom⟩ := (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu n P).mp hC
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · simp [hs]
  have hsdeg : s.degree < n := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_eq_natDegree hu, degree_eq_natDegree hs] at hP
    have h : u.natDegree + s.natDegree < u.natDegree + n := by exact_mod_cast hP
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hs]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left h)
  have htests (r : Fin n) : polynomialWeightedFunctional T u (s * X ^ r.val) = 0 := by
    simpa only [polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_assoc] using hmom r
  have hs0 := eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn hsdeg
    (fun q hq => functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests _ htests hq)
  simp [hs0]

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hMc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hzero
  have hP := eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T hu hn
    (degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt c)
    (by intro i; rw [rationalModificationConstraint_sum_monomial_eq_mulVec, hMc]; rfl)
  exact hc (sum_monomial_fin_eq_zero_iff c |>.mp hP)

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero_of_sq_pos
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero_of_sq_pos
    (T : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {u : ℝ[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < n → p ≠ 0 →
      0 < polynomialWeightedFunctional T u (p^2)) :
    (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero T hu
  exact hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le
    ((posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos _ _).mpr hpos) le_rfl

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_mulVec_coefficients
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_mulVec_coefficients
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n *ᵥ rationalModificationCoefficients T u n =
      fun i => -u.leadingCoeff * rationalModificationLeadingConstraints T u n i
proof:
:= by
  have hdet := det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero T hu hn
  rw [rationalModificationCoefficients, mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_numerator_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraint_numerator_eq_zero
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (u.natDegree + n)) :
    rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (rationalModificationNumerator T u n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalModificationNumerator, map_add,
    rationalModificationConstraint_sum_monomial_eq_mulVec,
    rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_mulVec_coefficients T hu hn]
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, ← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul]
  simp only [rationalModificationLeadingConstraints, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.coeff_rationalModificationNumerator_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_rationalModificationNumerator_self
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (rationalModificationNumerator T u n).coeff (u.natDegree + n) = u.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalModificationNumerator, coeff_add, coeff_monomial, if_pos rfl,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt _), add_zero]

name: NLAlib.degree_rationalModificationNumerator_le
statement:
theorem degree_rationalModificationNumerator_le
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (rationalModificationNumerator T u n).degree ≤ (u.natDegree + n : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (degree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le (degree_monomial_le _ _)
    (degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt _).le)

name: NLAlib.degree_rationalModificationNumerator_eq
statement:
theorem degree_rationalModificationNumerator_eq
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (rationalModificationNumerator T u n).degree = (u.natDegree + n : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (degree_rationalModificationNumerator_le T u n)
  apply le_degree_of_ne_zero
  rw [coeff_rationalModificationNumerator_self]
  exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationNumerator_eq_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem rationalModificationNumerator_eq_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    rationalModificationNumerator T u n =
      u * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
proof:
:= by
  let P := rationalModificationNumerator T u n
  let π := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
  have hπ : π.Monic := monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ _
  have hπdeg : π.degree = n := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hπ.ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hUdeg : (u * π).degree = (u.natDegree + n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_eq_natDegree hu, hπdeg, Nat.cast_add]
  have hPdeg : P.degree = (u.natDegree + n : ℕ) := degree_rationalModificationNumerator_eq T hu n
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hcoeff := coeff_rationalModificationNumerator_self T u n
    change P.coeff (u.natDegree + n) = u.leadingCoeff at hcoeff
    rw [h, coeff_zero] at hcoeff
    exact (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu) hcoeff.symm
  have hPlead : P.leadingCoeff = u.leadingCoeff := by
    have hnat : P.natDegree = u.natDegree + n := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hP0] at hPdeg
      exact WithBot.coe_inj.mp hPdeg
    rw [leadingCoeff, hnat]
    exact coeff_rationalModificationNumerator_self T u n
  have hdiff : (P - u * π).degree < (u.natDegree + n : ℕ) := by
    exact (degree_sub_lt_left (hPdeg.trans hUdeg.symm) hP0
      (hPlead.trans (by rw [leadingCoeff_mul, hπ.leadingCoeff, mul_one]))).trans_eq hPdeg
  have hπC : ∀ i : Fin (u.natDegree + n), rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (u * π) = 0 := by
    apply (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu n (u * π)).mpr
    refine ⟨dvd_mul_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro r
    have h := functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn r
    simpa only [π, polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_assoc] using h
  have heq := eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T hu hn hdiff
    (by intro i; rw [map_sub, rationalModificationConstraint_numerator_eq_zero T hu hn, hπC i]; simp)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp heq

name: NLAlib.jacobi_expansion_forms
statement:
private theorem jacobi_expansion_forms (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {N : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ N, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < N, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (v : Fin N → ℝ) :
    let F : ℝ[X]
proof:
:= ∑ j : Fin N, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val
    L (F ^ 2) = v ⬝ᵥ v ∧ L (X * F ^ 2) = v ⬝ᵥ (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L N *ᵥ v) := by
  dsimp only
  let F : ℝ[X] := ∑ j : Fin N, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val
  have hpair (j : Fin N) : L (F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = v j :=
    functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L hL hH v j
  have hXpair (j : Fin N) : L (X * F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
      (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L N *ᵥ v) j := by
    simp only [F, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [show X * (C (v k) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k.val) *
        orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val = C (v k) *
          (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k.val * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  constructor
  · rw [pow_two]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [show F * (C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
      C (v j) * (F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hpair]
  · rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [show X * F * (C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
      C (v j) * (X * F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hXpair]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posSemidef
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posSemidef {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c)
    (N : ℕ) (hs : (N : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let J
proof:
:= orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) N
    (J - a • 1).PosSemidef ∧ (c • 1 - J).PosSemidef := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L N
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ N).trans hs)
  have hH (k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k :=
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ N).trans hs)
  have hJh := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L N
  have hscalar (z : ℝ) : (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ)).IsHermitian := by
    simp [Matrix.IsHermitian]
  have hform (v : Fin N → ℝ) (z : ℝ) :
      let F : ℝ[X] := ∑ j : Fin N, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val
      L ((X - C z) * F ^ 2) = star v ⬝ᵥ ((J - z • 1) *ᵥ v) := by
    dsimp only
    obtain ⟨hn, hx⟩ := jacobi_expansion_forms L hL hH v
    rw [sub_mul, map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hx, hn]
    simp only [J, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      star_trivial, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hJh.sub (hscalar a))
    intro v
    rw [← hform v a]
    change 0 ≤ ∫ x, ((X - C a) * (∑ j : Fin N, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) ^ 2).eval x ∂μ
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    simpa only [eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, Pi.zero_apply] using
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (sq_nonneg _)
  · apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg ((hscalar c).sub hJh)
    intro v
    have heq : star v ⬝ᵥ ((c • 1 - J) *ᵥ v) = - (star v ⬝ᵥ ((J - c • 1) *ᵥ v)) := by
      rw [← neg_sub J (c • 1), Matrix.neg_mulVec, dotProduct_neg]
    rw [heq, ← hform v c]
    change 0 ≤ -(∫ x, ((X - C c) * (∑ j : Fin N, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) ^ 2).eval x ∂μ)
    apply neg_nonneg.mpr
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
    simpa only [eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, Pi.zero_apply] using
      mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posDef
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posDef {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c)
    (N : ℕ) (hs : (N + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let J
proof:
:= orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) N
    (J - a • 1).PosDef ∧ (c • 1 - J).PosDef := by
  dsimp only
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L N
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ N + 1 by omega) : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ N + 1).trans hs)
  have hH (k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k :=
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show k + 1 ≤ N + 1 by omega) : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ N + 1).trans hs)
  have hJh := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L N
  have hscalar (z : ℝ) : (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ)).IsHermitian := by
    simp [Matrix.IsHermitian]
  have hpos (v : Fin N → ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
      0 < star v ⬝ᵥ ((J - a • 1) *ᵥ v) ∧ 0 < star v ⬝ᵥ ((c • 1 - J) *ᵥ v) := by
    let F : ℝ[X] := ∑ j : Fin N, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val
    have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hv
      funext i
      have h := functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L hL hH v i
      change L (F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) = v i at h
      simpa only [hz, zero_mul, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using h.symm
    have hFdeg : F.degree < N := by
      apply mem_degreeLT.mp
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro j _
      rw [C_mul']
      apply mem_degreeLT.mpr
      exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt (by
        rw [degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH _ j.isLt)]
        exact_mod_cast j.isLt)
    have hn : 0 < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le F.natDegree)
      ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hF0).mpr hFdeg)
    have hFd : F.degree ≤ (N - 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hF0]
      have hd := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hF0).mpr hFdeg
      exact_mod_cast (show F.natDegree ≤ N - 1 by omega)
    have hs' : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 2 ≤ μ.support.encard := by
      have heq : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 2 = (N : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show N - 1 + 2 = N + 1 by omega)
      rw [heq]
      exact hs
    have ha := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos hμ hs' hF0 hFd (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) (by simp) (by
      filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)
    have hc := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos hμ hs' hF0 hFd (r := C c - X) (by
      intro hz
      have h := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.coeff 1) hz
      simp at h) (by
      exact (degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (degree_C_le.trans (by norm_num)) (by simp))) (by
      filter_upwards [hμac] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2)
    have haL : 0 < L ((X - C a) * F ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow] using ha
    have hcL : 0 < L ((C c - X) * F ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow] using hc
    obtain ⟨hFn, hFx⟩ := jacobi_expansion_forms L hL hH v
    change L (F ^ 2) = _ at hFn
    change L (X * F ^ 2) = _ at hFx
    rw [sub_mul, map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hFx, hFn] at haL hcL
    constructor
    · simpa only [J, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
        dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] using haL
    · simpa only [J, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
        dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hcL
  exact ⟨Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (hJh.sub (hscalar a)) (fun v hv => (hpos v hv).1),
    Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos ((hscalar c).sub hJh) (fun v hv => (hpos v hv).2)⟩

name: NLAlib.base_add_small_size
statement:
private theorem base_add_small_size (u v : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    n-v.natDegree+(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) = u.natDegree+n
proof: := by omega

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u v : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n).det =
      (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) *
        (rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n).det
proof:
:= by
  let k := u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree
  let B := (rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n).submatrix
    finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
  have hlast (j : Fin (k+1)) :
      rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n (Sum.inr 0) (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) =
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val) := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp only [finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix,
        fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Fin.val_last, k, base_add_small_size]
    · simp [rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix]
  have hrow (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (k+1)) :
      rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n (Sum.inl i) (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) =
        C (rationalModificationConstraint T u (min n v.natDegree) i
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val))) := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun t => ?_) j
    · simp only [finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix,
        fromBlocks_apply₁₂, rationalModificationSmallLeadingConstraints, Fin.val_last, k,
        base_add_small_size]
    · simp [rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix, rationalModificationSmallMatrix]
  have hrows : rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n =
      B.submatrix (Fin.last k).cycleRange.symm id := by
    funext i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) i
    · simp only [rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix, Fin.val_zero,
        Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, B, Fin.cycleRange_symm_zero, k, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last]
      exact (hlast j).symm
    · simp only [rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix, Fin.val_succ,
        dif_neg (show t.val+1 ≠ 0 by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, B, Fin.cycleRange_symm_succ,
        Fin.succAbove_last, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castSucc]
      exact (hrow t j).symm
  rw [hrows, Matrix.det_permute, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]
  simp [sign_finRotate, k]

name: NLAlib.coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_self
statement:
theorem coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_self
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ u.natDegree+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix L T u v n).det.coeff (u.natDegree+n) =
      (rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det
proof:
:= by
  let π := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
  have hπ : π.Monic := monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ _
  have hnat : (u*π).natDegree = u.natDegree+n := by
    rw [natDegree_mul hu hπ.ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  rw [det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_eq L T hu hv hTv hL hn, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul]
  change _ * (u*π).coeff (u.natDegree+n) = _
  rw [← hnat, coeff_natDegree, leadingCoeff_mul, hπ.leadingCoeff, mul_one,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)]

name: NLAlib.coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_self_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_self_ne_zero
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ u.natDegree+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n).det.coeff (u.natDegree+n) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_eq,
    show (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) =
      C ((-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree)) by simp,
    coeff_C_mul, coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_self L T hu hv hTv hL hn]
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))
    (det_rationalModificationSmallMatrix_ne_zero L T hu hv hTv (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_small_det_div
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_small_det_div
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ u.natDegree+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n =
      ((u.leadingCoeff/
        (rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n).det.coeff (u.natDegree+n)) •
          (rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n).det) / u
proof:
:= by
  have hM := det_rationalModificationSmallMatrix_ne_zero L T hu hv hTv (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn
  have hlc := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu
  have hs : (-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
  rw [det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_eq,
    show (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) =
      C ((-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree)) by simp,
    coeff_C_mul, coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_self L T hu hv hTv hL hn,
    det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_eq L T hu hv hTv hL hn, smul_eq_C_mul]
  have hscalar : (u.leadingCoeff/((-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) *
      (rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det)) *
      (-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+min n v.natDegree) *
      ((rationalModificationSmallMatrix L T u v n).det/u.leadingCoeff) = 1 := by field_simp
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, hscalar, C_1, one_mul,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hu]

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    hankelMomentMatrix (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) k = hankelMomentMatrix L k
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  apply finiteMomentFunctional_apply_eq_of_degree_lt
  rw [degree_X_pow]
  exact_mod_cast (show i.val + j.val < 2 * n by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) k =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k
proof:
:= by
  apply monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_moments_eq
  intro j hj
  apply finiteMomentFunctional_apply_eq_of_degree_lt
  rw [degree_X_pow]
  exact_mod_cast (show j < 2 * n by omega)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMomentVector_eq
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) k =
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalPolynomialNorm
  rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq L hk.le]
  apply finiteMomentFunctional_apply_eq_of_degree_lt
  rw [degree_pow, degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact_mod_cast (show 2 * k < 2 * n by omega)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_finiteMomentVector_eq
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) k =
      orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMomentVector_eq L hk,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq L hk.le]
  congr 1
  apply finiteMomentFunctional_apply_eq_of_degree_lt
  rw [degree_mul, degree_X, degree_pow,
    degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact_mod_cast (show 1 + 2 * k < 2 * n by omega)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_finiteMomentVector_eq
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) k =
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · rw [orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMomentVector_eq L hk,
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMomentVector_eq L (by omega : k - 1 < n)]

name: NLAlib.orthonormalMomentPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem orthonormalMomentPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    orthonormalMomentPolynomial (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) k =
      orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMomentVector_eq L hk,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq L hk.le]

name: NLAlib.degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_le
statement:
private theorem degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_le (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).degree ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, C_mul']
  apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_eq
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) n =
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix,
    orthonormalMomentPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq L i.isLt,
    orthonormalMomentPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq L j.isLt]
  apply finiteMomentFunctional_apply_eq_of_degree_lt
  apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
  apply (add_le_add ((degree_mul_le _ _).trans
    (add_le_add (by rw [degree_X]) (degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_le L j.val)))
    (degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_le L i.val)).trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast (show 1 + j.val + i.val < 2 * n by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.momentGaussNodes_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem momentGaussNodes_finiteMomentVector_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    momentGaussNodes (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) n = momentGaussNodes L n
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_congr
    (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) n)
    (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n)
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq L n)
    ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm i)

name: NLAlib.momentGaussWeights_finiteMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem momentGaussWeights_finiteMomentVector_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    momentGaussWeights (finiteMomentFunctional (finiteMomentVector L n)) n = momentGaussWeights L n
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  unfold momentGaussWeights
  rw [momentGaussNodes_finiteMomentVector_eq]
  apply finiteMomentFunctional_apply_eq_of_degree_lt
  apply (Lagrange.degree_basis_le_of_mem _ (mem_univ i)).trans_lt
  simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < 2 * n by have := i.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) :
    HasPolynomialMoments (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).mpr
  convert hμ (p.comp (X ^ 2)) using 1
  ext x
  simp

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) :
    HasPolynomialMoments (μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  apply (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' (by fun_prop)
    (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)).mpr
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _), smul_eq_mul]
  convert hμ (X ^ 2 * p) using 1
  ext x
  simp

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_map_sq
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_map_sq (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ) (hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq hμ) p =
      polynomialIntegral μ hμ (p.comp (X ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialIntegral_apply,
    integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop) p.continuous.stronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_comp, eval_pow, eval_X]

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_withDensity_sq
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_withDensity_sq (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral (μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2)))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ) p = polynomialIntegral μ hμ (X ^ 2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialIntegral_apply, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    (by fun_prop) (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _), smul_eq_mul, polynomialIntegral_apply,
    eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X]

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_map_sq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_map_sq_ne_zero {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : (2 * k : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    hankelMomentDet
      (polynomialIntegral (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ) (hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq hμ)) k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ν := Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq hμ
  have hpos : (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral ν hν) k).PosDef := by
    apply (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_integral_sq_eval_pos ν hν k).mpr
    intro p hp hp0
    let r := p.comp (X ^ 2)
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := (expand_ne_zero (by decide : 0 < 2)).mpr hp0
    have hrd : r.degree < (2 * k : ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hr0]
      have hnat : r.natDegree = p.natDegree * 2 := natDegree_expand 2 p
      rw [hnat]
      have hp' := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
      exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree * 2 < 2 * k by omega)
    have h := integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hk hr0 hrd (hμ.integrable_sq r)
    dsimp only [ν]
    have hsm : StronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x ^ 2) :=
      (p.continuous.pow 2).stronglyMeasurable
    rw [integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (φ := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
      (f := fun x : ℝ => p.eval x ^ 2) (by fun_prop) hsm]
    simpa only [r, eval_comp, eval_pow, eval_X] using h
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _ |>.mp hpos.isUnit)

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_map_sq_withDensity_sq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_map_sq_withDensity_sq_ne_zero {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {k : ℕ} (hk : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    hankelMomentDet
      (polynomialIntegral
        (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2))))
        (hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ))) k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ν := Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2)))
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ)
  have hpos : (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral ν hν) k).PosDef := by
    apply (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_integral_sq_eval_pos ν hν k).mpr
    intro p hp hp0
    let r := X * p.comp (X ^ 2)
    have hpcomp0 : p.comp (X ^ 2) ≠ 0 := (expand_ne_zero (by decide : 0 < 2)).mpr hp0
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero X_ne_zero hpcomp0
    have hrd : r.degree < (2 * k + 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hr0]
      have hnat : r.natDegree = p.natDegree * 2 + 1 := by
        rw [natDegree_X_mul hpcomp0]
        exact congrArg (fun i : ℕ => i + 1) (natDegree_expand 2 p)
      rw [hnat]
      have hp' := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
      exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree * 2 + 1 < 2 * k + 1 by omega)
    have h := integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hk hr0 hrd (hμ.integrable_sq r)
    dsimp only [ν]
    have hsm : StronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x ^ 2) :=
      (p.continuous.pow 2).stronglyMeasurable
    rw [integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (φ := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
      (f := fun x : ℝ => p.eval x ^ 2) (by fun_prop) hsm,
