      integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (by fun_prop)
        (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _), smul_eq_mul]
    simpa only [r, eval_mul, eval_comp, eval_pow, eval_X, mul_pow] using h
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _ |>.mp hpos.isUnit)

name: NLAlib.coeff_sum_monomial_fin
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_sum_monomial_fin {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (i : Fin n) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, monomial j.val (c j)).coeff i.val = c i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hji
    exact if_neg (fun h => hji (Fin.ext h))
  · simp

name: NLAlib.sum_monomial_fin_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sum_monomial_fin_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) = 0 ↔ c = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i
    have hc := congrArg (fun p : 𝕜[X] => p.coeff i.val) h
    simpa only [coeff_sum_monomial_fin, coeff_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using hc
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: NLAlib.degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt
statement:
theorem degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)).degree < n
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_degreeLT.mp
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i _
  apply mem_degreeLT.mpr
  exact (degree_monomial_le _ _).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast i.isLt)

name: NLAlib.eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree < n) :
    p = ∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (p.coeff i.val)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp
  · rw [show (∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (p.coeff i.val)) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, monomial i (p.coeff i) from
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i : ℕ => monomial i (p.coeff i)) n]
    exact p.as_sum_range' n ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp)

name: NLAlib.functional_sum_monomial_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem functional_sum_monomial_mul_X_pow (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n j : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    L ((∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) * X ^ j) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, c i * L (X ^ (i.val + j))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, C_mul', map_smul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hq, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_comm p (C _ * _), mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul,
    mul_comm (X ^ i.val) p, h i, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.functional_mul_X_pow_eq_hankel_mulVec
statement:
theorem functional_mul_X_pow_eq_hankel_mulVec (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree < n) (j : Fin n) :
    L (p * X ^ j.val) = (hankelMomentMatrix L n *ᵥ (fun i => p.coeff i.val)) j
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp]
  rw [functional_sum_monomial_mul_X_pow]
  simp only [hankelMomentMatrix, mulVec, dotProduct]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Nat.add_comm, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree < n)
    (horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < n → L (p * q) = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin n → 𝕜 := fun i => p.coeff i.val
  have hunit : IsUnit (hankelMomentMatrix L n) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)
  let : Invertible (hankelMomentMatrix L n) := hunit.invertible
  have hMc : hankelMomentMatrix L n *ᵥ c = 0 := by
    funext j
    rw [← functional_mul_X_pow_eq_hankel_mulVec L hp j]
    apply horth (X ^ j.val)
    rw [degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast j.isLt
  have hc : c = 0 := by
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_invertible (hankelMomentMatrix L n)
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_zero] using hMc
  rw [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp]
  have hc' (i : Fin n) : p.coeff i.val = 0 := congrFun hc i
  simp only [hc', monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: NLAlib.functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) (j : Fin n) :
    L (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n * X ^ j.val) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (hankelMomentMatrix L n) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)
  let : Invertible (hankelMomentMatrix L n) := hunit.invertible
  have hsystem : hankelMomentMatrix L n *ᵥ orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n =
      (fun i => -L (X ^ (n + i.val))) := by
    rw [orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  unfold monicOrthogonalPolynomial orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart
  rw [add_mul, map_add, ← pow_add, functional_sum_monomial_mul_X_pow]
  have hs := congrFun hsystem j
  simp only [hankelMomentMatrix, mulVec, dotProduct] at hs
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n i * L (X ^ (i.val + j.val))) =
      -L (X ^ (n + j.val)) := by
    rw [← hs]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Nat.add_comm, mul_comm]
  rw [hsum, add_neg_cancel]

name: NLAlib.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) :
    IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  exact functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests L
    (functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero L hn) hq

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {p q : 𝕜[X]}
    (hp : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) (hq : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n q)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  apply hp.eq_of_nondegenerate hq
  intro r hr horth
  exact eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero L hn hr horth

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) :
    ∃! p : 𝕜[X], IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p
proof:
:= by
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hn
  refine ⟨monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n, hp, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  exact hq.eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero hp hn

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (h : ∃! p : 𝕜[X], IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) :
    hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, huniq⟩ := h
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.monic.ne_zero, hp.natDegree_eq]
  have hker : ∀ c : Fin n → 𝕜, hankelMomentMatrix L n *ᵥ c = 0 → c = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    let r : 𝕜[X] := ∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)
    have hr : r.degree < n := degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt c
    have horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < n → L (r * q) = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      apply functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests L _ hq
      intro i
      rw [functional_mul_X_pow_eq_hankel_mulVec L hr i]
      simp only [r, coeff_sum_monomial_fin, hc, Pi.zero_apply]
    have hpr : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n (p + r) := by
      refine ⟨hp.monic.add_of_left (hr.trans_eq hpd.symm), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt (hr.trans_eq hpd.symm), hp.natDegree_eq]
      · intro q hq
        rw [add_mul, map_add, hp.orthogonal _ hq, horth _ hq, add_zero]
    have hr0 : r = 0 := by
      have heq := huniq (p + r) hpr
      exact (add_eq_left.mp heq)
    exact (sum_monomial_fin_eq_zero_iff c).mp hr0
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Matrix.mulVec (hankelMomentMatrix L n)) := by
    intro c d hcd
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply hker (c - d)
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hcd, sub_self]
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp hinj))

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_iff_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_iff_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    (∃! p : 𝕜[X], IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) ↔ hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L,
    existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero L⟩

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.functional_mul_X_pow_eq_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.monic.ne_zero, hp.natDegree_eq]
  have hdiff : (p - X ^ n).degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [← hpd]
    apply degree_sub_lt_left (by simp [hpd]) hp.monic.ne_zero
    simp [(hp.monic).leadingCoeff]
  have h := hp.orthogonal (p - X ^ n) hdiff
  rw [mul_sub, map_sub] at h
  simpa only [pow_two] using (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.functional_sq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.functional_sq_ne_zero
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {p : 𝕜[X]}
    (hp : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) (hn : hankelMomentDet L (n + 1) ≠ 0) :
    L (p ^ 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.monic.ne_zero, hp.natDegree_eq]
  have horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < (n + 1 : ℕ) → L (p * q) = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    apply functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests L _ hq
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i.val < n
    · apply hp.orthogonal
      rw [degree_X_pow]
      exact_mod_cast hi
    · have hieq : i.val = n := by have := i.isLt; omega
      rw [hieq, hp.functional_mul_X_pow_eq_sq, hzero]
  have hpzero := eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero L hn
    (show p.degree < (n + 1 : ℕ) by rw [hpd]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n) horth
  exact hp.monic.ne_zero hpzero

name: NLAlib.quasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional_iff_forall_existsUnique
statement:
theorem quasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional_iff_forall_existsUnique
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L ↔
      ∀ n, ∃! p : 𝕜[X], IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p
proof:
:= by
  unfold QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional
  simp_rw [existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_iff_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) (n : ℕ) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n)).functional_sq_ne_zero
    (hL (n + 1))

name: NLAlib.functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero_of_ne
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {i j : ℕ} (hi : hankelMomentDet L i ≠ 0)
    (hj : hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    L (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij | hij
  · rw [mul_comm]
    apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hj).orthogonal
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hij
  · apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hi).orthogonal
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hij

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn.ne']
  exact div_ne_zero (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite hL n)
    (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite hL (n - 1))

name: NLAlib.eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_degree_le_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_degree_le_of_orthogonal
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hL : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (ho : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < n → L (p * q) = 0) :
    p = C (p.coeff n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  let r := p - C (p.coeff n) * P
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hL
  have hPd : P.degree = n := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hP.monic.ne_zero, hP.natDegree_eq]
  have hrd : r.degree < n := by
    apply (degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero _ _).mpr
    intro k hk
    simp only [r, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul]
    by_cases hkn : k = n
    · subst k
      have hcoeff : P.coeff n = 1 := by
        rw [← hP.natDegree_eq, coeff_natDegree, hP.monic.leadingCoeff]
      rw [hcoeff, mul_one, sub_self]
    · have hnk : n < k := by omega
      have hpzero : p.coeff k = 0 :=
        coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hnk))
      have hPzero : P.coeff k = 0 := coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (by
        rw [hPd]
        exact_mod_cast hnk)
      rw [hpzero, hPzero, mul_zero, sub_self]
  have hr0 : r = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero L hL hrd
    intro q hq
    rw [show r * q = p * q - C (p.coeff n) * (P * q) by dsimp [r]; ring,
      map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, ho q hq, hP.orthogonal q hq, smul_zero, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hr0

name: NLAlib.degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt
statement:
theorem degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt
    (L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x).degree < n
proof:
:=
  degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt _

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    HasCoeffDerivAt (fun y => monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n)
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hc (i : Fin n) :=
    (contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients hL hn i).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  intro k
  simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial, orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv, coeff_add, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial]
  convert (hasDerivAt_const x ((X ^ n : ℝ[X]).coeff k)).add
    (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin n))) =>
      show HasDerivAt (fun y => if i.val = k then
          orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L y) n i else 0)
        (if i.val = k then deriv (fun y => orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L y) n i) x
          else 0) x from by
        split_ifs
        · exact (hc i).hasDerivAt
        · exact hasDerivAt_const x 0)) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L y) n)
      (D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n ^ 2)) x
proof:
:= by
  let P := fun y => monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n
  let V := monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x
  have hP := hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn
  have hVdeg : V.degree < n := degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt L n x
  have hPdeg (y : ℝ) : (P y).degree = n := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hnn : (n : WithBot ℕ) + n < ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show n + n < 2 * n + 1 by omega)
  have hVp : (V * P x + P x * V).degree < (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_add_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply max_lt
    · apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
      rw [hPdeg]
      exact (add_le_add hVdeg.le (le_rfl : (n : WithBot ℕ) ≤ n)).trans_lt hnn
    · apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
      rw [hPdeg]
      exact (add_le_add (le_rfl : (n : WithBot ℕ) ≤ n) hVdeg.le).trans_lt hnn
  have h := hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial (d := 2 * n + 1)
    (p := fun y => P y * P y) (p' := V * P x + P x * V)
    (by intro y; rw [degree_mul, hPdeg]; norm_cast; omega) hVp (hP.mul hP) hD
  have horth := (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) hn).orthogonal V hVdeg
  have hv : L x (V * P x + P x * V) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, mul_comm V]
    simp only [P, horth, add_zero]
  simpa only [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, pow_two, hv, add_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.not_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_and_succ
statement:
theorem not_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_and_succ
    {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (x : 𝕜) :
    ¬ ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x = 0 ∧
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hnorm1 : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n + 1) ≠ 0 :=
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
        (hL (n + 1) (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (n + 1 + 1) le_rfl)
    have hnorm0 : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0 :=
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
        (hL n (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (n + 1) (by omega))
    have hb : orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact div_ne_zero hnorm1 hnorm0
    have hrec := congrArg (eval x) (monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L (n + 1) hL)
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hrec
    rw [h1, h2, mul_zero, zero_sub] at hrec
    have h0 : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x = 0 := by
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (neg_eq_zero.mp hrec.symm)).resolve_left hb
    exact ih (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)) ⟨h0, h1⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues₀_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues₀_eq_zero
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n))) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval
      ((isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).eigenvalues₀ i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let hB := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  have hmem : hB.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.range hB.eigenvalues := by
    rw [← hB.range_eigenvalues₀]
    exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmem
  rw [← hj]
  exact eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues_eq_zero L hL hH j

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues₀_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_strict_interlacing
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_strict_interlacing
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n + 1, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i : Fin n) :
    (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (n + 1)).eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin (n + 1)).symm i.succ) <
      (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i) ∧
      (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i) <
      (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (n + 1)).eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin (n + 1)).symm i.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  let hB := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let hC := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (n + 1)
  let e : Fin n ↪ Fin (n + 1) := ⟨Fin.castSucc, Fin.castSucc_injective n⟩
  let k : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)) := Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm i
  have hup := hC.eigenvalues₀_submatrix_le e k
  have hlo := hC.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_submatrix e k
  have hsub : (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (n + 1)).submatrix e e =
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n := by rfl
  rw [(hC.submatrix e).eigenvalues₀_congr hB hsub k] at hup hlo
  have hup' : hB.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ hC.eigenvalues₀
      (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin (n + 1)).symm i.castSucc) := by
    convert hup using 1
    congr 1
  have hlo' : hC.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin (n + 1)).symm i.succ) ≤
      hB.eigenvalues₀ k := by
    convert hlo using 1
    congr 1
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [k, Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_succ, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hroot := eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues₀_eq_zero L
    (fun j hj => hL j (by omega)) (fun j hj => hH j (by omega)) k
  have hne (j : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)))) : hC.eigenvalues₀ j ≠ hB.eigenvalues₀ k := by
    intro heq
    have hnext := eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues₀_eq_zero L hL hH j
    rw [heq] at hnext
    exact not_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_and_succ L n hL _ ⟨hroot, hnext⟩
  exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hlo' (hne _), lt_of_le_of_ne hup' (hne _).symm⟩

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_momentRecurrenceMap
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => coordinateMomentFunctional c v.ofLp (X ^ k)) m :=
    fun k => (contDiff_coordinateMomentFunctional_ofLp_apply c (X ^ k)).contDiffAt
  have hraw : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) =>
      fun s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n =>
        Sum.elim (fun i : Fin n => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (coordinateMomentFunctional c v.ofLp) i.val)
          (fun i : Fin n => if i.val = 0 then coordinateMomentFunctional c v.ofLp 1 else
            orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (coordinateMomentFunctional c v.ofLp) i.val) s) m := by
    apply contDiffAt_pi.mpr
    intro s
    cases s with
    | inl i =>
      exact contDiffAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha hL
        (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hM i.isLt.le)
        (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM i.isLt).ne'
    | inr i =>
      by_cases hi : i.val = 0
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr, hi]
        exact (contDiff_coordinateMomentFunctional_ofLp_apply c 1).contDiffAt
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr, if_neg hi]
        exact contDiffAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta hL
          (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hM i.isLt.le)
          (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hM (by have := i.isLt; omega))
          (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM (by have := i.isLt; omega)).ne'
  exact (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin n ⊕ Fin n => ℝ)).symm.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp m hraw

name: NLAlib.euclideanJacobian_momentRecurrenceMap_eq
proof:
:= by
  let L := coordinateMomentFunctional c m.ofLp
  have hf := (contDiffAt_momentRecurrenceMap c hM).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hline (t : ℝ) (k : Fin d) :
      coordinateMomentFunctional c (m + t • EuclideanSpace.single k 1).ofLp = L + t • c k := by
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_add, WithLp.ofLp_smul, PiLp.ofLp_single] using
      coordinateMomentFunctional_add_smul_single c m.ofLp t k
  ext s k
  rw [euclideanJacobian_apply_eq_deriv hf]
  cases s with
  | inl i =>
    have h := hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_affine L (c k) i.val
      (fun j hj => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hM (by have := i.isLt; omega))
      (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM i.isLt).ne'
    simpa only [momentRecurrenceMap, PiLp.toLp_apply, Sum.elim_inl, hline,
      momentSensitivityMatrix, L] using h.deriv
  | inr i =>
    by_cases hi : i.val = 0
    · have h : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (L + t • c k) 1) (c k 1) 0 := by
        simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        convert (hasDerivAt_const 0 (L 1)).fun_add ((hasDerivAt_id 0).mul_const (c k 1)) using 1
        all_goals first | rfl | simp
      simpa only [momentRecurrenceMap, PiLp.toLp_apply, Sum.elim_inr, hi, ite_true,
        hline, momentSensitivityMatrix, L] using h.deriv
    · have h := hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_affine L (c k)
        (show 0 < i.val by omega)
        (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hM i.isLt.le)
        (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hM (by have := i.isLt; omega))
        (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM i.isLt).ne'
        (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM (by have := i.isLt; omega)).ne'
      simpa only [momentRecurrenceMap, PiLp.toLp_apply, Sum.elim_inr, if_neg hi,
        hline, momentSensitivityMatrix, L] using h.deriv

    (hμs : ∀ N, HasPolynomialMoments (μs N)) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hm : ∀ j < 2*n, Tendsto (fun N => ∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μs N) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μ))) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) {s : Set ℝ} {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ t ∈ s, |t| ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun N t => (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (μs N) (hμs N)) k).eval t)
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k).eval l s
proof:
:= by
  let m := finiteMomentVector (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  have hpos := finiteMomentFunctional_measure_posDef hμ hn
  have hU := tendstoUniformlyOn_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    (L := fun v : Fin (2*n) → ℝ => finiteMomentFunctional v) (x := m)
    (fun j => (contDiff_finiteMomentFunctional_apply (X^j)).contDiffAt)
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hpos hk) hR
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hU ⊢
  intro ε hε
  have h := (tendsto_finiteMomentVector_polynomialIntegral hμs hμ hm).eventually (hU ε hε)
  simpa only [m, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_finiteMomentVector_eq _ hk] using h

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_Icc_of_moment_convergence
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_Icc_of_moment_convergence
    (hμs : ∀ N, HasPolynomialMoments (μs N)) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hm : ∀ j < 2*n, Tendsto (fun N => ∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μs N) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μ))) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (a b : ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun N t => (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (μs N) (hμs N)) n).eval t)
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).eval l (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendstoUniformlyOn_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_moment_convergence hμs hμ hm hn le_rfl
    (R := max |a| |b|)
  intro t ht
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor
  · have h := neg_le_neg (le_max_left |a| |b|)
    exact h.trans ((neg_abs_le a).trans ht.1)
  · exact ht.2.trans ((le_abs_self b).trans (le_max_right |a| |b|))

name: NLAlib.tendsto_gaussNodes_of_moment_convergence
statement:
theorem tendsto_gaussNodes_of_moment_convergence
    (hμs : ∀ N, HasPolynomialMoments (μs N)) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hm : ∀ j < 2*n, Tendsto (fun N => ∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μs N) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μ))) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (i : Fin n) :
    Tendsto (fun N => gaussNodes (μs N) (hμs N) n i) l (𝓝 (gaussNodes μ hμ n i))
proof:
:= by
  let m := finiteMomentVector (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  have hpos := finiteMomentFunctional_measure_posDef hμ hn
  have hcont := continuousAt_eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
    (L := fun v : Fin (2*n) → ℝ => finiteMomentFunctional v) (x := m)
    (fun j => (contDiff_finiteMomentFunctional_apply (X^j)).contDiffAt)
    (fun k hk => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hpos hk.le)
    (fun k hk => orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hpos hk) i
  have h := hcont.tendsto.comp (tendsto_finiteMomentVector_polynomialIntegral hμs hμ hm)
  change Tendsto (fun N => momentGaussNodes (finiteMomentFunctional
    (finiteMomentVector (polynomialIntegral (μs N) (hμs N)) n)) n i) l
    (𝓝 (momentGaussNodes (finiteMomentFunctional m) n i)) at h
  simpa only [m, momentGaussNodes_finiteMomentVector_eq, gaussNodes] using h

name: NLAlib.tendsto_gaussWeights_of_moment_convergence

name: NLAlib.tendsto_hankelMomentDet_of_moment_convergence
statement:
theorem tendsto_hankelMomentDet_of_moment_convergence
    (hμs : ∀ N, HasPolynomialMoments (μs N)) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hm : ∀ j < 2*n, Tendsto (fun N => ∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μs N) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μ))) :
    Tendsto (fun N => hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral (μs N) (hμs N)) n)
      l (𝓝 (hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun v : Fin (2*n) → ℝ =>
      hankelMomentDet (finiteMomentFunctional v) n) := by
    apply Continuous.matrix_det
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    apply continuous_pi
    intro j
    exact (contDiff_finiteMomentFunctional_apply (r := 1) (X^(i.val+j.val))).continuous
  have h := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (tendsto_finiteMomentVector_polynomialIntegral hμs hμ hm)

    hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq _ le_rfl] using h

name: NLAlib.eventually_posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_of_moment_convergence
statement:
theorem eventually_posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_of_moment_convergence
    (hμs : ∀ N, HasPolynomialMoments (μs N)) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hm : ∀ j < 2*n, Tendsto (fun N => ∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μs N) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μ))) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    ∀ᶠ N in l, (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral (μs N) (hμs N)) n).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : 0 < hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n :=

  filter_upwards [(tendsto_hankelMomentDet_of_moment_convergence hμs hμ hm).eventually
    (eventually_gt_nhds hdet)] with N hN
