name: NLAlib.tendsto_specNorm_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_sub_of_moment_convergence
statement:
theorem tendsto_specNorm_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_sub_of_moment_convergence
    (hμs : ∀ N, HasPolynomialMoments (μs N)) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hm : ∀ j < 2*n, Tendsto (fun N => ∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μs N) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, x^j ∂μ))) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    Tendsto (fun N => specNorm
      (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral (μs N) (hμs N)) n -
        orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n)) l (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let m := finiteMomentVector (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  have hpos := finiteMomentFunctional_measure_posDef hμ hn
  have hentry := continuousAt_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply
    (L := fun v : Fin (2*n) → ℝ => finiteMomentFunctional v) (x := m)
    (fun j => (contDiff_finiteMomentFunctional_apply (X^j)).contDiffAt)
    (fun k hk => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hpos hk.le)
    (fun k hk => orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hpos hk)
  have hc := continuousAt_specNorm_of_entrywise
    (A := fun v : Fin (2*n) → ℝ => orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (finiteMomentFunctional v) n -
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (finiteMomentFunctional m) n)
    (fun i j => (hentry i j).sub continuousAt_const)
  have h := hc.tendsto.comp (tendsto_finiteMomentVector_polynomialIntegral hμs hμ hm)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, m, orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_finiteMomentVector_eq,
    sub_self, specNorm_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination_of_finite
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ k ≤ n+1, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n = z + christoffelQuotient L z n +
      (if n = 0 then 0 else christoffelElimination L z (n-1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (eval z) (monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L n hL)
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C] at h
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta] at h
    simp [christoffelQuotient, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero]
    linear_combination h
  | succ n =>
    simp only [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel, christoffelElimination,
      christoffelQuotient]
    field_simp [hz (n+1) (by omega), hz n (by omega)]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
    linear_combination h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0)
    (hsucc : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n+1)).eval z ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)) n =
      z + christoffelQuotient L z n + christoffelElimination L z n
proof:
:= by
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  let M := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n+1)
  let R := christoffelPolynomial L z n
  let q := christoffelQuotient L z n
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n (by omega))
  have hM := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL (n+1) le_rfl)
  have hR := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial L n hL hz
  have hnorm : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0 := hP.functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (n+1) le_rfl)
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hsucc) hz
  have hPdeg : P.degree < (n+1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hP.monic.ne_zero, hP.natDegree_eq]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n
  have hRdeg : R.degree < (n+1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hR.monic.ne_zero, hR.natDegree_eq]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n
  have hMP : L (M*P) = 0 := hM.orthogonal P hPdeg
  have hMR : L (M*R) = 0 := hM.orthogonal R hRdeg
  have hPM : L (P*M) = 0 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hMP
  have hPR : L (P*R) = orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n :=
    hP.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic hR.monic hR.natDegree_eq
  have hmul : (X-C z)*R = M+C q*P := by
    simpa only [R, M, P, q, christoffelQuotient, neg_div, map_neg,
      neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial L n hz
  have hXR : X*R = M+C q*P+C z*R := by linear_combination hmul
  have hnormNew : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)) n =
      q * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n := by
    simpa only [q, christoffelQuotient, neg_div] using
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L n hL hz
  have hnum : polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z) (X*R^2) =
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n+1) + q*q*orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n +
        q*z*orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n := by
    change L ((X-C z)*(X*R^2)) = _
    rw [show (X-C z)*(X*R^2) = ((X-C z)*R)*(X*R) by ring, hmul, hXR]
    rw [show (M+C q*P)*(M+C q*P+C z*R) = M*M+C q*(M*P)+C z*(M*R)+
        C q*(P*M)+C (q*q)*(P*P)+C (q*z)*(P*R) by simp only [map_mul]; ring]
    simp only [map_add, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hMP, hMR, hPM, hPR,
      mul_zero, add_zero]
    simp only [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, pow_two, P, M]
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L n hL hz,
    hnormNew, hnum]
  dsimp only [christoffelElimination, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta]
  rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  change (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n+1)+q*q*orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n+
    q*z*orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)/(q*orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) =
      z+q+(orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n+1)/orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)/q
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {z : 𝕜} (hn : 0<n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ k ≤ n+1, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)) n =
      christoffelQuotient L z n * christoffelElimination L z (n-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn.ne',
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L n hL (hz n (by omega)),
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L (n-1)
      (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)) (hz (n-1) (by omega)),
    christoffelElimination, show n-1+1 = n by omega,
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn.ne', christoffelQuotient, christoffelQuotient]
  have hprev : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n-1) ≠ 0 :=
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL (n-1) (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero
      (hL (n-1+1) (by omega))
  simp only [show n-1+1 = n by omega]
  field_simp [hz n (by omega), hz (n-1) (by omega), hprev]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_mul_prod_beta_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_mul_prod_beta_eq {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k *
      (∏ i ∈ Ico (k + 1) (n + 1), orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i) =
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
    subst k
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hkn : k = n + 1
    · subst k; simp
    have hkn' : k ≤ n := by omega
    have hH : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0 :=
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
        (hL n (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)
    rw [prod_Ico_succ_top (by omega : k + 1 ≤ n + 1), ← mul_assoc,
      ih (fun j hj => hL j (by omega)) k hkn', orthogonalRecurrenceBeta,
      if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hH

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_sum_prod_beta_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sum_prod_beta_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (x y : 𝕜) :
    (x - y) * (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1),
      (∏ i ∈ Ico (k + 1) (n + 1), orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i) *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval y) =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y
proof:
:= by
  have hH (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k ≠ 0 :=
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
      (hL k (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (k + 1) (by omega))
  have hs : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n *
      (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) y).eval x =
      ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1),
        (∏ i ∈ Ico (k + 1) (n + 1), orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i) *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval y := by
    simp only [monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    have hprod := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_mul_prod_beta_eq L n
      (fun j hj => hL j (by omega)) k (by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega)
    rw [← hprod]
    field_simp [hH k (by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega)]
  rw [← hs]
  have h := sub_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial n hL x y
  field_simp [hH n le_rfl] at h
  linear_combination h

name: NLAlib.sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
statement:
theorem sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) (x : ℝ) :
    (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n).eval x ^ 2 =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x ^ 2 / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, eval_mul, eval_C, mul_pow, inv_pow]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hH.le]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_confluent_and_pos
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_confluent_and_pos
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j ≤ n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2) =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ∧
      0 < ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2) =
      (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) x).eval x := by
    simp only [monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH k (by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega))]
    ring
  refine ⟨he.trans (eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial_self n hL x), ?_⟩
  apply sum_pos' (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨0, mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n), ?_⟩
  rw [sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH 0 (by omega))]
  simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, eval_one, one_pow]
  exact div_pos zero_lt_one (hH 0 (by omega))

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_normalized_confluent_and_pos
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_normalized_confluent_and_pos
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2) =
      Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) *
        ((orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
          (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n).eval x -
          (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
            (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) ∧
      0 < ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he := sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_confluent_and_pos L n hL
    (fun j hj => hH j (by omega)) x
  have hc : Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) *
      (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n + 1)))⁻¹ *
        (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n))⁻¹ = (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      Real.sqrt_div (hH (n + 1) le_rfl).le]
    field_simp [(Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH (n + 1) le_rfl)).ne',
      (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH n (by omega))).ne', (hH n (by omega)).ne']
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (hH n (by omega)).le).symm
  refine ⟨?_, he.2⟩
  rw [he.1]
  simp only [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C]
  linear_combination
    -((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x -
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) * hc

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_sub_le
    (L M : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) {t R : ℝ} (ht : |t| ≤ R) :
    |(monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval t - (monicOrthogonalPolynomial M n).eval t| ≤
      ∑ i : Fin n, |orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n i -
        orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients M n i| * R ^ i.val
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval t -
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial M n).eval t =
        ∑ i : Fin n, (orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n i -
          orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients M n i) * t ^ i.val := by
    simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial, orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart,
      eval_add, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_finsetSum, eval_monomial]
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
  rw [heq]
  apply (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [abs_mul, abs_pow]
  gcongr

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {L : E → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {x : E} {n : ℕ} {s : Set ℝ} {R : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) (hR : ∀ t ∈ s, |t| ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun y t => (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).eval t)
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n).eval (𝓝 x) s
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hbound : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => ∑ i : Fin n,
      |orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L y) n i - orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L x) n i| *
        R ^ i.val) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := tendsto_finsetSum (univ : Finset (Fin n))
      (f := fun i y => |orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L y) n i -
        orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L x) n i| * R ^ i.val) (fun i _ =>
      (((contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients hL hn i).continuousAt.sub
        continuousAt_const).abs.mul continuousAt_const))
    simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, sub_self, abs_zero, zero_mul, sum_const_zero] using h
  filter_upwards [hbound.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hε)] with y hy
  intro t ht
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
  exact (abs_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_sub_le (L y) (L x) n (hR t ht)).trans_lt hy

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_polynomial
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  apply (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' (by fun_prop)
    (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)).mpr
  apply (hμ (w * p)).congr
  filter_upwards [hw] with x hx
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hx, smul_eq_mul, eval_mul]

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_withDensity_polynomial
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_withDensity_polynomial {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (w : ℝ[X]) (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w.eval x) :
    polynomialIntegral (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w.eval x)))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_polynomial hμ w hw) =
        polynomialWeightedFunctional (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) w
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  rw [polynomialIntegral_apply, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    (by fun_prop) (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top),
    polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, polynomialIntegral_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hw] with x hx
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hx, smul_eq_mul, eval_mul]

name: NLAlib.eq_of_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_support_gap
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  have hp : p.Monic := monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  by_contra huv
  obtain ⟨r, hpr⟩ := dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hpu
  have hrv : r.eval v = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (eval v) hpr
    rw [hpv] at h
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => huv h.symm))
  obtain ⟨q, hrq⟩ := dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hrv
  have hpq : p = ((X - C u) * (X - C v)) * q := by
    change monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n = _
    rw [hpr, hrq, mul_assoc]
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero] at hpq
    exact hp.ne_zero hpq
  have hqd : q.degree < n := by
    have hd := congrArg natDegree hpq
    rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial,
      natDegree_mul (mul_ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C u).ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C v).ne_zero) hq0,
      natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C u).ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C v).ne_zero,
      natDegree_X_sub_C, natDegree_X_sub_C] at hd
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hq0]
    exact_mod_cast (show q.natDegree < n by omega)
  have horth : (∫ x, p.eval x * q.eval x ∂μ) = 0 := by
    have hspec := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ n + 1).trans hn)
    simpa only [L, p, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul] using hspec.orthogonal q hqd
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => p.eval x * q.eval x) μ := by
    convert hμ (p * q) using 1
    ext x
    simp
  have hnon : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] (fun x => p.eval x * q.eval x) := by
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
    have hxg : x ∉ Ioo c d := fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp hg h hx
    have heval : p.eval x * q.eval x = (x - u) * (x - v) * q.eval x ^ 2 := by
      rw [hpq]
      simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      ring
    rw [heval]
    apply mul_nonneg _ (sq_nonneg _)
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, not_and_or, not_lt] at hxg
    rcases hxg with hxc | hdx
    · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.1]) (by linarith [hv.1])
    · exact mul_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2]) (by linarith [hv.2])
  have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hnon hint).mp horth
  have hpzero : (∫ x, p.eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    have hpx : p.eval x = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx
      · exact hx
      · simp only [hpq, eval_mul, hx, mul_zero]
    simp only [hpx, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply]
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, p.eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    simpa only [L, p, orthogonalPolynomialNorm, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow] using
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ hn
  exact hpos.ne' hpzero

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_mem_support_of_encard_eq
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_mem_support_of_encard_eq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : μ.support.encard = n) (x : ℝ) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).eval x = 0 ↔
      x ∈ μ.support
proof:
:= by
  have hs : μ.support.Finite := Set.finite_of_encard_le_coe hn.le
  have hcard : hs.toFinset.card = n := by
    exact_mod_cast hs.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card.symm.trans hn
  rw [← hcard, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_nodal_support μ hμ hs]
  simp only [Lagrange.nodal_eq, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, id_eq,
    Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ => hxy ▸ hy, fun hx => ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.eq_of_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_support_gap_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
  · have hus := (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_mem_support_of_encard_eq
      hμ heq.symm u).mp hpu
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hg hu hus).elim
  · exact eq_of_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_support_gap hμ
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ENat.natCast_add_one_le_iff.mpr hlt)
      hg hu hv hpu hpv

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_christoffelQuotient_mul_elimination
statement:
private theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_christoffelQuotient_mul_elimination
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {z : 𝕜}
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hz : ∀ k ≤ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n =
      christoffelQuotient L z (n-1) * christoffelElimination L z (n-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [christoffelElimination, show n-1+1 = n by omega]
  have hq : christoffelQuotient L z (n-1) ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa only [show n-1+1=n by omega] using hz n le_rfl))
      (hz (n-1) (by omega))
  field_simp [hq]

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_add_scalar_one
statement:
private theorem monicJacobiMatrix_add_scalar_one (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → 𝕜) (z : 𝕜) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n (fun j => z + a j) b = monicJacobiMatrix n a b + z • 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [monicJacobiMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, diagonal_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.one_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  all_goals simp [hij]
  all_goals ring

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_eq_of_coefficients
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [monicJacobiMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, diagonal_apply, Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [ha i.val i.isLt]
  by_cases hsub : j.val+1 = i.val
  · rw [if_pos hsub, if_pos hsub, hb i.val i.isLt (by omega)]
  · rw [if_neg hsub, if_neg hsub]

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_sub_scalar_one_eq_christoffel_factors_of_finite
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_sub_scalar_one_eq_christoffel_factors_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {z : 𝕜} (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ k ≤ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z ≠ 0) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L) - z • 1 =
      darbouxLowerMatrix n (christoffelElimination L z) *
        darbouxUpperMatrix n (christoffelQuotient L z)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : monicJacobiMatrix n (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L) =
      monicJacobiMatrix n
        (fun j => z + (christoffelQuotient L z j +
          if j=0 then 0 else christoffelElimination L z (j-1)))
        (fun j => christoffelQuotient L z (j-1) * christoffelElimination L z (j-1)) := by
    apply monicJacobiMatrix_eq_of_coefficients
    · intro i hi
      rw [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination_of_finite
        (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hz k (by omega))]
      ring
    · intro i hin hi
      exact orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_christoffelQuotient_mul_elimination hi
        (fun k hk => hz k (by omega))
  rw [hJ, monicJacobiMatrix_add_scalar_one, add_sub_cancel_right,
    darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_darbouxUpperMatrix]

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary_of_finite
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {z : 𝕜} (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ k ≤ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z ≠ 0) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n
        (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)))
        (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z))) =
      darbouxUpperMatrix n (christoffelQuotient L z) *
        darbouxLowerMatrix n (christoffelElimination L z) + z • 1 +
          christoffelElimination L z (n-1) • terminalCoordinateMatrix n
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : monicJacobiMatrix n
        (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)))
        (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z))) =
      monicJacobiMatrix n
        (fun j => z + (christoffelQuotient L z j + christoffelElimination L z j))
        (fun j => christoffelQuotient L z j * christoffelElimination L z (j-1)) := by
    apply monicJacobiMatrix_eq_of_coefficients
    · intro i hi
      rw [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
        (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)) (hz i (by omega)) (hz (i+1) (by omega))]
      ring
    · intro i hin hi
      exact orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite hi
        (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hz k (by omega))
  rw [hJ, monicJacobiMatrix_add_scalar_one,
    monicJacobiMatrix_eq_darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix_add_boundary]
  abel

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_sub_scalar_one_eq_christoffel_factors
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_sub_scalar_one_eq_christoffel_factors
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L) - z • 1 =
      darbouxLowerMatrix n (christoffelElimination L z) *
        darbouxUpperMatrix n (christoffelQuotient L z)
proof:
:=
  monicJacobiMatrix_sub_scalar_one_eq_christoffel_factors_of_finite n
    (fun k _ => hL k) (fun k _ => hz k)

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n
        (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)))
        (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z))) =
      darbouxUpperMatrix n (christoffelQuotient L z) *
        darbouxLowerMatrix n (christoffelElimination L z) + z • 1 +
          christoffelElimination L z (n-1) • terminalCoordinateMatrix n
proof:
:=
  monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary_of_finite n
    (fun k _ => hL k) (fun k _ => hz k)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).nextCoeff -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    have h := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L 0 hL
    simp [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta] at h
    rw [h, nextCoeff_X_sub_C, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero]
    rw [show (1 : 𝕜[X]).nextCoeff = 0 by
      simpa only [C_1] using nextCoeff_C_eq_zero (1 : 𝕜)]
    ring
  | succ n =>
    have hrec := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L (n + 1) hL
    rw [sub_mul] at hrec
    have h := congrArg (fun p : 𝕜[X] => p.coeff (n + 1)) hrec
    simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
    have htop : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).coeff (n + 1) = 1 := by
      simpa only [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial] using
        (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).coeff_natDegree
    have hlow : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).coeff (n + 1) = 0 :=
      coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]; omega)
    rw [htop, hlow, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]; omega),
      nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]; omega),
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel, show n + 1 + 1 - 1 = n + 1 by omega]
    linear_combination h

name: NLAlib.integrable_complex_eval_div_sub_of_ae_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => p.eval (x : ℂ) / (z - (x : ℂ))) (Icc a b) :=
    (p.continuous.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal).continuousOn.div
      (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal).continuousOn
      (fun x hx => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz x hx))
  refine (hc.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
  filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx hnot
  exact (hnot hx).elim

name: NLAlib.gauss_poly_complex_eval_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem gauss_poly_complex_eval_eq_zero {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (i : Fin n) :
    ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
      Complex.ofRealHom).eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
    Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom (gaussNodes μ hμ n i)) = 0
  rw [eval_map_apply]
  have h := (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [h, map_zero]

name: NLAlib.eval_map_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_off_Icc
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hμ hn, Lagrange.nodal_eq,
    Polynomial.map_prod, eval_prod]
  apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i))

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_eq_integral_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_eq_integral_dividedDifference
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (z : ℂ) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      ∫ x : ℝ, (((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
        Complex.ofRealHom).dividedDifference z).eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  have hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := fun k hk =>
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn)
  have hexact : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < n → L q =
      ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hμ n i * q.eval (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) := by
    intro q hq
    exact integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn
      (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ 2*n by omega)))
  rw [secondKindPolynomial_eq_sum_weight_mul_dividedDifference L n hn0 hL _ _ hexact,
    Polynomial.map_sum]
  simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn
    ((degree_dividedDifference_lt hn0 (by rw [natDegree_map, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]) z).trans_le
      (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ 2*n by omega)))]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 1
  have hm : ((p.dividedDifference (gaussNodes μ hμ n i)).map Complex.ofRealHom) =
      (p.map Complex.ofRealHom).dividedDifference (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)).ne_zero
    rw [X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference]
    have h := congrArg (Polynomial.map Complex.ofRealHom)
      (X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference p (gaussNodes μ hμ n i))
    rw [show (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ) = Complex.ofRealHom (gaussNodes μ hμ n i) by rfl,
      eval_map_apply]
    simpa only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C] using h
  rw [hm, eval_dividedDifference_comm]

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  apply eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div Complex.ofRealHom
    (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n hn0
    (fun k hk => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn))
  · intro i
    exact (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn
      (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ 2*n by omega)))
  · exact eval_map_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_off_Icc hμ hs hn hz
  · intro i
    exact hz _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i)

name: NLAlib.stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    stieltjesTransform μ z -
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      (∫ x : ℝ, ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
        Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ) / (z - (x : ℂ)) ∂μ) /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  let p := (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hpz := eval_map_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_off_Icc hμ hs hn hz
  have h1 := integrable_complex_eval_div_sub_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hz (1 : ℂ[X])
  simp only [eval_one, one_div] at h1
  have hp := integrable_complex_eval_div_sub_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hz p
  have hdd := hμ.integrable_complex_eval (p.dividedDifference z)
  have he : (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ)/(z-(x:ℂ)) ∂μ) =
      p.eval z * stieltjesTransform μ z -
        ∫ x : ℝ, (p.dividedDifference z).eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ := by
    rw [stieltjesTransform, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_sub (h1.const_mul _) hdd]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    rw [eval_dividedDifference_of_ne _ (fun h => hz x hx h.symm)]
    field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz x hx), sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hz x hx h.symm)]
    ring
  rw [eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_eq_integral_dividedDifference hμ hn0 hn z, he]
  change _ - _ / p.eval z = (p.eval z * _ - _) / p.eval z
  rw [sub_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hpz]

name: NLAlib.stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral_sq
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral_sq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    stieltjesTransform μ z -
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      (∫ x : ℝ, ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
        Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ)^2 / (z - (x : ℂ)) ∂μ) /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z^2
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  let p := (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hpz := eval_map_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_off_Icc hμ hs hn hz
  have hd : (p * p.dividedDifference z).degree < (2*n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
    have hpdeg : p.degree = (n : ℕ) := by
      dsimp only [p]
      rw [degree_map_eq_of_injective Complex.ofRealHom.injective,
        degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ _).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    rw [hpdeg]
    have hdd := degree_dividedDifference_lt (p := p) hn0
      (by dsimp [p]; rw [natDegree_map, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]) z
    exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_left (by simp) hdd).trans_eq (by norm_cast; omega)
  have hzero : (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ) * (p.dividedDifference z).eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    have he := integral_complex_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn hd
    simp only [eval_mul] at he
    rw [he]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    simp only [p, gauss_poly_complex_eval_eq_zero hμ hn i, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  have hp := integrable_complex_eval_div_sub_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hz p
  have hsquare := integrable_complex_eval_div_sub_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hz (p^2)
  simp only [eval_pow] at hsquare
  have hdd := hμ.integrable_complex_eval (p * p.dividedDifference z)
  simp only [eval_mul] at hdd
  have he : p.eval z * (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ)/(z-(x:ℂ)) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ)^2/(z-(x:ℂ)) ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    calc
      _ = (∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ)^2/(z-(x:ℂ)) +
          p.eval (x : ℂ) * (p.dividedDifference z).eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
        rw [eval_dividedDifference_of_ne _ (fun h => hz x hx h.symm)]
        field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz x hx), sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hz x hx h.symm)]
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_add hsquare hdd, hzero, add_zero]
  rw [stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral hμ hs hn0 hn hz]
  change _ / p.eval z = _ / p.eval z^2
  rw [← he]
  change p.eval z ≠ 0 at hpz
  field_simp
  rfl

name: NLAlib.norm_stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_le
statement:
theorem norm_stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_le
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, δ ≤ ‖z - (x : ℂ)‖) :
    ‖stieltjesTransform μ z -
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖ ≤
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n /
        (δ * ‖((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
          Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  have hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx h
    have h' := hgap x hx
    rw [h, sub_self, norm_zero] at h'
    linarith
  have hbound : ‖∫ x : ℝ, ((p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ))^2 /
      (z-(x:ℂ)) ∂μ‖ ≤ orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n / δ := by
    have hint : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (p.eval x)^2/δ) μ := by
      simpa only [eval_pow] using
        (show Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (p^2).eval x/δ) μ from (hμ (p^2)).div_const δ)
    have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hint (show ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂μ,
        ‖((p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ))^2 / (z-(x:ℂ))‖ ≤ (p.eval x)^2/δ by
      filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
      change ‖((p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom x))^2 / (z-(x:ℂ))‖ ≤ _
      rw [eval_map_apply, norm_div, norm_pow]
      change ‖((p.eval x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖^2 / ‖z-(x:ℂ)‖ ≤ _
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) hδ (hgap x hx))
    simpa only [integral_div, orthogonalPolynomialNorm, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, p] using h
  rw [stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral_sq hμ hs hn0 hn hz, norm_div, norm_pow]
  change ‖∫ x : ℝ, ((p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ))^2 / (z-(x:ℂ)) ∂μ‖ /
    ‖(p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖^2 ≤ _
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound (sq_nonneg _)).trans_eq (div_div _ _ _)

name: NLAlib.secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_stieltjesTransform_of_encard_eq
statement:
theorem secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_stieltjesTransform_of_encard_eq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : μ.support.encard = n) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      stieltjesTransform μ z
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ.isFiniteMeasure
  have he := stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_eq_integral hμ hs hn0 hn.ge hz
  have hint : (∫ x : ℝ, ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
      Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x:ℂ)/(z-(x:ℂ)) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
    change ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
      Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom x)/(z-(x:ℂ)) = 0
    rw [eval_map_apply,
      (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_mem_support_of_encard_eq hμ hn x).mpr hx,
      map_zero, zero_div]
  rw [hint, zero_div] at he
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp he).symm

name: NLAlib.HasPolynomialMoments.isFiniteMeasure
statement:
theorem HasPolynomialMoments.isFiniteMeasure {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) :
    IsFiniteMeasure μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure (one_ne_zero : (1:ℝ) ≠ 0)).mp
  simpa only [eval_one] using (hμ (1 : ℝ[X]))

name: NLAlib.HasPolynomialMoments.integrable_sq
statement:
theorem HasPolynomialMoments.integrable_sq {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (p : ℝ[X]) : Integrable (fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (p ^ 2).eval = fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2 := by
    funext x
    exact eval_pow 2
  rw [← hp]
  exact hμ (p ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_pow
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_pow (μ : Measure ℝ) :
    HasPolynomialMoments μ ↔ ∀ k : ℕ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ k) μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h k
    simpa only [eval_pow, eval_X] using h (X ^ k)
  · intro h p
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [show (p + q).eval = p.eval + q.eval by funext x; exact eval_add]
      exact hp.add hq
    | monomial k c => simpa only [eval_monomial] using (h k).const_mul c

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_abs_pow
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_abs_pow (μ : Measure ℝ) :
    HasPolynomialMoments μ ↔ ∀ k : ℕ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ k) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasPolynomialMoments_iff_integrable_pow]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro k
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow] using
    (integrable_norm_iff (μ := μ) (f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ k) (by fun_prop)).symm

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) : HasPolynomialMoments μ
proof:
:=
  fun p => integrable_eval_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ p

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialIntegral_apply (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (p : ℝ[X]) : polynomialIntegral μ hμ p = ∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_mul
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_mul (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral μ hμ (p * q) = ∫ x, p.eval x * q.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_eval_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem integral_sq_eval_eq_zero_iff {μ : Measure ℝ} (p : ℝ[X])
    (hp : Integrable (fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2) μ) :
    (∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 ↔ ∀ x ∈ μ.support, p.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (p.eval x)) hp).mp hzero
    have hsup : μ.support ⊆ {x | p.eval x = 0} := by
      apply Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed (isClosed_eq p.continuous continuous_const)
      filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
      simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, sq_eq_zero_iff] using hx
    exact hsup
  · intro hs
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
    simp only [hs x hx, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply]

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard {μ : Measure ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp0 : p ≠ 0)
    (hp : p.degree < n) (hi : Integrable (fun x => (p.eval x) ^ 2) μ) :
    0 < ∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (p.eval x)))
  intro heq
  have hs := (integral_sq_eval_eq_zero_iff p hi).mp heq.symm
  have hsub : μ.support ⊆ (p.roots.toFinset : Set ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    simpa only [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots hp0, IsRoot.def] using hs x hx
  have hcard : p.roots.toFinset.card ≤ p.natDegree :=
    (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans (card_roots' p)
  have hdeg : p.natDegree < n := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
  have hle : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ p.natDegree := hn.trans
    ((encard_mono hsub).trans (by exact_mod_cast hcard))
  exact (not_le_of_gt hdeg) (by exact_mod_cast hle)

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_eval_pos_iff_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem integral_sq_eval_pos_iff_le_support_encard (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < n → p ≠ 0 → 0 < ∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ↔
      (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpos
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : μ.support.encard < n := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hfin : μ.support.Finite := finite_of_encard_le_coe hlt.le
    let s := hfin.toFinset
    have hcard : s.card < n := by
      simpa only [s, hfin.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card, Nat.cast_lt] using hlt
    let p : ℝ[X] := Lagrange.nodal s id
    have hp : p.Monic := Lagrange.nodal_monic
    have hdeg : p.degree < n := by
      rw [show p = Lagrange.nodal s id from rfl, Lagrange.degree_nodal]
      exact_mod_cast hcard
    have hi := hμ.integrable_sq p
    have hz : (∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 :=
      (integral_sq_eval_eq_zero_iff p hi).mpr (fun x hx =>
        Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (s := s) (v := id) (i := x)
          (by simpa only [s, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hx))
    have h := hpos p hdeg hp.ne_zero
    rw [hz] at h
    exact lt_irrefl _ h
  · intro hn p hp hp0
    apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn hp0 hp
    exact hμ.integrable_sq p

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_self_eq_alpha
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_self_eq_alpha (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (hH : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i i = orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L i.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix, functional_X_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul,
    ← pow_two (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val))⁻¹, inv_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt hH.le, orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha]
  have hp : monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val * (X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val) =
      X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [hp]
  ring

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i j = Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L j.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix, functional_X_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul]
  have hj := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL j.val j.isLt.le)
  rw [hj.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic (monic_X.mul (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val))
    (by rw [natDegree_X_mul (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]; omega)]
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (by omega : j.val ≠ 0),
    show j.val - 1 = i.val by omega, Real.sqrt_div (hH j.val j.isLt).le]
  change (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j.val))⁻¹ *
      (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val))⁻¹ * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j.val = _
  field_simp [(Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH j.val j.isLt)).ne',
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH i.val i.isLt)).ne']
  exact (Real.sq_sqrt (hH j.val j.isLt).le).symm

name: NLAlib.sq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_beta
statement:
theorem sq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_beta
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i j ^ 2 = orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L j.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta L hL hH i j hij]
  apply Real.sq_sqrt
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (by omega : j.val ≠ 0), show j.val - 1 = i.val by omega]
  exact (div_pos (hH _ j.isLt) (hH _ i.isLt)).le

name: NLAlib.X_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
statement:
theorem X_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) :
    X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n =
      C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n)) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n - 1) +
      C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n +
      C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1))) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hs (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n + 1) : Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH k hk)).ne'
  have hnext : (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n))⁻¹ =
      Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) *
        (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n + 1)))⁻¹ := by
    rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      Real.sqrt_div (hH (n + 1) le_rfl).le]
    field_simp [hs n (by omega), hs (n + 1) le_rfl]
  have hprev : (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n))⁻¹ * orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n =
      Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n) *
        (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1)))⁻¹ := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta]
    rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn, Real.sqrt_div (hH n (by omega)).le]
    field_simp [hs n (by omega), hs (n - 1) (by omega), (hH (n - 1) (by omega)).ne']
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (hH n (by omega)).le,
      Real.sq_sqrt (hH (n - 1) (by omega)).le]
  have hrec : X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) +
      C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1) := by
    linear_combination -(monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L n hL)
  calc
    _ = C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n))⁻¹ *
        (X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n) := by simp only [orthonormalMomentPolynomial]; ring
    _ = C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n))⁻¹ *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) +
          C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
          C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1)) := by rw [hrec]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [orthonormalMomentPolynomial]
      have hcnext := congrArg (C : ℝ →+* ℝ[X]) hnext
      have hcprev := congrArg (C : ℝ →+* ℝ[X]) hprev
      simp only [map_mul] at hcnext hcprev
      linear_combination monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) * hcnext +
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1) * hcprev

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiMatrix (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n =
      jacobiMatrix (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (fun i => Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i)) n
proof:
:= by
  have hsym := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n)
  ext i j
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  split_ifs with h0 h1 h2
  · have hij : i = j := Fin.ext h0
    subst j
    exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_self_eq_alpha L i (hH i.val i.isLt)
  · exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta L hL hH i j h1
  · rw [hsym.apply]
    exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta L hL hH j i h2
  · rcases (show i.val + 1 < j.val ∨ j.val + 1 < i.val by omega) with hij | hji
    · exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL i j hij
    · rw [hsym.apply]
      exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL j i hji

name: NLAlib.auxiliary_border_fst_sum
statement:
private theorem auxiliary_border_fst_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → 𝕜[X] × 𝕜[X]) :
    (∑ j, f j).1 = ∑ j, (f j).1
proof: := map_sum (LinearMap.fst 𝕜 𝕜[X] 𝕜[X]) _ _

name: NLAlib.auxiliary_border_snd_sum
statement:
private theorem auxiliary_border_snd_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → 𝕜[X] × 𝕜[X]) :
    (∑ j, f j).2 = ∑ j, (f j).2
proof: := map_sum (LinearMap.snd 𝕜 𝕜[X] 𝕜[X]) _ _

name: NLAlib.auxiliary_border_det_eq
statement:
private theorem auxiliary_border_det_eq (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (hm : n ≤ m)
    (hd : (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm).det ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationAuxiliaryBorderMatrix L T x z hm).det =
      C (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm).det *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) -
          ∑ j : RationalModificationAuxiliaryIndex l m n,
            C (((rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm)⁻¹ *ᵥ
              rationalModificationAuxiliaryLeadingConstraints L T x z hm) j) *
                (rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L j).1)
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm
  have hu : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd
  let : Invertible (M.map C) :=
    { invOf := (M⁻¹).map C
      invOf_mul_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.nonsing_inv_mul hu]; simp
      mul_invOf_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.mul_nonsing_inv hu]; simp }
  rw [rationalModificationAuxiliaryBorderMatrix,det_fromBlocks₁₁,
    det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
  rw [show (M.map C).det = C M.det from (RingHom.map_det C M).symm]
  congr 1
  change monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) -
      ∑ j, (∑ i, (rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L i).1*C (M⁻¹ i j))*
        C (rationalModificationAuxiliaryLeadingConstraints L T x z hm j) =
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) -
      ∑ i, C (∑ j, M⁻¹ i j*rationalModificationAuxiliaryLeadingConstraints L T x z hm j)*
        (rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L i).1
  simp only [map_sum,map_mul,sum_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryBorderMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryBorderMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z) (hm : n ≤ m)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationAuxiliaryBorderMatrix L T x z hm).det =
      C (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm).det * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm
  let b := rationalModificationAuxiliaryLeadingConstraints L T x z hm
  let c := M⁻¹ *ᵥ b
  let low : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j, C (c j)*(rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L j).1
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n)-low
  let A : 𝕜[X] := -(∑ j, C (c j)*(rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L j).2)
  let u := Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x
  let π := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
  have hd := det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix_ne_zero L T x z hx hz hm hn
  have hMc : M *ᵥ c = b := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [mulVec_mulVec,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd),one_mulVec]
  have hlow : low.degree < (l+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    cases j with
    | inl j => simp [rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn]
    | inr j =>
      simp only [rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn,Sum.elim_inr]
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
      exact_mod_cast j.isLt
  have hA : A.degree < (m-n : ℕ) := by
    dsimp only [A]
    rw [degree_neg]
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    cases j with
    | inl j =>
      simp only [rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn,Sum.elim_inl,degree_X_pow]
      exact_mod_cast j.isLt
    | inr j => simp [rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn]
  have hs : (P,A) = (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n),0) -
      ∑ j, c j • rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L j := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp [P,A,low,C_mul',auxiliary_border_fst_sum,auxiliary_border_snd_sum]
  have hrows (i : Fin (l+m)) : rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow T x z i (P,A) = 0 := by
    rw [hs,map_sub,map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
    have hi := congrFun hMc ((rationalModificationAuxiliaryRowEquiv hm).symm i)
    have he : (∑ j, c j*rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow T x z i
        (rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L j)) =
        rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow T x z i (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n),0) := by
      simpa only [M,b,rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix,
        rationalModificationAuxiliaryLeadingConstraints,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,
        Equiv.apply_symm_apply,mul_comm] using hi
    rw [he,sub_self]
  have hfull := rationalModificationConstraint_of_auxiliary_rows T x z hx hz hm P A hA hrows
  have htop : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n)).degree = (l+n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).sub_of_left
    (hlow.trans_eq htop.symm)
  have hPdeg : P.degree = (l+n : ℕ) :=
    (degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (hlow.trans_eq htop.symm)).trans htop
  have hπ := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn
  have hπm : π.Monic := hπ.monic
  have hu : u.Monic := Lagrange.nodal_monic
  have hUdeg : (u*π).degree = (l+n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul,degree_eq_natDegree hu.ne_zero,degree_eq_natDegree hπ.monic.ne_zero,
      hπ.natDegree_eq]
    simp only [u,Lagrange.natDegree_nodal,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_add]
  have hdiff : (P-u*π).degree < (l+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sub_lt_left (hPdeg.trans hUdeg.symm) hPmonic.ne_zero ?_).trans_eq hPdeg
    simp only [hPmonic.leadingCoeff,leadingCoeff_mul,hu.leadingCoeff,hπm.leadingCoeff,mul_one]
  have hπrows : ∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (u*π) = 0 := by
    apply (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu.ne_zero n _).mpr
    refine ⟨dvd_mul_right _ _,?_⟩
    intro r
    simpa only [π,polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply,mul_assoc] using
      functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn r
  have heq : P = u*π := sub_eq_zero.mp
    (eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T hu.ne_zero hn
      (by simpa only [u,Lagrange.natDegree_nodal,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] using hdiff)
      (by intro i; rw [map_sub,hfull i,hπrows i,sub_self]))
  rw [auxiliary_border_det_eq L T x z hm hd]
  change C M.det * P = _
  rw [heq]
  exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z) (hm : n ≤ m)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix L T x z hm).det =
      C (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm).det * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ∧
      (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix,Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]
  exact ⟨det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryBorderMatrix_eq L T x z hx hz hm hn,
    det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix_ne_zero L T x z hx hz hm hn⟩

name: NLAlib.degree_monic_eq
statement:
private theorem degree_monic_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).degree = (k : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]

name: NLAlib.degree_orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem degree_orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_le
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L k).degree ≤ ((2*k+1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial
  rw [C_mul']
  apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
  apply (degree_sub_le _ _).trans
  apply max_le
  · rw [degree_mul, degree_X_sub_C, degree_pow, degree_monic_eq, nsmul_eq_mul]
    norm_cast
    omega
  · rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
    rw [degree_mul, degree_monic_eq, degree_monic_eq]
    exact_mod_cast (show k - 1 + k ≤ 2*k + 1 by omega)

name: NLAlib.degree_orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem degree_orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial_le
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial L k).degree ≤ ((2*k : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial
  rw [C_mul']
  apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
  apply (degree_sub_le _ _).trans
  apply max_le
  · rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
    rw [degree_pow, degree_monic_eq, nsmul_eq_mul]
    norm_cast
  · rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans
    rw [degree_pow, degree_monic_eq, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (show 2*(k - 1) ≤ 2*k by omega)

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change L (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
    L (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val)
  exact congrArg L (by ac_rfl)

name: NLAlib.functional_X_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem functional_X_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (i j : ℕ) :
    L (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i) =
      (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j))⁻¹ *
        (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹ *
        L (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j * (X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, orthonormalMomentPolynomial]
  rw [show X * (C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j))⁻¹ * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) *
      (C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹ * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i) =
      C ((Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j))⁻¹ *
        (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i))⁻¹) *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j * (X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i)) by
      rw [C_mul]; ring, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix, functional_X_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul]
  rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
    (hL j.val j.isLt.le)).orthogonal (X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val) (by
      rw [degree_mul, degree_X, degree_eq_natDegree
        (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 + i.val < j.val by omega)), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_pos
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_pos (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix, functional_X_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul]
  have hj := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL j.val j.isLt.le)
  rw [hj.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic
    (monic_X.mul (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val)) (by
      rw [natDegree_X_mul (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
      omega)]
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH _ j.isLt)))
    (inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hH _ i.isLt)))) (hH _ j.isLt)

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_injective
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_injective
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) :
    Function.Injective (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  apply (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).eigenvalues_injective_of_unreduced
  · intro i j hij
    exact orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_eq_zero L hL j i hij
  · intro i j hij
    exact (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_pos L hL hH i j hij).ne'

name: NLAlib.functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    L ((∑ j : Fin n, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) *
      orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) = v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  have hterm (j : Fin n) : L (C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val *
      orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) = v j * (if j = i then 1 else 0) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      functional_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L (hL _ j.isLt.le) (hL _ i.isLt.le)
        (hH _ j.isLt) (hH _ i.isLt)]
    simp only [Fin.val_inj]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simp

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues_eq_zero
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i : Fin n) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval
      ((isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).eigenvalues i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let B := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let hB := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let θ := hB.eigenvalues i
  let v : Fin n → ℝ := hB.eigenvectorBasis i
  let F : ℝ[X] := ∑ j : Fin n, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val
  let s : ℝ[X] := (X - C θ) * F
  have hFpair (j : Fin n) : L (F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = v j :=
    functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L hL hH v j
  have hv : B *ᵥ v = θ • v := hB.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hv0 : v = 0 := by
      ext j
      have hj := hFpair j
      simpa only [hzero, zero_mul, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using hj.symm
    have hnorm := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hB i i
    simp only at hnorm
    change v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 at hnorm
    rw [hv0, zero_dotProduct] at hnorm
    exact zero_ne_one hnorm
  have hFdeg : F.degree < n := by
    apply mem_degreeLT.mp
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply mem_degreeLT.mpr
    exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt (by
      rw [degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH _ j.isLt)]
      exact_mod_cast j.isLt)
  have hSpair (j : Fin n) : L (s * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = 0 := by
    have hXF : L (X * F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = (B *ᵥ v) j := by
      simp only [F, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [show X * (C (v k) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k.val) *
          orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val =
          C (v k) * (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k.val *
            orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    change L (((X - C θ) * F) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = 0
    rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, map_sub, hXF, mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, hFpair, hv, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, sub_self]
  have hSmonic (j : Fin n) : L (s * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j.val) = 0 := by
    rw [← sqrt_norm_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH _ j.isLt),
      show s * (C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j.val)) *
        orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
        C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j.val)) *
          (s * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, hSpair, smul_zero]
  have hSorth (r : ℝ[X]) (hr : r.degree < n) : L (s * r) = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_lt L hr
    rw [← hc, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hSmonic ⟨j, mem_range.mp hj⟩, smul_zero]
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C θ).ne_zero hF0
  have hsd : s.natDegree = n := by
    have hlt : ¬ s.degree < n := fun h => hs0
      (eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero L
        (hL n le_rfl) h hSorth)
    have hge : n ≤ s.natDegree := by
      exact Nat.le_of_not_gt (fun h => hlt ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hs0).mp h))
    have hle : s.natDegree ≤ n := by
      have h := natDegree_mul_le (p := X - C θ) (q := F)
      rw [natDegree_X_sub_C] at h
      have hFn := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hF0).mpr hFdeg
      exact h.trans (by omega)
    exact le_antisymm hle hge
  have hsSpec : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n (s * C s.leadingCoeff⁻¹) := by
    refine ⟨monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hs0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [natDegree_mul_leadingCoeff_inv _ hs0, hsd]
    · intro r hr
      rw [show (s * C s.leadingCoeff⁻¹) * r = C s.leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (s * r) by ring,
        C_mul', map_smul, hSorth _ hr, smul_zero]
  have heq := hsSpec.eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n le_rfl)) (hL n le_rfl)
  rw [← heq]
  change (s * C s.leadingCoeff⁻¹).eval θ = 0
  simp only [s, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_self, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem charpoly_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) :
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n).charpoly = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  let B := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let hB := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero (s := Finset.univ)
    (v := hB.eigenvalues) (eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_injective L hL hH).injOn
  · have hdeg : B.charpoly.degree = (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (charpoly_monic B).ne_zero, charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim,
        Fintype.card_fin]
    have hPdeg : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).degree = (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
      (degree_sub_lt_left (hdeg.trans hPdeg.symm) (charpoly_monic B).ne_zero
        ((charpoly_monic B).leadingCoeff.trans (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).leadingCoeff.symm)).trans_eq hdeg
  · intro i _
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eigenvalues_eq_zero L hL hH i, sub_zero]
    rw [hB.charpoly_eq, eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (mem_univ i)
    simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0)
    (hprev : hankelMomentDet (L x) (n - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n ≠ 0)
    (hhprev : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) (n - 1) ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L y) n)
      (D (orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial (L x) n)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hD hn).fun_div
    (hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hD hprev) hhprev
  have heq : D (orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial (L x) n) =
      (D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n ^ 2) * orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) (n - 1) -
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n * D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) (n - 1) ^ 2)) /
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) (n - 1) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta,
      if_neg hn0.ne', C_mul', map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  rw [heq]
  convert h using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, hn0.ne']

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_mass_of_moment_derivatives
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_mass_of_moment_derivatives
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {x : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => L y 1) (D 1) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hD 0

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_affine
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_affine
    (L D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0)
    (hprev : hankelMomentDet L (n - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0)
    (hhprev : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1) ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L + t • D) n)
      (D (orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial L n)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => (L + t • D) (X ^ k)) 0 := by
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_id.mul contDiffAt_const)
  have hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (L + t • D) (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) 0 := by
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    convert (hasDerivAt_const 0 (L (X ^ k))).fun_add
      ((hasDerivAt_id 0).mul_const (D (X ^ k))) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | simp
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta hn0 hL hD
    (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hn)
    (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hprev)
    (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hh)
    (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hhprev)

name: NLAlib.christoffelPolynomial_eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
statement:
theorem christoffelPolynomial_eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    {z : 𝕜} (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    christoffelPolynomial L z n =
      C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n / (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) *
        monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) z
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0 :=
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero
      (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)
  have h := congrArg
    (fun p : 𝕜[X] => C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n /
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) * p)
    (X_sub_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial n hL z)
  have hc1 : C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n / (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) *
      C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) =
        (1 : 𝕜[X]) := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← C_1]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have hc2 : C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n / (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) *
      C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval z / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) =
        C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval z /
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) := by
    rw [← map_mul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  simp only [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hc1, one_mul, hc2] at h
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero
  rw [X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial L n hz]
  rw [← h]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentMatrix_smul

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_smul
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_smul (c : 𝕜) (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    hankelMomentDet (c • L) n = c^n * hankelMomentDet L n

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_smul
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_smul (c : 𝕜) (hc : c ≠ 0) (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (c • L) n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  have hcn : hankelMomentDet (c • L) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hankelMomentDet_smul]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hc) hn
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hn
  apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (c • L) hcn).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero _ hcn
  refine ⟨hp.monic, hp.natDegree_eq, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hp.orthogonal q hq, mul_zero]
