name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix_ne_zero
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z) (hm : n ≤ m)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L T x z hm).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hd
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hMc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hd
  let P : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (l+n), c (Sum.inr j) • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j.val
  let A : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (m-n), c (Sum.inl j) • X^j.val
  have hP : P.degree < (l+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast j.isLt
  have hA : A.degree < (m-n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast j.isLt
  have hs : (P,A) = ∑ j, c j • rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn L j := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp [P,A,rationalModificationAuxiliaryColumn,Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      auxiliary_fst_sum,auxiliary_snd_sum]
  have hrows (i : Fin (l+m)) : rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow T x z i (P,A) = 0 := by
    rw [hs,map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
    have hi := congrFun hMc ((rationalModificationAuxiliaryRowEquiv hm).symm i)
    simpa only [rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply,Pi.zero_apply,mul_comm] using hi
  have hfull := rationalModificationConstraint_of_auxiliary_rows T x z hx hz hm P A hA hrows
  have hP0 : P = 0 := eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T
    Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero hn
    (by simpa only [Lagrange.natDegree_nodal,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] using hP) hfull
  have hAe (i : Fin m) : A.eval (z i) = 0 := by
    have hi := hrows ⟨l+i.val,by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
    simpa only [rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow,dif_neg (show ¬l+i.val<l by omega),
      Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,LinearMap.add_apply,LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.fst_apply,LinearMap.snd_apply,polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply,
      Polynomial.leval_apply,hP0,mul_zero,map_zero,zero_add] using hi
  have hA0 : A = 0 :=
    Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero Finset.univ hz.injOn
      (by simpa only [card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] using
        hA.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le m n)) (fun i _ => hAe i)
  have hliP := (monicMomentPolynomialSequence L).linearIndependent.comp
    (fun j : Fin (l+n) => j.val) Fin.val_injective
  have hcP := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hliP (fun j => c (Sum.inr j)) hP0
  have hliA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (fun j : Fin (m-n) => (X : 𝕜[X])^j.val) := by
    simpa only [coe_basisMonomials,Function.comp_def,monomial_one_right_eq_X_pow] using
      (Polynomial.basisMonomials 𝕜).linearIndependent.comp
        (fun j : Fin (m-n) => j.val) Fin.val_injective
  have hcA := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hliA (fun j => c (Sum.inl j)) hA0
  exact hc (funext (fun j => Sum.casesOn j hcA hcP))

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ) (hk : k < n) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) k =
      ∫ x, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalPolynomialNorm
  rw [finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply hμ]
  · simp only [eval_pow]
  · rw [degree_pow, degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ k).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * k < 2 * n by omega)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ) (hk : k < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) k =
      (∫ x, x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) /
      (∫ x, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n) k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq hμ hk,
    finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply hμ]
  · simp only [eval_mul, eval_X, eval_pow]
  · rw [degree_mul, degree_X, degree_pow,
      degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ k).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 + 2 * k < 2 * n by omega)

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (fun i : Fin (2 * n) => ∫ x, (p i).eval x ∂μ) =
      fun i : Fin (2 * n) => finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n (p i) := by
    funext i
    symm
    apply finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply hμ
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (hp i).ne_zero, hdeg]
    exact_mod_cast i.isLt
  rw [hm, modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_eq _ p a b n
    (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional hμ hs) hp hdeg hrec]
  congr 2
  rw [eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero (hp 0) (hdeg 0), finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_apply hμ]
  · simp only [eval_one]
  · rw [degree_one]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 * n by have := k.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_formula
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_formula {μ : Measure ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ)
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X]) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    let π
proof:
:= monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n)
    modifiedChebyshevCoefficients a b (fun i : Fin (2 * n) => ∫ x, (p i).eval x ∂μ) k =
      ((∫ x, x * (π k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) / (∫ x, (π k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ),
        if (k : ℕ) = 0 then ∫ _, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ else
          (∫ x, (π k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) / (∫ x, (π (k - 1)).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_eq hμ hs p a b hp hdeg hrec,
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq hμ k.isLt]
  congr 1
  split_ifs with hk0
  · rfl
  · rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hk0,
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq hμ k.isLt,
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_finiteMeasureMomentFunctional_eq hμ (by have := k.isLt; omega)]

name: NLAlib.functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    L ((∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) ^ 2) = c ⬝ᵥ (hankelMomentMatrix L n *ᵥ c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pow_two, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, dotProduct, mulVec,
    hankelMomentMatrix]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [monomial_mul_monomial, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul', map_smul]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  ring_nf

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_hankelMomentMatrix
statement:
theorem isHermitian_hankelMomentMatrix (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix L n).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [hankelMomentMatrix, conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, Nat.add_comm]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_hankelMomentMatrix
statement:
theorem posSemidef_hankelMomentMatrix (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    (isHermitian_hankelMomentMatrix _ _)
  intro c
  rw [star_trivial, ← functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct]
  change 0 ≤ ∫ x, ((∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) ^ 2).eval x ∂μ
  simp only [eval_pow]
  exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_integral_sq_eval_pos
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_integral_sq_eval_pos (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).PosDef ↔
      ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < n → p ≠ 0 → 0 < ∫ x, (p.eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hpos⟩ p hp hp0
    let c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => p.coeff i.val
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hp0
      rw [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp]
      have hc' (i : Fin n) : p.coeff i.val = 0 := congrFun hzero i
      simp only [hc', monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have h := hpos hc
    rw [star_trivial, ← functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct] at h
    change 0 < ∫ x, ((∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) ^ 2).eval x ∂μ at h
    rw [show (∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) = p from
      (eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp).symm] at h
    simpa only [eval_pow] using h
  · intro hpos
    refine ⟨isHermitian_hankelMomentMatrix _ _, ?_⟩
    intro c hc
    rw [star_trivial, ← functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct]
    let p : ℝ[X] := ∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := (sum_monomial_fin_eq_zero_iff c).not.mpr hc
    have hp : p.degree < n := by
      apply mem_degreeLT.mp
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro i _
      apply mem_degreeLT.mpr
      exact (degree_monomial_le _ _).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast i.isLt)
    simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow] using hpos p hp hp0

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_le_support_encard (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).PosDef ↔
      (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard
proof:
:= by
  exact (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_integral_sq_eval_pos μ hμ n).trans
    (integral_sq_eval_pos_iff_le_support_encard μ hμ n)

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_le_support_encard μ hμ n).mpr hn
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _ |>.mp hpos.isUnit)

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_det_pos
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_det_pos (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).PosDef ↔
      0 < hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.det_pos
  · intro h
    exact (posSemidef_hankelMomentMatrix μ hμ n).posDef_iff_det_ne_zero.mpr h.ne'

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_pos_iff_le_support_encard
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_pos_iff_le_support_encard (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n ↔
      (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard
proof:
:=
  (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_det_pos μ hμ n).symm.trans
    (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_le_support_encard μ hμ n)

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_leading_dets_pos
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_leading_dets_pos (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).PosDef ↔
      ∀ k ≤ n, 0 < hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_le_support_encard]
  constructor
  · intro hn k hkn
    exact (hankelMomentDet_pos_iff_le_support_encard μ hμ k).mpr
      ((by exact_mod_cast hkn : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn)
  · intro h
    exact (hankelMomentDet_pos_iff_le_support_encard μ hμ n).mp (h n le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (w p : 𝕜[X]) :
    polynomialWeightedFunctional L w p = L (w * p)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.weighted_lower_nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · exact hr0
  let p := (X - C z) * r
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero hr0
  have hpd : p.degree ≤ n := by
    apply natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mp
    have hdeg := natDegree_mul_le (p := X - C z) (q := r)
    rw [natDegree_X_sub_C] at hdeg
    have hrn := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hr0).mpr hr
    exact hdeg.trans (by omega)
  have heq := eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_degree_le_of_orthogonal L hL hpd
    (fun s hs => by
      change L (((X - C z) * r) * s) = 0
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact ho s hs)
  have h := congrArg (eval z) heq
  simp only [p, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_self, zero_mul] at h
  have hc : p.coeff n = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_right hz
  rw [hc, C_0, zero_mul] at heq
  exact False.elim (hp0 heq)

name: NLAlib.X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial
statement:
theorem X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    (X - C z) * christoffelPolynomial L z n =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) -
        C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval z /
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  let N := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) -
    C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval z /
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  have hNz : N.eval z = 0 := by
    simp only [N, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hz, sub_self]
  have hmod : N %ₘ (X - C z) = 0 := by
    rw [modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval, hNz, C_0]
  have h := modByMonic_add_div N (X - C z)
  rw [hmod, zero_add] at h
  change (X - C z) * (N /ₘ (X - C z)) = N
  exact h

name: NLAlib.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial
statement:
theorem isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n
      (christoffelPolynomial L z n)
proof:
:= by
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
  let c := (P (n + 1)).eval z / (P n).eval z
  let N := P (n + 1) - C c * P n
  have hdeg (k : ℕ) : (P k).degree = k := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hsmall : (C c * P n).degree < (P (n + 1)).degree := by
    rw [hdeg (n + 1), C_mul']
    exact (degree_smul_le c _).trans_lt (by rw [hdeg n]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  have hNmonic : N.Monic := (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).sub_of_left hsmall
  have hNdegree : N.natDegree = n + 1 := by
    have h := degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt hsmall
    exact (natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq h).trans (natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1))
  have hmul := X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial L n hz
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (monic_X_sub_C z).of_mul_monic_left
    rw [hmul]
    exact hNmonic
  · change (N /ₘ (X - C z)).natDegree = n
    rw [natDegree_divByMonic _ (monic_X_sub_C z), hNdegree, natDegree_X_sub_C]
    omega
  · intro r hr
    change L ((X - C z) * (christoffelPolynomial L z n * r)) = 0
    rw [← mul_assoc, hmul, sub_mul, map_sub,
      show (C _ * P n) * r = C c * (P n * r) by
        change (C c * P n) * r = C c * (P n * r)
        exact mul_assoc _ _ _,
      C_mul', map_smul,
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
        (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)).orthogonal r (hr.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)),
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n (by omega))).orthogonal r hr,
      smul_zero, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_ne_zero
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial
  refine ⟨christoffelPolynomial L z n, isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial L n hL hz, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  exact hp.eq_of_nondegenerate (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial L n hL hz)
    (weighted_lower_nondegenerate L (hL n (by omega)) hz)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n =
      christoffelPolynomial L z n
proof:
:=
  (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _
    (hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_ne_zero L n hL hz)).eq_of_nondegenerate
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial L n hL hz)
      (weighted_lower_nondegenerate L (hL n (by omega)) hz)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n =
      -((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval z /
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z) * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n
proof:
:= by
  let P := christoffelPolynomial L z n
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial L n hL hz
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialNorm,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L n hL hz]
  change L ((X - C z) * P ^ 2) = _
  rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial L n hz,
    sub_mul, map_sub]
  have hdeg : P.degree < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hP.monic.ne_zero, hP.natDegree_eq]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n
  rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
    (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)).orthogonal P hdeg]
  rw [mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
      (hL n (by omega))).functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic hP.monic hP.natDegree_eq]
  change 0 - _ * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n = -_ * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n
  ring

name: NLAlib.quasiDefinitePolynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem quasiDefinitePolynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z))
proof:
:=
  fun n => hankelMomentDet_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_ne_zero L n
    (fun k _ => hL k) (hz n)

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevState_correct
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevState_correct (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b m : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1))
    (hm : ∀ l < 2 * n, m l = L (p l)) :
    ∀ k < n,
      (∀ l, k + l < 2 * n →
        (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).row l = orthogonalMixedMoment L p k l) ∧
      (∀ l, k + l < 2 * n →
        (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).prev l =
          if k = 0 then 0 else orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) l) ∧
      (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).alpha = orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k ∧
      (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).beta =
        if k = 0 then L (p 0) else orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      simpa only [modifiedChebyshevState, modifiedChebyshevInit,
        orthogonalMixedMoment_zero] using hm l (by omega)
    · intro l _
      rfl
    · change a 0 + m 1 / m 0 = _
      rw [hm 0 (by omega), hm 1 (by omega)]
      exact (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_zero_eq_modified_moments hL hk
        (eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero (hp 0) (hdeg 0)) (by simpa using hrec 0)).symm
    · change m 0 = L (p 0)
      exact hm 0 (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    obtain ⟨hrow, hprev, halpha, hbeta⟩ := ih (by omega)
    let s := modifiedChebyshevState a b m k
    have hcoef : (if k = 0 then 0 else s.beta) = orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k := by
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · simp [hk0, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta]
      · simp only [s, hbeta, if_neg hk0]
    have hnew : ∀ l, k + 1 + l < 2 * n →
        (modifiedChebyshevStep a b k s).row l = orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k + 1) l := by
      intro l hl
      change s.row (l + 1) + (a l - s.alpha) * s.row l -
        (if k = 0 then 0 else s.beta) * s.prev l +
        (if l = 0 then 0 else b l * s.row (l - 1)) = _
      rw [hcoef]
      change (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).row (l + 1) +
        (a l - (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).alpha) *
        (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).row l -
        orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k * (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).prev l + _ = _
      rw [hrow (l + 1) (by omega), halpha, hrow l (by omega), hprev l (by omega),
        orthogonalMixedMoment_succ L p a b k l
          (fun j hj => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL (by omega)) (hrec l)]
      have hbprev : orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k *
          (if k = 0 then 0 else orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) l) =
          orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k * orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) l := by
        by_cases hk0 : k = 0 <;> simp [hk0, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta]
      rw [hbprev]
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hl0]
      · simp only [if_neg hl0]
        rw [show s.row (l - 1) = orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (l - 1) from hrow _ (by omega)]
    refine ⟨hnew, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      simpa only [modifiedChebyshevState, modifiedChebyshevStep, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false] using hrow l (by omega)
    · change a (k + 1) + (modifiedChebyshevStep a b k s).row (k + 2) /
          (modifiedChebyshevStep a b k s).row (k + 1) - s.row (k + 1) / s.row k = _
      rw [hnew (k + 2) (by omega), hnew (k + 1) (by omega),
        show s.row (k + 1) = _ from hrow (k + 1) (by omega),
        show s.row k = _ from hrow k (by omega)]
      simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
        (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_mixed_ratio hL hk (by omega) hp hdeg (hrec (k + 1))).symm
    · change (modifiedChebyshevStep a b k s).row (k + 1) / s.row k = _
      rw [hnew (k + 1) (by omega), show s.row k = _ from hrow k (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
        (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_mixed_ratio hL hk (by omega) hp hdeg).symm

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevState_diagonal_pos
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevState_diagonal_pos (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b m : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1))
    (hm : ∀ l < 2 * n, m l = L (p l)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) :
    0 < (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).row k
proof:
:= by
  rw [(modifiedChebyshevState_correct L p a b m n hL hp hdeg hrec hm k hk).1 k (by omega)]
  exact orthogonalMixedMoment_diag_pos hL hk (hp k) (hdeg k)

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_eq
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    modifiedChebyshevCoefficients a b (fun i : Fin (2 * n) => L (p i)) k =
      (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k,
        if (k : ℕ) = 0 then L (p 0) else orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := modifiedChebyshevState_correct L p a b
    (fun l => if h : l < 2 * n then L (p (⟨l, h⟩ : Fin (2 * n))) else 0)
    n hL hp hdeg hrec (by intro l hl; simp only [dif_pos hl]) k k.isLt
  exact Prod.ext h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2

name: NLAlib.polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_coe
    (b : Basis (Fin d) 𝕜 (degreeLT 𝕜 d)) (i : Fin d) (p : degreeLT 𝕜 d) :
    polynomialBasisCoordinate b i (p : 𝕜[X]) = b.repr p i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialBasisCoordinate, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    degreeLTProjection_coe, Basis.coord_apply]

name: NLAlib.polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_of_degree_lt
    (b : Basis (Fin d) 𝕜 (degreeLT 𝕜 d)) (i : Fin d) (p : 𝕜[X]) (hp : p.degree < d) :
    polynomialBasisCoordinate b i p = b.repr ⟨p, mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩ i
proof:
:=
  polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_coe b i ⟨p, mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩

name: NLAlib.polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_basis
    (b : Basis (Fin d) 𝕜 (degreeLT 𝕜 d)) (i j : Fin d) :
    polynomialBasisCoordinate b i (b j : 𝕜[X]) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_coe, b.repr_self]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.coordinateMomentFunctional_polynomialBasis_eq_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem coordinateMomentFunctional_polynomialBasis_eq_of_degree_lt
    (b : Basis (Fin d) 𝕜 (degreeLT 𝕜 d)) (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree < d) :
    coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L) p = L p
proof:
:= by
  let p' : degreeLT 𝕜 d := ⟨p, mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩
  have hcoord (i : Fin d) : polynomialBasisCoordinate b i p = b.repr p' i :=
    polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_coe b i p'
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin d, (b.repr p' i) • (b i : 𝕜[X])) = p := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q : degreeLT 𝕜 d => (q : 𝕜[X])) (b.sum_repr p')
    simpa only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, p'] using h
  rw [coordinateMomentFunctional_apply]
  simp only [polynomialBasisMomentVector, hcoord]
  rw [← hsum, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.coordinateMomentFunctional_polynomialBasis_apply_basis
statement:
theorem coordinateMomentFunctional_polynomialBasis_apply_basis
    (b : Basis (Fin d) 𝕜 (degreeLT 𝕜 d)) (m : Fin d → 𝕜) (j : Fin d) :
    coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) m (b j : 𝕜[X]) = m j
proof:
:=
  coordinateMomentFunctional_apply_dual _ _ _ (polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_basis b) j

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) 𝕜 (degreeLT 𝕜 d)) (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hd : 2*n ≤ d) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) n =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  apply monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_moments_eq
  intro k hk
  apply coordinateMomentFunctional_polynomialBasis_eq_of_degree_lt
  rw [degree_X_pow]
  exact_mod_cast hk.trans_le hd

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.eq_of_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.eq_of_nondegenerate
    (hp : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) (hq : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n q)
    (hL : ∀ r : 𝕜[X], r.degree < n →
      (∀ s : 𝕜[X], s.degree < n → L (r * s) = 0) → r = 0) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.monic.ne_zero, hp.natDegree_eq]
  have hqd : q.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hq.monic.ne_zero, hq.natDegree_eq]
  have hdiff : (p - q).degree < n := by
    rw [← hpd]
    apply degree_sub_lt_left (hpd.trans hqd.symm) hp.monic.ne_zero
    exact hp.monic.leadingCoeff.trans hq.monic.leadingCoeff.symm
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hL (p - q) hdiff
  intro s hs
  rw [sub_mul, map_sub, hp.orthogonal _ hs, hq.orthogonal _ hs, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.eq_of_nonzero_sq
statement:
theorem IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.eq_of_nonzero_sq
    (hp : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) (hq : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n q)
    (hL : ∀ r : 𝕜[X], r.degree < n → r ≠ 0 → L (r ^ 2) ≠ 0) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.monic.ne_zero, hp.natDegree_eq]
  have hqd : q.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hq.monic.ne_zero, hq.natDegree_eq]
  have hdiff : (p - q).degree < n := by
    rw [← hpd]
    apply degree_sub_lt_left (hpd.trans hqd.symm) hp.monic.ne_zero
    exact hp.monic.leadingCoeff.trans hq.monic.leadingCoeff.symm
  have hzero : L ((p - q) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    rw [pow_two, sub_mul, map_sub, hp.orthogonal _ hdiff, hq.orthogonal _ hdiff, sub_self]
  by_contra hne
  exact hL (p - q) hdiff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne) hzero

name: NLAlib.divisor_constraints_full
statement:
private theorem divisor_constraints_full
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v * p) = L p) (n : ℕ) (P : 𝕜[X])
    (horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ) → L (P*q) = 0)
    (hsmall : ∀ i : Fin (min n v.natDegree), T (P * X^i.val) = 0) :
    ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < n → T (P*q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T (u := 1) one_ne_zero
    (min n v.natDegree) P).mpr ⟨one_dvd _, hsmall⟩
  have hf := (rationalModificationConstraint_small_iff_full L T (u := 1)
    one_ne_zero hv hTv n P horth).mp hs
  have hm := ((rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T (u := 1) one_ne_zero n P).mp hf).2
  exact fun q hq => functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests T hm hq

name: NLAlib.det_divisorModificationMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_divisorModificationMatrix_ne_zero
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v * p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j < n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    (divisorModificationMatrix L T v n).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hMc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hz
  let P : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (min n v.natDegree), c j •
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val)
  have hindex (j : Fin (min n v.natDegree)) : n-v.natDegree+j.val < n := by
    have := j.isLt; omega
  have hPdeg : P.degree < n := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hindex j
  have horth (q : 𝕜[X]) (hq : q.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ)) : L (P*q) = 0 := by
    simp only [P, sum_mul, map_sum, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ (hindex j))).orthogonal q
      (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (n-v.natDegree) j.val)), smul_zero]
  have hsmall (i : Fin (min n v.natDegree)) : T (P * X^i.val) = 0 := by
    have hi := congrFun hMc i
    dsimp only [P]
    rw [sum_mul, map_sum]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    simpa only [divisorModificationMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Pi.zero_apply, mul_comm] using hi
  have hzero := eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    T hn hPdeg (divisor_constraints_full L T hv hTv n P horth hsmall)
  have hlin := (monicMomentPolynomialSequence L).linearIndependent.comp
    (fun j : Fin (min n v.natDegree) => n-v.natDegree+j.val)
    (fun i j hij => Fin.ext (Nat.add_left_cancel hij))
  exact hc (funext (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hlin c hzero))

name: NLAlib.divisorModificationMatrix_mulVec_coefficients
statement:
theorem divisorModificationMatrix_mulVec_coefficients
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v * p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j < n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    divisorModificationMatrix L T v n *ᵥ divisorModificationCoefficients L T v n =
      -divisorModificationMoments L T v n
proof:
:= by
  have hd := det_divisorModificationMatrix_ne_zero L T hv hTv hL hn
  rw [divisorModificationCoefficients, Matrix.neg_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_neg,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd), Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_divisorModification
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_divisorModification
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v * p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial T n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      ∑ j : Fin (min n v.natDegree), C (divisorModificationCoefficients L T v n j) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - v.natDegree + j.val)
proof:
:= by
  let c := divisorModificationCoefficients L T v n
  let low : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (min n v.natDegree), C (c j) *
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val)
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n + low
  have hindex (j : Fin (min n v.natDegree)) : n-v.natDegree+j.val < n := by
    have := j.isLt; omega
  have hlow : low.degree < n := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hindex j
  have htop : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).degree = (n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).add_of_left
    (hlow.trans_eq htop.symm)
  have hPdeg : P.natDegree = n := by
    dsimp only [P]
    rw [natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt (hlow.trans_eq htop.symm),
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have horth (q : 𝕜[X]) (hq : q.degree < (n-v.natDegree : ℕ)) : L (P*q) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [P, low]
    rw [add_mul, map_add,
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n le_rfl)).orthogonal q
        (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le n v.natDegree))]
    simp only [sum_mul, C_mul', smul_mul_assoc, map_sum, map_smul, zero_add]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ (hindex j).le)).orthogonal q
      (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (n-v.natDegree) j.val)), smul_zero]
  have hsmall (i : Fin (min n v.natDegree)) : T (P*X^i.val) = 0 := by
    have hi := congrFun (divisorModificationMatrix_mulVec_coefficients L T hv hTv
      (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn) i
    dsimp only [P, low]
    simp only [add_mul, map_add, sum_mul, C_mul', smul_mul_assoc, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have he : (∑ j : Fin (min n v.natDegree), c j *
        T (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-v.natDegree+j.val)*X^i.val)) =
        -T (X^i.val*monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n) := by
      simpa only [divisorModificationMatrix, divisorModificationMoments, Matrix.mulVec,
        dotProduct, Pi.neg_apply, c, mul_comm] using hi
    rw [he]
    rw [mul_comm (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n), add_neg_cancel]
  exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial T hn).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    ⟨hPmonic, hPdeg, divisor_constraints_full L T hv hTv n P horth hsmall⟩ hn

name: NLAlib.divisorModificationCoefficients_unique
statement:
theorem divisorModificationCoefficients_unique
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v * p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j < n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0)
    (c : Fin (min n v.natDegree) → 𝕜)
    (hc : divisorModificationMatrix L T v n *ᵥ c = -divisorModificationMoments L T v n) :
    c = divisorModificationCoefficients L T v n
proof:
:= by
  have hd := det_divisorModificationMatrix_ne_zero L T hv hTv hL hn
  have hi := congrArg (fun x => (divisorModificationMatrix L T v n)⁻¹ *ᵥ x)
    (hc.trans (divisorModificationMatrix_mulVec_coefficients L T hv hTv hL hn).symm)
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd),
    Matrix.one_mulVec] using hi

name: NLAlib.secondKindPolynomial_add_two
statement:
theorem secondKindPolynomial_add_two (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    secondKindPolynomial L (n + 2) =
      (X - C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L (n + 1))) * secondKindPolynomial L (n + 1) -
        C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) * secondKindPolynomial L n
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.natDegree_secondKindPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_secondKindPolynomial_le (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    (secondKindPolynomial L n).natDegree ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | more n ih ih1 =>
    rw [secondKindPolynomial_add_two]
    have hleft : ((X - C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L (n + 1))) *
        secondKindPolynomial L (n + 1)).natDegree ≤ n + 1 := by
      apply (natDegree_mul_le).trans
      rw [natDegree_X_sub_C]
      omega
    have hright : (C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) *
        secondKindPolynomial L n).natDegree ≤ n + 1 :=
      (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (ih.trans (by omega))
    exact (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (by simpa using max_le hleft hright)

name: NLAlib.functional_dividedDifference_recurrence
statement:
private theorem functional_dividedDifference_recurrence
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 2, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (z : 𝕜) :
    L ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 2)).dividedDifference z) =
      (z - orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L (n + 1)) *
        L ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).dividedDifference z) -
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1) *
        L ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).dividedDifference z)
proof:
:= by
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)
  let d := p.dividedDifference z
  have hC (c : 𝕜) : L (C c) = c * L 1 := by
    rw [show C c = c • (1 : 𝕜[X]) by rw [← C_mul', mul_one], map_smul]
    rfl
  have hfactor := congrArg L (X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference p z)
  rw [sub_mul, map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, map_sub, hC] at hfactor
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hfactor
  have hzero : L p = 0 := by
    have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL (n + 1) (by omega))
    simpa only [mul_one] using hp.orthogonal 1
      (by rw [degree_one]; exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_succ n))
  rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L (n + 1) hL, sub_mul,
    dividedDifference_sub, dividedDifference_sub, dividedDifference_X_mul,
    dividedDifference_C_mul, dividedDifference_C_mul]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, map_sub, map_add, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hC]
  change L (X * d) + p.eval z * L 1 - orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L (n + 1) * L d -
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1) *
      L ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).dividedDifference z) = _
  rw [hzero] at hfactor
  linear_combination hfactor

name: NLAlib.eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (z : 𝕜) :
    (secondKindPolynomial L n).eval z =
      L ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).dividedDifference z)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one =>
    have hr := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L 0 hL
    simp [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta] at hr
    rw [secondKindPolynomial_one, eval_C, hr, dividedDifference_sub,
      dividedDifference_X, dividedDifference_C]
    simp
  | more n ih ih1 =>
    rw [secondKindPolynomial_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C,
      eval_mul, eval_C, ih1 (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)), ih (fun k hk => hL k (by omega))]
    exact (functional_dividedDifference_recurrence L n hL z).symm

name: NLAlib.eval_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
statement:
theorem eval_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜)
    (hv : ∀ i, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval (v i) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {z : 𝕜} (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0)
    (hzv : ∀ i, z ≠ v i) :
    (secondKindPolynomial L n).eval z / (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z =
      ∑ i, w i / (z - v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference L n hL z,
    hexact _ (degree_dividedDifference_lt hn
      (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]) z), Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [eval_dividedDifference_of_ne _ (fun h => hzv i h.symm), hv i]
  field_simp [hz, sub_ne_zero.mpr (hzv i), sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hzv i h.symm)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.secondKindPolynomial_eq_sum_weight_mul_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem secondKindPolynomial_eq_sum_weight_mul_dividedDifference
    [Infinite 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) :
    secondKindPolynomial L n =
      ∑ i, C (w i) * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).dividedDifference (v i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro z
  rw [eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference L n hL z,
    hexact _ (degree_dividedDifference_lt hn
      (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]) z)]
  simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [eval_dividedDifference_comm]

name: NLAlib.eval_secondKindPolynomial_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_secondKindPolynomial_at_node
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hroot : ∀ i, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval (v i) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) (i : ι) :
    (secondKindPolynomial L n).eval (v i) =
      w i * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval (v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference L n hL (v i),
    hexact _ (degree_dividedDifference_lt hn
      (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]) (v i))]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [eval_dividedDifference_self]
  · intro j _ hji
    rw [eval_dividedDifference_of_ne _ (fun h => hji (hv h)), hroot j, hroot i]
    simp
  · simp

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
    [Infinite 𝕜] {𝕜' : Type*} [Field 𝕜'] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (f : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜') (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜)
    (hv : ∀ i, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval (v i) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {z : 𝕜'} (hz : ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).map f).eval z ≠ 0)
    (hzv : ∀ i, z ≠ f (v i)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial L n).map f).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).map f).eval z =
      ∑ i, f (w i) / (z - f (v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondKindPolynomial_eq_sum_weight_mul_dividedDifference L n hn hL v w hexact,
    Polynomial.map_sum]
  simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h := congrArg (fun p : 𝕜[X] => (p.map f).eval z)
    (X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n) (v i))
  simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C,
    eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, hv i, map_zero, sub_zero] at h
  have hdd : (((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).dividedDifference (v i)).map f).eval z =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).map f).eval z / (z - f (v i)) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hzv i))).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  rw [hdd]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_lt {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree < n) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → 𝕜, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, c j • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) = p
proof:
:= by
  let S := monicMomentPolynomialSequence L
  have hCoeff : ∀ i < n, IsUnit (S i).leadingCoeff := by
    intro i _
    rw [show S i = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i from rfl,
      (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i).leadingCoeff]
    exact isUnit_one
  have hmem : p ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT 𝕜 n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp
  rw [← S.span_degreeLT hCoeff] at hmem
  have hset : Set.Iio n = (Finset.range n : Set ℕ) := by ext i; simp
  rw [hset] at hmem
  exact (Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun' 𝕜).mp hmem

name: NLAlib.exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_le {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → 𝕜, (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), c j • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) = p
proof:
:= by
  let S := monicMomentPolynomialSequence L
  have hCoeff : ∀ i ≤ n, IsUnit (S i).leadingCoeff := by
    intro i _
    rw [show S i = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i from rfl,
      (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i).leadingCoeff]
    exact isUnit_one
  have hmem : p ∈ Polynomial.degreeLE 𝕜 n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLE.mpr hp
  rw [← S.span_degreeLE hCoeff] at hmem
  have hset : Set.Iic n = (Finset.range (n + 1) : Set ℕ) := by ext i; simp
  rw [hset] at hmem
  exact (Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun' 𝕜).mp hmem

      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
proof:
:= by
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  change 0 < ∫ x, (p ^ 2).eval x ∂μ
  simp only [eval_pow]
  apply integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ n).ne_zero
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  · exact hμ.integrable_sq p

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : (i : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    polynomialIntegral μ hμ (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) i *
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij | hij
  · rw [mul_comm]
    apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ hj).orthogonal
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ i).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hij
  · apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ hi).orthogonal
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial _ j).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hij

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_nodal_support
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_nodal_support (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (hs : μ.support.Finite) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) hs.toFinset.card =
      Lagrange.nodal hs.toFinset id
proof:
:= by
  let n := hs.toFinset.card
  have hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := by rw [hs.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card]
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ hn
  have hq : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
      (Lagrange.nodal hs.toFinset id) := by
    refine ⟨Lagrange.nodal_monic, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, ?_⟩
    intro q _
    change (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal hs.toFinset id * q).eval x ∂μ) = 0
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
    have hz : (Lagrange.nodal hs.toFinset id).eval x = 0 := by
      simpa only [id_eq] using Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node
        (s := hs.toFinset) (v := id) (i := x)
        (by simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hx)
    simp only [eval_mul, hz, zero_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
  exact hp.eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero hq
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ hn)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_zero_of_finite_support
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_zero_of_finite_support (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (hs : μ.support.Finite) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) hs.toFinset.card = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalPolynomialNorm
  rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_nodal_support μ hμ hs]
  change (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal hs.toFinset id ^ 2).eval x ∂μ) = 0
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
  have hz : (Lagrange.nodal hs.toFinset id).eval x = 0 := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node
      (s := hs.toFinset) (v := id) (i := x)
      (by simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hx)
  simp only [eval_pow, hz, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply]

    finiteMomentFunctional (fun i : Fin d => L (X ^ i.val)) p = L p

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients_eq_of_moments_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients_eq_of_moments_eq
    {L M : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ k < 2 * n, L (X ^ k) = M (X ^ k)) :
    orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n = orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients M n
proof:
:= by
  have hH : hankelMomentMatrix L n = hankelMomentMatrix M n := by
    ext i j
    apply h
    have := i.isLt
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  have hv : (fun i : Fin n => -L (X ^ (n + i.val))) =
      fun i : Fin n => -M (X ^ (n + i.val)) := by
    funext i
    rw [h (n + i.val) (by have := i.isLt; omega)]
  simp only [orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients, hH, hv]

    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial M n
proof:

  simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial, orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart,
