name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt {p : E → 𝕜[X]} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : ∀ y, (p y).degree < d)
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (p y).coeff i.val) x)
    (hL : ∀ i : Fin d, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (X ^ i.val)) x) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (p y)) x
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun y => L y (p y)) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin d, (p y).coeff i.val * L y (X ^ i.val) := by
    funext y
    nth_rw 1 [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt (hp y)]
    simp only [map_sum, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [heq]
  exact ContDiffAt.sum (fun i _ => (hc i).mul (hL i))

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) (i : Fin n) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients (L y) n i) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro j _
  apply ContDiffAt.mul
  · exact ContDiffAt.matrix_inv_apply (A := fun y => hankelMomentMatrix (L y) n)
      (fun k l => hL (k.val + l.val)) hn i j
  · exact (hL (n + j.val)).neg

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).coeff k) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial, orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart,
    coeff_add, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial]
  apply ContDiffAt.add contDiffAt_const
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · exact contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients hL hn i
  · exact contDiffAt_const

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L y) n) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalPolynomialNorm
  apply contDiffAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt (d := 2 * n + 1)
  · intro y
    rw [degree_pow, degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_self (2 * n))
  · intro i
    simp only [pow_two]
    exact contDiffAt_coeff_mul (contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn)
      (contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn) i.val
  · exact fun i => hL i.val

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (L y) n) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
  apply ContDiffAt.div _ (contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hn) hh
  apply contDiffAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt (d := 2 * n + 2)
  · intro y
    rw [degree_mul, degree_X, degree_pow,
      degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 + 2 * n < 2 * n + 2 by omega)
  · intro i
    apply contDiffAt_coeff_mul (fun _ => contDiffAt_const)
    intro k
    simp only [pow_two]
    exact contDiffAt_coeff_mul (contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn)
      (contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn) k
  · exact fun i => hL i.val

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0)
    (hprev : hankelMomentDet (L x) (n - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) (n - 1) ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L y) n) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
  split_ifs
  · exact contDiffAt_const
  · exact (contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hn).div
      (contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hprev) hh

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem continuousAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] {a : T}
    {L : T → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {p : T → ℝ[X]} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : ∀ y, (p y).degree < d)
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d, ContinuousAt (fun y => (p y).coeff i.val) a)
    (hL : ∀ i : Fin d, ContinuousAt (fun y => L y (X ^ i.val)) a) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => L y (p y)) a
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun y => L y (p y)) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin d, (p y).coeff i.val * L y (X ^ i.val) := by
    funext y
    nth_rw 1 [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt (hp y)]
    simp only [map_sum, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [heq]
  exact tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hc i).mul (hL i))

name: NLAlib.root_border_det_eq
statement:
private theorem root_border_det_eq (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hd : (rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n).det ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix L T x z n).det =
      C (rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n).det *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) -
          ∑ j : Fin (l+m),
            C (((rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n)⁻¹ *ᵥ
              rationalModificationRootLeadingConstraints L T x z n) j) *
                monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+j.val))
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n
  have hu : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd
  let : Invertible (M.map C) :=
    { invOf := (M⁻¹).map C
      invOf_mul_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.nonsing_inv_mul hu]; simp
      mul_invOf_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.mul_nonsing_inv hu]; simp }
  rw [rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix, det_fromBlocks₁₁,
    det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
  rw [show (M.map C).det = C M.det from (RingHom.map_det C M).symm]
  congr 1
  change monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) -
      ∑ j : Fin (l+m), (∑ i : Fin (l+m),
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+i.val) * C (M⁻¹ i j)) *
          C (rationalModificationRootLeadingConstraints L T x z n j) =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) -
        ∑ i : Fin (l+m), C (∑ j : Fin (l+m), M⁻¹ i j *
          rationalModificationRootLeadingConstraints L T x z n j) *
            monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+i.val)
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, sum_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ l+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix L T x z n).det =
      C (rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n).det * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n
  let b := rationalModificationRootLeadingConstraints L T x z n
  let c := M⁻¹ *ᵥ b
  let low : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (l+m), C (c j) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+j.val)
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n) - low
  let u := Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x
  let π := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n
  have hd := det_rationalModificationRootMatrix_ne_zero L T x z hx hz hTv hm
    (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn
  have hMc : M *ᵥ c = b := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd), one_mulVec]
  have hindex (j : Fin (l+m)) : n-m+j.val < l+n := by have := j.isLt; omega
  have hlow : low.degree < (l+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hindex j
  have htop : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (l+n)).degree = (l+n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).sub_of_left (hlow.trans_eq htop.symm)
  have hPdeg : P.degree = (l+n : ℕ) :=
    (degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (hlow.trans_eq htop.symm)).trans htop
  have hrows (i : Fin (l+m)) : rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i P = 0 := by
    have hi := congrFun hMc i
    dsimp only [P, low]
    rw [map_sub, map_sum]
    simp only [C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have he : (∑ j : Fin (l+m), c j * rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+j.val))) = b i := by
      simpa only [M, rationalModificationRootMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using hi
    rw [he]
    simp only [b, rationalModificationRootLeadingConstraints, sub_self]
  have horth (q : 𝕜[X]) (hq : q.degree < (n-m : ℕ)) : L (P*q) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [P, low]
    rw [sub_mul, map_sub,
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ le_rfl)).orthogonal q
        (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n-m ≤ l+n by omega)))]
    simp only [sum_mul, C_mul', smul_mul_assoc, map_sum, map_smul]
    rw [sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by
      rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ (hindex j).le)).orthogonal q
        (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (n-m) j.val)), smul_zero])]
    simp
  have hfull := rationalModificationConstraint_full_of_root_rows L T x z hx hz hTv horth hrows
  have hπ := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn
  have hπm : π.Monic := hπ.monic
  have hu : u.Monic := Lagrange.nodal_monic
  have hUdeg : (u*π).degree = (l+n : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_eq_natDegree hu.ne_zero, degree_eq_natDegree hπ.monic.ne_zero,
      hπ.natDegree_eq]
    simp only [u, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_add]
  have hdiff : (P-u*π).degree < (l+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sub_lt_left (hPdeg.trans hUdeg.symm) hPmonic.ne_zero ?_).trans_eq hPdeg
    simp only [hPmonic.leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_mul, hu.leadingCoeff, hπm.leadingCoeff, mul_one]
  have hπrows : ∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (u*π) = 0 := by
    apply (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T hu.ne_zero n _).mpr
    refine ⟨dvd_mul_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro r
    simpa only [π, polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_assoc] using
      functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_X_pow_eq_zero (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) hn r
  have heq : P = u*π := sub_eq_zero.mp
    (eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T hu.ne_zero hn
      (by simpa only [u, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hdiff)
      (by intro i; rw [map_sub, hfull i, hπrows i, sub_self]))
  rw [root_border_det_eq L T x z n hd]
  change C M.det * P = _
  rw [heq]
  exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    {n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ n) :
    (rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L T x z n).det =
      (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(l+m) * (rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix L T x z n).det
proof:
:= by
  let k := l+m
  let B := (rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix L T x z n).submatrix
    finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
  have hlast (j : Fin (k+1)) :
      rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix L T x z n (Sum.inr 0) (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) =
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+j.val) := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp only [finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix,
        fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Fin.val_last, k, show n-m+(l+m)=l+n by omega]
    · simp [rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix]
  have hrow (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (k+1)) :
      rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix L T x z n (Sum.inl i) (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) =
        C (rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+j.val))) := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun t => ?_) j
    · simp only [finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix,
        fromBlocks_apply₁₂, rationalModificationRootLeadingConstraints, Fin.val_last, k,
        show n-m+(l+m)=l+n by omega]
    · simp [rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix, rationalModificationRootMatrix]
  have hrows : rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L T x z n =
      B.submatrix (Fin.last k).cycleRange.symm id := by
    funext i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) i
    · simp only [rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix, Fin.val_zero,
        Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, B, Fin.cycleRange_symm_zero, k, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last]
      exact (hlast j).symm
    · simp only [rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix, Fin.val_succ,
        dif_neg (show t.val+1 ≠ 0 by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, B, Fin.cycleRange_symm_succ,
        Fin.succAbove_last, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castSucc]
      exact (hrow t j).symm
  rw [hrows, Matrix.det_permute, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]
  simp [sign_finRotate, k]

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_eq_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_eq_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ l+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L T x z n).det =
      C ((-1 : 𝕜)^(l+m) * (rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n).det) *
        Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x *
          monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ∧
      (-1 : 𝕜)^(l+m) * (rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_eq L T x z hm,
      det_rationalModificationRootBorderMatrix_eq L T x z hx hz hTv hm hL hn]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
    ring
  · exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))
      (det_rationalModificationRootMatrix_ne_zero L T x z hx hz hTv hm (fun j hj => hL j hj.le) hn)

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div_of_ne_gaussNodes
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div_of_ne_gaussNodes
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin n, z ≠ (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
        ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) / (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  apply eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div Complex.ofRealHom
    (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n hn0
    (fun k hk => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn))
  · intro i
    exact (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact integral_eval_eq_sum_gaussWeights_mul_eval hμ hn0 hn
      (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ 2 * n by omega)))
  · rw [← nodal_gaussNodes_eq_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hμ hn, Lagrange.nodal_eq,
      Polynomial.map_prod, eval_prod]
    apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i _
    simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz i)
  · exact hz

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_resolvent
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_resolvent
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin n, z ≠ (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ : ℝ) *
        (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) -
          (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹
            ⟨0, hn0⟩ ⟨0, hn0⟩
proof:
:= by
  let hJ := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  have hzJ (i : Fin n) : z ≠ Complex.ofRealHom (hJ.eigenvalues i) :=
    hz i
  rw [eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_gaussWeights_div_of_ne_gaussNodes hμ hn0 hn hz,
    inv_smul_one_sub_map_apply_eq_sum hJ Complex.ofRealHom hzJ, mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [gaussWeights_eq_mass_mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero hμ hn0 hn i]
  change _ = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ : ℝ) *
    (Complex.ofRealHom ((hJ.eigenvectorBasis i : Fin n → ℝ) ⟨0, hn0⟩) *
      Complex.ofRealHom ((hJ.eigenvectorBasis i : Fin n → ℝ) ⟨0, hn0⟩) /
        (z - (gaussNodes μ hμ n i : ℂ)))
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe]
  ring

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_resolvent_of_off_Icc
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_resolvent_of_off_Icc
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ : ℝ) *
        (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) -
          (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹
            ⟨0, hn0⟩ ⟨0, hn0⟩
proof:
:=
  eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_resolvent hμ hn0 hn
    (fun i => hz _ (gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i))

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) -
      (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹
        ⟨0, hn0⟩ ⟨0, hn0⟩ =
      jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialIntegral μ hμ))
        (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ fun i => Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) i))
        z n 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiMatrix _ n
    (fun k hk => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn))
    (fun k hk => orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show k + 1 ≤ n by omega) : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hn))]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  exact inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero _ _ m hz

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobiFraction
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobiFraction
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z =
      (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ : ℝ) *
        jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialIntegral μ hμ))
          (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ fun i => Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) i))
          z n 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_resolvent hμ hn0 hn
    (fun i h => hz (by simpa using congrArg Complex.im h)),
    inv_smul_one_sub_map_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero hμ hn0 hn hz]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_mem_Ioo
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let B := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let F : ℝ[X] := ∑ j : Fin n, C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn0
    have hz : n = 0 := by omega
    subst n
    apply hv0
    ext i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ n + 1 by omega) : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n + 1).trans hn)
  have hH (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k :=
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show k + 1 ≤ n + 1 by omega) : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ n + 1).trans hn)
  have hFpair (j : Fin n) : L (F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = v j :=
    functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L hL hH v j
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hv0
    ext j
    have h := hFpair j
    simpa only [hz, zero_mul, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using h.symm
  have hFdeg : F.degree < n := by
    apply mem_degreeLT.mp
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j _
    rw [C_mul']
    apply mem_degreeLT.mpr
    exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt (by
      rw [degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH _ j.isLt)]
      exact_mod_cast j.isLt)
  have hFdeg' : F.degree ≤ (n - 1 : ℕ) := by
    have h := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hF0).mpr hFdeg
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hF0]
    exact_mod_cast (show F.natDegree ≤ n - 1 by omega)
  have hXFpair (j : Fin n) : L (X * F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) = (B *ᵥ v) j := by
    simp only [F, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [show X * (C (v k) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k.val) *
        orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val =
        C (v k) * (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k.val *
          orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have hnorm : L (F ^ 2) = v ⬝ᵥ v := by
    rw [pow_two]
    conv_lhs => rhs; unfold F
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
    simp only [dotProduct]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [show F * (C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
      C (v j) * (F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hFpair]
  have hXnorm : L (X * F ^ 2) = θ * L (F ^ 2) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc]
    conv_lhs => rhs; unfold F
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
    have heq : (∑ j : Fin n, L (X * F * (C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val))) =
        v ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ v) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [show X * F * (C (v j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) =
          C (v j) * (X * F * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) by ring,
          C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hXFpair]
    rw [heq, hv, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two F, hnorm]
  have hnormpos : 0 < L (F ^ 2) := by
    rw [hnorm]
    simpa only [star_trivial] using (dotProduct_star_self_pos_iff (v := v)).mpr hv0
  have hsupport : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 2 ≤ μ.support.encard := by
    have heq : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 2 = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 + 2 = n + 1 by omega)
    rw [heq]
    exact hn
  have ha := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos hμ hsupport hF0 hFdeg' (monic_X_sub_C a).ne_zero
    (by simp) (by
      filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)
  have hb := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos hμ hsupport hF0 hFdeg' (r := C b - X)
    (by
      intro hz
      have h := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.coeff 1) hz
      simp at h) (by
      exact (degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (degree_C_le.trans (by norm_num)) (by simp))) (by
      filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2)
  have haL : 0 < L ((X - C a) * F ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow] using ha
  have hbL : 0 < L ((C b - X) * F ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_pow] using hb
  rw [sub_mul, map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hXnorm] at haL hbL
  exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩

name: NLAlib.gaussNodes_mem_Ioo
proof:
:= by
  let hB := isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  apply eigenvalue_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_mem_Ioo hμ hs hn
    (v := hB.eigenvectorBasis i)
  · intro hzero
    have h := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hB i i
    simp only at h
    rw [hzero, zero_dotProduct] at h
    exact zero_ne_one h
  · exact hB.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i

name: NLAlib.gaussNodes_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
  · have hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc a b := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc hs
    apply hsupport
    apply (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_mem_support_of_encard_eq hμ heq.symm _).mp
    exact (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨(gaussNodes_mem_Ioo hμ hs
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ENat.natCast_add_one_le_iff.mpr hlt) i).1.le,
      (gaussNodes_mem_Ioo hμ hs
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ENat.natCast_add_one_le_iff.mpr hlt) i).2.le⟩

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ}
    {p : ℝ → ℝ[X]} {p' : ℝ[X]} {x : ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : ∀ y, (p y).degree < d) (hp' : p'.degree < d)
    (hc : HasCoeffDerivAt p p' x)
    (hL : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (p y)) (D (p x) + L x p') x
proof:
:= by
  have hpair (M : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (s : ℝ[X]) (hs : s.degree < d) :
      M s = ∑ i : Fin d, s.coeff i.val * M (X ^ i.val) := by
    nth_rw 1 [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hs]
    simp only [map_sum, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have heq : (fun y => L y (p y)) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin d, (p y).coeff i.val * L y (X ^ i.val) := by
    funext y
    exact hpair (L y) (p y) (hp y)
  rw [heq, hpair D (p x) (hp x), hpair (L x) p' hp']
  convert HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin d))) =>
    (hc i.val).mul (hL i.val)) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_finiteMomentFunctional_apply
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_finiteMomentFunctional_apply {d : ℕ} (m v : Fin d → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => finiteMomentFunctional (m + t • v) p)
      (finiteMomentFunctional v p) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteMomentFunctional_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  convert HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin d))) =>
    ((hasDerivAt_const x (m i)).add ((hasDerivAt_id x).mul_const (v i))).mul_const
      (p.coeff i.val)) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_monomial (s a : ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment s (monomial r a) = a * (r ! : ℝ) / s ^ (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [exponentialPolynomialMoment, Polynomial.lsum_apply,
    Polynomial.sum_monomial_index, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc]

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_X_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_X_pow (s : ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment s (X ^ r) = (r ! : ℝ) / s ^ (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [monomial_one_right_eq_X_pow, one_mul] using
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_monomial s 1 r

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_C (s a : ℝ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment s (C a) = a / s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using exponentialPolynomialMoment_monomial s a 0

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_derivative
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_derivative {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment s p.derivative =
      s * exponentialPolynomialMoment s p - p.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add, coeff_add, hp, hq]
    ring
  | monomial n a =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp; field_simp; ring
    | succ n =>
      simp only [Polynomial.derivative_monomial, Nat.add_one_sub_one,
        exponentialPolynomialMoment_monomial, coeff_monomial, Nat.succ_ne_zero,
        if_false, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      field_simp
      ring

name: NLAlib.laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply (p : ℝ[X]) :
    laguerreRodriguesOperator p = p.derivative - p
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.X_pow_dvd_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply, Nat.sub_succ]
    exact (pow_sub_one_dvd_derivative_of_pow_dvd ih).sub
      ((pow_dvd_pow X (Nat.sub_le _ _)).trans ih)

name: NLAlib.coeff_zero_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator
statement:
private theorem coeff_zero_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k] (X ^ n)).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply X_dvd_iff.mp
  simpa only [pow_one] using (pow_dvd_pow X (by omega : 1 ≤ n - k)).trans
    (X_pow_dvd_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator n k)

name: NLAlib.derivative_commute_laguerreRodriguesOperator
statement:
private theorem derivative_commute_laguerreRodriguesOperator :
    Function.Commute (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X]) laguerreRodriguesOperator
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  simp [laguerreRodriguesOperator]

name: NLAlib.iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_zero
statement:
private theorem iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  iterate_map_zero laguerreRodriguesOperator n

name: NLAlib.iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_C
statement:
private theorem iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_C (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] (C a) = C ((-1 : ℝ)^n * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
    simp only [laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply, derivative_C, zero_sub, ← C_neg, pow_succ]
    congr 1
    ring

name: NLAlib.iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_self
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_self (n : ℕ) :
    (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] (laguerrePolynomial n) = C ((-1 : ℝ)^n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerrePolynomial, iterate_derivative_smul]
  rw [(derivative_commute_laguerreRodriguesOperator.iterate_iterate n n) (X ^ n)]
  rw [iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_natCast_mul, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero,
    mul_one, Nat.descFactorial_self, ← C_eq_natCast,
    iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_C, smul_C]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  have hn : (n ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_eq_zero {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n < k) :
    (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k] (laguerrePolynomial n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerrePolynomial, iterate_derivative_smul,
    (derivative_commute_laguerreRodriguesOperator.iterate_iterate k n) (X ^ n)]
  rw [iterate_derivative_eq_zero (by simpa using hnk),
    iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_zero, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreRodriguesOperator_mul
statement:
private theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreRodriguesOperator_mul
    (q p : ℝ[X]) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (laguerreRodriguesOperator q * p) =
      -exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (q * p.derivative) - q.coeff 0 * p.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := exponentialPolynomialMoment_derivative (s := 1) one_ne_zero (q * p)
  rw [derivative_mul, map_add, one_mul, mul_coeff_zero] at h
  rw [laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply, sub_mul, map_sub]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_mul
statement:
private theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_mul
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1
      ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k] (X ^ n) * p) =
      (-1 : ℝ)^k * exponentialPolynomialMoment 1
        (X ^ n * (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k] p)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply',
      exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerreRodriguesOperator_mul,
      coeff_zero_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator (by omega), zero_mul, sub_zero,
      ih (by omega), ← Function.iterate_succ_apply, pow_succ]
    ring

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (laguerrePolynomial n * p) =
      ((-1 : ℝ)^n / (n ! : ℝ)) * exponentialPolynomialMoment 1
        (X ^ n * (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerrePolynomial, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul,
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_mul n n le_rfl]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial
    (i j : ℕ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (laguerrePolynomial i * laguerrePolynomial j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain hij | rfl | hji := lt_trichotomy i j
  · rw [mul_comm, exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul,
      iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_eq_zero hij, mul_zero, map_zero,
      mul_zero, if_neg (by omega)]
  · rw [exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul,
      iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_self,
      show X ^ i * C ((-1 : ℝ)^i) = C ((-1 : ℝ)^i) * X ^ i by ring,
      ← smul_eq_C_mul,
      map_smul, exponentialPolynomialMoment_X_pow]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, one_pow, div_one, ↓reduceIte]
    have hn : (i ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero i
    have hsign : (-1 : ℝ)^i * (-1 : ℝ)^i = 1 := by
      rw [← mul_pow]
      norm_num
    field_simp
    simpa only [pow_two, ↓reduceIte] using hsign
  · rw [exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul,
      iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_eq_zero hji, mul_zero, map_zero,
      mul_zero, if_neg (by omega)]

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment s (laguerrePolynomial n) =
      (s - 1)^n / s^(n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
      exponentialPolynomialMoment s
        ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k] (X ^ n)) =
        (s - 1)^k * exponentialPolynomialMoment s (X ^ n) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply, map_sub,
        exponentialPolynomialMoment_derivative hs,
        coeff_zero_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator (by omega), sub_zero,
        ih (by omega), pow_succ]
      ring
  rw [laguerrePolynomial, map_smul, h n le_rfl, exponentialPolynomialMoment_X_pow]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have hn : (n ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.coeff_laguerrePolynomial_self
statement:
theorem coeff_laguerrePolynomial_self (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerrePolynomial n).coeff n = (-1 : ℝ)^n / (n ! : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.coeff 0)
    (iterate_derivative_laguerrePolynomial_self n)
  simp only [coeff_iterate_derivative, zero_add, Nat.descFactorial_self,
    nsmul_eq_mul, coeff_C, ↓reduceIte] at h
  exact (eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)).mpr (by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h)

name: NLAlib.natDegree_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem natDegree_laguerrePolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerrePolynomial n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  have h (k : ℕ) :
      ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[k] (X ^ n)).natDegree ≤ n := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply]
      exact (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le
        ((natDegree_derivative_le _).trans (Nat.sub_le _ _) |>.trans ih) ih)
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans (h n)
  · apply le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
    rw [coeff_laguerrePolynomial_self]
    exact div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)

name: NLAlib.laguerrePolynomial_ne_zero
statement: theorem laguerrePolynomial_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : laguerrePolynomial n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := coeff_laguerrePolynomial_self n
  rw [h, coeff_zero] at hh
  exact (div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
    (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)) hh.symm

name: NLAlib.degree_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_laguerrePolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerrePolynomial n).degree = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (laguerrePolynomial_ne_zero n), natDegree_laguerrePolynomial]

name: NLAlib.span_laguerrePolynomial_eq_degreeLE
statement:
theorem span_laguerrePolynomial_eq_degreeLE (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => laguerrePolynomial i.val)) =
      degreeLE ℝ n
proof:
:= by
  have hset : Set.range (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => laguerrePolynomial i.val) =
      laguerrePolynomialSequence '' Set.Iic n := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i.val, by simpa using i.isLt, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hset]
  apply Polynomial.Sequence.span_degreeLE
  intro i _
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (laguerrePolynomial_ne_zero i)

name: NLAlib.exists_sum_smul_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
theorem exists_sum_smul_laguerrePolynomial {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    ∃ a : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, p = ∑ i, a i • laguerrePolynomial i.val
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : p ∈ Submodule.span ℝ
      (Set.range (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => laguerrePolynomial i.val)) := by
    rw [span_laguerrePolynomial_eq_degreeLE]
    exact mem_degreeLE.mpr hp
  simpa only [eq_comm] using (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem

name: NLAlib.C_leadingCoeff_mul_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix
statement:
theorem C_leadingCoeff_mul_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    C u.leadingCoeff * (rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n).det =
      C (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det * rationalModificationNumerator T u n
proof:
:= by
  let M := rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n
  have hdet : M.det ≠ 0 := det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero T hu hn
  have hunit : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  let : Invertible (M.map C) :=
    { invOf := (M⁻¹).map C
      invOf_mul_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.nonsing_inv_mul hunit]; simp
      mul_invOf_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, M.mul_nonsing_inv hunit]; simp }
  rw [rationalModificationBorderMatrix, det_fromBlocks₁₁,
    det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
  have hmap : (M.map C).det = C M.det := (RingHom.map_det C M).symm
  rw [hmap, mul_left_comm]
  congr 1
  change C u.leadingCoeff * (X^(u.natDegree+n) - ∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree+n),
      (∑ i : Fin (u.natDegree+n), X^i.val * C (M⁻¹ i j)) *
        C (rationalModificationLeadingConstraints T u n j)) =
    rationalModificationNumerator T u n
  rw [rationalModificationNumerator]
  simp only [sum_mul]
  rw [sum_comm, mul_sub, mul_sum]
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  congr 1
  rw [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, ← sum_neg_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [rationalModificationCoefficients]
  change C u.leadingCoeff * (∑ j : Fin (u.natDegree+n),
      X^i.val * C (M⁻¹ i j) * C (rationalModificationLeadingConstraints T u n j)) =
    -monomial i.val ((M⁻¹ *ᵥ
      (fun j => -u.leadingCoeff * rationalModificationLeadingConstraints T u n j)) i)
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial,
    mul_neg, neg_mul, sum_neg_distrib, neg_neg, map_sum, map_mul, map_neg]
  rw [mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_eq
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n).det =
      ((rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det / u.leadingCoeff) •
        rationalModificationNumerator T u n
proof:
:= by
  have h := C_leadingCoeff_mul_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix T hu hn
  have hlc : u.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu
  have huC : C u.leadingCoeff ≠ (0 : 𝕜[X]) := C_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ huC
  rw [h, smul_eq_C_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hlc]

name: NLAlib.coeff_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_self
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n).det.coeff (u.natDegree + n) =
      (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_eq T hu hn, coeff_smul,
    coeff_rationalModificationNumerator_self, smul_eq_mul,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)]

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_zero_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_zero_apply
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (u.natDegree + n + 1)) :
    rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n 0 j = X ^ j.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix]

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_succ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_succ_apply
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (u.natDegree + n)) (j : Fin (u.natDegree + n + 1)) :
    rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n i.succ j =
      C (rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (X ^ j.val))
proof:
:= by
