name: NLAlib.rationalModificationBorderMatrix_lastRow
statement:
private theorem rationalModificationBorderMatrix_lastRow
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ)
    (j : Fin (u.natDegree + n + 1)) :
    rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n (Sum.inr 0) (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) = X ^ j.val
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simp [rationalModificationBorderMatrix]
  · simp [rationalModificationBorderMatrix]

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationBorderMatrix_constraintRow
statement:
private theorem rationalModificationBorderMatrix_constraintRow
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (u.natDegree + n)) (j : Fin (u.natDegree + n + 1)) :
    rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n (Sum.inl i) (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) =
      C (rationalModificationConstraint T u n i (X ^ j.val))
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simp [rationalModificationBorderMatrix, rationalModificationLeadingConstraints]
  · simp [rationalModificationBorderMatrix, rationalModificationConstraintMatrix]

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_eq
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det =
      (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(u.natDegree + n) * (rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n).det
proof:
:= by
  let B := (rationalModificationBorderMatrix T u n).submatrix
    finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
  have hrows : rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n =
      B.submatrix (Fin.last (u.natDegree+n)).cycleRange.symm id := by
    funext i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · simp only [rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_zero_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        id_eq, B, Fin.cycleRange_symm_zero, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last]
      exact (rationalModificationBorderMatrix_lastRow T u n j).symm
    · simp only [rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_succ_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        id_eq, B, Fin.cycleRange_symm_succ, Fin.succAbove_last,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castSucc]
      exact (rationalModificationBorderMatrix_constraintRow T u n k j).symm
  rw [hrows, Matrix.det_permute, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]
  simp

name: NLAlib.coeff_det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_self
statement:
theorem coeff_det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_self
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det.coeff (u.natDegree + n) =
      (-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree + n) * (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_eq,
    show (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(u.natDegree + n) = C ((-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree + n)) by simp,
    coeff_C_mul, coeff_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_self T hu hn]

name: NLAlib.coeff_det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_self_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_self_ne_zero
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det.coeff (u.natDegree + n) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_self T hu hn]
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))
    (det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero T hu hn)

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationNumerator_eq_smul_det_firstRowMatrix
statement:
theorem rationalModificationNumerator_eq_smul_det_firstRowMatrix
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    rationalModificationNumerator T u n =
      (u.leadingCoeff / (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det.coeff (u.natDegree+n)) •
        (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det
proof:
:= by
  have hlc : u.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu
  have hdet := det_rationalModificationConstraintMatrix_ne_zero T hu hn
  have hsign : (-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+n) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
  symm
  rw [coeff_det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_self T hu hn,
    det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_eq, det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_eq T hu hn,
    show (-1 : 𝕜[X])^(u.natDegree+n) = C ((-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+n)) by simp]
  simp only [smul_eq_C_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  have hscalar : (u.leadingCoeff /
      ((-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+n) * (rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det)) *
      (-1 : 𝕜)^(u.natDegree+n) *
      ((rationalModificationConstraintMatrix T u n).det / u.leadingCoeff) = 1 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hscalar, C_1, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_det_div
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_det_div
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n =
      ((u.leadingCoeff /
        (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det.coeff (u.natDegree+n)) •
          (rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix T u n).det) / u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rationalModificationNumerator_eq_smul_det_firstRowMatrix T hu hn,
    rationalModificationNumerator_eq_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial T hu hn,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hu]

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X
statement:
theorem IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {p : 𝕜[X]}
    (hp : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p)
    (hs : ∀ r : 𝕜[X], L (r.comp (-X)) = L r) :
    IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n ((-1 : 𝕜[X]) ^ n * p.comp (-X))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hp.natDegree_eq] using hp.monic.neg_one_pow_natDegree_mul_comp_neg_X
  · rw [natDegree_mul, natDegree_comp]
    all_goals simp [hp.natDegree_eq, hp.monic.ne_zero]
  · intro r hr
    rw [show (-1 : 𝕜[X]) ^ n = C ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ n) by simp, mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul]
    have hswap : L (p.comp (-X) * r) = L (p * r.comp (-X)) := by
      simpa only [mul_comp, comp_neg_X_comp_neg_X] using hs (p * r.comp (-X))
    rw [hswap, hp.orthogonal _ (by simpa only [degree_comp_neg_X] using hr), smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ r : 𝕜[X], L (r.comp (-X)) = L r) :
    (-1 : 𝕜[X]) ^ n * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).comp (-X) =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hL
  exact (hp.neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X hs).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero hp hL

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_comp_neg_X
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_comp_neg_X {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hs : Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => -x) μ = μ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral μ hμ (p.comp (-X)) = polynomialIntegral μ hμ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X]
  rw [← integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable measurable_neg p.continuous.stronglyMeasurable, hs]

name: NLAlib.neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hs : Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => -x) μ = μ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    (-1 : ℝ[X]) ^ n * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).comp (-X) =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
proof:
:=
  neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ hn)
    (polynomialIntegral_comp_neg_X hμ hs)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_zero_of_comp_neg_X
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_zero_of_comp_neg_X
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ r : ℝ[X], L (r.comp (-X)) = L r) : orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  have hpar := neg_one_pow_mul_comp_neg_X_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n hL hs
  have hsign : ((-1 : ℝ[X]) ^ n) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
    simp
  have hsq : (p.comp (-X)) ^ 2 = p ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun r : ℝ[X] => r ^ 2) hpar
    rw [mul_pow, hsign, one_mul] at h
    exact h
  have h := hs (X * p ^ 2)
  rw [mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, hsq, neg_mul, map_neg] at h
  have hz : L (X * p ^ 2) = 0 := by linarith
  change L (X * p ^ 2) / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n = 0
  rw [hz, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialIntegral_eq_zero
proof:
:=
  orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_zero_of_comp_neg_X _ n
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ hn)
    (polynomialIntegral_comp_neg_X hμ hs)

name: NLAlib.shiftedHankelMomentDet_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedHankelMomentDet_zero (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) :
    shiftedHankelMomentDet L 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_below
proof:
:= by
  unfold monicOrthogonalPolynomial orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart
  rw [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt i.isLt),
    coeff_sum_monomial_fin, zero_add]

name: NLAlib.nextCoeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_neg_shiftedHankelMomentDet_div
statement:
theorem nextCoeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_neg_shiftedHankelMomentDet_div
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).nextCoeff =
      -shiftedHankelMomentDet L n / hankelMomentDet L n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, shiftedHankelMomentDet_zero,
      hankelMomentDet_zero, neg_zero, zero_div]
    simpa only [C_1] using nextCoeff_C_eq_zero (1 : 𝕜)
  | succ n =>
    rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]; omega),
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [show n = (Fin.last n).val by rfl, coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_below,
      orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients]
    simp only [Fin.val_last]
    have h := congrFun (det_smul_inv_mulVec_eq_cramer (hankelMomentMatrix L (n+1))
      (fun i => L (X ^ ((n+1)+i.val))) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)) (Fin.last n)
    change (hankelMomentMatrix L (n+1)).det *
      ((hankelMomentMatrix L (n+1))⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun i => L (X ^ ((n+1)+i.val)))) (Fin.last n) =
      ((hankelMomentMatrix L (n+1)).updateCol (Fin.last n)
        (fun i => L (X ^ ((n+1)+i.val)))).det at h
    rw [show (fun i : Fin (n+1) => -L (X ^ ((n+1)+i.val))) =
      -(fun i : Fin (n+1) => L (X ^ ((n+1)+i.val))) by rfl,
      mulVec_neg, Pi.neg_apply]
    change -_ = -_ / (hankelMomentMatrix L (n+1)).det
    apply (eq_div_iff hn).mpr
    simp only [hankelMomentDet, shiftedHankelMomentDet]
    linear_combination -h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_shiftedHankelMomentDet_sub
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_shiftedHankelMomentDet_sub
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n =
      shiftedHankelMomentDet L (n+1) / hankelMomentDet L (n+1) -
        shiftedHankelMomentDet L n / hankelMomentDet L n
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff L n hL,
    nextCoeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_neg_shiftedHankelMomentDet_div L n
      (hL n (by omega)),
    nextCoeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_neg_shiftedHankelMomentDet_div L (n+1)
      (hL (n+1) le_rfl)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.det_borderedHankelMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_borderedHankelMatrix_eq (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) :
    (borderedHankelMatrix L n).det =
      C (hankelMomentDet L n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  let H := hankelMomentMatrix L n
  have hunit : IsUnit H.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
  let : Invertible (H.map C) :=
    { invOf := (H⁻¹).map C
      invOf_mul_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, H.nonsing_inv_mul hunit]; simp
      mul_invOf_self := by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, H.mul_nonsing_inv hunit]; simp }
  rw [borderedHankelMatrix, det_fromBlocks₁₁, det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
  have hdet : (H.map C).det = C H.det := (RingHom.map_det C H).symm
  rw [hdet]
  congr 1
  change X^n - (∑ j : Fin n,
      (∑ i : Fin n, (X : 𝕜[X])^i.val * C (H⁻¹ i j)) * C (L (X ^ (n+j.val)))) =
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
  rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial, orthogonalPolynomialLowerPart]
  simp only [sum_mul]
  rw [sum_comm]
  have hterms (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j : Fin n, (X : 𝕜[X])^i.val * C (H⁻¹ i j) * C (L (X ^ (n+j.val)))) =
        -monomial i.val (orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n i) := by
    rw [orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients]
    change _ = -monomial i.val ((H⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun j => -L (X ^ (n+j.val)))) i)
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct,
      mul_neg, sum_neg_distrib, monomial_neg, neg_neg]
    rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_comm]
    rw [map_sum, mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
  simp_rw [hterms]
  rw [sum_neg_distrib, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_inv_smul_det_borderedHankelMatrix
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_inv_smul_det_borderedHankelMatrix
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : hankelMomentDet L n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n =
      (hankelMomentDet L n)⁻¹ • (borderedHankelMatrix L n).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_borderedHankelMatrix_eq L n hn, smul_eq_C_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, map_one, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.det_borderedHankelMatrix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem det_borderedHankelMatrix_zero (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) :
    (borderedHankelMatrix L 0).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_borderedHankelMatrix_eq L 0 (by simp), hankelMomentDet_zero,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, map_one, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.smul_dividedFunctional_nodal_mul
statement:
theorem smul_dividedFunctional_nodal_mul
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} {cv : 𝕜} (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hv : v = C cv * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    (cv • T) (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z * p) = L p
proof:
:= by
  have h := hTv p
  rw [hv, mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.polynomialWeightedFunctional_smul_nodal
statement:
theorem polynomialWeightedFunctional_smul_nodal
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} {cu : 𝕜} (hcu : cu ≠ 0)
    (cv : 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (hu : u = C cu * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) :
    polynomialWeightedFunctional (cv • T) (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) =
      (cv/cu) • polynomialWeightedFunctional T u
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  simp only [polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hu, mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} {cu cv : 𝕜}
    (hcu : cu ≠ 0) (hcv : cv ≠ 0) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hu : u = C cu * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)
    (hv : v = C cv * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ l+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    let D
proof:
:= rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L (cv • T) x z n
    let c := (-1 : 𝕜)^(l+m) * (rationalModificationRootMatrix L (cv • T) x z n).det / cu
    D.det = C c * u * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ∧ c ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp only
  have hratio : cv/cu ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hcv hcu
  have he := polynomialWeightedFunctional_smul_nodal T hcu cv x hu
  have hnc : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional (cv • T)
      (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he, hankelMomentDet_smul]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hratio) hn
  have hp : monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (cv • T)
      (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n := by
    rw [he, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_smul _ hratio _ hn]
  have hd := det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_eq_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (cv • T)
    x z hx hz (smul_dividedFunctional_nodal_mul L T z hv hTv) hm hL hnc
  constructor
  · rw [hd.1, hp]
    let a := (-1 : 𝕜)^(l+m) * (rationalModificationRootMatrix L (cv • T) x z n).det
    change C a * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x * _ = C (a/cu) * u * _
    rw [hu, ← mul_assoc (C (a/cu)) (C cu) (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x),
      ← map_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hcu]
  · exact div_ne_zero hd.2 hcu

name: NLAlib.sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentCoordinates_eq
statement:
theorem sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentCoordinates_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < n) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, C (orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p i) *
      orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_lt L hp
  let v : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => c i.val * Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val)
  have hv : (∑ i : Fin n, C (v i) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) = p := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n, c i.val • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        dsimp only [v]
        rw [C_mul, mul_assoc, sqrt_norm_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH i.val i.isLt), C_mul']
      _ = p := by
        exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ => c j • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j) n).trans hc
  have hcoord (i : Fin n) : orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p i = v i := by
    rw [orthonormalMomentCoordinates, ← hv]
    exact functional_sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L hL hH v i
  simp only [hcoord]
  exact hv

name: NLAlib.jacobi_mulVec_orthonormalMomentCoordinates
statement:
theorem jacobi_mulVec_orthonormalMomentCoordinates (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < n) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n *ᵥ orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p =
      orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n (X * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentCoordinates_eq L hL hH hp
  ext i
  change (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n *ᵥ orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p) i =
    L ((X * p) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val)
  conv_rhs => rw [← hrec]
  simp only [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    mul_sum, sum_mul, map_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [show X * (C (orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p j) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val) *
      orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val =
      C (orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p j) *
        (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) by ring,
    C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.functional_mul_eq_dotProduct_orthonormalMomentCoordinates
statement:
theorem functional_mul_eq_dotProduct_orthonormalMomentCoordinates (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < n) (r : ℝ[X]) :
    L (p * r) = orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n p ⬝ᵥ orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n r
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := sum_C_mul_orthonormalMomentCoordinates_eq L hL hH hp
  conv_lhs => rw [← hrec]
  simp only [sum_mul, map_sum, dotProduct, orthonormalMomentCoordinates]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val) r]

name: NLAlib.pow_jacobi_mulVec_single_eq_orthonormalMomentCoordinates
statement:
theorem pow_jacobi_mulVec_single_eq_orthonormalMomentCoordinates
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n ^ k) *ᵥ Pi.single ⟨0, hn⟩ 1 =
      orthonormalMomentCoordinates L n (X ^ k * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    ext i
    simp only [orthonormalMomentCoordinates,
      functional_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L (hL 0 (by omega)) (hL i.val i.isLt.le)
        (hH 0 hn) (hH i.val i.isLt), Pi.single_apply]
    congr 1
    exact propext ⟨fun h => (congrArg Fin.val h).symm, fun h => Fin.ext h.symm⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    have hd : (X ^ k * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0).degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_mul, degree_X_pow, degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH 0 hn)]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
      exact_mod_cast (show k < n by omega)
    rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih (by omega),
      jacobi_mulVec_orthonormalMomentCoordinates L hL hH hd]
    congr 1
    rw [pow_succ']
    ring

name: NLAlib.functional_X_pow_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_pow_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem functional_X_pow_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_pow_apply_zero_zero
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 * n) :
    L (X ^ k) = L 1 * (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  let J := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n
  let e : Fin n → ℝ := Pi.single ⟨0, hn⟩ 1
  let i := k / 2
  let j := k - i
  have hi : i < n := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hj : j ≤ n := by dsimp [j, i]; omega
  have hij : i + j = k := by dsimp [i, j]; omega
  have hsym : Jᵀ = J := (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp
    (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n)).eq
  have hpow : e ⬝ᵥ ((J ^ k) *ᵥ e) = ((J ^ i) *ᵥ e) ⬝ᵥ ((J ^ j) *ᵥ e) := by
    rw [← hij, pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec,
      ← show (J ^ i)ᵀ = J ^ i by rw [transpose_pow, hsym], vecMul_transpose]
    rw [transpose_pow, hsym]
  have hPi : (X ^ i * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0).degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_X_pow, degree_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (hH 0 hn)]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hi
  have hpair := functional_mul_eq_dotProduct_orthonormalMomentCoordinates L hL hH hPi
    (X ^ j * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0)
  rw [← pow_jacobi_mulVec_single_eq_orthonormalMomentCoordinates L hn hL hH i hi.le,
    ← pow_jacobi_mulVec_single_eq_orthonormalMomentCoordinates L hn hL hH j hj, ← hpow] at hpair
  have heval : e ⬝ᵥ ((J ^ k) *ᵥ e) = (J ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩ := by
    rw [dotProduct_comm, dotProduct_single_one, Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
    rfl
  rw [heval] at hpair
  have hH0 : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0 = L 1 := by simp [orthogonalPolynomialNorm]
  have hcancel : L 1 * (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0))⁻¹ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hH 0 hn).le, ← hH0, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hH 0 hn).ne']
  have hp0 : orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0 = C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0))⁻¹ := by
    simp [orthonormalMomentPolynomial]
  have hprod : (X ^ i * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0) *
      (X ^ j * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L 0) =
        C ((Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0))⁻¹ ^ 2) * X ^ k := by
    rw [hp0, ← hij, pow_add, C_pow]
    ring
  rw [hprod, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hpair
  change L (X ^ k) = L 1 * (J ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
  rw [← hpair, ← mul_assoc, hcancel, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.functional_eq_mass_mul_aeval_jacobi_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem functional_eq_mass_mul_aeval_jacobi_apply_zero_zero
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ)) :
    L p = L 1 * (aeval (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n) p) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  have heq := eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp
  rw [heq, map_sum, map_sum]
  simp only [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    map_pow, aeval_X]
  rw [Matrix.sum_apply, mul_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [functional_X_pow_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_pow_apply_zero_zero L hn hL hH j.isLt]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem integral_pow_eq_mass_mul_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_pow
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 * n) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, x ^ k ∂μ) = (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) *
      (orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n ^ k) ⟨0, hn⟩ ⟨0, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := functional_X_pow_eq_mass_mul_jacobi_pow_apply_zero_zero (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) hn
    (fun j hj => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hs))
    (fun j hj => orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj : (j + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ n).trans hs)) hk
  simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_one] using h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_weightedDivided_eq_sub_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_weightedDivided_eq_sub_nextCoeff
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) n).nextCoeff -
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) (n+1)).nextCoeff
proof:
:=
  orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff _ _ hn

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_weightedDivided_eq_integral_ratio
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_weightedDivided_eq_integral_ratio
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v) (n : ℕ) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n+1) =
      (∫ x, u.eval x * ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n+1)).eval x)^2/v.eval x ∂μ) /
        (∫ x, u.eval x * ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x)^2/v.eval x ∂μ) := by
  simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false,
    if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel, orthogonalPolynomialNorm,
    polynomialWeightedFunctional_dividedPolynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow]

name: NLAlib.moments_eq_zero_of_rootCofactor_eq_low_polynomial
statement:
theorem moments_eq_zero_of_rootCofactor_eq_low_polynomial
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hm : n ≤ m) (P a : 𝕜[X]) (ha : a.degree < (m-n : ℕ))
    (hc : ∀ i, T (P*rootCofactor z i) = a.eval (z i)) :
    ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < n → T (P*q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hqm : q.degree < m := hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)
  have hprod : (a*q).degree < (m-1 : ℕ) := by
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · simp [ha0]
    by_cases hq0 : q = 0
    · simp [hq0]
    have ha' : a.natDegree < m-n := by
      exact_mod_cast (show (a.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) < (m-n : ℕ) by
        simpa only [degree_eq_natDegree ha0] using ha)
    have hq' : q.natDegree < n := by
      exact_mod_cast (show (q.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) < (n : ℕ) by
        simpa only [degree_eq_natDegree hq0] using hq)
    rw [degree_mul, degree_eq_natDegree ha0, degree_eq_natDegree hq0, ← Nat.cast_add]
    exact_mod_cast (show a.natDegree+q.natDegree < m-1 by omega)
  have hprod' : (a*q).degree < m := hprod.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le m 1)
  have hi := Lagrange.coeff_eq_sum (s := Finset.univ) hz.injOn
    (by simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hprod')
  simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hi
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin m, (a.eval (z i)*q.eval (z i))/(rootCofactor z i).eval (z i) = 0 := by
    rw [show (a*q).coeff (m-1) = 0 from coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hprod] at hi
    simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, eval_mul, rootCofactor, eval_prod,
      eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using hi.symm
  rw [eq_sum_C_mul_rootCofactor z hz hqm, mul_sum, map_sum]
  have hpull (i : Fin m) :
      T (P*(C (q.eval (z i)/(rootCofactor z i).eval (z i))*rootCofactor z i)) =
        (q.eval (z i)/(rootCofactor z i).eval (z i))*a.eval (z i) := by
    rw [show P*(C (q.eval (z i)/(rootCofactor z i).eval (z i))*rootCofactor z i) =
        C (q.eval (z i)/(rootCofactor z i).eval (z i))*(P*rootCofactor z i) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, hc, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [hpull]
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hsum

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_of_auxiliary_rows
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraint_of_auxiliary_rows
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z) (hm : n ≤ m)
    (P a : 𝕜[X]) (ha : a.degree < (m-n : ℕ))
    (hr : ∀ i, rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow T x z i (P,a) = 0) :
    ∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) n i P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have heval (i : Fin l) : P.eval (x i) = 0 := by
    simpa only [rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow, dif_pos i.isLt,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply, Polynomial.leval_apply]
      using hr ⟨i.val,by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
  have hc (i : Fin m) : T (P*rootCofactor z i) = (-a).eval (z i) := by
    have hi := hr ⟨l+i.val,by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
    simp only [rationalModificationAuxiliaryRow, dif_neg (show ¬l+i.val<l by omega),
      Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply, Polynomial.leval_apply,
      polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_comm] at hi
    simpa only [eval_neg] using eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hi
  have hmoment := moments_eq_zero_of_rootCofactor_eq_low_polynomial T z hz hm P (-a)
    (by simpa only [degree_neg] using ha) hc
  apply (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero n P).mpr
  exact ⟨(nodal_dvd_iff_forall_eval_eq_zero x hx P).mpr heval,
    fun i => hmoment (X^i.val) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast i.isLt)⟩

name: NLAlib.smul_complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_rootCofactor_eq_cauchy
statement:
theorem smul_complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_rootCofactor_eq_cauchy
    {μ : Measure ℝ} {m : ℕ} {v : ℂ[X]} {cv : ℂ} (hcv : cv ≠ 0)
    (z : Fin m → ℂ) (hv : v = C cv * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    (hdiv : HasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hv0 : ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂μ, v.eval (t : ℂ) ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) (i : Fin m) :
    (cv • complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) (p*rootCofactor z i) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, p.eval (t : ℂ)/((t : ℂ)-z i) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_apply,
    ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hv0] with t ht
  have hnodes (j : Fin m) : (t : ℂ) ≠ z j := by
    intro he
    apply ht
    rw [he,hv,eval_mul,Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ j),mul_zero]
  have hc : (rootCofactor z i).eval (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [rootCofactor,eval_prod,eval_sub,eval_X,eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hnodes j))
  have he : v.eval (t : ℂ) = cv*(((t : ℂ)-z i)*(rootCofactor z i).eval (t : ℂ)) := by
    rw [hv,eval_mul,eval_C,Lagrange.nodal_eq_mul_nodal_erase (mem_univ i),
      eval_mul,eval_sub,eval_X,eval_C]
    rfl
  rw [eval_mul,he]
  field_simp [hcv,hc,sub_ne_zero.mpr (hnodes i)]

name: NLAlib.support_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous μ _).support_mono
  · apply (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous' (by fun_prop) ?_).support_mono
    filter_upwards [hpos] with x hx
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hx).ne'

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_ne_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < u.eval x/v.eval x) {n : ℕ}
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hdiv
        (hpos.mono fun _ h => h.le))) n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
  rw [support_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq hpos]
  exact hs

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq_det_div
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq_det_div
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv0 : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, v.eval x ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < u.eval x/v.eval x) {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    let hdiv := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
    let hpa : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x := hs.mono fun x hx => (hpos x hx).le
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hdiv hpa
    let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let T := dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv
    let D := rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n =
      ((u.leadingCoeff / D.det.coeff (u.natDegree+n)) • D.det) / u ∧
      D.det.coeff (u.natDegree+n) ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
  let hdiv := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
  let hpa : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x := hs.mono fun x hx => (hpos x hx).le
  have hps : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < u.eval x/v.eval x := hs.mono hpos
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let T := dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv
  have hTv (p : ℝ[X]) : T (v*p) = L p :=
    dividedPolynomialIntegral_denominator_mul hμ v hdiv (hs.mono hv0) p
  have hL (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ u.natDegree+n) : hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ u.natDegree+n).trans hcard)
  have heq := polynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq μ u v hdiv hpa
  have hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact hankelMomentDet_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_ne_zero u v hdiv hps
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ u.natDegree+n by omega) : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ u.natDegree+n).trans hcard)
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_small_det_div L T hu hv hTv hL hn,
    coeff_det_rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix_self_ne_zero L T hu hv hTv hL hn⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_det_auxiliaryFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
statement:
theorem exists_det_auxiliaryFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, t ∈ Icc a b) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, v.eval t ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, 0 < u.eval t/v.eval t)
    (x : Fin u.natDegree → ℂ) (z : Fin v.natDegree → ℂ)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hux : u.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (u.leadingCoeff : ℂ)*Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)
    (hvz : v.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (v.leadingCoeff : ℂ)*Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    {n : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ v.natDegree)
    (hcard : ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    let hr := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
    let hc := hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
      (v := v.map Complex.ofRealHom) (by
        intro t ht
        change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
        rw [eval_map_apply]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht))
    let hpa : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono fun t ht => (hpos t ht).le
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpa
    let L := complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let T := complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc
    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix L ((v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) • T) x z hm).det =
        C c * u.map Complex.ofRealHom *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n).map
            Complex.ofRealHom ∧
      ∀ (p : ℂ[X]) (i : Fin v.natDegree),
        ((v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) • T) (p*rootCofactor z i) =
          ∫ t : ℝ, p.eval (t : ℂ)/((t : ℂ)-z i) ∂μ := by
  dsimp only
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
  let hr := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
  let hc := hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    (v := v.map Complex.ofRealHom) (by
      intro t ht
      change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
      rw [eval_map_apply]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht))
  let hpa : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono fun t ht => (hpos t ht).le
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpa
  let L := complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let T := complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc
  have hcu : (u.leadingCoeff : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)
  have hcv : (v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hv)
  have hps : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 < u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono hpos
  have hsn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard :=
    ((by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ u.natDegree+n by omega) : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ u.natDegree+n).trans hcard)
  have heq : complexPolynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν =
      polynomialWeightedFunctional T (u.map Complex.ofRealHom) :=
    complexPolynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq u v hr hc hpa
  have hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (u.map Complex.ofRealHom)) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← heq]
    apply hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral_ne_zero hν
    rw [support_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq hps]
    exact hsn
  have hnr : hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_ne_zero u v hr hps hsn
  have hp : monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (u.map Complex.ofRealHom)) n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n).map
        Complex.ofRealHom := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact monicOrthogonalPolynomial_complexPolynomialIntegral_eq_map hν hnr
  have hd := det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic L T hcu hcv x z hx hz hux hm hn
  dsimp only at hd
  refine ⟨_,hd.2,hd.1.trans (by rw [hp]),?_⟩
  intro p i
  apply smul_complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_rootCofactor_eq_cauchy hcv z hvz hc _ p i
  filter_upwards [hs] with t ht
  change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
  rw [eval_map_apply]
  exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht)

name: NLAlib.monicLaguerrePolynomial_eq_rodrigues
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicLaguerrePolynomial, laguerrePolynomial, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hn : (n ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_mul
statement:
private theorem laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_mul (p : ℝ[X]) :
    laguerreRodriguesOperator (X * p) = X * laguerreRodriguesOperator p + p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply, derivative_mul, derivative_X, one_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_succ_X_mul
statement:
private theorem iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_succ_X_mul (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1] (X * p) =
      X * (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1] p +
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) •
          (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_mul p
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_add, map_smul,
      laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_mul]
    rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' (f :=
      (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])) n p]
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply' (f :=
      (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])) (n + 1) p]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
      smul_eq_C_mul, map_add, C_1]
    ring

name: NLAlib.iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_smul
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_smul,
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: NLAlib.derivative_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ
statement:
private theorem derivative_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ (n : ℕ) :
    derivative ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1]
      (X ^ (n + 1))) =
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) •
          (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1] (X ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(derivative_commute_laguerreRodriguesOperator.iterate_right (n + 1))
    (X ^ (n + 1)), derivative_X_pow_succ, ← smul_eq_C_mul]
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
    iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_smul (n + 1) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (X ^ n)

name: NLAlib.X_mul_derivative_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ
statement:
private theorem X_mul_derivative_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ
    (n : ℕ) :
    X * derivative ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1]
      (X ^ (n + 1))) =
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) •
          (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1] (X ^ (n + 1)) -
        (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2) •
          (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] (X ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_succ_X_mul n (X ^ n)
  rw [← pow_succ'] at h
  rw [derivative_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ]
  rw [smul_eq_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul]
  rw [h]
  simp only [smul_eq_C_mul, map_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ
statement:
private theorem iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n + 1] (X ^ (n + 1)) =
      (C ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - X) *
        (laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] (X ^ n) +
      X * derivative ((laguerreRodriguesOperator : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] (X ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ', iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_succ_X_mul,
    Function.iterate_succ_apply', laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply,
    smul_eq_C_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.monicLaguerrePolynomial_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem monicLaguerrePolynomial_zero : monicLaguerrePolynomial 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [monicLaguerrePolynomial_eq_rodrigues]

name: NLAlib.coeff_monicLaguerrePolynomial_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_monicLaguerrePolynomial_self (n : ℕ) :
    (monicLaguerrePolynomial n).coeff n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicLaguerrePolynomial, coeff_smul, coeff_laguerrePolynomial_self,
    smul_eq_mul]
  have hn : (n ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  have hsign : (-1 : ℝ)^n * (-1 : ℝ)^n = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  field_simp
  simpa only [pow_two] using hsign

name: NLAlib.natDegree_monicLaguerrePolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem natDegree_monicLaguerrePolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (monicLaguerrePolynomial n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans (by rw [natDegree_laguerrePolynomial])
  · exact le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (by rw [coeff_monicLaguerrePolynomial_self]; norm_num)

name: NLAlib.monic_monicLaguerrePolynomial
statement: theorem monic_monicLaguerrePolynomial (n : ℕ) : (monicLaguerrePolynomial n).Monic
proof:
:= by
  apply monic_of_degree_le n
  · exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans (by rw [degree_laguerrePolynomial])
  · exact coeff_monicLaguerrePolynomial_self n

name: NLAlib.degree_monicLaguerrePolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_monicLaguerrePolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (monicLaguerrePolynomial n).degree = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicLaguerrePolynomial n).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicLaguerrePolynomial]

name: NLAlib.monicLaguerrePolynomial_succ_eq
statement:
theorem monicLaguerrePolynomial_succ_eq (n : ℕ) :
    monicLaguerrePolynomial (n + 1) =
      (X - C (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)) * monicLaguerrePolynomial n -
        C ((n : ℝ)^2) * monicLaguerrePolynomial (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [monicLaguerrePolynomial_eq_rodrigues,
      laguerreRodriguesOperator_apply]
  | succ n =>
    rw [monicLaguerrePolynomial_eq_rodrigues,
      monicLaguerrePolynomial_eq_rodrigues,
      monicLaguerrePolynomial_eq_rodrigues,
      Nat.add_one_sub_one, iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ,
      X_mul_derivative_iterate_laguerreRodriguesOperator_X_pow_succ]
    simp only [smul_eq_C_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ, map_neg, C_1, map_ofNat]
    ring

name: NLAlib.alphaSensitivity_coordinate_basis_eq
statement:
private theorem alphaSensitivity_coordinate_basis_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial
      (coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) j =
      orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L j
proof:
:= by
  have hjprev : j - 1 < n := by omega
  simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial,
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hj,
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hj,
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hj,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hj.le).trans hd),
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hjprev.le).trans hd)]

name: NLAlib.betaSensitivity_coordinate_basis_eq
statement:
private theorem betaSensitivity_coordinate_basis_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial
      (coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) j =
      orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial L j
proof:
:= by
  have hjprev : j - 1 < n := by omega
  simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceBetaSensitivityPolynomial,
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hj,
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hjprev,
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hj,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hj.le).trans hd),
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hjprev.le).trans hd)]

name: NLAlib.momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasisMomentVector_eq
statement:
theorem momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasisMomentVector_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d) :
    momentRecurrenceMap (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) n
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun s => Sum.elim
        (fun i : Fin n => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L i.val)
        (fun i : Fin n => if i.val = 0 then L 1 else orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i.val) s)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  cases s with
  | inl i =>
    simp only [momentRecurrenceMap, PiLp.toLp_apply, Sum.elim_inl,
      orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd i.isLt]
  | inr i =>
    simp only [momentRecurrenceMap, PiLp.toLp_apply, Sum.elim_inr,
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd i.isLt]
    congr 1
    apply coordinateMomentFunctional_polynomialBasis_eq_of_degree_lt
    apply degree_one_le.trans_lt
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by have := i.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.euclideanJacobian_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq
statement:
theorem euclideanJacobian_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef) :
    euclideanJacobian (momentRecurrenceMap (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) n)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) = polynomialBasisSensitivityMatrix b L n
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (hankelMomentMatrix
      (coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b)
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)).ofLp) n).PosDef := by
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_toLp, hankelMomentMatrix_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd] using hL
  rw [euclideanJacobian_momentRecurrenceMap_eq _ hM]
  ext s k
  cases s with
  | inl i =>
    simp only [momentSensitivityMatrix, polynomialBasisSensitivityMatrix,
      Sum.elim_inl, alphaSensitivity_coordinate_basis_eq b L hd i.isLt]
  | inr i =>
    simp only [momentSensitivityMatrix, polynomialBasisSensitivityMatrix,
      Sum.elim_inr, betaSensitivity_coordinate_basis_eq b L hd i.isLt]

name: NLAlib.polynomialBasisCoordinate_alphaSensitivity_eq_repr
statement:
theorem polynomialBasisCoordinate_alphaSensitivity_eq_repr
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    (i : Fin n) (k : Fin d) :
    polynomialBasisCoordinate b k (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L i.val) =
      b.repr ⟨orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L i.val,
        mem_degreeLT.mpr ((degree_orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_le L i.val).trans_lt
          (by exact_mod_cast (show 2*i.val+1 < d by have := i.isLt; omega)))⟩ k
proof:
:= by
  apply polynomialBasisCoordinate_apply_of_degree_lt
  exact (degree_orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_le L i.val).trans_lt
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 2*i.val+1 < d by have := i.isLt; omega))

name: NLAlib.polynomialBasisCoordinate_betaSensitivity_eq_repr
statement:
theorem polynomialBasisCoordinate_betaSensitivity_eq_repr
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    (i : Fin n) (k : Fin d) :

name: NLAlib.momentRecurrenceMap_ne_zero_of_posDef
statement:
theorem momentRecurrenceMap_ne_zero_of_posDef {c : Fin d → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)}
    {m : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hM : (hankelMomentMatrix (coordinateMomentFunctional c m.ofLp) n).PosDef) :
    momentRecurrenceMap c n m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmass : 0 < coordinateMomentFunctional c m.ofLp 1 := by
    simpa only [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, one_pow] using
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM hn
  intro hz
  have h := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) => v (Sum.inr ⟨0, hn⟩)) hz
  simp only [momentRecurrenceMap, PiLp.toLp_apply, Sum.elim_inr, ite_true,
    PiLp.zero_apply] at h
  exact hmass.ne' h

name: NLAlib.momentCoordinates_ne_zero_of_posDef
proof:
:= by
  have hmass : 0 < coordinateMomentFunctional c m.ofLp 1 := by
    simpa only [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, one_pow] using
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hM hn
  intro hm
  simp only [coordinateMomentFunctional_apply, hm, WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
    zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hmass
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hmass

name: NLAlib.mapAbsCondition_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq_specNorm
statement:
theorem mapAbsCondition_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq_specNorm
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef) :
    mapAbsCondition (momentRecurrenceMap (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) n)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) = specNorm (polynomialBasisSensitivityMatrix b L n)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (hankelMomentMatrix
      (coordinateMomentFunctional (polynomialBasisCoordinate b)
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)).ofLp) n).PosDef := by
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_toLp, hankelMomentMatrix_coordinate_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd] using hL
  rw [← specNorm_euclideanJacobian
    ((contDiffAt_momentRecurrenceMap _ hM).differentiableAt (by norm_num)),
    euclideanJacobian_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq b L hd hL]

name: NLAlib.mapNormRelativeCondition_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq
statement:
theorem mapNormRelativeCondition_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq
    (b : Basis (Fin d) ℝ (degreeLT ℝ d)) (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : 2*n ≤ d)
    (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef) :
    mapNormRelativeCondition (momentRecurrenceMap (polynomialBasisCoordinate b) n)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)) =
      specNorm (polynomialBasisSensitivityMatrix b L n) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (polynomialBasisMomentVector b L)‖ /
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun s => Sum.elim
          (fun i : Fin n => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L i.val)
          (fun i : Fin n => if i.val = 0 then L 1 else orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i.val) s)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapNormRelativeCondition,
    mapAbsCondition_momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasis_eq_specNorm b L hd hL,
    momentRecurrenceMap_polynomialBasisMomentVector_eq b L hd]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul
statement:
private theorem tendsto_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul (p : ℝ[X]) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x * Real.exp (-(a*x))) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simpa only [eval_add, add_mul, add_zero] using hp.add hq
  | monomial n c =>
    have h := tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_atTop_nhds_zero (n : ℝ) a ha
    simp only [Real.rpow_natCast] at h
    simpa only [eval_monomial, mul_assoc, mul_zero, neg_mul] using h.const_mul c

name: NLAlib.derivativeResolvent_eval_mul_exp_neg_eq_integral_Ioi
statement:
theorem derivativeResolvent_eval_mul_exp_neg_eq_integral_Ioi {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (p : ℝ[X]) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (derivativeResolvent a p).eval x * Real.exp (-(a*x)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, p.eval t * Real.exp (-(a*t))
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => (derivativeResolvent a p).eval t * Real.exp (-(a*t)))
      (-(p.eval t * Real.exp (-(a*t)))) t := by
    have h := (derivativeResolvent a p).hasDerivAt t |>.mul
      ((((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul a).neg).exp)
    have he := congrArg (fun q : ℝ[X] => q.eval t)
      (derivative_derivativeResolvent ha.ne' p)
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul] at he
    have hd : (derivativeResolvent a p).derivative.eval t * Real.exp (-(a*t)) +
        (derivativeResolvent a p).eval t * (Real.exp (-(a*t)) * (-a)) =
        -(p.eval t * Real.exp (-(a*t))) := by rw [he]; ring
    convert! h using 1
    simpa only [id_eq, Pi.neg_apply, mul_one] using hd.symm
  have hint := (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p ha).mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  have h := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun t _ => hderiv t) hint.neg
    (tendsto_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul (derivativeResolvent a p) ha)
  rw [integral_neg, zero_sub] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 < a) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x, Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-(a*t))) =
      Real.exp ((1/4-a)*x) / (a-1/4)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-(a*t))) =
      (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp ((1/4-a)*t)) := by
    funext t
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 1/4-a < 0)]
  rw [show (a-1/4 : ℝ) = -(1/4-a) by ring, div_neg, neg_div]

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 < a) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-(a*t))) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 1/4-a < 0) x)
    ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t _
  change Real.exp ((1/4-a)*t) = Real.exp (t/4) * Real.exp (-(a*t))
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.derivativeResolvent_error_eq_exp_tail_integral
statement:
theorem derivativeResolvent_error_eq_exp_tail_integral {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 < a)
    (p : ℝ[X]) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (x/4) / (a-1/4) - (derivativeResolvent a p).eval x =
      Real.exp (a*x) * ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi x,
        (Real.exp (t/4) - p.eval t) * Real.exp (-(a*t))
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hp := (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p ha0).mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx)
  simp_rw [sub_mul]
  rw [integral_sub (integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha x) hp,
    integral_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha,
    ← derivativeResolvent_eval_mul_exp_neg_eq_integral_Ioi ha0 p hx]
  have h1 : Real.exp (a*x) * Real.exp ((1/4-a)*x) = Real.exp (x/4) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h2 : Real.exp (a*x) * Real.exp (-(a*x)) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  calc
    _ = (Real.exp (a*x) * Real.exp ((1/4-a)*x))/(a-1/4) -
        (derivativeResolvent a p).eval x * (Real.exp (a*x) * Real.exp (-(a*x))) := by
          rw [h1, h2, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_mul_sq_pos
statement:
theorem integral_eval_mul_sq_pos {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {k : ℕ} (hn : (k + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    {p r : ℝ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpd : p.degree ≤ k)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hrd : r.degree ≤ (1 : ℕ))
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ r.eval x) :
    0 < ∫ x, r.eval x * p.eval x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => r.eval x * p.eval x ^ 2) μ := by
    convert hμ (r * p ^ 2) using 1
    ext x
    simp
  have hnon : 0 ≤ ∫ x, r.eval x * p.eval x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hpos] with x hx
    exact mul_nonneg hx (sq_nonneg _)
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hnon
  intro hz
  have hae : (fun x => r.eval x * p.eval x ^ 2) =ᵐ[μ] 0 :=
    (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae (by
      filter_upwards [hpos] with x hx
      exact mul_nonneg hx (sq_nonneg _)) hi).mp hz.symm
  have hs : (∫ x, ((r * p).eval x) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    have hzero : r.eval x * p.eval x = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · simp [sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h]
    simp only [eval_mul, hzero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply]
  have hstrict := integral_sq_eval_pos_of_le_support_encard hn (mul_ne_zero hr hp)
    (p := r * p) (by
      exact (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt ((add_le_add hrd hpd).trans_lt (by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 + k < k + 2 by omega)))) (hμ.integrable_sq (r * p))
  exact hstrict.ne' hs

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_mem_Ioo {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {a b : ℝ} (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {k : ℕ}
    (hn : (k + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k ∈ Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k
  let H := orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k
  have hH : 0 < H := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
    ((by exact_mod_cast (show k + 1 ≤ k + 2 by omega) : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ k + 2).trans hn)
  have hp : p.Monic := monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k
  have hpd : p.degree ≤ k := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have ha := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos hμ hn hp.ne_zero hpd
    (monic_X_sub_C a).ne_zero (by simp) (by
      filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)
  have hb := integral_eval_mul_sq_pos hμ hn hp.ne_zero hpd
    (p := p) (r := C b - X) (by
      intro hz
      have hz' := congrArg (fun s : ℝ[X] => s.coeff 1) hz
      simp at hz') (by
      exact (degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (degree_C_le.trans (by norm_num)) (by simp))) (by
      filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
      simpa only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2)
  have ha' : 0 < L (X * p ^ 2) - a * H := by
    change 0 < L (X * p ^ 2) - a * L (p ^ 2)
    have haL : 0 < L ((X - C a) * p ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C,
        eval_pow] using ha
    simpa only [sub_mul, map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using haL
  have hb' : 0 < b * H - L (X * p ^ 2) := by
    change 0 < b * L (p ^ 2) - L (X * p ^ 2)
    have hbL : 0 < L ((C b - X) * p ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C,
        eval_pow] using hb
    simpa only [sub_mul, map_sub, C_mul', map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hbL
  change a < L (X * p ^ 2) / H ∧ L (X * p ^ 2) / H < b
  exact ⟨(lt_div_iff₀ hH).mpr (by linarith), (div_lt_iff₀ hH).mpr (by linarith)⟩

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_pos_and_le
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_pos_and_le {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {a b : ℝ} (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hn : (k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    0 < orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k ∧
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k ≤ max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k
  let r := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (k - 1)
  let q := X * r
  let H := orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k
  let Hprev := orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (k - 1)
  have hH : 0 < H := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ hn
  have hHp : 0 < Hprev := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
    ((by exact_mod_cast (show k - 1 + 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega) :
      (k - 1 + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ k + 1).trans hn)
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ k : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ k + 1).trans hn)
  have hr : r.Monic := monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (k - 1)
  have hqd : q.natDegree = k := by
    rw [natDegree_X_mul hr.ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    omega
  have hpair : L (p * q) = H := hp.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic (monic_X.mul hr) hqd
  have hraw : H ≤ L (q ^ 2) := by
    have hnon : 0 ≤ L ((q - p) ^ 2) := by
      change 0 ≤ ∫ x, ((q - p) ^ 2).eval x ∂μ
      simp only [eval_pow]
      exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    have heq : L ((q - p) ^ 2) = L (q ^ 2) - H := by
      rw [show (q - p) ^ 2 = q ^ 2 - (p * q + p * q) + p ^ 2 by ring,
        map_add, map_sub, map_add, hpair]
      change L (q ^ 2) - (H + H) + H = L (q ^ 2) - H
      ring
    rw [heq] at hnon
    linarith
  have hbound : L (q ^ 2) ≤ max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) * Hprev := by
    change (∫ x, (q ^ 2).eval x ∂μ) ≤
      max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) * ∫ x, (r ^ 2).eval x ∂μ
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono_ae (hμ _) ((hμ _).const_mul _)
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    simp only [eval_pow, q, eval_mul, eval_X, mul_pow]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
    rcases le_total 0 x with hx0 | hx0
    · have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := hx0.trans hx.2
      exact (sq_le_sq₀ hx0 hb0).mpr hx.2 |>.trans (le_max_right _ _)
    · have ha0 : a ≤ 0 := hx.1.trans hx0
      have hsq : x ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1) (neg_nonneg.mpr hx0)]
      exact hsq.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  change 0 < orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k ∧ orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k ≤ _
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hk.ne']
  exact ⟨div_pos hH hHp, (div_le_iff₀ hHp).mpr (hraw.trans hbound)⟩

name: NLAlib.forall_rationalModificationRootConstraint_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem forall_rationalModificationRootConstraint_eq_zero_iff
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (P : 𝕜[X]) :
    (∀ i, rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i P = 0) ↔
      (∀ i, P.eval (x i) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, T (P * rootCofactor z i) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro i
      simpa only [rationalModificationRootConstraint, dif_pos i.isLt,
        Polynomial.leval_apply] using h ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
    · intro i
      have hi := h ⟨l+i.val, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
      simpa only [rationalModificationRootConstraint, dif_neg (show ¬l+i.val<l by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_comm] using hi
  · rintro ⟨hx, hz⟩ i
    unfold rationalModificationRootConstraint
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact hx ⟨i.val, hi⟩
    · simpa only [polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply, mul_comm] using
        hz ⟨i.val-l, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_full_of_root_rows
statement:
theorem rationalModificationConstraint_full_of_root_rows
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} {P : 𝕜[X]}
    (horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < (n-m : ℕ) → L (P*q) = 0)
    (hrows : ∀ i, rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i P = 0) :
    ∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) n i P = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨heval, hcof⟩ := (forall_rationalModificationRootConstraint_eq_zero_iff T x z P).mp hrows
  have hdiv := (nodal_dvd_iff_forall_eval_eq_zero x hx P).mpr heval
  have hmoment := (forall_rootCofactor_moment_eq_zero_iff T z hz P).mp hcof
  have hs := (rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero
    (min n (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z).natDegree) P).mpr
      ⟨hdiv, fun r => hmoment (X^r.val) (by
        rw [degree_X_pow]
        exact_mod_cast (show r.val < m by
          have hr := lt_of_lt_of_le r.isLt (min_le_right n (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z).natDegree)
          simpa only [Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hr))⟩
  exact (rationalModificationConstraint_small_iff_full L T
    Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero hTv n P
    (by simpa only [Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using horth)).mp hs

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_rationalModificationRootConstraint_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_rationalModificationRootConstraint_eq_zero
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0)
    {P : 𝕜[X]} (hP : P.degree < (l+n : ℕ))
    (horth : ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < (n-m : ℕ) → L (P*q) = 0)
    (hrows : ∀ i, rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i P = 0) : P = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_zero_of_rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero T Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero hn
    (by simpa only [Lagrange.natDegree_nodal, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hP)
    (rationalModificationConstraint_full_of_root_rows L T x z hx hz hTv horth hrows)

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationRootMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationRootMatrix_ne_zero
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ n)
    (hL : ∀ j < l+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0) :
    (rationalModificationRootMatrix L T x z n).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hd
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hMc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hd
  let P : 𝕜[X] := ∑ j : Fin (l+m), c j • monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-m+j.val)
  have hindex (j : Fin (l+m)) : n-m+j.val < l+n := by have := j.isLt; omega
  have hPdeg : P.degree < (l+n : ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
    intro j _
    apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L _).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hindex j
  have horth (q : 𝕜[X]) (hq : q.degree < (n-m : ℕ)) : L (P*q) = 0 := by
    simp only [P, sum_mul, smul_mul_assoc, map_sum, map_smul]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [(isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL _ (hindex j))).orthogonal q
      (hq.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (n-m) j.val)), smul_zero]
  have hrows (i : Fin (l+m)) : rationalModificationRootConstraint T x z i P = 0 := by
    have hi := congrFun hMc i
    simpa only [P, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, rationalModificationRootMatrix,
      Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm, Pi.zero_apply] using hi
  have hzero := eq_zero_of_rationalModificationRootConstraint_eq_zero L T x z hx hz hTv hn
    hPdeg horth hrows
  have hlin := (monicMomentPolynomialSequence L).linearIndependent.comp
    (fun j : Fin (l+m) => n-m+j.val) (fun i j hij => Fin.ext (Nat.add_left_cancel hij))
  exact hc (funext (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hlin c hzero))

name: NLAlib.nextCoeff_christoffelPolynomial
statement:
private theorem nextCoeff_christoffelPolynomial (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    (christoffelPolynomial L z n).nextCoeff =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).nextCoeff + z + christoffelQuotient L z n
proof:
:= by
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_christoffelPolynomial L n hL hz
  have hproddeg : ((X - C z) * christoffelPolynomial L z n).natDegree = n + 1 := by
    rw [natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero hP.monic.ne_zero,
      natDegree_X_sub_C, hP.natDegree_eq]
    omega
  have hnext : ((X - C z) * christoffelPolynomial L z n).coeff n =
      -z + (christoffelPolynomial L z n).nextCoeff := by
    have h := (monic_X_sub_C z).nextCoeff_mul hP.monic
    rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by rw [hproddeg]; omega), hproddeg,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel, nextCoeff_X_sub_C] at h
    exact h
  have h := congrArg (fun p : 𝕜[X] => p.coeff n) (X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial L n hz)
  rw [hnext, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul] at h
  have htop : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).coeff n = 1 := by
    simpa only [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial] using
      (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).coeff_natDegree
  rw [htop, mul_one] at h
  have hnextold : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).coeff n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).nextCoeff := by
    rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]; omega),
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [hnextold] at h
  rw [christoffelQuotient, neg_div]
  linear_combination h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n = z + christoffelQuotient L z n +
      (if n = 0 then 0 else christoffelElimination L z (n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (eval z) (monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L n (fun k _ => hL k))
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C] at h
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta] at h
    simp [christoffelQuotient, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero]
    linear_combination h
  | succ n =>
    simp only [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel, christoffelElimination,
      christoffelQuotient]
    field_simp [hz (n + 1), hz n]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
    linear_combination h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n =
      z + christoffelQuotient L z n + christoffelElimination L z n
proof:
:= by
  have hnew := quasiDefinitePolynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C hL hz
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff _ n (fun k _ => hnew k),
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L n (fun k _ => hL k) (hz n),
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L (n + 1) (fun k _ => hL k) (hz (n + 1)),
    nextCoeff_christoffelPolynomial L n (fun k _ => hL k) (hz n),
    nextCoeff_christoffelPolynomial L (n + 1) (fun k _ => hL k) (hz (n + 1))]
  have hα := orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff L (n + 1) (fun k _ => hL k)
  have hq := orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination hL hz (n + 1)
  simp only [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hq
  linear_combination hq - hα

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n =
      christoffelQuotient L z n * christoffelElimination L z (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn.ne',
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L n (fun k _ => hL k) (hz n),
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C L (n - 1) (fun k _ => hL k) (hz (n - 1)),
    christoffelElimination, show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega,
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn.ne', christoffelQuotient, christoffelQuotient]
  have hprev := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_ne_zero_of_quasiDefinite hL (n - 1)
  simp only [show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega]
  field_simp [hz n, hz (n - 1), hprev]

name: NLAlib.hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc
proof:

name: NLAlib.integral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X])
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) =
      ∫ x, u.eval x*f x/v.eval x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    (by fun_prop) (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hpos] with x hx
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hx, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.polynomialWeightedFunctional_dividedPolynomialIntegral_eq_integral_modified
statement:
theorem polynomialWeightedFunctional_dividedPolynomialIntegral_eq_integral_modified

    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hμ) u p =
      ∫ x, p.eval x ∂rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v
proof:

name: NLAlib.dividedPolynomialIntegral_denominator_mul
statement:
theorem dividedPolynomialIntegral_denominator_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (v : ℝ[X])
    (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hv : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, v.eval x ≠ 0) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv (v*p) = polynomialIntegral μ hμ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [dividedPolynomialIntegral_apply, polynomialIntegral_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hv] with x hx

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x) :
    HasPolynomialMoments (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  apply (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' (by fun_prop)
    (by filter_upwards with x; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)).mpr
  apply (hdiv (u*p)).congr
  filter_upwards [hpos] with x hx
  simp only [eval_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hx, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x) :
    polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hdiv hpos) =
      polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  rw [polynomialIntegral_apply,
    ← polynomialWeightedFunctional_dividedPolynomialIntegral_eq_integral_modified μ u v hdiv hpos]

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef ↔
      ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < n → p ≠ 0 → 0 < L (p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hpos⟩ p hp hp0
    let c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => p.coeff i.val
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hp0
      rw [eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp]
      have hc' (i : Fin n) : p.coeff i.val = 0 := congrFun hzero i
      simp only [hc', monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have h := hpos hc
    rw [star_trivial, ← functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct] at h
    rw [show (∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) = p from
      (eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt hp).symm] at h
    exact h
  · intro hpos
    refine ⟨isHermitian_hankelMomentMatrix _ _, ?_⟩
    intro c hc
    rw [star_trivial, ← functional_sum_monomial_sq_eq_dotProduct]
    exact hpos _ (degree_sum_monomial_fin_lt c)
      ((sum_monomial_fin_eq_zero_iff c).not.mpr hc)

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_of_le
proof:
:= by

  intro p hp hp0
  exact hL p (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)) hp0

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le
