    (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_of_le hL hk).isUnit)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef
proof:
:= by
  apply (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos L n).mp hL
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast hk
  · exact (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).ne_zero

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_linearDivisor
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_linearDivisor
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hsize : min n v.natDegree = 1)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial T n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      C (linearDivisorCoefficient L T v n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < min n v.natDegree := by omega
  let i0 : Fin (min n v.natDegree) := ⟨0,hs⟩
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (min n v.natDegree))) = {i0} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
    have := i.isLt
    dsimp only [i0]
    omega
  have hbase : n-v.natDegree = n-1 := by omega
  have he := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_divisorModification L T hv hTv hL hn
  rw [hu, Finset.sum_singleton] at he
  simpa only [i0, Nat.add_zero, hbase, linearDivisorCoefficient, dif_pos hs] using he

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_quadraticDivisor
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_quadraticDivisor
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hsize : min n v.natDegree = 2)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial T n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      C (quadraticDivisorCoefficients L T v n).1 * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-1) +
      C (quadraticDivisorCoefficients L T v n).2 * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 2 ≤ min n v.natDegree := hsize.ge
  let i0 : Fin (min n v.natDegree) := ⟨0,by omega⟩
  let i1 : Fin (min n v.natDegree) := ⟨1,by omega⟩
  have hne : i0 ≠ i1 := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [i0,i1] at this
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (min n v.natDegree))) = {i0,i1} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
    have := i.isLt
    dsimp only [i0,i1]
    omega
  have hbase : n-v.natDegree = n-2 := by omega
  have hnext : n-2+1 = n-1 := by omega
  have he := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_divisorModification L T hv hTv hL hn
  rw [hu, Finset.sum_pair hne] at he
  simp only [i0, i1, Nat.add_zero, hbase, hnext] at he
  simp only [quadraticDivisorCoefficients, dif_pos hs]
  rw [he]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc

      (v.continuous.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal).continuousOn hv
  refine (hc.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
  filter_upwards [hs] with x hx hn

name: NLAlib.complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_denominator_mul
statement:
theorem complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_denominator_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (v : ℂ[X])
    (hdiv : HasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hv : ∀ᵐ (x : ℝ) ∂μ, v.eval (x : ℂ) ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv (v*p) = complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_apply, complexPolynomialIntegral_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hv] with x hx
  rw [eval_mul, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hx]

name: NLAlib.complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_rootCofactor_eq_cauchy
statement:
theorem complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_rootCofactor_eq_cauchy
    {μ : Measure ℝ} {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → ℂ)
    (hdiv : HasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments μ (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z))
    (hz : ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂μ, ∀ i, (t : ℂ) ≠ z i) (p : ℂ[X]) (i : Fin m) :
    complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z) hdiv (p*rootCofactor z i) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, p.eval (t : ℂ)/((t : ℂ)-z i) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hz] with t ht
  have hc : (rootCofactor z i).eval (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [rootCofactor, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht j))
  have he : (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z).eval (t : ℂ) =
      ((t : ℂ)-z i) * (rootCofactor z i).eval (t : ℂ) := by
    rw [Lagrange.nodal_eq_mul_nodal_erase (Finset.mem_univ i), eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    rfl
  rw [eval_mul, he]
  field_simp [hc, sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht i)]

name: NLAlib.complexPolynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem complexPolynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (u v : ℝ[X]) (hr : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hc : HasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom))
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t) :
    complexPolynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpos) =
      polynomialWeightedFunctional (complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc)
        (u.map Complex.ofRealHom)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  rw [complexPolynomialIntegral_apply, polynomialWeightedFunctional_apply,
    complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_apply, rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (by fun_prop)
      (by filter_upwards with t; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hpos] with t ht
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ht, eval_mul]
  change (u.eval t/v.eval t) • p.eval (t : ℂ) =
    ((u.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) * p.eval (t : ℂ)) /
      (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t)
  rw [eval_map_apply, eval_map_apply]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe]
  ring

name: NLAlib.orthogonalMixedMoment_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem orthogonalMixedMoment_zero (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X]) (l : ℕ) :
    orthogonalMixedMoment L p 0 l = L (p l)
proof:
:= by
  simp [orthogonalMixedMoment]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalMixedMoment_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hL).orthogonal
  rw [hp]
  exact_mod_cast hl

name: NLAlib.orthogonalMixedMoment_diag
proof:
:=
  (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hL).functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic
    hp hdeg

name: NLAlib.orthogonalMixedMoment_succ
statement:
theorem orthogonalMixedMoment_succ (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k l : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ k + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hp : X * p l = p (l + 1) + C (a l) * p l +
      if l = 0 then 0 else C (b l) * p (l - 1)) :
    orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k + 1) l = orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (l + 1) +
      (a l - orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k) * orthogonalMixedMoment L p k l -
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k * orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) l +
      if l = 0 then 0 else b l * orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (l - 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalMixedMoment
  rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L k hL]
  have he : ((X - C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k)) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k -
      C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (k - 1)) * p l =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k * (X * p l) -
        C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k) * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k * p l) -
        C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k) * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (k - 1) * p l) := by ring
  rw [he, hp]
  split_ifs <;>
    simp only [mul_add, add_zero, map_add, map_sub, C_mul', mul_smul_comm,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: NLAlib.orthogonalMixedMoment_diag_pos
statement:
theorem orthogonalMixedMoment_diag_pos {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]} {n k : ℕ}
    (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef) (hk : k < n)
    (hp : (p k).Monic) (hdeg : (p k).natDegree = k) :
    0 < orthogonalMixedMoment L p k k
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalMixedMoment_diag (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL hk.le) hp hdeg]
  exact orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hL hk

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_mixed_ratio
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_mixed_ratio {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]}
    {n k : ℕ} (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef) (hk : k < n) (hk0 : k ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k =
      orthogonalMixedMoment L p k k / orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalMixedMoment_diag (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL hk.le)
      (hp k) (hdeg k),
    orthogonalMixedMoment_diag (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL (by omega))
      (hp (k - 1)) (hdeg (k - 1))]
  exact if_neg hk0

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_mixed_ratio
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_mixed_ratio {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]}
    {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {n k : ℕ} (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hk : k < n) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic)
    (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : X * p k = p (k + 1) + C (a k) * p k +
      if k = 0 then 0 else C (b k) * p (k - 1)) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k = a k +
      orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (k + 1) / orthogonalMixedMoment L p k k -
      orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) k / orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd (j : ℕ) : (p j).degree = j := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree (hp j).ne_zero, hdeg]
  have hz := orthogonalMixedMoment_eq_zero
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL (by omega : k + 1 ≤ n)) (hd k) (by omega)
  have he := orthogonalMixedMoment_succ L p a b k k
    (fun j hj => hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL (by omega)) hrec
  rw [hz, if_neg hk0, orthogonalMixedMoment_eq_zero
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hL hk.le) (hd (k - 1)) (by omega),
    mul_zero, add_zero, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_mixed_ratio hL hk hk0 hp hdeg] at he
  have hc := (orthogonalMixedMoment_diag_pos hL hk (hp k) (hdeg k)).ne'
  have hpv := (orthogonalMixedMoment_diag_pos hL (by omega : k - 1 < n)
    (hp (k - 1)) (hdeg (k - 1))).ne'
  field_simp [hpv] at he
  field_simp [hc, hpv]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_zero_eq_modified_moments
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_zero_eq_modified_moments {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ}
    {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]} {a : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hp0 : p 0 = 1) (hrec : X * p 0 = p 1 + C a * p 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L 0 = a + L (p 1) / L (p 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : L (p 0) ≠ 0 := by
    have h := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hL hn
    simpa [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, hp0] using h.ne'
  have he : L X = L (p 1) + a * L (p 0) := by
    have h := congrArg L hrec
    simp only [C_mul', map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    simpa only [hp0, mul_one] using h
  simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero,
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm, one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [← hp0, he]
  field_simp [hnorm]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem integrableOn_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (n : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x^n * Real.exp (-(s*x))) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x^n * Real.exp (-x)) (Ioi 0) := by
    convert (Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (by positivity : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1))
      using 1
    ext x
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, Real.rpow_natCast, mul_comm]
  have hc := (integrableOn_Ioi_comp_mul_left_iff
    (fun x : ℝ => x^n * Real.exp (-x)) 0 hs).mpr (by simpa using hb)
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun (hc.const_mul (s^n)⁻¹) ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro x _
  simp only [mul_pow, mul_assoc]
  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hs.ne'), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (n : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, x^n * Real.exp (-(s*x))) = (n ! : ℝ) / s^(n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
    (by positivity : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1) hs
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, Real.rpow_natCast,
    Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial] at h
  rw [show (n : ℝ) + 1 = ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) by simp, Real.rpow_natCast] at h
  rw [h]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (p : ℝ[X]) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x * Real.exp (-(s*x))) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    exact (hp.add hq).congr_fun (by intro x _; simp [add_mul]) measurableSet_Ioi
  | monomial n a =>
    exact IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((integrableOn_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi n hs).const_mul a)
      (by intro x _; simp [mul_assoc]) measurableSet_Ioi

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (p : ℝ[X]) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, p.eval x * Real.exp (-(s*x))) =
      exponentialPolynomialMoment s p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [eval_add, add_mul, map_add]
    rw [integral_add (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi p hs)
      (integrableOn_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi q hs), hp, hq]
  | monomial n a =>
    simp only [eval_monomial, mul_assoc]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_pow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi n hs,
      exponentialPolynomialMoment_monomial]
    ring

name: NLAlib.integral_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
theorem integral_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial (i j : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, (laguerrePolynomial i).eval x *
      (laguerrePolynomial j).eval x * Real.exp (-x)) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [eval_mul, one_mul] using
    (integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
      (laguerrePolynomial i * laguerrePolynomial j) zero_lt_one).trans
      (exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial i j)

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quarter_mul_laguerrePolynomial
statement:
theorem integral_exp_quarter_mul_laguerrePolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, Real.exp (x / 4) *
      (laguerrePolynomial n).eval x * Real.exp (-x)) =
      4 * (-1 : ℝ)^n / 3^(n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (x / 4) *
      (laguerrePolynomial n).eval x * Real.exp (-x)) =
      (fun x : ℝ => (laguerrePolynomial n).eval x * Real.exp (-((3/4)*x))) := by
    ext x
    rw [mul_comm (Real.exp (x/4)), mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_eval_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi _ (by norm_num),
    exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial (by norm_num)]
  rw [show (3 : ℝ)/4 - 1 = (-1)/4 by norm_num]
  rw [div_pow, div_pow, pow_succ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_prod_beta
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_prod_beta
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n = orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0 *
      ∏ i ∈ range n, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hnorm : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0 :=
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero
        (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)
    rw [prod_range_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← ih (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)), orthogonalRecurrenceBeta,
      if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    exact (mul_div_cancel₀ _ hnorm).symm

name: NLAlib.X_sub_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
statement:
theorem X_sub_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (y : 𝕜) :
    (X - C y) * monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) y =
      C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) -
      C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n
proof:
:= by
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
  let H := orthogonalPolynomialNorm L
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hr := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L 0 hL
    simp [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta] at hr
    simp only [monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial, Nat.zero_add, range_one, sum_singleton,
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, eval_one, mul_one]
    rw [hr]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, map_mul, map_sub, map_one]
    ring
  | succ n ih =>
    have hH (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n + 1) : H i ≠ 0 :=
      (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL i (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero
        (hL (i + 1) (by omega))
    have hr := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L (n + 1) hL
    have hre := congrArg (eval y) hr
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hre
    have hb : orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1) / H (n + 1) = (H n)⁻¹ := by
      rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      change H (n + 1) / H n / H (n + 1) = _
      field_simp [hH n (by omega), hH (n + 1) le_rfl]
    change (X - C y) * (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1 + 1), C ((P i).eval y / H i) * P i) = _
    rw [sum_range_succ, mul_add]
    change (X - C y) * monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) y + _ = _
    rw [ih (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)), hre, hr]
    simp only [P, H, div_eq_mul_inv, map_mul, map_sub, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hbC := congrArg (C : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜[X]) hb
    simp only [H, div_eq_mul_inv, map_mul] at hbC
    linear_combination
      -(C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) -
        C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n) * hbC

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
statement:
theorem sub_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (x y : 𝕜) :
    (x - y) * (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) y).eval x =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y) /
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (eval x) (X_sub_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial n hL y)
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial_self
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial_self
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (x : 𝕜) :
    (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) x).eval x =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) /
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : 𝕜[X] => p.derivative.eval x)
    (X_sub_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial n hL x)
  simp only [derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C,
    sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_sub,
    eval_X, eval_C, sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_det_rootFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
statement:
theorem exists_det_rootFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, t ∈ Icc a b) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, v.eval t ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, 0 < u.eval t/v.eval t)
    (x : Fin u.natDegree → ℂ) (z : Fin v.natDegree → ℂ)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hux : u.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (u.leadingCoeff : ℂ) * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)
    (hvz : v.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    {n : ℕ} (hm : v.natDegree ≤ n)
    (hcard : ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let hμ
proof:
:= hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    let hr := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
    let hc := hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
      (v := v.map Complex.ofRealHom) (by
        intro t ht
        change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
        rw [eval_map_apply]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht))
    let hpa : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono fun t ht => (hpos t ht).le
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpa
    let L := complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let T := complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc
    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L ((v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) • T) x z n).det =
        C c * u.map Complex.ofRealHom *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n).map
            Complex.ofRealHom := by
  dsimp only
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
  let hr := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
  let hc := hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    (v := v.map Complex.ofRealHom) (by
      intro t ht
      change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
      rw [eval_map_apply]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht))
  let hpa : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono fun t ht => (hpos t ht).le
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpa
  let L := complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let T := complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc
  have hcu : (u.leadingCoeff : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hu)
  have hcv : (v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hv)
  have hTv (p : ℂ[X]) : T (v.map Complex.ofRealHom*p) = L p := by
    apply complexDividedPolynomialIntegral_denominator_mul hμ _ hc
    filter_upwards [hs] with t ht
    change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
    rw [eval_map_apply]
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht)
  have hL (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ u.natDegree+n) : hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral_ne_zero hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hj : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ u.natDegree+n).trans hcard)
  have hps : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 < u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono hpos
  have hsn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard :=
    ((by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ u.natDegree+n by omega) : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ u.natDegree+n).trans hcard)
  have heq : complexPolynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν =
      polynomialWeightedFunctional T (u.map Complex.ofRealHom) :=
    complexPolynomialIntegral_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq u v hr hc hpa
  have hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (u.map Complex.ofRealHom)) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← heq]
    apply hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral_ne_zero hν
    rw [support_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq hps]
    exact hsn
  have hnr : hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_ne_zero u v hr hps hsn
  have hp : monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T (u.map Complex.ofRealHom)) n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n).map
        Complex.ofRealHom := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact monicOrthogonalPolynomial_complexPolynomialIntegral_eq_map hν hnr
  have hd := det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic L T hcu hcv x z hx hz
    hux hvz hTv hm hL hn
  dsimp only at hd
  refine ⟨_, hd.2, ?_⟩
  exact hd.1.trans (by rw [hp])

name: NLAlib.functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_mul_eq_neg
statement:
theorem functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_mul_eq_neg
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : q.degree < n) :
    L x (monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x * q) =
      -D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * q)
proof:
:= by
  let P := fun y => monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n
  let V := monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x
  have hP := hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn
  have hVdeg : V.degree ≤ n := (degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt L n x).le
  have hPdeg (y : ℝ) : (P y).degree = n := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hnn : (n : WithBot ℕ) + n < ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show n + n < 2 * n + 1 by omega)
  have hpoly := hP.mul (hasCoeffDerivAt_const q x)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at hpoly
  have hder := hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial (d := 2 * n + 1)
    (p := fun y => P y * q) (p' := V * q)
    (by intro y; apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt; rw [hPdeg];
        exact (add_le_add le_rfl hq.le).trans_lt hnn)
    ((degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt ((add_le_add hVdeg hq.le).trans_lt hnn)) hpoly hD
  have hdet : ContinuousAt (fun y => hankelMomentDet (L y) n) x :=
    (ContDiffAt.matrix_det (A := fun y => hankelMomentMatrix (L y) n)
      (fun i j => hL (i.val + j.val))).continuousAt
  have heq : (fun y => L y (P y * q)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hdet.eventually_ne hn] with y hy
    exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) hy).orthogonal q hq
  have hzero : HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (P y * q)) 0 x :=
    (hasDerivAt_const x 0).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  have hsum := hder.unique hzero
  linarith

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_eq_sum
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_eq_sum
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : ∀ k < n, orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) k ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x =
      -∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        (D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) i) /
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) i) • monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_lt (L x)
    (degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt L n x)
  have hcoeff (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) : c j =
      -D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) j) /
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) j := by
    have hjdeg : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) j).degree < n := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) j).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
      exact_mod_cast hj
    have hp := functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_mul_eq_neg hL hD
      (hn n le_rfl) hjdeg
    rw [← hc] at hp
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul, smul_mul_assoc, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hp
    have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i *
        L x (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) i * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) j)) =
        c j * orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, pow_two]
      · intro i hi hij
        rw [functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero_of_ne (L x)
          (hn i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi).le) (hn j hj.le) hij, mul_zero]
      · exact fun h => (h (Finset.mem_range.mpr hj)).elim
    rw [hsum] at hp
    exact (eq_div_iff (hh j hj)).mpr hp
  rw [← hc, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [hcoeff i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi), neg_div, neg_smul]

name: NLAlib.complexPolynomialIntegral_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexPolynomialIntegral_apply (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (p : ℂ[X]) : complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ p = ∫ x : ℝ, p.eval (x : ℂ) ∂μ
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.complexPolynomialIntegral_apply_map
statement:
theorem complexPolynomialIntegral_apply_map (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (p : ℝ[X]) :
    complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ (p.map Complex.ofRealHom) = (polynomialIntegral μ hμ p : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ x : ℝ, (p.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom x) ∂μ) = _
  simp_rw [eval_map_apply]

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentMatrix_complexPolynomialIntegral
statement:
theorem hankelMomentMatrix_complexPolynomialIntegral (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    hankelMomentMatrix (complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ) n =
      (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := complexPolynomialIntegral_apply_map μ hμ (X^(i.val+j.val))
  simpa only [Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Matrix.map_apply, hankelMomentMatrix,
    Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe] using h

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) (n : ℕ) :
    hankelMomentDet (complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ) n =
      ((hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hankelMomentDet, hankelMomentMatrix_complexPolynomialIntegral]
  exact (Complex.ofRealHom.map_det (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n)).symm

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral]
  exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ hs)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_complexPolynomialIntegral_eq_map
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_complexPolynomialIntegral_eq_map
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ) n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom
proof:
:= by
  let p := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n
  have hp := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) hn
  have hnc : hankelMomentDet (complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hankelMomentDet_complexPolynomialIntegral]
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hn
  apply (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ) hnc).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero _ hnc
  refine ⟨hp.monic.map _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [natDegree_map, hp.natDegree_eq]
  · intro q hq
    by_cases hq0 : q=0
    · simp [hq0]
    have hqd := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hq0).mpr hq
    rw [q.as_sum_range' (q.natDegree+1) (Nat.lt_succ_self _), mul_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have hjn : j < n := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega
    have he : p.map Complex.ofRealHom * monomial j (q.coeff j) =
        C (q.coeff j) * ((p * X^j).map Complex.ofRealHom) := by
      simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X]
      rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
      ring
    rw [he, C_mul', map_smul, complexPolynomialIntegral_apply_map]
    rw [hp.orthogonal (X^j) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast hjn)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.det_monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix
statement:
theorem det_monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    (monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix L n).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have htri : (monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix L n).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
      (by change j.val < i.val at hij
          simpa only [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial] using hij)
  rw [det_of_isUpperTriangular htri]
  apply prod_eq_one
  intro i _
  simpa only [monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial] using
    (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).coeff_natDegree

name: NLAlib.functional_sum_monomial_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem functional_sum_monomial_mul_eq (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (c d : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    L ((∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (c i)) *
      (∑ j : Fin n, monomial j.val (d j))) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, c i * L (X ^ (i.val + j.val)) * d j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sum_mul, mul_sum, map_sum]
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [monomial_mul_monomial, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, C_mul', map_smul]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.transpose_coefficientMatrix_mul_hankel_mul_coefficientMatrix
statement:
theorem transpose_coefficientMatrix_mul_hankel_mul_coefficientMatrix
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k < n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    (monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix L n)ᵀ * hankelMomentMatrix L n *
      monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix L n =
        diagonal (fun i : Fin n => orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val)
proof:
:= by
  have hP (i : Fin n) : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).degree < n := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    exact_mod_cast i.isLt
  ext i j
  rw [mul_apply]
  simp only [mul_apply, transpose_apply, monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix,
    hankelMomentMatrix]
  simp only [sum_mul]
  rw [sum_comm]
  have hform := functional_sum_monomial_mul_eq L n
    (fun k => (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L i.val).coeff k.val)
    (fun k => (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L j.val).coeff k.val)
  rw [← eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt (hP i),
    ← eq_sum_monomial_fin_of_degree_lt (hP j)] at hform
  rw [← hform]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [diagonal_apply_eq, orthogonalPolynomialNorm, pow_two]
  · rw [diagonal_apply_ne _ hij]
    exact functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero_of_ne L
      (hL i.val i.isLt) (hL j.val j.isLt)
      (fun h => hij (Fin.ext h))

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentDet_eq_prod_orthogonalPolynomialNorm
statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_eq_prod_orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k < n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    hankelMomentDet L n = ∏ i : Fin n, orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.det
    (transpose_coefficientMatrix_mul_hankel_mul_coefficientMatrix L n hL)
  simpa only [det_mul, det_transpose, det_monicOrthogonalCoefficientMatrix,
    one_mul, mul_one, det_diagonal, hankelMomentDet] using h

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_div_hankelMomentDet
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_div_hankelMomentDet
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n = hankelMomentDet L (n + 1) / hankelMomentDet L n
proof:
:= by
  have hnext := hankelMomentDet_eq_prod_orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n + 1)
    (fun k hk => hL k (by omega))
  have hprev := hankelMomentDet_eq_prod_orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n (fun k hk => hL k (by omega))
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc] at hnext
  simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hnext
  rw [← hprev] at hnext
  rw [hnext, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (hL n (by omega))]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_hankelMomentDet_ratio
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_hankelMomentDet_ratio
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n = hankelMomentDet L (n + 1) * hankelMomentDet L (n - 1) /
      hankelMomentDet L n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn.ne',
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_div_hankelMomentDet L n hL,
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_div_hankelMomentDet L (n - 1) (fun k hk => hL k (by omega)),
    show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega]
  field_simp [hL n (by omega), hL (n - 1) (by omega)]

name: NLAlib.functional_comp_X_sq_mul_X_pow_eq_zero_of_odd
statement:
private theorem functional_comp_X_sq_mul_X_pow_eq_zero_of_odd
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hs : ∀ p : ℝ[X], L (p.comp (-X)) = L p)
    (p : ℝ[X]) {j : ℕ} (hj : Odd j) : L (p.comp (X ^ 2) * X ^ j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (p.comp (X ^ 2)).comp (-X) = p.comp (X ^ 2) := by
    rw [comp_assoc]
    congr 1
    simp [pow_comp]
  have h := hs (p.comp (X ^ 2) * X ^ j)
  rw [mul_comp, hcomp, pow_comp, X_comp, hj.neg_pow, mul_neg, map_neg] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hs : Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => -x) μ = μ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : (2 * k : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (2 * k) =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
        (polynomialIntegral (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ) (hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq hμ))
        k).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let ν := Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq hμ
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral ν hν) k
  have hνdet := hankelMomentDet_map_sq_ne_zero hμ hk
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral ν hν) hνdet
  have hspec : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L (2 * k) (P.comp (X ^ 2)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hP.monic.expand (by decide : 0 < 2)
    · change (expand ℝ 2 P).natDegree = 2 * k
      rw [natDegree_expand, hP.natDegree_eq]
      omega
    · intro q hq
      apply functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests L _ hq
      intro j
      by_cases hj : Even j.val
      · obtain ⟨l, hjeq⟩ := even_iff_exists_two_mul.mp hj
        have hl : l < k := by have := j.isLt; omega
        have h := hP.orthogonal (X ^ l) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast hl)
        change polynomialIntegral ν hν (P * X ^ l) = 0 at h
        rw [polynomialIntegral_map_sq] at h
        simpa only [L, hjeq, mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, ← pow_mul] using h
      · exact functional_comp_X_sq_mul_X_pow_eq_zero_of_odd L
          (polynomialIntegral_comp_neg_X hμ hs) P (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hj)
  exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ hk).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    hspec (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ hk)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    (hs : Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => -x) μ = μ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (2 * k + 1) =
      X * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
        (polynomialIntegral
          (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
            (μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2))))
          (hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ))) k).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
  let ν := Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
    (μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2)))
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ)
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral ν hν) k
  have hνdet := hankelMomentDet_map_sq_withDensity_sq_ne_zero hμ hk
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral ν hν) hνdet
  have hPcomp : (P.comp (X ^ 2)).Monic := hP.monic.expand (by decide : 0 < 2)
  have hspec : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L (2 * k + 1) (X * P.comp (X ^ 2)) := by
    refine ⟨monic_X.mul hPcomp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [natDegree_X_mul hPcomp.ne_zero]
      change (expand ℝ 2 P).natDegree + 1 = 2 * k + 1
      rw [natDegree_expand, hP.natDegree_eq]
      omega
    · intro q hq
      apply functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests L _ hq
      intro j
      by_cases hj : Even j.val
      · rw [show X * P.comp (X ^ 2) * X ^ j.val = P.comp (X ^ 2) * X ^ (j.val + 1) by
          rw [pow_succ]; ring]
        exact functional_comp_X_sq_mul_X_pow_eq_zero_of_odd L
          (polynomialIntegral_comp_neg_X hμ hs) P hj.add_one
      · obtain ⟨l, hjeq⟩ := Odd.exists_bit1 (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hj)
        have hl : l < k := by have := j.isLt; omega
        have h := hP.orthogonal (X ^ l) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast hl)
        change polynomialIntegral ν hν (P * X ^ l) = 0 at h
        rw [polynomialIntegral_map_sq _ (hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ),
          polynomialIntegral_withDensity_sq μ hμ] at h
        have hid : X * P.comp (X ^ 2) * X ^ (2 * l + 1) =
            X ^ 2 * (P * X ^ l).comp (X ^ 2) := by
          simp only [mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, ← pow_mul, pow_add, pow_one]
          ring
        change L (X * P.comp (X ^ 2) * X ^ j.val) = 0
        rw [hjeq, hid]
        exact h
  exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialIntegral μ hμ hk).eq_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero
    hspec (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ hk)

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_outside_support_interval
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_outside_support_interval
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b z : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (hz : z < a ∨ b < z) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).eval z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn z).mp hzero
  have hloc := gaussNodes_mem_Icc hμ hs hn i
  rw [hi] at hloc
  rcases hz with hz | hz <;> linarith [hloc.1, hloc.2]

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial_self_pos
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial_self_pos
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hh : ∀ k ≤ n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (z : ℝ) :
    0 < (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n+1) z).eval z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  have hterm (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ range (n+1)) :
      0 ≤ (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z := by
    have hkn : k ≤ n := by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← pow_two]
    exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hh k hkn).le
  have hzero : 0 < (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L 0).eval z / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0 *
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L 0).eval z := by
    simp only [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero, eval_one, mul_one]
    exact div_pos zero_lt_one (hh 0 (Nat.zero_le n))
  exact hzero.trans_le (single_le_sum hterm (by simp))

name: NLAlib.eval_christoffelPolynomial_ne_zero_of_real
proof:
:= by
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n+1) : hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast hk : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ n+1).trans hn)
  have hh (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) k :=
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard μ hμ
      ((by exact_mod_cast (show k+1 ≤ n+1 by omega) : (k+1:ℕ∞) ≤ n+1).trans hn)
  rw [christoffelPolynomial_eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial _ n hL hz,
    eval_mul, eval_C]
  exact mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero (hh n le_rfl).ne' hz)
    (eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial_self_pos _ n hh z).ne'

name: NLAlib.eval_christoffelPolynomial_ne_zero_of_outside_support_interval
statement:
theorem eval_christoffelPolynomial_ne_zero_of_outside_support_interval
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b z : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n+1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (hz : z < a ∨ b < z) :
    (christoffelPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) z n).eval z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eval_christoffelPolynomial_ne_zero_of_real hμ hn
  exact eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_ne_zero_of_outside_support_interval hμ hs
    ((by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n : (n:ℕ∞) ≤ n+1).trans hn) hz

name: NLAlib.associatedMonicPolynomial_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem associatedMonicPolynomial_zero (α β : ℕ → 𝕜) (s : ℕ) :
    associatedMonicPolynomial α β s 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.associatedMonicPolynomial_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem associatedMonicPolynomial_one (α β : ℕ → 𝕜) (s : ℕ) :
    associatedMonicPolynomial α β s 1 = X-C (α s)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.associatedMonicPolynomial_add_two
statement:
theorem associatedMonicPolynomial_add_two (α β : ℕ → 𝕜) (s n : ℕ) :
    associatedMonicPolynomial α β s (n+2) =
      (X-C (α (s+n+1))) * associatedMonicPolynomial α β s (n+1) -
        C (β (s+n+1)) * associatedMonicPolynomial α β s n
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.monic_and_natDegree_associatedMonicPolynomial
statement:
theorem monic_and_natDegree_associatedMonicPolynomial (α β : ℕ → 𝕜) (s n : ℕ) :
    (associatedMonicPolynomial α β s n).Monic ∧
      (associatedMonicPolynomial α β s n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => exact ⟨monic_X_sub_C _, natDegree_X_sub_C _⟩
  | more n ih ih1 =>
    rw [associatedMonicPolynomial_add_two]
    have hleft : ((X-C (α (s+n+1))) * associatedMonicPolynomial α β s (n+1)).Monic :=
      (monic_X_sub_C _).mul ih1.1
    have hdeg : ((X-C (α (s+n+1))) * associatedMonicPolynomial α β s (n+1)).degree =
        ((n+2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_mul, degree_X_sub_C, degree_eq_natDegree ih1.1.ne_zero, ih1.2]
      norm_cast
      omega
    have hsmall : (C (β (s+n+1)) * associatedMonicPolynomial α β s n).degree <
        ((X-C (α (s+n+1))) * associatedMonicPolynomial α β s (n+1)).degree := by
      rw [hdeg, C_mul']
      apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree ih.1.ne_zero, ih.2]
      exact_mod_cast (show n < n+2 by omega)
    have hmonic := hleft.sub_of_left hsmall
    refine ⟨hmonic, ?_⟩
    have hd := (degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt hsmall).trans hdeg
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hmonic.ne_zero] at hd
    exact WithBot.coe_inj.mp hd

name: NLAlib.secondKindPolynomial_eq_mass_mul_associatedMonicPolynomial
statement:
theorem secondKindPolynomial_eq_mass_mul_associatedMonicPolynomial
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    secondKindPolynomial L (n+1) = C (L 1) *
      associatedMonicPolynomial (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L) 1 n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp [secondKindPolynomial, associatedMonicPolynomial]; ring
  | more n ih ih1 =>
    rw [show n+2+1 = (n+1)+2 by omega, secondKindPolynomial_add_two,
      ih1, ih, associatedMonicPolynomial_add_two]
    have heq : 1+n+1 = n+1+1 := by omega
    rw [heq]
    ring

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} {cu cv : 𝕜}
    (hcu : cu ≠ 0) (hcv : cv ≠ 0) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hu : u = C cu * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) (hm : n ≤ m)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    let D
proof:
:= rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix L (cv • T) x z hm
    let c := (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L (cv • T) x z hm).det / cu
    D.det = C c * u * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ∧ c ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp only
  have hratio : cv/cu ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hcv hcu
  have he := polynomialWeightedFunctional_smul_nodal T hcu cv x hu
  have hnc : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional (cv • T)
      (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he,hankelMomentDet_smul]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hratio) hn
  have hp : monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (cv • T)
      (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)) n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n := by
    rw [he,monicOrthogonalPolynomial_smul _ hratio _ hn]
  have hd := det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_eq L (cv • T) x z hx hz hm hnc
  constructor
  · rw [hd.1,hp]
    let a := (rationalModificationAuxiliaryMatrix L (cv • T) x z hm).det
    change C a * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x * _ = C (a/cu) * u * _
    rw [hu,← mul_assoc (C (a/cu)) (C cu) (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x),
      ← map_mul,div_mul_cancel₀ _ hcu]
  · exact div_ne_zero hd.2 hcu

name: NLAlib.nodal_dvd_iff_forall_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nodal_dvd_iff_forall_eval_eq_zero (z : Fin l → 𝕜) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (P : 𝕜[X]) :
    Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z ∣ P ↔ ∀ i, P.eval (z i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl⟩ i
    rw [eval_mul, Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (Finset.mem_univ i), zero_mul]
  · intro h
    apply EuclideanDomain.mod_eq_zero.mp
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero Finset.univ hz.injOn
    · simpa only [Lagrange.degree_nodal, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
        (degree_mod_lt P (Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero (s := Finset.univ) (v := z)))
    · intro i _
      have he := congrArg (fun q : 𝕜[X] => q.eval (z i))
        (EuclideanDomain.div_add_mod P (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z))
      simpa only [eval_add, eval_mul,
        Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (Finset.mem_univ i), zero_mul, zero_add, h i] using he

name: NLAlib.eq_sum_C_mul_rootCofactor
statement:
theorem eq_sum_C_mul_rootCofactor (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    {q : 𝕜[X]} (hq : q.degree < m) :
    q = ∑ i : Fin m, C (q.eval (z i) / (rootCofactor z i).eval (z i)) * rootCofactor z i
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lagrange.eq_interpolate (s := Finset.univ) hz.injOn
    (by simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hq)
  rw [Lagrange.interpolate_eq_sum] at h
  simpa only [rootCofactor, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] using h

name: NLAlib.forall_rootCofactor_moment_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem forall_rootCofactor_moment_eq_zero_iff (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (hz : Function.Injective z) (P : 𝕜[X]) :
    (∀ i, T (P * rootCofactor z i) = 0) ↔
      ∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < m → T (P*q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    rw [eq_sum_C_mul_rootCofactor z hz hq, mul_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    rw [show P * (C _ * rootCofactor z i) = C _ * (P * rootCofactor z i) by ring,
      C_mul', map_smul, h i, smul_zero]
  · intro h i
    apply h
    have hi : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) := Finset.mem_univ i
    have hdeg := Lagrange.degree_nodal (s := Finset.univ.erase i) (v := z)
    change (Lagrange.nodal (Finset.univ.erase i) z).degree < _
    rw [hdeg, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (show m-1 < m by have := i.isLt; omega)

name: NLAlib.rationalModification_root_constraints_iff
statement:
theorem rationalModification_root_constraints_iff (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (hx : Function.Injective x)
    (hz : Function.Injective z) (P : 𝕜[X]) :
    ((∀ i, P.eval (x i) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, T (P * rootCofactor z i) = 0)) ↔
      ∀ i, rationalModificationConstraint T (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) m i P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalModificationConstraint_eq_zero_iff T Lagrange.nodal_ne_zero,
    nodal_dvd_iff_forall_eval_eq_zero x hx, forall_rootCofactor_moment_eq_zero_iff T z hz]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hm⟩
    exact ⟨hu, fun i => hm (X^i.val) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast i.isLt)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, hm⟩
    exact ⟨hu, fun q hq => functional_mul_eq_zero_of_monomial_tests T hm hq⟩

name: NLAlib.contDiffAt_coeff_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_coeff_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0)
    (hh : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n) (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => (orthonormalMomentPolynomial (L y) n).coeff k) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, coeff_C_mul]
  exact ((contDiffAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hn).sqrt hh.ne').inv
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hh).ne' |>.mul (contDiffAt_coeff_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL hn k)

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem continuousAt_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k < n, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) k) (i j : Fin n) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (L y) n i j) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
  suffices h : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y =>
      L y (X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial (L y) j.val *
        orthonormalMomentPolynomial (L y) i.val)) x from h.continuousAt
  apply contDiffAt_functional_polynomial_of_degree_lt (d := 2 * n + 2)
  · intro y
    have hd (k : ℕ) : (orthonormalMomentPolynomial (L y) k).degree ≤ k := by
      rw [orthonormalMomentPolynomial, C_mul']
      apply (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_eq
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) k).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
    apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
    apply (add_le_add ((degree_mul_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (by rw [degree_X]) (hd j.val))) (hd i.val)).trans_lt
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 + j.val + i.val < 2 * n + 2 by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)
  · intro k
    apply contDiffAt_coeff_mul
    · apply contDiffAt_coeff_mul (fun _ => contDiffAt_const)
      exact contDiffAt_coeff_orthonormalMomentPolynomial hL (hn j.val j.isLt) (hh j.val j.isLt)
    · exact contDiffAt_coeff_orthonormalMomentPolynomial hL (hn i.val i.isLt) (hh i.val i.isLt)
  · exact fun k => hL k.val

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem continuousAt_eigenvalues_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k < n, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) k) (i : Fin n) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y =>
      (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (L y) n).eigenvalues i) x
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.IsHermitian.continuousAt_eigenvalues₀
    (fun y => isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (L y) n)
    (continuousAt_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply hL hn hh)
    ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)).symm i)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_eq_adjacent
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_eq_adjacent
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0)
    (hprev : n ≠ 0 → orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1) ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L n =
      C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)⁻¹ *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)) -
      if n = 0 then 0 else C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1))⁻¹ *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L n hn]
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial,
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, ite_true, mul_zero, map_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    ring
  · simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial,
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hn0, map_mul, map_ofNat]
    have hcancel : C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)⁻¹ *
        C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1)) =
        C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← map_mul]
      congr 1
      field_simp
    linear_combination - (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1) *
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n) * hcancel

name: NLAlib.functional_X_mul_monic_mul_variation_eq
statement:
private theorem functional_X_mul_monic_mul_variation_eq
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0) :
    L x (X * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x) =
      -orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L x) n *
        D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) (n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x)
  let V := monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x
  have hV : V.degree < n := degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt L n x
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst n
    have hVz : V = 0 := by simp [V, monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv]
    simp [V, hVz, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta]
  · have hrec := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq (L x) n hn
    have heq : X * P n = P (n + 1) + C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (L x) n) * P n +
        C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L x) n) * P (n - 1) := by
      dsimp only [P]
      linear_combination -hrec
    have horth := (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x)
      (hn n (by omega))).orthogonal V hV
    have horthnext := (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x)
      (hn (n + 1) le_rfl)).orthogonal V (hV.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n))
    have hprev : (P (n - 1)).degree < n := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) _).ne_zero,
        natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
      exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < n by omega)
    have hvar := functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_mul_eq_neg hL hD
      (hn n (by omega)) hprev
    change L x (X * P n * V) = _
    rw [heq, add_mul, add_mul, map_add, map_add, mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul,
      mul_assoc, C_mul', map_smul, horthnext, horth, smul_zero, zero_add, zero_add]
    rw [mul_comm (P (n - 1)) V, hvar]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (L y) n)
      (D (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial (L x) n)) x
proof:
:= by
  let P := fun y => monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n
  let V := monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x
  have hP := hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial hL (hn n (by omega))
  have hV : V.degree ≤ n := (degree_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_lt L n x).le
  have hPdeg (y : ℝ) : (P y).degree = n := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hBdeg : (X * (V * P x + P x * V)).degree < ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
    rw [degree_X]
    have hsum : (V * P x + P x * V).degree ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ) + n := by
      apply (degree_add_le _ _).trans
      apply max_le
      · exact (degree_mul_le _ _).trans (by rw [hPdeg]; exact add_le_add hV le_rfl)
      · exact (degree_mul_le _ _).trans (by rw [hPdeg]; exact add_le_add le_rfl hV)
    apply (add_le_add (le_rfl : (1 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ 1) hsum).trans_lt
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 + (n + n) < 2 * n + 2 by omega)
  have hpoly := (hasCoeffDerivAt_const X x).mul (hP.mul hP)
  simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at hpoly
  have hnum := hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial (d := 2 * n + 2)
    (p := fun y => X * (P y * P y)) (p' := X * (V * P x + P x * V))
    (by intro y; rw [degree_mul, degree_X, degree_mul, hPdeg];
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 + (n + n) < 2 * n + 2 by omega)) hBdeg hpoly hD
  have hcross := functional_X_mul_monic_mul_variation_eq hL hD hn
  have hB : X * (V * P x + P x * V) = C (2 : ℝ) * (X * P x * V) := by
    simp only [map_ofNat]
    ring
  have hBvalue : L x (X * (V * P x + P x * V)) =
      -2 * orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L x) n *
        D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) (n - 1)) := by
    rw [hB, C_mul', map_smul, hcross]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hBvalue] at hnum
  have h := hnum.fun_div (hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm hL hD (hn n (by omega))) hh
  have heq : D (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial (L x) n) =
      ((D (X * (P x * P x)) +
          -2 * orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (L x) n *
            D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) (n - 1))) *
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n -
        L x (X * (P x * P x)) * D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n ^ 2)) /
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n ^ 2 := by
    simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial, mul_sub, map_sub,
      C_mul', map_smul, sub_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) (n - 1))]
    simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha, P, pow_two]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [heq]
  convert h using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp only [orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha, P, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_affine
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_affine
    (L D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (L + t • D) n)
      (D (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L n)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => (L + t • D) (X ^ k)) 0 := by
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact (contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_id.mul contDiffAt_const))
  have hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (L + t • D) (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) 0 := by
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    convert (hasDerivAt_const 0 (L (X ^ k))).fun_add
      ((hasDerivAt_id 0).mul_const (D (X ^ k))) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | simp
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha hL hD
    (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hn)
    (by simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hh)

name: NLAlib.IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic
statement:
theorem IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {p q : 𝕜[X]}
    (hp : IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L n p) (hq : q.Monic) (hqn : q.natDegree = n) :
    L (p * q) = L (p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.monic.ne_zero, hp.natDegree_eq]
  have hqd : q.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero, hqn]
  have hdiff : (p - q).degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [← hpd]
    exact degree_sub_lt_left (hpd.trans hqd.symm) hp.monic.ne_zero
      (hp.monic.leadingCoeff.trans hq.leadingCoeff.symm)
  have h := hp.orthogonal (p - q) hdiff
  rw [mul_sub, map_sub] at h
  simpa only [pow_two] using (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) =
      (X - C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n)) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n -
        C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
  let α := orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n
  let β := orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n
  let r := X * P n - P (n + 1) - C α * P n - C β * P (n - 1)
  have hP (k : ℕ) : (P k).Monic := monic_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k
  have hdeg (k : ℕ) : (P k).degree = k := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (hP k).ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
  have hn := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL n (by omega))
  have hn1 := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)
  have hnorm : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0 := hn.functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (n + 1) le_rfl)
  have halpha : α * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n = L (X * P n ^ 2) := by
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hnorm
  have hdiff : (X * P n - P (n + 1)).degree < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    have hxdeg : (X * P n).degree = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_mul, degree_X, hdeg]
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega)
    exact (degree_sub_lt_left (hxdeg.trans (hdeg (n + 1)).symm)
      (monic_X.mul (hP n)).ne_zero
      ((monic_X.mul (hP n)).leadingCoeff.trans (hP (n + 1)).leadingCoeff.symm)).trans_eq hxdeg
  have hαdeg : (C α * P n).degree < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [C_mul']
    exact (degree_smul_le α (P n)).trans_lt (by rw [hdeg]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  have hβdeg : (C β * P (n - 1)).degree < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [C_mul']
    exact (degree_smul_le β (P (n - 1))).trans_lt (by rw [hdeg]; exact_mod_cast (show n - 1 < n + 1 by omega))
  have hr : r.degree < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) :=
    (degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt
      (max_lt ((degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (max_lt hdiff hαdeg)) hβdeg)
  have hnext (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) : L (P (n + 1) * P i) = 0 := by
    apply hn1.orthogonal
    rw [hdeg]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi)
  have hpair (i j : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      L (P i * P j) = 0 :=
    functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_mul_eq_zero_of_ne L
      (hL i (by omega)) (hL j (by omega)) hij
  have hrpair (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) : L (r * P i) = 0 := by
    have hcomm : X * P n * P i = P n * (X * P i) := by ring
    simp only [r, sub_mul, map_sub, mul_assoc, C_mul', smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← mul_assoc X, hnext i hi]
    by_cases hin : i = n
    · subst i
      rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_two]
      change L (X * P n ^ 2) - 0 - α * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n -
        β * L (P (n - 1) * P n) = 0
      rw [halpha, sub_zero, sub_self, zero_sub]
      by_cases hn0 : n = 0
      · simp [β, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, hn0]
      · rw [hpair (n - 1) n (by omega) le_rfl (by omega), mul_zero, neg_zero]
    · by_cases hiprev : i = n - 1
      · subst i
        have hnp : 0 < n := by omega
        have hX : (X * P (n - 1)).natDegree = n := by
          rw [natDegree_X_mul (hP _).ne_zero, natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial]
          omega
        have hx := hn.functional_mul_eq_sq_of_monic (monic_X.mul (hP (n - 1))) hX
        rw [hcomm, hx, hpair n (n - 1) le_rfl (by omega) (by omega)]
        rw [← pow_two]
        change orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n - 0 - α * 0 -
          β * orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1) = 0
        have hpNorm := (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L
          (hL (n - 1) (by omega))).functional_sq_ne_zero (hL (n - 1 + 1) (by omega))
        change orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1) ≠ 0 at hpNorm
        rw [show β = orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1) by
          simp only [β, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hnp.ne'], div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpNorm]
        ring
      · have hiLow : i + 1 < n := by omega
        have hx : L (P n * (X * P i)) = 0 := by
          apply hn.orthogonal
          rw [degree_mul, degree_X, hdeg]
          exact_mod_cast (show 1 + i < n by omega)
        rw [hcomm, hx, hpair n i le_rfl hi (fun h => hin h.symm),
          hpair (n - 1) i (by omega) hi (fun h => hiprev h.symm)]
        ring
  have hrzero : r = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_orthogonal_of_hankelMomentDet_ne_zero L
      (hL (n + 1) le_rfl) hr
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_of_degree_lt L hs
    rw [← hc, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hrpair i (by have := mem_range.mp hi; omega), smul_zero]
  change P (n + 1) = (X - C α) * P n - C β * P (n - 1)
  dsimp only [r] at hrzero
  linear_combination -hrzero

name: NLAlib.sq_degree_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le
statement:
theorem sq_degree_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le {p : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ} {b δ : ℝ}
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 b, |p.eval x - exp (-x)| ≤ δ) :
    (1 - exp (-1) - 2 * δ) * b / (2 * (1 + δ)) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hb
  have hzero := (abs_le.mp (herr 0 ⟨le_rfl, hbpos.le⟩)).1
  have hone := (abs_le.mp (herr 1 ⟨zero_le_one, hb⟩)).2
  simp only [neg_zero, exp_zero] at hzero
  have hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 b, |p.eval x| ≤ 1 + δ := by
    intro x hx
    have hexp : exp (-x) ≤ 1 := exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith [hx.1])
    calc |p.eval x| = |(p.eval x - exp (-x)) + exp (-x)| := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ |p.eval x - exp (-x)| + |exp (-x)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ δ + 1 := add_le_add (herr x hx) (by rwa [abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)])
      _ = 1 + δ := add_comm _ _
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hslope⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope
    (fun x => p.eval x) (fun x => p.derivative.eval x) zero_lt_one p.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => p.hasDerivAt x)
  simp only [sub_zero, div_one] at hslope
  have hmark := abs_eval_derivative_le_two_mul_sq_div_mul_of_forall_abs_eval_le
    hbpos hp hM (x := ξ) ⟨hξ.1.le, hξ.2.le.trans hb⟩
  have hsep : 1 - exp (-1) - 2 * δ ≤ |p.derivative.eval ξ| := by
    rw [hslope]
    linarith [neg_le_abs (p.eval 1 - p.eval 0)]
  have hbound := hsep.trans hmark
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, sub_zero, le_div_iff₀ hbpos] at hbound
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (1 + δ))]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_div_six_le_degree_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_div_six_le_degree_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le {p : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ} {b δ : ℝ}
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδsmall : δ ≤ 1 / 8) (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 b, |p.eval x - exp (-x)| ≤ δ) :
    √(b / 6) ≤ (q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : exp (-1) ≤ 3 / 8 := by
    rw [exp_neg, ← one_div, div_le_iff₀ (exp_pos 1)]
    linarith [Real.exp_one_gt_d9]
  have hlower := sq_degree_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le hb hδ hp herr
  have hratio : b / 6 ≤ (1 - exp (-1) - 2 * δ) * b / (2 * (1 + δ)) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (1 + δ))]
    have : 0 ≤ b := by linarith
    nlinarith
  have hs := sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ b / 6 by positivity)
  nlinarith [hratio.trans hlower, sqrt_nonneg (b / 6), (Nat.cast_nonneg q : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q)]

name: NLAlib.degree_mul_bound_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_sign_le
statement:
theorem degree_mul_bound_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_sign_le {p : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ} {γ ε M : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγone : γ < 1) (hε : ε < 1) (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval x| ≤ M)
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, γ ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 → |p.eval x - Real.sign x| ≤ ε) :
    (1 - ε) * √(1 - γ ^ 2) / γ ≤ (q : ℝ) * M
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := abs_le.mp (herr γ (by rw [abs_of_pos hγ])
    (by rw [abs_of_pos hγ]; exact hγone.le))
  have hneg := abs_le.mp (herr (-γ) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hγ])
    (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hγ]; exact hγone.le))
  rw [sign_of_pos hγ] at hpos
  rw [sign_of_neg (neg_lt_zero.mpr hγ)] at hneg
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hslope⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope
    (fun x => p.eval x) (fun x => p.derivative.eval x) (show -γ < γ by linarith)
    p.continuous.continuousOn (fun x _ => p.hasDerivAt x)
  have hξabs : |ξ| < γ := abs_lt.mpr hξ
  have hξone : |ξ| < 1 := hξabs.trans hγone
  have hder : (1 - ε) / γ ≤ p.derivative.eval ξ := by
    rw [hslope, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < γ - -γ), div_mul_eq_mul_div,
      div_le_iff₀ hγ]
    nlinarith [hpos.1, hneg.2]
  have hbern := abs_eval_derivative_le_div_sqrt_of_forall_abs_eval_le hp hM hξone
  have hroot : 0 < √(1 - ξ ^ 2) := by
    apply sqrt_pos.mpr
    nlinarith [sq_abs ξ, abs_nonneg ξ]
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hroot] at hbern
  have hsqrt : √(1 - γ ^ 2) ≤ √(1 - ξ ^ 2) := by
    apply sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [sq_abs ξ, abs_nonneg ξ]
  calc (1 - ε) * √(1 - γ ^ 2) / γ = ((1 - ε) / γ) * √(1 - γ ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ ((1 - ε) / γ) * √(1 - ξ ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt
      (div_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr hε).le hγ.le)
    _ ≤ |p.derivative.eval ξ| * √(1 - ξ ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hder.trans (le_abs_self _)) (sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (q : ℝ) * M := hbern

name: NLAlib.inv_mul_eval_T_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem inv_mul_eval_T_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le {a b ε : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hp : p.degree < q)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |p.eval x - 1 / x| ≤ ε) :
    1 / (b * (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := ha.trans hab
  have hε : 0 ≤ ε := (abs_nonneg _).trans (herr a ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩)
  let r : ℝ[X] := 1 - X * p
  have hr : r.degree ≤ q := by
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · simp [r, hp0]
    · have hpn : p.natDegree < q := by
        rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp0] at hp
        exact_mod_cast hp
      apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
      refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) ?_)
      exact natDegree_mul_le.trans (by simp only [natDegree_X]; omega)
  have hr0 : r.eval 0 = 1 := by simp [r]
  have hrbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |r.eval x| ≤ b * ε := by
    intro x hx
    have hxpos : 0 < x := ha.trans_le hx.1
    have heq : r.eval x = -(x * (p.eval x - 1 / x)) := by
      simp only [r, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_mul, eval_X]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hxpos]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (herr x hx) hxpos.le).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx.2 hε)
  have hmin := inv_eval_T_real_le_of_forall_abs_eval_le ha hab hr hr0 hrbound
  calc 1 / (b * (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) =
        (1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) / b := by ring
    _ ≤ ε := (div_le_iff₀ hb).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hmin)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_ratio_pow_div_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_ratio_pow_div_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le {a b ε : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hp : p.degree < q)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |p.eval x - 1 / x| ≤ ε) :
    ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q / b ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hTpos : 0 < (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) := by
    have harg : 1 ≤ (b + a) / (b - a) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hab)]
      linarith
    linarith [one_le_eval_T_real (q : ℤ) harg]
  have hsup := eval_T_real_le_pow (q := q)
    (show 1 ≤ (b + a) / (b - a) by rw [le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hab)]; linarith)
  rw [add_div_sub_add_sqrt_sq_sub_one_eq ha hab] at hsup
  have hρ : 0 < (√b + √a) / (√b - √a) := by
    have := sqrt_lt_sqrt ha.le hab
    positivity
  have hinv : ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q =
      (((√b + √a) / (√b - √a)) ^ q)⁻¹ := by rw [← inv_pow, inv_div]
  have hle : ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q ≤
      1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) := by
    rw [hinv, one_div]
    exact inv_anti₀ hTpos hsup
  calc _ ≤ (1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) / b :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle (ha.le.trans hab.le)
    _ = 1 / (b * (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) := by ring
    _ ≤ ε := inv_mul_eval_T_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le ha hab hp herr

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eq_integral_derivative
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eq_integral_derivative {u v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval u (-1) 1)
    (huv : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv u x = v x)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    chebyshevCoeff u k = 2 / (Real.pi * k) *
      ∫ x in -1..1, v x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : (∫ x in -1..1, u x * deriv (fun t => sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos t)) x) =
      -(k : ℝ) * (∫ x in -1..1, u x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ x in -1..1, u x * (-(k : ℝ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_Ioo_of_le (by norm_num)
        intro x hx
        dsimp only
        rw [(hasDerivAt_sin_mul_arccos k hx).deriv]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro x _
        ring
  have hright : (∫ x in -1..1, deriv u x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)) =
      ∫ x in -1..1, v x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [huv] with x hx hxi
    rw [hx (by simpa using uIoc_subset_uIcc hxi)]
  have hibp := hu.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul (absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_sin_mul_arccos k)
  rw [hleft, hright] at hibp
  simp only [arccos_one, mul_zero, sin_zero, arccos_neg_one, sin_nat_mul_pi,
    sub_zero, zero_sub] at hibp
  have hkreal : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk.ne'
  have hj : (∫ x in -1..1, u x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      (∫ x in -1..1, v x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)) / k := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hkreal).mpr
    linarith [hibp]
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_weighted_integral, if_neg hk.ne', hj]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_sin_arccos_eq
statement:
theorem integral_mul_sin_arccos_eq (v : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in -1..1, v x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)) =
      ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, v (cos θ) * (sin ((k : ℝ) * θ) * sin θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv_of_deriv_nonpos
    (g := fun x => v x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x))
    (f := cos) (f' := fun θ => -sin θ) (a := 0) (b := Real.pi)
    (by fun_prop) (fun θ _ => hasDerivAt_cos θ)
    (fun θ hθ => neg_nonpos.mpr (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi
      (by simpa only [min_eq_left pi_pos.le] using hθ.1.le)
      (by simpa only [max_eq_right pi_pos.le] using hθ.2.le)))
  have hi : (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi,
      ((fun x => v x * sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)) ∘ cos) θ * -sin θ) =
      -(∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, v (cos θ) * (sin ((k : ℝ) * θ) * sin θ)) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro θ hθ
    have ht : θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by simpa only [uIcc_of_le pi_pos.le] using hθ
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, arccos_cos ht.1 ht.2]
    ring
  rw [hi, cos_zero, cos_pi, intervalIntegral.integral_symm (a := -1) (b := 1)] at hs
  exact neg_injective hs.symm

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_bv_cosine
proof:
:= by
  have h : BoundedVariationOn (v ∘ cos) (uIcc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := by
    simpa only [uIcc_of_le pi_pos.le] using boundedVariationOn_comp_cos hv
  exact (intervalIntegrable_of_boundedVariationOn h).mul_continuousOn (by fun_prop)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eq_sub_derivative
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eq_sub_derivative {u v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval u (-1) 1)
    (huv : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv u x = v x)
    (hv : BoundedVariationOn v (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    chebyshevCoeff u k = (chebyshevCoeff v (k - 1) - chebyshevCoeff v (k + 1)) / (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  have hsin : ∀ θ : ℝ, v (cos θ) * (sin ((k : ℝ) * θ) * sin θ) =
      (v (cos θ) * cos (((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ) -
        v (cos θ) * cos (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ)) / 2 := by
    intro θ
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ k), Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [sub_mul, add_mul, one_mul, cos_sub, cos_add]
    ring
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_integral_derivative hu huv (by omega : 0 < k),
    integral_mul_sin_arccos_eq]
  simp_rw [hsin]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (intervalIntegrable_bv_cosine hv (k - 1)) (intervalIntegrable_bv_cosine hv (k + 1))]
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, if_neg (show k - 1 ≠ 0 by omega),
    if_neg (show k + 1 ≠ 0 by omega)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_one_eq_derivative
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_one_eq_derivative {u v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval u (-1) 1)
    (huv : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv u x = v x)
    (hv : BoundedVariationOn v (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
