    chebyshevCoeff u 1 = chebyshevCoeff v 0 - chebyshevCoeff v 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsin : ∀ θ : ℝ, v (cos θ) * (sin ((1 : ℕ) * θ) * sin θ) =
      (v (cos θ) * cos (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ) -
        v (cos θ) * cos (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ)) / 2 := by
    intro θ
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, one_mul, zero_mul, cos_zero]
    rw [cos_two_mul]
    rw [show sin θ * sin θ = 1 - cos θ ^ 2 by nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]]
    ring
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_integral_derivative hu huv (by omega : 0 < (1 : ℕ)),
    integral_mul_sin_arccos_eq]
  simp_rw [hsin]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (intervalIntegrable_bv_cosine hv 0) (intervalIntegrable_bv_cosine hv 2)]
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, ite_true,
    if_neg (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), zero_mul, cos_zero]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_jackson
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_jackson {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, Q.degree ≤ r ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M,
      |‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖ - Q.eval x| ≤
        Real.pi * M / (2 * (r + 1 : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : M = 0
  · subst M
    refine ⟨Polynomial.C ‖z⁻¹‖, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Polynomial.degree_C_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le r)
    · intro x hx
      have hxzero : x = 0 := by linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
      subst x
      simp
  have hMpos : 0 < M := lt_of_le_of_ne hM (Ne.symm hzero)
  have hLip : LipschitzOnWith ⟨z.im⁻¹ ^ 2, by positivity⟩
      (fun x : ℝ => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖) (Set.Icc (-M) M) :=
    (Complex.lipschitzWith_norm_inv_sub_of_im_pos hz).lipschitzOnWith
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hApprox⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval
    (by linarith : -M < M) hLip r
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have h := hApprox x hx
  change |‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖ - Q.eval x| ≤
    Real.pi * (z.im⁻¹ ^ 2) * (M - -M) / (4 * (r + 1 : ℝ)) at h
  have hc : Real.pi * (z.im⁻¹ ^ 2) * (M - -M) / (4 * (r + 1 : ℝ)) =
      Real.pi * M / (2 * (r + 1 : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2) := by
    have hr : (r + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [hz.ne', hr]
    ring
  rwa [hc] at h

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_approximation {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, Q.degree ≤ r ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M,
      |‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖ - Q.eval x| ≤ 6 * M / ((r : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hApprox⟩ := exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_jackson hz M hM r
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, fun x hx => (hApprox x hx).trans ?_⟩
  have hrR : 0 < (r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hr
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (r + 1 : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2)
    (mul_pos hrR (sq_pos_of_pos hz))).mpr
  have hpi : Real.pi * (r : ℝ) ≤ 12 * (r + 1 : ℝ) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Real.pi_lt_four.le hrR.le
    linarith
  convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpi (mul_nonneg hM (sq_nonneg z.im)) using 1 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.quadratic_mem_Icc_of_mem_two_intervals
statement:
theorem quadratic_mem_Icc_of_mem_two_intervals {a b c d x : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) (hlen : d - c = b - a)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b ∪ Icc c d) :
    x ^ 2 - (b + c) * x ∈ Icc (-(b * c)) (-(a * d))
proof:
:= by
  have hends : a + d = b + c := by linarith
  have hupper : -(a * d) - (x ^ 2 - (b + c) * x) = (x - a) * (d - x) := by
    rw [← hends]
    ring
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hx.2)
        (sub_nonpos.mpr (hx.2.trans hbc.le))]
    · have hp := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)
        (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx.2.trans (hbc.le.trans hcd.le)))
      rw [← hupper] at hp
      linarith
  · constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hbc.le.trans hx.1))
        (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.1)]
    · have hp := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hab.le.trans (hbc.le.trans hx.1)))
        (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2)
      rw [← hupper] at hp
      linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_eval_le_on_two_intervals
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_eval_le_on_two_intervals {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hb : b < 0) (hc : 0 < c) (hcd : c < d)
    (hlen : d - c = b - a) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * k : ℕ) ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b ∪ Icc c d,
        |p.eval x| ≤ 2 * ((√|a * d| - √|b * c|) / (√|a * d| + √|b * c|)) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a < 0 := hab.trans hb
  have hd : 0 < d := hc.trans hcd
  have hbc : b < c := hb.trans hc
  have hα : 0 < -(b * c) := neg_pos.mpr (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hb hc)
  have hβ : -(b * c) < -(a * d) := by
    have hprod := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) (sub_pos.mpr (hab.trans hbc))
    nlinarith
  let H : ℝ[X] := X ^ 2 - C (b + c) * X
  let p := (chebyshevResidual (-(b * c)) (-(a * d)) k).comp H
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
    have hH : H.natDegree ≤ 2 := by dsimp [H]; compute_degree
    have hr := natDegree_le_of_degree_le
      (degree_chebyshevResidual_le (-(b * c)) (-(a * d)) k)
    exact natDegree_comp_le.trans (by nlinarith)
  · simpa [p, H] using (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero (q := k) hα hβ)
  · intro x hx
    have hmem := quadratic_mem_Icc_of_mem_two_intervals hab hbc hcd hlen hx
    have hbound := abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow k hα hβ hmem
    simpa [p, H, abs_of_neg (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos ha hd),
      abs_of_neg (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hb hc)] using hbound

name: NLAlib.continuous_chebyshevCircleFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_chebyshevCircleFunction {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ)
    (hFc : ContinuousOn F (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)) : Continuous (chebyshevCircleFunction F)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ∀ θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ‖fourier 1 θ‖ = 1 :=
    fun θ => Circle.norm_coe _
  have hne : ∀ θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), fourier 1 θ ≠ 0 := by
    intro θ
    exact norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [hnorm]; norm_num)
  have hJ : Continuous (fun θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => joukowski (fourier 1 θ)) := by
    unfold joukowski
    exact ((fourier 1).continuous.add ((fourier 1).continuous.inv₀ hne)).div_const 2
  exact hFc.comp_continuous hJ (fun θ =>
    joukowski_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse (by rw [hnorm]; exact ⟨le_rfl, hρ⟩))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCircleFunction_coe_eq_cos
statement:
theorem chebyshevCircleFunction_coe_eq_cos (F : ℂ → ℂ) (θ : ℝ) :
    chebyshevCircleFunction F (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = F (Real.cos θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCircleFunction, fourier_one_eq_circleMap]
  have hn : ‖circleMap (0 : ℂ) 1 θ‖ = 1 := by simp
  rw [joukowski_eq_re_of_norm_eq_one hn]
  congr 1
  simp [circleMap, Complex.exp_mul_I]

name: NLAlib.fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_eq_circleIntegral (F : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ) =
      (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ w in C(0, 1), F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierCoeff_eq_intervalIntegral _ _ 0, zero_add, circleIntegral]
  have heq : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      deriv (circleMap (0 : ℂ) 1) θ •
        (F (joukowski (circleMap 0 1 θ)) / circleMap 0 1 θ ^ (k + 1)) =
        I * (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) •
          chebyshevCircleFunction F θ) := by
    intro θ
    rw [deriv_circleMap, ← fourier_one_eq_circleMap, fourier_neg,
      fourier_nat_eq_pow]
    have hn : ‖fourier 1 (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))‖ = 1 := Circle.norm_coe _
    have hz : fourier 1 (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) ≠ 0 :=
      norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [hn]; norm_num)
    rw [map_pow, ← Complex.inv_eq_conj hn, inv_pow, pow_succ]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, chebyshevCircleFunction]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [heq]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
  have hπ : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff
statement:
theorem chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff (F : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevComplexCoeff F k = (if k = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 2) *
      fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevComplexCoeff, fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_eq_circleIntegral]

name: NLAlib.abs_two_mul_re_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_two_mul_re_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    |2 * (fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ)).re| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hk
  simpa [chebyshevAnalyticCoeff, chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff,
    Nat.ne_of_gt hk, Complex.mul_re] using h

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCircleFunction_neg
statement:
theorem chebyshevCircleFunction_neg (F : ℂ → ℂ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    chebyshevCircleFunction F (-θ) = chebyshevCircleFunction F θ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevCircleFunction, fourier_one, AddCircle.toCircle_neg, Circle.coe_inv,
    joukowski_inv]

name: NLAlib.fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_neg
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_neg (F : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (-k) =
      fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierCoeff, fourierCoeff]
  have h := MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self
    (fun θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => fourier (-k) θ • chebyshevCircleFunction F θ)
    AddCircle.haarAddCircle
  simp only [fourier_apply_neg, neg_neg, chebyshevCircleFunction_neg] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_nat_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem norm_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_nat_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ)‖ ≤ M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · let r := (1 + ρ) / 2
    have hr : 1 < r ∧ r < ρ := by dsimp [r]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hsub := filledBernsteinEllipse_subset_openBernsteinEllipse hρ hr.2
    have h := norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_zero_le hr.1 (hFd.continuousOn.mono hsub)
      (hFd.mono (interior_subset.trans hsub)) (fun z hz => hM z (hsub hz))
    simpa [chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff] using h
  · have h := norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hk
    rw [chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hk), norm_mul] at h
    norm_num only [norm_ofNat] at h
    rw [mul_div_assoc] at h
    linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖chebyshevComplexCoeff F 0‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  simpa [chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff] using
    norm_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_nat_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM 0

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F 0| ≤ M
proof:
:=
  (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
    (norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM)

name: NLAlib.summable_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem summable_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    Summable (fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F))
proof:
:= by
  have hgeom : Summable (fun k : ℕ => (ρ⁻¹) ^ k) :=
    summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one (by
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < ρ⁻¹)]
      exact (inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hρ)
  have hs_norm : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      ‖fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ)‖) := by
    apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) _ (hgeom.mul_left M)
    intro k
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using
      norm_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_nat_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM k
  have hs_nat := hs_norm.of_norm
  have hs_neg : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (-((k : ℤ) + 1))) := by
    simp_rw [fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_neg]
    exact_mod_cast (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hs_nat
  exact Summable.of_nat_of_neg_add_one hs_nat hs_neg

name: NLAlib.hasSum_fourier_chebyshevCircleFunction_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem hasSum_fourier_chebyshevCircleFunction_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℤ => fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) k • fourier k θ)
      (chebyshevCircleFunction F θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := filledBernsteinEllipse_subset_openBernsteinEllipse (r := 1) hρ hρ
  let g : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℂ) :=
    ⟨chebyshevCircleFunction F, continuous_chebyshevCircleFunction (ρ := 1) le_rfl
      (hFd.continuousOn.mono hsub)⟩
  exact has_pointwise_sum_fourier_series_of_summable
    (f := g) (summable_fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM) θ

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_sin_mul_arccos
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sin_mul_arccos (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos t))
      (-(k : ℝ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)).comp x
    ((hasDerivAt_arccos (ne_of_gt hx.1) (ne_of_lt hx.2)).const_mul (k : ℝ))
  have hT : (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x = cos ((k : ℝ) * arccos x) := by
    calc
      (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x = (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (cos (arccos x)) :=
        congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval t) (cos_arccos hx.1.le hx.2.le).symm
      _ = cos ((k : ℝ) * arccos x) := by simp only [T_real_cos, Int.cast_natCast]
  have hval : cos ((k : ℝ) * arccos x) * ((k : ℝ) * -(1 / √(1 - x ^ 2))) =
      -(k : ℝ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hT]
    simp only [one_div, Real.sqrt_inv]
    ring
  rw [hval] at h
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using h

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_sin_mul_arccos_deriv
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_sin_mul_arccos_deriv (k : ℕ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun x => -(k : ℝ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹)
      volume (-1) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x * √(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹)
      volume (-1) 1 := intervalIntegrable_sqrt_one_sub_sq_inv.continuousOn_mul (by fun_prop)
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using h.const_mul (-(k : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.integral_sin_mul_arccos_deriv
statement:
theorem integral_sin_mul_arccos_deriv (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ t in -1..x, -(k : ℝ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval t * √(1 - t ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hx.1
    (f := fun t => sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos t)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun t ht => hasDerivAt_sin_mul_arccos k ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hx.2⟩)
    ((intervalIntegrable_sin_mul_arccos_deriv k).mono_set (by
      rw [uIcc_of_le hx.1, uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
      exact Icc_subset_Icc_right hx.2))
  simpa only [arccos_neg_one, sin_nat_mul_pi, sub_zero] using h

name: NLAlib.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_sin_mul_arccos
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_sin_mul_arccos (k : ℕ) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun x => sin ((k : ℝ) * arccos x)) (-1) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (intervalIntegrable_sin_mul_arccos_deriv k).absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_intervalIntegral
    (c := -1) (by simp)
  apply absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_congr (f := fun x =>
    ∫ t in -1..x, -(k : ℝ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval t * √(1 - t ^ 2)⁻¹) _ h
  intro x hx
  exact integral_sin_mul_arccos_deriv k (by simpa using hx)

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_le {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) {M : ℝ} (_hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f x| ≤ M) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, ‖fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)‖ ^ 2) ≤ M ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let g : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℂ) :=
    ⟨(fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)),
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf)⟩
  let gLp := g.toLp 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle ℂ
  have hP := hasSum_sq_fourierCoeff gLp
  simp only [gLp, fourierCoeff_toLp] at hP
  have hfinite := hP.summable.sum_le_tsum (s.map ⟨(fun k : ℕ => (k : ℤ)), Nat.cast_injective⟩)
    (fun i hi => sq_nonneg _)
  rw [hP.tsum_eq] at hfinite
  simp only [sum_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk] at hfinite
  refine hfinite.trans ?_
  have hAe : ∀ᵐ t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle, gLp t = g t :=
    g.coeFn_toLp AddCircle.haarAddCircle
  rw [integral_congr_ae (hAe.mono (fun t ht => by rw [ht]))]
  have hgi : Integrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    (g.continuous.norm.pow 2).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hb : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) _
    change ‖(realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)‖ ≤ M
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hM _ (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc t)
  exact (integral_mono hgi (integrable_const (M ^ 2)) hb).trans_eq (by simp)

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_sqrt_card_mul
statement:
theorem sum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_sqrt_card_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) {M : ℝ} (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f x| ≤ M) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f k|) ≤ 2 * √(s.card : ℝ) * M
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff : ∀ k, |chebyshevCoeff f k| ≤
      2 * ‖fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)‖ := by
    intro k
    rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf, abs_mul]
    have hz := Complex.abs_re_le_norm
      (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ))
    split_ifs <;> norm_num <;> nlinarith [norm_nonneg
      (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ))]
  have hsquares : (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f k| ^ 2) ≤ 4 * M ^ 2 := by
    calc (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f k| ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ s, 4 * ‖fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)‖ ^ 2 := by
          apply sum_le_sum
          intro k hk
          nlinarith [hcoeff k, abs_nonneg (chebyshevCoeff f k), norm_nonneg
            (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ))]
      _ = 4 * ∑ k ∈ s, ‖fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [mul_sum]
      _ ≤ 4 * M ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_norm_sq_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_le hf hM0 hM s) (by norm_num)
  have hcauchy := sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq s (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  simp only [mul_one, one_pow, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hcauchy
  have hc := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ s.card by positivity)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f k| := sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsquares (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ s.card by positivity)
  have hsquare : (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f k|) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * √(s.card : ℝ) * M) ^ 2 := by
    calc _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f k| ^ 2) * s.card := hcauchy
      _ ≤ 4 * M ^ 2 * s.card := hmul
      _ = (2 * √(s.card : ℝ) * M) ^ 2 := by simp only [mul_pow, hc]; ring
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ hnonneg (by positivity)).mp hsquare

name: NLAlib.sign_eq_mul_sq_rpow_neg_half
statement:
theorem sign_eq_mul_sq_rpow_neg_half {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Real.sign x = x * (x ^ 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.rpow_neg (sq_nonneg x), ← sqrt_eq_rpow, sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with h | h
  · rw [Real.sign_of_neg h, abs_of_neg h]
    field_simp
  · rw [Real.sign_of_pos h, abs_of_pos h, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx]

name: NLAlib.exists_sign_polynomial_of_bernstein_radius
statement:
theorem exists_sign_polynomial_of_bernstein_radius {γ ρ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hγone : γ < 1) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hr : ρ < (1 + γ) / (1 - γ)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n ∧
      (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).degree ≤ ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, γ ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 →
        |Real.sign x - (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).eval x| ≤
          2 * (bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) / ρ ^ n / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hγ2 : 0 < γ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hγ
  have hγ2one : γ ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hrad : ρ < (√(1 : ℝ) + √(γ ^ 2)) / (√(1 : ℝ) - √(γ ^ 2)) := by
    simpa only [sqrt_one, sqrt_sq hγ.le, add_comm] using hr
  have hm := bernsteinIntervalLower_pos hγ2 hγ2one hρ hrad
  have hml : bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ ≤ bernsteinIntervalUpper (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ := by
    have hs : 0 ≤ ρ + ρ⁻¹ := by positivity
    dsimp [bernsteinIntervalLower, bernsteinIntervalUpper]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr hγ2one).le hs]
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hE⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_rpow_sub_eval_le
    hγ2 hγ2one hρ hrad (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) n
  have hmax : max ((bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))
      ((bernsteinIntervalUpper (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) =
      (bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    max_eq_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hm hml (by norm_num))
  rw [hmax] at hE
  refine ⟨q, hq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
    have hqn := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hq
    have hcomp : (q.comp (X ^ 2)).natDegree ≤ 2 * n := by
      refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
      simp only [natDegree_X_pow]
      omega
    exact natDegree_mul_le.trans (by simp only [natDegree_X]; omega)
  · intro x hxlo hxhi
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by intro hx0; simpa [hx0] using hγ.trans_le hxlo
    have hx2 : x ^ 2 ∈ Icc (γ ^ 2) 1 := by
      rw [Set.mem_Icc]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_abs x, abs_nonneg x]
    have hbound := hE (x ^ 2) hx2
    rw [sign_eq_mul_sq_rpow_neg_half hx0, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_comp, eval_pow,
      eval_X, ← mul_sub, abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (abs_nonneg x)).trans
      (mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) hxhi)

name: NLAlib.bernsteinIntervalLower_sq_one_add
statement:
theorem bernsteinIntervalLower_sq_one_add {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ) = γ ^ 2 * (3 + γ) / 4
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [bernsteinIntervalLower]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_sign_polynomial_abs_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_sign_polynomial_abs_sub_eval_le {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hγone : γ < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n ∧
      (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).degree ≤ ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, γ ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 →
        |Real.sign x - (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).eval x| ≤
          (4 / (√3 * γ ^ 2)) / (1 + γ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 1 + γ < (1 + γ) / (1 - γ) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hγone)]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hd, hE⟩ := exists_sign_polynomial_of_bernstein_radius
    hγ hγone (by linarith) hr n
  have hm : 0 < bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ) := by
    rw [bernsteinIntervalLower_sq_one_add hγ]
    positivity
  have hs : √3 * γ / 2 ≤ √(bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ)) := by
    have hs3 : √(3 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 3 := sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hsm := sq_sqrt hm.le
    rw [bernsteinIntervalLower_sq_one_add hγ] at hsm ⊢
    nlinarith [sqrt_nonneg (3 : ℝ), sqrt_nonneg (γ ^ 2 * (3 + γ) / 4)]
  have hspos : 0 < √(bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ)) := sqrt_pos.mpr hm
  have hs3pos : 0 < √(3 : ℝ) := sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hconst : 2 / √(bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ)) / γ ≤ 4 / (√3 * γ ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hspos hγ) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hγ.le]
  refine ⟨q, hq, hd, fun x hxlo hxhi => (hE x hxlo hxhi).trans ?_⟩
  have heq : 2 * (bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ)) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) /
      (1 + γ) ^ n / ((1 + γ) - 1) =
      (2 / √(bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 (1 + γ)) / γ) / (1 + γ) ^ n := by
    rw [rpow_neg hm.le, ← sqrt_eq_rpow]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hconst (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.isCompact_chebyshevCube
statement:
theorem isCompact_chebyshevCube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] :
    IsCompact (chebyshevCube ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ι => Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ => isCompact_Icc)
  convert hc.image (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _) using 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨WithLp.ofLp x, fun i _ => hx i, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact fun i => hy i (Set.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_ae_mem_chebyshevCube_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem integrable_of_ae_mem_chebyshevCube_of_continuousOn
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ chebyshevCube ι) {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (chebyshevCube ι)) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hf.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) isCompact_chebyshevCube
  rwa [IntegrableOn, Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hμ] at hi

name: NLAlib.filledBernsteinEllipse_subset_openBernsteinEllipse
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨w, ⟨?_, hw.2.trans_lt hrρ⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hρ |>.trans_le hw.1

name: NLAlib.joukowski_inv
statement: theorem joukowski_inv (w : ℂ) : joukowski w⁻¹ = joukowski w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [joukowski, inv_inv, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.joukowski_eq_re_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem joukowski_eq_re_of_norm_eq_one {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) :
    joukowski w = (w.re : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [joukowski, Complex.inv_eq_conj hw, Complex.add_conj]
  push_cast
  ring

name: NLAlib.ofReal_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem ofReal_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ x : ℝ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : (x : ℂ) ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ
proof:
:= by
  let w : ℂ := ⟨x, Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)⟩
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one x).mpr (abs_le.mpr hx)
  have hnorm : ‖w‖ = 1 := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hx2)
    have hn : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, w]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
  refine ⟨w, ?_, joukowski_eq_re_of_norm_eq_one hnorm⟩
  change 1 ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ ρ
  rw [hnorm]
  exact ⟨le_rfl, hρ⟩

name: NLAlib.joukowski_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem joukowski_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} {w : ℂ}
    (hw : 1 ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ ρ) : joukowski w ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ
proof:
:=
  ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.hasStrictDerivAt_joukowski
statement:
theorem hasStrictDerivAt_joukowski {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    HasStrictDerivAt joukowski ((1 - (w ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2) w
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasStrictDerivAt_id w).add (hasStrictDerivAt_inv hw)).const_smul ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹)
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  · funext z
    simp only [joukowski, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.add_apply, id_eq]
    ring
  · simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: NLAlib.joukowski_deriv_ne_zero
statement:
theorem joukowski_deriv_ne_zero {w : ℂ} (hw : 1 < ‖w‖) :
    (1 - (w ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hw))
  have hw2 : w ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hn := congrArg norm h
    simp only [norm_pow, norm_one] at hn
    nlinarith
  apply div_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  intro h
  have hinv : (w ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := by linear_combination -h
  have hp := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => z * w ^ 2) hinv
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hw0), one_mul] at hp
  exact hw2 hp.symm

name: NLAlib.joukowski_mem_interior_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem joukowski_mem_interior_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} {w : ℂ}
    (hw : 1 < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < ρ) : joukowski w ∈ interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let S := {z : ℂ | 1 < ‖z‖ ∧ ‖z‖ < ρ}
  have hS : IsOpen S := (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
    (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hmem : S ∈ 𝓝 w := hS.mem_nhds hw
  have hImage : joukowski '' S ∈ Filter.map joukowski (𝓝 w) := Filter.image_mem_map hmem
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hw.1))
  rw [(hasStrictDerivAt_joukowski hw0).map_nhds_eq (joukowski_deriv_ne_zero hw.1)] at hImage
  apply mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset hImage ?_
  rintro z ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  exact joukowski_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse ⟨hu.1.le, hu.2.le⟩

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_joukowski_closed_annulus
statement:
theorem continuousOn_joukowski_closed_annulus (ρ : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn joukowski (closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ \ ball 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousOn.div_const
  apply continuousOn_id.add
  apply continuousOn_id.inv₀
  intro w hw hzero
  change w = 0 at hzero
  have h := hw.2
  norm_num [hzero] at h

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_comp_joukowski_closed_annulus
proof:
:= by
  refine hF.comp (continuousOn_joukowski_closed_annulus ρ) ?_
  intro w hw
  apply joukowski_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, mem_closedBall, mem_ball, dist_zero_right, not_lt] at hw
  exact ⟨hw.2, hw.1⟩

name: NLAlib.differentiableAt_comp_joukowski_open_annulus
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_comp_joukowski_open_annulus {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℝ}
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)))
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) ρ \ closedBall 0 1) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (F ∘ joukowski) w
proof:
:= by
  have hw' : 1 < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < ρ := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_sdiff, mem_ball, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le, and_comm] using hw
  have hmem := joukowski_mem_interior_filledBernsteinEllipse hw'
  have hdiff := (hF _ hmem).differentiableAt (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hmem)
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hw'.1))
  exact hdiff.comp w (hasStrictDerivAt_joukowski hw0).hasDerivAt.differentiableAt

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos
statement: theorem chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos (M : ℕ) : 0 < chebyshevJacksonAngle M
proof:
:=
  div_pos pi_pos (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonAngle_lt_pi
statement: theorem chebyshevJacksonAngle_lt_pi (M : ℕ) : chebyshevJacksonAngle M < π
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevJacksonAngle
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < M + 2 by positivity)]
  nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ M from Nat.cast_nonneg M, pi_pos]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonAngle_le_pi_div_three
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonAngle_le_pi_div_three {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    chebyshevJacksonAngle M ≤ π / 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevJacksonAngle
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left pi_pos.le (by norm_num)
  exact_mod_cast (by omega : 3 ≤ M + 2)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonAngle_mul
statement: theorem chebyshevJacksonAngle_mul (M : ℕ) : (M + 2 : ℝ) * chebyshevJacksonAngle M = π
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevJacksonAngle
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.sin_chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos
statement: theorem sin_chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos (M : ℕ) : 0 < sin (chebyshevJacksonAngle M)
proof:
:=
  sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M) (chebyshevJacksonAngle_lt_pi M)

name: NLAlib.sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_mul
statement:
theorem sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_mul (M j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M + 1) :
    2 * (∑ l ∈ range (M + 1 - j),
      chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l * chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M (l + j)) =
      ((M + 2 : ℝ) - j) * cos ((j : ℝ) * chebyshevJacksonAngle M) +
        sin ((j : ℝ) * chebyshevJacksonAngle M) * cot (chebyshevJacksonAngle M)
proof:
:= by
  let θ := chebyshevJacksonAngle M
  let n := M + 1 - j
  have hn : (n : ℝ) = (M : ℝ) + 1 - j := by
    dsimp [n]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hj]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hN : (M + 2 : ℝ) * θ = π := chebyshevJacksonAngle_mul M
  have hs : sin θ ≠ 0 := (sin_chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).ne'
  have hcos := Real.sin_mul_sum_cos n (2 * θ) (((j : ℝ) + 2) * θ)
  have h1 : 2 * θ / 2 = θ := by ring
  have h2 : (n : ℝ) * (2 * θ) / 2 = (n : ℝ) * θ := by ring
  have h3 : ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (2 * θ) / 2 + ((j : ℝ) + 2) * θ = π := by
    rw [hn]
    nlinarith [hN]
  have h4 : (n : ℝ) * θ = π - ((j : ℝ) + 1) * θ := by
    rw [hn]
    nlinarith [hN]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4, sin_pi_sub, cos_pi, mul_neg_one] at hcos
  have hprod (l : ℕ) :
      2 * (chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l * chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M (l + j)) =
        cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) - cos (2 * θ * (l : ℝ) + ((j : ℝ) + 2) * θ) := by
    have ha : (j : ℝ) * θ = (((l + j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ) - (((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have hb : 2 * θ * (l : ℝ) + ((j : ℝ) + 2) * θ =
        (((l + j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ) + (((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [ha, hb, cos_sub, cos_add]
    dsimp [chebyshevJacksonSineWeight, θ]
    ring
  have hsum : 2 * (∑ l ∈ range n,
      chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l * chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M (l + j)) =
      (n : ℝ) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) -
        ∑ l ∈ range n, cos (2 * θ * (l : ℝ) + ((j : ℝ) + 2) * θ) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    simp_rw [hprod]
    rw [sum_sub_distrib, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hadd : sin (((j : ℝ) + 1) * θ) =
      sin ((j : ℝ) * θ) * cos θ + cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) * sin θ := by
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, sin_add]
  change 2 * (∑ l ∈ range n,
      chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l * chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M (l + j)) =
      ((M + 2 : ℝ) - j) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) + sin ((j : ℝ) * θ) * cot θ
  rw [hsum, cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hs)
  have hcos' : sin θ * (∑ l ∈ range n, cos (2 * θ * (l : ℝ) + ((j : ℝ) + 2) * θ)) =
      -(sin ((j : ℝ) * θ) * cos θ + cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) * sin θ) := hcos.trans (congrArg Neg.neg hadd)
  rw [mul_sub, hcos', hn]
  field_simp [hs]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_eq_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_eq_autocorrelation (M j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M + 1) :
    chebyshevJacksonDamping M j = (2 / (M + 2 : ℝ)) *
      ∑ l ∈ range (M + 1 - j), chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l * chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M (l + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping, ← sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_mul M j hj]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_zero (M : ℕ) : chebyshevJacksonDamping M 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (M + 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simp [chebyshevJacksonDamping, hN]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_succ (M : ℕ) : chebyshevJacksonDamping M (M + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping_eq_autocorrelation M (M + 1) le_rfl]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_sq
statement:
theorem sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_sq (M : ℕ) :
    (∑ l ∈ range (M + 1), chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l ^ 2) = (M + 2 : ℝ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_mul M 0 (by omega)
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero, add_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, cos_zero, mul_one,
    sin_zero, sub_zero] at h
  simp_rw [← sq] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_nonneg {M l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ M) :
    0 ≤ chebyshevJacksonSineWeight M l
proof:
:= by
  apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).le)
  have h : ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M + 2 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : l + 1 ≤ M + 2)
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).le).trans_eq
    (chebyshevJacksonAngle_mul M)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_nonneg
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_nonneg {M j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ M + 1) :
    0 ≤ chebyshevJacksonDamping M j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping_eq_autocorrelation M j hj]
  apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
  apply sum_nonneg
  intro l hl
  have hlt := mem_range.mp hl
  exact mul_nonneg (chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_nonneg (by omega))
    (chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_nonneg (by omega))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_one (M : ℕ) :
    chebyshevJacksonDamping M 1 = cos (chebyshevJacksonAngle M)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (sin_chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).ne'
  simp only [chebyshevJacksonDamping, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  field_simp [hs]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_two
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_two (M : ℕ) :
    chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2 =
      (((M : ℝ) + 1) * cos (2 * chebyshevJacksonAngle M) + 1) / (M + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (sin_chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).ne'
  simp only [chebyshevJacksonDamping, Nat.cast_ofNat, sin_two_mul, cos_two_mul,
    cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  field_simp [hs]
  ring

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_congr
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {f g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hfg : EqOn f g (chebyshevCube ι))
    (M : ℕ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator f M r = tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator g M r
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
  rw [hfg hx]

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_nonneg
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, 0 ≤ f x)
    (M : ℕ) {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    0 ≤ tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator f M r
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
  exact mul_nonneg (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr) (hf _ hx)

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_le
statement:
theorem abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, |f x| ≤ B) (M : ℕ)
    {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator f M r| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hI : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => B * tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) := integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop)
  refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hI ?_).trans_eq ?_
  · filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
    have hp := tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hp]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB _ hx) hp).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_const
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_const {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (c : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator (fun _ => c) M r = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator, integral_mul_const, integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel,
    one_mul]

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_eq_approx
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_eq_approx {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (M : ℕ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator f M r = tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r
proof:
:=
  (tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral hf M r).symm

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_eq_approx_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_eq_approx_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (chebyshevCube ι)) (M : ℕ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator f M r = tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := hf.extend_real
  rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_congr hfg, tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_congr hfg]
  exact tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_eq_approx hg.continuous M r

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_sub_le_of_coordinate_lipschitz
statement:
theorem abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_sub_le_of_coordinate_lipschitz
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (L : ι → NNReal)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, ∀ y ∈ chebyshevCube ι,
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = y j) → |f x - f y| ≤ (L i : ℝ) * |x i - y i|)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator f M r - f r| ≤ (6 / M) * ∑ i, (L i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonOperator_eq_approx_of_lipschitzOnWith
    (lipschitzOnWith_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube L hf)]
  exact abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_coordinate_lipschitz L hf hM hr

name: NLAlib.re_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction
statement:
theorem re_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)).re =
      1 / Real.pi * ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, f (cos θ) * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  let g : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℝ := realChebyshevCircleFunction f
  let u : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => f (cos θ) * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
  have hg : Continuous g := continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf
  have hI : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) =>
      fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t * (g t : ℂ)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    ((fourier (-(k : ℤ))).continuous.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hg)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hR := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm hI
  change (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
    (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t * (g t : ℂ)).re ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) =
      (fourierCoeff (fun t => (g t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)).re at hR
  rw [← hR, AddCircle.integral_haarAddCircle,
    ← AddCircle.intervalIntegral_preimage (2 * Real.pi) (-Real.pi)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have hterm : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) *
        (g (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) : ℂ)).re = u θ := by
    intro θ
    rw [fourier_neg, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos]
    dsimp [g, u]
    rw [realChebyshevCircleFunction_coe]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm]
  have hu : Continuous u :=
    (hf.comp_continuous continuous_cos (fun θ => ⟨neg_one_le_cos θ, cos_le_one θ⟩)).mul
      (by fun_prop)
  have heven : ∀ θ, u (-θ) = u θ := by
    intro θ
    simp [u, mul_neg]
  have hreflect : (∫ θ in -Real.pi..0, u θ) = ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, u θ := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (f := u) (a := 0) (b := Real.pi)
    simp only [neg_zero] at h
    simpa only [heven] using h.symm
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume)
    (hu.intervalIntegrable (-Real.pi) 0) (hu.intervalIntegrable 0 Real.pi)
  rw [hreflect] at hsplit
  have hbound : -Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = Real.pi := by ring
  rw [hbound, ← hsplit]
  dsimp [u]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff f k = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) *
      (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, re_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf]
  ring

name: NLAlib.fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_neg
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_neg (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (-k) =
      fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierCoeff, fourierCoeff]
  have h := MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self
    (fun θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) =>
      fourier (-k) θ • (realChebyshevCircleFunction f θ : ℂ)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle
  simp only [fourier_apply_neg, neg_neg, even_realChebyshevCircleFunction] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevAmplifier_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevAmplifier_le (α γ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).degree ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevAmplifier_def, C_mul']
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans (degree_le_natDegree.trans ?_)
  have h1 : (C (1 / α) * X : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans natDegree_X_le
  have : ((T ℝ q).comp (C (1 / α) * X)).natDegree ≤ q := by
    refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
    rw [natDegree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast this

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevAmplifier_self
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevAmplifier_self {α γ : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) :
    (chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).eval (α * (1 + γ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_chebyshevAmplifier, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hα.ne']
  exact div_self (by linarith [one_le_eval_T_real (q : ℤ) (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + γ)])

name: NLAlib.one_le_eval_chebyshevAmplifier
statement:
theorem one_le_eval_chebyshevAmplifier {α γ x : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hx : α * (1 + γ) ≤ x) : 1 ≤ (chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_chebyshevAmplifier]
  have hT := one_le_eval_T_real (q : ℤ) (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + γ)
  have hxa : 1 + γ ≤ x / α := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hα]; linarith
  have hmono := monotoneOn_eval_T_real q (Set.mem_Ici.2 (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + γ))
    (Set.mem_Ici.2 (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x / α)) hxa
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith), one_mul]
  exact hmono

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshevAmplifier_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_chebyshevAmplifier_le {α γ x : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-α) α) :
    |(chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).eval x| ≤ 2 / (1 + √(2 * γ)) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_chebyshevAmplifier]
  have hlow := one_add_sqrt_two_mul_pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real hγ q
  have hpos : 0 < (1 + √(2 * γ)) ^ q := by positivity
  have hT : 0 < (T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ) := by linarith [div_pos hpos two_pos]
  have hxa : |x / α| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hα, div_le_one hα, abs_le]; exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩
  have h1 := abs_eval_T_real_le_one (q : ℤ) hxa
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hT, div_le_div_iff₀ hT hpos]
  calc |(T ℝ q).eval (x / α)| * (1 + √(2 * γ)) ^ q ≤ 1 * (1 + √(2 * γ)) ^ q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hpos.le
    _ ≤ 2 * (T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ) := by linarith

name: NLAlib.inv_eval_T_real_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem inv_eval_T_real_le_two_mul_pow {a b : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    1 / (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) ≤ 2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := sqrt_add_div_sqrt_sub_pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real ha hab q
  have hsa := Real.sqrt_pos.2 ha
  have hsb : √a < √b := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt ha.le hab
  have hρ : 0 < ((√b + √a) / (√b - √a)) ^ q := by
    apply pow_pos; apply div_pos <;> linarith
  have hT : 0 < (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) := by linarith [div_pos hρ two_pos]
  have hinv : (√b - √a) / (√b + √a) = ((√b + √a) / (√b - √a))⁻¹ := by rw [inv_div]
  rw [hinv, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_div_iff₀ hT hρ]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow {a b x : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    |(chebyshevResidual a b q).eval x| ≤ 2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q
proof:
:=
  (abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le ha hab hx).trans (inv_eval_T_real_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab)

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_lt_abs_eval_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_lt_abs_eval_sub_inv_le {a b : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < q ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      |p.eval x - 1 / x| ≤ (2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  set r := chebyshevResidual a b q
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hrs⟩ := exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one
    (degree_chebyshevResidual_le a b q) (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)
  refine ⟨s, hs, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hx.1
  have hev : 1 - r.eval x = x * s.eval x := by
    rw [← eval_one (x := x), ← eval_sub, hrs, eval_mul, eval_X]
  have hval : s.eval x - 1 / x = -(r.eval x / x) := by
    field_simp; linarith
  rw [hval, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_of_pos hxpos]
  have hbound := abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab hx
  calc |r.eval x| / x ≤ |r.eval x| / a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) ha hx.1
    _ ≤ (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) / a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound ha.le
    _ = (2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q := by ring

name: NLAlib.summable_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction
statement:
theorem summable_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) :
    Summable (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : ∀ k : ℕ,
      ‖fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)‖ ≤
        |chebyshevCoeff f k| := by
    intro k
    let z := fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)
    have him : z.im = 0 := im_fourierCoeff_of_even_real _
      (even_realChebyshevCircleFunction f) _
    have hz : z = (z.re : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [him]
    have hc := chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf k
    change chebyshevCoeff f k = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) * z.re at hc
    change ‖z‖ ≤ |chebyshevCoeff f k|
    rw [hz, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, hc]
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · simp [hk]
    · simp only [if_neg hk, abs_mul]
      norm_num only [abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg z.re]
  have hs_nat : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ)) :=
    (Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hbound hs).of_norm
  have hs_neg : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (-((k : ℤ) + 1))) := by
    simp_rw [fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_neg]
    exact_mod_cast (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hs_nat
  exact Summable.of_nat_of_neg_add_one hs_nat hs_neg

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (k : ℤ) *
      fourier (k : ℤ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) +
      (fourierCoeff (fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)) (-(k : ℤ)) *
        fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)))).re =
      chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction_neg, ← mul_add, fourier_neg,
    Complex.add_conj, T_real_cos, re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos,
    chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf, if_neg hk.ne']
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero,
    Int.cast_natCast]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ))
      (f (Real.cos θ))
proof:
:= by
  let g : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℂ) :=
    ⟨(fun t => (realChebyshevCircleFunction f t : ℂ)),
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf)⟩
  let u : ℤ → ℂ := fun k => fourierCoeff g k * fourier k (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
  have hu : HasSum u (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [u, g, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, smul_eq_mul,
      realChebyshevCircleFunction_coe] using
      has_pointwise_sum_fourier_series_of_summable (f := g)
        (summable_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf hs) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
  have hp : Summable (fun k : ℕ => u (k : ℤ)) :=
    hu.summable.comp_injective Nat.cast_injective
  have hn : Summable (fun k : ℕ => u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) :=
    hu.summable.comp_injective (show Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => -((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) by
      intro a b hab
      have h := neg_injective hab
      exact Nat.add_right_cancel (Int.natCast_inj.mp h))
  have hps : Summable (fun k : ℕ => u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hp
  have hsum : (∑' k : ℕ, u (k : ℤ)) + (∑' k : ℕ, u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← hu.tsum_eq]
    exact (tsum_of_nat_of_neg_add_one hp hn).symm
  have hsplit := hp.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  simp only [sum_range_one] at hsplit
  have hpair := Complex.reCLM.hasSum (hps.hasSum.add hn.hasSum)
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))).re =
        chebyshevCoeff f (k + 1) * (T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ) := by
    intro k
    exact re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf (Nat.succ_pos k) θ
  change HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))).re)
    ((∑' k : ℕ, u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + (∑' k : ℕ, u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))).re at hpair
  simp_rw [hterm] at hpair
  have hfull := hpair.zero_add (f := fun k : ℕ =>
    chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ))
  have hzero : chebyshevCoeff f 0 * (T ℝ (0 : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ) = (u 0).re := by
    simp [chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf, u, g]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hfull hsplit
  rw [hzero] at hfull
  have heq : (u 0).re +
      ((∑' k : ℕ, u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + (∑' k : ℕ, u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))).re =
        f (Real.cos θ) := by
    rw [← Complex.add_re, ← add_assoc, hsplit, hsum, Complex.ofReal_re]
  rw [heq] at hfull
  exact hfull

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2] using
    hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos hf hs (Real.arccos x)

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_tsum
statement:
theorem abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_tsum {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |f x - (chebyshevTrunc f n).eval x| ≤ ∑' j, |chebyshevCoeff f (j + (n + 1))|
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x
  have hu : HasSum u (f x) := hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hs hx
  have hsplit := hu.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add (n + 1)
  rw [hu.tsum_eq] at hsplit
  have hp : (chebyshevTrunc f n).eval x = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), u k := by
    simp only [chebyshevTrunc, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, u]
  have herr : f x - (chebyshevTrunc f n).eval x = ∑' j, u (j + (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hp]
    linarith
  have hterm : ∀ j, ‖u (j + (n + 1))‖ ≤ |chebyshevCoeff f (j + (n + 1))| := by
    intro j
    dsimp [u]
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx))
      (abs_nonneg _)).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  have hstail := (summable_nat_add_iff (n + 1)).mpr hs
  have hnorm := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm hstail
  rw [herr, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm).trans (hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hterm hstail)

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => (chebyshevTrunc f n).eval x) f atTop (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : ∀ k x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
      ‖chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x‖ ≤ |chebyshevCoeff f k| := by
    intro k x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx))
      (abs_nonneg _)).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  have hu := tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat hs hbound
  have hshift : TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n x => ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x)
      (fun x => ∑' k, chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) atTop
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := fun v hv => (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1).eventually (hu v hv)
  have heq : EqOn (fun x => ∑' k, chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) f
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := fun x hx => (hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hs hx).tsum_eq
  convert hshift.congr_right heq using 1
  simp only [chebyshevTrunc, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshev_cosine_full_period
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshev_cosine_full_period {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1) 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, f (Real.cos θ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ)) =
      2 * ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, f (Real.cos θ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => f (Real.cos θ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ)
  have hfc : Continuous (fun θ => f (Real.cos θ)) :=
    hf.comp_continuous Real.continuous_cos (fun θ => ⟨Real.neg_one_le_cos θ, Real.cos_le_one θ⟩)
  have hg : Continuous g := hfc.mul ((T ℝ (k : ℤ)).continuous.comp Real.continuous_cos)
  have hreflect := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (f := g)
    (a := Real.pi) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (2 * Real.pi)
  have hsym : ∀ θ, g (2 * Real.pi - θ) = g θ := by
    intro θ
    simp only [g, Real.cos_two_pi_sub]
  simp_rw [hsym] at hreflect
  have heq : (∫ θ in Real.pi..2 * Real.pi, g θ) = ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, g θ := by
    simpa only [sub_self, show 2 * Real.pi - Real.pi = Real.pi by ring] using hreflect
  have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume)
    (hg.intervalIntegrable 0 Real.pi) (hg.intervalIntegrable Real.pi (2 * Real.pi))
  change (∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, g θ) = 2 * ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, g θ
  rw [← hadd, heq]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_eq_chebyshevCoeff
statement:
theorem chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_eq_chebyshevCoeff {F : ℂ → ℂ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1) 1))
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k = chebyshevCoeff f k
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : Continuous (fun θ => f (Real.cos θ)) :=
    hf.comp_continuous Real.continuous_cos (fun θ => ⟨Real.neg_one_le_cos θ, Real.cos_le_one θ⟩)
  have hcircle : ∀ θ : ℝ, chebyshevCircleFunction F (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) =
      (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ) := by
    intro θ
    rw [chebyshevCircleFunction_coe_eq_cos]
    exact hF _ ⟨Real.neg_one_le_cos θ, Real.cos_le_one θ⟩
  have hI : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ =>
      fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) * (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ))
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    exact ((fourier (-(k : ℤ))).continuous.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2 * Real.pi))).mul
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hfc)
  have hreal := Complex.reCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hI
  change (∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) * (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ)).re) =
    (∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) * (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ)).re at hreal
  have hterm : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) * (f (Real.cos θ) : ℂ)).re =
        f (Real.cos θ) * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ) := by
    intro θ
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero,
      sub_zero, fourier_neg, Complex.conj_re, re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos,
      T_real_cos, Int.cast_natCast]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at hreal
  rw [chebyshevAnalyticCoeff, chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff,
    fourierCoeff_eq_intervalIntegral _ _ 0, zero_add]
  simp_rw [hcircle]
  have hnormal (z : ℂ) :
      ((if k = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 2) * ((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) • z)).re =
        (if k = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 2) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * z.re := by
    split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.real_smul]
    ring
  rw [hnormal]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← hreal, integral_chebyshev_cosine_full_period hf k, chebyshevCoeff,
    integral_measureT_eq_integral_cos]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_ofReal_chebyshevCoeff
statement:
theorem chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_ofReal_chebyshevCoeff {F : ℂ → ℂ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1) 1))
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevComplexCoeff F k = (chebyshevCoeff f k : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let g : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℝ := fun θ => (chebyshevCircleFunction F θ).re
  have hreal : chebyshevCircleFunction F = fun θ => (g θ : ℂ) := by
    funext θ
    induction θ using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H θ =>
      change chebyshevCircleFunction F (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) =
        ((chebyshevCircleFunction F (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re : ℂ)
      rw [chebyshevCircleFunction_coe_eq_cos, hF _ ⟨Real.neg_one_le_cos θ, Real.cos_le_one θ⟩]
      simp
  have heven : ∀ θ, g (-θ) = g θ := by
    intro θ
    simp only [g, chebyshevCircleFunction_neg]
  have him := im_fourierCoeff_of_even_real g heven (k : ℤ)
  apply Complex.ext
  · simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re, chebyshevAnalyticCoeff] using
      chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_eq_chebyshevCoeff hf hF k
  · rw [chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff, hreal]
    split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.mul_im, him]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_add
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff, add_mul]
  rw [integral_add (f := fun x => f x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x)
    (g := fun x => g x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x)
    (integrable_measureT (hf.mul (by fun_prop)))
    (integrable_measureT (hg.mul (by fun_prop))), mul_add]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_const_mul
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_const_mul (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x => c * f x) k = c * chebyshevCoeff f k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff]
  simp_rw [mul_assoc]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_sub
proof:
:= by
  have h := chebyshevCoeff_add (g := fun x => (-1 : ℝ) * g x) hf
    (continuousOn_const.mul hg) k
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_const_mul] at h
  simpa only [neg_one_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using h

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eval_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevCoeff_eval_T (j k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x => (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) k = if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff]
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst j
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero]
      rw [integral_eval_T_real_mul_self_measureT_zero]
      simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    · rw [if_neg hk, integral_T_real_mul_self_measureT_of_ne_zero hk, if_pos rfl]
      field_simp
  · rw [integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne hjk, if_neg hjk, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eval_sum_smul_T
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eval_sum_smul_T (c : ℕ → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x => (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), c j • T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) k =
      if k ≤ n then c k else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff, eval_finsetSum, eval_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j hj =>
    integrable_measureT (by fun_prop))]
  simp_rw [mul_assoc, integral_const_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ j, (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi *
      (c j * ∫ x, (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x ∂measureT) =
        c j * (if j = k then 1 else 0) := by
    intro j
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm ((if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi) (c j), mul_assoc,
      ← chebyshevCoeff, chebyshevCoeff_eval_T]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq']

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eval_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eval_eq_zero_of_degree_lt {p : ℝ[X]} {n k : ℕ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ n) (hnk : n < k) : chebyshevCoeff p.eval k = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le hp
  rw [← hc, chebyshevCoeff_eval_sum_smul_T, if_neg (by omega)]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevTrunc_eval_eq_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem chebyshevTrunc_eval_eq_of_degree_le {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ n) : chebyshevTrunc p.eval n = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le hp
  unfold chebyshevTrunc
  rw [← hc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eval_sum_smul_T, if_pos (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)), C_mul']

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevTrunc_le
statement: theorem degree_chebyshevTrunc_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (chebyshevTrunc f n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevTrunc
  refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun k hk => ?_)
  rw [C_mul']
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_zero_le
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevCoeff_zero_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f x| ≤ M) : |chebyshevCoeff f 0| ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := 0) (b := Real.pi) (f := fun θ => f (cos θ) * cos ((0 : ℝ) * θ))
    (C := M) (fun θ hθ => by
      simpa only [zero_mul, cos_zero, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        hM (cos θ) ⟨neg_one_le_cos θ, cos_le_one θ⟩)
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, if_true, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, cos_zero, mul_one]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / Real.pi)]
  simp only [sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, Real.norm_eq_abs, zero_mul, cos_zero,
    mul_one] at hI
  calc 1 / Real.pi * |∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, f (cos θ)| ≤ 1 / Real.pi * (M * Real.pi) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (by positivity)
    _ = M := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := 0) (b := Real.pi) (f := fun θ => f (cos θ) * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ))
    (C := M) (fun θ hθ => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_cos_le_one _) (abs_nonneg _)).trans
        (by simpa only [mul_one] using hM (cos θ) ⟨neg_one_le_cos θ, cos_le_one θ⟩))
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, if_neg hk.ne']
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (2 : ℝ) / Real.pi)]
  simp only [sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hI
  calc 2 / Real.pi * |∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, f (cos θ) * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)| ≤
      2 / Real.pi * (M * Real.pi) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * M := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.eq_chebyshevCoeff_of_hasSum
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : ∀ j x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
      ‖a j * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x‖ ≤ |a j| := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx))
      (abs_nonneg _)).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  have hu := (tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat hs hbound).congr_right
    (fun x hx => (hseries x hx).tsum_eq)
  have hshift : TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n x => ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), a j * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) f atTop
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := fun v hv => (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1).eventually (hu v hv)
  symm
  apply eq_of_forall_dist_le
  intro ε hε
  have hU := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hshift) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hU
  let n := m + k
  let p : ℝ[X] := ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ)
  have hp : chebyshevCoeff p.eval k = a k := by
    rw [chebyshevCoeff_eval_sum_smul_T, if_pos (by dsimp [n]; omega)]
  have hE : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f x - p.eval x| ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hm n (by dsimp [n]; omega) x hx
    simpa only [p, eval_finsetSum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, Real.dist_eq] using h.le
  have hdiff : chebyshevCoeff (fun x => f x - p.eval x) k = chebyshevCoeff f k - a k := by
    rw [chebyshevCoeff_sub hf (by fun_prop), hp]
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · have h := abs_chebyshevCoeff_zero_le hE
    rw [hdiff] at h
    linarith
  · have h := abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_two_mul hE hk
    rw [hdiff] at h
    linarith

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_lipschitzOnWith
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := (√(2 : ℝ))⁻¹
  have hrootpos : 0 < √(2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hrootgt : 1 < √(2 : ℝ) := by nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hq1 : q < 1 := (inv_lt_one₀ hrootpos).mpr hrootgt
  have hsqrtpow : ∀ j : ℕ, √((2 : ℝ) ^ j) = (√(2 : ℝ)) ^ j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), ih, pow_succ]
  have hblock : ∀ j, ∑ k ∈ Ico (2 ^ j) (2 ^ (j + 1)),
      |chebyshevCoeff f (k + 1)| ≤ (Real.pi * (L : ℝ)) * q ^ j := by
    intro j
    let n : ℕ := 2 ^ j
    have hn : 0 < n := by dsimp [n]; positivity
    have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hE⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_unit hf n
    let M : ℝ := Real.pi * (L : ℝ) / (2 * n)
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
    have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f x - p.eval x| ≤ M := by
      intro x hx
      refine (hE x hx).trans ?_
      dsimp [M]
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
      linarith
    let s : Finset ℕ := Ico n (2 * n)
    let shift : ℕ ↪ ℕ := ⟨(fun k => k + 1), fun a b h => Nat.add_right_cancel h⟩
    have hcf : ∀ k ∈ s, chebyshevCoeff (fun x => f x - p.eval x) (k + 1) =
        chebyshevCoeff f (k + 1) := by
      intro k hk
      rw [chebyshevCoeff_sub hf.continuousOn p.continuous.continuousOn,
        chebyshevCoeff_eval_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hp (by
          have hk' : n ≤ k := (mem_Ico.mp hk).1
          omega), sub_zero]
    have hfinite := sum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_sqrt_card_mul
      (hf.continuousOn.sub p.continuous.continuousOn) hM0 hbound (s.map shift)
    rw [sum_map] at hfinite
    change (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff (fun x => f x - p.eval x) (k + 1)|) ≤
      2 * √((s.map shift).card : ℝ) * M at hfinite
    have hsum : (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff (fun x => f x - p.eval x) (k + 1)|) =
        ∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f (k + 1)| := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [hcf k hk]
    rw [hsum] at hfinite
    have hcard : (s.map shift).card = n := by simp [s]; omega
    rw [hcard] at hfinite
    have hupper : 2 ^ (j + 1) = 2 * n := by dsimp [n]; rw [pow_succ]; omega
    rw [hupper]
    change (∑ k ∈ s, |chebyshevCoeff f (k + 1)|) ≤ _
    refine hfinite.trans_eq ?_
    have hncast : (n : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ j := by simp [n]
    have hroot : √(n : ℝ) = √(2 : ℝ) ^ j := by rw [hncast, hsqrtpow]
    have hden : (n : ℝ) = (√(2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hroot, Real.sq_sqrt hnR.le]
    dsimp [M, q]
    rw [hroot, hden, inv_pow]
    field_simp
  have hs := summable_of_dyadic_block_sum_le_geometric
    (a := fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f (k + 1)|) (fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
    (C := Real.pi * (L : ℝ)) (by positivity) hq0 hq1 hblock
  exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp hs

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_lipschitzOnWith
proof:
:=
  hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf.continuousOn (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_lipschitzOnWith hf) hx

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc_of_lipschitzOnWith
proof:
:=
  tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc hf.continuousOn (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_lipschitzOnWith hf)

name: NLAlib.sum_eval_converseDifference
statement:
private theorem sum_eval_converseDifference (q : ℕ → ℂ[X]) (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (converseDifference q j).eval z = (q n).eval z
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [converseDifference]
  | succ n ih => rw [sum_range_succ, ih]; simp [converseDifference]

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_converseDifference_succ_le
statement:
private theorem norm_eval_converseDifference_succ_le {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    {C ρ r : ℝ} (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hE : ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ C / ρ ^ n)
    (n : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse r) :
    ‖(converseDifference q (n + 1)).eval z‖ ≤ C * (1 + ρ) * (r / ρ) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (converseDifference q (n + 1)).degree ≤ (n + 1 : ℕ) := by
    dsimp only [converseDifference]
    exact (degree_sub_le _ _).trans
      (max_le (hq _) ((hq n).trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n)))
  have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖(converseDifference q (n + 1)).eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ C * (1 + ρ) / ρ ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [converseDifference, eval_sub]
    calc ‖(q (n + 1)).eval (x : ℂ) - (q n).eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤
          ‖(q (n + 1)).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ + ‖f x - (q n).eval (x : ℂ)‖ :=
            by
              have heq : (q (n + 1)).eval (x : ℂ) - (q n).eval (x : ℂ) =
                  ((q (n + 1)).eval (x : ℂ) - f x) + (f x - (q n).eval (x : ℂ)) := by ring
              rw [heq]
              exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ C / ρ ^ (n + 1) + C / ρ ^ n := by
        rw [norm_sub_rev (f x)]
        exact add_le_add (hE _ _ hx) (hE _ _ hx)
      _ = C * (1 + ρ) / ρ ^ (n + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
  have hw := norm_eval_le_mul_pow_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hd hbound hz
  convert hw using 1
  rw [div_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_holomorphic_extension_of_geometric_polynomial_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_geometric_polynomial_approximation
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {C ρ : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hE : ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ C / ρ ^ n) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F (x : ℂ) = f x) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => (converseDifference q n).eval z
  let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' n, D n z
  have hs : SummableLocallyUniformlyOn D (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    apply SummableLocallyUniformlyOn_of_locally_bounded (isOpen_openBernsteinEllipse hρ)
    intro K hsub hK
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrρ, hKr⟩ := exists_lt_radius_subset_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ hK hsub
    let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n = 0 then ‖(q 0).coeff 0‖
      else C * (1 + ρ) * (r / ρ) ^ n
    have hratio0 : 0 ≤ r / ρ := by positivity
    have hratio1 : r / ρ < 1 := (div_lt_one (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hrρ
    have hu : Summable u := by
      apply (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
      have hgeo := (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hratio0 hratio1).mul_left (C * (1 + ρ))
      simpa only [u, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false, if_false] using
        (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hgeo
    refine ⟨u, hu, fun n z hz => ?_⟩
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hq0 : q 0 = Polynomial.C ((q 0).coeff 0) := eq_C_of_degree_le_zero (hq 0)
      simp only [D, converseDifference, u, if_pos rfl]
      rw [hq0, eval_C]
      simp
    | succ n =>
      simpa only [D, u, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false] using
        norm_eval_converseDifference_succ_le hC hρ hr.le hq hE n (hKr hz)
  have hsum := hs.hasSumLocallyUniformlyOn.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_finsetRange
  have hshift : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n z => ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), D j z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    intro u hu x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := hsum u hu x hx
    exact ⟨t, ht, (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1).eventually h⟩
  have hlimit : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop
      (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    apply hshift.congr
    intro n z hz
    exact sum_eval_converseDifference q n z
  refine ⟨F, hlimit.differentiableOn (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (q n).differentiableOn)
    (isOpen_openBernsteinEllipse hρ), ?_, hlimit⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxellipse := ofReal_mem_openBernsteinEllipse hρ hx
  have hpoint := hlimit.tendsto_at hxellipse
  have hrate : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C / ρ ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hinv : |ρ⁻¹| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)), inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)]
      exact hρ
    have hh := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one hinv).const_mul C
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow, mul_zero] using hh
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun n => ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => hE n x hx) hrate
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hpoint ((tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero).mpr hnorm)

name: NLAlib.exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_rates
statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_rates
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hE : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < ρ → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ C / s ^ n) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F (x : ℂ) = f x) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => (converseDifference q n).eval z
  let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' n, D n z
  have hs : SummableLocallyUniformlyOn D (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    apply SummableLocallyUniformlyOn_of_locally_bounded (isOpen_openBernsteinEllipse hρ)
    intro K hsub hK
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrρ, hKr⟩ := exists_lt_radius_subset_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ hK hsub
    obtain ⟨s, hrs, hsρ⟩ := exists_between hrρ
    have hs1 : 1 < s := hr.trans hrs
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hEs⟩ := hE s hs1 hsρ
    let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n = 0 then ‖(q 0).coeff 0‖
      else C * (1 + s) * (r / s) ^ n
    have hratio0 : 0 ≤ r / s := by positivity
    have hratio1 : r / s < 1 := (div_lt_one (zero_lt_one.trans hs1)).mpr hrs
    have hu : Summable u := by
      apply (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
      have hgeo := (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hratio0 hratio1).mul_left (C * (1 + s))
      simpa only [u, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false, if_false] using
        (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hgeo
    refine ⟨u, hu, fun n z hz => ?_⟩
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hq0 : q 0 = Polynomial.C ((q 0).coeff 0) := eq_C_of_degree_le_zero (hq 0)
      simp only [D, converseDifference, u, if_pos rfl]
      rw [hq0, eval_C]
      simp
    | succ n =>
      simpa only [D, u, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false] using
        norm_eval_converseDifference_succ_le hC hs1 hr.le hq hEs n (hKr hz)
  have hsum := hs.hasSumLocallyUniformlyOn.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_finsetRange
  have hshift : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n z => ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), D j z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    intro u hu x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := hsum u hu x hx
    exact ⟨t, ht, (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1).eventually h⟩
  have hlimit : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop
      (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    apply hshift.congr
    intro n z hz
    exact sum_eval_converseDifference q n z
  refine ⟨F, hlimit.differentiableOn (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (q n).differentiableOn)
