    (isOpen_openBernsteinEllipse hρ), ?_, hlimit⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs1, hsρ⟩ := exists_between hρ
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hEs⟩ := hE s hs1 hsρ
  have hpoint := hlimit.tendsto_at (ofReal_mem_openBernsteinEllipse hρ hx)
  have hrate : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C / s ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hinv : |s⁻¹| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans hs1)), inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hs1)]
      exact hs1
    have hh := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one hinv).const_mul C
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow, mul_zero] using hh
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun n => ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => hEs n x hx) hrate
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hpoint ((tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero).mpr hnorm)

name: NLAlib.geometric_bound_of_root_limsup_le
statement:
theorem geometric_bound_of_root_limsup_le {e : ℕ → ℝ} {ρ s : ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hs : 1 < s) (hsρ : s < ρ)
    (hlim : limsup (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (e n ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹))) atTop ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ρ⁻¹) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n, e n ≤ C / s ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : 0 < s := zero_lt_one.trans hs
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := zero_lt_one.trans hρ
  have hinv : ρ⁻¹ < s⁻¹ := (inv_lt_inv₀ hρ0 hs0).mpr hsρ
  have hroot := eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt
    (hlim.trans_lt ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (inv_pos.mpr hs0)).mpr hinv))
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hroot
  let C : ℝ := 1 + ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), e n * s ^ n
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := by
    dsimp only [C]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sum_nonneg fun n _ => mul_nonneg (he n) (pow_nonneg hs0.le n))
  refine ⟨C, zero_le_one.trans hC1, fun n => ?_⟩
  by_cases hn : n ≤ N
  · have hterm : e n * s ^ n ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), e j * s ^ j :=
      single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (he j) (pow_nonneg hs0.le j))
        (mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hs0 n)).mpr (hterm.trans (by dsimp only [C]; linarith))
  · have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hrootn : e n ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) < s⁻¹ :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (inv_pos.mpr hs0)).mp (hN n (by omega))
    have hpow : e n ≤ (s⁻¹) ^ n := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (he n) hn0]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg (he n) _) hrootn.le n
    calc e n ≤ 1 / s ^ n := by simpa only [inv_pow, one_div] using hpow
      _ ≤ C / s ^ n := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC1 (pow_nonneg hs0.le n)

name: NLAlib.exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_limsup
statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_limsup
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {e : ℕ → ℝ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hE : ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ e n)
    (hlim : limsup (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (e n ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹))) atTop ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ρ⁻¹) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F (x : ℂ) = f x) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_rates hρ hq
  intro s hs hsρ
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := geometric_bound_of_root_limsup_le he hρ hs hsρ hlim
  exact ⟨C, hC, fun n x hx => (hE n x hx).trans (hbound n)⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_norm_limsup
statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_norm_limsup
    (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℂ)) {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hlim : limsup (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal
      (‖(⟨fun x : Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 => (q n).eval (x : ℂ), by fun_prop⟩ :
          C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℂ)) - f‖ ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹))) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ⁻¹) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1), F (x : ℂ) = f ⟨x, hx⟩) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let p : ℕ → C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℂ) := fun n =>
    ⟨fun x => (q n).eval (x : ℂ), by fun_prop⟩
  have hE : ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
      ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f x‖ ≤ ‖p n - f‖ := by
    intro n x hx
    rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx]
    exact (p n - f).norm_coe_le_norm ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFx, hconv⟩ :=
    exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_limsup
      (f := IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f) (e := fun n => ‖p n - f‖)
      hρ hq (fun n => norm_nonneg _) hE hlim
  exact ⟨F, hF, fun x hx => by simpa only [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx] using hFx x hx, hconv⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_T_even_sin
statement:
theorem eval_T_even_sin (j : ℕ) (u : ℂ) :
    (T ℂ (2 * j : ℕ)).eval (Complex.sin u) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^j * Complex.cos (2 * (j : ℂ) * u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.cos_pi_div_two_sub, T_complex_cos]
  simp only [Int.cast_natCast]
  have he : ((2 * j : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((Real.pi : ℂ) / 2 - u) =
      ((j * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) - 2 * (j : ℂ) * u := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, Complex.cos_sub, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin,
    Real.cos_nat_mul_pi, Real.sin_nat_mul_pi]
  simp

name: NLAlib.chebyshevTrunc_abs_succ_even
statement:
private theorem chebyshevTrunc_abs_succ_even (m : ℕ) :
    chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (m + 1)) =
      chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * m) +
        C (chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (m + 1))) *
          T ℝ (2 * (m + 1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevTrunc
  rw [show 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = (2 * m + 1) + 1 + 1 by omega,
    sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, chebyshevCoeff_abs_odd]
  simp only [C_0, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [show 2 * m + 1 + 1 = 2 * (m + 1) by omega]

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevTrunc_abs_even_sin
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevTrunc_abs_even_sin (m : ℕ) (u : ℂ) :
    ((chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * m)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval
      (Complex.sin u) =
      (2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)) : ℝ) +
        (4 / Real.pi : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ range m,
          (1 - Complex.cos (2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u)) /
            (4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [chebyshevTrunc]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [chebyshevTrunc_abs_succ_even, Polynomial.map_add, eval_add, ih,
      Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, map_T, eval_mul, eval_C,
      chebyshevCoeff_abs_even (by omega), eval_T_even_sin, sum_range_succ]
    have hsign : (-1 : ℂ)^(m + 1 + 1) * (-1 : ℂ)^(m + 1) = -1 := by
      rw [pow_succ, mul_right_comm, ← mul_pow]
      norm_num
    have hd : 4 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m + 1 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos m
      have h : (4 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 - 1) ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast h
    have hπ : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
    have hd0 : ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * m + 1 ≠ 0 by omega)
    have hd1 : ((2 * (m + 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 2 * (m + 1) + 1 ≠ 0 by omega)
    have hterm : Complex.ofRealHom (4 / Real.pi * (-1 : ℝ)^(m + 1 + 1) /
        (4 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 - 1)) *
          ((-1 : ℂ)^(m + 1) * Complex.cos (2 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u)) =
        -(4 / (Real.pi : ℂ)) * Complex.cos (2 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u) /
          (4 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1) := by
      set H := Complex.cos (2 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u)
      simp only [Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe]
      push_cast
      linear_combination 4 / (Real.pi : ℂ) * H /
        (4 * ((m : ℂ) + 1)^2 - 1) * hsign
    rw [hterm]
    set S : ℂ := ∑ j ∈ range m,
      (1 - Complex.cos (2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u)) /
        (4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1)
    push_cast
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one] at hd hd0 hd1
    field_simp [hπ, hd, hd0, hd1]
    ring

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_chebyshevTrunc_abs_even_sin_le
statement:
theorem norm_eval_chebyshevTrunc_abs_even_sin_le (m : ℕ) (u : ℂ) :
    ‖((chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * m)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval
      (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤
      2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)) +
        8 * m / (3 * Real.pi) * ‖u‖^2 * Real.exp ((2 * m : ℕ) * |u.im|)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range m) :
      ‖(1 - Complex.cos (2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u)) /
          (4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1)‖ ≤
        (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ‖u‖^2 * Real.exp ((2 * m : ℕ) * |u.im|) := by
    have hjm : j + 1 ≤ m := by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega
    have hj1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos j
    have hd : 0 < 4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 - 1 := by nlinarith
    have hden : ‖(4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1)‖ =
        4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 - 1 := by
      have he : 4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^2 - 1 =
          ((4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [he, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hd]
    have hn : ‖2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u‖^2 / 2 =
        2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 * ‖u‖^2 := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_natCast]
      ring
    have hi : |(2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u).im| =
        2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * |u.im| := by
      norm_num [Complex.mul_im, Complex.mul_re, abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
      exact Or.inl (by positivity)
    have harg : 2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * |u.im| ≤
        ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * |u.im| := by
      have h : ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hjm
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hc := Complex.norm_one_sub_cos_le_norm_sq_mul_exp_abs_im
      (2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u)
    rw [hn, hi] at hc
    have hc' := hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr harg) (by positivity))
    have hratio : 2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 /
        (4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 - 1) ≤ 2 / 3 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
      nlinarith
    rw [norm_div, hden]
    refine (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hc' hd.le).trans ?_
    have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio
      (show 0 ≤ ‖u‖^2 * Real.exp ((2 * m : ℕ) * |u.im|) by positivity)
    convert hbound using 1 <;> ring
  have hs := (norm_sum_le (range m) _).trans (sum_le_sum hterm)
  simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hs
  rw [eval_chebyshevTrunc_abs_even_sin]
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
  have hπ : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)) := by positivity
  have hc4 : 0 ≤ 4 / Real.pi := by positivity
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hc0,
    Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hc4]
  have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hc4
  convert add_le_add_left hbound (2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1))) using 1 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.sum_choose_int_sub_two_mul_succ
statement:
theorem sum_choose_int_sub_two_mul_succ {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (f : ℤ → R) (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (s + 2), ((s + 1).choose j : R) * f ((s + 1 : ℕ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : R) *
        (f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) + 1) + f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show s + 2 = (s + 1) + 1 by omega, sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.cast_add,
    Int.natCast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hsplit : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ((s + 1).choose (j + 1) : R) * f ((s : ℤ) + 1 - 2 * ((j : ℤ) + 1)) =
        (s.choose j : R) * f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) - 1) +
        (s.choose (j + 1) : R) * f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * ((j : ℤ) + 1) + 1) := by
    intro j
    have h1 : (s : ℤ) + 1 - 2 * ((j : ℤ) + 1) = (s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) - 1 := by ring
    have h2 : (s : ℤ) - 2 * ((j : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = (s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) - 1 := by ring
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.cast_add, h1, h2, add_mul]
  simp_rw [hsplit, sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
  rw [sum_add_distrib]
  have hshift : (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose (j + 1) : R) *
      f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * ((j : ℤ) + 1) + 1)) + f ((s : ℤ) + 1) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : R) * f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) + 1) := by
    have h := sum_range_succ' (fun j => (s.choose j : R) *
      f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) + 1)) (s + 1)
    rw [sum_range_succ] at h
    simpa using h.symm
  simp only [mul_add] at hshift
  rw [add_assoc, hshift, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.sum_choose_mul_chebyshev_eq_two_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem sum_choose_mul_chebyshev_eq_two_mul_X_pow (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), C (s.choose j : ℝ) * T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))) =
      (2 * X : ℝ[X]) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => simp
  | succ s ih =>
    simp_rw [C_eq_natCast]
    rw [sum_choose_int_sub_two_mul_succ]
    have hrec : ∀ r : ℤ, T ℝ (r + 1) + T ℝ (r - 1) = (2 * X : ℝ[X]) * T ℝ r := by
      intro r
      rw [T_add_one]
      ring
    simp_rw [hrec]
    have hmul : ∀ j : ℕ, (s.choose j : ℝ[X]) * (2 * X * T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))) =
        (2 * X : ℝ[X]) * ((s.choose j : ℝ[X]) * T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))) := by
      intro j; ring
    simp_rw [hmul]
    rw [← mul_sum, pow_succ', ← ih]
    simp only [C_eq_natCast]

name: NLAlib.degree_monomialChebyshevApprox_le
statement:
theorem degree_monomialChebyshevApprox_le (s d : ℕ) :
    (monomialChebyshevApprox s d).degree ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomialChebyshevApprox
  rw [C_mul']
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ((degree_sum_le _ _).trans ?_)
  refine Finset.sup_le fun j hj => ?_
  have hd := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
  rw [C_mul']
  exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans (by rw [degree_T]; exact_mod_cast hd)

name: NLAlib.sum_choose_mul_exp_int_sub_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_choose_mul_exp_int_sub_two_mul (s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : ℝ) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) =
      (exp θ + exp (-θ)) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => simp
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [show s + 1 + 1 = s + 2 by omega,
      sum_choose_int_sub_two_mul_succ (fun r : ℤ => exp (θ * (r : ℝ))) s]
    have hrec : ∀ r : ℤ, exp (θ * ((r + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) + exp (θ * ((r - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
        (exp θ + exp (-θ)) * exp (θ * (r : ℝ)) := by
      intro r
      push_cast
      rw [mul_add, mul_sub, mul_one, exp_add, exp_sub, div_eq_mul_inv, ← exp_neg]
      ring
    simp_rw [hrec]
    have hmul : ∀ j : ℕ, (s.choose j : ℝ) *
        ((exp θ + exp (-θ)) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) =
        (exp θ + exp (-θ)) *
          ((s.choose j : ℝ) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) := by
      intro j; ring
    simp_rw [hmul]
    rw [← mul_sum, ih, pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_mul_exp_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_mul_exp_le (s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : ℝ) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) ≤
        exp ((s : ℝ) * θ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_choose_mul_exp_int_sub_two_mul]
  have hcosh : exp θ + exp (-θ) = 2 * cosh θ := by rw [cosh_eq]; ring
  rw [hcosh, mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]
  have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt (cosh_pos θ)) (cosh_le_exp_half_sq θ) s
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  rw [← exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_abs_tail_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_abs_tail_le (s : ℕ) {d θ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ (range (s + 1)).filter
        (fun j : ℕ => d < |(((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)|),
          (s.choose j : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * exp (-θ * d + (s : ℝ) * θ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ * (s.choose j : ℝ)
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ)
  let tail := (range (s + 1)).filter (fun j => d < |r j|)
  change ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ * (∑ j ∈ tail, (s.choose j : ℝ)) ≤ _
  rw [mul_sum]
  change (∑ j ∈ tail, w j) ≤ _
  have hmarkov : ∀ j ∈ tail, 1 ≤ exp (-θ * d) * (exp (θ * r j) + exp (-θ * r j)) := by
    intro j hj
    have hr := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (r j) with hpos | hneg
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hpos] at hr
      have hm : 1 ≤ exp (-θ * d + θ * r j) := one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
      rw [exp_add] at hm
      nlinarith [exp_pos (-θ * d), exp_pos (-θ * r j)]
    · rw [abs_of_neg hneg] at hr
      have hm : 1 ≤ exp (-θ * d + -θ * r j) := one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
      rw [exp_add] at hm
      nlinarith [exp_pos (-θ * d), exp_pos (θ * r j)]
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ tail, w j) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), exp (-θ * d) * w j * (exp (θ * r j) + exp (-θ * r j)) := by
    refine (sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_).trans
      (sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (filter_subset _ _) (fun j _ _ => by
        dsimp [w]; positivity))
    have hw : 0 ≤ w j := by dsimp [w]; positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hmarkov j hj) hw]
  have hplus := inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_mul_exp_le s θ
  have hminus := inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_mul_exp_le s (-θ)
  have htotal : (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1),
      exp (-θ * d) * w j * (exp (θ * r j) + exp (-θ * r j))) =
      exp (-θ * d) *
        (((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ * (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1),
          (s.choose j : ℝ) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) +
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ * (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1),
          (s.choose j : ℝ) * exp ((-θ) * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)))) := by
    simp only [mul_add, mul_sum, sum_add_distrib]
    apply congrArg₂ (· + ·) <;> apply sum_congr rfl <;> intro j hj <;> dsimp [w, r] <;> ring
  rw [htotal] at hsum
  have he := exp_pos (-θ * d)
  have hfinal := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hplus hminus) he.le
  rw [neg_sq] at hfinal
  refine hsum.trans (hfinal.trans_eq ?_)
  rw [exp_add]
  ring

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_natAbs_tail_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_natAbs_tail_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (d : ℕ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ (range (s + 1)).filter
        (fun j : ℕ => d < Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))), (s.choose j : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * exp (- (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s))
proof:
:= by
  have h := inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_abs_tail_le s
    (d := (d : ℝ)) (θ := d / s) (by positivity)
  have hpred : ∀ j : ℕ, (d : ℝ) < |(((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)| ↔
      d < Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) := by
    intro j
    rw [← Int.cast_abs, ← Int.natCast_natAbs]
    exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl
  simp_rw [hpred] at h
  convert h using 1
  congr 2
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.pow_eq_inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_eval_T
statement:
theorem pow_eq_inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_eval_T (s : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ s = ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : ℝ) * (T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval x) (sum_choose_mul_chebyshev_eq_two_mul_X_pow s)
  simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_ofNat, eval_X] at h
  rw [h, mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le_sum
statement:
theorem abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le_sum (s d : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |x ^ s - (monomialChebyshevApprox s d).eval x| ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ (range (s + 1)).filter
        (fun j : ℕ => d < Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))), (s.choose j : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit := sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (range (s + 1))
    (fun j : ℕ => Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) ≤ d)
    (fun j : ℕ => (s.choose j : ℝ) * (T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))).eval x)
  simp only [not_le] at hsplit
  rw [pow_eq_inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_eval_T, ← hsplit]
  simp only [monomialChebyshevApprox, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_finsetSum]
  rw [mul_add, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity :
    0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹)]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
    (sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_)) (by positivity)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  have hT := abs_eval_T_real_le_one ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) (abs_le.mpr hx)
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).trans_eq (mul_one _)

name: NLAlib.abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (d : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |x ^ s - (monomialChebyshevApprox s d).eval x| ≤
      2 * exp (- (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s))
proof:
:=
  (abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le_sum s d hx).trans
    (inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_natAbs_tail_le hs d)

name: NLAlib.monomialChebyshevApprox_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem monomialChebyshevApprox_zero (d : ℕ) : monomialChebyshevApprox 0 d = 1
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.monomialChebyshevApprox_eq_X_pow
statement:
theorem monomialChebyshevApprox_eq_X_pow {s d : ℕ} (hsd : s ≤ d) :
    monomialChebyshevApprox s d = X ^ s
proof:
:= by
  have hfilter : (range (s + 1)).filter
      (fun j : ℕ => Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) ≤ d) = range (s + 1) := by
    apply filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro j hj
    have hj' : j ≤ s := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hj)
    have habs : |(s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)| ≤ (s : ℤ) := abs_le.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    have hn : Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) ≤ s := by
      rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs] at habs
      exact_mod_cast habs
    exact hn.trans hsd
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro x
  simp only [monomialChebyshevApprox, hfilter, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_finsetSum, eval_pow, eval_X]
  exact (pow_eq_inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_eval_T s x).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_pow_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_pow_sub_eval_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ d ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |x ^ s - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * exp (- (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s))
proof:
:=
  ⟨monomialChebyshevApprox s d, degree_monomialChebyshevApprox_le s d,
    fun _ hx => abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le hs d hx⟩

name: NLAlib.hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun i : ℕ => x ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)) (exp x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ]
  exact NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp x

name: NLAlib.tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le_exp
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le_exp {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑' i : ℕ, x ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)) ≤ exp x
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp x
  have h := hsum.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add t
  rw [hsum.tsum_eq] at h
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, x ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ) :=
    sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_mul_tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le
statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : exp 2 * ℓ ≤ (t : ℝ)) :
    exp (-ℓ) * (∑' i : ℕ, ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)) ≤ exp (-(t : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsℓ := ((summable_nat_add_iff t).mpr (hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp ℓ).summable)
  have hsx := ((summable_nat_add_iff t).mpr
    (hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp (ℓ * exp 2)).summable)
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ) ≤
      exp (-2 * (t : ℝ)) * ((ℓ * exp 2) ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    have he : 1 ≤ exp (-2 * (t : ℝ)) * (exp 2) ^ (i + t) := by
      rw [← exp_nat_mul, ← exp_add]
      apply one_le_exp_iff.mpr
      push_cast
      nlinarith
    rw [mul_pow]
    have hp : 0 ≤ ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    have heq : exp (-2 * (t : ℝ)) *
        (ℓ ^ (i + t) * exp 2 ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)) =
        (exp (-2 * (t : ℝ)) * exp 2 ^ (i + t)) *
          (ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
    rw [heq]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_left hp he
  have htail := hsℓ.tsum_le_tsum hterm (hsx.mul_left (exp (-2 * (t : ℝ))))
  rw [tsum_mul_left] at htail
  have hfull := tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le_exp
    (show 0 ≤ ℓ * exp 2 by positivity) t
  have h : exp (-ℓ) * (∑' i : ℕ, ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
      exp (-ℓ) * (exp (-2 * (t : ℝ)) * exp (ℓ * exp 2)) :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by positivity)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull (by positivity))
        (by positivity))
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [← exp_add, ← exp_add]
  apply exp_le_exp.mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_sub_sum_pow_div_factorial_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_sum_pow_div_factorial_le {ℓ u : ℝ} (_hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hu : |u| ≤ ℓ)
    (t : ℕ) :
    |exp u - ∑ i ∈ range t, u ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)| ≤
      ∑' i : ℕ, ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsu := hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp u
  have hsℓ := (summable_nat_add_iff t).mpr (hasSum_pow_div_factorial_exp ℓ).summable
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖u ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)‖ ≤
      ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ) := by
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_pow,
      abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (i + t).factorial : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i + t).factorial)]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hu _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hsn : Summable (fun i : ℕ => ‖u ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm hsℓ
  have hsplit := hsu.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add t
  rw [hsu.tsum_eq] at hsplit
  have heq : exp u - ∑ i ∈ range t, u ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ) =
      ∑' i : ℕ, u ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ) := by linarith
  rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hsn).trans (hsn.tsum_le_tsum hterm hsℓ)

name: NLAlib.degree_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le
statement:
theorem degree_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le (ℓ : ℝ) (t d : ℕ) :
    (exponentialChebyshevApprox ℓ t d).degree ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  unfold exponentialChebyshevApprox
  rw [C_mul']
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ((degree_sum_le _ _).trans ?_)
  refine Finset.sup_le fun i _ => ?_
  rw [C_mul']
  exact (degree_smul_le _ _).trans (degree_monomialChebyshevApprox_le i d)

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_sub_eval_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_eval_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    {t : ℕ} (_ht0 : 0 < t) (ht : exp 2 * ℓ ≤ (t : ℝ)) (d : ℕ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |exp (-ℓ) * exp (-ℓ * y) - (exponentialChebyshevApprox ℓ t d).eval y| ≤
      exp (-(t : ℝ)) + 2 * exp (-(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * t))
proof:
:= by
  let E := 2 * exp (-(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * t))
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by dsimp [E]; positivity
  have hmono : ∀ i ∈ range t, |y ^ i - (monomialChebyshevApprox i d).eval y| ≤ E := by
    intro i hi
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi0
    · simpa only [pow_zero, monomialChebyshevApprox_zero, eval_one, sub_self, abs_zero] using hE
    · have h := abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le hi0 d hy
      refine h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (by norm_num))
      have hit : (i : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast (mem_range.mp hi).le
      have hip : (0 : ℝ) < i := by exact_mod_cast hi0
      have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg (d : ℝ))
        (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 * i by positivity) (show (2 : ℝ) * i ≤ 2 * t by linarith)
      simpa [neg_div] using neg_le_neg hdiv
  let S := ∑ i ∈ range t, (-ℓ * y) ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)
  let V := ∑ i ∈ range t, ((-ℓ) ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)) *
    (monomialChebyshevApprox i d).eval y
  have hdiff : S - V = ∑ i ∈ range t, ((-ℓ) ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)) *
      (y ^ i - (monomialChebyshevApprox i d).eval y) := by
    dsimp [S, V]
    rw [← sum_sub_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [mul_pow]
    ring
  have hcompress : |S - V| ≤ E * (∑ i ∈ range t, ℓ ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hdiff, mul_sum]
    refine (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hℓ,
      abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono i hi) (by positivity)).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  have hu : |-ℓ * y| ≤ ℓ := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hℓ]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mpr hy) hℓ).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  have hTaylor := abs_exp_sub_sum_pow_div_factorial_le hℓ hu t
  change |exp (-ℓ * y) - S| ≤ _ at hTaylor
  have htail := exp_neg_mul_tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le hℓ t ht
  have hfirst := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTaylor (by positivity)).trans htail
  have hweight : exp (-ℓ) * (∑ i ∈ range t, ℓ ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg hℓ t)
      (show 0 ≤ exp (-ℓ) by positivity)
    simpa [← exp_add] using h
  have hsecond : exp (-ℓ) * |S - V| ≤ E := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcompress (show 0 ≤ exp (-ℓ) by positivity)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hweight hE
    nlinarith
  have htri := abs_sub_le (exp (-ℓ * y)) S V
  have hfinal := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htri (show 0 ≤ exp (-ℓ) by positivity)
  have hev : (exponentialChebyshevApprox ℓ t d).eval y = exp (-ℓ) * V := by
    simp only [exponentialChebyshevApprox, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_finsetSum, V]
  rw [hev, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
  dsimp [E] at hsecond
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.degree_exponentialApprox_le
statement:
theorem degree_exponentialApprox_le (b δ : ℝ) :
    (exponentialApprox b δ).degree ≤ exponentialApproxDegree b δ
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
  unfold exponentialApprox
  refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
  have h1 := natDegree_le_of_degree_le
    (degree_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le (b / 2) (exponentialApproxCutoff b δ)
      (exponentialApproxDegree b δ))
  have h2 : (C (2 / b) * X - 1 : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans natDegree_X_le
    · simp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b) :
    |exp (-x) - (exponentialApprox b δ).eval x| ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let t := exponentialApproxCutoff b δ
  let d := exponentialApproxDegree b δ
  have hcut : max (exp 1 ^ 2 * b / 2) (log (2 / δ)) ≤ (t : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have ht : exp 2 * (b / 2) ≤ (t : ℝ) := by
    have hexp : exp 2 = exp 1 ^ 2 := by rw [show (2 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 by norm_num, exp_add, sq]
    rw [hexp]
    have h := (le_max_left (exp 1 ^ 2 * b / 2) (log (2 / δ))).trans hcut
    nlinarith
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by
    have hpos : 0 < exp 1 ^ 2 * b / 2 := by positivity
    have hp := hpos.trans_le ((le_max_left _ _).trans hcut)
    exact_mod_cast hp
  have htlog : log (2 / δ) ≤ (t : ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hcut
  have hlog4 : 0 ≤ log (4 / δ) := log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]; linarith)
  have hroot : sqrt (2 * (t : ℝ) * log (4 / δ)) ≤ (d : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hd : 2 * (t : ℝ) * log (4 / δ) ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hs := sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * (t : ℝ) * log (4 / δ) by positivity)
    have hn := sqrt_nonneg (2 * (t : ℝ) * log (4 / δ))
    nlinarith
  have hTaylor : exp (-(t : ℝ)) ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have h := exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg htlog)
    rw [exp_neg, exp_neg, exp_log (by positivity : 0 < 2 / δ), inv_div] at h
    simpa only [exp_neg] using h
  have hcompression : 2 * exp (-(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * t)) ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have he : -(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * t) ≤ -log (4 / δ) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 * t by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have h := exp_le_exp.mpr he
    rw [exp_neg, exp_log (by positivity : 0 < 4 / δ), inv_div] at h
    nlinarith
  have hy : 2 / b * x - 1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor <;> nlinarith [div_mul_cancel₀ (2 : ℝ) hb.ne',
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2 / b by positivity) hx.1,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 (show 0 ≤ 2 / b by positivity)]
  have h := abs_exp_sub_eval_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le
    (show 0 ≤ b / 2 by positivity) ht0 ht d hy
  have hexp : exp (-(b / 2)) * exp (-(b / 2) * (2 / b * x - 1)) = exp (-x) := by
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp] at h
  have hev : (exponentialApprox b δ).eval x =
      (exponentialChebyshevApprox (b / 2) t d).eval (2 / b * x - 1) := by
    simp only [exponentialApprox, eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, eval_one, t, d]
  rw [hev]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_le {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ exponentialApproxDegree b δ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b, |exp (-x) - p.eval x| ≤ δ
proof:
:=
  ⟨exponentialApprox b δ, degree_exponentialApprox_le b δ,
    fun _ hx => abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le hb hδ hδ1 hx⟩

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_nonneg (M : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * π)) :
    0 ≤ chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel M t
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_eq_sum (M : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * π)) :
    chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel M t = 1 + 2 * ∑ j ∈ range M,
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M (j + 1) * (fourier ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel, normSq_sum_real_mul_fourier_eq_autocorrelation,
    sum_chebyshevJacksonSineWeight_sq, sum_range_succ]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, sum_range_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hnorm : 2 / (M + 2 : ℝ) * ((M + 2 : ℝ) / 2) = 1 := by
    field_simp [show (M + 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity]
  rw [mul_add, hnorm]
  congr 1
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (2 / (M + 2 : ℝ)) 2, mul_assoc, mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping_eq_autocorrelation M (j + 1) (by
    have := mem_range.mp hj
    omega)]
  ring_nf

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_coe_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_coe_eq_sum (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel M (t : AddCircle (2 * π)) =
      1 + 2 * ∑ j ∈ range M, chebyshevJacksonDamping M (j + 1) * cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_eq_sum]
  simp_rw [re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonKernel_cos_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonKernel_cos_eq_sum (M : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) :
    chebyshevJacksonKernel M (cos a) (cos b) =
      1 / π + (2 / π) * ∑ j ∈ range M,
        chebyshevJacksonDamping M (j + 1) * cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) *
          cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * b)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) :
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M j * normalizedChebyshev j (cos a) * normalizedChebyshev j (cos b) =
        ((if j = 0 then 1 else 2) / π) * chebyshevJacksonDamping M j *
          cos ((j : ℝ) * a) * cos ((j : ℝ) * b) := by
    rw [normalizedChebyshev_cos, normalizedChebyshev_cos]
    have h := normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq j
    calc
      _ = normalizedChebyshevWeight j ^ 2 * chebyshevJacksonDamping M j *
          cos ((j : ℝ) * a) * cos ((j : ℝ) * b) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h]
  simp_rw [chebyshevJacksonKernel, hterm]
  rw [sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, cos_zero, chebyshevJacksonDamping_zero,
    if_true, mul_one, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false]
  rw [mul_sum]
  simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [add_comm]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonKernel_cos_eq_circle
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonKernel_cos_eq_circle (M : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) :
    chebyshevJacksonKernel M (cos a) (cos b) =
      (chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel M ((a - b : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * π)) +
        chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel M ((a + b : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * π))) / (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevJacksonKernel_cos_eq_sum, chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_coe_eq_sum,
    chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_coe_eq_sum]
  have h (j : ℕ) :
      cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (a - b)) + cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (a + b)) =
        2 * (cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) * cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * b)) := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_add, cos_sub, cos_add]
    ring
  have hs : (∑ j ∈ range M, chebyshevJacksonDamping M (j + 1) *
      cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (a - b))) +
      (∑ j ∈ range M, chebyshevJacksonDamping M (j + 1) * cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (a + b))) =
        2 * ∑ j ∈ range M, chebyshevJacksonDamping M (j + 1) *
          cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) * cos (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * b) := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib, mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [← mul_add, h]
    ring
  field_simp
  nlinarith [hs]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2, ← cos_arccos hr.1 hr.2, chebyshevJacksonKernel_cos_eq_circle]
  exact div_nonneg (add_nonneg (chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_nonneg M _)
    (chebyshevJacksonCircleKernel_nonneg M _)) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonKernel_symm
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonKernel_symm (M : ℕ) (x r : ℝ) :
    chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r = chebyshevJacksonKernel M r x
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.continuous_normalizedChebyshev
statement: @[fun_prop] theorem continuous_normalizedChebyshev (j : ℕ) : Continuous (normalizedChebyshev j)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.mul (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).continuous

name: NLAlib.integral_normalizedChebyshev_mul
statement:
theorem integral_normalizedChebyshev_mul (j k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, normalizedChebyshev j x * normalizedChebyshev k x ∂measureT) =
      if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_measureT_eq_integral_cos, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le]
  exact integral_normalizedChebyshev_cos_mul j k

name: NLAlib.continuous_chebyshevJacksonKernel
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_chebyshevJacksonKernel (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x => chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevJacksonKernel
  exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_normalizedChebyshev j)).mul continuous_const)

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_normalizedChebyshev
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_normalizedChebyshev
    (M k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ M + 1) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * normalizedChebyshev k x ∂measureT) =
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M k * normalizedChebyshev k r
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M j * normalizedChebyshev j x *
        normalizedChebyshev j r * normalizedChebyshev k x =
      (chebyshevJacksonDamping M j * normalizedChebyshev j r) *
        (normalizedChebyshev j x * normalizedChebyshev k x) := by
    ring
  simp_rw [chebyshevJacksonKernel, sum_mul, hterm]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_measureT (by
    exact ((continuous_const.mul ((continuous_normalizedChebyshev j).mul
      (continuous_normalizedChebyshev k))).continuousOn)))]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, integral_normalizedChebyshev_mul]
  by_cases hkM : k ≤ M
  · rw [sum_eq_single k]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [hj]
    · intro hnot
      exact False.elim (hnot (mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
  · have heq : k = M + 1 := by omega
    subst k
    rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping_succ, zero_mul]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have hne : j ≠ M + 1 := by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega
    simp [hne]

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r ∂measureT) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_normalizedChebyshev M 0 (by omega) r
  simp only [normalizedChebyshev_zero, chebyshevJacksonDamping_zero, one_mul] at h
  rw [integral_mul_const] at h
  have hp : sqrt π ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sqrt_pos.2 pi_pos)
  field_simp at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.normalizedChebyshevWeight_pos
statement: theorem normalizedChebyshevWeight_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < normalizedChebyshevWeight k
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedChebyshevWeight
  apply sqrt_pos.2
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_T
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_T (M k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ M + 1) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x ∂measureT) =
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval r
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_normalizedChebyshev M k hk r
  simp only [normalizedChebyshev] at h
  have hfun (x : ℝ) : chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r *
      (normalizedChebyshevWeight k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) =
      normalizedChebyshevWeight k * (chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) := by ring
  simp_rw [hfun] at h
  rw [integral_const_mul] at h
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (normalizedChebyshevWeight_pos k))
  exact h.trans (by ring)

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_id
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_id (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * x ∂measureT) =
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M 1 * r
proof:
:= by
  simpa using integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_T M 1 (by omega) r

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sq
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sq {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * x ^ 2 ∂measureT) =
      (1 + chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2 * (2 * r ^ 2 - 1)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_T M 2 (by omega) r
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, T_two, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_ofNat, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one] at h
  have hfun (x : ℝ) : chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (2 * x ^ 2 - 1) =
      2 * (chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * x ^ 2) - chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r := by ring
  simp_rw [hfun] at h
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)) (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sub_sq
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sub_sq {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (x - r) ^ 2 ∂measureT) =
      (1 - chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2) / 2 +
        r ^ 2 * (chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2 - 2 * chebyshevJacksonDamping M 1 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun (x : ℝ) : chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (x - r) ^ 2 =
      chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * x ^ 2 -
        (2 * r) * (chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * x) + r ^ 2 * chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r := by ring
  simp_rw [hfun]
  rw [integral_add (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)) (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)),
    integral_sub (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)) (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel,
    integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sq hM, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_id]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sub_sq_le {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (x - r) ^ 2 ∂measureT) ≤
      sin (chebyshevJacksonAngle M) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let θ := chebyshevJacksonAngle M
  have hc : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ cos θ := by
    rw [← cos_pi_div_three]
    exact cos_le_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).le
      (by linarith [pi_pos]) (chebyshevJacksonAngle_le_pi_div_three hM)
  have hMreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hcM : 1 ≤ ((M : ℝ) + 1) * cos θ := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : (2 : ℝ) ≤ M + 1)
      (by linarith : 0 ≤ cos θ)
    linarith
  have hcoef : chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2 - 2 * chebyshevJacksonDamping M 1 + 1 =
      2 * (cos θ - 1) * (((M : ℝ) + 1) * cos θ - 1) / (M + 2) := by
    rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping_two, chebyshevJacksonDamping_one, cos_two_mul]
    dsimp [θ]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hcoefneg : chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2 - 2 * chebyshevJacksonDamping M 1 + 1 ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hcoef]
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by nlinarith [cos_le_one θ]) (by linarith)) (by positivity)
  have hconstant : (1 - chebyshevJacksonDamping M 2) / 2 =
      (((M : ℝ) + 1) / (M + 2)) * sin θ ^ 2 := by
    rw [chebyshevJacksonDamping_two, cos_two_mul, cos_sq']
    dsimp [θ]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hratio : ((M : ℝ) + 1) / (M + 2) ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).2
    linarith
  rw [integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sub_sq hM]
  have hprod := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg r) hcoefneg
  have hconst := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio (sq_nonneg (sin θ))
  rw [one_mul] at hconst
  rw [hconstant]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_Icc_measureT
statement: theorem ae_mem_Icc_measureT : ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT, x ∈ Set.Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    unfold measureT
    exact ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc
  exact h.mono fun _ hx => ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le_sin
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le_sin {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x - r| ∂measureT) ≤
      sin (chebyshevJacksonAngle M)
proof:
:= by
  let S := sin (chebyshevJacksonAngle M)
  have hS : 0 < S := sin_chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M
  have hi : ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT,
      2 * S * (chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x - r|) ≤
      chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (x - r) ^ 2 + S ^ 2 * chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r := by
    filter_upwards [ae_mem_Icc_measureT] with x hx
    have hp : 2 * S * |x - r| ≤ (x - r) ^ 2 + S ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|x - r| - S), sq_abs (x - r)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr)
    nlinarith
  have h := integral_mono_ae (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop))
    (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)) hi
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop))
    (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)), integral_const_mul, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel] at h
  have hsq := integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sub_sq_le hM r
  change _ ≤ S ^ 2 at hsq
  change _ ≤ S
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x - r| ∂measureT) ≤ 6 / M
proof:
:= by
  refine (integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le_sin hM hr).trans
    ((sin_le (chebyshevJacksonAngle_pos M).le).trans ?_)
  unfold chebyshevJacksonAngle
  have hMp : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < M)
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hMp).2
  nlinarith [pi_lt_four]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_le_one
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_le_one {M j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ M + 1) :
    chebyshevJacksonDamping M j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x 1 * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x ≤
      chebyshevJacksonKernel M x 1 := by
    filter_upwards [ae_mem_Icc_measureT] with x hx
    have hT := (abs_le.mp (abs_eval_T_real_le_one (j : ℤ) (abs_le.mpr hx))).2
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx (by norm_num))).trans_eq
      (mul_one _)
  have hi := integral_mono_ae (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop))
    (integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)) h
  simpa only [integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_T M j hj 1, T_eval_one,
    mul_one, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel] using hi

name: NLAlib.chebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem chebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc {M j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ M + 1) :
    chebyshevJacksonDamping M j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨chebyshevJacksonDamping_nonneg hj, chebyshevJacksonDamping_le_one hj⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_eq_clenshawState
statement:
theorem sum_smul_eq_clenshawState {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (α β c : ℕ → R) (y : ℕ → M)
    (hy : ∀ k, y (k + 2) = α (k + 1) • y (k + 1) - β (k + 1) • y k)
    (k n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, c (k + j) • y (k + j)) =
      (clenshawState α β c k n).1 • y k +
      (clenshawState α β c k n).2 • (y (k + 1) - α k • y k)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => simp [clenshawState]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ']
    have hshift : (∑ j ∈ range n, c (k + (j + 1)) • y (k + (j + 1))) =
        ∑ j ∈ range n, c ((k + 1) + j) • y ((k + 1) + j) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      congr 2 <;> omega
    rw [hshift, ih]
    simp only [Nat.add_zero, clenshawState]
    have hstep := hy k
    rw [show k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 by omega, hstep]
    module

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_eval_T_eq_clenshawState
statement:
theorem sum_mul_eval_T_eq_clenshawState {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (c : ℕ → R) (t : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), c j * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (j : ℤ)).eval t) =
      (clenshawState (fun _ => 2 * t) (fun _ => 1) c 0 (n + 1)).1 -
        t * (clenshawState (fun _ => 2 * t) (fun _ => 1) c 0 (n + 1)).2
proof:
:= by
  have hy : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval t =
        (2 * t) * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval t -
          (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (k : ℤ)).eval t := by
    intro k
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one,
      Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_add_two]
    simp
  have h := sum_smul_eq_clenshawState (fun _ => 2 * t) (fun _ => (1 : R)) c
    (fun k => (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (k : ℤ)).eval t) (by simp [smul_eq_mul]) 0 (n + 1)
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_zero, Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_zero,
    Polynomial.eval_one, Nat.cast_one, Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_one, Polynomial.eval_X,
    mul_one] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_congr
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_congr {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hfg : EqOn f g (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff f k = chebyshevCoeff g k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ =>
    congrArg (fun y => y * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ))
      (hfg ⟨neg_one_le_cos θ, cos_le_one θ⟩))]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevTrunc_congr
statement:
theorem chebyshevTrunc_congr {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hfg : EqOn f g (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    chebyshevTrunc f n = chebyshevTrunc g n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevTrunc, chebyshevCoeff_congr hfg]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_eq_self
statement:
theorem chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_eq_self (n : ℕ)
    (p : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) (hp : p ∈ polynomialApproximationSpace (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) n) :
    chebyshevProjectionLinearMap n p = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mp hp
  have hcongr : EqOn (IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
      (q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))) q.eval (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hx]
    rfl
  change (chebyshevTrunc _ n).toContinuousMapOn _ = _
  rw [chebyshevTrunc_congr hcongr, chebyshevTrunc_eval_eq_of_degree_le hq]

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_dirichletIntegral
proof:
:= by
  have hxcos : (fourier 1 (Real.arccos x : AddCircle (2 * π))).re = x := by
    rw [show (fourier 1 (Real.arccos x : AddCircle (2 * π))).re = cos (arccos x) by
      simpa using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 (arccos x), cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2]
  rw [← hxcos, ← integral_dirichletCircleKernel_mul_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf,
    ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hki : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * π) => M * |dirichletCircleKernel n t|)
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n).abs).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hki (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => ?_))).trans_eq ?_
  · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM _ (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc _)) (abs_nonneg _)).trans_eq
      (mul_comm _ _)
  · rw [integral_const_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_le_dirichletIntegral
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_le_dirichletIntegral (n : ℕ)
    (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    ‖chebyshevProjectionLinearMap n f‖ ≤
      (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), |dirichletCircleKernel n t| ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => abs_nonneg _))
    (norm_nonneg _))).mpr
  intro x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  change |(chebyshevTrunc (IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f) n).eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ _
  apply abs_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_dirichletIntegral f.continuous.Icc_extend'.continuousOn
    (fun y hy => ?_) n x.property
  rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ hy]
  exact f.norm_coe_le_norm ⟨y, hy⟩

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProjectionOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevProjectionOperator_apply (n : ℕ) (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    chebyshevProjectionOperator n f = chebyshevProjectionLinearMap n f
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_mul_smoothedSign_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_mul_smoothedSign_le (u ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    |u / sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |u| ≤ u * (u / sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) + ε
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : 0 < u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hv : 0 < sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) := sqrt_pos.mpr hsq
  have hv2 : sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) ^ 2 = u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2 := sq_sqrt hsq.le
  have hAu : |u| ^ 2 = u ^ 2 := sq_abs u
  have hl : |u| ≤ sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg u]
  have hu : sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) ≤ |u| + ε := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg u]
  constructor
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hv]
    exact (div_le_one hv).mpr hl
  · rw [show u * (u / sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) + ε =
        (u ^ 2 + ε * sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) / sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) by field_simp]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hv).mpr
    have hprod : 0 ≤ (sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) - |u|) * ε :=
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hl) hε.le
    have hprod' : 0 ≤ |u| * (|u| + ε - sqrt (u ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) :=
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_dirichletIntegral
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_dirichletIntegral (n : ℕ) :
    ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator n‖ =
      ∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), |dirichletCircleKernel n t| ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (integral_nonneg (fun _ => abs_nonneg _))
      (norm_chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_le_dirichletIntegral n)
  · apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ range n, (T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x
    have hd : Continuous d := by dsimp [d]; fun_prop
    have hden : ∀ x : ℝ, sqrt (d x ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      intro x
      exact (sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)).ne'
    let f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ) := ⟨fun x => d x / sqrt (d x ^ 2 + ε ^ 2),
      ((hd.div (by fun_prop) hden).comp continuous_subtype_val)⟩
    have hf : ‖f‖ ≤ 1 := by
      apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le f (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mpr
      intro x
      exact (abs_sub_mul_smoothedSign_le (d x) ε hε).1
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f
    have hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := f.continuous.Icc_extend'.continuousOn
    have hdcircle : ∀ t : AddCircle (2 * π), d ((fourier 1 t).re) = dirichletCircleKernel n t := by
      intro t
      simp only [d, dirichletCircleKernel, eval_T_re_fourier_one]
    have hgcircle : ∀ t : AddCircle (2 * π), realChebyshevCircleFunction g (-t) =
        dirichletCircleKernel n t / sqrt (dirichletCircleKernel n t ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) := by
      intro t
      rw [even_realChebyshevCircleFunction]
      change IccExtend (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) f ((fourier 1 t).re) = _
      rw [IccExtend_of_mem _ _ (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc t)]
      change d ((fourier 1 t).re) / sqrt (d ((fourier 1 t).re) ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) = _
      rw [hdcircle]
    have hvalue : chebyshevProjectionOperator n f ⟨1, by norm_num⟩ =
        ∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), dirichletCircleKernel n t *
          (dirichletCircleKernel n t / sqrt (dirichletCircleKernel n t ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))
            ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
      have h := integral_dirichletCircleKernel_mul_realChebyshevCircleFunction hg n 0
      simp only [zero_sub, hgcircle, fourier_eval_zero, Complex.one_re] at h
      exact h.symm
    have hint : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * π) => dirichletCircleKernel n t *
        (dirichletCircleKernel n t / sqrt (dirichletCircleKernel n t ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) + ε)
          AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
      apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport _ (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
      have hnz : ∀ t : AddCircle (2 * π), sqrt (dirichletCircleKernel n t ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
        intro t
        exact (sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)).ne'
      exact ((continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n).mul
        ((continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n).div
          (((continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n).pow 2).add continuous_const).sqrt hnz)).add continuous_const
    have hI := integral_mono
      ((continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n).abs.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)) hint
      (fun t => (abs_sub_mul_smoothedSign_le (dirichletCircleKernel n t) ε hε).2)
    have hint' : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * π) => dirichletCircleKernel n t *
        (dirichletCircleKernel n t / sqrt (dirichletCircleKernel n t ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)))
          AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
      exact (hint.sub (integrable_const ε)).congr (ae_of_all _ (fun t => by simp))
    rw [integral_add hint' (integrable_const ε), integral_const] at hI
    simp only [Measure.real, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at hI
    rw [← hvalue] at hI
    have hval := (chebyshevProjectionOperator n f).apply_le_norm ⟨1, by norm_num⟩
    have hnorm := (chebyshevProjectionOperator n).le_opNorm f
    have hnorm' : ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator n‖ * ‖f‖ ≤ ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator n‖ := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf (norm_nonneg (chebyshevProjectionOperator n))
    linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_zero :
    ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator 0‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_dirichletIntegral]
  simp [dirichletCircleKernel]

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_intervalIntegral
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_intervalIntegral (n : ℕ) :
    ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator n‖ = (1 / (2 * π)) *
      ∫ t in -π..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_dirichletIntegral,
    AddCircle.integral_haarAddCircle,
    ← AddCircle.intervalIntegral_preimage (2 * π) (-π)]
  rw [show -π + 2 * π = π by ring]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, one_div]

name: NLAlib.harmonic_le_norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator
statement:
theorem harmonic_le_norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator (n : ℕ) :
    (4 / π ^ 2) * (harmonic n : ℝ) ≤ ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator n‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_eq_dirichletIntegral]
  exact harmonic_le_integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel n

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_le_log
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevProjectionOperator_le_log (n : ℕ) :
    ‖chebyshevProjectionOperator n‖ ≤ 3 + (4 / π ^ 2) * log (n + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans _ (integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_le_log n)
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (integral_nonneg (fun _ => abs_nonneg _))
    (norm_chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_le_dirichletIntegral n)

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_chebyshevProjection_le_minimaxError
statement:
theorem norm_sub_chebyshevProjection_le_minimaxError (n : ℕ) (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ)) :
    ‖f - chebyshevProjectionOperator n f‖ ≤
      (4 + (4 / π ^ 2) * log (n + 1 : ℕ)) * minimaxError n f
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sub_projection_le_minimaxError n (chebyshevProjectionLinearMap n)
    (3 + (4 / π ^ 2) * log (n + 1 : ℕ)) (chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_eq_self n)
    (fun g => (norm_chebyshevProjectionLinearMap_le_dirichletIntegral n g).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_le_log n) (norm_nonneg g))) f
  rw [chebyshevProjectionOperator_apply]
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_exp_eq_modifiedBesselCoeff
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_exp_eq_modifiedBesselCoeff (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) k = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) * modifiedBesselCoeff a k
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral]
  unfold modifiedBesselCoeff
  ring

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_pow_div_factorial
statement:
theorem summable_abs_pow_div_factorial (b : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => |b| ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have habs : ∀ n : ℕ, |(n.factorial : ℝ)| = (n.factorial : ℝ) :=
    fun n => abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_pow, habs] using
    NormedSpace.norm_expSeries_div_summable b

name: NLAlib.hasSum_circleExponential
statement:
theorem hasSum_circleExponential (b : ℝ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (n : ℤ) t)
      (circleExponential b t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleExponential
  rw [Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]
  have h := NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp ((b : ℂ) * fourier 1 t)
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ => ((b : ℂ) * fourier 1 t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℂ)) =
      fun n : ℕ => ((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (n : ℤ) t := by
    funext n
    rw [mul_pow, fourier_nat_eq_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_circleExponential_le
statement:
theorem norm_circleExponential_le (b : ℝ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    ‖circleExponential b t‖ ≤ Real.exp |b|
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleExponential, Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc b * (fourier 1 t).re ≤ |b * (fourier 1 t).re| := le_abs_self _
    _ = |b| * |(fourier 1 t).re| := abs_mul _ _
    _ ≤ |b| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (abs_le.mpr (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc t)) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = |b| := mul_one _

name: NLAlib.fourierCoeff_circleExponential_nat
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_circleExponential_nat (b : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    fourierCoeff (circleExponential b) (k : ℤ) = ((b ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℂ := fun n t =>
    ((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (n : ℤ) t
  have h := hasSum_fourierCoeff_of_summable_bound (F := F)
    (b := fun n => |b| ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ))
    (fun n => continuous_const.mul (fourier (n : ℤ)).continuous)
    (summable_abs_pow_div_factorial b) (fun n t => by
      change ‖((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (n : ℤ) t‖ ≤ _
      rw [norm_mul, show ‖fourier (n : ℤ) t‖ = (1 : ℝ) from Circle.norm_coe _, mul_one,
        Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_pow,
        abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ n.factorial by positivity)] ) (hasSum_circleExponential b) (k : ℤ)
  have hterm : ∀ n, fourierCoeff (F n) (k : ℤ) =
      if n = k then ((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro n
    change fourierCoeff (fun t => ((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (n : ℤ) t) _ = _
    rw [fourierCoeff.const_mul]
    have hc := congrFun (fourierCoeff_fourier (T := 2 * Real.pi) (n : ℤ)) (k : ℤ)
    rw [hc]
    by_cases hnk : n = k
    · subst n
      simp
    · have hkn : (k : ℤ) ≠ (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast Ne.symm hnk
      simp only [Pi.single_apply, if_neg hnk, if_neg hkn, mul_zero]
  simp_rw [hterm] at h
  have hsingle : HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
      if n = k then ((b ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0)
      ((b ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    convert hasSum_ite_eq k ((b ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) using 1
    funext n
    by_cases hn : n = k
    · subst n; simp
    · simp [hn]
  exact h.unique hsingle

name: NLAlib.hasSum_pow_div_factorial_modifiedBesselCoeff
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_div_factorial_modifiedBesselCoeff (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ => (a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) /
      ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ))) (modifiedBesselCoeff a k)
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ := a / 2
  let F : ℕ → AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℂ := fun j t =>
    ((b ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (-(j : ℤ)) t * circleExponential b t
  let f : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℂ := fun t => (Real.exp (a * (fourier 1 t).re) : ℂ)
  have hcont : Continuous (circleExponential b) := by unfold circleExponential; fun_prop
  have hseries : ∀ t, HasSum (fun j => F j t) (f t) := by
    intro t
    have h := (hasSum_circleExponential b (-t)).mul_right (circleExponential b t)
    simp only [fourier_apply_neg] at h
    have heq : circleExponential b (-t) * circleExponential b t = f t := by
      change Complex.exp ((b : ℂ) * fourier 1 (-t)) * Complex.exp ((b : ℂ) * fourier 1 t) =
        (Real.exp (a * (fourier 1 t).re) : ℂ)
      rw [← Complex.exp_add, Complex.ofReal_exp]
      apply congrArg Complex.exp
      rw [fourier_apply_neg, fourier_neg]
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [b, Complex.mul_re]
        ring
      · simp [Complex.mul_im]
    rw [heq] at h
    exact h
  have hbound : ∀ j t, ‖F j t‖ ≤ (|b| ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp |b| := by
    intro j t
    change ‖((b ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourier (-(j : ℤ)) t * circleExponential b t‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, show ‖fourier (-(j : ℤ)) t‖ = (1 : ℝ) from Circle.norm_coe _,
      mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_pow,
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ j.factorial by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_circleExponential_le b t) (by positivity)
  have hs := hasSum_fourierCoeff_of_summable_bound (F := F)
    (b := fun j => (|b| ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp |b|)
    (fun j => (continuous_const.mul (fourier (-(j : ℤ))).continuous).mul hcont)
    ((summable_abs_pow_div_factorial b).mul_right _) hbound hseries (k : ℤ)
  have hterm : ∀ j, fourierCoeff (F j) (k : ℤ) =
      (((a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) / ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro j
    have heq : F j = fun t => ((b ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (fourier (-(j : ℤ)) t * circleExponential b t) := by
      funext t
      change (_ * _) * _ = _ * (_ * _)
      exact mul_assoc _ _ _
    rw [heq, fourierCoeff.const_mul, fourierCoeff_fourier_mul]
    have hidx : (k : ℤ) - -(j : ℤ) = ((j + k : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hidx, fourierCoeff_circleExponential_nat]
    push_cast
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, ← pow_add]
    have he : j + (j + k) = 2 * j + k := by omega
    rw [he]
    dsimp only [b]
    push_cast
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at hs
  have hr := Complex.reCLM.hasSum hs
  change HasSum (fun j : ℕ =>
    ((((a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) / ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)).re)
      (fourierCoeff f (k : ℤ)).re at hr
  have hcoeff : (fourierCoeff f (k : ℤ)).re = modifiedBesselCoeff a k := by
    have h := re_fourierCoeff_realChebyshevCircleFunction
      (f := fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) (by fun_prop) k
    exact h
  rw [hcoeff] at hr
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using hr

name: NLAlib.modifiedBesselCoeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem modifiedBesselCoeff_nonneg {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ modifiedBesselCoeff a k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hasSum_pow_div_factorial_modifiedBesselCoeff a k).tsum_eq]
  apply tsum_nonneg
  intro j
  positivity

name: NLAlib.modifiedBesselCoeff_le_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp
statement:
theorem modifiedBesselCoeff_le_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    modifiedBesselCoeff a k ≤ (a / 2) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (a ^ 2 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ := a / 2
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hs := hasSum_pow_div_factorial_modifiedBesselCoeff a k
  have he : HasSum (fun j : ℕ => (b ^ 2) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) (Real.exp (b ^ 2)) := by
    rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ]
    exact NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (b ^ 2)
  have hm := he.mul_left (b ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ))
  have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ, (a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) /
      ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
        (b ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * ((b ^ 2) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    have hfac : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((j + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (show k ≤ j + k by omega)
    have hleft : (a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) /
        ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ)) =
          (b ^ k * (b ^ 2) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) / ((j + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [b]
      rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
      ring
    have hright : b ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * ((b ^ 2) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) =
        (b ^ k * (b ^ 2) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) / (k.factorial : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [hleft, hright]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hfac
  have h := hs.summable.tsum_le_tsum hterm hm.summable
  rw [hs.tsum_eq, hm.tsum_eq] at h
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 = a ^ 2 / 4 := by dsimp [b]; ring
  simpa only [b, hb2] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_modifiedBesselCoeff_le_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp
statement:
theorem abs_modifiedBesselCoeff_le_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |modifiedBesselCoeff a k| ≤ (|a| / 2) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (a ^ 2 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hasSum_pow_div_factorial_modifiedBesselCoeff a k
  have hsabs := hasSum_pow_div_factorial_modifiedBesselCoeff |a| k
  have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ‖(a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) / ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ))‖ =
        (|a| / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) / ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_pow, abs_div, abs_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num),
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ) by positivity)]
  have hnorm : Summable (fun j : ℕ =>
      ‖(a / 2) ^ (2 * j + k) / ((j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j + k).factorial : ℝ))‖) := by
    simp_rw [hterm]
    exact hsabs.summable
  have h := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
  rw [hs.tsum_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  simp_rw [hterm] at h
  rw [hsabs.tsum_eq] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hb := modifiedBesselCoeff_le_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp (abs_nonneg a) k
  simpa only [sq_abs] using hb

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_modifiedBesselCoeff
statement:
theorem summable_abs_modifiedBesselCoeff (a : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k => |modifiedBesselCoeff a k|)
proof:
:= by
  have hmajor : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      (|a| / 2) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (a ^ 2 / 4)) := by
    have h := (summable_abs_pow_div_factorial (|a| / 2)).mul_right (Real.exp (a ^ 2 / 4))
    simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ |a| / 2 by positivity)] using h
  exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
    (abs_modifiedBesselCoeff_le_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp a) hmajor

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_exp
statement:
theorem summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_exp (a : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff (fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) k|)
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) _ ((summable_abs_modifiedBesselCoeff a).mul_left 2)
  intro k
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_exp_eq_modifiedBesselCoeff, abs_mul]
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp only [if_pos hk]
    norm_num
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (modifiedBesselCoeff a k)]
  · simp [hk]

name: NLAlib.hasSum_modifiedBesselCoeff_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem hasSum_modifiedBesselCoeff_mul_eval_T (a : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasSum (fun k => (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) * modifiedBesselCoeff a k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x)
      (Real.exp (a * x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T (f := fun x => Real.exp (a * x))
    (by fun_prop) (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_exp a) hx
  simpa only [chebyshevCoeff_exp_eq_modifiedBesselCoeff] using h

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc_exp
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc_exp (a : ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => (chebyshevTrunc (fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) n).eval x)
      (fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) Filter.atTop (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:=
  tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc (by fun_prop) (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_exp a)

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_modifiedBesselCoeff_tail
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_modifiedBesselCoeff_tail (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |Real.exp (a * x) - (chebyshevTrunc (fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) n).eval x| ≤
      2 * ∑' j, |modifiedBesselCoeff a (j + (n + 1))|
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_tsum (f := fun x => Real.exp (a * x))
    (by fun_prop) (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_exp a) n hx
  have hterm : ∀ j, |chebyshevCoeff (fun x => Real.exp (a * x)) (j + (n + 1))| =
      2 * |modifiedBesselCoeff a (j + (n + 1))| := by
    intro j
    rw [chebyshevCoeff_exp_eq_modifiedBesselCoeff, if_neg (by omega), abs_mul]
    norm_num
  simp_rw [hterm] at h
  simpa only [tsum_mul_left] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_cos_gaussChebyshev_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hLR : 0 < (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  let a : ℝ := (k : ℝ)*π/L
  have ha : 0 < a/2 := by dsimp [a];positivity
  have haπ : a/2 < π := by
    dsimp [a]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),div_lt_iff₀ hLR]
    have hkR : (k : ℝ) < 2*L := by exact_mod_cast hkL
    nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hsin : sin (a/2) ≠ 0 := (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi ha haπ).ne'
  have ht := sin_mul_sum_cos L a (a/2)
  have h₁ : (L : ℝ)*a/2 = (k : ℝ)*π/2 := by dsimp [a];field_simp
  have h₂ : ((L : ℝ)-1)*a/2+a/2 = (k : ℝ)*π/2 := by rw [show ((L : ℝ)-1)*a/2+a/2 = (L : ℝ)*a/2 by ring,h₁]
  rw [h₁,h₂] at ht
  have hs : sin ((k : ℝ)*π/2)*cos ((k : ℝ)*π/2) = 0 := by
    have h := sin_two_mul ((k : ℝ)*π/2)
    rw [show 2*((k : ℝ)*π/2) = (k : ℝ)*π by ring,sin_nat_mul_pi] at h
    linarith
  rw [hs] at ht
  have hsum := (mul_eq_zero.mp ht).resolve_left hsin
  convert hsum using 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  congr 1
  dsimp [a]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gaussChebyshevRule_eval_T
statement:
theorem gaussChebyshevRule_eval_T {L k : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (hkL : k < 2*L) :
    gaussChebyshevRule L (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval = if k=0 then π else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k=0
  · subst k
    simp only [gaussChebyshevRule,Nat.cast_zero,T_zero,eval_one,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ π (by exact_mod_cast hL.ne' : (L : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  rw [if_neg hk,gaussChebyshevRule]
  have he : (∑ j : Fin L,(T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero L j)) = 0 := by
    simp only [chebyshevZero,T_real_cos,Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ => cos ((k : ℝ)*((2*(j : ℝ)+1)*π/(2*L))))]
    exact sum_cos_gaussChebyshev_eq_zero hL (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk) hkL
  rw [he,mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_measureT_eq_gaussChebyshevRule
statement:
theorem integral_eval_measureT_eq_gaussChebyshevRule {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2*L : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x,p.eval x ∂measureT) = gaussChebyshevRule L p.eval
proof:
:= by
  let I := polynomialIntegral measureT hasPolynomialMoments_measureT
  let Q : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun p => gaussChebyshevRule L p.eval
      map_add' := by intro p q;simp [gaussChebyshevRule,mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c p
        simp only [gaussChebyshevRule,eval_smul,smul_eq_mul,RingHom.id_apply,← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring }
  have hT (k : ℕ) (hk : k<2*L) : I (T ℝ (k : ℤ)) = Q (T ℝ (k : ℤ)) := by
    change (∫ x,(T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x ∂measureT) = gaussChebyshevRule L (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval
    rw [gaussChebyshevRule_eval_T hL hk]
    by_cases hk0 : k=0
    · subst k
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero,if_true] using integral_eval_T_real_measureT_zero
    · rw [if_neg hk0]
      exact integral_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk0)
  by_cases hp0 : p=0
  · simp [hp0,gaussChebyshevRule]
  have hp' : p.degree ≤ (2*L-1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp0] at hp ⊢
    have hd : p.natDegree < 2*L := by exact_mod_cast hp
    exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree ≤ 2*L-1 by omega)
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := exists_sum_smul_T_eq_of_degree_le hp'
  change I p = Q p
  rw [← hc,map_sum,map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [map_smul,map_smul,hT k (by have := mem_range.mp hk;omega)]

name: NLAlib.gaussChebyshevRule_one
statement:
theorem gaussChebyshevRule_one {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    gaussChebyshevRule L (fun _ => 1) = π
proof:
:= by
  simpa using gaussChebyshevRule_eval_T hL (k := 0) (by omega)

name: NLAlib.gaussChebyshevRule_normalized_mul
statement:
theorem gaussChebyshevRule_normalized_mul {L j k : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hj : j<L) (hk : k<L) :
    gaussChebyshevRule L (fun x => normalizedChebyshev j x * normalizedChebyshev k x) =
      if j=k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := normalizedChebyshevPolynomial j * normalizedChebyshevPolynomial k
  have hd (l : ℕ) : (normalizedChebyshevPolynomial l).degree = (l : ℕ) := by
    rw [normalizedChebyshevPolynomial,degree_C_mul (normalizedChebyshevWeight_pos l).ne',degree_T]
    simp
  have hdeg : p.degree < (2*L : ℕ) := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_mul_le _ _)
    rw [hd,hd,← Nat.cast_add]
    exact_mod_cast (show j+k<2*L by omega)
  have he := integral_eval_measureT_eq_gaussChebyshevRule hL hdeg
  simp only [p,eval_mul,eval_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial] at he
  exact he.symm.trans (integral_normalizedChebyshev_mul j k)

name: NLAlib.abs_im_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem abs_im_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) : |z.im| ≤ (ρ - ρ⁻¹) / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
  let r := ‖w‖
  have hr : 0 < r := by change 0 < ‖w‖; linarith [hw.1]
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by linarith
  have hi : (joukowski w).im = w.im * ((1 - (r^2)⁻¹) / 2) := by
    rw [joukowski, Complex.div_ofNat_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.inv_im,
      Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    change (w.im + -w.im / r^2) / 2 = w.im * ((1 - (r^2)⁻¹) / 2)
    field_simp
    ring
  have hc : 0 ≤ (1 - (r^2)⁻¹) / 2 := by
    have hsq : 1 ≤ r^2 := one_le_pow₀ hw.1
    have hinv : (r^2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ (pow_pos hr 2)).mpr hsq
    linarith
  have hinv : ρ⁻¹ ≤ r⁻¹ := (inv_le_inv₀ hρpos hr).mpr hw.2
  have hrange : r - r⁻¹ ≤ ρ - ρ⁻¹ := by
    have hwr : r ≤ ρ := hw.2
    linarith
  rw [hi, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc]
  calc
    |w.im| * ((1 - (r^2)⁻¹) / 2) ≤ r * ((1 - (r^2)⁻¹) / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w) hc
    _ = (r - r⁻¹) / 2 := by field_simp
    _ ≤ (ρ - ρ⁻¹) / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrange (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.norm_le_cosh_and_abs_im_le_sinh_of_mem_openBernsteinEllipse
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : 1 < Real.exp t := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr ht
  have hfilled := (mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ.le z).mpr
    ((mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ z).mp hz).le
  constructor
  · simpa only [Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg] using norm_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ.le hfilled
  · simpa only [Real.sinh_eq, Real.exp_neg] using abs_im_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ.le hfilled

name: NLAlib.exists_lt_radius_subset_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem exists_lt_radius_subset_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hsub : K ⊆ openBernsteinEllipse ρ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 1 < r ∧ r < ρ ∧ K ⊆ filledBernsteinEllipse r
proof:
:= by
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hrρ⟩ := exists_between hρ
    exact ⟨r, hr, hrρ, empty_subset _⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hmax⟩ := hK.exists_isMaxOn hne
    (show ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => ‖z - 1‖ + ‖z + 1‖) K by fun_prop)
  have hzellipse := hsub hz
  rw [openBernsteinEllipse_eq_image_one_le_norm hρ] at hzellipse
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := hzellipse
  obtain ⟨r, hwr, hrρ⟩ := exists_between hw.2
  have hr : 1 < r := hw.1.trans_lt hwr
