  refine ⟨r, hr, hrρ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff hr.le]
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith [hw.1])
  have hmax' : ‖y - 1‖ + ‖y + 1‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + ‖w‖⁻¹ := by
    rw [← norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hw0, hwz]
    exact hmax hy
  exact hmax'.trans (strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one.monotoneOn hw.1 hr.le hwr.le)

name: NLAlib.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_comp_cos_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_comp_cos_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (f ∘ cos) 0 π
proof:
:= by
  have hg : LipschitzOnWith L (f ∘ cos) (uIcc (0 : ℝ) π) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hf.comp lipschitzWith_cos.lipschitzOnWith
      (fun x _ => ⟨neg_one_le_cos x, cos_le_one x⟩)
  exact hg.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval

name: NLAlib.abs_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem abs_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (θ : ℝ) :
    |deriv (f ∘ cos) θ| ≤ L * |sin θ|
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.deriv_cos, abs_neg] using
    hf.norm_deriv_comp_le differentiableAt_cos
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ⟨neg_one_le_cos x, cos_le_one x⟩))

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem integral_sq_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, deriv (f ∘ cos) θ ^ 2) ≤ π * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb (θ : ℝ) : deriv (f ∘ cos) θ ^ 2 ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin θ ^ 2 := by
    have h := abs_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf θ
    have hh := mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg _) h
    simpa only [← sq, mul_pow, sq_abs] using hh
  have hmajor : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin θ ^ 2) volume 0 π :=
    (show Continuous (fun θ => (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin θ ^ 2) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => deriv (f ∘ cos) θ ^ 2) volume 0 π := by
    apply hmajor.mono_fun' ((measurable_deriv _).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with θ
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq] using hb θ
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on pi_pos.le hi hmajor (fun θ _ => hb θ)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_sin_sq] at h
  simp only [sin_zero, sin_pi, zero_mul, sub_zero] at h
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq
statement:
theorem integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, -deriv (f ∘ cos) θ * sin ((j : ℝ) * θ)) =
      π / 2 * ((j : ℝ) * chebyshevCoeff f j)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_comp_cos_of_lipschitzOnWith hf
  have hs : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun θ => sin ((j : ℝ) * θ)) 0 π :=
    (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun θ => sin ((j : ℝ) * θ)) from by fun_prop).contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval
  have hd (θ : ℝ) : deriv (fun t => sin ((j : ℝ) * t)) θ =
      (j : ℝ) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) := by
    simpa only [id_eq, mul_comm, mul_one] using (((hasDerivAt_id θ).const_mul (j : ℝ)).sin).deriv
  have hi := hg.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hs
  simp only [hd, Function.comp_apply, mul_zero, sin_zero, sin_nat_mul_pi, mul_zero,
    sub_zero, zero_sub] at hi
  have hleft : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, f (cos θ) * ((j : ℝ) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ))) =
      (j : ℝ) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, f (cos θ) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro θ _
    ring
  rw [hleft] at hi
  simp_rw [neg_mul]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, ← hi, chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral,
    if_neg (by omega : j ≠ 0)]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 < j) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, (j : ℝ) ^ 2 * chebyshevCoeff f j ^ 2) ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hg := absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_comp_cos_of_lipschitzOnWith hf
  have hb (θ : ℝ) : deriv (f ∘ cos) θ ^ 2 ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin θ ^ 2 := by
    have hh := mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg _)
      (abs_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf θ)
    simpa only [← sq, mul_pow, sq_abs] using hh
  have hmajor : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin θ ^ 2) volume 0 π :=
    (show Continuous (fun θ => (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin θ ^ 2) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hv2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => (-deriv (f ∘ cos) θ) ^ 2) volume 0 π := by
    apply hmajor.mono_fun' (((measurable_deriv _).neg).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with θ
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.neg_apply, neg_sq, abs_sq] using hb θ
  have h := sum_sq_le_two_div_pi_integral_sq_of_sine_coefficients
    hg.intervalIntegrable_deriv.neg hv2 s hs (fun j => (j : ℝ) * chebyshevCoeff f j)
    (fun j hj => integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq hf (hs j hj))
  simp only [mul_pow, Pi.neg_apply, neg_sq] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  have henergy := integral_sq_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henergy (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / π by positivity)
  convert hm using 1
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.summable_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem summable_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ => ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * chebyshevCoeff f (j + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply summable_of_sum_le (fun j => by positivity) (c := (L : ℝ) ^ 2)
  intro s
  let e : ℕ ↪ ℕ := ⟨fun j => j + 1, fun _ _ h => Nat.add_right_cancel h⟩
  have h := sum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf (s.map e)
    (fun j hj => by rcases mem_map.mp hj with ⟨k, _, rfl⟩; change 0 < k + 1; omega)
  rw [sum_map] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.tsum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem tsum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * chebyshevCoeff f (j + 1) ^ 2) ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply (summable_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_of_lipschitzOnWith hf).tsum_le_of_sum_le
  intro s
  let e : ℕ ↪ ℕ := ⟨fun j => j + 1, fun _ _ h => Nat.add_right_cancel h⟩
  have h := sum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf (s.map e)
    (fun j hj => by rcases mem_map.mp hj with ⟨k, _, rfl⟩; change 0 < k + 1; omega)
  rw [sum_map] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.tsum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_affine
statement:
theorem tsum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_affine (c a : ℝ) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => c + a * x) (j + 1) ^ 2) = a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc (k : ℕ) : chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => c + a * x) k =
      c * (if 0 = k then 1 else 0) + a * (if 1 = k then 1 else 0) := by
    have heq : (fun x : ℝ => c + a * x) = (fun x : ℝ =>
        c * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (0 : ℤ)).eval x +
          a * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (1 : ℤ)).eval x) := by
      funext x
      simp
    rw [heq, chebyshevCoeff_add (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      chebyshevCoeff_const_mul, chebyshevCoeff_const_mul]
    have h0 := chebyshevCoeff_eval_T 0 k
    have h1 := chebyshevCoeff_eval_T 1 k
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one] at h0 h1
    rw [h0, h1]
  have heq (j : ℕ) : ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => c + a * x) (j + 1) ^ 2 =
        if j = 0 then a ^ 2 else 0 := by
    rw [hc]
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · simp [hj]
    · simp [hj]
  simp_rw [heq]
  simp

name: NLAlib.bernsteinIntervalLower_pos
statement:
theorem bernsteinIntervalLower_pos {a b ρ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hr : ρ < (√b + √a) / (√b - √a)) :
    0 < bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  have harg : 1 ≤ (b + a) / (b - a) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hba]; linarith
  have hs : 1 < (√b + √a) / (√b - √a) := by
    have hsa := sqrt_pos.mpr ha
    have hsb := sqrt_lt_sqrt ha.le hab
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < √b - √a)]
    linarith
  have hiden : (√b + √a) / (√b - √a) + ((√b + √a) / (√b - √a))⁻¹ =
      2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) := by
    rw [← add_div_sub_add_sqrt_sq_sub_one_eq ha hab,
      Real.add_sqrt_self_sq_sub_one_inv harg]
    ring
  have hcmp := strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one (𝕜 := ℝ) hρ.le hs.le hr
  dsimp only at hcmp
  rw [hiden] at hcmp
  have hh : (ρ + ρ⁻¹) * (b - a) < 2 * (b + a) := by
    rwa [← mul_div_assoc, lt_div_iff₀ hba] at hcmp
  dsimp [bernsteinIntervalLower]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.bernsteinIntervalMap_mem_enclosure
statement:
theorem bernsteinIntervalMap_mem_enclosure {a b ρ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hρ : 1 < ρ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ) :
    bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ ≤ (bernsteinIntervalMap a b z).re ∧
      ‖bernsteinIntervalMap a b z‖ ≤ bernsteinIntervalUpper a b ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hfilled := (mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ.le z).mpr
    ((mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ z).mp hz).le
  constructor
  · simpa [bernsteinIntervalLower, bernsteinIntervalMap, Complex.div_re] using
      re_affine_ge_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hab.le hρ.le hfilled
  · have hsum : 0 ≤ b + a := by linarith
    simpa only [bernsteinIntervalMap, bernsteinIntervalUpper, abs_of_nonneg hsum] using
      norm_affine_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hab.le hρ.le hfilled

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_rightHalfPlane
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_rightHalfPlane
    {a b ρ M : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hr : ρ < (√b + √a) / (√b - √a))
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re})
    (hM : ∀ z : ℂ, bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ ≤ z.re →
      ‖z‖ ≤ bernsteinIntervalUpper a b ρ → ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ n / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := bernsteinIntervalLower_pos ha hab hρ hr
  have hmaps : MapsTo (bernsteinIntervalMap a b) (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)
      {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re} := by
    intro z hz
    exact hlower.trans_le (bernsteinIntervalMap_mem_enclosure ha hab hρ hz).1
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ (bernsteinIntervalMap a b) := by
    unfold bernsteinIntervalMap
    fun_prop
  refine exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval hab hρ
    (hF.comp hdiff.differentiableOn hmaps) ?_ ?_ n
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := bernsteinIntervalMap_mem_enclosure ha hab hρ hz
    exact hM _ hl hu
  · intro t ht
    have hreal : bernsteinIntervalMap a b (t : ℂ) =
        (((b - a) * t + b + a) / 2 : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [bernsteinIntervalMap]
      push_cast
      ring
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hreal]
    apply hmatch
    constructor <;> nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2]

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_rpow_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_rpow_sub_eval_le {a b ρ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hr : ρ < (√b + √a) / (√b - √a)) (α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      |x ^ α - p.eval x| ≤
        2 * max ((bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ) ^ α)
          ((bernsteinIntervalUpper a b ρ) ^ α) / ρ ^ n / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := bernsteinIntervalLower_pos ha hab hρ hr
  apply exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_rightHalfPlane
    (F := fun z : ℂ => z ^ (α : ℂ)) ha hab hρ hr
  · intro z hz
    exact (Complex.hasStrictDerivAt_cpow_const (c := (α : ℂ))
      (Or.inl hz : z ∈ Complex.slitPlane)).hasDerivAt.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro z hl hu
    have hlnorm : bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ ≤ ‖z‖ := hl.trans (Complex.re_le_norm z)
    rw [Complex.norm_cpow_real]
    rcases le_total 0 α with hα | hα
    · exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hu hα).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    · exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hlower hlnorm hα).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · intro x hx
    exact (Complex.ofReal_cpow (ha.le.trans hx.1) α).symm

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_log_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_log_sub_eval_le {a b ρ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hr : ρ < (√b + √a) / (√b - √a)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      |Real.log x - p.eval x| ≤
        2 * (max |Real.log (bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ)|
          |Real.log (bernsteinIntervalUpper a b ρ)| + Real.pi / 2) / ρ ^ n / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := bernsteinIntervalLower_pos ha hab hρ hr
  apply exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_rightHalfPlane
    (F := Complex.log) ha hab hρ hr
  · intro z hz
    exact (Complex.differentiableAt_log (Or.inl hz : z ∈ Complex.slitPlane)).differentiableWithinAt
  · intro z hl hu
    have hlnorm : bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ ≤ ‖z‖ := hl.trans (Complex.re_le_norm z)
    have hnpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := hlower.trans_le hlnorm
    have hloglo := Real.log_le_log hlower hlnorm
    have hloghi := Real.log_le_log hnpos hu
    have hlogabs : |Real.log ‖z‖| ≤ max |Real.log (bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ)|
        |Real.log (bernsteinIntervalUpper a b ρ)| := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · have hm := le_max_left |Real.log (bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ)|
          |Real.log (bernsteinIntervalUpper a b ρ)|
        linarith [neg_le_abs (Real.log (bernsteinIntervalLower a b ρ))]
      · exact hloghi.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
    have harg : |Complex.arg z| ≤ Real.pi / 2 :=
      Complex.abs_arg_le_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (hlower.le.trans hl)
    exact (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans (by
      rw [Complex.log_re, Complex.log_im]
      exact add_le_add hlogabs harg)
  · intro x hx
    exact (Complex.ofReal_log (ha.le.trans hx.1)).symm

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eq_weighted_integral
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eq_weighted_integral (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff f k = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi *
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (f x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) * Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff, integral_measureT]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff f k = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi *
      ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, f (Real.cos θ) * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff, integral_measureT_eq_integral_cos]
  simp_rw [T_real_cos, Int.cast_natCast]

name: NLAlib.eval_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (normalizedChebyshevPolynomial j).eval x = normalizedChebyshev j x
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedChebyshevPolynomial, normalizedChebyshev]

name: NLAlib.eval_map_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_map_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ((normalizedChebyshevPolynomial j).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ) =
      (normalizedChebyshev j x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (x : ℂ) = Complex.ofRealHom x from rfl, eval_map_apply,
    eval_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevJacksonApprox_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevJacksonApprox_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevJacksonApprox f M).degree ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun j hj => ?_)
  refine (degree_mul_le _ _).trans ?_
  have hT : (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).degree ≤ M := by
    rw [degree_T]
    exact_mod_cast (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega : j ≤ M)
  exact (add_le_add degree_C_le hT).trans_eq (zero_add _)

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (chebyshevJacksonApprox f M).eval r =
      ∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * f x ∂measureT
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
      chebyshevJacksonDamping M j * normalizedChebyshev j x * normalizedChebyshev j r * f x =
      (chebyshevJacksonDamping M j * normalizedChebyshevWeight j ^ 2 * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval r) *
        (f x * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) := by
    unfold normalizedChebyshev
    ring
  simp only [chebyshevJacksonApprox, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  simp_rw [chebyshevJacksonKernel, sum_mul, hterm]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun j x =>
    (chebyshevJacksonDamping M j * normalizedChebyshevWeight j ^ 2 * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval r) *
      (f x * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x)) _ (fun j _ =>
        (integrable_measureT (hf.mul (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).continuous.continuousOn)).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  unfold chebyshevCoeff
  ring

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_nonneg
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f x)
    (M : ℕ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ (chebyshevJacksonApprox f M).eval r
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral hf]
  apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_Icc_measureT] with x hx
  exact mul_nonneg (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr) (hpos x hx)

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral hf, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => B * chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r) measureT :=
    integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)
  refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hi ?_).trans_eq ?_
  · filter_upwards [ae_mem_Icc_measureT] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB x hx) (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr)).trans_eq
      (mul_comm _ _)
  · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(chebyshevJacksonApprox f M).eval r - f r| ≤ 6 * (L : ℝ) / M
proof:
:= by
  have hiK : Integrable (fun x => chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r) measureT :=
    integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)
  have hif : Integrable (fun x => chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * f x) measureT :=
    integrable_measureT ((continuous_chebyshevJacksonKernel M r).continuousOn.mul hf.continuousOn)
  have heq : (chebyshevJacksonApprox f M).eval r - f r =
      ∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (f x - f r) ∂measureT := by
    rw [eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral hf.continuousOn]
    simp_rw [mul_sub]
    rw [integral_sub hif (hiK.mul_const _), integral_mul_const, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel,
      one_mul]
  rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hdom : Integrable (fun x => (L : ℝ) * (chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x - r|)) measureT :=
    integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)
  have hbound := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hdom (show ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT,
      ‖chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * (f x - f r)‖ ≤
        (L : ℝ) * (chebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x - r|) from by
    filter_upwards [ae_mem_Icc_measureT] with x hx
    have hLip := hf.dist_le_mul x hx r hr
    simp only [Real.dist_eq] at hLip
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLip (chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr)).trans_eq
      (by ring))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hbound
  exact hbound.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le hM hr) L.coe_nonneg).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.normalizedChebyshevWeight_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem normalizedChebyshevWeight_mem_Icc (j : ℕ) :
    normalizedChebyshevWeight j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnon : 0 ≤ normalizedChebyshevWeight j := sqrt_nonneg _
  refine ⟨hnon,?_⟩
  have hs : normalizedChebyshevWeight j ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq]
    apply (div_le_one pi_pos).mpr
    split_ifs <;> linarith [pi_gt_three]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_normalizedChebyshev_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_normalizedChebyshev_le_one (j : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : |normalizedChebyshev j x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedChebyshev,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (normalizedChebyshevWeight_mem_Icc j).1]
  exact (mul_le_mul (normalizedChebyshevWeight_mem_Icc j).2
    (Chebyshev.abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx)) (abs_nonneg _)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).trans_eq (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorNormalizedChebyshev_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_tensorNormalizedChebyshev_le_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (α : ι → ℕ) {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorNormalizedChebyshev,Finset.abs_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_le_one (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun i _ => abs_normalizedChebyshev_le_one _ (hx i))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_sign_eq_half_integral
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_sign_eq_half_integral (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff Real.sign k = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi * (1 - (-1 : ℝ) ^ k) *
      ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => Real.sign (Real.cos θ) * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
  have hfirst : EqOn u (fun θ => Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)) (uIoo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) := by
    intro θ hθ
    have ht : θ ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) := by simpa [uIoo_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi / 2)] using hθ
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [Real.sign_of_pos (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [ht.1, Real.pi_pos], ht.2⟩), one_mul]
  have hsecond : EqOn u (fun θ => -Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)) (uIoo (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi) := by
    intro θ hθ
    have ht : θ ∈ Ioo (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi := by
      simpa [uIoo_of_le (show Real.pi / 2 ≤ Real.pi by linarith [Real.pi_pos])] using hθ
    dsimp only [u]
    have hneg : Real.cos θ < 0 := Real.cos_neg_of_pi_div_two_lt_of_lt
      ht.1 (by linarith [ht.2, Real.pi_pos])
    rw [Real.sign_of_neg hneg, neg_one_mul]
  have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable u volume 0 (Real.pi / 2) :=
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ))).intervalIntegrable _ _).congr_uIoo hfirst.symm
  have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable u volume (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi :=
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => -Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ))).intervalIntegrable _ _).congr_uIoo hsecond.symm
  have hsym : ∀ θ, u (Real.pi - θ) = -((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) * u θ := by
    intro θ
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.sign_neg,
      show (k : ℝ) * (Real.pi - θ) = (k : ℝ) * Real.pi - (k : ℝ) * θ by ring,
      Real.cos_nat_mul_pi_sub]
    ring
  have hreflect : (∫ θ in Real.pi / 2..Real.pi, u θ) =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) * ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, u θ := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (f := u) (a := 0) (b := Real.pi / 2) Real.pi
    simp only [show Real.pi - Real.pi / 2 = Real.pi / 2 by ring, sub_zero, hsym] at h
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi1 hi2
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral]
  change (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi * (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, u θ) = _
  rw [← hsplit, hreflect, intervalIntegral.integral_congr_uIoo hfirst]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_sign_even
statement: @[simp] theorem chebyshevCoeff_sign_even (j : ℕ) : chebyshevCoeff Real.sign (2 * j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_sign_eq_half_integral]
  simp [pow_mul]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_sign_odd
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_sign_odd (j : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff Real.sign (2 * j + 1) = 4 * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j / (Real.pi * (2 * j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_sign_eq_half_integral, if_neg (by omega),
    integral_cos_mul_half_pi _ (by positivity)]
  have hsin : Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2)) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ j := by
    rw [show (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (Real.pi / 2) = (j : ℝ) * Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by push_cast; ring]
    simp [Real.sin_add, Real.cos_nat_mul_pi]
  rw [hsin]
  simp [pow_add, pow_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.neg_one_pow_mul_eval_T_odd_sin
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_eval_T_odd_sin (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (T ℝ ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval (Real.sin φ) =
      Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub φ, T_real_cos]
  have hangle : ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2 - φ) =
      (Real.pi / 2 - ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) + (j : ℝ) * Real.pi := by
    push_cast
    ring
  simp only [Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [hangle, Real.cos_add_nat_mul_pi, Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub,
    ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.tendsto_sum_sign_chebyshevSeries
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_sign_chebyshevSeries {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    Tendsto (fun m => 4 / Real.pi * ∑ j ∈ range m,
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) * (T ℝ ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x)
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.sign x))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst x
    have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ, ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) *
        (T ℝ ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval 0 = 0 := by
      intro j
      have h := neg_one_pow_mul_eval_T_odd_sin j 0
      simp only [Real.sin_zero, mul_zero] at h
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, h, zero_div]
    simp_rw [hterm, sum_const_zero, mul_zero, Real.sign_zero]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  · have hsin : Real.sin (Real.arcsin x) = x := Real.sin_arcsin hx.1 hx.2
    have h := (tendsto_sum_sin_odd_div (Real.arcsin x) (by rwa [hsin])).const_mul (4 / Real.pi)
    have hvalue : 4 / Real.pi * (Real.pi / 4 * Real.sign (Real.sin (Real.arcsin x))) = Real.sign x := by
      rw [hsin]
      field_simp
    rw [hvalue] at h
    have hfunc : (fun m => 4 / Real.pi * ∑ j ∈ range m,
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) * (T ℝ ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x) =
        fun m => 4 / Real.pi * ∑ j ∈ range m,
          Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.arcsin x) / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) := by
      funext m
      congr 1
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have hT := neg_one_pow_mul_eval_T_odd_sin j (Real.arcsin x)
      rw [hsin] at hT
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, hT]
    rw [hfunc]
    exact h

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv
statement:
theorem summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv {ν : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff (F 0) k|)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν (le_refl ν)).mul_left (2 * V / Real.pi)
  apply (summable_nat_add_iff (ν + 1)).mp
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) _ hs
  intro j
  have hb := abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial hAC hderiv hBV hV
    (k := j + (ν + 1)) (by omega)
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hb

name: NLAlib.tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_descFactorial
statement:
theorem tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_descFactorial {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν ≤ n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    (∑' j, |chebyshevCoeff (F 0) (j + (n + 1))|) ≤
      2 * V / (Real.pi * ν * (n.descFactorial ν : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hVnonneg : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hs := (summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν hn).mul_left (2 * V / Real.pi)
  have hcoeff := (summable_nat_add_iff (n + 1)).mpr
    (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv hν hAC hderiv hBV hV)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j, (2 * V / Real.pi) * ((n + 1 + j).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply hcoeff.tsum_le_tsum _ hs
      intro j
      have hb := abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial hAC hderiv hBV hV
        (k := j + (n + 1)) (by omega)
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hb
    _ = (2 * V / Real.pi) * ∑' j, ((n + 1 + j).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      tsum_mul_left
    _ ≤ (2 * V / Real.pi) * ((n.descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ / ν) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tsum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le hν hn) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_pow
statement:
theorem tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_pow {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν < n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    (∑' j, |chebyshevCoeff (F 0) (j + (n + 1))|) ≤
      2 * V / (Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hVnonneg : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hpow : ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν ≤ (n.descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sub hn.le, ← Nat.cast_pow]
    exact_mod_cast (show (n - ν) ^ ν ≤ n.descFactorial ν from
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega : n - ν ≤ n + 1 - ν) ν).trans
        (Nat.pow_sub_le_descFactorial n ν))
  have hnreal : (ν : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hνreal : (0 : ℝ) < ν := by exact_mod_cast hν
  exact (tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_descFactorial hν hn.le hAC hderiv hBV hV).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity)
      (mul_pos (mul_pos pi_pos hνreal) (pow_pos (sub_pos.mpr hnreal) ν))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)))

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_of_bv {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν < n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |F 0 x - (chebyshevTrunc (F 0) n).eval x| ≤
      2 * V / (Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (F 0) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    simpa using (hAC 0 hν).continuousOn
  exact (abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_tsum hf
    (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv hν hAC hderiv hBV hV) n hx).trans
    (tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_pow hν hn hAC hderiv hBV hV)

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_eval_chebyshevInterpolant_le_of_bv
statement:
theorem abs_sub_eval_chebyshevInterpolant_le_of_bv {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν < n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |F 0 x - (chebyshevInterpolant (F 0) n).eval x| ≤
      4 * V / (Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (F 0) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    simpa using (hAC 0 hν).continuousOn
  have hb := abs_sub_eval_chebyshevInterpolant_le_two_mul_tsum hf
    (summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_of_bv hν hAC hderiv hBV hV) (by omega : 0 < n) hx
  exact hb.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_tail_le_pow hν hn hAC hderiv hBV hV)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_approx_of_bv
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_approx_of_bv {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν < n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |F 0 x - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * V / (Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:=
  ⟨chebyshevTrunc (F 0) n, degree_chebyshevTrunc_le (F 0) n,
    fun _ hx => abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_of_bv hν hn hAC hderiv hBV hV hx⟩

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_le_of_bv
statement:
theorem minimaxError_le_of_bv (f : C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℝ))
    {ν n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ} (hF : ∀ x : Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F 0 x = f x)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν < n)
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V) :
    minimaxError n f ≤ 2 * V / (Real.pi * ν * ((n : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hVnonneg : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) - ν := sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hn.le)
  have hmem : (chebyshevTrunc (F 0) n).toContinuousMapOn (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) ∈
      polynomialApproximationSpace (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) n :=
    mem_polynomialApproximationSpace_iff.mpr
      ⟨chebyshevTrunc (F 0) n, degree_chebyshevTrunc_le (F 0) n, rfl⟩
  apply (minimaxError_le_norm_sub f hmem).trans
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (by positivity)).mpr
  intro x
  change |f x - (chebyshevTrunc (F 0) n).eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ _
  rw [← hF x]
  exact abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_of_bv hν hn hAC hderiv hBV hV x.property

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ) *
      fourier (k : ℤ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) +
      (fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (-(k : ℤ)) *
        fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)))).re =
      chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierCoeff_chebyshevCircleFunction_neg, ← mul_add, fourier_neg, Complex.add_conj,
    T_real_cos, re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos]
  rw [chebyshevAnalyticCoeff, chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  norm_num
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ))
      (F (Real.cos θ)).re
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℤ → ℂ := fun k => fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) k *
    fourier k (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
  have hu : HasSum u (F (Real.cos θ)) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, chebyshevCircleFunction_coe_eq_cos] using
      hasSum_fourier_chebyshevCircleFunction_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM
        (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
  have hp : Summable (fun k : ℕ => u (k : ℤ)) :=
    hu.summable.comp_injective Nat.cast_injective
  have hn : Summable (fun k : ℕ => u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) :=
    hu.summable.comp_injective (show Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => -((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) by
      intro a b hab
      have h := neg_injective hab
      exact Nat.add_right_cancel (Int.natCast_inj.mp h))
  have hps : Summable (fun k : ℕ => u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hp
  have hsum : (∑' k : ℕ, u (k : ℤ)) + (∑' k : ℕ, u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      F (Real.cos θ) := by
    rw [← hu.tsum_eq]
    exact (tsum_of_nat_of_neg_add_one hp hn).symm
  have hsplit := hp.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  simp only [sum_range_one] at hsplit
  have hpair := Complex.reCLM.hasSum (hps.hasSum.add hn.hasSum)
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))).re =
        chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F (k + 1) * (T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ) := by
    intro k
    exact re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T F (Nat.succ_pos k) θ
  change HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))).re)
    ((∑' k : ℕ, u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + (∑' k : ℕ, u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))).re at hpair
  simp_rw [hterm] at hpair
  have hfull := hpair.zero_add (f := fun k : ℕ =>
    chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ))
  have hzero : chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F 0 * (T ℝ (0 : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ) = (u 0).re := by
    simp [chebyshevAnalyticCoeff, chebyshevComplexCoeff_eq_fourierCoeff, u]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hfull hsplit
  rw [hzero] at hfull
  have heq : (u 0).re +
      ((∑' k : ℕ, u ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + (∑' k : ℕ, u (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))).re =
        (F (Real.cos θ)).re := by
    rw [← Complex.add_re, ← add_assoc, hsplit, hsum]
  rw [heq] at hfull
  exact hfull

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le (F : ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).degree ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevAnalyticTrunc
  refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun k hk => ?_)
  rw [C_mul']
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) (F x).re
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2] using
    hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM (Real.arccos x)

name: NLAlib.abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (N : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(F x).re - (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).eval x| ≤
      2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x
  have hu : HasSum u (F x).re := hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hx
  have hsplit := hu.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add (N + 1)
  rw [hu.tsum_eq] at hsplit
  have hp : (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).eval x = ∑ k ∈ range (N + 1), u k := by
    simp only [chebyshevAnalyticTrunc, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, u]
  have herr : (F x).re - (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).eval x =
      ∑' i : ℕ, u (i + (N + 1)) := by rw [hp]; linarith
  have hq : |ρ⁻¹| < 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < ρ⁻¹)]
    exact (inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hρ
  have hgeom : Summable (fun i : ℕ => 2 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1))) := by
    have h := ((summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq).mul_right ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (N + 1))).mul_left (2 * M)
    convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
    funext i
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, pow_add]
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖u (i + (N + 1))‖ ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1)) := by
    intro i
    have hc := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM
      (k := i + (N + 1)) (by omega)
    have hT := abs_eval_T_real_le_one ((i + (N + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) (abs_le.mpr hx)
    dsimp [u]
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (abs_nonneg _)).trans (by simpa using hc)
  have hnorm := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _) hterm hgeom
  rw [herr, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  refine (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm).trans ((hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hterm hgeom).trans_eq ?_)
  have hterm_eq : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1)) =
      2 * M * ((ρ⁻¹) ^ i * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (N + 1)) := by
    intro i
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, pow_add]
  simp_rw [hterm_eq]
  rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_right, tsum_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq]
  have hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)
  rw [pow_succ]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp [hρ0]

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N, degree_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le F N, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have h := abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM N hx
  rw [hmatch x hx, Complex.ofReal_re] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {a c ρ M : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F t = (f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2) : ℂ))
    (N : ℕ) : ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a c,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hE⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    (f := fun t => f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2)) hρ hFd hM hmatch N
  let s : ℝ[X] := C (2 / (c - a)) * X - C ((c + a) / (c - a))
  refine ⟨p.comp s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
    refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
    have hpN := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp
    have hs : s.natDegree ≤ 1 := by
      refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
      · exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans natDegree_X_le
      · simp
    nlinarith
  · intro x hx
    have hca : 0 < c - a := sub_pos.mpr hac
    let t := 2 / (c - a) * x - (c + a) / (c - a)
    have ht : t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have htform : t = (2 * x - c - a) / (c - a) := by dsimp [t]; ring
      rw [htform]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hca]
        nlinarith [hx.1]
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hca]
        nlinarith [hx.2]
    have heq : ((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2 = x := by
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hca]
      ring
    have h := hE t ht
    rw [heq] at h
    simpa only [eval_comp, s, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, t] using h

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem summable_abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    Summable (fun k => |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k|)
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans
    (abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM)
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < ρ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hρ0
  have hq1 : ρ⁻¹ < 1 := (inv_lt_one₀ hρ0).mpr hρ
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => abs_nonneg _) ?_
    ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0.le hq1).mul_left (2 * M))
  intro k
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_zero_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using h.trans (by linarith : M ≤ 2 * M)
  · have h := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hk
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using h

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_chebyshevCube
statement:
theorem ae_mem_chebyshevCube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] :
    ∀ᵐ x : ι → ℝ ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT), WithLp.toLp 2 x ∈ chebyshevCube ι
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have h : ∀ᵐ x ∂measureT, x ∈ Ioc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      unfold measureT
      exact ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc
    exact h.mono fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩
  exact ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i =>
    (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := fun _ : ι => measureT)).eventually h1)

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevCoeff_congr
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevCoeff_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {f g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hfg : EqOn f g (chebyshevCube ι)) (α : ι → ℕ) :
    tensorChebyshevCoeff f α = tensorChebyshevCoeff g α
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
  rw [hfg hx]

name: NLAlib.normalizedChebyshev_cos
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedChebyshev_cos (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshev k (cos θ) = normalizedChebyshevWeight k * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedChebyshev, T_real_cos]

name: NLAlib.normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq
statement:
theorem normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq (k : ℕ) :
    normalizedChebyshevWeight k ^ 2 = (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / π
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedChebyshevWeight, sq_sqrt]
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: NLAlib.normalizedChebyshev_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedChebyshev_zero (x : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshev 0 x = 1 / sqrt π
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedChebyshev, normalizedChebyshevWeight]

name: NLAlib.integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous
statement:
theorem integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ} (hF : Continuous F) :
    Integrable F (Measure.pi (fun _ => chebyshevAngleMeasure))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ι => Icc (0 : ℝ) π)) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ => isCompact_Icc)
  have hi := hF.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => volume)) hc
  have hs : Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ι => Ioc (0 : ℝ) π) ⊆
      Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ι => Icc (0 : ℝ) π) := by
    intro x hx i hi
    exact ⟨(hx i hi).1.le, (hx i hi).2⟩
  have h := hi.mono_set hs
  simpa only [IntegrableOn, Measure.restrict_pi_pi, chebyshevAngleMeasure] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_normalizedChebyshev_cos_mul
statement:
theorem integral_normalizedChebyshev_cos_mul (j k : ℕ) :
    (∫ θ, normalizedChebyshev j (cos θ) * normalizedChebyshev k (cos θ)
      ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure) = if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := integral_measureT_eq_integral_cos
    (f := fun x => normalizedChebyshev j x * normalizedChebyshev k x)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le] at he
  change (∫ θ in Ioc (0 : ℝ) π,
    normalizedChebyshev j (cos θ) * normalizedChebyshev k (cos θ)) = _
  rw [← he]
  have hfactor (x : ℝ) : normalizedChebyshev j x * normalizedChebyshev k x =
      (normalizedChebyshevWeight j * normalizedChebyshevWeight k) *
        ((T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) := by
    dsimp [normalizedChebyshev]
    ring
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, ← sq]
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst j
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_zero]
      rw [integral_eval_T_real_mul_self_measureT_zero, normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq]
      simp [pi_ne_zero]
    · rw [integral_T_real_mul_self_measureT_of_ne_zero hj, normalizedChebyshevWeight_sq,
        if_neg hj]
      field_simp
  · rw [integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne hjk, if_neg hjk, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_normalized_sin_mul
statement:
theorem integral_normalized_sin_mul {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∫ θ, (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((j : ℝ) * θ)) *
        (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((k : ℝ) * θ)) ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure) =
      if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor (θ : ℝ) : (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((j : ℝ) * θ)) *
      (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((k : ℝ) * θ)) =
      (sqrt (2 / π)) ^ 2 * (sin ((j : ℝ) * θ) * sin ((k : ℝ) * θ)) := by ring
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [integral_const_mul, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have he := integral_sin_nat_mul_mul_sin_nat_mul hj hk
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le] at he
  change 2 / π * (∫ θ in Ioc (0 : ℝ) π,
    sin ((j : ℝ) * θ) * sin ((k : ℝ) * θ)) = _
  rw [he]
  split_ifs
  · field_simp
  · simp

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (α : ι → ℕ) :
    tensorChebyshevCoeff f α =
      ∫ θ : ι → ℝ, f (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => cos (θ i))) *
        ∏ i, normalizedChebyshev (α i) (cos (θ i))
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => chebyshevAngleMeasure)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) *
      ∏ i, normalizedChebyshev (α i) (x i)) := by
    apply Continuous.mul (hf.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _))
    unfold normalizedChebyshev
    fun_prop
  have h := integral_map (μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) π)))
    measurePreserving_pi_cos_chebyshev.measurable.aemeasurable
    hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [measurePreserving_pi_cos_chebyshev.map_eq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.continuous_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis
statement:
theorem continuous_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (i : ι) (α : ι → ℕ) : Continuous (tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorChebyshevMixedBasis
  apply continuous_finsetProd
  intro j _
  split_ifs
  · fun_prop
  · unfold normalizedChebyshev
    fun_prop

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis_mul
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis_mul
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (α β : ι → ℕ)
    (hα : 0 < α i) (hβ : 0 < β i) :
    (∫ θ, tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α θ * tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i β θ
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => chebyshevAngleMeasure)) = if α = β then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_prod_mul_prod_eq_ite _
    (fun (j : ι) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => if j = i then sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((k : ℝ) * t)
      else normalizedChebyshev k (cos t)) α β
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j
    simpa using integral_normalized_sin_mul hα hβ
  · simpa only [if_neg hj] using integral_normalizedChebyshev_cos_mul (α j) (β j)

name: NLAlib.isometry_toLp_insertNth
statement:
theorem isometry_toLp_insertNth {d : ℕ} (i : Fin (d + 1)) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Isometry (fun t : ℝ => (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth t y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  apply isometry_iff_dist_eq.mpr
  intro x z
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  have he : (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth x y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) -
      WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth z y) = PiLp.single 2 i (x - z) := by
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext j
    apply (i.forall_iff_succAbove).mpr ?_ j
    constructor
    · simp
    · intro j
      simp [Fin.succAbove_ne]
  rw [he, PiLp.norm_single]

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_euclidean_insertNth
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_one, Function.comp_def] using hf.comp (isometry_toLp_insertNth i y).lipschitz

name: NLAlib.measurable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial
proof:
:= by
  let F (y : Fin d → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :=
    f (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth (cos t) (fun j => cos (y j))))
  have hc : Continuous F.uncurry := by
    apply hf.comp
    apply (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp
    apply continuous_pi
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      fun_prop
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hj
      simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
      fun_prop
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : (Fin d → ℝ) × ℝ => -deriv (F p.1) p.2) :=
    (measurable_deriv_with_param (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) hc).neg
  change Measurable (fun θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ =>
    -deriv (F (fun j => θ (i.succAbove j))) (θ i))
  have hcoords : Measurable (fun θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ =>
      fun j : Fin d => θ (i.succAbove j)) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun j => measurable_pi_apply (i.succAbove j))
  have hh := hm.comp (hcoords.prodMk (measurable_pi_apply i))
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_le
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [tensorChebyshevCosinePartial, abs_neg, Function.comp_def] using
    abs_deriv_comp_cos_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
      (lipschitzWith_euclidean_insertNth hf i (fun j => cos (θ (i.succAbove j)))).lipschitzOnWith
      (θ i)

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_le_const
proof:
:= by
  exact (abs_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_le hf i θ).trans
    (by simpa only [mul_one] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sin_le_one (θ i)) L.coe_nonneg)

name: NLAlib.integrable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_sq
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_const ((L : ℝ) ^ 2)).mono'
    ((measurable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial hf.continuous i).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with θ
  have h := mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg _) (abs_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_le_const hf i θ)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq, ← sq, sq_abs] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_mul_mixed
proof:
:= by
  have hm := integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous
    (continuous_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α).abs
  apply (hm.const_mul (L : ℝ)).mono'
    (((measurable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial hf.continuous i).mul
      (continuous_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable)
  filter_upwards [] with θ
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_le_const hf i θ) (abs_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_sin_sq_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_sin_sq_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure {d : ℕ} (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    (∫ θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ, sin (θ i) ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => chebyshevAngleMeasure)) = π ^ (d + 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsin : (∫ θ, sin θ ^ 2 ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure) = π / 2 := by
    change (∫ θ in Ioc (0 : ℝ) π, sin θ ^ 2) = _
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le, integral_sin_sq]
    simp
  have hone : (∫ _θ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure) = π := by
    change (∫ _θ in Ioc (0 : ℝ) π, (1 : ℝ)) = _
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le]
    simp
  have he (θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) : sin (θ i) ^ 2 =
      ∏ j, if j = i then sin (θ j) ^ 2 else 1 := by
    rw [i.prod_univ_succAbove]
    simp [Fin.succAbove_ne]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun j θ => if j = i then sin θ ^ 2 else 1),
    i.prod_univ_succAbove]
  simp only [ite_true, hsin, Fin.succAbove_ne, if_false, hone, prod_const, card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [pow_succ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  have hb (θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) :
      tensorChebyshevCosinePartial f i θ ^ 2 ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin (θ i) ^ 2 := by
    have h := mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg _) (abs_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_le hf i θ)
    simpa only [← sq, mul_pow, sq_abs] using h
  have hm := integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous
    (show Continuous (fun θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ => (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * sin (θ i) ^ 2) from by fun_prop)
  have h := integral_mono_ae (integrable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_sq hf i) hm
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sin_sq_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure] at h
  calc
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * (π ^ (d + 1) / 2) := h
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.cos_insertNth
statement:
theorem cos_insertNth {d : ℕ} (i : Fin (d + 1)) (t : ℝ) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (fun j => cos ((i.insertNth t y : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) j)) =
      i.insertNth (cos t) (fun j => cos (y j))
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  apply (i.forall_iff_succAbove).mpr ?_ j
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro k
    simp

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevMixedBasis_insertNth
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevMixedBasis_insertNth {d : ℕ}
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (α : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α (i.insertNth t y) =
      (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((α i : ℝ) * t)) *
        ∏ j, normalizedChebyshev (α (i.succAbove j)) (cos (y j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevMixedBasis, i.prod_univ_succAbove]
  simp [Fin.succAbove_ne]

name: NLAlib.prod_normalizedChebyshev_cos_insertNth
statement:
theorem prod_normalizedChebyshev_cos_insertNth {d : ℕ}
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (α : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∏ j, normalizedChebyshev (α j) (cos ((i.insertNth t y : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) j))) =
      normalizedChebyshev (α i) (cos t) *
        ∏ j, normalizedChebyshev (α (i.succAbove j)) (cos (y j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [i.prod_univ_succAbove]
  simp

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_insertNth
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_insertNth {d : ℕ}
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℝ) (i : Fin (d + 1))
    (t : ℝ) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    tensorChebyshevCosinePartial f i (i.insertNth t y) =
      -deriv ((fun x => f (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth x (fun j => cos (y j))))) ∘ cos) t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorChebyshevCosinePartial, Fin.insertNth_apply_same,
    Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Function.comp_def]

name: NLAlib.integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq_mul_integral_cos
statement:
theorem integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq_mul_integral_cos
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (∫ θ, -deriv (f ∘ cos) θ * sin ((j : ℝ) * θ) ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure) =
      (j : ℝ) * ∫ θ, f (cos θ) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq hf hj
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, if_neg (by omega : j ≠ 0)] at h
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le pi_pos.le] at h
  calc
    _ = π / 2 * ((j : ℝ) * (2 / π *
        ∫ θ, f (cos θ) * cos ((j : ℝ) * θ) ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure)) := h
    _ = _ := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_mul_mixed_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := integral_pi_fin_eq_integral_insertNth
    (fun _ : Fin (d + 1) => chebyshevAngleMeasure) i
    (integrable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_mul_mixed hf i α)
  have hc : Continuous (fun θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ =>
      f (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => cos (θ j))) *
        ∏ j, normalizedChebyshev (α j) (cos (θ j))) := by
    apply Continuous.mul (hf.continuous.comp ((PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp (by fun_prop)))
    unfold normalizedChebyshev
    fun_prop
  rw [hleft, tensorChebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral hf.continuous,
    integral_pi_fin_eq_integral_insertNth _ i (integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous hc),
    ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with y
  simp_rw [tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_insertNth, tensorChebyshevMixedBasis_insertNth,
    prod_normalizedChebyshev_cos_insertNth, cos_insertNth, normalizedChebyshev_cos]
  let F (x : ℝ) := f (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth x (fun j => cos (y j))))
  let K : ℝ := ∏ j, normalizedChebyshevWeight (α (i.succAbove j)) *
    cos ((α (i.succAbove j) : ℝ) * y j)
  have hu := integral_neg_deriv_comp_cos_mul_sin_eq_mul_integral_cos
    (lipschitzWith_euclidean_insertNth hf i (fun j => cos (y j))).lipschitzOnWith hα
  change (∫ t, -deriv (F ∘ cos) t * (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((α i : ℝ) * t) * K)
      ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure) =
    (α i : ℝ) * ∫ t, F (cos t) * (normalizedChebyshevWeight (α i) * cos ((α i : ℝ) * t) * K)
      ∂chebyshevAngleMeasure
  have hl (t : ℝ) : -deriv (F ∘ cos) t * (sqrt (2 / π) * sin ((α i : ℝ) * t) * K) =
      (sqrt (2 / π) * K) * (-deriv (F ∘ cos) t * sin ((α i : ℝ) * t)) := by ring
  have hr (t : ℝ) : F (cos t) * (normalizedChebyshevWeight (α i) * cos ((α i : ℝ) * t) * K) =
      (normalizedChebyshevWeight (α i) * K) * (F (cos t) * cos ((α i : ℝ) * t)) := by ring
  simp_rw [hl, hr]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hu]
  rw [normalizedChebyshevWeight, if_neg (by omega : α i ≠ 0)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_coordinate_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t := s.filter (fun α => 0 < α i)
  have h := sum_sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_of_orthonormal t
    (tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i) (integrable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_sq hf i)
    (fun α _ => integrable_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_mul_mixed hf i α)
    (fun α _ β _ => integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous
      ((continuous_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α).mul (continuous_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i β)))
    (fun α hα β hβ => integral_tensorChebyshevMixedBasis_mul i α β
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hβ).2)
  have he : (∑ α ∈ t, (∫ θ, tensorChebyshevCosinePartial f i θ * tensorChebyshevMixedBasis i α θ
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => chebyshevAngleMeasure)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ α ∈ s, (α i : ℝ) ^ 2 * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2 := by
    rw [show t = s.filter (fun α => 0 < α i) from rfl, sum_filter]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro α _
    by_cases hα : 0 < α i
    · rw [if_pos hα, integral_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_mul_mixed_eq hf i α hα, mul_pow]
    · have hz : α i = 0 := by omega
      simp [hz]
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.trans (integral_tensorChebyshevCosinePartial_sq_le hf i)

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith {d : ℕ}
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (s : Finset (Fin d → ℕ)) :
    (∑ α ∈ s, (∑ i, (α i : ℝ) ^ 2) * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * π ^ d * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d =>
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), ∑ α ∈ s, (α i : ℝ) ^ 2 * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2 := by
        simp_rw [sum_mul]
        rw [sum_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (d + 1), π ^ (d + 1) * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 :=
        sum_le_sum (fun i _ => sum_coordinate_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le hf i s)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring

name: NLAlib.summable_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_of_lipschitzWith
proof:
:= by
  apply summable_of_sum_le (fun α => by positivity)
    (c := (d : ℝ) * π ^ d * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)
  exact sum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith hf

name: NLAlib.tsum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith
statement:
theorem tsum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith {d : ℕ}
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    (∑' α : Fin d → ℕ, (∑ i, (α i : ℝ) ^ 2) * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * π ^ d * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  apply (summable_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_of_lipschitzWith hf).tsum_le_of_sum_le
  exact sum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith hf

name: NLAlib.tsum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := hf.extend_real
  have he (α : Fin d → ℕ) : tensorChebyshevCoeff f α = tensorChebyshevCoeff g α :=
    tensorChebyshevCoeff_congr hfg α
  simp_rw [he]
  exact tsum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith hg

name: NLAlib.eval_joukowskiReversePoly
proof:
:= by
  have hn : p.natDegree < n + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp)
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' hn, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [joukowskiReversePoly, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow,
    eval_X, eval_add, eval_one]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hjn : j ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (mem_range.mp hj)
  have hpow : v ^ n = v ^ (n - j) * v ^ j := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hjn]
  have hJ : joukowski v = (1 + v ^ 2) / (2 * v) := by
    dsimp [joukowski]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hpow, hJ, div_pow, mul_pow]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_joukowski_le_mul_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith)
  let q := joukowskiReversePoly p n
  have hqbound : ∀ v ∈ frontier (ball (0 : ℂ) 1), ‖q.eval v‖ ≤ M := by
    intro v hv
    rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)] at hv
    have hvnorm : ‖v‖ = 1 := by simpa [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hv
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [hvnorm]; norm_num)
    have hre : v.re ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      exact abs_le.mp (by simpa only [hvnorm] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm v)
    rw [show q = joukowskiReversePoly p n from rfl, eval_joukowskiReversePoly hp hv0,
      norm_mul, norm_pow, hvnorm, one_pow, one_mul, joukowski_eq_re_of_norm_eq_one hvnorm]
    exact hM v.re hre
  have hdiff : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => q.eval z) (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
    ⟨q.differentiable.differentiableOn, q.continuous.continuousOn⟩
  have hmem : w⁻¹ ∈ closure (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
    rw [closure_ball (0 : ℂ) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    simp only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_inv]
    exact (inv_le_one₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0)).mpr hw
  have hbound := Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
    (isBounded_ball : Bornology.IsBounded (ball (0 : ℂ) 1)) hdiff hqbound hmem
  rw [show q = joukowskiReversePoly p n from rfl,
    eval_joukowskiReversePoly hp (inv_ne_zero hw0), norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv,
    joukowski_inv, inv_pow] at hbound
  have hscaled : ‖p.eval (joukowski w)‖ / ‖w‖ ^ n ≤ M := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hbound
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0) n)).mp hscaled

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_le_mul_pow_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem norm_eval_le_mul_pow_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {p : ℂ[X]} {n : ℕ}
    {M ρ : ℝ} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖p.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ M)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) : ‖p.eval z‖ ≤ M * ρ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
  exact (norm_eval_joukowski_le_mul_pow hp hM hw.1).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw.2 n) hM0)

statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_tensorNormalizedChebyshev {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
