name: NLAlib.continuous_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ) (M : ℕ) : Continuous (tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox
  exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun α _ => continuous_const.mul
    ((continuous_tensorNormalizedChebyshev α).comp (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 _)))

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_congr
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hfg : EqOn f g (chebyshevCube ι)) (M : ℕ)
    (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r = tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox g M r
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox, tensorChebyshevCoeff_congr hfg]

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (M : ℕ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r =
      ∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * f (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (α : ι → ℕ) (x : ι → ℝ) : tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α *
      tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α (WithLp.ofLp r) *
        f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) =
      (tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α (WithLp.ofLp r)) *
        (f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x) := by ring
  simp_rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_eq_sum, sum_mul, hterm]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun α x =>
    (tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α (WithLp.ofLp r)) *
      (f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x)) _ (fun α _ =>
    (integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous ((hf.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _)).mul
      (continuous_tensorNormalizedChebyshev α))).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
  unfold tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox tensorChebyshevCoeff tensorNormalizedChebyshev
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro α _
  ring

name: NLAlib.euclidean_norm_le_sum_abs
statement:
theorem euclidean_norm_le_sum_abs {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ ∑ i, |x i|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : x = ∑ i, PiLp.single 2 i (x i) := by
    ext j
    simp
  calc
    ‖x‖ = ‖∑ i, PiLp.single 2 i (x i)‖ := congrArg norm hx
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖(PiLp.single 2 i (x i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = _ := by simp only [PiLp.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_lipschitzWith
statement:
theorem abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_lipschitzWith
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ}
    {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r - f r| ≤ 6 * Fintype.card ι * (L : ℝ) / M
proof:
:= by
  have hK : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hif : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) *
      f (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) :=
    integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (hK.mul (hf.continuous.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _)))
  have heq : tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r - f r =
      ∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * (f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) - f r)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT) := by
    rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral hf.continuous]
    simp_rw [mul_sub]
    rw [integral_sub hif ((integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous hK).mul_const _),
      integral_mul_const, integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel, one_mul]
  rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hdom : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => (L : ℝ) *
      (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * ∑ i, |x i - r i|))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) := integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop)
  have hbound := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hdom (show ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT),
      ‖tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * (f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) - f r)‖ ≤
        (L : ℝ) * (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * ∑ i, |x i - r i|) from by
    filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
    have hpos := tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr
    have hLip := hf.dist_le_mul (WithLp.toLp 2 x) r
    rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm] at hLip
    have hnorm := euclidean_norm_le_sum_abs (WithLp.toLp 2 x - r)
    have hL : |f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) - f r| ≤ (L : ℝ) * ∑ i, |x i - r i| :=
      hLip.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm L.coe_nonneg)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hpos]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL hpos).trans_eq (by ring))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hbound
  exact hbound.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_abs_sub_le hM hr) L.coe_nonneg).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ}
    {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (chebyshevCube ι)) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r - f r| ≤ 6 * Fintype.card ι * (L : ℝ) / M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := hf.extend_real
  rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_congr hfg, hfg hr]
  exact abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_lipschitzWith hg hM hr

name: NLAlib.nonneg_of_norm_le_on_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_norm_le_on_open_bernsteinEllipse {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) : 0 ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : ℂ) ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ :=
    filledBernsteinEllipse_subset_openBernsteinEllipse (r := 1) hρ hρ
      (ofReal_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse (ρ := 1) le_rfl (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (-1) 1))
  exact (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0 hz)

name: NLAlib.circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_eq_radius
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_eq_radius {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFc : ContinuousOn F (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ))) (k : ℕ) :
    (∮ w in C(0, 1), F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1)) =
      ∮ w in C(0, ρ), F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnonzero : ∀ w ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ \ ball 0 1, w ≠ 0 := by
    intro w hw hzero
    have h := hw.2
    norm_num [hzero] at h
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1))
      (closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ \ ball 0 1) :=
    (continuousOn_comp_joukowski_closed_annulus hFc).div
      (continuousOn_id.pow _) (fun w hw => pow_ne_zero _ (hnonzero w hw))
  have hd : ∀ w ∈ (ball (0 : ℂ) ρ \ closedBall 0 1) \ (∅ : Set ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1)) w := by
    intro w hw
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have h := hw.1.2
      norm_num [hzero] at h
    exact (differentiableAt_comp_joukowski_open_annulus hFd hw.1).div
      (differentiableAt_id.pow _) (pow_ne_zero _ hw0)
  exact (Complex.circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiable_on_annulus_off_countable
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hρ.le countable_empty hc hd).symm

name: NLAlib.norm_normalized_circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_le {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ}
    (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hFc : ContinuousOn F (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ w in C(0, 1), F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1))‖ ≤ M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_eq_radius hρ hFc hFd]
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := zero_lt_one.trans hρ
  have hbound : ∀ w ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) ρ,
      ‖F (joukowski w) / w ^ (k + 1)‖ ≤ M / ρ ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro w hw
    have hnorm : ‖w‖ = ρ := by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm] using hw
    rw [norm_div, norm_pow, hnorm]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg hρ0.le _)
    exact hM _ (joukowski_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse (by rw [hnorm]; exact ⟨hρ.le, le_rfl⟩))
  have h := circleIntegral.norm_two_pi_i_inv_smul_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hρ0.le hbound
  change ‖(2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * _‖ ≤ _ at h
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFc : ContinuousOn F (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    ‖chebyshevComplexCoeff F k‖ ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevComplexCoeff, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hk), norm_mul]
  norm_num only [norm_ofNat]
  have h := norm_normalized_circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_le hρ hFc hFd hM k
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  rw [← mul_div_assoc] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_zero_le
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_zero_le {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFc : ContinuousOn F (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖chebyshevComplexCoeff F 0‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  simpa [chebyshevComplexCoeff] using
    norm_normalized_circleIntegral_chebyshevCoeff_le hρ hFc hFd hM 0

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFc : ContinuousOn F (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (interior (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ)))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:=
  (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le hρ hFc hFd hM hk)

name: NLAlib.norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    ‖chebyshevComplexCoeff F k‖ ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (1 : ℝ) ρ, ‖chebyshevComplexCoeff F k‖ ≤ 2 * M / r ^ k := by
    intro r hr
    have hsub := filledBernsteinEllipse_subset_openBernsteinEllipse hρ hr.2
    exact norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le hr.1 (hFd.continuousOn.mono hsub)
      (hFd.mono (interior_subset.trans hsub)) (fun z hz => hM z (hsub hz)) hk
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun r : ℝ => 2 * M / r ^ k) ρ := by
    apply ContinuousAt.div continuousAt_const (continuousAt_id.pow _)
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hρ))
  have : NeBot (𝓝[Ioo (1 : ℝ) ρ] ρ) := right_nhdsWithin_Ioo_neBot hρ
  exact ge_of_tendsto (hc.continuousWithinAt.tendsto)
    (Filter.mem_of_superset self_mem_nhdsWithin (fun r hr => hb r hr))

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ k
proof:
:=
  (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_chebyshevComplexCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hk)

name: NLAlib.integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous
statement:
theorem integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ} (hF : Continuous F) :
    Integrable F (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT))
proof:
:= by
  apply (measurePreserving_pi_cos_chebyshev.integrable_comp hF.aestronglyMeasurable).mp
  exact integrable_pi_chebyshevAngleMeasure_of_continuous
    (hF.comp (continuous_pi (fun i => continuous_cos.comp (continuous_apply i))))

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {M : ℕ} {α : ι → ℕ} (hα : ∀ i, α i ≤ M + 1) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨prod_nonneg (fun i _ => (chebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc (hα i)).1),
    prod_le_one (fun i _ => (chebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc (hα i)).1)
      (fun i _ => (chebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc (hα i)).2)⟩

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (M : ℕ) {x r : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r
proof:
:=
  prod_nonneg (fun i _ => chebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M (hx i) (hr i))

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (M : ℕ) (r : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun i x => chebyshevJacksonKernel M x (r i))]
  simp only [integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel, prod_const_one]

name: NLAlib.continuous_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (M : ℕ) : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ) =>
      tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel chebyshevJacksonKernel normalizedChebyshev
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_eq_sum
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_eq_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : ℕ) (x r : ι → ℝ) :
    tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r =
      ∑ α ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : ι => range (M + 1)), tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α *
        tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel chebyshevJacksonKernel
  rw [prod_univ_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro α _
  simp only [tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping, tensorNormalizedChebyshev, prod_mul_distrib]

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (M : ℕ) (r : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x i - r i|
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) =
      ∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x (r i) * |x - r i| ∂measureT
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfun (x : ι → ℝ) : tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x i - r i| =
      ∏ j, chebyshevJacksonKernel M (x j) (r j) * (if j = i then |x j - r j| else 1) := by
    rw [prod_mul_distrib]
    simp [tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel]
  simp_rw [hfun]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun j (x : ℝ) =>
    chebyshevJacksonKernel M x (r j) * (if j = i then |x - r j| else 1))]
  have hint (j : ι) : (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x (r j) *
      (if j = i then |x - r j| else 1) ∂measureT) =
      if j = i then (∫ x, chebyshevJacksonKernel M x (r i) * |x - r i| ∂measureT) else 1 := by
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [hji, integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel]
  simp_rw [hint]
  simp

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_abs_sub_le
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_abs_sub_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {r : ι → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * ∑ i, |x i - r i|
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) ≤ 6 * Fintype.card ι / M
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_sum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun i x => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x i - r i|)
    _ (fun i _ => integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop))]
  simp_rw [integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : ι, (6 / M : ℝ) :=
      sum_le_sum (fun i _ => integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le hM (hr i))
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one
statement:
theorem norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ‖joukowski w - 1‖ + ‖joukowski w + 1‖ = ‖w‖ + ‖w‖⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hm : joukowski w - 1 = (w - 1) ^ 2 / (2 * w) := by
    dsimp [joukowski]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hp : joukowski w + 1 = (w + 1) ^ 2 / (2 * w) := by
    dsimp [joukowski]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hsum : ‖w - 1‖ ^ 2 + ‖w + 1‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (‖w‖ ^ 2 + 1) := by
    simp only [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_sub, Complex.normSq_add,
      Complex.normSq_one]
    ring
  rw [hm, hp, norm_div, norm_div, norm_pow, norm_pow, norm_mul]
  norm_num
  rw [← add_div, hsum]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.exists_one_le_norm_joukowski_eq
statement:
theorem exists_one_le_norm_joukowski_eq (z : ℂ) :
    ∃ w : ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ joukowski w = z
proof:
:= by
  let p : ℂ[X] := X ^ 2 - C (2 * z) * X + 1
  have hdeg : p.degree = 2 := by dsimp [p]; compute_degree <;> norm_num
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Complex.exists_root (show 0 < p.degree by rw [hdeg]; norm_num)
  have heq : w ^ 2 - 2 * z * w + 1 = 0 := by simpa [p, Polynomial.IsRoot] using hw
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at heq
  have hJ : joukowski w = z := by
    dsimp [joukowski]
    field_simp
    linear_combination heq
  by_cases hnorm : 1 ≤ ‖w‖
  · exact ⟨w, hnorm, hJ⟩
  · refine ⟨w⁻¹, ?_, (joukowski_inv w).trans hJ⟩
    rw [norm_inv]
    exact (one_le_inv₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0)).mpr (le_of_not_ge hnorm)

name: NLAlib.openBernsteinEllipse_eq_image_one_le_norm
statement:
theorem openBernsteinEllipse_eq_image_one_le_norm {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ) :
    openBernsteinEllipse ρ = joukowski '' {w : ℂ | 1 ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < ρ}
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    by_cases hnorm : 1 ≤ ‖w‖
    · exact ⟨w, ⟨hnorm, hw.2⟩, rfl⟩
    · have hwpos : 0 < ‖w‖ := lt_trans (inv_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)) hw.1
      refine ⟨w⁻¹, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, joukowski_inv w⟩
      · rw [norm_inv]
        exact (one_le_inv₀ hwpos).mpr (le_of_not_ge hnorm)
      · rw [norm_inv]
        exact (inv_lt_comm₀ hwpos (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hw.1
  · rintro z ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨w, ⟨?_, hw.2⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ((inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hρ).trans_le hw.1

name: NLAlib.mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ) (z : ℂ) :
    z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ ↔ ‖z - 1‖ + ‖z + 1‖ < ρ + ρ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_norm_joukowski_eq z
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith)
  rw [norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hw0]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [openBernsteinEllipse_eq_image_one_le_norm hρ] at hz
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hJ⟩ := hz
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith [hv.1])
    have hnorm : ‖v‖ + ‖v‖⁻¹ = ‖w‖ + ‖w‖⁻¹ := by
      rw [← norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hv0, hJ,
        norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hw0]
    rw [← hnorm]
    exact strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one hv.1 hρ.le hv.2
  · intro hdist
    have hrad : ‖w‖ < ρ := by
      by_contra h
      have hle := strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one.monotoneOn hρ.le hw (le_of_not_gt h)
      linarith
    rw [openBernsteinEllipse_eq_image_one_le_norm hρ]
    exact ⟨w, ⟨hw, hrad⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.isOpen_openBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem isOpen_openBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ) :
    IsOpen (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : openBernsteinEllipse ρ = {z : ℂ | ‖z - 1‖ + ‖z + 1‖ < ρ + ρ⁻¹} := by
    ext z
    exact mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ z
  rw [heq]
  exact isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const

name: NLAlib.openBernsteinEllipse_mono
statement:
theorem openBernsteinEllipse_mono {r ρ : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) :
    openBernsteinEllipse r ⊆ openBernsteinEllipse ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff hr z] at hz
  rw [mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff (hr.trans_le hrρ) z]
  exact hz.trans_le (strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one.monotoneOn hr.le (hr.le.trans hrρ) hrρ)

name: NLAlib.ofReal_mem_openBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem ofReal_mem_openBernsteinEllipse {ρ x : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : (x : ℂ) ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ
proof:
:=
  filledBernsteinEllipse_subset_openBernsteinEllipse hρ hρ
    (ofReal_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse (ρ := 1) le_rfl hx)

name: NLAlib.mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff
statement:
theorem mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) (z : ℂ) :
    z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ ↔ ‖z - 1‖ + ‖z + 1‖ ≤ ρ + ρ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_norm_joukowski_eq z
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith)
  rw [norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hw0]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hJ⟩
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith [hv.1])
    have hnorm : ‖v‖ + ‖v‖⁻¹ = ‖w‖ + ‖w‖⁻¹ := by
      rw [← norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hv0, hJ,
        norm_joukowski_sub_one_add_norm_joukowski_add_one hw0]
    rw [← hnorm]
    exact strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one.monotoneOn hv.1 hρ hv.2
  · intro hdist
    have hrad : ‖w‖ ≤ ρ := by
      by_contra h
      have hlt := strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one hρ hw (lt_of_not_ge h)
      linarith
    exact ⟨w, ⟨hw, hrad⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_T_complex_joukowski
statement:
theorem eval_T_complex_joukowski {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (T ℂ (n : ℤ)).eval (joukowski w) = (w ^ n + (w⁻¹) ^ n) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : joukowski w = Complex.cosh (Complex.log w) := by
    simp [joukowski, Complex.cosh, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log hw]
  rw [hJ, T_complex_cosh]
  simp [Complex.cosh, Int.cast_natCast, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_nat_mul,
    Complex.exp_log hw, inv_pow]

name: NLAlib.norm_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) : ‖z‖ ≤ (ρ + ρ⁻¹) / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
  calc ‖joukowski w‖ = ‖w + w⁻¹‖ / 2 := by simp [joukowski]
    _ ≤ (‖w‖ + ‖w⁻¹‖) / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_add_le _ _) (by norm_num)
    _ = (‖w‖ + ‖w‖⁻¹) / 2 := by rw [norm_inv]
    _ ≤ (ρ + ρ⁻¹) / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one.monotoneOn hw.1 hρ hw.2) (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.neg_semiaxis_le_re_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem neg_semiaxis_le_re_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) : -(ρ + ρ⁻¹) / 2 ≤ z.re
proof:
:= by
  have hn := norm_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ hz
  have hre := (abs_le.mp (Complex.abs_re_le_norm z)).1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_T_complex_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by linarith [hw.1])
  rw [eval_T_complex_joukowski hw0, norm_div]
  norm_num
  have hadd : ‖w ^ n + w⁻¹ ^ n‖ ≤ ‖w‖ ^ n + (‖w‖⁻¹) ^ n := by
    simpa only [norm_pow, norm_inv] using norm_add_le (w ^ n) (w⁻¹ ^ n)
  have hrad : ‖w‖ ^ n + (‖w‖⁻¹) ^ n ≤ ρ ^ n + (ρ⁻¹) ^ n := by
    simp only [inv_pow]
    exact strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one.monotoneOn
      (one_le_pow₀ hw.1) (one_le_pow₀ hρ) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hw.2 n)
  simpa only [inv_pow] using div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hadd.trans hrad)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)

name: NLAlib.closure_openBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem closure_openBernsteinEllipse {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ) :
    closure (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) = filledBernsteinEllipse ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) := by
    have heq : filledBernsteinEllipse ρ = {z : ℂ | ‖z - 1‖ + ‖z + 1‖ ≤ ρ + ρ⁻¹} := by
      ext z
      exact mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ.le z
    rw [heq]
    exact isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · apply closure_minimal _ hclosed
    intro z hz
    exact (mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ.le z).mpr
      ((mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ z).mp hz).le
  · intro z hz
    have hdist := (mem_filledBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ.le z).mp hz
    have hc : 2 < ρ + ρ⁻¹ := by
      have hh := strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one (𝕜 := ℝ) (by simp : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 1)
        hρ.le hρ
      norm_num at hh
      exact hh
    have hscale : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, (t : ℂ) * z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ := by
      intro t ht
      have hsub : ‖(t : ℂ) * z - 1‖ ≤ t * ‖z - 1‖ + (1 - t) := by
        calc ‖(t : ℂ) * z - 1‖ =
            ‖(t : ℂ) * (z - 1) + ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-1)‖ := by
              congr 1
              push_cast
              ring
          _ ≤ ‖(t : ℂ) * (z - 1)‖ + ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = t * ‖z - 1‖ + (1 - t) := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_one, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
              Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_nonneg ht.1, abs_of_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr ht.2).le]
      have hadd : ‖(t : ℂ) * z + 1‖ ≤ t * ‖z + 1‖ + (1 - t) := by
        calc ‖(t : ℂ) * z + 1‖ =
            ‖(t : ℂ) * (z + 1) + ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := by
              congr 1
              push_cast
              ring
          _ ≤ ‖(t : ℂ) * (z + 1)‖ + ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = t * ‖z + 1‖ + (1 - t) := by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1, abs_of_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr ht.2).le]
      rw [mem_openBernsteinEllipse_iff hρ]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist ht.1,
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht.2) (sub_pos.mpr hc)]
    have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * z) := by fun_prop
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ closure (Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [closure_Ico zero_ne_one]
      exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    have hzin : z ∈ closure ((fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * z) '' Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      apply image_closure_subset_closure_image hcontinuous
      exact ⟨1, h1, by simp⟩
    exact closure_mono (by rintro w ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩; exact hscale t ht) hzin

name: NLAlib.re_affine_ge_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem re_affine_ge_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {a b ρ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) :
    (b + a - (b - a) * ((ρ + ρ⁻¹) / 2)) / 2 ≤
      (((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z + (b + a : ℝ)).re / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hre := neg_semiaxis_le_re_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ hz
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    zero_mul, sub_zero]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hre (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]

name: NLAlib.norm_affine_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem norm_affine_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse {a b ρ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse ρ) :
    ‖(((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z + (b + a : ℝ)) / 2‖ ≤
      (|b + a| + (b - a) * ((ρ + ρ⁻¹) / 2)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn := norm_le_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hρ hz
  rw [norm_div]
  rw [norm_ofNat]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by norm_num)
  calc ‖((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z + (b + a : ℝ)‖ ≤
      ‖((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z‖ + ‖((b + a : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = (b - a) * ‖z‖ + |b + a| := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
    _ ≤ |b + a| + (b - a) * ((ρ + ρ⁻¹) / 2) := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_weighted_abs_sub_le
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_weighted_abs_sub_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (L : ι → NNReal)
    {r : ι → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * |x i - r i|
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) ≤ (6 / M) * ∑ i, (L i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun (x : ι → ℝ) : tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r *
      (∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * |x i - r i|) =
      ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x i - r i|) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  simp_rw [hfun]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun i x => (L i : ℝ) *
    (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x r * |x i - r i|)) _
    (fun i _ => integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop))]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * (6 / M) := sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_chebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_abs_sub_le hM (hr i)) (L i).coe_nonneg
    _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_modulus
statement:
theorem abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_modulus
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (L : ι → NNReal)
    (hmod : ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, ∀ y ∈ chebyshevCube ι,
      |f x - f y| ≤ ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * |x i - y i|)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r - f r| ≤ (6 / M) * ∑ i, (L i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hif : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) *
      f (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) :=
    integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (hK.mul (hf.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _)))
  have heq : tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r - f r =
      ∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * (f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) - f r)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT) := by
    rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_eq_integral hf]
    simp_rw [mul_sub]
    rw [integral_sub hif ((integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous hK).mul_const _),
      integral_mul_const, integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel, one_mul]
  rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hdom : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) *
      ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * |x i - r i|) (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) :=
    integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop)
  have hbound := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hdom (show ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT),
      ‖tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * (f (WithLp.toLp 2 x) - f r)‖ ≤
        tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r) * ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * |x i - r i| from by
    filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
    have hpos := tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx hr
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hpos]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmod _ hx _ hr) hpos)
  exact hbound.trans (integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_weighted_abs_sub_le hM L hr)

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube
statement:
theorem abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (L : ι → NNReal)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, ∀ y ∈ chebyshevCube ι,
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = y j) → |f x - f y| ≤ (L i : ℝ) * |x i - y i|)
    {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hx : x ∈ chebyshevCube ι) (hy : y ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |f x - f y| ≤ ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * |x i - y i|
proof:
:=
  Function.abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_bound (fun _ : ι => Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (fun z => f (WithLp.toLp 2 z)) (fun i => (L i : ℝ))
    (fun i z hz w hw hzw => hf i (WithLp.toLp 2 z) hz (WithLp.toLp 2 w) hw hzw) hx hy

name: NLAlib.lipschitzOnWith_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnWith_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (L : ι → NNReal)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, ∀ y ∈ chebyshevCube ι,
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = y j) → |f x - f y| ≤ (L i : ℝ) * |x i - y i|) :
    LipschitzOnWith (∑ i, L i) f (chebyshevCube ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
  refine (abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube L hf hx hy).trans ?_
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, (L i : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ := sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (L i).coe_nonneg
      simpa only [PiLp.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using (PiLp.norm_apply_le (x - y) i)
    _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul]; simp

name: NLAlib.abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_coordinate_lipschitz
statement:
theorem abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_coordinate_lipschitz
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (L : ι → NNReal)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ chebyshevCube ι, ∀ y ∈ chebyshevCube ι,
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = y j) → |f x - f y| ≤ (L i : ℝ) * |x i - y i|)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (hr : r ∈ chebyshevCube ι) :
    |tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f M r - f r| ≤ (6 / M) * ∑ i, (L i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hLip := lipschitzOnWith_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube L hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := hLip.extend_real
  rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_congr hfg, hfg hr]
  apply abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_modulus hg.continuous L ?_ hM hr
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [← hfg hx, ← hfg hy]
  exact abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_chebyshevCube L hf hx hy

name: NLAlib.sin_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem sin_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse (u : ℂ) :
    Complex.sin u ∈ filledBernsteinEllipse (Real.exp |u.im|)
proof:
:= by
  let w := Complex.I * Complex.exp (-u * Complex.I)
  have hw : ‖w‖ = Real.exp u.im := by
    simp only [w, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_exp,
      Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.neg_im, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_sub, neg_neg]
  have hwJ : joukowski w = Complex.sin u := by
    have hinv : w⁻¹ = -Complex.I * Complex.exp (u * Complex.I) := by
      dsimp [w]
      rw [mul_inv_rev, Complex.inv_I, ← Complex.exp_neg]
      simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg]
      ring
    rw [joukowski, hinv]
    dsimp [w, Complex.sin]
    ring
  by_cases hu : 0 ≤ u.im
  · refine ⟨w, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hwJ⟩
    · rw [hw]
      exact Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr hu
    · rw [hw, abs_of_nonneg hu]
  · refine ⟨w⁻¹, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [norm_inv, hw, ← Real.exp_neg]
      exact Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    · rw [norm_inv, hw, ← Real.exp_neg, abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hu)]
    · rw [joukowski_inv, hwJ]

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_sin_le_mul_exp_abs_im
statement:
theorem norm_eval_sin_le_mul_exp_abs_im {p : ℂ[X]} {n : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖p.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ M) (u : ℂ) :
    ‖p.eval (Complex.sin u)‖ ≤ M * Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * |u.im|)
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_eval_le_mul_pow_of_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse hp hM
    (sin_mem_filledBernsteinEllipse u)
  simpa only [Real.exp_nat_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_eval_le_mul_exp_of_norm_le_half
statement:
theorem norm_eval_le_mul_exp_of_norm_le_half {p : ℂ[X]} {n : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖p.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ M)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ‖p.eval z‖ ≤ M * Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * |z.im| / Real.sqrt (1 - ‖z‖^2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, _, hum⟩ := Complex.exists_sin_eq_of_norm_le_half hz
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
  have h := norm_eval_sin_le_mul_exp_abs_im hp hM u
  rw [hu] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hM0
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hum (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_variation_div
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := boundedVariationOn_comp_cos hf
  have hv : (eVariationOn (f ∘ cos) (Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)).toReal ≤
      (eVariationOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono hf (variationOn_comp_cos_le f)
  have hbound := abs_integral_mul_cos_le_variation_div hcomp hk
  have hkreal : 0 < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral, if_neg hk.ne', abs_mul,
    abs_of_pos (div_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) pi_pos)]
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 / Real.pi) * ((eVariationOn (f ∘ cos) (Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)).toReal / k) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (2 / Real.pi) * ((eVariationOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal / k) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_descFactorial {ν : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {V : ℝ}
    (hAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F j) (-1) 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → deriv (F j) x = F (j + 1) x)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hV : (eVariationOn (F ν) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).toReal ≤ V)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : ν + 1 ≤ k) :
    |chebyshevCoeff (F 0) k| ≤ 2 * V / (Real.pi * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  induction ν generalizing F k with
  | zero =>
      have hb := abs_chebyshevCoeff_le_variation_div hBV (by omega : 0 < k)
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.descFactorial_one] at *
      exact hb.trans (by gcongr)
  | succ ν ih =>
      have hu : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (F 0) (-1) 1 := hAC 0 (by omega)
      have hv : BoundedVariationOn (F 1) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
        by_cases hν : ν = 0
        · simpa [hν] using hBV
        · have h := (hAC 1 (by omega)).boundedVariationOn
          simpa using h
      have hshiftAC : ∀ j < ν, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun x => F (j + 1) x) (-1) 1 :=
        fun j hj => hAC (j + 1) (by omega)
      have hshiftder : ∀ j < ν, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
          deriv (fun t => F (j + 1) t) x = F ((j + 1) + 1) x :=
        fun j hj => hderiv (j + 1) (by omega)
      have hl := ih (F := fun j => F (j + 1)) hshiftAC hshiftder hBV hV
        (k := k - 1) (by omega)
      have hr := ih (F := fun j => F (j + 1)) hshiftAC hshiftder hBV hV
        (k := k + 1) (by omega)
      have hVnonneg : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hV
      have hDpos : 0 < ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega : ν + 1 ≤ k - 1))
      have hDle : ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) ≤
          ((k + 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.descFactorial_le (ν + 1) (show k - 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega)
      have hr' : |chebyshevCoeff (F 1) (k + 1)| ≤
          2 * V / (Real.pi * ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)) := by
        exact hr.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity)
          (mul_pos pi_pos hDpos) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDle pi_pos.le))
      have hkreal : 0 < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
      have hfactor : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1 + 1) : ℝ) =
          (k : ℝ) * ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := by
        have hn := Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ (k - 1) (ν + 1)
        have hkm : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
        rw [hkm] at hn
        exact_mod_cast hn
      rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_sub_derivative hu (hderiv 0 (by omega)) hv (by omega),
        abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hkreal)]
      calc
        _ ≤ (|chebyshevCoeff (F 1) (k - 1)| + |chebyshevCoeff (F 1) (k + 1)|) / (2 * k) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (abs_sub _ _) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (2 * V / (Real.pi * ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)) +
            2 * V / (Real.pi * ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ))) / (2 * k) := by
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add hl hr') (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by rw [hfactor]; ring

name: NLAlib.fejerChebyshevMean_eq_sum_smul_T
statement:
theorem fejerChebyshevMean_eq_sum_smul_T (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    fejerChebyshevMean f n = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1),
      (1 - (k : ℝ) / (n + 1)) • (C (chebyshevCoeff f k) * T ℝ (k : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℕ → ℝ[X] := fun k => C (chebyshevCoeff f k) * T ℝ (k : ℤ)
  have hsum : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), chebyshevTrunc f m) =
      ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [chebyshevTrunc, b]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ, ih]
      change (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k) +
        (∑ k ∈ range (n + 2), b k) =
          ∑ k ∈ range (n + 2), ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k
      rw [sum_range_succ (f := b) (n + 1),
        sum_range_succ (f := fun k => ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k) (n + 1)]
      simp only [show n + 2 - (n + 1) = 1 by omega, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
      rw [← add_assoc, ← sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hcount : ((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        norm_cast
        have := mem_range.mp hk
        omega
      calc
        ((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k + b k =
            ((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k + (1 : ℝ) • b k := by rw [one_smul]
        _ = (((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) • b k := (add_smul _ _ _).symm
        _ = ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) • b k := by rw [hcount]
  unfold fejerChebyshevMean
  rw [hsum, smul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [smul_smul]
  have hk_le : k ≤ n + 1 := (mem_range.mp hk).le
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hk_le]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  change ((n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n + 1 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))) • b k = _
  congr 1
  have hn0 : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.degree_fejerChebyshevMean_le
statement:
theorem degree_fejerChebyshevMean_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (fejerChebyshevMean f n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold fejerChebyshevMean
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ((degree_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun m hm => ?_))
  exact (degree_chebyshevTrunc_le f m).trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hm))

name: NLAlib.fejerChebyshevMean_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem fejerChebyshevMean_const (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    fejerChebyshevMean (fun _ => c) n = C c
proof:
:= by
  have htrunc : ∀ m, chebyshevTrunc (fun _ => c) m = C c := by
    intro m
    simpa only [eval_C] using chebyshevTrunc_eval_eq_of_degree_le
      (p := C c) (n := m) (degree_C_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le m))
  unfold fejerChebyshevMean
  simp_rw [htrunc]
  rw [sum_const, card_range, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
  have hn0 : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hn0, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_dirichletCircleKernel_mul_realChebyshevCircleFunction
statement:
theorem integral_dirichletCircleKernel_mul_realChebyshevCircleFunction {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) (a : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), dirichletCircleKernel n t * realChebyshevCircleFunction f (a - t)
      ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = (chebyshevTrunc f n).eval ((fourier 1 a).re)
proof:
:= by
  let g := realChebyshevCircleFunction f
  have hg : Continuous g := continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf
  have hgi : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => g (a - t)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    (hg.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hki : ∀ k, Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) =>
      (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * g (a - t)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
    intro k
    exact ((Complex.continuous_re.comp (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).continuous).mul
      (hg.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hterm : ∀ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), dirichletCircleKernel n t * g (a - t) =
      (fourier 0 t).re * g (a - t) +
        2 * ∑ k ∈ range n, (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re * g (a - t) := by
    intro t
    simp only [dirichletCircleKernel, add_mul, mul_assoc, sum_mul]
    simp
  change (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), dirichletCircleKernel n t * g (a - t)
    ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = _
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [integral_add (by simpa using hgi) (by
    exact (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k hk => hki k)).const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
    integral_finsetSum _ (fun k hk => hki k),
    integral_re_fourier_mul_comp_sub_eq_re_fourier_mul_coeff hg (even_realChebyshevCircleFunction f)]
  simp_rw [integral_re_fourier_mul_comp_sub_eq_re_fourier_mul_coeff hg
    (even_realChebyshevCircleFunction f)]
  simp only [chebyshevTrunc, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, T_zero, eval_one, mul_one]
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf]
  simp only [if_true, one_mul, fourier_zero,
    Complex.one_re]
  rw [mul_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_re_fourierCoeff hf, if_neg (by omega), eval_T_re_fourier_one]
  ring

name: NLAlib.eval_fejerChebyshevMean_eq_integral
statement:
theorem eval_fejerChebyshevMean_eq_integral {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) (a : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (fejerChebyshevMean f n).eval ((fourier 1 a).re) =
      ∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), fejerCircleKernel n t * realChebyshevCircleFunction f (a - t)
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fejerChebyshevMean, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_finsetSum]
  simp_rw [fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet]
  have hterm : ∀ t, (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), dirichletCircleKernel m t) *
      realChebyshevCircleFunction f (a - t) = (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), dirichletCircleKernel m t * realChebyshevCircleFunction f (a - t) := by
    intro t
    rw [mul_assoc, sum_mul]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum (f := fun m t =>
    dirichletCircleKernel m t * realChebyshevCircleFunction f (a - t)) _ (fun m hm =>
    ((continuous_dirichletCircleKernel m).mul
      ((continuous_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf).comp
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
          (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _))]
  simp_rw [integral_dirichletCircleKernel_mul_realChebyshevCircleFunction hf]

name: NLAlib.eval_fejerChebyshevMean_nonneg
statement:
theorem eval_fejerChebyshevMean_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f x) (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ (fejerChebyshevMean f n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hxcos : (fourier 1 (Real.arccos x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = x := by
    rw [show (fourier 1 (Real.arccos x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = Real.cos (Real.arccos x) by
      simpa using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 (Real.arccos x), Real.cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2]
  rw [← hxcos, eval_fejerChebyshevMean_eq_integral hf]
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro t
  exact mul_nonneg (fejerCircleKernel_nonneg _ _)
    (hpos _ (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc _))

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_fejerChebyshevMean_le
proof:
:= by
  have hxcos : (fourier 1 (Real.arccos x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = x := by
    rw [show (fourier 1 (Real.arccos x : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = Real.cos (Real.arccos x) by
      simpa using re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos 1 (Real.arccos x), Real.cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2]
  rw [← hxcos, eval_fejerChebyshevMean_eq_integral hf, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hki : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => M * fejerCircleKernel n t)
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_fejerCircleKernel n)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hki (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => ?_))).trans_eq ?_
  · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (fejerCircleKernel_nonneg _ _)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM _ (re_fourier_one_mem_Icc _))
      (fejerCircleKernel_nonneg _ _)).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_fejerCircleKernel_eq_one, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.fejerChebyshevMean_sub
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fejerChebyshevMean, chebyshevTrunc, chebyshevCoeff_sub hf hg, C_sub,
    sub_mul, sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_fejerChebyshevMean_eval
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_fejerChebyshevMean_eval (p : ℝ[X]) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => (fejerChebyshevMean p.eval n).eval x) p.eval atTop
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℝ := Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
  let pc : C(s, ℝ) := p.toContinuousMapOn s
  let u : ℕ → C(s, ℝ) := fun n => (chebyshevTrunc p.eval n).toContinuousMapOn s
  have hexact : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, u n = pc := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop p.natDegree] with n hn
    have hp : p.degree ≤ n := p.degree_le_natDegree.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    dsimp [u, pc]
    rw [chebyshevTrunc_eval_eq_of_degree_le hp]
  have hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 pc) := tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    (hexact.mono (fun n hn => hn.symm))
  have hcesaro := hu.cesaro_smul.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hmean : Tendsto (fun n => (fejerChebyshevMean p.eval n).toContinuousMapOn s) atTop (𝓝 pc) := by
    convert hcesaro using 1
    funext n
    ext x
    simp [fejerChebyshevMean, u, eval_smul, eval_finsetSum]
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hnorm : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ‖pc - (fejerChebyshevMean p.eval n).toContinuousMapOn s‖ < ε := by
    filter_upwards [(Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hmean) ε hε] with n hn
    rw [_root_.dist_eq_norm] at hn
    simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hn
  filter_upwards [hnorm] with n hn x hx
  have h := ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm
    (pc - (fejerChebyshevMean p.eval n).toContinuousMapOn s) ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa only [pc, ContinuousMap.sub_apply, Polynomial.toContinuousMapOn_apply,
    Polynomial.toContinuousMap_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.dist_eq] using h) hn

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_fejerChebyshevMean
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_fejerChebyshevMean {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => (fejerChebyshevMean f n).eval x) f atTop
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_polynomial_near_of_continuousOn (-1) 1 f hf (ε / 3) (by positivity)
  have hpoly := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (tendstoUniformlyOn_fejerChebyshevMean_eval p))
    (ε / 3) (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hpoly] with n hn x hx
  have herr : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |f y - p.eval y| ≤ ε / 3 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact (hp y hy).le
  have hmean := abs_eval_fejerChebyshevMean_le (hf.sub p.continuous.continuousOn) herr n hx
  change |(fejerChebyshevMean (fun y => f y - p.eval y) n).eval x| ≤ ε / 3 at hmean
  rw [fejerChebyshevMean_sub hf p.continuous.continuousOn, eval_sub] at hmean
  have h1 := hp x hx
  have h2 := hn x hx
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at h2 ⊢
  have ht1 := abs_sub_le (f x) (p.eval x) ((fejerChebyshevMean f n).eval x)
  have ht2 := abs_sub_le (p.eval x) ((fejerChebyshevMean p.eval n).eval x)
    ((fejerChebyshevMean f n).eval x)
  rw [abs_sub_comm (p.eval x) (f x)] at h1
  rw [abs_sub_comm ((fejerChebyshevMean f n).eval x) ((fejerChebyshevMean p.eval n).eval x)] at hmean
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_cos_mul_half_pi
statement:
theorem integral_cos_mul_half_pi (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, Real.cos (c * θ)) = Real.sin (c * (Real.pi / 2)) / c
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ hc, integral_cos]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) k =
      (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi * (1 + (-1 : ℝ) ^ k) *
        ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, Real.cos θ * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => |Real.cos θ| * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
  have hu : Continuous u := by fun_prop
  have hsym : ∀ θ, u (Real.pi - θ) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * u θ := by
    intro θ
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [Real.cos_pi_sub, abs_neg,
      show (k : ℝ) * (Real.pi - θ) = (k : ℝ) * Real.pi - (k : ℝ) * θ by ring,
      Real.cos_nat_mul_pi_sub]
    ring
  have hreflect : (∫ θ in Real.pi / 2..Real.pi, u θ) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, u θ := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (f := u) (a := 0) (b := Real.pi / 2) Real.pi
    have hhalf : Real.pi - Real.pi / 2 = Real.pi / 2 := by ring
    simp only [hhalf, sub_zero, hsym] at h
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hfirst : (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, u θ) =
      ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, Real.cos θ * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro θ hθ
    have ht : θ ∈ Icc 0 (Real.pi / 2) := by simpa [uIcc_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi / 2)] using hθ
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.cos_nonneg_of_neg_pi_div_two_le_of_le
      (by linarith [ht.1, Real.pi_pos]) ht.2)]
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hu.intervalIntegrable 0 (Real.pi / 2)) (hu.intervalIntegrable (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi)
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_eq_cosine_integral]
  change (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi * (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, u θ) = _
  rw [← hsplit, hreflect, hfirst]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem chebyshevCoeff_abs_zero : chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) 0 = 2 / Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral]
  simp [integral_cos]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_odd
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevCoeff_abs_odd (j : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral]
  simp [pow_add, pow_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_cos_mul_cos_even_half_pi
statement:
theorem integral_cos_mul_cos_even_half_pi {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, Real.cos θ * Real.cos ((2 * j : ℕ) * θ)) =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ j) / (4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (1 : ℝ) + 2 * j ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hneg : (1 : ℝ) - 2 * j ≠ 0 := by
    have hjR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linarith
  have hproduct : ∀ θ : ℝ, Real.cos θ * Real.cos ((2 * j : ℕ) * θ) =
      (Real.cos ((1 + 2 * j) * θ) + Real.cos ((1 - 2 * j) * θ)) / 2 := by
    intro θ
    push_cast
    rw [show (1 + 2 * (j : ℝ)) * θ = θ + 2 * (j : ℝ) * θ by ring,
      show (1 - 2 * (j : ℝ)) * θ = θ - 2 * (j : ℝ) * θ by ring,
      Real.cos_add, Real.cos_sub]
    ring
  simp_rw [hproduct]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
      (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop),
    integral_cos_mul_half_pi _ hpos, integral_cos_mul_half_pi _ hneg]
  have hsinplus : Real.sin ((1 + 2 * (j : ℝ)) * (Real.pi / 2)) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ j := by
    rw [show (1 + 2 * (j : ℝ)) * (Real.pi / 2) = (j : ℝ) * Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by ring]
    simp [Real.sin_add, Real.cos_nat_mul_pi]
  have hsinminus : Real.sin ((1 - 2 * (j : ℝ)) * (Real.pi / 2)) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ j := by
    rw [show (1 - 2 * (j : ℝ)) * (Real.pi / 2) = Real.pi / 2 - (j : ℝ) * Real.pi by ring]
    simp [Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_nat_mul_pi]
  rw [hsinplus, hsinminus]
  rw [show 4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 = -((1 + 2 * (j : ℝ)) * (1 - 2 * (j : ℝ))) by ring]
  field_simp [hpos, hneg]
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_even
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_abs_even {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * j) =
      4 / Real.pi * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) / (4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral,
    if_neg (show 2 * j ≠ 0 by omega), integral_cos_mul_cos_even_half_pi hj]
  simp [pow_mul, pow_succ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_abs
statement: theorem lipschitzWith_abs : LipschitzWith 1 (fun x : ℝ => |x|)
proof:

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_abs_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_abs_mul_eval_T {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasSum (fun k => chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) |x|

name: NLAlib.tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc_abs
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc_abs :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => (chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) n).eval x)
      (fun x : ℝ => |x|) atTop (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:=
  tendstoUniformlyOn_chebyshevTrunc (by fun_prop) summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * j)| =
      4 / Real.pi / (4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hjR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hden : 0 < 4 * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  rw [chebyshevCoeff_abs_even hj, abs_div, abs_mul,
    abs_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 4 / Real.pi by positivity), abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos hden]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_eq_sub
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_eq_sub (j : ℕ) :
    |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + 1))| =
      2 / Real.pi * (1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even (by omega)]
  have hfac : 4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 = (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * (j : ℝ) + 3) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hfac]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasSum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_tail
statement:
theorem hasSum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_tail (m : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun j => |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + m + 1))|)
      (2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => 1 / (2 * ((j + m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)
  have hs : Summable (fun j => |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + m + 1))|) :=
    summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs.comp_injective (by
      intro a c h
      change 2 * (a + m + 1) = 2 * (c + m + 1) at h
      omega)
  have hn : Summable (fun j => ‖|chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + m + 1))|‖) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)] using hs
  have hterm : ∀ j, |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + m + 1))| =
      2 / Real.pi * (b j - b (j + 1)) := by
    intro j
    rw [abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_eq_sub]
    dsimp only [b]
    push_cast
    congr 2
    ring
  apply (hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat_of_summable_norm hn).mpr
  have hzero : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun j => by dsimp [b]; positivity))
      _ (show Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) from tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with j hj
    dsimp only [b]
    have hjR : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < j by omega)
    have hden : (j : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((j + m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; nlinarith
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hjR hden
  have hsum : (fun N : ℕ => ∑ j ∈ range N,
      |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + m + 1))|) =
      fun N => 2 / Real.pi * (b 0 - b N) := by
    funext N
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [← mul_sum, sum_range_sub']
  rw [hsum]
  have ht := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := b 0)).sub hzero).const_mul (2 / Real.pi)
  have hvalue : 2 / Real.pi * (b 0 - 0) = 2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1)) := by
    dsimp only [b]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hvalue] at ht
  exact ht

name: NLAlib.tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_tail
statement:
theorem tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_tail (m : ℕ) :
    (∑' j, |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (j + (2 * m + 1))|) =
      2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (j + (2 * m + 1))|
  have hs : Summable u := (summable_nat_add_iff (2 * m + 1)).mpr summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs
  have he : Summable (fun j => u (2 * j)) := hs.comp_injective (by
    intro a b h
    change 2 * a = 2 * b at h
    omega)
  have ho : Summable (fun j => u (2 * j + 1)) := hs.comp_injective (by
    intro a b h
    change 2 * a + 1 = 2 * b + 1 at h
    omega)
  have hzero : ∀ j, u (2 * j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [show 2 * j + (2 * m + 1) = 2 * (j + m) + 1 by omega, chebyshevCoeff_abs_odd, abs_zero]
  have hodd : ∀ j, u (2 * j + 1) = |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + m + 1))| := by
    intro j
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [show 2 * j + 1 + (2 * m + 1) = 2 * (j + m + 1) by omega]
  have h := tsum_even_add_odd he ho
  simp_rw [hzero, hodd] at h
  rw [tsum_zero, zero_add, (hasSum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_tail m).tsum_eq] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.abs_abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le
statement:
theorem abs_abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(|x|) - (chebyshevTrunc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * m)).eval x| ≤
      2 / (Real.pi * (2 * m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_sub_eval_chebyshevTrunc_le_tsum (f := fun x : ℝ => |x|)
    (by fun_prop) summable_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs (2 * m) hx
  simpa only [tsum_abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_tail] using h

name: NLAlib.summable_chebyshevFoldFiber
statement:
theorem summable_chebyshevFoldFiber {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hs : Summable (fun k => |a k|))
    (n j : ℕ) : Summable (fun k => if chebyshevAliasIndex n k = j then a k else 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_norm
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) _ hs
  intro k
  by_cases h : chebyshevAliasIndex n k = j <;> simp [h, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevFoldPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevFoldPolynomial_le (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevFoldPolynomial a n).degree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevFoldPolynomial
  refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun k hk => ?_)
  rw [C_mul']
  refine (degree_smul_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)

name: NLAlib.hasSum_mul_eval_T_alias
statement:
theorem hasSum_mul_eval_T_alias {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hs : Summable (fun k => |a k|))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k => a k * (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n k : ℤ)).eval x)
      ((chebyshevFoldPolynomial a n).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : ∀ j ∈ range (n + 1), HasSum
      (fun k => (if chebyshevAliasIndex n k = j then a k else 0) * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x)
      (chebyshevFoldCoeff a n j * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) := by
    intro j hj
    exact (summable_chebyshevFoldFiber hs n j).hasSum.mul_right _
  have h := hasSum_sum hj
  convert h using 1
  · funext k
    rw [sum_eq_single (chebyshevAliasIndex n k)]
    · simp
    · intro j hj hne
      simp [hne.symm]
    · intro hnot
      exact False.elim (hnot (mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (chebyshevAliasIndex_le hn k))))
  · simp only [chebyshevFoldPolynomial, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevInterpolant_eq_foldPolynomial
statement:
theorem chebyshevInterpolant_eq_foldPolynomial {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    chebyshevInterpolant f n = chebyshevFoldPolynomial (chebyshevCoeff f) n
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ (chebyshev_node_injOn n)
  · have hdegree := degree_chebyshevFoldPolynomial_le (chebyshevCoeff f) n
    rw [card_range]
    exact hdegree.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  · intro j hj
    have h := hasSum_mul_eval_T_alias hs hn (node n j)
    have hterm : ∀ k,
        chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n k : ℤ)).eval (node n j) =
          chebyshevCoeff f k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node n j) := by
      intro k
      rw [eval_T_node_eq_eval_T_alias hn k j]
    simp_rw [hterm] at h
    exact h.unique (hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hs node_mem_Icc)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_eval_interpolant_eq_foldCoeff
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_eval_interpolant_eq_foldCoeff {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (chebyshevInterpolant f n).eval j =
      if j ≤ n then chebyshevFoldCoeff (chebyshevCoeff f) n j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevInterpolant_eq_foldPolynomial hf hs hn]
  simp only [chebyshevFoldPolynomial, C_mul']
  exact chebyshevCoeff_eval_sum_smul_T _ _ _

name: NLAlib.chebyshevAliasIndex_eq_self_of_le
statement:
theorem chebyshevAliasIndex_eq_self_of_le {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    chebyshevAliasIndex n k = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevAliasIndex
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  omega

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_eval_chebyshevInterpolant_le_two_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem abs_sub_eval_chebyshevInterpolant_le_two_mul_tsum {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |chebyshevCoeff f k|)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |f x - (chebyshevInterpolant f n).eval x| ≤
      2 * ∑' j, |chebyshevCoeff f (j + (n + 1))|
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => chebyshevCoeff f k *
    ((T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x - (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n k : ℤ)).eval x)
  have hu : HasSum u (f x - (chebyshevInterpolant f n).eval x) := by
    have h := (hasSum_chebyshevCoeff_mul_eval_T hf hs hx).sub (hasSum_mul_eval_T_alias hs hn x)
    rw [← chebyshevInterpolant_eq_foldPolynomial hf hs hn] at h
    simpa only [u, mul_sub] using h
  have hzero : ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), u k = 0 := by
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    dsimp [u]
    rw [chebyshevAliasIndex_eq_self_of_le hn (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)),
      sub_self, mul_zero]
  have hsplit := hu.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add (n + 1)
  rw [hzero, zero_add, hu.tsum_eq] at hsplit
  have hterm : ∀ j, ‖u (j + (n + 1))‖ ≤ 2 * |chebyshevCoeff f (j + (n + 1))| := by
    intro j
    have hT := abs_eval_T_real_le_one ((j + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) (abs_le.mpr hx)
    have hI := abs_eval_T_real_le_one (chebyshevAliasIndex n (j + (n + 1)) : ℤ) (abs_le.mpr hx)
    have hsum : |(T ℝ ((j + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x -
        (T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n (j + (n + 1)) : ℤ)).eval x| ≤ 2 := by
      have h := abs_sub ((T ℝ ((j + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x)
        ((T ℝ (chebyshevAliasIndex n (j + (n + 1)) : ℤ)).eval x)
      linarith
    dsimp [u]
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (abs_nonneg _)).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  have hstail := ((summable_nat_add_iff (n + 1)).mpr hs).mul_left 2
  have hnorm := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm hstail
  rw [← hsplit, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm).trans ((hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hterm hstail).trans_eq
    (tsum_mul_left))

name: NLAlib.exists_strictMono_deriv_zeros_between
statement:
private theorem exists_strictMono_deriv_zeros_between {n : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (hf : Continuous f) (hz : ∀ i, f (v i) = 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, StrictMono c ∧
      ∀ i, c i ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ∧ deriv f (c i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h (i : Fin (n+1)) : ∃ c ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ), deriv f c = 0 := by
    exact exists_deriv_eq_zero (hv Fin.castSucc_lt_succ) hf.continuousOn (by rw [hz, hz])
  choose c hc hz using h
  refine ⟨c, fun i j hij => ?_, fun i => ⟨hc i, hz i⟩⟩
  exact (hc i).2.trans_le (hv.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hij)) |>.trans (hc j).1

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_scaled_exp
statement:
private theorem hasDerivAt_scaled_exp (A B x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A * Real.exp (B*t)) (A*B*Real.exp (B*x)) x
proof:
:= by
  convert! (((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul B).exp).const_mul A using 1
  simp [mul_comm, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.eval_pos_and_derivative_nonneg_of_exp_interpolation
statement:
theorem eval_pos_and_derivative_nonneg_of_exp_interpolation (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (p : ℝ[X]) (_hp : p.degree ≤ n) (v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ), StrictMono v →
      ∀ (A B : ℝ), 0 < A → 0 < B →
        (∀ i, p.eval (v i) = A * Real.exp (B*v i)) →
        ∀ x : ℝ, v (Fin.last n) ≤ x → 0 < p.eval x ∧ 0 ≤ p.derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro p hp v _ A B hA _ hval x _
    have hc := p.eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hp
    have h := hval (Fin.last 0)
    rw [hc, eval_C] at h
    rw [hc, eval_C, derivative_C, eval_zero]
    exact ⟨h ▸ mul_pos hA (Real.exp_pos _), le_rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro p hp v hv A B hA hB hval x hx
    let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => A * Real.exp (B*t) - p.eval t
    have hf : Continuous f := by dsimp [f]; fun_prop
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcz⟩ := exists_strictMono_deriv_zeros_between hv hf
      (fun i => by dsimp [f]; rw [hval]; ring)
    have hderval (i : Fin (n+1)) : p.derivative.eval (c i) =
        (A*B) * Real.exp (B*c i) := by
      have hd := (hasDerivAt_scaled_exp A B (c i)).sub (p.hasDerivAt (c i))
      have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A * Real.exp (B*t) - p.eval t)
          (A*B*Real.exp (B*c i) - p.derivative.eval (c i)) (c i) := by
        convert! hd using 1
      have hz := (hcz i).2
      change deriv (fun t => A * Real.exp (B*t) - p.eval t) (c i) = 0 at hz
      rw [hd'.deriv] at hz
      linarith
    have hpder : p.derivative.degree ≤ n := degree_le_of_natDegree_le
      ((natDegree_derivative_le p).trans (by have h := natDegree_le_of_degree_le hp; omega))
    have hlast : c (Fin.last n) < v (Fin.last (n+1)) := by
      simpa only [Fin.succ_last] using (hcz (Fin.last n)).1.2
    have hdpos (t : ℝ) (ht : v (Fin.last (n+1)) ≤ t) : 0 < p.derivative.eval t :=
      (ih p.derivative hpder c hc (A*B) B (mul_pos hA hB) hB hderval t
        (hlast.le.trans ht)).1
    have hmono : MonotoneOn p.eval (Ici (v (Fin.last (n+1)))) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Ici _) p.continuous.continuousOn
        (fun t _ => (p.hasDerivAt t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      intro t ht
      exact (hdpos t (interior_subset ht)).le
    have hnodepos : 0 < p.eval (v (Fin.last (n+1))) := by
      rw [hval]
      exact mul_pos hA (Real.exp_pos _)
    exact ⟨hnodepos.trans_le (hmono self_mem_Ici hx hx), (hdpos x hx).le⟩

name: NLAlib.eval_pos_le_exp_and_derivative_nonneg_of_interpolation
statement:
theorem eval_pos_le_exp_and_derivative_nonneg_of_interpolation {n : ℕ}
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    {a x B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo 0 a)
    (hval : ∀ i, p.eval (v i) = Real.exp (B*v i)) (hx : a ≤ x) :
    0 < p.eval x ∧ p.eval x ≤ Real.exp (B*x) ∧ 0 ≤ p.derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hxa : v (Fin.last n) ≤ x := (hva _).2.le.trans hx
  have hpos := eval_pos_and_derivative_nonneg_of_exp_interpolation n p hp v hv 1 B
    zero_lt_one hB (by simpa only [one_mul] using hval) x hxa
  have hax : 0 < x := (hva 0).1.trans_le ((hva 0).2.le.trans hx)
  have hinterp : Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ v (fun i => Real.exp (B*v i)) = p := by
    apply (Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ hv.injective.injOn ?_ ?_).symm
    · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    · intro i _
      exact hval i
  obtain ⟨ξ, _, hrem⟩ := exists_sub_eval_interpolate_eq (f := fun t => Real.exp (B*t))
    hax hv.injective (fun i => ⟨(hva i).1.le, (hva i).2.le.trans hx⟩)
    ⟨le_rfl.trans hax.le, le_rfl⟩ (by fun_prop) (by
      intro k _
      rw [iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul]
      fun_prop)
  rw [show ((fun t => Real.exp (B*t)) ∘ v) = (fun i => Real.exp (B*v i)) by rfl,
    hinterp, iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul] at hrem
  have hnodal : 0 ≤ (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ v).eval x := by
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => sub_nonneg.mpr ((hva i).2.le.trans hx)
  have hremNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.exp (B*x) - p.eval x := by
    rw [hrem]
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_pos (pow_pos hB _) (Real.exp_pos _)).le
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hnodal
  exact ⟨hpos.1, sub_nonneg.mp hremNonneg, hpos.2⟩

name: Lagrange.nodal_eval_ne_zero_of_forall_ne
statement:
private theorem nodal_eval_ne_zero_of_forall_ne {q : ℕ} (v : Fin q → ℝ) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) : (nodal univ v).eval a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eval_nodal]
  exact prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (ha i)

name: Lagrange.natDegree_hermiteInterpolate_le
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : 0 < q
  · have hd := degree_hermiteInterpolate_lt
      (show (univ : Finset (Fin q)).Nonempty from ⟨⟨0, hq⟩, mem_univ _⟩) hv.injOn y d
    apply natDegree_le_of_degree_le
    simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hd.le
  · have hq0 : q = 0 := by omega
    subst q
    simp [hermiteInterpolate]

name: Lagrange.degree_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (hermiteEndpointInterpolate a ya v y d).natDegree ≤ 2 * q := by
    unfold hermiteEndpointInterpolate
    apply (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
    apply max_le (natDegree_hermiteInterpolate_le hv y d)
    apply (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans
    simp [natDegree_pow, natDegree_nodal, mul_comm]
  exact degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hd))

name: Lagrange.degree_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b ya yb v y d).natDegree ≤ 2 * q + 1 := by
    dsimp only [hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate]
    apply (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
    apply max_le
    · exact (natDegree_hermiteInterpolate_le hv y d).trans (by omega)
    · have hlin : (C ((ya - (hermiteInterpolate univ v y d).eval a) /
          (nodal univ v).eval a ^ 2) +
        C (((yb - (hermiteInterpolate univ v y d).eval b) / (nodal univ v).eval b ^ 2 -
          (ya - (hermiteInterpolate univ v y d).eval a) / (nodal univ v).eval a ^ 2) /
            (b - a)) * (X - C a)).natDegree ≤ 1 := by compute_degree
      apply (natDegree_mul_le.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hlin _)).trans
      simp [natDegree_pow, natDegree_nodal]
      omega
  exact degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hd))

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteEndpointInterpolate, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow,
    eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i), eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn y d (mem_univ i)]
  ring

name: Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_derivative_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_at_node {q : ℕ} (a ya : ℝ)
    {v : Fin q → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v) (y d : Fin q → ℝ) (i : Fin q) :
    (hermiteEndpointInterpolate a ya v y d).derivative.eval (v i) = d i
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteEndpointInterpolate, derivative_add, derivative_pow,
    eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i),
    eval_derivative_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn y d (mem_univ i)]

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_endpoint
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_endpoint {q : ℕ} (a ya : ℝ) (v y d : Fin q → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) : (hermiteEndpointInterpolate a ya v y d).eval a = ya
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := nodal_eval_ne_zero_of_forall_ne v ha
  simp only [hermiteEndpointInterpolate, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow]
