  ring

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node {q : ℕ} (a b ya yb : ℝ)
    {v : Fin q → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v) (y d : Fin q → ℝ) (i : Fin q) :
    (hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b ya yb v y d).eval (v i) = y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate, eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i),
    eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn y d (mem_univ i)]

name: Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_derivative_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_at_node {q : ℕ} (a b ya yb : ℝ)
    {v : Fin q → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v) (y d : Fin q → ℝ) (i : Fin q) :
    (hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b ya yb v y d).derivative.eval (v i) = d i
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate, derivative_add, derivative_mul,
    derivative_pow, eval_nodal_at_node (mem_univ i),
    eval_derivative_hermiteInterpolate_at_node hv.injOn y d (mem_univ i)]

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_left
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_left {q : ℕ} (a b ya yb : ℝ)
    (v y d : Fin q → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) :
    (hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b ya yb v y d).eval a = ya
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := nodal_eval_ne_zero_of_forall_ne v ha
  simp only [hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow,
    eval_sub, eval_X, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_right
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_right {q : ℕ} (a b ya yb : ℝ)
    (v y d : Fin q → ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i) (hb : ∀ i, b ≠ v i) :
    (hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b ya yb v y d).eval b = yb
proof:
:= by
  have hπa := nodal_eval_ne_zero_of_forall_ne v ha
  have hπb := nodal_eval_ne_zero_of_forall_ne v hb
  simp only [hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow,
    eval_sub, eval_X]
  field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.symm]
  ring

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le (F : ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).degree ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (fun j => (F (node N j)).re) (chebyshev_node_injOn N)
  rw [card_range] at h
  apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
  rcases eq_or_ne (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N) 0 with hzero | hzero
  · simp [hzero]
  · have hn := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hzero).mpr h
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_node
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_node (F : ℂ → ℂ) (N j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).eval (node N j) = (F (node N j)).re
proof:
:= by
  exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ (chebyshev_node_injOn N) (mem_range.mpr (by omega))

name: NLAlib.interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_of_le
statement:
theorem interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_of_le {N k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ N) :
    Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
      (fun j => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j)) = T ℝ (k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Lagrange.eq_interpolate (chebyshev_node_injOn N)
  rw [degree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast, card_range]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_interpolate_eval_T_node_le_one_all
statement:
theorem abs_eval_interpolate_eval_T_node_le_one_all (N k : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
      (fun j => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j))).eval x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
  · simp [range_one, node]
  · exact abs_eval_interpolate_eval_T_node_le_one hN k hx

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_interpolate_T_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_interpolate_T_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k *
      (Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
        (fun j => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j))).eval x)
      ((chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : ∀ j ∈ range (N + 1), HasSum (fun k : ℕ =>
      (chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j)) *
        (Lagrange.basis (range (N + 1)) (node N) j).eval x)
      ((F (node N j)).re * (Lagrange.basis (range (N + 1)) (node N) j).eval x) := by
    intro j hj
    exact (hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM node_mem_Icc).mul_right _
  have h := hasSum_sum hj
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  · funext k
    simp only [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  · simp only [chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]

name: NLAlib.abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (N : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(F x).re - (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).eval x| ≤
      4 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let I : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (Lagrange.interpolate (range (N + 1)) (node N)
    (fun j => (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (node N j))).eval x
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x -
    chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * I k
  have hu : HasSum u ((F x).re - (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).eval x) :=
    (hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM hx).sub
      (hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_interpolate_T_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM N x)
  have hzero : ∑ k ∈ range (N + 1), u k = 0 := by
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    dsimp [u, I]
    rw [interpolate_eval_T_node_eq_T_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk)), sub_self]
  have hsplit := hu.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add (N + 1)
  rw [hzero, zero_add, hu.tsum_eq] at hsplit
  have hq : |ρ⁻¹| < 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < ρ⁻¹)]
    exact (inv_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)).mpr hρ
  have hgeom : Summable (fun i : ℕ => 4 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1))) := by
    have h := ((summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq).mul_right ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (N + 1))).mul_left (4 * M)
    convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
    funext i
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, pow_add]
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖u (i + (N + 1))‖ ≤ 4 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1)) := by
    intro i
    let k := i + (N + 1)
    have hc := abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM
      (k := k) (by dsimp [k]; omega)
    have hT := abs_eval_T_real_le_one (k : ℤ) (abs_le.mpr hx)
    have hI : |I k| ≤ 1 := abs_eval_interpolate_eval_T_node_le_one_all N k hx
    have hsum : |(T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x - I k| ≤ 2 := by
      have h := abs_sub ((T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) (I k)
      linarith
    change |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x -
      chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * I k| ≤ _
    rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (abs_nonneg (chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k))
    have hc2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    calc |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| * |(T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x - I k|
        ≤ |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| * 2 := hmul
      _ = 2 * |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k| := mul_comm _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * M / ρ ^ k) := hc2
      _ = 4 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1)) := by dsimp [k]; ring
  have hnorm := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _) hterm hgeom
  rw [← hsplit, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  refine (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm).trans ((hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hterm hgeom).trans_eq ?_)
  have hterm_eq : ∀ i : ℕ, 4 * M / ρ ^ (i + (N + 1)) =
      4 * M * ((ρ⁻¹) ^ i * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (N + 1)) := by
    intro i
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, pow_add]
  simp_rw [hterm_eq]
  rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_right, tsum_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hq, pow_succ]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hρ)]

name: NLAlib.degree_le_and_abs_sub_chebyshev_approximations_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem degree_le_and_abs_sub_chebyshev_approximations_le_of_open_ellipse
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).degree ≤ N ∧ (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).degree ≤ N ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        |f x - (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1) ∧
        |f x - (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).eval x| ≤ 4 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨degree_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le F N, degree_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le F N, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have h1 := abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM N hx
  have h2 := abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le_of_open_ellipse hρ hFd hM N hx
  rw [hmatch x hx, Complex.ofReal_re] at h1 h2
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: Lagrange.natDegree_hermite_term_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_hermite_term_le {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s)
    (y d : ι → ℝ) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (C (y i) * hermiteValueBasis s v i + C (d i) * hermiteDerivativeBasis s v i).natDegree ≤
      2 * s.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < s.card := card_pos.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hb := natDegree_basis hv hi
  have hv₁ : (1 - C (2 * (Lagrange.basis s v i).derivative.eval (v i)) *
      (X - C (v i)) : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := by compute_degree
  have hv₂ : (X - C (v i) : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := by compute_degree
  apply (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
  apply max_le
  · apply (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans
    apply (natDegree_mul_le.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hv₁ _)).trans
    rw [natDegree_pow, hb]
    omega
  · apply (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans
    apply (natDegree_mul_le.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hv₂ _)).trans
    rw [natDegree_pow, hb]
    omega

name: Lagrange.degree_hermiteInterpolate_lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermiteInterpolate
  apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
  rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)]
  intro i hi
  apply (degree_le_natDegree).trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_hermite_term_le hv y d hi)
    (by have := hs.card_pos; omega : 2 * s.card - 1 < 2 * s.card))

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteValueBasis
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteValueBasis {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s)
    {i j : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s) :
    (hermiteValueBasis s v i).eval (v j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hermiteValueBasis, eval_basis_self hv hi]
  · simp [hermiteValueBasis, hij, eval_basis_of_ne hij hj]

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteDerivativeBasis
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteDerivativeBasis {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s)
    {i j : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s) :
    (hermiteDerivativeBasis s v i).eval (v j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hermiteDerivativeBasis, eval_basis_self hv hi]
  · simp [hermiteDerivativeBasis, eval_basis_of_ne hij hj]

name: Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteValueBasis
statement:
theorem eval_derivative_hermiteValueBasis {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s)
    {i j : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s) :
    (hermiteValueBasis s v i).derivative.eval (v j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hermiteValueBasis, derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_pow,
      eval_basis_self hv hi]
  · simp [hermiteValueBasis, derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_pow,
      eval_basis_of_ne hij hj]

name: Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteDerivativeBasis
statement:
theorem eval_derivative_hermiteDerivativeBasis {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s)
    {i j : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s) :
    (hermiteDerivativeBasis s v i).derivative.eval (v j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hermiteDerivativeBasis, derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_pow,
      eval_basis_self hv hi]
  · simp [hermiteDerivativeBasis, derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_pow,
      hij, eval_basis_of_ne hij hj]

name: Lagrange.eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_hermiteInterpolate_at_node {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s)
    (y d : ι → ℝ) {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) :
    (hermiteInterpolate s v y d).eval (v j) = y j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteInterpolate, eval_finsetSum, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [eval_hermiteValueBasis hv hj hj, eval_hermiteDerivativeBasis hv hj hj]
    simp
  · intro i hi hij
    rw [eval_hermiteValueBasis hv hi hj, eval_hermiteDerivativeBasis hv hi hj, if_neg hij]
    simp
  · exact fun h => (h hj).elim

name: Lagrange.eval_derivative_hermiteInterpolate_at_node
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteInterpolate, derivative_sum, derivative_add, derivative_C_mul,
    eval_finsetSum, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [eval_derivative_hermiteValueBasis hv hj hj,
      eval_derivative_hermiteDerivativeBasis hv hj hj]
    simp
  · intro i hi hij
    rw [eval_derivative_hermiteValueBasis hv hi hj,
      eval_derivative_hermiteDerivativeBasis hv hi hj, if_neg hij]
    simp
  · exact fun h => (h hj).elim

name: NLAlib.exists_strictMono_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
private lemma exists_strictMono_deriv_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _))))
    (hz : ∀ i, f (v i) = 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, StrictMono c ∧
      ∀ i, c i ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ∧ deriv f (c i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ c ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ), deriv f c = 0 := by
    intro i
    refine exists_deriv_eq_zero (hv Fin.castSucc_lt_succ) (hf.mono ?_) (by rw [hz, hz])
    exact Icc_subset_Icc (hv.monotone (Fin.zero_le _)) (hv.monotone (Fin.le_last _))
  choose c hc hc0 using key
  refine ⟨c, fun i j hij => ?_, fun i => ⟨hc i, hc0 i⟩⟩
  calc c i < v i.succ := (hc i).2
    _ ≤ v j.castSucc := hv.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hij)
    _ < c j := (hc j).1

name: NLAlib.exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_aux
statement:
private lemma exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_aux (q : ℕ) :
    ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (v : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ), StrictMono v →
      ContinuousOn f (Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _))) →
      (∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo (v 0) (v (Fin.last _)))) →
      (∀ i, f (v i) = 0) → ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo (v 0) (v (Fin.last _)), iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    intro f v hv hf _ hz
    obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := exists_strictMono_deriv_eq_zero hv hf hz
    exact ⟨c 0, (hc 0).1, by simpa using (hc 0).2⟩
  | succ q ih =>
    intro f v hv hf hf' hz
    obtain ⟨c, hcm, hc⟩ := exists_strictMono_deriv_eq_zero hv hf hz
    have hsub : Icc (c 0) (c (Fin.last _)) ⊆ Ioo (v 0) (v (Fin.last _)) := by
      intro t ht
      have h0 := (hc 0).1.1
      have h1 := (hc (Fin.last _)).1.2
      simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_last] at h0 h1
      exact ⟨h0.trans_le ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt h1⟩
    have hd0 : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Icc (c 0) (c (Fin.last _))) := by
      have h := hf' 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)
      rw [zero_add, iteratedDeriv_one] at h
      exact h.mono hsub
    have hdk : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (deriv f))
        (Ioo (c 0) (c (Fin.last _))) := by
      intro k hk
      have h := hf' (k + 1) (by omega)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ'] at h
      exact h.mono (Ioo_subset_Icc_self.trans hsub)
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := ih (deriv f) c hcm hd0 hdk (fun i => (hc i).2)
    refine ⟨ξ, hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ), ?_⟩
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using hξ0

name: NLAlib.exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_strictMono {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    {v : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ i, f (v i) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _)) ⊆ Icc a b := Icc_subset_Icc (hva 0).1 (hva _).2
  have hsub' : Ioo (v 0) (v (Fin.last _)) ⊆ Ioo a b := Ioo_subset_Ioo (hva 0).1 (hva _).2
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_aux q f v hv (hf.mono hsub)
    (fun k hk => (hf' k hk).mono hsub') hz
  exact ⟨ξ, hsub' hξ, hξ0⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_card
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_card {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {s : Finset ℝ}
    (hs : s.card = q + 2) (hsab : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_strictMono (s.orderEmbOfFin hs).strictMono
    (fun i => hsab _ (s.orderEmbOfFin_mem hs i)) hf hf' (fun i => hz _ (s.orderEmbOfFin_mem hs i))

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_interpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_interpolate_eq {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b x : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k ≤ q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, f x - (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ v (f ∘ v)).eval x =
      iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ / (q + 1).factorial * (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ v).eval x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L := Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ v (f ∘ v) with hL
  set ω := Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ v with hω_def
  have hLnode : ∀ i, L.eval (v i) = f (v i) := fun i =>
    Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ hv.injOn (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hωnode : ∀ i, ω.eval (v i) = 0 := fun i => Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (Finset.mem_univ i)
  by_cases hnode : ∃ i, x = v i
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hnode
    refine ⟨(a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hLnode, hωnode]
    simp
  simp only [not_exists] at hnode
  have hω : ω.eval x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hω_def, Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hnode i)
  set K := (f x - L.eval x) / ω.eval x with hK
  set h : ℝ[X] := L + C K * ω with hh
  have hs : (insert x (Finset.univ.image v)).card = q + 2 := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hv, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin]
    simpa [eq_comm] using hnode
  have hEq := iteratedDeriv_sub_eval_eqOn isOpen_Ioo h (n := q + 1)
    (fun k hk => hf' k (by omega))
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_card (f := fun t => f t - h.eval t) hs
    (by
      intro y hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · exact hx
      · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
        exact hva i)
    (hf.sub (Polynomial.continuous _).continuousOn)
    (fun k hk => ((hf' (k + 1) (by omega)).continuousOn.sub
      (Polynomial.continuous _).continuousOn).congr (hEq (k + 1) (by omega)))
    (by
      intro y hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · simp only [hh, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, hK]
        field_simp
        ring
      · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
        simp [hh, hLnode, hωnode])
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  have hD : (derivative^[q + 1] h).eval ξ = K * (q + 1).factorial := by
    have hLdeg : L.degree < ↑(q + 1) := by
      have := Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (s := Finset.univ) (f ∘ v) hv.injOn
      rwa [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    have hωdeg : ω.natDegree = q + 1 := by simp [hω_def, Lagrange.natDegree_nodal]
    have hωmon : ω.leadingCoeff = 1 := Lagrange.nodal_monic
    rw [hh, iterate_map_add, iterate_derivative_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hLdeg, zero_add,
      iterate_derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, ← hωdeg, eval_iterate_derivative_natDegree,
      hωmon, mul_one]
  have h1 : iteratedDeriv (q + 1) (fun t => f t - h.eval t) ξ =
      iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ - (derivative^[q + 1] h).eval ξ := hEq (q + 1) le_rfl hξ
  rw [hξ0, hD] at h1
  have hfac : ((q + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [show iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = K * (q + 1).factorial by linarith, hK]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.nodal_chebyshevZero
statement:
theorem nodal_chebyshevZero (q : ℕ) :
    Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ (chebyshevZero q) = C (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1)) * Chebyshev.T ℝ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hroots := Chebyshev.roots_T_real q
  rw [Finset.image_val, Finset.range_val, (Chebyshev.roots_T_real_nodup q).dedup] at hroots
  have hcard : (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).roots.card = (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).natDegree := by
    rw [hroots]
    simp
  have hT := C_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_multiset_X_sub_C hcard
  rw [hroots, Multiset.map_map] at hT
  conv_rhs => rw [← hT]
  rw [Chebyshev.leadingCoeff_T, Lagrange.nodal_eq, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul]
  have hc : (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1) : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((q : ℤ).natAbs - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [Int.natAbs_natCast]
    field_simp
  rw [hc, C_1, one_mul]
  have := Finset.prod_map_val (Finset.range q)
    ((fun a => X - C a) ∘ fun k : ℕ => Real.cos ((2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / (2 * q)))
  rw [Finset.range_val] at this
  rw [this, ← Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.eval_T_real_chebyshevZero
statement:
theorem eval_T_real_chebyshevZero (q : ℕ) (k : Fin q) :
    (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (chebyshevZero q k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node (s := Finset.univ) (v := chebyshevZero q)
    (Finset.mem_univ k)
  rw [nodal_chebyshevZero, eval_mul, eval_C] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_nodal_chebyshevZero_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_nodal_chebyshevZero_le (q : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ (chebyshevZero q)).eval x| ≤ 1 / 2 ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodal_chebyshevZero, eval_mul, eval_C, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity)
    (Chebyshev.abs_eval_T_real_le_one _ (abs_le.mpr hx))

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_eval_interpolate_chebyshevZero_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_eval_interpolate_chebyshevZero_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {q : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1) 1))
    (hf' : ∀ k ≤ q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo (-1) 1))
    (hM : ∀ ξ ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, |iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ| ≤ M) :
    ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |f x - (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (chebyshevZero (q + 1))
        (f ∘ chebyshevZero (q + 1))).eval x| ≤ M / (2 ^ q * (q + 1).factorial)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, heq⟩ := exists_sub_eval_interpolate_eq (by norm_num)
    (chebyshevZero_injective _) (chebyshevZero_mem_Icc _) hx hf hf'
  have hω := abs_eval_nodal_chebyshevZero_le (q + 1) hx
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hω
  rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_div, Nat.abs_cast]
  calc |iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ| / (q + 1).factorial *
        |(Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ (chebyshevZero (q + 1))).eval x|
      ≤ M / (q + 1).factorial * (1 / 2 ^ q) := by
        have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM ξ hξ)
        exact mul_le_mul (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hM ξ hξ) (by positivity)) hω
          (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = M / (2 ^ q * (q + 1).factorial) := by
        field_simp

name: NLAlib.nodal_resolvent_eq_sum_basis_div
statement:
theorem nodal_resolvent_eq_sum_basis_div {F : Type*} [Field F] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → F) (hv : Set.InjOn v s) {t x : F}
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, t ≠ v i) (hx : t ≠ x) :
    ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t - (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x) /
      ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x)) =
        ∑ i ∈ s, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x / (t - v i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let l := Lagrange.nodal s v
  let Q := l /ₘ (X - C t)
  have hl : l ≠ 0 := (Lagrange.nodal_monic (s := s) (v := v)).ne_zero
  have hlt : l.eval t ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht i hi))
  have hQdeg : Q.degree < s.card := by
    have h := degree_divByMonic_lt l (X - C t) hl (by simp)
    simpa [l, Lagrange.degree_nodal] using h
  have hQeval (y : F) : l.eval t + (y - t) * Q.eval y = l.eval y := by
    have h := congrArg (fun P : F[X] => P.eval y) (modByMonic_add_div l (X - C t))
    simpa only [modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval, eval_add, eval_C, eval_mul,
      eval_sub, eval_X] using h
  have hRdeg : (C (l.eval t)⁻¹ * Q).degree < s.card :=
    (degree_mul_le_of_le (degree_C_le) (le_refl Q.degree)).trans_lt (by simpa using hQdeg)
  have hR : C (l.eval t)⁻¹ * Q = Lagrange.interpolate s v (fun i => (t - v i)⁻¹) := by
    refine Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ hv hRdeg ?_
    intro i hi
    have h := hQeval (v i)
    rw [show l.eval (v i) = 0 from Lagrange.eval_nodal_at_node hi] at h
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_C]
    field_simp [hlt, sub_ne_zero.mpr (ht i hi)]
    linear_combination -h
  have hRx := congrArg (fun P : F[X] => P.eval x) hR
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum] at hRx
  have hQx := hQeval x
  change (l.eval t - l.eval x) / (l.eval t * (t - x)) = _
  simp only [div_eq_inv_mul]
  rw [← hRx]
  field_simp [hlt, sub_ne_zero.mpr hx]
  linear_combination hQx

name: NLAlib.sphere_ne_of_mem_ball
statement:
private theorem sphere_ne_of_mem_ball {c t x : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Metric.sphere c R) (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R) : t ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  subst t
  exact (ne_of_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx)) (Metric.mem_sphere.mp ht)

name: NLAlib.circleIntegrable_div_sub
proof:
:= by
  exact ((hf.mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall).div
    (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn
    (fun t ht => sub_ne_zero.mpr (sphere_ne_of_mem_ball ht hx))).circleIntegrable hR

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℂ) (hv : Set.InjOn v s) {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c x : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R))
    (hvR : ∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ Metric.ball c R) (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate s v (f ∘ v)).eval x = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      ∮ t in C(c, R), f t *
        (((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t - (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x) /
          ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c R) := by
    simpa only [closure_ball c hR.ne.symm] using hf.continuousOn
  have hInt (i : ι) (h : i ∈ s) := circleIntegrable_div_sub hR.le hc (hvR i h)
  have heq : (∮ t in C(c, R), f t *
        (((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t - (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x) /
          ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x)))) =
        ∮ t in C(c, R), ∑ i ∈ s, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x • (f t / (t - v i)) := by
    refine circleIntegral.integral_congr hR.le ?_
    intro t ht
    dsimp only
    rw [nodal_resolvent_eq_sum_basis_div s v hv
      (fun i hi => sphere_ne_of_mem_ball ht (hvR i hi)) (sphere_ne_of_mem_ball ht hx),
      Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsum := circleIntegral.integral_fun_sum
    (f := fun i t => (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x • (f t / (t - v i)))
    (fun i hi => (hInt i hi).const_smul)
  rw [heq, hsum]
  simp_rw [circleIntegral.integral_smul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hC (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ t in C(c, R), f t / (t - v i)) = f (v i) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul] using
      hf.two_pi_i_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (hvR i hi)
  simp only [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, Function.comp_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [mul_left_comm, hC i hi, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.sub_eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem sub_eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℂ) (hv : Set.InjOn v s) {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c x : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R))
    (hvR : ∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ Metric.ball c R) (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R) :
    f x - (Lagrange.interpolate s v (f ∘ v)).eval x =
      (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∮ t in C(c, R), f t / ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x))
proof:
:= by
  let l := Lagrange.nodal s v
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c R) := by
    simpa only [closure_ball c hR.ne.symm] using hf.continuousOn
  have hlt (t : ℂ) (ht : t ∈ Metric.sphere c R) : l.eval t ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi =>
      sub_ne_zero.mpr (sphere_ne_of_mem_ball ht (hvR i hi))
  have hE : CircleIntegrable (fun t => f t / (l.eval t * (t - x))) c R := by
    refine ((hc.mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall).div
      (l.continuous.continuousOn.mul (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn)
      (fun t ht => mul_ne_zero (hlt t ht)
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr (sphere_ne_of_mem_ball ht hx)))).circleIntegrable hR.le
  have hX := circleIntegrable_div_sub hR.le hc hx
  have hK : (∮ t in C(c, R), f t *
        ((l.eval t - l.eval x) / (l.eval t * (t - x)))) =
      ∮ t in C(c, R), f t / (t - x) - l.eval x • (f t / (l.eval t * (t - x))) := by
    refine circleIntegral.integral_congr hR.le ?_
    intro t ht
    dsimp only
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp [hlt t ht, sub_ne_zero.mpr (sphere_ne_of_mem_ball ht hx)]
  have hP := eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral s v hv hR hf hvR hx
  change (Lagrange.interpolate s v (f ∘ v)).eval x = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    (∮ t in C(c, R), f t * ((l.eval t - l.eval x) / (l.eval t * (t - x)))) at hP
  have hC : (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ t in C(c, R), f t / (t - x)) = f x := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul] using
      hf.two_pi_i_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul hx
  have hIntSub := circleIntegral.integral_sub
    (f := fun t => f t / (t - x))
    (g := fun t => l.eval x • (f t / (l.eval t * (t - x)))) hX hE.const_smul
  rw [hK, hIntSub,
    circleIntegral.integral_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, hC] at hP
  change f x - (Lagrange.interpolate s v (f ∘ v)).eval x =
    l.eval x * (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * _
  rw [hP]
  ring

name: NLAlib.twoSidedSketchEstimate_sub_frobSq
statement:
theorem twoSidedSketchEstimate_sub_frobSq (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (L : Matrix m m ℝ) (R : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    twoSidedSketchEstimate A L R - frobSq A =
      -(Aᵀ * (L - 1) * A * (R - 1)).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hA : frobSq A = (Aᵀ * A).trace := by
    simpa using frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  simp only [twoSidedSketchEstimate, hA, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.trace_sandwich_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem trace_sandwich_eq_sum (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (L : Matrix m m ℝ) (R : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (Aᵀ * L * A * R).trace =
      ∑ i, ∑ l, ∑ k, ∑ j, A j i * L j k * A k l * R l i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Finset.sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_trace_sandwich
statement:
private theorem integrable_trace_sandwich (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {L : Ω → Matrix m m ℝ} {R : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ} (hind : IndepFun L R μ)
    (hL : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => L ω i j) μ)
    (hR : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => R ω i j) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (Aᵀ * L ω * A * R ω).trace) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [trace_sandwich_eq_sum]
  refine integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => ?_
  have hij : IndepFun (fun ω => L ω j k) (fun ω => R ω l i) μ :=
    hind.comp (Matrix.measurable_entry j k) (Matrix.measurable_entry l i)
  have hi := (hij.integrable_mul (hL j k) (hR l i)).const_mul (A j i * A k l)
  exact hi.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by simp only [Pi.mul_apply]; ring)

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_sandwich_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem integral_trace_sandwich_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    {L : Ω → Matrix m m ℝ} {R : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ} (hind : IndepFun L R μ)
    (hL : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => L ω i j) μ)
    (hR : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => R ω i j) μ)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, L ω i j ∂μ = 0) :
    ∫ ω, (Aᵀ * L ω * A * R ω).trace ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hint (i l : n) (k j : m) :
      Integrable (fun ω => A j i * L ω j k * A k l * R ω l i) μ := by
    have hij : IndepFun (fun ω => L ω j k) (fun ω => R ω l i) μ :=
      hind.comp (Matrix.measurable_entry j k) (Matrix.measurable_entry l i)
    have hi := (hij.integrable_mul (hL j k) (hR l i)).const_mul (A j i * A k l)
    exact hi.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by simp only [Pi.mul_apply]; ring)
  simp_rw [trace_sandwich_eq_sum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hint i l k j]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun l _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hint i l k j]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro l _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hint i l k j]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro k _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hint i l k j]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  have hij : IndepFun (fun ω => L ω j k) (fun ω => R ω l i) μ :=
    hind.comp (Matrix.measurable_entry j k) (Matrix.measurable_entry l i)
  simp_rw [show ∀ ω, A j i * L ω j k * A k l * R ω l i =
    (A j i * A k l) * (L ω j k * R ω l i) by intro ω; ring]
  rw [integral_const_mul, hij.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
    (hL j k).aestronglyMeasurable (hR l i).aestronglyMeasurable, hzero]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_twoSidedSketchEstimate
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_twoSidedSketchEstimate
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {L : Ω → Matrix m m ℝ} {R : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hind : IndepFun L R μ)
    (hL : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => L ω i j) μ)
    (hR : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => R ω i j) μ)
    (hmeanL : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, L ω i j ∂μ = (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) i j) :
    Integrable (fun ω => twoSidedSketchEstimate A (L ω) (R ω)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, twoSidedSketchEstimate A (L ω) (R ω) ∂μ) = frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  have hind' : IndepFun (fun ω => L ω - 1) (fun ω => R ω - 1) μ :=
    hind.comp (show Measurable (fun T : Matrix m m ℝ => T - 1) by fun_prop)
      (show Measurable (fun T : Matrix n n ℝ => T - 1) by fun_prop)
  have hL' (i j : m) : Integrable (fun ω => (L ω - 1) i j) μ :=
    (hL i j).sub (integrable_const _)
  have hR' (i j : n) : Integrable (fun ω => (R ω - 1) i j) μ :=
    (hR i j).sub (integrable_const _)
  have hz (i j : m) : ∫ ω, (L ω - 1) i j ∂μ = 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, integral_sub (hL i j) (integrable_const _),
      integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, hmeanL, sub_self]
  have hi := integrable_trace_sandwich A hind' hL' hR'
  have he := integral_trace_sandwich_eq_zero A hind' hL' hR' hz
  have hid (ω : Ω) : twoSidedSketchEstimate A (L ω) (R ω) =
      frobSq A - (Aᵀ * (L ω - 1) * A * (R ω - 1)).trace := by
    linarith [twoSidedSketchEstimate_sub_frobSq A (L ω) (R ω)]
  simp_rw [hid]
  refine ⟨(integrable_const _).sub hi, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hi, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, he, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le
    {m n k t : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    {G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hG.isProbabilityMeasure
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_gaussianRangeFrame_le_bestRankFrobSq A hkt G hG
  have hae : (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (gaussianRangeFrame A t (G ω)) A)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw A G hG,
      ae_project_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw A G hG,
      ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min A G hG] with ω ho hp hr
    rw [rangeProjector_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse,
      one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_residual ho hp (by rw [hr, Fintype.card_fin]) A]
  exact ⟨hi.congr hae, (integral_congr_ae hae).symm.le.trans he⟩

name: NLAlib.measureReal_frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_gt_le_quarter
statement:
theorem measureReal_frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_gt_le_quarter
    {n k : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hk : 0 < k)
    {G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A)} ≤
      (1 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hG.isProbabilityMeasure
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le
    (k := k) A (by omega) hG
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hc : 0 ≤ A.trace ^ 2 / k := by positivity
  have he' : (∫ ω, frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A) ∂μ) ≤
      2 * (A.trace ^ 2 / k) := by
    have hcoeff : 1 + (k : ℝ) / ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) - k - 1) = 2 := by
      push_cast
      have hden : (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1 - k - 1) = k := by ring
      rw [hden, div_self hkR.ne']
      norm_num
    rw [hcoeff] at he
    exact he.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bestRankFrobSq_le_trace_sq_div hA hk) (by norm_num))
  by_cases hc0 : A.trace ^ 2 / k = 0
  · have he0 : (∫ ω, frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A) ∂μ) = 0 := by
      rw [hc0, mul_zero] at he'
      exact le_antisymm he' (integral_nonneg fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _)
    have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun ω => frobSq_nonneg _) hi).1 he0
    have hz : μ {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A)} = 0 := by
      apply measure_mono_null (t := {ω | frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A) ≠ 0})
        _ (ae_iff.mp hae)
      intro ω hω
      have hh : 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k = 0 := by rw [mul_div_assoc, hc0, mul_zero]
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hh] at hω ⊢
      exact ne_of_gt hω
    simp [measureReal_def, hz]
  · have hcp : 0 < A.trace ^ 2 / k := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hc0)
    have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => frobSq_nonneg ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A))
      hi (8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k)
    apply (measureReal_mono (show
      {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A)} ⊆
      {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k ≤ frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G ω)) * A)} from
      fun ω h => show 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k ≤ _ from le_of_lt h)).trans
    rw [mul_div_assoc] at hm ⊢
    have hpos : 0 < 8 * (A.trace ^ 2 / k) := by positivity
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.frobSq_hutchPlusPlusResidual_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_hutchPlusPlusResidual_le {n s : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype s]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) :
    frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) ≤ frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * S)) * A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobSq_mul_le_frobSq_mul_specNorm_sq
    ((1 - rangeProjector (A * S)) * A) (1 - rangeProjector (A * S))
  have hp := specNorm_one_sub_rangeProjector_le_one (A * S)
  have hn := specNorm_nonneg (1 - rangeProjector (A * S))
  have hs : specNorm (1 - rangeProjector (A * S)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  exact h.trans (by nlinarith [frobSq_nonneg ((1 - rangeProjector (A * S)) * A)])

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_quadForm_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem memLp_two_quadForm_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : HasLaw z (gaussianVector n) μ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => quadForm A (z ω)) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  have hl := fun i => hz.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal i
  have h4 (i : n) : MemLp (fun ω => z ω i) 4 μ := by
    have h := memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := 0) (v := 1) 4 (by simp)
    rw [← (hl i).map_eq] at h
    exact (memLp_map_measure_iff aestronglyMeasurable_id (hl i).aemeasurable).1 h
  simp_rw [quadForm_eq_sum]
  refine memLp_finsetSum _ fun i _ => memLp_finsetSum _ fun j _ => ?_
  have : ENNReal.HolderTriple 4 4 2 := ⟨by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (by simp) (by simp)).mp
    norm_num [ENNReal.toReal_add]⟩
  have hij : MemLp (fun ω => z ω i * z ω j) 2 μ := (h4 j).mul' (h4 i)
  exact hij.const_mul (A i j)

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem memLp_two_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => hutchinsonEstimate A (G ω)) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, quadForm_hutchinsonBlock] using
    memLp_two_quadForm_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A)
      (hasLaw_uncurry_gaussianMatrix.comp hG)

name: NLAlib.integral_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix [Nonempty κ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) :
    ∫ ω, hutchinsonEstimate A (G ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, quadForm_hutchinsonBlock, trace_hutchinsonBlock] using
    integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A)
      (hasLaw_uncurry_gaussianMatrix.comp hG)

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_sq_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix [Nonempty κ]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) :
    ∫ ω, (hutchinsonEstimate A (G ω) - A.trace) ^ 2 ∂μ =
      2 * frobSq A / Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  have hB : (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A).IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_blockDiagonal_iff.mpr (fun _ => hA)).smul (by simp)
  have hv := variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector hB
    (hasLaw_uncurry_gaussianMatrix.comp hG)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, quadForm_hutchinsonBlock, frobSq_hutchinsonBlock] at hv
  rw [variance_eq_integral
    (memLp_two_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix A hG).aemeasurable,
    integral_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix A hG] at hv
  exact hv.trans (by ring)

name: NLAlib.hutchPlusPlusBasis_mul_transpose_eq_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem hutchPlusPlusBasis_mul_transpose_eq_rangeProjector
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) :
    hutchPlusPlusBasis A S * (hutchPlusPlusBasis A S)ᵀ = rangeProjector (A * S)
proof:

    (hasOrthonormalCols_hutchPlusPlusBasis A S) (range_hutchPlusPlusBasis A S).symm).symm

name: NLAlib.hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_projector
statement:
theorem hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_projector (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (S : Matrix n s ℝ) (Z : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    hutchPlusPlusEstimate A S Z = (A * rangeProjector (A * S)).trace +
      hutchinsonEstimate (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold hutchPlusPlusEstimate deflatedTraceEstimate
  rw [hutchPlusPlusBasis_mul_transpose_eq_rangeProjector]
  congr 1
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hutchPlusPlusBasis_mul_transpose_eq_rangeProjector,
    Matrix.trace_mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_trace_mul_rangeProjector_add_trace_hutchPlusPlusResidual
statement:
theorem trace_eq_trace_mul_rangeProjector_add_trace_hutchPlusPlusResidual
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) :
    A.trace = (A * rangeProjector (A * S)).trace + (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S).trace
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace_eq_trace_mul_mul_add_trace_sub_mul_mul_sub
    (rangeProjector_mul_self (A * S)) A
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, rangeProjector_mul_self, Matrix.trace_mul_comm] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace
statement:
theorem hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (S : Matrix n s ℝ) (Z : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    hutchPlusPlusEstimate A S Z - A.trace =
      hutchinsonEstimate (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) Z - (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_projector,
    trace_eq_trace_mul_rangeProjector_add_trace_hutchPlusPlusResidual A S]
  ring

name: NLAlib.measurable_hutchPlusPlusResidual
statement:
theorem measurable_hutchPlusPlusResidual (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    Measurable (hutchPlusPlusResidual A : Matrix n s ℝ → Matrix n n ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := measurable_rangeProjector.comp (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id
    : Measurable (fun S : Matrix n s ℝ => A * S))
  have hPe := Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp hP
  apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
  intro i j
  simp only [hutchPlusPlusResidual, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.measurable_hutchPlusPlusEstimate
statement:
theorem measurable_hutchPlusPlusEstimate (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun p : Matrix n s ℝ × Matrix n r ℝ => hutchPlusPlusEstimate A p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_projector]
  have hP := measurable_rangeProjector.comp (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_fst
    : Measurable (fun p : Matrix n s ℝ × Matrix n r ℝ => A * p.1))
  have hC : Measurable (fun p : Matrix n s ℝ × Matrix n r ℝ => hutchPlusPlusResidual A p.1) :=
    (measurable_hutchPlusPlusResidual A).comp measurable_fst
  have htrace : Measurable (fun p : Matrix n s ℝ × Matrix n r ℝ =>
      (A * rangeProjector (A * p.1)).trace) := by
    simp only [Matrix.trace]
    fun_prop
  refine htrace.add ?_
  simp only [hutchinsonEstimate, quadForm_eq_sum, star_trivial]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.run_finiteBlockMultiplyProgram
statement:
private theorem run_finiteBlockMultiplyProgram (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix n s ℝ) :
    (finiteBlockMultiplyProgram B).run A.mulVec = A * B
