name: NLAlib.hutchinsonEstimate_eq_trace_mul
statement:
theorem hutchinsonEstimate_eq_trace_mul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (Z : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    hutchinsonEstimate A Z = (Fintype.card r : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Zᵀ * (A * Z)).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hutchinsonEstimate, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, quadForm, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, star_trivial, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.run_hutchPlusPlusProgram
statement:
theorem run_hutchPlusPlusProgram (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) (Z : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    (hutchPlusPlusProgram S Z).run A.mulVec = hutchPlusPlusEstimate A S Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [hutchPlusPlusProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, QueryProgram.run_map,
    run_finiteBlockMultiplyProgram]
  rw [hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_projector, hutchinsonEstimate_eq_trace_mul]
  congr 1
  · rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← rangeProjector_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  · congr 2
    have hp : (1 - rangeProjector (A * S))ᵀ = 1 - rangeProjector (A * S) := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
        (Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub (rangeProjector_isHermitian (A * S))).eq
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, hp, hutchPlusPlusResidual, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.exists_matvecAlg_hutchPlusPlusEstimate
statement:
theorem exists_matvecAlg_hutchPlusPlusEstimate (S : Matrix n s ℝ) (Z : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    ∃ alg : MatvecAlg ℝ n ℝ,
      alg.cost = 2 * Fintype.card s + Fintype.card r ∧
        ∀ A : Matrix n n ℝ, alg.run A = hutchPlusPlusEstimate A S Z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨_, hutchPlusPlusProgram S Z⟩, ?_, fun A => run_hutchPlusPlusProgram A S Z⟩
  change Fintype.card r + Fintype.card s + Fintype.card s = _
  omega

name: NLAlib.measurable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual
statement:
theorem measurable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun p : Matrix n r ℝ × (n → ℝ) =>
      (p.1ᵀ * A * p.1).trace +
        quadForm ((1 - p.1 * p.1ᵀ) * A * (1 - p.1 * p.1ᵀ)) p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, quadForm_eq_sum, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.integrable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_prod
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : α → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQm : Measurable Q)
    (hQ : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, HasOrthonormalCols (Q s))
    (hw : Integrable (fun w : n → ℝ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2) η) :
    Integrable (fun p : α × (n → ℝ) => ((Q p.1)ᵀ * A * Q p.1).trace +
      quadForm ((1 - Q p.1 * (Q p.1)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Q p.1 * (Q p.1)ᵀ)) p.2) (ν.prod η)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (measurable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual A).comp
    ((hQm.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  refine (((integrable_const (Fintype.card n : ℝ)).add (hw.comp_snd ν)).const_mul
    (specNorm A)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [measurePreserving_fst.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hQ] with p hp
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.add_apply] using
    abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le A hp p.2

name: NLAlib.integrable_deflatedTraceEstimate_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_deflatedTraceEstimate_prod [Nonempty κ]
    {η : Measure (Matrix n κ ℝ)} [IsProbabilityMeasure η]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : α → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQm : Measurable Q)
    (hQ : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, HasOrthonormalCols (Q s))
    (hcol : ∀ k, Integrable (fun Z : Matrix n κ ℝ =>
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Z j k)‖ ^ 2) η) :
    Integrable (fun p : α × Matrix n κ ℝ => deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q p.1) p.2)
      (ν.prod η)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (k : κ) : Integrable (fun p : α × Matrix n κ ℝ =>
      ((Q p.1)ᵀ * A * Q p.1).trace +
        quadForm ((1 - Q p.1 * (Q p.1)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Q p.1 * (Q p.1)ᵀ))
          (fun j => p.2 j k)) (ν.prod η) := by
    have hm := (measurable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual A).comp
      ((hQm.comp measurable_fst).prodMk (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j =>
        (Matrix.measurable_entry j k).comp measurable_snd))
    refine (((integrable_const (Fintype.card n : ℝ)).add
      ((hcol k).comp_snd ν)).const_mul (specNorm A)).mono'
      hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [measurePreserving_fst.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hQ] with p hp
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.add_apply] using
      abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le A hp (fun j => p.2 j k)
  have heq (p : α × Matrix n κ ℝ) : deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q p.1) p.2 =
      (∑ k, (((Q p.1)ᵀ * A * Q p.1).trace +
        quadForm ((1 - Q p.1 * (Q p.1)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Q p.1 * (Q p.1)ᵀ))
          (fun j => p.2 j k))) / Fintype.card κ := by
    have hc : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
    simp only [deflatedTraceEstimate, hutchinsonEstimate, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [heq]
  exact (integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => hterm k).div_const _

name: NLAlib.integrable_norm_toLp_sq_of_second_moments
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_toLp_sq_of_second_moments {w : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hw : AEMeasurable w μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, w ω i * w ω j ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (w ω)‖ ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := integrable_quadForm_of_second_moments (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (z := w) (fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).comp_aemeasurable hw) hsecond
  simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, quadForm, star_trivial,
    Matrix.one_mulVec] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace_of_measurable
statement:
theorem integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace_of_measurable
    [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : α → Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQm : Measurable Q) (hQ : ∀ s, HasOrthonormalCols (Q s))
    {S : Ω → α} {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hS : AEMeasurable S μ)
    (hG : AEMeasurable G μ) (hind : IndepFun S G μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ k i j, ∫ ω, G ω i k * G ω j k ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    ∫ ω, deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q (S ω)) (G ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map S) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hS
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map G) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hG
  apply integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace A hQ hS hG hind hsecond
  have hcol (k : κ) : Integrable (fun Z : Matrix n κ ℝ =>
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Z j k)‖ ^ 2) (μ.map G) := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun Z : Matrix n κ ℝ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Z j k)‖ ^ 2) := by
      fun_prop
    apply (integrable_map_measure hm.aestronglyMeasurable hG).2
    exact integrable_norm_toLp_sq_of_second_moments
      (aemeasurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => (Matrix.measurable_entry i k).comp_aemeasurable hG)
      (hsecond k)
  exact integrable_deflatedTraceEstimate_prod A hQm (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hQ) hcol

name: NLAlib.integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace_of_ae_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace_of_ae_hasOrthonormalCols
    [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : α → Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQm : Measurable Q) {S : Ω → α} {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hS : AEMeasurable S μ) (hG : AEMeasurable G μ) (hind : IndepFun S G μ)
    (hQ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q (S ω)))
    (hsecond : ∀ k i j, ∫ ω, G ω i k * G ω j k ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    ∫ ω, deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q (S ω)) (G ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map S) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hS
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map G) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hG
  have hset : MeasurableSet {s | HasOrthonormalCols (Q s)} := by
    have heq : {s | HasOrthonormalCols (Q s)} =
        ⋂ i, ⋂ j, {s | ((Q s)ᴴ * Q s) i j = (1 : Matrix r r ℝ) i j} := by
      ext s
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
      constructor
      · intro h i j
        exact congrFun (congrFun h.conjTranspose_mul_self i) j
      · intro h
        exact Matrix.ext h
    rw [heq]
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro i
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro j
    exact measurableSet_eq_fun ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp
      ((Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp hQm).matrix_mul hQm)) measurable_const
  have hQo : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ.map S, HasOrthonormalCols (Q s) := (ae_map_iff hS hset).2 hQ
  have hcol (k : κ) : Integrable (fun Z : Matrix n κ ℝ =>
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Z j k)‖ ^ 2) (μ.map G) := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun Z : Matrix n κ ℝ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Z j k)‖ ^ 2) := by
      fun_prop
    apply (integrable_map_measure hm.aestronglyMeasurable hG).2
    exact integrable_norm_toLp_sq_of_second_moments
      (aemeasurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => (Matrix.measurable_entry i k).comp_aemeasurable hG)
      (hsecond k)
  have hint := integrable_deflatedTraceEstimate_prod A hQm hQo hcol
  rw [integral_of_indepFun (g := fun s Z => deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q s) Z) hS hG hind hint]
  have hfixed : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ.map S,
      ∫ Z, deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q s) Z ∂μ.map G = A.trace := by
    filter_upwards [hQo, hint.prod_right_ae] with s hs hi
    rw [integral_map hG hi.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace A hs
      (fun i k => (Matrix.measurable_entry i k).comp_aemeasurable hG) hsecond
  rw [integral_congr_ae hfixed, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.indepFun_leaveOneOutSketch_col
statement:
theorem indepFun_leaveOneOutSketch_col [DecidableEq κ]
    {W : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hW : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω j => W ω j i) μ)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω j => W ω j i) μ) (i : κ) :
    IndepFun (fun ω => leaveOneOutSketch (W ω) i) (fun ω j => W ω j i) μ
proof:
:= by
  let s := Finset.univ.erase i
  let t : Finset κ := {i}
  have hdis : Disjoint s t := by simp [s, t]
  have hi := hind.indepFun_finset₀ s t hdis hW
  let f : (s → (n → ℝ)) → Matrix n {j : κ // j ≠ i} ℝ :=
    fun x k j => x ⟨j.1, by simp [s, j.2]⟩ k
  let g : (t → (n → ℝ)) → (n → ℝ) := fun x => x ⟨i, by simp [t]⟩
  have hf : Measurable f := by
    apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro k j
    exact (measurable_pi_apply k).comp (measurable_pi_apply _)
  have hg : Measurable g := measurable_pi_apply _
  convert hi.comp hf hg using 1 <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace_of_iIndepFun
statement:
theorem integral_leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace_of_iIndepFun
    [Nonempty κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {W : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hW : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω j => W ω j i) μ)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω j => W ω j i) μ)
    {Qf : ∀ i, Matrix n {j : κ // j ≠ i} ℝ → Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQm : ∀ i, Measurable (Qf i))
    (hQ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf i (leaveOneOutSketch (W ω) i)))
    (hsecond : ∀ i j j', ∫ ω, W ω j i * W ω j' i ∂μ = if j = j' then 1 else 0) :
    ∫ ω, leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate A
      (fun i => Qf i (leaveOneOutSketch (W ω) i)) (W ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  let S : ∀ i, Ω → Matrix n {j : κ // j ≠ i} ℝ :=
    fun i ω => leaveOneOutSketch (W ω) i
  have hS (i : κ) : AEMeasurable (S i) μ := by
    apply aemeasurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    apply aemeasurable_pi_lambda
    intro k
    exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp_aemeasurable (hW k.1)
  let D : κ → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => ((Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ * A * Qf i (S i ω)).trace +
    quadForm ((1 - Qf i (S i ω) * (Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ) * A *
      (1 - Qf i (S i ω) * (Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ)) (fun j => W ω j i)
  have hDI (i : κ) : Integrable (D i) μ := by
    have hm := (measurable_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual A).comp_aemeasurable
      (((hQm i).comp_aemeasurable (hS i)).prodMk (hW i))
    refine (((integrable_const (Fintype.card n : ℝ)).add
      (integrable_norm_toLp_sq_of_second_moments (hW i) (hsecond i))).const_mul
      (specNorm A)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hQ i] with ω hω
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.add_apply] using
      abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le A hω (fun j => W ω j i)
  have hDE (i : κ) : ∫ ω, D i ω ∂μ = A.trace := by
    have hr : Measurable (Matrix.replicateCol Unit : (n → ℝ) → Matrix n Unit ℝ) := by
      apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
      intro j k
      exact measurable_pi_apply j
    have hi := (indepFun_leaveOneOutSketch_col hW hind i).comp measurable_id hr
    have h := integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace_of_ae_hasOrthonormalCols
      (κ := Unit) A (hQm i) (hS i) (hr.comp_aemeasurable (hW i)) hi (hQ i)
      (fun _ j k => hsecond i j k)
    simpa [D, deflatedTraceEstimate, hutchinsonEstimate] using h
  change ∫ ω, (∑ i, D i ω) / Fintype.card κ ∂μ = A.trace
  rw [integral_div, integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hDI i]
  simp only [hDE, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hc : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.hutchinsonEstimate_gram
statement:
private theorem hutchinsonEstimate_gram (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (G : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    hutchinsonEstimate (Aᵀ * A) G = frobSq (A * G) / Fintype.card r
proof:
:= by
  rw [hutchinsonEstimate, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  congr 1
  have hq (k : r) : quadForm (Aᵀ * A) (fun i => G i k) =
      ∑ j, (A * G) j k ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, star_trivial,
      dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.mul_apply, pow_two] using
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self A (fun i => G i k)
  simp_rw [hq]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.hutchinsonEstimate_sub
statement:
private theorem hutchinsonEstimate_sub (M B : Matrix n n ℝ) (G : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    hutchinsonEstimate (M - B) G = hutchinsonEstimate M G - hutchinsonEstimate B G
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hutchinsonEstimate, quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]

name: NLAlib.hutchinsonEstimate_smul
statement:
private theorem hutchinsonEstimate_smul (c : ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (G : Matrix n r ℝ) :
    hutchinsonEstimate (c • B) G = c * hutchinsonEstimate B G
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hutchinsonEstimate, quadForm, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: NLAlib.twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate_eq_controlVariate
statement:
theorem twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate_eq_controlVariate (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n r ℝ) (H : Matrix m s ℝ) :
    twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A G H =
      gaussianControlVariateEstimate (Aᵀ * A)
        ((Fintype.card s : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((Hᵀ * A)ᵀ * (Hᵀ * A))) G
proof:
:= by
  have hf (T : Matrix s n ℝ) : (Tᵀ * T).trace = frobSq T := by
    simpa using (frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self T).symm
  rw [gaussianControlVariateEstimate, Matrix.trace_smul, hf,
    hutchinsonEstimate_sub, hutchinsonEstimate_smul,
    hutchinsonEstimate_gram, hutchinsonEstimate_gram]
  simp only [twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.twoSidedGaussian_moments_of_measurable
statement:
private theorem twoSidedGaussian_moments_of_measurable
    (A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v)
    {G : Ω → Matrix (Fin b) (Fin u) ℝ} {H : Ω → Matrix (Fin a) (Fin v) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin b) (Fin u)) μ)
    (hH : HasLaw H (gaussianMatrix (Fin a) (Fin v)) μ)
    (hHm : Measurable H) (hind : IndepFun H G μ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω)) 2 μ ∧
    (∫ ω, twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω) ∂μ) = frobSq A ∧
    Var[fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω); μ] =
      2 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * (frobSq (Aᵀ * A) + frobSq A ^ 2) ∧
    Var[fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω); μ] ≤
      4 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * frobSq A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (Fin u) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hu
  let B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin v) ℝ → Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) ℝ := fun X =>
    (v : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((Xᵀ * A)ᵀ * (Xᵀ * A))
  have hBm : Measurable B := by
    dsimp [B]
    fun_prop
  have hBeq (X : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin v) ℝ) :
      B X = Aᵀ * ((1 / (v : ℝ)) • (X * Xᵀ)) * A := by
    simp only [B, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, one_div]
  have he : ∫ ω, frobSq (Aᵀ * A - B (H ω)) ∂μ =
      (frobSq A * frobSq A + frobSq (Aᵀ * A)) / v := by
    simp_rw [frobSq_sub_comm (Aᵀ * A), hBeq]
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_transpose, frobSq_transpose] using
      (integral_frobSq_mul_gram_mul_transpose_sub_of_hasLaw hH hv Aᵀ Aᵀ).1
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (Aᵀ * A - B (H ω))) μ := by
    by_cases hA : A = 0
    · simp [hA, B]
    · apply Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero
      rw [he]
      have hp : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A)
        (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
      exact (div_pos (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos hp hp) (frobSq_nonneg _))
        (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hv)).ne'
  have hM : (Aᵀ * A).IsHermitian := by
    simpa using Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  have hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (B (H ω)).IsHermitian := ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.smul _ (by simp)
    simpa using Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self ((H ω)ᵀ * A)
  have hInd : IndepFun (fun ω => B (H ω)) G μ := hind.comp hBm measurable_id
  obtain ⟨hLp, hmean, hvar, _⟩ :=
    gaussianControlVariateEstimate_moments_of_indepFun hM (hBm.comp hHm) hB hG hInd hi
  have hest (ω : Ω) : twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω) =
      gaussianControlVariateEstimate (Aᵀ * A) (B (H ω)) (G ω) := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate_eq_controlVariate A (G ω) (H ω)
  change MemLp (fun ω => gaussianControlVariateEstimate (Aᵀ * A) (B (H ω)) (G ω)) 2 μ at hLp
  change (∫ ω, gaussianControlVariateEstimate (Aᵀ * A) (B (H ω)) (G ω) ∂μ) = _ at hmean
  change Var[fun ω => gaussianControlVariateEstimate (Aᵀ * A) (B (H ω)) (G ω); μ] = _ at hvar
  simp_rw [← hest] at hLp hmean hvar
  have htrace : (Aᵀ * A).trace = frobSq A := by
    simpa using (frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self A).symm
  rw [htrace] at hmean
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fintype.card_fin, he] at hvar
  have hvar' : Var[fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω); μ] =
      2 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * (frobSq (Aᵀ * A) + frobSq A ^ 2) := hvar.trans (by ring)
  refine ⟨hLp, hmean, hvar', ?_⟩
  rw [hvar']
  have hle : frobSq (Aᵀ * A) ≤ frobSq A ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [frobSq_transpose, pow_two] using frobSq_mul_le Aᵀ A
  calc
    2 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * (frobSq (Aᵀ * A) + frobSq A ^ 2) ≤
        2 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * (frobSq A ^ 2 + frobSq A ^ 2) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate_moments_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate_moments_of_indepFun
    (A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v)
    {G : Ω → Matrix (Fin b) (Fin u) ℝ} {H : Ω → Matrix (Fin a) (Fin v) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin b) (Fin u)) μ)
    (hH : HasLaw H (gaussianMatrix (Fin a) (Fin v)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun H G μ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω)) 2 μ ∧
    (∫ ω, twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω) ∂μ) = frobSq A ∧
    Var[fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω); μ] =
      2 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * (frobSq (Aᵀ * A) + frobSq A ^ 2) ∧
    Var[fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω); μ] ≤
      4 / ((u : ℝ) * v) * frobSq A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let H' := hH.aemeasurable.mk H
  have hHH : H =ᵐ[μ] H' := hH.aemeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  obtain ⟨hLp, hmean, hvar, hbound⟩ := twoSidedGaussian_moments_of_measurable A hu hv hG
    (hH.congr hHH.symm) hH.aemeasurable.measurable_mk (hind.congr hHH Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl)
  have he : (fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H ω)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω) (H' ω) :=
    hHH.mono fun ω hω => congrArg (twoSidedGaussianFrobEstimate A (G ω)) hω
  exact ⟨(memLp_congr_ae he).2 hLp, (integral_congr_ae he).trans hmean,
    (variance_congr he).trans hvar, (variance_congr he).trans_le hbound⟩

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_trace_mul_mul_add_trace_sub_mul_mul_sub
statement:
theorem trace_eq_trace_mul_mul_add_trace_sub_mul_mul_sub {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : P * P = P)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    A.trace = (P * A * P).trace + ((1 - P) * A * (1 - P)).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (1 - P) * (1 - P) = 1 - P := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, hP]; simp
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hP, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle (1 - P), hQ, ← Matrix.trace_add,
    ← Matrix.add_mul, add_sub_cancel, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.trace_eq_trace_transpose_mul_mul_add
statement:
theorem trace_eq_trace_transpose_mul_mul_add {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    A.trace = (Qᵀ * A * Q).trace + ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hPP : Q * Qᵀ * (Q * Qᵀ) = Q * Qᵀ := mul_conjTranspose_mul_mul_conjTranspose hQ
  have h1 : (Q * Qᵀ * A * (Q * Qᵀ)).trace = (Qᵀ * A * Q).trace := by
    rw [show Q * Qᵀ * A * (Q * Qᵀ) = Q * (Qᵀ * A * Q * Qᵀ) by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc],
      Matrix.trace_mul_comm,
      show Qᵀ * A * Q * Qᵀ * Q = Qᵀ * A * Q * (Qᵀ * Q) by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc],
      show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [trace_eq_trace_mul_mul_add_trace_sub_mul_mul_sub hPP A, h1]

name: NLAlib.integral_hutchinsonEstimate_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_hutchinsonEstimate_eq_trace [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hmeas : ∀ i k, AEMeasurable (fun ω => Z ω i k) μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ k i j, ∫ ω, Z ω i k * Z ω j k ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    ∫ ω, hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hkI := fun k => integrable_quadForm_of_second_moments A
    (z := fun ω i => Z ω i k) (fun i => hmeas i k) (hsecond k)
  have hkE := fun k => integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments A
    (z := fun ω i => Z ω i k) (fun i => hmeas i k) (hsecond k)
  simp only [hutchinsonEstimate]
  rw [integral_div, integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => hkI k]
  simp only [hkE, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_hutchPlusPlusBasis
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_hutchPlusPlusBasis {s : Type*} [Fintype s]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) : HasOrthonormalCols (hutchPlusPlusBasis A S)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix _

name: NLAlib.range_hutchPlusPlusBasis
statement:
theorem range_hutchPlusPlusBasis {s : Type*} [Fintype s]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) :
    LinearMap.range (hutchPlusPlusBasis A S).mulVecLin = LinearMap.range (A * S).mulVecLin
proof:
:=
  range_orthonormalBasisMatrix _

name: NLAlib.card_hutchPlusPlusBasis_le
statement:
theorem card_hutchPlusPlusBasis_le {s : Type*} [Fintype s]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (A * S).mulVecLin))) ≤ Fintype.card s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  exact finrank_range_le_card (R := ℝ) _

name: NLAlib.integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace [Nonempty κ] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hmeas : ∀ i k, AEMeasurable (fun ω => Z ω i k) μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ k i j, ∫ ω, Z ω i k * Z ω j k ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    ∫ ω, deflatedTraceEstimate A Q (Z ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hk := fun k => integrable_quadForm_of_second_moments
    ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) (z := fun ω i => Z ω i k) (fun i => hmeas i k)
      (hsecond k)
  have hint : Integrable (fun ω => hutchinsonEstimate ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) (Z ω))
      μ := by
    simp only [hutchinsonEstimate]
    exact (integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => hk k).div_const _
  simp only [deflatedTraceEstimate]
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hint, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul,
    integral_hutchinsonEstimate_eq_trace _ hmeas hsecond,
    ← trace_eq_trace_transpose_mul_mul_add hQ A]

name: NLAlib.integral_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_trace [Nonempty κ] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {s : Type*} [Fintype s] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ)
    {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hmeas : ∀ i k, AEMeasurable (fun ω => Z ω i k) μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ k i j, ∫ ω, Z ω i k * Z ω j k ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    ∫ ω, hutchPlusPlusEstimate A S (Z ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:=
  integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace A (hasOrthonormalCols_hutchPlusPlusBasis A S)
    hmeas hsecond

name: NLAlib.integral_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    [Nonempty κ] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {s : Type*} [Fintype s]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n s ℝ) {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) :
    ∫ ω, hutchPlusPlusEstimate A S (Z ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_eq_trace A S
  · intro i k
    exact (Matrix.measurable_entry i k).comp_aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable
  · intro k i j
    have h := hZ.integral_comp ((Matrix.measurable_entry i k).mul
      (Matrix.measurable_entry j k)).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact h.trans (by simpa using integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul i j k k)

name: NLAlib.integral_comp_of_indepFun_of_forall_integral_eq
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  rw [integral_of_indepFun hX hY hXY hg]
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.map X), ∫ y, g x y ∂(μ.map Y) = c := by
    filter_upwards [hg.prod_right_ae] with x hx
    rw [integral_map hY hx.aestronglyMeasurable, hc x]
  rw [integral_congr_ae hae, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_comp_eq_trace [Nonempty κ] {α : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace α] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {Q : α → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ s, HasOrthonormalCols (Q s)) {S : Ω → α}
    {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hS : AEMeasurable S μ) (hG : AEMeasurable G μ) (hSG : IndepFun S G μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ k i j, ∫ ω, G ω i k * G ω j k ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hint : Integrable (fun p : α × Matrix n κ ℝ => deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q p.1) p.2)
      ((μ.map S).prod (μ.map G))) :
    ∫ ω, deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q (S ω)) (G ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : ∀ i k, AEMeasurable (fun ω => G ω i k) μ := fun i k =>
    (Matrix.measurable_entry i k).comp_aemeasurable hG
  exact integral_comp_of_indepFun_of_forall_integral_eq (g := fun s Z =>
    deflatedTraceEstimate A (Q s) Z) hS hG hSG hint
    (fun s => integral_deflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace A (hQ s) hmeas hsecond)

name: NLAlib.integral_leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate_eq_trace [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {α : κ → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)]
    {Qf : ∀ i, α i → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ i s, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf i s))
    {S : ∀ i, Ω → α i} {W : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hS : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (S i) μ)
    (hW : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω j => W ω j i) μ)
    (hind : ∀ i, IndepFun (S i) (fun ω j => W ω j i) μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j j', ∫ ω, W ω j i * W ω j' i ∂μ = if j = j' then 1 else 0)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : α i × (n → ℝ) => ((Qf i p.1)ᵀ * A * Qf i p.1).trace +
      quadForm ((1 - Qf i p.1 * (Qf i p.1)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Qf i p.1 * (Qf i p.1)ᵀ)) p.2)
      ((μ.map (S i)).prod (μ.map fun ω j => W ω j i))) :
    ∫ ω, leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate A (fun i => Qf i (S i ω)) (W ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hterm : ∀ i, ∫ ω, (((Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ * A * Qf i (S i ω)).trace +
      quadForm ((1 - Qf i (S i ω) * (Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ) * A * (1 - Qf i (S i ω) * (Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ))
        (fun j => W ω j i)) ∂μ = A.trace := fun i => by
    refine integral_comp_of_indepFun_of_forall_integral_eq (X := S i)
      (Y := fun ω j => W ω j i) (g := fun s w => ((Qf i s)ᵀ * A * Qf i s).trace +
        quadForm ((1 - Qf i s * (Qf i s)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Qf i s * (Qf i s)ᵀ)) w)
      (hS i) (hW i) (hind i) (hint i) fun s => ?_
    have hmeas : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (fun ω => W ω j i) μ := fun j =>
      (measurable_pi_apply j).comp_aemeasurable (hW i)
    have hqI := integrable_quadForm_of_second_moments
      ((1 - Qf i s * (Qf i s)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Qf i s * (Qf i s)ᵀ)) (z := fun ω j => W ω j i)
      hmeas (hsecond i)
    have hqE := integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments
      ((1 - Qf i s * (Qf i s)ᵀ) * A * (1 - Qf i s * (Qf i s)ᵀ)) (z := fun ω j => W ω j i)
      hmeas (hsecond i)
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hqI, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, hqE,
      ← trace_eq_trace_transpose_mul_mul_add (hQ i s) A]
  have hint' : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => ((Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ * A * Qf i (S i ω)).trace +
      quadForm ((1 - Qf i (S i ω) * (Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ) * A * (1 - Qf i (S i ω) * (Qf i (S i ω))ᵀ))
        (fun j => W ω j i)) μ := fun i => by
    have hmap : μ.map (fun ω => (S i ω, fun j => W ω j i)) =
        (μ.map (S i)).prod (μ.map fun ω j => W ω j i) :=
      (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hS i) (hW i)).1 (hind i)
    have h := hint i
    rw [← hmap] at h
    exact h.comp_aemeasurable ((hS i).prodMk (hW i))
  simp only [leaveOneOutDeflatedTraceEstimate]
  rw [integral_div, integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hint' i]
  simp only [hterm, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_integral_spectralMeasure_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_integral_spectralMeasure_eq_trace {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, MemLp (fun ω => z ω i) 2 μ)
    (hind : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IndepFun (fun ω => z ω i) (fun ω => z ω j) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) :
    ∫ ω, (∫ x, f x ∂spectralMeasure hA (z ω)) ∂μ = (cfc f A).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm]
  exact integral_quadForm_eq_trace _ hz hind hmean hsq

name: NLAlib.gaussianControlVariateEstimate_sub_trace
statement:
theorem gaussianControlVariateEstimate_sub_trace (M B : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n κ ℝ) :
    gaussianControlVariateEstimate M B G - M.trace =
      hutchinsonEstimate (M - B) G - (M - B).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianControlVariateEstimate, Matrix.trace_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.measurable_controlVariate
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianControlVariateEstimate, hutchinsonEstimate, quadForm_eq_sum,
    Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_apply]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.integral_controlVariate_fixed
statement:
private theorem integral_controlVariate_fixed [Nonempty κ] (M B : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ∫ G, gaussianControlVariateEstimate M B G ∂gaussianMatrix n κ = M.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hG : HasLaw (id : Matrix n κ ℝ → _) (gaussianMatrix n κ) (gaussianMatrix n κ) :=
    ⟨aemeasurable_id, Measure.map_id⟩
  have hi := (memLp_two_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix (M - B) hG).integrable
    (by norm_num)
  simp only [id_eq] at hi
  have hmean := integral_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix (M - B) hG
  simp only [id_eq] at hmean
  rw [show (fun G => gaussianControlVariateEstimate M B G) =
    (fun G => B.trace + hutchinsonEstimate (M - B) G) from rfl,
    integral_add (integrable_const _) hi,
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul,
    hmean, Matrix.trace_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.controlVariate_product_moments
statement:
private theorem controlVariate_product_moments [Nonempty κ]
    {ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℝ)} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.IsHermitian)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ B ∂ν, B.IsHermitian)
    (hres : Integrable (fun B => frobSq (M - B)) ν) :
    MemLp (fun p : Matrix n n ℝ × Matrix n κ ℝ =>
      gaussianControlVariateEstimate M p.1 p.2) 2 (ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) ∧
    (∫ p, gaussianControlVariateEstimate M p.1 p.2 ∂ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) =
      M.trace ∧
    (∫ p, (gaussianControlVariateEstimate M p.1 p.2 - M.trace) ^ 2
      ∂ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) =
      2 / Fintype.card κ * ∫ B, frobSq (M - B) ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let e : Matrix n n ℝ × Matrix n κ ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
    gaussianControlVariateEstimate M p.1 p.2 - M.trace
  have he : Measurable e := (measurable_controlVariate M).sub_const _
  have hG : HasLaw (id : Matrix n κ ℝ → _) (gaussianMatrix n κ) (gaussianMatrix n κ) :=
    ⟨aemeasurable_id, Measure.map_id⟩
  have hfiber (B : Matrix n n ℝ) : MemLp (fun G => e (B, G)) 2 (gaussianMatrix n κ) := by
    have hi := (memLp_two_hutchinsonEstimate_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix (M - B) hG).sub
      (memLp_const (M - B).trace)
    change MemLp (fun G => hutchinsonEstimate (M - B) G - (M - B).trace) 2
      (gaussianMatrix n κ) at hi
    simpa only [e, gaussianControlVariateEstimate_sub_trace] using hi
  have hsecond : ∀ᵐ B ∂ν, ∫ G, e (B, G) ^ 2 ∂gaussianMatrix n κ =
      2 / Fintype.card κ * frobSq (M - B) := by
    filter_upwards [hB] with B hB
    simpa only [e, gaussianControlVariateEstimate_sub_trace, id_eq] using
      (integral_sq_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix (hM.sub hB) hG).trans
        (by ring)
  have he2 : Integrable (fun p => e p ^ 2) (ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) := by
    apply (integrable_prod_iff (he.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable).2
    refine ⟨ae_of_all _ fun B => (hfiber B).integrable_sq, ?_⟩
    have hi := hres.const_mul (2 / Fintype.card κ)
    apply hi.congr
    filter_upwards [hsecond] with B hB
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq] using hB.symm
  have heLp : MemLp e 2 (ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq he.aestronglyMeasurable).2 he2
  have hFLp : MemLp (fun p : Matrix n n ℝ × Matrix n κ ℝ =>
      gaussianControlVariateEstimate M p.1 p.2) 2 (ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) := by
    have hi := heLp.add (memLp_const M.trace)
    change MemLp (fun p => e p + M.trace) 2 (ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) at hi
    simpa only [e, sub_add_cancel] using hi
  refine ⟨hFLp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [integral_prod _ (hFLp.integrable (by norm_num))]
    simp_rw [integral_controlVariate_fixed]
    simp
  · change ∫ p, e p ^ 2 ∂ν.prod (gaussianMatrix n κ) = _
    rw [integral_prod _ he2, integral_congr_ae hsecond, integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.gaussianControlVariateEstimate_moments_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem gaussianControlVariateEstimate_moments_of_indepFun [Nonempty κ]
    {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.IsHermitian)
    {B : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ} {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hBm : Measurable B) (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (B ω).IsHermitian)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) (hind : IndepFun B G μ)
    (hres : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (M - B ω)) μ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω)) 2 μ ∧
    (∫ ω, gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω) ∂μ) = M.trace ∧
    Var[fun ω => gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω); μ] =
      2 / Fintype.card κ * ∫ ω, frobSq (M - B ω) ∂μ ∧
    μ[fun ω => gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω) |
      MeasurableSpace.comap B inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => M.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hBL : HasLaw B (μ.map B) μ := ⟨hBm.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have hBG := hind.hasLaw_prod hBL hG
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map B) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hBm.aemeasurable
  have hsymm : MeasurableSet {T : Matrix n n ℝ | T.IsHermitian} := by
    have he : {T : Matrix n n ℝ | T.IsHermitian} =
        ⋂ i : n, ⋂ j : n, {T : Matrix n n ℝ | T j i = T i j} := by
      ext T
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, Matrix.IsHermitian.ext_iff, star_trivial]
    rw [he]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter fun j =>
      measurableSet_eq_fun (Matrix.measurable_entry (α := ℝ) j i)
        (Matrix.measurable_entry (α := ℝ) i j)
  have hB' := (ae_map_iff hBm.aemeasurable hsymm).2 hB
  have hmres : Measurable (fun T : Matrix n n ℝ => frobSq (M - T)) := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply]
    fun_prop
  have hres' : Integrable (fun T => frobSq (M - T)) (μ.map B) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hmres.aestronglyMeasurable hBm.aemeasurable).2 hres
  obtain ⟨hLp, hmean, hsecond⟩ := controlVariate_product_moments (κ := κ) hM hB' hres'
  have hLp' : MemLp (fun ω => gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω)) 2 μ := by
    have h := hLp
    rw [← hBG.map_eq] at h
    exact h.comp_of_map hBG.aemeasurable
  have hmean' : (∫ ω, gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω) ∂μ) = M.trace :=
    (hBG.integral_comp hLp.aestronglyMeasurable).trans hmean
  refine ⟨hLp', hmean', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [variance_eq_integral hLp'.aemeasurable, hmean']
    have hm := ((measurable_controlVariate (κ := κ) M).sub_const M.trace).pow_const 2
    rw [show (∫ ω, (gaussianControlVariateEstimate M (B ω) (G ω) - M.trace) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∫ p, (gaussianControlVariateEstimate M p.1 p.2 - M.trace) ^ 2
        ∂((μ.map B).prod (gaussianMatrix n κ)) from hBG.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable,
      hsecond]
    congr 1
    exact (hBL.integral_comp hmres.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
  · exact hind.condExp_comp_eq_const hBm hG (hLp.integrable (by norm_num))
      (ae_of_all _ fun T => integral_controlVariate_fixed M T)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_columnBlock
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_columnBlock {n b t : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [Fintype b] [Fintype t] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Matrix n (b × t) ℝ) (a : b) :
    frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * S)) * A) ≤
      frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * Matrix.of (fun i j => S i (a, j)))) * A)
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : rangeProjector (A * S) * (A * Matrix.of (fun i j => S i (a, j))) =
      A * Matrix.of (fun i j => S i (a, j)) := by
    ext i j
    exact congrArg (fun M => M i (a, j)) (rangeProjector_mul (A * S))
  simpa only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul] using
    frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_mul_eq hfix A

name: NLAlib.measureReal_frobSq_hutchPlusPlusResidual_gt_le_pow_quarter
statement:
theorem measureReal_frobSq_hutchPlusPlusResidual_gt_le_pow_quarter
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {n k L : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hk : 0 < k)
    {S : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin L × Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ}
    (hS : HasLaw S (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin L × Fin (2 * k + 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A (S ω))} ≤
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hS.isProbabilityMeasure
  let B : Fin L → Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun a ω => Matrix.of fun i j => S ω i (a, j)
  let E : Set (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ) :=
    {G | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G)) * A)}
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := by
    have hP := measurable_rangeProjector.comp
      (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id :
        Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ => A * G)
    have hF : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ =>
        frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector (A * G)) * A)) :=
      measurable_frobSq.comp (by
        apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
        have hp := Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp hP
        intro i j
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
        fun_prop)
    exact measurableSet_lt measurable_const hF
  have hind := iIndepFun_gaussianMatrix_columnBlocks hS
  have hsingle (a : Fin L) : μ (B a ⁻¹' E) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    have h := measureReal_frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_gt_le_quarter hA hk
      (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_columnBlock hS a)
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ (B a ⁻¹' E))]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h
  have hsub : {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A (S ω))} ⊆
      ⋂ a, B a ⁻¹' E := by
    intro ω hω
    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
    intro a
    exact hω.trans_le ((frobSq_hutchPlusPlusResidual_le A (S ω)).trans
      (frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_columnBlock A (S ω) a))
  have hbound : μ {ω | 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k < frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A (S ω))} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ L) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ μ (⋂ a, B a ⁻¹' E) := measure_mono hsub
      _ = ∏ a, μ (B a ⁻¹' E) := hind.meas_iInter (fun _ => ⟨E, hE, rfl⟩)
      _ ≤ ∏ _a : Fin L, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => zero_le) (fun a _ => hsingle a)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
          ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4)]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) hbound

name: NLAlib.quadForm_hutchinsonBlock
statement:
theorem quadForm_hutchinsonBlock (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (Z : Matrix n κ ℝ) :
    quadForm (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A) (fun e => Z e.1 e.2) = hutchinsonEstimate A Z
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ (i : n) (k : κ) (j : n), ∑ l : κ,
      (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)⁻¹ * (if k = l then A i j else 0) * (Z i k * Z j l) =
        (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)⁻¹ * (A i j * (Z i k * Z j k)) := fun i k j => by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k (fun l _ hl => by simp [Ne.symm hl]) (by simp)]
    simp only [if_true]; ring
  rw [quadForm_eq_sum, hutchinsonEstimate, div_eq_inv_mul]
  simp only [hutchinsonBlock, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, quadForm_eq_sum, star_trivial, h]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_hutchinsonBlock
statement:
theorem frobSq_hutchinsonBlock [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    frobSq (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A) = frobSq A / Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have h : ∀ (i : n) (k : κ) (j : n), ∑ l : κ, (if k = l then A i j else 0) ^ 2 = A i j ^ 2 :=
    fun i k j => by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k (fun l _ hl => by simp [Ne.symm hl]) (by simp)]
      simp
  rw [hutchinsonBlock, frobSq_smul, frobSq_eq_sum_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, h, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_hutchinsonBlock_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_hutchinsonBlock_le (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    specNorm (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A) ≤ specNorm A / Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hutchinsonBlock, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, ← specNorm_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)), div_eq_inv_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (specNorm_blockDiagonal_const_le A)
    (inv_nonneg.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.trace_hutchinsonBlock
statement:
theorem trace_hutchinsonBlock [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A).trace = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [hutchinsonBlock, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_blockDiagonal]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.hutchinsonBlock_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma hutchinsonBlock_ne_zero [Nonempty κ] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ : ∃ i j, A i j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hA (Matrix.ext h)
  obtain ⟨k⟩ := ‹Nonempty κ›
  have hm : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero)
  intro h0
  have := congrFun (congrFun h0 (i, k)) (j, k)
  simp [hutchinsonBlock, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, hij, hm] at this

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_uncurry_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasLaw_uncurry_gaussianMatrix :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix n κ ℝ => fun e : n × κ => G e.1 e.2) (gaussianVector (n × κ))
      (gaussianMatrix n κ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(measurable_pi_lambda (fun (G : Matrix n κ ℝ) (e : n × κ) => G e.1 e.2)
      fun e => Matrix.measurable_entry e.1 e.2).aemeasurable,
    gaussianMatrix_map_uncurry⟩

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_integral_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_integral_le [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun (e : n × κ) ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ e : n × κ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) - ∫ ω', hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω') ∂μ|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
          (Fintype.card κ * t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)))
proof:
:= by
  set m : ℝ := (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) with hmdef
  have hm : 0 < m := Nat.cast_pos.2 Fintype.card_pos
  by_cases hA0 : A = 0
  · subst hA0
    have h1 : μ.real {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) (Z ω) -
        ∫ ω', hutchinsonEstimate (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) (Z ω') ∂μ|} ≤ 1 := measureReal_le_one
    have hF : frobNorm (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) = 0 := by
      rw [frobNorm_eq_zero_iff]
    have hS : specNorm (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) = 0 := specNorm_zero
    simp only [hF, hS]
    norm_num
    exact h1.trans (by norm_num)
  have h := hanson_wright_mgf (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A) (fun (e : n × κ) ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) K hK
    hind hmgf t ht
  simp only [quadForm_hutchinsonBlock] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  gcongr 2 * exp ?_
  rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_min (le_of_eq ?_) ?_) (by positivity)
  · rw [frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_hutchinsonBlock, ← hmdef, mul_div_assoc',
      div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_comm m]
  · have hB : 0 < specNorm (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A) := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_pos_iff.mpr (hutchinsonBlock_ne_zero hA0)
    have hle := specNorm_hutchinsonBlock_le (κ := κ) A
    rw [← hmdef] at hle
    calc m * t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A) = t / (K ^ 2 * (specNorm A / m)) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm (hutchinsonBlock (κ := κ) A)) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ht (by positivity)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (by positivity))

name: NLAlib.nnreal_one_sq
statement: private lemma nnreal_one_sq : (⟨(1 : ℝ) ^ 2, sq_nonneg 1⟩ : NNReal) = 1
proof: := by ext; simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix [Nonempty κ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) - A.trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * t ^ 2 / frobNorm A ^ 2) (Fintype.card κ * t / specNorm A))
proof:
:= by
  have hflat : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => Z ω e.1 e.2) (gaussianVector (n × κ)) μ :=
    hasLaw_uncurry_gaussianMatrix.comp hZ
  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (e : n × κ) ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) μ :=
    hflat.iIndepFun_eval_of_gaussianVector
  have hlaw : ∀ e : n × κ, HasLaw (fun ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) (gaussianReal 0 1) μ := fun e =>
    hflat.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal e
  have hmean : ∫ ω, hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) ∂μ = A.trace := by
    simp_rw [← quadForm_hutchinsonBlock]
    rw [integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector _ hflat, trace_hutchinsonBlock]
  have h := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_integral_le A 1 one_pos hind
    (fun e => by rw [nnreal_one_sq]; exact hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hlaw e)) t ht
  simpa [hmean] using h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
    [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hZ : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => Z ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) - A.trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * t ^ 2 / frobNorm A ^ 2) (Fintype.card κ * t / specNorm A))
proof:
:= by
  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (e : n × κ) ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) μ :=
    hZ.iIndepFun_eval_of_rademacherVector
  have hlaw : ∀ e : n × κ, HasLaw (fun ω => Z ω e.1 e.2) rademacherMeasure μ := fun e =>
    hZ.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure e
  have hmean : ∫ ω, hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) ∂μ = A.trace := by
    simp_rw [← quadForm_hutchinsonBlock]
    rw [integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector _ hZ, trace_hutchinsonBlock]
  have h := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_integral_le A 1 one_pos hind
    (fun e => by
      rw [nnreal_one_sq]; exact hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hlaw e)) t ht
  simpa [hmean] using h

name: NLAlib.mul_sq_le_min_hutchinson_exponent_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem mul_sq_le_min_hutchinson_exponent_of_posSemidef [Nonempty κ]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (htr : 0 < A.trace) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 ≤ min (Fintype.card κ * (ε * A.trace) ^ 2 / frobNorm A ^ 2)
      (Fintype.card κ * (ε * A.trace) / specNorm A)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card κ := Nat.cast_pos.2 Fintype.card_pos
  have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at htr
  have hF : 0 < frobNorm A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobNorm_nonneg A)
    (Ne.symm fun h => hA0 ((frobNorm_eq_zero_iff A).1 h))
  have hS : 0 < specNorm A := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_pos_iff.mpr hA0
  have hFt := frobNorm_le_trace_of_posSemidef hA
  have hSt := specNorm_le_trace_of_posSemidef hA
  refine le_min ?_ ?_
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have : frobNorm A ^ 2 ≤ A.trace ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hF.le hFt 2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2)]
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hS]
    have h1 : ε ^ 2 ≤ ε := by nlinarith
    have h2 : Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 * specNorm A ≤ Fintype.card κ * ε * A.trace := by
      have := mul_le_mul h1 hSt hS.le hε.le
      nlinarith
    linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_mul_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_mul_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    [Nonempty κ] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (htr : 0 < A.trace)
    {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ} (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * A.trace ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) - A.trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix A hZ
    (ε * A.trace) (by positivity)).trans ?_
  gcongr 2 * exp ?_
  have h := mul_sq_le_min_hutchinson_exponent_of_posSemidef (κ := κ) hA htr hε hε1
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2) := by positivity
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hc
  rw [neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff]
  calc Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2) = 1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2) *
        (Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := this

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_le_card
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_le_card [Nonempty κ]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (htr : 0 < A.trace) {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hm : 256 * exp 1 ^ 2 * Real.log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card κ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * A.trace ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) - A.trace|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  refine (measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_mul_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    hA htr hZ hε hε1).trans ?_
  have hlog : Real.log (2 / δ) ≤ Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hm
    linarith
  calc 2 * exp (-(Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)))
      ≤ 2 * exp (-Real.log (2 / δ)) := by gcongr
    _ = δ := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.hutchPlusPlusRank_pos_and_one_le_mul
statement:
theorem hutchPlusPlusRank_pos_and_one_le_mul {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < hutchPlusPlusRank ε ∧ 1 ≤ ε * hutchPlusPlusRank ε
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.le_ceil (1 / ε)
  refine ⟨Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (by positivity), ?_⟩
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp h
  simpa [hutchPlusPlusRank, mul_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.pow_quarter_hutchPlusPlusBlocks_le
statement:
theorem pow_quarter_hutchPlusPlusBlocks_le {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ hutchPlusPlusBlocks δ ≤ δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : 0 < log (4 : ℝ) := log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hL := (div_le_iff₀ h4).mp (Nat.le_ceil (log (2 / δ) / log 4))
  have he : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ hutchPlusPlusBlocks δ =
      exp (-((hutchPlusPlusBlocks δ : ℝ) * log 4)) := by
    rw [neg_mul_eq_mul_neg, exp_nat_mul, exp_neg, exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]
    simp only [one_div]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ exp (-log (2 / δ)) := exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hL)
    _ = δ / 2 := by rw [exp_neg, exp_log (by positivity)]; field_simp

name: NLAlib.hutchPlusPlusProbes_pos_and_tail_le
statement:
theorem hutchPlusPlusProbes_pos_and_tail_le {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    0 < hutchPlusPlusProbes ε δ ∧
      2 * exp (-((hutchPlusPlusProbes ε δ : ℝ) * ε / (2048 * exp 1 ^ 2))) ≤ δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hl : 0 < log (4 / δ) := log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ).2 (by linarith))
  have hc : 0 < 2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 / ε * log (4 / δ) := by positivity
  refine ⟨Nat.ceil_pos.mpr hc, ?_⟩
  have hr := Nat.le_ceil (2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 / ε * log (4 / δ))
  have hC : 0 < 2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hrl : log (4 / δ) ≤ hutchPlusPlusProbes ε δ * ε / (2048 * exp 1 ^ 2) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hC).2
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr hε.le
    dsimp only [hutchPlusPlusProbes]
    convert hh using 1
    field_simp
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * exp (-log (4 / δ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hrl)) (by norm_num)
    _ = δ / 2 := by rw [exp_neg, exp_log (by positivity)]; field_simp; ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_budget
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_budget
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {S : Ω → Matrix (Fin n)
      (Fin (hutchPlusPlusBlocks δ) × Fin (2 * hutchPlusPlusRank ε + 1)) ℝ}
    {Z : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (hutchPlusPlusProbes ε δ)) ℝ}
    (hS : HasLaw S (gaussianMatrix (Fin n)
      (Fin (hutchPlusPlusBlocks δ) × Fin (2 * hutchPlusPlusRank ε + 1))) μ)
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (hutchPlusPlusProbes ε δ))) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Z S μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * A.trace < |hutchPlusPlusEstimate A (S ω) (Z ω) - A.trace|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hkε⟩ := hutchPlusPlusRank_pos_and_one_le_mul hε
  obtain ⟨hr, hrt⟩ := hutchPlusPlusProbes_pos_and_tail_le hε hδ hδ1
  have h := measureReal_abs_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le hA hk hr hε hε1 hkε hS hZ hind
  have hL := pow_quarter_hutchPlusPlusBlocks_le hδ
  linarith

name: NLAlib.hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget_le
statement:
theorem hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget_le {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget ε δ : ℝ) ≤
      (10 * (log (2 / δ) / log 4 + 1) + 2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 * log (4 / δ) + 1) / ε
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (hutchPlusPlusRank ε : ℝ) ≤ 2 / ε := by
    have hh := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / ε)).le
    dsimp only [hutchPlusPlusRank]
    have he : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by simpa using hε1)
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] at hh he ⊢
    linarith
  have hl : 0 ≤ log (2 / δ) / log 4 := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact (log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ).2 (by linarith))).le
    · exact (log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 4)).le
  have hL : (hutchPlusPlusBlocks δ : ℝ) ≤ log (2 / δ) / log 4 + 1 :=
    (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hl).le
  have hr : (hutchPlusPlusProbes ε δ : ℝ) ≤ 2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 / ε * log (4 / δ) + 1 :=
    (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      (log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ).2 (by linarith))).le)).le
  have hw : 2 * (hutchPlusPlusRank ε : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 5 / ε := by
    have he : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by simpa using hε1)
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] at hk he ⊢
    linarith
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hL hw (by positivity) (by linarith : 0 ≤ log (2 / δ) / log 4 + 1)
  unfold hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget
  push_cast
  have he : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by simpa using hε1)
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] at hr hprod he ⊢
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget_le
statement:
theorem exists_hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget_le :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε δ : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → 0 < δ → δ < 1 →
      (hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget ε δ : ℝ) ≤ C / ε * (1 + log (1 / δ))
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := 10 / log 4 + 2048 * exp 1 ^ 2
  let b : ℝ := 10 * log 2 / log 4 + 11 + 2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 * log 4
  have hl4 : 0 < log (4 : ℝ) := log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hl2 : 0 < log (2 : ℝ) := log_pos (by norm_num)
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  refine ⟨a + b, add_pos ha hb, ?_⟩
  intro ε δ hε hε1 hδ hδ1
  have hx : 0 ≤ log (1 / δ) := (log_pos ((one_lt_div hδ).2 hδ1)).le
  have h2 : log (2 / δ) = log 2 + log (1 / δ) := by
    rw [log_div (by norm_num) hδ.ne', log_div one_ne_zero hδ.ne', log_one, zero_sub]
    ring
  have h4 : log (4 / δ) = log 4 + log (1 / δ) := by
    rw [log_div (by norm_num) hδ.ne', log_div one_ne_zero hδ.ne', log_one, zero_sub]
    ring
  apply (hutchPlusPlusQueryBudget_le hε hε1 hδ hδ1).trans
  rw [h2, h4]
  have he : 10 * ((log 2 + log (1 / δ)) / log 4 + 1) +
      2048 * exp 1 ^ 2 * (log 4 + log (1 / δ)) + 1 = a * log (1 / δ) + b := by
    dsimp [a, b]
    ring
  rw [he, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hε.le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb.le hx]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_frobSq_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hZ.isProbabilityMeasure
  by_cases hC0 : C = 0
  · subst C
    have hempty : {ω | ε * T < |hutchinsonEstimate (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) (Z ω) -
        (0 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|} = ∅ := by
      ext ω
      simp [hutchinsonEstimate, quadForm, not_lt.mpr (mul_nonneg hε.le hT)]
    rw [hempty, measureReal_empty]
    positivity
  have hF : 0 < frobNorm C := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobNorm_nonneg C)
    (Ne.symm fun h => hC0 ((frobNorm_eq_zero_iff C).1 h))
  have hN : 0 < specNorm C := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_pos_iff.mpr hC0
  have hTs : 0 < T := by
    have hf := frobNorm_sq C
    nlinarith
  have hbound : specNorm C ≤ 8 * T := by
    have hs := specNorm_le_frobNorm C
    have hfs := frobNorm_sq C
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε1 (sq_nonneg T)]
  have hfirst : (Fintype.card r : ℝ) * ε / 8 ≤
      Fintype.card r * (ε * T) ^ 2 / frobNorm C ^ 2 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hF)).2
    rw [frobNorm_sq]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC
      (show 0 ≤ (Fintype.card r : ℝ) * ε / 8 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hsecond : (Fintype.card r : ℝ) * ε / 8 ≤
      Fintype.card r * (ε * T) / specNorm C := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hN).2
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound
      (show 0 ≤ (Fintype.card r : ℝ) * ε / 8 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have ht := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    C hZ (ε * T) (mul_nonneg hε.le hT)
  apply (measureReal_mono (show {ω | ε * T < |hutchinsonEstimate C (Z ω) - C.trace|} ⊆
    {ω | ε * T ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate C (Z ω) - C.trace|} from
    fun ω h => show ε * T ≤ _ from le_of_lt h)).trans
  apply ht.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
  apply exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hmin := le_min hfirst hsecond
  have hpos : 0 < (1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2) : ℝ) := by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ -(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) * (Fintype.card r * ε / 8) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hmin (neg_nonpos.mpr hpos.le)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le
    {n k L r : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hr : 0 < r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hkε : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε * k)
    {S : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin L × Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ}
    {Z : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ}
    (hS : HasLaw S (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin L × Fin (2 * k + 1))) μ)
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin r)) μ) (hind : IndepFun Z S μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * A.trace < |hutchPlusPlusEstimate A (S ω) (Z ω) - A.trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((r : ℝ) * ε / (2048 * exp 1 ^ 2))) + (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hS.isProbabilityMeasure
  let : Nonempty (Fin r) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hr
  let E : Set (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ ×
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin L × Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ) :=
    {p | ε * A.trace < |hutchPlusPlusEstimate A p.2 p.1 - A.trace|}
  let G : Set (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin L × Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ) :=
    {S | frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) ≤ 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k}
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_lt measurable_const
    (((measurable_hutchPlusPlusEstimate A).comp measurable_swap).sub measurable_const).abs
  have hG : MeasurableSet G := measurableSet_le
    (measurable_frobSq.comp (measurable_hutchPlusPlusResidual A)) measurable_const
  apply hind.measureReal_mem_le_add hZ.aemeasurable hS.aemeasurable hE hG (by positivity)
  · intro S hgood
    have hc : frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) ≤ 8 * ε * A.trace ^ 2 := by
      have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
      have hdiv : (1 : ℝ) / k ≤ ε := (div_le_iff₀ hkR).2 hkε
      change frobSq (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) ≤ 8 * A.trace ^ 2 / k at hgood
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv
        (show 0 ≤ 8 * A.trace ^ 2 by positivity)
      exact hgood.trans (by simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_assoc,
        mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hh)
    have ht := measureReal_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_frobSq_le
      (hutchPlusPlusResidual A S) hZ (Matrix.PosSemidef.trace_nonneg hA) hε hε1 hc
    simpa only [E, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hutchPlusPlusEstimate_sub_trace, Fintype.card_fin] using ht
  · simpa only [G, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_le] using
      measureReal_frobSq_hutchPlusPlusResidual_gt_le_pow_quarter hA hk hS

name: NLAlib.ae_hutchinsonEstimate_one_eq_card_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ e : n × κ, G ω e.1 e.2 ^ 2 = 1 :=
    (ae_all_iff).mpr fun e =>
      (ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hG.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure e)).mono
        fun ω h => by rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]
  filter_upwards [hsq] with ω hω
  rw [hutchinsonEstimate_one]
  have hn : ∀ k : κ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => G ω i k)‖ ^ 2 = Fintype.card n := by
    intro k
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    change (∑ i : n, G ω i k * G ω i k) = Fintype.card n
    simp_rw [← sq]
    calc (∑ i : n, G ω i k ^ 2) = ∑ _i : n, (1 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hω (i, k))
      _ = Fintype.card n := by simp
  simp only [hn, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := κ))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k))
    {q : ℕ} (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Polynomial ℝ} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) {a c E : ℝ}
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c)
    (hfp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a c, |f x - p.eval x| ≤ E) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    μ.real {ω | η + 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * η ^ 2 / frobNorm (cfc f A) ^ 2)
          (Fintype.card κ * η / specNorm (cfc f A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := ae_hutchinsonEstimate_one_eq_card_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector hG
  have hsub : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ {ω | η + 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} →
      ω ∈ {ω | η ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (cfc f A) (G ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} := by
    filter_upwards [hnorm] with ω hω
    intro hbad
    have hdet := abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_hutchinsonEstimate_le
      hA (G ω) (hQ ω) (hK ω) hp hspec hfp
    rw [hω] at hdet
    have htri := abs_sub_le (compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω))
      (hutchinsonEstimate (cfc f A) (G ω)) (cfc f A).trace
    change η + 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace| at hbad
    change η ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (cfc f A) (G ω) - (cfc f A).trace|
    nlinarith
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top μ _)
    (measure_mono_ae hsub)).trans
    (measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector (cfc f A) hG η hη)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : (cfc f A).PosSemidef)
    (htr : 0 < (cfc f A).trace) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k))
    {q : ℕ} (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {p : Polynomial ℝ} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) {a c E : ℝ}
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c)
    (hfp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a c, |f x - p.eval x| ≤ E) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hbudget : 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E ≤ (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * (cfc f A).trace <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (1024 * exp 1 ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector hA hG hQ hK
    hp hspec hfp (η := (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace) (by positivity)
  have hsub : {ω | ε * (cfc f A).trace <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ⊆
      {ω | (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace + 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E <
        |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} := by
    intro ω hω
    change ε * (cfc f A).trace < _ at hω
    change (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace + 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E < _
    linarith
  refine ((measureReal_mono hsub).trans hraw).trans ?_
  gcongr 2 * exp ?_
  have h := mul_sq_le_min_hutchinson_exponent_of_posSemidef (κ := κ) hF htr
    (show 0 < ε / 2 by positivity) (show ε / 2 ≤ 1 by linarith)
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hc
  rw [neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff]
  calc Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (1024 * exp 1 ^ 2) =
      (1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) * (Fintype.card κ * (ε / 2) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := hh

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_of_le_card
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_of_le_card
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : (cfc f A).PosSemidef)
    (htr : 0 < (cfc f A).trace) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k))
    {q : ℕ} (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {p : Polynomial ℝ} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) {a c E : ℝ}
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c)
    (hfp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a c, |f x - p.eval x| ≤ E) {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbudget : 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E ≤ (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace)
    (hm : 1024 * exp 1 ^ 2 * log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card κ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * (cfc f A).trace <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  refine (measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
    hA hF htr hG hQ hK hp hspec hfp hε hε1 hbudget).trans ?_
  have hlog : log (2 / δ) ≤ Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (1024 * exp 1 ^ 2) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hm
    linarith
  calc 2 * exp (-(Fintype.card κ * ε ^ 2 / (1024 * exp 1 ^ 2))) ≤
        2 * exp (-log (2 / δ)) := by gcongr
    _ = δ := by rw [exp_neg, exp_log (by positivity)]; field_simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitzOnWith
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k)) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a c : ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    μ.real {ω | η + Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * η ^ 2 / frobNorm (cfc f A) ^ 2)
          (Fintype.card κ * η / specNorm (cfc f A)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval hac hf (2 * q - 1)
  have hdeg : p.degree < 2 * q := hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 < 2 * q by omega))
  have h := measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
    hA hG hQ hK hdeg hspec hfp hη
  have hcast : ((2 * q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = 2 * (q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 + 1 = 2 * q by omega)
  rw [hcast] at h
  have hthresh : η + 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * (2 * q))) =
      η + Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) := by ring
  simpa only [hthresh] using h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitz_order
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitz_order
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k)) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a c : ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hsteps : Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) / (2 * ε) ≤ q) :
    μ.real {ω | ε < |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * (ε / 2) ^ 2 / frobNorm (cfc f A) ^ 2)
          (Fintype.card κ * (ε / 2) / specNorm (cfc f A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitzOnWith
    hA hG hQ hq hK hac hspec hf (η := ε / 2) (by positivity)
  have hbudget : Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 4 * q by omega))]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hsteps
    nlinarith
  refine (measureReal_mono ?_).trans hraw
  intro ω hω
  change ε < _ at hω
  change ε / 2 + Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) < _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitz_order
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lipschitz_order
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : (cfc f A).PosSemidef)
    (htr : 0 < (cfc f A).trace) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k)) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {a c : ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c))
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsteps : Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) /
      (2 * ε * (cfc f A).trace) ≤ q)
    (hm : 1024 * exp 1 ^ 2 * log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card κ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * (cfc f A).trace <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval hac hf (2 * q - 1)
  have hdeg : p.degree < 2 * q := hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 < 2 * q by omega))
  apply measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_of_le_card hA hF htr
    hG hQ hK hdeg hspec hfp hε hε1 hδ _ hm
  have hcast : ((2 * q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = 2 * (q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 + 1 = 2 * q by omega)
  rw [hcast]
  have hbudget : Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) ≤
      (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 4 * q by omega))]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hsteps
    nlinarith
  convert hbudget using 1

statement:
theorem abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_inv_sub_hutchinsonEstimate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (G : Matrix n κ ℝ) {Q : κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q k)) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : ∀ k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q k).mulVecLin) :
    |compressionQuadratureEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) G Q - hutchinsonEstimate (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A) G| ≤
      2 * ((2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ (2 * q)) *
        hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpdeg, hpE⟩ := exists_degree_lt_abs_eval_sub_inv_le (2 * q) ha hab
  exact abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_hutchinsonEstimate_le hA G hQ hK hpdeg hspec
