name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_inv_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_inv_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix [Nonempty n]
    [Nonempty κ] [DecidableEq κ] {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k)) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {t s : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    μ.real {ω | t + 2 * ((2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ (2 * q)) * (Fintype.card n + s) ≤
        |compressionQuadratureEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) (Q ω) -
          (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A).trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min (Fintype.card κ * t ^ 2 / frobNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A) ^ 2)
            (Fintype.card κ * t / specNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A))) +
        2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min (Fintype.card κ * s ^ 2 / Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card κ * s))
proof:
:= by
  set E := (2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ (2 * q)
  set F := cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ √b - √a := sub_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hab.le)
    have h2 : 0 < √b + √a := by positivity
    positivity
  
  have hsub : {ω | t + 2 * E * (Fintype.card n + s) ≤
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) (Q ω) - F.trace|} ⊆
      {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace|} ∪
        {ω | s ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_or, not_le] at hnot hω
    have hdet := abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_inv_sub_hutchinsonEstimate_le hA ha hab hspec (G ω) (hQ ω)
      (hK ω)
    have htr : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace = Fintype.card n := by simp
    rw [htr] at hnot
    have h1 : hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) < Fintype.card n + s := by
      have := (abs_lt.1 hnot.2).2; linarith
    have h2 : 2 * E * hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) ≤
        2 * E * (Fintype.card n + s) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.le (by positivity)
    have h3 : |compressionQuadratureEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) (Q ω) - F.trace| ≤
        |compressionQuadratureEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) (Q ω) - hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω)| +
          |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    linarith [hnot.1]
  have hF := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix F hG t ht
  have hI := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) hG s hs
  
  have hspec1 : 0 < specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (norm_pos_iff.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≠ 0))
  have hI' : 2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * s ^ 2 / frobNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ^ 2)
          (Fintype.card κ * s / specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * s ^ 2 / Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card κ * s)) := by
    rw [frobNorm_one_sq]
    gcongr 2 * exp ?_
    rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_min le_rfl ?_) (by positivity)
    calc (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * s = Fintype.card κ * s / 1 := (div_one _).symm
      _ ≤ Fintype.card κ * s / specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hspec1 specNorm_one_le
  calc μ.real {ω | t + 2 * E * (Fintype.card n + s) ≤
        |compressionQuadratureEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) (Q ω) - F.trace|}
      ≤ μ.real ({ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace|} ∪
          {ω | s ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) -
            (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|}) := measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace|} +
          μ.real {ω | s ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) -
            (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|} := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hF (hI.trans hI')

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_abs_slqEstimate_inv_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_abs_slqEstimate_inv_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix [Nonempty n]
    [Nonempty κ] [DecidableEq κ] {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n κ) μ)
    (q : ℕ)
    {t s : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    μ.real {ω | t + 2 * ((2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ (2 * q)) * (Fintype.card n + s) ≤
        |slqEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) q -
          (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A).trace|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min (Fintype.card κ * t ^ 2 / frobNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A) ^ 2)
            (Fintype.card κ * t / specNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A))) +
        2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min (Fintype.card κ * s ^ 2 / Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card κ * s))
proof:
:= by
  set E := (2 / a) * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ (2 * q)
  set F := cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) A
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ √b - √a := sub_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hab.le)
    have h2 : 0 < √b + √a := by positivity
    positivity
  
  have hsub : {ω | t + 2 * E * (Fintype.card n + s) ≤
      |slqEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) q - F.trace|} ⊆
      {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace|} ∪
        {ω | s ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_or, not_le] at hnot hω
    have hdet := abs_slqEstimate_inv_sub_hutchinsonEstimate_le hA ha hab hspec (G ω) q
    have htr : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace = Fintype.card n := by simp
    rw [htr] at hnot
    have h1 : hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) < Fintype.card n + s := by
      have := (abs_lt.1 hnot.2).2; linarith
    have h2 : 2 * E * hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) ≤
        2 * E * (Fintype.card n + s) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.le (by positivity)
    have h3 : |slqEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) q - F.trace| ≤
        |slqEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) q - hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω)| +
          |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    linarith [hnot.1]
  have hF := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix F hG t ht
  have hI := measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) hG s hs
  
  have hspec1 : 0 < specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (norm_pos_iff.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≠ 0))
  have hI' : 2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * s ^ 2 / frobNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ^ 2)
          (Fintype.card κ * s / specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (Fintype.card κ * s ^ 2 / Fintype.card n) (Fintype.card κ * s)) := by
    rw [frobNorm_one_sq]
    gcongr 2 * exp ?_
    rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_min le_rfl ?_) (by positivity)
    calc (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * s = Fintype.card κ * s / 1 := (div_one _).symm
      _ ≤ Fintype.card κ * s / specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hspec1 specNorm_one_le
  calc μ.real {ω | t + 2 * E * (Fintype.card n + s) ≤
        |slqEstimate A (fun x : ℝ => 1 / x) (G ω) q - F.trace|}
      ≤ μ.real ({ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace|} ∪
          {ω | s ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) -
            (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|}) := measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate F (G ω) - F.trace|} +
          μ.real {ω | s ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) (G ω) -
            (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).trace|} := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hF (hI.trans hI')

statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_lower_bound
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {G : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => G ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {Q : Ω → κ → Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : ∀ ω k, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω k)) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : ∀ ω k, krylovSpace A (fun i => G ω i k) q ≤ LinearMap.range (Q ω k).mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Polynomial ℝ} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) {a c E b : ℝ}
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hmin : ∀ x ∈ Icc a c, b ≤ f x) (hfp : ∀ x ∈ Icc a c, |f x - p.eval x| ≤ E)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbudget : E ≤ ε * b / 4)
    (hm : 1024 * exp 1 ^ 2 * log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card κ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε * (cfc f A).trace <
      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hF := posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues hA (fun i => hb.le.trans (hmin _ (hspec i)))

    simpa only [RCLike.re_to_real] using
      mul_card_le_re_trace_cfc_of_le hA (fun i => hmin _ (hspec i))
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have htr : 0 < (cfc f A).trace := (mul_pos hb hn).trans_le htrle
  apply measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_of_le_card
    hA hF htr hG hQ hK hp hspec hfp hε hε1 hδ _ hm
  calc 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * E ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * (ε * b / 4) := by
        gcongr
    _ = (ε / 2) * (b * Fintype.card n) := by ring
    _ ≤ (ε / 2) * (cfc f A).trace := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htrle (by positivity)

    (hm : 1024 * exp 1 ^ 2 * log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card κ) :

      |compressionQuadratureEstimate A f (G ω) (Q ω) - (cfc f A).trace|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
    hac hρ hFd hM hmatch (2 * q - 1)
  have hdeg : p.degree < 2 * q := hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 < 2 * q by omega))
  exact measureReal_abs_compressionQuadratureEstimate_sub_trace_gt_mul_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector_of_le_card hA hF htr
    hG hQ hK hdeg hspec hfp hε hε1 hδ (by convert hsteps using 1; ring) hm

name: NLAlib.one_sub_filter_mean_le_four_div_sq
statement:
theorem one_sub_filter_mean_le_four_div_sq (d g : ι → ℝ) {H : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hHtop : H ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), g i ^ 2) (k : ℕ) {ℓ : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hLog : Real.log ((∑ i, g i ^ 2) / H) ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log 2) :
    1 - (∑ i, d i * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) /
      (∑ i, ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) ≤
        4 / (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D := ∑ i, ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2 with hDdef
  set G := ∑ i, g i ^ 2 with hGdef
  set δ := 2 / (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) with hδdef
  have hHD : H ≤ D := by
    refine hHtop.trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), g i ^ 2
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1),
            ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2, eval_evenChebyshevFilter_one, one_pow, one_pow, one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          (fun i _ _ => by positivity)
  have hHG : H ≤ G :=
    hHtop.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun i _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  have hD : 0 < D := hH.trans_le hHD
  have hG : 0 < G := hH.trans_le hHG
  have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := by rw [hδdef]; positivity
  have hRatio : G / H ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
    apply (Real.log_le_log_iff (div_pos hG hH) (by positivity)).mp
    rw [Real.log_pow]
    exact hLog
  have hEnergy : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * G ≤ H := by
    have ht := (div_le_iff₀ hH).mp hRatio
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ ℓ)).mp
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * G) = G := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
        norm_num
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * H := ht
  have hNum : D - (∑ i, d i * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) ≤
      δ * D + δ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * G := by
    rw [hDdef, hGdef]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (one_sub_mul_eval_evenChebyshevFilter_pow_sq_le (hd i) k hℓ) (sq_nonneg (g i))
    rw [hδdef]
    nlinarith
  have hNum' : D - (∑ i, d i * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) ≤
      2 * δ * D := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEnergy hδ
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHD hδ
    nlinarith
  have hResult : 1 - (∑ i, d i * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) / D ≤
      2 * δ := by
    rw [show 1 - (∑ i, d i * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) / D =
      (D - (∑ i, d i * ((evenChebyshevFilter k).eval (d i) ^ ℓ) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2)) / D by
        rw [sub_div, div_self hD.ne']]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hD).mpr
    nlinarith [hNum']
  rw [hδdef] at hResult
  convert hResult using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_filter_mean_le_log_sq
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_filter_mean_le_log_sq (d g : ι → ℝ) {H : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hHtop : H ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), g i ^ 2) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.natDegree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 1 = 1 ∧
      1 - (∑ i, d i * p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) / (∑ i, p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * g i ^ 2) ≤
        4 * (1 + Real.log ((∑ i, g i ^ 2) / H) / Real.log 2) ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L := Real.log ((∑ i, g i ^ 2) / H) with hLdef
  set ℓ := max 1 ⌈L / Real.log 2⌉₊ with hℓdef
  set k := q / ℓ with hkdef
  have hh : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hEnergy : H ≤ ∑ i, g i ^ 2 :=
    hHtop.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun i _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hH).mpr (by simpa only [one_mul] using hEnergy))
  have hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ := le_max_left _ _
  have hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ := by omega
  have hLog : L ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    have hc := Nat.le_ceil (L / Real.log 2)
    have hm : (⌈L / Real.log 2⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := by exact_mod_cast (le_max_right 1 _)
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hh).mp (hc.trans hm)
  have hℓUpper : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + L / Real.log 2 := by
    rw [hℓdef, Nat.cast_max]
    apply max_le
    · linarith [div_nonneg hL hh.le]
    · have h := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg hL hh.le)
      linarith
  have hDegree : ℓ * k ≤ q := by rw [hkdef]; exact Nat.mul_div_le _ _
  have hWidth : q ≤ ℓ * (2 * k + 1) := by
    have ht : q < (k + 1) * ℓ := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hℓ0).mp (Nat.lt_succ_self k)
    have hu : (k + 1) * ℓ ≤ (2 * k + 1) * ℓ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ℓ (by omega)
    exact ht.le.trans (hu.trans_eq (Nat.mul_comm _ _))
  refine ⟨evenChebyshevFilter k ^ ℓ,
    (natDegree_pow_le_of_le ℓ (natDegree_evenChebyshevFilter_le k)).trans hDegree,
    by simp only [eval_pow, eval_evenChebyshevFilter_one, one_pow], ?_⟩
  have h := one_sub_filter_mean_le_four_div_sq d g hd hH hHtop k hℓ hLog
  simp only [eval_pow]
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hw : (q : ℝ) ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) * ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hWidth
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ hm.le hw 2
  rw [mul_pow] at hs
  calc
    4 / (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ 4 * (ℓ : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hC) (sq_pos_of_pos hm)).mpr
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg ℓ) hℓUpper 2

name: NLAlib.lanczosRayleighRelativeError_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem lanczosRayleighRelativeError_zero (b : ι → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRayleighRelativeError (0 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) b q = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lanczosRayleighRelativeError, specNorm_zero, div_zero]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRayleighRelativeError_nonneg
statement:
theorem lanczosRayleighRelativeError_nonneg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (lanczosRitzValue_le_specNorm A b _)) (specNorm_nonneg A)

name: NLAlib.lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_one
statement:
theorem lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_one {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (b : ι → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hL : specNorm A = 0
  · simp only [lanczosRayleighRelativeError, hL, div_zero, zero_le_one]
  · have hLp : 0 < specNorm A := (specNorm_nonneg A).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hL)
    rw [lanczosRayleighRelativeError, div_le_one hLp]
    linarith [lanczosRitzValue_nonneg hA b (q + 1)]

name: NLAlib.measurable_lanczosRayleighRelativeError
statement:
theorem measurable_lanczosRayleighRelativeError {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (q : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun b : ι → ℝ => lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q)
proof:
:=
  (measurable_const.sub (measurable_lanczosRitzValue hA (q + 1))).div_const _

name: NLAlib.lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_log_sq
statement:
theorem lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_log_sq [Nonempty ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hL : 0 < specNorm A) {u : ι → ℝ}
    (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u) (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1)
    {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q ≤
      4 * (1 + Real.log (‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) / Real.log 2) ^ 2 /
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hH := hA.isHermitian
  set L := specNorm A with hLdef
  have hL0 : hH.eigenvalues₀ 0 = L := hA.specNorm_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero.symm
  let c := fun i => (hH.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b
  let a := fun i => (hH.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ u
  let d := fun i => hH.eigenvalues i / L
  have hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := fun i => by
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) hL.le
    · apply (div_le_one hL).mpr
      rw [← hL0]; exact hH.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero i
  
  have hHtop : (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), c i ^ 2 := by
    have huu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hu1, one_pow]
    have haa : ∑ i, a i ^ 2 = 1 := by
      show ∑ i, ((hH.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 = 1
      rw [sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hH u, huu]
    have hub : u ⬝ᵥ b = ∑ i, a i * c i :=
      dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul hH u b
    have hzero : ∀ i, d i ≠ 1 → a i = 0 := fun i hi => by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1
        (eigenvalues_sub_mul_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq_zero hH hu i) with h | h
      · exact absurd (show d i = 1 by
          show hH.eigenvalues i / L = 1
          rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h, hL0]; exact div_self hL.ne') hi
      · exact h
    have hsum : ∑ i, a i * c i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), a i * c i := by
      have hz : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i ≠ 1), a i * c i = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by rw [hzero i (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2, zero_mul]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (fun i => d i = 1), hz, add_zero]
    rw [hub, hsum]
    refine (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_of_le_one_left (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) ?_
    rw [← haa]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun i _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hHpos : 0 < (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨p, hpDegree, hpOne, hpMean⟩ :=
    exists_polynomial_filter_mean_le_log_sq d c hd hHpos hHtop hq
  let P := p.comp (C (L⁻¹) * X)
  have hpEval : ∀ i, P.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) = p.eval (d i) := by
    intro i
    simp only [P, eval_comp, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, d, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [mul_comm L⁻¹]
  have hPDegree : P.natDegree ≤ q := by
    have hX : (C (L⁻¹) * X : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 :=
      natDegree_C_mul_le _ _ |>.trans natDegree_X_le
    exact natDegree_comp_le.trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left p.natDegree hX).trans
      (by simpa only [mul_one] using hpDegree))
  let y := aeval A P *ᵥ b
  have hy : y ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1) := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b (q + 1) _).mpr
    ⟨P, (degree_le_of_natDegree_le hPDegree).trans_lt
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self q), rfl⟩
  have hD : y ⬝ᵥ y = ∑ i, p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [y, hpEval] using dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum hH P b
  have hN : y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) = L * (∑ i, d i * p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) := by
    have h := quadForm_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hH P b
    change y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) =
      ∑ i, hH.eigenvalues i * P.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 at h
    rw [h, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [hpEval]
    simp only [d]
    field_simp
  have hDp : 0 < ∑ i, p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 := by
    refine hHpos.trans_le (hHtop.trans ?_)
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), c i ^ 2
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 1), p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2, hpOne, one_pow, one_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          (fun i _ _ => by positivity)
  have hRQ : rayleighQuotient A y =
      L * ((∑ i, d i * p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) / (∑ i, p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2)) := by
    rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div, hN, hD, mul_div_assoc]
  have hCompare := rayleighQuotient_le_lanczosRitzValue_of_mem hA b (q + 1) hy
  have hError : lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q ≤
      1 - (∑ i, d i * p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) / (∑ i, p.eval (d i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) := by
    rw [hRQ] at hCompare
    rw [lanczosRayleighRelativeError, ← hLdef]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hL).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hParseval : (∑ i, c i ^ 2) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    exact sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hH b
  rw [hParseval] at hpMean
  exact hError.trans hpMean

name: NLAlib.integral_lanczosRayleighRelativeError_gaussianVector_le
statement:
theorem integral_lanczosRayleighRelativeError_gaussianVector_le {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (∫ b, lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q ∂(gaussianVector ι)) ≤
      min 1 (4 * ((Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2 + Real.log 2) ^ 2 + 4) /
        ((Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector ι
  let T := Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
  let h := Real.log 2
  let m := (q : ℝ)
  have hh : 0 < h := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hm : 0 < m := by dsimp only [m]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
  have hfm := measurable_lanczosRayleighRelativeError hA.isHermitian q
  have hfi : Integrable (fun b => lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' hfm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun b => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (lanczosRayleighRelativeError_nonneg A b q)]
      exact lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_one hA b q
  have hOne : (∫ b, lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q ∂μ) ≤ 1 := by
    have hBound := integral_mono hfi (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
      (fun b => lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_one hA b q)
    simpa only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] using hBound
  apply le_min hOne
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · have hzero : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hzero]
    simp only [lanczosRayleighRelativeError_zero, integral_zero]
    positivity
  by_cases hZero : specNorm A = 0
  · simp only [lanczosRayleighRelativeError, hZero, div_zero, integral_zero]
    positivity
  · have hL : 0 < specNorm A := (specNorm_nonneg A).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hZero)
    have hH := hA.isHermitian
    set i₀ : ι := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) (0 : Fin (Fintype.card ι))
    set u : ι → ℝ := (hH.eigenvectorBasis i₀ : ι → ℝ)
    have hu : A *ᵥ u = hH.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u := by
      rw [← hH.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq]
      exact hH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i₀
    have hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 := by
      have := hH.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i₀
      simpa [u] using this
    let C := fun b : ι → ℝ => fun i => (hH.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b
    let Lf := fun c : ι → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2)
    have hMP : MeasurePreserving C μ μ :=
      measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_gaussianVector hH
    have hLm : Measurable Lf := by dsimp only [Lf]; fun_prop
    have hL2m : Measurable (fun c => Lf c ^ 2) := hLm.pow_const 2
    obtain ⟨hLI, hLV, hLI2, hLV2⟩ := log_overlap_moments_gaussianVector (ι := ι) i₀
    have hLCI : Integrable (fun b => Lf (C b)) μ := by
      apply (integrable_map_measure hLm.aestronglyMeasurable hMP.measurable.aemeasurable).mp
      rwa [hMP.map_eq]
    have hLCI2 : Integrable (fun b => Lf (C b) ^ 2) μ := by
      apply (integrable_map_measure hL2m.aestronglyMeasurable hMP.measurable.aemeasurable).mp
      rwa [hMP.map_eq]
    have hLCV : (∫ b, Lf (C b) ∂μ) ≤ T + 2 := by
      have he := integral_map (μ := μ) hMP.measurable.aemeasurable hLm.aestronglyMeasurable
      rw [hMP.map_eq] at he
      exact he.symm.trans_le hLV
    have hLCV2 : (∫ b, Lf (C b) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ T ^ 2 + 4 * T + 8 := by
      have he := integral_map (μ := μ) hMP.measurable.aemeasurable hL2m.aestronglyMeasurable
      rw [hMP.map_eq] at he
      exact he.symm.trans_le hLV2
    let F := fun b : ι → ℝ => (1 + Lf (C b) / h) ^ 2
    have hFEq : ∀ b, F b = (Lf (C b) ^ 2 + 2 * h * Lf (C b) + h ^ 2) / h ^ 2 := by
      intro b
      dsimp only [F]
      field_simp [hh.ne']
      ring
    have hFI : Integrable F μ := by
      have hsum : Integrable (fun b => Lf (C b) ^ 2 + 2 * h * Lf (C b) + h ^ 2) μ :=
        (hLCI2.add (hLCI.const_mul (2 * h))).add (integrable_const _)
      exact (hsum.div_const (h ^ 2)).congr (ae_of_all _ fun b => (hFEq b).symm)
    have hFV : (∫ b, F b ∂μ) ≤ ((T + 2 + h) ^ 2 + 4) / h ^ 2 := by
      have he : (∫ b, F b ∂μ) =
          ((∫ b, Lf (C b) ^ 2 ∂μ) + 2 * h * (∫ b, Lf (C b) ∂μ) + h ^ 2) / h ^ 2 := by
        have hsI : Integrable (fun b => Lf (C b) ^ 2 + 2 * h * Lf (C b)) μ :=
          hLCI2.add (hLCI.const_mul (2 * h))
        have hAdd : (∫ b, Lf (C b) ^ 2 + 2 * h * Lf (C b) + h ^ 2 ∂μ) =
            (∫ b, Lf (C b) ^ 2 + 2 * h * Lf (C b) ∂μ) + ∫ _ : ι → ℝ, h ^ 2 ∂μ :=
          integral_add hsI (integrable_const (h ^ 2))
        have hAdd2 : (∫ b, Lf (C b) ^ 2 + 2 * h * Lf (C b) ∂μ) =
            (∫ b, Lf (C b) ^ 2 ∂μ) + ∫ b, 2 * h * Lf (C b) ∂μ :=
          integral_add hLCI2 (hLCI.const_mul (2 * h))
        rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hFEq), integral_div, hAdd, hAdd2, integral_const_mul]
        simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
      rw [he]
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
      have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLCV (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * h)
      nlinarith
    have hNZ := ae_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_ne_zero_gaussianVector hH i₀
    have hPoint : (fun b => lanczosRayleighRelativeError A b q) ≤ᵐ[μ]
        fun b => 4 * F b / m ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [hNZ] with b hb
      have hs := lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_log_sq hA hL hu hu1 hb hq
      rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hH b] at hs
      exact hs
    have hBound := integral_mono_ae hfi ((hFI.const_mul 4).div_const (m ^ 2)) hPoint
    rw [integral_div, integral_const_mul] at hBound
    refine hBound.trans ?_
    have hb := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFV (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)) (sq_nonneg m)
    refine hb.trans_eq ?_
    dsimp only [T, h, m]
    ring

name: NLAlib.integral_lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_lanczosRayleighRelativeError_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {G : Ω → ι → ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    (∫ ω, lanczosRayleighRelativeError A (G ω) q ∂μ) ≤
      min 1 (4 * ((Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2 + Real.log 2) ^ 2 + 4) /
        ((Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∫ ω, lanczosRayleighRelativeError A (G ω) q ∂μ) = _ :=
    hG.integral_comp (measurable_lanczosRayleighRelativeError hA.isHermitian q).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact he.trans_le (integral_lanczosRayleighRelativeError_gaussianVector_le hA hq)

name: NLAlib.powerRayleighRelativeError_zero

name: NLAlib.powerRayleighRelativeError_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerRayleighRelativeError_nonneg {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (b : ι → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.powerRayleighRelativeError_le_one
statement:
theorem powerRayleighRelativeError_le_one {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (b : ι → ℝ)
    (q : ℕ) : powerRayleighRelativeError A b q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hL : specNorm A = 0
  · simp only [powerRayleighRelativeError, hL, div_zero, zero_le_one]
  · have hLp : 0 < specNorm A := (specNorm_nonneg A).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hL)
    have h0 : 0 ≤ rayleighQuotient A ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) := by
      rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div]
      refine div_nonneg ?_ (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
      simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b)
    rw [powerRayleighRelativeError, div_le_one hLp]
    linarith

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_gaussianVector
    (v : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun g : ι → ℝ => WithLp.ofLp (v.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 g)))
      (gaussianVector ι) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : Measurable (fun g : ι → ℝ => WithLp.toLp 2 g) := by fun_prop
  have hm2 : Measurable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => v.repr x) :=
    v.repr.continuous.measurable
  have hm3 : Measurable (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => WithLp.ofLp y) := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨hm3.comp (hm2.comp hm1), ?_⟩
  have h := map_pi_eq_stdGaussian (ι := ι)
  have hfun : (fun g : ι → ℝ => WithLp.ofLp (v.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 g)))
      = (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => WithLp.ofLp y) ∘ ((fun x => v.repr x) ∘
          (fun g : ι → ℝ => WithLp.toLp 2 g)) := rfl
  rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map hm3 (hm2.comp hm1), ← Measure.map_map hm2 hm1, h]
  rw [show (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => v.repr x) = ⇑v.repr from rfl, stdGaussian_map,
    ← h, Measure.map_map hm3 (by fun_prop)]
  exact Measure.map_id

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_gaussianVector {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun b : ι → ℝ => fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b)
      (gaussianVector ι) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have h := measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_gaussianVector hA.eigenvectorBasis
  have he : (fun b : ι → ℝ => WithLp.ofLp (hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 b))) =
      fun b : ι → ℝ => fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b := by
    funext b i
    rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    simp only [star_trivial]
    exact dotProduct_comm _ _
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.ae_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_ne_zero_gaussianVector
proof:
:= by
  let := nullSingletonClass_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) (by norm_num)
  have hMP := (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1) i).comp
    (measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_gaussianVector hA)
  have h := (gaussianReal 0 1).ae_ne 0
  rw [← hMP.map_eq] at h
  exact ae_of_ae_map hMP.measurable.aemeasurable h

name: NLAlib.log_overlap_moments_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem log_overlap_moments_gaussianVector [Nonempty ι] (i₀ : ι) :
    Integrable (fun c : ι → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2)) (gaussianVector ι) ∧
    (∫ c, Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2) ∂(gaussianVector ι)) ≤
      Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2 ∧
    Integrable (fun c : ι → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2) ^ 2)
      (gaussianVector ι) ∧
    (∫ c, Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianVector ι)) ≤
      Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 8
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, Fintype.card ι = m + 1 :=
    ⟨Fintype.card ι - 1, by have := Fintype.card_pos (α := ι); omega⟩
  set e : ι ≃ Fin (m + 1) := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hm
  set F : (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) :=
    fun x => MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : ι => ℝ) e.symm x
  have hF : MeasurePreserving F (gaussianVector (Fin (m + 1))) (gaussianVector ι) :=
    measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1) e.symm
  have hFapp : ∀ (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : ι), F x i = x (e i) := fun x i => by
    simp only [F]
    conv_lhs => rw [show i = e.symm (e i) from (e.symm_apply_apply i).symm]
    exact MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply e.symm (β := fun _ : ι => ℝ) x (e i)
  have hcomp : ∀ x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ,
      Real.log ((∑ i, F x i ^ 2) / (F x i₀) ^ 2) =
        Real.log ((∑ j, x j ^ 2) / (x (e i₀)) ^ 2) := fun x => by
    simp only [hFapp]
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp e (fun j => x j ^ 2)]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_log_sum_div_sq_pi_gaussianReal_le m (e i₀)
  have hcard : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by rw [hm]
  have hL1 : Integrable (fun c : ι → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2))
      (gaussianVector ι) := by
    rw [← hF.map_eq]
    refine (integrable_map_measure ?_ hF.measurable.aemeasurable).2 ?_
    · exact (Measurable.log (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact h1.congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => (hcomp x).symm)
  have hL2 : Integrable (fun c : ι → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2) ^ 2)
      (gaussianVector ι) := by
    rw [← hF.map_eq]
    refine (integrable_map_measure ?_ hF.measurable.aemeasurable).2 ?_
    · exact ((Measurable.log (by fun_prop)).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact h3.congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => by rw [Function.comp_apply, hcomp x])
  refine ⟨hL1, ?_, hL2, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hF.map_eq, integral_map hF.measurable.aemeasurable
      (Measurable.log (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp_rw [hcomp]
    rw [← hcard]; exact h2
  · rw [← hF.map_eq, integral_map hF.measurable.aemeasurable
      ((Measurable.log (by fun_prop)).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp_rw [hcomp]
    rw [← hcard]; exact h4

name: Matrix.PosSemidef.specNorm_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosSemidef.specNorm_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero [Nonempty ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : specNorm A = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues hA.isHermitian]
  have hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := hA.eigenvalues_nonneg
  have htop : ∀ i, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 :=
    hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero
  have h0 : 0 ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›; exact (hnn i).trans (htop i)
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg h0]
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hnn i)]
    exact htop i
  · have := norm_le_pi_norm hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) 0)
    rwa [hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq, Real.norm_of_nonneg h0] at this

name: NLAlib.integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_gaussianVector_le
statement:
theorem integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_gaussianVector_le {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (q : ℕ) :
    (∫ b, powerRayleighRelativeError A b q ∂(gaussianVector ι)) ≤
      min 1 ((Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2) / ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector ι
  let T := Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
  let r := ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp only [r]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < 2 * q + 1)
  have hfm := measurable_powerRayleighRelativeError A q
  have hfi : Integrable (fun b => powerRayleighRelativeError A b q) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' hfm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun b => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (powerRayleighRelativeError_nonneg hA b q)]
      exact powerRayleighRelativeError_le_one hA b q
  have hOne : (∫ b, powerRayleighRelativeError A b q ∂μ) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := integral_mono hfi (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
      (fun b => powerRayleighRelativeError_le_one hA b q)
    simpa only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] using h
  apply le_min hOne
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · have hzero : A = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hzero]
    simp only [powerRayleighRelativeError_zero, integral_zero]
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T + 2 := by
      simp only [T, Fintype.card_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, Real.log_zero]; norm_num
    exact div_nonneg this hr.le
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    linarith
  by_cases hZero : specNorm A = 0
  · simp only [powerRayleighRelativeError, hZero, div_zero, integral_zero]
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hr.le
  · have hL : 0 < specNorm A := (specNorm_nonneg A).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hZero)
    set i₀ : ι := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) (0 : Fin (Fintype.card ι))
    have h₀ : hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀ = specNorm A := by
      rw [hA.specNorm_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq]
    let C := fun b : ι → ℝ => fun i => (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b
    have hMP : MeasurePreserving C μ μ :=
      measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_gaussianVector hA.isHermitian
    let L := fun c : ι → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (c i₀) ^ 2)
    have hLm : Measurable L := by dsimp only [L]; fun_prop
    obtain ⟨hLI, hLV, _, _⟩ := log_overlap_moments_gaussianVector (ι := ι) i₀
    have hLCI : Integrable (fun b => L (C b)) μ := by
      apply (integrable_map_measure hLm.aestronglyMeasurable hMP.measurable.aemeasurable).mp
      rwa [hMP.map_eq]
    have hLCV : (∫ b, L (C b) ∂μ) ≤ T + 2 := by
      have h := integral_map (μ := μ) hMP.measurable.aemeasurable hLm.aestronglyMeasurable
      rw [hMP.map_eq] at h
      exact h.symm.trans_le hLV
    have hNZ : ∀ᵐ b ∂μ, C b i₀ ≠ 0 :=
      ae_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_ne_zero_gaussianVector hA.isHermitian i₀
    have hPoint : (fun b => powerRayleighRelativeError A b q) ≤ᵐ[μ] fun b => L (C b) / r := by
      filter_upwards [hNZ] with b hb
      have h := sub_rayleighQuotient_pow_div_specNorm_le_log_overlap_div hA hL i₀ h₀ b hb q
      rw [← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA.isHermitian b] at h
      simpa only [powerRayleighRelativeError, rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_eq] using h
    have h := integral_mono_ae hfi (hLCI.div_const r) hPoint
    rw [integral_div] at h
    exact h.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hLCV hr.le)

name: NLAlib.integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (q : ℕ) {G : Ω → ι → ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    (∫ ω, powerRayleighRelativeError A (G ω) q ∂μ) ≤
      min 1 ((Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2) / ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∫ ω, powerRayleighRelativeError A (G ω) q ∂μ) = _ :=
    hG.integral_comp (measurable_powerRayleighRelativeError A q).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact h.trans_le (integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_gaussianVector_le hA q)

name: NLAlib.integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_le_three_log_div
statement:
theorem integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_le_three_log_div
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι)
    {G : Ω → ι → ℝ} (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    (∫ ω, powerRayleighRelativeError A (G ω) q ∂μ) ≤
      3 * Real.log (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / q
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
  have hn2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by linarith
  have hlog2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have hlogn : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hn2
  have hT : Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2 ≤ 6 * Real.log (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hn0.ne']
    linarith
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < 2 * q + 1)
  have hc : (Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) + 2) / ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      3 * Real.log (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / q := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hr hq0).mpr
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT hq0.le
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  exact ((integral_powerRayleighRelativeError_le_of_hasLaw hA q hG).trans
    (min_le_right _ _)).trans hc

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : HasLaw z (gaussianVector n) μ) :
    ∫ ω, quadForm A (z ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:=
  integral_quadForm_eq_trace A (fun i => memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hz.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal i))
    (fun _ _ hij => hz.iIndepFun_eval_of_gaussianVector.indepFun hij)
    (fun i => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hz.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal i))
    (fun i => integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hz.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal i))

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector

theorem integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : HasLaw z (rademacherVector n) μ) :
    ∫ ω, quadForm A (z ω) ∂μ = A.trace
proof:
:=
  integral_quadForm_eq_trace A
    (fun i => memLp_two_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hz.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure i))
    (fun _ _ hij => hz.iIndepFun_eval_of_rademacherVector.indepFun hij)
    (fun i => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hz.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure i))
    (fun i => integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hz.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure i))

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : HasLaw z (gaussianVector n) μ) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * A j i
proof:
:= by
  have hl := fun i => hz.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal i
  simpa using variance_quadForm A (fun i => (hl i).aemeasurable)
    hz.iIndepFun_eval_of_gaussianVector
    (fun i => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))
    (fun i => integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))
    (fun i => integrable_pow_four_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))
    (fun i => integral_pow_four_eq_three_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hz : HasLaw z (gaussianVector n) μ) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] = 2 * frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  have hl := fun i => hz.hasLaw_eval_gaussianReal i
  exact variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_three
    hA (fun i => (hl i).aemeasurable)
    hz.iIndepFun_eval_of_gaussianVector
    (fun i => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))
    (fun i => integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))
    (fun i => integrable_pow_four_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))
    (fun i => integral_pow_four_eq_three_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl i))

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hz : HasLaw z (rademacherVector n) μ) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] = 2 * (frobSq A - ∑ i, A i i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := fun i => hz.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure i
  exact variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_one
    hA (fun i => (hl i).aemeasurable)
    hz.iIndepFun_eval_of_rademacherVector
    (fun i => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl i))
    (fun i => integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl i))
    (fun i => integrable_pow_four_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl i))
    (fun i => integral_pow_four_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl i))

name: NLAlib.quadForm_rowSelector
statement:
theorem quadForm_rowSelector (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) (z : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (rowSelector A i) z = z i * (A *ᵥ z) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, rowSelector, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply, ite_mul,
    zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun k _ hk => by simp [hk]) (by simp)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.trace_rowSelector
statement: theorem trace_rowSelector (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) : (rowSelector A i).trace = A i i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rowSelector, Matrix.trace]

name: NLAlib.variance_contraction_rowSelector
statement:
private lemma variance_contraction_rowSelector (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) (m₄ : ℝ) :
    ∑ k, ∑ j, rowSelector A i k j ^ 2 + ∑ k, ∑ j, rowSelector A i k j * rowSelector A i j k +
        (m₄ - 3) * ∑ k, rowSelector A i k k ^ 2 =
      ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 + (m₄ - 2) * A i i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ k, ∑ j, rowSelector A i k j ^ 2 = ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun k _ hk => by simp [rowSelector, hk]) (by simp)]
    simp [rowSelector]
  have h2 : ∑ k, ∑ j, rowSelector A i k j * rowSelector A i j k = A i i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun k _ hk => by simp [rowSelector, hk]) (by simp)]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => by simp [rowSelector, hj]) (by simp)]
    simp [rowSelector, sq]
  have h3 : ∑ k, rowSelector A i k k ^ 2 = A i i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun k _ hk => by simp [rowSelector, hk]) (by simp)]
    simp [rowSelector]
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq_of_second_moments
statement:
theorem integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq_of_second_moments (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hmeas : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω j) μ)
    (hsecond : ∀ j k, ∫ ω, z ω j * z ω k ∂μ = if j = k then 1 else 0) (i : n) :
    ∫ ω, z ω i * (A *ᵥ z ω) i ∂μ = A i i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← quadForm_rowSelector]
  rw [integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments _ hmeas hsecond, trace_rowSelector]

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq
statement:
theorem integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hz : ∀ i, MemLp (fun ω => z ω i) 2 μ)
    (hind : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IndepFun (fun ω => z ω i) (fun ω => z ω j) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) (i : n) :
    ∫ ω, z ω i * (A *ᵥ z ω) i ∂μ = A i i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← quadForm_rowSelector]
  rw [integral_quadForm_eq_trace _ hz hind hmean hsq, trace_rowSelector]

name: NLAlib.variance_mul_mulVec_apply
statement:
theorem variance_mul_mulVec_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ) {m₄ : ℝ}
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = m₄) (i : n) :
    Var[fun ω => z ω i * (A *ᵥ z ω) i; μ] = ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 + (m₄ - 2) * A i i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← quadForm_rowSelector]
  rw [variance_quadForm _ hmeas hindep hmean hsq h4 hm4, variance_contraction_rowSelector]

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector
proof:

name: NLAlib.variance_mul_mulVec_apply_of_hasLaw_gaussianVector

    (fun j => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hl j))

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector

theorem integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : HasLaw z (rademacherVector n) μ) (i : n) :
    ∫ ω, z ω i * (A *ᵥ z ω) i ∂μ = A i i
proof:
:= by
  have hl := fun j => hz.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure j
  exact integral_mul_mulVec_apply_eq A (fun j => memLp_two_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl j))

name: NLAlib.variance_mul_mulVec_apply_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem variance_mul_mulVec_apply_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : HasLaw z (rademacherVector n) μ) (i : n) :
    Var[fun ω => z ω i * (A *ᵥ z ω) i; μ] = ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 - A i i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hl := fun j => hz.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure j
  rw [variance_mul_mulVec_apply A (fun j => (hl j).aemeasurable)
    hz.iIndepFun_eval_of_rademacherVector
    (fun j => integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl j))
    (fun j => integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl j))
    (fun j => integrable_pow_four_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl j))
    (fun j => integral_pow_four_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hl j)) i]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_diagonalSpectralLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_diagonalSpectralLaw (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (b : n → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Integrable f (diagonalSpectralLaw U d b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagonalSpectralLaw
  apply integrable_finsetSum_measure.mpr
  intro i _
  apply Integrable.smul_measure_nnreal
  exact integrable_dirac (by simp)

name: NLAlib.integral_diagonalSpectralLaw
statement:
theorem integral_diagonalSpectralLaw (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (b : n → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂diagonalSpectralLaw U d b =
      ∑ i, (‖((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b) i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • f (d i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagonalSpectralLaw
  rw [integral_finsetSum_measure (fun i _ =>
    (integrable_dirac (by simp)).smul_measure_nnreal)]
  simp only [integral_smul_nnreal_measure, integral_dirac, NNReal.smul_def, NNReal.coe_pow,
    coe_nnnorm]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum (d : n → ℂ) (c : n → ℂ) :
    quadForm (Matrix.diagonal d) c = ∑ i, (‖c i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • d i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, dotProduct, Pi.star_apply,
    RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  calc
    star (c i) * (d i * c i) = d i * (c i * star (c i)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_conj]; simp [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc
statement:
theorem integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (b : n → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂diagonalSpectralLaw U d b = quadForm (cfc f A) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_diagonalSpectralLaw, hA, cfc_complex_unitary_conj,
    cfc_diagonal_complex]
  · simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, quadForm_diagonal_eq_sum] using
      (quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => f (d i)))
        (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ b).symm
  · constructor
    change (Matrix.diagonal d)ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal d =
      Matrix.diagonal d * (Matrix.diagonal d)ᴴ
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_unitary_coordinates
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_unitary_coordinates (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) :
    ∑ i, ‖((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b) i‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ b
  have hUU : (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 := Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_one, hUU] at h
  have hh := congrArg Complex.re h
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.one_mulVec] at hh
  change RCLike.re (star b ⬝ᵥ b) =
    RCLike.re (star ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b)) at hh
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct] at hh
  rw [hh]
  exact (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (WithLp.toLp 2 ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b))).symm

name: NLAlib.isProbabilityMeasure_diagonalSpectralLaw
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_diagonalSpectralLaw (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)
    (d : n → ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ = 1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (diagonalSpectralLaw U d b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  simp only [diagonalSpectralLaw, Measure.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Measure.smul_apply, Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem (Set.mem_univ _), ENNReal.smul_def,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hsum : (∑ i, ‖((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b) i‖₊ ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) = 1 := by
    apply NNReal.coe_injective
    simp only [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_pow, coe_nnnorm, NNReal.coe_one,
      sum_norm_sq_unitary_coordinates, hb, one_pow]
  exact_mod_cast hsum

name: NLAlib.diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_of_diagonalizations
statement:
theorem diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_of_diagonalizations {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (U V : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d e : n → ℂ)
    (hU : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hV : A = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal e * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (b : n → ℂ) : diagonalSpectralLaw U d b = diagonalSpectralLaw V e b
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  have h := (integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc U d hU b (fun z => (f z : ℂ))).trans
    (integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc V e hV b (fun z => (f z : ℂ))).symm
  simp only [integral_complex_ofReal] at h
  exact Complex.ofReal_injective h

name: NLAlib.normalSpectralLaw_eq_diagonalSpectralLaw
statement:
theorem normalSpectralLaw_eq_diagonalSpectralLaw {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hU : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal d * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) (b : n → ℂ) :
    normalSpectralLaw hA b = diagonalSpectralLaw U d b
proof:
:= by
  exact diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_of_diagonalizations _ _ _ _
    (exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA).choose_spec.choose_spec hU b

name: NLAlib.isProbabilityMeasure_normalSpectralLaw
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalSpectralLaw
  exact isProbabilityMeasure_diagonalSpectralLaw _ _ b hb

name: NLAlib.integral_normalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc
proof:
:= by
  exact integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc _ _
    (exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA).choose_spec.choose_spec b f

name: NLAlib.weightedChebyshevError_eq_sqrt_sum
statement:
theorem weightedChebyshevError_eq_sqrt_sum (k : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    weightedChebyshevError k a b =
      Real.sqrt (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, ((a j - b j) / j) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedChebyshevError, dist_eq_norm, weightedChebyshevVector,
    ← WithLp.toLp_sub, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Pi.sub_apply,
    ← sub_div]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_attach (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun j => ((a j - b j) / j) ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.weightedChebyshevError_triangle
statement:
theorem weightedChebyshevError_triangle (k : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ → ℝ) :
    weightedChebyshevError k a c ≤
      weightedChebyshevError k a b + weightedChebyshevError k b c
proof: := dist_triangle _ _ _

name: NLAlib.weightedChebyshevError_comm
statement:
theorem weightedChebyshevError_comm (k : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    weightedChebyshevError k a b = weightedChebyshevError k b a

name: NLAlib.chebyshevMomentError_eq_weightedChebyshevError
statement:
theorem chebyshevMomentError_eq_weightedChebyshevError (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevMomentError μ ν k = weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevMoments μ) (chebyshevMoments ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedChebyshevError_eq_sqrt_sum]

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_Icc_chebyshevGridLaw
statement:
theorem ae_mem_Icc_chebyshevGridLaw {g : ℕ} (z : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂chebyshevGridLaw z, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:

name: NLAlib.chebyshevMoments_gridLaw
statement:
theorem chebyshevMoments_gridLaw {g : ℕ} (z : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g)) :
    chebyshevMoments (chebyshevGridLaw z) = chebyshevGridMoments z.val
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [chebyshevMoments, chebyshevGridLaw,
    integral_map (measurable_of_finite _).aemeasurable (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_finiteSamplingLaw]

name: NLAlib.continuous_weightedChebyshevError_gridMoments
statement:
theorem continuous_weightedChebyshevError_gridMoments (g k : ℕ) (mhat : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun z : Fin g → ℝ => weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments z) mhat)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun z : Fin g → ℝ => weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments z) mhat) =
    (fun z => Real.sqrt (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, ((chebyshevGridMoments z j - mhat j) / j) ^ 2))
    from funext fun z => weightedChebyshevError_eq_sqrt_sum _ _ _]
  unfold chebyshevGridMoments
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.exists_minimizer_weightedChebyshevError_gridMoments
statement:
theorem exists_minimizer_weightedChebyshevError_gridMoments (g k : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (mhat : ℕ → ℝ) : ∃ z ∈ stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g), ∀ a ∈ stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g),
      weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments z) mhat ≤
        weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments a) mhat
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨Pi.single ⟨0, hg⟩ 1, single_mem_stdSimplex ℝ _⟩
  exact (isCompact_stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g)).exists_isMinOn hne
    (continuous_weightedChebyshevError_gridMoments g k mhat).continuousOn

name: NLAlib.integrable_chebyshev_of_ae_mem_Icc
statement:
private theorem integrable_chebyshev_of_ae_mem_Icc
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (j : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h : IntegrableOn (fun x => (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x) (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) μ :=
    (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).continuous.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc
  rwa [IntegrableOn, Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hμ] at h

name: NLAlib.exists_gridMoments_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_gridMoments_approximation (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (k g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    ∃ a : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g),
      weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevMoments μ) (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) ≤
        Real.pi * Real.sqrt k / (2 * g)
proof:
:= by
  let I := chebyshevGridIndex g hg
  have hI : Measurable I := measurable_chebyshevGridIndex g hg
  let ν := μ.map I
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hI.aemeasurable
  let a : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g) := ⟨fun i => ν.real {i},
    ⟨fun _ => measureReal_nonneg, by
      simp⟩⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  have hmoment (j : ℕ) : chebyshevGridMoments a.val j =
      ∫ x, (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g (I x)) ∂μ := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun i : Fin g => (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g i)) :=
      measurable_of_finite _
    rw [← integral_map hI.aemeasurable hm.aestronglyMeasurable,
      integral_fintype (Integrable.of_finite : Integrable _ ν)]
    rfl
  have hcoord (j : ℕ) : |chebyshevMoments μ j - chebyshevGridMoments a.val j| ≤
      j * Real.pi / (2 * g) := by
    have hi : Integrable (fun x => (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g (I x))) μ :=
      (Integrable.of_finite : Integrable (fun i => (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g i)) ν).comp_aemeasurable
        hI.aemeasurable
    rw [chebyshevMoments, hmoment,
      ← integral_sub (integrable_chebyshev_of_ae_mem_Icc μ hμ j) hi, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := j * Real.pi / (2 * g)) ?_).trans_eq (by simp)
    filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
    exact abs_eval_chebyshev_sub_grid_le g hg hx j
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k,
      ((chebyshevMoments μ j - chebyshevGridMoments a.val j) / j) ^ 2) ≤
        (k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (2 * g)) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (Real.pi / (2 * g)) ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        have hjpos : (0 : ℝ) < j := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1; omega)
        have hd : |(chebyshevMoments μ j - chebyshevGridMoments a.val j) / j| ≤
            Real.pi / (2 * g) := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hjpos]
          apply (div_le_iff₀ hjpos).2
          exact (hcoord j).trans_eq (by ring)
        simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).2 hd
      _ = _ := by simp
  rw [weightedChebyshevError_eq_sqrt_sum]
  apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).2
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  apply hsum.trans_eq
  simp only [div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg k)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_gridLaw_le_of_weightedChebyshevError_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_gridLaw_le_of_weightedChebyshevError_le
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) {k g : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hg : 0 < g)
    (mhat : ℕ → ℝ) {Γ η : ℝ}
    (hnoise : weightedChebyshevError k mhat (chebyshevMoments μ) ≤ Γ)
    (z : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g))
    (hfit : ∀ a : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin g),
      weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments z.val) mhat ≤
        weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) mhat + η) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ (chebyshevGridLaw z) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (36 / k + 2 * Γ + Real.pi * Real.sqrt k / (2 * g) + η)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_gridMoments_approximation μ hμ k g hg
  have htri₁ := weightedChebyshevError_triangle k (chebyshevGridMoments z.val) mhat (chebyshevMoments μ)
  have htri₂ := weightedChebyshevError_triangle k (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) (chebyshevMoments μ) mhat
  have ha' : weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) (chebyshevMoments μ) ≤
      Real.pi * Real.sqrt k / (2 * g) := by rwa [weightedChebyshevError_comm]
  have hn' : weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevMoments μ) mhat ≤ Γ := by
    rwa [weightedChebyshevError_comm]
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_thirtySix_div_add_chebyshevMomentError
    μ (chebyshevGridLaw z) hμ (ae_mem_Icc_chebyshevGridLaw z) hk).trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  rw [chebyshevMomentError_eq_weightedChebyshevError, chebyshevMoments_gridLaw,
    weightedChebyshevError_comm k (chebyshevMoments μ)]
  linarith [hfit a]

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_gridLaw_le_of_ceil_rpow_three_div_two
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_gridLaw_le_of_ceil_rpow_three_div_two
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (mhat : ℕ → ℝ) {Γ η : ℝ}
    (hnoise : weightedChebyshevError k mhat (chebyshevMoments μ) ≤ Γ)
    (z : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin ⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊))
    (hfit : ∀ a : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin ⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊),
      weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments z.val) mhat ≤
        weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) mhat + η) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ (chebyshevGridLaw z) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((36 + Real.pi / 2) / k + 2 * Γ + η)
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hg : 0 < ⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊ :=
    (Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hkpos _))
  have hrpow : (k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt k := by
    rw [show (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 / 2 by norm_num,
      Real.rpow_one_add' hkpos.le (by norm_num), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hscale : (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt k ≤ ⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊ := by
    rw [← hrpow]
    exact Nat.le_ceil _
  have hgrid : Real.pi * Real.sqrt k / (2 * (⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊ : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.pi / (2 * k) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale Real.pi_pos.le]
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_gridLaw_le_of_weightedChebyshevError_le μ hμ hk hg mhat hnoise z hfit).trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  calc
    _ ≤ 36 / k + 2 * Γ + Real.pi / (2 * k) + η := by linarith
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProbeCount_pos
statement:
theorem chebyshevProbeCount_pos {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < chebyshevProbeCount a j
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr
  positivity

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProbeCount_antitone
statement:
theorem chebyshevProbeCount_antitone {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    AntitoneOn (chebyshevProbeCount a) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj hij
  apply Nat.ceil_mono
  change 1 ≤ i at hi
  have hi' : (0 : ℝ) < i := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_left
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha hi' (show (i : ℝ) ≤ j by exact_mod_cast hij)) 1

name: NLAlib.sum_chebyshevProbeCount_le
statement:
theorem sum_chebyshevProbeCount_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (chebyshevProbeCount a j : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * k + a * (1 + Real.log k)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (2 + a * (j : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      have := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ 1 + a / j by positivity)).le
      dsimp [chebyshevProbeCount]
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using (this.trans_eq (by ring))
    _ = 2 * k + a * (harmonic k : ℝ) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Icc,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc,
        Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact harmonic_le_one_add_log k

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProbeAccuracy_pos
statement:
theorem chebyshevProbeAccuracy_pos {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    0 < chebyshevProbeAccuracy k
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have := Real.log_nonneg hk'
  unfold chebyshevProbeAccuracy
  positivity

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProbeAccuracy_sq_mul
statement:
theorem chebyshevProbeAccuracy_sq_mul {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log k) = 1 / (k : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hlog : 0 < 1 + Real.log k := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ k by exact_mod_cast hk)
    linarith
  rw [chebyshevProbeAccuracy, div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hlog.le]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_chebyshevProbeAccuracy_le_one
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_chebyshevProbeAccuracy_le_one {k j : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hj : j ≤ k) : Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hlog : 1 ≤ 1 + Real.log k := by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hk']
  have hsqrt : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + Real.log k) := by
    exact (Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by linarith)).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hγ : chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ≤ 1 / (k : ℝ) := by
    unfold chebyshevProbeAccuracy
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hj' : Real.sqrt j ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).2
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    have : (j : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hj
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * (1 / (k : ℝ)) := mul_le_mul hj' hγ
      (chebyshevProbeAccuracy_pos hk).le (by positivity)
    _ = 1 := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg
statement:
theorem chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg (n k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold chebyshevProbeBudget chebyshevProbeConstant
  positivity

name: NLAlib.sum_chebyshevProbeCount_budget_le
statement:
theorem sum_chebyshevProbeCount_budget_le {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (δ : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ) j : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * k + chebyshevProbeConstant * k ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log k) ^ 2 *
        Real.log ((k : ℝ) / δ) ^ 2 / n
proof:
:= by
  apply (sum_chebyshevProbeCount_le (chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg n k δ) k).trans_eq
  rw [chebyshevProbeBudget, chebyshevProbeAccuracy, div_pow, mul_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log k by
      have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ k by exact_mod_cast hk); linarith)]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_probeCount_mul_le_div
statement:
theorem exp_neg_probeCount_mul_le_div {n k j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hj : 0 < j) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    2 * Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
      ((chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ) j : ℝ) * n *
        (Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k) ^ 2)) ≤ δ / k
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hj' : (0 : ℝ) < j := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hj
  have hk' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hγ := chebyshevProbeAccuracy_pos (show 1 ≤ k by omega)
  let h := Real.log ((k : ℝ) / δ)
  have hhlog : Real.log 2 ≤ h := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num)
    ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith))
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    have := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    linarith
  have hh : 1 / 2 ≤ h := hhalf.trans hhlog
  have hb := Nat.le_ceil (1 + chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ / j)
  have hb' : chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ / j ≤
      (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ) j : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [chebyshevProbeCount]
    linarith
  have hexp : 4 * h ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
      ((chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ) j : ℝ) * n *
        (Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k) ^ 2) := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hj'.le]
    have hbmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb'
      (show 0 ≤ (1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) * n * (j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2) by positivity)
    calc
      _ = chebyshevProbeBudget n k δ / j *
          ((1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) * n * (j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2)) := by
        dsimp [chebyshevProbeBudget, chebyshevProbeConstant, h]
        field_simp
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := hbmul
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(h + Real.log 2)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith
    _ = δ / k := by
      rw [neg_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg,
        Real.exp_log (show 0 < (k : ℝ) / δ by positivity), Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.weightedChebyshevError_le_inv_of_coordinate_error
statement:
theorem weightedChebyshevError_le_inv_of_coordinate_error {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k,
      |a j - b j| ≤ Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k) :
    weightedChebyshevError k a b ≤ 1 / k
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, ((a j - b j) / j) ^ 2) ≤
      chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2 * (harmonic k : ℝ) := by
    rw [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    have hjpos : (0 : ℝ) < j := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1; omega)
    have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (chebyshevProbeAccuracy_pos hk).le)).2 (h j hj)
    rw [sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hjpos.le] at hs
    simp only [Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast, div_pow]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hjpos)).2
    calc
      _ ≤ j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2 := hs
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  rw [weightedChebyshevError_eq_sqrt_sum]
  apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).2
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2 * (harmonic k : ℝ) := hsum
    _ ≤ chebyshevProbeAccuracy k ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log k) := by
      gcongr
      exact harmonic_le_one_add_log k
    _ = (1 / (k : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by rw [chebyshevProbeAccuracy_sq_mul hk, div_pow, one_pow]

name: NLAlib.integral_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw_star_poly_mul_poly
statement:
theorem integral_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw_star_poly_mul_poly
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (p q : Polynomial ℂ) :
    (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), star (p.eval (x 0 : ℂ))*q.eval (x 1 : ℂ)
      ∂normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b) =
      star ((Polynomial.aeval (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) p)*ᵥb) ⬝ᵥ
        ((Polynomial.aeval (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) q)*ᵥb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalCoordinateSpectralLaw, integral_map
    Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
  exact integral_normalSpectralLaw_star_poly_re_mul_poly_im hA b p q

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_integral
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_integral
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (j k : Fin (M+1)) :
    ((normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A)) j k =
      ∫ z, ((normalizedChebyshev j z.re * normalizedChebyshev k z.im : ℝ) : ℂ)
        ∂normalSpectralLaw hA b
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_normalMixedMomentProgram]
  exact (integral_normalSpectralLaw_normalizedChebyshev_eq_crossGram hA b M j k).symm

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_coordinate_integral
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_coordinate_integral
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (j k : Fin (M+1)) :
    ((normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A)) j k =
      ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ((normalizedChebyshev j (x 0) * normalizedChebyshev k (x 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        ∂normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalCoordinateSpectralLaw, integral_map
    Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable (by
      apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
      unfold normalizedChebyshev
      fun_prop)]
  simpa only [Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI_repr_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one] using
    run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_integral hA b M j k

name: NLAlib.normalMixedScalarWork_le
statement:
theorem normalMixedScalarWork_le (M : ℕ)
    (matrixResponse adjointResponse previous : Bool → Fin M → n → ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix n (Fin (M+1)) ℂ) :
    normalMixedScalarWork M matrixResponse adjointResponse previous X Y ≤

:=

name: NLAlib.totalHermitianSpectralLaw_eq
statement:
private theorem totalHermitianSpectralLaw_eq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    totalHermitianSpectralLaw A = empiricalSpectralLaw hA
proof: := dif_pos hA

name: NLAlib.cost_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg
statement:
theorem cost_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (S δ : ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ) :
    (cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k hk S δ G).cost =
      min (chebyshevQueryCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) k) (Fintype.card n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : chebyshevQueryCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) k ≤ Fintype.card n
  · simp only [cappedChebyshevDensityAlg, if_pos h, MatvecAlg.cost, min_eq_left h]
  · simp only [cappedChebyshevDensityAlg, if_neg h, MatvecAlg.cost, min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]

name: NLAlib.cost_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_le
statement:
theorem cost_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_le (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (S δ : ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ) :
    ((cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k hk S δ G).cost : ℝ) ≤
      min (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
        (2 * k + chebyshevProbeConstant * k ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log k) ^ 2 *
          Real.log ((k : ℝ) / δ) ^ 2 / Fintype.card n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cost_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg]
  apply le_min
  · exact_mod_cast min_le_right _ _
  · apply (Nat.cast_le.mpr (min_le_left _ _)).trans
    rw [chebyshevQueryCount_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum]
    exact sum_chebyshevProbeCount_budget_le hk δ

name: NLAlib.run_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg
statement:
theorem run_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (S δ : ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ) :
    (cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k hk S δ G).run A =
      if chebyshevQueryCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) k ≤ Fintype.card n then
        (chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate (S⁻¹ • A) k hk δ G).map (fun x => S * x)
      else empiricalSpectralLaw hA
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : chebyshevQueryCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) k ≤ Fintype.card n
  · have he : cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k hk S δ G =
        ⟨_, chebyshevDensityProgram k hk S δ G⟩ := if_pos h
    rw [if_pos h]
    exact (congrArg (fun alg : MatvecAlg ℝ n (Measure ℝ) => alg.run A) he).trans
      (run_chebyshevDensityProgram A k hk S δ G)
  · have he : cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k hk S δ G =
        ⟨_, matrixRecoveryProgram.map totalHermitianSpectralLaw⟩ := if_neg h
    rw [if_neg h]
    apply (congrArg (fun alg : MatvecAlg ℝ n (Measure ℝ) => alg.run A) he).trans
    simp only [MatvecAlg.run, QueryProgram.run_map,
      run_matrixRecoveryProgram, totalHermitianSpectralLaw_eq hA]

name: NLAlib.isProbabilityMeasure_run_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_run_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (S δ : ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure ((cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k hk S δ G).run A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg hA]
  split_ifs
  · unfold chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate
    exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  · infer_instance

name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) =>
      G ω e.1 e.2)
      (rademacherVector (n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ENNReal.ofReal ((38 + Real.pi / 2) * S / k) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (empiricalSpectralLaw hA)
        ((cappedChebyshevDensityAlg k (by omega) S δ (G ω)).run A)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [run_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg hA]
  split_ifs
  · exact measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_empiricalSpectralLaw_scaled_gt_le hA hS hbound hk hδ hδ1 hG
  · simpa only [wassersteinEDistOne_self, not_lt_zero, Set.ofPred_false, measureReal_empty]
      using hδ.le
