name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_epsilon_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_epsilon_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n
      (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n)
        ⌈(38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε⌉₊ δ) 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n)
        ⌈(38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε⌉₊ δ) 1)) => G ω e.1 e.2)
      (rademacherVector (n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n)
        ⌈(38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε⌉₊ δ) 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (ε * S) < wassersteinEDistOne (empiricalSpectralLaw hA)
      ((cappedChebyshevDensityAlg ⌈(38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε⌉₊
        (by have := two_le_spectralDensity_degree hε hε1; omega) S δ (G ω)).run A)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (measureReal_mono ?_ (measure_ne_top _ _)).trans
    (measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_cappedChebyshevDensityAlg_gt_le
      hA hS hbound (two_le_spectralDensity_degree hε hε1) hδ hδ1 hG)
  intro ω hω
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hω ⊢
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hω
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (spectralDensity_constant_div_ceil_le hε) hS.le
  simpa only [div_mul_eq_mul_div] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_normalSpectralLaw_star_poly_re_mul_poly_im
statement:
theorem integral_normalSpectralLaw_star_poly_re_mul_poly_im
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (b : n → ℂ) (p q : ℂ[X]) :
    (∫ z, star (p.eval (z.re : ℂ)) * q.eval (z.im : ℂ) ∂normalSpectralLaw hA b) =
      star ((aeval (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) p) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
        ((aeval (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) q) *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hnormal : IsStarNormal A := ⟨hA.symm⟩
  rw [integral_normalSpectralLaw_eq_quadForm_cfc,
    cfc_mul (fun z : ℂ => star (p.eval (z.re : ℂ))) (fun z : ℂ => q.eval (z.im : ℂ)) A
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    cfc_star]
  have hp : cfc (fun z : ℂ => p.eval (z.re : ℂ)) A =
      aeval (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) p := by
    rw [← cfc_realPart (fun z => p.eval z) A (by fun_prop) hnormal,
      cfc_polynomial p _ (realPart A).property.isStarNormal]
  have hq : cfc (fun z : ℂ => q.eval (z.im : ℂ)) A =
      aeval (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) q := by
    rw [← cfc_imaginaryPart (fun z => q.eval z) A (by fun_prop) hnormal,
      cfc_polynomial q _ (imaginaryPart A).property.isStarNormal]
  rw [hp, hq]
  rw [quadForm, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose, star_star]

name: NLAlib.integral_normalSpectralLaw_normalizedChebyshev_eq_crossGram
statement:
theorem integral_normalSpectralLaw_normalizedChebyshev_eq_crossGram
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (j k : Fin (M+1)) :
    (∫ z, ((normalizedChebyshev j z.re * normalizedChebyshev k z.im : ℝ) : ℂ)
      ∂normalSpectralLaw hA b) =
      ((normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M)ᴴ *
        normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M) j k
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_normalSpectralLaw_star_poly_re_mul_poly_im hA b
    ((normalizedChebyshevPolynomial j).map Complex.ofRealHom)
    ((normalizedChebyshevPolynomial k).map Complex.ofRealHom)
  simpa only [eval_map_normalizedChebyshevPolynomial, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix, Pi.star_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_uniformComplexSpectralLaw_eq_trace_cfc
statement:
private theorem integral_uniformComplexSpectralLaw_eq_trace_cfc
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hU : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)*Matrix.diagonal d*(U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂uniformComplexSpectralLaw d = (cfc f A).trace/(Fintype.card n : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : IsStarNormal (Matrix.diagonal d) := by
    constructor
    change (Matrix.diagonal d)ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal d = Matrix.diagonal d * (Matrix.diagonal d)ᴴ
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose,Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mul_comm _ _
  rw [integral_uniformComplexSpectralLaw,hU,cfc_complex_unitary_conj U f _ hn,
    cfc_diagonal_complex, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Unitary.coe_star_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_diagonal]

:=

name: NLAlib.normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_uniformComplexSpectralLaw

theorem normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_uniformComplexSpectralLaw {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hU : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)*Matrix.diagonal d*(U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) :
    normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA = uniformComplexSpectralLaw d
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  have he := (integral_normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_trace_cfc hA (fun z => (f z : ℂ))).trans
    (integral_uniformComplexSpectralLaw_eq_trace_cfc U d hU (fun z => (f z : ℂ))).symm
  simp only [integral_complex_ofReal] at he
  exact Complex.ofReal_injective he

name: NLAlib.ae_norm_le_normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,d,hU⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  rw [normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_uniformComplexSpectralLaw hA U d hU,
    uniformComplexSpectralLaw]
  apply Measure.ae_smul_measure
  rw [ae_finsetSum_measure_iff]
  intro i _
  let : Nonempty n := ⟨i⟩
  apply (ae_dirac_iff (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const)).mpr
  have hs : spectrum ℂ A = Set.range d := by
    rw [hU]
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Unitary.coe_star,spectrum_diagonal] using
      (Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal d) (U := U))
  have hm : d i ∈ spectrum ℂ A := hs.symm ▸ Set.mem_range_self i
  simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hm

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_chebyshevCube_normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw
statement:
theorem ae_mem_chebyshevCube_normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1) :

name: NLAlib.normal_log_factors
statement:
private theorem normal_log_factors {M : ℕ} (hM : 2≤M) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) :
    (1/2 : ℝ)≤log M ∧ 0≤log ((M : ℝ)/δ) ∧
      log ((2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)/δ) ≤ 5*log ((M : ℝ)/δ) ∧
      0≤log ((2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)/δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (2 : ℝ)≤M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hmp : 0<(M : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlog : log 2≤log M := log_le_log (by norm_num) hm
  have hhalf : (1/2 : ℝ)≤log M := by linarith [log_two_gt_d9]
  have hdlog : log δ≤0 := log_nonpos hδ.le hδ1.le
  have hratio : 0≤log ((M : ℝ)/δ) := by rw [log_div hmp.ne' hδ.ne'];linarith
  have hknat : 1≤(M+1)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hk : (((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)=(M : ℝ)^2+2*M := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hknat,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  have hnum : (2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)≤8*(M : ℝ)^2 := by rw [hk];nlinarith
  have hnumpos : 0<(2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [hk];positivity
  have hupper : log ((2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)/δ)≤5*log ((M : ℝ)/δ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ log (8*(M : ℝ)^2/δ) := log_le_log (div_pos hnumpos hδ)
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hδ.le)
      _ = 3*log 2+2*log M-log δ := by
        rw [log_div (by positivity) hδ.ne',log_mul (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 hmp.ne'),
          show (8 : ℝ)=2^3 by norm_num,log_pow,log_pow]
        norm_num
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [log_div hmp.ne' hδ.ne'];linarith
  have hlower : 0≤log ((2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)/δ) := by
    apply log_nonneg
    apply (one_le_div hδ).mpr
    rw [hk]
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨hhalf,hratio,hupper,hlower⟩

name: NLAlib.pi_mul_normalTensorMomentRadius_mul_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem pi_mul_normalTensorMomentRadius_mul_sqrt_le {n M : ℕ}
    (hn : 1≤n) (hM : 2≤M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) :
    π*normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) ≤
      128*sqrt (log ((M : ℝ)/δ)*log M/n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlog,hlogratio,hupper,hlower⟩ := normal_log_factors hM hδ hδ1
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ)≤n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnp : 0<(n : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hden : (n : ℝ)≤2*n-1 := by linarith
  have hdenpos : 0<2*(n : ℝ)-1 := by linarith
  have hsq : normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ ^ 2 =
      8/(2*(n : ℝ)-1)*log ((2*((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)/δ) := by
    rw [normalTensorMomentRadius,sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hlower)]
  have hradius : normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ ^ 2 ≤ 40*log ((M : ℝ)/δ)/n := by
    rw [hsq]
    calc
      _ ≤ (8/(n : ℝ))*(5*log ((M : ℝ)/δ)) :=
        mul_le_mul (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hnp hden) hupper hlower (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hL : 0≤5+(π/2)*log M := by positivity
  have hLbound : 5+(π/2)*log M≤12*log M := by
    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right pi_lt_four.le (show 0≤log M by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hpi : π^2≤16 := by nlinarith [pi_pos,pi_lt_four]
  let T : ℝ := log ((M : ℝ)/δ)*log M/n
  have hT : 0≤T := by dsimp [T];positivity
  have hs : (π*normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M))^2 ≤
      (128*sqrt T)^2 := by
    calc
      _ = (π^2*normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ^2)*(5+(π/2)*log M) := by
        rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,sq_sqrt hL]
      _ ≤ (16*(40*log ((M : ℝ)/δ)/n))*(12*log M) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hpi hradius (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) hLbound hL (by positivity)
      _ = 7680*T := by dsimp [T];ring
      _ ≤ 128^2*T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) hT
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow,sq_sqrt hT]
  have hr : 0≤normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ := sqrt_nonneg _
  have hleft : 0≤π*normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pi_pos.le hr) (sqrt_nonneg _)
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ hleft (by positivity)).mp hs

name: NLAlib.normalSpectralDensityError_le_asymptotic
statement:
theorem normalSpectralDensityError_le_asymptotic {n M : ℕ}
    (hn : 1≤n) (hM : 2≤M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) :
    84/(M : ℝ)+π*normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) ≤
      128*(1/(M : ℝ)+sqrt (log ((M : ℝ)/δ)*log M/n))

:= by
  have hh := pi_mul_normalTensorMomentRadius_mul_sqrt_le hn hM hδ hδ1
  have hm : 0≤(M : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg M
  have hbase : 84/(M : ℝ)≤128/(M : ℝ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) hm
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hh hbase ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram_asymptotic_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram_asymptotic_gt_le
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0<S) (hbound : specNorm A≤S)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 2≤M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b |
      ENNReal.ofReal (128*S*(1/(M : ℝ)+sqrt (log ((M : ℝ)/δ)*log M/Fintype.card n))) <
        wassersteinEDistOne (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA)
          ((normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A))} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans
    (measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram_gt_le hA hS hbound hM hδ hδ1)
  intro b hb
  change ENNReal.ofReal _ < _ at hb
  change ENNReal.ofReal _ < _
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hb
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (normalSpectralDensityError_le_asymptotic (n := Fintype.card n)
      (Fintype.card_pos (α := n)) hM hδ hδ1) hS.le
  simpa only [mul_assoc,mul_left_comm,mul_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.exists_finite_support_run_normalSpectralQuadratureProgram
statement:
theorem exists_finite_support_run_normalSpectralQuadratureProgram
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖=1)
    (hbound : specNorm A≤1) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℂ,s.card≤(M+1)^2 ∧
      (normalSpectralQuadratureProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) (s : Set ℂ)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [run_normalSpectralQuadratureProgram hA b hb hbound]
  obtain ⟨s,hcard,hnull⟩ := exists_finite_support_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw
    (normalSpectralCubeLaw hA b) M
  let t := s.image Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm
  refine ⟨t,Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simpa using hcard),?_⟩
  apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
  have hh : ∀ᵐ z ∂(tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw (normalSpectralCubeLaw hA b) M).map
      Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm,z ∈ (t : Set ℂ) := by
    apply (ae_map_iff Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
      (p := fun z : ℂ => z ∈ (t : Set ℂ)) t.finite_toSet.measurableSet).mpr
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hnull] with x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ s := by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff,not_not,Finset.mem_coe] using hx
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x,hx',rfl⟩
  filter_upwards [hh] with z hz
  exact fun he => he hz

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sq_le_card_of_specNorm_le_one
statement:
private theorem frobNorm_sq_le_card_of_specNorm_le_one (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : specNorm A ≤ 1) : frobNorm A ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNorm_sq]
  apply (frobSq_le_rank_mul_specNorm_sq A).trans
  have hr : (A.rank : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast Matrix.rank_le_card_width A
  calc
    _ ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * 1 := by
      gcongr
      simpa using (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).2 hA
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa using hr

name: NLAlib.specNorm_aeval_chebyshev_le_one
proof:
:= by
  apply specNorm_aeval_le hA _ zero_le_one
  intro i
  apply Chebyshev.abs_eval_T_real_le_one
  calc
    |hA.eigenvalues i| = ‖hA.eigenvalues i‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ ‖hA.eigenvalues‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ _
    _ = specNorm A := hA.specNorm_eq_norm_eigenvalues.symm
    _ ≤ 1 := hbound

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_div_card_sub_trace_div_card_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_div_card_sub_trace_div_card_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] [Nonempty κ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {Z : Ω → Matrix n κ ℝ}
    (hZ : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × κ) => Z ω e.1 e.2) (rademacherVector (n × κ)) μ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    μ.real {ω | a < |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) / Fintype.card n -
      A.trace / Fintype.card n|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        (Fintype.card κ * Fintype.card n * a ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  by_cases hzero : A = 0
  · have he : {ω | a < |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) / Fintype.card n -
        A.trace / Fintype.card n|} = ∅ := by
      ext ω
      simp [hzero, hutchinsonEstimate, quadForm, ha.not_gt]
    rw [he, measureReal_empty]
    positivity
  have hS : 0 < specNorm A := (specNorm_nonneg A).lt_of_ne
    (fun h => hzero (norm_eq_zero.mp ((specNorm_eq_norm A).symm.trans h.symm)))
  have hF : 0 < frobNorm A ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero
    (fun h => hzero ((frobNorm_eq_zero_iff A).mp h))
  have hFbound := frobNorm_sq_le_card_of_specNorm_le_one A hA
  have hexp : (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * Fintype.card n * a ^ 2 ≤
      min (Fintype.card κ * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * a) ^ 2 / frobNorm A ^ 2)
        (Fintype.card κ * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * a) / specNorm A) := by
    apply le_min
    · apply (le_div_iff₀ hF).2
      calc
        _ ≤ (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * Fintype.card n * a ^ 2 * Fintype.card n := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by ring
    · apply (le_div_iff₀ hS).2
      calc
        _ ≤ (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * Fintype.card n * a ^ 2 * 1 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ _ := by
          have : a ^ 2 ≤ a := by nlinarith
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card κ * Fintype.card n by positivity)
            (sub_nonneg.mpr this)]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * a ≤ |hutchinsonEstimate A (Z ω) - A.trace|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono _ (measure_ne_top _ _)
      intro ω hω
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hn] at hω ⊢
      exact (mul_comm _ _).trans_le ((lt_div_iff₀ hn).mp hω).le
    _ ≤ _ := (measureReal_le_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_sub_trace_le_of_hasLaw_rademacherVector
      A hZ _ (by positivity)).trans (by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hexp (neg_nonpos.mpr (by positivity)))

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_rademacherVector_prefix
proof:
:= by
  apply hasLaw_rademacherVector_of_iIndepFun
    (x := fun (e : n × Fin q) ω => G ω e.1 (e.2.castLE hq))
    (fun e => hG.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure (e.1, e.2.castLE hq))
  exact hG.iIndepFun_eval_of_rademacherVector.precomp
    (g := fun e : n × Fin q => (e.1, e.2.castLE hq)) (by
      intro a b he
      have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst he
      have h₂ := congrArg (fun e : n × Fin L => e.2.val) he
      exact Prod.ext h₁ (Fin.ext h₂))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate_sub_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate_sub_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {k j : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) =>
      G ω e.1 e.2)
      (rademacherVector (n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k <
      |chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate A (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ)
        (chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg _ _ _) (G ω) j -
        (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))).trace / Fintype.card n|} ≤ δ / k
proof:
:= by
  have hj1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1
  have hjk := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).2
  have ha := chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg (Fintype.card n) k δ
  let a := chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ
  have : Nonempty (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount a j)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (chebyshevProbeCount_pos ha j)
  have hprefix := hasLaw_rademacherVector_prefix
    (chebyshevProbeCount_antitone ha (by simp) hj1 hj1) hG
  have ht : 0 < Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k := mul_pos
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega))) (chebyshevProbeAccuracy_pos (by omega))
  have htail := measureReal_abs_hutchinsonEstimate_div_card_sub_trace_div_card_gt_le
    (Z := fun ω i (t : Fin (chebyshevProbeCount a j)) => G ω i
      (t.castLE (chebyshevProbeCount_antitone ha (by simp) hj1 hj1)))
    (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))) (specNorm_aeval_chebyshev_le_one hA hbound j)
    hprefix ht (sqrt_mul_chebyshevProbeAccuracy_le_one (by omega) hjk)
  simp only [chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate, dif_pos hj1]
  refine htail.trans ?_
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
    exp_neg_probeCount_mul_le_div Fintype.card_pos hk (by omega) hδ hδ1

name: NLAlib.measureReal_weightedChebyshevError_traceMomentEstimate_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_weightedChebyshevError_traceMomentEstimate_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) =>
      G ω e.1 e.2)
      (rademacherVector (n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | 1 / (k : ℝ) < weightedChebyshevError k
      (chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate A (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ)
        (chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg _ _ _) (G ω))
      (fun j => (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))).trace / Fintype.card n)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let E : ℕ → Set Ω := fun j => {ω | Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k <
      |chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate A (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ)
        (chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg _ _ _) (G ω) j -
        (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))).trace / Fintype.card n|}
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real (⋃ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, E j) := by
      apply measureReal_mono _ (measure_ne_top _ _)
      intro ω hω
      by_contra hnot
      have hcoord : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k,
          |chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate A (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ)
            (chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg _ _ _) (G ω) j -
            (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))).trace / Fintype.card n| ≤
              Real.sqrt j * chebyshevProbeAccuracy k := by
        intro j hj
        exact le_of_not_gt fun hgt => hnot (Set.mem_biUnion hj hgt)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (weightedChebyshevError_le_inv_of_coordinate_error (by omega) _ _ hcoord)) hω
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, μ.real (E j) := measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, δ / k := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact measureReal_abs_chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate_sub_gt_le hA hbound hk hj hδ hδ1 hG
    _ = δ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_real
statement:
private theorem integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_real (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)
    (d : n → ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℝ) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂diagonalSpectralLaw U d b =
      ∑ i, Complex.normSq (((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b) i)*f (d i)
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg Complex.re (integral_diagonalSpectralLaw U d b (fun z => (f z : ℂ)))
  simpa only [integral_complex_ofReal,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.re_sum,Complex.smul_re,
    Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,smul_eq_mul] using he

name: NLAlib.integral_uniformComplexSpectralLaw_real

name: NLAlib.measureReal_normalSpectralLaw_integral_sub_empirical_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_normalSpectralLaw_integral_sub_empirical_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hU : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)*Matrix.diagonal d*(U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)
    (f : ℂ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, f (d i) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | r < |(∫ z, f z ∂normalSpectralLaw hA b) -
      ∫ z, f z ∂normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA|} ≤
      2*exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*r^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  let c : n → ℝ := fun i => f (d i)
  let m := (∑ i, c i)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hmean : ∑ i, c i = (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*m := by dsimp [m];field_simp
  have hm : m ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hlow : ∑ i, (-1 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, c i := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => (hf i).1)
    have hhigh : ∑ i, c i ≤ ∑ i, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => (hf i).2)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_neg,mul_one] at hlow hhigh
    constructor
    · exact (le_div_iff₀ hn).mpr (by linarith)
    · exact (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr (by linarith)
  have he (b : n → ℂ) :
      (∫ z, f z ∂normalSpectralLaw hA b) - ∫ z, f z ∂normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA =
        sphereDiagonalForm c ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *ᵥ b)-m := by
    rw [normalSpectralLaw_eq_diagonalSpectralLaw hA U d hU b,
      normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_uniformComplexSpectralLaw hA U d hU,
      integral_diagonalSpectralLaw_real,integral_uniformComplexSpectralLaw_real]
    simp only [sphereDiagonalForm,c,m,mul_comm]
  simp_rw [he]
  have hunit : HasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    change ((U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U
  have hl := hasLaw_mulVec_complexSphereVector_unitary (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ hunit
  rw [hl.measureReal_eq (p := fun b : n → ℂ => r < |sphereDiagonalForm c b-m|) (by
    unfold sphereDiagonalForm
    exact measurableSet_lt measurable_const (by fun_prop))]
  exact measureReal_abs_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le c hm hr hf hmean

name: NLAlib.norm_diagonal_atom_le_specNorm
statement:
private theorem norm_diagonal_atom_le_specNorm {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hU : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)*Matrix.diagonal d*(U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ) (i : n) :
    ‖d i‖ ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty n := ⟨i⟩
  have hs : spectrum ℂ A = Set.range d := by
    rw [hU]
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Unitary.coe_star,spectrum_diagonal] using
      (Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal d) (U := U))
  have hm : d i ∈ spectrum ℂ A := hs.symm ▸ Set.mem_range_self i
  simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hm

name: NLAlib.measureReal_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    (α : Fin 2 → ℕ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | r < |tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy
      (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b) (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) α|} ≤
      2*exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*r^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,d,hU⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  let f : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => tensorNormalizedChebyshev α
    (WithLp.ofLp (Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr z))
  have hf : ∀ i, f (d i) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    apply abs_le.mp
    apply abs_tensorNormalizedChebyshev_le_one
    have hz := (norm_diagonal_atom_le_specNorm U d hU i).trans hbound
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact abs_le.mp ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm (d i)).trans hz)
    · exact abs_le.mp ((Complex.abs_im_le_norm (d i)).trans hz)
  have he (b : n → ℂ) : tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy
      (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b) (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) α =
      (∫ z, f z ∂normalSpectralLaw hA b) - ∫ z, f z ∂normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA := by
    rw [tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy,normalCoordinateSpectralLaw,
      normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw,integral_map
      Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
      (by fun_prop),integral_map
      Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [he]
  exact measureReal_normalSpectralLaw_integral_sub_empirical_gt_le hA U d hU f hf hr

name: NLAlib.measureReal_exists_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    (M : ℕ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | ∃ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
      r < |tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
        (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) α|} ≤
      (tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M).card *
        (2*exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*r^2/2))
proof:
:= by
  let E := fun α : Fin 2 → ℕ => {b : n → ℂ |
    r < |tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
      (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) α|}
  change (complexSphereVector n).real {b | ∃ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,b ∈ E α} ≤ _
  have he : {b | ∃ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,b ∈ E α} =
      ⋃ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,E α := by ext b;simp
  rw [he]
  apply (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
        2*exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*r^2/2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun α _ => measureReal_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_gt_le hA hbound α hr
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.normalTensorMomentRadius_pos
statement:
theorem normalTensorMomentRadius_pos {n M : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) : 0 < normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ
proof:
:= by
  have hnp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hKnat : 1 ≤ (M+1)^2-1 := by
    have : 4 ≤ (M+1)^2 := by nlinarith
    omega
  have hK : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hKnat
  have hden : 0 < 2*(n : ℝ)-1 := by linarith
  apply sqrt_pos.mpr
  apply mul_pos (div_pos (by norm_num) hden)
  apply log_pos
  exact (one_lt_div hδ).mpr (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.card_mul_exp_normalTensorMomentRadius_le
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ := ((M+1)^2-1 : ℕ)
  have hnp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hKnat : 1 ≤ (M+1)^2-1 := by
    have : 4 ≤ (M+1)^2 := by nlinarith
    omega
  have hK : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K := by dsimp [K];exact_mod_cast hKnat
  have hden : 0 < 2*(n : ℝ)-1 := by linarith
  have harg : 1 < 2*K/δ := (one_lt_div hδ).mpr (by linarith)
  have hl : 0 < log (2*K/δ) := log_pos harg
  have hsq : normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ ^ 2 =
      8/(2*(n : ℝ)-1)*log (2*K/δ) := by
    unfold normalTensorMomentRadius
    exact sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hl.le)
  have hc : 1 ≤ 4*(n : ℝ)/(2*(n : ℝ)-1) := (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr (by linarith)
  have hexp : exp (-(n : ℝ)*(normalTensorMomentRadius n M δ)^2/2) ≤ δ/(2*K) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ exp (-log (2*K/δ)) := by
        apply exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [hsq]
        have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hl.le
        calc
          _ = -(4*(n : ℝ)/(2*(n : ℝ)-1)*log (2*K/δ)) := by ring
          _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [one_mul] using neg_le_neg h
      _ = δ/(2*K) := by rw [exp_neg,exp_log (by positivity)];field_simp
  change K*(2*exp _) ≤ δ
  calc
    _ ≤ K*(2*(δ/(2*K))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by norm_num)) (by linarith)
    _ = δ := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_exists_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_radius_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_radius_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | ∃ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
      normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ <
        |tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
          (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) α|} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (measureReal_exists_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_gt_le hA hbound M
    (normalTensorMomentRadius_pos Fintype.card_pos hM hδ hδ1)).trans
  rw [card_tensorChebyshevMomentIndices]
  exact card_mul_exp_normalTensorMomentRadius_le Fintype.card_pos hM hδ hδ1

name: NLAlib.measureReal_normalTensorMomentError_radius_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_normalTensorMomentError_radius_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ = Aᴴ*A) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b |
      normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ * sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) <
        tensorChebyshevMomentError (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
          (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) M} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans
    (measureReal_exists_normalTensorMomentDiscrepancy_radius_gt_le hA hbound hM hδ hδ1)
  intro b hb
  change normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ * sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) <
    tensorChebyshevMomentError (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
      (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) M at hb
  by_contra he
  have hcoord : ∀ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
      |tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
        (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) α| ≤
        normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ := by
    intro α hα
    exact le_of_not_gt (fun h => he ⟨α,hα,h⟩)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (tensorChebyshevMomentError_le_of_discrepancy_le _ _ hM
    (normalTensorMomentRadius_pos Fintype.card_pos hM hδ hδ1).le hcoord)) hb

name: NLAlib.measurable_chebyshevGridIndex
statement:
theorem measurable_chebyshevGridIndex (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    Measurable (chebyshevGridIndex g hg)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x => min ⌊(g : ℝ) * Real.arccos x / Real.pi⌋₊ (g - 1)) :=
    (Nat.measurable_floor.comp
      ((Real.continuous_arccos.measurable.const_mul (g : ℝ)).div_const Real.pi)).min measurable_const
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding (Fin.val : Fin g → ℕ) :=
    ⟨Fin.val_injective, measurable_of_finite _, fun s _ => (Set.to_countable _).measurableSet⟩
  exact he.measurable_comp_iff.mp hm

name: NLAlib.abs_arccos_sub_chebyshevGridAngle_le
statement:
theorem abs_arccos_sub_chebyshevGridAngle_le (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.arccos x - chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x)| ≤ Real.pi / (2 * g)
proof:
:= by
  let y : ℝ := (g : ℝ) * Real.arccos x / Real.pi
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.arccos_nonneg x))
    Real.pi_pos.le
  have hyg : y ≤ g := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.arccos_le_pi x) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hf := Nat.floor_le hy0
  have hfu := Nat.lt_floor_add_one y
  let i : ℕ := min ⌊y⌋₊ (g - 1)
  have hil : (i : ℝ) ≤ y := (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.min_le_left _ _)).trans hf
  have hiu : y ≤ (i : ℝ) + 1 := by
    by_cases h : ⌊y⌋₊ ≤ g - 1
    · simpa only [i, min_eq_left h] using hfu.le
    · have he : i = g - 1 := min_eq_right (by omega)
      have hg' : ((g - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = g := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ g))
      simpa only [he, hg'] using hyg
  have hgpos : (0 : ℝ) < g := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hg
  have hscale : Real.arccos x - chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x) =
      (y - ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * (Real.pi / g) := by
    simp only [chebyshevGridAngle, chebyshevGridIndex]
    change Real.arccos x - (2 * (i : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / (2 * g) = _
    dsimp [y]
    field_simp
  rw [hscale, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (div_pos Real.pi_pos hgpos)]
  have hi : |y - ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (Real.pi / g) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshev_sub_grid_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_chebyshev_sub_grid_le (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (j : ℕ) :
    |(T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x - (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x))| ≤
      j * Real.pi / (2 * g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos := Real.abs_cos_sub_cos_le
    ((j : ℝ) * Real.arccos x) ((j : ℝ) * chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x))
  have hT : (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x = Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * Real.arccos x) := by
    calc
      _ = (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos (Real.arccos x)) := by rw [Real.cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2]
      _ = _ := by simp [T_real_cos]
  have hTgrid : (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x)) =
      Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x)) := by
    rw [chebyshevZero, T_real_cos]
    simp only [Int.cast_natCast, chebyshevGridAngle]
  rw [hT, hTgrid]
  calc
    _ ≤ |(j : ℝ) * Real.arccos x - (j : ℝ) *
        chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x)| := hcos
    _ = (j : ℝ) * |Real.arccos x - chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x)| := by
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j)]
    _ ≤ (j : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (2 * g)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_arccos_sub_chebyshevGridAngle_le g hg x) (Nat.cast_nonneg j)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram

theorem run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (S : ℝ)

    (normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (((normalSpectralQuadratureProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle (S⁻¹•A))).map
        (fun z => S•z))
proof:
:= by

    ← matrixAdjointOracle_real_smul]

name: NLAlib.isProbabilityMeasure_run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    (b : n → ℂ) (hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖=1) (M : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure ((normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram]
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_run_normalSpectralQuadratureProgram
    (normal_real_smul hA S⁻¹) b hb (specNorm_inv_smul_le_one hS hbound) M

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    (b : n → ℂ) (hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖=1) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    wassersteinEDistOne
      ((normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A))
      ((normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (72*S/M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram, run_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram]
  have hB := normal_real_smul hA S⁻¹
  have hBn := specNorm_inv_smul_le_one hS hbound
  rw [run_normalSpectralDensityProgram hB b hb hBn]
  have hw := wassersteinEDistOne_map_real_smul_le
    ((normalSpectralQuadratureProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle (S⁻¹•A)))
    (normalSpectralDensityKernelLaw hB b M) hS
  apply hw.trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal S*ENNReal.ofReal (24/(M:ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (wassersteinEDistOne_run_normalSpectralQuadratureProgram_le hB b hb hBn hM) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (72*S/M) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hS.le]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      calc
        _ = 24*S/M := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg M)

name: NLAlib.exists_finite_support_run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram
statement:
theorem exists_finite_support_run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    (b : n → ℂ) (hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖=1) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℂ, s.card ≤ (M+1)^2 ∧
      (normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) (s : Set ℂ)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [run_normalScaledSpectralQuadratureProgram]
  obtain ⟨s,hcard,hnull⟩ := exists_finite_support_run_normalSpectralQuadratureProgram
    (normal_real_smul hA S⁻¹) b hb (specNorm_inv_smul_le_one hS hbound) M
  let t := s.image (fun z => S•z)
  refine ⟨t,Finset.card_image_le.trans hcard,?_⟩
  apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
  have hh : ∀ᵐ z ∂((normalSpectralQuadratureProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle (S⁻¹•A))).map
      (fun z => S•z), z ∈ (t : Set ℂ) := by
    apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop)
      (p := fun z : ℂ => z ∈ (t : Set ℂ)) t.finite_toSet.measurableSet).mpr
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hnull] with z hz
    have hz' : z ∈ s := by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff,not_not,Finset.mem_coe] using hz
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨z,hz',rfl⟩
  filter_upwards [hh] with z hz
  exact fun he => he hz

name: NLAlib.map_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw_symm
statement:
theorem map_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw_symm {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (b : n → ℂ) :
    (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b).map Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm =
      normalSpectralLaw hA b
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalCoordinateSpectralLaw, Measure.map_map
    Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm.continuous.measurable
    Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.continuous.measurable]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: NLAlib.ae_norm_le_normalSpectralLaw
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,d,hU⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  rw [normalSpectralLaw_eq_diagonalSpectralLaw hA U d hU b, diagonalSpectralLaw,
    ae_finsetSum_measure_iff]
  intro i _
  let : Nonempty n := ⟨i⟩
  apply Measure.ae_smul_measure
  apply (ae_dirac_iff (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const)).mpr
  have hs : spectrum ℂ A = Set.range d := by
    rw [hU]
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, spectrum_diagonal] using
      (Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal d) (U := U))
  have hm : d i ∈ spectrum ℂ A := hs.symm ▸ Set.mem_range_self i
  simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hm

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_chebyshevCube_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalCoordinateSpectralLaw, ae_map_iff
    Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable]
  filter_upwards [ae_norm_le_normalSpectralLaw hA b] with z hz
  have hz1 := hz.trans hbound
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact abs_le.mp ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm z).trans hz1)
  · exact abs_le.mp ((Complex.abs_im_le_norm z).trans hz1)
  · exact isCompact_chebyshevCube.isClosed.measurableSet

name: NLAlib.weightedChebyshevError_restrict_right

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRegressionWeights_minimizes
statement:
theorem chebyshevRegressionWeights_minimizes (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (mhat : ℕ → ℝ)
    (a : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin ⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊)) :
    weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments (chebyshevRegressionWeights k hk mhat).val) mhat ≤
      weightedChebyshevError k (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) mhat
proof:
:= by
  rw [← weightedChebyshevError_restrict_right k _ mhat,
    ← weightedChebyshevError_restrict_right k (chebyshevGridMoments a.val) mhat]
  exact (exists_minimizer_weightedChebyshevError_gridMoments
    (g := ⌈(k : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)⌉₊)
    k
    (Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
      (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (show 0 < k by omega)) _))
      (restrictChebyshevMoments k mhat)).choose_spec.2 a.val a.property

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRegressionWeights_congr
proof:
:= by
  have he : restrictChebyshevMoments k a = restrictChebyshevMoments k b := by
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k
    · simp [restrictChebyshevMoments, hj, h j hj]
    · simp [restrictChebyshevMoments, hj]
  unfold chebyshevRegressionWeights
  rw [he]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_empiricalSpectralLaw_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_empiricalSpectralLaw_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) =>
      G ω e.1 e.2)
      (rademacherVector (n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ENNReal.ofReal ((38 + Real.pi / 2) / k) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (empiricalSpectralLaw hA)
        (chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate A k (by omega) δ (G ω))} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (measureReal_mono (s₂ := {ω | 1 / (k : ℝ) < weightedChebyshevError k
      (chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate A (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ)
        (chebyshevProbeBudget_nonneg _ _ _) (G ω))
      (fun j => (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))).trace / Fintype.card n)})
    ?_ (measure_ne_top _ _)).trans
    (measureReal_weightedChebyshevError_traceMomentEstimate_gt_le hA hbound hk hδ hδ1 hG)
  intro ω hω
  by_contra hbad
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hbad hω
  have hn := le_of_not_gt hbad
  have hm : (fun j : ℕ => (aeval A (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))).trace / Fintype.card n) =
      chebyshevMoments (empiricalSpectralLaw hA) :=
    funext fun j => (chebyshevMoments_empiricalSpectralLaw hA j).symm
  rw [hm] at hn
  have hw := wassersteinEDistOne_gridLaw_le_of_ceil_rpow_three_div_two
    (empiricalSpectralLaw hA) (ae_mem_Icc_empiricalSpectralLaw hA hbound) (by omega)
    _ hn (chebyshevRegressionWeights k (by omega) _) (η := 0)
    (fun a => (chebyshevRegressionWeights_minimizes k (by omega) _ a).trans_eq (by simp))
  have hc : (36 + Real.pi / 2) / (k : ℝ) + 2 * (1 / k) + 0 =
      (38 + Real.pi / 2) / k := by ring
  rw [hc] at hw
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hw) hω

name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_empiricalSpectralLaw_scaled_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_empiricalSpectralLaw_scaled_gt_le
    [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {G : Ω → Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ}
    (hG : HasLaw (fun ω (e : n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) =>
      G ω e.1 e.2)
      (rademacherVector (n × Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1))) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ENNReal.ofReal ((38 + Real.pi / 2) * S / k) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (empiricalSpectralLaw hA)
        ((chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate (S⁻¹ • A) k (by omega) δ (G ω)).map
          (fun x => S * x))} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let B := S⁻¹ • A
  have hB : B.IsHermitian := hA.smul (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint])
  have hnorm : specNorm B ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hS.le)]
    calc
      _ ≤ S⁻¹ * S := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (inv_nonneg.mpr hS.le)
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hS.ne'
  have hlaw : (empiricalSpectralLaw hB).map (fun x => S * x) = empiricalSpectralLaw hA := by
    have hh := empiricalSpectralLaw_smul hB S
    simpa only [B, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hS.ne', one_smul] using hh.symm
  apply (measureReal_mono (s₂ := {ω | ENNReal.ofReal ((38 + Real.pi / 2) / k) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (empiricalSpectralLaw hB)
        (chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate B k (by omega) δ (G ω))})
    ?_ (measure_ne_top _ _)).trans
    (measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_empiricalSpectralLaw_gt_le hB hnorm hk hδ hδ1 hG)
  intro ω hω
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hω ⊢
  by_contra hn
  have hw := wassersteinEDistOne_map_mul_le (empiricalSpectralLaw hB)
    (chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate B k (by omega) δ (G ω)) hS
  rw [hlaw] at hw
  have hw' := hw.trans (mul_le_mul_right (le_of_not_gt hn) (ENNReal.ofReal S))
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hS.le] at hw'
  have he : S * ((38 + Real.pi / 2) / (k : ℝ)) = (38 + Real.pi / 2) * S / k := by ring
  rw [he] at hw'
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hw') hω

name: NLAlib.spectralDensity_constant_div_ceil_le
statement:
theorem spectralDensity_constant_div_ceil_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (38 + Real.pi / 2) / (⌈(38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < 38 + Real.pi / 2 := by positivity
  have hceil : 0 < ⌈(38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε⌉₊ :=
    Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr (div_pos hc hε)
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hceil)).2
  have := Nat.le_ceil ((38 + Real.pi / 2) / ε)
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp this |>.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)

proof:

    calc
      _ = ‖hA.eigenvalues i‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm

name: NLAlib.empiricalSpectralLaw_smul
statement:
theorem empiricalSpectralLaw_smul {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (S : ℝ) :
    empiricalSpectralLaw (hA.smul (show IsSelfAdjoint S by simp [IsSelfAdjoint])) =
      (empiricalSpectralLaw hA).map (fun x => S * x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext
  intro E hE
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)).mp
  change (empiricalSpectralLaw (hA.smul (show IsSelfAdjoint S by simp [IsSelfAdjoint]))).real E =
    ((empiricalSpectralLaw hA).map (fun x => S * x)).real E
  rw [← integral_indicator_one hE, ← integral_indicator_one hE]
  change (∫ x, E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x ∂empiricalSpectralLaw _) =
    ∫ x, E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x ∂(empiricalSpectralLaw hA).map (fun x => S * x)
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => S * x) (empiricalSpectralLaw hA))
      ((measurable_const.indicator hE).aestronglyMeasurable),
    integral_empiricalSpectralLaw_eq_trace_cfc, integral_empiricalSpectralLaw_eq_trace_cfc]
  rw [cfc_comp_const_mul S _ A
    (((spectrum ℝ A).toFinite.image _).continuousOn _) hA.isSelfAdjoint]

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_normalSpectralDensityKernelLaw_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_normalSpectralDensityKernelLaw_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (hb : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖=1)
    (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    wassersteinEDistOne (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA) (normalSpectralDensityKernelLaw hA b M) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (36/M + π*tensorChebyshevMomentError (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
        (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) M)
proof:
:= by
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b hb
  have hν := ae_mem_chebyshevCube_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b hbound
  have hμ := ae_mem_chebyshevCube_normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA hbound
  have ht := wassersteinEDistOne_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_le_momentError
    (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b) hμ hν hM
  have hs : sqrt ((2:ℝ)*π^2/2) = π := by
    rw [show (2:ℝ)*π^2/2=π^2 by ring, sqrt_sq pi_pos.le]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at ht
  rw [hs, tensorChebyshevMomentError_comm] at ht
  have hm := wassersteinEDistOne_map_le_mul (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA)
    (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw (chebyshevCubeLift (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)) M)
    (K := 1) one_ne_zero Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm.isometry.lipschitz
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, map_normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw_symm] at hm
  exact hm.trans ht

name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalSpectralDensityProgram_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalSpectralDensityProgram_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ 1)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b |
      ENNReal.ofReal (84/M + π*normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ *
        sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M)) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA)
        ((normalSpectralDensityProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A))} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ∀ᵐ b : n → ℂ ∂complexSphereVector n, b ∈ {b : n → ℂ |
      ENNReal.ofReal (84/M + π*normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ *
        sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M)) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA)
        ((normalSpectralDensityProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A))} →
      b ∈ {b | normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ *sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) <
        tensorChebyshevMomentError (normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b)
          (normalEmpiricalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA) M} := by
    filter_upwards [ae_norm_eq_one_complexSphereVector (n := n)] with b hb
    intro hbad
    change ENNReal.ofReal _ < _ at hbad
    by_contra he
    have he' := le_of_not_gt he
    have hw := wassersteinEDistOne_normalSpectralDensityKernelLaw_le hA b hb hbound
      (show 1 ≤ M by omega)
    rw [run_normalSpectralDensityProgram hA b hb hbound] at hbad
    apply (not_lt_of_ge (hw.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_))) hbad
    have hdet : (36:ℝ)/M ≤ 84/M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg M)
    have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he' pi_pos.le
    nlinarith
  have hm := ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top (complexSphereVector n) _)
    (measure_mono_ae hsub)
  exact hm.trans (measureReal_normalTensorMomentError_radius_gt_le hA hbound (by omega) hδ hδ1)

name: NLAlib.normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_smul
statement:
theorem normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_smul {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (S : ℝ) :
    normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw (normal_real_smul hA S) =
      (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA).map (fun z => S•z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,d,hU⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hA
  have hUs : S•A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ)*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => S•d i)*(U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ := by
    have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => S•d i) = S•Matrix.diagonal d := by
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i=j <;> simp [hij]
    rw [hU, hd]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul]
  rw [normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_uniformComplexSpectralLaw _ U _ hUs,
    normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_eq_uniformComplexSpectralLaw hA U d hU]
  have hf : Measurable (fun z : ℂ => S•z) := by fun_prop
  simp only [uniformComplexSpectralLaw, Measure.map_smul,
    Measure.map_finset_sum' hf.aemeasurable, Measure.map_dirac' hf]
