name: NLAlib.measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b |
      ENNReal.ofReal (S*(84/M + π*normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ *
        sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M))) <
      wassersteinEDistOne (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA)
        ((normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram S b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A))} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let B := S⁻¹•A
  have hB := normal_real_smul hA S⁻¹
  have hBn := specNorm_inv_smul_le_one hS hbound
  have hlaw : (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hB).map (fun z => S•z) = normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hA := by
    have hh := normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw_smul hB S
    simpa only [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hS.ne', one_smul] using hh.symm
  apply (measureReal_mono (s₂ := {b : n → ℂ |
      ENNReal.ofReal (84/M + π*normalTensorMomentRadius (Fintype.card n) M δ *
        sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M)) < wassersteinEDistOne (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hB)
        ((normalSpectralDensityProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle B))}) ?_).trans
    (measureReal_wassersteinEDistOne_normalSpectralDensityProgram_gt_le hB hBn hM hδ hδ1)
  intro b hbad
  change ENNReal.ofReal _ < _ at hbad
  change ENNReal.ofReal _ < _
  by_contra hnot
  have hs := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hw := wassersteinEDistOne_map_real_smul_le (normalEmpiricalSpectralLaw hB)
    ((normalSpectralDensityProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle B)) hS
  rw [hlaw, ← run_normalScaledSpectralDensityProgram] at hw
  have hh := hw.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by positivity))
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hS.le] at hh
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) hbad

name: NLAlib.chebyshevQueryCount_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chebyshevQueryCount_eq_sum (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevQueryCount a k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, chebyshevProbeCount a j
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [chebyshevQueryCount]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [chebyshevQueryCount, ih, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    omega

name: NLAlib.chebyshev_next_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hj]
    have hjpos : 1 ≤ j := by omega
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Chebyshev.T_add_one,
      map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_ofNat, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
    rw [show (j : ℤ) - 1 = ((j - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega]
    congr 1
    simp only [show (2 : Matrix n n ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) by
      ext i l; simp [Matrix.ofNat_apply, Matrix.one_apply], Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.run_chebyshevTableProgram_apply
statement:
theorem run_chebyshevTableProgram_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (S : ℝ) (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount a 1)) ℝ) (k j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k)
    (i : Fin (chebyshevProbeCount a 1)) (hi : j = 0 ∨ i.val < chebyshevProbeCount a j) :
    ((chebyshevTableProgram a ha S G k).run A.mulVec j).col i =
      (aeval (S⁻¹ • A) (Chebyshev.T ℝ (j : ℤ))) *ᵥ G.col i
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing j i with
  | zero =>
    have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst j
    simp [chebyshevTableProgram, QueryProgram.run]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hjlast : j = k + 1
    · subst j
      have hia : i.val < chebyshevProbeCount a (k + 1) := hi.resolve_left (by omega)
      have hik : k = 0 ∨ i.val < chebyshevProbeCount a k := by
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · exact Or.inl hk
        · exact Or.inr (hia.trans_le (chebyshevProbeCount_antitone ha
            (by change 1 ≤ k; omega) (by change 1 ≤ k + 1; omega) (by omega)))
      have hcur := ih k le_rfl i hik
      have hprev : k - 1 = 0 ∨ i.val < chebyshevProbeCount a (k - 1) := by
        by_cases hk : k - 1 = 0
        · exact Or.inl hk
        · exact Or.inr (hia.trans_le (chebyshevProbeCount_antitone ha
            (by change 1 ≤ k - 1; omega) (by change 1 ≤ k + 1; omega) (by omega)))
      have hpr := ih (k - 1) (by omega) i hprev
      rw [chebyshevTableProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, chebyshevTableStep,
        QueryProgram.run_map, QueryProgram.run_family, Function.update_self,
        chebyshev_next_mulVec]
      have hindex : probeIndex ha k ⟨i.val, hia⟩ = i := Fin.ext rfl
      ext r
      simp only [Matrix.col_apply, dif_pos hia, hindex, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
        Matrix.smul_mulVec, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have hp := congrFun hpr r
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hk, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [hcur]
      · simp only [if_neg hk, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [hcur]
        exact congrArg (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (S⁻¹ * (A *ᵥ
          ((aeval (S⁻¹ • A)) (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)) *ᵥ G.col i)) r) - x) hp
    · have hjk : j ≤ k := by omega
      rw [chebyshevTableProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, chebyshevTableStep,
        QueryProgram.run_map, QueryProgram.run_family, Function.update_of_ne hjlast]
      exact ih j hjk i hi

name: NLAlib.run_chebyshevMomentProgram_apply
statement:
theorem run_chebyshevMomentProgram_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (S : ℝ) (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount a 1)) ℝ) (k j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k) :
    (chebyshevMomentProgram a ha S G k).run A.mulVec j =
      chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate (S⁻¹ • A) a ha G j
proof:
:= by
  have hj1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1
  have hjk := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).2
  simp only [chebyshevMomentProgram, QueryProgram.run_map, dif_pos hj1,
    chebyshevTraceMomentEstimate, hutchinsonEstimate, Fintype.card_fin]
  congr 2
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  rw [run_chebyshevTableProgram_apply A a ha S G k j hjk _ (Or.inr t.isLt)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.run_chebyshevDensityProgram
statement:
theorem run_chebyshevDensityProgram (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (S δ : ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ) :
    (chebyshevDensityProgram k hk S δ G).run A.mulVec =
      (chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate (S⁻¹ • A) k hk δ G).map (fun x => S * x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chebyshevDensityProgram, QueryProgram.run_map, chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate]
  congr 2
  apply chebyshevRegressionWeights_congr
  intro j hj
  exact run_chebyshevMomentProgram_apply A _ _ S G k j hj

name: NLAlib.exists_matvecAlg_chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate
statement:
theorem exists_matvecAlg_chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (S δ : ℝ)
    (G : Matrix n (Fin (chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) 1)) ℝ) :
    ∃ alg : MatvecAlg ℝ n (MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ),
      alg.cost = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k,
        chebyshevProbeCount (chebyshevProbeBudget (Fintype.card n) k δ) j ∧
      ∀ A : Matrix n n ℝ, alg.run A =
        (chebyshevSpectralDensityEstimate (S⁻¹ • A) k hk δ G).map (fun x => S * x)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨⟨_, chebyshevDensityProgram k hk S δ G⟩,
    chebyshevQueryCount_eq_sum _ _, fun A => run_chebyshevDensityProgram A k hk S δ G⟩

name: NLAlib.gaussianReal_abs_le_le_sqrt_two_div_pi
statement:
private theorem gaussianReal_abs_le_le_sqrt_two_div_pi (t : ℝ) :
    gaussianReal 0 1 {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ t} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * t)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hc : Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) = 2 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 / Real.pi)]
    have he : (2 / Real.pi) * (2 * Real.pi) = 4 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [he]
    convert Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs (2 : ℝ) using 1 <;> norm_num
  have hpdf (x : ℝ) : gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
    rw [gaussianPDFReal_def]
    simp only [NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])) (inv_nonneg.mpr hp.le)).trans
      (by rw [mul_one])
  have hset : {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ t} = Icc (-t) t := by ext x; simp [abs_le]
  rw [hset, gaussianReal_apply 0 (by norm_num : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0)]
  calc
    (∫⁻ x in Icc (-t) t, gaussianPDF 0 1 x) ≤
        ∫⁻ _ in Icc (-t) t, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ :=
      lintegral_mono fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hpdf x)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * t)) := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Icc,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hp.le)]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hp.ne')
      calc
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * t) * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) = 2 * t := by
          field_simp
        _ = (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) * t := by rw [hc]
        _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_dotProduct_le_mulVec_norm
statement:
private theorem exists_unit_dotProduct_le_mulVec_norm [Nonempty m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : specNorm A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧
      ∀ x, specNorm A * |v ⬝ᵥ x| ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < specNorm A := lt_of_le_of_ne (specNorm_nonneg A) (Ne.symm hA)
  have hGram : (A * Aᵀ).IsHermitian := by
    simpa using Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self Aᵀ
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hq⟩ := exists_unit_abs_quadForm_eq_specNorm hGram
  let w : n → ℝ := Aᵀ *ᵥ u
  have hw : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = specNorm A := by
    have hquad : quadForm (A * Aᵀ) u = w ⬝ᵥ w := by
      simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
        star_trivial] using quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self Aᵀ u
    have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ w := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self w
    rw [hquad, abs_of_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg w)] at hq
    have hgramnorm : specNorm (A * Aᵀ) = specNorm A ^ 2 := by
      simpa using specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self A
    rw [hgramnorm] at hq
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 w)]
  let v : n → ℝ := (specNorm A)⁻¹ • w
  have hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [v, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpos), hw, inv_mul_cancel₀ hA]
  refine ⟨v, hv, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hd : specNorm A * (v ⬝ᵥ x) = u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
    simp only [v, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hA, one_mul]
    simp only [w, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_transpose]
  have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm (WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x))
  have hi : inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x)) =
      u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]
  rw [hi, hu, one_mul, ← hd, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpos] at hcs
  exact hcs

name: NLAlib.le_gaussianResidualMaximum
statement:
private theorem le_gaussianResidualMaximum (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (g : κ → n → ℝ) (j : κ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ g j)‖ ≤ gaussianResidualMaximum A g
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianResidualMaximum
  exact Finset.le_sup' (fun j => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ g j)‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: NLAlib.gaussianResidualMaximum_nonneg
statement:
private theorem gaussianResidualMaximum_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (g : κ → n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ gaussianResidualMaximum A g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := ‹Nonempty κ›
  exact (norm_nonneg _).trans (le_gaussianResidualMaximum A g j)

name: NLAlib.measure_specNorm_gt_gaussianResidualMaximum_le
statement:
theorem measure_specNorm_gt_gaussianResidualMaximum_le
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α)
    {g : κ → Ω → n → ℝ} (hg : ∀ j, HasLaw (g j) (gaussianVector n) μ)
    (hind : iIndepFun g μ) :
    μ {ω | α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum A (fun j => g j ω) <
      specNorm A} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((α⁻¹) ^ Fintype.card κ)
proof:
:= by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_trans (by norm_num) hα
  have hc : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  by_cases hA : specNorm A = 0
  · have hempty : {ω | α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum A (fun j => g j ω) <
        specNorm A} = ∅ := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_lt, hA]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hαpos.le hc.le) (gaussianResidualMaximum_nonneg A _)
    rw [hempty, measure_empty]
    exact zero_le
  have hm : Nonempty m := by
    by_contra hempty
    have : IsEmpty m := not_nonempty_iff.mp hempty
    have hzero : A = 0 := Matrix.ext fun i _ => isEmptyElim i
    exact hA (by rw [hzero, specNorm_zero])
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hdom⟩ := exists_unit_dotProduct_le_mulVec_norm A hA
  let t : ℝ := (α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi))⁻¹
  let E : κ → Set Ω := fun j => {ω | |v ⬝ᵥ g j ω| ≤ t}
  have hset : MeasurableSet {x : n → ℝ | |v ⬝ᵥ x| ≤ t} := by
    apply measurableSet_le _ measurable_const
    unfold dotProduct
    fun_prop
  have hscalar : MeasurableSet {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ t} :=
    measurableSet_le measurable_id.abs measurable_const
  have hE (j : κ) : μ (E j) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal α⁻¹ := by
    have hl := (hasLaw_dotProduct_gaussianVector v hv).comp (hg j)
    have heq : μ (E j) = gaussianReal 0 1 {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ t} := by
      exact hl.measure_eq hscalar
    rw [heq]
    apply (gaussianReal_abs_le_le_sqrt_two_div_pi t).trans_eq
    congr 1
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
  have hsub : {ω | α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum A (fun j => g j ω) <
      specNorm A} ⊆ ⋂ j, E j := by
    intro ω hω
    change α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum A (fun j => g j ω) <
      specNorm A at hω
    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
    intro j
    have hpos : 0 < specNorm A := lt_of_le_of_ne (specNorm_nonneg A) (Ne.symm hA)
    have hdom' := (hdom (g j ω)).trans (le_gaussianResidualMaximum A (fun j => g j ω) j)
    have hprod : (α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi)) * |v ⬝ᵥ g j ω| < 1 := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdom' (mul_nonneg hαpos.le hc.le)
      have : specNorm A * ((α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi)) * |v ⬝ᵥ g j ω|) <
          specNorm A * 1 := by
        calc
          _ = α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (specNorm A * |v ⬝ᵥ g j ω|) := by ring
          _ ≤ _ := hh
          _ < _ := by simpa only [mul_one] using hω
      exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ hpos).mp this
    change |v ⬝ᵥ g j ω| ≤ t
    rw [show t = 1 / (α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi)) by simp [t]]
    exact ((lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hαpos hc)).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hprod)).le
  calc
    μ _ ≤ μ (⋂ j, E j) := measure_mono hsub
    _ = ∏ j, μ (E j) := hind.meas_iInter (fun j => ⟨_, hset, rfl⟩)
    _ ≤ ∏ _j : κ, ENNReal.ofReal α⁻¹ :=
      Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => zero_le) (fun j _ => hE j)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (inv_nonneg.mpr hαpos.le)]

name: NLAlib.measurable_gaussianResidualMaximum
statement:
private theorem measurable_gaussianResidualMaximum :
    Measurable (fun p : Matrix m n ℝ × (κ → n → ℝ) => gaussianResidualMaximum p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianResidualMaximum
  have hf (j : κ) : Measurable (fun p : Matrix m n ℝ × (κ → n → ℝ) =>
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (p.1 *ᵥ p.2 j)‖) := by
    change Measurable (fun p : Matrix m n ℝ × (κ → n → ℝ) =>
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => ∑ k, p.1 i k * p.2 j k)‖)
    fun_prop
  have hm := Finset.measurable_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j _ => hf j)
  change Measurable (fun p => (Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
    (fun j (p : Matrix m n ℝ × (κ → n → ℝ)) => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (p.1 *ᵥ p.2 j)‖)) p) at hm
  simpa only [Finset.sup'_apply] using hm

name: NLAlib.measure_specNorm_gt_gaussianResidualMaximum_le_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem measure_specNorm_gt_gaussianResidualMaximum_le_of_indepFun
    {R : Ω → Matrix m n ℝ} {G : Ω → κ → n → ℝ}
    (hR : AEMeasurable R μ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (Measure.pi fun _ : κ => gaussianVector n) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun R G μ) {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) :
    μ {ω | α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum (R ω) (G ω) <
      specNorm (R ω)} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((α⁻¹) ^ Fintype.card κ)
proof:
:= by
  let E : Set (Matrix m n ℝ × (κ → n → ℝ)) :=
    {p | α * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum p.1 p.2 < specNorm p.1}
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := by
    apply measurableSet_lt
      ((measurable_gaussianResidualMaximum (m := m) (n := n) (κ := κ)).const_mul _)
    exact measurable_specNorm_of_entries fun i j => (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp measurable_fst
  have hfixed (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : κ => gaussianVector n) {g | (A, g) ∈ E} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((α⁻¹) ^ Fintype.card κ) :=
    measure_specNorm_gt_gaussianResidualMaximum_le A hα
      (fun j => (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : κ => gaussianVector n) j).hasLaw)
      (iIndepFun_pi fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  exact hind.measure_mem_le_of_forall hR hG hE hfixed

name: NLAlib.measure_exists_specNorm_gt_freshGaussianResidualMaximum_le
statement:
theorem measure_exists_specNorm_gt_freshGaussianResidualMaximum_le
    (F : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : ∀ t, F t ≤ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)
    (R : ℕ → Ω → Matrix m n ℝ) (hR : ∀ t, Measurable[F t] (R t))
    (s : ℕ → ℕ) (hs : ∀ t, 0 < s t)
    (G : ∀ t, Ω → Fin (s t) → n → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ t, HasLaw (G t) (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (s t) => gaussianVector n) μ)
    (hfresh : ∀ t, Indep (F t) (MeasurableSpace.comap (G t) inferInstance) μ)
    (α : ℕ → ℝ) (hα : ∀ t, 1 < α t) {δ : ℝ}
    (hbudget : (∑' t, ENNReal.ofReal (((α t)⁻¹) ^ s t)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ)
    (τ : Ω → WithTop ℕ) :
    letI : ∀ t, Nonempty (Fin (s t))
proof:
:= fun t => Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (hs t)
    μ {ω | ∃ t, α t * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum (R t ω) (G t ω) <
      specNorm (R t ω)} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧
    μ {ω | ∃ t : ℕ, τ ω = (t : WithTop ℕ) ∧
      α t * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum (R t ω) (G t ω) <
        specNorm (R t ω)} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  let : ∀ t, Nonempty (Fin (s t)) := fun t => Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (hs t)
  let E : ℕ → Set Ω := fun t => {ω |
    α t * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum (R t ω) (G t ω) < specNorm (R t ω)}
  have hstage (t : ℕ) : μ (E t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((α t)⁻¹) ^ s t) := by
    have hind : IndepFun (R t) (G t) μ := by
      rw [IndepFun_iff_Indep, Indep_iff]
      intro u v hu hv
      exact (Indep_iff _ _ _).mp (hfresh t) u v ((hR t).comap_le u hu) hv
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
      measure_specNorm_gt_gaussianResidualMaximum_le_of_indepFun
        ((hR t).mono (hF t) le_rfl).aemeasurable (hG t) hind (hα t)
  have hall : μ (⋃ t, E t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ :=
    (measure_iUnion_le E).trans ((ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hstage).trans hbudget)
  have he : {ω | ∃ t, α t * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) *
      gaussianResidualMaximum (R t ω) (G t ω) < specNorm (R t ω)} = ⋃ t, E t := by
    ext ω
    simp [E]
  refine ⟨he ▸ hall, ?_⟩
  apply (measure_mono (show {ω | ∃ t : ℕ, τ ω = (t : WithTop ℕ) ∧
      α t * Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * gaussianResidualMaximum (R t ω) (G t ω) <
        specNorm (R t ω)} ⊆ ⋃ t, E t from ?_)).trans hall
  rintro ω ⟨t, _, ht⟩
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨t, ht⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_adjacent_eq_of_monotone_not_strictMono
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hn
  apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
  intro i
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hd (Fin.castSucc_le_succ i)) (h i)

name: NLAlib.interlacing_upper_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem interlacing_upper_of_adjacent {n : ℕ} (d b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hd : Monotone d) (h : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) :
    ∀ i j, i < j → b i ≤ d j
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  let l : Fin n := ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩
  exact (h i l rfl).trans (hd (show l ≤ j by change i.val + 1 ≤ j.val; omega))

name: NLAlib.val_succAbove_eq_ite
statement:
theorem val_succAbove_eq_ite {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (p.succAbove i).val = if i.val < p.val then i.val else i.val + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.succAbove, Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.bordered_interlacing_succAbove
statement:
theorem bordered_interlacing_succAbove {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (hb : Monotone b)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∀ i : Fin n,
      b (p.succ.succAbove i.castSucc) ≤ d (p.succAbove i) ∧
      d (p.succAbove i) ≤ b (p.succ.succAbove i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  constructor
  · apply le_trans (hb ?_) (h (p.succAbove i)).1
    change (p.succ.succAbove i.castSucc).val ≤ (p.succAbove i).val
    simp only [val_succAbove_eq_ite, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · apply le_trans (h (p.succAbove i)).2 (hb ?_)
    change (p.succAbove i).val + 1 ≤ (p.succ.succAbove i.succ).val
    simp only [val_succAbove_eq_ite, Fin.val_succ]
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: NLAlib.bordered_interlacing_forced_root
statement:
theorem bordered_interlacing_forced_root {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : d i.castSucc = d i.succ) :
    b i.castSucc.succ = d i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hidx : i.succ.castSucc = i.castSucc.succ := rfl
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa only [hidx, ← hi] using (h i.succ).1) (h i.castSucc).2

name: NLAlib.rank_one_interlacing_forced_root
statement:
theorem rank_one_interlacing_forced_root {n : ℕ}
    (d b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i < j → b i ≤ d j) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : d i.castSucc = d i.succ) : b i.castSucc = d i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa only [← hi] using hhi i.castSucc i.succ Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)
    (hlo i.castSucc)

name: Real.ciSup_add_ciSup_le_of_abs_sub_le
statement:
theorem ciSup_add_ciSup_le_of_abs_sub_le {T : Type*} [Nonempty T]
    (b x y : T → ℝ)
    (hplus : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => b t + x t))
    (hminus : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => b t - x t))
    (hcontract : ∀ t u, |y t - y u| ≤ |x t - x u|) :
    (⨆ t, b t + y t) + (⨆ t, b t - y t) ≤
      (⨆ t, b t + x t) + (⨆ t, b t - x t)
proof:
:= by
  apply ciSup_add_ciSup_le
  intro t u
  have hd := (le_abs_self (y t - y u)).trans (hcontract t u)
  rcases le_total (x t) (x u) with h | h
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr h)] at hd
    have ht := le_ciSup hminus t
    have hu := le_ciSup hplus u
    linarith
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h)] at hd
    have ht := le_ciSup hplus t
    have hu := le_ciSup hminus u
    linarith

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_of_boundaryOne_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_of_boundaryOne_eq_zero [ContractibleSpace X]
    (Γ : OneChain X) (hΓ : boundaryOne Γ = 0) : IsNullHomologous Γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic X
  let edge : X → C(I, X) := fun x =>
    H.toContinuousMap.comp ⟨fun t => (t, x), by fun_prop⟩
  let square : C(I, X) → C(I × I, X) := fun γ =>
    H.toContinuousMap.comp ⟨fun t => (t.1, γ t.2), by fun_prop⟩
  have hL (γ : C(I, X)) : left (square γ) = γ := by
    ext t
    simp [left, square]
  have hR (γ : C(I, X)) : right (square γ) = ContinuousMap.const I p := by
    ext t
    simp [right, square]
  have hB (γ : C(I, X)) : bottom (square γ) = edge (γ 0) := by
    ext t
    rfl
  have hT (γ : C(I, X)) : top (square γ) = edge (γ 1) := by
    ext t
    rfl
  let Q : OneChain X →ₗ[ℤ] TwoChain X :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ (fun γ => Finsupp.single (square γ) 1)
  let D : OneChain X →ₗ[ℤ] (X →₀ ℤ) :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ (fun _ => Finsupp.single p 1)
  let E : (X →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] OneChain X :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ (fun x => Finsupp.single (edge x) 1)
  have hfill : boundaryTwo.comp Q =
      constantChain.comp D - LinearMap.id - E.comp boundaryOne := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro γ k
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Q, D, E, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
      boundaryTwo, constantChain, boundaryOne, squareBoundary,
      hL, hR, hB, hT, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      smul_add, smul_sub, Finsupp.smul_single_one]
    abel
  have heq := LinearMap.congr_fun hfill Γ
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    hΓ, map_zero, sub_zero] at heq
  refine ⟨-(Q Γ), D Γ, ?_⟩
  rw [map_neg, heq]
  abel

name: Cubical.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_subtype_val_eq
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_subtype_val_eq (Γ : OneChain X) (S : Set X)
    [ContractibleSpace S] (hΓ : boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hs : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ t, γ t ∈ S) :
    ∃ Δ : OneChain S,
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(S, X)) Δ = Γ ∧
        IsNullHomologous Δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Δ, hΔ⟩ := exists_mapOne_subtype_val_eq Γ S hs
  refine ⟨Δ, hΔ, isNullHomologous_of_boundaryOne_eq_zero Δ ?_⟩
  apply mapZero_injective (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(S, X))
    Subtype.val_injective
  rw [map_zero, ← boundaryOne_mapOne, hΔ, hΓ]

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.horizontal_apply
statement:
theorem horizontal_apply (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (t : I) :
    Grid.horizontal (vertex x y) i j t =
      (lineMap (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ) + y j * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Grid.horizontal, vertex, Path.segment_apply, lineMap_apply_module]
  ring

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertical_apply
statement:
theorem vertical_apply (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin n) (t : I) :
    Grid.vertical (vertex x y) i j t =
      (x i : ℂ) + (lineMap (y j.castSucc) (y j.succ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Grid.vertical, vertex, Path.segment_apply, lineMap_apply_module]
  ring

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.horizontal_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem horizontal_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (hc : Grid.walkHorizontalCoefficients p q i j ≠ 0) (t : I) :
    (Grid.horizontal (vertex x y) i j t).re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧
      (Grid.horizontal (vertex x y) i j t).im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hj : j = p.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hc (by simp [Grid.walkHorizontalCoefficients, hne])
  subst j
  have hi : Grid.intervalCoefficients p.1 q.1 i ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Grid.walkHorizontalCoefficients] using hc
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := Grid.intervalCoefficients_ne_zero_bounds p.1 q.1 i hi
  have hl : min (x p.1) (x q.1) ≤ x i.castSucc := by
    rw [← hx.map_min]
    exact hx hlo
  have hh : x i.succ ≤ max (x p.1) (x q.1) := by
    rw [← hx.map_max]
    exact hx hhi
  have hm := hx i.castSucc_lt_succ.le
  rw [horizontal_apply]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero,
    Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, mul_one, zero_add]
  exact ⟨(convex_Icc _ _).lineMap_mem ⟨hl, hm.trans hh⟩ ⟨hl.trans hm, hh⟩ t.property,
    left_mem_uIcc⟩

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertical_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem vertical_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hy : Monotone y)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin n)
    (hc : Grid.walkVerticalCoefficients p q i j ≠ 0) (t : I) :
    (Grid.vertical (vertex x y) i j t).re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧
      (Grid.vertical (vertex x y) i j t).im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi : i = q.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hc (by simp [Grid.walkVerticalCoefficients, hne])
  subst i
  have hj : Grid.intervalCoefficients p.2 q.2 j ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Grid.walkVerticalCoefficients] using hc
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := Grid.intervalCoefficients_ne_zero_bounds p.2 q.2 j hj
  have hl : min (y p.2) (y q.2) ≤ y j.castSucc := by
    rw [← hy.map_min]
    exact hy hlo
  have hh : y j.succ ≤ max (y p.2) (y q.2) := by
    rw [← hy.map_max]
    exact hy hhi
  have hm := hy j.castSucc_lt_succ.le
  rw [vertical_apply]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero,
    Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, mul_one, zero_add]
  exact ⟨right_mem_uIcc,
    (convex_Icc _ _).lineMap_mem ⟨hl, hm.trans hh⟩ ⟨hl.trans hm, hh⟩ t.property⟩

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.walkChain_mem_rectangle
statement:
theorem walkChain_mem_rectangle
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∀ γ ∈ (Grid.walkChain (vertex x y) p q).support, ∀ t,
      (γ t).re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧ (γ t).im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact Grid.edgeChain_mapsTo_of_nonzero_edges_mapsTo (vertex x y)
    (Grid.walkHorizontalCoefficients p q) (Grid.walkVerticalCoefficients p q)
    {z : ℂ | z.re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧ z.im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)}
    (horizontal_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero x y hx p q)
    (vertical_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero x y hy p q)

name: Complex.norm_sub_lt_two_mul_of_mem_coordinate_rectangle
statement:
theorem norm_sub_lt_two_mul_of_mem_coordinate_rectangle
    {a b c z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (ha : ‖a - z‖ < r) (hb : ‖b - z‖ < r)
    (hr : c.re ∈ Set.uIcc a.re b.re) (hi : c.im ∈ Set.uIcc a.im b.im) :
    ‖c - z‖ < 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  have hra : |a.re - z.re| < r := by
    simpa only [sub_re] using (abs_re_le_norm (a - z)).trans_lt ha
  have hrb : |b.re - z.re| < r := by
    simpa only [sub_re] using (abs_re_le_norm (b - z)).trans_lt hb
  have hia : |a.im - z.im| < r := by
    simpa only [sub_im] using (abs_im_le_norm (a - z)).trans_lt ha
  have hib : |b.im - z.im| < r := by
    simpa only [sub_im] using (abs_im_le_norm (b - z)).trans_lt hb
  have hrc : |c.re - z.re| < r := by
    rw [abs_lt] at hra hrb ⊢
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hr with h | h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  have hic : |c.im - z.im| < r := by
    rw [abs_lt] at hia hib ⊢
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hi with h | h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  apply (norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans_lt
  simpa only [sub_re, sub_im] using (show |c.re - z.re| + |c.im - z.im| < 2 * r by linarith)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.walkChain_norm_sub_lt
statement:
theorem walkChain_norm_sub_lt
    {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y) (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1))
    {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hp : ‖vertex x y p.1 p.2 - z‖ < r)
    (hq : ‖vertex x y q.1 q.2 - z‖ < r) :
    ∀ γ ∈ (Grid.walkChain (vertex x y) p q).support, ∀ t, ‖γ t - z‖ < 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  intro γ hγ t
  obtain ⟨hr, hi⟩ := walkChain_mem_rectangle x y hx hy p q γ hγ t
  exact Complex.norm_sub_lt_two_mul_of_mem_coordinate_rectangle hp hq
    (by simpa only [vertex_re] using hr) (by simpa only [vertex_im] using hi)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.norm_cell_sub_center_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hre, him⟩ := cell_mem_rectangle x y hx hy i j p
  have hr : |(Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j p - center x y i j).re| ≤ h / 2 := by
    rw [Complex.sub_re, center_re, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [hre.1, hre.2]
  have hi : |(Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j p - center x y i j).im| ≤ h / 2 := by
    rw [Complex.sub_im, center_im, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [him.1, him.2]
  exact (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans (by linarith)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.norm_cell_sub_cell_le
proof:
:= by
  have hp := norm_cell_sub_center_le x y hx hy i j hwidth hheight p
  have hq := norm_cell_sub_center_le x y hx hy i j hwidth hheight q
  have ht := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub
    (Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j p) (center x y i j) (Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j q)
  rw [norm_sub_rev (center x y i j)] at ht
  linarith

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.strictMono_coordinate
statement:
theorem strictMono_coordinate (N : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    StrictMono (coordinate N h)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (sub_lt_sub_right (by exact_mod_cast hij) _) hh

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.coordinate_succ_sub_castSucc
statement:
theorem coordinate_succ_sub_castSucc (N : ℕ) (h : ℝ) (i : Fin (2 * N)) :
    coordinate N h i.succ - coordinate N h i.castSucc = h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinate, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.coe_floorIndex
statement:
theorem coe_floorIndex (N : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hlo : -(N : ℝ) ≤ u) (hhi : u < N) :
    (floorIndex N u hlo hhi : ℝ) = (⌊u⌋ : ℝ) + N
proof:
:= by
  have hl : -(N : ℤ) ≤ ⌊u⌋ := Int.le_floor.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hlo)
  have hn : 0 ≤ ⌊u⌋ + (N : ℤ) := by omega
  have he := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn
  change (((⌊u⌋ + (N : ℤ)).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = _
  exact_mod_cast he

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.coordinate_floorIndex_error
statement:
theorem coordinate_floorIndex_error (N : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (r : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(N : ℝ) ≤ r / h) (hhi : r / h < N) :
    coordinate N h (floorIndex N (r / h) hlo hhi) ≤ r ∧
      r - coordinate N h (floorIndex N (r / h) hlo hhi) < h
proof:
:= by
  have he : coordinate N h (floorIndex N (r / h) hlo hhi) = (⌊r / h⌋ : ℝ) * h := by
    rw [coordinate, coe_floorIndex]
    ring
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · exact (le_div_iff₀ hh).mp (Int.floor_le _)
  · have hf := (div_lt_iff₀ hh).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (r / h))
    nlinarith

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_normalized_coordinate_box
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_coordinate_box {C : Set ℂ} (hC : IsCompact C)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ C,
      (-(N : ℝ) ≤ z.re / h ∧ z.re / h < N) ∧
        (-(N : ℝ) ≤ z.im / h ∧ z.im / h < N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hRpos, hR⟩ := hC.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (R / h + 1)
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hnorm := hR z hz
  have hre := Complex.abs_re_le_norm z
  have him := Complex.abs_im_le_norm z
  have hNr : R / h < (N : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hpos : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by linarith [div_pos hRpos hh]
  have hr : -R ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ R := by
    constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self z.re, neg_le_abs z.re]
  have hi : -R ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ R := by
    constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self z.im, neg_le_abs z.im]
  constructor
  · constructor
    · have hd := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hh).mpr hr.1
      rw [neg_div] at hd
      linarith
    · exact ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hh).mpr hr.2).trans_lt hNr
  · constructor
    · have hd := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hh).mpr hi.1
      rw [neg_div] at hd
      linarith
    · exact ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hh).mpr hi.2).trans_lt hNr

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_quantizer
statement:
theorem exists_quantizer {C : Set ℂ} (hC : IsCompact C) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ q : C → Fin (2 * N + 1) × Fin (2 * N + 1),
      ∀ z : C, ‖vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h) (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_normalized_coordinate_box hC hh
  let q : C → Fin (2 * N + 1) × Fin (2 * N + 1) := fun z =>
    (floorIndex N (z.val.re / h) (hN z z.property).1.1 (hN z z.property).1.2,
      floorIndex N (z.val.im / h) (hN z z.property).2.1 (hN z z.property).2.2)
  refine ⟨N, q, ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hre := coordinate_floorIndex_error N hh z.val.re (hN z z.property).1.1 (hN z z.property).1.2
  have him := coordinate_floorIndex_error N hh z.val.im (hN z z.property).2.1 (hN z z.property).2.2
  apply (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans_lt
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, vertex_re, vertex_im]
  change |coordinate N h (q z).1 - z.val.re| + |coordinate N h (q z).2 - z.val.im| < 2 * h
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hre.1), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr him.1)]
  linarith [hre.2, him.2]

name: Path.map_concat
statement:
theorem map_concat {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    {f : X → Y} (hf : Continuous f) :
    (concat p γ).map hf = concat (fun i => f (p i)) (fun i => (γ i).map hf)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [concat_zero]; ext t; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [concat_succ]
    erw [map_trans, concat_succ, ih]
    rfl

name: Cubical.exists_piece_of_mem_support_pathChain
statement:
theorem exists_piece_of_mem_support_pathChain (p : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    {q : C(I, X)} (hq : q ∈ (pathChain p γ).support) :
    ∃ i, (γ i).toContinuousMap = q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  have hz : pathChain p γ q = 0 := by
    simp only [pathChain, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    have hne : (γ i).toContinuousMap ≠ q := fun h => hnot ⟨i, h⟩
    simp [hne]
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hq) hz

name: Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_pathChain (p : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    boundaryOne (pathChain p γ) = Finsupp.single (p (Fin.last n)) 1 -
      Finsupp.single (p 0) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathChain, map_sum, boundaryOne, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
    one_smul, Path.coe_toContinuousMap, Path.source, Path.target]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib]
  let f : Fin (n + 1) → X →₀ ℤ := fun i => Finsupp.single (p i) 1
  change (∑ i : Fin n, f i.succ) - (∑ i : Fin n, f i.castSucc) = f (Fin.last n) - f 0
  have hs : (∑ i : Fin n, f i.succ) = (∑ i, f i) - f 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    abel
  have ht : (∑ i : Fin n, f i.castSucc) = (∑ i, f i) - f (Fin.last n) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    abel
  rw [hs, ht]
  abel

name: Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero (p : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) (hp : p (Fin.last n) = p 0) :
    boundaryOne (pathChain p γ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryOne_pathChain, hp, sub_self]

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_concat_sub_pathChain
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_concat_sub_pathChain (p : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single (Path.concat p γ).toContinuousMap 1 - pathChain p γ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, Finsupp.single (p 0) 1, ?_⟩
    simp [pathChain, constantChain]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hs := isNullHomologous_single_trans_sub
      (Path.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc)) (γ (Fin.last n))
    have ht := hs.add (ih (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc))
    convert ht using 1
    simp only [Path.concat_succ, pathChain, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    abel

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_zero
statement: theorem isNullHomologous_zero : IsNullHomologous (0 : OneChain X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩

name: Cubical.IsNullHomologous.add
statement:
theorem IsNullHomologous.add {Γ Δ : OneChain X}
    (hΓ : IsNullHomologous Γ) (hΔ : IsNullHomologous Δ) : IsNullHomologous (Γ + Δ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, D, rfl⟩ := hΓ
  obtain ⟨T, E, rfl⟩ := hΔ
  refine ⟨S + T, D + E, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_add]
  abel

name: Cubical.IsNullHomologous.neg
statement:
theorem IsNullHomologous.neg {Γ : OneChain X} (hΓ : IsNullHomologous Γ) :
    IsNullHomologous (-Γ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, D, rfl⟩ := hΓ
  refine ⟨-S, -D, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_neg]
  abel

name: Cubical.IsNullHomologous.sub
statement:
theorem IsNullHomologous.sub {Γ Δ : OneChain X}
    (hΓ : IsNullHomologous Γ) (hΔ : IsNullHomologous Δ) : IsNullHomologous (Γ - Δ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hΓ.add hΔ.neg

name: Cubical.IsNullHomologous.smul
statement:
theorem IsNullHomologous.smul {Γ : OneChain X} (hΓ : IsNullHomologous Γ) (k : ℤ) :
    IsNullHomologous (k • Γ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, D, rfl⟩ := hΓ
  refine ⟨k • S, k • D, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_smul, smul_add]

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_finsetSum
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → OneChain X)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, IsNullHomologous (f i)) : IsNullHomologous (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (isNullHomologous_zero (X := X))
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).add
      (ih (fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_sub_initialPart_sub_finalPart
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_sub_initialPart_sub_finalPart
    (γ : C(I, X)) (r : I) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single γ 1 - Finsupp.single (initialPart γ r) 1 -
      Finsupp.single (finalPart γ r) 1)
proof:
:= by
  let q : C(I × I, X) := ⟨fun p => γ (p.2 *
    unitInterval.symm (unitInterval.symm r * unitInterval.symm p.1)), by
      apply γ.continuous.comp
      apply continuous_induced_rng.mpr
      change Continuous (fun p : I × I => (p.2 : ℝ) *
        (1 - (1 - (r : ℝ)) * (1 - (p.1 : ℝ))))
      fun_prop⟩
  have hleft : left q = initialPart γ r := by ext t; simp [left, q, initialPart]
  have hright : right q = γ := by ext t; simp [right, q]
  have hbottom : bottom q = ContinuousMap.const I (γ 0) := by ext t; simp [bottom, q]
  have htop : top q = finalPart γ r := by ext t; simp [top, q, finalPart]
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single q 1, Finsupp.single (γ 0) (-1), ?_⟩
  simp only [boundaryTwo, constantChain, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul,
    neg_smul, squareBoundary, hleft, hright, hbottom, htop]
  abel

name: Cubical.mapOne_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOne_single (f : C(X, Y)) (γ : C(I, X)) (k : ℤ) :
    mapOne f (Finsupp.single γ k) = Finsupp.single (f.comp γ) k
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapOne]

name: Cubical.mapTwo_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapTwo_single (f : C(X, Y)) (q : C(I × I, X)) (k : ℤ) :
    mapTwo f (Finsupp.single q k) = Finsupp.single (f.comp q) k
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapTwo]

name: Cubical.mapZero_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapZero_single (f : C(X, Y)) (x : X) (k : ℤ) :
    mapZero f (Finsupp.single x k) = Finsupp.single (f x) k
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapZero]

name: Cubical.mapOne_mapOne
statement:
theorem mapOne_mapOne (f : C(X, Y)) (g : C(Y, Z)) (Γ : OneChain X) :
    mapOne g (mapOne f Γ) = mapOne (g.comp f) Γ
proof:
:= by
  have h : (mapOne g).comp (mapOne f) = mapOne (g.comp f) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro γ k
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, mapOne_single]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h Γ

name: Cubical.mapOne_squareBoundary
statement:
theorem mapOne_squareBoundary (f : C(X, Y)) (q : C(I × I, X)) :
    mapOne f (squareBoundary q) = squareBoundary (f.comp q)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : f.comp (left q) = left (f.comp q) := by ext t; rfl
  have hR : f.comp (right q) = right (f.comp q) := by ext t; rfl
  have hB : f.comp (bottom q) = bottom (f.comp q) := by ext t; rfl
  have hT : f.comp (top q) = top (f.comp q) := by ext t; rfl
  simp only [squareBoundary, map_add, map_sub, mapOne_single, hL, hR, hB, hT]

name: Cubical.boundaryOne_mapOne
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_mapOne (f : C(X, Y)) (Γ : OneChain X) :
    boundaryOne (mapOne f Γ) = mapZero f (boundaryOne Γ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : boundaryOne.comp (mapOne f) = (mapZero f).comp boundaryOne := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro γ k
    simp [boundaryOne]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h Γ

name: Cubical.boundaryTwo_mapTwo
statement:
theorem boundaryTwo_mapTwo (f : C(X, Y)) (S : TwoChain X) :
    boundaryTwo (mapTwo f S) = mapOne f (boundaryTwo S)
proof:
:= by
  have h : boundaryTwo.comp (mapTwo f) = (mapOne f).comp boundaryTwo := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro q k
    simp [boundaryTwo, mapOne_squareBoundary]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h S

name: Cubical.constantChain_mapZero
statement:
theorem constantChain_mapZero (f : C(X, Y)) (D : X →₀ ℤ) :
    constantChain (mapZero f D) = mapOne f (constantChain D)
proof:
:= by
  have h : constantChain.comp (mapZero f) = (mapOne f).comp constantChain := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro x k
    simp [constantChain, ContinuousMap.comp_const]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h D

name: Cubical.IsNullHomologous.map
statement:
theorem IsNullHomologous.map {Γ : OneChain X} (hΓ : IsNullHomologous Γ) (f : C(X, Y)) :
    IsNullHomologous (mapOne f Γ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, D, rfl⟩ := hΓ
  refine ⟨mapTwo f S, mapZero f D, ?_⟩
  rw [boundaryTwo_mapTwo, constantChain_mapZero, ← map_add]

name: Cubical.comp_injective
statement:
theorem comp_injective {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (fun γ : C(A, X) => f.comp γ)
proof:
:= by
  intro γ δ h
  ext t
  apply hf
  exact congrArg (fun p : C(A, Y) => p t) h

name: Cubical.mapOne_injective
statement:
theorem mapOne_injective (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (mapOne f)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mapDomain_injective (comp_injective f hf)

name: Cubical.mapZero_injective
statement:
theorem mapZero_injective (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (mapZero f)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mapDomain_injective hf

name: Cubical.exists_mapOne_subtype_val_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mapOne_subtype_val_eq (Γ : OneChain X) (S : Set X)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ t, γ t ∈ S) :
    ∃ Δ : OneChain S,
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(S, X)) Δ = Γ
proof:
:= by
  let j : C(S, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hj : Function.Injective (fun γ : C(I, S) => j.comp γ) :=
    comp_injective j Subtype.val_injective
  have hs : (↑Γ.support : Set C(I, X)) ⊆ Set.range (fun γ : C(I, S) => j.comp γ) := by
    intro γ hγ
    refine ⟨⟨fun t => ⟨γ t, hΓ γ hγ t⟩, γ.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩, ?_⟩
    ext t
    rfl
  refine ⟨Finsupp.comapDomain (fun γ : C(I, S) => j.comp γ) Γ hj.injOn, ?_⟩
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain _ hj Γ hs

name: Cubical.exists_mapTwo_subtype_val_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mapTwo_subtype_val_eq (Γ : TwoChain X) (S : Set X)
    (hΓ : ∀ q ∈ Γ.support, ∀ t, q t ∈ S) :
    ∃ Δ : TwoChain S,
      mapTwo (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(S, X)) Δ = Γ
proof:
:= by
  let j : C(S, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hj : Function.Injective (fun q : C(I × I, S) => j.comp q) :=
    comp_injective j Subtype.val_injective
  have hs : (↑Γ.support : Set C(I × I, X)) ⊆
      Set.range (fun q : C(I × I, S) => j.comp q) := by
    intro q hq
    refine ⟨⟨fun t => ⟨q t, hΓ q hq t⟩, q.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩, ?_⟩
    ext t
    rfl
  refine ⟨Finsupp.comapDomain (fun q : C(I × I, S) => j.comp q) Γ hj.injOn, ?_⟩
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain _ hj Γ hs

name: Cubical.dist_convexComb_uniformNode_le
statement:
theorem dist_convexComb_uniformNode_le {n i : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hi : i < n) (t : I) :
    dist (Set.Icc.convexComb (uniformNode n i) (uniformNode n (i + 1)) t) (uniformNode n i) ≤
      1 / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  simp only [Set.Icc.coe_convexComb, coe_uniformNode_of_le hn hi.le,
    coe_uniformNode_of_le hn (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi), Nat.cast_succ]
  have he : (1 - (t : ℝ)) * ((i : ℝ) / n) + (t : ℝ) * (((i : ℝ) + 1) / n) -
      (i : ℝ) / n = (t : ℝ) / n := by ring
  rw [he, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg t.property.1 hn'.le)]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right t.property.2 hn'.le

name: Cubical.exists_uniform_subdivision_image_small
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_subdivision_image_small
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (γ : C(I, E)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ i < n, ∀ t : I,
      ‖subedge γ (uniformNode n i) (uniformNode n (i + 1)) t - γ (uniformNode n i)‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsmall⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp
    (CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous γ.continuous) ε hε
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
  refine ⟨m + 1, Nat.succ_pos m, ?_⟩
  intro i hi t
  have hm' : 1 / ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < δ := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hm
  have hd := (dist_convexComb_uniformNode_le (Nat.succ_pos m) hi t).trans_lt hm'
  change ‖γ (Set.Icc.convexComb (uniformNode (m + 1) i) (uniformNode (m + 1) (i + 1)) t) -
    γ (uniformNode (m + 1) i)‖ < ε
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hsmall hd

name: Set.subset_boundedComplementFill
statement: theorem subset_boundedComplementFill (s : Set X) : s ⊆ boundedComplementFill s
proof:
:=
  subset_union_left

name: Set.not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff
statement:
theorem not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff {s : Set X} {x : X} :
    x ∉ boundedComplementFill s ↔ x ∉ s ∧ ¬ IsBounded (connectedComponentIn sᶜ x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [boundedComplementFill, hx]

name: Set.connectedComponentIn_subset_compl_boundedComplementFill
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hx⟩ := not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff.mp hx
  intro y hy
  refine not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff.mpr ⟨connectedComponentIn_subset sᶜ x hy, ?_⟩
  rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq hy]
  exact hx

name: Set.isClosed_boundedComplementFill
statement:
theorem isClosed_boundedComplementFill [LocallyConnectedSpace X] {s : Set X}
    (hs : IsClosed s) : IsClosed (boundedComplementFill s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro x hx
  have hx' := (not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff.mp hx).1
  exact Filter.mem_of_superset
    (hs.isOpen_compl.connectedComponentIn.mem_nhds (mem_connectedComponentIn hx'))
    (connectedComponentIn_subset_compl_boundedComplementFill hx)

name: Set.not_isBounded_connectedComponentIn_compl_of_norm_lt
statement:
theorem not_isBounded_connectedComponentIn_compl_of_norm_lt
    {s : Set E} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hs : s ⊆ closedBall 0 R)
    {x : E} (hx : R < ‖x‖) : ¬ IsBounded (connectedComponentIn sᶜ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := hR.trans_lt hx
  let ray : Set E := (fun t : ℝ => t • x) '' Ici 1
  have hray : IsPreconnected ray :=
    isPreconnected_Ici.image _ (by fun_prop)
  have hxray : x ∈ ray := ⟨1, by simp, one_smul ℝ x⟩
  have hrays : ray ⊆ sᶜ := by
    rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ hz
    change 1 ≤ t at ht
    have hb := hs hz
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at hb
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans ht)] at hb
    nlinarith
  have hraycomp : ray ⊆ connectedComponentIn sᶜ x :=
    hray.subset_connectedComponentIn hxray hrays
  intro hcomp
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (hcomp.subset hraycomp).exists_norm_le
  let t : ℝ := (max M ‖x‖ + 1) / ‖x‖
  have ht : 1 ≤ t := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hxpos).mpr
    linarith [le_max_right M ‖x‖]
  have hn : ‖t • x‖ = max M ‖x‖ + 1 := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans ht)]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hxpos.ne'
  have hb := hM (t • x) ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  rw [hn] at hb
  linarith [le_max_left M ‖x‖]

name: Set.boundedComplementFill_subset_closedBall
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hn : R < ‖x‖ := by simpa only [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] using hnot
  rcases hx with hx | ⟨_, hcomp⟩
  · exact hnot (hs hx)
  · exact not_isBounded_connectedComponentIn_compl_of_norm_lt hR hs hn hcomp

name: Set.isBounded_boundedComplementFill
statement:
theorem isBounded_boundedComplementFill {s : Set E} (hs : IsBounded s) :
    IsBounded (boundedComplementFill s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hb⟩ := hs.exists_pos_norm_le
  exact isBounded_closedBall.subset
    (boundedComplementFill_subset_closedBall hR.le
      (fun x hx => mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr (hb x hx)))

name: Set.isCompact_boundedComplementFill
statement:
theorem isCompact_boundedComplementFill [LocallyConnectedSpace E] [ProperSpace E]
    {s : Set E} (hs : IsCompact s) : IsCompact (boundedComplementFill s)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr
    ⟨isClosed_boundedComplementFill hs.isClosed, isBounded_boundedComplementFill hs.isBounded⟩

name: Set.exists_cthickening_boundedComplementFill_subset_open
statement:
theorem exists_cthickening_boundedComplementFill_subset_open
    [LocallyConnectedSpace E] [ProperSpace E] {s U : Set E}
    (hs : IsCompact s) (hU : IsOpen U) (hsub : boundedComplementFill s ⊆ U) :
    ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ cthickening δ (boundedComplementFill s) ⊆ U
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_boundedComplementFill hs).exists_cthickening_subset_open hU hsub

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.boundaryOne_localComparisonChain
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_localComparisonChain
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) :
    boundaryOne (localComparisonChain x y q γ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [localComparisonChain, map_sub, map_sub, map_add, Grid.boundaryOne_walkChain]
  simp only [boundaryOne, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul,
    ContinuousMap.comp_apply, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, quantizerConnector,
    Path.coe_toContinuousMap, Path.source, Path.target]
  abel

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.localComparisonChain_mapsTo_ball
statement:
theorem localComparisonChain_mapsTo_ball
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) (hγ : ∀ t, ‖(γ t : ℂ) - γ 0‖ < h) :
    ∀ δ ∈ (localComparisonChain x y q γ).support, ∀ t,
      δ t ∈ ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Set ℂ := ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h)
  let P : Submodule ℤ (OneChain ℂ) := Finsupp.supported ℤ ℤ {δ : C(I, ℂ) | ∀ t, δ t ∈ B}
  have h0 : (γ 0 : ℂ) ∈ B := by
    simp only [B, mem_ball, dist_self]
    positivity
  have h1 : (γ 1 : ℂ) ∈ B := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    exact (hγ 1).trans (by linarith)
  have hq0 : ‖vertex x y (q (γ 0)).1 (q (γ 0)).2 - γ 0‖ < 3 * h :=
    (hq (γ 0)).trans (by linarith)
  have hq1 : ‖vertex x y (q (γ 1)).1 (q (γ 1)).2 - γ 0‖ < 3 * h := by
    exact (norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ (γ 1 : ℂ) _).trans_lt
      (by linarith [hq (γ 1), hγ 1])
  have hQ0 : vertex x y (q (γ 0)).1 (q (γ 0)).2 ∈ B := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hq0.trans (by linarith)
  have hQ1 : vertex x y (q (γ 1)).1 (q (γ 1)).2 ∈ B := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hq1.trans (by linarith)
  have hsingle : Finsupp.single
      ((⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)).comp γ) (1 : ℤ) ∈ P := by
    apply Finsupp.single_mem_supported
    intro t
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    exact (hγ t).trans (by linarith)
  have hc0 : Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) (1 : ℤ) ∈ P := by
    apply Finsupp.single_mem_supported
    intro t
    exact (convex_ball _ _).lineMap_mem h0 hQ0 t.property
  have hc1 : Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) (1 : ℤ) ∈ P := by
    apply Finsupp.single_mem_supported
    intro t
    exact (convex_ball _ _).lineMap_mem h1 hQ1 t.property
  have hwalk : Grid.walkChain (vertex x y) (q (γ 0)) (q (γ 1)) ∈ P := by
    intro δ hδ t
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have hw := walkChain_norm_sub_lt x y hx hy _ _ hq0 hq1 δ hδ t
    exact hw.trans (by linarith)
  exact P.sub_mem (P.sub_mem (P.add_mem hsingle hc1) hwalk) hc0

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) (hγ : ∀ t, ‖(γ t : ℂ) - γ 0‖ < h) :
    ∃ Δ : OneChain (ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h)),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h), ℂ)) Δ = localComparisonChain x y q γ ∧
          IsNullHomologous Δ
proof:
:= by
  let : ContractibleSpace (ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h)) :=
    (convex_ball _ _).contractibleSpace ⟨γ 0, by simp; positivity⟩
  exact exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_subtype_val_eq _ _
    (boundaryOne_localComparisonChain x y q γ)
    (localComparisonChain_mapsTo_ball x y hx hy q hh hq γ hγ)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain_thickening
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain_thickening
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) (hγ : ∀ t, ‖(γ t : ℂ) - γ 0‖ < h) :
    ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ = localComparisonChain x y q γ ∧
          IsNullHomologous Δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Δ, hΔ, hnull⟩ := exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain
    x y hx hy q hh hq γ hγ
  have hB : ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h) ⊆ thickening (8 * h) C := by
    intro z hz
    exact mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨γ 0, (γ 0).property, hz⟩
  refine ⟨mapOne (ContinuousMap.inclusion hB) Δ, ?_, hnull.map _⟩
  rw [mapOne_mapOne]
  exact hΔ

name: Cubical.boundaryOne_squareBoundary

name: Cubical.Grid.edgeChain_mapsTo_of_nonzero_edges_mapsTo
statement:
theorem edgeChain_mapsTo_of_nonzero_edges_mapsTo
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ) (S : Set E)
    (hH : ∀ i j, h i j ≠ 0 → ∀ t, horizontal v i j t ∈ S)
    (hV : ∀ i j, w i j ≠ 0 → ∀ t, vertical v i j t ∈ S) :
    ∀ q ∈ (edgeChain v h w).support, ∀ t, q t ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro q hq t
  by_contra hnot
  have hh (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      (h i j • Finsupp.single (horizontal v i j) (1 : ℤ)) q = 0 := by
    by_cases hc : h i j = 0
    · simp [hc]
    · have hne : horizontal v i j ≠ q := by
        intro he
        exact hnot (he ▸ hH i j hc t)
      simp [hne]
  have hw (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
      (w i j • Finsupp.single (vertical v i j) (1 : ℤ)) q = 0 := by
    by_cases hc : w i j = 0
    · simp [hc]
    · have hne : vertical v i j ≠ q := by
        intro he
        exact hnot (he ▸ hV i j hc t)
      simp [hne]
  have hz : edgeChain v h w q = 0 := by
    simp only [edgeChain, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, hh, hw,
      sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hq) hz

name: Cubical.Grid.boundaryTwo_cellChain_eq_edgeChain
statement:
theorem boundaryTwo_cellChain_eq_edgeChain
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ)
    (hc : RectangularChain.IsCycle h w) :
    boundaryTwo (cellChain v (RectangularChain.cellCoefficients h)) = edgeChain v h w
proof:
:= by
  rw [cellChain, map_sum]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, boundaryTwo, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
  have he := RectangularChain.sum_edges_eq_sum_cell_boundaries h w hc
    (fun i j => Finsupp.single (horizontal v i j) (1 : ℤ))
    (fun i j => Finsupp.single (vertical v i j) (1 : ℤ))
  rw [edgeChain, he]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [squareBoundary, right_cell, left_cell, top_cell, bottom_cell]
  congr 1
  abel

name: Cubical.Grid.cellChain_mapsTo_of_nonzero_cell_mapsTo
statement:
theorem cellChain_mapsTo_of_nonzero_cell_mapsTo
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E) (c : Fin m → Fin n → ℤ) (S : Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i j, c i j ≠ 0 → ∀ t, cell v i j t ∈ S) :
    ∀ q ∈ (cellChain v c).support, ∀ t, q t ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro q hq t
  by_contra hnot
  have hz : cellChain v c q = 0 := by
    simp only [cellChain, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    by_cases hc : c i j = 0
    · simp [hc]
    · have hne : cell v i j ≠ q := by
        intro he
        exact hnot (he ▸ hS i j hc t)
      simp [hne]
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hq) hz

name: Cubical.Grid.vertexChain_apply_vertex
statement:
theorem vertexChain_apply_vertex
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (hv : Function.Injective (fun p : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1) => v p.1 p.2))
    (a : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    vertexChain v a (v i j) = a i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he (k : Fin (m + 1)) (l : Fin (n + 1)) : v k l = v i j ↔ k = i ∧ l = j := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact Prod.mk.inj (hv h)
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      rfl
  simp [vertexChain, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, he,
    ite_and]

name: Cubical.Grid.boundaryOne_edgeChain_eq_neg_vertexChain
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_edgeChain_eq_neg_vertexChain
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ) :
    boundaryOne (edgeChain v h w) =
      -vertexChain v (fun i j => Fin.edgeBoundary h i j + Fin.edgeBoundary (w i) j)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (∑ i, ∑ j, Fin.edgeBoundary h i j • Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, h i j •
        (Finsupp.single (v i.castSucc j) 1 - Finsupp.single (v i.succ j) 1) := by
    rw [sum_comm]
    conv_rhs => rw [sum_comm]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    have he (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
        Fin.edgeBoundary h i j = Fin.edgeBoundary (fun k => h k j) i :=
      Fin.map_edgeBoundary (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℤ) j) h i
    simp_rw [he]
    exact Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul (fun k => h k j)
      (fun i => Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ))
  have hw : (∑ i, ∑ j, Fin.edgeBoundary (w i) j • Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j •
        (Finsupp.single (v i j.castSucc) 1 - Finsupp.single (v i j.succ) 1) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul (w i) (fun j => Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ))
  have hv : vertexChain v (fun i j => Fin.edgeBoundary h i j + Fin.edgeBoundary (w i) j) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, Fin.edgeBoundary h i j • Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ)) +
        ∑ i, ∑ j, Fin.edgeBoundary (w i) j • Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ) := by
    simp only [vertexChain, add_smul, sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hv, hh, hw]
  simp only [edgeChain, map_add, map_sum, map_smul, boundaryOne,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, horizontal, vertical, Path.coe_toContinuousMap,
    Path.source, Path.target]
  simp only [smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib]
  abel

name: Cubical.Grid.isCycle_of_boundaryOne_edgeChain_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isCycle_of_boundaryOne_edgeChain_eq_zero
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (hv : Function.Injective (fun p : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1) => v p.1 p.2))
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ)
    (hc : boundaryOne (edgeChain v h w) = 0) : RectangularChain.IsCycle h w
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryOne_edgeChain_eq_neg_vertexChain, neg_eq_zero] at hc
  intro i j
  have he := congrArg (fun c : E →₀ ℤ => c (v i j)) hc
  simpa only [vertexChain_apply_vertex v hv, Finsupp.zero_apply] using he

name: Cubical.Grid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeChain
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeChain
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ)
    (hc : RectangularChain.IsCycle h w) (S : Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i j, RectangularChain.cellCoefficients h i j ≠ 0 →
      ∀ t, cell v i j t ∈ S) :
    ∃ Γ : OneChain S,
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(S, E)) Γ = edgeChain v h w ∧
        IsNullHomologous Γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_mapTwo_subtype_val_eq
    (cellChain v (RectangularChain.cellCoefficients h)) S
    (cellChain_mapsTo_of_nonzero_cell_mapsTo v _ S hS)
  refine ⟨boundaryTwo T, ?_, ⟨T, 0, by simp⟩⟩
  rw [← boundaryTwo_mapTwo, hT, boundaryTwo_cellChain_eq_edgeChain v h w hc]

name: Polynomial.exists_complex_polynomial_near_of_continuousOn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_polynomial_near_of_continuousOn a b (fun x => (f x).re)
    (Complex.continuous_re.comp_continuousOn hf) (ε/2) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_polynomial_near_of_continuousOn a b (fun x => (f x).im)
    (Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn hf) (ε/2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨p.map Complex.ofRealHom + C Complex.I * q.map Complex.ofRealHom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hp' := hp x hx
  have hq' := hq x hx
  have h := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im
    (f x - (p.map Complex.ofRealHom + C Complex.I * q.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ))
  have he : (p.map Complex.ofRealHom + C Complex.I * q.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (x : ℂ) =
      (p.eval x : ℝ) + Complex.I * (q.eval x : ℝ) := by
    change _ = (Complex.ofRealHom (p.eval x)) + Complex.I * Complex.ofRealHom (q.eval x)
    rw [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C]
    rw [show (x : ℂ) = Complex.ofRealHom x by rfl, eval_map_apply, eval_map_apply]
  rw [he] at h
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, Complex.I_im, one_mul, sub_zero,
    add_zero, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, zero_add] at h
  rw [abs_sub_comm (p.eval x) _] at hp'
  rw [abs_sub_comm (q.eval x) _] at hq'
  rw [he]
  exact h.trans_lt (by linarith)

name: Real.exists_finset_interval_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_interval_net (a : ℝ) {L ε : ℝ} (_hL : 0 ≤ L) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset ℝ, N.card ≤ ⌈2*L/ε⌉₊+1 ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, |x-a| ≤ L → ∃ u ∈ N, |x-u| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : ℕ := ⌈2*L/ε⌉₊
  let N := (Finset.range (q+1)).image (fun k : ℕ => a-L+(k : ℝ)*ε)
  refine ⟨N, (Finset.card_image_le).trans (by simp [q]), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hlo : 0 ≤ x-a+L := by have hh := (abs_le.mp hx).1; linarith
  have hhi : x-a+L ≤ 2*L := by have hh := (abs_le.mp hx).2; linarith
  let k : ℕ := ⌊(x-a+L)/ε⌋₊
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ (x-a+L)/ε := div_nonneg hlo hε.le
  have hklo : (k : ℝ) ≤ (x-a+L)/ε := Nat.floor_le hdiv
  have hkhi : (x-a+L)/ε < (k : ℝ)+1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hkq : k ≤ q := by
    have hh : (k : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := hklo.trans
      ((div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hhi hε.le).trans (Nat.le_ceil _))
    exact_mod_cast hh
  refine ⟨a-L+(k : ℝ)*ε, Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hkq), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have hmullo : (k : ℝ)*ε ≤ x-a+L := (le_div_iff₀ hε).mp hklo
  have hmulhi : x-a+L < ((k : ℝ)+1)*ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hkhi
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ x-(a-L+(k : ℝ)*ε))]
  linarith

name: Real.exists_finset_union_intervals_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_union_intervals_net {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → ℝ) {L ε : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset ℝ, N.card ≤ Fintype.card ι*(⌈2*L/ε⌉₊+1) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, (∃ i, |x-a i| ≤ L) → ∃ u ∈ N, |x-u| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose N hcard hcover using (fun i => exists_finset_interval_net (a i) hL hε)
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion N, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Finset.card_univ] using Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul
      Finset.univ N (⌈2*L/ε⌉₊+1) (fun i _ => hcard i)
  · intro x ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hclose⟩ := hcover i x hi
    exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hu⟩, hclose⟩

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_const
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_const (x : X) (k : ℤ) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single (ContinuousMap.const I x) k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, Finsupp.single x k, ?_⟩
  simp [constantChain]

name: Cubical.subedge_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subedge_zero (γ : C(I, X)) (r s : I) : subedge γ r s 0 = γ r
proof:
:= by
  simp [subedge]

name: Cubical.subedge_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subedge_one (γ : C(I, X)) (r s : I) : subedge γ r s 1 = γ s
proof:
:= by
  simp [subedge]

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_initialPart_sub_initialPart_sub_subedge
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_initialPart_sub_initialPart_sub_subedge
    (γ : C(I, X)) (r s : I) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single (initialPart γ s) 1 -
      Finsupp.single (initialPart γ r) 1 - Finsupp.single (subedge γ r s) 1)
proof:
:= by
  let q : C(I × I, X) := ⟨fun p => γ (p.2 * Set.Icc.convexComb r s p.1), by
    apply γ.continuous.comp
    apply continuous_induced_rng.mpr
    change Continuous (fun p : I × I => (p.2 : ℝ) *
      ((1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) + (p.1 : ℝ) * (s : ℝ)))
    fun_prop⟩
  have hL : left q = initialPart γ r := by ext t; simp [left, q, initialPart]
  have hR : right q = initialPart γ s := by ext t; simp [right, q, initialPart]
  have hT : top q = subedge γ r s := by ext t; simp [top, q, subedge]
  have hB : bottom q = ContinuousMap.const I (γ 0) := by ext t; simp [bottom, q]
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single q 1, Finsupp.single (γ 0) (-1), ?_⟩
  simp only [boundaryTwo, constantChain, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
    one_smul, neg_smul, squareBoundary, hL, hR, hT, hB]
  abel

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_initialPart_sub_subdivisionChain
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_initialPart_sub_subdivisionChain
    (γ : C(I, X)) (p : ℕ → I) (n : ℕ) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single (initialPart γ (p n)) 1 -
      Finsupp.single (initialPart γ (p 0)) 1 - subdivisionChain γ p n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [subdivisionChain] using (isNullHomologous_zero (X := X))
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := (isNullHomologous_initialPart_sub_initialPart_sub_subedge γ (p n) (p (n + 1))).add ih
    convert h using 1
    simp only [subdivisionChain, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    abel

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_sub_subdivisionChain
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_sub_subdivisionChain
    (γ : C(I, X)) (p : ℕ → I) (n : ℕ) (hzero : p 0 = 0) (hone : p n = 1) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single γ 1 - subdivisionChain γ p n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := isNullHomologous_initialPart_sub_subdivisionChain γ p n
  have h0 : initialPart γ (p 0) = ContinuousMap.const I (γ 0) := by
    ext t
    simp [initialPart, hzero]
  have h1 : initialPart γ (p n) = γ := by
    ext t
    simp [initialPart, hone]
  rw [h0, h1] at h
  have hc := h.add (isNullHomologous_single_const (γ 0) 1)
  convert hc using 1
  abel

name: Cubical.coe_uniformNode_of_le
statement:
theorem coe_uniformNode_of_le {n i : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    (uniformNode n i : ℝ) = (i : ℝ) / n
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one
    ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg i) hn'.le,
      (div_le_one hn').mpr (by exact_mod_cast hi)⟩)

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_sub_uniform_subdivisionChain
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_sub_uniform_subdivisionChain
    (γ : C(I, X)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single γ 1 - subdivisionChain γ (uniformNode n) n)
proof:
:= by
  apply isNullHomologous_single_sub_subdivisionChain
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_uniformNode_of_le hn (Nat.zero_le n)]
    simp
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_uniformNode_of_le hn le_rfl]
    simp [hn.ne']

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_sub_uniformSubdivision
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_sub_uniformSubdivision (Γ : OneChain X)
    (size : C(I, X) → ℕ) (hsize : ∀ γ, 0 < size γ) :
    IsNullHomologous (Γ - uniformSubdivision size Γ)
proof:
:= by
  induction Γ using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simpa using (isNullHomologous_zero (X := X))
  | add Γ Δ hΓ hΔ =>
    have he := hΓ.add hΔ
    convert he using 1
    simp only [map_add]
    abel
  | single γ k =>
    have he := (isNullHomologous_single_sub_uniform_subdivisionChain γ (hsize γ)).smul k
    simpa only [uniformSubdivision, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, smul_sub,
      Finsupp.smul_single_one] using he

name: Cubical.boundaryOne_uniformSubdivision
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_uniformSubdivision (Γ : OneChain X)
    (size : C(I, X) → ℕ) (hsize : ∀ γ, 0 < size γ) :
    boundaryOne (uniformSubdivision size Γ) = boundaryOne Γ
proof:
:= by
  have he := (isNullHomologous_sub_uniformSubdivision Γ size hsize).boundaryOne_eq_zero
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at he
  exact he.symm

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.edgeChainMap_subdivisionWalkCoefficients
statement:
theorem edgeChainMap_subdivisionWalkCoefficients
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) (k : ℕ) :
    Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) (subdivisionWalkCoefficients q γ k) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, Grid.walkChain (vertex x y)
        (q (γ (uniformNode k i))) (q (γ (uniformNode k (i + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [subdivisionWalkCoefficients, map_sum]
  rfl

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.sum_localComparisonChain_subedge
statement:
theorem sum_localComparisonChain_subedge
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
        localComparisonChain x y q (subedge γ (uniformNode k i) (uniformNode k (i + 1))) =
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ))
          (subdivisionChain γ (uniformNode k) k) +
        Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) 1 -
        Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) (subdivisionWalkCoefficients q γ k) -
        Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : uniformNode k 0 = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [coe_uniformNode_of_le hk (Nat.zero_le k)]
  have hone : uniformNode k k = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [coe_uniformNode_of_le hk le_rfl, hk.ne']
  rw [edgeChainMap_subdivisionWalkCoefficients]
  simp only [localComparisonChain, subedge_zero, subedge_one, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, subdivisionChain, map_sum, mapOne_single]
  have ht := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun i =>
    Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ (uniformNode k i))) (1 : ℤ)) k
  rw [hone, hzero] at ht
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at ht
  rw [(sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp ht]
  abel

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeComparison
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeComparison
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) :
    ∃ c : Grid.Coefficients m n, ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ =
          Finsupp.single ((⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)).comp γ) 1 +
            Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) 1 -
            Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) c -
            Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) 1 ∧
        IsNullHomologous Δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let j : C(C, ℂ) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hsmall⟩ := exists_uniform_subdivision_image_small (j.comp γ) hh
  have hlocal (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :=
    exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain_thickening x y hx hy q hh hq
      (subedge γ (uniformNode k i) (uniformNode k (i + 1))) (by
        intro t
        rw [subedge_zero]
        change ‖(γ (Set.Icc.convexComb (uniformNode k i) (uniformNode k (i + 1)) t) : ℂ) -
          γ (uniformNode k i)‖ < h
        exact hsmall i hi t)
  choose Δ hΔ hn using hlocal
  let S : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C) :=
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, if hi : i < k then Δ i hi else 0
  have hS : IsNullHomologous S := by
    apply isNullHomologous_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    simpa only [dif_pos hi] using hn i hi
  have heS : mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
      C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) S =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
          localComparisonChain x y q (subedge γ (uniformNode k i) (uniformNode k (i + 1))) := by
    simp only [S, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [dif_pos hi]
    exact hΔ i hi
  have hC : C ⊆ thickening (8 * h) C := by
    intro z hz
    exact mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨z, hz, by simp; positivity⟩
  let incl : C(C, thickening (8 * h) C) := ContinuousMap.inclusion hC
  let T := mapOne incl (Finsupp.single γ 1 - subdivisionChain γ (uniformNode k) k)
  have hT : IsNullHomologous T :=
    (isNullHomologous_single_sub_uniform_subdivisionChain γ hk).map incl
  have hj : (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
      C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)).comp incl = j := by ext z; rfl
  have heT : mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
      C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) T =
      mapOne j (Finsupp.single γ 1 - subdivisionChain γ (uniformNode k) k) := by
    dsimp only [T]
    rw [mapOne_mapOne, hj]
  refine ⟨subdivisionWalkCoefficients q γ k, T + S, ?_, hT.add hS⟩
  rw [map_add, heS, heT, sum_localComparisonChain_subedge x y q γ hk,
    map_sub, mapOne_single]
  simp only [j]
  abel

name: Cubical.mem_support_mapOne_comp_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_mapOne_comp_iff (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (Γ : OneChain X) (γ : C(I, X)) :
    f.comp γ ∈ (mapOne f Γ).support ↔ γ ∈ Γ.support
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
  change Finsupp.mapDomain (fun δ : C(I, X) => f.comp δ) Γ (f.comp γ) ≠ 0 ↔ Γ γ ≠ 0
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (comp_injective f hf)]

name: Cubical.mapOne_mem_supported
statement:
theorem mapOne_mem_supported (f : C(X, Y)) (Γ : OneChain X) (S : Set C(I, Y))
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, f.comp γ ∈ S) :
    mapOne f Γ ∈ Finsupp.supported ℤ ℤ S
proof:
:= by
  exact Finsupp.supported_comap_lmapDomain ℤ ℤ (fun γ : C(I, X) => f.comp γ) S hΓ

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex_re
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertex_re (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : (vertex x y i j).re = x i
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertex]

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex_im
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertex_im (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : (vertex x y i j).im = y j
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertex]

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex_injective
statement:
theorem vertex_injective (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1) => vertex x y p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply hx.injective
    simpa only [vertex_re] using congrArg Complex.re h
  · apply hy.injective
    simpa only [vertex_im] using congrArg Complex.im h

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.cell_apply
statement:
theorem cell_apply (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) (p : I × I) :
    Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j p =
      (lineMap (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ) (p.1 : ℝ) : ℝ) +
        (lineMap (y j.castSucc) (y j.succ) (p.2 : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Grid.cell, vertex, lineMap_apply_module] <;> ring

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.cell_mem_rectangle
statement:
theorem cell_mem_rectangle (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) (p : I × I) :
    (Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j p).re ∈ Icc (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ) ∧
      (Grid.cell (vertex x y) i j p).im ∈ Icc (y j.castSucc) (y j.succ)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.castSucc ≤ i.succ := i.castSucc_lt_succ.le
  have hj : j.castSucc ≤ j.succ := j.castSucc_lt_succ.le
  rw [cell_apply]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero,
    Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, mul_one, zero_add]
  exact ⟨(convex_Icc _ _).lineMap_mem ⟨le_rfl, hx hi⟩ ⟨hx hi, le_rfl⟩ p.1.property,
    (convex_Icc _ _).lineMap_mem ⟨le_rfl, hy hj⟩ ⟨hy hj, le_rfl⟩ p.2.property⟩

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.center_re
statement:
@[simp]
theorem center_re (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (center x y i j).re = (x i.castSucc + x i.succ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [center]

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.center_im
statement:
@[simp]
theorem center_im (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (center x y i j).im = (y j.castSucc + y j.succ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [center]

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.center_mem_open_rectangle
statement:
theorem center_mem_open_rectangle (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
