    x i.castSucc < (center x y i j).re ∧ (center x y i j).re < x i.succ ∧
      y j.castSucc < (center x y i j).im ∧ (center x y i j).im < y j.succ
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hx i.castSucc_lt_succ
  have hj := hy j.castSucc_lt_succ
  simp only [center_re, center_im]
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.center_strictly_outside_other_rectangle
statement:
theorem center_strictly_outside_other_rectangle
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y)
    (i k : Fin m) (j l : Fin n) (hne : (i, j) ≠ (k, l)) :
    (center x y i j).re < x k.castSucc ∨ x k.succ < (center x y i j).re ∨
      (center x y i j).im < y l.castSucc ∨ y l.succ < (center x y i j).im
proof:
:= by
  have hcenter := center_mem_open_rectangle x y hx hy i j
  rcases lt_trichotomy i k with hik | rfl | hki
  · exact Or.inl (hcenter.2.1.trans_le (hx.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hik)))
  · rcases lt_trichotomy j l with hjl | rfl | hlj
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl
        (hcenter.2.2.2.trans_le (hy.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hjl)))))
    · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr
        ((hy.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hlj)).trans_lt hcenter.2.2.1)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ((hx.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hki)).trans_lt hcenter.1))

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.connectorChainMap_boundaryOne_single
statement:
theorem connectorChainMap_boundaryOne_single
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) (k : ℤ) :
    connectorChainMap x y q (boundaryOne (Finsupp.single γ k)) =
      k • Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) 1 -
        k • Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundaryOne, connectorChainMap, smul_sub]

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_cycleComparison
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_cycleComparison
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0) :
    ∃ c : Grid.Coefficients m n, ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ =
          mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ -
            Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) c ∧
        IsNullHomologous Δ ∧ RectangularChain.IsCycle c.1 c.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose c d he hd using
    exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeComparison x y hx.monotone hy.monotone q hh hq
  let cm : OneChain C →ₗ[ℤ] Grid.Coefficients m n := Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ c
  let dm : OneChain C →ₗ[ℤ] OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C) :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ d
  let j : C(C, ℂ) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let incl : C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hnull (Ξ : OneChain C) : IsNullHomologous (dm Ξ) := by
    induction Ξ using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (isNullHomologous_zero (X := thickening (8 * h) C))
    | add Ξ Θ hΞ hΘ => simpa only [map_add] using hΞ.add hΘ
    | single γ k => simpa only [dm, Finsupp.linearCombination_single] using (hd γ).smul k
  have heq (Ξ : OneChain C) : mapOne incl (dm Ξ) =
      mapOne j Ξ + connectorChainMap x y q (boundaryOne Ξ) -
        Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) (cm Ξ) := by
    induction Ξ using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add Ξ Θ hΞ hΘ =>
      simp only [map_add, hΞ, hΘ]
      abel
    | single γ k =>
      simp only [dm, cm, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul, mapOne_single,
        connectorChainMap_boundaryOne_single]
      rw [he γ]
      simp only [smul_sub, smul_add, Finsupp.smul_single_one]
      abel
  have hdiff : mapOne incl (dm Γ) = mapOne j Γ -
      Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) (cm Γ) := by
    simpa only [hc, map_zero, add_zero] using heq Γ
  refine ⟨cm Γ, dm Γ, hdiff, hnull Γ, ?_⟩
  apply Grid.isCycle_of_boundaryOne_edgeChain_eq_zero (vertex x y) (vertex_injective x y hx hy)
  have hb := (hnull Γ).boundaryOne_eq_zero
  have hb' : boundaryOne (mapOne incl (dm Γ)) = 0 := by
    rw [boundaryOne_mapOne, hb, map_zero]
  rw [hdiff, map_sub, boundaryOne_mapOne, hc, map_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at hb'
  exact hb'

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_uniform_grid_cycle_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_grid_cycle_approximation (hC : IsCompact C) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ c : Grid.Coefficients (2 * N) (2 * N),
      ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
        mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
          C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ =
            mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ -
              Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)) c ∧
          IsNullHomologous Δ ∧ RectangularChain.IsCycle c.1 c.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, q, hq⟩ := exists_quantizer hC hh
  obtain ⟨c, Δ, he, hn, hc'⟩ := exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_cycleComparison
    (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h) (strictMono_coordinate N hh) (strictMono_coordinate N hh)
    q hh hq Γ hc
  exact ⟨N, c, Δ, he, hn, hc'⟩

name: uniformSubdivision_node_mem_Icc
statement:
private theorem uniformSubdivision_node_mem_Icc {n i : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    (i : ℝ) / n ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  exact ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg i) hn'.le,
    (div_le_one hn').mpr (by exact_mod_cast hi)⟩

name: uniformSubdivision_cell_subset_ball
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.1)]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hδ
  have htop : t ≤ (i : ℝ) / n + 1 / n := by simpa only [add_div] using ht.2
  linarith

name: exists_uniform_subdivision_subordinate_open_cover
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_subdivision_subordinate_open_cover
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Sort*} (γ : ℝ → X) (hγ : Continuous γ)
    (U : ι → Set X) (hU : ∀ j, IsOpen (U j))
    (hcover : γ '' Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ j, U j) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ i < n, ∃ j, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / n) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / n),
      γ t ∈ U j
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ j, γ ⁻¹' U j := by
    intro t ht
    simpa only [mem_iUnion, mem_preimage] using hcover (mem_image_of_mem γ ht)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hmesh⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric isCompact_Icc
    (fun j => hγ.isOpen_preimage _ (hU j)) hpre
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
  have hm' : 1 / ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < δ := by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hm
  refine ⟨m + 1, Nat.succ_pos m, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmesh ((i : ℝ) / (m + 1 : ℕ))
    (uniformSubdivision_node_mem_Icc (Nat.succ_pos m) hi.le)
  exact ⟨j, fun t ht => hj (uniformSubdivision_cell_subset_ball hm' ht)⟩

name: exists_uniform_grid_subordinate_open_cover
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_grid_subordinate_open_cover
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Sort*} (ψ : ℝ × ℝ → X) (hψ : Continuous ψ)
    (U : ι → Set X) (hU : ∀ j, IsOpen (U j))
    (hcover : ψ '' Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ j, U j) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ i < n, ∀ k < n, ∃ j,
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (((i : ℝ) / n), ((k : ℝ) / n))
        (((i + 1 : ℝ) / n), ((k + 1 : ℝ) / n)), ψ t ∈ U j
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ j, ψ ⁻¹' U j := by
    intro t ht
    simpa only [mem_iUnion, mem_preimage] using hcover (mem_image_of_mem ψ ht)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hmesh⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric isCompact_Icc
    (fun j => hψ.isOpen_preimage _ (hU j)) hpre
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
  have hm' : 1 / ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < δ := by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hm
  refine ⟨m + 1, Nat.succ_pos m, ?_⟩
  intro i hi k hk
  have hi' := uniformSubdivision_node_mem_Icc (Nat.succ_pos m) hi.le
  have hk' := uniformSubdivision_node_mem_Icc (Nat.succ_pos m) hk.le
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmesh (((i : ℝ) / (m + 1 : ℕ)), ((k : ℝ) / (m + 1 : ℕ)))
    ⟨⟨hi'.1, hk'.1⟩, ⟨hi'.2, hk'.2⟩⟩
  refine ⟨j, fun t ht => hj ?_⟩
  rw [mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
  exact ⟨mem_ball.mp (uniformSubdivision_cell_subset_ball hm' ⟨ht.1.1, ht.2.1⟩),
    mem_ball.mp (uniformSubdivision_cell_subset_ball hm' ⟨ht.1.2, ht.2.2⟩)⟩

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_of_pathHomotopy
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_of_pathHomotopy
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} (γ : Path x x)
    (H : γ.Homotopy (Path.refl x)) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single γ.toContinuousMap 1)
proof:
:= by
  let q : C(I × I, X) := ⟨H, H.toHomotopy.continuous⟩
  have hleft : left q = γ.toContinuousMap := by
    ext t
    simp [left, q]
  have hright : right q = ContinuousMap.const I x := by
    ext t
    simp [right, q]
  have hbottom : bottom q = ContinuousMap.const I x := by
    ext t
    simp [bottom, q]
  have htop : top q = ContinuousMap.const I x := by
    ext t
    simp [top, q]
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single q (-1), Finsupp.single x 1, ?_⟩
  simp only [boundaryTwo, constantChain, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
    neg_smul, one_smul, squareBoundary, hleft, hright, hbottom, htop]
  abel

name: Cubical.isNullHomologous_single_trans_sub
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_single_trans_sub
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {a b c : X} (γ : Path a b) (δ : Path b c) :
    IsNullHomologous (Finsupp.single (γ.trans δ).toContinuousMap 1 -
      Finsupp.single γ.toContinuousMap 1 - Finsupp.single δ.toContinuousMap 1)
proof:
:= by
  let r : I := ⟨1 / 2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hi : initialPart (γ.trans δ).toContinuousMap r = γ.toContinuousMap := by
    ext t
    change (γ.trans δ) (t * r) = γ t
    have ht : ((t * r : I) : ℝ) = (t : ℝ) / 2 := by
      simp only [Set.Icc.coe_mul, r]
      ring
    rw [← (γ.trans δ).extend_apply (t * r).property]
    rw [Path.extend_trans_of_le_half _ _ (by rw [ht]; linarith [t.property.2]), ht]
    rw [show 2 * ((t : ℝ) / 2) = (t : ℝ) by ring, γ.extend_apply t.property]
  have hf : finalPart (γ.trans δ).toContinuousMap r = δ.toContinuousMap := by
    ext t
    change (γ.trans δ) (unitInterval.symm (unitInterval.symm r * unitInterval.symm t)) = δ t
    let u := unitInterval.symm (unitInterval.symm r * unitInterval.symm t)
    have ht : (u : ℝ) = (1 + (t : ℝ)) / 2 := by
      simp only [u, unitInterval.coe_symm_eq, Set.Icc.coe_mul, r]
      ring
    change (γ.trans δ) u = δ t
    rw [← (γ.trans δ).extend_apply u.property]
    rw [Path.extend_trans_of_half_le _ _ (by rw [ht]; linarith [t.property.1]), ht]
    rw [show 2 * ((1 + (t : ℝ)) / 2) - 1 = (t : ℝ) by ring, δ.extend_apply t.property]
  have h := isNullHomologous_single_sub_initialPart_sub_finalPart (γ.trans δ).toContinuousMap r
  rwa [hi, hf] at h

name: NLAlib.isCoveringMap_of_isProperMap_of_isLocalHomeomorph
statement:
theorem isCoveringMap_of_isProperMap_of_isLocalHomeomorph
    {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space E] [T2Space X]
    {f : E → X} (hf : IsProperMap f) (hlocal : IsLocalHomeomorph f) : IsCoveringMap f
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite (x : X) : (f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite := by
    have himage : (f '' (f ⁻¹' {x})).Finite :=
      (finite_singleton x).subset (by rintro _ ⟨e, he, rfl⟩; exact he)
    exact (hf.isCompact_preimage isCompact_singleton).finite
      (hlocal.isLocalHomeomorphOn.isDiscrete_of_image himage.isDiscrete)
  intro x
  exact hf.isClosedMap.isEvenlyCovered_of_openPartialHomeomorph (hfinite x)
    (fun e _ => by
      obtain ⟨φ, he, hφ⟩ := hlocal e
      exact ⟨φ, he, hφ.symm⟩)

name: NLAlib.bijective_of_isProperMap_of_isLocalHomeomorph
statement:
theorem bijective_of_isProperMap_of_isLocalHomeomorph
    {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space E] [T2Space X]
    [Nonempty E] [PreconnectedSpace E] [SimplyConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    {f : E → X} (hf : IsProperMap f) (hlocal : IsLocalHomeomorph f) : Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  have hcov := isCoveringMap_of_isProperMap_of_isLocalHomeomorph hf hlocal
  let e : E := Classical.arbitrary E
  obtain ⟨g, hg, _⟩ := hcov.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts (ContinuousMap.id X) (f e) e rfl
  have hgf : (g : X → E) ∘ f = id := by
    apply hcov.eq_of_comp_eq (g.continuous.comp hf.continuous) continuous_id
    · ext x
      exact congrFun hg.2 (f x)
    · exact hg.1
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg g hxy
    exact (congrFun hgf x).symm.trans (h.trans (congrFun hgf y))
  · intro x
    exact ⟨g x, congrFun hg.2 x⟩

name: Fin.partialSum_sub
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [partialSum_succ, partialSum_succ, partialSum_succ, ih]
    abel

name: Fin.partialSum_ite_eq_one
statement:
theorem partialSum_ite_eq_one {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    partialSum (fun j => if j = a then (1 : ℤ) else 0) i =
      if a.castSucc < i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [partialSum_succ, ih]
    simp only [Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff, Fin.castSucc_lt_succ_iff]
    rcases lt_trichotomy a i with h | rfl | h
    · simp [h, h.le, h.ne']
    · simp
    · have hna : ¬a < i := not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt h)
      have hna' : ¬a ≤ i := not_le.mpr h
      simp [hna, hna', ne_of_lt h]

name: Cubical.Grid.intervalCoefficients_eq
statement:
theorem intervalCoefficients_eq (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    intervalCoefficients a b i =
      (if a ≤ i.castSucc then 1 else 0) - (if b ≤ i.castSucc then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intervalCoefficients, Fin.edgePrefix, Fin.partialSum_sub,
    Fin.partialSum_ite_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_lt_succ_iff]

name: Cubical.Grid.edgeBoundary_intervalCoefficients
statement:
theorem edgeBoundary_intervalCoefficients (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Fin.edgeBoundary (intervalCoefficients a b) i =
      (if i = a then 1 else 0) - (if i = b then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.edgeBoundary_edgePrefix
  simp only [sum_sub_distrib, sum_ite_eq', mem_univ, if_true, sub_self]

name: Cubical.Grid.intervalCoefficients_ne_zero_bounds
statement:
theorem intervalCoefficients_ne_zero_bounds (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : intervalCoefficients a b i ≠ 0) :
    min a b ≤ i.castSucc ∧ i.succ ≤ max a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalCoefficients_eq] at hi
  split_ifs at hi with ha hb hb
  · exact False.elim (hi (by norm_num))
  · have hab : i.castSucc < b := lt_of_not_ge hb
    constructor
    · exact (min_le_left a b).trans ha
    · exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le.mp hab).trans (le_max_right a b)
  · have hab : i.castSucc < a := lt_of_not_ge ha
    constructor
    · exact (min_le_right a b).trans hb
    · exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le.mp hab).trans (le_max_left a b)
  · exact False.elim (hi (by norm_num))

name: Cubical.Grid.boundaryOne_horizontalWalk
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_horizontalWalk
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (a b : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    boundaryOne (horizontalWalk v a b j) = Finsupp.single (v b j) 1 - Finsupp.single (v a j) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he := Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul (intervalCoefficients a b)
    (fun i => Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ))
  simp only [edgeBoundary_intervalCoefficients, sub_smul, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
    sum_sub_distrib, sum_ite_eq', mem_univ, if_true] at he
  simp only [horizontalWalk, map_sum, map_smul, boundaryOne,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, horizontal, Path.coe_toContinuousMap,
    Path.source, Path.target, smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib]
  simpa only [smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib, neg_sub] using congrArg Neg.neg he.symm

name: Cubical.Grid.boundaryOne_verticalWalk
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_verticalWalk
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    boundaryOne (verticalWalk v i a b) = Finsupp.single (v i b) 1 - Finsupp.single (v i a) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he := Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul (intervalCoefficients a b)
    (fun j => Finsupp.single (v i j) (1 : ℤ))
  simp only [edgeBoundary_intervalCoefficients, sub_smul, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
    sum_sub_distrib, sum_ite_eq', mem_univ, if_true] at he
  simp only [verticalWalk, map_sum, map_smul, boundaryOne,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, vertical, Path.coe_toContinuousMap,
    Path.source, Path.target, smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib]
  simpa only [smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib, neg_sub] using congrArg Neg.neg he.symm

name: Cubical.Grid.walkChain_eq_horizontalWalk_add_verticalWalk
statement:
theorem walkChain_eq_horizontalWalk_add_verticalWalk
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) :
    walkChain v p q = horizontalWalk v p.1 q.1 p.2 + verticalWalk v q.1 p.2 q.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [walkChain, edgeChain, walkHorizontalCoefficients, walkVerticalCoefficients,
    horizontalWalk, verticalWalk, ite_smul]

name: Cubical.Grid.boundaryOne_walkChain
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_walkChain
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) :
    boundaryOne (walkChain v p q) =
      Finsupp.single (v q.1 q.2) 1 - Finsupp.single (v p.1 p.2) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [walkChain_eq_horizontalWalk_add_verticalWalk, map_add,
    boundaryOne_horizontalWalk, boundaryOne_verticalWalk]
  abel

name: Cubical.Grid.edgeChain_mem_supported
statement:
theorem edgeChain_mem_supported
    (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ)
    (S : Set C(I, E))
    (hH : ∀ i j, h i j ≠ 0 → horizontal v i j ∈ S)
    (hV : ∀ i j, w i j ≠ 0 → vertical v i j ∈ S) :
    edgeChain v h w ∈ Finsupp.supported ℤ ℤ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P := Finsupp.supported ℤ ℤ S
  apply P.add_mem
  · apply P.sum_mem
    intro i _
    apply P.sum_mem
    intro j _
    by_cases hc : h i j = 0
    · simpa only [hc, zero_smul] using P.zero_mem
    · exact P.smul_mem _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported ℤ 1 (hH i j hc))
  · apply P.sum_mem
    intro i _
    apply P.sum_mem
    intro j _
    by_cases hc : w i j = 0
    · simpa only [hc, zero_smul] using P.zero_mem
    · exact P.smul_mem _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported ℤ 1 (hV i j hc))

name: NLAlib.cot_pi_sub
statement: theorem cot_pi_sub (x : ℝ) : Real.cot (π - x) = -Real.cot x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, cos_pi_sub, sin_pi_sub, neg_div]

name: NLAlib.cot_pi_div_two_sub
statement: theorem cot_pi_div_two_sub (x : ℝ) : Real.cot (π / 2 - x) = tan x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, tan_eq_sin_div_cos, cos_pi_div_two_sub, sin_pi_div_two_sub]

name: NLAlib.cot_sub_tan_eq_two_mul_cot_two_mul
statement:
theorem cot_sub_tan_eq_two_mul_cot_two_mul {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hxπ : x < π / 2) :
    Real.cot x - tan x = 2 * Real.cot (2 * x)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : sin x ≠ 0 := (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx (by linarith [pi_pos])).ne'
  have hc : cos x ≠ 0 := (cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], hxπ⟩).ne'
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, sin_two_mul, cos_two_mul]
  field_simp [hs, hc]
  nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq x]

name: NLAlib.cot_half_index_reflect
statement:
theorem cot_half_index_reflect {N j : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hj : j < 2 * N) :
    Real.cot ((((2 * N - 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)) =
      -Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
proof:
:= by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have heq : (((2 * N - 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) =
      π - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [heq, cot_pi_sub]

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentPrefix_two_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rootCotangentPrefix_two_mul_eq_zero {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun j : ℕ => Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
  have hr := sum_range_reflect f (2 * N)
  have heq : (∑ j ∈ range (2 * N), f (2 * N - 1 - j)) = -∑ j ∈ range (2 * N), f j := by
    rw [← sum_neg_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact cot_half_index_reflect hN (mem_range.mp hj)
  rw [heq] at hr
  change (∑ j ∈ range (2 * N), f j) = 0
  linarith

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentPrefix_reflect
statement:
theorem rootCotangentPrefix_reflect {N r : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hr : r ≤ 2 * N) :
    rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * N - r) = rootCotangentPrefix N r
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun j : ℕ => Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
  have hsum := sum_Ico_reflect f 0 (m := r) (n := 2 * N - 1) (by omega)
  simp only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, show 2 * N - 1 + 1 = 2 * N by omega, Nat.sub_zero] at hsum
  have heq : (∑ j ∈ range r, f (2 * N - 1 - j)) = -rootCotangentPrefix N r := by
    change (∑ j ∈ range r, f (2 * N - 1 - j)) = -∑ j ∈ range r, f j
    rw [← sum_neg_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact cot_half_index_reflect hN ((mem_range.mp hj).trans_le hr)
  rw [heq, sum_Ico_eq_sub f (Nat.sub_le _ _)] at hsum
  change -rootCotangentPrefix N r = rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * N) - rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * N - r) at hsum
  rw [rootCotangentPrefix_two_mul_eq_zero hN] at hsum
  linarith

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentSample_reflect
statement:
theorem rootCotangentSample_reflect {N k : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    rootCotangentSample N (N - k) = rootCotangentSample N k
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootCotangentSample
  rw [Nat.sub_sub_self hk, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib,
    rootCotangentPrefix_reflect hN (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hk)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentPrefix_succ
statement:
theorem rootCotangentPrefix_succ (N r : ℕ) :
    rootCotangentPrefix N (r + 1) = rootCotangentPrefix N r +
      Real.cot (((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_range_succ _ _

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentSample_sub_succ
statement:
theorem rootCotangentSample_sub_succ {N k : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hk : k < N / 2) :
    (N : ℝ) * (rootCotangentSample N (k + 1) - rootCotangentSample N k) =
      2 * Real.cot (((2 * k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * π / (2 * N)) -
        Real.cot ((((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)) -
        Real.cot ((((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
proof:
:= by
  have hkN : k + 1 ≤ N := by omega
  have hkNR : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hkN
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  let u := ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)
  have hu : 0 < u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  have huπ : u < π / 2 := by dsimp [u]; rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have href : Real.cot ((((N - (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)) = tan u := by
    have heq : (((N - (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) = π / 2 - u := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkN]
      push_cast
      dsimp [u]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq, cot_pi_div_two_sub]
  have hpair := cot_sub_tan_eq_two_mul_cot_two_mul hu huπ
  unfold rootCotangentSample
  rw [show N - k = (N - (k + 1)) + 1 by omega, rootCotangentPrefix_succ,
    rootCotangentPrefix_succ, show 2 * (k + 1) = (2 * k + 1) + 1 by omega,
    rootCotangentPrefix_succ, rootCotangentPrefix_succ, href]
  dsimp [u] at hpair
  have harg : 2 * (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)) = ((2 * k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * π / (2 * N) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [harg] at hpair
  rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hNR.ne', mul_div_cancel₀ _ hNR.ne']
  linear_combination hpair

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentSample_succ_le
statement:
theorem rootCotangentSample_succ_le {N k : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hk : k < N / 2) :
    rootCotangentSample N (k + 1) ≤ rootCotangentSample N k
proof:
:= by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hkR : 2 * (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * k + 2 ≤ N by omega)
  let a := (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)
  let b := (2 * (k : ℝ) + 3 / 2) * π / (2 * N)
  have ha : a ∈ Ioc 0 (π / 2) := by
    dsimp [a]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hb : b ∈ Ioc 0 (π / 2) := by
    dsimp [b]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hconv := convexOn_cot.2 ha hb (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hmid : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • a + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • b = (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * π / (2 * N) := by
    dsimp [a, b]
    ring
  rw [hmid] at hconv
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hconv
  have hd := rootCotangentSample_sub_succ hN hk
  push_cast at hd
  have hbarg : (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) = b := by dsimp [b]; ring
  rw [hbarg] at hd
  change (N : ℝ) * (rootCotangentSample N (k + 1) - rootCotangentSample N k) =
    2 * Real.cot ((2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * π / (2 * N)) - Real.cot a - Real.cot b at hd
  have hn : (N : ℝ) * (rootCotangentSample N (k + 1) - rootCotangentSample N k) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hd]
    nlinarith
  have hs : rootCotangentSample N (k + 1) - rootCotangentSample N k ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by simpa only [mul_zero] using hn) hNR
  exact sub_nonpos.mp hs

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentSample_center_le
statement:
theorem rootCotangentSample_center_le {N k : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hk0 : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k < N) :
    rootCotangentSample N (N / 2) ≤ rootCotangentSample N k
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < N := by omega
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (rootCotangentSample N) (Set.Icc 1 (N / 2) : Set ℕ) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_succ_le (ordConnected_Icc : (Set.Icc 1 (N / 2) : Set ℕ).OrdConnected)
    intro j hjmax hj hjs
    have hjupper := hjs.2
    change j + 1 ≤ N / 2 at hjupper
    exact rootCotangentSample_succ_le hpos (by omega)
  by_cases hk : k ≤ N / 2
  · exact hanti ⟨hk0, hk⟩ ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩ hk
  · have hr0 : 1 ≤ N - k := by omega
    have hrN : N - k ≤ N / 2 := by omega
    have h := hanti ⟨hr0, hrN⟩ ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩ hrN
    rw [rootCotangentSample_reflect hpos hkN.le] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.cot_half_index_complement
statement:
theorem cot_half_index_complement {N j : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hj : j < N) :
    Real.cot ((((N - 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N)) =
      tan (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
proof:
:= by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have heq : (((N - 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) =
      π / 2 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [heq, cot_pi_div_two_sub]

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentPrefix_sub_complement
statement:
theorem rootCotangentPrefix_sub_complement {N r : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hr : r ≤ N) :
    rootCotangentPrefix N N - rootCotangentPrefix N (N - r) =
      ∑ j ∈ range r, tan (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun j : ℕ => Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
  have hsum := sum_Ico_reflect f 0 (m := r) (n := N - 1) (by omega)
  simp only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, show N - 1 + 1 = N by omega, Nat.sub_zero] at hsum
  rw [sum_Ico_eq_sub f (Nat.sub_le _ _)] at hsum
  refine hsum.symm.trans ?_
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact cot_half_index_complement hN ((mem_range.mp hj).trans_le hr)

name: NLAlib.rootCotangentSample_center_eq
statement:
theorem rootCotangentSample_center_eq {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    rootCotangentSample N (N / 2) =
      (2 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ range (N / 2), Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) +
        (if Odd N then (1 / (N : ℝ)) * tan (π / (4 * N)) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  let m := N / 2
  have hpos : 0 < N := by omega
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hmN : m ≤ N := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have htail := rootCotangentPrefix_sub_complement hpos hmN
  have hpairs : rootCotangentPrefix N m - (∑ j ∈ range m, tan (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))) =
      2 * ∑ j ∈ range m, Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) := by
    unfold rootCotangentPrefix
    rw [← sum_sub_distrib, mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjN : j + 1 ≤ N := by dsimp [m] at hj; have hj' := mem_range.mp hj; omega
    have hjNR : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hjN
    have hu : 0 < ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) := by positivity
    have huπ : ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N) < π / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
    rw [cot_sub_tan_eq_two_mul_cot_two_mul hu huπ]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hlast : rootCotangentPrefix N N - rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * m) =
      if Odd N then tan (π / (4 * N)) else 0 := by
    by_cases hNO : Odd N
    · have hNm : N = 2 * m + 1 := by have ho := Nat.odd_iff.mp hNO; dsimp [m]; omega
      have hidx : 2 * m = N - 1 := by omega
      rw [hNm, rootCotangentPrefix_succ]
      rw [← hNm, hidx, add_sub_cancel_left, if_pos hNO]
      have href := cot_half_index_complement hpos (show 0 < N from hpos)
      simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] at href
      convert href using 1
      congr 1
      ring
    · have hNm : N = 2 * m := by have he := Nat.even_iff.mp (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mp hNO); dsimp [m]; omega
      rw [← hNm, sub_self, if_neg hNO]
  have hnum : rootCotangentPrefix N (N - m) + rootCotangentPrefix N m - rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * m) =
      2 * (∑ j ∈ range m, Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)) +
        (if Odd N then tan (π / (4 * N)) else 0) := by
    linarith
  change (rootCotangentPrefix N (N - m) + rootCotangentPrefix N m - rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * m)) / N = _
  rw [hnum, add_div]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: NLAlib.one_sub_polarSchulz_step
statement:
theorem one_sub_polarSchulz_step (s : ℝ) :
    1 - s * (3 - s ^ 2) / 2 = (s - 1) ^ 2 * (s + 2) / 2
proof: := by ring

name: NLAlib.polarSchulz_step_mem
statement:
theorem polarSchulz_step_mem {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs3 : s ^ 2 < 3) :
    0 < s * (3 - s ^ 2) / 2 ∧ s * (3 - s ^ 2) / 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · positivity
  · have h := one_sub_polarSchulz_step s
    have hn : 0 ≤ (s - 1) ^ 2 * (s + 2) / 2 := by positivity
    linarith

name: NLAlib.polarSchulzScalar_mem
statement:
theorem polarSchulzScalar_mem {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs3 : s ^ 2 < 3) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ∧ polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact polarSchulz_step_mem hs hs3
  | succ k ih =>
    apply polarSchulz_step_mem ih.1
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) - 1)]

name: NLAlib.one_sub_sq_polarSchulz_step
statement:
theorem one_sub_sq_polarSchulz_step (s : ℝ) :
    1 - (s * (3 - s ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 = (1 - s ^ 2) ^ 2 * (3 + (1 - s ^ 2)) / 4
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: NLAlib.polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem
statement:
theorem polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs3 : s ^ 2 < 3) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ 1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2 ∧
      1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2 < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hle⟩ := polarSchulzScalar_mem hs hs3 k
  constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hp]

name: NLAlib.polarSchulzScalar_defect_step_le
statement:
theorem polarSchulzScalar_defect_step_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs3 : s ^ 2 < 3)
    (k : ℕ) :
    1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 2) ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 by omega, polarSchulzScalar,
    one_sub_sq_polarSchulz_step]
  have he := polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem hs hs3 k
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith :
    3 + (1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2) ≤ 4)
      (sq_nonneg (1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.polarSchulzScalar_defect_le
statement:
theorem polarSchulzScalar_defect_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs3 : s ^ 2 < 3)
    (k : ℕ) :
    1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - polarSchulzScalar s 1 ^ 2) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 - polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
        polarSchulzScalar_defect_step_le hs hs3 k
      _ ≤ ((1 - polarSchulzScalar s 1 ^ 2) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem hs hs3 k).1 ih 2
      _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.abs_polarSchulzScalar_sub_one_le_defect
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hle⟩ := polarSchulzScalar_mem hs hs3 k
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_polarSchulzScalar
statement:
theorem tendsto_polarSchulzScalar {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs3 : s ^ 2 < 3) :
    Tendsto (polarSchulzScalar s) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he0, he1⟩ := polarSchulzScalar_defect_mem hs hs3 0
  have hp := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one he0 he1).comp
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2))
  have ht : Tendsto (fun k => polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1) - 1) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero_norm (fun k => (abs_polarSchulzScalar_sub_one_le_defect hs hs3 k).trans
      (polarSchulzScalar_defect_le hs hs3 k)) hp
  have hh : Tendsto (fun k => polarSchulzScalar s (k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using ht.add_const 1
  exact (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp hh

name: NLAlib.tsum_inv_pow_nat_succ_le_two
statement:
theorem tsum_inv_pow_nat_succ_le_two {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p)⁻¹) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le (fun j => by positivity)
  intro m
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range m, (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
      apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ j + 1 by omega)) hp
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Ioo 0 (m + 1), ((j : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [show Ioo 0 (m + 1) = Ico 1 (m + 1) by ext j; simp; omega,
        sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_comm 1]
    _ ≤ 2 := by simpa using (sum_Ioo_inv_sq_le (α := ℝ) 0 (m + 1))

name: Function.abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_bound
statement:
theorem abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (S : ι → Set ℝ) (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x, (∀ j, x j ∈ S j) → ∀ y, (∀ j, y j ∈ S j) →
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = y j) → |f x - f y| ≤ L i * |x i - y i|)
    {x y : ι → ℝ} (hx : ∀ j, x j ∈ S j) (hy : ∀ j, y j ∈ S j) :
    |f x - f y| ≤ ∑ i, L i * |x i - y i|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let z (s : Finset ι) : ι → ℝ := fun i => if i ∈ s then x i else y i
  have hz (s : Finset ι) : ∀ j, z s j ∈ S j := by
    intro j
    dsimp [z]
    split_ifs
    · exact hx j
    · exact hy j
  have h (s : Finset ι) : |f (z s) - f y| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, L i * |x i - y i| := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [z]
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      have hcoord := hf i (z (insert i s)) (hz _) (z s) (hz _) (by
        intro j hji
        simp [z, hji])
      simp only [z, mem_insert_self, if_true, if_neg hi] at hcoord
      rw [sum_insert hi]
      exact (abs_sub_le (f (z (insert i s))) (f (z s)) (f y)).trans (add_le_add hcoord ih)
  simpa only [z, Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using h univ

name: sphereChernoffParameter_mul_sub_lt_half
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < 1+x := by linarith
  have hx1 : 0 < 1-x := by linarith
  have hs : 0 < 1-x^2 := by nlinarith
  have ht : 0 < sphereChernoffParameter m x := by unfold sphereChernoffParameter; positivity
  have he : 1 - 2 * sphereChernoffParameter m x * (1-x) = (1+m)/(1+x) := by
    unfold sphereChernoffParameter
    field_simp
    ring
  have hp : 0 < (1+m)/(1+x) := div_pos (by linarith) hx0
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd ht.le
  nlinarith

name: card_mul_sub_sq_div_two_le_sum_log_affine
statement:
theorem card_mul_sub_sq_div_two_le_sum_log_affine {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (d : ι → ℝ) {m x : ℝ} (hm : -1 < m) (_hm1 : m < 1)
    (hmx : m < x) (hx : x < 1) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∑ i, d i = Fintype.card ι * m) :
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (x-m)^2 / 2 ≤
      ∑ i, log (1 - 2*sphereChernoffParameter m x*(d i-x))
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < 1+m := by linarith
  have hm1' : 0 < 1-m := by linarith
  have hx0 : 0 < 1+x := by linarith
  have hx1 : 0 < 1-x := by linarith
  let a := (1+m)/(1+x)
  let b := (1-m)/(1-x)
  have ha : 0 < a := div_pos hm0 hx0
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos hm1' hx1
  have hi (i : ι) :
      ((1+d i)/2)*log a + ((1-d i)/2)*log b ≤
        log (1 - 2*sphereChernoffParameter m x*(d i-x)) := by
    have hc := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.concaveOn.2 ha hb
      (show 0 ≤ (1+d i)/2 by linarith [(hd i).1])
      (show 0 ≤ (1-d i)/2 by linarith [(hd i).2]) (by ring)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hc
    have he : 1 - 2*sphereChernoffParameter m x*(d i-x) =
        ((1+d i)/2)*a + ((1-d i)/2)*b := by
      have hs : 0 < 1-x^2 := by nlinarith
      dsimp [a,b,sphereChernoffParameter]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hx0, ne_of_gt hx1, ne_of_gt hs]
      ring
    rwa [he]
  have hsplus : ∑ i, (1+d i)/2 = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*(1+m)/2 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hmean]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  have hsminus : ∑ i, (1-d i)/2 = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*(1-m)/2 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hmean]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  have hsum : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) *
      (((1+m)/2)*log a + ((1-m)/2)*log b) ≤
      ∑ i, log (1 - 2*sphereChernoffParameter m x*(d i-x)) := by
    apply le_trans _ (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hi i)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hsplus, hsminus]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have hkl := two_mul_sub_sq_le_binary_log
    (p := (1+m)/2) (q := (1+x)/2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have he₁ : ((1+m)/2)/((1+x)/2) = a := by dsimp [a]; field_simp
  have he₂ : (1-(1+m)/2)/(1-(1+x)/2) = b := by
    rw [show 1-(1+m)/2 = (1-m)/2 by ring, show 1-(1+x)/2 = (1-x)/2 by ring]
    dsimp [b]
    field_simp
  rw [he₁,he₂] at hkl
  have he₃ : 1-(1+m)/2 = (1-m)/2 := by ring
  rw [he₃] at hkl
  apply le_trans _ hsum
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkl (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card ι))
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.two_mul_sub_div_add_le_log
statement:
theorem two_mul_sub_div_add_le_log {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    2 * (x - 1) / (x + 1) ≤ log x
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun x : ℝ => log x - 2 * (x - 1) / (x + 1)
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ Ici (1 : ℝ), HasDerivAt f ((x - 1) ^ 2 / (x * (x + 1) ^ 2)) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : 1 ≤ x := hx
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by linarith [hx']
    have hx1 : x + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith [hx']
    have h := (Real.hasDerivAt_log hx0).sub
      ((((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const 1).const_mul 2).div ((hasDerivAt_id x).add_const 1) hx1)
    apply h.congr_deriv
    simp only [id_eq]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hm : MonotoneOn f (Ici (1 : ℝ)) :=
    monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Ici 1)
      (fun x hx => (hd x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun x hx => (hd x (interior_subset hx)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun x hx => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by have hx' : 1 ≤ x := interior_subset hx; linarith) (sq_nonneg _)))
  have h := hm (by simp) hx hx
  dsimp [f] at h
  rw [log_one] at h
  norm_num at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.cotangent_log_remainder_le_one
statement: theorem cotangent_log_remainder_le_one : (2 / π) * (2 + log (2 / π)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < π := pi_pos
  have hlo := two_mul_sub_div_add_le_log (x := π / 2) (by linarith [pi_gt_three])
  have hlog : log (2 / π) = -log (π / 2) := by
    rw [show 2 / π = (π / 2)⁻¹ by field_simp, log_inv]
  rw [hlog, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hp]
  have hden : 0 < π / 2 + 1 := by linarith
  have hnum : 2 * (π / 2 - 1) / (π / 2 + 1) ≥ 2 - π / 2 := by
    rw [ge_iff_le, le_div_iff₀ hden]
    nlinarith [pi_gt_d2]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_cons
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_cons {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
    {k : ℕ} (hk : finrank 𝕜 E = k + 1) (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (bW : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) 𝕜 (𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (k + 1)) 𝕜 E,
      b 0 = u ∧ ∀ i, b i.succ = (bW i : E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : Fin (k + 1) → E := Fin.cons u (fun i => (bW i : E))
  have hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · simp [v, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hu]
      · have hinner : inner 𝕜 u (bW j : E) = 0 :=
          Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp (bW j).property
        simpa only [v, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm, ite_false] using hinner
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · have hinner : inner 𝕜 (bW i : E) u = 0 :=
          Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left.mp (bW i).property
        simpa only [v, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false] using hinner
      · simpa only [v, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, Submodule.coe_inner] using
          (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp bW.orthonormal i j)
  let c : Basis (Fin (k + 1)) 𝕜 E :=
    basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' v hv.linearIndependent (by simpa using hk.symm)
  let b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (k + 1)) 𝕜 E :=
    c.toOrthonormalBasis (by simpa only [c, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'] using hv)
  have hb (i : Fin (k + 1)) : b i = v i := by
    simp only [b, Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis, c, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank']
  exact ⟨b, hb 0, fun i => hb i.succ⟩

name: NLAlib.bisectionInterval_sub
statement:
theorem bisectionInterval_sub (f : ℝ → ℝ) (v lo hi : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).2 - (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).1 =
      (hi - lo) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [bisectionInterval]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [bisectionInterval]
    split_ifs <;> dsimp <;> rw [pow_succ] <;> rw [div_mul_eq_div_div] <;> rw [← ih] <;> ring

name: NLAlib.bisectionInterval_contains_root
statement:
theorem bisectionInterval_contains_root {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a v lo hi root : ℝ}
    (hf : StrictMonoOn f (Ioi a)) (hroot : f root = v)
    (ha : a ≤ lo) (hlo : lo < root) (hhi : root ≤ hi) (n : ℕ) :
    a ≤ (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).1 ∧
      (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).1 < root ∧
      root ≤ (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨ha, hlo, hhi⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    let p := bisectionInterval f v lo hi n
    have hp : a ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 < root ∧ root ≤ p.2 := ih
    have hmid : a < (p.1 + p.2) / 2 := by linarith [hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2]
    have hroota : a < root := lt_of_le_of_lt ha hlo
    have htest : f ((p.1 + p.2) / 2) < v ↔ (p.1 + p.2) / 2 < root := by
      rw [← hroot]
      exact hf.lt_iff_lt hmid hroota
    change a ≤ (if f ((p.1 + p.2) / 2) < v then ((p.1 + p.2) / 2, p.2)
      else (p.1, (p.1 + p.2) / 2)).1 ∧
      (if f ((p.1 + p.2) / 2) < v then ((p.1 + p.2) / 2, p.2)
      else (p.1, (p.1 + p.2) / 2)).1 < root ∧
      root ≤ (if f ((p.1 + p.2) / 2) < v then ((p.1 + p.2) / 2, p.2)
      else (p.1, (p.1 + p.2) / 2)).2
    split_ifs with h
    · exact ⟨hmid.le, htest.mp h, hp.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, le_of_not_gt (fun hlt => h (htest.mpr hlt))⟩

name: NLAlib.bisectionInterval_upper_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem bisectionInterval_upper_sub_root_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a v lo hi root : ℝ}
    (hf : StrictMonoOn f (Ioi a)) (hroot : f root = v)
    (ha : a ≤ lo) (hlo : lo < root) (hhi : root ≤ hi) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).2 - root ∧
      (bisectionInterval f v lo hi n).2 - root ≤ (hi - lo) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hl, hu⟩ := bisectionInterval_contains_root hf hroot ha hlo hhi n
  constructor
  · exact sub_nonneg.mpr hu
  · rw [← bisectionInterval_sub f v lo hi n]
    linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_equal_peaks_with_convex_combination
proof:
:= by
  let Γ : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin n → ℝ := fun x j => M j.succ x - M 0 x
  obtain ⟨g, _, hgU, hright, hleft, hginv⟩ :=
    exists_inverse_of_isProperMap_of_hasStrictFDerivAt hU hΓ hproper
  refine ⟨g 0, hgU 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine Fin.cases rfl (fun j => ?_) i
    have h := congrFun (hright 0) j
    dsimp at h
    linarith
  · intro u hu
    let a : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => M i u
    let z : ℝ → Fin n → ℝ := fun s => g (s • Γ u)
    let b : ℝ → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun s i => L i (z s) ((D (z s)).symm (Γ u))
    have hzU (s : ℝ) : z s ∈ U := hgU _
    have hdifference (s : ℝ) (j : Fin n) : b s j.succ - b s 0 = a j.succ - a 0 := by
      have hd := (hasFDerivAt_apply j (Γ (z s))).comp (z s) (hΓ (z s) (hzU s)).hasFDerivAt
      have hm := (hM j.succ (z s) (hzU s)).sub (hM 0 (z s) (hzU s))
      have heq := hd.unique hm
      have hv := congrArg (fun A : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ => A ((D (z s)).symm (Γ u))) heq
      change (D (z s) ((D (z s)).symm (Γ u))) j =
        L j.succ (z s) ((D (z s)).symm (Γ u)) - L 0 (z s) ((D (z s)).symm (Γ u)) at hv
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hv
      exact hv.symm
    have hb (s : ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : b s i = b s 0 + a i - a 0 := by
      refine Fin.cases (by ring) (fun j => ?_) i
      linarith [hdifference s j]
    have hscalar (s : ℝ) : b s 0 - a 0 = -∑ i, W (z s) i * a i := by
      have hN := hnormal (z s) (hzU s) ((D (z s)).symm (Γ u))
      change ∑ i, W (z s) i * b s i = 0 at hN
      have hsum : (∑ i, W (z s) i * b s i) =
          b s 0 + (∑ i, W (z s) i * a i) - a 0 := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ i, W (z s) i * (b s 0 + a i - a 0) :=
            sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => congrArg (fun t => W (z s) i * t) (hb s i))
          _ = _ := by
            simp_rw [mul_sub, mul_add]
            rw [sum_sub_distrib, sum_add_distrib, ← sum_mul, ← sum_mul,
              hWsum (z s) (hzU s), one_mul, one_mul]
      rw [hsum] at hN
      linarith
    let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => M 0 (z s) - s * a 0
    have hcder (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt c (b s 0 - a 0) s := by
      have hline := (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const (Γ u)
      simp only [one_smul] at hline
      have hg := (hginv (s • Γ u)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hline
      have hm := (hM 0 (z s) (hzU s)).comp_hasDerivAt s hg
      convert! hm.sub ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const (a 0)) using 1
      simp only [b, z, one_mul, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    obtain ⟨s, _, hs⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope c (fun s => b s 0 - a 0)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) (fun t _ => (hcder t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t _ => hcder t)
    have hc0 : c 0 = M 0 (g 0) := by simp [c, z]
    have hc1 : c 1 = 0 := by
      have hl : g (Γ u) = u := hleft u hu
      simp only [c, z, one_smul, one_mul, hl, a, sub_self]
    rw [hc0, hc1] at hs
    simp only [sub_zero, div_one, zero_sub] at hs
    refine ⟨W (z s), hWnonneg (z s) (hzU s), hWsum (z s) (hzU s), ?_⟩
    linarith [hscalar s]

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_mem_Icc_of_nonneg_sum_one
statement:
theorem sum_mul_mem_Icc_of_nonneg_sum_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {w a : ι → ℝ} {A B : ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hs : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ Icc A B) : (∑ i, w i * a i) ∈ Icc A B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · calc
      A = ∑ i, w i * A := by rw [← sum_mul, hs, one_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ i, w i * a i := sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha i).1 (hw i))
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, w i * B := sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha i).2 (hw i))
      _ = B := by rw [← sum_mul, hs, one_mul]

name: Finset.sum_range_sum_range_eq_sum_displacements
statement:
theorem sum_range_sum_range_eq_sum_displacements {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ l ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range l, f j l) =
      ∑ d ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range (n - (d + 1)), f j (j + d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_sigma', sum_sigma']
  apply sum_bij (fun p _ => (⟨p.1 - p.2 - 1, p.2⟩ : (d : ℕ) × ℕ))
  · intro p hp
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range] at hp ⊢
    omega
  · intro p hp q hq he
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range] at hp hq
    have h1 := congrArg Sigma.fst he
    have h2 := congrArg Sigma.snd he
    change p.1 - p.2 - 1 = q.1 - q.2 - 1 at h1
    change p.2 = q.2 at h2
    have hfirst : p.1 = q.1 := by omega
    exact Sigma.ext hfirst (heq_of_eq h2)
  · intro q hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range] at hq
    refine ⟨⟨q.2 + q.1 + 1, q.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range]
      omega
    · apply Sigma.ext
      · change q.2 + q.1 + 1 - q.2 - 1 = q.1
        omega
      · exact HEq.rfl
  · intro p hp
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range] at hp
    change f p.2 p.1 = f p.2 (p.2 + (p.1 - p.2 - 1) + 1)
    congr 1
    omega

name: NLAlib.normSq_sum_real_mul_fourier_eq_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem normSq_sum_real_mul_fourier_eq_autocorrelation
    (v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Complex.normSq (∑ j ∈ range n, (v j : ℂ) * fourier (j : ℤ) t) =
      (∑ j ∈ range n, v j ^ 2) +
        2 * ∑ d ∈ range n, (∑ j ∈ range (n - (d + 1)), v j * v (j + d + 1)) *
          (fourier ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
proof:
:= by
  have htri (m : ℕ) :
      Complex.normSq (∑ j ∈ range m, (v j : ℂ) * fourier (j : ℤ) t) =
        (∑ j ∈ range m, v j ^ 2) +
          2 * ∑ l ∈ range m, ∑ j ∈ range l,
            v j * v l * (fourier ((l - j : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re := by
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ, Complex.normSq_add, ih, Complex.normSq_mul,
        Complex.normSq_ofReal, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
        show ‖fourier (m : ℤ) t‖ = (1 : ℝ) from Circle.norm_coe _]
      have hc : ((∑ j ∈ range m, (v j : ℂ) * fourier (j : ℤ) t) *
          conj ((v m : ℂ) * fourier (m : ℤ) t)).re =
          ∑ j ∈ range m, v j * v m * (fourier ((m - j : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re := by
        rw [sum_mul, Complex.re_sum]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have he : (j : ℤ) + -(m : ℤ) = -((m - j : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          have := mem_range.mp hj
          omega
        rw [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← fourier_neg]
        have hr : (v j : ℂ) * fourier (j : ℤ) t * ((v m : ℂ) * fourier (-(m : ℤ)) t) =
            ((v j * v m : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (fourier (j : ℤ) t * fourier (-(m : ℤ)) t) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hr, ← fourier_add, he, fourier_neg, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.conj_re, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      rw [hc, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ]
      ring
  rw [htri, sum_range_sum_range_eq_sum_displacements]
  congr 2
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  have he (j : ℕ) : j + d + 1 - j = d + 1 := by omega
  simp_rw [he, ← sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.exists_common_power_factors_with_right_eq
statement:
theorem exists_common_power_factors_with_right_eq
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (a : κ → ℝ) (u v : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hu : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ u l x) (hv : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ v l x)
    (hfactor : ∀ l x, a x = u l x ^ (1 - θ) * v l x ^ θ) :
    ∃ U V : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ U x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ V x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = U x ^ (1 - θ) * V x ^ θ) ∧
      (∀ x, U x ^ 2 = ∑ l, u l x ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ l x, V x ≤ v l x) ∧
      (∀ x, V x = (a x / U x ^ (1 - θ)) ^ θ⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : κ → ℝ := fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ l, u l x ^ 2)
  let V : κ → ℝ := fun x => (a x / U x ^ (1 - θ)) ^ θ⁻¹
  have hU : ∀ x, 0 ≤ U x := fun _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hUsq (x : κ) : U x ^ 2 = ∑ l, u l x ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => sq_nonneg (u l x))
  have hule (l : ι) (x : κ) : u l x ≤ U x := by
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun l (_ : l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
      sq_nonneg (u l x)) (Finset.mem_univ l)
    nlinarith [hUsq x, hU x, hu l x]
  have hVpow (x : κ) : V x ^ θ = a x / U x ^ (1 - θ) := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact Real.rpow_inv_rpow (div_nonneg (ha x) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hU x) _)) hθ.1.ne'
  refine ⟨U, V, hU, fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (ha x) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hU x) _)) _, ?_, hUsq, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  · intro x
    rw [hVpow]
    by_cases hzero : U x = 0
    · have hueq : ∀ l, u l x = 0 := fun l => le_antisymm (by simpa [hzero] using hule l x) (hu l x)
      have hazero : a x = 0 := by
        rw [hfactor (Classical.arbitrary ι) x, hueq,
          Real.zero_rpow (by linarith [hθ.2] : 1 - θ ≠ 0), zero_mul]
      simp [hazero]
    · have hpowne : U x ^ (1 - θ) ≠ 0 :=
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hU x) (Ne.symm hzero)) _).ne'
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpowne]
  · intro l x
    have hbound : a x ≤ U x ^ (1 - θ) * v l x ^ θ := by
      rw [hfactor l x]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow (hu l x) (hule l x) (by linarith [hθ.2]))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (hv l x) _)
    have hdiv : a x / U x ^ (1 - θ) ≤ v l x ^ θ := by
      by_cases hzero : U x = 0
      · simp [hzero, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith [hθ.2] : 1 - θ ≠ 0),
          Real.rpow_nonneg (hv l x) θ]
      · apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hU x) (Ne.symm hzero)) _)).mpr
        simpa only [mul_comm] using hbound
    have hh := Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (div_nonneg (ha x) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hU x) _)) hdiv (inv_nonneg.mpr hθ.1.le)
    rwa [Real.rpow_rpow_inv (hv l x) hθ.1.ne'] at hh

name: NLAlib.exists_common_power_factors_of_power_factorizations
statement:
theorem exists_common_power_factors_of_power_factorizations
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (a : κ → ℝ) (u v : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hu : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ u l x) (hv : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ v l x)
    (hfactor : ∀ l x, a x = u l x ^ (1 - θ) * v l x ^ θ) :
    ∃ U V : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ U x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ V x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = U x ^ (1 - θ) * V x ^ θ) ∧
      (∀ x, U x ^ 2 = ∑ l, u l x ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ l x, V x ≤ v l x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hf, hsq, hle, _⟩ :=
    exists_common_power_factors_with_right_eq hθ a u v ha hu hv hfactor
  exact ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hf, hsq, hle⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_mul_rpow_eq
statement:
private theorem sum_sq_mul_rpow_eq
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (a : κ → ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hsum : ∑ j, a j ^ 2 = s ^ 2) (ht : 0 < 2 + 2 * t) :
    ∑ j, (a j * s ^ t) ^ 2 = s ^ (2 + 2 * t)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_pow, ← Finset.sum_mul, hsum]
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · simp [hs0, Real.zero_rpow ht.ne']
  · have hspos := lt_of_le_of_ne hs (Ne.symm hs0)
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast s 2, ← Real.rpow_natCast (s ^ t) 2,
      ← Real.rpow_mul hs, ← Real.rpow_add hspos]
    congr 1
    norm_num
    ring

name: NLAlib.exists_row_power_factors
statement:
theorem exists_row_power_factors
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {p q θ : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : ι → κ → ℝ) (s : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i)
    (hsum : ∀ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 = s i ^ 2) :
    ∃ u v : ι → κ → ℝ,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ u i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ v i j) ∧
      (∀ i j, a i j = u i j ^ (1 - θ) * v i j ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, u i j ^ 2) = ∑ i, s i ^ p ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, v i j ^ 2) ^ (q / 2)) = ∑ i, s i ^ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  let u : ι → κ → ℝ := fun i j => a i j * s i ^ (p / 2 - 1)
  let v : ι → κ → ℝ := fun i j => a i j * s i ^ (p / q - 1)
  have he : (p / 2 - 1) * (1 - θ) + (p / q - 1) * θ = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = p * ((1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q) - 1 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [← hexp]; field_simp; ring
  refine ⟨u, v, fun i j => mul_nonneg (ha i j) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hs i) _),
    fun i j => mul_nonneg (ha i j) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hs i) _), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    by_cases hs0 : s i = 0
    · have hj : a i j = 0 := by
        have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset κ)) =>
          sq_nonneg (a i j)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
        rw [hsum i, hs0] at hh
        nlinarith [ha i j]
      simp [u, v, hj, Real.zero_rpow hθ.1.ne',
        Real.zero_rpow (by linarith [hθ.2] : 1 - θ ≠ 0)]
    · have hspos := lt_of_le_of_ne (hs i) (Ne.symm hs0)
      symm
      dsimp [u, v]
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (ha i j) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hs i) _),
        Real.mul_rpow (ha i j) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hs i) _),
        ← Real.rpow_mul (hs i), ← Real.rpow_mul (hs i)]
      calc
        _ = (a i j ^ (1 - θ) * a i j ^ θ) *
          (s i ^ ((p / 2 - 1) * (1 - θ)) * s i ^ ((p / q - 1) * θ)) := by ring
        _ = a i j := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg (ha i j) (by linarith [hθ.2]) hθ.1.le,
            ← Real.rpow_add hspos, he]
          simp
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hh := sum_sq_mul_rpow_eq (a i) (hs i) (hsum i)
      (t := p / 2 - 1) (by linarith)
    convert hh using 1
    congr 1
    ring
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hh := sum_sq_mul_rpow_eq (a i) (hs i) (hsum i)
      (t := p / q - 1) (by have := div_pos hp0 hq; linarith)
    change (∑ j, (a i j * s i ^ (p / q - 1)) ^ 2) ^ (q / 2) = _
    rw [hh, ← Real.rpow_mul (hs i)]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.exists_scalar_power_factors
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_power_factors
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {p q θ : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : κ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) :
    ∃ u v : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ v x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = u x ^ (1 - θ) * v x ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ x, u x ^ 2) = ∑ x, a x ^ p ∧
      (∑ x, v x ^ q) = ∑ x, a x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => a x ^ (p / 2), fun x => a x ^ (p / q),
    fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (ha x) _, fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (ha x) _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (ha x), ← Real.rpow_mul (ha x)]
    by_cases hx : a x = 0
    · have he₀ : p / 2 * (1 - θ) ≠ 0 :=
        (mul_pos (div_pos hp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)) (by linarith [hθ.2])).ne'
      have he₁ : p / q * θ ≠ 0 := (mul_pos (div_pos hp hq) hθ.1).ne'
      simp [hx, Real.zero_rpow he₀, Real.zero_rpow he₁]
    · rw [← Real.rpow_add (lt_of_le_of_ne (ha x) (Ne.symm hx))]
      have he : p / 2 * (1 - θ) + p / q * θ = 1 := by
        calc
          _ = p * ((1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q) := by ring
          _ = 1 := by rw [← hexp]; field_simp
      rw [he, Real.rpow_one]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (a x ^ (p / 2)) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (ha x)]
    congr 1
    norm_num
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (ha x)]
    congr 1
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ p hq.ne'

name: NLAlib.exists_weighted_scalar_power_factors
statement:
theorem exists_weighted_scalar_power_factors
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {p q θ c : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : κ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) :
    ∃ u v : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ v x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = u x ^ (1 - θ) * v x ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ x, u x ^ 2) = c ^ (θ * p) * ∑ x, a x ^ p ∧
      c ^ q * (∑ x, v x ^ q) = c ^ (θ * p) * ∑ x, a x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hfactor, hleft, hright⟩ :=
    exists_scalar_power_factors hp hq hθ hexp (fun x => c ^ θ * a x)
      (fun x => mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _) (ha x))
  have hsum : (∑ x, (c ^ θ * a x) ^ p) = c ^ (θ * p) * ∑ x, a x ^ p := by
    simp_rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _) (ha _),
      ← Real.rpow_mul hc.le, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  refine ⟨u, fun x => v x / c, hu, fun x => div_nonneg (hv x) hc.le, ?_,
    hleft.trans hsum, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [Real.div_rpow (hv x) hc.le, ← mul_div_assoc, ← hfactor x]
    exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ (a x) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc θ).ne').symm
  · simp_rw [Real.div_rpow (hv _) hc.le, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc q).ne']
    exact hright.trans hsum

name: NLAlib.differentiable_powerInterpolationCoefficient
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem differentiable_powerInterpolationCoefficient (u v : ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (powerInterpolationCoefficient u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold powerInterpolationCoefficient
  split_ifs <;> fun_prop

name: NLAlib.norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_of_pos
statement:
theorem norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_of_pos
    {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖powerInterpolationCoefficient u v z‖ = u ^ (1 - z.re) * v ^ z.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerInterpolationCoefficient, if_pos ⟨hu, hv⟩, Complex.norm_exp,
    Real.rpow_def_of_pos hu, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hv, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_boundaries
statement:
theorem norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_boundaries
    {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖powerInterpolationCoefficient u v ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ u ∧
    ‖powerInterpolationCoefficient u v (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hh : 0 < u ∧ 0 < v
  · simp [norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_of_pos hh.1 hh.2]
  · simp [powerInterpolationCoefficient, hh, hu, hv]

name: NLAlib.powerInterpolationCoefficient_real
statement:
theorem powerInterpolationCoefficient_real
    {u v θ : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    powerInterpolationCoefficient u v (θ : ℂ) = ((u ^ (1 - θ) * v ^ θ : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hh : 0 < u ∧ 0 < v
  · rw [powerInterpolationCoefficient, if_pos hh, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hh.1,
      Real.rpow_def_of_pos hh.2, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_exp,
      Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  · have hz : u = 0 ∨ v = 0 := by
      push Not at hh
      by_cases hu0 : u = 0
      · exact Or.inl hu0
      · exact Or.inr (le_antisymm (hh (lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm hu0))) hv)
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [powerInterpolationCoefficient, Real.zero_rpow hθ.1.ne',
        Real.zero_rpow (by linarith [hθ.2] : 1 - θ ≠ 0)]

name: NLAlib.norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_le_max
statement:
theorem norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_le_max
    {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ‖powerInterpolationCoefficient u v z‖ ≤ max u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hh : 0 < u ∧ 0 < v
  · rw [norm_powerInterpolationCoefficient_of_pos hh.1 hh.2]
    calc
      _ ≤ max u v ^ (1 - z.re) * max u v ^ z.re :=
        mul_le_mul (Real.rpow_le_rpow hu (le_max_left _ _) (sub_nonneg.mpr hz.2))
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow hv (le_max_right _ _) hz.1)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg hv _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hu.trans (le_max_left _ _)) _)
      _ = max u v := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add (hh.1.trans_le (le_max_left _ _))]
        simp
  · simp [powerInterpolationCoefficient, hh, hu.trans (le_max_left u v)]

name: Real.rpow_inv_two_mul_le_exp_half_of_log_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hd with hzero | hpos
  · rw [← hzero, zero_rpow (by positivity : (1/(2*p) : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    exact (exp_pos _).le
  · rw [rpow_def_of_pos hpos]
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hden : 0 < 2*p := by positivity
    have hh : log d/(2*p) ≤ 1/2 := (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr (by linarith)
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using hh

name: Real.exp_one_mul_rpow_inv_two_mul_le_nine_of_log_le
proof:
:= by
  have hdim := rpow_inv_two_mul_le_exp_half_of_log_le hd hp hlog
  have he : exp (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ exp 1 := exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdim.trans he) (exp_pos 1).le
  have hsq : exp 1 * exp 1 ≤ 9 := by
    have h := exp_one_lt_three
    nlinarith [exp_pos 1]
  exact hmul.trans hsq

name: Real.hasSum_pow_sum_fin
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_sum_fin {r : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun t : Fin N → ℕ => r ^ (∑ j, t j)) ((1 - r)⁻¹ ^ N)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ j : Fin N, HasSum (fun k : ℕ => r ^ k) (1 - r)⁻¹ := by
    intro j
    simpa only [one_div] using hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1
  have hn : ∀ j : Fin N, Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖r ^ k‖) := by
    intro j
    exact summable_norm_geometric_of_norm_lt_one
      (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr0] using hr1)
  have h := hasSum_list_prod_of_summable_norm (fun _ : Fin N => fun k : ℕ => r ^ k)
    (fun _ : Fin N => (1 - r)⁻¹) hs hn
  simpa only [List.prod_ofFn, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using h

name: Real.inv_one_sub_pow_le_three
statement:
theorem inv_one_sub_pow_le_three {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (m : ℕ)
    (hsmall : (m : ℝ) * x ≤ 2 / 3) : (1 - x)⁻¹ ^ m ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simp [hm]
  have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm
  have hxmx : x ≤ (m : ℝ) * x := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hm1) hx]
  have hbase : 1 / 3 ≤ (1 - x) ^ m := by
    have hB := one_add_mul_le_pow (a := -x) (by linarith : -2 ≤ -x) m
    simp only [mul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at hB
    linarith
  have hpos : 0 < (1 - x) ^ m := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hbase
  rw [inv_pow]
  exact ((inv_le_inv₀ hpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)).mpr hbase).trans
    (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.fourier_apply_add
statement:
theorem fourier_apply_add (k : ℤ) (x y : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    fourier k (x + y) = fourier k x * fourier k y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fourier_apply, smul_add, AddCircle.toCircle_add, Circle.coe_mul]

name: NLAlib.fourier_nat_div_period
statement:
theorem fourier_nat_div_period (k N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    fourier (k : ℤ) ((2 * Real.pi / N : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) =
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * I * (k : ℂ) / (N : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN.ne']

name: NLAlib.fourier_nat_div_period_eq_one
statement:
theorem fourier_nat_div_period_eq_one (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    fourier (N : ℤ) ((2 * Real.pi / N : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_nat_div_period N N hN]
  exact (Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I_mul_div_eq_one_iff hN.ne').mpr (dvd_refl N)

name: NLAlib.fourier_nat_div_period_ne_one
statement:
theorem fourier_nat_div_period_ne_one {k N : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hkN : k < N) :
    fourier (k : ℤ) ((2 * Real.pi / N : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hone
  rw [fourier_nat_div_period k N (hk.trans hkN)] at hone
  have hdvd := (Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I_mul_div_eq_one_iff (Nat.ne_of_gt (hk.trans hkN))).mp hone
  exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hk hdvd).not_gt hkN

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos
statement:
theorem re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (fourier (k : ℤ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).re = Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  push_cast
  have heq : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (k : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ) / (2 * Real.pi) =
      (((k : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [heq]
  rw [Complex.exp_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
    Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_im, zero_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.im_fourier_nat_coe_eq_sin
statement:
theorem im_fourier_nat_coe_eq_sin (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (fourier (k : ℤ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))).im = Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  push_cast
  have heq : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (k : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) / (2 * Real.pi) =
      (((k : ℝ) * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [heq, Complex.exp_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_re,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, mul_one, add_zero, zero_add]

name: NLAlib.fourier_apply_neg
statement:
theorem fourier_apply_neg (k : ℤ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    fourier k (-θ) = fourier (-k) θ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fourier_apply, smul_neg, neg_smul]

name: NLAlib.fourier_nat_eq_pow
statement:
theorem fourier_nat_eq_pow (k : ℕ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    fourier (k : ℤ) θ = fourier 1 θ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, fourier_zero, pow_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, fourier_add, ih, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.fourier_one_eq_circleMap
statement:
theorem fourier_one_eq_circleMap (θ : ℝ) :
    fourier 1 (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = circleMap 0 1 θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  simp only [circleMap, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul, zero_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_of_boundedVariationOn {h : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (uIcc a b)) : IntervalIntegrable h volume a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, rfl⟩ := hh.locallyBoundedVariationOn.exists_monotoneOn_sub_monotoneOn
  exact hp.intervalIntegrable.sub hq.intervalIntegrable

name: NLAlib.sum_variationOn_cells_eq
statement:
theorem sum_variationOn_cells_eq {h : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ}
    (ht : Monotone t) (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))) :
    ∑ j ∈ range N, (eVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)))).toReal =
      (eVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : ∀ j ∈ range N, eVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1))) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro j hj
    apply hh.mono
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨(ht (Nat.zero_le j)).trans hx.1,
      hx.2.trans (ht (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)))⟩
  rw [← ENNReal.toReal_sum hfinite, eVariationOn.sum' h ht]

name: NLAlib.sum_abs_sub_le_variationOn
statement:
theorem sum_abs_sub_le_variationOn {h : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ}
    (ht : Monotone t) (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))) :
    ∑ j ∈ range N, |h (t (j + 1)) - h (t j)| ≤
      (eVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have he := eVariationOn.sum_le_of_monotoneOn_Iic (f := h) (n := N)
    (s := Icc (t 0) (t N)) (ht.monotoneOn _) (fun i hi =>
      ⟨ht (Nat.zero_le i), ht hi⟩)
  have hleft : (∑ j ∈ range N, edist (h (t (j + 1))) (h (t j))) ≠ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hh he
  have hr := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hleft hh).mpr he
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => edist_ne_top (h (t (j + 1))) (h (t j)))] at hr
  simpa only [edist_dist,
    Real.dist_eq, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _)] using hr

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_sub_left_sum_le_mesh_mul_variation
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_left_sum_le_mesh_mul_variation {h g : ℝ → ℝ}
    {t : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ} {ε B : ℝ} (ht : Monotone t)
    (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N)))
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (t 0) (t N))) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (_hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hgB : ∀ x ∈ Icc (t 0) (t N), |g x| ≤ B)
    (hmesh : ∀ j < N, t (j + 1) - t j ≤ ε) :
    |(∫ x in t 0..t N, h x * g x) -
        ∑ j ∈ range N, h (t j) * ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x| ≤
      ε * B * (eVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hcellsub : ∀ j < N, Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)) ⊆ Icc (t 0) (t N) := by
    intro j hj x hx
    exact ⟨(ht (Nat.zero_le _)).trans hx.1, hx.2.trans (ht (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj))⟩
  have hcellBV : ∀ j < N, BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1))) :=
    fun j hj => hh.mono (hcellsub j hj)
  have hgi : ∀ j < N, IntervalIntegrable g volume (t j) (t (j + 1)) := by
    intro j hj
    exact (hg.mono (hcellsub j hj)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (ht (Nat.le_succ _))
  have hhi : ∀ j < N, IntervalIntegrable h volume (t j) (t (j + 1)) := by
    intro j hj
    apply intervalIntegrable_of_boundedVariationOn
    rw [uIcc_of_le (ht (Nat.le_succ _))]
    exact hcellBV j hj
  have hhgi : ∀ j < N, IntervalIntegrable (fun x => h x * g x) volume (t j) (t (j + 1)) := by
    intro j hj
    exact (hhi j hj).mul_continuousOn (by
      rw [uIcc_of_le (ht (Nat.le_succ _))]
      exact hg.mono (hcellsub j hj))
  have hcell : ∀ j < N,
      |(∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), h x * g x) -
        h (t j) * ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x| ≤
        ε * B * (eVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)))).toReal := by
    intro j hj
    have heq : (∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), h x * g x) -
        h (t j) * ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x =
        ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), (h x - h (t j)) * g x := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hhgi j hj)
        ((hgi j hj).const_mul (h (t j)))]
      congr 1
      funext x
      ring
    rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hnorm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := t j) (b := t (j + 1))
      (C := (eVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)))).toReal * B) (f := fun x => (h x - h (t j)) * g x)
      (fun x hx => by
        have hx' : x ∈ Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)) := by
          rw [uIoc_of_le (ht (Nat.le_succ _))] at hx
          exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self hx
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
        have hdist := (hcellBV j hj).dist_le hx' ⟨le_rfl, ht (Nat.le_succ _)⟩
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist
        exact mul_le_mul hdist (hgB x (hcellsub j hj hx')) (abs_nonneg _) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (ht (Nat.le_succ _)))] at hnorm
    refine hnorm.trans ?_
    have hv := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := eVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1))))
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmesh j hj) (mul_nonneg hv hB)]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals hhgi, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  calc |∑ j ∈ range N, ((∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), h x * g x) -
      h (t j) * ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x)| ≤
      ∑ j ∈ range N, |(∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), h x * g x) -
        h (t j) * ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x| := abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range N, ε * B * (eVariationOn h (Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)))).toReal :=
      sum_le_sum fun j hj => hcell j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    _ = ε * B * (eVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))).toReal := by
      rw [← mul_sum, sum_variationOn_cells_eq ht hh]

name: NLAlib.abs_sum_mul_primitive_sub_le_variation
statement:
theorem abs_sum_mul_primitive_sub_le_variation {h G : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    {N : ℕ} {M : ℝ} (ht : Monotone t)
    (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hG : ∀ x ∈ Icc (t 0) (t N), |G x| ≤ M) (hG0 : G (t 0) = 0) (hGN : G (t N) = 0) :
    |∑ j ∈ range N, h (t j) * (G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j))| ≤
      M * (eVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hAbel := Finset.sum_range_by_parts (fun j => h (t j))
    (fun j => G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j)) N
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hAbel
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun i => G (t i))] at hAbel
  simp only [hG0, hGN, sub_zero, mul_zero, zero_sub] at hAbel
  rw [hAbel, abs_neg]
  calc |∑ j ∈ range (N - 1), (h (t (j + 1)) - h (t j)) * G (t (j + 1))| ≤
      ∑ j ∈ range (N - 1), |(h (t (j + 1)) - h (t j)) * G (t (j + 1))| :=
        abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (N - 1), |h (t (j + 1)) - h (t j)| * M := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      rw [abs_mul]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
      apply hG
      exact ⟨ht (Nat.zero_le _), ht (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega)⟩
    _ = M * ∑ j ∈ range (N - 1), |h (t (j + 1)) - h (t j)| := by rw [← sum_mul]; ring
    _ ≤ M * ∑ j ∈ range N, |h (t (j + 1)) - h (t j)| := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hM
      exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono (Nat.sub_le _ _))
        (fun _ _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ M * (eVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t N))).toReal :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_abs_sub_le_variationOn ht hh) hM

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_mul_le_primitive_bound_mul_variation
statement:
theorem abs_integral_mul_le_primitive_bound_mul_variation {h g G : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a b B M : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc a b))
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b)) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hgB : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |g x| ≤ B) (hGM : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |G x| ≤ M)
    (hGa : G a = 0) (hGb : G b = 0) (hder : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt G (g x) x) :
    |∫ x in a..b, h x * g x| ≤ M * (eVariationOn h (Icc a b)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  let V := (eVariationOn h (Icc a b)).toReal
  have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, |∫ x in a..b, h x * g x| ≤
      M * V + ((b - a) / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * B * V := by
    intro n
    have hn : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => a + (b - a) * j / (n + 1 : ℕ)
    have ht : Monotone t := by
      intro i j hij
      dsimp [t]
      gcongr
    have ht0 : t 0 = a := by simp [t]
    have htN : t (n + 1) = b := by dsimp [t]; push_cast; field_simp; ring
    have hht : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (t 0) (t (n + 1))) := by rw [ht0, htN]; exact hh
    have hgt : ContinuousOn g (Icc (t 0) (t (n + 1))) := by rw [ht0, htN]; exact hg
    have hmesh : ∀ j < n + 1, t (j + 1) - t j ≤ (b - a) / (n + 1 : ℕ) := by
      intro j hj
      dsimp [t]
      push_cast
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
    have hB' : ∀ x ∈ Icc (t 0) (t (n + 1)), |g x| ≤ B := by rw [ht0, htN]; exact hgB
    have hM' : ∀ x ∈ Icc (t 0) (t (n + 1)), |G x| ≤ M := by rw [ht0, htN]; exact hGM
    have herr := abs_integral_sub_left_sum_le_mesh_mul_variation ht hht hgt hB
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (n + 1 : ℕ)) hB' hmesh
    have hsamp := abs_sum_mul_primitive_sub_le_variation ht hht hM hM'
      (by rwa [ht0]) (by rwa [htN])
    have hprimitive : ∀ j < n + 1,
        ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x = G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j) := by
      intro j hj
      have hsub : Icc (t j) (t (j + 1)) ⊆ Icc a b := by
        rw [← ht0, ← htN]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc (ht (Nat.zero_le _)) (ht (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj))
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      · intro x hx
        rw [uIcc_of_le (ht (Nat.le_succ _))] at hx
        exact hder x (hsub hx)
      · exact (hg.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (ht (Nat.le_succ _))
    have heq : (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), h (t j) * ∫ x in t j..t (j + 1), g x) =
        ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), h (t j) * (G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j)) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [hprimitive j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)]
    rw [ht0, htN] at herr
    rw [heq] at herr
    rw [ht0, htN] at hsamp
    have htri : |∫ x in a..b, h x * g x| ≤
        |(∫ x in a..b, h x * g x) -
          ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), h (t j) * (G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j))| +
        |∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), h (t j) * (G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j))| := by
      have := abs_add_le
        ((∫ x in a..b, h x * g x) - ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), h (t j) * (G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j)))
        (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), h (t j) * (G (t (j + 1)) - G (t j)))
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using this
    exact htri.trans ((add_le_add herr hsamp).trans_eq (by dsimp [V]; ring))
  have hrate : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((b - a) / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * B * V)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := ((tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (b - a)).comp
      (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).mul_const B |>.mul_const V
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, zero_mul] using h
  have hlimit : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => M * V + ((b - a) / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * B * V)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (M * V)) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add hrate
  exact ge_of_tendsto hlimit (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)

name: le_add_of_forall_sq_le_weighted_sq
statement:
theorem le_add_of_forall_sq_le_weighted_sq {a b d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → a ^ 2 ≤ (1+ε)*b^2 + (1+ε⁻¹)*d^2) :
    a ≤ b+d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hbad
  have hgap : b+d < a := lt_of_not_ge hbad
  by_cases hbzero : b=0
  · subst b
    by_cases hdzero : d=0
    · subst d
      have hh := h 1 zero_lt_one
      norm_num at hh
      nlinarith
    · have hdp : 0 < d := lt_of_le_of_ne hd (Ne.symm hdzero)
      have hu : 0 < a^2-d^2 := by nlinarith
      let ε := 2*d^2/(a^2-d^2)
      have he : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
      have hh := h ε he
      have hi : ε⁻¹*d^2 = (a^2-d^2)/2 := by
        dsimp [ε]
        field_simp [hdp.ne',hu.ne']
      nlinarith
  · have hbp : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (Ne.symm hbzero)
    by_cases hdzero : d=0
    · subst d
      have hu : 0 < a^2-b^2 := by nlinarith
      let ε := (a^2-b^2)/(2*b^2)
      have he : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
      have hh := h ε he
      have hi : ε*b^2 = (a^2-b^2)/2 := by
        dsimp [ε]
        field_simp [hbp.ne']
      nlinarith
    · have hdp : 0 < d := lt_of_le_of_ne hd (Ne.symm hdzero)
      have hh := h (d/b) (div_pos hdp hbp)
      have hi : (d/b)*b^2 = b*d := by field_simp [hbp.ne']
      have hj : (d/b)⁻¹*d^2 = b*d := by field_simp [hbp.ne',hdp.ne']
      nlinarith
