name: two_mul_sub_sq_le_binary_log
statement:
theorem two_mul_sub_sq_le_binary_log {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    2 * (q - p) ^ 2 ≤ p * log (p / q) + (1 - p) * log ((1 - p) / (1 - q))
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => p * (log p - log x) +
    (1 - p) * (log (1 - p) - log (1 - x)) - 2 * (x - p) ^ 2
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -p / x + (1 - p) / (1 - x) - 4 * (x - p)
  have hd (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc p q) : HasDerivAt F (F' x) x := by
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hp.trans_le hx.1)
    have hx1 : 1 - x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [hx.2] : 0 < 1 - x)
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_const x (log p)).sub (hasDerivAt_log hx0)).const_mul p).add
      (((hasDerivAt_const x (log (1 - p))).sub
        (((hasDerivAt_const x (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id x)).log hx1)).const_mul (1-p))
    convert h.sub ((((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const p).pow 2).const_mul 2) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (dsimp [F, F']; ring)
  have hc : ContinuousOn F (Icc p q) := fun x hx => (hd x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hm : MonotoneOn F (Icc p q) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc p q) hc
      (fun x hx => (hd x (interior_subset hx)).hasDerivWithinAt)
    intro x hx
    have hxc := interior_subset hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hp.trans_le hxc.1
    have hx1 : 0 < 1-x := by linarith [hxc.2]
    have he : F' x = (x-p) * (1 - 4*x*(1-x)) / (x*(1-x)) := by
      dsimp [F']
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [he]
    apply div_nonneg
    · apply mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxc.1)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2*x-1)]
    · positivity
  have h := hm (show p ∈ Icc p q from ⟨le_rfl, hpq⟩)
    (show q ∈ Icc p q from ⟨hpq, le_rfl⟩) hpq
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hp.trans_le hpq)
  rw [log_div hp0 hq0, log_div (by linarith : 1-p ≠ 0) (by linarith : 1-q ≠ 0)]
  dsimp [F] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.tendsto_even_sequence_of_degree_transfer
statement:
theorem tendsto_even_sequence_of_degree_transfer
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a (2*n)) {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ n, a (2*n) ≤ M)
    (htransfer : ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 →
      ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, a N ≤ a (2*m)/α+r N) :
    Tendsto (fun n => a (2*n)) atTop (𝓝 (liminf (fun n => a (2*n)) atTop))
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => a (2*n)
  let b : ℝ := liminf u atTop
  have hbelow : IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) atTop u :=
    ⟨0, eventually_map.mpr (Eventually.of_forall ha)⟩
  have habove : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) atTop u :=
    ⟨M, eventually_map.mpr (Eventually.of_forall hM)⟩
  have hco : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≥ ·) atTop u := habove.isCoboundedUnder_ge
  obtain ⟨σ, hσu, hσ⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto_liminf hco hbelow
  have hα (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) : limsup u atTop ≤ b/α := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, htr⟩ := htransfer α hα0 hα1
    have hpoint (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) : a N ≤ b/α+r N := by
      have h := hσ.eventually (htr N hN)
      exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds
        ((hσu.div_const α).add_const (r N)) h
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    apply limsup_le_of_le hbelow.isCoboundedUnder_le
    have hrε : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, r (2*n) < ε := by
      exact (hr.comp (tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n : ℕ => by dsimp; omega) tendsto_id)).eventually
        (gt_mem_nhds hε)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1, hrε] with n hn hnr
    exact (hpoint (2*n) (by omega)).trans (by linarith)
  have hsup : limsup u atTop ≤ b := by
    let α : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1-1/(n+2:ℝ)
    have hαt : Tendsto α atTop (𝓝 1) := by
      have h := (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (1:ℝ)).comp
        (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 2)
      have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (1:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1) := tendsto_const_nhds
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, α, sub_zero] using hc.sub h
    have hden : ∀ n : ℕ, (0:ℝ) < n+2 := by intro n; positivity
    have hα0 (n : ℕ) : 0 < α n := by
      dsimp [α]
      have hn : (1:ℝ) < n+2 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ) ≤ n)]
      have h := (div_lt_one (hden n)).mpr hn
      linarith
    have hα1 (n : ℕ) : α n < 1 := by
      dsimp [α]
      have := div_pos (zero_lt_one : (0:ℝ)<1) (hden n)
      linarith
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => b/α n) atTop (𝓝 b) := by
      have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => b) atTop (𝓝 b) := tendsto_const_nhds
      simpa only [div_one] using! hc.div hαt (one_ne_zero : (1:ℝ)≠0)
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds hlim
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hα (α n) (hα0 n) (hα1 n)))
  exact tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le le_rfl hsup habove hbelow

name: NLAlib.tendsto_nat_of_even_odd
statement:
theorem tendsto_nat_of_even_odd {a : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ}
    (he : Tendsto (fun n => a (2*n)) atTop (𝓝 b))
    (ho : Tendsto (fun n => a (2*n+1)) atTop (𝓝 b)) :
    Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_def]
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (he.eventually hs)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (ho.eventually hs)
  apply eventually_atTop.mpr
  refine ⟨2*max N M, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hdivN : N ≤ n/2 := by omega
  have hdivM : M ≤ n/2 := by omega
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one n with heven | hodd
  · have hneven : n=2*(n/2) := by omega
    rw [hneven]
    exact hN _ hdivN
  · have hnodd : n=2*(n/2)+1 := by omega
    rw [hnodd]
    exact hM _ hdivM

name: NLAlib.tendsto_nat_mul_of_even_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_nat_of_even_odd h
  let L : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((2*n+2:ℕ):ℝ) * (((2*(n+1):ℕ):ℝ)*e (2*(n+1)))
  let U : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((2*n:ℕ):ℝ) * (((2*n:ℕ):ℝ)*e (2*n))
  have hratioL : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((2*n+2:ℕ):ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    convert! tendsto_add_mul_div_add_mul_atTop_nhds (1:ℝ) 2 2
      (d := 2) (by norm_num) using 1
    · funext n
      push_cast
      ring
    · norm_num
  have hratioU : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((2*n:ℕ):ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    convert! tendsto_add_mul_div_add_mul_atTop_nhds (1:ℝ) 0 2
      (d := 2) (by norm_num) using 1
    · funext n
      push_cast
      ring
    · norm_num
  have hL : Tendsto L atTop (𝓝 b) := by
    simpa only [L, Function.comp_apply, one_mul] using
      hratioL.mul (h.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1))
  have hU : Tendsto U atTop (𝓝 b) := by
    simpa only [U, one_mul] using hratioU.mul h
  have hlo : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L n ≤ ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*e (2*n+1) := by
    filter_upwards [] with n
    have hden : ((2*n+2:ℕ):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have heq : L n = ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*e (2*n+2) := by
      dsimp [L]
      rw [show 2*(n+1)=2*n+2 by omega]
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (he (by omega : 2*n+1 ≤ 2*n+2)) (by positivity)
  have hhi : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*e (2*n+1) ≤ U n := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    have hden : ((2*n:ℕ):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have heq : U n = ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*e (2*n) := by
      dsimp [U]
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (he (by omega : 2*n ≤ 2*n+1)) (by positivity)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hL hU hlo hhi

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_of_upper_triangular_basis
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_of_upper_triangular_basis
    {𝕜 E n ι : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    [LocallyFiniteOrderBot n] [WellFoundedLT n]
    (b : Basis n 𝕜 E) (f : ι → Module.End 𝕜 E)
    (htri : ∀ a, ((f a).toMatrix b b).IsUpperTriangular) :
    ∃ q : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 E, ∀ a, ((f a).toMatrix q.toBasis q.toBasis).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  let q := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b) b
  let R := q.toBasis.toMatrix b
  let := Basis.invertibleToMatrix q.toBasis b
  have hR : R.IsUpperTriangular :=
    InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis_inv_isUpperTriangular _ _
  have hRinv : R⁻¹.IsUpperTriangular := Matrix.blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular hR
  have hback : b.toMatrix q.toBasis = R⁻¹ :=
    (Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv (Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip b q.toBasis)).symm
  refine ⟨q, fun a => ?_⟩
  have hchange := basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
    q.toBasis b q.toBasis b (f a)
  rw [hback] at hchange
  rw [← hchange]
  exact (hR.mul (htri a)).mul hRinv

name: NLAlib.tsum_even_geometric_tail_le
statement:
theorem tsum_even_geometric_tail_le {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, if n < k ∧ Even k then q ^ k else 0) ≤ q ^ (n + 1) / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let m := 2 * (n / 2 + 1)
  let f := fun k : ℕ => if n < k ∧ Even k then q ^ k else 0
  have hm : n < m := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j + m) := by intro i j h; dsimp only at h; omega
  have hsup : Function.support f ⊆ Set.range (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j + m) := by
    intro k hk
    have hcond : n < k ∧ Even k := by
      by_contra h
      change f k ≠ 0 at hk
      simp [f, h] at hk
    have hke := Nat.even_iff.mp hcond.2
    refine ⟨k / 2 - (n / 2 + 1), ?_⟩
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  have heq := hinj.tsum_eq hsup
  have hgeom : (∑' j : ℕ, f (2 * j + m)) = q ^ m / (1 - q ^ 2) := by
    have hfun : (fun j : ℕ => f (2 * j + m)) = fun j => q ^ m * (q ^ 2) ^ j := by
      funext j
      have heven : Even (2 * j + m) := by dsimp [m]; rw [Nat.even_iff]; omega
      dsimp [f]
      rw [if_pos ⟨by omega, heven⟩, pow_add, pow_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [hfun, tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (sq_nonneg q) (by nlinarith)]
    rfl
  rw [← heq, hgeom]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by nlinarith : 0 ≤ 1 - q ^ 2)
  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0.le hq1.le (by omega)

name: NLAlib.tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_geometric
statement:
theorem tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_geometric {c : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hs : Summable (fun k => |c k|)) {q M : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hc : ∀ k, 0 < k → |c k| ≤ 2 * M * q ^ k) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑' k, if n < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0) ≤
      2 * M * q ^ (n + 1) / (1 - q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Summable (fun k => if n < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0) :=
    hs.of_nonneg_of_le (by intro k; split_ifs <;> positivity) (by intro k; split_ifs <;> simp)
  have hgeom : Summable (fun k : ℕ => if n < k ∧ Even k then 2 * M * q ^ k else 0) :=
    ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0.le hq1).mul_left (2 * M)).of_nonneg_of_le
      (by intro k; split_ifs <;> positivity) (by intro k; split_ifs; rfl; positivity)
  calc _ ≤ ∑' k, if n < k ∧ Even k then 2 * M * q ^ k else 0 :=
      ht.tsum_le_tsum (by intro k; split_ifs with h; exact hc k (by omega); rfl) hgeom
    _ = 2 * M * (∑' k : ℕ, if n < k ∧ Even k then q ^ k else 0) := by
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro k
      split_ifs <;> simp
    _ ≤ 2 * M * (q ^ (n + 1) / (1 - q ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tsum_even_geometric_tail_le hq0 hq1 n) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Real.one_le_div_and_sum_inv_div_eq_one
statement:
theorem one_le_div_and_sum_inv_div_eq_one
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (s : ι → ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : ∑ j, s j = L) (hLpos : 0 < L) (hs : ∀ j, 0 < s j) :
    (∀ j, 1 ≤ L / s j) ∧ ∑ j, 1 / (L / s j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro j
    apply (one_le_div (hs j)).mpr
    rw [← hL]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => (hs i).le) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  · simp_rw [one_div_div]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, hL, div_self hLpos.ne']

name: ENNReal.one_le_ofReal_div_and_sum_inv_toReal_eq_one
statement:
theorem one_le_ofReal_div_and_sum_inv_toReal_eq_one
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (s : ι → ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : ∑ j, s j = L) (hLpos : 0 < L) (hs : ∀ j, 0 < s j) :
    (∀ j, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L / s j)) ∧
      ∑ j, ((ENNReal.ofReal (L / s j))⁻¹).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hsum⟩ := Real.one_le_div_and_sum_inv_div_eq_one s hL hLpos hs
  have hp0 (j : ι) : 0 ≤ L / s j := le_trans zero_le_one (hp j)
  constructor
  · intro j
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_one] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hp j)
  · simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp0 _), one_div] using hsum

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_pencil_image_line
statement:
theorem exists_unit_pencil_image_line {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [Nontrivial E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] [Nontrivial F]
    (A B : E →ₗ[ℂ] F) (hdim : finrank ℂ E = finrank ℂ F) :
    ∃ u : E, ∃ v : F, ∃ a b : ℂ,
      ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ A u = a • v ∧ B u = b • v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, a, b, hx, hy, hAx, hBx⟩ := exists_nonzero_pencil_image_line A B hdim
  have hxn : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
  have hyn : 0 < ‖y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hy
  let u := (‖x‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ • x
  let v := (‖y‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ • y
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [u, norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg hxn.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxn.ne']
  have hv : ‖v‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [v, norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg hyn.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hyn.ne']
  refine ⟨u, v, (‖x‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ * a * ‖y‖, (‖x‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ * b * ‖y‖, hu, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [u, v, map_smul, hAx, smul_smul, mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hyn.ne'), mul_one]
  · simp only [u, v, map_smul, hBx, smul_smul, mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hyn.ne'), mul_one]

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBases_pencil_upper_triangular
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBases_pencil_upper_triangular {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [FiniteDimensional ℂ F]
    (k : ℕ) (A B : E →ₗ[ℂ] F) (hE : finrank ℂ E = k) (hF : finrank ℂ F = k) :
    ∃ e : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℂ E, ∃ f : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℂ F,
      (∀ i j, j < i → inner ℂ (f i) (A (e j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, j < i → inner ℂ (f i) (B (e j)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing E F with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨(stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ E).reindex (finCongr hE),
      (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ F).reindex (finCongr hF),
      fun i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    have : Nontrivial E := Module.finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hE]; omega)
    have : Nontrivial F := Module.finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hF]; omega)
    obtain ⟨u, v, a, b, hu, hv, hAu, hBu⟩ := exists_unit_pencil_image_line A B (hE.trans hF.symm)
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hu; exact zero_ne_one hu
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hv; exact zero_ne_one hv
    let E' : Submodule ℂ E := (ℂ ∙ u)ᗮ
    let F' : Submodule ℂ F := (ℂ ∙ v)ᗮ
    have hE' : finrank ℂ E' = k := by
      have hh := (ℂ ∙ u).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
      rw [finrank_span_singleton hu0, hE] at hh
      dsimp [E']; omega
    have hF' : finrank ℂ F' = k := by
      have hh := (ℂ ∙ v).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
      rw [finrank_span_singleton hv0, hF] at hh
      dsimp [F']; omega
    let comp (L : E →ₗ[ℂ] F) : E' →ₗ[ℂ] F' :=
      F'.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (L.comp E'.subtype)
    obtain ⟨e', f', hA', hB'⟩ := ih (comp A) (comp B) hE' hF'
    obtain ⟨e, he0, heS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hE u hu e'
    obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hF v hv f'
    have hCoeff (L : E →ₗ[ℂ] F) (c : ℂ) (hLu : L u = c • v)
        (hL' : ∀ i j, j < i → inner ℂ (f' i) (comp L (e' j)) = 0) :
        ∀ i j, j < i → inner ℂ (f i) (L (e j)) = 0 := by
      intro i j hij
      revert hij
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · intro hi
        rw [he0, hLu, inner_smul_right]
        have hfv : inner ℂ (f i) v = 0 := by
          rw [← hf0]
          exact f.orthonormal.inner_eq_zero (ne_of_gt hi)
        rw [hfv, mul_zero]
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
        · intro hi
          exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _)) hi |>.elim
        · intro hi
          rw [hfS, heS]
          have hh := hL' i j (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hi)
          simpa only [comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
            Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left] using hh
    exact ⟨e, f, hCoeff A a hAu hA', hCoeff B b hBu hB'⟩

name: NLAlib.polarNewtonScalar_pos
statement:
theorem polarNewtonScalar_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < polarNewtonScalar s k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact hs
  | succ k ih => dsimp only [polarNewtonScalar]; positivity

name: NLAlib.abs_cayley_lt_one
statement: theorem abs_cayley_lt_one {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : |(s - 1) / (s + 1)| < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < s + 1), div_lt_one (by linarith)]
  exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.cayley_polarNewton_step
statement:
theorem cayley_polarNewton_step {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (((s + s⁻¹) / 2) - 1) / (((s + s⁻¹) / 2) + 1) = ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
  have hp : s + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hd : (s + s⁻¹) / 2 + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.cayley_polarNewtonScalar
statement:
theorem cayley_polarNewtonScalar {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (k : ℕ) :
    (polarNewtonScalar s k - 1) / (polarNewtonScalar s k + 1) =
      ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [polarNewtonScalar]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [polarNewtonScalar, cayley_polarNewton_step (polarNewtonScalar_pos hs k), ih,
      ← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.polarNewtonScalar_eq
statement:
theorem polarNewtonScalar_eq {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (k : ℕ) :
    polarNewtonScalar s k =
      (1 + ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)) /
        (1 - ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cayley_polarNewtonScalar hs k]
  have hp := polarNewtonScalar_pos hs k
  have hd : polarNewtonScalar s k + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hn : 1 - (polarNewtonScalar s k - 1) / (polarNewtonScalar s k + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, sub_eq_zero, eq_div_iff hd]
    intro h
    linarith
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_polarNewtonScalar
statement:
theorem tendsto_polarNewtonScalar {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Tendsto (polarNewtonScalar s) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ‖(s - 1) / (s + 1)‖ < 1 := abs_cayley_lt_one hs
  have ht := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one hc).comp
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2))
  have hlim := (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).add ht).div
    ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub ht)
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) - 0 ≠ 0))
  have he : (fun k => (1 + ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)) /
      (1 - ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k))) = polarNewtonScalar s := by
    funext k
    exact (polarNewtonScalar_eq hs k).symm
  have hlim' : Tendsto (fun k => (1 + ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)) /
      (1 - ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k))) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    convert hlim using 1
    · funext k; rfl
    · norm_num
  rwa [he] at hlim'

name: NLAlib.abs_polarNewtonScalar_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem abs_polarNewtonScalar_sub_one_le {s r : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hcr : |(s - 1) / (s + 1)| ≤ r) (k : ℕ) :
    |polarNewtonScalar s k - 1| ≤ 2 * r ^ (2 ^ k) / (1 - r ^ (2 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  let c := ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ (2 ^ k)
  have hrp : r ^ (2 ^ k) < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hr hr1 (by positivity)
  have hcp : |c| ≤ r ^ (2 ^ k) := by
    simpa only [c, abs_pow] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hcr (2 ^ k)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - c := by have := le_abs_self c; linarith
  have he : polarNewtonScalar s k - 1 = 2 * c / (1 - c) := by
    rw [polarNewtonScalar_eq hs]
    change (1 + c) / (1 - c) - 1 = _
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), abs_of_pos hden]
  apply div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg hr _))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcp (by norm_num)) (by linarith)
  have := le_abs_self c
  linarith

name: NLAlib.variationOn_comp_cos_le
statement:
theorem variationOn_comp_cos_le (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    eVariationOn (h ∘ cos) (Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ≤ eVariationOn h (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:=
  eVariationOn.comp_le_of_antitoneOn h cos strictAntiOn_cos.antitoneOn
    (fun x _ => ⟨neg_one_le_cos x, cos_le_one x⟩)

name: NLAlib.boundedVariationOn_comp_cos
proof:
:=
  ((variationOn_comp_cos_le h).trans_lt hh.lt_top).ne

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_mul_cos_le_variation_div
statement:
theorem abs_integral_mul_cos_le_variation_div {h : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hh : BoundedVariationOn h (Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    |∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, h θ * cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)| ≤
      (eVariationOn h (Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)).toReal / k
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : 0 < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hder : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t => sin ((k : ℝ) * t) / k)
      (cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)) θ := by
    intro θ
    simpa [Function.comp_def, hkpos.ne'] using
      ((hasDerivAt_sin ((k : ℝ) * θ)).comp θ
        ((hasDerivAt_id θ).const_mul (k : ℝ))).div_const (k : ℝ)
  have hbound := abs_integral_mul_le_primitive_bound_mul_variation
    (G := fun θ => sin ((k : ℝ) * θ) / k) (B := 1) (M := 1 / (k : ℝ))
    Real.pi_pos hh (by fun_prop) zero_le_one (by positivity)
    (fun θ _ => abs_cos_le_one _)
    (fun θ _ => by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hkpos]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (abs_sin_le_one _) hkpos.le)
    (by simp) (by rw [sin_nat_mul_pi]; simp) (fun θ _ => hder θ)
  simpa only [one_div, mul_one, mul_comm, div_eq_mul_inv] using hbound

name: Real.integral_cos_int_mul_zero_pi
statement:
theorem integral_cos_int_mul_zero_pi {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, cos ((k : ℝ) * x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ (by exact_mod_cast hk), integral_cos]
  simp [sin_int_mul_pi]

name: Real.integral_sin_nat_mul_mul_sin_nat_mul
statement:
theorem integral_sin_nat_mul_mul_sin_nat_mul {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, sin ((j : ℝ) * x) * sin ((k : ℝ) * x)) =
      if j = k then π / 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have htrig (x : ℝ) : sin ((j : ℝ) * x) * sin ((k : ℝ) * x) =
      (cos (((j : ℝ) - k) * x) - cos (((j : ℝ) + k) * x)) / 2 := by
    rw [sub_mul, add_mul, cos_sub, cos_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [htrig]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _)
    (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _)]
  have hsum : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, cos (((j : ℝ) + k) * x)) = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast integral_cos_int_mul_zero_pi (k := (j : ℤ) + k) (by omega)
  rw [hsum]
  by_cases heq : j = k
  · simp [heq]
  · have hdiff : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, cos (((j : ℝ) - k) * x)) = 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast integral_cos_int_mul_zero_pi (k := (j : ℤ) - k) (by omega)
    simp [heq, hdiff]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_le_two_div_pi_integral_sq_of_sine_coefficients
statement:
theorem sum_sq_le_two_div_pi_integral_sq_of_sine_coefficients
    {v : ℝ → ℝ} (hv : IntervalIntegrable v volume 0 π)
    (hv2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => v x ^ 2) volume 0 π)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 < j) (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ j ∈ s, (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, v x * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) = π / 2 * c j) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2) ≤ 2 / π * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, v x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j ∈ s, c j * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)
  have hq : Continuous q := by dsimp [q]; fun_prop
  have hqs (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ s) :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, q x * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) = π / 2 * c j := by
    simp only [q, sum_mul]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun k _ =>
      Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _)]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have heq : ∀ k ∈ s, (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π,
        sin ((k : ℝ) * x) * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) = if k = j then π / 2 else 0 :=
      fun k hk => integral_sin_nat_mul_mul_sin_nat_mul (hs k hk) (hs j hj)
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => congrArg (fun a => c k * a) (heq k hk))]
    simp [hj, mul_ite, mul_comm]
  have hqq : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, q x ^ 2) = π / 2 * ∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2 := by
    have heq (x : ℝ) : q x ^ 2 = ∑ j ∈ s, c j * (q x * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) := by
      calc
        q x ^ 2 = q x * (∑ j ∈ s, c j * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) := by
          change q x ^ 2 = q x * q x
          ring
        _ = ∑ j ∈ s, q x * (c j * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) := mul_sum ..
        _ = _ := sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
    simp_rw [heq]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j _ =>
      Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _)]
    simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hqs j hj]
    ring
  have hvq : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => v x * q x) volume 0 π :=
    hv.mul_continuousOn hq.continuousOn
  have hvqeq : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, v x * q x) = π / 2 * ∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2 := by
    have heq (x : ℝ) : v x * q x = ∑ j ∈ s, c j * (v x * sin ((j : ℝ) * x)) := by
      dsimp [q]
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    simp_rw [heq]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j _ =>
      (hv.mul_continuousOn (by fun_prop)).const_mul (c j))]
    simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hc j hj]
    ring
  have hnonneg := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall (μ := volume)
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := π) pi_pos.le (fun x => sq_nonneg (v x - q x))
  have heq (x : ℝ) : (v x - q x) ^ 2 = v x ^ 2 - 2 * (v x * q x) + q x ^ 2 := by ring
  simp_rw [heq] at hnonneg
  have hq2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => q x ^ 2) volume 0 π :=
    (show Continuous (fun x => q x ^ 2) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hv2.sub (hvq.const_mul 2))
       hq2,
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub hv2 (hvq.const_mul 2),
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hvqeq, hqq] at hnonneg
  have hb : (∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2) * π ≤
      2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, v x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  exact ((le_div_iff₀ pi_pos).mpr hb).trans_eq (by ring)

name: NLAlib.inv_cast_descFactorial_eq_sub
statement:
theorem inv_cast_descFactorial_eq_sub {ν k : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hk : ν < k) :
    (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      (((k - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ - (k.descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹) / ν
proof:
:= by
  have hν0 : (ν : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hν
  have hA : ((k - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hB : (k.descFactorial ν : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hC : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hleft : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) = k * ((k - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    have h := Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ (k - 1) ν
    rw [show k - 1 + 1 = k by omega] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hright : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) - ν) * (k.descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
  field_simp [hA, hB, hC, hν0]
  linear_combination -(k.descFactorial ν : ℝ) * hleft + ((k - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) * hright

name: NLAlib.sum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail
statement:
theorem sum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail {ν n : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν ≤ n) (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range m, ((n + 1 + j).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      (((n.descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ - ((n + m).descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹) / ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) : ((n + 1 + j).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      (((n + j).descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ - ((n + (j + 1)).descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹) / ν := by
    rw [inv_cast_descFactorial_eq_sub hν (by omega), show n + 1 + j - 1 = n + j by omega,
      show n + 1 + j = n + (j + 1) by omega]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← sum_div, sum_range_sub']
  simp

name: NLAlib.summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail
statement:
theorem summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail {ν n : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν ≤ n) :
    Summable (fun j => ((n + 1 + j).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply summable_of_sum_range_le (c := (n.descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ / ν)
    (fun j => by positivity)
  intro m
  rw [sum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν hn]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sub_le_self _ (by positivity)) (Nat.cast_nonneg ν)

name: NLAlib.tsum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le
statement:
theorem tsum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le {ν n : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : ν ≤ n) :
    (∑' j, ((n + 1 + j).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ (n.descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ / ν
proof:
:= by
  apply (summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν hn).tsum_le_of_sum_range_le
  intro m
  rw [sum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν hn]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sub_le_self _ (by positivity)) (Nat.cast_nonneg ν)

name: NLAlib.two_mul_inv_cast_descFactorial_le_adjacent
statement:
theorem two_mul_inv_cast_descFactorial_le_adjacent {ν k : ℕ} (hk : ν + 1 < k) :
    2 * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ + ((k + 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hA0 : ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hB0 : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hC0 : ((k + 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have hkR : (ν : ℝ) + 1 < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkν : (0 : ℝ) < k - ν - 1 := by linarith
  have hknu : (0 : ℝ) < k - ν := by linarith
  have hkp : (0 : ℝ) < k + 1 := by positivity
  have hA : ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) =
      ((k : ℝ) - ν - 1) * ((k - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega),
      Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  have hB : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) = k * ((k - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    have h := Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ (k - 1) ν
    rw [show k - 1 + 1 = k by omega] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hC : ((k + 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * (k.descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ k ν
  have hB' : (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) - ν) * (k.descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
  have hleft : (k : ℝ) * ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) =
      ((k : ℝ) - ν - 1) * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := by rw [hA, hB]; ring
  have hright : ((k : ℝ) - ν) * ((k + 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ) := by rw [hC, hB']; ring
  have hAinv : ((k - 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      (k : ℝ) / (k - ν - 1) * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp [hA0, hB0, ne_of_gt hkν]
    linear_combination -hleft
  have hCinv : ((k + 1).descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      ((k : ℝ) - ν) / (k + 1) * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp [hC0, hB0, ne_of_gt hkp]
    linear_combination -hright
  have hrat : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) / (k - ν - 1) + ((k : ℝ) - ν) / (k + 1) := by
    have hid : (k : ℝ) / (k - ν - 1) + ((k : ℝ) - ν) / (k + 1) - 2 =
        ((ν : ℝ) + 1) * (ν + 2) / ((k - ν - 1) * (k + 1)) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hkν, ne_of_gt hkp]
      ring
    have hnon : 0 ≤ ((ν : ℝ) + 1) * (ν + 2) / ((k - ν - 1) * (k + 1)) := by positivity
    rw [← hid] at hnon
    linarith
  rw [hAinv, hCinv, ← add_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrat (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.tsum_even_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le
statement:
theorem tsum_even_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le {ν s : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hs : ν < s) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, if s < k ∧ Even k then (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) ≤
      1 / (2 * (ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  let m := 2 * (s / 2 + 1)
  let r := m - 1
  let g := fun k : ℕ => (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hm : s < m := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have hr : s ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; omega
  have hss : Summable (fun j => g (r + j)) := by
    have h := summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν (show ν ≤ r - 1 by omega)
    simpa only [show r - 1 + 1 = r by omega] using h
  have hA : Summable (fun j => g (r + (2 * j + 1))) := by
    convert hss.comp_injective (show Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j + 1) by intro a b h; dsimp only at h; omega) using 1 <;> rfl
  have hB : Summable (fun j => g (r + 2 * j)) := by
    convert hss.comp_injective (show Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j) by intro a b h; dsimp only at h; omega) using 1 <;> rfl
  have hBs : Summable (fun j => g (r + 2 * (j + 1))) := by
    convert hB.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective using 1 <;> rfl
  have hmid (j : ℕ) : 2 * g (r + (2 * j + 1)) ≤ g (r + 2 * j) + g (r + 2 * (j + 1)) := by
    have h := two_mul_inv_cast_descFactorial_le_adjacent (show ν + 1 < r + (2 * j + 1) by omega)
    simpa only [show r + (2 * j + 1) - 1 = r + 2 * j by omega,
      show r + (2 * j + 1) + 1 = r + 2 * (j + 1) by omega] using h
  have hab : (∑' j, g (r + (2 * j + 1))) ≤ ∑' j, g (r + 2 * j) := by
    have h := (hA.mul_left 2).tsum_le_tsum hmid (hB.add hBs)
    rw [tsum_mul_left, hB.tsum_add hBs] at h
    have hz := hB.tsum_eq_zero_add
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g r := by dsimp [g]; positivity
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at hz
    linarith
  have htotal : (∑' j, g (r + j)) =
      (∑' j, g (r + 2 * j)) + ∑' j, g (r + (2 * j + 1)) := by
    have he := (Nat.divModEquiv 2).symm.tsum_eq (fun j => g (r + j))
    have hp : Summable (fun p : ℕ × Fin 2 => g (r + (Nat.divModEquiv 2).symm p)) := by
      convert hss.comp_injective (Nat.divModEquiv 2).symm.injective using 1 <;> rfl
    rw [← he, hp.tsum_prod]
    simp only [Nat.divModEquiv_symm_apply, tsum_fintype, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one,
      add_zero, Nat.mul_comm _ 2]
    exact hB.tsum_add hA
  let f := fun k : ℕ => if s < k ∧ Even k then g k else 0
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j + m) := by intro i j h; dsimp only at h; omega
  have hsup : Function.support f ⊆ Set.range (fun j : ℕ => 2 * j + m) := by
    intro k hk
    have hcond : s < k ∧ Even k := by
      by_contra h
      change f k ≠ 0 at hk
      simp [f, h] at hk
    have hke := Nat.even_iff.mp hcond.2
    refine ⟨k / 2 - (s / 2 + 1), ?_⟩
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  have heven : (∑' k, f k) = ∑' j, g (r + (2 * j + 1)) := by
    rw [← hinj.tsum_eq hsup]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    have hjEven : Even (2 * j + m) := by dsimp [m]; rw [Nat.even_iff]; omega
    rw [show f (2 * j + m) = g (2 * j + m) by dsimp [f]; rw [if_pos ⟨by omega, hjEven⟩]]
    congr 1
    dsimp [r]
    omega
  have hfull : (∑' j, g (r + j)) ≤ ( (r - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ / ν := by
    simpa only [show r - 1 + 1 = r by omega] using
      tsum_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le hν (show ν ≤ r - 1 by omega)
  have hden : ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν ≤ ((r - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by
    have h := Nat.pow_sub_le_descFactorial (r - 1) ν
    rw [show r - 1 + 1 = r by omega] at h
    have hle : (s - ν) ^ ν ≤ (r - ν) ^ ν := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hr ν) ν
    have hR : (((s - ν) ^ ν : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((r - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle.trans h
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_sub hs.le] using hR
  have hpower : 0 < ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν := by
    have hsr : (ν : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
    positivity
  have hshort : ((r - 1).descFactorial ν : ℝ)⁻¹ / ν ≤ 1 / ((ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν) := by
    have hνR : (0 : ℝ) < ν := by exact_mod_cast hν
    have h := inv_anti₀ hpower hden
    have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h hνR.le
    simpa only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_one] using hd
  change (∑' k, f k) ≤ _
  rw [heven]
  have h := hfull.trans hshort
  rw [htotal] at h
  have hhalf : 2 * (∑' j, g (r + (2 * j + 1))) ≤ 1 / ((ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν) := by linarith
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < (ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν := by
    have hνR : (0 : ℝ) < ν := by exact_mod_cast hν
    positivity
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)).mpr
  have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp hhalf
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.summable_inv_cast_descFactorial
statement:
theorem summable_inv_cast_descFactorial {ν : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← summable_nat_add_iff (ν + 1)]
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using
    summable_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail hν (le_refl ν)

name: NLAlib.tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_descFactorial
statement:
theorem tsum_even_abs_tail_le_of_descFactorial {c : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hcS : Summable (fun k => |c k|)) {ν s : ℕ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hs : ν < s)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hc : ∀ k, ν + 1 ≤ k → |c k| ≤ A * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, if s < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0) ≤
      A / (2 * (ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Summable (fun k => if s < k ∧ Even k then |c k| else 0) :=
    hcS.of_nonneg_of_le (by intro k; split_ifs <;> positivity) (by intro k; split_ifs <;> simp)
  have hg : Summable (fun k => if s < k ∧ Even k then (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) :=
    (summable_inv_cast_descFactorial hν).of_nonneg_of_le
      (by intro k; split_ifs <;> positivity) (by intro k; split_ifs; rfl; positivity)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' k, A * (if s < k ∧ Even k then (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) := by
      apply ht.tsum_le_tsum _ (hg.mul_left A)
      intro k
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hc k (by omega)
      · simp
    _ = A * (∑' k, if s < k ∧ Even k then (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) := by rw [tsum_mul_left]
    _ ≤ A * (1 / (2 * (ν : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) - ν) ^ ν)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tsum_even_inv_cast_descFactorial_tail_le hν hs) hA
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem norm_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_sqrt
    (u : ℝ → F) (v : ℝ → F) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc 0 1))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt u (v t) t)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖v t‖ ≤ (3/2) * Real.sqrt t * C) :
    ‖u 1-u 0‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => (3/2) * Real.sqrt t * C) volume 0 1 :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (3/2) * Real.sqrt t * C)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have h := norm_sub_le_integral_of_norm_deriv_le_of_le
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) hu
    (fun t ht => (hd t ht).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (ae_of_all _ fun t ht => by rw [(hd t ht).deriv]; exact hbound t ht) hi
  have he : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (3/2) * Real.sqrt t * C) = C := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    simp_rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [integral_rpow (Or.inl (show (-1 : ℝ) < 1/2 by norm_num))]
    norm_num
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.polynomial_laguerre_mul
statement:
theorem polynomial_laguerre_mul (p q : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    (p * q).derivative.eval x ^ 2 - (p * q).eval x * (p * q).derivative.derivative.eval x =
      q.eval x ^ 2 * (p.derivative.eval x ^ 2 - p.eval x * p.derivative.derivative.eval x) +
      p.eval x ^ 2 * (q.derivative.eval x ^ 2 - q.eval x * q.derivative.derivative.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [derivative_mul, derivative_add, eval_add, eval_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.laguerre_prod_nonneg
statement:
private theorem laguerre_prod_nonneg (m : Multiset ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    let p : ℝ[X]
proof:
:= (m.map (X - C ·)).prod
    0 ≤ p.derivative.eval x ^ 2 - p.eval x * p.derivative.derivative.eval x := by
  induction m using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons r m ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
    rw [polynomial_laguerre_mul]
    simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C, sub_zero, derivative_one,
      eval_one, one_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_one]
    exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) ih)

name: NLAlib.laguerre_prod_pos
proof:
:= (m.map (X - C ·)).prod
    0 < p.derivative.eval x ^ 2 - p.eval x * p.derivative.derivative.eval x := by
  obtain hzero | ⟨r, hr⟩ := m.empty_or_exists_mem
  · exact (hm hzero).elim
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hr
  have hq : ((m.map (X - C ·)).prod : ℝ[X]).eval x ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, eval_mul] at hx
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hx).2
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
  rw [polynomial_laguerre_mul]
  simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C, sub_zero, derivative_one,
    eval_one, one_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_one]
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hq)
    (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (laguerre_prod_nonneg m x))

name: NLAlib.polynomial_laguerre_pos_of_splits
statement:
theorem polynomial_laguerre_pos_of_splits {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Splits)
    (hpc : p.derivative ≠ 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : p.eval x ≠ 0) :
    0 < p.derivative.eval x ^ 2 - p.eval x * p.derivative.derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := splits_iff_exists_multiset.mp hp
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro hm0
    rw [hm0, Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.prod_zero, mul_one] at hm
    apply hpc
    rw [hm, derivative_C]
  have hlc : p.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hx (by rw [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp h, eval_zero])
  have hprod : ((m.map (X - C ·)).prod : ℝ[X]).eval x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hm, eval_mul, eval_C] at hx
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hx).2
  have hpos := laguerre_prod_pos m hm0 x hprod
  conv_rhs => rw [hm]
  rw [polynomial_laguerre_mul]
  simp only [derivative_C, derivative_zero, eval_zero, eval_C, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
    mul_zero, sub_self, zero_add]
  exact mul_pos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hlc) hpos

name: NLAlib.polynomial_second_derivative_neg_of_splits
statement:
theorem polynomial_second_derivative_neg_of_splits {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Splits)
    (hpc : p.derivative ≠ 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < p.eval x) (hcrit : p.derivative.eval x = 0) :
    p.derivative.derivative.eval x < 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := polynomial_laguerre_pos_of_splits hp hpc hx.ne'
  rw [hcrit] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.strictAntiOn_polynomial_logDeriv_of_splits
statement:
theorem strictAntiOn_polynomial_logDeriv_of_splits {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Splits)
    (hpc : p.derivative ≠ 0) {a b : ℝ} (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 < p.eval x) :
    StrictAntiOn (fun x => p.derivative.eval x / p.eval x) (Ioo a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictAntiOn_of_deriv_neg (convex_Ioo a b)
    (p.derivative.continuousOn.div p.continuousOn (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).ne'))
  intro x hx
  rw [interior_Ioo] at hx
  have hd := p.derivative.hasDerivAt x |>.div (p.hasDerivAt x) (hpos x hx).ne'
  rw [hd.deriv]
  apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
  · have h := polynomial_laguerre_pos_of_splits hp hpc (hpos x hx).ne'
    nlinarith
  · exact sq_pos_of_ne_zero (hpos x hx).ne'

name: NLAlib.eq_of_polynomial_critical_of_splits
statement:
theorem eq_of_polynomial_critical_of_splits {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Splits)
    (hpc : p.derivative ≠ 0) {a b : ℝ} (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 < p.eval x)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo a b) (hy : y ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hxc : p.derivative.eval x = 0) (hyc : p.derivative.eval y = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply (strictAntiOn_polynomial_logDeriv_of_splits hp hpc hpos).injOn hx hy
  simp only [hxc, hyc, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.polynomial_splits_of_natDegree_le_card_add_one
statement:
theorem polynomial_splits_of_natDegree_le_card_add_one {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : ∀ r ∈ s, p.eval r = 0) (hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ s.card + 1) : p.Splits
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ[X] := ∏ r ∈ s, (X - C r)
  have hqdeg : q.natDegree = s.card := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [natDegree_prod_of_monic s (fun r : ℝ => X - C r) (fun r _ => monic_X_sub_C r)]
    simp
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact (monic_prod_of_monic s (fun r : ℝ => X - C r) (fun r _ => monic_X_sub_C r)).ne_zero
  have hqdvd : q ∣ p := by
    apply Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime
    · intro a _ b _ hab
      exact pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C Function.injective_id hab
    · intro r hr
      exact dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (hs r hr)
  obtain ⟨r, hpr⟩ := hqdvd
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hpr; exact hp hpr
  have hrdeg : r.natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hpr, natDegree_mul hq0 hr0, hqdeg] at hdeg
    omega
  rw [hpr]
  exact (Splits.prod (fun r _ => Splits.X_sub_C r)).mul
    (Splits.of_degree_le_one (natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mp hrdeg))

name: Antitone.mul_sum_tail_le_mul_sum_block
statement:
theorem mul_sum_tail_le_mul_sum_block {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Antitone a)
    {k l : ℕ} (hkl : k ≤ l) :
    (l : ℝ) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, a (l + j)) ≤
      (k : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, a (k + i))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ((l - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, a (l + j)) ≤
      (k : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l - k), a (k + i)) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l - k), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, a (l + j) := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l - k), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, a (k + i) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        apply ha
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        omega
      _ = _ := by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
  have hs : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, a (k + i)) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l - k), a (k + i)) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, a (l + j) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show l = (l - k) + k by omega]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hs]
  have hc : ((l - k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (l : ℝ) - k := Nat.cast_sub hkl
  rw [hc] at hp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.dirichletCircleKernel_coe
statement:
theorem dirichletCircleKernel_coe (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    dirichletCircleKernel n (θ : AddCircle (2 * π)) =
      1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ range n, cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dirichletCircleKernel, re_fourier_nat_coe_eq_cos]

name: NLAlib.sin_half_mul_dirichletCircleKernel_coe
statement:
theorem sin_half_mul_dirichletCircleKernel_coe (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    sin (θ / 2) * dirichletCircleKernel n (θ : AddCircle (2 * π)) =
      sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dirichletCircleKernel_coe, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ,
      sin (θ / 2) * (2 * cos ((k + 1 : ℕ) * θ)) =
        sin (((k + 1 : ℕ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * θ) -
          sin (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * θ) := by
    intro k
    have hp : (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * θ =
        ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ + θ / 2 := by ring
    have hm : ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * θ =
        ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ - θ / 2 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hp, hm, sin_add, sin_sub]
    ring
  simp_rw [mul_assoc, hterm]
  rw [sum_range_sub (fun k : ℕ => sin (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * θ))]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_one]
  rw [show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * θ = θ / 2 by ring]
  ring

name: NLAlib.dirichletCircleKernel_coe_eq_sin_div
statement:
theorem dirichletCircleKernel_coe_eq_sin_div (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : sin (θ / 2) ≠ 0) :
    dirichletCircleKernel n (θ : AddCircle (2 * π)) =
      sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * θ) / sin (θ / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_div_iff hθ).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact sin_half_mul_dirichletCircleKernel_coe n θ

name: NLAlib.dirichletCircleKernel_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem dirichletCircleKernel_zero (n : ℕ) :
    dirichletCircleKernel n 0 = 2 * (n : ℝ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := dirichletCircleKernel_coe n 0
  simpa only [AddCircle.coe_zero, mul_zero, cos_zero, sum_const, card_range,
    nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.one_div_sin_half_le
statement:
theorem one_div_sin_half_le (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htπ : t ≤ π) :
    1 / sin (t / 2) ≤ 2 / t + t / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 < t / 2 := by positivity
  have hu2 : t / 2 < 2 := by linarith [Real.pi_lt_four]
  have hs : 0 < sin (t / 2) := sin_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨hu, by linarith [pi_pos]⟩
  have hlo := sin_ge_sub_cube hu.le
  have hfac : 0 ≤ 1 / (t / 2) + (t / 2) / 2 := by positivity
  have hsq : 0 ≤ (t / 2) ^ 2 * (4 - (t / 2) ^ 2) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
    nlinarith
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hs).mpr
  have hid : (2 / t + t / 4) * (t / 2 - (t / 2) ^ 3 / 6) =
      1 + (t / 2) ^ 2 * (4 - (t / 2) ^ 2) / 12 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo hfac
  have hfactor : 1 / (t / 2) + (t / 2) / 2 = 2 / t + t / 4 := by ring
  rw [hfactor, hid] at hmul
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_dirichletCircleKernel_coe_le_sinc
statement:
theorem abs_dirichletCircleKernel_coe_le_sinc (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htπ : t ≤ π) :
    |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))| ≤
      2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * |sinc (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| + t / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (t / 2) :=
    sin_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by positivity, by linarith [pi_pos]⟩
  have hM : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by positivity
  have hMt : 0 < ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t := mul_pos hM ht
  rw [dirichletCircleKernel_coe_eq_sin_div n t hs.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hs]
  calc
    |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| / sin (t / 2)
        = |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| * (1 / sin (t / 2)) := by ring
    _ ≤ |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| * (2 / t + t / 4) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (one_div_sin_half_le t ht htπ) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * |sinc (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| + t / 4 := by
      rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hMt.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hMt]
      have hsin := abs_sin_le_one (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)
      have hid : 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) *
          (|sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| / (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)) =
          |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| * (2 / t) := by field_simp
      rw [hid, mul_add]
      nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sin_nat_pi
statement:
theorem integral_abs_sin_nat_pi (j : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (j : ℝ) * π..(j + 1 : ℕ) * π, |sin x|) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∀ x : ℝ, |sin (x + (j : ℝ) * π)| = |sin x| := by
    intro x
    rw [sin_add_nat_mul_pi, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (fun x : ℝ => |sin x|)
    ((j : ℝ) * π) (a := 0) (b := π)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => hshift x)] at h
  have hend : π + (j : ℝ) * π = (j + 1 : ℕ) * π := by push_cast; ring
  rw [zero_add, hend] at h
  rw [← h]
  calc
    (∫ x in 0..π, |sin x|) = ∫ x in 0..π, sin x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le pi_pos.le] at hx
      exact abs_of_nonneg (sin_nonneg_of_mem_Icc hx)
    _ = 2 := by rw [integral_sin]; norm_num

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sinc_zero_pi_le
statement: theorem integral_abs_sinc_zero_pi_le : (∫ x in 0..π, |sinc x|) ≤ π
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, (1 : ℝ) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on pi_pos.le
        (continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun x _ => abs_sinc_le_one x)
    _ = π := by simp

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi_le
statement:
theorem integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi_le (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) :
    (∫ x in (j : ℝ) * π..(j + 1 : ℕ) * π, |sinc x|) ≤ 2 / ((j : ℝ) * π)
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : 0 < (j : ℝ) * π := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hj) pi_pos
  have hab : (j : ℝ) * π ≤ (j + 1 : ℕ) * π := by push_cast; nlinarith [pi_pos]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x in (j : ℝ) * π..(j + 1 : ℕ) * π, |sin x| / ((j : ℝ) * π) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab
        (continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((continuous_sin.abs.div_const _).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      intro x hx
      have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hlow hx.1
      rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hx0.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hx0]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) hlow hx.1
    _ = 2 / ((j : ℝ) * π) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_abs_sin_nat_pi]

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi_le_harmonic
statement:
theorem integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi_le_harmonic (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in 0..(n + 1 : ℕ) * π, |sinc x|) ≤ π + (2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
    (μ := volume)
    (a := fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ) * π) (n := n + 1)
    (f := fun x : ℝ => |sinc x|)
    (fun _ _ => continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hsplit
  rw [← hsplit, sum_range_succ']
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ range n, 2 / (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * π)) + π := by
      apply add_le_add
      · apply sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        exact integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi_le (j + 1) (by omega)
      · simpa using integral_abs_sinc_zero_pi_le
    _ = π + (2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ) := by
      rw [harmonic, Rat.cast_sum]
      simp only [Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast]
      rw [mul_sum]
      have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 / (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * π) =
          (2 / π) * (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) := by intro j; ring
      simp_rw [hterm]
      ring

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_zero_pi_le_harmonic
statement:
theorem integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_zero_pi_le_harmonic (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t in 0..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|) ≤
      2 * (π + (2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ)) + π ^ 2 / 8
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2
  have hM : 0 < M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hD : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|) := by
    exact (continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n |>.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2 * π))).abs
  have hB : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => 2 * M * |sinc (M * t)| + t / 4) := by
    fun_prop
  have hbound : (∫ t in 0..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|) ≤
      ∫ t in 0..π, 2 * M * |sinc (M * t)| + t / 4 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo pi_pos.le
      (hD.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hB.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    intro t ht
    exact abs_dirichletCircleKernel_coe_le_sinc n t ht.1 ht.2.le
  have hchange : M * (∫ t in 0..π, |sinc (M * t)|) = ∫ t in 0..M * π, |sinc t| := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero] using
      intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left (fun t : ℝ => |sinc t|) M
        (a := 0) (b := π)
  have hsinc : (∫ t in 0..M * π, |sinc t|) ≤ π + (2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ) := by
    apply le_trans _ (integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi_le_harmonic n)
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval le_rfl (mul_nonneg hM.le pi_pos.le)
    · dsimp [M]
      push_cast
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
    · exact continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hint : (∫ t in 0..π, 2 * M * |sinc (M * t)| + t / 4) =
      2 * (∫ t in 0..M * π, |sinc t|) + π ^ 2 / 8 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
      ((show Continuous (fun t : ℝ => 2 * M * |sinc (M * t)|) by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((show Continuous (fun t : ℝ => t / 4) by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_id]
    rw [show 2 * M * (∫ t in 0..π, |sinc (M * t)|) =
      2 * (M * (∫ t in 0..π, |sinc (M * t)|)) by ring, hchange]
    ring
  rw [hint] at hbound
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_zero_pi_div_pi_le_log
statement:
theorem integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_zero_pi_div_pi_le_log (n : ℕ) :
    (1 / π) * (∫ t in 0..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|) ≤
      3 + (4 / π ^ 2) * log (n + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : (harmonic n : ℝ) ≤ 1 + log (n + 1 : ℕ) := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn]
    · have hn0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      apply (harmonic_le_one_add_log n).trans
      gcongr
      linarith
  have hD := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_zero_pi_le_harmonic n) (one_div_nonneg.mpr pi_pos.le)
  have hH' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hH (show 0 ≤ 4 / π ^ 2 by positivity)
  have hconst : π / 8 + 4 / π ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have hpi := Real.pi_lt_four
    have hpi3 := Real.pi_gt_three
    have hdiv : 4 / π ^ 2 < 4 / 9 := by
      apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)).mpr
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hid : (1 / π) * (2 * (π + (2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ)) + π ^ 2 / 8) =
      2 + (4 / π ^ 2) * (harmonic n : ℝ) + π / 8 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hid] at hD
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_half_period
statement:
theorem integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_half_period (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), |dirichletCircleKernel n t| ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) =
      (1 / π) * ∫ t in 0..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|
  have hu : Continuous u :=
    (continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n |>.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2 * π))).abs
  have heven : ∀ t : ℝ, u (-t) = u t := by
    intro t
    simp only [u, dirichletCircleKernel_coe, mul_neg, cos_neg]
  rw [AddCircle.integral_haarAddCircle,
    ← AddCircle.intervalIntegral_preimage (2 * π) (-π)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have hreflect : (∫ t in -π..0, u t) = ∫ t in 0..π, u t := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (f := u) (a := 0) (b := π)
    simp only [neg_zero] at h
    simpa only [heven] using h.symm
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume)
    (hu.intervalIntegrable (-π) 0) (hu.intervalIntegrable 0 π)
  rw [hreflect] at hsplit
  rw [show -π + 2 * π = π by ring]
  change (2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ t in -π..π, u t) = (1 / π) * (∫ t in 0..π, u t)
  rw [← hsplit]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_le_log
statement:
theorem integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_le_log (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), |dirichletCircleKernel n t| ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) ≤
      3 + (4 / π ^ 2) * log (n + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_half_period]
  exact integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_zero_pi_div_pi_le_log n

name: NLAlib.two_div_le_one_div_sin_half
statement:
theorem two_div_le_one_div_sin_half (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htπ : t ≤ π) :
    2 / t ≤ 1 / sin (t / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (t / 2) := sin_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by positivity, by linarith [pi_pos]⟩
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) hs
    (sin_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ t / 2))
  have heq : (1 : ℝ) / (t / 2) = 2 / t := by ring
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.sinc_le_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_coe
statement:
theorem sinc_le_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_coe (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htπ : t ≤ π) :
    2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * |sinc (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| ≤
      |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (t / 2) :=
    sin_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by positivity, by linarith [pi_pos]⟩
  have hMt : 0 < ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t := by positivity
  rw [dirichletCircleKernel_coe_eq_sin_div n t hs.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hs,
    sinc_of_ne_zero hMt.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hMt]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (two_div_le_one_div_sin_half t ht htπ)
    (abs_nonneg (sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)))
  have hid : 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) *
      (|sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| / (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)) =
      |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| * (2 / t) := by field_simp
  rw [hid, show |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| / sin (t / 2) =
    |sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)| * (1 / sin (t / 2)) by ring]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.two_div_nat_pi_le_integral_abs_sinc
statement:
theorem two_div_nat_pi_le_integral_abs_sinc (j : ℕ) :
    2 / ((j + 1 : ℕ) * π) ≤ ∫ x in (j : ℝ) * π..(j + 1 : ℕ) * π, |sinc x|
proof:
:= by
  have hhigh : 0 < ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * π := by positivity
  have hab : (j : ℝ) * π ≤ (j + 1 : ℕ) * π := by push_cast; nlinarith [pi_pos]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x in (j : ℝ) * π..(j + 1 : ℕ) * π, |sin x| / ((j + 1 : ℕ) * π) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_abs_sin_nat_pi]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo hab
        ((continuous_sin.abs.div_const _).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      intro x hx
      have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hx.1
      rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hx0.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hx0]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) hx0 hx.2.le

name: NLAlib.harmonic_le_integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi
statement:
theorem harmonic_le_integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi (n : ℕ) :
    (2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ) ≤ ∫ x in 0..(n : ℝ) * π, |sinc x|
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume)
    (a := fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ) * π) (n := n)
    (f := fun x : ℝ => |sinc x|)
    (fun _ _ => continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hsplit
  rw [← hsplit, harmonic, Rat.cast_sum, mul_sum]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  simp only [Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast]
  have hterm : (2 / π) * (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      2 / (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * π) := by ring
  rw [hterm]
  exact two_div_nat_pi_le_integral_abs_sinc j

name: NLAlib.harmonic_le_integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel
statement:
theorem harmonic_le_integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel (n : ℕ) :
    (4 / π ^ 2) * (harmonic n : ℝ) ≤
      ∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), |dirichletCircleKernel n t| ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2
  have hM : 0 < M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hD : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))|) :=
    (continuous_dirichletCircleKernel n |>.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2 * π))).abs
  have hchange : M * (∫ t in 0..π, |sinc (M * t)|) = ∫ t in 0..M * π, |sinc t| := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero] using
      intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left (fun t : ℝ => |sinc t|) M
        (a := 0) (b := π)
  have hpoint : (∫ t in 0..π, 2 * M * |sinc (M * t)|) ≤
      ∫ t in 0..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))| := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo pi_pos.le
      ((show Continuous (fun t : ℝ => 2 * M * |sinc (M * t)|) by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (hD.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    intro t ht
    exact sinc_le_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_coe n t ht.1 ht.2.le
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, show 2 * M * (∫ t in 0..π, |sinc (M * t)|) =
    2 * (M * (∫ t in 0..π, |sinc (M * t)|)) by ring, hchange] at hpoint
  have hsinc : (∫ t in 0..(n : ℝ) * π, |sinc t|) ≤ ∫ t in 0..M * π, |sinc t| := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval le_rfl (by positivity)
    · dsimp [M]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
    · exact continuous_sinc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hH := harmonic_le_integral_abs_sinc_nat_pi n
  have htotal : (4 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ) ≤
      ∫ t in 0..π, |dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))| := by
    have heq : (4 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ) = 2 * ((2 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ)) := by ring
    rw [heq]
    linarith
  rw [integral_abs_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_half_period]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htotal (show 0 ≤ 1 / π by positivity)
  have hid : (4 / π ^ 2) * (harmonic n : ℝ) =
      (1 / π) * ((4 / π) * (harmonic n : ℝ)) := by ring
  rw [hid]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_two_nsmul
statement:
theorem re_fourier_two_nsmul (k : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (fourier (k : ℤ) (2 • t)).re = (fourier ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul, fourier_apply_add, ← fourier_add]
  rw [show (k : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) = ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega]

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_mul_re_fourier_nat
statement:
theorem re_fourier_mul_re_fourier_nat (k l : ℕ) (hlk : l ≤ k)
    (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    2 * ((fourier (k : ℤ) t).re * (fourier (l : ℤ) t).re) =
      (fourier ((k + l : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re + (fourier ((k - l : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hlk, sub_eq_add_neg, fourier_add, fourier_add, fourier_neg]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

name: NLAlib.modulatedFejerCircleKernel_eq_sum
statement:
theorem modulatedFejerCircleKernel_eq_sum (K : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    modulatedFejerCircleKernel K t = (K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (K + 1),
      ((fourier ((4 * K : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re + ∑ j ∈ range m,
        ((fourier ((4 * K + 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re +
          (fourier ((4 * K - 2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re))
proof:
:= by
  rw [modulatedFejerCircleKernel, fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_comm _ ((K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹), mul_assoc, mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  simp only [dirichletCircleKernel, re_fourier_two_nsmul, mul_add, mul_one,
    mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hfreq : 2 * (j + 1) ≤ 4 * K := by have := mem_range.mp hm; have := mem_range.mp hj; omega
  have h := re_fourier_mul_re_fourier_nat (4 * K) (2 * (j + 1)) hfreq t
  norm_num only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_re_fourier_nat_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_re_fourier_nat_eq_zero {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), (fourier (k : ℤ) t).re ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)] using integral_re_fourier_nat_succ_eq_zero (k - 1)

name: NLAlib.integral_fejerCircleKernel_two_nsmul_eq_one
statement:
theorem integral_fejerCircleKernel_two_nsmul_eq_one (K : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), fejerCircleKernel K (2 • t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdir (m : ℕ) : (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
      dirichletCircleKernel m (2 • t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1 := by
    simp_rw [dirichletCircleKernel, re_fourier_two_nsmul]
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (by
      apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport _ (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
      fun_prop), integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (by
        intro k hk
        apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport _ (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
        fun_prop)]
    have hz (k : ℕ) : (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
        (fourier ((2 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 0 :=
      integral_re_fourier_nat_eq_zero (by omega)
    simp only [hz]
    simp
  simp_rw [fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (by
    intro m hm
    exact ((continuous_dirichletCircleKernel m).comp (continuous_id.nsmul 2)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _))]
  simp only [hdir, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.continuous_modulatedFejerCircleKernel
statement: theorem continuous_modulatedFejerCircleKernel (K : ℕ) : Continuous (modulatedFejerCircleKernel K)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Complex.continuous_re.comp (fourier ((4 * K : ℕ) : ℤ)).continuous).mul
    ((continuous_fejerCircleKernel K).comp (continuous_id.nsmul 2))

name: NLAlib.abs_modulatedFejerCircleKernel_le
statement:
theorem abs_modulatedFejerCircleKernel_le (K : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    |modulatedFejerCircleKernel K t| ≤ fejerCircleKernel K (2 • t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modulatedFejerCircleKernel, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (fejerCircleKernel_nonneg _ _)]
  have hcos : |(fourier ((4 * K : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re| ≤ 1 :=
    (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans_eq (Circle.norm_coe _)
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcos (fejerCircleKernel_nonneg _ _)).trans_eq (one_mul _)

name: Real.tendsto_const_rpow_inv_two_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_const_rpow_inv_two_nat {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => d ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)))) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => 2 * (p : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
  have hexp : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => 1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [one_div, Function.comp_def] using tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hden
  simpa only [Real.rpow_zero, Function.comp_def] using
    (Real.continuousAt_const_rpow hd.ne').tendsto.comp hexp

name: Real.le_two_mul_of_even_moments_zero
statement:
theorem le_two_mul_of_even_moments_zero {E σ d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hM : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → E ≤ 2 * d ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) * σ) :
    E ≤ 2 * σ
proof:
:= by
  apply ge_of_tendsto (f := fun p : ℕ => 2 * d ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) * σ)
    (by simpa only [mul_one] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_const_rpow_inv_two_nat hd)).mul_const σ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with p hp
  exact hM p hp

name: Real.le_two_mul_add_four_mul_sqrt_log_of_even_moments
statement:
theorem le_two_mul_add_four_mul_sqrt_log_of_even_moments
    {E σ κ d : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hd : 1 < d)
    (hM : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → E ≤
      2 * d ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) * Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * κ ^ 2)) :
    E ≤ 2 * σ + 4 * κ * Real.sqrt (Real.log d)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ0 : κ = 0
  · subst κ
    have hh : E ≤ 2 * σ := le_two_mul_of_even_moments_zero (by linarith) (by
      intro p hp
      simpa only [zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero, add_zero,
        Real.sqrt_sq hσ] using hM p hp)
    simpa using hh
  have hκpos : 0 < κ := lt_of_le_of_ne hκ (Ne.symm hκ0)
  let ℓ := Real.log d
  let L := Real.sqrt ℓ
  have hℓ : 0 < ℓ := Real.log_pos hd
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hLs : L ^ 2 = ℓ := Real.sq_sqrt hℓ.le
  let p : ℕ := ⌈ℓ + σ * L / κ⌉₊
  have hchoice : 0 < ℓ + σ * L / κ := by positivity
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr hchoice
  have hpR : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hlo : ℓ + σ * L / κ ≤ (p : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hhi : (p : ℝ) < ℓ + σ * L / κ + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hchoice.le
  have hpminus : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp, Nat.cast_one]
  have hℓp : ℓ ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
    have hh : 0 ≤ σ * L / κ := by positivity
    linarith
  have hu₀ : 0 ≤ ℓ / (2 * (p : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hu₁ : ℓ / (2 * (p : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (p : ℝ))).mpr
    linarith
  have hdim : d ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) ≤ 1 + ℓ / (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < d)]
    have he := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le (show |ℓ / (2 * (p : ℝ))| ≤ 1 by
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hu₀] using hu₁)
    have hle := (le_abs_self (Real.exp (ℓ / (2 * (p : ℝ))) - 1)).trans he
    have heq : Real.log d * (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) = ℓ / (2 * (p : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [ℓ]; ring
    rw [heq]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hu₀] at hle
    have hratio : 2 * (ℓ / (2 * (p : ℝ))) = ℓ / (p : ℝ) := by field_simp
    linarith
  have hscaled : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * κ ^ 2 ≤ ℓ * κ ^ 2 + σ * κ * L := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (p : ℝ) - 1 ≤ ℓ + σ * L / κ by linarith)
      (sq_nonneg κ)
    have hc : (ℓ + σ * L / κ) * κ ^ 2 = ℓ * κ ^ 2 + σ * κ * L := by
      field_simp
    rw [hc, ← hpminus] at hh
    exact hh
  have hsum : (σ + κ * L) ^ 2 = σ ^ 2 + ℓ * κ ^ 2 + 2 * σ * κ * L := by
    rw [add_sq, mul_pow, hLs]
    ring
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * κ ^ 2) ≤ σ + κ * L := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    rw [hsum]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hσ hκ) hL]
  have hprod : ℓ / (p : ℝ) * (σ + κ * L) ≤ κ * L := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo (mul_nonneg hκ hL)
    have hc : (ℓ + σ * L / κ) * (κ * L) = ℓ * (σ + κ * L) := by
      field_simp
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun y : ℝ => σ * y) hLs]
    rw [hc] at hh
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpR).mpr
    nlinarith
  calc
    E ≤ 2 * d ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) *
        Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * κ ^ 2) := hM p hp
    _ ≤ 2 * (1 + ℓ / (p : ℝ)) * (σ + κ * L) :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdim (by norm_num)) hroot
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * σ + 2 * κ * L + 2 * (ℓ / (p : ℝ) * (σ + κ * L)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * σ + 4 * κ * Real.sqrt (Real.log d) := by dsimp [L, ℓ] at *; linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_triangular_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_upper_triangular_with_charpoly
    {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] (k : ℕ) (f : Module.End 𝕜 E) (hk : finrank 𝕜 E = k)
    (d : Fin k → 𝕜) (hchar : f.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) 𝕜 E,
      (∀ i j, j < i → inner 𝕜 (b i) (f (b j)) = 0) ∧
      ∀ i, inner 𝕜 (b i) (f (b i)) = d i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing E with
  | zero =>
    let b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 0) 𝕜 E :=
      (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 E).reindex (finCongr hk)
    exact ⟨b, fun i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    have hμ : f.HasEigenvalue (d 0) := by
      apply (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_isRoot_charpoly _ _).mpr
      rw [hchar]
      simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (k + 1)))
      simp
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxne⟩ := hμ.exists_hasEigenvector
    have hfx : f x = d 0 • x := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx
    have hxnorm : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hxne
    let u : E := (‖x‖⁻¹ : 𝕜) • x
    have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      simp only [u, norm_smul, norm_inv, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
        abs_of_nonneg hxnorm.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxnorm.ne']
    have hune : u ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hu
    have hfu : f u = d 0 • u := by simp only [u, map_smul, hfx, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    let W : Submodule 𝕜 E := (𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ
    have hWdim : finrank 𝕜 W = k := by
      have hdim := (𝕜 ∙ u).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
      rw [finrank_span_singleton hune, hk] at hdim
      dsimp [W]
      omega
    let Cμ : Module.End 𝕜 W := W.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (f.comp W.subtype)
    have hfactor : f.charpoly = (X - C (d 0)) * Cμ.charpoly :=
      charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_orthogonal_compression f hu hfu hk
    have hCchar : Cμ.charpoly = ∏ i : Fin k, (X - C (d i.succ)) := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (d 0))
      rw [← hfactor, hchar, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    obtain ⟨bW, htriW, hdiagW⟩ := ih Cμ hWdim (fun i => d i.succ) hCchar
    obtain ⟨b, hb₀, hbS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hk u hu bW
    refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      revert hij
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · intro hij
        rw [hb₀, hfu, inner_smul_right]
        have hiu : inner 𝕜 (b i) u = 0 := by
          rw [← hb₀]
          exact b.orthonormal.inner_eq_zero (ne_of_gt hij)
        rw [hiu, mul_zero]
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
        · intro hij
          exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _)) hij |>.elim
        · intro hij
          rw [hbS, hbS]
          simpa only [Cμ, LinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
            Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left] using
              htriW i j (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)
    · intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · rw [hb₀, hfu, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hu]
        simp
      · rw [hbS]
        simpa only [Cμ, LinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
          Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left] using hdiagW i

name: NLAlib.one_sub_sum_pow_div_sum_pow_le_log_div
statement:
theorem one_sub_sum_pow_div_sum_pow_le_log_div {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d g : ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (i₀ : ι) (h₀ : d i₀ = 1) (hg : g i₀ ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) :
    1 - (∑ i, g i ^ 2 * d i ^ (2 * q + 1)) / (∑ i, g i ^ 2 * d i ^ (2 * q)) ≤
      Real.log ((∑ i, g i ^ 2) / (g i₀ ^ 2)) / ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let G := ∑ i, g i ^ 2
  let M := fun s : ℕ => ∑ i, g i ^ 2 * d i ^ s
  let r := 2 * q + 1
  have hg2 : 0 < g i₀ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hg
  have hG : 0 < G := hg2.trans_le
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (g i)) (Finset.mem_univ i₀))
  have hMlow : ∀ s, g i₀ ^ 2 ≤ M s := by
    intro s
    have h := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => g i ^ 2 * d i ^ s)
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (hd i) s)) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    simpa only [h₀, one_pow, mul_one] using h
  have hMp : ∀ s, 0 < M s := fun s => hg2.trans_le (hMlow s)
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < r := by
    exact_mod_cast (by dsimp [r]; omega : 0 < r)
  let α := ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) / r
  let β := ((r : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹
  let w := fun i => g i ^ 2 / G
  have hα0 : 0 ≤ α := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hr.le
  have hα1 : α ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hr).mpr
    exact_mod_cast (by dsimp [r]; omega : 2 * q ≤ r)
  have hαβ : α + β = 1 := by
    dsimp only [α, β, r]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hw : ∑ i, w i = 1 := by
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_self hG.ne']
  have hpow : ∀ i, (d i ^ r) ^ α = d i ^ (2 * q) := by
    intro i
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (hd i)]
    have he : (r : ℝ) * α = ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [α]
      rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hr.ne']
    rw [he, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hJ := (Real.concaveOn_rpow hα0 hα1).le_map_sum (t := Finset.univ)
    (w := w) (p := fun i => d i ^ r)
    (fun i _ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hG.le) hw
    (fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hd i) r)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, hpow, w, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div] at hJ
  let a := M r / G
  let b := M (2 * q) / G
  have ha : 0 < a := div_pos (hMp r) hG
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos (hMp (2 * q)) hG
  have hJ' : b ≤ a ^ α := hJ
  have hlow : a ^ β ≤ a / b := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hb).mpr
    calc a ^ β * b ≤ a ^ β * a ^ α :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ' (Real.rpow_nonneg ha.le _)
      _ = a := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add ha, show β + α = 1 by linarith, Real.rpow_one]
  have hlead : g i₀ ^ 2 / G ≤ a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hMlow r) hG.le
  have hroot : (g i₀ ^ 2 / G) ^ β ≤ a ^ β :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow (div_nonneg hg2.le hG.le) hlead (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)
  have hrootEq : (g i₀ ^ 2 / G) ^ β = Real.exp (-Real.log (G / g i₀ ^ 2) / r) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (div_pos hg2 hG), Real.log_div hg2.ne' hG.ne',
      Real.log_div hG.ne' hg2.ne']
    congr 1
    dsimp only [β]
    ring
  have hratio : a / b = M r / M (2 * q) := by
    dsimp only [a, b]
    field_simp
  rw [hrootEq] at hroot
  have hExp : Real.exp (-Real.log (G / g i₀ ^ 2) / r) ≤ M r / M (2 * q) := by
    rw [← hratio]
    exact hroot.trans hlow
  have hscalar := Real.add_one_le_exp (-Real.log (G / g i₀ ^ 2) / r)
  rw [neg_div] at hExp hscalar
  change 1 - M r / M (2 * q) ≤ Real.log (G / g i₀ ^ 2) / r
  linarith

name: NLAlib.factorial_two_mul_le_four_pow_mul_factorial_sq
statement:
theorem factorial_two_mul_le_four_pow_mul_factorial_sq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 * n).factorial ≤ 4 ^ n * n.factorial ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : (2 * n).choose n * n.factorial * n.factorial = (2 * n).factorial := by
    simpa only [show 2 * n - n = n by omega] using
      Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (show n ≤ 2 * n by omega)
  rw [← he]
  have hpow : 2 ^ (2 * n) = 4 ^ n := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n.factorial ^ 2) (Nat.choose_le_two_pow (2 * n) n)
  simpa only [hpow, pow_two, mul_assoc] using h

name: NLAlib.factorial_le_succ_pow_pred
statement: theorem factorial_le_succ_pow_pred (n : ℕ) : n.factorial ≤ (n + 1) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn]
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
    calc
      (n + 1) * n.factorial ≤ (n + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (n - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ih
      _ = (n + 1) ^ n := by rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
      _ ≤ (n + 1 + 1) ^ (n + 1 - 1) := by
        simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show n + 1 ≤ n + 1 + 1 by omega) n

name: NLAlib.factorial_radial_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem factorial_radial_coefficient_le {r p d : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    2 * 4 ^ d * 2 ^ ((p - 1) * (d - 1)) * (p - 1).factorial ^ (d - 1) *
        (r + 4 * p) ^ (p - 1) ≤
