  exact sub_nonneg.mp h

name: NLAlib.eventually_continuousAt_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain
statement:
theorem eventually_continuousAt_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain
    {𝕜 E F G : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] [CompleteSpace G]
    {f : E × F → G} {D : (E × F) →L[𝕜] G} {u : E × F}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f D u)
    (hD : (D ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr 𝕜 E F).IsInvertible) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 u.1, ContinuousAt (hf.implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hD) x
proof:
:= by
  let d := hf.implicitFunctionDataOfProdDomain hD
  have htarget : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 u.1, (f u, x) ∈ d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.target := by
    have ht := d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.open_target.mem_nhds
      d.map_pt_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
    exact (continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id).preimage_mem_nhds ht
  filter_upwards [htarget] with x hx
  exact ((d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.symm.continuousAt hx).comp
    (continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id)).snd

name: Complex.sum_weight_normSq_sub_average
statement:
theorem sum_weight_normSq_sub_average (w : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℂ)
    (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    let a : ℂ
proof:
:= ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * z i
    (∑ i, w i * Complex.normSq (z i - a)) =
      (∑ i, w i * Complex.normSq (z i)) - Complex.normSq a := by
  dsimp only
  let a : ℂ := ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * z i
  have hcross : (∑ i, w i * (z i * conj a).re) = Complex.normSq a := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * (z i * conj a)).re := by
        simp only [Complex.re_sum, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      _ = (a * conj a).re := by
        simp only [a, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re]
  change (∑ i, w i * Complex.normSq (z i - a)) = _
  simp only [Complex.normSq_sub, mul_sub, mul_add, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hconst : (∑ i, w i * Complex.normSq a) = Complex.normSq a := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hw, one_mul]
  have htwo : (∑ i, w i * (2 * (z i * conj a).re)) = 2 * Complex.normSq a := by
    rw [← hcross, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hconst, htwo]
  ring

name: Complex.eq_average_of_norm_average_eq_bound
statement:
theorem eq_average_of_norm_average_eq_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hws : ∑ i, w i = 1) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hz : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ ≤ M) (ha : ‖∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * z i‖ = M) :
    ∀ j, z j = ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * z i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : ℂ := ∑ i, (w i : ℂ) * z i
  have hvar := sum_weight_normSq_sub_average w z hws
  have hbudget : (∑ i, w i * Complex.normSq (z i)) ≤ M ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, w i * M ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by
          rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
          exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hM).mpr (hz i)) (hw i).le
      _ = M ^ 2 := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hws, one_mul]
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i * Complex.normSq (z i - a)) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hvar, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ha]
    linarith
  intro j
  have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
    mul_nonneg (hw i).le (Complex.normSq_nonneg (z i - a))) (mem_univ j)
  have hzero : Complex.normSq (z j - a) = 0 := by
    have hnonneg := Complex.normSq_nonneg (z j - a)
    nlinarith [hw j]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp hzero)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalProjectionOnto_map_starProjection_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalProjectionOnto_map_starProjection_eq
    (f : Module.End 𝕜 E) (hf : Set.MapsTo f Wᗮ Wᗮ) (x : E) :
    W.orthogonalProjectionOnto (f (W.starProjection x)) = W.orthogonalProjectionOnto (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : W.orthogonalProjectionOnto (f (x - W.starProjection x)) = 0 :=
    W.orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_zero_iff.mpr (hf (W.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal x))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub] at hzero
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm

name: NLAlib.commute_orthogonal_compressions_of_invariant
statement:
theorem commute_orthogonal_compressions_of_invariant
    (f g : Module.End 𝕜 E) (hf : Set.MapsTo f Wᗮ Wᗮ) (hg : Set.MapsTo g Wᗮ Wᗮ)
    (hcomm : Commute f g) :
    Commute (W.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (f.comp W.subtype))
      (W.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (g.comp W.subtype))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change W.orthogonalProjectionOnto (f (W.starProjection (g x.val))) =
    W.orthogonalProjectionOnto (g (W.starProjection (f x.val)))
  rw [orthogonalProjectionOnto_map_starProjection_eq W f hf,
    orthogonalProjectionOnto_map_starProjection_eq W g hg]
  exact congrArg W.orthogonalProjectionOnto (LinearMap.congr_fun hcomm.eq x.val)

name: Real.one_lt_log_four_mul
statement:
theorem one_lt_log_four_mul {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    1 < log (4 * D)
proof:
:= by
  apply (lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by positivity)).mpr
  linarith [exp_one_lt_three]

name: Real.log_two_mul_add_le_log_four_mul
proof:
:= by
  apply log_le_log (by positivity)
  have hrc : 1 ≤ r * c := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr) (sub_nonneg.mpr hc)]
  have hs : r + c ≤ 2 * r * c := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr) (sub_nonneg.mpr hc)]
  nlinarith

name: Real.log_four_mul_mul_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem log_four_mul_mul_mul_pow_le {a b m : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (q : ℕ) :
    log (4 * a * b * m ^ q) ≤ (q + 4 : ℝ) * log (max a b + m)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  have hd : 2 ≤ max a b + m := by linarith [le_max_left a b]
  have h2 : log 2 ≤ log (max a b + m) := log_le_log (by norm_num) hd
  have hla : log a ≤ log (max a b + m) := log_le_log ha0 (by
    linarith [le_max_left a b])
  have hlb : log b ≤ log (max a b + m) := log_le_log hb0 (by
    linarith [le_max_right a b])
  have hlm : log m ≤ log (max a b + m) := log_le_log hm0 (by
    linarith [le_max_left a b])
  have h4 : log (4 : ℝ) = 2 * log 2 := by
    have h := log_pow (2 : ℝ) 2
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  rw [log_mul (by positivity) (pow_ne_zero q hm0.ne'),
    log_mul (by positivity) hb0.ne', log_mul (by norm_num) ha0.ne', log_pow, h4]
  have hq : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg q
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlm hq]

name: NLAlib.norm_pair_mul
statement:
theorem norm_pair_mul {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (a : m → ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    ‖(fun ij : m × n => a ij.1 * b ij.2)‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖b‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with hm | hm
  · simp [Pi.norm_def]
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp [Pi.norm_def]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg b))).mpr
    intro ij
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (norm_le_pi_norm a ij.1) (norm_le_pi_norm b ij.2)
      (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  · obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup Finset.univ Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => ‖a i‖₊)
    obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup Finset.univ Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => ‖b j‖₊)
    have hai : ‖a‖ = ‖a i‖ := by simpa only [Pi.norm_def, coe_nnnorm] using congrArg NNReal.toReal hi
    have hbj : ‖b‖ = ‖b j‖ := by simpa only [Pi.norm_def, coe_nnnorm] using congrArg NNReal.toReal hj
    rw [hai, hbj, ← norm_mul]
    exact norm_le_pi_norm (fun ij : m × n => a ij.1 * b ij.2) (i, j)

name: NLAlib.bddBelow_metricInfTransform
statement:
private theorem bddBelow_metricInfTransform (g : C(X, ℝ)) (x : X) :
    BddBelow (range fun y : X => dist x y - g y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨-‖g‖, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  linarith [g.apply_le_norm y, dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y)]

name: NLAlib.metricInfTransform_le
statement:
theorem metricInfTransform_le (g : C(X, ℝ)) (x y : X) :
    metricInfTransform g x ≤ dist x y - g y
proof:
:=
  ciInf_le (bddBelow_metricInfTransform g x) y

name: NLAlib.metricInfTransform_lipschitz
statement:
theorem metricInfTransform_lipschitz [Nonempty X] (g : C(X, ℝ)) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (metricInfTransform g)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_le_add_mul 1
  intro x y
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
  rw [← sub_le_iff_le_add]
  apply le_ciInf
  intro z
  have hx := metricInfTransform_le g x z
  have ht := dist_triangle x y z
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_lipschitz_dominate_of_add_le_dist
statement:
theorem exists_lipschitz_dominate_of_add_le_dist [Nonempty X]
    (f g : C(X, ℝ)) (hfg : ∀ x y, f x + g y ≤ dist x y) :
    ∃ u : C(X, ℝ), LipschitzWith 1 u ∧ (∀ x, f x ≤ u x) ∧ ∀ y, g y ≤ -u y
proof:
:= by
  let u : C(X, ℝ) := ⟨metricInfTransform g, (metricInfTransform_lipschitz g).continuous⟩
  refine ⟨u, metricInfTransform_lipschitz g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    apply le_ciInf
    intro y
    have h := hfg x y
    linarith
  · intro y
    have h := metricInfTransform_le g y y
    simp only [dist_self, zero_sub] at h
    change g y ≤ -metricInfTransform g y
    linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_pow_mul_sum_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem sum_mul_pow_mul_sum_mul_pow_le (w x : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (a b : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, w i * x i ^ a) * (∑ i, w i * x i ^ b) ≤
      (∑ i, w i) * ∑ i, w i * x i ^ (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpoint (i j : ι) :
      w i * w j * (x i ^ a * x j ^ b + x j ^ a * x i ^ b) ≤
        w i * w j * (x i ^ (a + b) + x j ^ (a + b)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg (hw i) (hw j))
    rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    rcases le_total (x i) (x j) with hij | hji
    · have ha := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hx i) hij a
      have hb := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hx i) hij b
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha) (sub_nonneg.mpr hb)]
    · have ha := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hx j) hji a
      have hb := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hx j) hji b
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha) (sub_nonneg.mpr hb)]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) => hpoint i j
  have hL : (∑ i, ∑ j, w i * w j * (x i ^ a * x j ^ b + x j ^ a * x i ^ b)) =
      2 * ((∑ i, w i * x i ^ a) * (∑ i, w i * x i ^ b)) := by
    simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [show (∑ i, ∑ j, w i * w j * (x j ^ a * x i ^ b)) =
      ∑ j, ∑ i, w i * w j * (x j ^ a * x i ^ b) from Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [show ∀ i j, w i * w j * (x i ^ a * x j ^ b) =
      (w i * x i ^ a) * (w j * x j ^ b) by intros; ring,
      show ∀ i j, w j * w i * (x i ^ a * x j ^ b) =
      (w i * x i ^ a) * (w j * x j ^ b) by intros; ring]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    ring
  have hR : (∑ i, ∑ j, w i * w j * (x i ^ (a + b) + x j ^ (a + b))) =
      2 * ((∑ i, w i) * ∑ i, w i * x i ^ (a + b)) := by
    simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp_rw [show ∀ i j, w i * w j * x i ^ (a + b) =
      (w i * x i ^ (a + b)) * w j by intros; ring,
      show ∀ i j, w i * w j * x j ^ (a + b) =
      w i * (w j * x j ^ (a + b)) by intros; ring]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    ring
  rw [hL, hR] at hsum
  linarith

name: NLAlib.prod_list_sum_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem prod_list_sum_mul_pow_le (w x : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (ks : List ℕ) (hne : ks ≠ []) :
    (ks.map fun k => ∑ i, w i * x i ^ k).prod ≤
      (∑ i, w i) ^ (ks.length - 1) * ∑ i, w i * x i ^ ks.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction ks with
  | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
  | cons k ks ih =>
    cases ks with
    | nil => simp
    | cons l ls =>
      have htail := ih (by simp)
      have hm (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ∑ i, w i * x i ^ n :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (pow_nonneg (hx i) n)
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.length_cons, List.sum_cons,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel] at *
      calc
        _ ≤ (∑ i, w i * x i ^ k) *
            ((∑ i, w i) ^ ls.length * ∑ i, w i * x i ^ (l + ls.sum)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (hm k)
        _ = (∑ i, w i) ^ ls.length *
            ((∑ i, w i * x i ^ k) * ∑ i, w i * x i ^ (l + ls.sum)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (∑ i, w i) ^ ls.length *
            ((∑ i, w i) * ∑ i, w i * x i ^ (k + (l + ls.sum))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_mul_pow_mul_sum_mul_pow_le w x hw hx _ _)
            (pow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hw i) _)
        _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_cot
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_cot {x : ℝ} (hx : sin x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt Real.cot (-1 / (sin x) ^ 2) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos x).div (Real.hasDerivAt_sin x) hx
  have heq : (-sin x * sin x - cos x * cos x) / sin x ^ 2 = -1 / sin x ^ 2 := by
    congr 1
    nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq x]
  exact (h.congr_deriv heq).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin y))

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_mul_cot
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_mul_cot {x : ℝ} (hx : sin x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => t * Real.cot t) ((sin x * cos x - x) / (sin x) ^ 2) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_id x).mul (hasDerivAt_cot hx)
  apply h.congr_deriv
  simp only [one_mul, id_eq, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.antitoneOn_mul_cot
statement: theorem antitoneOn_mul_cot : AntitoneOn (fun x => x * Real.cot x) (Ioc 0 (π / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (π / 2), 0 < sin x := by
    intro x hx
    exact sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx.1 (hx.2.trans_lt (by linarith [pi_pos]))
  apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Ioc 0 (π / 2))
    (fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_mul_cot (hs x hx).ne').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_mul_cot (hs x (interior_subset hx)).ne').hasDerivWithinAt)
  intro x hx
  apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ (sq_nonneg _)
  have hx' := interior_subset hx
  have hsc : sin x * cos x ≤ sin x := mul_le_of_le_one_right (hs x hx').le (cos_le_one x)
  have hsin : sin x ≤ x := Real.sin_le hx'.1.le
  linarith

name: NLAlib.monotoneOn_sin_mul_div_sin_mul
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_sin_mul_div_sin_mul {h k : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hk : h ≤ k)
    (hkπ : k ≤ π / 2) :
    MonotoneOn (fun s => sin (h * s) / sin (k * s)) (Ioc 0 (1 / 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : 0 < k := hh.trans_le hk
  have hargs : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2),
      h * s ∈ Ioc 0 (π / 2) ∧ k * s ∈ Ioc 0 (π / 2) := by
    intro s hs
    have hsone : s ≤ 1 := by linarith [hs.2]
    have hsh : h * s ≤ h := by nlinarith
    have hsk : k * s ≤ k := by nlinarith
    exact ⟨⟨mul_pos hh hs.1, hsh.trans (hk.trans hkπ)⟩,
      ⟨mul_pos hkpos hs.1, hsk.trans hkπ⟩⟩
  have hsine : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2), 0 < sin (h * s) ∧ 0 < sin (k * s) := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hargs s hs
    exact ⟨sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi ha.1 (ha.2.trans_lt (by linarith [pi_pos])),
      sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hb.1 (hb.2.trans_lt (by linarith [pi_pos]))⟩
  let d := fun s =>
    (h * cos (h * s) * sin (k * s) - k * sin (h * s) * cos (k * s)) /
      (sin (k * s)) ^ 2
  have hderiv : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => sin (h * s) / sin (k * s)) (d s) s := by
    intro s hs
    have hhder := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (h * s)).comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul h)
    have hkder := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (k * s)).comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul k)
    apply (hhder.div hkder (hsine s hs).2.ne').congr_deriv
    dsimp [d]
    ring
  apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Ioc 0 (1 / 2))
    (fun s hs => (hderiv s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hderiv s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
  intro s hs
  have hs' := interior_subset hs
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hargs s hs'
  obtain ⟨haSin, hbSin⟩ := hsine s hs'
  have hanti := antitoneOn_mul_cot ha hb (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk hs'.1.le)
  simp only [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, ← mul_div_assoc] at hanti
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hbSin haSin] at hanti
  have hnum : 0 ≤ h * cos (h * s) * sin (k * s) - k * sin (h * s) * cos (k * s) := by
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := s) ?_ hs'.1
    nlinarith [hanti]
  exact div_nonneg hnum (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.sin_mul_sq_le_two_mul_sin_half_sq
statement:
theorem sin_mul_sq_le_two_mul_sin_half_sq {h u s : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hhπ : h ≤ π / 2) (hu : h / 2 ≤ u) (huπ : u ≤ π / 2)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    sin (h * s) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * sin (π * s / 2) ^ 2 * sin u ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · simp [hs0]
  have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs.1 (Ne.symm hs0)
  have hsinhalf : 0 < sin (π / 4) := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith [pi_pos])
    (by linarith [pi_pos])
  have hsinarg : 0 < sin (π / 2 * s) := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    (mul_pos (by linarith [pi_pos]) hspos) (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hs.2])
  have hm := monotoneOn_sin_mul_div_sin_mul hh hhπ le_rfl
    ⟨hspos, hs.2⟩ (by norm_num) hs.2
  have heq1 : h * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = h / 2 := by ring
  have heq2 : π / 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = π / 4 := by ring
  dsimp only at hm
  rw [heq1, heq2, div_le_div_iff₀ hsinarg hsinhalf] at hm
  have hhs : 0 ≤ sin (h * s) := sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi
    (mul_nonneg hh.le hs.1) (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hs.2])
  have hhhalf : 0 ≤ sin (h / 2) := sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi
    (by linarith) (by linarith [pi_pos])
  have hsq := sq_le_sq₀ (mul_nonneg hhs hsinhalf.le)
    (mul_nonneg hhhalf hsinarg.le) |>.mpr hm
  have hhcmp : sin (h / 2) ≤ sin u := sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
    (by linarith [pi_pos]) huπ hu
  have husin : 0 ≤ sin u := sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [pi_pos])
  have husq := sq_le_sq₀ hhhalf husin |>.mpr hhcmp
  have hhalfSq : sin (π / 4) ^ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [sin_pi_div_four]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  have hsq' : sin (h * s) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ sin (h / 2) ^ 2 * sin (π / 2 * s) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow, hhalfSq, mul_one_div] using hsq
  have harg : π / 2 * s = π * s / 2 := by ring
  rw [harg] at hsq'
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right husq (sq_nonneg (sin (π * s / 2)))]

name: NLAlib.sin_add_mul_sin_sub
statement:
theorem sin_add_mul_sin_sub (u v : ℝ) :
    sin (u + v) * sin (u - v) = sin u ^ 2 - sin v ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sin_add, sin_sub]
  nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq u, sin_sq_add_cos_sq v,
    mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (sin u)) (sq_nonneg (sin v))]

name: NLAlib.cos_mul_cot_pair_le
statement:
theorem cos_mul_cot_pair_le {h u s : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhπ : h ≤ π / 2)
    (hu : h / 2 ≤ u) (huπ : u ≤ π / 2) (hs : s ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    cos (π * s) * (Real.cot (u + h * s) + Real.cot (u - h * s)) ≤ 2 * Real.cot u
proof:
:= by
  have hup : 0 < u + h * s := by nlinarith [hs.1]
  have hum : 0 < u - h * s := by nlinarith [hs.2]
  have hupπ : u + h * s < π := by nlinarith [hs.2, pi_pos]
  have humπ : u - h * s < π := by nlinarith [hs.1, pi_pos]
  have hp := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hup hupπ
  have hm := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hum humπ
  have husin : 0 < sin u := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [pi_pos])
  have hucos : 0 ≤ cos u := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], huπ⟩
  have hd : 0 < sin u ^ 2 - sin (h * s) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sin_add_mul_sin_sub]
    exact mul_pos hp hm
  have hpair : Real.cot (u + h * s) + Real.cot (u - h * s) =
      (2 * sin u * cos u) / (sin u ^ 2 - sin (h * s) ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
    rw [← sin_add_mul_sin_sub]
    field_simp
    rw [sin_add, sin_sub, cos_add, cos_sub]
    calc
      _ = 2 * sin u * cos u * (sin (h * s) ^ 2 + cos (h * s) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]
  rw [hpair, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, ← mul_div_assoc,
    ← mul_div_assoc, div_le_div_iff₀ hd husin]
  have hsin := sin_mul_sq_le_two_mul_sin_half_sq hh hhπ hu huπ ⟨hs.1, hs.2.le⟩
  have hcos : cos (π * s) = 1 - 2 * sin (π * s / 2) ^ 2 := by
    have h := cos_two_mul (π * s / 2)
    rw [show 2 * (π * s / 2) = π * s by ring] at h
    nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq (π * s / 2)]
  rw [hcos]
  have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsin (mul_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hucos)
  nlinarith [hbound]

name: NLAlib.lipschitzWith_comp_const_sub
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_comp_const_sub {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hg : LipschitzWith L g) (x : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith L (fun t : ℝ => g (x - t))
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : LipschitzWith 1 (fun t : ℝ => x - t) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro a b
    simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, Real.dist_eq]
    have heq : (x - a) - (x - b) = -(a - b) := by ring
    rw [heq, abs_neg]
  simpa only [mul_one, Function.comp_def] using hg.comp hlin

name: Real.sum_pow_div_card_le_rpow_sum_pow_div_card
statement:
theorem sum_pow_div_card_le_rpow_sum_pow_div_card
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    {k j : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hkj : k ≤ j) :
    (∑ i, f i ^ k) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≤
      ((∑ i, f i ^ j) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) ^ ((k : ℝ) / j)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : 0 < j := hk.trans_le hkj
  have hjR : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl h =>
    simp [Real.zero_rpow (div_pos hkR hjR).ne']
  | inr h =>
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    have hθ0 : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) / j := (div_pos hkR hjR).le
    have hθ1 : (k : ℝ) / j ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hjR).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hkj)
    have hw : (∑ _i : ι, (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1 := by
      simp [hd.ne']
    have hJ := (Real.concaveOn_rpow hθ0 hθ1).le_map_sum
      (t := Finset.univ) (w := fun _ : ι => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹)
      (p := fun i => f i ^ j)
      (fun _ _ => inv_nonneg.mpr hd.le) hw (fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hf i) j)
    have hpower (i : ι) : (f i ^ j) ^ ((k : ℝ) / j) = f i ^ k := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (hf i)]
      have he : (j : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) / j) = k := by
        rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hjR.ne']
      rw [he, Real.rpow_natCast]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hJ
    simp_rw [hpower] at hJ
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum] at hJ
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hJ

name: Real.sum_pow_div_card_le_pow_mul_rpow_sum_pow_div_card
statement:
theorem sum_pow_div_card_le_pow_mul_rpow_sum_pow_div_card
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hfr : ∀ i, f i ≤ r)
    {k j L : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hkL : k ≤ L) :
    (∑ i, f i ^ L) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≤
      r ^ (L - k) *
        ((∑ i, f i ^ j) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) ^ ((k : ℝ) / j)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (i : ι) : f i ^ L ≤ r ^ (L - k) * f i ^ k := by
    calc
      f i ^ L = f i ^ (L - k) * f i ^ k := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hkL]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (hf i) (hfr i) _) (pow_nonneg (hf i) _)
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ i, r ^ (L - k) * f i ^ k) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hpoint i)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = r ^ (L - k) * ((∑ i, f i ^ k) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_div_assoc]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (sum_pow_div_card_le_rpow_sum_pow_div_card f hf hk hkj) (pow_nonneg hr _)

name: NLAlib.evenMomentInterpolation_le_pow
statement:
theorem evenMomentInterpolation_le_pow {u : ℕ → ℝ} {q k : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ p, 0 ≤ u p) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hk : k ≤ 2 * q)
    (hbound : ∀ p ≤ q, u p ≤ x ^ (2 * p)) :
    evenMomentInterpolation u k ≤ x ^ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold evenMomentInterpolation
  apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (pow_nonneg hx _)).2
  have h1 : k / 2 ≤ q := by omega
  have h2 : (k + 1) / 2 ≤ q := by omega
  calc
    u (k / 2) * u ((k + 1) / 2) ≤
        x ^ (2 * (k / 2)) * x ^ (2 * ((k + 1) / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul (hbound _ h1) (hbound _ h2) (hu _) (pow_nonneg hx _)
    _ = (x ^ k) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      omega

name: NLAlib.choose_mul_factorial_le_mul_pow
statement:
theorem choose_mul_factorial_le_mul_pow {p q k : ℕ} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (2 * p).choose (k + 2) * (k + 2).factorial ≤
      (2 * p) * (2 * q) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, ← Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]
  rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 by omega, Nat.descFactorial_succ]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.sub_le _ _)
    ((Nat.descFactorial_le_pow _ _).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _))

name: NLAlib.sum_pow_mul_pow_le_div
statement:
theorem sum_pow_mul_pow_le_div {a x : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hax : a < x) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range n, a ^ k * x ^ (n - 1 - k)) ≤ x ^ n / (x - a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hax)).2
  have hgeom := geom_sum₂_mul a x n
  have hpow := pow_nonneg ha n
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.finiteMomentUpdate_le
statement:
theorem finiteMomentUpdate_le {ν R x : ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℝ} {p q : ℕ}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hx : 2 * (q : ℝ) * R < x)
    (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hbound : ∀ i ≤ q, u i ≤ x ^ (2 * i)) :
    finiteMomentUpdate ν R u p ≤
      (2 * (p : ℝ)) * x ^ (2 * p - 1) * ((q : ℝ) * ν / (x - 2 * q * R))
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := le_trans (by positivity) hx.le
  have ha : 0 ≤ 2 * (q : ℝ) * R := by positivity
  have hcoeff (k : ℕ) :
      ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * (p : ℝ)) * (2 * (q : ℝ)) ^ (k + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast choose_mul_factorial_le_mul_pow (k := k) hpq
  calc
    finiteMomentUpdate ν R u p ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range (2 * p - 1),
          ((2 * (p : ℝ)) * (2 * (q : ℝ)) ^ (k + 1)) / 2 * ν * R ^ k *
            x ^ (2 * p - (k + 2)) := by
      unfold finiteMomentUpdate
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      have hi : 2 * p - (k + 2) ≤ 2 * q := by omega
      have hcdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff k) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      have hcv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcdiv hν
      have hcvR := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcv (pow_nonneg hR k)
      exact mul_le_mul hcvR
        (evenMomentInterpolation_le_pow hu hx0 hi hbound)
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = (2 * (p : ℝ)) * (q : ℝ) * ν *
        ∑ k ∈ range (2 * p - 1),
          (2 * (q : ℝ) * R) ^ k * x ^ (2 * p - 1 - 1 - k) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [mul_pow, pow_succ]
      have he : 2 * p - (k + 2) = 2 * p - 1 - 1 - k := by omega
      rw [he]
      ring
    _ ≤ (2 * (p : ℝ)) * (q : ℝ) * ν *
        (x ^ (2 * p - 1) / (x - 2 * q * R)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_pow_mul_pow_le_div ha hx _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.finiteMomentBarrier_mono
statement:
theorem finiteMomentBarrier_mono {q : ℕ} {ν R : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
    Monotone (finiteMomentBarrier q ν R)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold finiteMomentBarrier
  gcongr

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_finiteMomentBarrier
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_finiteMomentBarrier {q : ℕ} {ν R t : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hν : 0 < ν) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivAt (finiteMomentBarrier q ν R)
      ((q : ℝ) * ν / Real.sqrt (2 * (q : ℝ) * ν * (t + 1))) t
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < 2 * (q : ℝ) * ν * (t + 1) := by
    have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
    positivity
  have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const 1).const_mul (2 * (q : ℝ) * ν)).sqrt hpos.ne').add_const
    (2 * (q : ℝ) * R)
  convert! h using 1
  simp only [id_eq, mul_one]
  ring

name: NLAlib.finiteMomentUpdate_le_barrier_sub
statement:
theorem finiteMomentUpdate_le_barrier_sub {ν R : ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℝ} {p q n : ℕ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i)
    (hbound : ∀ i ≤ q, u i ≤ finiteMomentBarrier q ν R n ^ (2 * i)) :
    finiteMomentUpdate ν R u p ≤
      finiteMomentBarrier q ν R (n + 1) ^ (2 * p) -
        finiteMomentBarrier q ν R n ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 1 ≤ q := hp.trans hpq
  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
  have hpos (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 < 2 * (q : ℝ) * ν * (t + 1) := by positivity
  have hbar (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
      2 * (q : ℝ) * R < finiteMomentBarrier q ν R t := by
    dsimp only [finiteMomentBarrier]
    linarith [Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos t ht)]
  let D : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (2 * (p : ℝ)) *
    finiteMomentBarrier q ν R t ^ (2 * p - 1) *
      ((q : ℝ) * ν / Real.sqrt (2 * (q : ℝ) * ν * (t + 1)))
  have hd (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
      HasDerivAt (fun t => finiteMomentBarrier q ν R t ^ (2 * p)) (D t) t := by
    convert! (hasDerivAt_finiteMomentBarrier hq hν ht).pow (2 * p) using 1
    simp only [D, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t => finiteMomentBarrier q ν R t ^ (2 * p)) := by
    unfold finiteMomentBarrier
    fun_prop
  have hDcont : ContinuousOn D (Icc (n : ℝ) (n + 1)) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · apply ContinuousOn.mul continuousOn_const
      apply ContinuousOn.pow
      unfold finiteMomentBarrier
      fun_prop
    · apply ContinuousOn.div continuousOn_const
      · fun_prop
      · intro t ht
        exact (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos t (le_trans (by positivity) ht.1))).ne'
  have hle : (n : ℝ) ≤ n + 1 := by linarith
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable D volume (n : ℝ) (n + 1) :=
    hDcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hle
  have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hle hcont.continuousOn
    (fun t ht => hd t (le_trans (by positivity) ht.1.le)) hint
  have hcmp (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (n : ℝ) (n + 1)) :
      finiteMomentUpdate ν R u p ≤ D t := by
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := le_trans (by positivity) ht.1
    have hboundt (i : ℕ) (hiq : i ≤ q) :
        u i ≤ finiteMomentBarrier q ν R t ^ (2 * i) := by
      apply (hbound i hiq).trans
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀
      · exact le_trans (by positivity) (hbar n (by positivity)).le
      · exact finiteMomentBarrier_mono hν.le ht.1
    convert finiteMomentUpdate_le hν.le hR hp hpq (hbar t ht0) hu hboundt using 1
    simp only [D, finiteMomentBarrier, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hle
    (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => finiteMomentUpdate ν R u p)
      volume (n : ℝ) (n + 1)) hint hcmp
  rw [hftc] at hmono
  simpa using hmono

name: NLAlib.le_finiteMomentBarrier_pow
statement:
theorem le_finiteMomentBarrier_pow {ν R : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {M : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hM : ∀ n p, 0 ≤ M n p) (hzero : ∀ n, M n 0 = 1)
    (hinit : ∀ p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q → M 0 p = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ n p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q →
      M (n + 1) p ≤ M n p + finiteMomentUpdate ν R (M n) p) :
    ∀ n p, p ≤ q → M n p ≤ finiteMomentBarrier q ν R n ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro p hp
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · simp [hp0, hzero]
    · rw [hinit p (by omega) hp]
      exact pow_nonneg (by unfold finiteMomentBarrier; positivity) _
  | succ n ih =>
    intro p hp
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · simp [hp0, hzero]
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
    have hdiff := finiteMomentUpdate_le_barrier_sub hν hR hp1 hp (hM n) ih
    have hrec := hstep n p hp1 hp
    have hind := ih p hp
    push_cast at hdiff ⊢
    linarith

name: NLAlib.finiteMomentBarrier_le_sqrt_add_mul
statement:
theorem finiteMomentBarrier_le_sqrt_add_mul {ν R : ℝ} {q m : ℕ}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    finiteMomentBarrier q ν R m ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * ν * m) + 2 * (q : ℝ) * R
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteMomentBarrier
  apply add_le_add _ le_rfl
  apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)).2
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmul := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * ν by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr hmR)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.le_sqrt_add_mul_pow_of_finiteMomentUpdate
statement:
theorem le_sqrt_add_mul_pow_of_finiteMomentUpdate {ν R : ℝ} {q m : ℕ}
    {M : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hM : ∀ n p, 0 ≤ M n p) (hzero : ∀ n, M n 0 = 1)
    (hinit : ∀ p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q → M 0 p = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ n p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q →
      M (n + 1) p ≤ M n p + finiteMomentUpdate ν R (M n) p) :
    M m q ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * ν * m) + 2 * (q : ℝ) * R) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_finiteMomentBarrier_pow hν hR hq hM hzero hinit hstep m q le_rfl).trans
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀
  · unfold finiteMomentBarrier
    positivity
  · exact finiteMomentBarrier_le_sqrt_add_mul hν.le hm

name: NLAlib.sub_le_of_continuous_of_subseq_difference_quotient_le
statement:
theorem sub_le_of_continuous_of_subseq_difference_quotient_le
    (F : ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc 0 1)) (L : ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ c ≤ L, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      Tendsto (fun ν => (F (t + (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2)) - F t) /
        ((1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2))) atTop (𝓝 c)) :
    F 1 - F 0 ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  let ε := (F 1 - F 0 - L) / 2
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
  have hgap : L + ε < F 1 - F 0 := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => F t - (L + ε) * t
  have hG : ContinuousOn G (Set.Icc 0 1) := hF.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hmin⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)) hG
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
  have ht1 : t < 1 := by
    have hmin0 := hmin (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
    change G t ≤ G 0 at hmin0
    have hne : t ≠ 1 := by
      intro heq
      simp only [heq, G, mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_one] at hmin0
      linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 hne
  obtain ⟨c, hc, φ, _, hlim⟩ := hv t ⟨ht.1, ht1⟩
  have hquot (ν : ℕ) : L + ε ≤
      (F (t + (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2)) - F t) / ((1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2)) := by
    have hden : 0 < (φ ν : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
    have hstep : 0 < (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2) := div_pos (by linarith) hden
    have hstepBound : (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 - t := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr
      nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (φ ν : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg _]
    have hminStep := hmin (show t + (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 by
      constructor <;> linarith)
    change G t ≤ G (t + (1 - t) / ((φ ν : ℝ) + 2)) at hminStep
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hstep).mpr
    dsimp [G] at hminStep
    nlinarith
  have hLc : L + ε ≤ c := ge_of_tendsto hlim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hquot)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sin_odd_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sin_odd_eq (φ : ℝ) (hφ : Real.sin φ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ)) =
      Real.sin ((n : ℝ) * φ) ^ 2 / Real.sin φ
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 * Real.sin φ * Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) =
      Real.cos ((2 * j : ℕ) * φ) - Real.cos ((2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) * φ) := by
    intro j
    have hm : ((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ = (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) - φ := by push_cast; ring
    have hp : ((2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ = (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) + φ := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hm, hp, Real.cos_sub, Real.cos_add]
    ring
  have hsum : 2 * Real.sin φ * (∑ j ∈ range n, Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ)) =
      2 * Real.sin ((n : ℝ) * φ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [sum_range_sub']
    rw [show ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ = 2 * ((n : ℝ) * φ) by push_cast; ring,
      Real.cos_two_mul_eq_one_sub]
    simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.cos_zero]
    ring
  apply (eq_div_iff hφ).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_sin_odd_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_sin_odd_le (φ : ℝ) (hφ : Real.sin φ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ j ∈ range n, Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ)‖ ≤ 1 / |Real.sin φ|
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sum_sin_odd_eq φ hφ, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.sin_sq_le_one _) (abs_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.tendsto_one_div_odd_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_one_div_odd_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => 1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun j => by positivity))
    _ (show Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) from tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with j hj
  have hjR : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < j by omega)
  simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hjR
    (show (j : ℝ) ≤ 2 * j + 1 by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) j])

name: NLAlib.exists_tendsto_sum_sin_odd_div
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_sum_sin_odd_div (φ : ℝ) (hφ : Real.sin φ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun n => ∑ j ∈ range n,
      Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 L)
proof:
:= by
  have hanti : Antitone (fun j : ℕ => 1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * i + 1 ≤ 2 * j + 1 by omega))
  have hC := hanti.cauchySeq_series_mul_of_tendsto_zero_of_bounded tendsto_one_div_odd_atTop
    (norm_sum_sin_odd_le φ hφ)
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hC
  refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, one_div, mul_comm _ (Real.sin _), ← div_eq_mul_inv] using hL

name: NLAlib.hasSum_pow_mul_sin_odd_div
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_mul_sin_odd_div (φ r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ => r ^ (2 * j + 1) * Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) /
      (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) (-(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re)
proof:
:= by
  let w : ℂ := Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hw : ‖w‖ = 1 := by dsimp [w]; simp [Complex.norm_exp]
  have hz : ‖Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg hr0, hw]
    simpa using hr1
  have hs := Complex.reCLM.hasSum (Complex.hasSum_arctan hz)
  have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ,
      (((-1 : ℂ) ^ j * (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w) ^ (2 * j + 1) /
        ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)).re) =
          -(r ^ (2 * j + 1) * Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    intro j
    have hi : (-1 : ℂ) ^ j * Complex.I ^ (2 * j + 1) = Complex.I := by
      rw [pow_add, pow_mul, Complex.I_sq]
      simp only [pow_one]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
      norm_num
    have heq : (-1 : ℂ) ^ j * (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w) ^ (2 * j + 1) =
        Complex.I * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * j + 1) * w ^ (2 * j + 1) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]
      calc _ = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ j * Complex.I ^ (2 * j + 1)) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * j + 1) * w ^ (2 * j + 1) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hi]
    rw [heq]
    have him : (w ^ (2 * j + 1)).im = Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) := by
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
      have he : ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          ((((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [he, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
    rw [show ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((2 * (j : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; rfl,
      ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.div_ofReal_re]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, him, zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add,
      sub_zero, zero_sub, one_mul]
    ring
  change HasSum (fun j : ℕ =>
    (((-1 : ℂ) ^ j * (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w) ^ (2 * j + 1) /
      ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)).re)) (Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w)).re at hs
  simp_rw [hterm] at hs
  simpa only [neg_neg] using hs.neg

name: NLAlib.re_im_unit_circle_cayley
statement:
theorem re_im_unit_circle_cayley {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hi : w.im ≠ 0) :
    ((1 - w) / (1 + w)).re = 0 ∧
      ((1 - w) / (1 + w)).im = -2 * w.im / Complex.normSq (1 + w) ∧
      0 < Complex.normSq (1 + w)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (1 : ℂ) + w ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have him := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.zero_im, zero_add] at him
    exact hi him
  have hn : Complex.normSq w = 1 := by rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hw]; norm_num
  have hsq : w.re ^ 2 + w.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Complex.normSq_apply, ← pow_two] using hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hne⟩
  · rw [Complex.div_re]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.add_im, Complex.one_im, zero_sub, zero_add]
    rw [← add_div, show (1 - w.re) * (1 + w.re) + -w.im * w.im = 0 by nlinarith [hsq], zero_div]
  · rw [Complex.div_im]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.add_im, Complex.one_im, zero_sub, zero_add]
    rw [← sub_div]
    congr 1
    ring

name: NLAlib.neg_re_arctan_I_mul_eq_sign
statement:
theorem neg_re_arctan_I_mul_eq_sign {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hi : w.im ≠ 0) :
    -(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * w)).re = Real.pi / 4 * Real.sign w.im
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℂ := (1 - w) / (1 + w)
  obtain ⟨hqr, hqi, hd⟩ := re_im_unit_circle_cayley hw hi
  have hI : Complex.I * w * Complex.I = -w := by
    calc Complex.I * w * Complex.I = w * (Complex.I * Complex.I) := by ring
      _ = -w := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; simp
  have harctan : (Complex.arctan (Complex.I * w)).re = q.arg / 2 := by
    rw [Complex.arctan, hI, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]
    change (-Complex.I / 2 * Complex.log q).re = q.arg / 2
    norm_num [Complex.mul_re]
    rw [Complex.log_im]
    ring
  rw [harctan]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hi with hneg | hpos
  · have hqpos : 0 < q.im := by
      change 0 < ((1 - w) / (1 + w)).im
      rw [hqi]
      exact div_pos (by linarith) hd
    rw [Complex.arg_eq_pi_div_two_iff.mpr ⟨hqr, hqpos⟩, Real.sign_of_neg hneg]
    ring
  · have hqneg : q.im < 0 := by
      change ((1 - w) / (1 + w)).im < 0
      rw [hqi]
      exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hd
    rw [Complex.arg_eq_neg_pi_div_two_iff.mpr ⟨hqr, hqneg⟩, Real.sign_of_pos hpos]
    ring

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_neg_re_arctan_I_mul
statement:
theorem continuousAt_neg_re_arctan_I_mul {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hi : w.im ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun r : ℝ => -(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w)).re) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hqr, hqi, hd⟩ := re_im_unit_circle_cayley hw hi
  have hqne : ((1 - w) / (1 + w)).im ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hqi]
    exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hi) hd.ne'
  have hI : Complex.I * w * Complex.I = -w := by
    calc Complex.I * w * Complex.I = w * (Complex.I * Complex.I) := by ring
      _ = -w := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; simp
  have hden : (1 : ℂ) - Complex.I * (1 : ℂ) * w * Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [mul_one, hI, sub_neg_eq_add]
    intro h
    have him := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.zero_im, zero_add] at him
    exact hi him
  have hq : ((1 + Complex.I * (1 : ℂ) * w * Complex.I) /
      (1 - Complex.I * (1 : ℂ) * w * Complex.I)) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    simp only [mul_one, hI, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr hqne)
  have hquot : ContinuousAt (fun r : ℝ =>
      (1 + Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w * Complex.I) /
        (1 - Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w * Complex.I)) 1 :=
    (by fun_prop : ContinuousAt (fun r : ℝ => 1 + Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w * Complex.I) 1).div
      (by fun_prop) hden
  have hlog := hquot.clog hq
  have harctan := hlog.const_mul (-Complex.I / 2)
  exact (Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp harctan).neg

name: NLAlib.tendsto_sum_sin_odd_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_sin_odd_div (φ : ℝ) (hφ : Real.sin φ ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ j ∈ range n,
      Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.pi / 4 * Real.sign (Real.sin φ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_tendsto_sum_sin_odd_div φ hφ
  let w : ℂ := Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hw : ‖w‖ = 1 := by dsimp [w]; simp [Complex.norm_exp]
  have him : w.im = Real.sin φ := Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im φ
  have hine : w.im ≠ 0 := by rwa [him]
  let l : Filter ℝ := 𝓝[Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1] 1
  have hradial : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2) l (𝓝[<] 1) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within
    · have ht : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2) (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) := by
        have hc : ContinuousAt (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2) (1 : ℝ) := by fun_prop
        simpa only [one_pow] using hc.tendsto
      exact ht.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
      change r ^ 2 < 1
      nlinarith [hr.1, hr.2]
  have hAbel := (Real.tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt hL).comp hradial
  have hid : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r) l (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) := tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hmul := hid.mul hAbel
  simp only [one_mul] at hmul
  have hF : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => -(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w)).re) l (𝓝 L) := by
    apply hmul.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    have hs := hasSum_pow_mul_sin_odd_div φ r hr.1.le hr.2
    change r * (∑' j : ℕ, Real.sin (((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * φ) /
      (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * (r ^ 2) ^ j) = _
    rw [← hs.tsum_eq, ← tsum_mul_left]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
    ring
  have hcont : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => -(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * w)).re) l
      (𝓝 (-(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (1 : ℂ) * w)).re)) :=
    (continuousAt_neg_re_arctan_I_mul hw hine).tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hvalue : -(Complex.arctan (Complex.I * (1 : ℂ) * w)).re =
      Real.pi / 4 * Real.sign (Real.sin φ) := by
    simpa only [mul_one, him] using neg_re_arctan_I_mul_eq_sign hw hine
  rw [hvalue] at hcont
  let : NeBot l := by
    dsimp [l]
    exact right_nhdsWithin_Ioo_neBot (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hF hcont
  rw [heq] at hL
  exact hL

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_simultaneous_upper_triangular_with_charpoly
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_simultaneous_upper_triangular_with_charpoly
    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (k : ℕ) (T : ι → Module.End ℂ E)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (T i) (T j)) (hk : finrank ℂ E = k)
    (a₀ : ι) (d : Fin k → ℂ) (hchar : (T a₀).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℂ E,
      (∀ a i j, j < i → inner ℂ (b i) (T a (b j)) = 0) ∧
      ∀ i, inner ℂ (b i) (T a₀ (b i)) = d i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing E with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨(stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ E).reindex (finCongr hk),
      fun _ i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    have hμ : (T a₀).HasEigenvalue (d 0) := by
      apply (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_isRoot_charpoly _ _).mpr
      rw [hchar]
      simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (k + 1)))
      simp
    obtain ⟨x, χ, hx, hTx, hT₀x⟩ := exists_common_eigenvector_with_eigenvalue T hcomm a₀ (d 0) hμ
    have hxnorm : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
    let u : E := (‖x‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • x
    have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      simp only [u, norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg hxnorm.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxnorm.ne']
    have hune : u ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hu
    have hTu (a : ι) : T a u = χ a • u := by
      simp only [u, map_smul, hTx, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    have hT₀u : T a₀ u = d 0 • u := by
      simp only [u, map_smul, hT₀x, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    let W : Submodule ℂ E := (ℂ ∙ u)ᗮ
    have hWdim : finrank ℂ W = k := by
      have h := (ℂ ∙ u).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
      rw [finrank_span_singleton hune, hk] at h
      dsimp [W]; omega
    have hpres (a : ι) : Set.MapsTo (T a) Wᗮ Wᗮ := by
      dsimp [W]
      rw [Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal]
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
      rw [map_smul, hTu, smul_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self u)
    let S (a : ι) : Module.End ℂ W :=
      W.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp ((T a).comp W.subtype)
    have hScomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (S a) (S b) := by
      intro a b hab
      exact commute_orthogonal_compressions_of_invariant W (T a) (T b) (hpres a) (hpres b) (hcomm hab)
    have hfactor : (T a₀).charpoly = (X - C (d 0)) * (S a₀).charpoly :=
      charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_orthogonal_compression (T a₀) hu hT₀u hk
    have hSchar : (S a₀).charpoly = ∏ i : Fin k, (X - C (d i.succ)) := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (d 0))
      rw [← hfactor, hchar, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    obtain ⟨bW, htriW, hdiagW⟩ := ih S hScomm hWdim (fun i => d i.succ) hSchar
    obtain ⟨b, hb₀, hbS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hk u hu bW
    refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a i j hij
      revert hij
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · intro hij
        rw [hb₀, hTu, inner_smul_right]
        have hiu : inner ℂ (b i) u = 0 := by
          rw [← hb₀]
          exact b.orthonormal.inner_eq_zero (ne_of_gt hij)
        rw [hiu, mul_zero]
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
        · intro hij; exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _)) hij |>.elim
        · intro hij
          rw [hbS, hbS]
          simpa only [S, LinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
            Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left] using
              htriW a i j (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)
    · intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · rw [hb₀, hT₀u, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hu]
        simp
      · rw [hbS]
        simpa only [S, LinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
          Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left] using hdiagW i

name: NLAlib.mixed_pow_add_mixed_pow_le
statement:
theorem mixed_pow_add_mixed_pow_le {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    {m l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ m) :
    x ^ l * y ^ (m - l) + x ^ (m - l) * y ^ l ≤ x ^ m + y ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hpowx : x ^ l * x ^ (m - l) = x ^ m := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hl]
  have hpowy : y ^ l * y ^ (m - l) = y ^ m := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hl]
  rcases le_total y x with hxy | hxy
  · have h1 : 0 ≤ x ^ l - y ^ l := sub_nonneg.mpr (pow_le_pow_left₀ hy hxy l)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ x ^ (m - l) - y ^ (m - l) :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (pow_le_pow_left₀ hy hxy _)
    have h := mul_nonneg h1 h2
    nlinarith [hpowx, hpowy]
  · have h1 : 0 ≤ y ^ l - x ^ l := sub_nonneg.mpr (pow_le_pow_left₀ hx hxy l)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ y ^ (m - l) - x ^ (m - l) :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (pow_le_pow_left₀ hx hxy _)
    have h := mul_nonneg h1 h2
    nlinarith [hpowx, hpowy]

name: NLAlib.nat_mul_mul_pow_le_pow_add
statement:
theorem nat_mul_mul_pow_le_pow_add {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (p : ℝ) * x * y ^ (p - 1) ≤ x ^ p + (p - 1 : ℕ) * y ^ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · subst y
    by_cases hp1 : p = 1
    · subst p; simp
    · have hpos : 0 < p - 1 := by omega
      simp only [zero_pow hpos.ne', mul_zero]
      positivity
  have hyp : 0 < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hy (Ne.symm hy0)
  have hratio : -1 ≤ x / y - 1 := by linarith [div_nonneg hx hy]
  have hbern := one_add_mul_self_le_rpow_one_add hratio
    (p := (p : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hp)
  rw [add_sub_cancel, Real.rpow_natCast] at hbern
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbern (pow_nonneg hy p)
  have hquot : (x / y) ^ p * y ^ p = x ^ p := by rw [div_pow]; field_simp
  have hprev : y ^ (p - 1) * y = y ^ p := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hp]
  rw [hquot] at h
  have hcast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) - 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using (Nat.cast_sub (R := ℝ) hp)
  rw [hcast]
  have hleft : (1 + (p : ℝ) * (x / y - 1)) * y ^ p =
      y ^ p + (p : ℝ) * x * y ^ (p - 1) - (p : ℝ) * y ^ p := by
    rw [← hprev]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hleft] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_sub_pow_le_of_even
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sub_pow_le_of_even {m : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (a b : ℝ) :
    (a - b) * (a ^ (m + 1) - b ^ (m + 1)) ≤
      ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * (a - b) ^ 2 * (a ^ m + b ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  let T := ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |a| ^ l * |b| ^ (m - l)
  have hrefl : (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |a| ^ (m - l) * |b| ^ l) = T := by
    calc _ = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        |a| ^ (m - l) * |b| ^ (m - (m - l)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l hl => ?_
          rw [Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl))]
      _ = T := by
        simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
          Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun l => |a| ^ l * |b| ^ (m - l)) (m + 1)
  have hpair := Finset.sum_le_sum fun l (hl : l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1)) =>
    mixed_pow_add_mixed_pow_le (abs_nonneg a) (abs_nonneg b)
      (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl))
  have hT : T ≤ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * (a ^ m + b ^ m) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hrefl, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, hm.pow_abs] at hpair
    change T + T ≤ _ at hpair
    linarith
  have hsum : (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a ^ l * b ^ (m - l)) ≤ T := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro l _
    simpa only [abs_mul, abs_pow] using le_abs_self (a ^ l * b ^ (m - l))
  have hgeom := (Commute.all a b).mul_geom_sum₂ (m + 1)
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hgeom
  calc (a - b) * (a ^ (m + 1) - b ^ (m + 1)) =
        (a - b) ^ 2 * (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a ^ l * b ^ (m - l)) := by
          rw [← hgeom]; ring
    _ ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * (a ^ m + b ^ m)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.rpow_le_sqrt_mul_rpow_of_nat_pow_le
statement:
theorem rpow_le_sqrt_mul_rpow_of_nat_pow_le
    {M V q : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hbound : M ≤ q ^ p * V) :
    M ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) ≤ Real.sqrt q * V ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hp)
  have hr : (p : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow hM hbound (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)))
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (pow_nonneg hq p) hV, ← Real.rpow_natCast,
    ← Real.rpow_mul hq, hr, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_norm_sq
statement:
theorem norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_norm_sq {α E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    (s : Finset α) (z : α → E) :
    ‖∑ a ∈ s, z a‖ ^ 2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ a ∈ s, ‖z a‖ ^ 2

statement:

    MeasurePreserving cos (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) π)) measureT

  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
