name: NLAlib.exists_inverse_of_isProperMap_of_hasStrictFDerivAt
statement:
theorem exists_inverse_of_isProperMap_of_hasStrictFDerivAt
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {U : Set E} [Nonempty U] [PreconnectedSpace U] (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f : E → E} {D : E → E ≃L[ℝ] E}
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ U, HasStrictFDerivAt f (D x : E →L[ℝ] E) x)
    (hproper : IsProperMap (fun x : U => f x)) :
    ∃ g : E → E, Continuous g ∧ (∀ y, g y ∈ U) ∧
      (∀ y, f (g y) = y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ U, g (f x) = x) ∧
      ∀ y, HasStrictFDerivAt g ((D (g y)).symm : E →L[ℝ] E) y
proof:
:= by
  have hOn : IsLocalHomeomorphOn f U := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨(hf x hx).toOpenPartialHomeomorph f,
      (hf x hx).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source,
      (hf x hx).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe.symm⟩
  have hlocal : IsLocalHomeomorph (fun x : U => f x) := by
    apply isLocalHomeomorph_iff_isLocalHomeomorphOn_univ.mpr
    exact hOn.comp hU.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isLocalHomeomorph.isLocalHomeomorphOn
      (fun x _ => x.property)
  have hb := bijective_of_isProperMap_of_isLocalHomeomorph hproper hlocal
  let e : U ≃ₜ E := hlocal.toHomeomorphOfBijective hb
  let g : E → E := fun y => (e.symm y : E)
  have hgU (y : E) : g y ∈ U := (e.symm y).property
  have hright (y : E) : f (g y) = y := e.apply_symm_apply y
  have hleft (x : E) (hx : x ∈ U) : g (f x) = x := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.symm_apply_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)
  refine ⟨g, continuous_subtype_val.comp e.symm.continuous, hgU, hright, hleft, ?_⟩
  intro y
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (g y), g (f x) = x := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds (hgU y)] with x hx
    exact hleft x hx
  have hd := (hf (g y) (hgU y)).to_local_left_inverse hevent
  rwa [hright y] at hd

name: Real.gaussian_resolvent_moment_fluctuations_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_resolvent_moment_fluctuations_le {σ p : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (η : ℝ) :
    sqrt (4*(σ^2*(η⁻¹)^4)*p)+sqrt (σ^2*(η⁻¹)^4)*sqrt (2*p) ≤
      4*σ*sqrt p/η^2
proof:
:= by
  let c := σ^2*(η⁻¹)^4
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by positivity
  have hs : sqrt c = σ/η^2 := by
    rw [show c = (σ*(η⁻¹)^2)^2 by dsimp [c]; ring, sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  have ha : sqrt (4*c*p) = 2*sqrt c*sqrt p := by
    have he : (2*sqrt c*sqrt p)^2 = 4*c*p := by
      rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,sq_sqrt hc,sq_sqrt hp]
      ring
    rw [← he,sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  have hb : sqrt (2*p) ≤ 2*sqrt p :=
    sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [sq_sqrt hp]⟩
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sqrt_nonneg c)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*sqrt c*sqrt p+sqrt c*(2*sqrt p) := by rw [ha]; exact add_le_add le_rfl hh
    _ = _ := by rw [hs]; ring

name: Real.mixed_resolvent_scale_le_sq
statement:
theorem mixed_resolvent_scale_le_sq {R σ p δ : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hRp : R*p ≤ δ) (hcube : R*σ^2*p^2 ≤ δ^3) :
    R*σ*p*sqrt p ≤ δ^2
proof:
:= by
  have hm := mul_le_mul hcube hRp (mul_nonneg hR hp) (pow_nonneg hδ 3)
  have hs : (R*σ*p*sqrt p)^2 ≤ (δ^2)^2 := by
    calc
      _ = (R*σ^2*p^2)*(R*p) := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_sqrt hp]
        ring
      _ ≤ δ^3*δ := hm
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (sq_nonneg δ)).mp hs

name: Real.resolvent_variance_and_gamma_scale_le
statement:
theorem resolvent_variance_and_gamma_scale_le
    {R E Q v ℓ p δ η : ℝ} (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hη : 0 < η) (hδη : δ ≤ η)
    (hvp : v*p ≤ δ^2) (hRE : R*E*p ≤ 3*δ^2)
    (hRQ : R^2*Q*p ≤ δ^4) (hRℓ : R^4*ℓ*p ≤ δ^4)
    (hRp : R^2*p^2 ≤ δ^2) (hR4p : R^4*p^2 ≤ δ^4) :
    let B
proof:
:= (2/η^4)*(8*v+64*R*E)+(32*R^2/η^6)*((exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*ℓ)
    let c := sqrt (6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6))
    B*p ≤ 500*(δ/η^2)^2 ∧ c*p ≤ 22*(δ/η^2) := by
  let T := δ/η^2
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by dsimp [T]; positivity
  have hdiv : δ^4/η^6 ≤ δ^2/η^4 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hη 6) (pow_pos hη 4)]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((sq_le_sq₀ hδ hη.le).mpr hδη) (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg δ) (pow_nonneg hη.le 4))
    calc
      _ = (δ^2*η^4)*δ^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (δ^2*η^4)*η^2 := hm
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hTtwo : δ^2/η^4 = T^2 := by dsimp [T]; ring
  have hfirst : (2/η^4)*(8*v+64*R*E)*p ≤ 400*δ^2/η^4 := by
    have hn : 2*(8*v+64*R*E)*p ≤ 400*δ^2 := by
      linear_combination 16*hvp+128*hRE
    calc
      _ = (2*(8*v+64*R*E)*p)/η^4 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hn (pow_nonneg hη.le 4)
  have hRQnonneg : 0 ≤ R^2*Q*p := by positivity
  have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (sub_le_sub_right exp_one_lt_three.le 1) hRQnonneg
  have hsecond : (32*R^2/η^6)*((exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*ℓ)*p ≤ 96*δ^4/η^6 := by
    have hn : 32*R^2*((exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*ℓ)*p ≤ 96*δ^4 := by
      linear_combination 32*he+64*hRQ+32*hRℓ
    calc
      _ = (32*R^2*((exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*ℓ)*p)/η^6 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hn (pow_nonneg hη.le 6)
  have hB : ((2/η^4)*(8*v+64*R*E)+(32*R^2/η^6)*((exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*ℓ))*p ≤
      500*T^2 := by
    have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 96)
    rw [hTtwo] at hd
    have hf : 400*δ^2/η^4 = 400*T^2 := by rw [mul_div_assoc, hTtwo]
    have hs : 96*δ^4/η^6 = 96*(δ^4/η^6) := by ring
    rw [hf] at hfirst
    rw [hs] at hsecond
    nlinarith only [hfirst, hsecond, hd, sq_nonneg T]
  have hκ : 0 ≤ 6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6) := by positivity
  have hc_sq : (sqrt (6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6))*p)^2 =
      96*(R^2*p^2/η^4)+384*(R^4*p^2/η^6) := by
    rw [mul_pow, sq_sqrt hκ]
    ring
  have hcp_sq : (sqrt (6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6))*p)^2 ≤ 480*T^2 := by
    have h1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hRp (pow_nonneg hη.le 4)
    have h2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hR4p (pow_nonneg hη.le 6)
    have h3 := h2.trans hdiv
    rw [hTtwo] at h1 h3
    rw [hc_sq]
    nlinarith only [h1,h3]
  refine ⟨hB, ?_⟩
  have hleft : 0 ≤ sqrt (6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6))*p := by positivity
  have hright : 0 ≤ 22*T := by positivity
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ hleft hright).mp
  nlinarith only [hcp_sq, sq_nonneg T]

name: Real.resolvent_variance_scale_le_of_source_parameters
statement:
theorem resolvent_variance_scale_le_of_source_parameters
    {R σ s E Q ℓ p δ η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hη : 0 < η) (hδη : δ ≤ η)
    (hE : E ≤ 2*σ*sqrt p+R*p) (hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q) (hQ : Q ≤ σ^2) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ p)
    (hsp : s*sqrt p ≤ δ) (hRp : R*p ≤ δ) (hcube : R*σ^2*p^2 ≤ δ^3) :
    let B
proof:
:= (2/η^4)*(8*s^2+64*R*E)+(32*R^2/η^6)*((exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*ℓ)
    let c := sqrt (6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6))
    B*p ≤ 500*(δ/η^2)^2 ∧ c*p ≤ 22*(δ/η^2) := by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by linarith
  have hp2 : 1 ≤ p^2 := by nlinarith
  have hsp2 : s^2*p ≤ δ^2 := by
    have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ s*sqrt p) hsp 2
    simpa only [mul_pow, sq_sqrt hp0] using hh
  have hRp2 : R^2*p^2 ≤ δ^2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hR hp0) hRp 2
  have hmixed := mixed_resolvent_scale_le_sq hR hσ hp0 hδ hRp hcube
  have hRE : R*E*p ≤ 3*δ^2 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (mul_nonneg hR hp0)
    nlinarith only [hh,hmixed,hRp2]
  have hRQ : R^2*Q*p ≤ δ^4 := by
    have hvar := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ
      (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg R) hp0)
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg R) (sq_nonneg σ)) hp0)
    have hmsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ R*σ*p*sqrt p) hmixed 2
    calc
      _ ≤ R^2*σ^2*p := by nlinarith only [hvar]
      _ ≤ R^2*σ^2*p*p^2 := by simpa only [mul_one] using hstep
      _ = (R*σ*p*sqrt p)^2 := by
        rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,mul_pow,sq_sqrt hp0]
        ring
      _ ≤ (δ^2)^2 := hmsq
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hR4p : R^4*p^2 ≤ δ^4 := by
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2 (sq_nonneg p)
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (pow_nonneg hR 4)
    have hfour := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hR hp0) hRp 4
    calc
      _ ≤ R^4*(p^2*p^2) := by simpa only [mul_one] using hmul
      _ = (R*p)^4 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := hfour
  have hRℓ : R^4*ℓ*p ≤ δ^4 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR 4) hp0)
    have hle : R^4*ℓ*p ≤ R^4*p^2 := by nlinarith only [hh]
    exact hle.trans hR4p
  exact resolvent_variance_and_gamma_scale_le hQ0 hp0 hδ hη hδη
    hsp2 hRE hRQ hRℓ hRp2 hR4p

name: Real.resolvent_grid_error_le_of_source_moment_budgets
statement:
theorem resolvent_grid_error_le_of_source_moment_budgets
    {B c p V δ η ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hη : 0 < η) (hε : ε ≤ δ)
    (hB : B*p ≤ 500*(δ/η^2)^2) (hc : c*p ≤ 22*(δ/η^2))
    (hV : V ≤ 8192*(δ/η^2)) :
    9*(4*sqrt (12*B*p)+8*c*p+sqrt (24*B*p)+c*p+V)+10*ε/η^2 ≤
      80000*δ/η^2
proof:
:= by
  let T := δ/η^2
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by dsimp [T]; positivity
  have h12 : sqrt (12*B*p) ≤ 80*T := by
    apply sqrt_le_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    nlinarith only [hB, sq_nonneg T]
  have h24 : sqrt (24*B*p) ≤ 110*T := by
    apply sqrt_le_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    nlinarith only [hB, sq_nonneg T]
  have hmesh : ε/η^2 ≤ T := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hε (sq_nonneg η)
  have htarget : 80000*δ/η^2 = 80000*T := by dsimp [T]; ring
  change c*p ≤ 22*T at hc
  change V ≤ 8192*T at hV
  have hmesh10 : 10*ε/η^2 ≤ 10*T := by
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmesh
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 10)
  rw [htarget]
  linear_combination 36*h12+9*h24+81*hc+9*hV+hmesh10+610*hT

name: Real.resolvent_comparison_remainder_le_of_source_parameters
statement:
theorem resolvent_comparison_remainder_le_of_source_parameters
    {R σ Q p δ η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hη : 0 < η) (hδη : δ ≤ η) (hQ : Q ≤ σ^2)
    (hRp : R*p ≤ δ) (hcube : R*σ^2*p^2 ≤ δ^3) :
    4096*(p^2*R*Q+p^3*R^3)/η^4 ≤ 8192*δ/η^2
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : p^2*R*Q ≤ δ^3 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg p) hR)
    nlinarith only [hh,hcube]
  have hsecond : p^3*R^3 ≤ δ^3 := by
    have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hR hp) hRp 3
    simpa only [mul_pow,mul_comm] using hh
  have hdiv : δ^3/η^4 ≤ δ/η^2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hη 4) (pow_pos hη 2)]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((sq_le_sq₀ hδ hη.le).mpr hδη) (mul_nonneg hδ (sq_nonneg η))
    calc
      _ = (δ*η^2)*δ^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (δ*η^2)*η^2 := hh
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hn : 4096*(p^2*R*Q+p^3*R^3) ≤ 8192*δ^3 := by
    linear_combination 4096*hfirst+4096*hsecond
  calc
    _ ≤ 8192*δ^3/η^4 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hn (pow_nonneg hη.le 4)
    _ = 8192*(δ^3/η^4) := by ring
    _ ≤ 8192*(δ/η^2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Real.resolvent_grid_error_le_inv_two_height
statement:
theorem resolvent_grid_error_le_inv_two_height
    {δ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hheight : 160000*δ ≤ η) :
    80000*δ/η^2 ≤ (2*η)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hη 2) (by positivity : 0 < 2*η)]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hheight hη.le
  nlinarith only [hh]

name: NLAlib.summable_of_dyadic_block_sum_le_geometric
statement:
theorem summable_of_dyadic_block_sum_le_geometric {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k)
    {C q : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hblock : ∀ j, ∑ k ∈ Ico (2 ^ j) (2 ^ (j + 1)), a k ≤ C * q ^ j) :
    Summable a
proof:
:= by
  have hgeom : Summable (fun j : ℕ => q ^ j) :=
    summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hq0])
  have hfinite : ∀ J, ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ J), a k ≤ a 0 + C * ∑ j ∈ range J, q ^ j := by
    intro J
    induction J with
    | zero => simp
    | succ J ih =>
      rw [← sum_range_add_sum_Ico a (show 2 ^ J ≤ 2 ^ (J + 1) by
        rw [pow_succ]; omega), sum_range_succ]
      have h := add_le_add ih (hblock J)
      calc _ ≤ (a 0 + C * ∑ j ∈ range J, q ^ j) + C * q ^ J := h
        _ = a 0 + C * ((∑ j ∈ range J, q ^ j) + q ^ J) := by ring
  apply summable_of_sum_range_le ha (c := a 0 + C * ∑' j : ℕ, q ^ j)
  intro m
  have hm := sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (range_mono (show m ≤ 2 ^ m from (show m < 2 ^ m from Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le))
    (fun k hk hnot => ha k)
  exact hm.trans ((hfinite m).trans (add_le_add (le_refl (a 0))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgeom.sum_le_tsum (range m) (fun j hj => pow_nonneg hq0 j)) hC)))

name: ConcaveOn.div_mul_le_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem div_mul_le_of_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f)
    (hf0 : 0 ≤ f 0) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) :
    (b / a) * f a ≤ f b
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ b / a := div_nonneg hb ha.le
  have ht1 : b / a ≤ 1 := (div_le_one ha).mpr hba
  have heq : (b / a) • a + (1 - b / a) • (0 : ℝ) = b := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, div_mul_cancel₀ _ ha.ne']
  have h := hf.2 ha.le (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 0 by norm_num) ht0
    (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) (by ring : b / a + (1 - b / a) = 1)
  rw [heq] at h
  change (b / a) * f a + (1 - b / a) * f 0 ≤ f b at h
  have hz := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) hf0
  linarith

name: ConcaveOn.div_le_div_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem div_le_div_of_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f)
    (hf0 : 0 ≤ f 0) {t a : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hta : t ≤ a) :
    f a / a ≤ f t / t
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := ht.trans_le hta
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ ha ht).mpr
  calc
    f a * t = a * ((t / a) * f a) := by field_simp [ha.ne']
    _ ≤ a * f t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (hf.div_mul_le_of_nonneg hf0 ha ht.le hta) ha.le
    _ = f t * a := mul_comm _ _

name: ConcaveOn.div_rpow_mul_rpow_le
statement:
theorem div_rpow_mul_rpow_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f)
    (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) {a b p : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hba : b ≤ a) (hp : 0 ≤ p) : (f a / a) ^ p * b ^ p ≤ f b ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hb ha.le) (hfn a ha.le))
    (hf.div_mul_le_of_nonneg (hfn 0 le_rfl) ha hb hba) hp
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (div_nonneg hb ha.le) (hfn a ha.le), Real.div_rpow hb ha.le] at h
  rw [Real.div_rpow (hfn a ha.le) ha.le]
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: ConcaveOn.rpow_sub_rpow_le_div_rpow_mul
statement:
theorem rpow_sub_rpow_le_div_rpow_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x)
    {a b p : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    f a ^ p - f b ^ p ≤ (f a / a) ^ p * (a ^ p - b ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := hf.div_rpow_mul_rpow_le hfn ha hb hba hp
  have heq : (f a / a) ^ p * a ^ p = f a ^ p := by
    rw [Real.div_rpow (hfn a ha.le) ha.le,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha p).ne']
  rw [mul_sub, heq]
  linarith

name: ConcaveOn.sum_rpow_sub_prefix_le
statement:
theorem sum_rpow_sub_prefix_le {N k : ℕ} (a b : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : Antitone a) (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hb0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i)
    (hba : ∀ i, b i ≤ a i) (hk : k < N) {p ε : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x)
    (hdeficit : (∑ i, a i ^ p) - (∑ i, if i.val < k then b i ^ p else 0) ≤
      (1 + ε) * (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then a i ^ p else 0)) :
    (∑ i, f (a i) ^ p) - (∑ i, if i.val < k then f (b i) ^ p else 0) ≤
      (1 + ε) * (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) ^ p else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit (g : Fin N → ℝ) : (∑ i, g i) =
      (∑ i, if i.val < k then g i else 0) + (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then g i else 0) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i.val < k
    · simp only [if_pos hi, if_neg (not_le.mpr hi), add_zero]
    · simp only [if_neg hi, if_pos (not_lt.mp hi), zero_add]
  have hheadSub (g h : Fin N → ℝ) :
      (∑ i, if i.val < k then g i - h i else 0) =
        (∑ i, if i.val < k then g i else 0) - (∑ i, if i.val < k then h i else 0) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  let t := a ⟨k, hk⟩
  by_cases ht : 0 < t
  · let c := (f t / t) ^ p
    have hc : 0 ≤ c := Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg (hfn t ht.le) ht.le) _
    have hbudget : (∑ i, if i.val < k then a i ^ p - b i ^ p else 0) ≤
        ε * (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then a i ^ p else 0) := by
      rw [hheadSub]
      rw [hsplit (fun i => a i ^ p)] at hdeficit
      nlinarith
    have hhead : (∑ i, if i.val < k then f (a i) ^ p - f (b i) ^ p else 0) ≤
        c * (∑ i, if i.val < k then a i ^ p - b i ^ p else 0) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : i.val < k
      · rw [if_pos hi, if_pos hi]
        have hta : t ≤ a i := ha (show i ≤ (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin N) from hi.le)
        have hai : 0 < a i := ht.trans_le hta
        have hr : (f (a i) / a i) ^ p ≤ c := Real.rpow_le_rpow
          (div_nonneg (hfn _ (ha0 i)) hai.le)
          (hf.div_le_div_of_nonneg (hfn 0 le_rfl) ht hta) hp.le
        exact (hf.rpow_sub_rpow_le_div_rpow_mul hfn hai (hb0 i) (hba i) hp.le).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr
            (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.rpow_le_rpow (hb0 i) (hba i) hp.le)))
      · simp only [if_neg hi, mul_zero, le_refl]
    have htail : c * (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then a i ^ p else 0) ≤
        ∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) ^ p else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : k ≤ i.val
      · rw [if_pos hi, if_pos hi]
        exact hf.div_rpow_mul_rpow_le hfn ht (ha0 i)
          (ha (show (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin N) ≤ i from hi)) hp.le
      · simp only [if_neg hi, mul_zero, le_refl]
    have hcombined := hhead.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbudget hc)
    have hlast := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hε
    rw [hheadSub] at hcombined
    rw [hsplit (fun i => f (a i) ^ p)]
    nlinarith
  · have ht0 : t = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp ht) (ha0 _)
    have htail0 : (∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then a i ^ p else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : k ≤ i.val
      · have hai : a i = 0 := le_antisymm
          ((ha (show (⟨k, hk⟩ : Fin N) ≤ i from hi)).trans ht0.le) (ha0 i)
        simp only [if_pos hi, hai, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
      · simp only [if_neg hi]
    rw [htail0, mul_zero] at hdeficit
    have hsumB : (∑ i, if i.val < k then b i ^ p else 0) ≤ ∑ i, b i ^ p := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (hb0 i) _
    have hnn (i : Fin N) : 0 ≤ a i ^ p - b i ^ p :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.rpow_le_rpow (hb0 i) (hba i) hp.le)
    have hsum0 : (∑ i, (a i ^ p - b i ^ p)) = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have hnonneg := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (hb0 i) (hba i) hp.le)
      linarith
    have hab (i : Fin N) : a i = b i := by
      have hi := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn i)).mp hsum0 i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      apply le_antisymm _ (hba i)
      exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff (ha0 i) (hb0 i) hp).mp (sub_eq_zero.mp hi).le
    simp_rw [← hab]
    rw [hsplit (fun i => f (a i) ^ p)]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, if k ≤ i.val then f (a i) ^ p else 0 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by split_ifs; exacts [Real.rpow_nonneg (hfn _ (ha0 i)) _, le_rfl]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_cot_sub_one_div_eq_log_sinc
statement:
theorem integral_cot_sub_one_div_eq_log_sinc {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hLπ : L ≤ π / 2) :
    (∫ x in 0..L, Real.cot x - 1 / x) = log (sin L / L)
proof:
:= by
  have hs (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc 0 L) : sinc x ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases hx0 : x = 0
    · simp [hx0]
    · have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hx.1 (Ne.symm hx0)
      rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hx0]
      exact div_ne_zero (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hxpos (by linarith [hx.2, pi_pos])).ne' hx0
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => log (sinc x)) (Icc 0 L) := continuous_sinc.continuousOn.log hs
  have hd (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo 0 L) :
      HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => log (sinc x)) (Real.cot x - 1 / x) x := by
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hx.1.ne'
    have hs0 : sin x ≠ 0 := (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx.1 (by linarith [hx.2, pi_pos])).ne'
    have hdiv := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin x).div (hasDerivAt_id x) hx0
    have h := hdiv.log (by dsimp only [Pi.div_apply, id_eq]; exact div_ne_zero hs0 hx0)
    have hder : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => log (sin x / x)) (Real.cot x - 1 / x) x := by
      apply h.congr_deriv
      rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
      dsimp only [Pi.div_apply, id_eq]
      field_simp
    apply hder.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hx.1] with y hy
    rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hy.ne']
  have hInt := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hL.le hc hd
    ((continuousOn_cot_sub_one_div.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hLπ)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hL.le)
  simpa only [sinc_zero, log_one, sub_zero, sinc_of_ne_zero hL.ne'] using hInt

name: NLAlib.sum_inv_nat_add_half
statement:
theorem sum_inv_nat_add_half (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range m, 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) = 2 * (harmonic (2 * m) : ℝ) - (harmonic m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih, show 2 * (m + 1) = (2 * m + 1) + 1 by omega,
      harmonic_succ, harmonic_succ, harmonic_succ]
    push_cast
    have hm : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hm2 : 2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hm3 : 2 * (m : ℝ) + 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hmh : (m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [hm, hm2, hm3, hmh]
    ring

name: NLAlib.harmonic_add_log_sinc_le_mul_sum_cot_midpoint
statement:
theorem harmonic_add_log_sinc_le_mul_sum_cot_midpoint {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hmh : (m : ℝ) * h ≤ π / 2) :
    2 * (harmonic (2 * m) : ℝ) - (harmonic m : ℝ) + log (sin ((m : ℝ) * h) / ((m : ℝ) * h)) ≤
      h * ∑ j ∈ range m, Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  let g := fun x : ℝ => Real.cot x - 1 / x
  let a := fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ) * h
  have hbounds (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m) : 0 ≤ a j ∧ a j ≤ a (j + 1) ∧ a (j + 1) ≤ π / 2 := by
    have hjR : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hj
    dsimp [a]
    push_cast
    exact ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith, (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hjR hh.le).trans hmh⟩
  have hgi (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m) : IntervalIntegrable g volume (a j) (a (j + 1)) := by
    obtain ⟨h0, hab, hb⟩ := hbounds j hj
    exact (continuousOn_cot_sub_one_div.mono (Icc_subset_Icc h0 hb)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
  have hmid (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range m) :
      (∫ x in a j..a (j + 1), g x) ≤ h * g (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h) := by
    obtain ⟨h0, hab, hb⟩ := hbounds j (mem_range.mp hj)
    have hi := integral_cot_sub_one_div_le_mul_midpoint h0 hab hb
    have hd : a (j + 1) - a j = h := by dsimp [a]; push_cast; ring
    have hmida : (a j + a (j + 1)) / 2 = ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h := by dsimp [a]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hd, hmida] at hi
    exact hi
  have hs := sum_le_sum hmid
  rw [intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals hgi, ← mul_sum] at hs
  simp only [a, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hs
  rw [integral_cot_sub_one_div_eq_log_sinc (mul_pos hmR hh) hmh] at hs
  have heq : h * (∑ j ∈ range m, g (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h)) =
      h * (∑ j ∈ range m, Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * h)) -
        (2 * (harmonic (2 * m) : ℝ) - (harmonic m : ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [g]
    rw [sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, mul_sum, ← sum_inv_nat_add_half]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj0 : (j : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [hh.ne', hj0]
  rw [heq] at hs
  linarith

name: NLAlib.re_sum_fourier_mul_conj_eq_sum
statement:
theorem re_sum_fourier_mul_conj_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    ((∑ j ∈ range n, fourier (j : ℤ) t) * conj (fourier (n : ℤ) t)).re =
      ∑ j ∈ range n, (fourier ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_mul, Complex.re_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ j ∈ range n,
      (fourier (j : ℤ) t * conj (fourier (n : ℤ) t)).re =
        (fourier (((n - 1 - j) + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re := by
    intro j hj
    have hjn : j < n := mem_range.mp hj
    rw [← fourier_neg, ← fourier_add]
    have hidx : (j : ℤ) + -(n : ℤ) = -(((n - 1 - j) + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      omega
    rw [hidx, fourier_neg, Complex.conj_re]
  rw [sum_congr rfl hterm]
  exact sum_range_reflect (fun j => (fourier ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re) n

name: NLAlib.normSq_sum_fourier_eq_sum_dirichletCircleKernel
statement:
theorem normSq_sum_fourier_eq_sum_dirichletCircleKernel (n : ℕ)
    (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Complex.normSq (∑ j ∈ range n, fourier (j : ℤ) t) =
      ∑ m ∈ range n, dirichletCircleKernel m t
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, Complex.normSq_add, ih, sum_range_succ,
      re_sum_fourier_mul_conj_eq_sum]
    have hn : Complex.normSq (fourier (n : ℤ) t) = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, show ‖fourier (n : ℤ) t‖ = (1 : ℝ) from Circle.norm_coe _]
      norm_num
    rw [hn]
    simp only [dirichletCircleKernel]
    ring

name: NLAlib.fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet
statement:
theorem fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet (n : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    fejerCircleKernel n t = (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), dirichletCircleKernel m t
proof:
:= by
  rw [fejerCircleKernel, normSq_sum_fourier_eq_sum_dirichletCircleKernel]

name: NLAlib.fejerCircleKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem fejerCircleKernel_nonneg (n : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    0 ≤ fejerCircleKernel n t
proof:
:= by
  unfold fejerCircleKernel
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)) (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.continuous_dirichletCircleKernel
statement: theorem continuous_dirichletCircleKernel (n : ℕ) : Continuous (dirichletCircleKernel n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dirichletCircleKernel
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.continuous_fejerCircleKernel
statement: theorem continuous_fejerCircleKernel (n : ℕ) : Continuous (fejerCircleKernel n)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : fejerCircleKernel n = fun t =>
      (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), dirichletCircleKernel m t :=
    funext (fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet n)
  rw [heq]
  exact continuous_const.mul (continuous_finsetSum _ (fun m hm => continuous_dirichletCircleKernel m))

name: NLAlib.integral_re_fourier_nat_succ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_re_fourier_nat_succ_eq_zero (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
      ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (fourierCoeff_fourier (T := 2 * Real.pi) 0) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  have hI : Integrable (fun t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) => fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t)
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle := (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hR := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm hI
  change (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re
    ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
      fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle).re at hR
  rw [hR]
  have hzero : (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
      fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 0 := by
    have hne : -((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by omega
    simpa only [fourierCoeff, neg_neg, fourier_zero, ContinuousMap.coe_one,
      Pi.one_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Pi.single_apply, if_neg hne,
      if_neg (Ne.symm hne)] using h
  rw [hzero]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_one
statement:
theorem integral_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_one (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), dirichletCircleKernel n t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold dirichletCircleKernel
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (by
      apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport _ (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
      fun_prop), integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun k t => (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re) _ (fun k hk =>
      (Complex.continuous_re.comp (fourier ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _))]
  simp_rw [integral_re_fourier_nat_succ_eq_zero]
  simp

name: NLAlib.integral_fejerCircleKernel_eq_one
statement:
theorem integral_fejerCircleKernel_eq_one (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), fejerCircleKernel n t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fejerCircleKernel_eq_avg_dirichlet]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun m hm =>
    (continuous_dirichletCircleKernel m).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _))]
  simp only [integral_dirichletCircleKernel_eq_one, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
    mul_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernel_eq_dirichlet
statement:
theorem lobattoKernel_eq_dirichlet {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    lobattoKernel n t =
      (dirichletCircleKernel (n - 1) (t : AddCircle (2 * π)) +
        dirichletCircleKernel n (t : AddCircle (2 * π))) / (4 * n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dirichletCircleKernel_coe, dirichletCircleKernel_coe]
  have heq : n = (n - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hn).symm
  nth_rw 3 [heq]
  rw [sum_range_succ]
  dsimp [lobattoKernel]
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sin_half_mul_lobattoKernel
statement:
theorem sin_half_mul_lobattoKernel {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    sin (t / 2) * lobattoKernel n t = sin ((n : ℝ) * t) * cos (t / 2) / (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lobattoKernel_eq_dirichlet hn, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_add,
    sin_half_mul_dirichletCircleKernel_coe, sin_half_mul_dirichletCircleKernel_coe]
  have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]; norm_num
  rw [hcast, show ((n : ℝ) - 1 + 1 / 2) * t = (n : ℝ) * t - t / 2 by ring,
    show ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t = (n : ℝ) * t + t / 2 by ring,
    sin_sub, sin_add]
  ring

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernel_eq_sin_cot
statement:
theorem lobattoKernel_eq_sin_cot {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : sin (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    lobattoKernel n t = sin ((n : ℝ) * t) * Real.cot (t / 2) / (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sin_half_mul_lobattoKernel hn t
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ ht)
  calc
    sin (t / 2) * lobattoKernel n t = _ := h
    _ = _ := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernel_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem lobattoKernel_neg (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : lobattoKernel n (-t) = lobattoKernel n t
proof:
:= by
  simp [lobattoKernel, mul_neg]

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernel_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem lobattoKernel_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : lobattoKernel n 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lobattoKernel, mul_zero, cos_zero, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]; norm_num
  rw [hcast]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernel_periodic
statement: theorem lobattoKernel_periodic (n : ℕ) : Function.Periodic (lobattoKernel n) (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  simp only [lobattoKernel, mul_add]
  simp_rw [cos_add_nat_mul_two_pi]

name: NLAlib.lobattoKernel_grid_zero
statement:
theorem lobattoKernel_grid_zero {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k < 2 * n) :
    lobattoKernel n ((k : ℝ) * π / n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hk0' : (0 : ℝ) < k := by positivity
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) < 2 * n := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have ha : 0 < (k : ℝ) * π / n / 2 := by positivity
  have hb : (k : ℝ) * π / n / 2 < π := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), div_lt_iff₀ hn0]
    nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hs : sin ((k : ℝ) * π / n / 2) ≠ 0 := (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi ha hb).ne'
  rw [lobattoKernel_eq_sin_cot hn hs]
  rw [show (n : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) * π / n) = (k : ℝ) * π by field_simp,
    sin_nat_mul_pi, zero_mul, zero_div]

name: ContinuousLinearMap.sum_proj_smulRight
statement:
theorem sum_proj_smulRight (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) :
    (∑ j, (proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) j).smulRight (L (Pi.single j 1))) = L
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  conv_rhs => rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' x]
  simp [map_sum, map_smul]

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_mul_lt_three_bernstein_exponent_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pos_mul_lt_three_bernstein_exponent_eq {t v L : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (hv : 0 < v) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ * L < 3 ∧
      -θ * t + ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) * v = -(t ^ 2 / (2 * (v + L * t / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < v + L * t / 3 := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hv (by positivity)
  let θ := t / (v + L * t / 3)
  have hθ : 0 < θ := div_pos ht hden
  have hθL : θ * L < 3 := by
    dsimp [θ]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hden]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨θ, hθ, hθL, ?_⟩
  have hgden : 0 < 1 - θ * L / 3 := by linarith
  field_simp [hden.ne', hgden.ne']
  dsimp [θ]
  field_simp [hden.ne']
  ring

name: NLAlib.affine_inv_sub_inv_affine_eq
statement:
theorem affine_inv_sub_inv_affine_eq {a b t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a + b = 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    a + b * t⁻¹ - (a + b * t)⁻¹ = a * b * (t - 1) ^ 2 / (t * (a + b * t))
proof:
:= by
  have he : 0 < a + b * t := add_pos ha (mul_pos hb ht)
  have hbEq : b = 1 - a := by linarith
  rw [hbEq] at he ⊢
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.inv_affine_le_affine_inv_and_lt_of_ne
statement:
theorem inv_affine_le_affine_inv_and_lt_of_ne {a b t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a + b = 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (a + b * t)⁻¹ ≤ a + b * t⁻¹ ∧ (t ≠ 1 → (a + b * t)⁻¹ < a + b * t⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hgap := affine_inv_sub_inv_affine_eq ha hb hab ht
  have hden : 0 < t * (a + b * t) := mul_pos ht (add_pos ha (mul_pos hb ht))
  constructor
  · have hn : 0 ≤ a * b * (t - 1) ^ 2 / (t * (a + b * t)) :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_pos ha hb).le (sq_nonneg _)) hden.le
    linarith
  · intro ht1
    have hn : 0 < a * b * (t - 1) ^ 2 / (t * (a + b * t)) :=
      div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos ha hb) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr ht1))) hden
    linarith

name: NLAlib.one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ)
    (hu0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ u i) (hu1 : ∀ i ∈ s, u i ≤ 1) :
    1 - ∑ i ∈ s, u i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - u i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [sum_insert hi, prod_insert hi]
    have hsi0 (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ s) := hu0 j (mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    have hsi1 (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ s) := hu1 j (mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, u j := sum_nonneg hsi0
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih hsi0 hsi1)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hu1 i (mem_insert_self _ _)))
    have hui0 := hu0 i (mem_insert_self _ _)
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.cast_descFactorial_eq_prod_range_sub
statement:
theorem cast_descFactorial_eq_prod_range_sub (k m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ k + 1) :
    (k.descFactorial m : ℝ) = ∏ j ∈ range m, ((k : ℝ) - j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range, Nat.cast_prod]
  apply prod_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact Nat.cast_sub (by have h := mem_range.mp hj; omega)

name: NLAlib.pow_mul_one_sub_le_cast_descFactorial
statement:
theorem pow_mul_one_sub_le_cast_descFactorial {k ν : ℕ} (hk : ν < k) :
    (k : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1) * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / k) ≤
      (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ range (ν + 1), (j : ℝ)) = (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2 := by
    have h := sum_range_id_mul_two (ν + 1)
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
    have hR := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) h
    push_cast at hR
    linarith
  have h := one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub (range (ν + 1)) (fun j => (j : ℝ) / k)
    (fun j hj => div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j) hk0.le)
    (fun j hj => (div_le_one hk0).mpr (by exact_mod_cast (show j ≤ k by
      have h := mem_range.mp hj
      omega)))
  rw [← sum_div, hsum] at h
  have hprod : (∏ j ∈ range (ν + 1), ((k : ℝ) - j)) =
      (k : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1) * ∏ j ∈ range (ν + 1), (1 - (j : ℝ) / k) := by
    calc
      _ = (∏ j ∈ range (ν + 1), (k : ℝ) * (1 - (j : ℝ) / k)) := by
        apply prod_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        field_simp
      _ = _ := by rw [prod_mul_distrib, prod_const, card_range]
  rw [cast_descFactorial_eq_prod_range_sub k (ν + 1) (by omega), hprod]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (pow_nonneg hk0.le _)

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_sum
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_sum {𝕜 E ι κ : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (P : Submodule 𝕜 E)
    (bP : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 P) (bQ : OrthonormalBasis κ 𝕜 Pᗮ) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (ι ⊕ κ) 𝕜 E,
      (∀ i, b (Sum.inl i) = (bP i : E)) ∧
      (∀ i, b (Sum.inr i) = (bQ i : E))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : ι ⊕ κ → E := Sum.elim (fun i => (bP i : E)) (fun i => (bQ i : E))
  have hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro i j
    cases i with
    | inl i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j => simpa [v] using orthonormal_iff_ite.mp bP.orthonormal i j
      | inr j =>
        have h := Submodule.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal (bP i).property (bQ j).property
        simpa [v] using h
    | inr i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j =>
        have h := Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (bP j).property (bQ i).property
        simpa [v] using h
      | inr j => simpa [v] using orthonormal_iff_ite.mp bQ.orthonormal i j
  have hdim : Fintype.card (ι ⊕ κ) = finrank 𝕜 E := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, ← finrank_eq_card_basis bP.toBasis,
      ← finrank_eq_card_basis bQ.toBasis, P.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal]
  let c := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' v hv.linearIndependent hdim
  let b := c.toOrthonormalBasis
    (by simpa only [c, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'] using hv)
  refine ⟨b, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [b, Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis, c,
      coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank', v, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_of_pointwise_tendsto_of_bounded_derivatives
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_of_pointwise_tendsto_of_bounded_derivatives
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f d : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hDm : ∀ n, Measurable (D n)) (hdm : Measurable d)
    (hdc : ContinuousOn d (Ioi 0))
    (hDeriv : ∀ n t, 0 < t → HasDerivAt (F n) (D n t) t)
    (hBound : ∀ n t, 0 < t → |D n t| ≤ B)
    (hFlim : ∀ t, 0 < t → Tendsto (fun n => F n t) atTop (nhds (f t)))
    (hDlim : ∀ t, 0 < t → Tendsto (fun n => D n t) atTop (nhds (d t)))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) : HasDerivAt f (d t) t
proof:
:= by
  have hpos {a b x : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hx : x ∈ uIcc a b) : 0 < x := by
    change min a b ≤ x ∧ x ≤ max a b at hx
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min ha hb) hx.1
  have hdb (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : |d x| ≤ B :=
    le_of_tendsto' ((continuous_abs.tendsto (d x)).comp (hDlim x hx))
      (fun n => hBound n x hx)
  have hDi (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
      IntervalIntegrable (D n) volume a b := by
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => B) volume a b).mono_fun'
      (hDm n).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hBound n x (hpos ha hb (uIoc_subset_uIcc hx))
  have hdi (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : IntervalIntegrable d volume a b := by
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => B) volume a b).mono_fun'
      hdm.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hdb x (hpos ha hb (uIoc_subset_uIcc hx))
  have hidentity (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
      f b - f a = ∫ s in a..b, d s := by
    have hN (n : ℕ) : (∫ s in a..b, D n s) = F n b - F n a :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun s hs => hDeriv n s (hpos ha hb hs)) (hDi n a b ha hb)
    have hI : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ s in a..b, D n s) atTop
        (nhds (∫ s in a..b, d s)) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
        (fun _ => B) (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hDm n).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict)
        (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ae_of_all _ fun s hs => ?_)
        intervalIntegrable_const (ae_of_all _ fun s hs => ?_)
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hBound n s (hpos ha hb (uIoc_subset_uIcc hs))
      · exact hDlim s (hpos ha hb (uIoc_subset_uIcc hs))
    have he : (fun n => ∫ s in a..b, D n s) = fun n => F n b - F n a := funext hN
    rw [he] at hI
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique ((hFlim b hb).sub (hFlim a ha)) hI
  let a := t / 2
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have hc : ContinuousAt d t := hdc.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds ht)
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hdi a t ha ht)
    hdm.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hc
  apply (hFTC.const_add (f a)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ s in nhds t, 0 < s := isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds ht
  filter_upwards [hnear] with s hs
  have h := hidentity a s ha hs
  linarith

name: hasFDerivAt_of_continuous_secant
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_of_continuous_secant {f : E → F} {L : E → E →L[𝕜] F} {x : E}
    (hL : ContinuousAt L x)
    (hsec : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y - f x = L y (y - x)) :
    HasFDerivAt f (L x) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, isLittleO_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ‖L y - L x‖ < ε := by
    exact (hL.sub continuousAt_const).norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa using hε))
  filter_upwards [hsec, hsmall] with y hy hsmall
  rw [hy, ← sub_apply]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall.le (norm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.convexOn_cot
statement: theorem convexOn_cot : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioc 0 (π / 2)) Real.cot
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (π / 2), 0 < sin x := by
    intro x hx
    exact sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx.1 (hx.2.trans_lt (by linarith [pi_pos]))
  apply convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg (f' := fun x => -1 / sin x ^ 2) (convex_Ioc 0 (π / 2))
    (fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_cot (hs x hx).ne').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_cot (hs x (interior_subset hx)).ne').hasDerivWithinAt)
    (f'' := fun x => (2 * sin x * cos x) / (sin x ^ 2) ^ 2)
  · intro x hx
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const x (-1 : ℝ)).div ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin x).pow 2)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (hs x (interior_subset hx)).ne')
    have hneg : HasDerivAt (fun x => -1 / sin x ^ 2) ((2 * sin x * cos x) / (sin x ^ 2) ^ 2) x := by
      exact h.congr_deriv (by simp only [Pi.pow_apply, zero_mul, neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.reduceSub, pow_one]; ring)
    exact hneg.hasDerivWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    have hx' := interior_subset hx
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hs x hx').le)
      (cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [hx'.1, pi_pos], hx'.2⟩)) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.mul_midpoint_le_integral_of_convexOn
proof:
:= by
  have hfi : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b := hf.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
  have hfr : ContinuousOn (fun x => f (a + b - x)) (Icc a b) :=
    hf.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn (by intro x hx; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
  have hfri : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f (a + b - x)) volume a b := hfr.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
  have hpoint : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f ((a + b) / 2) ≤ (f x + f (a + b - x)) / 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have hr : a + b - x ∈ Icc a b := by constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
    have h := hc.2 hx hr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num)
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * x + 1 / 2 * (a + b - x) = (a + b) / 2 by ring,
      show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * f x + 1 / 2 * f (a + b - x) = (f x + f (a + b - x)) / 2 by ring] using h
  have hbound := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab intervalIntegrable_const
    ((hfi.add hfri).div_const 2) hpoint
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, intervalIntegral.integral_div,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add hfi hfri, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left,
    show a + b - b = a by ring, show a + b - a = b by ring] at hbound
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, add_self_div_two] using hbound

name: NLAlib.integral_cot_eq_log_sin
statement:
theorem integral_cot_eq_log_sin {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ π / 2) :
    (∫ x in a..b, Real.cot x) = log (sin b) - log (sin a)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < sin x := by
    intro x hx
    exact sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (ha.trans_le hx.1) ((hx.2.trans hb).trans_lt (by linarith [pi_pos]))
  have hcot : ContinuousOn Real.cot (Icc a b) := fun x hx =>
    (hasDerivAt_cot (hs x hx).ne').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt _ (hcot.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
  intro x hx
  rw [uIcc_of_le hab] at hx
  have h := (Real.hasDerivAt_log (hs x hx).ne').comp x (Real.hasDerivAt_sin x)
  apply h.congr_deriv
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  ring

name: NLAlib.cot_le_one_div
statement: theorem cot_le_one_div {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hxπ : x ≤ π / 2) : Real.cot x ≤ 1 / x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases heq : x = π / 2
  · simp only [heq, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, cos_pi_div_two, sin_pi_div_two, zero_div, one_div_div]; positivity
  have hlt : x < π / 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hxπ heq
  have hcos : 0 < cos x := cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], hlt⟩
  have hsin : 0 < sin x := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx (by linarith [pi_pos])
  have htan := Real.le_tan hx.le hlt
  rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, le_div_iff₀ hcos] at htan
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, div_le_div_iff₀ hsin hx]
  simpa only [one_mul, mul_comm] using htan

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormalBasis_simultaneous_upper_triangular
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormalBasis_simultaneous_upper_triangular
    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (k : ℕ) (T : ι → Module.End ℂ E)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (T i) (T j)) (hk : finrank ℂ E = k) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℂ E,
      ∀ a i j, j < i → inner ℂ (b i) (T a (b j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing E with
  | zero =>
    let b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 0) ℂ E :=
      (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ E).reindex (finCongr hk)
    exact ⟨b, fun _ i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    have : Nontrivial E := finrank_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hk]; omega)
    obtain ⟨x, χ, hxne, hTx⟩ := exists_common_eigenvector_of_pairwise_commute T hcomm
    have hxnorm : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hxne
    let u : E := (‖x‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • x
    have hunorm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      simp only [u, norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg hxnorm.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxnorm.ne']
    have hune : u ≠ 0 := by intro hu; rw [hu, norm_zero] at hunorm; exact zero_ne_one hunorm
    have hTu (a : ι) : T a u = χ a • u := by
      simp only [u, map_smul, hTx, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    let W : Submodule ℂ E := (ℂ ∙ u)ᗮ
    have hWdim : finrank ℂ W = k := by
      have hdim := (ℂ ∙ u).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
      rw [finrank_span_singleton hune, hk] at hdim
      dsimp [W]
      omega
    have hpres (a : ι) : Set.MapsTo (T a) Wᗮ Wᗮ := by
      dsimp [W]
      rw [Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal]
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
      rw [map_smul, hTu, smul_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self u)
    let C (a : ι) : Module.End ℂ W :=
      W.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp ((T a).comp W.subtype)
    have hCcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (C a) (C b) := by
      intro a b hab
      exact commute_orthogonal_compressions_of_invariant W (T a) (T b) (hpres a) (hpres b) (hcomm hab)
    obtain ⟨bW, htri⟩ := ih C hCcomm hWdim
    let v : Fin (k + 1) → E := Fin.cons u (fun i => (bW i : E))
    have hv : Orthonormal ℂ v := by
      rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
      intro i j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
        · simp [v, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hunorm]
        · have hinner : inner ℂ u (bW j : E) = 0 :=
            Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp (bW j).property
          simpa only [v, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm,
            ite_false] using hinner
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
        · have hinner : inner ℂ (bW i : E) u = 0 :=
            Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left.mp (bW i).property
          simpa only [v, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false] using hinner
        · simpa only [v, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, Submodule.coe_inner] using
            (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp bW.orthonormal i j)
    let c : Basis (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ E :=
      basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' v hv.linearIndependent (by simpa using hk.symm)
    let b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ E :=
      c.toOrthonormalBasis (by simpa only [c, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'] using hv)
    have hb (i : Fin (k + 1)) : b i = v i := by
      simp only [b, Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis, c, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank']
    refine ⟨b, fun a i j hij => ?_⟩
    rw [hb, hb]
    revert hij
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · intro hij
      have hi : i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hij
      rw [show v 0 = u from rfl, hTu, inner_smul_right]
      have hiu : inner ℂ (v i) u = 0 := by
        simpa only [v, Fin.cons_zero] using hv.inner_eq_zero hi
      rw [hiu, mul_zero]
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · intro hij
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _)) hij |>.elim
      · intro hij
        have hh := htri a i j (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)
        simpa only [C, LinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
          Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left,
          v, Fin.cons_succ] using hh

name: NLAlib.exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum (θ x : ℝ) :
    exp (θ * x ^ 2) =
      ∑' m : ℕ, θ ^ m * x ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show exp (θ * x ^ 2) = ∑' m : ℕ, (θ * x ^ 2) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) by
    rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div]]
  congr with m
  rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]

name: NLAlib.factorial_two_mul_div_factorial_le_succ_pow
statement:
theorem factorial_two_mul_div_factorial_le_succ_pow (m : ℕ) :
    (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ≤
      ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : Nat.factorial (2 * m) ≤ (2 * m + 1) ^ m * Nat.factorial m := by
    calc Nat.factorial (2 * m)
        ≤ (2 * m) ^ m * Nat.factorial m := Nat.factorial_two_mul_le m
      _ ≤ (2 * m + 1) ^ m * Nat.factorial m := by
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ _) m)
  have hfac_pos : 0 < (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hfac_pos]
  exact_mod_cast hnat

name: NLAlib.cosh_taylor_term_le
statement:
theorem cosh_taylor_term_le (y : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    y ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) ≤ cosh y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.cosh_eq_tsum]
  have hs := (Real.hasSum_cosh y).summable
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ y ^ (2 * n) / (Nat.factorial (2 * n) : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    exact div_nonneg (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right n) y)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.factorial (2 * n)))
  have hsingle :=
    hs.sum_le_tsum ({m} : Finset ℕ) (fun n _ => hnonneg n)
  simpa using hsingle

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq
statement:
theorem exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    exp (-u) ≤ 1 - u + u ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hden_pos : 0 < 1 + u := by linarith
  have h_exp_ge : 1 + u ≤ exp u := by
    simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp u
  have hinv : (exp u)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + u)⁻¹ :=
    (inv_le_inv₀ (exp_pos u) hden_pos).2 h_exp_ge
  have hrat : (1 + u)⁻¹ ≤ 1 - u + u ^ 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ hden_pos]
    ring_nf
    nlinarith [pow_nonneg hu 3]
  calc
    exp (-u) = (exp u)⁻¹ := by rw [exp_neg]
    _ ≤ (1 + u)⁻¹ := hinv
    _ ≤ 1 - u + u ^ 2 := hrat

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_mul_one_add_le_one
statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_one_add_le_one (u : ℝ) :
    exp (-u) * (1 + u) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h_exp_ge : 1 + u ≤ exp u := by
    simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp u
  calc
    exp (-u) * (1 + u) ≤ exp (-u) * exp u := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_ge (exp_nonneg _)
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [← exp_add]
      ring_nf
      simp

name: NLAlib.exp_add_le_average_exp_two
statement:
theorem exp_add_le_average_exp_two (a b : ℝ) :
    exp (a + b) ≤ (exp (2 * a) + exp (2 * b)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hconv := convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (2 * a)) (Set.mem_univ (2 * b))
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = 1)
  calc
    exp (a + b) = exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (2 * a) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (2 * b)) := by
      congr 1
      norm_num
      ring
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * exp (2 * a) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * exp (2 * b) := hconv
    _ = (exp (2 * a) + exp (2 * b)) / 2 := by ring

name: NLAlib.exp_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs (x : ℝ) :
    Real.exp x ≤ 1 + x + x ^ 2 * Real.exp |x|
proof:
:= by
  have he : 1 ≤ Real.exp |x| := Real.one_le_exp (abs_nonneg x)
  by_cases hsmall : |x| ≤ 1
  · have hrem := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le hsmall
    have hupper : Real.exp x ≤ 1 + x + x ^ 2 := by
      linarith [(le_abs_self (Real.exp x - 1 - x)).trans hrem]
    have hmul : x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 * Real.exp |x| := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (sq_nonneg x)
    linarith
  · by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
    · have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hx] using (not_le.mp hsmall).le
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
      have hsq : 1 ≤ x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hmul : Real.exp x ≤ x ^ 2 * Real.exp x := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (Real.exp_pos x).le
      linarith
    · have hx0 : x ≤ 0 := (not_le.mp hx).le
      have hx1 : x ≤ -1 := by
        have h := (not_le.mp hsmall).le
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hx0] at h
        linarith
      have hex : Real.exp x ≤ 1 := by simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx0
      have hsq : -x ≤ x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hmul : x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 * Real.exp |x| := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (sq_nonneg x)
      linarith

name: NLAlib.neg_sub_mul_log_one_sub_le
statement:
theorem neg_sub_mul_log_one_sub_le {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    -ε - (1 - ε) * log (1 - ε) ≤ -(ε ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (1 - t) * log (1 - t) + t - t ^ 2 / 2
  have hderiv : ∀ t, t < 1 → HasDerivAt g (-log (1 - t) - t) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t) (-1) t := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub 1
    have hlog := h1.log (by linarith)
    have hprod := h1.mul hlog
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t - t ^ 2 / 2) (1 - t) t := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_id' t).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).div_const 2)
      exact this.congr_deriv (by norm_num)
    have := hprod.add hp
    refine (this.congr_deriv ?_).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    · field_simp [show (1 - t) ≠ 0 by linarith]
      ring
    · simp only [g, Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; ring
  have hmono : MonotoneOn g (Set.Ico 0 1) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ico 0 1) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact fun t ht => (hderiv t ht.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ico] at ht
      exact (hderiv t ht.2).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ico] at ht
      rw [(hderiv t ht.2).deriv]
      have := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1 - t by linarith [ht.2])
      linarith
  have := hmono (Set.mem_Ico.2 ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩) (Set.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hε0, hε1⟩) hε0
  simp only [g, sub_zero, log_one, mul_zero, zero_add, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
    not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, zero_div] at this
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_log_one_add_le
statement:
theorem sub_mul_log_one_add_le {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    ε - (1 + ε) * log (1 + ε) ≤ -(ε ^ 2 / 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_log_one_add hε0
  have hlow := le_hasSum h 0 (fun n _ => by positivity)
  simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
    div_self, mul_one, pow_one] at hlow
  have hpos : 0 < ε + 2 := by linarith
  have key : ε + ε ^ 2 / 3 ≤ (1 + ε) * (2 * (ε / (ε + 2))) := by
    rw [← sub_nonneg]
    have : (1 + ε) * (2 * (ε / (ε + 2))) - (ε + ε ^ 2 / 3) = ε ^ 2 * (1 - ε) / (3 * (ε + 2)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [this]
    have : 0 ≤ 1 - ε := by linarith
    positivity
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (show 0 ≤ 1 + ε by linarith)]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_hFun
statement: private lemma hasDerivAt_hFun (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt hFun ((1 - Real.exp u * (1 - u)) / 3) u
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (((Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).sub_const 1).sub (hasDerivAt_id u)).div_const 3
  have h2 := ((hasDerivAt_id u).div_const 3).const_sub 1
  have h3 := h2.mul ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).sub_const 1)
  have h4 := ((hasDerivAt_id u).add h1).sub h3
  refine (h4.congr_deriv ?_).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  · simp; ring
  · simp [hFun]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_gFun
statement: private lemma hasDerivAt_gFun (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt gFun (hFun u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).sub_const 1).sub (hasDerivAt_id u)
  have h2 := ((hasDerivAt_id u).div_const 3).const_sub 1
  have h4 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 u).div_const 2).sub (h2.mul h1)
  refine (h4.congr_deriv ?_).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  · simp [hFun]; ring
  · simp [gFun]

name: NLAlib.hFun_mono
statement: private lemma hFun_mono : Monotone hFun
proof:
:= by
  apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun u => (hasDerivAt_hFun u).differentiableAt)
  intro u
  rw [(hasDerivAt_hFun u).deriv]
  have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-u)
  have h2 : Real.exp u * Real.exp (-u) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  have hpos := Real.exp_pos u
  apply div_nonneg _ (by norm_num)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.gFun_nonneg
statement: private lemma gFun_nonneg (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ gFun u
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ gFun := fun u => (hasDerivAt_gFun u).differentiableAt
  have g0 : gFun 0 = 0 := by simp [gFun]
  have h0 : hFun 0 = 0 := by simp [hFun]
  rcases le_total u 0 with hu | hu
  · have hanti : AntitoneOn gFun (Set.Iic 0) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Iic 0) hdiff.continuous.continuousOn
        hdiff.differentiableOn
      intro x hx
      rw [interior_Iic] at hx
      rw [(hasDerivAt_gFun x).deriv]
      have := hFun_mono (le_of_lt (Set.mem_Iio.mp hx))
      linarith
    have := hanti (Set.mem_Iic.mpr hu) (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl) hu
    linarith
  · have hmono : MonotoneOn gFun (Set.Ici 0) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici 0) hdiff.continuous.continuousOn
        hdiff.differentiableOn
      intro x hx
      rw [interior_Ici] at hx
      rw [(hasDerivAt_gFun x).deriv]
      have := hFun_mono (le_of_lt (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx))
      linarith
    have := hmono (Set.mem_Ici.mpr le_rfl) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hu) hu
    linarith

name: NLAlib.exp_mul_le_one_add_mul_add_sq_mul_of_le
statement:
theorem exp_mul_le_one_add_mul_add_sq_mul_of_le {L θ x : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθL : θ * L < 3) (hx : x ≤ L) :
    Real.exp (θ * x) ≤ 1 + θ * x + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hux : θ * x ≤ θ * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hθ.le
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - θ * L / 3 := by linarith
  have hpos' : 0 < 1 - θ * x / 3 := by linarith
  have hg := gFun_nonneg (θ * x)
  unfold gFun at hg
  have h1 : Real.exp (θ * x) - 1 - θ * x ≤ ((θ * x) ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * x / 3) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos']; nlinarith
  have h2 : ((θ * x) ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * x / 3) ≤ ((θ * x) ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hpos (by linarith)
  have h3 : (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * x ^ 2 = ((θ * x) ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) := by
    ring
  linarith

name: NLAlib.rpow_inv_choose_compare_iff_pow_compare
statement:
theorem rpow_inv_choose_compare_iff_pow_compare {N k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < N)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    (y ^ (1 / ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ)) ≤ x ^ (1 / ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ)) ↔
      y ^ k ≤ x ^ (N - k)) ∧
    (y ^ (1 / ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ)) = x ^ (1 / ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ)) ↔
      y ^ k = x ^ (N - k))
proof:
:= by
  have hpNat : 0 < (N - 1).choose (k - 1) := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hqNat : 0 < (N - 1).choose k := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (N - 1).choose (k - 1) := by exact_mod_cast hpNat
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < (N - 1).choose k := by exact_mod_cast hqNat
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have hcNat : k * (N - 1).choose k = (N - k) * (N - 1).choose (k - 1) := by
    have h := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq (N - 1) (k - 1)
    have h1 : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    have h2 : (N - 1) - (k - 1) = N - k := by omega
    simpa only [h1, h2, mul_comm] using h
  have hc : (k : ℝ) * ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ) =
      ((N - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcNat
  let e : ℝ := (k : ℝ) * ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ)
  have he : 0 < e := mul_pos hkR hq
  have hye : (y ^ (1 / ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ))) ^ e = y ^ k := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hy]
    have harg : (1 / ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ)) * e = k := by dsimp [e]; field_simp
    rw [harg, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hxe : (x ^ (1 / ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ))) ^ e = x ^ (N - k) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]
    have harg : (1 / ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ)) * e = (N - k : ℕ) := by
      dsimp [e]
      rw [hc]
      field_simp
    rw [harg, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hle := Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff (Real.rpow_nonneg hy (1 / ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ)))
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hx (1 / ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ))) he
  have heq := Real.rpow_left_inj (Real.rpow_nonneg hy (1 / ((N - 1).choose k : ℝ)))
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hx (1 / ((N - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ))) he.ne'
  rw [hye, hxe] at hle heq
  exact ⟨hle.symm, heq.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_bounded_pow_orbit_of_jordan_chain
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_bounded_pow_orbit_of_jordan_chain
    (f : Module.End ℂ E) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : ‖μ‖ = 1) {x y : E}
    (hx : f x = μ • x) (hy : f y = μ • y + x)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) y‖ ≤ C) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hμ
  let u := μ⁻¹ • x
  have hfu : f u = μ • u := by simp only [u, map_smul, hx, smul_smul, mul_comm]
  have hfy : f y = μ • (y + u) := by
    change f y = μ • (y + μ⁻¹ • x)
    rw [hy, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hμne, one_smul]
  have hpow (k : ℕ) : (f ^ k) y = μ ^ k • (y + (k : ℂ) • u) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, map_add, map_smul, hfy, hfu]
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
      module
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb
  have hbound (k : ℕ) : (k : ℝ) * ‖u‖ ≤ C + ‖y‖ := by
    have hnorm : ‖y + (k : ℂ) • u‖ ≤ C := by
      have h := hC k
      simpa only [hpow, norm_smul, norm_pow, hμ, one_pow, one_mul] using h
    calc
      (k : ℝ) * ‖u‖ = ‖(k : ℂ) • u‖ := by
        conv_rhs => rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_natCast]
      _ = ‖(y + (k : ℂ) • u) - y‖ := by congr 1; module
      _ ≤ ‖y + (k : ℂ) • u‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ C + ‖y‖ := add_le_add hnorm le_rfl
  have hu : u = 0 := by
    by_contra hune
    have hpos := norm_pos_iff.mpr hune
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((C + ‖y‖) / ‖u‖)
    have hlt : C + ‖y‖ < (k : ℝ) * ‖u‖ := (div_lt_iff₀ hpos).mp hk
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound k)) hlt
  have hxu : x = μ • u := by simp only [u, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hμne, one_smul]
  rw [hxu, hu, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_bounded_pow_orbits
statement:
theorem maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_bounded_pow_orbits
    (f : Module.End ℂ E) (hb : ∀ x : E, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) x‖ ≤ C)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : ‖μ‖ = 1) : f.maxGenEigenspace μ = f.eigenspace μ
proof:
:= by
  let N := f - μ • (1 : Module.End ℂ E)
  have hstep (z : E) (hz : N (N z) = 0) : N z = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_bounded_pow_orbit_of_jordan_chain f hμ (y := z)
    · have h := sub_eq_zero.mp hz
      exact h
    · change f z = μ • z + (f z - μ • z)
      abel
    · exact hb z
  have hpower (k : ℕ) (z : E) (hz : (N ^ k) z = 0) : N z = 0 := by
    induction k generalizing z with
    | zero =>
      have hz0 : z = 0 := by simpa using hz
      rw [hz0, map_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      apply hstep z
      apply ih (N z)
      simpa only [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] using hz
  apply le_antisymm _ Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace f μ z).mp hz
  apply Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hpower k z hk)

name: NLAlib.norm_eigenvalue_le_one_of_bounded_pow_orbit
statement:
theorem norm_eigenvalue_le_one_of_bounded_pow_orbit
    (f : Module.End ℂ E) {μ : ℂ} {x : E} (hx : f.HasEigenvector μ x)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(f ^ k) x‖ ≤ C) : ‖μ‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx.2
  have hpow (k : ℕ) : ‖μ‖ ^ k ≤ C / ‖x‖ := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hxpos).mpr
    simpa only [hx.pow_apply, norm_smul, norm_pow] using hC k
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (C / ‖x‖) (lt_of_not_ge h)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hpow k)) hk

name: NLAlib.cot_neg
statement: theorem cot_neg (x : ℝ) : Real.cot (-x) = -Real.cot x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, cos_neg, sin_neg, div_neg]

name: NLAlib.sin_div_cos_sub_eq_half_cot_add
statement:
theorem sin_div_cos_sub_eq_half_cot_add {θ φ : ℝ}
    (hm : sin ((θ - φ) / 2) ≠ 0) (hp : sin ((θ + φ) / 2) ≠ 0) :
    sin θ / (cos φ - cos θ) =
      (Real.cot ((θ - φ) / 2) + Real.cot ((θ + φ) / 2)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hden : cos φ - cos θ = 2 * sin ((θ - φ) / 2) * sin ((θ + φ) / 2) := by
    rw [cos_sub_cos]
    have harg : (φ - θ) / 2 = -((θ - φ) / 2) := by ring
    rw [harg, sin_neg]
    have hadd : (φ + θ) / 2 = (θ + φ) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hadd]
    ring
  have hnum : sin θ = cos ((θ - φ) / 2) * sin ((θ + φ) / 2) +
      cos ((θ + φ) / 2) * sin ((θ - φ) / 2) := by
    nth_rw 1 [show θ = (θ - φ) / 2 + (θ + φ) / 2 by ring]
    rw [sin_add]
    ring
  rw [hden, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  have hfrac (a b c d s : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hs : s = c * b + d * a) :
      s / (2 * a * b) = (c / a + d / b) / 2 := by
    field_simp [ha, hb]
    linarith
  exact hfrac _ _ _ _ _ hm hp hnum

name: NLAlib.sin_div_abs_cos_sub_of_lt
statement:
theorem sin_div_abs_cos_sub_of_lt {θ φ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 π) (hφ : φ ∈ Ioo 0 π)
    (hlt : θ < φ) :
    sin θ / |cos φ - cos θ| =
      (Real.cot ((φ - θ) / 2) - Real.cot ((θ + φ) / 2)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : cos φ < cos θ := strictAntiOn_cos ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2.le⟩ ⟨hφ.1.le, hφ.2.le⟩ hlt
  have hp : sin ((θ + φ) / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith [hθ.1, hφ.1]) (by linarith [hθ.2, hφ.2])).ne'
  have hmpos : 0 < sin ((φ - θ) / 2) := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [hφ.2, hθ.1, pi_pos])
  have hm : sin ((θ - φ) / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show (θ - φ) / 2 = -((φ - θ) / 2) by ring, sin_neg]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hmpos.ne'
  rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hcos), div_neg, sin_div_cos_sub_eq_half_cot_add hm hp,
    show (θ - φ) / 2 = -((φ - θ) / 2) by ring, cot_neg]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sin_div_abs_cos_sub_of_gt
statement:
theorem sin_div_abs_cos_sub_of_gt {θ φ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 π) (hφ : φ ∈ Ioo 0 π)
    (hlt : φ < θ) :
    sin θ / |cos φ - cos θ| =
      (Real.cot ((θ - φ) / 2) + Real.cot ((θ + φ) / 2)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : cos θ < cos φ := strictAntiOn_cos ⟨hφ.1.le, hφ.2.le⟩ ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2.le⟩ hlt
  have hp : sin ((θ + φ) / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith [hθ.1, hφ.1]) (by linarith [hθ.2, hφ.2])).ne'
  have hm : sin ((θ - φ) / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [hθ.2, hφ.1, pi_pos])).ne'
  rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hcos), sin_div_cos_sub_eq_half_cot_add hm hp]

name: NLAlib.sum_sin_div_abs_cos_sub_eq_rootCotangentSample
statement:
theorem sum_sin_div_abs_cos_sub_eq_rootCotangentSample {N k : ℕ}
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkN : k < N) :
    (1 / (N : ℝ)) * (∑ j ∈ range N,
      sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
        |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - cos (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)|) =
          rootCotangentSample N k
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 0 < N := by omega
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hkNR : (k : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hkN
  let f := fun j : ℕ => Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / (2 * N))
  let G := fun j : ℕ => sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
    |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - cos (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N)|
  have hφ : (k : ℝ) * π / N ∈ Ioo 0 π := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hNR]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hθ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < N) : ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N ∈ Ioo 0 π := by
    have hjR : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hj
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hNR]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hfirst (j : ℕ) (hj : j < k) : G j = (f (k - 1 - j) - f (k + j)) / 2 := by
    have hjR : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hj
    have hlt : ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N < (k : ℝ) * π / N := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hNR]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [sin_div_abs_cos_sub_of_lt (hθ j (hj.trans hkN)) hφ hlt]
    dsimp [f]
    congr 2
    · rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    · push_cast
      ring_nf
  have hsecond (j : ℕ) (hj : j < N - k) : G (k + j) = (f j + f (2 * k + j)) / 2 := by
    have hjN : k + j < N := by omega
    have hlt : (k : ℝ) * π / N < (((k + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hNR]
      push_cast
      nlinarith [pi_pos, (Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j)]
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [sin_div_abs_cos_sub_of_gt (hθ _ hjN) hφ hlt]
    dsimp [f]
    congr 2 <;> push_cast <;> ring_nf
  have hA : (∑ j ∈ range k, G j) =
      (2 * rootCotangentPrefix N k - rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * k)) / 2 := by
    have heq : (∑ j ∈ range k, G j) = ∑ j ∈ range k, (f (k - 1 - j) - f (k + j)) / 2 :=
      sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => hfirst j (mem_range.mp hj))
    rw [heq]
    rw [← sum_div, sum_sub_distrib, sum_range_reflect]
    have hsplit := sum_range_add f k k
    change rootCotangentPrefix N (k + k) = rootCotangentPrefix N k + ∑ j ∈ range k, f (k + j) at hsplit
    rw [show k + k = 2 * k by omega] at hsplit
    change (rootCotangentPrefix N k - ∑ j ∈ range k, f (k + j)) / 2 = _
    congr 1
    linarith
  have hB : (∑ j ∈ range (N - k), G (k + j)) =
      (rootCotangentPrefix N (N - k) + rootCotangentPrefix N (N + k) - rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * k)) / 2 := by
    have heq : (∑ j ∈ range (N - k), G (k + j)) = ∑ j ∈ range (N - k), (f j + f (2 * k + j)) / 2 :=
      sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => hsecond j (mem_range.mp hj))
    rw [heq]
    rw [← sum_div, sum_add_distrib]
    have hsplit := sum_range_add f (2 * k) (N - k)
    change rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * k + (N - k)) = rootCotangentPrefix N (2 * k) +
      ∑ j ∈ range (N - k), f (2 * k + j) at hsplit
    rw [show 2 * k + (N - k) = N + k by omega] at hsplit
    change (rootCotangentPrefix N (N - k) + ∑ j ∈ range (N - k), f (2 * k + j)) / 2 = _
    congr 1
    linarith
  have href : rootCotangentPrefix N (N + k) = rootCotangentPrefix N (N - k) := by
    have h := rootCotangentPrefix_reflect hN (show N - k ≤ 2 * N by omega)
    rw [show 2 * N - (N - k) = N + k by omega] at h
    exact h
  change (1 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ range N, G j = _
  have hsplit : (∑ j ∈ range N, G j) = (∑ j ∈ range k, G j) + ∑ j ∈ range (N - k), G (k + j) := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hkN.le] using sum_range_add G k (N - k)
  rw [hsplit, hA, hB, href]
  unfold rootCotangentSample
  ring

name: ConvexOn.monotoneOn_nonneg_of_even
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.monotoneOn_nonneg_of_even {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ univ f) (he : Function.Even f) : MonotoneOn f (Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := le_antisymm (hxy.trans_eq hy0) hx
    simp [hx0, hy0]
  · have hyp : 0 < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hy (Ne.symm hy0)
    have ha : 0 ≤ (y + x) / (2 * y) :=
      div_nonneg (add_nonneg hyp.le hx) (by positivity)
    have hb : 0 ≤ (y - x) / (2 * y) := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxy) (by positivity)
    have hab : (y + x) / (2 * y) + (y - x) / (2 * y) = 1 := by field_simp; ring
    have harg : (y + x) / (2 * y) * y + (y - x) / (2 * y) * (-y) = x := by field_simp; ring
    have h := hf.2 (mem_univ y) (mem_univ (-y)) ha hb hab
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, harg, he y, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_succ_submatrix
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_succ_submatrix
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {k : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) R)
    (μ : R) (hcol : ∀ i, M i 0 = if i = 0 then μ else 0) :
    M.charpoly = (X - C μ) * (M.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  have hcharm : M.charmatrix.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      (M.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charmatrix := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  rw [Matrix.charpoly, Matrix.det_succ_column_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq, hcol,
    ite_true, Fin.succAbove_zero, hcharm]
  have hzero (i : Fin k) : M.charmatrix i.succ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne _ _ _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i), hcol,
      if_neg (Fin.succ_ne_zero i), C_0, neg_zero]
  simp only [hzero, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_orthogonal_compression
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_orthogonal_compression
    {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
    {k : ℕ} (f : Module.End 𝕜 E) {u : E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) {μ : 𝕜}
    (hfu : f u = μ • u) (hk : finrank 𝕜 E = k + 1) :
    f.charpoly = (X - C μ) *
      (((𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp
        (f.comp (𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ.subtype)) : Module.End 𝕜 (𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  have hune : u ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hu
  let W : Submodule 𝕜 E := (𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ
  have hdim : finrank 𝕜 W = k := by
    have h := (𝕜 ∙ u).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
    rw [finrank_span_singleton hune, hk] at h
    dsimp [W]
    omega
  let bW : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) 𝕜 W := (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 W).reindex (finCongr hdim)
  obtain ⟨b, hb₀, hbS⟩ := exists_orthonormalBasis_cons hk u hu bW
  let Cμ : Module.End 𝕜 W := W.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp (f.comp W.subtype)
  let M := f.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis
  have hcol (i : Fin (k + 1)) : M i 0 = if i = 0 then μ else 0 := by
    simp only [M, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, hb₀, hfu, map_smul]
    rw [← hb₀]
    change (μ • b.toBasis.repr (b.toBasis 0)) i = _
    rw [b.toBasis.repr_self]
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have htail : M.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = Cμ.toMatrix bW.toBasis bW.toBasis := by
    ext i j
    simp only [M, Matrix.submatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hbS, Cμ, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left]
  have h := charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_succ_submatrix M μ hcol
  rw [htail, LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix] at h
  simpa only [M, LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction
statement:
theorem exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hne : T.Nonempty) (z : E) :
    ∃ x ∈ T, inner ℝ z x = realSupportFunction T z
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : E => inner ℝ z x) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := hT.exists_isMaxOn hne hc.continuousOn
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  symm
  exact (show IsGreatest ((fun x => inner ℝ z x) '' T) (inner ℝ z x) from
    ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, by rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact hmax hy⟩).csSup_eq

name: NLAlib.inner_le_realSupportFunction
statement:
theorem inner_le_realSupportFunction {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ T) (z : E) : inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z
proof:
:= by
  exact le_csSup ((hT.image (continuous_const.inner continuous_id)).bddAbove)
    ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_realSupportFunction_le
statement:
theorem abs_realSupportFunction_le {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ ≤ R) (z : E) :
    |realSupportFunction T z| ≤ R * ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hT hne z
  rw [← he]
  exact (abs_real_inner_le_norm z x).trans (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, hR x hx])

name: NLAlib.abs_realSupportFunction_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_realSupportFunction_sub_le {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ ≤ R) (z w : E) :
    |realSupportFunction T z - realSupportFunction T w| ≤ R * ‖z - w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ z w : E, realSupportFunction T z - realSupportFunction T w ≤ R * ‖z-w‖ := by
    intro z w
    obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hT hne z
    have hl := inner_le_realSupportFunction hT hx w
    have hi := abs_real_inner_le_norm (z-w) x
    have hinner : inner ℝ (z-w) x = inner ℝ z x - inner ℝ w x := inner_sub_left _ _ _
    rw [he] at hinner
    have hb : ‖z-w‖ * ‖x‖ ≤ R * ‖z-w‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z-w), hR x hx]
    linarith [le_abs_self (inner ℝ (z-w) x)]
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨hstep z w, by simpa [norm_sub_rev] using hstep w z⟩

name: NLAlib.continuous_realSupportFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_realSupportFunction {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty) :
    Continuous (realSupportFunction T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := hT.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  exact (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := ⟨R, hR.le⟩) (fun z w => by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
    change |realSupportFunction T z - realSupportFunction T w| ≤ R * ‖z-w‖
    exact abs_realSupportFunction_sub_le hT hne hbound z w)).continuous

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_image_add
statement:
theorem realSupportFunction_image_add {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (a z : E) :
    realSupportFunction ((fun x => x + a) '' T) z = realSupportFunction T z + inner ℝ z a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hT hne z
  have himg : IsCompact ((fun x : E => x + a) '' T) := hT.image (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hf⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction himg (hne.image _) z
  have hxy := inner_le_realSupportFunction hT hy z
  have hyx := inner_le_realSupportFunction himg
    (mem_image_of_mem (fun x => x + a) hx) z
  rw [inner_add_right] at hf hyx
  linarith

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_convexHull
statement:
theorem realSupportFunction_convexHull {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (z : E) : realSupportFunction (convexHull ℝ T) z = realSupportFunction T z
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ T, inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z := by
    have hc : Convex ℝ {x : E | inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z} := by
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      change inner ℝ z (a • x + b • y) ≤ realSupportFunction T z
      rw [inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right]
      calc
        _ ≤ a * realSupportFunction T z + b * realSupportFunction T z :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb)
        _ = _ := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    exact convexHull_min (fun x hx => inner_le_realSupportFunction hT hx z) hc
