  have hbound : BddAbove ((fun x => inner ℝ z x) '' convexHull ℝ T) :=
    ⟨realSupportFunction T z, by rintro _ ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩; exact hb x hx⟩
  obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hT hne z
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact csSup_le ((hne.mono (subset_convexHull ℝ T)).image _)
      (by rintro _ ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩; exact hb y hy)
  · rw [← he]
    exact le_csSup hbound ⟨x, subset_convexHull ℝ T hx, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem realSupportFunction_singleton (x z : E) :
    realSupportFunction ({x} : Set E) z = inner ℝ z x
proof:
:= by
  simp [realSupportFunction]

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_mono
statement:
theorem realSupportFunction_mono {S T : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S) (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hT : IsCompact T) (hst : S ⊆ T) (z : E) :
    realSupportFunction S z ≤ realSupportFunction T z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hS hne z
  rw [← he]
  exact inner_le_realSupportFunction hT (hst hx) z

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_image_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem realSupportFunction_image_linearIsometryEquiv (T : Set E)
    (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (z : E) :
    realSupportFunction (U '' T) z = realSupportFunction T (U.symm z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold realSupportFunction
  congr 1
  have hi (x : E) : inner ℝ (U.symm z) x = inner ℝ z (U x) := by
    simpa only [U.apply_symm_apply] using (U.inner_map_map (U.symm z) x).symm
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hr⟩
    refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
    exact (hi x).trans hr
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,hr⟩
    refine ⟨U x, ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (hi x).symm.trans hr

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_image_smul
statement:
theorem realSupportFunction_image_smul {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (z : E) :
    realSupportFunction ((fun x => c • x) '' T) z = c * realSupportFunction T z
proof:
:= by
  have himg : IsCompact ((fun x : E => c • x) '' T) := hT.image (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hT hne z
  obtain ⟨_,⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,hf⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction himg (hne.image _) z
  have hxy := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inner_le_realSupportFunction hT hy z) hc
  have hyx := inner_le_realSupportFunction himg (mem_image_of_mem (fun x => c • x) hx) z
  rw [inner_smul_right] at hf hyx
  rw [he] at hyx
  exact le_antisymm (by linarith) hyx

name: NLAlib.realSupportFunction_closure_convexHull
statement:
theorem realSupportFunction_closure_convexHull {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hne : T.Nonempty) (z : E) :
    realSupportFunction (closure (convexHull ℝ T)) z = realSupportFunction T z
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ T, inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z := by
    have hc : Convex ℝ {x : E | inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z} := by
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      change inner ℝ z (a • x + b • y) ≤ realSupportFunction T z
      rw [inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right]
      calc
        _ ≤ a * realSupportFunction T z + b * realSupportFunction T z :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb)
        _ = _ := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    exact convexHull_min (fun x hx => inner_le_realSupportFunction hT hx z) hc
  have hclosed : IsClosed {x : E | inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z} :=
    isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hb : ∀ x ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ T), inner ℝ z x ≤ realSupportFunction T z :=
    closure_minimal hbase hclosed
  have hbound : BddAbove ((fun x => inner ℝ z x) '' closure (convexHull ℝ T)) :=
    ⟨realSupportFunction T z, by rintro _ ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩; exact hb x hx⟩
  obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := exists_inner_eq_realSupportFunction hT hne z
  have hsubset : T ⊆ closure (convexHull ℝ T) := (subset_convexHull ℝ T).trans subset_closure
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact csSup_le ((hne.mono hsubset).image _)
      (by rintro _ ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩; exact hb y hy)
  · rw [← he]
    exact le_csSup hbound ⟨x,hsubset hx,rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sum_sq_sub_le_card_mul_dist
statement:
private lemma sqrt_sum_sq_sub_le_card_mul_dist {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2) ≤ Fintype.card ι * dist x y
proof:
:= by
  refine (sqrt_sum_sq_le_sum_abs (fun i => x i - y i)).trans ?_
  calc ∑ i, |x i - y i| ≤ ∑ _i : ι, dist x y := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact dist_le_pi_dist x y i
    _ = Fintype.card ι * dist x y := by simp

name: NLAlib.continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_sqrt_sum_sq
statement:
theorem continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_sqrt_sum_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) : Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ (L * Fintype.card ι) * dist x y := by
    intro x y
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    refine (hLip x y).trans ?_
    rw [mul_assoc]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hL
    refine (sqrt_sum_sq_le_sum_abs (fun i => x i - y i)).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i, |x i - y i| ≤ ∑ _i : ι, dist x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
          rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact dist_le_pi_dist x y i
      _ = Fintype.card ι * dist x y := by simp
  exact (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le' h).continuous

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_fderiv_le_sq_of_lipschitz
statement:
theorem sum_sq_fderiv_le_sq_of_lipschitz {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (g : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Differentiable ℝ g) (L : ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, |g x - g y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, (fderiv ℝ g x (Pi.single i 1)) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set D := fderiv ℝ g x with hD
  set v : ι → ℝ := fun i => D (Pi.single i 1) with hv
  set S := ∑ i, v i ^ 2 with hS
  have hDv : D v = S := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single v]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have : (Pi.single i (v i) : ι → ℝ) = v i • Pi.single i 1 := by
      ext j; by_cases h : j = i
      · subst h; simp
      · simp [h]
    rw [this, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, sq]
  have hderiv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => g (x + t • v)) S 0 := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add x
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt g D (x + (0:ℝ) • v) := by
      simpa using (hg x).hasFDerivAt
    rw [← hDv]
    exact h2.comp_hasDerivAt (x := (0:ℝ)) h1
  have ht := hderiv.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hle : S ≤ L * Real.sqrt S := by
    refine le_of_tendsto ht ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t (htp : 0 < t)
    have h := hLip (x + (0 + t) • v) (x + (0:ℝ) • v)
    have hsq : ∑ i, ((x + (0 + t) • v) i - (x + (0:ℝ) • v) i) ^ 2 = t ^ 2 * S := by
      rw [hS, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp; ring
    rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg t), Real.sqrt_sq htp.le] at h
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    have h3 := (le_abs_self _).trans h
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ htp]
    simp only [zero_add] at h3 ⊢
    linarith
  rcases hS0.eq_or_lt with h0 | h0
  · rw [← h0]; positivity
  · have hsp : 0 < Real.sqrt S := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h0
    have hsL : Real.sqrt S ≤ L := by
      have : Real.sqrt S * Real.sqrt S ≤ L * Real.sqrt S := by
        rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hS0]; exact hle
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hsp
    have : S = Real.sqrt S ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hS0).symm
    rw [this]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hsp.le hsL 2

name: NLAlib.exists_contDiff_abs_sub_le_of_lipschitz
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_abs_sub_le_of_lipschitz {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ) (hLip : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n g) ∧
      (∀ x y, |g x - g y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) ∧
      ∀ x, |g x - f x| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  set C : ℝ := |L| * Fintype.card ι with hC
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
  have hdist : ∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ C * dist x y := by
    intro x y
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    refine (hLip x y).trans ?_
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self L) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans ?_
    rw [hC, mul_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sqrt_sum_sq_sub_le_card_mul_dist x y) (abs_nonneg L)
  have hcont : Continuous f := (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le' hdist).continuous
  set r : ℝ := ε / (C + 1) with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := div_pos hε (by linarith)
  have hCr : C * r ≤ ε := by
    rw [hr, mul_div_assoc']
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  let φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ι → ℝ) := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr0, half_lt_self hr0⟩
  set ψ : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ := φ.normed (volume : Measure (ι → ℝ)) with hψ
  set g : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ :=
    convolution ψ f (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) (volume : Measure (ι → ℝ)) with hg
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrable f (volume : Measure (ι → ℝ)) := hcont.locallyIntegrable
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g :=
    φ.hasCompactSupport_normed.contDiff_convolution_left _ φ.contDiff_normed hloc
  have hgdef : ∀ x, g x = ∫ t, ψ t * f (x - t) := by
    intro x
    rw [hg, convolution_lsmul]
    rfl
  have hint : ∀ x, Integrable (fun t => ψ t * f (x - t)) (volume : Measure (ι → ℝ)) := by
    intro x
    have := (φ.hasCompactSupport_normed (μ := volume)).convolutionExists_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) (φ.continuous_normed (μ := volume)) hloc x
    exact this
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact hsmooth.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  · intro x y
    rw [hgdef x, hgdef y, ← integral_sub (hint x) (hint y)]
    have hb : ∀ t, |ψ t * f (x - t) - ψ t * f (y - t)|
        ≤ ψ t * (L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) := by
      intro t
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (φ.nonneg_normed (μ := volume) t)]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (φ.nonneg_normed (μ := volume) t)
      have := hLip (x - t) (y - t)
      simpa using this
    calc |∫ t, (ψ t * f (x - t) - ψ t * f (y - t))|
        ≤ ∫ t, |ψ t * f (x - t) - ψ t * f (y - t)| := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ t, ψ t * (L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) := by
          refine integral_mono ((hint x).sub (hint y)).abs ?_ hb
          exact (φ.integrable_normed (μ := volume)).mul_const _
      _ = L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2) := by
          rw [integral_mul_const, φ.integral_normed (μ := volume), one_mul]
  · intro x
    rw [← Real.dist_eq]
    refine φ.dist_normed_convolution_le hcont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    intro y hy
    refine (hdist y x).trans ?_
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Metric.mem_ball.mp hy).le hC0).trans ?_
    exact hCr

name: NLAlib.exists_linearIsometry_comp_eq_of_norm_eq
statement:
theorem exists_linearIsometry_comp_eq_of_norm_eq {𝕜 E F : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F]
    (A B : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (h : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ = ‖B x‖) :
    ∃ U : F →ₗᵢ[𝕜] F, U.toLinearMap.comp B = A
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker B ≤ LinearMap.ker A := by
    intro x hx
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    rw [h x, show B x = 0 from hx, norm_zero]
  let L₀ := (LinearMap.ker B).liftQ A hker
  let L₁ := L₀.comp B.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap
  have happly (x : E) : L₁ ⟨B x, LinearMap.mem_range_self B x⟩ = A x := by
    change L₀ (B.quotKerEquivRange.symm (B.quotKerEquivRange (Submodule.Quotient.mk x))) = A x
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  let L : LinearMap.range B →ₗᵢ[𝕜] F :=
    { toLinearMap := L₁
      norm_map' := by
        intro y
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := y.property
        have hy : y = ⟨B x, LinearMap.mem_range_self B x⟩ := Subtype.ext hx.symm
        rw [hy, happly]
        exact h x }
  refine ⟨L.extend, ?_⟩
  ext x
  exact (L.extend_apply ⟨B x, LinearMap.mem_range_self B x⟩).trans (happly x)

name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.measure_mem_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem IndepFun.measure_mem_le_of_forall
    {X : Ω → α} {Y : Ω → β} (hind : IndepFun X Y μ)
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hY : HasLaw Y ν μ)
    {s : Set (α × β)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) {c : ENNReal}
    (hbound : ∀ x, ν {y | (x, y) ∈ s} ≤ c) :
    μ {ω | (X ω, Y ω) ∈ s} ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have hXL : HasLaw X (μ.map X) μ := ⟨hX, rfl⟩
  have hXY := hind.hasLaw_prod hXL hY
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  calc
    μ {ω | (X ω, Y ω) ∈ s} = ((μ.map X).prod ν) s := hXY.measure_eq hs
    _ = ∫⁻ x, ν {y | (x, y) ∈ s} ∂μ.map X := Measure.prod_apply hs
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _x, c ∂μ.map X := lintegral_mono hbound
    _ = c := by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.condExp_comp_eq_const
statement:
theorem IndepFun.condExp_comp_eq_const
    {X : Ω → α} {Y : Ω → β} (hind : IndepFun X Y μ)
    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : HasLaw Y ν μ) {f : α × β → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f ((μ.map X).prod ν)) {c : ℝ}
    (hmean : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map X, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂ν = c) :
    μ[fun ω => f (X ω, Y ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ]
      fun _ => c
proof:
:= by
  have hXL : HasLaw X (μ.map X) μ := ⟨hX.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have hXY := hind.hasLaw_prod hXL hY
  have hfi : Integrable (fun ω => f (X ω, Y ω)) μ := by
    have hf' : Integrable f (μ.map fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := by rwa [hXY.map_eq]
    exact hf'.comp_aemeasurable hXY.aemeasurable
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX.aemeasurable
  refine (ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq hX.comap_le hfi
    (fun s _ _ => (integrable_const c).integrableOn) ?_
    aestronglyMeasurable_const).symm
  rintro s ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ _
  let u : Set (α × β) := Prod.fst ⁻¹' t
  have hu : MeasurableSet u := ht.preimage measurable_fst
  have hIf := hf.indicator hu
  have hIc : Integrable (u.indicator (fun _ : α × β => c)) ((μ.map X).prod ν) :=
    (integrable_const c).indicator hu
  have hleft := hXY.integral_comp hIc.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hright := hXY.integral_comp hIf.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← integral_indicator (ht.preimage hX), ← integral_indicator (ht.preimage hX)]
  change (∫ ω, (u.indicator (fun _ : α × β => c)) (X ω, Y ω) ∂μ) =
    ∫ ω, (u.indicator f) (X ω, Y ω) ∂μ
  rw [show (∫ ω, (u.indicator (fun _ : α × β => c)) (X ω, Y ω) ∂μ) =
    ∫ p, (u.indicator (fun _ : α × β => c)) p ∂((μ.map X).prod ν) from hleft,
    show (∫ ω, (u.indicator f) (X ω, Y ω) ∂μ) =
    ∫ p, (u.indicator f) p ∂((μ.map X).prod ν) from hright,
    integral_prod _ hIc, integral_prod _ hIf]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hmean] with x hx
  by_cases hxt : x ∈ t
  · simpa [u, hxt] using hx.symm
  · simp [u, hxt]

name: ProbabilityTheory.covariance_le_sqrt_variance_mul_sqrt_variance
statement:
theorem covariance_le_sqrt_variance_mul_sqrt_variance
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 μ) :
    cov[X, Y; μ] ≤ Real.sqrt (Var[X; μ]) * Real.sqrt (Var[Y; μ])
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun ω => X ω - ∫ x, X x ∂μ
  let g := fun ω => Y ω - ∫ x, Y x ∂μ
  have hf : MemLp f 2 μ := hX.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hg : MemLp g 2 μ := hY.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hfg : Integrable (fun ω => f ω * g ω) μ := hf.integrable_mul hg
  have hfgabs : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ * ‖g ω‖) μ := hf.norm.integrable_mul hg.norm
  have hc := integral_mul_norm_le_Lp_mul_Lq Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
    (show MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal 2) μ by simpa using hf)
    (show MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal 2) μ by simpa using hg)
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) : f ω * g ω ≤ ‖f ω‖ * ‖g ω‖ := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul] using le_abs_self (f ω * g ω)
  have hle := (integral_mono hfg hfgabs hpoint).trans hc
  rw [variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable, variance_eq_integral hY.aemeasurable]
  simpa only [covariance, f, g, Real.rpow_two, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using hle

name: ProbabilityTheory.variance_add_le_mul_sq_add_of_le_mul_sq
statement:
theorem variance_add_le_mul_sq_add_of_le_mul_sq
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 μ) {c a b : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hVX : Var[X; μ] ≤ c * a ^ 2) (hVY : Var[Y; μ] ≤ c * b ^ 2) :
    Var[fun ω => X ω + Y ω; μ] ≤ c * (a + b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hx : Real.sqrt (Var[X; μ]) ≤ Real.sqrt c * a := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ha, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hc] using hVX
  have hy : Real.sqrt (Var[Y; μ]) ≤ Real.sqrt c * b := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hb, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hc] using hVY
  have hcov := (covariance_le_sqrt_variance_mul_sqrt_variance hX hY).trans
    (mul_le_mul hx hy (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ha))
  rw [variance_fun_add hX hY]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hc
  nlinarith

name: MeasureTheory.integral_norm_sq_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    {X : Ω → κ → ℝ} {Y : Ω' → κ → ℝ}
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 ν)
    (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Y ω ∂ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j, cov[(fun ω => X ω i), (fun ω => X ω j); μ] =
      cov[(fun ω => Y ω i), (fun ω => Y ω j); ν])
    (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖L (X ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∫ ω, ‖L (Y ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let R := Complex.reCLM.comp L
  let I := Complex.imCLM.comp L
  let B := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp R R +
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp I I
  have hB (x : κ → ℝ) : B x x = ‖L x‖ ^ 2 := by
    change (L x).re * (L x).re + (L x).im * (L x).im = ‖L x‖ ^ 2
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
  have hm (i : κ) : (∫ ω, X ω i ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Y ω i ∂ν := by
    let P : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj i
    exact (P.integral_comp_comm (hX.integrable one_le_two)).trans
      ((congrArg P hmean).trans (P.integral_comp_comm (hY.integrable one_le_two)).symm)
  have hs := NLAlib.integral_mul_coordinates_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq hX hY hm hcov
  have h := NLAlib.integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_of_second_moments_eq B hX hY hs
  simpa only [hB] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasLaw_iff_map_eq
statement:
theorem hasLaw_iff_map_eq {Ω 𝓧 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace 𝓧]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure 𝓧} {X : Ω → 𝓧} (hν : ν ≠ 0) :
    HasLaw X ν μ ↔ μ.map X = ν
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.map_eq, fun h => ⟨AEMeasurable.of_map_ne_zero (h ▸ hν), h⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.bilin_quadratic_pi_expansion
statement:
private theorem bilin_quadratic_pi_expansion
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    B x (L x) = ∑ i, ∑ j, (x i * x j) • B (Pi.single i 1) (L (Pi.single j 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : B x (L x) = ∑ i, x i • B (Pi.single i 1) (L x) := by
    simpa only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_apply, smul_apply] using
      congrArg (fun v : κ → ℝ => B v (L x)) (pi_eq_sum_univ' x)
  have hL : L x = ∑ j, x j • L (Pi.single j 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' x]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  rw [hx, hL]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.quadratic_coefficient_bound
statement:
private theorem quadratic_coefficient_bound
    (T : V → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (C : ℝ) (hT : ∀ v, ‖T v‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) (i j : κ) (v : V) :
    ‖B (Pi.single i 1) (T v (Pi.single j 1))‖ ≤
      ‖B (Pi.single i 1)‖ * (C * ‖(Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : κ → ℝ)‖)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((B (Pi.single i 1)).le_opNorm _).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((T v).le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hT v) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)))

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_quadratic_of_memLp
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_quadratic_of_memLp
    (D : Ω → κ → ℝ) (hD : MemLp D 2 P) (W : Ω → V) (hW : AEMeasurable W P)
    (T : V → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hTc : Continuous T)
    (C : ℝ) (hT : ∀ v, ‖T v‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => B (D ω) (T (W ω) (D ω))) P
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i j : κ) : Integrable
      (fun ω => (D ω i * D ω j) • B (Pi.single i 1) (T (W ω) (Pi.single j 1))) P := by
    have hprod : Integrable (fun ω => D ω i * D ω j) P :=
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).memLp_of_bilin 1 (hD.eval i) (hD.eval j)).integrable le_rfl
    have hGc : Continuous (fun v => B (Pi.single i 1) (T v (Pi.single j 1))) :=
      (B _).continuous.comp (hTc.clm_apply continuous_const)
    exact hprod.smul_bdd _ (hGc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hW).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => quadratic_coefficient_bound T C hT B i j (W ω))
  have hs := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hi i j))
  exact hs.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ω =>
    (bilin_quadratic_pi_expansion B (T (W ω)) (D ω)).symm)

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_of_indepFun
    (D : Ω → κ → ℝ) (hD : MemLp D 2 P) (W : Ω → V) (hW : AEMeasurable W P)
    (hDW : IndepFun D W P)
    (T : V → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hTc : Continuous T)
    (C : ℝ) (hT : ∀ v, ‖T v‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ ω, B (D ω) (T (W ω) (D ω)) ∂P) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (∫ ω, D ω i * D ω j ∂P) •
        ∫ ω, B (Pi.single i 1) (T (W ω) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have hprod (i j : κ) : Integrable (fun ω => D ω i * D ω j) P :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).memLp_of_bilin 1 (hD.eval i) (hD.eval j)).integrable le_rfl
  have hGc (i j : κ) : Continuous (fun v => B (Pi.single i 1) (T v (Pi.single j 1))) :=
    (B _).continuous.comp (hTc.clm_apply continuous_const)
  have hG (i j : κ) : Integrable
      (fun ω => B (Pi.single i 1) (T (W ω) (Pi.single j 1))) P :=
    Integrable.of_bound ((hGc i j).measurable.comp_aemeasurable hW).aestronglyMeasurable _
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => quadratic_coefficient_bound T C hT B i j (W ω))
  have hind (i j : κ) : IndepFun (fun ω => D ω i * D ω j)
      (fun ω => B (Pi.single i 1) (T (W ω) (Pi.single j 1))) P :=
    hDW.comp (show Measurable (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * x j) by fun_prop)
      (hGc i j).measurable
  have hi (i j : κ) := (hind i j).integrable_smul (hprod i j) (hG i j)
  have he : (fun ω => B (D ω) (T (W ω) (D ω))) =
      fun ω => ∑ i, ∑ j, (D ω i * D ω j) • B (Pi.single i 1) (T (W ω) (Pi.single j 1)) := by
    funext ω
    exact bilin_quadratic_pi_expansion B (T (W ω)) (D ω)
  rw [he, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hi i j))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi'
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi i j)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj'
  exact (hind i j).integral_fun_smul_eq_smul_integral
    (hprod i j).aestronglyMeasurable (hG i j).aestronglyMeasurable

name: MeasureTheory.integral_stoppedValue_le_integral_zero_of_supermartingale
statement:
theorem integral_stoppedValue_le_integral_zero_of_supermartingale
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {ℱ : Filtration ℕ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›}
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration μ ℱ] {S : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hS : Supermartingale S ℱ μ)
    {τ : Ω → ℕ∞} (hτ : IsStoppingTime ℱ τ) {N : ℕ} (hbdd : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ N) :
    (∫ ω, stoppedValue S τ ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := hS.neg.expected_stoppedValue_mono (isStoppingTime_const ℱ 0) hτ
    (fun _ => bot_le) hbdd
  rw [stoppedValue_const] at h
  change (∫ ω, -S 0 ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, -(stoppedValue S τ ω) ∂μ at h
  rw [integral_neg, integral_neg, neg_le_neg_iff] at h
  exact h

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_exists_le_nat_le_supermartingale_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_le_nat_le_supermartingale_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ℱ : Filtration ℕ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} {S : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hS : Supermartingale S ℱ μ)
    (hNonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] S k) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (N : ℕ) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ N, c ≤ S k ω} ≤ (∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ) / c
proof:
:= by
  let τ : Ω → ℕ∞ := fun ω => (hittingBtwn S (Ici c) 0 N ω : ℕ)
  have hτ : IsStoppingTime ℱ τ :=
    hS.stronglyAdapted.adapted.isStoppingTime_hittingBtwn measurableSet_Ici
  have hbdd : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ N := fun ω => by
    change ((hittingBtwn S (Ici c) 0 N ω : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (N : ℕ∞)
    exact_mod_cast (hittingBtwn_le (u := S) (s := Ici c) (n := 0) (m := N) (ω := ω))
  let R : Ω → ℝ := stoppedValue S τ
  have hRI : Integrable R μ := integrable_stoppedValue ℕ hτ hS.integrable hbdd
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] R := by
    have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ S k ω := ae_all_iff.mpr hNonneg
    filter_upwards [hall] with ω hω
    exact hω (τ ω).untopA
  have hcross : {ω | ∃ k ≤ N, c ≤ S k ω} ⊆ {ω | c ≤ R ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkc⟩ := hω
    exact stoppedValue_hittingBtwn_mem ⟨k, ⟨Nat.zero_le k, hk⟩, hkc⟩
  have hbound : c * μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ N, c ≤ S k ω} ≤ ∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ := by
    calc c * μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ N, c ≤ S k ω} ≤ c * μ.real {ω | c ≤ R ω} :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (measureReal_mono hcross) hc.le
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, R ω ∂μ := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hR0 hRI c
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ := integral_stoppedValue_le_integral_zero_of_supermartingale hS hτ hbdd
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hbound

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_exists_le_supermartingale_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_le_supermartingale_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ℱ : Filtration ℕ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} {S : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hS : Supermartingale S ℱ μ)
    (hNonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] S k) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k, c ≤ S k ω} ≤ (∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ) / c
proof:
:= by
  let E : ℕ → Set Ω := fun N => {ω | ∃ k ≤ N, c ≤ S k ω}
  have hmono : Monotone E := by
    intro a b hab ω hω
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hc⟩ := hω
    exact ⟨k, hk.trans hab, hc⟩
  have heq : {ω | ∃ k, c ≤ S k ω} = ⋃ N, E N := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact ⟨k, k, le_rfl, hk⟩
    · rintro ⟨N, k, hkN, hk⟩
      exact ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hbound : μ {ω | ∃ k, c ≤ S k ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ) / c) := by
    rw [heq, hmono.measure_iUnion]
    apply iSup_le
    intro N
    calc μ (E N) = ENNReal.ofReal (μ (E N)).toReal :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ (E N))).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ) / c) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        (measureReal_exists_le_nat_le_supermartingale_le hS hNonneg hc N)
  have h0 : 0 ≤ (∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂μ) / c := div_nonneg (integral_nonneg_of_ae (hNonneg 0)) hc.le
  simpa only [measureReal_def, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h0] using ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp) hbound

name: PMF.toReal_bind_eq_sum
statement:
theorem toReal_bind_eq_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α)
    (q : α → PMF β) (b : β) :
    ((p.bind q) b).toReal = ∑ a, (p a).toReal * (q a b).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [bind_apply, tsum_fintype, ENNReal.toReal_sum]
  · simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  · intro a _
    exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (p.apply_ne_top a) ((q a).apply_ne_top b)

name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.measureReal_mem_le_add
statement:
theorem IndepFun.measureReal_mem_le_add [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {α β : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] {X : Ω → α} {Y : Ω → β} (hXY : IndepFun X Y μ)
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y μ) {E : Set (α × β)} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    {G : Set β} (hG : MeasurableSet G) {δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ} (hδ₁ : 0 ≤ δ₁)
    (hsec : ∀ y ∈ G, μ.real {ω | (X ω, y) ∈ E} ≤ δ₁) (hGc : μ.real {ω | Y ω ∉ G} ≤ δ₂) :
    μ.real {ω | (X ω, Y ω) ∈ E} ≤ δ₁ + δ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hδ₂ : 0 ≤ δ₂ := measureReal_nonneg.trans hGc
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map Y) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY
  have hslice (y : β) : MeasurableSet ((fun x => (x, y)) ⁻¹' E) :=
    measurable_prodMk_right hE
  have hjoint : μ {ω | (X ω, Y ω) ∈ E} =
      ∫⁻ y, μ {ω | (X ω, y) ∈ E} ∂(μ.map Y) := by
    have h1 : μ {ω | (X ω, Y ω) ∈ E} = (μ.map fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) E := by
      rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hX.prodMk hY) hE]
      rfl
    rw [h1, (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX hY).1 hXY, Measure.prod_apply_symm hE]
    exact lintegral_congr fun y => Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hX (hslice y)
  have hG' : (μ.map Y) Gᶜ = μ {ω | Y ω ∉ G} := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hY hG.compl]
    rfl
  have hle : μ {ω | (X ω, Y ω) ∈ E} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ + ENNReal.ofReal δ₂ := by
    rw [hjoint, ← lintegral_add_compl _ hG]
    gcongr
    · calc ∫⁻ y in G, μ {ω | (X ω, y) ∈ E} ∂(μ.map Y) ≤ ∫⁻ _ in G, ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ ∂(μ.map Y) :=
            setLIntegral_mono' hG fun y hy => by
              rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _)]
              exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hsec y hy)
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
            rw [setLIntegral_const]
            exact mul_le_of_le_one_right' prob_le_one
    · calc ∫⁻ y in Gᶜ, μ {ω | (X ω, y) ∈ E} ∂(μ.map Y) ≤ ∫⁻ _ in Gᶜ, 1 ∂(μ.map Y) :=
            setLIntegral_mono' hG.compl fun _ _ => prob_le_one
        _ = μ {ω | Y ω ∉ G} := by rw [setLIntegral_const, one_mul, hG']
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₂ := by
            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _)]
            exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hGc
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add hδ₁ hδ₂] at hle
  exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (add_nonneg hδ₁ hδ₂) hle

name: MeasureTheory.integral_inv_card_smul_sum_pi
statement:
theorem integral_inv_card_smul_sum_pi
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ ω : ι → Ω, (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, f (ω i)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω : ι → Ω => f (ω i)) (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) :=
    (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : ι => μ) i).integrable_comp_of_integrable hf
  rw [integral_smul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)]
  have he (i : ι) : (∫ ω : ι → Ω, f (ω i) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ :=
    integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : ι => μ) (i := i) hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [he, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := ι)), one_smul]

name: MeasureTheory.variance_inv_card_mul_sum_pi
statement:
theorem variance_inv_card_mul_sum_pi
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) :
    Var[fun ω : ι → Ω => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, f (ω i);
      Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)] = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * Var[f; μ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [variance_const_mul]
  have hs := variance_sum_pi (fun _ : ι => hf)
  have he : (∑ i : ι, (fun ω : ι → Ω => f (ω i))) =
      (fun ω : ι → Ω => ∑ i, f (ω i)) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [he] at hs
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  by_cases h : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) = 0
  · simp [h]
  · field_simp

name: MeasureTheory.integral_centered_average_sq_pi
statement:
theorem integral_centered_average_sq_pi
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    (ν : Measure ι) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (f : ι → ℝ) {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ ω : Fin c → ι, ((1 / (c : ℝ)) * ∑ j, f (ω j) - ∫ i, f i ∂ν) ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) * (∫ i, f i ^ 2 ∂ν - (∫ i, f i ∂ν) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcR : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc.ne'
  have hL : MemLp f 2 ν :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (AEStronglyMeasurable.of_discrete)).mpr .of_finite
  let X : (Fin c → ι) → ℝ := fun ω => (1 / (c : ℝ)) * ∑ j, f (ω j)
  have hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin c => ν) = ∫ i, f i ∂ν := by
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun _ _ => .of_finite)]
    have heval : ∀ j : Fin c,
        ∫ ω, f (ω j) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin c => ν) = ∫ i, f i ∂ν := by
      intro j
      exact integral_comp_eval (show AEStronglyMeasurable f ν from .of_discrete)
    simp only [heval, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have hvar : variance X (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin c => ν)) =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) * (∫ i, f i ^ 2 ∂ν - (∫ i, f i ∂ν) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [variance_const_mul]
    have hsum := variance_sum_pi (fun _ : Fin c => hL)
    have hfun : (∑ j : Fin c, (fun ω : Fin c → ι => f (ω j))) =
        (fun ω : Fin c → ι => ∑ j, f (ω j)) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hfun] at hsum
    rw [hsum, variance_eq_sub hL]
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  rw [variance_eq_integral (show AEMeasurable X _ from Measurable.of_discrete.aemeasurable),
    hmean] at hvar
  exact hvar

name: MeasureTheory.integral_centered_average_norm_sq_pi
statement:
theorem integral_centered_average_norm_sq_pi
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    (ν : Measure ι) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (f : ι → ℂ) {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ ω : Fin c → ι, ‖(1 / (c : ℝ)) • ∑ j, f (ω j) - ∫ i, f i ∂ν‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) * (∫ i, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 ∂ν - ‖∫ i, f i ∂ν‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  have hr := integral_centered_average_sq_pi ν (fun i => (f i).re) hc
  have hi := integral_centered_average_sq_pi ν (fun i => (f i).im) hc
  simp_rw [hnorm, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.smul_re,
    Complex.smul_im, Complex.re_sum, Complex.im_sum, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [integral_add .of_finite .of_finite, integral_add .of_finite .of_finite]
  have hre : (∫ i, f i ∂ν).re = ∫ i, (f i).re ∂ν := by
    simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using (integral_re (show Integrable f ν from .of_finite)).symm
  have him : (∫ i, f i ∂ν).im = ∫ i, (f i).im ∂ν := by
    simpa only [RCLike.im_eq_complex_im] using (integral_im (show Integrable f ν from .of_finite)).symm
  rw [hre, him, hr, hi]
  ring

name: NLAlib.subgamma_parameter
proof:
:= by
  let q := sqrt (2 * V * a)
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hqsq : q ^ 2 = 2 * V * a := sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  let D := q + 2 * c * a
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  let θ := 2 * a / D
  have hθ : 0 < θ := div_pos (by positivity) hD
  have hdom : c * θ < 1 := by
    dsimp [θ]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_one hD]
    dsimp [D]
    linarith
  refine ⟨θ, hθ, hdom, ?_⟩
  have hid : 1 - c * θ = q / D := by dsimp [θ, D]; field_simp; ring
  rw [hid]
  change a + V * (2 * a / D) ^ 2 / (2 * (q / D)) =
    (2 * a / D) * (q + c * a)
  field_simp [hD.ne', hq.ne']
  dsimp [D]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_ge_le_of_subgamma_mgf
statement:
theorem measureReal_ge_le_of_subgamma_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d V c θ t : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hexp : Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤
      d * exp (V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)))) :
    μ.real {ω | m + t ≤ X ω} ≤
      d * exp (-θ * t + V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf (X := fun ω => X ω - m) t hθ hexp
  have hset : {ω | m + t ≤ X ω} = {ω | t ≤ X ω - m} := by
    ext ω
    change m + t ≤ X ω ↔ t ≤ X ω - m
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  rw [hset]
  apply h.trans
  change exp (-θ * t) * (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ exp (-θ * t) * (d * exp (V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmgf (exp_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (exp _) d, mul_assoc, ← exp_add]

name: NLAlib.ae_le_of_bounded_positive_mgf
statement:
private theorem ae_le_of_bounded_positive_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d : ℝ}
    (hexp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤ d) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  apply (ae_le_const_iff_forall_gt_measure_zero X m).mpr
  intro b hb
  apply (measureReal_eq_zero_iff (μ := μ) (s := {ω | b ≤ X ω}) (by finiteness)).mp
  apply le_antisymm _ measureReal_nonneg
  have hinfty : Tendsto (fun θ : ℝ => -θ * (b - m)) atTop atBot := by
    convert! tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp
      (tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop (sub_pos.mpr hb)) using 1
    funext θ
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, id_eq]
    ring
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun θ : ℝ => d * exp (-θ * (b - m))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_zero] using
      (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp hinfty).const_mul d
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds hlim
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with θ hθ
  have hh := measureReal_ge_le_of_subgamma_mgf (V := 0) (c := 0)
    (t := b - m) hθ (hexp θ hθ) (by simpa using hmgf θ hθ)
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel, zero_mul, zero_div, sub_zero, add_zero] using hh

name: NLAlib.measureReal_ge_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf_pos
statement:
theorem measureReal_ge_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf_pos
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d V c : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hexp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤ d * exp (V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ))))
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    μ.real {ω | m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s ≤ X ω} ≤ d * exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hdom, hopt⟩ := subgamma_parameter hs hV hc
  have heq : -θ * (sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s) +
      V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)) = -s := by linarith
  have hh := measureReal_ge_le_of_subgamma_mgf hθ.le (hexp θ hθ.le hdom)
    (hmgf θ hθ.le hdom) (t := sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s)
  simpa only [heq, add_assoc] using hh

name: NLAlib.measureReal_ge_le_of_zero_variance_subgamma_mgf
statement:
private theorem measureReal_ge_le_of_zero_variance_subgamma_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d c s : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hexp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤ d) :
    μ.real {ω | m + c * s ≤ X ω} ≤ d * exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)
  let θ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (1 - ε n) / c
  have hεpos (n : ℕ) : 0 < ε n := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  have hεlt (n : ℕ) : ε n < 1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
    linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)]
  have hθpos (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ θ n := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hεlt n).le) hc.le
  have hdom (n : ℕ) : c * θ n < 1 := by
    have heq : c * θ n = 1 - ε n := by dsimp [θ]; field_simp
    rw [heq]
    linarith [hεpos n]
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : μ.real {ω | m + c * s ≤ X ω} ≤ d * exp (-θ n * (c * s)) := by
    have hh := measureReal_ge_le_of_subgamma_mgf (V := 0) (c := c) (t := c * s)
      (hθpos n) (hexp (θ n) (hθpos n) (hdom n))
      (by simpa using hmgf (θ n) (hθpos n) (hdom n))
    simpa only [zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero] using hh
  have hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ε, Function.comp_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] using
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hθlim : Tendsto θ atTop (𝓝 (1 / c)) := by
    simpa only [θ, sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hεlim).div_const c
  have heq : -(1 / c) * (c * s) = -s := by field_simp
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => d * exp (-θ n * (c * s))) atTop (𝓝 (d * exp (-s))) := by
    have hh := (Real.continuous_exp.tendsto (-(1 / c) * (c * s))).comp
      (hθlim.neg.mul_const (c * s))
    simpa only [heq, Function.comp_def] using hh.const_mul d
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds hlim (Eventually.of_forall hbound)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_gt_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d V c : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hexp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤ d * exp (V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ))))
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    μ.real {ω | m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s < X ω} ≤ d * exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with rfl | hs
  · simpa only [neg_zero, exp_zero, mul_one] using measureReal_le_one.trans hd
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hV with rfl | hV
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with rfl | hc
    · have hae := ae_le_of_bounded_positive_mgf
        (fun θ hθ => hexp θ hθ (by simp))
        (fun θ hθ => by simpa using hmgf θ hθ (by simp))
      have hz : μ {ω | m < X ω} = 0 := by simpa only [not_le] using ae_iff.mp hae
      have hzr : μ.real {ω | m < X ω} = 0 := (measureReal_eq_zero_iff (by finiteness)).mpr hz
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sqrt_zero, add_zero, hzr]
      exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (exp_pos _).le
    · simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sqrt_zero, add_zero]
      have hmono : μ.real {ω | m + c * s < X ω} ≤ μ.real {ω | m + c * s ≤ X ω} :=
        measureReal_mono (by
          intro ω h
          change m + c * s ≤ X ω
          exact (show m + c * s < X ω from h).le)
      exact hmono.trans (measureReal_ge_le_of_zero_variance_subgamma_mgf hc hexp
        (fun θ hθ hdom => by simpa using hmgf θ hθ hdom) (s := s))
  · have hmono : μ.real {ω | m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s < X ω} ≤
        μ.real {ω | m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s ≤ X ω} :=
      measureReal_mono (by
        intro ω h
        change m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s ≤ X ω
        exact (show m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s < X ω from h).le)
    exact hmono.trans (measureReal_ge_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf_pos hV hc hexp hmgf hs)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_ge_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf
statement:
theorem measureReal_ge_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d V c : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hnd : 0 < V ∨ 0 < c)
    (hexp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →

    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    μ.real {ω | m + sqrt (2 * V * s) + c * s ≤ X ω} ≤ d * exp (-s)
proof:
:= by

  · have hcpos : 0 < c := hnd.resolve_left (by simp)
    simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sqrt_zero, add_zero] using
      measureReal_ge_le_of_zero_variance_subgamma_mgf hcpos hexp

name: NLAlib.le_sqrt_add_of_subgamma_dual
statement:
private theorem le_sqrt_add_of_subgamma_dual {x a V c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hdual : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → c * θ < 1 →
      θ * x ≤ a + V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ))) :
    x ≤ sqrt (2 * V * a) + c * a
proof:
:= by
  have happrox (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
      x ≤ sqrt (2 * (V + δ) * (a + δ)) + c * (a + δ) := by
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hdom, hopt⟩ := subgamma_parameter (by linarith : 0 < a + δ)
      (by linarith : 0 < V + δ) hc
    have hden : 0 < 2 * (1 - c * θ) := by linarith
    have hfrac : V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)) ≤
        (V + δ) * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le) (sq_nonneg θ)) hden.le
    have hh := hdual θ hθ hdom
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (show θ * x ≤
      θ * (sqrt (2 * (V + δ) * (a + δ)) + c * (a + δ)) by linarith) hθ
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  have hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hcont : Continuous (fun δ : ℝ => sqrt (2 * (V + δ) * (a + δ)) + c * (a + δ)) := by fun_prop
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => sqrt (2 * (V + ε n) * (a + ε n)) + c * (a + ε n))
      atTop (𝓝 (sqrt (2 * V * a) + c * a)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, add_zero] using (hcont.tendsto 0).comp hεlim
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds hlim
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => happrox (ε n) (by dsimp [ε]; positivity))

name: NLAlib.integral_le_sqrt_log_add_of_subgamma_mgf
statement:
theorem integral_le_sqrt_log_add_of_subgamma_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X μ) {m d V c : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hexp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * (X ω - m))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → c * θ < 1 →
      (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω - m)) ∂μ) ≤ d * exp (V * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * θ)))) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) ≤ m + sqrt (2 * V * log d) + c * log d
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0 < d := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hd
  have hbound : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) - m ≤ sqrt (2 * V * log d) + c * log d := by
    apply le_sqrt_add_of_subgamma_dual (log_nonneg hd) hV hc
    intro θ hθ hdom
    have hj := convexOn_exp.map_integral_le continuous_exp.continuousOn isClosed_univ
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => mem_univ _))
      ((hX.sub (integrable_const m)).const_mul θ) (hexp θ hθ.le hdom)
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hj
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub hX (integrable_const m),
      integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hj
    apply exp_le_exp.mp
    exact hj.trans (by simpa only [exp_add, exp_log hdpos] using hmgf θ hθ.le hdom)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_gt_abs_sub_sqrt_add_le_of_sign_subgamma_mgf
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_abs_sub_sqrt_add_le_of_sign_subgamma_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {m d V c : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hexp : ∀ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → c * s < 1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * (e * (X ω - m)))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → c * s < 1 →
      (∫ ω, Real.exp (s * (e * (X ω - m))) ∂μ) ≤
        d * Real.exp (V * s ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * s))))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < |X ω - m|} ≤
      2 * d * Real.exp (-t)
proof:
:= by
  have htail (e : ℝ) (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) :
      μ.real {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < e * (X ω - m)} ≤
        d * Real.exp (-t) := by
    have h := measureReal_gt_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf
      (X := fun ω => e * (X ω - m)) (m := 0) hd hV hc
      (fun s hs hdom => by simpa only [sub_zero] using hexp e he s hs hdom)
      (fun s hs hdom => by simpa only [sub_zero] using hmgf e he s hs hdom) ht
    simpa only [zero_add] using h
  have hset : {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < |X ω - m|} ⊆
      {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < (1 : ℝ) * (X ω - m)} ∪
      {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < (-1 : ℝ) * (X ω - m)} := by
    intro ω hω
    change Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < |X ω - m| at hω
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (X ω - m) with h0 | h0
    · left
      change Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < (1 : ℝ) * (X ω - m)
      simpa only [one_mul, abs_of_nonneg h0] using hω
    · right
      change Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < (-1 : ℝ) * (X ω - m)
      simpa only [neg_one_mul, abs_of_neg h0] using hω
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < (1 : ℝ) * (X ω - m)} +
        μ.real {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * V * t) + c * t < (-1 : ℝ) * (X ω - m)} :=
      (measureReal_mono hset).trans (measureReal_union_le _ _)
    _ ≤ d * Real.exp (-t) + d * Real.exp (-t) :=
      add_le_add (htail 1 (Or.inl rfl)) (htail (-1) (Or.inr rfl))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_ofReal_exp_neg_half_Ioi_eq_two
statement:
private theorem lintegral_ofReal_exp_neg_half_Ioi_eq_two :
    (∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t / 2))) = ENNReal.ofReal 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t / 2)) = fun t => Real.exp ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) * t) := by
    funext t
    congr 1
    ring
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t / 2)) (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [he]
    exact integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < 0) 0
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (ae_of_all _ fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le),
    he, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < 0) 0]
  norm_num

name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_ofReal_two_mul_mul_exp_neg_half_Ioi_eq_eight
statement:
private theorem lintegral_ofReal_two_mul_mul_exp_neg_half_Ioi_eq_eight :
    (∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t * Real.exp (-t / 2))) = ENNReal.ofReal 8
proof:
:= by
  have hG := Real.integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
    (a := 2) (r := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hgamma : Real.Gamma 2 = 1 := by
    norm_num
  have he : (fun t : ℝ => t ^ ((2 : ℝ) - 1) * Real.exp (-((1 / 2) * t))) =
      fun t => t * Real.exp (-t / 2) := by
    funext t
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) - 1 = 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_one]
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [he, hgamma] at hG
  norm_num at hG
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) (Ioi 0) :=
    Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero (by rw [hG]; norm_num)
  have hi2 : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => 2 * t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) (Ioi 0) := by
    have he2 : (fun t : ℝ => 2 * t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) =
        fun t => 2 * (t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) := by funext t; ring
    rw [he2]
    exact hi.const_mul 2
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi2]
  · have he2 : (fun t : ℝ => 2 * t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) =
        fun t => 2 * (t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) := by funext t; ring
    rw [he2, integral_const_mul, hG]
    norm_num
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ht.le) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_and_integral_sq_le_of_exp_neg_half_tail
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_sq_le_of_exp_neg_half_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hf0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ {ω | t < f ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t / 2))) :
    Integrable f μ ∧ (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) ≤ 2 ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) μ ∧ (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (f ω) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 2 := by
    rw [lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt μ (ae_of_all _ hf0) hf.aemeasurable]
    calc (∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, μ {ω | t < f ω}) ≤
        ∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t / 2)) := by
          apply lintegral_mono_ae
          filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
          exact htail t ht
      _ = _ := lintegral_ofReal_exp_neg_half_Ioi_eq_two
  have hInt : ∀ z : ℝ, (∫ t in 0..z, 2 * t) = z ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]
    ring
  have hLC := lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul μ (ae_of_all _ hf0) hf.aemeasurable
    (g := fun t : ℝ => 2 * t)
    (fun t _ => (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).intervalIntegrable 0 t)
    (by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ht.le)
  simp only [hInt] at hLC
  have hL2 : (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (f ω ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 8 := by
    rw [hLC]
    calc (∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, μ {ω | t < f ω} * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t)) ≤
        ∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t / 2)) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t) := by
          apply lintegral_mono_ae
          filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (htail t ht) (by positivity)
      _ = ∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t * Real.exp (-t / 2)) := by
          apply lintegral_congr_ae
          exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
            change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t / 2)) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t) =
              ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t * Real.exp (-t / 2))
            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos _).le]
            congr 1
            ring
      _ = _ := lintegral_ofReal_two_mul_mul_exp_neg_half_Ioi_eq_eight
  have hi : Integrable f μ :=
    ⟨hf.aestronglyMeasurable, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ hf0)).mpr
      (hL.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)⟩
  have hi2 : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) μ :=
    ⟨(hf.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable,
      (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ fun ω => sq_nonneg (f ω))).mpr
        (hL2.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)⟩
  refine ⟨hi, ?_, hi2, ?_⟩
  · rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ hf0) hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by norm_num) hL
  · rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω => sq_nonneg (f ω))
      (hf.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by norm_num) hL2
