name: MeasureTheory.MeasureTheory.memLp_and_lpNorm_le_nat_of_exponential_tail
statement:
theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_le_nat_of_exponential_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ.real {ω | t < X ω} ≤ Real.exp (-t))
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    MemLp X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ∧ lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hqtop : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := by simp
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t) * t ^ ((q : ℝ) - 1))
      (Ioi 0) := Real.GammaIntegral_convergent hqr
  have hgnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))]
      fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t) * t ^ ((q : ℝ) - 1) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg ht.le _)
  have hGamma : (q : ℝ) * Real.Gamma q = (q.factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.Gamma_add_one hqr.ne', Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have hmoment : (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ (q : ℝ)) ∂μ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (q.factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul μ
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hnn) hX hqr]
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q : ℝ) *
          ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
            ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t) * t ^ ((q : ℝ) - 1)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply lintegral_mono_ae
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos _).le]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _)]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (htail t ht)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((q : ℝ) * Real.Gamma q) := by
        rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hg hgnn,
          ← Real.Gamma_eq_integral hqr, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hqr.le]
      _ = _ := by rw [hGamma]
  have hpowMeas : AEMeasurable (fun ω => X ω ^ (q : ℝ)) μ := hX.pow_const _
  have hpowNN : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => X ω ^ (q : ℝ) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => Real.rpow_nonneg (hnn ω) _
  have hpowInt : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ (q : ℝ)) μ := by
    refine ⟨hpowMeas.aestronglyMeasurable, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hpowNN).2 ?_⟩
    exact hmoment.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hmem : MemLp X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ := by
    apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hX.aestronglyMeasurable hq0 hqtop).mp
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnn _)]
      using hpowInt
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  have hpowLe : (∫ ω, X ω ^ (q : ℝ) ∂μ) ≤ (q.factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hpowNN hpowMeas.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hmoment
  have hfac : (q.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ (q : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow q
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal hq0 hqtop hX.aestronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnn _)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((q : ℝ) ^ (q : ℝ)) ^ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (integral_nonneg_of_ae hpowNN) (hpowLe.trans hfac)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr hqr.le)
    _ = q := by rw [← Real.rpow_mul hqr.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hqr.ne', Real.rpow_one]

name: MeasureTheory.MeasureTheory.memLp_and_lpNorm_le_of_shifted_exponential_tail
statement:
theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_le_of_shifted_exponential_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ.real {ω | a + b * t < X ω} ≤ Real.exp (-t))
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    MemLp X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ∧ lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ≤ a + b * q
proof:
:= by
  let Y : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => max (X ω - a) 0 / b
  have hY : AEMeasurable Y μ := ((hX.sub_const a).max aemeasurable_const).div_const b
  have hYnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Y ω := fun ω => div_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hb.le
  have hYtail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ.real {ω | t < Y ω} ≤ Real.exp (-t) := by
    intro t ht
    have he : {ω | t < Y ω} = {ω | a + b * t < X ω} := by
      ext ω
      change t < max (X ω - a) 0 / b ↔ _
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hb, lt_max_iff]
      have hbt : ¬t * b < 0 := not_lt.mpr (mul_nonneg ht.le hb.le)
      simp only [hbt, or_false]
      change t * b < X ω - a ↔ a + b * t < X ω
      constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
    rw [he]
    exact htail t ht
  obtain ⟨hYm, hYn⟩ := memLp_and_lpNorm_le_nat_of_exponential_tail μ Y hY hYnn hYtail q hq
  let G : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => a + b * Y ω
  have hGm : MemLp G (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ := (memLp_const a).add (hYm.const_mul b)
  have hdom : ∀ ω, ‖X ω‖ ≤ G ω := by
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnn ω)]
    dsimp [G, Y]
    rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hb.ne']
    linarith [le_max_left (X ω - a) 0]
  have hXm : MemLp X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ := hGm.of_le hX.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hdom ω).trans (le_abs_self _))
  refine ⟨hXm, (lpNorm_mono_real hGm hdom).trans ?_⟩
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  calc
    lpNorm G (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ≤ lpNorm (fun _ : Ω => a) (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ +
        lpNorm (fun ω => b * Y ω) (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ :=
      lpNorm_add_le (memLp_const a) hqone
    _ = a + b * lpNorm Y (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ := by
      rw [lpNorm_const' (by exact_mod_cast hq.ne') (by simp)]
      rw [show (fun ω => b * Y ω) = b • Y by rfl, lpNorm_const_smul]
      simp [Measure.real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_pos hb]
    _ ≤ a + b * q := by gcongr

name: ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem lintegral_of_indepFun {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    {X : Ωs → α} {Y : Ωs → β} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y μ)
    (hXY : IndepFun X Y μ) {g : α → β → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hg : AEMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ((μ.map X).prod (μ.map Y))) :
    ∫⁻ ω, g (X ω) (Y ω) ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, g x y ∂(μ.map Y) ∂(μ.map X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX hY).1 hXY
  have hg' : AEMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.map fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := by rwa [h]
  calc ∫⁻ ω, g (X ω) (Y ω) ∂μ
      = ∫⁻ p, Function.uncurry g p ∂(μ.map fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) :=
        (lintegral_map' hg' (hX.prodMk hY)).symm
    _ = ∫⁻ p, Function.uncurry g p ∂((μ.map X).prod (μ.map Y)) := by rw [h]
    _ = _ := lintegral_prod _ hg

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem integral_of_indepFun {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    {X : Ωs → α} {Y : Ωs → β} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y μ)
    (hXY : IndepFun X Y μ) {g : α → β → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable (fun p : α × β => g p.1 p.2) ((μ.map X).prod (μ.map Y))) :
    ∫ ω, g (X ω) (Y ω) ∂μ = ∫ x, ∫ y, g x y ∂(μ.map Y) ∂(μ.map X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX hY).1 hXY
  have hg' : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : α × β => g p.1 p.2)
      (μ.map fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := by rw [h]; exact hg.aestronglyMeasurable
  calc ∫ ω, g (X ω) (Y ω) ∂μ
      = ∫ p : α × β, g p.1 p.2 ∂(μ.map fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) :=
        (integral_map (hX.prodMk hY) hg').symm
    _ = ∫ p : α × β, g p.1 p.2 ∂((μ.map X).prod (μ.map Y)) := by rw [h]
    _ = _ := integral_prod _ hg

name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.integrable_exp_mul_norm
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_norm (μ : Measure E) [IsGaussian μ] (a : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => Real.exp (a * ‖x‖)) μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hi⟩ := exists_integrable_exp_sq μ
  have hb : ∀ r : ℝ, a * r ≤ C * r ^ 2 + a ^ 2 / (4 * C) := by
    intro r
    have hsq := sq_nonneg (r - a / (2 * C))
    field_simp at hsq ⊢
    nlinarith
  refine (hi.const_mul (Real.exp (a ^ 2 / (4 * C)))).mono'
    (by fun_prop) (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [add_comm] using hb ‖x‖)

name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.memLp_two_exp_mul_norm
statement:
theorem memLp_two_exp_mul_norm (μ : Measure E) [IsGaussian μ] (a : ℝ) :
    MemLp (fun x : E => Real.exp (a * ‖x‖)) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (by fun_prop)]
  simpa only [← Real.exp_nat_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc] using
    integrable_exp_mul_norm μ (2 * a)

name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.integrable_norm_pow_mul_exp_mul_norm
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_pow_mul_exp_mul_norm (μ : Measure E) [IsGaussian μ]
    (k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ k * Real.exp (a * ‖x‖)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : MemLp (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ k) 2 μ := by
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (by fun_prop)]
    simpa only [← pow_mul, id_eq] using
      (memLp_id μ ((k * 2 : ℕ) : ENNReal) (by finiteness)).integrable_norm_pow'
  exact hp.integrable_mul (memLp_two_exp_mul_norm μ a)

name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.map_neg_eq_self_of_integral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem map_neg_eq_self_of_integral_eq_zero (μ : Measure E) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) : μ.map (fun x : E => -x) = μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext_of_charFunDual
  ext L
  change charFunDual (μ.map ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.neg ℝ : E ≃L[ℝ] E).toContinuousLinearMap)) L = _
  rw [charFunDual_map]
  rw [charFunDual_eq_of_integral_eq_zero hmean,
    charFunDual_eq_of_integral_eq_zero hmean]
  congr 3
  congr 1
  convert (variance_neg (X := (L : E → ℝ)) (μ := μ)) using 1
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.integral_comp_neg_eq_of_integral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_comp_neg_eq_of_integral_eq_zero
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (μ : Measure E) [IsGaussian μ] (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0)
    (f : E → F) (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f (-x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hneg := map_neg_eq_self_of_integral_eq_zero μ hmean
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.map (fun x : E => -x)) := by
    rw [hneg]
    exact hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← integral_map (by fun_prop) hfm, hneg]

name: Real.exp_mul_sub_mul_sub_le_posPart_sq
statement:
theorem exp_mul_sub_mul_sub_le_posPart_sq {a b s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (exp (s * a) - exp (s * b)) * (s * (a - b)) ≤
      s ^ 2 * (exp (s * a) * max (a - b) 0 ^ 2 +
        exp (s * b) * max (b - a) 0 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar (u v : ℝ) : exp u - exp v ≤ exp u * (u - v) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_one_le_exp (v - u)) (exp_pos u).le
    have he : exp u * exp (v - u) = exp v := by
      rw [← exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [he] at h
    nlinarith
  rcases le_total b a with hab | hab
  · rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hab), max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hab)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hscalar (s * a) (s * b))
      (mul_nonneg hs (sub_nonneg.mpr hab))
    nlinarith
  · rw [max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hab), max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hscalar (s * b) (s * a))
      (mul_nonneg hs (sub_nonneg.mpr hab))
    nlinarith

name: Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le {u s M : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ M) :
    Real.exp (s * u) ≤ Real.exp (|s| * M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (abs_nonneg s))

name: MeasureTheory.entropy_exp_mul_le_integral_posPart_sq
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_mul_le_integral_posPart_sq
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hY : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (s * f x)) μ)
    (hW : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.exp (s * f x)) μ)
    (hU : Integrable (fun q : Ω × Ω =>
      Real.exp (s * f q.1) * max (f q.1 - f q.2) 0 ^ 2) (μ.prod μ)) :
    (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) ≤
      s ^ 2 * ∫ q : Ω × Ω,
        Real.exp (s * f q.1) * max (f q.1 - f q.2) 0 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
proof:
:= by
  let Y : Ω → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (s * f x)
  let W : Ω → ℝ := fun x => f x * Y x
  let U : Ω × Ω → ℝ := fun q => Y q.1 * max (f q.1 - f q.2) 0 ^ 2
  let G : Ω × Ω → ℝ := fun q => (Y q.1 - Y q.2) * (f q.1 - f q.2)
  have hW' : Integrable W μ := hW
  have hY' : Integrable Y μ := hY
  have hU' : Integrable U (μ.prod μ) := hU
  have hG : Integrable G (μ.prod μ) := by
    have h := (((hW'.comp_fst μ).add (hW'.comp_snd μ)).sub
      (hY'.mul_prod hf)).sub (hf.mul_prod hY')
    convert h using 1
    ext q
    dsimp [G, W]
    ring
  have hGint : ∫ q, G q ∂(μ.prod μ) =
      2 * ((∫ x, W x ∂μ) - (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * (∫ x, f x ∂μ)) := by
    have he : G = fun q : Ω × Ω =>
        (W q.1 + W q.2 - Y q.1 * f q.2) - f q.1 * Y q.2 := by
      ext q
      dsimp [G, W]
      ring
    rw [he,
      integral_sub (f := fun q : Ω × Ω => W q.1 + W q.2 - Y q.1 * f q.2)
        (g := fun q : Ω × Ω => f q.1 * Y q.2)
        (((hW'.comp_fst μ).add (hW'.comp_snd μ)).sub (hY'.mul_prod hf)) (hf.mul_prod hY'),
      integral_sub (f := fun q : Ω × Ω => W q.1 + W q.2)
        (g := fun q : Ω × Ω => Y q.1 * f q.2)
        ((hW'.comp_fst μ).add (hW'.comp_snd μ)) (hY'.mul_prod hf),
      integral_add (f := fun q : Ω × Ω => W q.1) (g := fun q : Ω × Ω => W q.2)
        (hW'.comp_fst μ) (hW'.comp_snd μ),
      integral_fun_fst, integral_fun_snd, integral_prod_mul, integral_prod_mul]
    simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul]
    ring
  have hpair := integral_mono (hG.const_mul s)
    ((hU'.add hU'.swap).const_mul (s ^ 2)) (fun q : Ω × Ω => by
      have hp := Real.exp_mul_sub_mul_sub_le_posPart_sq (a := f q.1) (b := f q.2) hs
      dsimp [G, U, Y]
      nlinarith)
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hpair
  change s * (∫ q, G q ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
    s ^ 2 * ∫ q, U q + U q.swap ∂μ.prod μ at hpair
  rw [integral_add (f := U) (g := fun q => U q.swap) hU' hU'.swap,
    integral_prod_swap, hGint] at hpair
  have hJ : Real.exp (s * ∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, Y x ∂μ := by
    simpa only [integral_const_mul, Y] using
      convexOn_exp.map_integral_le Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
        isClosed_univ (ae_of_all μ fun _ => Set.mem_univ _) (hf.const_mul s) hY
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, Y x ∂μ := (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hJ
  have hlog : s * (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ Real.log (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) :=
    (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).mpr hJ
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hpos.le
  have hleft : (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) = s * ∫ x, W x ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    ext x
    dsimp [W, Y]
    ring
  rw [hleft]
  change s * (∫ x, W x ∂μ) - (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) ≤
    s ^ 2 * ∫ q, U q ∂(μ.prod μ)
  nlinarith

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_of_uniform_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem integrable_of_uniform_abs_bound
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (integrable_const M).mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all μ fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hM x)

name: MeasureTheory.exp_mul_posPart_sq_abs_le
statement:
private theorem exp_mul_posPart_sq_abs_le {a b M s : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (ha : |a| ≤ M) (hb : |b| ≤ M) :
    |Real.exp (s * a) * max (a - b) 0 ^ 2| ≤
      Real.exp (|s| * M) * (2 * M) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd : max (a - b) 0 ≤ 2 * M := by
    apply max_le
    · linarith [le_abs_self (a - b), abs_sub a b]
    · positivity
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  exact mul_le_mul (Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le ha)
    ((sq_le_sq₀ (le_max_right _ _) (by positivity)).mpr hd)
    (sq_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f g : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hfb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) (hgb : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ M)
    (s : ℝ) : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (s * f x) * max (f x - g x) 0 ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_of_uniform_abs_bound (by fun_prop)
    (Real.exp (|s| * M) * (2 * M) ^ 2)
  exact fun x => exp_mul_posPart_sq_abs_le hM (hfb x) (hgb x)

name: MeasureTheory.entropy_exp_mul_le_integral_posPart_sq_of_bounded
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_mul_le_integral_posPart_sq_of_bounded
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) ≤
      s ^ 2 * ∫ q : Ω × Ω,
        Real.exp (s * f q.1) * max (f q.1 - f q.2) 0 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := integrable_of_uniform_abs_bound hfm M hbound (μ := μ)
  have hY : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (s * f x)) μ := integrable_of_uniform_abs_bound
    (Real.measurable_exp.comp ((measurable_const (a := s)).mul hfm)) (Real.exp (|s| * M))
    (fun x => by simpa only [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := s) (hbound x))
    (μ := μ)
  have hW : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.exp (s * f x)) μ := by
    apply integrable_of_uniform_abs_bound (by fun_prop) (M * Real.exp (|s| * M))
    intro x
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact mul_le_mul (hbound x) (Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (hbound x))
      (Real.exp_pos _).le hM
  have hU : Integrable (fun q : Ω × Ω =>
      Real.exp (s * f q.1) * max (f q.1 - f q.2) 0 ^ 2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le (fun q : Ω × Ω => f q.1) (fun q : Ω × Ω => f q.2)
      (hfm.comp measurable_fst) (hfm.comp measurable_snd) hM
      (fun q => hbound q.1) (fun q => hbound q.2) s
  exact entropy_exp_mul_le_integral_posPart_sq μ f hs hf hY hW hU

name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.isMarkovKernel_const_withDensity_of_integral_eq_one
statement:
theorem isMarkovKernel_const_withDensity_of_integral_eq_one
    (ν : Measure β) [SFinite ν] {f : α → β → ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hi : ∀ a, Integrable (f a) ν) (hpos : ∀ a, 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] f a)
    (hmass : ∀ a, ∫ b, f a b ∂ν = 1) :
    IsMarkovKernel ((Kernel.const α ν).withDensity (fun a b => ENNReal.ofReal (f a b))) where
  isProbabilityMeasure a
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hf.ennreal_ofReal]
    simp only [Kernel.const_apply, withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_univ]
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hi a) (hpos a), hmass a]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_one

name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.comp_const_withDensity
statement:
theorem comp_const_withDensity (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β)
    [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] {f : α → β → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) :
    ((Kernel.const α ν).withDensity f) ∘ₘ μ =
      ν.withDensity (fun b => ∫⁻ a, f a b ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.bind_apply hs ((Kernel.const α ν).withDensity f).aemeasurable,
    withDensity_apply _ hs]
  simp_rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hf, Kernel.const_apply, withDensity_apply _ hs]
  exact lintegral_lintegral_swap hf.aemeasurable

name: PMF.sum_toReal
statement: theorem sum_toReal {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (q : PMF J) : ∑ j, (q j).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => q.apply_ne_top j)]
  have hsum : ∑ j, q j = 1 := by simpa only [tsum_fintype] using q.tsum_coe
  simp [hsum]

name: MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_pi_prod_swap_if
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_pi_prod_swap_if (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : ∀ i, Ω i × Ω i =>
      fun i => if p i then (x i).swap else x i)
      (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i))
      (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i))
proof:
:= by
  apply measurePreserving_pi (fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)) (fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i))
    (f := fun i (z : Ω i × Ω i) => if p i then z.swap else z)
  intro i
  by_cases hi : p i
  · simpa only [hi, if_true] using
      (Measure.measurePreserving_swap :
        MeasurePreserving Prod.swap ((ν i).prod (ν i)) ((ν i).prod (ν i)))
  · simp only [hi, if_false]
    exact ⟨measurable_id, Measure.map_id⟩

name: MeasureTheory.integral_pi_prod_swap_if
statement:
theorem integral_pi_prod_swap_if {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (f : (∀ i, Ω i × Ω i) → E)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i))) :
    (∫ x, f (fun i => if p i then (x i).swap else x i)
      ∂Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)) =
      ∫ x, f x ∂Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := measurePreserving_pi_prod_swap_if ν p
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f
      ((Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)).map
        (fun x : ∀ i, Ω i × Ω i => fun i => if p i then (x i).swap else x i)) := by
    rw [hp.map_eq]
    exact hf
  have h := integral_map hp.measurable.aemeasurable hfm
  rw [hp.map_eq] at h
  exact h.symm

name: MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_prod_pi_update_swap
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_prod_pi_update_swap (i : ι) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i), Function.update q.2 i (q.1 i)))
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Ω Ω ι ν ν
  have hs := measurePreserving_pi_prod_swap_if ν (fun j => j = i)
  have h := hp.comp (hs.comp hp.symm)
  apply h.congr (by fun_prop)
  exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
    apply Prod.ext <;> ext j <;> by_cases hj : j = i <;>
      simp [Function.comp_def, MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow,
        Equiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow, hj]

name: MeasureTheory.integral_prod_pi_update_swap
statement:
theorem integral_prod_pi_update_swap {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (i : ι) (f : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → E)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) :
    (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i), Function.update q.2 i (q.1 i))
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) =
      ∫ q, f q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := measurePreserving_prod_pi_update_swap ν i
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f
      (((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)).map
        (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
          (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i), Function.update q.2 i (q.1 i)))) := by
    rw [hp.map_eq]
    exact hf
  have h := integral_map hp.measurable.aemeasurable hfm
  rw [hp.map_eq] at h
  exact h.symm

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_prod_eq_integral_sections
statement:
theorem measureReal_prod_eq_integral_sections
    {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (F : Set (α × β)) :
    (μ.prod ν).real F = ∫ x, ν.real {y | (x, y) ∈ F} ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [measureReal_def]
  rw [Measure.prod_apply (MeasurableSet.of_discrete)]
  symm
  exact integral_toReal Measurable.of_discrete.aemeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => measure_lt_top ν _))

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_prod_le_measureReal_add_of_sections_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_prod_le_measureReal_add_of_sections_le
    {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (E : Set α) (F : Set (α × β)) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hF : ∀ x, x ∉ E → ν.real {y | (x, y) ∈ F} ≤ c) :
    (μ.prod ν).real F ≤ μ.real E + c
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_prod_eq_integral_sections]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x + c ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono Integrable.of_finite Integrable.of_finite
      intro x
      dsimp only
      by_cases hx : x ∈ E
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        exact (measureReal_le_one (μ := ν)).trans (by linarith)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_add]
        exact hF x hx
    _ = _ := by
      have hi : (∫ x, E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x ∂μ) = μ.real E := by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, measureReal_def] using
          integral_indicator_const (μ := μ) (1 : ℝ) (show MeasurableSet E from .of_discrete)
      rw [integral_add Integrable.of_finite Integrable.of_finite, hi]
      simp only [integral_const, measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul]

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_prod_eq_integral_sections_of_measurableSet
statement:
theorem measureReal_prod_eq_integral_sections_of_measurableSet
    {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (F : Set (α × β)) (hF : MeasurableSet F) :
    (μ.prod ν).real F = ∫ x, ν.real {y | (x, y) ∈ F} ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [measureReal_def]
  rw [Measure.prod_apply hF]
  symm
  exact integral_toReal (measurable_measure_prodMk_left hF).aemeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => measure_lt_top ν _))

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_prod_le_measureReal_add_of_sections_le_of_measurableSet
statement:
theorem measureReal_prod_le_measureReal_add_of_sections_le_of_measurableSet
    {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (E : Set α) (F : Set (α × β)) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hFm : MeasurableSet F)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hF : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∉ E → ν.real {y | (x, y) ∈ F} ≤ c) :
    (μ.prod ν).real F ≤ μ.real E + c
proof:
:= by
  have hsec : Integrable (fun x => ν.real {y | (x, y) ∈ F}) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono'
      (measurable_measure_prodMk_left hFm).ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg measureReal_nonneg]
      exact measureReal_le_one
  have hi : Integrable (E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) μ :=
    (integrable_const _).indicator hE
  rw [measureReal_prod_eq_integral_sections_of_measurableSet μ ν F hFm]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x + c ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hsec (hi.add (integrable_const c))
      filter_upwards [hF] with x hxF
      change ν.real {y | (x, y) ∈ F} ≤ E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x + c
      by_cases hx : x ∈ E
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        exact (measureReal_le_one (μ := ν)).trans (by linarith)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_add]
        exact hxF hx
    _ = _ := by
      have hi' : (∫ x, E.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x ∂μ) = μ.real E := by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using integral_indicator_const (μ := μ) (1 : ℝ) hE
      rw [integral_add hi (integrable_const c), hi']
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]

name: MeasureTheory.integral_ciSup_sum_pi_le_mean_add_integral_copy_sub
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_pi_le_mean_add_integral_copy_sub
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R v : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ t, (∑ i, ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, X i (x i) t ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      v + ∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
        ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
          ∂(Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let F (x : ι → Ω) (t : T) := ∑ i, X i (x i) t
  let D (p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) (t : T) :=
    ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
  have hFc (t : T) : Continuous (fun x => F x t) := by
    dsimp [F]
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)
  have hDc (t : T) : Continuous (fun p => D p t) := by
    dsimp [D]
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro i _
    exact ((hXc i t).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst)).sub
      ((hXc i t).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd))
  have hFb (x : ι → Ω) (t : T) : |F x t| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R := by
    exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans <|
      (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hX i (x i) t).trans_eq (by simp)
  have hDb (p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) (t : T) :
      |D p t| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (2 * R) := by
    apply (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, (2 * R) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hsub : |X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t| ≤
            |X i (p.1 i) t| + |X i (p.2 i) t| := by
          simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_neg] using
            abs_add_le (X i (p.1 i) t) (-(X i (p.2 i) t))
        exact hsub.trans (by linarith [hX i (p.1 i) t, hX i (p.2 i) t])
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hFi := integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le μ F hFc hFb
  have hDi := integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le (μ.prod μ) D hDc hDb
  have hsection (x : ι → Ω) : Integrable (fun y => ⨆ t, D (x, y) t) μ := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le μ
      (fun y t => D (x, y) t) (fun t => (hDc t).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
    exact fun y t => hDb (x, y) t
  have hpoint (x : ι → Ω) : (⨆ t, F x t) ≤ v + ∫ y, ⨆ t, D (x, y) t ∂μ := by
    apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    have hXi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω t) (ν i) := by
      apply Integrable.of_bound (hXc i t).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable R
      exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hX i ω t
    have hY (i : ι) : Integrable (fun y : ι → Ω => X i (y i) t) μ :=
      integrable_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := i) (hXi i)
    have hsubi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun y : ι → Ω => X i (x i) t - X i (y i) t) μ := by
      convert! (integrable_const (X i (x i) t)).sub (hY i) using 1
    have htest : Integrable (fun y => D (x, y) t) μ := by
      exact integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hsubi i)
    have heach (i : ι) : (∫ y : ι → Ω, X i (x i) t - X i (y i) t ∂μ) =
        X i (x i) t - ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i := by
      rw [integral_sub (integrable_const (X i (x i) t)) (hY i)]
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
      congr 1
      exact integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (hXi i).aestronglyMeasurable
    have he : (∫ y, D (x, y) t ∂μ) = F x t - ∑ i, ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i := by
      dsimp only [D, F]
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hsubi i)]
      simp_rw [heach]
      exact Finset.sum_sub_distrib _ _
    have hle := integral_mono htest (hsection x) (fun y =>
      le_ciSup (⟨(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (2 * R), by
        rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hDb (x, y) u)⟩) t)
    rw [he] at hle
    linarith [hmean t]
  have hle := integral_mono hFi ((integrable_const v).add hDi.integral_prod_left) hpoint
  change (∫ x, ⨆ t, F x t ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, v + ∫ y, ⨆ t, D (x, y) t ∂μ ∂μ at hle
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hDi.integral_prod_left,
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, ← integral_prod _ hDi] at hle
  exact hle

name: abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_oscillation
statement:
theorem _root_.abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_oscillation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i), |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i)
    (x y : ∀ i, S i) : |f y - f x| ≤ ∑ i, c i
proof:
:= by
  let z (s : Finset ι) : ∀ i, S i := fun i => if i ∈ s then y i else x i
  have hs : ∀ s : Finset ι, |f (z s) - f x| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, c i := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [z]
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      have hz : z (insert i s) = Function.update (z s) i (y i) := by
        funext j
        by_cases hij : j = i
        · subst j; simp [z]
        · simp [z, hij]
      rw [hz, Finset.sum_insert hi]
      exact (abs_sub_le _ _ _).trans (add_le_add (h i (z s) (y i)) ih)
  simpa [z] using hs Finset.univ

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_range_oscillation
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_of_range_oscillation
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ x y, |g x - g y| ≤ c) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => g x - ∫ y, g y ∂μ) ⟨c ^ 2 / 4, by positivity⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty Ω := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  let x₀ : Ω := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω)
  have hbb : BddBelow (Set.range g) := by
    refine ⟨g x₀ - c, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have := (abs_le.mp (h x x₀)).1
    linarith
  let a := sInf (Set.range g)
  have hb : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + c) := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨csInf_le hbb ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have hl : g x - c ≤ a := by
      refine le_csInf (Set.range_nonempty g) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have := (abs_le.mp (h x y)).2
      linarith
    linarith
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc hg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
  have hproxy : ((‖a + c - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : NNReal) = ⟨c ^ 2 / 4, by positivity⟩ := by
    ext
    change (‖a + c - a‖ / 2) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 / 4
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    ring
  rw [hproxy] at hsg
  exact hsg

name: NLAlib.bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_coordinates
statement:
theorem bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_coordinates
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    B x x = ∑ i, ∑ j, (x i * x j) * B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : B x x = ∑ i, x i • B (Pi.single i 1) x := by
    simpa only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_apply, smul_apply] using
      congrArg (fun v : κ → ℝ => B v x) (pi_eq_sum_univ' x)
  have hsecond : ∀ i, B (Pi.single i 1) x =
      ∑ j, x j • B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) := by
    intro i
    conv_lhs => rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' x]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  rw [hx]
  simp_rw [hsecond, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_quadratic_of_memLp_two
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_quadratic_of_memLp_two
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    {X : Ω → κ → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => B (X ω) (X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i j : κ) : Integrable
      (fun ω => (X ω i * X ω j) * B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)) μ :=
    ((hX.eval i).integrable_mul (hX.eval j)).mul_const _
  simpa only [bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_coordinates] using
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
      integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hi i j))

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_second_moments
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_second_moments
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    {X : Ω → κ → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    (∫ ω, B (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (∫ ω, X ω i * X ω j ∂μ) *
        B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i j : κ) : Integrable
      (fun ω => (X ω i * X ω j) * B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)) μ :=
    ((hX.eval i).integrable_mul (hX.eval j)).mul_const _
  simp_rw [bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_coordinates]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hi i j))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi i j)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact integral_mul_const _ _

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_of_second_moments_eq
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_of_second_moments_eq
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    {X : Ω → κ → ℝ} {Z : Ω' → κ → ℝ}
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hZ : MemLp Z 2 ν)
    (hmatch : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, X ω i * X ω j ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Z ω i * Z ω j ∂ν) :
    (∫ ω, B (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) = ∫ ω, B (Z ω) (Z ω) ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_second_moments B hX,
    integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_second_moments B hZ, hmatch]

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_coordinates_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem integral_mul_coordinates_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq
    {X : Ω → κ → ℝ} {Z : Ω' → κ → ℝ}
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hZ : MemLp Z 2 ν)
    (hmean : ∀ i, (∫ ω, X ω i ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Z ω i ∂ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j, cov[fun ω => X ω i, fun ω => X ω j; μ] =
      cov[fun ω => Z ω i, fun ω => Z ω j; ν]) (i j : κ) :
    (∫ ω, X ω i * X ω j ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Z ω i * Z ω j ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hc := hcov i j
  rw [covariance_eq_sub (hX.eval i) (hX.eval j),
    covariance_eq_sub (hZ.eval i) (hZ.eval j),
    hmean i, hmean j] at hc
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply] at hc
  linarith

name: NLAlib.covariance_comp_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem covariance_comp_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    {X : Ω → κ → ℝ} {Z : Ω' → κ → ℝ}
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hZ : MemLp Z 2 ν)
    (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Z ω ∂ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j, cov[(fun ω => X ω i), (fun ω => X ω j); μ] =
      cov[(fun ω => Z ω i), (fun ω => Z ω j); ν])
    (L K : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    cov[(fun ω => L (X ω)), (fun ω => K (X ω)); μ] =
      cov[(fun ω => L (Z ω)), (fun ω => K (Z ω)); ν]
proof:
:= by
  have hXi : Integrable X μ := hX.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hZi : Integrable Z ν := hZ.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hmeans (i : κ) : (∫ ω, X ω i ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Z ω i ∂ν := by
    let P : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj i
    calc
      (∫ ω, X ω i ∂μ) = P (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) := P.integral_comp_comm hXi
      _ = P (∫ ω, Z ω ∂ν) := congrArg P hmean
      _ = ∫ ω, Z ω i ∂ν := (P.integral_comp_comm hZi).symm
  have hsecond := integral_mul_coordinates_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq hX hZ hmeans hcov
  let B := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp L K
  have hprod := integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_of_second_moments_eq B hX hZ hsecond
  change (∫ ω, L (X ω) * K (X ω) ∂μ) = (∫ ω, L (Z ω) * K (Z ω) ∂ν) at hprod
  have hiX : MemLp (fun ω => L (X ω)) 2 μ := L.comp_memLp' hX
  have hkX : MemLp (fun ω => K (X ω)) 2 μ := K.comp_memLp' hX
  have hiZ : MemLp (fun ω => L (Z ω)) 2 ν := L.comp_memLp' hZ
  have hkZ : MemLp (fun ω => K (Z ω)) 2 ν := K.comp_memLp' hZ
  rw [covariance_eq_sub hiX hkX, covariance_eq_sub hiZ hkZ]
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [hprod, L.integral_comp_comm hXi, K.integral_comp_comm hXi,
    L.integral_comp_comm hZi, K.integral_comp_comm hZi, hmean]

name: NLAlib.covariance_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem covariance_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    (ρ σ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] [IsProbabilityMeasure σ]
    (hρ : MemLp id 2 ρ) (hσ : MemLp id 2 σ)
    (hmean : (∫ x, x ∂ρ) = ∫ x, x ∂σ)
    (hcov : ∀ i j, cov[(fun x => x i), (fun x => x j); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x => x i), (fun x => x j); σ])
    (L K : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) : cov[L, K; ρ] = cov[L, K; σ]
proof:
:= by
  exact covariance_comp_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    hρ hσ hmean hcov L K

name: NoncommutativeProbability.polynomialWordProduct_merge
statement:
theorem polynomialWordProduct_merge (X : ι → A) (l r : List (ι×Polynomial K))
    (i : ι) (P Q : Polynomial K) :
    polynomialWordProduct X (l++(i,P)::(i,Q)::r)=
      polynomialWordProduct X (l++(i,P*Q)::r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialWordProduct,List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.prod_append,
    List.prod_cons,map_mul,mul_assoc]

name: NoncommutativeProbability.polynomialWordMoment_constant
statement:
theorem polynomialWordMoment_constant (φ : A →ₗ[K] K) (X : ι → A)
    (l : List (ι×Polynomial K)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j<l.length) (c : K)
    (hc : (l[j]).2=Polynomial.C c) :
    polynomialWordMoment φ X l=c*polynomialWordMoment φ X (l.eraseIdx j)
proof:
:= by
  let ev : ι×Polynomial K → A := fun u => Polynomial.aeval (X u.1) u.2
  have he : ev (l[j])=algebraMap K A c := by simp [ev,hc]
  have hh := List.mul_prod_eraseIdx (l := l.map ev) (i := j)
    (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hj) (fun a ha => by
      rw [List.getElem_map,he]
      exact Algebra.commutes c a)
  rw [List.eraseIdx_map] at hh
  have hp : polynomialWordProduct X l=c•polynomialWordProduct X (l.eraseIdx j) := by
    change (l.map ev).prod=c•((l.eraseIdx j).map ev).prod
    rw [← hh,List.getElem_map,he,Algebra.smul_def]
  unfold polynomialWordMoment
  rw [hp,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]

name: NoncommutativeProbability.polynomialProductMoment_apply
statement:
theorem polynomialProductMoment_apply (φ : A →ₗ[K] K) (X : ι → A) {m : ℕ}
    (color : Fin m → ι) (P : Fin m → Polynomial K) :
    polynomialProductMoment φ X color P=
      polynomialWordMoment φ X (List.ofFn fun j => (color j,P j))
proof:
:= by
  change φ ((List.ofFn fun j => Polynomial.aeval (X (color j)) (P j)).prod)=_
  simp only [polynomialWordMoment,polynomialWordProduct,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def]

name: NoncommutativeProbability.polynomialWordMoment_eq_of_free
statement:
theorem polynomialWordMoment_eq_of_free
    (φ : A →ₗ[K] K) (ψ : B →ₗ[K] K) (X : ι → A) (Y : ι → B)
    (hφ : φ 1=1) (hψ : ψ 1=1) (hX : IsFreeFamily φ X) (hY : IsFreeFamily ψ Y)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (P : Polynomial K), φ (Polynomial.aeval (X i) P)=ψ (Polynomial.aeval (Y i) P))
    (l : List (ι×Polynomial K)) :
    polynomialWordMoment φ X l=polynomialWordMoment ψ Y l
proof:
:= by
  have hall (n : ℕ) : ∀ l : List (ι×Polynomial K), l.length=n →
      polynomialWordMoment φ X l=polynomialWordMoment ψ Y l := by
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro l hlen
      by_cases hn : n=0
      · have hl : l=[] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (hlen.trans hn)
        subst l
        simp only [polynomialWordMoment,polynomialWordProduct,List.map_nil,List.prod_nil,hφ,hψ]
      have hnpos : 0<n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      by_cases hchain : l.IsChain (fun u v => u.1≠v.1)
      · let color : Fin l.length → ι := fun j => (l.get j).1
        let P : Fin l.length → Polynomial K := fun j => (l.get j).2
        let c : Fin l.length → K := fun j => φ (Polynomial.aeval (X (color j)) (P j))
        let Pc : Fin l.length → Polynomial K := fun j => P j-Polynomial.C (c j)
        let C : Fin l.length → Polynomial K := fun j => Polynomial.C (c j)
        let D := polynomialProductMoment φ X color-polynomialProductMoment ψ Y color
        have hcolor : (List.ofFn color).IsChain (· ≠ ·) := by
          apply List.isChain_ofFn.mpr
          intro j hj
          exact (List.isChain_iff_getElem.mp hchain) j hj
        have hcenterX (j : Fin l.length) : φ (Polynomial.aeval (X (color j)) (Pc j))=0 := by
          simp [Pc,c,map_sub,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,map_smul,hφ,smul_eq_mul]
        have hcenterY (j : Fin l.length) : ψ (Polynomial.aeval (Y (color j)) (Pc j))=0 := by
          simp [Pc,c,map_sub,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,map_smul,hψ,smul_eq_mul,hLaw]
        have hcenter : D Pc=0 := by
          change φ ((List.ofFn fun j => Polynomial.aeval (X (color j)) (Pc j)).prod)-
            ψ ((List.ofFn fun j => Polynomial.aeval (Y (color j)) (Pc j)).prod)=0
          rw [hX l.length (hlen ▸ hnpos) color hcolor Pc hcenterX,
            hY l.length (hlen ▸ hnpos) color hcolor Pc hcenterY,sub_self]
        have hproper (s : Finset (Fin l.length)) (hs : s≠Finset.univ) :
            D (s.piecewise Pc C)=0 := by
          have hex : ∃ j : Fin l.length, j∉s := by
            by_contra h
            push Not at h
            exact hs (Finset.eq_univ_of_forall h)
          obtain ⟨j,hjs⟩ := hex
          let b : List (ι×Polynomial K) := List.ofFn fun j => (color j,s.piecewise Pc C j)
          have hj : (j : ℕ)<b.length := by simpa only [b,List.length_ofFn] using j.isLt
          have hb : (b[(j : ℕ)]).2=Polynomial.C (c j) := by
            simp [b,Finset.piecewise,hjs,C]
          have hbshort : (b.eraseIdx j).length<n := by
            have hbLen : b.length=n := by simp only [b,List.length_ofFn,hlen]
            rw [List.length_eraseIdx,if_pos hj,hbLen]
            omega
          have hh := ih (b.eraseIdx j).length hbshort (b.eraseIdx j) rfl
          change polynomialProductMoment φ X color (s.piecewise Pc C)-
            polynomialProductMoment ψ Y color (s.piecewise Pc C)=0
          rw [polynomialProductMoment_apply,polynomialProductMoment_apply]
          change polynomialWordMoment φ X b-polynomialWordMoment ψ Y b=0
          rw [polynomialWordMoment_constant φ X b j hj (c j) hb,
            polynomialWordMoment_constant ψ Y b j hj (c j) hb,hh,sub_self]
        have hdecomp : P=Pc+C := by
          funext j
          exact (sub_add_cancel (P j) (Polynomial.C (c j))).symm
        have hD : D P=0 := by
          rw [hdecomp,D.map_add_univ]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single Finset.univ]
          · simpa only [Finset.piecewise_univ] using hcenter
          · intro s hs hne
            exact hproper s hne
          · simp
        have hlist : (List.ofFn fun j => (color j,P j))=l := by
          change List.ofFn (fun j : Fin l.length => l.get j)=l
          exact List.ofFn_get l
        change polynomialProductMoment φ X color P-polynomialProductMoment ψ Y color P=0 at hD
        rw [polynomialProductMoment_apply,polynomialProductMoment_apply,hlist] at hD
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hD
      · rw [List.isChain_iff_forall_rel_of_append_cons_cons] at hchain
        push Not at hchain
        obtain ⟨a,b,l₁,l₂,he,hab⟩ := hchain
        rcases a with ⟨i,P⟩
        rcases b with ⟨j,Q⟩
        have hij : i=j := hab
        subst j
        let l' := l₁++(i,P*Q)::l₂
        have hshort : l'.length<n := by simp only [he,List.length_append,List.length_cons] at hlen; dsimp [l']; simp only [List.length_append,List.length_cons]; omega
        have hh := ih l'.length hshort l' rfl
        rw [he]
        unfold polynomialWordMoment
        rw [polynomialWordProduct_merge,polynomialWordProduct_merge]
        exact hh
  exact hall l.length l rfl

name: NoncommutativeProbability.aeval_moment_eq_of_powers
statement:
theorem aeval_moment_eq_of_powers (φ : A →ₗ[K] K) (ψ : B →ₗ[K] K)
    (x : A) (y : B) (hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, φ (x^n)=ψ (y^n)) (P : Polynomial K) :
    φ (Polynomial.aeval x P)=ψ (Polynomial.aeval y P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add P Q hP hQ => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hP hQ
  | monomial n c =>
    simp only [Polynomial.aeval_monomial,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,smul_mul_assoc,
      one_mul,map_smul,hpow]

name: NoncommutativeProbability.freeAlgebra_lift_moment_eq_of_free
statement:
theorem freeAlgebra_lift_moment_eq_of_free
    (φ : A →ₗ[K] K) (ψ : B →ₗ[K] K) (X : ι → A) (Y : ι → B)
    (hφ : φ 1=1) (hψ : ψ 1=1) (hX : IsFreeFamily φ X) (hY : IsFreeFamily ψ Y)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (P : Polynomial K), φ (Polynomial.aeval (X i) P)=ψ (Polynomial.aeval (Y i) P))
    (P : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    φ (FreeAlgebra.lift K X P)=ψ (FreeAlgebra.lift K Y P)
proof:
:= by
  have hEvalX : FreeAlgebra.lift K X=
      (MonoidAlgebra.lift K A (FreeMonoid ι) (FreeMonoid.lift X)).comp
        (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := K) (X := ι)).toAlgHom := by
    ext i
    simp [FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid]
  have hEvalY : FreeAlgebra.lift K Y=
      (MonoidAlgebra.lift K B (FreeMonoid ι) (FreeMonoid.lift Y)).comp
        (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := K) (X := ι)).toAlgHom := by
    ext i
    simp [FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid]
  have hword (w : FreeMonoid ι) : φ ((w.toList.map X).prod)=ψ ((w.toList.map Y).prod) := by
    have hh := polynomialWordMoment_eq_of_free φ ψ X Y hφ hψ hX hY hLaw
      (w.toList.map fun i => (i,Polynomial.X))
    simpa only [polynomialWordMoment,polynomialWordProduct,List.map_map,
      Function.comp_def,Polynomial.aeval_X] using hh
  rw [hEvalX,hEvalY,AlgHom.comp_apply,AlgHom.comp_apply]
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply,FreeMonoid.lift_apply]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum,map_sum,map_smul,hword]

name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.integrable_exp_mul_sum₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp
  | insert i s hi_notin_s h_rec =>
      have h_int_s : ∀ j ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω : Ω => exp (t * X j ω)) μ :=
        fun j hj => h_int j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      specialize h_rec h_int_s
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi_notin_s]
      refine IndepFun.integrable_exp_mul_add ?_ (h_int i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) h_rec
      exact (h_indep.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem₀ h_meas hi_notin_s).symm

name: MeasureTheory.integral_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero
statement:
private theorem integral_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 (ν i))
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂ν i = 0) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ i, X i (x i)) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) =
      ∑ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i
proof:
:= by
  have hXi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => X i (x i)) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).integrable_comp_of_integrable ((hX i).integrable one_le_two)
  have hL : MemLp (fun x : ι → Ω => ∑ i, X i (x i)) 2 (Measure.pi ν) :=
    memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hX i).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν i)
  have hm : (∫ x : ι → Ω, ∑ i, X i (x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hXi i)]
    simp only [integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := _) (hX _).aestronglyMeasurable, hmean,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have h := variance_sum_pi hX
  have he : (∑ i, fun x : ι → Ω => X i (x i)) = (fun x => ∑ i, X i (x i)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [he, variance_eq_sub hL, hm] at h
  simp_rw [variance_eq_sub (hX _), hmean] at h
  simpa only [Pi.pow_apply, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), sub_zero] using h

name: MeasureTheory.integral_norm_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℂ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 (ν i))
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂ν i = 0) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, ‖∑ i, X i (x i)‖ ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) =
      ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖X i ω‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i
proof:
:= by
  let R (i : ι) (ω : Ω) := (X i ω).re
  let I (i : ι) (ω : Ω) := (X i ω).im
  have hR (i : ι) : MemLp (R i) 2 (ν i) := by
    simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using (hX i).re
  have hI (i : ι) : MemLp (I i) 2 (ν i) := by
    simpa only [RCLike.im_eq_complex_im] using (hX i).im
  have hmR (i : ι) : ∫ ω, R i ω ∂ν i = 0 := by
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply, map_zero] using
      (Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm ((hX i).integrable one_le_two)).trans
        (congrArg Complex.reCLM (hmean i))
  have hmI (i : ι) : ∫ ω, I i ω ∂ν i = 0 := by
    simpa only [Complex.imCLM_apply, map_zero] using
      (Complex.imCLM.integral_comp_comm ((hX i).integrable one_le_two)).trans
        (congrArg Complex.imCLM (hmean i))
  have hSr : MemLp (fun x : ι → Ω => ∑ i, R i (x i)) 2 (Measure.pi ν) :=
    memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hR i).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν i)
  have hSi : MemLp (fun x : ι → Ω => ∑ i, I i (x i)) 2 (Measure.pi ν) :=
    memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hI i).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν i)
  have hnorm (z : ℂ) : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm_sub_sq_re z
    linarith
  calc
    _ = (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ i, R i (x i)) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) +
        ∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ i, I i (x i)) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν := by
      simp_rw [hnorm, Complex.re_sum, Complex.im_sum]
      exact integral_add hSr.integrable_sq hSi.integrable_sq
    _ = (∑ i, ∫ ω, R i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i) + ∑ i, ∫ ω, I i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i := by
      rw [integral_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero ν R hR hmR,
        integral_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero ν I hI hmI]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [← integral_add (hR i).integrable_sq (hI i).integrable_sq]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => (hnorm (X i ω)).symm

name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.ext_of_pi_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_pi_mean_covariance_eq
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (μ ν : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsGaussian μ] [IsGaussian ν]
    (hmean : (∫ x, x ∂μ) = ∫ x, x ∂ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j, cov[fun x => x i, fun x => x j; μ] =
      cov[fun x => x i, fun x => x j; ν]) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  let L : (κ → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ κ :=
    (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : κ => ℝ)).symm
  apply L.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding.map_injective
  change μ.map L = ν.map L
  apply IsGaussian.ext
  · change (∫ x, x ∂μ.map L) = ∫ x, x ∂ν.map L
    rw [L.integral_id_map, L.integral_id_map, hmean]
  · have hμ (i : κ) : MemLp (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i) 2 μ :=
      (IsGaussian.memLp_two_id (μ := μ)).eval i
    have hν (i : κ) : MemLp (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i) 2 ν :=
      (IsGaussian.memLp_two_id (μ := ν)).eval i
    ext x y
    change covarianceBilin (μ.map (fun x => toLp 2 x)) x y =
      covarianceBilin (ν.map (fun x => toLp 2 x)) x y
    rw [covarianceBilin_apply_pi hμ, covarianceBilin_apply_pi hν]
    simp_rw [hcov]

name: Representation.averagedIntertwiningMap_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem averagedIntertwiningMap_toLinearMap
    (ρ : Representation k G V) (σ : Representation k G W) (M : V →ₗ[k] W) :
    (averagedIntertwiningMap ρ σ M).toLinearMap =
      (Fintype.card G : k)⁻¹ • ∑ g : G, (σ g).comp (M.comp (ρ g⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  simp [averagedIntertwiningMap, invariantsEquivIntertwiningMap, averageMap,
    GroupAlgebra.average, map_sum, linHom_apply,
    LinearMap.intertwiningMap_of_isIntertwiningMap]

name: Representation.trace_averagedIntertwiningMap
statement:
theorem trace_averagedIntertwiningMap [FiniteDimensional k V]
    (ρ : Representation k G V) (M : V →ₗ[k] V) :
    LinearMap.trace k V (averagedIntertwiningMap ρ ρ M).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.trace k V M
proof:
:= by
  rw [averagedIntertwiningMap_toLinearMap, map_smul, map_sum]
  have hg (g : G) : LinearMap.trace k V ((ρ g).comp (M.comp (ρ g⁻¹))) =
      LinearMap.trace k V M := by
    change LinearMap.trace k V (ρ g * (M * ρ g⁻¹)) = _
    rw [LinearMap.trace_mul_cycle', ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    simp
  simp_rw [hg]
  simp [smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

name: Representation.averagedIntertwiningMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem averagedIntertwiningMap_eq_zero
    (ρ : Representation k G V) (σ : Representation k G W)
    [IsIrreducible ρ] [IsIrreducible σ] (hne : IsEmpty (Equiv ρ σ))
    (M : V →ₗ[k] W) : averagedIntertwiningMap ρ σ M = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hne
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: Representation.exists_averagedIntertwiningMap_eq_smul_id
statement:
theorem exists_averagedIntertwiningMap_eq_smul_id
    [IsAlgClosed k] [FiniteDimensional k V]
    (ρ : Representation k G V) [IsIrreducible ρ] (M : V →ₗ[k] V) :
    ∃ c : k, (averagedIntertwiningMap ρ ρ M).toLinearMap = c • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsIrreducible.algebraMap_intertwiningMap_bijective_of_isAlgClosed
    (ρ := ρ) |>.surjective (averagedIntertwiningMap ρ ρ M)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  rw [← hc]
  rfl

name: Representation.averagedIntertwiningMap_self_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem averagedIntertwiningMap_self_toLinearMap
    [IsAlgClosed k] [FiniteDimensional k V]
    (ρ : Representation k G V) [IsIrreducible ρ]
    (hV : (Module.finrank k V : k) ≠ 0) (M : V →ₗ[k] V) :
    (averagedIntertwiningMap ρ ρ M).toLinearMap =
      (LinearMap.trace k V M / Module.finrank k V) • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_averagedIntertwiningMap_eq_smul_id ρ M
  have ht := trace_averagedIntertwiningMap ρ M
  rw [hc, map_smul, LinearMap.trace_id, smul_eq_mul] at ht
  have hc' : c = LinearMap.trace k V M / Module.finrank k V :=
    (eq_div_iff hV).mpr ht
  rw [hc, hc']

name: Subrepresentation.isIrreducible_toRepresentation_iff
statement:
theorem isIrreducible_toRepresentation_iff (S : Subrepresentation ρ) :
    IsIrreducible S.toRepresentation ↔ IsAtom S
proof:
:= by
  change IsSimpleOrder (Subrepresentation S.toRepresentation) ↔ IsAtom S
  rw [← Set.isSimpleOrder_Iic_iff_isAtom]
  exact (S.subtypeOrderIso).isSimpleOrder_iff

name: Subrepresentation.exists_irreducible_le
statement:
theorem exists_irreducible_le [FiniteDimensional k V]
    (S : Subrepresentation ρ) (hS : S ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ T : Subrepresentation ρ, T ≤ S ∧ IsIrreducible T.toRepresentation
proof:
:= by
  have hwf : WellFounded ((· < ·) : Subrepresentation ρ → Subrepresentation ρ → Prop) := by
    apply (measure (fun T : Subrepresentation ρ => Module.finrank k T.toSubmodule)).wf.mono
    intro A B hAB
    exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hAB
  letI : IsAtomic (Subrepresentation ρ) := isAtomic_of_orderBot_wellFounded_lt hwf
  obtain hbot | ⟨T, hT, hTS⟩ := eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le S
  · exact (hS hbot).elim
  · exact ⟨T, hTS, (isIrreducible_toRepresentation_iff T).mpr hT⟩

name: Representation.toMatrix_averagedIntertwiningMap
statement:
theorem toMatrix_averagedIntertwiningMap
    (ρ : Representation ℂ G (n → ℂ)) (σ : Representation ℂ G (m → ℂ))
    (M : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (averagedIntertwiningMap ρ σ M.toLin').toLinearMap =
      (Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ g : G,
        LinearMap.toMatrix' (σ g) * (M * LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  rw [averagedIntertwiningMap_toLinearMap]
  simp only [map_smul, map_sum, LinearMap.toMatrix'_comp,
    LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin']

name: Representation.sum_matrix_conjugates_eq_trace_smul
statement:
theorem sum_matrix_conjugates_eq_trace_smul
    [Nonempty n] (ρ : Representation ℂ G (n → ℂ)) [IsIrreducible ρ]
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ g : G,
        LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) * (M * LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g⁻¹)) =
      (M.trace / Fintype.card n) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toMatrix_averagedIntertwiningMap]
  rw [averagedIntertwiningMap_self_toLinearMap ρ
    (by simpa using (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero :
      (Fintype.card n : ℂ) ≠ 0))]
  simp

name: Representation.sum_matrix_conjugates_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_matrix_conjugates_eq_zero
    (ρ : Representation ℂ G (n → ℂ)) (σ : Representation ℂ G (m → ℂ))
    [IsIrreducible ρ] [IsIrreducible σ] (hne : IsEmpty (Equiv ρ σ))
    (M : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ g : G,
      LinearMap.toMatrix' (σ g) * (M * LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g⁻¹)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toMatrix_averagedIntertwiningMap, averagedIntertwiningMap_eq_zero ρ σ hne]
  simp

name: Representation.toMatrix_inv_eq_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem toMatrix_inv_eq_conjTranspose
    (ρ : Representation ℂ G (n → ℂ))
    (hu : ∀ g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (g : G) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g⁻¹) = (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g))ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g))ᴴ * LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) = 1 :=
    Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mp (hu g)
  have hright : LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) * LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix'_mul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one,
      LinearMap.toMatrix'_one]
  calc
    _ = 1 * LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g⁻¹) := (Matrix.one_mul _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [← hleft, Matrix.mul_assoc, hright, Matrix.mul_one]

name: Representation.matrix_coefficients_orthogonality_self
statement:
theorem matrix_coefficients_orthogonality_self
    [Nonempty n] (ρ : Representation ℂ G (n → ℂ)) [IsIrreducible ρ]
    (hu : ∀ g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)
    (i j a b : n) :
    (Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ g : G,
        LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) i a * star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) j b) =
      if a = b then (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ * (if i = j then 1 else 0) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℂ => M i j)
    (sum_matrix_conjugates_eq_trace_smul ρ (Matrix.single a b 1))
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.single_apply] at hh
  simp only [toMatrix_inv_eq_conjTranspose ρ hu, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] at hh
  have ht : (Matrix.single a b (1 : ℂ)).trace = if a = b then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hab
    · subst b; exact Matrix.trace_single_eq_same _ _
    · exact Matrix.trace_single_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hab
  by_cases hab : a = b <;> by_cases hij : i = j <;>
    simpa [ht, hab, hij, Matrix.one_apply, div_eq_mul_inv, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul] using hh

name: Representation.matrix_coefficients_orthogonality_of_inequivalent
statement:
theorem matrix_coefficients_orthogonality_of_inequivalent
    (ρ : Representation ℂ G (n → ℂ)) (σ : Representation ℂ G (m → ℂ))
    [IsIrreducible ρ] [IsIrreducible σ] (hne : IsEmpty (Equiv ρ σ))
    (hρ : ∀ g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)
    (i a : m) (j b : n) :
    (Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ g : G,
      LinearMap.toMatrix' (σ g) i a * star (LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ g) j b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℂ => M i j)
    (sum_matrix_conjugates_eq_zero ρ σ hne (Matrix.single a b 1))
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.single_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] at hh
  simp only [toMatrix_inv_eq_conjTranspose ρ hρ, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] at hh
  simpa [ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul] using hh

name: NLAlib.exists_equiv_sum_extending_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_sum_extending_embedding {p q n : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype n] (e : p ↪ n)
    (hcard : Fintype.card p + Fintype.card q = Fintype.card n) :
    ∃ f : (p ⊕ q) ≃ n, ∀ i, f (Sum.inl i) = e i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let eL : p ≃ {j : n // j ∈ Set.range e} := Equiv.ofInjective e e.injective
  have hRange : Fintype.card {j : n // j ∈ Set.range e} = Fintype.card p :=
    Fintype.card_congr eL.symm
  have hRest : Fintype.card {j : n // j ∉ Set.range e} = Fintype.card q := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, hRange]
    omega
  let eR : q ≃ {j : n // j ∉ Set.range e} := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hRest.symm
  exact ⟨(Equiv.sumCongr eL eR).trans (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j ∈ Set.range e)),
    fun _ => rfl⟩

name: MeasureTheory.measure_map_prod_map_of_aemeasurable
statement:
theorem measure_map_prod_map_of_aemeasurable {α β γ δ : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace γ] [MeasurableSpace δ]
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEMeasurable g ν) :
    (μ.map f).prod (ν.map g) =
      (μ.prod ν).map (fun p : α × β => (f p.1, g p.2))
proof:
:= by
  let f' := hf.mk f
  let g' := hg.mk g
  have hf_map : μ.map f = μ.map f' := Measure.map_congr hf.ae_eq_mk
  have hg_map : ν.map g = ν.map g' := Measure.map_congr hg.ae_eq_mk
  have hpair :
      (fun p : α × β => (f p.1, g p.2)) =ᵐ[μ.prod ν]
        Prod.map f' g' := by
    exact
      ((Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := ν)).ae_eq_comp hf.ae_eq_mk).prodMk
        ((Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := ν)).ae_eq_comp hg.ae_eq_mk)
  calc
    (μ.map f).prod (ν.map g)
        = (μ.map f').prod (ν.map g') := by rw [hf_map, hg_map]
    _ = (μ.prod ν).map (Prod.map f' g') :=
        Measure.map_prod_map μ ν hf.measurable_mk hg.measurable_mk
    _ = (μ.prod ν).map (fun p : α × β => (f p.1, g p.2)) :=
        Measure.map_congr hpair.symm

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset
statement:
theorem ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset (μ : Measure ℝ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc a b) : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, z ∈ Icc a b
proof:
:=
  (show ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, z ∈ μ.support from μ.support_mem_ae).mono hsupport

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.isCompact_support_of_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem isCompact_support_of_subset_Icc (μ : Measure ℝ) {a b : ℝ}

name: CurveIntegrable.concat
statement:
protected theorem CurveIntegrable.concat (p : Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hγ : ∀ i, CurveIntegrable ω (γ i)) : CurveIntegrable ω (Path.concat p γ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Path.concat_zero]; exact CurveIntegrable.refl _ _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Path.concat_succ]
    exact (ih (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc) (fun i => hγ i.castSucc)).trans
      (hγ (Fin.last n))

name: curveIntegral_concat
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_concat (p : Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hγ : ∀ i, CurveIntegrable ω (γ i)) :
    curveIntegral ω (Path.concat p γ) = ∑ i : Fin n, curveIntegral ω (γ i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Path.concat_succ]
    erw [curveIntegral_trans
      (CurveIntegrable.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc) (fun i => hγ i.castSucc))
      (hγ (Fin.last n)), ih _ _ (fun i => hγ i.castSucc), Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]

name: Path.forall_mem_concat
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro r; simpa only [concat_zero, Path.refl_apply] using hp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro r
    rw [concat_succ]
    have hr : (concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc)).trans (γ (Fin.last n)) r ∈
        range (concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc)) ∪ range (γ (Fin.last n)) := by
      rw [← Path.trans_range]
      exact mem_range_self r
    rcases hr with ⟨t, ht⟩ | ⟨t, ht⟩
    · erw [← ht]
      exact ih (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => γ i.castSucc) hp (fun i => hγ i.castSucc) t
    · erw [← ht]
      exact hγ (Fin.last n) t

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_lt_mul_lpNorm_le_inv_pow
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_mul_lpNorm_le_inv_pow {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : MemLp X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    μ.real {ω | a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ < ‖X ω‖} ≤ (a ^ q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  by_cases hzero : lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ = 0
  · have hz := (lpNorm_eq_zero hX hq0).mp hzero
    have he : {ω | a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ < ‖X ω‖} =ᵐ[μ] (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hz] with ω hω
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hω
      apply propext
      change (a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ < ‖X ω‖) ↔ False
      simp [hzero, hω]
    rw [measureReal_congr he, measureReal_empty]
    positivity
  have hL : 0 < lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne lpNorm_nonneg (Ne.symm hzero)
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => ‖X ω‖ ^ (q : ℝ)) μ := by
    exact (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hX.1 hq0 (by simp)).mpr hX
  have hi' : Integrable (fun ω => ‖X ω‖ ^ q) μ := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using hi
  have hm : (∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ q ∂μ) = lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ^ q := by
    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal hq0 (by simp) hX.1]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (integral_nonneg fun _ =>
      Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _), inv_mul_cancel₀ hqr.ne', Real.rpow_one]
    simp only [Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hs : {ω | a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ < ‖X ω‖} ⊆
      {ω | (a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) ^ q ≤ ‖X ω‖ ^ q} := by
    intro ω hω
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_pos ha hL).le hω.le q
  have hmarkov := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (X ω)) q)
    hi' ((a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) ^ q)
  have ht : 0 < (a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) ^ q := pow_pos (mul_pos ha hL) q
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | (a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) ^ q ≤ ‖X ω‖ ^ q} :=
      measureReal_mono hs
    _ ≤ (∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ q ∂μ) / (a * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) ^ q :=
      (le_div_iff₀ ht).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hmarkov)
    _ = (a ^ q)⁻¹ := by rw [hm, mul_pow]; field_simp

name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_lt_exp_mul_lpNorm_le_exp_neg
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_exp_mul_lpNorm_le_exp_neg {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : MemLp X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | Real.exp 1 * lpNorm X (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ < ‖X ω‖} ≤ Real.exp (-(q : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := measureReal_lt_mul_lpNorm_le_inv_pow hq hX (Real.exp_pos 1)
  convert h using 1
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_neg]
  simp

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype
statement:
theorem integrable_iSup_of_fintype {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [Fintype ι]
    [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t, Integrable (f t) μ) (hm : ∀ t, Measurable (f t)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ⨆ t, f t ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun t _ => (hf t).abs)
    (Measurable.iSup hm).aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  obtain ⟨t0⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => f t ω) := (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  have hs : ∀ t, |f t ω| ≤ ∑ t, |f t ω| := fun t =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun t => |f t ω|) (fun t _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ t)
  constructor
  · have h1 := le_ciSup hb t0
    have h2 := hs t0
    have := neg_abs_le (f t0 ω)
    linarith
  · exact ciSup_le fun t => (le_abs_self _).trans (hs t)

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_iInf_of_fintype
statement:
theorem integrable_iInf_of_fintype {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [Fintype ι]
    [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t, Integrable (f t) μ) (hm : ∀ t, Measurable (f t)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ⨅ t, f t ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun t _ => (hf t).abs)
    (Measurable.iInf hm).aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  obtain ⟨t0⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
  have hb : BddBelow (Set.range fun t => f t ω) := (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow
  have hs : ∀ t, |f t ω| ≤ ∑ t, |f t ω| := fun t =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun t => |f t ω|) (fun t _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ t)
  constructor
  · refine le_ciInf fun t => ?_
    have := neg_abs_le (f t ω)
    have := hs t
    linarith
  · have h1 := ciInf_le hb t0
    have h2 := hs t0
    have := le_abs_self (f t0 ω)
    linarith

name: Matrix.integral_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem integral_conjTranspose (f : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (∫ x, (f x)ᴴ ∂μ) = (∫ x, f x ∂μ)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix n n 𝕜 →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Matrix n n 𝕜 :=
    (starₗᵢ ℝ : Matrix n n 𝕜 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Matrix n n 𝕜).toLinearIsometry
  simpa only [L, LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry, coe_starₗᵢ,
    Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using L.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ) f

name: Matrix.isHermitian_integral
statement:
theorem isHermitian_integral {f : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (f x).IsHermitian) : (∫ x, f x ∂μ).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ x, f x ∂μ)ᴴ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
  rw [← integral_conjTranspose]
  exact integral_congr_ae (hf.mono fun x hx => hx.eq)

name: Matrix.trace_integral
statement:
theorem trace_integral {f : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ).trace = ∫ x, (f x).trace ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  exact ((Matrix.traceLinearMap n 𝕜 𝕜).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm hf).symm

name: Matrix.re_trace_integral
statement:
theorem re_trace_integral {f : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    RCLike.re (∫ x, f x ∂μ).trace = ∫ x, RCLike.re (f x).trace ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_integral hf]
  exact (integral_re ((Matrix.traceLinearMap n 𝕜 𝕜).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hf)).symm

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.support_map_eq_range_of_compact
statement:
theorem support_map_eq_range_of_compact (μ : Measure X) (f : X → Y)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hfull : μ.support=Set.univ) :
    (μ.map f).support=Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  have hr : IsClosed (Set.range f) := (isCompact_range hf).isClosed
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply support_subset_of_isClosed hr
    apply (ae_map_iff hf.measurable.aemeasurable hr.measurableSet).mpr
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ⟨x,rfl⟩
  · rintro y ⟨x,rfl⟩
    apply (mem_support_iff_forall _).mpr
    intro U hU
    have hx : x∈μ.support := by rw [hfull]; trivial
    have hp := (mem_support_iff_forall x).mp hx (f ⁻¹' U) (hf.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hU)
    exact hp.trans_le (le_map_apply hf.measurable.aemeasurable U)

name: MeasureTheory.isHermitian_polarizationHermitianFamily
statement:
theorem isHermitian_polarizationHermitianFamily (k : (n × n) ⊕ (n × n)) :
    (polarizationHermitianFamily k).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | inl p => exact isHermitian_hermitianUnitRe p.1 p.2
  | inr p => exact isHermitian_hermitianUnitIm p.1 p.2

name: MeasureTheory.sum_stieltjesTransform_polarizationSignedCoordinates
statement:
theorem sum_stieltjesTransform_polarizationSignedCoordinates
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (μ : (n → ℂ) → FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z) = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    M z = ∑ k, (polarizationSignedCoordinates μ k).stieltjesTransform z •
      polarizationHermitianFamily k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [polarizationSignedCoordinates, polarizationHermitianFamily, Sum.elim_inl,
    Sum.elim_inr, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_smul,
    SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_sub _ _ hz, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure,
    Complex.real_smul, ← hμ _ z hz]
  simp_rw [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub, matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub_I]
  have hr (i j : n) :
      ((1 / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (2 * ((M z) i j + (M z) j i)) =
        ((M z) i j + (M z) j i) / 4 := by push_cast; ring
  have hi (i j : n) :
      ((-1 / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (2 * Complex.I * ((M z) i j - (M z) j i)) =
        ((M z) i j - (M z) j i) / (4 * Complex.I) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    simp only [Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  simp_rw [hr, hi, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  exact (sum_hermitianUnit_eq (M z)).symm

name: MeasureTheory.exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_quadratic_stieltjes
statement:
theorem exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_quadratic_stieltjes
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (μ : (n → ℂ) → FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z) = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n, ∀ v : n → ℂ,
      P.quadraticForm v = (μ v : Measure ℝ).toSignedMeasure
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _hP, hrep⟩ := exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_stieltjesCombination
    polarizationHermitianFamily isHermitian_polarizationHermitianFamily
    (polarizationSignedCoordinates μ) M
    (fun _ hz => sum_stieltjesTransform_polarizationSignedCoordinates M μ hμ hz)
    (fun v => ⟨μ v, hμ v⟩)
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  intro v
  apply SignedMeasure.eq_of_stieltjesTransform_eq
  intro z hz
  rw [hrep v z hz, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure]
  exact hμ v z hz

name: MeasureTheory.condExp_prod_fst_of_integral_eq
statement:
theorem condExp_prod_fst_of_integral_eq
    {μ : Measure A} {ν : Measure B} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {f : A × B → E} {g : A → E} (hf : Integrable f (μ.prod ν))
    (hg : StronglyMeasurable g) (he : ∀ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂ν = g x) :
    (μ.prod ν)[f | MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ.prod ν]
      fun p => g p.1
proof:
:= by
  have hgi : Integrable g μ := by simpa only [he] using hf.integral_prod_left
  have hgp : Integrable (fun p : A × B => g p.1) (μ.prod ν) := hgi.comp_fst ν
  have hfst : @Measurable (A × B) A
      (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance) _ Prod.fst :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  refine (ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq measurable_fst.comap_le hf
    (fun s _ _ => hgp.integrableOn) ?_ (hg.comp_measurable hfst).aestronglyMeasurable).symm
  rintro s ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ hs
  have hset : Prod.fst ⁻¹' t = t ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set B) := by ext p; simp
  rw [hset, setIntegral_prod _ hgp.integrableOn, setIntegral_prod _ hf.integrableOn]
  simp only [integral_const, Measure.restrict_univ, probReal_univ, one_smul, he]

name: NLAlib.exponentialAtomicMeasure_toMeasure

name: NLAlib.integral_exponentialAtomicMeasure

name: NLAlib.isCompactExpRepresentation_exponentialAtomicMeasure

theorem isCompactExpRepresentation_exponentialAtomicMeasure (a b : ι → ℝ)
