name: MeasureTheory.measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_two_resolvent_grids
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_two_resolvent_grids
    {Ω E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [CStarAlgebra E] [CStarAlgebra F]
    [Nontrivial E] [Nontrivial F]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A : Ω → E) (B : Ω → F)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsSelfAdjoint (A ω)) (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsSelfAdjoint (B ω))
    (N M : Finset ℝ) {η C δ ε : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : δ + (C + 1) * ε / η^2 ≤ (2 * η)⁻¹) :
    μ.real {ω | 2 * C * η < Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A ω)) (spectrum ℝ (B ω))} ≤
      μ.real {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε} +
      μ.real {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), ∃ u ∈ M, |ξ-u| ≤ ε} +
      (∑ u ∈ N, μ.real {ω |
        C * ‖resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + δ <
          ‖resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖}) +
      ∑ u ∈ M, μ.real {ω |
        C * ‖resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + δ <
          ‖resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Bad : Set Ω := {ω | 2 * C * η <
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A ω)) (spectrum ℝ (B ω))}
  let LA : Set Ω := {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε}
  let LB : Set Ω := {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), ∃ u ∈ M, |ξ-u| ≤ ε}
  let EF (u : ℝ) : Set Ω := {ω |
    C * ‖resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + δ <
      ‖resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖}
  let ER (u : ℝ) : Set Ω := {ω |
    C * ‖resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + δ <
      ‖resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖}
  have hsub : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ Bad → ω ∈ ((LA ∪ LB) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, EF u) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ M, ER u := by
    filter_upwards [hA, hB] with ω hωA hωB
    intro hf
    by_cases hcoverA : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
    · by_cases hcoverB : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), ∃ u ∈ M, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
      · by_cases hbadF : ∃ u ∈ N, ω ∈ EF u
        · obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hbadF
          exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem u (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hu he)))
        · by_cases hbadR : ∃ u ∈ M, ω ∈ ER u
          · obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hbadR
            exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem u (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hu he))
          · have hfwd := hωA.forall_exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
              hωB (N : Set ℝ) hη hC hcoverA (fun u hu =>
                le_of_not_gt (fun hh => hbadF ⟨u, hu, hh⟩)) herror
            have hrev := hωB.forall_exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
              hωA (M : Set ℝ) hη hC hcoverB (fun u hu =>
                le_of_not_gt (fun hh => hbadR ⟨u, hu, hh⟩)) herror
            exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge
              (Metric.hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist (by positivity) hfwd hrev) hf)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr hcoverB))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl hcoverA))
  have hm : μ.real Bad ≤ μ.real (((LA ∪ LB) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, EF u) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ M, ER u) :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) (measure_mono_ae hsub)
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real ((LA ∪ LB) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, EF u) + μ.real (⋃ u ∈ M, ER u) :=
      hm.trans (measureReal_union_le _ _)
    _ ≤ (μ.real (LA ∪ LB) + μ.real (⋃ u ∈ N, EF u)) + ∑ u ∈ M, μ.real (ER u) :=
      add_le_add (measureReal_union_le _ _) (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le M ER)
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (add_le_add (measureReal_union_le _ _) (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le N EF)) le_rfl

name: Real.abs_ciSup_le_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem abs_ciSup_le_of_abs_le {T : Type*} [Nonempty T]
    (f : T → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (h : ∀ t, |f t| ≤ M) : |⨆ t, f t| ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range f) := ⟨M, by
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h t)⟩
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · let t : T := Classical.choice inferInstance
    exact (abs_le.mp (h t)).1.trans (le_ciSup hb t)
  · exact ciSup_le fun t => (le_abs_self _).trans (h t)

name: MeasureTheory.measurable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_bddAbove
statement:
theorem measurable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_bddAbove
    {T E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (f : E → T → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t, Continuous (fun x => f x t))
    (hb : ∀ x, BddAbove (Set.range (f x))) :
    Measurable (fun x => ⨆ t, f x t)
proof:
:=
  (lowerSemicontinuous_ciSup hb (fun t => (hf t).lowerSemicontinuous)).measurable

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le
    {T E : Type*} [Nonempty T] [TopologicalSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : E → T → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t, Continuous (fun x => f x t))
    {M : ℝ} (h : ∀ x t, |f x t| ≤ M) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⨆ t, f x t) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hm := measurable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_bddAbove f hf (fun x =>
    ⟨M, by rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h x t)⟩)
  apply Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable M
  exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_ciSup_le_of_abs_le (f x) (h x)

name: MeasureTheory.preimage_lt_eq_biUnion_rat
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · intro hω
    have hn : {x | t < f x} ∈ 𝓝 (X ω) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const hf).mem_nhds hω
    obtain ⟨l, u, hxu, hlu⟩ := mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hn
    obtain ⟨q, hlq, hqx⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hxu.1
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨q, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hlu ⟨hlq, hqx.trans hxu.2⟩, hqx⟩⟩
  · intro hω
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hω
    obtain ⟨hq, hqx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hq
    exact hq.trans_le (hm hqx.le)

name: MeasureTheory.directedOn_upperCuts
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq r hr
  rcases le_total q r with h | h
  · refine ⟨q, hq, subset_rfl, ?_⟩
    intro ω hω
    change (q : ℝ) < X ω
    change (r : ℝ) < X ω at hω
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (show (q : ℝ) ≤ r by exact_mod_cast h) hω
  · refine ⟨r, hr, ?_, subset_rfl⟩
    intro ω hω
    change (r : ℝ) < X ω
    change (q : ℝ) < X ω at hω
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (show (r : ℝ) ≤ q by exact_mod_cast h) hω

name: MeasureTheory.measure_lt_comp_le_of_measure_lt_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [preimage_lt_eq_biUnion_rat X hf hm t, preimage_lt_eq_biUnion_rat Y hf hm t]
  change μ (⋃ q ∈ {q : ℚ | t < f q}, {ω | (q : ℝ) < X ω}) ≤
    ν (⋃ q ∈ {q : ℚ | t < f q}, {ω | (q : ℝ) < Y ω})
  rw [measure_biUnion_eq_iSup (Set.to_countable _) (directedOn_upperCuts X f t),
    measure_biUnion_eq_iSup (Set.to_countable _) (directedOn_upperCuts Y f t)]
  exact iSup_le fun q => iSup_le fun hq =>
    (hXY q).trans (le_iSup_of_le q (le_iSup_of_le hq le_rfl))

name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_comp_le_of_measure_lt_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_comp_le_of_measure_lt_le {Ω Ω' : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω'] {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {Y : Ω' → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y ν)
    (hXY : ∀ t : ℝ, μ {ω | t < X ω} ≤ ν {ω | t < Y ω})
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hm : Monotone f) (hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (f (X ω)) ∂μ) ≤
      ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (f (Y ω)) ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt μ (ae_of_all _ fun _ => hn _)
      (hf.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hX),
    lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt ν (ae_of_all _ fun _ => hn _)
      (hf.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hY)]
  exact lintegral_mono fun t => measure_lt_comp_le_of_measure_lt_le X Y hXY hf hm t

name: realMomentCFC
statement: private theorem realMomentCFC : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  (IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)).toContinuousFunctionalCalculus

name: lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_gramMoment
statement:
theorem lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_gramMoment (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ a)) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => f x) (4 * q : ENNReal)
        (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha) =
      ((φ ((star (cfc f a) * cfc f a) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^ ((4 * q : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 4 * q := by omega
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint (cfc f a) := IsSelfAdjoint.cfc
  have hc : cfc (fun x : ℝ => |f x| ^ (4 * q)) a =
      (star (cfc f a) * cfc f a) ^ (2 * q) := by
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => f x ^ (4 * q)) a := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro x hx
        exact (show Even (4 * q) from ⟨2 * q, by omega⟩).pow_abs _
      _ = cfc f a ^ (4 * q) := cfc_pow f (4 * q) a hf ha
      _ = (star (cfc f a) * cfc f a) ^ (2 * q) := by
        rw [hself.star_eq, ← pow_two, ← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        omega
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, hc] using
    lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq φ ha f hf (4 * q) hp

name: lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_resolvent_modulus
statement:
theorem lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_resolvent_modulus (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖) (4 * q : ENNReal)
        (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha) =
      ((φ ((star (resolvent a z) * resolvent a z) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^
        ((4 * q : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hnonzero (x : ℝ) : z - (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hz
    have heq : z = (x : ℂ) := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    rw [heq]
    rfl
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖) (spectrum ℝ a) :=
    ((continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal).inv₀ hnonzero).norm.continuousOn
  rw [lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_gramMoment φ ha _ hf q hq,
    ← ha.abs_resolvent_eq_cfc hz]
  congr 3
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint (CFC.abs (resolvent a z)) := (CFC.abs_nonneg _).isSelfAdjoint
  rw [hself.star_eq, ← pow_two, CFC.abs_sq]

name: Matrix.measurable_inv
statement: theorem measurable_inv : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n 𝕜 => A⁻¹)
proof:
:= by

  exact (continuous_id.matrix_det.measurable.inv).smul
    continuous_id.matrix_adjugate.measurable

name: MvPolynomial.ae_eval_ne_zero_normedField_fin
statement:
private theorem ae_eval_ne_zero_normedField_fin (μ : Measure 𝕜) [SigmaFinite μ]
    [NullSingletonClass μ] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) 𝕜), f ≠ 0 →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ), MvPolynomial.eval x f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => hf ?_
    apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro y
    have : y = x := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst this
    simpa using hx
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f hf
    set g := MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv 𝕜 n f with hg
    have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hf
      exact (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv 𝕜 n).injective (by rw [← hg, h, map_zero])
    have hc : g.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hg0
    have hih := ih g.leadingCoeff hc
    rw [ae_iff]
    simp only [ne_eq, not_not]
    have hmp := measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => μ) 0
    let T : Set (𝕜 × (Fin n → 𝕜)) :=
      {q | MvPolynomial.eval (Fin.cons q.1 q.2 : Fin (n+1) → 𝕜) f = 0}
    have hT : MeasurableSet T := by
      have hcont : Continuous fun q : 𝕜 × (Fin n → 𝕜) =>
          MvPolynomial.eval (Fin.cons q.1 q.2 : Fin (n+1) → 𝕜) f := by
        apply (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval f).comp
        refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · simpa using continuous_fst
        · simp only [Fin.cons_succ]; exact (continuous_apply j).comp continuous_snd
      exact hcont.measurable (measurableSet_singleton 0)
    have hpre : MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => 𝕜) 0 ⁻¹' T =
        {x | MvPolynomial.eval x f = 0} := by
      ext x
      have hx : (Fin.cons (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => 𝕜) 0 x).1
          (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => 𝕜) 0 x).2 : Fin (n+1) → 𝕜) = x := by
        ext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply]
        · simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply, Fin.tail]
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, T, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      rw [hx]
    rw [← hpre, hmp.measure_preimage hT.nullMeasurableSet, Measure.prod_apply_symm hT]
    refine (lintegral_congr_ae ?_).trans lintegral_zero
    filter_upwards [hih] with s hs
    have hpoly : Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval s) g ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hs
      have := congrArg (fun q => Polynomial.coeff q g.natDegree) h0
      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hfin : ((fun y => (y, s)) ⁻¹' T).Finite := by
      refine (Polynomial.roots
        (Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval s) g)).toFinset.finite_toSet.subset ?_
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, T, MvPolynomial.eval_eq_eval_mv_eval']
        at hy
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hpoly,
        Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
      exact hy
    simpa using hfin.measure_zero μ

name: MvPolynomial.ae_eval_ne_zero_normedField
statement:
theorem ae_eval_ne_zero_normedField {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : Measure 𝕜)
    [SigmaFinite μ] [NullSingletonClass μ] (f : MvPolynomial ι 𝕜) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => μ), MvPolynomial.eval x f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι) := Fintype.equivFin ι
  have hg : MvPolynomial.rename e f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hf
    exact MvPolynomial.rename_injective e e.injective (by rw [h, map_zero])
  have h := ae_eval_ne_zero_normedField_fin μ _ _ hg
  let T : (Fin (Fintype.card ι) → 𝕜) → (ι → 𝕜) := fun y i => y (e i)
  have hT : Measurable T := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => measurable_pi_apply _
  have hmap : Measure.map T (Measure.pi fun _ => μ) = Measure.pi fun _ : ι => μ := by
    symm
    refine Measure.pi_eq fun s hs => ?_
    rw [Measure.map_apply hT (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs)]
    have hpre : T ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi s = Set.univ.pi fun k => s (e.symm k) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, T]
      constructor
      · intro hy k; simpa using hy (e.symm k)
      · intro hy i; simpa using hy (e i)
    rw [hpre, Measure.pi_pi]
    exact Fintype.prod_equiv e.symm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {x : ι → 𝕜 | MvPolynomial.eval x f ≠ 0} :=
    ((MvPolynomial.continuous_eval f).measurable (measurableSet_singleton 0)).compl
  rw [← hmap, ae_map_iff hT.aemeasurable hmeas]
  filter_upwards [h] with y hy
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_rename] at hy
  exact hy

name: Matrix.measurable_entry
statement: theorem measurable_entry (i : m) (j : n) : Measurable fun A : Matrix m n α => A i j
proof:

name: Matrix.measurable_of

name: Matrix.measurable_iff_entries
statement:

    Measurable f ↔ ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => f x i j
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf i j => (measurable_entry i j).comp hf, fun h => ?_⟩
  exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j => h i j

name: Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose
statement:

theorem measurable_conjTranspose [Star α] [TopologicalSpace α] [ContinuousStar α]
    [BorelSpace α] : Measurable (conjTranspose : Matrix m n α → Matrix n m α)
proof:
:=
  measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun i j => continuous_star.measurable.comp (measurable_entry j i)

name: Measurable.matrix_mul
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem Measurable.matrix_mul {β l m n α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] [MeasurableMul₂ α] [MeasurableAdd₂ α]
    {f : β → Matrix l m α} {g : β → Matrix m n α} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) :
    Measurable fun x => f x * g x
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun i j => ?_
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun k _ =>
    ((Matrix.measurable_entry i k).comp hf).mul ((Matrix.measurable_entry k j).comp hg)

name: MeasureTheory.hasDerivAt_resolventPowerMean
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resolventPowerMean
    (X : Ω → selfAdjoint A) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (L : A →L[ℂ] E) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (resolventPowerMean μ X L n)
      (-(n : ℂ)•resolventPowerMean μ X L (n+1) z) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolventPowerMean
  have h := L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z
    (hasDerivAt_integral_resolvent_selfAdjoint_pow X hX hz n)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,map_smul] using h

proof:

    (a.property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz) n)

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_log_sub_of_lt_support
statement:
theorem integrable_log_sub_of_lt_support (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) {u : ℝ} (hu : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, u < x) :
    Integrable (fun x => Real.log (x - u)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.log (x - u)) μ.support := by
    apply (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.log
    intro x hx
    exact (sub_pos.mpr (hu x hx)).ne'
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
  have hre : μ.restrict μ.support = μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_inv_sub_of_lt_support
statement:
theorem integrable_inv_sub_of_lt_support (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) {u : ℝ} (hu : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, u < x) :
    Integrable (fun x => (x - u)⁻¹) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (x - u)⁻¹) μ.support := by
    apply (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.inv₀
    intro x hx
    exact (sub_pos.mpr (hu x hx)).ne'
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
  have hre : μ.restrict μ.support = μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi

name: MeasureTheory.hasDerivAt_logarithmicPotential_of_lt_support
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_logarithmicPotential_of_lt_support
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, u < x) :
    HasDerivAt (logarithmicPotential μ) (-(∫ x, (x - u)⁻¹ ∂μ)) u
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun v x => Real.log (x - v)
  let D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    fun v x => (-(x-v)⁻¹) • (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  let U : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | p.1 < p.2}
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_snd
  have hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) U := by
    apply (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst).continuousOn.log
    intro p hp
    exact (sub_pos.mpr hp).ne'
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.1 p.2) U := by
    have hi : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.2-p.1)⁻¹) U :=
      (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst).continuousOn.inv₀
        (fun p hp => (sub_pos.mpr hp).ne')
    exact hi.neg.smul continuousOn_const
  have hd (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ U) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun v => F v p.2) (D p.1 p.2) p.1 := by
    have hh := ((hasDerivAt_const p.1 p.2).sub (hasDerivAt_id p.1)).log
      (sub_pos.mpr hp).ne'
    convert! hh.hasFDerivAt using 1
    ext
    simp [D, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have h := NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support μ hμ F D U hU hF hD hd u hu
  have hDi : Integrable (D u) μ := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (D u) μ.support :=
      hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn hu
    have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
    have hre : μ.restrict μ.support = μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
    rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi
  have hh := h.hasDerivAt
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hDi] at hh
  convert! hh using 1
  simp [D, integral_neg]

name: MeasureTheory.continuousAt_integral_log_one_add_mul_zero
statement:
private theorem continuousAt_integral_log_one_add_mul_zero
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) :
    ContinuousAt (fun v : ℝ => ∫ x, Real.log (1 + v * x) ∂μ) 0
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun v x => Real.log (1 + v * x)
  let D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    fun v x => (x / (1 + v * x)) • (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  let U : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 1 + p.1 * p.2 ≠ 0}
  have harg : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + p.1 * p.2) := by fun_prop
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun harg continuous_const
  have hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) U :=
    harg.continuousOn.log (fun _ hp => hp)
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.1 p.2) U :=
    (continuous_snd.continuousOn.div harg.continuousOn (fun _ hp => hp)).smul
      continuousOn_const
  have hd (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ U) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun v => F v p.2) (D p.1 p.2) p.1 := by
    have hh := (((hasDerivAt_id p.1).mul_const p.2).const_add 1).log hp
    convert! hh.hasFDerivAt using 1
    ext
    simp [D, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have h := NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support μ hμ F D U hU hF hD hd 0
    (fun _ _ => by simp [U])
  exact h.continuousAt

name: MeasureTheory.tendsto_logarithmicPotential_sub_log_neg_atBot
statement:
theorem tendsto_logarithmicPotential_sub_log_neg_atBot
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) :
    Tendsto (fun u => logarithmicPotential μ u - Real.log (-u)) atBot (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont := continuousAt_integral_log_one_add_mul_zero μ hμ
  have ht : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => ∫ x, Real.log (1 + (-u)⁻¹ * x) ∂μ)
      atBot (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, Real.log_one, integral_zero] using
      hcont.tendsto.comp (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop)
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := hμ.bddAbove_image continuous_norm.continuousOn
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_lt_atBot (min (-R) (-1))] with u hu
  have huR : u < -R := lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _)
  have hu0 : u < 0 := by
    have hu1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_right (-R) (-1))
    linarith
  have hsupport : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, u < x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := hR ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
    have hxlo := neg_abs_le x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hxR
    linarith
  have hi := integrable_log_sub_of_lt_support μ hμ hsupport
  have he : logarithmicPotential μ u - Real.log (-u) =
      ∫ x, Real.log (x-u) - Real.log (-u) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_sub hi (integrable_const _), integral_const]
    simp [logarithmicPotential]
  rw [he]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
  have harg : 1 + (-u)⁻¹ * x = (x-u)/(-u) := by
    field_simp [hu0.ne]
    ring
  rw [harg, Real.log_div (sub_pos.mpr (hsupport x hx)).ne' (neg_pos.mpr hu0).ne']

name: MeasureTheory.eqOn_logarithmicPotential_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem eqOn_logarithmicPotential_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : ∀ x ∈ μ.support, a ≤ x) (F : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ u < a, HasDerivAt F (-(∫ x, (x-u)⁻¹ ∂μ)) u)
    (hF_infty : Tendsto (fun u => F u - Real.log (-u)) atBot (𝓝 0)) :
    EqOn F (logarithmicPotential μ) (Iio a)
proof:
:= by
  have hL (u : ℝ) (hu : u < a) :=
    hasDerivAt_logarithmicPotential_of_lt_support μ hμ
      (fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hu (ha x hx))
  have hD (u : ℝ) (hu : u < a) :
      HasDerivAt (fun v => F v - logarithmicPotential μ v) 0 u := by
    convert! (hF u hu).sub (hL u hu) using 1
    simp
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := isOpen_Iio.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
    (convex_Iio a).isPreconnected
    (fun u hu => (hD u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun u hu => (hD u hu).deriv)
  have ht₀ : Tendsto (fun u => F u - logarithmicPotential μ u) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
    convert hF_infty.sub (tendsto_logarithmicPotential_sub_log_neg_atBot μ hμ) using 1
    · funext u
      ring
    · simp
  have htc : Tendsto (fun u => F u - logarithmicPotential μ u) atBot (𝓝 c) := by
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_lt_atBot a] with u hu
    exact (hc u hu).symm
  have hc₀ : c = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique htc ht₀
  intro u hu
  have hh := hc u hu
  rw [hc₀] at hh
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hh

name: MeasureTheory.exists_uniform_stieltjes_bound_on_support_of_local_average_im_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_stieltjes_bound_on_support_of_local_average_im_bound
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T]
    (ν : Measure T) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (ρ : T → FiniteMeasure ℝ) (r : T → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hrep : ∀ t : T, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → r t z=
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → Continuous (fun t : T => r t z))
    (B : NNReal) (hmass : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, (ρ t).mass≤B)
    (hmeas : ∀ γ : NNReal, γ≠0 → AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : T × ℝ => (r p.1 ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)).im) (ν.prod volume))
    (x ε δ C : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (havg : ∀ y ∈ ball x ε, ∀ γ : NNReal, γ≠0 → (γ : ℝ)<δ →
      (∫ t : T, (r t ((y : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)).im ∂ν)≤C*(γ : ℝ)) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0≤M ∧ ∀ t ∈ ν.support, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → z.re=x → ‖r t z‖≤M
proof:
:= by
  let C0 := max C ((B : ℝ)/δ^2)
  have hfull : ∀ y ∈ ball x ε, ∀ γ : NNReal, γ≠0 →
      (∫ t : T, (r t ((y : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)).im ∂ν)≤C0*(γ : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy γ hγ
    have hγpos : 0<(γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
    by_cases hsmall : (γ : ℝ)<δ
    · exact (havg y hy γ hγ hsmall).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hγpos.le)
    · let z : ℂ := (y : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I
      have hz : 0<z.im := by simpa [z] using hγpos
      have hbound : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, ‖r t z‖≤(B : ℝ)/(γ : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hmass] with t ht
        rw [hrep t z hz]
        have hh := Complex.norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le (ρ t : Measure ℝ) hz
        have hm : (ρ t : Measure ℝ).real univ=((ρ t).mass : ℝ) := by
          rw [Measure.real,← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,ENNReal.coe_toReal]
        simp only [hm,z,Complex.add_im,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.I_im,Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,zero_add,add_zero] at hh
        exact hh.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr ht) hγpos.le)
      have hi : Integrable (fun t : T => r t z) ν :=
        (integrable_const _).mono' (hc z hz).aestronglyMeasurable hbound
      have hmean : (∫ t : T, (r t z).im ∂ν)≤(B : ℝ)/(γ : ℝ) := by
        calc
          _ ≤ ∫ _t : T, (B : ℝ)/(γ : ℝ) ∂ν :=
            integral_mono_ae hi.im (integrable_const _)
              (hbound.mono fun t ht => (Complex.im_le_norm _).trans ht)
          _ = _ := by simp only [integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul]
      have hδγ : δ≤(γ : ℝ) := le_of_not_gt hsmall
      have hsq : δ^2≤(γ : ℝ)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hδ.le hδγ 2
      have hlarge : (B : ℝ)/(γ : ℝ)≤((B : ℝ)/δ^2)*(γ : ℝ) := by
        calc
          _ = ((B : ℝ)*(γ : ℝ))/(γ : ℝ)^2 := by field_simp [hγpos.ne']
          _ ≤ ((B : ℝ)*(γ : ℝ))/δ^2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg B.property hγpos.le) (sq_pos_of_pos hδ) hsq
          _ = _ := by ring
      exact hmean.trans (hlarge.trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hγpos.le))
  let a := ε/2
  have ha : 0<a := half_pos hε
  have haε : a<ε := by dsimp only [a]; linarith
  obtain ⟨g,hgone,hgzero,hgcompact,hgrange⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_one_zero_of_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall x a)
      isOpen_ball.isClosed_compl
      (disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr (closedBall_subset_ball haε))
  let f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ := BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup g g.continuous 1
    (fun y => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hgrange y).1]; exact (hgrange y).2)
  have hfint : Integrable f := g.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgcompact
  have hfnonneg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0≤f y := fun y => (hgrange y).1
  have hfone : ∀ y : ℝ, |y-x|<a → 1≤f y := by
    intro y hy
    have hymem : y∈closedBall x a := by simpa only [mem_closedBall,Real.dist_eq] using hy.le
    exact (hgone hymem).symm.le
  have hzero := ae_integral_eq_zero_of_average_im_stieltjes_le_mul ν ρ r hrep B hmass hmeas
    f hfint hfnonneg (ball x ε) (fun y hy => hgzero hy) C0 hfull
  refine ⟨a⁻¹*(B : ℝ),by positivity,?_⟩
  intro t ht z hz hzx
  exact norm_stieltjes_family_le_on_support_of_ae_zero_positive_test ν ρ r hrep hc B hmass
    f hfnonneg hzero x a ha hfone t ht z hz hzx

name: circleIntegral.conj_eq_neg_of_conj_eq
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => circleMap 0 r θ * I * f (circleMap 0 r θ)
  have hF : Function.Periodic F (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro θ
    dsimp [F]
    rw [(periodic_circleMap 0 r) θ]
  have hc (θ : ℝ) : conj (F θ) = -F (-θ) := by
    have hs := hf (circleMap 0 r θ) (circleMap_mem_sphere' 0 r θ)
    dsimp [F]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, conj_I, conj_circleMap_zero, ← hs,
      conj_circleMap_zero]
    ring
  have hperiod : (∫ θ in -(2 * Real.pi)..0, F θ) = ∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, F θ := by
    simpa using hF.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-(2 * Real.pi)) 0
  simp only [circleIntegral, deriv_circleMap, smul_eq_mul]
  change conj (∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, F θ) = -(∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, F θ)
  rw [← intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_conj]
  simp_rw [hc]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg, neg_zero, hperiod]

name: circleIntegral.normalized_im_eq_zero_of_conj_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp
  rw [map_mul, conj_eq_neg_of_conj_eq hf]
  have hcoef : conj ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹) = -(2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [map_inv₀, map_mul, map_ofNat, conj_ofReal, conj_I, mul_neg, inv_neg]
  rw [hcoef]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_continuous_compact
statement:
private theorem integrable_continuous_compact {Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [CompactSpace Z] (μ : Measure Z)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : C(Z, ℝ)) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:=
  f.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace f)

name: NLAlib.exists_isCoupling_integral_le_of_potentials_le
statement:
theorem exists_isCoupling_integral_le_of_potentials_le
    (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (cost : C(X × Y, ℝ)) (C : ℝ)
    (hdual : ∀ (f : C(X, ℝ)) (g : C(Y, ℝ)),
      (∀ x y, f x + g y ≤ cost (x, y)) → (∫ x, f x ∂μ) + (∫ y, g y ∂ν) ≤ C) :
    ∃ π : Measure (X × Y), π.IsCoupling μ ν ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure π ∧ (∫ p, cost p ∂π) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let V := additivePotentialSubmodule X Y
  have hconst (r : ℝ) : ContinuousMap.const (X × Y) r ∈ V :=
    ⟨ContinuousMap.const X r, 0, by intro p; simp⟩
  obtain ⟨π, hπfinite, hπV, hπcost⟩ :=
    exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_sSup_of_submodule (μ.prod ν) V hconst cost
  have : IsFiniteMeasure π := hπfinite
  have hproduct := Measure.isCoupling_prod μ ν
  have hsplit (F : C(X × Y, ℝ)) (f : C(X, ℝ)) (g : C(Y, ℝ))
      (hF : ∀ p, F p = f p.1 + g p.2) :
      (∫ p, F p ∂μ.prod ν) = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) + ∫ y, g y ∂ν := by
    have hf := hproduct.measurePreserving_fst.integrable_comp_of_integrable
      (integrable_continuous_compact μ f)
    have hg := hproduct.measurePreserving_snd.integrable_comp_of_integrable
      (integrable_continuous_compact ν g)
    calc
      (∫ p, F p ∂μ.prod ν) = ∫ p, f p.1 + g p.2 ∂μ.prod ν := integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hF)
      _ = (∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ.prod ν) + ∫ p, g p.2 ∂μ.prod ν := integral_add hf hg
      _ = _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·)
        (hproduct.integral_fst f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable)
        (hproduct.integral_snd g.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable)
  have hcouple : π.IsCoupling μ ν := by
    constructor
    · apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
      intro f
      let F : C(X × Y, ℝ) := f.toContinuousMap.comp ⟨Prod.fst, continuous_fst⟩
      have hFV : F ∈ V := ⟨f.toContinuousMap, 0, by intro p; simp [F]⟩
      calc
        (∫ x, f x ∂π.fst) = ∫ p, F p ∂π :=
          integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        _ = ∫ p, F p ∂μ.prod ν := hπV F hFV
        _ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
          simpa using hsplit F f.toContinuousMap 0
            (by intro p; simp [F])
    · apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
      intro g
      let G : C(X × Y, ℝ) := g.toContinuousMap.comp ⟨Prod.snd, continuous_snd⟩
      have hGV : G ∈ V := ⟨0, g.toContinuousMap, by intro p; simp [G]⟩
      calc
        (∫ y, g y ∂π.snd) = ∫ p, G p ∂π :=
          integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable g.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        _ = ∫ p, G p ∂μ.prod ν := hπV G hGV
        _ = ∫ y, g y ∂ν := by
          simpa using hsplit G 0 g.toContinuousMap
            (by intro p; simp [G])
  refine ⟨π, hcouple, hcouple.isProbabilityMeasure, ?_⟩
  rw [hπcost]
  have hnonempty : ((fun F : C(X × Y, ℝ) => ∫ p, F p ∂μ.prod ν) ''
      {F ∈ V | F ≤ cost}).Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, ContinuousMap.const (X × Y) (-‖cost‖),
      ⟨hconst _, fun p => cost.neg_norm_le_apply p⟩, rfl⟩
  apply csSup_le hnonempty
  rintro _ ⟨F, ⟨hFV, hle⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f, g, hF⟩ := hFV
  change (∫ p, F p ∂μ.prod ν) ≤ C
  rw [hsplit F f g hF]
  apply hdual f g
  intro x y
  rw [← hF (x, y)]
  exact hle (x, y)

name: MeasureTheory.approachingThreshold_tendsto
statement:
private theorem approachingThreshold_tendsto (τ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (approachingThreshold τ) atTop (𝓝 τ)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => τ - 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 τ)
  simpa only [one_div, sub_zero] using
    (tendsto_const_nhds (x := τ)).sub tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: MeasureTheory.ge_tail_eq_iInter
statement:
private theorem ge_tail_eq_iInter {Ω : Type*} (f : Ω → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) :
    {ω | τ ≤ f ω} = ⋂ k : ℕ, {ω | approachingThreshold τ k < f ω}
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · intro h
    change τ ≤ f ω at h
    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
    intro k
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    change τ - 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) < f ω
    linarith
  · intro h
    exact le_of_tendsto' (approachingThreshold_tendsto τ)
      (fun k => (Set.mem_iInter.mp h k).le)

name: MeasureTheory.strict_tail_antitone
statement:
private theorem strict_tail_antitone {Ω : Type*} (f : Ω → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) :
    Antitone (fun k : ℕ => {ω | approachingThreshold τ k < f ω})
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn ω hω
  have hcast : (m : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hmn
  have hdiv : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) :=
    one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
  change τ - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) < f ω
  change τ - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) < f ω at hω
  linarith

name: MeasureTheory.measure_ge_le_of_measure_gt_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [ge_tail_eq_iInter X τ, ge_tail_eq_iInter Y τ,
    (strict_tail_antitone X τ).measure_iInter
      (fun _ => nullMeasurableSet_lt aemeasurable_const hX) ⟨0, measure_ne_top _ _⟩,
    (strict_tail_antitone Y τ).measure_iInter
      (fun _ => nullMeasurableSet_lt aemeasurable_const hY) ⟨0, measure_ne_top _ _⟩]
  exact iInf_mono fun k => hcomp (approachingThreshold τ k)

statement: private theorem spectralSupportRealCFC : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint

name: support_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_univ_of_faithful
statement:
theorem support_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_univ_of_faithful
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hS : IsClosed (S : Set A))
    (hfaithful : ∀ b : A, b∈S → φ (star b*b)=0 → b=0)
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (haS : a∈S) :
    (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha).support=Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro x
  apply (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro U hU
  by_contra hpos
  have hU0 : positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha U=0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  let f : C(spectrum ℝ a,ℝ) :=
    ⟨fun y => max 0 (ε-dist y x),continuous_const.max (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.dist continuous_const))⟩
  have hzero : (fun y => f y*f y)=ᵐ[positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hU0] with y hy
    have hd : ε≤dist y x := le_of_not_gt (fun h => hy (hball h))
    have hf : f y=0 := max_eq_left (sub_nonpos.mpr hd)
    simp only [hf,mul_zero,Pi.zero_apply]
  have hInt : ∫ y, (f*f) y ∂positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha=0 := by
    change (∫ y, f y*f y ∂positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha)=0
    rw [integral_congr_ae hzero]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply,integral_zero]
  have hre : (φ (cfcHom ha (f*f))).re=0 :=
    (integral_positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha (f*f)).symm.trans hInt
  have hnonneg : 0≤cfcHom ha (f*f) := (cfcHom_nonneg_iff _).mpr (fun y => mul_self_nonneg (f y))
  have him := (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg hnonneg)).2
  have hz : φ (cfcHom ha (f*f))=0 := Complex.ext hre him.symm
  let Sᵣ : StarSubalgebra ℝ A :=
    { S.toSubalgebra.restrictScalars ℝ with star_mem' := S.star_mem' }
  have hle : StarAlgebra.elemental ℝ a≤Sᵣ := by
    unfold StarAlgebra.elemental
    apply StarSubalgebra.topologicalClosure_minimal
    · exact StarAlgebra.adjoin_le (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr haS)
    · exact hS
  have hmem : cfcHom ha f∈S := hle (cfcHom_mem_elemental ha f)
  have hstar : star (cfcHom ha f)=cfcHom ha f := by rw [← map_star]; simp
  have hsq : cfcHom ha (f*f)=star (cfcHom ha f)*cfcHom ha f := by rw [map_mul,hstar]
  rw [hsq] at hz
  have hcf := hfaithful (cfcHom ha f) hmem hz
  have hf : f=0 := (cfcHom_injective ha) (by simpa only [map_zero] using hcf)
  have hx := congrArg (fun g : C(spectrum ℝ a,ℝ) => g x) hf
  have hε0 : ε=0 := by
    simpa only [f,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,ContinuousMap.zero_apply,dist_self,sub_zero,max_eq_right hε.le] using hx
  exact (ne_of_gt hε) hε0

name: MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_update_pi
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_update_pi (i : ι) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : (ι → Ω) × Ω => Function.update p.1 i p.2)
      ((Measure.pi μ).prod (μ i)) (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurable_update', ?_⟩
  refine (Measure.pi_eq fun s hs => ?_).symm
  rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_update' (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs)]
  have hpre : (fun p : (ι → Ω) × Ω => Function.update p.1 i p.2) ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi s
      = Set.univ.pi (Function.update s i Set.univ) ×ˢ s i := by
    ext ⟨x, t⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, Set.mem_prod]
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨fun j => ?_, by simpa using h i⟩
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp
      · have := h j
        rw [Function.update_of_ne hj] at this
        rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]; exact this
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simpa using h2
      · have := h1 j
        rw [Function.update_of_ne hj] at this
        rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]; exact this
  rw [hpre, Measure.prod_prod, Measure.pi_pi]
  have : (fun j => μ j (Function.update s i Set.univ j))
      = Function.update (fun j => μ j (s j)) i 1 := by
    ext1 j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj; simp
    · simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
  rw [this, Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), one_mul,
    ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => μ j (s j)) (Finset.mem_univ i), mul_comm,
    Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_comp_update_pi
statement:
theorem integrable_comp_update_pi (i : ι) {F : (ι → Ω) → ℝ} (hF : Integrable F (Measure.pi μ)) :
    Integrable (fun p : (ι → Ω) × Ω => F (Function.update p.1 i p.2))
      ((Measure.pi μ).prod (μ i))
proof:
:=
  ((measurePreserving_update_pi μ i).integrable_comp hF.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hF

name: MeasureTheory.integral_integral_update_pi
proof:
:= by
  have hmp := measurePreserving_update_pi μ i
  rw [← integral_prod _ (integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hF)]
  calc ∫ p, F (Function.update p.1 i p.2) ∂((Measure.pi μ).prod (μ i))
      = ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.map (fun p : (ι → Ω) × Ω => Function.update p.1 i p.2)
          ((Measure.pi μ).prod (μ i))) :=
        (integral_map hmp.measurable.aemeasurable
          (by rw [hmp.map_eq]; exact hF.aestronglyMeasurable)).symm
    _ = ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi μ) := by rw [hmp.map_eq]

name: MeasureTheory.ae_integrable_comp_update_pi
proof:
:=
  (integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hF).prod_right_ae

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_integral_update_pi
proof:
:=
  (integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hF).integral_prod_left

name: MeasureTheory.sq_integral_le_integral_div_mul_integral
statement:
theorem sq_integral_le_integral_div_mul_integral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (a b : α → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : ∀ x, δ ≤ b x)
    (ha : Integrable a μ) (hbi : Integrable b μ) (hab : Integrable (fun x => a x ^ 2 / b x) μ) :
    (∫ x, a x ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x, a x ^ 2 / b x ∂μ) * (∫ x, b x ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  set A := ∫ x, a x ∂μ
  set B := ∫ x, b x ∂μ
  set Q := ∫ x, a x ^ 2 / b x ∂μ
  have hB : δ ≤ B := by
    have := integral_mono (integrable_const δ) hbi hb
    simpa using this
  have hBpos : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ hB
  set l := A / B
  have hpt : ∀ x, (a x - l * b x) ^ 2 / b x = a x ^ 2 / b x - 2 * l * a x + l ^ 2 * b x := by
    intro x
    have : b x ≠ 0 := (lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (hb x)).ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (a x - l * b x) ^ 2 / b x ∂μ := by
    refine integral_nonneg (fun x => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hδ.le.trans (hb x)))
  have hcalc : ∫ x, (a x - l * b x) ^ 2 / b x ∂μ = Q - 2 * l * A + l ^ 2 * B := by
    simp_rw [hpt]
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => a x ^ 2 / b x - 2 * l * a x) μ := hab.sub (ha.const_mul _)
    have h2 : Integrable (fun x => l ^ 2 * b x) μ := hbi.const_mul _
    have h3 : Integrable (fun x => 2 * l * a x) μ := ha.const_mul _
    rw [integral_add h1 h2, integral_sub hab h3, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rw [hcalc] at hnonneg
  have : Q - 2 * l * A + l ^ 2 * B = Q - A ^ 2 / B := by
    simp only [l]; field_simp; ring
  rw [this, sub_nonneg, div_le_iff₀ hBpos] at hnonneg
  exact hnonneg

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs
statement:
theorem integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure P] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hXi : ∀ t, Integrable (X t) P)
    (g : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hXae : AEMeasurable (fun ω t => X t ω) P) (K : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ ∑ t, |x t| + K) :
    Integrable (fun ω => g (fun t => X t ω)) P
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun t _ => (hXi t).abs).add
    (integrable_const K)) (hg.comp_aemeasurable hXae).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  simpa using hb (fun t => X t ω)

name: MeasureTheory.stieltjesTransform_quadraticMeasureCombination
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_quadraticMeasureCombination
    (H : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : ∀ k, (H k).IsHermitian) (s : κ → SignedMeasure ℝ)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → M z = ∑ k, (s k).stieltjesTransform z • H k)
    (v : n → ℂ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    (quadraticMeasureCombination H s v).stieltjesTransform z = matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticMeasureCombination, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_sum _ _ hz]
  simp only [SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_smul, Complex.real_smul]
  rw [hM z hz, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hre : ((matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v (H k) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (H k) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · rfl
    · exact (hH k).im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self v |>.symm
  rw [hre]
  ring

name: MeasureTheory.quadraticMeasureCombination_nonneg_of_stieltjes
statement:
theorem quadraticMeasureCombination_nonneg_of_stieltjes
    (H : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : ∀ k, (H k).IsHermitian) (s : κ → SignedMeasure ℝ)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → M z = ∑ k, (s k).stieltjesTransform z • H k)
    (hscalar : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z) = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ E : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet E →
      0 ≤ quadraticMeasureCombination H s v E
proof:
:= by
  intro v E hE
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hscalar v
  have he : quadraticMeasureCombination H s v = (μ : Measure ℝ).toSignedMeasure := by
    apply SignedMeasure.eq_of_stieltjesTransform_eq
    intro z hz
    rw [stieltjesTransform_quadraticMeasureCombination H hH s M hM v hz,
      SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure]
    exact hμ z hz
  rw [he, Measure.toSignedMeasure_apply_measurable hE]
  exact measureReal_nonneg

name: MeasureTheory.exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_stieltjesCombination
statement:
theorem exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_stieltjesCombination
    (H : κ → Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : ∀ k, (H k).IsHermitian) (s : κ → SignedMeasure ℝ)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → M z = ∑ k, (s k).stieltjesTransform z • H k)
    (hscalar : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z) = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ μ : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n,
      μ.toVectorMeasure = matrixMeasureCombination H s ∧
      ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
        (μ.quadraticForm v).stieltjesTransform z = matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := positiveMatrixMeasureOfCombination H hH s
    (quadraticMeasureCombination_nonneg_of_stieltjes H hH s M hM hscalar)
  refine ⟨μ, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro v z hz
  have he : μ.quadraticForm v = quadraticMeasureCombination H s v := by
    apply VectorMeasure.ext
    intro E _
    exact (quadraticMeasureCombination_apply H s v E).symm
  rw [he]
  exact stieltjesTransform_quadraticMeasureCombination H hH s M hM v hz

name: PositiveLinearMap.re_le_re_pow_rpow
statement:
theorem PositiveLinearMap.re_le_re_pow_rpow (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1)
    {a : A} (ha : 0≤a) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) :
    (φ a).re≤((φ (a^m)).re)^((m : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint a := ha.isSelfAdjoint
  let μ := positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := isProbabilityMeasure_positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hφ hself
  let f : spectrum ℝ a → ℝ := fun x => (x : ℝ)
  have hf : Continuous f := continuous_subtype_val
  have hmem : MemLp f (m : ENNReal) μ :=
    hf.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hp : (1 : ENNReal)≤m := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm)
  have hLp : lpNorm f 1 μ≤lpNorm f (m : ENNReal) μ := by
    calc
      _ = (eLpNorm f 1 μ).toReal := (toReal_eLpNorm hmem.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
      _ ≤ (eLpNorm f (m : ENNReal) μ).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hmem.eLpNorm_ne_top
        (eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le hp hmem.aestronglyMeasurable)
      _ = _ := toReal_eLpNorm hmem.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hcalc (n : ℕ) : cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x|^n) a=a^n := by
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x^n) a := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro x hx
        change |x|^n=x^n
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg ha hx)]
      _ = _ := cfc_pow_id a n hself
  have hfirst : lpNorm f 1 μ=(φ a).re := by
    have habs : cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x|) a=a := by simpa only [pow_one] using hcalc 1
    simpa only [pow_one,habs,Nat.cast_one,inv_one,Real.rpow_one] using
      lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq φ hself (fun x : ℝ => x)
        continuous_id.continuousOn 1 (by decide)
  have hlast : lpNorm f (m : ENNReal) μ=((φ (a^m)).re)^((m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    simpa only [hcalc] using lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq φ hself (fun x : ℝ => x)
      continuous_id.continuousOn m hm
  rwa [hfirst,hlast] at hLp

name: MeasureTheory.sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_integral_sq
statement:
theorem sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_integral_sq
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hfg : Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) μ)
    (hf : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2) μ) (hg : Integrable (fun x => (g x)^2) μ) :
    (∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ)^2 ≤ (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ) * ∫ x, (g x)^2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hquad (c : ℝ) : 0 ≤ (∫ x, (g x)^2 ∂μ) * (c*c) +
      (-2 * ∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ) * c + ∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (f x - c*g x)^2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
    have heq : (fun x => (f x - c*g x)^2) =
        (fun x => (f x)^2 - (2*c) * (f x * g x) + (c*c) * (g x)^2) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [heq] at hnonneg
    have hadd := integral_add (hf.sub (hfg.const_mul (2*c))) (hg.const_mul (c*c))
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hadd
    rw [hadd, integral_sub hf (hfg.const_mul (2*c)), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul] at hnonneg
    nlinarith
  have h := discrim_le_zero hquad
  unfold discrim at h
  nlinarith

name: MeasureTheory.sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_mul_integral
statement:
theorem sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_mul_integral
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {f w : α → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hf : Integrable (fun x => f x * w x) μ)
    (hsq : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 * w x) μ) (hwi : Integrable w μ) :
    (∫ x, f x * w x ∂μ)^2 ≤ (∫ x, (f x)^2 * w x ∂μ) * ∫ x, w x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hquad (c : ℝ) : 0 ≤ (∫ x, w x ∂μ) * (c*c) +
      (-2 * ∫ x, f x * w x ∂μ) * c + ∫ x, (f x)^2 * w x ∂μ := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (f x - c)^2 * w x ∂μ :=
      integral_nonneg fun x => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hw x)
    have heq : (fun x => (f x - c)^2 * w x) =
        (fun x => (f x)^2 * w x - (2*c) * (f x * w x) + (c*c) * w x) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [heq] at hnonneg
    have hadd := integral_add (hsq.sub (hf.const_mul (2*c))) (hwi.const_mul (c*c))
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hadd
    rw [hadd, integral_sub hsq (hf.const_mul (2*c)), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul] at hnonneg
    nlinarith
  have h := discrim_le_zero hquad
  unfold discrim at h
  nlinarith

name: lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℝ a)) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => f x) (p : ENNReal) (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha) =
      ((φ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |f x| ^ p) a)).re) ^ ((p : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => f x) (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha) :=
    hf.domRestrict.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (f := fun x : spectrum ℝ a => f x)
    (p := (p : ENNReal)) (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne') (by simp) hm]
  rw [← integral_comp_subtype_positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha
    (fun x : ℝ => |f x| ^ p) (hf.abs.pow p)]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.rpow_natCast]

name: MeasureTheory.sq_integral_sq_le_integral_mul_integral_cube
statement:
theorem sq_integral_sq_le_integral_mul_integral_cube
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {f : Ω → ℝ}
    (hf : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (h1 : Integrable f μ)
    (h2 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) μ) (h3 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 3) μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x, f x ∂μ) * (∫ x, f x ^ 3 ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ := integral_nonneg_of_ae hf
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnonneg with hz | hp
  · have hfzero : f =ᵐ[μ] 0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hf h1).mp hz.symm
    have h2zero : (fun x => f x ^ 2) =ᵐ[μ] 0 := hfzero.mono fun x hx => by simp [hx]
    rw [integral_congr_ae h2zero]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, integral_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), ← hz,
      zero_mul, le_refl]
  · let c : ℝ := (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ) / (∫ x, f x ∂μ)
    have hc : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) * c = ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ :=
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp.ne'
    have hpoly : 0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ^ 3 - (2 * c) * f x ^ 2 + c ^ 2 * f x ∂μ := by
      apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
      filter_upwards [hf] with x hx
      change 0 ≤ f x at hx
      change 0 ≤ f x ^ 3 - (2 * c) * f x ^ 2 + c ^ 2 * f x
      have he : f x ^ 3 - (2 * c) * f x ^ 2 + c ^ 2 * f x = f x * (f x - c) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [he]
      exact mul_nonneg hx (sq_nonneg _)
    have hadd := integral_add (h3.sub (h2.const_mul (2 * c))) (h1.const_mul (c ^ 2))
    have hsub := integral_sub h3 (h2.const_mul (2 * c))
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hadd
    rw [hadd, hsub, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hpoly
    have hc2 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => c * x) hc
    have hbound : c ^ 2 * (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, f x ^ 3 ∂μ := by nlinarith only [hpoly, hc2]
    calc
      (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2 = ((∫ x, f x ∂μ) * c) ^ 2 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) hc.symm
      _ = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) * (c ^ 2 * (∫ x, f x ∂μ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound hnonneg

name: MeasureTheory.integral_pi_fin_eq_integral_insertNth
statement:
theorem integral_pi_fin_eq_integral_insertNth
    {n : ℕ} {X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (μ : Fin (n + 1) → Measure X) [∀ j, SigmaFinite (μ j)]
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) {f : (Fin (n + 1) → X) → E} (hf : Integrable f (Measure.pi μ)) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂Measure.pi μ) =
      ∫ y, ∫ t, f (i.insertNth t y) ∂μ i ∂Measure.pi (fun j => μ (i.succAbove j))
proof:
:= by
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => X) i).symm
  have hp := (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ i).symm
  have hi : Integrable (f ∘ e)
      ((μ i).prod (Measure.pi (fun j => μ (i.succAbove j)))) :=
    (hp.integrable_comp_emb e.measurableEmbedding).mpr hf
  calc
    _ = ∫ p : X × (Fin n → X), f (e p)
        ∂(μ i).prod (Measure.pi (fun j => μ (i.succAbove j))) :=
      (hp.integral_comp' f).symm
    _ = _ := by
      change (∫ p : X × (Fin n → X), (f ∘ e) p
        ∂(μ i).prod (Measure.pi (fun j => μ (i.succAbove j)))) = _
      rw [integral_prod_symm _ hi]
      simp only [e, Function.comp_def, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
        Equiv.coe_fn_mk]

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.support_map_homeomorph
statement:
theorem support_map_homeomorph (ν : Measure X) (e : X ≃ₜ Y) :
    (ν.map e).support=e '' ν.support
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsClosed (e '' ν.support) := e.isClosedMap _ ν.isClosed_support
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply support_subset_of_isClosed hc
    apply (ae_map_iff e.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hc.measurableSet).mpr
    have hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν,x∈ν.support := ν.support_mem_ae
    exact hs.mono fun x hx => ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  · rintro y ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
    apply (mem_support_iff_forall _).mpr
    intro U hU
    have hp := (mem_support_iff_forall x).mp hx (e ⁻¹' U)
      (e.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hU)
    exact hp.trans_le (le_map_apply e.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable U)

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_log_add_of_bounded
statement:
theorem integrable_log_add_of_bounded {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C δ : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Integrable (fun x => Real.log (g x + δ)) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_const (|Real.log δ| + |Real.log (C + δ)|)).mono'
    (hg.add_const δ).log.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  have hl : Real.log δ ≤ Real.log (g x + δ) :=
    Real.log_le_log hδ (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hbound x).1)
  have hu : Real.log (g x + δ) ≤ Real.log (C + δ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by linarith [(hbound x).1]) (by linarith [(hbound x).2])
  constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log δ), neg_abs_le (Real.log δ),
    le_abs_self (Real.log (C + δ)), abs_nonneg (Real.log (C + δ)), abs_nonneg (Real.log δ)]

name: MeasureTheory.monotone_exp_integral_log_add
statement:
theorem monotone_exp_integral_log_add {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C) :
    Monotone (fun δ : {δ : ℝ // 0 < δ} =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (∫ x, Real.log (g x + δ) ∂μ)))
proof:
:= by
  intro δ η hδη
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  apply integral_mono (integrable_log_add_of_bounded hg hbound δ.property)
    (integrable_log_add_of_bounded hg hbound η.property)
  intro x
  exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith [(hbound x).1, δ.property]) (by linarith [show (δ : ℝ) ≤ (η : ℝ) from hδη])

name: MeasureTheory.tendsto_lintegral_logDeficit_add_inv_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_lintegral_logDeficit_add_inv_nat {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g) (c : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫⁻ x, logDeficit c (g x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ x, logDeficit c (g x) ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  apply lintegral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone
  · intro n
    exact ((hg.add_const _).logDeficit c).aemeasurable
  · filter_upwards [] with x i j hij
    apply logDeficit_antitone c
    apply add_le_add_right
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hij 1)
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    apply (continuous_logDeficit c).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := g x)).add
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))

name: MeasureTheory.tendsto_exp_integral_log_add_inv_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_exp_integral_log_add_inv_nat {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal
      (Real.exp (∫ x, Real.log (g x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ∂μ)))
      atTop (𝓝 (EReal.exp (upperLogIntegral μ g (Real.log (C + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hdef := tendsto_lintegral_logDeficit_add_inv_nat (μ := μ) hg (Real.log (C + 1))
  have hcoe := continuous_coe_ennreal_ereal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hdef
  have hsub : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Real.log (C + 1) : EReal) -
      ((∫⁻ x, logDeficit (Real.log (C + 1)) (g x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ∂μ) : EReal))
      atTop (𝓝 (upperLogIntegral μ g (Real.log (C + 1)))) := by
    change Tendsto _ atTop (𝓝 ((Real.log (C + 1) : EReal) +
      -((∫⁻ x, logDeficit (Real.log (C + 1)) (g x) ∂μ) : EReal)))
    exact (EReal.continuousAt_add (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top _))
      (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot _))).tendsto.comp
        (tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hcoe.neg)
  have hexp := ENNReal.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hsub
  apply hexp.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with n
  have hδ : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hδ1 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    norm_num
  have heq := upperLogIntegral_eq_integral (μ := μ)
    (g := fun x => g x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    (c := Real.log (C + 1))
    (ae_of_all _ (fun x => by linarith [(hbound x).1]))
    (integrable_log_add_of_bounded hg hbound hδ)
    (ae_of_all _ (fun x => Real.log_le_log (by linarith [(hbound x).1])
      (by linarith [(hbound x).2])))
  change EReal.exp (upperLogIntegral μ (fun x => g x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    (Real.log (C + 1))) = _
  rw [heq, EReal.exp_coe]

name: MeasureTheory.regularizedGeometricMean_eq_exp_upperLogIntegral
statement:
theorem regularizedGeometricMean_eq_exp_upperLogIntegral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C) :
    regularizedGeometricMean μ g =
      EReal.exp (upperLogIntegral μ g (Real.log (C + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have ht := tendsto_exp_integral_log_add_inv_nat (μ := μ) hg hbound
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ge_of_tendsto' ht
    intro n
    exact iInf_le _ (⟨1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1), by positivity⟩ : {δ : ℝ // 0 < δ})
  · apply le_iInf
    intro δ
    apply le_of_tendsto ht
    have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ δ :=
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).eventually_le_const δ.property
    filter_upwards [hsmall] with n hn
    exact monotone_exp_integral_log_add hg hbound
      (show (⟨1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1), by positivity⟩ : {δ : ℝ // 0 < δ}) ≤ δ from hn)

name: MeasureTheory.regularizedGeometricMean_eq_geometricMean
statement:
theorem regularizedGeometricMean_eq_geometricMean {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C) :
    regularizedGeometricMean μ g = geometricMean μ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularizedGeometricMean_eq_exp_upperLogIntegral hg hbound, geometricMean,
    upperLogIntegral_eq_extendedLogIntegral hg (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith))]
  filter_upwards [] with x
  by_cases hx : 0 < g x
  · rw [ENNReal.log_ofReal_of_pos hx, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
    exact Real.log_le_log hx (by linarith [(hbound x).2])
  · simp [ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos (le_of_not_gt hx)]

name: MeasureTheory.le_geometricMean_of_le_exp_integral_log_add
statement:
theorem le_geometricMean_of_le_exp_integral_log_add {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C)
    {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      a ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (∫ x, Real.log (g x + δ) ∂μ))) :
    a ≤ geometricMean μ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← regularizedGeometricMean_eq_geometricMean hg hC hbound]
  exact le_iInf (fun δ => ha δ δ.property)

name: MeasureTheory.geometricMean_ne_top_of_bounded
statement:
theorem geometricMean_ne_top_of_bounded {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbound : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ C) :
    geometricMean μ g ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [← regularizedGeometricMean_eq_geometricMean hg hC hbound]
  apply ne_of_lt
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (iInf_le _ (⟨1, zero_lt_one⟩ : {δ : ℝ // 0 < δ}))
    ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

name: MeasureTheory.logDeficit_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem logDeficit_zero (c : ℝ) : logDeficit c 0 = ∞
proof:

name: MeasureTheory.logDeficit_of_pos
statement:
theorem logDeficit_of_pos (c : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    logDeficit c x = ENNReal.ofReal (c - Real.log x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDeficit, ENNReal.log_ofReal_of_pos hx, ← EReal.coe_sub,
    EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]

name: MeasureTheory.logDeficit_antitone
statement: theorem logDeficit_antitone (c : ℝ) : Antitone (logDeficit c)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  exact EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl

name: MeasureTheory.continuous_logDeficit
statement: theorem continuous_logDeficit (c : ℝ) : Continuous (logDeficit c)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : EReal => (c : EReal) - y) := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro y
    exact (EReal.continuousAt_add (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top c))
      (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot c))).comp
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_neg).continuousAt
  exact EReal.continuous_toENNReal.comp
    (hc.comp (ENNReal.continuous_log.comp ENNReal.continuous_ofReal))

name: Measurable.logDeficit
statement:
theorem _root_.Measurable.logDeficit {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g) (c : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun x => logDeficit c (g x))
proof:
:=
  (continuous_logDeficit c).measurable.comp hg

name: MeasureTheory.upperLogIntegral_eq_integral
statement:
theorem upperLogIntegral_eq_integral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < g x)
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => Real.log (g x)) μ)
    (hle : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Real.log (g x) ≤ c) :
    upperLogIntegral μ g c = ((∫ x, Real.log (g x) ∂μ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun x => c - Real.log (g x) := by
    filter_upwards [hle] with x hx using sub_nonneg.mpr hx
  have hi := (integrable_const c).sub hlog
  have heq : (∫⁻ x, logDeficit c (g x) ∂μ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (c - ∫ x, Real.log (g x) ∂μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (c - Real.log (g x)) ∂μ := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hpos] with x hx using logDeficit_of_pos c hx
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (c - ∫ x, Real.log (g x) ∂μ) := by
        simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, integral_sub (integrable_const c) hlog, integral_const,
          probReal_univ, one_smul] using
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi hnonneg).symm
  have hnonnegint : 0 ≤ c - ∫ x, Real.log (g x) ∂μ := by
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, integral_sub (integrable_const c) hlog, integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul] using integral_nonneg_of_ae hnonneg
  rw [upperLogIntegral, heq, EReal.coe_ennreal_ofReal,
    max_eq_left hnonnegint, ← EReal.coe_sub]
  congr 1
  ring

name: MeasureTheory.upperLogIntegral_eq_bot_of_ae_zero
statement:
theorem upperLogIntegral_eq_bot_of_ae_zero {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (hg : g =ᵐ[μ] 0) : upperLogIntegral μ g c = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hdef : (fun x => logDeficit c (g x)) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => ∞ := by
    filter_upwards [hg] with x hx
    simp [hx]
  simp [upperLogIntegral, lintegral_congr_ae hdef]

name: MeasureTheory.PositiveMatrixMeasure.re_entry_eq_quadraticForm
statement:
theorem re_entry_eq_quadraticForm (P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n) (i j : n) :
    ComplexMeasure.re (P.entry i j) = (1 / 4 : ℝ) •
      (P.quadraticForm (Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1) -
        P.quadraticForm (Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply VectorMeasure.ext
  intro E hE
  change (P E i j).re = (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
    ((star (Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1) ⬝ᵥ (P E *ᵥ (Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1))).re -
      (star (Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1) ⬝ᵥ (P E *ᵥ (Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1))).re)
  have hQ := congrArg Complex.re (matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub (P E) i j)
  have hsym : P E j i = star (P E i j) := ((P.isHermitian E hE).apply j i).symm
  simp only [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.add_re, hsym, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] at hQ
  norm_num only [show (2 : ℂ).re = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℂ).im = 0 from rfl, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_one, add_zero] at hQ
  linarith

name: MeasureTheory.PositiveMatrixMeasure.im_entry_eq_quadraticForm
statement:
theorem im_entry_eq_quadraticForm (P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n) (i j : n) :
    ComplexMeasure.im (P.entry i j) = (-1 / 4 : ℝ) •
      (P.quadraticForm (Pi.single i 1 + Complex.I • Pi.single j 1) -
        P.quadraticForm (Pi.single i 1 - Complex.I • Pi.single j 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply VectorMeasure.ext
  intro E hE
  change (P E i j).im = (-1 / 4 : ℝ) *
    ((star (Pi.single i 1 + Complex.I • Pi.single j 1) ⬝ᵥ
      (P E *ᵥ (Pi.single i 1 + Complex.I • Pi.single j 1))).re -
      (star (Pi.single i 1 - Complex.I • Pi.single j 1) ⬝ᵥ
        (P E *ᵥ (Pi.single i 1 - Complex.I • Pi.single j 1))).re)
  have hQ := congrArg Complex.re (matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub_I (P E) i j)
  have hsym : P E j i = star (P E i j) := ((P.isHermitian E hE).apply j i).symm
  simp only [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_im, hsym, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re,
    Complex.conj_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im] at hQ
  norm_num only [show (2 : ℂ).re = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℂ).im = 0 from rfl, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_one, add_zero] at hQ
  linarith

name: MeasureTheory.PositiveMatrixMeasure.entryStieltjesTransform_eq_of_quadraticForm
statement:
theorem entryStieltjesTransform_eq_of_quadraticForm
    (P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n) (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hrep : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
      (P.quadraticForm v).stieltjesTransform z = matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (i j : n) :
    P.entryStieltjesTransform z i j = M z i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [entryStieltjesTransform, re_entry_eq_quadraticForm, im_entry_eq_quadraticForm]
  simp only [SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_smul,
    SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_sub _ _ hz, Complex.real_smul, hrep _ z hz]
  rw [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub, matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub_I]
  push_cast
  ring_nf
  simp only [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

name: MeasureTheory.deficit_add_posPart
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | bot => simp
  | top => exact False.elim (not_le_of_gt (EReal.coe_lt_top c) ht)
  | coe t =>
    have htc : t ≤ c := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp ht
    simp only [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_neg, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
    rcases le_total 0 t with ht0 | ht0
    · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos (neg_nonpos.mpr ht0), add_zero,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (sub_nonneg.mpr htc) ht0]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos ht0, add_zero,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_add hc (neg_nonneg.mpr ht0)]
      simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_log_posPart_lt_top
statement:
theorem lintegral_log_posPart_lt_top {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hle : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) ≤ c) :
    (∫⁻ x, (ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x))).toENNReal ∂μ) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _ : α, ENNReal.ofReal c ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [hle] with x hx
      simpa only [EReal.real_coe_toENNReal] using EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal hx
    _ < ∞ := by
      rw [lintegral_const]
      exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top (measure_lt_top μ univ)

name: MeasureTheory.upperLogIntegral_eq_extendedLogIntegral
statement:
theorem upperLogIntegral_eq_extendedLogIntegral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ}
    (hg : Measurable g) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hle : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) ≤ c) :
    upperLogIntegral μ g c = extendedLogIntegral μ g
proof:
:= by
  let p := ∫⁻ x, (ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x))).toENNReal ∂μ
  let q := ∫⁻ x, (-ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x))).toENNReal ∂μ
  let d := ∫⁻ x, logDeficit c (g x) ∂μ
  have hp : p ≠ ∞ := ne_of_lt (lintegral_log_posPart_lt_top hle)
  have hm := hg.ennreal_ofReal.ennreal_log
  have hbalance : d + p = ENNReal.ofReal c + q := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ x, logDeficit c (g x) +
          (ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x))).toENNReal ∂μ :=
        (lintegral_add_left (hg.logDeficit c) _).symm
      _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal c +
          (-ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x))).toENNReal ∂μ := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hle] with x hx using deficit_add_posPart c hc _ hx
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal c + q := by
        rw [lintegral_add_left measurable_const]
        simp [q]
  change (c : EReal) - (d : EReal) = (p : EReal) - (q : EReal)
  by_cases hq : q = ∞
  · have hd : d = ∞ := by
      by_contra hd
      have hsum : d + p = ∞ := by simpa only [hq, add_top] using hbalance
      exact (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hd, hp⟩) hsum
    simp [hq, hd]
  · have hd : d ≠ ∞ := by
      intro hd
      simp [hd] at hbalance
      exact (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, hq⟩) hbalance.symm
    have hreal := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hbalance
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hd hp, ENNReal.toReal_add ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hq,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hc] at hreal
    rw [← EReal.coe_ennreal_toReal hd, ← EReal.coe_ennreal_toReal hp,
      ← EReal.coe_ennreal_toReal hq, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub]
    congr 1
    linarith

name: MeasureTheory.extendedLogIntegral_eq_integral
statement:
theorem extendedLogIntegral_eq_integral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < g x)
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => Real.log (g x)) μ)
    (hle : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Real.log (g x) ≤ c) :
    extendedLogIntegral μ g = ((∫ x, Real.log (g x) ∂μ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← upperLogIntegral_eq_extendedLogIntegral hg hc ?_]
  · exact upperLogIntegral_eq_integral hpos hlog hle
  · filter_upwards [hpos, hle] with x hx hxle
    simpa only [ENNReal.log_ofReal_of_pos hx, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] using hxle

name: MeasureTheory.extendedLogIntegral_congr_ae
statement:
theorem extendedLogIntegral_congr_ae {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {g h : α → ℝ} (hgh : g =ᵐ[μ] h) :
    extendedLogIntegral μ g = extendedLogIntegral μ h
proof:
:= by
  unfold extendedLogIntegral
  congr 1 <;> apply congrArg ENNReal.toEReal <;> apply lintegral_congr_ae
  all_goals filter_upwards [hgh] with x hx; rw [hx]

name: MeasureTheory.geometricMean_congr_ae
statement:
theorem geometricMean_congr_ae {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {g h : α → ℝ} (hgh : g =ᵐ[μ] h) :
    geometricMean μ g = geometricMean μ h
proof:
:=
  congrArg EReal.exp (extendedLogIntegral_congr_ae hgh)

name: MeasureTheory.extendedLogIntegral_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendedLogIntegral_zero {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    extendedLogIntegral μ (fun _ : α => (0 : ℝ)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [extendedLogIntegral]

name: MeasureTheory.geometricMean_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricMean_zero {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    geometricMean μ (fun _ : α => (0 : ℝ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [geometricMean]

name: MeasureTheory.geometricMean_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricMean_const {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    geometricMean μ (fun _ : α => a) = ENNReal.ofReal a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with ha0 | ha0
  · subst a
    simp
  · have hlog := extendedLogIntegral_eq_integral (μ := μ)
      (g := fun _ : α => a) measurable_const (c := max (Real.log a) 0)
      (le_max_right _ _) (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => ha0))
      (integrable_const (Real.log a)) (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => le_max_left _ _))
    simpa only [geometricMean, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul,
      EReal.exp_coe, Real.exp_log ha0] using congrArg EReal.exp hlog

name: MeasureTheory.geometricMean_eq_zero_of_lintegral_negPart_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricMean, extendedLogIntegral, ← EReal.coe_ennreal_toReal hpos,
    hneg, EReal.coe_ennreal_top,
    EReal.sub_top, EReal.exp_bot]

name: MeasureTheory.upperLogIntegral_eq_of_bounds
statement:
theorem upperLogIntegral_eq_of_bounds {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g)
    {c d : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hlec : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) ≤ c)
    (hled : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) ≤ d) :
    upperLogIntegral μ g c = upperLogIntegral μ g d
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperLogIntegral_eq_extendedLogIntegral hg hc hlec,
    upperLogIntegral_eq_extendedLogIntegral hg hd hled]

name: spectralLawRealCFC
statement: private theorem spectralLawRealCFC : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint

:=
  (IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)).toContinuousFunctionalCalculus

name: integral_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveRealSpectrumMeasure,integral_map measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_comp_subtype_positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha f hf.continuousOn

name: integral_pow_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure φ ha _ (by fun_prop),cfc_pow_id a n ha]

name: measureReal_univ_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure
proof:
:= by

name: isProbabilityMeasure_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1) {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (positiveRealSpectrumMeasure φ ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isProbabilityMeasure_iff_real,measureReal_univ_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure,hφ,Complex.one_re]

name: ae_mem_spectrum_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure
proof:
:= by
  apply (ae_map_iff measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable
    (ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.isCompact_spectrum (R := ℝ) a).isClosed.measurableSet).mpr
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => x.property

name: support_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_spectrum
statement:
theorem support_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_spectrum
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hS : IsClosed (S : Set A))
    (hfaithful : ∀ b : A, b∈S → φ (star b*b)=0 → b=0)
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (haS : a∈S) :
    (positiveRealSpectrumMeasure φ ha).support=spectrum ℝ a
proof:
:= by
  have hfull := support_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_univ_of_faithful φ S hS hfaithful ha haS
  have hh := Measure.support_map_eq_range_of_compact (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ ha)
    (Subtype.val : spectrum ℝ a → ℝ) continuous_subtype_val hfull
  simpa only [positiveRealSpectrumMeasure,Subtype.range_coe_subtype,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using hh

name: positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_of_power_moments
statement:
theorem positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_of_power_moments
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (ψ : B →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) {a : A} {b : B}
    (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b)
    (hmom : ∀ n : ℕ, (φ (a^n)).re=(ψ (b^n)).re) :
    positiveRealSpectrumMeasure φ ha=positiveRealSpectrumMeasure ψ hb
proof:
:= by
  let K := spectrum ℝ a ∪ spectrum ℝ b
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    (ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.isCompact_spectrum (R := ℝ) a).union
      (ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.isCompact_spectrum (R := ℝ) b)
  apply Measure.eq_of_integral_pow_eq_of_ae_mem_isCompact hK
  · exact (ae_mem_spectrum_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure φ ha).mono fun x hx => Or.inl hx
  · exact (ae_mem_spectrum_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure ψ hb).mono fun x hx => Or.inr hx
  · intro n
    rw [integral_pow_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure,integral_pow_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure,hmom n]

name: spectrum_real_eq_of_faithful_power_moments
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_eq_of_faithful_power_moments
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (ψ : B →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hS : IsClosed (S : Set A))
    (T : StarSubalgebra ℂ B) (hT : IsClosed (T : Set B))
    (hfaithfulA : ∀ c : A, c∈S → φ (star c*c)=0 → c=0)
    (hfaithfulB : ∀ c : B, c∈T → ψ (star c*c)=0 → c=0)
    {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b) (haS : a∈S) (hbT : b∈T)
    (hmom : ∀ n : ℕ, (φ (a^n)).re=(ψ (b^n)).re) : spectrum ℝ a=spectrum ℝ b
proof:
:= by
  have heq := positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_of_power_moments φ ψ ha hb hmom
  calc
    spectrum ℝ a=(positiveRealSpectrumMeasure φ ha).support :=
      (support_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_spectrum φ S hS hfaithfulA ha haS).symm
    _=(positiveRealSpectrumMeasure ψ hb).support := congrArg Measure.support heq
    _=spectrum ℝ b := support_positiveRealSpectrumMeasure_eq_spectrum ψ T hT hfaithfulB hb hbT

name: norm_eq_of_faithful_power_moments
statement:
theorem norm_eq_of_faithful_power_moments
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (ψ : B →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hS : IsClosed (S : Set A))
    (T : StarSubalgebra ℂ B) (hT : IsClosed (T : Set B))
    (hfaithfulA : ∀ c : A, c∈S → φ (star c*c)=0 → c=0)
    (hfaithfulB : ∀ c : B, c∈T → ψ (star c*c)=0 → c=0)
    {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b) (haS : a∈S) (hbT : b∈T)
    (hmom : ∀ n : ℕ, (φ (a^n)).re=(ψ (b^n)).re) : ‖a‖=‖b‖
proof:
:= by
  have hs := spectrum_real_eq_of_faithful_power_moments φ ψ S hS T hT
    hfaithfulA hfaithfulB ha hb haS hbT hmom
  rw [← ha.toReal_spectralRadius_eq_norm,← hb.toReal_spectralRadius_eq_norm]
  simp only [spectralRadius,hs]

name: MeasureTheory.integral_le_sqrt_integral_sq
statement:
theorem integral_le_sqrt_integral_sq {Y : Ω → ℝ} (hYi : Integrable Y μ)
    (hY2 : Integrable (fun ω => Y ω ^ 2) μ) :
    ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2 : MemLp Y 2 μ := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hYi.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hY2
  have hvar := variance_nonneg Y μ
  rw [variance_eq_sub hL2] at hvar
  have h2 : (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    have : μ[Y ^ 2] = ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ := rfl
    linarith
  calc ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ ≤ |∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ| := le_abs_self _
    _ = Real.sqrt ((∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h2

name: MeasureTheory.integral_le_of_integral_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_le_of_integral_sq_le (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : Integrable X μ) (hX2 : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) μ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ c ^ 2) : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ c
proof:
:=
  (integral_le_sqrt_integral_sq hX hX2).trans
    ((Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_sq hc))
