name: PositiveLinearMap.re_pow_affine_rpow_le
statement:
theorem PositiveLinearMap.re_pow_affine_rpow_le (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 1)
    {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {s c : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ((φ ((s • a + algebraMap ℝ A c) ^ m)).re) ^ ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      s * ((φ (a ^ m)).re) ^ ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) + c
proof:
:= by
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint a := ha.isSelfAdjoint
  let hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) :=
    isProbabilityMeasure_positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hφ hself
  have hp : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ m by omega)
  have hmem : MemLp (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => s * (x : ℝ)) (m : ENNReal)
      (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) :=
    ((continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val).memLp_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _))
  have hLp := lpNorm_le_add_of_uniform_approximation hmem hp (by simp) hc
    (f := fun x : spectrum ℝ a => s * (x : ℝ) + c)
    (fun x => by simp only [add_sub_cancel_left,abs_of_nonneg hc,le_refl])
  have hcfcid : cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ m) a = a ^ m := by
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ m) a := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro x hx
        change |x|^m=x^m
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg ha hx)]
      _ = _ := cfc_pow_id a m hself
  have hcfcaff : cfc (fun x : ℝ => |s*x+c| ^ m) a =
      (s • a + algebraMap ℝ A c) ^ m := by
    calc
      _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => (s*x+c) ^ m) a := by
        apply cfc_congr
        intro x hx
        change |s*x+c|^m=(s*x+c)^m
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs
          (spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg ha hx)) hc)]
      _ = cfc (fun x : ℝ => s*x+c) a ^ m :=
        cfc_pow _ m a ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).add continuous_const).continuousOn hself
      _ = _ := by
        rw [cfc_add_const c (fun x : ℝ => s*x) a
          (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).continuousOn hself,
          cfc_const_mul_id s a hself]
  have hid : lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => (x : ℝ)) (m : ENNReal)
      (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) = ((φ (a ^ m)).re) ^ ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    simpa only [hcfcid] using lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq φ hself
      (fun x : ℝ => x) continuous_id.continuousOn m hm
  have haff : lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => s * (x : ℝ) + c) (m : ENNReal)
      (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) =
        ((φ ((s • a + algebraMap ℝ A c) ^ m)).re) ^ ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    simpa only [hcfcaff] using lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq φ hself
      (fun x : ℝ => s*x+c) ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).add continuous_const).continuousOn m hm
  have hscale : lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => s * (x : ℝ)) (m : ENNReal)
      (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) =
        s * ((φ (a ^ m)).re) ^ ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    calc
      _ = ‖s‖ * lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ a => (x : ℝ)) (m : ENNReal)
          (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) :=
        lpNorm_const_smul s _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hs,hid]
  rwa [haff,hscale] at hLp

name: MeasureTheory.ae_condExp_le_condExp_of_ae_le

    (hXY : X ≤ᵐ[μ] Y) : μ[X | m] ≤ᵐ[μ] μ[Y | m]

name: norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin
statement:
theorem norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin
    (ω : E → E →L[𝕜] F) (γ : Path a b) {C : ℝ}
    (hω : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖ω (γ.extend t)‖ ≤ C)
    (hγ : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖) volume 0 1) :
    ‖curveIntegral ω γ‖ ≤ C * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ F := .restrictScalars ℝ 𝕜 F
  rw [curveIntegral_def, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le zero_le_one
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_) (hγ.const_mul C)
  rw [curveIntegralFun_def]
  exact (ω (γ.extend t)).le_of_opNorm_le (hω t (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht)) _

name: norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin_of_contDiffOn
    (ω : E → E →L[𝕜] F) (γ : Path a b) {C : ℝ}
    (hω : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖ω (γ.extend t)‖ ≤ C)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend I) :
    ‖curveIntegral ω γ‖ ≤ C * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin ω γ hω
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖) I :=
    (hγ.continuousOn_derivWithin uniqueDiffOn_Icc_zero_one le_rfl).norm
  exact hc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one

name: Complex.norm_two_pi_i_inv_mul_curveIntegral_le_integral_speed_mul
statement:
theorem norm_two_pi_i_inv_mul_curveIntegral_le_integral_speed_mul
    {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) (g : ℂ → ℂ) {C : ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖g (γ.extend t)‖ ≤ C)
    (hγ : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖) volume 0 1) :
    ‖(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * curveIntegral
      (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ‖ ≤
      ((∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖) / (2 * Real.pi)) * C
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin
    (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
    (C := C) (by simpa only [norm_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id, mul_one] using hg) hγ
  rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_I, mul_one,
    norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  norm_num only [norm_ofNat]
  calc
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ‖curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ‖ ≤
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (C * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
    _ = ((∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖derivWithin γ.extend I t‖) / (2 * Real.pi)) * C := by ring

name: NLAlib.exists_isCoupling_integral_dist_le_of_lipschitz_integral_sub_le
statement:
theorem exists_isCoupling_integral_dist_le_of_lipschitz_integral_sub_le
    (μ ν : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (C : ℝ)
    (hdual : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), LipschitzWith 1 f →
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤ C) :
    ∃ π : Measure (X × X), π.IsCoupling μ ν ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure π ∧ (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ∂π) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty X := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  let cost : C(X × X, ℝ) := ⟨fun p => dist p.1 p.2, continuous_fst.dist continuous_snd⟩
  apply exists_isCoupling_integral_le_of_potentials_le μ ν cost C
  intro f g hfg
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hfu, hgu⟩ := exists_lipschitz_dominate_of_add_le_dist f g hfg
  have hI (m : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure m] (F : C(X, ℝ)) : Integrable F m :=
    F.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace F)
  have hf := integral_mono (hI μ f) (hI μ u) hfu
  have hg := integral_mono (hI ν g) (hI ν (-u)) hgu
  have he : (∫ x, (-u) x ∂ν) = -(∫ x, u x ∂ν) := integral_neg _
  have hb := hdual u hu
  linarith

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_lipschitz_integral_sub_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_lipschitz_integral_sub_le
    (μ ν : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (C : ℝ)
    (hdual : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), LipschitzWith 1 f →
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤ C) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hprob, hcost⟩ :=
    exists_isCoupling_integral_dist_le_of_lipschitz_integral_sub_le μ ν C hdual
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure π := hprob
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral hπ).trans
  have hI : Integrable (fun p : X × X => dist p.1 p.2) π :=
    (continuous_fst.dist continuous_snd).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  calc
    (∫⁻ p, edist p.1 p.2 ∂π) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ∂π) := by
      simp_rw [edist_dist]
      exact (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hI (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => dist_nonneg))).symm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcost

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact_of_lipschitzOn_integral_sub_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact_of_lipschitzOn_integral_sub_le
    [SecondCountableTopology X] (μ ν : Measure X)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ K) (C : ℝ)
    (hdual : ∀ f : X → ℝ, LipschitzOnWith 1 f K →
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤ C) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : CompactSpace K := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK
  let μK : Measure K := μ.comap Subtype.val
  let νK : Measure K := ν.comap Subtype.val
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μK :=
    (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hK.measurableSet).isProbabilityMeasure_comap
      (by simpa using hμ)
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure νK :=
    (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hK.measurableSet).isProbabilityMeasure_comap
      (by simpa using hν)
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_comap_subtype_val μ ν hK.measurableSet hμ hν).trans
  apply wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_lipschitz_integral_sub_le μK νK C
  intro u hu
  let F : X → ℝ := fun x => if hx : x ∈ K then u ⟨x, hx⟩ else 0
  have hFu (x : K) : F x = u x := by simp [F, x.property]
  have hF : LipschitzOnWith 1 F K := by
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa only [F, dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy, Subtype.edist_mk_mk] using hu ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hEq (m : Measure X) (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ K) :
      (∫ x : K, u x ∂m.comap Subtype.val) = ∫ x, F x ∂m := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ x : K, F x ∂m.comap Subtype.val :=
        integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ (fun x => (hFu x).symm))
      _ = ∫ x in K, F x ∂m := integral_subtype_comap hK.measurableSet F
      _ = _ := by rw [Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hm]
  rw [hEq μ hμ, hEq ν hν]
  exact hdual F hF

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_integrable_finite
statement:
theorem integrable_iSup_of_integrable_finite (f : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) μ) : Integrable (fun ω => ⨆ i, f i ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hf i).abs).mono'
    (AEMeasurable.iSup fun i => (hf i).aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro ω
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := fun i => f i ω)
  rw [← hi, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (f j ω)) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: MeasureTheory.integral_iSup_le_mean_add_sum_integral_abs_sub
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_le_mean_add_sum_integral_abs_sub
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) μ)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i, ∫ ω, f i ω ∂μ ≤ M) :
    (∫ ω, ⨆ i, f i ω ∂μ) ≤
      M + ∑ i, ∫ ω, |f i ω - ∫ x, f i x ∂μ| ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => |f i ω - ∫ x, f i x ∂μ|) μ :=
    ((hf i).sub (integrable_const _)).abs
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ ω, M + ∑ i, |f i ω - ∫ x, f i x ∂μ| ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono (integrable_iSup_of_integrable_finite f hf)
        ((integrable_const _).add (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => hd i))
      intro ω
      apply ciSup_le
      intro i
      change f i ω ≤ M + ∑ j, |f j ω - ∫ x, f j x ∂μ|
      have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (f j ω - ∫ x, f j x ∂μ)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have habs := le_abs_self (f i ω - ∫ x, f i x ∂μ)
      linarith [hM i]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hd i),
        integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hd i]
      simp

name: NLAlib.integral_intervalDensityMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_intervalDensityMeasure {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}

name: NLAlib.isCompactExpRepresentation_intervalDensityMeasure
statement:
theorem isCompactExpRepresentation_intervalDensityMeasure
    {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hρ : IntegrableOn ρ (Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Icc a b), 0 ≤ ρ x) :
    IsCompactExpRepresentation (intervalDensityMeasure ρ a b hρ)
      (fun t => ∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (t * x) * ρ x) a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ae_mem_Icc_intervalDensityMeasure ρ a b hρ
  · intro t
    rw [integral_intervalDensityMeasure hρ hpos,
      intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.add
statement:
theorem add {ν₁ ν₂ : FiniteMeasure ℝ} {F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h₁ : IsCompactExpRepresentation ν₁ F₁ a b)
    (h₂ : IsCompactExpRepresentation ν₂ F₂ a b) :
    IsCompactExpRepresentation (ν₁ + ν₂) (fun t => F₁ t + F₂ t) a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ae_add_measure_iff.mpr ⟨h₁.ae_mem_Icc, h₂.ae_mem_Icc⟩
  · intro t
    rw [FiniteMeasure.toMeasure_add, integral_add_measure (h₁.integrable_exp t)
      (h₂.integrable_exp t), h₁.integral_exp t, h₂.integral_exp t]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_matrix_sandwich
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_matrix_sandwich (L : Matrix c a K) (R : Matrix b d K)
    {f : Ω → Matrix a b K} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => L*f ω*R) μ ∧
      (∫ ω,L*f ω*R ∂μ)=L*(∫ ω,f ω ∂μ)*R
proof:
:= by
  let T : Matrix a b K →ₗ[K] Matrix c d K :=
    { toFun := fun X => L*X*R
      map_add' := by intro X Y; simp only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul]
      map_smul' := by intro k X; simp only [Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,RingHom.id_apply] }
  let Tc : Matrix a b K →L[K] Matrix c d K := T.toContinuousLinearMap
  exact ⟨Tc.integrable_comp hf,Tc.integral_comp_comm hf⟩

name: MeasureTheory.hasDerivAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ ξ ∈ μ.support, (ξ : ℂ)≠z) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-w)⁻¹ ∂μ)
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, (((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹)^2 ∂μ) z
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w ξ => ((ξ : ℂ)-w)⁻¹
  let D : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    fun w ξ => ((((ξ : ℂ)-w)⁻¹)^2)•(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℂ)
  let U : Set (ℂ×ℝ) := {p | (p.2 : ℂ)-p.1≠0}
  have harg : Continuous (fun p : ℂ×ℝ => (p.2 : ℂ)-p.1) := by fun_prop
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun harg continuous_const
  have hFi : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ×ℝ => F p.1 p.2) U :=
    harg.continuousOn.inv₀ (fun _ hp => hp)
  have hDi : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ×ℝ => D p.1 p.2) U :=
    (hFi.pow 2).smul continuousOn_const
  have hd (p : ℂ×ℝ) (hp : p∈U) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun w => F w p.2) (D p.1 p.2) p.1 := by
    have hh : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ((p.2 : ℂ)-w)⁻¹)
        ((((p.2 : ℂ)-p.1)⁻¹)^2) p.1 := by
      convert! (((hasDerivAt_const p.1 (p.2 : ℂ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id p.1)).inv hp) using 1
      simp only [zero_sub,neg_neg,one_div,inv_pow]
      rfl
    convert! hh.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ using 1
    ext w
    simp only [D,ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
      _root_.smul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hpoint : ∀ ξ ∈ μ.support, (z,ξ)∈U := by
    intro ξ hξ
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz ξ hξ)
  have h := NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support μ hμ F D U hU hFi hDi hd z hpoint
  have hIntD : Integrable (D z) μ := by
    have hi0 : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : ℝ => ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹) μ.support :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.inv₀
        (fun ξ hξ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz ξ hξ))
    have hc : ContinuousOn (D z) μ.support := by
      exact (hi0.pow 2).smul continuousOn_const
    have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
    have hre : μ.restrict μ.support=μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
    rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hi
  have he : (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, (((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹)^2 ∂μ)).restrictScalars ℝ=∫ ξ : ℝ,D z ξ ∂μ := by
    ext w
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hIntD]
    simp only [D,ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
      _root_.smul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,smul_eq_mul,integral_mul_const]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,one_smul] using
    (hasFDerivAt_of_restrictScalars ℝ h he).hasDerivAt

name: MeasureTheory.analyticAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
statement:
theorem analyticAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ ξ ∈ μ.support, (ξ : ℂ)≠z) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-w)⁻¹ ∂μ) z
proof:
:= by
  have he : IsClosed (Complex.ofReal '' μ.support) :=
    (hμ.image Complex.continuous_ofReal).isClosed
  have hzmem : z∈(Complex.ofReal '' μ.support)ᶜ := by
    rintro ⟨ξ,hξ,hξz⟩
    exact hz ξ hξ hξz
  apply Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mpr
  filter_upwards [he.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzmem] with w hw
  apply (hasDerivAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support μ hμ w ?_).differentiableAt
  intro ξ hξ hξw
  exact hw ⟨ξ,hξ,hξw⟩

name: MeasureTheory.norm_pow_cstar_le
statement: private theorem norm_pow_cstar_le (a : A) (n : ℕ) : ‖a^n‖≤‖a‖^n
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial A with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    simpa only [Subsingleton.elim (a^n) 0,norm_zero] using pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) n
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    exact norm_pow_le a n

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_mixed_powers
statement:
theorem integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_mixed_powers
    (X : Ω → selfAdjoint A) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (hw : w.im≠0) (p q : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => resolvent (X ω : A) z^p*resolvent (X ω : A) w^q) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    ((((selfAdjoint.continuous_resolvent hz).pow p).mul
      ((selfAdjoint.continuous_resolvent hw).pow q)).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX)
    (|z.im|⁻¹^p*|w.im|⁻¹^q)
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro ω
  apply (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
  apply mul_le_mul
    ((norm_pow_cstar_le _ _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      ((X ω).property.norm_resolvent_le hz) p))
    ((norm_pow_cstar_le _ _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      ((X ω).property.norm_resolvent_le hw) q)) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: MeasureTheory.sub_smul_resolventMixedMean
statement:
theorem sub_smul_resolventMixedMean
    (X : Ω → selfAdjoint A) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (L : A →L[ℂ] E) {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (hw : w.im≠0) (p q : ℕ) :
    (w-z)•resolventMixedMean μ X L (p+1) (q+1) z w=
      resolventMixedMean μ X L (p+1) q z w-resolventMixedMean μ X L p (q+1) z w
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolventMixedMean
  rw [← L.map_smul, ← integral_smul]
  have he : (fun ω => (w-z)•(resolvent (X ω : A) z^(p+1)*resolvent (X ω : A) w^(q+1)))=
      (fun ω => resolvent (X ω : A) z^(p+1)*resolvent (X ω : A) w^q-
        resolvent (X ω : A) z^p*resolvent (X ω : A) w^(q+1)) := by
    funext ω
    exact spectrum.sub_smul_resolvent_pow_mul_pow (X ω : A)
      ((X ω).property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz)
      ((X ω).property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hw) p q
  rw [he,integral_sub (integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_mixed_powers X hX hz hw (p+1) q)
    (integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_mixed_powers X hX hz hw p (q+1)),L.map_sub]

name: MeasureTheory.tendsto_resolventMixedMean_of_powers
statement:
theorem tendsto_resolventMixedMean_of_powers
    (μ' : (i : ι) → Measure (Ω' i)) [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ' i)]
    (X : (i : ι) → Ω' i → selfAdjoint (B i))
    (hX : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (X i) (μ' i))
    (L : (i : ι) → B i →L[ℂ] E) (a : selfAdjoint A₀) (L₀ : A₀ →L[ℂ] E)
    (f : Filter ι) {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (hw : w.im≠0) (hzw : z≠w)
    (hzlim : ∀ k : ℕ, Tendsto (fun i => resolventPowerMean (μ' i) (X i) (L i) (k+1) z)
      f (𝓝 (L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) z^(k+1)))))
    (hwlim : ∀ k : ℕ, Tendsto (fun i => resolventPowerMean (μ' i) (X i) (L i) (k+1) w)
      f (𝓝 (L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) w^(k+1)))))
    (p q : ℕ) (hpq : 0<p+q) :
    Tendsto (fun i => resolventMixedMean (μ' i) (X i) (L i) p q z w)
      f (𝓝 (L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) z^p*resolvent (a : A₀) w^q)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : w-z≠0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hzw.symm
  have hall (n : ℕ) : ∀ p q : ℕ, p+q=n → 0<n →
      Tendsto (fun i => resolventMixedMean (μ' i) (X i) (L i) p q z w)
        f (𝓝 (L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) z^p*resolvent (a : A₀) w^q))) := by
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro p q he hn
      cases p with
      | zero =>
        cases q with
        | zero => omega
        | succ q => simpa only [resolventMixedMean,resolventPowerMean,pow_zero,one_mul] using hwlim q
      | succ p =>
        cases q with
        | zero => simpa only [resolventMixedMean,resolventPowerMean,pow_zero,mul_one] using hzlim p
        | succ q =>
          have h₁ := ih (p+1+q) (by omega) (p+1) q rfl (by omega)
          have h₂ := ih (p+(q+1)) (by omega) p (q+1) rfl (by omega)
          have ht := (h₁.sub h₂).const_smul (w-z)⁻¹
          have hi (i : ι) := sub_smul_resolventMixedMean (X i) (hX i) (L i) hz hw p q
          have h₀ := congrArg L₀ (spectrum.sub_smul_resolvent_pow_mul_pow (a : A₀)
            (a.property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz)
            (a.property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hw) p q)
          simp only [map_smul,map_sub] at h₀
          simp_rw [← hi,← h₀,inv_smul_smul₀ hc] at ht
          exact ht
  exact hall (p+q) p q rfl hpq

name: MeasureTheory.ae_condExp_le_condExp_on_of_ae_le_on
statement:
theorem ae_condExp_le_condExp_on_of_ae_le_on {Ω : Type*}
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    {X Y : Ω → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X μ) (hY : Integrable Y μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet[m] s) (hXY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ s → X ω ≤ Y ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ s → μ[X | m] ω ≤ μ[Y | m] ω
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : s.indicator X ≤ᵐ[μ] s.indicator Y := by
    filter_upwards [hXY] with ω hω
    by_cases hsω : ω ∈ s
    · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hsω] using hω hsω
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hsω, le_refl]
  have h := condExp_mono (m := m) (hX.indicator (hm _ hs)) (hY.indicator (hm _ hs)) hpoint
  filter_upwards [h, condExp_indicator hX hs, condExp_indicator hY hs] with ω hω h₁ h₂
  intro hsω
  rw [h₁, h₂] at hω
  simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hsω] using hω

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.integrable
statement: theorem HasFiniteNatMoments.integrable (hf : HasFiniteNatMoments f μ) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_one] using hf 1

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.pow
statement:
theorem HasFiniteNatMoments.pow (hf : HasFiniteNatMoments f μ) (p : ℕ) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => f ω ^ p) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  simpa only [← pow_mul] using hf (p * q)

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_mul_of_sq
statement:
private theorem integrable_mul_of_sq (hf : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) μ)
    (hg : Integrable (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) μ)
    (hfmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hgmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f ω * g ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  exact ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hfmeas).2 hf).integrable_mul
    ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hgmeas).2 hg)

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.mul
statement:
theorem HasFiniteNatMoments.mul (hf : HasFiniteNatMoments f μ)
    (hg : HasFiniteNatMoments g μ) : HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => f ω * g ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hfp := hf.pow p
  have hgp := hg.pow p
  simpa only [mul_pow] using integrable_mul_of_sq (hfp 2) (hgp 2)
    hfp.integrable.aestronglyMeasurable hgp.integrable.aestronglyMeasurable

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.const_mul
statement:
theorem HasFiniteNatMoments.const_mul (hf : HasFiniteNatMoments f μ) (c : ℝ) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => c * f ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  simpa only [mul_pow] using (hf p).const_mul (c ^ p)

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.add
statement:
theorem HasFiniteNatMoments.add (hf : HasFiniteNatMoments f μ)
    (hg : HasFiniteNatMoments g μ) : HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => f ω + g ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  simp_rw [add_pow]
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  have hi := ((hf.pow i).mul (hg.pow (p - i))).integrable
  exact hi.mul_const _

name: MeasureTheory.hasFiniteNatMoments_const
statement:
theorem hasFiniteNatMoments_const [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (c : ℝ) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments (fun _ : Ω => c) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  exact integrable_const _

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using (hasFiniteNatMoments_const (μ := μ) 0)
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      exact (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).add
        (ih fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.prod
statement:
theorem HasFiniteNatMoments.prod [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    {f : ι → Ω → ℝ} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, HasFiniteNatMoments (f i) μ) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ s, f i ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa using (hasFiniteNatMoments_const (μ := μ) 1)
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi]
      exact ((hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).mul
        (ih fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.comp_measurePreserving
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  exact hT.integrable_comp_of_integrable (hf p)

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.matrix_pow_entry
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing i j with
  | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using hasFiniteNatMoments_const (μ := μ) ((1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) i j)
  | succ p ih =>
      simp only [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
      exact HasFiniteNatMoments.sum Finset.univ fun a _ => (ih i a).mul (hA a j)

name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteNatMoments.trace_matrix_pow
proof:
:= by
  exact HasFiniteNatMoments.sum Finset.univ fun a _ =>
    HasFiniteNatMoments.matrix_pow_entry hA p a a

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral
proof:
:=
  iInf_le_of_le π (iInf_le_of_le hπ le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_self (μ : Measure X) : wassersteinEDistOne μ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  refine (wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral (Measure.isCoupling_map_diag μ)).trans ?_
  exact (lintegral_map_le (fun p : X × X => edist p.1 p.2)
    (fun x : X => (x, x))).trans_eq (by simp)

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral_compProd
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral_compProd (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ]
    (κ : Kernel X X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ (κ ∘ₘ μ) ≤ ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, edist x y ∂κ x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  convert wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral (Measure.isCoupling_compProd μ κ) using 1
  exact (Measure.lintegral_compProd (measurable_fst.edist measurable_snd)).symm

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_comp_le_of_lintegral_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_comp_le_of_lintegral_le (μ : Measure X)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (κ : Kernel X X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {C : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫⁻ y, edist x y ∂κ x ≤ C) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ (κ ∘ₘ μ) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral_compProd μ κ).trans
  exact (lintegral_mono_ae hC).trans_eq (by simp)

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_map_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_map_le {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [PseudoEMetricSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    (μ ν : Measure X) {f : X → Y} (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) :
    wassersteinEDistOne (μ.map f) (ν.map f) ≤ wassersteinEDistOne μ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine le_iInf fun π => le_iInf fun hπ => ?_
  have hfm := hf.continuous.measurable
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral (hπ.map hfm hfm)).trans
  rw [lintegral_map (g := fun p : X × X => (f p.1, f p.2))
    (measurable_fst.edist measurable_snd) (by fun_prop)]
  apply lintegral_mono
  intro p
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using hf p.1 p.2

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_swap
statement:
private theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_swap (μ ν : Measure X) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ wassersteinEDistOne ν μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_iInf fun π => le_iInf fun hπ => ?_
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_lintegral hπ.swap).trans
  rw [lintegral_map (measurable_fst.edist measurable_snd) measurable_swap]
  exact le_of_eq (lintegral_congr fun p => edist_comm p.2 p.1)

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_comm
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_comm (μ ν : Measure X) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν = wassersteinEDistOne ν μ
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (wassersteinEDistOne_le_swap μ ν) (wassersteinEDistOne_le_swap ν μ)

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_comap_subtype_val
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_comap_subtype_val (μ ν : Measure X) {K : Set X}
    (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ K) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤
      wassersteinEDistOne (μ.comap (Subtype.val : K → X)) (ν.comap (Subtype.val : K → X))
proof:
:= by
  have hmapμ : (μ.comap (Subtype.val : K → X)).map Subtype.val = μ := by
    rw [map_comap_subtype_coe hK, Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hμ]
  have hmapν : (ν.comap (Subtype.val : K → X)).map Subtype.val = ν := by
    rw [map_comap_subtype_coe hK, Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hν]
  simpa only [hmapμ, hmapν] using wassersteinEDistOne_map_le
    (μ.comap (Subtype.val : K → X)) (ν.comap (Subtype.val : K → X))
    (f := Subtype.val) isometry_subtype_coe.lipschitz

name: NLAlib.enorm_integral_sub_le_wassersteinEDistOne
proof:
:= by
  refine le_iInf fun π => le_iInf fun hπ => ?_
  have hfst : Integrable (fun p : X × X => f p.1) π :=
    hπ.measurePreserving_fst.integrable_comp_of_integrable hμ
  have hsnd : Integrable (fun p : X × X => f p.2) π :=
    hπ.measurePreserving_snd.integrable_comp_of_integrable hν
  rw [← hπ.integral_fst hμ.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← hπ.integral_snd hν.aestronglyMeasurable, ← integral_sub hfst hsnd]
  apply (enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _).trans
  apply lintegral_mono
  intro p
  simpa only [← edist_eq_enorm_sub, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using hf p.1 p.2

name: NLAlib.exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_of_tendsto
    {X T I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    (K : T → C(X, ℝ)) (C : ℝ≥0) (F : I → T → ℝ) (f : T → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure X,
      μ.mass ≤ C ∧ ∀ t, ∫ x, K t x ∂μ = F i t)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun i => F i t) l (𝓝 (f t))) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure X, μ.mass ≤ C ∧ ∀ t, ∫ x, K t x ∂μ = f t
proof:
:= by
  let L : FiniteMeasure X → T → ℝ := fun μ t => ∫ x, K t x ∂μ
  have hL : Continuous L := continuous_pi fun t =>
    FiniteMeasure.continuous_integral_continuousMap (K t)
  have hc : IsCompact (L '' {μ : FiniteMeasure X | μ.mass ≤ C}) :=
    (isCompact_setOfPred_finiteMeasure_le_of_compactSpace X C).image hL
  have hf : f ∈ L '' {μ : FiniteMeasure X | μ.mass ≤ C} := by
    apply hc.isClosed.mem_of_tendsto (tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr hlim)
    filter_upwards [hrep] with i hi
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, heq⟩ := hi
    exact ⟨μ, hμ, funext heq⟩
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, heq⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨μ, hμ, fun t => congrFun heq t⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_finiteMeasure_exp_mul_eq_of_tendsto_of_mass_le
statement:
theorem exists_finiteMeasure_exp_mul_eq_of_tendsto_of_mass_le
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot] (a b : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0)
    (F : I → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass ≤ C ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc a b) ∧
      ∀ t, ∫ x, Real.exp (t * x) ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) = F i t)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun i => F i t) l (𝓝 (f t))) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass ≤ C ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc a b) ∧
      ∀ t, ∫ x, Real.exp (t * x) ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) = f t
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ → C(Icc a b, ℝ) := fun t =>
    ⟨fun x => Real.exp (t * (x : ℝ)), by fun_prop⟩
  have hrep' : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure (Icc a b),
      μ.mass ≤ C ∧ ∀ t, ∫ x, K t x ∂μ = F i t := by
    filter_upwards [hrep] with i hi
    obtain ⟨μ, hmass, hsupp, hμ⟩ := hi
    refine ⟨μ.comap Subtype.val, (FiniteMeasure.mass_comap_le _ _).trans hmass, ?_⟩
    intro t
    change ∫ x : Icc a b, Real.exp (t * (x : ℝ))
      ∂(Measure.comap Subtype.val (μ : Measure ℝ)) = F i t
    rw [integral_subtype_comap (μ := (μ : Measure ℝ)) (s := Icc a b)
      measurableSet_Icc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * x)),
      Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hsupp, hμ]
  obtain ⟨μ, hmass, hμ⟩ :=
    exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_of_tendsto K C F f hrep' hlim
  refine ⟨μ.map Subtype.val, (FiniteMeasure.mass_map_le _ _).trans hmass, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.map (Subtype.val : Icc a b → ℝ) (μ : Measure (Icc a b)),
      x ∈ Icc a b
    exact (ae_map_iff measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable measurableSet_Icc).mpr
      (Eventually.of_forall fun x => x.property)
  · intro t
    change ∫ x, Real.exp (t * x)
      ∂Measure.map (Subtype.val : Icc a b → ℝ) (μ : Measure (Icc a b)) = f t
    have hval : IsClosedEmbedding (Subtype.val : Icc a b → ℝ) :=
      IsClosedEmbedding.subtypeVal isClosed_Icc
    rw [hval.integral_map
      (μ := (μ : Measure (Icc a b))) (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * x))]
    exact hμ t

name: NLAlib.exists_finiteMeasure_exp_mul_eq_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_finiteMeasure_exp_mul_eq_of_tendsto
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot] (a b : ℝ)
    (F : I → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc a b) ∧
      ∀ t, ∫ x, Real.exp (t * x) ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) = F i t)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun i => F i t) l (𝓝 (f t))) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc a b) ∧
      ∀ t, ∫ x, Real.exp (t * x) ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) = f t
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ≥0 := ⟨|f 0| + 1, by positivity⟩
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ i in l, F i 0 < (C : ℝ) :=
    (hlim 0).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self (f 0)) (lt_add_one _)))
  have hrep' : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass ≤ C ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc a b) ∧
      ∀ t, ∫ x, Real.exp (t * x) ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) = F i t := by
    filter_upwards [hrep, hbound] with i hi hbi
    obtain ⟨μ, hsupp, hμ⟩ := hi
    refine ⟨μ, ?_, hsupp, hμ⟩
    have hmass : (μ.mass : ℝ) = F i 0 := by
      calc
        (μ.mass : ℝ) = ∫ x : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂(μ : Measure ℝ) := by
          simp only [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
          rfl
        _ = F i 0 := by simpa only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero] using hμ 0
    change (μ.mass : ℝ) ≤ (C : ℝ)
    exact hmass.trans_le hbi.le
  obtain ⟨μ, -, hsupp, hμ⟩ :=
    exists_finiteMeasure_exp_mul_eq_of_tendsto_of_mass_le a b C F f hrep' hlim
  exact ⟨μ, hsupp, hμ⟩

name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_pi_fin_succ
statement:
theorem lintegral_pi_fin_succ {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] {n : ℕ}
    (μ : Fin (n + 1) → Measure E) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → E) → ENNReal) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂Measure.pi μ) =
      ∫⁻ a, ∫⁻ x, f (Fin.cons a x) ∂Measure.pi (fun i => μ i.succ) ∂μ 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E) 0).symm
  have he := (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0).symm
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ p : E × (Fin n → E), f (e p)
        ∂(μ 0).prod (Measure.pi (fun i => μ i.succ)) := by
      symm
      exact he.lintegral_comp hf
    _ = _ := by
      change (∫⁻ p : E × (Fin n → E), (f ∘ e) p
        ∂(μ 0).prod (Measure.pi (fun i => μ i.succ))) = _
      rw [lintegral_prod _ (hf.comp e.measurable).aemeasurable]
      simp only [e, Function.comp_def, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply,
        Fin.insertNthEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.insertNth_zero, cast_eq]

name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_add_sum_apply_pi_le_of_lintegral_add_apply_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_add_sum_apply_pi_le_of_lintegral_add_apply_le {n : ℕ}
    (ν γ : Fin n → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (γ i)] (S : AddSubgroup E)
    (X Y : Fin n → E → E) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hν : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, X i x ∈ S) (hγ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂γ i, Y i x ∈ S)
    (f : E → ENNReal) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hstep : ∀ i A, A ∈ S → (∫⁻ x, f (A + X i x) ∂ν i) ≤ ∫⁻ x, f (A + Y i x) ∂γ i)
    (A : E) (hA : A ∈ S) :
    (∫⁻ x, f (A + ∑ i, X i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫⁻ x, f (A + ∑ i, Y i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi γ
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [lintegral_pi_fin_succ ν _ (by fun_prop),
      lintegral_pi_fin_succ γ _ (by fun_prop)]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ a, ∫⁻ x, f (A + X 0 a + ∑ i, Y i.succ (x i))
          ∂Measure.pi (fun i : Fin n => γ i.succ) ∂ν 0 := by
        apply lintegral_mono_ae
        filter_upwards [hν 0] with a ha
        simpa only [add_assoc] using ih (fun i => ν i.succ) (fun i => γ i.succ)
          (fun i => X i.succ) (fun i => Y i.succ) (fun i => hX i.succ) (fun i => hY i.succ)
          (fun i => hν i.succ) (fun i => hγ i.succ)
          (fun i => hstep i.succ) (A + X 0 a) (S.add_mem hA ha)
      _ = ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ a, f ((A + ∑ i, Y i.succ (x i)) + X 0 a) ∂ν 0
          ∂Measure.pi (fun i : Fin n => γ i.succ) := by
        rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by fun_prop)]
        congr 1
        funext x
        congr 1
        funext a
        congr 1
        abel
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ a, f ((A + ∑ i, Y i.succ (x i)) + Y 0 a) ∂γ 0
          ∂Measure.pi (fun i : Fin n => γ i.succ) := by
        apply lintegral_mono_ae
        have hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi (fun i : Fin n => γ i.succ), ∀ i, Y i.succ (x i) ∈ S :=
          ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae
            (μ := fun i : Fin n => γ i.succ)).eventually (hγ i.succ))
        filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
        exact hstep 0 _ (S.add_mem hA (S.sum_mem (fun i _ => hx i)))
      _ = _ := by
        rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by fun_prop)]
        congr 1
        funext a
        congr 1
        funext x
        congr 1
        abel

name: NLAlib.two_add_sq_le_exp_add_exp_neg
statement:
private theorem two_add_sq_le_exp_add_exp_neg (x : ℝ) :
    2 + x ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp x + Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (Real.hasSum_cosh x).summable
  have h := hs.sum_le_tsum (Finset.range 2) (fun n _ =>
    div_nonneg ((even_two_mul n).pow_nonneg x) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  rw [← Real.cosh_eq_tsum] at h
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Real.cosh_eq] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.contDiff
statement:
theorem contDiff (h : IsCompactExpRepresentation ν F a b) (k : WithTop ℕ∞) :
    ContDiff ℝ k F
proof:
:=
  (show AnalyticOnNhd ℝ F univ from fun t _ => h.analyticAt t).contDiff

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
statement:
theorem le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
    (h : IsCompactExpRepresentation ν F a b) :
    F 1 ≤ F 0 + deriv F 0 +
      iteratedDeriv 2 F 0 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient b
proof:
:= by
  apply le_add_deriv_add_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient (h.contDiff 2)
  intro t ht
  simpa using h.iteratedDeriv_even_le_exp_mul_zero 1 ht.1

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.two_mul_zero_add_iteratedDeriv_two_le_add
statement:
theorem two_mul_zero_add_iteratedDeriv_two_le_add
    (h : IsCompactExpRepresentation ν F a b) :
    2 * F 0 + iteratedDeriv 2 F 0 ≤ F 1 + F (-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.integral_exp 0, ← h.integral_exp 1, ← h.integral_exp (-1),
    h.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral]
  simp only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, one_mul, neg_one_mul]
  have hpow : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (ν : Measure ℝ) := by
    simpa using h.integrable_pow_mul_exp 2 0
  have hexp : Integrable Real.exp (ν : Measure ℝ) := by simpa using h.integrable_exp 1
  have hneg : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-x)) (ν : Measure ℝ) := by
    simpa using h.integrable_exp (-1)
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  simp only [mul_one]
  rw [← integral_add (integrable_const (2 : ℝ)) hpow, ← integral_add hexp hneg]
  exact integral_mono ((integrable_const (2 : ℝ)).add hpow)
    (hexp.add hneg)
    (fun x => two_add_sq_le_exp_add_exp_neg x)

name: MeasureTheory.norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le_of_ae_dist_ge
statement:
theorem norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le_of_ae_dist_ge
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (x a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (z : ℂ)
    (hzre : z.re=x) (hsep : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂μ, a≤|ξ-x|) :
    ‖∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂μ‖≤a⁻¹*μ.real univ
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
  filter_upwards [hsep] with ξ hξ
  have hnorm : a≤‖(ξ : ℂ)-z‖ := by
    have hre : |ξ-x|≤‖(ξ : ℂ)-z‖ := by
      simpa only [Complex.sub_re,Complex.ofReal_re,hzre] using
        Complex.abs_re_le_norm ((ξ : ℂ)-z)
    exact hξ.trans hre
  rw [norm_inv]
  exact (inv_le_inv₀ (ha.trans_le hnorm) ha).mpr hnorm

name: MeasureTheory.im_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le_of_ae_dist_ge
statement:
theorem im_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le_of_ae_dist_ge
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (x a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a)
    (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) (hsep : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂μ, a≤|ξ-x|) :
    (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I))⁻¹ ∂μ).im≤
      ((γ : ℝ)/a^2)*μ.real univ
proof:
:= by
  have hγpos : 0<(γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
  have hz : 0<((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I).im := by simpa using hγpos
  change RCLike.im (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I))⁻¹ ∂μ)≤_
  rw [← integral_im (Complex.integrable_real_cauchyKernel μ hz)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ _ξ : ℝ, (γ : ℝ)/a^2 ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae (Complex.integrable_real_cauchyKernel μ hz).im (integrable_const _)
      filter_upwards [hsep] with ξ hξ
      have hs : a^2≤(ξ-x)^2 := by
        simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le hξ 2
      have hden : a^2≤(ξ-x)^2+(γ : ℝ)^2 := hs.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _))
      have he : (((ξ : ℂ)-((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I))⁻¹).im=
          (γ : ℝ)/((ξ-x)^2+(γ : ℝ)^2) := by
        simp only [Complex.inv_im,Complex.sub_im,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.add_im,
          Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,
          zero_add,add_zero,zero_sub,neg_neg,Complex.normSq_apply,Complex.sub_re,
          Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,sub_zero]
        ring
      change (((ξ : ℂ)-((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I))⁻¹).im≤_
      rw [he]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hγpos.le (sq_pos_of_pos ha) hden
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_comm]

name: MeasureTheory.norm_stieltjes_le_of_zero_positive_test
statement:
theorem norm_stieltjes_le_of_zero_positive_test
    (ρ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (hfnonneg : ∀ ξ, 0≤f ξ)
    (hzero : ∫ ξ : ℝ, f ξ ∂(ρ : Measure ℝ)=0)
    (x a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hfone : ∀ ξ, |ξ-x|<a → 1≤f ξ)
    (z : ℂ) (hzre : z.re=x) :
    ‖∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ : Measure ℝ)‖≤a⁻¹*(ρ.mass : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable f (ρ : Measure ℝ) :=
    (integrable_const ‖f‖).mono' f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => f.norm_coe_le_norm ξ)
  have hfzero := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hfnonneg hi).mp hzero
  have hsep : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂(ρ : Measure ℝ), a≤|ξ-x| := by
    filter_upwards [hfzero] with ξ hξ
    change f ξ=0 at hξ
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro ht
    have hh := hfone ξ ht
    rw [hξ] at hh
    linarith
  have hh := norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le_of_ae_dist_ge (ρ : Measure ℝ) x a ha z hzre hsep
  simpa only [Measure.real,← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,ENNReal.coe_toReal] using hh

name: MeasureTheory.norm_stieltjes_family_le_on_support_of_ae_zero_positive_test
statement:
theorem norm_stieltjes_family_le_on_support_of_ae_zero_positive_test
    {T : Type*} [MeasurableSpace T] [TopologicalSpace T]
    (ν : Measure T) (ρ : T → FiniteMeasure ℝ) (r : T → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hrep : ∀ t : T, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → r t z=
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → Continuous (fun t : T => r t z))
    (B : NNReal) (hmass : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, (ρ t).mass≤B)
    (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (hfnonneg : ∀ ξ, 0≤f ξ)
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, ∫ ξ : ℝ, f ξ ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ)=0)
    (x a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hfone : ∀ ξ, |ξ-x|<a → 1≤f ξ)
    (t : T) (ht : t∈ν.support) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) (hzre : z.re=x) :
    ‖r t z‖≤a⁻¹*(B : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : ∀ᵐ u ∂ν, ‖r u z‖≤a⁻¹*(B : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hmass,hzero] with u huM hu0
    rw [hrep u z hz]
    exact (norm_stieltjes_le_of_zero_positive_test (ρ u) f hfnonneg hu0 x a ha hfone z hzre).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr huM) (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le))
  exact Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed
    (isClosed_le (hc z hz).norm continuous_const) he ht

name: Real.bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le
    (X : ι → T → ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i t, |X i t| ≤ R) (r : ι → ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ∑ i, r i * X i t)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∑ i, |r i| * R, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans <| (abs_mul _ _).trans_le <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hX i t) (abs_nonneg _)

name: MeasureTheory.measurable_ciSup_sum_mul_of_bounded
statement:
theorem measurable_ciSup_sum_mul_of_bounded
    (X : ι → T → ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i t, |X i t| ≤ R) :
    Measurable (fun r : ι → ℝ => ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i t)
proof:
:= by
  apply LowerSemicontinuous.measurable
  apply lowerSemicontinuous_ciSup
  · exact fun r => Real.bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le X hX r
  · intro t
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun r : ι → ℝ => ∑ i, r i * X i t)).lowerSemicontinuous

name: NLAlib.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_congr
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_congr {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    {f g : ℝ → X} {a b : ℝ} (heq : EqOn f g (uIcc a b))
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b) : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g a b
proof:
:= by
  apply hf.congr'
  have hd : ∀ᶠ E in AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.totalLengthFilter ⊓
      𝓟 (AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.disjWithin a b),
      E ∈ AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.disjWithin a b :=
    (Filter.eventually_principal.mpr fun E hE => hE).filter_mono inf_le_right
  filter_upwards [hd] with E hE
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [heq (hE.1 i hi).1, heq (hE.1 i hi).2]

name: MeasureTheory.measure_eq_of_integral_eval_eq_of_finite_carrier
statement:
theorem measure_eq_of_integral_eval_eq_of_finite_carrier {μ ν : Measure ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (s : Finset ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ s)
    (h : ∀ p : ℝ[X], (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∫ x, p.eval x ∂ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  let p := Lagrange.interpolate s id f
  have hp (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ s) : p.eval x = f x := by
    exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node f (fun _ _ _ _ h => h) hx
  calc
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (by
      filter_upwards [hμ] with x hx
      exact (hp x hx).symm)
    _ = ∫ x, p.eval x ∂ν := h p
    _ = ∫ x, f x ∂ν := integral_congr_ae (by
      filter_upwards [hν] with x hx
      exact hp x hx)

name: MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_integral_of_support_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_of_support_subset_Icc {I 𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {l : Filter I} {μs : I → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ} {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
    (hweak : Tendsto μs l (𝓝 μ)) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ i in l, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc a b)
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → 𝕜}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i : Measure ℝ)) l
      (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : C(Icc a b, 𝕜) := ⟨fun x => f x, continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hf⟩
  let G : ℝ →ᵇ 𝕜 := (BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact F).compContinuous
    ⟨projIcc a b hab, continuous_projIcc⟩
  have hG (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) : G x = f x := by
    change f (projIcc a b hab x) = f x
    rw [projIcc_of_mem hab hx]
  have hEq (ν : Measure ℝ) (hν : ν.support ⊆ Icc a b) :
      (∫ x, G x ∂ν) = ∫ x, f x ∂ν :=
    integral_congr_ae ((ν.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hν).mono hG)
  have h := (tendsto_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto 𝕜).mp hweak G
  rw [hEq (μ : Measure ℝ) hμ] at h
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [hs] with i hi
  exact hEq (μs i : Measure ℝ) hi

name: MeasureTheory.curveIntegral_smul_id_eq_integral_Icc
statement:
private theorem curveIntegral_smul_id_eq_integral_Icc {c d : ℂ}
    (γ : Path c d) (g : ℂ → ℂ) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, derivWithin γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t * g (γ.extend t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveIntegral_def, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
    ← integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
  congr 1
  ext t
  simp only [curveIntegralFun_def, smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: MeasureTheory.curveIntegrable_integrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub
statement:
private theorem curveIntegrable_integrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {c d : ℂ} (γ : Path c d)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hoff : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, γ.extend t ≠ (x : ℂ))
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.range γ)) :
    CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => curveIntegral
      (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ) μ ∧
    (∫ x : ℝ, curveIntegral
      (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ ∂μ) =
      curveIntegral
        (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •
          ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
proof:
:= by
  let ν := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  let H : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun xt =>
    derivWithin γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) xt.2 *
      (f (γ.extend xt.2) / (γ.extend xt.2 - (xt.1 : ℂ)))
  have hc : ContinuousOn H (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    have hfcomp : ContinuousOn (fun xt : ℝ × ℝ => f (γ.extend xt.2))
        (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hf.comp
          (show ContinuousOn (fun xt : ℝ × ℝ => γ.extend xt.2) _ by fun_prop)
          (fun xt hxt => ⟨⟨xt.2, hxt.2⟩, (γ.extend_apply hxt.2).symm⟩)
    apply ((hγ.continuousOn_derivWithin uniqueDiffOn_Icc_zero_one le_rfl).comp
      continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun _ hxt => hxt.2)).mul
    apply hfcomp.div (show ContinuousOn
      (fun xt : ℝ × ℝ => γ.extend xt.2 - (xt.1 : ℂ)) _ by fun_prop)
    intro xt hxt
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff xt.2 hxt.2 xt.1 hxt.1)
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ xt ∂μ.prod ν, xt ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_mem_iff_ae_ae_mem
      (measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    exact ⟨hx, ht⟩
  have hInt : Integrable H (μ.prod ν) := by
    refine (hc.integrableOn_compact
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).integrable_of_ae_notMem_eq_zero ?_
    filter_upwards [hmem] with xt hxt hnot
    exact (hnot hxt).elim
  have hswap := integral_integral_swap (f := fun x t => H (x, t))
    (by convert! hInt using 1)
  have hcurve : CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ := by
    rw [CurveIntegrable, intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le zero_le_one]
    apply hInt.integral_prod_right.congr
    filter_upwards with t
    dsimp only [H]
    simp only [curveIntegralFun_def, smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_mul_const]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  have houter : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => curveIntegral
      (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ) μ := by
    simp_rw [curveIntegral_smul_id_eq_integral_Icc]
    simpa only [H, ν] using hInt.integral_prod_left
  refine ⟨hcurve, houter, ?_⟩
  simp_rw [curveIntegral_smul_id_eq_integral_Icc]
  trans ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫ x : ℝ,
    derivWithin γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t *
      (f (γ.extend t) / (γ.extend t - (x : ℂ))) ∂μ
  · simpa only [H, ν] using hswap
  · apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: MeasureTheory.curveIntegrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub
statement:
theorem curveIntegrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {c d : ℂ} (γ : Path c d)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hoff : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, γ.extend t ≠ (x : ℂ))
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.range γ)) :
    CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ ∧
    (∫ x : ℝ, curveIntegral
      (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ ∂μ) =
      curveIntegral
        (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •
          ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
proof:
:= by
  have h := curveIntegrable_integrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub hs γ hγ hoff hf
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_curveIntegral_div_sub_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem integrable_curveIntegral_div_sub_of_contDiffOn
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {c d : ℂ} (γ : Path c d)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hoff : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, γ.extend t ≠ (x : ℂ))
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.range γ)) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => curveIntegral
      (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ) μ
proof:
:=
  (curveIntegrable_integrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub hs γ hγ hoff hf).2.1

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal
statement:
theorem integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal
    (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (x : ℝ) (γ : NNReal) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_cauchyPDFReal x).bdd_mul f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => f.norm_coe_le_norm y))

name: MeasureTheory.integral_norm_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_le
    (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (x : ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, ‖f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y‖) ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, ‖f‖ * cauchyPDFReal x γ y := by
      apply integral_mono (integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal f x γ).norm
        ((integrable_cauchyPDFReal x).const_mul ‖f‖)
      intro y
      change ‖f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * cauchyPDFReal x γ y
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (cauchyPDF_pos x hγ y).le]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (f.norm_coe_le_norm y) (cauchyPDF_pos x hγ y).le
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul, integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_one x hγ, mul_one]

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_prod
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f p.2 * cauchyPDFReal p.1 γ p.2) (μ.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f p.2 * cauchyPDFReal p.1 γ p.2) := by
    have hf : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f p.2) :=
      (f.continuous.comp continuous_snd).stronglyMeasurable
    unfold cauchyPDFReal
    exact hf.mul (by fun_prop)
  refine (integrable_prod_iff hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun x => integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal f x γ)
  · apply (integrable_const ‖f‖).mono' (hm.norm.integral_prod_right').aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))]
      exact integral_norm_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_le f x γ hγ)

name: MeasureTheory.integral_cauchyRegularization_eq
statement:
theorem integral_cauchyRegularization_eq (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, f y * (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x γ y ∂μ)) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ, f (x + γ * t) ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => (integral_const_mul (f y) _).symm)
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, (∫ y : ℝ, f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y) ∂μ :=
      (integral_integral_swap
        (integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_prod μ f γ hγ)).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun x => integral_mul_cauchyPDFReal_eq_integral_affine f x γ hγ)

name: MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_cauchyRegularization
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_cauchyRegularization (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) {γ : ℕ → NNReal} (hγne : ∀ n, γ n ≠ 0)
    (hγ : Tendsto (fun n => (γ n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y : ℝ, f y * (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂μ))
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, f x ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  have hm (n : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f (p.1 + γ n * p.2)) :=
    (f.continuous.comp (by fun_prop)).stronglyMeasurable
  have hbound (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
      ‖∫ t : ℝ, f (x + γ n * t) ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, ‖f (x + γ n * t)‖ ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1 := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ ≤ ∫ _t : ℝ, ‖f‖ ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1 := by
        apply integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)) (integrable_const _)
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => f.norm_coe_le_norm _)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have ht := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := μ) (fun _ : ℝ => ‖f‖)
    (fun n => (hm n).integral_prod_right.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_const _) (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hbound n))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => tendsto_integral_affine_cauchy f x hγ))
  simpa only [integral_cauchyRegularization_eq μ f _ (hγne _)] using ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasLaw_pi_select
statement:
theorem hasLaw_pi_select (g : κ → ι) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    HasLaw (fun x : ι → E => fun j => x (g j))
      (Measure.pi (fun j => ν (g j))) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : iIndepFun (fun i (x : ι → E) => x i) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  exact (hi.precomp hg).hasLaw_pi (fun j => (measurePreserving_eval ν (g j)).hasLaw)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_prod_pi_select
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_pi_select {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (g : κ → ι) (hg : Function.Injective g) (f : κ → E → 𝕜)
    (hf : ∀ j, Integrable (f j) (ν (g j))) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → E => ∏ j, f j (x (g j))) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (hasLaw_pi_select ν g hg).measurePreserving (by fun_prop)
  exact hm.integrable_comp_of_integrable (Integrable.fintype_prod hf)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_prod_pi_select
statement:
theorem integral_prod_pi_select {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (g : κ → ι) (hg : Function.Injective g) (f : κ → E → 𝕜)
    (hf : ∀ j, Integrable (f j) (ν (g j))) :
    (∫ x : ι → E, ∏ j, f j (x (g j)) ∂Measure.pi ν) =
      ∏ j, ∫ x, f j x ∂ν (g j)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : κ → E, ∏ j, f j (x j) ∂Measure.pi (fun j => ν (g j)) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
        (hasLaw_pi_select ν g hg).integral_comp
          (Integrable.fintype_prod hf).aestronglyMeasurable
    _ = _ := integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod _

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasLaw_pi_mix
statement:
theorem hasLaw_pi_mix (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    HasLaw (fun x : (ι → E) × (ι → E) =>
      fun i => if p i then x.1 i else x.2 i)
      (Measure.pi ν) ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  let g : ι → ι ⊕ ι := fun i => if p i then Sum.inl i else Sum.inr i
  have hg : Function.Injective g := by
    intro i j hij
    have he := congrArg (Sum.elim id id) hij
    simpa [g, apply_ite] using he
  haveI : ∀ j : ι ⊕ ι, IsProbabilityMeasure (Sum.elim ν ν j) := by
    intro j
    cases j with
    | inl i => simpa only [Sum.elim_inl] using (inferInstance : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i))
    | inr i => simpa only [Sum.elim_inr] using (inferInstance : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i))
  have hs := hasLaw_pi_select (fun j : ι ⊕ ι => Sum.elim ν ν j) g hg
  have hc := (measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi_symm
    (fun j : ι ⊕ ι => Sum.elim ν ν j)).hasLaw
  convert hs.comp hc using 1
  · funext x i
    dsimp [g, Function.comp_def, MeasurableEquiv.coe_sumPiEquivProdPi_symm,
      Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · congr 1
    funext i
    dsimp [g]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_bilin_rotation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_bilin_rotation
    (Y Z : Ω → E) (hY : Integrable Y μ) (hZ : Integrable Z μ)
    (f : E → F) (hfc : Continuous f)
    (g : E → G) (dg : E → E →L[ℝ] G)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (dg x) x) (hdgc : Continuous dg)
    (Cf Cg Cd : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤Cf)
    (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖≤Cg) (hdgb : ∀ x, ‖dg x‖≤Cd)
    (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] ℂ) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ω, B (f (Y ω))
        (g (Real.cos t • Y ω+Real.sin t • Z ω)) ∂μ)
      (∫ ω, B (f (Y ω))
        (dg (Real.cos θ • Y ω+Real.sin θ • Z ω)
          (-Real.sin θ • Y ω+Real.cos θ • Z ω)) ∂μ) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hCf : 0≤Cf := (norm_nonneg (f 0)).trans (hfb 0)
  have hCg : 0≤Cg := (norm_nonneg (g 0)).trans (hgb 0)
  have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (dg 0)).trans (hdgb 0)
  have hgc : Continuous g := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hg x).continuousAt
  let W (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) := Real.cos t • Y ω+Real.sin t • Z ω
  let D (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) := -Real.sin t • Y ω+Real.cos t • Z ω
  let H (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) := B (f (Y ω)) (g (W t ω))
  let H' (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) := B (f (Y ω)) (dg (W t ω) (D t ω))
  have hWa (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (W t) μ :=
    (hY.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul _).add (hZ.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul _)
  have hDa (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (D t) μ :=
    (hY.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul _).add (hZ.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul _)
  have hfa := hfc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hBa := B.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hfa
  have hHa (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (H t) μ :=
    isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (hBa.prodMk (hgc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hWa t)))
  have hH'a (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (H' t) μ := by
    have hdga := hdgc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hWa t)
    have hga := isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (hdga.prodMk (hDa t))
    exact isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hBa.prodMk hga)
  have hHi : Integrable (H θ) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hHa θ) (‖B‖*Cf*Cg)
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun ω =>
      (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans (by gcongr <;> first | exact hfb _ | exact hgb _)
  have hDb (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ‖D t ω‖≤‖Y ω‖+‖Z ω‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖-Real.sin t • Y ω‖+‖Real.cos t • Z ω‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖Y ω‖+‖Z ω‖ := by
        simp only [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_neg]
        gcongr
        · exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sin_le_one t)
        · exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (Real.abs_cos_le_one t)
  have hbound (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ‖H' t ω‖≤‖B‖*Cf*Cd*(‖Y ω‖+‖Z ω‖) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖B‖*‖f (Y ω)‖*‖dg (W t ω) (D t ω)‖ := B.le_opNorm₂ _ _
      _ ≤ ‖B‖*Cf*(Cd*(‖Y ω‖+‖Z ω‖)) := by
        gcongr
        · exact hfb _
        · exact ((dg _).le_opNorm _).trans
            ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdgb _) (norm_nonneg _)).trans
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hDb t ω) hCd))
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hdiff (ω : Ω) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => H t ω) (H' t ω) t := by
    have hW : HasDerivAt (fun t => W t ω) (D t ω) t :=
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).smul_const (Y ω)).add
        ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).smul_const (Z ω))
    exact (B (f (Y ω))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t ((hg _).comp_hasDerivAt t hW)
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := μ)
    (F := H) (F' := H') (x₀ := θ) (s := Set.univ)
    (bound := fun ω => ‖B‖*Cf*Cd*(‖Y ω‖+‖Z ω‖)) Filter.univ_mem
    (Eventually.of_forall hHa) hHi (hH'a θ)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun ω t _ => hbound t ω)
    ((hY.norm.add hZ.norm).const_mul (‖B‖*Cf*Cd))
    (Eventually.of_forall fun ω t _ => hdiff ω t)).2

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.mass_eq
statement: theorem mass_eq (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) : μ Set.univ = ν Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.1, ← h.2, fst_univ, snd_univ]

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.measurePreserving_fst
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_fst (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) :
    MeasurePreserving Prod.fst π μ
proof: := ⟨measurable_fst, h.1⟩

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.measurePreserving_snd
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_snd (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) :
    MeasurePreserving Prod.snd π ν
proof: := ⟨measurable_snd, h.2⟩

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.isProbabilityMeasure
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure π where
  measure_univ
proof: := by rw [← fst_univ, h.1, measure_univ]

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.swap
statement: theorem swap (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) : (π.map Prod.swap).IsCoupling ν μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsCoupling] using And.intro h.2 h.1

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.map
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hfst := fst_map_prodMk (μ := π) (X := fun p : α × β => f p.1)
      (Y := fun p : α × β => g p.2) (by fun_prop)
    rw [hfst]
    change π.map (f ∘ Prod.fst) = μ.map f
    rw [← Measure.map_map hf measurable_fst]
    exact congrArg (Measure.map f) h.1
  · have hsnd := snd_map_prodMk (μ := π) (X := fun p : α × β => f p.1)
      (Y := fun p : α × β => g p.2) (by fun_prop)
    rw [hsnd]
    change π.map (g ∘ Prod.snd) = ν.map g
    rw [← Measure.map_map hg measurable_snd]
    exact congrArg (Measure.map g) h.2

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.integral_fst
statement:
theorem integral_fst (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) {f : α → E}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) : ∫ p, f p.1 ∂π = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : AEStronglyMeasurable f (π.map Prod.fst) := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable f π.fst
    rw [h.1]
    exact hf
  rw [← integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable hf']
  exact congrArg (fun m => ∫ x, f x ∂m) h.1

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.IsCoupling.integral_snd
statement:
theorem integral_snd (h : π.IsCoupling μ ν) {f : β → E}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ν) : ∫ p, f p.2 ∂π = ∫ x, f x ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : AEStronglyMeasurable f (π.map Prod.snd) := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable f π.snd
    rw [h.2]
    exact hf
  rw [← integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable hf']
  exact congrArg (fun m => ∫ x, f x ∂m) h.2

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.isCoupling_prod

theorem isCoupling_prod (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] : (μ.prod ν).IsCoupling μ ν

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.isCoupling_map_diag

theorem isCoupling_map_diag (μ : Measure α) :
    (μ.map (fun x => (x, x))).IsCoupling μ μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [fst_map_prodMk (X := fun x : α => x) (Y := fun x : α => x)
      (μ := μ) measurable_id]
    exact Measure.map_id
  · rw [snd_map_prodMk (X := fun x : α => x) (Y := fun x : α => x)
      (μ := μ) measurable_id]
    exact Measure.map_id

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.isCoupling_compProd
