theorem isCoupling_compProd (μ : Measure α) [SFinite μ] (κ : Kernel α β)
    [IsMarkovKernel κ] : (μ ⊗ₘ κ).IsCoupling μ (κ ∘ₘ μ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fst_compProd μ κ, snd_compProd μ κ⟩

name: cstar_norm_pow_le
statement: private theorem cstar_norm_pow_le (a : A) (n : ℕ) : ‖a^n‖≤‖a‖^n
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial A with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    simpa only [Subsingleton.elim (a^n) 0,norm_zero] using pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) n
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    exact norm_pow_le a n

name: selfAdjoint.continuous_resolvent
statement:
theorem continuous_resolvent {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) :
    Continuous (fun a : selfAdjoint A => resolvent (a : A) z)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro a
  have hu := a.property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz
  have hi : ContinuousAt Ring.inverse (algebraMap ℂ A z-(a : A)) := by
    simpa only [hu.unit_spec] using NormedRing.inverse_continuousAt hu.unit
  change ContinuousAt (fun b : selfAdjoint A => Ring.inverse (algebraMap ℂ A z-(b : A))) a
  exact hi.comp (f := fun b : selfAdjoint A => algebraMap ℂ A z-(b : A))
    ((continuous_const.sub continuous_subtype_val).continuousAt :
    ContinuousAt (fun b : selfAdjoint A => algebraMap ℂ A z-(b : A)) a)

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_pow
    (X : Ω → selfAdjoint A) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => resolvent (X ω : A) z^n) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (((selfAdjoint.continuous_resolvent hz).pow n).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX)
    (|z.im|⁻¹^n)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω =>
    (cstar_norm_pow_le _ _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      ((X ω).property.norm_resolvent_le hz) n)

name: MeasureTheory.hasDerivAt_integral_resolvent_selfAdjoint_pow
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_resolvent_selfAdjoint_pow
    (X : Ω → selfAdjoint A) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ∫ ω, resolvent (X ω : A) w^n ∂μ)
      (-(n : ℂ)•∫ ω, resolvent (X ω : A) z^(n+1) ∂μ) z
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := |z.im|/2
  have hr : 0<r := by dsimp [r]; exact half_pos (abs_pos.mpr hz)
  have hheight {w : ℂ} (hw : w∈Metric.ball z r) : r≤|w.im| := by
    have hd : ‖w-z‖<r := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hw
    have hi := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w-z)
    have ha := abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub w.im z.im
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at hi
    have hlow := (le_abs_self (|w.im|-|z.im|)).trans ha
    have hrev := (neg_le_abs (|w.im|-|z.im|)).trans ha
    dsimp [r] at *
    linarith
  have hne {w : ℂ} (hw : w∈Metric.ball z r) : w.im≠0 :=
    abs_pos.mp (hr.trans_le (hheight hw))
  have hm : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => resolvent (X ω : A) w^n) μ := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z hr] with w hw
    exact (((selfAdjoint.continuous_resolvent (hne hw)).pow n).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX)
  have hdm : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun ω => -(n : ℂ)•resolvent (X ω : A) z^(n+1)) μ :=
    (((selfAdjoint.continuous_resolvent hz).pow (n+1)).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX).const_smul _
  have hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ w∈Metric.ball z r,
      ‖-(n : ℂ)•resolvent (X ω : A) w^(n+1)‖≤(n : ℝ)*(r⁻¹)^(n+1) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro ω w hw
    rw [norm_smul,norm_neg,Complex.norm_natCast]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    apply (cstar_norm_pow_le _ _).trans
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
    exact ((X ω).property.norm_resolvent_le (hne hw)).trans
      (inv_anti₀ hr (hheight hw))
  have hd : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ w∈Metric.ball z r,
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℂ => resolvent (X ω : A) v^n)
        (-(n : ℂ)•resolvent (X ω : A) w^(n+1)) w := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro ω w hw
    exact spectrum.hasDerivAt_resolvent_pow (X ω : A)
      ((X ω).property.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero (hne hw)) n
  have hh := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z hr) hm (integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_pow X hX hz n)
    hdm hb (integrable_const _) hd
  simpa only [integral_smul] using hh.2

name: ContinuousLinearMap.integral_bilinear_sub_integral
statement:
theorem integral_bilinear_sub_integral
    (B : F →L[𝕜] F →L[𝕜] G) (f : Ω → F)
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hBf : Integrable (fun x => B (f x) (f x)) μ) :
    (∫ x, B (f x-∫ y, f y ∂μ) (f x-∫ y, f y ∂μ) ∂μ)=
      (∫ x, B (f x) (f x) ∂μ)-B (∫ y, f y ∂μ) (∫ y, f y ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  let m := ∫ y, f y ∂μ
  have hleft : Integrable (fun x => B (f x) m) μ := (B.flip m).integrable_comp hf
  have hright : Integrable (fun x => B m (f x)) μ := (B m).integrable_comp hf
  have heq (x : Ω) : B (f x-m) (f x-m)=
      B (f x) (f x)-B (f x) m-B m (f x)+B m m := by
    simp only [map_sub,sub_apply]
    abel
  change (∫ x, B (f x-m) (f x-m) ∂μ)=(∫ x, B (f x) (f x) ∂μ)-B m m
  simp_rw [heq]
  have hadd := integral_add ((hBf.sub hleft).sub hright)
    (integrable_const (B m m) : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => B m m) μ)
  have hsub := integral_sub (hBf.sub hleft) hright
  have hsub' := integral_sub hBf hleft
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hadd hsub hsub'
  have hleftMean : (∫ x, B (f x) m ∂μ)=B m m := (B.flip m).integral_comp_comm hf
  have hrightMean : (∫ x, B m (f x) ∂μ)=B m m := (B m).integral_comp_comm hf
  rw [hadd,hsub,hsub',
    hleftMean,hrightMean,
    integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul]
  change (∫ x, B (f x) (f x) ∂μ)-B m m-B m m+B m m=_
  abel

name: Matrix.integrable_iff_entries
statement:
theorem integrable_iff_entries {f : Ω → Matrix m n 𝕜} :
    Integrable f μ ↔ ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => f ω i j) μ
proof:
:= by
  let L : (m → n → 𝕜) ≃L[𝕜] Matrix m n 𝕜 :=
    (Matrix.ofLinearEquiv 𝕜).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have h := L.integrable_comp_iff (φ := fun ω => fun i j => f ω i j) (μ := μ)
  have heq : (fun ω => L (fun i j => f ω i j)) = f := by
    funext ω
    ext i j
    rfl
  rw [heq] at h
  simpa only [integrable_pi_iff] using h

name: Matrix.memLp_iff_entries
statement:
theorem memLp_iff_entries {f : Ω → Matrix m n 𝕜} {p : ℝ≥0∞} :
    MemLp f p μ ↔ ∀ i j, MemLp (fun ω => f ω i j) p μ
proof:
:= by
  let L : (m → n → 𝕜) ≃L[𝕜] Matrix m n 𝕜 :=
    (Matrix.ofLinearEquiv 𝕜).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have h := L.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hf
    change MemLp (fun ω => fun i j => f ω i j) p μ at h
    exact fun i j => (h.eval i).eval j
  · intro hf
    have h : MemLp (fun ω => fun i j => f ω i j) p μ :=
      MemLp.of_eval (fun i => MemLp.of_eval (hf i))
    have hi := L.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' h
    have heq : (L.toContinuousLinearMap ∘ fun ω => fun i j => f ω i j) = f := by
      funext ω
      ext i j
      rfl
    rw [heq] at hi
    exact hi

name: Matrix.integral_apply
statement:
theorem integral_apply {f : Ω → Matrix m n 𝕜} (hf : Integrable f μ) (i : m) (j : n) :
    (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) i j = ∫ ω, f ω i j ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix m n 𝕜 →L[𝕜] 𝕜 := (Matrix.entryLinearMap 𝕜 𝕜 i j).toContinuousLinearMap
  exact (L.integral_comp_comm hf).symm

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) (F : X → Ω → E) (D : X → Ω → X →L[ℝ] E)
    (U : Set (X × Ω)) (hU : IsOpen U) (hF : ContinuousOn (fun p => F p.1 p.2) U)
    (hD : ContinuousOn (fun p => D p.1 p.2) U)
    (hderiv : ∀ p ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (fun x => F x p.2) (D p.1 p.2) p.1)
    (x₀ : X) (hpoint : ∀ a ∈ μ.support, (x₀,a) ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ a, F x a ∂μ) (∫ a, D x₀ a ∂μ) x₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,W,hVo,hWo,hxV,hsubW,hVW⟩ := generalized_tube_lemma
    (isCompact_singleton (x := x₀)) hμ hU (by rintro ⟨x,a⟩ ⟨rfl,ha⟩; exact hpoint a ha)
  obtain ⟨C,hCc,hxC,hCV⟩ := exists_compact_subset (x := x₀) hVo (hxV (by simp))
  have hCU : C ×ˢ μ.support ⊆ U := fun p hp => hVW ⟨hCV hp.1,hsubW hp.2⟩
  have hCnhds : C ∈ 𝓝 x₀ := mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hxC
  have hxC' : x₀ ∈ C := interior_subset hxC
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := (hCc.prod hμ).bddAbove_image (hD.norm.mono hCU)
  have hrestrict : μ.restrict μ.support = μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
  have hFsection (x : X) (hx : x ∈ C) : ContinuousOn (F x) μ.support := by
    exact hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun a ha => hCU ⟨hx,ha⟩)
  have hDsection : ContinuousOn (D x₀) μ.support := by
    exact hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun a ha => hpoint a ha)
  have hFi : Integrable (F x₀) μ := by
    have hi := (hFsection x₀ hxC').integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
    rwa [IntegrableOn, hrestrict] at hi
  have hDm : AEStronglyMeasurable (D x₀) μ := by
    have hm := hDsection.aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact (μ := μ) hμ hμ.measurableSet
    rwa [hrestrict] at hm
  apply hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (s := C) (bound := fun _ => M) hCnhds
  · filter_upwards [hCnhds] with x hx
    have hm := (hFsection x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact (μ := μ) hμ hμ.measurableSet
    rwa [hrestrict] at hm
  · exact hFi
  · exact hDm
  · filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with a ha
    intro x hx
    exact hM ⟨(x,a),⟨hx,ha⟩,rfl⟩
  · exact integrable_const M
  · filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with a ha
    intro x hx
    exact hderiv (x,a) (hCU ⟨hx,ha⟩)

name: rpow_inv_two_mul_sq
statement:
private theorem rpow_inv_two_mul_sq {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (v ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ 2 = v ^ ((m : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (v ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ (2 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast _ 2).symm
    _ = v ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹ * 2) := (Real.rpow_mul hv _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      have hmR : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm.ne'
      congr 1
      field_simp [hmR]

name: PositiveLinearMap.gramMoment_rpow_le_add_norm
statement:
theorem PositiveLinearMap.gramMoment_rpow_le_add_norm (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hφ : φ 1 = 1) (htrace : ∀ x y : A, φ (x*y)=φ (y*x))
    (S T : A) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ((φ ((star S*S)^m)).re) ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      ((φ ((star T*T)^m)).re) ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹) + ‖S-T‖
proof:
:= by
  have hvS : 0 ≤ (φ ((star S*S)^m)).re :=
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg (CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg
      (star_mul_self_nonneg S) m))).1
  have hvT : 0 ≤ (φ ((star T*T)^m)).re :=
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg (CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg
      (star_mul_self_nonneg T) m))).1
  apply le_add_of_forall_sq_le_weighted_sq
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hvS _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hvT _) (norm_nonneg _)
  intro ε hε
  rw [rpow_inv_two_mul_sq hvS m hm,rpow_inv_two_mul_sq hvT m hm]
  have ho := φ.re_pow_le_re_pow_of_tracial htrace (star_mul_self_nonneg S)
    (star_mul_self_le_weighted_gram_add_norm S T hε) m
  have hr := Real.rpow_le_rpow hvS ho (by positivity : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹)
  exact hr.trans (φ.re_pow_affine_rpow_le hφ (star_mul_self_nonneg T)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+ε) (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1+ε⁻¹)*‖S-T‖^2) m hm)

name: PositiveLinearMap.abs_gramMoment_rpow_sub_le_norm
statement:
theorem PositiveLinearMap.abs_gramMoment_rpow_sub_le_norm (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hφ : φ 1 = 1) (htrace : ∀ x y : A, φ (x*y)=φ (y*x))
    (S T : A) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    |((φ ((star S*S)^m)).re) ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹) -
      ((φ ((star T*T)^m)).re) ^ ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)| ≤ ‖S-T‖
proof:
:= by
  have hST := φ.gramMoment_rpow_le_add_norm hφ htrace S T m hm
  have hTS := φ.gramMoment_rpow_le_add_norm hφ htrace T S m hm
  rw [norm_sub_rev T S] at hTS
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩

name: Path.curveIntegral_ofLine_eq_intervalIntegral
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_ofLine_eq_intervalIntegral
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ) {a b : ℂ}
    (h₀ : γ 0 = a) (h₁ : γ 1 = b) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => f z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.ofLine hγ.continuous.continuousOn h₀ h₁) =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv γ t * f (γ t)
proof:
:= by
  let p := Path.ofLine hγ.continuous.continuousOn h₀ h₁
  have heq : EqOn p.extend γ I := by
    intro t ht
    rw [p.extend_apply ht]
    rfl
  rw [curveIntegral_def]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro t ht
  have ht' : t ∈ I := by simpa only [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using ht
  rw [curveIntegralFun_def]
  simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change f (p.extend t) * derivWithin p.extend I t = deriv γ t * f (γ t)
  rw [heq ht', derivWithin_congr heq (heq ht'),
    (hγ.differentiable (by norm_num) t).derivWithin (uniqueDiffOn_Icc_zero_one t ht')]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: Complex.circlePath_extend_apply
statement:
theorem circlePath_extend_apply {c : ℂ} {r t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I) :
    (circlePath c r).extend t = circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
  rfl

name: Complex.contDiffOn_circlePath_extend
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_circlePath_extend (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (circlePath c r).extend I
proof:
:= by
  have h : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t)) :=
    (contDiff_circleMap c r).comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)
  exact h.contDiffOn.congr (fun t ht => circlePath_extend_apply ht)

name: Complex.curveIntegral_circlePath_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_circlePath_eq_circleIntegral (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => f z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (circlePath c r) =
      ∮ z in C(c, r), f z
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t)) :=
    (contDiff_circleMap c r).comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)
  unfold circlePath
  rw [Path.curveIntegral_ofLine_eq_intervalIntegral hγ]
  have hder (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun t : ℝ => circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t)) t =
      (2 * Real.pi) • deriv (circleMap c r) (2 * Real.pi * t) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_one, deriv_circleMap] using
      ((hasDerivAt_circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t)).scomp t
        ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (2 * Real.pi))).deriv
  simp_rw [hder, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
  have hscale := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left
    (fun t : ℝ => deriv (circleMap c r) t * f (circleMap c r t)) (2 * Real.pi)
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
  simpa only [mul_zero, mul_one, circleIntegral, smul_eq_mul] using hscale

name: Complex.contDiffOn_circlePath_map_extend
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_circlePath_map_extend
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U)
    (hc : sphere c |r| ⊆ U)
    (hgc : ContinuousOn g (range (circlePath c r))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((circlePath c r).map' hgc).extend I
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => g (circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t))) :=
    ((hg.contDiffOn hU).restrict_scalars ℝ).comp_contDiff
      ((contDiff_circleMap c r).comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))
      (fun t => hc (circleMap_mem_sphere' c r _))
  apply hγ.contDiffOn.congr
  intro t ht
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
  rfl

name: Complex.curveIntegral_circlePath_map_eq_circleIntegral_mul_deriv
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_circlePath_map_eq_circleIntegral_mul_deriv
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) {g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U)
    (hc : sphere c |r| ⊆ U)
    (hgc : ContinuousOn g (range (circlePath c r))) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => f z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        ((circlePath c r).map' hgc) =
      ∮ z in C(c, r), f (g z) * deriv g z
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => g (circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t))) :=
    ((hg.contDiffOn hU).restrict_scalars ℝ).comp_contDiff
      ((contDiff_circleMap c r).comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))
      (fun t => hc (circleMap_mem_sphere' c r _))
  let p : Path (g (c + (r : ℂ))) (g (c + (r : ℂ))) :=
    Path.ofLine hγ.continuous.continuousOn
    (by simp [circleMap]) (by simp [circleMap])
  have hp : p = (circlePath c r).map' hgc := by
    ext t
    rfl
  rw [← hp, Path.curveIntegral_ofLine_eq_intervalIntegral hγ]
  have hder (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun t : ℝ => g (circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t))) t =
      (2 * Real.pi) •
        (deriv (circleMap c r) (2 * Real.pi * t) * deriv g (circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t))) := by
    have hg' := (hg.differentiableAt
      (hU.mem_nhds (hc (circleMap_mem_sphere' c r (2 * Real.pi * t))))).hasDerivAt
    have hc' := (hasDerivAt_circleMap c r (2 * Real.pi * t)).scomp t
      ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (2 * Real.pi))
    have hh := (hg'.scomp t hc').deriv
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_one, deriv_circleMap, smul_eq_mul,
      Complex.real_smul, mul_assoc] using hh
  simp_rw [hder, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
  have hscale := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left
    (fun t : ℝ => deriv (circleMap c r) t *
      (f (g (circleMap c r t)) * deriv g (circleMap c r t))) (2 * Real.pi)
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
  simp only [mul_zero, mul_one] at hscale
  simpa only [circleIntegral, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm,
    mul_comm] using hscale

name: circleIntegral.integral_neg_radius_eq
statement:
theorem integral_neg_radius_eq (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∮ z in C(c, -r), f z) = ∮ z in C(c, r), f z
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleIntegral
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => deriv (circleMap c r) θ * f (circleMap c r θ)
  have hperiod : Function.Periodic F (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro θ
    simp only [F, deriv_circleMap, (periodic_circleMap c r) θ,
      (periodic_circleMap 0 r) θ]
  calc
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, deriv (circleMap c (-r)) θ • f (circleMap c (-r) θ)) =
        ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, F (θ + Real.pi) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro θ _
      simp only [F, deriv_circleMap, circleMap_neg_radius, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = ∫ θ in Real.pi..2 * Real.pi + Real.pi, F θ := by
      simpa only [zero_add] using intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right F Real.pi
        (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 2 * Real.pi)
    _ = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, F θ := by
      simpa only [zero_add, add_comm] using hperiod.intervalIntegral_add_eq Real.pi 0

name: NLAlib.intervalIntegrable_circleIntegral_and_integral_circleIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_circleIntegral_and_integral_circleIntegral_eq
    {F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ} {a b r : ℝ} {c : ℂ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) (Icc a b ×ˢ Metric.sphere c r)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun x => ∮ z in C(c, r), F x z) volume a b ∧
    (∫ x in a..b, ∮ z in C(c, r), F x z) =
      ∮ z in C(c, r), ∫ x in a..b, F x z
proof:
:= by
  let H : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (circleMap c r) p.2 * F p.1 (circleMap c r p.2)
  have hc : ContinuousOn H (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := by
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, circleMap c r p.2))
        (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (Icc a b ×ˢ Metric.sphere c r) := by
      intro p hp
      exact ⟨hp.1, circleMap_mem_sphere c hr p.2⟩
    have hcomp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 (circleMap c r p.2))
        (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :=
      hF.comp (by fun_prop) hmap
    have hd : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (circleMap c r) p.2) := by
      simp only [deriv_circleMap]
      fun_prop
    exact hd.continuousOn.mul hcomp
  have hi : Integrable H
      ((volume.restrict (Icc a b)).prod (volume.restrict (Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))) := by
    rw [Measure.prod_restrict]
    exact hc.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  constructor
  · rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hab]
    have heq : (fun x => ∮ z in C(c, r), F x z) =
        fun x => ∫ y in Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi), H (x, y) := by
      funext x
      simp only [circleIntegral, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le,
        ← integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, H, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact hi.integral_prod_left
  have hswap := integral_integral_swap (f := fun x θ => H (x, θ)) hi
  simp_rw [circleIntegral, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, ← integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
  trans ∫ θ in Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ∫ x in Icc a b,
    deriv (circleMap c r) θ * F x (circleMap c r θ)
  · simpa only [H, smul_eq_mul] using hswap
  · apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with θ
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_circleIntegral_eq_circleIntegral_integral
statement:
theorem integral_circleIntegral_eq_circleIntegral_integral
    {F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ} {a b r : ℝ} {c : ℂ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) (Icc a b ×ˢ Metric.sphere c r)) :
    (∫ x in a..b, ∮ z in C(c, r), F x z) =
      ∮ z in C(c, r), ∫ x in a..b, F x z
proof:
:=
  (intervalIntegrable_circleIntegral_and_integral_circleIntegral_eq hab hr hF).2

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_and_integral_mul_rpow_le_lpNorm
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_mul_rpow_le_lpNorm
    {M U : Ω → ℝ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s)
    (hM : MemLp M (ENNReal.ofReal s) μ) (hU : Integrable U μ)
    (hMnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ M ω) (hUnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ U ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => M ω * U ω ^ ((s - 1) / s)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, M ω * U ω ^ ((s - 1) / s) ∂μ) ≤
        lpNorm M (ENNReal.ofReal s) μ * (∫ ω, U ω ∂μ) ^ ((s - 1) / s)
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℝ := s / (s - 1)
  let a : ℝ := (s - 1) / s
  let V : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => U ω ^ a
  have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans zero_lt_one hs
  have hsm1 : 0 < s - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hs
  have ht : 0 < t := div_pos hs0 hsm1
  have hat : a * t = 1 := by
    dsimp [a, t]
    field_simp [hs0.ne', hsm1.ne']
  have hit : 1 / t = a := by
    dsimp [a, t]
    field_simp [hs0.ne', hsm1.ne']
  have hst : s.HolderConjugate t :=
    (Real.holderConjugate_iff_eq_conjExponent hs).mpr rfl
  have hVmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable V μ :=
    (hU.aemeasurable.pow_const a).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hVnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ V ω := by
    filter_upwards [hUnn] with ω hω
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg hω a
  have hVpow : (fun ω => V ω ^ t) =ᵐ[μ] U := by
    filter_upwards [hUnn] with ω hω
    dsimp [V]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hω, hat, Real.rpow_one]
  have hV : MemLp V (ENNReal.ofReal t) μ := by
    apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hVmeas (by simp [ht]) (by simp)).mp
    refine hU.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hVnn, hVpow] with ω hω hpow
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ht.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hω, hpow]
  have : ENNReal.HolderTriple (ENNReal.ofReal s) (ENNReal.ofReal t) 1 :=
    hst.ennrealOfReal
  have hProd : Integrable (fun ω => M ω * V ω) μ := hM.integrable_mul hV
  have hMnorm : lpNorm M (ENNReal.ofReal s) μ =
      (∫ ω, M ω ^ s ∂μ) ^ (1 / s) := by
    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by simp [hs0]) (by simp) hM.1,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hs0.le]
    simp only [one_div]
    congr 1
    exact integral_congr_ae (hMnn.mono fun ω hω => by
      change ‖M ω‖ ^ s = M ω ^ s
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hω])
  have hBound := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg hst hMnn hVnn hM hV
  rw [integral_congr_ae hVpow, ← hMnorm, hit] at hBound
  exact ⟨hProd, hBound⟩

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_and_integral_mul_rpow_le_lpNorm_two_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_mul_rpow_le_lpNorm_two_mul
    {M U : Ω → ℝ} (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hM : MemLp M (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ) (hU : Integrable U μ)
    (hMnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ M ω) (hUnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ U ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => M ω * U ω ^ ((2 * (p : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * p))) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, M ω * U ω ^ ((2 * (p : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * p)) ∂μ) ≤
        lpNorm M (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ *
          (∫ ω, U ω ∂μ) ^ ((2 * (p : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * p))
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hp : 1 ≤ p)
  have hcast : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (p : ℝ)) = 2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_mul]
  simpa only [hcast] using
    (integrable_and_integral_mul_rpow_le_lpNorm (by linarith : 1 < 2 * (p : ℝ))
      (hcast.symm ▸ hM) hU hMnn hUnn)

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.continuousIntegral_apply
statement:
private theorem continuousIntegral_apply (μ : Measure K) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : C(K, ℝ)) : continuousIntegral μ f = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  change L1.integralCLM' ℝ (ContinuousMap.toLp 1 μ ℝ f) = _
  rw [← L1.integral_eq' ℝ, L1.integral_eq_integral]
  exact integral_congr_ae (ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (p := 1) μ f)

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.eq_of_integral_pow_eq_of_compact
proof:
:= by
  let Iμ := continuousIntegral μ
  let Iν := continuousIntegral ν
  have hpoly (P : ℝ[X]) :
      Iμ (Polynomial.toContinuousMapOnAlgHom K P) =
        Iν (Polynomial.toContinuousMapOnAlgHom K P) := by
    induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add P Q hP hQ =>
      simp only [map_add, hP, hQ]
    | monomial n a =>
      have heq : Polynomial.toContinuousMapOnAlgHom K (Polynomial.monomial n a) =
          a • (Polynomial.toContinuousMapOnAlgHom K (Polynomial.X ^ n)) := by
        ext x
        simp
      rw [heq, map_smul, map_smul]
      congr 1
      simpa only [Iμ, Iν, continuousIntegral_apply,
        Polynomial.toContinuousMapOnAlgHom_apply, Polynomial.toContinuousMapOn_apply,
        Polynomial.toContinuousMap_apply, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] using hmom n
  have hcont (f : C(K, ℝ)) : Iμ f = Iν f := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed {g : C(K, ℝ) | Iμ g = Iν g} :=
      isClosed_eq Iμ.continuous Iν.continuous
    have hsub : (polynomialFunctions K : Set C(K, ℝ)) ⊆
        {g : C(K, ℝ) | Iμ g = Iν g} := by
      rw [polynomialFunctions_coe]
      rintro _ ⟨P, rfl⟩
      exact hpoly P
    apply closure_minimal hsub hclosed
    change f ∈ (polynomialFunctions K).topologicalClosure
    rw [polynomialFunctions.topologicalClosure]
    trivial
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  simpa only [Iμ, Iν, continuousIntegral_apply,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_toContinuousMap] using hcont f.toContinuousMap

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.eq_of_integral_pow_eq_of_ae_mem_isCompact
statement:
theorem eq_of_integral_pow_eq_of_ae_mem_isCompact {μ ν : Measure ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ K)
    (hmom : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x, x ^ n ∂μ = ∫ x, x ^ n ∂ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace K := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK
  have heq : μ.comap (Subtype.val : K → ℝ) = ν.comap (Subtype.val : K → ℝ) := by
    apply eq_of_integral_pow_eq_of_compact
    intro n
    rw [integral_subtype_comap (μ := μ) hK.measurableSet (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n),
      integral_subtype_comap (μ := ν) hK.measurableSet (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n),
      restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hμ, restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hν]
    exact hmom n
  have h := congrArg (fun ρ : Measure K => ρ.map Subtype.val) heq
  simpa only [map_comap_subtype_coe hK.measurableSet,
    restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hμ, restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hν] using h

name: MeasureTheory.integral_prod_mul_prod_eq_ite
statement:
theorem integral_prod_mul_prod_eq_ite
    {ι κ X : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq κ] [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : ι → Measure X) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
    (φ : ι → κ → X → ℝ) (α β : ι → κ)
    (horth : ∀ i, (∫ x, φ i (α i) x * φ i (β i) x ∂μ i) =
      if α i = β i then 1 else 0) :
    (∫ x, (∏ i, φ i (α i) (x i)) * (∏ i, φ i (β i) (x i)) ∂Measure.pi μ) =
      if α = β then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun i x => φ i (α i) x * φ i (β i) x)]
  simp_rw [horth]
  by_cases h : α = β
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp h
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (if_neg hi)

name: MeasureTheory.sum_sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem sum_sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_of_orthonormal
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [DecidableEq ι] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → Ω → ℝ) {v : Ω → ℝ}
    (hv2 : Integrable (fun x => v x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvφ : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun x => v x * φ i x) μ)
    (hφφ : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, Integrable (fun x => φ i x * φ j x) μ)
    (horth : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s,
      (∫ x, φ i x * φ j x ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (∫ x, v x * φ i x ∂μ) ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x, v x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c (i : ι) := ∫ x, v x * φ i x ∂μ
  let q (x : Ω) := ∑ i ∈ s, c i * φ i x
  have hqφ (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ s) :
      Integrable (fun x => q x * φ j x) μ := by
    simp only [q, sum_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact integrable_finsetSum s (fun i hi => (hφφ i hi j hj).const_mul (c i))
  have hqφeq (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ s) :
      (∫ x, q x * φ j x ∂μ) = c j := by
    simp only [q, sum_mul, mul_assoc]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i hi => (hφφ i hi j hj).const_mul (c i))]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => congrArg (fun a => c i * a) (horth i hi j hj))]
    simp [hj, mul_ite]
  have heq (x : Ω) : q x ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ s, c i * (q x * φ i x) := by
    calc
      q x ^ 2 = q x * (∑ i ∈ s, c i * φ i x) := by change q x ^ 2 = q x * q x; ring
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, q x * (c i * φ i x) := mul_sum ..
      _ = _ := sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  have hq2 : Integrable (fun x => q x ^ 2) μ := by
    simp_rw [heq]
    exact integrable_finsetSum s (fun i hi => (hqφ i hi).const_mul (c i))
  have hq2eq : (∫ x, q x ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ 2 := by
    simp_rw [heq]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i hi => (hqφ i hi).const_mul (c i))]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
    exact sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by rw [hqφeq i hi]; ring)
  have hvq : Integrable (fun x => v x * q x) μ := by
    simp only [q, mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finsetSum s (fun i hi => by
      simpa only [mul_left_comm] using (hvφ i hi).const_mul (c i))
  have hvqeq : (∫ x, v x * q x ∂μ) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ 2 := by
    have h (x : Ω) : v x * q x = ∑ i ∈ s, c i * (v x * φ i x) := by
      simp only [q, mul_sum]
      exact sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    simp_rw [h]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i hi => (hvφ i hi).const_mul (c i))]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
    exact sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by dsimp [c]; ring)
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (v x - q x) ^ 2 ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (v x - q x))
  have he (x : Ω) : (v x - q x) ^ 2 = v x ^ 2 - 2 * (v x * q x) + q x ^ 2 := by ring
  simp_rw [he] at hn
  have hsub : Integrable (fun x => v x ^ 2 - 2 * (v x * q x)) μ :=
    hv2.sub (hvq.const_mul 2)
  rw [integral_add hsub hq2,
    integral_sub hv2 (hvq.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, hvqeq, hq2eq] at hn
  change (∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ 2) ≤ _
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasLaw_prod_of_sections
statement:
theorem hasLaw_prod_of_sections
    {ρ : Measure I} {ν : Measure Ω} {γ : Measure B}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {g : I × Ω → B} (hg : Measurable g)
    (hγ : ∀ i, HasLaw (fun ω => g (i, ω)) γ ν) : HasLaw g γ (ρ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hg.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  ext t ht
  rw [Measure.map_apply hg ht, Measure.prod_apply (hg ht)]
  have he (i : I) : ν ((Prod.mk i) ⁻¹' (g ⁻¹' t)) = γ t := by
    exact (hγ i).measurePreserving (hg.comp measurable_prodMk_left) |>.measure_preimage ht.nullMeasurableSet
  simp_rw [he]
  simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasLaw_prod_of_section_laws
statement:
theorem hasLaw_prod_of_section_laws [Countable I] [MeasurableSingletonClass I]
    {ρ : Measure I} {ν : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {γ : I → Measure B} {g : I × Ω → B} (hg : Measurable g)
    (hγ : ∀ i, HasLaw (fun ω => g (i, ω)) (γ i) ν) :
    HasLaw g (ρ.bind γ) (ρ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hg.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  ext t ht
  rw [Measure.map_apply hg ht, Measure.prod_apply (hg ht),
    Measure.bind_apply ht (measurable_of_countable γ).aemeasurable]
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with i
  exact (hγ i).measurePreserving (hg.comp measurable_prodMk_left) |>.measure_preimage ht.nullMeasurableSet

name: ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_prod_of_sections
statement:
theorem indepFun_prod_of_sections
    {ρ : Measure I} {ν : Measure Ω} {γ : Measure B}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    {f : I × Ω → A} {g : I × Ω → B} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hind : ∀ i, IndepFun (fun ω => f (i, ω)) (fun ω => g (i, ω)) ν)
    (hγ : ∀ i, HasLaw (fun ω => g (i, ω)) γ ν) : IndepFun f g (ρ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepFun_iff_measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul]
  intro s t hs ht
  have hmass (i : I) : ν ((Prod.mk i) ⁻¹' (g ⁻¹' t)) = γ t := by
    exact (hγ i).measurePreserving (hg.comp measurable_prodMk_left) |>.measure_preimage ht.nullMeasurableSet
  have hprod (i : I) : ν ((Prod.mk i) ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' s ∩ g ⁻¹' t)) =
      ν ((Prod.mk i) ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' s)) * γ t := by
    change ν ((fun ω => f (i, ω)) ⁻¹' s ∩ (fun ω => g (i, ω)) ⁻¹' t) = _
    rw [(hind i).measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul s t hs ht]
    have hm := hmass i
    change ν ((fun ω => g (i, ω)) ⁻¹' t) = γ t at hm
    rw [hm]
    rfl
  have hmap := (hasLaw_prod_of_sections (ρ := ρ) hg hγ).map_eq
  have hgt : (ρ.prod ν) (g ⁻¹' t) = γ t := by
    rw [← Measure.map_apply hg ht, hmap]
  rw [Measure.prod_apply ((hf hs).inter (hg ht)), hgt,
    Measure.prod_apply (hf hs)]
  simp_rw [hprod]
  exact lintegral_mul_const' _ _ (measure_ne_top γ t)

name: NLAlib.exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_sSup_of_submodule
statement:
theorem exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_sSup_of_submodule
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (V : Submodule ℝ C(X, ℝ)) (hconst : ∀ r : ℝ, ContinuousMap.const X r ∈ V)
    (cost : C(X, ℝ)) :
    ∃ π : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasure π ∧
      (∀ F : C(X, ℝ), F ∈ V → ∫ x, F x ∂π = ∫ x, F x ∂μ) ∧
      (∫ x, cost x ∂π) =
        sSup ((fun F : C(X, ℝ) => ∫ x, F x ∂μ) '' {F ∈ V | F ≤ cost})
proof:
:= by
  have hI (F : C(X, ℝ)) : Integrable F μ :=
    F.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace F)
  let f : C(X, ℝ) →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ⟨V, { toFun := fun F => ∫ x, F.val x ∂μ
          map_add' := fun F G => integral_add (hI F.val) (hI G.val)
          map_smul' := fun r F => integral_smul r F.val }⟩
  let s : PointedCone ℝ C(X, ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {F | ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x}
      zero_mem' := fun _ => le_rfl
      add_mem' := fun hF hG x => add_nonneg (hF x) (hG x)
      smul_mem' := fun r F hF x => mul_nonneg r.property (hF x) }
  have hpos (F : f.domain) (hF : (F : C(X, ℝ)) ∈ s) :
      0 ≤ f F := integral_nonneg (fun x => hF x)
  have hdense (F : C(X, ℝ)) : ∃ G : f.domain,
      (G : C(X, ℝ)) + F ∈ s := by
    refine ⟨⟨ContinuousMap.const X ‖F‖, hconst ‖F‖⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x
    change 0 ≤ ‖F‖ + F x
    linarith [F.neg_norm_le_apply x]
  obtain ⟨g, hgf, hg, hcost⟩ := exists_extension_nonneg_apply_eq_sSup
    s f cost hpos hdense
  let Λ : C_c(X, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun F => g F.toContinuousMap
      map_add' := fun F G => g.map_add F.toContinuousMap G.toContinuousMap
      map_smul' := fun r F => g.map_smul r F.toContinuousMap
      monotone' := by
        intro F G hFG
        apply sub_nonneg.mp
        rw [← g.map_sub]
        apply hg
        exact fun x => sub_nonneg.mpr (hFG x) }
  let π := RealRMK.rieszMeasure Λ
  have hrepr (F : C(X, ℝ)) : ∫ x, F x ∂π = g F := by
    exact RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure Λ
      (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.continuousMapEquiv F)
  refine ⟨π, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F hF
    exact (hrepr F).trans (hgf ⟨F, hF⟩)
  · rw [hrepr cost, hcost]
    congr 1
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨F.val, ⟨F.property, fun x => sub_nonneg.mp (hF x)⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨F, ⟨hF, hle⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨F, hF⟩, (fun x => sub_nonneg.mpr (hle x)), rfl⟩

name: MeasureTheory.exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {F W : Ω → ℝ}
    (hF : Integrable F μ) (hW : Integrable W μ) (hWnonneg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ W x)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hsc : IsPreconnected s) {D : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hD : ContinuousOn D s)
    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ ξ ∈ s, F x = D ξ * W x) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ s, (∫ x, F x ∂μ) = D ξ * ∫ x, W x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : (∫ x, W x ∂μ) = 0
  · have hWzero := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hWnonneg hW).mp hzero
    have hFzero : F =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hWzero, hpoint] with x hx hp
      obtain ⟨ξ, _, heq⟩ := hp
      simpa [hx] using heq
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := hs
    exact ⟨ξ, hξ, by simp [integral_congr_ae hFzero, hzero]⟩
  let d := (∫ x, F x ∂μ) / ∫ x, W x ∂μ
  have hbudget : (∫ x, F x ∂μ) = ∫ x, d * W x ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    dsimp [d]
    field_simp
  by_contra hnone
  have hne : ∀ ξ ∈ s, D ξ ≠ d := by
    intro ξ hξ heq
    apply hnone
    refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
    rw [heq]
    dsimp [d]
    field_simp
  rcases hsc.mapsTo_Ioi_or_Iio hD hne with hgt | hlt
  · have hle : (fun x => d * W x) ≤ᵐ[μ] F := by
      filter_upwards [hWnonneg, hpoint] with x hx hp
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, heq⟩ := hp
      rw [heq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgt hξ).le hx
    have heq := (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le (hW.const_mul d) hF hle).mp hbudget.symm
    have hWzero : W =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hWnonneg, hpoint, heq] with x hx hp heqx
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hFx⟩ := hp
      have hmul : (D ξ - d) * W x = 0 := by change d * W x = F x at heqx; nlinarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (sub_pos.mpr (hgt hξ)).ne'
    exact hzero (by simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, integral_zero] using integral_congr_ae hWzero)
  · have hle : F ≤ᵐ[μ] (fun x => d * W x) := by
      filter_upwards [hWnonneg, hpoint] with x hx hp
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, heq⟩ := hp
      rw [heq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hlt hξ).le hx
    have heq := (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le hF (hW.const_mul d) hle).mp hbudget
    have hWzero : W =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hWnonneg, hpoint, heq] with x hx hp heqx
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hFx⟩ := hp
      have hmul : (d - D ξ) * W x = 0 := by change F x = d * W x at heqx; nlinarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (sub_pos.mpr (hlt hξ)).ne'
    exact hzero (by simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, integral_zero] using integral_congr_ae hWzero)

name: MeasureTheory.exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise_of_weight_constant_sign
statement:
theorem exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise_of_weight_constant_sign
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {F W : Ω → ℝ}
    (hF : Integrable F μ) (hW : Integrable W μ)
    (hWsign : (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ W x) ∨ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, W x ≤ 0))
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hsc : IsPreconnected s) {D : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hD : ContinuousOn D s) (hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ ξ ∈ s, F x = D ξ * W x) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ s, (∫ x, F x ∂μ) = D ξ * ∫ x, W x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hWsign with hpos | hneg
  · exact exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise hF hW hpos hs hsc hD hpoint
  · obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_eq_mul_integral_of_pointwise hF.neg hW.neg
      (hneg.mono fun x hx => neg_nonneg.mpr hx) hs hsc hD
      (hpoint.mono fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := hx
        exact ⟨ξ, hξ, by simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, mul_neg] using congrArg Neg.neg he⟩)
    exact ⟨ξ, hξ, by simpa only [integral_neg, Pi.neg_apply, mul_neg, neg_inj] using he⟩

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.integrable_exp
statement:
theorem integrable_exp (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t * x)) (ν : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:=
  integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc measurable_id.aemeasurable h.ae_mem_Icc

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.mem_interior_integrableExpSet
statement:
theorem mem_interior_integrableExpSet (t : ℝ) :
    t ∈ interior (integrableExpSet (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν : Measure ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : integrableExpSet (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν : Measure ℝ) = univ := by
    ext s
    simp only [mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact h.integrable_exp s
  simp [heq]

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.measureReal_univ_eq
statement: theorem measureReal_univ_eq : (ν : Measure ℝ).real univ = F 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using h.integral_exp 0

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_eq_integral (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k F t = ∫ x, x ^ k * Real.exp (t * x) ∂(ν : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : F = mgf (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν : Measure ℝ) := by
    funext s
    exact (h.integral_exp s).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact iteratedDeriv_mgf (h.mem_interior_integrableExpSet t) k

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.integrable_pow_mul_exp
statement:
theorem integrable_pow_mul_exp (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ k * Real.exp (t * x)) (ν : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:=
  integrable_pow_mul_exp_of_mem_interior_integrableExpSet
    (h.mem_interior_integrableExpSet t) k

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.iteratedDeriv_even_nonneg
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_even_nonneg (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * r) F t
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral]
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  exact mul_nonneg ((even_two_mul r).pow_nonneg x) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.exp_mul_iteratedDeriv_even_zero_le
statement:
theorem exp_mul_iteratedDeriv_even_zero_le (r : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Real.exp (t * a) * iteratedDeriv (2 * r) F 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * r) F t
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral, h.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral]
  simp only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_mono_ae
    (((h.integrable_pow_mul_exp (2 * r) 0).congr (by simp)).const_mul _)
    (h.integrable_pow_mul_exp (2 * r) t)
  filter_upwards [h.ae_mem_Icc] with x hx
  have hp : 0 ≤ x ^ (2 * r) := (even_two_mul r).pow_nonneg x
  have he : Real.exp (t * a) ≤ Real.exp (t * x) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 ht)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.iteratedDeriv_even_le_exp_mul_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_even_le_exp_mul_zero (r : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    iteratedDeriv (2 * r) F t ≤ Real.exp (t * b) * iteratedDeriv (2 * r) F 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral, h.iteratedDeriv_eq_integral]
  simp only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_mono_ae (h.integrable_pow_mul_exp (2 * r) t)
    (((h.integrable_pow_mul_exp (2 * r) 0).congr (by simp)).const_mul _)
  filter_upwards [h.ae_mem_Icc] with x hx
  have hp : 0 ≤ x ^ (2 * r) := (even_two_mul r).pow_nonneg x
  have he : Real.exp (t * x) ≤ Real.exp (t * b) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 ht)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.analyticAt
statement: theorem analyticAt (t : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ F t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : F = mgf (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν : Measure ℝ) := by
    funext s
    exact (h.integral_exp s).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact analyticAt_mgf (h.mem_interior_integrableExpSet t)

name: NLAlib.IsCompactExpRepresentation.mono
statement:
theorem mono {c d : ℝ} (hca : c ≤ a) (hbd : b ≤ d) :
    IsCompactExpRepresentation ν F c d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, h.integral_exp⟩
  filter_upwards [h.ae_mem_Icc] with x hx
  exact ⟨hca.trans hx.1, hx.2.trans hbd⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_of_tendsto
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot] (a b : ℝ)
    (F : I → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν (F i) a b)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => F i t) l (𝓝 (f t))) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ, IsCompactExpRepresentation ν f a b
proof:
:= by
  have hrep' : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(ν : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc a b) ∧
        ∀ t, (∫ x, Real.exp (t * x) ∂(ν : Measure ℝ)) = F i t := by
    filter_upwards [hrep] with i hi
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hi
    exact ⟨ν, hν.ae_mem_Icc, hν.integral_exp⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hsupp, heq⟩ := exists_finiteMeasure_exp_mul_eq_of_tendsto a b F f hrep' hlim
  exact ⟨ν, hsupp, heq⟩

name: ConcaveOn.condExp_map_le_of_condExp_mem
statement:
theorem _root_.ConcaveOn.condExp_map_le_of_condExp_mem {Ω E : Type*}
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ) [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    {s : Set E} {g : E → ℝ} {f : Ω → E} (hg : ConcaveOn ℝ s g) (hgc : ContinuousOn g s)
    (hfs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω ∈ s) (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hgf : Integrable (fun ω => g (f ω)) μ) (hmean : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, μ[f | m] ω ∈ s) :
    μ[(fun ω => g (f ω)) | m] ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => g (μ[f | m] ω)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (E × ℝ) := {p | p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ≤ g p.1}
  let p : Ω → E × ℝ := fun ω => (f ω, g (f ω))
  have hp : Integrable p μ := hf.prodMk hgf
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, μ[p | m] ω ∈ closure S :=
    hg.convex_hypograph.closure.condExp_mem hm hp isClosed_closure
      (hfs.mono fun ω hω => subset_closure ⟨hω, le_rfl⟩)
  have hfst := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).comp_condExp_comm (m := m) hp
  have hsnd := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E ℝ).comp_condExp_comm (m := m) hp
  filter_upwards [hmem, hfst, hsnd, hmean] with ω hω h₁ h₂ hmean
  change (μ[p | m] ω).1 = μ[f | m] ω at h₁
  change (μ[p | m] ω).2 = μ[(fun ω => g (f ω)) | m] ω at h₂
  have heq : μ[p | m] ω = (μ[f | m] ω, μ[(fun ω => g (f ω)) | m] ω) := Prod.ext h₁ h₂
  rw [heq] at hω
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hω
  have hglim : Tendsto (fun n => g (u n).1) atTop (𝓝 (g (μ[f | m] ω))) :=
    (hgc _ hmean).tendsto.comp (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
      ⟨(continuous_fst.tendsto _).comp hlim, Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).1⟩)
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' ((continuous_snd.tendsto _).comp hlim) hglim (fun n => (hu n).2)

name: MeasureTheory.integral_comp_finite_eq_sum
statement:
theorem integral_comp_finite_eq_sum (cell : Ω → ι) (hcell : Measurable cell) (g : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, g (cell ω) ∂μ) = ∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) * g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_map hcell.aemeasurable (Integrable.of_finite (f := g)).aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_fintype Integrable.of_finite]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_measureReal_apply hcell (measurableSet_singleton i), smul_eq_mul]

name: MeasureTheory.exists_condExp_finitePartitionMean_factor
statement:
theorem exists_condExp_finitePartitionMean_factor
    (cell : Ω → ι) (hcell : Measurable cell) {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    ∃ g : ι → E,
      μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell ‹MeasurableSpace ι›] = g ∘ cell ∧
        ∀ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) ≠ 0 → finitePartitionMean μ cell f i = g i
proof:
:= by
  have hm : MeasurableSpace.comap cell ‹MeasurableSpace ι› ≤ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω› := hcell.comap_le
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ :=
    (stronglyMeasurable_condExp (μ := μ) (f := f)
      (m := MeasurableSpace.comap cell ‹MeasurableSpace ι›)).exists_eq_measurable_comp
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hsi : MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap cell ‹MeasurableSpace ι›] (cell ⁻¹' {i}) :=
    ⟨{i}, measurableSet_singleton i, rfl⟩
  have hconst : (∫ ω in cell ⁻¹' {i},
      μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell ‹MeasurableSpace ι›] ω ∂μ) =
      μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) • g i := by
    rw [hg]
    calc
      _ = ∫ _ω in cell ⁻¹' {i}, g i ∂μ := by
        apply setIntegral_congr_fun (hm _ hsi)
        intro ω hω
        change g (cell ω) = g i
        rw [show cell ω = i from hω]
      _ = _ := setIntegral_const _
  have hset := setIntegral_condExp hm hf hsi
  rw [hconst] at hset
  dsimp [finitePartitionMean]
  rw [← hset, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hi, one_smul]

name: MeasureTheory.sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_eq_integral_condExp
statement:
theorem sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_eq_integral_condExp
    (cell : Ω → ι) (hcell : Measurable cell) {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ) (q : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) * ‖finitePartitionMean μ cell f i‖ ^ q) =
      ∫ ω, ‖μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell ‹MeasurableSpace ι›] ω‖ ^ q ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hmean⟩ := exists_condExp_finitePartitionMean_factor cell hcell hf
  rw [hg]
  change _ = ∫ ω, (fun i => ‖g i‖ ^ q) (cell ω) ∂μ
  rw [integral_comp_finite_eq_sum (μ := μ) cell hcell (fun i => ‖g i‖ ^ q)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) = 0
  · rw [hi, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  · rw [hmean i hi]

name: MeasureTheory.sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_le_integral
statement:
theorem sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_le_integral
    (cell : Ω → ι) (hcell : Measurable cell) {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hfm : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ q) μ) :
    (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) * ‖finitePartitionMean μ cell f i‖ ^ q) ≤
      ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ q ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_eq_integral_condExp cell hcell hf]
  exact integral_norm_condExp_rpow_le hq hfm

name: MeasureTheory.finitePartitionMean_comp_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem finitePartitionMean_comp_continuousLinearMap
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (cell : Ω → ι) {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ) (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (i : ι) :
    finitePartitionMean μ cell (T ∘ f) i = T (finitePartitionMean μ cell f i)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [finitePartitionMean]
  rw [T.integral_comp_comm hf.restrict, map_smul]

name: NLAlib.differentiableAt_integral_of_contDiffOn_compact_support
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_integral_of_contDiffOn_compact_support
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    (F : X × Ω → E) (U : Set (X × Ω)) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U) (x₀ : X)
    (hpoint : ∀ a ∈ μ.support, (x₀, a) ∈ U) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => ∫ a, F (x, a) ∂μ) x₀
proof:
:= by
  let D : X → Ω → X →L[ℝ] E := fun x a =>
    (fderiv ℝ F (x, a)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ X Ω)
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : X × Ω => D p.1 p.2) U := by
    change ContinuousOn (fun p : X × Ω =>
      (fderiv ℝ F p).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ X Ω)) U
    exact (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_comp continuousOn_const
  have hd (p : X × Ω) (hp : p ∈ U) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun x => F (x, p.2)) (D p.1 p.2) p.1 := by
    have hjoint := ((hF.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero).hasFDerivAt
    have hpair : HasFDerivAt (fun x : X => (x, p.2))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ X Ω) p.1 := by
      convert (hasFDerivAt_id p.1).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const p.2 p.1) using 1 <;> rfl
    exact hjoint.comp p.1 hpair
  exact (hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support μ hμ
    (fun x a => F (x, a)) D U hU hF.continuousOn hD hd x₀ hpoint).differentiableAt

name: MeasureTheory.continuousOn_integral_of_continuousOn_compact_support
statement:
theorem continuousOn_integral_of_continuousOn_compact_support
    {X Ω E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [FirstCountableTopology X]
    [TopologicalSpace Ω] [T2Space Ω] [SecondCountableTopology Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [BorelSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) {F : X → Ω → E}
    (hF : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) (K ×ˢ μ.support)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x => ∫ y, F x y ∂μ) K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hK.prod hμ).bddAbove_image hF.norm
  have hre : μ.restrict μ.support = μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
  apply continuousOn_of_dominated (bound := fun _ => C)
  · intro x hx
    have hs : ContinuousOn (F x) μ.support :=
      hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hy⟩)
    have hm := hs.aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact (μ := μ) hμ hμ.measurableSet
    rwa [hre] at hm
  · intro x hx
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with y hy
    exact hC ⟨(x, y), ⟨hx, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact integrable_const C
  · filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with y hy
    exact hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hy⟩)

name: Measurable.finSnoc
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem Measurable.finSnoc {α R : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace R] {i : ℕ}
    {f : α → Fin i → R} {g : α → R} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) :
    Measurable fun a => (Fin.snoc (f a) (g a) : Fin (i + 1) → R)
proof:
:= by
  refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => ?_
  induction j using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simpa only [Fin.snoc_last] using hg
  | cast j =>
    simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
    exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp hf

name: MeasureTheory.PositiveMatrixMeasure.re_entry_transpose
statement:
theorem re_entry_transpose (P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n) (i j : n) :
    ComplexMeasure.re (P.entry j i) = ComplexMeasure.re (P.entry i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply VectorMeasure.ext
  intro E hE
  change (P E j i).re = (P E i j).re
  simpa only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] using
    congrArg Complex.re ((P.isHermitian E hE).apply i j)

name: MeasureTheory.PositiveMatrixMeasure.im_entry_transpose
statement:
theorem im_entry_transpose (P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n) (i j : n) :
    ComplexMeasure.im (P.entry j i) = -ComplexMeasure.im (P.entry i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply VectorMeasure.ext
  intro E hE
  change (P E j i).im = -(P E i j).im
  have h := congrArg Complex.im ((P.isHermitian E hE).apply i j)
  simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] at h
  linarith

name: MeasureTheory.PositiveMatrixMeasure.eq_of_entryStieltjesTransform_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_entryStieltjesTransform_eq
    (P Q : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n)
    (h : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ∀ i j : n,
      P.entryStieltjesTransform z i j = Q.entryStieltjesTransform z i j) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  have hre (i j : n) : ComplexMeasure.re (P.entry i j) = ComplexMeasure.re (Q.entry i j) := by
    apply SignedMeasure.eq_of_stieltjesTransform_eq
    intro z hz
    have hij := h z hz i j
    have hji := h z hz j i
    rw [entryStieltjesTransform, entryStieltjesTransform] at hij
    rw [entryStieltjesTransform, entryStieltjesTransform, re_entry_transpose P i j,
      re_entry_transpose Q i j, im_entry_transpose P i j, im_entry_transpose Q i j,
      SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_neg, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_neg] at hji
    linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * hij + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * hji
  have him (i j : n) : ComplexMeasure.im (P.entry i j) = ComplexMeasure.im (Q.entry i j) := by
    apply SignedMeasure.eq_of_stieltjesTransform_eq
    intro z hz
    have hij := h z hz i j
    have hji := h z hz j i
    rw [entryStieltjesTransform, entryStieltjesTransform] at hij
    rw [entryStieltjesTransform, entryStieltjesTransform, re_entry_transpose P i j,
      re_entry_transpose Q i j, im_entry_transpose P i j, im_entry_transpose Q i j,
      SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_neg, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_neg] at hji
    have hd : (2 * Complex.I) * (ComplexMeasure.im (P.entry i j)).stieltjesTransform z =
        (2 * Complex.I) * (ComplexMeasure.im (Q.entry i j)).stieltjesTransform z := by
      linear_combination hij - hji
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Complex.I_ne_zero) hd
  have hv : P.toVectorMeasure = Q.toVectorMeasure := by
    apply VectorMeasure.ext
    intro E _
    ext i j
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact congrArg (fun s : SignedMeasure ℝ => s E) (hre i j)
    · exact congrArg (fun s : SignedMeasure ℝ => s E) (him i j)
  cases P
  cases Q
  cases hv
  rfl

name: MvPolynomial.ae_eval_ne_zero_fin
statement:
private theorem ae_eval_ne_zero_fin (μ : Measure ℝ) [SigmaFinite μ]
    [NullSingletonClass μ] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), f ≠ 0 →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ), MvPolynomial.eval x f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => hf ?_
    apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro y
    have : y = x := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst this
    simpa using hx
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f hf
    set g := MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv ℝ n f with hg
    have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hf
      exact (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv ℝ n).injective (by rw [← hg, h, map_zero])
    have hc : g.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hg0
    have hih := ih g.leadingCoeff hc
    rw [ae_iff]
    simp only [ne_eq, not_not]
    have hmp := measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => μ) 0
    let T : Set (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) :=
      {q | MvPolynomial.eval (Fin.cons q.1 q.2 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) f = 0}
    have hT : MeasurableSet T := by
      have hcont : Continuous fun q : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) =>
          MvPolynomial.eval (Fin.cons q.1 q.2 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) f := by
        apply (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval f).comp
        refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · simpa using continuous_fst
        · simp only [Fin.cons_succ]; exact (continuous_apply j).comp continuous_snd
      exact hcont.measurable (measurableSet_singleton 0)
    have hpre : MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0 ⁻¹' T =
        {x | MvPolynomial.eval x f = 0} := by
      ext x
      have hx : (Fin.cons (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0 x).1
          (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0 x).2 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) = x := by
        ext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply]
        · simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply, Fin.tail]
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, T, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      rw [hx]
    rw [← hpre, hmp.measure_preimage hT.nullMeasurableSet, Measure.prod_apply_symm hT]
    refine (lintegral_congr_ae ?_).trans lintegral_zero
    filter_upwards [hih] with s hs
    have hpoly : Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval s) g ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hs
      have := congrArg (fun q => Polynomial.coeff q g.natDegree) h0
      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hfin : ((fun y => (y, s)) ⁻¹' T).Finite := by
      refine (Polynomial.roots
        (Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval s) g)).toFinset.finite_toSet.subset ?_
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, T, MvPolynomial.eval_eq_eval_mv_eval']
        at hy
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hpoly,
        Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
      exact hy
    simpa using hfin.measure_zero μ

name: MvPolynomial.ae_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ae_eval_ne_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : Measure ℝ)
    [SigmaFinite μ] [NullSingletonClass μ] (f : MvPolynomial ι ℝ) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => μ), MvPolynomial.eval x f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι) := Fintype.equivFin ι
  have hg : MvPolynomial.rename e f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hf
    exact MvPolynomial.rename_injective e e.injective (by rw [h, map_zero])
  have h := ae_eval_ne_zero_fin μ _ _ hg
  let T : (Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) := fun y i => y (e i)
  have hT : Measurable T := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => measurable_pi_apply _
  have hmap : Measure.map T (Measure.pi fun _ => μ) = Measure.pi fun _ : ι => μ := by
    symm
    refine Measure.pi_eq fun s hs => ?_
    rw [Measure.map_apply hT (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs)]
    have hpre : T ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi s = Set.univ.pi fun k => s (e.symm k) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, T]
      constructor
      · intro hy k; simpa using hy (e.symm k)
      · intro hy i; simpa using hy (e i)
    rw [hpre, Measure.pi_pi]
    exact Fintype.prod_equiv e.symm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {x : ι → ℝ | MvPolynomial.eval x f ≠ 0} :=
    ((MvPolynomial.continuous_eval f).measurable (measurableSet_singleton 0)).compl
  rw [← hmap, ae_map_iff hT.aemeasurable hmeas]
  filter_upwards [h] with y hy
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_rename] at hy
  exact hy

name: MvPolynomial.volume_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem volume_eval_eq_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : MvPolynomial ι ℝ)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) : volume {x : ι → ℝ | eval x f = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := ae_eval_ne_zero volume f hf
  simpa only [ae_iff, not_not, MeasureTheory.volume_pi] using h

name: MeasureTheory.condExp_family_le_family_condExp_of_exponential_comparison
statement:
theorem condExp_family_le_family_condExp_of_exponential_comparison
    {Ω E P : Type*} {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MetricSpace P] [MeasurableSpace P] [BorelSpace P] [SecondCountableTopology P] [Nonempty P]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ) [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    {s : Set E} {g : P → E → ℝ} {f : Ω → E} {U : Ω → P}
    (hconc : ∀ p, ConcaveOn ℝ s (g p)) (hcont : ∀ p, ContinuousOn (g p) s)
    (hcomp : ∀ p q, ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → dist p q ≤ δ → g p x ≤ Real.exp δ * g q x)
    (hfs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω ∈ s) (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hfixed : ∀ p, Integrable (fun ω => g p (f ω)) μ)
    (hactual : Integrable (fun ω => g (U ω) (f ω)) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, μ[f | m] ω ∈ s) (hU : Measurable[m] U) :
    μ[(fun ω => g (U ω) (f ω)) | m] ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω)
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → P := denseSeq P
  let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k
  have hδ : ∀ k, 0 < δ k := fun k => by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hJ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ j : ℕ,
      μ[(fun ω => g (u j) (f ω)) | m] ω ≤ g (u j) (μ[f | m] ω) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun j => ConcaveOn.condExp_map_le_of_condExp_mem hm
      (hconc (u j)) (hcont (u j)) hfs hf (hfixed (u j)) hmean
  have hcuts : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ e : ℕ × ℕ, dist (U ω) (u e.1) < δ e.2 →
      μ[(fun ω => g (U ω) (f ω)) | m] ω ≤
        Real.exp (δ e.2) * μ[(fun ω => g (u e.1) (f ω)) | m] ω := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro e
    let C : Set Ω := {ω | dist (U ω) (u e.1) < δ e.2}
    have hconst : Measurable[m] (fun _ : Ω => u e.1) := measurable_const
    have hδconst : Measurable[m] (fun _ : Ω => δ e.2) := measurable_const
    have hC : MeasurableSet[m] C := by
      let : MeasurableSpace Ω := m
      exact measurableSet_lt (hU.dist hconst) hδconst
    have hpoint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ C → g (U ω) (f ω) ≤ Real.exp (δ e.2) * g (u e.1) (f ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hfs] with ω hω
      intro hωC
      exact hcomp _ _ _ hω _ (hδ e.2).le (le_of_lt hωC)
    have hc := ae_condExp_le_condExp_on_of_ae_le_on hm hactual
      ((hfixed (u e.1)).const_mul (Real.exp (δ e.2))) hC hpoint
    filter_upwards [hc, condExp_smul (Real.exp (δ e.2)) (fun ω => g (u e.1) (f ω)) m]
      with ω hω hscale
    intro hnear
    have hh := hω hnear
    have hs : μ[(fun ω => Real.exp (δ e.2) * g (u e.1) (f ω)) | m] ω =
        Real.exp (δ e.2) * μ[(fun ω => g (u e.1) (f ω)) | m] ω := by
      change μ[(fun ω => Real.exp (δ e.2) • g (u e.1) (f ω)) | m] ω =
        Real.exp (δ e.2) • μ[(fun ω => g (u e.1) (f ω)) | m] ω at hscale
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hscale
    rw [hs] at hh
    exact hh
  filter_upwards [hJ, hcuts, hmean] with ω hJω hcutsω hmeanω
  have hbound : ∀ k : ℕ, μ[(fun ω => g (U ω) (f ω)) | m] ω ≤
      Real.exp (2 * δ k) * g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (denseRange_denseSeq P).exists_dist_lt (U ω) (hδ k)
    have hfirst := hcutsω (j, k) hj
    have hreverse := hcomp (u j) (U ω) _ hmeanω (δ k) (hδ k).le
      (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hj.le)
    calc μ[(fun ω => g (U ω) (f ω)) | m] ω ≤
          Real.exp (δ k) * μ[(fun ω => g (u j) (f ω)) | m] ω := hfirst
      _ ≤ Real.exp (δ k) * g (u j) (μ[f | m] ω) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hJω j) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ ≤ Real.exp (δ k) * (Real.exp (δ k) * g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreverse (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (2 * δ k) * g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
  have hδlim : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one (by norm_num : |(1 / 2 : ℝ)| < 1)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k => Real.exp (2 * δ k) * g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω)) atTop
      (𝓝 (g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω))) := by
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun k => 2 * δ k) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using hδlim.const_mul 2
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] using
      ((Real.continuous_exp.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp htwo).mul_const (g (U ω) (μ[f | m] ω))
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' tendsto_const_nhds hlim hbound

name: MeasureTheory.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_resolventPowerMean_of_first
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_resolventPowerMean_of_first
    (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (Ω i)) [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : (i : ι) → Ω i → selfAdjoint (B i))
    (hX : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (X i) (μ i))
    (L : (i : ι) → B i →L[ℂ] E) (a : selfAdjoint A₀) (L₀ : A₀ →L[ℂ] E)
    (p : Filter ι)
    (hfirst : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun i => resolventPowerMean (μ i) (X i) (L i) 1)
      (fun z : ℂ => L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) z)) p {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (k : ℕ) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun i => resolventPowerMean (μ i) (X i) (L i) (k+1))
      (fun z : ℂ => L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) z^(k+1))) p {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa only [zero_add,pow_one] using hfirst
  | succ k ih =>
    let c : ℂ := -((k+1 : ℕ) : ℂ)
    have hc : c≠0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero k))
    have hd := ih.deriv (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun i =>
      differentiableOn_resolventPowerMean (X i) (hX i) (L i) (k+1))
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im)
    have hs := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℂ ℂ (E := E) c⁻¹).uniformContinuous.comp_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn hd
    refine (hs.congr fun i z hz => ?_).congr_right fun z hz => ?_
    · change c⁻¹•deriv (resolventPowerMean (μ i) (X i) (L i) (k+1)) z=
        resolventPowerMean (μ i) (X i) (L i) (k+1+1) z
      rw [(hasDerivAt_resolventPowerMean (X i) (hX i) (L i) (ne_of_gt hz) (k+1)).deriv]
      exact inv_smul_smul₀ hc _
    · change c⁻¹•deriv (fun w : ℂ => L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) w^(k+1))) z=
        L₀ (resolvent (a : A₀) z^(k+1+1))
      rw [(hasDerivAt_linearMap_resolvent_pow L₀ a (ne_of_gt hz) (k+1)).deriv]
      exact inv_smul_smul₀ hc _

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_norm_add_sum_smul
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_add_sum_smul {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ) (z : E) (a : ι → E) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖z + ∑ i, X i ω • a i‖) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖) := by fun_prop
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => fun i => X i ω) μ :=
    aemeasurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => (hX i).aemeasurable
  have hi := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hX i).norm.mul_const ‖a i‖
  refine ((integrable_const ‖z‖).add hi).mono'
    (hc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hm).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  change |‖z + ∑ i, X i ω • a i‖| ≤ ‖z‖ + ∑ i, ‖X i ω‖ * ‖a i‖
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
  simpa only [norm_smul] using norm_sum_le Finset.univ (fun i => X i ω • a i)

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_norm_add_sum_smul_pi
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_add_sum_smul_pi {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (ν : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν i)) (z : E) (a : ι → E) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:=
  integrable_norm_add_sum_smul (fun i => integrable_eval (hν i)) z a

name: MeasureTheory.integral_fin_succ_norm_sum
statement:
private theorem integral_fin_succ_norm_sum (n : ℕ)
    (ν : Fin (n + 1) → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν i)) (z : E) (a : Fin (n + 1) → E) :
    (∫ x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi ν) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ‖(z + t • a 0) + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ‖
        ∂Measure.pi (fun i => ν i.succ) ∂ν 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove ν 0).symm
  have hF := integrable_norm_add_sum_smul_pi ν hν z a
  have hi := e.integrable_comp_of_integrable hF
  have he := e.integral_comp' (fun x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ => ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖)
  simp only [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.insertNth_zero, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.cons_succ,
    Fin.zero_succAbove, Fin.cons_zero, Function.comp_def, cast_eq, ← add_assoc] at hi he
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, ← add_assoc]
  rw [← he, integral_prod _ hi]

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_norm_mixed_fin_series
statement:
private theorem integrable_norm_mixed_fin_series (n : ℕ)
    (ν : Measure ℝ) (η : Fin n → Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (η i)]
    (hν : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) ν) (hη : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (η i))
    (z : E) (a : Fin (n + 1) → E) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) =>
      ‖(z + p.1 • a 0) + ∑ i, p.2 i • a i.succ‖) (ν.prod (Measure.pi η))
proof:
:= by
  let X : Fin (n + 1) → (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) → ℝ :=
    Fin.cases (fun p => p.1) (fun i p => p.2 i)
  have hX : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) (ν.prod (Measure.pi η)) := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_)
    · exact hν.comp_fst _
    · exact (integrable_eval (hη i)).comp_snd _
  have hi := integrable_norm_add_sum_smul hX z a
  simpa [X, Fin.sum_univ_succ, ← add_assoc] using hi

name: MeasureTheory.integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le_fin
statement:
private theorem integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le_fin (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (ν η : Fin n → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
      [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (η i)]
      (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν i))
      (hη : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (η i)) (a : Fin n → E),
      (∀ i z, (∫ t : ℝ, ‖z + t • a i‖ ∂ν i) ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, ‖z + t • a i‖ ∂η i) →
      ∀ z, (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi η
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro ν η _ _ hν hη a hstep z
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro ν η _ _ hν hη a hstep z
    have hνν := integrable_norm_mixed_fin_series n (ν 0) (fun i => ν i.succ)
      (hν 0) (fun i => hν i.succ) z a
    have hνη := integrable_norm_mixed_fin_series n (ν 0) (fun i => η i.succ)
      (hν 0) (fun i => hη i.succ) z a
    have hηη := integrable_norm_mixed_fin_series n (η 0) (fun i => η i.succ)
      (hη 0) (fun i => hη i.succ) z a
    calc
      _ = ∫ t : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ‖(z + t • a 0) + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ‖
          ∂Measure.pi (fun i => ν i.succ) ∂ν 0 := integral_fin_succ_norm_sum n ν hν z a
      _ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ‖(z + t • a 0) + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ‖
          ∂Measure.pi (fun i => η i.succ) ∂ν 0 := by
        apply integral_mono hνν.integral_prod_left hνη.integral_prod_left
        intro t
        exact ih (fun i => ν i.succ) (fun i => η i.succ) (fun i => hν i.succ)
          (fun i => hη i.succ) (fun i => a i.succ) (fun i => hstep i.succ) (z + t • a 0)
      _ = ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ, ‖(z + t • a 0) + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ‖
          ∂ν 0 ∂Measure.pi (fun i => η i.succ) := integral_integral_swap hνη
      _ ≤ ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ, ‖(z + t • a 0) + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ‖
          ∂η 0 ∂Measure.pi (fun i => η i.succ) := by
        apply integral_mono hνη.integral_prod_right hηη.integral_prod_right
        intro x
        have h := hstep 0 (z + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ)
        simpa only [add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using h
      _ = ∫ t : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ‖(z + t • a 0) + ∑ i, x i • a i.succ‖
          ∂Measure.pi (fun i => η i.succ) ∂η 0 := (integral_integral_swap hηη).symm
      _ = _ := (integral_fin_succ_norm_sum n η hη z a).symm

name: MeasureTheory.integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (ν η : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (η i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν i))
    (hη : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (η i)) (a : ι → E)
    (hstep : ∀ i z, (∫ t : ℝ, ‖z + t • a i‖ ∂ν i) ≤
      ∫ t : ℝ, ‖z + t • a i‖ ∂η i) (z : E) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫ x : ι → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi η
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  rw [← (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft ν e).integral_comp',
    ← (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft η e).integral_comp']
  simp only [MeasurableEquiv.coe_piCongrLeft, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
  simp_rw [← e.sum_comp]
  simp only [Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
  exact integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le_fin _ (fun i => ν (e i)) (fun i => η (e i))
    (fun i => hν (e i)) (fun i => hη (e i)) (fun i => a (e i)) (fun i => hstep (e i)) z

name: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_le_of_finite_condExp_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_le_of_finite_condExp_le
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpt : p ≠ ∞)
    {f : Ω → E} (hf : MemLp f p μ) (C : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hC : ∀ (k : ℕ) (cell : Ω → Fin k), Measurable cell →
      eLpNorm (μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) p μ ≤ C) :
    eLpNorm f p μ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  borelize E
  apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε _
  have hehalf : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < ((ε / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := by exact_mod_cast (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨g, happrox, hg⟩ := hf.exists_simpleFunc_eLpNorm_sub_lt hpt hehalf.ne'
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (↥g.range)
  let cell : Ω → Fin (Fintype.card ↥g.range) := fun ω => e ⟨g ω, g.mem_range_self ω⟩
  have hcell : Measurable cell :=
    (measurable_of_finite e).comp (g.measurable.subtype_mk (h := fun ω => g.mem_range_self ω))
  have hcellm : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance] cell := by
    intro s hs
    exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  have hval : StronglyMeasurable (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card ↥g.range) =>
      ((e.symm i : ↥g.range) : E)) := .of_discrete
  have hgsm : StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance] (g : Ω → E) := by
    convert hval.comp_measurable hcellm using 1
    ext ω
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, cell, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hfi := hf.integrable hp
  have hgi := hg.integrable hp
  have hces := condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable hcell.comap_le hgsm hgi
  have hcdiff := condExp_sub hgi hfi (MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance)
  rw [hces] at hcdiff
  have hdiff : eLpNorm ((g : Ω → E) - μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) p μ ≤
      eLpNorm (f - (g : Ω → E)) p μ := by
    calc
      _ = eLpNorm (μ[(g : Ω → E) - f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) p μ :=
        eLpNorm_congr_ae hcdiff.symm
      _ ≤ eLpNorm ((g : Ω → E) - f) p μ := eLpNorm_condExp_le_eLpNorm _ hp
      _ = _ := eLpNorm_sub_comm _ _ _ _
  have hce : AEStronglyMeasurable (μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) μ :=
    integrable_condExp.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hgnorm : eLpNorm (g : Ω → E) p μ ≤ eLpNorm (f - (g : Ω → E)) p μ + C := by
    calc
      _ = eLpNorm (((g : Ω → E) - μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) +
          μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) p μ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
      _ ≤ eLpNorm ((g : Ω → E) - μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) p μ +
          eLpNorm (μ[f | MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance]) p μ :=
        eLpNorm_add_le (hg.aestronglyMeasurable.sub hce) hce hp
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hdiff (hC _ cell hcell)
  calc
    _ = eLpNorm ((f - (g : Ω → E)) + (g : Ω → E)) p μ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (f - (g : Ω → E)) p μ + eLpNorm (g : Ω → E) p μ :=
      eLpNorm_add_le (hf.aestronglyMeasurable.sub hg.aestronglyMeasurable) hg.aestronglyMeasurable hp
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (f - (g : Ω → E)) p μ + (eLpNorm (f - (g : Ω → E)) p μ + C) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl hgnorm
    _ ≤ ((ε / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) + (((ε / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) + C) := by
      gcongr
    _ = C + ε := by
      rw [← add_assoc, ← ENNReal.coe_add, add_halves, add_comm]

name: MeasureTheory.integral_norm_rpow_root_le_of_finitePartitionMean_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_rpow_root_le_of_finitePartitionMean_le
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    {f : Ω → E} (hf : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hfinite : ∀ (k : ℕ) (cell : Ω → Fin k), Measurable cell →
      (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) * ‖finitePartitionMean μ cell f i‖ ^ q) ^ q⁻¹ ≤ C) :
    (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ q ∂μ) ^ q⁻¹ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := le_trans zero_le_one hq
  have hqp : 1 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q := by simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hq
  have hqne : ENNReal.ofReal q ≠ 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hq)
  have h := eLpNorm_le_of_finite_condExp_le hqp ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hf (ENNReal.ofReal C) ?_
  · rw [hf.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm hqne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top] at h
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hq0] at h
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hC).mp h
  · intro k cell hcell
    have hmem := MemLp.condExp (m := MeasurableSpace.comap cell inferInstance) hqp hf
    rw [hmem.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm hqne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hq0]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [← sum_mul_norm_finitePartitionMean_rpow_eq_integral_condExp cell hcell (hf.integrable hqp)]
    exact hfinite k cell hcell

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_le_of_wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact
statement:
theorem integral_sub_le_of_wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact
    (μ ν : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ K)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hW : wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C)
    {f : X → ℝ} (hf : LipschitzOnWith 1 f K) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hfg⟩ := hf.extend_real
  have hi (m : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure m] (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ K) : Integrable g m := by
    have hh := hg.continuous.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := m) hK
    rwa [IntegrableOn, Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hm] at hh
  have hh := (enorm_integral_sub_le_wassersteinEDistOne hg (hi μ hμ) (hi ν hν)).trans hW
  rw [← ofReal_norm] at hh
  have hn := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hC).mp hh
  have hEq (m : Measure X) (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ K) :
      (∫ x, f x ∂m) = ∫ x, g x ∂m :=
    integral_congr_ae (hm.mono fun x hx => hfg hx)
  rw [hEq μ hμ, hEq ν hν]
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hn)

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_add_of_ae_mem_compact
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_add_of_ae_mem_compact
    (μ ν ξ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ξ] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ K) (hξ : ∀ᵐ x ∂ξ, x ∈ K)
    {C D : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hμν : wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C)
    (hνξ : wassersteinEDistOne ν ξ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ξ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C+D)
proof:
:= by
  apply wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact_of_lipschitzOn_integral_sub_le
    μ ξ hK hμ hξ (C+D)
  intro f hf
  have h1 := integral_sub_le_of_wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact
    μ ν hK hμ hν hC hμν hf
  have h2 := integral_sub_le_of_wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact
    ν ξ hK hν hξ hD hνξ hf
  linarith

name: MeasureTheory.measurable_integral_update_pi

  exact (StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'

name: MeasureTheory.card_smul_integral_uniform_prod
statement:
theorem card_smul_integral_uniform_prod (μ : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ]
    (f : ι → Ω → F)
    (hf : Integrable (fun p : ι × Ω => f p.1 p.2)
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod μ)) :
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) •
        (∫ p : ι × Ω, f p.1 p.2 ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod μ) =
      ∫ ω, ∑ i, f i ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ hf, ← integral_smul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
    change (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) •
      (∫ i, f i ω ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure) = ∑ i, f i ω
    rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum]
    simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
