      ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ← Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]

name: MeasureTheory.card_smul_integral_uniform_prod_prod
statement:
theorem card_smul_integral_uniform_prod_prod
    (μ : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ] (γ : Measure Z) [SFinite γ]
    (f : ι → Ω → Z → F)
    (hf : Integrable (fun q : (ι × Ω) × Z => f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)
      (((PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod μ).prod γ)) :
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) •
        (∫ q : (ι × Ω) × Z, f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2
          ∂((PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod μ).prod γ) =
      ∫ q : Ω × Z, ∑ i, f i q.1 q.2 ∂μ.prod γ
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure
  let g : ι × (Ω × Z) → F := fun p => f p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  have hm := measurePreserving_prodAssoc ρ μ γ
  have hg : Integrable g (ρ.prod (μ.prod γ)) :=
    (hm.integrable_comp_emb MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.measurableEmbedding).mp hf
  have he : (∫ q : (ι × Ω) × Z, f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2 ∂(ρ.prod μ).prod γ) =
      ∫ p, g p ∂ρ.prod (μ.prod γ) := hm.integral_comp' g
  rw [he]
  exact card_smul_integral_uniform_prod (μ.prod γ) (fun i p => f i p.1 p.2) hg

name: MeasureTheory.lpNorm_le_add_of_uniform_approximation
statement:
theorem MeasureTheory.lpNorm_le_add_of_uniform_approximation {f g : Ω → ℝ}
    {p : ENNReal} (hg : MemLp g p μ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp_top : p ≠ ⊤)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ δ) :
    lpNorm f p μ ≤ lpNorm g p μ + δ
proof:
:= by
  have hp_zero : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have herror : lpNorm (f - g) p μ ≤ δ := by
    have h := lpNorm_mono_real (memLp_const δ : MemLp (fun _ : Ω => δ) p μ)
      (f := f - g) (fun x => by simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hfg x)
    simpa only [lpNorm_const' hp_zero hp_top, probReal_univ, Real.one_rpow,
      mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hδ] using h
  exact (lpNorm_le_lpNorm_add_lpNorm_sub' hg hp).trans (add_le_add le_rfl herror)

name: MeasureTheory.Integrable.sqrt_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem Integrable.sqrt_mul_sqrt {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hf0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (hg0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ g ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Real.sqrt (f ω) * Real.sqrt (g ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hfs : MemLp (fun ω => Real.sqrt (f ω)) 2 μ := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable)).2
    simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (hf0 _)] using hf
  have hgs : MemLp (fun ω => Real.sqrt (g ω)) 2 μ := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable)).2
    simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (hg0 _)] using hg
  exact hfs.integrable_mul hgs

name: MeasureTheory.integral_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem integral_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hf0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (hg0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ g ω) :
    (∫ ω, Real.sqrt (f ω) * Real.sqrt (g ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) * ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfs : MemLp (fun ω => Real.sqrt (f ω)) 2 μ := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable)).2
    simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (hf0 _)] using hf
  have hgs : MemLp (fun ω => Real.sqrt (g ω)) 2 μ := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable)).2
    simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (hg0 _)] using hg
  have hcs := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
    (show (2 : ℝ).HolderConjugate 2 from Real.holderConjugate_iff.mpr
      ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => Real.sqrt_nonneg (f ω))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => Real.sqrt_nonneg (g ω))
    (by simpa using hfs) (by simpa using hgs)
  simp_rw [Real.rpow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (hf0 _), Real.sq_sqrt (hg0 _)] at hcs
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (integral_nonneg hf0)]
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, one_div] using hcs

name: MeasureTheory.integrable_rpow_of_nonneg_of_le
statement:
theorem integrable_rpow_of_nonneg_of_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Ω → ℝ} {p q : ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hfnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hfq : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ q) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ p) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ∀ ω, ‖f ω‖ = f ω := fun ω => Real.norm_of_nonneg (hfnn ω)
  have hfq' : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ q) μ := by simpa only [hnorm] using hfq
  simpa only [hnorm] using integrable_norm_rpow_of_le hf hp hq hpq hfq'

name: MeasureTheory.integral_rpow_root_le_of_nonneg_of_le
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_root_le_of_nonneg_of_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : Ω → ℝ} {p q : ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hfnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hfq : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ q) μ) :
    (∫ ω, f ω ^ p ∂μ) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ (∫ ω, f ω ^ q ∂μ) ^ q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 < q := hp.trans_le hpq
  have hnorm : ∀ ω, ‖f ω‖ = f ω := fun ω => Real.norm_of_nonneg (hfnn ω)
  have hfp := integrable_rpow_of_nonneg_of_le hf hfnn hp.le hq.le hpq hfq
  have hMp : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ :=
    (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hf (by simp [hp]) (by simp)).1
      (by simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le, hnorm] using hfp)
  have hMq : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ :=
    (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hf (by simp [hq]) (by simp)).1
      (by simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hq.le, hnorm] using hfq)
  have hmono := eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hpq) hf
  rw [hMp.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm (by simp [hp]) (by simp),
    hMq.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm (by simp [hq]) (by simp)] at hmono
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hq.le, hnorm] at hmono
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (Real.rpow_nonneg
    (integral_nonneg fun ω => Real.rpow_nonneg (hfnn ω) _) _)).1 hmono

name: MeasureTheory.integral_rpow_root_le_of_integral_rpow_le
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_root_le_of_integral_rpow_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : Ω → ℝ} {p q C : ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hfnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hfq : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ q) μ) (hqbound : (∫ ω, f ω ^ q ∂μ) ≤ C ^ q) :
    (∫ ω, f ω ^ p ∂μ) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 < q := hp.trans_le hpq
  calc (∫ ω, f ω ^ p ∂μ) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ (∫ ω, f ω ^ q ∂μ) ^ q⁻¹ :=
      integral_rpow_root_le_of_nonneg_of_le hf hfnn hp hpq hfq
    _ ≤ (C ^ q) ^ q⁻¹ := Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (integral_nonneg fun ω => Real.rpow_nonneg (hfnn ω) _) hqbound (by positivity)
    _ = C := Real.rpow_rpow_inv hC hq.ne'

name: MeasureTheory.integral_rpow_le_of_integral_rpow_le
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_le_of_integral_rpow_le {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → ℝ} {p q C : ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hfnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hfq : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ q) μ) (hqbound : (∫ ω, f ω ^ q ∂μ) ≤ C ^ q) :
    (∫ ω, f ω ^ p ∂μ) ≤ C ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hroot := integral_rpow_root_le_of_integral_rpow_le hf hfnn hp hpq hC hfq hqbound
  have hpint : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, f ω ^ p ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun ω => Real.rpow_nonneg (hfnn ω) _
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hpint _) hroot hp.le
  rwa [Real.rpow_inv_rpow hpint hp.ne'] at h

name: MeasureTheory.stieltjes_integral_pos_of_ae_pos
statement:
private theorem stieltjes_integral_pos_of_ae_pos
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : μ≠0)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hfi : Integrable f μ) (hf : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂μ, 0<f ξ) :
    0<∫ ξ : ℝ, f ξ ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have : (ae μ).NeBot := ae_neBot.mpr hμ
  have hn : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂μ, 0≤f ξ := hf.mono fun _ h => h.le
  apply (integral_nonneg_of_ae hn).lt_of_ne'
  intro hzero
  have he := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hn hfi).mp hzero
  obtain ⟨ξ,hξ,hξ0⟩ := (hf.and he).exists
  change f ξ=0 at hξ0
  exact hξ.ne' hξ0

name: MeasureTheory.integral_inv_sub_pos_and_sq_pos_of_support_gt
statement:
theorem integral_inv_sub_pos_and_sq_pos_of_support_gt
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsCompact μ.support)
    (hμne : μ≠0) (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ ξ ∈ μ.support, u<ξ) :
    0<∫ ξ : ℝ, (ξ-u)⁻¹ ∂μ ∧ 0<∫ ξ : ℝ, ((ξ-u)⁻¹)^2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : ℝ => (ξ-u)⁻¹) μ.support :=
    (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn.inv₀
      (fun ξ hξ => (sub_pos.mpr (hu ξ hξ)).ne')
  have hre : μ.restrict μ.support=μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem μ.support_mem_ae
  have hi : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (ξ-u)⁻¹) μ := by
    have hh := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
    rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hh
  have hi2 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((ξ-u)⁻¹)^2) μ := by
    have hh := (hc.pow 2).integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) hμ
    rwa [IntegrableOn,hre] at hh
  have hp : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂μ, 0<(ξ-u)⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with ξ hξ
    exact inv_pos.mpr (sub_pos.mpr (hu ξ hξ))
  refine ⟨stieltjes_integral_pos_of_ae_pos μ hμne _ hi hp,?_⟩
  exact stieltjes_integral_pos_of_ae_pos μ hμne _ hi2
    (hp.mono fun _ h => sq_pos_of_pos h)

name: Circle.integral_probabilityMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_probabilityMeasure {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Circle → E) :
    (∫ z, f z ∂probabilityMeasure) =
      (2 * π)⁻¹ • ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (Circle.exp θ)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ z, f z ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle.map
    AddCircle.homeomorphCircle'.toMeasurableEquiv)) = _
  rw [integral_map_equiv AddCircle.homeomorphCircle'.toMeasurableEquiv]
  rw [AddCircle.integral_haarAddCircle]
  change (2 * π)⁻¹ • (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * π), (f ∘ AddCircle.homeomorphCircle') t) = _
  rw [← AddCircle.intervalIntegral_preimage (2 * π) 0 (f ∘ AddCircle.homeomorphCircle')]
  simp only [zero_add, Function.comp_apply, AddCircle.homeomorphCircle'_apply_mk]

name: Circle.integral_probabilityMeasure_eq_circleAverage
statement:
theorem integral_probabilityMeasure_eq_circleAverage
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : ℂ → E) :
    (∫ z : Circle, f z ∂probabilityMeasure) = Real.circleAverage f 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_probabilityMeasure, Real.circleAverage_def]
  simp only [circleMap, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul, zero_add, Circle.coe_exp]

name: MeasureTheory.stieltjesFamily_regularization_bound
statement:
private theorem stieltjesFamily_regularization_bound
    (ρ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) :
    ‖∫ x : ℝ, f x*(∫ t : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal t γ x ∂(ρ : Measure ℝ))‖≤
      ‖f‖*(ρ.mass : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_cauchyRegularization_eq (ρ : Measure ℝ) f γ hγ]
  have hinner (x : ℝ) : ‖∫ t : ℝ, f (x+γ*t) ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1‖≤‖f‖ := by
    simpa only [probReal_univ,mul_one] using
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := cauchyMeasure 0 1)
        (Eventually.of_forall fun t => f.norm_coe_le_norm (x+γ*t))
  have hh := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := (ρ : Measure ℝ))
    (Eventually.of_forall hinner)
  simpa only [Measure.real,← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,ENNReal.coe_toReal] using hh

name: MeasureTheory.ae_integral_eq_zero_of_average_im_stieltjes_le_mul
statement:
theorem ae_integral_eq_zero_of_average_im_stieltjes_le_mul
    {T : Type*} [MeasurableSpace T] (ν : Measure T) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (ρ : T → FiniteMeasure ℝ) (r : T → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hrep : ∀ t : T, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → r t z=
      ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ))
    (B : NNReal) (hmass : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, (ρ t).mass≤B)
    (hmeas : ∀ γ : NNReal, γ≠0 → AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : T×ℝ => (r p.1 ((p.2 : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)).im) (ν.prod volume))
    (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ) (hfint : Integrable f) (hfnonneg : ∀ x, 0≤f x)
    (U : Set ℝ) (hfzero : ∀ x ∉ U, f x=0) (C : ℝ)
    (haverage : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ γ : NNReal, γ≠0 →
      (∫ t : T, (r t ((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)).im ∂ν)≤C*(γ : ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, ∫ x : ℝ, f x ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ)=0
proof:
:= by
  let k (γ : NNReal) (t : T) (x : ℝ) :=
    f x*(Real.pi⁻¹*(r t ((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I)).im)
  let a (γ : NNReal) (t : T) := ∫ x : ℝ, k γ t x
  let g (t : T) := ∫ x : ℝ, f x ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ)
  have hkeq (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) (t : T) (x : ℝ) :
      k γ t x=f x*(∫ y : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal y γ x ∂(ρ t : Measure ℝ)) := by
    have hz : 0<((x : ℂ)+(γ : ℝ)*Complex.I).im := by
      simpa using (NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ))
    rw [Complex.integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im_integral (ρ t : Measure ℝ) x γ hγ,
      ← hrep t _ hz]
  have hknonneg (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) (t : T) (x : ℝ) : 0≤k γ t x := by
    rw [hkeq γ hγ]
    exact mul_nonneg (hfnonneg x) (integral_nonneg fun y => (cauchyPDF_pos y hγ x).le)
  have hki (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) (t : T) : Integrable (k γ t) := by
    have hi := (integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_prod
      (ρ t : Measure ℝ) f γ hγ).integral_prod_right
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul] at hi
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => k γ t x)
    simpa only [hkeq γ hγ] using hi
  have hanorm (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) (t : T) :
      ‖a γ t‖≤‖f‖*((ρ t).mass : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [a,hkeq γ hγ] using stieltjesFamily_regularization_bound (ρ t) f γ hγ
  have hkmeas (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : T×ℝ => k γ p.1 p.2) (ν.prod volume) := by
    exact (f.continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      ((hmeas γ hγ).const_mul Real.pi⁻¹)
  have hkiprod (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) :
      Integrable (fun p : T×ℝ => k γ p.1 p.2) (ν.prod volume) := by
    apply (integrable_prod_iff (hkmeas γ hγ)).mpr
    refine ⟨Eventually.of_forall (hki γ hγ),?_⟩
    apply (integrable_const (‖f‖*(B : ℝ))).mono'
      (hkmeas γ hγ).norm.integral_prod_right'
    filter_upwards [hmass] with t ht
    have he : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖k γ t x‖)=a γ t := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => Real.norm_of_nonneg (hknonneg γ hγ t x)
    rw [he,Real.norm_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (hknonneg γ hγ t))]
    exact (le_abs_self (a γ t)).trans ((hanorm γ hγ t).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr ht) (norm_nonneg f)))
  have hmean (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ≠0) :
      (∫ t : T, a γ t ∂ν)≤(Real.pi⁻¹*C*(γ : ℝ))*(∫ x : ℝ, f x) := by
    rw [show (∫ t : T, a γ t ∂ν)=∫ x : ℝ, ∫ t : T, k γ t x ∂ν from
      integral_integral_swap (hkiprod γ hγ)]
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono (hkiprod γ hγ).integral_prod_right (hfint.const_mul _)
    intro x
    simp only [k,integral_const_mul]
    by_cases hx : x∈U
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (haverage x hx γ hγ)
        (mul_nonneg (hfnonneg x) (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.pi_pos.le))]
    · simp only [hfzero x hx,zero_mul,mul_zero,le_refl]
  let γ (n : ℕ) : NNReal := ⟨1/((n : ℝ)+1),by positivity⟩
  have hγne (n : ℕ) : γ n≠0 := by
    apply NNReal.coe_ne_zero.mp
    change 1/((n : ℝ)+1)≠0
    positivity
  have hγ : Tendsto (fun n => (γ n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_div_atTop 1
  have hlim (t : T) : Tendsto (fun n => a (γ n) t) atTop (𝓝 (g t)) := by
    simpa only [a,hkeq _ (hγne _),g] using
      tendsto_integral_cauchyRegularization (ρ t : Measure ℝ) f hγne hγ
  have hameas (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (a (γ n)) ν :=
    (hkmeas (γ n) (hγne n)).integral_prod_right'
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, ‖a (γ n) t‖≤‖f‖*(B : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hmass] with t ht
    exact (hanorm _ (hγne n) t).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr ht) (norm_nonneg f))
  have hlimit := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := ν) (fun _ : T => ‖f‖*(B : ℝ))
    hameas (integrable_const _) hbound (Eventually.of_forall hlim)
  have hzeroLim : Tendsto (fun n => (Real.pi⁻¹*C*(γ n : ℝ))*(∫ x : ℝ, f x))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero,zero_mul] using (hγ.const_mul (Real.pi⁻¹*C)).mul_const (∫ x : ℝ,f x)
  have hzero : (∫ t : T, g t ∂ν)=0 := by
    apply le_antisymm (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hlimit hzeroLim
      (Eventually.of_forall fun n => hmean (γ n) (hγne n)))
    exact integral_nonneg fun t => integral_nonneg hfnonneg
  have hgmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable g ν :=
    aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop hameas (Eventually.of_forall hlim)
  have hgnorm : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, ‖g t‖≤‖f‖*(B : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hmass] with t ht
    have hh := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := (ρ t : Measure ℝ))
      (Eventually.of_forall fun x => f.norm_coe_le_norm x)
    have hm : (ρ t : Measure ℝ).real univ=((ρ t).mass : ℝ) := by
      rw [Measure.real,← FiniteMeasure.ennreal_mass,ENNReal.coe_toReal]
    exact (hh.trans_eq (congrArg (fun x : ℝ => ‖f‖*x) hm)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr ht) (norm_nonneg f))
  have hgi : Integrable g ν := (integrable_const _).mono' hgmeas hgnorm
  exact (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun t => integral_nonneg hfnonneg) hgi).mp hzero

name: MeasureTheory.nonneg_of_tendsto_integral_of_uniform_lower_bound
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_tendsto_integral_of_uniform_lower_bound
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hRi : ∀ n, Integrable (R n) μ)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hRlower : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, -C ≤ R n x)
    (hRlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => R n x) atTop (𝓝 L))
    (L : ℝ) (hIlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, R n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    0 ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  let N : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n x => min (R n x) 0
  have hNi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (N n) μ := by
    exact (hRi n).inf (integrable_const (0 : ℝ))
  have hNbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖N n x‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [hRlower n] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (min_le_right (R n x) 0)]
    have hh : -C ≤ min (R n x) 0 := le_min hx (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hNlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => N n x) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hRlim] with x hx
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hxl⟩ := hx
    simpa only [N, min_eq_right hl] using hxl.min (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (0 : ℝ)))
  have hINlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, N n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [integral_zero] using tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun _ => C) (fun n => (hNi n).aestronglyMeasurable) (integrable_const C) hNbound hNlim
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hINlim hIlim
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_mono (hNi n) (hRi n)
    (fun x => min_le_left (R n x) 0)

name: MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg_of_shift_identity_limit
statement:
theorem integral_nonneg_of_shift_identity_limit
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (F A B C : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (Y A' B' C' : Ω → ℝ)
    (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψ' : Continuous ψ')
    (b K P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hψ0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ ψ t) (hψP : ∀ t, ψ t ≤ P)
    (hLi : ∀ n, Integrable
      (fun x => ψ' (F n x) * A n x + (b - B n x) * ψ (F n x)) μ)
    (hRi : ∀ n, Integrable (fun x => (b - C n x) * ψ (F n x)) μ)
    (hidentity : ∀ n,
      (∫ x, ψ' (F n x) * A n x + (b - B n x) * ψ (F n x) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, (b - C n x) * ψ (F n x) ∂μ)
    (hupper : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, C n x ≤ K)
    (hF : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (Y x)))
    (hA : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => A n x) atTop (𝓝 (A' x)))
    (hB : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => B n x) atTop (𝓝 (B' x)))
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => C n x) atTop (𝓝 (C' x)))
    (hC' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, C' x ≤ b)
    (bound : Ω → ℝ) (hboundi : Integrable bound μ)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      ‖ψ' (F n x) * A n x + (b - B n x) * ψ (F n x)‖ ≤ bound x) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x, ψ' (Y x) * A' x + (b - B' x) * ψ (Y x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n x =>
    ψ' (F n x) * A n x + (b - B n x) * ψ (F n x)
  let R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n x => (b - C n x) * ψ (F n x)
  have hLlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => L n x) atTop
      (𝓝 (ψ' (Y x) * A' x + (b - B' x) * ψ (Y x))) := by
    filter_upwards [hF, hA, hB] with x hxF hxA hxB
    exact (((hψ'.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hxF).mul hxA).add
      ((tendsto_const_nhds.sub hxB).mul (hψ.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hxF)))
  have hILlim := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound
    (fun n => (hLi n).aestronglyMeasurable) hboundi hbound hLlim
  have hRlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ l : ℝ, 0 ≤ l ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => R n x) atTop (𝓝 l) := by
    filter_upwards [hF, hC, hC'] with x hxF hxC hxC'
    refine ⟨(b - C' x) * ψ (Y x), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxC') (hψ0 _), ?_⟩
    exact (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hxC).mul (hψ.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hxF)
  let M : ℝ := (|b| + |K|) * P
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hP
  have hRlower : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, -M ≤ R n x := by
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hupper n] with x hx
    have hh : -(|b| + |K|) ≤ b - C n x := by
      linarith [neg_abs_le b, le_abs_self K]
    have hmul :
        -(|b| + |K|) * P ≤ (b - C n x) * ψ (F n x) :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left (hψP _) (by
        linarith [abs_nonneg b, abs_nonneg K])).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (hψ0 _))
    simpa only [M, R, neg_mul] using hmul
  apply nonneg_of_tendsto_integral_of_uniform_lower_bound μ R hRi M hM hRlower hRlim
  simpa only [L, hidentity] using hILlim

name: MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg_of_positive_translates
statement:
theorem integral_nonneg_of_positive_translates
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (X A B : Ω → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψ' : Continuous ψ')
    (b : ℝ)
    (hmeas : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x => ψ' (X x + ε) * A x + (b - B x) * ψ (X x + ε)) μ)
    (bound : Ω → ℝ) (hboundi : Integrable bound μ)
    (hbound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      ‖ψ' (X x + ε) * A x + (b - B x) * ψ (X x + ε)‖ ≤ bound x)
    (hweak : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      0 ≤ ∫ x, ψ' (X x + ε) * A x + (b - B x) * ψ (X x + ε) ∂μ) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x, ψ' (X x) * A x + (b - B x) * ψ (X x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  have hε (n : ℕ) : 0 < ε n := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  have hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => ψ' (X x + ε n) * A x + (b - B x) * ψ (X x + ε n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (ψ' (X x) * A x + (b - B x) * ψ (X x))) := by
    filter_upwards with x
    have hx : Tendsto (fun n => X x + ε n) atTop (𝓝 (X x)) := by
      simpa only [add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add hεlim
    exact ((hψ'.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx).mul tendsto_const_nhds).add
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (hψ.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx))
  have hi := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound
    (fun n => hmeas (ε n) (hε n)) hboundi (fun n => hbound (ε n) (hε n)) hlim
  exact ge_of_tendsto hi (Eventually.of_forall fun n => hweak (ε n) (hε n))

name: NLAlib.continuous_integral_affine_path
statement:
theorem continuous_integral_affine_path
    (X Z : Ω → E) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ) (hZ : AEStronglyMeasurable Z μ)
    (c : E) (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b)
    (Φ : E → F) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ x, ‖Φ x‖ ≤ C) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ω, Φ (c + a t • X ω + b t • Z ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun _ => C)
  · intro t
    exact hΦ.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      ((aestronglyMeasurable_const.add (hX.const_smul (a t))).add (hZ.const_smul (b t)))
  · intro t
    exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => hbound _
  · exact integrable_const C
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => hΦ.comp ((continuous_const.add
      (ha.smul continuous_const)).add (hb.smul continuous_const))

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_affine_path
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_affine_path
    (X Z : Ω → E) (hX : Integrable X μ) (hZ : Integrable Z μ)
    (c : E) (a b a' b' : ℝ → ℝ) {t₀ : ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 t₀)
    (ha : ∀ t ∈ s, HasDerivAt a (a' t) t)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ s, HasDerivAt b (b' t) t)
    (A B : ℝ) (hab : ∀ t ∈ s, |a' t| ≤ A) (hbb : ∀ t ∈ s, |b' t| ≤ B)
    (Φ : E → F) (DΦ : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hΦ : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt Φ (DΦ x) x) (hDc : Continuous DΦ)
    (C₀ C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hΦb : ∀ x, ‖Φ x‖ ≤ C₀) (hDb : ∀ x, ‖DΦ x‖ ≤ C₁) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ ω, Φ (c + a t • X ω + b t • Z ω) ∂μ)
      (∫ ω, DΦ (c + a t₀ • X ω + b t₀ • Z ω)
        (a' t₀ • X ω + b' t₀ • Z ω) ∂μ) t₀
proof:
:= by
  let Y : ℝ → Ω → E := fun t ω => c + a t • X ω + b t • Z ω
  let V : ℝ → Ω → E := fun t ω => a' t • X ω + b' t • Z ω
  have hY (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (Y t) μ :=
    (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add (hX.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul (a t))).add
      (hZ.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul (b t))
  have hV (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (V t) μ :=
    (hX.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul (a' t)).add
      (hZ.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul (b' t))
  have hΦc : Continuous Φ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hΦ x).continuousAt)
  have hFm (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Φ (Y t ω)) μ :=
    hΦc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hY t)
  have hFi : Integrable (fun ω => Φ (Y t₀ ω)) μ :=
    (integrable_const C₀).mono' (hFm t₀) (ae_of_all _ fun ω => hΦb _)
  have hDm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => DΦ (Y t₀ ω) (V t₀ ω)) μ :=
    isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      ((hDc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hY t₀)).prodMk (hV t₀))
  have hdom (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) (ω : Ω) :
      ‖DΦ (Y t ω) (V t ω)‖ ≤ C₁ * (A * ‖X ω‖ + B * ‖Z ω‖) := by
    have hv : ‖V t ω‖ ≤ |a' t| * ‖X ω‖ + |b' t| * ‖Z ω‖ := by
      simpa only [V,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_add_le (a' t • X ω) (b' t • Z ω)
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖DΦ (Y t ω)‖ * ‖V t ω‖ := (DΦ _).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ C₁ * (|a' t| * ‖X ω‖ + |b' t| * ‖Z ω‖) :=
        mul_le_mul (hDb _) hv (norm_nonneg _) hC₁
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact hab t ht; exact hbb t ht
  have hdiff (ω : Ω) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) :
      HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ (Y t ω)) (DΦ (Y t ω) (V t ω)) t := by
    have hy : HasDerivAt (fun t => Y t ω) (V t ω) t := by
      simpa only [Y,V,zero_add,Pi.add_def] using
        ((hasDerivAt_const t c).add ((ha t ht).smul_const (X ω))).add
          ((hb t ht).smul_const (Z ω))
    exact (hΦ _).comp_hasDerivAt t hy
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := μ)
    (F := fun t ω => Φ (Y t ω)) (F' := fun t ω => DΦ (Y t ω) (V t ω))
    (bound := fun ω => C₁ * (A * ‖X ω‖ + B * ‖Z ω‖)) hs
    (Eventually.of_forall hFm) hFi hDm
    (ae_of_all _ fun ω t ht => hdom t ht ω)
    (((hX.norm.const_mul A).add (hZ.norm.const_mul B)).const_mul C₁)
    (ae_of_all _ hdiff)).2

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_sqrt_affine_path
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_sqrt_affine_path
    (X Z : Ω → E) (hX : Integrable X μ) (hZ : Integrable Z μ)
    (c : E) (Φ : E → F) (DΦ : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hΦ : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt Φ (DΦ x) x) (hDc : Continuous DΦ)
    (C₀ C₁ : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hΦb : ∀ x, ‖Φ x‖ ≤ C₀) (hDb : ∀ x, ‖DΦ x‖ ≤ C₁)
    {t₀ : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (ht₁ : t₀ < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ ω, Φ (c + Real.sqrt t • X ω + Real.sqrt (1-t) • Z ω) ∂μ)
      (∫ ω, DΦ (c + Real.sqrt t₀ • X ω + Real.sqrt (1-t₀) • Z ω)
        ((1/(2*Real.sqrt t₀)) • X ω - (1/(2*Real.sqrt (1-t₀))) • Z ω) ∂μ) t₀
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℝ := Set.Ioo (t₀/2) ((1+t₀)/2)
  have hs : s ∈ 𝓝 t₀ := Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have h0 (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) : 0 < t := by dsimp [s] at ht; linarith [ht.1]
  have h1 (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) : t < 1 := by dsimp [s] at ht; linarith [ht.2]
  have ha (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) : HasDerivAt Real.sqrt (1/(2*Real.sqrt t)) t :=
    Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt (h0 t ht).ne'
  have hb (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) :
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1-t)) (-(1/(2*Real.sqrt (1-t)))) t := by
    have hh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1-t) (-1) t := by
      simpa only [Pi.sub_def,id_eq,zero_sub] using
        (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)
    simpa only [neg_div] using hh.sqrt (by linarith [h1 t ht])
  have hab (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) :
      |1/(2*Real.sqrt t)| ≤ 1/(2*Real.sqrt (t₀/2)) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    gcongr
    exact ht.1.le
  have hbb (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ s) :
      |-(1/(2*Real.sqrt (1-t)))| ≤ 1/(2*Real.sqrt ((1-t₀)/2)) := by
    rw [abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    gcongr
    dsimp [s] at ht
    linarith [ht.2]
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_affine_path X Z hX hZ c Real.sqrt
    (fun t => Real.sqrt (1-t)) (fun t => 1/(2*Real.sqrt t))
    (fun t => -(1/(2*Real.sqrt (1-t)))) hs ha hb
    (1/(2*Real.sqrt (t₀/2))) (1/(2*Real.sqrt ((1-t₀)/2))) hab hbb
    Φ DΦ hΦ hDc C₀ C₁ hC₁ hΦb hDb
  simpa only [neg_smul,sub_eq_add_neg] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal_affine
statement:
theorem cauchyPDFReal_affine (x t : ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    cauchyPDFReal 0 1 t = (γ : ℝ) * cauchyPDFReal x γ (x + γ * t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cauchyPDFReal, NNReal.coe_one, sub_zero, one_pow, mul_one]
  field_simp [hγ, NNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr hγ]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_mul_cauchyPDFReal_eq_integral_affine
statement:
theorem integral_mul_cauchyPDFReal_eq_integral_affine (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, f (x + γ * t) ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cauchyMeasure_of_scale_ne_zero 0 (by norm_num),
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (measurable_cauchyPDF 0 1)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  simp only [cauchyPDF, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (le_of_lt (cauchyPDF_pos 0 (γ := (1 : NNReal)) (by norm_num) _)),
    smul_eq_mul]
  have he : (fun t : ℝ => cauchyPDFReal 0 1 t * f (x + γ * t)) =
      fun t : ℝ => (γ : ℝ) * (f (x + γ * t) * cauchyPDFReal x γ (x + γ * t)) := by
    funext t
    rw [cauchyPDFReal_affine x t γ hγ]
    ring
  rw [he, integral_const_mul,
    integral_comp_mul_left (fun y : ℝ => f (x + y) * cauchyPDFReal x γ (x + y)),
    integral_add_left_eq_self (fun y : ℝ => f y * cauchyPDFReal x γ y) x]
  simp only [abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr γ.coe_nonneg), smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [NNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr hγ]

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_integral_affine_cauchy
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_affine_cauchy (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    {γ : ℕ → NNReal} (hγ : Tendsto (fun n => (γ n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t : ℝ, f (x + γ n * t) ∂cauchyMeasure 0 1)
      atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  have ht (t : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n => f (x + γ n * t)) atTop (𝓝 (f x)) := by
    apply f.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add (hγ.mul_const t)
  have h := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := cauchyMeasure 0 1)
    (fun _ : ℝ => ‖f‖)
    (fun n => (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => f (x + γ n * t))).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_const _) (fun _ => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => f.norm_coe_le_norm _))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ht)
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_map_le_mul
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_map_le_mul {X Y : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace X] [PseudoEMetricSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [PseudoEMetricSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    (μ ν : Measure X) {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : K ≠ 0) {f : X → Y} (hf : LipschitzWith K f) :
    wassersteinEDistOne (μ.map f) (ν.map f) ≤ K * wassersteinEDistOne μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hK' : (K : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hK
  simp only [wassersteinEDistOne, ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hK' ENNReal.coe_ne_top]
  refine le_iInf fun π => le_iInf fun hπ => ?_
  have hfm := hf.continuous.measurable
  apply (iInf_le_of_le (π.map (fun p => (f p.1, f p.2)))
    (iInf_le_of_le (hπ.map hfm hfm) le_rfl)).trans
  rw [lintegral_map (g := fun p : X × X => (f p.1, f p.2))
    (measurable_fst.edist measurable_snd) (by fun_prop), ← lintegral_const_mul' _ _]
  · exact lintegral_mono fun p => hf p.1 p.2
  · exact ENNReal.coe_ne_top

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_map_mul_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_map_mul_le (μ ν : Measure ℝ) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) :
    wassersteinEDistOne (μ.map (fun x => S * x)) (ν.map (fun x => S * x)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal S * wassersteinEDistOne μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hf : LipschitzWith ⟨S, hS.le⟩ (fun x : ℝ => S * x) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    simp only [Real.dist_eq, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hS]
    rfl
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_coe_nnreal hS.le]
  exact wassersteinEDistOne_map_le_mul μ ν (K := ⟨S, hS.le⟩)
    (by intro he; exact hS.ne' (congrArg (fun x : ℝ≥0 => (x : ℝ)) he)) hf

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_map_real_smul_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_map_real_smul_le {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] (μ ν : Measure E) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) :
    wassersteinEDistOne (μ.map (fun z => S•z)) (ν.map (fun z => S•z)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal S * wassersteinEDistOne μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hf : LipschitzWith ⟨S,hS.le⟩ (fun z : E => S•z) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro z w
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hS.le]
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    exact le_rfl
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_coe_nnreal hS.le]
  exact wassersteinEDistOne_map_le_mul μ ν (K := ⟨S,hS.le⟩)
    (by intro he; exact hS.ne' (congrArg (fun x : ℝ≥0 => (x:ℝ)) he)) hf

name: Finset.mem_iff_val_lt_card_of_lower
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have hs : Iic i ⊆ T := fun j hj => hT i hi j (mem_Iic.mp hj)
    have hc := card_le_card hs
    simp only [Fin.card_Iic] at hc
    omega
  · intro hi
    by_contra hn
    have hs : T ⊆ Iio i := by
      intro j hj
      apply mem_Iio.mpr
      by_contra hji
      exact hn (hT j hj i (le_of_not_gt hji))
    have hc := card_le_card hs
    simp only [Fin.card_Iio] at hc
    omega

name: Finset.exists_equiv_fin_prefix_of_monotone
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_fin_prefix_of_monotone
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {m : ℕ}
    (S : Fin (m + 1) → Finset ι) (hS : Monotone S) :
    ∃ e : Fin (Fintype.card ι) ≃ ι,
      ∀ (k : Fin (m + 1)) (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)),
        e i ∈ S k ↔ i.val < (S k).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let excluded (x : ι) : Finset (Fin (m + 1)) := univ.filter fun k => x ∉ S k
  have hrank {x y : ι} {k : Fin (m + 1)} (hx : x ∈ S k) (hy : y ∉ S k) :
      (excluded x).card < (excluded y).card := by
    have hs : excluded x ⊆ excluded y := by
      intro j hj
      have hxj : x ∉ S j := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hjk : j ≤ k := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hxj (hS (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hn)) hx)
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, fun hyj => hy (hS hjk hyj)⟩
    apply card_lt_card
    exact (ssubset_iff_of_subset hs).mpr
      ⟨k, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hy⟩, by simpa [excluded] using hx⟩
  let key (x : ι) : ℕ ×ₗ Fin (Fintype.card ι) :=
    toLex ((excluded x).card, Fintype.equivFin ι x)
  have hkey : Function.Injective key := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply (Fintype.equivFin ι).injective
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℕ ×ₗ Fin (Fintype.card ι) => (ofLex z).2) hxy
  let : LinearOrder ι := LinearOrder.lift' key hkey
  have hlower (k : Fin (m + 1)) {x y : ι} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hy : y ∈ S k) : x ∈ S k := by
    by_contra hx
    have hr := hrank hy hx
    change key x ≤ key y at hxy
    rcases Prod.Lex.toLex_le_toLex.mp hxy with hlt | ⟨heq, _⟩ <;> omega
  let e := Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq ι rfl
  refine ⟨e.toEquiv, fun k i => ?_⟩
  let T : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) := (S k).map e.symm.toEquiv.toEmbedding
  have hmem (j : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) : j ∈ T ↔ e j ∈ S k := by
    simp [T]
  have hT : ∀ j ∈ T, ∀ l ≤ j, l ∈ T := by
    intro j hj l hlj
    exact (hmem l).mpr (hlower k (e.monotone hlj) ((hmem j).mp hj))
  have h := mem_iff_val_lt_card_of_lower T hT i
  change e i ∈ S k ↔ i.val < (S k).card
  simpa only [hmem, T, card_map] using h

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.good_two
statement:
private theorem good_two [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected) :
    Good G 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let u : V := Classical.arbitrary V
  obtain ⟨v, huv⟩ := hG.preconnected.exists_adj_of_nontrivial u
  let f : Fin 2 ↪ V := ⟨![u, v], by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · exact (huv.ne hij).elim
    · exact (huv.ne hij.symm).elim
    · rfl⟩
  refine ⟨0, edge, f, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  have heq : e = (0, 1) := List.mem_singleton.mp he
  rw [heq]
  exact huv

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.good_succ
statement:
private theorem good_succ {G : SimpleGraph V} {n : ℕ}
    (t : LeafTree n) (f : Fin (n + 2) ↪ V)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t.edgeList, G.Adj (f e.1) (f e.2))
    (u : V) (hu : u ∉ Set.range f) (p : Fin (n + 2))
    (hpu : G.Adj (f p) u) : Good G (n + 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f' := Fin.Embedding.cons f hu
  refine ⟨n + 1, attach t p, f', by omega, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with he | he
  · simpa [he, f'] using hpu
  · rcases List.mem_map.mp he with ⟨e', he', rfl⟩
    simpa [f'] using ht e' he'

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.exists_spanning_tree
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_tree [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : LeafTree n) (f : Fin (n + 2) ≃ V),
      ∀ e ∈ t.edgeList, G.Adj (f e.1) (f e.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htwo := good_two G hG
  have htwole : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mpr inferInstance
  let m := Nat.findGreatest (Good G) (Fintype.card V)
  have hgood : Good G m := Nat.findGreatest_spec htwole htwo
  obtain ⟨n, t, f, hm, ht⟩ := hgood
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    by_contra hnot
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
    have hout : u ∉ Set.range f := hu
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hG (f 0) u
    obtain ⟨dart, _hmem, hin, hout'⟩ := p.exists_boundary_dart (Set.range f) ⟨0, rfl⟩ hout
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hin
    have hadj : G.Adj (f i) dart.snd := hi ▸ dart.adj
    have hnext : Good G (m + 1) := by
      simpa only [hm] using good_succ t f ht dart.snd hout' i hadj
    have hlt : n + 2 < Fintype.card V := by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
        Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective f f.injective hnot
    have hmle : m + 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := by omega
    have hbad : m + 1 ≤ m := Nat.le_findGreatest hmle hnext
    omega
  exact ⟨n, t, Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨f.injective, hsurj⟩, ht⟩

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.edgeList_sym2_nodup
statement:
theorem edgeList_sym2_nodup {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) :
    (t.edgeList.map (fun e => s(e.1, e.2))).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | edge => simp [edgeList]
  | @attach n t p ih =>
      simp only [edgeList, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
      refine List.Nodup.cons ?_ ?_
      · intro hmem
        obtain ⟨e, _he, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
        rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq with h | h
        · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _ h.2
        · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _ h.1
      · have hmap :
            t.edgeList.map (fun e => s(e.1.succ, e.2.succ)) =
              (t.edgeList.map (fun e => s(e.1, e.2))).map (Sym2.map Fin.succ) := by
          rw [List.map_map]
          rfl
        change (t.edgeList.map (fun e => s(e.1.succ, e.2.succ))).Nodup
        rw [hmap]
        exact ih.map (Sym2.map.injective (Fin.succ_injective _))

name: NLAlib.sum_powersetCard_sum_insert_eq
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_sum_insert_eq {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (w : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ S ∈ s.powersetCard k, ∑ i ∈ s, if i ∉ S then w (insert i S) else 0) =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * ∑ T ∈ s.powersetCard (k + 1), w T
proof:
:= by
  let P := ((s.powersetCard k) ×ˢ s).filter fun x => x.2 ∉ x.1
  let T := ((s.powersetCard (k + 1)) ×ˢ s).filter fun x => x.2 ∈ x.1
  have hbij : (∑ x ∈ P, w (insert x.2 x.1)) = ∑ x ∈ T, w x.1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun x => (insert x.2 x.1, x.2))
      (fun x => (x.1.erase x.2, x.2))
    · rintro ⟨S, i⟩ h
      rcases (by simpa only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
        Finset.mem_powersetCard] using h) with ⟨⟨⟨hSs, hCard⟩, his⟩, hiS⟩
      simp only [T, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
      exact ⟨⟨⟨Finset.insert_subset his hSs, by
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hiS, hCard]⟩, his⟩, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
    · rintro ⟨S, i⟩ h
      rcases (by simpa only [T, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
        Finset.mem_powersetCard] using h) with ⟨⟨⟨hSs, hCard⟩, his⟩, hiS⟩
      simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
      exact ⟨⟨⟨(Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans hSs, by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hiS, hCard]; omega⟩, his⟩, Finset.notMem_erase _ _⟩
    · rintro ⟨S, i⟩ h
      have hiS : i ∉ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2
      simp only [Finset.erase_insert hiS]
    · rintro ⟨S, i⟩ h
      have hiS : i ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2
      simp only [Finset.insert_erase hiS]
    · intros
      rfl
  have hcount : (∑ S ∈ s.powersetCard k, ∑ i ∈ s,
      if i ∉ S then w (insert i S) else 0) =
      ∑ S ∈ s.powersetCard (k + 1), ∑ i ∈ s, if i ∈ S then w S else 0 := by
    simpa only [P, T, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_product] using hbij
  rw [hcount, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  rcases Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS with ⟨hSs, hCard⟩
  calc (∑ i ∈ s, if i ∈ S then w S else 0) = ∑ i ∈ S, if i ∈ S then w S else 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_subset hSs (fun i _ hi => by simp only [if_neg hi])).symm
    _ = (k + 1 : ℝ) * w S := by
      simp [hCard]

name: NLAlib.exists_tail_mem_of_mem_powersetCard_succ
proof:
:= by
  let H := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k
  have hH : H.card ≤ k := by
    have hi : H.image Fin.val ⊆ Finset.range k := by
      intro i hi
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    calc H.card = (H.image Fin.val).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injective H Fin.val_injective).symm
      _ ≤ (Finset.range k).card := Finset.card_le_card hi
      _ = k := Finset.card_range k
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hsub : T ⊆ H := by
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h i hi⟩
  have hc := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans hH
  rw [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hT).2] at hc
  omega

name: NLAlib.sum_powersetCard_prod_succ_le_tail_mul_sum_prod
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_prod_succ_le_tail_mul_sum_prod {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin n → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard (k + 1), ∏ i ∈ T, d i) ≤
      (∑ i : Fin n, if k ≤ (i : ℕ) then d i else 0) *
        ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, d i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    have he : (∅ : Finset (Fin 0)).powersetCard (k + 1) = ∅ :=
      Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty.mpr (by simp)
    simp [he]
  | succ n =>
    let K := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powersetCard (k + 1)
    let H := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).filter fun i : Fin (n + 1) => k ≤ (i : ℕ)
    let P := H ×ˢ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powersetCard k)
    let chosen (T : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) : Fin (n + 1) :=
      if hT : T ∈ K then Classical.choose (exists_tail_mem_of_mem_powersetCard_succ hT) else 0
    have hchosen : ∀ T ∈ K, chosen T ∈ T ∧ k ≤ (chosen T : ℕ) := by
      intro T hT
      dsimp only [chosen]
      rw [dif_pos hT]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_tail_mem_of_mem_powersetCard_succ hT)
    let f (T : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) := (chosen T, T.erase (chosen T))
    have hf : ∀ T ∈ K, f T ∈ P := by
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨hi, htail⟩ := hchosen T hT
      simp only [P, f, Finset.mem_product, H, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
        true_and, Finset.mem_powersetCard, Finset.subset_univ, true_and]
      refine ⟨htail, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hT).2]
      omega
    have hinj : ∀ T ∈ K, ∀ S ∈ K, f T = f S → T = S := by
      intro T hT S hS he
      have hi : chosen T = chosen S := congrArg Prod.fst he
      have he' : T.erase (chosen T) = S.erase (chosen S) := congrArg Prod.snd he
      calc T = insert (chosen T) (T.erase (chosen T)) := (Finset.insert_erase (hchosen T hT).1).symm
        _ = insert (chosen S) (S.erase (chosen S)) := congrArg₂ (fun i S => insert i S) hi he'
        _ = S := Finset.insert_erase (hchosen S hS).1
    have hprod : ∀ T ∈ K, d (f T).1 * (∏ i ∈ (f T).2, d i) = ∏ i ∈ T, d i := by
      intro T hT
      exact Finset.mul_prod_erase T d (hchosen T hT).1
    have himage : (∑ T ∈ K, ∏ i ∈ T, d i) =
        ∑ z ∈ K.image f, d z.1 * ∏ i ∈ z.2, d i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T hT => (hprod T hT).symm
    have hle : (∑ T ∈ K, ∏ i ∈ T, d i) ≤ ∑ z ∈ P, d z.1 * ∏ i ∈ z.2, d i := by
      rw [himage]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
        exact hf T hT
      · intro z _ _
        exact mul_nonneg (hd z.1) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => hd i)
    convert hle using 1
    dsimp only [P]
    rw [Finset.sum_product]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    simp only [H, Finset.sum_filter]

name: Finset.subset_extendToCard
statement: theorem subset_extendToCard (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) : s ⊆ s.extendToCard r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold extendToCard
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_subsuperset_card_eq (subset_univ s) h
      (by simp : min r (Fintype.card ι) ≤ (univ : Finset ι).card))).1
  · exact Subset.rfl

name: Finset.card_extendToCard
statement:
theorem card_extendToCard (s : Finset ι) {r : ℕ} (h : s.card ≤ r) :
    (s.extendToCard r).card = min r (Fintype.card ι)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' : s.card ≤ min r (Fintype.card ι) := le_min h (card_le_univ s)
  rw [extendToCard, dif_pos h']
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_subsuperset_card_eq (subset_univ s) h'
    (by simp : min r (Fintype.card ι) ≤ (univ : Finset ι).card))).2.2

name: Finset.subset_neighborExtension
statement:
theorem subset_neighborExtension (s : Finset ι) (neighbors : ι → Finset ι) (r : ℕ) :
    s ⊆ s.neighborExtension neighbors r
proof:
:=
  subset_union_left.trans (subset_extendToCard _ _)

name: Finset.mem_neighborExtension
proof:
:= by
  exact subset_extendToCard _ _ (mem_union_right _ (mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, hj, hi⟩))

name: Finset.card_neighborExtension
statement:
theorem card_neighborExtension (s : Finset ι) (neighbors : ι → Finset ι)
    {r c : ℕ} (hc : ∀ j ∈ s, (neighbors j).card ≤ c)
    (hr : s.card + s.card * c ≤ r) :
    (s.neighborExtension neighbors r).card = min r (Fintype.card ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply card_extendToCard
  exact (card_union_le _ _).trans
    ((Nat.add_le_add_left (card_biUnion_le_card_mul s neighbors c hc) _).trans hr)

name: Finset.subset_heavyFlag
statement:
theorem subset_heavyFlag (rows : ℕ → Finset ι) (neighbors : ℕ → ι → Finset ι)
    (N M : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) : rows k ⊆ heavyFlag rows neighbors N M k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact subset_extendToCard _ _
  | succ k => exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_extendToCard _ _)

name: Finset.heavyFlag_subset_heavyNeighborFlag
statement:
theorem heavyFlag_subset_heavyNeighborFlag (rows : ℕ → Finset ι)
    (neighbors : ℕ → ι → Finset ι) (N M : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    heavyFlag rows neighbors N M k ⊆ heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k
proof:
:=
  subset_neighborExtension _ _ _

name: Finset.heavyNeighborFlag_subset_heavyFlag_succ
statement:
theorem heavyNeighborFlag_subset_heavyFlag_succ (rows : ℕ → Finset ι)
    (neighbors : ℕ → ι → Finset ι) (N M : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k ⊆ heavyFlag rows neighbors N M (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  subset_union_left.trans (subset_extendToCard _ _)

name: Finset.card_heavyFlag_and_heavyNeighborFlag
statement:
theorem card_heavyFlag_and_heavyNeighborFlag
    (rows : ℕ → Finset ι) (neighbors : ℕ → ι → Finset ι)
    (N M c : ℕ → ℕ) (hzero : (rows 0).card ≤ N 0)
    (hcol : ∀ k j, (neighbors k j).card ≤ c k)
    (hM : ∀ k, N k + N k * c k ≤ M k)
    (hN : ∀ k, M k + (rows (k + 1)).card ≤ N (k + 1)) :
    ∀ k, (heavyFlag rows neighbors N M k).card = min (N k) (Fintype.card ι) ∧
      (heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k).card = min (M k) (Fintype.card ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  have hmain : ∀ k, (heavyFlag rows neighbors N M k).card =
      min (N k) (Fintype.card ι) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact card_extendToCard _ hzero
    | succ k ih =>
        apply card_extendToCard
        have hcard : (heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k).card =
            min (M k) (Fintype.card ι) := by
          apply card_neighborExtension _ _ (fun j _ => hcol k j)
          calc
            _ ≤ N k + N k * c k := by rw [ih]; gcongr <;> exact min_le_left _ _
            _ ≤ M k := hM k
        apply (card_union_le _ _).trans
        change (heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k).card + _ ≤ _
        rw [hcard]
        exact (Nat.add_le_add_right (min_le_left _ _) _).trans (hN k)
  refine ⟨hmain k, ?_⟩
  apply card_neighborExtension _ _ (fun j _ => hcol k j)
  calc
    _ ≤ N k + N k * c k := by rw [hmain k]; gcongr <;> exact min_le_left _ _
    _ ≤ M k := hM k

name: Finset.monotone_interleavedHeavyFlag
statement:
theorem monotone_interleavedHeavyFlag (rows : ℕ → Finset ι)
    (neighbors : ℕ → ι → Finset ι) (N M : ℕ → ℕ) :
    Monotone (interleavedHeavyFlag rows neighbors N M)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t % 2 = 0
  · have ht' : (t + 1) % 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hd : (t + 1) / 2 = t / 2 := by omega
    simp only [interleavedHeavyFlag, if_pos ht, if_neg ht', hd]
    exact heavyFlag_subset_heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M _
  · have ht' : (t + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
    have hd : (t + 1) / 2 = t / 2 + 1 := by omega
    simp only [interleavedHeavyFlag, if_neg ht, if_pos ht', hd]
    exact heavyNeighborFlag_subset_heavyFlag_succ rows neighbors N M _

name: Finset.exists_equiv_fin_prefix_heavyFlag
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_fin_prefix_heavyFlag (rows : ℕ → Finset ι)
    (neighbors : ℕ → ι → Finset ι) (N M : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : Fin (Fintype.card ι) ≃ ι, ∀ k ≤ L, ∀ i : Fin (Fintype.card ι),
      (e i ∈ heavyFlag rows neighbors N M k ↔
        i.val < (heavyFlag rows neighbors N M k).card) ∧
      (e i ∈ heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k ↔
        i.val < (heavyNeighborFlag rows neighbors N M k).card)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Fin (2 * L + 1 + 1) → Finset ι := fun t =>
    interleavedHeavyFlag rows neighbors N M t
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_equiv_fin_prefix_of_monotone S
    ((monotone_interleavedHeavyFlag rows neighbors N M).comp (fun _ _ h => h))
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  intro k hk i
  constructor
  · simpa [S, interleavedHeavyFlag] using he ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩ i
  · have hd : (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k := by omega
    simpa [S, interleavedHeavyFlag, hd] using he ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩ i

name: NLAlib.prod_bipartite_tree_edges_eq_weight
statement:
theorem prod_bipartite_tree_edges_eq_weight [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    {r q : ℕ} (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q)
    (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V)
    (ur : Fin (r+1) ≃ U) (vc : Fin q ≃ V)
    (occ : Fin t.edgeList.length ↪ E)
    (hend : ∀ k : Fin t.edgeList.length,
      sr (occ k) = ur (t.edgeList.get k).1 ∧
        tg (occ k) = vc (t.edgeList.get k).2)
    (w : I → J → ℝ)
    (X : Fin (r+1) → I) (Y : Fin q → J) :
    (∏ e ∈ univ.map occ, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e)))) =
      RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight w t X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight
  calc
    (∏ e ∈ univ.map occ, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e))))
        = univ.prod (fun k : Fin t.edgeList.length =>
            w (X (ur.symm (sr (occ k)))) (Y (vc.symm (tg (occ k))))) := by
          rw [Finset.prod_map]
    _ = univ.prod (fun k : Fin t.edgeList.length =>
            w (X (t.edgeList.get k).1) (Y (t.edgeList.get k).2)) := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
          intro k hk
          rcases hend k with ⟨hk1, hk2⟩
          rw [hk1, hk2]
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    _ = (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin t.edgeList.length =>
            w (X (t.edgeList.get k).1) (Y (t.edgeList.get k).2))).prod := by
          rw [← List.prod_ofFn]
    _ = (t.edgeList.map (fun e => w (X e.1) (Y e.2))).prod := by
          rw [List.ofFn_comp' (f := fun k : Fin t.edgeList.length => t.edgeList.get k)
            (g := fun e => w (X e.1) (Y e.2))]
          rw [List.ofFn_get]

name: NLAlib.sum_prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_of_connected
statement:
theorem sum_prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_of_connected [Fintype U] [Fintype V] [Nonempty U]
    [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [DecidableEq U] [DecidableEq V]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V)
    (hG : (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph sr tg).Connected)
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (a c s : ℝ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ a)
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ c)
    (hw : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J,
       ∏ e : E, w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e))) ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ (Fintype.card U - 1) *
        c ^ (Fintype.card V) *
        s ^ (Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card U - 1 + Fintype.card V))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, q, t, ur, vc, occ, hend⟩ :=
    RowRootedBipartiteTree.exists_spanning_tree_syntax (U := U) (V := V)
      (E := E) sr tg hG
  let T : Finset E := univ.map occ
  let O : Finset E := Tᶜ
  have hcardU : Fintype.card U = r + 1 := by
    simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_congr ur).symm
  have hcardV : Fintype.card V = q := by
    simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_congr vc).symm
  have hlen : t.edgeList.length = r + q := RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList_length t
  have hTcard : T.card = r + q := by
    simp [T, hlen]
  have hOcard : O.card = Fintype.card E - (r + q) := by
    dsimp [O]
    rw [Finset.card_compl, hTcard]
  have hdisj : Disjoint T O := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro e heT heO
    have henot : e ∉ T := by simpa [O] using heO
    exact henot heT
  have huni : T ∪ O = univ := by
    simp [O]
  have hTprod : ∀ (X : Fin (r+1) → I) (Y : Fin q → J),
      (∏ e ∈ T, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e)))) =
        RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight w t X Y := by
    intro X Y
    dsimp [T]
    exact prod_bipartite_tree_edges_eq_weight t sr tg ur vc occ hend w X Y
  have hsplit : ∀ (X : Fin (r+1) → I) (Y : Fin q → J),
      (∏ e : E, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e)))) ≤
        RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight w t X Y * s ^ O.card := by
    intro X Y
    calc
      (∏ e : E, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e))))
          ≤ (∏ e ∈ T, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e)))) * s ^ O.card := by
            exact prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_prod_mul_pow (w := w) (s := s) hwnn hw
              T O hdisj huni sr tg (fun u => X (ur.symm u)) (fun v => Y (vc.symm v))
      _ = RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight w t X Y * s ^ O.card := by
            congr 1
            exact hTprod X Y
  have hr : r = Fintype.card U - 1 := by
    rw [hcardU, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hq' : q = Fintype.card V := by
    exact hcardV.symm
  have hO : O.card = Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card U - 1 + Fintype.card V) := by
    rw [hOcard, ← hr, ← hq']
  calc
    (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J,
        ∏ e : E, w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))
    = ∑ X : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : V → J,
        ∏ e : E, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (y (tg e)) := by
        exact (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.arrowCongr ur (Equiv.refl I))
          (g := fun x : U → I =>
            ∑ y : V → J, ∏ e : E, w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))).symm
    _ = ∑ X : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ Y : Fin q → J,
        ∏ e : E, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (Y (vc.symm (tg e))) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro X hX
        exact (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.arrowCongr vc (Equiv.refl J))
          (g := fun y : V → J =>
            ∏ e : E, w (X (ur.symm (sr e))) (y (tg e)))).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ X : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ Y : Fin q → J,
        RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight w t X Y * s ^ O.card := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro X hX
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro Y hY
        exact hsplit X Y
    _ = (∑ X : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ Y : Fin q → J,
          RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight w t X Y) * s ^ O.card := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro X hX
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum t w * s ^ O.card := by
        rfl
    _ ≤ ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ r * c ^ q) * s ^ O.card := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum_le t w a c hwnn hcol hrow ha hc)
          (pow_nonneg hs O.card)
    _ = (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ (Fintype.card U - 1) *
          c ^ (Fintype.card V) * s ^ (Fintype.card E -
            (Fintype.card U - 1 + Fintype.card V)) := by
        rw [hr, hq', hO]

name: NLAlib.good_succ_of_row
statement:
private lemma good_succ_of_row {r q : ℕ} (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V)
    (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q)
    (f : Fin (r+1) ↪ U) (g : Fin q ↪ V)
    (hocc : ∀ i j, (i, j) ∈ t.edgeList →
      ∃ e, sr e = f i ∧ tg e = g j)
    (u' : U) (hu' : u' ∉ Set.range f) (j : Fin q) (e0 : E)
    (he0 : sr e0 = u' ∧ tg e0 = g j) :
    Good sr tg (r + 1 + q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let f' : Fin ((r+1)+1) ↪ U := Fin.Embedding.cons f hu'
  let g' : Fin q ↪ V := g
  refine ⟨r + 1, q, RowRootedBipartiteTree.addRow t j, f', g', ?_, ?_⟩
  · ac_rfl
  · intro i j' hij
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hij with h | h
    · have hi : i = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have hj : j' = j := congrArg Prod.snd h
      rw [hi, hj]
      refine ⟨e0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [f', he0.1]
      · simp [g', he0.2]
    · rcases List.mem_map.mp h with ⟨e, he, heeq⟩
      have hi : i = Fin.succ e.1 := (congrArg Prod.fst heeq).symm
      have hj : j' = e.2 := (congrArg Prod.snd heeq).symm
      rcases hocc e.1 e.2 he with ⟨e1, hsr, htg⟩
      refine ⟨e1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hi]
        simpa [f'] using hsr
      · rw [hj]
        simpa [g'] using htg

name: NLAlib.good_succ_of_column
statement:
private lemma good_succ_of_column {r q : ℕ} (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V)
    (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q)
    (f : Fin (r+1) ↪ U) (g : Fin q ↪ V)
    (hocc : ∀ i j, (i, j) ∈ t.edgeList →
      ∃ e, sr e = f i ∧ tg e = g j)
    (v' : V) (hv' : v' ∉ Set.range g) (u : Fin (r+1)) (e0 : E)
    (he0 : sr e0 = f u ∧ tg e0 = v') :
    Good sr tg (r + 1 + q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let g' : Fin (q+1) ↪ V := Fin.Embedding.cons g hv'
  let f' : Fin (r+1) ↪ U := f
  refine ⟨r, q + 1, RowRootedBipartiteTree.addColumn t u, f', g', ?_, ?_⟩
  · ac_rfl
  · intro i j' hij
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hij with h | h
    · have hi : i = u := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have hj : j' = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd h
      rw [hi, hj]
      refine ⟨e0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [f', he0.1]
      · simp [g', he0.2]
    · rcases List.mem_map.mp h with ⟨e, he, heeq⟩
      have hi : i = e.1 := (congrArg Prod.fst heeq).symm
      have hj : j' = Fin.succ e.2 := (congrArg Prod.snd heeq).symm
      rcases hocc e.1 e.2 he with ⟨e1, hsr, htg⟩
      refine ⟨e1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hi]
        simpa [f'] using hsr
      · rw [hj]
        simpa [g'] using htg

name: NLAlib.good_one
statement: private lemma good_one [Nonempty U] (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V) : Good sr tg 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let u0 : U := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty U)
  let f : Fin 1 ↪ U := ⟨fun _ => u0, by
    intro a b h
    exact Subsingleton.elim a b⟩
  let g : Fin 0 ↪ V := ⟨fun x => x.elim0, by intro a; exact a.elim0⟩
  refine ⟨0, 0, RowRootedBipartiteTree.root, f, g, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  simp [RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList] at hij

name: NLAlib.good_le_card
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨r, q, t, f, g, rfl, hocc⟩
  have hf : r + 1 ≤ Fintype.card U := by
    simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding f)
  have hg : q ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding g)
  exact add_le_add hf hg

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.exists_spanning_tree_syntax
statement:
theorem RowRootedBipartiteTree.exists_spanning_tree_syntax
    [Fintype U] [Fintype V] [Nonempty U]
    (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V)
    (hG : (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph sr tg).Connected) :
    ∃ (r q : ℕ) (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q)
      (ur : Fin (r+1) ≃ U) (vc : Fin q ≃ V)
      (occ : Fin t.edgeList.length ↪ E),
      ∀ k : Fin t.edgeList.length,
        sr (occ k) = ur (t.edgeList.get k).1 ∧
        tg (occ k) = vc (t.edgeList.get k).2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card U + Fintype.card V
  have hone : Good sr tg 1 := good_one sr tg
  have hone_le : 1 ≤ n := by
    dsimp [n]
    have hpos : 1 ≤ Fintype.card U := Nat.succ_le_of_lt Fintype.card_pos
    exact le_trans hpos (Nat.le_add_right (Fintype.card U) (Fintype.card V))
  let m := Nat.findGreatest (Good sr tg) n
  have hm_good : Good sr tg m := Nat.findGreatest_spec (m := 1) (P := Good sr tg)
    (n := n) hone_le hone
  rcases hm_good with ⟨r, q, t, f, g, hm_eq, hocc⟩
  have hf_surj : Function.Surjective f := by
    by_contra hnsf
    rcases not_forall.mp hnsf with ⟨u, hu⟩
    have hu_notmem : u ∉ Set.range f := by
      simpa [Set.mem_range] using hu
    let S : Set (Sum U V) := Sum.inl '' Set.range f ∪ Sum.inr '' Set.range g
    have hstart : Sum.inl (f 0) ∈ S := by
      left
      exact ⟨f 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hend : Sum.inl u ∉ S := by
      intro hmem
      rw [Set.mem_union] at hmem
      rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
      · rcases hmem with ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩
        rcases hx with ⟨i, hi⟩
        have this : u = x := Sum.inl.inj hxeq.symm
        exact hu ⟨i, by rw [this]; exact hi⟩
      · rcases hmem with ⟨v, hv, hveq⟩
        exact Sum.inl_ne_inr hveq.symm
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hG (Sum.inl (f 0)) (Sum.inl u)
    obtain ⟨d, hdarts, hdfst, hdsnd⟩ := p.exists_boundary_dart S hstart hend
    have hd_adj : (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph sr tg).Adj d.fst d.snd := d.adj
    cases hd : d.snd with
    | inl u' =>
        have hu' : u' ∉ Set.range f := by
          intro hmem
          apply hdsnd
          left
          exact ⟨u', hmem, hd.symm⟩
        rcases hd_adj with ⟨u0, v0, hcase, he⟩
        rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
        · exfalso
          exact Sum.inr_ne_inl (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
        · have hu0 : u0 = u' := Sum.inl.inj (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
          have hv0 : v0 ∈ Set.range g := by
            rcases hdfst with hdfst | hdfst
            · exfalso
              rcases hdfst with ⟨u1, hu1, heq⟩
              exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (heq.trans hcase.1)
            · rcases hdfst with ⟨v1, hv1, heq⟩
              rcases hv1 with ⟨j, hj⟩
              refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
              have this : v1 = v0 := Sum.inr.inj (heq.trans hcase.1)
              simpa [this] using hj
          rcases hv0 with ⟨j, hj⟩
          rcases he with ⟨e0, he0⟩
          have he0' : sr e0 = u' ∧ tg e0 = g j := by
            constructor
            · simpa [hu0] using he0.1
            · rw [hj]
              exact he0.2
          have hgood_succ : Good sr tg (m + 1) := by
            simpa [hm_eq] using good_succ_of_row sr tg t f g hocc
              u' hu' j e0 he0'
          have hnsf' : ¬ Function.Surjective f := by
            intro hsurj
            exact hu' (hsurj u')
          have hcardU_lt : r + 1 < Fintype.card U := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using
              (Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective f f.injective hnsf')
          have hq : q ≤ Fintype.card V := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding g)
          have hrm : r + 1 + 1 ≤ Fintype.card U := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hcardU_lt
          have hmle : m + 1 ≤ n := by
            dsimp [n]
            rw [show m + 1 = (r + 1 + 1) + q by
              rw [hm_eq]
              ac_rfl]
            exact add_le_add hrm hq
          have hmle' : m + 1 ≤ m := Nat.le_findGreatest (m := m + 1)
            (P := Good sr tg) (n := n) hmle hgood_succ
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hmle') (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
    | inr v' =>
        have hv' : v' ∉ Set.range g := by
          intro hmem
          apply hdsnd
          right
          exact ⟨v', hmem, hd.symm⟩
        rcases hd_adj with ⟨u0, v0, hcase, he⟩
        rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
        · have hv0 : v0 = v' := Sum.inr.inj (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
          have hu0 : u0 ∈ Set.range f := by
            rcases hdfst with hdfst | hdfst
            · rcases hdfst with ⟨u1, hu1, heq⟩
              rcases hu1 with ⟨i, hi⟩
              refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
              have this : u1 = u0 := Sum.inl.inj (heq.trans hcase.1)
              simpa [this] using hi
            · exfalso
              rcases hdfst with ⟨v1, hv1, heq⟩
              exact Sum.inr_ne_inl (heq.trans hcase.1)
          rcases hu0 with ⟨i, hi⟩
          rcases he with ⟨e0, he0⟩
          have he0' : sr e0 = f i ∧ tg e0 = v' := by
            constructor
            · rw [hi]
              exact he0.1
            · simpa [hv0] using he0.2
          have hgood_succ : Good sr tg (m + 1) := by
            simpa [hm_eq] using good_succ_of_column sr tg t f g hocc
              v' hv' i e0 he0'
          have hnsg' : ¬ Function.Surjective g := by
            intro hsurj
            exact hv' (hsurj v')
          have hcardV_lt : q < Fintype.card V := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using
              (Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective g g.injective hnsg')
          have hf : r + 1 ≤ Fintype.card U := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding f)
          have hq : q + 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hcardV_lt
          have hmle : m + 1 ≤ n := by
            dsimp [n]
            rw [show m + 1 = (r + 1) + (q + 1) by
              rw [hm_eq]
              ac_rfl]
            exact add_le_add hf hq
          have hmle' : m + 1 ≤ m := Nat.le_findGreatest (m := m + 1)
            (P := Good sr tg) (n := n) hmle hgood_succ
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hmle') (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
        · exfalso
          exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
  have hg_surj : Function.Surjective g := by
    by_contra hnsg
    rcases not_forall.mp hnsg with ⟨v, hv⟩
    have hv_notmem : v ∉ Set.range g := by
      simpa [Set.mem_range] using hv
    let S : Set (Sum U V) := Sum.inl '' Set.range f ∪ Sum.inr '' Set.range g
    have hstart : Sum.inl (f 0) ∈ S := by
      left
      exact ⟨f 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hend : Sum.inr v ∉ S := by
      intro hmem
      rw [Set.mem_union] at hmem
      rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
      · rcases hmem with ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩
        exact Sum.inl_ne_inr hxeq
      · rcases hmem with ⟨w, hw, hweq⟩
        rcases hw with ⟨j, hj⟩
        have this : v = w := Sum.inr.inj hweq.symm
        exact hv ⟨j, by rw [this]; exact hj⟩
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hG (Sum.inl (f 0)) (Sum.inr v)
    obtain ⟨d, hdarts, hdfst, hdsnd⟩ := p.exists_boundary_dart S hstart hend
    have hd_adj : (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph sr tg).Adj d.fst d.snd := d.adj
    cases hd : d.snd with
    | inl u' =>
        have hu' : u' ∉ Set.range f := by
          intro hmem
          apply hdsnd
          left
          exact ⟨u', hmem, hd.symm⟩
        rcases hd_adj with ⟨u0, v0, hcase, he⟩
        rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
        · exfalso
          exact Sum.inr_ne_inl (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
        · have hu0 : u0 = u' := Sum.inl.inj (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
          have hv0 : v0 ∈ Set.range g := by
            rcases hdfst with hdfst | hdfst
            · exfalso
              rcases hdfst with ⟨u1, hu1, heq⟩
              exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (heq.trans hcase.1)
            · rcases hdfst with ⟨v1, hv1, heq⟩
              rcases hv1 with ⟨j, hj⟩
              refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
              have this : v1 = v0 := Sum.inr.inj (heq.trans hcase.1)
              simpa [this] using hj
          rcases hv0 with ⟨j, hj⟩
          rcases he with ⟨e0, he0⟩
          have he0' : sr e0 = u' ∧ tg e0 = g j := by
            constructor
            · simpa [hu0] using he0.1
            · rw [hj]
              exact he0.2
          have hgood_succ : Good sr tg (m + 1) := by
            simpa [hm_eq] using good_succ_of_row sr tg t f g hocc
              u' hu' j e0 he0'
          have hnsf' : ¬ Function.Surjective f := by
            intro hsurj
            exact hu' (hsurj u')
          have hcardU_lt : r + 1 < Fintype.card U := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using
              (Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective f f.injective hnsf')
          have hq : q ≤ Fintype.card V := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding g)
          have hrm : r + 1 + 1 ≤ Fintype.card U := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hcardU_lt
          have hmle : m + 1 ≤ n := by
            dsimp [n]
            rw [show m + 1 = (r + 1 + 1) + q by
              rw [hm_eq]
              ac_rfl]
            exact add_le_add hrm hq
          have hmle' : m + 1 ≤ m := Nat.le_findGreatest (m := m + 1)
            (P := Good sr tg) (n := n) hmle hgood_succ
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hmle') (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
    | inr v' =>
        have hv' : v' ∉ Set.range g := by
          intro hmem
          apply hdsnd
          right
          exact ⟨v', hmem, hd.symm⟩
        rcases hd_adj with ⟨u0, v0, hcase, he⟩
        rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
        · have hv0 : v0 = v' := Sum.inr.inj (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
          have hu0 : u0 ∈ Set.range f := by
            rcases hdfst with hdfst | hdfst
            · rcases hdfst with ⟨u1, hu1, heq⟩
              rcases hu1 with ⟨i, hi⟩
              refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
              have this : u1 = u0 := Sum.inl.inj (heq.trans hcase.1)
              simpa [this] using hi
            · exfalso
              rcases hdfst with ⟨v1, hv1, heq⟩
              exact Sum.inr_ne_inl (heq.trans hcase.1)
          rcases hu0 with ⟨i, hi⟩
          rcases he with ⟨e0, he0⟩
          have he0' : sr e0 = f i ∧ tg e0 = v' := by
            constructor
            · rw [hi]
              exact he0.1
            · simpa [hv0] using he0.2
          have hgood_succ : Good sr tg (m + 1) := by
            simpa [hm_eq] using good_succ_of_column sr tg t f g hocc
              v' hv' i e0 he0'
          have hnsg' : ¬ Function.Surjective g := by
            intro hsurj
            exact hv' (hsurj v')
          have hcardV_lt : q < Fintype.card V := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using
              (Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective g g.injective hnsg')
          have hf : r + 1 ≤ Fintype.card U := by
            simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_le_of_embedding f)
          have hq : q + 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hcardV_lt
          have hmle : m + 1 ≤ n := by
            dsimp [n]
            rw [show m + 1 = (r + 1) + (q + 1) by
              rw [hm_eq]
              ac_rfl]
            exact add_le_add hf hq
          have hmle' : m + 1 ≤ m := Nat.le_findGreatest (m := m + 1)
            (P := Good sr tg) (n := n) hmle hgood_succ
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hmle') (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
        · exfalso
          exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (hcase.2.symm.trans hd)
  let ur : Fin (r+1) ≃ U := Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨f.injective, hf_surj⟩
  let vc : Fin q ≃ V := Equiv.ofBijective g ⟨g.injective, hg_surj⟩
  let occFun : Fin t.edgeList.length → E :=
    fun k => Classical.choose
      (hocc (t.edgeList.get k).1 (t.edgeList.get k).2
        (List.get_mem (t.edgeList) k))
  let occFinal : Fin t.edgeList.length ↪ E :=
    ⟨occFun, by
      intro k1 k2 h
      have hs1 := Classical.choose_spec
        (hocc (t.edgeList.get k1).1 (t.edgeList.get k1).2
          (List.get_mem (t.edgeList) k1))
      have hs2 := Classical.choose_spec
        (hocc (t.edgeList.get k2).1 (t.edgeList.get k2).2
          (List.get_mem (t.edgeList) k2))
      have hrow : (t.edgeList.get k1).1 = (t.edgeList.get k2).1 := by
        apply f.injective
        calc
          f (t.edgeList.get k1).1 = sr (occFun k1) := hs1.1.symm
          _ = sr (occFun k2) := by rw [h]
          _ = f (t.edgeList.get k2).1 := hs2.1
      have hcol : (t.edgeList.get k1).2 = (t.edgeList.get k2).2 := by
        apply g.injective
        calc
          g (t.edgeList.get k1).2 = tg (occFun k1) := hs1.2.symm
          _ = tg (occFun k2) := by rw [h]
          _ = g (t.edgeList.get k2).2 := hs2.2
      have hedge : t.edgeList.get k1 = t.edgeList.get k2 := Prod.ext hrow hcol
      exact (RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList_nodup t).injective_get hedge⟩
  refine ⟨r, q, t, ur, vc, occFinal, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hspec := Classical.choose_spec
    (hocc (t.edgeList.get k).1 (t.edgeList.get k).2
      (List.get_mem (t.edgeList) k))
  constructor
  · calc
      sr (occFinal k) = f (t.edgeList.get k).1 := hspec.1
      _ = ur (t.edgeList.get k).1 := by
        simp [ur, Equiv.ofBijective]
  · calc
      tg (occFinal k) = g (t.edgeList.get k).2 := hspec.2
      _ = vc (t.edgeList.get k).2 := by
        simp [vc, Equiv.ofBijective]

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.exists_spanning_tree_occurrences
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_tree_occurrences
    (src dst : E → V)
    (hG : (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph src dst).Connected) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : LeafTree n) (f : Fin (n + 2) ≃ V)
      (occ : Fin t.edgeList.length ↪ E),
      ∀ k, s(src (occ k), dst (occ k)) =
        s(f (t.edgeList.get k).1, f (t.edgeList.get k).2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, t, f, ht⟩ := exists_spanning_tree (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph src dst) hG
  have hex (k : Fin t.edgeList.length) :
      ∃ e : E, s(src e, dst e) = s(f (t.edgeList.get k).1, f (t.edgeList.get k).2) := by
    obtain ⟨_hne, e, he⟩ := ht (t.edgeList.get k) (List.get_mem _ _)
    exact ⟨e, Sym2.eq_iff.mpr he⟩
  choose occ hocc using hex
  have hkey : Function.Injective (fun k : Fin t.edgeList.length =>
      s((t.edgeList.get k).1, (t.edgeList.get k).2)) := by
    intro k l hkl
    have heq :
        (t.edgeList.map (fun e => s(e.1, e.2))).get ⟨k.val, by simp⟩ =
          (t.edgeList.map (fun e => s(e.1, e.2))).get ⟨l.val, by simp⟩ := by
      simpa only [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map] using hkl
    have hindices := t.edgeList_sym2_nodup.injective_get heq
    have hh : k.val = l.val := congrArg (fun z => z.val) hindices
    exact Fin.ext hh
  have hinj : Function.Injective occ := by
    intro k l hkl
    apply hkey
    apply Sym2.map.injective f.injective
    change s(f (t.edgeList.get k).1, f (t.edgeList.get k).2) =
      s(f (t.edgeList.get l).1, f (t.edgeList.get l).2)
    rw [← hocc k, ← hocc l, hkl]
  exact ⟨n, t, f, ⟨occ, hinj⟩, hocc⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_prod_edge_weight_le_of_connected
statement:
theorem sum_prod_edge_weight_le_of_connected
    (src dst : E → V) (hG : (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph src dst).Connected)
    (hp : 0 < Fintype.card E)
    (w : α → α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j, w i j = w j i)
    (s : α → ℝ) (hcap : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ s i)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hda : (∑ i, (∑ j, w i j) ^ Fintype.card E) ≤ a ^ Fintype.card E)
    (hsb : (∑ i, s i ^ Fintype.card E) ≤ b ^ Fintype.card E) :
    (∑ x : V → α, ∏ e : E, w (x (src e)) (x (dst e))) ≤
      a ^ (Fintype.card V - 1) * b ^ (Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card V - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hD : 0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j
  case neg =>
    have hzero : (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j) = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hD)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw i j)
    have hwzero (i j : α) : w i j = 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hw i j)).mp
        ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw i j)).mp hzero i (by simp)) j (by simp)
    simp only [hwzero, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, zero_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hp),
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
    positivity
  obtain ⟨n, t, f, occ, hend⟩ := LeafTree.exists_spanning_tree_occurrences src dst hG
  let T : Finset E := Finset.univ.map occ
  let O : Finset E := Tᶜ
  let c : ℕ := O.card
  let q : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ := fun v => (O.filter (fun e => f.symm (src e) = v)).card
  have hq : ∑ v, q v = c := by
    simpa only [q, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.filter_true_of_mem,
      Finset.mem_univ, Finset.filter_true] using
      Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter O Finset.univ (fun e => f.symm (src e))
  have hcardV : Fintype.card V = n + 2 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_congr f).symm
  have hTcard : T.card = n + 1 := by simp only [T, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, t.edgeList_length]
  have hOcard : c = Fintype.card E - (n + 1) := by
    simp only [c, O, Finset.card_compl, hTcard]
  have hTle : n + 1 ≤ Fintype.card E := by
    rw [← hTcard]
    exact Finset.card_le_univ T
  have htotal : n + c + 1 = Fintype.card E := by omega
  have hs (i : α) : 0 ≤ s i := (hw i i).trans (hcap i i)
  have hTprod (X : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
      (∏ e ∈ T, w (X (f.symm (src e))) (X (f.symm (dst e)))) = t.edgeWeight w X := by
    rw [Finset.prod_map]
    have hterm (k : Fin t.edgeList.length) :
        w (X (f.symm (src (occ k)))) (X (f.symm (dst (occ k)))) =
          w (X (t.edgeList.get k).1) (X (t.edgeList.get k).2) := by
      rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp (hend k) with h | h
      · rw [h.1, h.2, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      · rw [h.1, h.2, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hsymm]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [t.edgeWeight_eq_prod_edgeList, ← List.prod_ofFn]
    congr 1
    rw [List.ofFn_comp' (f := fun k : Fin t.edgeList.length => t.edgeList.get k)
      (g := fun e => w (X e.1) (X e.2)), List.ofFn_get]
  have hOprod (X : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
      (∏ e ∈ O, s (X (f.symm (src e)))) = ∏ v, s (X v) ^ q v := by
    symm
    simpa only [Finset.prod_const, q] using
      Finset.prod_fiberwise' O (fun e => f.symm (src e)) (fun v => s (X v))
  have hsplit (X : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
      (∏ e : E, w (X (f.symm (src e))) (X (f.symm (dst e)))) ≤
        t.edgeWeight w X * ∏ v, s (X v) ^ q v := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_prod_compl T, hTprod, ← hOprod]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (t.edgeWeight_nonneg w hw X)
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun e _ => hw _ _) (fun e _ => hcap _ _)
  have htree := t.sum_edgeWeight_mul_prod_pow_le_of_power_sums w hw hsymm hD s hs q c hq a b ha hb
    (by simpa only [htotal] using hda) (by simpa only [htotal] using hsb)
  calc
    (∑ x : V → α, ∏ e : E, w (x (src e)) (x (dst e))) =
        ∑ X : Fin (n + 2) → α, ∏ e : E, w (X (f.symm (src e))) (X (f.symm (dst e))) := by
      exact (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.arrowCongr f (Equiv.refl α))
        (fun x : V → α => ∏ e : E, w (x (src e)) (x (dst e)))).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ X : Fin (n + 2) → α, t.edgeWeight w X * ∏ v, s (X v) ^ q v :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun X _ => hsplit X
    _ ≤ a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ c := htree
    _ = _ := by rw [hcardV, show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega, hOcard]

name: Finset.card_injective_functions_image
statement:
theorem card_injective_functions_image (S : Finset α) (hS : S.card = k) :
    (((univ : Finset (Fin k → α)).filter Function.Injective).filter
      (fun h => univ.image h = S)).card = k.factorial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := ((univ : Finset (Fin k → α)).filter Function.Injective).filter
    (fun h => univ.image h = S)
  have e : D ≃ {h : Fin k → α // Function.Injective h ∧ univ.image h = S} :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun _ => by simp [D]
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe D, Fintype.card_congr e,
    Fintype.card_congr (injectiveImageEquiv S),
    Fintype.card_equiv (S.equivFinOfCardEq hS).symm, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Finset.sum_injective_image_eq_factorial_nsmul
statement:
theorem sum_injective_image_eq_factorial_nsmul {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : Finset α → M) (k : ℕ) :
