    (∑ h : Fin k → α, if Function.Injective h then f (univ.image h) else 0) =
      k.factorial • ∑ S ∈ (univ : Finset α).powersetCard k, f S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← sum_filter]
  have hMap : ∀ h ∈ ((univ : Finset (Fin k → α)).filter Function.Injective),
      univ.image h ∈ (univ : Finset α).powersetCard k := by
    intro h hh
    rw [mem_powersetCard]
    exact ⟨subset_univ _, by rw [card_image_of_injective _ (mem_filter.mp hh).2, card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin]⟩
  rw [← sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to' hMap f, ← sum_nsmul]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  rw [sum_const, card_injective_functions_image S (mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2]

name: Finset.sum_powersetCard_prod_equiv
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_prod_equiv {β R : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [CommSemiring R] (e : α ≃ β) (f : β → R) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ S ∈ (univ : Finset α).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, f (e i)) =
      ∑ S ∈ (univ : Finset β).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_univ_equiv e, powersetCard_map, sum_map]
  simp [mapEmbedding, prod_map]

proof: := rfl

proof: := rfl

name: Equiv.compl_finset_disjSum
statement:
theorem compl_finset_disjSum {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) :
    (S.disjSum T)ᶜ = Sᶜ.disjSum Tᶜ

:= by

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.pairingSum_eq_sum_quotient
statement:
lemma pairingSum_eq_sum_quotient (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C) (alpha beta : E → O)
    [Fintype R] [Fintype C] [Fintype E] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    [Fintype (RowQuotient sr alpha beta)] [Fintype (ColQuotient tg alpha beta)]
    [DecidableEq (RowQuotient sr alpha beta)] [DecidableEq (ColQuotient tg alpha beta)]
    (w : I → J → ℝ) :
    pairingSum sr tg alpha beta w =
      ∑ f : RowQuotient sr alpha beta → I, ∑ g : ColQuotient tg alpha beta → J,
        ∏ e : E, w (f (rowEnd sr alpha beta e)) (g (colEnd tg alpha beta e))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pairingSum] using (sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient sr tg alpha beta w)

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.pairingSum_cycle_le
statement:
theorem pairingSum_cycle_le [Fintype E] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (q : ℕ) (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    (hcover : Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta))
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (a c : ℝ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hwle : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ 1)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ a)
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ c)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) *
        a ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) *
        c ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w =
      ∑ f : RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → I,
        ∑ g : ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → J,
          ∏ e : E, w (f (rowEnd (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta e))
            (g (colEnd (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta e)) := by
    exact pairingSum_eq_sum_quotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w
  rw [hsum]
  have hG : (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph
      (rowEnd (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) (colEnd (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)).Connected :=
    bipartiteOccurrenceGraph_quotient_cycle_connected q alpha beta hcover
  have hb : (∑ x : RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → I,
        ∑ y : ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → J,
          ∏ e : E, w (x (rowEnd (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta e))
            (y (colEnd (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta e))) ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) *
        a ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) *
        c ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
    have hcore := sum_prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_of_connected
      (U := RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)
      (V := ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)
      (E := E) (I := I) (J := J)
      (sr := rowEnd (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)
      (tg := colEnd (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)
      hG w a c 1 hwnn hcol hrow hwle ha hc (by norm_num)
    simpa [one_pow, mul_one] using hcore
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.pairingSum_cycle_le_of_nat_bounds
statement:
theorem pairingSum_cycle_le_of_nat_bounds [Fintype E] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (q : ℕ) (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    (hcover : Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta))
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (a c : ℝ) (d1 d2 : ℕ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hwle : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ 1)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ a)
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ c)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hd1 : a ≤ (d1 : ℝ)) (hd2 : c ≤ (d2 : ℝ)) :
    pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) *
        (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 := pairingSum_cycle_le q alpha beta hcover w a c hwnn hwle hcol hrow ha hc
  have hpow1 : a ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) ≤
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hd1 _
  have hpow2 : c ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) ≤
      (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hc hd2 _
  have hcard : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hd1nn : 0 ≤ (d1 : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d1
  calc
    pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w
        ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * c ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := h1
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * c ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow1 hcard) (pow_nonneg hc _)
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow2 (mul_nonneg hcard (pow_nonneg hd1nn _))

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.pairingSum_cycle_one
statement:
theorem pairingSum_cycle_one [Fintype E]
    (q : ℕ) (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    (d1 d2 : ℕ) :
    pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta
      (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) =
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta
        (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) =
      ∑ f : RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d1,
        ∑ g : ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d2,
          ∏ e : E, (1 : ℝ) := by
    exact pairingSum_eq_sum_quotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta
      (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ))
  rw [hsum]
  have hcount : (∑ f : RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d1,
        ∑ g : ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d2,
          (1 : ℝ)) =
      (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d1) : ℝ) *
        (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d2) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  calc
    (∑ f : RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d1,
        ∑ g : ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d2,
          ∏ e : E, (1 : ℝ))
        = ∑ f : RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d1,
            ∑ g : ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d2,
              (1 : ℝ) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro f hf
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro g hg
          simp
    _ = (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d1) : ℝ) *
          (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta → Fin d2) : ℝ) := hcount
    _ = (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)) *
          (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
          rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
          rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow]

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.pairingSum_cycle_div_card_le
statement:
theorem pairingSum_cycle_div_card_le [Fintype E] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Nonempty I] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (q : ℕ) (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    (hcover : Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta))
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (d1 d2 : ℕ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hwle : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ 1)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ (d1 : ℝ))
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ (d2 : ℝ))
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) :
    pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w /
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤
      pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta
        (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) / (d1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hIposN : 0 < Fintype.card I := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (inferInstance : Nonempty I)
  have hIpos : 0 < (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hIposN
  have hd1pos : 0 < (d1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  have hd1ne : (d1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd1pos
  have hUpos : 0 < Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (rowQuotient_nonempty_cycle q alpha beta)
  have hUsub : Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) =
      (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) + 1 :=
    (Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hUpos)).symm
  have hb : pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) *
        (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
    exact pairingSum_cycle_le_of_nat_bounds q alpha beta hcover w (d1 : ℝ) (d2 : ℝ) d1 d2
      hwnn hwle hcol hrow (by exact_mod_cast (le_of_lt hd1)) (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le d2))
      (le_rfl : (d1 : ℝ) ≤ (d1 : ℝ)) (le_rfl : (d2 : ℝ) ≤ (d2 : ℝ))
  have hdiv : pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w /
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hIpos]
    calc
      pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w
          ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := hb
      _ = ((d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta))) * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by ring
  have hunit : pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta
        (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) =
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
    exact pairingSum_cycle_one q alpha beta d1 d2
  have hpowr : (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)) =
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * (d1 : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta))
          = (d1 : ℝ) ^ ((Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) + 1) := by
            exact congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (d1 : ℝ) ^ k) hUsub
      _ = (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * (d1 : ℝ) := by
            rw [pow_succ]
  have hdiv1 : (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) / (d1 : ℝ) =
      (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) *
        (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := by
    rw [hpowr]
    field_simp [hd1ne]
  calc
    pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta w / (Fintype.card I : ℝ)
        ≤ (d1 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta) - 1) * (d2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)) := hdiv
    _ = pairingSum (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta
          (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) / (d1 : ℝ) := by
        rw [hunit]
        exact hdiv1.symm

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList_addRow
statement:
lemma edgeList_addRow {r q : ℕ} (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (v : Fin q) :
    edgeList (addRow t v) =
      (0, v) :: (edgeList t).map (fun e => (Fin.succ e.1, e.2))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList_addColumn
statement:
lemma edgeList_addColumn {r q : ℕ} (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (u : Fin (r+1)) :
    edgeList (addColumn t u) =
      (u, 0) :: (edgeList t).map (fun e => (e.1, Fin.succ e.2))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight_nonneg
statement:
theorem weight_nonneg (w : I → J → ℝ) {r q : ℕ} (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j) (x : Fin (r+1) → I) (y : Fin q → J) :
    0 ≤ weight w t x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold weight
  exact List.prod_nonneg
    (s := (edgeList t).map (fun e => w (x e.1) (y e.2)))
    (by
      intro a ha
      rcases List.mem_map.mp ha with ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
      exact hwnn (x e.1) (y e.2))

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight_addRow_eq
statement:
theorem weight_addRow_eq (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (v : Fin q)
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (x : Fin ((r+1)+1) → I) (y : Fin q → J) :
    weight w (addRow t v) x y =
      w (x 0) (y v) * weight w t (fun i => x (Fin.succ i)) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold weight
  rw [edgeList_addRow]
  rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
  congr 1
  rw [List.map_map]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.weight_addColumn_eq
statement:
theorem weight_addColumn_eq (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (u : Fin (r+1))
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (x : Fin (r+1) → I) (y : Fin (q+1) → J) :
    weight w (addColumn t u) x y =
      w (x u) (y 0) * weight w t x (fun j => y (Fin.succ j))
proof:
:= by
  unfold weight
  rw [edgeList_addColumn]
  rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
  congr 1
  rw [List.map_map]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.optionPiEquiv_apply_none
statement:
private lemma optionPiEquiv_apply_none {α : Type*} (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n+1) → α) :
    (optionPiEquiv n x) none = x 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [optionPiEquiv]

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.optionPiEquiv_apply_some
proof:
:= by
  simp [optionPiEquiv]

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.sum_optionPiEquiv
statement:
private lemma sum_optionPiEquiv {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {n q : ℕ}
    (F : (Option (Fin n) → I) → (Fin q → J) → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : Fin (n+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
        F (optionPiEquiv n x) y) =
      ∑ x : Option (Fin n) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J, F x y
proof:
:= by
  exact Equiv.sum_comp (optionPiEquiv (α := I) n)
    (g := fun x' => ∑ y : Fin q → J, F x' y)

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList_length
statement:
theorem edgeList_length (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) :
    (edgeList t).length = r + q
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | root => simp [edgeList]
  | addRow t v ih =>
      simp [edgeList, List.length_map, ih]
      ac_rfl
  | addColumn t u ih =>
      simp [edgeList, List.length_map, ih]
      ac_rfl

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.edgeList_nodup
statement:
theorem edgeList_nodup (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) :
    (edgeList t).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | root => simp [edgeList]
  | addRow t v ih =>
      simp only [edgeList]
      refine List.Nodup.cons ?_ ?_
      · intro hmem
        rcases List.mem_map.mp hmem with ⟨e, he, heeq⟩
        have hzero : Fin.succ e.1 = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst heeq
        exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero e.1) hzero
      · refine List.Nodup.map ?_ ih
        intro a b h
        rcases Prod.ext_iff.mp h with ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact Prod.ext (Fin.succ_injective _ h1) h2
  | addColumn t u ih =>
      simp only [edgeList]
      refine List.Nodup.cons ?_ ?_
      · intro hmem
        rcases List.mem_map.mp hmem with ⟨e, he, heeq⟩
        have hzero : Fin.succ e.2 = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd heeq
        exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero e.2) hzero
      · refine List.Nodup.map ?_ ih
        intro a b h
        rcases Prod.ext_iff.mp h with ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact Prod.ext h1 (Fin.succ_injective _ h2)

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum_addRow_eq
statement:
theorem partitionSum_addRow_eq (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (v : Fin q)
    (w : I → J → ℝ) :
    partitionSum (addRow t v) w =
      ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
        (∑ i : I, w i (y v)) * weight w t x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    partitionSum (addRow t v) w
        = ∑ x : Fin ((r+1)+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
            w (x 0) (y v) * weight w t (fun i => x (Fin.succ i)) y := by
          simp [partitionSum, weight_addRow_eq]
    _ = ∑ x : Option (Fin (r+1)) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
            w (x none) (y v) * weight w t (fun i => x (some i)) y := by
          let F : (Option (Fin (r+1)) → I) → (Fin q → J) → ℝ :=
            fun x' y => w (x' none) (y v) * weight w t (fun i => x' (some i)) y
          calc
            (∑ x : Fin ((r+1)+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
                w (x 0) (y v) * weight w t (fun i => x (Fin.succ i)) y)
                = ∑ x : Fin ((r+1)+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
                    F (optionPiEquiv (r+1) x) y := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
                  intro x hx
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
                  intro y hy
                  simp [F, optionPiEquiv_apply_none, optionPiEquiv_apply_some]
            _ = ∑ x : Option (Fin (r+1)) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J, F x y := by
                  exact sum_optionPiEquiv (n := r+1) F
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
            (∑ i : I, w i (y v)) * weight w t x y := by
          exact sum_row_leaf_mul_eq_sum_column_sum_mul (U := Fin (r+1)) (V := Fin q)
            (I := I) (J := J) (v := v) (w := w)
            (F := fun x' y => weight w t x' y)

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum_addColumn_eq
statement:
theorem partitionSum_addColumn_eq (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (u : Fin (r+1))
    (w : I → J → ℝ) :
    partitionSum (addColumn t u) w =
      ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
        (∑ j : J, w (x u) j) * weight w t x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    partitionSum (addColumn t u) w
        = ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q+1) → J,
            w (x u) (y 0) * weight w t x (fun j => y (Fin.succ j)) := by
          simp [partitionSum, weight_addColumn_eq]
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q+1) → J,
            w (x u) ((optionPiEquiv q y) none) *
              weight w t x (fun j => (optionPiEquiv q y) (some j)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro y hy
          simp [optionPiEquiv_apply_none, optionPiEquiv_apply_some]
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Option (Fin q) → J,
            w (x u) (y none) * weight w t x (fun j => y (some j)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro x hx
          exact Equiv.sum_comp (optionPiEquiv (α := J) q)
            (g := fun y' : Option (Fin q) → J =>
              w (x u) (y' none) * weight w t x (fun j => y' (some j)))
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
            (∑ j : J, w (x u) j) * weight w t x y := by
          exact sum_column_leaf_mul_eq_sum_row_sum_mul (U := Fin (r+1)) (V := Fin q)
            (I := I) (J := J) (u := u) (w := w)
            (F := fun x y => weight w t x y)

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum_addRow_le
statement:
theorem partitionSum_addRow_le (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (v : Fin q)
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ a) :
    partitionSum (addRow t v) w ≤ a * partitionSum t w
proof:
:= by
  rw [partitionSum_addRow_eq t v w]
  calc
    (∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
        (∑ i : I, w i (y v)) * weight w t x y)
        ≤ ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
            a * weight w t x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro y hy
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcol (y v)) (weight_nonneg w t hwnn x y)
    _ = a * partitionSum t w := by
          simp [partitionSum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum_addColumn_le
statement:
theorem partitionSum_addColumn_le (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q) (u : Fin (r+1))
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ c) :
    partitionSum (addColumn t u) w ≤ c * partitionSum t w
proof:
:= by
  rw [partitionSum_addColumn_eq t u w]
  calc
    (∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
        (∑ j : J, w (x u) j) * weight w t x y)
        ≤ ∑ x : Fin (r+1) → I, ∑ y : Fin q → J,
            c * weight w t x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro y hy
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrow (x u)) (weight_nonneg w t hwnn x y)
    _ = c * partitionSum t w := by
          simp [partitionSum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.RowRootedBipartiteTree.partitionSum_le
statement:
theorem partitionSum_le (t : RowRootedBipartiteTree r q)
    (w : I → J → ℝ) (a c : ℝ)
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ a)
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ c)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    partitionSum t w ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ r * c ^ q
proof:
:= by
  refine RowRootedBipartiteTree.rec
    (motive := fun r q t => partitionSum t w ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ r * c ^ q)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ t
  · simp [partitionSum, weight, edgeList]
  · intro r q t v ih
    calc
      partitionSum (addRow t v) w ≤ a * partitionSum t w :=
        partitionSum_addRow_le t v w a hwnn hcol
      _ ≤ a * ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ r * c ^ q) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih ha
      _ = (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ (r+1) * c ^ q := by
        rw [pow_succ']
        ring
  · intro r q t u ih
    calc
      partitionSum (addColumn t u) w ≤ c * partitionSum t w :=
        partitionSum_addColumn_le t u w c hwnn hrow
      _ ≤ c * ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ r * c ^ q) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hc
      _ = (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * a ^ r * c ^ (q+1) := by
        rw [pow_succ']
        ring

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_edgeWeight_mul_prod_pow_le
statement:
theorem sum_edgeWeight_mul_prod_pow_le
    (w : α → α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j, w i j = w j i)
    (hD : 0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (s : α → ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i)
    (q : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ) (c : ℕ) (hq : ∑ v, q v = c)
    (hN : 0 < n + c) (A B : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hdmoment :
      (∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j)) * (∑ j, w i j) ^ (n + c)) ≤
        A ^ (n + c))
    (hsmoment :
      (∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j)) * s i ^ (n + c)) ≤
        B ^ (n + c)) :
    (∑ x : Fin (n + 2) → α, t.edgeWeight w x * ∏ v, s (x v) ^ q v) ≤
      (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j) * A ^ n * B ^ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP, _hPsum, hmarginal, hdensity⟩ :=
    t.exists_stationary_edgeWeight_factorization w hw hsymm hD
  let e : Sum (Fin (n + 2)) (Fin (n + 2)) → ℕ :=
    Sum.elim t.degreeExcess q
  let f : Sum (Fin (n + 2)) (Fin (n + 2)) → (Fin (n + 2) → α) → ℝ :=
    Sum.elim (fun v x => ∑ j, w (x v) j) (fun v x => s (x v))
  let C : Sum (Fin (n + 2)) (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ :=
    Sum.elim (fun _ => A) (fun _ => B)
  have hf (i) (x : Fin (n + 2) → α) : 0 ≤ f i x := by
    cases i with
    | inl v => exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw _ j
    | inr v => exact hs _
  have he : ∑ i, e i = n + c := by
    simp only [e, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
      t.sum_degreeExcess, hq]
  have hC (i) : 0 < C i := by
    cases i <;> assumption
  have hmoment (i) : (∑ x, P x * f i x ^ (n + c)) ≤ C i ^ (n + c) := by
    cases i with
    | inl v =>
      exact (hmarginal v (fun i => (∑ j, w i j) ^ (n + c))).trans_le hdmoment
    | inr v =>
      exact (hmarginal v (fun i => s i ^ (n + c))).trans_le hsmoment
  have hholder := Real.sum_mul_prod_pow_le_prod_pow P hP f hf e (n + c) hN he C hC hmoment
  have hprod (x : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
      (∏ i, f i x ^ e i) =
        t.excessWeight (fun i => ∑ j, w i j) x * ∏ v, s (x v) ^ q v := by
    simp only [f, e, Fintype.prod_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, excessWeight]
  have hcap : (∏ i, C i ^ e i) = A ^ n * B ^ c := by
    simp only [C, e, Fintype.prod_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
      Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, t.sum_degreeExcess, hq]
  rw [hcap] at hholder
  calc
    (∑ x : Fin (n + 2) → α, t.edgeWeight w x * ∏ v, s (x v) ^ q v) =
        (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j) * ∑ x, P x * ∏ i, f i x ^ e i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      rw [hdensity, hprod]
      ring
    _ ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j) * (A ^ n * B ^ c) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hholder hD.le
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_mul_pow_le_of_power_sums
statement:
private theorem sum_mul_pow_le_of_power_sums
    (d s : α → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i)
    (N : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hda : (∑ i, d i ^ (N + 1)) ≤ a ^ (N + 1))
    (hsb : (∑ i, s i ^ (N + 1)) ≤ b ^ (N + 1)) :
    (∑ i, d i * s i ^ N) ≤ a * b ^ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := Real.sum_mul_prod_pow_le_prod_pow (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => by norm_num)
    (Fin.cons d (Fin.cons s Fin.elim0)) (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> assumption)
    ![1, N] (N + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _) (by simp; omega)
    ![a, b] (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> assumption)
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simpa using (by assumption))
  simpa [Fin.prod_univ_succ] using h

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_edgeWeight_mul_prod_pow_le_of_power_sums
statement:
theorem sum_edgeWeight_mul_prod_pow_le_of_power_sums
    (w : α → α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j, w i j = w j i)
    (hD : 0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (s : α → ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i)
    (q : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ) (c : ℕ) (hq : ∑ v, q v = c)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hda : (∑ i, (∑ j, w i j) ^ (n + c + 1)) ≤ a ^ (n + c + 1))
    (hsb : (∑ i, s i ^ (n + c + 1)) ≤ b ^ (n + c + 1)) :
    (∑ x : Fin (n + 2) → α, t.edgeWeight w x * ∏ v, s (x v) ^ q v) ≤
      a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hN : 0 < n + c
  case neg =>
    have hn : n = 0 := by omega
    have hc : c = 0 := by omega
    subst n c
    have hq0 (v) : q v = 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)).mp hq v (by simp)
    cases t
    simp only [hq0, pow_zero, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
    change (∑ x : Fin 2 → α, edge.edgeWeight w x) ≤ a ^ 1
    rw [sum_edgeWeight_edge, pow_one]
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using hda
  let N := n + c
  let D : ℝ := ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j
  have hDne : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  have hd (i : α) : 0 ≤ ∑ j, w i j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw i j
  have hmix := sum_mul_pow_le_of_power_sums (fun i => ∑ j, w i j) s hd hs N a b ha hb hda hsb
  let A : ℝ := (a ^ (N + 1) / D) ^ ((N : ℝ)⁻¹)
  let B : ℝ := (a * b ^ N / D) ^ ((N : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hAbase : 0 < a ^ (N + 1) / D := div_pos (pow_pos ha _) hD
  have hBbase : 0 < a * b ^ N / D := div_pos (mul_pos ha (pow_pos hb _)) hD
  have hA : 0 < A := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hAbase _
  have hB : 0 < B := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hBbase _
  have hApow : A ^ N = a ^ (N + 1) / D := Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hAbase.le hNne
  have hBpow : B ^ N = a * b ^ N / D := Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hBbase.le hNne
  have hdmoment :
      (∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / D) * (∑ j, w i j) ^ N) ≤ A ^ N := by
    rw [hApow]
    calc
      (∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / D) * (∑ j, w i j) ^ N) =
          (∑ i, (∑ j, w i j) ^ (N + 1)) / D := by
        simp only [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← pow_succ', ← Finset.sum_div]
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hda hD.le
  have hsmoment : (∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / D) * s i ^ N) ≤ B ^ N := by
    rw [hBpow]
    calc
      (∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / D) * s i ^ N) = (∑ i, (∑ j, w i j) * s i ^ N) / D := by
        simp only [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div]
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmix hD.le
  have hbound := t.sum_edgeWeight_mul_prod_pow_le w hw hsymm hD s hs q c hq hN A B hA hB
    hdmoment hsmoment
  have hexponent : (a ^ (N + 1)) ^ n * a ^ c = (a ^ (n + 1)) ^ N := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    dsimp [N]
    ring
  have hpower : (D * A ^ n * B ^ c) ^ N = (a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ c) ^ N := by
    calc
      (D * A ^ n * B ^ c) ^ N = D ^ N * (A ^ N) ^ n * (B ^ N) ^ c := by
        simp only [mul_pow, pow_right_comm A n N, pow_right_comm B c N]
      _ = D ^ N * (a ^ (N + 1) / D) ^ n * (a * b ^ N / D) ^ c := by rw [hApow, hBpow]
      _ = (a ^ (N + 1)) ^ n * a ^ c * (b ^ N) ^ c := by
        rw [div_pow, div_pow, mul_pow, show D ^ N = D ^ n * D ^ c from pow_add D n c]
        field_simp
      _ = (a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ c) ^ N := by
        rw [hexponent, pow_right_comm b N c, mul_pow]
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑ x : Fin (n + 2) → α, t.edgeWeight w x * ∏ v, s (x v) ^ q v :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => mul_nonneg (t.edgeWeight_nonneg w hw x)
      (Finset.prod_nonneg fun v _ => pow_nonneg (hs _) _)
  apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ hNne (by positivity : 0 ≤ a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ c)
  exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hbound N).trans_eq hpower

name: Finset.card_le_two_mul_card_image_canonicalPair
statement:
theorem card_le_two_mul_card_image_canonicalPair {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (j : ι → ι) :
    s.card ≤ 2 * (s.image (fun i => (max i (j i), min i (j i)))).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ι → ι × ι := fun i => (max i (j i), min i (j i))
  change s.card ≤ 2 * (s.image f).card
  by_contra h
  have hlt : (s.image f).card * 2 < s.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨e, _, he⟩ := exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to
    (fun i hi => mem_image_of_mem f hi) hlt
  have hsub : s.filter (fun i => f i = e) ⊆ {e.1, e.2} := by
    intro i hi
    have hfi := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
    apply mem_insert.mpr
    by_cases hij : j i ≤ i
    · left
      have hfst := congrArg Prod.fst hfi
      simpa only [f, max_eq_left hij] using hfst
    · right
      apply mem_singleton.mpr
      have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd hfi
      simpa only [f, min_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hij)] using hsnd
  have hc : (s.filter (fun i => f i = e)).card ≤ 2 :=
    (card_le_card hsub).trans (by by_cases heq : e.1 = e.2 <;> simp [heq])
  omega

name: NLAlib.prod_powersetCard_prod_erase_eq_pow
statement:
theorem prod_powersetCard_prod_erase_eq_pow (f : Finset n → M) (k : ℕ) :
    (∏ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1), ∏ i ∈ T, f (T.erase i)) =
      (∏ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k, f S) ^ (Fintype.card n - k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := ((Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1)).sigma (fun T => T)
  let R := ((Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k).sigma (fun S => Finset.univ \ S)
  have hprod : (∏ u ∈ L, f (u.1.erase u.2)) = ∏ v ∈ R, f v.1 := by
    refine Finset.prod_bij' (fun u _ => ⟨u.1.erase u.2, u.2⟩)
      (fun v _ => ⟨insert v.2 v.1, v.2⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro u hu
      rcases Finset.mem_sigma.mp hu with ⟨hT, hi⟩
      have hcard := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hT).2
      apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
      constructor
      · apply Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
        exact ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, by rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, hcard]; omega⟩
      · simp
    · intro v hv
      rcases Finset.mem_sigma.mp hv with ⟨hS, hi⟩
      have hcard := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2
      have hnot : v.2 ∉ v.1 := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2
      apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
      constructor
      · apply Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
        exact ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, by rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnot, hcard]⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    · intro u hu
      have hi := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hu).2
      exact Sigma.ext (Finset.insert_erase hi) (by rfl)
    · intro v hv
      have hi := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hv).2).2
      exact Sigma.ext (Finset.erase_insert hi) (by rfl)
    · intro u _
      rfl
  rw [Finset.prod_sigma', show
    (∏ x ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (k + 1)).sigma (fun a => a), f (x.1.erase x.2)) =
      ∏ v ∈ R, f v.1 from hprod]
  rw [show R = ((Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k).sigma (fun S => Finset.univ \ S) from rfl,
    Finset.prod_sigma]
  calc
    _ = ∏ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard k, f S ^ (Fintype.card n - k) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro S hS
      change (∏ _i ∈ Finset.univ \ S, f S) = _
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ S),
        Finset.card_univ, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2]
    _ = _ := Finset.prod_pow _ _ _

name: Nat.cast_choose_pred_div_choose
statement:
theorem cast_choose_pred_div_choose {n d s : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hds : d ≤ s) (hsn : s ≤ n) :
    (((n - (d - 1)).choose (s - (d - 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((n - d).choose (s - d) : ℝ) =
      ((n - d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n - (d - 1) = n - d + 1 := by omega
  have hs : s - (d - 1) = s - d + 1 := by omega
  rw [hn, hs]
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < ((n - d).choose (s - d) : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hsn d))
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hc.ne' (by positivity)).mpr
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (n - d) (s - d)).symm

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.mk_a_eq_mk_b
statement:
theorem mk_a_eq_mk_b (a b c d : E → V) (e : E) :
    (Quotient.mk'' (a e) : VertexQuotient a b c d) = Quotient.mk'' (b e)
proof:
:= by
  exact Quotient.sound' (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨e, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.mk_c_eq_mk_d
statement:
theorem mk_c_eq_mk_d (a b c d : E → V) (e : E) :
    (Quotient.mk'' (c e) : VertexQuotient a b c d) = Quotient.mk'' (d e)
proof:
:= by
  exact Quotient.sound' (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨e, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.endpointSetoid_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem endpointSetoid_le_ker_iff (a b c d : E → V) (x : V → α) :
    endpointSetoid a b c d ≤ Setoid.ker x ↔
      ∀ e, x (a e) = x (b e) ∧ x (c e) = x (d e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e
    exact ⟨h (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨e, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩),
      h (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨e, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)⟩
  · intro h
    apply Setoid.eqvGen_le
    intro u v huv
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := huv
    rcases he with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact (h e).1
    · exact (h e).2

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient
statement:
theorem sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq α]
    (a b c d : E → V)
    [Fintype (VertexQuotient a b c d)] [DecidableEq (VertexQuotient a b c d)]
    (w : α → α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : V → α, ∏ e : E,
      if x (a e) = x (b e) ∧ x (c e) = x (d e) then w (x (a e)) (x (c e)) else 0) =
      ∑ y : VertexQuotient a b c d → α, ∏ e : E,
        w (y (Quotient.mk'' (a e))) (y (Quotient.mk'' (c e)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : (V → α) → Prop := fun x => endpointSetoid a b c d ≤ Setoid.ker x
  let F : (V → α) → ℝ := fun x => ∏ e : E, w (x (a e)) (x (c e))
  have hindicator (x : V → α) :
      (∏ e : E, if x (a e) = x (b e) ∧ x (c e) = x (d e)
        then w (x (a e)) (x (c e)) else 0) = if P x then F x else 0 := by
    by_cases hx : P x
    · simp only [if_pos hx]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun e _ =>
        if_pos ((endpointSetoid_le_ker_iff a b c d x).mp hx e)
    · rw [if_neg hx]
      have hnot : ¬ ∀ e, x (a e) = x (b e) ∧ x (c e) = x (d e) :=
        fun h => hx ((endpointSetoid_le_ker_iff a b c d x).mpr h)
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ e) (if_neg he)
  simp_rw [hindicator]
  calc
    (∑ x : V → α, if P x then F x else 0) = ∑ x : {x : V → α // P x}, F x := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) F
    _ = ∑ y : VertexQuotient a b c d → α, ∏ e : E,
          w (y (Quotient.mk'' (a e))) (y (Quotient.mk'' (c e))) := by
      exact (Equiv.sum_comp (Setoid.liftEquiv (endpointSetoid a b c d)).symm
        (fun x : {x : V → α // P x} => F x)).symm

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.connected_quotient_of_connected
statement:
theorem connected_quotient_of_connected (a b c d : E → V)
    (hG : (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph (Sum.elim a b) (Sum.elim c d)).Connected) :
    (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph
      (fun e => (Quotient.mk'' (a e) : VertexQuotient a b c d))
      (fun e => (Quotient.mk'' (c e) : VertexQuotient a b c d))).Connected
proof:
:= by
  let Q := VertexQuotient a b c d
  let q : V → Q := Quotient.mk''
  let G := SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph (Sum.elim a b) (Sum.elim c d)
  let H := SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph (fun e => q (a e)) (fun e => q (c e))
  have hstep {u v : V} (h : G.Adj u v) : H.Reachable (q u) (q v) := by
    by_cases huv : q u = q v
    · rw [huv]
    · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      refine ⟨huv, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨_hne, e, he⟩ := h
      cases e with
      | inl e =>
        exact ⟨e, he.imp (fun h => ⟨congrArg q h.1, congrArg q h.2⟩)
          (fun h => ⟨congrArg q h.1, congrArg q h.2⟩)⟩
      | inr e =>
        have hab : q (a e) = q (b e) := mk_a_eq_mk_b a b c d e
        have hcd : q (c e) = q (d e) := mk_c_eq_mk_d a b c d e
        exact ⟨e, he.imp (fun h => ⟨hab.trans (congrArg q h.1), hcd.trans (congrArg q h.2)⟩)
          (fun h => ⟨hab.trans (congrArg q h.1), hcd.trans (congrArg q h.2)⟩)⟩
  have hwalk {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) : H.Reachable (q u) (q v) := by
    induction p with
    | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
    | cons h p ih => exact (hstep h).trans ih
  have : Nonempty Q := ⟨q (Classical.choice hG.nonempty)⟩
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro u v
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep u
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep v
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hG u v
  exact hwalk p

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.sum_prod_indicator_le_of_power_sums
statement:
theorem sum_prod_indicator_le_of_power_sums
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq α]
    (a b c d : E → V)
    [Fintype (VertexQuotient a b c d)] [DecidableEq (VertexQuotient a b c d)]
    (hG : (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph (Sum.elim a b) (Sum.elim c d)).Connected)
    (hp : 0 < Fintype.card E)
    (w : α → α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j) (hsymm : ∀ i j, w i j = w j i)
    (s : α → ℝ) (hcap : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ s i)
    (A B : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hdA : (∑ i, (∑ j, w i j) ^ Fintype.card E) ≤ A ^ Fintype.card E)
    (hsB : (∑ i, s i ^ Fintype.card E) ≤ B ^ Fintype.card E) :
    (∑ x : V → α, ∏ e : E,
      if x (a e) = x (b e) ∧ x (c e) = x (d e) then w (x (a e)) (x (c e)) else 0) ≤
      A ^ (Fintype.card (VertexQuotient a b c d) - 1) *
        B ^ (Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card (VertexQuotient a b c d) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient]
  let Q := VertexQuotient a b c d
  have hconn := connected_quotient_of_connected a b c d hG
  have : Nonempty Q := hconn.nonempty
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Q with hQ | hQ
  · have : Subsingleton Q := hQ
    let : Unique Q := { default := Classical.choice hconn.nonempty, uniq := fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _ }
    have hcard : Fintype.card Q = 1 := Fintype.card_unique
    change (∑ y : Q → α, ∏ e : E,
      w (y (Quotient.mk'' (a e))) (y (Quotient.mk'' (c e)))) ≤
        A ^ (Fintype.card Q - 1) * B ^ (Fintype.card E - (Fintype.card Q - 1))
    rw [hcard]
    simp only [Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, Nat.sub_zero, one_mul]
    calc
      (∑ y : Q → α, ∏ e : E,
          w (y (Quotient.mk'' (a e))) (y (Quotient.mk'' (c e)))) =
          ∑ y : Q → α, w (y default) (y default) ^ Fintype.card E := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y _
        have heq (u : Q) : y u = y default := congrArg y (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
        simp only [heq, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ]
      _ = ∑ i, w i i ^ Fintype.card E :=
        Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.funUnique Q α) (fun i => w i i ^ Fintype.card E)
      _ ≤ ∑ i, s i ^ Fintype.card E :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (hw i i) (hcap i i) _
      _ ≤ _ := hsB
  · have : Nontrivial Q := hQ
    exact sum_prod_edge_weight_le_of_connected
      (fun e => (Quotient.mk'' (a e) : Q)) (fun e => (Quotient.mk'' (c e) : Q))
      hconn hp w hw hsymm s hcap A B hA hB hdA hsB

name: NLAlib.EndpointPairingQuotient.paired_oriented_cycle_connected
statement:
theorem paired_oriented_cycle_connected {k : ℕ} (a b : E → Fin (k + 1))
    (hcover : Function.Surjective (Sum.elim a b)) (flip : E → Bool) :
    (SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph
      (Sum.elim a (fun e => orientedCycleSource (b e) (flip e)))
      (Sum.elim (fun e => finRotate (k + 1) (a e))
        (fun e => orientedCycleTarget (b e) (flip e)))).Connected
proof:
:= by
  let G := SimpleGraph.indexedOccurrenceGraph
    (Sum.elim a (fun e => orientedCycleSource (b e) (flip e)))
    (Sum.elim (fun e => finRotate (k + 1) (a e))
      (fun e => orientedCycleTarget (b e) (flip e)))
  have hstep (r : Fin (k + 1)) (hne : r ≠ finRotate (k + 1) r) :
      G.Adj r (finRotate (k + 1) r) := by
    refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hcover r
    cases e with
    | inl e => exact ⟨Sum.inl e, Or.inl ⟨he, congrArg (finRotate (k + 1)) he⟩⟩
    | inr e =>
      cases hflip : flip e with
      | false =>
        refine ⟨Sum.inr e, Or.inl ?_⟩
        simpa [orientedCycleSource, orientedCycleTarget, hflip] using
          (And.intro he (congrArg (finRotate (k + 1)) he))
      | true =>
        refine ⟨Sum.inr e, Or.inr ?_⟩
        simpa [orientedCycleSource, orientedCycleTarget, hflip] using
          (And.intro (congrArg (finRotate (k + 1)) he) he)
  have hpath : SimpleGraph.pathGraph (k + 1) ≤ G := by
    intro u v huv
    rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj] at huv
    have hforward {u v : Fin (k + 1)} (h : u.val + 1 = v.val) : G.Adj u v := by
      have hu : u.val < k := by omega
      have hv : finRotate (k + 1) u = v := by
        rw [finRotate_of_lt hu]
        exact Fin.ext h
      rw [← hv]
      apply hstep
      intro heq
      have heq' := congrArg Fin.val heq
      rw [hv] at heq'
      omega
    rcases huv with h | h
    · exact hforward h
    · exact (hforward h).symm
  exact (SimpleGraph.pathGraph_connected k).mono hpath

name: Fintype.prod_fiber_pow
statement:
theorem prod_fiber_pow {R E : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq E] [Fintype E]
    (idx : R → E) (z : E → ℝ) :
    (∏ r : R, z (idx r)) =
      ∏ e : E, z e ^ ((univ : Finset R).filter (fun r => idx r = e)).card
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∏ r : R, z (idx r)) = ∏ e : E, ∏ _r : {r : R // idx r = e}, z e := by
      exact (Fintype.prod_fiberwise' idx z).symm
    _ = ∏ e : E, z e ^ ((univ : Finset R).filter (fun r => idx r = e)).card := by
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
      intro e he
      rw [← Fintype.card_subtype (p := fun r : R => idx r = e)]
      simp

name: NLAlib.sum_row_leaf_mul_eq_sum_column_sum_mul
statement:
theorem sum_row_leaf_mul_eq_sum_column_sum_mul (v : V) (w : I → J → ℝ)
    (F : (U → I) → (V → J) → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : Option U → I, ∑ y : V → J,
        w (x none) (y v) * F (fun u => x (some u)) y) =
      ∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, (∑ i : I, w i (y v)) * F x y
proof:
:= by
  let e : (Option U → I) ≃ I × (U → I) :=
    Equiv.piOptionEquivProd (α := U) (β := fun _ : Option U => I)
  calc
    (∑ x : Option U → I, ∑ y : V → J,
        w (x none) (y v) * F (fun u => x (some u)) y)
        = ∑ p : I × (U → I), ∑ y : V → J, w p.1 (y v) * F p.2 y := by
          exact (Equiv.sum_comp e (g := fun p : I × (U → I) =>
            ∑ y : V → J, w p.1 (y v) * F p.2 y))
    _ = ∑ x : U → I, ∑ i : I, ∑ y : V → J,
          w i (y v) * F x y := by
          exact Fintype.sum_prod_type_right (f := fun p : I × (U → I) =>
            ∑ y : V → J, w p.1 (y v) * F p.2 y)
    _ = ∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, ∑ i : I,
          w i (y v) * F x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro x hx
          exact Finset.sum_comm (s := (Finset.univ : Finset I))
            (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (V → J)))
            (f := fun (i : I) (y : V → J) => w i (y v) * F x y)
    _ = ∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, (∑ i : I, w i (y v)) * F x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro y hy
          exact (Finset.sum_mul (s := (Finset.univ : Finset I))
            (f := fun i : I => w i (y v)) (a := F x y)).symm

name: NLAlib.sum_row_leaf_mul_le_mul_sum
statement:
theorem sum_row_leaf_mul_le_mul_sum (v : V) (a : ℝ) (w : I → J → ℝ)
    (F : (U → I) → (V → J) → ℝ)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, w i j) ≤ a)
    (hF : ∀ (x : U → I) (y : V → J), 0 ≤ F x y) :
    (∑ x : Option U → I, ∑ y : V → J,
        w (x none) (y v) * F (fun u => x (some u)) y) ≤
      a * (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, F x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_row_leaf_mul_eq_sum_column_sum_mul v w F]
  calc
    (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, (∑ i : I, w i (y v)) * F x y)
        ≤ ∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, a * F x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro y hy
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcol (y v)) (hF x y)
    _ = ∑ x : U → I, a * (∑ y : V → J, F x y) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro x hx
          exact (Finset.mul_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (V → J)))
            (f := fun y : V → J => F x y) (a := a)).symm
    _ = a * (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, F x y) := by
          exact (Finset.mul_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (U → I)))
            (f := fun x : U → I => ∑ y : V → J, F x y) (a := a)).symm

name: NLAlib.sum_column_leaf_mul_eq_sum_row_sum_mul
statement:
theorem sum_column_leaf_mul_eq_sum_row_sum_mul (u : U) (w : I → J → ℝ)
    (F : (U → I) → (V → J) → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : Option V → J,
        w (x u) (y none) * F x (fun v => y (some v))) =
      ∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, (∑ j : J, w (x u) j) * F x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_row_leaf_mul_eq_sum_column_sum_mul (U := V) (V := U) (I := J) (J := I)
    (v := u) (w := fun j i => w i j) (F := fun y x => F x y)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (U → I)))
    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Option V → J)))
    (f := fun (x : U → I) (y : Option V → J) =>
      w (x u) (y none) * F x (fun v => y (some v)))]
  rw [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (V → J)))
    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (U → I)))
    (f := fun (x : V → J) (y : U → I) =>
      (∑ j : J, w (y u) j) * F y x)]

name: NLAlib.sum_column_leaf_mul_le_mul_sum
statement:
theorem sum_column_leaf_mul_le_mul_sum (u : U) (a : ℝ) (w : I → J → ℝ)
    (F : (U → I) → (V → J) → ℝ)
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, w i j) ≤ a)
    (hF : ∀ (x : U → I) (y : V → J), 0 ≤ F x y) :
    (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : Option V → J,
        w (x u) (y none) * F x (fun v => y (some v))) ≤
      a * (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, F x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_column_leaf_mul_eq_sum_row_sum_mul u w F]
  calc
    (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, (∑ j : J, w (x u) j) * F x y)
        ≤ ∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, a * F x y := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro y hy
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrow (x u)) (hF x y)
    _ = ∑ x : U → I, a * (∑ y : V → J, F x y) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro x hx
          exact (Finset.mul_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (V → J)))
            (f := fun y : V → J => F x y) (a := a)).symm
    _ = a * (∑ x : U → I, ∑ y : V → J, F x y) := by
          exact (Finset.mul_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (U → I)))
            (f := fun x : U → I => ∑ y : V → J, F x y) (a := a)).symm

name: NLAlib.prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_pow
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (Finset.prod A (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e))))
        ≤ Finset.prod A (fun _ : E => s) := by
          exact Finset.prod_le_prod
            (fun e he => hwnn (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))
            (fun e he => hw (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))
    _ = s ^ A.card := Finset.prod_const s

name: NLAlib.prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_prod_mul_pow
statement:
theorem prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_prod_mul_pow {U V I J E : Type*}
    [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    {w : I → J → ℝ} {s : ℝ}
    (hwnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j) (hw : ∀ i j, w i j ≤ s)
    (T O : Finset E) (hdisj : Disjoint T O) (huni : T ∪ O = univ)
    (sr : E → U) (tg : E → V)
    (x : U → I) (y : V → J) :
    (Finset.prod (univ : Finset E) (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))) ≤
      (Finset.prod T (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))) * s ^ O.card
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (Finset.prod (univ : Finset E) (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e))))
        = Finset.prod (T ∪ O) (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e))) := by
          rw [← huni]
    _ = (Finset.prod T (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))) *
          (Finset.prod O (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))) := by
          exact Finset.prod_union hdisj
    _ ≤ (Finset.prod T (fun e => w (x (sr e)) (y (tg e)))) * s ^ O.card := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (prod_bipartite_edge_weight_le_pow (A := O) hwnn hw sr tg x y)
            (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun e he => hwnn (x (sr e)) (y (tg e))))

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.edgeList_length
statement: theorem edgeList_length {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) : t.edgeList.length = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | edge => rfl
  | attach t p ih => simp [edgeList, ih]

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_labelings_succ
statement:
theorem sum_labelings_succ {n : ℕ} (F : (Fin (n + 1) → α) → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, F x) = ∑ y : Fin n → α, ∑ a : α, F (Fin.cons a y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ x, F x) = ∑ p : α × (Fin n → α), F (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) :=
      (Equiv.sum_comp (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => α)) F).symm
    _ = _ := Fintype.sum_prod_type_right _

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.markovWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem markovWeight_nonneg (π : α → ℝ) (K : α → α → ℝ)
    (hπ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ π i) (hK : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ K i j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (x : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
    0 ≤ t.markovWeight π K x
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | edge => exact mul_nonneg (hπ _) (hK _ _)
  | attach t p ih => exact mul_nonneg (ih _) (hK _ _)

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_markovWeight_mul_vertex
statement:
theorem sum_markovWeight_mul_vertex (π : α → ℝ) (K : α → α → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ i, ∑ j, K i j = 1)
    (hstationary : ∀ j, ∑ i, π i * K i j = π j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (v : Fin (n + 2)) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, t.markovWeight π K x * f (x v)) = ∑ i, π i * f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t generalizing f with
  | edge =>
      have hs (F : α → α → ℝ) :
          (∑ x : Fin 2 → α, F (x 0) (x 1)) = ∑ a, ∑ b, F a b := by
        rw [sum_labelings_succ, Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        change (∑ y : Fin 1 → α, F a (y 0)) = _
        exact Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.funUnique (Fin 1) α) (F a)
      fin_cases v
      · change (∑ x : Fin 2 → α, π (x 0) * K (x 0) (x 1) * f (x 0)) = _
        rw [hs (fun a b => π a * K a b * f a)]
        simp_rw [mul_right_comm _ _ (f _), ← Finset.mul_sum, hK, mul_one]
      · change (∑ x : Fin 2 → α, π (x 0) * K (x 0) (x 1) * f (x 1)) = _
        rw [hs (fun a b => π a * K a b * f b), Finset.sum_comm]
        simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hstationary]
  | @attach n t p ih =>
      rw [sum_labelings_succ]
      simp only [markovWeight, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun v => ?_) v
      · simp only [Fin.cons_zero, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        calc
          (∑ x : Fin (n + 2) → α,
              t.markovWeight π K x * ∑ a, K (x p) a * f a) =
              ∑ i, π i * ∑ a, K i a * f a := ih p (fun i => ∑ a, K i a * f a)
          _ = ∑ i, π i * f i := by
            simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            simp_rw [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul, hstationary]
      · simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
        simp_rw [mul_right_comm _ _ (f _), ← Finset.mul_sum, hK, mul_one]
        exact ih v f

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_markovWeight
statement:
theorem sum_markovWeight (π : α → ℝ) (K : α → α → ℝ)
    (hπ : ∑ i, π i = 1) (hK : ∀ i, ∑ j, K i j = 1)
    (hstationary : ∀ j, ∑ i, π i * K i j = π j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) : (∑ x, t.markovWeight π K x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := t.sum_markovWeight_mul_vertex π K hK hstationary 0 (fun _ => 1)
  simpa only [mul_one, hπ] using h

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_degreeExcess
statement:
theorem sum_degreeExcess {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) :
    (∑ v, t.degreeExcess v) = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t with
  | edge => simp [degreeExcess]
  | attach t p ih => simp [degreeExcess, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ih]

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.edgeWeight_eq_prod_edgeList
statement:
theorem edgeWeight_eq_prod_edgeList (w : α → α → ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (x : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
    t.edgeWeight w x = (t.edgeList.map (fun e => w (x e.1) (x e.2))).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | edge => simp [edgeWeight, edgeList]
  | attach t p ih =>
      simp only [edgeWeight, edgeList, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.map_map]
      rw [ih]
      exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.edgeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem edgeWeight_nonneg (w : α → α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (x : Fin (n + 2) → α) : 0 ≤ t.edgeWeight w x
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | edge => exact hw _ _
  | attach t p ih => exact mul_nonneg (ih _) (hw _ _)

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.sum_edgeWeight_edge
statement:
theorem sum_edgeWeight_edge (w : α → α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : Fin 2 → α, edge.edgeWeight w x) = ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑ x : Fin 2 → α, w (x 0) (x 1)) = _
  rw [sum_labelings_succ, Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change (∑ y : Fin 1 → α, w i (y 0)) = _
  exact Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.funUnique (Fin 1) α) (w i)

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.excessWeight_attach
statement:
theorem excessWeight_attach (d : α → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n)
    (p : Fin (n + 2)) (x : Fin (n + 1 + 2) → α) :
    (attach t p).excessWeight d x =
      t.excessWeight d (fun i => x i.succ) * d (x p.succ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold excessWeight
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [degreeExcess, Fin.cons_zero,
    pow_zero, Fin.cons_succ, one_mul, pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  congr 1
  simp only [pow_ite, pow_one, pow_zero]
  simp

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.edgeWeight_eq_mul_markovWeight_excessWeight
statement:
theorem edgeWeight_eq_mul_markovWeight_excessWeight
    (π d : α → ℝ) (K w : α → α → ℝ) (D : ℝ)
    (hπ : ∀ i, D * π i = d i) (hK : ∀ i j, d i * K i j = w i j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) (x : Fin (n + 2) → α) :
    t.edgeWeight w x = D * t.markovWeight π K x * t.excessWeight d x
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | edge =>
      simp only [edgeWeight, markovWeight, excessWeight, degreeExcess, pow_zero,
        Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
      rw [← mul_assoc, hπ, hK]
  | attach t p ih =>
      rw [edgeWeight, markovWeight, excessWeight_attach, ih]
      rw [← hK (x p.succ) (x 0)]
      ring

name: NLAlib.LeafTree.exists_stationary_edgeWeight_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_stationary_edgeWeight_factorization
    (w : α → α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ w i j)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j, w i j = w j i)
    (hD : 0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, w i j)
    {n : ℕ} (t : LeafTree n) :
    ∃ P : (Fin (n + 2) → α) → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ P x) ∧ (∑ x, P x) = 1 ∧
      (∀ v (f : α → ℝ), (∑ x, P x * f (x v)) =
        ∑ i, ((∑ j, w i j) / (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j)) * f i) ∧
      ∀ x, t.edgeWeight w x = (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j) * P x *
        t.excessWeight (fun i => ∑ j, w i j) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d : α → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j, w i j
  let D : ℝ := ∑ i, d i
  have hD0 : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD
  have hd (i : α) : 0 ≤ d i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw i j
  have hwzero (i j : α) (hi : d i = 0) : w i j = 0 := by
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _ => hw i k)).mp hi j (by simp)
  let π : α → ℝ := fun i => d i / D
  let K : α → α → ℝ := fun i j => if d i = 0 then π j else w i j / d i
  have hπnonneg (i : α) : 0 ≤ π i := div_nonneg (hd i) hD.le
  have hKnonneg (i j : α) : 0 ≤ K i j := by
    dsimp [K]
    split_ifs
    · exact hπnonneg j
    · exact div_nonneg (hw i j) (hd i)
  have hπsum : ∑ i, π i = 1 := by
    simp only [π, ← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hD0
  have hKsum (i : α) : ∑ j, K i j = 1 := by
    by_cases hi : d i = 0
    · simp only [K, hi, if_pos]
      exact hπsum
    · simp only [K, hi, if_false, ← Finset.sum_div]
      exact div_self hi
  have hπdegree (i : α) : D * π i = d i := by
    dsimp [π]
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hD0
  have hKdegree (i j : α) : d i * K i j = w i j := by
    by_cases hi : d i = 0
    · simp only [K, hi, if_pos, zero_mul, hwzero i j hi]
    · simp only [K, hi, if_false]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hi
  have hstationary (j : α) : ∑ i, π i * K i j = π j := by
    have hterm (i : α) : π i * K i j = w i j / D := by
      calc
        π i * K i j = (d i * K i j) / D := by dsimp [π]; ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hKdegree]
    simp_rw [hterm, ← Finset.sum_div, hsymm _ j]
    rfl
  refine ⟨t.markovWeight π K, t.markovWeight_nonneg π K hπnonneg hKnonneg,
    t.sum_markovWeight π K hπsum hKsum hstationary, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun v f => t.sum_markovWeight_mul_vertex π K hKsum hstationary v f
  · exact t.edgeWeight_eq_mul_markovWeight_excessWeight π d K w D hπdegree hKdegree

name: NLAlib.factorial_mul_sum_powersetCard_prod_le_sum_pow
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_sum_powersetCard_prod_le_sum_pow {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (q : ℕ) :
    (q.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ S ∈ s.powersetCard q, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : (Fin q → α) → ℝ := fun h => if Function.Injective h then
    if Finset.univ.image h ⊆ s then ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.image h, f i else 0 else 0
  have hFilter : (((Finset.univ : Finset α).powersetCard q).filter (· ⊆ s)) =
      s.powersetCard q := by
    ext S
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powersetCard, Finset.subset_univ, true_and]
    exact and_comm
  have hRestrict : (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powersetCard q,
      if S ⊆ s then ∏ i ∈ S, f i else 0) = ∑ S ∈ s.powersetCard q, ∏ i ∈ S, f i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hFilter]
  have hCount : (q.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ S ∈ s.powersetCard q, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) =
      ∑ h : Fin q → α, F h := by
    simpa only [F, hRestrict, nsmul_eq_mul] using
      (Finset.sum_injective_image_eq_factorial_nsmul
        (fun S => if S ⊆ s then ∏ i ∈ S, f i else (0 : ℝ)) q).symm
  let H := Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin q => s)
  have hSmall : (∑ h : Fin q → α, F h) = ∑ h ∈ H, F h := by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
    intro h _ hh
    have hNotSub : ¬ Finset.univ.image h ⊆ s := by
      intro hSub
      apply hh
      apply Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr
      intro j
      apply hSub
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    simp [F, hNotSub]
  rw [hCount, hSmall, Finset.sum_pow']
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro h hh
  have hRange : ∀ j, h j ∈ s := Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hh
  have hSub : Finset.univ.image h ⊆ s := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    exact hRange j
  by_cases hInj : Function.Injective h
  · simp only [F, if_pos hInj, if_pos hSub]
    rw [Finset.prod_image hInj.injOn]
  · simp only [F, if_neg hInj]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => hf _ (hRange j))

name: NLAlib.sum_powersetCard_prod_le_prod_sum_tail
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_prod_le_prod_sum_tail {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (r : ℕ) :
    (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) ≤
      ∏ j : Fin r, ∑ i : Fin n, if (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    have ht : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      split_ifs
      · exact hf i
      · exact le_rfl
    calc
      _ ≤ (∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0) *
          ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r, ∏ i ∈ S, f i :=
        sum_powersetCard_prod_succ_le_tail_mul_sum_prod f hf r
      _ ≤ (∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0) *
          ∏ j : Fin r, ∑ i : Fin n, if (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih ht
      _ = _ := by rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]; simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]; exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.card_filter_fin_val_lt_le
statement:
private theorem card_filter_fin_val_lt_le {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) :
    (S.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < r)).card ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : (S.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < r)).image Fin.val ⊆ Finset.range r := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
  have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective, Finset.card_range] at hc
  exact hc

name: NLAlib.sum_powersetCard_prod_le_mul_sum_powersetCard_tail
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_prod_le_mul_sum_powersetCard_tail {n r k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hrk : r ≤ k) :
    (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) ≤
      (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) *
        ∑ T ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i : Fin n => r ≤ (i : ℕ))).powersetCard (k - r),
          ∏ i ∈ T, f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k
  let Tail := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i : Fin n => r ≤ (i : ℕ))
  let P := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r) ×ˢ Tail.powersetCard (k - r)
  have hExists (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S ∈ K) :
      ∃ H : Finset (Fin n), (S.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < r)) ⊆ H ∧ H ⊆ S ∧ H.card = r := by
    exact Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      (card_filter_fin_val_lt_le S r) (by rw [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2]; exact hrk)
  let head (S : Finset (Fin n)) := if hS : S ∈ K then Classical.choose (hExists S hS) else ∅
  have hHead (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S ∈ K) :
      (S.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < r)) ⊆ head S ∧ head S ⊆ S ∧ (head S).card = r := by
    dsimp only [head]
    rw [dif_pos hS]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hExists S hS)
  let g (S : Finset (Fin n)) := (head S, S \ head S)
  have hg (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S ∈ K) : g S ∈ P := by
    have hH := hHead S hS
    apply Finset.mem_product.mpr
    constructor
    · exact Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hH.2.2⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
      constructor
      · intro i hi
        have hiS := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).1
        have hiH := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        by_contra hn
        exact hiH (hH.1 (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hiS, by omega⟩))
      · rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hH.2.1, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2, hH.2.2]
  have hInj : ∀ S ∈ K, ∀ T ∈ K, g S = g T → S = T := by
    intro S hS T hT he
    have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst he
    have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd he
    calc
      S = head S ∪ (S \ head S) := (Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (hHead S hS).2.1).symm
      _ = head T ∪ (T \ head T) := congrArg₂ (· ∪ ·) h₁ h₂
      _ = T := Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (hHead T hT).2.1
  have hWeight (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S ∈ K) :
      (∏ i ∈ (g S).1, f i) * (∏ i ∈ (g S).2, f i) = ∏ i ∈ S, f i := by
    simpa only [g, mul_comm] using Finset.prod_sdiff (f := f) (hHead S hS).2.1
  have hImage : (∑ S ∈ K, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) =
      ∑ z ∈ K.image g, (∏ i ∈ z.1, f i) * ∏ i ∈ z.2, f i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image hInj]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun S hS => (hWeight S hS).symm)
  have hLe : (∑ S ∈ K, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) ≤
      ∑ z ∈ P, (∏ i ∈ z.1, f i) * ∏ i ∈ z.2, f i := by
    rw [hImage]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      exact hg S hS
    · intro z _ _
      exact mul_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hf i))
        (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hf i))
  convert hLe using 1
  dsimp only [P, Tail]
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]

name: NLAlib.factorial_mul_sum_powersetCard_prod_le_prod_sum_tail_mul_pow
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_sum_powersetCard_prod_le_prod_sum_tail_mul_pow {n r k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hrk : r ≤ k) :
    ((k - r).factorial : ℝ) *
        (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) ≤
      (∏ j : Fin r, ∑ i : Fin n, if (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0) *
        (∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0) ^ (k - r)
proof:
:= by
  let T := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i : Fin n => r ≤ (i : ℕ))
  have hSplit := sum_powersetCard_prod_le_mul_sum_powersetCard_tail f hf hrk
  have hHead := sum_powersetCard_prod_le_prod_sum_tail f hf r
  have hFac := factorial_mul_sum_powersetCard_prod_le_sum_pow T f (fun i _ => hf i) (k - r)
  have hSum : (∑ i ∈ T, f i) = ∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0 := by
    simp only [T, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [hSum] at hFac
  have hE : 0 ≤ ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r, ∏ i ∈ S, f i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun S _ => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hf i))
  have hTail : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ (i : ℕ) then f i else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    split_ifs
    · exact hf i
    · exact le_rfl
  calc
    _ ≤ ((k - r).factorial : ℝ) *
        ((∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) *
          ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard (k - r), ∏ i ∈ S, f i) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSplit (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard r, ∏ i ∈ S, f i) *
        (((k - r).factorial : ℝ) * ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard (k - r), ∏ i ∈ S, f i) := by
      rw [mul_left_comm]
    _ ≤ _ := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFac hE).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hHead (pow_nonneg hTail _))

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.rowEnd_beta
statement:
lemma rowEnd_beta (sr : O → R) (alpha beta : E → O) (e : E) :
    rowEnd sr alpha beta e = Quotient.mk'' (sr (beta e))
proof:
:= by
  apply Quotient.sound'
  exact Relation.EqvGen.rel (sr (alpha e)) (sr (beta e))
    (⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩ : RowRel sr alpha beta (sr (alpha e)) (sr (beta e)))

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.colEnd_beta
statement:
lemma colEnd_beta (tg : O → C) (alpha beta : E → O) (e : E) :
    colEnd tg alpha beta e = Quotient.mk'' (tg (beta e))
proof:
:= by
  apply Quotient.sound'
  exact Relation.EqvGen.rel (tg (alpha e)) (tg (beta e))
    (⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩ : ColRel tg alpha beta (tg (alpha e)) (tg (beta e)))

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.rowSetoid_rel_imp_eq_of_admissible
statement:
lemma rowSetoid_rel_imp_eq_of_admissible (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) (x : R → I) (y : C → J)
    (hA : Admissible sr tg alpha beta x y) :
    ∀ a b, (rowSetoid sr alpha beta).r a b → x a = x b
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  induction hab with
  | rel x y h =>
      rcases h with ⟨e, ha, hb⟩
      rw [← ha, ← hb]
      exact (hA e).1
  | refl x => rfl
  | symm x y h ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans x y z h1 h2 ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.colSetoid_rel_imp_eq_of_admissible
statement:
lemma colSetoid_rel_imp_eq_of_admissible (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) (x : R → I) (y : C → J)
    (hA : Admissible sr tg alpha beta x y) :
    ∀ a b, (colSetoid tg alpha beta).r a b → y a = y b
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  induction hab with
  | rel x y h =>
      rcases h with ⟨e, ha, hb⟩
      rw [← ha, ← hb]
      exact (hA e).2
  | refl x => rfl
  | symm x y h ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans x y z h1 h2 ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.admissible_iff_rowSetoid_le_ker_colSetoid_le_ker
statement:
lemma admissible_iff_rowSetoid_le_ker_colSetoid_le_ker (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) (x : R → I) (y : C → J) :
    Admissible sr tg alpha beta x y ↔
      rowSetoid sr alpha beta ≤ Setoid.ker x ∧ colSetoid tg alpha beta ≤ Setoid.ker y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · apply Setoid.eqvGen_le
      intro a b hab
      rcases hab with ⟨e, ha, hb⟩
      rw [← ha, ← hb]
      exact (h e).1
    · apply Setoid.eqvGen_le
      intro a b hab
      rcases hab with ⟨e, ha, hb⟩
      rw [← ha, ← hb]
      exact (h e).2
  · intro h e
    constructor
    · exact h.1 (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact h.2 (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.quotientLabelEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma quotientLabelEquiv_apply (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) (f : RowQuotient sr alpha beta → I)
    (g : ColQuotient tg alpha beta → J) :
    (quotientLabelEquiv sr tg alpha beta (f, g)).1 =
      (f ∘ Quotient.mk'', g ∘ Quotient.mk'')
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.sum_ite_eq_sum_subtype
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype p (fun a => if p a then f a else 0)]
  have h₁ : (∑ i : {x : α // p x}, (if p i.1 then f i.1 else 0)) =
      ∑ i : {x : α // p x}, f i.1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact if_pos i.property
  have h₂ : (∑ i : {x : α // ¬ p x}, (if p i.1 then f i.1 else 0)) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    exact if_neg i.property
  rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.pairWeight_pullback
statement:
lemma pairWeight_pullback [Fintype E] (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) (w : I → J → ℝ) (f : RowQuotient sr alpha beta → I)
    (g : ColQuotient tg alpha beta → J) :
    pairWeight sr tg alpha w (f ∘ Quotient.mk'') (g ∘ Quotient.mk'') =
      ∏ e : E, w (f (rowEnd sr alpha beta e)) (g (colEnd tg alpha beta e))
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairWeight, rowEnd, colEnd]

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient
statement:
theorem sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient
    (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C) (alpha beta : E → O)
    [Fintype R] [Fintype C] [Fintype E] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    [Fintype (RowQuotient sr alpha beta)] [Fintype (ColQuotient tg alpha beta)]
    [DecidableEq (RowQuotient sr alpha beta)] [DecidableEq (ColQuotient tg alpha beta)]
    (w : I → J → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : R → I, ∑ y : C → J,
        ∏ e : E,
          if x (sr (alpha e)) = x (sr (beta e)) ∧
              y (tg (alpha e)) = y (tg (beta e))
            then w (x (sr (alpha e))) (y (tg (alpha e))) else 0)
    = (∑ f : RowQuotient sr alpha beta → I,
        ∑ g : ColQuotient tg alpha beta → J,
          ∏ e : E, w (f (rowEnd sr alpha beta e)) (g (colEnd tg alpha beta e)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ x : R → I, ∑ y : C → J,
        ∏ e : E,
          if x (sr (alpha e)) = x (sr (beta e)) ∧
              y (tg (alpha e)) = y (tg (beta e))
            then w (x (sr (alpha e))) (y (tg (alpha e))) else 0)
        = ∑ x : R → I, ∑ y : C → J,
            if Admissible sr tg alpha beta x y
              then pairWeight sr tg alpha w x y else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro x hx
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro y hy
            by_cases hA : Admissible sr tg alpha beta x y
            · rw [if_pos hA]
              apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
              intro e he
              rw [if_pos (hA e)]
            · rw [if_neg hA]
              rcases not_forall.mp hA with ⟨e, he⟩
              apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ e)
              exact if_neg he
    _ = ∑ xy : (R → I) × (C → J),
        if Admissible sr tg alpha beta xy.1 xy.2
          then pairWeight sr tg alpha w xy.1 xy.2 else 0 := by
        rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type']
    _ = ∑ xy : {xy : (R → I) × (C → J) // Admissible sr tg alpha beta xy.1 xy.2},
        pairWeight sr tg alpha w xy.1.1 xy.1.2 := by
        rw [sum_ite_eq_sum_subtype (p := fun xy : (R → I) × (C → J) =>
          Admissible sr tg alpha beta xy.1 xy.2)
          (f := fun xy : (R → I) × (C → J) =>
            pairWeight sr tg alpha w xy.1 xy.2)]
    _ = (∑ fg : (RowQuotient sr alpha beta → I) × (ColQuotient tg alpha beta → J),
        ∏ e : E, w (fg.1 (rowEnd sr alpha beta e)) (fg.2 (colEnd tg alpha beta e))) := by
        rw [(Equiv.sum_comp (e := quotientLabelEquiv sr tg alpha beta)
          (g := fun xy => pairWeight sr tg alpha w xy.1.1 xy.1.2)).symm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro fg hfg
        rcases fg with ⟨f, g⟩
        rw [quotientLabelEquiv_apply]
        exact pairWeight_pullback sr tg alpha beta w f g
    _ = (∑ f : RowQuotient sr alpha beta → I,
        ∑ g : ColQuotient tg alpha beta → J,
          ∏ e : E, w (f (rowEnd sr alpha beta e)) (g (colEnd tg alpha beta e))) := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.surjective_sum_map_quotient
statement:
lemma surjective_sum_map_quotient (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) :
    Function.Surjective (Sum.map (Quotient.mk'' : R → RowQuotient sr alpha beta)
      (Quotient.mk'' : C → ColQuotient tg alpha beta))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl q =>
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep q
      refine ⟨Sum.inl r, ?_⟩
      simp [hr]
  | inr q =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep q
      refine ⟨Sum.inr c, ?_⟩
      simp [hc]

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.connected_quotient_of_connected
statement:
theorem connected_quotient_of_connected (sr : O → R) (tg : O → C)
    (alpha beta : E → O) (hcover : Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta))
    (hG : (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph sr tg).Connected) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (rowEnd sr alpha beta) (colEnd tg alpha beta)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  exact SimpleGraph.Connected.map
    (quotientGraphHom sr tg alpha beta hcover)
    (surjective_sum_map_quotient sr tg alpha beta) hG

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.cycle_inl_edge
statement:
lemma cycle_inl_edge (p : ℕ) (x : Fin p) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow p) (cycleCol p)).Adj
      (Sum.inl x) (Sum.inr x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨x, x, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨Sum.inl x, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.cycle_inr_edge
statement:
lemma cycle_inr_edge (p : ℕ) (x : Fin p) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow p) (cycleCol p)).Adj
      (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inl (finRotate p x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨finRotate p x, x, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨Sum.inr x, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.cycle_reachable_row_down
statement:
lemma cycle_reachable_row_down (q : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm : m < q + 1) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))).Reachable
      (Sum.inl (⟨m, hm⟩ : Fin (q + 1))) (Sum.inl (0 : Fin (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      have hm' : m < q + 1 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hm
      have hstep : finRotate (q + 1) (⟨m, hm'⟩ : Fin (q + 1)) = ⟨m + 1, hm⟩ := by
        simpa using finRotate_of_lt (n := q) (k := m) (by omega)
      have hroad :
          (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))).Reachable
            (Sum.inl (⟨m, hm'⟩ : Fin (q + 1)))
            (Sum.inl (⟨m + 1, hm⟩ : Fin (q + 1))) := by
        simpa [hstep] using
          ((cycle_inl_edge (q + 1) (⟨m, hm'⟩ : Fin (q + 1))).reachable.trans
            (cycle_inr_edge (q + 1) (⟨m, hm'⟩ : Fin (q + 1))).reachable)
      exact (hroad.symm).trans (ih hm')

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.cycle_reachable_row
statement:
lemma cycle_reachable_row (q : ℕ) (t : Fin (q + 1)) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))).Reachable
      (Sum.inl (0 : Fin (q + 1))) (Sum.inl t)
proof:
:= by
  exact (cycle_reachable_row_down q t.val t.isLt).symm

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.cycle_reachable_col
statement:
lemma cycle_reachable_col (q : ℕ) (c : Fin (q + 1)) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))).Reachable
      (Sum.inl (0 : Fin (q + 1))) (Sum.inr c)
proof:
:= by
  exact (cycle_reachable_row q c).trans (cycle_inl_edge (q + 1) c).reachable

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.cycle_reachable_zero
statement:
lemma cycle_reachable_zero (q : ℕ) :
    ∀ x : Sum (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)),
      (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))).Reachable
        (Sum.inl (0 : Fin (q + 1))) x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl r => exact cycle_reachable_row q r
  | inr c => exact cycle_reachable_col q c

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph_cycle_connected
statement:
theorem bipartiteOccurrenceGraph_cycle_connected (q : ℕ) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))).Connected
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
  refine ⟨Sum.inl (0 : Fin (q + 1)), ?_⟩
  intro x
  exact cycle_reachable_zero q x

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.rowQuotient_nonempty_cycle
statement:
lemma rowQuotient_nonempty_cycle (q : ℕ) (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :
    Nonempty (RowQuotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Quotient.mk'' (0 : Fin (q + 1))⟩

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.colQuotient_nonempty_cycle
statement:
lemma colQuotient_nonempty_cycle (q : ℕ) (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :
    Nonempty (ColQuotient (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Quotient.mk'' (0 : Fin (q + 1))⟩

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph_quotient_cycle_connected
statement:
theorem bipartiteOccurrenceGraph_quotient_cycle_connected (q : ℕ) [Fintype E]
    (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    (hcover : Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta)) :
    (SimpleGraph.bipartiteOccurrenceGraph
        (rowEnd (cycleRow (q + 1)) alpha beta)
        (colEnd (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  exact SimpleGraph.Connected.map
    (quotientGraphHom (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1))
      alpha beta hcover)
    (surjective_sum_map_quotient (cycleRow (q + 1)) (cycleCol (q + 1)) alpha beta)
    (bipartiteOccurrenceGraph_cycle_connected q)

name: NLAlib.PairingQuotient.card_pairing_eq_succ
statement:
lemma card_pairing_eq_succ (q : ℕ) [Fintype E]
    (alpha beta : E → Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    (hcover : Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta)) :
    Fintype.card E = q + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Fintype.card (E ⊕ E) = 2 * Fintype.card E := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum]
    ring
  have hsum' : Fintype.card (Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 2 * (q + 1) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum]
