    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hc : Fintype.card (E ⊕ E) = Fintype.card (Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :=
    Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective (Sum.elim alpha beta) hcover)
  have h2 : 2 * Fintype.card E = 2 * (q + 1) := by
    rw [← hsum, hc, hsum']
  omega

name: Finset.sum_powersetCard_sum_subset
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_sum_subset {α M : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    [AddCommMonoid M] (T : Finset α) (d s : ℕ) (hds : d ≤ s)
    (w : Finset α → M) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, ∑ J ∈ T.powersetCard d,
      if J ⊆ S then w J else 0) =
      (T.card - d).choose (s - d) • ∑ J ∈ T.powersetCard d, w J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_nsmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J hJ
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset J T s
      (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hJ).1]
  · rw [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hJ).2]
  · rw [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hJ).2]
    exact hds

name: Finset.sum_powersetCard_ite_mem
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_ite_mem {α M : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (T S : Finset α) (s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) (v : M) :
    (∑ R ∈ T.powersetCard t, if S ∈ R.powersetCard s then v else 0) =
      if S ∈ T.powersetCard s then (T.card - s).choose (t - s) • v else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hS : S ∈ T.powersetCard s
  · rw [if_pos hS]
    have hSc := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2
    simp only [Finset.mem_powersetCard, hSc, and_true]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset S T t (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).1
        (by simpa only [hSc] using hst), hSc]
  · rw [if_neg hS]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro R hR
    rw [if_neg]
    intro hSR
    exact hS (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
      ⟨(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hSR).1.trans (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hR).1,
        (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hSR).2⟩)

name: Equiv.coloringSplit_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem coloringSplit_fst {τ ι κ : Type*} (z : τ → ι)
    (hz : Function.Injective z) (c : ι → κ) (t : τ) :
    (coloringSplit z hz c).1 t = c (z t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coloringSplit, Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd, Equiv.arrowCongr,
    Equiv.ofInjective]

name: Finset.sum_coloring_indicator
statement:
theorem sum_coloring_indicator {τ ι : Type*} [Fintype τ] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq ι]
    (z : τ → ι) (hz : Function.Injective z) :
    (∑ c : ι → τ, if ∀ t, c (z t) = t then (1 : ℕ) else 0) =
      Fintype.card ({i // i ∉ Set.range z} → τ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Equiv.coloringSplit (κ := τ) z hz
  have hf (c : ι → τ) : (∀ t, c (z t) = t) ↔ (e c).1 = id := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      funext t
      simpa [e] using h t
    · intro h t
      have ht := congrFun h t
      simpa [e] using ht
  simp_rw [hf]
  rw [← e.symm.sum_comp (fun c : ι → τ => if (e c).1 = id then (1 : ℕ) else 0)]
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single id]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [hb]
  · simp

name: Finset.sum_coloring_indicator_mul_card_pow
statement:
theorem sum_coloring_indicator_mul_card_pow {τ ι : Type*} [Fintype τ] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq ι]
    (z : τ → ι) (hz : Function.Injective z) :
    (∑ c : ι → τ, if ∀ t, c (z t) = t then (1 : ℕ) else 0) *
      Fintype.card τ ^ Fintype.card τ = Fintype.card (ι → τ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_coloring_indicator z hz]
  have he := Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.coloringSplit (κ := τ) z hz)
  simpa [Fintype.card_fun, Nat.mul_comm] using he.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_nonzero_pencil_image_line
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_pencil_image_line {E F : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [Nontrivial E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℂ F] [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] [Nontrivial F]
    (A B : E →ₗ[ℂ] F) (hdim : finrank ℂ E = finrank ℂ F) :
    ∃ x : E, ∃ y : F, ∃ a b : ℂ,
      x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ A x = a • y ∧ B x = b • y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hB : Function.Injective B
  · let e := B.linearEquivOfInjective hB hdim
    let T : Module.End ℂ E := e.symm.toLinearMap.comp A
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Module.End.exists_eigenvalue T
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := ha.exists_hasEigenvector
    have hTx : T x = a • x := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx
    have hAx := congrArg e hTx
    have hBx : B x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx0 (hB (h.trans B.map_zero.symm))
    refine ⟨x, B x, a, 1, hx0, hBx, ?_, by simp⟩
    simpa only [T, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      map_smul, e, LinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective_apply] using hAx
  · have hKer : LinearMap.ker B ≠ ⊥ := fun h => hB (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp h)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hKer
    have hBx : B x = 0 := hx
    by_cases hAx : A x = 0
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ne (0 : F)
      exact ⟨x, y, 0, 0, hx0, hy, by simpa using hAx, by simpa using hBx⟩
    · exact ⟨x, A x, 1, 0, hx0, hAx, by simp, by simpa using hBx⟩

name: Lagrange.linearMap_eq_sum_basis_mul_eval
statement:
theorem linearMap_eq_sum_basis_mul_eval (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {s : Finset ι} {v : ι → 𝕜} (hv : InjOn v s) {p : 𝕜[X]}
    (hp : p.degree < s.card) :
    L p = ∑ i ∈ s, L (Lagrange.basis s v i) * p.eval (v i)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_interpolate hv hp]
  rw [interpolate_apply, map_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Lagrange.linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_eq_sum_weighted_eval_iff (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)
    {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) {v : ι → 𝕜} (hv : InjOn v s)
    (w : ι → 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < (s.card + k : ℕ) →
      L p = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i = L (Lagrange.basis s v i)) ∧
        (∀ q : 𝕜[X], q.degree < k → L (nodal s v * q) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : 0 < s.card := hs.card_pos
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro i hi
      have hdeg : (Lagrange.basis s v i).degree < (s.card + k : ℕ) := by
        rw [degree_basis hv hi]
        exact_mod_cast (show s.card - 1 < s.card + k by omega)
      have he := h (Lagrange.basis s v i) hdeg
      rw [sum_eq_single i] at he
      · simpa only [eval_basis_self hv hi, mul_one] using he.symm
      · intro j hj hji
        rw [eval_basis_of_ne hji.symm hj, mul_zero]
      · exact fun hnot => (hnot hi).elim
    · intro q hq
      by_cases hq0 : q = 0
      · simp [hq0]
      have hqn : q.natDegree < k := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hq0).mpr hq
      have hdeg : (nodal s v * q).degree < (s.card + k : ℕ) := by
        rw [degree_mul, degree_nodal, degree_eq_natDegree hq0,
          ← Nat.cast_add]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.add_lt_add_left hqn s.card
      rw [h _ hdeg]
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [eval_mul, eval_nodal_at_node hi, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  · rintro ⟨hw, horth⟩ p hp
    let Q := p /ₘ nodal s v
    let R := p %ₘ nodal s v
    have hQ : Q.degree < k := by
      by_cases hQ0 : Q = 0
      · simp [hQ0]
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · have hp' : p.degree < (nodal s v).degree := by simpa [hk0, degree_nodal] using hp
        exact (hQ0 ((divByMonic_eq_zero_iff nodal_monic).mpr hp')).elim
      have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [Q, h] at hQ0
      have hpn := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hQ0]
      have hqn : Q.natDegree = p.natDegree - s.card := by
        simp only [Q, natDegree_divByMonic p nodal_monic, natDegree_nodal]
      rw [hqn]
      exact_mod_cast (show p.natDegree - s.card < k by omega)
    have hR : R.degree < s.card := by
      simpa only [R, degree_nodal] using
        degree_modByMonic_lt p (nodal_monic (s := s) (v := v))
    have hdiv : p = R + nodal s v * Q := (modByMonic_add_div p (nodal s v)).symm
    have hLp : L p = L R := by rw [hdiv, map_add, horth Q hQ, add_zero]
    rw [hLp, linearMap_eq_sum_basis_mul_eval L hv hR]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hw i hi]
    have hnode : R.eval (v i) = p.eval (v i) := by
      rw [hdiv, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_nodal_at_node hi, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rw [hnode]

name: Polynomial.linearMap_eq_of_degree_lt_iff_pow
statement:
theorem linearMap_eq_of_degree_lt_iff_pow {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L M : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < d → L p = M p) ↔
      (∀ k < d, L (X ^ k) = M (X ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h k hk
    exact h (X ^ k) (by simpa only [degree_X_pow] using Nat.cast_lt.mpr hk)
  · intro h p hp
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · simp [hp0]
    have hpn := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp
    conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' hpn]
    conv_rhs => rw [p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' hpn]
    rw [map_sum, map_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, map_smul, h k (mem_range.mp hk)]

name: NLAlib.finrank_le_finrank_comap_endomorphism
statement:
theorem finrank_le_finrank_comap_endomorphism {K V : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (W : Submodule K V) (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    finrank K W ≤ finrank K (W.comap T)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (W.mkQ.comp T)
  have hr : finrank K (LinearMap.range (W.mkQ.comp T)) ≤ finrank K (V ⧸ W) :=
    (LinearMap.range (W.mkQ.comp T)).finrank_le
  have hW := W.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [LinearMap.ker_comp, Submodule.ker_mkQ] at h
  omega

name: LinearMap.finrank_ker_comp_le
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_comp_le (f : W →ₗ[K] U) (g : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (f.comp g)) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) + Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker g)
proof:
:= by
  let S := LinearMap.ker (f.comp g)
  let L := g.comp S.subtype
  have hr : LinearMap.range L ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact x.property
  let J : LinearMap.ker L →ₗ[K] LinearMap.ker g :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨(x : S).val, x.property⟩
      map_add' := by intro x y; rfl
      map_smul' := by intro c x; rfl }
  have hJ : Function.Injective J := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : LinearMap.ker g => z.val) hxy
  have hker := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hJ
  have hrange := Submodule.finrank_mono hr
  have hdim := L.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  change Module.finrank K S ≤ _
  omega

name: NLAlib.lagrange_basis_univ_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem lagrange_basis_univ_comp_equiv {F ι κ : Type*} [Field F]
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (v : ι → F) (e : κ ≃ ι) (i : κ) :
    Lagrange.basis univ (v ∘ e) i = Lagrange.basis univ v (e i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Lagrange.basis
  apply prod_bij (fun j _ => e j)
  · intro j hj
    exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨(fun h => (mem_erase.mp hj).1 (e.injective h)), mem_univ _⟩
  · intro j _ k _ h
    exact e.injective h
  · intro j hj
    refine ⟨e.symm j, mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, mem_univ _⟩, e.apply_symm_apply j⟩
    intro h
    exact (mem_erase.mp hj).1 (by simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using congrArg e h)
  · intro j hj
    rfl

name: NLAlib.finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv_inl {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin 1) :
    finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv p (Sum.inl i) = p
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv_inr {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    finOneSumSuccAboveEquiv p (Sum.inr i) = p.succAbove i

name: NLAlib.charpoly_eq_mul_of_isolated_equiv
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_mul_of_isolated_equiv {m n K : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing K]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (e : Fin 1 ⊕ n ≃ m)
    (h : ∀ j, A (e (Sum.inl 0)) (e (Sum.inr j)) = 0 ∧
      A (e (Sum.inr j)) (e (Sum.inl 0)) = 0) :
    A.charpoly = (X - C (A (e (Sum.inl 0)) (e (Sum.inl 0)))) *
      (A.submatrix (fun j => e (Sum.inr j)) (fun j => e (Sum.inr j))).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let B := A.submatrix (fun j => e (Sum.inr j)) (fun j => e (Sum.inr j))
  have hblocks : A.submatrix e e = Matrix.fromBlocks
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => A (e (Sum.inl 0)) (e (Sum.inl 0)))) 0 0 B := by
    ext i j
    cases i with
    | inl i =>
      fin_cases i
      cases j with
      | inl j => fin_cases j; simp
      | inr j => exact (h j).1
    | inr i =>
      cases j with
      | inl j => fin_cases j; exact (h i).2
      | inr j => rfl
  rw [← Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm A]
  change (A.submatrix e e).charpoly = _
  rw [hblocks, Matrix.charpoly_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]
  simp [B]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_submatrix_of_isolated_coordinate
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_X_sub_C_mul_submatrix_of_isolated_coordinate {n K : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing K]
    (M : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (μ : K)
    (hcol : ∀ j, M j i = if j = i then μ else 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j, M i j = if j = i then μ else 0) :
    M.charpoly = (X - C μ) *
      (M.submatrix (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val)
        (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => j.val)).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 1 ⊕ {j : n // j ≠ i} ≃ n :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.ofUnique (Fin 1) {j : n // j = i}) (Equiv.refl _)).trans
      (Equiv.sumCompl (· = i))
  have he : e (Sum.inl 0) = i := rfl
  have h := charpoly_eq_mul_of_isolated_equiv M e fun j =>
    ⟨by rw [he]; exact (hrow j.val).trans (if_neg j.property),
      by rw [he]; exact (hcol j.val).trans (if_neg j.property)⟩
  rw [he, (hcol i).trans (if_pos rfl)] at h
  exact h

name: Commute.matrix_inv_right
statement: theorem matrix_inv_right {A B : Matrix n n K} (h : Commute A B) : Commute A B⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  by_cases hu : IsUnit B
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hu
    rw [Ring.inverse_unit]
    exact h.units_inv_right
  · rw [Ring.inverse_non_unit _ hu]
    exact Commute.zero_right _

statement: theorem self_mem_bicommutantAlgebra (A : Matrix n n K) : A ∈ bicommutantAlgebra A

:= by

name: Matrix.inv_mem_bicommutantAlgebra

theorem inv_mem_bicommutantAlgebra {A X : Matrix n n K}
    (hX : X ∈ bicommutantAlgebra A) : X⁻¹ ∈ bicommutantAlgebra A

name: Matrix.isUnit_bicommutant_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_bicommutant_iff {A : Matrix n n K} (X : bicommutantAlgebra A) :
    IsUnit X ↔ IsUnit X.val
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.map (bicommutantAlgebra A).val
  · intro h
    exact ⟨⟨X, bicommutantInverse X,
      Subtype.ext (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h)),
      Subtype.ext (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp h))⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_lagrange_basis_le_gap_mul
statement:
theorem abs_eval_lagrange_basis_le_gap_mul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℝ) {a b j : ι} {x y δ B r : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (hab : a ≠ b) (hj : j ∈ s)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hxa : |x - v a| ≤ δ) (hxb : |x - v b| ≤ δ)
    (hxB : ∀ k ∈ s, |x - v k| ≤ B) (hyr : ∀ k ∈ s, r ≤ |y - v k|) :
    |(Lagrange.basis s v j).eval x| ≤
      (δ * B ^ (s.card - 2) / r ^ (s.card - 1)) * |(Lagrange.basis s v j).eval y|
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ∃ k ∈ s.erase j, |x - v k| ≤ δ := by
    by_cases hja : j = a
    · exact ⟨b, mem_erase.mpr ⟨(by simpa [hja] using hab.symm), hb⟩, hxb⟩
    · exact ⟨a, mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hja, ha⟩, hxa⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkδ⟩ := hk
  have hcard : ((s.erase j).erase k).card = s.card - 2 := by
    rw [card_erase_of_mem hk, card_erase_of_mem hj]
    omega
  have hnumx : (∏ l ∈ s.erase j, |x - v l|) ≤ δ * B ^ (s.card - 2) := by
    rw [← mul_prod_erase _ _ hk]
    have hrest : (∏ l ∈ (s.erase j).erase k, |x - v l|) ≤ B ^ (s.card - 2) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∏ _l ∈ (s.erase j).erase k, B :=
          prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun l hl =>
            hxB l (mem_of_mem_erase (mem_of_mem_erase hl)))
        _ = _ := by rw [prod_const, hcard]
    exact mul_le_mul hkδ hrest (prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)) hδ
  have hnumy : r ^ (s.card - 1) ≤ ∏ l ∈ s.erase j, |y - v l| := by
    calc
      _ = ∏ _l ∈ s.erase j, r := by rw [prod_const, card_erase_of_mem hj]
      _ ≤ _ := prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => hr.le)
        (fun l hl => hyr l (mem_of_mem_erase hl))
  let D : ℝ := ∏ l ∈ s.erase j, |(v j - v l)⁻¹|
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hval (z : ℝ) : |(Lagrange.basis s v j).eval z| = D * ∏ l ∈ s.erase j, |z - v l| := by
    simp only [Lagrange.basis, eval_prod, Lagrange.basisDivisor, eval_mul, eval_C,
      eval_sub, eval_X, abs_prod, abs_mul, prod_mul_distrib, D]
  rw [hval x, hval y]
  calc
    _ ≤ D * (δ * B ^ (s.card - 2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnumx hD
    _ = (δ * B ^ (s.card - 2) / r ^ (s.card - 1)) * (D * r ^ (s.card - 1)) := by
      field_simp
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnumy hD) (by positivity)

name: Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_map
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_cols_map (σ : K →+* L) {A : Matrix m n K}
    (hA : LinearIndependent K A.col) : LinearIndependent L (A.map σ).col
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective A.mulVecLin := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff.mpr hA
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := A.mulVecLin.exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hinj)
  let B := LinearMap.toMatrix' g
  have hBA : B * A = 1 := by
    apply Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec.mpr
    intro v
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix' g) *ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = v
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec]
    exact congrArg (fun f : (n → K) →ₗ[K] (n → K) => f v) hg
  have hmap : (B.map σ) * A.map σ = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.map_mul, hBA, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero σ) (map_one σ)]
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff.mp
  intro x y hxy
  have h := congrArg (fun v => B.map σ *ᵥ v) hxy
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hmap, Matrix.one_mulVec] using h

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_lagrange_basis_nat_half
statement:
theorem abs_eval_lagrange_basis_nat_half {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    |(Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j).eval (1 / 2)| =
      (|∏ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - k)| / (n ! : ℝ)) *
        (n.choose j : ℝ) / |(j : ℝ) - 1 / 2|
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≠ (j : ℝ) := by
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j; norm_num
    · have hj1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ j by omega)
      linarith
  have hw : |Lagrange.nodalWeight (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j| =
      ((j ! : ℝ) * ((n - j)! : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
    rw [Lagrange.nodalWeight, prod_inv_distrib, abs_inv, abs_prod,
      prod_abs_natCast_sub_eq_factorial hj]
  rw [Lagrange.eval_basis_not_at_node (mem_range.mpr (by omega)) hhalf, abs_mul, abs_mul,
    hw, abs_inv, abs_sub_comm]
  simp only [Lagrange.eval_nodal]
  have hf0 : (n ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  have hj0 : (j ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero j
  have hnj0 : ((n - j)! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero (n - j)
  have hchoose : (n.choose j : ℝ) * (j ! : ℝ) * ((n - j)! : ℝ) = (n ! : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hj
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hratio : ((j ! : ℝ) * ((n - j)! : ℝ))⁻¹ = (n ! : ℝ)⁻¹ * (n.choose j : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hchoose]
  rw [hratio]
  ring

name: NLAlib.pow_two_div_four_mul_sq_lt_sum_abs_lagrange_basis
statement:
theorem pow_two_div_four_mul_sq_lt_sum_abs_lagrange_basis {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ n / (4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) <
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1),
        |(Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j).eval (1 / 2)|
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hprod := one_div_four_mul_nat_le_abs_half_grid_product hn
  have hprodpos : 0 < |∏ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - k)| / (n ! : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hprod
  have hsumchoose : (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose j : ℝ)) = 2 ^ n := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (1 / (4 * (n : ℝ))) * (n.choose j : ℝ) / n := by
      rw [← sum_div, ← mul_sum, hsumchoose]
      ring
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1),
        (|∏ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - k)| / (n ! : ℝ)) * (n.choose j : ℝ) / n := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hnreal.le
    _ < ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1),
        |(Lagrange.basis (range (n + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) j).eval (1 / 2)| := by
      apply sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (by simp)
      intro j hj
      have hjn : j ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hj)
      rw [abs_eval_lagrange_basis_nat_half hjn]
      have hjhalfpos : 0 < |(j : ℝ) - 1 / 2| := by
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0
        · subst j; norm_num
        · have hjreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ j by omega)
          rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
          linarith
      have hjhalflt : |(j : ℝ) - 1 / 2| < n := by
        apply abs_lt.mpr
        have hjreal : (j : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hjn
        have hjnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := by positivity
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hjchoose : (0 : ℝ) < n.choose j := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos hjn)
      exact div_lt_div_of_pos_left (mul_pos hprodpos hjchoose) hjhalfpos hjhalflt

name: NLAlib.eval_lagrange_basis_affine
statement:
theorem eval_lagrange_basis_affine {F ι : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → F) (i : ι) (x α β : F) (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    (Lagrange.basis s (fun j => α * v j + β) i).eval (α * x + β) =
      (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lagrange.basis, eval_prod, Lagrange.basisDivisor,
    eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X]
  apply prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [show α * v i + β - (α * v j + β) = α * (v i - v j) by ring,
    show α * x + β - (α * v j + β) = α * (x - v j) by ring, mul_inv_rev]
  calc
    _ = ((v i - v j)⁻¹ * (x - v j)) * (α⁻¹ * α) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hα, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.lagrange_basis_univ_fin_eq_range
statement:
theorem lagrange_basis_univ_fin_eq_range {F : Type*} [Field F] (n : ℕ)
    (v : ℕ → F) (j : Fin n) :
    Lagrange.basis univ (fun k : Fin n => v k) j = Lagrange.basis (range n) v j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lagrange.basis]
  apply prod_bij (fun k _ => k.val)
  · intro k hk
    have hkj : k ≠ j := (mem_erase.mp hk).1
    exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨(fun h => hkj (Fin.ext h)), mem_range.mpr k.isLt⟩
  · intro k _ l _ hkl
    exact Fin.ext hkl
  · intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hkj, hk⟩ := mem_erase.mp hk
    refine ⟨⟨k, mem_range.mp hk⟩, mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, mem_univ _⟩, rfl⟩
    intro h
    exact hkj (congrArg Fin.val h)
  · intro k _
    rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_mulVec_injective_of_rows_injective
statement:
theorem exists_mulVec_injective_of_rows_injective (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : Function.Injective A.row) : ∃ z : n → ℝ, Function.Injective (A *ᵥ z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let pairs := {p : m × m // p.1 ≠ p.2}
  let f (p : pairs) : Module.Dual ℝ (n → ℝ) := dotProductBilin ℝ ℝ (A.row p.val.1 - A.row p.val.2)
  have hf (p : pairs) : ∃ z, f p z ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    have hzero : A.row p.val.1 - A.row p.val.2 = 0 :=
      dotProduct_eq_zero _ hn
    exact p.property (hA (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Module.Dual.exists_forall_ne_zero_of_forall_exists f hf
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  apply hz ⟨(i, j), hne⟩
  change (A.row i - A.row j) ⬝ᵥ z = 0
  rw [sub_dotProduct]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hij

name: Polynomial.degreeTruncation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem degreeTruncation_apply (d : ℕ) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    degreeTruncation d p = ∑ i : Fin d, C (p.coeff i.val)*X^i.val
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degreeTruncation, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    lcoeff_apply, smul_eq_C_mul]

name: Polynomial.degreeLTProjection_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem degreeLTProjection_coe {d : ℕ} (p : degreeLT 𝕜 d) :
    degreeLTProjection d (p : 𝕜[X]) = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change degreeTruncation d (p : 𝕜[X]) = _
  rw [degreeTruncation_apply]
  have hp : (p : 𝕜[X]).degree < d := mem_degreeLT.mp p.property
  by_cases hp0 : (p : 𝕜[X]) = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  simp only [C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun i : ℕ => monomial i ((p : 𝕜[X]).coeff i)) d).trans
      (((p : 𝕜[X]).as_sum_range' d ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).mpr hp)).symm)

name: Module.End.eigenspace_inf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_bot_of_stable_product
statement:
theorem eigenspace_inf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_bot_of_stable_product
    (f s : End ℂ V) (hfs : Commute f s)
    (hpos : ∀ z, (s*f).HasEigenvalue z → 0 < z.re)
    (a μ : ℂ) (hμ : ¬0 < (a*μ).re) :
    s.eigenspace a ⊓ f.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let W := s.eigenspace a ⊓ f.maxGenEigenspace μ
  have hpres : ∀ v ∈ W, f v ∈ W := by
    intro v hv
    refine ⟨mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr ?_, f.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (Commute.refl f) μ hv.2⟩
    have hc : f (s v) = s (f v) := congrArg (fun T : End ℂ V => T v) hfs.eq
    rw [← hc, mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv.1, map_smul]
  by_contra hW
  have : Nontrivial W := Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hW
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := Module.End.exists_eigenvalue (f.restrict hpres)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := hν.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hv0' : (v : V) ≠ 0 := by exact fun h => hv0 (Subtype.ext h)
  have hfν : f (v : V) = ν • (v : V) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv)
  have hνμ : ν=μ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hboth : (v : V) ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace ν ⊓ f.maxGenEigenspace μ :=
      ⟨eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace (mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hfν), v.property.2⟩
    rw [(f.disjoint_genEigenspace hne ⊤ ⊤).eq_bot] at hboth
    exact hv0' hboth
  subst ν
  have hp : (s*f).HasEigenvalue (a*μ) := by
    apply hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector (x := (v : V))
    refine ⟨mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr ?_, hv0'⟩
    change s (f (v : V)) = (a*μ) • (v : V)
    rw [hfν, map_smul, mem_eigenspace_iff.mp v.property.1, smul_smul, mul_comm μ a]
  exact hμ (hpos _ hp)

name: Module.End.eigenspace_eq_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_of_stable_involution
statement:
theorem eigenspace_eq_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_of_stable_involution
    (f s : End ℂ V) (hfs : Commute f s) (hss : s^2=1)
    (hpos : ∀ z, (s*f).HasEigenvalue z → 0 < z.re)
    (a : ℂ) (haa : a^2=1) :
    s.eigenspace a = ⨆ z : {z : ℂ // 0 < (a*z).re}, f.maxGenEigenspace z.val
proof:
:= by
  have hpres : ∀ v ∈ s.eigenspace a, f v ∈ s.eigenspace a := by
    intro v hv
    apply mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
    have hc : f (s v) = s (f v) := congrArg (fun T : End ℂ V => T v) hfs.eq
    rw [← hc, mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv, map_smul]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.eq_iSup_inf_genEigenspace (f := f) ⊤ hpres
      (iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top f)]
    apply iSup_le
    intro μ
    by_cases hμ : 0 < (a*μ).re
    · exact inf_le_right.trans (le_iSup
        (fun z : {z : ℂ // 0 < (a*z).re} => f.maxGenEigenspace z.val) ⟨μ, hμ⟩)
    · rw [eigenspace_inf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_bot_of_stable_product f s hfs hpos a μ hμ]
      exact bot_le
  · apply iSup_le
    intro μ v hv
    have hssv : s (s v)=v := by
      have h := congrArg (fun T : End ℂ V => T v) hss
      simpa only [pow_two, mul_apply, one_apply] using h
    have haa' : a*a=1 := by simpa only [pow_two] using haa
    let q : V := (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (v-a • s v)
    have hqW : q ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace μ.val :=
      (f.maxGenEigenspace μ.val).smul_mem _
        ((f.maxGenEigenspace μ.val).sub_mem hv
          ((f.maxGenEigenspace μ.val).smul_mem a (f.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm hfs μ.val hv)))
    have hqS : q ∈ s.eigenspace (-a) := by
      apply mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
      dsimp [q]
      rw [map_smul, map_sub, map_smul, hssv]
      rw [smul_comm (-a) ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹)]
      congr 1
      simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, neg_mul, haa', neg_one_smul]
      module
    have hq0 : q=0 := by
      have hh : q ∈ s.eigenspace (-a) ⊓ f.maxGenEigenspace μ.val := ⟨hqS, hqW⟩
      rw [eigenspace_inf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_bot_of_stable_product f s hfs hpos
        (-a) μ.val (by simpa only [neg_mul, Complex.neg_re] using not_lt_of_ge (neg_nonpos.mpr μ.property.le))] at hh
      exact hh
    have hzero : v-a • s v=0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp hq0).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    have hv' : v=a • s v := sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    apply mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
    calc
      s v = (a*a) • s v := by rw [haa', one_smul]
      _ = a • v := by rw [mul_smul, ← hv']

name: NLAlib.exists_common_eigenvector_with_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem exists_common_eigenvector_with_eigenvalue
    {K E ι : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E]
    [FiniteDimensional K E] (T : ι → Module.End K E)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (T i) (T j)) (a₀ : ι) (μ : K)
    (hμ : (T a₀).HasEigenvalue μ) :
    ∃ x : E, ∃ χ : ι → K, x ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ a, T a x = χ a • x) ∧ T a₀ x = μ • x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := Module.End.eigenspace (T a₀) μ
  have hW : W ≠ ⊥ := Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff.mp hμ
  let : Nontrivial W := Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hW
  have hpres (a : ι) : Set.MapsTo (T a) W W := by
    apply Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comm
    rcases eq_or_ne a₀ a with rfl | hne
    · exact Commute.refl _
    · exact hcomm hne
  let S (a : ι) : Module.End K W := (T a).restrict (hpres a)
  have hScomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (S a) (S b) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomm hab).eq x.val
  obtain ⟨x, χ, hx, hTx⟩ := exists_common_eigenvector_of_pairwise_commute S hScomm
  refine ⟨x.val, χ, fun h => hx (Subtype.ext h), fun a => congrArg Subtype.val (hTx a), ?_⟩
  exact Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp x.property

name: NLAlib.exists_common_eigenvector_of_pairwise_commute
statement:
theorem exists_common_eigenvector_of_pairwise_commute
    {K E ι : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E]
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [Nontrivial E] (f : ι → Module.End K E)
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j => Commute (f i) (f j)) :
    ∃ (x : E) (χ : ι → K), x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, f i x = χ i • x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  generalize hd : finrank K E = d
  induction d using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing E with
  | ind d ih =>
    by_cases hscalar : ∀ i, ∃ μ, Module.End.eigenspace (f i) μ = ⊤
    · choose χ hχ using hscalar
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : E)
      refine ⟨x, χ, hx, fun i => Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp ?_⟩
      rw [hχ i]
      trivial
    · push Not at hscalar
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hscalar
      obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := Module.End.exists_eigenvalue (f i)
      let W := Module.End.eigenspace (f i) μ
      have hWne : W ≠ ⊥ := Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff.mp hμ
      let : Nontrivial W := Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hWne
      have hWdim : finrank K W < d := by
        rw [← hd]
        exact Submodule.finrank_lt (hi μ)
      have hpres (j : ι) : Set.MapsTo (f j) W W := by
        apply Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comm
        rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
        · exact Commute.refl _
        · exact hcomm hij
      let g (j : ι) : Module.End K W := (f j).restrict (hpres j)
      have hgcomm : Pairwise fun j k => Commute (g j) (g k) := by
        intro j k hjk
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomm hjk).eq x.val
      obtain ⟨x, χ, hx, hxg⟩ := ih (finrank K W) hWdim g hgcomm rfl
      refine ⟨x.val, χ, fun hx0 => hx (Subtype.ext hx0), fun j => ?_⟩
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hxg j)

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_eq_of_map_univ_val_eq
statement:
theorem exists_perm_eq_of_map_univ_val_eq {n α : Type*} [Fintype n]
    (a b : n → α) (hab : Finset.univ.val.map a = Finset.univ.val.map b) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, b (σ i) = a i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard (z : α) : Fintype.card {i : n // a i = z} = Fintype.card {i : n // b i = z} := by
    have h := congrArg (Multiset.count z) hab
    simpa only [Multiset.count_map, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card, Finset.filter_val,
      eq_comm] using h
  let e (z : α) : {i : n // a i = z} ≃ {i : n // b i = z} := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (hcard z)
  exact ⟨Equiv.ofFiberEquiv e, Equiv.ofFiberEquiv_map e⟩

name: NLAlib.exactRowSubset_nonempty
statement:
theorem exactRowSubset_nonempty {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) : Nonempty (ExactRowSubset α k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, _, hT⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α))
    (by simpa using hk)
  exact ⟨T, hT⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_erase_comm
statement:
theorem sum_sum_erase_comm {α M : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → α → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, ∑ c ∈ s.erase a, f a c) = ∑ c ∈ s, ∑ a ∈ s.erase c, f a c
proof:
:= by
  have hexpand (g : α → α → M) :
      (∑ a ∈ s, ∑ c ∈ s.erase a, g a c) =
        ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ c ∈ s, if c ≠ a then g a c else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [← Finset.filter_ne' s a, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [hexpand f, hexpand (fun c a ↦ f a c), Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  by_cases h : c = a <;> simp [h, Ne.symm]

name: NLAlib.lagrange_basis_eq_weight_mul_prod
statement:
theorem lagrange_basis_eq_weight_mul_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {R : Type*} [Field R] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → R) (i : ι) :
    Lagrange.basis s v i = C (Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i) * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (X - C (v j))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lagrange.basis, Lagrange.basisDivisor, Lagrange.nodalWeight,
    prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod]

name: NLAlib.wronskian_lagrange_basis
statement:
theorem wronskian_lagrange_basis {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {R : Type*} [Field R] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → R) {i j : ι}
    (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Polynomial.wronskian (Lagrange.basis s v i) (Lagrange.basis s v j) =
      C (Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i * Lagrange.nodalWeight s v j * (v i - v j)) *
        (∏ k ∈ (s.erase i).erase j, (X - C (v k))) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let P : R[X] := ∏ k ∈ (s.erase i).erase j, (X - C (v k))
  have hpi : (∏ k ∈ s.erase i, (X - C (v k))) = (X - C (v j)) * P := by
    exact (Finset.mul_prod_erase (s.erase i) (fun k => X - C (v k))
      (mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hij, hj⟩)).symm
  have hpj : (∏ k ∈ s.erase j, (X - C (v k))) = (X - C (v i)) * P := by
    have h := Finset.mul_prod_erase (s.erase j) (fun k => (X : R[X]) - C (v k))
      (mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, hi⟩)
    rw [erase_right_comm] at h
    exact h.symm
  rw [lagrange_basis_eq_weight_mul_prod, lagrange_basis_eq_weight_mul_prod, hpi, hpj]
  simp only [Polynomial.wronskian, derivative_mul, derivative_X, derivative_C,
    zero_mul, zero_add, sub_zero, one_mul, map_mul, map_sub]
  change _ = C (Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i) * C (Lagrange.nodalWeight s v j) *
    (C (v i) - C (v j)) * P ^ 2
  ring

name: NLAlib.wronskian_C_mul_C_mul
statement:
theorem wronskian_C_mul_C_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b : R) (p q : R[X]) :
    Polynomial.wronskian (C a * p) (C b * q) = C (a * b) * Polynomial.wronskian p q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polynomial.wronskian, derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add, map_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.wronskian_lagrange_partition_expansion
statement:
theorem wronskian_lagrange_partition_expansion {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {R : Type*} [Field R] (s u v : Finset ι) (t : ι → R) (a b : ι → R)
    (hu : u ⊆ s) (hv : v ⊆ s) (hdis : Disjoint u v) :
    Polynomial.wronskian (∑ i ∈ u, C (a i) * Lagrange.basis s t i)
        (∑ j ∈ v, C (b j) * Lagrange.basis s t j) =
      ∑ i ∈ u, ∑ j ∈ v,
        C (a i * b j * Lagrange.nodalWeight s t i * Lagrange.nodalWeight s t j * (t i - t j)) *
          (∏ k ∈ (s.erase i).erase j, (X - C (t k))) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.wronskianBilin_apply, LinearMap.map_sum₂]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [map_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [Polynomial.wronskianBilin_apply, wronskian_C_mul_C_mul,
    wronskian_lagrange_basis s t (hu hi) (hv hj) (by
      intro hij; exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis hi (hij ▸ hj)), ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.signed_eval_nodal_in_gap_pos
proof:
:= by
  let p : Fin (n + 3) := i.castSucc.succ
  let w : Fin (n + 3) → ℝ := Fin.insertNth p x v
  have hw : StrictMono w := Fin.strictMono_insertNth hv i x hx.1 hx.2
  have hweight : Lagrange.nodalWeight univ w p = ((Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x)⁻¹ := by
    rw [nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite, Fin.prod_univ_succAbove _ p]
    simp only [w, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove,
      Fin.succAbove_ne, if_false, ite_true, one_mul]
    rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal, prod_inv_distrib]
  have he : n + 2 - p.val = n + 1 - i.val := by dsimp [p]; omega
  have hpos := signed_nodalWeight_pos hw p
  rw [he, hweight] at hpos
  rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hpos with h | h
  · exact mul_pos h.1 (inv_pos.mp h.2)
  · exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg h.1 (inv_lt_zero'.mp h.2)

name: NLAlib.eval_nodal_in_gap_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := signed_eval_nodal_in_gap_pos hv i hx
  intro hz
  rw [hz, mul_zero] at h
  exact lt_irrefl _ h

name: NLAlib.eval_nodal_gap_eq_sign_mul_abs
statement:
theorem eval_nodal_gap_eq_sign_mul_abs {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (i : Fin (n + 1)) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) :
    (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val *
      |(Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x|
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := signed_eval_nodal_in_gap_pos hv i hx
  have habs : |(Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x| =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - i.val) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x := by
    simpa only [abs_mul, abs_neg_one_pow, one_mul] using abs_of_pos hpos
  have hsi : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hsg : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - i.val)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have he : n + 1 = (n + 1 - i.val) + i.val := by omega
  have hpfull : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - i.val) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val := by
    simpa only [← he] using (pow_add (-1 : ℝ) (n + 1 - i.val) i.val)
  rw [habs, hpfull]
  symm
  calc
    _ = (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 - i.val)) ^ 2 * (((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val) ^ 2)) *
        (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hsg, hsi]; ring

name: NLAlib.nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite
statement:
theorem nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (v : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v i = ∏ j, if j = i then 1 else (v i - v j)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold Lagrange.nodalWeight
  symm
  calc
    _ = (if i = i then (1 : ℝ) else (v i - v i)⁻¹) *
        ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, if j = i then 1 else (v i - v j)⁻¹ :=
      (mul_prod_erase univ (fun j => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else (v i - v j)⁻¹) (mem_univ i)).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [if_pos rfl, one_mul]
      exact prod_congr rfl fun j hj => if_neg (mem_erase.mp hj).1

name: NLAlib.signed_nodalWeight_pos
statement:
theorem signed_nodalWeight_pos {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - i.val) * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega)
    subst i
    simp [Lagrange.nodalWeight]
  | succ n ih =>
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.sub_zero, ite_true, one_mul, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false]
      have heq : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ∏ j : Fin (n + 1), (v 0 - v j.succ)⁻¹ =
          ∏ j : Fin (n + 1), -(v 0 - v j.succ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
          (prod_neg (s := univ) (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => (v 0 - v j.succ)⁻¹)).symm
      rw [heq]
      apply prod_pos
      intro j hj
      have h := hv (show (0 : Fin (n + 2)) < j.succ by exact Fin.succ_pos j)
      exact neg_pos.mpr (inv_lt_zero'.mpr (sub_neg.mpr h))
    · have hw : StrictMono (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => v k.succ) := hv.comp Fin.strictMono_succ
      have hold := ih hw j
      have hfirst : 0 < (v j.succ - v 0)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (sub_pos.mpr
        (hv (show (0 : Fin (n + 2)) < j.succ by exact Fin.succ_pos j)))
      rw [nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
      rw [if_neg (Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero j))]
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_sub_add_right, Fin.succ_inj]
      rw [← nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => v k.succ) j]
      have hprod := mul_pos hfirst hold
      simpa only [mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hprod

name: NLAlib.sum_eval_mul_nodalWeight_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff := Lagrange.coeff_eq_sum (s := univ) hv.injOn
    (hp.trans_le (by simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n))
  have hz := Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hp
  simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel, hz] at hcoeff
  simpa only [Lagrange.nodalWeight, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, div_eq_mul_inv] using hcoeff.symm

name: NLAlib.neg_one_pow_mul_abs_nodalWeight
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_abs_nodalWeight {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (r : Fin (n + 1)) (i : ℕ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (r.val + i) * |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v r| =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + i) * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v r
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := signed_nodalWeight_pos hv r
  have habs : |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v r| =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - r.val) * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v r := by
    simpa only [abs_mul, abs_neg_one_pow, one_mul] using abs_of_pos hpos
  rw [habs, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show (r.val + i) + (n - r.val) = n + i by omega]

name: Finset.sum_range_mul_blocks
statement:
theorem sum_range_mul_blocks {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : ℕ → M) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (n * m), f k = ∑ i ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range m, f (i * m + j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.succ_mul, sum_range_add, ih, sum_range_succ]

name: NLAlib.strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_add_inv_Ici_one {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜]
    [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] :
    StrictMonoOn (fun r : 𝕜 => r + r⁻¹) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr s hs hrs
  change 1 ≤ r at hr
  change 1 ≤ s at hs
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr
  have hs0 : 0 < s := hr0.trans hrs
  have hrsprod : 1 < r * s := by nlinarith
  have hid : s + s⁻¹ - (r + r⁻¹) = (s - r) * (r * s - 1) / (r * s) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← sub_pos, hid]
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hrs) (sub_pos.mpr hrsprod)) (mul_pos hr0 hs0)

name: AlgHom.map_resolvent
proof:
:= by
  change IsUnit (algebraMap R A z - a) at hz
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hz
  have hmap : (φ (u : A)) = algebraMap R B z - φ a := by
    rw [hu, map_sub, φ.commutes]
  change φ (Ring.inverse (algebraMap R A z - a)) =
    Ring.inverse (algebraMap R B z - φ a)
  rw [← hu, Ring.inverse_unit, ← hmap]
  change φ ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) = Ring.inverse (((Units.map φ.toMonoidHom u : Bˣ) : B))
  rw [Ring.inverse_unit]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.wronskian_lagrange_partition_pos
statement:
theorem wronskian_lagrange_partition_pos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (t : ι → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (u v : Finset ι)
    (hdis : Disjoint u v) (hcover : u ∪ v = univ) (hun : u.Nonempty) (hvn : v.Nonempty)
    (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ i ∈ u, ∀ j ∈ v,
      0 < a i * b j * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ t i * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ t j * (t i - t j))
    (x : ℝ) :
    0 < (Polynomial.wronskian (∑ i ∈ u, C (a i) * Lagrange.basis univ t i)
      (∑ j ∈ v, C (b j) * Lagrange.basis univ t j)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [wronskian_lagrange_partition_expansion univ u v t a b (subset_univ _) (subset_univ _) hdis]
  simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X]
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hun
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hvn
  have hex : ∃ i ∈ u, ∃ j ∈ v, (∏ k ∈ (univ.erase i).erase j, (x - t k)) ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases hx : ∃ k, x = t k
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx
      have hkset : k ∈ u ∨ k ∈ v := by
        rw [← mem_union, hcover]
        exact mem_univ k
      rcases hkset with hku | hkv
      · refine ⟨k, hku, j₀, hj₀, ?_⟩
        apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        intro r hr
        have hrk : r ≠ k := (mem_erase.mp (mem_erase.mp hr).2).1
        rw [hk, sub_ne_zero]
        exact fun h => hrk (ht h.symm)
      · refine ⟨i₀, hi₀, k, hkv, ?_⟩
        apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        intro r hr
        have hrk : r ≠ k := (mem_erase.mp hr).1
        rw [hk, sub_ne_zero]
        exact fun h => hrk (ht h.symm)
    · refine ⟨i₀, hi₀, j₀, hj₀, ?_⟩
      apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      intro r hr
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hx ⟨r, h⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hp⟩ := hex
  apply sum_pos'
  · intro r hr
    exact sum_nonneg fun k hk => mul_nonneg (hcoeff r hr k hk).le (sq_nonneg _)
  · refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
    apply sum_pos'
    · intro r hr
      exact mul_nonneg (hcoeff i hi r hr).le (sq_nonneg _)
    · exact ⟨j, hj, mul_pos (hcoeff i hi j hj) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hp)⟩

name: Fin.map_edgeBoundary
statement:
theorem map_edgeBoundary (f : A →+ B) (c : Fin n → A) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    f (edgeBoundary c i) = edgeBoundary (fun k => f (c k)) i
proof:
:= by
  have hs : f (snoc (α := fun _ => A) c 0 i) = snoc (α := fun _ => B) (fun k => f (c k)) 0 i := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i <;> simp
  have hc : f (cons (α := fun _ => A) 0 c i) = cons (α := fun _ => B) 0 (fun k => f (c k)) i := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i <;> simp
  simp only [edgeBoundary, map_sub, hs, hc]

name: Fin.sum_edgeBoundary
statement: theorem sum_edgeBoundary (c : Fin n → A) : ∑ i, edgeBoundary c i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeBoundary]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp

name: Fin.eq_zero_of_edgeBoundary_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_edgeBoundary_eq_zero (c : Fin n → A)
    (h : ∀ i, edgeBoundary c i = 0) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => ext i; exact i.elim0
  | succ n =>
    ext i
    induction i using Fin.induction with
    | zero => simpa [edgeBoundary] using h 0
    | succ i hi =>
      have hh := h i.succ.castSucc
      rw [edgeBoundary, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.castSucc_succ, Fin.cons_succ] at hh
      simpa only [sub_eq_zero, hi, Pi.zero_apply] using hh

name: Fin.partialSum_last_eq_sum
statement:
theorem partialSum_last_eq_sum (h : Fin n → A) :
    partialSum h (last n) = ∑ i, h i
proof:
:= by
  unfold partialSum
  change (List.take n (List.ofFn h)).sum = _
  rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]
  exact Fin.sum_ofFn h

name: Fin.edgeBoundary_edgePrefix
statement:
theorem edgeBoundary_edgePrefix (h : Fin (n + 1) → A) (hsum : ∑ i, h i = 0)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) : edgeBoundary (edgePrefix h) j = h j
proof:
:= by
  have hlo : snoc (α := fun _ => A) (edgePrefix h) 0 j = partialSum h j.succ := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [partialSum_last_eq_sum, hsum]
    · simp [edgePrefix]
  have hhi : cons (α := fun _ => A) 0 (edgePrefix h) j = partialSum h j.castSucc := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp
    · simp [edgePrefix, Fin.castSucc_succ]
  rw [edgeBoundary, hlo, hhi]
  rw [partialSum_succ]
  abel

name: RectangularChain.sum_horizontal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_horizontal_eq_zero
    (horizontal : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → A)
    (vertical : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → A) (hcycle : IsCycle horizontal vertical)
    (i : Fin m) : ∑ j, horizontal i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let s : (Fin (n + 1) → A) →+ A :=
    { toFun := fun f => ∑ j, f j
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := by intro f g; simp [sum_add_distrib] }
  have hb : ∀ k, Fin.edgeBoundary (fun i => ∑ j, horizontal i j) k = 0 := by
    intro k
    have hh : (∑ j, Fin.edgeBoundary horizontal k j) =
        Fin.edgeBoundary (fun i => ∑ j, horizontal i j) k :=
      Fin.map_edgeBoundary s horizontal k
    have hz : (∑ j, (Fin.edgeBoundary horizontal k j +
        Fin.edgeBoundary (vertical k) j)) = 0 := by
      exact sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => hcycle k j)
    rw [sum_add_distrib, Fin.sum_edgeBoundary, add_zero, hh] at hz
    exact hz
  exact congrFun (Fin.eq_zero_of_edgeBoundary_eq_zero _ hb) i

name: RectangularChain.horizontal_eq_cell_boundary
statement:
theorem horizontal_eq_cell_boundary
    (horizontal : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → A)
    (vertical : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → A) (hcycle : IsCycle horizontal vertical)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    horizontal i j = Fin.edgeBoundary (cellCoefficients horizontal i) j
proof:
:= by
  exact (Fin.edgeBoundary_edgePrefix (horizontal i)
    (sum_horizontal_eq_zero horizontal vertical hcycle i) j).symm

name: RectangularChain.vertical_eq_cell_boundary
statement:
theorem vertical_eq_cell_boundary
    (horizontal : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → A)
    (vertical : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → A) (hcycle : IsCycle horizontal vertical)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    vertical i j = -Fin.edgeBoundary (cellCoefficients horizontal) i j
proof:
:= by
  let c := cellCoefficients horizontal
  have hh : (fun k => Fin.edgeBoundary (c k)) = horizontal := by
    ext k l
    exact (horizontal_eq_cell_boundary horizontal vertical hcycle k l).symm
  have hcomm : Fin.edgeBoundary (Fin.edgeBoundary c i) =
      Fin.edgeBoundary horizontal i := by
    have h := Fin.map_edgeBoundary (Fin.edgeBoundaryHom n) c i
    change Fin.edgeBoundary (Fin.edgeBoundary c i) =
      Fin.edgeBoundary (fun k => Fin.edgeBoundary (c k)) i at h
    rwa [hh] at h
  have hz : Fin.edgeBoundary (vertical i + Fin.edgeBoundary c i) = 0 := by
    have ha := (Fin.edgeBoundaryHom n).map_add (vertical i) (Fin.edgeBoundary c i)
    change Fin.edgeBoundary (vertical i + Fin.edgeBoundary c i) =
      Fin.edgeBoundary (vertical i) + Fin.edgeBoundary (Fin.edgeBoundary c i) at ha
    rw [ha, hcomm]
    ext l
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_comm] using hcycle i l
  have hv := Fin.eq_zero_of_edgeBoundary_eq_zero
    (vertical i + Fin.edgeBoundary c i) (fun l => congrFun hz l)
  have hp := congrFun hv j
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hp

name: Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul
statement:
theorem sum_edgeBoundary_smul (c : Fin n → R) (e : Fin (n + 1) → B) :
    (∑ j, edgeBoundary c j • e j) =
      ∑ i, c i • (e i.castSucc - e i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeBoundary, sub_smul]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib]
  have hlo : (∑ j, snoc (α := fun _ => R) c 0 j • e j) =
      ∑ i, c i • e i.castSucc := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp
  have hhi : (∑ j, cons (α := fun _ => R) 0 c j • e j) =
      ∑ i, c i • e i.succ := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp
  rw [hlo, hhi, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [smul_sub]

name: RectangularChain.sum_edges_eq_sum_cell_boundaries
statement:
theorem sum_edges_eq_sum_cell_boundaries
    (horizontal : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → R)
    (vertical : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → R) (hcycle : IsCycle horizontal vertical)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → B) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → B) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, horizontal i j • h i j) + (∑ i, ∑ j, vertical i j • v i j) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, cellCoefficients horizontal i j •
        (h i j.castSucc + v i.succ j - h i j.succ - v i.castSucc j)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (∑ i, ∑ j, horizontal i j • h i j) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, cellCoefficients horizontal i j • (h i j.castSucc - h i j.succ) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp_rw [horizontal_eq_cell_boundary horizontal vertical hcycle]
    exact Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul _ _
  have hv : (∑ i, ∑ j, vertical i j • v i j) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, cellCoefficients horizontal i j • (v i.succ j - v i.castSucc j) := by
    rw [sum_comm]
    conv_rhs => rw [sum_comm]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp_rw [vertical_eq_cell_boundary horizontal vertical hcycle, neg_smul]
    rw [sum_neg_distrib]
    have hs := Fin.sum_edgeBoundary_smul
      (fun i => cellCoefficients horizontal i j) (fun i => v i j)
    have he : (fun i => Fin.edgeBoundary (cellCoefficients horizontal) i j) =
        Fin.edgeBoundary (fun i => cellCoefficients horizontal i j) := by
      ext i
      exact Fin.map_edgeBoundary (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun _ : Fin n => R) j) _ i
    simp_rw [← he] at hs
    rw [hs, ← sum_neg_distrib]
    simp only [← smul_neg, neg_sub]
  rw [hh, hv, ← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [← smul_add]
  congr 1
  abel

name: Polynomial.degree_geometricResolventPolynomial_lt
statement:
theorem degree_geometricResolventPolynomial_lt (z : 𝕜) (m : ℕ) :
    (geometricResolventPolynomial z m).degree < m
proof:
:=
  degree_sum_fin_lt _

name: Polynomial.geometricResolventPolynomial_succ
statement:
theorem geometricResolventPolynomial_succ (z : 𝕜) (m : ℕ) :
    geometricResolventPolynomial z (m+1) = geometricResolventPolynomial z m +
      C (z⁻¹ ^ (m+1)) * X ^ m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [geometricResolventPolynomial, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc,
    Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

name: Polynomial.inv_sub_eval_geometricResolventPolynomial_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [geometricResolventPolynomial, one_div]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [geometricResolventPolynomial_succ, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X,
      ← sub_sub, ih]
    rw [inv_pow]
    field_simp [hz, sub_ne_zero.mpr hzt]
    ring

name: Finset.sum_range_sub_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem sum_range_sub_of_adjacent {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (f g : ℕ → G) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → f (i + 1) = g i) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, (f i - g i) = f 0 - g (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, sum_range_succ' f, sum_range_succ g]
  have hs : (∑ i ∈ range k, f (i + 1)) = ∑ i ∈ range k, g i := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact h i (Nat.succ_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hi))
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one]
  abel

name: Finset.sum_grid_boundary_eq
statement:
theorem sum_grid_boundary_eq {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (bottom top left right : ℕ → ℕ → G) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hc : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, bottom i j + right i j = top i j + left i j)
    (hh : ∀ i < n, ∀ j, j + 1 < n → bottom i (j + 1) = top i j)
    (hv : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → ∀ j < n, left (i + 1) j = right i j) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, right (n - 1) j) - (∑ j ∈ range n, left 0 j) =
      (∑ i ∈ range n, top i (n - 1)) - (∑ i ∈ range n, bottom i 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : (∑ i ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range n,
      ((bottom i j - top i j) + (right i j - left i j))) = 0 := by
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have h := hc i (mem_range.mp hi) j (mem_range.mp hj)
    calc
      _ = (bottom i j + right i j) - (top i j + left i j) := by abel
      _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr h
  simp_rw [sum_add_distrib] at hzero
  have hhorizontal : (∑ i ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range n, (bottom i j - top i j)) =
      ∑ i ∈ range n, (bottom i 0 - top i (n - 1)) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact sum_range_sub_of_adjacent _ _ hn (hh i (mem_range.mp hi))
  have hvertical : (∑ i ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range n, (right i j - left i j)) =
      ∑ j ∈ range n, (right (n - 1) j - left 0 j) := by
    rw [sum_comm]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have h := sum_range_sub_of_adjacent (fun i => left i j) (fun i => right i j)
      hn (fun i hi => hv i hi j (mem_range.mp hj))
    have hneg := congrArg Neg.neg h
    simpa only [← sum_neg_distrib, neg_sub] using hneg
  rw [hhorizontal, hvertical] at hzero
  rw [← sum_sub_distrib, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  have h := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hzero
  simpa only [← sum_neg_distrib, neg_sub] using h

name: NLAlib.degree_sub_lt_of_monic_natDegree_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : p.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.ne_zero, hpn]
  have hqd : q.degree = n := by rw [degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero, hqn]
  simpa only [hpd] using degree_sub_lt_left (hpd.trans hqd.symm) hp.ne_zero
    (hp.leadingCoeff.trans hq.leadingCoeff.symm)

name: NLAlib.degree_sub_lt_of_monic_nextCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem degree_sub_lt_of_monic_nextCoeff_eq {p q : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q.Monic) (hpn : p.natDegree = n + 1)
    (hqn : q.natDegree = n + 1) (hc : p.nextCoeff = q.nextCoeff) :
    (p - q).degree < n
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg := degree_sub_lt_of_monic_natDegree_eq hp hq hpn hqn
  apply (degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero _ _).mpr
  intro m hm
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hm with rfl | hlt
  · rw [coeff_sub]
    have hpc : p.nextCoeff = p.coeff n := by
      rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by omega), hpn, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hqc : q.nextCoeff = q.coeff n := by
      rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (by omega), hqn, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hpc.symm.trans (hc.trans hqc))
  · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (hdeg.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hlt))

name: NLAlib.polynomial_eq_base_sub_residue_sum
statement:
theorem polynomial_eq_base_sub_residue_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℝ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q base : ℝ[X])
    (hdeg : (q - base).degree < Fintype.card ι)
    (hbase : ∀ j, base.eval (d j) = 0) :
    q = base - ∑ j, C (-q.eval (d j) /
      (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (d j - d l))) *
        (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (X - C (d l)))
proof:
:= by
  have heq := Lagrange.eq_interpolate (s := Finset.univ) (v := d)
    hd.injOn (by simpa using hdeg)
  have hr : q - base = ∑ j, C (q.eval (d j) /
      (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (d j - d l))) *
        (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (X - C (d l))) := by
    simpa only [Lagrange.interpolate_eq_sum, eval_sub, hbase, sub_zero] using heq
  simp only [neg_div, map_neg, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_neg_eq_add]
  linear_combination hr

name: spectrum.mul_resolvent_sub_resolvent_mul
statement:
theorem spectrum.mul_resolvent_sub_resolvent_mul
    {R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
    (a b : A) {z : R} (hz : z ∈ resolventSet R a) :
    b * resolvent a z - resolvent a z * b =
      resolvent a z * (b * a - a * b) * resolvent a z
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : resolvent a z * (algebraMap R A z - a) = 1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hz
  have hright : (algebraMap R A z - a) * resolvent a z = 1 := Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hz
  have he : (algebraMap R A z - a) * b - b * (algebraMap R A z - a) = b * a - a * b := by
    rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left z b).eq]
    abel
  calc
    _ = (resolvent a z * (algebraMap R A z - a)) * b * resolvent a z -
        resolvent a z * b * ((algebraMap R A z - a) * resolvent a z) := by
      rw [hleft, hright, one_mul, mul_one]
    _ = resolvent a z * ((algebraMap R A z - a) * b - b * (algebraMap R A z - a)) *
        resolvent a z := by noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he]

name: NLAlib.neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_bordered_interlacing
statement:
theorem neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_bordered_interlacing
    {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hd : StrictMono d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ -(∏ i, (d j - b i)) / (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - d l))
proof:
:= by
  have hrat (l : Fin n) (hl : l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j) :
      0 ≤ (d j - b l.castSucc) / (d j - d l) := by
    have hlj : l ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hlj with hlt | hgt
    · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ((hb (by exact hlt.le)).trans (h j).1))
        (sub_pos.mpr (hd hlt)).le
    · apply div_nonneg_of_nonpos
      · apply sub_nonpos.mpr
        exact (h j).2.trans (hb (by change j.val + 1 ≤ l.val; omega))
      · exact (sub_neg.mpr (hd hgt)).le
  have hprod : 0 ≤ ∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - b l.castSucc) / (d j - d l) :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg hrat
  have hj : 0 ≤ d j - b j.castSucc := sub_nonneg.mpr (h j).1
  have hlast : 0 ≤ b (Fin.last n) - d j := sub_nonneg.mpr
    ((h j).2.trans (hb (Fin.le_last _)))
  calc
    0 ≤ (d j - b j.castSucc) * (b (Fin.last n) - d j) *
        (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - b l.castSucc) / (d j - d l)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hj hlast) hprod
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ (fun l : Fin n => d j - b l.castSucc)
        (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      ring

name: NLAlib.neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_rank_one_interlacing
statement:
theorem neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_rank_one_interlacing
    {n : ℕ} (d b : Fin n → ℝ) (hd : StrictMono d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ -(∏ i, (d j - b i)) / (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - d l))
proof:
:= by
  have hrat (l : Fin n) (hl : l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j) :
      0 ≤ (d j - b l) / (d j - d l) := by
    have hlj : l ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hlj with hlt | hgt
    · have hlNext : l.val + 1 < n := by have := j.isLt; change l.val < j.val at hlt; omega
      let t : Fin n := ⟨l.val + 1, hlNext⟩
      have hbt : b l ≤ d t := hhi l t rfl
      have htj : t ≤ j := by change l.val + 1 ≤ j.val; change l.val < j.val at hlt; omega
      exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hbt.trans (hd.monotone htj)))
        (sub_pos.mpr (hd hlt)).le
    · exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr ((hlo j).trans (hb hgt.le)))
        (sub_neg.mpr (hd hgt)).le
  have hprod : 0 ≤ ∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - b l) / (d j - d l) :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg hrat
  calc
    0 ≤ (b j - d j) * (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - b l) / (d j - d l)) :=
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlo j)) hprod
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ (fun l => d j - b l)
        (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      ring

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_ite_ne_eq_sub_diag
statement:
theorem sum_sum_ite_ne_eq_sub_diag {ι R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup R] (f : ι → ι → R) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else f i j) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, f i j) - ∑ i, f i i
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (i j : ι) : (if i = j then 0 else f i j) =
      f i j - if i = j then f i j else 0 := by split_ifs <;> simp
  simp_rw [hpoint, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp

name: Polynomial.exists_coprime_factors_roots_partition
statement:
theorem exists_coprime_factors_roots_partition (p : K[X]) (hp : p.Monic)
    (P : K → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ∃ f g : K[X], f.Monic ∧ g.Monic ∧ f * g = p ∧ IsCoprime f g ∧
      f.roots = p.roots.filter P ∧ g.roots = p.roots.filter (fun z => ¬ P z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : K[X] := ((p.roots.filter P).map fun z => X - C z).prod
  let g : K[X] := ((p.roots.filter (fun z => ¬ P z)).map fun z => X - C z).prod
  have hf : f.Monic := monic_multisetProd_X_sub_C _
  have hg : g.Monic := monic_multisetProd_X_sub_C _
  have hfr : f.roots = p.roots.filter P := roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C _
  have hgr : g.roots = p.roots.filter (fun z => ¬ P z) := roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C _
  refine ⟨f, g, hf, hg, ?_, ?_, hfr, hgr⟩
  · change ((p.roots.filter P).map fun z => X - C z).prod *
      ((p.roots.filter (fun z => ¬ P z)).map fun z => X - C z).prod = p
    rw [← Multiset.prod_add, ← Multiset.map_add, Multiset.filter_add_not]
    exact ((IsAlgClosed.splits p).eq_prod_roots_of_monic hp).symm
  · rw [isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed K K]
    intro z
    simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval]
    by_cases hfz : f.eval z = 0
    · right
      intro hgz
      have hfi := (mem_roots hf.ne_zero).mpr hfz
      have hgi := (mem_roots hg.ne_zero).mpr hgz
      rw [hfr, Multiset.mem_filter] at hfi
      rw [hgr, Multiset.mem_filter] at hgi
      exact hgi.2 hfi.2
    · exact Or.inl hfz

name: NLAlib.signed_mul_neg_pow
statement:
private theorem signed_mul_neg_pow {N j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ N) (c t : ℝ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ N * (c * (-t) ^ j) = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (N - j) * c) * t ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_add, show j + j = 2 * j by omega, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  have hpow : (-1 : ℝ) ^ N = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (N - j) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hnegpow : (-t) ^ j = (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * t ^ j := neg_pow t j
  rw [hpow, hnegpow]
  calc
    _ = (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (N - j) * c) * t ^ j) *
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hp, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.mul_eval_neg_pos_of_signed_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_eval_neg_pos_of_signed_coeff_nonneg {p : ℝ[X]} {N : ℕ}
    (hdeg : p.natDegree = N) (hp : p.Monic)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j, j ≤ N → 0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ (N - j) * p.coeff j)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ N * p.eval (-t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range, hdeg, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_pos'
  · intro j hj
    have hjN : j ≤ N := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    rw [signed_mul_neg_pow hjN]
    exact mul_nonneg (hcoeff j hjN) (pow_nonneg ht.le _)
  · refine ⟨N, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self N), ?_⟩
    rw [signed_mul_neg_pow le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul]
    have hN : p.coeff N = 1 := by simpa only [hdeg] using hp.coeff_natDegree
    rw [hN, one_mul]
    exact pow_pos ht N

name: Polynomial.monic_linearPoleProduct
statement:
theorem monic_linearPoleProduct (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) :
    (linearPoleProduct v s).Monic
proof:
:= monic_prod_of_monic _ _
      (fun i _ => (monic_X_sub_C (v i)).pow (s i))

name: Polynomial.natDegree_linearPoleProduct
statement:
@[simp] theorem natDegree_linearPoleProduct (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) :
    (linearPoleProduct v s).natDegree = ∑ i, s i
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearPoleProduct, natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _
    (fun i _ => (monic_X_sub_C (v i)).pow (s i))]
  simp

name: Polynomial.degree_linearPoleRemainder_lt
statement:
theorem degree_linearPoleRemainder_lt (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ)
    (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) :
    (linearPoleRemainder v s c).degree < (∑ i, s i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
  apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
  intro i _
  apply (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt
  apply (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)).mpr
  intro j _
  have hprod : (∏ k ∈ univ.erase i, (X-C (v k))^(s k)).degree =
      ((∑ k ∈ univ.erase i, s k : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun k _ => (monic_X_sub_C (v k)).pow (s k))]
    simp
  have hsum : s i + (∑ k ∈ univ.erase i, s k) = ∑ k, s k :=
    (add_comm _ _).trans (sum_erase_add _ _ (mem_univ i))
  have hdeg : (C (c i j) * (X-C (v i))^j.val *
      ∏ k ∈ univ.erase i, (X-C (v k))^(s k)).degree ≤
        ((j.val + (∑ k ∈ univ.erase i, s k) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans
    rw [hprod, Nat.cast_add]
    apply add_le_add _ le_rfl
    apply (degree_mul_le _ _).trans
    simp only [degree_pow, degree_X_sub_C, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    simpa only [zero_add] using add_le_add (degree_C_le (a := c i j))
      (le_refl (j.val : WithBot ℕ))
  exact hdeg.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show j.val + (∑ k ∈ univ.erase i, s k) < ∑ k, s k by omega))

name: Polynomial.eq_C_of_degree_lt_one
statement:
private theorem eq_C_of_degree_lt_one {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree < (1 : WithBot ℕ)) :
    p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : p = 0
  · simp [h0]
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree h0] at hp
  apply eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero
  have h : p.natDegree < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hp
  omega

name: Polynomial.existsUnique_eq_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder
statement:
theorem existsUnique_eq_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (hv : Function.Injective v) (s : ι → ℕ) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    ∃! qc : 𝕜[X] × ((i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜),
      p = qc.1 * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s qc.2
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : Set.Pairwise (univ : Finset ι) (fun i j =>
      IsCoprime (X-C (v i)) (X-C (v j))) := fun i _ j _ hij => pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C hv hij
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, he⟩ := eq_quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow p
    (fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C (v i)) hcop s
  let c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜 := fun i j => (r i j).coeff 0
  have hrc (i : ι) (j : Fin (s i)) : r i j = C (c i j) :=
    eq_C_of_degree_lt_one (by simpa only [degree_X_sub_C] using hr i (mem_univ i) j)
  have heq : p = q * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s c := by
    simpa only [linearPoleProduct, linearPoleRemainder, hrc] using he
  refine ⟨(q,c), heq, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨q',c'⟩ he'
  obtain ⟨hq, hc⟩ := quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow_unique
    (fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C (v i)) hcop
    (q₁ := q') (q₂ := q) (r₁ := fun i j => C (c' i j)) (r₂ := fun i j => C (c i j))
    (fun i _ j => (degree_C_le).trans_lt (by simp))
    (fun i _ j => (degree_C_le).trans_lt (by simp)) (he'.symm.trans heq)
  refine Prod.ext hq ?_
  funext i j
  have h := congrArg (fun r => (r j).coeff 0) (hc i (mem_univ i))
  simpa only [coeff_C_zero] using h

name: Polynomial.degree_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder_lt_iff
statement:
theorem degree_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder_lt_iff
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) {d : ℕ} (hmd : (∑ i, s i) ≤ d)
    (q : 𝕜[X]) (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) :
    (q * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s c).degree < d ↔
      q.degree < (d - ∑ i, s i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · rw [hq, zero_mul, zero_add, degree_zero]
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
    · intro _
      exact (degree_linearPoleRemainder_lt v s c).trans_le
        (show (∑ i, s i : ℕ) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ) by exact_mod_cast hmd)
  have hqdeg : q.degree = (q.natDegree : ℕ) := degree_eq_natDegree hq
  have hprod : (linearPoleProduct v s).degree = (∑ i, s i : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (monic_linearPoleProduct v s).ne_zero, natDegree_linearPoleProduct]
  have hsmall : (linearPoleRemainder v s c).degree < (q * linearPoleProduct v s).degree := by
    rw [degree_mul, hqdeg, hprod, ← Nat.cast_add]
    exact (degree_linearPoleRemainder_lt v s c).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  rw [degree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt hsmall, degree_mul, hqdeg, hprod, ← Nat.cast_add]
  norm_cast
  omega

name: NLAlib.length_insertionWords
statement: theorem length_insertionWords (n j : ℕ) : (insertionWords n j).length = n.choose j
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => cases j <;> simp [insertionWords]
  | succ n ih => cases j <;> simp [insertionWords, ih, Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.add_comm]

name: NLAlib.length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords
statement:
theorem length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords {n j : ℕ} {w : List Bool}
    (hw : w ∈ insertionWords n j) : w.length = n ∧ w.count true = j
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j w with
  | zero =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp only [insertionWords, List.mem_singleton] at hw; subst w; simp
    | succ j => simp [insertionWords] at hw
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero =>
      simp only [insertionWords, List.mem_map] at hw
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hw
      obtain ⟨hl, hc⟩ := ih hv
      simp [hl, hc]
    | succ j =>
      simp only [insertionWords, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at hw
      rcases hw with ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨hl, hc⟩ := ih hv
        simp [hl, hc]
      · obtain ⟨hl, hc⟩ := ih hv
        simp [hl, hc]

name: NLAlib.insertionWords_eq_nil_of_lt
statement:
theorem insertionWords_eq_nil_of_lt {n j : ℕ} (hnj : n < j) :
    insertionWords n j = []
proof:
:= by
  apply List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp
  rw [length_insertionWords, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnj]

name: NLAlib.sum_insertionWords_zero
statement:
theorem sum_insertionWords_zero (A X : R) (n : ℕ) :
    ((insertionWords n 0).map (insertionWord A X)).sum = A ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [insertionWords, insertionWord]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [insertionWords, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, insertionWord,
      List.map_cons, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.prod_cons] at *
    rw [List.sum_map_mul_left]
    change A * ((insertionWords n 0).map (insertionWord A X)).sum = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.sum_insertionWords_succ_succ
statement:
theorem sum_insertionWords_succ_succ (A X : R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ((insertionWords (n + 1) (j + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum =
      A * ((insertionWords n (j + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum +
        X * ((insertionWords n j).map (insertionWord A X)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [insertionWords, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, insertionWord, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
    Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.sum_map_mul_left]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_insertionWords_eq_add_pow
statement:
theorem sum_sum_insertionWords_eq_add_pow (A X : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ((insertionWords n j).map (insertionWord A X)).sum) = (A + X) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [insertionWords, insertionWord]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp_rw [sum_insertionWords_succ_succ]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      sum_insertionWords_zero, ih]
    have hz : ((insertionWords n (n + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum = 0 := by
      rw [insertionWords_eq_nil_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
      simp
    have hs : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ((insertionWords n (j + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum) + A ^ n =
          (A + X) ^ n := by
      conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hz, add_zero]
      rw [← ih, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ n, sum_insertionWords_zero]
    calc
      _ = A * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((insertionWords n (j + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum) + A ^ n) +
            X * (A + X) ^ n := by rw [pow_succ']; noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hs, ← add_mul, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.length_subInsertionWords
statement:
theorem length_subInsertionWords (w : List Bool) :
    (subInsertionWords w).length = 2 ^ w.count true
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [subInsertionWords]
  | cons b w ih =>
    cases b with
    | false => simpa [subInsertionWords] using ih
    | true => simp [subInsertionWords, ih, pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]

name: NLAlib.counts_of_mem_subInsertionWords
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | nil => simp only [subInsertionWords, List.mem_singleton] at hv; subst v; simp
  | cons b w ih =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      simp only [subInsertionWords, List.mem_map] at hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
      obtain ⟨hf, ht⟩ := ih hu
      simp_all
    | true =>
      simp only [subInsertionWords, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at hv
      rcases hv with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨hf, ht⟩ := ih hu
        constructor
        · simpa using hf
        · simp only [List.count_cons_self]
          omega
      · obtain ⟨hf, ht⟩ := ih hu
        constructor
        · simpa using hf
        · simp only [List.count_cons_self]
          omega

name: NLAlib.insertionWord_sub_one_eq_sum
statement:
theorem insertionWord_sub_one_eq_sum (A H : R) (w : List Bool) :
    insertionWord A (H - 1) w =
      ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v => (-1 : R) ^ v.1 *
        insertionWord A H v.2).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [subInsertionWords, insertionWord]
  | cons b w ih =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      simp only [subInsertionWords, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
        insertionWord, List.map_cons, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.prod_cons]
      change A * insertionWord A (H - 1) w = _
      rw [ih]
      have hterm (v : ℕ × List Bool) :
          (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * (A * insertionWord A H v.2) =
            A * ((-1 : R) ^ v.1 * insertionWord A H v.2) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ((Commute.neg_one_left A).pow_left v.1).eq, mul_assoc]
      change A * ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
          (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * insertionWord A H v.2).sum =
        ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
          (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * (A * insertionWord A H v.2)).sum
      simp_rw [hterm]
      rw [List.sum_map_mul_left]
    | true =>
      simp only [subInsertionWords, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_map,
        Function.comp_def, insertionWord, List.map_cons, ↓reduceIte, List.prod_cons]
      change (H - 1) * insertionWord A (H - 1) w = _
      rw [ih]
      have hterm (v : ℕ × List Bool) :
          (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * (H * insertionWord A H v.2) =
            H * ((-1 : R) ^ v.1 * insertionWord A H v.2) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ((Commute.neg_one_left H).pow_left v.1).eq, mul_assoc]
      change (H - 1) * ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
          (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * insertionWord A H v.2).sum =
        ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
          (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * (H * insertionWord A H v.2)).sum +
        ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
          (-1 : R) ^ (v.1 + 1) * insertionWord A H v.2).sum
      simp_rw [hterm, List.sum_map_mul_left, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_mul]
      have hn (l : List (ℕ × List Bool)) :
          (l.map fun v => -((-1 : R) ^ v.1 * insertionWord A H v.2)).sum =
            -(l.map fun v => (-1 : R) ^ v.1 * insertionWord A H v.2).sum := by
        induction l with
        | nil => simp
        | cons v l ih => simp [ih, add_comm]
      rw [hn]
      noncomm_ring

name: CommRing.one_sub_sq_mul_inverse_product
statement:
theorem one_sub_sq_mul_inverse_product (t d e : R)
    (hd : (1-t)*d=1) (he : (1+t)*e=1) : (1-t^2)*(d*e)=1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ((1-t)*d)*((1+t)*e) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [hd, he, one_mul]

name: CommRing.cayley_value_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem cayley_value_mul_inverse (t d e : R)
    (hd : (1-t)*d=1) (he : (1+t)*e=1) : (d*(1+t))*(e*(1-t))=1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ((1-t)*d)*((1+t)*e) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [hd, he, one_mul]

name: CommRing.half_mul_cayley_add_inverse
statement:
theorem half_mul_cayley_add_inverse (t d e c : R)
    (hd : (1-t)*d=1) (he : (1+t)*e=1) (hc : c*2=1) :
    c*(d*(1+t)+e*(1-t)) = (d*e)*(1+t^2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = c*((d*(1+t))*(e*(1+t))+(e*(1-t))*(d*(1-t))) := by
      rw [mul_comm e (1+t), he, mul_comm d (1-t), hd, mul_one, mul_one]
    _ = c*(d*e)*((1+t)^2+(1-t)^2) := by ring
    _ = (c*2)*(d*e)*(1+t^2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hc, one_mul]

name: CommRing.one_sub_cayley_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_cayley_mul (x e : R) (he : (x+1)*e=1) :
    (1-(x-1)*e)*x = 1+(x-1)*e
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = 1+(x-1)*e+(x-1)*(1-(x+1)*e) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: commute_resolvent
statement:
theorem commute_resolvent {R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
    (a : A) (r s : R) : Commute (resolvent a r) (resolvent a s)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [resolvent]
  apply Commute.ringInverse_ringInverse
  exact (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left r _).sub_left
    ((Algebra.commute_algebraMap_right s a).sub_right (Commute.refl a))

name: star_resolvent
statement:
theorem star_resolvent {R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
    [InvolutiveStar R] [StarRing A] [StarModule R A] (a : A) (r : R) :
    star (resolvent a r) = resolvent (star a) (star r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resolvent, ← Ring.inverse_star, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    star_sub, star_smul, star_one]

name: spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent_eq_sub_smul_mul
statement:
theorem spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent_eq_sub_smul_mul
    {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
    (a : A) {z w : R} (hz : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hw : w ∈ resolventSet R a) :
    resolvent a z - resolvent a w = (w-z) • (resolvent a z * resolvent a w)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : resolvent a z * (algebraMap R A z-a) = 1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hz
  have hj : (algebraMap R A w-a) * resolvent a w = 1 := Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hw
  have he : (algebraMap R A w-a)-(algebraMap R A z-a) = (w-z) • (1 : A) := by
    rw [sub_smul, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    abel
  calc
    _ = resolvent a z * ((algebraMap R A w-a)-(algebraMap R A z-a)) *
        resolvent a w := by
