      rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, hj, hi, mul_one, one_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [he, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, smul_mul_assoc]

name: Polynomial.X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference (p : 𝕜[X]) (z : 𝕜) :
    (X - C z) * p.dividedDifference z = p - C (p.eval z)
proof:
:= by
  have hmod : (p - C (p.eval z)) %ₘ (X - C z) = 0 := by
    rw [modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval]
    simp
  have h := modByMonic_add_div (p - C (p.eval z)) (X - C z)
  rw [hmod, zero_add] at h
  exact h

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_C
statement: @[simp] theorem dividedDifference_C (a z : 𝕜) : (C a).dividedDifference z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero
  rw [X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference]
  simp

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem dividedDifference_add (p q : 𝕜[X]) (z : 𝕜) :
    (p + q).dividedDifference z = p.dividedDifference z + q.dividedDifference z
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero
  rw [mul_add, X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference,
    X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, eval_add, map_add]
  ring

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_C_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem dividedDifference_C_mul (a : 𝕜) (p : 𝕜[X]) (z : 𝕜) :
    (C a * p).dividedDifference z = C a * p.dividedDifference z
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero
  rw [X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, mul_left_comm, X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference,
    eval_mul, eval_C, map_mul]
  ring

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem dividedDifference_sub (p q : 𝕜[X]) (z : 𝕜) :
    (p - q).dividedDifference z = p.dividedDifference z - q.dividedDifference z
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero
  rw [mul_sub, X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference,
    X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, eval_sub, map_sub]
  ring

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_X_mul
statement:
theorem dividedDifference_X_mul (p : 𝕜[X]) (z : 𝕜) :
    (X * p).dividedDifference z = X * p.dividedDifference z + C (p.eval z)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (monic_X_sub_C z).ne_zero
  rw [X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, mul_add, mul_left_comm,
    X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference, eval_mul, eval_X, map_mul]
  ring

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_one
statement: @[simp] theorem dividedDifference_one (z : 𝕜) : (1 : 𝕜[X]).dividedDifference z = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [C_1] using dividedDifference_C (1 : 𝕜) z

name: Polynomial.dividedDifference_X
statement: @[simp] theorem dividedDifference_X (z : 𝕜) : (X : 𝕜[X]).dividedDifference z = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_one, dividedDifference_one, mul_zero, zero_add, eval_one, C_1] using
    dividedDifference_X_mul (1 : 𝕜[X]) z

name: Polynomial.degree_dividedDifference_lt
statement:
theorem degree_dividedDifference_lt {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) (z : 𝕜) : (p.dividedDifference z).degree < n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : p.dividedDifference z = 0
  · rw [hq, degree_zero]
    exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
  apply (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hq).mp
  have hnum : (p - C (p.eval z)).natDegree ≤ n :=
    (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le hp (by rw [natDegree_C]; exact Nat.zero_le n))
  rw [dividedDifference, natDegree_divByMonic _ (monic_X_sub_C z), natDegree_X_sub_C]
  omega

name: Polynomial.eval_dividedDifference_self
statement:
theorem eval_dividedDifference_self (p : 𝕜[X]) (z : 𝕜) :
    (p.dividedDifference z).eval z = p.derivative.eval z
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : 𝕜[X] => q.derivative.eval z)
    (X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference p z)
  simpa only [derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C,
    sub_zero, one_mul, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C,
    sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero] using h

name: Polynomial.eval_dividedDifference_of_ne
statement:
theorem eval_dividedDifference_of_ne (p : 𝕜[X]) {x z : 𝕜} (hx : x ≠ z) :
    (p.dividedDifference z).eval x = (p.eval x - p.eval z) / (x - z)
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx)).mpr
  have h := congrArg (eval x) (X_sub_C_mul_dividedDifference p z)
  simpa only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, mul_comm] using h

name: Polynomial.eval_dividedDifference_comm
statement:
theorem eval_dividedDifference_comm (p : 𝕜[X]) (x y : 𝕜) :
    (p.dividedDifference x).eval y = (p.dividedDifference y).eval x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    rfl
  rw [eval_dividedDifference_of_ne p (fun h => hxy h.symm), eval_dividedDifference_of_ne p hxy]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_alternating_affine_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_alternating_affine_two_mul {R : Type*} [Field R] (N : ℕ) (α β : R) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (2 * N), (-1 : R) ^ j * (α - ((j : R) + 1 / 2) * β)) = (N : R) * β
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (N + 1) = (2 * N + 1) + 1 by omega, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, ih]
    have heven : (-1 : R) ^ (2 * N) = 1 := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
    have hodd : (-1 : R) ^ (2 * N + 1) = -1 := by rw [pow_succ, heven]; norm_num
    rw [heven, hodd]
    push_cast
    ring

name: spectrum.sub_smul_resolvent_pow_mul_pow
statement:
theorem sub_smul_resolvent_pow_mul_pow
    {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
    (a : A) {z w : R} (hz : z∈resolventSet R a) (hw : w∈resolventSet R a)
    (p q : ℕ) :
    (w-z)•(resolvent a z^(p+1)*resolvent a w^(q+1))=
      resolvent a z^(p+1)*resolvent a w^q-
        resolvent a z^p*resolvent a w^(q+1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = resolvent a z^p*((w-z)•(resolvent a z*resolvent a w))*resolvent a w^q := by
      rw [pow_succ (resolvent a z),pow_succ' (resolvent a w)]
      simp only [smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm,mul_assoc]
    _ = resolvent a z^p*(resolvent a z-resolvent a w)*resolvent a w^q := by
      rw [← resolvent_sub_resolvent_eq_sub_smul_mul a hz hw]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [pow_succ (resolvent a z),pow_succ' (resolvent a w)]
      noncomm_ring

name: mul_pow_sub_pow_mul_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mul_pow_sub_pow_mul_eq_sum {R : Type*} [Ring R] (a b : R) (n : ℕ) :
    a * b ^ n - b ^ n * a =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, b ^ k * (a * b - b * a) * b ^ (n - 1 - k)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → R := fun k => b ^ k * a * b ^ (n - k)
  calc
    _ = f 0 - f n := by simp [f]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (f k - f (k + 1)) := (Finset.sum_range_sub' f n).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hsub : n - k = (n - 1 - k) + 1 := by omega
      have hsub' : n - (k + 1) = n - 1 - k := by omega
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [hsub, hsub', pow_succ b k, pow_succ' b (n - 1 - k)]
      noncomm_ring

name: Polynomial.derivativeResolvent_apply_of_le
statement:
theorem derivativeResolvent_apply_of_le {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (a : 𝕜) :
    derivativeResolvent a p = ∑ r ∈ range (n+1), (a⁻¹)^(r+1) • derivative^[r] p
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [derivativeResolvent]
  exact Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ (by simp [hn]) _ (by simp)

name: Polynomial.derivativeResolvent_apply
statement:
theorem derivativeResolvent_apply (a : 𝕜) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    derivativeResolvent a p =
      ∑ r ∈ range (p.natDegree+1), (a⁻¹)^(r+1) • derivative^[r] p
proof:
:=
  derivativeResolvent_apply_of_le le_rfl a

name: Polynomial.natDegree_derivativeResolvent_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_derivativeResolvent_le (a : 𝕜) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    (derivativeResolvent a p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivativeResolvent_apply]
  apply (natDegree_sum_le _ _).trans
  rw [Finset.fold_max_le]
  refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, fun i _ => ?_⟩
  exact (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans ((natDegree_iterate_derivative p i).trans (Nat.sub_le _ _))

name: Polynomial.sub_derivative_derivativeResolvent
statement:
theorem sub_derivative_derivativeResolvent {a : 𝕜} (ha : a ≠ 0) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    a • derivativeResolvent a p - (derivativeResolvent a p).derivative = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivativeResolvent_apply, smul_sum, derivative_sum]
  simp_rw [derivative_smul, ← Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  have hcoeff (r : ℕ) : a * (a⁻¹)^(r+1) = (a⁻¹)^r := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    calc
      a * ((a⁻¹)^r * a⁻¹) = (a⁻¹)^r * (a*a⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = (a⁻¹)^r := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, mul_one]
  simp_rw [smul_smul, hcoeff]
  rw [sum_range_succ' (f := fun r => (a⁻¹)^r • derivative^[r] p)]
  simp only [pow_zero, Function.iterate_zero_apply, one_smul]
  rw [sum_range_succ]
  rw [iterate_derivative_eq_zero (Nat.lt_succ_self p.natDegree), smul_zero, add_zero]
  abel

name: Polynomial.derivative_derivativeResolvent
statement:
theorem derivative_derivativeResolvent {a : 𝕜} (ha : a ≠ 0) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    (derivativeResolvent a p).derivative = a • derivativeResolvent a p - p
proof:
:= by
  have h := sub_derivative_derivativeResolvent ha p
  apply eq_sub_of_add_eq
  simpa only [add_comm] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h).symm

name: Polynomial.coeff_derivativeResolvent_of_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem coeff_derivativeResolvent_of_natDegree_le {a : 𝕜} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (derivativeResolvent a p).coeff n = p.coeff n / a
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : 𝕜[X] => q.coeff n) (derivative_derivativeResolvent ha p)
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_sub, coeff_smul] at h
  rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
    ((natDegree_derivativeResolvent_le a p).trans_lt (hp.trans_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self n))),
    zero_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  apply (eq_div_iff ha).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h.symm)

name: Polynomial.eval_nonneg_of_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem eval_nonneg_of_coeff_nonneg {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p.coeff k)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ p.eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_eq_sum_range]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hp k) (pow_nonneg hx k)

name: Polynomial.eval_pos_of_coeff_nonneg_of_coeff_zero_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_eq_sum_range]
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum
    (s := Finset.range (p.natDegree+1)) (f := fun k => p.coeff k * x^k)
    (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hp k) (pow_nonneg hx k))
    (show 0 ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree+1) by simp)
  simp only [pow_zero, mul_one] at h
  exact hp0.trans_le h

name: Polynomial.coeff_iterate_derivative_nonneg
statement:
theorem coeff_iterate_derivative_nonneg {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p.coeff k)
    (r k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] p).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_iterate_derivative, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hp _)

name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_comp_X_add_C
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_comp_X_add_C (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] (p.comp (X+C a)) =
      ((derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] p).comp (X+C a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, derivative_comp]
    simp only [derivative_add, derivative_X, derivative_C, add_zero, one_mul,
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_eval_nonneg_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_eval_nonneg_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
    {p : ℝ[X]} {a : ℝ} (hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ (p.comp (X+C a)).coeff k)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : a ≤ x) (r : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ((derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[r] p).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h := eval_nonneg_of_coeff_nonneg (fun k => coeff_iterate_derivative_nonneg hp r k)
    (show 0 ≤ x-a by linarith)
  rw [iterate_derivative_comp_X_add_C, eval_comp, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C,
    sub_add_cancel] at h
  exact h

name: Polynomial.eval_pos_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem eval_pos_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg {p : ℝ[X]} {a : ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ (p.comp (X+C a)).coeff k)
    (hp0 : 0 < (p.comp (X+C a)).coeff 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : a ≤ x) :
    0 < p.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h := eval_pos_of_coeff_nonneg_of_coeff_zero_pos hp hp0
    (show 0 ≤ x-a by linarith)
  simpa only [eval_comp, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, sub_add_cancel] using h

name: Polynomial.derivative_eval_pos_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem derivative_eval_pos_of_shifted_coeff_nonneg {p : ℝ[X]} {a : ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ (p.comp (X+C a)).coeff k)
    (hp1 : 0 < (p.comp (X+C a)).coeff 1) {x : ℝ} (hx : a ≤ x) :
    0 < p.derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((p.comp (X+C a)).derivative).coeff k := by
    rw [coeff_derivative]
    exact mul_nonneg (hp _) (by positivity)
  have hzero : 0 < ((p.comp (X+C a)).derivative).coeff 0 := by
    simpa only [coeff_derivative, zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_one] using hp1
  have h := eval_pos_of_coeff_nonneg_of_coeff_zero_pos hcoeff hzero
    (show 0 ≤ x-a by linarith)
  have hd := iterate_derivative_comp_X_add_C p a 1
  simp only [Function.iterate_one] at hd
  rw [hd, eval_comp, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, sub_add_cancel] at h
  exact h

name: Polynomial.shifted_laguerre_recurrence_coeff_certificate
statement:
theorem shifted_laguerre_recurrence_coeff_certificate
    (P : ℕ → ℝ[X]) (hP0 : P 0 = 1)
    (hP : ∀ j, P (j+1) = (X-C (2*(j:ℝ)+1)) * P j - C ((j:ℝ)^2) * P (j-1))
    (N j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    (∀ k, 0 ≤ ((P j).comp (X+C (4*(N:ℝ)))).coeff k) ∧
    (∀ k, 0 ≤ (((P j).comp (X+C (4*(N:ℝ)))) -
      C (j:ℝ) * ((P (j-1)).comp (X+C (4*(N:ℝ))))).coeff k) ∧
    0 < ((P j).comp (X+C (4*(N:ℝ)))).coeff 0 ∧
    (0 < j → 0 < ((P j).comp (X+C (4*(N:ℝ)))).coeff 1)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℕ → ℝ[X] := fun j => (P j).comp (X+C (4*(N:ℝ)))
  change (∀ k, 0 ≤ (Q j).coeff k) ∧
    (∀ k, 0 ≤ (Q j - C (j:ℝ)*Q (j-1)).coeff k) ∧
    0 < (Q j).coeff 0 ∧ (0 < j → 0 < (Q j).coeff 1)
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    simp [Q, hP0]
    intro k
    rw [← C_1, coeff_C]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hQ, hgap, hQ0, _⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hrec : Q (j+1) - C ((j+1:ℕ):ℝ) * Q j =
        X*Q j + C (4*(N:ℝ)-4*j-2)*Q j + C (j:ℝ)*(Q j-C (j:ℝ)*Q (j-1)) := by
      dsimp [Q]
      rw [hP]
      apply Polynomial.funext
      intro x
      simp only [eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hscalar : 0 ≤ 4*(N:ℝ)-4*j-2 := by
      have : (j:ℝ)+1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hj
      linarith
    have hX (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (X*Q j).coeff k := by
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k => simpa only [coeff_X_mul] using hQ k
    have hg (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (Q (j+1)-C ((j+1:ℕ):ℝ)*Q j).coeff k := by
      rw [hrec, coeff_add, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C_mul]
      exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (hX k) (mul_nonneg hscalar (hQ k)))
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hgap k))
    have hnext (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (Q (j+1)).coeff k := by
      have := hg k
      rw [coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul] at this
      nlinarith [hQ k, show (0:ℝ) ≤ j+1 by positivity]
    refine ⟨hnext, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hg
    · have := hg 0
      rw [coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul] at this
      have hp : 0 < ((j+1:ℕ):ℝ) * (Q j).coeff 0 := mul_pos (by positivity) hQ0
      linarith
    · intro _
      have h1 : (Q j).coeff 0 ≤
          (Q (j+1)-C ((j+1:ℕ):ℝ)*Q j).coeff 1 := by
        rw [hrec, coeff_add, coeff_add, coeff_X_mul, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C_mul]
        have := mul_nonneg hscalar (hQ 1)
        have := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ j by positivity) (hgap 1)
        linarith
      rw [coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul] at h1
      have := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ j+1 by positivity) (hQ 1)
      push_cast at h1
      linarith

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_forall_abs_eval_le_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_abs_eval_le_of_nonpos {P : ℝ[X]} {M : ℝ} (hM : M ≤ 0)
    (hP : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |P.eval x| ≤ M) : P = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot
  refine Set.Infinite.mono (fun x hx => ?_) (Set.Icc_infinite (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 1))
  have := hP x hx
  have h0 : |P.eval x| = 0 := le_antisymm (this.trans hM) (abs_nonneg _)
  exact abs_eq_zero.mp h0

name: NLAlib.eval_iterate_derivative_natDegree
statement:
theorem eval_iterate_derivative_natDegree (p : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    (derivative^[p.natDegree] p).eval x = p.natDegree.factorial * p.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have h : (derivative^[p.natDegree] p).natDegree ≤ 0 :=
    (natDegree_iterate_derivative p _).trans (by omega)
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero h, eval_C, coeff_iterate_derivative, zero_add,
    Nat.descFactorial_self, nsmul_eq_mul, leadingCoeff]

name: List.ofFn_insertNth_eq_take_cons_drop
statement:
theorem ofFn_insertNth_eq_take_cons_drop {α : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (v : Fin m → α) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (a : α) :
    List.ofFn (Fin.insertNth i a v) =
      (List.ofFn v).take i ++ a :: (List.ofFn v).drop i
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have hi : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
    subst i
    simp
  | succ m ih =>
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp
    · rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail v, Fin.insertNth_succ_cons,
        List.ofFn_cons, List.ofFn_cons, ih]
      simp

name: Matrix.det_submatrix_singleton
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_singleton (M : Matrix n n R) (i : n) :
    (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : ↥({i} : Finset n) → n)
      (Subtype.val : ↥({i} : Finset n) → n)).det = M i i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Unique ↥({i} : Finset n) :=
    { default := ⟨i, by simp⟩
      uniq := fun j => Subtype.ext (Finset.mem_singleton.mp j.property) }
  have hd : ((default : ↥({i} : Finset n)) : n) = i :=
    Finset.mem_singleton.mp (default : ↥({i} : Finset n)).property
  simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, hd] using
    det_unique (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : ↥({i} : Finset n) → n)
      (Subtype.val : ↥({i} : Finset n) → n))

name: Matrix.det_submatrix_pair
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_pair (M : Matrix n n R) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : ↥({i, j} : Finset n) → n)
      (Subtype.val : ↥({i, j} : Finset n) → n)).det =
      M i i * M j j - M i j * M j i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Fin 2 → ↥({i, j} : Finset n) := fun a =>
    if a = 0 then ⟨i, by simp⟩ else ⟨j, by simp⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · intro a b h
      have he := congrArg Subtype.val h
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all [f]
    · intro a
      have ha := a.property
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
      rcases ha with ha | ha
      · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [f] using ha.symm
      · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [f] using ha.symm
  let e := Equiv.ofBijective f hf
  rw [← det_submatrix_equiv_self e
    (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : ↥({i, j} : Finset n) → n)
      (Subtype.val : ↥({i, j} : Finset n) → n)), det_fin_two]
  simp [e, f, Matrix.submatrix_apply]

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_transpose_mul_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem exists_eq_transpose_mul_of_posSemidef [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : ∃ F : Matrix n n ℝ, A = Fᵀ * F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := CStarAlgebra.nonneg_iff_eq_star_mul_self.mp hA.nonneg
  exact ⟨F, by rw [hF, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]⟩

name: Matrix.det_one_add_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem det_one_add_diagonal_mul (M : Matrix n n R) (z : n → R) :
    (1 + diagonal z * M).det =
      ∑ S : Finset n, (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det * ∏ i ∈ S, z i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := (detRowAlternating : (n → R) [⋀^n]→ₗ[R] R)
  rw [add_comm]
  change D ((fun i => (diagonal z * M) i) + fun i => (1 : Matrix n n R) i) = _
  rw [D.map_add_univ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  have hrow : S.piecewise (fun i => (diagonal z * M) i)
      (fun i => (1 : Matrix n n R) i) =
      fun i => (if i ∈ S then z i else 1) • S.piecewise M (1 : Matrix n n R) i := by
    funext i j
    simp only [Finset.piecewise, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hrow, D.map_smul_univ]
  change (∏ i, if i ∈ S then z i else 1) *
    (Matrix.of (S.piecewise M (1 : Matrix n n R))).det = _
  have hd := det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det M S
  change (Matrix.of (S.piecewise M (1 : Matrix n n R))).det = _ at hd
  rw [hd]
  simp only [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, mul_comm]

name: Matrix.det_one_add_eq_sum_principal_minors
statement:
theorem det_one_add_eq_sum_principal_minors (M : Matrix n n R) :
    (1 + M).det =
      ∑ S : Finset n, (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [diagonal_one, one_mul, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one] using
    det_one_add_diagonal_mul M (fun _ => 1)

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_minor_dominant
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_minor_dominant {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    ∑ i ∈ univ.erase j, ‖A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j)‖ <
      ‖A (k.succAbove j) (k.succAbove j)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < A k (k.succAbove j) := hpos _ _ (Fin.ne_succAbove _ _)
  have hoff : ∀ i ∈ univ.erase j, 0 < A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) := by
    intro i hi
    exact hpos _ _ (fun h => (mem_erase.mp hi).1 (Fin.succAbove_right_injective h))
  have hcol := hsum (k.succAbove j)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => A i (k.succAbove j)) k,
    ← sum_erase_add univ (fun i => A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j)) (mem_univ j)] at hcol
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ univ.erase j, A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) :=
    sum_nonneg fun i hi => (hoff i hi).le
  have hd : A (k.succAbove j) (k.succAbove j) < 0 := by linarith
  simp_rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_neg hd]
  have heq : (∑ i ∈ univ.erase j, |A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j)|) =
      ∑ i ∈ univ.erase j, A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) :=
    sum_congr rfl fun i hi => abs_of_pos (hoff i hi)
  rw [heq]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_det_minor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_det_minor_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) : (A.submatrix k.succAbove k.succAbove).det ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  det_ne_zero_of_sum_col_lt_diag (strictColumnLaplacian_minor_dominant A hpos hsum k)

name: NLAlib.minorDiagonalHomotopy_det_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem minorDiagonalHomotopy_det_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (minorDiagonalHomotopy A k s).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply det_ne_zero_of_sum_col_lt_diag
  intro j
  have hd := strictColumnLaplacian_minor_dominant A hpos hsum k j
  dsimp [minorDiagonalHomotopy]
  simp only [ite_true]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hd
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hij := (mem_erase.mp hi).1
  rw [if_neg hij, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
  change s * ‖A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j)‖ ≤ _
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hs.2

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_signed_det_minor_pos
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_signed_det_minor_pos {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (A.submatrix k.succAbove k.succAbove).det
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (minorDiagonalHomotopy A k s).det
  have hf : Continuous f := by
    apply Continuous.const_mul
    apply Continuous.matrix_det
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    apply continuous_pi
    intro j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp only [minorDiagonalHomotopy, if_pos hij]
      exact continuous_const
    · simp only [minorDiagonalHomotopy, if_neg hij]
      exact continuous_id.mul continuous_const
  have hne : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f s ≠ 0 := fun s hs =>
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (minorDiagonalHomotopy_det_ne_zero A hpos hsum k hs)
  have hf0 : 0 < f 0 := by
    have hzero : minorDiagonalHomotopy A k 0 =
        Matrix.diagonal (fun j => A (k.succAbove j) (k.succAbove j)) := by
      ext i j
      simp only [minorDiagonalHomotopy, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    dsimp [f]
    rw [hzero, Matrix.det_diagonal]
    have hprod : (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (∏ j : Fin n, A (k.succAbove j) (k.succAbove j)) =
        ∏ j : Fin n, -A (k.succAbove j) (k.succAbove j) := by
      simpa only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using (prod_neg (s := univ)
        (fun j : Fin n => A (k.succAbove j) (k.succAbove j))).symm
    rw [hprod]
    apply prod_pos
    intro j hj
    have hcol := hsum (k.succAbove j)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => A i (k.succAbove j)) k,
      ← sum_erase_add univ (fun i => A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j)) (mem_univ j)] at hcol
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ univ.erase j, A (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) := by
      apply sum_nonneg
      intro i hi
      exact (hpos _ _ (fun h => (mem_erase.mp hi).1 (Fin.succAbove_right_injective h))).le
    have hk := hpos k (k.succAbove j) (Fin.ne_succAbove _ _)
    linarith
  have hprod := mul_pos_of_continuousOn_ne_zero hf.continuousOn hne
    (x := 0) (y := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hf1 : 0 < f 1 := (mul_pos_iff.mp hprod).resolve_right (by intro h; linarith [h.1]) |>.2
  have hone : minorDiagonalHomotopy A k 1 = A.submatrix k.succAbove k.succAbove := by
    ext i j
    simp only [minorDiagonalHomotopy, submatrix_apply, one_mul, ite_self]
  simpa only [f, hone] using hf1

name: Matrix.conjTranspose_ofRowList_mul_ofRowList
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_ofRowList_mul_ofRowList (rows : List (n → 𝕜)) :
    (ofRowList rows)ᴴ * ofRowList rows =
      (rows.map (fun a => vecMulVec (star a) a)).sum
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (rows.map (fun a => vecMulVec (star a) a)).sum =
      ∑ i : Fin rows.length, vecMulVec (star (rows.get i)) (rows.get i) := by
    rw [← List.ofFn_getElem_eq_map rows (fun a => vecMulVec (star a) a), List.sum_ofFn]
    rfl
  rw [hm]
  ext j k
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply, ofRowList]

name: Matrix.sum_rowGrams_ofFn
statement:
theorem sum_rowGrams_ofFn {N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin N) n 𝕜) :
    ((List.ofFn (fun i => A i)).map (fun a => vecMulVec (star a) a)).sum = Aᴴ * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  ext j k
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    Function.comp_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply]

name: Matrix.conjTranspose_updateRow_mul_updateRow_eq_add
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_updateRow_mul_updateRow_eq_add [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i : m) (a : n → 𝕜) (hi : B i = 0) :
    (B.updateRow i a)ᴴ * B.updateRow i a = Bᴴ * B + vecMulVec (star a) a
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
    (fun t => star ((B.updateRow i a) t j) * (B.updateRow i a) t k) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
    (fun t => star (B t j) * B t k) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have he : (∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      star ((B.updateRow i a) t j) * (B.updateRow i a) t k) =
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, star (B t j) * B t k := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [Matrix.updateRow_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp ht).1]
  rw [he]
  simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self, hi, Pi.zero_apply, star_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem mul_apply_self_of_isUpperTriangular {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [LinearOrder n]
    [Semiring R] {A B : Matrix n n R} (hA : A.IsUpperTriangular) (hB : B.IsUpperTriangular)
    (i : n) : (A * B) i i = A i i * B i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · intro k _ hki
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hki with h | h
    · rw [hA h, zero_mul]
    · rw [hB h, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.mul_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular
statement:
theorem mul_apply_self_of_isLowerTriangular {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [LinearOrder n]
    [Semiring R] {A B : Matrix n n R} (hA : A.IsLowerTriangular) (hB : B.IsLowerTriangular)
    (i : n) : (A * B) i i = A i i * B i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · intro k _ hki
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hki with h | h
    · rw [hB (i := k) (j := i) h, mul_zero]
    · rw [hA (i := i) (j := k) h, zero_mul]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.eq_one_of_isLowerTriangular_of_mul_transpose_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hOther : Rᵀ * R = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hOrth
  let : Invertible R := ⟨Rᵀ, hOther, hOrth⟩
  have hTranspose : Rᵀ.IsLowerTriangular := by
    have h := Matrix.blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular hR
    rwa [Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hOrth] at h
  have hOff (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) : R i j = 0 := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
    · exact hR (i := i) (j := j) hlt
    · exact hTranspose (i := j) (j := i) hgt
  have hDiagonal (i : n) : R i i = 1 := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hOrth i) i
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i] at h
    · have hh := hDiag i
      nlinarith
    · intro j _ hji
      rw [hOff i j hji.symm, zero_mul]
    · simp
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simpa only [Matrix.one_apply_eq] using hDiagonal i
  · rw [hOff i j hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne hij]

name: List.arcLength_prependArc
statement:
private theorem arcLength_prependArc (mode : Bool) (s : Arc) :
    arcLength (prependArc mode s) = arcLength s + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases mode <;> simp [arcLength, prependArc] <;> omega

name: List.arcLength_singletonArc
statement: private theorem arcLength_singletonArc (mode : Bool) : arcLength (singletonArc mode) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [singletonArc, arcLength_prependArc]
  rfl

name: List.arcValue_singletonArc
statement:
private theorem arcValue_singletonArc {B : Type*} [Monoid B] (X Y : B) (mode : Bool) :
    arcValue X Y (singletonArc mode) = modeValue X Y mode
proof:
:= by
  cases mode <;> simp [arcValue, singletonArc, prependArc, modeValue]

name: List.arcValue_prependArc
proof:
:= by
  cases mode with
  | false => simp [arcValue, prependArc, modeValue, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  | true =>
    change X ^ s.1 * Y ^ (s.2 + 1) = Y * (X ^ s.1 * Y ^ s.2)
    rw [pow_succ']
    calc
      X ^ s.1 * (Y * Y ^ s.2) = (X ^ s.1 * Y) * Y ^ s.2 := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (Y * X ^ s.1) * Y ^ s.2 :=
        congrArg (fun t => t * Y ^ s.2) (hXY.pow_left s.1).eq
      _ = Y * (X ^ s.1 * Y ^ s.2) := mul_assoc _ _ _

name: List.arcValue_addArc
proof:
:= by
  simp only [arcValue, addArc, pow_add]
  calc
    (X ^ s.1 * X ^ t.1) * (Y ^ s.2 * Y ^ t.2) =
        X ^ s.1 * ((X ^ t.1 * Y ^ s.2) * Y ^ t.2) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = X ^ s.1 * ((Y ^ s.2 * X ^ t.1) * Y ^ t.2) :=
      congrArg (fun z => X ^ s.1 * (z * Y ^ t.2)) (hXY.pow_pow t.1 s.2).eq
    _ = (X ^ s.1 * Y ^ s.2) * (X ^ t.1 * Y ^ t.2) := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: List.eval_splitTaggedBlocks
statement:
private theorem eval_splitTaggedBlocks {B κ : Type*} [Monoid B] {X Y : B}
    (hXY : Commute X Y) (C : κ → B) (w : List (TaggedBlock κ)) :
    (w.map (blockValue X Y C)).prod =
      arcValue X Y (splitTaggedBlocks w).1 *
        ((splitTaggedBlocks w).2.map (segmentValue X Y C)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [splitTaggedBlocks, arcValue]
  | cons b w ih =>
    obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
    cases c with
    | none =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, blockValue, Option.elim_none, mul_one]
      change modeValue X Y mode * (w.map (blockValue X Y C)).prod =
        arcValue X Y (prependArc mode (splitTaggedBlocks w).1) *
          ((splitTaggedBlocks w).2.map (segmentValue X Y C)).prod
      rw [ih, arcValue_prependArc hXY, mul_assoc]
    | some tag =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, blockValue, Option.elim_some]
      change (modeValue X Y mode * C tag) * (w.map (blockValue X Y C)).prod =
        arcValue X Y (singletonArc mode) *
          (C tag * arcValue X Y (splitTaggedBlocks w).1 *
            ((splitTaggedBlocks w).2.map (segmentValue X Y C)).prod)
      rw [ih, arcValue_singletonArc]
      simp only [mul_assoc]

name: List.length_segments_splitTaggedBlocks
statement:
private theorem length_segments_splitTaggedBlocks {κ : Type*} (w : List (TaggedBlock κ)) :
    (splitTaggedBlocks w).2.length = (w.filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
    cases c <;> simp [splitTaggedBlocks, ih]

name: List.totalArcLength_splitTaggedBlocks
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
    cases c with
    | none =>
      change arcLength (prependArc mode (splitTaggedBlocks w).1) +
        (((splitTaggedBlocks w).2.map (fun s => arcLength s.2)).sum) = w.length + 1
      rw [arcLength_prependArc]
      omega
    | some tag =>
      change arcLength (singletonArc mode) +
        (arcLength (splitTaggedBlocks w).1 +
          (((splitTaggedBlocks w).2.map (fun s => arcLength s.2)).sum)) = w.length + 1
      rw [arcLength_singletonArc]
      omega

name: List.eval_closeSegments
statement:
private theorem eval_closeSegments {B κ : Type*} [Monoid B] {X Y : B}
    (hXY : Commute X Y) (C : κ → B) (lead : Arc)
    (s : List (ArcSegment κ)) (hs : s ≠ []) :
    ((closeSegments lead s).map (segmentValue X Y C)).prod =
      (s.map (segmentValue X Y C)).prod * arcValue X Y lead
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => exact (hs rfl).elim
  | cons t s ih =>
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      obtain ⟨tag, a⟩ := t
      simp [closeSegments, segmentValue, arcValue_addArc hXY, mul_assoc]
    | cons u s =>
      simp only [closeSegments, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
      rw [ih (by simp)]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]

name: List.arcLength_addArc
statement:
private theorem arcLength_addArc (s t : Arc) :
    arcLength (addArc s t) = arcLength s + arcLength t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [arcLength, addArc]
  omega

name: List.leadingArc_pos_of_ne_nil
statement:
private theorem leadingArc_pos_of_ne_nil {κ : Type*} (w : List (TaggedBlock κ)) (hw : w ≠ []) :
    0 < arcLength (splitTaggedBlocks w).1
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil => exact (hw rfl).elim
  | cons b w =>
    obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
    cases c with
    | none =>
      change 0 < arcLength (prependArc mode (splitTaggedBlocks w).1)
      rw [arcLength_prependArc]
      omega
    | some tag =>
      change 0 < arcLength (singletonArc mode)
      rw [arcLength_singletonArc]
      decide

name: List.positiveInternalArcs_splitTaggedBlocks
statement:
private theorem positiveInternalArcs_splitTaggedBlocks {κ : Type*} (w : List (TaggedBlock κ)) :
    positiveInternalArcs (splitTaggedBlocks w).2
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons b w ih =>
    obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
    cases c with
    | none => exact ih
    | some tag =>
      change positiveInternalArcs ((tag, (splitTaggedBlocks w).1) :: (splitTaggedBlocks w).2)
      cases ht : (splitTaggedBlocks w).2 with
      | nil => trivial
      | cons t s =>
        have hw : w ≠ [] := by
          intro hw
          subst w
          simp [splitTaggedBlocks] at ht
        exact ⟨leadingArc_pos_of_ne_nil w hw, by simpa only [ht] using ih⟩

name: List.map_tags_closeSegments
statement:
private theorem map_tags_closeSegments {κ : Type*} (lead : Arc) (s : List (ArcSegment κ)) :
    (closeSegments lead s).map Prod.fst = s.map Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t s ih =>
    cases s with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons u s =>
      simp only [closeSegments, List.map_cons]
      exact congrArg (List.cons t.1) ih

name: List.totalArcLength_closeSegments
statement:
private theorem totalArcLength_closeSegments {κ : Type*} (lead : Arc)
    (s : List (ArcSegment κ)) (hs : s ≠ []) :
    ((closeSegments lead s).map (fun t => arcLength t.2)).sum =
      (s.map (fun t => arcLength t.2)).sum + arcLength lead
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => exact (hs rfl).elim
  | cons t s ih =>
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      obtain ⟨tag, a⟩ := t
      simp [closeSegments, arcLength_addArc]
    | cons u s =>
      simp only [closeSegments, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [ih (by simp)]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.add_assoc]

name: List.positiveArcs_closeSegments
statement:
private theorem positiveArcs_closeSegments {κ : Type*} (lead : Arc)
    (hLead : 0 < arcLength lead) (s : List (ArcSegment κ))
    (hs : positiveInternalArcs s) :
    ∀ t ∈ closeSegments lead s, 0 < arcLength t.2
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [closeSegments]
  | cons t s ih =>
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      intro u hu
      simp only [closeSegments, List.mem_singleton] at hu
      subst u
      rw [arcLength_addArc]
      omega
    | cons u s =>
      obtain ⟨ht, hrest⟩ := hs
      intro v hv
      simp only [closeSegments, List.mem_cons] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | hv
      · exact ht
      · exact ih hrest v hv

name: List.segments_ne_nil_of_marked
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hc := length_segments_splitTaggedBlocks w
  rw [hs, List.length_nil] at hc
  omega

name: List.closedSegments_spec
proof:
:= closeSegments (splitTaggedBlocks w).1 (splitTaggedBlocks w).2
    c.length = (w.filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length ∧
      (c.map (fun t => arcLength t.2)).sum = w.length ∧
      (∀ t ∈ c, 0 < arcLength t.2) := by
  have hs := segments_ne_nil_of_marked w hMarked
  have hw : w ≠ [] := by intro hw; subst w; simp at hMarked
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · have ht := congrArg List.length
      (map_tags_closeSegments (splitTaggedBlocks w).1 (splitTaggedBlocks w).2)
    simpa only [List.length_map, length_segments_splitTaggedBlocks] using ht
  constructor
  · rw [totalArcLength_closeSegments _ _ hs, Nat.add_comm]
    exact totalArcLength_splitTaggedBlocks w
  · exact positiveArcs_closeSegments _ (leadingArc_pos_of_ne_nil w hw) _
      (positiveInternalArcs_splitTaggedBlocks w)

name: List.trace_eval_closedSegments
statement:
private theorem trace_eval_closedSegments {𝕜 n κ : Type*} [CommSemiring 𝕜]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {X Y : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hXY : Commute X Y)
    (C : κ → Matrix n n 𝕜) (w : List (TaggedBlock κ))
    (hMarked : 0 < (w.filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length) :
    (w.map (blockValue X Y C)).prod.trace =
      (((closeSegments (splitTaggedBlocks w).1 (splitTaggedBlocks w).2).map
        (segmentValue X Y C)).prod).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hs := segments_ne_nil_of_marked w hMarked
  rw [eval_splitTaggedBlocks hXY C w, Matrix.trace_mul_comm,
    eval_closeSegments hXY C _ _ hs]

name: List.length_filter_eq_sum_marks
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    obtain ⟨mode, c⟩ := b
    cases c with
    | none => simp [ih]
    | some tag =>
      simp [ih]
      omega

name: List.length_filter_ofFn_eq_markedCount
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_filter_eq_sum_marks, List.map_ofFn, Fin.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

name: List.length_profileBlocks
proof:
:= by
  simp only [profileBlocks, List.length_flatten, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def,
    profileBlock, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_singleton,
    Fin.sum_ofFn, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  omega

name: List.length_filter_flatten
statement:
private theorem length_filter_flatten {α : Type*} (f : α → Bool) (w : List (List α)) :
    (w.flatten.filter f).length = (w.map (fun t => (t.filter f).length)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t w ih =>
    change ((t ++ w.flatten).filter f).length =
      (t.filter f).length + (w.map (fun t => (t.filter f).length)).sum
    rw [List.filter_append, List.length_append, ih]

name: List.markedCount_profileBlocks
statement:
private theorem markedCount_profileBlocks {κ : Type*} {N : ℕ}
    (w : Fin N → TaggedBlock κ) (m : Fin N → ℕ) :
    ((profileBlocks w m).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length =
      markedCount w + ∑ j, m j
proof:
:= by
  have hblock (j : Fin N) :
      ((profileBlock w m j).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length =
        m j + (if (w j).2.isSome then 1 else 0) := by
    cases hc : (w j).2 <;> simp [profileBlock, hc]
  rw [profileBlocks, length_filter_flatten, List.map_ofFn, Fin.sum_ofFn]
  simp only [Function.comp_def]
  simp_rw [hblock]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [markedCount, Nat.add_comm]

name: List.eval_profileBlocks
statement:
private theorem eval_profileBlocks {B κ : Type*} [Monoid B] (X Y : B)
    {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → TaggedBlock κ) (m : Fin N → ℕ)
    (C : κ → B) (H : Fin N → B) :
    ((profileBlocks w m).map (blockValue X Y (Sum.elim C H))).prod =
      (List.ofFn (fun j => (modeValue X Y (w j).1 * H j) ^ m j *
        modeValue X Y (w j).1 * (w j).2.elim 1 C)).prod
proof:
:= by
  have hblock (j : Fin N) :
      ((profileBlock w m j).map (blockValue X Y (Sum.elim C H))).prod =
        (modeValue X Y (w j).1 * H j) ^ m j *
          modeValue X Y (w j).1 * (w j).2.elim 1 C := by
    cases hc : (w j).2 <;> simp [profileBlock, blockValue, hc, mul_assoc]
  simp only [profileBlocks, List.map_flatten, List.prod_flatten,
    List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def]
  exact congrArg (fun f : Fin N → B => (List.ofFn f).prod) (funext hblock)

name: List.cyclicProfileArcs_spec
statement:
theorem cyclicProfileArcs_spec {κ : Type*} {N : ℕ}
    (w : Fin N → Bool × Option κ) (m : Fin N → ℕ)
    (hMarked : 0 < ((List.ofFn w).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length) :
    (cyclicProfileArcs w m).length =
        ((List.ofFn w).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length + ∑ j, m j ∧
      ((cyclicProfileArcs w m).map (fun s => s.2.1 + s.2.2)).sum = N + ∑ j, m j ∧
      (∀ s ∈ cyclicProfileArcs w m, 0 < s.2.1 + s.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hMarks : 0 < markedCount w := by
    rw [← length_filter_ofFn_eq_markedCount]
    exact hMarked
  have hProfile : 0 < ((profileBlocks w m).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length := by
    rw [markedCount_profileBlocks]
    exact hMarks.trans_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨hlen, hdegree, hpos⟩ := closedSegments_spec (profileBlocks w m) hProfile
  dsimp only [cyclicProfileArcs]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hpos⟩
  · rw [hlen, markedCount_profileBlocks, ← length_filter_ofFn_eq_markedCount]
  · simpa only [arcLength, length_profileBlocks] using hdegree

name: Matrix.trace_profile_word_eq_cyclicProfileArcs
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.trace_profile_word_eq_cyclicProfileArcs
    {𝕜 n κ : Type*} [CommSemiring 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {X Y : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hXY : Commute X Y) {N : ℕ}
    (w : Fin N → Bool × Option κ) (m : Fin N → ℕ)
    (hMarked : 0 < ((List.ofFn w).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length)
    (C : κ → Matrix n n 𝕜) (H : Fin N → Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (List.ofFn (fun j => ((if (w j).1 then Y else X) * H j) ^ m j *
      (if (w j).1 then Y else X) * (w j).2.elim 1 C)).prod.trace =
      ((cyclicProfileArcs w m).map (fun s =>
        Sum.elim C H s.1 * (X ^ s.2.1 * Y ^ s.2.2))).prod.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hMarks : 0 < markedCount w := by
    rw [← length_filter_ofFn_eq_markedCount]
    exact hMarked
  have hProfile : 0 < ((profileBlocks w m).filter (fun b => b.2.isSome)).length := by
    rw [markedCount_profileBlocks]
    exact hMarks.trans_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  change (List.ofFn (fun j => (modeValue X Y (w j).1 * H j) ^ m j *
    modeValue X Y (w j).1 * (w j).2.elim 1 C)).prod.trace = _
  rw [← eval_profileBlocks X Y w m C H]
  exact trace_eval_closedSegments hXY (Sum.elim C H) (profileBlocks w m) hProfile

name: Matrix.coeff_prod_one_add_X_indicator
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : (∏ i ∈ S, if i ∈ J then (1 + X : R[X]) else 1) =
      (1 + X) ^ (S ∩ J).card := by
    rw [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.prod_const]
  rw [hp, coeff_one_add_X_pow]
  by_cases h : J ⊆ S
  · simp [h, Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr h]
  · have hlt : (S ∩ J).card < J.card := by
      apply Finset.card_lt_card
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne Finset.inter_subset_right ?_
      intro he
      exact h (Finset.inter_eq_right.mp he)
    simp [h, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hlt]

name: Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_card
statement:
theorem coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_card (M : Matrix n n R) :
    (det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).coeff (Fintype.card n) = M.det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors,
    ← Finset.card_univ (α := n), Finset.powersetCard_self, Finset.sum_singleton]
  let e : ↥(Finset.univ : Finset n) ≃ n :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      invFun := fun i => ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact det_submatrix_equiv_self e M

name: Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_diagonal_indicator
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm : 1 + diagonal (fun i => if i ∈ J then (X : R[X]) else 0) * K.map C =
      Matrix.of (J.piecewise (1 + (X : R[X]) • K.map C).row
        (1 : Matrix n n R[X]).row) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Finset.piecewise, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hm, det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det]
  have hs : (1 + (X : R[X]) • K.map C).submatrix (Subtype.val : J → n) (Subtype.val : J → n) =
      1 + (X : R[X]) • (K.submatrix (Subtype.val : J → n) (Subtype.val : J → n)).map C := by
    apply Matrix.ext
    intro i j
    change (1 : Matrix n n R[X]) (i : n) (j : n) + X * C (K i j) =
      (1 : Matrix J J R[X]) i j + X * C (K i j)
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply, Subtype.val_inj]
  rw [hs]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using
    coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_card (K.submatrix (Subtype.val : J → n) (Subtype.val : J → n))

name: Matrix.sum_det_principal_minors_superset
statement:
theorem sum_det_principal_minors_superset (L K : Matrix n n R)
    (hK : K * (1 + L) = L) (J : Finset n) :
    (∑ S : Finset n,
      if J ⊆ S then (L.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det else 0) =
      (1 + L).det * (K.submatrix (Subtype.val : J → n) (Subtype.val : J → n)).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Lp : Matrix n n R[X] := L.map C
  let Kp : Matrix n n R[X] := K.map C
  let t : n → R[X] := fun i => if i ∈ J then X else 0
  have hk : Kp * (1 + Lp) = Lp := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n R => M.map C) hK
    simpa [Lp, Kp, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.map_add, Matrix.map_one] using h
  have hdiag : diagonal (fun i => 1 + t i) = (1 : Matrix n n R[X]) + diagonal t := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j; simp
    · simp [h]
  have he : 1 + diagonal (fun i => 1 + t i) * Lp =
      (1 + diagonal t * Kp) * (1 + Lp) := by
    rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hk,
      hdiag, Matrix.add_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul]
    simp only [add_assoc]
  have hd := congrArg (fun p : R[X] => p.coeff J.card)
    (congrArg Matrix.det he)
  rw [Matrix.det_mul] at hd
  have hc : (1 + Lp).det = C (1 + L).det := by
    have hm : 1 + Lp = (1 + L).map C := by
      simp [Lp, Matrix.map_add, Matrix.map_one]
    rw [hm]
    exact (RingHom.map_det (C : R →+* R[X]) (1 + L)).symm
  rw [hc, Polynomial.coeff_mul_C, coeff_det_one_add_diagonal_indicator] at hd
  rw [det_one_add_diagonal_mul, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff] at hd
  have ht (i : n) : 1 + t i = if i ∈ J then (1 + X : R[X]) else 1 := by
    simp only [t]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hminor (S : Finset n) :
      (Lp.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det =
        C (L.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det := by
    exact (RingHom.map_det (C : R →+* R[X])
      (L.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n))).symm
  simp only [ht, hminor, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_prod_one_add_X_indicator] at hd
  simpa only [mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_one, one_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_comm] using hd

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α]
    {m n k l : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (U : Matrix m k α) (A : Matrix m n α) (V : Matrix n l α) (i : k) (j : l) :
    (Uᵀ * A * V) i j = U.col i ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ V.col j)
proof:

    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: Matrix.fromBlocks_sub
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_sub [Sub R] (A A' : Matrix m p R) (B B' : Matrix m q R)
    (C C' : Matrix n p R) (D D' : Matrix n q R) :
    fromBlocks A B C D - fromBlocks A' B' C' D' =
      fromBlocks (A - A') (B - B') (C - C') (D - D')
proof:
