name: Matrix.sum_fin_snoc
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_snoc {m : ℕ} (F : (Fin (m + 1) → n) → R) :
    (∑ v, F v) = ∑ v : Fin m → n, ∑ j : n, F (Fin.snoc v j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => n)).sum_comp F,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  rfl

name: Matrix.trace_mul_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum
statement:
theorem trace_mul_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum {m : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix n n R) (A : Fin m → Matrix n n R) :
    (B * (List.ofFn A).prod).trace =
      ∑ v : Fin (m + 1) → n,
        B (v (Fin.last m)) (v 0) *
          ∏ r : Fin m, A r (v r.castSucc) (v r.succ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction m generalizing B with
  | zero =>
    simp only [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil,
      Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one]
    exact ((Equiv.funUnique (Fin 1) n).sum_comp (fun i => B i i)).symm
  | succ m ih =>
    let A' : Fin m → Matrix n n R := fun r => A r.castSucc
    have heq : (B * (List.ofFn A).prod).trace =
        ((A (Fin.last m) * B) * (List.ofFn A').prod).trace := by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.prod_concat, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle', ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [heq, ih, sum_fin_snoc (m := m + 1)]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc,
      ← Fin.castSucc_succ, Fin.succ_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last,
      Fin.snoc_apply_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    dsimp only [A']
    ring

name: Matrix.trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum
statement:
theorem trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum {m : ℕ} (A : Fin (m + 1) → Matrix n n R) :
    (List.ofFn A).prod.trace =
      ∑ v : Fin (m + 1) → n,
        (∏ r : Fin m, A r.castSucc (v r.castSucc) (v r.succ)) *
          A (Fin.last m) (v (Fin.last m)) (v 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.prod_concat, Matrix.trace_mul_comm,
    trace_mul_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: Matrix.trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum_cyclic
statement:
theorem trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum_cyclic {m : ℕ}
    (A : Fin (m + 1) → Matrix n n R) :
    (List.ofFn A).prod.trace =
      ∑ v : Fin (m + 1) → n,
        ∏ r : Fin (m + 1), A r (v r) (v (finRotate (m + 1) r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc, finRotate_last]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro r _
  have hr : finRotate (m + 1) r.castSucc = r.succ := finRotate_of_lt r.isLt
  rw [hr]

name: Matrix.trace_list_prod_rotate
statement:
theorem trace_list_prod_rotate {R n : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (L : List (Matrix n n R)) (s : ℕ) :
    (L.rotate s).prod.trace = L.prod.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod, List.prod_append, Matrix.trace_mul_comm,
    List.prod_take_mul_prod_drop]

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_vecMul_zero_constant
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_vecMul_zero_constant {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    {v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hv : v ᵥ* A = 0) : ∀ i j, v i = v j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmax⟩ := exists_max_image univ v univ_nonempty
  have hweighted : (∑ i, (v i - v j) * A i j) = 0 := by
    simp only [sub_mul, sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sum, hsum, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact congrFun hv j
  have hnonpos : ∀ i ∈ univ, (v i - v j) * A i j ≤ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [hij]
    · exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr (hmax i hi)) (hpos i j hij).le
  have hterms := (sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos hnonpos).mp hweighted
  have heq : ∀ i, v i = v j := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · rw [hij]
    · have h := hterms i (mem_univ i)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right (hpos i j hij).ne')
  intro i k
  exact (heq i).trans (heq k).symm

name: NLAlib.det_eq_zero_of_column_sum_zero
statement:
theorem det_eq_zero_of_column_sum_zero {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0) : A.det = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : A.transpose *ᵥ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    ext j
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, transpose_apply, mul_one, hsum, Pi.zero_apply]
  have h := Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hzero
    (i := (0 : Fin (n + 1))) (by exact (nonZeroDivisors ℝ).one_mem)
  simpa only [det_transpose] using h

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_adjugate_row_constant
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_adjugate_row_constant {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) : A.adjugate i j = A.adjugate i k
proof:
:= by
  have hd := det_eq_zero_of_column_sum_zero A hsum
  have hmul := Matrix.adjugate_mul A
  rw [hd, zero_smul] at hmul
  have hv : (fun j => A.adjugate i j) ᵥ* A = 0 := by
    ext j
    exact congrFun (congrFun hmul i) j
  exact strictColumnLaplacian_vecMul_zero_constant A hpos hsum hv j k

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_signed_adjugate_diag_pos
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_signed_adjugate_diag_pos {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * A.adjugate i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  have heven : (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((i : ℕ) + i) = 1 := by
    rw [show (i : ℕ) + i = 2 * i by omega, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  rw [heven, one_mul]
  exact strictColumnLaplacian_signed_det_minor_pos A hpos hsum i

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_mulVec_signed_adjugate_diag_eq_zero
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_mulVec_signed_adjugate_diag_eq_zero {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0) :
    A *ᵥ (fun i => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * A.adjugate i i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := det_eq_zero_of_column_sum_zero A hsum
  have hmul := Matrix.mul_adjugate A
  rw [hd, zero_smul] at hmul
  ext i
  have hz : (∑ j, A i j * A.adjugate j 0) = 0 := congrFun (congrFun hmul i) 0
  change (∑ j, A i j * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ n * A.adjugate j j)) = 0
  calc
    _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * ∑ j, A i j * A.adjugate j 0 := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [strictColumnLaplacian_adjugate_row_constant A hpos hsum j j 0]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hz, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.strictColumnLaplacian_exists_pos_kernel_sum_one
statement:
theorem strictColumnLaplacian_exists_pos_kernel_sum_one {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < A i j) (hsum : ∀ j, ∑ i, A i j = 0) :
    ∃ w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧ A *ᵥ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := fun i => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * A.adjugate i i
  have hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i := strictColumnLaplacian_signed_adjugate_diag_pos A hpos hsum
  have hs : 0 < ∑ i, p i := sum_pos (fun i hi => hp i) univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨fun i => p i / ∑ j, p j, fun i => div_pos (hp i) hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← sum_div]
    exact div_self hs.ne'
  · have hk := strictColumnLaplacian_mulVec_signed_adjugate_diag_eq_zero A hpos hsum
    ext i
    change (∑ j, A i j * (p j / ∑ k, p k)) = 0
    simp only [← mul_div_assoc, ← sum_div]
    rw [show (∑ j, A i j * p j) = 0 from congrFun hk i, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.inv_apply_zero_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix,
    Ring.inverse_eq_inv', smul_eq_mul]
  simp [div_eq_inv_mul]

name: NLAlib.det_row_difference_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_row_difference_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (J : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hminor : Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin n => J i.succ j) ≠ 0)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hwsum : ∑ i, w i = 1) (hwJ : w ᵥ* J = 0) :
    Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin n => J i.succ j - J 0 j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hDv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  let u := J *ᵥ v
  have hsucc : ∀ i : Fin n, u i.succ = u 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := congrFun hDv i
    change (∑ j, (J i.succ j - J 0 j) * v j) = 0 at h
    simp only [sub_mul, sum_sub_distrib] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hu : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), u i = u 0 := by
    intro i
    exact Fin.cases rfl hsucc i
  have hwu : w ⬝ᵥ u = 0 := by
    dsimp [u]
    rw [dotProduct_mulVec, hwJ]
    simp [dotProduct]
  have hu0 : u 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp [dotProduct] at hwu
    simp_rw [hu] at hwu
    rw [← sum_mul, hwsum, one_mul] at hwu
    exact hwu
  have hJv : (fun i j : Fin n => J i.succ j) *ᵥ v = 0 := by
    ext i
    change u i.succ = 0
    rw [hsucc, hu0]
  exact hv (Matrix.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hminor hJv)

name: NLAlib.exists_continuousLinearEquiv_apply_eq_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(A.toLinearEquiv (Pi.basisFun ℝ ι) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA)).toContinuousLinearEquiv, ?_⟩
  intro x
  rfl

name: Matrix.rank_eq_of_lowerTriangular_positive_prefix
statement:
theorem rank_eq_of_lowerTriangular_positive_prefix {n r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n)
    (L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hL : L.IsLowerTriangular)
    (hpos : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < r → 0 < L i i)
    (hzero : ∀ i j : Fin n, r ≤ j.val → L i j = 0) : L.rank = r
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin r → Fin n := Fin.castLE hr
  let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ := L.submatrix id e
  let E : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ := fun j k => if k.val = j.val then 1 else 0
  have hfactor : B * E = L := by
    ext i k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    by_cases hk : k.val < r
    · let j : Fin r := ⟨k.val, hk⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp only [B, E, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, j, ite_true, mul_one]
        exact congrArg (L i) (Fin.ext rfl)
      · intro a ha haj
        have hne : k.val ≠ a.val := fun h => haj (Fin.ext h.symm)
        simp only [E, if_neg hne, mul_zero]
      · simp
    · have hz := hzero i k (by omega)
      rw [hz]
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro j hj
      have hne : k.val ≠ j.val := by have := j.isLt; omega
      simp only [E, if_neg hne, mul_zero]
  have hupper : L.rank ≤ r := by
    rw [← hfactor]
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left B E).trans (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Matrix.rank_le_card_width B)
  let M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ := L.submatrix e e
  have hMlower : M.IsLowerTriangular := fun i j hij => hL (i := e i) (j := e j) hij
  have hMdet : 0 < M.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular M hMlower]
    exact prod_pos fun j hj => hpos (e j) j.isLt
  have hMrank : M.rank = r := by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hMdet.ne'
  have hlower : r ≤ L.rank := by rw [← hMrank]; exact Matrix.rank_submatrix_le L e e
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: Matrix.isUnit_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_rank_eq_card {𝕜 n : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hA : A.rank = Fintype.card n) : IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hAv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  have hker : v ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin := by simpa using hAv
  have hp : 0 < Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨⟨v, hker⟩, by simpa using hv⟩
  have hn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker A.mulVecLin
  rw [Matrix.rank] at hA
  simp only [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hn
  omega

name: sum_range_ite_even_div_two
statement:
private theorem sum_range_ite_even_div_two {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 1), if Even k then f (k / 2) else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun k _ => k / 2)
  · intro k hk
    have hk' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).1
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk' ⊢
    omega
  · intro k hk l hl hEq
    have hkEven := Nat.even_iff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
    have hlEven := Nat.even_iff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hl).2
    omega
  · intro j hj
    refine ⟨2 * j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr ?_, Nat.even_iff.mpr ?_⟩ <;>
        have hj' := Finset.mem_range.mp hj <;> omega
    · omega
  · intro k _
    rfl

name: ite_even_catalan_succ_succ
statement:
private theorem ite_even_catalan_succ_succ {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (n : ℕ) :
    (if Even (n + 2) then (catalan ((n + 2) / 2) : R) else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (if Even k then (catalan (k / 2) : R) else 0) *
          (if Even (n - k) then (catalan ((n - k) / 2) : R) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : Even n
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := even_iff_exists_two_mul.mp hn
    have hEven : Even (2 * a + 2) := Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega)
    have hDiv : (2 * a + 2) / 2 = a + 1 := by omega
    rw [if_pos hEven, hDiv]
    calc
      (catalan (a + 1) : R) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), (catalan j : R) * (catalan (a - j) : R) := by
        simp only [catalan_succ, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul, Finset.sum_range]
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * a + 1),
          if Even k then (catalan (k / 2) : R) * (catalan (a - k / 2) : R) else 0 :=
        (sum_range_ite_even_div_two (fun j => (catalan j : R) * (catalan (a - j) : R)) a).symm
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        by_cases hkEven : Even k
        · have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          have hkMod := Nat.even_iff.mp hkEven
          have hRest : Even (2 * a - k) := Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega)
          have hRestDiv : (2 * a - k) / 2 = a - k / 2 := by omega
          simp only [if_pos hkEven, if_pos hRest, hRestDiv]
        · simp only [if_neg hkEven, zero_mul]
  · have hnMod : n % 2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (Nat.even_iff.mpr h)
    have hEven : ¬Even (n + 2) := by
      intro h
      have hMod := Nat.even_iff.mp h
      omega
    rw [if_neg hEven]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    by_cases hkEven : Even k
    · have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hkMod := Nat.even_iff.mp hkEven
      have hRest : ¬Even (n - k) := by
        intro h
        have hMod := Nat.even_iff.mp h
        omega
      simp only [if_neg hRest, mul_zero]
    · simp only [if_neg hkEven, zero_mul]

name: eq_ite_even_catalan_of_recursion
statement:
theorem eq_ite_even_catalan_of_recursion {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (f : ℕ → R) (hZero : f 0 = 1) (hOne : f 1 = 0)
    (hStep : ∀ n, f (n + 2) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f k * f (n - k)) (n : ℕ) :
    f n = if Even n then (catalan (n / 2) : R) else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [hZero]
    | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [hOne]
      | succ n =>
        calc
          f (n + 2) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f k * f (n - k) := hStep n
          _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (if Even k then (catalan (k / 2) : R) else 0) *
                (if Even (n - k) then (catalan ((n - k) / 2) : R) else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k hk
            have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
            rw [ih k (by omega), ih (n - k) (by omega)]
          _ = _ := (ite_even_catalan_succ_succ n).symm

name: Matrix.exists_balanced_le_with_no_perm_pos
statement:
theorem exists_balanced_le_with_no_perm_pos (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, C i j = s) :
    ∃ (D : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ s ∧
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ D i j) ∧ (∀ i, ∑ j, D i j = a) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, D i j = a) ∧ (∀ i j, D i j ≤ C i j) ∧
      ¬ ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, 0 < (C - D) i (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set d : ℕ := #{ij : n × n | C ij.1 ij.2 ≠ 0} with hd
  clear_value d
  induction d using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing C s with
  | ind d ih =>
    by_cases hp : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, 0 < C i (σ i)
    · obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := exists_min_image univ (fun i => C i (σ i)) univ_nonempty
      let t := C i (σ i)
      let P := σ.permMatrix ℝ
      let N := C - t • P
      have ht : 0 < t := hσ i
      have hmin (j : n) : t ≤ C j (σ j) := hi j (mem_univ j)
      have hts : t ≤ s := by
        rw [← hrow i]
        exact single_le_sum (fun j _ => hC i j) (mem_univ _)
      have hP := mem_doublyStochastic_iff_sum.mp
        (permMatrix_mem_doublyStochastic (σ := σ) (R := ℝ))
      have hN (j k : n) : 0 ≤ N j k := by
        dsimp [N, P]
        simp only [Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq]
        split_ifs with hjk
        · subst k
          simpa using sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin j)
        · simpa using hC j k
      have hNrow (j : n) : ∑ k, N j k = s - t := by
        simp only [N, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sum]
        rw [hrow j, hP.2.1 j, mul_one]
      have hdN : #{ij : n × n | N ij.1 ij.2 ≠ 0} < d := by
        rw [hd]
        apply card_lt_card
        apply ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro jk hjk
          simp only [mem_filter_univ] at hjk ⊢
          intro hzero
          have hNzero : N jk.1 jk.2 = 0 := by
            have hPzero : P jk.1 jk.2 = 0 := by
              dsimp [P]
              simp only [Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq, ite_eq_right_iff, one_ne_zero, imp_false]
              intro heq
              exact (hσ jk.1).ne' (by simpa [heq] using hzero)
            simp [N, hzero, hPzero]
          exact hjk hNzero
        · intro heq
          have hmem : (i, σ i) ∈ ({ij : n × n | C ij.1 ij.2 ≠ 0} : Finset (n × n)) := by
            simp [ht.ne', ← show t = C i (σ i) from rfl]
          have hmemN := (Finset.ext_iff.mp heq (i, σ i)).mpr hmem
          simp [N, P, t, Equiv.toPEquiv_apply] at hmemN
      obtain ⟨D, a, ha, has, hD, hDr, hDc, hDN, hno⟩ :=
        ih _ hdN N (s - t) hN (sub_nonneg.mpr hts) hNrow rfl
      refine ⟨t • P + D, t + a, add_nonneg ht.le ha, by linarith, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j k
        exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht.le (hP.1 j k)) (hD j k)
      · intro j
        simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]
        rw [hP.2.1 j, hDr j, mul_one]
      · intro k
        simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]
        rw [hP.2.2 k, hDc k, mul_one]
      · intro j k
        have h := hDN j k
        change D j k ≤ C j k - t * P j k at h
        change t * P j k + D j k ≤ C j k
        linarith
      · have hres : C - (t • P + D) = N - D := by
          ext j k
          simp only [N, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        rw [hres]
        exact hno
    · exact ⟨0, 0, le_rfl, hs, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simpa using hC,
        by simpa using hp⟩

name: Matrix.exists_smul_doublyStochastic_le_of_row_sum_one
statement:
theorem exists_smul_doublyStochastic_le_of_row_sum_one (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, C i j = 1) :
    ∃ (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : ℝ), B ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ n ∧
      0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧
      1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ j, ((∑ i, C i j) - 1) ^ 2) ≤ a ∧
      ∀ i j, a * B i j ≤ C i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, a, ha, ha1, hD, hDr, hDc, hDC, hno⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_le_with_no_perm_pos C 1 hC zero_le_one hrow
  have hresrow (i : n) : ∑ j, (C - D) i j = 1 - a := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, sum_sub_distrib, hrow i, hDr i]
  have hHall := sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_of_no_perm_pos
    (C - D) (1 - a) (fun i j => sub_nonneg.mpr (hDC i j))
    (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1) hresrow hno
  have heq (j : n) : (∑ i, (C - D) i j) - (1 - a) = (∑ i, C i j) - 1 := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, sum_sub_distrib, hDc j]
    ring
  simp_rw [heq] at hHall
  have herr : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ j, ((∑ i, C i j) - 1) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hroot := Real.sq_sqrt herr
  have hroot0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ j, ((∑ i, C i j) - 1) ^ 2)
  have hbound : 1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ j, ((∑ i, C i j) - 1) ^ 2) ≤ a := by
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hDB⟩ := (exists_mem_doublyStochastic_eq_smul_iff ha).mpr ⟨hD, hDr, hDc⟩
  refine ⟨B, a, hB, ha, ha1, hbound, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  simpa only [hDB, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hDC i j

name: Matrix.exists_smul_doublyStochastic_le_of_col_sum_one
statement:
theorem exists_smul_doublyStochastic_le_of_col_sum_one (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, C i j = 1) :
    ∃ (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : ℝ), B ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ n ∧
      0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧
      1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ i, ((∑ j, C i j) - 1) ^ 2) ≤ a ∧
      ∀ i j, a * B i j ≤ C i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, a, hB, ha, ha1, hbound, hBC⟩ :=
    exists_smul_doublyStochastic_le_of_row_sum_one Cᵀ
      (fun i j => hC j i) hcol
  exact ⟨Bᵀ, a, transpose_mem_doublyStochastic_iff.mpr hB,
    ha, ha1, hbound, fun i j => hBC j i⟩

name: Matrix.sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_of_no_perm_pos
statement:
theorem sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_of_no_perm_pos [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hrow : ∀ i, (∑ j : n, C i j) = t)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, 0 < C i (σ i)) :
    t ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
      ∑ j : n, ((∑ i : n, C i j) - t) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r : n → n → Prop := fun i j => 0 < C i j
  
  
  have hhall : ¬ (∀ S : Finset n,
      S.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ∃ i ∈ S, r i j)).card) := by
    intro hall
    have hinj : ∃ f : n → n, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ i, r i (f i) :=
      (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective r).mp hall
    rcases hinj with ⟨f, hfinj, hf⟩
    have hbij : Function.Bijective f := hfinj.bijective_of_finite
    refine hno ⟨Equiv.ofBijective f hbij, ?_⟩
    intro i
    exact hf i
  push Not at hhall
  rcases hhall with ⟨S, hS⟩
  let N : Finset n := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ∃ i ∈ S, r i j)
  have hSN : N.card < S.card := by
    simpa [N] using hS
  
  have hC_zero {i j : n} (hi : i ∈ S) (hj : j ∉ N) : C i j = 0 := by
    have hnot : ¬ ∃ i ∈ S, 0 < C i j := by
      intro h
      exact hj (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, h⟩)
    have hle : C i j ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hgt
      exact hnot ⟨i, hi, lt_of_not_ge hgt⟩
    exact le_antisymm hle (hC i j)
  
  have hrow_N (i : n) (hi : i ∈ S) : (∑ j ∈ N, C i j) = t := by
    have hsum : (∑ j ∈ N, C i j) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ, C i j :=
      Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ N) (fun j _ hjn => hC_zero hi hjn)
    simpa using hsum.trans (by simpa using hrow i)
  have hsumSN : (∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ N, C i j) = S.card * t := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ N, C i j) = ∑ i ∈ S, t := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact hrow_N i hi
      _ = S.card * t := by simp
  
  have hcol_le (j : n) : (∑ i ∈ S, C i j) ≤ ∑ i : n, C i j := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ S) ?_
    intro i _ _
    exact hC i j
  have hSle : (S.card : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, (∑ i : n, C i j) := by
    calc
      (S.card : ℝ) * t = ∑ j ∈ N, (∑ i ∈ S, C i j) := by
        rw [← hsumSN]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, (∑ i : n, C i j) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hcol_le j)
  let e : n → ℝ := fun j => (∑ i : n, C i j) - t
  have hE : t ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, e j := by
    have h1 : (S.card : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, (e j + t) := by
      calc
        (S.card : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, (∑ i : n, C i j) := hSle
        _ = ∑ j ∈ N, (e j + t) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          dsimp [e]
          ring
    have h2 : (∑ j ∈ N, (e j + t)) = (∑ j ∈ N, e j) + (N.card : ℝ) * t := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp
    have h3 : (S.card : ℝ) * t - (N.card : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, e j := by
      linarith
    let d : ℕ := S.card - N.card
    have hdpos : 0 < d := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt hSN)
    have hd1 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ d := by
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt hdpos
    have hd1r : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd1
    have hcast_sub : (S.card : ℝ) - (N.card : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact (Nat.cast_sub (m := N.card) (n := S.card) (Nat.le_of_lt hSN)).symm
    have hdt : t ≤ (d : ℝ) * t := by
      calc
        t = (1 : ℝ) * t := by ring
        _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd1r ht
    have hdE : (d : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, e j := by
      calc
        (d : ℝ) * t = ((S.card : ℝ) - (N.card : ℝ)) * t := by rw [hcast_sub]
        _ = (S.card : ℝ) * t - (N.card : ℝ) * t := by ring
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ N, e j := h3
    exact le_trans hdt hdE
  have hsq : t ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j ∈ N, e j) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht hE 2
  have hcs : (∑ j ∈ N, e j) ^ 2 ≤ (N.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ N, e j ^ 2 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq N (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) e
    simpa only [one_mul, one_pow, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using h
  have hsqN : (∑ j ∈ N, e j ^ 2) ≤ ∑ j : n, e j ^ 2 := by
    simpa using
      (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ N)
        (fun j _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  have hNle0 : (N.card : ℝ) ≤ ((Finset.univ : Finset n).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ N))
  have hNle : (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by
    simpa using hNle0
  calc
    t ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j ∈ N, e j) ^ 2 := hsq
    _ ≤ (N.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ N, e j ^ 2 := hcs
    _ ≤ (N.card : ℝ) * ∑ j : n, e j ^ 2 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqN (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ j : n, e j ^ 2 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNle (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _))
    _ = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ j : n, ((∑ i : n, C i j) - t) ^ 2 := by
      simp [e]

name: Matrix.exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_lt_one [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i, (∑ j : n, C i j) = 1)
    (herr : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
      ∑ j : n, ((∑ i : n, C i j) - 1) ^ 2 < 1) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, 0 < C i (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hno
  have hle := sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_of_no_perm_pos C 1 hC zero_le_one hrow hno
  have hle' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
      ∑ j : n, ((∑ i : n, C i j) - 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa using hle
  linarith

name: Matrix.exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_row_sub_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_row_sub_lt_one [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j)
    (hcol : ∀ j, (∑ i : n, C i j) = 1)
    (herr : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
      ∑ j : n, ((∑ i : n, C j i) - 1) ^ 2 < 1) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm n, ∀ i, 0 < C i (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_perm_pos_of_card_mul_sum_sq_column_sub_lt_one (Matrix.transpose C)
    (by intro i j; simpa using hC j i)
    (by intro i; simpa using hcol i)
    (by simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using herr)
  refine ⟨τ.symm, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hi := hτ (τ.symm i)
  simpa using hi

name: Polynomial.Chebyshev.degree_S_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_S_natCast (n : ℕ) : (S R (n : ℤ)).degree = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => norm_cast; simp
  | more n hn hn1 =>
    have hRec : S R ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        X * S R ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - S R (n : ℤ) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] using S_add_two R (n : ℤ)
    have hMain : (X * S R ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).degree = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [mul_comm, degree_mul_X, hn1]
      norm_cast
    rw [hRec, degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt]
    · exact hMain
    · rw [hn, hMain]
      norm_cast
      omega

name: Polynomial.Chebyshev.monic_S_natCast
statement: theorem monic_S_natCast (n : ℕ) : (S R (n : ℤ)).Monic
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | more n _ hn1 =>
    have hRec : S R ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        X * S R ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - S R (n : ℤ) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] using S_add_two R (n : ℤ)
    rw [hRec]
    apply (monic_X.mul hn1).sub_of_left
    rw [mul_comm, degree_mul_X, degree_S_natCast, degree_S_natCast]
    norm_cast
    omega

name: Polynomial.Chebyshev.chebyshevSsequence_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chebyshevSsequence_apply (n : ℕ) : chebyshevSsequence R n = S R (n : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: Polynomial.derivative_hermite_succ
statement:
theorem derivative_hermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    derivative (hermite (n + 1)) = (n + 1) • hermite n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hermite_one, hermite_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [hermite_succ, derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_X, one_mul,
      ih, derivative_smul]
    calc
      _ = hermite (n + 1) + (n + 1) • (X * hermite n - derivative (hermite n)) := by
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
      _ = hermite (n + 1) + (n + 1) • hermite (n + 1) := by rw [← hermite_succ]
      _ = _ := by simp only [add_nsmul, one_nsmul]; ac_rfl

name: Polynomial.X_mul_hermite_succ
statement:
theorem X_mul_hermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    X * hermite (n + 1) = hermite (n + 2) + (n + 1) • hermite n
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermite_succ (n + 1), derivative_hermite_succ]
  exact (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.starProjection_singleton_eq_inner_normalized_smul
statement:
theorem starProjection_singleton_eq_inner_normalized_smul
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (u w : E) :
    (ℝ ∙ u).starProjection w =
      (inner ℝ ((‖u‖ : ℝ)⁻¹ • u) w) • ((‖u‖ : ℝ)⁻¹ • u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.starProjection_singleton, real_inner_smul_left, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidt_map_linearIsometry
statement:
theorem gramSchmidt_map_linearIsometry
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {k : ℕ}
    (L : E →ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (f : Fin k → E) (j : Fin k) :
    gramSchmidt ℝ (fun i => L (f i)) j = L (gramSchmidt ℝ f j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (show WellFounded ((· < ·) : Fin k → Fin k → Prop) from wellFounded_lt).induction
    (C := fun j => gramSchmidt ℝ (fun i => L (f i)) j = L (gramSchmidt ℝ f j)) j ?_
  intro j ih
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq (gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ (fun i => L (f i)) j).symm,
    eq_sub_of_add_eq (gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ f j).symm, map_sub, map_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [ih i (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi), map_smul,
    L.inner_map_map, L.norm_map]

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidtNormed_map_linearIsometry
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_map_linearIsometry
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {k : ℕ}
    (L : E →ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (f : Fin k → E) (j : Fin k) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (fun i => L (f i)) j = L (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_map_linearIsometry,
    L.norm_map, map_smul]

name: NLAlib.measurable_gramSchmidt
statement:
theorem measurable_gramSchmidt
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {k : ℕ}
    (f : Ω → Fin k → E) (hf : ∀ j, Measurable (fun ω => f ω j)) (j : Fin k) :
    Measurable (fun ω => gramSchmidt ℝ (f ω) j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (show WellFounded ((· < ·) : Fin k → Fin k → Prop) from wellFounded_lt).induction
    (C := fun j => Measurable (fun ω => gramSchmidt ℝ (f ω) j)) j ?_
  intro j ih
  have heq : (fun ω => gramSchmidt ℝ (f ω) j) =
      (fun ω => f ω j - ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iio j,
        (inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ (f ω) i) (f ω j) /
          ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (f ω) i‖ ^ 2) • gramSchmidt ℝ (f ω) i) :=
    funext (fun ω => eq_sub_of_add_eq (gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ (f ω) j).symm)
  rw [heq]
  apply (hf j).sub
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro i hi
  have hg := ih i (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi)
  exact ((hg.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (hf j)).div (hg.norm.pow_const 2)).smul hg

name: NLAlib.measurable_gramSchmidtNormed
statement:
theorem measurable_gramSchmidtNormed
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {k : ℕ}
    (f : Ω → Fin k → E) (hf : ∀ j, Measurable (fun ω => f ω j)) (j : Fin k) :
    Measurable (fun ω => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (f ω) j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gramSchmidtNormed, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  have hg := measurable_gramSchmidt f hf j
  exact hg.norm.inv.smul hg

name: NLAlib.inner_gramSchmidtNormed_self_eq_norm_gramSchmidt
statement:
theorem inner_gramSchmidtNormed_self_eq_norm_gramSchmidt
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin k → E) (j : Fin k) :
    inner ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f j) (f j) = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ f j‖
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ f j) (f j) = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ f j‖ ^ 2 := by
    have heq : f j = gramSchmidt ℝ f j + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iio j,
        (inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ f i) (f j) / ‖gramSchmidt ℝ f i‖ ^ 2) •
          gramSchmidt ℝ f i := by
      exact gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ f j
    rw [heq]
    rw [inner_add_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
    have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Iio j,
        inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ f j)
          ((inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ f i) (f j) / ‖gramSchmidt ℝ f i‖ ^ 2) •
            gramSchmidt ℝ f i)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [inner_smul_right, gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ f (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi).ne', mul_zero]
    simp only [inner_sum, hsum, add_zero, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, inner_smul_left]
  simp only [conj_trivial, hinner, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  by_cases hh : ‖gramSchmidt ℝ f j‖ = 0
  · simp [hh]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.inner_gramSchmidtNormed_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem inner_gramSchmidtNormed_eq_zero_of_lt
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin k → E) {i j : Fin k} (hij : j < i) :
    inner ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i) (f j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, inner_smul_left,
    gramSchmidt_inv_triangular ℝ f hij, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.eq_sum_inner_smul_of_mem_span_orthonormal
statement:

    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [Fintype ι]
    (v : ι → E) (hv : Orthonormal ℝ v) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)) :

name: IsSelfAdjoint.inv_le_norm_resolvent_apply_of_residual_le
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.inv_le_norm_resolvent_apply_of_residual_le
    {T : E →L[ℂ] E} (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0)
    {u : E} (hu : ‖u‖=1) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0<L)
    (hres : ‖(algebraMap ℂ (E →L[ℂ] E) z-T) u‖≤L) :
    L⁻¹≤‖resolvent T z u‖
proof:
:= by
  let R := resolvent T z
  let H := algebraMap ℂ (E →L[ℂ] E) z-T
  have hunit : z∈resolventSet ℂ T := hT.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz
  have hRH : R*H=1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hunit
  have hRu : R (H u)=u := by
    calc
      _ = (R*H) u := rfl
      _ = (1 : E →L[ℂ] E) u := congrArg (fun S : E →L[ℂ] E => S u) hRH
      _ = _ := rfl
  have hnormal : IsStarNormal R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [hT.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz]
    infer_instance
  have hnorm : ‖R.adjoint u‖=‖R u‖ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.isStarNormal_iff_norm_eq_adjoint.mp hnormal u).symm
  have hinner : inner ℂ u u=inner ℂ (R.adjoint u) (H u) := by
    rw [R.adjoint_inner_left,hRu]
  have hineq : 1≤‖R u‖*L := by
    calc
      _ = ‖inner ℂ u u‖ := by rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,hu]; norm_num
      _ = ‖inner ℂ (R.adjoint u) (H u)‖ := congrArg norm hinner
      _ ≤ ‖R.adjoint u‖*‖H u‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖R.adjoint u‖*L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hres (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by rw [hnorm]
  simpa only [one_div] using (div_le_iff₀ hL).mpr hineq

name: ContinuousLinearMap.norm_le_inv_of_im_inner_coercive
statement:
theorem norm_le_inv_of_im_inner_coercive
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    (T M : E →L[ℂ] E) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hTM : ∀ x, T (M x) = -x)
    (hcoercive : ∀ x, η * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℂ x (T x)).im) :
    ‖M‖ ≤ η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply opNorm_le_bound _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hη.le)
  intro x
  have hbound : η * ‖M x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖M x‖ * ‖x‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (inner ℂ (M x) (T (M x))).im := hcoercive (M x)
      _ ≤ ‖inner ℂ (M x) (T (M x))‖ := Complex.im_le_norm _
      _ = ‖inner ℂ (M x) (-x)‖ := by rw [hTM]
      _ ≤ ‖M x‖ * ‖-x‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [norm_neg]
  by_cases hzero : ‖M x‖ = 0
  · rw [hzero]
    positivity
  have hpos : 0 < ‖M x‖ := (norm_nonneg _).lt_of_ne' hzero
  have hmul : η * ‖M x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by nlinarith
  exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hη).mpr hmul

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_comp_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_comp_sq_le (a : R → X →L[ℝ] Y) (b : R → Y →L[ℝ] Z) :
    ‖∑ r, b r ∘L a r‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖∑ r, (a r)† ∘L a r‖ * ‖∑ r, b r ∘L (b r)†‖
proof:
:= by
  let A := blockAnalysis a
  let B := blockSynthesis b
  have hcomp : B ∘L A = ∑ r, b r ∘L a r := blockSynthesis_comp_blockAnalysis_eq a b
  have hA : A† ∘L A = ∑ r, (a r)† ∘L a r := blockAnalysis_adjoint_comp_eq a
  have hB : B ∘L B† = ∑ r, b r ∘L (b r)† := blockSynthesis_comp_adjoint_eq b
  have hnorm : ‖B ∘L A‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le B A
  calc
    ‖∑ r, b r ∘L a r‖ ^ 2 = ‖B ∘L A‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hcomp]
    _ ≤ (‖B‖ * ‖A‖) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm 2
    _ = (‖A‖ * ‖A‖) * (‖B‖ * ‖B‖) := by ring
    _ = ‖A† ∘L A‖ * ‖B ∘L B†‖ := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_adjoint_comp_self]
      have hBadj := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_adjoint_comp_self (B†)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_adjoint] at hBadj
      rw [hBadj, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    _ = ‖∑ r, (a r)† ∘L a r‖ * ‖∑ r, b r ∘L (b r)†‖ := by rw [hA, hB]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_comp_sq_le_of_projections
statement:
theorem norm_sum_comp_sq_le_of_projections
    (E : X →L[ℝ] X) (F : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (G : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hEadj : E† = E) (hFadj : F† = F) (hGadj : G† = G)
    (_hEid : E ∘L E = E) (hFid : F ∘L F = F) (_hGid : G ∘L G = G)
    (a : R → X →L[ℝ] Y) (b : R → Y →L[ℝ] Z) :
    ‖G ∘L (∑ r, (b r ∘L F) ∘L a r) ∘L E‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖E ∘L (∑ r, ((a r)† ∘L F) ∘L a r) ∘L E‖ *
      ‖G ∘L (∑ r, (b r ∘L F) ∘L (b r)†) ∘L G‖
proof:
:= by
  let ap : R → X →L[ℝ] Y := fun r ↦ (F ∘L a r) ∘L E
  let bp : R → Y →L[ℝ] Z := fun r ↦ (G ∘L b r) ∘L F
  have hmain := norm_sum_comp_sq_le ap bp
  have hleft :
      ∑ r, bp r ∘L ap r = G ∘L (∑ r, (b r ∘L F) ∘L a r) ∘L E := by
    ext x
    simp only [ap, bp, sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    congr 2
    change (F ∘L F) (a r (E x)) = F (a r (E x))
    rw [hFid]
  have hrightA :
      ∑ r, (ap r)† ∘L ap r =
        E ∘L (∑ r, ((a r)† ∘L F) ∘L a r) ∘L E := by
    ext x
    simp only [ap, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_comp, hEadj, hFadj,
      sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    congr 2
    change (F ∘L F) (a r (E x)) = F (a r (E x))
    rw [hFid]
  have hrightB :
      ∑ r, bp r ∘L (bp r)† =
        G ∘L (∑ r, (b r ∘L F) ∘L (b r)†) ∘L G := by
    ext z
    simp only [bp, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_comp, hGadj, hFadj,
      sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    congr 2
    change (F ∘L F) (((b r)†) (G z)) = F (((b r)†) (G z))
    rw [hFid]
  rw [hleft, hrightA, hrightB] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidt_map_linearIsometry_rclike
statement:
theorem gramSchmidt_map_linearIsometry_rclike
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] {k : ℕ}
    (L : E →ₗᵢ[𝕜] F) (f : Fin k → E) (j : Fin k) :
    gramSchmidt 𝕜 (fun i => L (f i)) j = L (gramSchmidt 𝕜 f j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (show WellFounded ((· < ·) : Fin k → Fin k → Prop) from wellFounded_lt).induction
    (C := fun j => gramSchmidt 𝕜 (fun i => L (f i)) j = L (gramSchmidt 𝕜 f j)) j ?_
  intro j ih
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq (gramSchmidt_def'' 𝕜 (fun i => L (f i)) j).symm,
    eq_sub_of_add_eq (gramSchmidt_def'' 𝕜 f j).symm,map_sub,map_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [ih i (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi),map_smul,L.inner_map_map,L.norm_map]

statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_map_linearIsometry_rclike
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]

name: NLAlib.measurable_gramSchmidt_rclike
statement:
theorem measurable_gramSchmidt_rclike
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {k : ℕ}
    (f : Ω → Fin k → E) (hf : ∀ j, Measurable (fun ω => f ω j)) (j : Fin k) :
    Measurable (fun ω => gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (show WellFounded ((· < ·) : Fin k → Fin k → Prop) from wellFounded_lt).induction
    (C := fun j => Measurable (fun ω => gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) j)) j ?_
  intro j ih
  have heq : (fun ω => gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) j) =
      (fun ω => f ω j-∑ i ∈ Finset.Iio j,
        (inner 𝕜 (gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) i) (f ω j)/
          (‖gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) i‖ : 𝕜)^2) • gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) i) :=
    funext (fun ω => eq_sub_of_add_eq (gramSchmidt_def'' 𝕜 (f ω) j).symm)
  rw [heq]
  apply (hf j).sub
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro i hi
  have hg := ih i (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi)
  have hnorm : Measurable (fun ω => (‖gramSchmidt 𝕜 (f ω) i‖ : 𝕜)) :=
    RCLike.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hg.norm
  exact ((hg.inner (𝕜 := 𝕜) (hf j)).div (hnorm.pow_const 2)).smul hg

name: NLAlib.measurable_gramSchmidtNormed_rclike
statement:
theorem measurable_gramSchmidtNormed_rclike
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {k : ℕ}
    (f : Ω → Fin k → E) (hf : ∀ j, Measurable (fun ω => f ω j)) (j : Fin k) :

name: NLAlib.eq_sum_inner_smul_of_mem_span_orthonormal_rclike
statement:
theorem eq_sum_inner_smul_of_mem_span_orthonormal_rclike
    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [Fintype ι]
    (v : ι → E) (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range v)) :
    x = ∑ i, inner 𝕜 (v i) x • v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hx
  have hcoeff (i : ι) : inner 𝕜 (v i) x = c i := by
    rw [← hc]

name: InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_eq_of_eq_prefix
statement:
theorem gramSchmidt_eq_of_eq_prefix {f g : ℕ → E} {j : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ i ≤ j, f i = g i) : gramSchmidt 𝕜 f j = gramSchmidt 𝕜 g j
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h j ih =>
    rw [gramSchmidt_def, gramSchmidt_def, h j le_rfl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hij : i < j := Finset.mem_Iio.mp hi
    rw [ih i hij (fun k hk => h k (hk.trans hij.le))]

name: InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed_eq_of_eq_prefix
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_eq_of_eq_prefix {f g : ℕ → E} {j : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ i ≤ j, f i = g i) : gramSchmidtNormed 𝕜 f j = gramSchmidtNormed 𝕜 g j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_eq_of_eq_prefix h]

name: real_spectrum_nonempty
statement: private theorem real_spectrum_nonempty {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) : (spectrum ℝ a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases CStarAlgebra.norm_or_neg_norm_mem_spectrum ha with hp | hn
  · exact ⟨_,hp⟩
  · exact ⟨_,hn⟩

name: norm_le_norm_add_spectrum_hausdorffDist
statement:
private theorem norm_le_norm_add_spectrum_hausdorffDist
    {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b) :
    ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖ + Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ a) (spectrum ℝ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hAn := real_spectrum_nonempty ha
  have hBn := real_spectrum_nonempty hb
  have hA := spectrum.isCompact (𝕜 := ℝ) a
  have hB := spectrum.isCompact (𝕜 := ℝ) b
  have hf := Metric.hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hAn hBn hA.isBounded hB.isBounded
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hn⟩ : ∃ x ∈ spectrum ℝ a, ‖x‖ = ‖a‖ := by
    rcases CStarAlgebra.norm_or_neg_norm_mem_spectrum ha with hp | hn
    · exact ⟨_,hp,by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨_,hn,by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hy,he⟩ := hB.exists_infDist_eq_dist hBn x
  have hd := Metric.infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx hf
  rw [he] at hd
  have hyb : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖b‖ := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hy
  have ht : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x-y‖+‖y‖ := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (x-y) y
  rw [← dist_eq_norm,hn] at ht
  linarith only [ht,hyb,hd]

name: IsSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_sub_norm_le_hausdorffDist_real_spectrum
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_sub_norm_le_hausdorffDist_real_spectrum
    {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b) :
    |‖a‖-‖b‖| ≤ Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ a) (spectrum ℝ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hAB := norm_le_norm_add_spectrum_hausdorffDist ha hb
  have hBA := norm_le_norm_add_spectrum_hausdorffDist hb ha
  rw [Metric.hausdorffDist_comm] at hBA
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩

name: IsSelfAdjoint.abs_sSup_spectrum_sub_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.abs_sSup_spectrum_sub_le_hausdorffDist
    {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b) :
    |sSup (spectrum ℝ a)-sSup (spectrum ℝ b)| ≤
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ a) (spectrum ℝ b)
proof:
:=
    Metric.abs_csSup_sub_csSup_le_hausdorffDist (spectrum.isCompact a) (spectrum.isCompact b)
      (real_spectrum_nonempty ha) (real_spectrum_nonempty hb)

name: IsSelfAdjoint.abs_sInf_spectrum_sub_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.abs_sInf_spectrum_sub_le_hausdorffDist
    {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b) :
    |sInf (spectrum ℝ a)-sInf (spectrum ℝ b)| ≤
