    Metric.abs_csInf_sub_csInf_le_hausdorffDist (spectrum.isCompact a) (spectrum.isCompact b)
      (real_spectrum_nonempty ha) (real_spectrum_nonempty hb)

name: realResolventCFC
statement: private theorem realResolventCFC : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  (IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)).toContinuousFunctionalCalculus

name: IsSelfAdjoint.abs_resolvent_eq_cfc
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.abs_resolvent_eq_cfc {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    CFC.abs (resolvent a z) = cfc (fun x : ℝ => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖) a
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) (spectrum ℂ a) := by
    apply (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn.inv₀
    intro x hx hzero
    have hxreal := ha.spectrumRestricts.rightInvOn hx
    apply hz
    have hzx : z = x := sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    rw [hzx, ← hxreal]
    rfl
  rw [ha.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz]
  rw [CFC.abs_eq_cfcₙ_coe_norm ℂ _ (cfc_predicate _ _)]
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun w : ℂ => (‖w‖ : ℂ)) (cfc (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) a) :=
      cfcₙ_eq_cfc (f := fun w : ℂ => (‖w‖ : ℂ))
        (a := cfc (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) a)
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_norm |>.continuousOn) (by simp)
    _ = cfc (fun x : ℂ => (‖(z - x)⁻¹‖ : ℂ)) a :=
      (cfc_comp' (fun w : ℂ => (‖w‖ : ℂ)) (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) a
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_norm |>.continuousOn) hf ha.isStarNormal).symm
    _ = _ := cfc_complex_eq_real a (fun x hx => by simp) ha

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_cfc_resolvent_modulus
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.norm_cfc_resolvent_modulus {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖cfc (fun x : ℝ => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖) a‖ = ‖resolvent a z‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ha.abs_resolvent_eq_cfc hz, CFC.norm_abs]

name: PositiveLinearMap.gramMoment_rpow_le_norm
statement:
theorem PositiveLinearMap.gramMoment_rpow_le_norm (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hφ : φ 1 = 1) (T : A) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ((φ ((star T * T)^p)).re) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ ‖T‖
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 ≤ (star T*T)^p := CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg T) p
  have hr : 0 ≤ (φ ((star T*T)^p)).re := (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg hG)).1
  have hn := φ.norm_apply_le_of_nonneg ((star T*T)^p) hG
  rw [hφ, norm_one, one_mul] at hn
  have hb : (φ ((star T*T)^p)).re ≤ ‖T‖ ^ (2*p) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖φ ((star T*T)^p)‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
      _ ≤ ‖(star T*T)^p‖ := hn
      _ ≤ ‖star T*T‖ ^ p := norm_pow_le' _ hp
      _ = _ := by rw [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self]; ring
  have hh := Real.rpow_le_rpow hr hb (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/((2*p:ℕ):ℝ))
  calc
    _ ≤ (‖T‖ ^ (2*p)) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) := hh
    _ = ‖T‖ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg T)]
      have hpn : ((2*p : ℕ):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [mul_one_div_cancel hpn, Real.rpow_one]

name: nonreal_sub_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem nonreal_sub_ne_zero {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℂ a) : z - x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg Complex.im (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
  have hr := ha.mem_spectrum_eq_re hx
  rw [hr] at he
  exact hz (by simpa using he)

name: IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_norm_resolvent_eq
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_norm_resolvent_eq [Nontrivial A]
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    ∃ β ∈ spectrum ℝ a, ‖resolvent a z‖ = ‖z - (β : ℂ)‖⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) (spectrum ℂ a) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn.inv₀
      (fun x hx => nonreal_sub_ne_zero ha hz hx)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := (IsGreatest.norm_cfc (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) a hf ha.isStarNormal).1
  have hr := ha.mem_spectrum_eq_re hx
  refine ⟨x.re, spectrum.of_algebraMap_mem ℂ (hr ▸ hx), ?_⟩
  rw [ha.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz, ← he]
  change ‖(z - x)⁻¹‖ = ‖z - (x.re : ℂ)‖⁻¹
  rw [norm_inv, ← hr]

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_eq_inv_of_mem_spectrum_real
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_eq_inv_of_mem_spectrum_real
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {ξ η : ℝ}
    (hξ : ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ a) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ‖resolvent a ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ := (ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hz : z.im ≠ 0 := by simpa only [z, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
    mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] using hη.ne'
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa only [z, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero,
      add_zero, zero_add, abs_of_pos hη] using ha.norm_resolvent_le hz
  · have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) (spectrum ℂ a) :=
      (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn.inv₀
        (fun x hx => nonreal_sub_ne_zero ha hz hx)
    have hb := norm_apply_le_norm_cfc (fun x : ℂ => (z - x)⁻¹) a
      (spectrum.algebraMap_mem ℂ hξ) hf ha.isStarNormal
    rw [← ha.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz] at hb
    change ‖(z - (ξ : ℂ))⁻¹‖ ≤ ‖resolvent a z‖ at hb
    have he : ‖(z - (ξ : ℂ))⁻¹‖ = η⁻¹ := by
      dsimp only [z]
      rw [show (ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (ξ : ℂ) = (η : ℂ) * Complex.I by ring]
      rw [norm_inv, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hη]
    rwa [he] at hb

name: IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison
    [Nontrivial B] {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b)
    {ξ η C δ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ a) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hδ : δ ≤ (2 * η)⁻¹)
    (hcmp : ‖resolvent a ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      C * ‖resolvent b ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + δ) :
    ∃ β ∈ spectrum ℝ b, dist ξ β ≤ 2 * C * η
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ≠ 0 := by simpa using hη.ne'
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, hn⟩ := hb.exists_mem_spectrum_real_norm_resolvent_eq hz
  rw [ha.norm_resolvent_eq_inv_of_mem_spectrum_real hξ hη, hn] at hcmp
  have hdpos : 0 < ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ := by
    apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
    intro he
    exact hz (by simpa using congrArg Complex.im he)
  have hhalf : (2 * η)⁻¹ ≤ C * ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖⁻¹ := by
    have hs : η⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * η)⁻¹ := by field_simp
    linarith
  have hnormle : ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * C * η := by
    have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhalf hdpos.le
    rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hdpos.ne', mul_one] at hs
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * η)
    have he : ((2 * η)⁻¹ * ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖) * (2 * η) =
        ‖(ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ)‖ := by field_simp
    rw [he] at hm
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨β, hβ, le_trans ?_ hnormle⟩
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero,
    mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero] using
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm ((ξ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I - (β : ℂ))

name: IsSelfAdjoint.forall_exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.forall_exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
    [Nontrivial B] {a : A} {b : B} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b)
    (N : Set ℝ) {η C δ ε : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hcover : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ a, ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε)
    (hcmp : ∀ u ∈ N,
      ‖resolvent a ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)‖ ≤
        C*‖resolvent b ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)‖+δ)
    (herror : δ+(C+1)*ε/η^2 ≤ (2*η)⁻¹) :
    ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ a, ∃ β ∈ spectrum ℝ b, dist ξ β ≤ 2*C*η
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hdist⟩ := hcover ξ hξ
  have hl := ha.abs_norm_resolvent_real_sub_le ξ u hη.ne'
  have hr := hb.abs_norm_resolvent_real_sub_le u ξ hη.ne'
  rw [abs_sub_comm u ξ] at hr
  have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdist (sq_nonneg η)
  have hl' := (le_abs_self _).trans (hl.trans hd)
  have hr' := (le_abs_self _).trans (hr.trans hd)
  have hg := hcmp u hu
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr' hC
  apply ha.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_of_resolvent_comparison hb hξ hη herror
  rw [show δ+(C+1)*ε/η^2 = δ+ε/η^2+C*(ε/η^2) by ring]
  linear_combination hl' + hg + hm

name: CStarAlgebra.norm_sum_mul_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_mul_sq_le (a b : ι → A) :
    ‖∑ i, a i * b i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖∑ i, a i * star (a i)‖ * ‖∑ i, star (b i) * b i‖
proof:
:= by
  let x : WithCStarModule A (ι → A) :=
    (WithCStarModule.equiv A (ι → A)).symm (fun i => star (b i))
  let y : WithCStarModule A (ι → A) :=
    (WithCStarModule.equiv A (ι → A)).symm a
  have h := CStarModule.norm_inner_le (A := A) (WithCStarModule A (ι → A)) (x := x) (y := y)
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
  simpa only [mul_pow, WithCStarModule.pi_norm_sq, WithCStarModule.pi_inner,
    WithCStarModule.inner_def, x, y, WithCStarModule.equiv_symm_pi_apply,
    star_star, mul_comm (‖∑ i, star (b i) * b i‖)] using hsq

name: CStarAlgebra.star_mul_le_smul_one_of_norm_le
statement:
private theorem star_mul_le_smul_one_of_norm_le (a : A) {c : ℝ}
    (_hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ c) : star a * a ≤ c ^ 2 • (1 : A)
proof:
:= by
  refine (CStarAlgebra.star_mul_le_algebraMap_norm_sq (a := a)).trans ?_
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
    smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg a) ha 2)
      (show (0 : A) ≤ 1 from zero_le_one)

name: CStarAlgebra.norm_sum_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_mul_mul_le (a b c : ι → A) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hb : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖∑ i, a i * b i * c i‖ ≤
      r / 2 * (‖∑ i, a i * star (a i)‖ + ‖∑ i, star (c i) * c i‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (∑ i, star (b i * c i) * (b i * c i)) ≤
      r ^ 2 • (∑ i, star (c i) * c i) := by
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    have h := star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate
      (star_mul_le_smul_one_of_norm_le (b i) hr (hb i)) (c i)
    simpa only [star_mul, mul_assoc, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      Algebra.mul_smul_comm, one_mul] using h
  have hn : ‖∑ i, star (b i * c i) * (b i * c i)‖ ≤
      r ^ 2 * ‖∑ i, star (c i) * c i‖ := by
    have h := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => star_mul_self_nonneg (b i * c i)) hle
    simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg r)] using h
  have hcs := norm_sum_mul_sq_le a (fun i => b i * c i)
  have hcs' : ‖∑ i, a i * b i * c i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖∑ i, a i * star (a i)‖ * ‖∑ i, star (b i * c i) * (b i * c i)‖ := by
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hcs
  have hsq := hcs'.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (norm_nonneg _))
  have hpos : 0 ≤ r / 2 *
      (‖∑ i, a i * star (a i)‖ + ‖∑ i, star (c i) * c i‖) := by positivity
  have hdiff := sq_nonneg
    (‖∑ i, a i * star (a i)‖ - ‖∑ i, star (c i) * c i‖)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg r) hdiff]

name: CStarAlgebra.add_mul_star_add_le
statement:
theorem add_mul_star_add_le (a b : A) :
    (a + b) * star (a + b) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) • (a * star a) + (2 : ℝ) • (b * star b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_nonneg]
  convert mul_star_self_nonneg (a - b) using 1
  simp only [two_smul, star_add, star_sub]
  noncomm_ring

name: realTraceCFC
statement: private theorem realTraceCFC : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  (IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)).toContinuousFunctionalCalculus

name: PositiveLinearMap.re_mul_nonneg_of_tracial
proof:
:= by
  let c := CFC.sqrt b
  have hc : IsSelfAdjoint c := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg b).isSelfAdjoint
  have hcc : c * c = b := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self b hb
  have he : φ (a * b) = φ (c * a * c) := by
    calc
      _ = φ (c * (a * c)) := by rw [← hcc, ← mul_assoc, htrace]
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_assoc]
  rw [he]
  exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg (hc.conjugate_nonneg ha))).1

name: PositiveLinearMap.hasDerivAt_re_pow_affine_of_tracial
statement:
theorem PositiveLinearMap.hasDerivAt_re_pow_affine_of_tracial (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (htrace : ∀ x y : A, φ (x * y) = φ (y * x)) (a h : A) (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (φ ((a + v • h) ^ m)).re)
      ((m : ℝ) * (φ (h * (a + t • h) ^ (m - 1))).re) t
proof:
:= by
  let L : A →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toLinearMap := Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap.comp (φ.toLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ)
      cont := Complex.continuous_re.comp (map_continuous φ) }
  have haff : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => a + v • h) h t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const h).const_add a
  have hd := L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (haff.fun_pow' m)
  change HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (φ ((a + v • h) ^ m)).re)
    ((φ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      (a + t • h) ^ (m.pred - i) * h * (a + t • h) ^ i)).re) t at hd
  have he (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Finset.range m) :
      φ ((a + t • h) ^ (m.pred - i) * h * (a + t • h) ^ i) =
        φ (h * (a + t • h) ^ (m - 1)) := by
    have hsum : i + (m.pred - i) = m - 1 := by
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
      omega
    calc
      _ = φ ((h * (a + t • h) ^ i) * (a + t • h) ^ (m.pred - i)) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, htrace]
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, hsum]
  have hs : (φ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      (a + t • h) ^ (m.pred - i) * h * (a + t • h) ^ i)).re =
      (m : ℝ) * (φ (h * (a + t • h) ^ (m - 1))).re := by
    rw [map_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range m, (φ (h * (a + t • h) ^ (m - 1))).re := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact congrArg Complex.re (he i hi)
      _ = _ := by simp
  rwa [hs] at hd

name: PositiveLinearMap.re_pow_le_re_pow_of_tracial
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (φ ((a + t • (b-a)) ^ m)).re
  let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    (m : ℝ) * (φ ((b-a) * (a + t • (b-a)) ^ (m-1))).re
  have hd (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f (d t) t :=
    φ.hasDerivAt_re_pow_affine_of_tracial htrace a (b-a) m t
  have hmono : MonotoneOn f (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      ((continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun t => (hd t).continuousAt).continuousOn)
    · intro t ht
      exact (hd t).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := (Set.mem_Icc.mp (interior_subset ht)).1
      have hg : 0 ≤ a + t • (b-a) := add_nonneg ha (smul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hab))
      exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (φ.re_mul_nonneg_of_tracial htrace
        (sub_nonneg.mpr hab) (CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg hg (m-1)))
  have hh := hmono (by simp : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
    (by simp : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) zero_le_one
  simpa only [f, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul, add_sub_cancel] using hh

name: CStarMatrix.norm_le_card_mul_of_forall_norm_entry_le
statement:
theorem norm_le_card_mul_of_forall_norm_entry_le
    (M : CStarMatrix D D (H →L[ℂ] H)) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hM : ∀ i j, ‖M i j‖ ≤ r) : ‖M‖ ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_toPiLpStarAlgHom M]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hr)
  intro x
  have hrow (i : D) : ‖∑ j, M i j (x j)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) * r ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) * ∑ j, ‖M i j (x j)‖ ^ 2 := by
        simpa only [Finset.card_univ] using
          NLAlib.norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_norm_sq Finset.univ (fun j => M i j (x j))
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) * ∑ j, (r * ‖x j‖) ^ 2 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
          (((M i j).le_opNorm (x j)).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM i j) (norm_nonneg _))) 2
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [mul_pow, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
        ring
  have hsq : ‖toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := H) M x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ((Fintype.card D : ℝ) * r * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp only [toPiLpStarAlgHom_apply]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : D, (Fintype.card D : ℝ) * r ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hrow i)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  have hright : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) * r * ‖x‖ := by positivity
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := H) M x)]

name: resolvent_sub_eq_reference_sub_factorization
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_eq_reference_sub_factorization {a b d e : A} {z : R}
    (ha : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hb : z ∈ resolventSet R b)
    (hd : z ∈ resolventSet R d) (he : z ∈ resolventSet R e)
    (hab : a-b=d-e) :
    resolvent a z-resolvent b z =
      (1+resolvent a z*(a-d)) * (resolvent d z-resolvent e z) *
        (1+(b-e)*resolvent b z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent ha hb,hab]
  calc
    _ = ((1+resolvent a z*(a-d))*(resolvent d z*(d-e)))*resolvent b z := by
      rw [← resolvent_mul_eq_one_add_mul_resolvent_mul ha hd (d-e)]
    _ = (1+resolvent a z*(a-d))*
        ((resolvent d z*(d-e))*resolvent b z) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [mul_resolvent_eq_mul_resolvent_mul_one_add hb he (resolvent d z*(d-e)),
        ← spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent hd he]
      rw [mul_assoc]

name: resolvent_sub_smul_one_sub_eq
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_smul_one_sub_eq (a : A) (t z : R) :
    resolvent (a-t•(1 : A)) (z-t)=resolvent a z
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [resolvent]
  congr 1
  simp only [map_sub,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  abel

name: norm_one_compression_le
statement: private theorem norm_one_compression_le : ‖(1 : A)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh := CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self (x := (1 : A))
  simp only [star_one,one_mul] at hh
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1 : A)]

name: norm_resolvent_sub_le_of_reference_difference
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_sub_le_of_reference_difference
    {a b d e : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (hb : IsSelfAdjoint b)
    (hd : IsSelfAdjoint d) (he : IsSelfAdjoint e) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im)
    (hab : a-b=d-e) {σ K : ℝ} (hησ : z.im ≤ σ) (hK : 0<K)
    (hY₀ : ‖a-d‖ ≤ 2*σ) (hY₁ : ‖b-e‖ ≤ 2*σ)
    (hRef : ‖resolvent d z-resolvent e z‖ ≤ (K*σ)⁻¹) :
    ‖resolvent a z-resolvent b z‖ ≤ 9*σ/(K*z.im^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : 0<σ := hz.trans_le hησ
  have hRa : ‖resolvent a z‖ ≤ z.im⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [abs_of_pos hz] using ha.norm_resolvent_le hz.ne'
  have hRb : ‖resolvent b z‖ ≤ z.im⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [abs_of_pos hz] using hb.norm_resolvent_le hz.ne'
  have hratio : 1 ≤ σ/z.im := (le_div_iff₀ hz).mpr (by simpa using hησ)
  have hscalar : 1+2*σ*z.im⁻¹ ≤ 3*σ/z.im := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at hratio ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hleft : ‖1+resolvent a z*(a-d)‖ ≤ 3*σ/z.im := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(1 : A)‖+‖resolvent a z‖*‖a-d‖ :=
        (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (norm_mul_le _ _))
      _ ≤ 1+z.im⁻¹*(2*σ) := add_le_add norm_one_compression_le
        (mul_le_mul hRa hY₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [hscalar]
  have hright : ‖1+(b-e)*resolvent b z‖ ≤ 3*σ/z.im := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(1 : A)‖+‖b-e‖*‖resolvent b z‖ :=
        (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (norm_mul_le _ _))
      _ ≤ 1+(2*σ)*z.im⁻¹ := add_le_add norm_one_compression_le
        (mul_le_mul hY₁ hRb (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
      _ ≤ _ := hscalar
  rw [resolvent_sub_eq_reference_sub_factorization
    (ha.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne')
    (hb.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne')
    (hd.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne')
    (he.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne') hab]
  calc
    _ ≤ (‖1+resolvent a z*(a-d)‖ * ‖resolvent d z-resolvent e z‖) *
        ‖1+(b-e)*resolvent b z‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ ((3*σ/z.im)*(K*σ)⁻¹)*(3*σ/z.im) := by
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by field_simp [hσ.ne',hK.ne',hz.ne']; ring

name: StarAlgHom.map_sqrt
statement:
theorem map_sqrt (φ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    φ (CFC.sqrt a) = CFC.sqrt (φ a)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique _ (map_nonneg φ (CFC.sqrt_nonneg a))
  rw [← map_mul, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self a ha]

name: CStarMatrix.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (m := m) (n := n) (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply CStarMatrix.ext
    intro i j
    exact congrArg (fun T : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A => T (.inl i) (.inl j)) h
  · apply CStarMatrix.ext
    intro i j
    exact congrArg (fun T : CStarMatrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) A => T (.inr i) (.inr j)) h

name: CStarMatrix.spectrum_real_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem spectrum_real_blockDiagonal (P : CStarMatrix m m A) (Q : CStarMatrix n n A)
    (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) (hQ : IsSelfAdjoint Q) :
    spectrum ℝ (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (P, Q)) = spectrum ℝ P ∪ spectrum ℝ Q
proof:
:= by
  have hPQ : IsSelfAdjoint (P, Q) := by
    change (star P, star Q) = (P, Q)
    rw [hP.star_eq, hQ.star_eq]
  exact (hPQ.map_spectrum_real (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (m := m) (n := n) (A := A))
    (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_injective (m := m) (n := n) (A := A))).trans
    (Prod.spectrum_eq P Q)

name: IsStarNormal.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_notMem_spectrum
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℂ => z - x) (spectrum ℂ a) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn
  have hshift : cfc (fun x : ℂ => z - x) a = algebraMap ℂ A z - a := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun _ : ℂ => z) (fun x : ℂ => x) a
      continuous_const.continuousOn continuous_id.continuousOn,
      cfc_const z a ha, cfc_id' ℂ a ha]
  change Ring.inverse (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) = _
  rw [← hshift]
  apply (cfc_inv (fun x : ℂ => z - x) a _ hf ha).symm
  intro x hx hzx
  exact hz (sub_eq_zero.mp hzx ▸ hx)

name: IsStarNormal.exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_norm_sub
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    exact ⟨z, hzb, by simp⟩
  have hδ : 0 < ‖a - b‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab)
  by_contra! hfar
  have hza : z ∉ spectrum ℂ a := by
    intro hz
    have h := hfar z hz
    simp only [dist_self] at h
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (norm_nonneg _)) h
  have hR : ‖resolvent a z‖ < ‖a - b‖⁻¹ := by
    rw [ha.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_notMem_spectrum hza]
    apply norm_cfc_lt (inv_pos.mpr hδ)
    intro x hx
    rw [norm_inv]
    have hdist : ‖a - b‖ < ‖z - x‖ := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hfar x hx
    exact (inv_lt_inv₀ (hδ.trans hdist) hδ).mpr hdist
  have hsmall : ‖resolvent a z * (b - a)‖ < 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖resolvent a z‖ * ‖a - b‖ := by
        simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using norm_mul_le (resolvent a z) (b - a)
      _ < ‖a - b‖⁻¹ * ‖a - b‖ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hR hδ
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hδ.ne'
  have hunitA : IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) := spectrum.notMem_iff.mp hza
  have hunit := hunitA.mul (isUnit_one_sub_of_norm_lt_one hsmall)
  have hfactor : (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) * (1 - resolvent a z * (b - a)) =
      algebraMap ℂ A z - b := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc,
      show (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) * resolvent a z = 1 from
        Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hunitA, one_mul]
    abel
  rw [hfactor] at hunit
  exact (spectrum.mem_iff.mp hzb) hunit

name: IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_norm_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (x : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ b := spectrum.algebraMap_mem ℂ hxb
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := ha.isStarNormal.exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_norm_sub hx
  have heq : w = (w.re : ℂ) := ha.mem_spectrum_eq_re hw
  refine ⟨w.re, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hw' : (w.re : ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ a := by rw [← heq]; exact hw
    exact spectrum.of_algebraMap_mem ℂ hw'
  · rw [heq] at hd
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hd

name: CStarMatrix.normalizedFunctional_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedFunctional_apply (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (T : CStarMatrix D D A) :
    normalizedFunctional φ T=(Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹*∑ j,φ (T j j)
proof: := rfl

name: CStarMatrix.normalizedFunctional_star_mul
statement:
theorem normalizedFunctional_star_mul (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (T : CStarMatrix D D A) :
    normalizedFunctional φ (star T*T)=
      (Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹*∑ j,∑ i,φ (star (T i j)*T i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedFunctional_apply,CStarMatrix.mul_apply,CStarMatrix.star_apply,map_sum]

name: CStarMatrix.normalizedFunctional_nonneg
statement:
private theorem normalizedFunctional_nonneg (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) {T : CStarMatrix D D A}
    (hT : 0≤T) : 0≤normalizedFunctional φ.toLinearMap T
proof:
:= by
  let P : AddSubmonoid (CStarMatrix D D A) :=
    { carrier := {T | 0≤normalizedFunctional φ.toLinearMap T}
      zero_mem' := by simp
      add_mem' := by intro T U hT hU; simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,map_add] using add_nonneg hT hU }
  have hle : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun R : CStarMatrix D D A => star R*R)≤P := by
    apply AddSubmonoid.closure_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨R,rfl⟩
    change 0≤normalizedFunctional φ.toLinearMap (star R*R)
    rw [normalizedFunctional_star_mul]
    apply mul_nonneg
    · have hh : 0≤(Fintype.card D : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_inv,Complex.ofReal_natCast] using Complex.zero_le_real.mpr hh
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        φ.map_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg (R i j))
  exact hle (StarOrderedRing.nonneg_iff.mp hT)

name: CStarMatrix.normalizedPositiveFunctional_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedPositiveFunctional_apply (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (T : CStarMatrix D D A) :
    normalizedPositiveFunctional φ T=normalizedFunctional φ.toLinearMap T
proof: := rfl

name: CStarMatrix.normalizedPositiveFunctional_one
statement:
theorem normalizedPositiveFunctional_one [Nonempty D] (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1) :
    normalizedPositiveFunctional (D := D) φ 1=1
proof:
:= by
  change (Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹*(∑ j : D, φ ((1 : CStarMatrix D D A) j j))=1
  simp only [CStarMatrix.one_apply_eq,hφ,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (show (Fintype.card D : ℂ)≠0 from Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero)

name: CStarMatrix.eq_zero_of_normalizedPositiveFunctional_star_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_normalizedPositiveFunctional_star_mul_eq_zero
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hfaithful : ∀ a : A, φ (star a*a)=0 → a=0)
    (T : CStarMatrix D D A) (hzero : normalizedPositiveFunctional φ (star T*T)=0) : T=0
proof:
:= by
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  have : Nonempty D := ⟨j⟩
  have hcard : (Fintype.card D : ℂ)≠0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hz : ∑ j,∑ i,φ (star (T i j)*T i j)=0 := by
    rw [normalizedPositiveFunctional_apply,normalizedFunctional_star_mul] at hzero
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero hcard)
  have hr : ∑ j,∑ i,(φ (star (T i j)*T i j)).re=0 := by
    have hh := congrArg Complex.re hz
    change (Complex.reCLM (∑ j,∑ i,φ (star (T i j)*T i j)))=0 at hh
    simpa only [map_sum,Complex.reCLM_apply] using hh
  have hnonneg (i j : D) : 0≤(φ (star (T i j)*T i j)).re :=
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg (T i j)))).1
  have hc := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hnonneg i j)).mp hr j (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have he := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hnonneg i j)).mp hc i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  apply hfaithful
  exact Complex.ext he (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp
    (φ.map_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg (T i j)))).2.symm

name: realClampCFC
statement: private theorem realClampCFC : IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)

name: isSelfAdjoint_cfcSymmetricClamp
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_cfcSymmetricClamp (L : ℝ) (a : A) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (cfcSymmetricClamp L a)
proof: := IsSelfAdjoint.cfc

name: norm_cfcSymmetricClamp_le
statement:
theorem norm_cfcSymmetricClamp_le (L : ℝ) (hL : 0≤L) (a : A) :
    ‖cfcSymmetricClamp L a‖ ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_cfc_le hL
  intro x hx
  have hp := (Set.projIcc (-L) L (by linarith : -L≤L) x).property
  exact (Real.norm_eq_abs _).trans_le (abs_le.mpr hp)

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_sub_cfcSymmetricClamp_le
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_sub_cfcSymmetricClamp_le {a : A}
    (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {z : ℂ} (hre : z.re=0) (hz : 0<z.im)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) :
    ‖resolvent a z-resolvent (cfcSymmetricClamp L a) z‖ ≤ L⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ((max (-L) (min L w.re) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let f : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (z-w)⁻¹
  have hg : Continuous g := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
    (continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min Complex.continuous_re))
  have hne (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ spectrum ℂ a) : z-w≠0 := by
    intro hh
    have hreal := ha.spectrumRestricts.rightInvOn hw
    apply hz.ne'
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hh,← hreal]
    rfl
  have hf : ContinuousOn f (spectrum ℂ a) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn.inv₀ hne
  have hneG (w : ℂ) : z-g w≠0 := by
    intro hh
    apply hz.ne'
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hh]
    rfl
  have hfg : ContinuousOn f (g '' spectrum ℂ a) := by
    apply (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn.inv₀
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩
    exact hneG v
  have hc : cfcSymmetricClamp L a = cfc g a :=
    cfc_real_eq_complex (fun x : ℝ => max (-L) (min L x)) ha
  have hr : resolvent (cfcSymmetricClamp L a) z =
      cfc (fun w : ℂ => f (g w)) a := by
    calc
      _ = cfc f (cfcSymmetricClamp L a) :=
        (isSelfAdjoint_cfcSymmetricClamp L a).resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne'
      _ = cfc f (cfc g a) := congrArg (cfc f) hc
      _ = _ := (cfc_comp' f g a hfg hg.continuousOn ha.isStarNormal).symm
  rw [ha.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne',hr]
  change ‖cfc f a-cfc (fun w : ℂ => f (g w)) a‖ ≤ L⁻¹
  rw [← cfc_sub f (fun w : ℂ => f (g w)) a hf
    (hfg.comp hg.continuousOn (fun _ hx => Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx))]
  apply norm_cfc_le (inv_nonneg.mpr hL.le)
  intro w hw
  have hreal := ha.spectrumRestricts.rightInvOn hw
  rw [← hreal]
  change ‖(z-(w.re : ℂ))⁻¹-
    (z-((max (-L) (min L w.re) : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹‖≤L⁻¹
  exact Complex.norm_inv_sub_real_sub_inv_sub_clamp_le hre hz hL w.re

name: CFC.tendsto_smul_abs_sub_one_of_tendsto_smul_sub_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_smul_abs_sub_one_of_tendsto_smul_sub_one
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a : ι → A} {t : ι → ℝ} {S : A}
    (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 1))
    (hs : Tendsto (fun i => t i • (a i - 1)) l (𝓝 S))
    (hS : IsSelfAdjoint S) :
    Tendsto (fun i => t i • (abs (a i) - 1)) l (𝓝 S)
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : Tendsto (fun i => t i • (star (a i) - 1)) l (𝓝 S) := by
    have h := hs.star
    simpa only [star_smul, star_trivial, star_sub, star_one, hS.star_eq] using h
  have hgram : Tendsto (fun i => t i • (star (a i) * a i - 1)) l (𝓝 (S + S)) := by
    have h := (hstar.mul ha).add hs
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    apply h.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun i => ?_)
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_add]
    congr 1
    noncomm_ring
  have hq : Tendsto (fun i => abs (a i) + 1) l (𝓝 ((1 : A) + 1)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, abs_one] using
      ((CFC.continuous_abs.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ha).add_const 1)
  have hunit : IsUnit ((1 : A) + 1) := by
    have he : (algebraMap ℝ A) 2 = (1 : A) + 1 := by
      calc
        _ = (algebraMap ℝ A) ((1 : ℝ) + 1) := by norm_num
        _ = _ := by rw [map_add, map_one]
    rw [← he]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).map (algebraMap ℝ A)
  have hinvc : ContinuousAt (Ring.inverse : A → A) ((1 : A) + 1) := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hunit
    rw [← hu]
    exact NormedRing.inverse_continuousAt u
  have hinv := hinvc.tendsto.comp hq
  have hqunit : ∀ᶠ i in l, IsUnit (abs (a i) + 1) :=
    hq.eventually (Units.isOpen.mem_nhds hunit)
  have hprod := hgram.mul hinv
  have hcenter : (S + S) * Ring.inverse ((1 : A) + 1) = S := by
    calc
      _ = (S * ((1 : A) + 1)) * Ring.inverse ((1 : A) + 1) := by rw [mul_add, mul_one]
      _ = S := by rw [mul_assoc, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hunit, mul_one]
  rw [hcenter] at hprod
  apply hprod.congr'
  filter_upwards [hqunit] with i hi
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
  have hfactor : (abs (a i) - 1) * (abs (a i) + 1) = star (a i) * a i - 1 := by
    calc
      _ = abs (a i) * abs (a i) - 1 := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [abs_mul_abs]
  rw [← hfactor, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hi, mul_one]

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_sub_le_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_sub_le_of_im_ne_zero
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (hw : w.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖resolvent a z-resolvent a w‖ ≤ ‖z-w‖*(|z.im|⁻¹*|w.im|⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent_eq_sub_smul_mul a
    (ha.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz)
    (ha.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hw), norm_smul, norm_sub_rev w z]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
  exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul (ha.norm_resolvent_le hz) (ha.norm_resolvent_le hw)
      (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))

name: IsSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_resolvent_real_sub_le
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_resolvent_real_sub_le
    {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) (x y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ≠ 0) :
    |‖resolvent a ((x : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)‖-
      ‖resolvent a ((y : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)‖| ≤ |x-y|/η^2
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ((x : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I).im ≠ 0 := by simpa using hη
  have hw : ((y : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I).im ≠ 0 := by simpa using hη
  have hs := (abs_norm_sub_norm_le _ _).trans (ha.norm_resolvent_sub_le_of_im_ne_zero hz hw)
  have he : ((x : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)-((y : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I) =
      ((x-y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  simp only [he, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im,
    Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] at hs
  calc
    _ ≤ |x-y| * (|η|⁻¹*|η|⁻¹) := hs
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_two, inv_pow, sq_abs, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: realGramCFC
statement: private theorem realGramCFC : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  (IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)).toContinuousFunctionalCalculus

name: star_mul_self_add_le_weighted
statement:
theorem star_mul_self_add_le_weighted (T E : A) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    star (T + E) * (T + E) ≤
      (1 + ε) • (star T * T) + (1 + ε⁻¹) • (star E * E)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ ε⁻¹ • (star (ε • T - E) * (ε • T - E)) :=
    smul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hε.le) (star_mul_self_nonneg _)
  have hc : ε⁻¹ * (ε * ε) = ε := by field_simp [hε.ne']
  have he : ε⁻¹ • (star (ε • T - E) * (ε • T - E)) =
      ((1 + ε) • (star T * T) + (1 + ε⁻¹) • (star E * E)) -
        star (T + E) * (T + E) := by
    simp only [star_sub, star_smul, star_trivial, star_add, sub_mul, mul_sub,
      add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub,
      smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hε.ne', hc, one_smul]
    module
  exact sub_nonneg.mp (he ▸ hp)

name: star_mul_self_le_norm_sq
statement:
theorem star_mul_self_le_norm_sq (E : A) :
    star E * E ≤ algebraMap ℝ A (‖E‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (IsSelfAdjoint.star_mul_self E).le_algebraMap_norm_self
  simpa only [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self, pow_two] using h

name: star_mul_self_le_weighted_gram_add_norm
statement:
theorem star_mul_self_le_weighted_gram_add_norm (S T : A) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    star S * S ≤ (1 + ε) • (star T * T) +
      algebraMap ℝ A ((1 + ε⁻¹) * ‖S - T‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := star_mul_self_add_le_weighted T (S-T) hε
  have h₂ : (1+ε) • (star T*T) + (1+ε⁻¹) • (star (S-T)*(S-T)) ≤
      (1+ε) • (star T*T) + algebraMap ℝ A ((1+ε⁻¹)*‖S-T‖^2) := by
    apply add_le_add le_rfl
    have h := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (star_mul_self_le_norm_sq (S-T))
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+ε⁻¹)
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, ← map_mul] using h
  have he : T+(S-T)=S := by abel
  simpa only [he] using h₁.trans h₂

name: CStarAlgebra.isCompact_Icc

  intro x hx

name: im_eq_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum
statement:
private theorem im_eq_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum {a : A}
    (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℂ a) : x.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hxreal : (x.re : ℂ) = x := ha.spectrumRestricts.rightInvOn hx

  rfl

name: sub_ne_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  apply hz
  rw [sub_eq_zero.mp heq]
  exact im_eq_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum ha hx

name: IsSelfAdjoint.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℂ => z - x) (spectrum ℂ a) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn
  have hunit : IsUnit (cfc (fun x : ℂ => z - x) a) :=
    (isUnit_cfc_iff _ _ hf ha.isStarNormal).mpr
      (fun _ hx => sub_ne_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum ha hz hx)
  simpa only [cfc_sub (fun _ : ℂ => z) (fun x : ℂ => x) a
    continuous_const.continuousOn continuous_id.continuousOn,
    cfc_const z a ha.isStarNormal, cfc_id' ℂ a ha.isStarNormal]
    using hunit

name: IsSelfAdjoint.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℂ => z - x) (spectrum ℂ a) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn
  have hshift : cfc (fun x : ℂ => z - x) a = algebraMap ℂ A z - a := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun _ : ℂ => z) (fun x : ℂ => x) a
      continuous_const.continuousOn continuous_id.continuousOn,
      cfc_const z a ha.isStarNormal, cfc_id' ℂ a ha.isStarNormal]
  change Ring.inverse (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) = _
  rw [← hshift]
  exact (cfc_inv (fun x : ℂ => z - x) a
    (fun _ hx => sub_ne_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum ha hz hx) hf ha.isStarNormal).symm

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_le
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.norm_resolvent_le {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) : ‖resolvent a z‖ ≤ |z.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [ha.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz]
  apply norm_cfc_le (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _))
  intro x hx
  rw [norm_inv]
  have hheight : |z.im| ≤ ‖z - x‖ := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_im, im_eq_zero_of_mem_selfAdjoint_spectrum ha hx,
      sub_zero] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - x)
  simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (abs_pos.mpr hz) hheight

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_pow_of_pos
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.norm_pow_of_pos {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) : ‖a ^ n‖ = ‖a‖ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : a = 0
  · subst a
    simp [zero_pow hn.ne']
  have hpos : 0 < ‖a‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hzero
  have hN : n < 2 ^ n := n.lt_two_pow_self
  have hdiff : 0 < 2 ^ n - n := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hN
  have hpow : ‖a‖ ^ (2 ^ n) = ‖a‖ ^ n * ‖a‖ ^ (2 ^ n - n) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hN.le]
  have hle : ‖a‖ ^ (2 ^ n) ≤ ‖a ^ n‖ * ‖a‖ ^ (2 ^ n - n) := by
    calc
      _ = ‖a ^ (2 ^ n)‖ := (ha.norm_pow_two_pow n).symm
      _ = ‖a ^ n * a ^ (2 ^ n - n)‖ := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hN.le]
      _ ≤ ‖a ^ n‖ * ‖a ^ (2 ^ n - n)‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_pow_le' a hdiff) (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [hpow] at hle
  exact le_antisymm (norm_pow_le' a hn)
    (le_of_mul_le_mul_right hle (pow_pos hpos _))

name: CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_affineCombination
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_affineCombination
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (C : ι → Matrix D D ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ i, (C i).IsHermitian) (X : ι → A) (hX : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (X i)) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (affineCombination ℂ A₀ C X)
proof:
:= by
  change star (affineCombination ℂ A₀ C X)=affineCombination ℂ A₀ C X
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change star (algebraMap ℂ A (A₀ j i)+∑ k, C k j i•X k)=
    algebraMap ℂ A (A₀ i j)+∑ k, C k i j•X k
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,star_add,star_sum,star_smul,star_one,hA₀.apply]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [(hC k).apply,(hX k).star_eq]

name: Complex.measurable_cayleyBoundaryReal
statement: theorem measurable_cayleyBoundaryReal : Measurable cayleyBoundaryReal
proof:
:= by
  unfold cayleyBoundaryReal inverseCayleyTransform
  fun_prop

name: Complex.cayleyTransform_inverseCayleyTransform
statement:
theorem cayleyTransform_inverseCayleyTransform {w : ℂ} (hw : 1 - w ≠ 0) :
    cayleyTransform (inverseCayleyTransform w) = w
proof:
:= by
  have hden : inverseCayleyTransform w + I ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hd : inverseCayleyTransform w = -I := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left he
    rw [inverseCayleyTransform, div_eq_iff hw] at hd
    have hi : 2 * I = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = I * (1 + w) + I * (1 - w) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hd]; ring
    norm_num at hi
  unfold cayleyTransform
  apply (div_eq_iff hden).mpr
  unfold inverseCayleyTransform
  field_simp [hw]
  ring_nf

name: Complex.ofReal_sub_ne_zero_of_im_pos
statement:
theorem ofReal_sub_ne_zero_of_im_pos (x : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    (x : ℂ) - z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im he
  simp only [sub_im, ofReal_im, zero_im, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at hi
  exact (ne_of_gt hz) hi

name: Complex.I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayleyTransform
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) {ξ : Circle} (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) :
    I * herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform z) ξ =
      ((1 + (cayleyBoundaryReal ξ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((cayleyBoundaryReal ξ : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ - (cayleyBoundaryReal ξ : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : 1 - (ξ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    apply hξ
    exact Circle.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp he).symm
  have hzi := add_I_ne_zero_of_im_pos hz
  have hξz : (ξ : ℂ) - cayleyTransform z ≠ 0 :=
    circle_coe_sub_ne_zero (by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using
      norm_cayleyTransform_lt_one hz) ξ
  have hxz := ofReal_sub_ne_zero_of_im_pos (cayleyBoundaryReal ξ) hz
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
  apply (eq_div_iff hxz).mpr
  simp only [ofReal_add, ofReal_one, ofReal_pow, ofReal_cayleyBoundaryReal]
  rw [herglotzRieszKernel_def]
  simp only [sub_zero]
  field_simp [hξz]
  unfold inverseCayleyTransform cayleyTransform
  field_simp [hw, hzi]
  ring_nf
  simp only [I_sq, I_pow_three]
  ring

name: Complex.one_add_sq_cayleyBoundaryReal
statement:
theorem one_add_sq_cayleyBoundaryReal {ξ : Circle} (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) :
    1 + (cayleyBoundaryReal ξ) ^ 2 = 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Circle.normSq_coe ξ
  rw [normSq_apply] at hs
  have hd : 1 - (ξ : ℂ).re ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (circle_re_lt_one_of_ne_one hξ))
  have hn : normSq (1 - (ξ : ℂ)) = 2 * (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) := by
    simp only [normSq_apply, sub_re, sub_im, one_re, one_im]
    nlinarith
  have hp : normSq (1 + (ξ : ℂ)) = 2 * (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re) := by
    simp only [normSq_apply, add_re, add_im, one_re, one_im]
    nlinarith
  have he : (cayleyBoundaryReal ξ) ^ 2 =
      (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re) / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) := by
    calc
      _ = normSq (inverseCayleyTransform (ξ : ℂ)) := by
        rw [← ofReal_cayleyBoundaryReal, normSq_ofReal]
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [inverseCayleyTransform, normSq_div, normSq_mul, normSq_I,
          one_mul, hn, hp]
        field_simp [hd]
  rw [he]
  field_simp [hd]
  ring

name: Complex.curveIntegral_cubicalPath_univ_lift
statement:
private theorem curveIntegral_cubicalPath_univ_lift {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b)
    (ω : ℂ → ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    curveIntegral ω (cubicalPath
      ((⟨fun z => ⟨z, Set.mem_univ z⟩, continuous_id.subtype_mk _⟩ :
        C(ℂ, (Set.univ : Set ℂ))).comp γ.toContinuousMap)) = curveIntegral ω γ
proof:
:= by
  have he : cubicalPath
      ((⟨fun z => ⟨z, Set.mem_univ z⟩, continuous_id.subtype_mk _⟩ :
        C(ℂ, (Set.univ : Set ℂ))).comp γ.toContinuousMap) =
      γ.cast (by simp) (by simp) := by ext t; rfl
  rw [he, curveIntegral_cast]

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_rectangularGrid_eq_cellCoefficients
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_rectangularGrid_eq_cellCoefficients
    {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ)
    (hc : RectangularChain.IsCycle h w) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral
      (Cubical.mapOne (⟨fun z => ⟨z, Set.mem_univ z⟩,
          continuous_id.subtype_mk _⟩ : C(ℂ, (Set.univ : Set ℂ)))
        (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain (Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex x y) h w))
      (Cubical.RectangularGrid.center x y i j) =
        ((RectangularChain.cellCoefficients h i j : ℤ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let v := Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex x y
  let τ := Cubical.RectangularGrid.center x y i j
  let p : ℂ := 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I
  let L : Cubical.OneChain ℂ →ₗ[ℤ] ℂ :=
    (cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹)).comp
      (Cubical.mapOne (⟨fun z => ⟨z, Set.mem_univ z⟩,
        continuous_id.subtype_mk _⟩ : C(ℂ, (Set.univ : Set ℂ))))
  have hcell (k : Fin m) (l : Fin n) :
      L (Cubical.squareBoundary (Cubical.Grid.cell v k l)) =
        if k = i ∧ l = j then p else 0 := by
    simp only [Cubical.squareBoundary, map_add, map_sub, Cubical.Grid.right_cell,
      Cubical.Grid.left_cell, Cubical.Grid.top_cell, Cubical.Grid.bottom_cell]
    simp only [L, LinearMap.comp_apply, Cubical.mapOne_single, cubicalCurveIntegral,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    simp only [Cubical.Grid.horizontal, Cubical.Grid.vertical,
      curveIntegral_cubicalPath_univ_lift]
    change
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
          (Path.segment (v k.succ l.castSucc) (v k.succ l.succ)) -
        curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
          (Path.segment (v k.castSucc l.castSucc) (v k.castSucc l.succ)) -
        curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
          (Path.segment (v k.castSucc l.succ) (v k.succ l.succ)) +
        curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
          (Path.segment (v k.castSucc l.castSucc) (v k.succ l.castSucc)) = _
    by_cases he : k = i ∧ l = j
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := he
      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩]
      obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc', hd⟩ :=
        Cubical.RectangularGrid.center_mem_open_rectangle x y hx hy k l
      have hp := curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_two_pi_I ha hb hc' hd
      change _ = p
      dsimp only [v, Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex, p, τ]
      linear_combination hp
    · rw [if_neg he]
      have hout := Cubical.RectangularGrid.center_strictly_outside_other_rectangle
        x y hx hy i k j l (by intro hkl; exact he (Prod.mk.inj hkl.symm))
      have hz := curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_zero_of_outside
        (hx.monotone k.castSucc_lt_succ.le) (hy.monotone l.castSucc_lt_succ.le) hout
      dsimp only [v, Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertex]
      linear_combination hz
  have he : L (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w) =
      ((RectangularChain.cellCoefficients h i j : ℤ) : ℂ) * p := by
    rw [← Cubical.Grid.boundaryTwo_cellChain_eq_edgeChain v h w hc]
    simp only [Cubical.Grid.cellChain, map_sum, map_smul, Cubical.boundaryTwo,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    simp only [hcell, smul_ite, smul_zero]
    simp [zsmul_eq_mul, ite_and]
  change p⁻¹ * L (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w) = _
  rw [he]
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [p]
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)) I_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: Complex.contDiffOn_cubicalPath_grid_edgeChain
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_cubicalPath_grid_edgeChain
    {m n : ℕ} (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ) :
    ∀ γ ∈ (Cubical.mapOne fullPlaneLift (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w)).support,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I
proof:
:= by
  apply Cubical.mapOne_mem_supported
  have hs := Cubical.Grid.edgeChain_mem_supported v h w
    {γ : C(I, ℂ) | ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath (fullPlaneLift.comp γ)).extend I}
    (by
      intro i j _
      change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Path.segment (v i.castSucc j) (v i.succ j)).extend I
      exact Path.contDiffOn_extend_segment _ _ _)
    (by
      intro i j _
      change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Path.segment (v i j.castSucc) (v i j.succ)).extend I
      exact Path.contDiffOn_extend_segment _ _ _)
  exact hs

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_grid_of_isNullHomologous_comparison
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_grid_of_isNullHomologous_comparison
    {C Θ : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain C)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {m n : ℕ} (v : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)
    (h : Fin m → Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → ℤ)
    (Δ : Cubical.OneChain Θ) (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Δ)
    (he : Cubical.mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Θ, ℂ)) Δ =
      Cubical.mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ -
        Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w)
    (hΘ : IsOpen Θ) {τ : ℂ} (hτ : τ ∉ Θ) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral Γ τ =
      cubicalWindingIntegral (Cubical.mapOne fullPlaneLift (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w)) τ
proof:
:= by
  let jC : C(C, (univ : Set ℂ)) := ContinuousMap.inclusion (subset_univ C)
  let jΘ : C(Θ, (univ : Set ℂ)) := ContinuousMap.inclusion (subset_univ Θ)
  have hjC : fullPlaneLift.comp (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) = jC := by
    ext z
    rfl
  have hjΘ : fullPlaneLift.comp (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Θ, ℂ)) = jΘ := by
    ext z
    rfl
  have he' : Cubical.mapOne jΘ Δ = Cubical.mapOne jC Γ -
      Cubical.mapOne fullPlaneLift (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w) := by
    have hp := congrArg (Cubical.mapOne fullPlaneLift) he
    simpa only [map_sub, Cubical.mapOne_mapOne, hjC, hjΘ] using hp
  let P : Submodule ℤ (Cubical.OneChain (univ : Set ℂ)) :=
    Finsupp.supported ℤ ℤ {γ | ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I}
  have hC : Cubical.mapOne jC Γ ∈ P :=
    Cubical.mapOne_mem_supported jC Γ _ (by intro γ hγ; exact hΓ γ hγ)
  have hgrid : Cubical.mapOne fullPlaneLift (Cubical.Grid.edgeChain v h w) ∈ P :=
    contDiffOn_cubicalPath_grid_edgeChain v h w
  have hΔ : ∀ γ ∈ Δ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I := by
    have hs : Cubical.mapOne jΘ Δ ∈ P := he' ▸ P.sub_mem hC hgrid
    intro γ hγ
    exact hs ((Cubical.mem_support_mapOne_comp_iff jΘ
      (fun _ _ hab => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : (univ : Set ℂ) => (z : ℂ)) hab)) Δ γ).mpr hγ)
  have hz := cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_isNullHomologous hΘ
    (g := fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹) (by
      intro z hz
      exact ((differentiableAt_id.sub_const τ).inv
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr (by intro heq; exact hτ (heq ▸ hz)))).differentiableWithinAt)
    Δ hΔ hnull
  have hi := congrArg (cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹)) he'
  simp only [map_sub, jC, jΘ, cubicalCurveIntegral_mapOne_inclusion, hz] at hi
  exact congrArg ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ·) (sub_eq_zero.mp hi.symm)

name: Complex.sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_path
statement:
theorem sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_path {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b)
    {U V : Set ℂ} {G H g : ℂ → ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hG : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt G (g z) z)
    (hH : ∀ z ∈ V, HasDerivAt H (g z) z)
    (hγU : ∀ t, γ t ∈ U) (hγV : ∀ t, γ t ∈ V) :
    G b - G a = H b - H a
proof:
:= by
  have hd (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ U ∩ V) : HasDerivAt (fun z => G z - H z) 0 z := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using (hG z hz.1).fun_sub (hH z hz.2)
  have hlocal : IsLocallyConstant (fun t : unitInterval => G (γ t) - H (γ t)) := by
    apply IsLocallyConstant.iff_isOpen_fiber.mpr
    intro w
    have ho := (hU.inter hV).isOpen_inter_preimage_of_deriv_eq_zero
      (fun z hz => (hd z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun z hz => (hd z hz).deriv) {w}
    have heq : (fun t : unitInterval => G (γ t) - H (γ t)) ⁻¹' {w} =
        γ ⁻¹' ((U ∩ V) ∩ (fun z => G z - H z) ⁻¹' {w}) := by
      ext t
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff]
      simp only [hγU t, hγV t, true_and]
    rw [heq]
    exact γ.continuous.isOpen_preimage _ ho
  have h := hlocal.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace 1 0
  simp only [γ.target, γ.source] at h
  linear_combination h

name: Complex.sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_continuous
statement:
theorem sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_continuous
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : Continuous γ) {u v : ℝ} (huv : u ≤ v)
    {U V : Set ℂ} {G H g : ℂ → ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hG : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt G (g z) z)
    (hH : ∀ z ∈ V, HasDerivAt H (g z) z)
    (hγU : ∀ t ∈ Icc u v, γ t ∈ U) (hγV : ∀ t ∈ Icc u v, γ t ∈ V) :
    G (γ v) - G (γ u) = H (γ v) - H (γ u)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_path ((Path.segment u v).map hγ) hU hV hG hH
  · intro t
    apply hγU
    exact (convex_Icc u v).lineMap_mem ⟨le_rfl, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_rfl⟩ t.property
  · intro t
    apply hγV
    exact (convex_Icc u v).lineMap_mem ⟨le_rfl, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_rfl⟩ t.property

name: Complex.primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_of_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_of_hasDerivAt
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : Continuous γ) {p : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    {G H : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {U V : ℕ → Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hp : ∀ i < n, p i ≤ p (i + 1))
    (hU : ∀ i < n, IsOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ i < n, IsOpen (V i))
    (hG : ∀ i < n, ∀ z ∈ U i, HasDerivAt (G i) (g z) z)
    (hH : ∀ i < n, ∀ z ∈ V i, HasDerivAt (H i) (g z) z)
    (hγU : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc (p i) (p (i + 1)), γ t ∈ U i)
    (hγV : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc (p i) (p (i + 1)), γ t ∈ V i) :
    primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ p G n = primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ p H n
proof:
:= by
  unfold primitiveSubdivisionTransport
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hin : i < n := mem_range.mp hi
  exact sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_continuous hγ (hp i hin)
    (hU i hin) (hV i hin) (hG i hin) (hH i hin) (hγU i hin) (hγV i hin)

name: Complex.primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : Continuous γ) {p : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    {G : ℂ → ℂ} {H : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {V : ℕ → Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hp : ∀ i < n, p i ≤ p (i + 1)) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hV : ∀ i < n, IsOpen (V i))
    (hG : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt G (g z) z)
    (hH : ∀ i < n, ∀ z ∈ V i, HasDerivAt (H i) (g z) z)
    (hγU : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc (p i) (p (i + 1)), γ t ∈ U)
    (hγV : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc (p i) (p (i + 1)), γ t ∈ V i) :
    primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ p H n = G (γ (p n)) - G (γ (p 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_of_hasDerivAt hγ hp hV
    (fun _ _ => hU) hH (fun _ _ => hG) hγV hγU]
  simpa only [primitiveSubdivisionTransport] using sum_range_sub (fun i => G (γ (p i))) n

name: Complex.primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_curveIntegral_of_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_curveIntegral_of_hasDerivAt
    {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend I)
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {G : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {U : ℕ → Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hp : ∀ i < n, p i ≤ p (i + 1)) (hp0 : p 0 = 0) (hpn : p n = 1)
    (hpI : ∀ i ≤ n, p i ∈ I)
    (hG : ∀ i < n, ∀ z ∈ U i, HasDerivAt (G i) (g z) z)
    (hg : ∀ i < n, ContinuousOn g (U i))
    (hγU : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc (p i) (p (i + 1)), γ.extend t ∈ U i) :
    primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ.extend p G n =
      curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
proof:
:= by
  let F := curveIntegralFun (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
  have hcell (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
      IntervalIntegrable F volume (p i) (p (i + 1)) ∧
      (∫ t in (p i)..(p (i + 1)), F t) =
        G i (γ.extend (p (i + 1))) - G i (γ.extend (p i)) := by
    have hpi := hpI i hi.le
    have hpnext := hpI (i + 1) hi
    have hsubset : Icc (p i) (p (i + 1)) ⊆ I :=
      fun t ht => ⟨hpi.1.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hpnext.2⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => g (γ.extend t)) (Icc (p i) (p (i + 1))) :=
      (hg i hi).comp γ.continuous_extend.continuousOn (hγU i hi)
    have hd : ContinuousOn (fun t => derivWithin γ.extend I t)
        (Icc (p i) (p (i + 1))) :=
      (hγ.continuousOn_derivWithin uniqueDiffOn_Icc_zero_one le_rfl).mono hsubset
    have hFeq : F = fun t => g (γ.extend t) * derivWithin γ.extend I t := by
      funext t
      simp only [F, curveIntegralFun_def, smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hF : ContinuousOn F (Icc (p i) (p (i + 1))) := by
      rw [hFeq]
      exact hc.fun_mul hd
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable F volume (p i) (p (i + 1)) :=
      hF.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (hp i hi)
    refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
    have hcontG : ContinuousOn (G i) (U i) :=
      fun z hz => (hG i hi z hz).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le (hp i hi)
      (hcontG.comp γ.continuous_extend.continuousOn (hγU i hi)) _ hint
    intro r hr
    have hrI : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hpi.1 hr.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hr.2 hpnext.2⟩
    have hnhds : I ∈ nhds r := Icc_mem_nhds hrI.1 hrI.2
    have hderγ := (hγ.differentiableOn (by norm_num) r
      (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hrI)).differentiableAt hnhds
    have hDerG := hG i hi (γ.extend r) (hγU i hi r (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hr))
    have hdcomp := (hDerG.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt r hderγ.hasDerivAt
    simpa [F, curveIntegralFun_def, derivWithin_of_mem_nhds hnhds,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hdcomp
  unfold primitiveSubdivisionTransport
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ range n, (G i (γ.extend (p (i + 1))) - G i (γ.extend (p i)))) =
        ∑ i ∈ range n, ∫ t in (p i)..(p (i + 1)), F t := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact (hcell i (mem_range.mp hi)).2.symm
    _ = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t := by
      simpa only [hp0, hpn] using
        intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (fun i hi => (hcell i hi).1)
    _ = curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ :=
      (curveIntegral_def _ γ).symm

name: Complex.exists_primitive_subdivision_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_subdivision_of_differentiableOn
    {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) {Ω : Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω) (hγΩ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ Ω) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ U : ℕ → Set ℂ, ∃ G : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ,
      ∀ i < n, IsOpen (U i) ∧ (∀ z ∈ U i, HasDerivAt (G i) (g z) z) ∧
        ContinuousOn g (U i) ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / n) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / n), γ.extend t ∈ U i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrad : ∀ z : Ω, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball (z : ℂ) r ⊆ Ω :=
    fun z => Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hΩ.mem_nhds z.property)
  choose r hr hball using hrad
  let B : Ω → Set ℂ := fun z => Metric.ball (z : ℂ) (r z)
  have hprimitive : ∀ z : Ω, ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ w ∈ B z, HasDerivAt G (g w) w := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := (convex_ball (z : ℂ) (r z)).exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt
      (hg.mono (hball z))
    exact ⟨G, fun w hw => (hG w hw).hasDerivAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)⟩
  choose G hG using hprimitive
  have hγext : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ.extend t ∈ Ω := by
    intro t ht
    rw [γ.extend_apply ht]
    exact hγΩ ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hcover : γ.extend '' Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ z : Ω, B z := by
    rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    apply mem_iUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨⟨γ.extend t, hγext t ht⟩, mem_ball_self (hr _)⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hmesh⟩ := exists_uniform_subdivision_subordinate_open_cover γ.extend
    γ.continuous_extend B (fun _ => isOpen_ball) hcover
  choose J hJ using hmesh
  let K : ℕ → Ω := fun i => if hi : i < n then J i hi else J 0 hn
  refine ⟨n, hn, B ∘ K, G ∘ K, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hKi : K i = J i hi := dif_pos hi
  refine ⟨isOpen_ball, hG (K i), hg.continuousOn.mono (hball (K i)), ?_⟩
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hKi] using hJ i hi

name: Complex.hasDerivAt_ellipseMap
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_ellipseMap (M ε θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (ellipseMap M ε)
      (((-M * Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + (ε * Real.cos θ : ℝ) * I) θ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ellipseMap, Pi.add_apply, mul_neg, neg_mul] using!
    (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ).const_mul M).ofReal_comp.add
      (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).const_mul ε).ofReal_comp.mul_const I))

name: Complex.norm_ellipseMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_ellipseMap_le {M ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖ellipseMap M ε θ‖ ≤ M + ε
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖ellipseMap M ε θ‖ ≤ ‖((M * Real.cos θ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ +
        ‖((ε * Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = M * |Real.cos θ| + ε * |Real.sin θ| := by
      simp only [norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_I, mul_one,
        abs_of_nonneg hM, abs_of_nonneg hε]
    _ ≤ M + ε := by
      nlinarith [Real.abs_cos_le_one θ, Real.abs_sin_le_one θ]

name: Complex.ellipseMap_two_pi_sub
statement:
private theorem ellipseMap_two_pi_sub (M ε θ : ℝ) :
    ellipseMap M ε (2 * Real.pi - θ) = conj (ellipseMap M ε θ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ellipseMap, Real.cos_two_pi_sub, Real.sin_two_pi_sub, map_add, map_mul,
    conj_ofReal, conj_I, ofReal_neg, mul_neg]
  ring

name: Complex.ellipse_tangent_reflection
statement:
private theorem ellipse_tangent_reflection (M ε θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (ellipseMap M ε) (2 * Real.pi - θ) = -conj (deriv (ellipseMap M ε) θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_ellipseMap _ _ _).deriv, (hasDerivAt_ellipseMap _ _ _).deriv]
  simp only [Real.cos_two_pi_sub, Real.sin_two_pi_sub, map_add, map_mul,
    conj_ofReal, conj_I]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Complex.neg_normalized_re
statement:
private theorem neg_normalized_re (z : ℂ) :
    (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * z)).re = -z.im / (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ) = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * I by push_cast; rfl]
  rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_I, ← ofReal_inv]
  simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_re, mul_im, I_re, I_im, ofReal_re,
    ofReal_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_sub, neg_mul]
  ring

name: Complex.neg_normalized_ellipseIntegral_re_eq
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_ellipseIntegral_re_eq
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {M ε : ℝ}
    (hc : ContinuousOn (fun θ => f (ellipseMap M ε θ)) (Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (hconj : ∀ θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi,
      f (conj (ellipseMap M ε θ)) = conj (f (ellipseMap M ε θ))) :
    (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * ellipseIntegral f M ε)).re =
      (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi,
        M * Real.sin θ * (f (ellipseMap M ε θ)).im -
          ε * Real.cos θ * (f (ellipseMap M ε θ)).re) / Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => deriv (ellipseMap M ε) θ * f (ellipseMap M ε θ)
  have hQcont : ContinuousOn Q (Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.mul _ hc
    have hd : deriv (ellipseMap M ε) = fun θ =>
        (((-M * Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + (ε * Real.cos θ : ℝ) * I) := by
      funext θ
      exact (hasDerivAt_ellipseMap _ _ _).deriv
    rw [hd]
    fun_prop
  have hQ : IntervalIntegrable Q volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    hQcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc Real.two_pi_pos.le
  have hπ : 0 ≤ Real.pi := Real.pi_pos.le
  have hπ2 : Real.pi ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hup : IntervalIntegrable Q volume 0 Real.pi :=
    hQ.mono_set (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hπ, uIcc_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le] using
      Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hπ2)
  have hlo : IntervalIntegrable Q volume Real.pi (2 * Real.pi) :=
    hQ.mono_set (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hπ2, uIcc_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le] using
      Icc_subset_Icc hπ le_rfl)
  have hreflection (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi) :
      Q (2 * Real.pi - θ) = -conj (Q θ) := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    rw [ellipseMap_two_pi_sub, hconj θ hθ, ellipse_tangent_reflection, map_mul, neg_mul]
  have hlow : (∫ θ in Real.pi..2 * Real.pi, Q θ) =
      -conj (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, Q θ) := by
    have hchange := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left
      (a := 0) (b := Real.pi) Q (2 * Real.pi)
    have hends : 2 * Real.pi - Real.pi = Real.pi := by ring
    rw [hends, sub_zero] at hchange
    rw [← hchange]
    calc
      _ = ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, -conj (Q θ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro θ hθ
        exact hreflection θ (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hπ] using hθ)
      _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_conj]
  have hfull : ellipseIntegral f M ε =
      (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, Q θ) - conj (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, Q θ) := by
    change (∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, Q θ) = _
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hup hlo, hlow, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [hfull, neg_normalized_re]
  simp only [sub_im, conj_im]
  have hi := Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hup
  change (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, (Q θ).im) = (∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, Q θ).im at hi
  rw [← hi]
  have hpoint (θ : ℝ) : -(Q θ).im =
      M * Real.sin θ * (f (ellipseMap M ε θ)).im -
        ε * Real.cos θ * (f (ellipseMap M ε θ)).re := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    rw [(hasDerivAt_ellipseMap _ _ _).deriv]
    simp only [mul_im, add_re, add_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, mul_re, I_re, I_im,
      mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero]
    ring
  rw [show -((∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, (Q θ).im) - -(∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, (Q θ).im)) =
    2 * -(∫ θ in 0..Real.pi, (Q θ).im) by ring]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  field_simp

name: Complex.neg_mul_le_im_exp_mul_of_im_le
statement:
private theorem neg_mul_le_im_exp_mul_of_im_le {z v : ℂ} {M ε C : ℝ}
    (hre : z.re ≤ M) (him : 0 ≤ z.im) (himε : z.im ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hv : 0 ≤ v.im) (hvC : ‖v‖ ≤ C) :
    -(Real.exp M * C * ε) ≤ (exp z * v).im
proof:
:= by
  have he0 : 0 ≤ ε := him.trans himε
  have hcos : 0 ≤ Real.cos z.im :=
    Real.cos_nonneg_of_neg_pi_div_two_le_of_le
      (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) ((himε.trans hε).trans Real.one_le_pi_div_two)
  have hphase := neg_abs_sin_mul_norm_le_im_exp_mul hcos hv
  have hs : |Real.sin z.im| ≤ ε :=
    (Real.abs_sin_le_abs.trans_eq (abs_of_nonneg him)).trans himε
  have hsC : |Real.sin z.im| * ‖v‖ ≤ ε * C :=
    mul_le_mul hs hvC (norm_nonneg _) he0
  have hrot : -(ε * C) ≤ (exp (z.im * I) * v).im := by linarith
  have heq : (exp z * v).im = Real.exp z.re * (exp (z.im * I) * v).im := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← re_add_im z, exp_add, mul_assoc]
    simp only [mul_im, exp_ofReal_re, exp_ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [heq]
  have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrot (Real.exp_pos z.re).le
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hre)
    (mul_nonneg he0 hC)
  nlinarith

name: Complex.neg_normalized_exp_ellipseIntegral_re_ge
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_exp_ellipseIntegral_re_ge
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {M ε C : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε' : ε ≤ 1)
    (hc : ContinuousOn (fun θ => h (ellipseMap M ε θ)) (Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (hconj : ∀ θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi,
      h (conj (ellipseMap M ε θ)) = conj (h (ellipseMap M ε θ)))
    (him : ∀ θ ∈ Ioo 0 Real.pi, 0 ≤ (h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).im)
    (hbound : ∀ θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi, ‖h (ellipseMap M ε θ)‖ ≤ C) :
    -((M + 1) * Real.exp M * C) * ε ≤
      (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * ellipseIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) M ε)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hbound 0 ⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos.le⟩)
  have hγ : Continuous (ellipseMap M ε) := by unfold ellipseMap; fun_prop
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun θ => exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ))
      (Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := (continuous_exp.comp hγ).continuousOn.mul hc
  have hfconj (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi) :
      exp (conj (ellipseMap M ε θ)) * h (conj (ellipseMap M ε θ)) =
        conj (exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)) := by
    rw [exp_conj, hconj θ hθ, map_mul]
  rw [neg_normalized_ellipseIntegral_re_eq hfc hfconj]
  let D : ℝ := Real.exp M * C
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hC
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ =>
    M * Real.sin θ * (exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).im -
      ε * Real.cos θ * (exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).re
  have hpoint (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 Real.pi) : -((M + 1) * D) * ε ≤ F θ := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ := (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθ.1 hθ.2).le
    have hs1 := Real.sin_le_one θ
    have hx : (ellipseMap M ε θ).re ≤ M := by
      simp only [ellipseMap, add_re, ofReal_re, mul_re, ofReal_im, I_re, I_im,
        mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
      nlinarith [Real.cos_le_one θ]
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ (ellipseMap M ε θ).im := by
      simpa only [ellipseMap, add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, I_im, I_re,
        mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using mul_nonneg hε hs0
    have hyε : (ellipseMap M ε θ).im ≤ ε := by
      simpa only [ellipseMap, add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, I_im, I_re,
        mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using mul_le_of_le_one_right hε hs1
    have hlower := neg_mul_le_im_exp_mul_of_im_le hx hy0 hyε hε' hC
      (him θ hθ) (hbound θ ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2.le⟩)
    have hnorm : ‖exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)‖ ≤ D := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_exp]
      exact mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx) (hbound θ ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2.le⟩)
        (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hre : |(exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).re| ≤ D :=
      (abs_re_le_norm _).trans hnorm
    have hvertical : ε * Real.cos θ * (exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).re ≤
        ε * D := by
      apply (le_abs_self _).trans
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hε]
      have hh := mul_le_mul (Real.abs_cos_le_one θ) hre (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hε]
    have hmain0 : 0 ≤ M * Real.sin θ := mul_nonneg hM hs0
    have hmain1 : M * Real.sin θ ≤ M := mul_le_of_le_one_right hM hs1
    have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlower hmain0
    have hp' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmain1 (mul_nonneg hD hε)
    dsimp only [F]
    dsimp only [D] at *
    nlinarith
  have hFcont : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 Real.pi) := by
    have hcf := hfc.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    have hre : ContinuousOn (fun θ => (exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).re)
        (Icc 0 Real.pi) := continuous_re.comp_continuousOn hcf
    have him : ContinuousOn (fun θ => (exp (ellipseMap M ε θ) * h (ellipseMap M ε θ)).im)
        (Icc 0 Real.pi) := continuous_im.comp_continuousOn hcf
    exact (by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun θ => M * Real.sin θ) (Icc 0 Real.pi)).mul him |>.sub
      ((by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun θ => ε * Real.cos θ) (Icc 0 Real.pi)).mul hre)
  have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo Real.pi_pos.le
    (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun _ : ℝ => -((M + 1) * D) * ε) volume 0 Real.pi)
    (hFcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc Real.pi_pos.le) hpoint
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero] at hint
  apply (le_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mpr
  dsimp only [F, D] at hint
  nlinarith

name: Complex.nonneg_of_neg_normalized_exp_ellipseIntegral_re_eq
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_neg_normalized_exp_ellipseIntegral_re_eq
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {M C δ w : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hc : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ,
      ContinuousOn (fun θ => h (ellipseMap M ε θ)) (Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (hconj : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ, ∀ θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi,
      h (conj (ellipseMap M ε θ)) = conj (h (ellipseMap M ε θ)))
    (him : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (h z).im)
    (hbound : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ, ∀ θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi,
      ‖h (ellipseMap M ε θ)‖ ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ,
      (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * ellipseIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) M ε)).re = w) :
    0 ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ := (M + 1) * Real.exp M * C
  have hest : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), -K * ε ≤ w := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (lt_min hδ zero_lt_one)] with ε hε
    have heδ : ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ := ⟨hε.1, (lt_min_iff.mp hε.2).1⟩
    rw [← hw ε heδ]
    apply neg_normalized_exp_ellipseIntegral_re_ge hM hε.1.le (lt_min_iff.mp hε.2).2.le
      (hc ε heδ) (hconj ε heδ)
    · intro θ hθ
      apply him
      have hsin := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθ.1 hθ.2
      simpa only [ellipseMap, add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, I_im, I_re,
        mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using mul_pos hε.1 hsin
    · exact hbound ε heδ
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => -K * ε) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, id_eq] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul ((tendsto_id : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)).mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)))
  exact le_of_tendsto hlim hest

name: Complex.lipschitzWith_norm_inv_sub_of_im_pos
statement:
theorem Complex.lipschitzWith_norm_inv_sub_of_im_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    LipschitzWith ⟨z.im⁻¹ ^ 2, by positivity⟩
      (fun x : ℝ => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  have hheight (t : ℝ) : z.im ≤ ‖z - (t : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hz] using
      Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - (t : ℂ))
  have hne (t : ℝ) : z - (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have h := hheight t
    rw [hzero, norm_zero] at h
    exact hz.not_ge h
  have hd : dist (z - (x : ℂ)) (z - (y : ℂ)) = dist x y := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have hdiff : z - (x : ℂ) - (z - (y : ℂ)) = ((y - x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_sub]
      ring
    rw [hdiff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm]
  have hprod : z.im ^ 2 ≤ ‖z - (x : ℂ)‖ * ‖z - (y : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul (hheight x) (hheight y) hz.le (norm_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ ≤ dist ((z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹) ((z - (y : ℂ))⁻¹) := by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using dist_norm_norm_le ((z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹) ((z - (y : ℂ))⁻¹)
    _ = dist x y / (‖z - (x : ℂ)‖ * ‖z - (y : ℂ)‖) := by
      rw [dist_inv_inv₀ (hne x) (hne y), hd]
    _ ≤ dist x y / z.im ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (dist_nonneg) (sq_pos_of_pos hz) hprod
    _ = _ := by
      change dist x y / z.im ^ 2 = z.im⁻¹ ^ 2 * dist x y
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
      ring

name: Complex.norm_inv_sub_inv_sub_real_le
statement:
private theorem Complex.norm_inv_sub_inv_sub_real_le {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : ℝ)
    (hnum : |x-y| ≤ ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖) (hden : L ≤ ‖z-(y : ℂ)‖) :
    ‖(z-(x : ℂ))⁻¹-(z-(y : ℂ))⁻¹‖ ≤ L⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hne (t : ℝ) : z-(t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hh
    have ht : z = (t : ℂ) := sub_eq_zero.mp hh
    have : z.im=0 := by rw [ht]; rfl
    exact hz.ne' this
  have hd : dist (z-(x : ℂ)) (z-(y : ℂ)) = |x-y| := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have he : z-(x : ℂ)-(z-(y : ℂ)) = ((y-x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [he,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_sub_comm]
  rw [← dist_eq_norm,dist_inv_inv₀ (hne x) (hne y),hd]
  have hx : 0 < ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne x)
  have hy : 0 < ‖z-(y : ℂ)‖ := hL.trans_le hden
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ / (‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ * ‖z-(y : ℂ)‖) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (mul_pos hx hy).le
    _ = (‖z-(y : ℂ)‖)⁻¹ := by field_simp
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hL hden

name: Complex.norm_inv_sub_real_sub_inv_sub_clamp_le
statement:
theorem Complex.norm_inv_sub_real_sub_inv_sub_clamp_le {z : ℂ}
    (hre : z.re=0) (hz : 0 < z.im) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖(z-(x : ℂ))⁻¹-
      (z-((max (-L) (min L x) : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹‖ ≤ L⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hreal (t : ℝ) : |t| ≤ ‖z-(t : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_re,Complex.ofReal_re,hre,zero_sub,abs_neg] using
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z-(t : ℂ))
  by_cases hleft : x ≤ -L
  · have he : max (-L) (min L x) = -L := by
      rw [min_eq_right (by linarith),max_eq_left hleft]
    rw [he]
    apply Complex.norm_inv_sub_inv_sub_real_le hz hL x (-L)
    · have hn : x+L ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have hx : x ≤ 0 := by linarith
      calc
        |x- -L| = -(x+L) := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add,abs_of_nonpos hn]
        _ ≤ |x| := by rw [abs_of_nonpos hx]; linarith
        _ ≤ _ := hreal x
    · simpa only [abs_neg,abs_of_pos hL] using hreal (-L)
  by_cases hright : L ≤ x
  · have he : max (-L) (min L x) = L := by
      rw [min_eq_left hright,max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    rw [he]
    apply Complex.norm_inv_sub_inv_sub_real_le hz hL x L
    · have hn : 0 ≤ x-L := sub_nonneg.mpr hright
      have hx : 0 ≤ x := hL.le.trans hright
      calc
        |x-L| = x-L := abs_of_nonneg hn
        _ ≤ |x| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]; linarith
        _ ≤ _ := hreal x
    · simpa only [abs_of_pos hL] using hreal L
  · have he : max (-L) (min L x) = x := by
      rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hright),max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hleft)]
    simp only [he,sub_self,norm_zero]
    exact inv_nonneg.mpr hL.le

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_congr
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_congr {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    {g h : ℂ → ℂ} (he : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, g (γ r : ℂ) = h (γ r : ℂ)) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ = cubicalCurveIntegral h Γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro γ hγ
  congr 1
  rw [curveIntegral_def, curveIntegral_def]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro r hr
  have hr' : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using hr
  simp only [curveIntegralFun_def, (cubicalPath γ).extend_apply hr']
  rw [show g ((cubicalPath γ) ⟨r, hr'⟩) = h ((cubicalPath γ) ⟨r, hr'⟩) from he γ hγ ⟨r, hr'⟩]

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_const_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hpath (γ : C(I, Ω)) :
      curveIntegral (fun z => (c * g z) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) =
        c * curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
    have he : (fun z => (c * g z) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) =
        fun z => c • (g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) := by
      funext z
      exact mul_smul c (g z) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
    rw [he, curveIntegral_fun_smul]
    rfl
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, hpath, mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro γ _
  simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_sub {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (g h : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ))
    (hh : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => h z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ)) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => g z - h z) Γ =
      cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ - cubicalCurveIntegral h Γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  rw [← sum_sub_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro γ hγ
  have he : (fun z => (g z - h z) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) =
      fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ - h z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ := by
    funext z
    exact sub_smul (g z) (h z) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
  rw [he, curveIntegral_fun_sub (hg γ hγ) (hh γ hγ)]
  exact smul_sub (Γ γ) _ _

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_sum
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_sum {Ω : Set ℂ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (g : ι → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ i, CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => g i z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ)) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => ∑ i, g i z) Γ = ∑ i, cubicalCurveIntegral (g i) Γ
proof:
:= by
  have hpath (γ : C(I, Ω)) (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) :
      curveIntegral (fun z => (∑ i, g i z) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) =
        ∑ i, curveIntegral (fun z => g i z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
    have he : curveIntegralFun
        (fun z => (∑ i, g i z) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) =
        fun r => ∑ i, curveIntegralFun
          (fun z => g i z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) r := by
      funext r
      simp only [curveIntegralFun_def, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, sum_mul]
    simp only [curveIntegral_def]
    rw [he, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => hg γ hγ i)]
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∑ i, Γ γ • curveIntegral
