        (fun z => g i z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro γ hγ
      rw [hpath γ hγ, smul_sum]
    _ = _ := sum_comm

name: Complex.integrable_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub
statement:
theorem integrable_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub {Ω : Set ℂ}
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f Ω) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) Γ) μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro γ hγ
  apply Integrable.smul
  apply integrable_curveIntegral_div_sub_of_contDiffOn hs (cubicalPath γ) (hΓ γ hγ)
  · intro t ht x hx
    rw [(cubicalPath γ).extend_apply ht]
    exact hoff γ hγ ⟨t, ht⟩ x hx
  · exact hf.mono (by rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact (γ r).property)

name: Complex.integral_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub
statement:
theorem integral_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub {Ω : Set ℂ}
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f Ω) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) Γ ∂μ) =
      cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) Γ
proof:
:= by
  have hInt (γ : C(I, Ω)) (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) :=
    integrable_curveIntegral_div_sub_of_contDiffOn hs (cubicalPath γ) (hΓ γ hγ)
      (fun t ht x hx => by rw [(cubicalPath γ).extend_apply ht]; exact hoff γ hγ ⟨t, ht⟩ x hx)
      (hf.mono (by rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact (γ r).property))
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun (γ : C(I, Ω)) (x : ℝ) => Γ γ • curveIntegral
    (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ)) _
    (fun γ hγ => (hInt γ hγ).smul (Γ γ))]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro γ hγ
  rw [(hInt γ hγ).integral_smul]
  rw [(curveIntegrable_and_integral_curveIntegral_div_sub hs (cubicalPath γ) (hΓ γ hγ)
    (fun t ht x hx => by rw [(cubicalPath γ).extend_apply ht]; exact hoff γ hγ ⟨t, ht⟩ x hx)
    (hf.mono (by rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact (γ r).property))).2]

name: Complex.norm_cos_le_exp_abs_im
statement: theorem norm_cos_le_exp_abs_im (w : ℂ) : ‖cos w‖ ≤ Real.exp |w.im|
proof:
:= by
  have h : ‖cos w‖ ≤ (Real.exp (-w.im) + Real.exp w.im) / 2 := by
    rw [cos, norm_div, norm_ofNat]
    refine (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_add_le _ _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq ?_
    simp only [norm_exp, mul_re, I_re, I_im, mul_zero, mul_one,
      zero_sub, neg_re, neg_im, neg_neg]
  have hp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_abs_self w.im)
  have hn := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_abs w.im)
  linarith

name: Complex.norm_sin_le_norm_mul_exp_abs_im
statement:
theorem norm_sin_le_norm_mul_exp_abs_im (w : ℂ) :
    ‖sin w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ * Real.exp |w.im|
proof:
:= by
  have hd (t : ℝ) (_ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun t : ℝ => sin ((t : ℂ) * w))
        (cos ((t : ℂ) * w) * w) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t := by
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).mul_const w).csin).comp_ofReal
    simpa only [id_eq, one_mul] using h.hasDerivWithinAt
  have hb (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      ‖cos ((t : ℂ) * w) * w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ * Real.exp |w.im| := by
    have him : |((t : ℂ) * w).im| ≤ |w.im| := by
      simp only [mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero, abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg w.im) ht.2
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc
      ‖cos ((t : ℂ) * w)‖ * ‖w‖ ≤
          Real.exp |((t : ℂ) * w).im| * ‖w‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_cos_le_exp_abs_im _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ Real.exp |w.im| * ‖w‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr him) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖w‖ * Real.exp |w.im| := mul_comm _ _
  have h := (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
    (x := 0) (y := 1) hd hb (by simp) (by simp)
  simpa only [ofReal_one, ofReal_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, sin_zero,
    sub_zero, sub_zero, norm_one, mul_one] using h

name: Complex.norm_one_sub_cos_le_norm_sq_mul_exp_abs_im
statement:
theorem norm_one_sub_cos_le_norm_sq_mul_exp_abs_im (w : ℂ) :
    ‖1 - cos w‖ ≤ ‖w‖^2 / 2 * Real.exp |w.im|
proof:
:= by
  have hid : 1 - cos w = 2 * sin (w / 2)^2 := by
    calc
      1 - cos w = 1 - cos (2 * (w / 2)) := by congr 2; ring
      _ = 2 * sin (w / 2)^2 := by rw [cos_two_mul_eq_one_sub]; ring
  have hsin := norm_sin_le_norm_mul_exp_abs_im (w / 2)
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (sin (w / 2))) hsin 2
  rw [hid, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_ofNat]
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by norm_num)).trans_eq ?_
  simp only [norm_div, norm_ofNat, div_ofNat_im, abs_div,
    show |(2 : ℝ)| = 2 by norm_num]
  rw [mul_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have he : (2 : ℝ) * (|w.im| / 2) = |w.im| := by ring
  rw [he]
  ring

name: circleIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_neg_integral_deriv_mul
statement:
theorem integral_mul_deriv_eq_neg_integral_deriv_mul
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : sphere c r ⊆ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U) :
    (∮ z in C(c, r), f z * deriv g z) =
      -(∮ z in C(c, r), deriv f z * g z)
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : ContinuousOn (deriv f) U := (hf.deriv hU).continuousOn
  have hgd : ContinuousOn (deriv g) U := (hg.deriv hU).continuousOn
  have hleft : CircleIntegrable (fun z => deriv f z * g z) c r :=
    ((hfd.mul hg.continuousOn).mono hc).circleIntegrable hr
  have hright : CircleIntegrable (fun z => f z * deriv g z) c r :=
    ((hf.continuousOn.mul hgd).mono hc).circleIntegrable hr
  have hzero : (∮ z in C(c, r), deriv f z * g z + f z * deriv g z) = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_hasDerivWithinAt hr
    intro z hz
    exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hc hz))).hasDerivAt.mul
      (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hc hz))).hasDerivAt).hasDerivWithinAt
  rw [integral_add hleft hright] at hzero
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by simpa only [add_comm] using hzero)

name: circleIntegral.integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_neg_integral_exp_mul
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_neg_integral_exp_mul
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : sphere c r ⊆ U)
    (hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h U) :
    (∮ z in C(c, r), exp z * deriv h z) =
      -(∮ z in C(c, r), exp z * h z)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Complex.deriv_exp] using
    integral_mul_deriv_eq_neg_integral_deriv_mul hr hU hc
      Complex.differentiable_exp.differentiableOn hh

name: Complex.PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.node_le_next
proof:
:=
  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg D.size)

name: Complex.PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.bottom_succ_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  have h := sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_continuous
    (γ := fun t => ψ (t, ((j + 1 : ℝ) / D.size)))
    (hψ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)) (D.node_le_next i)
    (D.isOpen_chart i hi (j + 1) hj) (D.isOpen_chart i hi j (by omega))
    (D.hasDerivAt_primitive i hi (j + 1) hj) (D.hasDerivAt_primitive i hi j (by omega))
    (fun t ht => D.mapsTo_chart i hi (j + 1) hj (t, ((j + 1 : ℝ) / D.size))
      ⟨⟨ht.1, by simp⟩, ⟨ht.2, by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using D.node_le_next (j + 1)⟩⟩)
    (fun t ht => D.mapsTo_chart i hi j (by omega) (t, ((j + 1 : ℝ) / D.size))
      ⟨⟨ht.1, D.node_le_next j⟩, ⟨ht.2, le_rfl⟩⟩)
  simpa only [bottom, top, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h

name: Complex.PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.left_succ_eq_right
proof:
:= by
  have h := sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_continuous
    (γ := fun t => ψ (((i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size), t))
    (hψ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)) (D.node_le_next j)
    (D.isOpen_chart (i + 1) hi j hj) (D.isOpen_chart i (by omega) j hj)
    (D.hasDerivAt_primitive (i + 1) hi j hj) (D.hasDerivAt_primitive i (by omega) j hj)
    (fun t ht => D.mapsTo_chart (i + 1) hi j hj (((i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size), t)
      ⟨⟨by simp, ht.1⟩, ⟨by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using D.node_le_next (i + 1), ht.2⟩⟩)
    (fun t ht => D.mapsTo_chart i (by omega) j hj (((i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size), t)
      ⟨⟨D.node_le_next i, ht.1⟩, ⟨le_rfl, ht.2⟩⟩)
  simpa only [left, right, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h

name: Complex.PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.sum_right_sub_sum_left_eq_sum_top_sub_sum_bottom
statement:
theorem sum_right_sub_sum_left_eq_sum_top_sub_sum_bottom
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} {ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} (D : PrimitiveHomotopyGrid g ψ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range D.size, D.right (D.size - 1) j) - (∑ j ∈ range D.size, D.left 0 j) =
      (∑ i ∈ range D.size, D.top i (D.size - 1)) - (∑ i ∈ range D.size, D.bottom i 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_grid_boundary_eq _ _ _ _ D.size_pos
  · intro i _ j _
    dsimp [bottom, top, left, right]
    ring
  · exact fun _ hi _ hj => D.bottom_succ_eq_top hψ hi hj
  · exact fun _ hi _ hj => D.left_succ_eq_right hψ hi hj

name: Complex.nonempty_primitiveHomotopyGrid_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem nonempty_primitiveHomotopyGrid_of_differentiableOn
    {ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) {Ω : Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω)
    (hψΩ : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1, ψ t ∈ Ω) :
    Nonempty (PrimitiveHomotopyGrid g ψ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrad : ∀ z : Ω, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball (z : ℂ) r ⊆ Ω :=
    fun z => mem_nhds_iff.mp (hΩ.mem_nhds z.property)
  choose r hr hball using hrad
  let B : Ω → Set ℂ := fun z => ball (z : ℂ) (r z)
  have hprimitive : ∀ z : Ω, ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ w ∈ B z, HasDerivAt G (g w) w := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := (convex_ball (z : ℂ) (r z)).exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt
      (hg.mono (hball z))
    exact ⟨G, fun w hw => (hG w hw).hasDerivAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)⟩
  choose G hG using hprimitive
  have hcover : ψ '' Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ z : Ω, B z := by
    rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    apply mem_iUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨⟨ψ t, hψΩ t ht⟩, mem_ball_self (hr _)⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hmesh⟩ := exists_uniform_grid_subordinate_open_cover ψ hψ B
    (fun _ => isOpen_ball) hcover
  choose J hJ using hmesh
  let K : ℕ → ℕ → Ω := fun i j =>
    if hi : i < n then if hj : j < n then J i hi j hj else J 0 hn 0 hn else J 0 hn 0 hn
  refine ⟨⟨n, hn, fun i j => B (K i j), fun i j => G (K i j),
    fun _ _ _ _ => isOpen_ball, fun i _ j _ => hG (K i j),
    fun i _ j _ => hg.continuousOn.mono (hball (K i j)), ?_⟩⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  simpa only [K, dif_pos hi, dif_pos hj] using hJ i hi j hj

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_not_mem_boundedComplementFill
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_not_mem_boundedComplementFill
    {C : Set ℂ} (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {τ : ℂ} (hτ : τ ∉ boundedComplementFill C) : cubicalWindingIntegral Γ τ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hoff, hunbounded⟩ := not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff.mp hτ
  apply cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_preconnected Γ hc hΓ
    isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn (S := connectedComponentIn Cᶜ τ)
    (fun z hz => fun ht => connectedComponentIn_subset Cᶜ τ hz (cubicalTrace_subset Γ ht))
    hunbounded (mem_connectedComponentIn hoff)

name: Complex.rectangularGrid_cell_mem_of_comparison
statement:
theorem rectangularGrid_cell_mem_of_comparison
    {C Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {h δ : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hmesh : 9 * h ≤ δ)
    (hbuffer : cthickening δ (boundedComplementFill C) ⊆ Ω)
    (N : ℕ) (c : Grid.Coefficients (2 * N) (2 * N))
    (hcycle : RectangularChain.IsCycle c.1 c.2)
    (Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C)) (hnull : IsNullHomologous Δ)
    (he : mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ =
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ -
        Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)) c) :
    ∀ i j, RectangularChain.cellCoefficients c.1 i j ≠ 0 →
      ∀ p, Grid.cell (vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)) i j p ∈ Ω
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij p
  let τ := center (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h) i j
  have hnear : τ ∈ thickening (8 * h) (boundedComplementFill C) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hofffill : τ ∉ boundedComplementFill C :=
      fun ht => hnot (self_subset_thickening (by positivity) _ ht)
    have hoff : τ ∉ thickening (8 * h) C := by
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hd⟩ := mem_thickening_iff.mp ht
      exact hnot (mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨z, subset_boundedComplementFill C hz, hd⟩)
    have hz := cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_not_mem_boundedComplementFill Γ hc hΓ hofffill
    have heq := cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_grid_of_isNullHomologous_comparison Γ hΓ
      (vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)) c.1 c.2 Δ hnull he isOpen_thickening hoff
    have hi := cubicalWindingIntegral_rectangularGrid_eq_cellCoefficients
      (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h) (strictMono_coordinate N hh) (strictMono_coordinate N hh)
      c.1 c.2 hcycle i j
    change cubicalWindingIntegral (mapOne fullPlaneLift
      (Grid.edgeChain (vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)) c.1 c.2)) τ = _ at hi
    have hzero : ((RectangularChain.cellCoefficients c.1 i j : ℤ) : ℂ) = 0 := by
      rw [← hi, ← heq, hz]
    exact hij (by exact_mod_cast hzero)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hd⟩ := mem_thickening_iff.mp hnear
  apply hbuffer
  apply mem_cthickening_of_dist_le _ z δ _ hz
  have hcell := norm_cell_sub_center_le (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)
    (strictMono_coordinate N hh).monotone (strictMono_coordinate N hh).monotone i j
    (coordinate_succ_sub_castSucc N h i).le (coordinate_succ_sub_castSucc N h j).le p
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd ⊢
  exact (norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ τ z).trans (by linarith)

name: Complex.HadamardThreeLines.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_zero_of_right_boundary_error
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_zero_of_right_boundary_error
    (F : ι → ℂ → E) (p : Filter ι) (C u₀ : ℝ) (hC : 0≤C)
    (hd : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F i) {z : ℂ | 0<z.re})
    (hb : ∀ i z, 0<z.re → ‖F i z‖≤C/z.re)
    (hu : ∀ u, u₀≤u → ∃ ε : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0≤ε i) ∧ Tendsto ε p (𝓝 0) ∧
        ∀ i z, z.re=u → ‖F i z‖≤ε i) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F (fun _ => 0) p {z : ℂ | 0<z.re}
proof:
:= by
  apply tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_of_forall_exists_nhds
  intro z hz
  change 0<z.re at hz
  let l : ℝ := z.re/4
  let h : ℝ := z.re/2
  let u : ℝ := max u₀ (z.re+1)
  have hl : 0<l := by dsimp [l]; linarith
  have hlh : l<h := by dsimp [l,h]; linarith
  have hhz : h<z.re := by dsimp [h]; linarith
  have hzu : z.re<u := (by linarith : z.re<z.re+1).trans_le (le_max_right _ _)
  have hhu : h≤u := hhz.le.trans hzu.le
  let B : ℝ := max 1 (C/l)
  have hB : 1≤B := le_max_left _ _
  have hbound (i : ι) (w : ℂ) (hw : w∈verticalClosedStrip l u) : ‖F i w‖≤B := by
    exact (hb i w (hl.trans_le hw.1)).trans
      ((div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC hl hw.1).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hcl : closure (verticalStrip l u) ⊆ {w : ℂ | 0<w.re} := by
    have he : closure (verticalStrip l u) ⊆ {w : ℂ | l≤w.re} :=
      closure_minimal (fun _ hw => hw.1.le) (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_re)
    exact fun w hw => hl.trans_le (he hw)
  have hdiff (i : ι) : DiffContOnCl ℂ (F i) (verticalStrip l u) :=
    ((hd i).mono hcl).diffContOnCl
  obtain ⟨ε,hε0,hε,hupper⟩ := hu u (le_max_left _ _)
  have hf := tendstoUniformlyOn_zero_of_upper_boundary_error F p hlh hhu hdiff hB hbound
    ε hε0 hε hupper
  refine ⟨verticalClosedStrip h u,?_,hf⟩
  apply mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds
  apply mem_of_superset ((isOpen_Ioo.preimage continuous_re).mem_nhds ⟨hhz,hzu⟩)
  intro w hw
  exact ⟨hw.1.le,hw.2.le⟩

name: Complex.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_zero_of_upper_boundary_error
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_zero_of_upper_boundary_error
    (F : ι → ℂ → E) (p : Filter ι) (C u₀ : ℝ) (hC : 0≤C)
    (hd : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F i) {z : ℂ | 0<z.im})
    (hb : ∀ i z, 0<z.im → ‖F i z‖≤C/z.im)
    (hu : ∀ u, u₀≤u → ∃ ε : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0≤ε i) ∧ Tendsto ε p (𝓝 0) ∧
        ∀ i z, z.im=u → ‖F i z‖≤ε i) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F (fun _ => 0) p {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
proof:
:= by
  let G : ι → ℂ → E := fun i w => F i (I*w)
  have hm : MapsTo (fun w : ℂ => I*w) {w | 0<w.re} {z | 0<z.im} := by
    intro w hw
    simpa only [mem_ofPred_eq,mul_im,I_re,zero_mul,I_im,one_mul,zero_add] using hw
  have hdG (i : ι) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (G i) {w : ℂ | 0<w.re} :=
    (hd i).comp (by fun_prop) hm
  have hbG (i : ι) (w : ℂ) (hw : 0<w.re) : ‖G i w‖≤C/w.re := by
    simpa only [mul_im,I_re,zero_mul,I_im,one_mul,zero_add] using hb i (I*w) (hm hw)
  have huG (u : ℝ) (hu₀ : u₀≤u) : ∃ ε : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0≤ε i) ∧ Tendsto ε p (𝓝 0) ∧
        ∀ i w, w.re=u → ‖G i w‖≤ε i := by
    obtain ⟨ε,hε0,hε,hεu⟩ := hu u hu₀
    refine ⟨ε,hε0,hε,?_⟩
    intro i w hw
    exact hεu i (I*w) (by simpa only [mul_im,I_re,zero_mul,I_im,one_mul,zero_add] using hw)
  have hg := HadamardThreeLines.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_zero_of_right_boundary_error
    G p C u₀ hC hdG hbG huG
  have hmi : MapsTo (fun z : ℂ => -I*z) {z | 0<z.im} {w | 0<w.re} := by
    intro z hz
    simpa only [mem_ofPred_eq,mul_re,neg_re,I_re,neg_zero,zero_mul,
      neg_im,I_im,neg_mul,one_mul,zero_sub,neg_neg] using hz
  have hc := hg.comp (fun z : ℂ => -I*z) hmi
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).continuousOn
  simpa only [G,Function.comp_def,← mul_assoc,mul_neg,I_mul_I,neg_neg,one_mul] using hc

name: Real.integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded
statement:
theorem integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) {B : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ t, |f t| ≤ B) :
    Integrable (fun t => hirschmanDensity r t * f t)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_hirschmanDensity hr).const_mul B).mono'
    (((continuous_hirschmanDensity hr).measurable).mul hf).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
    dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply]
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t), Real.norm_eq_abs]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound t) (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le

name: Complex.regularizedLogNorm_exp_bounds
statement:
theorem regularizedLogNorm_exp_bounds {ε H x : ℝ} (hε : ε ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hx : |x| ≤ H) :
    -H ≤ regularizedLogNorm ε ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
      regularizedLogNorm ε ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ) ≤
        Real.log (sqrt ((Real.exp H) ^ 2 + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = Real.exp x := by
    simp only [norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos x)]
  have hpos : 0 < sqrt ((Real.exp x) ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) := sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hxH := (abs_le.mp hx).2
  have he : Real.exp x ≤ Real.exp H := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hxH
  unfold regularizedLogNorm
  rw [hn]
  constructor
  · calc
      -H ≤ x := (abs_le.mp hx).1
      _ = Real.log (Real.exp x) := (Real.log_exp x).symm
      _ ≤ _ := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos x) (by
        calc
          Real.exp x = sqrt ((Real.exp x) ^ 2) := (sqrt_sq (Real.exp_pos x).le).symm
          _ ≤ _ := sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ε]))
  · apply Real.log_le_log hpos
    apply sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos x, Real.exp_pos H, hε.1, hε.2]

name: Complex.abs_regularizedLogNorm_exp_le
statement:
theorem abs_regularizedLogNorm_exp_le {ε H x : ℝ} (hε : ε ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hx : |x| ≤ H) :
    |regularizedLogNorm ε ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ)| ≤
      H + |Real.log (sqrt ((Real.exp H) ^ 2 + 1))|
proof:
:= by
  have h := regularizedLogNorm_exp_bounds hε hx
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (sqrt ((Real.exp H) ^ 2 + 1)))]
  · linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log (sqrt ((Real.exp H) ^ 2 + 1)))]

name: Complex.tendsto_regularizedLogNorm_exp
proof:
:= by
  have ht := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (Real.exp x) ^ 2)).add (hε.pow 2)).sqrt
  simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), add_zero, sqrt_sq (Real.exp_pos x).le] at ht
  have hl := (Real.continuousAt_log (Real.exp_ne_zero x)).tendsto.comp ht
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, regularizedLogNorm, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos x),
    Real.log_exp] using hl

name: Complex.tendsto_integral_hirschman_regularizedLogNorm_exp
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_hirschman_regularizedLogNorm_exp {r H : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : Measurable h)
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hbound : ∀ t, |h t| ≤ H)
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : ∀ n, ε n ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t : ℝ, hirschmanDensity r t *
      regularizedLogNorm (ε n) ((Real.exp (h t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ t : ℝ, hirschmanDensity r t * h t))
proof:
:= by
  let C := H + |Real.log (sqrt ((Real.exp H) ^ 2 + 1))|
  apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun t => C * hirschmanDensity r t)
  · intro n
    have hm := ((continuous_regularizedLogNorm (hε n).1).comp
      (continuous_ofReal.comp Real.continuous_exp)).measurable.comp hh
    exact ((continuous_hirschmanDensity hr).measurable.mul hm).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact (integrable_hirschmanDensity hr).const_mul C
  · intro n
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t), Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (abs_regularizedLogNorm_exp_le (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hε n)) hH (hbound t))
        (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun t => (tendsto_regularizedLogNorm_exp hεlim (h t)).const_mul _

name: Complex.regularizedLogNorm_le_exp_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem regularizedLogNorm_le_exp_of_norm_le {ε x : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ Real.exp x) :
    regularizedLogNorm ε z ≤ regularizedLogNorm ε ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (regularizedLogNorm_bounds hε (Real.exp_pos x).le hz).2
  simpa only [regularizedLogNorm, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos x)] using h

name: Complex.HadamardThreeLines.norm_le_mul_boundary_error_rpow
statement:
theorem norm_le_mul_boundary_error_rpow
    {f : ℂ → E} {l h u B ε : ℝ} (hlh : l<h) (hhu : h≤u)
    (hd : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (verticalStrip l u))
    (hB : 1≤B) (hbound : ∀ z∈verticalClosedStrip l u, ‖f z‖≤B)
    (hε0 : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hupper : ∀ z : ℂ, z.re=u → ‖f z‖≤ε)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈verticalClosedStrip h u) :
    ‖f z‖≤B*ε^((h-l)/(u-l))
proof:
:= by
  have hlu : l<u := hlh.trans_le hhu
  have hz' : z∈verticalClosedStrip l u := ⟨hlh.le.trans hz.1,hz.2⟩
  have hu0 : 0<u-l := sub_pos.mpr hlu
  have ht0 : 0≤(z.re-l)/(u-l) := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hz'.1) hu0.le
  have ht1 : (z.re-l)/(u-l)≤1 := (div_le_one hu0).mpr (by linarith [hz'.2])
  have hθ0 : 0≤(h-l)/(u-l) := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlh.le) hu0.le
  have hθ : (h-l)/(u-l)≤(z.re-l)/(u-l) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hz.1]) hu0.le
  have hbdd : BddAbove ((norm ∘ f) '' verticalClosedStrip l u) := by
    refine ⟨B,?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩
    exact hbound w hw
  have ha : ∀ w∈re ⁻¹' {l}, ‖f w‖≤B := by
    intro w hw
    apply hbound w
    have he : w.re=l := hw
    exact ⟨he.ge,he.trans_le hlu.le⟩
  have hb : ∀ w∈re ⁻¹' {u}, ‖f w‖≤ε := fun w hw => hupper w hw
  have hh := norm_le_interp_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip' hlu hz' hd hbdd ha hb
  apply hh.trans
  have hpowB : B^(1-(z.re-l)/(u-l))≤B := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hB (show 1-(z.re-l)/(u-l)≤1 by linarith)
  have hpowε : ε^((z.re-l)/(u-l))≤ε^((h-l)/(u-l)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hε0 hε1 hθ0 hθ
  exact mul_le_mul hpowB hpowε (Real.rpow_nonneg hε0 _) (zero_le_one.trans hB)

name: Complex.HadamardThreeLines.tendstoUniformlyOn_zero_of_upper_boundary_error
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_zero_of_upper_boundary_error
    (F : ι → ℂ → E) (p : Filter ι) {l h u B : ℝ} (hlh : l<h) (hhu : h≤u)
    (hd : ∀ i, DiffContOnCl ℂ (F i) (verticalStrip l u))
    (hB : 1≤B) (hbound : ∀ i z, z∈verticalClosedStrip l u → ‖F i z‖≤B)
    (ε : ι → ℝ) (hε0 : ∀ i, 0≤ε i) (hε : Tendsto ε p (𝓝 0))
    (hupper : ∀ i z, z.re=u → ‖F i z‖≤ε i) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn F (fun _ => 0) p (verticalClosedStrip h u)
proof:
:= by
  have hθ : 0<(h-l)/(u-l) := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlh) (sub_pos.mpr (hlh.trans_le hhu))
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun i => B*ε i^((h-l)/(u-l))) p (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using (hε.rpow_const_nhds_zero hθ).const_mul B
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ i in p, ε i≤1 := hε.eventually (eventually_le_nhds zero_lt_one)
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro δ hδ
  have hlt : ∀ᶠ i in p, B*ε i^((h-l)/(u-l))<δ :=
    hlim.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hδ)
  filter_upwards [hsmall,hlt] with i hi hilt
  intro z hz
  simpa only [dist_zero_left] using
    (norm_le_mul_boundary_error_rpow hlh hhu (hd i) hB (hbound i)
      (hε0 i) hi (hupper i) hz).trans_lt hilt

name: Complex.circleIntegral_comp_mul_deriv_eq_of_close_to_real_mul
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_comp_mul_deriv_eq_of_close_to_real_mul
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {R S r a : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z | S < ‖z‖}) (hSr : S < r)
    (hclose : ∀ u ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ‖g u - (a : ℂ) * u‖ < |a| * r - R) :
    (∮ u in C(0, r), f (g u) * deriv g u) =
      ∮ z in C(0, |a| * r), f z
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsOpen {z : ℂ | S < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hV : IsOpen {z : ℂ | R < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hc : sphere (0 : ℂ) |r| ⊆ {z : ℂ | S < ‖z‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm, abs_of_pos hr] using hz
    simpa [hz'] using hSr
  have hgc : ContinuousOn g (range (circlePath 0 r)) :=
    hg.continuousOn.mono (by
      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
      apply hc
      exact circleMap_mem_sphere' 0 r _)
  let γ₀ := (circlePath 0 r).map' hgc
  let γ₁ := circlePath 0 (a * r)
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => circleMap 0 r (2 * Real.pi * t)
  let ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    ((1 - t.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (g (z t.2) - (a : ℂ) * z t.2) + (a : ℂ) * z t.2
  have hgz : Continuous (fun t => g (z t)) := by
    exact hg.continuousOn.comp_continuous
      ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
      (fun t => hc (circleMap_mem_sphere' 0 r _))
  have hz : Continuous z :=
    (continuous_circleMap 0 r).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  have hψ : Continuous ψ := by
    exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_fst)).mul
      ((hgz.comp continuous_snd).sub (continuous_const.mul (hz.comp continuous_snd)))).add
      (continuous_const.mul (hz.comp continuous_snd))
  have hψV : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1, ψ t ∈ {z : ℂ | R < ‖z‖} := by
    intro t ht
    have hnormz : ‖z t.2‖ = r := by simp [z, abs_of_pos hr]
    have hnorma : ‖(a : ℂ) * z t.2‖ = |a| * r := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, hnormz]
    have herr := hclose (z t.2) (by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm] using hnormz)
    have htlo : 0 ≤ t.1 := ht.1.1
    have hthi : t.1 ≤ 1 := ht.2.1
    have hcoeff : ‖((1 - t.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hsmall : ‖((1 - t.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (g (z t.2) - (a : ℂ) * z t.2)‖ ≤ ‖g (z t.2) - (a : ℂ) * z t.2‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hcoeff
    have htriangle : ‖(a : ℂ) * z t.2‖ ≤ ‖ψ t‖ +
        ‖((1 - t.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (g (z t.2) - (a : ℂ) * z t.2)‖ := by
      have h := norm_sub_le (ψ t)
        (((1 - t.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (g (z t.2) - (a : ℂ) * z t.2))
      simpa only [ψ, add_sub_cancel_left] using h
    change R < ‖ψ t‖
    linarith
  have hleft : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ₀.extend t = ψ (0, t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
    change g (z t) = ψ (0, t)
    simp [ψ]
  have hright : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ₁.extend t = ψ (1, t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [circlePath_extend_apply ht]
    simp [ψ, z, circleMap, Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hloop : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ψ (t, 0) = ψ (t, 1) := by
    intro t _
    simp [ψ, z, circleMap]
  have heq := curveIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_of_freeHomotopy γ₀ γ₁ hψ
    hV hf hψV hleft hright hloop
    (contDiffOn_circlePath_map_extend hU hg hc hgc)
    (contDiffOn_circlePath_extend 0 (a * r))
  rw [curveIntegral_circlePath_map_eq_circleIntegral_mul_deriv f hU hg hc hgc,
    curveIntegral_circlePath_eq_circleIntegral] at heq
  rw [heq]
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ a
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg ha]
  · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge ha), neg_mul]
    exact (circleIntegral.integral_neg_radius_eq f 0 (a * r)).symm

name: Complex.eventually_circleIntegral_comp_mul_deriv_eq_of_tendsto_affine
statement:
theorem eventually_circleIntegral_comp_mul_deriv_eq_of_tendsto_affine
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {R S ρ a : ℝ} {q : ℂ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z | S < ‖z‖}) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun u => g u - (a : ℂ) * u)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 q)) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRρ : R < ρ) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop,
      (∮ u in C(0, r), f (g u) * deriv g u) = ∮ z in C(0, ρ), f z
proof:
:= by
  have habs : 0 < |a| := abs_pos.mpr ha
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      ‖g u - (a : ℂ) * u‖ < ‖q‖ + 1 :=
    hlim.norm.eventually_lt_const (lt_add_one _)
  obtain ⟨T, _, hT⟩ := Filter.hasBasis_cobounded_norm.eventually_iff.mp hbound
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ), eventually_gt_atTop S,
    eventually_ge_atTop T, eventually_gt_atTop ((R + ‖q‖ + 1) / |a|)]
    with r hr hSr hTr hlarge
  have hmul : R + ‖q‖ + 1 < r * |a| := (div_lt_iff₀ habs).mp hlarge
  have hclose : ∀ u ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      ‖g u - (a : ℂ) * u‖ < |a| * r - R := by
    intro u hu
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ = r := by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm] using hu
    have hsmall := hT (x := u) (by change T ≤ ‖u‖; simpa only [hnorm] using hTr)
    nlinarith
  have hRr : R < |a| * r := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg q]
  exact (circleIntegral_comp_mul_deriv_eq_of_close_to_real_mul hr hf hg hSr hclose).trans
    (NLAlib.circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior hf (mul_pos habs hr) hρ hRr hRρ)

name: Complex.eventually_circleIntegral_exp_eq_neg_circleIntegral_exp_mul_of_inverse
statement:
theorem eventually_circleIntegral_exp_eq_neg_circleIntegral_exp_mul_of_inverse
    {F g : ℂ → ℂ} {R S ρ a : ℝ} {q : ℂ}
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z | S < ‖z‖}) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun u => g u - (a : ℂ) * u)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 q))
    (hinverse : ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, F (g u) = u)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRρ : R < ρ) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop,
      (∮ z in C(0, ρ), exp (F z)) = -(∮ u in C(0, r), exp u * g u)
proof:
:= by
  have hmoment := eventually_circleIntegral_comp_mul_deriv_eq_of_tendsto_affine
    (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn hF) hg ha hlim hρ hRρ
  obtain ⟨T, _, hT⟩ := Filter.hasBasis_cobounded_norm.eventually_iff.mp hinverse
  filter_upwards [hmoment, eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ), eventually_gt_atTop S,
    eventually_ge_atTop T] with r hmoment hr hSr hTr
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hmoment
  have hpoint : EqOn (fun u => exp (F (g u)) * deriv g u)
      (fun u => exp u * deriv g u) (sphere (0 : ℂ) r) := by
    intro u hu
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ = r := by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm] using hu
    change exp (F (g u)) * deriv g u = exp u * deriv g u
    rw [hT (x := u) (by change T ≤ ‖u‖; simpa only [hnorm] using hTr)]
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr hr.le hpoint] at hmoment
  have hU : IsOpen {z : ℂ | S < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hc : sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ {z : ℂ | S < ‖z‖} := by
    intro u hu
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ = r := by simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm] using hu
    change S < ‖u‖
    simpa only [hnorm] using hSr
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_neg_integral_exp_mul hr.le hU hc hg]
    at hmoment
  exact hmoment.symm

name: NLAlib.circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R r s : ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hRr : R < r) (hRs : R < s) :
    (∮ z in C(0, r), f z) = ∮ z in C(0, s), f z
proof:
:= by
  suffices haux : ∀ {u v : ℝ}, 0 < u → R < u → u ≤ v →
      (∮ z in C(0, v), f z) = ∮ z in C(0, u), f z by
    rcases le_total r s with hrs | hsr
    · exact (haux hr hRr hrs).symm
    · exact haux hs hRs hsr
  intro u v hu hRu huv
  have hsub : closedBall (0 : ℂ) v \ ball 0 u ⊆ {z | R < ‖z‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : u ≤ ‖z‖ := by simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz.2
    exact hRu.trans_le hz'
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : ℂ | R < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  exact Complex.circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiable_on_annulus_off_countable
    hu huv (s := (∅ : Set ℂ)) countable_empty (hf.continuousOn.mono hsub)
    (fun z hz => hf.differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds (by
      have hz' : u < ‖z‖ := by
        simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] using hz.1.2
      exact hRu.trans hz')))

name: NLAlib.circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R r s : ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    (∮ z in C(0, s), z⁻¹ * f z) = ∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹ * f z
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : closedBall (0 : ℂ) s \ ball 0 r ⊆ {z | R < ‖z‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : r ≤ ‖z‖ := by simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz.2
    exact hRr.trans_le hz'
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : ℂ | R < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  simpa only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] using
    circleIntegral_sub_center_inv_smul_eq_of_differentiable_on_annulus_off_countable
      hr hrs (s := (∅ : Set ℂ)) countable_empty (hf.continuousOn.mono hsub)
      (fun z hz => hf.differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds (by
        have hz' : r < ‖z‖ := by
          simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] using hz.1.2
        exact hRr.trans hz')))

name: NLAlib.two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_zero_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_zero_of_tendsto
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R r : ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (hlim : Tendsto f (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0)) :
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹ * f z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  apply le_antisymm _ (norm_nonneg _)
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in cobounded ℂ, ‖f z‖ < ε := by
    simpa only [dist_zero_right] using (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hlim ε hε)
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := hasBasis_cobounded_norm.eventually_iff.mp hev
  let s := max r K
  have hrs : r ≤ s := le_max_left _ _
  have hKs : K ≤ s := le_max_right _ _
  have hs : 0 < s := hr.trans_le hrs
  rw [← circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_of_differentiableOn_exterior hf hr hRr hrs]
  have hb : ∀ z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) s, ‖z⁻¹ * f z‖ ≤ ε / s := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = s := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, hz']
    calc
      s⁻¹ * ‖f z‖ ≤ s⁻¹ * ε :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK (hKs.trans_eq hz'.symm)).le (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le)
      _ = ε / s := by ring
  have hbound := circleIntegral.norm_two_pi_i_inv_smul_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hs.le hb
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs.ne', zero_add] using hbound

name: NLAlib.two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_of_tendsto
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ} {R r : ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖}) (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r)
    (hlim : Tendsto f (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 a)) :
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹ * f z) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ {z | R < ‖z‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    exact hRr.trans_eq hz'.symm
  have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r) : z ≠ 0 := by
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    intro h
    exact hr.ne' (by simpa [h] using hz'.symm)
  have hci : CircleIntegrable (fun z => z⁻¹ * f z) 0 r :=
    ((continuousOn_id.inv₀ hne).mul (hf.continuousOn.mono hsub)).circleIntegrable hr.le
  have hca : CircleIntegrable (fun z : ℂ => z⁻¹ * a) 0 r :=
    ((continuousOn_id.inv₀ hne).mul continuousOn_const).circleIntegrable hr.le
  have hz := two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_zero_of_tendsto
    (hf.sub_const a) hr hRr (by simpa using hlim.sub_const a)
  have heq : (∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹ * (f z - a)) =
      (∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹ * f z) - (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ) * a := by
    simp_rw [mul_sub]
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_sub hci hca]
    congr 1
    simp_rw [mul_comm _ a]
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hk : (∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹) = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ) := by
      simpa only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] using
        circleIntegral.integral_sub_center_inv (0 : ℂ) hr.ne'
    rw [hk]
  rw [heq] at hz
  have hpi : (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  rw [mul_sub, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hpi] at hz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

name: NLAlib.two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_div_sub_eq_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_div_sub_eq_of_tendsto
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a t : ℂ} {R r : ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | R < ‖z‖}) (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r)
    (htr : ‖t‖ < r) (hlim : Tendsto f (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 a)) :
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), f z / (z - t)) = a
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (1 - t * z⁻¹)⁻¹ * f z
  have hzero (z : ℂ) (hz : max R ‖t‖ < ‖z‖) : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' := (le_max_right R ‖t‖).trans_lt hz
    simpa [h] using (norm_nonneg t).trans_lt h'
  have hsub (z : ℂ) (hz : max R ‖t‖ < ‖z‖) : z - t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' := (le_max_right R ‖t‖).trans_lt hz
    simp [sub_eq_zero.mp h] at h'
  have hden (z : ℂ) (hz : max R ‖t‖ < ‖z‖) : 1 - t * z⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hsub z hz
    have hh := congrArg (fun w : ℂ => w * z) h
    simpa only [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hzero z hz), mul_one,
      zero_mul] using hh
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z | max R ‖t‖ < ‖z‖} := by
    have hf' : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | max R ‖t‖ < ‖z‖} :=
      hf.mono (fun _ hz => (le_max_left R ‖t‖).trans_lt hz)
    intro z hz
    have hi : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w⁻¹) z :=
      differentiableAt_id.inv (hzero z hz)
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (1 - t * w⁻¹)⁻¹) z :=
      ((hi.const_mul t).const_sub 1).inv (hden z hz)
    exact hd.differentiableWithinAt.mul (hf' z hz)
  have hg_lim : Tendsto g (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 a) := by
    have hinv : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => (1 - t * z⁻¹)⁻¹) (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 1) := by
      have hh : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => 1 - t * z⁻¹) (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (1 : ℂ)) := by
        simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℂ))).sub
          (tendsto_inv₀_cobounded.const_mul t)
      simpa using hh.inv₀ one_ne_zero
    simpa [g] using hinv.mul hlim
  have hg_eq : (∮ z in C(0, r), z⁻¹ * g z) =
      ∮ z in C(0, r), f z / (z - t) := by
    apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hr.le
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ = r := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    have hzext : max R ‖t‖ < ‖z‖ := by rw [hz']; exact max_lt hRr htr
    dsimp [g]
    field_simp [hzero z hzext, hsub z hzext, hden z hzext]
  rw [← hg_eq]
  exact two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_inv_mul_eq_of_tendsto hg hr
    (max_lt hRr htr) hg_lim

name: circleIntegral.continuousOn_extendFromSphere
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_extendFromSphere {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (f : C(sphere c r, ℂ)) : ContinuousOn (extendFromSphere f) (sphere c r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  convert f.continuous using 1
  ext z
  change extendFromSphere f z = f z
  simp only [extendFromSphere, dif_pos z.property]

name: circleIntegral.continuousMapIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem continuousMapIntegral_eq {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (f : C(sphere c r, ℂ)) (g : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ z (hz : z ∈ sphere c r), f ⟨z, hz⟩ = g z) :
    continuousMapIntegral c r hr f = ∮ z in C(c, r), g z
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_congr hr
  intro z hz
  simpa only [extendFromSphere, dif_pos hz] using hg z hz

name: circleIntegral.inverse_apply
statement:
private theorem inverse_apply {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : C(X, ℂ)) (hf : IsUnit f) (x : X) :
    (Ring.inverse f) x = (f x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := congrArg (fun g : C(X, ℂ) => g x) (Ring.mul_inverse_cancel f hf)
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul

name: circleIntegral.analyticAt_integral_div
statement:
theorem analyticAt_integral_div {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    {F G : ℂ → C(sphere c r, ℂ)} {u : ℂ}
    (hF : AnalyticAt ℂ F u) (hG : AnalyticAt ℂ G u)
    (hzero : ∀ z, F u z ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun v => ∮ z in C(c, r),
      if hz : z ∈ sphere c r then G v ⟨z, hz⟩ / F v ⟨z, hz⟩ else 0) u
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (F u) := (F u).isUnit_iff_forall_ne_zero.mpr hzero
  have hinv : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun v => Ring.inverse (F v)) u := by
    have hi := analyticAt_inverse (𝕜 := ℂ) hunit.unit
    rw [hunit.unit_spec] at hi
    exact hi.comp hF
  have ha : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun v => continuousMapIntegral c r hr (G v * Ring.inverse (F v))) u :=
    ((continuousMapIntegral c r hr).analyticAt
      (G u * Ring.inverse (F u))).comp
        (f := fun v => G v * Ring.inverse (F v)) (hG.mul hinv)
  apply ha.congr
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 u, IsUnit (F v) :=
    hF.continuousAt.eventually (Units.isOpen.mem_nhds hunit)
  filter_upwards [hevent] with v hv
  apply continuousMapIntegral_eq hr
  intro z hz
  simp only [dif_pos hz, ContinuousMap.mul_apply, inverse_apply (F v) hv, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Complex.PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport_eq
statement:
theorem transport_eq {g : ℂ → ℂ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : Continuous γ)
    (D E : PrimitivePathSubdivision g γ) : D.transport = E.transport
proof:
:=
  primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_eq hγ D.size_pos E.size_pos
    D.isOpen_chart E.isOpen_chart D.hasDerivAt_primitive E.hasDerivAt_primitive
    D.mapsTo_chart E.mapsTo_chart

name: Complex.PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport_eq_curveIntegral
statement:
theorem transport_eq_curveIntegral {a b : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} (γ : Path a b)
    (D : PrimitivePathSubdivision g γ.extend) (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend I) :
    D.transport = curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : 0 < (D.size : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast D.size_pos
  apply primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_curveIntegral_of_hasDerivAt γ hγ
    (fun i _ => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ i) hsize.le)
    (by simp) (by simp [D.size_pos.ne'])
    (fun i hi => ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg i) hsize.le,
      (div_le_one hsize).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hi)⟩)
    D.hasDerivAt_primitive D.continuousOn
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using D.mapsTo_chart)

name: Complex.nonempty_primitivePathSubdivision_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem nonempty_primitivePathSubdivision_of_differentiableOn
    {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) {Ω : Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω) (hγΩ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ Ω) :
    Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g γ.extend)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, U, G, h⟩ := exists_primitive_subdivision_of_differentiableOn γ hΩ hg hγΩ
  exact ⟨⟨n, hn, U, G, fun i hi => (h i hi).1,
    fun i hi => (h i hi).2.1, fun i hi => (h i hi).2.2.1,
    fun i hi => (h i hi).2.2.2⟩⟩

name: Complex.primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport
statement:
theorem primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport {a b : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} (γ : Path a b)
    (h : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g γ.extend))
    (D : PrimitivePathSubdivision g γ.extend) : primitivePathIntegral g γ h = D.transport
proof:
:=
  PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport_eq γ.continuous_extend (Classical.choice h) D

name: Complex.primitivePathIntegral_eq_curveIntegral
statement:
theorem primitivePathIntegral_eq_curveIntegral {a b : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} (γ : Path a b)
    (h : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g γ.extend))
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend I) :
    primitivePathIntegral g γ h = curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
proof:
:=
  PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport_eq_curveIntegral γ (Classical.choice h) hγ

name: Complex.primitivePathIntegral_refl
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport (Path.refl a) h (Classical.choice h)]
  unfold PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport primitiveSubdivisionTransport
  simp [Path.refl_extend]

name: Complex.norm_le_norm_add_mul_I
statement:
private theorem norm_le_norm_add_mul_I {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 ≤ z.im) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z + (t : ℂ) * I‖
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_sq_le_sq _ (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [← normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [normSq_apply, add_re, add_im, mul_re, mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im,
    I_re, I_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
  nlinarith

name: Complex.im_pos_of_slope_pos
statement:
private theorem im_pos_of_slope_pos {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R d : ℝ} {c z : ℂ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f {u | R < ‖u‖})
    (hreal : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → (f u).im ≠ 0)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun u => f u - (d : ℂ) * u) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 c))
    (hd : 0 < d) (hzR : R < ‖z‖) (hzim : 0 < z.im) : 0 < (f z).im
proof:
:= by
  let ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => z + (t : ℂ) * I
  have hnorm : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), R < ‖ray t‖ := fun t ht =>
    hzR.trans_le (norm_le_norm_add_mul_I hzim.le ht)
  have him : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), 0 < (ray t).im := by
    intro t ht
    simpa [ray] using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hzim ht
  have hray : Continuous ray := by fun_prop
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun t => (f (ray t)).im) (Ici (0 : ℝ)) :=
    continuous_im.continuousOn.comp
      (hcont.comp hray.continuousOn hnorm) (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z.im + t) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_left atTop z.im tendsto_id
  have hnormTop : Tendsto (fun t => ‖ray t‖) atTop atTop := by
    apply tendsto_atTop_mono _ ht
    intro t
    simpa [ray] using im_le_norm (ray t)
  have hcb : Tendsto ray atTop (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) :=
    tendsto_norm_atTop_iff_cobounded.mp hnormTop
  have herror : Tendsto (fun t => (f (ray t) - (d : ℂ) * ray t).im)
      atTop (𝓝 c.im) := continuous_im.tendsto c |>.comp (hlim.comp hcb)
  have hlinear : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => d * (z.im + t)) atTop atTop :=
    ht.const_mul_atTop hd
  have hgTop : Tendsto (fun t => (f (ray t)).im) atTop atTop := by
    convert herror.add_atTop hlinear using 1
    ext t
    simp [ray]
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hgT⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)).and
    (hgTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0)).exists
  by_contra hnot
  have hzle : (f (ray 0)).im ≤ 0 := by simpa [ray] using le_of_not_gt hnot
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hzero⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hT
    (hg.mono (fun _ ht => ht.1)) ⟨hzle, hgT.le⟩
  exact hreal (ray t) (hnorm t ht.1) (him t ht.1) hzero

name: Complex.im_pos_iff_slope_pos_of_tendsto_affine
statement:
theorem im_pos_iff_slope_pos_of_tendsto_affine {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R d : ℝ} {c z : ℂ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f {u | R < ‖u‖})
    (hreal : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → (f u).im ≠ 0)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun u => f u - (d : ℂ) * u) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 c))
    (hd : d ≠ 0) (hzR : R < ‖z‖) (hzim : 0 < z.im) :
    0 < (f z).im ↔ 0 < d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    by_contra hdnot
    have hdneg : d < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hdnot) hd
    have hnegreal : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im → (-f u).im ≠ 0 := by
      intro u hu him
      simpa using hreal u hu him
    have hneglim : Tendsto (fun u => -f u - ((-d : ℝ) : ℂ) * u)
        (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (-c)) := by
      convert hlim.neg using 1
      ext u
      push_cast
      ring
    have hneg := im_pos_of_slope_pos hcont.neg hnegreal hneglim
      (neg_pos.mpr hdneg) hzR hzim
    simpa using (not_lt_of_ge hf.le) (neg_pos.mp hneg)
  · exact fun hdpos => im_pos_of_slope_pos hcont hreal hlim hdpos hzR hzim

name: Complex.cayleyQuotient_re
statement:
theorem cayleyQuotient_re (z : ℂ) :
    ((1 + z) / (1 - z)).re = (1 - normSq z) / normSq (1 - z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_re]
  simp only [add_re, sub_re, one_re, add_im, sub_im, one_im, zero_add, zero_sub, normSq_apply]
  ring

name: Complex.hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im
statement:
theorem hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im (a b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane a b z).im = b * (1 - normSq z) / normSq (1 - z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane, add_im, ofReal_im, zero_add, mul_im, mul_re,
    ofReal_re, I_im, I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
  rw [cayleyQuotient_re]
  ring

name: Complex.hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im_pos
statement:
theorem hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im_pos (a : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :
    0 < (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane a b z).im
proof:
:= by
  have hzn : ‖z‖ < 1 := by simpa using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by intro h; subst z; simp at hzn
  have hden : 0 < normSq (1 - z) := normSq_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz1.symm)
  have hnum : 0 < 1 - normSq z := by
    rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  rw [hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im]
  exact div_pos (mul_pos hb hnum) hden

name: Complex.hirschmanDiskToStrip_re
statement:
theorem hirschmanDiskToStrip_re (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z).re =
      arg (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (Real.cos (π * r)) (Real.sin (π * r)) z) / π
proof:
:= by
  simp [hirschmanDiskToStrip, div_ofReal_re, mul_re, log_im]

name: Complex.hirschmanDiskToStrip_re_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem hirschmanDiskToStrip_re_mem_Ioo {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) : (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z).re ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sin (π * r) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
    (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have him := hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im_pos (Real.cos (π * r)) hs hz
  rw [hirschmanDiskToStrip_re]
  constructor
  · apply div_pos _ pi_pos
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (arg_nonneg_iff.mpr him.le) (by
      intro h
      exact him.ne' (arg_eq_zero_iff.mp h.symm).2)
  · apply (div_lt_one pi_pos).2
    exact arg_lt_pi_iff.mpr (Or.inr (ne_of_gt him))

name: Complex.hirschmanDiskToStrip_zero
statement:
theorem hirschmanDiskToStrip_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    hirschmanDiskToStrip r 0 = (r : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcenter : hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (Real.cos (π * r)) (Real.sin (π * r)) 0 =
      exp (((π * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) := by
    simp [hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane, exp_mul_I]
  unfold hirschmanDiskToStrip
  rw [hcenter, log_exp (by simp; nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.1]) (by simp; nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])]
  simp only [ofReal_mul]
  field_simp
  simp [I_sq]

name: Complex.differentiableAt_hirschmanDiskToStrip
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_hirschmanDiskToStrip {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (hirschmanDiskToStrip r) z
proof:
:= by
  have hzn : ‖z‖ < 1 := by simpa using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by intro h; subst z; simp at hzn
  have hs : 0 < Real.sin (π * r) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
    (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have him := hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im_pos (Real.cos (π * r)) hs hz
  have hM : DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (Real.cos (π * r)) (Real.sin (π * r))) z := by
    unfold hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane
    fun_prop (disch := exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hz1.symm)
  exact (((differentiableAt_log (Or.inr (ne_of_gt him))).comp z hM).mul_const (-I)).div_const _

name: Complex.analyticOnNhd_hirschmanDiskToStrip
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_hirschmanDiskToStrip {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (hirschmanDiskToStrip r) (ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_ball).2
  exact fun z hz => (differentiableAt_hirschmanDiskToStrip hr hz).differentiableWithinAt

name: Complex.primitivePathIntegral_boundary_eq_zero_of_grid
statement:
theorem primitivePathIntegral_boundary_eq_zero_of_grid
    {a b c d : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (L : Path a b) (R : Path c d) (B : Path a c) (T : Path b d)
    (hL : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g L.extend))
    (hR : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g R.extend))
    (hB : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g B.extend))
    (hT : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g T.extend))
    {ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) (D : PrimitiveHomotopyGrid g ψ)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, L.extend t = ψ (0, t))
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, R.extend t = ψ (1, t))
    (hbottom : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, B.extend t = ψ (t, 0))
    (htop : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, T.extend t = ψ (t, 1)) :
    primitivePathIntegral g R hR - primitivePathIntegral g L hL -
      primitivePathIntegral g T hT + primitivePathIntegral g B hB = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < (D.size : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast D.size_pos
  have hlast : D.size - 1 < D.size := Nat.sub_lt D.size_pos (by decide)
  have hend : ((D.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = D.size := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt D.size_pos)
  have hlastnode : (((D.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / D.size = 1 := by
    rw [hend, div_self hn.ne']
  have hnode (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ D.size) : (i : ℝ) / D.size ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg i) hn.le, (div_le_one hn).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hi)⟩
  have hcell (i : ℕ) (hi : i < D.size) {t : ℝ}
      (ht : t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / D.size) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size)) : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hnext : (i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hnode (i + 1) hi
    exact ⟨(hnode i hi.le).1.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hnext.2⟩
  let DL : PrimitivePathSubdivision g L.extend :=
    ⟨D.size, D.size_pos, D.chart 0, D.primitive 0,
      fun j hj => D.isOpen_chart 0 D.size_pos j hj,
      fun j hj => D.hasDerivAt_primitive 0 D.size_pos j hj,
      fun j hj => D.continuousOn 0 D.size_pos j hj,
      fun j hj t ht => by
        rw [hleft t (hcell j hj ht)]
        apply D.mapsTo_chart 0 D.size_pos j hj
        exact ⟨⟨by simp, ht.1⟩, ⟨by positivity, ht.2⟩⟩⟩
  let DR : PrimitivePathSubdivision g R.extend :=
    ⟨D.size, D.size_pos, D.chart (D.size - 1), D.primitive (D.size - 1),
      fun j hj => D.isOpen_chart _ hlast j hj,
      fun j hj => D.hasDerivAt_primitive _ hlast j hj,
      fun j hj => D.continuousOn _ hlast j hj,
      fun j hj t ht => by
        rw [hright t (hcell j hj ht)]
        apply D.mapsTo_chart _ hlast j hj
        exact ⟨⟨(hnode _ hlast.le).2, ht.1⟩, ⟨hlastnode.symm.le, ht.2⟩⟩⟩
  let DB : PrimitivePathSubdivision g B.extend :=
    ⟨D.size, D.size_pos, fun i => D.chart i 0, fun i => D.primitive i 0,
      fun i hi => D.isOpen_chart i hi 0 D.size_pos,
      fun i hi => D.hasDerivAt_primitive i hi 0 D.size_pos,
      fun i hi => D.continuousOn i hi 0 D.size_pos,
      fun i hi t ht => by
        rw [hbottom t (hcell i hi ht)]
        apply D.mapsTo_chart i hi 0 D.size_pos
        exact ⟨⟨ht.1, by simp⟩, ⟨ht.2, by positivity⟩⟩⟩
  let DT : PrimitivePathSubdivision g T.extend :=
    ⟨D.size, D.size_pos, fun i => D.chart i (D.size - 1), fun i => D.primitive i (D.size - 1),
      fun i hi => D.isOpen_chart i hi _ hlast,
      fun i hi => D.hasDerivAt_primitive i hi _ hlast,
      fun i hi => D.continuousOn i hi _ hlast,
      fun i hi t ht => by
        rw [htop t (hcell i hi ht)]
        apply D.mapsTo_chart i hi _ hlast
        exact ⟨⟨ht.1, (hnode _ hlast.le).2⟩, ⟨ht.2, hlastnode.symm.le⟩⟩⟩
  have hLi : primitivePathIntegral g L hL = ∑ j ∈ range D.size, D.left 0 j := by
    rw [primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport L hL DL]
    unfold PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport primitiveSubdivisionTransport
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj' := mem_range.mp hj
    rw [hleft _ (hnode (j + 1) hj'), hleft _ (hnode j hj'.le)]
    simp only [DL, PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.left, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hRi : primitivePathIntegral g R hR = ∑ j ∈ range D.size, D.right (D.size - 1) j := by
    rw [primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport R hR DR]
    unfold PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport primitiveSubdivisionTransport
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj' := mem_range.mp hj
    rw [hright _ (hnode (j + 1) hj'), hright _ (hnode j hj'.le)]
    simp only [DR, PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.right, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hlastnode]
  have hBi : primitivePathIntegral g B hB = ∑ i ∈ range D.size, D.bottom i 0 := by
    rw [primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport B hB DB]
    unfold PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport primitiveSubdivisionTransport
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' := mem_range.mp hi
    rw [hbottom _ (hnode (i + 1) hi'), hbottom _ (hnode i hi'.le)]
    simp only [DB, PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.bottom, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hTi : primitivePathIntegral g T hT = ∑ i ∈ range D.size, D.top i (D.size - 1) := by
    rw [primitivePathIntegral_eq_transport T hT DT]
    unfold PrimitivePathSubdivision.transport primitiveSubdivisionTransport
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' := mem_range.mp hi
    rw [htop _ (hnode (i + 1) hi'), htop _ (hnode i hi'.le)]
    simp only [DT, PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.top, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hlastnode]
  rw [hRi, hLi, hTi, hBi, D.sum_right_sub_sum_left_eq_sum_top_sub_sum_bottom hψ]
  abel

name: Complex.freeHomotopy_node_mem_Icc
statement:
private theorem freeHomotopy_node_mem_Icc {n i : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    (i : ℝ) / n ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  exact ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg i) hn'.le,
    (div_le_one hn').mpr (by exact_mod_cast hi)⟩

name: Complex.curveIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_of_freeHomotopy
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_of_freeHomotopy
    {a b : ℂ} (γ₀ : Path a a) (γ₁ : Path b b)
    {ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) {Ω : Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω)
    (hψΩ : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1, ψ t ∈ Ω)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ₀.extend t = ψ (0, t))
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ₁.extend t = ψ (1, t))
    (hloop : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ψ (t, 0) = ψ (t, 1))
    (hγ₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ₀.extend I) (hγ₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ₁.extend I) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ₀ =
      curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ₁
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := Classical.choice (nonempty_primitiveHomotopyGrid_of_differentiableOn
    hψ hΩ hg hψΩ)
  have hn : 0 < (D.size : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast D.size_pos
  have hlast : D.size - 1 < D.size := Nat.sub_lt D.size_pos (by decide)
  have hlastadd : D.size - 1 + 1 = D.size := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt D.size_pos)
  have hend : ((D.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = D.size := by exact_mod_cast hlastadd
  have hlastnode : (((D.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / D.size = 1 := by
    rw [hend, div_self hn.ne']
  have hnode (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ D.size) : (i : ℝ) / D.size ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    freeHomotopy_node_mem_Icc D.size_pos hi
  have hcellI (i : ℕ) (hi : i < D.size) {t : ℝ}
      (ht : t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / D.size) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size)) : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hnext : (i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hnode (i + 1) hi
    exact ⟨(hnode i hi.le).1.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hnext.2⟩
  have hp (i : ℕ) (_hi : i < D.size) :
      (i : ℝ) / D.size ≤ ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / D.size := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hn.le
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ i
  have hleftChart : ∀ j < D.size,
      ∀ t ∈ Icc ((j : ℝ) / D.size) (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / D.size),
        γ₀.extend t ∈ D.chart 0 j := by
    intro j hj t ht
    have ht' : t ∈ Icc ((j : ℝ) / D.size) ((j + 1 : ℝ) / D.size) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ht
    rw [hleft t (hcellI j hj ht')]
    apply D.mapsTo_chart 0 D.size_pos j hj
    exact ⟨⟨by simp, ht'.1⟩, ⟨by positivity, ht'.2⟩⟩
  have hrightChart : ∀ j < D.size,
      ∀ t ∈ Icc ((j : ℝ) / D.size) (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / D.size),
        γ₁.extend t ∈ D.chart (D.size - 1) j := by
    intro j hj t ht
    have ht' : t ∈ Icc ((j : ℝ) / D.size) ((j + 1 : ℝ) / D.size) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ht
    rw [hright t (hcellI j hj ht')]
    apply D.mapsTo_chart _ hlast j hj
    exact ⟨⟨(hnode _ hlast.le).2, ht'.1⟩, ⟨hlastnode.symm.le, ht'.2⟩⟩
  have hL := primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_curveIntegral_of_hasDerivAt γ₀ hγ₀
    hp (by simp) (by simp [D.size_pos.ne']) hnode
    (fun j hj => D.hasDerivAt_primitive 0 D.size_pos j hj)
    (fun j hj => D.continuousOn 0 D.size_pos j hj) hleftChart
  have hR := primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_curveIntegral_of_hasDerivAt γ₁ hγ₁
    hp (by simp) (by simp [D.size_pos.ne']) hnode
    (fun j hj => D.hasDerivAt_primitive _ hlast j hj)
    (fun j hj => D.continuousOn _ hlast j hj) hrightChart
  have hsumL : (∑ j ∈ range D.size, D.left 0 j) =
      curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ₀ := by
    rw [← hL]
    unfold primitiveSubdivisionTransport
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj' := mem_range.mp hj
    have hnext := hnode (j + 1) hj'
    simp only [PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.left, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
    rw [hleft _ hnext, hleft _ (hnode j hj'.le)]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hsumR : (∑ j ∈ range D.size, D.right (D.size - 1) j) =
      curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ₁ := by
    rw [← hR]
    unfold primitiveSubdivisionTransport
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj' := mem_range.mp hj
    have hnext := hnode (j + 1) hj'
    simp only [PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.right, hlastnode]
    rw [hright _ hnext, hright _ (hnode j hj'.le)]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have htopBottom (i : ℕ) (hi : i < D.size) :
      D.top i (D.size - 1) = D.bottom i 0 := by
    have h := sub_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_continuous
      (γ := fun t => ψ (t, 0)) (hψ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))
      (hp i hi) (D.isOpen_chart i hi _ hlast) (D.isOpen_chart i hi 0 D.size_pos)
      (D.hasDerivAt_primitive i hi _ hlast) (D.hasDerivAt_primitive i hi 0 D.size_pos)
      (fun t ht => by
        have ht' : t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / D.size) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size) := by
          simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ht
        rw [hloop t (hcellI i hi ht')]
        apply D.mapsTo_chart i hi _ hlast
        exact ⟨⟨ht'.1, (hnode _ hlast.le).2⟩, ⟨ht'.2, hlastnode.symm.le⟩⟩)
      (fun t ht => by
        apply D.mapsTo_chart i hi 0 D.size_pos
        exact ⟨⟨ht.1, by simp⟩, ⟨by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ht.2,
          by positivity⟩⟩)
    have hnext := hnode (i + 1) hi
    have hcur := hnode i hi.le
    have hnext' : (i + 1 : ℝ) / D.size ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hnext
    simpa only [PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.top, PrimitiveHomotopyGrid.bottom,
      Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, hlastnode, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
      ← hloop _ hnext', ← hloop _ hcur] using h
  have hboundary := D.sum_right_sub_sum_left_eq_sum_top_sub_sum_bottom hψ
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ range D.size, D.top i (D.size - 1)) =
      ∑ i ∈ range D.size, D.bottom i 0 := by
    exact sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => htopBottom i (mem_range.mp hi))
  rw [hsum, sub_self, hsumL, hsumR] at hboundary
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hboundary).symm

name: MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_zero_eq_exp_neg_pi
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_zero_eq_exp_neg_pi (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ w in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g w) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, (π * exp (-(π * t))) * g (exp (-(π * t)))
proof:
:= by
  have hRange : (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(π * t))) '' Set.univ = Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, _, rfl⟩
      exact exp_pos _
    · intro hw
      refine ⟨-(Real.log w) / π, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      change exp (-(π * (-(Real.log w) / π))) = w
      rw [show -(π * (-(Real.log w) / π)) = Real.log w by field_simp]
      exact exp_log hw
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(π * t)))
      (-(π * exp (-(π * t)))) t := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul π).neg.exp
    change HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(π * t))) (exp (-(π * t)) * -(π * 1)) t at h
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hchange := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul (s := Set.univ) MeasurableSet.univ
    (fun t _ => (hderiv t).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (show Set.InjOn (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(π * t))) Set.univ from fun t _ s _ h => by
      have he := exp_injective h
      nlinarith [pi_pos]) g
  rw [hRange, Measure.restrict_univ] at hchange
  simpa only [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (mul_pos pi_pos (exp_pos _)), smul_eq_mul] using hchange

name: MeasureTheory.integral_Iio_zero_eq_neg_exp_neg_pi
statement:
theorem integral_Iio_zero_eq_neg_exp_neg_pi (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ w in Iio (0 : ℝ), g w) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, (π * exp (-(π * t))) * g (-exp (-(π * t)))
proof:
:= by
  have hRange : (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-(π * t))) '' Set.univ = Iio (0 : ℝ) := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, _, rfl⟩
      exact neg_neg_of_pos (exp_pos _)
    · intro hw
      refine ⟨-(Real.log (-w)) / π, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      change -exp (-(π * (-(Real.log (-w)) / π))) = w
      rw [show -(π * (-(Real.log (-w)) / π)) = Real.log (-w) by field_simp,
        exp_log (neg_pos.mpr hw), neg_neg]
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-(π * t)))
      (π * exp (-(π * t))) t := by
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul π).neg.exp).neg
    change HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-(π * t))) (-(exp (-(π * t)) * -(π * 1))) t at h
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hchange := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul (s := Set.univ) MeasurableSet.univ
    (fun t _ => (hderiv t).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (show Set.InjOn (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-(π * t))) Set.univ from fun t _ s _ h => by
      have he := exp_injective (neg_injective h)
      nlinarith [pi_pos]) g
  rw [hRange, Measure.restrict_univ] at hchange
  simpa only [abs_of_pos (mul_pos pi_pos (exp_pos _)), smul_eq_mul] using hchange

name: Complex.hirschmanLog_positive_exp
statement:
theorem hirschmanLog_positive_exp (t : ℝ) :
    log ((Real.exp (-(π * t)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ) = (t : ℂ) * I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_log (Real.exp_pos _).le, Real.log_exp]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Complex.hirschmanLog_negative_exp
statement:
theorem hirschmanLog_negative_exp (t : ℝ) :
    log ((-Real.exp (-(π * t)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ) = 1 + (t : ℂ) * I
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : -Real.exp (-(π * t)) < 0 := neg_neg_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
  rw [Complex.log, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_neg hneg, neg_neg,
    Real.log_exp, arg_ofReal_of_neg hneg]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring_nf
  simp [I_sq]
  ring

name: Real.cauchyPDFReal_exp_neg_pi_mul_eq_hirschman_left
statement:
theorem cauchyPDFReal_exp_neg_pi_mul_eq_hirschman_left {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (π * exp (-(π * t))) * ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal (cos (π * r))
      (Real.toNNReal (sin (π * r))) (exp (-(π * t))) =
      (1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (π * r) := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
    (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  rw [one_sub_mul_hirschmanDensity_one_sub hr]
  unfold ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal
  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hs.le]
  have hden : (exp (-(π * t)) - cos (π * r)) ^ 2 + sin (π * r) ^ 2 =
      2 * exp (-(π * t)) * (cosh (π * t) - cos (π * r)) := by
    rw [cosh_eq, exp_neg]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq (π * r)]
  rw [hden, mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_rev]
  field_simp

name: Real.cauchyPDFReal_neg_exp_neg_pi_mul_eq_hirschman_right
statement:
theorem cauchyPDFReal_neg_exp_neg_pi_mul_eq_hirschman_right {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (π * exp (-(π * t))) * ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal (cos (π * r))
      (Real.toNNReal (sin (π * r))) (-exp (-(π * t))) = r * hirschmanDensity r t
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (π * r) := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
    (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  rw [mul_hirschmanDensity (ne_of_gt hr.1)]
  unfold ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal
  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hs.le]
  have hden : (-exp (-(π * t)) - cos (π * r)) ^ 2 + sin (π * r) ^ 2 =
      2 * exp (-(π * t)) * (cosh (π * t) + cos (π * r)) := by
    rw [cosh_eq, exp_neg]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq (π * r)]
  rw [hden, mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_rev]
  field_simp

name: Complex.integral_cauchy_hirschmanLog_eq_boundary_integrals
statement:
theorem integral_cauchy_hirschmanLog_eq_boundary_integrals {r : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (G : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hG : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal (Real.cos (π * r))
      (Real.toNNReal (Real.sin (π * r))) w * G (log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ)))) :
    (∫ w : ℝ, ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal (Real.cos (π * r))
      (Real.toNNReal (Real.sin (π * r))) w * G (log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ))) =
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) * G ((t : ℂ) * I)) +
      ∫ t : ℝ, (r * hirschmanDensity r t) * G (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic hG, compl_Iic, integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio,
    integral_Iio_zero_eq_neg_exp_neg_pi, integral_Ioi_zero_eq_exp_neg_pi, add_comm]
  congr 1
  · apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      dsimp only
      rw [hirschmanLog_positive_exp, ← mul_assoc,
        cauchyPDFReal_exp_neg_pi_mul_eq_hirschman_left hr]
  · apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      dsimp only
      rw [hirschmanLog_negative_exp, ← mul_assoc,
        cauchyPDFReal_neg_exp_neg_pi_mul_eq_hirschman_right hr]

name: Complex.circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToStrip_eq_boundary_integrals
statement:
theorem circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToStrip_eq_boundary_integrals {r : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (G : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hG : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal (Real.cos (π * r))
      (Real.toNNReal (Real.sin (π * r))) w * G (log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ)))) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => G (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z)) 0 1 =
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) * G ((t : ℂ) * I)) +
      ∫ t : ℝ, (r * hirschmanDensity r t) * G (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sin (π * r) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
    (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have hscale : (⟨Real.sin (π * r), hs.le⟩ : NNReal) = Real.toNNReal (Real.sin (π * r)) := by
    ext
    exact (Real.coe_toNNReal _ hs.le).symm
  have h := circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_eq_cauchy (Real.cos (π * r)) hs
    (fun w => G (log w * (-I) / (π : ℂ)))
  rw [hscale] at h
  exact h.trans (integral_cauchy_hirschmanLog_eq_boundary_integrals hr G hG)

name: Complex.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
    {C Ω : Set ℂ} (hC : IsCompact C) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill C ⊆ Ω)
    (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I) :
    ∃ Φ : OneChain Ω,
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Ω, ℂ)) Φ =
        mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ ∧ IsNullHomologous Φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbuffer⟩ :=
    exists_cthickening_boundedComplementFill_subset_open hC hΩ hfill
  let h : ℝ := δ / 32
  have hh : 0 < h := div_pos hδ (by norm_num)
  have hmesh : 9 * h ≤ δ := by dsimp [h]; linarith
  obtain ⟨N, c, Δ, he, hn, hcycle⟩ := exists_uniform_grid_cycle_approximation hC hh Γ hc
  have hcells := rectangularGrid_cell_mem_of_comparison Γ hc hΓ hh hmesh hbuffer
    N c hcycle Δ hn he
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ, hnΨ⟩ := Grid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeChain
    (vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h)) c.1 c.2 hcycle Ω hcells
  have hnear : thickening (8 * h) C ⊆ Ω := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := mem_thickening_iff.mp hz
    apply hbuffer
    exact mem_cthickening_of_dist_le z w δ (boundedComplementFill C)
      (subset_boundedComplementFill C hw) (hd.le.trans (by linarith))
  let incl : C(thickening (8 * h) C, Ω) := ContinuousMap.inclusion hnear
  refine ⟨mapOne incl Δ + Ψ, ?_, (hn.map incl).add hnΨ⟩
  have hj : (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Ω, ℂ)).comp incl =
      (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) := by ext z; rfl
  rw [map_add, mapOne_mapOne, hj, he, hΨ]
  exact sub_add_cancel _ _

name: Complex.isNullHomologous_of_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_subset
statement:
theorem isNullHomologous_of_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_subset
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (Γ : OneChain Ω) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hfill : boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace Γ) ⊆ Ω) : IsNullHomologous Γ
proof:
:= by
  let C := cubicalTrace Γ
  let jΩ : C(Ω, ℂ) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hs : ∀ γ ∈ (mapOne jΩ Γ).support, ∀ t, γ t ∈ C :=
    mapOne_mem_supported jΩ Γ _ (fun γ hγ t => mem_cubicalTrace hγ t)
  obtain ⟨ΓC, hΓC⟩ := exists_mapOne_subtype_val_eq (mapOne jΩ Γ) C hs
  have hCΩ : C ⊆ Ω := cubicalTrace_subset Γ
  let incl : C(C, Ω) := ContinuousMap.inclusion hCΩ
  have he : mapOne incl ΓC = Γ := by
    apply mapOne_injective jΩ Subtype.val_injective
    rw [mapOne_mapOne]
    exact hΓC
  have hcC : boundaryOne ΓC = 0 := by
    apply mapZero_injective incl (by intro a b hab; exact Subtype.ext (congrArg
      (fun z : Ω => (z : ℂ)) hab))
    rw [← boundaryOne_mapOne, he, hc, map_zero]
  have hregC : ∀ γ ∈ ΓC.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I := by
    intro γ hγ
    have hmem := (mem_support_mapOne_comp_iff incl
      (by intro a b hab; exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : Ω => (z : ℂ)) hab)) ΓC γ).mpr hγ
    rw [he] at hmem
    exact hΓ _ hmem
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, hnΦ⟩ := exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_of_boundedComplementFill_subset
    (isCompact_cubicalTrace Γ) hΩ hfill ΓC hcC hregC
  have heΦ : Φ = Γ := mapOne_injective jΩ Subtype.val_injective (hΦ.trans hΓC)
  exact heΦ ▸ hnΦ

name: Complex.uniformSubdivision_refinement_cell_subset
statement:
private theorem uniformSubdivision_refinement_cell_subset
    {n m i j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m) (hj : j < m) :
    Icc (((i * m + j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ))
      (((i * m + j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ)) ⊆
      Icc ((i : ℝ) / n) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / n)
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnm' : 0 < ((n * m : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos hn hm
  have hleft : (i : ℝ) / n ≤ ((i * m + j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hn' hnm']
    push_cast
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j) hn'.le]
  have hright : ((i * m + j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ) ≤ (i + 1 : ℝ) / n := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hnm' hn']
    push_cast
    have hj' : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj' hn'.le]
  exact fun _ ht => ⟨hleft.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hright⟩

name: Complex.mul_add_lt_mul
statement:
private theorem mul_add_lt_mul {n m i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j < m) :
    i * m + j < n * m
proof:
:= by
  calc
    i * m + j < i * m + m := Nat.add_lt_add_left hj _
    _ = (i + 1) * m := by ring
    _ ≤ n * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)

name: Complex.primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_refinement
statement:
theorem primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_refinement
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : Continuous γ) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    {G H : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {U V : ℕ → Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hU : ∀ i < n, IsOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ k < n * m, IsOpen (V k))
    (hG : ∀ i < n, ∀ z ∈ U i, HasDerivAt (G i) (g z) z)
    (hH : ∀ k < n * m, ∀ z ∈ V k, HasDerivAt (H k) (g z) z)
    (hγU : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / n) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / n), γ t ∈ U i)
    (hγV : ∀ k < n * m, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ))
      ((k + 1 : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ)), γ t ∈ V k) :
    primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ (fun i => (i : ℝ) / n) G n =
      primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ (fun k => (k : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ)) H (n * m)
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  have hnm : 0 < ((n * m : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos hn hm
  have hblock (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
      (∑ j ∈ range m, (H (i * m + j) (γ (((i * m + j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ))) -
        H (i * m + j) (γ (((i * m + j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ))))) =
        G i (γ ((i + 1 : ℝ) / n)) - G i (γ ((i : ℝ) / n)) := by
    let p : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((i * m + j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ)
    have hp (j : ℕ) (_hj : j < m) : p j ≤ p (j + 1) := by
      dsimp [p]
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hnm.le
      exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_succ j) (i * m)
    have hinner := primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hγ hp
      (hU i hi) (fun j hj => hV (i * m + j) (mul_add_lt_mul hi hj))
      (hG i hi) (fun j hj => hH (i * m + j) (mul_add_lt_mul hi hj))
      (fun j hj t ht => hγU i hi t
        (uniformSubdivision_refinement_cell_subset hn hm hj
          (by simpa only [p, Nat.add_assoc] using ht)))
      (fun j hj t ht => hγV (i * m + j) (mul_add_lt_mul hi hj) t
        (by simpa only [p, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using ht))
    have hp0 : p 0 = (i : ℝ) / n := by
      dsimp [p]
      push_cast
      field_simp
    have hpm : p m = (i + 1 : ℝ) / n := by
      dsimp [p]
      push_cast
      field_simp
    simpa only [primitiveSubdivisionTransport, p, hp0, hpm, Nat.add_assoc] using hinner
  unfold primitiveSubdivisionTransport
  rw [sum_range_mul_blocks]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using (hblock i (mem_range.mp hi)).symm

name: Complex.primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_eq
statement:
theorem primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_eq
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : Continuous γ) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    {G H : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {U V : ℕ → Set ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hU : ∀ i < n, IsOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ i < m, IsOpen (V i))
    (hG : ∀ i < n, ∀ z ∈ U i, HasDerivAt (G i) (g z) z)
    (hH : ∀ i < m, ∀ z ∈ V i, HasDerivAt (H i) (g z) z)
    (hγU : ∀ i < n, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / n) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / n), γ t ∈ U i)
    (hγV : ∀ i < m, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((i : ℝ) / m) ((i + 1 : ℝ) / m), γ t ∈ V i) :
    primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ (fun i => (i : ℝ) / n) G n =
      primitiveSubdivisionTransport γ (fun i => (i : ℝ) / m) H m
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k => G (k / m)
  let W : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun k => U (k / m)
  have hindex (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n * m) : k / m < n :=
    (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hm).mpr hk
  have hW : ∀ k < n * m, IsOpen (W k) := fun k hk => hU _ (hindex k hk)
  have hP : ∀ k < n * m, ∀ z ∈ W k, HasDerivAt (P k) (g z) z :=
    fun k hk => hG _ (hindex k hk)
  have hγW : ∀ k < n * m, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ))
      ((k + 1 : ℝ) / (n * m : ℕ)), γ t ∈ W k := by
    intro k hk t ht
    apply hγU _ (hindex k hk) t
    have hidx : k / m * m + k % m = k := by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod k m
    apply uniformSubdivision_refinement_cell_subset hn hm (Nat.mod_lt k hm)
    simpa only [hidx, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ht
  have h₁ := primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_refinement hγ hn hm hU hW hG hP hγU hγW
  have h₂ := primitiveSubdivisionTransport_uniform_refinement hγ hm hn hV
    (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hW)
