    hH (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hP)
    hγV (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hγW)
  rw [Nat.mul_comm m n] at h₂
  exact h₁.trans h₂.symm

name: Complex.add_I_ne_zero_of_im_pos
statement: theorem add_I_ne_zero_of_im_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) : z + I ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im h
  simp only [add_im, I_im, zero_im] at hi
  linarith

name: Complex.one_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one
statement: theorem one_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ < 1) : 1 - w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he : w = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
  simp only [he, norm_one, lt_self_iff_false] at hw

name: Complex.norm_cayleyTransform_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_cayleyTransform_lt_one {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ‖cayleyTransform z‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < normSq (z + I) := normSq_pos.mpr (add_I_ne_zero_of_im_pos hz)
  have hs : normSq (cayleyTransform z) < 1 := by
    rw [cayleyTransform, normSq_div, div_lt_one hd]
    simp only [normSq_apply, sub_re, sub_im, add_re, add_im, I_re, I_im]
    nlinarith
  rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq] at hs
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (cayleyTransform z)]

name: Complex.im_inverseCayleyTransform
statement:
theorem im_inverseCayleyTransform (w : ℂ) :
    (inverseCayleyTransform w).im = (1 - normSq w) / normSq (1 - w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inverseCayleyTransform, div_im, mul_re, mul_im, add_re, add_im,
    sub_re, sub_im, one_re, one_im, I_re, I_im, normSq_apply]
  ring

name: Complex.im_inverseCayleyTransform_pos
statement:
theorem im_inverseCayleyTransform_pos {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ < 1) :
    0 < (inverseCayleyTransform w).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [im_inverseCayleyTransform]
  have hn : normSq w < 1 := by rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
  exact div_pos (by linarith) (normSq_pos.mpr (one_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hw))

name: Complex.analyticOnNhd_inverseCayleyTransform
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_inverseCayleyTransform :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ inverseCayleyTransform (ball 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  have hw' : ‖w‖ < 1 := by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw
  exact (analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_const.add analyticAt_id)).div
    (analyticAt_const.sub analyticAt_id) (one_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hw')

name: Complex.analyticOnNhd_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_cayleyTransform :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ cayleyTransform {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im}
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  exact (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const).div (analyticAt_id.add analyticAt_const)
    (add_I_ne_zero_of_im_pos hz)

name: Complex.one_sub_cayleyTransform_ne_zero
statement:
theorem one_sub_cayleyTransform_ne_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : z + I ≠ 0) :
    1 - cayleyTransform z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he : z - I = z + I :=
    (div_eq_one_iff_eq hz).mp (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im he
  simp only [sub_im, add_im, I_im] at hi
  linarith

name: Complex.inverseCayleyTransform_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem inverseCayleyTransform_cayleyTransform {z : ℂ} (hz : z + I ≠ 0) :
    inverseCayleyTransform (cayleyTransform z) = z
proof:
:= by
  apply (div_eq_iff (one_sub_cayleyTransform_ne_zero hz)).mpr
  unfold cayleyTransform
  field_simp [hz]
  ring_nf

name: Complex.inverseCayleyTransform_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem inverseCayleyTransform_zero : inverseCayleyTransform 0 = I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inverseCayleyTransform, add_zero, sub_zero, mul_one, div_one]

name: Complex.dist_mul_I_lt_iff
statement:
theorem dist_mul_I_lt_iff {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) < r ↔ ‖z‖ ^ 2 < 2 * r * z.im
proof:
:= by
  have heq : dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * z.im := by
    simp only [dist_eq_norm, Complex.sq_norm, normSq_apply, sub_re, sub_im,
      mul_re, mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, I_re, I_im]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖z‖), dist_nonneg (x := z) (y := (r : ℂ) * I)]
  · intro h
    nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := z) (y := (r : ℂ) * I)]

name: Complex.im_pos_of_dist_mul_I_lt
statement:
theorem im_pos_of_dist_mul_I_lt {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hz : dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) < r) : 0 < z.im
proof:
:= by
  have h := (dist_mul_I_lt_iff hr).mp hz
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖z‖]

name: Complex.exists_pos_dist_mul_I_lt_iff_im_pos
statement:
theorem exists_pos_dist_mul_I_lt_iff_im_pos (s : Finset ℂ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) < r ↔ 0 < z.im
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * |z.im|)
  let r := 1 + ∑ z ∈ s, f z
  have hf (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ f z := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (abs_nonneg _))
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ z ∈ s, f z := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun z _ => hf z)
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  refine ⟨r, hr, fun z hz => ⟨im_pos_of_dist_mul_I_lt hr, fun hzim => ?_⟩⟩
  apply (dist_mul_I_lt_iff hr).mpr
  have hterm : f z ≤ ∑ z ∈ s, f z := Finset.single_le_sum (fun z _ => hf z) hz
  have hquot : ‖z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im) < r := by
    have heq : f z = ‖z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im) := by dsimp [f]; rw [abs_of_pos hzim]
    rw [heq] at hterm
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have h := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * z.im)).mp hquot
  nlinarith

name: Complex.exists_tangent_circle_eventually_mem_iff_im_pos
statement:
theorem exists_tangent_circle_eventually_mem_iff_im_pos
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {F : α → Set ℂ} {a : α}
    (hF : UpperHemicontinuousAt F a) (hfin : (F a).Finite)
    (hreal : ∀ z ∈ F a, z.im ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, ∀ z ∈ F x,
      (dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) < r ↔ 0 < z.im) ∧ dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) ≠ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsel⟩ := exists_pos_dist_mul_I_lt_iff_im_pos hfin.toFinset
  let U : Set ℂ := ball ((r : ℂ) * I) r ∪ {z : ℂ | z.im < 0}
  have hopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_ball.union (isOpen_lt continuous_im continuous_const)
  have hcover : F a ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hpos : 0 < z.im
    · exact Or.inl ((hsel z (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hz)).mpr hpos)
    · exact Or.inr (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hreal z hz))
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, F x ⊆ U := by
    filter_upwards [hF U (hopen.mem_nhdsSet.mpr hcover)] with x hx
    exact subset_of_mem_nhdsSet hx
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hnear] with x hx z hz
  have hzU := hx hz
  refine ⟨⟨im_pos_of_dist_mul_I_lt hr, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro hpos
    rcases hzU with hball | hneg
    · exact hball
    · exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge hpos.le hneg)
  · intro heq
    rcases hzU with hball | hneg
    · exact ne_of_lt hball heq
    · have him : |z.im - r| ≤ dist z ((r : ℂ) * I) := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using abs_im_le_norm (z - (r : ℂ) * I)
      have habs' := neg_le_abs (z.im - r)
      rw [heq] at him
      change z.im < 0 at hneg
      linarith

name: Complex.circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle_ne_one
statement:
theorem circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle_ne_one (q : ℝ) :
    circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
  have hden : (q : ℂ) + I ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Complex.im h
    norm_num at this
  intro h
  have he := (div_eq_one_iff_eq hden).mp h
  have := congrArg Complex.im he
  norm_num at this

name: Complex.hirschmanLog_real_re_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem hirschmanLog_real_re_mem_Icc (w : ℝ) :
    (log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ)).re ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ)).re = arg (w : ℂ) / π := by
    simp [div_ofReal_re, mul_re, log_im]
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨div_nonneg (arg_nonneg_iff.mpr (by simp)) pi_pos.le,
    (div_le_one pi_pos).mpr (arg_le_pi _)⟩

name: Complex.measurable_hirschmanLog_real
statement:
theorem measurable_hirschmanLog_real :
    Measurable (fun w : ℝ => log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop

name: ContinuousOn.measurable_comp_hirschmanLog_real
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 := fun w =>
    ⟨log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ), hirschmanLog_real_re_mem_Icc w⟩
  have hgc : Continuous (fun z : HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 => g z) :=
    continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hg
  exact hgc.measurable.comp (show Measurable f from measurable_hirschmanLog_real.subtype_mk)

name: Complex.tendsto_hirschmanDiskToStrip_boundary
statement:
theorem tendsto_hirschmanDiskToStrip_boundary {r q : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {u : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hu : ∀ n, u n ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
    (hlim : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 (circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q))))
    (hw : Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n => hirschmanDiskToStrip r (u n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (log ((Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sin (π * r) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
    (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have hM : ContinuousAt (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (Real.cos (π * r)) (Real.sin (π * r)))
      (circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q)) := by
    unfold hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane
    fun_prop (disch := exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle_ne_one q).symm)
  have hMl : Tendsto
      (fun n => hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (Real.cos (π * r)) (Real.sin (π * r)) (u n))
      atTop (𝓝 ((Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    have ht := hM.tendsto.comp hlim
    rw [hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_circleMap_boundary] at ht
    exact ht.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun n => log (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (Real.cos (π * r)) (Real.sin (π * r)) (u n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (log ((Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    by_cases hp : 0 < Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q
    · exact (differentiableAt_log (Or.inl hp)).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hMl
    · have hn : Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hp) hw
      exact (continuousWithinAt_log_of_re_neg_of_im_zero
        (z := ((Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q : ℝ) : ℂ)) hn rfl).tendsto.comp
        (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hMl, Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
          (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_im_pos (Real.cos (π * r)) hs (hu n)).le⟩)
  exact (hlog.mul_const (-I)).div_const (π : ℂ)

name: Complex.continuous_hirschmanDiskToStrip_radial
statement:
theorem continuous_hirschmanDiskToStrip_radial {r ρ : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρ : ρ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ => hirschmanDiskToStrip r
      ((ρ : ℂ) * circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q)))
proof:
:= by
  apply (analyticOnNhd_hirschmanDiskToStrip hr).continuousOn.comp_continuous
  · unfold hirschmanBoundaryAngle
    fun_prop
  · intro q
    have hn : ‖(ρ : ℂ) * circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q)‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [norm_mul, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hρ.1] using hρ.2
    simpa using hn

name: Complex.continuous_regularizedLogNorm
statement:
theorem continuous_regularizedLogNorm {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Continuous (regularizedLogNorm ε)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.log _ (fun z => ne_of_gt (sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)))
  exact ((continuous_norm.pow 2).add continuous_const).sqrt

name: Complex.regularizedLogNorm_bounds
statement:
theorem regularizedLogNorm_bounds {ε B : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ B) :
    Real.log ε ≤ regularizedLogNorm ε z ∧
      regularizedLogNorm ε z ≤ Real.log (sqrt (B ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < sqrt (‖z‖ ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) := sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  constructor
  · apply Real.log_le_log hε
    calc
      ε = sqrt (ε ^ 2) := (sqrt_sq hε.le).symm
      _ ≤ _ := sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖z‖])
  · apply Real.log_le_log hpos
    apply sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]

name: Complex.abs_regularizedLogNorm_le
statement:
theorem abs_regularizedLogNorm_le {ε B : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ B) :
    |regularizedLogNorm ε z| ≤ |Real.log ε| + |Real.log (sqrt (B ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))|
proof:
:= by
  have h := regularizedLogNorm_bounds hε hB hz
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [neg_abs_le (Real.log ε), abs_nonneg (Real.log (sqrt (B ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)))]
  · linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log (sqrt (B ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))), abs_nonneg (Real.log ε)]

name: Complex.integrable_cauchy_mul_regularizedLog_boundary
statement:
theorem integrable_cauchy_mul_regularizedLog_boundary {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1))
    {B ε : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖g z‖ ≤ B)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (a : ℝ) (b : NNReal) :
    Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal a b w *
      regularizedLogNorm ε (g (log (w : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ))))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (continuous_regularizedLogNorm hε).measurable.comp
    hg.measurable_comp_hirschmanLog_real
  apply ((ProbabilityTheory.integrable_cauchyPDFReal a (γ := b)).const_mul
    (|Real.log ε| + |Real.log (sqrt (B ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))|)).mono'
    ((ProbabilityTheory.measurable_cauchyPDFReal a b).mul hm).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all _ fun w => by
    dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    have hp : 0 ≤ ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal a b w := by
      unfold ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal
      positivity
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hp, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (abs_regularizedLogNorm_le hε hB (hbound _ (hirschmanLog_real_re_mem_Icc w))) hp

name: Complex.hirschmanBoundaryWeight_eq_cauchy
statement:
theorem hirschmanBoundaryWeight_eq_cauchy (q : ℝ) :
    1 / (π * (1 + q ^ 2)) = ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal 0 1 q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal, NNReal.coe_one, sub_zero, one_pow, mul_one]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Complex.circleAverage_zero_radius_eq_circleAverage_smul
statement:
theorem circleAverage_zero_radius_eq_circleAverage_smul (F : ℂ → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    Real.circleAverage F 0 ρ = Real.circleAverage (fun z => F ((ρ : ℂ) * z)) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Real.circleAverage, circleMap, zero_add, ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: Complex.norm_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants
statement:
theorem norm_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants {r B H : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖g z‖ ≤ B)
    (h₀ h₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (hm₀ : Measurable h₀) (hm₁ : Measurable h₁)
    (hb₀ : ∀ t, |h₀ t| ≤ H) (hb₁ : ∀ t, |h₁ t| ≤ H)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖g ((t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (h₀ t))
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖g (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (h₁ t)) :
    ‖g (r : ℂ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) * h₀ t) +
      ∫ t : ℝ, (r * hirschmanDensity r t) * h₁ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : closure (HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) =
      HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 := by
    simp only [HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip, HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip,
      closure_preimage_re, closure_Ioo (show (0 : ℝ) ≠ 1 by norm_num)]
  have hc := hg.continuousOn
  rw [hcl] at hc
  have ha : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn (isOpen_Ioo.preimage continuous_re)).mpr hg.differentiableOn
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (norm_nonneg (g 0)).trans (hbound 0 (by
    simp [HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip]))
  have hH : 0 ≤ H := (abs_nonneg (h₀ 0)).trans (hb₀ 0)
  have hrr : 1 - r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hr.2], by linarith [hr.1]⟩
  have hmap₀ (t : ℝ) : (t : ℂ) * I ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 := by
    simp [HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip]
  have hmap₁ (t : ℝ) : 1 + (t : ℂ) * I ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 := by
    simp [HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip]
  have hcont₀ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => g ((t : ℂ) * I)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hc.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) hmap₀
  have hcont₁ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => g (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hc.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) hmap₁
  obtain ⟨ε, -, hε, hεlim⟩ := exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto' (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  have hlim₀ := tendsto_integral_hirschman_regularizedLogNorm_exp hrr hm₀ hH hb₀ hε hεlim
  have hlim₁ := tendsto_integral_hirschman_regularizedLogNorm_exp hr hm₁ hH hb₁ hε hεlim
  have hrightlim := (hlim₀.const_mul (1 - r)).add (hlim₁.const_mul r)
  have hfinal (n : ℕ) : sqrt (‖g (r : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 + (ε n) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp ((1 - r) * (∫ t : ℝ, hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t *
        regularizedLogNorm (ε n) ((Real.exp (h₀ t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
        r * (∫ t : ℝ, hirschmanDensity r t *
          regularizedLogNorm (ε n) ((Real.exp (h₁ t) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    have hgint₀ := integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded hrr
      ((continuous_regularizedLogNorm (hε n).1).comp hcont₀).measurable
      (fun t => abs_regularizedLogNorm_le (hε n).1 hB (hbound _ (hmap₀ t)))
    have hgint₁ := integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded hr
      ((continuous_regularizedLogNorm (hε n).1).comp hcont₁).measurable
      (fun t => abs_regularizedLogNorm_le (hε n).1 hB (hbound _ (hmap₁ t)))
    have hmeas₀ := ((continuous_regularizedLogNorm (hε n).1).comp
      (continuous_ofReal.comp Real.continuous_exp)).measurable.comp hm₀
    have hmeas₁ := ((continuous_regularizedLogNorm (hε n).1).comp
      (continuous_ofReal.comp Real.continuous_exp)).measurable.comp hm₁
    have hhint₀ := integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded hrr hmeas₀
      (fun t => abs_regularizedLogNorm_exp_le (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hε n)) hH (hb₀ t))
    have hhint₁ := integrable_hirschmanDensity_mul_of_bounded hr hmeas₁
      (fun t => abs_regularizedLogNorm_exp_le (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hε n)) hH (hb₁ t))
    have hmono₀ := integral_mono hgint₀ hhint₀ (fun t =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (regularizedLogNorm_le_exp_of_norm_le (hε n).1 (hleft t))
        (hirschmanDensity_pos hrr t).le)
    have hmono₁ := integral_mono hgint₁ hhint₁ (fun t =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (regularizedLogNorm_le_exp_of_norm_le (hε n).1 (hright t))
        (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le)
    have hbase := regularizedLogNorm_le_hirschman_boundary_integrals hr hc ha hB hbound (hε n).1
    simp only [mul_assoc, integral_const_mul] at hbase
    have hlog : regularizedLogNorm (ε n) (g (r : ℂ)) ≤
        (1 - r) * (∫ t : ℝ, hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t *
          regularizedLogNorm (ε n) ((Real.exp (h₀ t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
        r * (∫ t : ℝ, hirschmanDensity r t *
          regularizedLogNorm (ε n) ((Real.exp (h₁ t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      hbase.trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono₀ (by linarith [hr.2]))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono₁ hr.1.le))
    exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (sqrt_pos.mpr
      (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos (hε n).1)))).mp hlog
  have hleftlim := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := ‖g (r : ℂ)‖ ^ 2)).add (hεlim.pow 2)).sqrt
  simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), add_zero, sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at hleftlim
  have h := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hleftlim
    (Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hrightlim) hfinal
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_assoc, integral_const_mul] using h

name: Complex.cubicalLength_pathChain_eq_sum
statement:
theorem cubicalLength_pathChain_eq_sum {Ω : Set ℂ} {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    cubicalLength (Cubical.pathChain p γ) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        ‖derivWithin ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I t‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff (q : C(I, Ω)) : 0 ≤ Cubical.pathChain p γ q := by
    simp only [Cubical.pathChain, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    apply sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  let L : Cubical.OneChain Ω →ₗ[ℤ] ℝ := Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ (fun q =>
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖derivWithin (cubicalPath q).extend I t‖)
  have he : cubicalLength (Cubical.pathChain p γ) = L (Cubical.pathChain p γ) := by
    simp only [cubicalLength, L, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro q _
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hcoeff q), zsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [he]
  simp only [Cubical.pathChain, map_sum, L, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul,
    cubicalPath_toContinuousMap_extend]

name: Complex.schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_conj
statement:
theorem schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_conj (f axis : ℂ → ℂ) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f axis (conj z) =
      conj (schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f axis z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hneg | hpos
  · simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hneg, not_lt_of_ge hneg.le]
  · simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hpos, not_lt_of_ge hpos.le]

name: Complex.schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_conj_of_conj_eq_axis
statement:
theorem schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_conj_of_conj_eq_axis (f axis : ℂ → ℂ)
    (haxis : ∀ z : ℂ, axis (conj z) = conj (axis z)) (z : ℂ) :
    schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f axis (conj z) =
      conj (schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f axis z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z.im = 0
  · simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hz, haxis]
  · exact schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_conj f axis hz

name: Complex.differentiableOn_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hneg | hpos
  · have hh : DifferentiableAt ℂ (conj ∘ f ∘ conj) z := by
      simpa only [conj_conj] using (hf (conj z) (by simpa using neg_pos.mpr hneg)).conj_conj
    apply hh.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [isOpen_lt continuous_im continuous_const |>.mem_nhds hneg] with w hw
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hw, not_lt_of_ge hw.le]
  · apply (hf z hpos).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_im |>.mem_nhds hpos] with w hw
    simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hw]

name: Complex.schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_eq_of_conj_eq
statement:
theorem schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_eq_of_conj_eq
    (f g : ℂ → ℂ) {R : ℝ}
    (hupper : ∀ z : ℂ, R < ‖z‖ → 0 < z.im → f z = g z)
    (href : ∀ z : ℂ, R < ‖z‖ → g (conj z) = conj (g z))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : R < ‖z‖) : schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f g z = g z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : 0 < z.im
  · simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hpos, hupper z hz hpos]
  · by_cases hneg : z.im < 0
    · have hzconj : R < ‖conj z‖ := by simpa using hz
      have hposconj : 0 < (conj z).im := by simpa using neg_pos.mpr hneg
      simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hpos, hneg, hupper (conj z) hzconj hposconj,
        href z hz]
    · simp [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hpos, hneg]

name: Complex.differentiableOn_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_union_exterior
statement:
theorem differentiableOn_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_union_exterior
    (f g : ℂ → ℂ) {R : ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → DifferentiableAt ℂ f z)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hupper : ∀ z : ℂ, R < ‖z‖ → 0 < z.im → f z = g z)
    (href : ∀ z : ℂ, R < ‖z‖ → g (conj z) = conj (g z)) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f g)
      ({z | z.im ≠ 0} ∪ {z | R < ‖z‖})
proof:
:= by
  have hext : DifferentiableOn ℂ (schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f g) {z | R < ‖z‖} := by
    apply hg.congr
    intro z hz
    exact schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_eq_of_conj_eq f g hupper href hz
  exact (differentiableOn_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f g hf).union_of_isOpen hext
    (isOpen_ne_fun continuous_im continuous_const)
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm)

name: Complex.norm_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_le
statement:
theorem norm_schwarzHalfPlaneExtension_le
    (f axis : ℂ → ℂ) {M C : ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ M → 0 < z.im → ‖f z‖ ≤ C)
    (haxis : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ M → z.im = 0 → ‖axis z‖ ≤ C)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ M) : ‖schwarzHalfPlaneExtension f axis z‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : 0 < z.im
  · simpa only [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, if_pos hpos] using hf z hz hpos
  · by_cases hneg : z.im < 0
    · simpa [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, hpos, hneg] using
        hf (conj z) (by simpa using hz) (by simpa using neg_pos.mpr hneg)
    · have heq : z.im = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (le_of_not_gt hneg)
      simpa only [schwarzHalfPlaneExtension, if_neg hpos, if_neg hneg] using haxis z hz heq

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_mapOne_inclusion
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_mapOne_inclusion {Ω Θ : Set ℂ} (h : Ω ⊆ Θ)
    (g : ℂ → ℂ) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral g (Cubical.mapOne (ContinuousMap.inclusion h) Γ) =
      cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ
proof:
:= by
  have he : (cubicalCurveIntegral g).comp (Cubical.mapOne (ContinuousMap.inclusion h)) =
      cubicalCurveIntegral g := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro γ k
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Cubical.mapOne_single, cubicalCurveIntegral,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun he Γ

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_mapOne_inclusion
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_mapOne_inclusion {Ω Θ : Set ℂ} (h : Ω ⊆ Θ)
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (τ : ℂ) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral (Cubical.mapOne (ContinuousMap.inclusion h) Γ) τ =
      cubicalWindingIntegral Γ τ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cubicalWindingIntegral, cubicalCurveIntegral_mapOne_inclusion]

name: Complex.hirschmanBoundaryAngle_mem
statement:
theorem hirschmanBoundaryAngle_mem (q : ℝ) :
    hirschmanBoundaryAngle q ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
  constructor <;> linarith [arctan_mem_Ioo q |>.1, arctan_mem_Ioo q |>.2]

name: Complex.strictMono_hirschmanBoundaryAngle
statement: theorem strictMono_hirschmanBoundaryAngle : StrictMono hirschmanBoundaryAngle
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  dsimp [hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
  linarith [arctan_strictMono hxy]

name: Complex.range_hirschmanBoundaryAngle
statement: theorem range_hirschmanBoundaryAngle : Set.range hirschmanBoundaryAngle = Ioo (0 : ℝ) (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  ext θ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact hirschmanBoundaryAngle_mem q
  · intro hθ
    refine ⟨Real.tan ((θ - π) / 2), ?_⟩
    unfold hirschmanBoundaryAngle
    rw [Real.arctan_tan (by linarith [hθ.1]) (by linarith [hθ.2])]
    ring

name: Complex.hasDerivAt_hirschmanBoundaryAngle
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_hirschmanBoundaryAngle (q : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt hirschmanBoundaryAngle (2 / (1 + q ^ 2)) q
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((Real.hasDerivAt_arctan q).const_mul 2).const_add π
  change HasDerivAt hirschmanBoundaryAngle (2 * (1 / (1 + q ^ 2))) q at h
  exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)

name: Complex.circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle
statement:
theorem circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle (q : ℝ) :
    circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q) = ((q : ℂ) - I) / ((q : ℂ) + I)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : Real.cos (π + 2 * arctan q) = (q ^ 2 - 1) / (1 + q ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.cos_add, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi, zero_mul, sub_zero, neg_one_mul,
      Real.cos_two_mul, Real.cos_sq_arctan]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hsin : Real.sin (π + 2 * arctan q) = -2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi, Real.cos_pi, zero_mul, zero_add, neg_one_mul,
      Real.sin_two_mul, Real.sin_arctan, Real.cos_arctan]
    have hs : sqrt (1 + q ^ 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity))
    field_simp
    rw [sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [circleMap, zero_add, ofReal_one, one_mul, hirschmanBoundaryAngle,
      mul_I_re, mul_I_im, ofReal_im, ofReal_re, Complex.exp_re, neg_zero,
      zero_sub, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, div_re, sub_re, add_re, I_re, sub_zero,
      add_zero, sub_im, add_im, I_im, zero_sub, zero_add, normSq_apply]
    rw [hcos]
    ring
  · simp only [circleMap, zero_add, ofReal_one, one_mul, hirschmanBoundaryAngle,
      mul_I_re, mul_I_im, ofReal_im, ofReal_re, Complex.exp_im, neg_zero,
      zero_sub, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, div_im, sub_re, add_re, I_re, sub_zero,
      add_zero, sub_im, add_im, I_im, zero_sub, zero_add, normSq_apply]
    rw [hsin]
    ring

name: Complex.hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_circleMap_boundary
statement:
theorem hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_circleMap_boundary (a b q : ℝ) :
    hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane a b (circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q)) = ((a + b * q : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleMap_hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
  have hden : (q : ℂ) + I ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Complex.im h
    norm_num at this
  have hne : ((q : ℂ) - I) / ((q : ℂ) + I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have he := (div_eq_one_iff_eq hden).mp h
    have := congrArg Complex.im he
    norm_num at this
  have hquot : (1 + ((q : ℂ) - I) / ((q : ℂ) + I)) /
      (1 - ((q : ℂ) - I) / ((q : ℂ) + I)) = -(q : ℂ) * I := by
    field_simp
    ring_nf
    simp [I_sq]
  unfold hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane
  rw [hquot]
  push_cast
  ring_nf
  simp [I_sq]

name: Complex.circleAverage_eq_integral_hirschmanBoundaryAngle
statement:
theorem circleAverage_eq_integral_hirschmanBoundaryAngle (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
    Real.circleAverage F 0 1 =
      ∫ q : ℝ, (1 / (π * (1 + q ^ 2))) * F (circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q))
proof:
:= by
  have hchange := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul
    (s := Set.univ) MeasurableSet.univ
    (fun q _ => (hasDerivAt_hirschmanBoundaryAngle q).hasDerivWithinAt)
    strictMono_hirschmanBoundaryAngle.injective.injOn
    (fun θ => F (circleMap 0 1 θ))
  rw [image_univ, range_hirschmanBoundaryAngle] at hchange
  rw [Real.circleAverage, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le two_pi_pos.le,
    integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, hchange]
  simp only [Measure.restrict_univ, smul_eq_mul]
  have habs (q : ℝ) : |2 / (1 + q ^ 2)| = 2 / (1 + q ^ 2) := abs_of_pos (by positivity)
  simp_rw [habs]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
    field_simp

name: Complex.circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane
statement:
theorem circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane (a b : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => F (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane a b z)) 0 1 =
      ∫ q : ℝ, (1 / (π * (1 + q ^ 2))) * F ((a + b * q : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleAverage_eq_integral_hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
  simp_rw [hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_circleMap_boundary]

name: Complex.circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_eq_cauchy
statement:
theorem circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_eq_cauchy (a : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => F (hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane a b z)) 0 1 =
      ∫ w : ℝ, ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal a (⟨b, hb.le⟩ : NNReal) w * F (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hRange : (fun q : ℝ => a + b * q) '' Set.univ = Set.univ := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · exact fun _ => Set.mem_univ _
    · intro _
      refine ⟨(w - a) / b, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      field_simp
      ring
  have hchange := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul
    (s := Set.univ) MeasurableSet.univ
    (fun q _ => (((hasDerivAt_id q).const_mul b).const_add a).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (show Set.InjOn (fun q : ℝ => a + b * q) Set.univ from fun q _ w _ h => by
      have := (add_left_cancel h : b * q = b * w)
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hb) this)
    (fun w : ℝ => ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal a (⟨b, hb.le⟩ : NNReal) w * F (w : ℂ))
  simp only [id_eq, mul_one] at hchange
  rw [hRange, Measure.restrict_univ] at hchange
  rw [circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane, hchange]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
    simp only [abs_of_pos hb, smul_eq_mul, ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal]
    change 1 / (π * (1 + q ^ 2)) * F ((a + b * q : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      b * (π⁻¹ * b * ((a + b * q - a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2)⁻¹ * F ((a + b * q : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have hd : b * (π⁻¹ * b * ((a + b * q - a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2)⁻¹) =
        1 / (π * (1 + q ^ 2)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [← mul_assoc, hd]

name: Complex.ellipsePath_extend_apply
statement:
theorem ellipsePath_extend_apply {M ε t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I) :
    (ellipsePath M ε).extend t = ellipseMap M ε (2 * Real.pi * t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
  rfl

name: Complex.contDiff_ellipse_param
statement:
private theorem contDiff_ellipse_param (M ε : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => ellipseMap M ε (2 * Real.pi * t))
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => M * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t)) := by fun_prop
  have hi : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => ε * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t)) := by fun_prop
  simpa only [ellipseMap, ofRealCLM_apply, Pi.add_apply, Function.comp_def] using!
    (ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hr).add ((ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hi).mul contDiff_const)

name: Complex.contDiffOn_ellipsePath_extend
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_ellipsePath_extend (M ε : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (ellipsePath M ε).extend I
proof:
:= by
  have h := contDiff_ellipse_param M ε
  exact h.contDiffOn.congr (fun t ht => ellipsePath_extend_apply ht)

name: Complex.curveIntegral_ellipsePath_eq_ellipseIntegral
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_ellipsePath_eq_ellipseIntegral (f : ℂ → ℂ) (M ε : ℝ) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => f z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (ellipsePath M ε) =
      ellipseIntegral f M ε
proof:
:= by
  have hγ := contDiff_ellipse_param M ε
  unfold ellipsePath
  rw [Path.curveIntegral_ofLine_eq_intervalIntegral hγ]
  have hd (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ellipseMap M ε (2 * Real.pi * t)) t =
      (2 * Real.pi) • deriv (ellipseMap M ε) (2 * Real.pi * t) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_one, (hasDerivAt_ellipseMap _ _ _).deriv] using!
      ((hasDerivAt_ellipseMap M ε (2 * Real.pi * t)).scomp t
        ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (2 * Real.pi))).deriv
  simp_rw [hd, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
  have hs := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left
    (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (ellipseMap M ε) θ * f (ellipseMap M ε θ)) (2 * Real.pi)
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
  simpa only [mul_zero, mul_one, ellipseIntegral, smul_eq_mul] using hs

name: Complex.ellipseMap_self
statement: private theorem ellipseMap_self (M θ : ℝ) : ellipseMap M M θ = circleMap 0 M θ
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [ellipseMap, circleMap, add_re, add_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im,
      mul_re, mul_im, I_re, I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero,
      sub_zero, exp_re, exp_im, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]

name: Complex.ellipseMap_mem_off_real_or_exterior
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : Real.sin θ = 0
  · right
    have hn : ‖ellipseMap M ε θ‖ = M := by
      rcases Real.sin_eq_zero_iff_cos_eq.mp hs with hc | hc <;>
        simp only [ellipseMap, hs, hc, mul_one, mul_neg, mul_zero, ofReal_zero,
          zero_mul, add_zero, ofReal_neg, norm_neg, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hM]
    rwa [hn]
  · left
    simpa only [ellipseMap, add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, I_im, I_re,
      mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using mul_ne_zero hε.ne' hs

name: Complex.circleIntegral_eq_ellipseIntegral_of_differentiableOn_off_real_or_exterior
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_eq_ellipseIntegral_of_differentiableOn_off_real_or_exterior
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R M ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hε : 0 < ε) (hRM : R < M)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | z.im ≠ 0 ∨ R < ‖z‖}) :
    (∮ z in C(0, M), f z) = ellipseIntegral f M ε
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p =>
    ellipseMap M ((1 - p.1) * M + p.1 * ε) (2 * Real.pi * p.2)
  have hψ : Continuous ψ := by unfold ψ ellipseMap; fun_prop
  have hΩ : IsOpen {z : ℂ | z.im ≠ 0 ∨ R < ‖z‖} :=
    (isOpen_ne_fun continuous_im continuous_const).union
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm)
  have hm (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) 1) :
      0 < (1 - p.1) * M + p.1 * ε := by
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ p.1 := hp.1.1
    have ht1 : p.1 ≤ 1 := hp.2.1
    by_cases ht : p.1 = 1
    · simpa only [ht, sub_self, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_add] using hε
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht1 ht)) hM)
        (mul_nonneg ht0 hε.le)
  have hc := curveIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_of_freeHomotopy
    (circlePath 0 M) (ellipsePath M ε) hψ hΩ hf
    (fun p hp => ellipseMap_mem_off_real_or_exterior hM (hm p hp) hRM)
    (fun t ht => by rw [circlePath_extend_apply ht]; simp only [ψ, sub_zero, one_mul,
      zero_mul, add_zero]; exact (ellipseMap_self M _).symm)
    (fun t ht => by rw [ellipsePath_extend_apply ht]; simp only [ψ, sub_self, zero_mul,
      one_mul, zero_add])
    (fun t _ => by simp [ψ, ellipseMap])
    (contDiffOn_circlePath_extend 0 M) (contDiffOn_ellipsePath_extend M ε)
  rwa [curveIntegral_circlePath_eq_circleIntegral, curveIntegral_ellipsePath_eq_ellipseIntegral] at hc

name: Complex.neg_abs_sin_mul_norm_le_im_exp_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hre := abs_re_le_norm z
  have hs : -(Real.sin θ * z.re) ≤ |Real.sin θ| * ‖z‖ :=
    (neg_le_abs _).trans (by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hre (abs_nonneg _))
  have hc := mul_nonneg hcos hz
  simpa only [mul_im, exp_re, exp_im, mul_re, ofReal_re, I_re, mul_zero,
    ofReal_im, I_im, mul_one, sub_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
    using (show -(|Real.sin θ| * ‖z‖) ≤ Real.cos θ * z.im + Real.sin θ * z.re by linarith)

name: Complex.neg_normalized_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b ε : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => f (x + ε * I)) volume a b)
    (hconj : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f (x + (-ε) * I) = conj (f (x + ε * I)))
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-ε) ε)).re =
      (∫ x in a..b, (f (x + ε * I)).im) / Real.pi -
        ((∫ y in -ε..ε, f (b + y * I)).re -
          (∫ y in -ε..ε, f (a + y * I)).re) / (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (∫ x in a..b, f (x + (-ε) * I)) =
      conj (∫ x in a..b, f (x + ε * I)) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_conj]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    exact hconj x (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hab] using hx)
  rw [neg_normalized_re, rectangleBoundaryIntegral]
  simp only [ofReal_neg]
  rw [hp]
  simp only [sub_im, add_im, conj_im, I_mul_im]
  have hi := Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hf
  change (∫ x in a..b, (f (x + ε * I)).im) = (∫ x in a..b, f (x + ε * I)).im at hi
  rw [← hi]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Complex.norm_exp_mul_le
statement:
private theorem norm_exp_mul_le {z v : ℂ} {b C : ℝ}
    (hz : z.re ≤ b) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ C) : ‖exp z * v‖ ≤ Real.exp b * C
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, norm_exp]
  exact mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hz) hv (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: Complex.neg_exp_mul_le_im_exp_add_mul
statement:
private theorem neg_exp_mul_le_im_exp_add_mul {x b ε C : ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hx : x ≤ b) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε' : ε ≤ 1) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hz : 0 ≤ z.im) (hnorm : ‖z‖ ≤ C) :
    -(Real.exp b * C * ε) ≤ (exp (x + ε * I) * z).im
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : 0 ≤ Real.cos ε :=
    Real.cos_nonneg_of_neg_pi_div_two_le_of_le
      (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (hε'.trans Real.one_le_pi_div_two)
  have hphase := neg_abs_sin_mul_norm_le_im_exp_mul hcos hz
  have hs : |Real.sin ε| ≤ ε := by
    simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hε] using (Real.abs_sin_le_abs (x := ε))
  have hs' : |Real.sin ε| * ‖z‖ ≤ ε * C :=
    mul_le_mul hs hnorm (norm_nonneg _) hε
  have hrot : -(ε * C) ≤ (exp (ε * I) * z).im := by linarith
  have heq : (exp (x + ε * I) * z).im =
      Real.exp x * (exp (ε * I) * z).im := by
    rw [exp_add, mul_assoc]
    simp only [mul_im, exp_ofReal_re, exp_ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [heq]
  have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrot (Real.exp_pos x).le
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx)
    (mul_nonneg hε hC)
  nlinarith

name: Complex.neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_ge
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_ge
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {a b ε C : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε' : ε ≤ 1)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => exp (x + ε * I) * h (x + ε * I))
      volume a b)
    (hconj : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, h (x + (-ε) * I) = conj (h (x + ε * I)))
    (him : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ (h (x + ε * I)).im)
    (hupper : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ‖h (x + ε * I)‖ ≤ C)
    (hleft : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-ε) ε, ‖h (a + y * I)‖ ≤ C)
    (hright : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-ε) ε, ‖h (b + y * I)‖ ≤ C) :
    -((b - a + 2) * Real.exp b * C / Real.pi) * ε ≤
      (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) a b (-ε) ε)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hupper a ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩)
  have hpair (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :
      exp (x + (-ε) * I) * h (x + (-ε) * I) =
        conj (exp (x + ε * I) * h (x + ε * I)) := by
    rw [map_mul, hconj x hx, ← exp_conj]
    congr 2
    simp
  rw [neg_normalized_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq hint hpair hab]
  have himint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : ℝ => (exp (x + ε * I) * h (x + ε * I)).im) volume a b :=
    ⟨hint.1.im, hint.2.im⟩
  have hhor := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab
    (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun _ : ℝ => -(Real.exp b * C * ε)) volume a b) himint
    (fun x hx => neg_exp_mul_le_im_exp_add_mul hx.2 hε hε' hC
      (him x hx) (hupper x hx))
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hhor
  have hv (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≤ b)
      (hn : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-ε) ε, ‖h (c + y * I)‖ ≤ C) :
      ‖∫ y in -ε..ε, exp (c + y * I) * h (c + y * I)‖ ≤
        Real.exp b * C * (2 * ε) := by
    have heps : -ε ≤ ε := by linarith
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := -ε) (b := ε) (C := Real.exp b * C) (f := fun y : ℝ =>
        exp (c + y * I) * h (c + y * I)) (fun y hy => by
          apply norm_exp_mul_le (by simpa using hc)
          exact hn y (Ioc_subset_Icc_self (by simpa only [uIoc_of_le heps] using hy)))
    simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add, ← two_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2 * ε by positivity)]
      using hb
  have hvl := hv a hab hleft
  have hvr := hv b le_rfl hright
  have hr := (re_le_norm (∫ y in -ε..ε,
    exp (b + y * I) * h (b + y * I))).trans hvr
  have hl := ((neg_le_abs (∫ y in -ε..ε,
    exp (a + y * I) * h (a + y * I)).re).trans (abs_re_le_norm _)).trans hvl
  generalize (∫ x in a..b, (exp (x + ε * I) * h (x + ε * I)).im) = H at *
  generalize (∫ y in -ε..ε, exp (b + y * I) * h (b + y * I)).re = Vr at *
  generalize (∫ y in -ε..ε, exp (a + y * I) * h (a + y * I)).re = Vl at *
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hpi).mp
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: Complex.nonneg_of_neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {a b C δ w : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hcont : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ,
      ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => h (x + ε * I)) (Icc a b))
    (hconj : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      h (x + (-ε) * I) = conj (h (x + ε * I)))
    (him : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (h z).im)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc (-δ) δ, ‖h (x + y * I)‖ ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ,
      (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) a b (-ε) ε)).re = w) :
    0 ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ := (b - a + 2) * Real.exp b * C / Real.pi
  have hest : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), -K * ε ≤ w := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (lt_min hδ zero_lt_one)] with ε hε
    have heδ : ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ := ⟨hε.1, (lt_min_iff.mp hε.2).1⟩
    have he1 : ε ≤ 1 := (lt_min_iff.mp hε.2).2.le
    have hebox : ε ∈ Icc (-δ) δ := ⟨by linarith [heδ.1], heδ.2.le⟩
    rw [← hw ε heδ]
    apply neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_ge hab hε.1.le he1
    · exact ((by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => exp (x + ε * I))
        (Icc a b)).mul (hcont ε heδ)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
    · exact hconj ε heδ
    · intro x _
      apply him
      simpa using hε.1
    · intro x hx
      exact hbound x hx ε hebox
    · intro y hy
      exact hbound a ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩ y ⟨by linarith [heδ.2, hy.1], by linarith [heδ.2, hy.2]⟩
    · intro y hy
      exact hbound b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩ y ⟨by linarith [heδ.2, hy.1], by linarith [heδ.2, hy.2]⟩
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => -K * ε) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, id_eq] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul ((tendsto_id : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)).mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)))
  exact le_of_tendsto hlim hest

name: Complex.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_off_real
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_off_real
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b ε η : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hεη : ε ≤ η)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | z.im ≠ 0})
    (hleft : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => f (a + y * I)) (Icc (-η) η))
    (hright : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => f (b + y * I)) (Icc (-η) η)) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-ε) ε =
      rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-η) η
proof:
:= by
  have hη : 0 < η := hε.trans_le hεη
  have hup : rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b ε η = 0 := by
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f
        ([[((a : ℂ) + ε * I).re, ((b : ℂ) + η * I).re]] ×ℂ
          [[((a : ℂ) + ε * I).im, ((b : ℂ) + η * I).im]]) := by
      apply hf.mono
      intro z hz
      have hi : z.im ∈ Icc ε η := by
        simpa [uIcc_of_le hεη] using hz.2
      exact ne_of_gt (hε.trans_le hi.1)
    simpa [rectangleBoundaryIntegral, smul_eq_mul] using
      integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn f
        ((a : ℂ) + ε * I) ((b : ℂ) + η * I) hd
  have hlo : rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-η) (-ε) = 0 := by
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f
        ([[((a : ℂ) + (-η) * I).re, ((b : ℂ) + (-ε) * I).re]] ×ℂ
          [[((a : ℂ) + (-η) * I).im, ((b : ℂ) + (-ε) * I).im]]) := by
      apply hf.mono
      intro z hz
      have hi : z.im ∈ Icc (-η) (-ε) := by
        simpa [uIcc_of_le (neg_le_neg hεη)] using hz.2
      exact ne_of_lt (hi.2.trans_lt (neg_neg_of_pos hε))
    simpa [rectangleBoundaryIntegral, smul_eq_mul] using
      integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn f
        ((a : ℂ) + (-η) * I) ((b : ℂ) + (-ε) * I) hd
  have hsplit (r : ℝ)
      (hr : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => f (r + y * I)) (Icc (-η) η)) :
      (∫ y in -η..η, f (r + y * I)) =
        (∫ y in -η..-ε, f (r + y * I)) +
          (∫ y in -ε..ε, f (r + y * I)) +
            (∫ y in ε..η, f (r + y * I)) := by
    have hall : IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => f (r + y * I)) volume (-η) η :=
      hr.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith : -η ≤ η)
    have hpart (u v : ℝ) (hu : -η ≤ u) (hv : v ≤ η) (huv : u ≤ v) :
        IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => f (r + y * I)) volume u v := by
      apply hall.mono_set
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le huv, uIcc_of_le (show -η ≤ η by linarith)] using
        (Icc_subset_Icc hu hv)
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hpart (-η) ε le_rfl hεη (by linarith))
      (hpart ε η (by linarith) le_rfl hεη)]
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hpart (-η) (-ε) le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith))
      (hpart (-ε) ε (by linarith) hεη (by linarith))]
  have hsum : rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-η) η =
      rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-ε) ε +
        rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b ε η +
          rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-η) (-ε) := by
    simp only [rectangleBoundaryIntegral]
    rw [hsplit b hright, hsplit a hleft]
    ring
  simpa only [hup, hlo, add_zero] using hsum.symm

name: Complex.neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_nonneg
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_nonneg
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {a b C δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h {z | z.im ≠ 0})
    (hleft : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => h (a + y * I)) (Icc (-δ) δ))
    (hright : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => h (b + y * I)) (Icc (-δ) δ))
    (hconj : ∀ z : ℂ, z.im ≠ 0 → h (conj z) = conj (h z))
    (him : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (h z).im)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc (-δ) δ, ‖h (x + y * I)‖ ≤ C) :
    0 ≤ (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) a b (-δ) δ)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => exp z * h z) {z | z.im ≠ 0} :=
    differentiable_exp.differentiableOn.mul hh
  have hfl : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => exp (a + y * I) * h (a + y * I))
      (Icc (-δ) δ) := (by fun_prop : ContinuousOn
        (fun y : ℝ => exp (a + y * I)) (Icc (-δ) δ)).mul hleft
  have hfr : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => exp (b + y * I) * h (b + y * I))
      (Icc (-δ) δ) := (by fun_prop : ContinuousOn
        (fun y : ℝ => exp (b + y * I)) (Icc (-δ) δ)).mul hright
  apply nonneg_of_neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq hab hδ
  · intro ε hε
    apply hh.continuousOn.comp (by fun_prop)
    intro x _
    simpa using (ne_of_gt hε.1)
  · intro ε hε x _
    simpa using hconj (x + ε * I) (by simpa using (ne_of_gt hε.1))
  · exact him
  · exact hbound
  · intro ε hε
    rw [rectangleBoundaryIntegral_eq_of_differentiableOn_off_real hε.1 hε.2.le hf hfl hfr]

name: Real.hirschmanDensityZero_pos
statement: theorem hirschmanDensityZero_pos (t : ℝ) : 0 < hirschmanDensityZero t
proof:
:= by
  exact div_pos pi_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (by linarith [cosh_pos (π * t)]))

name: Real.hirschmanDensityZero_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem hirschmanDensityZero_neg (t : ℝ) :
    hirschmanDensityZero (-t) = hirschmanDensityZero t
proof:
:= by
  simp [hirschmanDensityZero]

name: Real.hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitiveZero
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitiveZero (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt hirschmanPrimitiveZero (hirschmanDensityZero t) t
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 1 + exp (-(π * t)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul π).neg.exp.const_add 1).inv hden
  change HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (1 + exp (-(π * x)))⁻¹)
    (-(exp (-(π * t)) * -(π * 1)) / (1 + exp (-(π * t))) ^ 2) t at h
  have h' : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (1 + exp (-(π * x)))⁻¹)
      (π * exp (-(π * t)) / (1 + exp (-(π * t))) ^ 2) t := by
    convert h using 1
    ring
  apply h'.congr_deriv
  dsimp [hirschmanDensityZero]
  rw [cosh_eq, exp_neg]
  have he := exp_pos (π * t)
  field_simp
  ring

name: Real.tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atTop :
    Tendsto hirschmanPrimitiveZero atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(π * t))) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop pi_pos)
  change Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (1 + exp (-(π * t)))⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 1)
  simpa only [add_zero, inv_one] using
    (tendsto_const_nhds.add he).inv₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) + 0 ≠ 0)

name: Real.tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atBot
statement:
theorem tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atBot :
    Tendsto hirschmanPrimitiveZero atBot (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
  exact tendsto_const_nhds.add_atTop
    (tendsto_exp_atTop.comp (tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atBot pi_pos)))

name: Real.integrable_of_even_nonneg_primitive
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : IntegrableOn f (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg' (fun t _ => hF t) (fun t _ => hnonneg t) htop
  have hci : IntegrableOn f (Ici (0 : ℝ)) := Iff.mpr integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi hpos
  have hneg : IntegrableOn f (Iic (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hci' : IntegrableOn f (Ici (-(0 : ℝ))) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hci
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun t => f (-t)) (Iic (0 : ℝ)) := hci'.comp_neg_Iic
    have heq : (fun t => f (-t)) = f := funext hf
    rwa [heq] at h
  rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
  exact integrableOn_union.mpr ⟨hneg, hpos⟩

name: Real.integrable_hirschmanDensityZero
statement: theorem integrable_hirschmanDensityZero : Integrable hirschmanDensityZero
proof:
:=
  integrable_of_even_nonneg_primitive hirschmanDensityZero_neg
    (fun t => (hirschmanDensityZero_pos t).le) hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitiveZero
    tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atTop

name: Real.integral_hirschmanDensityZero
statement: theorem integral_hirschmanDensityZero : (∫ t, hirschmanDensityZero t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitiveZero
    integrable_hirschmanDensityZero tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atBot
    tendsto_hirschmanPrimitiveZero_atTop

name: Real.hirschmanDenominator_pos
statement:
theorem hirschmanDenominator_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    0 < cosh (π * t) + cos (π * r)
proof:
:= by
  have hangle : π * r < π := by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2]
  have hc := cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1).le le_rfl hangle
  rw [cos_pi] at hc
  have hch : 1 ≤ cosh (π * t) := by
    nlinarith [cosh_sq (π * t), sq_nonneg (sinh (π * t)), cosh_pos (π * t)]
  linarith

name: Real.hirschmanDensity_pos
statement:
theorem hirschmanDensity_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    0 < hirschmanDensity r t
proof:
:= by
  exact div_pos (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1) (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2]))
    (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hr.1) (hirschmanDenominator_pos hr t))

name: Real.hirschmanDensity_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem hirschmanDensity_neg (r t : ℝ) : hirschmanDensity r (-t) = hirschmanDensity r t
proof:
:= by
  simp [hirschmanDensity]

name: Real.hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitive
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitive {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (hirschmanPrimitive r) (hirschmanDensity r t) t
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (π * r) :=
    sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1) (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have h := (((((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul π).exp.add_const (cos (π * r))).div_const
    (sin (π * r))).arctan).div_const (π * r)
  change HasDerivAt (hirschmanPrimitive r)
    ((1 / (1 + ((exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) / sin (π * r)) ^ 2)) *
      (exp (π * t) * (π * 1) / sin (π * r)) / (π * r)) t at h
  apply h.congr_deriv
  unfold hirschmanDensity
  rw [cosh_eq, exp_neg]
  have he := exp_pos (π * t)
  have hd := hirschmanDenominator_pos hr t
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + ((exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) / sin (π * r)) ^ 2 := by positivity
  field_simp
  have hp : sin (π * r) ^ 2 + (exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) ^ 2 =
      exp (π * t) ^ 2 + 1 + exp (π * t) * cos (π * r) * 2 := by
    nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq (π * r)]
  have hDp : 0 < exp (π * t) ^ 2 + 1 + exp (π * t) * cos (π * r) * 2 := by
    rw [← hp]
    positivity
  rw [hp]
  apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hr.1) (ne_of_gt hDp))).2
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hr.1]

name: Real.tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atTop {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Tendsto (hirschmanPrimitive r) atTop (𝓝 ((π / 2) / (π * r)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (π * r) :=
    sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1) (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have hexp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => exp (π * t)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_exp_atTop.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop pi_pos)
  have hin : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) / sin (π * r)) atTop atTop := by
    have hadd : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) atTop atTop :=
      hexp.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using
      hadd.atTop_mul_const (inv_pos.2 hs)
  change Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => arctan ((exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) / sin (π * r)) / (π * r)) _ _
  exact (((tendsto_arctan_atTop.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds).comp hin).div_const (π * r))

name: Real.tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atBot
statement:
theorem tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atBot {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Tendsto (hirschmanPrimitive r) atBot (𝓝 ((π / 2 - π * r) / (π * r)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sin (π * r) :=
    sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1) (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
  have hexp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => exp (π * t)) atBot (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atBot pi_pos)
  have hc : arctan (cos (π * r) / sin (π * r)) = π / 2 - π * r := by
    rw [show cos (π * r) / sin (π * r) = tan (π / 2 - π * r) by
      rw [tan_pi_div_two_sub, tan_eq_sin_div_cos, inv_div]]
    apply arctan_tan <;> nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.1, hr.2]
  have hlim := ((continuous_arctan.tendsto _).comp
    ((hexp.add_const (cos (π * r))).div_const (sin (π * r)))).div_const (π * r)
  change Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => arctan ((exp (π * t) + cos (π * r)) / sin (π * r)) / (π * r)) _ _
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_add, hc] using hlim

name: Real.integrable_hirschmanDensity
statement:
theorem integrable_hirschmanDensity {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Integrable (hirschmanDensity r)
proof:
:=
  integrable_of_even_nonneg_primitive (hirschmanDensity_neg r)
    (fun t => (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le) (hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitive hr)
    (tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atTop hr)

name: Real.integral_hirschmanDensity
statement:
theorem integral_hirschmanDensity {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ t, hirschmanDensity r t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto (hasDerivAt_hirschmanPrimitive hr)
    (integrable_hirschmanDensity hr) (tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atBot hr)
    (tendsto_hirschmanPrimitive_atTop hr)]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hr.1]
  ring

name: Real.tendsto_hirschmanDensity_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_hirschmanDensity_zero (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun r => hirschmanDensity r t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (hirschmanDensityZero t))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun r => hirschmanDensity r t) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] 0]
      (fun r => π * sinc (π * r) / (2 * (cosh (π * t) + cos (π * r)))) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
    rw [sinc_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero pi_ne_zero hr0), hirschmanDensity]
    field_simp [hr0]
  apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' heq.symm
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun r : ℝ => π * sinc (π * r) /
      (2 * (cosh (π * t) + cos (π * r)))) 0 := by
    apply ContinuousAt.div
    · fun_prop
    · fun_prop
    · simpa using ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
        (by linarith [cosh_pos (π * t)] : 0 < cosh (π * t) + 1))
  simpa only [hirschmanDensityZero, mul_zero, sinc_zero, cos_zero, mul_one] using
    hcont.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds

name: Real.hirschmanDensity_le_two_mul_zero
statement:
theorem hirschmanDensity_le_two_mul_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrhalf : r ≤ 1 / 2) (t : ℝ) :
    hirschmanDensity r t ≤ 2 * hirschmanDensityZero t
proof:
:= by
  have hangle : 0 ≤ π * r := (mul_pos pi_pos hr).le
  have hc : 0 ≤ cos (π * r) := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], by
    nlinarith [pi_pos]⟩
  have hch : 1 ≤ cosh (π * t) := by
    nlinarith [cosh_sq (π * t), sq_nonneg (sinh (π * t)), cosh_pos (π * t)]
  have hs : 0 ≤ sin (π * r) := sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hangle (by
    nlinarith [pi_pos])
  have hb : 0 < 2 * r * cosh (π * t) := mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hr) (cosh_pos _)
  calc
    hirschmanDensity r t ≤ sin (π * r) / (2 * r * cosh (π * t)) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hs hb (by
        have hprod : 0 ≤ (2 * r) * cos (π * r) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hc
        nlinarith)
    _ ≤ (π * r) / (2 * r * cosh (π * t)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sin_le hangle) hb.le
    _ = π / (2 * cosh (π * t)) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ 2 * hirschmanDensityZero t := by
      calc
        _ ≤ π / (cosh (π * t) + 1) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left pi_pos.le
          (by positivity) (by linarith)
        _ = _ := by unfold hirschmanDensityZero; field_simp

name: Real.continuous_hirschmanDensity
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_hirschmanDensity {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Continuous (hirschmanDensity r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hirschmanDensity
  apply Continuous.div
  · fun_prop
  · fun_prop
  · intro t
    exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hr.1) (hirschmanDenominator_pos hr t))

name: Real.tendsto_integral_hirschmanDensity_smul_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_hirschmanDensity_smul_zero
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : ℝ → E} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f volume) {B : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B) :
    Tendsto (fun r => ∫ t, hirschmanDensity r t • f t) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (∫ t, hirschmanDensityZero t • f t))
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (bound := fun t => (2 * B) * hirschmanDensityZero t)
  · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)] with r hr
    exact ((continuous_hirschmanDensity ⟨hr.1, by linarith [hr.2]⟩).aestronglyMeasurable).smul hf
  · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)] with r hr
    filter_upwards [hbound] with t ht
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hirschmanDensity_pos ⟨hr.1, by linarith [hr.2]⟩ t)]
    exact (mul_le_mul (hirschmanDensity_le_two_mul_zero hr.1 hr.2.le t) ht (norm_nonneg _)
      (by positivity [hirschmanDensityZero_pos t])).trans_eq (by ring)
  · exact integrable_hirschmanDensityZero.const_mul _
  · exact ae_of_all _ (fun t => (tendsto_hirschmanDensity_zero t).smul tendsto_const_nhds)

name: Real.one_sub_mul_hirschmanDensity_one_sub
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_hirschmanDensity_one_sub {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t =
      sin (π * r) / (2 * (cosh (π * t) - cos (π * r)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold hirschmanDensity
  rw [show π * (1 - r) = π - π * r by ring, sin_pi_sub, cos_pi_sub]
  have hr1 : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.2]
  field_simp [hr1]
  ring

name: Real.mul_hirschmanDensity
statement:
theorem mul_hirschmanDensity {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) :
    r * hirschmanDensity r t = sin (π * r) / (2 * (cosh (π * t) + cos (π * r)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold hirschmanDensity
  field_simp [hr]

name: Real.integral_boundary_weights_hirschmanDensity
statement:
theorem integral_boundary_weights_hirschmanDensity {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ t, (1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) = 1 - r ∧
      (∫ t, r * hirschmanDensity r t) = r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_hirschmanDensity (by constructor <;> linarith [hr.1, hr.2]), mul_one]
  · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_hirschmanDensity hr, mul_one]

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_primitive
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_primitive {Ω U : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    {G g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hG : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt G (g z) z) (hg : ContinuousOn g U)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hΓU : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ t, (γ t : ℂ) ∈ U) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let L : (Ω →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ℂ := Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ (fun z : Ω => G z)
  have he : cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ = L (Cubical.boundaryOne Γ) := by
    unfold cubicalCurveIntegral Cubical.boundaryOne
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro γ hγ
    rw [curveIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (cubicalPath γ) hG hg (hΓ γ hγ) (hΓU γ hγ)]
    simp [L]
  rw [he, hc, map_zero]

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_norm_sub_lt
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_norm_sub_lt {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {u v : ℂ} (hnear : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ t, ‖u - v‖ < ‖(γ t : ℂ) - u‖) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral Γ v = cubicalWindingIntegral Γ u
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set ℂ := {z | ‖u - v‖ < ‖z - u‖}
  have hu : ContinuousOn (fun z => (z - u)⁻¹) U :=
    (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀
      (fun z hz => (sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt hz).1)
  have hv : ContinuousOn (fun z => (z - v)⁻¹) U :=
    (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀
      (fun z hz => (sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt hz).2)
  have hz := cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_primitive Γ hc
    (fun z hz => hasDerivAt_log_div_sub_of_norm_sub_lt hz) (hv.sub hu) hΓ hnear
  have hi (w : ℂ) (hw : ∀ z ∈ U, z - w ≠ 0) :
      ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, CurveIntegrable
        (fun z => (z - w)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) := by
    intro γ hγ
    apply (((continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀ hw).smul continuousOn_const).curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn
      (hΓ γ hγ) (fun t => hnear γ hγ t)
  rw [cubicalCurveIntegral_sub Γ _ _
    (hi v (fun z hz => (sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt hz).2))
    (hi u (fun z hz => (sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt hz).1)), sub_eq_zero] at hz
  unfold cubicalWindingIntegral
  rw [hz]

name: Complex.eventually_cubicalWindingIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_cubicalWindingIntegral_eq {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {u : ℂ} (hu : u ∉ cubicalTrace Γ) :
    ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 u, cubicalWindingIntegral Γ v = cubicalWindingIntegral Γ u
proof:
:= by
  have hop : IsOpen ((cubicalTrace Γ)ᶜ) := (isCompact_cubicalTrace Γ).isClosed.isOpen_compl
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hop.mem_nhds hu)
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds u hε] with v hv
  apply cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_norm_sub_lt Γ hc hΓ
  intro γ hγ r
  have hnot : (γ r : ℂ) ∉ Metric.ball u ε :=
    fun hr => (hsub hr) (mem_cubicalTrace hγ r)
  have hlower : ε ≤ ‖(γ r : ℂ) - u‖ := by
    exact le_of_not_gt (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hnot)
  have hdist : ‖u - v‖ < ε := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hv
  exact hdist.trans_le hlower

name: Complex.isLocallyConstant_cubicalWindingIntegral
statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_cubicalWindingIntegral {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I) :
    IsLocallyConstant (fun u : {z : ℂ // z ∉ cubicalTrace Γ} => cubicalWindingIntegral Γ u)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsLocallyConstant.iff_eventually_eq _).mpr
  intro u
  exact continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually
    (eventually_cubicalWindingIntegral_eq Γ hc hΓ u.property)

name: Complex.norm_cubicalWindingIntegral_le_div_of_trace_bound
statement:
theorem norm_cubicalWindingIntegral_le_div_of_trace_bound {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ z ∈ cubicalTrace Γ, ‖z‖ ≤ R)
    {v : ℂ} (hv : R < ‖v‖) :
    ‖cubicalWindingIntegral Γ v‖ ≤
      (cubicalLength Γ / (2 * Real.pi)) / (‖v‖ - R)
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : 0 < ‖v‖ - R := sub_pos.mpr hv
  have hb := norm_two_pi_i_inv_mul_cubicalCurveIntegral_le_length_mul Γ
    (fun z => (z - v)⁻¹) (C := (‖v‖ - R)⁻¹) hΓ (by
    intro γ hγ t
    have hrev := norm_sub_norm_le v (γ t : ℂ)
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at hrev
    have hl : ‖v‖ - R ≤ ‖(γ t : ℂ) - v‖ := by
      linarith [hR (γ t) (mem_cubicalTrace hγ t)]
    rw [norm_inv]
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hδ hl)
  simpa only [cubicalWindingIntegral, div_eq_mul_inv] using hb

name: Complex.isBounded_cubicalWindingIntegral_level_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hRpos, hR⟩ := (isCompact_cubicalTrace Γ).isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  let L : ℝ := cubicalLength Γ / (2 * Real.pi)
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := div_nonneg (cubicalLength_nonneg Γ) (by positivity)
  have hwpos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw
  apply isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
  refine ⟨R + L / ‖w‖ + 1, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  by_contra hnot
  have hbig : R + L / ‖w‖ + 1 < ‖v‖ := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ L / ‖w‖ := div_nonneg hL hwpos.le
  have hfar : R < ‖v‖ := by linarith
  have hb := norm_cubicalWindingIntegral_le_div_of_trace_bound Γ hΓ hR hfar
  rw [show cubicalWindingIntegral Γ v = w from hv] at hb
  have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hfar)).mp hb
  have hstrict : L < (‖v‖ - R) * ‖w‖ :=
    (div_lt_iff₀ hwpos).mp (by linarith : L / ‖w‖ < ‖v‖ - R)
  change ‖w‖ * (‖v‖ - R) ≤ L at hmul
  nlinarith

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_preconnected
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_preconnected {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {S : Set ℂ} (hs : IsPreconnected S) (hoff : S ⊆ (cubicalTrace Γ)ᶜ)
    (hunbounded : ¬ Bornology.IsBounded S) {u : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ S) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral Γ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : PreconnectedSpace S := Subtype.preconnectedSpace hs
  have hloc := (isLocallyConstant_cubicalWindingIntegral Γ hc hΓ).comp_continuous
    (show Continuous (fun v : S => (⟨v, hoff v.property⟩ : {z : ℂ // z ∉ cubicalTrace Γ}))
      from continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)
  by_contra hne
  apply hunbounded
  apply (isBounded_cubicalWindingIntegral_level_of_ne_zero Γ hΓ hne).subset
  intro v hv
  exact hloc.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨u, hu⟩

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_component
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_component {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {u : ℂ} (hu : u ∉ cubicalTrace Γ)
    (hunbounded : ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (connectedComponentIn (cubicalTrace Γ)ᶜ u)) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral Γ u = 0
proof:
:=
  cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_preconnected Γ hc hΓ
    isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _) hunbounded
    (mem_connectedComponentIn hu)

name: Complex.mem_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_of_winding_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_boundedComplementFill_cubicalTrace_of_winding_ne_zero
    {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {τ : ℂ} (hw : cubicalWindingIntegral Γ τ ≠ 0) :
    τ ∈ boundedComplementFill (cubicalTrace Γ)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨hoff, hunbounded⟩ := not_mem_boundedComplementFill_iff.mp hnot
  exact hw (cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_zero_of_unbounded_component Γ hc hΓ hoff hunbounded)

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_pathChain_eq_one_of_curveIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_pathChain_eq_one_of_curveIntegral_eq
    {Ω : Set ℂ} {k : ℕ} (p : Fin (k + 1) → Ω)
    (γ : (i : Fin k) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hp : p (Fin.last k) = p 0)
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I)
    {a b x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Icc a b)
    (hoff : ∀ i r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ((γ i) r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hpos : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - (x₀ : ℂ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val) = 1) :
    ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, cubicalWindingIntegral (Cubical.pathChain p γ) (x : ℂ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : cubicalWindingIntegral (Cubical.pathChain p γ) (x₀ : ℂ) = 1 := by
    unfold cubicalWindingIntegral
    rw [cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_curveIntegral_concat]
    · exact hpos
    · intro i
      have hne : ∀ z ∈ range ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val), z - (x₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        rintro z ⟨r, rfl⟩
        exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hoff i r x₀ hx₀)
      exact (((continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀ hne).smul continuousOn_const)
        |>.curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hγ i) (fun r => mem_range_self r)
  intro x hx
  apply (cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_mem_real_interval (Cubical.pathChain p γ)
    (Cubical.boundaryOne_pathChain_eq_zero p γ hp)
    (contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hγ) hx₀ hx ?_).trans hbase
  intro t ht htrace
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp htrace
  obtain ⟨hqs, r, hr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hq
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Cubical.exists_piece_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hqs
  exact hoff i r t ht hr

name: Complex.curveIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b)
    {U : Set ℂ} {G g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hG : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt G (g z) z) (hg : ContinuousOn g U)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend I) (hγU : ∀ r, γ r ∈ U) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ = G b - G a
proof:
:= by
  have h := primitiveSubdivisionTransport_eq_curveIntegral_of_hasDerivAt γ hγ
    (n := 1) (p := fun i => (i : ℝ)) (G := fun _ => G) (U := fun _ => U)
    (fun i _ => by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ i) (by simp) (by simp)
    (fun i hi => by
      change 0 ≤ (i : ℝ) ∧ (i : ℝ) ≤ 1
      exact ⟨Nat.cast_nonneg i, by exact_mod_cast hi⟩)
    (fun _ _ => hG) (fun _ _ => hg) (by
      intro i hi t ht
      have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
      subst i
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, Nat.cast_one] at ht
      rw [γ.extend_apply ht]
      exact hγU ⟨t, ht⟩)
  simpa [primitiveSubdivisionTransport] using h.symm

name: Complex.sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt
statement:
theorem sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt {u v z : ℂ} (h : ‖u - v‖ < ‖z - u‖) :
    z - u ≠ 0 ∧ z - v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    rw [heq, norm_zero] at h
    exact (not_lt.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) h
  · intro heq
    have hz : z = v := sub_eq_zero.mp heq
    subst z
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at h
    exact (lt_irrefl _) h

name: Complex.hasDerivAt_log_div_sub_of_norm_sub_lt
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_log_div_sub_of_norm_sub_lt {u v z : ℂ} (h : ‖u - v‖ < ‖z - u‖) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z => log ((z - v) / (z - u))) ((z - v)⁻¹ - (z - u)⁻¹) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, hv⟩ := sub_ne_zero_and_sub_ne_zero_of_norm_sub_lt h
  have hlog : (z - v) / (z - u) ∈ slitPlane := by
    have heq : (z - v) / (z - u) = 1 + (u - v) / (z - u) := by
      field_simp [hu]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    apply mem_slitPlane_of_norm_lt_one
    rw [norm_div]
    exact (div_lt_one (norm_pos_iff.mpr hu)).mpr h
  have hd := (((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const v).div ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const u) hu).clog hlog
  have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun z => log ((z - v) / (z - u)))
      (((1 * (z - u) - (z - v) * 1) / (z - u) ^ 2) / ((z - v) / (z - u))) z := by
    simpa only [id_eq, Pi.div_apply] using hd
  apply hd'.congr_deriv
  field_simp [hu, hv]

name: Complex.cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_squareBoundary
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (q (projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one t.1, projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one t.2) : ℂ)
  have hψ : Continuous ψ := (continuous_subtype_val.comp q.continuous).comp
    ((continuous_projIcc.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (continuous_projIcc.comp continuous_snd))
  let D := Classical.choice (nonempty_primitiveHomotopyGrid_of_differentiableOn hψ hΩ hg
    (fun _ _ => (q _).property))
  have hp (γ : C(I, Ω)) := nonempty_primitivePathSubdivision_of_differentiableOn
    (cubicalPath γ) hΩ hg (fun t => (γ t).property)
  simp only [Cubical.squareBoundary, map_add, map_sub, cubicalPrimitiveIntegral,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
  apply primitivePathIntegral_boundary_eq_zero_of_grid
    (cubicalPath (Cubical.left q)) (cubicalPath (Cubical.right q))
    (cubicalPath (Cubical.bottom q)) (cubicalPath (Cubical.top q))
    (hp _) (hp _) (hp _) (hp _) hψ D
  · intro t ht
    rw [(cubicalPath (Cubical.left q)).extend_apply ht]
    simp [cubicalPath, ψ, Cubical.left, projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht]
  · intro t ht
    rw [(cubicalPath (Cubical.right q)).extend_apply ht]
    simp [cubicalPath, ψ, Cubical.right, projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht]
  · intro t ht
    rw [(cubicalPath (Cubical.bottom q)).extend_apply ht]
    simp [cubicalPath, ψ, Cubical.bottom, projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht]
  · intro t ht
    rw [(cubicalPath (Cubical.top q)).extend_apply ht]
    simp [cubicalPath, ψ, Cubical.top, projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht]

name: Complex.cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_boundaryTwo
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cubical.boundaryTwo, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_squareBoundary hΩ hg,
    smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: Complex.cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_constantChain
proof:
:= by
  have hz (x : Ω) : cubicalPrimitiveIntegral g hΩ hg
      (Finsupp.single (ContinuousMap.const I x) 1) = 0 := by
    rw [cubicalPrimitiveIntegral, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    change primitivePathIntegral g (Path.refl (x : ℂ)) _ = 0
    exact primitivePathIntegral_refl _
  rw [Cubical.constantChain, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, hz, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: Complex.cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral
statement:
theorem cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral {Ω : Set ℂ}
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I) :
    cubicalPrimitiveIntegral g hΩ hg Γ = cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicalPrimitiveIntegral cubicalCurveIntegral
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro γ hγ
  rw [primitivePathIntegral_eq_curveIntegral _ _ (hΓ γ hγ)]

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_isNullHomologous
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_isNullHomologous {Ω : Set ℂ}
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω) (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ) : cubicalCurveIntegral g Γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_eq_cubicalCurveIntegral hΩ hg Γ hΓ]
  obtain ⟨S, D, rfl⟩ := hnull
  rw [map_add, cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_boundaryTwo hΩ hg,
    cubicalPrimitiveIntegral_constantChain hΩ hg, add_zero]

name: Real.isProbabilityMeasure_hirschmanMeasure
statement:

    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_hirschmanDensity hr)
      (ae_of_all _ (fun t => (hirschmanDensity_pos hr t).le)), integral_hirschmanDensity hr]

name: Real.integral_hirschmanMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_hirschmanMeasure {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : ℝ → E) :
    ∫ t, f t ∂hirschmanMeasure r = ∫ t, hirschmanDensity r t • f t
proof:
