    (continuous_hirschmanDensity hr).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hirschmanDensity_pos hr _).le]

name: Complex.neg_normalized_exp_circleIntegral_re_nonneg
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_exp_circleIntegral_re_nonneg
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {R M C : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hRM : R < M)
    (hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h {z | z.im ≠ 0 ∨ R < ‖z‖})
    (href : ∀ z : ℂ, h (conj z) = conj (h z))
    (him : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (h z).im)
    (hbound : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ M + 1 → ‖h z‖ ≤ C) :
    0 ≤ (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, M), exp z * h z))).re
proof:
:= by
  apply nonneg_of_neg_normalized_exp_ellipseIntegral_re_eq
    (h := h) (M := M) (C := C) (δ := 1) hM.le zero_lt_one
  · intro ε hε
    apply hh.continuousOn.comp (by unfold ellipseMap; fun_prop)
    intro θ _
    exact ellipseMap_mem_off_real_or_exterior hM hε.1 hRM
  · intro ε _ θ _
    exact href _
  · exact him
  · intro ε hε θ _
    apply hbound
    exact (norm_ellipseMap_le hM.le hε.1.le _).trans (by linarith [hε.2])
  · intro ε hε
    rw [← circleIntegral_eq_ellipseIntegral_of_differentiableOn_off_real_or_exterior
      (f := fun z => exp z * h z) hM hε.1 hRM (differentiable_exp.differentiableOn.mul hh)]

name: Complex.curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane
    {a b τ r : ℂ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ t, r * (Path.segment a b t - τ) ∈ slitPlane) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment a b) =
      log (r * (b - τ)) - log (r * (a - τ))
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set ℂ := range (Path.segment a b)
  have hslit (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ U) : r * (z - τ) ∈ slitPlane := by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact hs t
  have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ U) : z - τ ≠ 0 :=
    fun he => slitPlane_ne_zero (hslit z hz) (by rw [he, mul_zero])
  have hG (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ U) :
      HasDerivAt (fun z => log (r * (z - τ))) (z - τ)⁻¹ z := by
    have hd := (((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const τ).const_mul r).clog (hslit z hz)
    simp only [id_eq, mul_one] at hd
    apply hd.congr_deriv
    field_simp [hr, hne z hz]
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => (z - τ)⁻¹) U :=
    (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀ hne
  exact curveIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (Path.segment a b) hG hg
    (Path.contDiffOn_extend_segment a b 1) (fun t => mem_range_self t)

name: Complex.log_neg_eq_sub_of_im_pos
statement:
private theorem log_neg_eq_sub_of_im_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :

  · simp [log_re]
  · simp [log_im, arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos hz]

name: Complex.log_neg_eq_add_of_im_neg
statement:
private theorem log_neg_eq_add_of_im_neg {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im < 0) :

name: Complex.im_segment_horizontal
statement:
private theorem im_segment_horizontal (x y h : ℝ) (t : I) :
    (Path.segment ((x : ℂ) + h * Complex.I) ((y : ℂ) + h * Complex.I) t).im = h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Path.segment_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, add_im, smul_im,
    ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, I_im, I_re, mul_one, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]

name: Complex.re_segment_vertical
statement:
private theorem re_segment_vertical (x c d : ℝ) (t : I) :
    (Path.segment ((x : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((x : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) t).re = x

name: Complex.curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_two_pi_I
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_two_pi_I
    {a b c d : ℝ} {τ : ℂ}
    (ha : a < τ.re) (hb : τ.re < b) (hc : c < τ.im) (hd : τ.im < d) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I)) +
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hbottom := curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane
    (τ := τ) (r := (1 : ℂ)) one_ne_zero (a := (a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) (b := (b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) (by
      intro t
      rw [one_mul]
      apply mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr
      right
      have h : (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) t - τ).im < 0 := by
        rw [sub_im, im_segment_horizontal]
        linarith
      exact ne_of_lt h)
  have hright := curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane
    (τ := τ) (r := (1 : ℂ)) one_ne_zero (a := (b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) (b := (b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) (by
      intro t
      rw [one_mul]
      apply mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr
      left
      rw [sub_re, re_segment_vertical]
      linarith)
  have htop := curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane
    (τ := τ) (r := (1 : ℂ)) one_ne_zero (a := (a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) (b := (b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) (by
      intro t
      rw [one_mul]
      apply mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr
      right
      have h : 0 < (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) t - τ).im := by
        rw [sub_im, im_segment_horizontal]
        linarith
      exact ne_of_gt h)
  have hleft := curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane
    (τ := τ) (r := (-1 : ℂ)) (by norm_num) (a := (a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) (b := (a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) (by
      intro t
      apply mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr
      left
      rw [neg_one_mul, neg_re, sub_re, re_segment_vertical]
      linarith)
  simp only [one_mul, neg_one_mul] at hbottom hright htop hleft
  rw [hbottom, hright, htop, hleft]
  have hpos : 0 < (((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) - τ).im := by simp; linarith
  have hneg : (((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) - τ).im < 0 := by simp; linarith
  rw [log_neg_eq_sub_of_im_pos hpos, log_neg_eq_add_of_im_neg hneg]
  ring

name: Complex.re_rotated_segment_pos
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 := t.property.1
  have ht1 := t.property.2
  have he : (r * (Path.segment a b t - τ)).re =
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) * (r * (a - τ)).re + (t : ℝ) * (r * (b - τ)).re := by
    simp [Path.segment_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, mul_re, sub_re, sub_im,
      add_re, add_im]
    ring
  rw [he]
  by_cases ht : (t : ℝ) = 1
  · simpa [ht] using hb
  · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
      (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht1 ht)) ha) (mul_nonneg ht0 hb.le)

name: Complex.curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos
    {v₀ v₁ v₂ v₃ τ r : ℂ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < (r * (v₀ - τ)).re) (h₁ : 0 < (r * (v₁ - τ)).re)
    (h₂ : 0 < (r * (v₂ - τ)).re) (h₃ : 0 < (r * (v₃ - τ)).re) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₀ v₁) +
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₁ v₂) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₃ v₂) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₀ v₃) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs {a b : ℂ} (ha : 0 < (r * (a - τ)).re) (hb : 0 < (r * (b - τ)).re) (t : I) :
      r * (Path.segment a b t - τ) ∈ slitPlane :=
    mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (re_rotated_segment_pos ha hb t))
  rw [curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane hr (hs h₀ h₁),
    curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane hr (hs h₁ h₂),
    curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane hr (hs h₃ h₂),
    curveIntegral_inv_sub_segment_eq_log_mul_sub_of_slitPlane hr (hs h₀ h₃)]
  ring

name: Complex.curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_zero_of_outside
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_zero_of_outside
    {a b c d : ℝ} {τ : ℂ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hout : τ.re < a ∨ b < τ.re ∨ τ.im < c ∨ d < τ.im) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I)) +
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hout with h | h | h | h
  · apply curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos (r := 1) one_ne_zero
    all_goals simp; linarith
  · apply curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos (r := -1) (by norm_num)
    all_goals simp; linarith
  · apply curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos (r := -Complex.I) (by simp)
    all_goals simp [mul_re, mul_im]; linarith
  · apply curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos (r := Complex.I) I_ne_zero
    all_goals simp [mul_re, mul_im]; linarith

name: Complex.tendsto_circleAverage_regularizedLogNorm_hirschman
statement:
theorem tendsto_circleAverage_regularizedLogNorm_hirschman {r B ε : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1))
    (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖g z‖ ≤ B)
    (hε : 0 < ε) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ n, ρ n ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlim : Tendsto ρ atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => Real.circleAverage
      (fun z => regularizedLogNorm ε (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z))) 0 (ρ n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.circleAverage (fun z => regularizedLogNorm ε
        (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z))) 0 1))
proof:
:= by
  let C := |Real.log ε| + |Real.log (sqrt (B ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))|
  let P := ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal (0 : ℝ) (1 : NNReal)
  let U (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ) := (ρ n : ℂ) * circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q)
  let W (q : ℝ) := log ((Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-I) / (π : ℂ)
  have hU (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ) : U n q ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    have hn : ‖U n q‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [U, norm_mul, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos (hρ n).1] using (hρ n).2
    simpa using hn
  have hstrip (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ) :
      hirschmanDiskToStrip r (U n q) ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1 :=
    Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hirschmanDiskToStrip_re_mem_Ioo hr (hU n q))
  have hcont (n : ℕ) : Continuous (fun q : ℝ => regularizedLogNorm ε
      (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r (U n q)))) :=
    (continuous_regularizedLogNorm hε).comp
      (hg.comp_continuous (continuous_hirschmanDiskToStrip_radial hr (hρ n)) (hstrip n))
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ q : ℝ, Tendsto (fun n => P q * regularizedLogNorm ε
      (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r (U n q)))) atTop (𝓝 (P q * regularizedLogNorm ε (g (W q)))) := by
    have hs : 0 < Real.sin (π * r) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (mul_pos pi_pos hr.1)
      (by nlinarith [pi_pos, hr.2])
    filter_upwards [volume.ae_ne (-Real.cos (π * r) / Real.sin (π * r))] with q hq
    have hw : Real.cos (π * r) + Real.sin (π * r) * q ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hq
      apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hs)).mpr
      linarith
    have hUl : Tendsto (fun n => U n q) atTop
        (𝓝 (circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q))) := by
      have ht := ((continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp hρlim).mul_const
        (circleMap 0 1 (hirschmanBoundaryAngle q))
      simp only [ofReal_one, one_mul] at ht
      exact ht.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    have hφ := tendsto_hirschmanDiskToStrip_boundary hr (fun n => hU n q) hUl hw
    have hgl : Tendsto (fun n => g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r (U n q))) atTop (𝓝 (g (W q))) :=
      (hg _ (hirschmanLog_real_re_mem_Icc _)).tendsto.comp
        (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hφ, Eventually.of_forall fun n => hstrip n q⟩)
    exact ((continuous_regularizedLogNorm hε).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hgl).const_mul (P q)
  have hDCT := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun q : ℝ => C * P q)
    (fun n => ((ProbabilityTheory.measurable_cauchyPDFReal 0 1).mul (hcont n).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((ProbabilityTheory.integrable_cauchyPDFReal 0 (γ := 1)).const_mul C)
    (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun q => by
      have hp : 0 ≤ P q := by dsimp [P, ProbabilityTheory.cauchyPDFReal]; positivity
      dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hp, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (abs_regularizedLogNorm_le hε hB (hbound _ (hstrip n q))) hp)
    hlim
  have hEq (n : ℕ) : Real.circleAverage
      (fun z => regularizedLogNorm ε (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z))) 0 (ρ n) =
      ∫ q : ℝ, P q * regularizedLogNorm ε (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r (U n q))) := by
    rw [circleAverage_zero_radius_eq_circleAverage_smul,
      circleAverage_eq_integral_hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
    simp_rw [hirschmanBoundaryWeight_eq_cauchy]
    rfl
  have hEqB : Real.circleAverage
      (fun z => regularizedLogNorm ε (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z))) 0 1 =
      ∫ q : ℝ, P q * regularizedLogNorm ε (g (W q)) := by
    rw [circleAverage_eq_integral_hirschmanBoundaryAngle]
    simp_rw [hirschmanBoundaryWeight_eq_cauchy]
    congr 1
    funext q
    simp only [hirschmanDiskToStrip, hirschmanDiskToHalfPlane_circleMap_boundary, W, P]
  simpa only [hEq, hEqB, Pi.mul_apply, P] using hDCT

name: Complex.regularizedLogNorm_le_hirschman_boundary_integrals
statement:
theorem regularizedLogNorm_le_hirschman_boundary_integrals {r B ε : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1))
    (ha : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖g z‖ ≤ B)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    regularizedLogNorm ε (g (r : ℂ)) ≤
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) *
        regularizedLogNorm ε (g ((t : ℂ) * I))) +
      ∫ t : ℝ, (r * hirschmanDensity r t) *
        regularizedLogNorm ε (g (1 + (t : ℂ) * I))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, -, hρ, hρlim⟩ := exists_seq_strictMono_tendsto' (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  have hlim := tendsto_circleAverage_regularizedLogNorm_hirschman hr hg hB hbound hε hρ hρlim
  have hle : regularizedLogNorm ε (g (r : ℂ)) ≤
      Real.circleAverage (fun z => regularizedLogNorm ε (g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z))) 0 1 := by
    apply ge_of_tendsto' hlim
    intro n
    have hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => g (hirschmanDiskToStrip r z)) (closedBall 0 (ρ n)) := by
      intro z hz
      have hn : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ n := by simpa using hz
      have hb : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simpa using hn.trans_lt (hρ n).2
      exact (ha _ (hirschmanDiskToStrip_re_mem_Ioo hr hb)).comp
        (analyticOnNhd_hirschmanDiskToStrip hr _ hb)
    have hj := hf.log_sqrt_norm_sq_add_sq_le_circleAverage (hρ n).1 hε
    simpa only [hirschmanDiskToStrip_zero hr, regularizedLogNorm] using hj
  rw [circleAverage_hirschmanDiskToStrip_eq_boundary_integrals hr
    (fun z => regularizedLogNorm ε (g z))
    (integrable_cauchy_mul_regularizedLog_boundary hg hB hbound hε _ _)] at hle
  exact hle

name: Complex.tendsto_conj_cobounded
statement:
private theorem tendsto_conj_cobounded :
    Tendsto (conj : ℂ → ℂ) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tendsto_norm_atTop_iff_cobounded]
  simpa only [norm_conj] using (tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := ℂ))

name: Complex.tendsto_affine_ratio
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Tendsto (fun u : ℂ => u⁻¹) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv₀_cobounded
  have ht : Tendsto (fun u => (f u - d * u) * u⁻¹ + d)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 d) := by
    simpa using (hf.mul hi).add_const d
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_cobounded_le_norm (1 : ℝ)] with u hu
  have hune : u ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; norm_num [hzero] at hu
  field_simp
  ring

name: Complex.eventually_conj_eq_of_tendsto_affine_of_finite_matching
statement:
theorem eventually_conj_eq_of_tendsto_affine_of_finite_matching
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (f : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (d : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ)
    (hd : Function.Injective d)
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun u => f i u - (d i : ℂ) * u)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (c i)))
    (hmatch : ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i,
      ∃ j, conj (f i (conj u)) = f j u) :
    ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i, f i (conj u) = conj (f i u)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio (i : ι) : Tendsto (fun u => f i u * u⁻¹)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (d i : ℂ)) := tendsto_affine_ratio (hlim i)
  have href (i : ι) : Tendsto (fun u => conj (f i (conj u)) * u⁻¹)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (d i : ℂ)) := by
    have h := continuous_conj.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      ((hratio i).comp tendsto_conj_cobounded)
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
  have hneq : ∀ i j, ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
      i ≠ j → conj (f i (conj u)) ≠ f j u := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ h => False.elim (h hij))
    have hdiff : (d i : ℂ) - (d j : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      exact hij (hd (ofReal_injective (sub_eq_zero.mp heq)))
    filter_upwards [((href i).sub (hratio j)).eventually_ne hdiff] with u hu _ heq
    exact hu (by rw [heq]; ring)
  have hneq' : ∀ᶠ u in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i j,
      i ≠ j → conj (f i (conj u)) ≠ f j u := by
    simpa only [Filter.eventually_all] using hneq
  filter_upwards [hmatch, hneq'] with u hm hn i
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hm i
  have hij : i = j := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hn i j hne hj
  subst j
  simpa using congrArg conj hj

name: Real.abs_arcsin_le_two_mul_abs
statement:
theorem abs_arcsin_le_two_mul_abs {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |arcsin x| ≤ 2 * |x|
proof:
:= by
  have hd (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2)) :
      HasDerivWithinAt arcsin (1 / sqrt (1 - y^2))
        (Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2)) y :=
    (hasDerivAt_arcsin (by linarith [hy.1]) (by linarith [hy.2])).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hb (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2)) :
      ‖1 / sqrt (1 - y^2)‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have hy2 : y^2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith [hy.1, hy.2]
    have hs : 0 < sqrt (1 - y^2) := sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hsq := sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - y^2)
    rw [norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hs)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hs).mpr
    nlinarith
  have h := (convex_Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
    (x := 0) (y := x) hd hb (by constructor <;> norm_num) (abs_le.mp hx)
  simpa only [arcsin_zero, sub_zero, norm_eq_abs] using h

name: Real.arsinh_le_self
statement: theorem arsinh_le_self {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : arsinh x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    arsinh x ≤ sinh (arsinh x) := self_le_sinh_iff.mpr (arsinh_nonneg_iff.mpr hx)
    _ = x := sinh_arsinh x

name: Complex.exists_small_sin_coordinates_upper
statement:
private theorem exists_small_sin_coordinates_upper {x y r : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrh : r ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hxy : x^2 + y^2 = r^2) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, Real.sin a * Real.cosh b = x ∧
      Real.cos a * Real.sinh b = y ∧
      |a| ≤ 2 * |x| ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧
      b ≤ y / Real.sqrt (1 - r^2) ∧ b ≤ 2 * y
proof:
:= by
  let d := 1 - r^2
  let v := (Real.sqrt (d^2 + 4*y^2) - d) / 2
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; nlinarith
  have hr2 : r^2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ d^2 + 4*y^2)
    have hsn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (d^2 + 4*y^2)
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  have hveq : v * (v + d) = y^2 := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ d^2 + 4*y^2)
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  have hvle : v ≤ y^2 / d := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hd).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg v]
  have hroot : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + v) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hrootsq := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + v)
  have hrootge : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + v) := by nlinarith
  have hxle : |x| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hxsq : x^2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
    rw [← sq_abs x] at hxsq
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
  have hquot : |x / Real.sqrt (1 + v)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hroot]
    exact (div_le_self (abs_nonneg x) hrootge).trans hxle
  let a := Real.arcsin (x / Real.sqrt (1 + v))
  let b := Real.arsinh (Real.sqrt v)
  have hsa : Real.sin a = x / Real.sqrt (1 + v) :=
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [(abs_le.mp hquot).1])
      (by linarith [(abs_le.mp hquot).2])
  have hcb : Real.cosh b = Real.sqrt (1 + v) := by
    dsimp [b]
    rw [Real.cosh_arsinh, Real.sq_sqrt hv]
  have hsb : Real.sinh b = Real.sqrt v := Real.sinh_arsinh _
  have hca : 0 ≤ Real.cos a := Real.cos_arcsin_nonneg _
  have hcq : (Real.cos a)^2 = 1 - x^2 / (1 + v) := by
    have h := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a
    rw [hsa, div_pow, hrootsq] at h
    linarith
  have hcy : Real.cos a * Real.sqrt v = y := by
    have hsq : (Real.cos a * Real.sqrt v)^2 = y^2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hv, hcq]
      have hpos : 1 + v ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hpos]
      dsimp [d] at hveq
      nlinarith
    have hn : 0 ≤ Real.cos a * Real.sqrt v := mul_nonneg hca (Real.sqrt_nonneg v)
    nlinarith
  have hbn : 0 ≤ b := Real.arsinh_nonneg_iff.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg v)
  have hble : b ≤ Real.sqrt v := Real.arsinh_le_self (Real.sqrt_nonneg v)
  have hsqrtd : 0 < Real.sqrt d := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hd
  have hvsqrt : Real.sqrt v ≤ y / Real.sqrt d := by
    have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hv
    have hdsq := Real.sq_sqrt hd.le
    have hp : 0 ≤ y / Real.sqrt d := div_nonneg hy hsqrtd.le
    have hdivsq : v ≤ (y / Real.sqrt d)^2 := by
      rwa [div_pow, hdsq]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg v]
  have hds : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.sqrt d := by
    have hdsq := Real.sq_sqrt hd.le
    have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg d
    dsimp [d] at hdsq
    nlinarith
  have hquotabs : |x / Real.sqrt (1 + v)| ≤ |x| := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hroot]
    exact div_le_self (abs_nonneg x) hrootge
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_, ?_, hbn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsa, hcb, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hroot.ne']
  · rw [hsb, hcy]
  · exact (Real.abs_arcsin_le_two_mul_abs hquot).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquotabs (by norm_num))
  · exact hble.trans hvsqrt
  · refine hble.trans (hvsqrt.trans ?_)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hsqrtd).mpr
    nlinarith

name: Complex.exists_sin_eq_of_norm_le_half
statement:
theorem exists_sin_eq_of_norm_le_half {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∃ u : ℂ, sin u = z ∧ ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * ‖z‖ ∧
      |u.im| ≤ |z.im| / Real.sqrt (1 - ‖z‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : z.re^2 + |z.im|^2 = ‖z‖^2 := by
    rw [sq_abs, ← normSq_eq_norm_sq, normSq_apply]
    ring
  obtain ⟨a, b, hre, him, ha, hb, hble, hb2⟩ := exists_small_sin_coordinates_upper
    (abs_nonneg z.im) (norm_nonneg z) hz hxy
  let u : ℂ := ⟨a, if 0 ≤ z.im then b else -b⟩
  have hum : |u.im| = b := by
    dsimp [u]
    split_ifs
    · exact abs_of_nonneg hb
    · rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hb]
  have husq : ‖u‖^2 = a^2 + b^2 := by
    rw [← normSq_eq_norm_sq, normSq_apply]
    change a * a + (if 0 ≤ z.im then b else -b) *
      (if 0 ≤ z.im then b else -b) = a^2 + b^2
    split_ifs <;> ring
  refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sin_eq]
    simp only [← ofReal_sin, ← ofReal_cosh, ← ofReal_cos, ← ofReal_sinh]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [u, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, mul_re, mul_im, I_re, I_im,
        add_re, mul_zero, sub_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, add_zero]
      split_ifs
      · exact hre
      · simpa only [Real.cosh_neg] using hre
    · simp only [u, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, mul_re, mul_im, I_re, I_im,
        add_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, mul_one]
      split_ifs with hy
      · simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hy] using him
      · rw [Real.sinh_neg, mul_neg, him, abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hy), neg_neg]
  · have hasq : a^2 ≤ (2 * |z.re|)^2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs a]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg a) ha 2
    have hbsq : b^2 ≤ (2 * |z.im|)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb hb2 2
    have hzsq : z.re^2 + z.im^2 = ‖z‖^2 := by simpa only [sq_abs] using hxy
    simp only [mul_pow, sq_abs] at hasq hbsq
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg u, norm_nonneg z]
  · rw [hum]
    exact hble

name: AnalyticOnNhd.log_norm_center_le_circleAverage
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (closedBall c |R|) := by simpa only [abs_of_pos hR] using hf
  have h := hf'.circleAverage_log_norm hR.ne' hc
  rw [abs_of_pos hR] at h
  rw [h]
  apply le_add_of_nonneg_left
  apply finsum_nonneg
  intro u
  by_cases hu : u ∈ closedBall c R
  · have hcoeff : (0 : ℝ) ≤ MeromorphicOn.divisor f (closedBall c R) u :=
      by exact_mod_cast hf.divisor_nonneg u
    apply mul_nonneg hcoeff
    by_cases huc : u = c
    · simp [huc]
    · apply Real.log_nonneg
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
      apply (one_le_div (by exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm huc)))).2
      simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm'] using hu
  · simp [hu]

name: Complex.regularizedLogWitness_self
statement:
theorem regularizedLogWitness_self (a : ℂ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    regularizedLogWitness a ε a = ((sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2) / ε : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : 0 < normSq a + ε ^ 2 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (normSq_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
  have hS : sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sqrt_pos.2 hP)
  unfold regularizedLogWitness
  rw [← normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, ← ofReal_add, ← ofReal_div]
  apply congrArg ofReal
  apply (div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hε) hS)).2
  rw [show sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2) / ε * (ε * sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2)) =
    sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2) ^ 2 by field_simp]
  exact (sq_sqrt hP.le).symm

name: Complex.normSq_regularizedLogWitness_numerator_le
statement:
theorem normSq_regularizedLogWitness_numerator_le (a z : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) :
    normSq (conj a * z + ((ε ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ≤
      (normSq a + ε ^ 2) * (normSq z + ε ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hid : (normSq a + ε ^ 2) * (normSq z + ε ^ 2) -
      normSq (conj a * z + ((ε ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ε ^ 2 * normSq (a - z) := by
    simp only [normSq_apply, add_re, add_im, mul_re, mul_im, conj_re, conj_im,
      ofReal_re, ofReal_im, sub_re, sub_im]
    ring
  have hpos := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ε) (normSq_nonneg (a - z))
  linarith

name: Complex.norm_regularizedLogWitness_le
statement:
theorem norm_regularizedLogWitness_le (a z : ℂ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖regularizedLogWitness a ε z‖ ≤ sqrt (normSq z + ε ^ 2) / ε
proof:
:= by
  have hPa : 0 < normSq a + ε ^ 2 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (normSq_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
  have hPz : 0 < normSq z + ε ^ 2 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (normSq_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
  have hSa : 0 < sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2) := sqrt_pos.2 hPa
  have hSz : 0 < sqrt (normSq z + ε ^ 2) := sqrt_pos.2 hPz
  rw [regularizedLogWitness, norm_div, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (mul_pos hε hSa)]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hε hSa)).2
  rw [show sqrt (normSq z + ε ^ 2) / ε * (ε * sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2)) =
    sqrt (normSq z + ε ^ 2) * sqrt (normSq a + ε ^ 2) by field_simp]
  have h := normSq_regularizedLogWitness_numerator_le a z ε
  rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq] at h
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hSz.le hSa.le)).mp
  rw [mul_pow, sq_sqrt hPz.le, sq_sqrt hPa.le]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using h

name: AnalyticOnNhd.log_sqrt_norm_sq_add_sq_le_circleAverage
statement:
theorem _root_.AnalyticOnNhd.log_sqrt_norm_sq_add_sq_le_circleAverage
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R ε : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (closedBall c R)) :
    Real.log (sqrt (‖f c‖ ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) ≤
      Real.circleAverage (fun z => Real.log (sqrt (‖f z‖ ^ 2 + ε ^ 2))) c R
proof:
:= by
  let Q (z : ℂ) := sqrt (normSq (f z) + ε ^ 2)
  have hQpos (z : ℂ) : 0 < Q z := sqrt_pos.2
    (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (normSq_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos hε))
  have hQge (z : ℂ) : ε ≤ Q z := by
    calc
      ε = sqrt (ε ^ 2) := (sqrt_sq hε.le).symm
      _ ≤ Q z := sqrt_le_sqrt (le_add_of_nonneg_left (normSq_nonneg _))
  have hMpos (z : ℂ) : 0 < Q z / ε := div_pos (hQpos z) hε
  have hMone (z : ℂ) : 1 ≤ Q z / ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by simpa using hQge z)
  let W (z : ℂ) := regularizedLogWitness (f c) ε (f z)
  have hW : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W (closedBall c R) := by
    intro z hz
    dsimp [W, regularizedLogWitness]
    exact ((analyticAt_const.mul (hf z hz)).add analyticAt_const).div_const
  have hWnorm : ‖W c‖ = Q c / ε := by
    dsimp [W]
    rw [regularizedLogWitness_self _ hε, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hMpos c)]
  have hWne : W c ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [hWnorm]; exact ne_of_gt (hMpos c))
  have hj := hW.log_norm_center_le_circleAverage hR hWne
  rw [hWnorm, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hQpos c)) (ne_of_gt hε)] at hj
  have hupper (z : ℂ) : Real.log ‖W z‖ ≤ Real.log (Q z) - Real.log ε := by
    rw [← Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hQpos z)) (ne_of_gt hε)]
    by_cases hzero : W z = 0
    · rw [hzero, norm_zero, Real.log_zero]
      exact Real.log_nonneg (hMone z)
    · exact Real.log_le_log (norm_pos_iff.mpr hzero) (norm_regularizedLogWitness_le _ _ hε)
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.log (Q z)) (closedBall c R) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.log _ (fun z _ => ne_of_gt (hQpos z))
    dsimp [Q]
    simp_rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    exact ((hf.continuousOn.norm.pow 2).add continuousOn_const).sqrt
  have hQint := (hcont.mono sphere_subset_closedBall).circleIntegrable hR.le
  have hW' : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W (closedBall c |R|) := by simpa only [abs_of_pos hR] using hW
  have hWint := (hW'.mono sphere_subset_closedBall).meromorphicOn.circleIntegrable_log_norm
  have hHInt : CircleIntegrable (fun z => Real.log (Q z) - Real.log ε) c R :=
    hQint.sub (continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable hR.le)
  have hm := Real.circleAverage_mono hWint hHInt (fun z _ => hupper z)
  rw [Real.circleAverage_fun_sub hQint (continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable hR.le),
    Real.circleAverage_const] at hm
  have hfinal : Real.log (Q c) ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun z => Real.log (Q z)) c R := by linarith
  simpa only [Q, normSq_eq_norm_sq] using hfinal

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_isPreconnected
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_isPreconnected {Ω S : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hoff : S ⊆ (cubicalTrace Γ)ᶜ)
    {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ S) (hv : v ∈ S) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral Γ u = cubicalWindingIntegral Γ v
proof:
:= by
  let : PreconnectedSpace S := Subtype.preconnectedSpace hS
  have hloc := (isLocallyConstant_cubicalWindingIntegral Γ hc hΓ).comp_continuous
    (show Continuous (fun z : S => (⟨z, hoff z.property⟩ : {w : ℂ // w ∉ cubicalTrace Γ}))
      from continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)
  exact hloc.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace ⟨u, hu⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩

name: Complex.cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_mem_real_interval
statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_mem_real_interval {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) (hc : Cubical.boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    {a b x₀ x : ℝ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Icc a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hoff : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, (t : ℂ) ∉ cubicalTrace Γ) :
    cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x : ℂ) = cubicalWindingIntegral Γ (x₀ : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  apply cubicalWindingIntegral_eq_of_isPreconnected Γ hc hΓ
    (S := Complex.ofReal '' Icc a b)
    (isPreconnected_Icc.image _ continuous_ofReal.continuousOn)
  · rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact hoff t ht
  · exact mem_image_of_mem _ hx
  · exact mem_image_of_mem _ hx₀

name: Complex.cubicalLength_nonneg
statement: theorem cubicalLength_nonneg {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) : 0 ≤ cubicalLength Γ
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_nonneg
  intro γ _
  exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall zero_le_one
    (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))

name: Complex.norm_cubicalCurveIntegral_le_length_mul
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicalCurveIntegral cubicalLength
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  rw [sum_mul]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro γ hγ
  rw [norm_zsmul ℝ, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have h := norm_curveIntegral_le_mul_integral_norm_derivWithin_of_contDiffOn
    (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ)
    (C := C) (fun t ht => by
      rw [(cubicalPath γ).extend_apply ht]
      simp only [norm_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id, mul_one]
      change ‖g (γ ⟨t, ht⟩ : ℂ)‖ ≤ C
      exact hg γ hγ ⟨t, ht⟩) (hΓ γ hγ)
  calc
    _ ≤ |(Γ γ : ℝ)| * (C * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        ‖derivWithin (cubicalPath γ).extend I t‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Complex.norm_two_pi_i_inv_mul_cubicalCurveIntegral_le_length_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_I, mul_one,
    norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  norm_num only [norm_ofNat]
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (cubicalLength Γ * C) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_cubicalCurveIntegral_le_length_mul Γ g hΓ hg)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Complex.curveIntegral_div_sub_eq_add_dslope
statement:
private theorem curveIntegral_div_sub_eq_add_dslope
    {a b t : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hoff : ∀ r, γ r ≠ t)
    (h1 : CurveIntegrable (fun z => (f z / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ)
    (h2 : CurveIntegrable (fun z => (f t / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (f z / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ =
      curveIntegral (fun z => dslope f t z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ +
        f t * curveIntegral (fun z => (z - t)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ
proof:
:= by
  have he : curveIntegral (fun z => dslope f t z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ =
      curveIntegral (fun z => (f z / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ -
        (f t / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ := by
    rw [curveIntegral_def, curveIntegral_def]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa only [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using hr
    simp only [curveIntegralFun_def, γ.extend_apply hr', dslope_of_ne f (hoff ⟨r, hr'⟩),
      slope_def_field, sub_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [curveIntegral_fun_sub h1 h2] at he
  have hω : (fun z => (f t / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) =
      fun z => f t • ((z - t)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) := by
    funext z
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_smul]
  rw [hω, curveIntegral_fun_smul] at he
  change _ = _ - f t * _ at he
  linear_combination -he

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub_eq_mul_inv_sub_of_isNullHomologous
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub_eq_mul_inv_sub_of_isNullHomologous
    {Ω : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {t : ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω) (ht : t ∈ Ω)
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ t)
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z / (z - t)) Γ =
      f t * cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => (z - t)⁻¹) Γ
proof:
:= by
  have hds : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope f t) Ω :=
    (differentiableOn_dslope (hΩ.mem_nhds ht)).mpr hf
  have hz := cubicalCurveIntegral_eq_zero_of_isNullHomologous hΩ hds Γ hΓ hnull
  have he : cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z / (z - t)) Γ =
      cubicalCurveIntegral (dslope f t) Γ +
        f t * cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => (z - t)⁻¹) Γ := by
    unfold cubicalCurveIntegral
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    rw [mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro γ hγ
    have hne (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ Ω \ {t}) : z - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz.2
    have hmem (r : I) : cubicalPath γ r ∈ Ω \ {t} := ⟨(γ r).property, hoff γ hγ r⟩
    have h1 : CurveIntegrable
        (fun z => (f z / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) :=
      ((hf.continuousOn.mono sdiff_subset).div (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) hne).smul
        continuousOn_const |>.curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hΓ γ hγ) hmem
    have h2 : CurveIntegrable
        (fun z => (f t / (z - t)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (cubicalPath γ) :=
      (continuousOn_const.div (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) hne).smul
        continuousOn_const |>.curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hΓ γ hγ) hmem
    rw [curveIntegral_div_sub_eq_add_dslope (cubicalPath γ) (hoff γ hγ) h1 h2]
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rwa [hz, zero_add] at he

name: Complex.two_pi_i_inv_mul_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub_eq_of_isNullHomologous
statement:
theorem two_pi_i_inv_mul_cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub_eq_of_isNullHomologous
    {Ω : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {t : ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω) (ht : t ∈ Ω)
    (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)
    (hoff : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ∀ r, (γ r : ℂ) ≠ t)
    (hnull : Cubical.IsNullHomologous Γ) (hw : cubicalWindingIntegral Γ t = 1) :
    (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * cubicalCurveIntegral (fun z => f z / (z - t)) Γ = f t
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubicalCurveIntegral_div_sub_eq_mul_inv_sub_of_isNullHomologous hΩ hf ht Γ hΓ hoff hnull]
  calc
    _ = f t * cubicalWindingIntegral Γ t := by unfold cubicalWindingIntegral; ring
    _ = f t := by rw [hw, mul_one]

name: Complex.mem_cubicalTrace
statement:
theorem mem_cubicalTrace {Ω : Set ℂ} {Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω}
    {γ : C(I, Ω)} (hγ : γ ∈ Γ.support) (r : I) : (γ r : ℂ) ∈ cubicalTrace Γ
proof:
:= by
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨γ, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hγ, mem_range_self r⟩⟩

name: Complex.isCompact_cubicalTrace
statement:
theorem isCompact_cubicalTrace {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) :
    IsCompact (cubicalTrace Γ)
proof:
:=
  Γ.support.isCompact_biUnion (fun γ _ =>
    isCompact_range (continuous_subtype_val.comp γ.continuous))

name: Complex.cubicalTrace_subset
statement: theorem cubicalTrace_subset {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω) : cubicalTrace Γ ⊆ Ω
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨γ, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
  obtain ⟨_, r, rfl⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
  exact (γ r).property

name: Complex.bddAbove_insert_norm_image_cubicalTrace
proof:
:=
  bddAbove_insert.mpr ((isCompact_cubicalTrace Γ).bddAbove_image hf.norm)

name: Complex.cubicalMaxNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem cubicalMaxNorm_nonneg {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (cubicalTrace Γ)) : 0 ≤ cubicalMaxNorm Γ f
proof:
:=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_insert_norm_image_cubicalTrace Γ hf) (mem_insert 0 _)

name: Complex.norm_le_cubicalMaxNorm
statement:
theorem norm_le_cubicalMaxNorm {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (cubicalTrace Γ)) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ cubicalTrace Γ) :
    ‖f z‖ ≤ cubicalMaxNorm Γ f
proof:
:=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_insert_norm_image_cubicalTrace Γ hf) (mem_insert_of_mem 0 (mem_image_of_mem _ hz))

name: Complex.exists_norm_eq_cubicalMaxNorm
statement:
theorem exists_norm_eq_cubicalMaxNorm {Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : Cubical.OneChain Ω)
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (cubicalTrace Γ)) (hΓ : (cubicalTrace Γ).Nonempty) :
    ∃ z ∈ cubicalTrace Γ, ‖f z‖ = cubicalMaxNorm Γ f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hmax⟩ := (isCompact_cubicalTrace Γ).exists_isMaxOn hΓ hf.norm
  refine ⟨z, hz, le_antisymm (norm_le_cubicalMaxNorm Γ hf hz) ?_⟩
  unfold cubicalMaxNorm
  apply csSup_le (Set.insert_nonempty 0 _)
  intro v hv
  rcases mem_insert_iff.mp hv with rfl | hv
  · exact norm_nonneg _
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact hmax hw

name: Complex.cubicalPath_toContinuousMap_extend
statement:
theorem cubicalPath_toContinuousMap_extend {Ω : Set ℂ} {a b : Ω} (γ : Path a b) :
    (cubicalPath γ.toContinuousMap).extend = (γ.map continuous_subtype_val).extend
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rfl

name: Complex.curveIntegral_cubicalPath_toContinuousMap
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_cubicalPath_toContinuousMap {Ω : Set ℂ} {a b : Ω}
    (γ : Path a b) (ω : ℂ → ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    curveIntegral ω (cubicalPath γ.toContinuousMap) =
      curveIntegral ω (γ.map continuous_subtype_val)
