:= by
  simp only [curveIntegral_def, curveIntegralFun_def, cubicalPath_toContinuousMap_extend]

name: Complex.contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_cubicalPath_of_mem_support_pathChain {Ω : Set ℂ} {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I)
    (q : C(I, Ω)) (hq : q ∈ (Cubical.pathChain p γ).support) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath q).extend I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Cubical.exists_piece_of_mem_support_pathChain p γ hq
  rw [cubicalPath_toContinuousMap_extend]
  exact hγ i

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_curveIntegral_concat
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_curveIntegral_concat {Ω : Set ℂ} {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (g : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, CurveIntegrable (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
      ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val)) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral g (Cubical.pathChain p γ) =
      curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.map_concat, curveIntegral_concat _ _ hγ]
  simp only [Cubical.pathChain, map_sum, cubicalCurveIntegral,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, curveIntegral_cubicalPath_toContinuousMap]

name: Complex.cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_of_contDiffOn {Ω : Set ℂ} {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) (γ : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : ContinuousOn g Ω)
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I) :
    cubicalCurveIntegral g (Cubical.pathChain p γ) =
      curveIntegral (fun z => g z • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        ((Path.concat p γ).map continuous_subtype_val)
proof:
:= by
  apply cubicalCurveIntegral_pathChain_eq_curveIntegral_concat
  intro i
  apply (hg.smul continuousOn_const).curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn (hγ i)
  intro t
  exact ((γ i) t).property

name: Real.tendsto_log_affine_nat_div_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_affine_nat_div_nat {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (B : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => log (A*n+B)/(n:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have haff : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => A*n+B) atTop atTop :=
    ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).const_mul_atTop hA).atTop_add
      tendsto_const_nhds
  have h := (tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop (1/A) (-B/A) 1
    (by positivity : (1/A:ℝ) ≠ 0)).comp haff
  convert h using 1
  funext n
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, pow_one]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: Real.tendsto_rpow_inv_nat_of_log_div_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_rpow_inv_nat_of_log_div_tendsto {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    {L : ℝ} (h : Tendsto (fun n => log (u n)/(n:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (u n) ^ (1/(n:ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 (exp L))
proof:
:= by
  have h' := continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h
  convert h' using 1
  funext n
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos (hu n)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sum_sq_le_sum_abs
statement:
theorem sqrt_sum_sq_le_sum_abs {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i, |x i|
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, |x i| := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left h0]
  have : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = ∑ i, |x i| ^ 2 := by simp [sq_abs]
  rw [this]
  exact Finset.sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.abs_mul_log_le_sq_add_one
statement: theorem abs_mul_log_le_sq_add_one (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) : |s * Real.log s| ≤ s ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.eq_or_lt with h | hs'
  · subst h; simp
  rcases le_or_gt s 1 with h1 | h1
  · have := Real.abs_log_mul_self_lt s hs' h1
    rw [mul_comm]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]
  · have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log s := Real.log_nonneg h1.le
    have hl2 : Real.log s ≤ s - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hs'
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs hl)]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.abs_add_mul_log_add_le
statement:
theorem abs_add_mul_log_add_le (a δ : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    |(a + δ) * Real.log (a + δ)| ≤ |a * Real.log a| + a + 2
proof:
:= by
  set b := a + δ with hb
  have hbpos : 0 < b := by positivity
  
  have hconv : a * Real.log b + a - b ≤ a * Real.log a := by
    rcases ha.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0; simp; linarith
    · have h1 := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (div_pos hpos hbpos)
      rw [Real.log_div hpos.ne' hbpos.ne', inv_div] at h1
      have h2 : a * (1 - b / a) ≤ a * (Real.log a - Real.log b) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 ha
      rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne'] at h2
      linarith
  rcases le_or_gt 1 b with hb1 | hb1
  · have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log b := Real.log_nonneg hb1
    have hlogb : Real.log b ≤ b - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hbpos
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hbpos.le hlog0)]
    have : b * Real.log b ≤ a * Real.log a + δ * (Real.log b + 1) := by
      have : b * Real.log b = a * Real.log b + δ * Real.log b := by rw [hb]; ring
      linarith
    have h3 : δ * (Real.log b + 1) ≤ Real.log b + 1 := by nlinarith
    have h4 := le_abs_self (a * Real.log a)
    linarith
  · have hlog0 : Real.log b ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hbpos.le hb1.le
    have hl := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hbpos
    have : b * (1 - b⁻¹) ≤ b * Real.log b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hbpos.le
    rw [mul_sub, mul_inv_cancel₀ hbpos.ne', mul_one] at this
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hbpos.le hlog0)]
    have := abs_nonneg (a * Real.log a)
    linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_mul_exp_le_exp_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem abs_mul_exp_le_exp_two_mul_add_one (u : ℝ) :
    |u * Real.exp u| ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have e2 : Real.exp (2 * u) = Real.exp u * Real.exp u := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  have hpos := Real.exp_pos u
  rcases le_total 0 u with h | h
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg h hpos.le), e2]
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp u
    nlinarith
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by nlinarith)]
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-u)
    have e : Real.exp (-u) * Real.exp u = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hpos.le
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (2 * u)]

name: NLAlib.log_one_add_le_sub_sq_div_two_add_pow_three_div_three
statement:
theorem log_one_add_le_sub_sq_div_two_add_pow_three_div_three {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    Real.log (1 + ε) ≤ ε - ε ^ 2 / 2 + ε ^ 3 / 3
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t - t ^ 2 / 2 + t ^ 3 / 3 - Real.log (1 + t)
  have hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt f (1 - t + t ^ 2 - 1 / (1 + t)) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 + t) 1 t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_add 1
    have hlog := h1.log (by linarith)
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t - t ^ 2 / 2 + t ^ 3 / 3) (1 - t + t ^ 2) t := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_id' t).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).div_const 2)).add
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 3 t).div_const 3))
      exact this.congr_deriv (by norm_num)
    exact hp.sub hlog
  have hmono : MonotoneOn f (Set.Ici 0) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici 0) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact fun t ht => (hderiv t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ici] at ht
      exact (hderiv t (le_of_lt ht)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ici] at ht
      have ht0 : 0 < t := ht
      rw [(hderiv t ht0.le).deriv]
      have : 1 - t + t ^ 2 - 1 / (1 + t) = t ^ 3 / (1 + t) := by field_simp; ring
      rw [this]; positivity
  have := hmono (Set.mem_Ici.2 le_rfl) (Set.mem_Ici.2 hε) hε
  simp [f] at this
  linarith

name: NLAlib.log_one_sub_le_neg_sub_sq_div_two
statement:
theorem log_one_sub_le_neg_sub_sq_div_two {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    Real.log (1 - ε) ≤ -ε - ε ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.hasSum_pow_div_log_of_abs_lt_one (x := ε) (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hε0])
  have := sum_le_hasSum (Finset.range 2) (fun n _ => by positivity) h
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ] at this
  linarith

name: LinearMap.image_sphere_eq_image_closedBall_of_ker_ne_bot
statement:
theorem image_sphere_eq_image_closedBall_of_ker_ne_bot (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker L ≠ ⊥) :
    L '' Metric.sphere 0 1 = L '' Metric.closedBall 0 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.image_mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall)
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := (LinearMap.ker L).ne_bot_iff.mp hker
  let u : E := ‖v‖⁻¹ • v
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [u, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv,
      abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v), inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hv0)]
  have hLu : L u = 0 := by simp only [u, map_smul, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv, smul_zero]
  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖x + t • u‖
  have hc : Continuous f := by unfold f; fun_prop
  have hlow : f 0 ≤ 1 := by simpa [f] using hxnorm
  have hhigh : 1 ≤ f 2 := by
    have h := norm_add_le (x + (2 : ℝ) • u) (-x)
    have heq : x + (2 : ℝ) • u + -x = (2 : ℝ) • u := by abel
    rw [heq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num), hu, norm_neg] at h
    dsimp only [f]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
    hc.continuousOn ⟨hlow, hhigh⟩
  refine ⟨x + t • u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using ht
  · rw [map_add, map_smul, hLu, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: LinearMap.convex_image_sphere_of_ker_ne_bot
statement:
theorem convex_image_sphere_of_ker_ne_bot (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker L ≠ ⊥) : Convex ℝ (L '' Metric.sphere 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.image_sphere_eq_image_closedBall_of_ker_ne_bot hker]
  exact (convex_closedBall (0 : E) 1).linear_image L

name: ConcaveOn.le_map_integral_of_integral_mem
statement:
theorem ConcaveOn.le_map_integral_of_integral_mem {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Set E) (g : E → ℝ) (f : Ω → E)
    (hg : ConcaveOn ℝ s g) (hgc : ContinuousOn g s)
    (hfs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω ∈ s) (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hgf : Integrable (fun ω => g (f ω)) μ) (hm : (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) ∈ s) :
    (∫ ω, g (f ω) ∂μ) ≤ g (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (E × ℝ) := {p | p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ≤ g p.1}
  have hi : (∫ ω, (f ω, g (f ω)) ∂μ) ∈ closure S :=
    hg.convex_hypograph.closure.integral_mem isClosed_closure
      (hfs.mono fun ω hω => subset_closure ⟨hω, le_rfl⟩) (hf.prodMk hgf)
  rw [integral_pair hf hgf] at hi
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hi
  have hglim : Tendsto (fun n => g (u n).1) atTop (𝓝 (g (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ))) :=
    (hgc _ hm).tendsto.comp (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
      ⟨(continuous_fst.tendsto _).comp hlim, Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).1⟩)
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' ((continuous_snd.tendsto _).comp hlim) hglim (fun n => (hu n).2)

name: Matrix.prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_mem_doublyStochastic
proof:
:= by
  have hrow (i : n) : (∏ j, x j ^ B i j) ≤ (B *ᵥ x) i := by
    exact Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted univ (B i) x
      (fun j _ => nonneg_of_mem_doublyStochastic hB)
      (sum_row_of_mem_doublyStochastic hB i) (fun j _ => (hx j).le)
  calc
    (∏ j, x j) = ∏ i, ∏ j, x j ^ B i j := by
      rw [prod_comm]
      apply prod_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_pos (hx j), sum_col_of_mem_doublyStochastic hB j]
      exact (Real.rpow_one _).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ i, (B *ᵥ x) i :=
      prod_le_prod (fun i _ => prod_nonneg fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hx j).le _)
        (fun i _ => hrow i)

name: Matrix.mul_prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic_le
statement:
theorem mul_prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic_le {C B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : B ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ n) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hBC : ∀ i j, a * B i j ≤ C i j) (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j) :
    a ^ Fintype.card n * (∏ j, x j) ≤ ∏ i, (C *ᵥ x) i
proof:
:= by
  have hBx (i : n) : 0 ≤ (B *ᵥ x) i :=
    sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (nonneg_of_mem_doublyStochastic hB) (hx j).le
  have hmul (i : n) : a * (B *ᵥ x) i ≤ (C *ᵥ x) i := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    calc
      a * (B i j * x j) = (a * B i j) * x j := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ C i j * x j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBC i j) (hx j).le
  calc
    a ^ Fintype.card n * (∏ j, x j) ≤ a ^ Fintype.card n * (∏ i, (B *ᵥ x) i) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_mem_doublyStochastic hB x hx)
        (pow_nonneg ha _)
    _ = ∏ i, a * (B *ᵥ x) i := by rw [prod_mul_distrib]; simp
    _ ≤ ∏ i, (C *ᵥ x) i :=
      prod_le_prod (fun i _ => mul_nonneg ha (hBx i)) (fun i _ => hmul i)

name: Matrix.mul_prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_col_sum_one
statement:
theorem mul_prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_col_sum_one (C : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, C i j = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ∑ i, ((∑ j, C i j) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ ε)
    (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x j) :
    (1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ε)) ^ Fintype.card n *
      (∏ j, x j) ≤ ∏ i, (C *ᵥ x) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _).trans hε
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hεbound := (le_div_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)).mp hεsmall
  have hsmall : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ε ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hbase : 0 ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ε) :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr hsmall)
  obtain ⟨B, a, hB, ha, _, hbound, hBC⟩ :=
    exists_smul_doublyStochastic_le_of_col_sum_one C hC hcol
  have hbasea : 1 - Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ε) ≤ a := by
    have hroot := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε hn0)
    linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ a ^ Fintype.card n * (∏ j, x j) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase hbasea _)
        (prod_nonneg fun j _ => (hx j).le)
    _ ≤ _ := mul_prod_le_prod_mulVec_of_doublyStochastic_le hB ha hBC x hx

name: NLAlib.Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Gamma (x + 1 / 2) ≤ Gamma x * √x
proof:
:= by
  have h := Gamma_mul_add_mul_le_rpow_Gamma_mul_rpow_Gamma hx (by linarith : 0 < x + 1)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hG : 0 < Gamma x := Gamma_pos_of_pos hx
  rw [show 1 / 2 * x + 1 / 2 * (x + 1) = x + 1 / 2 by ring, Gamma_add_one hx.ne',
    ← Real.mul_rpow hG.le (by positivity), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
    show Gamma x * (x * Gamma x) = Gamma x ^ 2 * x by ring,
    Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq hG.le] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.lintegral_ofReal_mul_rpow_mul_exp_Ioi
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_mul_rpow_mul_exp_Ioi {a r : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 < r) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (c * (t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-(r * t))))
      = ENNReal.ofReal (c * ((1 / r) ^ a * Gamma a))
proof:
:= by
  have hI := Real.integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha hr
  have hpos : 0 < (1 / r) ^ a * Gamma a := by
    have : 0 < Gamma a := Gamma_pos_of_pos ha
    positivity
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-(r * t))) (Ioi 0) :=
    Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero (by rw [hI]; exact hpos.ne')
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hint.const_mul c), integral_const_mul, hI]
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
  have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) < t := ht
  have : 0 ≤ t ^ (a - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le _
  positivity

name: NLAlib.lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_le {a : ℝ} (ha : -1 < a) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∫⁻ x in Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2))
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a + 1) / (a + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ a) (Ioc 0 t) := by
    have := (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (a := 0) (b := t) ha)
    exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ht).1 this
  calc ∫⁻ x in Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2))
      ≤ ∫⁻ x in Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ a) := by
        refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioc fun x hx => ?_
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        have h1 : 0 ≤ x ^ a := Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _
        have h2 : Real.exp (-x / 2) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith [hx.1])
        nlinarith
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in Ioc 0 t, x ^ a) := by
        rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint]
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with x hx
        exact Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a + 1) / (a + 1)) := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht, integral_rpow (Or.inl ha),
          Real.zero_rpow (by linarith), sub_zero]

name: Real.sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_logDefect
statement:
theorem sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_logDefect {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hdef : logDefect x ≤ 1 / 6) :
    (x - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 6 * logDefect x
proof:
:= by
  have hs_sq : (Real.sqrt x) ^ 2 = x := Real.sq_sqrt hx.le
  have hs_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hx
  have hlog_s : Real.log (Real.sqrt x) ≤ Real.sqrt x - 1 :=
    Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hs_pos
  have hlog_x : Real.log x = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt x) := by
    calc
      Real.log x = 2 * (Real.log x / 2) := by ring
      _ = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt x) := by rw [Real.log_sqrt hx.le]
  have hd_eq : logDefect x =
      (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 + 2 * ((Real.sqrt x - 1) - Real.log (Real.sqrt x)) := by
    unfold logDefect
    rw [hlog_x]
    nlinarith [hs_sq]
  have hd_ge : (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 ≤ logDefect x := by
    rw [hd_eq]
    nlinarith [hlog_s]
  have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ logDefect x := (sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt x - 1)).trans hd_ge
  have hu_sq_le : (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 6 := hd_ge.trans hdef
  have hsqrt2_sq : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hfrac : 1 / 6 < (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hlt : Real.sqrt 2 < 17 / 12 := by
      have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 < (17 / 12) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
      have hlt' : |Real.sqrt 2| < |17 / 12| := sq_lt_sq.mp hsq
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2),
        abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : 0 ≤ (17 / 12 : ℝ))] using hlt'
    have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ 2 = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
      nlinarith [hsqrt2_sq]
    rw [hsq]
    linarith
  have hx_lt_two : x < 2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hge : 2 ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hge
    have h1le_s : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt x := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two.le.trans hs2
    have hsq_le : (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 := by
      exact (sq_le_sq₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr Real.one_lt_sqrt_two.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr h1le_s)).2
        (sub_le_sub_right hs2 1)
    have hbad : 1 / 6 < (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 := hfrac.trans_le hsq_le
    linarith [hu_sq_le, hbad]
  have hsp6up : (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 6 := by
    have hlt : Real.sqrt 2 < 3 / 2 := by
      have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 < (3 / 2) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
      have hlt' : |Real.sqrt 2| < |3 / 2| := sq_lt_sq.mp hsq
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2),
        abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : 0 ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ))] using hlt'
    have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) ^ 2 = 3 + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
      nlinarith [hsqrt2_sq]
    rw [hsq]
    linarith
  have hsp6 : (Real.sqrt x + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 6 := by
    have hs_lt : Real.sqrt x < Real.sqrt 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt_iff hx.le).2 hx_lt_two
    have hlt : (Real.sqrt x + 1) ^ 2 < (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [hs_lt, hsqrt2_sq, hs_sq]
    exact le_of_lt (hlt.trans_le hsp6up)
  have hinner : (Real.sqrt x - 1) * (Real.sqrt x + 1) = x - 1 := by
    have h : (Real.sqrt x - 1) * (Real.sqrt x + 1) = (Real.sqrt x) ^ 2 - 1 := by ring
    rw [h, hs_sq]
  have hprod : (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt x + 1) ^ 2 = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, hinner]
  calc
    (x - 1) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt x - 1) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt x + 1) ^ 2 := hprod.symm
    _ ≤ logDefect x * 6 := by
      exact mul_le_mul hd_ge hsp6 (sq_nonneg _) hd_nonneg
    _ = 6 * logDefect x := by ring

name: Real.logDefect_nonneg
statement: theorem logDefect_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : 0 ≤ logDefect x
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx
  unfold logDefect
  linarith

name: Real.sum_sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_sum_logDefect_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_sum_logDefect_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → ℝ) (eps : ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hdef : ∑ i, logDefect (x i) ≤ eps) :
    ∑ i, (x i - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 6 * eps
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ logDefect (x i) := fun i => logDefect_nonneg (hx i)
  have hsingle : ∀ i, logDefect (x i) ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    intro i
    exact ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnonneg j)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans hdef).trans heps
  calc
    (∑ i, (x i - 1) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i, 6 * logDefect (x i) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_logDefect (hx i) (hsingle i)
    _ = 6 * ∑ i, logDefect (x i) := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ 6 * eps := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdef (by norm_num)

name: Real.sum_sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_prod
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_prod
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → ℝ) (eps : ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hsum : ∑ i, x i = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
    (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6) (hprod : exp (-eps) ≤ ∏ i, x i) :
    ∑ i, (x i - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 6 * eps
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : log (∏ i, x i) = ∑ i, log (x i) :=
    log_prod (fun i _ => ne_of_gt (hx i))
  have hlog_lower : -eps ≤ ∑ i, log (x i) := by
    have h := log_le_log (exp_pos (-eps)) hprod
    rwa [log_exp, hlog] at h
  apply sum_sq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_sum_logDefect_le x eps hx heps
  have hdef : (∑ i, logDefect (x i)) =
      (∑ i, x i) - (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - ∑ i, log (x i) := by
    unfold logDefect
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp
  rw [hdef, hsum]
  linarith

name: Real.inv_sq_le_inv_mul_inv_add
statement:
private lemma inv_sq_le_inv_mul_inv_add {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (1 / (x + δ)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (x * (x + δ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_pow, one_pow]
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos (add_pos hx hδ) 2) (mul_pos hx (add_pos hx hδ))]
  nlinarith [hx, hδ]

name: Real.inv_add_lt_inv
statement:
private lemma inv_add_lt_inv {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    1 / (x + δ) < 1 / x
proof:
:=
  one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hx (lt_add_of_pos_right x hδ)

name: Real.reciprocalBarrierGap_eq_mul_sum_inv_mul_inv_add
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalBarrierGap
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hxi : 0 < x i := hx i
  have hxiadd : 0 < x i + δ := add_pos hxi hδ
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hxi, ne_of_gt hxiadd, ne_of_gt (mul_pos hxi hxiadd)]
  ring

name: Real.reciprocalBarrierGap_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalBarrierGap_pos [Nonempty I] {δ : ℝ} {x : I → ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) : 0 < reciprocalBarrierGap δ x
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ i, 1 / (x i * (x i + δ)) := by
    exact Finset.sum_pos
      (fun i _ => one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos (hx i) (add_pos (hx i) hδ)))
      Finset.univ_nonempty
  nlinarith [reciprocalBarrierGap_eq_mul_sum_inv_mul_inv_add hδ hx, hδ, hpos]

name: Real.sum_mul_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_mul_sq
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => ha i)
    (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (ha i) (sq_nonneg (b i)))
    (fun i _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a i * b i)])

name: Real.reciprocal_barrier_upper_le
statement:
theorem reciprocal_barrier_upper_le [Nonempty I] {δ : ℝ} {x : I → ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) :
    (((∑ i, (1 / (x i + δ)) ^ 2) /
        ((∑ i, 1 / x i) - ∑ i, 1 / (x i + δ))) +
      (∑ i, 1 / (x i + δ))) ≤
    1 / δ + (∑ i, 1 / x i)
proof:
:= by
  set S1 : ℝ := ∑ i, (1 / (x i + δ)) ^ 2 with hS1
  set S2 : ℝ := ∑ i, 1 / (x i * (x i + δ)) with hS2
  set S3 : ℝ := ∑ i, 1 / (x i + δ) with hS3
  set S4 : ℝ := ∑ i, 1 / x i with hS4
  set D : ℝ := S4 - S3 with hD
  have hxadd : ∀ i, 0 < x i + δ := fun i => add_pos (hx i) hδ
  have hS1_le_S2 : S1 ≤ S2 := by
    rw [hS1, hS2]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => inv_sq_le_inv_mul_inv_add (hx i) hδ)
  have hS3_le_S4 : S3 ≤ S4 := by
    rw [hS3, hS4]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => le_of_lt (inv_add_lt_inv (hx i) hδ))
  have hD_eq : D = δ * S2 := by
    rw [hD, hS4, hS3, hS2]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hx i), ne_of_gt (hxadd i),
      ne_of_gt (mul_pos (hx i) (hxadd i))]
    ring
  have hS2pos : 0 < S2 := by
    rw [hS2]
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos (hx i) (hxadd i)))
      Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    nlinarith [hD_eq, hδ, hS2pos]
  have hδS1 : δ * S1 ≤ δ * S2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS1_le_S2 hδ.le
  have hδDS3 : δ * D * S3 ≤ δ * D * S4 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS3_le_S4 (mul_pos hδ hDpos).le
  have hcleared : δ * S1 + δ * D * S3 ≤ D + δ * D * S4 := by
    nlinarith [hδS1, hδDS3, hD_eq]
  have hδD : 0 < δ * D := mul_pos hδ hDpos
  have hleft : (δ * S1 + δ * D * S3) / (δ * D) = S1 / D + S3 := by
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hDpos.ne']
  have hright : (D + δ * D * S4) / (δ * D) = 1 / δ + S4 := by
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hDpos.ne']
  calc
    S1 / D + S3 = (δ * S1 + δ * D * S3) / (δ * D) := by rw [hleft]
    _ ≤ (D + δ * D * S4) / (δ * D) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcleared hδD.le
    _ = 1 / δ + S4 := by rw [hright]

name: Real.reciprocal_barrier_lower_le
statement:
theorem reciprocal_barrier_lower_le [Nonempty I] {δ : ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hy : ∀ i, δ < y i) (hcap : δ * (∑ i, 1 / y i) ≤ 1) :
    1 / δ - (∑ i, 1 / y i) ≤
      ((∑ i, (1 / (y i - δ)) ^ 2) /
        ((∑ i, 1 / (y i - δ)) - ∑ i, 1 / y i)) -
      (∑ i, 1 / (y i - δ))
proof:
:= by
  have hya : ∀ i, 0 < y i := fun i => lt_trans hδ (hy i)
  have ha : ∀ i, 0 < 1 / y i := fun i => one_div_pos.mpr (hya i)
  have hyb : ∀ i, 0 < y i - δ := fun i => sub_pos.mpr (hy i)
  have hb : ∀ i, 0 < 1 / (y i - δ) := fun i => one_div_pos.mpr (hyb i)
  set A : ℝ := ∑ i, 1 / y i with hA
  set B : ℝ := ∑ i, 1 / (y i - δ) with hB
  set E : ℝ := ∑ i, (1 / y i) * (1 / (y i - δ)) with hE
  set C : ℝ := ∑ i, (1 / y i) * (1 / (y i - δ)) ^ 2 with hC
  set B2 : ℝ := ∑ i, (1 / (y i - δ)) ^ 2 with hB2
  set D : ℝ := B - A with hD
  have hD_eq : D = δ * E := by
    rw [hD, hB, hA, hE]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hyb i), ne_of_gt (hya i)]
    ring
  have hBE : B2 - E = δ * C := by
    rw [hB2, hE, hC]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hyb i), ne_of_gt (hya i)]
    ring
  have hcauchy : E ^ 2 ≤ A * C := by
    rw [hE, hA, hC]
    exact sum_mul_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_mul_sq (fun i => (ha i).le)
  have hCnonneg : 0 ≤ C := by
    rw [hC]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (ha i).le (sq_nonneg _))
  have hEpos : 0 < E := by
    rw [hE]
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (ha i) (hb i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    nlinarith [hD_eq, hδ, hEpos]
  have hδE2 : δ ^ 2 * E ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 * (A * C) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcauchy (sq_nonneg δ)
  have hAC : δ * A * C ≤ C := by
    simpa using (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcap hCnonneg)
  have hδAC : δ * (δ * A * C) ≤ δ * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAC hδ.le
  have hDsq : D ^ 2 ≤ δ * C := by
    nlinarith [hD_eq, hδE2, hδAC]
  have hDpow : (δ * E) ^ 2 ≤ δ * C := by
    simpa [hD_eq] using hDsq
  have hDsq'' : δ ^ 3 * E ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 * C := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDpow hδ.le]
  have hBA : B - A = δ * E := hD.symm.trans hD_eq
  have hcleared : D - δ * A * D ≤ δ * B2 - δ * D * B := by
    rw [hD_eq]
    nlinarith [hBE, hBA, hDsq'', hδ]
  have hδD : 0 < δ * D := mul_pos hδ hDpos
  have hleft : (δ * B2 - δ * D * B) / (δ * D) = B2 / D - B := by
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hDpos.ne']
  have hright : (D - δ * A * D) / (δ * D) = 1 / δ - A := by
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hDpos.ne']
  calc
    1 / δ - A = (D - δ * A * D) / (δ * D) := by rw [hright]
    _ ≤ (δ * B2 - δ * D * B) / (δ * D) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcleared hδD.le
    _ = B2 / D - B := by rw [hleft]

name: Fin.exists_strictAnti_tendsto_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_strictAnti_tendsto_mem_Icc {n : ℕ} {b : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hb : Antitone b) {l u : ℝ} (hlu : l < u) (hmem : ∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) :
    ∃ v : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ, (∀ k, StrictAnti (v k)) ∧
      (∀ k i, v k i ∈ Icc l u) ∧ Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 b)
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ := (u - l) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  let c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => u - δ * ((i : ℝ) + 1)
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlu) hden
  have hδeq : δ * ((n : ℝ) + 1) = u - l := by
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hc : StrictAnti c := by
    intro i j hij
    have hcast : (i : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hij
    dsimp [c]
    nlinarith
  have hcmem : ∀ i, c i ∈ Icc l u := by
    intro i
    have hile : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have := (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt) : (i : ℝ) ≤ n)
      linarith
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (i : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    dsimp [c]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hεpos (k : ℕ) : 0 < ε k := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  have hεle (k : ℕ) : ε k ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1)).mpr
      (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k])
  let v : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ := fun k i => (1 - ε k) * b i + ε k * c i
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k i j hij
    exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb hij.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hεle k)))
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hc hij) (hεpos k))
  · intro k i
    have heps : 0 ≤ 1 - ε k := sub_nonneg.mpr (hεle k)
    have hbmem := hmem i
    have hcmemi := hcmem i
    have h₁ := mul_nonneg heps (sub_nonneg.mpr hbmem.1)
    have h₂ := mul_nonneg (hεpos k).le (sub_nonneg.mpr hcmemi.1)
    have h₃ := mul_nonneg heps (sub_nonneg.mpr hbmem.2)
    have h₄ := mul_nonneg (hεpos k).le (sub_nonneg.mpr hcmemi.2)
    dsimp [v]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    have heps : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    simpa only [v, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] using
      (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub heps).mul_const (b i)).add
        (heps.mul_const (c i))

name: ContDiffAt.matrix_det
statement:
theorem ContDiffAt.matrix_det (hA : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (A y).det) x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Matrix.det_apply]
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro σ _
  apply ContDiffAt.const_smul
  exact contDiffAt_prod (fun i _ => hA (σ i) i)

name: ContDiffAt.matrix_adjugate_apply
statement:
theorem ContDiffAt.matrix_adjugate_apply
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => A y i j) x) (i j : ι) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (A y).adjugate i j) x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  apply ContDiffAt.matrix_det
  intro k l
  simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact contDiffAt_const
  · exact hA k l

name: ContDiffAt.matrix_inv_apply
statement:
theorem ContDiffAt.matrix_inv_apply
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => A y i j) x)
    (hx : (A x).det ≠ 0) (i j : ι) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (A y)⁻¹ i j) x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ((ContDiffAt.matrix_det hA).inv hx).mul
    (ContDiffAt.matrix_adjugate_apply hA i j)

name: Real.le_div_one_sub_mul_of_hasDerivAt_self_bound
statement:
theorem le_div_one_sub_mul_of_hasDerivAt_self_bound
    (H D : ℝ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ u, HasDerivAt H (D u) u)
    (hzero : H 0 = 0) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hde : ∀ u, 0 < u → a * u < 1 →
      u * D u - H u ≤ a * u ^ 2 * D u)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hdom : a * s < 1) :
    H s ≤ s * D 0 / (1 - a * s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.eq_or_lt with rfl | hs
  · simp [hzero]
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 - a * u) * H u / u
  have hφ (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) : HasDerivAt φ
      ((u * (1 - a * u) * D u - H u) / u ^ 2) u := by
    have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul a).const_sub 1).mul
      (hH u)).div (hasDerivAt_id u) hu.ne'
    exact h.congr_deriv (by simp only [id_eq, Pi.mul_apply]; ring)
  have hanti : AntitoneOn φ (Set.Ioc 0 s) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ioc 0 s)
    · intro u hu
      exact (hφ u hu.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro u hu
      exact (hφ u (interior_subset hu).1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro u hu
      have hu' : u ∈ Set.Ioc 0 s := interior_subset hu
      have hdomu : a * u < 1 :=
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu'.2 ha).trans_lt hdom
      rw [(hφ u hu'.1).deriv]
      apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg _ (sq_nonneg _)
      have hd := hde u hu'.1 hdomu
      nlinarith
  have hlin : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => 1 - a * u) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => 1 - a * u) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [mul_zero, sub_zero] using (hc.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hlim : Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (D 0)) := by
    have h := hlin.mul ((hH 0).tendsto_slope_zero_right)
    simpa only [φ, zero_add, hzero, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_eq_div,
      one_mul, mul_div_assoc] using h
  have hslope : φ s ≤ D 0 := by
    refine ge_of_tendsto hlim ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hs] with u hu
    exact hanti ⟨hu.1, hu.2.le⟩ ⟨hs, le_rfl⟩ hu.2.le
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hdom)).mpr
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hslope hs.le
  change ((1 - a * s) * H s / s) * s ≤ D 0 * s at h
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs.ne'] at h
  nlinarith

name: Real.le_affine_add_div_of_hasDerivAt_bound
statement:
theorem le_affine_add_div_of_hasDerivAt_bound
    (H D : ℝ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ u, HasDerivAt H (D u) u)
    (hzero : H 0 = 0) {c C : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hde : ∀ u, 0 < u → c * u < 1 →
      u * D u - H u ≤ C * u ^ 2 / (1 - c * u) ^ 2)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hdom : c * s < 1) :
    H s ≤ s * D 0 + C * s ^ 2 / (1 - c * s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.eq_or_lt with rfl | hs
  · simp [hzero]
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => H u / u - C * u / (1 - c * u)
  have hφ (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hcu : c * u < 1) :
      HasDerivAt φ ((u * D u - H u) / u ^ 2 - C / (1 - c * u) ^ 2) u := by
    have h1 := (hH u).div (hasDerivAt_id u) hu.ne'
    have h2 := ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul C).div
      (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul c).const_sub 1) (sub_pos.mpr hcu).ne'
    exact (h1.sub h2).congr_deriv (by simp only [id_eq]; ring)
  have hanti : AntitoneOn φ (Set.Ioc 0 s) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ioc 0 s)
    · intro u hu
      exact (hφ u hu.1 ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.2 hc).trans_lt hdom)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro u hu
      have hu' : u ∈ Set.Ioc 0 s := interior_subset hu
      exact (hφ u hu'.1 ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu'.2 hc).trans_lt hdom)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro u hu
      have hu' : u ∈ Set.Ioc 0 s := interior_subset hu
      have hcu : c * u < 1 := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu'.2 hc).trans_lt hdom
      rw [(hφ u hu'.1 hcu).deriv]
      apply sub_nonpos.mpr
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hu'.1)).mpr
      exact (hde u hu'.1 hcu).trans_eq (by ring)
  have hlim : Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (D 0)) := by
    have hlin : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => C * u / (1 - c * u))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
      have hc : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => C * u / (1 - c * u)) 0 := by fun_prop (disch := norm_num)
      simpa only [mul_zero, sub_zero, zero_div] using hc.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have h := ((hH 0).tendsto_slope_zero_right).sub hlin
    simpa only [φ, zero_add, hzero, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_eq_div] using h
  have hslope : φ s ≤ D 0 := by
    refine ge_of_tendsto hlim ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hs] with u hu
    exact hanti ⟨hu.1, hu.2.le⟩ ⟨hs, le_rfl⟩ hu.2.le
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hslope hs.le
  change (H s / s - C * s / (1 - c * s)) * s ≤ D 0 * s at h
  have he : (H s / s - C * s / (1 - c * s)) * s =
      H s - C * s ^ 2 / (1 - c * s) := by
    field_simp [hs.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hdom).ne']
  rw [he] at h
  linarith

name: ContDiff.sub_eq_integral_fderiv_segment
proof:
:= by
  have hpath : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => x + u • h) := by fun_prop
  have hd (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => f (x + u • h))
      (fderiv ℝ f (x + u • h) h) u := by
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => x + u • h) h u := by
      simpa only [one_smul, id_eq] using ((hasDerivAt_id u).smul_const h).const_add x
    exact (hf.differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt u hp
  have hc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (x + u • h) h) :=
    ((hf.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).comp hpath).clm_apply continuous_const
  simpa only [one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero] using
    (intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun u _ => hd u)
      (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)).symm

name: ContDiff.sub_sub_smul_fderiv_eq_smul_integral_iteratedFDeriv_two
statement:
theorem ContDiff.sub_sub_smul_fderiv_eq_smul_integral_iteratedFDeriv_two
    {f : E → F} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (x z h : E) (a : ℝ) :
    f (x + a • h) - f x - a • fderiv ℝ f z h =
      a • ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (z + v • (x + u • (a • h) - z))
          ![x + u • (a • h) - z, h]
proof:
:= by
  have hf1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 f := hf.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hdf1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hfirst := hf1.sub_eq_integral_fderiv_segment x (a • h)
  simp only [map_smul] at hfirst
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul] at hfirst
  have hdiff (u : ℝ) :
      fderiv ℝ f (x + u • (a • h)) h - fderiv ℝ f z h =
        ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (z + v • (x + u • (a • h) - z))
            ![x + u • (a • h) - z, h] := by
    let d := x + u • (a • h) - z
    have hd := hdf1.sub_eq_integral_fderiv_segment z d
    have hc : Continuous (fun v : ℝ =>
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (z + v • d) d) :=
      ((hdf1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).comp (by fun_prop)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have he := congrArg (fun T : E →L[ℝ] F => T h) hd
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)] at he
    simpa only [d, add_sub_cancel, sub_apply,
      iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] using he
  have hcont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (x + u • (a • h)) h) :=
    ((hf.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).comp (by fun_prop)).clm_apply continuous_const
  rw [hfirst, ← smul_sub]
  congr 1
  have hconst : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ f z h) = fderiv ℝ f z h := by simp
  rw [← hconst, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    intervalIntegrable_const]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro u _
  exact hdiff u

name: ContDiff.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_smul_sq_integral_three
statement:
theorem ContDiff.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_smul_sq_integral_three
    {Φ : E → F} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 3 Φ) (x D V : E) (a : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ Φ (x + a • D) - fderiv ℝ Φ x) D -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x - a • V) ![D, D] =
      a ^ 2 • ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Φ
          (x - a • V + v • (a • (V + u • D))) ![V + u • D, D, D]
proof:
:= by
  let g : E → F := fun y => fderiv ℝ Φ y D
  have hgrad : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ Φ) := hΦ.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g := hgrad.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hcancel := hg.sub_sub_smul_fderiv_eq_smul_integral_iteratedFDeriv_two
    x (x - a • V) D a
  have hfirst (y : E) : fderiv ℝ g y D = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ y ![D, D] := by
    have h := iteratedFDeriv_clm_apply_const_apply hgrad (i := 1) (by norm_num)
      (x := y) (u := D) (m := ![D])
    simpa only [g, iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] using h
  have hsecond (y B : E) : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g y ![B, D] =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Φ y ![B, D, D] := by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (f := Φ) ![B, D, D]]
    have hi : Fin.init ![B, D, D] = ![B, D] := by
      funext i
      refine Fin.cases rfl (fun j => ?_) i
      have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
      subst j
      rfl
    have hl : ![B, D, D] (Fin.last 2) = D := rfl
    simpa only [g, hi, hl] using iteratedFDeriv_clm_apply_const_apply hgrad
      (i := 2) (by norm_num) (x := y) (u := D) (m := ![B, D])
  have hdelta (u : ℝ) : x + u • (a • D) - (x - a • V) = a • (V + u • D) := by
    simp only [smul_add, smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm u a]
    abel
  have hscale (y B : E) : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g y ![a • B, D] =
      a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g y ![B, D] := by
    simp only [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      map_smul, smul_apply]
  simp_rw [hfirst, hdelta, hscale, hsecond] at hcancel
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul] at hcancel
  rw [smul_smul] at hcancel
  simpa only [g, sub_apply, pow_two] using hcancel

name: NLAlib.mapAbsCondition_eq_norm_of_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem mapAbsCondition_eq_norm_of_hasFDerivAt {f : E → F} {x : E}
    {L : E →L[ℝ] F} (hf : HasFDerivAt f L x) : mapAbsCondition f x = ‖L‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAbsCondition, hf.fderiv]

name: NLAlib.mapAbsCondition_eq_abs_deriv
statement:
theorem mapAbsCondition_eq_abs_deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    mapAbsCondition f x = |deriv f x|
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAbsCondition, ← norm_deriv_eq_norm_fderiv, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.mapNormRelativeCondition_eq_abs_mul_deriv_div
statement:
theorem mapNormRelativeCondition_eq_abs_mul_deriv_div (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    mapNormRelativeCondition f x = |x * deriv f x / f x|
proof:

  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_mul]
