name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_sub
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_sub
    {u η u' η' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hu : ContinuousOn u [[a, b]]) (hη : ContinuousOn η [[a, b]])
    (huu' : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min a b) (max a b), HasDerivAt u (u' x) x)
    (hηη' : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min a b) (max a b), HasDerivAt η (η' x) x)
    (hu' : IntervalIntegrable u' volume a b)
    (hη' : IntervalIntegrable η' volume a b) :
    (∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * η' x) =
      Real.exp (u b) * η b - Real.exp (u a) * η a -
        ∫ x in a..b, η x * Real.exp (u x) * u' x
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.exp (u x)) [[a, b]] :=
    Real.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn hu
  have hparts := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul_of_hasDerivAt
    hexp hη (fun x hx => (huu' x hx).exp) hηη'
    (hu'.continuousOn_mul hexp) hη'
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hparts

name: NLAlib.neg_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
statement:
theorem neg_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
    {u η u' η' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hu : ContinuousOn u [[a, b]]) (hη : ContinuousOn η [[a, b]])
    (huu' : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min a b) (max a b), HasDerivAt u (u' x) x)
    (hηη' : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min a b) (max a b), HasDerivAt η (η' x) x)
    (hu' : IntervalIntegrable u' volume a b)
    (hη' : IntervalIntegrable η' volume a b)
    (hηa : η a = 0) (hηb : η b = 0) :
    -(∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * η' x) =
      ∫ x in a..b, η x * Real.exp (u x) * u' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_sub hu hη huu' hηη' hu' hη', hηa, hηb]
  simp

name: NLAlib.neg_integral_exp_mul_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem neg_integral_exp_mul_deriv_nonneg
    {u η u' η' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u [[a, b]]) (hη : ContinuousOn η [[a, b]])
    (huu' : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min a b) (max a b), HasDerivAt u (u' x) x)
    (hηη' : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min a b) (max a b), HasDerivAt η (η' x) x)
    (hu' : IntervalIntegrable u' volume a b)
    (hη' : IntervalIntegrable η' volume a b)
    (hηa : η a = 0) (hηb : η b = 0)
    (hη_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ η x)
    (hu'_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ u' x) :
    0 ≤ -(∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * η' x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
    hu hη huu' hηη' hu' hη' hηa hηb]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab fun x hx =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hη_nonneg x hx) (Real.exp_pos _).le) (hu'_nonneg x hx)

name: NLAlib.neg_sum_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
statement:
theorem neg_sum_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
    {u η : ℝ → ℝ} {u' η' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hu : ∀ k < n, ContinuousOn u [[v k, v (k + 1)]])
    (hη : ∀ k < n, ContinuousOn η [[v k, v (k + 1)]])
    (huu' : ∀ k < n, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min (v k) (v (k + 1))) (max (v k) (v (k + 1))),
      HasDerivAt u (u' k x) x)
    (hηη' : ∀ k < n, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min (v k) (v (k + 1))) (max (v k) (v (k + 1))),
      HasDerivAt η (η' k x) x)
    (hu' : ∀ k < n, IntervalIntegrable (u' k) volume (v k) (v (k + 1)))
    (hη' : ∀ k < n, IntervalIntegrable (η' k) volume (v k) (v (k + 1)))
    (hηa : η (v 0) = 0) (hηb : η (v n) = 0) :
    -(∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ x in v k..v (k + 1), Real.exp (u x) * η' k x) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ x in v k..v (k + 1), η x * Real.exp (u x) * u' k x
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.range n) rfl fun k hk =>
    integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_sub (hu k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
      (hη k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)) (huu' k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
      (hηη' k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)) (hu' k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
      (hη' k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_range_sub (fun j => Real.exp (u (v j)) * η (v j))] at hsum
  simp only [hηa, hηb, mul_zero, sub_self, zero_sub] at hsum
  exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr hsum

name: NLAlib.neg_sum_integral_exp_mul_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem neg_sum_integral_exp_mul_deriv_nonneg
    {u η : ℝ → ℝ} {u' η' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hv : ∀ k < n, v k ≤ v (k + 1))
    (hu : ∀ k < n, ContinuousOn u [[v k, v (k + 1)]])
    (hη : ∀ k < n, ContinuousOn η [[v k, v (k + 1)]])
    (huu' : ∀ k < n, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min (v k) (v (k + 1))) (max (v k) (v (k + 1))),
      HasDerivAt u (u' k x) x)
    (hηη' : ∀ k < n, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (min (v k) (v (k + 1))) (max (v k) (v (k + 1))),
      HasDerivAt η (η' k x) x)
    (hu' : ∀ k < n, IntervalIntegrable (u' k) volume (v k) (v (k + 1)))
    (hη' : ∀ k < n, IntervalIntegrable (η' k) volume (v k) (v (k + 1)))
    (hηa : η (v 0) = 0) (hηb : η (v n) = 0)
    (hη_nonneg : ∀ k < n, ∀ x ∈ Icc (v k) (v (k + 1)), 0 ≤ η x)
    (hu'_nonneg : ∀ k < n, ∀ x ∈ Icc (v k) (v (k + 1)), 0 ≤ u' k x) :
    0 ≤ -(∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ x in v k..v (k + 1), Real.exp (u x) * η' k x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_sum_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
    hu hη huu' hηη' hu' hη' hηa hηb]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k hk
  have hkn := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (hv k hkn) fun x hx =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hη_nonneg k hkn x hx) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (hu'_nonneg k hkn x hx)

name: NLAlib.neg_inv_pi_mul_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_and_nonneg
statement:
theorem neg_inv_pi_mul_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_and_nonneg
    {u η : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η)
    (hηa : η a = 0) (hηb : η b = 0)
    (hη_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ η x)
    (hu'_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ deriv u x) :
    (-(Real.pi⁻¹) * ∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * deriv η x) =
        Real.pi⁻¹ * ∫ x in a..b, η x * Real.exp (u x) * deriv u x ∧
      0 ≤ -(Real.pi⁻¹) * ∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * deriv η x
proof:
:= by
  have hdu : Differentiable ℝ u := hu.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hdη : Differentiable ℝ η := hη.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hi := neg_integral_exp_mul_deriv_eq_of_endpoints_eq_zero
    hu.continuous.continuousOn hη.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => (hdu x).hasDerivAt) (fun x _ => (hdη x).hasDerivAt)
    (hu.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable a b)
    (hη.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable a b) hηa hηb
  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∫ x in a..b, η x * Real.exp (u x) * deriv u x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab fun x hx =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hη_nonneg x hx) (Real.exp_pos _).le) (hu'_nonneg x hx)
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = Real.pi⁻¹ * -(∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * deriv η x) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hi]
  · calc
      _ = Real.pi⁻¹ * -(∫ x in a..b, Real.exp (u x) * deriv η x) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hi]
      _ ≥ 0 := mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.pi_pos.le) hpos

name: NLAlib.eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two
statement:
theorem eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    f 1 = f 0 + deriv f 0 +
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) * iteratedDeriv 2 f t
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : Continuous (deriv f) := by
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_one] using hf.continuous_iteratedDeriv 1 (by norm_num)
  have hfcc : Continuous (iteratedDeriv 2 f) := hf.continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 le_rfl
  have hfd : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hfdd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f) := by
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_one] using hf.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 1 (by norm_num)
  have hparts := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := (1 : ℝ))
    (u := fun t : ℝ => 1 - t) (u' := fun _ : ℝ => -1)
    (v := deriv f) (v' := iteratedDeriv 2 f)
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn hfc.continuousOn
    (fun t _ => by convert! (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t) using 1; simp)
    (fun t _ => by simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
      (hfdd t).hasDerivAt)
    intervalIntegrable_const (hfcc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := (1 : ℝ)) (fun t _ => hfd t) (hfc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, sub_zero, one_mul, neg_one_mul,
    intervalIntegral.integral_neg, hint] at hparts
  linarith

name: NLAlib.le_add_deriv_add_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient
statement:
theorem le_add_deriv_add_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient {f : ℝ → ℝ} {r c : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, iteratedDeriv 2 f t ≤ Real.exp (t * r) * c) :
    f 1 ≤ f 0 + deriv f 0 + c * expSecondRemainderCoefficient r
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two hf]
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  rw [expSecondRemainderCoefficient, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
  · exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
      (hf.continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 le_rfl)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  · exact (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)))).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  · intro t ht
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 - t) * (Real.exp (t * r) * c) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound t ht) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.expSecondRemainderCoefficient_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSecondRemainderCoefficient_nonneg (r : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ expSecondRemainderCoefficient r
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num)
  intro t ht
  exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.expSecondRemainderCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem expSecondRemainderCoefficient_zero :
    expSecondRemainderCoefficient 0 = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expSecondRemainderCoefficient, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (f := fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
    (g := fun t : ℝ => t) intervalIntegrable_const
    (continuous_id.intervalIntegrable (0 : ℝ) 1)]
  norm_num [integral_id]

name: NLAlib.sq_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient
statement:
theorem sq_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient (r : ℝ) :
    r ^ 2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient r = Real.exp r - 1 - r
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv : deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t * r)) =
      fun t => Real.exp (t * r) * r := by
    funext t
    simpa only [id_eq, one_mul] using (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const r).exp).deriv
  have hsecond : iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t * r)) =
      fun t => r ^ 2 * Real.exp (t * r) := by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hderiv]
    funext t
    have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const r).exp).mul_const r).deriv
    simp only [id_eq, one_mul] at h
    exact h.trans (by ring)
  have h := eq_add_deriv_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two
    (f := fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t * r)) (by fun_prop)
  rw [hderiv, hsecond] at h
  simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero] at h
  have heq : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) * (r ^ 2 * Real.exp (t * r))) =
      r ^ 2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient r := by
    rw [expSecondRemainderCoefficient, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext t
    ring
  rw [heq] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.expSecondRemainderCoefficient_eq_div
statement:
theorem expSecondRemainderCoefficient_eq_div {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    expSecondRemainderCoefficient r = (Real.exp r - 1 - r) / r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hr)).mpr
  simpa only [mul_comm] using sq_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient r

name: NLAlib.continuous_expSecondRemainderCoefficient
statement:
theorem continuous_expSecondRemainderCoefficient :
    Continuous expSecondRemainderCoefficient
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (Function.uncurry
      (fun r t : ℝ => (1 - t) * Real.exp (t * r))) := by
    fun_prop
  have h := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous
    (μ := volume) hcont (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1))
  change Continuous (fun r => expSecondRemainderCoefficient r)
  simpa only [expSecondRemainderCoefficient,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num),
    integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc] using h

name: NLAlib.monotone_expSecondRemainderCoefficient
statement:
theorem monotone_expSecondRemainderCoefficient :
    Monotone expSecondRemainderCoefficient
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
  · exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  · exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  · intro t ht
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrs ht.1))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)

name: NLAlib.one_half_le_expSecondRemainderCoefficient
statement:
theorem one_half_le_expSecondRemainderCoefficient {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    1 / 2 ≤ expSecondRemainderCoefficient r
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [expSecondRemainderCoefficient_zero] using
    monotone_expSecondRemainderCoefficient hr

name: NLAlib.expSecondRemainderCoefficient_le_div
statement:
theorem expSecondRemainderCoefficient_le_div {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 3) :
    expSecondRemainderCoefficient r ≤ (1 / 2) / (1 - r / 3)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : r = 0
  · simp [hzero]
  have hb := exp_mul_le_one_add_mul_add_sq_mul_of_le
    (L := r) (θ := (1 : ℝ)) (x := r) (by norm_num) (by simpa using hr) le_rfl
  simp only [one_mul, one_pow] at hb
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hzero)).mp
  rw [sq_mul_expSecondRemainderCoefficient]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.iteratedDeriv_sub_eval_eqOn
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_sub_eval_eqOn {f : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (p : ℝ[X])
    {n : ℕ} (hf : ∀ k < n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) U) :
    ∀ k ≤ n, EqOn (iteratedDeriv k (fun t => f t - p.eval t))
      (fun t => iteratedDeriv k f t - (derivative^[k] p).eval t) U
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  induction k with
  | zero => intro t _; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro t ht
    have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun t => f t - p.eval t) =ᶠ[nhds t]
        (fun t => iteratedDeriv k f t - (derivative^[k] p).eval t) :=
      (ih (by omega)).eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds ht)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, hev.deriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_succ, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact (deriv_fun_sub ((hf k (by omega)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds ht))
      (Polynomial.differentiableAt _)).trans (by rw [Polynomial.deriv])

name: Path.contDiffOn_extend_segment
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_extend_segment {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (a b : E) (n : WithTop ℕ∞) : ContDiffOn ℝ n (Path.segment a b).extend I
proof:
:= by
  have h : ContDiff ℝ n (AffineMap.lineMap a b : ℝ → E) := by
    have he : (AffineMap.lineMap a b : ℝ → E) = fun t => (1 - t) • a + t • b := by
      funext t
      simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
    rw [he]
    fun_prop
  exact h.contDiffOn.congr (fun t ht => eqOn_extend_segment a b ht)

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_bounds_tsupport_and_deriv
statement:
theorem exists_pos_bounds_tsupport_and_deriv (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi 0) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ a < b ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ Icc a b ∧ tsupport (deriv ψ) ⊆ Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hlow⟩ := hψc.isCompact.exists_forall_le' continuous_id.continuousOn
    (fun x hx => hψs hx)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hψc.isCompact.bddAbove
  let b := max a B + 1
  have hab : a < b := by dsimp [b]; linarith [le_max_left a B]
  have hs : tsupport ψ ⊆ Icc a b := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hlow x hx, ?_⟩
    have hxb : x ≤ B := hB hx
    dsimp [b]
    linarith [le_max_right a B]
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hab, hs, tsupport_deriv_subset.trans hs⟩

name: Lagrange.degree_basis_le_of_mem
statement:
theorem degree_basis_le_of_mem {F ι : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq ι]
    {s : Finset ι} (v : ι → F) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (Lagrange.basis s v i).degree ≤ ((s.card - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_le_natDegree.trans
  apply WithBot.coe_mono
  unfold Lagrange.basis
  apply (natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans
  calc (∑ j ∈ s.erase i, (basisDivisor (v i) (v j)).natDegree) ≤
      ∑ _j ∈ s.erase i, 1 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        unfold basisDivisor
        exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    _ = s.card - 1 := by simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi]

name: Lagrange.continuousAt_coeff_basisDivisor
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisDivisor, coeff_C_mul, coeff_sub, coeff_C]
  apply ContinuousAt.mul ((hu.sub hv).inv₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))
  apply ContinuousAt.sub continuousAt_const
  split_ifs
  · exact hv
  · exact continuousAt_const

name: Lagrange.continuousAt_coeff_basis
statement:
theorem continuousAt_coeff_basis {s : Finset ι} {v : E → ι → 𝕜} {i : ι}
    (hv : ∀ j, ContinuousAt (fun y => v y j) a)
    (hi : i ∈ s) (hinj : Set.InjOn (v a) s) (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => (Lagrange.basis s (v y) i).coeff k) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lagrange.basis]
  apply Polynomial.continuousAt_coeff_prod
  intro j hj l
  exact continuousAt_coeff_basisDivisor (hv i) (hv j)
    (fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1 (hinj (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).2 hi h.symm)) l

name: exists_monotone_deriv_zeros
statement:
private theorem exists_monotone_deriv_zeros {q : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {v : Fin (q + 3) → ℝ} (hv : Monotone v)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _))))
    (hz : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → v i = v j → iteratedDeriv (j.val - i.val) f (v i) = 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ, Monotone c ∧
      ∀ i, c i ∈ Icc (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ∧ deriv f (c i) = 0 ∧
        (v i.castSucc ≠ v i.succ → c i ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ))
proof:
:= by
  have hex (i : Fin (q + 2)) : ∃ c,
      c ∈ Icc (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ∧ deriv f c = 0 ∧
        (v i.castSucc ≠ v i.succ → c ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) := by
    by_cases heq : v i.castSucc = v i.succ
    · refine ⟨v i.castSucc, ⟨le_rfl, heq.le⟩, ?_, by simp [heq]⟩
      have h := hz i.castSucc i.succ (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ.le) heq
      simpa using h
    · have hlt : v i.castSucc < v i.succ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (hv Fin.castSucc_lt_succ.le) heq
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_zero hlt (hf.mono
        (Icc_subset_Icc (hv (Fin.zero_le _)) (hv (Fin.le_last _))))
        (by have h₁ := hz i.castSucc i.castSucc le_rfl rfl
            have h₂ := hz i.succ i.succ le_rfl rfl
            simpa using h₁.trans h₂.symm)
      exact ⟨c, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc, hc0, fun _ => hc⟩
  choose c hc using hex
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hc⟩
  intro i j hij
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hij with rfl | hij
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact (hc i).1.2.trans ((hv (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hij)).trans (hc j).1.1)

name: exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_monotone_with_multiplicities
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_monotone_with_multiplicities
    {q : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {v : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : Monotone v) (hspan : v 0 < v (Fin.last _))
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin (q + 1), v i.castSucc = v i.succ → v i.castSucc ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _))))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → v i = v j → iteratedDeriv (j.val - i.val) f (v i) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing f with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_zero hspan hf
      (by have h₁ := hz 0 0 le_rfl rfl
          have h₂ := hz (Fin.last _) (Fin.last _) le_rfl rfl
          simpa using h₁.trans h₂.symm)
    exact ⟨ξ, ⟨(hva 0).1.trans_lt hξ.1, hξ.2.trans_le (hva _).2⟩,
      by simpa using hξ0⟩
  | succ q ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hcm, hc⟩ := exists_monotone_deriv_zeros hv hf hz
    have hci (i : Fin (q + 2)) : c i ∈ Ioo a b := by
      by_cases heq : v i.castSucc = v i.succ
      · have hpoint : c i = v i.castSucc := le_antisymm
          ((hc i).1.2.trans_eq heq.symm) (hc i).1.1
        rw [hpoint]
        exact hrep i heq
      · have hi := (hc i).2.2 heq
        exact ⟨(hva _).1.trans_lt hi.1, hi.2.trans_le (hva _).2⟩
    have hcs : c 0 < c (Fin.last _) := by
      by_contra hnot
      have heq : c 0 = c (Fin.last _) := le_antisymm
        (hcm (Fin.zero_le _)) (not_lt.mp hnot)
      have hm : v (Fin.succ 0) ≤ v (Fin.last (q + 1)).castSucc := hv (by
        simp only [Fin.le_def, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]
        omega)
      have hfirst : v 0 = v (Fin.succ 0) := by
        by_contra hne
        have hh := (hc 0).2.2 hne
        have ht := (hc (Fin.last _)).1.1
        simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero] at hh
        rw [heq] at hh
        have hh2 := hh.2
        linarith
      have hlast : v (Fin.last (q + 1)).castSucc = v (Fin.last (q + 2)) := by
        by_contra hne
        have hh := (hc (Fin.last _)).2.2 hne
        have ht := (hc 0).1.2
        rw [← heq] at hh
        have hh1 := hh.1
        linarith
      have ht₁ := (hc 0).1.2
      have ht₂ := (hc (Fin.last _)).1.1
      change v 0 < v (Fin.last (q + 2)) at hspan
      rw [hfirst, ← hlast] at hspan
      rw [heq] at ht₁
      linarith
    have hcz : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → c i = c j →
        iteratedDeriv (j.val - i.val) (deriv f) (c i) = 0 := by
      intro i j hij heq
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hij with rfl | hij
      · simpa using (hc i).2.1
      have hm := hv (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hij)
      have hupper := (hc i).1.2
      have hlower := (hc j).1.1
      have h₁ : c i = v i.succ := by rw [heq]; linarith
      have h₂ : c j = v j.castSucc := by rw [← heq]; linarith
      have hi : v i.castSucc = v i.succ := by
        by_contra hne
        have hh := (hc i).2.2 hne
        rw [h₁] at hh
        exact (lt_irrefl _ hh.2)
      have hj : v j.castSucc = v j.succ := by
        by_contra hne
        have hh := (hc j).2.2 hne
        rw [h₂] at hh
        exact (lt_irrefl _ hh.1)
      have hold := hz i.castSucc j.succ (by
        simp only [Fin.le_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
        have hijv : i.val < j.val := hij
        omega) (by linarith)
      rw [show j.succ.val - i.castSucc.val = (j.val - i.val) + 1 by
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]; omega, iteratedDeriv_succ'] at hold
      simpa only [show c i = v i.castSucc by linarith] using hold
    have hsub : Icc (c 0) (c (Fin.last _)) ⊆ Ioo a b :=
      Icc_subset_Ioo (hci 0).1 (hci _).2
    have hdc : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Ioo a b) := by simpa using hf' 0 (by omega)
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξ0⟩ := ih hcm hcs
      (fun i => Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hci i)) (fun i _ => hci _)
      (hdc.mono hsub)
      (fun k hk => by simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using hf' (k + 1) (by omega)) hcz
    exact ⟨ξ, hξ, by simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using hξ0⟩

name: card_filter_ge_of_monotone_eq
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (j.val - i.val + 1) ↪ Fin N :=
    ⟨fun k => ⟨i.val + k.val, by
      have := i.isLt
      have := j.isLt
      have := k.isLt
      have hijv : i.val ≤ j.val := hij
      omega⟩,
      by intro k l h; apply Fin.ext; have := congrArg Fin.val h; dsimp at this; omega⟩
  have hsub : Finset.univ.map e ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = w i) := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hk
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
    · have hkj : e t ≤ j := by
        change i.val + t.val ≤ j.val
        have ht := t.isLt
        have hijv : i.val ≤ j.val := hij
        omega
      exact (hw hkj).trans_eq heq.symm
    · exact hw (by change i.val ≤ i.val + t.val; omega)
  simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_multiset_multiplicities
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_multiset_multiplicities
    {q : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (m : Multiset ℝ) (hm : m.card = q + 2)
    (hdistinct : ∃ x ∈ m, ∃ y ∈ m, x ≠ y)
    (hmem : ∀ x ∈ m, x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hrep : ∀ x ∈ m, 1 < m.count x → x ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count x, iteratedDeriv k f x = 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let l := m.sort (· ≤ ·)
  have hlen : l.length = q + 2 := by simp [l, hm]
  let w : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ := fun i => l.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)
  have hwm : Finset.univ.val.map w = m := by
    rw [Fin.univ_val_map]
    change (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (q + 2) => l.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i) : Multiset ℝ) = m
    rw [← List.ofFn_congr hlen l.get, List.ofFn_get]
    exact Multiset.sort_eq _ _
  have hwi (i : Fin (q + 2)) : w i ∈ m := by
    rw [← hwm]
    exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, by simp, rfl⟩
  have hmono : Monotone w := by
    intro i j hij
    exact (Multiset.pairwise_sort m (· ≤ ·)).rel_get_of_le hij
  have hcount {i j : Fin (q + 2)} (hij : i ≤ j) (heq : w i = w j) :
      j.val - i.val + 1 ≤ m.count (w i) := by
    have h := card_filter_ge_of_monotone_eq hmono hij heq
    have hc : m.count (w i) = (Finset.univ.filter fun k => w k = w i).card := by
      rw [← hwm, Multiset.count_map]
      simp [← Finset.filter_val, eq_comm]
    rwa [hc]
  have hspan : w 0 < w (Fin.last _) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have heq : w 0 = w (Fin.last _) := le_antisymm (hmono (Fin.zero_le _)) (not_lt.mp hnot)
    have hall (i : Fin (q + 2)) : w i = w 0 :=
      le_antisymm ((hmono (Fin.le_last _)).trans_eq heq.symm) (hmono (Fin.zero_le _))
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := hdistinct
    rw [← hwm] at hx hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
    exact hxy ((hall i).trans (hall j).symm)
  apply exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_monotone_with_multiplicities hmono hspan
    (fun i => hmem _ (hwi i))
  · intro i hi
    have hc := hcount Fin.castSucc_lt_succ.le hi
    apply hrep _ (hwi _)
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hc
    omega
  · exact hf.mono (Icc_subset_Icc (hmem _ (hwi 0)).1 (hmem _ (hwi _)).2)
  · exact hf'
  · intro i j hij heq
    exact hz _ (hwi i) _ (by have := hcount hij heq; omega)

name: norm_sub_endpoints_le_of_hasDerivAt_Ioo
statement:
theorem norm_sub_endpoints_le_of_hasDerivAt_Ioo
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f f' : ℝ → E} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 1))
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, ‖f' t‖ ≤ C) : ‖f 1 - f 0‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hl : LipschitzOnWith ⟨C, hC⟩ f (Ioo 0 1) := by
    apply Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le
      (fun t ht => (hf t ht).differentiableAt) _ (convex_Ioo 0 1)
    intro t ht
    change ‖deriv f t‖ ≤ C
    rw [(hf t ht).deriv]
    exact hb t ht
  have hclosure : closure (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) = Icc 0 1 := closure_Ioo zero_ne_one
  have hlc := hl.closure (by rwa [hclosure])
  rw [hclosure] at hlc
  have h := hlc.dist_le_mul 1 (show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 from ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩)
    0 (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 from ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩)
  convert h using 1 <;> norm_num [dist_eq_norm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.abs_le_abs_add_mul_abs_of_abs_deriv_le
statement:
theorem abs_le_abs_add_mul_abs_of_abs_deriv_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (C : ℝ)
    (hdf : ∀ x, |deriv f x| ≤ C) (z : ℝ) : |f z| ≤ |f 0| + C * |z|
proof:
:= by
  have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le (f := f) (s := Set.univ) (C := C)
    (fun x _ => hf x) (fun x _ => by simpa using hdf x) convex_univ (Set.mem_univ 0)
    (Set.mem_univ z)
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at this
  have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f z) (f 0)
  linarith

name: LipschitzOnWith.norm_deriv_comp_le
statement:
theorem LipschitzOnWith.norm_deriv_comp_le {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} {L : NNReal} {x : ℝ}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f s) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x)
    (hgs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, g y ∈ s) :
    ‖deriv (f ∘ g) x‖ ≤ L * ‖deriv g x‖
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ g) x
  · apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hd.hasDerivAt.tendsto_slope.norm
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hg.hasDerivAt.tendsto_slope.norm)
    filter_upwards [hgs.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with y hy
    simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hx : g x ∈ s := show x ∈ {y | g y ∈ s} from mem_of_mem_nhds hgs
    have hb := hf.norm_sub_le hy hx
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg (y - x)))]
  · rw [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd, norm_zero]
    positivity

name: Polynomial.contDiffAt_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_coeff_mul {p q : E → 𝕜[X]}
    (hp : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (p y).coeff k) x)
    (hq : ∀ k, ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (q y).coeff k) x) (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiffAt 𝕜 r (fun y => (p y * q y).coeff k) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_mul]
  exact ContDiffAt.sum (fun i _ => (hp i.1).mul (hq i.2))

name: Polynomial.hasCoeffDerivAt_const
statement:
theorem hasCoeffDerivAt_const (p : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    HasCoeffDerivAt (fun _ => p) 0 x
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  simpa using hasDerivAt_const x (p.coeff k)

name: Polynomial.HasCoeffDerivAt.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  simp only [coeff_mul, coeff_add]
  convert HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.antidiagonal k) =>
    (hp i.1).mul (hq i.2)) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Polynomial.continuousAt_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem continuousAt_coeff_mul {p q : T → R[X]}
    (hp : ∀ k, ContinuousAt (fun y => (p y).coeff k) a)
    (hq : ∀ k, ContinuousAt (fun y => (q y).coeff k) a) (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => (p y * q y).coeff k) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_mul]
  exact tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hp i.1).mul (hq i.2))

name: Polynomial.continuousAt_coeff_prod
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing k with
  | empty => simpa using (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : T => (1 : R[X]).coeff k) a)
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi]
    exact continuousAt_coeff_mul (hp i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (fun j => ih (fun l hl => hp l (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hl)) j) k

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem exists_norm_sub_eq_infDist_of_finiteDimensional {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (S : Submodule ℝ E)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] (f : E) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, ‖f - p‖ = Metric.infDist f (S : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set S := Metric.closedBall 0 (2 * ‖f‖)
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have h0 : (0 : S) ∈ K := by simp [K, norm_nonneg]
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : S => ‖f - (p : E)‖) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn ⟨0, h0⟩ hc.continuousOn
  have hbest : ∀ q : S, ‖f - (p : E)‖ ≤ ‖f - (q : E)‖ := by
    intro q
    by_cases hq : q ∈ K
    · exact hmin hq
    · have hqnorm : 2 * ‖f‖ < ‖(q : E)‖ := by
        simpa [K, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hq
      have htri := norm_sub_norm_le (q : E) f
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at htri
      have hp0 : ‖f - (p : E)‖ ≤ ‖f - ((0 : S) : E)‖ := hmin h0
      simp only [Submodule.coe_zero, sub_zero] at hp0
      linarith
  refine ⟨p, p.property, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · exact (Metric.le_infDist ⟨0, S.zero_mem⟩).mpr fun q hq => by
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hbest ⟨q, hq⟩
  · simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := f) p.property)

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_norm_sub_smul_lt_of_extremal_sign
statement:
theorem exists_pos_norm_sub_smul_lt_of_extremal_sign {K : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K] (e h : C(K, ℝ)) (hE : 0 < ‖e‖)
    (hsign : ∀ x, |e x| = ‖e‖ → 0 < e x * h x) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ‖e - t • h‖ < ‖e‖
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : ∀ x : K, ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × K in 𝓝 (0, x),
      0 < z.1 → |e z.2 - z.1 * h z.2| < ‖e‖ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : |e x| = ‖e‖
    · have hneg : -2 * e x * h x < 0 := by nlinarith [hsign x hx]
      have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × K => -2 * e z.2 * h z.2 + z.1 * (h z.2) ^ 2) :=
        by fun_prop
      have hev : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × K in 𝓝 (0, x),
          -2 * e z.2 * h z.2 + z.1 * (h z.2) ^ 2 < 0 :=
        hc.continuousAt.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa using hneg))
      filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
      intro ht
      have hbound : |e z.2| ≤ ‖e‖ := e.norm_coe_le_norm z.2
      have hsq : (e z.2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖e‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_abs (e z.2), abs_nonneg (e z.2)]
      have hmul := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ht hz
      apply (abs_lt).mpr
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (e z.2 - z.1 * h z.2 + ‖e‖),
        sq_nonneg (e z.2 - z.1 * h z.2 - ‖e‖)]
    · have hxlt : |e x| < ‖e‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (e.norm_coe_le_norm x) hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × K => |e z.2 - z.1 * h z.2|) := by fun_prop
      have hev : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × K in 𝓝 (0, x), |e z.2 - z.1 * h z.2| < ‖e‖ :=
        hc.continuousAt.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa using hxlt))
      exact hev.mono fun z hz _ => hz
  have huniform : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ∀ x : K,
      0 < t → |e x - t * h x| < ‖e‖ :=
    isCompact_univ.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually (fun x _ => hlocal x) |>.mono
      (fun _ ht x => ht x (Set.mem_univ x))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hstep⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp huniform
  refine ⟨δ / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hnear : dist (δ / 2) (0 : ℝ) < δ := by rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_lt_iff _ hE).mpr
  intro x
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hstep hnear x (by positivity : 0 < δ / 2)

name: Matrix.PosDef.eventually_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδB⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ•(1 : M)≤B := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
        (fun r hr => hB.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hr)
  have hn : ∀ᶠ x in l, ‖f x-B‖<δ :=
    ((hf.sub_const B).norm).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by simpa using hδ))
  filter_upwards [hn,hH] with x hx hHx
  have hneg : (-‖f x-B‖)•(1 : M)≤f x-B := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,neg_smul] using
      (hHx.sub hB.isHermitian).isSelfAdjoint.neg_algebraMap_norm_le_self
  have hle : (δ-‖f x-B‖)•(1 : M)≤f x := by
    convert! add_le_add hδB hneg using 1 <;> module
  have hp : IsStrictlyPositive (f x) :=
    (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (sub_pos.mpr hx)).isStrictlyPositive.of_le hle
  exact Matrix.IsStrictlyPositive.posDef hp

name: Matrix.eventually_posDef_sub_of_posDef_deriv
statement:
theorem eventually_posDef_sub_of_posDef_deriv
    (f : ℝ → M) (B : M) (hderiv : HasDerivAt f B 0) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hH : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, (f t).IsHermitian) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, (f t-f 0).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹•(f t-f 0)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 B) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hderiv.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hH0 : (f 0).IsHermitian := hH.self_of_nhds
  have hHs : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, (t⁻¹•(f t-f 0)).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [hH.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with t ht
    exact (ht.sub hH0).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t⁻¹)
  have hp := hB.eventually_of_tendsto hlim hHs
  filter_upwards [hp,self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht htp
  have hpos : 0<t := htp
  have h := ht.smul hpos
  simpa only [smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hpos.ne',one_smul] using h

name: Matrix.sum_det_updateRow_eq_trace_adjugate_mul
statement:
theorem sum_det_updateRow_eq_trace_adjugate_mul (A H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (∑ i : n, (A.updateRow i (H i)).det) = (A.adjugate * H).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← cramer_transpose_apply, cramer_eq_adjugate_mulVec, ← adjugate_transpose]
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, transpose_apply, trace, diag, mul_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: Matrix.hasDerivAt_det_of_entries
proof:
:= by
  have hAe : HasDerivAt A H t :=
    hasDerivAt_pi.mpr (fun i => hasDerivAt_pi.mpr (hA i))
  have h := ((detRowsContinuous.hasFDerivAt (A t)).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt t hAe
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => (A s).det) (detRowsContinuous.linearDeriv (A t) H) t at h
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.linearDeriv_apply] at h
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => (A s).det)
    (∑ i : n, ((A t).updateRow i (H i)).det) t at h
  rwa [sum_det_updateRow_eq_trace_adjugate_mul] at h

name: HasDerivAt.matrix_det
proof:
:= by
  apply hasDerivAt_det_of_entries
  intro i j
  let L : Matrix n n 𝕜 →L[ℝ] 𝕜 := (Matrix.entryLinearMap ℝ 𝕜 i j).toContinuousLinearMap
  have h := (L.hasFDerivAt (x := A t)).comp_hasDerivAt (f := A) (f' := H) t
    (by convert! hA)
  convert! h using 1

name: HasDerivAt.matrix_det_of_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  have hInv : (A t)⁻¹ = (A t).det⁻¹ • (A t).adjugate := by
    simp [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have hd : (A t).det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (A t)).mp hAt)
  have he : (A t).det * ((A t)⁻¹ * H).trace = ((A t).adjugate * H).trace := by
    rw [hInv, smul_mul, trace_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hd, one_mul]
  rw [he]
  exact hA.matrix_det

name: HasDerivAt.log_re_matrix_det
statement:
theorem _root_.HasDerivAt.log_re_matrix_det {A : ℝ → Matrix n n 𝕜}
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} {t : ℝ} (hA : HasDerivAt A H t)
    (hdet : 0 < (A t).det) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.log (RCLike.re (A s).det))
      (RCLike.re (((A t)⁻¹ * H).trace)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hdet).1
  have hi : IsUnit (A t) := (isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (A t)).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet.ne')
  have hd := (hA.matrix_det_of_isUnit hi)
  have hr := (RCLike.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hd).log hp.ne'
  have he : RCLike.re ((A t).det * ((A t)⁻¹ * H).trace) /
      RCLike.re (A t).det = RCLike.re (((A t)⁻¹ * H).trace) := by
    rw [RCLike.mul_re, (RCLike.pos_iff.mp hdet).2, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hp.ne'
  simpa only [RCLike.reCLM_apply, Function.comp_apply, he] using hr

name: Matrix.matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply (u : n → ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixQuadraticFormCLM u A = star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM_apply (u : n → ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM u A = (star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)).re
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.re_star_dotProduct_sq_mulVec_eq_sum_sq_norm_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem re_star_dotProduct_sq_mulVec_eq_sum_sq_norm_of_isHermitian
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (u : n → ℂ) :
    (star u ⬝ᵥ (A ^ 2 *ᵥ u)).re = ∑ i, ‖(A *ᵥ u) i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : A ^ 2 = Aᴴ * A := by rw [hA.eq, sq]
  rw [hsq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose, star_star]
  simp only [dotProduct, Complex.re_sum, Pi.star_apply, RCLike.star_def,
    Complex.conj_mul', ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: Matrix.matrix_eq_of_isHermitian_of_re_dotProduct_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem matrix_eq_of_isHermitian_of_re_dotProduct_mulVec_eq
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hq : ∀ u : n → ℂ, (star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)).re = (star u ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ u)).re) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hfull : ∀ u : n → ℂ, star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u) = star u ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ u) := by
    intro u
    apply Complex.ext (hq u)
    have hAi : (star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)).im = 0 := hA.im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self u
    have hBi : (star u ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ u)).im = 0 := hB.im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self u
    exact hAi.trans hBi.symm
  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
  apply (ext_inner_map _ _).mp
  intro x
  have hinner : inner ℂ x (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A x) = inner ℂ x (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B x) := by
    simpa only [PiLp.inner_apply, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, RCLike.inner_apply', dotProduct,
      starRingEnd_apply, Pi.star_apply] using hfull (WithLp.ofLp x)
  have hconj := congrArg star hinner
  simpa only [RCLike.star_def, inner_conj_symm] using hconj

name: Matrix.stieltjes_eventuallyEq_of_upperHalfPlane
statement:
private theorem stieltjes_eventuallyEq_of_upperHalfPlane
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (f g : ℂ → E) (u : ℝ) (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f (u : ℂ))
    (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g (u : ℂ))
    (he : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → f z=g z) : f=ᶠ[𝓝 (u : ℂ)] g
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf.eventually_eq_or_eventually_ne hg with h|h
  · exact h
  · let γ (k : ℕ) : ℝ := 1/((k : ℝ)+1)
    have hγ (k : ℕ) : 0<γ k := by dsimp only [γ]; positivity
    have hγ0 : Tendsto γ atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_div_atTop 1
    have hz : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (u : ℂ)+(γ k : ℂ)*Complex.I)
        atTop (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul,add_zero,Function.comp_def] using
        tendsto_const_nhds.add (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hγ0).mul_const Complex.I)
    have hzne (k : ℕ) : (u : ℂ)+(γ k : ℂ)*Complex.I≠(u : ℂ) := by
      intro hh
      have hi := congrArg Complex.im hh
      have hi' : γ k=0 := by simpa only [Complex.add_im,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,zero_add,add_zero]
        using hi
      exact (hγ k).ne' hi'
    have hz' : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (u : ℂ)+(γ k : ℂ)*Complex.I)
        atTop (𝓝[≠] (u : ℂ)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hz,Eventually.of_forall hzne⟩
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := (hz'.eventually h).exists
    exact False.elim (hk (he _ (by simpa using hγ k)))

name: Matrix.exists_global_real_matrix_extension_of_quadratic_stieltjes
statement:
theorem exists_global_real_matrix_extension_of_quadratic_stieltjes
    (N : ℂ → M) (μ : (n → ℂ) → FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))
    (hcompact : ∀ v : n → ℂ, IsCompact (μ v : Measure ℝ).support) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → M,
      (∀ u : ℝ, (∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, t≠u) →
        AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=N z) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  let Q (v : n → ℂ) (z : ℂ) := ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ)
  let G : ℂ → M := fun z =>
    (∑ i : n, ∑ j : n,
      ((1/8 : ℂ)*(Q (Pi.single i 1+Pi.single j 1) z-
        Q (Pi.single i 1-Pi.single j 1) z))•hermitianUnitRe i j)+
    (∑ i : n, ∑ j : n,
      ((-1/8 : ℂ)*(Q (Pi.single i 1+Complex.I•Pi.single j 1) z-
        Q (Pi.single i 1-Complex.I•Pi.single j 1) z))•hermitianUnitIm i j)
  have hQa (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, t≠u)
      (v : n → ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (Q v) (u : ℂ) :=
    analyticAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support (μ v : Measure ℝ) (hcompact v) u
      (fun t ht htu => hu v t ht (Complex.ofReal_injective htu))
  have hGa (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, t≠u) :
      AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) := by
    apply AnalyticAt.add
    · apply Finset.univ.analyticAt_fun_sum
      intro i _
      apply Finset.univ.analyticAt_fun_sum
      intro j _
      exact (analyticAt_const.mul ((hQa u hu _).sub (hQa u hu _))).smul analyticAt_const
    · apply Finset.univ.analyticAt_fun_sum
      intro i _
      apply Finset.univ.analyticAt_fun_sum
      intro j _
      exact (analyticAt_const.mul ((hQa u hu _).sub (hQa u hu _))).smul analyticAt_const
  have hGN (z : ℂ) (hz : 0<z.im) : G z=N z := by
    have hQ (v : n → ℂ) : Q v z=matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z) := (hμ v z hz).symm
    simp only [G,hQ,matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub,matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub_I]
    have hr (i j : n) : (1/8 : ℂ)*(2*((N z) i j+(N z) j i))=
        ((N z) i j+(N z) j i)/4 := by ring
    have hi (i j : n) : (-1/8 : ℂ)*(2*Complex.I*((N z) i j-(N z) j i))=
        ((N z) i j-(N z) j i)/(4*Complex.I) := by
      field_simp
      simp only [Complex.I_sq]
      ring
    simp_rw [hr,hi]
    exact sum_hermitianUnit_eq (N z)
  have hGr (x : ℝ) : (G x).IsHermitian := by
    have hQr (v : n → ℂ) : Q v (x : ℂ)=((∫ t : ℝ, (t-x)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [Q,← Complex.ofReal_sub,← Complex.ofReal_inv]
      exact integral_complex_ofReal
    have hRe (i j : n) :
        (((1/8 : ℂ)*(Q (Pi.single i 1+Pi.single j 1) x-
          Q (Pi.single i 1-Pi.single j 1) x))•hermitianUnitRe i j).IsHermitian := by
      apply (isHermitian_hermitianUnitRe i j).smul
      rw [hQr,hQr]
      simp [IsSelfAdjoint]
    have hIm (i j : n) :
        (((-1/8 : ℂ)*(Q (Pi.single i 1+Complex.I•Pi.single j 1) x-
          Q (Pi.single i 1-Complex.I•Pi.single j 1) x))•hermitianUnitIm i j).IsHermitian := by
      apply (isHermitian_hermitianUnitIm i j).smul
      rw [hQr,hQr]
      simp [IsSelfAdjoint]
    change (G x)ᴴ=G x
    simp only [G,Matrix.conjTranspose_add,Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
    apply congrArg₂ (fun A B : M => A+B)
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact (hRe i j).eq
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact (hIm i j).eq
  exact ⟨G,hGa,hGN,hGr⟩

name: Matrix.exists_analytic_real_matrix_extension_of_quadratic_stieltjes
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_real_matrix_extension_of_quadratic_stieltjes
    (N : ℂ → M) (μ : (n → ℂ) → FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))
    (hcompact : ∀ v : n → ℂ, IsCompact (μ v : Measure ℝ).support)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, t≠u) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → M, AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=N z) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hGa,hGN,hGr⟩ :=
    exists_global_real_matrix_extension_of_quadratic_stieltjes N μ hμ hcompact
  exact ⟨G,hGa u hu,hGN,hGr⟩

name: Matrix.quadratic_value_deriv_real_extension_of_stieltjes
statement:
theorem quadratic_value_deriv_real_extension_of_stieltjes
    (N G : ℂ → M) (μ : (n → ℂ) → FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))
    (hcompact : ∀ v : n → ℂ, IsCompact (μ v : Measure ℝ).support)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, t≠u)
    (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ)) (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=N z)
    (v : n → ℂ) :
    matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (G u)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-(u : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ) ∧
    matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (deriv G (u : ℂ))=
      ∫ t : ℝ, (((t : ℂ)-(u : ℂ))⁻¹)^2 ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, (t : ℂ)≠(u : ℂ) :=
    fun t ht htu => hu v t ht (Complex.ofReal_injective htu)
  have hQa := analyticAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
    (μ v : Measure ℝ) (hcompact v) u hgap
  have hpa := ((matrixQuadraticFormCLM v).analyticAt (G u)).comp hGa
  have he := stieltjes_eventuallyEq_of_upperHalfPlane
    (fun z : ℂ => matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (G z))
    (fun z : ℂ => ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ)) u hpa hQa
    (fun z hz => by rw [hGN z hz]; exact hμ v z hz)
  refine ⟨he.self_of_nhds,?_⟩
  have hpder : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (G z))
      (matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (deriv G (u : ℂ))) (u : ℂ) :=
    (matrixQuadraticFormCLM v).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (u : ℂ) hGa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hQder := hasDerivAt_integral_real_cauchyKernel_of_support
    (μ v : Measure ℝ) (hcompact v) u hgap
  exact hpder.unique (hQder.congr_of_eventuallyEq he)

name: Matrix.stieltjes_isHermitian_deriv_of_real_values
statement:
private theorem stieltjes_isHermitian_deriv_of_real_values
    (G : ℂ → M) (u : ℝ) (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hreal : ∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian) :
    (deriv G (u : ℂ)).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => G (x : ℂ)) (deriv G (u : ℂ)) u :=
    by
      have hcoe : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) u := by
        convert! (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := u)) using 1
      have hGC : HasFDerivAt G
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ (deriv G (u : ℂ))).restrictScalars ℝ) (u : ℂ) :=
        hGa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ
      convert! hGC.comp_hasDerivAt u hcoe using 1
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
        one_smul]
  have hl := hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hc : IsClosed {A : M | IsSelfAdjoint A} :=
    isClosed_eq continuous_star continuous_id
  apply IsSelfAdjoint.isHermitian
  apply hc.mem_of_tendsto hl
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t : ℝ =>
    (((hreal (u+t)).sub (hreal u)).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all t⁻¹)).isSelfAdjoint

name: Matrix.posDef_real_extension_and_deriv_of_quadratic_stieltjes
statement:
theorem posDef_real_extension_and_deriv_of_quadratic_stieltjes
    (N G : ℂ → M) (μ : (n → ℂ) → FiniteMeasure ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (N z)=
      ∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-z)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))
    (hcompact : ∀ v : n → ℂ, IsCompact (μ v : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hmass : ∀ v : n → ℂ, v≠0 → (μ v : Measure ℝ)≠0)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : ∀ v : n → ℂ, ∀ t ∈ (μ v : Measure ℝ).support, u<t)
    (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ)) (hGN : ∀ z : ℂ, 0<z.im → G z=N z)
    (hreal : ∀ x : ℝ, (G x).IsHermitian) :
    (G u).PosDef ∧ (deriv G (u : ℂ)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hquad (v : n → ℂ) (hv : v≠0) :
      0<matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (G u) ∧
      0<matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (deriv G (u : ℂ)) := by
    have hp := integral_inv_sub_pos_and_sq_pos_of_support_gt
      (μ v : Measure ℝ) (hcompact v) (hmass v hv) u (hu v)
    have he := quadratic_value_deriv_real_extension_of_stieltjes N G μ hμ hcompact u
      (fun w t ht => (hu w t ht).ne') hGa hGN v
    rw [he.1,he.2]
    have hval : (∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ)-(u : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))=
        ((∫ t : ℝ, (t-u)⁻¹ ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [← Complex.ofReal_sub,← Complex.ofReal_inv]
      exact integral_complex_ofReal
    have hder : (∫ t : ℝ, (((t : ℂ)-(u : ℂ))⁻¹)^2 ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ))=
        ((∫ t : ℝ, ((t-u)⁻¹)^2 ∂(μ v : Measure ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [← Complex.ofReal_sub,← Complex.ofReal_inv,← Complex.ofReal_pow]
      exact integral_complex_ofReal
    rw [hval,hder]
    exact ⟨Complex.zero_lt_real.mpr hp.1,Complex.zero_lt_real.mpr hp.2⟩
  exact ⟨PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (hreal u) (fun v hv => (hquad v hv).1),
    PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (stieltjes_isHermitian_deriv_of_real_values G u hGa hreal)
      (fun v hv => (hquad v hv).2)⟩

name: Matrix.exists_polynomial_charpoly_coeff_affine
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_charpoly_coeff_affine
    (A E : Matrix n n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℂ[X], ∀ t : ℂ, p.eval t = (A + t • E).charpoly.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix n n ℂ[X] := A.map C + (X : ℂ[X]) • E.map C
  refine ⟨M.charpoly.coeff k, fun t => ?_⟩
  have hmap : M.charpoly.map (evalRingHom t) = (A + t • E).charpoly := by
    rw [← Matrix.charpoly_map]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    simp [M, Matrix.map_apply]
    ring
  simpa only [coeff_map, coe_evalRingHom] using congrArg (fun p => p.coeff k) hmap

name: Matrix.analyticAt_charpoly_coeff_affine
statement:
theorem analyticAt_charpoly_coeff_affine
    (A E : Matrix n n ℂ) (k : ℕ) (t : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => (A + u • E).charpoly.coeff k) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_polynomial_charpoly_coeff_affine A E k
  simpa [hp, Polynomial.aeval_def] using
    (analyticAt_id (𝕜 := ℂ) (z := t)).aeval_polynomial p

name: Matrix.bilinearCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bilinearCLM_apply (v : m → 𝕜) (w : n → 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    bilinearCLM v w A = star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.norm_nonsing_inv_le_of_sub_smul_one_le
statement:
theorem norm_nonsing_inv_le_of_sub_smul_one_le
    (X : Matrix n n 𝕜) (w : 𝕜) (r : ℝ) (hX : IsUnit X)
    (herror : ‖X-w•1‖≤r) (hgap : r<‖w‖) :
    ‖X⁻¹‖≤(‖w‖-r)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖(1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)‖≤1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one,Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun i => by simp
  have he : w•X⁻¹=1-(X-w•1)*X⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hX),
      Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.one_mul]
    abel
  have hn : ‖w‖*‖X⁻¹‖≤1+r*‖X⁻¹‖ := by
    calc
      _ = ‖w•X⁻¹‖ := (norm_smul _ _).symm
      _ = ‖1-(X-w•1)*X⁻¹‖ := by rw [he]
      _ ≤ ‖(1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)‖+‖(X-w•1)*X⁻¹‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add h1 ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herror (norm_nonneg _)))
  have hd : ‖X⁻¹‖≤1/(‖w‖-r) := (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hgap)).mpr (by
    nlinarith only [hn])
  simpa only [one_div] using hd

name: Matrix.exists_eventually_norm_imaginaryPart_le_height_of_real_analytic
statement:
theorem exists_eventually_norm_imaginaryPart_le_height_of_real_analytic
    (G : ℂ → M) (u : ℝ) (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝 u, (G x).IsHermitian) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), 0<z.im →
      ‖(imaginaryPart (G z) : M)‖≤C*z.im
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,U,hU,hLip⟩ := hGa.hasStrictDerivAt.hasStrictFDerivAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  have hp : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => (z.re : ℂ))
      (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re,Function.comp_def] using
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp Complex.continuous_re).tendsto (u : ℂ)
  have hre : Tendsto Complex.re (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) (𝓝 u) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using Complex.continuous_re.tendsto (u : ℂ)
  refine ⟨K,K.property,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hU,hp.eventually hU,hre.eventually hreal] with z hzU hzReU hzreal
  intro hz
  have hzn : ‖z-(z.re : ℂ)‖=z.im := by
    have hdiff : z-(z.re : ℂ)=(z.im : ℂ)*Complex.I := by
      exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr (by simpa only [add_comm] using (Complex.re_add_im z).symm)
    rw [hdiff,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg hz.le]
  have hdiff : ‖G z-G (z.re : ℂ)‖≤(K : ℝ)*z.im := by
    simpa only [hzn] using lipschitzOnWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mp hLip hzU hzReU
  have him : (imaginaryPart (G z-G (z.re : ℂ)) : M)=(imaginaryPart (G z) : M) := by
    rw [map_sub,hzreal.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,sub_zero]
  have hn : ‖(imaginaryPart (G z-G (z.re : ℂ)) : M)‖≤‖G z-G (z.re : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa only [← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using imaginaryPart.norm_le (G z-G (z.re : ℂ))
  rw [him] at hn
  exact hn.trans hdiff

name: Matrix.matrix_smul_le_smul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem matrix_smul_le_smul_of_nonneg {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hAB : A ≤ B)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) : c • A ≤ c • B
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  rw [← smul_sub]
  exact (Matrix.le_iff.mp hAB).smul hc

name: Matrix.norm_le_re_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem norm_le_re_trace_of_posSemidef (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ A.trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have htrace : A.trace.re = ∑ i, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hA.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    simp
  have ht : 0 ≤ A.trace.re := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp hA.trace_nonneg).1
  conv_lhs => rw [← cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian]
  apply norm_cfc_le ht
  intro x hx
  rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i), htrace]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hA.eigenvalues_nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Matrix.re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_sq_norm
statement:
theorem re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_sq_norm {m : Type*} [Fintype m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) : (Aᴴ * A).trace.re = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    Complex.re_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [RCLike.star_def, Complex.conj_mul', ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: Matrix.norm_sq_le_sum_sq_norm_entries
statement:
theorem norm_sq_le_sum_sq_norm_entries {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) : ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_le_re_trace_of_posSemidef (Aᴴ * A) (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_sq_norm] at h
  simpa only [pow_two] using h

name: Matrix.re_trace_le_re_trace_of_le
statement:
theorem re_trace_le_re_trace_of_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (h : A ≤ B) :
    A.trace.re ≤ B.trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (Matrix.le_iff.mp h).trace_nonneg).1
  change 0 ≤ (B - A).trace.re at ht
  rw [Matrix.trace_sub, Complex.sub_re] at ht
  linarith

name: Matrix.re_trace_le_card_mul_norm_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem re_trace_le_card_mul_norm_of_isHermitian [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.trace.re ≤ Fintype.card n * ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  have ht : A.trace.re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
    simp
  rw [ht]
  calc
    (∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i) ≤ ∑ _i : n, ‖A‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hnorm : |hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ ‖A‖ := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans hnorm
    _ = Fintype.card n * ‖A‖ := by simp

name: Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM_eq_matrixQuadraticFormCLM
statement:
theorem inner_toEuclideanCLM_eq_matrixQuadraticFormCLM
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    inner ℂ x (toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A x) = matrixQuadraticFormCLM x.ofLp A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply, dotProduct,
    RCLike.inner_apply', starRingEnd_apply, Pi.star_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.mul_norm_sq_le_im_inner_of_imaginaryPart_ge
statement:
theorem mul_norm_sq_le_im_inner_of_imaginaryPart_ge
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {η : ℝ}
    (hA : η • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    η * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℂ x (toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A x)).im
proof:
:= by
  have h := RCLike.re_le_re ((matrixQuadraticPositiveMap x.ofLp).monotone hA)
  rw [inner_toEuclideanCLM_eq_matrixQuadraticFormCLM, im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM]
  have hnorm : (matrixQuadraticFormCLM x.ofLp 1).re = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← inner_toEuclideanCLM_eq_matrixQuadraticFormCLM]
    simp [← Complex.ofReal_pow]
  change matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM x.ofLp (η • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ≤
    matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM x.ofLp (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) at h
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  change η * (matrixQuadraticFormCLM x.ofLp 1).re ≤ _ at h
  rwa [hnorm] at h

name: Matrix.norm_le_inv_of_mul_eq_neg_one_of_imaginaryPart_ge
statement:
theorem norm_le_inv_of_mul_eq_neg_one_of_imaginaryPart_ge
    {T M : Matrix n n ℂ} {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hTM : T * M = -1)
    (hT : η • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ (imaginaryPart T : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    ‖M‖ ≤ η⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [cstar_norm_def]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.norm_le_inv_of_im_inner_coercive
    (toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) T)
    (toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) M) hη
  · intro x
    have h := congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A x) hTM
    simpa using h
  · exact mul_norm_sq_le_im_inner_of_imaginaryPart_ge hT

name: Matrix.imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_eq_conjTranspose_mul_of_mul_eq_neg_one
    {T M : Matrix n n ℂ} (hTM : T * M = -1) :
    (imaginaryPart M : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      Mᴴ * (imaginaryPart T : Matrix n n ℂ) * M
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Mᴴ * Tᴴ = -1 := by
    simpa only [conjTranspose_mul, conjTranspose_neg, conjTranspose_one] using
      congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hTM
  have hdiff : Mᴴ * (T - Tᴴ) * M = M - Mᴴ := by
    rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, hTM, hs]
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
  simp only [imaginaryPart_apply_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, hdiff]

name: Matrix.isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef) : IsUnit A
proof:
:= by
  apply mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp
  intro x y hxy
  by_contra hne
  have hp := (RCLike.pos_iff.mp (hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))).1
  have hz : A *ᵥ (x - y) = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  have hi : (matrixQuadraticFormCLM (x - y) A).im = 0 := by
    simp only [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply, hz, dotProduct_zero, Complex.zero_im]
  rw [im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM] at hi
  change matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM (x - y) (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) = 0 at hi
  change 0 < matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM (x - y) (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) at hp
  linarith

name: Matrix.mul_eq_neg_one_of_neg_inv_eq_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
statement:
theorem mul_eq_neg_one_of_neg_inv_eq_of_posDef_imaginaryPart
    {A T : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef)
    (heq : -A⁻¹ = T) : T * A = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← heq, neg_mul, nonsing_inv_mul A ((isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp
    (isUnit_of_posDef_imaginaryPart hA))]

name: Complex.coe_imaginaryPart
statement: theorem Complex.coe_imaginaryPart (z : ℂ) : (imaginaryPart z : ℂ) = (z.im : ℂ)

    simp [Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_re,
      Complex.sub_im]
