name: Matrix.matrixQuadraticPositiveMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixQuadraticPositiveMap_apply (v : n → ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixQuadraticPositiveMap v A = matrixQuadraticFormCLM v A
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM
statement:
theorem im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM (v : n → ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (matrixQuadraticFormCLM v A).im =
      matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_imaginaryPart (matrixQuadraticPositiveMap v) A
  rw [Complex.coe_imaginaryPart] at h
  exact (congrArg Complex.re h).symm

name: Matrix.im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM_nonneg
statement:
theorem im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM_nonneg (v : n → ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : Matrix.PosSemidef (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    0 ≤ (matrixQuadraticFormCLM v A).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM]
  exact hA.re_dotProduct_nonneg v

name: Matrix.contDiff_det
statement: theorem contDiff_det (k : ℕ∞ω) : ContDiff ℝ k (fun X : M => X.det)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Matrix.det_apply']
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro σ hσ
  apply contDiff_const.mul
  apply contDiff_prod
  intro i hi
  exact (Matrix.entryLinearMap ℝ ℂ (σ i) i).toContinuousLinearMap.contDiff

name: Matrix.hasFDerivAt_det
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_det (A : M) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun X : M => X.det)
      (((Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M A.adjugate)) A
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fun X : M => X.det) :=
    (contDiff_det (n := n) 1).differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hD := (hd A).hasFDerivAt
  have he : fderiv ℝ (fun X : M => X.det) A =
      ((Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M A.adjugate) := by
    ext H
    have hline : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => A + t • H) H 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const H).const_add A
    have hDA : HasFDerivAt (fun X : M => X.det)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun X : M => X.det) A) (A + (0 : ℝ) • H) := by
      simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using hD
    have h₁ := hDA.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hline
    have h₂ := hline.matrix_det
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h₁ h₂
    exact h₁.unique h₂
  rwa [he] at hD

name: HasFDerivAt.matrix_det
statement:
theorem _root_.HasFDerivAt.matrix_det {f : X → M} {f' : X →L[ℝ] M} {x : X}
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => (f y).det)
      ((((Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ M (f x).adjugate)).comp f') x
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_det (f x)).comp x hf

name: Matrix.posDef_everywhere_of_preconnected_isUnit
statement:
theorem posDef_everywhere_of_preconnected_isUnit
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [PreconnectedSpace X]
    (A : X → M) (hA : Continuous A) (hH : ∀ x : X, (A x).IsHermitian)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (A x)) (h0 : ∃ x : X, (A x).PosDef) :
    ∀ x : X, (A x).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  let P : Set X := {x | (0 : M)≤A x}
  have hPc : IsClosed P := isClosed_le continuous_const hA
  have hPo : IsOpen P := by
    apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
    intro x hx
    have hPSD : (A x).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hx
    have hp : (A x).PosDef := hPSD.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr (hU x)
    have he := hp.eventually_of_tendsto (hA.continuousAt.tendsto)
      (Eventually.of_forall hH)
    exact he.mono fun y hy => hy.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := h0
    exact ⟨x,hx.posSemidef.nonneg⟩
  have hPeq : P=univ := (show IsClopen P from ⟨hPc,hPo⟩).eq_univ hPne
  intro x
  have hp : x∈P := by rw [hPeq]; trivial
  have hPSD : (A x).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hp
  exact hPSD.posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr (hU x)

name: Matrix.eventually_posDef_imaginaryPart_of_posDef_deriv
statement:
theorem eventually_posDef_imaginaryPart_of_posDef_deriv
    (G : ℂ → M) (u : ℝ) (B : M) (hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G (u : ℂ))
    (hGd : HasDerivAt G B (u : ℂ)) (hB : B.PosDef)
    (hreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝 u, (G x).IsHermitian) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 (u : ℂ), 0<z.im →
      (imaginaryPart (G z) : M).PosDef ∧ ‖(imaginaryPart (G z) : M)‖≤C*z.im
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδB⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ•(1 : M)≤B := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      (CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mpr
        (fun r hr => hB.isStrictlyPositive.spectrum_pos hr)
  have hs : HasStrictDerivAt G B (u : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [hGd.deriv] using hGa.hasStrictDerivAt
  have he : ∀ᶠ p : ℂ × ℂ in 𝓝 ((u : ℂ),(u : ℂ)),
      ‖G p.1-G p.2-(p.1-p.2)•B‖≤(δ/2)*‖p.1-p.2‖ := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using
      hs.hasStrictFDerivAt.isLittleO.bound (half_pos hδ)
  have hre : Tendsto Complex.re (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) (𝓝 u) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using Complex.continuous_re.tendsto (u : ℂ)
  have hp : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => (z,(z.re : ℂ)))
      (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) (𝓝 ((u : ℂ),(u : ℂ))) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re,Function.comp_def,id_eq] using
      (continuous_id.prodMk (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp Complex.continuous_re)).tendsto (u : ℂ)
  refine ⟨δ/2+‖B‖,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hp.eventually he,hre.eventually hreal] with z hE hHerm
  intro hz
  have hzsub : z-(z.re : ℂ)=(z.im : ℂ)*Complex.I := by
    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr (by simpa only [add_comm] using (Complex.re_add_im z).symm)
  let E := G z-G (z.re : ℂ)-(z-(z.re : ℂ))•B
  have hEN : ‖E‖≤(δ/2)*z.im := by
    change ‖G z-G (z.re : ℂ)-(z-(z.re : ℂ))•B‖≤_
    rw [hzsub,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,
      Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hz] at hE
    simpa only [hzsub] using hE
  have hImE : (imaginaryPart E : M)=(imaginaryPart (G z) : M)-z.im•B := by
    dsimp only [E]
    rw [map_sub,map_sub,hHerm.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,sub_zero,hzsub]
    simp only [imaginaryPart_smul,hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint.imaginaryPart,
      Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,mul_one,
      zero_smul,zero_add,add_zero,sub_zero]
    change (imaginaryPart (G z) : M)-z.im•(realPart B : M)=_
    rw [hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint.coe_realPart]
  let A := (imaginaryPart (G z) : M)-z.im•B
  have hAN : ‖A‖≤(δ/2)*z.im := by
    have hn : ‖(imaginaryPart E : M)‖≤‖E‖ := by
      simpa only [← AddSubgroup.norm_coe] using imaginaryPart.norm_le E
    rw [hImE] at hn
    exact hn.trans hEN
  have hAH : A.IsHermitian := (imaginaryPart (G z)).property.sub
    (hB.isHermitian.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all z.im))
  have hneg : (-‖A‖)•(1 : M)≤A := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,neg_smul] using
      hAH.isSelfAdjoint.neg_algebraMap_norm_le_self
  have hneg' : (-(δ/2*z.im))•(1 : M)≤A :=
    (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (neg_le_neg hAN) (show (0 : M)≤1 from zero_le_one)).trans hneg
  have hB' : (z.im*δ)•(1 : M)≤z.im•B := by
    simpa only [smul_smul] using smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hδB hz.le
  have htotal : (δ/2*z.im)•(1 : M)≤(imaginaryPart (G z) : M) := by
    convert! add_le_add hneg' hB' using 1 <;> module
  have hpos : IsStrictlyPositive (imaginaryPart (G z) : M) :=
    (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul (mul_pos (half_pos hδ) hz)).isStrictlyPositive.of_le htotal
  refine ⟨Matrix.IsStrictlyPositive.posDef hpos,?_⟩
  have hsum : A+z.im•B=(imaginaryPart (G z) : M) := by
    dsimp only [A]
    exact sub_add_cancel _ _
  calc
    _ = ‖A+z.im•B‖ := by rw [hsum]
    _ ≤ ‖A‖+‖z.im•B‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (δ/2)*z.im+z.im*‖B‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hz.le]
      exact add_le_add hAN le_rfl
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Matrix.reCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem reCLM_apply (A : Matrix m n ℂ) : reCLM A = A.map Complex.re
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.reCLM_map_ofReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem reCLM_map_ofReal (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    reCLM (A.map Complex.ofReal) = A
proof: := by ext i j; simp

name: Matrix.map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_eq_zero
statement:
theorem map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, (A i j).im = 0) :
    (reCLM A).map Complex.ofReal = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  apply Complex.ext
  · rfl
  · exact (hA i j).symm

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.reCLM
statement:
theorem IsHermitian.reCLM {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (reCLM A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
  intro i j
  simpa only [reCLM_apply, map_apply, star_trivial, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] using
    congrArg Complex.re (hA.apply i j)

name: Matrix.isHermitian_hermitianUnitRe
statement: theorem isHermitian_hermitianUnitRe (i j : n) : (hermitianUnitRe i j).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermitianUnitRe, Matrix.IsHermitian, add_comm]

name: Matrix.isHermitian_hermitianUnitIm
statement: theorem isHermitian_hermitianUnitIm (i j : n) : (hermitianUnitIm i j).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermitianUnitIm Matrix.IsHermitian
  rw [conjTranspose_smul, conjTranspose_sub]
  simp only [conjTranspose_single, star_one, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_I]
  rw [neg_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: Matrix.matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub
statement:
theorem matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i j : n) :
    matrixQuadraticFormCLM (Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1) A -
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM (Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1) A =
        2 * (A i j + A j i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply, star_add, star_sub, Pi.star_single, star_one,
    Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub, add_dotProduct, sub_dotProduct,
    dotProduct_add, dotProduct_sub, single_dotProduct, one_mul,
    mulVec_single_one, Matrix.col_apply]
  ring

name: Matrix.matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub_I
statement:
theorem matrixQuadraticFormCLM_single_add_sub_I (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i j : n) :
    matrixQuadraticFormCLM (Pi.single i 1 + Complex.I • Pi.single j 1) A -
      matrixQuadraticFormCLM (Pi.single i 1 - Complex.I • Pi.single j 1) A =
        2 * Complex.I * (A i j - A j i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixQuadraticFormCLM_apply, star_add, star_sub, star_smul, Pi.star_single,
    star_one, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_I, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul, add_dotProduct, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_sub,
    dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, single_dotProduct, one_mul,
    mulVec_single_one, Matrix.col_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Matrix.sum_hermitianUnit_eq
statement:
theorem sum_hermitianUnit_eq (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, ((A i j + A j i) / 4) • hermitianUnitRe i j) +
      (∑ i, ∑ j, ((A i j - A j i) / (4 * Complex.I)) • hermitianUnitIm i j) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp [hermitianUnitRe, hermitianUnitIm, Matrix.single_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ite_and, mul_ite,
    mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Matrix.inv_sub_inv_sub_tangent_eq
statement:
theorem inv_sub_inv_sub_tangent_eq (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    A⁻¹-B⁻¹-B⁻¹*(B-A)*B⁻¹=B⁻¹*(B-A)*A⁻¹*(B-A)*B⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have he : B⁻¹*(B-A)*A⁻¹=A⁻¹-B⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB),Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA),
      Matrix.mul_one]
  calc
    _ = (B⁻¹*(B-A)*A⁻¹)-(B⁻¹*(B-A)*B⁻¹) := by rw [he]
    _ = B⁻¹*(B-A)*(A⁻¹-B⁻¹) := (Matrix.mul_sub _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_sub_inv ⟨fun _ => hB,fun _ => hA⟩]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.PosDef.inv_tangent_le
statement:
theorem PosDef.inv_tangent_le {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    B⁻¹*(B-A)*B⁻¹≤A⁻¹-B⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  rw [inv_sub_inv_sub_tangent_eq A B hA.isUnit hB.isUnit]
  have hC : (B-A).IsHermitian := hB.isHermitian.sub hA.isHermitian
  have hP := hA.inv.posSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (B⁻¹*(B-A))
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hC.eq,hB.inv.isHermitian.eq,Matrix.mul_assoc] using hP

name: Matrix.roots_charpoly_eq_map_of_injective_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem roots_charpoly_eq_map_of_injective_mem_spectrum
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ) (hev : Function.Injective ev)
    (hmem : ∀ i, ev i ∈ spectrum ℂ M) :
    M.charpoly.roots = Finset.univ.val.map ev
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset ℂ := Finset.univ.map ⟨ev, hev⟩
  have hroots : M.charpoly.roots = S.val := by
    apply Polynomial.roots_eq_of_natDegree_le_card_of_ne_zero
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
      exact (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp (hmem i)).eq_zero
    · simp [S, Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]
    · exact M.charpoly_monic.ne_zero
  simpa [S] using hroots

name: Matrix.sum_filter_roots_charpoly_eq_sum_ite_of_injective_mem_spectrum
statement:
theorem sum_filter_roots_charpoly_eq_sum_ite_of_injective_mem_spectrum
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ev : n → ℂ) (hev : Function.Injective ev)
    (hmem : ∀ i, ev i ∈ spectrum ℂ M) (p : ℂ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (M.charpoly.roots.filter p).sum = ∑ i, if p (ev i) then ev i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [roots_charpoly_eq_map_of_injective_mem_spectrum M ev hev hmem]
  rw [Multiset.filter_map]
  change (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p (ev i)), ev i) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]

name: Matrix.analyticAt_sum_filter_roots_charpoly_affine_upper
statement:
theorem analyticAt_sum_filter_roots_charpoly_affine_upper
    (A E : Matrix n n ℂ) (u : ℂ)
    (hreal : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + u • E), z.im ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun v : ℂ => ((A + v • E).charpoly.roots.filter
      (fun z => 0 < z.im)).sum) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun i v => (A + v • E).charpoly.coeff i
  let q : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℂ[X] := fun i => X ^ (i : ℕ)
  have hP (v : ℂ) : ∑ i, a i v • q i = (A + v • E).charpoly := by
    dsimp [a, q]
    change (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1),
      (fun k : ℕ => (A + v • E).charpoly.coeff k • (X : ℂ[X]) ^ k) i) = _
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k : ℕ =>
      (A + v • E).charpoly.coeff k • (X : ℂ[X]) ^ k)]
    simpa only [Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul] using
      ((A + v • E).charpoly.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow'
        (by rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]; omega)).symm
  have hset (v : ℂ) : {z | z ∈ (∑ i, a i v • q i).roots} =
      spectrum ℂ (A + v • E) := by
    ext z
    rw [hP]
    exact (Polynomial.mem_roots (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).ne_zero).trans
      (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly).symm
  have hroots : UpperHemicontinuousAt
      (fun v => {z | z ∈ (∑ i, a i v • q i).roots}) u := by
    simp only [hset]
    exact (upperHemicontinuous_spectrum ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ)).upperHemicontinuousAt _ |>.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).continuousAt
  have h := Polynomial.analyticAt_sum_filter_roots_upper_of_upperHemicontinuous q a
    (fun i => Matrix.analyticAt_charpoly_coeff_affine A E i u)
    (by rw [hP]; exact (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).ne_zero) hroots
    (fun z hz => hreal z (by rw [← hset u]; exact hz))
  simpa only [hP] using h

name: Matrix.ofReal_quadraticProbeMass
statement:
theorem ofReal_quadraticProbeMass (v : n → ℂ) :
    ((quadraticProbeMass v : ℝ) : ℂ) = matrixQuadraticFormCLM v 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rfl
  · have hI : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := isHermitian_one
    exact (hI.im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self v).symm

name: Matrix.tendsto_mul_I_matrixQuadraticFormCLM
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_I_matrixQuadraticFormCLM
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))) (v : n → ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) * Complex.I * matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(quadraticProbeMass v : ℝ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((matrixQuadraticFormCLM v).continuous.tendsto (-1)).comp hlim
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_neg,
    ← ofReal_quadraticProbeMass, Complex.ofReal_neg] using h

name: Matrix.im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM_le_mul_of_norm
statement:
theorem im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM_le_mul_of_norm
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℂ) (a C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ C * z.im) :
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      (matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z)).im ≤ (‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖ * C) * z.im
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz hza
  rw [im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ :=
      le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ :=
      (matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v).le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖ * (C * z.im) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb z hz hza) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: Matrix.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_quadratic_stieltjes_eq
statement:
theorem existsUnique_finiteMeasure_quadratic_stieltjes_eq
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Matrix.PosSemidef (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))) (κ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ < a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ C * z.im)
    (v : n → ℂ) :
    ∃! μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass = quadraticProbeMass v ∧
      (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc (-κ) κ) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => matrixQuadraticFormCLM v (M z)) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} :=
    fun z hz => ((matrixQuadraticFormCLM v).analyticAt _).comp (hM z hz)
  apply ha.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq_of_im_le
    (fun z hz => im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM_nonneg v (M z) (hpos z hz))
    (quadraticProbeMass v) (tendsto_mul_I_matrixQuadraticFormCLM M hlim v) κ
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb a ha
  exact ⟨‖matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v‖ * C,
    im_matrixQuadraticFormCLM_le_mul_of_norm M v a C hC⟩

name: Matrix.exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_stieltjes_eq
statement:
theorem exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_stieltjes_eq
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Matrix.PosSemidef (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))) (κ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ < a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ C * z.im) :
    ∃ P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n,
      P Set.univ = 1 ∧
      (∀ E : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ (Icc (-κ) κ)ᶜ → P E = 0) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ∀ i j : n, P.entryStieltjesTransform z i j = M z i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs (v : n → ℂ) := (existsUnique_finiteMeasure_quadratic_stieltjes_eq
    M hM hpos hlim κ hb v).exists
  choose μ hμ using hs
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_of_quadratic_stieltjes M μ
    (fun v => (hμ v).2.2)
  have hmass : P Set.univ = 1 := by
    apply matrix_eq_of_isHermitian_of_re_dotProduct_mulVec_eq
      (P.isHermitian Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ) isHermitian_one
    intro v
    change P.quadraticForm v Set.univ = matrixRealQuadraticFormCLM v 1
    rw [hP v, Measure.toSignedMeasure_apply_measurable MeasurableSet.univ]
    change ((μ v).mass : ℝ) = (quadraticProbeMass v : ℝ)
    exact congrArg (fun r : NNReal => (r : ℝ)) (hμ v).1
  have hsupp (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hEc : E ⊆ (Icc (-κ) κ)ᶜ) : P E = 0 := by
    apply matrix_eq_of_isHermitian_of_re_dotProduct_mulVec_eq (P.isHermitian E hE) isHermitian_zero
    intro v
    have he : (μ v : Measure ℝ) E = 0 := by
      apply measure_mono_null hEc
      change (μ v : Measure ℝ) {x | x ∉ Icc (-κ) κ} = 0
      exact ae_iff.mp (hμ v).2.1
    change P.quadraticForm v E = (star v ⬝ᵥ ((0 : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ v)).re
    rw [hP v, Measure.toSignedMeasure_apply_measurable hE]
    simp only [Measure.real, he, ENNReal.toReal_zero, Matrix.zero_mulVec, dotProduct_zero,
      Complex.zero_re]
  refine ⟨P, hmass, hsupp, ?_⟩
  intro z hz i j
  apply P.entryStieltjesTransform_eq_of_quadraticForm M ?_ hz i j
  intro v w hw
  rw [hP v, SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure]
  exact ((hμ v).2.2 w hw).symm

name: Matrix.existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_stieltjes_eq
statement:
theorem existsUnique_positiveMatrixMeasure_stieltjes_eq
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Matrix.PosSemidef (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))) (κ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ < a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ C * z.im) :
    ∃! P : PositiveMatrixMeasure ℝ n,
      P Set.univ = 1 ∧
      (∀ E : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ (Icc (-κ) κ)ᶜ → P E = 0) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ∀ i j : n, P.entryStieltjesTransform z i j = M z i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_positiveMatrixMeasure_stieltjes_eq M hM hpos hlim κ hb
  refine ⟨P, hP, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  apply Q.eq_of_entryStieltjesTransform_eq P
  intro z hz i j
  exact (hQ.2.2 z hz i j).trans (hP.2.2 z hz i j).symm

name: NormedSpace.radialProj_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem radialProj_zero (x : E) : radialProj 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [radialProj]

name: NormedSpace.radialProj_eq_self
statement:
theorem radialProj_eq_self {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {x : E} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R) :
    radialProj R x = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR.eq_or_lt with rfl | hR
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hx (norm_nonneg _))
    simp [hx0]
  · simp [radialProj, max_eq_left hx, hR.ne']

name: NormedSpace.norm_radialProj_le
statement: theorem norm_radialProj_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (x : E) : ‖radialProj R x‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR.eq_or_lt with rfl | hR
  · simp
  have hd : 0 < max R ‖x‖ := hR.trans_le (le_max_left _ _)
  rw [radialProj, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hd.le), div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right R ‖x‖) hR.le)

name: NormedSpace.continuous_radialProj
statement:
theorem continuous_radialProj {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    Continuous (radialProj R : E → E)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR.eq_or_lt with rfl | hR
  · have hz : (radialProj 0 : E → E) = fun _ => 0 := funext radialProj_zero
    rw [hz]
    exact continuous_const
  exact (continuous_const.div (continuous_const.max continuous_norm)
    (fun x => (hR.trans_le (le_max_left R ‖x‖)).ne')).smul continuous_id

name: inverseSubSeries_apply
proof: := rfl

name: inverse_sub_eq_inverse_one_sub_mul
statement:
private theorem inverse_sub_eq_inverse_one_sub_mul {b : A} (hb : IsUnit b) (x : A) :
    (b - x)⁻¹ʳ = (1 - b⁻¹ʳ * x)⁻¹ʳ * b⁻¹ʳ
proof:
:= by
  have hf : b - x = b * (1 - b⁻¹ʳ * x) := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel b hb, one_mul]
  rw [hf, Ring.inverse_mul (Or.inl hb)]

name: hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_inverse_sub
statement:
private theorem hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_inverse_sub [HasSummableGeomSeries A]
    {b : A} (hb : IsUnit b) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (fun x : A => (b - x)⁻¹ʳ)
      (inverseSubSeries (𝕜 := 𝕜) b⁻¹ʳ) 0
      (1 / ‖ContinuousLinearMap.mul 𝕜 A b⁻¹ʳ‖ₑ)
proof:
:= by
  let L : A →L[𝕜] A := ContinuousLinearMap.mul 𝕜 A b⁻¹ʳ
  have hg : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (fun x : A => (1 - x)⁻¹ʳ)
      (formalMultilinearSeries_geometric 𝕜 A) (L 0) 1 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_inverse_one_sub 𝕜 A
  have hc : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall ((fun x : A => (1 - x)⁻¹ʳ) ∘ L)
      ((formalMultilinearSeries_geometric 𝕜 A).compContinuousLinearMap L)
      (0 : A) (1 / ‖L‖ₑ) := hg.compContinuousLinearMap
  have hp := ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul 𝕜 A).flip b⁻¹ʳ).comp_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall
    hc
  apply hp.congr
  intro x _
  exact (inverse_sub_eq_inverse_one_sub_mul hb x).symm

name: iteratedFDeriv_ringInverse_sub_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_ringInverse_sub_apply [CompleteSpace A]
    {b : A} (hb : IsUnit b) {k : ℕ} (H : Fin k → A) :
    iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 k (fun x : A => (b - x)⁻¹ʳ) 0 H =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (List.ofFn (fun i => b⁻¹ʳ * H (σ i))).prod * b⁻¹ʳ
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_inverse_sub (𝕜 := 𝕜) hb).iteratedFDeriv_eq_sum_of_completeSpace]
  simp only [inverseSubSeries_apply]

name: iteratedFDeriv_resolvent_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_resolvent_apply [CompleteSpace A]
    {a : A} {ζ : 𝕜} (hζ : ζ ∈ resolventSet 𝕜 a) {k : ℕ} (H : Fin k → A) :
    iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 k (fun x : A => resolvent x ζ) a H =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        (List.ofFn (fun i => resolvent a ζ * H (σ i))).prod * resolvent a ζ
proof:
:= by
  have hb : IsUnit (algebraMap 𝕜 A ζ - a) := hζ
  have hp := (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_inverse_sub (𝕜 := 𝕜) hb).comp_sub a
  have heq : (fun x : A => ((algebraMap 𝕜 A ζ - a) - (x - a))⁻¹ʳ) =
      (fun x : A => resolvent x ζ) := by
    funext x
    unfold resolvent
    congr 1
    abel
  simp only [zero_add, heq] at hp
  rw [hp.iteratedFDeriv_eq_sum_of_completeSpace]
  simp only [inverseSubSeries_apply, resolvent]

name: spectrum.resolvent_add_factor
statement:
private theorem resolvent_add_factor {a h : A} {z : R}
    (hz : z ∈ resolventSet R a) :
    algebraMap R A z - (a + h) =
      (algebraMap R A z - a) * (1 - resolvent a z * h)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R A z - a) := hz
  rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc]
  change _ = _ - ((algebraMap R A z - a) * (algebraMap R A z - a)⁻¹ʳ) * h
  rw [Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hu, one_mul]
  abel

name: spectrum.resolvent_add_eq_inverse_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R A z - a) := hz
  change (algebraMap R A z - (a + h))⁻¹ʳ = _
  rw [resolvent_add_factor hz, Ring.inverse_mul (Or.inl hu)]
  rfl

name: spectrum.hasSum_resolvent_add_of_norm_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasSum_resolvent_add_of_norm_mul_lt_one {a h : A} {z : R}
    (hz : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hsmall : ‖resolvent a z * h‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (resolvent a z * h) ^ k * resolvent a z)
      (resolvent (a + h) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent_add_eq_inverse_mul hz]
  exact (hasSum_geom_series_inverse (resolvent a z * h) hsmall).mul_right _

name: spectrum.summable_norm_resolvent_add_series
proof:
:= by
  exact ((summable_norm_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hsmall).mul_right
    ‖resolvent a z‖).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => norm_mul_le _ _)

name: resolvent_mul_eq_one_add_mul_resolvent_mul
statement:
theorem resolvent_mul_eq_one_add_mul_resolvent_mul {a d : A} {z : R}
    (ha : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hd : z ∈ resolventSet R d) (p : A) :
    resolvent a z * p =
      (1 + resolvent a z * (a - d)) * (resolvent d z * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : resolvent a z * (algebraMap R A z - a) = 1 :=
    Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ ha
  have hj : (algebraMap R A z - d) * resolvent d z = 1 :=
    Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hd
  calc
    _ = resolvent a z * ((algebraMap R A z - d) * resolvent d z) * p := by
      rw [hj, mul_one]
    _ = (resolvent a z * (algebraMap R A z - d)) * (resolvent d z * p) := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      calc
        resolvent a z * (algebraMap R A z - d) =
            resolvent a z * ((algebraMap R A z - a) + (a - d)) := by abel_nf
        _ = 1 + resolvent a z * (a - d) := by rw [mul_add, hi]

name: mul_resolvent_eq_mul_resolvent_mul_one_add
statement:
theorem mul_resolvent_eq_mul_resolvent_mul_one_add {a d : A} {z : R}
    (ha : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hd : z ∈ resolventSet R d) (p : A) :
    p * resolvent a z =
      (p * resolvent d z) * (1 + (a - d) * resolvent a z)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (algebraMap R A z - a) * resolvent a z = 1 :=
    Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ ha
  have hj : resolvent d z * (algebraMap R A z - d) = 1 :=
    Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hd
  calc
    _ = p * (resolvent d z * (algebraMap R A z - d)) * resolvent a z := by
      rw [hj, mul_one]
    _ = (p * resolvent d z) * ((algebraMap R A z - d) * resolvent a z) := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      calc
        (algebraMap R A z - d) * resolvent a z =
            ((algebraMap R A z - a) + (a - d)) * resolvent a z := by abel_nf
        _ = 1 + (a - d) * resolvent a z := by rw [add_mul, hi]

name: norm_resolvent_mul_le_reference
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_mul_le_reference {a d : A} {z : R}
    (ha : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hd : z ∈ resolventSet R d) (p : A) :
    ‖resolvent a z * p‖ ≤
      (‖(1 : A)‖ + ‖resolvent a z‖ * ‖a - d‖) * ‖resolvent d z * p‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent_mul_eq_one_add_mul_resolvent_mul ha hd p]
  exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      ((norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (norm_mul_le _ _))) (norm_nonneg _))

name: norm_mul_resolvent_le_reference
statement:
theorem norm_mul_resolvent_le_reference {a d : A} {z : R}
    (ha : z ∈ resolventSet R a) (hd : z ∈ resolventSet R d) (p : A) :
    ‖p * resolvent a z‖ ≤
      ‖p * resolvent d z‖ * (‖(1 : A)‖ + ‖a - d‖ * ‖resolvent a z‖)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_resolvent_eq_mul_resolvent_mul_one_add ha hd p]
  exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (norm_mul_le _ _))) (norm_nonneg _))

name: norm_resolvent_sub_resolvent_le_projected
proof:
:= by
  rw [spectrum.resolvent_sub_resolvent ha hb, hab, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, norm_smul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg c)
  have heq : resolvent a z * p * resolvent b z =
      (resolvent a z * p) * (p * resolvent b z) := by
    calc
      _ = resolvent a z * (p * p) * resolvent b z := by rw [hp]
      _ = _ := by simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [heq]
  exact norm_mul_le _ _

name: summable_norm_and_hasSum_list_prod
statement:
private theorem summable_norm_and_hasSum_list_prod
    {R : Type*} [NormedRing R] [CompleteSpace R] {N : ℕ}
    (f : Fin N → ℕ → R) (x : Fin N → R)
    (hn : ∀ j, Summable (fun m => ‖f j m‖)) (hs : ∀ j, HasSum (f j) (x j)) :
    Summable (fun m : Fin N → ℕ => ‖(List.ofFn (fun j => f j (m j))).prod‖) ∧
      HasSum (fun m : Fin N → ℕ => (List.ofFn (fun j => f j (m j))).prod)
        (List.ofFn x).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    constructor
    · exact (hasSum_unique
        (fun m : Fin 0 → ℕ => ‖(List.ofFn (fun j => f j (m j))).prod‖)).summable
    · simpa only [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil] using
        hasSum_unique (fun m : Fin 0 → ℕ => (List.ofFn (fun j => f j (m j))).prod)
  | succ N ih =>
    obtain ⟨htn, hts⟩ := ih (fun j => f j.succ) (fun j => x j.succ)
      (fun j => hn j.succ) (fun j => hs j.succ)
    let e : (ℕ × (Fin N → ℕ)) ≃ (Fin (N + 1) → ℕ) :=
      Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => ℕ)
    have hnorm : Summable (fun m : ℕ × (Fin N → ℕ) =>
        ‖f 0 m.1 * (List.ofFn (fun j => f j.succ (m.2 j))).prod‖) :=
      @Summable.mul_norm R ℕ (Fin N → ℕ) _ (f 0)
        (fun m => (List.ofFn (fun j => f j.succ (m j))).prod) (hn 0) htn
    have hprod : Summable (fun m : ℕ × (Fin N → ℕ) =>
        f 0 m.1 * (List.ofFn (fun j => f j.succ (m.2 j))).prod) := hnorm.of_norm
    have hsum : HasSum (fun m : ℕ × (Fin N → ℕ) =>
        f 0 m.1 * (List.ofFn (fun j => f j.succ (m.2 j))).prod)
        (x 0 * (List.ofFn (fun j => x j.succ)).prod) := by
      have h := hprod.hasSum
      rw [← tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (hn 0) htn, (hs 0).tsum_eq, hts.tsum_eq] at h
      exact h
    constructor
    · apply e.summable_iff.mp
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, e, Fin.consEquiv_apply,
        List.ofFn_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, List.prod_cons] using hnorm
    · apply e.hasSum_iff.mp
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, e, Fin.consEquiv_apply,
        List.ofFn_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, List.prod_cons] using hsum

name: summable_norm_list_prod_of_summable_norm
statement:
theorem summable_norm_list_prod_of_summable_norm
    {R : Type*} [NormedRing R] [CompleteSpace R] {N : ℕ}
    (f : Fin N → ℕ → R) (hn : ∀ j, Summable (fun m => ‖f j m‖)) :
    Summable (fun m : Fin N → ℕ => ‖(List.ofFn (fun j => f j (m j))).prod‖)
proof:
:=
  (summable_norm_and_hasSum_list_prod f (fun j => ∑' m, f j m) hn
    (fun j => (hn j).of_norm.hasSum)).1

name: hasSum_list_prod_of_summable_norm
statement:
theorem hasSum_list_prod_of_summable_norm
    {R : Type*} [NormedRing R] [CompleteSpace R] {N : ℕ}
    (f : Fin N → ℕ → R) (x : Fin N → R)
    (hs : ∀ j, HasSum (f j) (x j)) (hn : ∀ j, Summable (fun m => ‖f j m‖)) :
    HasSum (fun m : Fin N → ℕ => (List.ofFn (fun j => f j (m j))).prod)
      (List.ofFn x).prod
proof:
:=
  (summable_norm_and_hasSum_list_prod f x hn hs).2

name: spectrum.hasDerivAt_resolvent_pow
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resolvent_pow (a : A) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : z∈resolventSet 𝕜 a) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : 𝕜 => resolvent a w^n)
      (-(n : 𝕜)•resolvent a z^(n+1)) z
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_resolvent_const_left hz).fun_pow' n
  have he : (∑ i∈Finset.range n,
      resolvent a z^(n.pred-i)*(-resolvent a z^2)*resolvent a z^i)=
      -(n : 𝕜)•resolvent a z^(n+1) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _i∈Finset.range n, -resolvent a z^(n+1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [mul_neg,neg_mul,← pow_add,← pow_add]
        have hi' : i<n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        have hex : n.pred-i+2+i=n+1 := by
          rw [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
          omega
        rw [hex]
      _ = _ := by simp [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜]
  exact he ▸ hd

name: spectrum.iteratedDeriv_resolvent
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_resolvent (a : A) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : z∈resolventSet 𝕜 a) :
    iteratedDeriv n (resolvent a) z=
      ((-1 : 𝕜)^n*(n.factorial : 𝕜))•resolvent a z^(n+1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing z with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : iteratedDeriv n (resolvent a)=ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun w : 𝕜 => ((-1 : 𝕜)^n*(n.factorial : 𝕜))•resolvent a w^(n+1)) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_resolventSet a).mem_nhds hz] with w hw
      exact ih hw
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ,he.deriv_eq]
    have hder : deriv (fun w : 𝕜 => ((-1 : 𝕜)^n*(n.factorial : 𝕜))•resolvent a w^(n+1)) z=
        ((-1 : 𝕜)^n*(n.factorial : 𝕜))•(-(n+1 : 𝕜)•resolvent a z^(n+1+1)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,Pi.smul_def] using
        ((hasDerivAt_resolvent_pow a hz (n+1)).const_smul
          ((-1 : 𝕜)^n*(n.factorial : 𝕜))).deriv
    rw [hder]
    simp only [smul_smul,Nat.factorial_succ,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,pow_succ]
    congr 1
    ring

name: norm_sub_le_two_mul_norm_mul_norm_dyson_residual
statement:
theorem norm_sub_le_two_mul_norm_mul_norm_dyson_residual
    {𝕜 A : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedRing A] [NormedSpace 𝕜 A]
    (s : A →L[𝕜] A) (a z m y : A)
    (hm : m*(z-a-s m)=1)
    (hc : ‖m‖*‖s‖*‖y‖≤1/2) :
    ‖y-m‖≤2*‖m‖*‖(z-a-s y)*y-1‖
proof:
:= by
  have he : y-m=m*s (y-m)*y+m*((z-a-s y)*y-1) := by
    calc
      _ = (m*(z-a-s m))*y-m := by rw [hm,one_mul]
      _ = _ := by rw [map_sub]; noncomm_ring
  have hp : ‖m*s (y-m)*y‖≤(‖m‖*‖s‖*‖y‖)*‖y-m‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖m‖*‖s (y-m)‖)*‖y‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (‖m‖*(‖s‖*‖y-m‖))*‖y‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (s.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hd : ‖y-m‖≤(1/2)*‖y-m‖+‖m‖*‖(z-a-s y)*y-1‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖m*s (y-m)*y‖+‖m*((z-a-s y)*y-1)‖ := by
        conv_lhs => rw [he]
        exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖m‖*‖s‖*‖y‖)*‖y-m‖+‖m‖*‖(z-a-s y)*y-1‖ :=
        add_le_add hp (norm_mul_le _ _)
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (norm_nonneg _)) le_rfl
  linarith

name: norm_pow_sub_pow_le_mul_pow
statement:
theorem norm_pow_sub_pow_le_mul_pow (a b : A) {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ R) (hb : ‖b‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) * R ^ n * ‖a - b‖
proof:
:= by
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := zero_le_one.trans hR
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : a ^ (n + 1) - b ^ (n + 1) =
        a ^ n * (a - b) + (a ^ n - b ^ n) * b := by
      simp only [pow_succ]
      noncomm_ring
    rw [he]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖a ^ n * (a - b)‖ + ‖(a ^ n - b ^ n) * b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖a ^ n‖ * ‖a - b‖ + ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ * ‖b‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_mul_le _ _)
      _ ≤ R ^ n * ‖a - b‖ + ((n : ℝ) * R ^ n * ‖a - b‖) * R := by
        gcongr
        exact (norm_pow_le a n).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) ha n)
      _ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R ^ (n + 1) * ‖a - b‖ := by
        rw [Nat.cast_add_one, pow_succ]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR0 n) (norm_nonneg (a - b)))]

name: NormedSpace.tendsto_pow_sub_pow_zero_of_tangent_eq
statement:
theorem tendsto_pow_sub_pow_zero_of_tangent_eq {F G : ℕ → A} {H : A}
    (hF : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) • (F n - 1)) atTop (𝓝 H))
    (hG : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) • (G n - 1)) atTop (𝓝 H)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (F n) ^ n - (G n) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let K := ‖H‖ + 1
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  have hFb : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ‖(n : ℝ) • (F n - 1)‖ ≤ K :=
    (hF.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by dsimp [K]; linarith))).mono (fun _ h => h.le)
  have hGb : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ‖(n : ℝ) • (G n - 1)‖ ≤ K :=
    (hG.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by dsimp [K]; linarith))).mono (fun _ h => h.le)
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) • (F n - G n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [← smul_sub, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, sub_self] using hF.sub hG
  have hmajor := hdiff.norm.const_mul (Real.exp K)
  simp only [norm_zero, mul_zero] at hmajor
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)) ?_ hmajor
  filter_upwards [hFb, hGb, eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with n hnF hnG hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hnorm (X : A) (hX : ‖(n : ℝ) • (X - 1)‖ ≤ K) :
      ‖X‖ ≤ Real.exp (K / n) := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hn0] at hX
    calc
      ‖X‖ = ‖1 + (X - 1)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ 1 + ‖X - 1‖ := by simpa only [norm_one] using norm_add_le (1 : A) (X - 1)
      _ ≤ 1 + K / n := by gcongr; exact (le_div_iff₀ hn0).mpr (by nlinarith [hX])
      _ ≤ Real.exp (K / n) := by simpa only [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (K / n)
  have hR : 1 ≤ Real.exp (K / n) := Real.one_le_exp (div_nonneg hK hn0.le)
  have hbound := norm_pow_sub_pow_le_mul_pow (F n) (G n) hR (hnorm _ hnF) (hnorm _ hnG) n
  have he : Real.exp (K / n) ^ n = Real.exp K := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [he] at hbound
  simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hn0, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hbound

name: NormedSpace.tendsto_pow_exp_of_tangent
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ A := .restrictScalars ℚ ℝ A
  let G : ℕ → A := fun n => NormedSpace.exp ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • H)
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => NormedSpace.exp (t • H)) H 0 := by
    simpa only [zero_smul, NormedSpace.exp_zero, one_mul] using
      (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const H (0 : ℝ))
  have hG : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) • (G n - 1)) atTop (𝓝 H) := by
    have hi : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_nhdsGT_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_add, zero_smul, NormedSpace.exp_zero, inv_inv]
      using hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right.comp hi
  have hdiff := tendsto_pow_sub_pow_zero_of_tangent_eq hF hG
  have hGeq : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (G n) ^ n = NormedSpace.exp H := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with n hn
    change (NormedSpace.exp ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • H)) ^ n = _
    rw [← NormedSpace.exp_nsmul]
    congr 1
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne'), one_smul]
  have hlimit := hdiff.add_const (NormedSpace.exp H)
  simp only [zero_add] at hlimit
  apply hlimit.congr'
  filter_upwards [hGeq] with n hn
  rw [← hn, sub_add_cancel]

name: HasDerivAt.tendsto_pow_inv_nat
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_pow_exp_of_tangent
  have hi : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_nhdsGT_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_add, hf0, inv_inv]
    using hf.tendsto_slope_zero_right.comp hi

name: Complex.cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im
statement:
theorem cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im (x y : ℝ) (γ : NNReal) :
    cauchyPDFReal x γ y = Real.pi⁻¹ *
      (((x : ℂ) - ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * I))⁻¹).im
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cauchyPDFReal, inv_im, sub_im, ofReal_im, add_im, mul_im, ofReal_re,
    I_re, I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, zero_sub, neg_neg,
    normSq_apply, sub_re, add_re, mul_re, sub_zero]
  ring_nf

name: Complex.integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im_integral
statement:
theorem integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im_integral
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (y : ℝ) (γ : NNReal) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x γ y ∂μ) = Real.pi⁻¹ *
      (∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * I))⁻¹ ∂μ).im
proof:
:= by
  have hz : 0 < ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * I).im := by
    simpa using (NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ))
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, Real.pi⁻¹ *
        (((x : ℂ) - ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * I))⁻¹).im ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun x => cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im x y γ))
    _ = Real.pi⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ,
        (((x : ℂ) - ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * I))⁻¹).im ∂μ) := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun r : ℝ => Real.pi⁻¹ * r)
      (integral_im (integrable_real_cauchyKernel μ hz))

name: MeasureTheory.measure_eq_of_integral_real_cauchyKernel_eq
statement:
theorem measure_eq_of_integral_real_cauchyKernel_eq (μ ν : Measure ℝ)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im →
      (∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂μ) = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂ν) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  let γ (n : ℕ) : NNReal := ⟨1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1), by positivity⟩
  have hγne (n : ℕ) : γ n ≠ 0 := by
    apply NNReal.coe_ne_zero.mp
    change 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0
    positivity
  have hγ : Tendsto (fun n => (γ n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_div_atTop 1
  have he (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) : (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂μ) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂ν := by
    rw [Complex.integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im_integral μ y _ (hγne n),
      Complex.integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im_integral ν y _ (hγne n), h]
    simpa using (show 0 < (γ n : ℝ) from NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hγne n)))
  have htest : (fun n => ∫ y : ℝ, f y * (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂μ)) =
      fun n => ∫ y : ℝ, f y * (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂ν) := by
    funext n
    simp only [he]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_integral_cauchyRegularization μ f hγne hγ)
    (htest ▸ tendsto_integral_cauchyRegularization ν f hγne hγ)

name: Complex.integrable_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley
statement:
theorem integrable_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform z) ξ) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc := continuous_herglotzRieszKernel_circle
    (by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using norm_cayleyTransform_lt_one hz)
  exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)

name: Complex.sub_I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley
statement:
theorem sub_I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) {ξ : Circle} (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) :
    I * herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform z) ξ -
      I * herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform I) ξ =
    (2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) : ℝ) •
      (((cayleyBoundaryReal ξ : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ - ((cayleyBoundaryReal ξ : ℂ) - I)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayleyTransform hz hξ,
    I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayleyTransform (by simp) hξ,
    ← one_add_sq_cayleyBoundaryReal hξ, Complex.real_smul]
  ring

name: Complex.integral_sub_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley_eq
statement:
theorem integral_sub_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley_eq
    (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hzero : μ {(1 : Circle)} = 0)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    I * (∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform z) ξ ∂μ) -
      I * (∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform I) ξ ∂μ) =
    ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ - ((x : ℂ) - I)⁻¹ ∂cayleyBoundaryMeasure μ
proof:
:= by
  have hI : 0 < I.im := by simp
  rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul,
    ← integral_sub ((integrable_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley μ hz).const_mul I)
      ((integrable_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley μ hI).const_mul I)]
  rw [cayleyBoundaryMeasure, integral_map measurable_cayleyBoundaryReal.aemeasurable
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ -
      ((x : ℂ) - I)⁻¹)).aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      measurable_cayleyBoundaryWeight.ennreal_ofReal
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ξ : Circle ∂μ, ξ ≠ 1 := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    simpa only [not_not, ofPred_eq_eq_singleton] using hzero
  filter_upwards [hae] with ξ hξ
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (by norm_num)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (circle_re_le_one ξ)))]
  exact sub_I_mul_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley hz hξ

name: Complex.tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_mul_I
statement:
theorem tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_mul_I {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ}
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) * I * f ((y : ℂ) * I))
      atTop (𝓝 c)) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => f ((y : ℂ) * I)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ =>
      -I * ((1 / y : ℝ) • ((y : ℂ) * I * f ((y : ℂ) * I)))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_smul, mul_zero, id_eq] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds (x := -I)).mul
        ((tendsto_id.const_div_atTop (1 : ℝ)).smul hlim)
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
  rw [Complex.real_smul, ofReal_div, ofReal_one]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hy]
  simp only [I_sq]
  ring

name: AnalyticOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.AnalyticOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (f z).im)
    (c : NNReal)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) * I * f ((y : ℂ) * I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(c : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass = c ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → f z = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, _hmass, hσ⟩ := hf.exists_finiteMeasure_cayley_integral_eq hpos
  have him (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
      (f z).im = ∫ ξ : Circle, poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform z) ξ ∂(σ : Measure Circle) := by
    rw [hσ z hz]
    simp only [add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, I_re, I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_add]
    exact (integral_re (integrable_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley (σ : Measure Circle) hz)).symm.trans
            (integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ =>
        (congrFun (poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel (c := 0)
          (w := cayleyTransform z)) (ξ : ℂ)).symm)))
  have hvertical : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => y * (f ((y : ℂ) * I)).im)
      atTop (𝓝 (c : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_re, mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, I_re, I_im,
      zero_mul, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub, neg_neg,
      neg_re, ofReal_re] using ((continuous_re.tendsto _).comp hlim).neg
  have hpoisson : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ∫ ξ : Circle,
      y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ ∂(σ : Measure Circle))
        atTop (𝓝 (c : ℝ)) := by
    apply hvertical.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    have hz : 0 < ((y : ℂ) * I).im := by simpa using hy
    rw [him _ hz, integral_const_mul]
  have hweight := integrable_weight_and_integral_eq_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass
    (σ : Measure Circle) hpoisson
  have hzero := measure_singleton_one_eq_zero_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass
    (σ : Measure Circle) hpoisson
  let ν := cayleyBoundaryMeasure (σ : Measure Circle)
  let hν : IsFiniteMeasure ν := isFiniteMeasure_cayleyBoundaryMeasure _ hweight.1
  let μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ := ⟨ν, hν⟩
  have hm : μ.mass = c := by
    apply NNReal.coe_injective
    change ν.real univ = (c : ℝ)
    exact (cayleyBoundaryMeasure_real_univ _ hweight.1).trans hweight.2
  have hdiff (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
      f z - f I = (∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂ν) -
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - I)⁻¹ ∂ν := by
    conv_lhs => lhs; rw [hσ z hz]
    conv_lhs => rhs; rw [hσ I (by simp)]
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
    rw [integral_sub_herglotzRieszKernel_cayley_eq (σ : Measure Circle) hzero hz]
    exact integral_sub (integrable_real_cauchyKernel ν hz)
      (integrable_real_cauchyKernel ν (by simp))
  have hconstant : f I - (∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - I)⁻¹ ∂ν) = 0 := by
    have hd : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => f ((y : ℂ) * I) -
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * I)⁻¹ ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [sub_zero] using (tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_mul_I hlim).sub
        (tendsto_integral_real_cauchyKernel_mul_I ν)
    have he : (fun y : ℝ => f ((y : ℂ) * I) -
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * I)⁻¹ ∂ν) =ᶠ[atTop]
        fun _ => f I - ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - I)⁻¹ ∂ν := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
      have hz : 0 < ((y : ℂ) * I).im := by simpa using hy
      linear_combination hdiff ((y : ℂ) * I) hz
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds (hd.congr' he)
  refine ⟨μ, hm, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  change f z = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂ν
  linear_combination hdiff z hz + hconstant

name: Complex.continuous_poissonKernel_circle
statement:
theorem continuous_poissonKernel_circle {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball 0 1) :
    Continuous (fun ξ : Circle => poissonKernel 0 w ξ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel]
  have hcoe : Continuous (fun ξ : Circle => (ξ : ℂ)) := continuous_subtype_val
  have hc : Continuous (fun ξ : Circle => herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ) :=
    (continuousOn_herglotzRieszKernel_sphere hw).comp_continuous
      hcoe (by
        intro ξ
        simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, abs_one] using Circle.norm_coe ξ)
  exact Complex.continuous_re.comp hc

name: Complex.poissonKernel_zero_mul_real
statement:
theorem poissonKernel_zero_mul_real (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (w ξ : ℂ) :
    poissonKernel 0 ((r : ℂ) * w) ((r : ℂ) * ξ) = poissonKernel 0 w ξ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel, Function.comp_apply,
    herglotzRieszKernel_def, sub_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [← mul_add, ← mul_sub, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hr)]

name: InnerProductSpace.radial_poisson_representation
statement:
private theorem radial_poisson_representation {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : HarmonicOnNhd u (ball 0 1))
    (hpos : ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, 0 ≤ u z)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure Circle, (μ.mass : ℝ) = u 0 ∧
      ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        (∫ ξ : Circle, poissonKernel 0 w ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)) = u ((r : ℂ) * w)
proof:
:= by
  have hradius (ξ : Circle) : (r : ℂ) * ξ ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr,
      Circle.norm_coe, mul_one] using hr1
  have hcont : Continuous (fun ξ : Circle => u ((r : ℂ) * ξ)) :=
    hu.continuousOn.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) hradius
  have hnonneg (ξ : Circle) : 0 ≤ u ((r : ℂ) * ξ) := hpos _ (hradius ξ)
  let ν := Circle.probabilityMeasure.withDensity (fun ξ : Circle => ENNReal.ofReal (u ((r : ℂ) * ξ)))
  have hint : Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => u ((r : ℂ) * ξ)) Circle.probabilityMeasure :=
    hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  let : IsFiniteMeasure ν := isFiniteMeasure_withDensity_ofReal hint.hasFiniteIntegral
  let μ : FiniteMeasure Circle := ⟨ν, inferInstance⟩
  have hintegral (f : Circle → ℝ) : (∫ ξ, f ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)) =
      ∫ ξ, u ((r : ℂ) * ξ) * f ξ ∂Circle.probabilityMeasure := by
    change (∫ ξ, f ξ ∂ν) = _
    dsimp only [ν]
    rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hcont.measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hnonneg _), smul_eq_mul]
  have hmass : (μ.mass : ℝ) = u 0 := by
    have hm := (show HarmonicOnNhd u (closedBall 0 |r|) from
      by simpa only [abs_of_pos hr] using hu.mono (closedBall_subset_ball hr1)).circleAverage_eq
    have hi := hintegral (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one] at hi
    have hi' := Circle.integral_probabilityMeasure_eq_circleAverage
      (fun ξ : ℂ => u ((r : ℂ) * ξ))
    have he : Real.circleAverage (fun ξ : ℂ => u ((r : ℂ) * ξ)) 0 1 = Real.circleAverage u 0 r := by
      simpa only [add_zero] using (Real.circleAverage_eq_circleAverage_zero_one (f := u) (c := 0) (R := r)).symm
    have hall := hi.trans (hi'.trans (he.trans hm))
    change (ν.real univ) = u 0
    simpa only [μ, FiniteMeasure.toMeasure_mk, integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hall
  refine ⟨μ, hmass, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  have hrw : (r : ℂ) * w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) r := by
    simp only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hw ⊢
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
    nlinarith
  have hp := (hu.mono (closedBall_subset_ball hr1)).circleAverage_poissonKernel_smul hrw
  rw [hintegral]
  have he : Real.circleAverage
      (fun ξ : ℂ => u ((r : ℂ) * ξ) * poissonKernel 0 w ξ) 0 1 =
      Real.circleAverage (poissonKernel 0 ((r : ℂ) * w) • u) 0 r := by
    rw [Real.circleAverage_eq_circleAverage_zero_one
      (f := poissonKernel 0 ((r : ℂ) * w) • u) (c := 0) (R := r)]
    apply Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere
    intro ξ _
    change u ((r : ℂ) * ξ) * poissonKernel 0 w ξ =
      poissonKernel 0 ((r : ℂ) * w) ((r : ℂ) * ξ + 0) * u ((r : ℂ) * ξ + 0)
    rw [add_zero, poissonKernel_zero_mul_real r hr.ne']
    exact mul_comm _ _
  exact (Circle.integral_probabilityMeasure_eq_circleAverage
    (fun ξ : ℂ => u ((r : ℂ) * ξ) * poissonKernel 0 w ξ)).trans (he.trans hp)

name: InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_poissonKernel_eq
statement:
theorem HarmonicOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_poissonKernel_eq {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : HarmonicOnNhd u (ball 0 1))
    (hpos : ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, 0 ≤ u z) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure Circle, (μ.mass : ℝ) = u 0 ∧
      ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        (∫ ξ : Circle, poissonKernel 0 w ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)) = u w
proof:
:= by
  let K : ball (0 : ℂ) 1 → C(Circle, ℝ) := fun w =>
    ⟨fun ξ => poissonKernel 0 w ξ, continuous_poissonKernel_circle w.property⟩
  let C : NNReal := ⟨u 0, hpos 0 (by simp)⟩
  let F : ℝ → ball (0 : ℂ) 1 → ℝ := fun r w => u ((r : ℂ) * w)
  have hrep : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure Circle,
      μ.mass ≤ C ∧ ∀ w, (∫ ξ, K w ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)) = F r w := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with r hr
    obtain ⟨μ, hmass, hμ⟩ := radial_poisson_representation hu hpos hr.1 hr.2
    refine ⟨μ, ?_, fun w => hμ w w.property⟩
    change (μ.mass : ℝ) ≤ u 0
    exact hmass.le
  have hlim (w : ball (0 : ℂ) 1) : Tendsto (fun r => F r w) (𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u w)) := by
    have hmul : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) * (w : ℂ)) := by fun_prop
    have ht : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) * (w : ℂ)) (𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (w : ℂ)) := by
      simpa only [ofReal_one, one_mul] using
        (hmul.continuousAt (x := 1)).tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Iio 1))
    exact (hu w w.property).1.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  obtain ⟨μ, _, hμ⟩ := NLAlib.exists_finiteMeasure_integral_eq_of_tendsto
    K C F (fun w => u w) hrep hlim
  refine ⟨μ, ?_, fun w hw => hμ ⟨w, hw⟩⟩
  have hm := hμ ⟨0, by simp⟩
  change (∫ ξ : Circle, poissonKernel 0 0 ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)) = u 0 at hm
  change ((μ : Measure Circle).real univ) = u 0
  simpa only [poissonKernel_def, sub_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
    sub_zero, Circle.norm_coe, one_pow, div_one, integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hm

name: AnalyticOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_cayley_integral_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.AnalyticOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_cayley_integral_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (f z).im) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure Circle, (μ.mass : ℝ) = (f I).im ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → f z = ((f I).re : ℂ) +
        I * ∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 (cayleyTransform z) ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => -I * f (inverseCayleyTransform w)
  have him (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :
      0 < (inverseCayleyTransform w).im :=
    im_inverseCayleyTransform_pos (by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw)
  have hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (ball 0 1) := by
    intro w hw
    exact analyticAt_const.mul ((hf _ (him w hw)).comp
      (analyticOnNhd_inverseCayleyTransform w hw))
  have hFpos (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) : 0 ≤ (F w).re := by
    simpa [F] using hpos _ (him w hw)
  obtain ⟨μ, hmass, hμ⟩ := hF.exists_finiteMeasure_herglotzRieszKernel_eq hFpos
  have hmass' : (μ.mass : ℝ) = (f I).im := by
    simpa [F] using hmass
  refine ⟨μ, hmass', ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hw : cayleyTransform z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using norm_cayleyTransform_lt_one hz
  have he := hμ (cayleyTransform z) hw
  simp only [F, inverseCayleyTransform_cayleyTransform (add_I_ne_zero_of_im_pos hz),
    inverseCayleyTransform_zero, mul_im, neg_im, I_re, I_im,
    zero_mul, zero_add, neg_mul, one_mul] at he
  have hm := congrArg (fun a : ℂ => I * a) he
  simp only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, I_mul_I, mul_neg, neg_neg, neg_one_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_neg] at hm
  exact hm

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.integrable_real_cauchyKernel

theorem integrable_real_cauchyKernel (s : SignedMeasure ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure
statement:
@[simp] theorem stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (z : ℂ) :
    stieltjesTransform μ.toSignedMeasure z = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂μ

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_add
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_add (s t : SignedMeasure ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    stieltjesTransform (s + t) z = stieltjesTransform s z + stieltjesTransform t z
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_add_vectorMeasure
    (s.integrable_real_cauchyKernel hz) (t.integrable_real_cauchyKernel hz)

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem stieltjesTransform_smul (a : ℝ) (s : SignedMeasure ℝ) (z : ℂ) :

proof:

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_sub
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_sub (s t : SignedMeasure ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    stieltjesTransform (s - t) z = stieltjesTransform s z - stieltjesTransform t z
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_sub_vectorMeasure
    (s.integrable_real_cauchyKernel hz) (t.integrable_real_cauchyKernel hz)

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.eq_zero_of_stieltjesTransform_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_stieltjesTransform_eq_zero (s : SignedMeasure ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → stieltjesTransform s z = 0) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := s.toJordanDecomposition.posPart
  let q := s.toJordanDecomposition.negPart
  have he : p.toSignedMeasure - q.toSignedMeasure = s :=
    s.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition
  have hpq : p = q := by
    apply measure_eq_of_integral_real_cauchyKernel_eq
    intro z hz
    have hs := h z hz
    rw [← he, stieltjesTransform_sub _ _ hz,
      stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure, stieltjesTransform_toSignedMeasure] at hs
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hs
  exact he.symm.trans (sub_eq_zero.mpr (Measure.toSignedMeasure_congr hpq))

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.eq_of_stieltjesTransform_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_stieltjesTransform_eq (s t : SignedMeasure ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → stieltjesTransform s z = stieltjesTransform t z) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_stieltjesTransform_eq_zero
  intro z hz
  rw [stieltjesTransform_sub _ _ hz, h z hz, sub_self]

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_sum
statement:
theorem stieltjesTransform_sum {κ : Type*} (t : Finset κ) (s : κ → SignedMeasure ℝ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    stieltjesTransform (∑ k ∈ t, s k) z = ∑ k ∈ t, stieltjesTransform (s k) z
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_finsetSum_vectorMeasure
    (fun k _ => (s k).integrable_real_cauchyKernel hz)

name: MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.stieltjesTransform_neg

@[simp] theorem stieltjesTransform_neg (s : SignedMeasure ℝ) (z : ℂ) :

statement:
theorem isFiniteMeasure_cayleyBoundaryMeasure (μ : Measure Circle)
    (hi : Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)) μ) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (cayleyBoundaryMeasure μ)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.withDensity (fun ξ : Circle =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)))) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_withDensity
      ((hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ =>
        div_nonneg (by norm_num) (sub_nonneg.mpr (circle_re_le_one ξ))))).mp

name: Complex.cayleyBoundaryMeasure_real_univ
statement:
theorem cayleyBoundaryMeasure_real_univ (μ : Measure Circle)
    (hi : Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)) μ) :
    (cayleyBoundaryMeasure μ).real univ = ∫ ξ : Circle, 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) ∂μ
proof:
:= by

    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ =>
      div_nonneg (by norm_num) (sub_nonneg.mpr (circle_re_le_one ξ)))
