name: Complex.norm_real_cauchyKernel_le
statement:
theorem norm_real_cauchyKernel_le (x : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ‖((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹‖ ≤ z.im⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_inv]
  apply inv_anti₀ hz
  have h := abs_im_le_norm ((x : ℂ) - z)
  simpa only [sub_im, ofReal_im, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hz] using h

name: Complex.integrable_real_cauchyKernel
statement:
theorem integrable_real_cauchyKernel (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_const z.im⁻¹).mono'
  · exact (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => norm_real_cauchyKernel_le x hz)

name: Complex.norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le
statement:
theorem norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ‖∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂μ‖ ≤ μ.real univ / z.im
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹‖ ∂μ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ _x : ℝ, z.im⁻¹ ∂μ := integral_mono
      (integrable_real_cauchyKernel μ hz).norm (integrable_const _)
      (fun x => norm_real_cauchyKernel_le x hz)
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const]; simp only [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Complex.tendsto_integral_real_cauchyKernel_mul_I
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_real_cauchyKernel_mul_I (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * I)⁻¹ ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ (tendsto_id.const_div_atTop (μ.real univ))
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
  have him : 0 < ((y : ℂ) * I).im := by simpa using hy
  simpa using norm_integral_real_cauchyKernel_le μ him

name: AnalyticOnNhd.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq
statement:
theorem AnalyticOnNhd.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (f z).im)
    (c : NNReal)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) * Complex.I * f ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(c : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    ∃! μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass = c ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → f z = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hm, hμ⟩ := hf.exists_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq hpos c hlim
  refine ⟨μ, ⟨hm, hμ⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν
  apply FiniteMeasure.toMeasure_injective
  exact measure_eq_of_integral_real_cauchyKernel_eq (ν : Measure ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (fun z hz => (hν.2 z hz).symm.trans (hμ z hz))

name: AnalyticOnNhd.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq_of_im_le
statement:
theorem AnalyticOnNhd.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq_of_im_le
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (f z).im)
    (c : NNReal)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) * Complex.I * f ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(c : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (κ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ < a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      (f z).im ≤ C * z.im) :
    ∃! μ : FiniteMeasure ℝ, μ.mass = c ∧
      (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc (-κ) κ) ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → f z = ∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, huniq⟩ := hf.existsUnique_finiteMeasure_stieltjes_eq hpos c hlim
  have hsupp : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂(μ : Measure ℝ), x ∈ Icc (-κ) κ := by
    apply ae_mem_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul (μ : Measure ℝ) κ
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb a ha
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz hza => by rw [← hμ.2 z hz]; exact hC z hz hza⟩
  refine ⟨μ, ⟨hμ.1, hsupp, hμ.2⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν
  exact huniq ν ⟨hν.1, hν.2.2⟩

name: MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
statement:
theorem integral_eq_zero_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ)
    (hfint : Integrable f) (hfnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (U : Set ℝ)
    (hfzero : ∀ x ∉ U, f x = 0) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ γ : NNReal, γ ≠ 0 →
      (∫ x : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) - ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ ∂μ).im ≤ C * γ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, f x ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let γ (n : ℕ) : NNReal := ⟨1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1), by positivity⟩
  have hγne (n : ℕ) : γ n ≠ 0 := by
    apply NNReal.coe_ne_zero.mp
    change 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0
    positivity
  have hγ : Tendsto (fun n => (γ n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_div_atTop 1
  have hle (n : ℕ) :
      (∫ y : ℝ, f y * (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂μ)) ≤
        (Real.pi⁻¹ * C * γ n) * ∫ y : ℝ, f y := by
    have hi := (integrable_boundedContinuousFunction_mul_cauchyPDFReal_prod
      μ f (γ n) (hγne n)).integral_prod_right
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul] at hi
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono hi (hfint.const_mul _)
    intro y
    change f y * (∫ x : ℝ, cauchyPDFReal x (γ n) y ∂μ) ≤
      (Real.pi⁻¹ * C * γ n) * f y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ U
    · rw [Complex.integral_cauchyPDFReal_eq_inv_pi_mul_im_integral μ y _ (hγne n)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb y hy (γ n) (hγne n))
        (mul_nonneg (hfnonneg y) (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos)))]
    · simp only [hfzero y hy, zero_mul, mul_zero, le_refl]
  have hlim := tendsto_integral_cauchyRegularization μ f hγne hγ
  have hlimzero : Tendsto (fun n =>
      (Real.pi⁻¹ * C * γ n) * ∫ y : ℝ, f y) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul] using (hγ.const_mul (Real.pi⁻¹ * C)).mul_const
      (∫ y : ℝ, f y)
  have hval := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hlim hlimzero (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hle)
  exact le_antisymm hval (integral_nonneg hfnonneg)

name: MeasureTheory.notMem_support_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
statement:
theorem notMem_support_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (x r C : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hb : ∀ y ∈ ball x r, ∀ γ : NNReal, γ ≠ 0 →
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ ∂μ).im ≤ C * γ) :
    x ∉ μ.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgx, hgzero, hgcompact, hgrange⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_one_zero_of_isCompact (isCompact_singleton (x := x))
      isOpen_ball.isClosed_compl
      (disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr (singleton_subset_iff.mpr (mem_ball_self hr)))
  let f : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ := BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup g g.continuous 1
    (fun y => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hgrange y).1]; exact (hgrange y).2)
  have hfx : f x = 1 := hgx (mem_singleton x)
  have hfint : Integrable f :=
    g.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgcompact
  have hzero : ∫ y : ℝ, f y ∂μ = 0 :=
    integral_eq_zero_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul μ f hfint (fun y => (hgrange y).1)
      (ball x r) (fun y hy => hgzero hy) C hb
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono'
    f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by
      change ‖g y‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hgrange y).1]; exact (hgrange y).2))
  have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun y => (hgrange y).1) hfi).mp hzero
  have hnull : μ {y : ℝ | 0 < f y} = 0 := by
    apply measure_mono_null (t := {y : ℝ | f y ≠ 0})
    · intro y hy
      exact ne_of_gt hy
    · change μ {y : ℝ | g y ≠ 0} = 0
      simpa only [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_iff, Pi.zero_apply] using hae
  apply Measure.notMem_support_iff_exists.mpr
  refine ⟨{y : ℝ | 0 < f y}, ?_, hnull⟩
  exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const f.continuous).mem_nhds
    (show 0 < f x by rw [hfx]; exact zero_lt_one)

name: MeasureTheory.support_subset_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
statement:
theorem support_subset_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (κ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ < a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂μ).im ≤ C * z.im) :
    μ.support ⊆ Icc (-κ) κ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hout : κ < |x| := by
    apply lt_of_not_ge
    intro hh
    exact hnot ((abs_le.mp hh))
  let a : ℝ := (|x| + κ) / 2
  have hκa : κ < a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have hax : a < |x| := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb a hκa
  apply (notMem_support_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul μ x (|x| - a) C
    (sub_pos.mpr hax) ?_) hx
  intro y hy γ hγ
  have hdist : |x - y| < |x| - a := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hy
  have htri : |x| ≤ |x - y| + |y| := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using abs_add_le (x - y) y
  have hay : a ≤ |y| := by linarith
  have hγpos : 0 < (γ : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)
  simpa only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, Complex.add_re,
    Complex.mul_re, sub_zero, add_zero] using
    hC ((y : ℂ) + (γ : ℝ) * Complex.I) (by simpa using hγpos) (by simpa using hay)

name: MeasureTheory.ae_mem_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
statement:
theorem ae_mem_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (κ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a : ℝ, κ < a → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → a ≤ |z.re| →
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ ∂μ).im ≤ C * z.im) :
    ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂μ, x ∈ Icc (-κ) κ
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
  exact support_subset_Icc_of_im_cauchyKernel_le_mul μ κ hb hx

name: Complex.integrable_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I
statement:
theorem integrable_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I
    (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ) μ
proof:
:= by
  have him : 0 < ((y : ℂ) * I).im := by simpa only [mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im,
    I_re, I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero] using hy
  have hw : cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I) ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using norm_cayleyTransform_lt_one him
  exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_poissonKernel_circle hw)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)

name: Complex.measure_singleton_one_eq_zero_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass
statement:
theorem measure_singleton_one_eq_zero_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass
    (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {c : ℝ}
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ∫ ξ : Circle,
      y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 c)) :
    μ {(1 : Circle)} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
      μ.real {(1 : Circle)} * y ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ ξ : Circle, y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ ∂μ := by
    have h := setIntegral_le_integral (s := {(1 : Circle)})
      (integrable_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I μ hy)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_nonneg ξ hy))
    simpa only [integral_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_one hy] using h
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, μ.real {(1 : Circle)} ≤ (c + 1) / y ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ), hlim.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (lt_add_one c))]
      with y hy hb
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hy)).mpr
    exact (hsingle y hy).trans hb.le
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (c + 1) / y ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_pow_atTop (α := ℝ) (show (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide)).const_div_atTop _
  have hle : μ.real {(1 : Circle)} ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds hzero hbound
  exact (measureReal_eq_zero_iff (μ := μ) (s := {(1 : Circle)})).mp
    (le_antisymm hle measureReal_nonneg)

name: Complex.integrable_weight_and_integral_eq_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass
statement:
theorem integrable_weight_and_integral_eq_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass
    (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {c : ℝ}
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ∫ ξ : Circle,
      y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 c)) :
    Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)) μ ∧
      ∫ ξ : Circle, 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) ∂μ = c
proof:
:= by
  let F (n : ℕ) (ξ : Circle) : ℝ :=
    ((n : ℝ) + 1) * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform (Complex.ofReal ((n : ℝ) + 1) * I)) ξ
  let v (ξ : Circle) : ℝ := 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)
  have hn (n : ℕ) : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hy : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 1) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (F n) μ :=
    by simpa only [F, ofReal_add, ofReal_one, ofReal_natCast] using
      integrable_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I μ (hn n)
  have hnonneg (n : ℕ) (ξ : Circle) : 0 ≤ F n ξ :=
    by simpa only [F, ofReal_add, ofReal_one, ofReal_natCast] using
      mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_nonneg ξ (hn n)
  have hvnonneg (ξ : Circle) : 0 ≤ v ξ := by
    exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) (sub_nonneg.mpr (circle_re_le_one ξ))
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ξ : Circle ∂μ, ξ ≠ 1 := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    simpa only [not_not, ofPred_eq_eq_singleton] using
      measure_singleton_one_eq_zero_of_tendsto_integral_poissonMass μ hlim
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ ξ : Circle ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => F n ξ) atTop (𝓝 (v ξ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hae] with ξ hξ
    simpa only [F, v, Function.comp_def, ofReal_add, ofReal_one, ofReal_natCast] using
      (tendsto_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I hξ).comp hy
  have hflim : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ξ, F n ξ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    simpa only [F, Function.comp_def, ofReal_add, ofReal_one, ofReal_natCast] using hlim.comp hy
  have hfatou : ∫⁻ ξ, ENNReal.ofReal (v ξ) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ ξ, liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (F n ξ)) atTop ∂μ := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hpoint] with ξ hξ
        exact ((ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp hξ).liminf_eq.symm
      _ ≤ liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ ξ, ENNReal.ofReal (F n ξ) ∂μ) atTop :=
        lintegral_liminf_le' (fun n => (hi n).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal c := by
        have heq (n : ℕ) : ∫⁻ ξ, ENNReal.ofReal (F n ξ) ∂μ =
            ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ξ, F n ξ ∂μ) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hi n)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hnonneg n))).symm
        simp_rw [heq]
        exact ((ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto c).comp hflim).liminf_eq
  have hv : Integrable v μ := by
    refine ⟨aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop (fun n => (hi n).aestronglyMeasurable)
      hpoint, ?_⟩
    exact (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hvnonneg)).mpr
      (hfatou.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
  refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
  have hdom : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ ξ ∂μ, ‖F n ξ‖ ≤ v ξ := by
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hae] with ξ hξ
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg n ξ)]
    simpa only [F, v, ofReal_add, ofReal_one, ofReal_natCast] using
      mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_le hξ (hn n)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique
    (tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence v (fun n => (hi n).aestronglyMeasurable)
      hv hdom hpoint) hflim

name: Complex.circle_re_le_one
statement: theorem circle_re_le_one (ξ : Circle) : (ξ : ℂ).re ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Circle.norm_coe] using re_le_norm (ξ : ℂ)

name: Complex.neg_one_le_circle_re
statement: theorem neg_one_le_circle_re (ξ : Circle) : -1 ≤ (ξ : ℂ).re
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_re_le_norm (ξ : ℂ)
  rw [Circle.norm_coe] at h
  exact (neg_le_neg h).trans (neg_abs_le _)

name: Complex.circle_re_lt_one_of_ne_one
statement: theorem circle_re_lt_one_of_ne_one {ξ : Circle} (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) : (ξ : ℂ).re < 1
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (circle_re_le_one ξ)
  intro he
  have hs := Circle.normSq_coe ξ
  rw [normSq_apply] at hs
  have hi : (ξ : ℂ).im = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ξ : ℂ).im]
  apply hξ
  apply Circle.ext
  apply Complex.ext
  · simpa only [Circle.coe_one, one_re] using he
  · simpa only [Circle.coe_one, one_im] using hi

name: Complex.cayleyTransform_mul_I
statement:
theorem cayleyTransform_mul_I (y : ℝ) (hy : y + 1 ≠ 0) :
    cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I) = (((y - 1) / (y + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cayleyTransform, ofReal_div, ofReal_sub, ofReal_add, ofReal_one]
  have hd : (y : ℂ) * I + I ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← add_one_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hy) I_ne_zero
  field_simp [hd, hy]

name: Complex.circle_mass_denominator_pos
statement:
theorem circle_mass_denominator_pos (ξ : Circle) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) * y ^ 2 + (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - (ξ : ℂ).re := sub_nonneg.mpr (circle_re_le_one ξ)
  have hb : 0 ≤ 1 + (ξ : ℂ).re := by linarith [neg_one_le_circle_re ξ]
  by_cases h : 1 - (ξ : ℂ).re = 0
  · have he : (ξ : ℂ).re = 1 := by linarith
    simp only [he, sub_self, zero_mul]
    norm_num
  · have hapos : 0 < 1 - (ξ : ℂ).re := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm h)
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos hapos (sq_pos_of_pos hy)) hb

name: Complex.mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I
statement:
theorem mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I (ξ : Circle) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ =
      2 * y ^ 2 / ((1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) * y ^ 2 + (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re))
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 : y + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [cayleyTransform_mul_I y hy1]
  have hs : (ξ : ℂ).im ^ 2 = 1 - (ξ : ℂ).re ^ 2 := by
    have h := Circle.normSq_coe ξ
    rw [normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith
  have hkernel : poissonKernel 0 ((((y - 1) / (y + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ =
      (1 - ((y - 1) / (y + 1)) ^ 2) /
        (((ξ : ℂ).re - (y - 1) / (y + 1)) ^ 2 + (ξ : ℂ).im ^ 2) := by
    simp only [poissonKernel_def, sub_zero, Circle.norm_coe, one_pow,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, ← normSq_eq_norm_sq, normSq_apply,
      sub_re, sub_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, sub_zero, ← sq]
  rw [hkernel, hs]
  have hd := circle_mass_denominator_pos ξ hy
  have hden : ((ξ : ℂ).re - (y - 1) / (y + 1)) ^ 2 + (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re ^ 2) =
      2 * ((1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) * y ^ 2 + (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re)) / (y + 1) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [hy1]
    ring
  have hnum : 1 - ((y - 1) / (y + 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * y / (y + 1) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [hy1]
    ring
  rw [hden, hnum]
  field_simp [hy1, hd.ne']
  ring

name: Complex.mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_nonneg (ξ : Circle) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 ≤ y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I ξ hy]
  exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (circle_mass_denominator_pos ξ hy).le

name: Complex.mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_le
statement:
theorem mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_le {ξ : Circle} (hξ : ξ ≠ 1)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ ≤ 2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I ξ hy]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (circle_mass_denominator_pos ξ hy)
    (sub_pos.mpr (circle_re_lt_one_of_ne_one hξ))).mpr
  nlinarith [neg_one_le_circle_re ξ]

name: Complex.mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_one
statement:
theorem mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I_one {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) (1 : Circle) = y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I _ hy]
  simp only [Circle.coe_one, one_re, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_add]
  ring

name: Complex.tendsto_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I {ξ : Circle} (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => y * poissonKernel 0 (cayleyTransform ((y : ℂ) * I)) ξ)
      atTop (𝓝 (2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re)))
proof:
:= by
  have hz : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re) / y ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_pow_atTop (α := ℝ) (show (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide)).const_div_atTop _
  have ha := sub_pos.mpr (circle_re_lt_one_of_ne_one hξ)
  have ht : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => 2 / ((1 - (ξ : ℂ).re) + (1 + (ξ : ℂ).re) / y ^ 2))
      atTop (𝓝 (2 / (1 - (ξ : ℂ).re))) := by
    convert! tendsto_const_nhds.div (tendsto_const_nhds.add hz)
      (by simpa only [add_zero] using ha.ne') using 1
    simp only [add_zero]
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
  rw [mul_poissonKernel_cayley_mul_I ξ hy]
  field_simp [hy.ne', (circle_mass_denominator_pos ξ hy).ne']

name: Complex.circle_coe_sub_ne_zero
statement:
theorem circle_coe_sub_ne_zero {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball 0 1) (ξ : Circle) :
    (ξ : ℂ) - w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg norm (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
  rw [Circle.norm_coe] at he
  have hh : ‖w‖ < 1 := by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw
  linarith

name: Complex.continuous_herglotzRieszKernel_circle
statement:
theorem continuous_herglotzRieszKernel_circle {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball 0 1) :
    Continuous (fun ξ : Circle => herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [herglotzRieszKernel_def, sub_zero]
  exact (continuous_subtype_val.add continuous_const).div
    (continuous_subtype_val.sub continuous_const) (circle_coe_sub_ne_zero hw)

name: Complex.hasDerivAt_herglotzRieszKernel_pole
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_herglotzRieszKernel_pole {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball 0 1) (ξ : Circle) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z => herglotzRieszKernel 0 z ξ)
      (2 * (ξ : ℂ) / ((ξ : ℂ) - w) ^ 2) w
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const w (ξ : ℂ)).add (hasDerivAt_id w)).div
    ((hasDerivAt_const w (ξ : ℂ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id w)) (circle_coe_sub_ne_zero hw ξ)
  have h' : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => ((ξ : ℂ) + z) / ((ξ : ℂ) - z))
      (((ξ : ℂ) - w + ((ξ : ℂ) + w)) / ((ξ : ℂ) - w) ^ 2) w := by
    convert! h using 1
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, id_eq, zero_add,
      zero_sub, one_mul, mul_neg_one, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have he : (ξ : ℂ) - w + ((ξ : ℂ) + w) = 2 * (ξ : ℂ) := by ring
  simpa only [herglotzRieszKernel_def, sub_zero, he] using h'

name: Complex.hasDerivAt_integral_herglotzRieszKernel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_herglotzRieszKernel (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball 0 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z => ∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 z ξ ∂μ)
      (∫ ξ : Circle, 2 * (ξ : ℂ) / ((ξ : ℂ) - w) ^ 2 ∂μ) w
proof:
:= by
  let r := (1 - ‖w‖) / 2
  have hw' : ‖w‖ < 1 := by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hinside (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ closedBall w r) : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    have hdist : ‖z - w‖ ≤ r := by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    have hn := norm_add_le (z - w) w
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at hn
    simp only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    dsimp [r] at hdist
    linarith
  let D : ℂ → Circle → ℂ := fun z ξ => 2 * (ξ : ℂ) / ((ξ : ℂ) - z) ^ 2
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × Circle => D p.1 p.2) (closedBall w r ×ˢ univ) := by
    dsimp [D]
    apply ContinuousOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    intro p hp
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (circle_coe_sub_ne_zero (hinside p.1 hp.1) p.2)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall w r).prod isCompact_univ).bddAbove_image hD.norm
  have hcontD : Continuous (D w) := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact (continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val).div
      ((continuous_subtype_val.sub continuous_const).pow 2)
      (fun ξ => pow_ne_zero 2 (circle_coe_sub_ne_zero hw ξ))
  have hi : Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ) μ :=
    (continuous_herglotzRieszKernel_circle hw).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := μ) (s := closedBall w r) (bound := fun _ => B) (closedBall_mem_nhds _ hr)
    (F := fun z ξ => herglotzRieszKernel 0 z ξ) (F' := D)
    (by
      filter_upwards [closedBall_mem_nhds w hr] with z hz
      exact (continuous_herglotzRieszKernel_circle (hinside z hz)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    hi hcontD.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ z hz => hB ⟨(z, ξ), ⟨hz, mem_univ _⟩, rfl⟩))
    (integrable_const B)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ z hz => hasDerivAt_herglotzRieszKernel_pole (hinside z hz) ξ))
  exact h.2

name: AnalyticOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_herglotzRieszKernel_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.AnalyticOnNhd.exists_finiteMeasure_herglotzRieszKernel_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball 0 1))
    (hpos : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, 0 ≤ (f w).re) :
    ∃ μ : FiniteMeasure Circle, (μ.mass : ℝ) = (f 0).re ∧
      ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        f w = Complex.I * (f 0).im +
          ∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : HarmonicOnNhd (fun w => (f w).re) (ball 0 1) :=
    fun w hw => (hf w hw).harmonicAt_re
  obtain ⟨μ, hmass, hμ⟩ := hu.exists_finiteMeasure_poissonKernel_eq hpos
  let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)
  have hi (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :
      Integrable (fun ξ : Circle => herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ) (μ : Measure Circle) :=
    (continuous_herglotzRieszKernel_circle hw).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hGre (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) : (G w).re = (f w).re := by
    calc
      (G w).re = ∫ ξ : Circle, (herglotzRieszKernel 0 w ξ).re ∂(μ : Measure Circle) :=
        (Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm (hi w hw)).symm
      _ = (f w).re := by
        simpa only [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel, Function.comp_apply] using hμ w hw
  have hGanalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (ball 0 1) := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd _ isOpen_ball
    intro w hw
    exact (hasDerivAt_integral_herglotzRieszKernel (μ : Measure Circle) hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hzero : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ((f - G) w).re = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Complex.sub_re, hGre w hw, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hf.sub hGanalytic).eq_const_of_re_eq_const hzero isOpen_ball
    ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) 1).isPreconnected⟩
  have hG0 : G 0 = ((f 0).re : ℂ) := by
    change (∫ ξ : Circle, herglotzRieszKernel 0 0 ξ ∂(μ : Measure Circle)) = _
    have hk (ξ : Circle) : herglotzRieszKernel 0 0 ξ = 1 := by
      simp only [herglotzRieszKernel_def, sub_zero, add_zero, div_self (Circle.coe_ne_zero ξ)]
    simp_rw [hk]
    rw [integral_const, Complex.real_smul, mul_one]
    change ((μ.mass : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((f 0).re : ℂ)
    exact congrArg Complex.ofReal hmass
  have hc0 : c = Complex.I * (f 0).im := by
    have he := hc 0 (by simp)
    change f 0 - G 0 = c at he
    rw [hG0] at he
    rw [← he]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  refine ⟨μ, hmass, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  have he := hc w hw
  change f w - G w = c at he
  rw [hc0] at he
  change f w = Complex.I * (f 0).im + G w
  linear_combination he

name: Polynomial.sub_ne_zero_on_circle
statement:
private theorem sub_ne_zero_on_circle {c w : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hw : dist w c ≠ r) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ sphere c r) : z - w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hzw : z = w := sub_eq_zero.mp h
  exact hw (hzw ▸ mem_sphere.mp hz)

name: Polynomial.circleIntegral_div_sub
statement:
private theorem circleIntegral_div_sub (c w : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hw : dist w c ≠ r) :
    (∮ z in C(c, r), z / (z - w)) =
      if dist w c < r then (2 * Real.pi * I) * w else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hinside : dist w c < r
  · rw [if_pos hinside]
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, id_eq] using
      (differentiableOn_id : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z)
        (closedBall c r)).circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (mem_ball.mpr hinside)
  · rw [if_neg hinside]
    have houtside : r < dist w c := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hinside) hw.symm
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z / (z - w)) (closedBall c r) := by
      intro z hz
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      apply differentiableAt_id.div (differentiableAt_id.sub_const w)
      intro h
      have : z = w := sub_eq_zero.mp h
      subst z
      exact (not_le_of_gt houtside) (mem_closedBall.mp hz)
    exact (hd.mono closure_ball_subset_closedBall).diffContOnCl.circleIntegral_eq_zero hr

name: Polynomial.circleIntegrable_div_sub
statement:
private theorem circleIntegrable_div_sub (c w : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hw : dist w c ≠ r) : CircleIntegrable (fun z : ℂ => z / (z - w)) c r
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuousOn_id.div (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const)
    (fun _ hz => sub_ne_zero_on_circle hw hz)).circleIntegrable hr

name: Polynomial.circleIntegrable_multiset_div_sub
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons w m ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons]
    exact (circleIntegrable_div_sub c w hr (h w (by simp))).add
      (ih (fun v hv => h v (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hv)))

name: Polynomial.circleIntegral_multiset_sum
statement:
private theorem circleIntegral_multiset_sum (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (m : Multiset ℂ) (h : ∀ w ∈ m, dist w c ≠ r) :
    (∮ z in C(c, r), (m.map (fun w => z / (z - w))).sum) =
      (m.map (fun w => if dist w c < r then (2 * Real.pi * I) * w else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [circleIntegral]
  | @cons w m ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons]
    have hm : ∀ v ∈ m, dist v c ≠ r := fun v hv => h v (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hv)
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_add (circleIntegrable_div_sub c w hr (h w (by simp))) ?_,
      circleIntegral_div_sub c w hr (h w (by simp)), ih hm]
    exact circleIntegrable_multiset_div_sub c hr m hm

name: Polynomial.circleIntegral_mul_derivative_div_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_mul_derivative_div_eq_sum_roots (p : ℂ[X]) (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hp : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, p.eval z ≠ 0) :
    (∮ z in C(c, r), z * (p.derivative.eval z / p.eval z)) =
      (p.roots.map
        (fun w => if dist w c < r then (2 * Real.pi * I) * w else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr hr (fun z hz => ?_)]
  · exact circleIntegral_multiset_sum c hr p.roots (fun w hw => by
      intro heq
      exact hp w (mem_sphere.mpr heq) ((mem_roots (by
        intro hzero
        simp [hzero] at hw)).mp hw))
  · rw [(IsAlgClosed.splits p).eval_derivative_div_eval_of_ne_zero (hp z hz),
      ← Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]
    congr 1
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro w _
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Polynomial.two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_mul_derivative_div_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_mul_derivative_div_eq_sum_roots
    (p : ℂ[X]) (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hp : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, p.eval z ≠ 0) :
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∮ z in C(c, r), z * (p.derivative.eval z / p.eval z)) =
      (p.roots.map (fun w => if dist w c < r then w else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleIntegral_mul_derivative_div_eq_sum_roots p c hr hp]
  have heq : (p.roots.map
      (fun w => if dist w c < r then (2 * Real.pi * I) * w else 0)).sum =
      (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ) *
        (p.roots.map (fun w => if dist w c < r then w else 0)).sum := by
    rw [← Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]
    congr 1
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro w _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [heq, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀, one_mul]
  simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

name: Polynomial.circleEval_sum_smul
statement:
private theorem circleEval_sum_smul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (a : ι → ℂ) (q : ι → ℂ[X]) :
    circleEval c r (∑ i, a i • q i) = ∑ i, a i • circleEval c r (q i)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [circleEval, eval_finsetSum]

name: Polynomial.analyticAt_sum_roots_in_circle
statement:
theorem analyticAt_sum_roots_in_circle {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (q : ι → ℂ[X]) (a : ι → ℂ → ℂ) {u c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (ha : ∀ i, AnalyticAt ℂ (a i) u)
    (hzero : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, (∑ i, a i u • q i).eval z ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun v => ((∑ i, a i v • q i).roots.map
      (fun w => if dist w c < r then w else 0)).sum) u
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℂ → ℂ[X] := fun v => ∑ i, a i v • q i
  let F : ℂ → C(sphere c r, ℂ) := fun v => circleEval c r (P v)
  let Z : C(sphere c r, ℂ) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let G : ℂ → C(sphere c r, ℂ) := fun v => Z * circleEval c r (P v).derivative
  have hF : AnalyticAt ℂ F u := by
    simp only [F, P, circleEval_sum_smul]
    exact Finset.univ.analyticAt_fun_sum fun i _ => (ha i).smul analyticAt_const
  have hG : AnalyticAt ℂ G u := by
    simp only [G, P, derivative_sum, derivative_smul, circleEval_sum_smul]
    exact analyticAt_const.mul
      (Finset.univ.analyticAt_fun_sum fun i _ => (ha i).smul analyticAt_const)
  have hz : ∀ z, F u z ≠ 0 := fun z => hzero z z.property
  have hA := (analyticAt_const (v := (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹)).mul
    (circleIntegral.analyticAt_integral_div hr hF hG hz)
  apply hA.congr
  have hunit : IsUnit (F u) := (F u).isUnit_iff_forall_ne_zero.mpr hz
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 u, IsUnit (F v) :=
    hF.continuousAt.eventually (Units.isOpen.mem_nhds hunit)
  filter_upwards [hevent] with v hv
  have hnonzero : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, (P v).eval z ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => ((F v).isUnit_iff_forall_ne_zero.mp hv) ⟨z, hz⟩
  have heq : (∮ z in C(c, r),
      if hz : z ∈ sphere c r then G v ⟨z, hz⟩ / F v ⟨z, hz⟩ else 0) =
      ∮ z in C(c, r), z * ((P v).derivative.eval z / (P v).eval z) := by
    apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hr
    intro z hz
    simp only [dif_pos hz, G, F, Z, circleEval, ContinuousMap.mul_apply,
      ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    ring
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [heq]
  exact two_pi_i_inv_mul_circleIntegral_mul_derivative_div_eq_sum_roots (P v) c hr hnonzero

name: Polynomial.sum_map_ite_eq_sum_filter
statement:
private theorem sum_map_ite_eq_sum_filter (m : Multiset ℂ) (p : ℂ → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : (m.map (fun z => if p z then z else 0)).sum = (m.filter p).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons z m ih =>
    by_cases hz : p z <;> simp [hz, ih]

name: Polynomial.analyticAt_sum_filter_roots_upper_of_upperHemicontinuous
statement:
theorem analyticAt_sum_filter_roots_upper_of_upperHemicontinuous
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (q : ι → ℂ[X]) (a : ι → ℂ → ℂ) {u : ℂ}
    (ha : ∀ i, AnalyticAt ℂ (a i) u) (hp : (∑ i, a i u • q i) ≠ 0)
    (hroots : UpperHemicontinuousAt
      (fun v => {z | z ∈ (∑ i, a i v • q i).roots}) u)
    (hreal : ∀ z ∈ (∑ i, a i u • q i).roots, z.im ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun v => ((∑ i, a i v • q i).roots.filter
      (fun z => 0 < z.im)).sum) u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hselect⟩ := Complex.exists_tangent_circle_eventually_mem_iff_im_pos
    hroots (Multiset.finite_toSet _) hreal
  have hbase := hselect.self_of_nhds
  have hzero : ∀ z ∈ sphere ((r : ℂ) * I) r,
      (∑ i, a i u • q i).eval z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz heval
    have hmem : z ∈ (∑ i, a i u • q i).roots := (mem_roots hp).mpr heval
    exact (hbase z hmem).2 (mem_sphere.mp hz)
  apply (analyticAt_sum_roots_in_circle q a hr.le ha hzero).congr
  filter_upwards [hselect] with v hv
  rw [← sum_map_ite_eq_sum_filter]
  congr 1
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro z hz
  simp only [(hv z hz).1]

name: Polynomial.im_sum_filter_roots_upper_nonneg
statement:
theorem im_sum_filter_roots_upper_nonneg (p : ℂ[X]) :
    0 ≤ ((p.roots.filter (fun z => 0 < z.im)).sum).im
proof:
:= by
  change 0 ≤ Complex.imAddGroupHom ((p.roots.filter (fun z => 0 < z.im)).sum)
  rw [map_multiset_sum]
  apply Multiset.sum_nonneg
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
  exact (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hz).2.le

name: NLAlib.mul_sub_mul_sub_neg_of_abs_lt
statement:
theorem mul_sub_mul_sub_neg_of_abs_lt {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a * b < 0)
    (hc : |c| < |a|) (hd : |d| < |b|) : (a - c) * (b - d) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hab with h | h
  · rw [abs_of_pos h.1] at hc
    rw [abs_of_neg h.2] at hd
    have hc' := (abs_lt.mp hc).2
    have hd' := (abs_lt.mp hd).1
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · rw [abs_of_neg h.1] at hc
    rw [abs_of_pos h.2] at hd
    have hc' := (abs_lt.mp hc).1
    have hd' := (abs_lt.mp hd).2
    exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.exists_strictMono_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem exists_strictMono_mem_Ioo {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ v : Fin k → Set.Ioo a b, StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < k + 1 := by positivity
  let v : Fin k → Set.Ioo a b := fun i =>
    ⟨a + (b - a) * ((i : ℕ) + 1) / (k + 1), by
      have hnum : (0 : ℝ) < (i : ℕ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hi : ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) < k + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (show (i : ℕ) + 1 < k + 1 by omega)
      constructor
      · exact lt_add_of_pos_right a (div_pos (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) hnum) hden)
      · have hpart : (b - a) * ((i : ℕ) + 1) / (k + 1) < b - a :=
          (div_lt_iff₀ hden).mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hi (sub_pos.mpr hab))
        linarith⟩
  refine ⟨v, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  have hijR : ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) < (j : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (show (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ) + 1 by omega)
  have hdiv := div_lt_div_of_pos_right
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hijR (sub_pos.mpr hab)) hden
  dsimp [v]; linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_sign_of_alternating_abs_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sign_of_alternating_abs_eq {k : ℕ} {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 < E)
    (u : Fin (k + 2) → ℝ) (habs : ∀ i, |u i| = E)
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (k + 1), u i.castSucc * u i.succ < 0) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, |σ| = 1 ∧ ∀ i, u i = σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * E
proof:
:= by
  let σ := u 0 / E
  refine ⟨σ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [σ]; rw [abs_div, habs 0, abs_of_pos hE]; exact div_self hE.ne'
  · intro i
    refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun j hj => ?_) i
    · simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
      exact (div_mul_cancel₀ (u 0) hE.ne').symm
    · have hnext : u j.succ = -u j.castSucc := by
        rcases abs_eq_abs.mp ((habs j.succ).trans (habs j.castSucc).symm) with h | h
        · have hs := hsign j
          rw [h] at hs
          exact (not_lt_of_ge (mul_self_nonneg _) hs).elim
        · exact h
      rw [hnext, hj]
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, pow_succ]
      ring

name: NLAlib.mul_pos_of_continuousOn_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hneg : f x * f y < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hnot)
    (mul_ne_zero (hzero x hx) (hzero y hy))
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hneg with h | h
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, heq⟩ := isPreconnected_Icc.intermediate_value hy hx hf
      ⟨h.2.le, h.1.le⟩
    exact hzero z hz heq
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, heq⟩ := isPreconnected_Icc.intermediate_value hx hy hf
      ⟨h.1.le, h.2.le⟩
    exact hzero z hz heq

name: NLAlib.exists_strictMono_eq_zero_of_mul_neg
statement:
theorem exists_strictMono_eq_zero_of_mul_neg {n : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _))))
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), f (v i.castSucc) * f (v i.succ) < 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, StrictMono c ∧
      ∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ) ∧ f (c i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ), f c = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hi : v i.castSucc < v i.succ := hv Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) :=
      hf.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc
      (hv.monotone (Fin.zero_le _)) (hv.monotone (Fin.le_last _)))
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp (hsign i) with h | h
    · exact intermediate_value_Ioo' hi.le hcont ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
    · exact intermediate_value_Ioo hi.le hcont ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
  choose c hc hczero using hzero
  refine ⟨c, fun i j hij => ?_, fun i => ⟨hc i, hczero i⟩⟩
  calc
    c i < v i.succ := (hc i).2
    _ ≤ v j.castSucc := hv.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hij)
    _ < c j := (hc j).1

name: IsCompact.exists_fixedPoint_of_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem IsCompact.exists_fixedPoint_of_monotoneOn
    {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) {F : X → X}
    (hF : ContinuousOn F K) (hmap : MapsTo F K K) (hmono : MonotoneOn F K)
    {a : X} (ha : a ∈ K) (hsub : a ≤ F a) :
    ∃ z ∈ K, F z = z ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, F^[n] a ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → X := fun n => F^[n] a
  have hu0 : u 0 = a := rfl
  have hus (n : ℕ) : u (n + 1) = F (u n) := Function.iterate_succ_apply' F n a
  have huK (n : ℕ) : u n ∈ K := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ha
    | succ n hn => rw [hus]; exact hmap hn
  have hum : Monotone u := by
    apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa only [hu0, hus] using hsub
    | succ n hn =>
      simpa only [hus] using hmono (huK n) (huK (n + 1)) hn
  obtain ⟨z, hz, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := hK.isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall huK).frequently
  have hupper (n : ℕ) : u n ≤ z := by
    apply ge_of_tendsto hlim
    filter_upwards [hφ.tendsto_atTop.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop n)] with k hk
    exact hum hk
  have hfLim : Tendsto (fun k => F (u (φ k))) atTop (𝓝 (F z)) :=
    (hF z hz).tendsto.comp (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
      ⟨hlim, Eventually.of_forall fun k => huK (φ k)⟩)
  have hsLim : Tendsto (fun k => u (φ k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (F z)) := by
    simpa only [hus] using hfLim
  have hlow : z ≤ F z := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hlim hsLim
    (Eventually.of_forall fun k => hum (Nat.le_succ (φ k)))
  have hupp : F z ≤ z := le_of_tendsto hsLim
    (Eventually.of_forall fun k => hupper (φ k + 1))
  exact ⟨z, hz, le_antisymm hupp hlow, hupper⟩

name: Metric.exists_mem_dist_le_of_hausdorffDist_le
statement:
private theorem exists_mem_dist_le_of_hausdorffDist_le
    {S T : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hSn : S.Nonempty) (hTn : T.Nonempty) {x δ : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ S) (hd : hausdorffDist S T ≤ δ) :
    ∃ y ∈ T, dist x y ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdist⟩ := hT.exists_infDist_eq_dist hTn x
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
  rw [← hdist]
  exact (infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx
    (hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hSn hTn hS.isBounded hT.isBounded)).trans hd

name: Metric.abs_sq_sub_sq_le_of_reference_radius
statement:
private theorem abs_sq_sub_sq_le_of_reference_radius
    {x y δ R : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hR : y ≤ R) (hd : |x - y| ≤ δ) :
    |x ^ 2 - y ^ 2| ≤ 2 * δ * R + δ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : x + y ≤ 2 * R + δ := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hd).2
    linarith
  calc
    |x ^ 2 - y ^ 2| = |x - y| * (x + y) := by
      rw [sq_sub_sq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hx hy)]
      ring
    _ ≤ δ * (2 * R + δ) := mul_le_mul hd hxy (add_nonneg hx hy) hδ
    _ = 2 * δ * R + δ ^ 2 := by ring

name: Metric.hausdorffDist_sq_positive_le_of_gap
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_sq_positive_le_of_gap
    {S T : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hSn : S.Nonempty) (hTn : T.Nonempty) {δ R : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hgapS : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < x → 2 * δ ≤ x)
    (hgapT : ∀ x ∈ T, 0 < x → 2 * δ ≤ x)
    (hrad : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 < y → y ≤ R)
    (hd : hausdorffDist S T ≤ δ) :
    hausdorffDist ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) '' (S ∩ Set.Ioi 0))
      ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) '' (T ∩ Set.Ioi 0)) ≤ 2 * δ * R + δ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist (by positivity)
  · rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hx, hx0⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_mem_dist_le_of_hausdorffDist_le hS hT hSn hTn hx hd
    have habs : |x - y| ≤ δ := by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hxy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by
      have hxg := hgapS x hx hx0
      have hxy' := (abs_le.mp habs).2
      linarith
    refine ⟨y ^ 2, ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using
      abs_sq_sub_sq_le_of_reference_radius hx0.le hy0.le hδ.le (hrad y hy hy0) habs
  · rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := exists_mem_dist_le_of_hausdorffDist_le hT hS hTn hSn hy
      (by simpa only [hausdorffDist_comm] using hd)
    have habs : |x - y| ≤ δ := by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hyx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by
      have hyg := hgapT y hy hy0
      have hxy' := (abs_le.mp habs).1
      linarith
    refine ⟨x ^ 2, ⟨x, ⟨hx, hx0⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using
      abs_sq_sub_sq_le_of_reference_radius hx0.le hy0.le hδ.le (hrad y hy hy0) habs

name: Metric.exists_finset_subset_card_le_of_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finset_subset_card_le_of_cover
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (S : Set X) (N : Finset X)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ u ∈ N, dist x u ≤ ε) :
    ∃ M : Finset X, (M : Set X) ⊆ S ∧ M.card ≤ N.card ∧
      ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ u ∈ M, dist x u ≤ 2 * ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ℝ≥0 := ⟨ε, hε⟩
  have hc : IsCover e S (N : Set X) := by
    apply IsCover.of_subset_iUnion_closedBall
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu⟩ := hcover x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem u (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hu hxu)
  have hb : coveringNumber (2 * e) S ≤ (N.card : ℕ∞) :=
    (coveringNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber e S).trans
      (by simpa using hc.externalCoveringNumber_le_encard)
  have htop : coveringNumber (2 * e) S ≠ ⊤ :=
    (lt_of_le_of_lt hb (by simp)).ne
  obtain ⟨C, hCS, hCf, hCc, hcard⟩ := exists_set_encard_eq_coveringNumber htop
  refine ⟨hCf.toFinset, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hCS (hCf.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
  · have hh := hcard.trans_le hb
    rw [hCf.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card] at hh
    exact_mod_cast hh
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hCc.subset_iUnion_closedBall hx)
    obtain ⟨huC, hxu⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hu
    refine ⟨u, hCf.mem_toFinset.mpr huC, ?_⟩
    have hnum : ((2 * e : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 2 * ε := by rw [NNReal.coe_mul]; rfl
    change dist x u ≤ ((2 * e : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) at hxu
    rwa [hnum] at hxu

name: Metric.abs_csSup_sub_csSup_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem abs_csSup_sub_csSup_le_hausdorffDist
    {S T : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hSn : S.Nonempty) (hTn : T.Nonempty) :
    |sSup S-sSup T| ≤ hausdorffDist S T
proof:
:= by
  have hf := hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hSn hTn hS.isBounded hT.isBounded
  have hst : sSup S-sSup T ≤ hausdorffDist S T := by
    obtain ⟨y,hy,he⟩ := hT.exists_infDist_eq_dist hTn (sSup S)
    have hd := infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (hS.sSup_mem hSn) hf
    rw [he,Real.dist_eq] at hd
    have hY := le_csSup hT.bddAbove hy
    linarith only [le_abs_self (sSup S-y),hd,hY]
  have hts : sSup T-sSup S ≤ hausdorffDist S T := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := hS.exists_infDist_eq_dist hSn (sSup T)
    have hf' := hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hTn hSn hT.isBounded hS.isBounded
    have hd := infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (hT.sSup_mem hTn) hf'
    rw [he,Real.dist_eq,hausdorffDist_comm] at hd
    have hX := le_csSup hS.bddAbove hx
    linarith only [le_abs_self (sSup T-x),hd,hX]
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hts],hst⟩

name: Metric.abs_csInf_sub_csInf_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem abs_csInf_sub_csInf_le_hausdorffDist
    {S T : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hSn : S.Nonempty) (hTn : T.Nonempty) :
    |sInf S-sInf T| ≤ hausdorffDist S T
proof:
:= by
  have hf := hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hSn hTn hS.isBounded hT.isBounded
  have hst : sInf S-sInf T ≤ hausdorffDist S T := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := hS.exists_infDist_eq_dist hSn (sInf T)
    have hf' := hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hTn hSn hT.isBounded hS.isBounded
    have hd := infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (hT.sInf_mem hTn) hf'
    rw [he,Real.dist_eq,hausdorffDist_comm] at hd
    have hX := csInf_le hS.bddBelow hx
    linarith only [neg_le_abs (sInf T-x),hd,hX]
  have hts : sInf T-sInf S ≤ hausdorffDist S T := by
    obtain ⟨y,hy,he⟩ := hT.exists_infDist_eq_dist hTn (sInf S)
    have hd := infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (hS.sInf_mem hSn) hf
    rw [he,Real.dist_eq] at hd
    have hY := csInf_le hT.bddBelow hy
    linarith only [neg_le_abs (sInf S-y),hd,hY]
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hts],hst⟩

name: NLAlib.haarFrameLaw_map_smul
statement:
theorem haarFrameLaw_map_smul {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (V : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (haarFrameLaw n k hkn).map (fun Q => V • Q) = haarFrameLaw n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  unfold haarFrameLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have heq : (fun Q : Stiefel n k => V • Q) ∘
      (fun O => O • coordinateStiefel n k hkn) =
      (fun O => O • coordinateStiefel n k hkn) ∘ (fun O => V * O) := by
    funext O
    exact (mul_smul V O _).symm
  rw [heq, ← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), map_mul_left_eq_self]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalHaar_map_smul_eq_haarFrameLaw
statement:
theorem orthogonalHaar_map_smul_eq_haarFrameLaw {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Q : Stiefel n k) :
    (orthogonalHaar n).map (fun O => O • Q) = haarFrameLaw n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_orthogonalGroup_smul_eq hkn (coordinateStiefel n k hkn) Q
  rw [← hV]
  have heq : (fun O => O • V • coordinateStiefel n k hkn) =
      (fun O => O • coordinateStiefel n k hkn) ∘ (fun O => O * V) := by
    funext O
    exact (mul_smul O V _).symm
  rw [heq, ← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), map_mul_right_eq_self]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.measure_eq_haarFrameLaw_of_invariant
statement:
theorem measure_eq_haarFrameLaw_of_invariant {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ν : Measure (Stiefel n k)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hinv : ∀ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, ν.map (fun Q => O • Q) = ν) :
    ν = haarFrameLaw n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext
  intro s hs
  let f : Stiefel n k → ℝ≥0∞ := s.indicator (fun _ => 1)
  have hf : Measurable f := measurable_const.indicator hs
  have hinner : ∀ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (∫⁻ Q, f (O • Q) ∂ν) = ν s := by
    intro O
    have hh := lintegral_map (μ := ν) hf
      (show Measurable (fun Q : Stiefel n k => O • Q) from by fun_prop)
    rw [hinv O] at hh
    simpa only [f, lintegral_indicator hs, lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ,
      one_mul] using hh.symm
  have horbit : ∀ Q : Stiefel n k,
      (∫⁻ O, f (O • Q) ∂orthogonalHaar n) = haarFrameLaw n k hkn s := by
    intro Q
    have hh := lintegral_map (μ := orthogonalHaar n) hf (show Measurable
      (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ => O • Q) from by fun_prop)
    rw [orthogonalHaar_map_smul_eq_haarFrameLaw hkn Q] at hh
    simpa only [f, lintegral_indicator hs, lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ,
      one_mul] using hh.symm
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ × Stiefel n k =>
      f (p.1 • p.2)) := hf.comp (by fun_prop)
  calc
    ν s = ∫⁻ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, ∫⁻ Q, f (O • Q) ∂ν
        ∂orthogonalHaar n := by simp only [hinner, lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
    _ = ∫⁻ Q, ∫⁻ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, f (O • Q) ∂orthogonalHaar n
        ∂ν := lintegral_lintegral_swap hmeas.aemeasurable
    _ = _ := by simp only [horbit, lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]

      (fun O => O • coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k hkn) ∘ (fun O => V*O) := by

name: NLAlib.unitaryHaar_map_smul_eq_frameLaw
statement:

name: NLAlib.measure_eq_unitaryHaarFrameLaw_of_invariant
statement:
theorem measure_eq_unitaryHaarFrameLaw_of_invariant {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ν : Measure (UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hinv : ∀ O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜, ν.map (fun Q => O • Q) = ν) :
    ν = unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext
  intro s hs
  let f : UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k → ℝ≥0∞ := s.indicator (fun _ => 1)
  have hf : Measurable f := measurable_const.indicator hs
  have hinner : ∀ O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜,
      (∫⁻ Q, f (O • Q) ∂ν) = ν s := by
    intro O
    have hh := lintegral_map (μ := ν) hf
      (show Measurable (fun Q : UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k => O • Q) from by fun_prop)
    rw [hinv O] at hh
    simpa only [f,lintegral_indicator hs,lintegral_const,Measure.restrict_apply_univ,one_mul] using hh.symm
  have horbit : ∀ Q : UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k,
      (∫⁻ O, f (O • Q) ∂unitaryHaar 𝕜 n) = unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n k hkn s := by
    intro Q
    have hh := lintegral_map (μ := unitaryHaar 𝕜 n) hf (show Measurable
      (fun O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜 => O • Q) from by fun_prop)
    rw [unitaryHaar_map_smul_eq_frameLaw 𝕜 hkn Q] at hh
    simpa only [f,lintegral_indicator hs,lintegral_const,Measure.restrict_apply_univ,one_mul] using hh.symm
  have hact : Measurable (fun p : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜 × UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k =>
      p.1 • p.2) := by
    apply Measurable.subtype_mk
    change Measurable (fun p : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜 × UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k =>
      p.1.val*p.2.val)
    exact (measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_fst).matrix_mul
      (measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_snd)
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜 × UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k =>
      f (p.1 • p.2)) := hf.comp hact
  calc
    ν s = ∫⁻ O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜, ∫⁻ Q, f (O • Q) ∂ν
        ∂unitaryHaar 𝕜 n := by simp only [hinner,lintegral_const,measure_univ,mul_one]
    _ = ∫⁻ Q, ∫⁻ O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜, f (O • Q) ∂unitaryHaar 𝕜 n
        ∂ν := lintegral_lintegral_swap hmeas.aemeasurable
    _ = _ := by simp only [horbit,lintegral_const,measure_univ,mul_one]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_gaussian_top_bottom_inverse
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_gaussian_top_bottom_inverse {n ell s r : ℕ}
    (E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ell) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hE : HasOrthonormalCols E) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hEV : Eᴴ*V=0)
    (hr : r+2≤ell) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ => frobSq ((Vᴴ*G)*(pinvR (Eᴴ*G)ᴴ)ᴴ))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin r)) ∧
      ∫ G, frobSq ((Vᴴ*G)*(pinvR (Eᴴ*G)ᴴ)ᴴ) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin r)=
        (s:ℝ)*r/((ell:ℝ)-r-1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_gaussian_mul_pinvR_adjoint_prod hr (s := s)
  have hG := hasLaw_gaussian_adjoint_top_and_bottom_blocks (r := r) E V hE hV hEV
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℝ × Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℝ =>
      frobSq (p.2*(pinvR p.1)ᴴ)) := measurable_frobSq.comp
    (measurable_snd.matrix_mul (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp (measurable_pinvR.comp measurable_fst)))
  constructor
  · rw [← hG.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hG.aemeasurable
  · exact (hG.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable).trans hv

statement:
theorem unitaryHaar_map_inv_smul_eq_frameLaw {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Q : UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n k) :
    (unitaryHaar 𝕜 n).map (fun O => O⁻¹ • Q) = unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜 => O⁻¹ • Q) =
      (fun O => O • Q) ∘ Inv.inv := rfl
  rw [heq,← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),map_inv_eq_self]
  exact unitaryHaar_map_smul_eq_frameLaw 𝕜 hkn Q

name: NLAlib.unitaryHaarFrameLaw_map_topGram_eq
statement:
theorem unitaryHaarFrameLaw_map_topGram_eq {n r ell : ℕ} (hrn : r ≤ n) (helln : ell ≤ n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n ell helln).map (unitaryFrameTopGram 𝕜 U) =
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n r hrn).map (unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 helln)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← unitaryHaar_map_inv_smul_eq_frameLaw 𝕜 hrn (⟨U,hU⟩ : UnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n r)]
  unfold unitaryHaarFrameLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (by unfold unitaryFrameTopGram; fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    Measure.map_map (by unfold unitaryFrameLeadingGram; fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  congr 1
  funext O
  have hinv : (O⁻¹).val = O.valᴴ := rfl
  change (Uᴴ*(O.val*(coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).val))*
      (Uᴴ*(O.val*(coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).val))ᴴ =
    ((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*((O⁻¹).val*U))ᴴ*
      ((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*((O⁻¹).val*U))
  rw [hinv]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_gaussian_mul_pinvR_adjoint_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_gaussian_mul_pinvR_adjoint_prod
    {r ell s : ℕ} (hr : r+2 ≤ ell) :
    Integrable (fun p : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℝ × Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℝ =>
      frobSq (p.2*(pinvR p.1)ᴴ))
        ((gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin ell)).prod (gaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r))) ∧
    ∫ p : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℝ × Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℝ,
      frobSq (p.2*(pinvR p.1)ᴴ)
        ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin ell)).prod (gaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r)) =
          (s:ℝ)*r/((ell:ℝ)-r-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix hr
  have hOne : frobSq (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ) = (s:ℝ) := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one,frobSq_diagonal]
    simp
  have hfix (T : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℝ) :
      Integrable (fun Z => frobSq (Z*T)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r)) ∧
        ∫ Z, frobSq (Z*T) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r) = (s:ℝ)*frobSq T := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [Matrix.one_mul] using
        integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ) T
    · simpa only [Matrix.one_mul,hOne] using
        integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℝ) T
  have h := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_random_prod
    (fun X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℝ => (pinvR X)ᴴ)
    (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp measurable_pinvR)
    (by simpa only [frobSq_conjTranspose] using hi.1) (s:ℝ) hfix
  refine ⟨h.1,h.2.trans ?_⟩
  simp_rw [frobSq_conjTranspose]
  rw [hi.2]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_complexGaussian_mul_pinvR_adjoint_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_complexGaussian_mul_pinvR_adjoint_prod
    {r ell s : ℕ} (hr : r+1 ≤ ell) :
    Integrable (fun p : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℂ × Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℂ =>
      frobSq (p.2*(pinvR p.1)ᴴ))
        ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin ell)).prod
          (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r))) ∧
    ∫ p : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℂ × Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℂ,
      frobSq (p.2*(pinvR p.1)ᴴ)
        ∂(circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin ell)).prod
          (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r)) =
          (s:ℝ)*r/((ell:ℝ)-r)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_circularComplexGaussianMatrix hr
  have hOne : frobSq (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℂ) = (s:ℝ) := by
    rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one,frobSq_diagonal]
    simp
  have hfix (T : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℂ) :
      Integrable (fun Z => frobSq (Z*T)) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r)) ∧
        ∫ Z, frobSq (Z*T) ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin s) (Fin r) = (2*(s:ℝ))*frobSq T := by
    simpa only [Matrix.one_mul,hOne] using
      integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_mul
        (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℂ) T
  have h := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_random_prod
    (fun X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin ell) ℂ => (pinvR X)ᴴ)
    (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp measurable_pinvR)
    (by simpa only [frobSq_conjTranspose] using hi.1) (2*(s:ℝ)) hfix
  refine ⟨h.1,h.2.trans ?_⟩
  simp_rw [frobSq_conjTranspose]
  rw [hi.2]
  have hgap : (ell:ℝ)-r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (show r<ell by omega)))
  field_simp [hgap]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_re_trace_inv_topGram_haar_real
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_re_trace_inv_topGram_haar_real {n r ell : ℕ}
    (hr : r+2 ≤ ell) (helln : ell ≤ n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    Integrable (fun Q => RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (unitaryFrameTopGram ℝ U Q)⁻¹))
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw ℝ n ell helln) ∧
    ∫ Q, RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (unitaryFrameTopGram ℝ U Q)⁻¹)
      ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw ℝ n ell helln = (r:ℝ)+((n:ℝ)-ell)*r/((ell:ℝ)-r-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hre : r ≤ ell := by omega
  let E := (coordinateUnitaryStiefel ℝ n ell helln).val
  have hE : HasOrthonormalCols E := (coordinateUnitaryStiefel ℝ n ell helln).property
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hEV,hcomp⟩ :
      ∃ V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n-ell)) ℝ,
        HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ Eᴴ*V=0 ∧ E*Eᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1 := by
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n)-Fintype.card (Fin ell)=n-ell := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [← hcard]
    exact exists_unitary_complement_orthogonal E hE
  have hcross := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_gaussian_top_bottom_inverse E V hE hV hEV hr
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin r),
      LinearIndependent ℝ (unitaryQRColumnFamily ℝ G) := by
    exact gaussianMatrix_ae_linearIndependent_qrColumnFamily (hre.trans helln)
  have h := integrable_and_integral_re_trace_inv_topGram_of_unitaryQR_law ℝ
    (hre.trans helln) helln U hU V hcomp (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin r))
    (hasLaw_unitaryQRFrame_gaussianMatrix (hre.trans helln)) hfull
    (ae_gaussian_topGram_isUnit E hE hre) (((n-ell:ℕ):ℝ)*r/((ell:ℝ)-r-1)) hcross
  simpa only [Nat.cast_sub helln] using h

statement:

      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw ℂ n ell helln) ∧
    ∫ Q, RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (unitaryFrameTopGram ℂ U Q)⁻¹)
      ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw ℂ n ell helln = (r:ℝ)+((n:ℝ)-ell)*r/((ell:ℝ)-r)

  let E := (coordinateUnitaryStiefel ℂ n ell helln).val

  obtain ⟨V,hV,hEV,hcomp⟩ :

        HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ Eᴴ*V=0 ∧ E*Eᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1 := by

name: NLAlib.re_trace_inv_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq
statement:
theorem re_trace_inv_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq {n r ell s : ℕ}
    (hrn : r ≤ n) (helln : ell ≤ n) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin s) 𝕜)
    (hcomp : (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).val*
      (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜)
    (hG : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 G))
    (hY : IsUnit (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ*
      ((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G))) :
    RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 helln
      (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G))⁻¹) =
      (r:ℝ)+frobSq ((Vᴴ*G)*(pinvR (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ))ᴴ) ∧
    IsUnit (unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 helln (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G))
proof:
:= by
  let E := (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).val
  let Q := (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G).val
  let R := unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hrn G
  let Y := Eᴴ*G
  let Z := Vᴴ*G
  let T := Eᴴ*Q
  have hR : IsUnit R := isUnit_unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hrn G hG
  have hQR : Q*R=G := unitaryQRFrame_mul_unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hrn G hG
  have hTY : T*R=Y := by
    change (Eᴴ*Q)*R=Eᴴ*G
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,hQR]
  have hGram : Rᴴ*R=Yᴴ*Y+Zᴴ*Z := by
    rw [conjTranspose_unitaryQRUpper_mul_self 𝕜 hrn G hG]
    calc
      Gᴴ*G = Gᴴ*(E*Eᴴ+V*Vᴴ)*G := by rw [hcomp,Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = Yᴴ*Y+Zᴴ*Z := by
        dsimp only [Y,Z]
        rw [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
          Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have htrace := trace_inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq T Y Z R hR hY hTY hGram
  have hcross := frobSq_mul_pinvR_adjoint_eq_re_trace Yᴴ Z
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hY)
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hcross
  constructor
  · change RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (Tᴴ*T)⁻¹) = _
    rw [htrace,map_add]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin,RCLike.natCast_re]
    rw [← hcross]
  · exact (inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq T Y R hR hY hTY).2

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_random_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_random_prod
    {𝕜 α : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [MeasurableSpace α]
    {r s t : Type*} [Fintype r] [Fintype s] [Fintype t]
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure (Matrix s r 𝕜)} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    (T : α → Matrix r t 𝕜) (hT : Measurable T)
    (hi : Integrable (fun a => frobSq (T a)) μ) (c : ℝ)
    (hfix : ∀ W : Matrix r t 𝕜,
      Integrable (fun Z => frobSq (Z*W)) ν ∧ ∫ Z, frobSq (Z*W) ∂ν = c*frobSq W) :
    Integrable (fun p : α × Matrix s r 𝕜 => frobSq (p.2*T p.1)) (μ.prod ν) ∧
      ∫ p : α × Matrix s r 𝕜, frobSq (p.2*T p.1) ∂μ.prod ν =
        c*∫ a, frobSq (T a) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : α × Matrix s r 𝕜 => frobSq (p.2*T p.1)) :=
    measurable_frobSq.comp (measurable_snd.matrix_mul (hT.comp measurable_fst))
  have hp : Integrable (fun p : α × Matrix s r 𝕜 => frobSq (p.2*T p.1)) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply (integrable_prod_iff hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
    constructor
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun a => (hfix (T a)).1)
    · simpa only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _),(hfix _).2] using hi.const_mul c
  refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
  rw [integral_prod _ hp]
  simp_rw [(hfix _).2]
  exact integral_const_mul c _

proof:
