name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQRFrame
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQRFrame {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)).map (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn) = haarFrameLaw n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  let ν := (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)).map (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn)
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (measurable_canonicalQRFrame n k hkn).aemeasurable
  apply measure_eq_haarFrameLaw_of_invariant hkn ν
  intro O
  let T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ := fun G => O.val * G
  have hT : Measurable T := measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id
  have hrot : HasLaw T (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)) := by
    have hh := hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal O.val (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
      (transpose_mul_self_orthogonalGroup O) (by simp [HasOrthonormalCols])
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_one, T] using hh
  have heq : (fun G => O • canonicalQRFrame n k hkn G) =ᵐ[gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)]
      (fun G => canonicalQRFrame n k hkn (T G)) := by
    filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_linearIndependent_qrColumnFamily hkn] with G hG
    exact (canonicalQRFrame_orthogonal_mul hkn O G hG).symm
  change ν.map (fun Q => O • Q) = ν
  dsimp only [ν]
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (measurable_canonicalQRFrame n k hkn)]
  change (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)).map (fun G => O • canonicalQRFrame n k hkn G) = _
  rw [Measure.map_congr heq]
  change (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)).map ((canonicalQRFrame n k hkn) ∘ T) = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_canonicalQRFrame n k hkn) hT, hrot.map_eq]

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQRFrame_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQRFrame_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {n k : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k)) μ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => canonicalQRFrame n k hkn (X ω)) (haarFrameLaw n k hkn) μ
proof:
:=
  (⟨(measurable_canonicalQRFrame n k hkn).aemeasurable,
    gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQRFrame hkn⟩ :
    HasLaw (canonicalQRFrame n k hkn) (haarFrameLaw n k hkn) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin k))).comp
    hX

name: NLAlib.continuous_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal
statement:
theorem continuous_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (stiefelSquareToOrthogonal (n := n))
proof:
:=
  continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _

name: NLAlib.stiefelSquareToOrthogonal_smul_coordinate
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change O.val * (coordinateStiefel n n le_rfl).val = O.val
  have hcoord : (coordinateStiefel n n le_rfl).val =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    simp [coordinateStiefel, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [hcoord, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.haarFrameLaw_map_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal
statement:
theorem haarFrameLaw_map_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal (n : ℕ) :
    (haarFrameLaw n n le_rfl).map stiefelSquareToOrthogonal = orthogonalHaar n
proof:
:= by
  unfold haarFrameLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (continuous_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal n).measurable (by fun_prop)]
  have heq : stiefelSquareToOrthogonal ∘
      (fun O => O • coordinateStiefel n n le_rfl) = id := by
    funext O
    exact stiefelSquareToOrthogonal_smul_coordinate O
  rw [heq, Measure.map_id]

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQR_orthogonal
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQR_orthogonal (n : ℕ) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)).map
      (fun G => stiefelSquareToOrthogonal (canonicalQRFrame n n le_rfl G)) = orthogonalHaar n
proof:
:= by
  change (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)).map
    (stiefelSquareToOrthogonal ∘ canonicalQRFrame n n le_rfl) = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map (continuous_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal n).measurable
    (measurable_canonicalQRFrame n n le_rfl), gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQRFrame,
    haarFrameLaw_map_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal]

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQR_orthogonal_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQR_orthogonal_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {n : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) μ) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => stiefelSquareToOrthogonal (canonicalQRFrame n n le_rfl (X ω)))
      (orthogonalHaar n) μ
proof:
:=
  (⟨((continuous_stiefelSquareToOrthogonal n).measurable.comp
      (measurable_canonicalQRFrame n n le_rfl)).aemeasurable,
    gaussianMatrix_map_canonicalQR_orthogonal n⟩ :
    HasLaw (fun G => stiefelSquareToOrthogonal (canonicalQRFrame n n le_rfl G)) (orthogonalHaar n)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n))).comp hX

name: NLAlib.map_unitaryQRFrame_eq_unitaryHaarFrameLaw
statement:
theorem map_unitaryQRFrame_eq_unitaryHaarFrameLaw {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (ν : Measure (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ G ∂ν, LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 G))
    (hinv : ∀ O : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) 𝕜,
      HasLaw (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 => O.val*G) ν ν) :
    ν.map (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn) = unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n k hkn
proof:
:= by
  let η := ν.map (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn)
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure η :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (measurable_unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn).aemeasurable
  apply measure_eq_unitaryHaarFrameLaw_of_invariant 𝕜 hkn η
  intro O
  let T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) 𝕜 := fun G => O.val*G
  have hT : Measurable T := measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id
  have heq : (fun G => O • unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn G) =ᵐ[ν]
      (fun G => unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn (T G)) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with G hG
    exact (unitaryQRFrame_unitary_mul 𝕜 hkn O G hG).symm
  change η.map (fun Q => O • Q) = η
  dsimp only [η]
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (measurable_unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn)]
  change ν.map (fun G => O • unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn G) = _
  rw [Measure.map_congr heq]
  change ν.map ((unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn) ∘ T) = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n k hkn) hT,(hinv O).map_eq]

name: NLAlib.map_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq_map_topGram
statement:
theorem map_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq_map_topGram {n r ell : ℕ}
    (hrn : r ≤ n) (helln : ell ≤ n) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (μ : Measure (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜))
    (hlaw : HasLaw (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n r hrn) μ) :
    μ.map (fun G => unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 helln (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G)) =
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n ell helln).map (unitaryFrameTopGram 𝕜 U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitaryHaarFrameLaw_map_topGram_eq 𝕜 hrn helln U hU]
  rw [← hlaw.map_eq,Measure.map_map (by unfold unitaryFrameLeadingGram; fun_prop)
    (measurable_unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_isUnit_matrix
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_isUnit_matrix (r : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) 𝕜 | IsUnit M}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det,isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  exact (isClosed_eq continuous_id.matrix_det continuous_const).isOpen_compl.measurableSet

name: NLAlib.ae_isUnit_topGram_of_unitaryQR_law
statement:
theorem ae_isUnit_topGram_of_unitaryQR_law {n r ell : ℕ}
    (hrn : r ≤ n) (helln : ell ≤ n) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (μ : Measure (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜))
    (hlaw : HasLaw (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n r hrn) μ)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ G ∂μ, LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 G))
    (htop : ∀ᵐ G ∂μ, IsUnit (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ*
      ((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G))) :
    ∀ᵐ Q ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n ell helln, IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram 𝕜 U Q)
proof:
:= by
  let J := fun G => unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 helln (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G)
  have hL : Measurable (unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 (r := r) helln) := by
    unfold unitaryFrameLeadingGram
    fun_prop
  have hJ : Measurable J := by
    exact hL.comp (measurable_unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn)
  have hsrc : ∀ᵐ G ∂μ, IsUnit (J G) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull,htop] with G hG hY
    let E := (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).val
    let Q := (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G).val
    let R := unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hrn G
    have hYR : (Eᴴ*Q)*R=Eᴴ*G := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,unitaryQRFrame_mul_unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hrn G hG]
    exact (inv_gram_of_mul_right_eq (Eᴴ*Q) (Eᴴ*G) R
      (isUnit_unitaryQRUpper 𝕜 hrn G hG) hY hYR).2
  have hmap : ∀ᵐ M ∂μ.map J, IsUnit M :=
    (ae_map_iff hJ.aemeasurable (measurableSet_isUnit_matrix 𝕜 r)).mpr hsrc
  rw [map_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq_map_topGram 𝕜 hrn helln U hU μ hlaw] at hmap
  exact ae_of_ae_map (by unfold unitaryFrameTopGram; fun_prop) hmap

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_re_trace_inv_topGram_of_unitaryQR_law
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_re_trace_inv_topGram_of_unitaryQR_law
    {n r ell s : ℕ} (hrn : r ≤ n) (helln : ell ≤ n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin s) 𝕜)
    (hcomp : (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).val*
      (coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (μ : Measure (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) 𝕜))
    (hlaw : HasLaw (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n r hrn) μ)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ G ∂μ, LinearIndependent 𝕜 (unitaryQRColumnFamily 𝕜 G))
    (htop : ∀ᵐ G ∂μ, IsUnit (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ*
      ((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G))) (c : ℝ)
    (hcross : Integrable (fun G => frobSq ((Vᴴ*G)*
      (pinvR (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ))ᴴ)) μ ∧
      ∫ G, frobSq ((Vᴴ*G)*(pinvR (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ))ᴴ) ∂μ = c) :
    Integrable (fun Q => RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (unitaryFrameTopGram 𝕜 U Q)⁻¹))
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n ell helln) ∧
    ∫ Q, RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (unitaryFrameTopGram 𝕜 U Q)⁻¹)
      ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n ell helln = (r:ℝ)+c
proof:
:= by
  have := hlaw.isProbabilityMeasure
  let J := fun G => unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 helln (unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn G)
  let H := unitaryFrameTopGram 𝕜 U (ell := ell)
  let φ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) 𝕜 → ℝ := fun M => RCLike.re (Matrix.trace M⁻¹)
  have hL : Measurable (unitaryFrameLeadingGram 𝕜 (r := r) helln) := by
    unfold unitaryFrameLeadingGram
    fun_prop
  have hJ : Measurable J := hL.comp (measurable_unitaryQRFrame 𝕜 n r hrn)
  have hH : Measurable H := by unfold H unitaryFrameTopGram; fun_prop
  have hφ : Measurable φ :=
    (RCLike.continuous_re.comp continuous_id.matrix_trace).measurable.comp measurable_matrix_inv
  have hl : μ.map J = (unitaryHaarFrameLaw 𝕜 n ell helln).map H :=
    map_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq_map_topGram 𝕜 hrn helln U hU μ hlaw
  have he : (fun G => φ (J G)) =ᵐ[μ] fun G => (r:ℝ)+frobSq ((Vᴴ*G)*
      (pinvR (((coordinateUnitaryStiefel 𝕜 n ell helln).valᴴ*G)ᴴ))ᴴ) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull,htop] with G hG hY
    exact (re_trace_inv_leadingGram_unitaryQRFrame_eq 𝕜 hrn helln V hcomp G hG hY).1
  have hi : Integrable (fun G => φ (J G)) μ :=
    ((integrable_const (r:ℝ)).add hcross.1).congr he.symm
  have hmap := (integrable_map_measure hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hJ.aemeasurable).mpr hi
  rw [hl] at hmap
  refine ⟨(integrable_map_measure hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hH.aemeasurable).mp hmap,?_⟩
  rw [← integral_map hH.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable,← hl,
    integral_map hJ.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable,integral_congr_ae he,
    integral_add (integrable_const _) hcross.1,hcross.2,integral_const]
  simp

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_sampleCovariance
statement:
theorem posSemidef_sampleCovariance (X : ι → d → 𝕜) :
    (sampleCovariance X).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.smul _ (by positivity)
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (X k))

name: NLAlib.sampleCovariance_mulVec
statement:
theorem sampleCovariance_mulVec {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (S : Matrix m d 𝕜) (X : ι → d → 𝕜) :
    sampleCovariance (fun k => S *ᵥ X k) = S * sampleCovariance X * Sᴴ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sampleCovariance, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul, vecMulVec_mulVec_star_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.smul_le_sampleCovariance_iff_whitened
statement:
theorem smul_le_sampleCovariance_iff_whitened
    {K S : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hS : IsUnit S) (hwhite : S * K * Sᴴ = 1)
    (X : ι → d → 𝕜) (a : ℝ) :
    a • K ≤ sampleCovariance X ↔
      a • (1 : Matrix d d 𝕜) ≤ sampleCovariance (fun k => S *ᵥ X k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sampleCovariance_mulVec, Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.le_iff]
  have heq : S * (sampleCovariance X - a • K) * Sᴴ =
      S * sampleCovariance X * Sᴴ - a • (1 : Matrix d d 𝕜) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hwhite]
  rw [← heq]
  exact hS.posSemidef_star_right_conjugate_iff.symm

name: NLAlib.covarianceDefectTerm_le
statement:
theorem covarianceDefectTerm_le (N : ℕ) (x : d → ℝ) :
    covarianceDefectTerm N x ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.le_iff).mpr
  change ((N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) -
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (1 - vecMulVec x x)).PosSemidef
  rw [← smul_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
  exact (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star x).smul (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_covarianceDefectTerm
statement:
theorem isHermitian_covarianceDefectTerm (N : ℕ) (x : d → ℝ) :
    (covarianceDefectTerm N x).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  exact (isHermitian_one.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star x).isHermitian).smul
    (IsSelfAdjoint.all (N : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_covarianceDefectTerm
statement:
theorem memLp_two_covarianceDefectTerm [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 4 μ) (N : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω)) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  exact ((memLp_const (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)).sub
    (memLp_two_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_four hX)).const_smul ((N : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.integral_covarianceDefectTerm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_covarianceDefectTerm_eq_zero [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ)
    (hisotropic : (∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω) ∂μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun ω => covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω)) =
      fun ω => (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((1 : Matrix d d ℝ) - vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω)) from rfl,
    integral_smul, integral_sub (integrable_const _) (integrable_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_two hX)]
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, hisotropic, sub_self, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.sum_covarianceDefectTerm
statement:
theorem sum_covarianceDefectTerm {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (X : Fin N → d → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, covarianceDefectTerm N (X i)) = 1 - sampleCovariance X
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN.ne'
  simp only [covarianceDefectTerm, ← Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_sub,
    ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul,
    sampleCovariance, star_trivial]

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_complex_covarianceDefectTerm
statement:
theorem memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_complex_covarianceDefectTerm
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 4 μ) (N : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates
      (realMatrixComplexification (covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω)) : Matrix d d ℂ)) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  let L := (realMatrixComplexification (n := d) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  exact (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := d) (n := d)).toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp'
    (L.comp_memLp' (memLp_two_covarianceDefectTerm hX N))

name: NLAlib.integral_complex_covarianceDefectTerm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_complex_covarianceDefectTerm_eq_zero [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ)
    (hisotropic : (∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, (realMatrixComplexification (covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω)) : Matrix d d ℂ) ∂μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let L := (realMatrixComplexification (n := d) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω)) μ :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)).sub
      (integrable_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_two hX)).smul ((N : ℝ)⁻¹)
  change (∫ ω, L (covarianceDefectTerm N (X ω)) ∂μ) = 0
  rw [L.integral_comp_comm hi, integral_covarianceDefectTerm_eq_zero hX hisotropic, map_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_sq_integral_rankOneProbe_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_sq_integral_rankOneProbe_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {r p : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ)
    (hy : Measurable y) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hfour : ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 4) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 4 ∂μ) ≤ A * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2)
    (hhigh : ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * (2 * p - 2))) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * (2 * p - 2)) ∂μ) ≤
          B * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ (2 * p - 2))
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤
        (A * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) *
          (B * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * p - 2) / gaussianEvenMoment (2 * p - 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hrad := integrable_and_gaussianEvenMoment_mul_integral_dotProduct_self_pow_le
    hr (by omega) y hy hB hhigh
  let f : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1)
  let g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2
  have hfi : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) μ := by
    simpa only [f, ← pow_mul, show (p - 1) * 2 = 2 * p - 2 by omega] using hrad.1
  have hgi : Integrable (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) μ := by
    simpa only [g, ← pow_mul] using (hfour x).1
  have hf : MemLp f 2 μ := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (by dsimp [f]; fun_prop)).2 hfi
  have hg : MemLp g 2 μ := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (by dsimp [g]; fun_prop)).2 hgi
  have hprod := hf.integrable_mul hg
  refine ⟨hprod, ?_⟩
  have hcs := sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_integral_sq hprod hfi hgi
  have hfbound : (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      B * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * p - 2) / gaussianEvenMoment (2 * p - 2) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (gaussianEvenMoment_pos _)).2
    simpa only [f, ← pow_mul, show (p - 1) * 2 = 2 * p - 2 by omega, mul_comm]
      using hrad.2
  have hgbound : (∫ ω, g ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ A * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [g, ← pow_mul] using (hfour x).2
  apply hcs.trans
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact mul_le_mul hgbound hfbound (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rankOneProbe_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rankOneProbe_le_sqrt
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {r p : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ)
    (hy : Measurable y) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hfour : ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 4) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 4 ∂μ) ≤ A * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2)
    (hhigh : ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * (2 * p - 2))) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * (2 * p - 2)) ∂μ) ≤
          B * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ (2 * p - 2))
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
        Real.sqrt (A * (B * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * p - 2) /
          gaussianEvenMoment (2 * p - 2))) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integrable_and_sq_integral_rankOneProbe_le hr hp y hy hA hB hfour hhigh x
  refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
  have hD : 0 ≤ gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * p - 2) := by
    unfold gaussianRadialMoment
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => by positivity
  have hC : 0 ≤ A * (B * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * p - 2) /
      gaussianEvenMoment (2 * p - 2)) := by
    have hg := gaussianEvenMoment_pos (2 * p - 2)
    positivity
  have hx : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ x := dotProduct_self_nonneg x
  apply (sq_le_sq₀
    (integral_nonneg fun ω => mul_nonneg
      (pow_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg (y ω)) _) (sq_nonneg _))
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hx)).1
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hC]
  nlinarith [h.2]

name: NLAlib.factorial_mul_gaussianRadialMoment_div_gaussianEvenMoment_le_sq
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_gaussianRadialMoment_div_gaussianEvenMoment_le_sq
    {r k d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * ((2 * k).factorial : ℝ)) ^ d * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * k) /
        gaussianEvenMoment (2 * k) ≤
      (4 ^ d * 2 ^ (k * (d - 1)) * (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) *
        ((r : ℝ) + 4 * (k + 1)) ^ k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ := ((2 * k).factorial : ℝ)
  let G : ℝ := (k.factorial : ℝ)
  let S : ℝ := (r : ℝ) + 4 * (k + 1)
  have hF : 0 < F := by dsimp [F]; positivity
  have hG : 0 ≤ G := by dsimp [G]; positivity
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by dsimp [S]; positivity
  have hdup : F ≤ 4 ^ k * G ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [F, G]
    exact_mod_cast factorial_two_mul_le_four_pow_mul_factorial_sq k
  have hgauss := factorial_le_gaussianEvenMoment (2 * k)
  have hrad : gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * k) ≤ S ^ (2 * k) := by
    apply (gaussianRadialMoment_le_pow r (2 * k)).trans
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
    dsimp [S]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hfirst : (4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * F) ^ d / gaussianEvenMoment (2 * k) ≤
      (8 : ℝ) ^ d * F ^ (d - 1) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (gaussianEvenMoment_pos _)).2
    calc
      (4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * F) ^ d = (8 : ℝ) ^ d * F ^ (d - 1) * F := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
        norm_num only [show (4 : ℝ) * 2 = 8 by norm_num]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, show d - 1 + 1 = d by omega]
      _ ≤ (8 : ℝ) ^ d * F ^ (d - 1) * gaussianEvenMoment (2 * k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgauss (by positivity)
  have hpow : (8 : ℝ) ^ d * F ^ (d - 1) ≤
      ((4 : ℝ) ^ d) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * G ^ 2) ^ (d - 1) := by
    apply mul_le_mul
    · rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm d 2, pow_mul]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) d
    · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hF.le hdup _
    · positivity
    · positivity
  calc
    (4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * ((2 * k).factorial : ℝ)) ^ d * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * k) /
        gaussianEvenMoment (2 * k) =
      ((4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * F) ^ d / gaussianEvenMoment (2 * k)) *
        gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * k) := by ring
    _ ≤ ((4 : ℝ) ^ d) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * G ^ 2) ^ (d - 1) * S ^ (2 * k) := by
      apply mul_le_mul (hfirst.trans hpow) hrad
      · unfold gaussianRadialMoment
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => by positivity
      · positivity
    _ = _ := by
      change _ = ((4 : ℝ) ^ d * 2 ^ (k * (d - 1)) * G ^ (d - 1) * S ^ k) ^ 2
      have h4 : ((4 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (d - 1) = (2 ^ (k * (d - 1)) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
      have hGpow : (G ^ 2) ^ (d - 1) = (G ^ (d - 1)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        omega
      have hSpow : S ^ (2 * k) = (S ^ k) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [mul_pow, h4, hGpow, hSpow]
      ring

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoMomentRadius_mono

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoVarianceBudget_pos
statement:
theorem khatriRaoVarianceBudget_pos {d r : ℕ} {K : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hK : 0 < K) :
    0 < khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r

name: NLAlib.two_le_khatriRaoVarianceBudget
statement:
theorem two_le_khatriRaoVarianceBudget {d r : ℕ} {K : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    2 ≤ khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r
proof:
:= by
  unfold khatriRaoVarianceBudget
  have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hkp : 1 ≤ K ^ (4 * d) := one_le_pow₀ hK
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * d + 4) := by
    simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (show 1 ≤ 3 * d + 4 by omega)
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * d + 4) := htwo
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * d + 4) * K ^ (4 * d) := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hkp
    _ ≤ _ := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hrR

name: NLAlib.one_le_khatriRaoMomentRadius
statement:
theorem one_le_khatriRaoMomentRadius {d r p : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hK : 1 ≤ K) : 1 ≤ khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r p
proof:
:= by
  unfold khatriRaoMomentRadius
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have htwo : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (d - 1) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hkp : 1 ≤ K ^ (2 * d) := one_le_pow₀ hK
  have hpp : 1 ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) := one_le_pow₀ hpR
  have hlast : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r + 4 * p := by
    have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r := by positivity
    linarith
  exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
    (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le htwo hkp) hpp) hlast

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rankOneProbe_le_factorial
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rankOneProbe_le_factorial
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {r p d : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hdir : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * n)) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * n) ∂μ) ≤
          (2 * (n.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * n)) ^ d * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ n)
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
        ((p.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r *
          khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r p ^ (p - 2) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  let L := 2 * p - 2
  let P : ℝ := 4 ^ d * 2 ^ ((p - 1) * (d - 1)) *
    ((p - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * p) ^ (p - 1)
  have hLp : L + 2 = 2 * p := by dsimp [L]; omega
  have hfour (a : Fin r → ℝ) := hdir 2 (by omega) a
  norm_num only [Nat.factorial, Nat.reduceMul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hfour
  have h := integrable_and_sq_integral_rankOneProbe_le hr hp y hy
    (show 0 ≤ (4 * K ^ 4) ^ d by positivity)
    (show 0 ≤ (2 * (L.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * L)) ^ d by positivity)
    hfour (hdir L (by dsimp [L]; omega)) x
  have hco : (4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * (L.factorial : ℝ)) ^ d *
      gaussianRadialMoment r L / gaussianEvenMoment L ≤ P ^ 2 := by
    have h0 := factorial_mul_gaussianRadialMoment_div_gaussianEvenMoment_le_sq
      (r := r) (k := p - 1) (d := d) (by omega)
    have hpcast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = p := by exact_mod_cast (show p - 1 + 1 = p by omega)
    simpa only [P, show 2 * (p - 1) = L by omega,
      hpcast] using h0
  have hKP : K ^ (4 * d) * K ^ ((2 * L) * d) = (K ^ (2 * d * p)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    nlinarith
  have he :
      ((4 * K ^ 4) ^ d * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) *
          ((2 * (L.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * L)) ^ d *
            gaussianRadialMoment r L / gaussianEvenMoment L) =
        (K ^ (2 * d * p)) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 *
          ((4 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 * (L.factorial : ℝ)) ^ d *
            gaussianRadialMoment r L / gaussianEvenMoment L) := by
    simp only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
    have heK : 4 * d + 2 * L * d = 2 * d * p * 2 := by nlinarith
    rw [show K ^ (2 * d * p * 2) = K ^ (4 * d) * K ^ (2 * L * d) by
      rw [← pow_add, heK]]
    ring
  have hraw : (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      K ^ (2 * d * p) * P * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    have hx := dotProduct_self_nonneg x
    apply (sq_le_sq₀
      (integral_nonneg fun ω => mul_nonneg
        (pow_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg (y ω)) _) (sq_nonneg _))
      (by dsimp [P]; positivity)).1
    calc
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ _ := h.2
      _ = _ := he
      _ ≤ (K ^ (2 * d * p)) ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 * P ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hco (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hN : 2 * P ≤ (p.factorial : ℝ) * 2 ^ (3 * d + 4) * r *
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * (p : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * p)) ^ (p - 2) := by
    dsimp [P]
    have h0 :
        2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ d * 2 ^ ((p - 1) * (d - 1)) *
          ((p - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * p) ^ (p - 1) ≤
        (p.factorial : ℝ) * 2 ^ (3 * d + 4) * r *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * (p : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * p)) ^ (p - 2) := by
      exact_mod_cast factorial_radial_coefficient_le hr hp hd
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h0
  have hKsplit : K ^ (2 * d * p) = K ^ (4 * d) * (K ^ (2 * d)) ^ (p - 2) := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    have hp' : p - 2 + 2 = p := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN (pow_nonneg hK (2 * d * p))
  have hfinal : K ^ (2 * d * p) * P ≤
      ((p.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r *
        khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r p ^ (p - 2) := by
    have heq : K ^ (2 * d * p) * ((p.factorial : ℝ) * 2 ^ (3 * d + 4) * r *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * (p : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * p)) ^ (p - 2)) =
      2 * (((p.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r *
        khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r p ^ (p - 2)) := by
      rw [hKsplit]
      simp only [khatriRaoVarianceBudget, khatriRaoMomentRadius, mul_pow]
      ring
    rw [heq] at hscale
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨h.1, hraw.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfinal (dotProduct_self_nonneg x))⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_two

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_four

    MemLp (fun ω => vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω)) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  have : ENNReal.HolderTriple 4 4 2 := ⟨by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (by finiteness) (by finiteness)).mp
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (by finiteness) (by finiteness)]
    norm_num⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_vecMulVec_mulVec_eq_congruence
statement:
theorem integral_vecMulVec_mulVec_eq_congruence {X : Ω → d → ℝ}
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (S : Matrix d d ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, vecMulVec (S *ᵥ X ω) (S *ᵥ X ω) ∂μ) =
      S * (∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) * Sᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let L := ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ (Matrix d d ℝ) S Sᵀ
  have h := L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_two hX)
  have hp (ω : Ω) : vecMulVec (S *ᵥ X ω) (S *ᵥ X ω) =
      S * vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) * Sᵀ := by
    simpa only [star_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec_star_mulVec S (X ω)
  simpa only [L, ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight_apply, ← hp] using h

name: NLAlib.exists_isUnit_whitening_second_moment
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_whitening_second_moment {X : Ω → d → ℝ}
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (K : Matrix d d ℝ) (hK : K.PosDef)
    (hsecond : (∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) = K) :
    ∃ S : Matrix d d ℝ, IsUnit S ∧ S * K * Sᵀ = 1 ∧
      (∫ ω, vecMulVec (S *ᵥ X ω) (S *ᵥ X ω) ∂μ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hwhite⟩ := hK.exists_isUnit_whitening
  change S * K * Sᵀ = 1 at hwhite
  refine ⟨S, hS, hwhite, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_vecMulVec_mulVec_eq_congruence hX S, hsecond, hwhite]

name: NLAlib.integral_dotProduct_sq_eq_quadForm_second_moment
statement:

name: NLAlib.variance_sq_dotProduct_le_of_isotropic
statement:

    ha, one_pow, mul_one] using hfourth a

name: NLAlib.measureReal_gt_le_of_fourthMoment_sample_size
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_le_of_fourthMoment_sample_size [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {L : Ω → ℝ} {v D n ε δ φ V : ℝ}
    (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hsize : 26 * v * max D (Real.log (D / δ)) / ε ^ 2 ≤ n)
    (hφ : φ ≤ Real.sqrt (12 * v * D / n))
    (hV : V ≤ (v + Real.sqrt (12 * v * D / n) / 3) / n)
    (htail : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      μ.real {ω | φ + Real.sqrt (2 * V * s) + (n⁻¹ / 3) * s < L ω} ≤
        D * Real.exp (-s)) :
    μ.real {ω | ε < L ω} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let s := Real.log (D / δ)
  have hD0 : 0 < D := by linarith
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Real.log_nonneg (by apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr; linarith)
  have hthreshold : φ + Real.sqrt (2 * V * s) + (n⁻¹ / 3) * s ≤ ε := by
    have hroot : Real.sqrt (2 * V * s) ≤
        Real.sqrt (2 * s * (v + Real.sqrt (12 * v * D / n) / 3) / n) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      calc
        2 * V * s = (2 * s) * V := by ring
        _ ≤ (2 * s) * ((v + Real.sqrt (12 * v * D / n) / 3) / n) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hc : (n⁻¹ / 3) * s = s / (3 * n) := by ring
    rw [hc]
    have hsize' := sqrt_add_sqrt_add_div_le_of_sample_size hv (show 0 ≤ D by linarith)
      hs hn hε hε1 hsize
    linarith
  have hprob := (measureReal_mono (fun ω hω => lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold hω)).trans (htail s hs)
  have he : D * Real.exp (-s) = δ := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (div_pos hD0 hδ)]
    field_simp
  exact hprob.trans_eq he

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_smul_one_le_sampleCovariance_pi_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_smul_one_le_sampleCovariance_pi_le
    (μ : Measure (d → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d)
    (hμ : MemLp (id : (d → ℝ) → d → ℝ) 4 μ)
    (hisotropic : (∫ x, vecMulVec x x ∂μ) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ))
    {β ε δ : ℝ} (hβ : 1 ≤ β)
    (hfourth : ∀ a : d → ℝ,
      Var[fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2; μ] ≤ β ^ 2 * (∫ x, (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {N : ℕ}
    (hsize : 26 * β ^ 2 * max (Fintype.card d : ℝ)
      (Real.log ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) / δ)) / ε ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ)) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)).real
      {x | ¬ ((1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) ≤ sampleCovariance x)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0 < Fintype.card d := by omega
  let : Nonempty d := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hdpos
  have hNreal : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by
    have hdreal : 0 < (Fintype.card d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdpos
    have hmax : 0 < max (Fintype.card d : ℝ) (Real.log ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) / δ)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hdreal (le_max_left _ _)
    have hp : 0 < 26 * β ^ 2 * max (Fintype.card d : ℝ)
        (Real.log ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) / δ)) / ε ^ 2 := by positivity
    exact hp.trans_le hsize
  have hN : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast hNreal
  let : NeZero N := ⟨hN.ne'⟩
  let P := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)
  let Y : (Fin N → d → ℝ) → Matrix d d ℝ := fun x => 1 - sampleCovariance x
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγmean, hγHerm, hγcov, htail⟩ :=
    exists_gaussian_covarianceDefect_pi μ hμ hisotropic hN
  let : IsGaussian γ := hγ
  let c : NNReal := ⟨β ^ 2 / (N : ℝ), by positivity⟩
  have hc : (c : ℝ) = β ^ 2 / (N : ℝ) := rfl
  have hY2 : MemLp Y 2 P :=
    (memLp_const (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)).sub (memLp_two_sampleCovariance_pi hμ)
  have hYmean : (∫ x, Y x ∂P) = 0 := integral_one_sub_sampleCovariance_pi_eq_zero hμ hisotropic
  have hYvar (u : d → ℝ) : Var[fun x => quadForm (Y x) u; P] ≤
      (c : ℝ) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 4 := by
    rw [hc]
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, id_eq, Y, P] using
      variance_quadForm_one_sub_sampleCovariance_pi_le (ι := Fin N) hμ hisotropic hfourth u
  have hstats := quadraticWeakVariance_le_and_integral_lambdaMax_le_of_covariance_eq_real
    P Y hY2 hYmean γ hγHerm hγmean hγcov c hd hYvar
  have hφ : (∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ) ≤ Real.sqrt (12 * β ^ 2 * Fintype.card d / (N : ℝ)) := by
    have he : 12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card d = 12 * β ^ 2 * Fintype.card d / (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [hc]
      ring
    simpa only [he] using hstats.2
  have hV : gaussianProxyVariance γ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      (β ^ 2 + Real.sqrt (12 * β ^ 2 * Fintype.card d / (N : ℝ)) / 3) / (N : ℝ) := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hφ (show 0 ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ by positivity)
    have h2 := hstats.1
    change quadraticWeakVariance γ ≤ β ^ 2 / (N : ℝ) at h2
    dsimp [gaussianProxyVariance]
    calc
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ) / 3 + quadraticWeakVariance γ ≤
          (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (12 * β ^ 2 * Fintype.card d / (N : ℝ)) / 3 +
            β ^ 2 / (N : ℝ) := by linarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hprob := measureReal_gt_le_of_fourthMoment_sample_size
    (μ := P) (L := fun x => lambdaMax (realMatrixComplexification (Y x) : Matrix d d ℂ))
    (show 1 ≤ β ^ 2 by nlinarith)
    (show 1 ≤ (Fintype.card d : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ Fintype.card d by omega))
    hNreal hε hε1.le hδ hδ1 hsize hφ hV htail
  apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans hprob
  intro x hx
  exact lt_lambdaMax_complexification_one_sub_of_not_smul_one_le
    (posSemidef_sampleCovariance x).isHermitian hx

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_smul_le_sampleCovariance_pi_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_smul_le_sampleCovariance_pi_le
    (μ : Measure (d → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d)
    (hμ : MemLp (id : (d → ℝ) → d → ℝ) 4 μ)
    (K : Matrix d d ℝ) (hK : K.PosDef)
    (hsecond : (∫ x, vecMulVec x x ∂μ) = K)
    {β ε δ : ℝ} (hβ : 1 ≤ β)
    (hfourth : ∀ a : d → ℝ,
      Var[fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2; μ] ≤ β ^ 2 * (∫ x, (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {N : ℕ}
    (hsize : 26 * β ^ 2 * max (Fintype.card d : ℝ)
      (Real.log ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) / δ)) / ε ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ)) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)).real
      {x | ¬ ((1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance x)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hwhite, hSiso⟩ := exists_isUnit_whitening_second_moment
    (hμ.mono_exponent (by norm_num)) K hK hsecond
  let L := (Matrix.mulVecLin S).toContinuousLinearMap
  let ν := μ.map L
  have hL : HasLaw L ν μ := ⟨L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := μ.isProbabilityMeasure_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hν4 : MemLp (id : (d → ℝ) → d → ℝ) 4 ν := by
    apply (memLp_map_measure_iff aestronglyMeasurable_id L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact L.comp_memLp' hμ
  have hνiso : (∫ x, vecMulVec x x ∂ν) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) := by
    have he := hL.integral_comp (f := fun x => vecMulVec x x) (by fun_prop)
    exact he.symm.trans hSiso
  have hνfourth (a : d → ℝ) :
      Var[fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2; ν] ≤ β ^ 2 * (∫ x, (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2 ∂ν) ^ 2 := by
    have hv := hL.covariance_fun_comp
      (f := fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2) (g := fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    rw [covariance_self (by fun_prop), covariance_self (by fun_prop)] at hv
    have hm := hL.integral_comp (f := fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)
    rw [← hv, ← hm]
    exact variance_sq_dotProduct_mulVec_le hfourth S a
  have hb := measureReal_not_smul_one_le_sampleCovariance_pi_le
    ν hd hν4 hνiso hβ hνfourth hε hε1 hδ hδ1 hsize
  let P := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)
  have hmaps (i : Fin N) : HasLaw (fun x : Fin N → d → ℝ => L (x i)) ν P :=
    hL.fun_comp (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => μ) i).hasLaw
  have hpi : HasLaw (fun x : Fin N → d → ℝ => fun i => L (x i))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) P :=
    (iIndepFun_pi (fun _ : Fin N => L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)).hasLaw_pi hmaps
  have hcont : Continuous (sampleCovariance : (Fin N → d → ℝ) → Matrix d d ℝ) := by
    change Continuous (fun x : Fin N → d → ℝ =>
      (Fintype.card (Fin N) : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, vecMulVec (x i) (star (x i)))
    fun_prop
  have hset : MeasurableSet {x : Fin N → d → ℝ |
      ¬ ((1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) ≤ sampleCovariance x)} :=
    ((isClosed_setOf_le_realMatrix ((1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ))).preimage hcont).measurableSet.compl
  have he := hpi.measureReal_eq hset
  have hsets : {x : Fin N → d → ℝ | ¬ ((1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance x)} =
      {x : Fin N → d → ℝ |
        ¬ ((1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) ≤ sampleCovariance (fun i => L (x i)))} := by
    ext x
    exact not_congr (smul_le_sampleCovariance_iff_whitened hS hwhite x (1 - ε))
  change P.real _ ≤ δ
  rw [hsets, he]
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_smul_le_sampleCovariance_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_smul_le_sampleCovariance_le_of_hasLaw
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Ω → d → ℝ)
    (μ : Measure (d → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) μ P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d)
    (hμ : MemLp (id : (d → ℝ) → d → ℝ) 4 μ)
    (K : Matrix d d ℝ) (hK : K.PosDef)
    (hsecond : (∫ x, vecMulVec x x ∂μ) = K)
    {β ε δ : ℝ} (hβ : 1 ≤ β)
    (hfourth : ∀ a : d → ℝ,
      Var[fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2; μ] ≤ β ^ 2 * (∫ x, (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hsize : 26 * β ^ 2 * max (Fintype.card d : ℝ)
      (Real.log ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) / δ)) / ε ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ)) :
    P.real {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance (fun i => W i ω))} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by

  have hset : MeasurableSet {x : Fin N → d → ℝ | ¬ ((1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance x)} :=
    ((isClosed_setOf_le_realMatrix ((1 - ε) • K)).preimage hcont).measurableSet.compl
  rw [hpi.measureReal_eq hset]

    μ hd hμ K hK hsecond hβ hfourth hε hε1 hδ hδ1 hsize

name: NLAlib.sqrt_add_sqrt_add_div_le_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem sqrt_add_sqrt_add_div_le_of_sample_size
    {v d s n ε : ℝ} (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 26 * v * max d s / ε ^ 2 ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt (12 * v * d / n) +
      Real.sqrt (2 * s * (v + Real.sqrt (12 * v * d / n) / 3) / n) +
      s / (3 * n) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by linarith
  have hsample : 26 * v * max d s ≤ n * ε ^ 2 :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hε)).mp hsize
  have hsampled : 26 * v * d ≤ n * ε ^ 2 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left d s) (by positivity)).trans hsample
  have hsamples : 26 * v * s ≤ n * ε ^ 2 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right d s) (by positivity)).trans hsample
  let a := Real.sqrt (12 * v * d / n)
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 = 12 * v * d / n := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have ha : a ≤ 53 * ε / 78 := by
    have hb : 12 * v * d / n ≤ (53 * ε / 78) ^ 2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have ha1 : a ≤ 53 / 78 := by nlinarith
  have hab : v + a / 3 ≤ (287 / 234) * v := by nlinarith
  have hsab := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (show 0 ≤ 2 * s by positivity)
  have hbrad : 2 * s * (v + a / 3) / n ≤ (24 * ε / 78) ^ 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hb : Real.sqrt (2 * s * (v + a / 3) / n) ≤ 24 * ε / 78 := by
    have hbsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * s * (v + a / 3) / n by positivity)
    have hb0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * s * (v + a / 3) / n)
    nlinarith
  have hc : s / (3 * n) ≤ ε / 78 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 3 * n by positivity)).mpr
    have hvs : s ≤ v * s := by nlinarith
    have heps : ε ^ 2 ≤ ε := by nlinarith
    have hneps := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heps hn.le
    nlinarith
  change a + Real.sqrt (2 * s * (v + a / 3) / n) + s / (3 * n) ≤ ε
  linarith

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sampleCovariance
statement:
theorem quadForm_sampleCovariance (X : ι → d → ℝ) (u : d → ℝ) :
    quadForm (sampleCovariance X) u =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (X i ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change quadFormLinearMap u ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, vecMulVec (X i) (star (X i))) = _
  rw [map_smul, map_sum]
  change (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, quadForm (vecMulVec (X i) (X i)) u = _
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, op_smul_eq_mul]
  rw [dotProduct_comm u (X i)]
  ring

      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) = ∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ
proof:

    integral_inv_card_smul_sum_pi (ι := ι) μ (integrable_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_two hX)

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_sq_dotProduct_of_memLp_four
proof:
:= by
  have h := (quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).comp_memLp'
    (memLp_two_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_four hX)
  change MemLp (fun ω => quadForm (vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω)) u) 2 μ at h
  have hp (ω : Ω) : quadForm (vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω)) u = (X ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, op_smul_eq_mul]
    rw [dotProduct_comm u (X ω)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_sampleCovariance_pi
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_sampleCovariance_pi [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 4 μ) (u : d → ℝ) :
    Var[fun ω : ι → Ω => quadForm (sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))) u;
      Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)] =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * Var[fun ω => (X ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2; μ]
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.one_sub_le_measureReal_smul_le_sampleCovariance_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem one_sub_le_measureReal_smul_le_sampleCovariance_of_hasLaw
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Ω → d → ℝ)
    (μ : Measure (d → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) μ P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d)
    (hμ : MemLp (id : (d → ℝ) → d → ℝ) 4 μ)
    (K : Matrix d d ℝ) (hK : K.PosDef)
    (hsecond : (∫ x, vecMulVec x x ∂μ) = K)
    {β ε δ : ℝ} (hβ : 1 ≤ β)
    (hfourth : ∀ a : d → ℝ,
      Var[fun x => (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2; μ] ≤ β ^ 2 * (∫ x, (x ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hsize : 26 * β ^ 2 * max (Fintype.card d : ℝ)
      (Real.log ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) / δ)) / ε ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ)) :
    1 - δ ≤ P.real {ω | (1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance (fun i => W i ω)}
proof:
:= by
  have hfailure := measureReal_not_smul_le_sampleCovariance_le_of_hasLaw
    W μ hW hind hd hμ K hK hsecond hβ hfourth hε hε1 hδ hδ1 hsize
  have hpi := hind.hasLaw_pi hW
  have hcont : Continuous (sampleCovariance : (Fin N → d → ℝ) → Matrix d d ℝ) := by
    change Continuous (fun x : Fin N → d → ℝ =>
      (Fintype.card (Fin N) : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, vecMulVec (x i) (star (x i)))
    fun_prop
  have hset : MeasurableSet {x : Fin N → d → ℝ |
      (1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance x} :=
    ((isClosed_setOf_le_realMatrix ((1 - ε) • K)).preimage hcont).measurableSet
  have hnull : NullMeasurableSet
      {ω | (1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance (fun i => W i ω)} P :=
    hpi.aemeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_preimage hset
  have he : P.real {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance (fun i => W i ω))} =
      1 - P.real {ω | (1 - ε) • K ≤ sampleCovariance (fun i => W i ω)} :=
    probReal_compl_eq_one_sub₀ hnull
  rw [he] at hfailure
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_gaussian_covarianceDefect_pi
statement:
theorem exists_gaussian_covarianceDefect_pi
    (μ : Measure (d → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : MemLp (id : (d → ℝ) → d → ℝ) 4 μ)
    (hisotropic : (∫ x, vecMulVec x x ∂μ) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ))
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ γ : Measure M, IsGaussian γ ∧ (∫ Z, Z ∂γ) = 0 ∧
      (∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) ∧
      (∀ a b, cov[fun x : Fin N → d → ℝ => matrixRealCoordinates
        (realMatrixComplexification (1 - sampleCovariance x) : M) a,
        fun x => matrixRealCoordinates (realMatrixComplexification (1 - sampleCovariance x) : M) b;
        Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)] =
          cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ]) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)).real
        {x | (∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ) +
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * s) + ((N : ℝ)⁻¹ / 3) * s <
          lambdaMax (realMatrixComplexification (1 - sampleCovariance x) : M)} ≤
            (Fintype.card d : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  let F : (d → ℝ) → M := fun x => realMatrixComplexification (covarianceDefectTerm N x)
  have hF : Measurable F := by
    dsimp [F, covarianceDefectTerm]
    fun_prop
  let ν : Fin N → Measure M := fun _ => μ.map F
  let P := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => μ)
  let W : Fin N → (Fin N → d → ℝ) → M := fun i x => F (x i)
  have hW (i : Fin N) : HasLaw (W i) (ν i) P := by
    exact (show HasLaw F (μ.map F) μ from ⟨hF.aemeasurable, rfl⟩).fun_comp
      (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => μ) i).hasLaw
  have hind : iIndepFun W P := iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => hF.aemeasurable)
  have hν2 (i : Fin N) : MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → ((d × d) ⊕ (d × d) → ℝ)) 2 (ν i) := by
    apply (memLp_map_measure_iff continuous_matrixRealCoordinates.aestronglyMeasurable hF.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_complex_covarianceDefectTerm hμ N
  have hνmean (i : Fin N) : (∫ Z, Z ∂ν i) = 0 := by
    have he := (show HasLaw F (ν i) μ from ⟨hF.aemeasurable, rfl⟩).integral_eq
    exact he.symm.trans (integral_complex_covarianceDefectTerm_eq_zero
      (hμ.mono_exponent (by norm_num)) hisotropic N)
  have hνHerm (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ Z ∂ν i, Z.IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff hF.aemeasurable
      (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : M => Aᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet).mpr
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      (isHermitian_covarianceDefectTerm N x).map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (fun r => by simp)
  have hνbound (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ Z ∂ν i, Z ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (1 : M) := by
    apply (ae_map_iff hF.aemeasurable
      (isClosed_le continuous_id continuous_const).measurableSet).mpr
    filter_upwards [] with x
    have he : (realMatrixComplexification (covarianceDefectTerm N x) : M) ≤
        realMatrixComplexification ((N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)) :=
      (realMatrixComplexification_le_iff _ _).mpr (covarianceDefectTerm_le N x)
    simpa only [map_smul, map_one, F, id_eq] using he
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγmean, hγHerm, hγcov, htail⟩ :=
    exists_isGaussian_integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_of_hasLaw
      W ν hW hind hν2 hνmean hνHerm (show 0 ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ by positivity) hνbound
  have hsum (x : Fin N → d → ℝ) :
      (∑ i, W i x) = (realMatrixComplexification (1 - sampleCovariance x) : M) := by
    change (∑ i, realMatrixComplexification (covarianceDefectTerm N (x i))) = _
    rw [← map_sum, sum_covarianceDefectTerm hN]
  refine ⟨γ, hγ, hγmean, hγHerm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hsum] using hγcov
  · simpa only [zero_add, add_zero, hsum] using (htail 0 isHermitian_zero).2.1

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_sampleCovariance_pi
statement:
theorem memLp_two_sampleCovariance_pi {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 4 μ) :
    MemLp (fun ω : ι → Ω => sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))) 2
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.memLp_iff_entries.mpr
  intro a b
  have hi (i : ι) : MemLp (fun ω : ι → Ω => (X (ω i) a) * (X (ω i) b)) 2
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) :=
    ((Matrix.memLp_iff_entries.mp (memLp_two_vecMulVec_self_of_memLp_four hX)) a b).comp_measurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : ι => μ) i)
  have hh := (memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i)).const_smul ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have he : ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ •
      fun ω : ι → Ω => ∑ i, X (ω i) a * X (ω i) b) =
      fun ω => sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i)) a b := by
    funext ω
    simp only [sampleCovariance, star_trivial, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [he] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.integral_one_sub_sampleCovariance_pi_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_one_sub_sampleCovariance_pi_eq_zero [Nonempty ι]
    {X : Ω → d → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 4 μ)
    (hisotropic : (∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ)) :
    (∫ ω : ι → Ω, 1 - sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) ((memLp_two_sampleCovariance_pi hX).integrable (by norm_num)),
    integral_sampleCovariance_pi (hX.mono_exponent (by norm_num)), hisotropic]
  simp

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_one_sub_sampleCovariance_pi_le
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_one_sub_sampleCovariance_pi_le
    {X : Ω → d → ℝ} {β : ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 4 μ)
    (hisotropic : (∫ ω, vecMulVec (X ω) (X ω) ∂μ) = (1 : Matrix d d ℝ))
    (hfourth : ∀ a : d → ℝ,
      Var[fun ω => (X ω ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2; μ] ≤
        β ^ 2 * (∫ ω, (X ω ⬝ᵥ a) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ 2)
    (u : d → ℝ) :
    Var[fun ω : ι → Ω => quadForm (1 - sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))) u;
      Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)] ≤
      (β ^ 2 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hq : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun ω : ι → Ω => quadForm (sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))) u)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) :=
    ((quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).comp_memLp' (memLp_two_sampleCovariance_pi hX)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have he : (fun ω : ι → Ω => quadForm (1 - sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))) u) =
      fun ω => quadForm (1 : Matrix d d ℝ) u - quadForm (sampleCovariance (fun i => X (ω i))) u := by
    funext ω
    exact (quadFormLinearMap u).map_sub _ _
  rw [he, variance_const_sub hq, variance_quadForm_sampleCovariance_pi hX]
  have hbound := hfourth u
  rw [integral_dotProduct_sq_eq_norm_sq_of_isotropic (hX.mono_exponent (by norm_num)) hisotropic] at hbound
  calc
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * Var[fun ω => (X ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2; μ] ≤
        (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * (β ^ 2 * (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.measure_lt_specNorm_gram_sub_card_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
statement:
theorem measure_lt_specNorm_gram_sub_card_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty m]
    (A : m → Ω → n → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hind : iIndepFun A μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i u, u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 → HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => A i ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (hiso : ∀ i u, u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 → ∫ ω, (A i ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    μ {ω | v < specNorm ((Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω))ᵀ *
        Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω) - (Fintype.card m : ℝ) • 1)} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (9 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card n *
        Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hNunit, hNcard, hNnet⟩ :=
    exists_finset_sphere_net n (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 by norm_num)
  norm_num only [show (1 + 2 / (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = 9 by norm_num] at hNcard
  let H : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ := fun ω =>
    (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω))ᵀ * Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω) -
      (Fintype.card m : ℝ) • 1
  have hsym : ∀ ω, (H ω).IsSymm := by
    intro ω
    simp only [H, Matrix.IsSymm, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.transpose_one]
  have hquad : ∀ ω x, quadForm (H ω) x =
      ∑ i, (A i ω ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 - (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    intro ω x
    change x ⬝ᵥ ((H ω) *ᵥ x) = _
    dsimp only [H]
    have hM := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) x
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hM
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← hM]
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply, pow_two]
  have hsub : {ω | v < specNorm (H ω)} ⊆
      ⋃ x ∈ N, {ω | v / 2 < |quadForm (H ω) x|} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_exists, not_lt] at hnot
    have hunit : ∀ x ∈ N, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1 := fun x hx => by
      rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, hNunit x hx, Real.sqrt_one]
    have hnet : ∀ y : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 →
        ∃ x ∈ N, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y)‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hy, one_pow]
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hNnet y hy'
      refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
      nlinarith [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self (x - y)]
    have h := specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm (hsym ω) N
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by positivity) hunit hnet hnot
    have heq : (v / 2) / (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = v := by ring
    rw [heq] at h
    exact (not_lt_of_ge h) hω
  have hterm : ∀ x ∈ N, μ {ω | v / 2 < |quadForm (H ω) x|} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2))) := by
    intro x hx
    let Y : m → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => A i ω ⬝ᵥ x
    have hYind : iIndepFun Y μ := by
      simpa only [Y, Function.comp_def] using
        hind.comp (fun (_ : m) (u : n → ℝ) => u ⬝ᵥ x)
          (fun _ => by simp only [dotProduct]; fun_prop)
    have hYmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (Y i) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ := by
      intro i
      exact hmgf i x (hNunit x hx)
    have hYsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Y i ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1 := by
      intro i
      exact hiso i x (hNunit x hx)
    have h := measureReal_le_abs_sum_sq_sub_card_of_hasSubgaussianMGF Y K hK hYind
      hYmgf hYsq (show 0 ≤ v / 2 by positivity)
    calc μ {ω | v / 2 < |quadForm (H ω) x|}
        ≤ μ {ω | v / 2 ≤ |∑ i, Y i ω ^ 2 - (Fintype.card m : ℝ)|} := by
          apply measure_mono
          intro ω hω
          change v / 2 < |quadForm (H ω) x| at hω
          simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hquad, hNunit x hx, mul_one, Y] using hω.le
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((μ {ω | v / 2 ≤ |∑ i, Y i ω ^ 2 -
          (Fintype.card m : ℝ)|}).toReal) :=
          (ofReal_measureReal (measure_ne_top _ _)).symm
      _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h
  calc μ {ω | v < specNorm (H ω)}
      ≤ μ (⋃ x ∈ N, {ω | v / 2 < |quadForm (H ω) x|}) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ N, μ {ω | v / 2 < |quadForm (H ω) x|} := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ N, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2))) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((N.card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
          min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2)))) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg N.card), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by
      calc _ ≤ (9 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card n * (2 * Real.exp _) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNcard (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring)

name: NLAlib.measure_extreme_singular_failure_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
statement:
theorem measure_extreme_singular_failure_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : m → Ω → n → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hind : iIndepFun A μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i u, u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 → HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => A i ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (hiso : ∀ i u, u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 → ∫ ω, (A i ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ {ω | singularValues (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) (Fintype.card n - 1) <
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) -
          (32 * Real.exp 1 * K ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log 9) *
            Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + t) ∨
      Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) +
        (32 * Real.exp 1 * K ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log 9) *
          Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + t) <
        specNorm (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω))} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card m := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log 9 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  let D := 32 * Real.exp 1 * K ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log 9) *
    Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + t
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  let v := max (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * D) (D ^ 2)
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := (sq_nonneg D).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN
  have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hN.le
  have hfirst : D ^ 2 / (4 * K ^ 4) ≤
      (v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have hvl : Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * D ≤ v := le_max_left _ _
    have hv2 : (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * D ^ 2 ≤ v ^ 2 := by
      have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hs.le hD) hvl 2
      rwa [mul_pow, hs2] at h
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg K) (sq_nonneg K),
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ K ^ 4 by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr hv2)]
  have hsecond : D ^ 2 / (4 * K ^ 4) ≤ (v / 2) / K ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have hvr : D ^ 2 ≤ v := le_max_right _ _
    have hK2 : 1 ≤ K ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hp : K ^ 2 ≤ 2 * K ^ 4 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (K ^ 2)]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (sq_nonneg D)
    have hmulv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hvr (show 0 ≤ 2 * K ^ 4 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hmin : D ^ 2 / (4 * K ^ 4) ≤
      min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2) :=
    le_min hfirst hsecond
  have hbase : 2 * (9 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card n *
      Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2)) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4)) := by
    have hn2 := Real.sq_sqrt hn
    have hl2 := Real.sq_sqrt hlog
    have hD2 : 1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4 *
        ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9) + t ^ 2 ≤ D ^ 2 := by
      have hc2 : (32 * Real.exp 1 * K ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log 9) *
          Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ^ 2 =
          1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9) := by
        simp only [mul_pow]
        rw [hl2, hn2]
        ring
      dsimp [D]
      have hp : 0 ≤ 32 * Real.exp 1 * K ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log 9) *
          Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * t := by positivity
      nlinarith only [hc2, hp]
    have hexp : Real.exp (-(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min ((v / 2) ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) ((v / 2) / K ^ 2)) ≤
        Real.exp (-((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9)) *
          Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      calc _ ≤ -(1 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2)) * (D ^ 2 / (4 * K ^ 4)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hmin (neg_nonpos.mpr (by positivity))
        _ = -D ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := by
          have hd : (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9 +
              t ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4) ≤
              D ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4) := by
            apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
            calc _ = 1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4 *
                ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9) + t ^ 2 := by field_simp
              _ ≤ D ^ 2 := hD2
          simp only [neg_div]
          linarith only [hd]
    calc _ ≤ 2 * (9 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card n *
        (Real.exp (-((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9)) *
          Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (1024 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4))) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by
        have hp9 : (9 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card n =
            Real.exp ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.log 9) := by
          rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
        rw [hp9, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc 2, ← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel,
          Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have hsub : {ω | singularValues (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) (Fintype.card n - 1) <
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) - D ∨
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) + D < specNorm (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω))} ⊆
      {ω | v < specNorm ((Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω))ᵀ *
        Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω) - (Fintype.card m : ℝ) • 1)} := by
    intro ω hω
    change _ < _ ∨ _ < _ at hω
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_lt] at hnot
    have heq : (Fintype.card m : ℝ) *
        max (D / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ))
          ((D / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) ^ 2) = v := by
      rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hN.le]
      dsimp [v]
      congr 1
      · rw [← mul_div_assoc]
        apply (div_eq_iff hs.ne').mpr
        nlinarith [hs2]
      · rw [div_pow, hs2]
        field_simp
    rw [← heq] at hnot
    have hlow := sqrt_mul_one_sub_le_singularValues_last_of_gram_error
      (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) hN.le (div_nonneg hD hs.le) hnot
    have hhigh := specNorm_le_sqrt_mul_one_add_of_gram_error
      (Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) hN.le (div_nonneg hD hs.le) hnot
    have hl : Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) *
        (1 - D / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) =
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) - D := by field_simp
    have hu : Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) *
        (1 + D / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) =
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ) + D := by field_simp
    rw [hl] at hlow
    rw [hu] at hhigh
    rcases hω with hω | hω <;> linarith
  exact (measure_mono hsub).trans
    ((measure_lt_specNorm_gram_sub_card_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
      A K hKpos hind hmgf hiso hv).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbase))

name: NLAlib.measure_lt_abs_mulVec_sq_sub_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
statement:
theorem measure_lt_abs_mulVec_sq_sub_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    (A : m → Ω → n → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hind : iIndepFun A μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i u, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => A i ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      ⟨K ^ 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ u), mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg K) (dotProduct_self_nonneg u)⟩ μ)
    (hiso : ∀ i u, ∫ ω, (A i ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 ∂μ = u ⬝ᵥ u)
    (x : n → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (μ {ω | |((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x
          - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)}).toReal ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with hm | hm
  · refine measureReal_le_one.trans ?_
    simp only [Fintype.card_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_div, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    norm_num
  by_cases hx0 : x ⬝ᵥ x = 0
  · have hx : x = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hx0
    subst x
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_zero, dotProduct_zero, sub_zero, mul_zero, abs_zero,
      lt_self_iff_false, Set.ofPred_false, measure_empty, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    positivity
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card m := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hpos : 0 < x ⬝ᵥ x := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hx0)
  set r := Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) with hr_def
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos
  set u := r⁻¹ • x with hu_def
  have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
    rw [hu_def, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      ← sq, inv_pow, hr_def, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx0]
  have hxu : x = r • u := by rw [hu_def, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
  let Y : m → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => A i ω ⬝ᵥ u
  have hindY : iIndepFun Y μ := by
    simpa only [Y, Function.comp_def] using
      hind.comp (fun (_ : m) (v : n → ℝ) => v ⬝ᵥ u)
        (fun _ => by simp only [dotProduct]; fun_prop)
  have hmgfY : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (Y i) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ := by
    intro i
    simpa only [Y, hu, mul_one] using hmgf i u
  have hsqY : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Y i ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1 := by
    intro i
    simpa only [Y, hu] using hiso i u
  have hid : ∀ ω,
      ((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ
        ((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x =
      (x ⬝ᵥ x) / Fintype.card m * ∑ i, Y i ω ^ 2 := by
    intro ω
    have hscale : (1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 1 / Fintype.card m := by
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hkpos.le, one_pow]
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x := Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le
    conv_lhs => rw [hxu]
    rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, mul_pow, hscale, hr2]
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply, Y, ← sq]
    ring
  have hsub : {ω | |((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) •
        Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ
        ((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x
        - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)} ⊆
      {ω | (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε ≤ |∑ i, Y i ω ^ 2 - Fintype.card m|} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hid] at hω ⊢
    have heq : (x ⬝ᵥ x) / Fintype.card m * ∑ i, Y i ω ^ 2 - x ⬝ᵥ x =
        (x ⬝ᵥ x) / Fintype.card m * (∑ i, Y i ω ^ 2 - Fintype.card m) := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (div_pos hpos hkpos)] at hω
    have hcancel : ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x) =
        (x ⬝ᵥ x) / Fintype.card m * ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε) := by field_simp
    rw [hcancel] at hω
    exact (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hω (div_nonneg hpos.le hkpos.le)).le
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by linarith
  have hK2 : ε ≤ K ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (K - 1)]
  have hfirst : ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε) ^ 2 /
      ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4) = (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / K ^ 4 := by
    field_simp
  have hmin : min (((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε) ^ 2 /
      ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * K ^ 4)) (((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε) / K ^ 2) =
      (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / K ^ 4 := by
    rw [hfirst, min_eq_left]
    calc (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / K ^ 4 =
        ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε / K ^ 2) * (ε / K ^ 2) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε / K ^ 2) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((div_le_one (by positivity)).2 hK2) (by positivity)
      _ = (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε / K ^ 2 := mul_one _
  have h := measureReal_le_abs_sum_sq_sub_card_of_hasSubgaussianMGF Y K hKpos hindY hmgfY hsqY
    (u := (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε) (by positivity)
  rw [hmin] at h
  refine (measureReal_mono hsub).trans (h.trans_eq ?_)
  congr 2
  ring

name: NLAlib.measure_lt_abs_mulVec_sq_sub_le_of_independent_subgaussian_entries
statement:
theorem measure_lt_abs_mulVec_sq_sub_le_of_independent_subgaussian_entries
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : m → Ω → n → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun e : m × n => fun ω => A e.1 ω e.2) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i j, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => A i ω j) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, A i ω j ∂μ = 0)
    (hsq : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, A i ω j ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (x : n → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (μ {ω | |((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt (Fintype.card m : ℝ)) • Matrix.of (fun i => A i ω)) *ᵥ x
          - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)}).toReal ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-((Fintype.card m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * K ^ 4)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmeas : ∀ i j, AEMeasurable (fun ω => A i ω j) μ :=
    fun i j => (hmgf i j).integrable.aemeasurable
  have hrow : ∀ i, iIndepFun (fun j ω => A i ω j) μ := fun i =>
    hind.precomp (g := fun j => (i, j)) (fun _ _ h => (Prod.mk.inj h).2)
  have hrowlaw : ∀ i, μ.map (A i) = Measure.pi (fun j => μ.map (fun ω => A i ω j)) :=
    fun i => (hrow i).map_fun_eq_pi_map (hmeas i)
  have : ∀ i j, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map (fun ω => A i ω j)) :=
    fun i j => Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hmeas i j)
  have hflat : AEMeasurable (fun ω (e : m × n) => A e.1 ω e.2) μ :=
    aemeasurable_pi_lambda _ fun e => hmeas e.1 e.2
  have hflatlaw : μ.map (fun ω (e : m × n) => A e.1 ω e.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun e : m × n => μ.map (fun ω => A e.1 ω e.2)) :=
    hind.map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun e : m × n => hmeas e.1 e.2)
  have hcurried : μ.map (fun ω i => A i ω) =
      Measure.pi (fun i => Measure.pi (fun j => μ.map (fun ω => A i ω j))) := by
    change μ.map ((MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ) ∘ (fun ω (e : m × n) => A e.1 ω e.2)) = _
    rw [← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
      (MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ).measurable.aemeasurable hflat,
      hflatlaw]
    simpa only [Measure.infinitePi_eq_pi] using
      Measure.infinitePi_map_curry (fun i j => μ.map (fun ω => A i ω j))
  have hindRows : iIndepFun A μ := by
    apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map
      (fun i => aemeasurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => hmeas i j)).2
    simpa only [hrowlaw] using hcurried
  apply measure_lt_abs_mulVec_sq_sub_le_of_independent_isotropic_rows
    A K hK hindRows ?_ ?_ x hε0 hε1
  · intro i u
    let c : NNReal := ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩
    have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_finset_sum_mul_of_iIndepFun (hrow i)
      (c := fun _ => c) (s := Finset.univ)
      (fun j _ => hmgf i j) u
    have hproxy : (∑ j : n, (u j ^ 2).toNNReal * c) =
        ⟨K ^ 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ u), mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg K) (dotProduct_self_nonneg u)⟩ := by
      ext
      simp only [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_mul]
      change (∑ j, ((u j ^ 2).toNNReal : ℝ) * K ^ 2) = K ^ 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ u)
      simp only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (sq_nonneg _)]
      simp only [dotProduct, ← sq]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_comm _ _
    rw [hproxy] at h
    simpa only [dotProduct, mul_comm] using h
  · intro i u
    have hLp : ∀ j, MemLp (fun ω => A i ω j) 2 μ := by
      intro j
      simpa using (hmgf i j).memLp 2
    have hprod : ∀ j l, Integrable (fun ω => A i ω j * A i ω l) μ := fun j l =>
      (hLp j).integrable_mul (hLp l)
    have hcross : ∀ j l, ∫ ω, A i ω j * A i ω l ∂μ = if j = l then 1 else 0 := by
      intro j l
      split_ifs with h
      · subst l
        simpa only [sq] using hsq i j
      · rw [((hrow i).indepFun h).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
          (hmgf i j).integrable.aestronglyMeasurable
          (hmgf i l).integrable.aestronglyMeasurable,
          hmean i j, zero_mul]
    have hexpand : ∀ ω, (A i ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 =
        ∑ j, ∑ l, (u j * u l) * (A i ω j * A i ω l) := by
      intro ω
      rw [sq, dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring
    calc
      (∫ ω, (A i ω ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
        ∑ j, ∑ l, (∫ ω, (u j * u l) * (A i ω j * A i ω l) ∂μ) := by
        simp_rw [hexpand]
        rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
          integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ => (hprod j l).const_mul (u j * u l)]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
          integral_finsetSum _ fun l _ => (hprod j l).const_mul (u j * u l)
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ l, (u j * u l) * (if j = l then 1 else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro l _
        rw [integral_const_mul, hcross]
      _ = u ⬝ᵥ u := by simp [dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.chaosKhintchineConstant_pos

name: NLAlib.chaosStrongKhintchineConstant_pos
statement:
theorem chaosStrongKhintchineConstant_pos (q : ℕ) :
