name: NLAlib.rpow_le_rpow_add_one_div_log_two
statement:
private theorem rpow_le_rpow_add_one_div_log_two {x s : ℝ}
    (hx : Real.log 2 ≤ x) : x ^ s ≤ x ^ (s + 1) / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hx0 : 0 < x := hlog.trans_le hx
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hlog, Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_one]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _)

name: NLAlib.log_dimension_lower
statement:
private theorem log_dimension_lower :
    Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.log_le_log (by norm_num)
  have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card m := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card m ≠ 0))
  have hi : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card ι ≠ 0))
  linarith [le_max_left (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ)]

name: NLAlib.chaosLogBudget_le_dimension_log
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card m := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card m ≠ 0))
  have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card n ≠ 0))
  have hi : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card ι ≠ 0))
  simpa [chaosLogBudget, chaosDimensionProduct, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, mul_assoc] using
    Real.log_four_mul_mul_mul_pow_le hm hn hi (Fintype.card τ)

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_sigma_mul_log_rpow
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_sigma_mul_log_rpow
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A ≤
      chaosKhintchineConstant (Fintype.card τ) * K ^ Fintype.card τ *
        (Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)) ^
          ((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) / 2) * chaosSigma A
proof:
:= by
  let s := (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) / 2
  let L := Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).le.trans
    (log_dimension_lower (ι := ι) (m := m) (n := n))
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ chaosLogBudget τ ι m n := by
    apply (Real.one_lt_log_four_mul _).le.trans' (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    have hp : 0 < chaosDimensionProduct τ ι m n := by
      unfold chaosDimensionProduct
      positivity
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hp)
  have hb : chaosLogBudget τ ι m n ^ s ≤
      (Fintype.card τ + 4 : ℝ) ^ s * L ^ s := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow hB0
      (chaosLogBudget_le_dimension_log (τ := τ) (ι := ι) (m := m) (n := n))
      (show 0 ≤ s by dsimp [s]; positivity)
    change chaosLogBudget τ ι m n ^ s ≤ ((Fintype.card τ + 4 : ℝ) * L) ^ s at h
    rwa [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card τ + 4) hL0] at h
  have h := (expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_budget ν K hK hcenter hpsi A).1
  apply h.trans
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb
      (pow_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 200 * K by positivity) (Fintype.card τ)))
    (chaosSigma_nonneg A)
  dsimp [s, L] at hmul
  convert hmul using 1 <;> simp only [chaosKhintchineConstant, mul_pow] <;> ring

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_sigma_add_covariance_mul_log_rpow
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_sigma_add_covariance_mul_log_rpow
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A ≤
      chaosStrongKhintchineConstant (Fintype.card τ) * K ^ Fintype.card τ *
        (chaosSigma A +
          (Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)) ^
            (((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) + 2) / 2) * chaosCovariance A)
proof:
:= by
  let q := Fintype.card τ
  let s := (q : ℝ) / 2
  let L := Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)
  let b := (q : ℝ) / 2 * (q + 4 : ℝ) ^ s / Real.log 2
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hL : Real.log 2 ≤ L := log_dimension_lower (ι := ι) (m := m) (n := n)
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := hlog.le.trans hL
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ chaosLogBudget τ ι m n := by
    apply (Real.one_lt_log_four_mul _).le.trans' (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    have hp : 0 < chaosDimensionProduct τ ι m n := by
      unfold chaosDimensionProduct
      positivity
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hp)
  have hb : chaosLogBudget τ ι m n ^ s ≤ (q + 4 : ℝ) ^ s * L ^ s := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow hB0
      (chaosLogBudget_le_dimension_log (τ := τ) (ι := ι) (m := m) (n := n))
      (show 0 ≤ s by dsimp [s]; positivity)
    change chaosLogBudget τ ι m n ^ s ≤ ((q + 4 : ℝ) * L) ^ s at h
    rwa [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q + 4) hL0] at h
  have he : (q : ℝ) / 2 * chaosLogBudget τ ι m n ^ s ≤ b * L ^ (s + 1) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (q : ℝ) / 2 * ((q + 4 : ℝ) ^ s * L ^ s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (q : ℝ) / 2 * ((q + 4 : ℝ) ^ s * (L ^ (s + 1) / Real.log 2)) := by
        gcongr
        exact rpow_le_rpow_add_one_div_log_two hL
      _ = _ := by dsimp [b]; ring
  have hinner : chaosSigma A + (q : ℝ) / 2 * chaosLogBudget τ ι m n ^ s *
        chaosCovariance A ≤ (1 + b) * (chaosSigma A + L ^ (s + 1) * chaosCovariance A) := by
    have hv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (chaosCovariance_nonneg A)
    have hσ := mul_nonneg hb0 (chaosSigma_nonneg A)
    have hcv := mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hL0 (s + 1)) (chaosCovariance_nonneg A)
    nlinarith only [hv, hσ, hcv]
  have h := (expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_budget ν K hK hcenter hpsi A).2
  apply h.trans
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner
    (pow_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 200 * K by positivity) q)
  have hexp : s + 1 = ((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) + 2) / 2 := by dsimp [s, q]; ring
  rw [hexp] at hm
  convert hm using 1 <;> simp only [chaosStrongKhintchineConstant, mul_pow] <;>
    dsimp [b, s, q] <;> ring

name: NLAlib.log_matrix_dimension_le_chaos_budget

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_rowCoefficients
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_rowCoefficients
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening (chaosRowCoefficients A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosFlattening A (S.disjSum ∅))
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates (β := Unit) (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl m)
  let f := ((Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl n)).trans (Equiv.prodAssoc _ _ _)
  have he : (chaosFlattening A (S.disjSum ∅)).reindex e f =
      chaosFlattening (chaosRowCoefficients A) S := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, chaosFlattening,
      chaosRowCoefficients]
    change A (chaosAssemble (S.disjSum ∅) (e.symm a).1 (f.symm b).1) a.2 b.2.2 =
      A (chaosAppendTuple (chaosAssemble S a.1 b.1) b.2.1) a.2 b.2.2
    congr 2
    funext t
    rcases t with t | u
    · by_cases ht : t ∈ S
      · simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
      · simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
    · cases u
      simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
        Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_rowCoefficients
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_rowCoefficients
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening (chaosRowCoefficients A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.disjSum ∅))
proof:
:= by
  let e := Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates (β := Unit) (ι := ι) S
  let f := ((Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl (m × n))).trans rowCovarianceShuffle
  have he : (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.disjSum ∅)).reindex e f =
      chaosCovarianceFlattening (chaosRowCoefficients A) S := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, chaosCovarianceFlattening,
      chaosRowCoefficients]
    change A (chaosAssemble (S.disjSum ∅) (e.symm a) (f.symm b).1) b.2.1 b.2.2.2 =
      A (chaosAppendTuple (chaosAssemble S a b.1) b.2.2.1) b.2.1 b.2.2.2
    congr 2
    funext t
    rcases t with t | u
    · by_cases ht : t ∈ S
      · simp [e, f, rowCovarianceShuffle, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates,
          chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
      · simp [e, f, rowCovarianceShuffle, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates,
          chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
    · cases u
      simp [e, f, rowCovarianceShuffle, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates,
        Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates,
        chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_columnCoefficients
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_columnCoefficients
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening (chaosColumnCoefficients A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.disjSum ∅))
proof:
:= by
  let e := Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates (β := Unit) (ι := ι) S
  let f := ((Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl (m × n))).trans columnCovarianceShuffle
  have he : (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.disjSum ∅)).reindex e f =
      chaosCovarianceFlattening (chaosColumnCoefficients A) S := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, chaosCovarianceFlattening,
      chaosColumnCoefficients]
    change A (chaosAssemble (S.disjSum ∅) (e.symm a) (f.symm b).1) b.2.1.2 b.2.2 =
      A (chaosAppendTuple (chaosAssemble S a b.1) b.2.1.1) b.2.1.2 b.2.2
    congr 2
    funext t
    rcases t with t | u
    · by_cases ht : t ∈ S
      · simp [e, f, columnCovarianceShuffle, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates,
          chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
      · simp [e, f, columnCovarianceShuffle, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates,
          chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
    · cases u
      simp [e, f, columnCovarianceShuffle, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyCoordinates,
        Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumEmptyComplementCoordinates,
        chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_columnCoefficients
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_columnCoefficients
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening (chaosColumnCoefficients A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosFlattening A (S.disjSum Finset.univ))
proof:
:= by
  let e := ((Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl m)).trans (Equiv.prodAssoc _ _ _)
  let f := (Equiv.finsetSumOneComplementCoordinates (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl n)
  have he : (chaosFlattening A (S.disjSum Finset.univ)).reindex e f =
      chaosFlattening (chaosColumnCoefficients A) S := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, chaosFlattening,
      chaosColumnCoefficients]
    change A (chaosAssemble (S.disjSum Finset.univ) (e.symm a).1 (f.symm b).1)
      a.2.2 b.2 = A (chaosAppendTuple (chaosAssemble S a.1 b.1) a.2.1) a.2.2 b.2
    congr 2
    funext t
    rcases t with t | u
    · by_cases ht : t ∈ S
      · simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumOneComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
      · simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumOneComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
    · cases u
      simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
        Equiv.finsetSumOneComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_entryCoefficients
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_entryCoefficients
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening (chaosEntryCoefficients A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.disjSum Finset.univ))
proof:

  let e := Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates (ι := ι) S
  let f := (Equiv.finsetSumOneComplementCoordinates (ι := ι) S).prodCongr
    (Equiv.refl (m × n))
  have he : (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.disjSum Finset.univ)).reindex e f =
      chaosFlattening (chaosEntryCoefficients A) S := by
    ext a b

      chaosCovarianceFlattening, chaosEntryCoefficients]

      · simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,

      · simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,
          Equiv.finsetSumOneComplementCoordinates, chaosAssemble, chaosAppendTuple, ht]
    · cases u
      simp [e, f, Equiv.finsetSumOneCoordinates, Equiv.finsetSumCoordinates,

  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

statement:

name: NLAlib.integrable_decoupledMatrixChaos
statement:
theorem integrable_decoupledMatrixChaos (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) :
    Integrable (fun x : τ × ι → ℝ => decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => x (t, i)))
      (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold decoupledMatrixChaos
  apply integrable_finset_sum
  intro z _
  have hz : Function.Injective (fun t : τ => (t, z t)) := by
    intro t u htu
    exact congrArg Prod.fst htu
  exact (integrable_prod_pi_select (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
    (fun t => (t, z t)) hz (fun _ => id) (fun t => hν (z t))).smul_const (A z)

name: NLAlib.integrable_coupledMatrixChaos
statement:
theorem integrable_coupledMatrixChaos (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hA : HasDistinctIndexSupport A) (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) :
    Integrable (coupledMatrixChaos A) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coupledMatrixChaos decoupledMatrixChaos
  apply integrable_finset_sum
  intro z _
  by_cases hz : Function.Injective z
  · exact (integrable_prod_pi_select ν z hz (fun _ => id) (fun t => hν (z t))).smul_const
      (A z)
  · simp only [hA z hz, smul_zero]
    exact integrable_const _

name: NLAlib.integrable_coloredMatrixChaos
statement:
theorem integrable_coloredMatrixChaos (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ)
    (c : ι → τ) (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) :
    Integrable (coloredMatrixChaos A c) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coloredMatrixChaos
  apply integrable_finset_sum
  intro z _
  by_cases hz : ∀ t, c (z t) = t
  · simp only [if_pos hz]
    have hi : Function.Injective z := by
      intro t u htu
      simpa [hz] using congrArg c htu
    exact (integrable_prod_pi_select ν z hi (fun _ => id) (fun t => hν (z t))).smul_const
      (A z)
  · simp only [if_neg hz]
    exact integrable_const _

    HasLaw (fun xy : (τ × ι → ℝ) × (τ × ι → ℝ) => chaosMix c xy.1 xy.2)

name: NLAlib.integral_decoupledMatrixChaos_mix
statement:
theorem integral_decoupledMatrixChaos_mix (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (c : ι → τ) (x : τ × ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ y : τ × ι → ℝ,
      decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => chaosMix c x y (t, i))
        ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) =
      coloredMatrixChaos A c (chaosRetainedVector c x)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (z : τ → ι) : Function.Injective (fun t => (t, z t)) := by
    intro t u htu
    exact congrArg Prod.fst htu
  have hf (z : τ → ι) (t : τ) :
      Integrable (fun u : ℝ => if c (z t) = t then x (t, z t) else u) (ν (z t)) := by
    split_ifs
    · exact integrable_const _
    · exact hν (z t)
  have hint (z : τ → ι) : Integrable
      (fun y : τ × ι → ℝ => (∏ t, chaosMix c x y (t, z t)) • A z)
      (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) :=
    (integrable_prod_pi_select (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
      (fun t => (t, z t)) (hi z)
      (fun t u => if c (z t) = t then x (t, z t) else u) (hf z)).smul_const _
  unfold decoupledMatrixChaos coloredMatrixChaos
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun z _ => hint z)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  rw [integral_smul_const]
  change (∫ y : τ × ι → ℝ,
    ∏ t, (if c (z t) = t then x (t, z t) else y (t, z t))
      ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) • A z = _
  rw [integral_prod_pi_select (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
    (fun t => (t, z t)) (hi z)
    (fun t u => if c (z t) = t then x (t, z t) else u) (hf z)]
  have hm (t : τ) :
      (∫ u : ℝ, (if c (z t) = t then x (t, z t) else u) ∂ν (z t)) =
        if c (z t) = t then x (t, z t) else 0 := by
    split_ifs <;> simp [hcenter]
  simp_rw [hm]
  by_cases hz : ∀ t, c (z t) = t
  · simp [hz, chaosRetainedVector]
  · simp only [if_neg hz]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := not_forall.mp hz
    have hp : (∏ u : τ, if c (z u) = u then x (u, z u) else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ t)
      simp [ht]
    rw [hp, zero_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_coloredMatrixChaos_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_coloredMatrixChaos_le (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (c : ι → τ) :
    (∫ h, specNorm (coloredMatrixChaos A c h) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫ x : τ × ι → ℝ, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => x (t, i)))
        ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
  let Y : (τ × ι → ℝ) → Matrix m n ℝ :=
    fun x => decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => x (t, i))
  have hY : Integrable Y ρ := integrable_decoupledMatrixChaos ν A hν
  have hcol := integrable_coloredMatrixChaos ν A c hν
  have hret := (hasLaw_chaosRetainedVector ν c).measurePreserving (by
    unfold chaosRetainedVector
    fun_prop)
  have hcolret := hret.integrable_comp_of_integrable hcol
  have hmix := (hasLaw_chaosMix ν c).measurePreserving (by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro ti
    unfold chaosMix
    split_ifs <;> fun_prop)
  have hjoint : Integrable (fun xy : (τ × ι → ℝ) × (τ × ι → ℝ) =>
      Y (chaosMix c xy.1 xy.2)) (ρ.prod ρ) := hmix.integrable_comp_of_integrable hY
  have hpoint (x : τ × ι → ℝ) :
      ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c (chaosRetainedVector c x)‖ ≤
        ∫ y, ‖Y (chaosMix c x y)‖ ∂ρ := by
    rw [← integral_decoupledMatrixChaos_mix ν A hν hcenter c x]
    exact norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
  have hstep := integral_mono hcolret.norm hjoint.norm.integral_prod_left hpoint
  change (∫ x, ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c (chaosRetainedVector c x)‖ ∂ρ) ≤
    ∫ x, ∫ y, ‖Y (chaosMix c x y)‖ ∂ρ ∂ρ at hstep
  have hleft : (∫ x, ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c (chaosRetainedVector c x)‖ ∂ρ) =
      ∫ h, ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c h‖ ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      (hasLaw_chaosRetainedVector ν c).integral_comp hcol.norm.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hright : (∫ x, ∫ y, ‖Y (chaosMix c x y)‖ ∂ρ ∂ρ) = ∫ x, ‖Y x‖ ∂ρ := by
    rw [← integral_prod _ hjoint.norm]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      (hasLaw_chaosMix ν c).integral_comp hY.norm.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [hleft, hright] at hstep
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hstep

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le [Nonempty τ]
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : HasDistinctIndexSupport A)
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0) :
    (∫ h, specNorm (coupledMatrixChaos A h) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ *
        ∫ x : τ × ι → ℝ, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => x (t, i)))
          ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
proof:
:= by
  let b := (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ / Fintype.card (ι → τ)
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hc : (Fintype.card (ι → τ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card (ι → τ) ≠ 0)
  have hcol (c : ι → τ) :
      Integrable (fun h => specNorm (coloredMatrixChaos A c h)) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (integrable_coloredMatrixChaos ν A c hν).norm
  have hsum : Integrable (fun h => b * ∑ c, specNorm (coloredMatrixChaos A c h))
      (Measure.pi ν) := (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun c _ => hcol c)).const_mul b
  have hstep := integral_mono (integrable_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos ν A hA hν) hsum
    (fun h => specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le_coloring_average A hA h)
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finset_sum _ (fun c _ => hcol c)] at hstep
  refine hstep.trans ?_
  calc
    b * ∑ c, ∫ h, specNorm (coloredMatrixChaos A c h) ∂Measure.pi ν ≤
        b * ∑ _ : ι → τ,
          ∫ x : τ × ι → ℝ, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => x (t, i)))
            ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun c _ => integral_specNorm_coloredMatrixChaos_le ν A hν hcenter c)) hb
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
      dsimp [b]
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le_of_hasLaw [Nonempty τ]
    {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {μ : Measure Ω} {μ' : Measure Ω'}
    {h : Ω → ι → ℝ} {g : Ω' → τ × ι → ℝ}
    (hh : HasLaw h (Measure.pi ν) μ)
    (hg : HasLaw g (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) μ')
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : HasDistinctIndexSupport A)
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (coupledMatrixChaos A (h ω)) ∂μ) ≤
      (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ *
        ∫ ω, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => g ω (t, i))) ∂μ'
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := hh.integral_comp
    (integrable_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos ν A hA hν).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hright := hg.integral_comp
    (integrable_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos ν A hν).aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hleft hright
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact integral_specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le ν A hA hν hcenter

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_le_sigma_mul_log_rpow_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_le_sigma_mul_log_rpow_of_hasLaw
    (hξ : HasLaw ξ (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) μ)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => ξ ω (t, i))) ∂μ) ≤
      chaosKhintchineConstant (Fintype.card τ) * K ^ Fintype.card τ *
        (Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)) ^
          ((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) / 2) * chaosSigma A
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_eq_expected_of_hasLaw ν hξ A]
  exact expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_sigma_mul_log_rpow ν K hK hcenter hpsi A

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_le_sigma_add_covariance_mul_log_rpow_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_le_sigma_add_covariance_mul_log_rpow_of_hasLaw
    (hξ : HasLaw ξ (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) μ)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => ξ ω (t, i))) ∂μ) ≤
      chaosStrongKhintchineConstant (Fintype.card τ) * K ^ Fintype.card τ *
        (chaosSigma A +
          (Real.log (max (Fintype.card m : ℝ) (Fintype.card n : ℝ) + Fintype.card ι)) ^
            (((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) + 2) / 2) * chaosCovariance A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_eq_expected_of_hasLaw ν hξ A]
  exact expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_sigma_add_covariance_mul_log_rpow
    ν K hK hcenter hpsi A

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_nonneg (ν : ι → Measure ℝ)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) : 0 ≤ expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_eq_expected_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_eq_expected_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {ξ : Ω → τ × ι → ℝ}
    (hξ : HasLaw ξ (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) μ)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => ξ ω (t, i))) ∂μ) =
      expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : τ × ι → ℝ =>
      ‖decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => x (t, i))‖) :=
    (continuous_decoupledMatrixChaos A).comp (by fun_prop) |>.norm
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, specNorm_eq_norm, expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm] using
    hξ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty τ]
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A = chaosSigma A
proof:
:= by
  simp [expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm, decoupledMatrixChaos_of_isEmpty,
    chaosSigma_of_isEmpty]

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_reindexModes
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_reindexModes (e : σ ≃ τ)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) :
    expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosReindexModes e A) =
      expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun ti : σ × ι => (e ti.1, ti.2)) := by
    intro ti tj hij
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact e.injective (congrArg Prod.fst hij)
    · exact congrArg (fun p : τ × ι => p.2) hij
  have hlaw := hasLaw_pi_select (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
    (fun ti : σ × ι => (e ti.1, ti.2)) hi
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : σ × ι → ℝ =>
      ‖decoupledMatrixChaos (chaosReindexModes e A) (fun t i => x (t, i))‖) := by
    apply Continuous.norm
    exact (continuous_decoupledMatrixChaos _).comp (by fun_prop)
  have he := hlaw.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at he
  unfold expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
  rw [← he]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n ℝ => ‖M‖)
    (decoupledMatrixChaos_reindexModes e A (fun t i => x (t, i)))

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_empty_of_unique
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_empty_of_unique (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening A ∅) =
      specNorm (coefficientRow (fun j => A (fun _ => j)))
proof:
:= by
  let e : (((∅ : Finset τ) → ι) × m) ≃ m := emptyCoordinateProdEquiv ∅ rfl
  let f : ((((∅ : Finset τ)ᶜ : Finset τ) → ι) × n) ≃ (ι × n) :=
    (fullOneCoordinateEquiv _ (by simp)).prodCongr (Equiv.refl n)
  have he : (chaosFlattening A ∅).reindex e f =
      coefficientRow (fun j => A (fun _ => j)) := by
    ext a jb
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, chaosFlattening,
      e, f, Equiv.prodCongr_symm, Equiv.prodCongr_apply,
      emptyCoordinateProdEquiv, fullOneCoordinateEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk,
      Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.refl_apply, coefficientRow]
    congr 2
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_univ_of_unique
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_univ_of_unique (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening A Finset.univ) =
      specNorm (coefficientColumn (fun j => A (fun _ => j)))
proof:
:= by
  let e : ((↥(Finset.univ : Finset τ) → ι) × m) ≃ (ι × m) :=
    (fullOneCoordinateEquiv _ Finset.univ_nonempty).prodCongr (Equiv.refl m)
  let f : ((((Finset.univ : Finset τ)ᶜ : Finset τ) → ι) × n) ≃ n :=
    emptyCoordinateProdEquiv _ (by simp)
  have he : (chaosFlattening A Finset.univ).reindex e f =
      coefficientColumn (fun j => A (fun _ => j)) := by
    ext ia b
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, chaosFlattening,
      e, f, Equiv.prodCongr_symm, Equiv.prodCongr_apply,
      emptyCoordinateProdEquiv, fullOneCoordinateEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk,
      Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.refl_apply, coefficientColumn]
    congr 2
    funext t
    simp [chaosAssemble, Subsingleton.elim t default]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_empty_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_empty_sq (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening A ∅) ^ 2 =
      specNorm (∑ j, A (fun _ => j) * (A (fun _ => j))ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_chaosFlattening_empty_of_unique, specNorm_coefficientRow_sq]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_univ_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_univ_sq (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening A Finset.univ) ^ 2 =
      specNorm (∑ j, (A (fun _ => j))ᴴ * A (fun _ => j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_chaosFlattening_univ_of_unique, specNorm_coefficientColumn_sq]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_of_isEmpty
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening A S) = specNorm (A default)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Equiv.uniqueProd m (S → ι)
  let f := Equiv.uniqueProd n (((Sᶜ : Finset τ)) → ι)
  have he : (chaosFlattening A S).reindex e f = A default := by
    ext a b
    change A (chaosAssemble S (e.symm a).1 (f.symm b).1) a b = A default a b
    congr 2
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.chaosSigma_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem chaosSigma_of_isEmpty (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    chaosSigma A = specNorm (A default)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact chaosSigma_le _ (fun S => (specNorm_chaosFlattening_of_isEmpty A S).le)
  · rw [← specNorm_chaosFlattening_of_isEmpty A ∅]
    exact specNorm_chaosFlattening_le _ _

name: NLAlib.chaosCovariance_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem chaosCovariance_of_isEmpty (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    chaosCovariance A = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply chaosCovariance_le _ le_rfl
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨t, _⟩ := hS
    exact isEmptyElim t
  · exact chaosCovariance_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.decoupledMatrixChaos_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem decoupledMatrixChaos_of_isEmpty
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : τ → ι → ℝ) :
    decoupledMatrixChaos A h = A default
proof:
:= by
  simp [decoupledMatrixChaos]

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_chaosExtendSamples
statement:
theorem hasLaw_chaosExtendSamples :
    HasLaw (fun xy : (τ × ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ) => chaosExtendSamples xy.1 xy.2)
      (Measure.pi (fun ti : (τ ⊕ Unit) × ι => ν ti.2))
      ((Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  let η : (τ × ι) ⊕ ι → Measure ℝ := Sum.elim (fun ti => ν ti.2) ν
  haveI : ∀ ti, IsProbabilityMeasure (η ti) := by
    intro ti
    rcases ti with ti | i
    · exact inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (ν ti.2))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i))
  have hs := (measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi_symm η).hasLaw
  have hm := (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft
    (fun ti : (τ ⊕ Unit) × ι => ν ti.2) (groupPairEquiv (τ := τ) (ι := ι)).symm).hasLaw
  have he : (fun ti : (τ × ι) ⊕ ι => ν (groupPairEquiv.symm ti).2) = η := by
    funext ti
    rcases ti with ti | i <;> rfl
  rw [he] at hm
  convert hm.comp hs using 1
  · funext xy ti
    rcases ti with ⟨t | u, i⟩
    · rfl
    · cases u
      rfl
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_sum_recursion
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_sum_recursion
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) :
    (∫ z : (τ ⊕ Unit) × ι → ℝ,
      specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => z (t, i)))
        ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : (τ ⊕ Unit) × ι => ν ti.2)) =
      ∫ x : τ × ι → ℝ, ∫ y : ι → ℝ,
        specNorm (∑ j, y j • decoupledMatrixChaos
          (fun z => A (chaosAppendTuple z j)) (fun t i => x (t, i)))
          ∂Measure.pi ν ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)
proof:
:= by
  let Y : (((τ ⊕ Unit) × ι) → ℝ) → Matrix m n ℝ :=
    fun z => decoupledMatrixChaos A (fun t i => z (t, i))
  have hY : Integrable Y (Measure.pi (fun ti : (τ ⊕ Unit) × ι => ν ti.2)) :=
    integrable_decoupledMatrixChaos ν A hν
  have hlaw := hasLaw_chaosExtendSamples (τ := τ) ν
  have hm := hlaw.measurePreserving (by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro ti
    unfold chaosExtendSamples
    rcases ti with ⟨t | u, i⟩ <;> fun_prop)
  have hj := hm.integrable_comp_of_integrable hY
  calc
    _ = ∫ xy : (τ × ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ), ‖Y (chaosExtendSamples xy.1 xy.2)‖
        ∂((Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)).prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Function.comp_apply] using
        (hlaw.integral_comp hY.norm.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = ∫ x : τ × ι → ℝ, ∫ y : ι → ℝ, ‖Y (chaosExtendSamples x y)‖
        ∂Measure.pi ν ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2) := integral_prod _ hj.norm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with y
      have hsamp : (fun t i => chaosExtendSamples x y (t, i)) =
          Sum.elim (fun t i => x (t, i)) (fun _ => y) := by
        funext t i
        rcases t with t | u <;> rfl
      change specNorm (Y (chaosExtendSamples x y)) = _
      dsimp only [Y]
      rw [hsamp, decoupledMatrixChaos_sum_recursion]

name: NLAlib.card_pow_smul_sum_coloredMatrixChaos
statement:
theorem card_pow_smul_sum_coloredMatrixChaos
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : HasDistinctIndexSupport A) (h : ι → ℝ) :
    ((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ) •
      (∑ c : ι → τ, coloredMatrixChaos A c h) =
        (Fintype.card (ι → τ) : ℝ) • coupledMatrixChaos A h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coloredMatrixChaos, coupledMatrixChaos, decoupledMatrixChaos]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  by_cases hz : Function.Injective z
  · have hc : (∑ c : ι → τ, if ∀ t, c (z t) = t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ = (Fintype.card (ι → τ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.sum_coloring_indicator_mul_card_pow z hz
    have hs : (∑ c : ι → τ,
        if ∀ t, c (z t) = t then (∏ t, h (z t)) • A z else 0) =
        (∑ c : ι → τ, if ∀ t, c (z t) = t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) •
          ((∏ t, h (z t)) • A z) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_smul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [hs, smul_smul, mul_comm, hc]
  · simp [hA z hz]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le_coloring_average
statement:
theorem specNorm_coupledMatrixChaos_le_coloring_average
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : HasDistinctIndexSupport A) (h : ι → ℝ) :
    specNorm (coupledMatrixChaos A h) ≤
      (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ /
        Fintype.card (ι → τ) * ∑ c, specNorm (coloredMatrixChaos A c h)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < (Fintype.card (ι → τ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hq : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ := by positivity
  have he := card_pow_smul_sum_coloredMatrixChaos A hA h
  have hn := congrArg (fun B : Matrix m n ℝ => ‖B‖) he
  rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hq,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hc.le] at hn
  have hb : ‖∑ c, coloredMatrixChaos A c h‖ ≤
      ∑ c, ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c h‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
  simp_rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hc).mp
  calc
    ‖coupledMatrixChaos A h‖ * (Fintype.card (ι → τ) : ℝ) =
        (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ * ‖∑ c, coloredMatrixChaos A c h‖ := by
          simpa [mul_comm] using hn.symm
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ *
        (∑ c, ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c h‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hq
    _ = ((Fintype.card τ : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card τ /
        Fintype.card (ι → τ) * ∑ c, ‖coloredMatrixChaos A c h‖) *
        Fintype.card (ι → τ) := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_reindexModes
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_reindexModes (e : σ ≃ τ)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset σ) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening (chaosReindexModes e A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosFlattening A (S.map e.toEmbedding))
proof:
:= by
  let er := (subsetModeEquiv e S).symm
  let ec := (complementModeEquiv e S).symm
  let r := (Equiv.arrowCongr er (Equiv.refl ι)).prodCongr (Equiv.refl m)
  let c := (Equiv.arrowCongr ec (Equiv.refl ι)).prodCongr (Equiv.refl n)
  have he : (chaosFlattening A (S.map e.toEmbedding)).reindex r c =
      chaosFlattening (chaosReindexModes e A) S := by
    ext a b
    change A (chaosAssemble (S.map e.toEmbedding) (r.symm a).1 (c.symm b).1) a.2 b.2 =
      A (fun t => chaosAssemble S a.1 b.1 (e.symm t)) a.2 b.2
    congr 2
    funext t
    by_cases ht : e.symm t ∈ S
    · simp [r, c, er, ec, Equiv.arrowCongr, subsetModeEquiv, complementModeEquiv,
        chaosAssemble, Finset.mem_map_equiv, ht, Finset.equivMap]
    · simp [r, c, er, ec, Equiv.arrowCongr, complementModeEquiv,
        chaosAssemble, Finset.mem_map_equiv, ht, Finset.equivMap]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_reindexModes
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_reindexModes (e : σ ≃ τ)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset σ) :
    specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening (chaosReindexModes e A) S) =
      specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.map e.toEmbedding))
proof:
:= by
  let er := (subsetModeEquiv e S).symm
  let ec := (complementModeEquiv e S).symm
  let r := Equiv.arrowCongr er (Equiv.refl ι)
  let c := (Equiv.arrowCongr ec (Equiv.refl ι)).prodCongr (Equiv.refl (m × n))
  have he : (chaosCovarianceFlattening A (S.map e.toEmbedding)).reindex r c =
      chaosCovarianceFlattening (chaosReindexModes e A) S := by
    ext a b
    change A (chaosAssemble (S.map e.toEmbedding) (r.symm a) (c.symm b).1) b.2.1 b.2.2 =
      A (fun t => chaosAssemble S a b.1 (e.symm t)) b.2.1 b.2.2
    congr 2
    funext t
    by_cases ht : e.symm t ∈ S
    · simp [r, c, er, ec, Equiv.arrowCongr, subsetModeEquiv, complementModeEquiv,
        chaosAssemble, Finset.mem_map_equiv, ht, Finset.equivMap]
    · simp [r, c, er, ec, Equiv.arrowCongr, complementModeEquiv,
        chaosAssemble, Finset.mem_map_equiv, ht, Finset.equivMap]
  rw [← he, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.chaosSigma_reindexModes
statement:
theorem chaosSigma_reindexModes (e : σ ≃ τ) (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    chaosSigma (chaosReindexModes e A) = chaosSigma A
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply chaosSigma_le
    intro S
    rw [specNorm_chaosFlattening_reindexModes]
    exact specNorm_chaosFlattening_le _ _
  · apply chaosSigma_le
    intro T
    have h := specNorm_chaosFlattening_le (chaosReindexModes e A) (T.map e.symm.toEmbedding)
    rw [specNorm_chaosFlattening_reindexModes] at h
    have hT : (T.map e.symm.toEmbedding).map e.toEmbedding = T := by
      ext t
      simp only [Finset.mem_map_equiv, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hT] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.chaosCovariance_reindexModes
statement:
theorem chaosCovariance_reindexModes (e : σ ≃ τ) (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    chaosCovariance (chaosReindexModes e A) = chaosCovariance A
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply chaosCovariance_le _ (chaosCovariance_nonneg _)
    intro S hS
    rw [specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_reindexModes]
    exact specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_le _ _ hS.map
  · apply chaosCovariance_le _ (chaosCovariance_nonneg _)
    intro T hT
    have h := specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_le (chaosReindexModes e A)
      (T.map e.symm.toEmbedding) hT.map
    rw [specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_reindexModes] at h
    have heT : (T.map e.symm.toEmbedding).map e.toEmbedding = T := by
      ext t
      simp only [Finset.mem_map_equiv, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [heT] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.decoupledMatrixChaos_reindexModes
statement:
theorem decoupledMatrixChaos_reindexModes (e : σ ≃ τ)
    (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : τ → ι → ℝ) :
    decoupledMatrixChaos (chaosReindexModes e A) (fun t => h (e t)) =
      decoupledMatrixChaos A h
proof:
:= by
  let ez := Equiv.arrowCongr e (Equiv.refl ι)
  unfold decoupledMatrixChaos
  rw [← ez.sum_comp (fun z : τ → ι => (∏ t, h t (z t)) • A z)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  congr 1
  simpa [ez, Equiv.arrowCongr] using
    e.prod_comp (fun t => h t (z (e.symm t)))

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_of_linear_bound
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_of_linear_bound
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ) (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i))
    (a b : ℝ)
    (hlinear : ∀ B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ,
      (∫ y : ι → ℝ, specNorm (∑ j, y j • B j) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        a * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B)) +
          b * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)) :
    expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A ≤
      a * (expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosRowCoefficients A) +
        expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosColumnCoefficients A)) +
          b * expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosEntryCoefficients A)
proof:
:= by
  let R := fun x : τ × ι → ℝ =>
    specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos (chaosRowCoefficients A) (fun t i => x (t, i)))
  let C := fun x : τ × ι → ℝ =>
    specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos (chaosColumnCoefficients A) (fun t i => x (t, i)))
  let V := fun x : τ × ι → ℝ =>
    specNorm (decoupledMatrixChaos (chaosEntryCoefficients A) (fun t i => x (t, i)))
  have hR : Integrable R (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) :=
    integrable_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos ν _ hν
  have hC : Integrable C (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) :=
    integrable_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos ν _ hν
  have hV : Integrable V (Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) :=
    integrable_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos ν _ hν
  have hp (x : τ × ι → ℝ) :
      (∫ y : ι → ℝ, specNorm (∑ j, y j • decoupledMatrixChaos
        (fun z => A (chaosAppendTuple z j)) (fun t i => x (t, i))) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      a * (R x + C x) + b * V x := by
    have h := hlinear (fun j => decoupledMatrixChaos
      (fun z => A (chaosAppendTuple z j)) (fun t i => x (t, i)))
    rw [coefficientRow_decoupledMatrixChaos, coefficientColumn_decoupledMatrixChaos,
      coefficientEntryRows_decoupledMatrixChaos] at h
    exact h
  unfold expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm
  rw [integral_specNorm_decoupledMatrixChaos_sum_recursion ν A hν]
  have hstep := integral_mono_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => integral_nonneg (fun y => specNorm_nonneg _)))
    (((hR.add hC).const_mul a).add (hV.const_mul b))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hp)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hstep
  refine hstep.trans_eq ?_
  calc
    (∫ x, a * (R x + C x) + b * V x ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) =
        (∫ x, a * (R x + C x) ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2)) +
          ∫ x, b * V x ∂Measure.pi (fun ti : τ × ι => ν ti.2) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using
        integral_add ((hR.add hC).const_mul a) (hV.const_mul b)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_add hR hC]

name: NLAlib.decoupledMatrixChaos_sum_recursion
statement:
theorem decoupledMatrixChaos_sum_recursion
    (A : ((τ ⊕ Unit) → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (h : τ → ι → ℝ) (g : ι → ℝ) :
    decoupledMatrixChaos A (Sum.elim h (fun _ => g)) =
      ∑ j, g j • decoupledMatrixChaos (fun z => A (chaosAppendTuple z j)) h
proof:
:= by
  unfold decoupledMatrixChaos
  rw [← (appendTupleEquiv (τ := τ) (ι := ι)).symm.sum_comp]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.prod_sum_type]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  ext a b
  have hu : (uniqueElim j : Unit → ι) = (fun _ => j) := by
    funext u
    cases u
    rfl
  simp [appendTupleEquiv, Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow, Equiv.funUnique,
    Equiv.piUnique, chaosAppendTuple, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_smul, mul_comm, hu]

name: NLAlib.coefficientRow_decoupledMatrixChaos

name: NLAlib.expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_bounds_of_linear_bounds
statement:
theorem expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_bounds_of_linear_bounds
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable id (ν i)) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (D : ℕ)
    (hordinary : ∀ (m n : Type u) [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
      [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n],
      Fintype.card m * Fintype.card n ≤ D → ∀ B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ,
      (∫ y : ι → ℝ, specNorm (∑ j, y j • B j) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (a * t) * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B)))
    (hstrong : ∀ (m n : Type u) [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
      [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n],
      Fintype.card m * Fintype.card n ≤ D → ∀ B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ,
      (∫ y : ι → ℝ, specNorm (∑ j, y j • B j) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        a * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B)) +
          (a * t) * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)) (q : ℕ) :
    ∀ (τ : Type u) [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ], Fintype.card τ = q →
      ∀ (m n : Type u) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
      [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n] (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n ℝ),
      chaosDimensionProduct τ ι m n ≤ D →
      (expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A ≤ (2 * a * t) ^ q * chaosSigma A) ∧
      (expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν A ≤
        (2 * a) ^ q * (chaosSigma A + (q : ℝ) / 2 * t ^ q * chaosCovariance A))
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h q ih =>
    intro τ _ _ hcard m n _ _ _ _ _ _ A hsize
    by_cases hq : q = 0
    · haveI : IsEmpty τ := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp (hcard.trans hq)
      simp [hq, expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_of_isEmpty]
    · have hqpos : 0 < q := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq
      haveI : Nonempty τ := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (hcard ▸ hqpos)
      let t₀ : τ := Classical.choice inferInstance
      let τ' := {t : τ // t ≠ t₀}
      let e : τ' ⊕ Unit ≃ τ :=
        ((Equiv.refl τ').sumCongr (Equiv.ofUnique Unit PUnit.{u + 1})).trans
          (Equiv.subtypeNeSumPUnit t₀)
      let r := Fintype.card τ'
      have hrq : r + 1 = q := by
        simpa only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_punit, hcard, r] using
          Fintype.card_congr e
      have hrlt : r < q := by omega
      let B := chaosReindexModes e A
      have hBsize : chaosDimensionProduct (τ' ⊕ Unit) ι m n ≤ D := by
        simpa only [chaosDimensionProduct, Fintype.card_congr e] using hsize
      have hR := ih r hrlt τ' rfl m (ι × n) (chaosRowCoefficients B)
        (by simpa only [chaosDimensionProduct_row] using hBsize)
      have hC := ih r hrlt τ' rfl (ι × m) n (chaosColumnCoefficients B)
        (by simpa only [chaosDimensionProduct_column] using hBsize)
      have hV := ih r hrlt τ' rfl ι (m × n) (chaosEntryCoefficients B)
        (by simpa only [chaosDimensionProduct_entry] using hBsize)
      have hshape : Fintype.card m * Fintype.card n ≤ D :=
        (card_mul_card_le_chaosDimensionProduct (τ := τ' ⊕ Unit)).trans hBsize
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := le_trans (by norm_num) ht
      have hbase0 : 0 ≤ 2 * a * t := by positivity
      have hRord : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosRowCoefficients B) ≤
          (2 * a * t) ^ r * chaosSigma B :=
        hR.1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (chaosSigma_rowCoefficients_le B)
          (pow_nonneg hbase0 r))
      have hCord : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosColumnCoefficients B) ≤
          (2 * a * t) ^ r * chaosSigma B :=
        hC.1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (chaosSigma_columnCoefficients_le B)
          (pow_nonneg hbase0 r))
      have hVord : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosEntryCoefficients B) ≤
          (2 * a * t) ^ r * chaosCovariance B :=
        hV.1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (chaosSigma_entryCoefficients_le B)
          (pow_nonneg hbase0 r))
      have hRstrong : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosRowCoefficients B) ≤
          (2 * a) ^ r * (chaosSigma B + (r : ℝ) / 2 * t ^ r * chaosCovariance B) := by
        apply hR.2.trans
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        exact add_le_add (chaosSigma_rowCoefficients_le B)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (chaosCovariance_rowCoefficients_le B) (by positivity))
      have hCstrong : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν (chaosColumnCoefficients B) ≤
          (2 * a) ^ r * (chaosSigma B + (r : ℝ) / 2 * t ^ r * chaosCovariance B) := by
        apply hC.2.trans
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        exact add_le_add (chaosSigma_columnCoefficients_le B)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (chaosCovariance_columnCoefficients_le B) (by positivity))
      have hBo : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν B ≤
          (2 * a * t) ^ (r + 1) * chaosSigma B := by
        have hstep := expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_of_linear_bound ν B hν (a * t) 0
          (fun C => by simpa using hordinary m n hshape C)
        simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at hstep
        calc
          _ ≤ (a * t) * ((2 * a * t) ^ r * chaosSigma B +
              (2 * a * t) ^ r * chaosSigma B) :=
            hstep.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hRord hCord) (by positivity))
          _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      have hBs : expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm ν B ≤
          (2 * a) ^ (r + 1) *
            (chaosSigma B + ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * t ^ (r + 1) * chaosCovariance B) := by
        have hstep := expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_le_of_linear_bound ν B hν a (a * t)
          (hstrong m n hshape)
        calc
          _ ≤ a * ((2 * a) ^ r *
              (chaosSigma B + (r : ℝ) / 2 * t ^ r * chaosCovariance B) +
              (2 * a) ^ r * (chaosSigma B + (r : ℝ) / 2 * t ^ r * chaosCovariance B)) +
              (a * t) * ((2 * a * t) ^ r * chaosCovariance B) :=
            hstep.trans (add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hRstrong hCstrong) ha)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVord (by positivity)))
          _ ≤ _ := by
            have hp : t ^ r ≤ t ^ (r + 1) := by
              rw [pow_succ]
              nlinarith [pow_nonneg ht0 r]
            have hdiff : 0 ≤ a * (2 * a) ^ r * (r : ℝ) *
                (t ^ (r + 1) - t ^ r) * chaosCovariance B := by
              exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr hp))
                (chaosCovariance_nonneg B)
            rw [pow_succ t r] at hdiff
            rw [mul_pow (2 * a) t r, pow_succ (2 * a) r, pow_succ t r]
            push_cast
            nlinarith only [hdiff]
      have heE := expectedDecoupledMatrixChaosNorm_reindexModes ν e A
      have heS := chaosSigma_reindexModes e A
      have heV := chaosCovariance_reindexModes e A
      constructor
      · rw [← heE, ← heS, ← hrq]
        exact hBo
      · rw [← heE, ← heS, ← heV, ← hrq]
        exact hBs

name: NLAlib.chaosAssemble_row

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosFlattening_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosFlattening_le (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Finset τ) :
    specNorm (chaosFlattening A S) ≤ chaosSigma A
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.le_sup' (fun T => specNorm (chaosFlattening A T)) (Finset.mem_univ S)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_chaosCovarianceFlattening_le (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (S : Finset τ) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A S) ≤ chaosCovariance A
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.le_sup'
    (fun T : Finset τ => if T = ∅ then 0 else specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A T))
    (Finset.mem_univ S)
  change specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A S) ≤
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun T => if T = ∅ then 0 else specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A T))
  simpa only [if_neg hS.ne_empty] using h

name: NLAlib.chaosSigma_nonneg
statement: theorem chaosSigma_nonneg (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) : 0 ≤ chaosSigma A
proof:
:=
  (specNorm_nonneg _).trans (specNorm_chaosFlattening_le A ∅)

name: NLAlib.chaosCovariance_nonneg
statement:
theorem chaosCovariance_nonneg (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    0 ≤ chaosCovariance A
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.le_sup'
    (fun T : Finset τ => if T = ∅ then 0 else specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A T))
    (Finset.mem_univ (∅ : Finset τ))
  change 0 ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
    (fun T => if T = ∅ then 0 else specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A T))
  simp only [ite_true] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.chaosSigma_le
statement:
theorem chaosSigma_le (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ S, specNorm (chaosFlattening A S) ≤ c) : chaosSigma A ≤ c
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup'_le _ _ (fun S _ => h S)

name: NLAlib.chaosCovariance_le
statement:
theorem chaosCovariance_le (A : (τ → ι) → Matrix m n 𝕜) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ S, S.Nonempty → specNorm (chaosCovarianceFlattening A S) ≤ c) :
    chaosCovariance A ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro S _
  split_ifs with hS
  · exact hc
  · exact h S (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hS)
