name: NLAlib.gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_sqrt_rowSq_le_integral
statement:
theorem gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_sqrt_rowSq_le_integral
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (i : ι) :
    gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * Real.sqrt (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ≤
      ∫ G, Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i) ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  let r := Real.sqrt (∑ j, b i j ^ 2)
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hrsq : r ^ 2 = ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hrow := (memLp_sqrt_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix b i).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hentry (j : ι) : Integrable (fun G => |b i j| * |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j|)
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι) :=
    ((memLp_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b i j 2 (by simp)).integrable (by norm_num)).abs.const_mul _
  have hpoint (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
      (∑ j, |b i j| * |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j|) ≤
        r * Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i) := by
    simpa only [r, rowSq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun j => |b i j|)
        (fun j => |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j|)
  have hm := integral_mono (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hentry j)) (hrow.const_mul r) hpoint
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hentry j), integral_const_mul] at hm
  have hleft : (∑ j, ∫ G, |b i j| * |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j| ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) =
      r ^ 2 * (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ∂gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    simp only [integral_const_mul, integral_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b hb,
      hrsq, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, sq_abs]
  rw [hleft] at hm
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ G, Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i) ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι :=
    integral_nonneg fun G : Matrix ι ι ℝ => Real.sqrt_nonneg (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i)
  have hlow := gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_le_integral_abs_gaussianReal
  change gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * r ≤ _
  rcases hr0.eq_or_lt with hz | hr
  · rw [← hz, mul_zero]
    exact hnonneg
  · have hmul : r * (gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * r) ≤
        r * (∫ G, Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i) ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg r) (sub_nonneg.mpr hlow)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hr).mp hmul

name: NLAlib.gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_rowMixedNorm_le_integral
statement:
theorem gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_rowMixedNorm_le_integral
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * rowMixedNorm b p ≤
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨hp⟩
  let F : Matrix ι ι ℝ → PiLp p (fun _ : ι => ℝ) := fun G =>
    WithLp.toLp p (fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i))
  let m : ι → ℝ := fun i => ∫ G, Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i) ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
  have hi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun G => Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i))
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := (memLp_sqrt_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix b i).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hF : Integrable F (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := integrable_piLp_iff.mpr hi
  have heq : (∫ G, F G ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) = WithLp.toLp p m := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    exact eval_integral_piLp hi i
  have hn := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (μ := gaussianMatrix ι ι) F
  rw [heq] at hn
  have hlen (i : ι) : rowSq b i = ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 := by
    simp only [rowSq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hmono := norm_toLp_mono_of_nonneg hp
    (fun i => gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * Real.sqrt (rowSq b i)) m
      (fun i => mul_nonneg gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        (fun i => by simpa only [hlen i] using
          gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_sqrt_rowSq_le_integral b hb i)
  have hscale : ‖(WithLp.toLp p (fun i => gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * Real.sqrt (rowSq b i)) :
      PiLp p (fun _ : ι => ℝ))‖ = gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * rowMixedNorm b p := by
    rw [rowMixedNorm_eq_norm_row_lengths b hp]
    change ‖gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant • (WithLp.toLp p (fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq b i)) :
      PiLp p (fun _ : ι => ℝ))‖ = _
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos.le]
  rw [hscale] at hmono
  have hnorm (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : ‖F G‖ = rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p :=
    (rowMixedNorm_eq_norm_row_lengths _ hp).symm
  simp_rw [hnorm] at hn
  exact hmono.trans hn

name: NLAlib.gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_selected_sqrt_log_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
statement:
theorem gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_selected_sqrt_log_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (S : Finset (ι × ι)) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hS : ∀ e ∈ S, e.2 ≤ e.1 ∧ m ≤ |b e.1 e.2|) :
    gaussianMaximumLowerConstant * m * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((S.card : ℝ) + 1)) ≤
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin S).symm
  let ρ : Fin (Fintype.card S) → ι × ι := fun k => (e k).1
  let V : Matrix ι ι ℝ → Fin (Fintype.card S) → ℝ := fun G k => G (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2
  have hρ : Function.Injective ρ := Subtype.val_injective.comp e.injective
  have hV : HasLaw V (gaussianVector (Fin (Fintype.card S))) (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := by
    apply hasLaw_gaussianVector_of_iIndepFun
    · intro k
      exact (measurePreserving_gaussianMatrix_entry (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2).hasLaw
    · exact iIndepFun.precomp hρ iIndepFun_gaussianMatrix_entry
  have hVi : MemLp V 2 (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := by
    apply memLp_pi_iff.mpr
    intro k
    exact memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2 2 (by simp)
  have hRi : Integrable (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤)
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := by
    simpa only [rowMixedNorm_top_eq_pi_norm] using integrable_pi_norm_sqrt_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix b
  have hpoint (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : m * ‖V G‖ ≤ rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ := by
    have hnorm : ‖fun k => m * V G k‖ ≤ rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ := by
      apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _)).mpr
      intro k
      obtain ⟨hcan, hcap⟩ := hS (ρ k) (e k).2
      have hx : symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2 =
          b (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2 * G (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2 := by
        simp only [symmetricGaussianMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, max_eq_left hcan, min_eq_right hcan]
      have hentry : |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2| ≤
          Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (ρ k).1) := by
        have h := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun j => ‖symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (ρ k).1 j‖ ^ 2)
            (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ (ρ k).2))
        simpa only [rowSq, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using h
      have hrow : Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (ρ k).1) ≤
          rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ := by
        rw [rowMixedNorm_top_eq_pi_norm]
        simpa only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] using
          norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i)) (ρ k).1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hm]
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcap (abs_nonneg (V G k))
      have hcap' : |b (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2| * |V G k| =
          |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (ρ k).1 (ρ k).2| := by rw [hx, abs_mul]
      rw [hcap'] at hmul
      exact hmul.trans (hentry.trans hrow)
    have hscale : ‖fun k => m * V G k‖ = m * ‖V G‖ := by
      have heq : (fun k => m * V G k) = m • V G := by funext k; rfl
      rw [heq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hm]
    rwa [hscale] at hnorm
  have hmean := integral_mono ((hVi.norm.integrable (by norm_num)).const_mul m) hRi hpoint
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hmean
  have hlaw := hV.integral_comp (show AEStronglyMeasurable
    (fun g : Fin (Fintype.card S) → ℝ => ‖g‖) (gaussianVector (Fin (Fintype.card S))) from by fun_prop)
  change (∫ G, ‖V G‖ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) = _ at hlaw
  rw [hlaw] at hmean
  have hlow := gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_sqrt_log_le_integral_norm_gaussianVector (Fintype.card S)
  simp only [Fintype.card_coe] at hlow hmean
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm (sub_nonneg.mpr hlow)]

name: NLAlib.exists_entry_eq_pi_norm_row
statement:
private theorem exists_entry_eq_pi_norm_row (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) (i : ι) : ∃ j, b i j = ‖b i‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nonempty ι := ⟨i⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := fun j => |b i j|)
  have hnorm : ‖b i‖ ≤ |b i j| := by
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)).mpr
    intro k
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hj]
    exact le_ciSup (Set.finite_range (fun l : ι => |b i l|)).bddAbove k
  have hrev : |b i j| ≤ ‖b i‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (b i) j
  exact ⟨j, by rw [abs_of_nonneg (hb0 i j)] at hnorm hrev; linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_sorted_row_sqrt_log_le_integral
statement:
theorem gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_sorted_row_sqrt_log_le_integral
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) :
    gaussianMaximumLowerConstant *
        (‖b (sortingEquiv (fun i => ‖b i‖) k)‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (k.val + 1))) ≤
      2 * ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose j hj using exists_entry_eq_pi_norm_row b hb0
  let e := sortingEquiv (fun i => ‖b i‖)
  let rows := (Finset.Iic k).image e
  let S := rows.image (fun i => (max i (j i), min i (j i)))
  let m := ‖b (e k)‖
  have hrows : rows.card = k.val + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.injective, Fin.card_Iic]
  have hcard : k.val + 1 ≤ 2 * S.card := by
    rw [← hrows]
    exact Finset.card_le_two_mul_card_image_canonicalPair rows j
  have hS : ∀ q ∈ S, q.2 ≤ q.1 ∧ m ≤ |b q.1 q.2| := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    refine ⟨min_le_max, ?_⟩
    have hmin : m ≤ b i (j i) := by
      obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
      rw [hj]
      exact sortedVector_antitone (fun i => ‖b i‖) (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hl)
    have hcoef : b (max i (j i)) (min i (j i)) = b i (j i) := by
      by_cases hij : j i ≤ i
      · rw [max_eq_left hij, min_eq_right hij]
      · have hij' : i ≤ j i := le_of_not_ge hij
        rw [max_eq_right hij', min_eq_left hij', hb.apply i (j i)]
    rw [hcoef, abs_of_nonneg (hb0 i (j i))]
    exact hmin
  have hlower := gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_selected_sqrt_log_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
    b S m (norm_nonneg _) hS
  have hcardR : (k.val : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * (S.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  have hlog : Real.log (k.val + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log ((S.card : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have harg : (k.val : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((S.card : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (S.card : ℝ)]
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < (k.val : ℝ) + 1) harg
    simpa only [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using h
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (Real.log (k.val + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((S.card : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    have hk0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (k.val + 1 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by
      have hk : 0 ≤ (k.val : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _; linarith)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((S.card : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by
      have hs : 0 ≤ (S.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _; linarith)
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hk0, Real.sq_sqrt hs0,
      Real.sqrt_nonneg (Real.log (k.val + 1 : ℝ)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (Real.log ((S.card : ℝ) + 1))]
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ gaussianMaximumLowerConstant * m :=
    mul_nonneg gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos.le (norm_nonneg _)
  change gaussianMaximumLowerConstant * (m * Real.sqrt (Real.log (k.val + 1))) ≤ _
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hroot)]

name: NLAlib.gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_profileLogRowMaximum_le_integral
statement:
theorem gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_profileLogRowMaximum_le_integral
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) :
    gaussianMaximumLowerConstant * profileLogRowMaximum b ≤
      2 * ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 ≤ ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι :=
    integral_nonneg fun G => rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _
  have hnorm : profileLogRowMaximum b ≤
      (2 * ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ⊤ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) /
        gaussianMaximumLowerConstant := by
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith) gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos.le)).mpr
    intro k
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))]
    have h := gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_sorted_row_sqrt_log_le_integral b hb hb0 k
    apply (le_div_iff₀ gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos).mpr
    nlinarith
  have h := (le_div_iff₀ gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos).mp hnorm
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (S : Matrix ι p ℝ) (T : Matrix m κ ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => frobSq (S * G * T))
      (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsq : Integrable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => frobSq G)
      (gaussianMatrix p m) := by
    simp_rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
    refine integrable_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => ?_
    exact (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry a b 2 (by simp)).integrable_sq
  have hm : Measurable fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => frobSq (S * G * T) :=
    measurable_frobSq_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp
      ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id).matrix_mul measurable_const))
  refine (hsq.const_mul (frobSq S * frobSq T)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun G => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _)]
  calc frobSq (S * G * T) ≤ frobSq (S * G) * frobSq T := frobSq_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ frobSq S * frobSq G * frobSq T :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_mul_le _ _) (frobSq_nonneg _)
    _ = frobSq S * frobSq T * frobSq G := by ring

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq_mul_mul_prod
statement:
private lemma measurable_frobSq_mul_mul_prod {α ι κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [Fintype ι]
    [Fintype κ] {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (S : Matrix ι p ℝ)
    {T : α → Matrix m κ ℝ}
    (hT : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => T x i j) :
    Measurable fun q : α × Matrix p m ℝ => frobSq (S * q.2 * T q.1)
proof:
:=
  measurable_frobSq_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp
    ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul
      ((Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hT).comp measurable_fst)))

name: NLAlib.lintegral_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
proof:
:= by
  have hYm : AEMeasurable Y μ := hY.aemeasurable
  have hFm : Measurable (Function.uncurry fun (x : α) (y : Matrix p m ℝ) =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (frobSq (S * y * T x))) := by
    exact ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_frobSq_mul_mul_prod S hT)
  have hGm : Measurable fun x : α => ENNReal.ofReal (frobSq S * frobSq (T x)) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_const.mul (measurable_frobSq_of_entries hT))
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_of_indepFun hX hYm hXY hFm.aemeasurable, hY.map_eq,
    ← lintegral_map' hGm.aemeasurable hX]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul S (T x))
    (ae_of_all _ fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _), integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
proof:
:= by
  have hYm : AEMeasurable Y μ := hY.aemeasurable
  have hL : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => frobSq (S * Y ω * T (X ω))) μ := by
    have hF := measurable_frobSq_mul_mul_prod S hT
    exact (hF.comp_aemeasurable (hX.prodMk hYm)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hR : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => frobSq S * frobSq (T (X ω))) μ :=
    (measurable_const.mul (measurable_frobSq_of_entries hT)).comp_aemeasurable hX
      |>.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← integral_const_mul,
    integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _) hL,
    integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => mul_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg _)) hR,
    lintegral_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun hX hY hXY S hT]

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
proof:
:= by
  have hYm : AEMeasurable Y μ := hY.aemeasurable
  have hF := measurable_frobSq_mul_mul_prod S hT
  refine ⟨(hF.comp_aemeasurable (hX.prodMk hYm)).aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _),
    lintegral_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun hX hY hXY S hT]
  exact (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal
    (ae_of_all _ fun _ => mul_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg _))).1
    (hTi.const_mul (frobSq S)).hasFiniteIntegral

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block {n k r r' t : ℕ}
    {Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂)
    (hV₁₂ : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0) (S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ =
      frobSq S₂ * ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ
proof:
:=
  integral_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
    (X := fun ω => V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)
    (Y := fun ω => V₂ᵀ * Ω ω)
    ((measurable_block V₁).comp_aemeasurable hΩ.aemeasurable)
    (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₂ hV₂)
    (gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV₁₂)
    S₂ (T := fun x => pinvR x) measurable_pinvR_entry

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block {n k r r' t : ℕ}
    {Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂)
    (hV₁₂ : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0) (S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ)
    (hi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ) :
    Integrable
      (fun ω => frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ
proof:
:=
  integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
    (X := fun ω => V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)
    (Y := fun ω => V₂ᵀ * Ω ω)
    ((measurable_block V₁).comp_aemeasurable hΩ.aemeasurable)
    (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₂ hV₂)
    (gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV₁₂)
    S₂ (T := fun x => pinvR x) measurable_pinvR_entry hi

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_pinvL_block_mul_block_mul
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_pinvL_block_mul_block_mul {m s q rp : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ} (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin rp) ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hQQp : Qᵀ * Qp = 0) (B : Matrix (Fin rp) ι ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * B) ∂μ =
      (∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) ∂μ) * frobSq B
proof:
:= by
  have key := integral_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
    (X := fun ω => Qᵀ * Ψ ω)
    (Y := fun ω => Qpᵀ * Ψ ω)
    ((measurable_block Q).comp_aemeasurable hΨ.aemeasurable)
    (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΨ Qp hQp)
    (gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp)
    Bᵀ (T := fun x => pinvR x) measurable_pinvR_entry
  have h1 : ∀ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * B) =
      frobSq (Bᵀ * (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)) := by
    intro ω
    rw [← frobSq_transpose]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, pinvL_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h2 : ∀ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) =
      frobSq (pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)) := by
    intro ω
    rw [← frobSq_transpose, pinvL_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  simp_rw [h1, h2, frobSq_transpose] at *
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact key

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_pinvR_block
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_pinvR_block {n k t : ℕ} {Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ =
      ∫ G, frobSq (pinvR G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ hV₁).map_eq]
  exact (integral_map (φ := fun ω => V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)
    ((measurable_block V₁).comp_aemeasurable hΩ.aemeasurable)
    (measurable_frobSq_of_entries measurable_pinvR_entry).aestronglyMeasurable).symm

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_one_gaussianReal
statement: private lemma integral_pow_one_gaussianReal : ∫ x, x ^ 1 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 0
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_two_gaussianReal
statement: private lemma integral_pow_two_gaussianReal : ∫ x, x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := variance_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)
  rw [variance_of_integral_eq_zero aemeasurable_id
    (by simp [integral_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)])] at h
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.mom_zero
statement: @[simp] private lemma mom_zero : mom 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [mom]

name: NLAlib.mom_one
statement: @[simp] private lemma mom_one : mom 1 = 0

name: NLAlib.mom_two

name: NLAlib.mom_four

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix (f : p × m → ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, ∏ e : p × m, f e (G e.1 e.2) ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = ∏ e : p × m, ∫ x, f e x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]
  rw [integral_gaussianMatrix_eq]
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun (a : p) (g : m → ℝ) => ∏ b, f (a, b) (g b))]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  exact integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun b x => f (a, b) x)

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix (f : p × m → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ e, Integrable (f e) (gaussianReal 0 1)) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => ∏ e : p × m, f e (G e.1 e.2))
      (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]
  rw [integrable_gaussianMatrix_iff]
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
  exact Integrable.fintype_prod (f := fun (a : p) (g : m → ℝ) => ∏ b, f (a, b) (g b))
    (fun a => Integrable.fintype_prod (fun b => hf (a, b)))

name: NLAlib.mono4
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cnt4, pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_boole, Finset.mem_univ,
    if_true]

name: NLAlib.integrable_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix (e1 e2 e3 e4 : p × m) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ =>
      G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2 * G e3.1 e3.2 * G e4.1 e4.2) (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mono4]
  exact integrable_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix (fun e x => x ^ cnt4 e1 e2 e3 e4 e)
    (fun e => integrable_pow_gaussianReal _)

name: NLAlib.prod_mom_cnt4
statement:
private lemma prod_mom_cnt4 (e1 e2 e3 e4 : p × m) :
    ∏ e, mom (cnt4 e1 e2 e3 e4 e) = ∏ e ∈ {e1, e2, e3, e4}, mom (cnt4 e1 e2 e3 e4 e)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine Finset.prod_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) fun e _ he => ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at he
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := he
  simp [cnt4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2, Ne.symm h3, Ne.symm h4]

name: NLAlib.integral_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix (e1 e2 e3 e4 : p × m) :
    ∫ G, G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2 * G e3.1 e3.2 * G e4.1 e4.2 ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = (if e1 = e2 then 1 else 0) * (if e3 = e4 then 1 else 0)
        + (if e1 = e3 then 1 else 0) * (if e2 = e4 then 1 else 0)
        + (if e1 = e4 then 1 else 0) * (if e2 = e3 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mono4]
  rw [integral_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix (fun e x => x ^ cnt4 e1 e2 e3 e4 e)]
  change ∏ e, mom (cnt4 e1 e2 e3 e4 e) = _
  rw [prod_mom_cnt4]
  by_cases h12 : e1 = e2 <;> by_cases h13 : e1 = e3 <;> by_cases h14 : e1 = e4 <;>
    by_cases h23 : e2 = e3 <;> by_cases h24 : e2 = e4 <;> by_cases h34 : e3 = e4 <;>
    subst_vars <;> (simp_all [Finset.prod_insert, cnt4, eq_comm]; try norm_num)

name: NLAlib.mono2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_boole, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

name: NLAlib.integrable_mono2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mono2]
  exact integrable_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix _ (fun e => integrable_pow_gaussianReal _)

name: NLAlib.integral_mono2
statement:
private lemma integral_mono2 (e1 e2 : p × m) :
    ∫ G, G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2 ∂(gaussianMatrix p m) = if e1 = e2 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mono2]
  rw [integral_prod_entry_gaussianMatrix
    (fun e x => x ^ ((if e1 = e then 1 else 0) + (if e2 = e then 1 else 0)))]
  change ∏ e, mom _ = _
  by_cases h : e1 = e2
  · subst h
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single e1]
    · simp
    · intro b _ hb; simp [Ne.symm hb]
    · simp
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ e1) (by simp [Ne.symm h])

name: NLAlib.L2_expand
statement:
private lemma L2_expand (u v : p × m → ℝ) (G : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    L u G * L v G = ∑ e2, ∑ e1, (u e1 * v e2) * (G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [L, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.L4_expand
proof:
:= by
  simp only [L, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_L2
statement:
private lemma integrable_L2 (u v : p × m → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G => L u G * L v G) (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [L2_expand]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun e2 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ =>
    (integrable_mono2 e1 e2).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integrable_L4
statement:
private lemma integrable_L4 (u v w z : p × m → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G => L u G * L v G * L w G * L z G) (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [L4_expand]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun e4 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e3 _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun e2 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ =>
    (integrable_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix e1 e2 e3 e4).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_L2
statement:
private lemma integral_L2 (u v : p × m → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, L u G * L v G ∂(gaussianMatrix p m) = ip u v
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [L2_expand]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun e2 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ =>
    (integrable_mono2 e1 e2).const_mul _]
  have : ∀ e2, ∫ G, ∑ e1, (u e1 * v e2) * (G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2) ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = ∑ e1, (u e1 * v e2) * (if e1 = e2 then 1 else 0) := by
    intro e2
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ => (integrable_mono2 e1 e2).const_mul _]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e1 _ => by rw [integral_const_mul, integral_mono2]
  simp_rw [this]
  simp [ip, mul_ite]

name: NLAlib.integral_L4
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [L4_expand]
  have hI : ∀ e1 e2 e3 e4 : p × m, Integrable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ =>
      (u e1 * v e2 * w e3 * z e4) * (G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2 * G e3.1 e3.2 * G e4.1 e4.2))
      (gaussianMatrix p m) := fun e1 e2 e3 e4 =>
    (integrable_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix e1 e2 e3 e4).const_mul _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun e4 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e3 _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun e2 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ => hI e1 e2 e3 e4]
  have : ∀ e4, ∫ G, ∑ e3, ∑ e2, ∑ e1, (u e1 * v e2 * w e3 * z e4) *
      (G e1.1 e1.2 * G e2.1 e2.2 * G e3.1 e3.2 * G e4.1 e4.2) ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = ∑ e3, ∑ e2, ∑ e1, (u e1 * v e2 * w e3 * z e4) *
      ((if e1 = e2 then 1 else 0) * (if e3 = e4 then 1 else 0)
        + (if e1 = e3 then 1 else 0) * (if e2 = e4 then 1 else 0)
        + (if e1 = e4 then 1 else 0) * (if e2 = e3 then 1 else 0)) := by
    intro e4
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun e3 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e2 _ =>
      integrable_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ => hI e1 e2 e3 e4]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e3 _ => ?_
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun e2 _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ => hI e1 e2 e3 e4]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e2 _ => ?_
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun e1 _ => hI e1 e2 e3 e4]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e1 _ => ?_
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_entry_mul_four_gaussianMatrix]
  simp_rw [this]
  simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_ite, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  simp only [ip, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  congr 1; congr 1
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.linForm_eq_L
statement:
private lemma linForm_eq_L (c : p → m → ℝ) (G : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    linForm c G = L (Function.uncurry c) G
proof:
:= by
  simp only [linForm, L, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Function.uncurry]

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_mul_eq_ip
statement:
private lemma sum_sum_mul_eq_ip (u v : p → m → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, u i j * v i j = ip (Function.uncurry u) (Function.uncurry v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ip, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Function.uncurry]

name: NLAlib.integrable_linForm_mul_two_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_linForm_mul_two_gaussianMatrix (u v : p → m → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G => linForm u G * linForm v G) (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [linForm_eq_L]
  exact integrable_L2 _ _

name: NLAlib.integrable_linForm_mul_four_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_linForm_mul_four_gaussianMatrix (u v w z : p → m → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G => linForm u G * linForm v G * linForm w G * linForm z G)
      (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [linForm_eq_L]
  exact integrable_L4 _ _ _ _

name: NLAlib.integral_linForm_mul_two_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_linForm_mul_two_gaussianMatrix (u v : p → m → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, linForm u G * linForm v G ∂(gaussianMatrix p m) = ∑ i, ∑ j, u i j * v i j
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [linForm_eq_L, sum_sum_mul_eq_ip]
  exact integral_L2 _ _

name: NLAlib.integral_linForm_mul_four_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_linForm_mul_four_gaussianMatrix (u v w z : p → m → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, linForm u G * linForm v G * linForm w G * linForm z G ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = (∑ i, ∑ j, u i j * v i j) * (∑ i, ∑ j, w i j * z i j)
        + (∑ i, ∑ j, u i j * w i j) * (∑ i, ∑ j, v i j * z i j)
        + (∑ i, ∑ j, u i j * z i j) * (∑ i, ∑ j, v i j * w i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [linForm_eq_L, sum_sum_mul_eq_ip]
  exact integral_L4 _ _ _ _

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_gram_comm
statement:
private lemma sum_sq_gram_comm {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (S : ι → κ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ k, (∑ c, S i c * S k c) ^ 2 = ∑ c, ∑ d, (∑ i, S i c * S i d) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  calc _ = ∑ i, ∑ c, ∑ k, ∑ d, S i c * S k c * (S i d * S k d) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ d, S i c * S k c * (S i d * S k d) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ i, ∑ d, ∑ k, S i c * S k c * (S i d * S k d) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ i, ∑ k, S i c * S k c * (S i d * S k d) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.entry_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, L, uST, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.ip_uST
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ip, uST, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sq_eq
statement:
private lemma frobSq_sq_eq (S : Matrix a p ℝ) (T : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (G : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    frobSq (S * G * T) ^ 2 = ∑ x : a × n, ∑ y : a × n,
      L (uST S T x) G * L (uST S T x) G * L (uST S T y) G * L (uST S T y) G
proof:
:= by
  have : frobSq (S * G * T) = ∑ x : a × n, L (uST S T x) G ^ 2 := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, entry_eq, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [this, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_sq
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_sq (S : Matrix a p ℝ)
    (T : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∫ G, frobSq (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = (frobSq S * frobSq T) ^ 2 + 2 * frobSq (Sᵀ * S) * frobSq (T * Tᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  have hL4 : ∀ u v w z : p × m → ℝ,
      ∫ G, L u G * L v G * L w G * L z G ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
        = ip u v * ip w z + ip u w * ip v z + ip u z * ip v w :=
    integral_L4
  have hI4 : ∀ u v w z : p × m → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun G => L u G * L v G * L w G * L z G) (gaussianMatrix p m) :=
    integrable_L4
  simp_rw [frobSq_sq_eq]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun x _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun y _ => hI4 _ _ _ _]
  have h1 : ∀ x : a × n, ∫ G, ∑ y : a × n,
      L (uST S T x) G * L (uST S T x) G * L (uST S T y) G * L (uST S T y) G
        ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = ∑ y : a × n, (ip (uST S T x) (uST S T x) * ip (uST S T y) (uST S T y)
          + 2 * ip (uST S T x) (uST S T y) ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun y _ => hI4 _ _ _ _]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by rw [hL4]; ring
  simp_rw [h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ip_uST]
  have hS : ∑ i, ∑ c, S i c * S i c = frobSq S := by simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, sq]
  have hT : ∑ j, ∑ b, T b j * T b j = frobSq T := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, sq]
  have hP : ∑ x : a × n, (∑ c, S x.1 c * S x.1 c) * (∑ b, T b x.2 * T b x.2)
      = frobSq S * frobSq T := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← hS, ← hT, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  have hS2 : ∑ i, ∑ k, (∑ c, S i c * S k c) ^ 2 = frobSq (Sᵀ * S) := by
    have := sum_sq_gram_comm (fun i c => S i c)
    rw [this]; simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hT2 : ∑ j, ∑ l, (∑ b, T b j * T b l) ^ 2 = frobSq (T * Tᵀ) := by
    have := sum_sq_gram_comm (fun j b => T b j)
    rw [this]; simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hQ : ∑ x : a × n, ∑ y : a × n,
      ((∑ c, S x.1 c * S y.1 c) * (∑ b, T b x.2 * T b y.2)) ^ 2
      = frobSq (Sᵀ * S) * frobSq (T * Tᵀ) := by
    rw [← hS2, ← hT2]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_pow]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hP, hQ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_sq_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_sq_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → Matrix p m ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix p m) μ)
    (S : Matrix a p ℝ) (T : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (S * X ω * T) ^ 2 ∂μ
      = (frobSq S * frobSq T) ^ 2 + 2 * frobSq (Sᵀ * S) * frobSq (T * Tᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => frobSq (S * G * T) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]; fun_prop
  rw [← integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_sq S T]
  exact hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.gaussianPDFReal_zero_one_le_half
statement: theorem gaussianPDFReal_zero_one_le_half (x : ℝ) : gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPDFReal_def]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
  have hden : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hinv : (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hden
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).trans
    (by simpa only [mul_one] using hinv)

name: NLAlib.gaussianReal_abs_le_le_ofReal
statement:
theorem gaussianReal_abs_le_le_ofReal {a : ℝ} (_ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    gaussianReal 0 1 {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ a} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a
proof:
:= by
  have hSet : {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ a} = Icc (-a) a := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Icc, abs_le]
  rw [hSet, gaussianReal_apply 0 (by norm_num : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0)]
  calc
    (∫⁻ x in Icc (-a) a, gaussianPDF 0 1 x) ≤
        ∫⁻ _ in Icc (-a) a, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro x
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (gaussianPDFReal_zero_one_le_half x)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * a) := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Icc]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
      congr 1
      ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianLogOverlap_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianLogOverlap_nonneg {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ gaussianLogOverlap g
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.log_nonneg
  have h : 0 ≤ (∑ j : Fin n, g j.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2 :=
    div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measurable_gaussianLogOverlap
statement: theorem measurable_gaussianLogOverlap (n : ℕ) : Measurable (@gaussianLogOverlap n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianLogOverlap
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.gaussianReal_div_sq_gt_le_ofReal_sqrt
statement:
theorem gaussianReal_div_sq_gt_le_ofReal_sqrt {s u : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hu : 0 < u) :
    gaussianReal 0 1 {x : ℝ | u < s / x ^ 2} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (s / u))
proof:
:= by
  apply (measure_mono (show {x : ℝ | u < s / x ^ 2} ⊆
      {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ Real.sqrt (s / u)} from ?_)).trans
      (gaussianReal_abs_le_le_ofReal (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  intro x hx
  change u < s / x ^ 2 at hx
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · simp only [hx0, zero_pow two_ne_zero, div_zero] at hx
    linarith
  · apply (Real.le_sqrt (abs_nonneg x) (div_nonneg hs hu.le)).mpr
    rw [sq_abs, le_div_iff₀ hu]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using ((lt_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx0)).mp hx).le

name: NLAlib.integrable_sqrt_sum_sq_pi_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integrable_sqrt_sum_sq_pi_gaussianReal (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun g : Fin n → ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ i, g i ^ 2))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] using
    integrable_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector n (1 / 2) (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.integral_sqrt_sum_sq_pi_gaussianReal_le
statement:
theorem integral_sqrt_sum_sq_pi_gaussianReal_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : Fin n → ℝ, Real.sqrt (∑ i, g i ^ 2)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)) ≤ Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving (fun G : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin n) ℝ => G 0)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin n)) (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    measurePreserving_gaussianMatrix_row 0
  have hm : Measurable (fun g : Fin n → ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ i, g i ^ 2)) := by fun_prop
  have h := integral_map (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin n)) hmp.measurable.aemeasurable
    (f := fun g : Fin n → ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ i, g i ^ 2)) hm.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [hmp.map_eq] at h
  exact h.trans_le (integral_sqrt_sum_sq_gaussianMatrix_entry_le (fun i : Fin n => i))

name: NLAlib.prod_gaussianReal_energy_ratio_gt_le
statement:
theorem prod_gaussianReal_energy_ratio_gt_le (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    ((gaussianReal 0 1).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1))
      {p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) | u < (∑ i, p.2 i ^ 2) / p.1 ^ 2} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n / u))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1
  have hm : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) | u < (∑ i, p.2 i ^ 2) / p.1 ^ 2} := by
    apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
    fun_prop
  rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm hm]
  change (∫⁻ g : Fin n → ℝ, gaussianReal 0 1 {x | u < (∑ i, g i ^ 2) / x ^ 2} ∂μ) ≤ _
  have hi := (integrable_sqrt_sum_sq_pi_gaussianReal n).div_const (Real.sqrt u)
  calc
    (∫⁻ g : Fin n → ℝ, gaussianReal 0 1 {x | u < (∑ i, g i ^ 2) / x ^ 2} ∂μ) ≤
        ∫⁻ g : Fin n → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ i, g i ^ 2) / Real.sqrt u) ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro g
      simpa only [Real.sqrt_div (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)] using
        gaussianReal_div_sq_gt_le_ofReal_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) hu
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ g : Fin n → ℝ, Real.sqrt (∑ i, g i ^ 2) ∂μ) / Real.sqrt u) := by
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi
        (ae_of_all _ fun g => div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)), integral_div]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt u) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (integral_sqrt_sum_sq_pi_gaussianReal_le n) (Real.sqrt_nonneg u))
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_div (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]

name: NLAlib.pi_gaussianReal_energy_ratio_gt_le
statement:
theorem pi_gaussianReal_energy_ratio_gt_le (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      {g | u < (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n / u))
proof:
:= by
  let e := MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0
  have hmp := measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1) 0
  have he : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      {g | u < (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2} =
      ((gaussianReal 0 1).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1))
        {p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) | u < (∑ i, p.2 i ^ 2) / p.1 ^ 2} := by
    rw [← hmp.map_eq, e.map_apply]
    congr 1
  rw [he]
  exact prod_gaussianReal_energy_ratio_gt_le n hu

name: NLAlib.pi_gaussianReal_logOverlap_gt_le
statement:
theorem pi_gaussianReal_logOverlap_gt_le (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : Real.log (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ t) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1) {g | t < gaussianLogOverlap g} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-t / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
  have hExp : 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp t := by
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ht
    rwa [Real.exp_log (mul_pos (by norm_num) hn)] at h
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hExp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp t := by push_cast at hExp; linarith
  have hu : 0 < Real.exp t - 1 := by linarith
  have he : {g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | t < gaussianLogOverlap g} =
      {g | Real.exp t - 1 < (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2} := by
    ext g
    change (t < Real.log (1 + (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2)) ↔
      (Real.exp t - 1 < (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2)
    have hR : 0 ≤ (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2 :=
      div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by linarith : 0 < 1 + (∑ i : Fin n, g i.succ ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2)]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  have hdiv : (n : ℝ) / (Real.exp t - 1) ≤ (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.exp t := by
    have h1 : 1 / (Real.exp t - 1) ≤ 2 / Real.exp t := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hu (Real.exp_pos t)).mpr
      linarith
    calc (n : ℝ) / (Real.exp t - 1) = n * (1 / (Real.exp t - 1)) := by ring
      _ ≤ n * (2 / Real.exp t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hn0
      _ = (2 * n) / Real.exp t := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by push_cast; linarith) (Real.exp_pos t).le
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdiv
  rw [Real.sqrt_div (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)), ← Real.exp_half] at hs
  have hbound : Real.sqrt (n / (Real.exp t - 1)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-t / 2) := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_mul] using hs
  rw [he]
  exact (pi_gaussianReal_energy_ratio_gt_le n hu).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound)

name: NLAlib.gaussianLogOverlap_eq_log_sum_div_sq
statement:
theorem gaussianLogOverlap_eq_log_sum_div_sq {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    gaussianLogOverlap g = Real.log ((∑ i, g i ^ 2) / (g 0) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g 0 = 0
  · simp only [gaussianLogOverlap, hg, zero_pow two_ne_zero, div_zero, add_zero,
      Real.log_one, Real.log_zero]
  · unfold gaussianLogOverlap
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    congr 1
    field_simp

name: NLAlib.frobSq_expand
statement:
private lemma frobSq_expand {ι κ p m : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype p] [Fintype m]
    (S : Matrix ι p ℝ) (T : Matrix m κ ℝ) (G : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    frobSq (S * G * T) = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ c, ∑ b, ∑ d,
      (S i k * T b j * S i c * T d j) * (G k b * G c d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have h : (S * G * T) i j = ∑ k, ∑ b, S i k * G k b * T b j := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  rw [h, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_quadratic
statement:
private lemma integral_quadratic {ι κ p m : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype p] [Fintype m]
    (w : ι → κ → p → p → m → m → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ c, ∑ b, ∑ d, w i j k c b d * (G k b * G c d))
        ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ b, w i j k k b b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hI : ∀ (k c : p) (b : m) (f : m → ℝ),
      Integrable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => ∑ d, f d * (G k b * G c d))
        (gaussianMatrix p m) :=
    fun k c b f => integrable_finsetSum _ fun d _ =>
      integrable_const_mul_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul k c b d _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun c _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hI k c b _]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun c _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hI k c b _]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun c _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hI k c b _]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun c _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hI k c b _]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hI k k b _]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun d _ => integrable_const_mul_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul k k b d _]
    simp [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul]
  · intro c _ hck
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun b _ => hI k c b _]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun d _ => integrable_const_mul_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul k c b d _]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun d _ => ?_
    simp [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul, Ne.symm hck]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (S : Matrix ι p ℝ) (T : Matrix m κ ℝ) :
    ∫ G, frobSq (S * G * T) ∂(gaussianMatrix p m) = frobSq S * frobSq T
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [frobSq_expand]
  rw [integral_quadratic (fun i j k c b d => S i k * T b j * S i c * T d j)]
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ι κ p m : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype p] [Fintype m]
    {X : Ω → Matrix p m ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix p m) μ) (S : Matrix ι p ℝ)
    (T : Matrix m κ ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (S * X ω * T) ∂μ = frobSq S * frobSq T
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => frobSq (S * G * T) := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]; fun_prop
  rw [← integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul S T]
  exact hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_ae_eval_ne_zero (p m : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin m) ℝ)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)), MvPolynomial.eval (fun ab => G ab.1 ab.2) f ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose {k t : ℕ} (h : k ≤ t) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin t)), IsUnit (G * Gᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := Matrix.det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose_ne_zero h
  filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_eval_ne_zero k t _ hP] with G hG

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_transpose_mul

    ∀ᵐ G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin t)), IsUnit (Gᵀ * G)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := Matrix.det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul_ne_zero h
  filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_eval_ne_zero k t _ hP] with G hG
  rw [Matrix.eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul] at hG

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_rank_eq
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_ae_rank_eq (p m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)), G.rank = min p m
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total p m with h | h
  · filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose h] with G hu
    have h1 := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hu
    have h2 := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left G Gᵀ
    have h3 := Matrix.rank_le_height G
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    rw [min_eq_left h]; omega
  · filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_transpose_mul h] with G hu
    have h1 := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hu
    have h2 := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Gᵀ G
    have h3 := Matrix.rank_le_width G
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    rw [min_eq_right h]; omega

name: NLAlib.exists_even_reciprocal_interpolation
statement:
private theorem exists_even_reciprocal_interpolation {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 < p) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ), 0 < k ∧ p < ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * p ∧ θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let k := ⌈p / 2⌉₊ + 1
  let q : ℝ := (2 * k : ℕ)
  have hk : 0 < k := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hqlo : p < q := by
    have hh := Nat.le_ceil (p / 2)
    dsimp [k, q]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hqhi : q ≤ 4 * p := by
    have hh := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ p / 2 by linarith)
    dsimp [q, k]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < q := hp0.trans hqlo
  have hpi : 1 / p < (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hp0 (by norm_num)).mpr
    linarith
  have hqi : 1 / q < 1 / p := by
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hq0 hp0).mpr
    linarith
  let d : ℝ := 1 / 2 - 1 / q
  let a : ℝ := 1 / 2 - 1 / p
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have had : a < d := by dsimp [a, d]; linarith
  let θ := a / d
  have hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨div_pos ha hd, (div_lt_one hd).mpr had⟩
  have hmul : θ * d = a := div_mul_cancel₀ a hd.ne'
  refine ⟨k, θ, hk, hqlo, hqhi, hθ, ?_⟩
  change 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q
  dsimp [d, a] at hmul
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hmul ⊢
  nlinarith
