name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_smul_rpow_root
statement:
private theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_smul_rpow_root
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) {p c : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (c • b) G) p ^ p
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹ =
        c * (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
          ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_profile_real_smul,
    schattenNormReal_real_smul_complex _ _ hp, abs_of_nonneg hc,
    Real.mul_rpow hc (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)]
  rw [integral_const_mul, Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hc _)
    (integral_nonneg fun G => Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _),
    Real.rpow_rpow_inv hc hp.ne']

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_two_lt
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_two_lt
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 < p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      96 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        2 * Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hD : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _
  have hE : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  by_cases hbzero : b = 0
  · have hz (G : Matrix n n ℝ) : symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G = 0 := by
      ext i j
      simp [symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix, hbzero]
    simp_rw [hz, schattenNormReal_zero hp0, Real.zero_rpow hp0.ne', integral_zero,
      Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero hp0.ne')]
    positivity
  obtain ⟨k, θ, hk, hkp, hqhi, hθ, hexp⟩ := exists_even_reciprocal_interpolation hp
  let q : ℝ := ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let c : ℝ := Real.sqrt q
  let A : ℝ := (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹
  let E : ℝ := (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
  let K : ℝ := A + c * E
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := Real.rpow_nonneg hD _
  have hEnn : 0 ≤ E := Real.rpow_nonneg hE _
  have hq0 : 0 < q := hp0.trans hkp
  have hc : 0 < c := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := by
    change 1 ≤ Real.sqrt q
    exact Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr (by linarith)
  have hEpos : 0 < E := by
    have hbn : ∃ i j, b i j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! hh
      exact hbzero (by ext i j; exact hh i j)
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := hbn
    have hh : 0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p :=
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hij) p).trans_le
        ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) p) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
            Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) p) (Finset.mem_univ i)))
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hh _
  have hK : 0 < K := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hA (mul_pos hc hEpos)
  have hApow : A ^ p = ∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) := Real.rpow_inv_rpow hD hp0.ne'
  have hEpow : E ^ p = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p := Real.rpow_inv_rpow hE hp0.ne'
  have hAK : A ≤ K := le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hc.le hEnn)
  have hcθ : c ^ θ ≤ c := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hc1 hθ.2.le
  have hcEK : c ^ θ * E ≤ K :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcθ hEnn).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hA)
  let bn : Matrix n n ℂ := K⁻¹ • b
  have hbn : bn.IsSymm := hb.smul _
  have hnorm (i j : n) : ‖bn i j‖ = K⁻¹ * ‖b i j‖ := by
    simp only [bn, Matrix.smul_apply, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hK)]
  have hrowbn : (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖bn i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) =
      K⁻¹ ^ p * ∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) := by
    simp_rw [hnorm, mul_pow, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      Real.mul_rpow (sq_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)]
    have he : (K⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) = K⁻¹ ^ p := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast K⁻¹ 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hK.le)]
      congr 1
      norm_num
      ring
    rw [he, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hentrybn : (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖bn i j‖ ^ p) = K⁻¹ ^ p * ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p := by
    simp_rw [hnorm, Real.mul_rpow (inv_nonneg.mpr hK.le) (norm_nonneg _), ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hcancel : K⁻¹ ^ p * K ^ p = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (inv_nonneg.mpr hK.le) hK.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hK.ne', Real.one_rpow]
  have hrow1 : (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖bn i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hrowbn, ← hApow]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow hA hAK hp0.le)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hK.le) _)).trans_eq hcancel
  have hentry1 : c ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖bn i j‖ ^ p) ≤ 1 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _) hEnn) hcEK hp0.le)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hK.le) p)
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _) hEnn, ← Real.rpow_mul hc.le, hEpow] at hh
    rw [hentrybn]
    calc
      _ = K⁻¹ ^ p * (c ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p)) := by ring
      _ ≤ K⁻¹ ^ p * K ^ p := hh
      _ = 1 := hcancel
  have hn := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_normalized_profiles
    bn hbn k hk p hp hkp θ hθ hexp hrow1 hentry1
  have hscale : b = K • bn := by
    dsimp [bn]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hK.ne', one_smul]
  have hrootScale := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_smul_rpow_root bn hp0 hK.le
  rw [← hscale] at hrootScale
  rw [hrootScale]
  have hcBound : c ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt p := by
    have hh := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hqhi
    have hs : Real.sqrt (4 * p) = 2 * Real.sqrt p := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    rwa [hs] at hh
  calc
    _ ≤ K * 96 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hK.le
    _ ≤ _ := by dsimp [K, A, E]; nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcBound hEnn]

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (ENNReal.ofReal p) ^ p
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      512 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  simp only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ hp0.le]
  by_cases hp2 : p = 2
  · subst p
    simp only [Real.rpow_two]
    have hh := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le b hb 1 (by omega)
    norm_num only [Nat.mul_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul] at hh
    simp only [one_div] at hh
    apply hh.trans
    have hA : 0 ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _
    have hB : 0 ≤ (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ 2) ^ ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) _
    have hsqrt : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) := Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr (by norm_num)
    norm_num only [div_self (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), Real.rpow_one]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hsqrt) hB]
  · have hpgt : 2 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp (Ne.symm hp2)
    let bc : Matrix n n ℂ := b.map Complex.ofReal
    have hbc : bc.IsSymm := by
      ext i j
      change (b j i : ℂ) = (b i j : ℂ)
      rw [hb.apply i j]
    have hX (G : Matrix n n ℝ) : symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix bc G =
        (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G).map Complex.ofReal := by
      ext i j
      simp [bc, symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix, symmetricGaussianMatrix]
    have hnorm (G : Matrix n n ℝ) :
        schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix bc G) p =
          schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p := by
      rw [hX]
      have hs (i : ℕ) : singularValues ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G).map Complex.ofReal) i =
          singularValues (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i :=
        singularValues_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) _ i
      simp only [schattenNormReal, hs]
    have hcomplex := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_two_lt bc hbc hpgt
    have hh : (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
        96 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
          2 * Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ^ p⁻¹) := by
      simpa only [hnorm, bc, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (hb0 _ _)] using hcomplex
    have hconvert := sqrt_mul_sum_entry_rpow_root_le_two_row_profiles b hb0 hp
    have hA : 0 ≤ (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _) _
    have hB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg p)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) _)
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_boundary_bounds
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_boundary_bounds
    {θ p₀ p₁ p M₀ M₁ B : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hp₀ : 1 < p₀) (hp₁ : 1 < p₁) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / p₀ + θ / p₁)
    (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁)
    (F : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, specNorm (F z) ≤ B)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) G) p₀ ^ p₀
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (1 / p₀) ≤ M₀)
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) G) p₁ ^ p₁
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (1 / p₁) ≤ M₁) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F (θ : ℂ)) G) p ^ p
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (1 / p) ≤ M₀ ^ (1 - θ) * M₁ ^ θ
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianMatrix n n
  have hraw : Integrable (id : Matrix n n ℝ → Matrix n n ℝ) μ :=
    ((hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianMatrix n n).memLp (by simp : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞)).integrable le_rfl
  have hmem := memLp_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F (θ : ℂ))
    (ENNReal.ofReal p) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  rw [one_div]
  apply integral_schattenNormReal_rpow_root_le_of_finitePartitionMean_le hp.le hmem
    (M₀ ^ (1 - θ) * M₁ ^ θ) (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hM₀ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hM₁ _))
  intro k cell hcell
  let a : Fin k → Matrix n n ℝ := finitePartitionMean μ cell id
  let H : Fin k → ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i z => symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z) (a i)
  have hmean (z : ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
      finitePartitionMean μ cell (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z)) i = H i z := by
    let T := (symmetricComplexGaussianSampleLinearMap (F z)).toContinuousLinearMap
    exact finitePartitionMean_comp_continuousLinearMap cell hraw T i
  have hH (i : Fin k) : DiffContOnCl ℂ (H i) (Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    let L := (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrixLinearMap (a i)).toContinuousLinearMap
    exact ⟨L.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hF.differentiableOn,
      L.continuous.comp_continuousOn hF.continuousOn⟩
  let C : Fin k → ℝ := fun i => ‖(symmetricComplexGaussianMatrixLinearMap (a i)).toContinuousLinearMap‖ * B
  have hHb (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ)
      (hz : z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1) : specNorm (H i z) ≤ C i := by
    let L := (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrixLinearMap (a i)).toContinuousLinearMap
    change ‖L (F z)‖ ≤ ‖L‖ * B
    exact (L.le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hbound z hz)
      (norm_nonneg L))
  have haverage (z : ℂ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
      (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) * schattenNormReal (H i z) q ^ q) ^ (1 / q) ≤
        (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z) G) q ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q) := by
    have h : (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) *
        schattenNormReal (finitePartitionMean μ cell (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z)) i) q ^ q) ≤
          ∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z) G) q ^ q ∂μ :=
      sum_mul_schattenNormReal_finitePartitionMean_rpow_le_integral cell hcell
        (f := symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z))
        (integrable_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F z)) hq hq
        (integrable_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow (F z) hq)
    simp_rw [hmean] at h
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      mul_nonneg (measureReal_nonneg) (Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _)) h
      (one_div_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hq))
  have hfinite := sum_mul_schattenNormReal_rpow_root_le_of_finite_boundary_bounds
    (fun i => μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i})) (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg)
    hθ hp₀ hp₁ hp hexp H hH C hHb
    (fun t => (haverage _ p₀ hp₀.le).trans (hleft t))
    (fun t => (haverage _ p₁ hp₁.le).trans (hright t))
  rw [one_div] at hfinite
  have hsum :
      (∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) *
        schattenNormReal (finitePartitionMean μ cell (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F (θ : ℂ))) i) p ^ p) =
      ∑ i, μ.real (cell ⁻¹' {i}) * schattenNormReal (H i (θ : ℂ)) p ^ p := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [hmean]
  rw [hsum]
  exact hfinite

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_normalized_profiles
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_normalized_profiles
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (p : ℝ) (hp2 : 2 < p) (hkp : p < ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ))
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hrow : (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤ 1)
    (hentry : (Real.sqrt ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ 96
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hq : 1 < q := lt_trans (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) < p) hkp
  have hq0 : 0 < q := zero_lt_one.trans hq
  have hc : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hhalf : q / 2 = k := by dsimp [q]; push_cast; ring
  obtain ⟨F, B, hF, hFs, hFc, _hB, hbnd, hleft, hrightRow, hrightEntry⟩ :=
    exists_entire_symmetric_profile_family hp2.le hq0 hθ hc hexp b hb hrow hentry
  have hleftMoment (t : ℝ) :
      (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) G) 2 ^ (2 : ℝ)
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) ≤ 2 := by
    simp only [Real.rpow_two]
    rw [integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_sq _ (hFs _), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).2 (by norm_num; exact hleft t)
  have hrightMoment (t : ℝ) :
      (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) G) q ^ q
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (1 / q) ≤ 96 := by
    let A : ℝ := (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ 2) ^ k) ^ q⁻¹
    let E : ℝ := (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ q) ^ q⁻¹
    have hA : A ≤ 1 := by
      have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => pow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) _)
        (by simpa only [hhalf, Real.rpow_natCast] using hrightRow t) (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      simpa only [Real.one_rpow] using h
    have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ q :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    have hcap : (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ q) ≤ (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ ^ q := by
      apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc q)).mp
      rw [← Real.mul_rpow hc.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le), mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', Real.one_rpow]
      exact hrightEntry t
    have hE : E ≤ (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ := by
      have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow hS hcap (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      simpa only [Real.rpow_rpow_inv (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le) hq0.ne'] using h
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt q := by
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      dsimp [q]
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≤ 2 * k)
    have hprod : Real.sqrt k * E ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt k * (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt q * (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrt (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
        _ = _ := mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne'
    have heven := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
      (F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (hFs _) k hk
    have hmoment :
        (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix (F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) G) q ^ q
          ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (1 / q) ≤ 48 * (A + Real.sqrt k * E) := by
      simpa only [q, A, E, Real.rpow_natCast, one_div] using heven
    exact hmoment.trans (by linarith)
  have hinterp :=
    integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_of_boundary_bounds
      hθ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2) hq (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) < p)
      hexp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 96) F
      ⟨hF.differentiableOn, hF.continuous.continuousOn⟩ hbnd hleftMoment hrightMoment
  rw [hFc, one_div] at hinterp
  apply hinterp.trans
  have h := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hθ.2.le) hθ.1.le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 96) (by ring : 1 - θ + θ = 1)
  exact h.trans (by nlinarith [hθ.2])

name: NLAlib.one_le_gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant
statement: theorem one_le_gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant : 1 ≤ gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant
  have hA := gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant_pos
  have hκ := gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos
  have hc := gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos
  have hi : 0 ≤ gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hd : 0 ≤ 32 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant := by positivity
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant_le_mean
statement:
theorem gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant_le_mean :
    gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant ≤ gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant
  have hA := gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant_pos
  have hκ := gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos
  have hc := gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos
  have hi : 0 ≤ gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hd : 0 ≤ 32 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant := by positivity
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_rowMixedNorm_top_le
statement:
private theorem integral_rowMixedNorm_top_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) ⊤ ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:=
  integral_mono (integrable_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix A (by simp))
    (integrable_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix A hp)
    (fun G => rowMixedNorm_top_le _ (le_trans (by norm_num) hp))

name: NLAlib.finite_sorted_mean_bound
statement:
private theorem finite_sorted_mean_bound {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hanti : Antitone (fun i => ‖A i‖)) {b p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hweight : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ b)
    (hblog : b ≤ (2 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant) *
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant *
        ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hpE : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hp
  let R := ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
    ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := integral_nonneg fun G => rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _
  let r := ⌈Real.exp p⌉₊
  let T := principalTailPart A r
  let m := principalTailEntryBound A r
  have hT : T.IsSymm := isSymm_principalTailPart A hA r
  have hT0 (i j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ T i j := by
    dsimp [T, principalTailPart]
    split_ifs
    · exact hA0 i j
    · exact le_rfl
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := principalTailEntryBound_nonneg A r
  have hcap (i j : Fin n) : T i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 :=
    principalTailPart_sq_le_entryBound_sq A hanti r i j
  have hsmall : Real.sqrt p * m ≤ b :=
    sqrt_mul_principalTailEntryBound_ceil_exp_le A hb hweight
  have htailMean : (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix T G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ R :=
    integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_principalTailPart_le A r hpE
  have htailRoot := integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_integral_add
    T hm hcap hpE hp
  have htailCaps := sqrt_mul_rowMax_profile_root_le_four_mul_integral_rowMixedNorm_rpow_root
    T hT hT0 hp
  have hcaps : Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖T i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      (4 + 32 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant) * R := by
    change b ≤ (2 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant) * R at hblog
    calc
      _ ≤ 4 * R + 16 * b := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ 4 * R + 16 * ((2 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant) * R) := by
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  have henergy := gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_rowMixedNorm_le_integral A hA
    (p := ENNReal.ofReal p) (le_trans (by norm_num) hpE)
  have henergy' : (∑ i, (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant⁻¹ * R := by
    have hformula := rowMixedNorm_ofReal_eq_sum_rowSq A hp0
    simp only [rowSq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, one_div] at hformula
    rw [hformula] at henergy
    have hdiv : (∑ i, (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
        R / gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant :=
      (le_div_iff₀ gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos).mpr (by
        simpa only [mul_comm] using henergy)
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hdiv
  have hop : (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant * R := by
    apply (integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_top A hA hA0).trans
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_rowMixedNorm_top_le A hpE)
      gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant_pos.le
  have hhead : 2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) *
      (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G)
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      32 * gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant * R := by
    have hfactor := Real.two_mul_two_mul_ceil_exp_rpow_le hp
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G)
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) := integral_nonneg fun G => specNorm_nonneg _
    calc
      _ ≤ 32 * (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfactor hnonneg
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith
  have hmain := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_head_tail_moments A hA hA0 r hp
  change (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p
    ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant * R
  dsimp only [gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant]
  change (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p
    ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ _ at hmain
  dsimp only [T] at hcaps
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant *
        ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
          ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hpE : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hp
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p := le_trans (by norm_num) hpE
  let e := sortingEquiv (fun i => ‖A i‖)
  let S := A.submatrix e e
  have hS : S.IsSymm := hA.submatrix e
  have hS0 (i j : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) : 0 ≤ S i j := hA0 (e i) (e j)
  have hrow (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) : ‖S i‖ = ‖A (e i)‖ :=
    e.surjective.pi_norm_comp (A (e i))
  have hanti : Antitone (fun i => ‖S i‖) := by
    simpa only [hrow, e, sortedVector, Function.comp_def] using
      sortedVector_antitone (fun i => ‖A i‖)
  have hweight (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) :
      ‖S i‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ profileLogRowMaximum A := by
    rw [hrow]
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm
      (fun l : Fin (Fintype.card ι) => ‖A (e l)‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (l.val + 1))) i
    simpa only [profileLogRowMaximum, e, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity :
      0 ≤ ‖A (e i)‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)))] using h
  have hmean := integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix e A hA hp1
  have hblog : profileLogRowMaximum A ≤ (2 / gaussianMaximumLowerConstant) *
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix S G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) := by
    rw [show (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix S G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) (Fin (Fintype.card ι))) =
        ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) (ENNReal.ofReal p)
          ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι from hmean]
    exact (profileLogRowMaximum_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_top A hA hA0).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_rowMixedNorm_top_le A hpE)
        (div_nonneg (by norm_num) gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos.le))
  have hbound := finite_sorted_mean_bound S hS hS0 hanti hp
    (profileLogRowMaximum_nonneg A) hweight hblog
  have hsch := integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix e A hA
    (p := ENNReal.ofReal p) hp1
  simp only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ hp0.le] at hsch
  rw [hsch, hmean] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant *
        ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    simp only [schattenNorm_top]
    apply (integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_top A hA hA0).trans
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right gaussianRowOperatorComparisonConstant_le_mean
      (integral_nonneg fun G => rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _)
  · have hpr : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p.toReal := by
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat] using ENNReal.toReal_mono hpt hp
    have h := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm A hA hA0 hpr
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hpt] at h
    simpa only [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt] using h

name: NLAlib.L_eq_linForm
statement:
private lemma L_eq_linForm (u : Fin n × Fin t → ℝ) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) :

proof:
:= by

statement:

name: NLAlib.L_col
statement:
private lemma L_col (f : Fin n → ℝ) (ℓ : Fin t) (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) :

:= by

name: NLAlib.ip_col
statement:
private lemma ip_col (f g : Fin n → ℝ) (ℓ ℓ' : Fin t) :
    ip (col f ℓ) (col g ℓ') = if ℓ = ℓ' then ∑ k, f k * g k else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ℓ = ℓ'
  · subst h; simp [ip, col, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  · simp [ip, col, Fintype.sum_prod_type, h]

name: NLAlib.entry_sq_expand
statement:
private lemma entry_sq_expand (f g : Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) :
    (r * ∑ ℓ, L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω - ∑ k, f k * g k) ^ 2
      = r ^ 2 * (∑ ℓ, ∑ ℓ', L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω * L (col f ℓ') Ω * L (col g ℓ') Ω)
        - 2 * r * (∑ k, f k * g k) * (∑ ℓ, L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω)
        + (∑ k, f k * g k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have : (∑ ℓ, L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω) ^ 2
      = ∑ ℓ, ∑ ℓ', L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω * L (col f ℓ') Ω * L (col g ℓ') Ω := by
    rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
  rw [← this]; ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_entry_sq
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [entry_sq_expand]
  refine ((Integrable.const_mul ?_ _).sub (Integrable.const_mul ?_ _)).add (integrable_const _)
  · exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun ℓ _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun ℓ' _ =>
      integrable_L4 _ _ _ _
  · exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun ℓ _ => integrable_L2 _ _

name: NLAlib.integral_entry_sq
statement:
private lemma integral_entry_sq (ht : 1 ≤ t) (f g : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∫ Ω, ((1 / (t : ℝ)) * ∑ ℓ, L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω - ∑ k, f k * g k) ^ 2
        ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t))
      = ((∑ k, f k ^ 2) * (∑ k, g k ^ 2) + (∑ k, f k * g k) ^ 2) / t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [entry_sq_expand]
  have i4 := integrable_finsetSum (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) Finset.univ fun ℓ _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun ℓ' _ =>
      integrable_L4 (col f ℓ) (col g ℓ) (col f ℓ') (col g ℓ')
  have i2 := integrable_finsetSum (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) Finset.univ fun ℓ _ =>
      integrable_L2 (col f ℓ) (col g ℓ)
  rw [integral_add (by exact (i4.const_mul _).sub (i2.const_mul _)) (integrable_const _),
    integral_sub (by exact i4.const_mul _) (by exact i2.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ fun ℓ _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun ℓ' _ =>
      integrable_L4 _ _ _ _,
    integral_finsetSum _ fun ℓ _ => integrable_L2 _ _]
  have h4 : ∀ ℓ : Fin t, ∫ Ω, ∑ ℓ' : Fin t,
      L (col f ℓ) Ω * L (col g ℓ) Ω * L (col f ℓ') Ω * L (col g ℓ') Ω ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t))
      = ∑ ℓ' : Fin t, ((∑ k, f k * g k) ^ 2 + (if ℓ = ℓ' then
          (∑ k, f k * f k) * (∑ k, g k * g k) + (∑ k, f k * g k) ^ 2 else 0)) := by
    intro ℓ
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun ℓ' _ => integrable_L4 _ _ _ _]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ℓ' _ => ?_
    rw [integral_L4, ip_col, ip_col, ip_col, ip_col, ip_col, ip_col]
    by_cases h : ℓ = ℓ'
    · simp [h, mul_comm (g _) (f _)]; ring
    · simp [h]; ring
  simp_rw [h4, integral_L2, ip_col]
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  have : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  simp only [sq]
  ring

name: NLAlib.entry_sub_eq
statement:
private lemma entry_sub_eq {a b : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (N : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin n) ℝ) (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (i : Fin a) (j : Fin b) :
    (M * ((1 / (t : ℝ)) • (Ω * Ωᵀ)) * Nᵀ - M * Nᵀ) i j
      = (1 / (t : ℝ)) * ∑ ℓ, L (col (M i) ℓ) Ω * L (col (N j) ℓ) Ω - ∑ k, M i k * N j k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, L_col]
  congr 1
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  calc _ = ∑ k', ∑ ℓ, ∑ k, M i k * (1 / (t : ℝ) * (Ω k ℓ * Ω k' ℓ)) * N j k' :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ ℓ, ∑ k', ∑ k, M i k * (1 / (t : ℝ) * (Ω k ℓ * Ω k' ℓ)) * N j k' := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gram_mul_transpose_sub
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_gram_mul_transpose_sub {a b n t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (M : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℝ) (N : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∫ Ω, frobSq (M * ((1 / (t : ℝ)) • (Ω * Ωᵀ)) * Nᵀ - M * Nᵀ)
        ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t))
      = (frobSq M * frobSq N + frobSq (M * Nᵀ)) / t ∧
    (frobSq M * frobSq N + frobSq (M * Nᵀ)) / t ≤ 2 / t * (frobSq M * frobSq N)
proof:
:= by
  have hMN : frobSq (M * Nᵀ) = ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ k, M i k * N j k) ^ 2 := by
    simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hMN' : frobSq M * frobSq N = ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ k, M i k ^ 2) * (∑ k, N j k ^ 2) := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  constructor
  · have hX : ∀ Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ,
        frobSq (M * ((1 / (t : ℝ)) • (Ω * Ωᵀ)) * Nᵀ - M * Nᵀ)
        = ∑ i, ∑ j, ((1 / (t : ℝ)) * ∑ ℓ, L (col (M i) ℓ) Ω * L (col (N j) ℓ) Ω
            - ∑ k, M i k * N j k) ^ 2 := by
      intro Ω; simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, entry_sub_eq]
    simp_rw [hX]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
      integrable_entry_sq (M i) (N j) _]
    have hij : ∀ i, ∫ Ω, ∑ j, ((1 / (t : ℝ)) * ∑ ℓ, L (col (M i) ℓ) Ω * L (col (N j) ℓ) Ω
            - ∑ k, M i k * N j k) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t))
        = ∑ j, ((∑ k, M i k ^ 2) * (∑ k, N j k ^ 2) + (∑ k, M i k * N j k) ^ 2) / t := by
      intro i
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => integrable_entry_sq (M i) (N j) _]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => integral_entry_sq ht (M i) (N j)
    simp_rw [hij, hMN, hMN', ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  · have hle : frobSq (M * Nᵀ) ≤ frobSq M * frobSq N := by
      rw [hMN, hMN']
      gcongr with i _ j _
      exact Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
    rw [show 2 / (t : ℝ) * (frobSq M * frobSq N)
      = (frobSq M * frobSq N + frobSq M * frobSq N) / t by ring]
    gcongr

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_mul_gram_mul_transpose_sub_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul_gram_mul_transpose_sub_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {a b n t : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (M : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℝ) (N : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (M * ((1 / (t : ℝ)) • (X ω * (X ω)ᵀ)) * Nᵀ - M * Nᵀ) ∂μ
      = (frobSq M * frobSq N + frobSq (M * Nᵀ)) / t ∧
    (frobSq M * frobSq N + frobSq (M * Nᵀ)) / t ≤ 2 / t * (frobSq M * frobSq N)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ =>
      frobSq (M * ((1 / (t : ℝ)) • (G * Gᵀ)) * Nᵀ - M * Nᵀ) := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := integral_frobSq_mul_gram_mul_transpose_sub ht M N
  refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
  rw [← h1]
  exact hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_gaussianLogOverlap_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_gaussianLogOverlap_le (n : ℕ) :
    let μ
proof:
:= Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1
    let T := Real.log (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    Integrable (@gaussianLogOverlap n) μ ∧
      (∫ g, gaussianLogOverlap g ∂μ) ≤ T + 2 ∧
      Integrable (fun g => gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ g, gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ T ^ 2 + 4 * T + 8 := by
  dsimp only
  let μ := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1
  let T := Real.log (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let Z := fun g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ => max (gaussianLogOverlap g - T) 0
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1)
    linarith
  have hZm : Measurable Z := (measurable_gaussianLogOverlap n |>.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const
  have hZ0 : ∀ g, 0 ≤ Z g := fun _ => le_max_right _ _
  have hZtail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ {g | t < Z g} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t / 2)) := by
    intro t ht
    have he : {g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | t < Z g} = {g | T + t < gaussianLogOverlap g} := by
      ext g
      change (t < max (gaussianLogOverlap g - T) 0) ↔ (T + t < gaussianLogOverlap g)
      rw [lt_max_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h) <;> linarith
      · intro h
        left
        linarith
    have hC : Real.sqrt (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = Real.exp (T / 2) := by
      rw [Real.exp_half]
      change _ = Real.sqrt (Real.exp (Real.log (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))))
      rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    have hExp : Real.sqrt (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(T + t) / 2) =
        Real.exp (-t / 2) := by
      rw [hC, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    have h := pi_gaussianReal_logOverlap_gt_le n (t := T + t) (by dsimp only [T]; linarith)
    rw [he]
    simpa only [hExp] using h
  have hZI := integrable_of_exp_neg_half_tail hZm hZ0 hZtail
  have hZv := integral_le_two_of_exp_neg_half_tail hZm hZ0 hZtail
  have hZI2 := integrable_sq_of_exp_neg_half_tail hZm hZ0 hZtail
  have hZv2 := integral_sq_le_eight_of_exp_neg_half_tail hZm hZ0 hZtail
  have hLm := measurable_gaussianLogOverlap n
  have hL0 := @gaussianLogOverlap_nonneg n
  have hLbound : ∀ g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, gaussianLogOverlap g ≤ T + Z g := by
    intro g
    have h := le_max_left (gaussianLogOverlap g - T) 0
    linarith
  have hLI : Integrable (@gaussianLogOverlap n) μ := by
    refine ((integrable_const T).add hZI).mono' hLm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun g => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hL0 g)]
      exact hLbound g
  have hLsqbound : ∀ g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2 ≤
      T ^ 2 + (2 * T) * Z g + Z g ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hL0 g) (hLbound g) 2
    nlinarith
  have hRightI : Integrable (fun g => T ^ 2 + (2 * T) * Z g + Z g ^ 2) μ :=
    ((integrable_const (T ^ 2)).add (hZI.const_mul (2 * T))).add hZI2
  have hLI2 : Integrable (fun g => gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2) μ := by
    refine hRightI.mono' (hLm.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun g => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact hLsqbound g
  refine ⟨hLI, ?_, hLI2, ?_⟩
  · have h := integral_mono hLI ((integrable_const T).add hZI) hLbound
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at h
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const T) hZI, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at h
    linarith
  · have h := integral_mono hLI2 hRightI hLsqbound
    have hSumI : Integrable (fun g => T ^ 2 + (2 * T) * Z g) μ :=
      (integrable_const (T ^ 2)).add (hZI.const_mul (2 * T))
    rw [integral_add hSumI hZI2,
      integral_add (integrable_const (T ^ 2)) (hZI.const_mul (2 * T)),
      integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_const_mul] at h
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_log_sum_div_sq_pi_gaussianReal_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_log_sum_div_sq_pi_gaussianReal_le (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let μ
proof:
:= Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1
    let T := Real.log (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    let L := fun g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ j, g j ^ 2) / (g i) ^ 2)
    Integrable L μ ∧ (∫ g, L g ∂μ) ≤ T + 2 ∧
      Integrable (fun g => L g ^ 2) μ ∧ (∫ g, L g ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ T ^ 2 + 4 * T + 8 := by
  dsimp only
  let μ := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1
  let L := fun g : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ => Real.log ((∑ j, g j ^ 2) / (g i) ^ 2)
  let e := Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i
  let F := MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) e
  have hMP : MeasurePreserving F μ μ :=
    measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1) e
  have hF : ∀ g j, F g j = g (e.symm j) := by
    intro g j
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply (β := fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) e g (e.symm j)
  have hEq : ∀ g, gaussianLogOverlap (F g) = L g := by
    intro g
    rw [gaussianLogOverlap_eq_log_sum_div_sq]
    have hS : (∑ j, F g j ^ 2) = ∑ j, g j ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hF]
      exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun j => g j ^ 2)
    have h0 : F g 0 = g i := by rw [hF]; simp [e]
    rw [hS, h0]
  obtain ⟨hI, hV, hI2, hV2⟩ := integrable_and_integral_gaussianLogOverlap_le n
  have hLI : Integrable L μ := by
    have h := (hMP.integrable_comp_emb F.measurableEmbedding (g := @gaussianLogOverlap n)).mpr hI
    exact h.congr (ae_of_all _ hEq)
  have hLI2 : Integrable (fun g => L g ^ 2) μ := by
    have h := (hMP.integrable_comp_emb F.measurableEmbedding
      (g := fun g => gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2)).mpr hI2
    exact h.congr (ae_of_all _ fun g => congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (hEq g))
  have hLV : (∫ g, L g ∂μ) = ∫ g, gaussianLogOverlap g ∂μ := by
    calc (∫ g, L g ∂μ) = ∫ g, gaussianLogOverlap (F g) ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun g => (hEq g).symm)
      _ = _ := hMP.integral_comp' (@gaussianLogOverlap n)
  have hLV2 : (∫ g, L g ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∫ g, gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    calc (∫ g, L g ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∫ g, gaussianLogOverlap (F g) ^ 2 ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun g => congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (hEq g).symm)
      _ = _ := hMP.integral_comp' (fun g => gaussianLogOverlap g ^ 2)
  exact ⟨hLI, hLV.trans_le hV, hLI2, hLV2.trans_le hV2⟩

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_pi_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_pi_gaussianReal {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :

      fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : Fin n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1) (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_pi_gaussianReal hA.eigenvectorBasis
  have he : (fun b : Fin n → ℝ => WithLp.ofLp (hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 b))) =
      fun b : Fin n → ℝ => fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : Fin n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b := by
    funext b i
    rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    simp only [star_trivial]
    exact dotProduct_comm _ _
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.ae_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_ne_zero_pi_gaussianReal

theorem ae_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_ne_zero_pi_gaussianReal {n : ℕ}

proof:

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le_comparator
statement:
theorem integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le_comparator
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (p r : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r)
    (s : n → ℝ) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ s i)
    (hd : (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ p) ≤ (r : ℝ) ^ p)
    (hs : (∑ i, s i ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    (∫ G, ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ≤
      (r : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∫ G, ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)).trace
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0)
  have hr' : (0 : ℝ) < r := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hr
  have hdiag (π : GaussianPairings (k + 1))
      (flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool) :
      (∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x) ≤
        (r : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → Fin r,
            symmetricCycleDiagramWeight (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) π flip x := by
    have hlen : (gaussianPairingEdges π).length = p := by
      have hlen := two_mul_gaussianPairingEdges_length π
      omega
    have h := sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_le_of_power_sums b hb π flip
      s hcap r 1 hr' zero_lt_one (by simpa only [hlen] using hd)
      (by simpa only [hlen, one_pow] using hs)
    rw [one_pow, mul_one] at h
    apply h.trans_eq
    rw [sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_one]
    let Q := symmetricCycleVertexQuotient π flip
    let : Nonempty Q := ⟨Quotient.mk'' (0 : Fin (k + 1))⟩
    have hv : 1 ≤ Nat.card Q := Nat.card_pos
    change (r : ℝ) ^ (Nat.card Q - 1) = (r : ℝ)⁻¹ * (r : ℝ) ^ Nat.card Q
    have hpow : (r : ℝ) ^ Nat.card Q = (r : ℝ) ^ (Nat.card Q - 1) * r := by
      rw [← pow_succ]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [hpow]
    field_simp
  have hsum :
      (∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
        ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
          ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x) ≤
      (r : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
          ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
            ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → Fin r,
              symmetricCycleDiagramWeight (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) π flip x := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro π _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun flip _ => hdiag π flip
  have h := (integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_le_sum_diagrams b hb k).trans
    (hsum.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_one_le_integral_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow r k)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr hr'.le)))
  have hk' : k + 1 = 2 * p := by omega
  simpa only [hk'] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem integral_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_le
    (r p : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ G, ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)).trace
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)) ≤
        (r : ℝ) * (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0)
  have hk' : k + 1 = 2 * p := by omega
  have hi := integrable_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow r k
  rw [hk'] at hi
  have hbound (G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) :
      ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)).trace ≤
        (r : ℝ) * specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p) := by
    have hpow : specNorm ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)) ≤
        specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p) := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_pow_le (gaussianSymmetricSum G) (2 * p)
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)).trace‖ := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ (r : ℝ) * specNorm ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)) := by
        simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
          norm_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p))
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
        (r : ℝ) * specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r) :=
      integral_mono hi ((integrable_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul r p).const_mul r) hbound
    _ = (r : ℝ) * ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
        specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r) := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (integral_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_le r p) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le_of_power_sums
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le_of_power_sums
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (p r : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r)
    (s : n → ℝ) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ s i)
    (hd : (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ p) ≤ (r : ℝ) ^ p)
    (hs : (∑ i, s i ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p)
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ≤ (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have htrace (G : Matrix n n ℝ) :
      schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p) =
        ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (2 * p)).trace := by
    simpa only [RCLike.re_to_real] using
      schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)
        (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr (symmetricGaussianMatrix_isSymm b G)) hp
  simp_rw [htrace]
  calc
    _ ≤ (r : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ G, ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)).trace
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r) :=
      integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le_comparator b hb p r hp hr s hcap hd hs
    _ ≤ (r : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((r : ℝ) * (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)) ^ (2 * p)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_le r p hr hp)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne'), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.canonical_pair_eq_iff_sym2_eq
statement:
private theorem canonical_pair_eq_iff_sym2_eq (i j k l : n) :
    (max i j, min i j) = (max k l, min k l) ↔ s(i, j) = s(k, l)
proof:
:= by
  have hsort (a b : n) : s(max a b, min a b) = s(a, b) := by
    by_cases hab : a ≤ b
    · simp only [max_eq_right hab, min_eq_left hab, Sym2.eq_swap]
    · simp only [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hab), min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hab)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (hsort i j).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun p : n × n => s(p.1, p.2)) h).trans (hsort k l))
  · intro h
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rfl
    · simp only [max_comm, min_comm]

name: NLAlib.profile_max_min_eq
statement:
private theorem profile_max_min_eq (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (i j : n) :
    b (max i j) (min i j) = b i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i ≤ j
  · simpa only [max_eq_right hij, min_eq_left hij] using hb.apply i j
  · simp only [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hij), min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hij)]

name: NLAlib.covariance_le_sum_orientations
statement:
private theorem covariance_le_sum_orientations (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (i j k l : n) :
    (if s(i, j) = s(k, l) then b i j ^ 2 else 0) ≤
      (if i = k ∧ j = l then b i j ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if i = l ∧ j = k then b i j ^ 2 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : s(i, j) = s(k, l)
  · rw [if_pos h]
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp h with h | h
    · rw [if_pos h]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by split_ifs <;> positivity)
    · rw [if_pos h]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (by split_ifs <;> positivity)
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact add_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> positivity) (by split_ifs <;> positivity)

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_covariance_eq_sum_diagrams
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_covariance_eq_sum_diagrams (b : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {k : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings k) (x : Fin k → n) :
    gaussianPairingWeight (fun r s =>
      (if x r = x s ∧ x (finRotate k r) = x (finRotate k s)
        then b (x r) (x (finRotate k r)) ^ 2 else 0) +
      (if x r = x (finRotate k s) ∧ x (finRotate k r) = x s
        then b (x r) (x (finRotate k r)) ^ 2 else 0)) π =
      ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
        symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPairingWeight_add_eq_sum_orientations]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro flip _
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro e _
  cases flip e <;> simp [orientedCycleSource, orientedCycleTarget]

name: NLAlib.pairingWeight_le_sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight
statement:
private theorem pairingWeight_le_sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight (b : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {k : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings k) (x : Fin k → n) :
    gaussianPairingWeight (fun r s =>
      if s(x r, x (finRotate k r)) = s(x s, x (finRotate k s))
      then b (x r) (x (finRotate k r)) ^ 2 else 0) π ≤
      ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
        symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x
proof:
:= by
  let C := fun r s : Fin k => if x r = x s ∧ x (finRotate k r) = x (finRotate k s)
    then b (x r) (x (finRotate k r)) ^ 2 else 0
  let D := fun r s : Fin k => if x r = x (finRotate k s) ∧ x (finRotate k r) = x s
    then b (x r) (x (finRotate k r)) ^ 2 else 0
  calc
    _ ≤ gaussianPairingWeight (fun r s => C r s + D r s) π :=
      gaussianPairingWeight_le_gaussianPairingWeight _ _
        (fun _ _ => by split_ifs <;> positivity)
        (fun r s => covariance_le_sum_orientations b _ _ _ _) π
    _ = _ := gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_covariance_eq_sum_diagrams b π x

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_le_sum_diagrams
statement:
theorem integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_le_sum_diagrams
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ G, ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (k + 1)).trace ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ≤
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
        ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
          ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_eq_sum_pairings]
  simp_rw [canonical_pair_eq_iff_sym2_eq, profile_max_min_eq b hb]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, ∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
        ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
          symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun π _ =>
        pairingWeight_le_sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π x
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro π _
      exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_le_of_power_sums
statement:
theorem sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_le_of_power_sums
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {k : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings (k + 1))
    (flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool)
    (s : n → ℝ) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ s i)
    (A B : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hdA : (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (gaussianPairingEdges π).length) ≤
      A ^ (gaussianPairingEdges π).length)
    (hsB : (∑ i, s i ^ (gaussianPairingEdges π).length) ≤ B ^ (gaussianPairingEdges π).length) :
    (∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, symmetricCycleDiagramWeight b π flip x) ≤
      A ^ (Nat.card (symmetricCycleVertexQuotient π flip) - 1) *
        B ^ ((gaussianPairingEdges π).length - (Nat.card (symmetricCycleVertexQuotient π flip) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a := fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1
  let b' := fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
  let Q := symmetricCycleVertexQuotient π flip
  let : Fintype Q := Fintype.ofFinite Q
  have hconn := paired_oriented_cycle_connected a b' (gaussianPairingEdges_endpoints_bijective π).surjective flip
  have hlength : 0 < (gaussianPairingEdges π).length := by
    have hh := two_mul_gaussianPairingEdges_length π
    omega
  have h := sum_prod_indicator_le_of_power_sums a
    (fun e => orientedCycleSource (b' e) (flip e))
    (fun e => finRotate (k + 1) (a e))
    (fun e => orientedCycleTarget (b' e) (flip e)) hconn
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hlength)
    (fun i j => b i j ^ 2) (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun i j => by rw [hb.apply i j])
    s hcap A B hA hB (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hdA)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hsB)
  simpa only [symmetricCycleDiagramWeight, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_entry_rpow
statement:
private theorem integral_abs_entry_rpow (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm)
    (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (i j : ι) :
    (∫ G, |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j| ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) =
      b i j ^ p * (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_apply_of_isSymm b hb, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (hb0 i j), Real.mul_rpow (hb0 i j) (abs_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_rowMax_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_rpow
statement:
theorem integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_rowMax_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_rpow
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1) * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ≤
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (ENNReal.ofReal p) ^ p
        ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hpE : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hp
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl h =>
      simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero]
      exact integral_nonneg fun G => Real.rpow_nonneg (rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _) _
  | inr h =>
      have hmax (i : ι) : ∃ j, b i j = ‖b i‖ := by
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm (b i)).1
        exact ⟨j, (Real.norm_of_nonneg (hb0 i j)) ▸ hj⟩
      choose f hf using hmax
      have hInt := (memLp_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hpE (Real.toNNReal p)).integrable_norm_rpow'
      have hInt' : Integrable (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)
          (ENNReal.ofReal p) ^ p) (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := by
        simpa only [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal, ENNReal.coe_toReal, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp0.le,
          Real.coe_toNNReal p hp0.le,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg (rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _)] using hInt
      have hselected : Integrable (fun G => ∑ i, |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ p)
          (gaussianMatrix ι ι) := integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_abs_entry_rpow b hp0.le i _
      calc
        _ = ∫ G, ∑ i, |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι := by
          rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_abs_entry_rpow b hp0.le i _]
          simp_rw [integral_abs_entry_rpow b hb hb0 hp0.le, hf]
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm]
        _ ≤ _ := integral_mono hselected hInt' (fun G => by
          rw [rowMixedNorm_ofReal_rpow _ hp0]
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          have hentry : |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ 2 ≤
              rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j‖)
              (Finset.mem_univ (f i))
          have hid : |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ p =
              (|symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul (abs_nonneg _) 2 (p / 2)]
            congr 1
            ring
          rw [hid]
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (sq_nonneg _) hentry (by linarith))

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_rowMax_profile_root_le_four_mul_integral_rowMixedNorm_rpow_root
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_rowMax_profile_root_le_four_mul_integral_rowMixedNorm_rpow_root
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      4 * (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (ENNReal.ofReal p) ^ p
        ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hscalarNN : 0 ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
    integral_nonneg fun z => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
  have hmaxNN : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  have hroot := Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg hscalarNN hmaxNN)
    (integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_rowMax_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_rpow b hb hb0 hp)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr hp0.le)
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hscalarNN hmaxNN] at hroot
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sqrt_div_four_le_integral_abs_rpow_root_gaussianReal hp)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hmaxNN p⁻¹)
  nlinarith [hmul.trans hroot]

name: NLAlib.memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix

proof:

        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * specNorm (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) :=
    schattenNormReal_le_card_rpow_mul_specNorm _ hp0
  exact (hmatrix.norm.const_mul ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / p))).of_le hmeas
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun G => by

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_sq
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_sq
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (hb : b.IsSymm) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) 2 ^ 2
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : schattenNormReal A 2 ^ 2 = frobSq A := by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one,
      ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self] using
      schattenNormReal_pow_even_eq_re_trace_gram A (r := 1) (by omega)
  have hi (i j : n) : Integrable
      (fun G : Matrix n n ℝ => ‖b i j‖ ^ 2 * G (max i j) (min i j) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix n n) :=
    (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry (max i j) (min i j) 2 (by norm_num)).integrable_sq.const_mul _
  simp_rw [hnorm, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,
    symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_apply_of_isSymm b hb, norm_mul, mul_pow,
    Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi i j))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi i j)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_sq_eq_one, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.component_profile_root_le
statement:
private theorem component_profile_root_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (c : Matrix n n ℝ) (hc : ∀ i j, |c i j| ≤ ‖b i j‖)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ((∑ i, (∑ j, c i j ^ 2) ^ k) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        Real.sqrt k * (∑ i, ‖c i‖ ^ (2 * k)) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤
      ((∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ k) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        Real.sqrt k * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ (2 * k)) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := 2 * k
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
  have hrow : (∑ i, (∑ j, c i j ^ 2) ^ k) ≤ ∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ k := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _ k
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg (c i j)) (hc i j) 2
  have hcap : (∑ i, ‖c i‖ ^ q) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ q := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    let S : ℝ := ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ q
    have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    have hrootpow : (S ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ q = S := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hS hqr.ne']
    have hn : ‖c i‖ ≤ S ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _)).mpr
      intro j
      apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _) hq.ne').mp
      rw [hrootpow, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hc i j) q).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) q) (Finset.mem_univ j))
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn q).trans_eq hrootpow
  apply add_le_add
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _) hrow
      (by positivity)
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) q)
        hcap (by positivity)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_nonneg_eq_even_root
statement:
private theorem lpNorm_nonneg_eq_even_root
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hfnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    lpNorm f (ENNReal.ofReal (q : ℝ)) μ = (∫ x, f x ^ q ∂μ) ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by positivity) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hf]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Nat.cast_nonneg q), Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (hfnn _), Real.rpow_natCast]

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) (2 * k : ℕ) ^ (2 * k)
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      48 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ k) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        Real.sqrt k * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ (2 * k)) ^ (((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  let q := 2 * k
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hq₂ : (2 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ q by dsimp [q]; omega)
  have hq₁ : 1 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by linarith
  let f : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ := fun G =>
    schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix (b.map Complex.re) G) q
  let g : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ := fun G =>
    schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix (b.map Complex.im) G) q
  let h : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ := fun G =>
    schattenNormReal (symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b G) q
  have hf := memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix (b.map Complex.re) hq₂
  have hg := memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix (b.map Complex.im) hq₂
  have hh := memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix b hq₁
    (ENNReal.ofReal (q : ℝ)) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hmono : lpNorm h (ENNReal.ofReal (q : ℝ)) (gaussianMatrix n n) ≤
      lpNorm (f + g) (ENNReal.ofReal (q : ℝ)) (gaussianMatrix n n) := by
    apply lpNorm_mono_real (hf.add hg)
    intro G
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)]
    exact schattenNormReal_symmetricComplexGaussianMatrix_le b G hq₁
  have htri := lpNorm_add_le hf (g := g) (ENNReal.one_le_ofReal.mpr hq₁)
  rw [lpNorm_nonneg_eq_even_root h hh.aestronglyMeasurable
      (fun _ => schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) hq] at hmono
  rw [lpNorm_nonneg_eq_even_root f hf.aestronglyMeasurable
      (fun _ => schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) hq,
    lpNorm_nonneg_eq_even_root g hg.aestronglyMeasurable
      (fun _ => schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) hq] at htri
  have hbre : (b.map Complex.re).IsSymm := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.map_apply, hb.apply i j]
  have hbim : (b.map Complex.im).IsSymm := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.map_apply, hb.apply i j]
  have hfr := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
    (b.map Complex.re) hbre k hk
  have hgr := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
    (b.map Complex.im) hbim k hk
  have hfre := component_profile_root_le b (b.map Complex.re)
    (fun i j => Complex.abs_re_le_norm (b i j)) k hk
  have hgim := component_profile_root_le b (b.map Complex.im)
    (fun i j => Complex.abs_im_le_norm (b i j)) k hk
  change (∫ G, h G ^ q ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ _
  have hsum := (hmono.trans htri).trans (add_le_add hfr hgr)
  nlinarith [hfre, hgim]

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (s : n → ℝ) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ s i)
    (A B : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hd : (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ p) ≤ A ^ (2 * p))
    (hs : (∑ i, s i ^ p) ≤ B ^ (2 * p)) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p)
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ≤ (24 * (A + Real.sqrt p * B)) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := ⌈(A / B) ^ 2⌉₊ + 1
  have hr : 0 < r := by omega
  have hrlo : (A / B) ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℝ) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil ((A / B) ^ 2)
    dsimp [r]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hrhi : (r : ℝ) ≤ (A / B) ^ 2 + 2 := by
    have h := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (sq_nonneg (A / B))
    dsimp [r]
    push_cast
    linarith
  let bn : Matrix n n ℝ := B⁻¹ • b
  let sn : n → ℝ := fun i => B⁻¹ ^ 2 * s i
  have hbns : bn.IsSymm := hb.smul _
  have hcapn (i j : n) : bn i j ^ 2 ≤ sn i := by
    simpa only [bn, sn, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_pow] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcap i j) (sq_nonneg B⁻¹)
  have hrow (i : n) : (∑ j, bn i j ^ 2) = B⁻¹ ^ 2 * (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) := by
    simp only [bn, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_pow, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hdn : (∑ i, (∑ j, bn i j ^ 2) ^ p) ≤ (r : ℝ) ^ p := by
    simp_rw [hrow, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      B⁻¹ ^ (2 * p) * (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ p) ≤
          B⁻¹ ^ (2 * p) * A ^ (2 * p) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hB.le) _)
      _ = ((A / B) ^ 2) ^ p := by
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg _) hrlo p
  have hsn : (∑ i, sn i ^ p) ≤ 1 := by
    simp only [sn, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      B⁻¹ ^ (2 * p) * (∑ i, s i ^ p) ≤ B⁻¹ ^ (2 * p) * B ^ (2 * p) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hB.le) _)
      _ = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB.ne', one_pow]
  have hn := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le_of_power_sums
    bn hbns p r hp hr sn hcapn hdn hsn
  have hbscale : b = B • bn := by
    dsimp [bn]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hB.ne', one_smul]
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * p : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hscale (G : Matrix n n ℝ) :
      schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p) =
        B ^ (2 * p) *
          schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix bn G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hbscale, symmetricGaussianMatrix_profile_smul]
    rw [schattenNormReal_smul _ _ hq, abs_of_pos hB, mul_pow]
  have hsqrtr : Real.sqrt r ≤ A / B + 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
    have hab : 0 ≤ A / B := div_nonneg hA hB.le
    nlinarith
  have hsqrtp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt p := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p)
  have hconstant : B * (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)) ≤
      24 * (A + Real.sqrt p * B) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrtr hB.le
    rw [mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hB.ne'] at h
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrtp hB.le]
  calc
    _ = B ^ (2 * p) * ∫ G,
        schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix bn G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p)
          ∂gaussianMatrix n n := by simp_rw [hscale]; exact integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ B ^ (2 * p) * (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)) ^ (2 * p) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (pow_nonneg hB.le _)
    _ = (B * (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p))) ^ (2 * p) := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hconstant _

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (2 * p : ℕ) ^ (2 * p)
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        24 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ p) ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) +
          Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ (2 * p)) ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := 2 * p
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
  let D : ℝ := ∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ p
  let S : ℝ := ∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ q
  let A : ℝ := D ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹)
  let B : ℝ := S ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => pow_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) _
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := Real.rpow_nonneg hD _
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Real.rpow_nonneg hS _
  have hApow : A ^ q = D := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hD hqr.ne']
  have hBpow : B ^ q = S := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hS hqr.ne']
  by_cases hBzero : B = 0
  · have hSzero : S = 0 := by simpa only [hBzero, zero_pow hq.ne'] using hBpow.symm
    have hbzero : b = 0 := by
      ext i j
      have hi : ‖b i‖ ^ q ≤ 0 := by
        calc
          _ ≤ S := Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (b k)) q)
            (Finset.mem_univ i)
          _ = 0 := hSzero
      have hn : ‖b i‖ = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff hq.ne').mp
        (le_antisymm hi (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
      exact congrFun (norm_eq_zero.mp hn) j
    have hz (G : Matrix n n ℝ) : symmetricGaussianMatrix b G = 0 := by
      ext i j
      simp [hbzero, symmetricGaussianMatrix]
    have hnorm (G : Matrix n n ℝ) :
        schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) q = 0 := by
      rw [hz, schattenNormReal_zero hqr]
    change (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) q ^ q ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^
      ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 24 * (A + Real.sqrt p * B)
    simp only [hnorm, zero_pow hq.ne', integral_zero,
      Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero hqr.ne')]
    positivity
  have hcap (i j : n) : b i j ^ 2 ≤ ‖b i‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm (b i) j
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
  have hbound := integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_le
    b hb p hp (fun i => ‖b i‖ ^ 2) hcap A B hA (lt_of_le_of_ne hB (Ne.symm hBzero))
    (by change D ≤ A ^ q; exact hApow.ge)
    (by simpa only [← pow_mul] using hBpow.ge)
  have hM : 0 ≤ ∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) q ^ q
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n := integral_nonneg fun G =>
    pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _
  have hroot := Real.rpow_le_rpow hM hbound (inv_nonneg.mpr hqr.le)
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (by positivity) hqr.ne'] at hroot
  exact hroot

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_even
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_even
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)
        (ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        24 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ ((((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 2)) ^
            (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) +
          Real.sqrt ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * p : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hhalf : (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 2 = p := by push_cast; ring
  simp only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ hq, hhalf, Real.rpow_natCast]
  apply (integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_two_mul_root_le b hb p hp).trans
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≤ 2 * p)

name: NLAlib.complex_product_frobSq_pinvR
statement:
private theorem complex_product_frobSq_pinvR {p : Type*} [Fintype p] {r s d : ℕ}
    (hrs : r+1≤s) (S : Matrix p (Fin d) ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun xy : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ =>
      frobSq (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1))
      ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
        (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s))) ∧
      ∫ xy, frobSq (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) ∂((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
        (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s)))=(r:ℝ)/((s:ℝ)-r)*frobSq S
proof:
:= by
  let μ := circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)
  let ν := circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s)
  let Φ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ → ℝ :=
    fun xy => frobSq (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1)
  have hm : Measurable Φ := measurable_frobSq.comp
    ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul (measurable_pinvR.comp measurable_fst))
  have hinner (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ) :=
    integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_mul S (pinvR X)
  obtain ⟨hXi,hXv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_circularComplexGaussianMatrix hrs
  have hi : Integrable Φ (μ.prod ν) := by
    rw [integrable_prod_iff hm.aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine ⟨Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun X => (hinner X).1,?_⟩
    refine (hXi.const_mul (2*frobSq S)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun X => ?_)
    dsimp only [Φ]
    simp_rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _)]
    exact (hinner X).2.symm
  refine ⟨hi,?_⟩
  change (∫ xy, Φ xy ∂μ.prod ν)=_
  rw [integral_prod Φ hi,integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun X => (hinner X).2),
    integral_const_mul,hXv]
  have hrsR : (r:ℝ)+1≤s := by exact_mod_cast hrs
  have hden : (s:ℝ)-r≠0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  field_simp [hden]

name: NLAlib.complex_product_mul_pinvR_entry
statement:
private theorem complex_product_mul_pinvR_entry {p : Type*} [Fintype p] {r s d : ℕ}
    (hrs : r+1≤s) (S : Matrix p (Fin d) ℂ) (i : p) (j : Fin r) :
    Integrable (fun xy : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ =>
      (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j)
      ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
        (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s))) ∧
      ∫ xy, (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j ∂((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
        (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s)))=0
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
    (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s))
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := complex_product_frobSq_pinvR hrs S
  have hm : Measurable (fun xy : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ =>
      (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j) := (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp
    ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul (measurable_pinvR.comp measurable_fst))
  have he : Integrable (fun xy : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ =>
      (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j) μ := ((integrable_const 1).add hi).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun xy => by
          have hs := normSq_entry_le_frobSq (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j
          rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at hs
          change ‖(S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j‖ ≤ 1+frobSq (S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1)
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j‖-1),norm_nonneg ((S*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) i j)])
  refine ⟨he,?_⟩
  rw [integral_prod _ he]
  have hz (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ) :=
    (integrable_and_integral_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_mul_entry S (pinvR X) i j).2
  rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hz),integral_zero]
