name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_complexGaussian_regression_noise
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_complexGaussian_regression_noise
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {r s d : ℕ} (hrs : r+1≤s)
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ} {Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hXY : HasLaw (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω))
      ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
        (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s))) μ) (D : Matrix (Fin d) p ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (pinvL (X ω)ᴴ*(Y ω)ᴴ*D)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL (X ω)ᴴ*(Y ω)ᴴ*D) ∂μ=(r:ℝ)/((s:ℝ)-r)*frobSq D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := complex_product_frobSq_pinvR hrs Dᴴ
  have hm : Measurable (fun xy : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ =>
      frobSq (Dᴴ*xy.2*pinvR xy.1)) := measurable_frobSq.comp
    ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul (measurable_pinvR.comp measurable_fst))
  simp_rw [complex_regression_noise_eq_adjoint,frobSq_conjTranspose]
  constructor
  · rw [← hXY.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hXY.aemeasurable
  · exact (hXY.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable).trans (by simpa only [frobSq_conjTranspose] using hv)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_complexGaussian_regression_noise_entry
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_complexGaussian_regression_noise_entry
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {r s d : ℕ} (hrs : r+1≤s)
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ} {Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hXY : HasLaw (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω))
      ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s)).prod
        (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin d) (Fin s))) μ) (D : Matrix (Fin d) p ℂ)
    (i : Fin r) (j : p) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (pinvL (X ω)ᴴ*(Y ω)ᴴ*D) i j) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, (pinvL (X ω)ᴴ*(Y ω)ᴴ*D) i j ∂μ=0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := complex_product_mul_pinvR_entry hrs Dᴴ j i
  have hm : Measurable (fun xy : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ × Matrix (Fin d) (Fin s) ℂ =>
      (Dᴴ*xy.2*pinvR xy.1) j i) := (Matrix.measurable_entry j i).comp
    ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul (measurable_pinvR.comp measurable_fst))
  have his : Integrable (fun ω => (Dᴴ*Y ω*pinvR (X ω)) j i) μ := by
    rw [← hXY.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hXY.aemeasurable
  have hvs : (∫ ω, (Dᴴ*Y ω*pinvR (X ω)) j i ∂μ)=0 :=
    (hXY.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable).trans hv
  simp_rw [complex_regression_noise_eq_adjoint,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,RCLike.star_def]
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · exact ((@RCLike.conjLIE ℂ _).toContinuousLinearEquiv.integrable_comp_iff).mpr his
  rw [integral_conj,hvs,map_zero]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  calc
    specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ≤ specNorm G + specNorm Gᴴ := specNorm_add_le _ _
    _ = 2 * specNorm G := by rw [specNorm_conjTranspose]; ring

name: NLAlib.measure_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le
statement:
theorem measure_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)).real
      {G | 32 * (r : ℝ) + 16 * t < specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ 2} ≤
      Real.exp (-t)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix
    (N := r) (n := r) (Real.sqrt (2 * t)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hrt : (Real.sqrt (2 * t)) ^ 2 = 2 * t := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hrr : (Real.sqrt (r : ℝ)) ^ 2 = r := Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hexp : -(Real.sqrt (2 * t)) ^ 2 / 2 = -t := by rw [hrt]; ring
  rw [hexp] at htail
  apply le_trans (measureReal_mono ?_) htail
  intro G hG
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hG ⊢
  have hsym := specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le_two_mul G
  have hgnn := specNorm_nonneg G
  have hsnn := specNorm_nonneg (gaussianSymmetricSum G)
  have hnormsq : specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * specNorm G ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hthreshold :
      (Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (2 * t)) ^ 2 ≤
        8 * (r : ℝ) + 4 * t := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) - Real.sqrt (2 * t))]
  by_contra hbad
  have hlt : specNorm G < Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (2 * t) :=
    lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hgnn hlt.le 2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measurable_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (specNorm : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm specNorm 1 fun X Y => by
      simpa only [one_mul] using abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y
  exact ((hc.comp continuous_gaussianSymmetricSum).pow 2).measurable

name: NLAlib.memLp_and_lpNorm_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le
statement:
theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le
    (r p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    MemLp (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ => specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ 2)
      (p : ℝ≥0∞) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)) ∧
    lpNorm (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ => specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ 2)
      (p : ℝ≥0∞) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)) ≤ 32 * (r : ℝ) + 16 * p
proof:
:= by
  exact memLp_and_lpNorm_le_of_shifted_exponential_tail
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r))
    (fun G => specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ 2)
    (measurable_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum r).aemeasurable
    (fun G => sq_nonneg _) (by positivity) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 16)
    (fun t ht => measure_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le r t ht) p hp

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul (r p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ =>
      specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp only [hp, mul_zero, pow_zero]
    exact integrable_const 1
  have hmem := (memLp_and_lpNorm_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le r p
    (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp)).1
  have hi := (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hmem.aestronglyMeasurable
    (by exact_mod_cast hp : (p : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) (by simp : (p : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞)).2 hmem
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, sq_abs,
    Real.rpow_natCast, ← pow_mul] using hi

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_root_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_root_le
    (r p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
      specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)) ^
        (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hbound⟩ := memLp_and_lpNorm_sq_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_le r p hp
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal hp0 (by simp) hmem.aestronglyMeasurable] at hbound
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, sq_abs,
    Real.rpow_natCast, ← pow_mul] at hbound
  let M : ℝ := ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
    specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := integral_nonneg fun G => pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
  have hroot : M ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) = Real.sqrt (M ^ ((p : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hM]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    field_simp
  change M ^ (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ _
  rw [hroot]
  calc
    Real.sqrt (M ^ ((p : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤ Real.sqrt (32 * (r : ℝ) + 16 * p) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hbound
    _ ≤ 8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
      have hr := Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg r : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r)
      have hp' := Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg p : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (r : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (p : ℝ))]

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_le (r p : ℕ) :
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
      specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)) ≤
      (8 * (Real.sqrt r + Real.sqrt p)) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp
  have hroot := integral_specNorm_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow_two_mul_root_le r p
    (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp)
  have hM : 0 ≤ ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
      specNorm (gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r) :=
    integral_nonneg fun G => pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
  have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hM _) hroot
    (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * p))
  rw [Real.rpow_inv_rpow hM (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0))] at hpow
  simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using hpow

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_le_matching_root
statement:

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_head_tail_moments
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_head_tail_moments
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm)
    (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (r : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) *
        (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) +
      512 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        Real.sqrt p * (∑ i : Fin n, ‖principalTailPart A r i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  let T := principalTailPart A r
  have hT : T.IsSymm := isSymm_principalTailPart A hA r
  have hT0 (i j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ T i j := by
    dsimp [T, principalTailPart]
    split_ifs
    · exact hA0 i j
    · exact le_rfl
  have hmoment := integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le T hT hT0 hp
  simp only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ hp0.le] at hmoment
  have hvariance : (∑ i, (∑ j, T i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      (∑ i, (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ := by
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _) _ (by positivity)
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
      (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => sq_principalTailPart_le A r i j) (by positivity)
  have htail := (integral_schattenNormReal_le_matching_root T hp).trans hmoment
  have htail' : (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix T G) p
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      512 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        Real.sqrt p * (∑ i : Fin n, ‖T i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹) := by
    apply htail.trans
    gcongr
  have hInt (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      Integrable (fun G => schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix B G) p)
        (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) :=
    (memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix B hp).integrable
      (ENNReal.one_le_ofReal.mpr (by linarith))
  have hpoint (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p ≤
        2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) +
          schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix T G) p := by
    have hsplit : headTailRemainder (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r +
        principalTailPart (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r = symmetricGaussianMatrix A G :=
      sub_add_cancel _ _
    calc
      _ = schattenNormReal (headTailRemainder (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r +
          principalTailPart (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r) p := congrArg
        (fun B => schattenNormReal B p) hsplit.symm
      _ ≤ schattenNormReal (headTailRemainder (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r) p +
          schattenNormReal (principalTailPart (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r) p :=
        schattenNormReal_add_le _ _ (by linarith)
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [← sample_principalTailPart]
        have h := schattenNormReal_headTailRemainder_le (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) r hp0
        dsimp [T]
        nlinarith
  have hmono := integral_mono
    (f := fun G => schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p)
    (g := fun G => 2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) +
      schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix T G) p) (hInt A)
    (((integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile A).const_mul
      (2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p))).add (hInt T)) hpoint
  have hsumInt : Integrable (fun G =>
      2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile A).const_mul _
  rw [integral_add hsumInt (hInt T), integral_const_mul] at hmono
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_head_tail_profiles
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_head_tail_profiles
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm)
    (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (r : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      2 * (2 * r : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) *
        (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) +
      512 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        Real.sqrt p * (∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ i.val then ‖A i‖ ^ p else 0) ^ p⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_head_tail_moments
    A hA hA0 r hp).trans
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hcaps : (∑ i, ‖principalTailPart A r i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      (∑ i : Fin n, if r ≤ i.val then ‖A i‖ ^ p else 0) ^ p⁻¹ := by
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) _
      (by positivity)
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _)
      (norm_principalTailPart_row_le A r i) hp0.le
    split_ifs at h ⊢ with hi
    · exact h
    · simpa only [Real.zero_rpow hp0.ne'] using h
  gcongr

name: NLAlib.sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_one_le_integral_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow
statement:
theorem sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_one_le_integral_trace_gaussianSymmetricSum_pow
    (r k : ℕ) :
    (∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
      ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
        ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → Fin r,
          symmetricCycleDiagramWeight (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) π flip x) ≤
      ∫ G, ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (k + 1)).trace ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)
proof:
:= by
  have htrace (G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) :
      ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (k + 1)).trace =
        ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → Fin r, ∏ i,
          gaussianSymmetricSum G (x i) (x (finRotate (k + 1) i)) := by
    simpa only [List.ofFn_const, List.prod_replicate] using
      Matrix.trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum_cyclic (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => gaussianSymmetricSum G)
  have hmoment :
      (∫ G, ((gaussianSymmetricSum G) ^ (k + 1)).trace ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r)) =
        ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → Fin r, ∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
          gaussianPairingWeight (fun i j =>
            2 * ((if x i = x j ∧ x (finRotate (k + 1) i) = x (finRotate (k + 1) j)
              then 1 else 0) +
              (if x i = x (finRotate (k + 1) j) ∧ x (finRotate (k + 1) i) = x j
              then 1 else 0))) π := by
    simp_rw [htrace]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => integrable_prod_gaussianSymmetricSum_entry
      (fun i => (x i, x (finRotate (k + 1) i))))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    exact integral_prod_gaussianSymmetricSum_entry_eq_sum_pairings
      (fun i => (x i, x (finRotate (k + 1) i)))
  rw [hmoment]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → Fin r, ∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
        ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
          symmetricCycleDiagramWeight (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) π flip x := by
      symm
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro π _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro x _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro π _
      rw [← gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_covariance_eq_sum_diagrams]
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, one_pow]
      apply gaussianPairingWeight_le_gaussianPairingWeight
      · intro i j
        exact add_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
      · intro i j
        have h : 0 ≤ (if x i = x j ∧ x (finRotate (k + 1) i) = x (finRotate (k + 1) j) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) +
            (if x i = x (finRotate (k + 1) j) ∧ x (finRotate (k + 1) i) = x j then 1 else 0) :=
          add_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
        linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_one
statement:
theorem sum_symmetricCycleDiagramWeight_one {r k : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings k)
    (flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool) :
    (∑ x : Fin k → Fin r, symmetricCycleDiagramWeight (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) π flip x) =
      (r : ℝ) ^ Nat.card (symmetricCycleVertexQuotient π flip)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a := fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1
  let b := fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
  let Q := symmetricCycleVertexQuotient π flip
  let : Fintype Q := Fintype.ofFinite Q
  have h := sum_prod_indicator_eq_sum_quotient a
    (fun e => orientedCycleSource (b e) (flip e))
    (fun e => finRotate k (a e))
    (fun e => orientedCycleTarget (b e) (flip e)) (fun _ _ : Fin r => (1 : ℝ))
  simpa only [symmetricCycleDiagramWeight, Matrix.of_apply, one_pow, Finset.prod_const_one,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, a, b,
    symmetricCycleVertexQuotient] using h

  constructor
  · rw [← hG.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hG.aemeasurable
  · exact (hG.integral_comp hm).trans hv

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_mul
    (S : Matrix a m ℂ) (T : Matrix n b ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix m n ℂ => frobSq (S*G*T)) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m n) ∧
      ∫ G, frobSq (S*G*T) ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix m n=2*frobSq S*frobSq T
proof:
:= by
  have hentry (i : a) (j : b) :=
    integrable_and_integral_normSq_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_mul_entry S T i j
  have he (G : Matrix m n ℂ) : frobSq (S*G*T)=∑ i,∑ j,Complex.normSq ((S*G*T) i j) := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  simp_rw [he]
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hentry i j).1,?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hentry i j).1]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hentry _ j).1,(hentry _ _).2]
  have hc (i : a) (j : b) : 2*∑ ij : m × n,Complex.normSq (S i ij.1*T ij.2 j)=
      (2*∑ k,Complex.normSq (S i k))*(∑ l,Complex.normSq (T l j)) := by
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Complex.normSq_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc,Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  simp_rw [hc]
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  simp only [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have hT : (∑ j : b,∑ l : n,Complex.normSq (T l j))=∑ l : n,∑ j : b,Complex.normSq (T l j) :=
    Finset.sum_comm
  calc
    _ = (∑ i : a,2*∑ k : m,Complex.normSq (S i k))*(∑ j : b,∑ l : n,Complex.normSq (T l j)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum,hT]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_entries_eq_frobNorm
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun ij : n × n => A ij.1 ij.2) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (n × n))‖ ^ 2 = frobNorm A ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun ij : n × n => A ij.1 ij.2) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (n × n)), frobNorm_nonneg A]

name: NLAlib.memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    MemLp (fun G => schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p)
      (ENNReal.ofReal p) (gaussianMatrix n n)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp
  let V : Matrix n n ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (n × n) := fun G =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun ij : n × n => symmetricGaussianMatrix b G ij.1 ij.2)
  have hV : MemLp V (ENNReal.ofReal p) (gaussianMatrix n n) := by
    rw [memLp_piLp_iff]
    intro ij
    exact memLp_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b ij.1 ij.2 _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun G => schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p) (gaussianMatrix n n) :=
    ((continuous_schattenNormReal hp0).measurable.comp
      (measurable_symmetricGaussianMatrix b)).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply hV.of_le hmeas
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro G
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)]
  calc
    schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ≤
        schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) 2 :=
      schattenNormReal_le_schattenNormReal_of_le _ (by norm_num) hp
    _ = frobNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) := schattenNormReal_two _
    _ = ‖V G‖ := (norm_toLp_entries_eq_frobNorm _).symm

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow

theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow

name: NLAlib.rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow
statement:
private theorem rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (i : n) :
    rowSq A i ^ (p / 2) ≤ schattenNormReal A p ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : rowSq A i ^ (p / 2) ≤ ∑ j, rowSq A j ^ (p / 2) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (rowSq_nonneg A j) (p / 2))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact hterm.trans (sum_rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow A hp)

name: NLAlib.integrable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow
statement:
private theorem integrable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (i : n) :
    Integrable (fun G => rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i ^ (p / 2))
      (gaussianMatrix n n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hp).mono'
    ((measurable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix b i).pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro G
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg
    (rowSq_nonneg (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i) (p / 2))]

name: NLAlib.integral_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (i : n) :
    (∫ G, rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i ∂gaussianMatrix n n) =
      ∑ j, b i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rowSq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
    (memLp_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b i j 2 (by simp)).integrable_sq)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => integral_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_sq b hb i j

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSq_profile_rpow_le_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow
statement:
theorem sum_rowSq_profile_rpow_le_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤
      ∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix n n
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 1 ≤ p / 2 := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < p / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hq
  have hJ (i : n) : (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) ≤
      ∫ G, rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i ^ (p / 2) ∂gaussianMatrix n n := by
    have hnn (G : Matrix n n ℝ) : 0 ≤ rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i :=
      rowSq_nonneg _ i
    have hroot := integral_rpow_root_le_of_nonneg_of_le
      (measurable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix b i).aestronglyMeasurable hnn
      zero_lt_one hq (integrable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hp i)
    simp only [Real.rpow_one, inv_one, integral_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hb] at hroot
    have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) hroot hq0.le
    rw [Real.rpow_inv_rpow
      (integral_nonneg fun G => Real.rpow_nonneg (hnn G) _) hq0.ne'] at hpow
    exact hpow
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∫ G, rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i ^ (p / 2)
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hJ i
    _ = ∫ G, ∑ i, rowSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) i ^ (p / 2)
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n :=
      (integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hp i)).symm
    _ ≤ _ := integral_mono
      (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_rowSq_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hp i))
      (integrable_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hp)
      (fun G => sum_rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow _ hp)

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow
statement:
theorem integral_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (i j : n) :
    (∫ G, |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j| ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix n n) =
      b i j ^ p * (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_apply_of_isSymm b hb, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (hb0 i j)]
  simp_rw [Real.mul_rpow (hb0 i j) (abs_nonneg _)]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  congr 1
  exact integral_comp_gaussianMatrix_entry_eq (max i j) (min i j)
    (fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ p) (continuous_abs.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hp)).measurable

name: NLAlib.integrable_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow
statement:
private theorem integrable_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (i j : n) :
    Integrable (fun G => |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i j| ^ p) (gaussianMatrix n n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (memLp_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b i j (ENNReal.ofReal p)
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).integrable_norm_rpow'
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_selected_entry_abs_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow
statement:
private theorem sum_selected_entry_abs_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (f : n → n) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, |A i (f i)| ^ p) ≤ schattenNormReal A p ^ p
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_) (sum_rowSq_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow A hp)
  intro i hi
  have hentry : |A i (f i)| ^ 2 ≤ rowSq A i := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖A i j‖) (Finset.mem_univ (f i))
  have hid : |A i (f i)| ^ p = (|A i (f i)| ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul (abs_nonneg _) 2 (p / 2)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hid]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (sq_nonneg _) hentry (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_selected_profile_rpow_le
statement:
theorem integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_selected_profile_rpow_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    (f : n → n) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1) * (∑ i, b i (f i) ^ p) ≤
      ∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix n n
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by linarith
  have hi : Integrable (fun G => ∑ i, |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ p)
      (gaussianMatrix n n) := integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
        integrable_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow b hp0 i (f i)
  calc
    _ = ∫ G, ∑ i, |symmetricGaussianMatrix b G i (f i)| ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix n n := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
        integrable_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow b hp0 i (f i))]
      simp_rw [integral_abs_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_rpow b hb hb0 hp0]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ _ := integral_mono hi (integrable_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hp)
      (fun G => sum_selected_entry_abs_rpow_le_schattenNormReal_rpow _ f hp)

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_rowMax_profile_rpow_le
statement:
theorem integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_rowMax_profile_rpow_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1) * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ≤
      ∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p ∂gaussianMatrix n n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero]
    exact integral_nonneg fun G => Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _
  have hmax (i : n) : ∃ j : n, b i j = ‖b i‖ := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (IsGreatest.pi_norm (b i)).1
    exact ⟨j, (Real.norm_of_nonneg (hb0 i j)) ▸ hj⟩
  choose f hf using hmax
  simpa only [hf] using
    integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_selected_profile_rpow_le b hb hb0 f hp

name: NLAlib.rowSq_profile_root_le_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
statement:
theorem rowSq_profile_root_le_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) _)
    (sum_rowSq_profile_rpow_le_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow b hb hp)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith))

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_rowMax_profile_root_le_four_mul_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_rowMax_profile_root_le_four_mul_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      4 * (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hp
  have hscalarNN : 0 ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
    integral_nonneg fun z => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
  have hmaxNN : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  have hroot := Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg hscalarNN hmaxNN)
    (integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal_mul_sum_rowMax_profile_rpow_le b hb hb0 hp)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr hp0.le)
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hscalarNN hmaxNN] at hroot
  have hscalar := sqrt_div_four_le_integral_abs_rpow_root_gaussianReal hp
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscalar (Real.rpow_nonneg hmaxNN p⁻¹)
  nlinarith [hmul.trans hroot]

name: NLAlib.row_profile_le_integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
statement:
theorem row_profile_le_integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (1 / 100 : ℝ) *
        ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
          Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹) ≤
      (∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (ENNReal.ofReal p) ^ p
        ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by linarith
  simp only [schattenNorm_ofReal _ hp0]
  have hvariance :=
    rowSq_profile_root_le_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root b hb hp
  have hmaximum :=
    sqrt_mul_rowMax_profile_root_le_four_mul_integral_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root
      b hb hb0 hp
  have hrootNN : 0 ≤ (∫ G, schattenNormReal (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ p
      ∂gaussianMatrix n n) ^ p⁻¹ :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun G =>
      Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _) _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose (p m : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => Gᵀ) (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin p))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Matrix.measurable_transpose.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry,
    Measure.map_map Matrix.measurable_transpose (MeasurableEquiv.measurable _)]
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => Gᵀ) ∘
        ((MeasurableEquiv.curry (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv)
      = ((MeasurableEquiv.curry (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv) ∘
        (fun x : Fin p × Fin m → ℝ => fun ji : Fin m × Fin p => x ji.swap) := by
    funext x; rfl
  have hswap : Measurable fun x : Fin p × Fin m → ℝ => fun ji : Fin m × Fin p => x ji.swap :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun ji => measurable_pi_apply _
  rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map (MeasurableEquiv.measurable _) hswap,
    map_comp_injective_pi _ Prod.swap Prod.swap_injective, ← gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry]

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {p m : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) μ) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => (X ω)ᵀ) (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin p)) μ
proof:
:=
  (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose p m).comp hX

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right {k m d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ => G * U) (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin d))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ => G * U)
      = (fun G : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ => Gᵀ) ∘
        (fun H : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ => Uᵀ * H) ∘
        (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ => Gᵀ) := by
    funext G
    simp [Matrix.transpose_mul]
  rw [hfun]
  exact (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose d k).comp
    ((hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block U hU).comp (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_transpose k m))

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {k m d : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin m)) μ) (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => X ω * U) (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin d)) μ
proof:
:=
  (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right U hU).comp hX

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec_of_dotProduct_self_eq_one
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec_of_dotProduct_self_eq_one {k n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).map (fun G => G *ᵥ x)
      = Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 1) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i _ => x i with hU_def
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := by
    show Uᵀ * U = 1
    ext a b
    fin_cases a; fin_cases b
    simpa [U, Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct] using hx
  have hM : Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => G * U :=
    measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_const
  have hE : Measurable fun H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin 1) ℝ => fun i => H i 0 :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => Matrix.measurable_entry i 0
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => G *ᵥ x)
      = (fun H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin 1) ℝ => fun i => H i 0) ∘
        (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => G * U) := by
    funext G i
    simp [U, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map hE hM, (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right U hU).map_eq]
  exact ((measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin k => Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun _ => measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin 1 => gaussianReal (0 : ℝ) 1) 0)).comp
    measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix.symm).map_eq

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec {k n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).map (fun G => G *ᵥ x)
      = Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 (x ⬝ᵥ x).toNNReal
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x ⬝ᵥ x = 0
  · have hx : x = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hx0
    subst hx
    have h0 : ∀ i : Fin k, MeasurePreserving (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (gaussianReal 0 1)
        (Measure.dirac 0) :=
      fun _ => ⟨measurable_const, by rw [Measure.map_const, measure_univ, one_smul]⟩
    have hR := (measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (fun _ : Fin k => Measure.dirac (0 : ℝ)) h0).map_eq
    rw [Measure.map_const, measure_univ, one_smul] at hR
    simp only [hx0, Real.toNNReal_zero, gaussianReal_zero_var, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    rw [← hR, Measure.map_const, measure_univ, one_smul]
    rfl
  · have hpos : 0 < x ⬝ᵥ x := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_star_nonneg x) (Ne.symm hx0)
    set r := Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) with hr_def
    have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos
    set u := r⁻¹ • x with hu_def
    have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
      rw [hu_def, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
        ← sq, inv_pow, hr_def, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx0]
    have hxu : x = r • u := by rw [hu_def, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    have hmu : Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => G *ᵥ u := by
      refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => ?_
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ => (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).mul_const _
    have hS : Measurable fun y : Fin k → ℝ => fun i => r * y i := by fun_prop
    have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => G *ᵥ x)
        = (fun y : Fin k → ℝ => fun i => r * y i) ∘ (fun G => G *ᵥ u) := by
      funext G i
      simp [hxu, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map hS hmu, gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec_of_dotProduct_self_eq_one u hu]
    have hvar : NNReal.mk (r ^ 2) (sq_nonneg _) * 1 = (x ⬝ᵥ x).toNNReal := by
      ext
      simp [hr_def, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, hpos.le]
    have hmp : ∀ i : Fin k, MeasurePreserving (fun y : ℝ => r * y) (gaussianReal 0 1)
        (gaussianReal 0 (x ⬝ᵥ x).toNNReal) := fun _ =>
      ⟨measurable_const_mul r, by rw [gaussianReal_map_const_mul, mul_zero]; congr 1⟩
    exact (measurePreserving_pi _ _ hmp).map_eq

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_mulVec_apply_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_mulVec_apply_gaussianMatrix {k n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => (G *ᵥ x) i) (x ⬝ᵥ x).toNNReal
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => G *ᵥ x := by
    refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => ?_
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ => (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).mul_const _
  have hlaw : (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).map (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => (G *ᵥ x) i)
      = gaussianReal 0 (x ⬝ᵥ x).toNNReal := by
    rw [show (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => (G *ᵥ x) i)
        = (fun y : Fin k → ℝ => y i) ∘ (fun G => G *ᵥ x) from rfl,
      ← Measure.map_map (measurable_pi_apply i) hm, gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec]
    exact (measurePreserving_eval _ i).map_eq
  have hX : AEMeasurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ => (G *ᵥ x) i)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)) := ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp hm).aemeasurable
  refine (HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hX).1 ?_
  rw [hlaw]
  exact hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal _

name: NLAlib.measurable_uncurry
statement:
private lemma measurable_uncurry (p m : Type*) [Fintype p] [Fintype m] :
    Measurable fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => fun ij : p × m => G ij.1 ij.2
proof:
:=
  measurable_pi_lambda _ fun ij => Matrix.measurable_entry ij.1 ij.2

name: NLAlib.measurable_flat
statement: private lemma measurable_flat (p m : Type*) [Fintype p] [Fintype m] : Measurable (flat p m)
proof:
:=
  (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 _).comp (measurable_uncurry p m)

name: NLAlib.map_flat_gaussianMatrix
proof:
:= by
  rw [show flat p m = WithLp.toLp 2 ∘ fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => fun ij => G ij.1 ij.2
      from rfl, ← Measure.map_map (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 _) (measurable_uncurry p m),
    gaussianMatrix_map_uncurry, map_pi_eq_stdGaussian]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eq_trace
statement:
private lemma sum_sq_eq_trace {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 = Matrix.trace (A * Aᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, sq]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_mul_orth
statement:
private lemma sum_sq_mul_orth {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq m]
    (U : Matrix p p ℝ)
    (V : Matrix m m ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1)
    (X : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (U * X * V) i j ^ 2 = ∑ i, ∑ j, X i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV' : V * Vᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hV
  rw [sum_sq_eq_trace, sum_sq_eq_trace]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc Matrix.trace (U * X * V * (Vᵀ * (Xᵀ * Uᵀ)))
      = Matrix.trace (U * (X * (V * Vᵀ) * Xᵀ) * Uᵀ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Matrix.trace (Uᵀ * U * (X * (V * Vᵀ) * Xᵀ)) := by
        rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Matrix.trace (X * Xᵀ) := by rw [hU, hV', Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_rotLin
statement:
private lemma norm_rotLin {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq m]
    (U : Matrix p p ℝ)
    (V : Matrix m m ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (p × m)) :
    ‖rotLin U V x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have h : ‖rotLin U V x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have := sum_sq_mul_orth U V hU hV (unflat x)
    simpa [rotLin, flat, unflat] using this
  have h1 := norm_nonneg (rotLin U V x)
  have h2 := norm_nonneg x
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖rotLin U V x‖ - ‖x‖), sq_nonneg (‖rotLin U V x‖ + ‖x‖)]

name: NLAlib.rotIso_flat
statement:
private lemma rotIso_flat {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq m]
    (U : Matrix p p ℝ)
    (V : Matrix m m ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1)
    (G : Matrix p m ℝ) :
    rotIso U V hU hV (flat p m G) = flat p m (U * G * V)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq p]
    [DecidableEq m] (U : Matrix p p ℝ)
    (V : Matrix m m ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => U * G * V) (gaussianMatrix p m)
      (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU
  have hV' : Vᵀ * V = 1 := hV
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => U * G * V) :=
    (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id).matrix_mul measurable_const
  refine ⟨hmeas.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  have key : ((gaussianMatrix p m).map
      (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => U * G * V)).map (flat p m) =
      (gaussianMatrix p m).map (flat p m) := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_flat p m) hmeas]
    have : flat p m ∘ (fun G : Matrix p m ℝ => U * G * V) =
        rotIso U V hU' hV' ∘ flat p m := by
      funext G; exact (rotIso_flat U V hU' hV' G).symm
    rw [this, ← Measure.map_map (rotIso U V hU' hV').continuous.measurable (measurable_flat p m),
      map_flat_gaussianMatrix, stdGaussian_map]
  have hfe : ⇑(flatEquiv p m) = flat p m := rfl
  rw [← hfe] at key
  exact (flatEquiv p m).map_measurableEquiv_injective key

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq m]
    {X : Ω → Matrix p m ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix p m) μ) (U : Matrix p p ℝ)
    (V : Matrix m m ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => U * X ω * V) (gaussianMatrix p m) μ
proof:
:=
  (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal U V hU hV).comp hX

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_pi_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_pi_gaussianReal {N : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun g : Fin N → ℝ => WithLp.ofLp (b.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 g)))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : Measurable (fun g : Fin N → ℝ => WithLp.toLp 2 g) := by fun_prop
  have hm2 : Measurable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) => b.repr x) :=
    b.repr.continuous.measurable
  have hm3 : Measurable (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => WithLp.ofLp y) := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨hm3.comp (hm2.comp hm1), ?_⟩
  have h := map_pi_eq_stdGaussian (ι := Fin N)
  have h' := map_pi_eq_stdGaussian (ι := ι)
  have hfun : (fun g : Fin N → ℝ => WithLp.ofLp (b.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 g)))
      = (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => WithLp.ofLp y) ∘ ((fun x => b.repr x) ∘
          (fun g : Fin N → ℝ => WithLp.toLp 2 g)) := rfl
  rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map hm3 (hm2.comp hm1), ← Measure.map_map hm2 hm1, h]
  rw [show (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) => b.repr x) = ⇑b.repr from rfl, stdGaussian_map,
    ← h', Measure.map_map hm3 (by fun_prop)]
  exact Measure.map_id

name: NLAlib.map_comp_injective_pi
statement:
theorem map_comp_injective_pi {ι κ β : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (ν : Measure β) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (e : ι → κ) (he : Function.Injective e) :
    Measure.map (fun x : κ → β => fun j => x (e j)) (Measure.pi fun _ : κ => ν) =
      Measure.pi fun _ : ι => ν
proof:
:= by
  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (i : κ) (x : κ → β) => x i) (Measure.pi fun _ : κ => ν) :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ (y : β) => y) (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  have hind' := hind.precomp he
  rw [iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun j => (measurable_pi_apply (e j)).aemeasurable)]
    at hind'
  rw [hind']
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : κ => ν) (e j)).map_eq

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block {n : ℕ} {k t : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype t]
    [DecidableEq k] (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) k ℝ)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => V₁ᵀ * G) (gaussianMatrix k t)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hk : Fintype.card k ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) := by
    simpa using card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols (Q := V₁) hV₁
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hk
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWe⟩ := exists_unitary_completion V₁ hV₁ e
  let H : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ :=
    fun G => Wᵀ * G * (1 : Matrix t t ℝ)
  have hH : HasLaw H (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) :=
    hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal Wᵀ 1
      (by
        show Wᵀᵀ * Wᵀ = 1
        rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]; exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW) (by simp [HasOrthonormalCols])
  have hR : HasLaw (fun X : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => Matrix.of fun j => X (e j))
      (gaussianMatrix k t) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) := by
    have hRm : Measurable fun X : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => Matrix.of fun j => X (e j) :=
      Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun j l => Matrix.measurable_entry (e j) l
    refine ⟨hRm.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
    rw [gaussianMatrix, Measure.map_map hRm Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv.measurable, gaussianMatrix,
      ← map_comp_injective_pi _ e e.injective,
      Measure.map_map Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv.measurable (by fun_prop)]
    rfl
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => V₁ᵀ * G) =
      (fun X : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => Matrix.of fun j => X (e j)) ∘ H := by
    funext G j l
    simp [H, Matrix.mul_apply, hWe]
  rw [hfun]
  exact hR.comp hH

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {n : ℕ} {k t : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype t] [DecidableEq k]
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) k ℝ)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => V₁ᵀ * X ω) (gaussianMatrix k t) μ
proof:
:=
  (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block V₁ hV₁).comp hX

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block {n : ℕ} {k r t : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype r]
    [Fintype t] [DecidableEq k] [DecidableEq r] (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) k ℝ)
    (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) r ℝ) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂)
    (hV₁₂ : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0) :
    IndepFun (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => V₁ᵀ * G)
      (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => V₂ᵀ * G)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hV₁' : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1 := hV₁
  have hV₂' : V₂ᵀ * V₂ = 1 := hV₂
  
  let V : Matrix (Fin n) (k ⊕ r) ℝ := Matrix.fromCols V₁ V₂
  have hV₂₁ : V₂ᵀ * V₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_transpose V₁, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hV₁₂, Matrix.transpose_zero]
  have hV : Vᵀ * V = 1 := by
    simp only [V, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols, hV₁', hV₂', hV₁₂,
      hV₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  have hk : Fintype.card (k ⊕ r) ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) := by
    simpa using card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols (Q := V) hV
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hk
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWe⟩ := exists_unitary_completion V hV e
  let H : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ :=
    fun G => Wᵀ * G * (1 : Matrix t t ℝ)
  have hH : HasLaw H (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) :=
    hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal Wᵀ 1
      (by
        show Wᵀᵀ * Wᵀ = 1
        rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]; exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW) (by simp [HasOrthonormalCols])
  have hHm : Measurable H := (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id).matrix_mul measurable_const
  
  have hrowm : ∀ a, Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => G a := fun a =>
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => Matrix.measurable_entry a j
  have hmeas : ∀ a, Measurable fun G => H G a := fun a => (hrowm a).comp hHm
  
  have hrows : iIndepFun (fun (a : Fin n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ) => G a)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) := by
    rw [iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun a => (hrowm a).aemeasurable)]
    have h1 : ∀ a, Measure.map (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => G a)
        (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) = Measure.pi fun _ : t => gaussianReal 0 1 :=
      fun a => ((measurePreserving_eval
        (fun _ : Fin n => Measure.pi fun _ : t => gaussianReal 0 1) a).comp
        measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix.symm).map_eq
    simp_rw [h1]
    exact (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix.symm).map_eq
  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (a : Fin n) G => H G a) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) := by
    rw [iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun a => (hrowm a).aemeasurable)] at hrows
    rw [iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun a => (hmeas a).aemeasurable),
      show (fun G (a : Fin n) => H G a) = (fun G (a : Fin n) => G a) ∘ H from rfl,
      ← Measure.map_map (measurable_pi_lambda _ hrowm) hHm, hH.map_eq, hrows]
    congr 1
    funext a
    rw [show (fun G => H G a) = (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => G a) ∘ H from rfl,
      ← Measure.map_map (hrowm a) hHm, hH.map_eq]
  let S : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.map (Function.Embedding.inl.trans e)
  let T : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.map (Function.Embedding.inr.trans e)
  have hST : Disjoint S T := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro a ha hb
    simp only [S, T, Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Function.Embedding.trans_apply,
      Function.Embedding.inl_apply, Function.Embedding.inr_apply] at ha hb
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hb
    exact absurd (e.injective hj) (by simp)
  have hpair := hind.indepFun_finset S T hST hmeas
  have hS : ∀ j : k, e (Sum.inl j) ∈ S := fun j => by simp [S]
  have hT : ∀ j : r, e (Sum.inr j) ∈ T := fun j => by simp [T]
  let φ : (S → t → ℝ) → Matrix k t ℝ :=
    fun y => Matrix.of fun j => y ⟨e (Sum.inl j), hS j⟩
  let ψ : (T → t → ℝ) → Matrix r t ℝ :=
    fun y => Matrix.of fun j => y ⟨e (Sum.inr j), hT j⟩
  have hφ : Measurable φ := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => measurable_pi_apply _
  have hψ : Measurable ψ := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => measurable_pi_apply _
  have h := hpair.comp hφ hψ
  convert h using 1
  · funext G j l
    simp [φ, H, Matrix.mul_apply, hWe, V]
  · funext G j l
    simp [ψ, H, Matrix.mul_apply, hWe, V]

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {n : ℕ} {k r t : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype r] [Fintype t]
    [DecidableEq k] [DecidableEq r] {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) t) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) k ℝ)
    (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) r ℝ) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂)
    (hV₁₂ : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0) :
    IndepFun (fun ω => V₁ᵀ * X ω) (fun ω => V₂ᵀ * X ω) μ
proof:
:= by
  have := hX.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hXm := hX.aemeasurable
  have hind := gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block (t := t) V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV₁₂
  have hm₁ := measurable_block (t := t) V₁
  have hm₂ := measurable_block (t := t) V₂
  rw [← hX.map_eq, indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hm₁.aemeasurable hm₂.aemeasurable] at hind
  show IndepFun ((fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => V₁ᵀ * G) ∘ X)
    ((fun G : Matrix (Fin n) t ℝ => V₂ᵀ * G) ∘ X) μ
  rw [indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hm₁.comp_aemeasurable hXm)
    (hm₂.comp_aemeasurable hXm), ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hm₁.aemeasurable hXm,
    ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hm₂.aemeasurable hXm, ← hind,
    AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (hm₁.prodMk hm₂).aemeasurable hXm]
  rfl

statement:
theorem integral_prod_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_eq_sum_pairings {k : ℕ}
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (idx : Fin k → n × n) :
    (∫ G, ∏ r, symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (idx r).1 (idx r).2 ∂gaussianMatrix n n) =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings k, gaussianPairingWeight
        (fun r s =>
          if (max (idx r).1 (idx r).2, min (idx r).1 (idx r).2) =
              (max (idx s).1 (idx s).2, min (idx s).1 (idx s).2)
          then b (max (idx r).1 (idx r).2) (min (idx r).1 (idx r).2) ^ 2 else 0) π

name: NLAlib.integrable_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun G => ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (k + 1)).trace)
      (gaussianMatrix n n)
proof:
:= by
  have htrace (G : Matrix n n ℝ) :
      ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (k + 1)).trace =
        ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, ∏ r,
          symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (x r) (x (finRotate (k + 1) r)) := by
    have hh := Matrix.trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum_cyclic
      (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)
    simpa only [List.ofFn_const, List.prod_replicate] using hh
  simp_rw [htrace]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun x _ =>
    integrable_prod_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b (fun r => (x r, x (finRotate (k + 1) r)))

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_eq_sum_pairings
statement:
theorem integral_trace_symmetricGaussianMatrix_pow_eq_sum_pairings
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ G, ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (k + 1)).trace ∂gaussianMatrix n n) =
      ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, ∑ π : GaussianPairings (k + 1),
        gaussianPairingWeight (fun r s =>
          if (max (x r) (x (finRotate (k + 1) r)), min (x r) (x (finRotate (k + 1) r))) =
              (max (x s) (x (finRotate (k + 1) s)), min (x s) (x (finRotate (k + 1) s)))
          then b (max (x r) (x (finRotate (k + 1) r)))
            (min (x r) (x (finRotate (k + 1) r))) ^ 2 else 0) π
proof:
:= by
  have htrace (G : Matrix n n ℝ) := Matrix.trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum_cyclic
    (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)
  have htrace' (G : Matrix n n ℝ) :
      ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ^ (k + 1)).trace =
        ∑ x : Fin (k + 1) → n, ∏ r,
          symmetricGaussianMatrix b G (x r) (x (finRotate (k + 1) r)) := by
    simpa only [List.ofFn_const, List.prod_replicate] using htrace G
  simp_rw [htrace']
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun x _ =>
    integrable_prod_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry b (fun r => (x r, x (finRotate (k + 1) r))))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  exact integral_prod_symmetricGaussianMatrix_entry_eq_sum_pairings b
    (fun r => (x r, x (finRotate (k + 1) r)))

name: NLAlib.sum_symmetric_eq_lower
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : (∑ i, ∑ j, if i < j then F i j else 0) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, if j < i then F i j else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [hF j i]
  have hsplit : (∑ i, ∑ j, F i j) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if j < i then F i j else 0) +
        (∑ i, ∑ j, if i < j then F i j else 0) +
          (∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then F i j else 0) := by
    simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    split_ifs <;> first | order | ring
  rw [hsplit, hswap]
  simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  split_ifs <;> first | order | ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_eq_linForm
statement:
theorem quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_eq_linForm
    (b G : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) v =
      linForm (symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b v) G
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_eq_sum_mul_mul]
  simp only [star_trivial]
  rw [sum_symmetric_eq_lower _ (fun i j => by
    rw [(symmetricGaussianMatrix_isSymm b G).apply i j]
    ring)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  dsimp [symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient]
  by_cases hij : j < i
  · simp only [hij, if_true, symmetricGaussianMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
      max_eq_left hij.le, min_eq_right hij.le]
    ring
  · by_cases heq : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [hij, if_false, if_true, symmetricGaussianMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
        max_self, min_self]
      ring
    · simp only [hij, heq, if_false, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le
    (b : Matrix n n ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (v w : n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b v i j -
      symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b w i j) ^ 2) ≤
        varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2) v w
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 * (v i * v j - w i * w j) ^ 2 =
      b j i ^ 2 * (v j * v i - w j * w i) ^ 2 := by
    intro i j
    rw [hb.apply i j]
    ring
  rw [varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq]
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [sum_symmetric_eq_lower _ hsymm]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  dsimp [symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient]
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b i j * (v i * v j - w i * w j))]

name: NLAlib.exists_abs_entry_eq_profile_scale
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl h =>
      have heq : (fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2) = 0 := by
        funext ij
        exact isEmptyElim ij.1
      simp only [heq, norm_zero, lt_self_iff_false] at hm
  | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := fun ij : ι × ι => |b ij.1 ij.2|)
      have hnorm : ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖ ≤ |b e.1 e.2| := by
        apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)).mpr
        intro ij
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, he]
        exact le_ciSup (Set.finite_range (fun ij : ι × ι => |b ij.1 ij.2|)).bddAbove ij
      have hrev : |b e.1 e.2| ≤ ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖ := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          norm_le_pi_norm (fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2) e
      exact ⟨e.1, e.2, le_antisymm hrev hnorm⟩

name: NLAlib.gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_profile_scale_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
statement:
theorem gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_profile_scale_le_integral_rowMixedNorm
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant * ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖ ≤
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := le_trans (by norm_num) hp
  have hcap : ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖ ≤ rowMixedNorm b p := by
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _)).mpr
    intro ij
    exact norm_entry_le_rowMixedNorm b hp1 ij.1 ij.2
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcap gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos.le).trans
    (gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_rowMixedNorm_le_integral b hb hp1)

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_measure_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_measure_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hm : 0 < ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) *
      Real.exp (-(t / ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖) ^ 2) ≤
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real {G | t ≤ rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p}
proof:
:= by
  let m := ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := exists_abs_entry_eq_profile_scale b hm
  have hlaw := (measurePreserving_gaussianMatrix_entry (max i j) (min i j)).hasLaw
  have hmeasure := hlaw.measureReal_eq
    (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_abs : MeasurableSet {x : ℝ | t / m ≤ |x|})
  have hlow := exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_abs_tail (t / m)
    (div_nonneg ht hm.le)
  rw [← hmeasure] at hlow
  apply hlow.trans
  apply measureReal_mono ?_ (by finiteness)
  intro G hG
  have hx := norm_entry_le_rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)
    (le_trans (by norm_num) hp) i j
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hx
  rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_apply_of_isSymm b hb, abs_mul, hij] at hx
  exact ((div_le_iff₀ hm).mp hG).trans (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hx)

name: NLAlib.sum_gueCoefficientMatrix_sandwich
statement:
theorem sum_gueCoefficientMatrix_sandwich (T : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, gueCoefficientMatrix k*T*gueCoefficientMatrix k) =
      normalizedTrace T • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,Finset.sum_mul]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x : n, ∑ y : n, T y x *
        ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, gueCoefficientMatrix k a y*gueCoefficientMatrix k x b := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [sum_gueCoefficientMatrix_entry_mul]
      by_cases hab : a=b
      · subst b
        simp [normalizedTrace,Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag,← Finset.sum_mul,mul_comm]
      · simp [hab]

name: NLAlib.sum_kronecker_gueCoefficientMatrix_sandwich
statement:
theorem sum_kronecker_gueCoefficientMatrix_sandwich
    (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (T : Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ) :
    (∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, (A⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix k)*T*
      (A⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix k)) =
      (A*normalizedPartialTrace T*A)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a,r⟩ ⟨b,s⟩
  have hs (g : d×n → ℂ) : (∑ x, g x)=∑ c, ∑ u, g (c,u) := Fintype.sum_prod_type g
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,hs,Finset.sum_mul]
  calc
    _ = ∑ c : d, ∑ u : n, ∑ e : d, ∑ v : n,
        (A a e*T (e,v) (c,u)*A c b)*
          ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, gueCoefficientMatrix k r v*gueCoefficientMatrix k u s := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro u _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [sum_gueCoefficientMatrix_entry_mul]
      by_cases hrs : r=s
      · subst s
        simp only [true_and,Matrix.one_apply_eq,mul_one,mul_ite,mul_zero]
        simp only [normalizedPartialTrace,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro c _
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro e _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro u _
        simp [mul_left_comm,mul_comm]
      · simp [hrs]

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_gaussianVector_split
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_gaussianVector_split (n N : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving
      (fun x : Fin (n + N) → ℝ => ((fun j : Fin n => x (Fin.castAdd N j)),
        (fun i : Fin N => x (Fin.natAdd n i))))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + N) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1).prod
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (α := fun _ : Fin (n + N) => ℝ)
    (fun _ : Fin (n + N) => gaussianReal 0 1) finSumFinEquiv).symm
  have h2 := measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi (X := fun _ : Fin n ⊕ Fin N => ℝ)
    (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)
  have h3 := h2.comp h1
  convert h3 using 1
  funext x
  simp [MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi, Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi, MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft,
    Equiv.piCongrLeft_symm_apply]

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianMatrix_row_castAdd
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianMatrix_row_castAdd (n N : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫ H, f (fun j => H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j)) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)))
      = ∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)

      = ∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)

    (ν := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)).comp

name: NLAlib.symmetricGaussianMatrix_mask
statement:
theorem symmetricGaussianMatrix_mask
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (P : ι → ι → Prop)
    [DecidableRel P] (hP : ∀ i j, P i j ↔ P j i) (A G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    symmetricGaussianMatrix (fun i j => if P i j then A i j else 0) G =
      (fun i j => if P i j then symmetricGaussianMatrix A G i j else 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hp : P (max i j) (min i j) ↔ P i j := by
    by_cases hij : i ≤ j
    · simp only [max_eq_right hij, min_eq_left hij]; exact hP j i
    · simp only [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hij), min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hij)]
  simp only [symmetricGaussianMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, hp]
  split_ifs <;> simp

statement:
theorem symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileBlockPart {n : ℕ}
    (A G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart A t) G =
      profileBlockPart (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) t
proof:
:= by
  classical

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_orthonormalRows
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_orthonormalRows
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq t]
    (U : Matrix p m ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols Uᴴ) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix m t ℂ => U*G) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix p t)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m t)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : HasOrthonormalCols (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix t t ℂ))ᴴ := by
    change (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix t t ℂ))ᴴᴴ * (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix t t ℂ))ᴴ = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.mul_one,
      show U*Uᴴ=1 from by simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hU,
      Matrix.one_kronecker_one]
  have hflat : HasLaw (fun G : Matrix m t ℂ => fun ij : m × t => G ij.1 ij.2)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector (m × t)) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m t) :=
    ⟨(by fun_prop : Measurable _).aemeasurable, circularComplexGaussianMatrix_map_uncurry⟩
  have hG := (hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_orthonormalRows
    (U ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix t t ℂ)) hK).comp hflat
  have h := hasLaw_curry_circularComplexGaussianVector.comp hG
  apply h.congr
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro G
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.kroneckerMap, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.one_apply]

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p -
        ∫ H, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b H) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ (gaussianMatrix ι ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hproxy : (Real.sqrt 2 * m) ^ 2 = 2 * m ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  simpa only [hproxy] using hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
    (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p) (Real.sqrt 2 * m)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hm)
    (abs_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le b hm hcap hp)

name: NLAlib.memLp_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem memLp_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (q : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p) q (gaussianMatrix ι ι)
proof:
:= by
  let m := ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := norm_nonneg _
  have hcap (i j : ι) : b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
    have h : |b i j| ≤ m := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm (fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2) (i, j)
    simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
  exact memLp_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hm hcap hp) q

name: NLAlib.integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_integral_add
statement:
theorem integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_rpow_root_le_integral_add
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ^ r ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ^ r⁻¹ ≤
      (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) +
        4 * Real.sqrt r * m
proof:
:= by
  have h := lpNorm_ofReal_le_integral_add_two_mul_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    (fun G => rowMixedNorm_nonneg (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p)
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hm hcap hp) hr
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by simp [show 0 < r by linarith])
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    (integrable_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hp).aestronglyMeasurable] at h
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (show 0 ≤ r by linarith),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _)] at h
  apply h.trans
  refine add_le_add le_rfl ?_
  change 2 * Real.sqrt ((2 * m ^ 2) * r) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt r * m
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg m)),
    Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_sq hm]
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 :=
    (Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).mpr (by norm_num)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrt
    (mul_nonneg hm (Real.sqrt_nonneg r))]

        (A*Q*A)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)

name: NLAlib.orientedPairMap_inverse
statement:
private theorem orientedPairMap_inverse {ι κ : Type*} [LinearOrder ι] [LinearOrder κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (p : ι × ι) : orientedPairMap e.symm (orientedPairMap e p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
  by_cases hij : j ≤ i
  · by_cases he : e i ≤ e j
    · simp [orientedPairMap, hij, he]
    · have he' : e j ≤ e i := le_of_not_ge he
      simp [orientedPairMap, hij, he']
  · have hij' : i < j := lt_of_not_ge hij
    have hne : e i ≠ e j := fun h => hij'.ne (e.injective h)
    by_cases he : e i ≤ e j
    · have he' : e i < e j := lt_of_le_of_ne he hne
      simp [orientedPairMap, hij, he'.not_ge, max_eq_right he, min_eq_left he,
        max_eq_right hij'.le, min_eq_left hij'.le]
    · have he' : e j < e i := lt_of_not_ge he
      simp [orientedPairMap, hij, he, max_eq_left he'.le, min_eq_right he'.le,
        max_eq_left hij'.le, min_eq_right hij'.le]

        (gaussianMatrix κ κ) (gaussianMatrix ι ι)

    by_cases hpt : p = ⊤
    · simp only [hpt, schattenNorm_top]
      exact measurable_specNorm_of_entries (fun i j => Matrix.measurable_entry i j)

        (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)) hpt
      simp only [schattenNorm_eq_of_ne_top _ hpt]
      exact (continuous_schattenNormReal hpr).measurable
  have h := (identDistrib_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix e b hb).comp hmeas
  have hr (A : Matrix κ κ ℝ) : schattenNorm (A.submatrix e e) p = schattenNorm A p :=
    schattenNorm_reindex A e.symm p
