    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (principalTailPart A r) G) p
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
    (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_mono (integrable_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix _ hp)
    (integrable_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix _ hp)
  intro G
  change rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (principalTailPart A r) G) p ≤
    rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) p
  rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_principalTailPart]
  exact rowMixedNorm_principalTailPart_le _ r (le_trans (by norm_num) hp)

name: NLAlib.principalTailEntryBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem principalTailEntryBound_nonneg {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ principalTailEntryBound A r
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalTailEntryBound
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: NLAlib.principalTailPart_sq_le_entryBound_sq
statement:
theorem principalTailPart_sq_le_entryBound_sq {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hanti : Antitone (fun i => ‖A i‖))
    (r : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    principalTailPart A r i j ^ 2 ≤ principalTailEntryBound A r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r < n
  · rw [principalTailEntryBound, dif_pos hr]
    unfold principalTailPart
    split_ifs with hij
    · have he : |A i j| ≤ ‖A i‖ := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm (A i) j
      have h : |A i j| ≤ ‖A ⟨r, hr⟩‖ :=
        he.trans (hanti (show (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin n) ≤ i from hij.1))
      simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
    · simp
  · have hi : ¬ r ≤ i.val := by omega
    simp [principalTailPart, principalTailEntryBound, hr, hi]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_principalTailEntryBound_ceil_exp_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_principalTailEntryBound_ceil_exp_le {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {b p : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hweight : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ * Real.sqrt (Real.log (i.val + 1)) ≤ b) :
    Real.sqrt p * principalTailEntryBound A ⌈Real.exp p⌉₊ ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : ⌈Real.exp p⌉₊ < n
  · rw [principalTailEntryBound, dif_pos hr]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.le_log_ceil_exp_add_one p)) (norm_nonneg (A ⟨_, hr⟩))
    have hw := hweight ⟨_, hr⟩
    nlinarith
  · simp only [principalTailEntryBound, dif_neg hr, mul_zero]
    exact hb

name: NLAlib.eval_det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose
statement:
private theorem eval_det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose (r s : ℕ)
    (G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun ij : Fin r × Fin s => G ij.1 ij.2)
      (Matrix.mvPolynomialX (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ * (Matrix.mvPolynomialX (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ)ᵀ).det =
        (G*Gᵀ).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.transpose_map]
  have hX : (Matrix.mvPolynomialX (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ).map
      (MvPolynomial.eval fun ij : Fin r × Fin s => G ij.1 ij.2) = G := by
    ext i j
    simp
  rw [hX]

name: NLAlib.det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose_ne_zero {r s : ℕ} (h : r ≤ s) :
    (Matrix.mvPolynomialX (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ * (Matrix.mvPolynomialX (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ)ᵀ).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  let G0 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ := Matrix.of fun i j => if j = Fin.castLE h i then 1 else 0
  have hE : G0*G0ᵀ=1 := by
    ext i j
    simp [G0, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Fin.castLE_inj, eq_comm]
  have he := eval_det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose r s G0
  rw [h0, map_zero, hE, Matrix.det_one] at he
  exact zero_ne_one he

name: NLAlib.circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_rank_eq
statement:
theorem circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_rank_eq {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s), G.rank = r
proof:
:= by
  have h := MvPolynomial.ae_eval_ne_zero_normedField circularComplexGaussian _
    (det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose_ne_zero hrs)
  have hf := circularComplexGaussianMatrix_map_uncurry (m := Fin r) (n := Fin s)
  change _ = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin r × Fin s => circularComplexGaussian) at hf
  rw [← hf] at h
  have h' := ae_of_ae_map (by fun_prop : Measurable
    (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℂ => fun ij : Fin r × Fin s => G ij.1 ij.2)).aemeasurable h
  filter_upwards [h'] with G hG
  rw [eval_det_complexPolynomial_mul_transpose] at hG
  have hu := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG)
  have hr := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hu
  have hlo := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left G Gᵀ
  have hhi := Matrix.rank_le_height G
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hr
  omega

name: NLAlib.circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_conjTranspose {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin s), IsUnit (G*Gᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_rank_eq hrs] with G hG
  apply Matrix.isUnit_of_rank_eq_card
  rw [Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose, hG, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.ae_isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have h := circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_conjTranspose hrs
  rw [← hG.map_eq] at h
  exact ae_of_ae_map hG.aemeasurable h

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_curry_sub
statement:
private lemma frobNorm_curry_sub {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (x y : p × m → ℝ) :
    frobNorm (((MeasurableEquiv.curry p m ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv x)
        - ((MeasurableEquiv.curry p m ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv y))
      = Real.sqrt (∑ ij, (x ij - y ij) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobNorm
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  congr 1
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.gaussian_concentration
statement:
theorem gaussian_concentration {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (h : Matrix p m ℝ → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hLip : ∀ X Y, |h X - h Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y)) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable h (gaussianMatrix p m) ∧
    (gaussianMatrix p m).real {X | (∫ Y, h Y ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)) + L * t ≤ h X}
      ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  set e := (MeasurableEquiv.curry p m ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv with he
  have hg : ∀ x y : p × m → ℝ,
      |(h ∘ e) x - (h ∘ e) y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ ij, (x ij - y ij) ^ 2) := by
    intro x y
    rw [← frobNorm_curry_sub]
    exact hLip _ _
  have hint := integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector (h ∘ e) L hL.le hg
  have hmeas := measureReal_ge_le_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector (h ∘ e) L hL hg t ht
  rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry]
  refine ⟨(integrable_map_equiv e h).mpr hint, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_map_equiv, measureReal_def, e.map_apply]
  exact hmeas

name: NLAlib.gaussian_concentration_of_hasLaw
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous h := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro X₀
    rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    have hc : Continuous (fun Y : Matrix p m ℝ => L * frobNorm (Y - X₀)) := by
      unfold frobNorm; simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]; fun_prop
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun Y : Matrix p m ℝ => L * frobNorm (Y - X₀)) (nhds X₀)
        (nhds 0) := by
      have := hc.tendsto X₀
      simpa [frobNorm, frobSq] using this
    refine squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun Y => ?_) h0
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    exact hLip Y X₀
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun G => (∫ Y, h Y ∂(gaussianMatrix p m)) + L * t ≤ h G)
    (measurableSet_le measurable_const hc.measurable)]
  exact (gaussian_concentration h L hL hLip t ht).2

name: NLAlib.gueMatrix_isHermitian
statement:

name: NLAlib.gueRawEntryCoefficient_dot
statement:
private theorem gueRawEntryCoefficient_dot
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n]
    (i j : c) (a b d e : n) :
    gueRawEntryCoefficient i a b ⬝ᵥ gueRawEntryCoefficient j d e =
      if i = j ∧ a = e ∧ b = d then 4 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gueRawEntryCoefficient, add_dotProduct, sub_dotProduct,
    smul_dotProduct, single_dotProduct, one_mul, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    by_cases had : a = d <;> by_cases hae : a = e <;>
      by_cases hbd : b = d <;> by_cases hbe : b = e <;>
      simp_all [mul_add, mul_sub, Complex.I_mul_I] <;> norm_num
  · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.gueMatrix_apply_eq_linearForm
statement:
private theorem gueMatrix_apply_eq_linearForm
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n]
    (x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ) (i : c) (a b : n) :
    gueMatrix x i a b = complexGaussianLinearForm
      (((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) • gueRawEntryCoefficient i a b) x
proof:
:= by
  change _ = (((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) •
    gueRawEntryCoefficient i a b) ⬝ᵥ (fun k => (x k : ℂ))
  simp only [smul_dotProduct, gueRawEntryCoefficient, add_dotProduct,
    sub_dotProduct, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
  simp [gueMatrix, gueRawMatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gueMatrix_apply_eq_complexGaussianLinearForm
statement:
theorem gueMatrix_apply_eq_complexGaussianLinearForm
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n]
    (x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ) (i : c) (a b : n) :
    gueMatrix x i a b = complexGaussianLinearForm (gueEntryCoefficient i a b) x
proof:

name: NLAlib.gueMatrixCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gueMatrixCLM_apply
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n]
    (x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ) : gueMatrixCLM x = fun i => gueMatrix x i
proof:
:= by
  ext i a b
  change complexGaussianLinearFormCLM
    (((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) • gueRawEntryCoefficient i a b) x = _
  rw [complexGaussianLinearFormCLM_apply, gueMatrix_apply_eq_linearForm]

name: NLAlib.measurable_gueMatrix
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_gueMatrix
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n] :
    Measurable (fun x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ => fun i => gueMatrix x i)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
  intro a b
  have h := (complexGaussianLinearFormCLM
    (((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) • gueRawEntryCoefficient i a b)).continuous.measurable
  change Measurable (fun x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ => complexGaussianLinearFormCLM
    (((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) • gueRawEntryCoefficient i a b) x) at h
  simpa only [complexGaussianLinearFormCLM_apply, gueMatrix_apply_eq_linearForm] using h

    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n] :

      (gaussianVector (GUECoordinate c n))

name: NLAlib.integral_gueMatrix_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_gueMatrix_eq_zero
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n] :
    (∫ x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ, (fun i => gueMatrix x i)
      ∂gaussianVector (GUECoordinate c n)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let K := GUECoordinate c n
  have hint := (hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianVector K).integrable
  have hmean : (∫ x : K → ℝ, x ∂gaussianVector K) = 0 := by
    ext k
    have he := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : K => ℝ) k).integral_comp_comm hint
    change (∫ x : K → ℝ, x ∂gaussianVector K) k = 0
    have he' : (∫ x : K → ℝ, x ∂gaussianVector K) k =
        ∫ x : K → ℝ, x k ∂gaussianVector K := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] using he.symm
    exact he'.trans (integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k))
  have he := (gueMatrixCLM (c := c) (n := n)).integral_comp_comm hint
  simpa only [gueMatrixCLM_apply, hmean, map_zero] using he

name: NLAlib.hasGaussianLaw_gueRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem hasGaussianLaw_gueRealCoordinates
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n] :
    HasGaussianLaw (gueRealCoordinates : (GUECoordinate c n → ℝ) → GUECoordinate c n → ℝ)
      (gaussianVector (GUECoordinate c n))
proof:
:= by
  let T : (GUECoordinate c n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (GUECoordinate c n → ℝ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k =>
      let L := complexGaussianLinearFormCLM
        (((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) •
          gueRawEntryCoefficient k.1 k.2.1 k.2.2.1)
      if k.2.2.2 = 0 then Complex.reCLM.comp L else Complex.imCLM.comp L
  have hT : ∀ x, T x = gueRealCoordinates x := by
    intro x
    ext k
    simp only [T, ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply, gueRealCoordinates]
    split <;> simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      complexGaussianLinearFormCLM_apply, gueMatrix_apply_eq_linearForm]
    rfl
    rfl
  simpa only [hT] using
    (hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianVector (GUECoordinate c n)).map_fun T

name: NLAlib.integral_gueMatrix_entry_mul
statement:
theorem integral_gueMatrix_entry_mul
    {c n : Type*} [Fintype c] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq c] [DecidableEq n]
    [Nonempty n] (i j : c) (a b d e : n) :
    (∫ x : GUECoordinate c n → ℝ, gueMatrix x i a b * gueMatrix x j d e
      ∂gaussianVector (GUECoordinate c n)) =
      if i = j ∧ a = e ∧ b = d then (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [gueMatrix_apply_eq_linearForm]
  rw [integral_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    gueRawEntryCoefficient_dot]
  by_cases h : i = j ∧ a = e ∧ b = d
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
    have hnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by positivity
    have hscale : 4 * ((2 * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n))⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ 2 =
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      calc
        _ = ((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card n)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_pow, inv_pow]
          ring
        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg]
    have hscaleC := congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ)) hscale
    push_cast at hscaleC
    convert hscaleC using 1
    simp only [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_mul,
      Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
    ring
  · simp [h]

      (gaussianVector (GUECoordinate c n))

  exact integrable_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul _ _

name: NLAlib.sum_gaussianSymmetricSumEntryCoefficient_mul
statement:
theorem sum_gaussianSymmetricSumEntryCoefficient_mul {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (i j k l : n) :
    (∑ u, ∑ v, gaussianSymmetricSumEntryCoefficient i j u v *
      gaussianSymmetricSumEntryCoefficient k l u v) =
        2 * ((if i = k ∧ j = l then 1 else 0) + (if i = l ∧ j = k then 1 else 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle (a b c d : n) :
      (∑ u, ∑ v, (Matrix.single a b 1 : Matrix n n ℝ) u v *
        (Matrix.single c d 1 : Matrix n n ℝ) u v) =
          if a = c ∧ b = d then 1 else 0 := by
    simp [Matrix.single, ite_and, mul_ite]
  simp only [gaussianSymmetricSumEntryCoefficient, Matrix.add_apply, add_mul, mul_add,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsingle]
  by_cases h1 : i = k ∧ j = l <;> by_cases h2 : i = l ∧ j = k <;>
    simp_all [eq_comm, and_comm] <;> ring

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_transpose_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasLaw_transpose_circularComplexGaussianMatrix :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix m n ℂ => Gᵀ) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix n m)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Matrix.measurable_transpose.aemeasurable,?_⟩
  rw [circularMatrix_eq_map_curry,
    Measure.map_map Matrix.measurable_transpose (MeasurableEquiv.measurable _)]
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix m n ℂ => Gᵀ) ∘
      ((MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℂ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv) =
      ((MeasurableEquiv.curry n m ℂ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv) ∘
        (fun x : m × n → ℂ => fun ji : n × m => x ji.swap) := by
    funext x
    rfl
  have hswap : Measurable (fun x : m × n → ℂ => fun ji : n × m => x ji.swap) :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun ji => measurable_pi_apply _
  rw [hfun,← Measure.map_map (MeasurableEquiv.measurable _) hswap,
    map_comp_injective_pi _ Prod.swap Prod.swap_injective,← circularMatrix_eq_map_curry]

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_conj_circularComplexGaussianMatrix

theorem hasLaw_conj_circularComplexGaussianMatrix :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix m n ℂ => G.map star) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m n)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m n)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : MeasurePreserving (star : (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) (circularComplexGaussianVector n) :=
    ⟨(by fun_prop),hasLaw_star_circularComplexGaussianVector.map_eq⟩
  have hp := measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : m => circularComplexGaussianVector n)
    (fun _ : m => circularComplexGaussianVector n) (fun _ => hs)
  have hm := measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_circularComplexGaussianMatrix (m := m) (n := n)
  exact (hm.comp (hp.comp hm.symm)).hasLaw

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_conjTranspose_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasLaw_conjTranspose_circularComplexGaussianMatrix :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix m n ℂ => Gᴴ) (circularComplexGaussianMatrix n m)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix m n)

  exact hasLaw_transpose_circularComplexGaussianMatrix.comp hasLaw_conj_circularComplexGaussianMatrix

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_rowSplit
statement:
theorem hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_rowSplit :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix (m ⊕ k) t ℂ =>
      (G.submatrix Sum.inl id,G.submatrix Sum.inr id))
      ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix m t).prod (circularComplexGaussianMatrix k t))
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (m ⊕ k) t)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi
    (fun _ : m ⊕ k => circularComplexGaussianVector t)
  have hp := (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_circularComplexGaussianMatrix (m := m) (n := t)).prod
    (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_circularComplexGaussianMatrix (m := k) (n := t))
  have hflat := (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
    (m := m ⊕ k) (n := t)).symm
  exact (hp.comp (hsum.comp hflat)).hasLaw

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_blocks
statement:
theorem hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_blocks [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq k] [DecidableEq t]
    (U : Matrix n m ℂ) (V : Matrix n k ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix n t ℂ => (Uᴴ*G,Vᴴ*G))
      ((circularComplexGaussianMatrix m t).prod (circularComplexGaussianMatrix k t))
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix n t)
proof:
:= by
  let W := Matrix.fromCols U V
  have hVU : Vᴴ*U=0 := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose U,← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hUV,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_zero]
  have hW : HasOrthonormalCols W := by
    change Wᴴ*W=1
    have hWC : Wᴴ=Matrix.fromRows Uᴴ Vᴴ := by
      ext i j
      cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hWC]
    simp only [W,Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols,
      show Uᴴ*U=1 from hU,show Vᴴ*V=1 from hV,hUV,hVU,Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  have hG := hasLaw_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_orthonormalRows (t := t) Wᴴ
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hW)
  have h := (hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_rowSplit (m := m) (k := k) (t := t)).comp hG
  apply h.congr
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro G
  apply Prod.ext <;> ext i j <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.circularComplexGaussianMatrix_indepFun_block
statement:
theorem circularComplexGaussianMatrix_indepFun_block [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m]
    [DecidableEq k] [DecidableEq t]

      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix n t)
proof:
:= by
  have hUl := hasLaw_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_orthonormalRows (t := t) Uᴴ
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hU)
  have hVl := hasLaw_mul_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_orthonormalRows (t := t) Vᴴ
    (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hV)
  exact (indepFun_iff_hasLaw_prodMk_prod hUl hVl).mpr
    (hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_blocks U V hU hV hUV)

statement:

    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n (b × t)) μ) (a : b) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => Matrix.of fun i j => G ω i (a, j)) (gaussianMatrix n t) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_of_iIndepFun
  · intro ij
    exact hG.hasLaw_entry_gaussianReal ij.1 (a, ij.2)
  · exact iIndepFun.precomp (g := fun ij : n × t => (ij.1, (a, ij.2)))
      (by intro i j h; cases i; cases j; simpa using h)
      hG.iIndepFun_entry_of_gaussianMatrix

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_columnBlocks
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_columnBlocks
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix n (b × t)) μ) :
    HasLaw (fun ω a => Matrix.of fun i j => G ω i (a, j))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : b => gaussianMatrix n t) μ
proof:
:= by
  let H : Ω → Matrix b (n × t) ℝ := fun ω => Matrix.of fun a ij => G ω ij.1 (a, ij.2)
  have hH : HasLaw H (gaussianMatrix b (n × t)) μ := by
    apply hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_of_iIndepFun
    · intro aij
      exact hG.hasLaw_entry_gaussianReal aij.2.1 (aij.1, aij.2.2)
    · exact iIndepFun.precomp (g := fun aij : b × (n × t) =>
          (aij.2.1, (aij.1, aij.2.2)))
        (by intro ⟨a,i,j⟩ ⟨a',i',j'⟩ h; simpa [Prod.mk.injEq, and_comm, and_left_comm] using h)
        hG.iIndepFun_entry_of_gaussianMatrix
  have hrows := measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix.symm.hasLaw.comp hH
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.curry n t ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv
  have he : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi fun _ : n × t => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (gaussianMatrix n t) :=
    ⟨e.measurable, gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry.symm⟩
  exact (measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : b => Measure.pi fun _ : n × t => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun _ : b => gaussianMatrix n t) (fun _ => he)).hasLaw.comp hrows

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_map_uncurry
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_map_uncurry :
    Measure.map (fun G : Matrix m n ℝ => fun ab : m × n => G ab.1 ab.2)
      (gaussianMatrix m n) = Measure.pi fun _ : m × n => gaussianReal 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : Measurable fun G : Matrix m n ℝ => fun ab : m × n => G ab.1 ab.2 :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun ab => Matrix.measurable_entry ab.1 ab.2
  have harr : Measure.map (fun G : m → n → ℝ => fun ab : m × n => G ab.1 ab.2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : m => Measure.pi fun _ : n => gaussianReal 0 1) =
      Measure.pi fun _ : m × n => gaussianReal 0 1 := by
    symm
    have hmeas' : Measurable fun G : m → n → ℝ => fun ab : m × n => G ab.1 ab.2 :=
      measurable_pi_lambda _ fun ab => (measurable_pi_apply ab.2).comp (measurable_pi_apply ab.1)
    refine Measure.pi_eq fun s hs => ?_
    rw [Measure.map_apply hmeas' (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs)]
    have hpre : (fun G : m → n → ℝ => fun ab : m × n => G ab.1 ab.2) ⁻¹'
        Set.univ.pi s = Set.univ.pi fun a => Set.univ.pi fun b => s (a, b) := by
      ext G
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, Prod.forall]
    rw [hpre, Measure.pi_pi]
    simp_rw [Measure.pi_pi]
    rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]
  rw [gaussianMatrix, Measure.map_map hmeas Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv.measurable]
  exact harr

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry :
    gaussianMatrix m n =
      (Measure.pi fun _ : m × n => gaussianReal 0 1).map
        ((MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv)
proof:
:= by
  have := Measure.infinitePi_map_curry (fun (_ : m) (_ : n) => gaussianReal 0 1)
  simp only [Measure.infinitePi_eq_pi] at this
  rw [gaussianMatrix, ← this, Measure.map_map Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv.measurable
    (MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ).measurable]
  rfl

statement:

    iIndepFun (fun (ab : m × n) (G : Matrix m n ℝ) => G ab.1 ab.2) (gaussianMatrix m n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map
    (f := fun (ab : m × n) (G : Matrix m n ℝ) => G ab.1 ab.2)
    (fun ab => (Matrix.measurable_entry ab.1 ab.2).aemeasurable)).mpr ?_
  refine gaussianMatrix_map_uncurry.trans ?_
  congr 1
  funext ab
  exact (measurePreserving_gaussianMatrix_entry ab.1 ab.2).map_eq.symm

proof:

  have hc : HasLaw ((MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv)
      (gaussianMatrix m n) (gaussianVector (m × n)) :=
    ⟨((MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv).measurable.aemeasurable,
      gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry.symm⟩
  exact hc.comp hf

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_sq_eq_one (a : m) (b : n) :
    ∫ G, G a b ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix m n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_comp_gaussianMatrix_entry_eq a b (fun x => x ^ 2) (by fun_prop)]
  have h := variance_eq_sub (memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := 0) (v := 1) 2 (by simp))
  rw [variance_id_gaussianReal] at h
  simp [integral_id_gaussianReal] at h
  exact h.symm

theorem integrable_const_mul_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul (a c : m) (b d : n) (k : ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (a c : m) (b d : n) :
    ∫ G, G a b * G c d ∂(gaussianMatrix m n) = if a = c ∧ b = d then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (a, b) = (c, d)
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
    simpa [← pow_two] using integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_sq_eq_one a b
  · have hne : ¬(a = c ∧ b = d) := fun h' => h (by rw [h'.1, h'.2])
    simp only [hne, if_false]
    have := (iIndepFun_gaussianMatrix_entry.indepFun h).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
      (Matrix.measurable_entry a b).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Matrix.measurable_entry c d).aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [this, integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_eq_zero, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
    {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (f : Matrix p m ℝ → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLip : ∀ X Y, |f X - f Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y)) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun X => f X - ∫ Y, f Y ∂gaussianMatrix p m)
      ⟨L ^ 2, sq_nonneg L⟩ (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.curry p m ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv
  have h : HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x => f (e x) - ∫ y, f (e y) ∂gaussianVector (p × m))
      ⟨L ^ 2, sq_nonneg L⟩ (gaussianVector (p × m)) := by
    simpa only [one_mul, Function.comp_def] using
      hasSubgaussianMGF_of_logSobolev hasEuclideanLogSobolev_gaussianVector
        (f ∘ e) L hL (fun x y => by rw [← frobNorm_curry_sub]; exact hLip _ _)
  rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry, integral_map_equiv]
  constructor
  · intro t
    exact (integrable_map_equiv e _).mpr (h.integrable_exp_mul t)
  · intro t
    simpa only [mgf, integral_map_equiv] using h.mgf_le t

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
    {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (f : Matrix p m ℝ → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLip : ∀ X Y, |f X - f Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y)) :
    Integrable f (gaussianMatrix p m)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.curry p m ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv
  have h := integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector (f ∘ e) L hL (fun x y => by
    rw [← frobNorm_curry_sub]
    exact hLip _ _)
  rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry]
  exact (integrable_map_equiv e f).mpr h

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_sub_integral_le_two_mul_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_abs_sub_integral_le_two_mul_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
    {p m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] (f : Matrix p m ℝ → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLip : ∀ X Y, |f X - f Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y)) :
    (∫ X, |f X - ∫ Y, f Y ∂gaussianMatrix p m| ∂gaussianMatrix p m) ≤ 2 * L
proof:
:= by
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.curry p m ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv
  have h := integral_abs_sub_integral_le_two_mul_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector
    (f ∘ e) L hL (fun x y => by rw [← frobNorm_curry_sub]; exact hLip _ _)
  rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry, integral_map_equiv, integral_map_equiv]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_le_mean_add_two_mul_sum_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_le_mean_add_two_mul_sum_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
    {p m κ : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype m] [Fintype κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (f : κ → Matrix p m ℝ → ℝ) (L : κ → ℝ) (hL : ∀ k, 0 ≤ L k)
    (hLip : ∀ k X Y, |f k X - f k Y| ≤ L k * frobNorm (X - Y))
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ k, ∫ X, f k X ∂gaussianMatrix p m ≤ M) :
    (∫ X, ⨆ k, f k X ∂gaussianMatrix p m) ≤ M + 2 * ∑ k, L k
proof:
:= by
  apply (integral_iSup_le_mean_add_sum_integral_abs_sub f
    (fun k => integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix (f k) (L k) (hL k) (hLip k)) hM).trans
  gcongr
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
    integral_abs_sub_integral_le_two_mul_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
      (f k) (L k) (hL k) (hLip k)

name: NLAlib.continuous_frobNorm_of
statement:
theorem continuous_frobNorm_of (p m : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun X : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => frobNorm X)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobNorm
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
statement:
theorem continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm {p m : ℕ} (h : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ X Y, |h X - h Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y)) : Continuous h
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro X₀
  rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
  have hc : Continuous (fun Y : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => L * frobNorm (Y - X₀)) :=
    continuous_const.mul ((continuous_frobNorm_of p m).comp (continuous_id.sub
      continuous_const))
  have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun Y : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => L * frobNorm (Y - X₀))
      (nhds X₀) (nhds 0) := by
    have := hc.tendsto X₀
    simpa [frobNorm, frobSq] using this
  refine squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun Y => ?_) h0
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact hLip Y X₀

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm {p m : ℕ}
    (h : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLip : ∀ X Y, |h X - h Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y)) :
    Integrable h (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) ∧
      Integrable (fun X => h X ^ 2) (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  have hcont := continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm h L hLip
  have hF := integrable_frobSq_gaussianMatrix p m
  have hbound : ∀ X, |h X| ≤ |h 0| + L * frobNorm X := by
    intro X
    have h1 := hLip X 0
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (h X) (h 0)
    linarith
  have hsq : ∀ X : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ, frobNorm X ^ 2 = frobSq X := fun X =>
    Real.sq_sqrt (frobSq_nonneg X)
  have hfn : ∀ X : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ, 0 ≤ frobNorm X := fun X => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  constructor
  · refine Integrable.mono' (((integrable_const (|h 0| + L)).add (hF.const_mul L)))
      hcont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun X => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (hbound X).trans ?_
    have := hsq X
    have := hfn X
    have : frobNorm X ≤ 1 + frobSq X := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (frobNorm X - 1)]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    nlinarith
  · refine Integrable.mono' (((integrable_const (2 * h 0 ^ 2)).add (hF.const_mul (2 * L ^ 2))))
      (hcont.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun X => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, sq_abs]
    have hb := hbound X
    have h0 : 0 ≤ |h X| := abs_nonneg _
    have : |h X| ^ 2 ≤ (|h 0| + L * frobNorm X) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 hb 2
    rw [sq_abs] at this
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    have hs := hsq X
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|h 0| - L * frobNorm X), sq_abs (h 0)]

name: NLAlib.abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le {a p m n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (X Y : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    |specNorm (S * X * T) - specNorm (S * Y * T)|
      ≤ (specNorm S * specNorm T) * frobNorm (X - Y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold specNorm
  refine (abs_norm_sub_norm_le _ _).trans ?_
  have hd : S * X * T - S * Y * T = S * (X - Y) * T := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
  rw [hd]
  have h1 := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul (S * (X - Y)) T
  have h2 := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul S (X - Y)
  have h3 := specNorm_le_frobNorm (X - Y)
  unfold specNorm at h3
  have hS : 0 ≤ ‖S‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hT : 0 ≤ ‖T‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hD : 0 ≤ ‖X - Y‖ := norm_nonneg _
  calc ‖S * (X - Y) * T‖
      ≤ ‖S * (X - Y)‖ * ‖T‖ := h1
    _ ≤ (‖S‖ * ‖X - Y‖) * ‖T‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hT
    _ ≤ (‖S‖ * frobNorm (X - Y)) * ‖T‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hS) hT
    _ = (‖S‖ * ‖T‖) * frobNorm (X - Y) := by ring

name: NLAlib.abs_frobNorm_sub_frobNorm_le
statement:
private theorem abs_frobNorm_sub_frobNorm_le {𝕜 m n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : |frobNorm A - frobNorm B| ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : frobNorm A ≤ frobNorm (A - B) + frobNorm B := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using frobNorm_add_le (A - B) B
  have h₂ : frobNorm B ≤ frobNorm (A - B) + frobNorm A := by
    have h := frobNorm_add_le (B - A) A
    rw [sub_add_cancel, show B - A = -(A - B) by abel, frobNorm_neg] at h
    exact h
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_frobNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_frobNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le {a p m n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (X Y : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    |frobNorm (S * X * T) - frobNorm (S * Y * T)| ≤
      (specNorm S * specNorm T) * frobNorm (X - Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_frobNorm_sub_frobNorm_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [show S * X * T - S * Y * T = S * (X - Y) * T by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]]
  calc
    frobNorm (S * (X - Y) * T) ≤ frobNorm (S * (X - Y)) * specNorm T :=
      frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm (X - Y)) * specNorm T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (frobNorm_mul_le_specNorm_mul_frobNorm _ _)
        (specNorm_nonneg T)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le
proof:
:= by
  have hI := integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
    (fun G => frobNorm (S * G * T)) (specNorm S * specNorm T)
    (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg S) (specNorm_nonneg T)) (abs_frobNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)
  have h := integral_le_sqrt_integral_sq hI.1 hI.2
  simp_rw [frobNorm_sq] at h
  rw [integral_frobSq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul, Real.sqrt_mul (frobSq_nonneg S)] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_measureReal_gt_le_of_mean_le
statement:
private theorem gaussianMatrix_measureReal_gt_le_of_mean_le {p m : ℕ}
    (f : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ → ℝ) {L M u : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hzero : f 0 = 0) (hLip : ∀ X Y, |f X - f Y| ≤ L * frobNorm (X - Y))
    (hmean : ∫ G, f G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ≤ M) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)).real {G | M + u * L < f G} ≤
      Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL | hL
  · have hf : ∀ G, f G = 0 := by
      intro G
      have h := hLip G 0
      rw [← hL, zero_mul, hzero, sub_zero] at h
      exact abs_nonpos_iff.mp h
    have he : {G | M + u * L < f G} = ∅ := by
      ext G
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rw [hf G, ← hL, mul_zero, add_zero]
      exact not_lt_of_ge hM
    rw [he, measureReal_empty]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · have h := (gaussian_concentration f L hL hLip u hu).2
    refine (measureReal_mono ?_).trans h
    intro G hG
    change (∫ Y, f Y ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) + L * u ≤ f G
    change M + u * L < f G at hG
    linarith

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_frobNorm_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_lt_frobNorm_mul_mul_le {a p m n : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)).real
      {G | frobNorm S * frobNorm T + u * (specNorm S * specNorm T) <
        frobNorm (S * G * T)} ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact gaussianMatrix_measureReal_gt_le_of_mean_le _
    (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _))
    (by simp) (abs_frobNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)
    (integral_frobNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T) hu

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_mul_mul_le {a p m n : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)).real
      {G | specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T +
        u * (specNorm S * specNorm T) < specNorm (S * G * T)} ≤
      Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact gaussianMatrix_measureReal_gt_le_of_mean_le _
    (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)))
    (by simp [specNorm_zero]) (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)
    (integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T) hu

name: NLAlib.abs_schattenNorm_sub_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_schattenNorm_sub_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    |schattenNorm A p - schattenNorm B p| ≤ frobNorm (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := le_trans (by norm_num) hp
  have hnorm (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : schattenNorm M p ≤ frobNorm M := by
    simpa only [schattenNorm_two] using schattenNorm_le_of_le M (by norm_num) hp
  have hAB := (schattenNorm_add_le (A - B) B hp1).trans
    (add_le_add (hnorm (A - B)) le_rfl)
  have hBA := (schattenNorm_add_le (B - A) A hp1).trans
    (add_le_add (hnorm (B - A)) le_rfl)
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hAB hBA
  have hf : frobNorm (B - A) = frobNorm (A - B) := by
    rw [show B - A = -(A - B) by abel, frobNorm_neg]
  rw [hf] at hBA
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

    (G H : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    |schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p -
      schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b H) p| ≤
        Real.sqrt 2 * m * frobNorm (G - H)

    (frobNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le b hm hcap G H)

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun G => schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p -
        ∫ H, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b H) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ (gaussianMatrix ι ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hproxy : (Real.sqrt 2 * m) ^ 2 = 2 * m ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  simpa only [hproxy] using hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix
    (fun G => schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p) (Real.sqrt 2 * m)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hm)
    (abs_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le b hm hcap hp)

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Integrable (fun G => schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p)
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι)
proof:
:= by
  let m := ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := norm_nonneg _
  have hcap (i j : ι) : b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
    have h : |b i j| ≤ m := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_le_pi_norm (fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2) (i, j)
    simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
  exact integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix _ (Real.sqrt 2 * m)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hm)
    (abs_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le b hm hcap hp)

theorem coefficientCovariance_gueCoefficientMatrix :
    coefficientCovariance (gueCoefficientMatrix (n := n)) =
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ)⁻¹ • (1 : Matrix (n×n) (n×n) ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext rs tu
  simp only [coefficientCovariance,coefficientVectorization,Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  have hs (k : GUECoordinate Unit n) : star (gueCoefficientMatrix k tu.1 tu.2) =
      gueCoefficientMatrix k tu.2 tu.1 := by
    exact (gueCoefficientMatrix_isHermitian k).apply _ _
  simp_rw [hs]
  rw [sum_gueCoefficientMatrix_entry_mul]
  by_cases h : rs=tu
  · subst tu
    simp
  · have hh : ¬(rs.1=tu.1 ∧ rs.2=tu.2) := fun he => h (Prod.ext he.1 he.2)
    simp [hh,h]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2) (G H : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    frobNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G - symmetricGaussianMatrix b H) ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 * m * frobNorm (G - H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := G - H
  have hpoint (i j : ι) :
      ((symmetricGaussianMatrix b G - symmetricGaussianMatrix b H) i j) ^ 2 ≤
        m ^ 2 * (D i j ^ 2 + D j i ^ 2) := by
    have hcopy : D (max i j) (min i j) ^ 2 ≤ D i j ^ 2 + D j i ^ 2 := by
      by_cases hij : i ≤ j
      · simp only [max_eq_right hij, min_eq_left hij]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D i j)]
      · simp only [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hij), min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hij)]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D j i)]
    calc
      _ = b (max i j) (min i j) ^ 2 * D (max i j) (min i j) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [symmetricGaussianMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.of_apply, D]
        ring
      _ ≤ m ^ 2 * D (max i j) (min i j) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcap _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcopy (sq_nonneg m)
  have hsum : frobSq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G - symmetricGaussianMatrix b H) ≤
      2 * m ^ 2 * frobSq D := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
    apply (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hpoint i j).trans
    apply le_of_eq
    simp_rw [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => D j i ^ 2)]
    ring
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hleft := frobNorm_sq (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G - symmetricGaussianMatrix b H)
  have hright := frobNorm_sq D
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * m * frobNorm D :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hm) (frobNorm_nonneg _)
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2 * m * frobNorm D) ^ 2 = 2 * m ^ 2 * frobSq D := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsqrt, hright]
  change frobNorm _ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * m * frobNorm D
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G - symmetricGaussianMatrix b H)]

name: NLAlib.abs_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hcap : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2) (G H : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    |specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) - specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b H)| ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 * m * frobNorm (G - H)
proof:
:=
  (abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm _ _).trans
    (frobNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le b hm hcap G H)

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G => specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G)) (gaussianMatrix ι ι)
proof:
:= by
  let m := ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := norm_nonneg _
  have hcap (i j : ι) : b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
    have h : |b i j| ≤ m := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm (fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2) (i, j)
    simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
  exact integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianMatrix _ (Real.sqrt 2 * m)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hm)
    (abs_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_sub_le b hm hcap)

name: NLAlib.identDistrib_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix
statement:
theorem identDistrib_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder ι] [LinearOrder κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (b : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    IdentDistrib (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p)
      (fun G => rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (b.submatrix e e) G) p)
      (gaussianMatrix κ κ) (gaussianMatrix ι ι)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (identDistrib_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix e b hb).comp
    (measurable_rowMixedNorm hp)
  have hr (A : Matrix κ κ ℝ) : rowMixedNorm (A.submatrix e e) p = rowMixedNorm A p :=
    rowMixedNorm_submatrix_equiv A e e hp
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, hr] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix
statement:
theorem integral_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder ι] [LinearOrder κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (b : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (b.submatrix e e) G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) =
      ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix κ κ
proof:
:=
  (identDistrib_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix e b hb hp).integral_eq.symm

name: NLAlib.integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix {p m : ℕ} (c : Fin p → Fin m → ℝ) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix {p m : ℕ} (c : Fin p → Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, linForm c G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) = 0
proof:
:= by

      (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) := fun i j =>
    ((memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry i j 2 (by simp)).integrable (by simp)).const_mul _
  unfold linForm
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => h i j]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => h i j]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_eq_zero, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_sqrt_sum_sq_gaussianMatrix_entry_le
statement:
theorem integral_sqrt_sum_sq_gaussianMatrix_entry_le {k m : ℕ} (σ : Fin k → Fin m) :
    ∫ H, Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin m)) ≤ Real.sqrt k
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ => ∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin m)) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry 0 (σ j) 2 (by simp)).integrable_sq
  have hQ0 : ∀ H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2 := fun H =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hcont : Continuous (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hS : Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin m)) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_const 1).add hQ) hcont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun H => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt (hQ0 H)
    have h2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2)
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2) - 1)]
  have hS2 : Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin m)) := by
    refine hQ.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun H => ?_)
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (hQ0 H)).symm
  refine MeasureTheory.integral_le_of_integral_sq_le _ _ hS hS2 _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg k)]
  simp_rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hQ0 _)]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
    (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry 0 (σ j) 2 (by simp)).integrable_sq]
  simp [integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_sq_eq_one]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_of_le_card_mul_sq_norm
statement:
theorem frobSq_of_le_card_mul_sq_norm {r k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    frobSq G ≤ (r : ℝ) * k * ‖G‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hentry (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) : (G i j) ^ 2 ≤ ‖G‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := Matrix.norm_entry_le_entrywise_sup_norm (A := G) (i := i) (j := j)
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (G i j)) h 2
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, ← sq]
  calc (∑ i, ∑ j, (G i j) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin r, ∑ _j : Fin k, ‖G‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hentry i j
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_const_add_norm_gaussianMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_const_add_norm_gaussianMatrix_pow (r k n : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => (c + ‖G‖) ^ n)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  have : @BorelSpace (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ)
      (UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (self := PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace)) _ :=
    Matrix.instBorelSpace
  have hx : MemLp (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => G) (n : ℝ≥0∞)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) :=
    (hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).memLp (by simp)
  have hconst : MemLp (fun _ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => c) (n : ℝ≥0∞)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) := memLp_const c
  have hsum := hconst.add hx.norm
  have hint := hsum.integrable_norm_pow'
  convert! hint using 1
  funext G
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z ^ n) (Real.norm_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hc (norm_nonneg G))).symm

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le {a p m n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hI, hI2⟩ := integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
    (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T))
    (specNorm S * specNorm T) (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg S) (specNorm_nonneg T))
    (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)
  refine MeasureTheory.integral_le_of_integral_sq_le (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) _ hI hI2 _ ?_
    (integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T)
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg S) (frobNorm_nonneg T))
    (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg S) (specNorm_nonneg T))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le {a p m n : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) ∧
    ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
    (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T))
    (specNorm S * specNorm T) (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg S) (specNorm_nonneg T))
    (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)).1, integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω}
    {a p m n : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) μ) (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (S * X ω * T)) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, specNorm (S * X ω * T) ∂μ ≤ specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm _ _ (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T
  have e : ∫ ω, specNorm (S * X ω * T) ∂μ
      = ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) :=
    hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hX.map_eq] at h1
  exact ⟨h1.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable, by rw [e]; exact h2⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw
proof:
:=
  (integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw hX S T).2

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_log_envelope
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_log_envelope
    (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (a d : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hcap : ∀ i j, |b i j| * Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ d) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      200 * (a + d)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2
  let L : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ‖b i‖
  have hB0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j := fun i j => sq_nonneg _
  have hBH : B.IsHermitian := isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb
  have hL0 (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ L i := norm_nonneg _
  have hLsq (i j : Fin n) : b i j ^ 2 ≤ L i ^ 2 := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm (b i) j
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
  have hLa (i : Fin n) : L i ≤ a := by
    have hnorm : L i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 := by
      have hmax : L i ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) := by
        apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).mpr
        intro j
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ j))
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 from
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg (b i j)), hL0 i,
          Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ j, b i j ^ 2)]
    nlinarith [hrow i, hL0 i]
  have hlog0 (i : Fin n) : 0 < Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    have hi : 0 ≤ (((i : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hLd (i : Fin n) : L i * Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ d := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (hlog0 i)).mp
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hd (hlog0 i).le)).mpr
    intro j
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (hlog0 i)).mpr (hcap i j)
  have henv (i : Fin n) : L i ^ 2 * Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ (a + d) ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul (hLa i) (hLd i) (mul_nonneg (hL0 i) (hlog0 i).le) ha
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha hd]
  have hfourth (i : Fin n) : Real.sqrt (∑ j, B i j ^ 2) ≤ a * L i := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (mul_nonneg ha (hL0 i))).mpr
    have hs : (∑ j, B i j ^ 2) ≤ L i ^ 2 * ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      dsimp [B]
      nlinarith [hLsq i j, sq_nonneg (b i j), sq_nonneg (L i)]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrow i) (sq_nonneg (L i))
    nlinarith
  have henvC (i : Fin n) : Real.sqrt (∑ j, B i j ^ 2) *
      Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ (a + d) ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfourth i) (hlog0 i).le
    have hmul2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hLd i) ha
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha hd]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (add_nonneg ha hd) with hz | hpos
  · have ha0 : a = 0 := by linarith
    have hb0 : b = 0 := by
      ext i j
      have hs := (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (b i k)) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans (hrow i)
      rw [ha0] at hs
      change b i j = 0
      nlinarith
    subst b
    have heq (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : symmetricGaussianMatrix 0 G = 0 := by
      ext i j
      simp only [symmetricGaussianMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul]
    simp only [heq, specNorm_zero, integral_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg ha hd)
  · have hR := integral_norm_varianceProfileRadius_gaussianVector_le B hB0 L hL0
      (fun i j => hLsq i j) a (a + d) ha hpos hrow henv
    have hC := integral_norm_spectralAbsoluteFactor_mul_gaussianVector_le B hBH (a + d) hpos henvC
    have hnorm := integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison_maxima b hb
    rw [integral_radiusMaximum_eq_vector, integral_correctionMaximum_eq_vector] at hnorm
    change (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      8 * (∫ g, ‖fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i‖ ∂gaussianVector (Fin n)) +
        4 * (∫ g, ‖fun i => ∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hBH i k * g k‖ ∂gaussianVector (Fin n)) at hnorm
    linarith

name: NLAlib.measure_sq_dist_colSpace_le_le_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem measure_sq_dist_colSpace_le_le_gaussianReal {N p d : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hrank : B.rank + d ≤ N) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hud : u ≤ d) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)
      {g | (⨅ c : Fin p → ℝ, Real.sqrt ((g - B *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (g - B *ᵥ c))) ^ 2 ≤ u}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.exp 1 * u / d) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
                                                                                             
                                                                                           
  let V : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) :=
    Submodule.map (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin N → ℝ)).symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin)
  have hV : Module.finrank ℝ V = B.rank := by
    rw [Matrix.rank]; exact LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq _ _
  have hmemV : ∀ c : Fin p → ℝ, WithLp.toLp 2 (B *ᵥ c) ∈ V := fun c =>
    Submodule.mem_map.2 ⟨B *ᵥ c, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hW : d ≤ Module.finrank ℝ Vᗮ := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal V
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at this; omega
  let bW := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Vᗮ
  let w : Fin d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) := fun k => (bW (Fin.castLE hW k) : _)
  have hw : Orthonormal ℝ w :=
    (bW.orthonormal.comp _ (Fin.castLE_injective hW)).comp_linearIsometry Vᗮ.subtypeₗᵢ
  have hwV : ∀ k, w k ∈ Vᗮ := fun k => (bW (Fin.castLE hW k)).2
  let v : Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) := Sum.elim w 0
  have hv : Orthonormal ℝ
      ((Set.range (Sum.inl : Fin d → Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d))).domRestrict v) := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    rintro ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩ ⟨_, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩
    have h1 := (orthonormal_iff_ite.1 hw) k l
    by_cases hkl : k = l
    · subst hkl; simpa [Set.domRestrict_apply, v] using h1
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hkl (Sum.inl_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)))]
      simpa [Set.domRestrict_apply, v, hkl] using h1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq
    (by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
        omega)
  have hbk : ∀ k, b (Sum.inl k) = w k := fun k => hb _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
                                                                     
  have hbessel : ∀ g : Fin N → ℝ,
      ∑ k : Fin d, ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫ ^ 2
        ≤ (⨅ c : Fin p → ℝ, Real.sqrt ((g - B *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (g - B *ᵥ c))) ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin d, ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hc : ∀ c : Fin p → ℝ, Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin d, ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫ ^ 2)
        ≤ Real.sqrt ((g - B *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (g - B *ᵥ c)) := by
      intro c
      refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
      have h1 : ∀ k, ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫ = ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 (g - B *ᵥ c)⟫ := by
        intro k
        rw [WithLp.toLp_sub, inner_sub_right,
          Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (hmemV c) (hwV k), sub_zero]
      have h2 := hw.sum_inner_products_le (x := WithLp.toLp 2 (g - B *ᵥ c))
        (s := Finset.univ)
      rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq] at h2
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h2
      simp_rw [h1]
      refine h2.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      simp [dotProduct, sq]
    have hle := le_ciInf hc
    calc ∑ k : Fin d, ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫ ^ 2
        = Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin d, ⟪w k, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫ ^ 2) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hS0).symm
      _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hle 2
                                                                               
  set T : (Fin N → ℝ) → (Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) → ℝ) :=
    fun g => WithLp.ofLp (b.repr (WithLp.toLp 2 g)) with hT_def
  have hT := measurePreserving_orthonormalBasis_repr_pi_gaussianReal b
  set C' : Set (Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) → ℝ) := {h | ∑ k : Fin d, h (Sum.inl k) ^ 2 ≤ u} with hC'
  have hC'm : MeasurableSet C' := by
    refine measurableSet_le ?_ measurable_const
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun k _ => (measurable_pi_apply _).pow_const 2
  have hsub : {g : Fin N → ℝ |
      (⨅ c : Fin p → ℝ, Real.sqrt ((g - B *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (g - B *ᵥ c))) ^ 2 ≤ u} ⊆ T ⁻¹' C' := by
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hC', Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hT_def] at hg ⊢
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) ((hbessel g).trans hg)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, hbk]
  have hmarg : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) => gaussianReal 0 1) C'
      = (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin d => gaussianReal 0 1) {g | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ u} := by
    have he := measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi
      (fun _ : Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) => gaussianReal 0 1)
    have hpre : C' = (MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) => ℝ) ⁻¹'
        ({g : Fin d → ℝ | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ u} ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      ext h; simp [hC', MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi, Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi]
    have hC0 : MeasurableSet {g : Fin d → ℝ | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ u} := by
      refine measurableSet_le ?_ measurable_const
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun k _ => (measurable_pi_apply _).pow_const 2
    rw [hpre, he.measure_preimage (hC0.prod MeasurableSet.univ).nullMeasurableSet,
      Measure.prod_prod, measure_univ, mul_one]
  calc (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)
        {g | (⨅ c : Fin p → ℝ, Real.sqrt ((g - B *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (g - B *ᵥ c))) ^ 2 ≤ u}
      ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1) (T ⁻¹' C') := measure_mono hsub
    _ = (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin d ⊕ Fin (N - d) => gaussianReal 0 1) C' :=
        hT.measure_preimage hC'm.nullMeasurableSet
    _ = _ := hmarg
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        (measureReal_sum_sq_le_le_gaussianVector hd u hu hud)

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_updateCol_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_updateCol_gaussianMatrix (N n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) × (Fin N → ℝ) =>
        Matrix.of fun i => Function.update (p.1 i) j (p.2 i))
      ((gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := MeasurePreserving.symm _ (measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ
    (Fin N) (fun _ => Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1) (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1))
  have h2 := measurePreserving_pi
    (fun _ : Fin N => (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1).prod (gaussianReal 0 1))
    (fun _ => Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun _ => MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_update_pi (fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1) j)
  have hof := measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix (m := Fin N) (n := Fin n)
  exact hof.comp ((h2.comp h1).comp (hof.symm.prod (MeasurePreserving.id _)))

name: NLAlib.measurable_iInf_sqrt_mulVec
proof:
:= by

  refine upperSemicontinuous_ciInf (fun A => ⟨0, ?_⟩) fun x => ?_
