name: NLAlib.rank_update_col_zero_le
statement:
private lemma rank_update_col_zero_le {N n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.of fun i l => Function.update (A i) j 0 l).rank ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  let B' : Matrix (Fin N) {l : Fin n // l ≠ j} ℝ := Matrix.of fun i l => A i l.1
  let E : Matrix {l : Fin n // l ≠ j} (Fin n) ℝ := Matrix.of fun l k => if k = l.1 then 1 else 0
  have hBE : (Matrix.of fun i l => Function.update (A i) j 0 l) = B' * E := by
    ext i k
    simp only [B', E, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    by_cases hk : k = j
    · subst hk
      rw [Function.update_self]
      symm
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
      rw [if_neg]; intro h; exact l.2 h.symm
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hk, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨k, hk⟩]
      · simp
      · intro b _ hb; rw [if_neg]; intro h; apply hb; exact Subtype.ext h.symm
      · simp
  rw [hBE]
  calc (B' * E).rank ≤ B'.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _
    _ ≤ Fintype.card {l : Fin n // l ≠ j} := Matrix.rank_le_card_width _
    _ = n - 1 := by simp [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]

name: NLAlib.updateCol_mulVec
statement:
private lemma updateCol_mulVec {N n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (g : Fin N → ℝ) (j : Fin n)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x j = 1) :
    Matrix.of (fun i => Function.update (A i) j (g i)) *ᵥ x
      = g - (Matrix.of fun i l => Function.update (A i) j 0 l) *ᵥ (-x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply,
    mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have h : ∀ l, Function.update (A i) j (g i) l * x l
      = Function.update (A i) j 0 l * x l + (if l = j then g i * x l else 0) := by
    intro l
    by_cases hl : l = j
    · subst hl; simp
    · simp [hl]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => h l, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), hx, mul_one, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.measure_sq_dist_col_span_le_le_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measure_sq_dist_col_span_le_le_gaussianMatrix {N n : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (j : Fin n)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hud : u ≤ (N : ℝ) - n + 1) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)).real {A | (⨅ x : {x : Fin n → ℝ // x j = 1},
        Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x.1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.1))) ^ 2 ≤ u}
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 * u / ((N : ℝ) - n + 1)) ^ (((N : ℝ) - n + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 1).le hu) (hu.trans hud)) _) ?_
  have hS : MeasurableSet {A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ | (⨅ x : {x : Fin n → ℝ // x j = 1},
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x.1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.1))) ^ 2 ≤ u} :=
    measurableSet_le ((measurable_iInf_sqrt_mulVec j).pow_const 2) measurable_const
  have hΦ := measurePreserving_updateCol_gaussianMatrix N n j
  rw [← hΦ.measure_preimage hS.nullMeasurableSet, Measure.prod_apply (hΦ.measurable hS)]
  have hd : ((N - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) - n + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hnN, Nat.cast_one]
  set bound := ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.exp 1 * u / ((N : ℝ) - n + 1)) ^ (((N : ℝ) - n + 1) / 2))
  calc ∫⁻ A, (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1) _ ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
      ≤ ∫⁻ _, bound ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := lintegral_mono fun A => ?_
    _ = bound := by rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
  set B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i l => Function.update (A i) j 0 l with hB
  have hrank : B.rank + (N - n + 1) ≤ N := by
    have : B.rank ≤ n - 1 := rank_update_col_zero_le A j
    have : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (fun h => by subst h; exact j.elim0)
    omega
  have key := measure_sq_dist_colSpace_le_le_gaussianReal B (d := N - n + 1) (by omega) hrank
    u hu (by rw [hd]; exact hud)
  rw [hd] at key
  refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) key
  intro g hg
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hg ⊢
  refine le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.iInf_nonneg fun _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ?_ 2) hg
  have hne : Nonempty {x : Fin n → ℝ // x j = 1} := ⟨⟨Pi.single j 1, by simp⟩⟩
  refine le_ciInf fun x => ?_
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun c : Fin n → ℝ =>
      Real.sqrt ((g - B *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (g - B *ᵥ c))) :=
    ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩
  refine (ciInf_le hbdd (-x.1)).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [hB, ← updateCol_mulVec A g j x.1 x.2]

name: NLAlib.measure_sigmaMin_le_le_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measure_sigmaMin_le_le_gaussianMatrix {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) (s : ℝ)
    (hsd : n * s ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ) - n + 1) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)).real {A | singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ s}
      ≤ n * (Real.exp 1 * n * s ^ 2 / ((N : ℝ) - n + 1)) ^ (((N : ℝ) - n + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (Real.rpow_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (by positivity) ((by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n * s ^ 2).trans hsd)) _)) ?_
  have : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
  set D : Fin n → (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) → ℝ := fun j A =>
    ⨅ x : {x : Fin n → ℝ // x j = 1},
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x.1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.1)) with hD
  have hD0 : ∀ j A, 0 ≤ D j A := fun j A =>
    Real.iInf_nonneg fun x => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsub : {A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ | singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ s}
      ⊆ ⋃ j : Fin n, {A | D j A ^ 2 ≤ n * s ^ 2} := by
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_iInf_norm_mulVec_le_of_singularValues_last_le A s hA
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hj
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, ?_⟩
    show D j A ^ 2 ≤ n * s ^ 2
    have h1 : D j A ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt n * s) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hD0 j A)
      (by simpa only [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self] using hj) 2
    rwa [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n)] at h1
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * s ^ 2 := by positivity
  calc (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) {A | singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ s}
      ≤ (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) (⋃ j : Fin n, {A | D j A ^ 2 ≤ n * s ^ 2}) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) {A | D j A ^ 2 ≤ n * s ^ 2} :=
        measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, ENNReal.ofReal
          ((Real.exp 1 * (n * s ^ 2) / ((N : ℝ) - n + 1)) ^ (((N : ℝ) - n + 1) / 2)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
          rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
            (measure_sq_dist_col_span_le_le_gaussianMatrix hnN j (n * s ^ 2) hu0 hsd)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal
          (n * (Real.exp 1 * n * s ^ 2 / ((N : ℝ) - n + 1)) ^ (((N : ℝ) - n + 1) / 2)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
          ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg n), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.measure_sq_dist_col_span_le_le_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measure_sq_dist_col_span_le_le_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {N n : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) μ) (hnN : n ≤ N) (j : Fin n)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hud : u ≤ (N : ℝ) - n + 1) :
    μ.real {ω | (⨅ x : {x : Fin n → ℝ // x j = 1},
        Real.sqrt ((X ω *ᵥ x.1) ⬝ᵥ (X ω *ᵥ x.1))) ^ 2 ≤ u}
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 * u / ((N : ℝ) - n + 1)) ^ (((N : ℝ) - n + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (⨅ x : {x : Fin n → ℝ // x j = 1}, Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x.1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x.1))) ^ 2 ≤ u)
    (measurableSet_le ((measurable_iInf_sqrt_mulVec j).pow_const 2) measurable_const)]
  exact measure_sq_dist_col_span_le_le_gaussianMatrix hnN j u hu hud

name: NLAlib.measure_sigmaMin_le_le_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous ((fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm (fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ s)
    (measurableSet_le hc.measurable measurable_const)]
  exact measure_sigmaMin_le_le_gaussianMatrix hn hnN s hsd

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileFirstPart_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileFirstPart_le
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hthreshold : ∀ k i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
      A i j ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k))) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ 224 * (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G) ≤
        ⨆ t : Fin (n + 1), specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart A t.val) G) := by
    have hmax (t : Fin (n + 1)) :
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart A t.val) G) ≤
          ⨆ t : Fin (n + 1), specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart A t.val) G) :=
      le_ciSup (f := fun t : Fin (n + 1) =>
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart A t.val) G))
        (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove t
    rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileFirstPart]
    apply specNorm_profileFirstPart_le _ ((specNorm_nonneg _).trans (hmax 0))
    intro t ht _
    rw [← symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileBlockPart]
    exact hmax ⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_of_le ht⟩
  let f : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun t G =>
    specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart A t.val) G)
  have hInt : Integrable (fun G => ⨆ t, f t G) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) :=
    integrable_iSup_of_integrable_finite f fun t =>
      integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile (profileBlockPart A t.val)
  have hmono := integral_mono
    (f := fun G => specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G))
    (g := fun G => ⨆ t, f t G)
    (integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile (profileFirstPart A)) hInt hpoint
  exact hmono.trans (integral_iSup_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileBlockPart_le
    A A hA (fun _ _ => le_rfl) ha hb hA0 hrow hthreshold)

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileSecondPart_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileSecondPart_le
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hthreshold : ∀ k i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
      A i j ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k))) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ 224 * (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G) ≤
        ⨆ t : Fin (n + 1), specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix
          (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val) G) := by
    have hmax (t : Fin (n + 1)) :
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val) G) ≤
          ⨆ t : Fin (n + 1), specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix
            (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val) G) :=
      le_ciSup (f := fun t : Fin (n + 1) =>
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val) G))
        (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove t
    rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileSecondPart]
    apply specNorm_profileSecondPart_le _ ((specNorm_nonneg _).trans (hmax 0))
    intro t ht _
    rw [← symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileSecondPart, ← symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileBlockPart]
    exact hmax ⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_of_le ht⟩
  let f : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun t G =>
    specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val) G)
  have hInt : Integrable (fun G => ⨆ t, f t G) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) :=
    integrable_iSup_of_integrable_finite f fun t =>
      integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile
        (profileBlockPart (profileSecondPart A) t.val)
  have hmono := integral_mono
    (f := fun G => specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G))
    (g := fun G => ⨆ t, f t G)
    (integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile (profileSecondPart A)) hInt hpoint
  exact hmono.trans (integral_iSup_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileBlockPart_le
    A (profileSecondPart A) (isSymm_profile_parts A hA).2.1
    (fun i j => (profile_parts_sq_le A i j).2.1) ha hb hA0 hrow hthreshold)

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileRemainderPart_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileRemainderPart_le
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hcross : ∀ k i j, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val → j.val < profileCutoff k →
      A i j ≤ a / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k)) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileRemainderPart A) G)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ 3400 * a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hentry (i j : Fin n) : A i j ≤ a := by
    have h := (Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ => sq_nonneg (A i l))
      (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans (hrow i)
    nlinarith [hA0 i j]
  have hnonneg (i j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ profileRemainderPart A i j := by
    unfold profileRemainderPart
    split_ifs
    · exact hA0 i j
    · exact le_rfl
  have hcap (i j : Fin n) : |profileRemainderPart A i j| * Real.log (i.val + 2) ≤ 16 * a := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg i j)]
    have hw := profileRemainderPart_mul_log_le_eight_mul A hA ha hA0 hentry hcross i j
    by_cases hi : i.val = 0
    · have hr : profileRemainderPart A i j ≤ a := by
        unfold profileRemainderPart
        split_ifs
        · exact hentry i j
        · exact ha
      have hlog : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
        have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
        linarith
      simp only [hi, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (hnonneg i j)]
    · have hi' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ i.val := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ i.val)
      have hlog : Real.log (i.val + 2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (i.val + 1 : ℝ) := by
        calc
          _ ≤ Real.log ((i.val + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
            Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
          _ = _ := Real.log_pow _ _
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (hnonneg i j)]
  have h := integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_log_envelope
    (profileRemainderPart A) (isSymm_profile_parts A hA).2.2 a (16 * a) ha (by positivity)
    (fun i => (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => (profile_parts_sq_le A i j).2.2).trans (hrow i)) hcap
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_of_profile_rearrangement
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_of_profile_rearrangement
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hthreshold : ∀ k i j, profileCutoff k ≤ i.val →
      A i j ≤ b / Real.sqrt (Real.log (profilePreviousCutoff k)))
    (hcross : ∀ k i j, profileNeighborCutoff k ≤ i.val → j.val < profileCutoff k →
      A i j ≤ a / Real.sqrt (profilePreviousCutoff k)) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      4096 * (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      symmetricGaussianMatrix A G =
        symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G +
        symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G +
        symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileRemainderPart A) G := by
    rw [symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileFirstPart, symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileSecondPart,
      symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileRemainderPart]
    exact (profileFirstPart_add_secondPart_add_remainderPart _).symm
  have hF := integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile (profileFirstPart A)
  have hS := integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile (profileSecondPart A)
  have hW := integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile (profileRemainderPart A)
  have hpoint (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) ≤
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G) +
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G) +
        specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileRemainderPart A) G) := by
    rw [hdecomp G]
    exact specNorm_add_add_le (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G)
      (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G)
      (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileRemainderPart A) G)
  have htotal := integral_mono
    (f := fun G => specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G))
    (g := fun G => specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G) +
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G) +
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileRemainderPart A) G))
    (integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_of_finite_profile A) ((hF.add hS).add hW) hpoint
  have hFS : Integrable (fun G =>
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileFirstPart A) G) +
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix (profileSecondPart A) G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) := hF.add hS
  rw [integral_add hFS hW, integral_add hF hS] at htotal
  have hfirst := integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileFirstPart_le
    A hA ha hb hA0 hrow hthreshold
  have hsecond := integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileSecondPart_le
    A hA ha hb hA0 hrow hthreshold
  have hrem := integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_profileRemainderPart_le
    A hA ha hA0 hrow hcross
  linarith

name: NLAlib.matrix_net_minimax_le
statement:
private theorem matrix_net_minimax_le {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (ε : ℝ) (U : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (V : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)))
    (hV : ∀ v ∈ V, ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hcov : ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ u ∈ U, ‖x-u‖ ≤ ε) :
    (⨅ u : U, ⨆ v : V, ∑ i, ∑ j, v.1 i * A i j * u.1 j)
      ≤ restrictedMinimum A T + ε * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) A
  obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := exists_norm_eq_restrictedMinimum A hT hne
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hxu⟩ := hcov x hx
  have h1 : (⨅ u : U, ⨆ v : V, ∑ i, ∑ j, v.1 i * A i j * u.1 j) ≤ ‖Φ u‖ := by
    refine (ciInf_le (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow ⟨u,hu⟩).trans ?_
    refine Real.iSup_le (fun v => ?_) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [← inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_sum]
    exact (real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans (by rw [hV _ v.2, one_mul])
  have h2 : ‖Φ u‖ ≤ ‖Φ x‖ + specNorm A * ε := by
    have hd : Φ u = Φ x - Φ (x-u) := by rw [map_sub]; abel
    rw [hd]
    refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add_right ?_ _)
    exact (Φ.le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxu (norm_nonneg _))
  change ‖Φ x‖ = restrictedMinimum A T at he
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gaussian_net_minimax_ge
statement:
private theorem gaussian_net_minimax_ge {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))} (hT : IsCompact T)
    (ε : ℝ) (U : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (V : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))) (hU : ↑U ⊆ T) [Nonempty U]
    (hcov : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖y‖ = 1 → ∃ v ∈ V, ‖y-v‖ ≤ ε)
    (H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+m)) ℝ) :
    (1-ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))‖
      - realSupportFunction T (-WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => H 0 (Fin.castAdd m j)))
      ≤ ⨅ u : U, ⨆ v : V,
        linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u.1 j) (fun i => v.1 i) k) H
proof:
:= by
  let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i))
  let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => H 0 (Fin.castAdd m j))
  obtain ⟨y,hy1,hyh⟩ : ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪y,h⟫ = ‖h‖ := by
    by_cases hz : h = 0
    · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0,hm⟩ : Fin m) 1, by simp, ?_⟩
      simp [hz]
    · refine ⟨(‖h‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • h, norm_smul_inv_norm hz, ?_⟩
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      field_simp
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hyv⟩ := hcov y hy1
  have hvh : (1-ε) * ‖h‖ ≤ ⟪v,h⟫ := by
    have heq : ⟪v,h⟫ = ⟪y,h⟫ - ⟪y-v,h⟫ := by rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
    have hb : ⟪y-v,h⟫ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ :=
      (real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hyv (norm_nonneg _))
    rw [heq,hyh]
    linarith
  refine le_ciInf fun u => ?_
  refine le_trans ?_ (le_ciSup (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove ⟨v,hv⟩)
  have hu := inner_le_realSupportFunction hT (hU u.2) (-g)
  have heq : linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u.1 j) (fun i => v i) k) H
      = ⟪u.1,g⟫ + ⟪v,h⟫ := by
    simp [linForm, Fin.sum_univ_add, g, h, PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]
  rw [heq]
  rw [inner_neg_left, real_inner_comm] at hu
  change (1-ε) * ‖h‖ - realSupportFunction T (-g) ≤ _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.comparison_coeff_sum_sq
statement:
private theorem comparison_coeff_sum_sq {m n : ℕ}
    (u u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    (∑ _i : Fin 1, ∑ k : Fin (n+m),
      (Fin.append (fun j => u j) (fun i => v i) k -
       Fin.append (fun j => u' j) (fun i => v' i) k)^2)
      = ‖u-u'‖^2 + ‖v-v'‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]

name: NLAlib.restricted_minimum_scaled_bound
statement:
private theorem restricted_minimum_scaled_bound {N n : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ = 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (1-ε) * (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian _) - gaussianWidth T
      ≤ (∫ A, restrictedMinimum A T ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
        + ε * ∫ A, specNorm A ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Fu, hFuS, hFufin, hFucov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    hT.totallyBounded ε hε
  obtain ⟨Fv, hFvS, hFvfin, hFvcov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  set U := hFufin.toFinset with hUdef
  set V := hFvfin.toFinset with hVdef
  have hU1 : ∀ u ∈ U, ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hUdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hu
    exact hunit _ (hFuS hu)
  have hV1 : ∀ v ∈ V, ‖v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hVdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hv
    simpa using hFvS hv
  have hcovU : ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ u ∈ U, ‖x-u‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFucov hx)
    refine ⟨y, by rw [hUdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; exact hy, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hyx
    exact hyx.le
  have hUsub : ↑U ⊆ T := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hUdef, Finset.mem_coe, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hx
    exact hFuS hx
  have hcovV : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ v ∈ V, ‖x - v‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) 1 := by simpa using hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFvcov hx')
    refine ⟨y, by rw [hVdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; exact hy, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hyx; exact hyx.le
  have hUne : Nonempty U := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨u,hu,-⟩ := hcovU x hx
    exact ⟨⟨u,hu⟩⟩
  have hVne : Nonempty V := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hcovV (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) 1) (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
  
  set b : U → V → Fin 1 → Fin (n + N) → ℝ :=
    fun u v _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u.1 j) (fun i => v.1 i) k with hb
  set a : U → V → Fin N → Fin n → ℝ := fun u v i j => v.1 i * u.1 j with ha
  have hsame : ∀ (u : U) (t s : V),
      ∫ H, (linForm (b u t) H - linForm (b u s) H) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)))
        ≤ ∫ G, (linForm (a u t) G - linForm (a u s) G) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := by
    intro u t s
    simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
    rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ha, hb, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [comparison_coeff_sum_sq]
    have hc := frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_same_eq_norm_sq u.1 t.1 s.1 (hU1 _ u.2)
    norm_num only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow, zero_add]
    simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] using hc.ge
  have hdiff : ∀ (u v : U) (t s : V), u ≠ v →
      ∫ G, (linForm (a u t) G - linForm (a v s) G) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
        ≤ ∫ H, (linForm (b u t) H - linForm (b v s) H) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
    intro u v t s _
    simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
    rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ha, hb, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [comparison_coeff_sum_sq]
    simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] using
      frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_le_norm_sq_add u.1 v.1 t.1 s.1
        (hU1 _ u.2) (hU1 _ v.2) (hV1 _ t.2) (hV1 _ s.2)
  have hGM := gordon_minimax_inequality (fun u t H => linForm (b u t) H)
    (fun u t G => linForm (a u t) G)
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix (fun p : U × V => b p.1 p.2))
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix (fun p : U × V => a p.1 p.2))
    (fun u t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun u t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    hsame hdiff
  
  have hsMin : Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => restrictedMinimum A T)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm _ 1 zero_le_one
      fun X Y => by
        rw [one_mul]
        exact abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_frobNorm X Y hT hne
          (fun x hx => (hunit x hx).le)).1
  have hspec : Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A) 1 zero_le_one
      fun X Y => by
        rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y).1
  have hXmm : Integrable (fun H => ⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : V, linForm (b u t) H)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) :=
    MeasureTheory.integrable_iInf_of_fintype (fun u H => ⨆ t : V, linForm (b u t) H)
      (fun u => MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype (fun t H => linForm (b u t) H)
        (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable))
      (fun u => Measurable.iSup fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have hYmm : Integrable (fun G => ⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : V, linForm (a u t) G)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    MeasureTheory.integrable_iInf_of_fintype (fun u G => ⨆ t : V, linForm (a u t) G)
      (fun u => MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype (fun t G => linForm (a u t) G)
        (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable))
      (fun u => Measurable.iSup fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  let gn : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N)) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    fun H => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j))
  let gm : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N)) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) :=
    fun H => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i))
  have hrow := measurePreserving_gaussianMatrix_row (m := Fin 1) (n := Fin (n+N)) 0
  have hgmp := (measurePreserving_fst
    (μ := gaussianVector (Fin n)) (ν := gaussianVector (Fin N))).comp
    ((measurePreserving_gaussianVector_split n N).comp hrow)
  have hmmp := (measurePreserving_snd
    (μ := gaussianVector (Fin n)) (ν := gaussianVector (Fin N))).comp
    ((measurePreserving_gaussianVector_split n N).comp hrow)
  have hgLaw : HasLaw gn (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N))) :=
    hasLaw_toLp_gaussianVector.comp ⟨hgmp.measurable.aemeasurable,hgmp.map_eq⟩
  have hmLaw : HasLaw gm (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N))) :=
    hasLaw_toLp_gaussianVector.comp ⟨hmmp.measurable.aemeasurable,hmmp.map_eq⟩
  let Uneg : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ
  have hnLaw : HasLaw Uneg (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) :=
    ⟨Uneg.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable,stdGaussian_map Uneg⟩
  have hngLaw : HasLaw (fun H => -gn H) (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N))) := hnLaw.comp hgLaw
  have hsupp := integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT hne
  have hg : Integrable (fun H => realSupportFunction T (-gn H))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N))) := by
    rw [← hngLaw.map_eq] at hsupp
    exact hsupp.comp_aemeasurable hngLaw.aemeasurable
  have hnorm : Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) => ‖x‖) (stdGaussian _) :=
    IsGaussian.integrable_id.norm
  have hh : Integrable (fun H => ‖gm H‖) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N))) := by
    rw [← hmLaw.map_eq] at hnorm
    exact hnorm.comp_aemeasurable hmLaw.aemeasurable
  calc
    (1-ε) * (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian _) - gaussianWidth T
      = ∫ H, ((1-ε) * ‖gm H‖ - realSupportFunction T (-gn H))
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N)) := by
        rw [integral_sub (hh.const_mul _) hg, integral_const_mul]
        have em : (∫ H, ‖gm H‖ ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N)))
            = ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian _ :=
          hmLaw.integral_comp hnorm.aestronglyMeasurable
        have eg : (∫ H, realSupportFunction T (-gn H) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N)))
            = gaussianWidth T := hngLaw.integral_comp
          (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT hne).aestronglyMeasurable
        rw [em,eg]
    _ ≤ ∫ H, (⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : V, linForm (b u t) H)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n+N)) := by
        refine integral_mono ((hh.const_mul _).sub hg) hXmm fun H => ?_
        exact gaussian_net_minimax_ge hN hT ε U V hUsub hcovV H
    _ ≤ ∫ G, (⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : V, linForm (a u t) G)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n) := hGM
    _ ≤ ∫ A, (restrictedMinimum A T + ε * specNorm A)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n) := by
        refine integral_mono hYmm (hsMin.add (hspec.const_mul ε)) fun G => ?_
        refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (matrix_net_minimax_le G hT hne ε U V hV1 hcovU)
        congr 1; funext u; congr 1; funext t
        simp only [linForm, ha]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        ring
    _ = (∫ A, restrictedMinimum A T ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
          + ε * ∫ A, specNorm A ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n) := by
        rw [integral_add hsMin (hspec.const_mul ε),integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_restrictedMinimum_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_restrictedMinimum_gaussianMatrix {m n : ℕ}
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ = 1) :
    Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ => restrictedMinimum A T)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin n))
proof:
:=
  (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm _ 1 zero_le_one
    fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]
      exact abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_frobNorm X Y hT hne
        (fun x hx => (hunit x hx).le)).1

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sub_gaussianWidth_le_integral_restrictedMinimum
proof:
:= by
  let EN := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian _
  let E := ∫ A, restrictedMinimum A T ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin n)
  let Sp := ∫ A, specNorm A ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin n)
  have hEN : 0 ≤ EN := integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
  have hSp : 0 ≤ Sp := integral_nonneg fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _
  have key : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → EN - gaussianWidth T - ε*(EN+Sp) ≤ E := by
    intro ε hε
    have h := restricted_minimum_scaled_bound (by omega : 0 < m) hT hne hunit ε hε
    change (1-ε)*EN-gaussianWidth T ≤ E+ε*Sp at h
    linarith
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  let δ := EN-gaussianWidth T-E
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  let C := EN+Sp+1
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
  have h := key (δ/(2*C)) (by positivity)
  have hb : δ/(2*C)*(EN+Sp) ≤ δ/2 := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div,div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    dsimp [C]
    nlinarith
  dsimp [δ] at hb
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sub_one_le_integral_norm_stdGaussian
statement:
private theorem sqrt_sub_one_le_integral_norm_stdGaussian {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    Real.sqrt m - 1 ≤ ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian _
proof:
:= by
  have h := sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sqrt_sum_sq_sub (N := m) (n := 1) le_rfl hm
  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∫ x : Fin 1 → ℝ, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i^2) ∂gaussianVector (Fin 1) :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have heq : (∫ x : Fin m → ℝ, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i^2) ∂gaussianVector (Fin m))
      = ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian _ := by
    have hh : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) => ‖x‖)
        (stdGaussian _) := continuous_norm.aestronglyMeasurable
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq] using
      (hasLaw_toLp_gaussianVector (n := Fin m)).integral_comp hh
  rw [heq] at h
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, Real.sqrt_one] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sub_one_sub_gaussianWidth_le_integral_restrictedMinimum

name: NLAlib.measureReal_restrictedMinimum_lt_sqrt_sub_gaussianWidth_le

name: NLAlib.profileMaxRowEnergy_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_top

theorem profileMaxRowEnergy_le_integral_rowMixedNorm_top
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) :

:= by

name: NLAlib.integrable_varianceProfileRadiusMaximum
statement:
theorem integrable_varianceProfileRadiusMaximum
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) :
    Integrable (varianceProfileRadiusMaximum B) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) ℝ =>
      fun j => varianceProfileRadius B (H 0) j) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)) := by
    apply integrable_pi_iff.mpr
    intro j
    have hV : MemLp (fun H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) ℝ =>
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => Real.sqrt (B j i) * H 0 i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
        2 (gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)) := by
      rw [memLp_piLp_iff]
      intro i
      exact (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry 0 i 2 (by simp)).const_mul _
    simpa only [varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm B hB0] using hV.norm.integrable (by norm_num)
  exact h.norm

name: NLAlib.integrable_varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum
statement:
theorem integrable_varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Integrable (varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum B hB) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have h : MemLp (fun H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) ℝ =>
      fun i => ∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * H 1 k)
      2 (gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)) := by
    apply memLp_pi_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact memLp_finsetSum _ fun k _ =>
      (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry 1 k 2 (by simp)).const_mul _
  exact h.norm.integrable (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G => specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (memLp_schattenNormReal_symmetricGaussianMatrix b (p := 2) (by norm_num)).integrable
    (by norm_num)
  apply h.mono' (measurable_specNorm_of_entries (fun i j =>
    (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp (measurable_symmetricGaussianMatrix b))).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro G
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _), schattenNormReal_two]
  exact specNorm_le_frobNorm _

name: NLAlib.linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_le_maxima
statement:
theorem linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_le_maxima
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hB0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ 1) (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    linForm (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB v) H ≤
      2 * varianceProfileRadiusMaximum B H + varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum B hB H
proof:
:= by
  apply linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_le B hB hB0 v hv H _ _
    (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  · intro j
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm (fun j => varianceProfileRadius B (H 0) j) j)
  · intro i
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans
      (norm_le_pi_norm (fun i => ∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * H 1 k) i)

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_comparison_le_maxima
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_comparison_le_maxima {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hB0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (v : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (hv : ∀ t, ∑ i, v t i ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    (∫ H, (⨆ t, linForm (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB (v t)) H)
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)) ≤
      2 * (∫ H, varianceProfileRadiusMaximum B H ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)) +
        ∫ H, varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum B hB H ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  have hR := integrable_varianceProfileRadiusMaximum B hB0
  have hM := integrable_varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum B hB
  rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add (hR.const_mul 2) hM]
  apply integral_mono
    (integrable_iSup_of_fintype _ (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
      (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)) ((hR.const_mul 2).add hM)
  intro H
  apply ciSup_le
  intro t
  exact linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_le_maxima B hB hB0 (v t) (hv t) H

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison_maxima
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison_maxima
    (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      8 * (∫ H, varianceProfileRadiusMaximum (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2) H
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)) +
      4 * (∫ H, varianceProfileCorrectionMaximum (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2)
        (isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb) H ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hNunit, -, hNcover⟩ := exists_finset_sphere_net (Fin n) (ε := 1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  let I := Option {x // x ∈ N}
  let v : I → Fin n → ℝ := fun t => t.elim 0 (fun x => x.1)
  have hv (t : I) : ∑ i, v t i ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    cases t with
    | none => simp [v]
    | some x =>
      have h := hNunit x.1 x.2
      simpa only [dotProduct, v, Option.elim_some, ← sq] using h.le
  let P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun G =>
    ⨆ t, quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t)
  let Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun G =>
    ⨆ t, -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t)
  have hPi : Integrable P (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) := by
    simp only [P, quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_eq_linForm]
    exact integrable_iSup_of_fintype _ (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
      (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have hQi : Integrable Q (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) := by
    have heq (t : I) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
        -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t) =
          linForm (fun i j => -symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b (v t) i j) G := by
      rw [quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_eq_linForm]
      simp only [linForm, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    change Integrable (fun G => ⨆ t, -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t)) _
    simp_rw [heq]
    apply integrable_iSup_of_fintype _
    · intro t
      exact integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _
    · intro t
      exact (continuous_linForm _).measurable
  have hpoint (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) ≤ 2 * (P G + Q G) := by
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ P G := by
      have h := le_ciSup (Set.finite_range (fun t : I =>
        quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t))).bddAbove (none : I)
      simpa only [v, Option.elim_none, quadForm_zero_right] using h
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q G := by
      have h := le_ciSup (Set.finite_range (fun t : I =>
        -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t))).bddAbove (none : I)
      simpa only [v, Option.elim_none, quadForm_zero_right, neg_zero] using h
    have hbound := specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm
      (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr (symmetricGaussianMatrix_isSymm b G)) N
      (ε := 1 / 4) (M := P G + Q G) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (add_nonneg hP0 hQ0)
      (fun x hx => by rw [← sqrt_dotProduct_self_eq_norm, hNunit x hx, Real.sqrt_one])
      (fun y hy => by
        have hy' : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hy, one_pow]
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hNcover y hy'
        refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
        rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hxy
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))])
      (fun x hx => by
        have hp := le_ciSup (Set.finite_range (fun t : I =>
          quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t))).bddAbove (some ⟨x, hx⟩ : I)
        have hq := le_ciSup (Set.finite_range (fun t : I =>
          -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t))).bddAbove (some ⟨x, hx⟩ : I)
        change quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) x ≤ P G at hp
        change -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) x ≤ Q G at hq
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    norm_num at hbound ⊢
    linarith
  have hnorm := integral_mono (integrable_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b)
    ((hPi.add hQi).const_mul 2) hpoint
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hnorm
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hnorm
  rw [integral_add hPi hQi] at hnorm
  have hmax := integral_iSup_comparison_le_maxima
    (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2) (isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb)
    (fun i j => sq_nonneg _) v hv
  have hplus := (integral_iSup_quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison b hb v).trans hmax
  have hminus := (integral_iSup_neg_quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison b hb v).trans hmax
  change (∫ G, P G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ _ at hplus
  change (∫ G, Q G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤ _ at hminus
  linarith

name: NLAlib.ssb_hasGaussianLaw_X
statement:
private theorem ssb_hasGaussianLaw_X {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p m : ℕ} (c : ι → Fin p → Fin m → ℝ)
    (d : ι → ℝ) : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => ssbX (c t) (d t) ω) (ssbP p m)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω : (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) × ℝ => ω) (ssbP p m) := by
    have : IsGaussian (ssbP p m) := inferInstance
    exact ⟨by rw [Measure.map_id']; exact this⟩
  set L : ((Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) :=
    (linFormCLM c).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ _ _) +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun t => d t • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) ℝ)
  have h := h0.map_fun L
  have e : (fun ω t => ssbX (c t) (d t) ω) = fun ω => L ω := by
    funext ω t
    simp [L, ssbX, linFormCLM, linForm]
  rw [e]; exact h

name: NLAlib.ssb_integral_X
statement:
private theorem ssb_integral_X {p m : ℕ} (c : Fin p → Fin m → ℝ) (d : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, ssbX c d ω ∂(ssbP p m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold ssbX
  rw [integral_add ((ssb_memLp_fst c).integrable (by simp))
    (((ssb_memLp_snd p m).integrable (by simp)).const_mul d), integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_fun_fst (fun G => linForm c G), integral_fun_snd (fun x : ℝ => x)]
  simp [integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix, integral_id_gaussianReal]

name: NLAlib.ssb_X_sub
proof:
