name: NLAlib.ssb_integral_X_sq
statement:
private theorem ssb_integral_X_sq {p m : ℕ} (c : Fin p → Fin m → ℝ) (d : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, ssbX c d ω ^ 2 ∂(ssbP p m) = ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j ^ 2 + d ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : ∀ ω : (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) × ℝ, ssbX c d ω ^ 2 =
      linForm c ω.1 ^ 2 + 2 * d * (linForm c ω.1 * ω.2) + d ^ 2 * ω.2 ^ 2 := by
    intro ω; unfold ssbX; ring
  simp_rw [hexp]
  have i1 := (ssb_memLp_fst c).integrable_sq
  have i2 : Integrable (fun ω : (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) × ℝ => 2 * d * (linForm c ω.1 * ω.2))
      (ssbP p m) := ((ssb_memLp_fst c).integrable_mul (ssb_memLp_snd p m)).const_mul (2 * d)
  have i3 := (ssb_memLp_snd p m).integrable_sq.const_mul (d ^ 2)
  rw [integral_add (f := fun ω => linForm c ω.1 ^ 2 + 2 * d * (linForm c ω.1 * ω.2)) (i1.add i2) i3,
    integral_add i1 i2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_fun_fst (fun G => linForm c G ^ 2), integral_fun_snd (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)]
  have hprod := integral_prod_mul (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) (ν := gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun G => linForm c G) (fun x : ℝ => x)
  rw [hprod, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
  have h1 : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 1 := by
    have h := variance_eq_sub (memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := 0) (v := 1) 2 (by simp))
    rw [variance_id_gaussianReal] at h
    simp [integral_id_gaussianReal] at h
    exact h.symm
  simp [h1, integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix]

name: NLAlib.ssb_sup_sq_le_sum
statement:
private theorem ssb_sup_sq_le_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → ℝ) :
    max (⨆ t, f t) 0 ^ 2 ≤ ∑ t, f t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := f)
  rw [← ht0]
  have h : max (f t0) 0 ^ 2 ≤ f t0 ^ 2 := by
    rcases le_total (f t0) 0 with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f t0)]
    · rw [max_eq_left h]
  exact h.trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun t => f t ^ 2) (fun t _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (Finset.mem_univ t0))

name: NLAlib.ssb_integrable_supsq
statement:
private theorem ssb_integrable_supsq {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [Fintype ι]
    [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t, MemLp (f t) 2 μ) (hm : ∀ t, Measurable (f t)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => max (⨆ t, f t ω) 0 ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun t _ => (hf t).integrable_sq)
    (((Measurable.iSup hm).max measurable_const).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  exact ssb_sup_sq_le_sum (fun t => f t ω)

name: NLAlib.ssb_gamma_jensen
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := B)
  rw [← ht0]
  rcases le_total (B t0) 0 with hb | hb
  · rw [max_eq_right hb]
    have : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 0 := by norm_num
    rw [this]
    exact integral_nonneg fun γ => sq_nonneg _
  · rw [max_eq_left hb]
    have hpt : ∀ γ : ℝ, B t0 ^ 2 + 2 * B t0 * d t0 * γ ≤ max (⨆ t, B t + d t * γ) 0 ^ 2 := by
      intro γ
      have h1 : B t0 + d t0 * γ ≤ max (⨆ t, B t + d t * γ) 0 :=
        (le_ciSup (f := fun t => B t + d t * γ) (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove t0).trans
          (le_max_left _ _)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (max (⨆ t, B t + d t * γ) 0 - B t0), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hb]
    have hid : Integrable (fun γ : ℝ => γ) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      (memLp_id_gaussianReal' 2 (by simp)).integrable (by simp)
    have hlin : Integrable (fun γ : ℝ => B t0 ^ 2 + 2 * B t0 * d t0 * γ) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      (integrable_const _).add (hid.const_mul _)
    calc B t0 ^ 2 = ∫ γ, (B t0 ^ 2 + 2 * B t0 * d t0 * γ) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
          rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (hid.const_mul _), integral_const,
            integral_const_mul, integral_id_gaussianReal]
          simp
      _ ≤ _ := integral_mono hlin hint hpt

name: NLAlib.ssb_fubini
statement:
private theorem ssb_fubini {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {p m : ℕ}
    (c : ι → Fin p → Fin m → ℝ) (d : ι → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, max (⨆ t, linForm (c t) G) 0 ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ ∫ ω, max (⨆ t, ssbX (c t) (d t) ω) 0 ^ 2 ∂(ssbP p m)
proof:
:= by
  have hint := ssb_integrable_supsq (μ := ssbP p m) (fun t => ssbX (c t) (d t))
    (fun t => ssb_memLp_X _ _) (fun t => (ssb_continuous_X _ _).measurable)
  rw [integral_prod _ hint]
  have hL := ssb_integrable_supsq (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) (fun t => linForm (c t))
    (fun t => memLp_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  refine integral_mono_ae hL hint.integral_prod_left ?_
  filter_upwards [hint.prod_right_ae] with G hG
  exact ssb_gamma_jensen (fun t => linForm (c t) G) d hG

name: NLAlib.ssb_layercake_eq
statement:
private theorem ssb_layercake_eq {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) (h : Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable h) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (max (h ω) 0 ^ 2) ∂μ
      = ∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi 0, μ {ω | t < h ω} * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * t)
proof:
:= by
  have := lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul μ (f := fun ω => max (h ω) 0)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => le_max_right _ _) (hh.max measurable_const).aemeasurable
    (g := fun t => 2 * t) (fun t _ => (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => by
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at ht; linarith))
  have e1 : ∀ x : ℝ, ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, 2 * t = x ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]; ring
  simp only [e1] at this
  rw [this]
  refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at ht
  congr 2
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, lt_max_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (h1 | h1)
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd h1 (not_lt.2 ht.le)
  · exact fun h1 => Or.inl h1

name: NLAlib.ssb_layercake_sq
statement:
private theorem ssb_layercake_sq {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    (P : Measure Ω) (Q : Measure Ω') (f : Ω → ℝ) (g : Ω' → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hg : Measurable g) (hfi : Integrable (fun ω => max (f ω) 0 ^ 2) P)
    (hgi : Integrable (fun ω => max (g ω) 0 ^ 2) Q)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → P {ω | t < f ω} ≤ Q {ω | t < g ω}) :
    ∫ ω, max (f ω) 0 ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, max (g ω) 0 ^ 2 ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _),
    ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => sq_nonneg _),
    ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hgi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => sq_nonneg _),
    ssb_layercake_eq P f hf, ssb_layercake_eq Q g hg]
  refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_left (htail t ht) _

name: NLAlib.ssbN_nonneg
statement: private theorem ssbN_nonneg {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (x : κ → ℝ) : 0 ≤ ssbN x
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.ssbN_sq
statement: private theorem ssbN_sq {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (x : κ → ℝ) : ∑ k, x k ^ 2 = ssbN x ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)).symm

name: NLAlib.ssb_inner_le
statement:
private theorem ssb_inner_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (x x' : κ → ℝ) :
    ∑ k, x k * x' k ≤ ssbN x * ssbN x'
proof:
:=
  Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _

name: NLAlib.ssb_coeff_cmp
proof:
:= by
  have hα := ssb_inner_le x x'
  have hβ := ssb_inner_le y y'
  have hL : ∑ k, ∑ l, (x k * y l - x' k * y' l) ^ 2
      = (∑ k, x k ^ 2) * (∑ l, y l ^ 2) - 2 * ((∑ k, x k * x' k) * (∑ l, y l * y' l))
        + (∑ k, x' k ^ 2) * (∑ l, y' l ^ 2) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  have hR1 : ∑ k, (ssbN y * x k - ssbN y' * x' k) ^ 2
      = ssbN y ^ 2 * (∑ k, x k ^ 2) - 2 * (ssbN y * ssbN y') * (∑ k, x k * x' k)
        + ssbN y' ^ 2 * (∑ k, x' k ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    ring
  have hR2 : ∑ l, (ssbN x * y l - ssbN x' * y' l) ^ 2
      = ssbN x ^ 2 * (∑ l, y l ^ 2) - 2 * (ssbN x * ssbN x') * (∑ l, y l * y' l)
        + ssbN x' ^ 2 * (∑ l, y' l ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  rw [hL, hR1, hR2, ssbN_sq x, ssbN_sq x', ssbN_sq y, ssbN_sq y']
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hα) (sub_nonneg.2 hβ)]

name: NLAlib.ssb_append_sq
statement:
private theorem ssb_append_sq {p m : ℕ} (u : Fin p → ℝ) (w : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∑ _i : Fin 1, ∑ k : Fin (p + m), Fin.append u w k ^ 2 = ∑ k, u k ^ 2 + ∑ l, w l ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp

name: NLAlib.ssb_append_sub_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp

name: NLAlib.ssb_main_cmp
statement:
private theorem ssb_main_cmp {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {p m : ℕ} (x : ι → Fin p → ℝ)
    (y : ι → Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∫ G, max (⨆ t, linForm (fun k l => x t k * y t l) G) 0 ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ ∫ H, max (⨆ t, linForm (ssbYc x y t) H) 0 ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)))
proof:
:= by
  set c : ι → Fin p → Fin m → ℝ := fun t k l => x t k * y t l with hc
  set d : ι → ℝ := fun t => ssbN (x t) * ssbN (y t) with hd
  refine (ssb_fubini c d).trans ?_
  have hvar : ∀ t, ∫ ω, ssbX (c t) (d t) ω ^ 2 ∂(ssbP p m)
      = ∫ H, linForm (ssbYc x y t) H ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) := by
    intro t
    rw [ssb_integral_X_sq, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ssbYc, hc, hd]
    rw [ssb_append_sq]
    have e1 : ∑ k, ∑ l, (x t k * y t l) ^ 2 = (∑ k, x t k ^ 2) * ∑ l, y t l ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring
    have e2 : ∑ k, (ssbN (y t) * x t k) ^ 2 = ssbN (y t) ^ 2 * ∑ k, x t k ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
    have e3 : ∑ l, (ssbN (x t) * y t l) ^ 2 = ssbN (x t) ^ 2 * ∑ l, y t l ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring
    rw [e1, e2, e3, ssbN_sq (x t), ssbN_sq (y t)]
    ring
  have hinc : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, (ssbX (c s) (d s) ω - ssbX (c t) (d t) ω) ^ 2 ∂(ssbP p m)
      ≤ ∫ H, (linForm (ssbYc x y s) H - linForm (ssbYc x y t) H) ^ 2
          ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) := by
    intro s t
    simp_rw [ssb_X_sub, linForm_sub_linForm]
    rw [ssb_integral_X_sq, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ssbYc, hc, hd, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [ssb_append_sub_sq]
    exact ssb_coeff_cmp (x s) (x t) (y s) (y t)
  have hS := slepian_inequality (fun t => ssbX (c t) (d t)) (fun t => linForm (ssbYc x y t))
    (ssb_hasGaussianLaw_X c d) (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    (fun t => ssb_integral_X _ _) (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) hvar hinc
  refine ssb_layercake_sq _ _ _ _ (Measurable.iSup fun t => (ssb_continuous_X _ _).measurable)
    (Measurable.iSup fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
    (ssb_integrable_supsq _ (fun t => ssb_memLp_X _ _) fun t => (ssb_continuous_X _ _).measurable)
    (ssb_integrable_supsq _ (fun t => memLp_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
      fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
    fun τ _ => hS τ

name: NLAlib.ssb_sandwich_entry
statement:
private theorem ssb_sandwich_entry {a p m n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) (u : Fin a → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, u i * (S * G * T) i j * v j
      = ∑ k, ∑ l, ((∑ i, u i * S i k) * (∑ j, T l j * v j)) * G k l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [← Fintype.sum_prod_type']
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv
    ({ toFun := fun x => (x.2.2.2, (x.2.2.1, (x.2.1, x.1)))
       invFun := fun x => (x.2.2.2, (x.2.2.1, (x.2.1, x.1)))
       left_inv := fun _ => rfl
       right_inv := fun _ => rfl } : Fin a × Fin n × Fin m × Fin p ≃ Fin p × Fin m × Fin n × Fin a)
    _ _ fun x => ?_
  simp only [Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  ring

name: NLAlib.ssb_norm_vecMul_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec Sᵀ u
  rw [hu, mul_one, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at h
  refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ h
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.ssb_norm_mulVec_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec T v
  rw [hv, mul_one] at h
  refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ h
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.ssb_vecMul_inner_le
statement:
private theorem ssb_vecMul_inner_le {a p : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin a))
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (g : Fin p → ℝ) :
    ∑ k, (∑ i, u i * S i k) * g k ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, (∑ k, S i k * g k) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∑ k, (∑ i, u i * S i k) * g k = ∑ i, u i * (∑ k, S i k * g k) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
  rw [e]
  have h := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun i => u i) (fun i => ∑ k, S i k * g k)
  rw [← norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq, hu, one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.ssb_mulVec_inner_le
statement:
private theorem ssb_mulVec_inner_le {m n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (h : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∑ l, (∑ j, T l j * v j) * h l ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ j, (∑ l, T l j * h l) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∑ l, (∑ j, T l j * v j) * h l = ∑ j, v j * (∑ l, T l j * h l) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
  rw [e]
  have h' := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun j => v j) (fun j => ∑ l, T l j * h l)
  rw [← norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq, hv, one_mul] at h'
  exact h'

name: NLAlib.ssb_minkowski
statement:
private theorem ssb_minkowski {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) (a b : Ω → ℝ)
    (ha0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ a ω) (hb0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ b ω) (ha : MemLp a 2 μ) (hb : MemLp b 2 μ) :
    ∫ ω, (a ω + b ω) ^ 2 ∂μ
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (∫ ω, a ω ^ 2 ∂μ) + Real.sqrt (∫ ω, b ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hab : ∫ ω, a ω * b ω ∂μ
      ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, a ω ^ 2 ∂μ) * Real.sqrt (∫ ω, b ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    have h2 : ENNReal.ofReal 2 = 2 := by simp
    have h := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg (μ := μ) Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ha0) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb0)
      (by rw [h2]; exact ha) (by rw [h2]; exact hb)
    simp only [Real.rpow_two] at h
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    exact h
  have hexp : ∀ ω, (a ω + b ω) ^ 2 = a ω ^ 2 + 2 * (a ω * b ω) + b ω ^ 2 := fun ω => by ring
  simp_rw [hexp]
  have i1 := ha.integrable_sq
  have i2 : Integrable (fun ω => 2 * (a ω * b ω)) μ := (ha.integrable_mul hb).const_mul 2
  have i3 := hb.integrable_sq
  rw [integral_add (f := fun ω => a ω ^ 2 + 2 * (a ω * b ω)) (i1.add i2) i3, integral_add i1 i2,
    integral_const_mul]
  have hA := Real.sq_sqrt (integral_nonneg fun ω => sq_nonneg (a ω) : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, a ω ^ 2 ∂μ)
  have hB := Real.sq_sqrt (integral_nonneg fun ω => sq_nonneg (b ω) : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, b ω ^ 2 ∂μ)
  nlinarith [hab]

name: NLAlib.ssb_lin_left
statement:
private theorem ssb_lin_left {p m : ℕ} (w : Fin p → ℝ) (H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ) :
    ∑ k, w k * H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k) = linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append w (0 : Fin m → ℝ) k) H
proof:
:= by
  unfold linForm; rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]; simp

name: NLAlib.ssb_lin_right
statement:
private theorem ssb_lin_right {p m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ) :
    ∑ l, w l * H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l) = linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (0 : Fin p → ℝ) w k) H
proof:
:= by
  unfold linForm; rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]; simp

name: NLAlib.ssb_integral_left_sq
statement:
private theorem ssb_integral_left_sq {r p m : ℕ} (W : Fin r → Fin p → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ => ∑ i, (∑ k, W i k * H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k)) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) ∧
    ∫ H, ∑ i, (∑ k, W i k * H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k)) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)))
      = ∑ i, ∑ k, W i k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ssb_lin_left]
  have hi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ =>
      linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (W i) (0 : Fin m → ℝ) k) H ^ 2) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) :=
    fun i => (memLp_linForm_gaussianMatrix _).integrable_sq
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hi i, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hi i]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, ssb_append_sq]
  simp

name: NLAlib.ssb_integral_right_sq
statement:
private theorem ssb_integral_right_sq {r p m : ℕ} (W : Fin r → Fin m → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ => ∑ i, (∑ l, W i l * H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l)) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) ∧
    ∫ H, ∑ i, (∑ l, W i l * H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l)) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)))
      = ∑ i, ∑ l, W i l ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ssb_lin_right]
  have hi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ =>
      linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (0 : Fin p → ℝ) (W i) k) H ^ 2) (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) :=
    fun i => (memLp_linForm_gaussianMatrix _).integrable_sq
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hi i, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hi i]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, ssb_append_sq]
  simp

name: NLAlib.ssb_memLp_sqrt
proof:
:= by
  refine MemLp.const_mul ?_ c
  refine (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hm.sqrt.aestronglyMeasurable)).2 ?_
  exact hQ.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (Real.sq_sqrt (hQ0 ω)).symm)

name: NLAlib.ssb_Y_bound
statement:
private theorem ssb_Y_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {a p m n : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : ι → Fin p → ℝ)
    (y : ι → Fin m → ℝ) (α β : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hx : ∀ t, ssbN (x t) ≤ α) (hy : ∀ t, ssbN (y t) ≤ β)
    (hxg : ∀ t (g : Fin p → ℝ), ∑ k, x t k * g k ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, (∑ k, S i k * g k) ^ 2))
    (hyh : ∀ t (h : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ l, y t l * h l ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ j, (∑ l, T l j * h l) ^ 2)) :
    ∫ H, max (⨆ t, linForm (ssbYc x y t) H) 0 ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)))
      ≤ (β * frobNorm S + α * frobNorm T) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set Q1 : (Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun H => ∑ i, (∑ k, S i k * H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k)) ^ 2 with hQ1
  set Q2 : (Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)) ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun H => ∑ j, (∑ l, (fun j l => T l j) j l * H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l)) ^ 2 with hQ2
  have hQ10 : ∀ H, 0 ≤ Q1 H := fun H => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hQ20 : ∀ H, 0 ≤ Q2 H := fun H => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hQ1m : Measurable Q1 := by rw [hQ1]; fun_prop
  have hQ2m : Measurable Q2 := by rw [hQ2]; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨hQ1i, hQ1e⟩ := ssb_integral_left_sq (m := m) S
  obtain ⟨hQ2i, hQ2e⟩ := ssb_integral_right_sq (p := p) (fun j l => T l j)
  have hYle : ∀ H t, linForm (ssbYc x y t) H
      ≤ β * Real.sqrt (Q1 H) + α * Real.sqrt (Q2 H) := by
    intro H t
    have e : linForm (ssbYc x y t) H
        = ssbN (y t) * (∑ k, x t k * H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k))
          + ssbN (x t) * (∑ l, y t l * H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l)) := by
      unfold linForm ssbYc
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
      simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1 <;> exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
    rw [e]
    have h1 := hxg t (fun k => H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k))
    have h2 := hyh t (fun l => H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l))
    have r1 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Q1 H) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have r2 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Q2 H) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have n1 := ssbN_nonneg (y t)
    have n2 := ssbN_nonneg (x t)
    have k1 : ssbN (y t) * (∑ k, x t k * H 0 (Fin.castAdd m k)) ≤ β * Real.sqrt (Q1 H) :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 n1).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hy t) r1)
    have k2 : ssbN (x t) * (∑ l, y t l * H 0 (Fin.natAdd p l)) ≤ α * Real.sqrt (Q2 H) :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 n2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hx t) r2)
    linarith
  have hW0 : ∀ H, 0 ≤ β * Real.sqrt (Q1 H) + α * Real.sqrt (Q2 H) := fun H =>
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hβ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (mul_nonneg hα (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  have hm1 := ssb_memLp_sqrt Q1 hQ10 hQ1i hQ1m β
  have hm2 := ssb_memLp_sqrt Q2 hQ20 hQ2i hQ2m α
  have hpt : ∀ H, max (⨆ t, linForm (ssbYc x y t) H) 0 ^ 2
      ≤ (β * Real.sqrt (Q1 H) + α * Real.sqrt (Q2 H)) ^ 2 := by
    intro H
    refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_max_right _ _) (max_le (ciSup_le fun t => hYle H t) (hW0 H)) 2
  have hint := ssb_integrable_supsq (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m)))
    (fun t => linForm (ssbYc x y t)) (fun t => memLp_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  refine (integral_mono hint (hm1.add hm2).integrable_sq hpt).trans ?_
  refine (ssb_minkowski _ _ _ (fun H => mul_nonneg hβ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    (fun H => mul_nonneg hα (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hm1 hm2).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have s1 : ∫ H, (β * Real.sqrt (Q1 H)) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) = β ^ 2 * frobSq S := by
    simp_rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hQ10 _)]
    rw [integral_const_mul, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
    congr 1
  have s2 : ∫ H, (α * Real.sqrt (Q2 H)) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) = α ^ 2 * frobSq T := by
    simp_rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hQ20 _)]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [hQ2e, frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_comm]
  rw [s1, s2, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hβ,
    Real.sqrt_sq hα]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.ssb_scaled_bound
statement:
private theorem ssb_scaled_bound {a p m n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε2 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (1 - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Fu, hFuS, hFufin, hFucov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  obtain ⟨Fv, hFvS, hFvfin, hFvcov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin a)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  set I := hFufin.toFinset ×ˢ hFvfin.toFinset with hIdef
  have hI1 : ∀ t ∈ I, ‖t.1‖ = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hIdef, Finset.mem_product, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at ht
    simpa using hFuS ht.1
  have hI2 : ∀ t ∈ I, ‖t.2‖ = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hIdef, Finset.mem_product, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at ht
    simpa using hFvS ht.2
  have hcov : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin a)), ‖u‖ = 1 →
      ‖v‖ = 1 → ∃ t ∈ I, ‖u - t.1‖ ≤ ε ∧ ‖v - t.2‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro u v hu hv
    have hu' : u ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1 := by simpa using hu
    have hv' : v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin a)) 1 := by simpa using hv
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFucov hu')
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFvcov hv')
    refine ⟨(y, z), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hIdef, Finset.mem_product, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
      exact ⟨hy, hz⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hyu; exact hyu.le
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hzv; exact hzv.le
  have hne : Nonempty I := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := hcov (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) 1)
      (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, ha⟩ : Fin a) 1) (by simp) (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩⟩
  
  set x : I → Fin p → ℝ := fun t k => ∑ i, t.1.2 i * S i k with hx
  set y : I → Fin m → ℝ := fun t l => ∑ j, T l j * t.1.1 j with hy
  have hspec : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) :=
    (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
      (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T))
      (specNorm S * specNorm T) (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg S) (specNorm_nonneg T))
      (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)).2
  have hL := ssb_integrable_supsq (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
    (fun t => linForm (fun k l => x t k * y t l)) (fun t => memLp_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have step1 : ∀ G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ, (1 - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2
      ≤ max (⨆ t, linForm (fun k l => x t k * y t l) G) 0 ^ 2 := by
    intro G
    have hnet := one_sub_two_mul_mul_specNorm_le_iSup (S * G * T) ε hε.le I hI2 hcov
    have e : (⨆ t : I, ∑ i, ∑ j, t.1.2 i * (S * G * T) i j * t.1.1 j)
        = ⨆ t, linForm (fun k l => x t k * y t l) G := by
      congr 1
      funext t
      exact ssb_sandwich_entry S T G (fun i => t.1.2 i) (fun j => t.1.1 j)
    rw [e] at hnet
    have h0 : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * ε) * specNorm (S * G * T) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    calc (1 - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2
        = ((1 - 2 * ε) * specNorm (S * G * T)) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 (hnet.trans (le_max_left _ _)) 2
  calc (1 - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      = ∫ G, (1 - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) :=
        (integral_const_mul _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ G, max (⨆ t, linForm (fun k l => x t k * y t l) G) 0 ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) :=
        integral_mono (hspec.const_mul _) hL step1
    _ ≤ ∫ H, max (⨆ t, linForm (ssbYc x y t) H) 0 ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (p + m))) :=
        ssb_main_cmp x y
    _ ≤ (specNorm T * frobNorm S + specNorm S * frobNorm T) ^ 2 :=
        ssb_Y_bound S T x y (specNorm S) (specNorm T) (specNorm_nonneg S)
          (specNorm_nonneg T)
          (fun t => ssb_norm_vecMul_le S t.1.2 (hI2 _ t.2))
          (fun t => ssb_norm_mulVec_le T t.1.1 (hI1 _ t.2))
          (fun t g => ssb_vecMul_inner_le S t.1.2 (hI2 _ t.2) g)
          (fun t h => ssb_mulVec_inner_le T t.1.1 (hI1 _ t.2) h)
    _ = (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2 := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le {a p m n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hzero : (∀ G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ, specNorm (S * G * T) = 0) →
      ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
        ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2 := by
    intro h0
    have : ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) = 0 := by simp [h0]
    rw [this]; exact hC
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
  · subst ha
    exact hzero fun G => by rw [Subsingleton.elim (S * G * T) 0, specNorm_zero]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
  · subst hn
    exact hzero fun G => by rw [Subsingleton.elim (S * G * T) 0, specNorm_zero]
  set E := ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) with hE
  set C := (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2 with hCdef
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := integral_nonneg fun G => sq_nonneg _
  by_contra hcon
  have hlt : C < E := not_le.1 hcon
  have hEpos : 0 < E := lt_of_le_of_lt hC hlt
  have hε : 0 < (E - C) / (8 * E) := div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hε2 : (E - C) / (8 * E) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; nlinarith
  have h := ssb_scaled_bound S T ha hn ((E - C) / (8 * E)) hε hε2
  rw [← hE, ← hCdef] at h
  have h1 : (1 - 4 * ((E - C) / (8 * E))) * E ≤ (1 - 2 * ((E - C) / (8 * E))) ^ 2 * E :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((E - C) / (8 * E))]) hE0
  have h2 : (1 - 4 * ((E - C) / (8 * E))) * E = (E + C) / 2 := by
    field_simp; ring
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le {a p m n : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) ∧
    ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m))
      ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
    (fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T))
    (specNorm S * specNorm T) (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg S) (specNorm_nonneg T))
    (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)).2, integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω}
    {a p m n : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) μ) (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (S * X ω * T) ^ 2) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, specNorm (S * X ω * T) ^ 2 ∂μ
      ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ => specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 :=
    (continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm _ _ (abs_specNorm_mul_of_mul_sub_le S T)).pow 2
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S T
  have e : ∫ ω, specNorm (S * X ω * T) ^ 2 ∂μ
      = ∫ G, specNorm (S * G * T) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) :=
    hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hX.map_eq] at h1
  exact ⟨h1.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable, by rw [e]; exact h2⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω}
    {a p m n : ℕ} {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin p) (Fin m)) μ) (S : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (T : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, specNorm (S * X ω * T) ^ 2 ∂μ
      ≤ (specNorm S * frobNorm T + frobNorm S * specNorm T) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le_of_hasLaw hX S T).2

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_profile_envelopes
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_profile_envelopes
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsSymm) (hA0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) :
    (∫ G, specNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix A G) ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      4096 * (profileMaxRowEnergy A + profileLogRowMaximum A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_equiv_entry_le_profile_envelopes A hA hA0
  let B := A.submatrix e e
  have hB : B.IsSymm := by
    ext i j
    exact hA.apply (e i) (e j)
  have hrow (i : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) :
      ∑ j, B i j ^ 2 ≤ profileMaxRowEnergy A ^ 2 := by
    change (∑ j, (fun l => A (e i) l ^ 2) (e j)) ≤ _
    rw [e.sum_comp (fun l => A (e i) l ^ 2)]
    exact sum_row_sq_le_profileMaxRowEnergy_sq A (e i)
  have hmean := integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_of_profile_rearrangement
    B hB (profileMaxRowEnergy_nonneg A) (profileLogRowMaximum_nonneg A)
    (fun i j => hA0 (e i) (e j)) hrow (fun k => (he k).1) (fun k => (he k).2)
  simpa only [B, integral_specNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_submatrix e A hA] using hmean

name: NLAlib.exists_right_sketch_rank_eq_of_le_rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin A.rank) ℝ (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin) :=
    Module.finBasis ℝ (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin)
  let e : Fin t ↪ Fin A.rank := Fin.castLEEmb ht
  have hpre : ∀ i : Fin A.rank, ∃ z : Fin n → ℝ, A *ᵥ z = (b i : Fin m → ℝ) :=
    fun i => (b i).property
  choose z hz using hpre
  let Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ := fun i j => z (e j) i
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j : Fin t => (b (e j) : Fin m → ℝ)) :=
    (b.linearIndependent.map' (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).subtype
      (Submodule.ker_subtype _)).comp e e.injective
  have hrow : ((A * Z)ᵀ).row = fun j => A *ᵥ z (e j) := rfl
  have hliRow : LinearIndependent ℝ ((A * Z)ᵀ).row := by
    rw [hrow]
    simpa only [hz] using hli
  refine ⟨Z, ?_⟩
  have hRank := hliRow.rank_matrix
  simpa only [Matrix.rank_transpose, Fintype.card_fin] using hRank

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_gram_mul_of_le_rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := exists_right_sketch_rank_eq_of_le_rank A ht
  let X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin t) ℝ) :=
    Matrix.mvPolynomialX (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ
  let Y := A.map MvPolynomial.C * X
  let p := (Yᵀ * Y).det
  have hEval (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) :
      MvPolynomial.eval (fun ab => G ab.1 ab.2) p =
        ((A * G)ᵀ * (A * G)).det := by
    dsimp [p, Y]
    rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.transpose_map]
    have hAmap : (A.map MvPolynomial.C).map
        (MvPolynomial.eval fun ab : Fin n × Fin t => G ab.1 ab.2) = A := by
      ext i j
      simp
    have hXmap : X.map (MvPolynomial.eval fun ab : Fin n × Fin t => G ab.1 ab.2) = G := by
      ext i j
      simp [X]
    rw [hAmap, hXmap]
  have hdetZ : ((A * Z)ᵀ * (A * Z)).det ≠ 0 :=
    det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq _ (by rw [Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self, hZ, Fintype.card_fin])
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have he := hEval Z
    rw [hzero, map_zero] at he
    exact hdetZ he.symm
  filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_eval_ne_zero n t p hp] with G hG
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  rw [← hEval G]
  exact hG

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_first_cols
statement:
theorem hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_first_cols (n : ℕ) {q t : ℕ} (hqt : q ≤ t) :
    HasLaw (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ => G.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin q)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t))
proof:
:= by
  let νt : Measure (Fin t → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1
  let νq : Measure (Fin q → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1
  let e : Fin q ↪ Fin t := Fin.castLEEmb hqt
  have hAll : iIndepFun (fun i (x : Fin t → ℝ) => x i) νt :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ x => x) (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  have hSub : iIndepFun (fun i (x : Fin t → ℝ) => x (e i)) νt :=
    iIndepFun.precomp e.injective hAll
  have hMap : νt.map (fun x i => x (e i)) = νq := by
    have h := iIndepFun.map_fun_eq_pi_map
      (fun i => (measurable_pi_apply (e i)).aemeasurable) hSub
    have hCoord : ∀ i : Fin q, νt.map (fun x => x (e i)) = gaussianReal 0 1 :=
      fun i => (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin t => gaussianReal 0 1) (e i)).map_eq
    simpa only [hCoord] using h
  have hRow : MeasurePreserving (fun x : Fin t → ℝ => fun i => x (e i)) νt νq :=
    ⟨measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => measurable_pi_apply (e i), hMap⟩
  have hFull := measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin n => νt) (fun _ : Fin n => νq)
    (fun _ => hRow)
  exact (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix.comp
    (hFull.comp measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix.symm)).hasLaw

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_rank_mul_eq_min
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_ae_rank_mul_eq_min {m n t : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t), (A * G).rank = min A.rank t
proof:
:= by
  let q := min A.rank t
  have hqr : q ≤ A.rank := min_le_left _ _
  have hqt : q ≤ t := min_le_right _ _
  have hSmall := gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_gram_mul_of_le_rank A hqr
  have hFirst := hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_first_cols n hqt
  rw [← hFirst.map_eq] at hSmall
  have hAE : ∀ᵐ G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t),
      IsUnit ((A * G.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt))ᵀ * (A * G.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt))) :=
    ae_of_ae_map hFirst.aemeasurable hSmall
  filter_upwards [hAE] with G hG
  have hRankSmall : (A * G.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt)).rank = q := by
    rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self (A * G.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt)),
      Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hG, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hEq : A * G.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt) =
      (A * G).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hqt) := rfl
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · exact le_min (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _) (Matrix.rank_le_width _)
  · change q ≤ (A * G).rank
    rw [← hRankSmall, hEq]
    exact Matrix.rank_submatrix_le _ _ _

name: NLAlib.ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min
statement:
theorem ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {m n t : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A * G ω).rank = min A.rank t
proof:
:= by
  have h := gaussianMatrix_ae_rank_mul_eq_min A (t := t)
  rw [← hG.map_eq] at h
  exact ae_of_ae_map hG.aemeasurable h

name: NLAlib.range_mulVecLin_mul_eq_of_rank_eq
statement:
theorem range_mulVecLin_mul_eq_of_rank_eq {m n t : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hRank : (A * Z).rank = A.rank) :
    LinearMap.range (A * Z).mulVecLin = LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Z *ᵥ x, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  · exact hRank

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin A.rank) ℝ,
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ Q * (Qᵀ * A) = A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := exists_right_sketch_rank_eq_of_le_rank A (le_refl A.rank)
  let Y := A * Z
  have hUnit : IsUnit (Yᵀ * Y) := by
    apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    apply det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq
    rw [Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self]
    simpa only [Y, Fintype.card_fin] using hZ
  let Q := polarFrame Y
  have hOrth : HasOrthonormalCols Q := hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame Y hUnit
  have hprojY : Q * (Qᵀ * Y) = Y := polarFrame_mul_transpose_mul_eq Y hUnit
  have hRange : LinearMap.range Y.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin :=
    range_mulVecLin_mul_eq_of_rank_eq A Z hZ
  have hCoeff : ∀ j : Fin n, ∃ v : Fin A.rank → ℝ, Y *ᵥ v = A.col j := by
    intro j
    have hmem : A.col j ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin := by
      refine ⟨Pi.single j 1, ?_⟩
      simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]
    rw [← hRange] at hmem
    exact hmem
  choose v hv using hCoeff
  let C : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin n) ℝ := fun i j => v j i
  have hFactor : Y * C = A := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (hv j) i
  refine ⟨Q, hOrth, ?_⟩
  calc
    Q * (Qᵀ * A) = Q * (Qᵀ * (Y * C)) :=
      congrArg (fun B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ => Q * (Qᵀ * B)) hFactor.symm
    _ = (Q * (Qᵀ * Y)) * C := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Y * C := by rw [hprojY]
    _ = A := hFactor

name: NLAlib.exists_measurable_gaussian_range_frame
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_gaussian_range_frame {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin (min A.rank t)) ℝ,
      (∀ i j, Measurable fun G => Qf G i j) ∧
      (∀ᵐ G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t), HasOrthonormalCols (Qf G)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t),
        Qf G * ((Qf G)ᵀ * (A * G)) = A * G
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hrt : A.rank ≤ t
  · rw [min_eq_left hrt]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQo, hQA⟩ := exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix A
    refine ⟨fun _ => Q, fun _ _ => measurable_const, ae_of_all _ fun _ => hQo, ?_⟩
    apply ae_of_all
    intro G
    calc
      Q * (Qᵀ * (A * G)) = (Q * (Qᵀ * A)) * G := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * G := by rw [hQA]
  · have htr : t ≤ A.rank := (not_le.mp hrt).le
    rw [min_eq_right htr]
    let Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin t) ℝ :=
      fun G => polarFrame (A * G)
    have hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun G => Qf G i j := fun i j =>
      (measurable_polarFrame_entry i j).comp (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id)
    have hGood := gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_gram_mul_of_le_rank A htr
    refine ⟨Qf, hQf, ?_, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [hGood] with G hG
      exact hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame (A * G) hG
    · filter_upwards [hGood] with G hG
      exact polarFrame_mul_transpose_mul_eq (A * G) hG

name: NLAlib.measurable_gaussianRangeFrame_entry
proof:
:=
  (exists_measurable_gaussian_range_frame A t).choose_spec.1 i j

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame
proof:
:=
  (exists_measurable_gaussian_range_frame A t).choose_spec.2.1

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_ae_project_gaussianRangeFrame
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_ae_project_gaussianRangeFrame {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t), gaussianRangeFrame A t G *
      ((gaussianRangeFrame A t G)ᵀ * (A * G)) = A * G
proof:
:=
  (exists_measurable_gaussian_range_frame A t).choose_spec.2.2

name: NLAlib.ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n t : ℕ}

    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (gaussianRangeFrame A t (G ω))
proof:
:= by

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n t : ℕ}

name: NLAlib.measure_sigmaMin_le_sqrt_sub_sqrt_sub_le_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measure_sigmaMin_le_sqrt_sub_sqrt_sub_le_gaussianMatrix {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (u : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)).real {A | singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n - u}
      ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  set h : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) → ℝ := fun X => -singularValues X (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) with hh
  have hLip : ∀ X Y, |h X - h Y| ≤ 1 * frobNorm (X - Y) := by
    intro X Y
    have := abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
    simp only [hh, one_mul]
    rw [show -singularValues X (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) - -singularValues Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
        = -(singularValues X (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) - singularValues Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) by ring, abs_neg]
    exact this
  obtain ⟨-, hconc⟩ := gaussian_concentration h 1 one_pos hLip u hu
  obtain ⟨-, -, hmean, -, -⟩ := gordon_extreme_singular_values (N := N) hn
  have hint : ∫ Y, h Y ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
      = -∫ Y, singularValues Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := by
    simp only [hh]
    exact integral_neg _
  refine le_trans (measureReal_mono ?_) hconc
  intro X hX
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hX ⊢
  rw [hint]
  simp only [hh]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix {N n : ℕ} (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)).real {A | Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n + t ≤ specNorm A}
      ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  set h : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) → ℝ := fun X => specNorm X with hh
  have hLip : ∀ X Y, |h X - h Y| ≤ 1 * frobNorm (X - Y) := by
    intro X Y
    simp only [hh, one_mul]
    exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y
  obtain ⟨-, hconc⟩ := gaussian_concentration h 1 one_pos hLip t ht
  have hmean := integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt (N := N) (n := n)
  refine le_trans (measureReal_mono ?_) hconc
  intro X hX
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hh] at hX ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.one_sub_le_measure_sigmaMin_and_specNorm_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem one_sub_le_measure_sigmaMin_and_specNorm_gaussianMatrix {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    1 - 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
      ≤ (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)).real {A | Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n - t ≤ singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∧
          specNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n + t}
proof:
:= by
  set μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)
  set E := {A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ | Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n - t ≤ singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∧
          specNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n + t} with hE
  set S1 := {A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ | singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n - t}
  set S2 := {A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ | Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n + t ≤ specNorm A}
  have hsub : Eᶜ ⊆ S1 ∪ S2 := by
    intro X hX
    simp only [hE, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_and_or, not_le] at hX
    rcases hX with hX | hX
    · exact Or.inl (le_of_lt hX)
    · exact Or.inr (le_of_lt hX)
  have hc : μ.real Eᶜ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    have h1 := measure_sigmaMin_le_sqrt_sub_sqrt_sub_le_gaussianMatrix (N := N) hn t ht
    have h2 := measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix (N := N) (n := n) t ht
    calc μ.real Eᶜ ≤ μ.real (S1 ∪ S2) := measureReal_mono hsub
      _ ≤ μ.real S1 + μ.real S2 := measureReal_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ μ.real E + μ.real Eᶜ := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = μ.real Set.univ := by simp
      _ = μ.real (E ∪ Eᶜ) := by rw [Set.union_compl_self]
      _ ≤ μ.real E + μ.real Eᶜ := measureReal_union_le _ _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measure_sigmaMin_le_sqrt_sub_sqrt_sub_le_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous ((fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm (fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n - u)
    (measurableSet_le hc.measurable measurable_const)]
  exact measure_sigmaMin_le_sqrt_sub_sqrt_sub_le_gaussianMatrix hn u hu

name: NLAlib.measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (specNorm : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm specNorm 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun A => Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n + t ≤ specNorm A)
    (measurableSet_le measurable_const hc.measurable)]
  exact measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix t ht

name: NLAlib.one_sub_le_measure_sigmaMin_and_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous (specNorm : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm specNorm 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y
  have hm : Continuous ((fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm (fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun A => Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n - t ≤ singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∧
      specNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n + t)
    ((measurableSet_le measurable_const hm.measurable).inter
      (measurableSet_le hs.measurable measurable_const))]
  exact one_sub_le_measure_sigmaMin_and_specNorm_gaussianMatrix hn t ht

name: NLAlib.gu_coeff_ineq
statement:
private theorem gu_coeff_ineq {N n : ℕ} (u u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hu' : ‖u'‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hv' : ‖v'‖ = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * u j - v' i * u' j) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (u j - u' j) ^ 2 + ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, PiLp.sub_apply] using
    frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_le_norm_sq_add u u' v v' hu hu' hv hv'

name: NLAlib.gu_coeffY_sq
statement:
private theorem gu_coeffY_sq {N n : ℕ} (u u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) :
    ∑ _i : Fin 1, ∑ k : Fin (n + N),
      (Fin.append (fun j => u j) (fun i => v i) k
        - Fin.append (fun j => u' j) (fun i => v' i) k) ^ 2
      = ∑ j, (u j - u' j) ^ 2 + ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp

name: NLAlib.gu_Y_le
statement:
private theorem gu_Y_le {N n : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)) ℝ) :
    linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u j) (fun i => v i) k) H
      ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j) ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∑ i, H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold linForm
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
  have h1 := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun j => u j)
    (fun j => H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j))
  have h2 := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun i => v i)
    (fun i => H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i))
  rw [← norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq, hu, one_mul] at h1
  rw [← norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq, hv, one_mul] at h2
  exact add_le_add h1 h2

name: NLAlib.gu_scaled_bound
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Fu, hFuS, hFufin, hFucov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  obtain ⟨Fv, hFvS, hFvfin, hFvcov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  set I := hFufin.toFinset ×ˢ hFvfin.toFinset with hIdef
  have hI1 : ∀ t ∈ I, ‖t.1‖ = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hIdef, Finset.mem_product, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at ht
    simpa using hFuS ht.1
  have hI2 : ∀ t ∈ I, ‖t.2‖ = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hIdef, Finset.mem_product, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at ht
    simpa using hFvS ht.2
  have hcov : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), ‖u‖ = 1 →
      ‖v‖ = 1 → ∃ t ∈ I, ‖u - t.1‖ ≤ ε ∧ ‖v - t.2‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro u v hu hv
    have hu' : u ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1 := by simpa using hu
    have hv' : v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) 1 := by simpa using hv
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFucov hu')
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFvcov hv')
    refine ⟨(y, z), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hIdef, Finset.mem_product, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
      exact ⟨hy, hz⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hyu; exact hyu.le
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hzv; exact hzv.le
  have hne : Nonempty I := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := hcov (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) 1)
      (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) 1) (by simp) (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩⟩
  
  set a : I → Fin N → Fin n → ℝ := fun t i j => t.1.2 i * t.1.1 j with ha
  set b : I → Fin 1 → Fin (n + N) → ℝ :=
    fun t _ k => Fin.append (fun j => t.1.1 j) (fun i => t.1.2 i) k with hb
  have hinc : ∀ s t : I,
      ∫ G, (linForm (a s) G - linForm (a t) G) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
        ≤ ∫ H, (linForm (b s) H - linForm (b t) H) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
    intro s t
    simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
    rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ha, hb, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [gu_coeffY_sq]
    exact gu_coeff_ineq _ _ _ _ (hI1 _ s.2) (hI1 _ t.2) (hI2 _ s.2) (hI2 _ t.2)
  have hSF := sudakov_fernique_inequality (fun t G => linForm (a t) G) (fun t H => linForm (b t) H)
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix a) (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix b)
    (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) hinc
  
  have hspec : Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A) 1 zero_le_one
      fun X Y => by
        rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y).1
  have hXsup := MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) (fun t G => linForm (a t) G)
    (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have hYsup := MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)))
    (fun t H => linForm (b t) H)
    (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have hsq : ∀ {k : ℕ} (σ : Fin k → Fin (n + N)), Integrable
      (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)) ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
    intro k σ
    have hQ : Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)) ℝ => ∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2)
        (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) :=
      integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
        (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry 0 (σ j) 2 (by simp)).integrable_sq
    refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_const 1).add hQ) (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)) ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2))).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun H => ?_)
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt hQ0
    have h2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2)
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2) - 1)]
  
  calc (1 - 2 * ε) * ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
      = ∫ A, (1 - 2 * ε) * specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
        (integral_const_mul _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ G, (⨆ t, linForm (a t) G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := by
        refine integral_mono (hspec.const_mul _) hXsup fun G => ?_
        refine (one_sub_two_mul_mul_specNorm_le_iSup G ε hε.le I hI2 hcov).trans
          (le_of_eq ?_)
        congr 1
        funext t
        simp only [linForm, ha]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        ring
    _ ≤ ∫ H, (⨆ t, linForm (b t) H) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := hSF
    _ ≤ ∫ H, (Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j) ^ 2)
          + Real.sqrt (∑ i, H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) ^ 2)) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
        refine integral_mono hYsup ((hsq _).add (hsq _)) fun H => ?_
        exact ciSup_le fun t => gu_Y_le t.1.1 t.1.2 (hI1 _ t.2) (hI2 _ t.2) H
    _ = ∫ H, Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j) ^ 2) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)))
          + ∫ H, Real.sqrt (∑ i, H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) ^ 2) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) :=
        integral_add (hsq _) (hsq _)
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt n + Real.sqrt N :=
        add_le_add (integral_sqrt_sum_sq_gaussianMatrix_entry_le _)
          (integral_sqrt_sum_sq_gaussianMatrix_entry_le _)
    _ = Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n := add_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt {N n : ℕ} :
    ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n := add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with hN | hN
  · subst hN
    have h0 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin n) ℝ, specNorm A = 0 := fun A => by
      rw [Subsingleton.elim A 0, specNorm_zero]
    simp only [h0, integral_zero]
    exact hs
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
  · subst hn
    have h0 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin 0) ℝ, specNorm A = 0 := fun A => by
      rw [Subsingleton.elim A 0, specNorm_zero]
    simp only [h0, integral_zero]
    exact hs
  set E := ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) with hE
  set s := Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hEpos : 0 < E := lt_of_le_of_lt hs hcon
  have h := gu_scaled_bound hN hn ((E - s) / (4 * E)) (div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
  rw [← hE] at h
  have : (1 - 2 * ((E - s) / (4 * E))) * E = (E + s) / 2 := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [this] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gl_norm_toLp
statement:
private theorem gl_norm_toLp {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (x : κ → ℝ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ)‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq]

name: NLAlib.gl_matrix_side
statement:
private theorem gl_matrix_side {N n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
    (U : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (T : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)))
    (hT : ∀ v ∈ T, ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hcov : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ u ∈ U, ‖x - u‖ ≤ ε)
    (hn : Nonempty {x : Fin n → ℝ // x ⬝ᵥ x = 1}) :
    ⨅ u : U, ⨆ v : T, ∑ i, ∑ j, v.1 i * A i j * u.1 j ≤ singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) + ε * specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) A with hΦ
  have hM : specNorm A = ‖Φ‖ := rfl
  have key : ∀ u : U, ⨆ v : T, ∑ i, ∑ j, v.1 i * A i j * u.1 j ≤ ‖Φ u.1‖ := by
    intro u
    refine Real.iSup_le (fun v => ?_) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [← inner_toEuclideanLin_eq_sum]
    refine (real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans ?_
    rw [hT _ v.2, one_mul]
  set L := ⨅ u : U, ⨆ v : T, ∑ i, ∑ j, v.1 i * A i j * u.1 j with hL
  have hx : ∀ x : {x : Fin n → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1},
      L - ε * specNorm A ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ := by
    intro x
    set xe : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := WithLp.toLp 2 x.1 with hxe
    have hxe1 : ‖xe‖ = 1 := x.2
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu⟩ := hcov xe hxe1
    have hb : BddBelow (Set.range fun u : U => ⨆ v : T, ∑ i, ∑ j, v.1 i * A i j * u.1 j) :=
      (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow
    have h1 : L ≤ ‖Φ u‖ := (ciInf_le hb ⟨u, hu⟩).trans (key ⟨u, hu⟩)
    have h2 : ‖Φ u‖ ≤ ‖Φ xe‖ + ‖Φ‖ * ε := by
      have hd : Φ u = Φ xe - Φ (xe - u) := by rw [map_sub]; abel
      rw [hd]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add_right ?_ _)
      exact (Φ.le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxu (norm_nonneg _))
    have h3 : ‖Φ xe‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x.1)‖ := rfl
    rw [hM]
    linarith
  have : Nonempty {x : Fin n → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} :=
    ⟨⟨hn.some.1, by rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, hn.some.2, Real.sqrt_one]⟩⟩
  have := le_ciInf hx
  rw [singularValues_last_eq_iInf]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gl_lin_append
statement:
private theorem gl_lin_append {N n : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))
    (H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)) ℝ) :
    linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u j) (fun i => v i) k) H
      = ∑ j, u j * H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j) + ∑ i, v i * H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold linForm
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]

name: NLAlib.gl_gauss_side
statement:
private theorem gl_gauss_side {N n : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (ε : ℝ)
    (U : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (T : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)))
    (hU : ∀ u ∈ U, ‖u‖ = 1) (hUne : Nonempty U)
    (hcov : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖y‖ = 1 → ∃ v ∈ T, ‖y - v‖ ≤ ε)
    (H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)) ℝ) :
    (1 - ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) ^ 2)
        - Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j) ^ 2)
      ≤ ⨅ u : U, ⨆ v : T,
          linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u.1 j) (fun i => v.1 i) k) H
proof:
:= by
  set h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i)) with hh
  have hhn : ‖h‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ i, H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) ^ 2) := gl_norm_toLp _
  
  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hyh⟩ : ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪y, h⟫ = ‖h‖ := by
    by_cases h0 : h = 0
    · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) 1, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [h0]; simp
    · refine ⟨(‖h‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • h, norm_smul_inv_norm h0, ?_⟩
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      have : ‖h‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 h0
      field_simp
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hyv⟩ := hcov y hy1
  have hvh : (1 - ε) * ‖h‖ ≤ ∑ i, v i * H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) := by
    have e1 : ⟪v, h⟫ = ∑ i, v i * H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) := by
      simp [hh, PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]
    have e2 : ⟪v, h⟫ = ⟪y, h⟫ - ⟪y - v, h⟫ := by rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
    have e3 : ⟪y - v, h⟫ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ :=
      (real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hyv (norm_nonneg _))
    rw [← e1, e2, hyh]
    linarith
  refine le_ciInf fun u => ?_
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun v : T =>
      linForm (fun _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u.1 j) (fun i => v.1 i) k) H) :=
    (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  refine le_trans ?_ (le_ciSup hb ⟨v, hv⟩)
  rw [gl_lin_append]
  have hcs := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun j => u.1 j)
    (fun j => -H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j))
  rw [← norm_eq_sqrt_sum_sq, hU _ u.2, one_mul] at hcs
  simp only [neg_sq, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at hcs
  rw [← hhn]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gl_integrable_sqrt_sumsq
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Integrable (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ => ∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin m)) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry 0 (σ j) 2 (by simp)).integrable_sq
  refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_const 1).add hQ) (by fun_prop : Continuous
    (fun H : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2))).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun H => ?_)
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt hQ0
  have h2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (σ j) ^ 2) - 1)]

name: NLAlib.gl_coeff_same
statement:
private theorem gl_coeff_same {N n : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * u j - v' i * u j) ^ 2 = ∑ i, (v i - v' i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, PiLp.sub_apply] using
    frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_same_eq_norm_sq u v v' hu

name: NLAlib.gl_scaled_bound
statement:
private theorem gl_scaled_bound {N n : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (1 - ε) * ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)
        - ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)
      ≤ ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
        + ε * ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Fu, hFuS, hFufin, hFucov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  obtain ⟨Fv, hFvS, hFvfin, hFvcov⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) 1).totallyBounded ε hε
  set U := hFufin.toFinset with hUdef
  set T := hFvfin.toFinset with hTdef
  have hU1 : ∀ u ∈ U, ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hUdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hu
    simpa using hFuS hu
  have hT1 : ∀ v ∈ T, ‖v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hTdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hv
    simpa using hFvS hv
  have hcovU : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ u ∈ U, ‖x - u‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1 := by simpa using hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFucov hx')
    refine ⟨y, by rw [hUdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; exact hy, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hyx; exact hyx.le
  have hcovT : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ v ∈ T, ‖x - v‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) 1 := by simpa using hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hFvcov hx')
    refine ⟨y, by rw [hTdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; exact hy, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hyx; exact hyx.le
  have hUne : Nonempty U := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := hcovU (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) 1) (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩⟩
  have hTne : Nonempty T := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hcovT (EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) 1) (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
  have hsub : Nonempty {x : Fin n → ℝ // x ⬝ᵥ x = 1} :=
    ⟨⟨Pi.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) 1, by simp [dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]⟩⟩
  
  set b : U → T → Fin 1 → Fin (n + N) → ℝ :=
    fun u v _ k => Fin.append (fun j => u.1 j) (fun i => v.1 i) k with hb
  set a : U → T → Fin N → Fin n → ℝ := fun u v i j => v.1 i * u.1 j with ha
  have hsame : ∀ (u : U) (t s : T),
      ∫ H, (linForm (b u t) H - linForm (b u s) H) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N)))
        ≤ ∫ G, (linForm (a u t) G - linForm (a u s) G) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := by
    intro u t s
    simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
    rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ha, hb, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [gu_coeffY_sq, gl_coeff_same _ _ _ (hU1 _ u.2)]
    simp
  have hdiff : ∀ (u v : U) (t s : T), u ≠ v →
      ∫ G, (linForm (a u t) G - linForm (a v s) G) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
        ≤ ∫ H, (linForm (b u t) H - linForm (b v s) H) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
    intro u v t s _
    simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
    rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
    simp only [ha, hb, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [gu_coeffY_sq]
    exact gu_coeff_ineq _ _ _ _ (hU1 _ u.2) (hU1 _ v.2) (hT1 _ t.2) (hT1 _ s.2)
  have hGM := gordon_minimax_inequality (fun u t H => linForm (b u t) H)
    (fun u t G => linForm (a u t) G)
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix (fun p : U × T => b p.1 p.2))
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix (fun p : U × T => a p.1 p.2))
    (fun u t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun u t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    hsame hdiff
  
  have hsMin : Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 zero_le_one
      fun X Y => by
        rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)).1
  have hspec : Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A) 1 zero_le_one
      fun X Y => by
        rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y).1
  have hXmm : Integrable (fun H => ⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : T, linForm (b u t) H)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) :=
    MeasureTheory.integrable_iInf_of_fintype (fun u H => ⨆ t : T, linForm (b u t) H)
      (fun u => MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype (fun t H => linForm (b u t) H)
        (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable))
      (fun u => Measurable.iSup fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have hYmm : Integrable (fun G => ⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : T, linForm (a u t) G)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    MeasureTheory.integrable_iInf_of_fintype (fun u G => ⨆ t : T, linForm (a u t) G)
      (fun u => MeasureTheory.integrable_iSup_of_fintype (fun t G => linForm (a u t) G)
        (fun t => integrable_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable))
      (fun u => Measurable.iSup fun t => (continuous_linForm _).measurable)
  have hg := gl_integrable_sqrt_sumsq (m := n + N) (fun j : Fin n => Fin.castAdd N j)
  have hh := gl_integrable_sqrt_sumsq (m := n + N) (fun i : Fin N => Fin.natAdd n i)
  have hEN := integral_gaussianMatrix_row_natAdd n N (fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  have hEn := integral_gaussianMatrix_row_castAdd n N (fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ j, x j ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  
  calc (1 - ε) * ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)
        - ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)
      = ∫ H, ((1 - ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, H 0 (Fin.natAdd n i) ^ 2)
          - Real.sqrt (∑ j, H 0 (Fin.castAdd N j) ^ 2)) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
        rw [integral_sub (hh.const_mul _) hg, integral_const_mul]
        simp only at hEN hEn
        rw [hEN, hEn]
    _ ≤ ∫ H, (⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : T, linForm (b u t) H) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin (n + N))) := by
        refine integral_mono ((hh.const_mul _).sub hg) hXmm fun H => ?_
        exact gl_gauss_side hN ε U T hU1 hUne hcovT H
    _ ≤ ∫ G, (⨅ u : U, ⨆ t : T, linForm (a u t) G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := hGM
    _ ≤ ∫ A, (singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) + ε * specNorm A) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := by
        refine integral_mono hYmm (hsMin.add (hspec.const_mul ε)) fun G => ?_
        refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (gl_matrix_side G ε U T hT1 hcovU hsub)
        congr 1; funext u; congr 1; funext t
        simp only [linForm, ha]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        ring
    _ = ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
          + ε * ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) := by
        rw [integral_add hsMin (hspec.const_mul ε), integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sigmaMin_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sigmaMin_gaussianMatrix {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤ ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    integral_nonneg fun A => singularValues_nonneg A _
  rcases le_or_gt N n with hNn | hNn
  · have : Real.sqrt N ≤ Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast hNn)
    linarith
  have hN : 0 < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hNn
  set EN := ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => gaussianReal 0 1)
    with hENdef
  set En := ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)
    with hEndef
  set E := ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) with hE
  set Sp := ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) with hSp
  have hD : Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤ EN - En :=
    sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sqrt_sum_sq_sub hn hNn.le
  have hEN0 : 0 ≤ EN := integral_nonneg fun _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hSp0 : 0 ≤ Sp := integral_nonneg fun A => specNorm_nonneg A
  have key : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → EN - En - ε * (EN + Sp) ≤ E := by
    intro ε hε
    have := gl_scaled_bound (N := N) (n := n) hN (by omega) ε hε
    linarith
  
  have hlim : EN - En ≤ E := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    set δ := EN - En - E with hδ
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by linarith
    set C := EN + Sp + 1 with hC
    have hC0 : 0 < C := by linarith
    have h1 := key (δ / (2 * C)) (by positivity)
    have h2 : δ / (2 * C) * (EN + Sp) ≤ δ / 2 := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gordon_extreme_singular_values
statement:
theorem gordon_extreme_singular_values {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) ∧
    Integrable (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A) (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) ∧
    Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤ ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) ∧
    ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n))
      ≤ ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) ∧
    ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  have hI1 := (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
    (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 zero_le_one fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)).1
  have hI2 := (integrable_and_integrable_sq_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm
    (fun A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ => specNorm A) 1 zero_le_one fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y).1
  refine ⟨hI1, hI2, sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sigmaMin_gaussianMatrix hn, ?_,
    integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt⟩
  exact integral_mono hI1 hI2 fun A => by
    have : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
    exact singularValues_le_specNorm A _

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

    ∫ ω, specNorm (X ω) ∂μ ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (specNorm : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm specNorm 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y
  rw [show ∫ ω, specNorm (X ω) ∂μ = ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) from
    hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_specNorm_gaussianMatrix_le_sqrt_add_sqrt

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sigmaMin_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sigmaMin_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {N n : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) μ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤ ∫ ω, singularValues (X ω) (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous ((fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm (fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
  rw [show ∫ ω, singularValues (X ω) (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂μ = ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) from
    hX.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable]

name: NLAlib.gordon_extreme_singular_values_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem gordon_extreme_singular_values_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {N n : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) μ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Integrable (fun ω => singularValues (X ω) (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) μ ∧ Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (X ω)) μ ∧
    Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤ ∫ ω, singularValues (X ω) (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂μ ∧
    ∫ ω, singularValues (X ω) (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, specNorm (X ω) ∂μ ∧
    ∫ ω, specNorm (X ω) ∂μ ≤ Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous (specNorm : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm specNorm 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_specNorm_sub_specNorm_le_frobNorm X Y
  have hm : Continuous ((fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) :=
    continuous_of_abs_sub_le_mul_frobNorm (fun A => singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)) 1 fun X Y => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact abs_singularValues_sub_le_frobNorm X Y (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := gordon_extreme_singular_values (N := N) hn
  have e1 : ∫ ω, singularValues (X ω) (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂μ = ∫ A, singularValues A (Fintype.card (Fin n) - 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    hX.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable
  have e2 : ∫ ω, specNorm (X ω) ∂μ = ∫ A, specNorm A ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin N) (Fin n)) :=
    hX.integral_comp hs.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hX.map_eq] at h1 h2
  refine ⟨h1.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable, h2.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e1]; exact h3
  · rw [e1, e2]; exact h4
  · rw [e2]; exact h5

name: NLAlib.exists_finiteGroupCayley_fourier_gaussian_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_finiteGroupCayley_fourier_gaussian_blocks [Nonempty P]
    (hu : ∀ p g, LinearMap.toMatrix' (ρ p g) ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (D p) ℂ)
    (hne : ∀ p q, p ≠ q → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (ρ p) (ρ q)))
    (hcomplete : IsCompleteIrreducibleFamily ρ)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {Z : Ω → G → ℂ}
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (circularComplexGaussianVector G) μ) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix G (FiniteGroupFourierIndex D) ℂ)
      (B : Ω → ∀ p, Matrix (D p) (D p) ℂ),
      HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ HasOrthonormalCols Uᴴ ∧
      HasLaw (fun ω => fun t : FiniteGroupFourierIndex D => B ω t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
        (circularComplexGaussianVector (FiniteGroupFourierIndex D)) μ ∧
      (∀ ω, finiteGroupCayleyMatrix (Z ω) = U *
        Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p => (1 : Matrix (D p) (D p) ℂ) ⊗ₖ
          (Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card G : ℝ) / Fintype.card (D p)) • B ω p)) * Uᴴ) ∧
      (∀ ω, specNorm (finiteGroupCayleyMatrix (Z ω)) =
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun p =>
          Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card G : ℝ) / Fintype.card (D p)) * specNorm (B ω p)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨finiteGroupFourierMatrix ρ, (fun ω => finiteGroupNormalizedBlock ρ (Z ω)),
    finiteGroupFourierMatrix_hasOrthonormalCols ρ hu hne, ?_,
    hasLaw_finiteGroupNormalizedBlocks_of_hasLaw ρ hu hne hZ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
      finiteGroupFourierMatrix_mul_conjTranspose ρ hu hne hcomplete
  · intro ω
    exact finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_fourier_normalized_blocks ρ hu hne hcomplete (Z ω)
  · intro ω
    exact specNorm_finiteGroupCayleyMatrix_eq_max_normalized_blocks ρ hu hne hcomplete (Z ω)
