name: NLAlib.sum_sq_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_sub
statement:
theorem sum_sq_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_sub
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ k, (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB v r k -
      varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB w r k) ^ 2) =
      4 * (∑ i, (varianceProfileDeformation B v i - varianceProfileDeformation B w i) ^ 2) +
        ∑ k, (∑ i, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * (v i ^ 2 - w i ^ 2)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient, Matrix.of_apply, if_true]
  norm_num only [show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    congr 1
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring

name: NLAlib.varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_le_comparisonCoefficient
statement:
theorem varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_le_comparisonCoefficient
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hB0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq B v w ≤
      ∑ r, ∑ k, (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB v r k -
        varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB w r k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_sq_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_sub]
  have hsymm : B.IsSymm := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hB
  have hgeo := varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_le_deformation B hB0 hsymm v w
  have hcor := neg_quadForm_le_sum_sq_spectralAbsoluteFactor hB (fun i => v i ^ 2 - w i ^ 2)
  have hform : quadForm B (fun i => v i ^ 2 - w i ^ 2) =
      varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm B v w := by
    simp only [quadForm_eq_sum_mul_mul, star_trivial, varianceProfileSquareDifferenceForm]
  rw [hform] at hcor
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le_comparison
statement:
theorem sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le_comparison
    (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b v i j -
      symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b w i j) ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ r, ∑ k, (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2)
        (isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb) v r k -
        varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2)
          (isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb) w r k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact (sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le b hb v w).trans
    (varianceProfileQuadraticDistanceSq_le_comparisonCoefficient _ _ (fun i j => sq_nonneg _) v w)

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm)
    (v : ι → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∫ G, (⨆ t, quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t))
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      ∫ H, (⨆ t, linForm (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient
        (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2) (isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb) (v t)) H)
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_eq_linForm]
  refine sudakov_fernique_inequality _ _
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) ?_
  intro s t
  simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
  rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
  exact sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le_comparison b hb (v s) (v t)

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_neg_quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_neg_quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_comparison
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm)
    (v : ι → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∫ G, (⨆ t, -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t))
      ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) ≤
      ∫ H, (⨆ t, linForm (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient
        (Matrix.of fun i j => b i j ^ 2) (isHermitian_varianceProfile_sq b hb) (v t)) H)
        ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  have hneg (t : ι) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      -quadForm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) (v t) =
        linForm (-symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b (v t)) G := by
    rw [quadForm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_eq_linForm]
    simp only [linForm, Matrix.neg_apply, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  simp_rw [hneg]
  refine sudakov_fernique_inequality _ _
    (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (hasGaussianLaw_linForm_gaussianMatrix _)
    (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) (fun t => integral_linForm_gaussianMatrix _) ?_
  intro s t
  simp_rw [linForm_sub_linForm]
  rw [integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix, integral_linForm_sq_gaussianMatrix]
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    (sum_sq_symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_sub_le_comparison b hb (v s) (v t))
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  change (-symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b (v s) i j -
    -symmetricGaussianQuadraticCoefficient b (v t) i j) ^ 2 = _
  ring

name: NLAlib.linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient
statement:
theorem linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (v : Fin n → ℝ)
    (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    linForm (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB v) H =
      2 * (∑ i, H 0 i * varianceProfileDeformation B v i) +
        ∑ i, v i ^ 2 * (∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * H 1 k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linForm, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient, Matrix.of_apply, if_true]
  norm_num only [show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  · simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    ring

name: NLAlib.linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient_le
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hB0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ 1) (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (R M : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hrows : ∀ j, varianceProfileRadius B (H 0) j ≤ R)
    (hcorr : ∀ i, ∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * H 1 k ≤ M) :
    linForm (varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient B hB v) H ≤ 2 * R + M
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : B.IsSymm := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hB
  have hrowSq (j : Fin n) : ∑ i, B i j * H 0 i ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (varianceProfileRadius_nonneg B (H 0) j) (hrows j) 2
    rw [varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB0] at hsq
    simpa only [hsymm.apply j _] using hsq
  have hfirst := sum_mul_varianceProfileDeformation_le B hB0 v (H 0) hv R hR hrowSq
  have hsecond : (∑ i, v i ^ 2 * (∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * H 1 k)) ≤ M := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ i, v i ^ 2 * M := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcorr i) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (∑ i, v i ^ 2) * M := (Finset.sum_mul ..).symm
      _ ≤ M := by nlinarith
  rw [linForm_varianceProfileComparisonCoefficient]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.independentSumResolventError_add_mesh_le_inv_two_height
statement:
theorem independentSumResolventError_add_mesh_le_inv_two_height
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    {R s σ δ η ε : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ A : M, A ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i) ≤ σ^2)
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card n) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hη : 0 < η) (hheight : 200000*δ ≤ η) (hε : ε ≤ δ)
    (hsp : s*Real.sqrt (p : ℝ) ≤ δ) (hRp : R*p ≤ δ)
    (hcube : R*σ^2*(p : ℝ)^2 ≤ δ^3) :
    independentSumResolventError ν R s η p+10*ε/η^2 ≤ (2*η)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Nonempty n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  let := hn
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := Nat.cast_nonneg p
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p from hp)
  have hδη : δ ≤ η := by linarith
  let E := ∫ x : ι → M, specNorm (∑ i, x i) ∂Measure.pi ν
  let Q := specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)
  let B := (2/η^4)*(8*s^2+64*R*E)+(32*R^2/η^6)*
    ((Real.exp 1-1)*Q+R^2*Real.log (Fintype.card n))
  let c := Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/η^4+64*R^4/η^6))
  let V := 4096*((p : ℝ)^2*R*Q+(p : ℝ)^3*R^3)/η^4
  let U := s*Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)/η^2
  let T := δ/η^2
  have hE : E ≤ 2*σ*Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)+R*p :=
    integral_specNorm_sum_pi_le_two_mul_sqrt_add_of_log_le
      ν (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hR hσ hpR hd hlog
        hHerm hBound hmean hvariance
  have hbudget := Real.resolvent_variance_scale_le_of_source_parameters
    hR hσ hs hp1 hδ hη hδη hE (specNorm_nonneg _) hvariance hlog hsp hRp hcube
  change B*(p : ℝ) ≤ 500*T^2 ∧ c*p ≤ 22*T at hbudget
  have hV : V ≤ 8192*T := by
    simpa only [V,T,Q,mul_div_assoc] using
      Real.resolvent_comparison_remainder_le_of_source_parameters
        hR hpR hδ hη hδη hvariance hRp hcube
  have herror := Real.resolvent_grid_error_le_of_source_moment_budgets
    hδ hη hε hbudget.1 hbudget.2 hV
  have hU : U ≤ T := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsp (sq_nonneg η)
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by dsimp [T]; positivity
  have herror' : 9*(4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p)+8*c*p+Real.sqrt (24*B*p)+c*p+V)+
      10*ε/η^2 ≤ 80000*T := by
    simpa only [T,mul_div_assoc] using herror
  have he : independentSumResolventError ν R s η p+10*ε/η^2 ≤ 100000*T := by
    have hh : 9*(4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p)+8*c*p+Real.sqrt (24*B*p)+c*p+V+4*U)+
        10*ε/η^2 ≤ 100000*T := by
      linear_combination herror'+36*hU+19964*hT
    simpa only [independentSumResolventError,B,c,E,Q,V,U,T,mul_div_assoc,mul_assoc] using hh
  calc
    _ ≤ 100000*T := he
    _ = 80000*((5/4 : ℝ)*δ)/η^2 := by dsimp [T]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := Real.resolvent_grid_error_le_inv_two_height hη (by nlinarith only [hheight])

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_covariance
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_covariance
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ)
    (B : M →L[ℝ] M →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let f
proof:
:= gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b
    let g := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ c e
    let μ := gaussianVector K
    (∫ y : E, B (f y) (g y) ∂μ) - B (∫ y : E, f y ∂μ) (∫ y : E, g y ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ k,
        ∫ w : E × E, B (fderiv ℝ f w.1 (Pi.single k 1))
          (fderiv ℝ g (t • w.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • w.2) (Pi.single k 1))
            ∂μ.prod μ := by
  dsimp only
  let f := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b
  let g := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ c e
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f := contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b
  have hgc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ g := contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ c e
  obtain ⟨Cf, Cd, _, _, hfb, hdfb⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b
  obtain ⟨Cg, Ce, _, _, hgb, hdgb⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ c e
  exact integral_bilin_sub_bilin_integrals_eq_standard_gaussian_gradient_integral
    f (fderiv ℝ f) g (fderiv ℝ g)
    (fun x => (hfc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt)
    (hfc.fderiv_right (m := ⊤) (by simp)).continuous
    (fun x => (hgc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt)
    (hgc.fderiv_right (m := ⊤) (by simp)).continuous
    Cf Cd Cg Ce hfb hdfb hgb hdgb B

name: NLAlib.mixedArc_eq_word
statement:
private theorem mixedArc_eq_word (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (a b : ℕ) :
    gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b =
      gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q
        (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin a => ζ) (fun _ : Fin b => star ζ))
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  have ht : (fun j : Fin (a + b) => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)
      (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin a => ζ) (fun _ : Fin b => star ζ) j)) =
      Fin.append (fun _ : Fin a => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ)
        (fun _ : Fin b => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (star ζ)) := by
    funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun _ => ?_) (fun _ => ?_) j <;> simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
  simp only [gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc, gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord, ht,
    List.ofFn_fin_append, List.prod_append, List.ofFn_const, List.prod_replicate]

name: NLAlib.sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_integral_mixedArc
statement:
theorem sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_integral_mixedArc
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    let W
proof:
:= ∫ x : E, gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b x ∂gaussianVector K
    (∑ i, ∑ r : n, (A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) * W *
      (A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))) -
      (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, (A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k) * W *
        (A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k)) = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  rw [mixedArc_eq_word]
  apply sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_integral_resolvent_word A₀ hA₀ A hA q
  intro j
  refine Fin.addCases (fun _ => ?_) (fun _ => ?_) j
  · simpa only [Fin.append_left] using hζ
  · simpa only [Fin.append_right, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hζ

name: NLAlib.integral_covarianceDifference_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_eq_gradient_integral
statement:
theorem integral_covarianceDifference_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_eq_gradient_integral
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ) :
    let f
proof:
:= gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b
    let g := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ c e
    let B := gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A
    let μ := gaussianVector K
    (∫ y : E, B (f y) (g y) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ k,
        ∫ w : E × E, B (fderiv ℝ f w.1 (Pi.single k 1))
          (fderiv ℝ g (t • w.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • w.2) (Pi.single k 1))
            ∂μ.prod μ := by
  dsimp only

    a b c e (gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A)

    sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_integral_mixedArc A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b,
    Matrix.zero_mul, normalizedTrace_zero, sub_zero] at h

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_le
statement:
theorem norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_le
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (C : κ → M)
    (hC : ∀ k, (C k).IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hVC : specNorm (coefficientVariance C) ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A))
    (hWC : specNorm (coefficientCovariance C) ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hL : a + b + c + e + 2 = 2 * m)
    (Y Z : E × E → E)
    (hY : MeasurePreserving Y ((gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)) (gaussianVector K))
    (hZ : MeasurePreserving Z ((gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)) (gaussianVector K)) :
    ‖∫ w : E × E, ∑ k : K, ∑ i : κ, normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (C i)
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) (Y w) (Pi.single k 1))
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e) (Z w) (Pi.single k 1))
        ∂(gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)‖ ≤
      ((a + b : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((c + e : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ m
          ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  let f : E → ℝ := fun x => resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ m
  let v : ℝ := specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
  let Y₄ : Fin 4 → E × E → E := ![Y, Y, Z, Z]
  let a₄ := mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers a b c e
  let b₄ := mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers a b c e
  let wgt : Fin (a + b) → Fin (c + e) → Fin 4 → ℝ :=
    fun l r j => ((a₄ l r j + b₄ l r j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * m : ℕ)
  let U : Fin (a + b) → Fin (c + e) → E × E → ℝ :=
    fun l r w => v * ∑ j, wgt l r j * f (Y₄ j w)
  have hY₄ (j : Fin 4) : MeasurePreserving (Y₄ j) (μ.prod μ) μ := by
    fin_cases j <;> first | exact hY | exact hZ
  have hfi : Integrable f μ :=
    integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ hm
  have hi (j : Fin 4) : Integrable (fun w : E × E => f (Y₄ j w)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (hY₄ j).integrable_comp_of_integrable hfi
  have he (j : Fin 4) : (∫ w : E × E, f (Y₄ j w) ∂μ.prod μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ :=
    (hY₄ j).hasLaw.integral_comp hfi.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hU (l : Fin (a + b)) (r : Fin (c + e)) : Integrable (U l r) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hi j).const_mul (wgt l r j)).const_mul v
  have hwgt (l : Fin (a + b)) (r : Fin (c + e)) : ∑ j, wgt l r j = 1 := by
    have hs := (mixedResolventCrossingPowers_lengths a b c e l r).2.trans hL
    dsimp only [wgt, a₄, b₄]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, show
        (∑ j : Fin 4, ((mixedResolventCrossingFirstPowers a b c e l r j +
          mixedResolventCrossingSecondPowers a b c e l r j : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (2 * m : ℕ) by
            exact_mod_cast hs,
      div_self (by positivity : ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  have hUint (l : Fin (a + b)) (r : Fin (c + e)) :
      (∫ w : E × E, U l r w ∂μ.prod μ) = v * ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
    dsimp only [U]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hi j).const_mul (wgt l r j)]
    simp only [integral_const_mul, he, ← Finset.sum_mul, hwgt, one_mul]
  have hcross (l : Fin (a + b)) (r : Fin (c + e)) (w : E × E) :
      ‖(Fintype.card (d × n) : ℂ)⁻¹ * coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear C
        (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q)
        (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (a₄ l r j) (b₄ l r j) (Y₄ j w))‖ ≤
        U l r w := by
    obtain ⟨harc, hlen⟩ := mixedResolventCrossingPowers_lengths a b c e l r
    have h := norm_nativeMixedArc_crossing_le_original_parameters C hC A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hq1
      hVC hWC ζ (a₄ l r) (b₄ l r) (hlen.trans hL) (by omega) harc (fun j => Y₄ j w)
    have hmom (j : Fin 4) : (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (Y₄ j w)) ζ) ^ (2 * m))).re = f (Y₄ j w) := by
      simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, resolventEvenMoment, f] using
        re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul
          (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (Y₄ j w)) ζ) m
    simpa only [hmom, v, wgt, U] using h
  have hpoint (w : E × E) :
      ‖∑ k : K, ∑ i : κ, normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (C i)
        (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) (Y w) (Pi.single k 1))
        (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e) (Z w) (Pi.single k 1))‖ ≤
        ∑ l, ∑ r, U l r w := by
    rw [sum_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_eq_crossing C A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b c e]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro l _
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro r _
    have hvec : (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ
        (a₄ l r j) (b₄ l r j) (Y₄ j w)) =
      ![gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b l).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b l).2 (Y w),
        gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b l).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight a b l).2 (Y w),
        gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitLeft c e r).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft c e r).2 (Z w),
        gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitRight c e r).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight c e r).2 (Z w)] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> rfl
    simpa only [hvec] using hcross l r w
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ w : E × E, ∑ l, ∑ r, U l r w ∂μ.prod μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
        (integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun r _ => hU l r)
        (Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun l _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun r _ => hU l r]
      simp only [integral_finsetSum _ fun r _ => hU _ r, hUint, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      dsimp only [v, f]
      ring

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
statement:
theorem norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i))
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖(∫ x : ι → M, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, x i) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      ∫ A : M, normalizedTrace (resolvent A ζ) ∂ρ‖ ≤
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment ν / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace ι := ⊤
  haveI (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  let γ := centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ
  have hγ := hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ
  haveI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hh := norm_resamplingInterpolation_trace_resolvent_sub_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
    (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
    (fun i => memLp_id_map_matrixRealCoordinates (ν i) (hν i)) γ hγ
    (fun a => integral_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw_eq_zero ρ hρ a)
    (fun a b => (covariance_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ a b).trans
      ((hcov a b).trans (covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates ν a b).symm)) ζ hζ
  rw [resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_law ν hHerm γ ζ hζ,
    resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_law ν hν ρ hρ hρHerm hmean ζ hζ,
    matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_matrixRealCoordinates_reconstruct ν hHerm] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance
statement:
theorem norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm (A - ∫ B : M, B ∂ν i) ≤ L)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖(∫ x : ι → M, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, x i) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      ∫ A : M, normalizedTrace (resolvent A ζ) ∂ρ‖ ≤
      (4 * L * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, (A - ∫ B : M, B ∂ν i)^2 ∂ν i)) / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  have hν (i : ι) : MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i) :=
    memLp_id_of_ae_specNorm_centered_le (ν i) (hbound i)
  exact (norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
    ν hν hHerm ρ hρ hρHerm hmean hcov ζ hζ).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance ν hL hHerm hbound)
        (by positivity))
