statement:
private theorem reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates_single
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (k : K) :
    H (finiteBaseCoordinates A (Pi.single k 1)) = finiteBaseCoefficient A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates A hA]
  simp

name: NLAlib.reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates_split
statement:
private theorem reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates_split
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ) (x : E) :
    A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+H (finiteBaseCoordinates A (gaussianCoordinateSplit q x)) =
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x
proof:
:= by
  rw [reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates A hA]
  unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  cases k <;> simp [gaussianCoordinateSplit,finiteBaseCoefficient,
    gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient,smul_smul,mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.coordinate_word_split_eq
statement:
private theorem coordinate_word_split_eq
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (w : Fin m → ℂ×M) (x : E) :
    hermitianCoordinateResolventWord (A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) w
      (finiteBaseCoordinates A (gaussianCoordinateSplit q x)) =
        gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord A₀ A q w x
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermitianCoordinateResolventWord gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord
  simp_rw [hermitianCoordinateResolvent,reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates_split A₀ A hA]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (p : ℕ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0<q) (hq1 : q<1) :
    let w
proof:
:= mixedResolventWord (n := d×n) ζ p
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x : E, normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) ζ ^ p *
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) (star ζ) ^ p)
        ∂gaussianVector K)
      ((1/2 : ℝ) •
        ((∑ i, ∑ a : n, ∫ x : E, ∑ j : Fin (p+p), ∑ k : Fin (p+p+1),
          normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord A₀ A q
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w j
              (A i⊗ₖ(Matrix.single a a 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))) k
              (A i⊗ₖ(Matrix.single a a 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))) x) ∂gaussianVector K)-
         (∑ i, ∑ a : GUECoordinate Unit n, ∫ x : E,
          ∑ j : Fin (p+p), ∑ k : Fin (p+p+1),
          normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord A₀ A q
            (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert w j
              (A i⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix a)) k (A i⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix a)) x)
          ∂gaussianVector K))) q := by
  dsimp only
  let A₀N : M := A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
  have hA₀N : A₀N.IsHermitian := by
    change (A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))ᴴ=A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker,hA₀.eq,Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
  let D : E →L[ℝ] J := finiteBaseCoordinates A
  let g : J → ℂ := fun y => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A₀N+H y) ζ ^ p*resolvent (A₀N+H y) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let f : E → ℂ := g ∘ D
  let df := fderiv ℝ f
  let ddf := fderiv ℝ df
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ g :=
    contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A₀N hA₀N ζ hζ p
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f := hc.comp D.contDiff
  have hdfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ df := hfc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hddfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ ddf := hdfc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  let C₀ : ℝ := |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2*p)
  let C₁ : ℝ := ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)*|ζ.im|⁻¹^(2*p+1)*‖H‖
  let C₂ : ℝ := ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)*((2*p+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*|ζ.im|⁻¹^(2*p+2)*‖H‖^2
  have hfb (x : E) : ‖f x‖≤C₀ :=
    norm_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A₀N hA₀N ζ hζ p (D x)
  have hdfb (x : E) : ‖df x‖≤C₁*‖D‖ := by
    change ‖fderiv ℝ (g ∘ D) x‖≤_
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ), D.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hc x (by simp)]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 g (D x)‖*∏ _ : Fin 1, ‖D‖ :=
        ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ C₁*‖D‖ := by
        simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one,Fin.prod_univ_one]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (norm_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A₀N hA₀N ζ hζ p (D x))
          (norm_nonneg _)
  have hddfb (x : E) : ‖ddf x‖≤C₂*‖D‖^2 := by
    change ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (g ∘ D)) x‖≤_
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ),norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv,
      D.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hc x (by simp)]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g (D x)‖*∏ _ : Fin 2, ‖D‖ :=
        ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ C₂*‖D‖^2 := by
        simp only [Fin.prod_univ_two,← sq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le
            A₀N hA₀N ζ hζ p (D x)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_gaussianCoordinateSplit f df ddf
    (fun x => (hfc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt)
    (fun x => (hdfc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt)
    hddfc.continuous C₀ (C₁*‖D‖) (C₂*‖D‖^2) hfb hdfb hddfb hq hq1
  have hfunction (t : ℝ) (x : E) : f (gaussianCoordinateSplit t x) = normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) ζ ^ p*
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) (star ζ) ^ p) := by
    dsimp only [f,Function.comp_def,g,D,A₀N]
    rw [reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates_split A₀ A hA]
  simp_rw [hfunction] at hd
  have hh (k : K) (x : E) : ddf (gaussianCoordinateSplit q x)
      (Pi.single k 1) (Pi.single k 1) =
      ∑ j : Fin (p+p), ∑ l : Fin (p+p+1),
        normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord A₀ A q
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) j
            (finiteBaseCoefficient A k)) l (finiteBaseCoefficient A k)) x) := by
    let u : E := Pi.single k (1 : ℝ)
    change fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (gaussianCoordinateSplit q x) u u = _
    have ht := iteratedFDeriv_two_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) f (gaussianCoordinateSplit q x) ![u,u]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero,Matrix.cons_val_one] at ht
    rw [← ht]
    rw [D.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hc _ (by simp)]
    let T : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
      (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
    have hgeq : g = T ∘ hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A₀N (mixedResolventWord ζ p) := by
      funext y
      simp [g,T,hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_mixed]
    rw [hgeq,T.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A₀N hA₀N (mixedResolventWord ζ p)
        (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p) (r := ⊤)).contDiffAt (by simp)]
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe,Function.comp_apply]
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_apply A₀N hA₀N
      (mixedResolventWord ζ p) (im_ne_zero_mixedResolventWord ζ hζ p)]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero,Matrix.cons_val_one,map_sum,T,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
      normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply]
    dsimp only [u,D,A₀N]
    simp_rw [reconstruct_finiteBaseCoordinates_single A hA,
      coordinate_word_split_eq A₀ A hA]
  simp_rw [hh] at hd
  simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,finiteBaseCoefficient] using hd

name: NLAlib.norm_nativeMixedArc_crossing_le_original_parameters
statement:
theorem norm_nativeMixedArc_crossing_le_original_parameters
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (C : κ → M)
    (hC : ∀ k, (C k).IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hVC : specNorm (coefficientVariance C) ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A))
    (hWC : specNorm (coefficientCovariance C) ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
    (ζ : ℂ) (a b : Fin 4 → ℕ) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = L) (hLpos : 0 < L)
    (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j) (x : Fin 4 → E) :
    ‖(Fintype.card (d × n) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear C (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q)
        (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (a j) (b j) (x j))‖ ≤
      (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        ∑ j, (((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / L) *
          (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent
            (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (x j)) ζ) ^ L)).re
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_inv_card_mul_coefficientCrossingTrace_resolvent_le_sum_normalizedTrace
    C (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q) hC
    (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA q)
    (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (x j))
    (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q (x j))
    ζ a b hL hLpos hArc
  have hV := specNorm_coefficientVariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_le (n := n) A hq hq1
  have hW := specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_le (n := n) A hq hq1
  have hpref : Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance C)) *
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance C)) *
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q))) *
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q))) ≤
        specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) *
          Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
          Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
          Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) := by
            gcongr
      _ = _ := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientVariance A)),
          Real.sq_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientCovariance A))]
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 4, (((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / L) *
      (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (x j)) ζ) ^ L)).re := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro j _
    apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    rw [← RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_eq_sum_div_card]
    exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ => pow_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ r) _)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpref hsum)

name: NLAlib.continuous_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem continuous_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun x : E => resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p)
proof:
:= by
  let T : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have h := Complex.reCLM.continuous.comp (T.continuous.comp
    (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ p p (r := ⊤)).continuous)
  have heq : (fun x : E => resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p) =
      fun x : E => (normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x)).re := by
    funext x
    exact resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x) ζ p
  rw [heq]
  simpa +instances only [T, Function.comp_def, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
    normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply] using! h

name: NLAlib.integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p) (gaussianVector K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (continuous_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ p).aestronglyMeasurable
    ((|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p))
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ _ hp)]
  exact resolventEvenMoment_le_inv_abs_im_pow _
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x) hζ hp

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_add_two_le
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_add_two_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ (p + 2)
        ∂gaussianVector K) ≤
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5 *
        (∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p
          ∂gaussianVector K) ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  let f : E → ℝ := fun x => resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p
  let α : ℝ := ((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ)
  have hα : 0 < α := by
    apply div_pos
    · exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 * p - 1 by omega)
    · positivity
  have hα1 : α ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [α]
    rw [div_le_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * p : ℕ))]
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * p - 1 ≤ 2 * p by omega)
  have hfnn (x : E) : 0 ≤ f x := resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ _ hp
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ hp
  have hmean : 0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ := integral_nonneg hfnn
  have hfrac : (∫ x, f x ^ α ∂μ) ≤ (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ^ α := by
    apply integral_rpow_le_of_integral_rpow_le hfi.aestronglyMeasurable hfnn hα hα1 hmean
    · simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using hfi
    · simp only [Real.rpow_one, le_refl]
  have hfraci : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ α) μ :=
    integrable_rpow_of_nonneg_of_le hfi.aestronglyMeasurable hfnn hα.le (by norm_num) hα1
      (by simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using hfi)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5 * f x ^ α ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_of_nonneg (Eventually.of_forall fun x => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ _ (by omega))
        (hfraci.const_mul _)
      filter_upwards [] with x
      have hHerm := gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x
      have h := hHerm.re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_resolvent_pow_le hζ hp
        (L := 2 * (p + 2)) (by omega)
      have hmom : (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent
          (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ) ^ (2 * (p + 2)))).re =
          resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ (p + 2) := by
        simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, resolventEvenMoment] using
          re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul
            (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ) (p + 2)
      rw [hmom] at h
      simpa only [f, α, show 2 * (p + 2) - (2 * p - 1) = 5 by omega] using h
    _ = (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5 * ∫ x, f x ^ α ∂μ := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_crossing_le_original_moment
statement:
theorem norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_crossing_le_original_moment
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (C : κ → M)
    (hC : ∀ k, (C k).IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hVC : specNorm (coefficientVariance C) ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A))
    (hWC : specNorm (coefficientCovariance C) ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : Fin 4 → ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hL : ∑ j, (a j + b j) = 2 * m) (hArc : ∀ j, 0 < a j + b j)
    (Y : Fin 4 → E × E → E)
    (hY : ∀ j, MeasurePreserving (Y j)
      ((gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)) (gaussianVector K)) :
    ‖∫ w : E × E, (Fintype.card (d × n) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear C (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q)
        (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (a j) (b j) (Y j w))
      ∂(gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)‖ ≤
      (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ m
          ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  let f : E → ℝ := fun x => resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ m
  let v : ℝ := specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
  let wgt : Fin 4 → ℝ := fun j => ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * m : ℕ)
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ hm
  have hi (j : Fin 4) : Integrable (fun w : E × E => f (Y j w)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (hY j).integrable_comp_of_integrable hfi
  have he (j : Fin 4) : (∫ w : E × E, f (Y j w) ∂μ.prod μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ :=
    (hY j).hasLaw.integral_comp hfi.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hwgt : ∑ j, wgt j = 1 := by
    dsimp only [wgt]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, show (∑ j, ((a j + b j : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (2 * m : ℕ) by exact_mod_cast hL,
      div_self (by positivity : ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  have hbound (w : E × E) :
      ‖(Fintype.card (d × n) : ℂ)⁻¹ * coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear C
        (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q)
        (fun j => gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (a j) (b j) (Y j w))‖ ≤
        v * ∑ j, wgt j * f (Y j w) := by
    have h := norm_nativeMixedArc_crossing_le_original_parameters C hC A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hq1
      hVC hWC ζ a b hL (by omega) hArc (fun j => Y j w)
    have hmom (j : Fin 4) : (normalizedTrace (CFC.abs (resolvent
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (Y j w)) ζ) ^ (2 * m))).re = f (Y j w) := by
      simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, resolventEvenMoment, f] using
        re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul
          (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (Y j w)) ζ) m
    simpa only [hmom, v, wgt] using h
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ w : E × E, v * ∑ j, wgt j * f (Y j w) ∂μ.prod μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
        ((integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hi j).const_mul (wgt j)).const_mul v)
        (Eventually.of_forall hbound)
    _ = v * (∑ j, wgt j) * ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hi j).const_mul (wgt j)]
      simp only [integral_const_mul, he, ← Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hwgt, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.norm_gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean_le
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b = 2 * p + 1) :
    ‖gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b‖ ≤
      (2 * p + 1 : ℕ) * (2 * (2 * p + 2 : ℕ) ^ 2 : ℝ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ (p + 2)
          ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let V : ℝ := specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x : E,
    resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ (p + 2) ∂gaussianVector K
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := integral_nonneg fun x => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ _ (by omega)
  unfold gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (a + b), (2 * (2 * p + 2 : ℕ) ^ 2 : ℝ) * V * M := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      let l := mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j
      let r := mixedResolventSplitRight a b j
      have hs := mixedResolventSplit_lengths a b j
      have hl : l.1 + l.2 ≤ 2 * p + 2 := by dsimp only [l]; omega
      have hr : r.1 + r.2 ≤ 2 * p + 2 := by dsimp only [r]; omega
      have hmul : ((l.1 + l.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((r.1 + r.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * p + 2 : ℕ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
        have hl' : ((l.1 + l.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * p + 2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
        have hr' : ((r.1 + r.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * p + 2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
        simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul hl' hr'
          (Nat.cast_nonneg (r.1 + r.2)) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * p + 2 : ℕ))
      have h := norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_covarianceDifference_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hq1
        ζ hζ l.1 l.2 r.1 r.2 (m := p + 2) (by omega) (by dsimp only [l, r]; omega)
      refine h.trans ?_
      change 2 * ((l.1 + l.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((r.1 + r.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * V * M ≤ _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [hmul]) hV) hM
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      hab, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.exists_hasDerivAt_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_norm_le
statement:
theorem exists_hasDerivAt_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_norm_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    ∃ D : ℂ,
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x : E, normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) ζ ^ p *
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) (star ζ) ^ p)
        ∂gaussianVector K) D q ∧
      ‖D‖ ≤ (2 * p * (2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5 *
        (∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p
          ∂gaussianVector K) ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  let I₁ := gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ (p + 1) p
  let I₂ := gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ p (p + 1)
  let V : ℝ := specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x : E,
    resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ (p + 2) ∂gaussianVector K
  have h₁ := norm_gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA hq.le hq1.le
    ζ hζ hp (p + 1) p (by omega)
  have h₂ := norm_gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA hq.le hq1.le
    ζ hζ hp p (p + 1) (by omega)
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((p : ℝ) • I₁ + (p : ℝ) • I₂),
    hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_covariance
      A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ p hq hq1, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) * ‖I₁‖ + (p : ℝ) * ‖I₂‖) := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
      simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_natCast] using norm_add_le ((p : ℝ) • I₁) ((p : ℝ) • I₂)
    _ ≤ (2 * p * (2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) * V * M := by
      dsimp only [I₁, I₂] at *
      have h := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ (Nat.cast_nonneg p))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ (Nat.cast_nonneg p))
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      dsimp only [V, M]
      push_cast at h ⊢
      nlinarith only [h]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have h := integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_add_two_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ hp
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (2 * p * (2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ^ 2)) hV)
      simpa only [M, V, mul_assoc] using h

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_spectrum_comparison
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_spectrum_comparison
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (φ : E →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1)
    (hfaithful : ∀ a : E, φ (star a*a)=0 → a=0)
    (S : ι → E) (hS : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (S i))
    (hfree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap S)
    (hlaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (S i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ))
    (hg : HasLaw g (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    let X
proof:
:= fun ω : Ω => A₀+∑ i,g ω i•A i
    let F := CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ A S
    let ξ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
    let r := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
    let b := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    (∫ ω : Ω,Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X ω)) (spectrum ℝ F) ∂μ) ≤ r ∧
    |(∫ ω : Ω,lambdaMin (X ω) ∂μ)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ r ∧
    |(∫ ω : Ω,lambdaMax (X ω) ∂μ)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ r ∧
    |(∫ ω : Ω,specNorm (X ω) ∂μ)-‖F‖| ≤ r ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X ω)) (spectrum ℝ F)} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) ∧
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < |lambdaMin (X ω)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) ∧
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < |lambdaMax (X ω)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) ∧
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < |specNorm (X ω)-‖F‖|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  have hs := spectrum_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
    φ hφ hfaithful S hS hfree hlaw A₀ hA₀ A hA
  have hn := norm_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
    φ hφ hfaithful S hS hfree hlaw A₀ hA₀ A hA
  simp only [hs,hn]
  let X := fun x : ι → ℝ => A₀+∑ i,x i•A i
  let F := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
  let H := fun x : ι → ℝ => Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X x)) (spectrum ℝ F)
  let ξ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
  let r := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
  let b := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
  have hHerm (x : ι → ℝ) : (X x).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hXc : Continuous X := by dsimp only [X]; fun_prop
  have hMaxC : Continuous (fun x => lambdaMax (X x)) := by
    have hh := continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart.comp hXc
    convert hh using 1
    funext x
    change lambdaMax (X x) = lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ (X x) : Matrix d d ℂ)
    rw [(hHerm x).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ]
  have hMinC : Continuous (fun x => lambdaMin (X x)) := by
    have hh := (continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart.comp hXc.neg).neg
    convert hh using 1
    funext x
    change lambdaMin (X x) = -lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ (-X x) : Matrix d d ℂ)
    rw [(hHerm x).neg.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ,lambdaMax_neg,neg_neg]
  have hNormC : Continuous (fun x => specNorm (X x)) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hXc.norm
  have hHc : Continuous H := by
    have hh := (continuous_hausdorffDist_spectrum_selfAdjointPart (spectrum ℝ F)).comp hXc
    convert hh using 1
    funext x
    change Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X x)) (spectrum ℝ F) =
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (selfAdjointPart ℝ (X x) : Matrix d d ℂ)) (spectrum ℝ F)
    rw [(hHerm x).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ]
  have hint (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
      (∫ ω : Ω,f (g ω) ∂μ) = ∫ x : ι → ℝ,f x ∂gaussianVector ι := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hg.integral_comp hf.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hprob (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (u : ℝ) :
      μ.real {ω | u < f (g ω)} = (gaussianVector ι).real {x | u < f x} :=
    hg.measureReal_eq (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hf.measurable)
  have hHD := gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean hd A₀ hA₀ A hA
  dsimp only at hHD
  have hHDmean : (∫ x,H x ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ r := by
    simpa only [H,X,F,r,ξ,mul_assoc] using hHD.1
  have hHDtail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      (gaussianVector ι).real {x | r+b*t < H x} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) := by
    simpa only [H,X,F,r,b,ξ,mul_assoc] using hHD.2
  obtain ⟨hMin,hMax,hNorm⟩ := gaussian_free_spectral_observables_mean_and_tail hd A₀ hA₀ A hA
  dsimp only at hMin hMax hNorm
  change (∫ ω : Ω,H (g ω) ∂μ) ≤ r ∧
    |(∫ ω : Ω,lambdaMin (X (g ω)) ∂μ)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ r ∧
    |(∫ ω : Ω,lambdaMax (X (g ω)) ∂μ)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ r ∧
    |(∫ ω : Ω,specNorm (X (g ω)) ∂μ)-‖F‖| ≤ r ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < H (g ω)} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) ∧
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < |lambdaMin (X (g ω))-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) ∧
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < |lambdaMax (X (g ω))-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) ∧
      μ.real {ω | r+b*t < |specNorm (X (g ω))-‖F‖|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hint H hHc]
    exact hHDmean
  · rw [hint _ hMinC]
    exact hMin.1
  · rw [hint _ hMaxC]
    exact hMax.1
  · rw [hint _ hNormC]
    exact hNorm.1
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hprob H hHc]
      exact hHDtail t ht
    · rw [hprob (fun x => |lambdaMin (X x)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)|)
        (hMinC.sub continuous_const).abs (r+b*t)]
      exact hMin.2 t ht
    · rw [hprob (fun x => |lambdaMax (X x)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)|)
        (hMaxC.sub continuous_const).abs (r+b*t)]
      exact hMax.2 t ht
    · rw [hprob (fun x => |specNorm (X x)-‖F‖|)
        (hNormC.sub continuous_const).abs (r+b*t)]
      exact hNorm.2 t ht

name: NLAlib.measureReal_hausdorffDist_gaussian_wordNative_gt_le_grid_error
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_gaussian_wordNative_gt_le_grid_error
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hmass : 0 < bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ≤ q)
    {η C δ t : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hscale : Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) ≤
      2*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*(Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q))
    (hCfwd : Real.exp 1*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(1/(4*q : ℝ)) ≤ C)
    (hCfree : 438*Real.exp 5 ≤ C)
    (hforward : (Real.exp 1*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(1/(4*q : ℝ))) *
      (((2*(2*q)+1)*(2*(2*q)+2)^2 : ℕ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)*specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*η⁻¹^5) ≤ δ)
    (hreverse : (438*Real.exp 5) *
      (Real.sqrt (4*(bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*η⁻¹^4)*(2*q)) + t +
        ((2*(2*q)+1)*(2*(2*q)+2)^2 : ℕ) *
          (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)*specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*η⁻¹^5 +
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))/((Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*η^2)) ≤ δ)
    (herror : δ+(C+1)*(2*(Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q))/η^2 ≤
      (2*η)⁻¹) :
    (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ | 2*C*η < Metric.hausdorffDist
      (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i)) (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))} ≤
      1/(16*(q : ℝ)) + (9*(Fintype.card d)^2 : ℕ)*Real.exp (-4*q : ℝ) +
        (18*(Fintype.card d)^2 : ℕ)*Real.exp (-t^2/(2*(bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*η⁻¹^4)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nontrivial (WordHilbertSpace ι) := by
    apply nontrivial_of_ne (wordVacuum ι) 0
    intro hz
    have hn := norm_wordVacuum (ι := ι)
    rw [hz,norm_zero] at hn
    exact zero_ne_one hn
  let ε := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q
  have hε : 0 < ε := mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmass) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  obtain ⟨N,M,hNc,hMc,hMS,hN,hM⟩ := exists_finset_gaussian_free_spectral_nets
    A₀ hA₀ A hA hε hscale
  let X : (ι → ℝ) → Matrix d d ℂ := fun x => A₀+∑ i,x i•A i
  let F := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
  let ζ (u : ℝ) : ℂ := (u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I
  have hζim (u : ℝ) : (ζ u).im=η := by simp [ζ]
  have hζre (u : ℝ) : (ζ u).re=u := by simp [ζ]
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 438*Real.exp 5).trans hCfree
  have hHerm (x : ι → ℝ) : (X x).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hF := isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA
  have hvar : coefficientVariance A = ∑ k,A k^2 := by simp only [coefficientVariance,pow_two]
  have hexp : 1 / (((2*(2*q) : ℕ)) : ℝ) = 1/(4*q : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hfwd (u : ℝ) : (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      C*‖resolvent F (ζ u)‖+δ < ‖resolvent (X x) (ζ u)‖} ≤ Real.exp (-4*q : ℝ) := by
    have hp := measureReal_specNorm_gaussian_resolvent_gt_free_le A₀ hA₀ A hA (ζ := ζ u)
      (by rw [hζim]; exact hη.ne') (by omega : 0 < 2*q)
    dsimp only at hp
    rw [hexp, hζim,abs_of_pos hη] at hp
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hp
    rw [show -(2*(2*(q : ℝ))) = -4*q by ring] at hp
    refine le_trans ?_ hp
    apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
    intro x hx
    change _ < specNorm (resolvent (X x) (ζ u))
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm (resolvent (X x) (ζ u))]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCfwd (norm_nonneg (resolvent F (ζ u)))
    have hb : (Real.exp 1*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(1/(4*q : ℝ))) *
      (((2*(2*q)+1)*(2*(2*q)+2)^2 : ℕ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)*specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*η⁻¹^5) ≤ δ := hforward
    dsimp only [F] at *
    change C*‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) (ζ u)‖+δ < _ at hx
    push_cast at hb ⊢
    dsimp only [X] at hx ⊢
    nlinarith only [hx,hmul,hb]
  have hrev (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ M) : (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      C*‖resolvent (X x) (ζ u)‖+δ < ‖resolvent F (ζ u)‖} ≤
      2*Real.exp (-t^2/(2*(bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*η⁻¹^4))) := by
    have hp := measureReal_free_resolvent_gt_gaussian_le A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hlog (ζ := ζ u)
      (by rw [hζim]; exact hη) (by rw [hζre]; exact hMS hu) ht
    dsimp only at hp
    rw [hζim,abs_of_pos hη,← hvar] at hp
    refine le_trans ?_ hp
    apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
    intro x hx
    change _ < ‖resolvent F (ζ u)‖
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCfree (norm_nonneg (resolvent (X x) (ζ u)))
    have hb := hreverse
    change C*‖resolvent (X x) (ζ u)‖+δ < ‖resolvent F (ζ u)‖ at hx
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm (resolvent (X x) (ζ u))]
    nlinarith only [hx,hmul,hb]
  have hLA : (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (X x), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ 2*ε} ≤ 1/(16*(q : ℝ)) := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (measureReal_specNorm_gaussianSeries_gt_bilinear_scale_le A hmass
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < q))
    apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
    intro x hx
    change 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q <
      specNorm (∑ i,x i•A i)
    by_contra hn
    apply hx
    intro ξ hξ
    have hb : specNorm (X x-A₀) ≤ 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε := by
      simpa only [X,add_sub_cancel_left,ε,mul_assoc] using le_of_not_gt hn
    obtain ⟨u,hu,hd⟩ := hN (X x) hb ξ hξ
    exact ⟨u,hu,hd.trans (by linarith only [hε])⟩
  have hLB : (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ F, ∃ u ∈ M, |ξ-u| ≤ 2*ε}=0 := by
    have he : {x : ι → ℝ | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ F, ∃ u ∈ M, |ξ-u| ≤ 2*ε}=∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,Set.mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false,not_not]
      exact hM
    rw [he,measureReal_empty]
  have hh := MeasureTheory.measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_two_resolvent_grids
    (gaussianVector ι) X (fun _ : ι → ℝ => F)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hHerm) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => hF)
      N M hη hC herror
  change (gaussianVector ι).real {x | 2*C*η < Metric.hausdorffDist
    (spectrum ℝ (X x)) (spectrum ℝ F)} ≤ _
  refine hh.trans ?_
  rw [hLB,add_zero]
  have hsumF : (∑ u ∈ N, (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      C*‖resolvent F (ζ u)‖+δ < ‖resolvent (X x) (ζ u)‖}) ≤
      (N.card : ℝ)*Real.exp (-4*q : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul] using Finset.sum_le_sum (s := N)
      (fun u _ => hfwd u)
  have hsumR : (∑ u ∈ M, (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      C*‖resolvent (X x) (ζ u)‖+δ < ‖resolvent F (ζ u)‖}) ≤
      (M.card : ℝ)*(2*Real.exp (-t^2/(2*(bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*η⁻¹^4)))) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul] using Finset.sum_le_sum (s := M)
      (fun u hu => hrev u hu)
  have hNcR : (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (9*(Fintype.card d)^2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hNc
  have hMcR : (M.card : ℝ) ≤ (9*(Fintype.card d)^2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hMc
  have hFcard := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNcR (Real.exp_pos (-4*q : ℝ)).le
  have hRcard := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMcR
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2*Real.exp (-t^2/(2*(bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*η⁻¹^4))))
  change _ ≤ _ at hLA
  dsimp only [ζ] at hsumF hsumR
  push_cast at hNcR hMcR hFcard hRcard ⊢
  linarith only [hLA,hsumF,hsumR,hFcard,hRcard]

name: NLAlib.integrable_nativeMixedArc_gradient_bilin
statement:
private theorem integrable_nativeMixedArc_gradient_bilin
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ)
    (B : M →L[ℝ] M →L[ℝ] ℂ) (Y Z : E × E → E)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (k : K) :
    Integrable (fun w : E × E => B
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) (Y w) (Pi.single k 1))
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e) (Z w) (Pi.single k 1)))
        ((gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K))
proof:
:= by
  let f := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b
  let g := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ c e
  let u : E := Pi.single k 1
  have hfc₀ := contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b (r := ⊤)
  have hgc₀ := contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ c e (r := ⊤)
  have hdfc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ f) := (hfc₀.fderiv_right (m := ⊤) (by simp)).continuous
  have hdgc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ g) := (hgc₀.fderiv_right (m := ⊤) (by simp)).continuous
  obtain ⟨Cf, Cd, _, hCd, _, hdfb⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b
  obtain ⟨Cg, Ce, _, hCe, _, hdgb⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ c e
  have hfc : Continuous (fun w => fderiv ℝ f (Y w) u) :=
    (hdfc.comp hY).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hgc : Continuous (fun w => fderiv ℝ g (Z w) u) :=
    (hdgc.comp hZ).clm_apply continuous_const
  apply Integrable.of_bound ((B.continuous.comp hfc).clm_apply hgc).aestronglyMeasurable
    (‖B‖ * (Cd * ‖u‖) * (Ce * ‖u‖))
  filter_upwards [] with w
  apply (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans
  apply mul_le_mul
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb _) (norm_nonneg u))) (norm_nonneg B)
  · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdgb _) (norm_nonneg u))
  · positivity
  · positivity

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_integral_nativeMixedArc_covarianceDifference_gradient_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_integral_nativeMixedArc_covarianceDifference_gradient_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hL : a + b + c + e + 2 = 2 * m) {t : ℝ} (ht : -1 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    ‖∑ k : K, ∫ w : E × E, gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) w.1 (Pi.single k 1))
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e)
        (t • w.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • w.2) (Pi.single k 1))
        ∂(gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)‖ ≤
      2 * ((a + b : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((c + e : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ m
          ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  let D : ι × n → M := fun ir => A ir.1 ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single ir.2 ir.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
  let G : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n → M := fun ik => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2
  let Y : E × E → E := Prod.fst
  let Z : E × E → E := fun w => t • w.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • w.2
  let f := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b
  let g := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ c e
  let FD : E × E → ℂ := fun w => ∑ k : K, ∑ ir : ι × n,
    normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (D ir) (fderiv ℝ f (Y w) (Pi.single k 1))
      (fderiv ℝ g (Z w) (Pi.single k 1))
  let FG : E × E → ℂ := fun w => ∑ k : K, ∑ ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n,
    normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (G ik) (fderiv ℝ f (Y w) (Pi.single k 1))
      (fderiv ℝ g (Z w) (Pi.single k 1))
  have hYc : Continuous Y := continuous_fst
  have hZc : Continuous Z := by
    have hy : Continuous (Prod.fst : E × E → E) := continuous_fst
    have hz : Continuous (Prod.snd : E × E → E) := continuous_snd
    simpa +instances only [Z, Pi.add_def, Pi.smul_def] using!
      (hy.const_smul t).add (hz.const_smul (Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2)))
  have hiB (B : M →L[ℝ] M →L[ℝ] ℂ) (k : K) :
      Integrable (fun w : E × E => B (fderiv ℝ f (Y w) (Pi.single k 1))
        (fderiv ℝ g (Z w) (Pi.single k 1))) (μ.prod μ) :=
    integrable_nativeMixedArc_gradient_bilin A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b c e B Y Z hYc hZc k
  have hiD : Integrable FD (μ.prod μ) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun ir _ => hiB _ k
  have hiG : Integrable FG (μ.prod μ) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun ik _ => hiB _ k
  have hDe (ir : ι × n) : (D ir).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [D, gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, Real.sqrt_one, one_smul] using
      gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA 1 (.inl ir)
  have hGe (ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n) : (G ik).IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [G, gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, sub_zero, Real.sqrt_one, one_smul] using
      gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA 0 (.inr ik)
  have hGW : specNorm (coefficientCovariance G) ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) := by
    rw [specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker_gueCoefficientMatrix]
    by_cases hn : Fintype.card n = 0
    · simp only [hn, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero]
      exact specNorm_nonneg _
    · exact div_le_self (specNorm_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)
  have hYp : MeasurePreserving Y (μ.prod μ) μ := measurePreserving_fst
  have hZp : MeasurePreserving Z (μ.prod μ) μ :=
    measurePreserving_standardGaussianCorrelation (κ := K) t ht ht1
  have hD := norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_le D hDe A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hq1
    (specNorm_coefficientVariance_kronecker_diagonal_single_le A)
    (specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker_diagonal_single_le A)
    ζ hζ a b c e hm hL Y Z hYp hZp
  have hG := norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_le G hGe A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hq1
    (specNorm_coefficientVariance_kronecker_gueCoefficientMatrix_le A) hGW
    ζ hζ a b c e hm hL Y Z hYp hZp
  have heq (w : E × E) : (∑ k : K, gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A
      (fderiv ℝ f (Y w) (Pi.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ g (Z w) (Pi.single k 1))) = FD w - FG w := by
    simp only [FD, FG, gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear, sub_apply, sum_apply,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Fintype.sum_prod_type, D, G]
  calc
    _ = ‖∫ w : E × E, FD w - FG w ∂μ.prod μ‖ := by
      rw [← integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => hiB _ k]
      simp only [heq]
    _ ≤ ‖∫ w, FD w ∂μ.prod μ‖ + ‖∫ w, FG w ∂μ.prod μ‖ := by
      rw [integral_sub hiD hiG]
      exact norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have h := add_le_add hD hG
      simpa only [FD, FG, f, g, two_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_covarianceDifference_le
statement:
theorem norm_integral_nativeMixedArc_covarianceDifference_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hL : a + b + c + e + 2 = 2 * m) :
    ‖∫ x : E, gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A
      (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b x)
      (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e x) ∂gaussianVector K‖ ≤
      2 * ((a + b : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((c + e : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ m
          ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_covarianceDifference_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_eq_gradient_integral
    A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b c e]
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1)
    (fun t ht => by
      have ht' : t ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        simpa only [Set.uIoc_of_le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)] using ht
      exact norm_sum_integral_nativeMixedArc_covarianceDifference_gradient_le
        (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA hq hq1 ζ hζ a b c e hm hL (t := t)
        (by linarith [ht'.1]) ht'.2)
  simpa only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_nativeMixedArc_bilin
statement:
private theorem integrable_nativeMixedArc_bilin
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ)
    (B : M →L[ℝ] M →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => B
      (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b x)
      (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e x)) (gaussianVector K)
proof:
:= by
  have hfc := (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b (r := ⊤)).continuous
  have hgc := (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ c e (r := ⊤)).continuous
  obtain ⟨Cf, _, hCf, _, hfb, _⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b
  obtain ⟨Cg, _, hCg, _, hgb, _⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ c e
  apply Integrable.of_bound ((B.continuous.comp hfc).clm_apply hgc).aestronglyMeasurable
    (‖B‖ * Cf * Cg)
  filter_upwards [] with x
  refine (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hfb x) (norm_nonneg B))
    (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hgb x) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.sum_integral_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion_sub_eq_covarianceMean
statement:
theorem sum_integral_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion_sub_eq_covarianceMean
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ r : n, ∫ x : E, mixedResolventTraceInsertion
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)
      (A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
      (A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ζ (star ζ) a b ∂gaussianVector K) -
    (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, ∫ x : E, mixedResolventTraceInsertion
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)
      (A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k) (A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k) ζ (star ζ) a b
      ∂gaussianVector K) =
      gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  let f (j : Fin (a + b)) := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ
    (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).2
  let g (j : Fin (a + b)) := gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ
    (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).2
  let D (i : ι) (r : n) : M := A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
  let G (i : ι) (k : GUECoordinate Unit n) : M := A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k
  let I (B : M →L[ℝ] M →L[ℝ] ℂ) (j : Fin (a + b)) :=
    ∫ x : E, B (f j x) (g j x) ∂μ
  have hi (B : M →L[ℝ] M →L[ℝ] ℂ) (j : Fin (a + b)) :
      Integrable (fun x : E => B (f j x) (g j x)) μ :=
    integrable_nativeMixedArc_bilin A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ _ _ _ _ B
  have hsplit (C : M) : (∫ x : E, mixedResolventTraceInsertion
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C C ζ (star ζ) a b ∂μ) =
      ∑ j : Fin (a + b), I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear C) j := by
    simp_rw [mixedResolventTraceInsertion_eq_sum_split]
    change (∫ x : E, ∑ j : Fin (a + b), normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear C (f j x) (g j x) ∂μ) = _
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hi _ j
  have hdiff (j : Fin (a + b)) :
      I (gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A) j =
      (∑ i, ∑ r : n, I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (D i r)) j) -
        ∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (G i k)) j := by
    dsimp only [I]
    simp only [gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear, sub_apply, sum_apply]
    rw [integral_sub
      (integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun r _ => hi _ j)
      (integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => hi _ j)]
    simp only [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun r _ => hi _ j,
      integral_finsetSum _ fun r _ => hi _ j]
    rfl
  let J (C : M) := ∫ x : E, mixedResolventTraceInsertion
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C C ζ (star ζ) a b ∂μ
  have hJ : J = fun C : M => ∑ j : Fin (a + b), I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear C) j :=
    funext hsplit
  change (∑ i, ∑ r : n, J (D i r)) - (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, J (G i k)) = _
  rw [hJ]
  change (∑ i, ∑ r : n, ∑ j : Fin (a + b), I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (D i r)) j) -
    (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, ∑ j : Fin (a + b), I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (G i k)) j) =
      ∑ j : Fin (a + b), I (gaussianFreeCovarianceDifferenceBilinear (n := n) A) j
  simp_rw [hdiff, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  · calc
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j : Fin (a + b), ∑ r : n, I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (D i r)) j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm
  · calc
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j : Fin (a + b), ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n,
          I (normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (G i k)) j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.integrable_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion
statement:
private theorem integrable_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) (C : M) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => mixedResolventTraceInsertion
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C C ζ (star ζ) a b) (gaussianVector K)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (j : Fin (a + b)) : Integrable (fun x : E => normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear C
      (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ
        (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).2 x)
      (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ
        (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).2 x))
      (gaussianVector K) := integrable_nativeMixedArc_bilin A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ _ _ _ _ _
  apply (integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hi j).congr
  filter_upwards [] with x
  exact (mixedResolventTraceInsertion_eq_sum_split
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C ζ a b).symm

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_covariance
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_covariance
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x : E, normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) ζ ^ p *
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) (star ζ) ^ p)
        ∂gaussianVector K)
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((p : ℝ) •
        gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ (p + 1) p +
          (p : ℝ) • gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ p (p + 1))) q
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  let D (i : ι) (r : n) : M := A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
  let G (i : ι) (k : GUECoordinate Unit n) : M := A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k
  let I (a b : ℕ) (C : M) := ∫ x : E,
    mixedResolventTraceInsertion (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C C ζ (star ζ) a b ∂μ
  have hcyclic (C : M) : (∫ x : E, cyclicMixedResolventHessian
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p C ∂μ) =
      (p : ℝ) • I (p + 1) p C + (p : ℝ) • I p (p + 1) C := by
    simp only [cyclicMixedResolventHessian]
    have hi₁ : Integrable (fun x : E => (p : ℝ) • mixedResolventTraceInsertion
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C C ζ (star ζ) (p + 1) p) μ := by
      simpa only [Pi.smul_apply] using! Integrable.smul (p : ℝ)
        (integrable_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ (p + 1) p C)
    have hi₂ : Integrable (fun x : E => (p : ℝ) • mixedResolventTraceInsertion
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) C C ζ (star ζ) p (p + 1)) μ := by
      simpa only [Pi.smul_apply] using! Integrable.smul (p : ℝ)
        (integrable_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ p (p + 1) C)
    rw [integral_add hi₁ hi₂, integral_smul, integral_smul]
  have he (a b : ℕ) : (∑ i, ∑ r : n, I a b (D i r)) -
      (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, I a b (G i k)) =
      gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b :=
    sum_integral_nativeMixedResolventTraceInsertion_sub_eq_covarianceMean A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_cyclic
    (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ p hq hq1
  let J (C : M) := ∫ x : E, cyclicMixedResolventHessian
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p C ∂μ
  have hJ : J = fun C : M => (p : ℝ) • I (p + 1) p C + (p : ℝ) • I p (p + 1) C :=
    funext hcyclic
  change HasDerivAt _ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) •
    ((∑ i, ∑ r : n, J (D i r)) - (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, J (G i k)))) q at hd
  rw [hJ] at hd
  have hderiv : ((∑ i, ∑ r : n, ((p : ℝ) • I (p + 1) p (D i r) +
      (p : ℝ) • I p (p + 1) (D i r))) -
      (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, ((p : ℝ) • I (p + 1) p (G i k) +
        (p : ℝ) • I p (p + 1) (G i k)))) =
      (p : ℝ) • gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ (p + 1) p +
      (p : ℝ) • gaussianFreeFiniteCovarianceInsertionMean (n := n) A₀ A q ζ p (p + 1) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum]
    rw [← he (p + 1) p, ← he p (p + 1)]
    simp only [smul_sub]
    abel
  exact hd.congr_deriv (congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • z) hderiv)

name: NLAlib.observable_mean_tail_of_abs_sub_le
statement:
private theorem observable_mean_tail_of_abs_sub_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f H : Ω → ℝ) (c r b : ℝ) (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hH : Integrable H μ)
    (hdom : ∀ x, |f x-c| ≤ H x) (hmean : (∫ x,H x ∂μ) ≤ r)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → μ.real {x | r+b*t < H x} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)) :
    |(∫ x,f x ∂μ)-c| ≤ r ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → μ.real {x | r+b*t < |f x-c|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : Integrable (fun x => f x-c) μ := hH.mono'
    (hf.sub_const c).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hdom x)
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := by
    simpa only [Pi.add_def,sub_add_cancel] using hD.add (integrable_const c)
  have he : (∫ x,f x-c ∂μ) = (∫ x,f x ∂μ)-c := by
    rw [integral_sub hfi (integrable_const c),integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      _ = |∫ x,f x-c ∂μ| := congrArg abs he.symm
      _ ≤ ∫ x,|f x-c| ∂μ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun x => f x-c)
      _ ≤ ∫ x,H x ∂μ := integral_mono hD.abs hH hdom
      _ ≤ r := hmean
  · intro t ht
    refine le_trans ?_ (htail t ht)
    apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
    intro x hx
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (hdom x)

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_spectral_observables_mean_and_tail
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_spectral_observables_mean_and_tail
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    let X
proof:
:= fun x : ι → ℝ => A₀+∑ i,x i•A i
    let F := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
    let ξ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
    let r := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
    let b := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    (|(∫ x : ι → ℝ,lambdaMin (X x) ∂gaussianVector ι)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ r ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (gaussianVector ι).real {x | r+b*t < |lambdaMin (X x)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)) ∧
    (|(∫ x : ι → ℝ,lambdaMax (X x) ∂gaussianVector ι)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ r ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (gaussianVector ι).real {x | r+b*t < |lambdaMax (X x)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)) ∧
    (|(∫ x : ι → ℝ,specNorm (X x) ∂gaussianVector ι)-‖F‖| ≤ r ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (gaussianVector ι).real {x | r+b*t < |specNorm (X x)-‖F‖|} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)) := by
  classical
  let : Nontrivial (WordHilbertSpace ι) := by
    apply nontrivial_of_ne (wordVacuum ι) 0
    intro hz
    have hn := norm_wordVacuum (ι := ι)
    rw [hz,norm_zero] at hn
    exact zero_ne_one hn
  dsimp only
  let X := fun x : ι → ℝ => A₀+∑ i,x i•A i
  let F := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
  let H := fun x : ι → ℝ => Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (X x)) (spectrum ℝ F)
  let ξ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
  let r := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
  let b := (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
  have hHerm (x : ι → ℝ) : (X x).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hF := isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA
  have hXc : Continuous X := by dsimp only [X]; fun_prop
  have hMaxC : Continuous (fun x => lambdaMax (X x)) := by
    have hh := continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart.comp hXc
    convert hh using 1
    funext x
    change lambdaMax (X x) = lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ (X x) : Matrix d d ℂ)
    rw [(hHerm x).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ]
  have hMinC : Continuous (fun x => lambdaMin (X x)) := by
    have hh := (continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart.comp hXc.neg).neg
    convert hh using 1
    funext x
    change lambdaMin (X x) = -lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ (-X x) : Matrix d d ℂ)
    rw [(hHerm x).neg.isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ,lambdaMax_neg,neg_neg]
  have hNormC : Continuous (fun x => specNorm (X x)) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hXc.norm
  have hHint : Integrable H (gaussianVector ι) :=
    integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector _ _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_sub_le_bilinearSquareMass A₀ hA₀ A hA (spectrum ℝ F))
  have hmain := gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean hd A₀ hA₀ A hA
  dsimp only at hmain
  have hmean : (∫ x,H x ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ r := by
    simpa only [H,r,ξ,mul_assoc] using hmain.1
  have htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (gaussianVector ι).real {x | r+b*t < H x} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) := by
    simpa only [H,r,b,ξ,mul_assoc] using hmain.2
  have hMinDom (x : ι → ℝ) : |lambdaMin (X x)-sInf (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ H x := by
    exact (hHerm x).isSelfAdjoint.abs_sInf_spectrum_sub_le_hausdorffDist hF
  have hMaxDom (x : ι → ℝ) : |lambdaMax (X x)-sSup (spectrum ℝ F)| ≤ H x := by
    exact (hHerm x).isSelfAdjoint.abs_sSup_spectrum_sub_le_hausdorffDist hF
  have hNormDom (x : ι → ℝ) : |specNorm (X x)-‖F‖| ≤ H x := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (hHerm x).isSelfAdjoint.abs_norm_sub_norm_le_hausdorffDist_real_spectrum hF
  exact ⟨observable_mean_tail_of_abs_sub_le (gaussianVector ι) _ H _ r b hMinC.measurable.aemeasurable hHint hMinDom hmean htail,
    observable_mean_tail_of_abs_sub_le (gaussianVector ι) _ H _ r b hMaxC.measurable.aemeasurable hHint hMaxDom hmean htail,
    observable_mean_tail_of_abs_sub_le (gaussianVector ι) _ H _ r b hNormC.measurable.aemeasurable hHint hNormDom hmean htail⟩

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {Q : Measure Ω'}
    (Z : ι → Ω → M) (ν : ι → Measure M)
    (hZ : ∀ i, HasLaw (Z i) (ν i) P) (hIndep : iIndepFun Z P)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
    (G : Ω' → M) (ρ : Measure M) (hG : HasLaw G ρ Q)
    (hGaussian : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω)) Q)
    (hGHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (G ω).IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ ω, G ω ∂Q) = ∫ ω, A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω ∂P)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) a),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) b); Q] =
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω) a),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω) b); P])
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : 0 < ζ.im) :
    specNorm ((∫ ω, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω) ζ ∂P) -
      ∫ ω, resolvent (G ω) ζ ∂Q) ≤
      288 * (R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂P) +
        R ^ 3 * Real.log (2 * Fintype.card n)) / ζ.im ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  let (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) := (hZ i).isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mp inferInstance
  let := hGaussian.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hPi : HasLaw (fun ω i => Z i ω) (Measure.pi ν) P := hIndep.hasLaw_pi hZ
  have hCoordLaw : HasLaw (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω))
      (ρ.map matrixRealCoordinates) Q :=
    (show HasLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) (ρ.map matrixRealCoordinates) ρ from
      ⟨measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable, rfl⟩).fun_comp hG
  have hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ := by
    constructor
    rw [← hCoordLaw.map_eq]
    exact hGaussian.isGaussian_map
  let := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hHset : MeasurableSet {A : M | A.IsHermitian} := by
    change MeasurableSet {A : M | Aᴴ = A}
    exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : M => Aᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian := by
    rw [← hG.map_eq]
    exact (ae_map_iff hG.aemeasurable hHset).mpr hGHerm
  have hνInt (i : ι) : Integrable (id : M → M) (ν i) :=
    Integrable.of_bound aestronglyMeasurable_id R (hBound i)
  have hSumInt : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => ∑ i, x i) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := i) (hνInt i))
  have hShiftM : Measurable (fun x : ι → M => A₀ + ∑ i, x i) := by fun_prop
  have hShiftMean : (∫ ω, A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω ∂P) =
      ∫ x : ι → M, A₀ + ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν :=
    hPi.integral_comp hShiftM.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hMeanProd : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    rw [← hG.integral_eq, hmean, hShiftMean,
      integral_add (integrable_const A₀) hSumInt]
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
  have hCoordsInt : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i))
      (Measure.pi ν) :=
    matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hSumInt
  have hScalarInt (a : J) : Integrable
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : J => ℝ) a).integrable_comp hCoordsInt
  have hCovProd (a b : J) :
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν] := by
    have hca : Measurable (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a) :=
      (measurable_pi_apply a).comp measurable_matrixRealCoordinates
    have hcb : Measurable (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b) :=
      (measurable_pi_apply b).comp measurable_matrixRealCoordinates
    calc
      _ = cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) a),
          (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) b); Q] :=
        (hG.covariance_fun_comp hca.aemeasurable hcb.aemeasurable).symm
      _ = cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω) a),
          (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω) b); P] := hcov a b
      _ = cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) a),
          (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν] :=
        hPi.covariance_fun_comp (hca.comp hShiftM).aemeasurable (hcb.comp hShiftM).aemeasurable
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [map_add, Pi.add_apply]
        rw [covariance_const_add_left (hScalarInt a), covariance_const_add_right (hScalarInt b)]
  have hSqMeas : Measurable (fun A : M => A ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [pow_two, id_eq] using
      (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_id : Measurable (fun A : M => A * A))
  have hνSq (i : ι) : Integrable (fun A : M => A ^ 2) (ν i) := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound hSqMeas.aestronglyMeasurable (R ^ 2) ?_
    filter_upwards [hBound i] with A hA
    rw [pow_two]
    exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (by
      simpa only [pow_two] using (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg A) hR).mpr hA)
  have hSq : (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂P) = ∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact (hZ i).integral_comp (hνSq i).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hleft : (∫ ω, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i ω) ζ ∂P) =
      ∫ x : ι → M, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ ∂Measure.pi ν :=
    hPi.integral_comp ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp hShiftM).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hright : (∫ ω, resolvent (G ω) ζ ∂Q) = ∫ A : M, resolvent A ζ ∂ρ :=
    hG.integral_comp (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).aestronglyMeasurable
  let : MeasurableSpace ι := ⊤
  have h := specNorm_integral_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le ν hHerm hR hBound
    ρ hρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hMeanProd hCovProd ζ hζ
  rw [← hleft, ← hright, ← hSq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.measure_schattenNorm_le_mul_measure_rowMixedNorm_of_integral_le
statement:
theorem measure_schattenNorm_le_mul_measure_rowMixedNorm_of_integral_le
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hmean : (∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      A * ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real {G | t ≤ schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p} ≤
      gaussianTailComparisonConstant A gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant
        (Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) *
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real {G |
        t / gaussianTailComparisonConstant A gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant
          (Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) ≤
            rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let m := ‖fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2‖
  have hc : 0 < Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hC := hA.trans (le_gaussianTailComparisonConstant hA gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos hc)
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := le_trans (by norm_num) hp
  by_cases hm0 : m = 0
  · have hbzero : b = 0 := by
      have hz := norm_eq_zero.mp hm0
      ext i j
      exact congrFun hz (i, j)
    have hsample (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : symmetricGaussianMatrix b G = 0 := by
      ext i j
      simp only [symmetricGaussianMatrix, hbzero, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul]
    have hS (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p = 0 :=
      (schattenNorm_eq_zero_iff _ hp1).mpr (hsample G)
    have hR (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p = 0 := by
      rw [hsample]
      exact rowMixedNorm_zero hp1
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · subst t
      simpa only [hS, hR, zero_div, le_refl, Set.ofPred_true, probReal_univ, mul_one] using hC
    · have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht (Ne.symm ht0)
      have hleft : (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real
          {G | t ≤ schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p} = 0 := by
        simp only [hS, show ¬t ≤ 0 by linarith, Set.ofPred_false, measureReal_empty]
      rw [hleft]
      exact mul_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) hC) measureReal_nonneg
  · have hm : 0 < m := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hm0)
    have hcap (i j : ι) : b i j ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
      have h : |b i j| ≤ m := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          norm_le_pi_norm (fun ij : ι × ι => b ij.1 ij.2) (i, j)
      simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
    exact measure_ge_le_mul_measure_ge_div_of_gaussian_concentration
      hA gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos hc hm
      (hasSubgaussianMGF_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hm.le hcap hp)
      (hasSubgaussianMGF_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hm.le hcap hp)
      hmean (gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_mul_profile_scale_le_integral_rowMixedNorm b hb hp)
      (fun u hu => exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_measure_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix
        b hb hp hm hu) ht

theorem gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_reflect
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (q : ℝ)

    gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (gaussianFreeEnsembleReflect r x) =
      (fun ab ce => (if ab.2=r then (-1 : ℂ) else 1)*

  ext ab ce
  rcases ab with ⟨a,u⟩
  rcases ce with ⟨b,v⟩

  by_cases hu : u=r <;> by_cases hv : v=r
  all_goals

      Matrix.smul_apply,Matrix.sum_apply,gueMatrix,gueRawMatrix,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,hu,hv,hv',Finset.mul_sum]
  all_goals
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring

name: NLAlib.fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent_apply
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q y) ζ) x h =
      resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ*
        (∑ k, h k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k)*
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ
proof:
:= by
  let L := gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A q
  let T := gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x
  have heq : gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q =
      fun y : E => A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+L y := by
    funext y
    simp [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation,L]
  have hL : HasFDerivAt (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q) L x := by
    rw [heq]
    exact L.hasFDerivAt.const_add _
  have hR := (hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian ζ T hT hζ).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hc := hR.comp x hL
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q y) ζ) _ x at hc
  rw [hc.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent,L,
    gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM_apply,T]

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_smul_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_smul_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (k : K) :
    (∫ x : E, x k • resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ
      ∂gaussianVector K) =
      ∫ x : E, resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ*
        gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k*
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let R : E → M := fun x => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ
  have hReq : R=gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (fun _ : Fin 1 => ζ) := by
    funext x
    simp [R,gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
  have hRc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ R := by
    rw [hReq]
    exact contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA q _ (fun _ => hζ)
  have hR (x : E) : ‖R x‖≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hi : Integrable R (gaussianVector K) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hRc.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable _ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hR)
  have hx : Integrable (fun x : E => x k) (gaussianVector K) :=
    (memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)).integrable one_le_two
  have hxi : Integrable (fun x : E => x k • R x) (gaussianVector K) :=
    hx.smul_bdd _ hRc.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hR)
  have hd (x : E) : fderiv ℝ R x (Pi.single k 1)=
      R x*gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k*R x := by
    rw [fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent_apply A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ]
    simp [R]
  have hdi : Integrable (fun x : E => fderiv ℝ R x (Pi.single k 1)) (gaussianVector K) := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (((hRc.fderiv_right (m := ⊤) (by simp)).continuous.clm_apply continuous_const).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹^2*‖gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k‖) ?_
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    rw [hd]
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖R x‖*‖gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k‖)*‖R x‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹*‖gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k‖)*|ζ.im|⁻¹ := by gcongr <;> exact hR x
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hs := integral_coordinate_smul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussian R
    (hRc.differentiable (by simp)) k hi hxi hdi
  simpa only [hd] using hs

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_gaussian_free_spectral_nets
statement:
theorem exists_finset_gaussian_free_spectral_nets
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hscale : Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε) :
    ∃ N M : Finset ℝ,
      N.card ≤ 9*(Fintype.card d)^2 ∧ M.card ≤ 9*(Fintype.card d)^2 ∧
      (M : Set ℝ) ⊆ spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ∧
      (∀ X : Matrix d d ℂ, specNorm (X-A₀) ≤ 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε →
        ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ X, ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε) ∧
      (∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A),
        ∃ u ∈ M, |ξ-u| ≤ 2*ε)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hcard, hcover⟩ := Real.exists_finset_union_intervals_net hA₀.eigenvalues
    (L := 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε) (by positivity) hε
  have hw : 2*(4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε)/ε = ((8*Fintype.card d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp [hε.ne']
    ring
  rw [hw, Nat.ceil_natCast] at hcard
  have hcard' : N.card ≤ 9*(Fintype.card d)^2 := by
    nlinarith [Nat.le_mul_self (Fintype.card d)]
  have hvar : coefficientVariance A = ∑ i, A i^2 := by
    simp only [coefficientVariance, pow_two]
  have hfreecover : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A),
      ∃ u ∈ N, dist ξ u ≤ ε := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hs : spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) =
        spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) := by
      simpa only [toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination] using!
        CStarMatrix.spectrum_real_toPiLpStarAlgHom
          (D := d) (H := WordHilbertSpace ι)
          (isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA)
    have hξ' : ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) := hs.symm ▸ hξ
    obtain ⟨β, hβ, hd⟩ := exists_mem_mean_spectrum_dist_le_wordMatrixLinearCombination
      hA₀ A hA hξ'
    rw [hA₀.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hβ
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hβ
    have hb : |ξ-hA₀.eigenvalues i| ≤ 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε := by
      rw [← Real.dist_eq]
      rw [← hvar] at hd
      exact hd.trans (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hdu⟩ := hcover ξ ⟨i, hb⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu, by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hdu⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hMcard, hMcover⟩ := Metric.exists_finset_subset_card_le_of_cover
    (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) N hε.le hfreecover
  refine ⟨N, M, hcard', hMcard.trans hcard', hM, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X hX ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨β, hβ, hd⟩ := hA₀.isSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_norm_sub hξ
    rw [hA₀.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hβ
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hβ
    apply hcover ξ
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    have hh : ‖A₀-X‖ ≤ 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*ε := by
      simpa only [norm_sub_rev, specNorm_eq_norm] using hX
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hd.trans hh
  · intro ξ hξ
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hMcover ξ hξ

name: NLAlib.hausdorffDist_spectrum_gaussian_wordNative_eq_zero_of_zero_weak
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_spectrum_gaussian_wordNative_eq_zero_of_zero_weak
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hzero : bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ = 0) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i))
      (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (bilinearSquareMass_univ_eq_zero_iff A).mp hzero
  have hHerm : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian := by
    intro i
    rw [hA]
    exact Matrix.isHermitian_zero
  have hbound := hausdorffDist_spectrum_wordMatrixLinearCombination_mean_le hA₀ A hHerm
  have hbound0 : Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))
      (spectrum ℝ A₀) ≤ 0 := by
    simpa only [hA, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero,
      specNorm_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero] using hbound
  have hs : spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) =
      spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) := by
    simpa only [toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination] using!
      CStarMatrix.spectrum_real_toPiLpStarAlgHom
        (D := d) (H := WordHilbertSpace ι)
        (isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hHerm)
  have hg : A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i = A₀ := by
    simp only [hA, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rw [hg, ← hs, Metric.hausdorffDist_comm]
  exact le_antisymm hbound0 Metric.hausdorffDist_nonneg
