statement:
theorem gaussian_free_shiftedGram_spectrum_comparison
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) (A₀ B : Matrix d d ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (φ : E →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 1)
    (hfaithful : ∀ a : E, φ (star a * a) = 0 → a = 0)
    (S : ι → E) (hS : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (S i))
    (hfree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap S)
    (hlaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (S i ^ n) = if Even n then (catalan (n / 2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ))
    (hg : HasLaw g (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    let X
proof:
:= fun ω : Ω => A₀ + ∑ i, g ω i • A i
    let F := CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ A S
    let Bf := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ E) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B)
    let σ := Real.sqrt (max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ)) (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i)))
    let v := Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))
    let ξ := Real.sqrt (σ * v)
    let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    (s = 0 → ∀ ω, spectrum ℝ (X ω * (X ω)ᴴ + B) = spectrum ℝ (F * star F + Bf)) ∧
      (0 < s → ∀ t : ℝ, ξ * Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ t →
        μ.real {ω | (10 : ℝ) ^ 44 * (‖F‖ + Real.sqrt (specNorm B)) * t +
          (10 : ℝ) ^ 44 * t ^ 2 < Metric.hausdorffDist
            (spectrum ℝ (X ω * (X ω)ᴴ + B)) (spectrum ℝ (F * star F + Bf))} ≤
          Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / s ^ 2)) := by
  classical
  have h10 : (1 : E) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hp := congrArg φ h
    rw [hφ, map_zero] at hp
    exact one_ne_zero hp
  let : Nontrivial E := ⟨⟨1, 0, h10⟩⟩
  dsimp only
  let X := fun ω : Ω => A₀ + ∑ i, g ω i • A i
  let F := CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ A S
  let f := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (D := d) (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ E)
  let Bf := f (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B)
  let ξ := Real.sqrt
    (Real.sqrt (max (specNorm (∑ i, A i * (A i)ᴴ)) (specNorm (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i))) *
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
  let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
  change (s = 0 → ∀ ω, spectrum ℝ (X ω * (X ω)ᴴ + B) = spectrum ℝ (F * star F + Bf)) ∧ _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hs0 ω
    have hm : bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ = 0 := by
      have hh := Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg A Finset.univ)
      change Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) = 0 at hs0
      rw [hs0] at hh
      simpa using hh.symm
    have hA := (bilinearSquareMass_univ_eq_zero_iff A).mp hm
    have hx : X ω = A₀ := by simp only [X, hA, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hx]
    exact (spectrum_shiftedGram_affineCombination_eq_of_zero_weak A₀ B hB A hm S).symm
  · intro hs t ht
    change 0 < s at hs
    change ξ * Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ t at ht
    have hweak := sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_le_sqrt_rectangular_variance_covariance A
    change s ≤ ξ at hweak
    have hξpos : 0 < ξ := hs.trans_le hweak
    have hdreal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le
      (mul_pos hξpos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlogpos _)) ht
    let L : ℝ := 100000000000000000000
    let δ : ℝ := 8 * L * t
    let b := specNorm B
    let H₀ : Matrix (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) ℂ := CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm
      (CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow
        (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) b δ))
    let H := gramCoefficientDilation A
    let HX := fun ω : Ω => H₀ + ∑ i, g ω i • H i
    let HF := CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ H₀ H S
    let ξH := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance H)) *
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance H)))
    let sH := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass H Finset.univ)
    have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ, L]; positivity
    have hb : specNorm B ≤ b := le_rfl
    have hH₀ : H₀.IsHermitian := isHermitian_dilation _
    have hH (i : ι) : (H i).IsHermitian := isHermitian_gramCoefficientDilation A i
    have hdH : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) := by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega
    have hξH : ξH ≤ 2 * ξ := sqrt_variance_covariance_gramCoefficientDilation_le A
    have hsH : sH ≤ 2 * s := sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_gramCoefficientDilation_le A
    have hcardH : (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) = 3 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ) := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Nat.cast_add]
      ring
    have hlogH : Real.log (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
        3 * Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hcardH]
      exact Real.log_three_mul_rpow_three_quarters_le hd
    have hlogH0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d))))) _
    have hbaseH : ξH * Real.log (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
        6 * ξ * Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul hξH hlogH hlogH0 (show 0 ≤ 2 * ξ by positivity)
      nlinarith only [hh]
    have hthreshold : L * ξH * Real.log (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) +
        L * sH * (t / s) ≤ δ := by
      have hbase := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbaseH (show 0 ≤ L by dsimp [L]; norm_num)
      have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (show 0 ≤ 6 * L by dsimp [L]; norm_num)
      have hweak' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsH (div_nonneg htpos.le hs.le)
      have hcancel : (2 * s) * (t / s) = 2 * t := by field_simp [hs.ne']
      rw [hcancel] at hweak'
      dsimp only [δ, L] at hbase hscale hweak' ⊢
      nlinarith only [hbase, hscale, hweak']
    have hlin := gaussian_free_spectrum_comparison hdH H₀ hH₀ H hH
      φ hφ hfaithful S hS hfree hlaw μ g hg
    dsimp only at hlin
    have hp := (hlin.2.2.2.2 (t / s) (div_nonneg htpos.le hs.le)).1
    change μ.real {ω | L * ξH * Real.log (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) +
      L * sH * (t / s) < Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (HX ω)) (spectrum ℝ HF)} ≤
        Real.exp (-(t / s) ^ 2) at hp
    have hDfree : CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation
        (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow F Bf b δ) = HF := by
      exact rectangularDilation_positiveGramRow_affineCombination A₀ B hB A S hS hb δ
    have hDsample (ω : Ω) : spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation
        (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (X ω)) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) b δ)) =
        spectrum ℝ (HX ω) := by
      have hSreal (i : ι) : IsSelfAdjoint (g ω i : ℂ) := by change star (g ω i : ℂ) = _; simp
      have hh := rectangularDilation_positiveGramRow_affineCombination
        (A := ℂ) A₀ B hB A (fun i => (g ω i : ℂ)) hSreal hb δ
      have hid (T : CStarMatrix d d ℂ) :
          CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ ℂ) T = T := by ext; rfl
      rw [hid, affineCombination_ofReal_eq_ofMatrix_real_series,
        affineCombination_ofReal_eq_ofMatrix_real_series] at hh
      exact (congrArg (spectrum ℝ) hh).trans (spectrum_real_ofMatrix_complex (HX ω))
    have hBsrc : IsSelfAdjoint (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) := hB
    have hBfree : IsSelfAdjoint Bf := hBsrc.map f
    have hsrcNorm : ‖CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B‖ ≤ b := by
      simpa only [CStarMatrix.norm_ofMatrix_complex, ← specNorm_eq_norm] using hb
    have hf : Function.Injective f := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom_injective _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℂ E)
    have hfreeNorm : ‖Bf‖ ≤ b := by
      rw [show ‖Bf‖ = ‖CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B‖ from NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map f hf _]
      exact hsrcNorm
    have hsub : {ω | (10 : ℝ) ^ 44 * (‖F‖ + Real.sqrt (specNorm B)) * t +
        (10 : ℝ) ^ 44 * t ^ 2 < Metric.hausdorffDist
          (spectrum ℝ (X ω * (X ω)ᴴ + B)) (spectrum ℝ (F * star F + Bf))} ⊆
        {ω | L * ξH * Real.log (Fintype.card (d ⊕ (d ⊕ d)) : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) +
          L * sH * (t / s) < Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (HX ω)) (spectrum ℝ HF)} := by
      intro ω hω
      change _ < Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (HX ω)) (spectrum ℝ HF)
      by_contra hn
      have hdil : Metric.hausdorffDist
          (spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow
            (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (X ω)) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) b δ)))
          (spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.rectangularDilation (CStarMatrix.positiveGramRow F Bf b δ))) ≤ δ := by
        rw [hDsample, hDfree]
        exact (le_of_not_gt hn).trans hthreshold
      have hquad := CStarMatrix.hausdorffDist_spectrum_shiftedGram_le_of_positiveGramRow
        (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (X ω)) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix B) F Bf
        hBsrc hBfree hsrcNorm hfreeNorm hδ hdil
      change Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (X ω * (X ω)ᴴ + B)))
        (spectrum ℝ (F * star F + Bf)) ≤ 4 * (‖F‖ + Real.sqrt b) * δ + 5 * δ ^ 2 at hquad
      rw [spectrum_real_ofMatrix_complex] at hquad
      have hnum : 4 * (‖F‖ + Real.sqrt b) * δ + 5 * δ ^ 2 ≤
          (10 : ℝ) ^ 44 * (‖F‖ + Real.sqrt b) * t + (10 : ℝ) ^ 44 * t ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [δ, L]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg F) (Real.sqrt_nonneg b)) htpos.le,
          sq_nonneg t]
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hquad.trans hnum)) hω
    have hprob := (measureReal_mono hsub (by finiteness)).trans hp
    simpa only [div_pow, neg_div] using hprob

name: NLAlib.continuous_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_time
statement:
theorem continuous_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_time
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (x : E) :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ => gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
  apply continuous_const.add
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro k _
  have hc : Continuous (fun q : ℝ => gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k) := by
    cases k with
    | inl ia =>
      simpa +instances only [gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, Pi.smul_def'] using!
        Real.continuous_sqrt.smul (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ =>
          A ia.1 ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single ia.2 ia.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)))
    | inr ik =>
      simpa +instances only [gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, Pi.smul_def', Function.comp_def,
        Pi.sub_def, id_eq] using!
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).smul
          (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2))
  simpa only [Pi.smul_def'] using
    (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => x k)).smul hc

name: NLAlib.continuous_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_time
statement:
theorem continuous_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_time
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (x : E) :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ => resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p)
proof:
:= by
  let Y : ℝ → M := fun q => gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x
  have hY : Continuous Y := continuous_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_time A₀ A x
  have hc := (contDiff_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate (0 : M)
    Matrix.isHermitian_zero ζ hζ p (r := ⊤)).continuous.comp
    (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous.comp hY)
  have he (q : ℝ) : (0 : M) + H (matrixRealCoordinates (Y q)) = Y q := by
    rw [zero_add]
    exact hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x)
  change Continuous (fun q : ℝ => resolventEvenMoment
    ((0 : M) + H (matrixRealCoordinates (Y q))) ζ p) at hc
  simpa only [he, Y] using hc

name: NLAlib.continuous_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem continuous_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ => ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p ∂gaussianVector K)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun _ => (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p))
  · intro q
    exact (integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ hp).aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro q
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ _ hp)]
    exact resolventEvenMoment_le_inv_abs_im_pow _
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x) hζ hp
  · exact integrable_const _
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    exact continuous_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_time A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ p x

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_pos
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_pos [Nonempty d] [Nonempty n]
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    0 < ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_resolventEvenMoment_pos (gaussianVector K)
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q)
  · have hm := ((gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A q).continuous.const_add
        (A₀ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)))
    have hm' : Continuous (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation (n := n) A₀ A q) := by
      change Continuous (fun x : E => A₀ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) +
        ∑ k, x k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k)
      simpa +instances only [gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM_apply, Pi.add_def] using! hm
    exact hm'.measurable.aemeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x
  · exact hζ
  · exact hp

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p
      ∂gaussianVector K) =
    (∫ x : E, normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x)
      ∂gaussianVector K).re
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₀, C₁, _, _, hb, _⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ p p
  have hi : Integrable (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ p p) (gaussianVector K) :=
    Integrable.of_bound
      (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ p p (r := ⊤)).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
      C₀ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
  let T : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have ht : Integrable (fun x : E => normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x))
      (gaussianVector K) := T.integrable_comp hi
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : E, (normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x)).re
        ∂gaussianVector K := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x) ζ p
    _ = _ := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm ht

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_even_order_prefactor_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_even_order_prefactor_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    (((2 * (2 * q) + 1) * (2 * (2 * q) + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      180 * (q : ℝ) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq2 : (q : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hq3 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (q : ℝ)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hq1)]
  push_cast
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_markov_factor_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_markov_factor_le {q d : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlog : Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    Real.exp 1 * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / (4 * (q : ℝ))) ≤ (1000000 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 2 * (q : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h := Real.exp_one_mul_rpow_inv_two_mul_le_nine_of_log_le
    (Nat.cast_nonneg d) hp (hlog.trans (by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) q] : (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (q : ℝ)))
  have heq : 2 * (2 * (q : ℝ)) = 4 * q := by ring
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h.trans (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_ultracontractive_factor_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_ultracontractive_factor_le :
    438 * Real.exp 5 ≤ (1000000 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Real.exp 5 = (Real.exp 1) ^ 5 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    norm_num
  rw [he]
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos 1).le Real.exp_one_lt_three.le 5
  norm_num at hp
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_interpolation_budget_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_interpolation_budget_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {V W Δ : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hbudget : (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * (V * W) ≤ Δ ^ 4) :
    let η : ℝ
proof:
:= 10000000000 * Δ
    (((2 * (2 * q) + 1) * (2 * (2 * q) + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (V * W) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5 ≤ Δ / η ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  let η : ℝ := 10000000000 * Δ
  have hη : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
  have hcoef := gaussian_free_even_order_prefactor_le hq
  have hraw : (((2 * (2 * q) + 1) * (2 * (2 * q) + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (V * W) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5 ≤ 180 * Δ ^ 4 / η ^ 5 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (180 * (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * (V * W) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (mul_nonneg hV hW)) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (180 * Δ ^ 4) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith only [hbudget]) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  refine hraw.trans ?_
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hη 5) (pow_pos hη 2)).mpr
  dsimp [η]
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg hΔ.le 6]

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_fluctuation_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_fluctuation_sqrt_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {s η : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let c : ℝ
proof:
:= s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4
    Real.sqrt (4 * c * (2 * (q : ℝ))) + 2 * Real.sqrt (c * q) ≤
      5 * (s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ)) / η ^ 2 := by
  let c : ℝ := s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4
  let L : ℝ := s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) / η ^ 2
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  have hLs : L ^ 2 = c * q := by
    dsimp [L, c]
    rw [div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg q)]
    field_simp
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (c * q) = L := by
    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hL).mp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    exact hLs.symm
  have hlarge : Real.sqrt (4 * c * (2 * (q : ℝ))) ≤ 3 * L := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg L]
  dsimp only
  calc
    _ ≤ 5 * L := by rw [hsq]; linarith
    _ = _ := by dsimp [L]; ring

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_forward_error_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_forward_error_le {q d : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlog : Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤ q) {B Δ η : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hΔ : 0 ≤ Δ) :
    (Real.exp 1 * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / (4 * (q : ℝ)))) * B ≤
      1000000 * (B + 6 * Δ / η ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussian_free_markov_factor_le hq hlog) hB
  have hpos : 0 ≤ 6 * Δ / η ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_reverse_error_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_reverse_error_le {q d : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {s σ B Δ η : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hweak : s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) ≤ Δ)
    (hvariance : σ / (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Δ) :
    let c : ℝ
proof:
:= s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4
    (438 * Real.exp 5) * (Real.sqrt (4 * c * (2 * (q : ℝ))) +
      2 * Real.sqrt (c * q) + B + σ / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2 * η ^ 2)) ≤
      1000000 * (B + 6 * Δ / η ^ 2) := by
  dsimp only
  have hfluc := gaussian_free_fluctuation_sqrt_le hq hs hη
  dsimp only at hfluc
  have hfluc' : 5 * (s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ)) / η ^ 2 ≤ 5 * Δ / η ^ 2 := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith only [hweak]) (sq_nonneg η)
  have hvar : σ / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2 * η ^ 2) ≤ Δ / η ^ 2 := by
    rw [← div_div]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hvariance (sq_nonneg η)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * (s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4) * (2 * (q : ℝ))) +
      2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4 * q) + B + σ / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2 * η ^ 2) := by positivity
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right gaussian_free_ultracontractive_factor_le hnonneg
  ring_nf at h hfluc hfluc' hvar ⊢
  linarith only [h, hfluc, hfluc', hvar]

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_grid_error_budget_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_grid_error_budget_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {V W s Δ : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hweak : s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) ≤ Δ)
    (hbudget : (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * (V * W) ≤ Δ ^ 4) :
    let η : ℝ
proof:
:= 10000000000 * Δ
    let B : ℝ := (((2 * (2 * q) + 1) * (2 * (2 * q) + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (V * W) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5
    let err : ℝ := 1000000 * (B + 6 * Δ / η ^ 2)
    err + (1000000 + 1) * (2 * s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ)) / η ^ 2 ≤ (2 * η)⁻¹ := by
  dsimp only
  let η : ℝ := 10000000000 * Δ
  have hη : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
  have hB := gaussian_free_interpolation_budget_le hq hV hW hΔ hbudget
  change (((2 * (2 * q) + 1) * (2 * (2 * q) + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    (V * W) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5 ≤ Δ / η ^ 2 at hB
  have hmesh : (1000000 + 1 : ℝ) * (2 * s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ)) / η ^ 2 ≤
      (2 * (1000000 + 1 : ℝ)) * Δ / η ^ 2 := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg η)
    nlinarith only [hweak]
  have hupper : (1000000 : ℝ) *
      ((((2 * (2 * q) + 1) * (2 * (2 * q) + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (V * W) * (η⁻¹) ^ 5 + 6 * Δ / η ^ 2) +
      (1000000 + 1) * (2 * s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ)) / η ^ 2 ≤
      (9000002 : ℝ) * Δ / η ^ 2 := by
    ring_nf at hB hmesh ⊢
    linarith only [hB, hmesh]
  refine hupper.trans ?_
  rw [← one_div]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hη 2) (by positivity : 0 < 2 * η)).mpr
  dsimp [η]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg Δ]

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_fluctuation_tail_eq
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_fluctuation_tail_eq {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {s η : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let c : ℝ
proof:
:= s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4
    2 * Real.exp (-((2 * Real.sqrt (c * q)) ^ 2) / (2 * c)) =
      2 * Real.exp (-2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
  let c : ℝ := s ^ 2 * (η⁻¹) ^ 4
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  change 2 * Real.exp (-((2 * Real.sqrt (c * q)) ^ 2) / (2 * c)) = _
  congr 2
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  field_simp [hc.ne']

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_sum_pi_gt_bilinear_scale_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_sum_pi_gt_bilinear_scale_le
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    {R s p : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hscale : 0 < R+s) (hd : 1 ≤ Fintype.card n)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ A : M, A ∂ν i = 0)
    (hbilinear : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ A : M, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i) ≤ s^2) :
    (Measure.pi ν).real {x : ι → M |
      4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(s*Real.sqrt p+R*p) < specNorm (∑ i, x i)} ≤
        (2*Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.exp (-p)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Nonempty n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  let := hn
  have hdR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hQ : specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i) ≤
      ((Fintype.card n : ℝ)*s)^2 := by
    have hh := specNorm_sum_integral_sq_le_card_sq_mul_of_bilinear_budget
      ν (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hR hHerm hBound hbilinear
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hscale' : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*s+R := by nlinarith only [hscale,hdR,hs]
  have hraw := measureReal_specNorm_sum_pi_gt_four_sqrt_add_le
    ν (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hR
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hs) hp hscale' hHerm hBound hmean hQ
  have hthreshold : 4*((Fintype.card n : ℝ)*s)*Real.sqrt p+4*R*p ≤
      4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(s*Real.sqrt p+R*p) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdR (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4*R*p)
    linear_combination hh
  apply (measureReal_mono (μ := Measure.pi ν) ?_).trans hraw
  intro x hx
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold hx

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_gaussian_sub_mean_gt_bilinear_scale_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_gaussian_sub_mean_gt_bilinear_scale_le
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    {R s p : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ A : M, A ∂ν i = 0)
    (hbilinear : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ A : M, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i) ≤ s^2)
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ]
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b);ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) b);Measure.pi ν]) :
    ρ.real {A : M | 4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*s*Real.sqrt p <
      specNorm (A-∫ B : M,B ∂ρ)} ≤ 4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-p)
proof:
:= by
  have hbudget (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (ha : ‖a‖=1) (hb : ‖b‖=1) :
      (∫ A : M, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M,B ∂ρ) *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ρ) ≤ s^2 := by
    rw [integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_sum_of_covariance_eq
      ν (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hBound hmean
        ρ IsGaussian.memLp_two_id hcov]
    exact hbilinear a b ha.le hb.le
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq hs] using
    measureReal_centered_specNorm_gt_le_gaussian_of_bilinear_budget
      ρ (sq_nonneg s) hp hbudget

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_residual_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_residual_le [Nonempty n]
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) :
    let m
proof:
:= gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ
    let S := coefficientSandwichSum A
    specNorm ((ζ • (1 : C)-A₀-S m)*m-1) ≤
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*‖S‖*
        (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4) := by
  dsimp only
  let m := gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ
  let S := coefficientSandwichSum A
  let R : E → M := fun x => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ
  let Q : E → C := fun x => normalizedPartialTrace (R x)
  let D : E → C := fun x => Q x-m
  let V := specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4
  have hReq : R=gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => ζ) := by
    funext x
    simp [R,gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
  have hRcont : Continuous R := by
    rw [hReq]
    exact (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 _ (fun _ => hζ) (r := 0)).continuous
  have hRi : Integrable R (gaussianVector K) := by
    rw [hReq]
    exact integrable_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 _ (fun _ => hζ)
  have hQcont : Continuous Q := (normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := n)).continuous.comp hRcont
  have hQ (x : E) : ‖Q x‖≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (specNorm_normalizedPartialTrace_le _).trans
      ((gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ)
  have hQi : Integrable Q (gaussianVector K) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hQcont.aestronglyMeasurable _ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hQ)
  have hm : ‖m‖≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ := specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ
  have hmean : (∫ x, Q x ∂gaussianVector K)=m :=
    (normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := n)).integral_comp_comm hRi
  have hDcont : Continuous D := hQcont.sub continuous_const
  have hD (x : E) : ‖D x‖≤2*|ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hQ x,hm])
  have hDi (a b : d) : Integrable (fun x : E => ‖D x a b‖^2) (gaussianVector K) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun x : E => ‖D x a b‖^2) :=
      ((residualEntryCLM a b).continuous.comp hDcont).norm.pow 2
    refine Integrable.of_bound hc.aestronglyMeasurable ((2*|ζ.im|⁻¹)^2) ?_
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      ((norm_apply_le_specNorm (D x) a b).trans (hD x)) 2
  have hV (a b : d) : (∫ x : E, ‖D x a b‖^2 ∂gaussianVector K)≤V := by
    simpa only [D,Q,m,gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry,Matrix.sub_apply] using
      integral_norm_partialTraceResolventEntry_sub_dyson_sq_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ a b
  let B : C →L[ℂ] C →L[ℂ] C := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ C).bilinearComp
    S (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ C)
  have hB (T U : C) : B T U=S T*U := rfl
  have hBcont : Continuous (fun x : E => B (Q x) (Q x)) :=
    (B.continuous.comp hQcont).clm_apply hQcont
  have hBbound (x : E) : ‖B (Q x) (Q x)‖≤‖S‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹^2 := by
    rw [hB]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖S (Q x)‖*‖Q x‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖S‖*‖Q x‖)*‖Q x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (S.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (‖S‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹)*|ζ.im|⁻¹ := by gcongr <;> exact hQ x
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hBi : Integrable (fun x => B (Q x) (Q x)) (gaussianVector K) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hBcont.aestronglyMeasurable _ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hBbound)
  have hcov := B.integral_bilinear_sub_integral Q hQi hBi
  rw [hmean] at hcov
  simp only [hB] at hcov
  change (∫ x, S (D x)*D x ∂gaussianVector K)=
    (∫ x, S (Q x)*Q x ∂gaussianVector K)-S m*m at hcov
  have hraw := gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_raw_dyson (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ
  change (ζ • (1 : C)-A₀)*m-(∫ x, (∑ i, A i*Q x*A i)*Q x ∂gaussianVector K)=1 at hraw
  simp_rw [← coefficientSandwichSum_apply_of_isHermitian A hA] at hraw
  have hres : (ζ • (1 : C)-A₀-S m)*m-1=
      ∫ x, S (D x)*D x ∂gaussianVector K := by
    rw [hcov,sub_mul,sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hraw]
    abel
  rw [hres]
  exact specNorm_integral_linearMap_mul_le_card_sq_mul_entry_second_moment S D
    hDcont.aestronglyMeasurable hDi V hV

name: NLAlib.ensembleReflectionAut_apply

name: NLAlib.map_finite_resolvent_word
statement:
private theorem map_finite_resolvent_word (φ : M →ₐ[ℂ] M) (T : M)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, ζ j ∈ resolventSet ℂ T) :
    φ ((List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent T (ζ j))).prod) =
      (List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (φ T) (ζ j))).prod
proof:

name: NLAlib.finite_word_transport
statement:
private theorem finite_word_transport
    (φ : M ≃ₐ[ℂ] M) (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0)
    (S : E → E) (hS : ∀ x, gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (S x) =
      φ (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)) (x : E) :
    gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ (S x) =
      φ (gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord
  rw [hS]
  symm
  apply map_finite_resolvent_word φ.toAlgHom _ ζ
  intro j
  change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ M (ζ j)-gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x).isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero (hζ j)

name: NLAlib.expected_word_transport
statement:
private theorem expected_word_transport
    (φ : M ≃ₐ[ℂ] M) (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0)
    (S : E → E) (hμ : MeasurePreserving S
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n))
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)))
    (hS : ∀ x, gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (S x) =
      φ (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)) :
    (∫ x : E, gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ x
      ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)) =
      φ (∫ x : E, gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ x
        ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)
  let F : E → M := gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ
  let L : M →L[ℂ] M := φ.toLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hF : Integrable F μ := integrable_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ
  have hFc : Continuous F :=
    (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ (r := 0)).continuous
  change (∫ x, F x ∂μ)=φ (∫ x, F x ∂μ)
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, F (S x) ∂μ := by
      have he := integral_map hμ.aemeasurable hFc.aestronglyMeasurable
      rw [hμ.map_eq] at he
      exact he
    _ = ∫ x, L (F x) ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      finite_word_transport φ A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ S hS x)
    _ = _ := L.integral_comp_comm hF

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_eq_kronecker_one
statement:
theorem exists_integral_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_eq_kronecker_one
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix d d ℂ,
      (∫ x : E, gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ x
        ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)) = Q⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_eq_kronecker_one_of_ensemble_entry_invariant
  · intro σ a b r s
    have h := expected_word_transport (ensemblePermutationAut (d := d) σ)
      A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ
      (fun x k => x (gaussianFreeEnsembleCoordinatePerm σ k))
      (measurePreserving_gaussianFreeEnsemble_permute σ)
      (fun x => gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_permute A₀ A q x σ)
    have he := congrFun (congrFun h (a,r)) (b,s)
    simpa only [ensemblePermutationAut_apply] using he.symm
  · intro t a b r s
    have h := expected_word_transport (ensembleReflectionAut (d := d) t)
      A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ (gaussianFreeEnsembleReflect t)
      (measurePreserving_gaussianFreeEnsemble_reflect t) (fun x => by
        ext ab ce
        rw [ensembleReflectionAut_apply]
        exact congrFun (congrFun (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_reflect A₀ A q x t) ab) ce)
    have he := congrFun (congrFun h (a,r)) (b,s)
    simpa only [ensembleReflectionAut_apply] using he

name: NLAlib.sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_integral_resolvent_word
statement:
theorem sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_integral_resolvent_word
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) :
    let W
proof:
:= ∫ x : E, gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ x
      ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)
    (∑ i, ∑ a : n, (A i⊗ₖ(Matrix.single a a 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))*W*
      (A i⊗ₖ(Matrix.single a a 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))) -
    (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, (A i⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix k)*W*
      (A i⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix k)) = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := exists_integral_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_eq_kronecker_one (n := n)
    A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ
  rw [hQ]
  exact sum_diagonal_sub_gue_covariance_sandwich_identity A Q

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_gaussian
statement:
theorem lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_gaussian
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ)) : lpNorm (fun x : ι → M => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ))
        (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (lpNorm (fun A : M => specNorm (resolvent A ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) ρ +
          4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
            (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / |ζ.im| ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) ρ := by
    apply ((IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id (μ := ρ)).map_of_measurable
      (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap
      (by fun_prop)).congr
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl
  have hc := abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_gaussian_le
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog
  have hX : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, (A₀ + ∑ i, x i).IsHermitian := by
    have hh : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (x i).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hHerm i)
    exact hh.mono fun x hx => hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => hx i)
  have hXm : AEMeasurable (fun x : ι → M => A₀ + ∑ i, x i) (Measure.pi ν) := by fun_prop
  have hupper := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
    (Measure.pi ν) _ hXm hX hζ hp
  have hlower := integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_lpNorm_specNorm
    ρ id aemeasurable_id hρHerm hζ hp
  simp only [id_eq] at hlower
  apply hupper.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have he := (le_abs_self _).trans hc
  linarith

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_le_pi
statement:
theorem lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_le_pi
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ)) : lpNorm (fun A : M => specNorm (resolvent A ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) ρ ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (lpNorm (fun x : ι → M => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ))
        (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi ν) +
          4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
            (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / |ζ.im| ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) ρ := by
    apply ((IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id (μ := ρ)).map_of_measurable
      (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap
      (by fun_prop)).congr
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl
  have hc := abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_gaussian_le
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog
  have hX : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, (A₀ + ∑ i, x i).IsHermitian := by
    have hh : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (x i).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hHerm i)
    exact hh.mono fun x hx => hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => hx i)
  have hXm : AEMeasurable (fun x : ι → M => A₀ + ∑ i, x i) (Measure.pi ν) := by fun_prop
  have hupper := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
    ρ id aemeasurable_id hρHerm hζ hp
  have hlower := integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_lpNorm_specNorm
    (Measure.pi ν) _ hXm hX hζ hp
  simp only [id_eq] at hupper
  apply hupper.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have he := (neg_le_abs _).trans hc
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_pi_gt_gaussian_mean_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_pi_gt_gaussian_mean_le
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((Z - ∫ H, H ∂ρ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    (Measure.pi ν).real {x : ι → M |
      Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ((∫ A : M, specNorm (resolvent A ζ) ∂ρ) +
          Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p) +
          4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
            (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / |ζ.im| ^ 4) <
        specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ)} ≤ Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLp := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_gaussian
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog
  have hG := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_le_integral_add_sqrt
    ρ hρHerm hσ hbilinear ζ hζ hp
  have hX : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, (A₀ + ∑ i, x i).IsHermitian := by
    have hh : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (x i).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hHerm i)
    exact hh.mono fun x hx => hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => hx i)
  have hXm : AEMeasurable (fun x : ι → M => A₀ + ∑ i, x i) (Measure.pi ν) := by fun_prop
  have hmem := memLp_specNorm_resolvent (Measure.pi ν) _ hXm hX hζ (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞))
  have hmarkov := measureReal_lt_exp_mul_lpNorm_le_exp_neg
    (Nat.mul_pos (by decide : 0 < 2) hp)
    (show MemLp (fun x : ι → M => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ))
      ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) by simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hmem)
  apply (measureReal_mono (μ := Measure.pi ν) (fun x hx => ?_)).trans hmarkov
  change Real.exp 1 * lpNorm (fun x : ι → M => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ))
    ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) < ‖specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ)‖
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
  have htotal := hLp.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (add_le_add hG le_rfl) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
  have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htotal (Real.exp_pos 1).le
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at *
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using he) hx

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_smul_kronecker
statement:
private theorem sum_smul_smul_kronecker {K : Type*} [Fintype K]
    (U : Matrix d d ℂ) (V : K → Matrix n n ℂ) (x : K → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ k, x k • (t • (U⊗ₖV k))) = t • (U⊗ₖ(∑ k, x k • V k))
proof:
:= by
  ext ab ce
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
    Complex.real_smul,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_eq_diagonal_add_gue
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_eq_diagonal_add_gue
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (q : ℝ)
    (x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ) :
    gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x =
      A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) +
        Real.sqrt q • (∑ i, A i⊗ₖMatrix.diagonal
          (fun a : n => (x (.inl (i,a)) : ℂ))) +
        Real.sqrt (1-q) • (∑ i, A i⊗ₖgueMatrix
          (fun k : GUECoordinate Unit n => x (.inr (i,k))) ())
proof:
:= by
  have hd (i : ι) :
      (∑ a : n, x (.inl (i,a)) • (Real.sqrt q •
        (A i⊗ₖ(Matrix.single a a 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)))) =
        Real.sqrt q • (A i⊗ₖMatrix.diagonal (fun a : n => (x (.inl (i,a)) : ℂ))) := by
    rw [sum_smul_smul_kronecker]
    congr 2
    simpa only [Matrix.smul_single,Complex.real_smul,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
      (Matrix.sum_single_eq_diagonal (fun a : n => (x (.inl (i,a)) : ℂ)))
  have hg (i : ι) :
      (∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, x (.inr (i,k)) • (Real.sqrt (1-q) •
        (A i⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix k))) =
        Real.sqrt (1-q) • (A i⊗ₖgueMatrix
          (fun k : GUECoordinate Unit n => x (.inr (i,k))) ()) := by
    rw [sum_smul_smul_kronecker]
    congr 2
    rw [gueMatrix_eq_sum_coordinate_smul_coefficient]
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,Complex.real_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation,Fintype.sum_sum_type,Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient,hd,hg,← Finset.smul_sum,add_assoc]

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_complex_kronecker
statement:
private theorem isHermitian_complex_kronecker {A : Matrix d d ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) : (A⊗ₖB).IsHermitian

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    (k : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n) :
    (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with ia|ik
  · have he : (Matrix.single ia.2 ia.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian := by
      rw [Matrix.IsHermitian,Matrix.conjTranspose_single]
      simp
    exact (isHermitian_complex_kronecker (hA _) he).smul (by rfl)
  · exact (isHermitian_complex_kronecker (hA _) (gueCoefficientMatrix_isHermitian _)).smul
      (by rfl)

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    (x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ) :
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x).IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  (isHermitian_complex_kronecker hA₀ Matrix.isHermitian_one).add
    (isHermitian_sum_smul_real _ (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA q) x)

statement:
theorem hasGaussianLaw_gaussianFreeFiniteSeries
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (q : ℝ) :
    HasGaussianLaw
      (fun x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ =>
        ∑ k, x k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k)

proof:

name: NLAlib.hasGaussianLaw_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
statement:
theorem hasGaussianLaw_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (q : ℝ) :
    HasGaussianLaw (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation (n := n) A₀ A q)
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)).map
    (gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A q)
  have : IsGaussian μ :=
    ((hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)).map_fun
      (gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM A q)).isGaussian_map
  have he : (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)).map
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q) =
      μ.map (fun T => A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+T) := by
    dsimp only [μ]
    rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_const_add _) (by fun_prop)]
    congr 1
    funext x
    simp [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation]
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [he]
  infer_instance

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (q : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ,
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x
      ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)) =
        A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)
  have hi (k : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n) : Integrable (fun x => x k) μ :=
    (memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)).integrable one_le_two
  have hz (k : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n) : (∫ x, x k ∂μ) = 0 :=
    integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)
  have hsum : Integrable
      (fun x => ∑ k, x k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q k) μ :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => (hi k).smul_const _
  change (∫ x, A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+
    ∑ k, x k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hsum,integral_const,
    integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hi k).smul_const _)]
  simp only [integral_smul_const,hz,zero_smul,Finset.sum_const_zero,
    add_zero,probReal_univ,one_smul]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_cyclic
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_cyclic
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x : E, normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) ζ ^ p *
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) (star ζ) ^ p)
        ∂gaussianVector K)
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) •
        ((∑ i, ∑ r : n, ∫ x : E, cyclicMixedResolventHessian
          (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p
          (A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ∂gaussianVector K) -
         (∑ i, ∑ k : GUECoordinate Unit n, ∫ x : E, cyclicMixedResolventHessian
          (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p
          (A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k) ∂gaussianVector K))) q
proof:
:= by
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent
    (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ p hq hq1
  dsimp only at hd
  have he (C : M) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (x : E) :
      (∑ j : Fin (p + p), ∑ k : Fin (p + p + 1), normalizedTrace
        (gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord A₀ A q
          (resolventWordInsert (resolventWordInsert (mixedResolventWord ζ p) j C) k C) x)) =
        cyclicMixedResolventHessian (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p C := by
    simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteBlockWord] using
      sum_twice_inserted_mixed_resolvent_trace_eq_cyclicHessian
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x) C hC ζ hζ p
  have hl (i : ι) (r : n) (x : E) := he
    (A i ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) (by
      simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, Real.sqrt_one, one_smul] using
        gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA 1 (.inl (i, r))) x
  have hr (i : ι) (k : GUECoordinate Unit n) (x : E) := he
    (A i ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix k) (by
      simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, sub_zero, Real.sqrt_one, one_smul] using
        gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA 0 (.inr (i, k))) x
  simpa only [hl, hr] using hd

name: NLAlib.gaussian_schatten_row_comparison
statement:
theorem gaussian_schatten_row_comparison
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (b : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hb : b.IsSymm) (hb0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j)
    {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    1 ≤ gaussianSchattenRowComparisonConstant ∧
    ((∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      ∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ∧
    ((∫ G, schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ≤
      gaussianSchattenRowComparisonConstant *
        ∫ G, rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p ∂gaussianMatrix ι ι) ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real {G | t ≤ rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p} ≤
        (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real {G | t ≤ schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p} ∧
      (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real {G | t ≤ schattenNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p} ≤
        gaussianSchattenRowComparisonConstant * (gaussianMatrix ι ι).real
          {G | t / gaussianSchattenRowComparisonConstant ≤
            rowMixedNorm (symmetricGaussianMatrix b G) p}
proof:
:= by
  have hA := one_le_gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant
  have hc : 0 < Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hAC : gaussianRowMeanComparisonConstant ≤ gaussianSchattenRowComparisonConstant :=
    le_gaussianTailComparisonConstant hA gaussianAbsoluteLowerConstant_pos hc
  have hmean := integral_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix_le_integral_rowMixedNorm b hb hb0 hp
  refine ⟨hA.trans hAC, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact integral_mono (integrable_rowMixedNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hp)
      (integrable_schattenNorm_symmetricGaussianMatrix b hp)
      (fun G => rowMixedNorm_le_schattenNorm _ hp)
  · exact hmean.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAC
      (integral_nonneg fun G => rowMixedNorm_nonneg _ _))
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨measureReal_mono (fun G hG => hG.trans (rowMixedNorm_le_schattenNorm _ hp))
      (by finiteness), ?_⟩
    exact measure_schattenNorm_le_mul_measure_rowMixedNorm_of_integral_le b hb hp hA hmean ht

name: NLAlib.resolvent_moment_comparison_scale_le
statement:
private theorem resolvent_moment_comparison_scale_le
    {p R Q η ℓ T : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ p)
    (hlarge : 16 * p * R ≤ η →
      T ≤ 9 * (2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) * R *
        ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * Q + R ^ 2 * (ℓ + 2 * p)) * η⁻¹ ^ 4)
    (hcrude : T ≤ η⁻¹) :
    T ≤ 4096 * (p ^ 2 * R * Q + p ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / η ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by linarith
  by_cases hlargeη : 16 * p * R ≤ η
  · have hp2 : p ≤ p ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hp) hp0]
    have hC : 9 * (2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ≤ 108 * p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hB : (Real.exp 1 - 1) * Q + R ^ 2 * (ℓ + 2 * p) ≤ 2 * Q + 3 * p * R ^ 2 := by
      have he : Real.exp 1 - 1 ≤ 2 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hQ,
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg R) (sub_nonneg.mpr hℓ)]
    calc
      T ≤ 9 * (2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) * R *
          ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * Q + R ^ 2 * (ℓ + 2 * p)) * η⁻¹ ^ 4 := hlarge hlargeη
      _ ≤ 108 * p ^ 2 * R * (2 * Q + 3 * p * R ^ 2) * η⁻¹ ^ 4 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (by positivity)).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hR) (by positivity))
      _ ≤ 4096 * (p ^ 2 * R * Q + p ^ 3 * R ^ 3) * η⁻¹ ^ 4 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        have h₀ : 0 ≤ p ^ 2 * R * Q := by positivity
        have h₁ : 0 ≤ p ^ 3 * R ^ 3 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  · have hηR : η ≤ 16 * p * R := (lt_of_not_ge hlargeη).le
    have hηcube := pow_le_pow_left₀ hη.le hηR 3
    have hnum : η ^ 3 ≤ 4096 * (p ^ 2 * R * Q + p ^ 3 * R ^ 3) := by
      have h₀ : 0 ≤ p ^ 2 * R * Q := by positivity
      nlinarith
    calc
      T ≤ η⁻¹ := hcrude
      _ = η ^ 3 / η ^ 4 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (pow_nonneg hη.le _)

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_gaussian_le
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (ν : ι → Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
    (ρ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : Matrix n n ℂ →
      ((n × n) ⊕ (n × n)) → ℝ) ρ)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A ∂ρ) = A₀ +
      ∫ x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : (n × n) ⊕ (n × n),
      cov[(fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ)) :
    |(∫ x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ p ∂Measure.pi ν) ^
        (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) -
      (∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ∂ρ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤
      4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
        (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / |ζ.im| ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hSecondMomentNonneg : 0 ≤ specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) :=
    specNorm_nonneg _
  have hRHS : 0 ≤ 4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R *
      specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) + (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) /
        |ζ.im| ^ 4 := by positivity
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : resolventEvenMoment A ζ p = 0 := by
      simp [resolventEvenMoment, normalizedTrace]
    simp only [hz, integral_zero, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact hRHS
  | inr hn =>
    let M := Matrix n n ℂ
    let J := (n × n) ⊕ (n × n)
    let E := J → ℝ
    let L : E →L[ℝ] M := hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates
    let Q := specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i)
    have hQ : 0 ≤ Q := specNorm_nonneg _
    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
    | inl hi =>
      have hρdirac : ρ = Measure.dirac A₀ :=
        eq_dirac_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance ρ hρ.memLp_two A₀
          (by simpa using hmean) (fun j => by simpa using hcov j j)
      have hzero :
          (∫ x : ι → M, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ p ∂Measure.pi ν) ^
              (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) -
            (∫ A : M, resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ∂ρ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 0 := by
        simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero, hρdirac]
        rw [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_dirac]
        exact sub_self _
      rw [hzero, abs_zero]
      exact hRHS
    | inr hi =>
      let κ : ι → Measure E := fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates
      have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure (κ i) :=
        (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
      have hν3 (i : ι) : MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i) :=
        MemLp.of_bound aestronglyMeasurable_id R (hBound i)
      have hκ2 (i : ι) : MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (κ i) :=
        memLp_id_map_matrixRealCoordinates (ν i)
          (MemLp.of_bound aestronglyMeasurable_id R (hBound i))
      have hκBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂κ i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R := by
        intro i
        have hm : MeasurableSet {x : E | specNorm (L x) ≤ R} :=
          (isClosed_le (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using L.continuous.norm)
            continuous_const).measurableSet
        apply (ae_map_iff measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable hm).mpr
        filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with A hA hb
        change specNorm (hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (matrixRealCoordinates A)) ≤ R
        rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA]
        exact hb
      let γ := centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ
      have hγ := hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ
      have hγmean := integral_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw_eq_zero ρ hρ
      have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
      have hγcov : ∀ a b : J,
          cov[(fun z : E => z a), (fun z : E => z b); γ] =
          cov[(fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q a),
            (fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q b);
            resamplingTripleMeasure κ] := by
        intro a b
        exact (covariance_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ a b).trans
          ((hcov a b).trans (covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates ν a b).symm)
      have hMoment := memLp_and_lpNorm_specNorm_sum_coordinate_sq_le_chernoff
        ν hR hHerm hBound (Nat.mul_pos (by decide : 0 < 2) hp)
      have hMomentBound : lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2))
          (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi κ) ≤
          (Real.exp 1 - 1) * Q + R ^ 2 * (Real.log (Fintype.card n) + 2 * (p : ℝ)) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hMoment.2
      have hLarge (hη : 16 * (p : ℝ) * R ≤ |ζ.im|) :
          |(∫ x : ι → M, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ p ∂Measure.pi ν) ^
              (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) -
            (∫ A : M, resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ∂ρ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤
          9 * (2 * (p : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * (p : ℝ) + 2) * R *
            ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * Q + R ^ 2 * (Real.log (Fintype.card n) + 2 * (p : ℝ))) *
              |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 := by
        have he := abs_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_le
          κ hκ2 γ hγ hγmean hγcov hR hκBound A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ hp hη
        dsimp only at he
        rw [resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_resolventEvenMoment_law ν hHerm γ A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ p,
          resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_resolventEvenMoment_law ν hν3 ρ hρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean ζ hζ p]
          at he
        have hCoeff : 0 ≤ 9 * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R := by positivity
        have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMomentBound hCoeff) (by positivity : 0 ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4)
        exact he.trans (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one] using hb)
      have hCrude := abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_le
        (Measure.pi ν) ρ (fun x : ι → M => A₀ + ∑ i, x i) id
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        ((ae_isHermitian_sum_pi ν hHerm).mono fun x hx => hA₀.add hx) hρHerm hζ hp
      exact resolvent_moment_comparison_scale_le
        (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hp)) hR hQ (abs_pos.mpr hζ) hlog hLarge hCrude

name: NLAlib.gramEntryEval_apply
statement:
private lemma gramEntryEval_apply {i : I} {j : J} (G : Matrix I J ℝ) :
    (gramEntryEval (i := i) (j := j)) G = G i j
proof:
:= by
  unfold gramEntryEval
  change (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (J → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (I → J → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (J → ℝ)) G) = G i j
  rfl

name: NLAlib.gramEntryLinearMap_apply
proof:
:= by
  unfold gramEntryLinearMap
  change (gramEntryEval (i := (idx t).1) (j := (idx t).2)).smulRight
    (b (idx t).1 (idx t).2) G = b (idx t).1 (idx t).2 * G (idx t).1 (idx t).2
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply]
  rw [gramEntryEval_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasGaussianLaw_gramEntryLinearMap

private theorem hasGaussianLaw_gramEntryLinearMap {k : ℕ} (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (idx : Fin k → I × J) :
    HasGaussianLaw (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => gramEntryLinearMap b idx G)
      (gaussianMatrix I J)
proof:
:= by

    (gramEntryLinearMap b idx) (gramEntryLinearMap b idx).continuous.measurable)

name: NLAlib.integrable_gramEntryLinearMap
statement:
private theorem integrable_gramEntryLinearMap {k : ℕ} (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (idx : Fin k → I × J) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => gramEntryLinearMap b idx G)
      (gaussianMatrix I J)
proof:
:= by
  have hLG := hasGaussianLaw_gramEntryLinearMap b idx
  have hI : Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) => x)
      ((gaussianMatrix I J).map (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => gramEntryLinearMap b idx G)) := by
    have hG : IsGaussian ((gaussianMatrix I J).map
        (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => gramEntryLinearMap b idx G)) :=
      hLG.isGaussian_map
    exact IsGaussian.integrable_id
  exact hI.comp_measurable (gramEntryLinearMap b idx).continuous.measurable

name: NLAlib.integral_gramEntryLinearMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hIntL := integrable_gramEntryLinearMap b idx
  have hproj (t : Fin k) :
      (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, gramEntryLinearMap b idx G ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) t =
        ∫ G, (gramEntryLinearMap b idx G) t ∂ gaussianMatrix I J := by
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] ℝ).integral_comp_comm
      hIntL).symm
  have hzero (t : Fin k) :
      ∫ G, (gramEntryLinearMap b idx G) t ∂ gaussianMatrix I J = 0 := by
    simp_rw [gramEntryLinearMap_apply]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    rw [integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_eq_zero]
    simp
  rw [WithLp.ext_iff]
  funext t
  rw [hproj t]
  exact hzero t

name: NLAlib.integral_gramEntryLinearMap_mul
statement:
private theorem integral_gramEntryLinearMap_mul {k : ℕ} (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (idx : Fin k → I × J) (a b' : Fin k) :
    (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
        (gramEntryLinearMap b idx G) a * (gramEntryLinearMap b idx G) b'
      ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) =
      if idx a = idx b' then (b (idx a).1 (idx a).2) ^ 2 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [gramEntryLinearMap_apply]
  have hre : (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
      (b (idx a).1 (idx a).2 * G (idx a).1 (idx a).2) *
        (b (idx b').1 (idx b').2 * G (idx b').1 (idx b').2)) =
      fun G => (b (idx a).1 (idx a).2 * b (idx b').1 (idx b').2) *
        (G (idx a).1 (idx a).2 * G (idx b').1 (idx b').2) := by
    funext G
    ring
  rw [hre]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_mul (idx a).1 (idx b').1 (idx a).2 (idx b').2]
  by_cases h : idx a = idx b'
  · rw [h]
    simp [sq]
  · have hne : ¬((idx a).1 = (idx b').1 ∧ (idx a).2 = (idx b').2) := by
      rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact h (Prod.ext h1 h2)
    simp [hne, h]

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_gaussianMatrix_entry_weighted_eq_sum_pairings
statement:
theorem integral_prod_gaussianMatrix_entry_weighted_eq_sum_pairings {k : ℕ}
    (b : I → J → ℝ) (idx : Fin k → I × J) :
    (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
        ∏ t : Fin k, b (idx t).1 (idx t).2 * G (idx t).1 (idx t).2 ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings k,
        gaussianPairingWeight
          (fun a b' => if idx a = idx b' then (b (idx a).1 (idx a).2) ^ 2 else 0) π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := gramEntryLinearMap b idx
  have hLG : HasGaussianLaw (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => L G) (gaussianMatrix I J) :=
    hasGaussianLaw_gramEntryLinearMap b idx
  have hmean : ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, L G ∂ gaussianMatrix I J = 0 :=
    integral_gramEntryLinearMap_eq_zero b idx
  have hic := integral_prod_gaussianVector_eq_sum_pairings
    (Ω := Matrix I J ℝ) (P := gaussianMatrix I J) (G := fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => L G)
    (hG := hLG) (hmean := hmean) (idx := fun t : Fin k => t)
  have hcov (a b' : Fin k) :
      (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, (L G) a * (L G) b' ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) =
        if idx a = idx b' then (b (idx a).1 (idx a).2) ^ 2 else 0 :=
    integral_gramEntryLinearMap_mul b idx a b'
  calc
    (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
        ∏ t : Fin k, b (idx t).1 (idx t).2 * G (idx t).1 (idx t).2 ∂ gaussianMatrix I J)
        = ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, ∏ r : Fin k, (L G) r ∂ gaussianMatrix I J := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
          intro G
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro t _
          rw [gramEntryLinearMap_apply]
    _ = ∑ π : GaussianPairings k,
          gaussianPairingWeight
            (fun a b' => ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, (L G) a * (L G) b' ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) π := by
          simpa using hic
    _ = ∑ π : GaussianPairings k,
          gaussianPairingWeight
            (fun a b' => if idx a = idx b' then (b (idx a).1 (idx a).2) ^ 2 else 0) π := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro π _
          congr 1
          funext a
          funext b'
          exact hcov a b'

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_gaussianMatrix_entry_weighted
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_gaussianMatrix_entry_weighted {k : ℕ}
    (b : I → J → ℝ) (idx : Fin k → I × J) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
        ∏ t : Fin k, b (idx t).1 (idx t).2 * G (idx t).1 (idx t).2) (gaussianMatrix I J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := gramEntryLinearMap b idx
  have hLG : HasGaussianLaw (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => L G) (gaussianMatrix I J) :=
    hasGaussianLaw_gramEntryLinearMap b idx
  have hmean : ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, L G ∂ gaussianMatrix I J = 0 :=
    integral_gramEntryLinearMap_eq_zero b idx
  have hIntV := integrable_prod_gaussianVector_of_centered
    (Ω := Matrix I J ℝ) (P := gaussianMatrix I J) (G := fun G : Matrix I J ℝ => L G)
    (hG := hLG) (hmean := hmean) (idx := fun t : Fin k => t)

  funext G

  intro t _
  rw [gramEntryLinearMap_apply]

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gram_cycle
statement:
theorem trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gram_cycle (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace ((A * Aᴴ) ^ (q + 1)) =
      ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → I, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → J,
        ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
          A (r t) (c t) * A (r (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gramOccurrence A q]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  exact (prod_gram_entries_eq_prod_pow_gramOccurrenceCount A q r c).symm

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_sum_pairings
statement:
theorem integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_sum_pairings (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
        Matrix.trace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ)^p) ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings (p + p), ∑ x : Fin p → I, ∑ y : Fin p → J,
        gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b p x y) π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hp)
  have hprod (x : Fin (q + 1) → I) (y : Fin (q + 1) → J) (G : Matrix I J ℝ) :
      (∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
          (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
            (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t))) =
        ∏ a : Fin ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
          b (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
            (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2 *
          G (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
            (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2 := by
    let f : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun t =>
      b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)
    let g : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun t =>
      b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)
    calc
      (∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
          (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
            (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)))
          = ∏ t : Fin (q + 1), f t * g t := by simp [f, g]
      _ = (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), f t) * (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), g t) := by
            rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      _ = ∏ s : Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1), Sum.elim f g s := by
            exact (Fintype.prod_sumElim f g).symm
      _ = ∏ a : Fin ((q + 1) + (q + 1)), Sum.elim f g (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a) := by
            exact Fintype.prod_equiv (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1)).symm
              (fun s => Sum.elim f g s)
              (fun a => Sum.elim f g (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a))
              (fun s => by simp)
      _ = ∏ a : Fin ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
            b (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
              (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2 *
            G (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
              (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2 := by
            apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
            intro a _
            cases h : gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a with
            | inl t =>
                simp [f, g, gramOccurrenceIdx]
            | inr t =>
                simp [f, g, gramOccurrenceIdx]
  have htrace (G : Matrix I J ℝ) :
      Matrix.trace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
        (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ)^(q + 1)) =
        ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
          ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
            (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
              (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)) := by
    let A : Matrix I J ℝ := Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)
    rw [trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gramOccurrence A q]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y _
    rw [← prod_gram_entries_eq_prod_pow_gramOccurrenceCount A q x y]
    simp [A]
  have hin (x : Fin (q + 1) → I) (y : Fin (q + 1) → J) :
      Integrable (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
          ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
            (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
              (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)))
        (gaussianMatrix I J) := by
    have hI := integrable_prod_gaussianMatrix_entry_weighted (k := (q + 1) + (q + 1)) b
      (fun a => gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a))
    convert hI using 1
    funext G
    exact hprod x y G
  have hinSum (x : Fin (q + 1) → I) :
      Integrable (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
          ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
            ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
              (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
                (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)))
        (gaussianMatrix I J) := by
    exact integrable_finsetSum (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun y : Fin (q + 1) → J => fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
        ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
          (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
            (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)))
      (fun y _ => hin x y)
  calc
    (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
        Matrix.trace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ)^(q + 1)) ∂ gaussianMatrix I J)
        = ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ, ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
            ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
              (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
                (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t))
            ∂ gaussianMatrix I J := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
          intro G
          exact htrace G
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
          ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
            ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
              (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
                (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t))
            ∂ gaussianMatrix I J := by
          rw [integral_finsetSum (s := Finset.univ)
            (f := fun x : Fin (q + 1) → I => fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
              ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
                ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
                  (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
                    (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)))
            (fun x _ => hinSum x)]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          rw [integral_finsetSum (s := Finset.univ)
            (f := fun y : Fin (q + 1) → J => fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
              ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
                (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
                  (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t)))
            (fun y _ => hin x y)]
    _ = ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
          ∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
            gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b (q + 1) x y) π := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro y _
          have hw := integral_prod_gaussianMatrix_entry_weighted_eq_sum_pairings
            (k := (q + 1) + (q + 1)) b
            (fun a => gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a))
          calc
            ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
                ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
                  (b (x t) (y t) * G (x t) (y t)) *
                    (b (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t) * G (x (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (y t))
                ∂ gaussianMatrix I J
                = ∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
                    ∏ a : Fin ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
                      b (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
                        (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2 *
                      G (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
                        (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2
                    ∂ gaussianMatrix I J := by
                  apply integral_congr_ae
                  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
                  intro G
                  exact hprod x y G
                _ = ∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
                      gaussianPairingWeight
                        (fun a b' =>
                          if (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)) =
                               (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) b'))
                            then (b (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).1
                                    (gramOccurrenceIdx q x y (gramCycleEquiv (q + 1) a)).2)^2
                            else 0) π := hw
                _ = ∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
                      gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b (q + 1) x y) π := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro π _
                  congr 1
                  funext a
                  funext b'
                  simp [gramCyclePairCovariance, gramCycleIdx_eq_gramOccurrenceIdx]
    _ = ∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)), ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I,
          ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
            gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b (q + 1) x y) π := by
          calc
            (∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I, ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
                ∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
                  gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b (q + 1) x y) π)
                = ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I,
                    (∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)),
                      ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
                        gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b (q + 1) x y) π) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro x _
                  exact Finset.sum_comm
            _ = ∑ π : GaussianPairings ((q + 1) + (q + 1)), ∑ x : Fin (q + 1) → I,
                  ∑ y : Fin (q + 1) → J,
                    gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b (q + 1) x y) π := by
                  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_sum_pairings_outer

theorem integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_sum_pairings_outer (b : I → J → ℝ)

        Matrix.trace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ)^p) ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) =

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingWeight_gramCyclePairCovariance_eq_prod_edges
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingWeight_gramCyclePairCovariance_eq_prod_edges (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (p : ℕ) (x : Fin p → I) (y : Fin p → J) (π : GaussianPairings (p + p)) :
    gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b p x y) π =
      ((gaussianPairingEdges π).map (fun e =>
        if gramCycleIdx p x y (gramCycleEquiv p e.1) = gramCycleIdx p x y (gramCycleEquiv p e.2)
          then (b (gramCycleIdx p x y (gramCycleEquiv p e.1)).1
                   (gramCycleIdx p x y (gramCycleEquiv p e.1)).2)^2
          else 0)).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPairingWeight_eq_prod_gaussianPairingEdges]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_zero_pow_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_trace_gram_zero_pow_gaussianMatrix (b : I → J → ℝ) :

        Matrix.trace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ)^0) ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) =
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun G : Matrix I J ℝ =>
      Matrix.trace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
        (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ)^0)) =
