    funext G
    simp [Matrix.trace_one]
  rw [h]
  simp

name: NLAlib.shifted_integral_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent
statement:
theorem shifted_integral_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) :
    (ζ • (1 : M)-A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))*
      (∫ x : E, resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ ∂gaussianVector K) =
      1+∫ x : E,
        (∑ k, gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k*
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ*
          gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k)*
            resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let R : E → M := fun x => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ
  let C := gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q
  let Z := ζ • (1 : M)-A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
  let μ := gaussianVector K
  have hReq : R=gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (fun _ : Fin 1 => ζ) := by
    funext x
    simp [R,gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
  have hRc : Continuous R := by
    rw [hReq]
    exact (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA q _ (fun _ => hζ)
      (r := 0)).continuous
  have hR (x : E) : ‖R x‖≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hi : Integrable R μ :=
    Integrable.of_bound hRc.aestronglyMeasurable _ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hR)
  have hxi (k : K) : Integrable (fun x : E => x k • R x) μ :=
    ((memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)).integrable one_le_two).smul_bdd _ hRc.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hR)
  have hci (k : K) : Integrable (fun x : E => R x*C k*R x) μ := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound ((hRc.mul_const _).mul hRc).aestronglyMeasurable
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹^2*‖C k‖) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖R x‖*‖C k‖)*‖R x‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹*‖C k‖)*|ζ.im|⁻¹ := by gcongr <;> exact hR x
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hpoint (x : E) : Z*R x=1+∑ k : K, C k*(x k • R x) := by
    have hu := (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x).isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
    have hinv : (ζ • (1 : M)-gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)*R x=1 := by
      simpa only [R,resolvent,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
        Ring.mul_inverse_cancel (ζ • (1 : M)-gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) hu
    calc
      _ = (ζ • (1 : M)-gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x)*R x+
          (∑ k, x k • C k)*R x := by
        dsimp only [Z,C,gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hinv,Finset.sum_mul]
        simp only [smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm]
  let P : M →L[ℂ] M := ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M Z
  change Z*(∫ x, R x ∂μ)=_
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, Z*R x ∂μ := (P.integral_comp_comm hi).symm
    _ = ∫ x, (1 : M)+∑ k : K, C k*(x k • R x) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    _ = 1+∑ k : K, C k*(∫ x, x k • R x ∂μ) := by
      rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ =>
        (hxi k).const_mul (C k)),integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul,integral_finsetSum]
      · congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M (C k)).integral_comp_comm (hxi k)
      · intro k _
        exact (hxi k).const_mul _
    _ = 1+∑ k : K, C k*(∫ x, R x*C k*R x ∂μ) := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [integral_coordinate_smul_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ k]
    _ = 1+∫ x, ∑ k : K, C k*(R x*C k*R x) ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum]
      · congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M (C k)).integral_comp_comm (hci k)).symm
      · intro k _
        exact (hci k).const_mul _
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      intro x
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      simp only [R,C,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resamplingInterpolation_sub_le_square_mass
statement:
theorem specNorm_resamplingInterpolation_sub_le_square_mass
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × C => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × C => resamplingTripleOriginal p j); resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ) 1 -
      resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ) 0) ≤
      72 * (R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) *
        ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let F : ℝ → M := resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ)
  let Y : ℝ := ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν
  let K : ℝ := 72 * (R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) * Y
  have hY : 0 ≤ Y := integral_nonneg fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  have hFc : Continuous F := continuous_resamplingInterpolation ν hν γ _
    (continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA ζ hζ) |ζ.im|⁻¹
    (specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le A hA ζ hζ)
  have hInterior : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F t ∧ specNorm (deriv F t) ≤ K := by
    intro t ht
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let base : C × E → M := fun q => A + L
      (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (∑ i, q.1 (i, 0)) q.2)
    let T : (ι × C) × E → M := fun q =>
      resolventCubicRemainder (base (q.1.2, q.2))
        (L (q.1.2 (q.1.1, 0) - q.1.2 (q.1.1, 1)))
        (L (q.1.2 (q.1.1, 0) - q.1.2 (q.1.1, 2))) a ζ
    let N : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
    let Q := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
    have hbase : Measurable base := by
      dsimp [base, resamplingAffinePoint]
      fun_prop
    have hbaseH : ∀ q, (base q).IsHermitian := fun q =>
      hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _)
    have he := integrable_and_specNorm_card_smul_integral_resolventCubicRemainder_le
      ν γ L base hbase.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hbaseH) hR
      (fun _ => ae_of_all _ fun _ => isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _)
      hBound a ζ hζ
    have hEstimate : specNorm (N • ∫ q, T q ∂Q) ≤
        (96 * R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + 288 * a ^ 2 * R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) * Y :=
      he.2.2
    have hd0 := integrable_and_hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_resolventCubicRemainder
      ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov A hA ζ hζ ht.1 ht.2
    have hd : HasDerivAt F ((N * a / 4) • ∫ q, T q ∂Q) t := by
      have hdRaw := hd0.2
      dsimp only at hdRaw
      change HasDerivAt F ((N * a / 4) • ∫ q,
        resolventCubicRemainder
          (A + L (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
          (L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
          (L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleSecond q.1)) a ζ ∂Q) t at hdRaw
      apply hdRaw.congr_deriv
      apply congrArg (fun v : M => (N * a / 4) • v)
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
        dsimp only
        rw [resamplingTriple_difference, resamplingTriple_difference_second]
        rfl
    refine ⟨hd.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    rw [hd.deriv]
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr ht.2.le
    have ha3 : a ^ 3 ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [one_pow] using pow_le_pow_left₀ ha ha1 3
    have hscalar : N * a / 4 = (a / 4) * N := by ring
    rw [hscalar, mul_smul, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_nonneg ha (by norm_num))]
    calc
      _ ≤ (a / 4) *
          ((96 * R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + 288 * a ^ 2 * R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) * Y) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEstimate (div_nonneg ha (by norm_num))
      _ ≤ K := by
        have hu : 0 ≤ R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 := by positivity
        have hv : 0 ≤ R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6 := by positivity
        have hcoef : (a / 4) *
            (96 * R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + 288 * a ^ 2 * R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) ≤
            72 * (R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 72 - 24 * a by linarith) hu,
            mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 72 - 72 * a ^ 3 by linarith) hv]
        dsimp [K]
        simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hY
  exact norm_sub_endpoints_le_of_hasDerivAt_Ioo hK hFc.continuousOn
    (fun t ht => (hInterior t ht).1.hasDerivAt) (fun t ht => (hInterior t ht).2)

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean_of_pos
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean_of_pos
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hmass : 0 < bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) :
    let ξ
proof:
:= Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
    let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    let E := ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
    let H := fun x : ι → ℝ => Metric.hausdorffDist
      (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i)) (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, H x ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*E ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (gaussianVector ι).real
        {x | (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*E+100000000000000000000*s*t < H x} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let q : ℕ := ⌈10*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)+100⌉₊
  obtain ⟨hq,hlog,hqupper,hfailure⟩ := gaussian_free_logarithmic_order_budgets hd
  change 0 < q at hq
  change Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ≤ q at hlog
  change (q : ℝ) ≤ 212*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) at hqupper
  change 1/(16*(q : ℝ))+27*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-(q : ℝ)) ≤ 1/2 at hfailure
  let ξ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
  let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
  let Δ := ξ*(q : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
  let E := ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
  let S := spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)
  let H := fun x : ι → ℝ => Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i)) S
  have hξ : 0 ≤ ξ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hspos : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmass
  have hweak0 := sqrt_bilinearSquareMass_le_sqrt_variance_covariance A hA
  have hvariance0 := sqrt_variance_div_card_le_sqrt_covariance A hA
  have hbudgets := gaussian_free_delta_budgets hq (Fintype.card_pos (α := d))
    (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientVariance A)) (specNorm_nonneg (coefficientCovariance A))
      hs hweak0 hvariance0
  dsimp only at hbudgets
  obtain ⟨hweak,hvariance,hbudget,hΔpos⟩ := hbudgets
  have hΔ : 0 < Δ := hΔpos hspos
  have hp := measureReal_hausdorffDist_gaussian_wordNative_gt_fixed_height A₀ hA₀ A hA
    hmass hq hlog hΔ hweak hvariance hbudget.le
  have hbad : (gaussianVector ι).real {x | (20000000000000000 : ℝ)*Δ < H x} ≤ 1/2 :=
    hp.trans hfailure
  have hXm : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => A₀+∑ i,x i•A i) := by fun_prop
  have hHerm (x : ι → ℝ) : (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hHm : AEMeasurable H (gaussianVector ι) :=
    aemeasurable_hausdorffDist_spectrum hXm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hHerm) S
  have hcompl := probReal_compl_eq_one_sub₀ (hHm.nullMeasurableSet_preimage (s := Set.Ioi (20000000000000000*Δ)) measurableSet_Ioi)
  have hhalf : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ (gaussianVector ι).real {x | H x ≤ 20000000000000000*Δ} := by
    have he : (H ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (20000000000000000*Δ))ᶜ = {x | H x ≤ 20000000000000000*Δ} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff,Set.mem_preimage,Set.mem_Ioi,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,not_lt]
    rw [he] at hcompl
    change (gaussianVector ι).real {x | H x ≤ 20000000000000000*Δ} =
      1-(gaussianVector ι).real {x | 20000000000000000*Δ < H x} at hcompl
    linarith only [hcompl,hbad]
  have hmean := integral_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_le_of_half_measure
    A₀ hA₀ A hA S hmass hhalf
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqp1 : 1 ≤ (q : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ) := Real.one_le_rpow hq1 (by norm_num)
  have hsΔ : s ≤ Δ := by
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqp1 hξ
    dsimp only [Δ]
    nlinarith only [hweak0,hx]
  have hlogpos : 0 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ Fintype.card d))
  have hpower : (q : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ) ≤ 212*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ) := by
    have hh := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg q) hqupper (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3/4)
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hlogpos] at hh
    have h212 : (212 : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ) ≤ 212 :=
      Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h212 (Real.rpow_nonneg hlogpos _))
  have hΔE : Δ ≤ 212*E := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpower hξ
    simpa only [Δ,E,mul_assoc,mul_left_comm] using hh
  have hwidth : (20000000000000000 : ℝ)*Δ+4*s ≤ 100000000000000000000*E := by
    have hE : 0 ≤ E := mul_nonneg hξ (Real.rpow_nonneg hlogpos _)
    nlinarith only [hΔE,hsΔ,hE]
  refine ⟨hmean.trans hwidth, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have htail := measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_gt_of_half_measure
    A₀ hA₀ A hA S hmass hhalf ht
  refine le_trans ?_ htail
  apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
  intro x hx
  change 20000000000000000*Δ+4*s+2*s*t < H x
  have hst : 0 ≤ s*t := mul_nonneg hs ht
  change 100000000000000000000*E+100000000000000000000*s*t < H x at hx
  nlinarith only [hx,hwidth,hst]

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    let ξ
proof:
:= Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
    let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    let E := ξ*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ)
    let H := fun x : ι → ℝ => Metric.hausdorffDist
      (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i)) (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, H x ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*E ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (gaussianVector ι).real
        {x | (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*E+100000000000000000000*s*t < H x} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2) := by
  classical
  by_cases hmass : 0 < bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
  · exact gaussian_free_hausdorffDist_le_with_probability_and_mean_of_pos hd A₀ hA₀ A hA hmass
  have hz : bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hmass)
    (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)
  have hH (x : ι → ℝ) := hausdorffDist_spectrum_gaussian_wordNative_eq_zero_of_zero_weak
    A₀ hA₀ A hz x
  dsimp only
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ Fintype.card d))
  have hE : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*
      Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hlog _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [hH]
    rw [integral_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hE
  · intro t ht
    have he : {x : ι → ℝ |
        (100000000000000000000 : ℝ)*(Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))*
          Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))*Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^(3/4 : ℝ))+
        100000000000000000000*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*t <
        Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i))
          (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))} = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,Set.mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false,hH]
      exact not_lt_of_ge (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hE)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) ht))
    rw [he,measureReal_empty]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent
statement:
private theorem contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (fun x : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ)
proof:
:= by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro x
  let L := gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A q
  have hu : IsUnit (ζ • (1 : M)-gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) :=
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x).isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero hζ
  have hi := contDiffAt_ringInverse (n := r) ℝ hu.unit
  rw [hu.unit_spec] at hi
  have hT : gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x =
      A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+L x := by simp [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation,L]
  rw [hT] at hi
  have ha : ContDiffAt ℝ r
      (fun y : E => ζ • (1 : M)-(A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+L y)) x :=
    contDiffAt_const.sub (contDiffAt_const.add L.contDiff.contDiffAt)
  convert! hi.comp x ha using 1
  funext y
  simp [resolvent,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation,L]

name: NLAlib.contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord
statement:
theorem contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord (n := n) A₀ A q ζ)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have he : gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord (n := n) A₀ A q ζ = fun _ : E => (1 : M) := by
      funext x
      simp [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
    rw [he]
    exact contDiff_const
  | succ m ih =>
    have he : gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord (n := n) A₀ A q ζ = fun x : E =>
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (ζ 0)*
          gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (Fin.tail ζ) x := by
      funext x
      simp only [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord,List.ofFn_succ,List.prod_cons]
      rfl
    rw [he]
    exact (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent A₀ hA₀ A hA q (ζ 0) (hζ 0)).mul
      (ih (Fin.tail ζ) (fun j => hζ j.succ))

name: NLAlib.norm_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_le
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) (x : E) :
    ‖gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q ζ x‖ ≤ ∏ j, |(ζ j).im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord,List.ofFn_zero,List.prod_nil,
      Fin.prod_univ_zero,← specNorm_eq_norm] using (specNorm_one_le (n := d × n) (𝕜 := ℂ))
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord,List.ofFn_succ,List.prod_cons]
    change ‖resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (ζ 0)*
      gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (Fin.tail ζ) x‖ ≤ _
    have hR : ‖resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (ζ 0)‖ ≤
        |(ζ 0).im|⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using
        (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x).specNorm_resolvent_le (hζ 0)
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (ζ 0)‖*
          ‖gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (Fin.tail ζ) x‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ |(ζ 0).im|⁻¹*∏ j : Fin m, |(ζ j.succ).im|⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul hR (ih (Fin.tail ζ) (fun j => hζ j.succ)) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: NLAlib.integrable_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (q : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord (n := n) A₀ A q ζ)
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n))
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.of_bound
    (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ
      (r := 0)).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (∏ j, |(ζ j).im|⁻¹) ?_
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (norm_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_le A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ)

name: NLAlib.integral_normalized_modulus_gaussianFreeFinite_correlation
statement:
theorem integral_normalized_modulus_gaussianFreeFinite_correlation
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : -1 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (∫ w : E × E, (normalizedTrace
      (CFC.abs (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q
        (t • w.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • w.2)) ζ) ^ (2 * p))).re
      ∂(gaussianVector K).prod (gaussianVector K)) =
      ∫ x : E, (normalizedTrace
        (CFC.abs (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ) ^ (2 * p))).re
          ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let F : E → ℝ := fun x => (normalizedTrace
    (CFC.abs (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ) ^ (2 * p))).re
  have heq (x : E) : F x =
      (normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x)).re := by
    have h := re_normalizedTrace_cfcAbs_pow_two_mul
      (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ) p
    change F x = (normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x)).re
    rw [show F x = resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p by
      simpa only [F, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, resolventEvenMoment] using h]
    exact resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x) ζ p
  let T : M →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hFc : Continuous F := by
    have hf := Complex.reCLM.continuous.comp (T.continuous.comp
      (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ p p (r := ⊤)).continuous)
    have hEqFn : F = fun x : E =>
        (normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ p p x)).re := funext heq
    rw [hEqFn]
    simpa +instances only [T, Function.comp_def, LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
      normalizedTraceLinearMap_apply] using! hf
  exact (measurePreserving_standardGaussianCorrelation (κ := K) t ht ht1).hasLaw.integral_comp
    hFc.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.variance_smul

name: NLAlib.covariance_outer_smul
statement:
private theorem covariance_outer_smul
    (C : Matrix (d × n) (d × n) ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec (fun ab : (d × n) × (d × n) => (r • C) ab.1 ab.2)

name: NLAlib.coefficientVariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient
statement:
theorem coefficientVariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    coefficientVariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q) =
      coefficientVariance A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1q : 0 ≤ 1 - q := sub_nonneg.mpr hq1
  have he : coefficientVariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q) =
      q • coefficientVariance (fun ia : ι × n => A ia.1 ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single ia.2 ia.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) +
      (1 - q) • coefficientVariance (fun ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2) := by
    simp only [coefficientVariance, Fintype.sum_sum_type, gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient,
      variance_smul, Real.sq_sqrt hq, Real.sq_sqrt h1q, Finset.smul_sum]
  have hd := coefficientVariance_kronecker A (fun r : n => (Matrix.single r r 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))
  have hg := coefficientVariance_kronecker A (gueCoefficientMatrix (n := n))
  rw [he, hd, hg,
    coefficientVariance_diagonal_single, coefficientVariance_gueCoefficientMatrix,
    ← add_smul]
  simp

name: NLAlib.coefficientCovariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient
statement:
theorem coefficientCovariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    coefficientCovariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q) =
      q • coefficientCovariance (fun ia : ι × n => A ia.1 ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single ia.2 ia.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) +
      (1 - q) • coefficientCovariance (fun ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1q : 0 ≤ 1 - q := sub_nonneg.mpr hq1
  simp only [coefficientCovariance_eq_sum_vecMulVec, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
    gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient, covariance_outer_smul, Real.sq_sqrt hq,
    Real.sq_sqrt h1q, Finset.smul_sum]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientVariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientVariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    specNorm (coefficientVariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q)) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientVariance A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientVariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A hq hq1, specNorm_kronecker]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (specNorm_nonneg _) specNorm_one_le

name: NLAlib.specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_coefficientCovariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_le
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A q)) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
proof:
:= by
  have h1q : 0 ≤ 1 - q := sub_nonneg.mpr hq1
  have hg : specNorm (coefficientCovariance
      (fun ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2)) ≤
        specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) := by
    rw [specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker_gueCoefficientMatrix]
    by_cases hn : Fintype.card n = 0
    · simp only [hn, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero]
      exact specNorm_nonneg _
    · exact div_le_self (specNorm_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)
  rw [coefficientCovariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A hq hq1]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖q • coefficientCovariance
          (fun ia : ι × n => A ia.1 ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single ia.2 ia.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))‖ +
        ‖(1 - q) • coefficientCovariance
          (fun ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2)‖ :=
      norm_add_le _ _
    _ = q * specNorm (coefficientCovariance
          (fun ia : ι × n => A ia.1 ⊗ₖ (Matrix.single ia.2 ia.2 1 : Matrix n n ℂ))) +
        (1 - q) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance
          (fun ik : ι × GUECoordinate Unit n => A ik.1 ⊗ₖ gueCoefficientMatrix ik.2)) := by
      simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hq, Real.norm_of_nonneg h1q,
        specNorm_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ q * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) + (1 - q) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker_diagonal_single_le A) hq)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg h1q)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    let F
proof:
:= fun q : ℝ => ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p ∂gaussianVector J
    |F 1 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) - F 0 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤
      ((2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5 := by
  dsimp only
  let F := fun q : ℝ => ∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ p ∂gaussianVector J
  let V : ℝ := specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
  let B : ℝ := ((2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) * V * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp only [B]; positivity
  change |F 1 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) - F 0 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤ B
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (d × n) with
  | inl hdn =>
    have hFzero (q : ℝ) : F q = 0 := by
      dsimp only [F]
      simp [resolventEvenMoment, normalizedTrace]
    rw [hFzero, hFzero, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact hB
  | inr hdn =>
    let : Nonempty d := hdn.map Prod.fst
    let : Nonempty n := hdn.map Prod.snd
    let s : ℝ := 1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let C : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * B
    have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hs : 0 ≤ s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
    have hα : (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 1 - s := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * p)]
      dsimp only [s]
      push_cast
      field_simp [hk.ne']
    have hFc : Continuous F :=
      continuous_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ hp
    have hFpos (q : ℝ) : 0 < F q :=
      integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_pos A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ hp
    have hD (q : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
        HasDerivAt F (deriv F q) q ∧ |deriv F q| ≤ C * F q ^ (1 - s) := by
      obtain ⟨D, hd, hb⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_mixed_resolvent_norm_le
        (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ hp hq.1 hq.2
      have hdR : HasDerivAt F D.re q := by
        have hr := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt q hd
        have he : F = fun t => (∫ x : E, normalizedTrace
            (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) ζ ^ p *
              resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A t x) (star ζ) ^ p)
            ∂gaussianVector J).re := by
          funext t
          exact integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re A₀ hA₀ A hA t ζ hζ p
        rw [he]
        exact hr
      refine ⟨hdR.congr_deriv hdR.deriv.symm, ?_⟩
      rw [hdR.deriv]
      refine (Complex.abs_re_le_norm D).trans (hb.trans_eq ?_)
      rw [hα]
      dsimp only [C, B, V, F]
      push_cast
      ring
    have he := Real.abs_rpow_sub_rpow_le_of_hasDerivAt_bound
      (f := F) (f' := deriv F) (a := 0) (b := 1) (s := s) (K := C)
      (by norm_num) hs hFc.continuousOn (fun q _ => hFpos q)
      (fun q hq => (hD q hq).1) (fun q hq => (hD q hq).2)
    have hCB : (s * C) * (1 - 0) = B := by
      dsimp only [s, C]
      field_simp [hk.ne']
      ring
    simpa only [s, hCB] using he

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_sub_wordNative_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_sub_wordNative_le [Nonempty n]
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im)
    (hlarge : 2*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖≤z.im^2) :
    specNorm (gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A z-
      wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z) ≤
      (2*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^3*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*
        specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*z.im⁻¹^5
proof:
:= by
  have hne : z.im≠0 := ne_of_gt hz
  have hm := specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA z hne
  have hc : ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹)*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*
      specNorm (gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A z)≤1/2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹)*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*|z.im|⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (by positivity)
      _ = ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖)/(z.im^2) := by
        rw [abs_of_pos hz]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,pow_two]
        ring
      _ ≤ 1/2 := by
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hz)).mpr
        nlinarith
  have hr := specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_residual_le (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA z hne
  have hs := specNorm_sub_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le_residual hA₀ hA hne
    (gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A z) hc
  dsimp only at hr
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*((Fintype.card d : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹)*
        ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*
          (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|z.im|⁻¹^4)) :=
      hs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (by positivity))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [abs_of_pos hz]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: NLAlib.differentiableOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent
statement:
theorem differentiableOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A)
      {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
proof:
:= by
  let X : (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ) →
      selfAdjoint (Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ) := fun x =>
    ⟨gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x,
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x⟩
  have hXm : AEStronglyMeasurable X (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)) := by
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.aestronglyMeasurable_comp_iff.mp
    change AEStronglyMeasurable (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0) _
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
    fun_prop
  have hh := differentiableOn_resolventPowerMean X hXm
    (normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := n)) 1
  unfold resolventPowerMean at hh
  unfold gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent
  simpa only [pow_one,normalizedPartialTraceCLM_apply,X,gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent] using hh

name: NLAlib.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_sub_wordNative_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_sub_wordNative_zero
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun N : ℕ => fun z : ℂ => gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ A z-
        wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z)
      (fun _ => 0) atTop {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
proof:
:= by
  let d₀ : ℝ := Fintype.card d
  let s : ℝ := ‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖
  let v : ℝ := specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)
  let u₀ : ℝ := 1+2*d₀*s
  let F : ℕ → ℂ → C := fun N z =>
    gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ A z-wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z
  have hd₀ : 0≤d₀ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hs : 0≤s := norm_nonneg _
  have hv : 0≤v := specNorm_nonneg _
  apply Complex.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_zero_of_upper_boundary_error
    F atTop (d₀+1) u₀ (by positivity)
  · intro N
    exact (differentiableOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ hA₀ A hA).sub
      ((differentiableOn_wordNativeDysonResolvent hA₀ hA).mono fun z hz => ne_of_gt hz)
  · intro N z hz
    have hm := specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_le (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ hA₀ A hA z (ne_of_gt hz)
    have hf := specNorm_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le hA₀ hA (ne_of_gt hz)
    change specNorm (_-_)≤_
    calc
      _ ≤ specNorm (gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ A z)+
          specNorm (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z) := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ |z.im|⁻¹+d₀*|z.im|⁻¹ := add_le_add hm hf
      _ = (d₀+1)/z.im := by rw [abs_of_pos hz]; simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
  · intro u hu
    have hu1 : 1≤u := by dsimp [u₀] at hu; nlinarith
    have hupos : 0<u := zero_lt_one.trans_le hu1
    have hlarge : 2*d₀*s≤u^2 := by dsimp [u₀] at hu; nlinarith
    let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => (2*d₀^3*s*v)/((N : ℝ)+1)^2*u⁻¹^5
    have hε0 (N : ℕ) : 0≤ε N := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
    have hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hi : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => 1/((N : ℝ)+1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
      have hh := ((hi.pow 2).const_mul (2*d₀^3*s*v)).mul_const (u⁻¹^5)
      simpa only [ε,div_pow,one_pow,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_zero,zero_mul,one_mul,inv_pow,
        zero_pow (by decide : 2≠0)] using hh
    refine ⟨ε,hε0,hε,?_⟩
    intro N z hz
    have hzpos : 0<z.im := hz.symm ▸ hupos
    have hh := specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_sub_wordNative_le
      (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ hA₀ A hA hzpos (by simpa only [hz] using hlarge)
    simpa only [F,ε,d₀,s,v,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,hz,specNorm_eq_norm] using hh

name: NLAlib.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun N : ℕ => gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ A)
      (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A) atTop {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
proof:
:= by
  have hc : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun _ : ℕ => wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A)
      (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A) atTop {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} := by
    intro U hU z hz
    refine ⟨Set.univ, Filter.univ_mem, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N w hw => ?_⟩
    exact refl_mem_uniformity hU
  have hh := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_sub_wordNative_zero
    A₀ hA₀ A hA).add hc
  simpa only [Pi.add_def, sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hh

name: NLAlib.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (k : ℕ) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun N : ℕ => fun z : ℂ => normalizedPartialTrace
        (∫ x : (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ),
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^(k+1)
            ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))))
      (fun z : ℂ => wordMatrixVacuumCompression
        (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^(k+1)))
      atTop {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
proof:
:= by
  let X := fun (N : ℕ) (x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ) =>
    (⟨gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x,
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x⟩ :
        selfAdjoint (Matrix (d×Fin (N+1)) (d×Fin (N+1)) ℂ))
  have hXm (N : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (X N)
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))) := by
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.aestronglyMeasurable_comp_iff.mp
    change AEStronglyMeasurable (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0) _
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
    fun_prop
  have hf := tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent A₀ hA₀ A hA
  have hh := tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_resolventPowerMean_of_first
    (fun N : ℕ => gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))) X hXm
    (fun N => normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := Fin (N+1)))
    (⟨wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A,
      isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA⟩)
    (wordMatrixVacuumCompressionCLM (D := d) (ι := ι)) atTop (by
      unfold resolventPowerMean gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent wordNativeDysonResolvent at *
      simp only [X,pow_one,normalizedPartialTraceCLM_apply]
      change TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun N : ℕ => fun z : ℂ => normalizedPartialTrace
          (∫ x, resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z
            ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))))
        (fun z : ℂ => wordMatrixVacuumCompression
          (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)) atTop {z : ℂ | 0<z.im}
      exact hf) k
  unfold resolventPowerMean at hh
  change TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
    (fun N : ℕ => fun z : ℂ => normalizedPartialTrace
      (∫ x, resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^(k+1)
        ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))))
    (fun z : ℂ => wordMatrixVacuumCompression
      (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^(k+1))) atTop {z : ℂ | 0<z.im} at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.partialTraceEntryCLM_apply
statement:
private theorem partialTraceEntryCLM_apply (a b : d) (T : M) :
    partialTraceEntryCLM a b T=normalizedPartialTrace T a b
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [partialTraceEntryCLM,smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',
    LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',Matrix.traceLinearMap_apply,smul_eq_mul] using
    (normalizedPartialTrace_apply_eq_trace T a b).symm

name: NLAlib.fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_apply
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (a b : d) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A q ζ a b) x h =
      normalizedPartialTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ*
        (∑ k, h k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k)*
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ) a b
proof:
:= by
  let L := gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A q
  let T := gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x
  let P : M →L[ℝ] ℂ := (partialTraceEntryCLM (n := n) a b).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA q x
  have heq : gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q =
      fun y : E => A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)+L y := by
    funext y
    simp [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation,L]
  have hL : HasFDerivAt (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q) L x := by
    rw [heq]
    exact L.hasFDerivAt.const_add _
  have hR := (hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian ζ T hT hζ).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hcomp := P.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hR.comp x hL)
  have hfun : (fun y : E => P (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q y) ζ)) =
      gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A q ζ a b := by
    funext y
    exact partialTraceEntryCLM_apply a b _
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y : E => P (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q y) ζ)) _ x at hcomp
  rw [hfun] at hcomp
  rw [hcomp.fderiv]
  simp only [P,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    rationalBlockMap_apply,rationalBlockDifference_resolvent,
    partialTraceEntryCLM_apply,L,gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM_apply,T]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_covariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_zero
statement:
private theorem specNorm_covariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_zero
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    specNorm (coefficientCovariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A 0)) =
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : coefficientCovariance (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A 0) =
      coefficientCovariance (fun ik : ι×GUECoordinate Unit n => A ik.1⊗ₖgueCoefficientMatrix ik.2) := by
    ext ab ce
    simp [coefficientCovariance,coefficientVectorization,Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,Fintype.sum_sum_type,gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient]
  rw [he,specNorm_coefficientCovariance_kronecker_gueCoefficientMatrix]

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_sq_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (a b : d) (x : E) :
    (∑ k : K, ‖fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A 0 ζ a b) x
      (Pi.single k 1)‖^2) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ k : K,
      fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A 0 ζ a b) x
        (Pi.single k 1) =
      normalizedPartialTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ*
        gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A 0 k*
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ) a b := by
    intro k
    rw [fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_apply A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 ζ hζ]
    simp
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  have hh := sum_norm_normalizedPartialTrace_resolvent_sandwich_sq_le
    (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A 0)
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x) hζ a b
  rw [specNorm_covariance_gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_zero] at hh
  simpa only [div_div,← sq] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_partialTraceResolventEntry_sub_integral_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_partialTraceResolventEntry_sub_integral_sq_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (a b : d) :
    (∫ x : E, ‖gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A 0 ζ a b x-
      ∫ y : E, gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A 0 ζ a b y
        ∂gaussianVector K‖^2 ∂gaussianVector K) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4
proof:
:= by
  let f := gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry (n := n) A₀ A 0 ζ a b
  let L := gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A 0
  let P : M →L[ℝ] ℂ := (partialTraceEntryCLM (n := n) a b).restrictScalars ℝ
  let R : E → M := fun x => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ
  have hReq : R=gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => ζ) := by
    funext x
    simp [R,gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
  have hRc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ R := by
    rw [hReq]
    exact contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 _ (fun _ => hζ)
  have hR (x : E) : ‖R x‖≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have heq : f=P ∘ R := by
    funext x
    exact (partialTraceEntryCLM_apply a b _).symm
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f := by rw [heq]; exact P.contDiff.comp hRc
  have hdfc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ f) := (hfc.fderiv_right (m := ⊤) (by simp)).continuous
  have hfb (x : E) : ‖f x‖≤‖P‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
    rw [heq,Function.comp_apply]
    exact (P.le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hR x) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hdfb (x : E) : ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖≤‖P‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹^2*‖L‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
    intro h
    rw [fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_apply A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 ζ hζ]
    rw [← gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM_apply A 0 h,← partialTraceEntryCLM_apply a b]
    change ‖P (R x*(L h)*R x)‖≤_
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖P‖*‖R x*(L h)*R x‖ := P.le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖P‖*((‖R x‖*‖L h‖)*‖R x‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ‖P‖*((|ζ.im|⁻¹*(‖L‖*‖h‖))*|ζ.im|⁻¹) := by
        gcongr
        · exact hR x
        · exact L.le_opNorm h
        · exact hR x
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact integral_norm_sub_integral_sq_le_gaussian_gradient_bound f (fderiv ℝ f)
    (fun x => (hfc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt) hdfc
    (‖P‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹) (‖P‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹^2*‖L‖)
    (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4)
    hfb hdfb (sum_norm_fderiv_gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry_sq_le
      A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ a b)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_gaussian_resolvent_gt_free_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_gaussian_resolvent_gt_free_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    let B : ℝ
proof:
:= ((2*p+1)*(2*p+2)^2 : ℕ) *
      (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹)^5
    (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ‖ + B) <
          specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ)} ≤ Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let X : (ι → ℝ) → Matrix d d ℂ := fun x => A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i
  have hXm : Measurable X := by unfold X; fun_prop
  have hX (x : ι → ℝ) : (X x).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  let B : ℝ := ((2*p+1)*(2*p+2)^2 : ℕ) *
    (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹)^5
  let L : ℝ := lpNorm (fun x => specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ)) (2*(p : ℝ≥0∞)) (gaussianVector ι)
  have hroot : ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation
      ((star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ) *
        resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ)^p)).re) ^
          (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ ‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ‖ := by
    exact (wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := d) (ι := ι)).gramMoment_rpow_le_norm
      wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_one _ hp
  have hcomp := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp
    (abs_gaussian_wordNative_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ hp)).1
  have hL : L ≤ (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      (‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ‖ + B) := by
    refine (lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
      (gaussianVector ι) X hXm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hX) hζ hp).trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
    dsimp only [X] at *
    linarith
  have hm0 := measureReal_lt_exp_mul_lpNorm_le_exp_neg (by omega : 0 < 2*p)
    (memLp_specNorm_resolvent (gaussianVector ι) X hXm.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hX) hζ ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞))
  have hm : (gaussianVector ι).real {x | Real.exp 1 * L <
      ‖specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ)‖} ≤ Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [L, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hm0
  refine le_trans ?_ hm
  apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
  intro x hx
  change Real.exp 1 * L < ‖specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ)‖
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa only [B, mul_assoc] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL (Real.exp_pos 1).le) hx

name: NLAlib.measureReal_free_resolvent_gt_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_free_resolvent_gt_gaussian_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ≤ q)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : 0 < ζ.im)
    (hspec : ζ.re ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    let c : ℝ
proof:
:= bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹)^4
    let B : ℝ := ((2*(2*q)+1)*(2*(2*q)+2)^2 : ℕ) *
      (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹)^5
    let E : ℝ := Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2)) / ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2 * ζ.im^2)
    (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      (438*Real.exp 5) * (specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ) +
        Real.sqrt (4*c*(2*q)) + t + B + E) <
          ‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ‖} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-t^2/(2*c)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let X : (ι → ℝ) → Matrix d d ℂ := fun x => A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i
  have hXm : Measurable X := by unfold X; fun_prop
  have hX (x : ι → ℝ) : (X x).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  let c : ℝ := bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹)^4
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := mul_nonneg (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _) (by positivity)
  let C : ℝ := 438*Real.exp 5
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
  let B : ℝ := ((2*(2*q)+1)*(2*(2*q)+2)^2 : ℕ) *
    (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹)^5
  let E : ℝ := Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2)) / ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2 * ζ.im^2)
  let L : ℝ := lpNorm (fun x => specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ))
    (2*((2*q : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) (gaussianVector ι)
  have hcomp := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp
    (abs_gaussian_wordNative_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ.ne'
      (by omega : 0 < 2*q))).2
  have hroot := integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_lpNorm_specNorm
    (gaussianVector ι) X hXm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hX) hζ.ne'
      (by omega : 0 < 2*q)
  have hfree := norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_log_order
    q hq hlog hA₀ A hA hζ hspec
  have hexp : 1 / (((2*(2*q) : ℕ)) : ℝ) = 1 / (4*q : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hexp] at hcomp hroot
  have hbound : ‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ‖ ≤ C*(L+B+E) := by
    refine hfree.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC.le)
    dsimp only [X, L, B, E] at *
    linarith
  have henergy (u : d → ℂ) (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ))^2 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)]
    exact sum_re_quadForm_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A u hu
  have hmgf0 := hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy
    A₀ hA₀ A hA (Real.sqrt_nonneg (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)) henergy ζ hζ.ne'
  have hmgf : HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x => specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ) -
        ∫ y, specNorm (resolvent (X y) ζ) ∂gaussianVector ι)
      ⟨c, hc⟩ (gaussianVector ι) := by
    simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _), X, c] using hmgf0
  have hm := measureReal_lt_lpNorm_sub_le_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm_nonneg (resolvent (X x) ζ)) hmgf
      (by omega : 0 < 2*q) ht
  refine le_trans ?_ hm
  apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
  intro x hx
  change specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ) + Real.sqrt (4*c*(((2*q : ℕ) : ℝ))) + t < L
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  change C*(specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ) + Real.sqrt (4*c*(2*q)) + t + B + E) < _ at hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hp := mul_nonneg hC.le (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_gt hnot))
  nlinarith only [hp, hx, hbound]

name: NLAlib.ae_eq_constant_sum_and_gaussian_of_zero_radius
statement:
theorem ae_eq_constant_sum_and_gaussian_of_zero_radius
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i,IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hBound : ∀ i,∀ᵐ A ∂ν i,specNorm A≤0)
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (A₀ : M)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M,A ∂ρ)=A₀+∫ x : ι → M,∑ i,x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b);ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) b);Measure.pi ν])
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → ι → M) (G : Ω → M)
    (hS : HasLaw S (Measure.pi ν) μ) (hG : HasLaw G ρ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,(A₀+∑ i,S ω i)=A₀ ∧ G ω=A₀
proof:
:= by
  have hνzero (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i,A=0 := by
    filter_upwards [hBound i] with A hA
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    exact le_antisymm (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hA) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hmeanν (i : ι) : (∫ A : M,A ∂ν i)=0 := by
    simpa only [integral_zero] using integral_congr_ae (hνzero i)
  have hprod : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν,∀ i,x i=0 := ae_all_iff.mpr fun i =>
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hνzero i)
  have hsumMean : (∫ x : ι → M,∑ i,x i ∂Measure.pi ν)=0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ _x : ι → M,(0 : M) ∂Measure.pi ν := integral_congr_ae
        (hprod.mono fun x hx => by simp only [hx,Finset.sum_const_zero])
      _ = _ := integral_zero _ _
  have hmeanρ : (∫ A : M,A ∂ρ)=A₀ := by simpa only [hsumMean,add_zero] using hmean
  have hbudget (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (_ha : ‖a‖≤1) (_hb : ‖b‖≤1) :
      (∑ i,∫ A : M,‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i)≤(0 : ℝ)^2 := by
    have hi (i : ι) : (∫ A : M,‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i)=0 := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ _A : M,(0 : ℝ) ∂ν i := integral_congr_ae ((hνzero i).mono fun A hA => by simp [hA])
        _ = _ := integral_zero _ _
    simp only [hi,Finset.sum_const_zero,le_refl,zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ)≠0)]
  have htail (p : ℝ) (hp : 0≤p) :
      ρ.real {A : M | 0<specNorm (A-A₀)}≤4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-p) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul,mul_zero,hmeanρ] using
      measureReal_specNorm_gaussian_sub_mean_gt_bilinear_scale_le
        ν (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) hp hBound hmeanν hbudget ρ hcov
  have ht : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => 4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-p))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      tendsto_const_nhds.mul Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero
  have hz : ρ.real {A : M | 0<specNorm (A-A₀)}=0 := le_antisymm
    (ge_of_tendsto ht (eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨0,fun p hp => htail p hp⟩)) measureReal_nonneg
  have hρzero : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ,A=A₀ := by
    have hnorm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ,specNorm (A-A₀)≤0 := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      simpa only [not_le] using ((measureReal_eq_zero_iff).mp hz)
    filter_upwards [hnorm] with A hA
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    exact le_antisymm (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hA) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hGzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,G ω=A₀ := by
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun A : M => A=A₀) hG.aemeasurable
    rwa [hG.map_eq]
  have hSzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,∀ i,S ω i=0 := by
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : ι → M => ∀ i,x i=0) hS.aemeasurable
    rwa [hS.map_eq]
  filter_upwards [hGzero,hSzero] with ω hωG hωS
  exact ⟨by simp only [hωS,Finset.sum_const_zero,add_zero],hωG⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_finite_gue_resolvent
statement:
private theorem integrable_finite_gue_resolvent
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)

    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ)
      (gaussianVector K)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun x : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ)=
      gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => ζ) := by
    funext x
    simp [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
  rw [heq]

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_apply
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (a b : d) :
    gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ a b=
      ∫ x : E, gaussianFreeFinitePartialTraceResolventEntry A₀ A 0 ζ a b x
        ∂gaussianVector K
proof:
:= by
  let P := (matrixEntryCLM a b).comp (normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := n))
  have he := P.integral_comp_comm (integrable_finite_gue_resolvent (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ)
  exact he.symm

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) :
    specNorm (gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ)≤|ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply (specNorm_normalizedPartialTrace_le (d := d) (n := n)
    (∫ x : E, resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ ∂gaussianVector K)).trans
  change ‖∫ x : E, resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ
    ∂gaussianVector K‖≤_
  have hi := integrable_finite_gue_resolvent (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x : E, ‖resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ‖
        ∂gaussianVector K := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ _x : E, |ζ.im|⁻¹ ∂gaussianVector K := integral_mono hi.norm (integrable_const _)
      (fun x => (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_partialTraceResolventEntry_sub_dyson_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_partialTraceResolventEntry_sub_dyson_sq_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) (a b : d) :

      gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ a b‖^2 ∂gaussianVector K) ≤
      specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)/(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^4
proof:
:= by

  exact integral_norm_partialTraceResolventEntry_sub_integral_sq_le A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ a b

name: NLAlib.partialTrace_finite_gue_covariance_integrand
statement:
private theorem partialTrace_finite_gue_covariance_integrand

      gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A 0 k)*T)=

proof:
:= by

      gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A 0 k)=
      ∑ i, (A i*normalizedPartialTrace T*A i)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_raw_dyson
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent_raw_dyson [Nonempty n]
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im≠0) :
    (ζ • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)-A₀)*gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ-
      (∫ x : E,
        (∑ i, A i*normalizedPartialTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ)*A i)*
          normalizedPartialTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ)
        ∂gaussianVector K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let R : E → M := fun x => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) ζ
  let C := gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient (n := n) A 0
  let F : E → M := fun x => (∑ k : K, C k*R x*C k)*R x
  let P := normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := n)
  have hRcont : Continuous R := by
    have heq : R=gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => ζ) := by
      funext x
      simp [R,gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
    rw [heq]
    exact (contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 _ (fun _ => hζ)
      (r := 0)).continuous
  have hR (x : E) : ‖R x‖≤|ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hFcont : Continuous F :=
    (continuous_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (continuous_const.mul hRcont).mul continuous_const)).mul hRcont
  have hFbound (x : E) : ‖F x‖≤(∑ k : K, ‖C k‖^2)*|ζ.im|⁻¹^2 := by
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ k : K, ‖C k*R x*C k*R x‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k : K, ‖C k‖^2*|ζ.im|⁻¹^2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k _
        calc
          _ ≤ ((‖C k‖*‖R x‖)*‖C k‖)*‖R x‖ :=
            (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))) (norm_nonneg _))
          _ ≤ ((‖C k‖*|ζ.im|⁻¹)*‖C k‖)*|ζ.im|⁻¹ := by gcongr <;> exact hR x
          _ = _ := by ring
      _ = _ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
  have hFi : Integrable F (gaussianVector K) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hFcont.aestronglyMeasurable _ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFbound)
  have hone : P (1 : M)=(1 : Matrix d d ℂ) := by
    rw [show (1 : M)=(1 : Matrix d d ℂ)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) by exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one.symm]
    exact normalizedPartialTrace_kronecker_one _
  have hZ : ζ • (1 : M)-A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)=
      (ζ • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)-A₀)⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    ext ⟨a,r⟩ ⟨b,s⟩
    by_cases hab : a=b <;> by_cases hrs : r=s <;>
      simp [Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,hab,hrs,Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  have hh := congrArg P (shifted_integral_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 ζ hζ)
  change P ((ζ • (1 : M)-A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))*(∫ x : E, R x ∂gaussianVector K))=
    P (1+∫ x : E, F x ∂gaussianVector K) at hh
  rw [map_add,hone,← P.integral_comp_comm hFi] at hh
  change normalizedPartialTrace ((ζ • (1 : M)-A₀⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n ℂ))*
    (∫ x : E, R x ∂gaussianVector K))=1+∫ x : E, normalizedPartialTrace (F x) ∂gaussianVector K at hh
  rw [hZ,normalizedPartialTrace_kronecker_one_mul] at hh
  simp only [F,C,partialTrace_finite_gue_covariance_integrand] at hh
  change (ζ • (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)-A₀)*gaussianFreeFiniteDysonResolvent (n := n) A₀ A ζ=
    1+_ at hh
  rw [hh,add_sub_cancel_right]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_of_matching_gaussian
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_of_matching_gaussian
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i,IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i,∀ᵐ A ∂ν i,A.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0≤R) (hBound : ∀ i,∀ᵐ A ∂ν i,specNorm A≤R)
    (hmeanν : ∀ i,∫ A : M,A ∂ν i=0)
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ,A.IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (hmean : (∫ A : M,A ∂ρ)=A₀)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b);ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) b);Measure.pi ν])
    (hd : 2≤Fintype.card n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0≤t)
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → ι → M) (G : Ω → M)
    (hS : HasLaw S (Measure.pi ν) μ) (hG : HasLaw G ρ μ) :
    let σ
proof:
:= Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i,∫ A : M,A^2 ∂ν i))
    let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearWeakVariance
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → M => A₀+∑ i,x i)))
    μ.real {ω | 80000000*(s*Real.sqrt t+R^(1/3 : ℝ)*σ^(2/3 : ℝ)*t^(2/3 : ℝ)+R*t) <
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,S ω i)) (spectrum ℝ (G ω))} ≤
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.exp (-t) := by
  let σ := Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i,∫ A : M,A^2 ∂ν i))
  let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearWeakVariance
    ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → M => A₀+∑ i,x i)))
  have hσ : 0≤σ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs : 0≤s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hvariance : specNorm (∑ i,∫ A : M,A^2 ∂ν i)≤σ^2 :=
    (Real.sq_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg _)).symm.le
  have hbilinear (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (ha : ‖a‖≤1) (hb : ‖b‖≤1) :
      (∑ i,∫ A : M,‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i)≤s^2 := by
    have hh := sum_integral_norm_sq_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance_shifted_sum
      ν (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hBound hmeanν A₀ a b ha hb
    simpa only [s,Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearWeakVariance_nonneg _)] using hh
  have hsumMean : (∫ x : ι → M,∑ i,x i ∂Measure.pi ν)=0 := by
    have hZi (i : ι) : Integrable (id : M → M) (ν i) :=
      Integrable.of_bound measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable R (hBound i)
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (f := fun i (x : ι → M) => x i) (fun i _ =>
      (measurePreserving_eval ν i).integrable_comp_of_integrable (hZi i))]
    simp only [integral_eval,hmeanν,Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hmean' : (∫ A : M,A ∂ρ)=A₀+∫ x : ι → M,∑ i,x i ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    simpa only [hsumMean,add_zero] using hmean
  have hh := measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_spectralScale_le ν hHerm hR hs hσ
    hBound hmeanν hvariance hbilinear ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean' hcov hd ht μ S G hS hG
  rw [independentSumSpectralScale_eq hR hσ ht] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.measureReal_two_sided_resolvent_comparison_failure_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_two_sided_resolvent_comparison_failure_le
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hmeanν : ∀ i, ∫ A : M, A ∂ν i = 0)
    (hbilinear : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ A : M, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ s^2)
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → ι → M) (G : Ω → M)
    (hS : HasLaw S (Measure.pi ν) μ) (hG : HasLaw G ρ μ)
 :
    μ.real {ω |
      9*specNorm (resolvent (G ω) ζ)+independentSumResolventError ν R s |ζ.im| p <
        specNorm (resolvent (A₀+∑ i, S ω i) ζ) ∨
      9*specNorm (resolvent (A₀+∑ i, S ω i) ζ)+independentSumResolventError ν R s |ζ.im| p <
        specNorm (resolvent (G ω) ζ)} ≤
        6*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have := hS.isProbabilityMeasure
  let F (x : ι → M) := specNorm (resolvent (A₀+∑ i, x i) ζ)
  let H (A : M) := specNorm (resolvent A ζ)
  let C := Real.exp 1*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^(1/((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let B := (2/|ζ.im|^4)*(8*s^2+64*R*
    ∫ x : ι → M, specNorm (∑ i, x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
    (32*R^2/|ζ.im|^6)*((Real.exp 1-1)*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)+
      R^2*Real.log (Fintype.card n))
  let c := Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))
  let aX := 4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p)+8*c*p
  let bX := Real.sqrt (24*B*p)+c*p
  let U := s*Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)/|ζ.im|^2
  let V := 4096*((p : ℝ)^2*R*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)+
    (p : ℝ)^3*R^3)/|ζ.im|^4
  let a := Real.sqrt (4*(s^2*(|ζ.im|⁻¹)^4)*p)
  let b := Real.sqrt (s^2*(|ζ.im|⁻¹)^4)*Real.sqrt (2*(p : ℝ))
  let K := aX+bX+V+4*U
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := Nat.cast_nonneg p
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := by
    have hQ := specNorm_nonneg (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)
    dsimp [V]
    positivity
  have haX : 0 ≤ aX := by dsimp [aX,c]; positivity
  have hbX : 0 ≤ bX := by dsimp [bX,c]; positivity
  have hU : 0 ≤ U := by dsimp [U]; positivity
  have hfl : a+b ≤ 4*U := by
    simpa only [a,b,U,mul_div_assoc,mul_assoc] using
      Real.gaussian_resolvent_moment_fluctuations_le hs hpR |ζ.im|
  have hC : C ≤ 9 := by
    dsimp [C]
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
    exact Real.exp_one_mul_rpow_inv_two_mul_le_nine_of_log_le
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hp) hlog
  have hbilinear' : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖=1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖=1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ A : M, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w)‖^2 ∂ν i) ≤ s^2 := by
    intro v w hv hw
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using
      hbilinear (WithLp.toLp 2 v) (WithLp.toLp 2 w) hv.le hw.le
  have hforward := measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_sum_gt_gaussian_le_of_bilinear_moments
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog hs
      hmeanν hbilinear' μ S G hS hG (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2*(p : ℝ)))
  change μ.real {ω | C*(H (G ω)+a+b+V)<F (S ω)} ≤
    Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))+2*Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (2*(p : ℝ)))^2/2) at hforward
  have hreverse := measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_gt_sum_le_of_bilinear_moments
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog
      hmeanν hbilinear μ S G hS hG hpR
  change μ.real {ω | C*(F (S ω)+aX+bX+V)<H (G ω)} ≤
    Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))+2*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ)) at hreverse
  have hprob : Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))+2*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ)) ≤
      3*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ)) := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hh := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show -(2*(p : ℝ)) ≤ -(p : ℝ) by linarith)
    linarith only [hh]
  have hprobF : Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))+2*Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (2*(p : ℝ)))^2/2) ≤
      3*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(p : ℝ))]
    simpa only [show -(2*(p : ℝ))/2 = -(p : ℝ) by ring] using hprob
  have hthresholdF (ω : Ω) : C*(H (G ω)+a+b+V) ≤ 9*H (G ω)+9*K := by
    have hH : 0 ≤ H (G ω) := specNorm_nonneg _
    have hi : 0 ≤ H (G ω)+a+b+V := by dsimp [a,b]; positivity
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hi
    dsimp only [K]
    linear_combination hh+9*hfl+9*haX+9*hbX
  have hthresholdR (ω : Ω) : C*(F (S ω)+aX+bX+V) ≤ 9*F (S ω)+9*K := by
    have hF : 0 ≤ F (S ω) := specNorm_nonneg _
    have hi : 0 ≤ F (S ω)+aX+bX+V := add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg hF haX) hbX) hV
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hi
    dsimp only [K]
    linear_combination hh+36*hU
  have hsub : {ω | 9*H (G ω)+9*K<F (S ω) ∨ 9*F (S ω)+9*K<H (G ω)} ⊆
      {ω | C*(H (G ω)+a+b+V)<F (S ω)} ∪
        {ω | C*(F (S ω)+aX+bX+V)<H (G ω)} := by
    intro ω hω
    rcases hω with hω | hω
    · exact Or.inl (lt_of_le_of_lt (hthresholdF ω) hω)
    · exact Or.inr (lt_of_le_of_lt (hthresholdR ω) hω)
  have htotal := (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hsub).trans
    ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hforward.trans hprobF) (hreverse.trans hprob)))
  rw [show 3*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ))+3*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ)) =
    6*Real.exp (-(p : ℝ)) by ring] at htotal
  simpa only [independentSumResolventError,K,aX,bX,B,c,U,V,F,H,
    add_assoc,mul_div_assoc,mul_assoc] using htotal

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_gt_sum_le_of_bilinear_moments
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_gt_sum_le_of_bilinear_moments
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    {v : ℝ}
    (hmeanν : ∀ i, ∫ A : M, A ∂ν i = 0)
    (hbilinear : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ A : M, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v)
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → ι → M) (G : Ω → M)
    (hS : HasLaw S (Measure.pi ν) μ) (hG : HasLaw G ρ μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    let B
proof:
:= (2/|ζ.im|^4)*(8*v+64*R*
      ∫ x : ι → M, specNorm (∑ i, x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
      (32*R^2/|ζ.im|^6)*((Real.exp 1-1)*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)+
        R^2*Real.log (Fintype.card n))
    let c := Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))
    μ.real {ω |
      Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, S ω i) ζ) +
          (4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p)+8*c*p) + (Real.sqrt (24*B*t)+c*t) +
          4096*((p : ℝ)^2*R*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)+
            (p : ℝ)^3*R^3)/|ζ.im|^4) < specNorm (resolvent (G ω) ζ)} ≤
      Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) + 2*Real.exp (-t) := by
  have := hS.isProbabilityMeasure
  let F (x : ι → M) := specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ)
  let H (A : M) := specNorm (resolvent A ζ)
  let C := Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let m := ∫ x, F x ∂Measure.pi ν
  let B := (2/|ζ.im|^4)*(8*v+64*R*
    ∫ x : ι → M, specNorm (∑ i, x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
    (32*R^2/|ζ.im|^6)*((Real.exp 1-1)*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)+
      R^2*Real.log (Fintype.card n))
  let c := Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))
  let a := 4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p)+8*c*p
  let b := Real.sqrt (24*B*t)+c*t
  let e := 4096*((p : ℝ)^2*R*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i)+
    (p : ℝ)^3*R^3)/|ζ.im|^4
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have hLp := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_le_pi
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog
  have hXmom := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_integral_add_of_bilinear_moments
    ν A₀ hA₀ (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hR hHerm hBound
      hmeanν hbilinear ζ hζ hp
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hXmom
  have htailG : μ.real {ω | C*(m+a+e) < H (G ω)} ≤ Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hG.measureReal_eq (p := fun A => C*(m+a+e) < H A)]
    · have hmem := memLp_specNorm_resolvent ρ id aemeasurable_id hρHerm hζ
        ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)
      have hmarkov := measureReal_lt_exp_mul_lpNorm_le_exp_neg
        (Nat.mul_pos (by decide : 0 < 2) hp) hmem
      apply (measureReal_mono (μ := ρ) (fun A hA => ?_)).trans hmarkov
      change Real.exp 1 * lpNorm H ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ρ < ‖H A‖
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
      have htotal := hLp.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (add_le_add hXmom le_rfl) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
      have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htotal (Real.exp_pos 1).le
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at *
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa only [mul_assoc, add_assoc, F, H, C, m, a, B, c, e,
        Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using he) hA
    · apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      change Measurable (fun A : M => ‖resolvent A ζ‖)
      exact (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).norm
  have htailX : μ.real {ω | b < |F (S ω)-m|} ≤ 2*Real.exp (-t) := by
    rw [hS.measureReal_eq (p := fun x => b < |F x-m|)]
    · exact measureReal_gt_abs_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_of_bilinear_moments
        ν A₀ hA₀ (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hR hHerm hBound
          hmeanν hbilinear ζ hζ ht
    · apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      apply Measurable.abs
      apply Measurable.sub _ measurable_const
      change Measurable (fun x : ι → M => ‖resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ‖)
      exact ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp (by fun_prop)).norm
  have hs : {ω | C*(F (S ω)+a+b+e) < H (G ω)} ⊆
      {ω | C*(m+a+e) < H (G ω)} ∪ {ω | b < |F (S ω)-m|} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_cases hg : C*(m+a+e) < H (G ω)
    · exact Or.inl hg
    · right
      by_contra hx
      change ¬ b < |F (S ω)-m| at hx
      have hxm : m ≤ F (S ω)+b := by
        have hab := neg_le_abs (F (S ω)-m)
        have hh := le_of_not_gt hx
        linarith
      have hmul : C*(m+a+e) ≤ C*(F (S ω)+a+b+e) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hC
      change C*(F (S ω)+a+b+e) < H (G ω) at hω
      exact (not_lt.mpr ((le_of_not_gt hg).trans hmul)) hω
  exact (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hs).trans
    ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add htailG htailX))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_sum_gt_gaussian_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_sum_gt_gaussian_le_of_hasLaw
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((Z - ∫ H, H ∂ρ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → ι → M) (G : Ω → M)
    (hS : HasLaw S (Measure.pi ν) μ) (hG : HasLaw G ρ μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω |
      Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (specNorm (resolvent (G ω) ζ) +
          Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p) +
          Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * t +
          4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
            (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / |ζ.im| ^ 4) <
        specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, S ω i) ζ)} ≤
      Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) + 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have := hS.isProbabilityMeasure
  let F (x : ι → M) := specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ)
  let H (A : M) := specNorm (resolvent A ζ)
  let C := Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let m := ∫ A, H A ∂ρ
  let c := σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4
  let a := Real.sqrt (4*c*p)
  let b := Real.sqrt c * t
  let e := 4096 * ((p : ℝ)^2*R*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A^2 ∂ν i) +
    (p : ℝ)^3*R^3) / |ζ.im|^4
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
