  have htailX : μ.real {ω | C*(m+a+e) < F (S ω)} ≤ Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hS.measureReal_eq (p := fun x => C*(m+a+e) < F x)]
    · exact measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_pi_gt_gaussian_mean_le
        ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog hσ hbilinear
    · apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      change Measurable (fun x : ι → M => ‖resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ‖)
      exact ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp (by fun_prop)).norm
  have hsg : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => H (G ω)-m) ⟨c, by positivity⟩ μ := by
    have hg : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun A => H A-m) ⟨c, by positivity⟩ (μ.map G) := by
      rw [hG.map_eq]
      exact hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_of_centered_bilinear_moment
        ρ hρHerm hσ hbilinear ζ hζ
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using HasSubgaussianMGF.of_map hG.aemeasurable hg
  have htailG : μ.real {ω | b < |H (G ω)-m|} ≤ 2*Real.exp (-t^2/2) :=
    measureReal_sqrt_mul_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF hsg ht
  have hs : {ω | C*(H (G ω)+a+b+e) < F (S ω)} ⊆
      {ω | C*(m+a+e) < F (S ω)} ∪ {ω | b < |H (G ω)-m|} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_cases hx : C*(m+a+e) < F (S ω)
    · exact Or.inl hx
    · right
      by_contra hg
      change ¬ b < |H (G ω)-m| at hg
      have hgm : m ≤ H (G ω)+b := by
        have hab := neg_le_abs (H (G ω)-m)
        have hh := le_of_not_gt hg
        linarith
      have hmul : C*(m+a+e) ≤ C*(H (G ω)+a+b+e) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hC
      change C*(H (G ω)+a+b+e) < F (S ω) at hω
      exact (not_lt.mpr ((le_of_not_gt hx).trans hmul)) hω
  exact (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hs).trans
    ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add htailX htailG))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_sum_gt_gaussian_le_of_bilinear_moments
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_sum_gt_gaussian_le_of_bilinear_moments
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
  (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
  (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
  (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
  (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
  (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
    cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
    cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
  (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
  (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hmeanν : ∀ i, ∫ A : M, A ∂ν i = 0)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ A : M, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → ι → M) (G : Ω → M)
    (hS : HasLaw S (Measure.pi ν) μ) (hG : HasLaw G ρ μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω |
      Real.exp 1 * (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (specNorm (resolvent (G ω) ζ) +
          Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p) +
          Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * t +
          4096 * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2 * R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
            (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * R ^ 3) / |ζ.im| ^ 4) <
        specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, S ω i) ζ)} ≤
      Real.exp (-((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ)) + 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hproxy : ∀ v w : n → ℂ,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
        (∫ A : M, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B, B ∂ρ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) ≤ σ ^ 2 := by
    intro v w hv hw
    have he := integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_sum_of_covariance_eq
      ν (fun _ (A : M) => A) (fun _ => measurable_id) hBound hmeanν
      ρ IsGaussian.memLp_two_id hcov v w
    exact he.trans_le (hbilinear v w hv hw)
  exact measureReal_specNorm_resolvent_sum_gt_gaussian_le_of_hasLaw
    ν hHerm hR hBound ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean hcov ζ hζ hp hlog hσ hproxy μ S G hS hG ht

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_hermitianCoordinateResolvent
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_hermitianCoordinateResolvent
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    let Y₀ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
    let Y₁ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2
    let Y₂ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2
    let d := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
    let R := fun y => hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ y
    HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ))
      (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) •
          (∫ q, R (Y₀ q) * d q * R (Y₀ q) - R (Y₁ q) * d q * R (Y₁ q)
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) -
        ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) •
          ∫ q, (2 : ℝ) • (R (Y₂ q) * d q * R (Y₂ q) * d q * R (Y₂ q))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) t := by
  let B : E →L[ℝ] (J → M) →L[ℝ] M := hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing
  have hΦ (y : E) : HasFDerivAt (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ)
      (B.flip (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ y)) y := by
    have he : B.flip (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ y) =
        hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv A ζ y := by
      ext u i j
      exact congrArg (fun C : M => C i j)
        (hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficients A ζ y u)
    rw [he]
    exact hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A hA ζ hζ y
  have h := hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_matrix ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov
    (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ) (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ)
    (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A ζ) B hΦ
    (hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A hA ζ hζ)
    (continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A hA ζ hζ)
    |ζ.im|⁻¹ (|ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖L‖) (2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 3 * ‖L‖ ^ 2)
    (specNorm_hermitianCoordinateResolvent_le A hA ζ hζ)
    (norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients_le A hA ζ hζ)
    (norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv_le A hA ζ hζ) ht ht1
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  simpa only [B, hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_sub_coefficients,
    hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficientsDeriv,
    hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_apply,
    two_smul] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_resolventCubicRemainder
statement:
theorem integrable_and_hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_resolventCubicRemainder
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let P
proof:
:= resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let Q := P.prod γ
    let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂P
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1-t)
    let Y₀ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
    let d := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
    let f := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
      L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1)
    let H := fun q => resolventCubicRemainder (A+L (Y₀ q)) (d q) (f q) a ζ
    Integrable H Q ∧
      HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ))
        (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*a/4) • ∫ q, H q ∂Q) t := by
  have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let Q := P.prod γ
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂P
  let a := Real.sqrt t
  let b := Real.sqrt (1-t)
  let Y₀ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
  let Y₁ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2
  let Y₂ := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2
  let d := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
    L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
  let f := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E =>
    L (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1)
  let R := hermitianCoordinateResolvent A ζ
  let H := fun q => resolventCubicRemainder (A+L (Y₀ q)) (d q) (f q) a ζ
  let V := fun q => R (Y₀ q)*d q*R (Y₀ q)-R (Y₁ q)*d q*R (Y₁ q)
  let K := fun q => (2 : ℝ) • (R (Y₂ q)*d q*R (Y₂ q)*d q*R (Y₂ q))
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
  let B : E →L[ℝ] (J → M) →L[ℝ] M := hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing
  let e (i j : n) : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    ((Matrix.entryLinearMap ℂ ℂ i j).toContinuousLinearMap).restrictScalars ℝ
  let Be (i j : n) : E →L[ℝ] (J → M) →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (J → M) M ℂ (e i j)).comp B
  have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht
  have hV : Integrable V Q := by
    apply Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    have hi := (integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine (F := J → M) ν hν γ a b
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A ζ)
      (continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients A hA ζ hζ)
      (|ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖L‖) (norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficients_le A hA ζ hζ)
      (Be i j)).2
    simpa only [V, R, d, Be, B, e, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_sub_coefficients,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
      Matrix.entryLinearMap_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventDeriv_apply,
      Matrix.sub_apply] using hi
  have hK : Integrable K Q := by
    apply Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    have hi := integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine (κ := J) (F := J → M) ν hν γ μ a b
      (hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A ζ)
      (continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv A hA ζ hζ)
      (2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 3 * ‖L‖ ^ 2)
      (norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventCoefficientsDeriv_le A hA ζ hζ) (Be i j)
    simpa only [K, R, d, Y₂, resamplingAffinePoint, Q, P, Be, B, e, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, hermitianCoordinateCoefficientPairing_coefficientsDeriv,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap',
      Matrix.entryLinearMap_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventSecondDeriv_apply,
      two_smul, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply] using hi
  have hp (q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E) :
      V q = a • K q + a^2 • H q := by
    have h₀₁ : A+L (Y₀ q)-a • d q = A+L (Y₁ q) := by
      have hy : Y₀ q-Y₁ q =
          a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleFirst q.1) := by
        dsimp [Y₀, Y₁, resamplingAffinePoint]
        module
      have hl : L (Y₀ q)-L (Y₁ q) = a • d q := by
        rw [← map_sub, hy, map_smul]
      rw [← hl]
      abel
    have h₀₂ : A+L (Y₀ q)-a • f q = A+L (Y₂ q) := by
      have hy : Y₀ q-Y₂ q =
          a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1) := by
        dsimp [Y₀, Y₂, resamplingAffinePoint]
        module
      have hl : L (Y₀ q)-L (Y₂ q) = a • f q := by
        rw [← map_sub, hy, map_smul]
      rw [← hl]
      abel
    have hh := resolvent_mul_resolvent_sub_eq_smul_add_smul_sq
      (A+L (Y₀ q)) (d q) (f q) a ζ
      (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _))
      (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _)
      (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _) hζ
    dsimp only at hh
    rw [h₀₁, h₀₂] at hh
    exact hh
  have hH : Integrable H Q := by
    have hi := (hV.sub (hK.smul a)).smul ((a^2)⁻¹)
    refine hi.congr (ae_of_all _ fun q => ?_)
    change (a^2)⁻¹ • (V q-a • K q) = H q
    rw [hp, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 ha.ne'), one_smul]
  refine ⟨hH, ?_⟩
  have hfirst : (∫ q, V q ∂Q) = a • (∫ q, K q ∂Q)+a^2 • ∫ q, H q ∂Q := by
    simp_rw [hp]
    have hKa : Integrable (fun q => a • K q) Q := by
      exact (hK.smul a).congr (ae_of_all _ fun q => rfl)
    have hHa : Integrable (fun q => a^2 • H q) Q := by
      exact (hH.smul (a^2)).congr (ae_of_all _ fun q => rfl)
    rw [integral_add hKa hHa]
    simp only [integral_smul]
  have hd := hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_hermitianCoordinateResolvent ν hν γ hγ
    hmean hcov A hA ζ hζ ht ht1
  change HasDerivAt _ ((N/(4*a)) • (∫ q, V q ∂Q)-(N/4) • ∫ q, K q ∂Q) t at hd
  apply hd.congr_deriv
  rw [hfirst, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  have hca : N/(4*a)*a = N/4 := by field_simp [ha.ne']
  have hcb : N/(4*a)*a^2 = N*a/4 := by field_simp [ha.ne']
  rw [hca, hcb]
  abel

name: NLAlib.measurable_normalizedTrace_resolvent
statement:
private theorem measurable_normalizedTrace_resolvent (ζ : ℂ) :
    Measurable (fun A : M => normalizedTrace (resolvent A ζ))
proof:
:= by
  have htr : Measurable (normalizedTrace : M → ℂ) :=
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_id.matrix_trace).measurable
  exact htr.comp (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ)

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_resolvent_eq_of_indepFun_hasLaw
statement:
private theorem integral_sum_resolvent_eq_of_indepFun_hasLaw
    (ν : ι → Measure M) (X : ι → Ω → M)
    (hX : ∀ i, HasLaw (X i) (ν i) P) (hXi : iIndepFun X P) (ζ : ℂ) :
    (∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, X i ω) ζ) ∂P) =
      ∫ x : ι → M, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, x i) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : ι → M => normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, x i) ζ)) :=
    (measurable_normalizedTrace_resolvent ζ).comp (by fun_prop)
  exact (hXi.hasLaw_pi hX).integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.integral_resolvent_eq_of_hasLaw
statement:
private theorem integral_resolvent_eq_of_hasLaw
    (ρ : Measure M) (G : Ω' → M) (hG : HasLaw G ρ P') (ζ : ℂ) :
    (∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (G ω) ζ) ∂P') =
      ∫ A : M, normalizedTrace (resolvent A ζ) ∂ρ
proof:
:=
  hG.integral_comp (measurable_normalizedTrace_resolvent ζ).aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_of_hasLaw
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i))
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
    (X : ι → Ω → M) (hX : ∀ i, HasLaw (X i) (ν i) P) (hXi : iIndepFun X P)
    (G : Ω' → M) (hG : HasLaw G ρ P') (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖(∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, X i ω) ζ) ∂P) -
      ∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (G ω) ζ) ∂P'‖ ≤
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment ν / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sum_resolvent_eq_of_indepFun_hasLaw ν X hX hXi ζ,
    integral_resolvent_eq_of_hasLaw ρ G hG ζ]
  exact norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
    ν hν hHerm ρ hρ hρHerm hmean hcov ζ hζ

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance_of_hasLaw
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm (A - ∫ B : M, B ∂ν i) ≤ L)
    (X : ι → Ω → M) (hX : ∀ i, HasLaw (X i) (ν i) P) (hXi : iIndepFun X P)
    (G : Ω' → M) (hG : HasLaw G ρ P') (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖(∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, X i ω) ζ) ∂P) -
      ∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (G ω) ζ) ∂P'‖ ≤
      (4 * L * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, (A - ∫ B : M, B ∂ν i)^2 ∂ν i)) / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sum_resolvent_eq_of_indepFun_hasLaw ν X hX hXi ζ,
    integral_resolvent_eq_of_hasLaw ρ G hG ζ]
  exact norm_integral_normalizedTrace_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance
    ν hHerm ρ hρ hρHerm hmean hcov hL hbound ζ hζ

name: NLAlib.measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_sum_gaussian_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_sum_gaussian_gt_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : ι → Ω → M) (hZm : ∀ i,Measurable (Z i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Z μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i,∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,(Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0≤R) (hBound : ∀ i,∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,specNorm (Z i ω)≤R)
    (hmeanZ : ∀ i,∫ ω,Z i ω ∂μ=0)
    (G : Ω → M) (hGaussian : HasGaussianLaw G μ)
    (hGHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,(G ω).IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (hmean : (∫ ω,G ω ∂μ)=A₀)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : J,
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) a),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) b);μ] =
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀+∑ i,Z i ω) a),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀+∑ i,Z i ω) b);μ])
    (hd : 2≤Fintype.card n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0≤t) :
    let σ
proof:
:= Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i,∫ ω,Z i ω^2 ∂μ))
    let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearWeakVariance (μ.map (fun ω => A₀+∑ i,Z i ω)))
    μ.real {ω | 80000000*(s*Real.sqrt t+R^(1/3 : ℝ)*σ^(2/3 : ℝ)*t^(2/3 : ℝ)+R*t) <
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,Z i ω)) (spectrum ℝ (G ω))} ≤
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.exp (-t) := by
  let ν (i : ι) := μ.map (Z i)
  let hZ (i : ι) : HasLaw (Z i) (ν i) μ := ⟨(hZm i).aemeasurable,rfl⟩
  let (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) := (hZ i).isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hPi : HasLaw (fun ω i => Z i ω) (Measure.pi ν) μ := hIndep.hasLaw_pi hZ
  let ρ := μ.map G
  let : IsGaussian ρ := hGaussian.isGaussian_map
  have hG : HasLaw G ρ μ := ⟨hGaussian.aemeasurable,rfl⟩
  have hHset : MeasurableSet {A : M | A.IsHermitian} := by
    change MeasurableSet {A : M | Aᴴ=A}
    exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : M => Aᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hνHerm (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i,A.IsHermitian := by
    rw [← (hZ i).map_eq]
    exact (ae_map_iff (hZ i).aemeasurable hHset).mpr (hHerm i)
  have hνBound (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i,specNorm A≤R := by
    rw [← (hZ i).map_eq]
    exact (ae_map_iff (hZ i).aemeasurable (by
      change MeasurableSet {A : M | ‖A‖≤R}
      exact measurableSet_le measurable_id.norm measurable_const)).mpr (hBound i)
  have hνMean (i : ι) : (∫ A : M,A ∂ν i)=0 := by
    rw [← (hZ i).integral_eq,hmeanZ]
  have hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ,A.IsHermitian := by
    rw [← hG.map_eq]
    exact (ae_map_iff hG.aemeasurable hHset).mpr hGHerm
  have hρMean : (∫ A : M,A ∂ρ)=A₀ := by rw [← hG.integral_eq,hmean]
  have hνInt (i : ι) : Integrable (id : M → M) (ν i) :=
    Integrable.of_bound aestronglyMeasurable_id R (hνBound i)
  have hSumInt : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => ∑ i,x i) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_eval (μ:=ν) (i:=i) (hνInt i))
  have hShiftM : Measurable (fun x : ι → M => A₀+∑ i,x i) := by fun_prop
  have hCoordsInt : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i))
      (Measure.pi ν) :=
    matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hSumInt
  have hScalarInt (a : J) : Integrable
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) a) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R:=ℝ) (φ:=fun _ : J => ℝ) a).integrable_comp hCoordsInt
  have hCovProd (a b : J) :
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b);ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i,x i) b);Measure.pi ν] := by
    have hca : Measurable (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a) :=
      (measurable_pi_apply a).comp measurable_matrixRealCoordinates
    have hcb : Measurable (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b) :=
      (measurable_pi_apply b).comp measurable_matrixRealCoordinates
    calc
      _ = cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) a),
          (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (G ω) b);μ] :=
        (hG.covariance_fun_comp hca.aemeasurable hcb.aemeasurable).symm
      _ = cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀+∑ i,Z i ω) a),
          (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀+∑ i,Z i ω) b);μ] := hcov a b
      _ = cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀+∑ i,x i) a),
          (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (A₀+∑ i,x i) b);Measure.pi ν] :=
        hPi.covariance_fun_comp (hca.comp hShiftM).aemeasurable (hcb.comp hShiftM).aemeasurable
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [map_add,Pi.add_apply]
        rw [covariance_const_add_left (hScalarInt a),covariance_const_add_right (hScalarInt b)]
  have hSqMeas : Measurable (fun A : M => A^2) := by
    simpa only [pow_two,id_eq] using
      (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_id : Measurable (fun A : M => A*A))
  have hνSq (i : ι) : Integrable (fun A : M => A^2) (ν i) := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound hSqMeas.aestronglyMeasurable (R^2) ?_
    filter_upwards [hνBound i] with A hA
    exact (norm_pow_le' A (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ)<2)).trans
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg A) hA 2)
  have hSq : (∑ i,∫ ω,Z i ω^2 ∂μ)=∑ i,∫ A : M,A^2 ∂ν i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact (hZ i).integral_comp (hνSq i).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hShiftLaw : HasLaw (fun ω => A₀+∑ i,Z i ω)
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → M => A₀+∑ i,x i)) μ :=
    (show HasLaw (fun x : ι → M => A₀+∑ i,x i)
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → M => A₀+∑ i,x i)) (Measure.pi ν) from
        ⟨hShiftM.aemeasurable,rfl⟩).fun_comp hPi
  have hh := measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_of_matching_gaussian
    ν hνHerm hR hνBound hνMean ρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hρMean hCovProd hd ht μ
      (fun ω i => Z i ω) G hPi hG
  rw [← hSq,← hShiftLaw.map_eq] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.blockDiagonal_resolvent
statement:
private theorem blockDiagonal_resolvent (T : n → D) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hζ : ∀ a, ζ ∈ resolventSet ℂ (T a)) :
    resolvent (Matrix.blockDiagonal T) ζ =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun a => resolvent (T a) ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ζ ∈ resolventSet ℂ T := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ (n → D) ζ - T)
    exact Pi.isUnit_iff.mpr hζ
  have he : resolvent T ζ = fun a => resolvent (T a) ζ := by
    funext a
    exact (Pi.evalAlgHom ℂ (fun _ : n => D) a).map_resolvent hu
  have hm := (blockDiagonalAlgHom (n := n) (d := d)).map_resolvent hu
  change Matrix.blockDiagonal (resolvent T ζ) = resolvent (Matrix.blockDiagonal T) ζ at hm
  rw [he] at hm
  exact hm.symm

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_one_eq_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_one_eq_blockDiagonal
    (A₀ : D) (A : ι → D) (x : E) :
    gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 1 x =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun a : n => A₀ + ∑ i, x (.inl (i, a)) • A i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_eq_diagonal_add_gue]
  simp only [Real.sqrt_one, sub_self, Real.sqrt_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
  ext ab ce
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul]
  by_cases h : ab.2 = ce.2
  · simp [h, mul_comm]
  · simp [h]

name: NLAlib.normalizedTrace_blockDiagonal
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedTrace, Matrix.trace_blockDiagonal, Fintype.card_prod,
    Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: NLAlib.blockDiagonal_resolvent_word
statement:
private theorem blockDiagonal_resolvent_word (T : n → D)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ a j, ζ j ∈ resolventSet ℂ (T a)) :
    (List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (Matrix.blockDiagonal T) (ζ j))).prod =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun a => (List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (T a) (ζ j))).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    simp only [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil]
    exact Matrix.blockDiagonal_one.symm
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons]
    rw [blockDiagonal_resolvent T (ζ 0) (fun a => hζ a 0),
      ih (fun j => ζ j.succ) (fun a j => hζ a j.succ), ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]

name: NLAlib.continuous_original_resolvent_word
statement:
private theorem continuous_original_resolvent_word
    (A₀ : D) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → D) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ =>
      (List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) (ζ j))).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ι → ℝ => (1 : D)))
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons]
    apply Continuous.mul _ (ih (Fin.tail ζ) (fun j => hζ j.succ))
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro x
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun y : ι → ℝ => A₀ + ∑ i, y i • A i) x := by
      apply Continuous.continuousAt
      apply continuous_const.add
      exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (continuous_apply i).smul continuous_const
    exact (hasFDerivAt_resolvent_of_isHermitian (ζ 0) _
      (hA₀.add (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x)) (hζ 0)).continuousAt.comp
      (f := fun y : ι → ℝ => A₀ + ∑ i, y i • A i)
      hcont

name: NLAlib.norm_original_resolvent_word_le
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa only [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil, Fin.prod_univ_zero,
      ← specNorm_eq_norm] using (specNorm_one_le (n := d) (𝕜 := ℂ))
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul
      (by simpa only [← specNorm_eq_norm] using hT.specNorm_resolvent_le (hζ 0))
      (ih (Fin.tail ζ) (fun j => hζ j.succ)) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))

name: NLAlib.integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_one
statement:
theorem integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_one
    [Nonempty n] (A₀ : D) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → D) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {m : ℕ} (ζ : Fin m → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ j, (ζ j).im ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x : E, normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A 1 ζ x)
      ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)) =
      ∫ x : ι → ℝ, normalizedTrace
        ((List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) (ζ j))).prod)
        ∂gaussianVector ι
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)
  let F : (ι → ℝ) → ℂ := fun x => normalizedTrace
    ((List.ofFn (fun j => resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) (ζ j))).prod)
  let L : D →L[ℂ] ℂ := (normalizedTraceLinearMap : D →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hFc : Continuous F := L.continuous.comp
    (continuous_original_resolvent_word A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ)
  have hFi : Integrable F (gaussianVector ι) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hFc.aestronglyMeasurable (∏ j, |(ζ j).im|⁻¹)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
        (norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm _).trans (by
          simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_original_resolvent_word_le _
            (hA₀.add (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x)) ζ hζ))
  have hsel (a : n) : HasLaw (fun x : E => fun i => x (.inl (i, a)))
      (gaussianVector ι) μ :=
    hasLaw_pi_select (fun _ : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (fun i : ι => Sum.inl (i, a)) (by intro i j h; exact Prod.mk.inj (Sum.inl.inj h) |>.1)
  have hInt (a : n) : (∫ x : E, F (fun i => x (.inl (i, a))) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x : ι → ℝ, F x ∂gaussianVector ι :=
    (hsel a).integral_comp hFc.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hI (a : n) : Integrable (fun x : E => F (fun i => x (.inl (i, a)))) μ :=
    (hsel a).measurePreserving (by fun_prop) |>.integrable_comp_of_integrable hFi
  have he (x : E) : normalizedTrace (gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A 1 ζ x) =
      (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ a : n, F (fun i => x (.inl (i, a))) := by
    unfold gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord
    rw [gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_one_eq_blockDiagonal,
      blockDiagonal_resolvent_word, normalizedTrace_blockDiagonal]
    intro a j
    change IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ D (ζ j) - (A₀ + ∑ i, x (.inl (i, a)) • A i))
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
      (hA₀.add (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA _)).isUnit_smul_one_sub_of_im_ne_zero (hζ j)
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => hI a)]
  simp only [hInt, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean_star
statement:
theorem gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean_star
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    normalizedPartialTrace
      (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ,
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) (star z)^k
          ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n))=
      (normalizedPartialTrace
        (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ,
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^k
            ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)))ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalizedPartialTrace_conjTranspose,← Matrix.integral_conjTranspose]
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro x
  dsimp only
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_pow]
  have hr := star_resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z
  rw [show star (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x)=
    gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x from
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x).eq] at hr
  exact congrArg (fun T => T^k) hr.symm

name: NLAlib.tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean
statement:
theorem tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => normalizedPartialTrace
        (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^(k+1)
            ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))))
      atTop (𝓝 (wordMatrixVacuumCompression
        (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^(k+1))))
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hzneg|hzpos
  · have hstar : 0<(star z).im := by simpa only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im] using neg_pos.mpr hzneg
    have ht := ((tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean
      A₀ hA₀ A hA k).tendsto_at hstar).star
    simp only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      ← gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean_star A₀ hA₀ A hA (k+1) (star z),star_star] at ht
    have hr := star_resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) (star z)
    rw [(isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).star_eq,star_star] at hr
    rw [← wordMatrixVacuumCompression_star,star_pow,hr] at ht
    exact ht
  · exact (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean A₀ hA₀ A hA k).tendsto_at hzpos

name: NLAlib.tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventMixedMean
statement:
theorem tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventMixedMean
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (hw : w.im≠0) (hzw : z≠w)
    (p q : ℕ) (hpq : 0<p+q) :
    Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => normalizedPartialTrace
        (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^p*
            resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) w^q
            ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))))
      atTop (𝓝 (wordMatrixVacuumCompression
        (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^p*
          resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) w^q)))
proof:
:= by
  let X := fun (N : ℕ) (x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ) =>
    (⟨gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x,
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x⟩ :
        selfAdjoint (Matrix (d×Fin (N+1)) (d×Fin (N+1)) ℂ))
  have hXm (N : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (X N)
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))) := by
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.aestronglyMeasurable_comp_iff.mp
    change AEStronglyMeasurable (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0) _
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
    fun_prop
  have hzlim (k : ℕ) : Tendsto
      (fun N => resolventPowerMean
        (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))))
        (X N) (normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := Fin (N+1))) (k+1) z)
      atTop (𝓝 (wordMatrixVacuumCompressionCLM
        (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^(k+1)))) := by
    unfold resolventPowerMean
    exact tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean A₀ hA₀ A hA hz k
  have hwlim (k : ℕ) : Tendsto
      (fun N => resolventPowerMean
        (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))))
        (X N) (normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := Fin (N+1))) (k+1) w)
      atTop (𝓝 (wordMatrixVacuumCompressionCLM
        (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) w^(k+1)))) := by
    unfold resolventPowerMean
    exact tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventPowerMean A₀ hA₀ A hA hw k
  have hh := tendsto_resolventMixedMean_of_powers
    (fun N => gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))) X hXm
    (fun N => normalizedPartialTraceCLM (d := d) (n := Fin (N+1)))
    (⟨wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A,isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA⟩)
    (wordMatrixVacuumCompressionCLM (D := d) (ι := ι)) atTop hz hw hzw hzlim hwlim p q hpq
  unfold resolventMixedMean at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.tendsto_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_resolvent_mixed_powers
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_resolvent_mixed_powers
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (hw : w.im≠0) (hzw : z≠w)
    (p q : ℕ) (hpq : 0<p+q) :
    Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => ∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
          normalizedTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^p*
            resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) w^q)
            ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))))
      atTop (𝓝 (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation
        (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^p*
          resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) w^q)))
proof:
:= by
  let L : C →L[ℂ] ℂ := normalizedTraceLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  have ht := L.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (tendsto_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventMixedMean A₀ hA₀ A hA hz hw hzw p q hpq)
  have he (N : ℕ) : L (normalizedPartialTrace
      (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^p*
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) w^q
          ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))))=
      ∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
        normalizedTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^p*
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) w^q)
          ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))) := by
    change normalizedTrace (normalizedPartialTrace _) = _
    rw [normalizedTrace_normalizedPartialTrace]
    have hi := integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_mixed_powers
      (μ := gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))))
      (fun x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ =>
        (⟨gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x,
          gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x⟩ :
            selfAdjoint (Matrix (d×Fin (N+1)) (d×Fin (N+1)) ℂ)))
      (by
        apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.aestronglyMeasurable_comp_iff.mp
        apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        change Continuous (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0)
        unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
        fun_prop) hz hw p q
    exact ((normalizedTraceLinearMap (n := d×Fin (N+1)) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm hi).symm
  dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at ht
  simp_rw [he] at ht
  exact ht

name: NLAlib.integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_mixedTrace
statement:
private theorem integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_mixedTrace
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (hw : w.im≠0) (p q : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ =>
      normalizedTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^p*
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) w^q))
      (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n))
proof:
:= by
  let X : (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n → ℝ) →
      selfAdjoint (Matrix (d×n) (d×n) ℂ) := fun x =>
    ⟨gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x,
      gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x⟩
  have hXm : AEStronglyMeasurable X (gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι n)) := by
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.aestronglyMeasurable_comp_iff.mp
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    change Continuous (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0)
    unfold gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation
    fun_prop
  have hi := integrable_resolvent_selfAdjoint_mixed_powers X hXm hz hw p q
  exact (normalizedTraceLinearMap (n := d×n) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hi

name: NLAlib.tendsto_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment
    (A₀ : C) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (A : ι → C) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0<p) :
    Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => ∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
        resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z p
          ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))))
      atTop (𝓝 ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation
        ((star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)*
          resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)^p)).re))
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : (star z).im≠0 := by simpa only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im,neg_ne_zero] using hz
  have hzw : z≠star z := by
    intro he
    have hi := congrArg Complex.im he
    simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im] at hi
    exact hz (by linarith)
  have ht := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (tendsto_integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFinite_resolvent_mixed_powers
      A₀ hA₀ A hA hz hstar hzw p p (by omega))
  have he (N : ℕ) :
      (∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
        normalizedTrace (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z^p*
          resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) (star z)^p)
          ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)))).re=
      ∫ x : GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1)) → ℝ,
        resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 0 x) z p
          ∂gaussianVector (GaussianFreeFiniteCoordinate ι (Fin (N+1))) := by
    have hi := (integral_re (integrable_gaussianFreeFinite_mixedTrace
      (n := Fin (N+1)) A₀ hA₀ A hA hz hstar p p)).symm
    simp only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] at hi
    rw [hi]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    exact (resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
      (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation_isHermitian A₀ hA₀ A hA 0 x) z p).symm
  dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at ht
  simp_rw [he] at ht
  have hr := star_resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z
  rw [(isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).star_eq] at hr
  have heq : (star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)*
      resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)^p=
      resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z^p*
        resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) (star z)^p := by
    rw [hr,(commute_resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) (star z) z).mul_pow]
    exact ((commute_resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) (star z) z).pow_pow p p).eq
  rwa [heq]

name: NLAlib.mixed_constant_resolventWord_prod
statement:
private theorem mixed_constant_resolventWord_prod
    {v : Type*} [Fintype v] [DecidableEq v]
    (Y : Matrix v v ℂ) (ζ : ℂ) (p : ℕ) :
    (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (p + p) => resolvent Y
      ((Fin.append (fun _ : Fin p => ζ) (fun _ : Fin p => star ζ)) j))).prod =
        resolvent Y ζ ^ p * resolvent Y (star ζ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun j : Fin (p + p) => resolvent Y
      ((Fin.append (fun _ : Fin p => ζ) (fun _ : Fin p => star ζ)) j)) =
      Fin.append (fun _ : Fin p => resolvent Y ζ)
        (fun _ : Fin p => resolvent Y (star ζ)) := by
    funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp only [Fin.append_left]
    · simp only [Fin.append_right]
  rw [he, List.ofFn_fin_append, List.prod_append]
  simp only [List.ofFn_const, List.prod_replicate]

name: NLAlib.integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_one
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_one [Nonempty n]
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : E, resolventEvenMoment (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A 1 x) ζ p
      ∂gaussianVector K) =
    ∫ x : ι → ℝ, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ p
      ∂gaussianVector ι
proof:
:= by
  let w : Fin (p + p) → ℂ := Fin.append (fun _ : Fin p => ζ) (fun _ : Fin p => star ζ)
  have hw : ∀ j, (w j).im ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simpa only [w, Fin.append_left] using hζ
    · simpa only [w, Fin.append_right, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hζ
  have he := integral_normalizedTrace_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord_one
    (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA w hw
  simp only [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord, w, mixed_constant_resolventWord_prod] at he
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) := by fun_prop
  have hg := integral_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_mixed_pow (gaussianVector ι)
    (fun x : ι → ℝ => A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) hm.aemeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => hA₀.add (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x)) hζ p
  rw [integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re A₀ hA₀ A hA 1 ζ hζ p, hg]
  simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc] using congrArg Complex.re he

name: NLAlib.measureReal_hausdorffDist_gaussian_wordNative_gt_fixed_height
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_gaussian_wordNative_gt_fixed_height
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hmass : 0 < bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ≤ q)
    {Δ : ℝ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hweak : Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q ≤ Δ)
    (hvariance : Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))/(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2 ≤ Δ)
    (hbudget : (q : ℝ)^3*(specNorm (coefficientVariance A)*specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) ≤ Δ^4) :
    (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ | (20000000000000000 : ℝ)*Δ < Metric.hausdorffDist
      (spectrum ℝ (A₀+∑ i,x i•A i)) (spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A))} ≤
      1/(16*(q : ℝ)) + 27*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-(q : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let η : ℝ := 10000000000*Δ
  have hη : 0 < η := by dsimp only [η]; positivity
  let B : ℝ := (((2*(2*q)+1)*(2*(2*q)+2)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)*
    (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)*specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))*η⁻¹^5
  let δ : ℝ := 1000000*(B+6*Δ/η^2)
  let s := Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
  let c : ℝ := bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*η⁻¹^4
  let t : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt (c*q)
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by dsimp only [t]; positivity
  have hV : 0 ≤ specNorm (coefficientVariance A) := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hW : 0 ≤ specNorm (coefficientCovariance A) := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp only [B]; positivity
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hqroot : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) := (Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).mpr (by simpa using hq1)
  have hscale : Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) ≤
      2*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*(s*Real.sqrt q) := by
    have hσ := sqrt_variance_le_card_mul_sqrt_bilinearSquareMass A hA
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqroot
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card d)) hs)
    dsimp only [s] at *
    nlinarith only [hσ,hh,mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card d)) hs]
  have hfwd := gaussian_free_forward_error_le (d := Fintype.card d) hq hlog hB hΔ.le (η := η)
  have hrev := gaussian_free_reverse_error_le (d := Fintype.card d) hq hs
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))) hB hη hweak hvariance
  dsimp only at hrev
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)] at hrev
  have hgrid := gaussian_free_grid_error_budget_le hq hV hW hΔ hweak hbudget
  dsimp only at hgrid
  have hp := measureReal_hausdorffDist_gaussian_wordNative_gt_le_grid_error A₀ hA₀ A hA
    hmass hq hlog hη ht hscale
    (gaussian_free_markov_factor_le hq hlog) gaussian_free_ultracontractive_factor_le
    hfwd hrev (by simpa only [B, η, mul_assoc] using hgrid)
  have he : 2*(1000000 : ℝ)*η = 20000000000000000*Δ := by dsimp only [η]; ring
  rw [he] at hp
  have htail := gaussian_free_fluctuation_tail_eq hq (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmass) hη
  dsimp only at htail
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)] at htail
  have htail' : Real.exp (-t^2/(2*c))=Real.exp (-2*(q : ℝ)) := by
    dsimp only [t,c]
    linarith only [htail]
  change _ ≤ _ at hp
  change _ ≤ _
  have h4 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) q] :
    (-4*(q : ℝ)) ≤ -(q : ℝ))
  have h2 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) q] :
    (-2*(q : ℝ)) ≤ -(q : ℝ))
  have h4m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2)
  have h2m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 18*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2)
  change _ ≤ 1/(16*(q : ℝ)) + (9*(Fintype.card d)^2 : ℕ)*Real.exp (-4*q : ℝ) +
    (18*(Fintype.card d)^2 : ℕ)*Real.exp (-t^2/(2*c)) at hp
  rw [htail'] at hp
  push_cast at hp
  linarith only [hp,h4m,h2m]

name: NLAlib.resolvent_comparison_scale_le
statement:
private theorem resolvent_comparison_scale_le
    {R v η L T : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hL : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ L)
    (hmain : T ≤ 72 * (R / η ^ 4 + R ^ 3 / η ^ 6) * (2 * v + R ^ 2 * L))
    (hcrude : T ≤ 2 / η) :
    T ≤ 288 * (R * v + R ^ 3 * L) / η ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := le_trans (by norm_num) hL
  by_cases hlarge : R ≤ η
  · have hratio : 0 ≤ R / η := div_nonneg hR hη.le
    have hratio1 : R / η ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hη).mpr hlarge
    have hratiosq : (R / η) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hdiv : R ^ 3 / η ^ 6 ≤ R / η ^ 4 := by
      calc
        _ = (R / η ^ 4) * (R / η) ^ 2 := by field_simp
        _ ≤ (R / η ^ 4) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratiosq (by positivity)
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    calc
      T ≤ 72 * (R / η ^ 4 + R ^ 3 / η ^ 6) * (2 * v + R ^ 2 * L) := hmain
      _ ≤ 72 * (2 * (R / η ^ 4)) * (2 * (v + R ^ 2 * L)) := by
        gcongr
        · linarith only [hdiv]
        · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg R) hL0]
      _ = _ := by field_simp; ring
  · have hηR : η ≤ R := (lt_of_not_ge hlarge).le
    have hcube : η ^ 3 ≤ R ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hη.le hηR 3
    have hprod : 0 ≤ R ^ 3 * (L - 1 / 2) :=
      mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR _) (sub_nonneg.mpr hL)
    have hnum : 2 * η ^ 3 ≤ 288 * (R * v + R ^ 3 * L) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hR hv, pow_nonneg hR 3]
    calc
      T ≤ 2 / η := hcrude
      _ = (2 * η ^ 3) / η ^ 4 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (pow_nonneg hη.le _)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_resolvent_sum_sub_gaussian_le
    {ι n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (ν : ι → Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R)
    (ρ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : Matrix n n ℂ →
      ((n × n) ⊕ (n × n)) → ℝ) ρ)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A ∂ρ) = A₀ +
      ∫ x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (hcov : ∀ a b : (n × n) ⊕ (n × n),
      cov[(fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν])
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : 0 < ζ.im) :
    specNorm ((∫ x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      ∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, resolvent A ζ ∂ρ) ≤
      288 * (R * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
        R ^ 3 * Real.log (2 * Fintype.card n)) / ζ.im ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let M := Matrix n n ℂ
  let J := (n × n) ⊕ (n × n)
  let E := J → ℝ
  let L : E →L[ℝ] M := hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates
  let B : ℝ := Real.log (2 * Fintype.card n)
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hc1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt Fintype.card_pos))
  have hB : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ B := by
    have hlog2 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
    exact hlog2.trans (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by nlinarith))
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (by norm_num) hB
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl hi =>
    let := hi
    have hrho : ρ = Measure.dirac A₀ :=
      eq_dirac_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance ρ hρ.memLp_two A₀
        (by simpa using hmean) (fun j => by simpa using hcov j j)
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 288 * (R * 0 + R ^ 3 * B) / ζ.im ^ 4 := by positivity
    simpa [hrho, B, specNorm_eq_norm] using hz
  | inr hi =>
    let := hi
    let κ : ι → Measure E := fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates
    have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure (κ i) :=
      (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
    have hν3 (i : ι) : MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i) :=
      MemLp.of_bound aestronglyMeasurable_id R (hBound i)
    have hκ2 (i : ι) : MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (κ i) :=
      memLp_id_map_matrixRealCoordinates (ν i)
        (MemLp.of_bound aestronglyMeasurable_id R (hBound i))
    have hκBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂κ i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R := by
      intro i
      have hm : MeasurableSet {x : E | specNorm (L x) ≤ R} := by
        exact (isClosed_le (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using L.continuous.norm)
          continuous_const).measurableSet
      apply (ae_map_iff measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable hm).mpr
      filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with A hA hb
      simpa only [L, hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA] using hb
    let γ := centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ
    have hγ := hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ
    have hγmean := integral_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw_eq_zero ρ hρ
    have hγcov : ∀ a b : J,
        cov[(fun z : E => z a), (fun z : E => z b); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p a),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p b);
          resamplingTripleMeasure κ] := by
      intro a b
      exact (covariance_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ a b).trans
        ((hcov a b).trans (covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates ν a b).symm)
    have hcomp := specNorm_resamplingInterpolation_sub_le_square_mass κ hκ2 γ hγ
      hγmean hγcov A₀ hA₀ hR hκBound ζ hζ.ne'
    have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
    rw [resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_resolvent_law ν hHerm γ A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ.ne',
      resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_resolvent_law ν hν3 ρ hρ hρHerm A₀ hA₀ hmean ζ hζ.ne']
      at hcomp
    have hsq := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_coordinate_sq_le_chernoff ν hR hHerm hBound
    let v := specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i)
    have hv : 0 ≤ v := specNorm_nonneg _
    have hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ B :=
      Real.log_le_log hc (by nlinarith)
    have hEY : (∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi κ) ≤
        2 * v + R ^ 2 * B := by
      refine hsq.2.trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three]) hv
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (sq_nonneg R)
    have hmain : specNorm ((∫ x : ι → M, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ ∂Measure.pi ν) -
        ∫ A : M, resolvent A ζ ∂ρ) ≤
        72 * (R / ζ.im ^ 4 + R ^ 3 / ζ.im ^ 6) * (2 * v + R ^ 2 * B) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ 72 * (R / ζ.im ^ 4 + R ^ 3 / ζ.im ^ 6) *
            (∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi κ) := by
          simpa only [abs_of_pos hζ, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using hcomp
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEY (by positivity)
    have hcrude := specNorm_integral_resolvent_sub_integral_resolvent_le
      (Measure.pi ν) ρ (fun x : ι → M => A₀ + ∑ i, x i) id (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      ((ae_isHermitian_sum_pi ν hHerm).mono fun x hx => hA₀.add hx) hρHerm ζ hζ.ne'
    have hcrude' : specNorm ((∫ x : ι → M, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ ∂Measure.pi ν) -
        ∫ A : M, resolvent A ζ ∂ρ) ≤ 2 / ζ.im := by
      simpa only [id_eq, abs_of_pos hζ, div_eq_mul_inv] using hcrude
    exact resolvent_comparison_scale_le hR hv hζ hB hmain hcrude'

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_delta_budgets
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_delta_budgets {q d : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hd : 0 < d)
    {V W s : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (_hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hweak : s ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt V * Real.sqrt W))
    (hvariance : Real.sqrt V / (d : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt W) :
    let σ
proof:
:= Real.sqrt V
    let ξ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt V * Real.sqrt W)
    let Δ := ξ * (q : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)
    s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) ≤ Δ ∧ σ / (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Δ ∧
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * (V * W) = Δ ^ 4 ∧ (0 < s → 0 < Δ) := by
  let σ := Real.sqrt V
  let v := Real.sqrt W
  let ξ := Real.sqrt (σ * v)
  let Δ := ξ * (q : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)
  change s * Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) ≤ Δ ∧ σ / (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Δ ∧
    (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * (V * W) = Δ ^ 4 ∧ (0 < s → 0 < Δ)
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdp : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hσ : 0 ≤ σ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hξ : 0 ≤ ξ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hqp : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
  have hqp1 : 1 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.one_le_rpow hq1 (by norm_num)
  have hξΔ : ξ ≤ Δ := by dsimp [Δ]; nlinarith
  have hqpower : Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hq1 (by norm_num)
  have hsd0 : 0 ≤ σ / (d : ℝ) := div_nonneg hσ hdp.le
  have hsdσ : σ / (d : ℝ) ≤ σ := div_le_self hσ hd1
  have hsdξ : σ / (d : ℝ) ≤ ξ := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ hsd0 hξ).mp
    have hx : ξ ^ 2 = σ * v := Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hσ hv)
    rw [hx, pow_two]
    exact mul_le_mul hsdσ hvariance hsd0 hσ
  have hxi4 : ξ ^ 4 = V * W := by
    calc
      ξ ^ 4 = (ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (σ * v) ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hσ hv)]
      _ = V * W := by dsimp [σ, v]; rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hV, Real.sq_sqrt hW]
  have hqpow4 : ((q : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 4 = (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast (Nat.cast_nonneg q)]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweak (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqpower hξ)
  · calc
      σ / (d : ℝ) ^ 2 = (σ / (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ) := by rw [div_div, pow_two]
      _ ≤ σ / (d : ℝ) := div_le_self hsd0 hd1
      _ ≤ ξ := hsdξ
      _ ≤ Δ := hξΔ
  · dsimp [Δ]
    rw [mul_pow, hxi4, hqpow4]
    ring
  · intro hspos
    exact mul_pos (hspos.trans_le hweak) hqp

name: NLAlib.gaussian_free_logarithmic_order_budgets
statement:
theorem gaussian_free_logarithmic_order_budgets {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    let q : ℕ
proof:
:= ⌈10 * Real.log (d : ℝ) + 100⌉₊
    0 < q ∧ Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ 212 * Real.log (d : ℝ) ∧
      1 / (16 * (q : ℝ)) + 27 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  let q : ℕ := ⌈10 * Real.log (d : ℝ) + 100⌉₊
  change 0 < q ∧ Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ 212 * Real.log (d : ℝ) ∧ _
  have hd2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdp : (0 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hd2
  have hloghalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hinput : 0 < 10 * Real.log (d : ℝ) + 100 := by linarith
  have hqpos : 0 < q := Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr hinput
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hqpos
  have hqlo : 10 * Real.log (d : ℝ) + 100 ≤ (q : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hqhi : (q : ℝ) < 10 * Real.log (d : ℝ) + 101 := by
    have h := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hinput.le
    change (q : ℝ) < _ at h
    linarith
  have hsmall : 1 / (16 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) := by
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by nlinarith only [hq1])
  have hexp : (d : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(q : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (-100) := by
    calc
      _ = Real.exp (2 * Real.log (d : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(q : ℝ)) := by
        rw [two_mul, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hdp, pow_two]
      _ = Real.exp (2 * Real.log (d : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-100) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hexpsmall : Real.exp (-100) ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by
    have he100 : (100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 100 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (100 : ℝ)]
    simpa only [Real.exp_neg, one_div] using
      (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 100) he100)
  refine ⟨hqpos, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
  have hprob := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hexp.trans hexpsmall) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 27)
  nlinarith only [hsmall, hprob]

name: NLAlib.norm_resamplingInterpolation_trace_resolvent_sub_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
statement:
theorem norm_resamplingInterpolation_trace_resolvent_sub_le_matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ) 1 -
      resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ) 0‖ ≤
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map L) / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  letI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hν₂ (i : ι) : MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i) := (hν i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let Q := P.prod γ
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂P
  let X₀ : Ω → E := fun q => resamplingTripleOriginal q.1
  let X₁ : Ω → E := fun q => resamplingTripleFirst q.1
  let X₂ : Ω → E := fun q => resamplingTripleSecond q.1
  let d : Ω → E := X₀-X₁
  let e : Ω → E := X₁-X₂
  let f : Ω → E := X₀-X₂
  let Y₀ : ℝ → Ω → E := fun t q =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ (Real.sqrt t) (Real.sqrt (1-t)) (X₀ q) q.2
  let Y₁ : ℝ → Ω → E := fun t q =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ (Real.sqrt t) (Real.sqrt (1-t)) (X₁ q) q.2
  let Y₂ : ℝ → Ω → E := fun t q =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ (Real.sqrt t) (Real.sqrt (1-t)) (X₂ q) q.2
  let R : ℝ → Ω → ℂ := fun t q => normalizedTrace
    (L (d q) * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (L (Y₀ t q)) (L (Y₁ t q))
      (L (Y₂ t q)) (L (d q)) (L (e q)) +
     L (d q) * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (L (Y₀ t q)) (L (Y₂ t q))
      (L (Y₂ t q)) (L (f q)) (L (d q)))
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
  let m₃ := matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map L)
  let v : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (N * Real.sqrt t / 4) • ∫ q, R t q ∂Q
  have hN : 0 < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hdf := continuous_hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative (n := n) ζ hζ
  have hΦ (y : E) : HasFDerivAt (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ)
      (hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct.flip (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ y)) y := by
    have he : hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct.flip (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ y) =
        hermitianCoordinateTraceResolventDerivative ζ y := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro h
      exact (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolventDerivative_apply ζ y h).symm
    rw [he]
    exact hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ hζ y
  have hΦc : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent (n := n) ζ) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => (hΦ y).continuousAt)
  have hm := memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν₂
  have hX₀ : Integrable X₀ Q := (hm.1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hX₁ : Integrable X₁ Q := (hm.2.1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hX₂ : Integrable X₂ Q := (hm.2.2.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hZ : Integrable (fun q : Ω => q.2) Q :=
    (hγ.memLp_two.integrable one_le_two).comp_snd P
  have hX₀m := hX₀.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hX₁m := hX₁.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hX₂m := hX₂.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hZm := hZ.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hY₀ (t : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (fun q => L (Y₀ t q)) Q := by
    have hy : AEMeasurable (Y₀ t) Q :=
      (aemeasurable_const.add ((hX₀m.sub aemeasurable_const).const_smul (Real.sqrt t))).add
        (hZm.const_smul (Real.sqrt (1-t)))
    exact (L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hy
  have hY₁ (t : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (fun q => L (Y₁ t q)) Q := by
    have hy : AEMeasurable (Y₁ t) Q :=
      (aemeasurable_const.add ((hX₁m.sub aemeasurable_const).const_smul (Real.sqrt t))).add
        (hZm.const_smul (Real.sqrt (1-t)))
    exact (L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hy
  have hY₂ (t : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (fun q => L (Y₂ t q)) Q := by
    have hy : AEMeasurable (Y₂ t) Q :=
      (aemeasurable_const.add ((hX₂m.sub aemeasurable_const).const_smul (Real.sqrt t))).add
        (hZm.const_smul (Real.sqrt (1-t)))
    exact (L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hy
  have hd : AEMeasurable (fun q => L (d q)) Q :=
    (L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hX₀m.sub hX₁m)
  have he : AEMeasurable (fun q => L (e q)) Q :=
    (L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hX₁m.sub hX₂m)
  have hf : AEMeasurable (fun q => L (f q)) Q :=
    (L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hX₀m.sub hX₂m)
  have h₃i := integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_differences ν hν L γ
  have h₃m := integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_differences ν hν L γ
  have hR (t : ℝ) : Integrable (R t) Q ∧ ‖∫ q, R t q ∂Q‖ ≤ 6 * (m₃/N) / |ζ.im|^4 :=
    integrable_and_norm_integral_six_word_remainder_le ζ hζ
      (fun q => L (Y₀ t q)) (fun q => L (Y₁ t q)) (fun q => L (Y₂ t q))
      (fun q => L (d q)) (fun q => L (e q)) (fun q => L (f q))
      (hY₀ t) (hY₁ t) (hY₂ t) hd he hf
      (ae_of_all _ fun q => isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _)
      (ae_of_all _ fun q => isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _)
      (ae_of_all _ fun q => isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _)
      h₃i.1 h₃i.2.1 h₃i.2.2 (m₃/N) h₃m.1 h₃m.2.1 h₃m.2.2
  have hv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ)) (v t) t := by
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1-t)
    have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht.1
    let K : Ω → ℂ := fun q => hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct (d q)
      (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ (Y₂ t q) (d q))
    have hK : Integrable K Q :=
      integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine ν hν₂ γ μ a b
        (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ) hdf
        (2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^3 * ‖L‖)
        (norm_hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative_le ζ hζ) hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct
    have hp (q : Ω) : hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct (d q)
        (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ (Y₀ t q) -
          hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ (Y₁ t q)) = a • K q + a^2 • R t q := by
      have h01 : Y₀ t q-Y₁ t q = a • d q := by dsimp [Y₀,Y₁,d,a,resamplingAffinePoint]; module
      have h12 : Y₁ t q-Y₂ t q = a • e q := by dsimp [Y₁,Y₂,e,a,resamplingAffinePoint]; module
      have h02 : Y₀ t q-Y₂ t q = a • f q := by dsimp [Y₀,Y₂,f,a,resamplingAffinePoint]; module
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_add] using
        hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct_squaredResolvent_affine_remainder ζ hζ
          (Y₀ t q) (Y₁ t q) (Y₂ t q) (d q) (e q) (f q) a h01 h12 h02
    have hfirst : (∫ q, hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct (d q)
        (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ (Y₀ t q) -
          hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ (Y₁ t q)) ∂Q) =
        a • (∫ q, K q ∂Q) + a^2 • ∫ q, R t q ∂Q := by
      simp_rw [hp]
      have hKa : Integrable (fun q => a • K q) Q := by
        refine (hK.smul a).congr ?_
        filter_upwards [] with q
        rfl
      have hRa : Integrable (fun q => a^2 • R t q) Q := by
        refine ((hR t).1.smul (a^2)).congr ?_
        filter_upwards [] with q
        rfl
      rw [integral_add hKa hRa,integral_smul,integral_smul]
    have hderiv := hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation ν hν₂ γ hγ hmean hcov
      (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ) (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ)
      (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative ζ) hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct hΦ
      (hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ hζ) hdf
      |ζ.im|⁻¹ (|ζ.im|⁻¹^2) (2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹^3 * ‖L‖)
      (norm_hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent_le ζ hζ)
      (specNorm_hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent_le ζ hζ)
      (norm_hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolventDerivative_le ζ hζ) ht.1 ht.2
    change HasDerivAt _ ((N/(4*a)) • (∫ q, hermitianCoordinateTraceProduct (d q)
        (hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ (Y₀ t q) -
          hermitianCoordinateSquaredResolvent ζ (Y₁ t q)) ∂Q) -
      (N/4) • ∫ q, K q ∂Q) t at hderiv
    apply hderiv.congr_deriv
    rw [hfirst,smul_add,smul_smul,smul_smul]
    have hca : N/(4*a)*a = N/4 := by field_simp [ha.ne']
    have hcb : N/(4*a)*a^2 = N*a/4 := by field_simp [ha.ne']
    rw [hca,hcb]
    dsimp [v,a]
    abel
  apply norm_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_sqrt _ v
    (continuous_resamplingInterpolation ν hν₂ γ _ hΦc |ζ.im|⁻¹
      (norm_hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent_le ζ hζ)).continuousOn hv
    (m₃/|ζ.im|^4)
  intro t ht
  have hc : 0 ≤ N*Real.sqrt t/4 := by positivity
  calc
    ‖v t‖ = (N*Real.sqrt t/4) * ‖∫ q, R t q ∂Q‖ := by
      change ‖(N*Real.sqrt t/4) • (∫ q, R t q ∂Q)‖ = _
      rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hc]
    _ ≤ (N*Real.sqrt t/4) * (6*(m₃/N)/|ζ.im|^4) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hR t).2 hc
    _ = (3/2) * Real.sqrt t * (m₃/|ζ.im|^4) := by field_simp [hN.ne']; ring

name: NLAlib.independentSumSpectralScale_eq
statement:
theorem independentSumSpectralScale_eq {R s σ t : ℝ}
    (hR : 0≤R) (hσ : 0≤σ) (ht : 0≤t) :
    independentSumSpectralScale R s σ t =
      s*Real.sqrt t+R^(1/3 : ℝ)*σ^(2/3 : ℝ)*t^(2/3 : ℝ)+R*t
proof:
:= by
  unfold independentSumSpectralScale
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (mul_nonneg hR (sq_nonneg σ)) (sq_nonneg t),
    Real.mul_rpow hR (sq_nonneg σ)]
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul hσ 2 (1/3 : ℝ),
    ← Real.rpow_natCast_mul ht 2 (1/3 : ℝ)]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.independentSumSpectralScale_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold independentSumSpectralScale
  positivity

name: NLAlib.sqrt_add_linear_le_independentSumSpectralScale
statement:
theorem sqrt_add_linear_le_independentSumSpectralScale {R s σ t : ℝ} (hR : 0≤R) :
    s*Real.sqrt t+R*t ≤ independentSumSpectralScale R s σ t
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Real.rpow_nonneg (show 0≤R*σ^2*t^2 by positivity) (1/3 : ℝ)
  dsimp [independentSumSpectralScale]
  linarith only [hh]

name: NLAlib.mixed_variance_le_independentSumSpectralScale_cube
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0≤R*σ^2*t^2 := by positivity
  have hroot : ((R*σ^2*t^2)^(1/3 : ℝ))^3=R*σ^2*t^2 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat,show (1/3 : ℝ)=(3 : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num] using
      Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hx (by decide : (3 : ℕ)≠0)
  have hle : (R*σ^2*t^2)^(1/3 : ℝ) ≤ independentSumSpectralScale R s σ t := by
    dsimp [independentSumSpectralScale]
    have h1 : 0≤s*Real.sqrt t := by positivity
    have h2 : 0≤R*t := by positivity
    linarith only [h1,h2]
  simpa only [hroot] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _) hle 3

name: NLAlib.sqrt_add_linear_and_mixed_variance_le_twenty_two_spectralScale
statement:
theorem sqrt_add_linear_and_mixed_variance_le_twenty_two_spectralScale {R s σ t p : ℝ}
    (hR : 0≤R) (hs : 0≤s) (ht : 0≤t) (hp : 0≤p) (hpt : p≤22*t) :
    s*Real.sqrt p+R*p≤22*independentSumSpectralScale R s σ t ∧
      R*σ^2*p^2≤(22*independentSumSpectralScale R s σ t)^3
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt p≤22*Real.sqrt t := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨by positivity,?_⟩
    rw [mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt ht]
    nlinarith only [hpt,ht]
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt hs
  have hlin := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpt hR
  have hbase := sqrt_add_linear_le_independentSumSpectralScale (s:=s) (σ:=σ) (t:=t) hR
  have hD := independentSumSpectralScale_nonneg (σ:=σ) hR hs ht
  refine ⟨by linear_combination hm+hlin+22*hbase,?_⟩
  have hp2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hp hpt 2)
    (mul_nonneg hR (sq_nonneg σ))
  have hcube := mixed_variance_le_independentSumSpectralScale_cube (σ:=σ) hR hs ht
  have hD3 : 0≤(independentSumSpectralScale R s σ t)^3 := pow_nonneg hD 3
  nlinarith only [hp2,hcube,hD3]

name: Real.sixty_mul_sq_mul_exp_neg_le_of_log_le
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0<d := by linarith
  have ht2 : log 2≤t := (log_le_log (by norm_num) hd).trans ht
  have h60 : (60 : ℝ)≤exp (18*t) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ)^18 := by norm_num
      _ = exp (18*log 2) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat,exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<2)] using
          (exp_nat_mul (log 2) 18).symm
      _ ≤ _ := exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [ht2])
  have hdt : d≤exp t := by
    rw [← exp_log hdpos]
    exact exp_le_exp.mpr ht
  have hprod : 60*d≤exp (19*t) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ exp (18*t)*exp t := mul_le_mul h60 hdt hdpos.le (exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hexp : exp (-p)≤exp (-(20*t)) := exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hp])
  calc
    _ ≤ 60*d^2*exp (-(20*t)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)
    _ = d*((60*d)*exp (-(20*t))) := by ring
    _ ≤ d*(exp (19*t)*exp (-(20*t))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod (exp_pos _).le) hdpos.le
    _ = _ := by rw [← exp_add]; congr 2; ring
