name: NLAlib.contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc
statement:
theorem contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) {r : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ r (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hr (ω : ℂ) (hω : ω.im ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ r
      (fun x : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ω) := by
    have heq : (fun x : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ω) =
        gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (fun _ : Fin 1 => ω) := by
      funext x
      simp [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
    rw [heq]
    exact contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ω) (fun _ => hω) (r := r)
  exact ((hr ζ hζ).pow a).mul ((hr (star ζ)
    (by simpa only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hζ)).pow b)

name: NLAlib.exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_bounds_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∃ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧
      (∀ x : E, specNorm (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b x) ≤ C₀) ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) x‖ ≤ C₁
proof:
:= by
  let A₀N : M := A₀ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
  have hA₀N : A₀N.IsHermitian := by
    change (A₀ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ))ᴴ = A₀ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hA₀.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
  let L := gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM (n := n) A q
  let D : E →L[ℝ] J := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp L
  let w := mixedArcBlocks (n := n) (d := d) ζ a b
  let g : J → M := hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A₀N w
  have hw : ∀ j, (w j).1.im ≠ 0 := mixedArcBlocks_im ζ hζ a b
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ g := contDiff_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord A₀N hA₀N w hw
  have hrec (x : E) : H (D x) = L x := by
    change H (matrixRealCoordinates (L x)) = L x
    apply hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates
    simpa only [L, gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM_apply] using
      isHermitian_sum_smul_real _ (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient_isHermitian A hA q) x
  have heq : gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b = g ∘ D := by
    funext x
    simp only [g, Function.comp_apply, hermitianCoordinateResolventWord,
      hermitianCoordinateResolvent, hrec, w, mixedArcBlocks, List.ofFn_fin_append,
      List.map_append, List.prod_append, List.ofFn_const, List.map_replicate,
      List.prod_replicate, mul_one]
    simp only [gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc, gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation,
      A₀N, L, gaussianFreeFiniteSeriesCLM_apply]
  let c : ℝ := |ζ.im|⁻¹
  let P : ℝ := ∏ j, ‖(w j).2‖
  let C₀ : ℝ := c ^ (a + b) * P
  let C₁ : ℝ := (a + b : ℕ) * c ^ (a + b + 1) * P * ‖H‖ * ‖D‖
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hP : 0 ≤ P := Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _
  refine ⟨C₀, C₁, by dsimp [C₀]; positivity, by dsimp [C₁]; positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, specNorm_eq_norm, g, C₀, P] using
      norm_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A₀N hA₀N w hw hc
        (fun j => (mixedArcBlocks_height ζ a b j).le) (D x)
  · intro x
    rw [heq, (hg.differentiable (by simp) (D x)).hasFDerivAt.comp x D.hasFDerivAt |>.fderiv]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ g (D x)‖ * ‖D‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
      _ ≤ C₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (norm_fderiv_hermitianCoordinateResolventWord_le A₀N hA₀N w hw hc
          (fun j => (mixedArcBlocks_height ζ a b j).le) (D x)) (norm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_apply
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) (x h : E) :
    let R
proof:
:= resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ
    let S := resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (star ζ)
    let V := ∑ k, h k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k
    fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) x h =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, R ^ (a - i) * V * R ^ (i + 1) * S ^ b) +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, R ^ a * S ^ (b - j) * V * S ^ (j + 1) := by
  let l : ℝ → E := fun t => x + t • h
  have hl : HasDerivAt l h 0 := by simpa [l] using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const h |>.const_add x
  have hcurve (ω : ℂ) (hω : ω.im ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (l t)) ω)
      (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (l 0)) ω *
        (∑ k, h k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k) *
        resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (l 0)) ω) 0 := by
    have hc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤
        (fun y : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q y) ω) := by
      have heq : (fun y : E => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q y) ω) =
          gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord A₀ A q (fun _ : Fin 1 => ω) := by
        funext y
        simp [gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord]
      rw [heq]
      exact contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteResolventWord (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => ω) (fun _ => hω) (r := ⊤)
    have hd := (hc.differentiable (by simp) (l 0)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hl
    simpa only [l, zero_smul, add_zero, Function.comp_def,
      fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteResolvent_apply A₀ hA₀ A hA q ω hω] using hd
  have hd := hasDerivAt_mixed_powers_of_sandwich
    (R := fun t : ℝ => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (l t)) ζ)
    (S := fun t : ℝ => resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q (l t)) (star ζ))
    (t := (0 : ℝ))
    (∑ k, h k • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k) (hcurve ζ hζ)
    (hcurve (star ζ) (by simpa only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hζ)) a b
  have hf : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b (l t))
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) x h) 0 := by
    have hc := ((contDiff_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b
      (r := ⊤)).differentiable (by simp) (l 0)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hl
    simpa only [l, Function.comp_def, zero_smul, add_zero] using hc
  apply hf.unique
  simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc, l, Function.comp_def,
    Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, zero_smul, add_zero] using hd

name: NLAlib.gramEntryMaxSq_nonneg
statement: private lemma gramEntryMaxSq_nonneg (b : I → J → ℝ) : 0 ≤ gramEntryMaxSq b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold gramEntryMaxSq
  obtain ⟨e, he, hEq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup'
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (I × J))) (H := Finset.univ_nonempty)
    (f := fun e : I × J => b e.1 e.2 ^ 2)
  rw [hEq]
  exact sq_nonneg (b e.1 e.2)

name: NLAlib.gram_entry_sq_le_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one
statement:
private lemma gram_entry_sq_le_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one (b : I → J → ℝ)

proof:
:= by

  unfold gramEntryMaxSq at hmax

    (f := fun e : I × J => b e.1 e.2 ^ 2) (Finset.mem_univ (i, j))

name: NLAlib.gramColMaxSum_ge_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one
statement:
private lemma gramColMaxSum_ge_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (hmax : gramEntryMaxSq b = 1) : 1 ≤ gramColMaxSum b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he, hEq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup'
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (I × J))) (H := Finset.univ_nonempty)
    (f := fun e : I × J => b e.1 e.2 ^ 2)
  have he1 : b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hmax
  have hsingle : b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : I, b i e.2 ^ 2 := by
    calc
      b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ ({e.1} : Finset I), b i e.2 ^ 2 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I), b i e.2 ^ 2 := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Finset.mem_univ e.1))
          (fun i hi hnot => sq_nonneg (b i e.2))
  calc
    1 = b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 := he1.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i : I, b i e.2 ^ 2 := hsingle
    _ ≤ gramColMaxSum b := gram_col_sum_le_gramColMaxSum b e.2

name: NLAlib.gramRowMaxSum_ge_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one
statement:
private lemma gramRowMaxSum_ge_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (hmax : gramEntryMaxSq b = 1) : 1 ≤ gramRowMaxSum b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he, hEq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup'
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (I × J))) (H := Finset.univ_nonempty)
    (f := fun e : I × J => b e.1 e.2 ^ 2)
  have he1 : b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hmax
  have hsingle : b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : J, b e.1 j ^ 2 := by
    calc
      b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 = ∑ j ∈ ({e.2} : Finset J), b e.1 j ^ 2 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset J), b e.1 j ^ 2 := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Finset.mem_univ e.2))
          (fun j hj hnot => sq_nonneg (b e.1 j))
  calc
    1 = b e.1 e.2 ^ 2 := he1.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j : J, b e.1 j ^ 2 := hsingle
    _ ≤ gramRowMaxSum b := gram_row_sum_le_gramRowMaxSum b e.1

name: NLAlib.bijective_sum_elim_gramPairingFirstOccurrence_gramPairingSecondOccurrence
statement:
lemma bijective_sum_elim_gramPairingFirstOccurrence_gramPairingSecondOccurrence (p : ℕ) (π : GaussianPairings (p + p)) :
    Function.Bijective
      (Sum.elim (gramPairingFirstOccurrence p π) (gramPairingSecondOccurrence p π) :
        Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length ⊕ Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length →
          Fin p ⊕ Fin p)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Function.Bijective
      (Sum.elim (fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length =>
          ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1)
        (fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length =>
          ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2) :
        Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length ⊕ Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length →
          Fin (p + p)) :=
    gaussianPairingEdges_endpoints_bijective π
  have href : Sum.elim (gramPairingFirstOccurrence p π) (gramPairingSecondOccurrence p π) =
      (gramCycleEquiv p ∘ Sum.elim
        (fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1)
        (fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2)) := by
    funext s
    cases s <;> rfl
  rw [href]
  exact (gramCycleEquiv p).bijective.comp hb

name: NLAlib.gram_edge_weight_eq_pairingSum_indicator
statement:
private lemma gram_edge_weight_eq_pairingSum_indicator (b : I → J → ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Fin p → I) (y : Fin p → J)
    (e : Fin (p + p) × Fin (p + p)) :
    gramCyclePairCovariance b p x y e.1 e.2 =
      if x (cycleRow p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1)) = x (cycleRow p (gramCycleEquiv p e.2)) ∧
          y (cycleCol p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1)) = y (cycleCol p (gramCycleEquiv p e.2))
        then b (x (cycleRow p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1))) (y (cycleCol p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1))) ^ 2
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold gramCyclePairCovariance
  cases h1 : gramCycleEquiv p e.1 <;> cases h2 : gramCycleEquiv p e.2 <;>
    simp [gramCycleIdx, cycleRow, cycleCol, Prod.ext_iff]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_eq_prod_gaussianPairingEdges
statement:
private lemma gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_eq_prod_gaussianPairingEdges (b : I → J → ℝ)
    (p : ℕ) (x : Fin p → I) (y : Fin p → J)
    (π : GaussianPairings (p + p)) :
    gaussianPairingWeight (gramCyclePairCovariance b p x y) π =
      ((gaussianPairingEdges π).map (fun e =>
        if x (cycleRow p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1)) = x (cycleRow p (gramCycleEquiv p e.2)) ∧
            y (cycleCol p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1)) = y (cycleCol p (gramCycleEquiv p e.2))
          then b (x (cycleRow p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1))) (y (cycleCol p (gramCycleEquiv p e.1))) ^ 2
          else 0)).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPairingWeight_eq_prod_gaussianPairingEdges]
  apply congrArg List.prod
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e he
  exact gram_edge_weight_eq_pairingSum_indicator b p x y e

name: NLAlib.gramPairingContribution_eq_pairingSum_cycle
statement:
theorem gramPairingContribution_eq_pairingSum_cycle (b : I → J → ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (π : GaussianPairings (p + p)) :
    gramPairingContribution b p π =
      pairingSum (cycleRow p) (cycleCol p) (gramPairingFirstOccurrence p π) (gramPairingSecondOccurrence p π)
        (fun i j => b i j ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold gramPairingContribution pairingSum
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro x _
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro y _
  rw [gaussianPairingWeight_cycle_eq_prod_gaussianPairingEdges b p x y π]
  rw [← Fin.prod_univ_fun_getElem (gaussianPairingEdges π)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp [gramPairingFirstOccurrence, gramPairingSecondOccurrence]; rfl

name: NLAlib.gramPairingContribution_div_card_le_unit_profile
statement:
theorem gramPairingContribution_div_card_le_unit_profile
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Nonempty I]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (b : I → J → ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (π : GaussianPairings (p + p)) (d1 d2 : ℕ)
    (hentry : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d1 : ℝ))
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d2 : ℝ))
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) :
    gramPairingContribution b p π / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤
      gramPairingContribution (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) p π /
        (d1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hp)
  change gramPairingContribution b (q + 1) π / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤
    gramPairingContribution (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) (q + 1) π /
      (d1 : ℝ)
  have hb := pairingSum_cycle_div_card_le (q := q)
    (alpha := gramPairingFirstOccurrence (q + 1) π) (beta := gramPairingSecondOccurrence (q + 1) π)
    (hcover := bijective_sum_elim_gramPairingFirstOccurrence_gramPairingSecondOccurrence (q + 1) π)
    (w := fun i j => b i j ^ 2) (d1 := d1) (d2 := d2)
    (hwnn := (fun i j => sq_nonneg (b i j)))
    (hwle := hentry) (hcol := hcol) (hrow := hrow) (hd1 := hd1)
  simpa only [gramPairingContribution_eq_pairingSum_cycle, one_pow] using hb

name: NLAlib.integral_unit_gaussian_trace_pow_eq_sum_pairings
statement:
private lemma integral_unit_gaussian_trace_pow_eq_sum_pairings (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (d1 d2 : ℕ) :
    (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ,
        (((Y) *
          (Y)ᴴ) ^ p).trace
        ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2)) =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings (p + p),
        gramPairingContribution (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) p π
proof:
:= by
  have hof (Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ) :
      Matrix.of (fun i j => Y i j) = Y := rfl
  simpa only [one_mul, hof] using
    integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_sum_pairings_outer
    (I := Fin d1) (J := Fin d2)
    (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) p hp

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_pow_div_card_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_of_sq_bounds
statement:
theorem integral_trace_gram_pow_div_card_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_of_sq_bounds
    (b : I → J → ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (d1 d2 : ℕ)
    (hentry : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d1 : ℝ))
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d2 : ℝ))
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) :
    (∫ G : Matrix I J ℝ,
        (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ) ^ p).trace
        ∂ gaussianMatrix I J) / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤
      (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ,
        (((Y) *
          (Y)ᴴ) ^ p).trace
        ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2)) / (d1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_sum_pairings_outer b p hp]
  rw [integral_unit_gaussian_trace_pow_eq_sum_pairings p hp d1 d2]
  calc
    (∑ π : GaussianPairings (p + p), gramPairingContribution b p π) /
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ)
        = ∑ π : GaussianPairings (p + p),
            gramPairingContribution b p π / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
    _ ≤ ∑ π : GaussianPairings (p + p),
          gramPairingContribution (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) p π /
            (d1 : ℝ) := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun π _ =>
            gramPairingContribution_div_card_le_unit_profile b p hp π d1 d2 hentry hcol hrow hd1)
    _ = (∑ π : GaussianPairings (p + p),
          gramPairingContribution (fun (_ : Fin d1) (_ : Fin d2) => (1 : ℝ)) p π) /
            (d1 : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_pow_div_card_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_of_even_moments
statement:
theorem integral_trace_gram_pow_div_card_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_of_even_moments
    (hX : iIndepFun (fun e : I × J => X e.1 e.2) μ)
    (hsym : ∀ e : I × J, IdentDistrib (X e.1 e.2) (fun w => -X e.1 e.2 w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e : I × J, ∀ p, 0 < p →
      Integrable (fun w => (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
      ∫ w, (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p)
    (b : I → J → ℝ) (hb : ∀ e : I × J, 0 ≤ b e.1 e.2)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (d1 d2 : ℕ)
    (hentry : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d1 : ℝ))
    (hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d2 : ℝ))
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) :
    (∫ w, (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ p).trace ∂μ)
      / (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤
    (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ,
        (((Y) *
          (Y)ᴴ) ^ p).trace
        ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2)) / (d1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hI := integral_trace_gram_pow_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_nat hX hsym h2 b hb p
  have hG := integral_trace_gram_pow_div_card_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_of_sq_bounds (I := I) (J := J)
    b p hp d1 d2 hentry hcol hrow hd1
  have hcardNN : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hI hcardNN).trans hG

name: NLAlib.integral_normalizedTrace_gram_pow_le_integral_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_normalizedTrace_gram_pow_le_integral_gaussianMatrix
    (hX : iIndepFun (fun e : I × J => X e.1 e.2) μ)
    (hsym : ∀ e : I × J, IdentDistrib (X e.1 e.2) (fun w => -X e.1 e.2 w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e : I × J, ∀ p, 0 < p →
      Integrable (fun w => (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
      ∫ w, (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p)
    (b : I → J → ℝ) (hb : ∀ e : I × J, 0 ≤ b e.1 e.2)
    (hmax : (Finset.univ : Finset (I × J)).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun e => b e.1 e.2 ^ 2) = 1)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ w, normalizedTrace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ p) ∂μ) ≤
      (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin (Nat.ceil ((Finset.univ : Finset J).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => ∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2))))
          (Fin (Nat.ceil ((Finset.univ : Finset I).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun i => ∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2)))) ℝ,
        normalizedTrace (((Y) *
          (Y)ᴴ) ^ p)
        ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin (Nat.ceil ((Finset.univ : Finset J).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => ∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2))))
          (Fin (Nat.ceil ((Finset.univ : Finset I).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun i => ∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let sigma1Sq : ℝ :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset J).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => ∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2)
  let sigma2Sq : ℝ :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset I).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => ∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2)
  let d1 : ℕ := Nat.ceil sigma1Sq
  let d2 : ℕ := Nat.ceil sigma2Sq
  change (∫ w, normalizedTrace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ p) ∂μ) ≤
    (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ,
      normalizedTrace (((Y) *
        (Y)ᴴ) ^ p)
      ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2))
  have hentry : ∀ i j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ 1 := gram_entry_sq_le_one_of_gramEntryMaxSq_eq_one b hmax
  have hcol : ∀ j : J, (∑ i : I, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d1 : ℝ) := by
    intro j
    dsimp [d1, sigma1Sq]
    simpa [gramColMaxSum] using gram_col_sum_le_ceil_gramColMaxSum b j
  have hrow : ∀ i : I, (∑ j : J, b i j ^ 2) ≤ (d2 : ℝ) := by
    intro i
    dsimp [d2, sigma2Sq]
    simpa [gramRowMaxSum] using gram_row_sum_le_ceil_gramRowMaxSum b i
  have hd1 : 0 < d1 := by
    dsimp [d1, sigma1Sq]
    simpa [gramColMaxSum] using gramColMaxSum_ceil_pos b hmax
  have hcmp := integral_trace_gram_pow_div_card_le_integral_gaussianMatrix_of_even_moments (I := I) (J := J)
    hX hsym h2 b hb p hp d1 d2 hentry hcol hrow hd1
  have hintL : (∫ w,
        normalizedTrace (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ p) ∂μ) =
      (∫ w, (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ p).trace ∂μ) /
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by
    simp_rw [NLAlib.normalizedTrace]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hintR : (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ,
        normalizedTrace (((Y) *
          (Y)ᴴ) ^ p)
        ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2)) =
      (∫ Y : Matrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2) ℝ,
        (((Y) *
          (Y)ᴴ) ^ p).trace
        ∂ gaussianMatrix (Fin d1) (Fin d2)) / (d1 : ℝ) := by
    simp_rw [NLAlib.normalizedTrace]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    simp [Fintype.card_fin, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [hintL, hintR]
  simpa [d1, d2] using hcmp

name: NLAlib.abs_gaussian_wordNative_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_gaussian_wordNative_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    |(∫ x : ι → ℝ, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ p
        ∂gaussianVector ι) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) -
      ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation
        ((star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ) *
          resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) ζ) ^ p)).re) ^
            (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤
      ((2 * p + 1) * (2 * p + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) *
        (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) * specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)) *
        (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 5
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds (x :=
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ p
      ∂gaussianVector ι) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)))).sub
      ((tendsto_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment A₀ hA₀ A hA hζ p hp).rpow_const
        (Or.inr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))))
  apply le_of_tendsto ht.abs
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro N
  have hb := abs_integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_sub_le
    (n := Fin (N + 1)) A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ hp
  dsimp only at hb
  rw [integral_gaussianFreeFinite_resolventEvenMoment_one A₀ hA₀ A hA ζ hζ p] at hb
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_single_eq_sum_split
statement:
theorem fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_single_eq_sum_split
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) (x : E) (k : K) :
    fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc (n := n) A₀ A q ζ a b) x (Pi.single k 1) =
      ∑ j : Fin (a + b),
        gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ
          (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b j).2 x *
        gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k *
        gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ
          (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight a b j).2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (∑ l : K, (Pi.single k (1 : ℝ) : E) l • gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q l) =
      gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k := by simp
  have hd := fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_apply (n := n)
    A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ a b x (Pi.single k 1 : E)
  simp only [hh] at hd
  refine hd.trans ?_
  simpa only [gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc] using
    mixed_power_insertion_sum_eq_sum_split
      (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) ζ)
      (resolvent (gaussianFreeFiniteInterpolation A₀ A q x) (star ζ))
      (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q k) a b

name: NLAlib.sum_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_eq_crossing
statement:
theorem sum_nativeMixedArc_gradient_sandwich_eq_crossing
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (C : κ → M)
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (a b c e : ℕ) (x y : E) :
    (∑ k : K, ∑ i : κ, normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear (C i)
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ a b) x (Pi.single k 1))
      (fderiv ℝ (gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ c e) y (Pi.single k 1))) =
      (Fintype.card (d × n) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ l : Fin (a + b), ∑ m : Fin (c + e),
        coefficientCrossingTraceMultilinear C (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q)
          ![gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b l).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft a b l).2 x,
            gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitRight a b l).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight a b l).2 x,
            gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitLeft c e m).1 (mixedResolventSplitLeft c e m).2 y,
            gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc A₀ A q ζ (mixedResolventSplitRight c e m).1 (mixedResolventSplitRight c e m).2 y]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fderiv_gaussianFreeFiniteMixedArc_single_eq_sum_split A₀ hA₀ A hA q ζ hζ,
    normalizedSandwichTraceBilinear_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact sum_normalizedTrace_sandwich_sums_eq_inv_card_mul_sum_crossing C
    (gaussianFreeFiniteCoefficient A q) _ _ _ _

name: NLAlib.prod_gram_entries_eq_prod_pow_gramOccurrenceCount
statement:
theorem prod_gram_entries_eq_prod_pow_gramOccurrenceCount
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (q + 1) → m) (c : Fin (q + 1) → n) :
    (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), A (v t) (c t) * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t)) =
      ∏ e : m × n, A e.1 e.2 ^ gramOccurrenceCount q v c e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun t => A (v t) (c t)
  let g : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun t => A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t)
  calc
    (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), A (v t) (c t) * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t))
        = (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), f t) * (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), g t) := by
          simp [f, g, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    _ = ∏ x : Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1), Sum.elim f g x := by
          exact (Fintype.prod_sumElim f g).symm
    _ = ∏ x : Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1),
          A (gramOccurrenceIdx q v c x).1 (gramOccurrenceIdx q v c x).2 := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro x _
          cases x <;> simp [gramOccurrenceIdx, f, g]
    _ = ∏ e : m × n,
          A e.1 e.2 ^ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))).filter (fun x => gramOccurrenceIdx q v c x = e)).card := by
          exact Fintype.prod_fiber_pow (R := Fin (q + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) (E := m × n)
            (idx := gramOccurrenceIdx q v c) (z := fun e : m × n => A e.1 e.2)
    _ = ∏ e : m × n, A e.1 e.2 ^ gramOccurrenceCount q v c e := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro e _
          simp [gramOccurrenceCount]

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gramOccurrence
statement:
theorem trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gramOccurrence
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    ((A * Aᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace =
      ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
        ∏ e : m × n, A e.1 e.2 ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpow : ((A * Aᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace =
      (List.ofFn (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => A * Aᴴ)).prod.trace := by
    congr 1
    rw [List.ofFn_const, List.prod_replicate]
  have hmul : ∀ i j, (A * Aᴴ) i j = ∑ k : n, A i k * A j k := by
    intro i j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hprodsum : ∀ v : Fin (q + 1) → m,
      (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), ∑ k : n, A (v t) k * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) k) =
        ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n, ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
          A (v t) (c t) * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t) := by
    intro v
    calc
      (∏ t : Fin (q + 1), ∑ k : n, A (v t) k * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) k)
          = ∏ t : Fin (q + 1), ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n),
              A (v t) k * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) k := by simp
      _ = ∑ c ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => (Finset.univ : Finset n)),
            ∏ t : Fin (q + 1), A (v t) (c t) * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t) := by
            exact Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => (Finset.univ : Finset n))
              (fun t k => A (v t) k * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) k)
      _ = ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n, ∏ t : Fin (q + 1),
            A (v t) (c t) * A (v (finRotate (q + 1) t)) (c t) := by simp
  rw [hpow, Matrix.trace_list_ofFn_prod_eq_sum_cyclic (R := ℝ) (m := q) (n := m)
    (A := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => A * Aᴴ)]
  simp_rw [hmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  rw [hprodsum v]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  exact prod_gram_entries_eq_prod_pow_gramOccurrenceCount A q v c

name: NLAlib.gramCoeff_nonneg
statement:
private lemma gramCoeff_nonneg {b : m → n → ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ e : m × n, 0 ≤ b e.1 e.2) (q : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (q + 1) → m) (c : Fin (q + 1) → n) :
    0 ≤ gramCoeff b q r c
proof:
:= by
  unfold gramCoeff
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun e _ => pow_nonneg (hb e) _)

name: NLAlib.trace_gram_pow_eq_sum_coeff_mul_monomial
statement:
private theorem trace_gram_pow_eq_sum_coeff_mul_monomial
    (b X : m → n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j)) *
        (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace =
      ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
        gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
          X e.1 e.2 ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [trace_mul_conjTranspose_pow_eq_sum_gramOccurrence (A := Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j))]

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_pow_le_integral_gaussianVector
statement:
private theorem integral_trace_gram_pow_le_integral_gaussianVector
    (hX : iIndepFun (fun e : m × n => X e.1 e.2) μ)
    (hsym : ∀ e : m × n, IdentDistrib (X e.1 e.2) (fun w => -X e.1 e.2 w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e : m × n, ∀ p, 0 < p →
      Integrable (fun w => (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
      ∫ w, (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p)
    (b : m → n → ℝ) (hb : ∀ e : m × n, 0 ≤ b e.1 e.2)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∫ w, (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
        (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace ∂μ ≤
      ∫ x : m × n → ℝ, ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
        gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
          x e ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e ∂(gaussianVector (m × n))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∫ w, (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w)) *
          (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * X i j w))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace ∂μ
        = ∫ w, ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
            gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
              (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
      intro w
      dsimp only
      exact trace_gram_pow_eq_sum_coeff_mul_monomial (b := b) (X := fun i j => X i j w) q
    _ ≤ ∫ x : m × n → ℝ, ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
          gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
            x e ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e ∂(gaussianVector (m × n)) := by
      have hle := integral_sum_mul_prod_pow_le_integral_sum_mul_prod_pow_gaussianVector
        (E := m × n) (τ := (Fin (q + 1) → m) × (Fin (q + 1) → n))
        (X := fun e : m × n => X e.1 e.2)
        hX hsym h2
        (c := fun rc => gramCoeff b q rc.1 rc.2)
        (k := fun rc e => gramOccurrenceCount q rc.1 rc.2 e)
        (hc := fun rc => gramCoeff_nonneg hb q rc.1 rc.2)
      convert hle using 1
      · apply integral_congr_ae
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
        intro w
        dsimp only
        exact (Fintype.sum_prod_type' (f := fun r c =>
          gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
            (X e.1 e.2 w) ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e)).symm
      · apply integral_congr_ae
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
        intro x
        dsimp only
        exact (Fintype.sum_prod_type' (f := fun r c =>
          gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n, x e ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e)).symm

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_integral_gaussianVector_monomial
statement:
private theorem integral_trace_gram_pow_gaussianMatrix_eq_integral_gaussianVector_monomial
    (b : m → n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (∫ G : Matrix m n ℝ,
        (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
            (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace
        ∂(gaussianMatrix m n)) =
      ∫ x : m × n → ℝ, ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
        gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
          x e ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e ∂(gaussianVector (m × n))
proof:
:= by
  let e : MeasurableEquiv (m × n → ℝ) (Matrix m n ℝ) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.curry m n ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving e (gaussianVector (m × n)) (gaussianMatrix m n) :=
    ⟨e.measurable, gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry.symm⟩
  calc
    ∫ G : Matrix m n ℝ,
        (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
            (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace
        ∂(gaussianMatrix m n)
        = ∫ x : m × n → ℝ,
            (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * (e x) i j)) *
                (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * (e x) i j))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace
            ∂(gaussianVector (m × n)) := by
          exact (hmp.integral_comp' (fun G : Matrix m n ℝ =>
            (((Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j)) *
                (Matrix.of (fun i j => b i j * G i j))ᴴ) ^ (q + 1)).trace)).symm
    _ = ∫ x : m × n → ℝ, ∑ r : Fin (q + 1) → m, ∑ c : Fin (q + 1) → n,
          gramCoeff b q r c * ∏ e : m × n,
            x e ^ gramOccurrenceCount q r c e ∂(gaussianVector (m × n)) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
      intro x
      dsimp only
      simp only [e, MeasurableEquiv.trans_apply, Matrix.coe_ofMeasurableEquiv,
        MeasurableEquiv.curry_apply, Matrix.of_apply]
      rw [trace_gram_pow_eq_sum_coeff_mul_monomial (b := b) (X := fun i j => x (i, j)) q]

name: NLAlib.abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (S : Set ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : d → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2) (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    |Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i)) S -
      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀ + ∑ i, y i • A i)) S| ≤
        σ * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs (x : ι → ℝ) : (∑ i, x i • A i).IsHermitian :=
    isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)
  have hx := hA₀.add (hs x)
  have hy := hA₀.add (hs y)
  have hd : (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i) - (A₀ + ∑ i, y i • A i) =
      ∑ i, (x i - y i) • A i := by
    simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    abel
  refine (abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_sub_le_specNorm_sub hx hy S).trans ?_
  rw [hd]
  exact specNorm_sum_smul_le_of_quadratic_energy A hA hσ henergy _

      Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀ + ∑ i, y i • A i)) S| ≤
        Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy A₀ hA₀ A hA S
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  intro u hu

name: NLAlib.integral_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_le_of_half_measure
statement:
theorem integral_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_le_of_half_measure
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (S : Set ℝ) (hpos : 0 < bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ) {a : ℝ}
    (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (gaussianVector ι).real
      {x | Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i)) S ≤ a}) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A₀ + ∑ i, x i • A i)) S
      ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ a + 4 * Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_le_of_half_measure_sublevel_gaussianVector _ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos)
    (fun x y => abs_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_sub_le_bilinearSquareMass A₀ hA₀ A hA S x y) hhalf

name: NLAlib.measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_gt_of_half_measure
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectrum_affineSeries_gt_of_half_measure
    (A₀ : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.integral_stein_energy_eq
statement:
theorem integral_stein_energy_eq
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (D DD : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ)
    (hF : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => F (Function.update x i y))
      (D i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hD : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => D i (Function.update x i y))
      (DD i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hfi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * D i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hxi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hgi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hddi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * DD i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)) :
    (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) + ψ (F x) * (∑ i, DD i x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)) =
    ∫ x, ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  let μ : Measure (ι → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1
  have hcoord (i : ι) :
      (∫ x, x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2 + ψ (F x) * DD i x ∂μ := by
    apply integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_gaussian_of_hasDerivAt_update
      (fun x => ψ (F x) * D i x)
      (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2 + ψ (F x) * DD i x) i ?_
      (hfi i) (hxi i) ((hgi i).add (hddi i))
    intro x t
    convert! (((hψ (F (Function.update x i t))).hasDerivAt.comp t (hF i x t)).mul
      (hD i x t)) using 1
    simp only [Function.comp_def]
    ring
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, ∑ i, (deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2 + ψ (F x) * DD i x) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2 + ψ (F x) * DD i x ∂μ :=
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hgi i).add (hddi i))
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ x, x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x) ∂μ :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hcoord i).symm
    _ = ∫ x, ∑ i, x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x) ∂μ :=
      (integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hxi i)).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring

name: NLAlib.integral_stein_shift_eq
statement:
theorem integral_stein_shift_eq
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (D DD : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ) (b : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => F (Function.update x i y))
      (D i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hD : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => D i (Function.update x i y))
      (DD i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hψi : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hfi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * D i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hxi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hgi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hddi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * DD i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)) :
    (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) +
      (b - ∑ i, x i * D i x) * ψ (F x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)) =
    ∫ x, (b - ∑ i, DD i x) * ψ (F x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  let μ : Measure (ι → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1
  have hAi : Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2)) μ := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hgi i)
  have hCi : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * (∑ i, DD i x)) μ := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hddi i)
  have hBi : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x)) μ := by
    have hh := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hxi i)
    convert! hh using 1
    funext x
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have he := integral_stein_energy_eq F D DD ψ hψ hF hD hfi hxi hgi hddi
  rw [integral_add hAi hCi] at he
  have hleft :
      (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) +
          (b - ∑ i, x i * D i x) * ψ (F x) ∂μ) =
      (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) ∂μ) +
        b * (∫ x, ψ (F x) ∂μ) -
          ∫ x, ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x) ∂μ := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) +
          (b - ∑ i, x i * D i x) * ψ (F x)) =
        (fun x => (deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) + b * ψ (F x)) -
          ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x)) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [hfun]
    have hs :
        (∫ x, (deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) + b * ψ (F x)) -
          ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x) ∂μ) =
        (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) + b * ψ (F x) ∂μ) -
          ∫ x, ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x) ∂μ :=
      integral_sub (hAi.add (hψi.const_mul b)) hBi
    have ha :
        (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) + b * ψ (F x) ∂μ) =
        (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) ∂μ) + ∫ x, b * ψ (F x) ∂μ :=
      integral_add hAi (hψi.const_mul b)
    rw [hs, ha, integral_const_mul]
  have hright :
      (∫ x, (b - ∑ i, DD i x) * ψ (F x) ∂μ) =
        b * (∫ x, ψ (F x) ∂μ) - ∫ x, ψ (F x) * (∑ i, DD i x) ∂μ := by
    have hfun : (fun x => (b - ∑ i, DD i x) * ψ (F x)) =
        (fun x => b * ψ (F x) - ψ (F x) * (∑ i, DD i x)) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [hfun, integral_sub (hψi.const_mul b) hCi, integral_const_mul]
  rw [hleft, hright]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_nonneg_of_gaussian_coordinate_approximation
statement:
theorem integral_nonneg_of_gaussian_coordinate_approximation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : ℕ → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (D DD : ℕ → ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (X A' B' C' : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ) (b K P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hψ0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ ψ t) (hψP : ∀ t, ψ t ≤ P)
    (hF : ∀ n i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => F n (Function.update x i y))
      (D n i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hD : ∀ n i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => D n i (Function.update x i y))
      (DD n i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hψi : ∀ n, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hfi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * D n i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hxi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F n x) * D n i x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hgi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F n x) * D n i x ^ 2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hddi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * DD n i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hupper : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      (∑ i, DD n i x) ≤ K)
    (hFlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (X x)))
    (hAlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (A' x)))
    (hBlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, x i * D n i x) atTop (𝓝 (B' x)))
    (hClim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, DD n i x) atTop (𝓝 (C' x)))
    (hC' : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1), C' x ≤ b)
    (bound : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hboundi : Integrable bound (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      ‖deriv ψ (F n x) * (∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) +
        (b - ∑ i, x i * D n i x) * ψ (F n x)‖ ≤ bound x) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x, deriv ψ (X x) * A' x + (b - B' x) * ψ (X x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  let μ : Measure (ι → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1
  have hAi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F n x) * (∑ i, D n i x ^ 2)) μ := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hgi n i)
  have hCi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * (∑ i, DD n i x)) μ := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hddi n i)
  have hBi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * (∑ i, x i * D n i x)) μ := by
    have hh := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hxi n i)
    convert! hh using 1
    funext x
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hLi (n : ℕ) : Integrable
      (fun x => deriv ψ (F n x) * (∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) +
        (b - ∑ i, x i * D n i x) * ψ (F n x)) μ := by
    convert! ((hAi n).add ((hψi n).const_mul b)).sub (hBi n) using 1
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hRi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => (b - ∑ i, DD n i x) * ψ (F n x)) μ := by
    convert! ((hψi n).const_mul b).sub (hCi n) using 1
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg_of_shift_identity_limit μ F
    (fun n x => ∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) (fun n x => ∑ i, x i * D n i x)
    (fun n x => ∑ i, DD n i x) X A' B' C' ψ (deriv ψ)
    hψ.continuous (hψ.continuous_deriv le_rfl) b K P hP hψ0 hψP hLi hRi
    (fun n => integral_stein_shift_eq (F n) (D n) (DD n) ψ
      (hψ.differentiable one_ne_zero) b (hF n) (hD n) (hψi n) (hfi n)
      (hxi n) (hgi n) (hddi n))
    hupper hFlim hAlim hBlim hClim hC' bound hboundi hbound

name: NLAlib.two_mul_add_one_pow_le
statement:
private lemma two_mul_add_one_pow_le {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp18 : p ≤ 18) :
    (2 * p + 1) ^ (2 * p + 2) ≤ 46 ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  interval_cases p <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.forty_six_le_two_pi_mul_exp_sq
statement: private lemma forty_six_le_two_pi_mul_exp_sq : (46 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi * Real.exp 1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have hpi := Real.pi_gt_d2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.mul_log_le_of_le_eighteen
proof:
:= by
  have hint : ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (2 * p + 2) ≤ ((46 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (2 * p) := by
    exact_mod_cast two_mul_add_one_pow_le hp hp18
  push_cast at hint
  have h46 : (46 : ℝ) ^ (2 * p) ≤ (2 * Real.pi * Real.exp 1 ^ 2) ^ (2 * p) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) forty_six_le_two_pi_mul_exp_sq _
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * p + 1) ^ (2 * p + 2) := by positivity
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpos (hint.trans h46)
  rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
    Real.log_pow, Real.log_exp] at hlog
  push_cast at hlog
  linarith

name: NLAlib.one_add_div_mul_inv_Gamma_rpow_le
statement:
theorem one_add_div_mul_inv_Gamma_rpow_le {p x : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp18 : p ≤ 18)
    (hx : 2 * p ≤ x) :
    (1 + 2 * (p : ℝ) / ((x : ℝ) + 1 - 2 * p))
        * (1 / Real.Gamma ((x : ℝ) + 2)) ^ (2 * (p : ℝ) / ((x : ℝ) + 1))
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 / x) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hxR : 2 * (p : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hx
  set X : ℝ := (x : ℝ) with hX
  set c : ℝ := 2 * (p : ℝ) with hc
  set n : ℝ := X + 1 with hn
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hc]; linarith
  have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
  have hnc : 0 < n - c := by rw [hn]; linarith
  have hG : Real.Gamma (X + 2) = ((x + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    have h2 : ((x + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = X + 2 := by rw [hX]; push_cast; ring
    rw [← Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial, h2]
  set F : ℝ := ((x + 1).factorial : ℝ) with hF
  have hF0 : 0 < F := by rw [hF]; exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos _
  rw [hG]
  set a : ℝ := 1 + c / (X + 1 - c) with ha
  have ha' : a = n / (n - c) := by
    have hd : X + 1 - c ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [ha, hn]; field_simp; ring
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by rw [ha']; positivity
  have hL : 0 < a * (1 / F) ^ (c / n) := by positivity
  have hR : 0 < (Real.exp 1 / X) ^ (2 * p) := by positivity
  have hF1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / F := by positivity
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / F) ^ (c / n) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hF1 _
  rw [← Real.log_le_log_iff hL hR, Real.log_mul ha0.ne' hrp.ne',
    Real.log_rpow hF1, Real.log_pow, Real.log_div (Real.exp_pos 1).ne' hX0.ne',
    Real.log_exp, one_div, Real.log_inv]
  
  have hS1 : (1 / 2) * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * n) + n * Real.log n - n ≤ Real.log F := by
    have h := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling (x + 1)
    have hcast : ((x + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = n := by rw [hn, hX]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast] at h
    have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * n) * (n / Real.exp 1) ^ (x + 1) := by positivity
    have hl := Real.log_le_log hpos h
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_sqrt (by positivity),
      Real.log_pow, Real.log_div hn0.ne' (Real.exp_pos 1).ne', Real.log_exp] at hl
    have hcast2 : ((x + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = n := hcast
    rw [hcast2] at hl
    linarith
  
  have hS2 : n * (Real.log n - Real.log (n - c)) ≤ (c + 1) * Real.log (c + 1) := by
    have hconc := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.concaveOn
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ (c + 1) / n := by positivity
    have hb1 : (c + 1) / n ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hn0]; rw [hn]; linarith
    have h : (1 - (c + 1) / n) • Real.log 1 + ((c + 1) / n) • Real.log (1 / (c + 1))
        ≤ Real.log ((1 - (c + 1) / n) • (1 : ℝ) + ((c + 1) / n) • (1 / (c + 1))) :=
      hconc.2 (Set.mem_Ioi.2 one_pos) (Set.mem_Ioi.2 (by positivity)) (by linarith) hb0
        (by ring)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, Real.log_one, mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one] at h
    have hpt : 1 - (c + 1) / n + (c + 1) / n * (1 / (c + 1)) = (n - c) / n := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [hpt, Real.log_div hnc.ne' hn0.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv] at h
    have h2 : n * ((c + 1) / n * -Real.log (c + 1)) ≤ n * (Real.log (n - c) - Real.log n) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hn0.le
    have h3 : n * ((c + 1) / n * -Real.log (c + 1)) = -((c + 1) * Real.log (c + 1)) := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  
  have hS3 : n * Real.log X - n * Real.log n ≤ -1 := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (x := n / X) (by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div hn0.ne' hX0.ne', inv_div] at h
    have h1 : 1 - X / n = 1 / n := by rw [hn]; field_simp; ring
    rw [h1] at h
    have h2 : n * (1 / n) ≤ n * (Real.log n - Real.log X) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hn0.le
    rw [mul_one_div_cancel hn0.ne'] at h2
    linarith
  
  have hS4 : (c + 2) * Real.log (c + 1) ≤ c * (Real.log (2 * Real.pi) + 2) := by
    have := mul_log_le_of_le_eighteen hp hp18
    rw [hc]; linarith
  
  have hS5 : Real.log (2 * Real.pi * (c + 1)) ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.pi * n) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by
      have : c + 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; linarith
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hS5' : Real.log (2 * Real.pi * (c + 1)) = Real.log (2 * Real.pi) + Real.log (c + 1) :=
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hla : Real.log a = Real.log n - Real.log (n - c) := by
    rw [ha', Real.log_div hn0.ne' hnc.ne']
  rw [hla]
  have hpc : ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) = c := by rw [hc]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hpc]
  have key : n * (Real.log n - Real.log (n - c)) - c * Real.log F
      ≤ n * (c * (1 - Real.log X)) := by
    have e1 : c * ((1 / 2) * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * n) + n * Real.log n - n)
        ≤ c * Real.log F := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS1 hc0.le
    have e3 : c * (n * Real.log X - n * Real.log n) ≤ c * (-1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS3 hc0.le
    have e5 : c * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * (c + 1)) ≤ c * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * n) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS5 hc0.le
    rw [hS5'] at e5
    nlinarith
  have hfin : n * (Real.log n - Real.log (n - c) + c / n * -Real.log F)
      ≤ n * (c * (1 - Real.log X)) := by
    have : n * (Real.log n - Real.log (n - c) + c / n * -Real.log F)
        = n * (Real.log n - Real.log (n - c)) - c * Real.log F := by field_simp; ring
    rw [this]; exact key
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hfin hn0

name: NLAlib.inv_Gamma_mul_rpow_le
statement:
private lemma inv_Gamma_mul_rpow_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (K R t : ℝ) (hRK : R ≤ K)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (1 / Real.Gamma ((N : ℝ) + 1)) * (1 / t ^ 2 * (K + R) / 2) ^ ((N : ℝ) / 2)
      ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * N)) * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt K / N) ^ (N : ℝ)
          * t ^ (-(N : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hNR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := le_trans hR hRK
  rw [Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have hst := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling N
  have hS0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * N) * (N / Real.exp 1) ^ N := by
    have : 0 < 2 * Real.pi * N := by positivity
    positivity
  set y : ℝ := 1 / t ^ 2 * (K + R) / 2 with hy_def
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by positivity
  have hy : y ^ ((N : ℝ) / 2) = (Real.sqrt y) ^ N := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hy0]
    ring_nf
  have hsy : Real.sqrt y = Real.sqrt ((K + R) / 2) / t := by
    rw [show y = ((K + R) / 2) / t ^ 2 by rw [hy_def]; ring,
      Real.sqrt_div' _ (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq ht.le]
  have hle : Real.sqrt ((K + R) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt K := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  rw [hy, hsy, Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_neg ht.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < N.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos N
  calc 1 / (N.factorial : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt ((K + R) / 2) / t) ^ N
      ≤ 1 / (N.factorial : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt K / t) ^ N := by
        gcongr
    _ ≤ 1 / (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * N) * (N / Real.exp 1) ^ N) * (Real.sqrt K / t) ^ N := by
        gcongr
    _ = 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * N) * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt K / N) ^ N * (t ^ N)⁻¹ := by
        have h1 : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * N) ≠ 0 := by
          have : 0 < 2 * Real.pi * N := by positivity
          positivity
        have h2 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        simp only [div_pow, mul_pow]
        field_simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_le_of_hasLaw'
statement:
private lemma integrable_and_integral_le_of_hasLaw'
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    {F : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Measurable F) {c : ℝ}
    (h : Integrable F (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, F G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ≤ c) :
    Integrable (fun w => F (X w)) μ ∧ ∫ w, F (X w) ∂μ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, le_of_eq_of_le (hX.integral_comp hF.aestronglyMeasurable) h.2⟩
  have hI : Integrable F (μ.map X) := by rw [hX.map_eq]; exact h.1
  exact hI.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le_of_pos
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le_of_pos {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).real {G | t < specNorm (pinvR G)}
      ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)))
          * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt k / ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)) ^ ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)
          * t ^ (-((k : ℝ) - r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : 0 < (k : ℝ) - r + 1 := by
    have : (r : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    linarith
  have hc : 0 ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)))
      * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt k / ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)) ^ ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)
      * t ^ (-((k : ℝ) - r + 1)) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg zero_le_one (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by positivity) hgap.le) _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg ht.le _)
  rw [measureReal_def]
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hc ?_
  have hsub : {G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ | t < specNorm (pinvR G)}
      ⊆ {G | singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / t ^ 2} := by
    intro G hG
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hG ⊢
    have hunit : IsUnit (G * Gᵀ) := by
      by_contra hunit
      have hz : (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ = 0 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit _
        (fun hdet => hunit ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr hdet))
      have hp : pinvR G = 0 := by
        simp only [pinvR, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hz, Matrix.mul_zero]
      rw [hp, specNorm_zero] at hG
      exact (not_lt_of_ge ht.le) hG
    have hsq : specNorm (pinvR G) ^ 2 = 1 / singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [specNorm_pinvR_sq G hunit, specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_eq G hunit]
    have h1 : t ^ 2 < 1 / singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hsq]; exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ hG ht.le (by norm_num)
    have hs2 : 0 < singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 := by
      rcases (sq_nonneg (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1))).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [← h, div_zero] at h1; nlinarith
    have ht2 : 0 < t ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hs2] at h1
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ht2]
    linarith
  refine (measure_mono hsub).trans ?_
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := hr
  rw [← ofReal_measureReal (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
    (s := {G | singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / t ^ 2})]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  refine (gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le hr1 hrk (1 / t ^ 2) (by positivity)).trans ?_
  set N : ℕ := k - r + 1 with hN_def
  have hN : (N : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) - r + 1 := by
    rw [hN_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hrk]; push_cast; ring
  have hN2 : (k : ℝ) - r + 2 = (N : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hN]; ring
  rw [hN2, ← hN]
  have hRK : (r : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
  have := inv_Gamma_mul_rpow_le (N := N) (by omega) (k : ℝ) (r : ℝ) t hRK (by positivity) ht
  convert this using 3

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le_of_hasLaw
statement:

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hrk : r + 1 ≤ k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => specNorm (pinvR G)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    ∫ G, specNorm (pinvR G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
      ≤ Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt k / ((k : ℝ) - r)
proof:
:= by
  have hrk' : r < k := by omega
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp hr hrk'
  refine ⟨hint, hbound.trans ?_⟩
  have hgap : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) - r := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hrk')
  have hcast : (r : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hrk'
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt k :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  calc Real.exp 1 / ((k : ℝ) - r) * Real.sqrt (((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / 2)
      ≤ Real.exp 1 / ((k : ℝ) - r) * Real.sqrt k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt k / ((k : ℝ) - r) := by ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le_of_hasLaw
statement:

:=
  integrable_and_integral_le_of_hasLaw' hX measurable_specNorm_pinvR
    (integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le hr hrk)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_pow_gaussianMatrix_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_pow_gaussianMatrix_le
    {r k p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp18 : p ≤ 18) (hrk : r + 2 * p ≤ k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    ∫ G, specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr0 | hr1
  · subst hr0
    have hf : (fun G : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin k) ℝ =>
        specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p) = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext G
      rw [specNorm_of_isEmpty, zero_pow (by omega)]
    rw [hf]
    refine ⟨integrable_zero _ _ _, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_zero]
    positivity
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := by omega
  have hrk' : r < k := by omega
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)
  have hgap : 2 * (p : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - r := by
    have h : ((r + 2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    push_cast at h
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp
      hr hrk' (p := (p : ℝ)) hpR (by linarith)
  simp_rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at hint hbound
  refine ⟨hint, hbound.trans ?_⟩
  have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hkR : (r : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hrk'
  have hC : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2) := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    · positivity
  have hle : Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2) := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hC hle p

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_pow_gaussianMatrix_le_of_hasLaw
statement:

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k p : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp18 : p ≤ 18) (hrk : r + 2 * p ≤ k) :
    Integrable (fun w => specNorm (X w * (X w)ᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p) μ ∧
    ∫ w, specNorm (X w * (X w)ᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p ∂μ
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^ p
proof:
:=
  integrable_and_integral_le_of_hasLaw' hX
    (measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose.pow_const p)
    (integrable_and_integral_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_pow_gaussianMatrix_le hp hp18 hrk)

name: NLAlib.matrix_entry_sq_le_frobSq
statement:
private lemma matrix_entry_sq_le_frobSq {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) : G i j ^ 2 ≤ frobSq G
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, ← sq]
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => sq_nonneg (G i a)) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans

name: NLAlib.norm_weak_expression_le
statement:
private lemma norm_weak_expression_le {ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℝ} {P Q s A B b y : ℝ}
    (_hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAs : A ≤ 4 * s)
    (hBs : |B| ≤ 2 * s) (hψ : ‖ψ y‖ ≤ P) (hψ' : ‖ψ' y‖ ≤ Q) :
    ‖ψ' y * A + (b - B) * ψ y‖ ≤ (4 * Q + 2 * P) * s + |b| * P
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ‖ψ' y * A‖ ≤ Q * (4 * s) := by
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hA]
    exact mul_le_mul hψ' hAs hA hQ
  have hsecond : ‖(b - B) * ψ y‖ ≤ (|b| + 2 * s) * P := by
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hsub : |b - B| ≤ |b| + 2 * s := (abs_sub b B).trans (add_le_add le_rfl hBs)
    exact mul_le_mul hsub hψ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  calc _ ≤ ‖ψ' y * A‖ + ‖(b - B) * ψ y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ Q * (4 * s) + (|b| + 2 * s) * P := add_le_add hfirst hsecond
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_softMin_update
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_softMin_update
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (x : Fin r × Fin k → ℝ) (i : Fin r × Fin k) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => inversePowerSoftMin n
      (regularizedGram ε (Matrix.of (fun a b => Function.update x i y (a, b)))))
      (gramSoftMinGradient n ε (Matrix.of (fun a b => Function.update x i t (a, b))) i.1 i.2) t
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
  let H : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ := Matrix.of (fun a b => Function.update x i t (a, b))
  let E : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ := Matrix.single i.1 i.2 1
  have heq (y : ℝ) : Matrix.of (fun a b => Function.update x i y (a, b)) = H + (y - t) • E := by
    have h := matrixOf_curry_update_eq_add_single (Function.update x i t) i.1 i.2 y
    simpa only [Prod.mk.eta, Function.update_idem, Function.update_self] using h
  have h := (hasDerivAt_gramSoftMin_single_zero n hn hε H i.1 i.2).comp_of_eq t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const t) (by simp)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, heq, sub_self, mul_one, id_eq, zero_smul, add_zero, E] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_mul_bounded_test
statement:
private lemma integrable_mul_bounded_test {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (f φ : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (P : ℝ) (hP : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ ≤ P) : Integrable (fun x => φ x * f x) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (hf.norm.const_mul P).mono' (hφ.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hf.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
