    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hP x) (norm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_weak_shift_nonneg_gaussianMatrix
statement:
private theorem integral_weak_shift_nonneg_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ) (hψ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x)
    (P Q : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hψP : ∀ x, ‖ψ x‖ ≤ P) (hψQ : ∀ x, ‖deriv ψ x‖ ≤ Q) :
    0 ≤ ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      deriv ψ (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 + ε) * (4 * singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) +
        (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) - 2 * singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) *
          ψ (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 + ε) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
  let μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)
  let ν : Measure ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1
  let e := (MeasurableEquiv.curry (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ).trans Matrix.ofMeasurableEquiv
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving e ν μ := ⟨e.measurable, (gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry).symm⟩
  let G : ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ := fun x => (e x)
  let X : ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => singularValues (G x)ᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2
  let S : ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => frobSq (G x)
  let F : ℕ → ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun n x => inversePowerSoftMin (n + 1) (regularizedGram ε (G x))
  let D : ℕ → (Fin r × Fin k) → ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun n i x => gramSoftMinGradient (n + 1) ε (G x) i.1 i.2
  let DD : ℕ → (Fin r × Fin k) → ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun n i x => gramSoftMinSecond (n + 1) ε (G x) (Matrix.single i.1 i.2 1)
  let b : ℝ := 2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)
  have hSi : Integrable S ν := hmp.integrable_comp_of_integrable (integrable_frobSq_gaussianMatrix r k)
  have hSnn (x) : 0 ≤ S x := frobSq_nonneg _
  have hFm (n) : Measurable (F n) :=
    (measurable_inversePowerSoftMin_regularizedGram (n + 1) ε).comp e.measurable
  have hDm (n i) : Measurable (D n i) :=
    (measurable_gramSoftMinGradient_entry (n + 1) ε i.1 i.2).comp e.measurable
  have hDDm (n i) : Measurable (DD n i) :=
    (measurable_gramSoftMinSecond_single (n + 1) ε i.1 i.2).comp e.measurable
  have henergy (n x) : (∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) = frobSq (gramSoftMinGradient (n + 1) ε (G x)) := by
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, D, frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, ← sq]
  have heuler (n x) : (∑ i, x i * D n i x) = frobInner (G x) (gramSoftMinGradient (n + 1) ε (G x)) := by
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, D, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, G, e, MeasurableEquiv.trans_apply, Matrix.coe_ofMeasurableEquiv, MeasurableEquiv.curry_apply,
      Matrix.of_apply]
  have hlap (n x) : (∑ i, DD n i x) = gramSoftMinLaplacian (n + 1) ε (G x) := by
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, DD, gramSoftMinLaplacian]
  have hAs (n x) : (∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * S x := by
    rw [henergy]
    exact frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_le (n + 1) (by omega) hε (G x)
  have hBs (n x) : |∑ i, x i * D n i x| ≤ 2 * S x := by
    rw [heuler]
    exact abs_frobInner_gramSoftMinGradient_le (n + 1) (by omega) hε (G x)
  have hDiSq (n i x) : D n i x ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S x :=
    (matrix_entry_sq_le_frobSq _ i.1 i.2).trans
      (frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_le (n + 1) (by omega) hε (G x))
  have hDi (n i) : Integrable (D n i) ν := by
    refine ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add (hSi.const_mul 4)).mono' (hDm n i).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      change |D n i x| ≤ 1 + 4 * S x
      have h := hDiSq n i x
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|D n i x| - 1), sq_abs (D n i x)]
  have hDi2 (n i) : Integrable (fun x => D n i x ^ 2) ν := by
    refine (hSi.const_mul 4).mono' ((hDm n i).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]; exact hDiSq n i x
  have hxiDi (n i) : Integrable (fun x => x i * D n i x) ν := by
    refine (hSi.const_mul 5).mono' ((measurable_pi_apply i).mul (hDm n i)).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      have hx : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ S x := matrix_entry_sq_le_frobSq (G x) i.1 i.2
      have hd := hDiSq n i x
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|x i| - |D n i x|), sq_abs (x i), sq_abs (D n i x)]
  have hψm (n) : Measurable (fun x => ψ (F n x)) := hψ.continuous.measurable.comp (hFm n)
  have hψ'm (n) : Measurable (fun x => deriv ψ (F n x)) :=
    (hψ.continuous_deriv le_rfl).measurable.comp (hFm n)
  have hψi (n) : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x)) ν := by
    refine (integrable_const P).mono' (hψm n).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => hψP _
  have hfi (n i) : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * D n i x) ν :=
    integrable_mul_bounded_test _ _ (hDi n i) (hψm n) P (fun x => hψP _)
  have hxi (n i) : Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F n x) * D n i x)) ν := by
    have h := integrable_mul_bounded_test _ _ (hxiDi n i) (hψm n) P (fun x => hψP _)
    convert h using 1
    funext x
    ring
  have hgi (n i) : Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F n x) * D n i x ^ 2) ν :=
    integrable_mul_bounded_test _ _ (hDi2 n i) (hψ'm n) Q (fun x => hψQ _)
  have hddi (n i) : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * DD n i x) ν := by
    have hd : Integrable (DD n i) ν := hmp.integrable_comp_of_integrable
      (integrable_gramSoftMinSecond_single_gaussianMatrix (by omega) (n + 1) (by omega) ε hε i.1 i.2)
    exact integrable_mul_bounded_test _ _ hd (hψm n) P (fun x => hψP _)
  have hAgg : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν,
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (X x + ε)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (4 * X x)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, x i * D n i x) atTop (𝓝 (2 * X x)) := by
    have h := ae_tendsto_regularizedGram_softMin_aggregates_gaussianMatrix hr hrk ε hε
    rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry] at h
    filter_upwards [ae_of_ae_map e.measurable.aemeasurable h] with x hx
    refine ⟨hx.1.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [henergy, Function.comp_def, G, X] using hx.2.1.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    · simpa only [heuler, Function.comp_def, G, X] using hx.2.2.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hCex : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ∃ L : ℝ, L ≤ b ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, DD n i x) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    have h := ae_exists_tendsto_gramSoftMinLaplacian_le_gaussianMatrix hr hrk ε hε
    rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry] at h
    filter_upwards [ae_of_ae_map e.measurable.aemeasurable h] with x hx
    obtain ⟨L, hL, ht⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hlap, Function.comp_def, G] using ht.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  let C' : ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x =>
    if h : ∃ L : ℝ, L ≤ b ∧ Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, DD n i x) atTop (𝓝 L)
      then Classical.choose h else 0
  have hClim : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, DD n i x) atTop (𝓝 (C' x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hCex] with x hx
    simpa only [C', dif_pos hx] using (Classical.choose_spec hx).2
  have hC' : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, C' x ≤ b := by
    filter_upwards [hCex] with x hx
    simpa only [C', dif_pos hx] using (Classical.choose_spec hx).1
  let bound : ((Fin r × Fin k) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => (4 * Q + 2 * P) * S x + |b| * P
  have hboundi : Integrable bound ν := (hSi.const_mul _).add (integrable_const _)
  have hweak := integral_nonneg_of_gaussian_coordinate_approximation
    F D DD (fun x => X x + ε) (fun x => 4 * X x) (fun x => 2 * X x) C' ψ hψ b (2 * k) P hP
    hψ0 (fun x => (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hψP x))
    (fun n i x t => hasDerivAt_softMin_update hr (n + 1) (by omega) ε hε x i t)
    (fun n i x t => hasDerivAt_gradient_update hr (n + 1) (by omega) ε hε x i t)
    hψi hfi hxi hgi hddi
    (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [hlap]
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, gramSoftMinLaplacian] using
        sum_gramSoftMinSecond_single_le (n + 1) (by omega) hε (G x))
    (hAgg.mono fun x hx => hx.1) (hAgg.mono fun x hx => hx.2.1) (hAgg.mono fun x hx => hx.2.2)
    hClim hC' bound hboundi
    (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun x => norm_weak_expression_le hP hQ (hSnn x)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) (hAs n x) (hBs n x) (hψP _) (hψQ _))
  have hXm : Measurable (fun H : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => singularValues Hᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) :=
    measurable_sigmaMin_transpose_sq
  have htest : Measurable (fun H : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      deriv ψ (singularValues Hᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 + ε) * (4 * singularValues Hᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) +
        (b - 2 * singularValues Hᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) * ψ (singularValues Hᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 + ε)) := by
    exact (((hψ.continuous_deriv le_rfl).measurable.comp (hXm.add_const ε)).mul
      (measurable_const.mul hXm)).add
      ((measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul hXm)).mul
        (hψ.continuous.measurable.comp (hXm.add_const ε)))
  rw [gaussianMatrix_eq_map_curry, integral_map e.measurable.aemeasurable htest.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact hweak

name: NLAlib.integral_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_weak_nonneg_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_weak_nonneg_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hψ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) :
    0 ≤ ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      4 * singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 * deriv ψ (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) +
        2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1 - singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) *
          ψ (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
  have hψ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := hψ.of_le (by simp)
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hψ.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hψc
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := (hψ1.continuous_deriv le_rfl).bounded_above_of_compact_support hψc.deriv
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := (norm_nonneg (ψ 0)).trans (hP 0)
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := (norm_nonneg (deriv ψ 0)).trans (hQ 0)
  let X : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → ℝ := fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2
  let b : ℝ := 2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)
  let bound : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun G => (4 * Q + 2 * P) * frobSq G + |b| * P
  have hXi : Measurable X := measurable_sigmaMin_transpose_sq
  have hboundi : Integrable bound (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) :=
    ((integrable_frobSq_gaussianMatrix r k).const_mul _).add (integrable_const _)
  have hweak := MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg_of_positive_translates (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
    X (fun G => 4 * X G) (fun G => 2 * X G) ψ (deriv ψ) hψ.continuous
    (hψ1.continuous_deriv le_rfl) b
    (fun ε _ => by
      exact (((hψ1.continuous_deriv le_rfl).measurable.comp (hXi.add_const ε)).mul
        (measurable_const.mul hXi)).add
        ((measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul hXi)).mul
          (hψ.continuous.measurable.comp (hXi.add_const ε))) |>.aestronglyMeasurable)
    bound hboundi
    (fun ε _ => ae_of_all _ fun G => by
      have hX : 0 ≤ X G := sq_nonneg _
      have hXs : X G ≤ frobSq G := by
        have h := (singularValues_le_specNorm Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1)).trans
          (specNorm_le_frobNorm Gᵀ)
        have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (singularValues_nonneg Gᵀ _) h 2
        simpa only [X, frobNorm_sq, frobSq_transpose] using hh
      apply norm_weak_expression_le hP0 hQ0 (frobSq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXs (by norm_num)) ?_ (hP _) (hQ _)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * X G)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXs (by norm_num))
    (fun ε hε => integral_weak_shift_nonneg_gaussianMatrix hr hrk ε hε ψ hψ1 hψ0 P Q hP0 hQ0 hP hQ)
  have heq : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      4 * singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 * deriv ψ (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) +
        2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1 - singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) * ψ (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2))
      = (fun G => deriv ψ (X G) * (4 * X G) + (b - 2 * X G) * ψ (X G)) := by
    funext G
    dsimp only [X, b]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hweak

name: NLAlib.integral_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_law_weak_nonneg_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_law_weak_nonneg_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hψ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), 4 * x * deriv ψ x + 2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1 - x) * ψ x
      ∂((gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).map (fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2) :=
    measurable_sigmaMin_transpose_sq
  have hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂((gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).map (fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2)),
      x ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) :=
    (ae_map_iff hm.aemeasurable measurableSet_Ioi).2
      (ae_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_pos_gaussianMatrix hr hrk)
  have hφ : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => 4 * x * deriv ψ x + 2 * ((k : ℝ) - r + 1 - x) * ψ x) := by
    have hψ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := hψ.of_le (by simp)
    exact ((measurable_const.mul measurable_id).mul (hψ1.continuous_deriv le_rfl).measurable).add
      ((measurable_const.mul (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)).mul hψ.continuous.measurable)
  rw [Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hpos, integral_map hm.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_weak_nonneg_gaussianMatrix hr hrk ψ hψ hψc hψ0

name: NLAlib.integrable_test_mul_unshiftedGramGradient_single_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_test_mul_unshiftedGramGradient_single_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi 0) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      ψ (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) *
        gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hψ.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hψc
  have hψzero : ψ 0 = 0 :=
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport fun h => lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ) (hψs h)
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := by simpa only [hψzero, norm_zero] using hP 0
  have hFm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) := by
    simpa only [regularizedGram_zero] using
      (measurable_inversePowerSoftMin_regularizedGram (ι := Fin r) (κ := Fin k) n 0)
  have hDm := measurable_gramSoftMinGradient_entry (ι := Fin r) (κ := Fin k) n 0 i j
  have hm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      ψ (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) *
        gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j) :=
    (hψ.continuous.measurable.comp hFm).mul hDm
  apply integrable_of_abs_le_frobSq_polynomial_gaussianMatrix r k 1 _ hm 0 (2 * P)
  intro G
  have hG := frobSq_nonneg G
  have hDsq := sq_gramSoftMinGradient_unshifted_single_le n hn G i j
  have hDabs : |gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j| ≤ 2 * (1 + frobSq G) := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 + frobSq G))).mp
    rw [sq_abs]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (frobSq G)]
  rw [abs_mul]
  have hh := mul_le_mul
    (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      hP (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)))
    hDabs (abs_nonneg _) hP0
  simpa only [zero_add, pow_one, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.integrable_coordinate_mul_test_mul_unshiftedGramGradient_single_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_mul_test_mul_unshiftedGramGradient_single_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi 0) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      G i j * (ψ (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) *
        gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hψ.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hψc
  have hψzero : ψ 0 = 0 :=
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport fun h => lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ) (hψs h)
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := by simpa only [hψzero, norm_zero] using hP 0
  have hFm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) := by
    simpa only [regularizedGram_zero] using
      (measurable_inversePowerSoftMin_regularizedGram (ι := Fin r) (κ := Fin k) n 0)
  have hDm := measurable_gramSoftMinGradient_entry (ι := Fin r) (κ := Fin k) n 0 i j
  have hEntry : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => G i j) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply j).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      G i j * (ψ (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) *
        gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j)) :=
    hEntry.mul ((hψ.continuous.measurable.comp hFm).mul hDm)
  apply integrable_of_abs_le_frobSq_polynomial_gaussianMatrix r k 2 _ hm 0 (2 * P)
  intro G
  have hG := frobSq_nonneg G
  have hDsq := sq_gramSoftMinGradient_unshifted_single_le n hn G i j
  have hDabs : |gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j| ≤ 2 * (1 + frobSq G) := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 + frobSq G))).mp
    rw [sq_abs]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (frobSq G)]
  have hrowsq : G i j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j', G i j' ^ 2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j' _ => sq_nonneg (G i j')) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hfullsq : (∑ j', G i j' ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i', ∑ j', G i' j' ^ 2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j' _ => sq_nonneg (G i' j'))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hEsq : G i j ^ 2 ≤ frobSq G := by
    simpa only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, Matrix.of_apply, ← pow_two] using hrowsq.trans hfullsq
  have hEabs : |G i j| ≤ 1 + frobSq G := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + frobSq G)).mp
    rw [sq_abs]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (frobSq G)]
  have htest :
      |ψ (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)) *
        gramSoftMinGradient n 0 G i j| ≤ 2 * P * (1 + frobSq G) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    have hh := mul_le_mul
      (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        hP (inversePowerSoftMin n (G * Gᵀ)))
      hDabs (abs_nonneg _) hP0
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hh
  rw [abs_mul]
  have hh := mul_le_mul hEabs htest (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + frobSq G)
  convert! hh using 1
  simp only [zero_add]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r ≤ k) (i : Fin r) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hqd : q < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i) ^ q) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i) ^ q
      ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)))
      = Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) /
        (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hdcast : ((k - r + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) - r + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hrk, Nat.cast_one]
  have hlaw := gaussianMatrix_map_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self hrk i
  have hD : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i) :=
    measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply i i
  have hS : Measurable (fun x : Fin (k - r + 1) → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    fun_prop
  have hφ : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => s ^ q) := by fun_prop
  have hint := integrable_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
    (d := k - r + 1) q hq (by simpa [hdcast] using hqd)
  have hval := integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
    (d := k - r + 1) q hq (by simpa [hdcast] using hqd)
  constructor
  · have h := (integrable_map_measure hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hS.aemeasurable).mpr hint
    rw [← hlaw] at h
    exact (integrable_map_measure hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hD.aemeasurable).mp h
  · rw [← integral_map hD.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable, hlaw,
      integral_map hS.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable, hval, hdcast]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_unit_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_unit_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r ≤ k) (u : Fin r → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqd : q < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (u ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ u)) ^ q) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      (u ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ u)) ^ q ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)))
      = Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) /
        (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := by
    by_contra h
    have : r = 0 := by omega
    subst r
    simp [dotProduct] at hu
  let i : Fin r := ⟨0, hr⟩
  let V : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin 1) ℝ := Matrix.of fun a _ => u a
  have hV : Vᵀ * V = 1 := by
    ext a b
    fin_cases a
    fin_cases b
    change (∑ a, u a * u a) = 1
    exact hu
  let e : Fin 1 ↪ Fin r := ⟨fun _ => i, fun a b _ => Subsingleton.elim a b⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUcol⟩ := exists_unitary_completion V hV e
  have hUi : ∀ a, U a i = u a := fun a => hUcol a 0
  let T : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) :=
    fun G => (Uᵀ * G * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ))
  have hTm : Measurable T := (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id).matrix_mul measurable_const
  have hUt : U * Uᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
  have hUt' : HasOrthonormalCols Uᵀ := by simpa [HasOrthonormalCols] using hUt
  have hrot : MeasurePreserving T (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) :=
    (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal Uᵀ 1 hUt' (by simp [HasOrthonormalCols])).measurePreserving
      hTm
  let F : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → ℝ := fun G =>
    ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i) ^ q
  have hFm : Measurable F := (measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply i i).pow_const q
  have hFT : F ∘ T = fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (u ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ u)) ^ q := by
    funext G
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, F, T, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [inv_self_mul_transpose_orthogonal_mul Uᵀ hUt', Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    congr 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hUi, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b hb
    ring
  obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self_gaussianMatrix hrk i q hq hqd
  constructor
  · rw [← hFT]
    exact hrot.integrable_comp_of_integrable hint
  · rw [← hFT]
    change (∫ G, F (T G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) = _
    rw [← integral_map hTm.aemeasurable hFm.aestronglyMeasurable, hrot.map_eq]
    exact hval

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r ≤ k) (v : Fin r → ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqd : q < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ^ q) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      (v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ^ q ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)))
      = (v ⬝ᵥ v) ^ q *
        (Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) /
          (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · subst v
    simp [Real.zero_rpow hq.ne']
  let S : ℝ := v ⬝ᵥ v
  have hS0 : 0 < S := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (by
    simpa [S, eq_comm] using (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.not.mpr hv))
  let c : ℝ := Real.sqrt S
  have hc0 : 0 < c := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hS0
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := hc0.ne'
  have hcsq : c ^ 2 = S := Real.sq_sqrt hS0.le
  let u : Fin r → ℝ := c⁻¹ • v
  have hcu : c • u = v := by simp [u, smul_smul, hcne]
  have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
    simp only [u, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    change c⁻¹ * (c⁻¹ * S) = 1
    rw [← hcsq]
    field_simp
  have hscale : ∀ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      (v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ^ q
        = S ^ q * (u ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ u)) ^ q := by
    intro G
    have hform : v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)
        = S * (u ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ u)) := by
      rw [← hcu, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, hcsq]
    have hQ : 0 ≤ u ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ u) := by
      simpa using (posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose G).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
    rw [hform, Real.mul_rpow hS0.le hQ]
  obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_unit_gaussianMatrix
      hrk u hu q hq.le hqd
  constructor
  · simpa only [hscale] using hint.const_mul (S ^ q)
  · simp_rw [hscale]
    rw [integral_const_mul, hval]

name: NLAlib.lintegral_rpow_sq_dotProduct_unit_pi_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_sq_dotProduct_unit_pi_gaussianReal {r : ℕ}
    (v : Fin r → ℝ) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    (∫⁻ z : Fin r → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal ((v ⬝ᵥ z) ^ 2) ^ q
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1))
      = ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : Measurable (fun z : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (z ^ 2) ^ q) := by fun_prop
  have hm : Measurable (fun z : Fin r → ℝ => v ⬝ᵥ z) := by
    unfold dotProduct
    fun_prop
  have hvnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, hv, Real.sqrt_one]
  rw [← lintegral_map hφ hm, (hasLaw_dotProduct_gaussianVector v hvnorm).map_eq]
  have hint := (memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := 0) (v := 1)
    (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * q)) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).integrable_norm_rpow'
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * q)] at hint
  have hfun : (fun z : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (z ^ 2) ^ q)
      = fun z : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (|z| ^ (2 * q)) := by
    funext z
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg z) hq, ← sq_abs,
      ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg _)]
    congr 2
  rw [hfun, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
  · rw [integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal q hq]
  · simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id_eq] using hint
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun z => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg z) _

name: NLAlib.lintegral_lintegral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem lintegral_lintegral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqd : q < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) :
    (∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, ∫⁻ v : Fin r → ℝ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ^ q
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)))
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2 + q) /
          Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) /
          (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2))))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)
  let ν := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1
  let a : ℝ := Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) /
    (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2))
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
    have h1 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q by linarith)
    have h2 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 by linarith)
    positivity
  have hjoint : Measurable (fun z : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) × (Fin r → ℝ) =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (z.2 ⬝ᵥ ((z.1 * z.1ᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ z.2)) ^ q) := by
    have hm (i j : Fin r) : Measurable (fun z : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) × (Fin r → ℝ) =>
        (z.1 * z.1ᵀ)⁻¹ i j) :=
      (measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply i j).comp measurable_fst
    have hz (i : Fin r) : Measurable (fun z : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) × (Fin r → ℝ) =>
        z.2 i) := (measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd
    exact ((Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hz i).mul
      (Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ fun j _ => (hm i j).mul (hz j))).ennreal_ofReal).pow_const q
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap hjoint.aemeasurable]
  have hinner : ∀ v : Fin r → ℝ,
      (∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal (v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ^ q ∂μ)
        = ENNReal.ofReal ((v ⬝ᵥ v) ^ q * a) := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ :=
      integrable_and_integral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
        hrk v q hq hqd
    have hnonneg : ∀ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
        0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v) := fun G => by
      simpa using (posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose G).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
    simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hnonneg _) hq.le]
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
      (ae_of_all _ fun G => Real.rpow_nonneg (hnonneg G) _), hval]
  change (∫⁻ v : Fin r → ℝ, (∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
    ENNReal.ofReal (v ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ^ q ∂μ) ∂ν) = _
  simp_rw [hinner]
  have hint := (integrable_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector r q hq.le).mul_const a
  simp_rw [dotProduct, ← sq]
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
    (ae_of_all _ fun v => mul_nonneg
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) _) ha0),
    integral_mul_const, integral_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector r hr q hq.le]

name: NLAlib.ofReal_rpow_specNorm_mul_gaussian_moment_le_lintegral
statement:
theorem ofReal_rpow_specNorm_mul_gaussian_moment_le_lintegral {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt Real.pi) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (specNorm A) ^ q
      ≤ ∫⁻ z : Fin r → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (z ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z)) ^ q
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hdet⟩ := exists_unit_specNorm_mul_dotProduct_sq_le hA
  have hproj : Measurable (fun z : Fin r → ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((v ⬝ᵥ z) ^ 2) ^ q) := by
    unfold dotProduct
    fun_prop
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt Real.pi) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (specNorm A) ^ q
      = ENNReal.ofReal (specNorm A) ^ q *
          ∫⁻ z : Fin r → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal ((v ⬝ᵥ z) ^ 2) ^ q
            ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1) := by
        rw [lintegral_rpow_sq_dotProduct_unit_pi_gaussianReal v hv q hq, mul_comm]
    _ = ∫⁻ z : Fin r → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (specNorm A * (v ⬝ᵥ z) ^ 2) ^ q
          ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1) := by
        simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (specNorm_nonneg A), ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hq]
        rw [lintegral_const_mul _ hproj]
    _ ≤ _ := lintegral_mono fun z =>
      ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hdet z)) hq

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_le
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqd : q < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q
      ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) ≤
      Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2 + q) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) *
        Real.sqrt Real.pi /
        (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) *
          Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)
  let c : ℝ := 2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt Real.pi
  let a : ℝ := (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2 + q) / Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2)) *
    (Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) /
      (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)))
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < r)
  have hG1 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < (r : ℝ) / 2 by positivity)
  have hG2 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < (r : ℝ) / 2 + q by positivity)
  have hG3 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q by linarith)
  have hG4 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 by linarith)
  have hG5 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < q + 1 / 2 by linarith)
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hcm0 : ENNReal.ofReal c ≠ 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.2 hc
  have hcmT : ENNReal.ofReal c ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hL : ENNReal.ofReal c *
      (∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal
        (specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹) ^ q ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a := by
    rw [← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ hcmT]
    calc (∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal
        (specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹) ^ q ∂μ)
        ≤ ∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, ∫⁻ z : Fin r → ℝ,
          ENNReal.ofReal (z ⬝ᵥ ((G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ z)) ^ q
          ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin r => gaussianReal 0 1) ∂μ :=
          lintegral_mono fun G => ofReal_rpow_specNorm_mul_gaussian_moment_le_lintegral
            hr (posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose G) q hq.le
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal a :=
      lintegral_lintegral_rpow_dotProduct_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix hr hrk q hq hqd
  have hbound : (∫⁻ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal
      (specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹) ^ q ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a / c) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_right hL (ENNReal.ofReal c)⁻¹
    rw [← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hcm0 hcmT, one_mul,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)] at h
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h
  have hnn : ∀ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      0 ≤ specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q :=
    fun G => Real.rpow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
  have hm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q) :=
    measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose.pow_const q
  simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) hq.le] at hbound
  have hint : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q) μ := by
    refine ⟨hm.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ hnn)]
    exact hbound.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hreal : (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q ∂μ) ≤ a / c := by
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint (ae_of_all _ hnn)] at hbound
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (div_nonneg ha hc.le)).1 hbound
  refine ⟨hint, hreal.trans_eq ?_⟩
  dsimp [a, c]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqd : q < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (X ω * (X ω)ᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q) μ ∧
    (∫ ω, specNorm (X ω * (X ω)ᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q ∂μ) ≤
      Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2 + q) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q) *
        Real.sqrt Real.pi /
        (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) *
          Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_le hr hrk q hq hqd
  have hm : Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q :=
    measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose.pow_const q
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ q)
        (μ.map X) := by
      rw [hX.map_eq]; exact hint
    exact h.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable
  · refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hval
    exact hX.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_lintegral_of_weak_inequality
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_lintegral_of_weak_inequality
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k)
    (hweak : ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi 0 → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) →
      0 ≤ ∫ x in Ioi 0, 4 * x * deriv ψ x +
        2 * (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) - x) * ψ x
        ∂((gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).map (fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2)))
    (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) {G | singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t} ≤
      ∫⁻ y in Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, ENNReal.ofReal
        ((2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2) /
          (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1))) *
          y ^ (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2) * Real.exp (-y / 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hanti, hnn, hdens⟩ :=
    exists_gamma_weighted_antitone_density_of_weak_inequality
      ((gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).map (fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2))
      ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) hweak
  have he : ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - 1 = ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2 := by ring
  simp_rw [he] at hdens
  exact gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_lintegral_of_antitone_density
    hr hrk h hh hnn hanti hdens t

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)

    (hweak : ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi 0 → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) →
      0 ≤ ∫ x in Ioi 0, 4 * x * deriv ψ x +
        2 * (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) - x) * ψ x
        ∂((gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).map (fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2)))
    (t : ℝ) :
    μ {w | singularValues (X w)ᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t} ≤
      ∫⁻ y in Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, ENNReal.ofReal
        ((2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2) /
          (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1))) *
          y ^ (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2) * Real.exp (-y / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hX.measure_eq (p := fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t)
    (measurableSet_le measurable_sigmaMin_transpose_sq measurable_const)]
  exact gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_lintegral_of_weak_inequality hr hrk hweak t

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
private lemma integrable_and_integral_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    {F : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Measurable F) {c : ℝ}
    (h : Integrable F (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, F G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ≤ c) :
    Integrable (fun w => F (X w)) μ ∧ ∫ w, F (X w) ∂μ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, le_of_eq_of_le (hX.integral_comp hF.aestronglyMeasurable) h.2⟩
  have hI : Integrable F (μ.map X) := by rw [hX.map_eq]; exact h.1
  exact hI.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_half_gap_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_half_gap_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r < k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ (((k : ℝ) - r) / 2))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ (((k : ℝ) - r) / 2)
      ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^
        (((k : ℝ) - r) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < r)
  have hgap : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) - r := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hrk)
  let q : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) - r) / 2
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_le
      hr hrk.le q hq (by dsimp [q]; linarith)
  refine ⟨hint, hbound.trans ?_⟩
  have h1 : (r : ℝ) / 2 + q = (k : ℝ) / 2 := by dsimp [q]; ring
  have h2 : ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 - q = 1 / 2 := by dsimp [q]; ring
  have h3 : q + 1 / 2 = ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 := by dsimp [q]; ring
  rw [h1, h2, h3, Real.Gamma_one_half_eq]
  have hnorm :
      Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) / 2) * Real.sqrt Real.pi * Real.sqrt Real.pi /
        (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) *
          Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)) =
      2 ^ (-q) * Real.pi * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) / 2) /
        (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    have hG1 := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < (r : ℝ) / 2 by positivity)).ne'
    have hG2 := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos
      (show 0 < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 by linarith)).ne'
    have hpow := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) q).ne'
    field_simp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_pos.le]
  rw [hnorm]
  simpa only [q, neg_div] using gamma_inverse_spectral_endpoint_le hr hrk

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r < k) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p ≤ ((k : ℝ) - r) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_half_gap_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le hr hrk
  have hC : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2) := by
    have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
    have hkR : (r : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    · positivity
  exact ⟨MeasureTheory.integrable_rpow_of_nonneg_of_le
    measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose.aestronglyMeasurable
    (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _) hp.le (hp.trans_le hpq).le hpq hint,
    integral_rpow_le_of_integral_rpow_le
    measurable_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose.aestronglyMeasurable
    (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _) hp hpq hC hint hbound⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp_of_hasLaw

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_rpow_inv_le_sharp
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_rpow_inv_le_sharp
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r < k) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p ≤ ((k : ℝ) - r) / 2) :
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp hr hrk hp hpq
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ p ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
  have hC : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2) := by
    have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
    have hkR : (r : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    · positivity
  calc _ ≤
      ((Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
        (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hnonneg hbound (by positivity)
    _ = _ := Real.rpow_rpow_inv hC hp.ne'

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_rpow_inv_le_sharp_of_hasLaw
statement:

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r < k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => specNorm (pinvR G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    (∫ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ, specNorm (pinvR G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) ≤
      Real.exp 1 / ((k : ℝ) - r) * Real.sqrt (((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) - r := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hrk)
  have hgap1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - r := by
    have h : ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    push_cast at h
    linarith
  have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hkR : (r : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
  have hnum : 0 ≤ ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_rpow_specNorm_inv_gaussianMatrix_le_sharp
      hr hrk (p := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hf : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) =ᵐ[gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)]
      (fun G => specNorm (pinvR G)) := by
    filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose hrk.le] with G hG
    rw [← specNorm_pinvR_sq G hG, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (specNorm_nonneg _)]
    norm_num
  rw [integral_congr_ae hf] at hbound
  refine ⟨hint.congr hf, hbound.trans_eq ?_⟩
  let B : ℝ := Real.exp 1 / ((k : ℝ) - r) * Real.sqrt (((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / 2)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  have hCsq : Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2) = B ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [mul_pow, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hnum]
    field_simp [hgap.ne']
  change (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) /
    (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = B
  rw [hCsq, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hB]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.sigmaMin_transpose_sq_of_one
statement:
private lemma sigmaMin_transpose_sq_of_one {k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    singularValues Gᵀ (0) ^ 2 = ∑ j, G 0 j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : ∀ x : {x : Fin 1 → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1},
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Gᵀ *ᵥ x.1)‖
        = Real.sqrt (∑ j, G 0 j ^ 2) := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
    congr 1
    have hx0 : x 0 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) hx
      rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hh
      simpa [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_one, sq] using hh
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_one]
    calc ∑ j, G 0 j * x 0 * (G 0 j * x 0) = ∑ j, G 0 j ^ 2 * x 0 ^ 2 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
      _ = ∑ j, G 0 j ^ 2 := by simp [hx0]
  have hne : Nonempty {x : Fin 1 → ℝ // ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1} :=
    ⟨⟨fun _ => 1, by simp [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, dotProduct]⟩⟩
  change singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin 1) - 1) ^ 2 = _
  rw [singularValues_last_eq_iInf]
  simp_rw [hconst]
  rw [ciInf_const, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.integral_Ioi_indicator_eq
statement:
private lemma integral_Ioi_indicator_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (k - 1) * (Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2)
        * (Iic (Real.sqrt t)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y)
      = (1 / 2) * ∫ x in Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, x ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.exp (-x / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_comp_rpow_Ioi
    (fun x : ℝ => (Iic t).indicator (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (x ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2)
      * Real.exp (-x / 2))) x) (p := 2) (by norm_num)
  have hR : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ x in Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, x ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.exp (-x / 2)
      = ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Iic t).indicator (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (x ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2)
          * Real.exp (-x / 2))) y := by
    rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic, Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_Iic,
      Set.Iic_inter_Ioi, integral_const_mul]
  rw [hR, ← h]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y (hy : 0 < y) => ?_
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have hiff : y ^ (2 : ℝ) ∈ Iic t ↔ y ∈ Iic (Real.sqrt t) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_two, Set.mem_Iic, Set.mem_Iic, Real.le_sqrt hy.le]
    exact ht
  by_cases hyt : y ∈ Iic (Real.sqrt t)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyt, Set.indicator_of_mem (hiff.2 hyt)]
    have hpow : y ^ (k - 1) = y ^ ((2 : ℝ) - 1) * (y ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hy.le, ← Real.rpow_add hy, ← Real.rpow_natCast, Nat.cast_sub hk]
      congr 1; push_cast; ring
    rw [hpow, abs_two, Real.rpow_two]
    ring
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyt, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hyt (hiff.1 h))]
    simp

name: NLAlib.rankOne_const_mul
statement:
private lemma rankOne_const_mul {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
        / (Real.Gamma (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (k : ℝ))
      * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-(((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / 2) * (1 / 2)
        * Real.Gamma ((((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / 2)) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hc : ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = k := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hc]
  have hdup := Real.Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half ((k : ℝ) / 2)
  rw [show (k : ℝ) / 2 + 1 / 2 = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 by ring, show 2 * ((k : ℝ) / 2) = k by ring]
    at hdup
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℝ) / 2) = 2 ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) := by
    rw [one_div, Real.inv_rpow (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num)]
    congr 1; ring
  rw [hhalf, Real.Gamma_one_half_eq]
  have gk := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < k by linarith)
  have gk2 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < k / 2 by linarith)
  have hpi : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.2 Real.pi_pos
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * 2 ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) * 2 ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num),
      show ((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2 + k / 2 + (1 - k) = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff (by positivity)]
  calc 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
        * (2 ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) / 2))
      = 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * 2 ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) * (Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) / 2)
          * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)) * (1 / 2) := by ring
    _ = 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * 2 ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) * 2 ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))
          * (Real.sqrt π * Real.Gamma k) * (1 / 2) := by rw [hdup]; ring
    _ = 1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt π * Real.Gamma k) := by rw [h2]; ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_one_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_eq
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_one_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin k)) {G | singularValues Gᵀ (0) ^ 2 ≤ t}
      = ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal
          (2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
              / (Real.Gamma (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (k : ℝ))
            * x ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.exp (-x / 2))
proof:
:= by
  set c : ℝ := 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
              / (Real.Gamma (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (k : ℝ)) with hc
  set a : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) - 2) / 2 with ha
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have ha1 : -1 < a := by rw [ha]; linarith
  have hcpos : 0 ≤ c := by
    rw [hc]
    have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < k by linarith)
    have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 by linarith)
    positivity
  set T : Set (Fin k → ℝ) := {g | ∑ j, g j ^ 2 ≤ t} with hT
  have hTm : MeasurableSet T := measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have hset : {G : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin k) ℝ | singularValues Gᵀ (0) ^ 2 ≤ t}
      = (fun G => G 0) ⁻¹' T := by
    ext G; simp [hT, sigmaMin_transpose_sq_of_one]
  rw [hset, gaussianMatrix_one_preimage T hTm]
  set ν := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1 with hν
  set φ : ℝ → ℝ := (Iic (Real.sqrt t)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) with hφ
  have hνT : ν.real T = ∫ x, φ (Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2)) ∂ν := by
    rw [← integral_indicator_one hTm]
    congr 1; ext x
    have hs : Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∈ Iic (Real.sqrt t) ↔ x ∈ T := by
      rw [Set.mem_Iic, Real.sqrt_le_sqrt_iff ht]; rfl
    by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, hφ, Set.indicator_of_mem (hs.2 hx)]; rfl
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, hφ, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hx (hs.1 h))]
  have h1 := integral_radial_gaussianVector k hk (fun _ => 1)
  have h2 := integral_radial_gaussianVector k hk φ
  simp only [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h1
  rw [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one] at h1
  rw [integral_pow_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two] at h1
  rw [hφ, integral_Ioi_indicator_eq hk ht] at h2
  set I : ℝ := ∫ x in Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2) with hI
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2)) (Ioc 0 t) := by
    have hpow : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ a) (Ioc 0 t) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ht).1
        (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (a := 0) (b := t) ha1)
    refine hpow.mono' (by fun_prop) ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _)
      (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ x ^ a := Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _
    have h2 : Real.exp (-x / 2) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith [hx.1])
    nlinarith
  have hRHS : ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2))
      = ENNReal.ofReal (c * I) := by
    rw [hI, ← integral_const_mul, ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
    · simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    · exact hint.const_mul c
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with x hx
      exact mul_nonneg hcpos (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  rw [hRHS, ← ofReal_measureReal, hνT, h2]
  congr 1
  have hconst := rankOne_const_mul hk
  rw [← hc] at hconst
  set K := (k : ℝ) * (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))).real (Metric.ball 0 1)
    * (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ k with hK
  set J := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-(((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / 2) * (1 / 2)
        * Real.Gamma ((((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / 2) with hJ
  have h1' : 1 = K * J := by rw [h1, hK]; ring
  calc (k : ℝ) * (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))).real (Metric.ball 0 1)
        * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ k * (1 / 2 * I))
      = K * (1 / 2) * I := by rw [hK]; ring
    _ = K * (c * J) * I := by rw [hconst]
    _ = (K * J) * c * I := by ring
    _ = c * I := by rw [← h1']; ring
