name: NLAlib.Gamma_half_sq_le_mul_prod
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) < ((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 := by positivity
    have hg : Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 + 1 / 2) ^ 2
        ≤ ((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 * Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n) / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 + 1 / 2) :=
        (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)).le
      calc Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 + 1 / 2) ^ 2
          ≤ (Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n) / 2) * √(((r : ℝ) + n) / 2)) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 (Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt hz) 2
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hz.le]; ring
    have he : ((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 + 1 / 2 = ((r : ℝ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 2 := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [he] at hg
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    calc Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 2) ^ 2
        ≤ ((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 * Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n) / 2) ^ 2 := hg
      _ ≤ ((r : ℝ) + n) / 2 * (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2
            * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (((r : ℝ) + i) / 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hz.le
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.prod_range_add_le_pow
statement:
theorem prod_range_add_le_pow (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + i) ≤ ((2 * r + n) / 2) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set M := (2 * r + n) / 2 with hM
  have hpos : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ r + (i : ℝ) := fun i _ => by positivity
  have hP : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + (i : ℝ)) := Finset.prod_nonneg hpos
  have hMpos : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; positivity
  have hrefl : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + (i : ℝ)) := by
    have := Finset.prod_range_reflect (fun i : ℕ => r + (i : ℝ)) (n + 1)
    simpa using this
  have hsq : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + (i : ℝ))) ^ 2 ≤ (M ^ (n + 1)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq]
    calc (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + (i : ℝ))) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + (i : ℝ))
        = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + (i : ℝ)))
            * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (r + ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by rw [hrefl]
      _ = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((r + (i : ℝ)) * (r + ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
          (Finset.prod_mul_distrib).symm
      _ ≤ ∏ _i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), M ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro i _; positivity
          · intro i hi
            have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hin, hM]
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((i : ℝ) - ((n : ℝ) - i))]
      _ = (M ^ (n + 1)) ^ 2 := by rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range, ← pow_mul,
            ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hP (pow_nonneg hMpos _) two_ne_zero).1 hsq

name: NLAlib.gammaRatio_le
statement:
theorem gammaRatio_le {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) :
    2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
        / (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1))
      ≤ (((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) / (2 * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hrk
  have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  push_cast
  have e1 : ((r : ℝ) + n) - r - 1 = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by ring
  have e2 : ((r : ℝ) + n) - r + 1 = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by ring
  rw [e1, e2]
  set M : ℝ := ((r : ℝ) + n + r) / 2 with hM
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by rw [hM]; positivity
  have gR := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < r / 2 by positivity)
  have gK := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < ((r : ℝ) + n + 1) / 2 by positivity)
  have gN := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)
  have key : 2 ^ (n + 1) * Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n + 1) / 2) ^ 2
      ≤ Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 * M ^ (n + 1) := by
    have h1 := Gamma_half_sq_le_mul_prod hr (n + 1)
    have h2 := prod_range_add_le_pow (r : ℝ) hrpos.le n
    have hc : ((r : ℝ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 2 = ((r : ℝ) + n + 1) / 2 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hc] at h1
    have hprod : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (((r : ℝ) + i) / 2)
        = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((r : ℝ) + i)) / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range]
    rw [hprod] at h1
    have hM' : (2 * (r : ℝ) + n) / 2 = M := by rw [hM]; ring
    rw [hM'] at h2
    have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (n + 1) := by positivity
    calc 2 ^ (n + 1) * Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n + 1) / 2) ^ 2
        ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2
            * ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((r : ℝ) + i)) / 2 ^ (n + 1))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h2pos.le
      _ = Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((r : ℝ) + i) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 * M ^ (n + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
  have hsqrt : (2 : ℝ) ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((r : ℝ) + n + 1) / 2)
      ≤ Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * M ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2) := by
    have hx : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2) = Real.sqrt (x ^ (n + 1)) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
      congr 1; push_cast; ring
    rw [hx 2 (by norm_num), hx M hMpos.le]
    have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt key
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq gK.le,
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq gR.le] at this
    linarith
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  have h2split : (2 : ℝ) ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2) = 2 ^ (((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2) * 2 := by
    rw [show ((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2 = ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2 + 1 by ring, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num),
      Real.rpow_one]
  rw [h2split] at hsqrt
  have hgN := gN.le
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrt hgN]

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)).real {G | singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t}
      ≤ (1 / Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 2))
          * (t * ((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 ≤ (1 / Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 2))
      * (t * ((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) := by
    have hrk' : (r : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) - r + 2 by linarith)
    positivity
  rw [measureReal_def]
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hpos ?_
  set c5 : ℝ := 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
      / (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)) with hc5
  set c6 : ℝ := (((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)
      / (2 * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1)) with hc6
  set a : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) / 2 with ha
  have hrk' : (r : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
  have ha1 : -1 < a := by rw [ha]; linarith
  have hgN := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) - r + 1 by linarith)
  have hc6pos : 0 ≤ c6 := by rw [hc6]; positivity
  have hD1 := gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_lintegral hr hrk t ht
  have hD2 : c5 ≤ c6 := gammaRatio_le hr hrk
  have hD3 := lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_le ha1 ht.le
  calc (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) {G | singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t}
      ≤ ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (c5 * x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2)) := hD1
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal c6 * ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2)) := by
        refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioc fun x hx => ?_
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc6pos]
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        have : 0 ≤ x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2) :=
          mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD2 this
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal c6 * ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ a * Real.exp (-x / 2)) :=
        lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c6 * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a + 1) / (a + 1)) := by gcongr
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 2))
          * (t * ((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc6pos]
        congr 1
        have hE : a + 1 = ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 := by rw [ha]; ring
        have hEpos : 0 < ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2 := by linarith
        have hG2 : Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 2)
            = ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) := by
          rw [show (k : ℝ) - r + 2 = ((k : ℝ) - r + 1) + 1 by ring,
            Real.Gamma_add_one (by linarith)]
        have hsplit : (t * ((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)
            = t ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) * (((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) := by
          rw [show t * ((k : ℝ) + r) / 2 = t * (((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) by ring,
            Real.mul_rpow ht.le (by positivity)]
        rw [hE, hsplit, hG2, hc6]
        field_simp

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {w | singularValues (X w)ᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t}
      ≤ (1 / Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) - r + 2))
          * (t * ((k : ℝ) + r) / 2) ^ (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun G => singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ t)
    (measurableSet_le measurable_sigmaMin_transpose_sq measurable_const)]
  exact gaussianMatrix_sigmaMin_transpose_sq_le_le hr hrk t ht

name: NLAlib.integrable_one_add_frobSq_gaussianMatrix_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_one_add_frobSq_gaussianMatrix_pow (r k p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => (1 + frobSq G) ^ p)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  have hFm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq G) :=
    measurable_frobSq_of_entries fun i j => Matrix.measurable_entry i j
  have hm : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => (1 + frobSq G) ^ p) := by
    fun_prop
  have hdom : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (1 + (r : ℝ) * k) ^ p * (1 + ‖G‖) ^ (2 * p)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) :=
    (integrable_const_add_norm_gaussianMatrix_pow r k (2 * p) 1 (by norm_num)).const_mul _
  apply hdom.mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards with G
  have hf := frobSq_nonneg G
  have hN := norm_nonneg G
  have hd : 0 ≤ (r : ℝ) * k := by positivity
  have hNsq : ‖G‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ‖G‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + ‖G‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hbase : 1 + frobSq G ≤ (1 + (r : ℝ) * k) * (1 + ‖G‖) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 1 + (r : ℝ) * k * ‖G‖ ^ 2 :=
        add_le_add (le_refl _) (frobSq_of_le_card_mul_sq_norm G)
      _ ≤ (1 + ‖G‖) ^ 2 + ((r : ℝ) * k) * (1 + ‖G‖) ^ 2 :=
        add_le_add hone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNsq hd)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + frobSq G) hbase p
  rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul] at hp
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + frobSq G) p)]
  exact hp

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_abs_le_frobSq_polynomial_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_of_abs_le_frobSq_polynomial_gaussianMatrix
    (r k p : ℕ) (f : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (C D : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ G, |f G| ≤ C + D * (1 + frobSq G) ^ p) :
    Integrable f (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      C + D * (1 + frobSq G) ^ p) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) :=
    (integrable_const C).add
      ((integrable_one_add_frobSq_gaussianMatrix_pow r k p).const_mul D)
  exact hd.mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun G => by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound G)

name: NLAlib.integrable_gramSoftMinSecond_single_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_gramSoftMinSecond_single_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      gramSoftMinSecond n ε G (Matrix.single i j 1)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  apply integrable_of_abs_le_frobSq_polynomial_gaussianMatrix r k (n + 2)
    _ (measurable_gramSoftMinSecond_single n ε i j) 2
    (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε⁻¹ ^ (n + 2) * (1 + ε * r) ^ (n + 1))
  intro G
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using
    abs_gramSoftMinSecond_single_le_frobSq_polynomial n hn ε hε G i j

name: NLAlib.integrable_test_mul_gramSoftMinSecond_single_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_test_mul_gramSoftMinSecond_single_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Measurable ψ) (P : ℝ)
    (hψP : ∀ x, ‖ψ x‖ ≤ P) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      ψ (inversePowerSoftMin n (regularizedGram ε G)) *
        gramSoftMinSecond n ε G (Matrix.single i j 1)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  exact (integrable_gramSoftMinSecond_single_gaussianMatrix hr n hn ε hε i j).bdd_mul
    (hψ.comp (measurable_inversePowerSoftMin_regularizedGram n ε)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall fun G => hψP _)

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_frobNorm_pinvR_le_sharp
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_lt_frobNorm_pinvR_le_sharp {r p : ℕ} (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin (r + p))).real
      {G | t * Real.sqrt (12 * (r : ℝ) / p) < frobNorm (pinvR G)} ≤ t ^ (-(p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have h := gaussianMatrix_lt_frobSq_pinvR_le_sharp (r := r) (k := r + p)
    (by omega) (t ^ 2) (by nlinarith)
  have hgap : ((r + p : ℕ) : ℝ) - r = p := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hgap] at h
  have he : {G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin (r + p)) ℝ |
      t * Real.sqrt (12 * (r : ℝ) / p) < frobNorm (pinvR G)} =
      {G | 12 * (r : ℝ) / p * t ^ 2 < frobSq (pinvR G)} := by
    ext G
    change t * Real.sqrt (12 * (r : ℝ) / p) < frobNorm (pinvR G) ↔
      12 * (r : ℝ) / p * t ^ 2 < frobSq (pinvR G)
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 12 * (r : ℝ) / p by positivity)
    have hn := frobNorm_nonneg (pinvR G)
    have htS := mul_nonneg ht0.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg (12 * (r : ℝ) / p))
    have hF := frobNorm_sq (pinvR G)
    have hth : (t * Real.sqrt (12 * (r : ℝ) / p)) ^ 2 = 12 * (r : ℝ) / p * t ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hs]
      ring
    rw [← hF, ← hth]
    exact (sq_lt_sq₀ htS hn).symm
  rw [he]
  convert h using 1
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul ht0.le]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le_rsvd
statement:
theorem gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le_rsvd {r p : ℕ} (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin (r + p))).real
      {G | t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (r + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) < specNorm (pinvR G)} ≤
      t ^ (-(p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hpR : (4 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr | hr
  · subst r
    have hz (G : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin (0 + p)) ℝ) : pinvR G = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have he : {G : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin (0 + p)) ℝ |
        t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt ((0 : ℝ) + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) < specNorm (pinvR G)} = ∅ := by
      ext G
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, hz, specNorm_zero]
      exact not_lt_of_ge (by positivity)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, he, measureReal_empty] using Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le (-(p : ℝ))
  let b : ℝ := Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (r + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hs := gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_pinvR_le_of_pos (r := r) (k := r + p)
    hr (by omega) (t * b) (mul_pos ht0 hb)
  have hgap : ((r + p : ℕ) : ℝ) - r + 1 = (p : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have hwidth : Real.sqrt ((r + p : ℕ) : ℝ) = Real.sqrt (r + p) := by push_cast; rfl
  rw [hgap, hwidth] at hs
  change _ ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ((p : ℝ) + 1))) *
    b ^ ((p : ℝ) + 1) * (t * b) ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) at hs
  have he : b ^ ((p : ℝ) + 1) * (t * b) ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) =
      t ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [Real.mul_rpow ht0.le hb.le]
    calc
      b ^ ((p : ℝ) + 1) * (t ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) * b ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1))) =
          t ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) * (b ^ ((p : ℝ) + 1) * b ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1))) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hb, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
  rw [mul_assoc, he] at hs
  have hc : 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ((p : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr
    apply (Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  refine hs.trans ?_
  calc
    (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * t ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) ≤
        t ^ (-((p : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc
        (Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le (-((p : ℝ) + 1)))
    _ ≤ t ^ (-(p : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le ht (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.Gamma_add_nat_div_two_sq_le_mul_prod
statement:
theorem Gamma_add_nat_div_two_sq_le_mul_prod {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.Gamma (x + n / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.Gamma x ^ 2 *
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x + i / 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hz : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
    have hg : Real.Gamma (x + n / 2 + 1 / 2) ^ 2
        ≤ (x + n / 2) * Real.Gamma (x + n / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.Gamma (x + n / 2 + 1 / 2) :=
        (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)).le
      calc Real.Gamma (x + n / 2 + 1 / 2) ^ 2
          ≤ (Real.Gamma (x + n / 2) * √(x + n / 2)) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 (Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt hz) 2
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hz.le]; ring
    have he : x + n / 2 + 1 / 2 = x + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [he] at hg
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    calc Real.Gamma (x + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2
        ≤ (x + n / 2) * Real.Gamma (x + n / 2) ^ 2 := hg
      _ ≤ (x + n / 2) * (Real.Gamma x ^ 2 * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x + i / 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hz.le
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.Gamma_add_nat_div_two_le
statement:
theorem Gamma_add_nat_div_two_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Real.Gamma (x + n / 2) ≤ Real.Gamma x *
      (x + ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 4) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have h1 := Gamma_add_nat_div_two_sq_le_mul_prod hx (m + 1)
  have h2 := prod_range_add_le_pow (2 * x) (by positivity) m
  have hprod : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (x + i / 2)
      = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (2 * x + i)) / 2 ^ (m + 1) := by
    calc _ = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ((2 * x + i) / 2) := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro i _; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range]
  rw [hprod] at h1
  have h3 : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (2 * x + i)) / 2 ^ (m + 1)
      ≤ (x + m / 4) ^ (m + 1) := by
    calc _ ≤ ((2 * (2 * x) + m) / 2) ^ (m + 1) / 2 ^ (m + 1) := by gcongr
      _ = (x + m / 4) ^ (m + 1) := by rw [← div_pow]; congr 1; ring
  have h4 := h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg _))
  have hxmean : 0 ≤ x + (m : ℝ) / 4 := by positivity
  have hrpow : (x + (m : ℝ) / 4) ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2)
      = Real.sqrt ((x + (m : ℝ) / 4) ^ (m + 1)) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hxmean]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h4
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).le,
    Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx).le] at hs
  convert hs using 1
  rw [show ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 = m by push_cast; ring, hrpow]

name: NLAlib.Gamma_nat_add_one_div_two_sq_ge
statement:
theorem Gamma_nat_add_one_div_two_sq_ge {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    Real.pi * ((d : ℝ) / (2 * Real.exp 1)) ^ d ≤
      Real.Gamma (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  set z : ℝ := ((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2 with hz
  have hz0 : 0 < z := by positivity
  have hg0 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hz0
  have hdup := Real.Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half z
  have hdup' : Real.Gamma z * Real.Gamma (z + 1 / 2)
      = (d.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt Real.pi := by
    rw [show 1 - 2 * z = -(d : ℝ) by rw [hz]; ring,
      show 2 * z = (d : ℝ) + 1 by rw [hz]; ring,
      Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial] at hdup
    exact hdup
  have hupper : (d.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt Real.pi
      ≤ Real.Gamma z ^ 2 * Real.sqrt z := by
    rw [← hdup']
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt hz0) hg0.le
    nlinarith
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ)) * 2 ^ d = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
    simp
  have hfac : (d.factorial : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Real.pi
      ≤ 2 ^ d * Real.Gamma z ^ 2 * Real.sqrt z := by
    calc _ = 2 ^ d * ((d.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt Real.pi) := by
          rw [show 2 ^ d * ((d.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt Real.pi)
            = (d.factorial : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ)) * 2 ^ d) * Real.sqrt Real.pi by ring,
            htwo, mul_one]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ d * (Real.Gamma z ^ 2 * Real.sqrt z) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hsqrt : Real.pi * Real.sqrt z ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * d) * Real.sqrt Real.pi := by
    apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).1
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hz0.le, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity),
      Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_pos.le, hz]
    have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg Real.pi]
  have hst := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling d
  have hpower : (2 : ℝ) ^ d * ((d : ℝ) / (2 * Real.exp 1)) ^ d
      = ((d : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ d := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; field_simp
  have hfinal : 2 ^ d * (Real.pi * ((d : ℝ) / (2 * Real.exp 1)) ^ d) * Real.sqrt z
      ≤ 2 ^ d * Real.Gamma z ^ 2 * Real.sqrt z := by
    calc _ = (Real.pi * Real.sqrt z) * ((d : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ d := by rw [← hpower]; ring
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * d) * Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ((d : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ d := by gcongr
      _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * d) * ((d : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ d) * Real.sqrt Real.pi := by ring
      _ ≤ (d.factorial : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Real.pi := by gcongr
      _ ≤ _ := hfac
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (le_of_mul_le_mul_right hfinal (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hz0))
    (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.Gamma_endpoint_moment_le
statement:
theorem Gamma_endpoint_moment_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    2 ^ (-(d : ℝ) / 2) * Real.pi * Real.Gamma (x + d / 2) /
        (Real.Gamma x * Real.Gamma (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2)
      ≤ (2 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (x + ((d : ℝ) - 1) / 4) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^
        ((d : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  set q : ℝ := (d : ℝ) / 2 with hq
  set M : ℝ := x + ((d : ℝ) - 1) / 4 with hM
  set T : ℝ := (d : ℝ) / (2 * Real.exp 1) with hT
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by positivity
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by rw [hM]; linarith
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; positivity
  have hg0 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx
  have hz0 := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < ((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2 by positivity)
  have hratio : Real.Gamma (x + d / 2) / Real.Gamma x ≤ M ^ q := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hg0).2
    simpa [hM, hq, mul_comm] using Gamma_add_nat_div_two_le hx hd
  have hinv : Real.pi / Real.Gamma (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / T ^ d := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    simpa [hT] using Gamma_nat_add_one_div_two_sq_ge hd
  have hfactor : 2 ^ (-q) * Real.pi * Real.Gamma (x + d / 2) /
        (Real.Gamma x * Real.Gamma (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2)
      ≤ 2 ^ (-q) * M ^ q / T ^ d := by
    calc _ = 2 ^ (-q) * (Real.Gamma (x + d / 2) / Real.Gamma x) *
          (Real.pi / Real.Gamma (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 2) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (-q) * M ^ q * (1 / T ^ d) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hTpow : T ^ d = (T ^ 2) ^ q := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast T d, ← Real.rpow_natCast T 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hT0.le]
    congr 1; rw [hq]; push_cast; ring
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-q) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ q := by
    rw [one_div, Real.inv_rpow (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num)]
  have heq : 2 ^ (-q) * M ^ q / T ^ d =
      (2 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * M / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ q := by
    rw [hTpow, htwo, ← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hM0.le,
      ← Real.div_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    rw [hT]
    field_simp
  simpa [hq, hM, neg_div] using hfactor.trans heq.le

name: NLAlib.gamma_inverse_spectral_endpoint_le
statement:
theorem gamma_inverse_spectral_endpoint_le {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r < k) :
    2 ^ (-((k : ℝ) - r) / 2) * Real.pi * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) / 2) /
        (Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) - r + 1) / 2) ^ 2)
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + r - 1) / (2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)) ^
        (((k : ℝ) - r) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hrk.le
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := by omega
  subst k
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r by omega)
  have h := Gamma_endpoint_moment_le (show 0 < (r : ℝ) / 2 by positivity) hd
  have he1 : (r : ℝ) / 2 + d / 2 = ((r : ℝ) + d) / 2 := by ring
  have he2 : 2 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((r : ℝ) / 2 + ((d : ℝ) - 1) / 4) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2
      = Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (((r : ℝ) + d) + r - 1) / (2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [he1, he2] at h
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, add_sub_cancel_left] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal fun a => if a = i then -1 else 1 with hD
  have hDD : D * D = 1 := by
    rw [hD, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1; funext a; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hDt : Dᵀ = D := Matrix.diagonal_transpose _
  have hU : Dᵀ * D = 1 := by rw [hDt, hDD]
  have hrot := hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_orthogonal (p := Fin r) (m := Fin k) D
    (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) hU (by simp [HasOrthonormalCols])
  have hDinv : D⁻¹ = D := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hDD
  have key : ∀ G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ,
      ((D * G * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) *
        (D * G * (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ))ᵀ)⁻¹ i j
        = -(G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i j := by
    intro G
    simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.transpose_mul, hDt]
    rw [show D * G * (Gᵀ * D) = D * (G * Gᵀ) * D by
      simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]]
    rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hDinv, hD]
    simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Ne.symm hij]
  have h1 := hrot.integral_comp
    (measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply (k := Fin k) i j).aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_def, key, integral_neg] at h1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_sq_dist_rowSpace
statement:
private lemma integrable_and_integral_inv_sq_dist_rowSpace {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n + 3 ≤ k)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hH : H.rank = n) :
    Integrable (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => (g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ ((H * Hᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g)))⁻¹)
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) ∧
    ∫ g, (g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ ((H * Hᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g)))⁻¹
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) = 1 / ((k : ℝ) - n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Measurable
      (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ ((H * Hᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))) := by
    apply Continuous.measurable
    fun_prop
  have hlaw := pi_gaussianReal_map_sq_dist_rowSpace H hH
  have hint := integrable_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin (k - n)) (by simpa using (show 3 ≤ k - n by omega))
  have hval := integral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin (k - n)) (by simpa using (show 3 ≤ k - n by omega))
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hval
  have hφ : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => s⁻¹) := measurable_inv
  have hS : Measurable (fun x : Fin (k - n) → ℝ => ∑ j, x j ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  constructor
  · have h := (integrable_map_measure hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hS.aemeasurable).mpr hint
    rw [← hlaw] at h
    exact (integrable_map_measure hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hq.aemeasurable).mp h
  · rw [← integral_map hq.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable, hlaw,
      integral_map hS.aemeasurable hφ.aestronglyMeasurable, hval,
      Nat.cast_sub (by omega : n ≤ k)]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self
statement:
private lemma integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self {n k : ℕ}
    (hnk : n + 3 ≤ k) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin k) ℝ => (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i)
        (gaussianMatrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin k)) ∧
    ∫ G, (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin k))
      = 1 / ((k : ℝ) - n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integrable_gaussianMatrix_iff, integral_gaussianMatrix_eq]
  set μ : Measure (Fin k → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1 with hμ
  set ν : Measure (Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ with hν
  set F : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun G => (Matrix.of G * (Matrix.of G)ᵀ)⁻¹ i i with hF
  have hFm : Measurable F :=
    (measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply i i).comp Matrix.measurable_of
  set e := MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Fin k → ℝ) i with he
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ) (μ.prod ν) :=
    measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ) i
  set Φ : (Fin k → ℝ) × (Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ := fun p => F (e.symm p) with hΦ
  have hΦm : Measurable Φ := hFm.comp e.symm.measurable
  have hΦnn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ Φ p := fun p => (posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose _).diag_nonneg
  
  have hschur : ∀ H : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ, (Matrix.of H).rank = n → ∀ g : Fin k → ℝ,
      Φ (g, H) = (g ⬝ᵥ g - (Matrix.of H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ
        ((Matrix.of H * (Matrix.of H)ᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (Matrix.of H *ᵥ g)))⁻¹ := by
    intro H hH g
    set G0 : Fin (n + 1) → Fin k → ℝ := Fin.insertNth i g H with hG0
    have hsub : (Matrix.of G0).submatrix i.succAbove id = Matrix.of H := by
      ext a b; simp [hG0]
    have hrow : Matrix.of G0 i = g := by funext b; simp [hG0]
    have hdet : ((Matrix.of G0).submatrix i.succAbove id *
        ((Matrix.of G0).submatrix i.succAbove id)ᵀ).det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hsub]
      exact det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq _ (by rw [Matrix.rank_self_mul_transpose, hH, Fintype.card_fin])
    have := inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self (Matrix.of G0) i hdet
    rw [hsub, hrow] at this
    simp only [hΦ, hF, he, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv]
    exact this
  have hrank : ∀ᵐ H ∂ν, (Matrix.of H).rank = n := by
    have := (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_gaussianMatrix (m := Fin n)
      (n := Fin k)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (gaussianMatrix_ae_rank_eq n k)
    filter_upwards [this] with H hH
    rw [Matrix.coe_ofMeasurableEquiv] at hH
    rw [hH]; omega
  have hinner : ∀ᵐ H ∂ν, Integrable (fun g => Φ (g, H)) μ ∧
      ∫ g, Φ (g, H) ∂μ = 1 / ((k : ℝ) - n - 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hrank] with H hH
    simp_rw [hschur H hH]
    exact integrable_and_integral_inv_sq_dist_rowSpace hnk (Matrix.of H) hH
  have hint : Integrable Φ (μ.prod ν) := by
    rw [integrable_prod_iff' hΦm.aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine ⟨hinner.mono fun H h => h.1, ?_⟩
    refine (integrable_const (1 / ((k : ℝ) - n - 2))).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hinner] with H hH
    simp_rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hΦnn _)]
    exact hH.2.symm
  constructor
  · have := (hmp.integrable_comp_emb e.measurableEmbedding (g := Φ)).mpr hint
    refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun G => ?_)
    simp [hΦ, hF]
  · have h1 := hmp.integral_comp' Φ
    simp only [hΦ, MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h1
    rw [h1, integral_prod_symm Φ hint]
    rw [integral_congr_ae (hinner.mono fun H h => h.2)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix {r k : ℕ}
    (hrk : r + 2 ≤ k) :
    (∀ i j : Fin r, Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
        (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i j) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))) ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin r, ∫ G, (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i j ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
      = (1 / ((k : ℝ) - r - 1)) * (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag : ∀ i : Fin r, Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ =>
      (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) := by
    intro i
    cases r with
    | zero => exact i.elim0
    | succ n =>
      exact (integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self (by omega) i).1
  refine ⟨fun i j => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · refine Integrable.mono' ((hdiag i).add (hdiag j))
      (measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply i j).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun G => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_apply_le_apply_self_add_apply_self _
      (posSemidef_inv_self_mul_transpose G) i j
  · by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      cases r with
      | zero => exact i.elim0
      | succ n =>
        rw [(integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self (by omega) i).2,
          Matrix.one_apply_eq, mul_one]
        push_cast
        ring_nf
    · rw [integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_of_ne i j hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne hij,
        mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    (hrk : r + 2 ≤ k) :
    (∀ i j : Fin r, Integrable (fun ω => (X ω * (X ω)ᵀ)⁻¹ i j) μ) ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin r, ∫ ω, (X ω * (X ω)ᵀ)⁻¹ i j ∂μ
      = (1 / ((k : ℝ) - r - 1)) * (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ := integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix hrk
  refine ⟨fun i j => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · have h : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i j) (μ.map X) := by
      rw [hX.map_eq]; exact hint i j
    exact h.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable
  · rw [← hval i j]
    exact hX.integral_comp (measurable_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply i j).aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r + 2 ≤ k) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin r =>
        ∫ G, (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i j ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)))
      = (1 / ((k : ℝ) - r - 1)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.of_apply, (integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix hrk).2 i j,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}

      = (1 / ((k : ℝ) - r - 1)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r + 2 ≤ k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq (pinvR G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    ∫ G, frobSq (pinvR G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) = (r : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) - r - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ := integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix hrk
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq (pinvR G))
      = fun G => ∑ i, (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i := by
    funext G; rw [frobSq_pinvR_eq_trace_inv, RCLike.re_to_real]; rfl
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hint i i, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hint i i]
  simp only [hval, Matrix.one_apply_eq, mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormal_complement_gramRowResidual
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormal_complement_gramRowResidual {n k : ℕ}
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℂ) (hH : IsUnit (H*Hᴴ)) :
    ∃ V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k-n)) ℂ, HasOrthonormalCols V ∧
      ∀ g, gramRowResidual H g = ((∑ j, Complex.normSq ((Vᴴ*ᵥg) j) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let M := H*Hᴴ
  have hM : M.PosDef := (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose H).posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr hH
  let S := cfc Real.sqrt M
  let W := cfc (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹) M
  have hW : W.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hSW : S*W=1 := cfc_sqrt_mul_inv_sqrt hM
  have hSS : S*S=M := cfc_sqrt_mul_self hM
  have hWhite : W*M*W=1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hM
  have hMWW : M*(W*W)=1 := by
    calc
      _ = S*(S*W)*W := by rw [← hSS]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hSW, Matrix.mul_one, hSW]
  have hW2 : W*W=M⁻¹ := (Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hMWW).symm
  let Q := Hᴴ*W
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q := by
    change (Hᴴ*W)ᴴ*(Hᴴ*W)=1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hW.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    simpa only [M, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hWhite
  have hproj : Q*Qᴴ=Hᴴ*M⁻¹*H := by
    change (Hᴴ*W)*(Hᴴ*W)ᴴ=Hᴴ*M⁻¹*H
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hW.eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    calc
      _ = Hᴴ*(W*W)*H := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hW2]
  have hc : ∃ V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k-n)) ℂ,
      HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ Q*Qᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1 := by
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin k)-Fintype.card (Fin n)=k-n := by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [← hcard]
    exact exists_unitary_complement Q hQ
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hcomp⟩ := hc
  have hVV : 1-Hᴴ*M⁻¹*H=V*Vᴴ := by rw [← hproj, ← hcomp]; abel
  refine ⟨V,hV,fun g => ?_⟩
  have hcross : star g ⬝ᵥ ((Hᴴ*M⁻¹*H)*ᵥg)=star (H*ᵥg) ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹*ᵥ(H*ᵥg)) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (star g) Hᴴ, Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose, star_star]
  have hr : gramRowResidual H g=quadForm (1-Hᴴ*M⁻¹*H) g := by
    rw [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, hcross]
    rfl
  rw [hr,hVV]
  have hq := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self Vᴴ g
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] at hq
  rw [hq, dotProduct]
  simp only [Pi.star_apply, RCLike.star_def, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, Complex.ofReal_sum]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_re_gramRowResidual_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_inv_re_gramRowResidual_circularComplexGaussianVector
    {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n+2 ≤ k) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℂ)
    (hH : IsUnit (H*Hᴴ)) :
    Integrable (fun g => ((gramRowResidual H g).re)⁻¹) (circularComplexGaussianVector (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ g, ((gramRowResidual H g).re)⁻¹ ∂circularComplexGaussianVector (Fin k) =
        1/(2*((k:ℝ)-n-1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hr⟩ := exists_orthonormal_complement_gramRowResidual H hH
  have hv : HasOrthonormalCols Vᴴᴴ := by rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (k-n)) := by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]; omega
  obtain ⟨hi,he⟩ := integrable_and_integral_inv_sum_normSq_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector Vᴴ hv hd
  have hfun : (fun g => ((gramRowResidual H g).re)⁻¹) =
      fun g => (∑ j, Complex.normSq ((Vᴴ*ᵥg) j))⁻¹ := by
    funext g
    rw [hr, Complex.ofReal_re]
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨hi,he.trans ?_⟩
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : n≤k)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.gramRowResidual_ofReal_re
statement:
theorem gramRowResidual_ofReal_re {n k : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℂ)
    (hH : IsUnit (H*Hᴴ)) (g : Fin k → ℂ) :
    ((gramRowResidual H g).re : ℂ)=gramRowResidual H g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hr⟩ := exists_orthonormal_complement_gramRowResidual H hH
  rw [hr,Complex.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_re_gramRowResidual_star_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_inv_re_gramRowResidual_star_circularComplexGaussianVector
    {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n+2 ≤ k) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℂ)
    (hH : IsUnit (H*Hᴴ)) :
    Integrable (fun g => ((gramRowResidual H (star g)).re)⁻¹) (circularComplexGaussianVector (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ g, ((gramRowResidual H (star g)).re)⁻¹ ∂circularComplexGaussianVector (Fin k) =
        1/(2*((k:ℝ)-n-1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_inv_re_gramRowResidual_circularComplexGaussianVector hnk H hH
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun g : Fin k → ℂ => ((gramRowResidual H g).re)⁻¹)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector (Fin k)) :=
    (by unfold gramRowResidual; fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hs := hasLaw_star_circularComplexGaussianVector (n := Fin k)
  constructor
  · rw [← hs.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hs.aemeasurable
  · exact (hs.integral_comp hm).trans hv

name: NLAlib.tendsto_regularizedGram_softMin_aggregates_of_unique_max
statement:
theorem tendsto_regularizedGram_softMin_aggregates_of_unique_max
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) (i₀ : ι)
    (hmax : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i <
      hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => inversePowerSoftMin n (regularizedGram ε G)) atTop
        (𝓝 (hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀)⁻¹) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => frobSq (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G)) atTop
        (𝓝 (4 * ((hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀)⁻¹ - ε))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => frobInner G (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G)) atTop
        (𝓝 (2 * ((hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀)⁻¹ - ε)))
proof:
:= by
  let b := hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  let l := fun i => (b i)⁻¹ - ε
  have hPi (i : ι) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (∑ j, b j ^ n) ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) * b i ^ (n + 1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (if i = i₀ then 1 else 0)) :=
    tendsto_sum_pow_rpow_mul_pow_succ_of_unique_max b i₀ (hpd.inv.eigenvalues_pos i₀)
      (fun i => (hpd.inv.eigenvalues_pos i).le) hmax i
  have hE := (tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
    (hPi i).const_mul (l i))).const_mul 2
  have hA := (tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
    ((hPi i).pow 2).const_mul (l i))).const_mul 4
  refine ⟨tendsto_inversePowerSoftMin_of_unique_max hpd i₀ hmax, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_spectral _ _ _ hpd]
    simpa only [ite_pow, one_pow, zero_pow (by omega : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_ite,
      mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using hA
  · simp_rw [frobInner_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_spectral _ _ _ hpd]
    simpa only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using hE

name: NLAlib.ae_tendsto_regularizedGram_softMin_aggregates_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_regularizedGram_softMin_aggregates_gaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrk : r ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᵐ G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)),
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => inversePowerSoftMin n (regularizedGram ε G))
        atTop (𝓝 (singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 + ε)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => frobSq (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G))
        atTop (𝓝 (4 * singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => frobInner G (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G))
        atTop (𝓝 (2 * singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
  filter_upwards [ae_exists_unique_max_eigenvalues_inv_regularizedGram_gaussianMatrix
    hr hrk ε hε] with G hG
  obtain ⟨i₀, hmax⟩ := hG
  let hpd := regularizedGram_posDef hε G
  have hle (i : Fin r) : hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≤
      hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀ := by
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · simpa only [hi] using le_rfl
    · exact (hmax i hi).le
  have hX := sq_singularValues_transpose_last_eq_inv_inverse_eigenvalue_sub ε G hpd i₀ hle
  obtain ⟨hF, hA, hB⟩ :=
    tendsto_regularizedGram_softMin_aggregates_of_unique_max ε G hpd i₀ hmax
  have hXadd : (hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀)⁻¹ = singularValues Gᵀ (Fintype.card (Fin r) - 1) ^ 2 + ε := by
    linarith
  rw [hXadd] at hF
  rw [← hX] at hA hB
  exact ⟨hF, hA, hB⟩

name: NLAlib.inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_succAbove
statement:
theorem inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_succAbove {n k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : Fin n)
    (hH : (G.submatrix i.succAbove id * (G.submatrix i.succAbove id)ᵀ).det ≠ 0) :
    (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i (i.succAbove a) =
      -(((G.submatrix i.succAbove id * (G.submatrix i.succAbove id)ᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ
          (G.submatrix i.succAbove id *ᵥ G i)) a) * (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ i i
proof:
:= by
  set H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ := G.submatrix i.succAbove id with hHdef
  set g : Fin k → ℝ := G i with hg
  set M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := H * Hᵀ with hM
  set c : Fin n → ℝ := M⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g) with hc
  set s : ℝ := g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ c with hs
  set A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ := G * Gᵀ with hA
  set w : Fin k → ℝ := g - Hᵀ *ᵥ c with hw
  set x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := Fin.insertNth i (1 : ℝ) (-c) with hx
  have hHw : H *ᵥ w = 0 := by
    rw [hw, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hM, hc, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hH), Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_self]
  have hgw : g ⬝ᵥ w = s := by
    rw [hw, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
  have hGx : Gᵀ *ᵥ x = w := by
    funext l
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply, hw, hx, Pi.sub_apply, hg,
      hHdef, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i]
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hGw : G *ᵥ w = Pi.single i s := by
    funext b
    induction b using Fin.succAboveCases i with
    | x =>
      simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
      rw [← hgw]; rfl
    | p a =>
      rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Fin.succAbove_ne i a)]
      have := congrFun hHw a
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, hHdef] using this
  have hAx : A *ᵥ x = Pi.single i s := by
    rw [hA, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hGx, hGw]
  have hadj : A.adjugate i i = M.det := by
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
    have : A.submatrix i.succAbove i.succAbove = M := by
      ext a b
      simp [hA, hM, hHdef, Matrix.mul_apply]
    rw [this, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hdetA : A.det = s * M.det := by
    have h1 : A.adjugate *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = A.det • x := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.adjugate_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [hAx] at h1
    have h2 := congrFun h1 i
    have h3 : (A.adjugate *ᵥ Pi.single i s) i = A.adjugate i i * s := by
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [h3, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hx, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, mul_one, hadj] at h2
    rw [← h2, mul_comm]
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := by rw [hA, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hsymm : A⁻¹ i (i.succAbove a) = A⁻¹ (i.succAbove a) i := by
    have : (A⁻¹)ᵀ = A⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hAt]
    rw [← this, Matrix.transpose_apply, this]
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · have hA0 : A⁻¹ = 0 := by
      apply Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit
      rw [hdetA, hs0, zero_mul]; exact not_isUnit_zero
    show A⁻¹ i (i.succAbove a) = -c a * A⁻¹ i i
    rw [hA0]; simp
  · have hdetU : IsUnit A.det := by
      rw [hdetA]; exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hs0 hH)
    have hcol : A⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single i s = x := by
      rw [← hAx, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdetU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hcol' : ∀ b, A⁻¹ b i * s = x b := by
      intro b
      have := congrFun hcol b
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply] using this
    have hii : A⁻¹ i i * s = 1 := by
      rw [hcol' i, hx, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
    have hai : A⁻¹ (i.succAbove a) i * s = -c a := by
      rw [hcol' (i.succAbove a), hx, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Pi.neg_apply]
    show A⁻¹ i (i.succAbove a) = -c a * A⁻¹ i i
    rw [hsymm]
    have hsinv : A⁻¹ i i = s⁻¹ := by
      field_simp; linarith
    rw [hsinv]
    field_simp
    linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormal_ker_sq_dist_rowSpace
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormal_ker_sq_dist_rowSpace {n k : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hH : H.rank = n) :
    ∃ V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k - n)) ℝ, Vᵀ * V = 1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (k - n), H *ᵥ (fun l => V l j) = 0) ∧ ∀ g : Fin k → ℝ,
      g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ ((H * Hᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g)) = ∑ j, (Vᵀ *ᵥ g) j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)
  set T : E →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    (Matrix.mulVecLin H).comp (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin k → ℝ)).toLinearMap with hT
  set K : Submodule ℝ E := LinearMap.ker T with hK
  have hrange : LinearMap.range T = ⊤ := by
    rw [hT, LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ (LinearEquiv.range _)]
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    rw [Module.finrank_fin_fun]
    exact hH
  have hfin : Module.finrank ℝ K = k - n := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker T
    rw [hrange, finrank_top, Module.finrank_fin_fun, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at h
    rw [hK]; omega
  set b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (k - n)) ℝ K := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ K).reindex (finCongr hfin)
  set V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k - n)) ℝ := Matrix.of fun l j => ((b j : K) : E).ofLp l with hV
  have hbK : ∀ j, H *ᵥ ((b j : K) : E).ofLp = 0 := by
    intro j
    have : T ((b j : K) : E) = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (b j).2
    exact this
  have hVcol : ∀ (j : Fin (k - n)) (g : Fin k → ℝ), (Vᵀ *ᵥ g) j = ((b j : K) : E).ofLp ⬝ᵥ g := by
    intro j g; simp [hV, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  refine ⟨V, ?_, fun j => hbK j, ?_⟩
  · ext j j'
    have h1 : (Vᵀ * V) j j' = inner ℝ ((b j : K) : E) ((b j' : K) : E) := by
      rw [inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp, star_trivial]; simp [hV, Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct]
    rw [h1, ← Submodule.coe_inner, orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal, Matrix.one_apply]
  · intro g
    set M := H * Hᵀ with hM
    have hdet : IsUnit M.det := by
      refine isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (det_ne_zero_of_rank_eq _ ?_)
      rw [hM, Matrix.rank_self_mul_transpose, hH, Fintype.card_fin]
    set c := M⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g) with hc
    set p := Hᵀ *ᵥ c with hp
    set r := g - p with hr
    have hHr : H *ᵥ r = 0 := by
      rw [hr, Matrix.mulVec_sub, hp, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hM, hc, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_self]
    have hq : g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ c = r ⬝ᵥ r := by
      have h1 : r ⬝ᵥ p = 0 := by
        rw [hp, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose, hHr, zero_dotProduct]
      have h2 : g ⬝ᵥ p = (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ c := by
        rw [hp, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
      have h3 : r ⬝ᵥ r = r ⬝ᵥ g - r ⬝ᵥ p := by
        rw [← dotProduct_sub]
      rw [h3, h1, hr, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm p g, h2, sub_zero]
    have hcoord : ∀ j, (Vᵀ *ᵥ g) j = ((b j : K) : E).ofLp ⬝ᵥ r := by
      intro j
      rw [hVcol, hr, dotProduct_sub, hp, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose,
        hbK, zero_dotProduct, sub_zero]
    have hrK : (WithLp.toLp 2 r : E) ∈ K := by
      simpa [hK, hT] using hHr
    set rK : K := ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 r, hrK⟩
    have hpars := b.sum_inner_mul_inner rK rK
    rw [hq]
    simp_rw [hcoord]
    have hrr : inner ℝ rK rK = r ⬝ᵥ r := by
      rw [Submodule.coe_inner, inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp, star_trivial]
    have hbj : ∀ j, inner ℝ (b j) rK = ((b j : K) : E).ofLp ⬝ᵥ r := by
      intro j; rw [Submodule.coe_inner, inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp, star_trivial]
    rw [← hrr, ← hpars]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [real_inner_comm, hbj, sq]

name: NLAlib.indepFun_mulVec_sq_dist_rowSpace
statement:
theorem indepFun_mulVec_sq_dist_rowSpace {n k : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hH : H.rank = n) :
    IndepFun (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => H *ᵥ g)
      (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ ((H * Hᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g)))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  set P := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1 with hP
  set E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hHV, hq⟩ := exists_orthonormal_ker_sq_dist_rowSpace H hH
  set hrow : Fin n → E := fun a => WithLp.toLp 2 (H a) with hhrow
  set vcol : Fin (k - n) → E := fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun l => V l j) with hvcol
  have : IsGaussian (P.map (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin k → ℝ) → E)) := by
    rw [hP, map_pi_eq_stdGaussian]; infer_instance
  have hlaw : HasGaussianLaw (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin k → ℝ) → E) P := IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw
  set L : E →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin (k - n) → ℝ) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun a => innerSL ℝ (hrow a)).prod
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j => innerSL ℝ (vcol j)) with hL
  have hpair : HasGaussianLaw (fun g : Fin k → ℝ =>
      ((fun a => ⟪hrow a, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫), (fun j => ⟪vcol j, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫))) P := by
    have := hlaw.map_fun L
    simpa [hL] using this
  have hcov : ∀ a j, cov[fun g : Fin k → ℝ => ⟪hrow a, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫,
      fun g => ⟪vcol j, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫; P] = 0 := by
    intro a j
    have hm : Measurable (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin k → ℝ) → E) := by fun_prop
    have h1 := covariance_map_fun (μ := P) (X := fun x : E => ⟪hrow a, x⟫)
      (Y := fun x : E => ⟪vcol j, x⟫) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hm.aemeasurable
    rw [← h1, hP, map_pi_eq_stdGaussian, ← covarianceBilin_apply_eq_cov IsGaussian.memLp_two_id,
      covarianceBilin_stdGaussian, innerSL_apply_apply, inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp, star_trivial]
    have := congrFun (hHV j) a
    simpa [hhrow, hvcol, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using this
  have hind := hpair.indepFun_of_covariance_eval hcov
  have h1 : (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => fun a => ⟪hrow a, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫) = fun g => H *ᵥ g := by
    funext g a
    rw [inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp, star_trivial]; rfl
  have h2 : (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => fun j => ⟪vcol j, WithLp.toLp 2 g⟫) = fun g => Vᵀ *ᵥ g := by
    funext g j
    rw [inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp, star_trivial]; rfl
  rw [h1, h2] at hind
  have hS : Measurable (fun y : Fin (k - n) → ℝ => ∑ j, y j ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have := hind.comp measurable_id hS
  have h3 : (fun g : Fin k → ℝ => g ⬝ᵥ g - (H *ᵥ g) ⬝ᵥ ((H * Hᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g)))
      = (fun y : Fin (k - n) → ℝ => ∑ j, y j ^ 2) ∘ (fun g => Vᵀ *ᵥ g) := funext hq
  rw [h3]
  exact this

name: NLAlib.measurable_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal
statement:
private theorem measurable_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal {r k : ℕ} (i : Fin r) :
    Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ => ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re)
proof:
:=
  Complex.measurable_re.comp ((Matrix.measurable_entry i i).comp
    (measurable_matrix_inv.comp (measurable_id.matrix_mul Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose)))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal_succ
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal_succ
    {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n+2 ≤ k) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin k) ℂ => ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin k) =
        1/(2*((k:ℝ)-n-1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integrable_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_iff, integral_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_eq]
  let μ := circularComplexGaussianVector (Fin k)
  let ν := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ
  let F : (Fin (n+1) → Fin k → ℂ) → ℝ := fun G =>
    ((Matrix.of G*(Matrix.of G)ᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re
  have hFm : Measurable F := (measurable_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal i).comp Matrix.measurable_of
  let e := MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => Fin k → ℂ) i
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n+1) => μ) (μ.prod ν) :=
    measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => μ) i
  let Φ : (Fin k → ℂ) × (Fin n → Fin k → ℂ) → ℝ := fun p => F (e.symm p)
  have hΦm : Measurable Φ := hFm.comp e.symm.measurable
  have hΦnn (p) : 0 ≤ Φ p :=
    (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp ((Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose (Matrix.of (e.symm p))).inv.diag_nonneg)).1
  have hschur (H : Fin n → Fin k → ℂ)
      (hH : IsUnit (Matrix.of H*(Matrix.of H)ᴴ)) (g : Fin k → ℂ) :
      Φ (g,H)=((gramRowResidual (Matrix.of H) (star g)).re)⁻¹ := by
    let G0 : Fin (n+1) → Fin k → ℂ := Fin.insertNth i g H
    have hsub : (Matrix.of G0).submatrix i.succAbove id=Matrix.of H := by
      ext a b
      simp [G0]
    have hrow : Matrix.of G0 i=g := by funext b; simp [G0]
    have hh : IsUnit ((Matrix.of G0).submatrix i.succAbove id*
        ((Matrix.of G0).submatrix i.succAbove id)ᴴ) := by rwa [hsub]
    have hd := inv_self_mul_conjTranspose_apply_self (Matrix.of G0) i hh
    rw [hsub,hrow, ← gramRowResidual_ofReal_re (Matrix.of H) hH (star g),
      ← Complex.ofReal_inv] at hd
    have hv := congrArg Complex.re hd
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at hv
    change ((Matrix.of G0*(Matrix.of G0)ᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re = _
    exact hv
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ H ∂ν, IsUnit (Matrix.of H*(Matrix.of H)ᴴ) := by
    have hm := (measurePreserving_ofMeasurableEquiv_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
      (m := Fin n) (n := Fin k)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_conjTranspose (by omega : n≤k))
    simpa only [Matrix.coe_ofMeasurableEquiv] using hm
  have hinner : ∀ᵐ H ∂ν, Integrable (fun g => Φ (g,H)) μ ∧
      ∫ g, Φ (g,H) ∂μ=1/(2*((k:ℝ)-n-1)) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with H hH
    simp_rw [hschur H hH]
    exact integrable_and_integral_inv_re_gramRowResidual_star_circularComplexGaussianVector hnk (Matrix.of H) hH
  have hint : Integrable Φ (μ.prod ν) := by
    rw [integrable_prod_iff' hΦm.aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine ⟨hinner.mono fun _ h => h.1, ?_⟩
    refine (integrable_const (1/(2*((k:ℝ)-n-1)))).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hinner] with H hH
    simp_rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hΦnn _)]
    exact hH.2.symm
  constructor
  · have h := (hmp.integrable_comp_emb e.measurableEmbedding (g := Φ)).mpr hint
    refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun G => ?_)
    simp [Φ,F]
  · have h := hmp.integral_comp' Φ
    simp only [Φ,MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
    rw [h,integral_prod_symm Φ hint,integral_congr_ae (hinner.mono fun _ h => h.2)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r+1 ≤ k) (i : Fin r) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ => ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k) =
        1/(2*((k:ℝ)-r))
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ n =>
    obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal_succ (by omega) i
    refine ⟨hi,hv.trans ?_⟩
    push_cast
    congr 1
    ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
    {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r+1 ≤ k) :

      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, frobSq (pinvR G) ∂circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k) =
        (r:ℝ)/(2*((k:ℝ)-r))
proof:
:= by
  have hd (i : Fin r) :=
    integrable_and_integral_re_inv_rowGram_diagonal_circularComplexGaussianMatrix hrk i
  have he : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℂ => frobSq (pinvR G)) =
      fun G => ∑ i, ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹ i i).re := by

    change ((G*Gᴴ)⁻¹).trace.re = _
    simp only [Matrix.trace,Complex.re_sum,Matrix.diag_apply]
  rw [he]

  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hd i).1]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_ite_eq_mul_add
statement:
private lemma sum_sum_ite_eq_mul_add {r : ℕ} (a b : ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin r, if i = j then a else b) = r * a + ((r : ℝ) * r - r) * b
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ i : Fin r, (∑ j : Fin r, if i = j then a else b) = a + ((r : ℝ) - 1) * b := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.sum_congr rfl
        (fun j hj => if_neg (Ne.symm (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj))),
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h | h
    · exact (Fin.elim0 (h ▸ i))
    · rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; push_cast; ring
  simp_rw [this, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_eq_of_hasLaw
statement:
private lemma integrable_and_integral_eq_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {r k : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) μ)
    {F : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Measurable F) {c : ℝ}
    (h : Integrable F (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, F G ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) = c) :
    Integrable (fun w => F (X w)) μ ∧ ∫ w, F (X w) ∂μ = c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, (hX.integral_comp hF.aestronglyMeasurable).trans h.2⟩
  have hI : Integrable F (μ.map X) := by rw [hX.map_eq]; exact h.1
  exact hI.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_inv_self_mul_transpose_gaussianMatrix {r k : ℕ}
    (hrk : r + 4 ≤ k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    ∫ G, frobSq (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
      = (r : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1)
          / (((k : ℝ) - r) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3))
proof:
:= by
  set M : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ :=
    fun G => (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ with hM
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹)
      = fun G => ∑ i, ∑ j, M G i j ^ 2 := by
    funext G; rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin r, Integrable (fun G => M G i j ^ 2) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, M G i j ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
        = if i = j then 1 / (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3))
          else 1 / (((k : ℝ) - r) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3)) := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self_sq_gaussianMatrix hrk i
    · rw [if_neg hij]
      exact integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_sq_gaussianMatrix hrk i j hij
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hterm i j).1, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hterm i j).1]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hterm _ j).1, fun i j => (hterm i j).2]
  rw [sum_sum_ite_eq_mul_add]
  have hx : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - r := by
    have : ((r + 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    push_cast at this; linarith
  have h1 : (k : ℝ) - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : (k : ℝ) - r - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h3 : (k : ℝ) - r - 3 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  ring

          / (((k : ℝ) - r) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_sq_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_sq_gaussianMatrix {r k : ℕ} (hrk : r + 4 ≤ k) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq (pinvR G) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
    ∫ G, frobSq (pinvR G) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
      = ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - r) - 2 * r * ((r : ℝ) - 1))
          / (((k : ℝ) - r) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3))
proof:
:= by
  set M : (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ :=
    fun G => (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ with hM
  have hfun : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin k) ℝ => frobSq (pinvR G) ^ 2)
      = fun G => ∑ i, ∑ j, M G i i * M G j j := by
    funext G
    rw [frobSq_pinvR_eq_trace_inv, RCLike.re_to_real, Matrix.trace, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    rfl
  have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin r, Integrable (fun G => M G i i * M G j j) (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k)) ∧
      ∫ G, M G i i * M G j j ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin k))
        = if i = j then 1 / (((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3))
          else ((k : ℝ) - r - 2) / (((k : ℝ) - r) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - r - 3)) := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ :=
        integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self_sq_gaussianMatrix hrk i
      simp only [if_true, hM]
      simp only [← sq]
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [if_neg hij]
      exact integrable_and_integral_inv_self_mul_transpose_apply_self_mul_apply_self_gaussianMatrix
        hrk i j hij
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hterm i j).1, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hterm i j).1]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (hterm _ j).1, fun i j => (hterm i j).2]
  rw [sum_sum_ite_eq_mul_add]
  have hx : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - r := by
    have : ((r + 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hrk
    push_cast at this; linarith
  have h1 : (k : ℝ) - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : (k : ℝ) - r - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h3 : (k : ℝ) - r - 3 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  ring
