proof:
:= by
  have hG : ∀ i j, Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ => G i j := Matrix.measurable_entry
  have hP : ∀ a b : ι, Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ =>
      inversePowerSoftMinWeight n (regularizedGram ε G) a b :=

name: NLAlib.measurable_gramSoftMinSecond_single
statement:
theorem measurable_gramSoftMinSecond_single (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ => gramSoftMinSecond n ε G (Matrix.single i j 1)
proof:
:= by
  let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
  have hG : ∀ i j, Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ => G i j := Matrix.measurable_entry
  have hE : ∀ i j, Measurable fun _ : Matrix ι κ ℝ => E i j := fun _ _ => measurable_const
  have hD : ∀ a b, Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ =>
      (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) a b := fun a b =>
    (measurable_mul_entry_of hE (fun a b => hG b a) a b).add
      (measurable_mul_entry_of hG (fun a b => hE b a) a b)
  have hW : ∀ a b : ι, Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ => regularizedGram ε G a b :=
    measurable_regularizedGram_entry ε
  have hSecond : Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ =>
      inversePowerSoftMinSecond n (regularizedGram ε G)
        (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) :=
    measurable_inversePowerSoftMinSecond_of_entries hW hD n
  have hC : ∀ a b : ι, Measurable fun _ : Matrix ι κ ℝ => ((2 : ℝ) • (E * Eᵀ)) a b :=
    fun _ _ => measurable_const
  have hFirst : Measurable fun G : Matrix ι κ ℝ =>
      inversePowerSoftMinFirst n (regularizedGram ε G) ((2 : ℝ) • (E * Eᵀ)) :=
    measurable_inversePowerSoftMinFirst_of_entries hW hC n
  exact hSecond.add hFirst

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_gram_direction
statement:
theorem trace_mul_gram_direction (X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hX : Xᵀ = X)
    (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ
proof:
:= Matrix.single i j 1
    Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) = 2 * (X * G) i j := by
  dsimp only
  let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
  have hGX : Gᵀ * X = (X * G)ᵀ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hX]
  have h1 : Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ)) = (X * G) i j := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    simp only [E, Matrix.trace_mul_single, op_smul_eq_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      one_mul, hGX, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have h2 : Matrix.trace (X * (G * Eᵀ)) = (X * G) i j := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    simp only [E, Matrix.transpose_single, Matrix.trace_mul_single,
      op_smul_eq_smul, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  change Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) = _
  rw [mul_add, Matrix.trace_add, h1, h2]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_sq
statement:
theorem sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_sq (X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hX : Xᵀ = X)
    (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
      Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) ^ 2) =
      4 * Matrix.trace (X ^ 2 * (G * Gᵀ))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [trace_mul_gram_direction X hX G, mul_pow]
  norm_num only
  have hfrob : frobInner (X * G) (X * G) = Matrix.trace (X ^ 2 * (G * Gᵀ)) := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul, hX, pow_two]
    calc Matrix.trace ((Gᵀ * X) * (X * G)) = Matrix.trace (Gᵀ * (X * X * G)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace ((X * X * G) * Gᵀ) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = _ := by congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← hfrob]
  simp only [frobInner_eq_sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction
statement:
theorem trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction (X Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : Xᵀ = X) (hY : Yᵀ = Y) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ
proof:
:= Matrix.single i j 1
    Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) =
      2 * (X * G) i j * (Y * G) i j + X i i * (Gᵀ * Y * G) j j +
        Y i i * (Gᵀ * X * G) j j := by
  dsimp only
  let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
  have hGX : Gᵀ * X = (X * G)ᵀ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hX]
  have hGY : Gᵀ * Y = (Y * G)ᵀ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hY]
  have h1 : Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ)) =
      (X * G) i j * (Y * G) i j := by
    calc _ = Matrix.trace (X * (E * (Gᵀ * Y) * E * Gᵀ)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace ((E * (Gᵀ * Y) * E * Gᵀ) * X) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = Matrix.trace ((E * (Gᵀ * Y) * E) * (Gᵀ * X)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [E, Matrix.single_mul_mul_single, one_mul, mul_one,
            Matrix.trace_single_mul, smul_eq_mul, hGX, hGY, Matrix.transpose_apply]
          ring
  have h2 : Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ) * Y * (G * Eᵀ)) =
      X i i * (Gᵀ * Y * G) j j := by
    calc _ = Matrix.trace (X * (E * (Gᵀ * Y * G) * Eᵀ)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [E, Matrix.transpose_single, Matrix.single_mul_mul_single,
            one_mul, mul_one, Matrix.trace_mul_single, op_smul_eq_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
  have h3 : Matrix.trace (X * (G * Eᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ)) =
      Y i i * (Gᵀ * X * G) j j := by
    calc _ = Matrix.trace ((X * G * Eᵀ * Y * E) * Gᵀ) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace (Gᵀ * (X * G * Eᵀ * Y * E)) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = Matrix.trace ((Gᵀ * X * G) * (Eᵀ * Y * E)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [E, Matrix.transpose_single, Matrix.single_mul_mul_single,
            one_mul, mul_one, Matrix.trace_mul_single, op_smul_eq_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h4 : Matrix.trace (X * (G * Eᵀ) * Y * (G * Eᵀ)) =
      (X * G) i j * (Y * G) i j := by
    calc _ = Matrix.trace ((X * G) * (Eᵀ * (Y * G) * Eᵀ)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [E, Matrix.transpose_single, Matrix.single_mul_mul_single,
            one_mul, mul_one, Matrix.trace_mul_single, op_smul_eq_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
  change Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) = _
  simp only [mul_add, add_mul, Matrix.trace_add]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction
statement:
theorem sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction (X Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : Xᵀ = X) (hY : Yᵀ = Y) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
      Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ))) =
      2 * Matrix.trace (X * Y * (G * Gᵀ)) +
        Matrix.trace X * Matrix.trace (Y * (G * Gᵀ)) +
        Matrix.trace Y * Matrix.trace (X * (G * Gᵀ))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction X Y hX hY G]
  have hfrob : frobInner (X * G) (Y * G) = Matrix.trace (X * Y * (G * Gᵀ)) := by
    rw [frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul, hX]
    calc Matrix.trace ((Gᵀ * X) * (Y * G)) = Matrix.trace (Gᵀ * (X * Y * G)) := by
          congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace ((X * Y * G) * Gᵀ) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = _ := by congr 1; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have htraceX : Matrix.trace (Gᵀ * X * G) = Matrix.trace (X * (G * Gᵀ)) := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (G * Gᵀ) X]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have htraceY : Matrix.trace (Gᵀ * Y * G) = Matrix.trace (Y * (G * Gᵀ)) := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (G * Gᵀ) Y]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← hfrob, ← htraceX, ← htraceY]
  simp only [frobInner_eq_sum_mul, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  congr 2
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring
  all_goals rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingWeight_mul_col_norm_sq_eq_insert
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingWeight_mul_col_norm_sq_eq_insert
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (S : Finset n) {j : n} (hj : j ∉ S) :
    complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S *
      ‖A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) -
        rangeProjector (complexVolumeSampleColumns A S) *
          A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)‖ ^ 2 =
      complexVolumeSamplingWeight A (insert j S)
proof:
:= by
  let B := complexVolumeSampleColumns A S
  let v := A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)
  let eSet : ↥(insert j S) ≃ S ⊕ PUnit :=
    (Equiv.setCongr (Finset.coe_insert j S)).trans (Equiv.Set.insert hj)
  let e : S ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ ↥(insert j S) :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl S) (Equiv.ofUnique (Fin 1) PUnit)).trans eSet.symm
  have hM : Matrix.fromCols B v = (complexVolumeSampleColumns A (insert j S)).submatrix id e := by
    ext i c
    cases c with
    | inl c =>
      simp [B, complexVolumeSampleColumns, e, eSet]
      rfl
    | inr c =>
      simp [v, complexVolumeSampleColumns, e, eSet]
      rfl
  have hGram : (Matrix.fromCols B v)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols B v =
      ((complexVolumeSampleColumns A (insert j S))ᴴ *
        complexVolumeSampleColumns A (insert j S)).submatrix e e := by
    rw [hM]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᴴ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det.re :=
      (det_gram_fromCols_eq_mul_frobenius_norm_sq_sub_rangeProjector B v).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [hGram, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]; rfl

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingWeight_mul_residual_norm_sq_eq_sum_insert
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingWeight_mul_residual_norm_sq_eq_sum_insert
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (S : Finset n) :
    complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S * ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ j, if j ∉ S then complexVolumeSamplingWeight A (insert j S) else 0
proof:
:= by
  let B := complexVolumeSampleColumns A S
  let P := rangeProjector B
  change complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S * ‖A - P * A‖ ^ 2 = _
  have hcols : ‖A - P * A‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ j, ‖(A - P * A).submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [← frobNorm_sq, frobNorm_eq_norm] using frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_col (A - P * A)
  rw [hcols, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  let v := A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)
  have hcol : (A - P * A).submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) = v - P * v := rfl
  rw [hcol]
  by_cases hj : j ∈ S
  · have hpv : P * v = v := by
      ext i c
      exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix m S ℂ => M i ⟨j, hj⟩) (rangeProjector_mul B)
    simp only [hpv, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero,
      if_neg (not_not.mpr hj)]
  · rw [if_pos hj]
    exact complexVolumeSamplingWeight_mul_col_norm_sq_eq_insert A S hj

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_normalizer_ratio
statement:
theorem integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_normalizer_ratio
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    (∫ S, ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2 ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk) =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer A (k + 1) /
        complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_complexVolumeSamplingLaw]
  simp only [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  simp only [complexVolumeSamplingWeight_mul_residual_norm_sq_eq_sum_insert]
  rw [sum_powersetCard_sum_insert_eq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_elementary_ratio
statement:
theorem integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_elementary_ratio
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    (∫ S, ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2 ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk) =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * complexGramElementary A (k + 1) / complexGramElementary A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_normalizer_ratio,
    complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_elementary, complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_elementary]

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_le_mul_tail
statement:
theorem integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_le_mul_tail
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    (∫ S, ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2 ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk) ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * complexGramTail A k
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := (complexGramElementary_pos_iff A k).mpr hk
  have hr : complexGramElementary A (k + 1) ≤ complexGramTail A k * complexGramElementary A k := by
    rw [complexGramElementary_eq_sum_prod_sorted, complexGramElementary_eq_sum_prod_sorted,
      complexGramTail]
    exact sum_powersetCard_prod_succ_le_tail_mul_sum_prod
      (complexGramEigenvalues A) (complexGramEigenvalues_nonneg A) k
  rw [integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_elementary_ratio, mul_div_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((div_le_iff₀ hZ).mpr hr) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_rank_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (∫ S, ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2 ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A (le_refl A.rank)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_elementary_ratio,
    complexGramElementary_eq_zero_of_rank_lt A (Nat.lt_succ_self A.rank), mul_zero, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingResidual_eq_zero_of_card_eq_rank
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingResidual_eq_zero_of_card_eq_rank
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {S : Finset n} (hS : S.card = A.rank)
    (hw : 0 < complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S) : complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_rank_eq_zero A
  rw [integral_complexVolumeSamplingLaw] at hzero
  have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun T _ =>
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (complexVolumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A T)
      ((complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_pos_iff A A.rank).mpr le_rfl).le) (sq_nonneg _))).mp hzero S
    (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hS⟩)
  have hp : 0 < complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S / complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer A A.rank :=
    div_pos hw ((complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_pos_iff A A.rank).mpr le_rfl)
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hterm).resolve_left hp.ne'))

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingLaw_zero_eq_dirac
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingLaw_zero_eq_dirac (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    complexVolumeSamplingLaw A (show 0 ≤ A.rank from Nat.zero_le _) = Measure.dirac ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext_of_measureReal_singleton
  intro S
  rw [measureReal_def, complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton,
    complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_zero]
  by_cases hS : S = ∅
  · subst S
    simp [measureReal_def]
  · have hc : S.card ≠ 0 := fun h => hS (Finset.card_eq_zero.mp h)
    simp [hc, hS, measureReal_def]

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (∫ S, ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2
      ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A (show 0 ≤ A.rank from Nat.zero_le _)) = ‖A‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexVolumeSamplingLaw_zero_eq_dirac, integral_dirac, complexVolumeSamplingResidual_empty]

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingWeight_eq_zero_of_card_gt_rank
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingWeight_eq_zero_of_card_gt_rank
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {S : Finset n} (hS : A.rank < S.card) :
    complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz := complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_zero_of_rank_lt A hS
  unfold complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer at hz
  exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun T _ => complexVolumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A T)).mp hz S
    (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.not_exists_positive_complexVolumeNormalizer_of_rank_lt
statement:
theorem not_exists_positive_complexVolumeNormalizer_of_rank_lt
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ} (hk : A.rank < k) :
    ¬ ∃ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z ∧ (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S) = Z
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨Z, hZ, he⟩
  have hz := complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_zero_of_rank_lt A hk
  change (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S) = 0 at hz
  rw [hz] at he
  exact hZ.ne' he.symm

name: NLAlib.ae_complexVolumeSamplingResidual_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ae_complexVolumeSamplingResidual_rank_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ∀ᵐ S ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A (le_refl A.rank), complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ae_iff_of_countable]
  intro S hS
  have hp := ENNReal.toReal_pos hS (measure_ne_top _ _)
  obtain ⟨hcard, hw⟩ := (complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton_pos_iff A (le_refl A.rank) S).mp hp
  exact complexVolumeSamplingResidual_eq_zero_of_card_eq_rank A hcard hw

    (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i)

name: NLAlib.sum_powersetCard_prod_pos_iff_card_nonzero
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_prod_pos_iff_card_nonzero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, a i) ↔
      k ≤ Fintype.card {i // a i ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := Finset.univ.filter fun i => a i ≠ 0
  have hcard : T.card = Fintype.card {i // a i ≠ 0} := by
    simp [T, Fintype.card_subtype]
  rw [← hcard]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hp⟩ :=
      (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg fun S _ => Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => ha i).mp h
    have hST : S ⊆ T := by
      intro i hi
      simp only [T, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact fun hz => (ne_of_gt hp) (Finset.prod_eq_zero hi hz)
    exact (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2.symm ▸ Finset.card_le_card hST
  · intro hk
    obtain ⟨S, hST, hSk⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hk
    apply (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg fun S _ =>
      Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => ha i).mpr
    refine ⟨S, Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hSk⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro i hi
    have hne : a i ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hST hi)).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (ha i) (Ne.symm hne)

name: NLAlib.complexGramElementary_pos_iff
statement:
theorem complexGramElementary_pos_iff (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < complexGramElementary A k ↔ k ≤ A.rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexGramElementary, sum_powersetCard_prod_pos_iff_card_nonzero
    _ (Matrix.eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_self_nonneg A)]
  rw [← (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs,
    Matrix.rank_conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.complexGramElementary_nonneg
statement:
theorem complexGramElementary_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :

    Matrix.eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_self_nonneg A i

name: NLAlib.complexGramElementary_eq_zero_of_rank_lt
statement:
theorem complexGramElementary_eq_zero_of_rank_lt (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ}

proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (not_lt.mp (by
    simpa [complexGramElementary_pos_iff] using not_le.mpr hk))
    (complexGramElementary_nonneg A k)

name: NLAlib.complexGramElementary_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexGramElementary_zero (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :

name: NLAlib.sum_re_det_complex_gram_principal_minors_eq
statement:
theorem sum_re_det_complex_gram_principal_minors_eq (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, ((Aᴴ * A).submatrix
      (Subtype.val : S → n) (Subtype.val : S → n)).det.re) =
      complexGramElementary A k
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Complex.re
    (Matrix.IsHermitian.sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A) k)
  simpa [complexGramElementary, ← Complex.ofReal_prod] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_powersetCard_prod_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_prod_eq_of_equiv {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (a : κ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, a i) =
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, a (e i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.map_univ_equiv e, Finset.powersetCard_map, Finset.sum_map]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  change (∏ i ∈ S.map e.toEmbedding, a i) = ∏ i ∈ S, a (e i)
  exact Finset.prod_map S e.toEmbedding a

name: NLAlib.complexGramElementary_eq_sum_prod_sorted
statement:
theorem complexGramElementary_eq_sum_prod_sorted (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    complexGramElementary A k =
      ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).powersetCard k,
        ∏ i ∈ S, complexGramEigenvalues A i
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  rw [complexGramElementary, sum_powersetCard_prod_eq_of_equiv e]
  simp only [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    complexGramEigenvalues]

name: NLAlib.sum_complexVolumeSamplingProbabilities
statement:
theorem sum_complexVolumeSamplingProbabilities (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) : ∑ S, complexVolumeSamplingProbabilities A k S = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := (complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_pos_iff A k).mpr hk
  apply NNReal.coe_injective
  rw [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_one]
  simp only [complexVolumeSamplingProbabilities, apply_ite,
    Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (complexVolumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A _) hZ.le), NNReal.coe_zero]
  have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset n)).filter (fun S => S.card = k) =
      Finset.univ.powersetCard k := by
    ext S
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_powersetCard, Finset.subset_univ]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hset, ← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hZ.ne'

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (S : Finset n) :
    (complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk {S}).toReal =
      if S.card = k then complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S / complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer A k else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := (complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_pos_iff A k).mpr hk
  rw [complexVolumeSamplingLaw, PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton _)]
  simp only [complexVolumeSamplingPMF, finiteSamplingPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.coe_toReal, complexVolumeSamplingProbabilities, apply_ite,
    Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (complexVolumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A _) hZ.le), NNReal.coe_zero]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSamplingLaw
statement:
theorem integral_complexVolumeSamplingLaw (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (f : Finset n → ℝ) :
    (∫ S, f S ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk) =
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k,
        complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S / complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer A k * f S
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := (complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_pos_iff A k).mpr hk
  rw [complexVolumeSamplingLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [complexVolumeSamplingPMF, finiteSamplingPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.coe_toReal, complexVolumeSamplingProbabilities, apply_ite,
    Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (complexVolumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A _) hZ.le),
    NNReal.coe_zero, smul_eq_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset n)).filter (fun S => S.card = k) =
      Finset.univ.powersetCard k := by
    ext S
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_powersetCard, Finset.subset_univ]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hset]

name: NLAlib.complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton_pos_iff
statement:
theorem complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton_pos_iff (A : Matrix m n ℂ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (S : Finset n) :
    0 < (complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk {S}).toReal ↔
      S.card = k ∧ 0 < complexVolumeSamplingWeight A S
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexVolumeSamplingLaw_singleton]
  have hZ := (complexVolumeSamplingNormalizer_pos_iff A k).mpr hk
  by_cases hS : S.card = k
  · simp only [hS, ite_true, true_and]
    exact div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hZ
  · simp only [hS, ite_false, lt_self_iff_false, false_and]

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingWeight_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    0 ≤ volumeSamplingWeight A S
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.det_nonneg
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_sum_prod_singularValues_sq
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_sum_prod_singularValues_sq
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    volumeSamplingNormalizer A k =
      ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k, ∏ i ∈ S, singularValues A i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, h⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  have hn := sum_det_principal_minors_eq_sum_prod_of_diagonalization
    (show Vᵀ * V = 1 from h.conjTranspose_mul_right)
    (show Aᵀ * A = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => singularValues A j ^ 2) * Vᵀ from
      h.conjTranspose_mul_self) k
  simpa only [volumeSamplingNormalizer, volumeSamplingWeight,
    transpose_volumeSampleColumns_mul_eq_submatrix] using hn

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) : 0 < volumeSamplingNormalizer A k
proof:
:= by
  have hkn : k ≤ n := hk.trans A.rank_le_width
  let S : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.image (Fin.castLE hkn)
  have hCard : S.card = k := by
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (Fin.castLE_injective hkn),
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hS : S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k :=
    Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hCard⟩
  have hProd : 0 < ∏ i ∈ S, singularValues A i ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro i hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨j, _, rfl⟩
    apply sq_pos_of_pos
    exact (singularValues_pos_iff A _).mpr (j.isLt.trans_le hk)
  rw [volumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_sum_prod_singularValues_sq]
  apply Finset.sum_pos'
  · intro T _
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  · exact ⟨S, hS, hProd⟩

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingWeight_mul_frobSq_col_eq_insert
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingWeight_mul_frobSq_col_eq_insert
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ S) :
    volumeSamplingWeight A S * frobSq
      (A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) - volumeSampleColumns A S *
        moorePenroseInverse (volumeSampleColumns A S) * A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)) =
      volumeSamplingWeight A (insert j S)
proof:
:= by
  let B := volumeSampleColumns A S
  let v := A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)
  let eSet : ↥(insert j S) ≃ S ⊕ PUnit :=
    (Equiv.setCongr (Finset.coe_insert j S)).trans (Equiv.Set.insert hj)
  let e : S ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ ↥(insert j S) :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl S) (Equiv.ofUnique (Fin 1) PUnit)).trans eSet.symm
  have hM : Matrix.fromCols B v = (volumeSampleColumns A (insert j S)).submatrix id e := by
    ext i c
    cases c with
    | inl c =>
      simp [B, volumeSampleColumns, e, eSet]
      rfl
    | inr c =>
      simp [v, volumeSampleColumns, e, eSet]
      rfl
  have hGram : (Matrix.fromCols B v)ᵀ * Matrix.fromCols B v =
      ((volumeSampleColumns A (insert j S))ᵀ * volumeSampleColumns A (insert j S)).submatrix e e := by
    rw [hM]
    rfl
  calc volumeSamplingWeight A S * frobSq (v - B * moorePenroseInverse B * v) =
      ((Matrix.fromCols B v)ᵀ * Matrix.fromCols B v).det :=
      (det_gram_fromCols_eq_mul_frobSq_sub_projector B v).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [hGram, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]; rfl

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingWeight_mul_frobSq_eq_sum_insert
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingWeight_mul_frobSq_eq_sum_insert
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    volumeSamplingWeight A S *
      frobSq (A - volumeSampleColumns A S * moorePenroseInverse (volumeSampleColumns A S) * A) =
      ∑ j, if j ∉ S then volumeSamplingWeight A (insert j S) else 0
proof:
:= by
  let B := volumeSampleColumns A S
  let P := B * moorePenroseInverse B
  change volumeSamplingWeight A S * frobSq (A - P * A) = _
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_single_columns, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  let v := A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j)
  have hcol : (A - P * A).submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) = v - P * v := rfl
  rw [hcol]
  by_cases hj : j ∈ S
  · have hpv : P * v = v := by
      ext i c
      exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) S ℝ => M i ⟨j, hj⟩)
        (mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul B)
    simp only [hpv, sub_self, frobSq_zero, mul_zero, if_neg (not_not.mpr hj)]
  · rw [if_pos hj]
    exact volumeSamplingWeight_mul_frobSq_col_eq_insert A S hj

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_eq_mul_normalizer_succ_div
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_eq_mul_normalizer_succ_div
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq A k =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * volumeSamplingNormalizer A (k + 1) / volumeSamplingNormalizer A k
proof:
:= by
  unfold volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq
  simp only [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  simp only [volumeSamplingWeight_mul_frobSq_eq_sum_insert]
  rw [sum_powersetCard_sum_insert_eq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq A k ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos A hk
  have hratio : volumeSamplingNormalizer A (k + 1) ≤
      bestRankFrobSq A k * volumeSamplingNormalizer A k := by
    rw [volumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_sum_prod_singularValues_sq,
      volumeSamplingNormalizer_eq_sum_prod_singularValues_sq, bestRankFrobSq_eq_sum_width]
    exact sum_powersetCard_prod_succ_le_tail_mul_sum_prod
      (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i ^ 2) (fun i => sq_nonneg _) k
  have hdiv : volumeSamplingNormalizer A (k + 1) / volumeSamplingNormalizer A k ≤
      bestRankFrobSq A k := (div_le_iff₀ hZ).mpr hratio
  rw [volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_eq_mul_normalizer_succ_div, mul_div_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) : 0 ≤ volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro S _
  exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (volumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A S)
    (volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos A hk).le) (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_rank_eq_zero (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq A A.rank = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq A (k := A.rank) le_rfl
  have htail : bestRankFrobSq A A.rank = 0 := by
    unfold bestRankFrobSq
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    split_ifs with hi
    · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A hi]
      simp
    · rfl
  rw [htail, mul_zero] at h
  exact le_antisymm h (volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_nonneg A le_rfl)

name: NLAlib.sub_volumeSample_projector_mul_eq_zero_of_card_eq_rank
statement:
theorem sub_volumeSample_projector_mul_eq_zero_of_card_eq_rank
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {S : Finset (Fin n)}
    (hS : S.card = A.rank) (hw : 0 < volumeSamplingWeight A S) :
    A - volumeSampleColumns A S * moorePenroseInverse (volumeSampleColumns A S) * A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq_rank_eq_zero A
  unfold volumeSamplingExpectedFrobSq at hzero
  have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
    (fun T _ => mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (volumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A T)
      (volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos A le_rfl).le) (frobSq_nonneg _))).mp hzero S
    (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hS⟩)
  have hc : 0 < volumeSamplingWeight A S / volumeSamplingNormalizer A A.rank :=
    div_pos hw (volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos A le_rfl)
  exact (frobSq_eq_zero_iff _).mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hterm).resolve_left hc.ne')

name: NLAlib.volumeSamplingProbability_nonneg
statement:
theorem volumeSamplingProbability_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : 0 ≤ volumeSamplingProbability A k S
proof:
:= by
  unfold volumeSamplingProbability
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (volumeSamplingWeight_nonneg A S) (volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos A hk).le
  · exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_volumeSamplingProbability
statement:
theorem sum_volumeSamplingProbability (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) : ∑ S, volumeSamplingProbability A k S = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun S => S.card = k) =
      Finset.univ.powersetCard k := by
    ext S
    simp [Finset.mem_powersetCard]
  simp only [volumeSamplingProbability]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hset, ← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self (volumeSamplingNormalizer_pos A hk).ne'

name: NLAlib.integral_volumeSamplingLaw
statement:
theorem integral_volumeSamplingLaw (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (f : Finset (Fin n) → ℝ) :
    (∫ S, f S ∂volumeSamplingLaw A hk) =
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k,
        volumeSamplingWeight A S / volumeSamplingNormalizer A k * f S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [volumeSamplingLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [volumeSamplingPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (volumeSamplingProbability_nonneg A hk _)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, volumeSamplingProbability, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun S => S.card = k) =
      Finset.univ.powersetCard k := by
    ext S
    simp [Finset.mem_powersetCard]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hset]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_volumeSamplingResidual
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_volumeSamplingResidual (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ}

      moorePenroseInverse (volumeSampleColumns A S) * A) ∂volumeSamplingLaw A hk) ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_volumeSamplingResidual_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_volumeSamplingResidual_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ A.rank)
    {T : Ω → Finset (Fin n)} (hT : HasLaw T (volumeSamplingLaw A hk) μ) :
    (∫ ω, frobSq (A - volumeSampleColumns A (T ω) *
      moorePenroseInverse (volumeSampleColumns A (T ω)) * A) ∂μ) ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:

  have he := hT.integral_comp (Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    (measurable_of_finite (fun S => frobSq (A - volumeSampleColumns A S *
      moorePenroseInverse (volumeSampleColumns A S) * A))))
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at he
  rw [he]
  exact integral_frobSq_volumeSamplingResidual_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq A hk

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_eq_complexGramTail
statement:
private theorem bestRankFrobSq_eq_complexGramTail {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    bestRankFrobSq A k = complexGramTail A k
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if k ≤ i then singularValues A i ^ 2 else 0
  have hrange : ∀ N, min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n) ≤ N →
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f i =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)), f i := fun N hN =>
    (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hN) fun i _ hni => by
      simp [f, singularValues_eq_zero_of_min_le A (not_lt.1 (by simpa using hni))]).symm
  have h2 : complexGramTail A k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card n), f i := by
    rw [complexGramTail, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [f, complexGramEigenvalues, sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀]
  rw [bestRankFrobSq, h2, hrange _ (min_le_left _ _), hrange _ (min_le_right _ _)]

name: NLAlib.integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_and_le_bestRank

      (k + 1 : ℝ) * complexGramElementary A (k + 1) / complexGramElementary A k ∧
    (∫ S, ‖complexVolumeSamplingResidual A S‖ ^ 2 ∂complexVolumeSamplingLaw A hk) ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_eq_elementary_ratio A hk, ?_⟩
  rw [bestRankFrobSq_eq_complexGramTail]
  exact integral_complexVolumeSampling_residual_norm_sq_le_mul_tail A hk

  rw [h]
  split_ifs with hS
  · exact re_det_rowGram_sizedSubset_eq_rowSubsetVolume Q ⟨S, hS⟩

statement:
theorem hasLaw_image_projectionPivotHistoryLaw (Q : Matrix n d ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    HasLaw (fun h : Fin (Fintype.card d) → n => Finset.univ.image h)
      (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) (projectionPivotHistoryLaw Q)
proof:

name: NLAlib.ae_size_fullRank_projectionRowVolumeLaw
statement:
private theorem ae_size_fullRank_projectionRowVolumeLaw {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    ∀ᵐ S ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ,
      S.card = Fintype.card d ∧ IsUnit (rowSubsetGram Q S)
proof:
:= by
  apply ae_iff_of_countable.mpr
  intro S hS
  have hp : 0 < (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ).real {S} :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos hS (measure_ne_top _ _)
  rw [projectionRowVolumeLaw_singleton] at hp
  split_ifs at hp with hcard
  · exact ⟨hcard, (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit Q S).mp hp⟩
  · exact (lt_irrefl 0 hp).elim

name: NLAlib.injective_of_image_card_eq
statement:
private theorem injective_of_image_card_eq {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n)
    (hc : (Finset.univ.image h).card = t) : Function.Injective h
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Set.InjOn h (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin t)) :=
    Finset.card_image_iff.mp (by simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hc)
  exact fun i j hij => hi (Finset.mem_univ i) (Finset.mem_univ j) hij

name: NLAlib.ae_injective_fullRank_projectionPivotHistoryLaw
statement:

    (Q : Matrix n d ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    ∀ᵐ h ∂projectionPivotHistoryLaw Q, Function.Injective h ∧
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram Q (Finset.univ.image h))
proof:
:= by
  have hS := (hasLaw_image_projectionPivotHistoryLaw Q hQ).ae_iff
    (show Measurable (fun S : Finset n => S.card = Fintype.card d ∧ IsUnit (rowSubsetGram Q S))
      from .of_discrete)
  have hA := hS.mpr (ae_size_fullRank_projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ)
  filter_upwards [hA] with h hh
  exact ⟨injective_of_image_card_eq h hh.1, hh.2⟩
