name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le {r t : ℕ}
    (hrt : r + 2 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ℝ => specNorm (pinvR G) ^ 2)
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin t)) ∧
    ∫ G, specNorm (pinvR G) ^ 2 ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ≤
      Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((t : ℝ) + r) / (2 * ((t : ℝ) - r) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hv⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_specNorm_inv_self_mul_transpose_pow_gaussianMatrix_le
      (r := r) (k := t) (p := 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  simp only [pow_one] at hi hv
  have he : (fun G : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ℝ => specNorm (pinvR G) ^ 2)
      =ᵐ[gaussianMatrix (Fin r) (Fin t)] fun G => specNorm (G * Gᵀ)⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose (show r ≤ t by omega)] with G hG
    exact specNorm_pinvR_sq G hG
  exact ⟨hi.congr he.symm, (integral_congr_ae he).trans_le hv⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n k p r r' : ℕ} (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ^ 2) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤
      2 * specNorm S₂ ^ 2 * (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) +
        frobSq S₂ * (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * k + p) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  set X : Ωs → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ := fun ω => V₁ᵀ * Ω ω with hXdef
  set Y : Ωs → Matrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p)) ℝ := fun ω => V₂ᵀ * Ω ω with hYdef
  have hXlaw : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) μ :=
    hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ hV₁
  have hYlaw : HasLaw Y (gaussianMatrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p))) μ :=
    hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₂ hV₂
  have hind : IndepFun X Y μ := gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV
  have hXm := hXlaw.aemeasurable
  have hYm := hYlaw.aemeasurable
  set g : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ → Matrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p)) ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun x y => specNorm (S₂ * y * pinvR x) ^ 2 with hgdef
  have hfg : (fun ω => specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ^ 2) =
      fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω) := rfl
  have hgm : Measurable fun q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ × Matrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p)) ℝ =>
      g q.1 q.2 :=
    (measurable_specNorm_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp
      ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul
        ((Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr measurable_pinvR_entry).comp measurable_fst)))).pow_const 2
  
  set B : (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ) → ℝ := fun x =>
    2 * specNorm S₂ ^ 2 * frobSq (pinvR x) + 2 * frobSq S₂ * specNorm (pinvR x) ^ 2
    with hBdef
  obtain ⟨hFi, hFv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix (r := k) (k := k + p) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨hSi, hSv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le
    (r := k) (t := k + p) (by omega)
  have hBi : Integrable B (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) :=
    (hFi.const_mul _).add (hSi.const_mul _)
  have hS0 := frobSq_nonneg S₂
  have hB0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x := fun x =>
    by
      have hx0 := frobSq_nonneg (pinvR x)
      dsimp [B]
      positivity
  set bound := 2 * specNorm S₂ ^ 2 * (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) +
    frobSq S₂ * (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * k + p) / p ^ 2) with hbound
  have hbound0 : 0 ≤ bound :=
    by
      have hpR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
      have hp1 : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
      dsimp [bound]
      positivity
  have hBint : ∫ x, B x ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) ≤ bound := by
    rw [hBdef, integral_add (hFi.const_mul _) (hSi.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul]
    push_cast at hFv hSv
    have heq : (↑k + ↑p - ↑k - 1 : ℝ) = p - 1 := by ring
    rw [heq] at hFv
    rw [hFv]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSv (show 0 ≤ 2 * frobSq S₂ by positivity)
    have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * specNorm S₂ ^ 2 * (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) +
          2 * frobSq S₂ * (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (k + p + k) / (2 * (k + p - k) ^ 2)) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl hh
      _ = bound := by
        dsimp [bound]
        rw [show ((k : ℝ) + p - k) = p by ring]
        congr 1
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hpR]
        ring
  have hL : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (g (X ω) (Y ω)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal bound := by
    rw [lintegral_of_indepFun hXm hYm hind (g := fun x y => ENNReal.ofReal (g x y))
      (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm).aemeasurable, hXlaw.map_eq, hYlaw.map_eq]
    calc ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (g x y) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p))
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))
        ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (B x) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
          obtain ⟨hci, hcv⟩ :=
            integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S₂ (pinvR x)
          rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hci (ae_of_all _ fun _ => sq_nonneg _)]
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          apply hcv.trans
          dsimp [B]
          have h1 := frobNorm_sq (pinvR x)
          have h2 := frobNorm_sq S₂
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (specNorm S₂ * frobNorm (pinvR x) -
            frobNorm S₂ * specNorm (pinvR x))]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, B x ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hBi (ae_of_all _ hB0)).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal bound := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hBint
  have hf0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω) := ae_of_all _ fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω)) μ :=
    (hgm.comp_aemeasurable (hXm.prodMk hYm)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hfi : Integrable (fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω)) μ :=
    ⟨hfm, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hf0).2 (hL.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)⟩
  rw [hfg]
  refine ⟨hfi, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hf0 hfm]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hbound0 hL

name: NLAlib.complexVectorTangentToColumns_le_of_orthogonal_competitor
statement:
theorem complexVectorTangentToColumns_le_of_orthogonal_competitor
    (B : Matrix n k ℂ) {u w : EuclideanSpace ℂ n} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (huw : inner ℂ u w = 0) (hw : u + w ∈ columnSpace B) :
    complexVectorTangentToColumns B u ≤ ‖w‖
proof:
:= by
  let S := columnSpace B
  have hpv : inner ℂ (S.starProjection u) (u + w) = 1 := by
    rw [S.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right,
      (Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff (K := S)).mpr hw,
      inner_add_right, huw, add_zero, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hu]
    norm_num
  have hvv : ‖u + w‖ ^ 2 = 1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [← pow_two, hu, one_pow] using
      (norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero u w huw)
  have hcs : 1 ≤ ‖S.starProjection u‖ ^ 2 * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
    have hc := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) (S.starProjection u) (u + w)
    rw [hpv, norm_one] at hc
    have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hc 2
    simpa only [one_pow, mul_pow, hvv] using hs
  have hpp : 0 < ‖S.starProjection u‖ := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : ‖S.starProjection u‖ = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [hz, zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_mul] at hcs
    linarith
  have hsplit := S.norm_sq_eq_add_norm_sq_starProjection u
  rw [hu, one_pow, S.starProjection_orthogonal_val] at hsplit
  unfold complexVectorTangentToColumns
  change ‖u - S.starProjection u‖ / ‖S.starProjection u‖ ≤ ‖w‖
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hpp).2
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [mul_pow]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
    {U : Matrix n k ℂ} (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (z : k → ℂ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ z) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 z : EuclideanSpace ℂ k)‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  have hh : star z ⬝ᵥ ((Uᴴ * U) *ᵥ z) = star (U *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ z) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose,
      star_star]
  rw [← hh, hU, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.complexVectorTangentToColumns_graph_col_le
statement:
theorem complexVectorTangentToColumns_graph_col_le
    {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l] (B : Matrix n l ℂ)
    {U₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℂ}
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (F : Matrix r k ℂ)
    (hRange : columnSpace (U₁ + U₂ * F) ≤ columnSpace B) (i : k) :
    complexVectorTangentToColumns B (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i)) ≤
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖
proof:
:= by
  let e : k → ℂ := Pi.single i 1
  have he : U₁.col i = U₁ *ᵥ e := by simp [e]
  have hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [he, norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU₁]
    simp [e]
  have horth : inner ℂ (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ *ᵥ F.col i)) = 0 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm, he]
    have hh : star e ⬝ᵥ ((U₁ᴴ * U₂) *ᵥ F.col i) =
        star (U₁ *ᵥ e) ⬝ᵥ (U₂ *ᵥ F.col i) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
        Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose, star_star]
    rw [← hh, hU, Matrix.zero_mulVec, dotProduct_zero]
  have hw : (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) +
      WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ *ᵥ F.col i) ∈ columnSpace B := by
    apply hRange
    refine ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 e, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.toLpLin_apply, Matrix.add_mulVec,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, WithLp.toLp_add]
    simp [e]
  exact (complexVectorTangentToColumns_le_of_orthogonal_competitor B hu horth hw).trans_eq
    (norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU₂ _)

name: NLAlib.norm_complex_graph_col_le_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem norm_complex_graph_col_le_of_diagonal
    (L₂ : Matrix r r ℂ) (F : Matrix r k ℂ) (eig : k → ℂ) (t : ℕ) (i : k) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((L₂ ^ t * F * (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (eig j)⁻¹) ^ t).col i) :
      EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖ ≤ (‖L₂‖ / ‖eig i‖) ^ t *
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : (L₂ ^ t * F * (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (eig j)⁻¹) ^ t).col i =
      ((eig i)⁻¹) ^ t • (L₂ ^ t *ᵥ F.col i) := by
    ext j
    change (L₂ ^ t * F * (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (eig j)⁻¹) ^ t) j i = _
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    change (L₂ ^ t * F) j i * ((eig i)⁻¹) ^ t =
      ((eig i)⁻¹) ^ t * (L₂ ^ t * F) j i
    ring
  have hp : ‖L₂ ^ t‖ ≤ ‖L₂‖ ^ t := by
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using
        (norm_le_one_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
          (P := (1 : Matrix r r ℂ)) Matrix.isHermitian_one
          (by change (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) * 1 = 1; exact Matrix.mul_one _))
    | succ t => exact norm_pow_le' L₂ (Nat.succ_pos t)
  have hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (L₂ ^ t *ᵥ F.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖ ≤
      ‖L₂‖ ^ t * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖ :=
    (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec (L₂ ^ t) (WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i))).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (norm_nonneg _))
  rw [hcol, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, norm_pow, norm_inv]
  calc ‖eig i‖⁻¹ ^ t * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (L₂ ^ t *ᵥ F.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖ ≤
      ‖eig i‖⁻¹ ^ t * (‖L₂‖ ^ t * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) _)
    _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.columnSpace_mul_le
statement:
theorem columnSpace_mul_le {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    (B : Matrix n k ℂ) (R : Matrix k l ℂ) : columnSpace (B * R) ≤ columnSpace B
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.range (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (B * R)) ≤
    LinearMap.range (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B)
  rw [Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: NLAlib.columnSpace_mul_eq_of_right_inverse
statement:
theorem columnSpace_mul_eq_of_right_inverse
    (B : Matrix n k ℂ) {R T : Matrix k k ℂ} (hRT : R * T = 1) :
    columnSpace (B * R) = columnSpace B
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (columnSpace_mul_le B R)
  have he : B = (B * R) * T := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hRT, Matrix.mul_one]
  conv_lhs => rw [he]
  exact columnSpace_mul_le (B * R) T

name: NLAlib.complexVectorTangentToColumns_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem complexVectorTangentToColumns_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℂ}
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (eig₁ : k → ℂ) (L₂ : Matrix r r ℂ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁) (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * L₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℂ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℂ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℂ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    (hEigen : ∀ i, eig₁ i ≠ 0) (t : ℕ) (i : k) :
    complexVectorTangentToColumns (A ^ t * Ω) (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i)) ≤
      (‖L₂‖ / ‖eig₁ i‖) ^ t *
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((Ω₂ * R).col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖
proof:
:= by
  let Linv : Matrix k k ℂ := Matrix.diagonal fun i => (eig₁ i)⁻¹
  have hL : Matrix.diagonal eig₁ * Linv = 1 := by
    dsimp only [Linv]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hEigen j)
  have hpow : (Matrix.diagonal eig₁) ^ t * Linv ^ t = 1 := by
    have hc : Commute (Matrix.diagonal eig₁) Linv := by change (Matrix.diagonal eig₁) * Linv = Linv * (Matrix.diagonal eig₁); rw [hL, mul_eq_one_comm.1 hL]
    rw [← hc.mul_pow, hL, one_pow]
  have hY : A ^ t * Ω = U₁ * (Matrix.diagonal eig₁) ^ t * Ω₁ + U₂ * L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ := by
    rw [hΩ, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hA₁, pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hA₂]
  have hN : A ^ t * Ω * (R * Linv ^ t) = U₁ + U₂ * (L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ * R * Linv ^ t) := by
    rw [hY, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ω₁, hR, Matrix.one_mul, hpow, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hRT : (R * Linv ^ t) * ((Matrix.diagonal eig₁) ^ t * Ω₁) = 1 := by
    have hpow' : Linv ^ t * (Matrix.diagonal eig₁) ^ t = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 hpow
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (Linv ^ t), hpow', Matrix.one_mul, mul_eq_one_comm.1 hR]
  have hSpace := columnSpace_mul_eq_of_right_inverse (A ^ t * Ω) hRT
  rw [hN] at hSpace
  have hh := complexVectorTangentToColumns_graph_col_le (A ^ t * Ω) hU₁ hU₂ hU
    (L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ * R * Linv ^ t) hSpace.le i
  exact hh.trans (by simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using
    norm_complex_graph_col_le_of_diagonal L₂ (Ω₂ * R) eig₁ t i)

name: NLAlib.complexSubspaceTangent_and_complexVectorTangentToColumns_le
statement:
theorem complexSubspaceTangent_and_complexVectorTangentToColumns_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℂ}
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (eig₁ : k → ℂ) (eig₂ : r → ℂ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁)
    (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * Matrix.diagonal eig₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℂ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℂ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℂ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hgap : ∀ i, α ≤ ‖eig₁ i‖) (t : ℕ) :
    complexSubspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (subspaceIterate A Ω t) ≤
        (‖Matrix.diagonal eig₂‖ / α) ^ t *
          complexSubspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin) ∧
      ∀ i, complexVectorTangentToColumns (A ^ t * Ω) (WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁.col i)) ≤
        (‖Matrix.diagonal eig₂‖ / ‖eig₁ i‖) ^ t *
          ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((Ω₂ * R).col i) : EuclideanSpace ℂ r)‖
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨complexSubspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal hU₁ hU₂ hU
    eig₁ eig₂ hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hα hgap t, ?_⟩
  have heig : ∀ i, eig₁ i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hh := hgap i
    rw [hi, norm_zero] at hh
    linarith
  exact fun i => complexVectorTangentToColumns_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
    hU₁ hU₂ hU eig₁ _ hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR heig t i

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_range_subset
proof:
:= by
  set Z := A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᵀ with hZdef
  
  have hQZ : Q * (Qᵀ * Z) = Z := by
    have : Z = A * Ω * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᵀ) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
    rw [this, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᵀ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q, hQ]
  have hres : projResidual Q A = (A - Z) - Q * (Qᵀ * (A - Z)) := by
    rw [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, hQZ]
    abel
  have h1 : specNorm (projResidual Q A) ≤ specNorm (A - Z) := by
    rw [hres]; exact specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hQo.conjTranspose_mul_self _
  
  have hU₂t : U₂ᵀ * U₂ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hU₂.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hV₁t : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hV₁.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have h2 : specNorm (A - Z) =
      specNorm (S₂ * V₂ᵀ + -(S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᵀ)) := by
    have he := sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq hA hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at he
    rw [hZdef, he, specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU₂t, sub_eq_add_neg]
  
  have horth : (S₂ * V₂ᵀ) * (-(S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᵀ))ᵀ = 0 := by
    have hV' : V₂ᵀ * V₁ = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hV
    rw [Matrix.transpose_neg, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc S₂, ← Matrix.mul_assoc V₂ᵀ, hV', Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have h3 := specNorm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero (X := S₂ * V₂ᵀ)
    (Y := -(S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᵀ)) horth
  rw [specNorm_neg, specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols (P := V₂) hV₂,
    specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV₁t] at h3
  calc specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm (A - Z) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) h1 2
    _ ≤ _ := by rw [h2]; exact h3

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_le_of_range_subset
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_range_subset hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit hQo hQ
  have ha := specNorm_nonneg S₂
  have hb := specNorm_nonneg (S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁)
  have hc := specNorm_nonneg (projResidual Q A)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le {k p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ => frobNorm (pinvR G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) ∧
    ∫ G, frobNorm (pinvR G) ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)))
      ≤ Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsqi, hsqv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix
    (r := k) (k := k + p) (by omega)
  have hm : Measurable fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ => frobNorm (pinvR G) :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.measurable.comp
      (measurable_frobSq_of_entries fun i j => measurable_pinvR_entry i j)
  have hsq : (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ => frobNorm (pinvR G) ^ 2) =
      fun G => frobSq (pinvR G) := funext fun G => frobNorm_sq _
  have hsqi' : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ =>
      frobNorm (pinvR G) ^ 2) (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) := by rw [hsq]; exact hsqi
  have hint : Integrable (fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ => frobNorm (pinvR G))
      (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) :=
    ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hm.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hsqi').integrable one_le_two
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  have hJ := integral_le_sqrt_integral_sq hint hsqi'
  rw [hsq, hsqv] at hJ
  refine hJ.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n k p r r' : ℕ} (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ ≤
      specNorm S₂ * Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) +
        frobNorm S₂ * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p)
proof:
:= by
  set X : Ωs → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ := fun ω => V₁ᵀ * Ω ω with hXdef
  set Y : Ωs → Matrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p)) ℝ := fun ω => V₂ᵀ * Ω ω with hYdef
  have hXlaw : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) μ :=
    hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ hV₁
  have hYlaw : HasLaw Y (gaussianMatrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p))) μ :=
    hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₂ hV₂
  have hind : IndepFun X Y μ := gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV
  have hXm := hXlaw.aemeasurable
  have hYm := hYlaw.aemeasurable
  set g : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ → Matrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p)) ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun x y => specNorm (S₂ * y * pinvR x) with hgdef
  have hfg : (fun ω => specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) =
      fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω) := rfl
  have hgm : Measurable fun q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ × Matrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p)) ℝ =>
      g q.1 q.2 :=
    measurable_specNorm_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp
      ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_snd).matrix_mul
        ((Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr measurable_pinvR_entry).comp measurable_fst)))
  
  set B : (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ) → ℝ := fun x =>
    specNorm S₂ * frobNorm (pinvR x) + frobNorm S₂ * specNorm (pinvR x)
    with hBdef
  obtain ⟨hFi, hFv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le (k := k) hp
  obtain ⟨hSi, hSv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_le
    (r := k) (k := k + p) hk (by omega)
  have hBi : Integrable B (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) :=
    (hFi.const_mul _).add (hSi.const_mul _)
  have hB0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x := fun x =>
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (frobNorm_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
  set bound := specNorm S₂ * Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) +
    frobNorm S₂ * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p) with hbound
  have hbound0 : 0 ≤ bound :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg (frobNorm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  have hBint : ∫ x, B x ∂(gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) ≤ bound := by
    rw [hBdef, integral_add (hFi.const_mul _) (hSi.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul]
    have hcast : ((k + p : ℕ) : ℝ) - k = p := by push_cast; ring
    have hcast' : Real.sqrt ((k + p : ℕ) : ℝ) = Real.sqrt (k + p) := by push_cast; ring_nf
    rw [hcast, hcast'] at hSv
    exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFv (specNorm_nonneg _))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSv (frobNorm_nonneg _))
  have hL : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (g (X ω) (Y ω)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal bound := by
    rw [lintegral_of_indepFun hXm hYm hind (g := fun x y => ENNReal.ofReal (g x y))
      (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm).aemeasurable, hXlaw.map_eq, hYlaw.map_eq]
    calc ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (g x y) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin r') (Fin (k + p))
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))
        ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (B x) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p)) := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
          obtain ⟨hci, hcv⟩ :=
            integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_gaussianMatrix_mul_le S₂ (pinvR x)
          rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hci (ae_of_all _ fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _)]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcv
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, B x ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + p))) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hBi (ae_of_all _ hB0)).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal bound := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hBint
  have hf0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω) := ae_of_all _ fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω)) μ :=
    (hgm.comp_aemeasurable (hXm.prodMk hYm)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hfi : Integrable (fun ω => g (X ω) (Y ω)) μ :=
    ⟨hfm, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hf0).2 (hL.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)⟩
  rw [hfg]
  refine ⟨hfi, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hf0 hfm]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hbound0 hL

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_residual_le_of_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_residual_le_of_gaussian
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m' q' : Type*} [Fintype m'] [DecidableEq m'] [Fintype q'] [DecidableEq q']
    {n k p r r' : ℕ} {A : Matrix m' (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m' (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m' (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ}
    {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix m' q' ℝ) (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω) :
    ∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ ≤
      (1 + Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1))) * specNorm S₂ +
        Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p * frobNorm S₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hle⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_specNorm_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le Ω hΩ hV₁ hV₂ hV S₂ hk hp
  have hunit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ) :=
    ae_isUnit_block hΩ V₁ hV₁ (by omega)
  have hpt : (fun ω => specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A)) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => specNorm S₂ + specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hQo, hQr, hunit] with ω hqo hqr hu
    exact specNorm_residual_le_of_range_subset hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV rfl rfl hu hqo hqr
  have hmono : ∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ ≤
      ∫ ω, (specNorm S₂ + specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) ∂μ :=
    integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun ω => specNorm_nonneg _)
      ((integrable_const (specNorm S₂)).add hint) hpt
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hint, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hmono
  refine hmono.trans ?_
  have := hle
  nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg S₂, frobNorm_nonneg S₂]

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_residual_le_singularValues_of_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_residual_le_singularValues_of_gaussian
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {q' : Type*} [Fintype q'] [DecidableEq q'] {m n k p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hkn : k ≤ n) (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) q' ℝ) (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω) :
    ∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ ≤
      (1 + Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1))) * singularValues A k +
        Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, hspec, hfrob⟩ :=
    exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm A k hkn
  have h := integral_specNorm_residual_le_of_gaussian hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hk hp Ω hΩ Q hQo hQr
  rwa [hspec, frobNorm, hfrob] at h

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_residual_gaussianRangeFrame_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_residual_gaussianRangeFrame_le
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ) :
    ∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (gaussianRangeFrame A (k + p) (Ω ω)) A) ∂μ ≤
      (1 + Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1))) * singularValues A k +
        Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k)
proof:
:=
  integral_specNorm_residual_le_singularValues_of_gaussian A hk hp hkn Ω hΩ _
    (ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw A Ω hΩ)
    (ae_project_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw A Ω hΩ)

name: NLAlib.complexSubspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_norm
statement:
theorem complexSubspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_norm
    {U₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℂ}
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1)
    (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0) (F : Matrix r k ℂ) :
    complexSubspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range (U₁ + U₂ * F).mulVecLin) = ‖F‖
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : U₂ᴴ * U₁ = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hU
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using h
  have hhead : ∀ z : k → ℂ, U₁ᴴ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ z) = z := by
    intro z
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU₁, hU,
      Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have htail : ∀ z : k → ℂ, U₂ᴴ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ z) = F *ᵥ z := by
    intro z
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU', hU₂,
      Matrix.one_mul, zero_add]
  let f := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (𝕜 := ℂ)).trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap F
  have he : ((fun x : n → ℂ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ᴴ *ᵥ x)‖) ''
      {x | x ∈ LinearMap.range (U₁ + U₂ * F).mulVecLin ∧
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₁ᴴ *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ 1}) =
      ((fun z : EuclideanSpace ℂ k => ‖f z‖) '' Metric.closedBall 0 1) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, hz⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 z, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, hhead, Metric.mem_closedBall,
          dist_zero_right] using hz
      · change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F *ᵥ z)‖ =
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ᴴ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ z))‖
        rw [htail]
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z, ⟨⟨WithLp.ofLp z, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [hhead, WithLp.toLp_ofLp, Metric.mem_closedBall,
          dist_zero_right] using hz
      · change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U₂ᴴ *ᵥ ((U₁ + U₂ * F) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z))‖ =
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z)‖
        rw [htail]
  rw [complexSubspaceTangent, he, ContinuousLinearMap.sSup_unitClosedBall_eq_norm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.complexSubspaceIterate_eq_range_graph
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : L₁ ^ t * Linv ^ t = 1 := by
    have hc : Commute L₁ Linv := by
      change L₁ * Linv = Linv * L₁
      rw [hL, mul_eq_one_comm.1 hL]
    rw [← hc.mul_pow, hL, one_pow]
  have hY : A ^ t * Ω = U₁ * L₁ ^ t * Ω₁ + U₂ * L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ := by
    rw [hΩ, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hA₁, pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hA₂]
  have hN : A ^ t * Ω * (R * Linv ^ t) =
      U₁ + U₂ * (L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ * R * Linv ^ t) := by
    rw [hY, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ω₁, hR, Matrix.one_mul, hpow, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hRu : IsUnit R :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2 (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hR)
  have hLu : IsUnit Linv :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2 (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hL)
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (A ^ t * Ω * (R * Linv ^ t)).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.range (A ^ t * Ω).mulVecLin := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_mul, LinearMap.range_comp]
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 (Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.2
      (hRu.mul (hLu.pow t))), Submodule.map_top]
  rw [hN] at hrange
  exact hrange.symm

name: NLAlib.norm_pow_mul_mul_pow_complex_le
statement:
theorem norm_pow_mul_mul_pow_complex_le
    (L₂ : Matrix r r ℂ) (F : Matrix r k ℂ) (Linv : Matrix k k ℂ) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖L₂ ^ t * F * Linv ^ t‖ ≤ (‖L₂‖ * ‖Linv‖) ^ t * ‖F‖
proof:
:= by
  have hp₂ : ‖L₂ ^ t‖ ≤ ‖L₂‖ ^ t := by
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using
        (norm_le_one_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
          (P := (1 : Matrix r r ℂ)) Matrix.isHermitian_one
          (by change (1 : Matrix r r ℂ) * 1 = 1; exact Matrix.mul_one _))
    | succ t => exact norm_pow_le' L₂ (Nat.succ_pos t)
  have hp₁ : ‖Linv ^ t‖ ≤ ‖Linv‖ ^ t := by
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using
        (norm_le_one_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem
          (P := (1 : Matrix k k ℂ)) Matrix.isHermitian_one
          (by change (1 : Matrix k k ℂ) * 1 = 1; exact Matrix.mul_one _))
    | succ t => exact norm_pow_le' Linv (Nat.succ_pos t)
  calc ‖L₂ ^ t * F * Linv ^ t‖ ≤ (‖L₂ ^ t‖ * ‖F‖) * ‖Linv ^ t‖ :=
      (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (‖L₂‖ ^ t * ‖F‖) * ‖Linv‖ ^ t :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp₂ (norm_nonneg F)) hp₁
        (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.complexSubspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := complexSubspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL 0
  simp only [subspaceIterate, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] at hzero
  rw [complexSubspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL t, hzero,
    complexSubspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_norm hU₁ hU₂ hU,
    complexSubspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_norm hU₁ hU₂ hU]
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using norm_pow_mul_mul_pow_complex_le L₂ (Ω₂ * R) Linv t

name: NLAlib.complexSubspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem complexSubspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℂ}
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (eig₁ : k → ℂ) (eig₂ : r → ℂ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁)
    (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * Matrix.diagonal eig₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℂ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℂ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℂ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hgap : ∀ i, α ≤ ‖eig₁ i‖) (t : ℕ) :
    complexSubspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (subspaceIterate A Ω t) ≤
      (‖Matrix.diagonal eig₂‖ / α) ^ t *
        complexSubspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin)
proof:
:= by
  let Linv : Matrix k k ℂ := Matrix.diagonal fun i => (eig₁ i)⁻¹
  have hEigenNonzero : ∀ i, eig₁ i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have := hgap i
    rw [hi, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hL : Matrix.diagonal eig₁ * Linv = 1 := by
    dsimp only [Linv]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hEigenNonzero i)
  have hLi : ‖Linv‖ ≤ 1 / α := by
    dsimp only [Linv]
    rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2
    intro i
    rw [norm_inv, ← one_div]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hα (hgap i)
  have hrate : ‖Matrix.diagonal eig₂‖ * ‖Linv‖ ≤ ‖Matrix.diagonal eig₂‖ / α := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLi (norm_nonneg (Matrix.diagonal eig₂))
  have hzero := complexSubspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL 0
  simp only [subspaceIterate, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] at hzero
  have htan : 0 ≤ complexSubspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin) := by
    rw [hzero, complexSubspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_norm hU₁ hU₂ hU]
    exact norm_nonneg _
  exact (complexSubspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le hU₁ hU₂ hU hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL t).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) hrate t) htan)

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_residual_of_measurable_frame
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_residual_of_measurable_frame
    {Ω m n l : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype l]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq l]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (Q : Ω → Matrix m l ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => Q ω i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A)) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (integrable_const (specNorm A)).mono'
    (measurable_specNorm_residual_of A hQ).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
  exact specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hω A

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_residual_le_rpow_integral
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_residual_le_rpow_integral
    {Ω m n l : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype l]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq l]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (Q : Ω → Matrix m l ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => Q ω i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω)) (q : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ) ≤
      (∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A)) ∂μ) ^
        (1 / (2 * (q : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun ω => specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A)
  let g := fun ω => specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A))
  let r := 2 * q + 1
  have hfi := integrable_specNorm_residual_of_measurable_frame A Q hQ hQo
  have hgi := integrable_specNorm_residual_of_measurable_frame ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A) Q hQ hQo
  have hfpi : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ r) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (specNorm A ^ r)).mono'
      ((measurable_specNorm_residual_of A hQ).pow_const r).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _)]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hω A) r
  have hJ := (convexOn_pow r (𝕜 := ℝ)).map_integral_le (continuous_pow r).continuousOn
    isClosed_Ici (ae_of_all _ fun ω => specNorm_nonneg (projResidual (Q ω) A)) hfi hfpi
  have hfg : (fun ω => f ω ^ r) ≤ᵐ[μ] g := by
    filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
    exact specNorm_residual_pow_le hω A q
  have hle : (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) ^ r ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ :=
    hJ.trans (integral_mono_ae hfpi hgi hfg)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun ω => specNorm_nonneg _
  have hcast : 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ) + 1) = ((r : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [r]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by dsimp [r]; omega
  rw [hcast, ← Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (n := r) hnonneg hr]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (pow_nonneg hnonneg r) hle (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg r))

name: NLAlib.ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_rank_le
    {Ω l : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype l]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {m n t : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (Q : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) l ℝ)
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * G ω)) = A * G ω)
    (ht : A.rank ≤ t) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A) = A
proof:
:= by
  have hRank : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A * G ω).rank = A.rank := by
    simpa only [min_eq_left ht] using ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min A G hG
  filter_upwards [hRank, hQr] with ω hr hproj
  have hRange := range_mulVecLin_mul_eq_of_rank_eq A (G ω) hr
  have hCols : ∀ j : Fin n, ∃ v : Fin t → ℝ, (A * G ω) *ᵥ v = A.col j := by
    intro j
    have hj : A.col j ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin := by
      rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [← hRange] at hj
    exact hj
  choose v hv using hCols
  let T : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin n) ℝ := fun i j => v j i
  have hAT : (A * G ω) * T = A := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (hv j) i
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin t) ℝ => M * T) hproj
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAT] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_residual_gram_pow_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_residual_gram_pow_gaussian_le
    {Ω l : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n k p : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    (Q : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) l ℝ) (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => Q ω i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω)) (q : ℕ)
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A) * G ω)) =
      ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A) * G ω) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ) ≤
      ((1 + Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1))) * singularValues A k ^ (2 * q + 1) +
        Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p *
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin m, if k ≤ (i : ℕ) then
            singularValues A i ^ (2 * (2 * q + 1)) else 0)) ^ (1 / (2 * (q : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let C := (A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ (1 + Real.sqrt (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1))) *
      singularValues A k ^ (2 * q + 1) + Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / p *
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin m, if k ≤ (i : ℕ) then
          singularValues A i ^ (2 * (2 * q + 1)) else 0) := by
    have := singularValues_nonneg A k
    positivity
  by_cases ht : A.rank ≤ k + p
  · have hCt : C.rank ≤ k + p := by
      change ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A).rank ≤ k + p
      rwa [rank_gram_pow_mul]
    have hproj := ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_rank_le C G hG Q hQr hCt
    have hzero : (fun ω => specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A)) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hproj, hQo] with ω hω ho
      have hc : projResidual (Q ω) C = 0 := by
        simp only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hω, sub_self]
      have hpow := specNorm_residual_pow_le ho A q
      change specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) A) ^ (2 * q + 1) ≤ specNorm (projResidual (Q ω) C) at hpow
      rw [hc, specNorm_zero] at hpow
      exact eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero (le_antisymm hpow (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _))
    rw [integral_congr_ae hzero, integral_zero]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg hB0 _
  · have hkn : k ≤ n := by have := A.rank_le_width; omega
    have hH := integral_specNorm_residual_le_singularValues_of_gaussian
      C hk hp hkn G hG Q hQo hQr
    have htail : bestRankFrobSq C k = ∑ i : Fin m, if k ≤ (i : ℕ) then
        singularValues A i ^ (2 * (2 * q + 1)) else 0 := by
      rw [bestRankFrobSq, Fintype.card_fin,
        ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if k ≤ i then singularValues C i ^ 2 else 0)]
      simp only [C, singularValues_gram_pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
        split_ifs
        · congr 1
          omega
        · rfl
    rw [htail, show singularValues C k = singularValues A k ^ (2 * q + 1) from
      singularValues_gram_pow_mul A q k] at hH
    exact (integral_specNorm_residual_le_rpow_integral A Q hQ hQo q).trans
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (integral_nonneg fun ω => specNorm_nonneg _) hH (by positivity))

name: NLAlib.subspaceIterate_eq_range_graph
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : L₁ ^ t * Linv ^ t = 1 := by
    have hc : Commute L₁ Linv := by
      change L₁ * Linv = Linv * L₁
      rw [hL, mul_eq_one_comm.1 hL]
    rw [← hc.mul_pow, hL, one_pow]
  have hY : A ^ t * Ω = U₁ * L₁ ^ t * Ω₁ + U₂ * L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ := by
    rw [hΩ, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hA₁, pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hA₂]
  have hN : A ^ t * Ω * (R * Linv ^ t) =
      U₁ + U₂ * (L₂ ^ t * Ω₂ * R * Linv ^ t) := by
    rw [hY, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ω₁, hR, Matrix.one_mul, hpow, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hRu : IsUnit R :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2 (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hR)
  have hLu : IsUnit Linv :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2 (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hL)
  have hrange := subspaceIterate_mul_of_isUnit A Ω (hRu.mul (hLu.pow t)) t
  rw [subspaceIterate, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hN] at hrange
  exact hrange.symm

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pow_mul_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_pow_mul_mul_pow_le
    (L₂ : Matrix r r ℝ) (F : Matrix r k ℝ) (Linv : Matrix k k ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    specNorm (L₂ ^ t * F * Linv ^ t) ≤
      (specNorm L₂ * specNorm Linv) ^ t * specNorm F
proof:
:= by
  have hp₂ : specNorm (L₂ ^ t) ≤ specNorm L₂ ^ t := by
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using (specNorm_one_le (n := r))
    | succ t => exact norm_pow_le' L₂ (Nat.succ_pos t)
  have hp₁ : specNorm (Linv ^ t) ≤ specNorm Linv ^ t := by
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using (specNorm_one_le (n := k))
    | succ t => exact norm_pow_le' Linv (Nat.succ_pos t)
  calc specNorm (L₂ ^ t * F * Linv ^ t) ≤
        (specNorm (L₂ ^ t) * specNorm F) * specNorm (Linv ^ t) :=
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (specNorm L₂ ^ t * specNorm F) * specNorm Linv ^ t :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp₂ (specNorm_nonneg F)) hp₁
        (specNorm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le
statement:
theorem subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0)
    {L₁ Linv : Matrix k k ℝ} {L₂ : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * L₁) (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * L₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℝ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℝ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℝ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    (hL : L₁ * Linv = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (subspaceIterate A Ω t) ≤
      (specNorm L₂ * specNorm Linv) ^ t *
        subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := subspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL 0
  simp only [subspaceIterate, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] at hzero
  rw [subspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL t, hzero,
    subspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_specNorm hU₁ hU₂ hU,
    subspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_specNorm hU₁ hU₂ hU]
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using specNorm_pow_mul_mul_pow_le L₂ (Ω₂ * R) Linv t

name: NLAlib.subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (eig₁ : k → ℝ) (eig₂ : r → ℝ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁)
    (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * Matrix.diagonal eig₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℝ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℝ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℝ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hgap : ∀ i, α ≤ |eig₁ i|) (t : ℕ) :
    subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (subspaceIterate A Ω t) ≤
      (specNorm (Matrix.diagonal eig₂) / α) ^ t *
        subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin)
proof:
:= by
  let Linv : Matrix k k ℝ := Matrix.diagonal fun i => (eig₁ i)⁻¹
  have hEigenNonzero : ∀ i, eig₁ i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have := hgap i
    rw [hi, abs_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hL : Matrix.diagonal eig₁ * Linv = 1 := by
    dsimp only [Linv]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hEigenNonzero i)
  have hLi : specNorm Linv ≤ 1 / α := by
    dsimp only [Linv]
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, ← one_div]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hα (hgap i)
  have hrate : specNorm (Matrix.diagonal eig₂) * specNorm Linv ≤
      specNorm (Matrix.diagonal eig₂) / α := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLi (specNorm_nonneg (Matrix.diagonal eig₂))
  have hzero := subspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL 0
  simp only [subspaceIterate, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] at hzero
  have htan : 0 ≤ subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin) := by
    rw [hzero, subspaceTangent_range_graph_eq_specNorm hU₁ hU₂ hU]
    exact specNorm_nonneg _
  exact (subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le hU₁ hU₂ hU hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL t).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)) hrate t) htan)

name: NLAlib.norm_graph_col_le_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem norm_graph_col_le_of_diagonal (L₂ : Matrix r r ℝ) (F : Matrix r k ℝ)
    (eig : k → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (i : k) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((L₂ ^ t * F * (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (eig j)⁻¹) ^ t).col i)‖ ≤
      (specNorm L₂ / |eig i|) ^ t * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : (L₂ ^ t * F * (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (eig j)⁻¹) ^ t).col i =
      ((eig i)⁻¹) ^ t • (L₂ ^ t *ᵥ F.col i) := by
    ext j
    change (L₂ ^ t * F * (Matrix.diagonal fun j => (eig j)⁻¹) ^ t) j i = _
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    change (L₂ ^ t * F) j i * ((eig i)⁻¹) ^ t =
      ((eig i)⁻¹) ^ t * (L₂ ^ t * F) j i
    ring
  have hp : specNorm (L₂ ^ t) ≤ specNorm L₂ ^ t := by
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero] using (specNorm_one_le (n := r))
    | succ t => exact norm_pow_le' L₂ (Nat.succ_pos t)
  have hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L₂ ^ t *ᵥ F.col i)‖ ≤
      specNorm L₂ ^ t * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i)‖ :=
    (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec (L₂ ^ t) (WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i))).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (norm_nonneg _))
  rw [hcol, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, abs_inv]
  calc |eig i|⁻¹ ^ t * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (L₂ ^ t *ᵥ F.col i)‖ ≤
        |eig i|⁻¹ ^ t * (specNorm L₂ ^ t * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (F.col i)‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) _)
    _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.vectorTangentToFrame_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrame_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal
    {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (eig₁ : k → ℝ) (L₂ : Matrix r r ℝ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁) (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * L₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℝ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℝ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℝ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    (hEigen : ∀ i, eig₁ i ≠ 0) (t : ℕ) {Q : Matrix n l ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hRange : subspaceIterate A Ω t ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (i : k) :
    vectorTangentToFrame Q (U₁.col i) ≤
      (specNorm L₂ / |eig₁ i|) ^ t * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((Ω₂ * R).col i)‖
proof:
:= by
  let Linv : Matrix k k ℝ := Matrix.diagonal fun i => (eig₁ i)⁻¹
  have hL : Matrix.diagonal eig₁ * Linv = 1 := by
    dsimp only [Linv]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hEigen j)
  rw [subspaceIterate_eq_range_graph hA₁ hA₂ hΩ hR hL t] at hRange
  have h := vectorTangentToFrame_graph_col_le hQ hU₁ hU₂ hU _ hRange i
  exact h.trans (by simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using
    norm_graph_col_le_of_diagonal L₂ (Ω₂ * R) eig₁ t i)

name: NLAlib.measurable_nystrom
statement:
theorem measurable_nystrom {n t : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq t] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    Measurable (nystrom A : Matrix n t ℝ → Matrix n n ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nystrom
  exact ((measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id).matrix_mul
    (measurable_moorePenroseInverse.comp
      ((Matrix.measurable_transpose.matrix_mul measurable_const).matrix_mul measurable_id))).matrix_mul
        (Matrix.measurable_transpose.matrix_mul measurable_const)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_eq_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_eq_transpose_mul
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n r k p : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {F : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A = Fᵀ * F) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) ν) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) ν ∧
      ∫ ω, specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)) ∂ν ≤
        (1 + 2 * k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) * singularValues F k ^ 2 +
          bestRankFrobSq F k * (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * k + p) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  obtain ⟨s, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hF, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, hspec, hfrob⟩ :=
    exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm F k hkn
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hF hV
  obtain ⟨hbi, hb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le
    Ω hΩ hV₁ hV₂ hV S₂ hp
  have hu := ae_isUnit_block hΩ V₁ hV₁ (show k ≤ k + p by omega)
  have ho := ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw F Ω hΩ
  have hr := ae_project_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw F Ω hΩ
  have hk := ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min F Ω hΩ
  have hpoint : (fun ω => specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) ≤ᵐ[ν]
      fun ω => specNorm S₂ ^ 2 +
        specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hu, ho, hr, hk] with ω hu ho hr hk
    rw [specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA,
      one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_residual ho hr
        (by rw [hk, Fintype.card_fin]) F]
    exact specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_range_subset hF hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV rfl rfl hu ho hr
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) ν :=
    ((measurable_specNorm_of_entries (fun i j => measurable_const.sub
      ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp (measurable_nystrom A)))).comp_aemeasurable
        hΩ.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) ν :=
    ((integrable_const (specNorm S₂ ^ 2)).add hbi).mono' hm
      (hpoint.mono fun ω h => by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _), Pi.add_apply] using h)
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  have hh := integral_mono_ae hi ((integrable_const (specNorm S₂ ^ 2)).add hbi) hpoint
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hh
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hbi, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hh
  rw [hspec, hfrob] at hb
  rw [hspec] at hh
  have hb' := hh.trans (add_le_add (le_refl (singularValues F k ^ 2)) hb)
  have heq : singularValues F k ^ 2 +
      (2 * singularValues F k ^ 2 * (k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) +
        bestRankFrobSq F k * (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * k + p) / p ^ 2)) =
      (1 + 2 * k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) * singularValues F k ^ 2 +
        bestRankFrobSq F k * (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * k + p) / p ^ 2) := by
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  exact heq ▸ hb'

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n k p : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hkn : k < n)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) ν) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) ν ∧
      ∫ ω, specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)) ∂ν ≤
        (1 + 2 * k / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) * singularValues A k +
          nuclearNorm (A - truncatedSVD A k) *
            (Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * k + p) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (CFC.sqrt A)ᴴ = CFC.sqrt A :=
    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A)).isHermitian.eq
  have hGram : (CFC.sqrt A)ᴴ * CFC.sqrt A = A := by
    rw [hS, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg]
  have hσ : singularValues (CFC.sqrt A) k ^ 2 = singularValues A k := by
    let j : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)) := ⟨k, by simpa using hkn⟩
    have h := sq_singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀ (CFC.sqrt A) j
    have he := congrFun (eigenvalues₀_eq_of_matrix_eq
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (CFC.sqrt A)) hA.isHermitian hGram) j
    exact h.trans (he.trans (singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA j).symm)
  have hG : A = (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ * CFC.sqrt A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hGram.symm
  obtain ⟨hi, hb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_eq_transpose_mul
    hG hp hkn.le Ω hΩ
  rw [hσ, bestRankFrobSq_sqrt_eq_nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD hA k] at hb
  exact ⟨hi, hb⟩

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {m q p : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q] [Fintype p] [DecidableEq q]
    (M : Matrix m q 𝕜) (R : Matrix q p 𝕜)
    (hM : IsUnit (Mᴴ * M)) (hR : IsUnit (R * Rᴴ)) :
    moorePenroseInverse (M * R) = pinvR R * pinvL M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hML := pinvL_mul (G := M) hM
  have hRP := mul_pinvR hR
  apply (isMoorePenroseInverse (M * R)).unique
  constructor
  · calc
      (M * R) * (pinvR R * pinvL M) * (M * R) =
          M * (R * pinvR R) * (pinvL M * M) * R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = M * R := by rw [hRP, hML]; simp
  · calc
      (pinvR R * pinvL M) * (M * R) * (pinvR R * pinvL M) =
          pinvR R * (pinvL M * M) * (R * pinvR R) * pinvL M := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = pinvR R * pinvL M := by rw [hML, hRP]; simp
  · have hEq : (M * R) * (pinvR R * pinvL M) = M * pinvL M := by
      calc
        _ = M * (R * pinvR R) * pinvL M := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = M * pinvL M := by rw [hRP]; simp
    rw [hEq]
    exact mul_pinvL_isHermitian M
  · have hEq : (pinvR R * pinvL M) * (M * R) = pinvR R * R := by
      calc
        _ = pinvR R * (pinvL M * M) * R := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = pinvR R * R := by rw [hML]; simp
    rw [hEq]
    exact pinvR_mul_isHermitian R

name: NLAlib.isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization
statement:
theorem isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {m q t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype q] [Fintype t] [DecidableEq q]
    (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜) (Y : Matrix m t 𝕜)
    (hY : Q * (Qᴴ * Y) = Y) (hRank : Y.rank = Fintype.card q) :
    IsUnit ((Qᴴ * Y) * (Qᴴ * Y)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hRankR : (Qᴴ * Y).rank = Y.rank := by
    apply le_antisymm (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Qᴴ Y)
    calc
      Y.rank = (Q * (Qᴴ * Y)).rank := congrArg Matrix.rank hY.symm
      _ ≤ (Qᴴ * Y).rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Q (Qᴴ * Y)
  exact isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card _ (hRankR.trans hRank)

name: NLAlib.rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_sketchedOutput
statement:
theorem rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_sketchedOutput
    {m n q t s : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [Fintype t] [Fintype s]
    [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (Y : Matrix m t ℝ)
    (Q : Matrix m q ℝ) (Ψ : Matrix m s ℝ)
    (hY : Q * (Qᵀ * Y) = Y) (hRank : Y.rank = Fintype.card q)
    (hΨ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) :
    rawGeneralizedNystrom A Y Ψ = sketchedOutput Q Ψ A
proof:
:= by
  let R := Qᵀ * Y
  have hR : IsUnit (R * Rᵀ) := isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization Q Y hY hRank
  have hFactor : Ψᵀ * Y = (Ψᵀ * Q) * R := by
    rw [← hY]
    simp only [R, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [rawGeneralizedNystrom, hFactor,
    moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) R hΨ hR]
  calc
    Y * (pinvR R * pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q)) * (Ψᵀ * A) =
        Q * (R * pinvR R) * pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * A) := by
          rw [← hY]
          simp only [R, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = sketchedOutput Q Ψ A := by
      rw [mul_pinvR hR]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_one, sketchedOutput, sketchedCore, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul
proof:
:= by
  set Y := F * Ω with hY
  have h1 : A * Ω = Fᵀ * Y := by rw [hA, hY, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h2 : Ωᵀ * A * Ω = Yᵀ * Y := by
    rw [hA, hY, Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h3 : Ωᵀ * A = Yᵀ * F := by
    rw [hA, hY, Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hP : (moorePenroseInverse Y)ᵀ * Yᵀ = Y * moorePenroseInverse Y := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul]; exact (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian Y).eq
  have hPP : Y * moorePenroseInverse Y * (Y * moorePenroseInverse Y) =
      Y * moorePenroseInverse Y := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem Y
  unfold nystrom
  have hMP : moorePenroseInverse (Yᵀ * Y) = moorePenroseInverse Y * (moorePenroseInverse Y)ᵀ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_mul_self Y
  rw [h1, h2, h3, hMP]
  calc Fᵀ * Y * (moorePenroseInverse Y * (moorePenroseInverse Y)ᵀ) * (Yᵀ * F)
      = Fᵀ * (Y * moorePenroseInverse Y * ((moorePenroseInverse Y)ᵀ * Yᵀ)) * F := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hP, hPP]

name: NLAlib.sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul [DecidableEq r] {F : Matrix r n ℝ}
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A = Fᵀ * F) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) :
    A - nystrom A Ω =
      ((1 - F * Ω * moorePenroseInverse (F * Ω)) * F)ᵀ *
        ((1 - F * Ω * moorePenroseInverse (F * Ω)) * F)
proof:
:= by
  set P := F * Ω * moorePenroseInverse (F * Ω) with hPdef
  have hPs : Pᵀ = P := (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian (F * Ω)).eq
  have hPi : P * P = P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem (F * Ω)
  have hQ : (1 - P)ᵀ * (1 - P) = 1 - P := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one, hPs, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub,
      Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hPi]
    abel
  rw [nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA Ω, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc A - Fᵀ * P * F = Fᵀ * (1 - P) * F := by
        rw [hA, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = Fᵀ * ((1 - P)ᵀ * (1 - P)) * F := by rw [hQ]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_sub_nystrom_of_eq_transpose_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA Ω, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_nystrom_of_eq_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem posSemidef_nystrom_of_eq_transpose_mul {F : Matrix r n ℝ} {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A = Fᵀ * F) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) : (nystrom A Ω).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  set P := F * Ω * moorePenroseInverse (F * Ω)
  have hPs : Pᵀ = P := (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian (F * Ω)).eq
  have hPi : P * P = P := mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem (F * Ω)
  have h : nystrom A Ω = (P * F)ᵀ * (P * F) := by
    rw [nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA Ω, Matrix.transpose_mul, hPs]
    calc Fᵀ * P * F = Fᵀ * (P * P) * F := by rw [hPi]
      _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [h, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _

name: NLAlib.trace_sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA Ω, frobSq, frobInner_eq_trace, RCLike.re_to_real,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r]
    {F : Matrix r n ℝ} {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A = Fᵀ * F) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) :
    specNorm (A - nystrom A Ω) =
      specNorm ((1 - F * Ω * moorePenroseInverse (F * Ω)) * F) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA Ω, specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_nystrom
statement:
theorem posSemidef_nystrom [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) : (nystrom A Ω).PosSemidef
proof:

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_sub_nystrom
statement:
theorem posSemidef_sub_nystrom [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) : (A - nystrom A Ω).PosSemidef
proof:

name: NLAlib.sub_nystrom_eq_generalizedSchurComplement
proof:
:= by
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := hA.eq
