name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_sqrt_residual
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_sqrt_residual [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) :
    specNorm (A - nystrom A Ω) =
      specNorm ((1 - rangeProjector (CFC.sqrt A * Ω)) * CFC.sqrt A) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).star_eq
  have hGram : A = (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ * CFC.sqrt A := by
    rw [hS, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg]
  simpa only [rangeProjector_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse] using
    specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hGram Ω

name: NLAlib.one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_residual
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_residual {m q p : Type*} [Fintype m]
    [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q] {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    {Y : Matrix m t ℝ} (hQY : Q * (Qᵀ * Y) = Y) (hr : Fintype.card q ≤ Y.rank)
    (F : Matrix m p ℝ) : (1 - Y * moorePenroseInverse Y) * F = projResidual Q F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_conjTranspose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse hQ hQY hr, residual_eq_one_sub_mul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_sub_nystrom_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_sub_nystrom_le {n r k t : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {F : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A = Fᵀ * F)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)).trace) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)).trace ∂μ ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * bestRankFrobSq F k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hint, hle⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_gaussianRangeFrame_le_bestRankFrobSq F hkt Ω hΩ
  have hae : (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (gaussianRangeFrame F t (Ω ω)) F))
      =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)).trace := by
    have ho := ae_hasOrthonormalCols_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw F Ω hΩ
    have hp := ae_project_gaussianRangeFrame_of_hasLaw F Ω hΩ
    have hrk := ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min F Ω hΩ
    filter_upwards [ho, hp, hrk] with ω hω hpω hrω
    rw [trace_sub_nystrom_eq_of_eq_transpose_mul hA,
      one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_residual hω hpω (by rw [hrω, Fintype.card_fin]) F]
  exact ⟨hint.congr hae, (integral_congr_ae hae).symm.le.trans hle⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_nuclearNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_nuclearNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_hasLaw {n k t : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => nuclearNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, nuclearNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)) ∂μ ≤
        (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * nuclearNorm (A - truncatedSVD A k)
proof:
:= by
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hS : (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ = CFC.sqrt A := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).star_eq
  have hGram : A = (CFC.sqrt A)ᵀ * CFC.sqrt A := by
    rw [hS, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg]
  obtain ⟨hint, hbound⟩ := integrable_and_integral_trace_sub_nystrom_le hGram hkt Ω hΩ
  have hEq : (fun ω => nuclearNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) =
      fun ω => (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)).trace :=
    funext fun ω => nuclearNorm_eq_trace_of_posSemidef (posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA (Ω ω))
  rw [hEq]
  rw [bestRankFrobSq_sqrt_eq_nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD hA k] at hbound
  exact ⟨hint, hbound⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_nuclearNorm_sub_nystrom_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_nuclearNorm_sub_nystrom_le {n k t : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ => nuclearNorm (A - nystrom A Ω))
        (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) ∧
      ∫ Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ, nuclearNorm (A - nystrom A Ω)
          ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ≤
        (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * nuclearNorm (A - truncatedSVD A k)
proof:
:=
  integrable_and_integral_nuclearNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_hasLaw hA hkt id HasLaw.id

name: NLAlib.sketchedCore_eq_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem sketchedCore_eq_of_eq_mul (Ψ : Matrix m s ℝ) (hG₁ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q)))
    (hA : A = Q * (Qᵀ * A)) : sketchedCore Q Ψ A = Qᵀ * A
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchedCore
  conv_lhs => rw [hA]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ψᵀ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, pinvL_mul (G := Ψᵀ * Q) hG₁, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.sketchedOutput_eq_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem sketchedOutput_eq_of_eq_mul (Ψ : Matrix m s ℝ)
    (hG₁ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) (hA : A = Q * (Qᵀ * A)) :
    sketchedOutput Q Ψ A = A
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchedOutput
  rw [sketchedCore_eq_of_eq_mul Q A Ψ hG₁ hA, ← hA]

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_residual_eq
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_residual_eq (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) :
    Ψᵀ * projResidual Q A = (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ hcomp A,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sketch_decomp
statement:
theorem sketch_decomp (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) :
    Ψᵀ * A = (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Qᵀ * A) + (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  calc Ψᵀ * A = Ψᵀ * (Q * (Qᵀ * A) + projResidual Q A) := by
        rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q, mul_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual]
    _ = (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Qᵀ * A) + (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, transpose_mul_residual_eq Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp]

name: NLAlib.sketchedCore_eq
statement:
theorem sketchedCore_eq (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1)
    (hG₁ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) :
    sketchedCore Q Ψ A =
      Qᵀ * A + pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchedCore
  rw [sketch_decomp Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp, Matrix.mul_add,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q)) (Ψᵀ * Q), pinvL_mul (G := Ψᵀ * Q) hG₁, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.error_decomp
statement:
theorem error_decomp (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1)
    (hG₁ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) :
    A - sketchedOutput Q Ψ A =
      projResidual Q A - Q * (pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchedOutput
  rw [sketchedCore_eq Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp hG₁, Matrix.mul_add]
  rw [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  rw [sub_add_eq_sub_sub]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_error
statement:
theorem frobSq_error [Fintype n] (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1)
    (hG₁ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) :
    frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q Ψ A) =
      frobSq (projResidual Q A) + frobSq (pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [error_decomp Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp hG₁,
    frobSq_sub_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _ (by
      rw [frobInner_comm]; exact frobInner_mul_residual hQ _ A),
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_transpose_mul_residual
statement:
theorem frobSq_transpose_mul_residual [Fintype n] [DecidableEq r] (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) :
    frobSq (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A) = frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ hcomp A,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  rw [frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQp.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.coreNoise_eq
statement:
theorem coreNoise_eq (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) :
    coreNoise Q Ψ A = pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coreNoise, transpose_mul_residual_eq Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q))]

name: NLAlib.sketchedCore_eq_add_coreNoise
statement:
theorem sketchedCore_eq_add_coreNoise (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) (hG₁ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) :
    sketchedCore Q Ψ A = Qᵀ * A + coreNoise Q Ψ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [sketchedCore_eq Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp hG₁, coreNoise_eq Q Qp Ψ A hQ hcomp]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_transpose_mul_residual
statement:
theorem specNorm_transpose_mul_residual [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq r]
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {Qp : Matrix m r ℝ} (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp)
    (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    specNorm (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A) = specNorm (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:=
  specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_of_eq_mul hQp.conjTranspose_mul_self
    (residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ hcomp A)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput_le_rank_factor_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput_le_rank_factor_gaussian
    {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Ω Ψ μ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j) (hQ : ∀ ω, Q ω = Qf (Ω ω))
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A)) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      ≤ (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ' : Q = fun ω => Qf (Ω ω) := funext hQ
  subst hQ'
  obtain ⟨hunit, hinv, hZi⟩ := rsvd_gaussian_inputs S₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt Ω hΩ
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ 1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1) := by
    have : (q : ℝ) + 2 ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hqs
    have : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1) := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg q) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hXm : AEMeasurable Ω μ := hΩ.aemeasurable
  have hYm : AEMeasurable Ψ μ := hΨ.aemeasurable
  have hres : Measurable fun x => frobSq (projResidual (Qf x) A) :=
    measurable_frobSq_residual_of A hQf
  have hYi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Qf (Ω ω)) A)) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (frobSq A)).mono' (hres.comp_aemeasurable hXm).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hQo] with ω h
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _)]
    exact frobSq_residual_le h A
  have hgm : Measurable fun p : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ × Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ =>
      frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf p.1) p.2 A) :=
    measurable_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput A (fun i j => (hQf i j).comp measurable_fst)
      (fun i j => (Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp measurable_snd)
  have hL : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal
        (frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf (Ω ω)) (Ψ ω) A)) ∂μ
      = ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1))
          * frobSq (projResidual (Qf (Ω ω)) A)) ∂μ := by
    refine (lintegral_of_indepFun hXm hYm hind
      (g := fun x y => ENNReal.ofReal (frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf x) y A)))
      (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm).aemeasurable).trans ?_
    rw [hΨ.map_eq, lintegral_map' ?_ hXm]
    · apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
      obtain ⟨hi, hv⟩ := completion_gaussian_of_orthonormal (s := s) _ A hω hq hqs
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (ae_of_all _ fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _), hv]
    · exact (Measurable.lintegral_prod_right' (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm)).aemeasurable
  have hcond : ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf (Ω ω)) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      = ∫ ω, (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1))
          * frobSq (projResidual (Qf (Ω ω)) A) ∂μ := by
    have hLm : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf (Ω ω)) (Ψ ω) A)) μ :=
      (hgm.comp_aemeasurable (hXm.prodMk hYm)).aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _) hLm,
      integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
        (ae_of_all _ fun _ => mul_nonneg hc0 (frobSq_nonneg _))
        (hYi.const_mul _).aestronglyMeasurable, hL]
  have hLm : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf (Ω ω)) (Ψ ω) A)) μ :=
    (hgm.comp_aemeasurable (hXm.prodMk hYm)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hFinite : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal
      (frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf (Ω ω)) (Ψ ω) A)) ∂μ < ⊤ := by
    rw [hL, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hYi.const_mul _)
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => mul_nonneg hc0 (frobSq_nonneg _))]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hIntegrable : Integrable
      (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf (Ω ω)) (Ψ ω) A)) μ :=
    ⟨hLm, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ fun _ => frobSq_nonneg _)).2 hFinite⟩
  refine ⟨hIntegrable, ?_⟩
  rw [hcond, integral_const_mul]
  have hRange := rsvd_main_gaussian hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt Ω hΩ
    (fun ω => Qf (Ω ω)) hQo hQr
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc0
  simpa only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hRange

name: NLAlib.gn_main_gaussian
statement:
theorem gn_main_gaussian
    {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hts : t + 2 ≤ s) (hqt : q ≤ t) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Ω Ψ μ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j) (hQ : ∀ ω, Q ω = Qf (Ω ω))
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      ≤ (1 + (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1)) * ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput_le_rank_factor_gaussian
    hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt (by omega : q + 2 ≤ s) hq Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hind Q Qf hQf hQ hQo hQr
  have hk : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hkt
  have ht : (t : ℝ) + 2 ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hts
  have hfac := Assembly.completion_factor_mono (Nat.cast_nonneg q)
    (by exact_mod_cast hqt : (q : ℝ) ≤ t) (by linarith : (t : ℝ) < s - 1)
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) (by linarith)
  refine h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) ?_)
  exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.completion_reduction
statement:
theorem completion_reduction {m n r : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq r] {q s : ℕ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Q : Matrix m (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix m r ℝ) (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s)
    (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix m (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hG₁ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)))
    (hG₂ : ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)) ∂μ
      = (∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) ∂μ) * frobSq (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A))
    (hG₁m : ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) ∂μ = (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1))
    (hGi : Integrable
      (fun ω => frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A))) μ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      = (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have hae : (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q (Ψ ω) A)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq (projResidual Q A)
        + frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)) := by
    filter_upwards [hG₁] with ω h
    exact frobSq_error Q Qp (Ψ ω) A hQ hcomp h
  rw [integral_congr_ae hae, integral_add (integrable_const _) hGi, integral_const,
    probReal_univ, one_smul, hG₂, hG₁m, frobSq_transpose_mul_residual Q Qp A hQ hQp hcomp]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gn_main
statement:
theorem gn_main [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hts : t + 2 ≤ s) (hqt : q ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix n (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix m (Fin s) ℝ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix m (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω)
    (hunit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ))
    (hinv : ∫ ω, frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ
      = (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) * frobSq S₂)
    (hcond : ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      = ∫ ω, (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ)
    (hYi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A)) μ)
    (hZi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      ≤ (1 + (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1)) * ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hstruct : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A)
      ≤ frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hQo, hQr, hunit] with ω h1 h2 h3
    exact frobSq_residual_le_of_range_subset hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV rfl rfl h3 h1 h2
  have hYbound := rsvd_assembly_ae hstruct hinv hYi hZi
  
  have hts' : (t : ℝ) < s - 1 := by
    have : (t : ℝ) + 2 ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hts
    linarith
  have hfac : (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1) ≤ (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1) :=
    Assembly.completion_factor_mono (Nat.cast_nonneg q) (by exact_mod_cast hqt) hts'
  have hcmax : 0 ≤ 1 + (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1) := by
    have : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1) := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg t) (by linarith)
    linarith
  exact Assembly.gn_assembly (cfac := fun _ => 1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1))
    (fun ω => frobSq_nonneg _) hcmax (fun _ => by linarith) hcond hYbound
    (hYi.const_mul _) hYi

name: NLAlib.gn_main_of_completion
statement:
theorem gn_main_of_completion [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [DecidableEq m]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hts : t + 2 ≤ s) (hqt : q ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix n (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix m (Fin s) ℝ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix m (Fin q) ℝ)
    {rp : Type*} [Fintype rp] (Qp : Ωs → Matrix m rp ℝ)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω)
    (hcomp : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * (Q ω)ᵀ + Qp ω * (Qp ω)ᵀ = 1)
    (hunit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ))
    (hG₁ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q ω)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q ω)))
    (hinv : ∫ ω, frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ
      = (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) * frobSq S₂)
    (hG : ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q ω) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp ω) * ((Qp ω)ᵀ * projResidual (Q ω) A)) ∂μ
      = ∫ ω, (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1) * frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ)
    (hYi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A)) μ)
    (hGi : Integrable (fun ω =>
      frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q ω) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp ω) * ((Qp ω)ᵀ * projResidual (Q ω) A))) μ)
    (hZi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      ≤ (1 + (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1)) * ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hae : (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A)
        + frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q ω) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp ω) * ((Qp ω)ᵀ * projResidual (Q ω) A)) := by
    filter_upwards [hQo, hcomp, hG₁] with ω h1 h2 h3
    exact frobSq_error (Q ω) (Qp ω) (Ψ ω) A h1 h2 h3
  have hcond : ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      = ∫ ω, (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * frobSq (projResidual (Q ω) A) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_congr_ae hae, integral_add hYi hGi, hG, ← integral_add hYi (hYi.const_mul _)]
    congr 1
    ext ω
    ring
  exact gn_main hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt hts hqt Ω Ψ Q hQo hQr hunit hinv hcond hYi hZi

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_hasOrthonormalCols_of_entries
statement:
theorem measurableSet_hasOrthonormalCols_of_entries
    {α m q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [Fintype m] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : α → Matrix m q ℝ} (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Q x i j) :
    MeasurableSet {x | HasOrthonormalCols (Q x)}
proof:
:= by
  have hGram := measurable_mul_entry_of (fun i j => hQ j i) hQ
  have hEq : {x | HasOrthonormalCols (Q x)} =
      ⋂ i, ⋂ j, {x | ((Q x)ᵀ * Q x) i j = (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) i j} := by
    ext x
    simp only [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.ext_iff, Set.mem_iInter,
      Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter fun j =>
    measurableSet_eq_fun (hGram i j) measurable_const

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_compression_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  have hΨ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun p : α × Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ => p.2ᵀ i j :=
    fun i j => (Matrix.measurable_entry j i).comp measurable_snd
  have hQ' : ∀ i j, Measurable fun p : α × Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ => Q p.1 i j :=
    fun i j => (hQ i j).comp measurable_fst
  have hW := measurable_mul_entry_of hΨ hQ'
  have hGram := measurable_mul_entry_of (fun i j => hW j i) hW
  have hArray : Measurable fun p : α × Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ =>
      (p.2ᵀ * Q p.1)ᵀ * (p.2ᵀ * Q p.1) :=
    Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr hGram
  have hdet : Measurable fun p : α × Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ =>
      ((p.2ᵀ * Q p.1)ᵀ * (p.2ᵀ * Q p.1)).det := by
    have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ => G.det :=
      continuous_id.matrix_det
    exact hc.measurable.comp hArray
  simpa only [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Set.compl_ofPred] using
    (measurableSet_eq_fun hdet measurable_const).compl

name: NLAlib.ae_isUnit_gaussian_compression_of_indep
statement:
theorem ae_isUnit_gaussian_compression_of_indep
    {α Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m q s : ℕ}
    (X : Ω → α) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ) (hind : IndepFun X Ψ μ)
    (Qf : α → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (X ω))) (hqs : q ≤ s) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qf (X ω))ᵀ *
      ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qf (X ω)))
proof:
:= by
  have hYm : AEMeasurable Ψ μ := hΨ.aemeasurable
  have hLeft : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  have hFrame : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map X, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf x) :=
    (ae_map_iff hX (measurableSet_hasOrthonormalCols_of_entries hQf)).2 hQo
  have hProd : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.map X).prod (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)),
      IsUnit ((p.2ᵀ * Qf p.1)ᵀ * (p.2ᵀ * Qf p.1)) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_compression_isUnit Qf hQf)).2
    filter_upwards [hFrame] with x hx
    have hFixed := ae_isUnit_block (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s))
      (Ω := fun G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ => G) HasLaw.id (Qf x) hx hqs
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hFixed
  have hLaw : μ.map (fun ω => (X ω, Ψ ω)) =
      (μ.map X).prod (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) := by
    rw [(indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX hYm).1 hind, hΨ.map_eq]
  have hMap : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ.map (fun ω => (X ω, Ψ ω)),
      IsUnit ((p.2ᵀ * Qf p.1)ᵀ * (p.2ᵀ * Qf p.1)) := by
    rw [hLaw]
    exact hProd
  exact ae_of_ae_map (hX.prodMk hYm) hMap

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_of_exact_rank_frame
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_of_exact_rank_frame
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k r r' t s q : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Ω Ψ μ)
    (Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (Ω ω)))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Qf (Ω ω) *
      ((Qf (Ω ω))ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω)
    (hRank : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A * Ω ω).rank = q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω)) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) *
          ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ := fun ω => Qf (Ω ω)
  have hcompression := ae_isUnit_gaussian_compression_of_indep
    Ω hΩ.aemeasurable Ψ hΨ hind Qf hQf hQo (by omega : q ≤ s)
  have hEq : (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Q ω) (Ψ ω) A) := by
    filter_upwards [hQr, hRank, hcompression] with ω hproj hrank hinj
    rw [rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_sketchedOutput A (A * Ω ω) (Q ω) (Ψ ω)
      hproj (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hrank) hinj]
  obtain ⟨hInt, hBound⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput_le_rank_factor_gaussian
    hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt hqs hq Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hind Q Qf hQf
    (fun _ => rfl) hQo hQr
  refine ⟨hInt.congr (hEq.mono fun _ h => h.symm), ?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae hEq]
  exact hBound

name: NLAlib.sketchedOutput_eq_of_projector_eq
statement:
theorem sketchedOutput_eq_of_projector_eq
    {m n q s : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [Fintype s] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (Q : Matrix m q ℝ) (Ψ : Matrix m s ℝ)
    (hProj : Q * (Qᵀ * A) = A) (hΨ : IsUnit ((Ψᵀ * Q)ᵀ * (Ψᵀ * Q))) :
    sketchedOutput Q Ψ A = A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    sketchedOutput Q Ψ A = Q * pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * A) := by
      simp only [sketchedOutput, sketchedCore, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Q * pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * (Q * (Qᵀ * A))) := by rw [hProj]
    _ = Q * (pinvL (Ψᵀ * Q) * (Ψᵀ * Q)) * (Qᵀ * A) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = A := by rw [pinvL_mul (G := Ψᵀ * Q) hΨ, Matrix.mul_one, hProj]

name: NLAlib.ae_rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_self_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem ae_rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_self_of_rank_le
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n t s : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hrt : A.rank ≤ t) (hrs : A.rank ≤ s) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω) = A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQo, hQA⟩ := exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix A
  have hRank : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A * Ω ω).rank = A.rank := by
    simpa only [min_eq_left hrt] using
      ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min A Ω hΩ
  have hUnit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) := by
    have h := ae_isUnit_block hΨ Q hQo hrs
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using h
  filter_upwards [hRank, hUnit] with ω hrank hunit
  have hY : Q * (Qᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω := by
    calc
      Q * (Qᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = (Q * (Qᵀ * A)) * Ω ω := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * Ω ω := by rw [hQA]
  exact (rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_sketchedOutput A (A * Ω ω) Q (Ψ ω)
    hY (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hrank) hunit).trans
      (sketchedOutput_eq_of_projector_eq A Q (Ψ ω) hQA hunit)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_of_sketch_cols_le_rank
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_of_sketch_cols_le_rank
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k r r' t s : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (htRank : t ≤ A.rank) (hst : t + 2 ≤ s)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Ω Ψ μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω)) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + (t : ℝ) / (s - t - 1)) *
          ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  let Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin t) ℝ :=
    fun G => polarFrame (A * G)
  have hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun G => Qf G i j := by
    intro i j
    exact (measurable_polarFrame_entry i j).comp (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id)
  have hGood : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((A * Ω ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) := by
    have h := gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_gram_mul_of_le_rank A htRank
    rw [← hΩ.map_eq] at h
    exact ae_of_ae_map hΩ.aemeasurable h
  have hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (Ω ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hGood] with ω hω
    exact hasOrthonormalCols_polarFrame (A * Ω ω) hω
  have hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Qf (Ω ω) *
      ((Qf (Ω ω))ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω := by
    filter_upwards [hGood] with ω hω
    exact polarFrame_mul_transpose_mul_eq (A * Ω ω) hω
  have hRank : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A * Ω ω).rank = t := by
    simpa only [min_eq_right htRank] using
      ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min A Ω hΩ
  exact integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_of_exact_rank_frame
    hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt hst (by omega : 1 ≤ t) Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hind Qf hQf hQo hQr hRank

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_rank_factor_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_rank_factor_gaussian
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k r r' t s : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hqs : min A.rank t + 2 ≤ s)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Ω Ψ μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω)) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + ((min A.rank t : ℕ) : ℝ) / (s - min A.rank t - 1)) *
          ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hrt : A.rank ≤ t
  · have hrs : A.rank ≤ s := by
      have hh : A.rank + 2 ≤ s := by simpa only [min_eq_left hrt] using hqs
      omega
    have hExact := ae_rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_self_of_rank_le A Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hrt hrs
    have hZero : (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) =ᵐ[μ]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hExact.mono fun ω hω => by
          change frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω)) = 0
          rw [hω]
          simp
    have hIntZero : Integrable (fun _ : Ωs => (0 : ℝ)) μ := integrable_const (0 : ℝ)
    refine ⟨hIntZero.congr (hZero.mono fun _ h => h.symm), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae hZero, integral_zero]
    have htR : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hkt
    have hsR : ((min A.rank t : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hqs
    have hden1 : (0 : ℝ) < (t : ℝ) - k - 1 := by linarith
    have hden2 : (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) - min A.rank t - 1 := by linarith
    have hc1 : 0 ≤ 1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) := by positivity
    have hc2 : 0 ≤ 1 + ((min A.rank t : ℕ) : ℝ) / (s - min A.rank t - 1) := by positivity
    exact mul_nonneg hc2 (mul_nonneg hc1 (frobSq_nonneg S₂))
  · have htRank : t ≤ A.rank := (not_le.mp hrt).le
    have hst : t + 2 ≤ s := by simpa only [min_eq_right htRank] using hqs
    simpa only [min_eq_right htRank] using
      integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_of_sketch_cols_le_rank
        hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt htRank hst Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hind

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_bestRankFrobSq
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_bestRankFrobSq
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k t s : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hqs : min A.rank t + 2 ≤ s)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ) (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (hind : IndepFun Ω Ψ μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω)) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + ((min A.rank t : ℕ) : ℝ) / (s - min A.rank t - 1)) *
          ((1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * bestRankFrobSq A k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
  · obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, hOPT⟩ :=
      exists_svd_right_blocks A k hkn
    obtain ⟨hInt, hBound⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_rawGeneralizedNystrom_le_rank_factor_gaussian
      hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt hqs Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hind
    exact ⟨hInt, by simpa only [hOPT] using hBound⟩
  · have hrt : A.rank ≤ t := by
      have hRankWidth := A.rank_le_width
      omega
    have hrs : A.rank ≤ s := by
      have hh : A.rank + 2 ≤ s := by simpa only [min_eq_left hrt] using hqs
      omega
    have hExact := ae_rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_self_of_rank_le A Ω Ψ hΩ hΨ hrt hrs
    have hZero : (fun ω => frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω))) =ᵐ[μ]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hExact.mono fun ω hω => by
          change frobSq (A - rawGeneralizedNystrom A (A * Ω ω) (Ψ ω)) = 0
          rw [hω]
          simp
    have hIntZero : Integrable (fun _ : Ωs => (0 : ℝ)) μ := integrable_const (0 : ℝ)
    refine ⟨hIntZero.congr (hZero.mono fun _ h => h.symm), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae hZero, integral_zero]
    have htR : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hkt
    have hsR : ((min A.rank t : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hqs
    have hden1 : (0 : ℝ) < (t : ℝ) - k - 1 := by linarith
    have hden2 : (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) - min A.rank t - 1 := by linarith
    have hc1 : 0 ≤ 1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) := by positivity
    have hc2 : 0 ≤ 1 + ((min A.rank t : ℕ) : ℝ) / (s - min A.rank t - 1) := by positivity
    have hOpt : 0 ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k := by
      rw [← frobSq_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_bestRankFrobSq A k]
      exact frobSq_nonneg _
    exact mul_nonneg hc2 (mul_nonneg hc1 hOpt)

name: NLAlib.complex_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero_comm
proof:
:= by
  have ht := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] using ht

name: NLAlib.aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition
statement:
theorem aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℂ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℂ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℂ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1)
    (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1)
    (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) :
    aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω =
      U₁ * S₁ * aeval (S₁ᴴ * S₁) p * (V₁ᴴ * Ω) +
      U₂ * S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : U₂ᴴ * U₁ = 0 := complex_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero_comm hU
  have hV' : V₂ᴴ * V₁ = 0 := complex_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero_comm hV
  have hAtU₁ : Aᴴ * U₁ = V₁ * S₁ᴴ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hU₁, hU', Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hAtU₂ : Aᴴ * U₂ = V₂ * S₂ᴴ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.conjTranspose_add, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hU, hU₂, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_one, zero_add]
  have hAV₁ : A * V₁ = U₁ * S₁ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hV₁, hV', Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hAV₂ : A * V₂ = U₂ * S₂ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hV, hV₂, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_one, zero_add]
  have hB₁ : (A * Aᴴ) * U₁ = U₁ * (S₁ * S₁ᴴ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAtU₁, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV₁, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hB₂ : (A * Aᴴ) * U₂ = U₂ * (S₂ * S₂ᴴ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAtU₂, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV₂, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hp₁ := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hB₁ p
  have hp₂ := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hB₂ p
  conv_lhs => arg 1; arg 2; rw [hA]
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hp₁, hp₂]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (aeval (S₁ * S₁ᴴ) p),
    aeval_conjGram_mul_eq_mul_aeval_conjGram S₁ p,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (aeval (S₂ * S₂ᴴ) p),
    aeval_conjGram_mul_eq_mul_aeval_conjGram S₂ p]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_mul_mul_conjTranspose_eq_of_filtered_blocks
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : Y * R * Cinv * V₁ᴴ =
      U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * D * Ω₂ * R * Cinv * V₁ᴴ := by
    rw [hY, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ω₁, hR, Matrix.one_mul,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc C, hC, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [hA, hZ, Matrix.mul_sub]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: NLAlib.norm_complex_filter_residual_sq_le_of_filtered_blocks
proof:
:= by
  let Z := Y * R * Cinv * V₁ᴴ
  let T := S₂ * D * Ω₂ * R * Cinv
  have hPZ : rangeProjector Y * Z = Z := by
    dsimp [Z]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      rangeProjector_mul]
  have hres : A - rangeProjector Y * A =
      (A - Z) - rangeProjector Y * (A - Z) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hPZ]
    abel
  have hdiff : A - Z = U₂ * (S₂ * V₂ᴴ - T * V₁ᴴ) :=
    sub_mul_mul_mul_conjTranspose_eq_of_filtered_blocks hA hY hR hC
  have horth : (S₂ * V₂ᴴ) * (-(T * V₁ᴴ))ᴴ = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_neg, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc S₂,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc V₂ᴴ, complex_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero_comm hV,
      Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have hs := norm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero horth
  rw [norm_neg, norm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hV₂,
    norm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hV₁] at hs
  calc ‖A - rangeProjector Y * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A - Z‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hres]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le Y _) 2
    _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [hdiff, norm_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU₂, sub_eq_add_neg]
        exact hs

name: NLAlib.norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le [DecidableEq t]
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℂ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℂ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℂ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1)
    (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1)
    (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (R : Matrix t k ℂ) (Cinv : Matrix k k ℂ)
    (hR : (V₁ᴴ * Ω) * R = 1) (hC : aeval (S₁ᴴ * S₁) p * Cinv = 1) :
    ‖A - rangeProjector (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) * A‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  norm_complex_filter_residual_sq_le_of_filtered_blocks hA
    (aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω)
    hR hC hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_complex_filter_residual_sq_le_of_filtered_blocks
proof:
:= by
  let Z := Y * R * Cinv * V₁ᴴ
  let T := S₂ * D * Ω₂ * R * Cinv
  have hPZ : rangeProjector Y * Z = Z := by
    dsimp [Z]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      rangeProjector_mul]
  have hres : A - rangeProjector Y * A =
      (A - Z) - rangeProjector Y * (A - Z) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hPZ]
    abel
  have hdiff : A - Z = U₂ * (S₂ * V₂ᴴ - T * V₁ᴴ) :=
    sub_mul_mul_mul_conjTranspose_eq_of_filtered_blocks hA hY hR hC
  have horth : (S₂ * V₂ᴴ) * (-(T * V₁ᴴ))ᴴ = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_neg, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc S₂,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc V₂ᴴ, complex_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero_comm hV,
      Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have hs := frobenius_norm_add_sq_eq_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero horth
  rw [norm_neg, frobenius_norm_sq_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hV₂,
    frobenius_norm_sq_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hV₁] at hs
  calc ‖A - rangeProjector Y * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A - Z‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hres]
        exact frobenius_norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le Y _
    _ = _ := by
        rw [hdiff, frobenius_norm_sq_mul_left_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU₂,
          sub_eq_add_neg]
        exact hs

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le [DecidableEq t]
    {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℂ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℂ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℂ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℂ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1)
    (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1)
    (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (R : Matrix t k ℂ) (Cinv : Matrix k k ℂ)
    (hR : (V₁ᴴ * Ω) * R = 1) (hC : aeval (S₁ᴴ * S₁) p * Cinv = 1) :
    ‖A - rangeProjector (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) * A‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  frobenius_norm_complex_filter_residual_sq_le_of_filtered_blocks hA
    (aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω)
    hR hC hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV

name: NLAlib.rangeProjector_mul_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_le
statement:
theorem rangeProjector_mul_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_le
    [DecidableEq t] (Q : Matrix m q ℂ) (Y : Matrix m t ℂ)
    (h : LinearMap.range Y.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    rangeProjector Q * Y = Y
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
  rw [Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same, toEuclideanLin_rangeProjector]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply (Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff (K := columnSpace Q)).mpr
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h (show Y *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x ∈ LinearMap.range Y.mulVecLin from
    ⟨WithLp.ofLp x, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 z, ?_⟩
  have hh := congrArg (WithLp.toLp 2) hz
  simpa only [Matrix.toLpLin_apply, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] using hh

name: NLAlib.rangeProjector_aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_blockKrylovSpace_le
statement:
theorem rangeProjector_aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_blockKrylovSpace_le
    [DecidableEq t] (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (Q : Matrix m q ℂ)
    {order : ℕ}
    (hK : blockKrylovSpace (A * Aᴴ) (A * Ω) order ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < order) :
    rangeProjector Q * (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) = aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω
proof:
:= by
  apply rangeProjector_mul_eq_of_range_mulVecLin_le
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  refine le_trans ?_ hK
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp0
  · simp
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range, Matrix.sum_mulVec]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_
  rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ)]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  rw [← col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(⟨i, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hi))
    ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).2 hp)⟩, j), rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_of_rank_eq_card
    {κ a b : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℂ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℂ} {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℂ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s₁ i : ℂ)) * V₁ᴴ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1) (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (hB : (V₁ᴴ * Ω).rank = κ)
    {c τ : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ i, c ≤ |p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2)|)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hmax : ∀ i, i < min a b → |s₂ i * p.eval (s₂ i ^ 2)| ≤ τ)
    (Q : Matrix m q ℂ)
    (hQ : rangeProjector Q * (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) = aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) :
    let S₂
proof:
:= (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal
    let B := V₁ᴴ * Ω
    let R := Bᴴ * (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹
    ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
      (τ / c) ^ 2 * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ ^ 2 * ‖R‖ ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  let S₂ := (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal
  let D := aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p
  let R := (V₁ᴴ * Ω)ᴴ * ((V₁ᴴ * Ω) * (V₁ᴴ * Ω)ᴴ)⁻¹
  let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
  have hC := aeval_gram_diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one (𝕜 := ℂ) s₁ p
    (fun i => abs_pos.mp (hc.trans_le (hmin i)))
  have hCi : ‖Cinv‖ ≤ 1 / c := by
    exact specNorm_diagonal_inv_le (𝕜 := ℂ) s₁ p hc hmin
  have hR : (V₁ᴴ * Ω) * R = 1 :=
    mul_pinvR_of_rank_eq_card _ (by simpa using hB)
  have htail : ‖S₂ * D‖ ≤ τ := by
    have hS₂ : S₂ = (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℂ) := by
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = j <;>
        simp [S₂, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, Matrix.map_apply, hij]
    change specNorm (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p) ≤ τ
    rw [hS₂, rectDiag_mul_aeval_gram]
    exact specNorm_rectDiag_le hτ hmax
  have hcore := norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV
    p Ω R Cinv hR hC
  have hmono := norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_mul_eq Q
    (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) hQ A
  have hTR : ‖S₂ * D * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R‖ ≤ (‖S₂ * D‖ * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖) * ‖R‖ :=
    (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hchain : ‖S₂ * D * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ≤ (τ / c) * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ * ‖R‖ := by
    calc ‖S₂ * D * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ≤
        ((‖S₂ * D‖ * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖) * ‖R‖) * ‖Cinv‖ :=
          (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTR (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = ‖S₂ * D‖ * (‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ * ‖R‖ * ‖Cinv‖) := by ring
      _ ≤ τ * (‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ * ‖R‖ * ‖Cinv‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htail
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = (τ * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ * ‖R‖) * ‖Cinv‖ := by ring
      _ ≤ (τ * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ * ‖R‖) * (1 / c) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCi
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hτ (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖A - rangeProjector (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) * A‖ ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hmono 2
    _ ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 + ‖S₂ * D * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2 := hcore
    _ ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 + ((τ / c) * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ * ‖R‖) ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hchain 2)
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]

name: NLAlib.norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_exact_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_exact_of_rank_eq_card
    {κ a b : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℂ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℂ} {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℂ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s₁ i : ℂ)) * V₁ᴴ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1) (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (hB : (V₁ᴴ * Ω).rank = κ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ i, c ≤ |p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2)|)
    (Q : Matrix m q ℂ)
    (hQ : rangeProjector Q * (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) = aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) :
    let S₂
proof:
:= (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal
    let B := V₁ᴴ * Ω
    let R := Bᴴ * (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹
    let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
    ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  let R := (V₁ᴴ * Ω)ᴴ * ((V₁ᴴ * Ω) * (V₁ᴴ * Ω)ᴴ)⁻¹
  let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
  have hC := aeval_gram_diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one (𝕜 := ℂ) s₁ p
    (fun i => abs_pos.mp (hc.trans_le (hmin i)))
  have hR : (V₁ᴴ * Ω) * R = 1 :=
    mul_pinvR_of_rank_eq_card _ (by simpa using hB)
  have hcore := norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le
    hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω R Cinv hR hC
  have hmono := norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_mul_eq Q
    (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) hQ A
  exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hmono 2).trans hcore

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_of_rank_eq_card
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_of_rank_eq_card
    {κ a b : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℂ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℂ} {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℂ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s₁ i : ℂ)) * V₁ᴴ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1) (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (hB : (V₁ᴴ * Ω).rank = κ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ i, c ≤ |p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2)|)
    (Q : Matrix m q ℂ)
    (hQ : rangeProjector Q * (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) = aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) :
    let S₂
proof:
:= (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal
    let B := V₁ᴴ * Ω
    let R := Bᴴ * (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹
    let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
    ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  let R := (V₁ᴴ * Ω)ᴴ * ((V₁ᴴ * Ω) * (V₁ᴴ * Ω)ᴴ)⁻¹
  let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
  have hC := aeval_gram_diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one (𝕜 := ℂ) s₁ p
    (fun i => abs_pos.mp (hc.trans_le (hmin i)))
  have hR : (V₁ᴴ * Ω) * R = 1 :=
    mul_pinvR_of_rank_eq_card _ (by simpa using hB)
  have hcore := frobenius_norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le
    hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω R Cinv hR hC
  exact (frobenius_norm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le_of_mul_eq Q
    (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) hQ A).trans hcore

name: NLAlib.complex_polynomial_filter_residual_bounds
statement:
theorem complex_polynomial_filter_residual_bounds
    {κ a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin κ)] {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℂ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℂ} {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℂ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s₁ i : ℂ)) * V₁ᴴ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1) (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ) (hB : (V₁ᴴ * Ω).rank = κ)
    (hc : 0 < filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p) (Q : Matrix m q ℂ)
    (hQ : rangeProjector Q * (aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) = aeval (A * Aᴴ) p * A * Ω) :
    let S₂
proof:
:= (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal
    let B := V₁ᴴ * Ω
    let R := Bᴴ * (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹
    let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
    ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
        (filterTailMaxAbs s₂ p a b / filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p) ^ 2 * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ ^ 2 * ‖R‖ ^ 2 ∧
      (@norm _ (Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup (m := m) (n := n) (α := ℂ)).toNorm
        (A - rangeProjector Q * A)) ^ 2 ≤
      (@norm _ (Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup (m := Fin a) (n := Fin b) (α := ℂ)).toNorm S₂) ^ 2 +
      (@norm _ (Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup (m := Fin a) (n := Fin κ) (α := ℂ)).toNorm
        (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv)) ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_exact_of_rank_eq_card s₁ s₂
    hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω hB hc (filterHeadMinAbs_le s₁ p) Q hQ,
    norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_of_rank_eq_card s₁ s₂
    hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω hB hc (filterHeadMinAbs_le s₁ p)
    (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (fun _ hi => abs_mul_eval_le_filterTailMaxAbs s₂ p hi) Q hQ, ?_⟩
  exact frobenius_norm_complex_polynomial_filter_residual_sq_le_of_rank_eq_card s₁ s₂
    hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω hB hc (filterHeadMinAbs_le s₁ p) Q hQ

name: NLAlib.complex_polynomial_filter_residual_bounds_of_blockKrylovSpace_le
statement:
theorem complex_polynomial_filter_residual_bounds_of_blockKrylovSpace_le
    {κ a b order : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin κ)] {A : Matrix m n ℂ}
    {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℂ} {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℂ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℂ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s₁ i : ℂ)) * V₁ᴴ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal * V₂ᴴ)
    (hU₁ : U₁ᴴ * U₁ = 1) (hU₂ : U₂ᴴ * U₂ = 1) (hU : U₁ᴴ * U₂ = 0)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1) (hV₂ : V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1) (hV : V₁ᴴ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < order) (Ω : Matrix n t ℂ)
    (hB : (V₁ᴴ * Ω).rank = κ) (hc : 0 < filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p) (Q : Matrix m q ℂ)
    (hK : blockKrylovSpace (A * Aᴴ) (A * Ω) order ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    let S₂
proof:
:= (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ).map Complex.ofReal
    let B := V₁ᴴ * Ω
    let R := Bᴴ * (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹
    let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => Complex.ofReal ((p.eval (s₁ i ^ 2))⁻¹)
    ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖A - rangeProjector Q * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S₂‖ ^ 2 +
        (filterTailMaxAbs s₂ p a b / filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p) ^ 2 * ‖V₂ᴴ * Ω‖ ^ 2 * ‖R‖ ^ 2 ∧
      (@norm _ (Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup (m := m) (n := n) (α := ℂ)).toNorm
        (A - rangeProjector Q * A)) ^ 2 ≤
      (@norm _ (Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup (m := Fin a) (n := Fin b) (α := ℂ)).toNorm S₂) ^ 2 +
      (@norm _ (Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup (m := Fin a) (n := Fin κ) (α := ℂ)).toNorm
        (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᴴ * S₂) p * (V₂ᴴ * Ω) * R * Cinv)) ^ 2 :=
  complex_polynomial_filter_residual_bounds s₁ s₂ hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω hB hc Q
    (rangeProjector_aeval_conjGram_mul_mul_eq_of_blockKrylovSpace_le A Ω Q hK hp)

name: NLAlib.aeval_gram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition
statement:
theorem aeval_gram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℝ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) :
    aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω =
      U₁ * S₁ * aeval (S₁ᵀ * S₁) p * (V₁ᵀ * Ω) +
      U₂ * S₂ * aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p * (V₂ᵀ * Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : U₂ᵀ * U₁ = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hU
  have hV' : V₂ᵀ * V₁ = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hV
  have hU₁t : U₁ᵀ * U₁ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hU₁.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hU₂t : U₂ᵀ * U₂ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hU₂.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hV₁t : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hV₁.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hV₂t : V₂ᵀ * V₂ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hV₂.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hAtU₁ : Aᵀ * U₁ = V₁ * S₁ᵀ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hU₁t, hU', Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hAtU₂ : Aᵀ * U₂ = V₂ * S₂ᵀ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hU, hU₂t, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_one, zero_add]
  have hAV₁ : A * V₁ = U₁ * S₁ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hV₁t, hV', Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hAV₂ : A * V₂ = U₂ * S₂ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hV, hV₂t, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_one, zero_add]
  have hB₁ : (A * Aᵀ) * U₁ = U₁ * (S₁ * S₁ᵀ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAtU₁, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV₁, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hB₂ : (A * Aᵀ) * U₂ = U₂ * (S₂ * S₂ᵀ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAtU₂, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV₂, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hp₁ := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hB₁ p
  have hp₂ := aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hB₂ p
  conv_lhs => arg 1; arg 2; rw [hA]
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hp₁, hp₂]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (aeval (S₁ * S₁ᵀ) p),
    aeval_gram_mul_eq_mul_aeval_gram S₁ p,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (aeval (S₂ * S₂ᵀ) p),
    aeval_gram_mul_eq_mul_aeval_gram S₂ p]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_mul_mul_transpose_eq_of_filtered_blocks
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : Y * R * Cinv * V₁ᵀ =
      U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * D * Ω₂ * R * Cinv * V₁ᵀ := by
    rw [hY, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ω₁, hR, Matrix.one_mul,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc C, hC, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [hA, hZ, Matrix.mul_sub]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: NLAlib.residual_sq_le_of_filtered_blocks
proof:
:= by
  let Z := Y * R * Cinv * V₁ᵀ
  let T := S₂ * D * Ω₂ * R * Cinv
  have hQZ : Q * (Qᵀ * Z) = Z := by
    dsimp [Z]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᵀ Y, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q, hQ]
  have hdiff : A - Z = U₂ * (S₂ * V₂ᵀ - T * V₁ᵀ) :=
    sub_mul_mul_mul_transpose_eq_of_filtered_blocks hA hY hR hC
  have hres : projResidual Q A = projResidual Q (A - Z) := by
    simp only [projResidual, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_sub, hQZ]
    abel
  have horth : (S₂ * V₂ᵀ) * (-(T * V₁ᵀ))ᵀ = 0 := by
    have hV' : V₂ᵀ * V₁ = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hV
    rw [Matrix.transpose_neg, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc S₂, ← Matrix.mul_assoc V₂ᵀ,
      hV', Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have hs :=
    specNorm_add_sq_le_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq_zero (X := S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (Y := -(T * V₁ᵀ)) horth
  have hU₂t : U₂ᵀ * U₂ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hU₂.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hV₁t : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hV₁.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hV₂t : V₂ᵀ * V₂ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hV₂.conjTranspose_mul_self
  rw [specNorm_neg, specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV₂t,
    specNorm_mul_transpose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV₁t] at hs
  have hforth : frobInner (S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (T * V₁ᵀ) = 0 := by
    rw [← frobInner_transpose]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact frobInner_mul_mul_eq_zero _ _ _ _ (conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hV)
  constructor
  · calc specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm (A - Z) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (by
            rw [hres]; exact specNorm_sub_mul_conjTranspose_mul_le hQo.conjTranspose_mul_self _) 2
      _ ≤ _ := by
          rw [hdiff, specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU₂t, sub_eq_add_neg]
          exact hs
  · calc frobSq (projResidual Q A) ≤ frobSq (A - Z) := by
          rw [hres]; exact frobSq_residual_le hQo _
      _ = _ := by
          rw [hdiff, frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU₂.conjTranspose_mul_self,
            frobSq_sub_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _ hforth,
            ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial V₂,
            ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial V₁,
            frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV₂.conjTranspose_mul_self,
            frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV₁.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter
statement:
theorem residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℝ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) (R : Matrix t k ℝ) (Cinv : Matrix k k ℝ)
    (hR : (V₁ᵀ * Ω) * R = 1)
    (hC : aeval (S₁ᵀ * S₁) p * Cinv = 1)
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ : Q * (Qᵀ * (aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω)) =
      aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm S₂ ^ 2 +
      specNorm (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv) ^ 2 ∧
    frobSq (projResidual Q A) ≤ frobSq S₂ +
      frobSq (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv)
proof:
:=
  residual_sq_le_of_filtered_blocks hA
    (aeval_gram_mul_mul_eq_of_block_decomposition hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV p Ω)
    hR hC hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hQo hQ

name: NLAlib.mul_transpose_aeval_gram_mul_mul_eq_of_blockKrylovSpace_le
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQo
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  exact (range_aeval_mul_le_blockKrylovSpace _ _ hp).trans hK

name: NLAlib.filterHeadMinAbs_le
statement:
theorem filterHeadMinAbs_le {κ : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin κ)] (s : Fin κ → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin κ) : filterHeadMinAbs s p ≤ |p.eval ((s i) ^ 2)|
proof:
:=
  Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.abs_mul_eval_le_filterTailMaxAbs
statement:
theorem abs_mul_eval_le_filterTailMaxAbs (s : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) {a b i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < min a b) : |s i * p.eval (s i ^ 2)| ≤ filterTailMaxAbs s p a b
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => Real.toNNReal (|s j * p.eval (s j ^ 2)|))
    (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
  have hc : (Real.toNNReal (|s i * p.eval (s i ^ 2)|) : ℝ) ≤ filterTailMaxAbs s p a b :=
    NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr h
  rwa [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (abs_nonneg _)] at hc

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter_envelopes
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter_envelopes
    [DecidableEq t] {κ a b : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℝ} (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal s₁ * V₁ᵀ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) (R : Matrix t (Fin κ) ℝ)
    (hR : (V₁ᵀ * Ω) * R = 1) {c τ : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ i, c ≤ |p.eval ((s₁ i) ^ 2)|)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hmax : ∀ i, i < min a b → |s₂ i * p.eval (s₂ i ^ 2)| ≤ τ)
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ : Q * (Qᵀ * (aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω)) = aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) ^ 2 +
        (τ / c) ^ 2 * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) ^ 2 * specNorm R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let S₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ := rectDiag s₂
  let D := aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p
  let Cinv := Matrix.diagonal fun i => (p.eval ((s₁ i) ^ 2))⁻¹
  have hC := aeval_gram_diagonal_mul_diagonal_inv_eq_one (𝕜 := ℝ) s₁ p
    (fun i => abs_pos.mp (hc.trans_le (hmin i)))
  have hCi := specNorm_diagonal_inv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) s₁ p hc hmin
  have htail : specNorm (S₂ * D) ≤ τ := by
    change specNorm ((rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) *
      aeval ((rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ)ᵀ * rectDiag s₂) p) ≤ τ
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, rectDiag_mul_aeval_gram]
    exact specNorm_rectDiag_le hτ hmax
  have hcore := (residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV
    p Ω R Cinv hR hC hQo hQ).1
  have hTR : specNorm (S₂ * D * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R) ≤
      (specNorm (S₂ * D) * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω)) * specNorm R :=
    (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (specNorm_mul_le _ _) (specNorm_nonneg R))
  have hchain : specNorm (S₂ * D * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv) ≤
      (τ / c) * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * specNorm R := by
    calc specNorm (S₂ * D * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv) ≤
        ((specNorm (S₂ * D) * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω)) * specNorm R) * specNorm Cinv :=
        (specNorm_mul_le _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTR (specNorm_nonneg Cinv))
      _ = specNorm (S₂ * D) * (specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * specNorm R * specNorm Cinv) := by ring
      _ ≤ τ * (specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * specNorm R * specNorm Cinv) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htail
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      _ = (τ * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * specNorm R) * specNorm Cinv := by ring
      _ ≤ (τ * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * specNorm R) * (1 / c) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCi
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hτ (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _))
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm S₂ ^ 2 +
        specNorm (S₂ * D * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv) ^ 2 := hcore
    _ ≤ specNorm S₂ ^ 2 + ((τ / c) * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * specNorm R) ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hchain 2)
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_sq_le_filterTailMaxAbs_div_filterHeadMinAbs
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_sq_le_filterTailMaxAbs_div_filterHeadMinAbs
    [DecidableEq t] {κ a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin κ)] {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℝ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal s₁ * V₁ᵀ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) (R : Matrix t (Fin κ) ℝ)
    (hR : (V₁ᵀ * Ω) * R = 1) (hc : 0 < filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p)
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ : Q * (Qᵀ * (aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω)) = aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) ^ 2 +
        (filterTailMaxAbs s₂ p a b / filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p) ^ 2 *
          specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) ^ 2 * specNorm R ^ 2
proof:
:=
  specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter_envelopes s₁ s₂ hA hU₁ hU₂ hU hV₁ hV₂ hV
    p Ω R hR hc (filterHeadMinAbs_le s₁ p) (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)
    (fun _ hi => abs_mul_eval_le_filterTailMaxAbs s₂ p hi) hQo hQ

name: NLAlib.traceExcessDrift_nonneg
statement: theorem traceExcessDrift_nonneg {τ x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ traceExcessDrift τ x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hx

name: NLAlib.traceExcessDrift_sum_le_sum
statement:
theorem traceExcessDrift_sum_le_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (w x : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hwSum : ∑ i, w i = 1) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    traceExcessDrift τ (∑ i, w i * x i) ≤ ∑ i, w i * traceExcessDrift τ (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let u := ∑ i, w i * x i
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (hx i)
  have hg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, w i * traceExcessDrift τ (x i) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (traceExcessDrift_nonneg (hx i))
  by_cases hut : u ≤ τ
  · change traceExcessDrift τ u ≤ _
    simpa only [traceExcessDrift, max_eq_right (by linarith : u - τ ≤ 0),
      zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_div] using hg
  · have huτ : τ < u := lt_of_not_ge hut
    have hu0 : 0 < u := hτ.trans_lt huτ
    have hlow : u - τ ≤ ∑ i, w i * max (x i - τ) 0 := by
      have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun i => w i * (x i - τ))
        (g := fun i => w i * max (x i - τ) 0)
        (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) (hw i))
      simpa only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hwSum, one_mul] using h
    have hCS : (∑ i, w i * max (x i - τ) 0) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ i, w i * traceExcessDrift τ (x i)) * u := by
      apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul Finset.univ
      · intro i _; exact mul_nonneg (hw i) (traceExcessDrift_nonneg (hx i))
      · intro i _; exact mul_nonneg (hw i) (hx i)
      · intro i _
        by_cases hi : x i = 0
        · simp only [hi, traceExcessDrift, zero_sub, max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hτ),
            mul_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero, div_zero]
          exact le_rfl
        · dsimp only [traceExcessDrift]
          have he : (w i * max (x i - τ) 0) ^ 2 =
              (w i * ((max (x i - τ) 0) ^ 2 / x i)) * (w i * x i) := by
            field_simp
          exact he.le
    change traceExcessDrift τ u ≤ _
    rw [traceExcessDrift, max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr huτ.le), div_le_iff₀ hu0]
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr huτ.le) hlow 2).trans hCS

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_succ_le_traceExcessDrift
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_succ_le_traceExcessDrift
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (t : ℕ) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) ≤ complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t -
      traceExcessDrift (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) (complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t) / r
proof:
:= by
  let τ := spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < r)
  have hstep : ∀ h : Fin t → n,
      (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re -
        (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h * complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re /
          (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re ≤
      (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re -
        traceExcessDrift τ (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re / r := by
    intro h
    let R := complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h
    have hR := posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t h
    have hAR := posSemidef_sub_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t h
    have he := sq_max_re_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_of_eigenvalues₀_le hA hR
      (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hR.isHermitian hA.isHermitian hAR) r
    have hd : (max (R.trace.re - τ) 0) ^ 2 / r ≤ (R * R).trace.re :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hr0).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm, RCLike.re_to_complex] using he)
    have htr : 0 ≤ R.trace.re := re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef hR
    have hdiv : traceExcessDrift τ R.trace.re / r ≤ (R * R).trace.re / R.trace.re := by
      rw [traceExcessDrift, div_right_comm]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd htr
    exact sub_le_sub_left hdiv R.trace.re
  have he : complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) ≤
      ∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h *
        ((complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re -
          traceExcessDrift τ (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re / r) := by
    rw [complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_succ_eq hA t]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun h _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep h)
      (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_div_assoc, ← Finset.sum_div] at he
  have hj := traceExcessDrift_sum_le_sum (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t)
    (fun h => (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re)
    (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t)
    (fun h => re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef (posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t h))
    (sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t) (spectralTraceTail_nonneg hA r)
  have hJ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hj hr0.le
  change complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) ≤ complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t -
    (∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h * traceExcessDrift τ
      (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re) / r at he
  change traceExcessDrift τ (complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t) / r ≤ _ at hJ
  exact he.trans (sub_le_sub_left hJ _)

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_complexSpectralTraceTail
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_complexSpectralTraceTail
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log (A.trace.re / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_mul_tail_of_traceExcessDrift_recursion (complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A)
    (complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_antitone hA) hτ (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < r)) hε
    (fun t => complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_succ_le_traceExcessDrift hA hr t) k
  simpa only [complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_zero] using hbudget

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_of_complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_of_complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log (1 / (ε * complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  have htr : 0 < A.trace.re := hτ.trans_le (spectralTraceTail_le_trace hA r)
  have he : 1 / (ε * complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) =
      A.trace.re / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) := by
    unfold complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail
    field_simp
  apply complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_complexSpectralTraceTail hA hr hτ hε
  simpa only [he] using hbudget

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_complexSpectralTraceTail_add
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_complexSpectralTraceTail_add
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε h : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r /
        (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r + h) +
      r * Real.log (A.trace.re / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r + h)) ≤ k) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r + h
proof:
:= by
  let τ := spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
  have heps : 0 < ε + h / τ := add_pos hε (div_pos hh hτ)
  have hmul : (ε + h / τ) * τ = ε * τ + h := by
    rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hτ.ne']
  have hdiv : (r : ℝ) / (ε + h / τ) = r * τ / (ε * τ + h) := by
    have hsum : 0 < ε * τ + h := add_pos (mul_pos hε hτ) hh
    apply (div_eq_div_iff heps.ne' hsum.ne').mpr
    rw [← hmul]
    ring
  have hB : (r : ℝ) / (ε + h / τ) + r * Real.log (A.trace.re / ((ε + h / τ) * τ)) ≤ k := by
    rw [hdiv, hmul]
    exact hbudget
  have hC := complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_complexSpectralTraceTail hA hr hτ heps hB
  have hR : (1 + (ε + h / τ)) * τ = (1 + ε) * τ + h := by
    calc (1 + (ε + h / τ)) * τ = τ + (ε + h / τ) * τ := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hmul]; ring
  exact hC.trans_eq hR

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_complexSpectralTraceTail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_complexSpectralTraceTail_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ}
