name: NLAlib.sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_trace_sub_approximation_eq
statement:
theorem sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_trace_sub_approximation_eq
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h *
      (A - complexRandomizedCholeskyApproximation A t h).trace.re) = complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  have he : A - complexRandomizedCholeskyApproximation A t h = complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h := by
    unfold complexRandomizedCholeskyApproximation

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ∧
      (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log
        (1 / (ε * complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) ∨
      (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0 ∧ r ≤ k)) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  rcases hbudget with ⟨hτ, hb⟩ | ⟨hτ, hk⟩
  · exact complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_le_of_complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail hA hr hτ hε hb
  · rw [complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_complexSpectralTraceTail_eq_zero hA hτ hk,
      hτ, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_le_mul_spectralTraceTail
statement:
theorem integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_le_mul_spectralTraceTail

      (A.trace.re / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) :
    (∫ h, (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A k h).trace.re ∂complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA k) ≤
      (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:

    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]

    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]

statement:
theorem integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ∧
      (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log
        (1 / (ε * complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) ∨
      (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0 ∧ r ≤ k)) :

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ∧
      (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log
        (1 / (ε * complexRelativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) ∨
      (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0 ∧ r ≤ k))
    {H : Ω → Fin k → n} (hH : HasLaw H (complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA k) μ) :
    (∫ ω, (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A k (H ω)).trace.re ∂μ) ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_of_hasLaw A hA k hH,
    ← integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA k]
  exact integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail hA hr hε hbudget

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_succ_le_traceExcessDrift
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_succ_le_traceExcessDrift
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (t : ℕ) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) ≤ choleskyExpectedTrace A t -
      traceExcessDrift (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) (choleskyExpectedTrace A t) / r
proof:
:= by
  let τ := spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < r)
  have hstep : ∀ h : Fin t → n,
      (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace -
        (partialCholeskyResidual A h * partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace /
          (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace ≤
      (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace -
        traceExcessDrift τ (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace / r := by
    intro h
    let R := partialCholeskyResidual A h
    have hR := posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA h
    have hAR := posSemidef_sub_partialCholeskyResidual hA h
    have he := sq_max_trace_sub_spectralTraceTail_le_mul_trace_sq hA hR hAR r
    have hd : (max (R.trace - τ) 0) ^ 2 / r ≤ (R * R).trace :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hr0).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using he)
    have htr : 0 ≤ R.trace := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hR.diag_nonneg
    have hdiv : traceExcessDrift τ R.trace / r ≤ (R * R).trace / R.trace := by
      rw [traceExcessDrift, div_right_comm]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd htr
    exact sub_le_sub_left hdiv R.trace
  have he : choleskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) ≤
      ∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h *
        ((partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace -
          traceExcessDrift τ (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace / r) := by
    rw [choleskyExpectedTrace_succ_eq hA t]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun h _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep h)
      (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_div_assoc, ← Finset.sum_div] at he
  have hj := traceExcessDrift_sum_le_sum (choleskyHistoryWeight A t)
    (fun h => (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace)
    (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t)
    (fun h => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA h).diag_nonneg)
    (sum_choleskyHistoryWeight A t) (spectralTraceTail_nonneg hA r)
  have hJ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hj hr0.le
  change choleskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) ≤ choleskyExpectedTrace A t -
    (∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h * traceExcessDrift τ
      (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace) / r at he
  change traceExcessDrift τ (choleskyExpectedTrace A t) / r ≤ _ at hJ
  exact he.trans (sub_le_sub_left hJ _)

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_spectralTraceTail
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_spectralTraceTail
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log (A.trace / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_mul_tail_of_traceExcessDrift_recursion (choleskyExpectedTrace A)
    (choleskyExpectedTrace_antitone hA) hτ (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < r)) hε
    (fun t => choleskyExpectedTrace_succ_le_traceExcessDrift hA hr t) k
  simpa only [choleskyExpectedTrace_zero] using hbudget

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_le_of_relativeSpectralTraceTail
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_le_of_relativeSpectralTraceTail
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log (1 / (ε * relativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  have htr : 0 < A.trace := hτ.trans_le (spectralTraceTail_le_trace hA r)
  have he : 1 / (ε * relativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) =
      A.trace / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) := by
    unfold relativeSpectralTraceTail
    field_simp
  apply choleskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_spectralTraceTail hA hr hτ hε
  simpa only [he] using hbudget

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_spectralTraceTail_add
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_spectralTraceTail_add
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε h : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r /
        (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r + h) +
      r * Real.log (A.trace / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r + h)) ≤ k) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A k ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r + h
proof:
:= by
  let τ := spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
  have heps : 0 < ε + h / τ := add_pos hε (div_pos hh hτ)
  have hmul : (ε + h / τ) * τ = ε * τ + h := by
    rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hτ.ne']
  have hdiv : (r : ℝ) / (ε + h / τ) = r * τ / (ε * τ + h) := by
    have hsum : 0 < ε * τ + h := add_pos (mul_pos hε hτ) hh
    apply (div_eq_div_iff heps.ne' hsum.ne').mpr
    rw [← hmul]
    ring
  have hB : (r : ℝ) / (ε + h / τ) + r * Real.log (A.trace / ((ε + h / τ) * τ)) ≤ k := by
    rw [hdiv, hmul]
    exact hbudget
  have hC := choleskyExpectedTrace_le_mul_spectralTraceTail hA hr hτ heps hB
  have hR : (1 + (ε + h / τ)) * τ = (1 + ε) * τ + h := by
    calc (1 + (ε + h / τ)) * τ = τ + (ε + h / τ) * τ := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hmul]; ring
  exact hC.trans_eq hR

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ}
    (ht : spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0) (hk : r ≤ k) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A k = 0
proof:
:=
  choleskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_rank_le hA ((rank_le_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero hA ht).trans hk)

name: NLAlib.sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_trace_sub_approximation_eq
statement:
theorem sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_trace_sub_approximation_eq
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h *
      (A - randomizedCholeskyApproximation A t h).trace) = choleskyExpectedTrace A t
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  have he : A - randomizedCholeskyApproximation A t h = partialCholeskyResidual A h := by

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_mul_spectralTraceTail
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_mul_spectralTraceTail

    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)

    (hbudget : (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log
      (A.trace / (ε * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) :
    (∫ h, (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace ∂choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k) ≤
      (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_mul_spectralTraceTail_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_mul_spectralTraceTail_of_hasLaw

    {H : Ω → Fin k → n} (hH : HasLaw H (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k) μ) :

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : (0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ∧
      (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log
        (1 / (ε * relativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) ∨
      (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0 ∧ r ≤ k)) :
    (∫ h, (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace ∂choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k) ≤
      (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw]
  rcases hbudget with ⟨hτ, hb⟩ | ⟨hτ, hk⟩
  · exact choleskyExpectedTrace_le_of_relativeSpectralTraceTail hA hr hτ hε hb
  · simpa only [choleskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero hA hτ hk,
      hτ, mul_zero] using (le_rfl : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0)

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_le_of_relative_budget_or_zero_tail_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]

    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {r k : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)

      (r : ℝ) / ε + r * Real.log
        (1 / (ε * relativeSpectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r)) ≤ k) ∨
      (spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0 ∧ r ≤ k))
    {H : Ω → Fin k → n} (hH : HasLaw H (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k) μ) :
    (∫ ω, (partialCholeskyResidual A (H ω)).trace ∂μ) ≤ (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
proof:

    ← integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k]

name: NLAlib.eliminationStep_eq_sub_nystrom
statement:
theorem eliminationStep_eq_sub_nystrom (R : Matrix n n ℝ) (i : n) :
    eliminationStep R i = R - nystrom R (fun (j : n) (_ : Fin 1) => if j = i then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  let E : Matrix n (Fin 1) ℝ := fun j _ => if j = i then 1 else 0
  have hcore : Eᵀ * R * E = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => R i i) := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    dsimp only [E]
    simp [ite_mul, mul_ite, Subsingleton.elim a b]
  ext j k
  rw [eliminationStep_apply]
  change _ = R j k - nystrom R E j k
  rw [nystrom, hcore, moorePenroseInverse_singleton]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  dsimp only [E]
  simp [ite_mul, mul_ite]
  ring

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory
statement:
theorem posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) : (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact hA
  | succ t ih => exact posSemidef_eliminationStep (ih (Fin.init h)) _

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_sub_complexCholeskyResidualHistory
statement:
theorem posSemidef_sub_complexCholeskyResidualHistory {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) : (A - complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simpa only [complexCholeskyResidualHistory, sub_self] using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero (n := n) (R := ℂ))
  | succ t ih =>
    have h := (ih (Fin.init h)).add
      (Matrix.le_iff.mp (eliminationStep_le (posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t (Fin.init h))
        (h (Fin.last t))))
    convert h using 1
    dsimp only [complexCholeskyResidualHistory]
    abel

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) : 0 ≤ complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact zero_le_one
  | succ t ih =>
    exact mul_nonneg (ih (Fin.init h))
      (choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg (posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t (Fin.init h)) _)

name: NLAlib.sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ
statement:
theorem sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℕ)
    (f : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ) :
    (∑ h : Fin (t + 1) → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A (t + 1) h *
      f (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A (t + 1) h)) =
      ∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h *
        ∑ i : n, choleskyPivotProbability (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h) i *
          f (eliminationStep (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h) i)
proof:
:= by
  calc (∑ h : Fin (t + 1) → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A (t + 1) h *
      f (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A (t + 1) h)) =
      ∑ z : n × (Fin t → n), complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t z.2 *
        choleskyPivotProbability (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t z.2) z.1 *
          f (eliminationStep (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t z.2) z.1) :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ : Fin (t + 1) => n)).symm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
      simp only [mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight
statement:
theorem sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [complexCholeskyHistoryWeight]
  | succ t ih =>
    have h := sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ A t (fun _ => 1)
    simpa only [mul_one, sum_choleskyPivotProbability, mul_one, ih] using h

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_zero (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A 0 = A.trace.re
proof:
:= by
  simp [complexCholeskyExpectedTrace, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight, complexCholeskyResidualHistory]

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_nonneg
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro h _
  apply mul_nonneg (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)
  exact re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef (posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t h)

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_antitone
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_antitone [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : Antitone (complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A)
proof:
:= by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro t
  rw [complexCholeskyExpectedTrace,
    sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ A t (fun R => R.trace.re)]
  change _ ≤ ∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h * (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro h _
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)
  let R := complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h
  have hR : R.PosSemidef := posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t h
  calc
    (∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i * (eliminationStep R i).trace.re) ≤
        ∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i * R.trace.re := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg hR i)
      have hn : 0 ≤ (R - eliminationStep R i).trace.re :=
        re_trace_nonneg_of_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp (eliminationStep_le hR i))
      rw [Matrix.trace_sub, Complex.sub_re] at hn
      linarith
    _ = R.trace.re := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_choleskyPivotProbability, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_succ_eq
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_succ_eq [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) :
    complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) =
      ∑ h : Fin t → n, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h *
        ((complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re -
          (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h * complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re /
            (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re)
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexCholeskyExpectedTrace,
    sum_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ A t (fun R => R.trace.re)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  exact congrArg (fun x => complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h * x)
    (sum_choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace_eliminationStep_eq
      (posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t h))

name: NLAlib.rank_complexCholeskyResidualHistory_le_sub
statement:
theorem rank_complexCholeskyResidualHistory_le_sub {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) (hw : 0 < complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h) :
    (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).rank ≤ A.rank - t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [complexCholeskyResidualHistory, Nat.sub_zero, le_refl]
  | succ t ih =>
    let R := complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (Fin.init h)
    have hR : R.PosSemidef := posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t (Fin.init h)
    have hW0 := complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t (Fin.init h)
    have hP0 := choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg hR (h (Fin.last t))
    change 0 < complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) * choleskyPivotProbability R (h (Fin.last t)) at hw
    have hW : 0 < complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) := by
      by_contra hn
      have he : complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hW0
      rw [he, zero_mul] at hw
      linarith
    have hP : 0 < choleskyPivotProbability R (h (Fin.last t)) := by
      by_contra hn
      have he : choleskyPivotProbability R (h (Fin.last t)) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hP0
      rw [he, mul_zero] at hw
      linarith
    have hprev := ih (Fin.init h) hW
    by_cases hz : R = 0
    · change (eliminationStep R _).rank ≤ _
      rw [hz, eliminationStep_zero, Matrix.rank_zero]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · have htr : R.trace.re ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        exact hz ((re_trace_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef hR).mp hzero)
      have hdiag : R (h (Fin.last t)) (h (Fin.last t)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        simp only [choleskyPivotProbability, RCLike.re_to_complex, if_neg htr, hzero, Complex.zero_re,
          zero_div] at hP
        linarith
      have hdrop := rank_eliminationStep_lt hdiag
      change (eliminationStep R _).rank ≤ _
      change R.rank ≤ A.rank - t at hprev
      omega

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyResidualHistory_eq_zero_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyResidualHistory_eq_zero_of_rank_le {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)

    complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_matrix_rank_eq_zero
  have hr := rank_complexCholeskyResidualHistory_le_sub hA t h hw
  rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le ht] at hr
  exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hr

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_rank_le {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)

name: NLAlib.integral_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw
statement:
theorem integral_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) (f : (Fin t → n) → ℝ) :
    (∫ h, f h ∂complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA t) =
      ∑ h, complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h * f h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [complexCholeskyHistoryLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  change (ENNReal.ofReal (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h)).toReal • f h = _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) :
    (∫ h, (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re ∂complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA t) =
      complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t
proof: := integral_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA t _

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_of_hasLaw [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) {H : Ω → Fin t → n}
    (hH : ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw H (complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA t) μ) :
    (∫ ω, (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (H ω)).trace.re ∂μ) =
      complexCholeskyExpectedTrace A t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA t]
  exact hH.integral_comp (Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable (measurable_of_finite (fun h : Fin t → n => (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h).trace.re)))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_trace_ge_le_factorial_elementary_div
statement:
private theorem measureReal_trace_ge_le_factorial_elementary_div
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k r : ℕ} (hrk : r ≤ k)
    (μ : Measure (Fin k → n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hMass : ∀ h : Fin k → n,
      μ.real {h} * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h = RCLike.re (A.submatrix h h).det)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    μ.real {h | c ≤ RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn h)).trace} ≤
      ((k.factorial : ℝ) *
        ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).powersetCard k,
          ∏ i ∈ S, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i) /
        ((∏ j : Fin r, spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian j) * c ^ (k - r))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := (∏ j : Fin r, spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian j) * c ^ (k - r)
  have hD : 0 < D := mul_pos
    (Finset.prod_pos fun j _ => hτ.trans_le (spectralTraceTail_antitone hA (by omega)))
    (pow_pos hc _)
  let E : Finset (Fin k → n) := Finset.univ.filter
    fun h => c ≤ RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn h)).trace
  have hSet : (E : Set (Fin k → n)) =
      {h | c ≤ RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn h)).trace} := by
    ext h
    simp [E]
  rw [← hSet, ← sum_measureReal_singleton]
  calc
    (∑ h ∈ E, μ.real {h}) ≤ ∑ h ∈ E, RCLike.re (A.submatrix h h).det / D := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro h hh
      have hLower : D ≤ choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h := by
        simpa only [D, choleskyHistoryTraceProduct, List.length_ofFn] using
          prod_spectralTraceTail_mul_pow_le_eliminationTraceProduct hA (List.ofFn h)
            (by simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using hrk) hc.le (Finset.mem_filter.mp hh).2
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hD).mpr
      calc
        μ.real {h} * D ≤ μ.real {h} * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLower measureReal_nonneg
        _ = _ := hMass h
    _ = (∑ h ∈ E, RCLike.re (A.submatrix h h).det) / D := by rw [Finset.sum_div]
    _ ≤ (∑ h : Fin k → n, RCLike.re (A.submatrix h h).det) / D := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hD.le
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ E)
      intro h _ _
      exact (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (hA.submatrix h).det_nonneg).1
    _ = _ := by rw [hA.isHermitian.sum_re_det_submatrix_eq_factorial_mul_sum_prod_eigenvalues₀]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_trace_ge_le_factorialTraceTail
statement:
private theorem measureReal_trace_ge_le_factorialTraceTail
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k r : ℕ} (hrk : r ≤ k)
    (μ : Measure (Fin k → n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hMass : ∀ h : Fin k → n,
      μ.real {h} * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h = RCLike.re (A.submatrix h h).det)
    (hτ : 0 < spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    μ.real {h | (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ≤
      RCLike.re (eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn h)).trace} ≤
        choleskyFactorialTraceTail r k ε
proof:
:= by
  let τ := spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r
  let T := ∏ j : Fin r, spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian j
  let E := ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card n))).powersetCard k,
    ∏ i ∈ S, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i
  have hT : 0 < T := Finset.prod_pos fun j _ =>
    hτ.trans_le (spectralTraceTail_antitone hA (by omega))
  have hOne : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < (1 + ε) * τ := mul_pos hOne hτ
  have hDen : 0 < T * ((1 + ε) * τ) ^ (k - r) := mul_pos hT (pow_pos hc _)
  have hFac : 0 < ((k - r).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos (k - r)
  have hFinalDen : 0 < ((k - r).factorial : ℝ) * (1 + ε) ^ (k - r) :=
    mul_pos hFac (pow_pos hOne _)
  have hScalar : ((k - r).factorial : ℝ) * E ≤ T * τ ^ (k - r) := by
    simpa only [E, T, τ, spectralTraceTail] using
      factorial_mul_sum_powersetCard_prod_le_prod_sum_tail_mul_pow
        hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ (eigenvalues₀_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA) hrk
  have hRatio : ((k.factorial : ℝ) * E) / (T * ((1 + ε) * τ) ^ (k - r)) ≤
      (k.factorial : ℝ) / ((k - r).factorial * (1 + ε) ^ (k - r)) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hDen hFinalDen).mpr
    calc
      ((k.factorial : ℝ) * E) * ((k - r).factorial * (1 + ε) ^ (k - r)) =
          ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (1 + ε) ^ (k - r)) * ((k - r).factorial * E) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (1 + ε) ^ (k - r)) * (T * τ ^ (k - r)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hScalar (by positivity)
      _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) * (T * ((1 + ε) * τ) ^ (k - r)) := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
  apply le_min measureReal_le_one
  exact (measureReal_trace_ge_le_factorial_elementary_div hA hrk μ hMass hτ hc).trans hRatio

name: NLAlib.measureReal_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_ge_le_factorialTraceTail
statement:

name: NLAlib.measureReal_trace_complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_ge_le_factorialTraceTail
statement:

name: NLAlib.ae_partialCholeskyResidual_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ae_partialCholeskyResidual_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero [Nonempty n]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_gt_le_factorialTraceTail
statement:
theorem measureReal_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_gt_le_factorialTraceTail [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k r : ℕ} (hrk : r ≤ k)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k).real
      {h | (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r < (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace} ≤
        choleskyFactorialTraceTail r k ε
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hτ : spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r = 0
  · have hz := ae_partialCholeskyResidual_eq_zero_of_spectralTraceTail_eq_zero hA hrk hτ
    have hm : (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA k).real
        {h | (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r < (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace} = 0 := by
      apply (measureReal_eq_zero_iff (by finiteness)).mpr
      apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      filter_upwards [hz] with h hh
      simp [hh, hτ]
    rw [hm]
    apply le_min zero_le_one
    apply div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _))
  · have hSub : {h : Fin k → n | (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r <
          (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace} ⊆
        {h : Fin k → n | (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r ≤
          (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace} := by
      intro h hh
      exact (show (1 + ε) * spectralTraceTail A hA.isHermitian r <
        (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace from hh).le
    exact (measureReal_mono hSub).trans
      (measureReal_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_ge_le_factorialTraceTail hA hrk
        ((spectralTraceTail_nonneg hA r).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hτ)) hε)

    have hm : (complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA k).real

name: NLAlib.one_div_le_inv_sub_log_sub_of_step_le
statement:
theorem one_div_le_inv_sub_log_sub_of_step_le
    {a b r : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hstep : b ≤ a - a ^ 2 / (r * (a + 1))) :
    1 / r ≤ (b⁻¹ - Real.log b) - (a⁻¹ - Real.log a)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb ha)
  rw [Real.log_div hb.ne' ha.ne'] at hlog
  have hinv : 0 ≤ b⁻¹ - a⁻¹ - (a - b) / a ^ 2 := by
    have he : b⁻¹ - a⁻¹ - (a - b) / a ^ 2 = (a - b) ^ 2 / (a ^ 2 * b) := by
      field_simp
    rw [he]
    positivity
  have hdelta : a ^ 2 / (r * (a + 1)) ≤ a - b := by linarith
  have hgain := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdelta
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ (a + 1) / a ^ 2)
  have he : a ^ 2 / (r * (a + 1)) * ((a + 1) / a ^ 2) = 1 / r := by
    field_simp
  rw [he] at hgain
  have he' : (a - b) * ((a + 1) / a ^ 2) = (a - b) / a ^ 2 + (1 - b / a) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he'] at hgain
  linarith

name: NLAlib.inv_sub_log_lt_inv_sub_log
statement:
theorem inv_sub_log_lt_inv_sub_log {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    b⁻¹ - Real.log b < a⁻¹ - Real.log a
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := ha.trans hab
  have hi : b⁻¹ < a⁻¹ := (inv_lt_inv₀ hb ha).2 hab
  have hl : Real.log a < Real.log b := Real.log_lt_log ha hab
  linarith

name: NLAlib.le_mul_tail_of_traceExcessDrift_recursion
statement:
theorem le_mul_tail_of_traceExcessDrift_recursion
    (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hmono : Antitone u) {τ r ε : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hrec : ∀ t, u (t + 1) ≤ u t - traceExcessDrift τ (u t) / r)
    (k : ℕ) (hbudget : r / ε + r * Real.log (u 0 / (ε * τ)) ≤ k) :
    u k ≤ (1 + ε) * τ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hfail
  have huk : (1 + ε) * τ < u k := lt_of_not_ge hfail
  let a := fun t => u t / τ - 1
  have hapos : ∀ t, t ≤ k → ε < a t := by
    intro t ht
    change ε < u t / τ - 1
    rw [lt_sub_iff_add_lt, lt_div_iff₀ hτ]
    have h := hmono ht
    nlinarith
  have hstep : ∀ t, t < k → a (t + 1) ≤ a t - (a t) ^ 2 / (r * (a t + 1)) := by
    intro t ht
    have hap : 0 < a t := hε.trans (hapos t ht.le)
    have hut : τ < u t := by
      have h := hapos t ht.le
      dsimp only [a] at h
      rw [lt_sub_iff_add_lt, lt_div_iff₀ hτ] at h
      nlinarith
    have hua : u t = (a t + 1) * τ := by
      dsimp only [a]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hdelta : (traceExcessDrift τ (u t) / r) / τ =
        (a t) ^ 2 / (r * (a t + 1)) := by
      rw [traceExcessDrift, max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hut.le), hua]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hrec t) hτ.le
    rw [sub_div, hdelta] at h
    change u (t + 1) / τ ≤ u t / τ - (a t) ^ 2 / (r * (a t + 1)) at h
    dsimp only [a]
    linarith
  let φ := fun t => (a t)⁻¹ - Real.log (a t)
  have hsum : (k : ℝ) / r ≤ φ k - φ 0 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.range k) (f := fun _ => (1 : ℝ) / r)
      (g := fun t => φ (t + 1) - φ t) (fun t ht =>
        one_div_le_inv_sub_log_sub_of_step_le
          (hε.trans (hapos t (Finset.mem_range.mp ht).le))
          (hε.trans (hapos (t + 1) (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp ht; omega))) hr
          (hstep t (Finset.mem_range.mp ht)))
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub] at h
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_div] using h
  have hφk : φ k < ε⁻¹ - Real.log ε :=
    inv_sub_log_lt_inv_sub_log hε (hapos k le_rfl)
  have ha0 : 0 < a 0 := hε.trans (hapos 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hu0 : 0 < u 0 := by
    have h := hmono (Nat.zero_le k)
    nlinarith
  have ha0u : a 0 < u 0 / τ := by dsimp only [a]; linarith
  have hlog0 : Real.log (a 0) < Real.log (u 0 / τ) := Real.log_lt_log ha0 ha0u
  have hinv0 : 0 ≤ (a 0)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr ha0.le
  have hlog : Real.log (u 0 / (ε * τ)) = Real.log (u 0 / τ) - Real.log ε := by
    rw [Real.log_div hu0.ne' (mul_pos hε hτ).ne', Real.log_mul hε.ne' hτ.ne',
      Real.log_div hu0.ne' hτ.ne']
    ring
  have hstrict : φ k - φ 0 < 1 / ε + Real.log (u 0 / (ε * τ)) := by
    rw [hlog, one_div]
    dsimp only [φ] at hφk ⊢
    linarith
  have hlt := (div_lt_iff₀ hr).mp (hsum.trans_lt hstrict)
  have he : (1 / ε + Real.log (u 0 / (ε * τ))) * r =
      r / ε + r * Real.log (u 0 / (ε * τ)) := by ring
  rw [he] at hlt
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hbudget) hlt

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) : 0 ≤ choleskyHistoryWeight A t h
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact zero_le_one
  | succ t ih =>
    exact mul_nonneg (ih (Fin.init h))
      (choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA (Fin.init h)) _)

name: NLAlib.sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ
statement:
theorem sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℕ)
    (f : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ h : Fin (t + 1) → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A (t + 1) h *
      f (partialCholeskyResidual A h)) =
      ∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h *
        ∑ i : n, choleskyPivotProbability (partialCholeskyResidual A h) i *
          f (eliminationStep (partialCholeskyResidual A h) i)
proof:
:= by
  calc (∑ h : Fin (t + 1) → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A (t + 1) h *
      f (partialCholeskyResidual A h)) =
      ∑ z : n × (Fin t → n), choleskyHistoryWeight A t z.2 *
        choleskyPivotProbability (partialCholeskyResidual A z.2) z.1 *
          f (eliminationStep (partialCholeskyResidual A z.2) z.1) :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ : Fin (t + 1) => n)).symm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
      simp only [mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.sum_choleskyHistoryWeight
statement:
theorem sum_choleskyHistoryWeight [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [choleskyHistoryWeight]
  | succ t ih =>
    have h := sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ A t (fun _ => 1)
    simpa only [mul_one, sum_choleskyPivotProbability, mul_one, ih] using h

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A 0 = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  simp [choleskyExpectedTrace, choleskyHistoryWeight, partialCholeskyResidual]

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_nonneg
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ choleskyExpectedTrace A t
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro h _
  apply mul_nonneg (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA h).diag_nonneg

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_antitone
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_antitone [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) : Antitone (choleskyExpectedTrace A)
proof:
:= by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro t
  rw [choleskyExpectedTrace, sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ]
  change _ ≤ ∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h * (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro h _
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)
  let R := partialCholeskyResidual A h
  have hR : R.PosSemidef := posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA h
  calc
    (∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i * (eliminationStep R i).trace) ≤
        ∑ i, choleskyPivotProbability R i * R.trace := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg hR i)
      have hn : 0 ≤ (R - eliminationStep R i).trace :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => (Matrix.le_iff.mp (eliminationStep_le hR i)).diag_nonneg
      rw [Matrix.trace_sub] at hn
      linarith
    _ = R.trace := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_choleskyPivotProbability, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_succ_eq
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_succ_eq [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) :
    choleskyExpectedTrace A (t + 1) =
      ∑ h : Fin t → n, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h *
        ((partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace -
          (partialCholeskyResidual A h * partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace /
            (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace)
proof:
:= by
  rw [choleskyExpectedTrace, sum_choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_succ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  exact congrArg (fun x => choleskyHistoryWeight A t h * x)
    (sum_choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace_eliminationStep_eq
      (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA h))

name: NLAlib.rank_partialCholeskyResidual_le_sub
statement:
theorem rank_partialCholeskyResidual_le_sub {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) (hw : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight A t h) :
    (partialCholeskyResidual A h).rank ≤ A.rank - t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [partialCholeskyResidual, Nat.sub_zero, le_refl]
  | succ t ih =>
    let R := partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init h)
    have hR : R.PosSemidef := posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA (Fin.init h)
    have hW0 := choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t (Fin.init h)
    have hP0 := choleskyPivotProbability_nonneg hR (h (Fin.last t))
    change 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) *
      choleskyPivotProbability R (h (Fin.last t)) at hw
    have hW : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) := by
      by_contra hn
      have he : choleskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hW0
      rw [he, zero_mul] at hw
      linarith
    have hP : 0 < choleskyPivotProbability R (h (Fin.last t)) := by
      by_contra hn
      have he : choleskyPivotProbability R (h (Fin.last t)) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hP0
      rw [he, mul_zero] at hw
      linarith
    have hprev := ih (Fin.init h) hW
    by_cases hz : R = 0
    · change (eliminationStep R _).rank ≤ _
      rw [hz, eliminationStep_zero, Matrix.rank_zero]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · have htr : R.trace ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        exact hz (hR.trace_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero)
      have hdiag : R (h (Fin.last t)) (h (Fin.last t)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        simp only [choleskyPivotProbability, RCLike.re_to_real, if_neg htr, hzero, zero_div] at hP
        linarith
      have hdrop := rank_eliminationStep_lt hdiag
      change (eliminationStep R _).rank ≤ _
      change R.rank ≤ A.rank - t at hprev
      omega

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyResidual_eq_zero_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem partialCholeskyResidual_eq_zero_of_rank_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : A.rank ≤ t) (h : Fin t → n) (hw : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight A t h) :
    partialCholeskyResidual A h = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_matrix_rank_eq_zero
  have hr := rank_partialCholeskyResidual_le_sub hA t h hw
  rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le ht] at hr
  exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hr

name: NLAlib.choleskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem choleskyExpectedTrace_eq_zero_of_rank_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : A.rank ≤ t) : choleskyExpectedTrace A t = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro h _
  by_cases hw : choleskyHistoryWeight A t h = 0
  · rw [hw, zero_mul]
  · have hp : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight A t h :=
      (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hw)
    rw [partialCholeskyResidual_eq_zero_of_rank_le hA ht h hp, Matrix.trace_zero, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_choleskyHistoryLaw
statement:
theorem integral_choleskyHistoryLaw [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) (f : (Fin t → n) → ℝ) :
    (∫ h, f h ∂choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t) =
      ∑ h, choleskyHistoryWeight A t h * f h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [choleskyHistoryLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  change (ENNReal.ofReal (choleskyHistoryWeight A t h)).toReal • f h = _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) :
    (∫ h, (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace ∂choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t) =
      choleskyExpectedTrace A t
proof: := integral_choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t _

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw_of_hasLaw [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) {H : Ω → Fin t → n}
    (hH : ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw H (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t) μ) :
    (∫ ω, (partialCholeskyResidual A (H ω)).trace ∂μ) =
      choleskyExpectedTrace A t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_trace_choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t]
  exact hH.integral_comp (Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable (measurable_of_finite (fun h : Fin t → n => (partialCholeskyResidual A h).trace)))

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryLaw_singleton
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryLaw_singleton [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) :
    (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t).real {h} = choleskyHistoryWeight A t h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Measure.real, choleskyHistoryLaw,
    PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton _)]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg hA t h)

name: NLAlib.eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_partialCholeskyResidual
statement:
theorem eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_partialCholeskyResidual
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) :
    eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn h) = partialCholeskyResidual A h
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
    change eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)]) = _
    rw [eliminationListResidual_append_singleton, ih]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_complexCholeskyResidualHistory
statement:
theorem eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_complexCholeskyResidualHistory
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) :
    eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn h) = complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t h
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
    change eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)]) = _
    rw [eliminationListResidual_append_singleton, ih]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_pos
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_pos {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n)
    (ht : t ≤ A.rank) : 0 < choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h
proof:
:=
  eliminationTraceProduct_pos hA _ (by simpa using ht)

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_succ
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {t : ℕ}
    (h : Fin (t + 1) → n) :
    choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h =
      choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A (Fin.init h) *
        (partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init h)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [choleskyHistoryTraceProduct, List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
  change eliminationTraceProduct A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)]) = _
  rw [eliminationTraceProduct_append_singleton,
    eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_partialCholeskyResidual]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_succ_complex
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_succ_complex (A : Matrix n n ℂ) {t : ℕ}
    (h : Fin (t + 1) → n) :
    choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h =
      choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A (Fin.init h) *
        (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (Fin.init h)).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [choleskyHistoryTraceProduct, List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
  change eliminationTraceProduct A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)]) = _
  rw [eliminationTraceProduct_append_singleton,
    eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_complexCholeskyResidualHistory]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_det
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_det {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) :
    choleskyHistoryWeight A t h * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h =
      (A.submatrix h h).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_submatrix_eq_eliminationPivotProduct hA]
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [choleskyHistoryWeight, choleskyHistoryTraceProduct,
      eliminationTraceProduct, eliminationPivotProduct]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [choleskyHistoryWeight, choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_succ,
      List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
    change _ = eliminationPivotProduct A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)])
    rw [eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton,
      eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_partialCholeskyResidual]
    have hp := choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace
      (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA (Fin.init h)) (h (Fin.last t))
    change choleskyPivotProbability _ _ *
      (partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init h)).trace =
        (partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init h)) (h (Fin.last t)) (h (Fin.last t)) at hp
    rw [show _ * _ * (_ * _) =
      (choleskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A (Fin.init h)) *
        (choleskyPivotProbability (partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init h)) (h (Fin.last t)) *
          (partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init h)).trace) by ring,
      ih, hp]

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_re_det
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_re_det {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) :
    complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h =
      (A.submatrix h h).det.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_submatrix_eq_eliminationPivotProduct hA]
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [complexCholeskyHistoryWeight, choleskyHistoryTraceProduct,
      eliminationTraceProduct, eliminationPivotProduct]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [complexCholeskyHistoryWeight, choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_succ_complex,
      List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
    change _ = Complex.re (eliminationPivotProduct A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)]))
    have hpiv : (eliminationPivotProduct A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h) ++ [h (Fin.last t)])).re =
        (eliminationPivotProduct A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h))).re *
          (eliminationListResidual A (List.ofFn (Fin.init h)) (h (Fin.last t)) (h (Fin.last t))).re :=
      re_eliminationPivotProduct_append_singleton hA _ _
    rw [hpiv,
      eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_complexCholeskyResidualHistory]
    have hp := choleskyPivotProbability_mul_re_trace
      (posSemidef_complexCholeskyResidualHistory hA t (Fin.init h)) (h (Fin.last t))
    change choleskyPivotProbability _ _ *
      (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (Fin.init h)).trace.re =
        (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (Fin.init h) (h (Fin.last t)) (h (Fin.last t))).re at hp
    rw [show _ * _ * (_ * _) =
      (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t (Fin.init h) * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A (Fin.init h)) *
        (choleskyPivotProbability (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (Fin.init h)) (h (Fin.last t)) *
          (complexCholeskyResidualHistory A t (Fin.init h)).trace.re) by ring,
      ih, hp]

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryWeight_eq_det_div_traceProduct
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryWeight_eq_det_div_traceProduct {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n)
    (ht : 0 < choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h) :
    choleskyHistoryWeight A t h = (A.submatrix h h).det / choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h
proof:
:=
  (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt ht)).mpr (choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_det hA h)

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_eq_re_det_div_traceProduct
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_eq_re_det_div_traceProduct {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n)
    (ht : 0 < choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h) :
    complexCholeskyHistoryWeight A t h = (A.submatrix h h).det.re / choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h
proof:
:=
  (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt ht)).mpr (complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_re_det hA h)

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryLaw_singleton_mul_traceProduct_eq_det
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryLaw_singleton_mul_traceProduct_eq_det [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) :
    (choleskyHistoryLaw A hA t).real {h} * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h =
      (A.submatrix h h).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [choleskyHistoryLaw_singleton]
  exact choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_det hA h

name: NLAlib.complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_singleton_mul_traceProduct_eq_re_det
statement:
theorem complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_singleton_mul_traceProduct_eq_re_det [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (t : ℕ) (h : Fin t → n) :
    (complexCholeskyHistoryLaw A hA t).real {h} * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct A h =
      (A.submatrix h h).det.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [complexCholeskyHistoryLaw_singleton]
  exact complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_re_det hA h

name: NLAlib.eq_re_det_div_descFactorial
statement:
private theorem eq_re_det_div_descFactorial {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {P : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P)
    {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) (ht : t ≤ P.rank) (w : ℝ)
    (hw : w * choleskyHistoryTraceProduct P h = RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det) :
    w = RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det / (P.rank.descFactorial t : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hPSD := hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp
  have htpos : 0 < choleskyHistoryTraceProduct P h := by
    apply eliminationTraceProduct_pos hPSD
    simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using ht
  by_cases hz : RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det = 0
  · have hwz : w = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp (hw.trans hz)).resolve_right htpos.ne'
    rw [hwz, hz, zero_div]
  · have hprod : eliminationPivotProduct P (List.ofFn h) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← det_submatrix_eq_eliminationPivotProduct hPSD]
      intro hd
      exact hz (by rw [hd, map_zero])
    have htrace := eliminationTraceProduct_eq_descFactorial_of_projector hs hp (List.ofFn h) hprod
    simp only [List.length_ofFn] at htrace
    change choleskyHistoryTraceProduct P h = _ at htrace
    have hfpos : (0 : ℝ) < P.rank.descFactorial t := htrace ▸ htpos
    apply (eq_div_iff hfpos.ne').mpr
    rwa [htrace] at hw

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryWeight_projector
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryWeight_projector {P : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n)
    (ht : t ≤ P.rank) :
    choleskyHistoryWeight P t h = (P.submatrix h h).det / (P.rank.descFactorial t : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_re_det_div_descFactorial hs hp h ht _
    (choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_det
      (hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp) h)

statement:
theorem complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_projector {P : Matrix n n ℂ}

    (ht : t ≤ P.rank) :
    complexCholeskyHistoryWeight P t h =
      (P.submatrix h h).det.re / (P.rank.descFactorial t : ℝ)
proof:

name: NLAlib.sum_re_det_submatrix_image_eq
statement:
private theorem sum_re_det_submatrix_image_eq {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (P : Matrix n n 𝕜) (t : ℕ) (S : Finset n) :
    (∑ h : Fin t → n, if Finset.univ.image h = S then RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det else 0) =
      (t.factorial : ℝ) * (if S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard t then
        RCLike.re (P.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Finset n → ℝ := fun T => if T = S then
    RCLike.re (P.submatrix (Subtype.val : T → n) Subtype.val).det else 0
  calc
    _ = ∑ h : Fin t → n, if Function.Injective h then f (Finset.univ.image h) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro h _
      by_cases hh : Function.Injective h
      · rw [if_pos hh, det_submatrix_eq_det_image_of_injective P h hh]
      · rw [if_neg hh, det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_not_injective P h hh, map_zero]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_injective_image_eq_factorial_nsmul]
      simp only [f, Finset.sum_ite_eq', nsmul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.pmf_map_image_toReal
statement:
private theorem pmf_map_image_toReal {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    (P : Matrix n n 𝕜) (t : ℕ) (p : PMF (Fin t → n))
    (hp : ∀ h, (p h).toReal = RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det / (t.factorial : ℝ))
    (S : Finset n) :
    ((p.map (fun h => Finset.univ.image h)) S).toReal =
      if S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard t then
        RCLike.re (P.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype, ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun h _ => by
    split_ifs
    · exact p.apply_ne_top h
    · exact ENNReal.zero_ne_top)]
  calc
    _ = ∑ h : Fin t → n, if Finset.univ.image h = S then
        RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det / (t.factorial : ℝ) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro h _
      by_cases he : Finset.univ.image h = S
      · rw [if_pos he.symm, if_pos he, hp]
      · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm he), if_neg he, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    _ = (∑ h : Fin t → n, if Finset.univ.image h = S then
        RCLike.re (P.submatrix h h).det else 0) / (t.factorial : ℝ) := by
      simp only [ite_div, zero_div, Finset.sum_div]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [sum_re_det_submatrix_image_eq]
      exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero t))

name: NLAlib.choleskyHistoryPMF_projector_image_toReal
statement:
theorem choleskyHistoryPMF_projector_image_toReal [Nonempty n] {P : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (S : Finset n) :
    (((choleskyHistoryPMF P (hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp) P.rank).map
      (fun h => Finset.univ.image h)) S).toReal =
      if S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard P.rank then
        (P.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine pmf_map_image_toReal P P.rank _ ?_ S
  intro h
  simp only [choleskyHistoryPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (choleskyHistoryWeight_nonneg
      (hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp) _ h)]
  rw [choleskyHistoryWeight_projector hs hp h le_rfl, Nat.descFactorial_self]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.eliminationPivotProduct_ne_zero_of_choleskyHistoryWeight_pos
statement:
theorem eliminationPivotProduct_ne_zero_of_choleskyHistoryWeight_pos
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n)
    (ht : t ≤ A.rank) (hw : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight A t h) :
    eliminationPivotProduct A (List.ofFn h) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp := mul_pos hw (choleskyHistoryTraceProduct_pos hA h ht)
  rw [choleskyHistoryWeight_mul_traceProduct_eq_det hA h,
    det_submatrix_eq_eliminationPivotProduct hA] at hp
  exact hp.ne'

name: NLAlib.eliminationPivotProduct_ne_zero_of_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_pos
statement:
theorem eliminationPivotProduct_ne_zero_of_complexCholeskyHistoryWeight_pos

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_of_choleskyHistoryWeight_pos
statement:
theorem frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_of_choleskyHistoryWeight_pos
    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] {Q : Matrix n d ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) (ht : t ≤ Fintype.card d)
    (hw : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight (Q * Qᴴ) t h) :
    frobSq (projectionPivotResidual Q (List.ofFn h)) = ((Fintype.card d - t : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := eliminationPivotProduct_ne_zero_of_choleskyHistoryWeight_pos
    (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose Q) h
    (by rwa [Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose, hQ.rank_eq_card]) hw
  simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using
    frobSq_projectionPivotResidual_eq_card_sub_length hQ (List.ofFn h) hprod

statement:
theorem choleskyPivotProbability_projection_frame_of_history_pos
    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] {Q : Matrix n d ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {t : ℕ} (h : Fin t → n) (ht : t < Fintype.card d)
    (hw : 0 < choleskyHistoryWeight (Q * Qᴴ) t h) (i : n) :
    choleskyPivotProbability (partialCholeskyResidual (Q * Qᴴ) h) i =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((projectionPivotResidual Q (List.ofFn h)).col i)‖ ^ 2 /
        ((Fintype.card d - t : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by

    (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose Q) h
    (by rw [Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose, hQ.rank_eq_card]; exact ht.le) hw
  simpa only [List.length_ofFn, eliminationListResidual_ofFn_eq_partialCholeskyResidual] using
    choleskyPivotProbability_projectionPivotResidual_eq_div_card_sub_length hQ (List.ofFn h)
      hprod (by simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using ht) i

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyFactor_castSucc
statement:
theorem partialCholeskyFactor_castSucc (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {k : ℕ} (s : Fin (k + 1) → n)
    (i : n) (j : Fin k) :
    partialCholeskyFactor A s i j.castSucc = partialCholeskyFactor A (Fin.init s) i j
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyFactor_last
statement:
theorem partialCholeskyFactor_last (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {k : ℕ} (s : Fin (k + 1) → n) (i : n) :
    partialCholeskyFactor A s i (Fin.last k) =
      partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init s) i (s (Fin.last k)) /
        Real.sqrt (partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init s) (s (Fin.last k)) (s (Fin.last k)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.nystrom_selectionMatrix
statement:
theorem nystrom_selectionMatrix {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (s : Fin k → n) :
    nystrom A (selectionMatrix s) =
      A.submatrix id s * moorePenroseInverse (A.submatrix s s) * A.submatrix s id
proof:
:= by
  have h : (selectionMatrix s)ᵀ * A * selectionMatrix s = A.submatrix s s := by
    rw [transpose_selectionMatrix_mul, mul_selectionMatrix]; rfl
  rw [nystrom, mul_selectionMatrix, h, transpose_selectionMatrix_mul]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual
statement:
theorem posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ}
    (s : Fin k → n) : (partialCholeskyResidual A s).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact hA
  | succ k ih => exact posSemidef_eliminationStep (ih _) _

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_sub_partialCholeskyResidual
statement:
theorem posSemidef_sub_partialCholeskyResidual {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ}
    (s : Fin k → n) : (A - partialCholeskyResidual A s).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [partialCholeskyResidual, sub_self] using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero (n := n) (R := ℝ))
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := (ih (Fin.init s)).add
      (Matrix.le_iff.mp (eliminationStep_le (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA (Fin.init s))
        (s (Fin.last k))))
    convert h using 1
    dsimp only [partialCholeskyResidual]
    abel

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyResidual_apply_pivot_left
statement:
theorem partialCholeskyResidual_apply_pivot_left {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ}
    (s : Fin k → n) (j : Fin k) (i : n) : partialCholeskyResidual A s (s j) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing i with
  | zero => exact j.elim0
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [partialCholeskyResidual]
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_left (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA _) _ _
    | cast j =>
      exact eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_row (fun i => ih (Fin.init s) j i) _ _

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyResidual_apply_pivot_right
statement:
theorem partialCholeskyResidual_apply_pivot_right {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {k : ℕ} (s : Fin k → n) (j : Fin k) (i : n) : partialCholeskyResidual A s i (s j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing i with
  | zero => exact j.elim0
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [partialCholeskyResidual]
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right (posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA _) _ _
    | cast j =>
      exact eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_col (fun i => ih (Fin.init s) j i) _ _

name: NLAlib.sub_partialCholeskyFactor_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem sub_partialCholeskyFactor_mul_transpose {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ}
    (s : Fin k → n) :
    A - partialCholeskyFactor A s * (partialCholeskyFactor A s)ᵀ =
      partialCholeskyResidual A s
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => ext i j; simp [partialCholeskyResidual]
  | succ k ih =>
    set R := partialCholeskyResidual A (Fin.init s) with hR
    set t := s (Fin.last k) with ht
    have hRpsd : R.PosSemidef := posSemidef_partialCholeskyResidual hA _
    have hsym : ∀ i j, R i j = R j i := fun i j => by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hRpsd.isHermitian j) i
      simpa using this
    have htt : 0 ≤ R t t := hRpsd.diag_nonneg
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (R t t) * Real.sqrt (R t t) = R t t := Real.mul_self_sqrt htt
    have hih := congrFun₂ (ih (Fin.init s))
    ext i j
    have hij := hih i j
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [partialCholeskyFactor_castSucc, partialCholeskyFactor_last, ← hR, ← ht,
      partialCholeskyResidual, eliminationStep_apply]
    rw [← sub_sub, hij, div_mul_div_comm, hsq, hsym t j]
    ring

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_fromBlocks_choleskySelection
statement:
private theorem posSemidef_fromBlocks_choleskySelection {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {k : ℕ} (s : Fin k → n) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (A.submatrix s s) (A.submatrix s id)
      (A.submatrix s id)ᴴ A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hblock : Matrix.fromBlocks (A.submatrix s s) (A.submatrix s id)
      (A.submatrix s id)ᴴ A = A.submatrix (Sum.elim s id) (Sum.elim s id) := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, hA.isHermitian.eq]
    ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> rfl
  rw [hblock]
  exact hA.submatrix _

name: NLAlib.sub_nystrom_choleskySelection_apply
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_zero_of_fromBlocks_posSemidef
    (posSemidef_fromBlocks_choleskySelection hA s)
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, sub_eq_zero] at h
  have ht := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix,
    hA.isHermitian.eq, (Matrix.IsHermitian.moorePenroseInverse (hA.submatrix s).isHermitian).eq,
    (hA.submatrix s).isHermitian.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc] at ht
  rw [nystrom_selectionMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  exact congrFun₂ ht i j

name: NLAlib.le_sub_nystrom_choleskySelection
proof:
:= by
  have hMe' : ∀ j i, M (s j) i = 0 := fun j i => by
    rw [← hM.isHermitian.apply, hMe, star_zero]
  have h1 : (A - M).submatrix id s = A.submatrix id s := by
    ext i j
    simp [hMe]
  have h2 : (A - M).submatrix s id = A.submatrix s id := by
    ext j i
    simp [hMe']
  have h3 : (A - M).submatrix s s = A.submatrix s s := by
    ext j j'
    simp [hMe]
  have h := posSemidef_sub_nystrom (Matrix.le_iff.mp hMA) (selectionMatrix s)
  rw [nystrom_selectionMatrix, h1, h2, h3] at h
  rw [Matrix.le_iff, nystrom_selectionMatrix]
  have heq : A - A.submatrix id s * moorePenroseInverse (A.submatrix s s) *
      A.submatrix s id - M =
      A - M - A.submatrix id s * moorePenroseInverse (A.submatrix s s) * A.submatrix s id := by
    abel
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyResidual_eq_sub_nystrom_selection
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ {k : ℕ} (s : Fin k → n), A - nystrom A (selectionMatrix s) ≤ A := by
    intro k s
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, sub_sub_cancel]
    exact posSemidef_nystrom hA _
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    ext i j
    simp [partialCholeskyResidual, nystrom]
  | succ k ih =>
    dsimp only [partialCholeskyResidual]
    rw [ih]
    have hR := posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA (selectionMatrix (Fin.init s))
    have hR' := posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA (selectionMatrix s)
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine le_sub_nystrom_choleskySelection (posSemidef_eliminationStep hR _) s
        ((eliminationStep_le hR _).trans (hle _)) ?_
      intro i j
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => exact eliminationStep_apply_pivot_right hR _ i
      | cast j =>
        exact eliminationStep_apply_eq_zero_of_col
          (fun i => sub_nystrom_choleskySelection_apply hA (Fin.init s) i j) _ i
    · rw [eliminationStep_eq_sub_nystrom]
      change A - nystrom A (selectionMatrix s) ≤
        (A - nystrom A (selectionMatrix (Fin.init s))) -
          nystrom (A - nystrom A (selectionMatrix (Fin.init s)))
            (selectionMatrix (fun _ : Fin 1 => s (Fin.last k)))
      refine le_sub_nystrom_choleskySelection hR' (fun _ : Fin 1 => s (Fin.last k)) ?_
        (fun i _ => sub_nystrom_choleskySelection_apply hA s i (Fin.last k))
      exact le_sub_nystrom_choleskySelection hR' (Fin.init s) (hle s)
        (fun i j => sub_nystrom_choleskySelection_apply hA s i j.castSucc)

name: NLAlib.partialCholeskyFactor_mul_transpose_eq_nystrom

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_pow_le_dotProduct_pow_mulVec
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_pow_le_dotProduct_pow_mulVec {M : Matrix m m ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef)
    {y : m → ℝ} (hy : y ⬝ᵥ y ≤ 1) {s : ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (y ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ y)) ^ s ≤ y ⬝ᵥ ((M ^ s) *ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  have hH := hM.isHermitian
  set ev := hH.eigenvalues with hev
  set w : m → ℝ := fun i => (⇑(hH.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ y) ^ 2 with hw
  have hev0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ev i := hM.eigenvalues_nonneg
  have hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := fun i => sq_nonneg _
  have h1 : y ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ y) = ∑ i, w i * ev i := by
    have h := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hH X y
    simp only [aeval_X, eval_X] at h
    rw [h]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  have h2 : y ⬝ᵥ ((M ^ s) *ᵥ y) = ∑ i, w i * ev i ^ s := by
    have h := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hH (X ^ s) y
    simp only [map_pow, aeval_X, eval_pow, eval_X] at h
    rw [h]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  have hc : ∑ i, w i = y ⬝ᵥ y := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hH y
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, w i * ev i ^ s :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (pow_nonneg (hev0 i) s)
  rw [h1, h2]
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c, c = ∑ i, w i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := by rw [hcdef, hc]; exact hy
  rcases (by rw [hcdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hw0 i : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c).eq_or_lt
    with hc0 | hcpos
  · have hwz : ∀ i, w i = 0 := fun i =>
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ => hw0 j).1 (hcdef ▸ hc0.symm) i
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp only [hwz, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    rw [zero_pow (by omega)]
  · have hJ := Real.pow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean_pow Finset.univ (fun i => w i / c) ev
      (fun i _ => div_nonneg (hw0 i) hcpos.le)
      (by rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hcdef, div_self hcpos.ne']) (fun i _ => hev0 i) s
    have hL : ∑ i, w i * ev i = c * ∑ i, w i / c * ev i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by field_simp
    have hR : ∑ i, w i / c * ev i ^ s = c⁻¹ * ∑ i, w i * ev i ^ s := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by field_simp
    rw [hR] at hJ
    rw [hL, mul_pow]
    calc c ^ s * (∑ i, w i / c * ev i) ^ s ≤ c ^ s * (c⁻¹ * ∑ i, w i * ev i ^ s) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ (pow_nonneg hcpos.le s)
      _ = c ^ (s - 1) * ∑ i, w i * ev i ^ s := by
          rw [← mul_assoc]
          congr 1
          rw [← pow_sub_one_mul (by omega : s ≠ 0)]
          field_simp
      _ ≤ 1 * ∑ i, w i * ev i ^ s :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_one₀ hcpos.le hc1) hR0
      _ = _ := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_mul_pow_le_specNorm_mul_gram_pow_mul
statement:
theorem specNorm_mul_pow_le_specNorm_mul_gram_pow_mul (P : Matrix m m ℝ) (hPs : Pᵀ = P)
    (hPi : IsIdempotentElem P) (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    specNorm (P * A) ^ (2 * q + 1) ≤ specNorm (P * (A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A)
proof:
:= by
  set M := A * Aᵀ with hMdef
  set s := 2 * q + 1 with hs
  have hMs : Mᵀ = M := by rw [hMdef, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have hMpsd : M.PosSemidef := by
    rw [hMdef, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose A
  
  have hH : (P * A) * (P * A)ᵀ = P * M * P := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hPs, hMdef]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hHs : (P * M ^ q * A) * (P * M ^ q * A)ᵀ = P * M ^ s * P := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, hPs, Matrix.transpose_pow, hMs]
    have : M ^ s = M ^ q * M * M ^ q := by
      rw [hs, ← pow_succ, ← pow_add]; ring_nf
    rw [this, hMdef]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hA2 : specNorm (P * A) ^ 2 = specNorm (P * M * P) := by
    rw [← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hH]
  have hB2 : specNorm (P * M ^ q * A) ^ 2 = specNorm (P * M ^ s * P) := by
    rw [← specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hHs]
  
  have hkey : specNorm (P * M * P) ^ s ≤ specNorm (P * M ^ s * P) := by
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with hm | hm
    · have : P * M * P = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [this, specNorm_zero, zero_pow (by omega)]
      exact specNorm_nonneg _
    · have hHpsd : (P * M * P).PosSemidef := by
        rw [← hH, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
        exact Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose _
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := exists_unit_mulVec_eq_specNorm_smul hHpsd
      have hval : x ⬝ᵥ ((P * M * P) *ᵥ x) = specNorm (P * M * P) := by
        rw [hxe, dotProduct_smul, hx, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      
      have hsand : ∀ B : Matrix m m ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ ((P * B * P) *ᵥ x) = (P *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (P *ᵥ x)) := by
        intro B
        rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
          ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hPs]
      have hy : (P *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ x) ≤ 1 := by
        have hPx := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self P x
        simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hPx
        rw [hPx, hPs, show P * P = P from hPi]
        have h := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm P x
        rw [hx, mul_one] at h
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h.trans
          (Matrix.IsHermitian.specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem hPs hPi))
      have hJ := dotProduct_mulVec_pow_le_dotProduct_pow_mulVec hMpsd hy (by omega : 1 ≤ s)
      rw [← hsand, ← hsand, hval] at hJ
      refine hJ.trans ?_
      have h := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (P * M ^ s * P) x
      rw [hx, mul_one] at h
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans h
  have hfin : (specNorm (P * A) ^ s) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm (P * M ^ q * A) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hA2, hB2]; exact hkey
  have := (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) s) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    two_ne_zero).1 hfin
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc] using this

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_pow_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_pow_le {q' : Type*} [Fintype q'] [DecidableEq q']
    {Q : Matrix m q' ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ (2 * q + 1) ≤ specNorm (projResidual Q ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A))
proof:
:= by
  have hPs : (1 - Q * Qᵀ)ᵀ = 1 - Q * Qᵀ := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  have h := specNorm_mul_pow_le_specNorm_mul_gram_pow_mul (1 - Q * Qᵀ) hPs
    (one_sub_mul_conjTranspose_idem hQ) A q
  rwa [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, residual_eq_one_sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_le_rpow
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_le_rpow {q' : Type*} [Fintype q'] [DecidableEq q']
    {Q : Matrix m q' ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ≤
      specNorm (projResidual Q ((A * Aᵀ) ^ q * A)) ^ (1 / (2 * (q : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := specNorm_residual_pow_le hQ A q
  have hne : 2 * q + 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hcast : (1 / (2 * (q : ℝ) + 1)) = ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast, ← Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (specNorm_nonneg (projResidual Q A)) hne]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _) h
    (inv_nonneg.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.rank_rangeProjector_sampled_mul_le
statement:
theorem rank_rangeProjector_sampled_mul_le (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    (G : Matrix (Fin n) k 𝕜) :
    (rangeProjector (A * G) * A).rank ≤ Fintype.card k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (rangeProjector (A * G) * A).rank ≤ (rangeProjector (A * G)).rank :=
      Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _
    _ = (A * G).rank := rank_rangeProjector _
    _ ≤ Fintype.card k := Matrix.rank_le_card_width _

:= by

      (measurable_const.matrix_mul (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp hS))).matrix_mul
