name: NLAlib.IsObliviousSubspaceInjection.measureReal_frobSq_osi_rangeResidual_le
statement:
theorem IsObliviousSubspaceInjection.measureReal_frobSq_osi_rangeResidual_le
    {S : Ω → Matrix k (Fin n) 𝕜} {α : ℝ} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : IsObliviousSubspaceInjection S d α μ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (hd : d ≤ n) :
    9 / 10 ≤ μ.real {ω | frobSq (A - rangeProjector (A * (S ω)ᴴ) * A) ≤
      (1 + 20 / α) * bestRankFrobSq A d}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, htail⟩ :=
    exists_svd_right_blocks A d hd
  have hc := h.measureReal_osiCrossSuccessEvent_ge hα V₁ hV₁ V₂ hV₂ S₂
  refine hc.trans (measureReal_mono ?_)
  intro ω hω
  change ((S ω * V₁)ᴴ).rank = d ∧
    frobSq (S₂ * (S ω * V₂)ᴴ * moorePenroseInverse ((S ω * V₁)ᴴ)) ≤
      (20 / α) * frobSq S₂ at hω
  change frobSq (A - rangeProjector (A * (S ω)ᴴ) * A) ≤ _
  let G₁ := (S ω * V₁)ᴴ
  let G₂ := (S ω * V₂)ᴴ
  have hG₁ : G₁ = V₁ᴴ * (S ω)ᴴ := Matrix.conjTranspose_mul _ _
  have hG₂ : G₂ = V₂ᴴ * (S ω)ᴴ := Matrix.conjTranspose_mul _ _
  have hu : IsUnit (G₁ * G₁ᴴ) := isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card G₁
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hω.1)
  have hb := frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_svd_blocks
    hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hG₁ hG₂ hu
  rw [← moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR G₁ hu] at hb
  calc
    frobSq (A - rangeProjector (A * (S ω)ᴴ) * A) ≤
        frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * G₂ * moorePenroseInverse G₁) := hb
    _ ≤ frobSq S₂ + (20 / α) * frobSq S₂ := add_le_add (le_refl _) hω.2
    _ = (1 + 20 / α) * bestRankFrobSq A d := by rw [htail]; ring

name: NLAlib.columnInterpolationCoefficients_spec_of_maximum_volume
statement:
theorem columnInterpolationCoefficients_spec_of_maximum_volume {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) (e : Fin k ↪ n)
    (hpos : 0 < ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det)
    (hmax : ∀ f : Fin k → n, ((A.submatrix id f)ᵀ * A.submatrix id f).det ≤
      ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det) :
    (columnInterpolationCoefficients A e).submatrix id e = 1 ∧
      (∀ i j, |columnInterpolationCoefficients A e i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      specNorm (A - A.submatrix id e * columnInterpolationCoefficients A e) ≤
        Real.sqrt (1 + (k : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k)) * singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨π, Q, R, T₀, D, hπ, hQ, _, hR, _, hFact, hEntry, hBudget⟩ :=
    exists_maximum_volume_qr_blocks_of_embedding A k hk e hpos hmax
  let C := A.submatrix id e
  let T := columnInterpolationCoefficients A e
  have hSel : C = Q * Matrix.fromRows R 0 := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hFact i) (Sum.inl j)
    simpa [C, hπ, Matrix.mul_apply] using h
  have hCQ : Cᵀ * Q = Matrix.fromCols Rᵀ 0 := by
    rw [hSel, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.transpose_fromRows, Matrix.transpose_zero]
  have hGram : Cᵀ * C = Rᵀ * R := by
    calc
      _ = Cᵀ * (Q * Matrix.fromRows R 0) := congrArg (fun X => Cᵀ * X) hSel
      _ = (Cᵀ * Q) * Matrix.fromRows R 0 := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hCQ, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hNormal : Cᵀ * A.submatrix id π = (Cᵀ * C) * Matrix.fromCols 1 T₀ := by
    rw [hFact, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hCQ, Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromBlocks,
      hGram, Matrix.mul_fromCols]
    simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hT : T.submatrix id π = Matrix.fromCols 1 T₀ := by
    change (((Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ * Cᵀ) * A).submatrix id π = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    change (Cᵀ * C)⁻¹ * (Cᵀ * A.submatrix id π) = _
    rw [hNormal, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpos.ne'), Matrix.one_mul]
  have hProd : (C * T).submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks R (R * T₀) 0 0 := by
    have heq : (C * T).submatrix id π = C * T.submatrix id π := by ext i j; rfl
    rw [heq, hSel, hT, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.zero_mul]
  have hErr : (A - C * T).submatrix id π = Q * Matrix.fromBlocks 0 0 0 D := by
    change A.submatrix id π - (C * T).submatrix id π = _
    rw [hFact, hProd, ← Matrix.mul_sub]
    congr 1
    ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> simp
  have hBlock : specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
      (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ) 0 D) ≤ specNorm D := by
    have hrow := specNorm_fromRows_sq_le
      (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ)
      (Matrix.fromCols (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin k) ℝ) D)
    have hcol := specNorm_fromCols_sq_le
      (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin k) ℝ) D
    simp only [specNorm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_add] at hrow hcol
    have heq : Matrix.fromRows
        (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ)
        (Matrix.fromCols (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card m - k)) (Fin k) ℝ) D) =
        Matrix.fromBlocks 0 0 0 D := by ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> rfl
    rw [heq] at hrow
    nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg D, specNorm_nonneg
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
        (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (Fintype.card n - k)) ℝ) 0 D)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M => M i (Sum.inl j)) hT
    simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, hπ, Matrix.fromCols_apply_inl] using h
  · intro i j
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := π.surjective j
    cases j' with
    | inl j' =>
      have h := congrArg (fun M => M i (Sum.inl j')) hT
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Matrix.fromCols_apply_inl] at h
      change |T i (π (Sum.inl j'))| ≤ 1
      rw [h]
      simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    | inr j' =>
      have h := congrArg (fun M => M i (Sum.inr j')) hT
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq, Matrix.fromCols_apply_inr] at h
      change |T i (π (Sum.inr j'))| ≤ 1
      rw [h]
      exact hEntry i j'
  · have hReindex := specNorm_reindex (A - C * T) (Equiv.refl m) π.symm
    change specNorm ((A - C * T).submatrix id π) = _ at hReindex
    change specNorm (A - C * T) ≤ _
    rw [← hReindex, hErr, specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ]
    apply hBlock.trans
    have hkn : k ≤ Fintype.card n := hk.trans A.rank_le_card_width
    have hb : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k) :=
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (sub_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkn))
    have h := singularValues_trailing_le_sqrt_budget_mul R T₀ D hR
      ((k : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k)) hb hBudget 0
    have hSpec := congrFun (singularValues_reindex A (Equiv.refl m) π.symm) k
    change singularValues (A.submatrix id π) k = _ at hSpec
    rw [hFact, singularValues_isometry_mul hQ] at hSpec
    rw [Nat.add_zero, hSpec, singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_interpolative_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_interpolative_decomposition {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ n, ∃ T : Matrix (Fin k) n ℝ,
      T.submatrix id e = 1 ∧ (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧
      specNorm (A - A.submatrix id e * T) ≤
        Real.sqrt (1 + (k : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) - k)) * singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hpos, hmax⟩ := exists_maximum_volume_column_embedding A k hk
  exact ⟨e, columnInterpolationCoefficients A e,
    columnInterpolationCoefficients_spec_of_maximum_volume A k hk e hpos hmax⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_exact_interpolative_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_exact_interpolative_decomposition {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∃ e : Fin A.rank ↪ n, ∃ T : Matrix (Fin A.rank) n ℝ,
      T.submatrix id e = 1 ∧ (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧ A = A.submatrix id e * T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, T, hId, hEntry, hErr⟩ := exists_interpolative_decomposition A A.rank le_rfl
  rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A le_rfl, mul_zero] at hErr
  have hzero : specNorm (A - A.submatrix id e * T) = 0 :=
    le_antisymm hErr (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have hEq : A - A.submatrix id e * T = 0 := by
    open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_eq_zero.mp
      (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hzero)
  exact ⟨e, T, hId, hEntry, sub_eq_zero.mp hEq⟩

name: NLAlib.mul_eq_mul_add_mul_of_eq_add
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc (U₁ * S₁), Matrix.mul_assoc (U₂ * S₂)]

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᴴ + U₂ * S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ := by
    rw [mul_eq_mul_add_mul_of_eq_add hA Ω, ← hΩ₁, ← hΩ₂, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc (U₁ * S₁) Ω₁, mul_pinvR hunit, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hZ, hA, Matrix.mul_sub]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq
proof:
:= by
  have horth : frobInner (S₂ * V₂ᴴ) (S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) = 0 := by
    rw [← frobInner_conjTranspose]
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact frobInner_mul_mul_eq_zero _ _ _ _ (conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_comm.1 hV)
  rw [sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq hA hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit,
    frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hU₂.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    frobSq_sub_of_frobInner_eq_zero _ _ horth,
    frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV₂.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    frobSq_mul_right_of_orthonormal hV₁.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.mul_transpose_mul_competitor
proof:
:= by
  have : A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ = A * Ω * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
  rw [this, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q, hQ]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_le_of_range_subset
proof:
:= by
  calc frobSq (projResidual Q A)
      ≤ frobSq (A - Q * (Qᴴ * (A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ))) :=
        frobSq_residual_le_frobSq_sub_mul hQo A _
    _ = frobSq (A - A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) := by rw [mul_transpose_mul_competitor hQ]
    _ = frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁) :=
        frobSq_sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_svd_blocks
proof:
:= by
  let C := A * Ω * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ)
  have hfix : rangeProjector (A * Ω) * C = C := by
    change rangeProjector (A * Ω) * ((A * Ω) * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ)) = _
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, rangeProjector_mul]
  have he : A - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * A =
      (A - C) - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * (A - C) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hfix]
    abel
  calc
    frobSq (A - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * A) =
        frobSq ((A - C) - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * (A - C)) := congrArg frobSq he
    _ ≤ frobSq (A - C) := frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le _ _
    _ = frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁) := by
      change frobSq (A - (A * Ω) * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ)) = _
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      exact frobSq_sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_svd_blocks
proof:
:= by
  let C := A * Ω * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ)
  have hfix : rangeProjector (A * Ω) * C = C := by
    change rangeProjector (A * Ω) * ((A * Ω) * (pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ)) = _
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, rangeProjector_mul]
  have he : A - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * A =
      (A - C) - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * (A - C) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hfix]
    abel
  have hc : A - C = U₂ * (S₂ * V₂ᴴ - S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) := by
    dsimp only [C]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    exact sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq hA hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit
  calc
    specNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * A) =
        specNorm ((A - C) - rangeProjector (A * Ω) * (A - C)) := congrArg specNorm he
    _ ≤ specNorm (A - C) := specNorm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le _ _
    _ = specNorm (S₂ * V₂ᴴ - S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) := by
      rw [hc, specNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU₂.conjTranspose_mul_self]
    _ ≤ specNorm (S₂ * V₂ᴴ) + specNorm (S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) := specNorm_sub_le _ _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV₂.conjTranspose_mul_self,
        specNorm_mul_conjTranspose_right_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV₁.conjTranspose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_mul_le_of_isBestFrobRankApprox_of_range_subset
proof:
:= by
  have hZrank : (Qᴴ * (A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ)).rank ≤ k :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans <| (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _).trans
      ((Matrix.rank_le_card_height _).trans (Fintype.card_fin k).le)
  calc frobSq (A - Q * Y) ≤ frobSq (A - Q * (Qᴴ * (A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ))) :=
        frobSq_sub_mul_le_of_isBestFrobRankApprox hQo hY _ hZrank
    _ = frobSq (A - A * Ω * pinvR Ω₁ * V₁ᴴ) := by rw [mul_transpose_mul_competitor hQ]
    _ = frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * Ω₂ * pinvR Ω₁) :=
        frobSq_sub_mul_pinvR_mul_conjTranspose_eq hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hΩ₁ hΩ₂ hunit

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_sq_le_sum_Ico_sq
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sq_le_sum_Ico_sq (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (hσ : Antitone σ) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ σ j)
    {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ ℓ) : ((ℓ : ℝ) - k) * σ ℓ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k ℓ, σ j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ _j ∈ Finset.Ico k ℓ, σ ℓ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k ℓ, σ j ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    have hjℓ : j ≤ ℓ := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hj).2.le
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hpos ℓ) (hσ hjℓ) 2
  rwa [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub hk] at h1

name: NLAlib.sq_le_sum_Ico_sq_div
statement:
theorem sq_le_sum_Ico_sq_div (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (hσ : Antitone σ) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ σ j) {k ℓ : ℕ}
    (hk : k < ℓ) : σ ℓ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k ℓ, σ j ^ 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - k)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos' : (0 : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) - k := by
    have : (k : ℝ) < ℓ := by exact_mod_cast hk
    linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos', mul_comm]
  exact sub_mul_sq_le_sum_Ico_sq σ hσ hpos hk.le

name: NLAlib.sq_le_four_div_mul_sum_Ico_sq
statement:
theorem sq_le_four_div_mul_sum_Ico_sq (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (hσ : Antitone σ) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ σ j)
    {k ℓ t N : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (hℓ : ℓ = (t + 1) / 2) (hk : 4 * k ≤ t) (hN : ℓ ≤ N) :
    σ ℓ ^ 2 ≤ (4 / t) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k N, σ j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlk : (t : ℝ) / 4 ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) - k := by
    have h1 : t ≤ 2 * ℓ := by omega
    have h1' : (t : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ℓ := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have h2 : (4 * k : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hk
    linarith
  have ht' : (0 : ℝ) < t := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have hkℓ : k ≤ ℓ := by omega
  have hmono : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k ℓ, σ j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k N, σ j ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.Ico_subset_Ico_right hN)
      (fun j _ _ => sq_nonneg (σ j))
  have h1 := (sub_mul_sq_le_sum_Ico_sq σ hσ hpos hkℓ).trans hmono
  have h2 : (t : ℝ) / 4 * σ ℓ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k N, σ j ^ 2 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlk (sq_nonneg _)).trans h1
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ ht']
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sq_singularValues_le_four_div_mul_sum_Ico_sq
statement:
theorem sq_singularValues_le_four_div_mul_sum_Ico_sq {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜)
    {k ℓ t N : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (hℓ : ℓ = (t + 1) / 2) (hk : 4 * k ≤ t) (hN : ℓ ≤ N) :
    singularValues A ℓ ^ 2 ≤ (4 / t) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico k N, singularValues A j ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sq_le_four_div_mul_sum_Ico_sq _ (singularValues_antitone A) (singularValues_nonneg A) ht hℓ
    hk hN

name: NLAlib.mem_columnSelectionList
statement: theorem mem_columnSelectionList {n k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin n) : f ∈ columnSelectionList n k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have he : f = Fin.elim0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [columnSelectionList, List.mem_singleton]
    exact he
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [columnSelectionList, List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨f 0, by simp, ?_⟩
    rw [List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨Fin.tail f, ih _, Fin.cons_self_tail f⟩

name: NLAlib.mem_columnEmbeddingList
statement: theorem mem_columnEmbeddingList {n k : ℕ} (e : Fin k ↪ Fin n) : e ∈ columnEmbeddingList n k
proof:
:= by
  rw [columnEmbeddingList, List.mem_filterMap]
  refine ⟨e, mem_columnSelectionList e, ?_⟩
  rw [dif_pos e.injective]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.maximumVolumeColumnSearch_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem maximumVolumeColumnSearch_eq_foldl {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    maximumVolumeColumnSearch A k = (columnEmbeddingList n k).foldl
      (fun acc e => match acc with
        | none => some e
        | some c => if ((A.submatrix id c)ᵀ * A.submatrix id c).det <
            ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det then some e else some c) none
proof:
:= by
  unfold maximumVolumeColumnSearch List.argmax
  apply congrArg (fun step => (columnEmbeddingList n k).foldl step none)
  funext acc e
  cases acc <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.maximumVolumeColumnSearch_spec
statement:
theorem maximumVolumeColumnSearch_spec {m n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ Fin n, maximumVolumeColumnSearch A k = some e ∧
      0 < ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det ∧
      ∀ f : Fin k → Fin n, ((A.submatrix id f)ᵀ * A.submatrix id f).det ≤
        ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e₀, hpos₀⟩ := exists_column_embedding_gram_det_pos A k hk
  have hlist : columnEmbeddingList n k ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_mem (mem_columnEmbeddingList e₀)
  have hsome : maximumVolumeColumnSearch A k ≠ none := by
    intro h
    apply hlist
    exact List.argmax_eq_none.mp h
  cases hs : maximumVolumeColumnSearch A k with
  | none => exact (hsome hs).elim
  | some e =>
    have he : e ∈ (columnEmbeddingList n k).argmax
        (fun e : Fin k ↪ Fin n => ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det) := hs
    have hmax (g : Fin k ↪ Fin n) : ((A.submatrix id g)ᵀ * A.submatrix id g).det ≤
        ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det :=
      List.le_of_mem_argmax (f := fun e : Fin k ↪ Fin n =>
        ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det) (mem_columnEmbeddingList g) he
    have hpos := hpos₀.trans_le (hmax e₀)
    refine ⟨e, rfl, hpos, ?_⟩
    intro f
    by_cases hf : Function.Injective f
    · exact hmax ⟨f, hf⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.mp hf
      have hzero : ((A.submatrix id f)ᵀ * A.submatrix id f).det = 0 := by
        apply Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq hne
        intro a
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
        rw [hij]
      rw [hzero]
      exact hpos.le

name: NLAlib.maximumVolumeColumnSearch_tie_first
statement:
theorem maximumVolumeColumnSearch_tie_first {m n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {e : Fin k ↪ Fin n} (he : maximumVolumeColumnSearch A k = some e) (g : Fin k ↪ Fin n)
    (hvol : ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e).det ≤
      ((A.submatrix id g)ᵀ * A.submatrix id g).det) :
    (columnEmbeddingList n k).idxOf e ≤ (columnEmbeddingList n k).idxOf g
proof:
:=
  List.index_of_argmax he (mem_columnEmbeddingList g) hvol

name: NLAlib.interpolativeDecompositionSearch_spec
statement:
theorem interpolativeDecompositionSearch_spec {m n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hk : k ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ e : Fin k ↪ Fin n, ∃ T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ,
      interpolativeDecompositionSearch A k = some (e, T) ∧
      T = columnInterpolationCoefficients A e ∧
      IsUnit ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e) ∧
      LinearIndependent ℝ (A.submatrix id e).col ∧
      T.submatrix id e = 1 ∧ (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 2) ∧
      specNorm (A - A.submatrix id e * T) ≤
        Real.sqrt (1 + (k : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - k)) * singularValues A k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hpos, hmax⟩ := maximumVolumeColumnSearch_spec A hk
  obtain ⟨hId, hEntry, hErr⟩ := columnInterpolationCoefficients_spec_of_maximum_volume A k hk e hpos hmax
  have hunit : IsUnit ((A.submatrix id e)ᵀ * A.submatrix id e) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpos.ne')
  have hcols : LinearIndependent ℝ (A.submatrix id e).col := by
    apply linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.mpr
    rw [Set.finrank, ← Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols]
    exact ((Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self _).symm.trans (Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hunit)).symm
  refine ⟨e, columnInterpolationCoefficients A e, ?_, rfl, hunit, hcols, hId, hEntry,
    (fun i j => (hEntry i j).trans (by norm_num)), ?_⟩
  · simp only [interpolativeDecompositionSearch, he, Option.map_some]
  · simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hErr

name: NLAlib.interpolativeDecompositionSearch_exact
statement:
theorem interpolativeDecompositionSearch_exact {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∃ e : Fin A.rank ↪ Fin n, ∃ T : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin n) ℝ,
      interpolativeDecompositionSearch A A.rank = some (e, T) ∧
      T.submatrix id e = 1 ∧ (∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ 1) ∧ A = A.submatrix id e * T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, T, hret, _, _, _, hId, hEntry, _, hErr⟩ := interpolativeDecompositionSearch_spec A le_rfl
  rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le A le_rfl, mul_zero] at hErr
  have hz : specNorm (A - A.submatrix id e * T) = 0 := le_antisymm hErr (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have heq : A - A.submatrix id e * T = 0 := by
    open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hz)
  exact ⟨e, T, hret, hId, hEntry, sub_eq_zero.mp heq⟩

name: NLAlib.ae_isUnit_block
statement:
theorem ae_isUnit_block {n k t : ℕ} {Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1) (hkt : k ≤ t) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlaw := hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ hV₁
  have h := gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose (k := k) hkt
  rw [← hlaw.map_eq] at h
  exact ae_of_ae_map hlaw.aemeasurable h

name: NLAlib.integrable_pinvR_block
statement:
theorem integrable_pinvR_block {n k t : ℕ} {Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix_of_hasLaw
    (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΩ V₁ hV₁) hkt).1

name: NLAlib.integral_pinvR_block
statement:
theorem integral_pinvR_block {n k t : ℕ} {Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ}
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) (V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hV₁ : V₁ᵀ * V₁ = 1) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ = (k : ℝ) / ((t : ℝ) - k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_frobSq_pinvR_block hΩ V₁ hV₁,
    (integrable_and_integral_frobSq_pinvR_gaussianMatrix hkt).2]

name: NLAlib.rsvd_gaussian_inputs
statement:
theorem rsvd_gaussian_inputs {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} (S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ) :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ)) ∧
    (∫ ω, frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ
      = (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) * frobSq S₂) ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ae_isUnit_block hΩ V₁ hV₁ (by omega), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := integral_frobSq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block hΩ V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV S₂
    rw [integral_pinvR_block hΩ V₁ hV₁ hkt] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_comm _ _)
  · exact integrable_frobSq_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block hΩ V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV S₂
      (integrable_pinvR_block hΩ V₁ hV₁ hkt)

name: NLAlib.rsvd_bound_nonneg
statement:
theorem rsvd_bound_nonneg {k t : ℕ} (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ} :
    0 ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂
proof:
:= by
  have : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hkt
  have h : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) (by linarith)
  exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (frobSq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.rsvd_main_gaussian
statement:
theorem rsvd_main_gaussian
    {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix m q ℝ)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A)) ∂μ ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hunit, hinv, hZi⟩ := rsvd_gaussian_inputs S₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt Ω hΩ
  by_cases hXi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A))) μ
  · exact rsvd_main hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt Ω Q hQo hQr hunit hinv hXi hZi
  · rw [integral_undef hXi]; exact rsvd_bound_nonneg hkt

name: NLAlib.rsvd_truncated_main_gaussian
statement:
theorem rsvd_truncated_main_gaussian
    {A : Matrix m (Fin n) ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin r) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r') ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (Q : Ωs → Matrix m q ℝ) (Y : Ωs → Matrix q (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω)
    (hY : ∀ ω, IsBestFrobRankApprox ((Q ω)ᵀ * A) k (Y ω)) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - Q ω * Y ω) ∂μ ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hunit, hinv, hZi⟩ := rsvd_gaussian_inputs S₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt Ω hΩ
  by_cases hXi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - Q ω * Y ω)) μ
  · exact rsvd_truncated_main hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt Ω Q Y hQo hQr hY hunit hinv hXi hZi
  · rw [integral_undef hXi]; exact rsvd_bound_nonneg hkt

name: NLAlib.completion_gaussian_inputs
statement:
theorem completion_gaussian_inputs [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m s q rp : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin rp) ℝ) (hQ : Qᵀ * Q = 1)
    (hQp : Qpᵀ * Qp = 1) (hQQp : Qᵀ * Qp = 0) (B : Matrix (Fin rp) ι ℝ) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s) :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q))) ∧
    (∫ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) ∂μ = (q : ℝ) / ((s : ℝ) - q - 1)) ∧
    Integrable
      (fun ω => frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * B)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * B) =
      frobSq (Bᵀ * (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)) := by
    intro ω
    rw [← frobSq_transpose]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, pinvL_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h2 : ∀ ω, frobSq (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) =
      frobSq (pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)) := by
    intro ω
    rw [← frobSq_transpose, pinvL_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [ae_isUnit_block hΨ Q hQ (by omega)] with ω h
    have hg := gram_conjTranspose_mul_eq (Ψ ω) Q
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hg
    rwa [hg]
  · simp_rw [h2]
    exact integral_pinvR_block hΨ Q hQ hqs
  · simp_rw [h1]
    exact integrable_frobSq_mul_gaussian_mul_of_indepFun
      (X := fun ω => Qᵀ * Ψ ω)
      (Y := fun ω => Qpᵀ * Ψ ω)
      ((measurable_block Q).comp_aemeasurable hΨ.aemeasurable)
      (hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΨ Qp hQp)
      (gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp)
      Bᵀ (T := fun x => pinvR x) measurable_pinvR_entry
      (integrable_pinvR_block hΨ Q hQ hqs)

name: NLAlib.completion_reduction_gaussian_integrable
statement:
theorem completion_reduction_gaussian_integrable [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m s q r : ℕ}
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) n ℝ)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s)
    (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q (Ψ ω) A)) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      = (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have hQQp : Qᵀ * Qp = 0 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_of_completion hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self hQp.conjTranspose_mul_self
      hcomp
  obtain ⟨hG₁, hG₁m, hGi⟩ :=
    completion_gaussian_inputs hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A) hqs
  have hG₂ := integral_frobSq_pinvL_block_mul_block_mul hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp (Qpᵀ * projResidual Q A)
  refine ⟨?_, completion_reduction Q Qp A hQ hQp hcomp hq hqs Ψ hG₁ hG₂ hG₁m hGi⟩
  refine ((integrable_const (frobSq (projResidual Q A))).add hGi).congr ?_
  filter_upwards [hG₁] with ω h
  exact (frobSq_error Q Qp (Ψ ω) A hQ hcomp h).symm

name: NLAlib.completion_reduction_gaussian
statement:
theorem completion_reduction_gaussian [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m s q r : ℕ}
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) n ℝ)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s)
    (Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q (Ψ ω) A) ∂μ
      = (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:=
  (completion_reduction_gaussian_integrable Q Qp A hQ hQp hcomp hq hqs Ψ hΨ).2

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput
statement:
theorem measurable_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput {γ m ι s q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace γ]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype ι] [Fintype s] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m ι ℝ)
    {Qf : γ → Matrix m q ℝ} {Ψf : γ → Matrix m s ℝ} (hQ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => Qf z i j)
    (hΨ : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => Ψf z i j) :
    Measurable fun z => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput (Qf z) (Ψf z) A)
proof:
:= by
  have hΨt : ∀ i j, Measurable fun z => (Ψf z)ᵀ i j := fun i j => hΨ j i
  have hA : ∀ i j, Measurable fun _ : γ => A i j := fun _ _ => measurable_const
  have hG := measurable_mul_entry_of hΨt hQ
  have hP := measurable_pinvL_entry_of hG
  have hB := measurable_mul_entry_of hΨt hA
  have hC := measurable_mul_entry_of hP hB
  have hD := measurable_mul_entry_of hQ hC
  refine measurable_frobSq_of_entries fun i j => ?_
  simp only [sketchedOutput, sketchedCore, Matrix.sub_apply]
  exact measurable_const.sub (hD i j)

name: NLAlib.completion_gaussian_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem completion_gaussian_of_orthonormal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) ι ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s) :
    Integrable (fun y => frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q y A)) (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) ∧
    ∫ y, frobSq (A - sketchedOutput Q y A) ∂gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)
      = (1 + (q : ℝ) / (s - q - 1)) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Qp, hQp, hcomp⟩ := exists_unitary_complement Q hQ
  exact completion_reduction_gaussian_integrable (μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) Q Qp A hQ hQp
    hcomp hq hqs (fun y => y) HasLaw.id

name: NLAlib.Assembly.completion_factor_mono
statement:
theorem completion_factor_mono {q k s : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqk : q ≤ k) (hks : k < s - 1) :
    q / (s - q - 1) ≤ k / (s - k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.Assembly.rsvd_assembly
statement:
theorem rsvd_assembly [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Zsq : Ω → ℝ} {OPTsq c : ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ ω, X ω ≤ OPTsq + Zsq ω) (hZ : ∫ ω, Zsq ω ∂μ = c * OPTsq)
    (hXi : Integrable X μ) (hZi : Integrable Zsq μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 + c) * OPTsq
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, (OPTsq + Zsq ω) ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hXi ((integrable_const _).add hZi) hX
    _ = OPTsq + c * OPTsq := by
        rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hZi, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, hZ]
    _ = (1 + c) * OPTsq := by ring

name: NLAlib.Assembly.rsvd_explicit
statement:
theorem rsvd_explicit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Zsq : Ω → ℝ} {OPTsq k t : ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ ω, X ω ≤ OPTsq + Zsq ω) (hZ : ∫ ω, Zsq ω ∂μ = k / (t - k - 1) * OPTsq)
    (hXi : Integrable X μ) (hZi : Integrable Zsq μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 + k / (t - k - 1)) * OPTsq
proof:
:=
  rsvd_assembly hX hZ hXi hZi

name: NLAlib.Assembly.gn_assembly
statement:
theorem gn_assembly {X Y cfac : Ω → ℝ} {cmax B : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hcmax : 0 ≤ cmax)
    (hc : ∀ ω, cfac ω ≤ cmax) (hcond : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, cfac ω * Y ω ∂μ)
    (hYbound : ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ ≤ B)
    (hcYi : Integrable (fun ω => cfac ω * Y ω) μ) (hYi : Integrable Y μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ cmax * B
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcond]
  calc ∫ ω, cfac ω * Y ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, cmax * Y ω ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hcYi (hYi.const_mul _) fun ω => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc ω) (hY ω)
    _ = cmax * ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ cmax * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYbound hcmax

name: NLAlib.Assembly.gn_explicit
statement:
theorem gn_explicit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Y cfac Zsq : Ω → ℝ} {k t s OPTsq : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hts : t + 2 ≤ s)
    (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hc : ∀ ω, cfac ω ≤ 1 + t / (s - t - 1))
    (hcond : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, cfac ω * Y ω ∂μ)
    (hstruct : ∀ ω, Y ω ≤ OPTsq + Zsq ω) (hZ : ∫ ω, Zsq ω ∂μ = k / (t - k - 1) * OPTsq)
    (hcYi : Integrable (fun ω => cfac ω * Y ω) μ) (hYi : Integrable Y μ)
    (hZi : Integrable Zsq μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 + t / (s - t - 1)) * ((1 + k / (t - k - 1)) * OPTsq)
proof:
:= by
  have hcmax : 0 ≤ 1 + t / (s - t - 1) := by
    have : 0 ≤ t / (s - t - 1) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    linarith
  exact gn_assembly hY hcmax hc hcond (rsvd_explicit hstruct hZ hYi hZi) hcYi hYi

name: NLAlib.rsvd_assembly_ae
statement:
theorem rsvd_assembly_ae [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Zsq : Ωs → ℝ} {OPTsq c : ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ OPTsq + Zsq ω) (hZ : ∫ ω, Zsq ω ∂μ = c * OPTsq)
    (hXi : Integrable X μ) (hZi : Integrable Zsq μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 + c) * OPTsq
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, (OPTsq + Zsq ω) ∂μ :=
        integral_mono_ae hXi ((integrable_const _).add hZi) hX
    _ = OPTsq + c * OPTsq := by
        rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hZi, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, hZ]
    _ = (1 + c) * OPTsq := by ring

name: NLAlib.rsvd_truncated_main
statement:
theorem rsvd_truncated_main [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix n (Fin t) ℝ) (Q : Ωs → Matrix m q ℝ)
    (Y : Ωs → Matrix q n ℝ)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω)
    (hY : ∀ ω, IsBestFrobRankApprox ((Q ω)ᵀ * A) k (Y ω))
    (hunit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ))
    (hinv : ∫ ω, frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ
      = (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) * frobSq S₂)
    (hXi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - Q ω * Y ω)) μ)
    (hZi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - Q ω * Y ω) ∂μ ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, frobSq (A - Q ω * Y ω)
      ≤ frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hQo, hQr, hunit] with ω h1 h2 h3
    exact frobSq_sub_mul_le_of_isBestFrobRankApprox_of_range_subset hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV rfl rfl h3 h1 h2
      (hY ω)
  exact rsvd_assembly_ae hX hinv hXi hZi

name: NLAlib.rsvd_main
statement:
theorem rsvd_main [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin k) ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin k) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ} {S₁ : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁) (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix n (Fin t) ℝ) (Q : Ωs → Matrix m q ℝ)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Q ω))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * Ω ω)) = A * Ω ω)
    (hunit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((V₁ᵀ * Ω ω) * (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)ᵀ))
    (hinv : ∫ ω, frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) ∂μ
      = (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1) * frobSq S₂)
    (hXi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A))) μ)
    (hZi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω))) μ) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (A - Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A)) ∂μ ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * frobSq S₂
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, frobSq (A - Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A))
      ≤ frobSq S₂ + frobSq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * Ω ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * Ω ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hQo, hQr, hunit] with ω h1 h2 h3
    exact frobSq_residual_le_of_range_subset hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV rfl rfl h3 h1 h2
  exact rsvd_assembly_ae hX hinv hXi hZi

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_mul_transpose_mul_le_frobSq_sub_mul
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_mul_transpose_mul_le_frobSq_sub_mul {m n q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (Q : Matrix m q ℝ)
    (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (Y : Matrix q n ℝ) :
    frobSq (A - Q * (Qᵀ * A)) ≤ frobSq (A - Q * Y)
proof:
:=
  frobSq_residual_le_frobSq_sub_mul hQo A Y

name: NLAlib.measurable_rsvd_rangeResidual
statement:
private theorem measurable_rsvd_rangeResidual {m n l : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin l) ℝ => A - rangeProjector (A * G) * A)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : Measurable (fun G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin l) ℝ => rangeProjector (A * G) * A) :=
    (measurable_rangeProjector.comp (measurable_const.matrix_mul measurable_id)).matrix_mul
      measurable_const
  refine Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr fun i j => ?_
  exact measurable_const.sub ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp hP)

name: NLAlib.ae_isUnit_rsvd_head
statement:
private theorem ae_isUnit_rsvd_head
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {n k p : ℕ}
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit ((Vᵀ * G ω) * (Vᵀ * G ω)ᵀ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlaw := hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hG V hV
  have h := gaussianMatrix_ae_isUnit_mul_transpose (k := k) (t := k + p) (by omega)
  rw [← hlaw.map_eq] at h
  exact ae_of_ae_map hlaw.aemeasurable h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_frobNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_frobNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) +
        u * t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * singularValues A k <
      frobNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A)} ≤
      2 * t ^ (-(p : ℝ)) + Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, hspec, hfrob⟩ :=
    exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm A k hkn
  have hFN : frobNorm S₂ = Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) := by rw [frobNorm, hfrob]
  have hUnit := ae_isUnit_rsvd_head G hG V₁ hV₁
  have hc := gaussianMatrix_lt_frobNorm_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le G hG
    V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV S₂ hp ht hu
  refine (show μ.real {ω | (1 + t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) *
        Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) +
        u * t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * singularValues A k <
      frobNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A)} ≤
      μ.real {ω | (t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * frobNorm S₂ +
          u * (t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * specNorm S₂ <
        frobNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω))} from ?_).trans hc
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top μ _)
  apply measure_mono_ae
  filter_upwards [hUnit] with ω hω
  change _ < frobNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A) → _
  intro hbad
  change (t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * frobNorm S₂ +
      u * (t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * specNorm S₂ <
    frobNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω))
  have hb := frobSq_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_svd_blocks hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV
    (Ω := G ω) (Ω₁ := V₁ᵀ * G ω) (Ω₂ := V₂ᵀ * G ω) rfl rfl hω
  have hres : frobNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A) ≤
      frobNorm S₂ + frobNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω)) := by
    rw [← frobNorm_sq (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A), ← frobNorm_sq S₂,
      ← frobNorm_sq (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω))] at hb
    nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A), frobNorm_nonneg S₂,
      frobNorm_nonneg (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω))]
  rw [hFN] at hres
  rw [hFN, hspec]
  ring_nf at hbad ⊢
  linarith only [hbad, hres]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_specNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_specNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * singularValues A k +
        t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) +
        u * t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * singularValues A k <
      specNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A)} ≤
      2 * t ^ (-(p : ℝ)) + Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, hspec, hfrob⟩ :=
    exists_svd_right_blocks_specNorm A k hkn
  have hFN : frobNorm S₂ = Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) := by rw [frobNorm, hfrob]
  have hUnit := ae_isUnit_rsvd_head G hG V₁ hV₁
  have hc := gaussianMatrix_lt_specNorm_mul_block_mul_pinvR_block_le G hG
    V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV S₂ hp ht hu
  refine (show μ.real {ω | (1 + t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * singularValues A k +
        t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) +
        u * t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * singularValues A k <
      specNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A)} ≤
      μ.real {ω | (t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * specNorm S₂ +
          (t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * frobNorm S₂ +
          u * (t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * specNorm S₂ <
        specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω))} from ?_).trans hc
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top μ _)
  apply measure_mono_ae
  filter_upwards [hUnit] with ω hω
  change _ < specNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A) → _
  intro hbad
  change (t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * specNorm S₂ +
      (t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * frobNorm S₂ +
      u * (t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1))) * specNorm S₂ <
    specNorm (S₂ * (V₂ᵀ * G ω) * pinvR (V₁ᵀ * G ω))
  have hb := specNorm_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_of_svd_blocks hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂
    (Ω := G ω) (Ω₁ := V₁ᵀ * G ω) (Ω₂ := V₂ᵀ * G ω) rfl rfl hω
  rw [hspec] at hb
  rw [hFN, hspec]
  ring_nf at hbad ⊢
  linarith only [hbad, hb]

name: NLAlib.ae_rsvd_rangeProjector_mul_eq_of_rank_le
statement:
theorem ae_rsvd_rangeProjector_mul_eq_of_rank_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n l : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin l) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin l)) μ) (hr : A.rank ≤ l) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A = A
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_rank_mul_gaussian_eq_min A G hG] with ω hω
  have he : (A * G ω).rank = A.rank := by simpa only [min_eq_left hr] using hω
  exact rangeProjector_mul_of_range_le (range_mulVecLin_mul_eq_of_rank_eq A (G ω) he).symm.le

name: NLAlib.one_sub_failure_le_measureReal_le
proof:
:= by
  have hm : NullMeasurableSet {ω | f ω ≤ B} μ :=
    hf.nullMeasurableSet_preimage measurableSet_Iic
  have h := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl₀ (μ := μ) hm
  rw [probReal_univ] at h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_frobNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_frobNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    1 - 2 * t ^ (-(p : ℝ)) - Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2) ≤
      μ.real {ω | frobNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A) ≤
        (1 + t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) +
        u * t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * singularValues A k}
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ =>
      frobNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * Z) * A)) :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.measurable.comp (measurable_frobSq.comp (measurable_rsvd_rangeResidual A))
  have h := one_sub_failure_le_measureReal_le (hm.comp_aemeasurable hG.aemeasurable)
    (measureReal_lt_frobNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le A hkn hp G hG ht hu)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h
  linarith only [h]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n k p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p))) μ)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    1 - 2 * t ^ (-(p : ℝ)) - Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2) ≤
      μ.real {ω | specNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * G ω) * A) ≤
        (1 + t * Real.sqrt (12 * (k : ℝ) / p)) * singularValues A k +
        t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * Real.sqrt (bestRankFrobSq A k) +
        u * t * (Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt (k + p) / ((p : ℝ) + 1)) * singularValues A k}
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + p)) ℝ =>
      specNorm (A - rangeProjector (A * Z) * A)) :=
    measurable_specNorm_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp (measurable_rsvd_rangeResidual A))
  have h := one_sub_failure_le_measureReal_le (hm.comp_aemeasurable hG.aemeasurable)
    (measureReal_lt_specNorm_rsvd_rangeResidual_le A hkn hp G hG ht hu)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h
  linarith only [h]

name: NLAlib.bestRankFrobSq_eq_zero_of_width_le
statement:
theorem bestRankFrobSq_eq_zero_of_width_le {m n k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hnk : n ≤ k) : bestRankFrobSq A k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bestRankFrobSq]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : k ≤ (i : ℕ)
  · rw [if_pos hi, singularValues_eq_zero_of_width_le A
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hnk.trans hi)]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hi]

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_residual_of_measurable_frame
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_residual_of_measurable_frame
    {α Ω m n q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (X : Ω → α) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (Qf : α → Matrix m q ℝ) (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (X ω))) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Qf (X ω)) A)) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (integrable_const (frobSq A)).mono'
    ((measurable_frobSq_residual_of A hQf).comp_aemeasurable hX).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _)]
  exact frobSq_residual_le hω A

name: NLAlib.ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_width_le
statement:
theorem ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_width_le
    {Ω q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {m n t : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (Q : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) q ℝ)
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * (A * G ω)) = A * G ω) (hnt : n ≤ t) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Q ω * ((Q ω)ᵀ * A) = A
proof:
:= by
  have hunit := ae_isUnit_block hG (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (by simp) hnt
  have hunit' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (G ω * (G ω)ᵀ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul] using hunit
  filter_upwards [hQr, hunit'] with ω hproj hfull
  have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin t) ℝ => M * pinvR (G ω)) hproj
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_pinvR hfull, Matrix.mul_one] using he

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_le_bestRankFrobSq_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_le_bestRankFrobSq_gaussian
    {Ω q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n k t : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) q ℝ)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (G ω)))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Qf (G ω) * ((Qf (G ω))ᵀ * (A * G ω)) = A * G ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Qf (G ω)) A)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (projResidual (Qf (G ω)) A) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  have hX := hG.aemeasurable
  refine ⟨integrable_frobSq_residual_of_measurable_frame A _ hX Qf hQf hQo, ?_⟩
  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
  · obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, htail⟩ :=
      exists_svd_right_blocks A k hkn
    have hb := rsvd_main_gaussian hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt G hG
      (fun ω => Qf (G ω)) hQo hQr
    rw [htail] at hb
    exact hb
  · have hfull := ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_width_le A G hG
      (fun ω => Qf (G ω)) hQr (by omega : n ≤ t)
    have hz : (fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Qf (G ω)) A)) =ᵐ[μ]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hfull] with ω hω
      simp [projResidual, hω]
    rw [integral_congr_ae hz, integral_zero, bestRankFrobSq_eq_zero_of_width_le A (by omega)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.rank_truncatedRsvdOutput_le
statement:
theorem rank_truncatedRsvdOutput_le {m n q : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (truncatedRsvdOutput Q A k).rank ≤ k
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Q (truncatedSVD (Qᵀ * A) k)).trans
    (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD (Qᵀ * A) k).1

name: NLAlib.frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_eq {m n q : ℕ}
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput Q A k) =
      frobSq (projResidual Q A) + bestRankFrobSq (Qᵀ * A) k
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncatedRsvdOutput
  rw [frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    frobSq_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_bestRankFrobSq]

name: NLAlib.IsBestFrobRankApprox.frobSq_sub_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual
statement:
theorem IsBestFrobRankApprox.frobSq_sub_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual
    {m n q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {Y : Matrix q n ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (hY : IsBestFrobRankApprox (Qᵀ * A) k Y) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    frobSq (A - Q * Y) ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k + frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_isBestFrobRankApprox A k
  have hRank : (Qᵀ * B).rank ≤ k := (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right Qᵀ B).trans hB.1
  have hBest := hY.2 (Qᵀ * B) hRank
  have hContraction := frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_le hQ (A - B)
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hB.frobSq_sub_eq_bestRankFrobSq] at hContraction
  rw [frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hContraction ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsBestFrobRankApprox.frobSq_sub_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_two_mul_frobSq_residual
statement:
theorem IsBestFrobRankApprox.frobSq_sub_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_two_mul_frobSq_residual
    {m n q : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {Y : Matrix q n ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (hY : IsBestFrobRankApprox (Qᵀ * A) k Y) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    frobSq (A - Q * Y) ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k + 2 * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hY.frobSq_sub_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual hQ
  linarith [frobSq_nonneg (projResidual Q A)]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual
    {m n q : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput Q A k) ≤
      bestRankFrobSq A k + frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have hY := isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD (Qᵀ * A) k
  exact hY.frobSq_sub_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual hQ

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_two_mul_frobSq_residual
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_two_mul_frobSq_residual
    {m n q : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput Q A k) ≤
      bestRankFrobSq A k + 2 * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobSq_sub_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_add_frobSq_residual Q hQ A k
  linarith [frobSq_nonneg (projResidual Q A)]

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_of_measurable_frame
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_of_measurable_frame
    {α Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n q : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) (X : Ω → α) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (Qf : α → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (X ω))) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput (Qf (X ω)) A k)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hCompressed : Measurable fun x => (Qf x)ᵀ * A :=
    Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr (measurable_mul_entry_of (f := fun x => (Qf x)ᵀ)
      (g := fun _ : α => A) (fun a b => hQf b a) (fun _ _ => measurable_const))
  have hOpt : Measurable fun x => bestRankFrobSq ((Qf x)ᵀ * A) k :=
    (continuous_bestRankFrobSq k).measurable.comp hCompressed
  have hValue := (measurable_frobSq_residual_of A hQf).add hOpt
  have hEq : (fun ω => frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput (Qf (X ω)) A k)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq (projResidual (Qf (X ω)) A) + bestRankFrobSq ((Qf (X ω))ᵀ * A) k := by
    filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
    exact frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_eq _ hω A k
  have hMeas := (hValue.comp_aemeasurable hX).aestronglyMeasurable.congr hEq.symm
  refine (integrable_const (frobSq A)).mono' hMeas ?_
  filter_upwards [hQo] with ω hω
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (frobSq_nonneg _)]
  have hbest := (isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD ((Qf (X ω))ᵀ * A) k).2
    (0 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin n) ℝ) (by simp)
  rw [sub_zero] at hbest
  have hpyth := frobSq_eq_frobSq_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual hω A
  rw [truncatedRsvdOutput, frobSq_sub_mul_eq hω]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hpyth ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_le_bestRankFrobSq_gaussian
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m n q k t : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin t)) μ)
    (Qf : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin t) ℝ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Measurable fun x => Qf x i j)
    (hQo : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, HasOrthonormalCols (Qf (G ω)))
    (hQr : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Qf (G ω) * ((Qf (G ω))ᵀ * (A * G ω)) = A * G ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput (Qf (G ω)) A k)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput (Qf (G ω)) A k) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 + (k : ℝ) / (t - k - 1)) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  have hX := hG.aemeasurable
  refine ⟨integrable_frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_of_measurable_frame A k _ hX Qf hQf hQo, ?_⟩
  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
  · obtain ⟨r, U₁, U₂, V₁, V₂, S₂, hA, hU₂, hV₁, hV₂, hV, htail⟩ :=
      exists_svd_right_blocks A k hkn
    have hb := rsvd_truncated_main_gaussian hA hU₂ hV₁ hV₂ hV hkt G hG
      (fun ω => Qf (G ω))
      (fun ω => truncatedSVD ((Qf (G ω))ᵀ * A) k)
      hQo hQr (fun _ => isBestFrobRankApprox_truncatedSVD _ k)
    rw [htail] at hb
    exact hb
  · have hfull := ae_gaussian_projection_reproduces_of_width_le A G hG
      (fun ω => Qf (G ω)) hQr (by omega : n ≤ t)
    have hOpt : bestRankFrobSq A k = 0 := bestRankFrobSq_eq_zero_of_width_le A (by omega)
    have hcompressed (ω : Ω) : bestRankFrobSq ((Qf (G ω))ᵀ * A) k = 0 :=
      bestRankFrobSq_eq_zero_of_width_le _ (by omega)
    have hz : (fun ω => frobSq (A - truncatedRsvdOutput (Qf (G ω)) A k)) =ᵐ[μ]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hfull, hQo] with ω hω horth
      rw [frobSq_truncatedRsvdOutput_eq _ horth, hcompressed]
      simp [projResidual, hω]
    rw [integral_congr_ae hz, integral_zero, hOpt]
    simp

statement:
theorem mul_sketchAndSolve_eq_rawGeneralizedNystrom

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ)
    (hs : A.rank + 2 ≤ s) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B) ∂μ =
        (1 + (A.rank : ℝ) / ((s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1)) *
          frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  by_cases hr : A.rank = 0
  · have hA : A = 0 := eq_zero_of_matrix_rank_eq_zero hr
    subst A
    simp
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQA⟩ := exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix A
  obtain ⟨Qp, hQp, hcomp⟩ := exists_unitary_complement Q hQ
  have hcomp' : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1 := by simpa using hcomp
  have hproj : Q * Qᵀ = A * moorePenroseInverse A :=
    mul_conjTranspose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse hQ hQA (by simp)
  have hres : projResidual Q B = (1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hproj]
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := completion_reduction_gaussian_integrable Q Qp B hQ hQp hcomp'
    (by omega) hs Ψ hΨ
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_isUnit_block hΨ Q hQ (by omega)] with ω hω
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hω
  have heq : (fun ω => frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq (B - sketchedOutput Q (Ψ ω) B) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with ω hω
    rw [mul_sketchAndSolve_eq_rawGeneralizedNystrom,
      rawGeneralizedNystrom_eq_sketchedOutput B A Q (Ψ ω) hQA (by simp) hω]
  refine ⟨hi.congr heq.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq, he, hres]

statement:
private theorem sketchSolveFrameNoise_eq_haarBlockNoise
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) K) (Ω : UnitaryStiefel K n ell)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1) :
    sketchSolveFrameNoise U Ω.valᴴ B=haarBlockNoise U V Ω*(Vᴴ*projResidual U B)
