name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_haar_of_frame
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_haar_of_frame
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) K) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) K)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (hUA : U*(Uᴴ*A)=A) (hRank : A.rank=r) (helln : ell≤n)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln,IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω))
    (htrace : Integrable (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (fun Ω => sketchAndSolve A Ω.valᴴ B) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) ∧
      (∫ Ω,sketchAndSolve A Ω.valᴴ B ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)=moorePenroseInverse A*B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hZ,hZmean⟩ := integrable_and_integral_haarBlockNoise helln U V hU hV hUV hcomp hfull htrace
  obtain ⟨hN,hNmean⟩ := integrable_and_integral_matrix_sandwich
    (pinvR (Uᴴ*A)) (Vᴴ*projResidual U B) hZ
  rw [hZmean,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at hNmean
  have he : (fun Ω => sketchAndSolve A Ω.valᴴ B) =ᵐ[unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln]
      (fun Ω => moorePenroseInverse A*B+pinvR (Uᴴ*A)*haarBlockNoise U V Ω*(Vᴴ*projResidual U B)) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with Ω hΩ
    have hSQ : IsUnit ((Ω.valᴴ*U)ᴴ*(Ω.valᴴ*U)) := by
      simpa only [unitaryFrameTopGram,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hΩ
    rw [sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise A U hU hUA (by simpa using hRank) Ω.valᴴ B hSQ,
      sketchSolveFrameNoise_eq_haarBlockNoise U V B Ω hU hcomp,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hconst := integrable_const (μ := unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) (moorePenroseInverse A*B)
  refine ⟨(hconst.add hN).congr he.symm,?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae he,integral_add hconst hN,hNmean,add_zero,integral_const,
    probReal_univ]
  ext i j
  change ((1 : ℝ) : K) * ((moorePenroseInverse A*B) i j) = _
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_haar_of_frame
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_haar_of_frame
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) K) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) K)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (hUA : U*(Uᴴ*A)=A) (hRank : A.rank=r) (helln : ell≤n) (hq : 0<q)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln,IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω))
    (htrace : Integrable (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (fun Ω => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A Ω.valᴴ B)) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) ∧
      (∫ Ω,frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A Ω.valᴴ B) ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)=
        (1+((∫ Ω,RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace
          ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)-r)/q)*frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hN,hNval⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise_mul
    helln hq U V hU hV hUV hcomp hfull htrace (Vᴴ*projResidual U B)
  have hD : frobSq (Vᴴ*projResidual U B)=frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B) := by
    calc
      _ = frobSq (V*(Vᴴ*projResidual U B)) :=
        (frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hV (Vᴴ*projResidual U B)).symm
      _ = frobSq (projResidual U B) := congrArg frobSq
        (residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual hU hcomp B).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg frobSq (projResidual_eq_optimalResidual A U hU hUA (by simpa using hRank) B)
  have he : (fun Ω => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A Ω.valᴴ B)) =ᵐ[unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln]
      (fun Ω => frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)+frobSq (haarBlockNoise U V Ω*(Vᴴ*projResidual U B))) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with Ω hΩ
    have hSQ : IsUnit ((Ω.valᴴ*U)ᴴ*(Ω.valᴴ*U)) := by
      simpa only [unitaryFrameTopGram,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hΩ
    rw [frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_eq A U hU hUA (by simpa using hRank) Ω.valᴴ B hSQ,
      sketchSolveFrameNoise_eq_haarBlockNoise U V B Ω hU hcomp]
  have hconst := integrable_const (μ := unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)
    (frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B))
  refine ⟨(hconst.add hN).congr he.symm,?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae he,integral_add hconst hN,hNval,hD,integral_const,
    probReal_univ,one_smul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.measurable_haarBlockNoise
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_haarBlockNoise
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K) :
    Measurable (haarBlockNoise (ell := ell) U V)
proof:
:= by
  unfold haarBlockNoise
  exact (measurable_pinvL.comp
    (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp measurable_subtype_coe |>.matrix_mul measurable_const)).matrix_mul
      ((Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp measurable_subtype_coe).matrix_mul measurable_const)

name: NLAlib.rightUnitaryInvariant_haarBlockNoiseLaw
statement:
theorem rightUnitaryInvariant_haarBlockNoiseLaw (helln : ell≤n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1) :
    RightUnitaryInvariant (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V)
proof:
:= by
  intro W
  let T : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin n) K := ⟨blockUnitaryAction U V W,
    Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr (hasOrthonormalCols_blockUnitaryAction U V hU hV hUV hcomp W)⟩
  have hleft : T.valᴴ*U=U := blockUnitaryAction_conjTranspose_mul_left U V hU hUV W
  have hright : T.valᴴ*V=V*W.val := blockUnitaryAction_conjTranspose_mul_right U V hV hUV W
  have he (Ω : UnitaryStiefel K n ell) : haarBlockNoise U V (T • Ω)=haarBlockNoise U V Ω*W.val := by
    change pinvL ((T.val*Ω.val)ᴴ*U)*((T.val*Ω.val)ᴴ*V)=_
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc,hleft,Matrix.mul_assoc,hright]
    simp only [haarBlockNoise,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  unfold haarBlockNoiseLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (measurable_haarBlockNoise U V)]
  have hf : (fun Z : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin q) K => Z*W.val) ∘ haarBlockNoise U V =
      haarBlockNoise U V ∘ (fun Ω : UnitaryStiefel K n ell => T • Ω) := by
    funext Ω
    exact (he Ω).symm
  rw [hf,← Measure.map_map (measurable_haarBlockNoise U V) (by fun_prop),
    unitaryHaarFrameLaw_map_smul K helln T]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise
    (helln : ell≤n) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln,IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω))
    (htrace : Integrable (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (fun Ω => frobSq (haarBlockNoise U V Ω)) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) ∧
      (∫ Ω,frobSq (haarBlockNoise U V Ω) ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) =
        (∫ Ω,RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace
          ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)-r
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun Ω => frobSq (haarBlockNoise U V Ω)) =ᵐ[unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln]
      (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace-r) := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with Ω hΩ
    have hgram : (Ω.valᴴ*U)ᴴ*(Ω.valᴴ*U)=unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω := by
      simp only [unitaryFrameTopGram,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    have hf : IsUnit ((Ω.valᴴ*U)ᴴ*(Ω.valᴴ*U)) := hgram ▸ hΩ
    have hrow := rowGram_sketch_blocks_eq_one Ω.val U V Ω.property hcomp
    have hh := frobSq_pinvL_blockNoise_eq_trace_inv_sub_card (Ω.valᴴ*U) (Ω.valᴴ*V) hf hrow
    simpa only [haarBlockNoise,hgram,Fintype.card_fin] using hh
  constructor
  · exact (htrace.sub (integrable_const _)).congr he.symm
  · rw [integral_congr_ae he,integral_sub htrace (integrable_const _)]
    simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise_mul
    (helln : ell≤n) (hq : 0<q) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln,IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω))
    (htrace : Integrable (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) (D : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin p) K) :
    Integrable (fun Ω => frobSq (haarBlockNoise U V Ω*D)) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) ∧
      (∫ Ω,frobSq (haarBlockNoise U V Ω*D) ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) =
        (((∫ Ω,RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace
          ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)-r)/q)*frobSq D
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (Fin q) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hq
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise helln U V hcomp hfull htrace
  have hm : AEMeasurable (haarBlockNoise (ell := ell) U V)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) := (measurable_haarBlockNoise U V).aemeasurable
  have hbase : Integrable (fun Z => frobSq Z) (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V) := by
    exact (integrable_map_measure measurable_frobSq.aestronglyMeasurable hm).mpr hi
  have hvalue : (∫ Z,frobSq Z ∂haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V)=
      (∫ Ω,RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace
        ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)-r := by
    rw [haarBlockNoiseLaw,integral_map hm measurable_frobSq.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact hv
  obtain ⟨himage,himageValue⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_of_rightUnitaryInvariant
    (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V) hbase (rightUnitaryInvariant_haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V hU hV hUV hcomp) D
  have hmf : Measurable (fun Z : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin q) K => frobSq (Z*D)) :=
    measurable_frobSq.comp (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_const)
  constructor
  · exact (integrable_map_measure hmf.aestronglyMeasurable hm).mp himage
  · rw [← integral_map hm hmf.aestronglyMeasurable]
    change (∫ Z,frobSq (Z*D) ∂haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V)=_
    rw [himageValue,hvalue,Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.integrable_haarBlockNoise
statement:
theorem integrable_haarBlockNoise
    (helln : ell≤n) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln,IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω))
    (htrace : Integrable (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (haarBlockNoise U V) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (integrable_and_integral_frobSq_haarBlockNoise helln U V hcomp hfull htrace).1
  have hm : AEMeasurable (haarBlockNoise (ell := ell) U V)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) := (measurable_haarBlockNoise U V).aemeasurable
  have hbase : Integrable (fun Z => frobSq Z) (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V) :=
    (integrable_map_measure measurable_frobSq.aestronglyMeasurable hm).mpr hi
  have hz := integrable_matrix_of_integrable_frobSq (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V) hbase
  exact hz.comp_aemeasurable hm

name: NLAlib.integral_haarBlockNoise_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_haarBlockNoise_eq_zero
    (helln : ell≤n) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1) :
    (∫ Ω,haarBlockNoise U V Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)=0
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEMeasurable (haarBlockNoise (ell := ell) U V)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) := (measurable_haarBlockNoise U V).aemeasurable
  have hl : HasLaw (haarBlockNoise U V) (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) := ⟨hm,rfl⟩
  exact hl.integral_eq.trans
    (integral_matrix_eq_zero_of_rightUnitaryInvariant (haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V)
      (rightUnitaryInvariant_haarBlockNoiseLaw helln U V hU hV hUV hcomp))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_haarBlockNoise
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_haarBlockNoise
    (helln : ell≤n) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) K) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin q) K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : Uᴴ*V=0) (hcomp : U*Uᴴ+V*Vᴴ=1)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln,IsUnit (unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω))
    (htrace : Integrable (fun Ω => RCLike.re ((unitaryFrameTopGram K U Ω)⁻¹).trace)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (haarBlockNoise U V) (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln) ∧
      (∫ Ω,haarBlockNoise U V Ω ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)=0
proof:
:=
  ⟨integrable_haarBlockNoise helln U V hcomp hfull htrace,
    integral_haarBlockNoise_eq_zero helln U V hU hV hUV hcomp⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormal_range_frame
statement:
theorem exists_orthonormal_range_frame [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix m (Fin A.rank) 𝕜, HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧
      Q*(Qᴴ*A)=A ∧ A*moorePenroseInverse A=Q*Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,V,h⟩ := exists_isThinSVD A
  refine ⟨U,h.left_orth,?_,h.mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq⟩
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,← h.mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq,mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]

name: NLAlib.pinvL_sketch_mul_eq_frame_add_noise
statement:
theorem pinvL_sketch_mul_eq_frame_add_noise [DecidableEq q]
    (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜) (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜)
    (hSQ : IsUnit ((S*Q)ᴴ*(S*Q))) :
    pinvL (S*Q)*(S*B)=Qᴴ*B+sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B
proof:
:= by
  have hB : S*B=(S*Q)*(Qᴴ*B)+S*projResidual Q B := by
    calc
      _ = S*(Q*(Qᴴ*B)+projResidual Q B) := by rw [mul_conjTranspose_mul_add_residual]
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_add,← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hB,Matrix.mul_add,← Matrix.mul_assoc,pinvL_mul hSQ,Matrix.one_mul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR_frame_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR_frame_mul_conjTranspose :
    moorePenroseInverse A=pinvR (Qᴴ*A)*Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hR := isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization Q A hQA hRank
  have hQG : IsUnit (Qᴴ*Q) := by rw [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self]; exact isUnit_one
  have h := moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL Q (Qᴴ*A) hQG hR
  have hP : pinvL Q=Qᴴ := by rw [pinvL,hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self,inv_one,Matrix.one_mul]
  rwa [hQA,hP] at h

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq_frame_projector
statement: theorem mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq_frame_projector : A*moorePenroseInverse A=Q*Qᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR_frame_mul_conjTranspose A Q hQ hQA hRank]
  calc
    _ = Q*((Qᴴ*A)*pinvR (Qᴴ*A))*Qᴴ := by
      conv_lhs => lhs; rw [← hQA]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pinvR (isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization Q A hQA hRank),Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.projResidual_eq_optimalResidual
statement:
theorem projResidual_eq_optimalResidual [DecidableEq m] (B : Matrix m p 𝕜) :
    projResidual Q B=(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq_frame_projector A Q hQ hQA hRank]
  simp only [projResidual,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise
statement:
theorem sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜)
    (hSQ : IsUnit ((S*Q)ᴴ*(S*Q))) :
    sketchAndSolve A S B=moorePenroseInverse A*B+
      pinvR (Qᴴ*A)*sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B
proof:
:= by
  have hR := isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization Q A hQA hRank
  have hFactor : S*A=(S*Q)*(Qᴴ*A) := by
    calc
      _ = S*(Q*(Qᴴ*A)) := congrArg (S*·) hQA.symm
      _ = _ := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  rw [sketchAndSolve,hFactor,moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL _ _ hSQ hR,
    Matrix.mul_assoc,pinvL_sketch_mul_eq_frame_add_noise Q S B hSQ,Matrix.mul_add,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR_frame_mul_conjTranspose A Q hQ hQA hRank,
    Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.fitted_sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise
statement:
theorem fitted_sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜)
    (hSQ : IsUnit ((S*Q)ᴴ*(S*Q))) :
    A*sketchAndSolve A S B=Q*(Qᴴ*B+sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise A Q hQ hQA hRank S B hSQ,Matrix.mul_add]
  have hR := mul_pinvR (isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization Q A hQA hRank)
  have hAP : A*pinvR (Qᴴ*A)=Q := by
    calc
      _ = Q*((Qᴴ*A)*pinvR (Qᴴ*A)) := by
        conv_lhs => lhs; rw [← hQA]
        exact Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = Q := by rw [hR,Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_moorePenroseInverse_eq_frame_projector A Q hQ hQA hRank,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc A, hAP, Matrix.mul_add]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_eq [DecidableEq m] (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜)
    (hSQ : IsUnit ((S*Q)ᴴ*(S*Q))) :
    frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A S B)=
      frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)+frobSq (sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fitted_sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise A Q hQ hQA hRank S B hSQ,
    frobSq_sub_mul_eq hQ]
  have hsub : Qᴴ*B-(Qᴴ*B+sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B) = -sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B := by abel
  rw [hsub,frobSq_neg,projResidual_eq_optimalResidual A Q hQ hQA hRank]

name: NLAlib.sketchSolveFrameNoise_eq_completion
statement:
theorem sketchSolveFrameNoise_eq_completion [Fintype r] [DecidableEq q] [DecidableEq m]
    (Q : Matrix m q 𝕜) (Qp : Matrix m r 𝕜) (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hcomp : Q*Qᴴ+Qp*Qpᴴ=1) :
    sketchSolveFrameNoise Q S B=pinvL (S*Q)*(S*Qp)*(Qpᴴ*projResidual Q B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchSolveFrameNoise
  conv_lhs => rw [residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ hcomp B]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sketchAndSolve_smul_sketch
statement:
theorem sketchAndSolve_smul_sketch
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜) {c : 𝕜} (hc : c≠0) :
    sketchAndSolve A (c•S) B=sketchAndSolve A S B
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchAndSolve
  rw [Matrix.smul_mul,moorePenroseInverse_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.mul_smul,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hc,one_smul]

name: NLAlib.sketchAndSolve_zero
statement:
theorem sketchAndSolve_zero (S : Matrix s m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜) :
    sketchAndSolve (0 : Matrix m n 𝕜) S B=0
proof: := by simp [sketchAndSolve]

name: NLAlib.measurable_sketchAndSolve
statement:
theorem measurable_sketchAndSolve [DecidableEq s] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜) :
    Measurable (fun S : Matrix s m 𝕜 => sketchAndSolve A S B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sketchAndSolve
  exact (measurable_moorePenroseInverse.comp (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_const)).matrix_mul
    (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_const)

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq_sketchAndSolve_residual
statement:
theorem measurable_frobSq_sketchAndSolve_residual [Fintype p] [DecidableEq s] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix m p 𝕜) :
    Measurable (fun S : Matrix s m 𝕜 => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A S B))
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_frobSq.comp
  apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
  intro i j
  exact measurable_const.sub ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp
    (measurable_const.matrix_mul (measurable_sketchAndSolve A B)))

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_sqrtTwo_smul_complexGaussianMatrix
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(by fun_prop : Measurable _).aemeasurable,?_⟩
  have h2 : Real.sqrt 2≠0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))
  rw [complexGaussianMatrix,Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have he : (fun G : Matrix m n ℂ => Real.sqrt 2 • G) ∘
      (fun G => (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ • G)=id := by
    funext G
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ h2,one_smul,id_eq]
  rw [he,Measure.map_id]

name: NLAlib.sketchAndSolve_sqrtTwo_smul_adjoint
statement:
private theorem sketchAndSolve_sqrtTwo_smul_adjoint {m n p s : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype s]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (G : Matrix m s ℂ) (B : Matrix m p ℂ) :
    sketchAndSolve A (Real.sqrt 2 • G)ᴴ B=sketchAndSolve A Gᴴ B
proof:
:= by
  have he : Real.sqrt 2 • G=(Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)•G := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply,RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul,smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  rw [he,Matrix.conjTranspose_smul]
  apply sketchAndSolve_smul_sketch A Gᴴ B
  apply star_ne_zero.mpr
  exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_complexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_complexGaussianMatrix
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (complexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℂ) (hs : A.rank+1≤s) :
    Integrable (fun ω => sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B ∂μ=moorePenroseInverse A*B
proof:
:= by
  have hU : HasLaw (fun ω => Real.sqrt 2 • Ψ ω)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ :=
    hasLaw_sqrtTwo_smul_complexGaussianMatrix.comp hΨ
  simpa only [sketchAndSolve_sqrtTwo_smul_adjoint] using
    integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix hU A B hs

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_complexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_complexGaussianMatrix
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (complexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℂ) (hs : A.rank+1≤s) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) ∂μ=
        (1+(A.rank:ℝ)/((s:ℝ)-A.rank))*frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : HasLaw (fun ω => Real.sqrt 2 • Ψ ω)
      (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ :=
    hasLaw_sqrtTwo_smul_complexGaussianMatrix.comp hΨ
  simpa only [sketchAndSolve_sqrtTwo_smul_adjoint] using
    integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix hU A B hs

name: NLAlib.integrable_entry_of_integrable_frobSq
statement:
private theorem integrable_entry_of_integrable_frobSq
    {Ω a b : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [Fintype a] [Fintype b] {X : Ω → Matrix a b ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ i j, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => X ω i j) μ)
    (hi : Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (X ω)) μ) (i : a) (j : b) :
    Integrable (fun ω => X ω i j) μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ((integrable_const 1).add hi).mono' (hX i j) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
  intro ω
  change ‖X ω i j‖ ≤ 1 + frobSq (X ω)
  have hsq : X ω i j ^ 2 ≤ frobSq (X ω) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
    exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (X ω i k)) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => sq_nonneg (X ω k l))
        (Finset.mem_univ i))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have habs := sq_abs (X ω i j)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|X ω i j| - 1)]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_gaussian_cross_block_entry
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_gaussian_cross_block_entry
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m s q r : ℕ}
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp) (hQQp : Qᵀ * Qp = 0)
    (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ((Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)) i j) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, ((Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)) i j ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hX := (measurable_block Q).comp_aemeasurable hΨ.aemeasurable
  have hY := hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_block_of_hasLaw hΨ Qp hQp
  have hind := gaussianMatrix_indepFun_block_of_hasLaw hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp
  have hiP (t : Fin s) : Integrable (fun ω => pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω) t j) μ :=
    integrable_entry_of_integrable_frobSq
      (fun a b => ((measurable_pinvR_entry a b).comp_aemeasurable hX).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (integrable_pinvR_block hΨ Q hQ hqs) t j
  have hiY (t : Fin s) : Integrable (fun ω => (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) i t) μ := by
    have h := (memLp_gaussianMatrix_entry i t 1 (by simp)).integrable (by simp)
    rw [← hY.map_eq] at h
    exact h.comp_aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable
  have hiProd (t : Fin s) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) i t * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω) t j) μ :=
    (hind.symm.comp (Matrix.measurable_entry i t) (measurable_pinvR_entry t j)).integrable_mul
      (hiY t) (hiP t)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun t _ => hiProd t)
  · change (∫ ω, ∑ t, (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) i t * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω) t j ∂μ) = 0
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun t _ => hiProd t)]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro t _
    have hprod := IndepFun.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
      (hind.symm.comp (Matrix.measurable_entry i t) (measurable_pinvR_entry t j))
        (hiY t).aestronglyMeasurable
        (hiP t).aestronglyMeasurable
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hprod
    have hmean : ∫ ω, (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) i t ∂μ = 0 := by
      have h := hY.integral_comp (Matrix.measurable_entry i t).aestronglyMeasurable
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, integral_gaussianMatrix_entry_eq_zero] using h
    exact hprod.trans (by rw [hmean, zero_mul])

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sketchedCore_entry
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_sketchedCore_entry
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m s q r : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ) (Qp : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQp : HasOrthonormalCols Qp)
    (hcomp : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1) (hqs : q + 2 ≤ s)
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ) (i : Fin q) (j : p) :
    Integrable (fun ω => sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B i j) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B i j ∂μ = (Qᵀ * B) i j
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hQQp : Qᵀ * Qp = 0 := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_of_completion
    hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self hQp.conjTranspose_mul_self hcomp
  let D := Qpᵀ * projResidual Q B
  let C := fun ω => (Qpᵀ * Ψ ω) * pinvR (Qᵀ * Ψ ω)
  have hC (k : Fin r) := integrable_and_integral_gaussian_cross_block_entry
    hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp hqs k i
  have hnoise (ω : Ω) :
      (pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) * D) i j =
        ∑ k, C ω k i * D k j := by
    have heq : pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Qp) = (C ω)ᵀ := by
      simp only [C, Matrix.transpose_mul, pinvR_transpose, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    rw [heq]
    rfl
  have hni : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ k, C ω k i * D k j) μ :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => (hC k).1.mul_const _
  have hne : (∫ ω, ∑ k, C ω k i * D k j ∂μ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hC k).1.mul_const _)]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    rw [integral_mul_const, (hC k).2, zero_mul]
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_isUnit_block hΨ Q hQ (by omega)] with ω hω
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hω
  have heq : (fun ω => sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B i j) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => (Qᵀ * B) i j + ∑ k, C ω k i * D k j := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with ω hω
    rw [sketchedCore_eq Q Qp (Ψ ω) B hQ hcomp hω, Matrix.add_apply, hnoise]
  refine ⟨((integrable_const _).add hni).congr heq.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq, integral_add (integrable_const _) hni, integral_const,
    probReal_univ, one_smul, hne, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ)
    (hs : A.rank + 2 ≤ s) :
    Integrable (fun ω => sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B ∂μ) = moorePenroseInverse A * B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQA⟩ := exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix A
  obtain ⟨Qp, hQp, hcomp⟩ := exists_unitary_complement Q hQ
  have hcomp' : Q * Qᵀ + Qp * Qpᵀ = 1 := by simpa using hcomp
  let R := Qᵀ * A
  have hR : IsUnit (R * Rᵀ) :=
    isUnit_rowGram_of_frame_factorization Q A hQA (by simp)
  have hpinv : moorePenroseInverse A = pinvR R * Qᵀ := by
    have hQQ : Qᵀ * Q = 1 := hQ
    have hpQ : pinvL Q = Qᵀ := by simp [pinvL, hQQ]
    have h := moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL Q R
      (by change IsUnit (Qᵀ*Q); rw [hQQ]; exact isUnit_one) hR
    rw [show Q * R = A from hQA, hpQ] at h
    exact h
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsUnit (((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)ᵀ * ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_isUnit_block hΨ Q hQ (by omega)] with ω hω
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using hω
  have heq : (fun ω => sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => pinvR R * sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B := by
    filter_upwards [hfull] with ω hω
    have hfactor : (Ψ ω)ᵀ * A = ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * R := by
      calc
        (Ψ ω)ᵀ * A = (Ψ ω)ᵀ * (Q * R) := congrArg ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * ·) hQA.symm
        _ = ((Ψ ω)ᵀ * Q) * R := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    rw [sketchAndSolve, hfactor,
      moorePenroseInverse_mul_eq_pinvR_mul_pinvL ((Ψ ω)ᵀ*Q) R hω hR, sketchedCore, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hcore (i : Fin A.rank) (j : p) :=
    integrable_and_integral_sketchedCore_entry hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hcomp' hs B i j
  have hi (i : Fin n) (j : p) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (pinvR R * sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B) i j) μ := by
    change Integrable (fun ω => ∑ k, pinvR R i k * sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B k j) μ
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => (hcore k j).1.const_mul _
  have hXi : Integrable (fun ω => pinvR R * sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B) μ :=
    Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr hi
  refine ⟨hXi.congr heq.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq, hpinv, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.integral_apply hXi i j]
  change (∫ ω, ∑ k, pinvR R i k * sketchedCore Q (Ψ ω) B k j ∂μ) =
    ∑ k, pinvR R i k * (Qᵀ * B) k j
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hcore k j).1.const_mul _)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [integral_const_mul, (hcore k j).2]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_comp_unitaryHaarFrameMatrixLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_comp_unitaryHaarFrameMatrixLaw_of_hasLaw
    {K Ω E : Type*} [RCLike K] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] {n ell : ℕ} {helln : ell≤n}
    {Z : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ell) K}
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (unitaryHaarFrameMatrixLaw K n ell helln) μ)
    (f : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ell) K → E) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hframe : Integrable (fun Q : UnitaryStiefel K n ell => f Q.val)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f (Z ω)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω,f (Z ω) ∂μ)=∫ Q : UnitaryStiefel K n ell,f Q.val ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : Integrable f (unitaryHaarFrameMatrixLaw K n ell helln) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hf.aestronglyMeasurable measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable).mpr hframe
  constructor
  · rw [← hZ.map_eq] at hbase
    exact hbase.comp_aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable
  · exact (hZ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable).trans
      (integral_map measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_comp_unitaryHaarAdjointSketchLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_comp_unitaryHaarAdjointSketchLaw_of_hasLaw
    {K Ω E : Type*} [RCLike K] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] {n ell : ℕ} {helln : ell≤n}
    {S : Ω → Matrix (Fin ell) (Fin n) K}
    (hS : HasLaw S (unitaryHaarAdjointSketchLaw K n ell helln) μ)
    (f : Matrix (Fin ell) (Fin n) K → E) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hframe : Integrable (fun Q : UnitaryStiefel K n ell => f Q.valᴴ)
      (unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f (S ω)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω,f (S ω) ∂μ)=∫ Q : UnitaryStiefel K n ell,f Q.valᴴ ∂unitaryHaarFrameLaw K n ell helln
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ell) K => f Zᴴ) :=
    hf.comp Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose
  have hbase : Integrable f (unitaryHaarAdjointSketchLaw K n ell helln) := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure hf.aestronglyMeasurable Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact (integrable_map_measure hm.aestronglyMeasurable measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable).mpr hframe
  constructor
  · rw [← hS.map_eq] at hbase
    exact hbase.comp_aemeasurable hS.aemeasurable
  · apply (hS.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable).trans
    rw [unitaryHaarAdjointSketchLaw,integral_map Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact integral_map measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable hm.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceInjection.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_le_of_cross_residual_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceInjection.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_le_of_cross_residual_le
    {k m n r : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {b : m → ℝ} {x : n → ℝ} {α γ : ℝ}
    (hS : IsSubspaceInjection S U α) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hA : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hx : IsLeastSquaresSolution (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x)
    (hcross : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Uᵀ *ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ (S *ᵥ
        (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)))))‖ ≤
      γ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let xstar := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
  let z := b - A *ᵥ xstar
  let c := Uᵀ *ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ (S *ᵥ z))
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hA (show A *ᵥ (x - xstar) ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin from
    ⟨x - xstar, rfl⟩)
  change U *ᵥ w = A *ᵥ (x - xstar) at hw
  have hUw : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self,
      ← Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec U w, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hnormal := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_forall_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero
    (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x).1 hx (x - xstar)
  have hres : S *ᵥ b - (S * A) *ᵥ x = S *ᵥ z - S *ᵥ (U *ᵥ w) := by
    rw [hw]
    simp only [z, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    abel
  rw [hres, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hw, sub_dotProduct] at hnormal
  have henergy : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ (U *ᵥ w))‖ ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ c := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    have hcEq : w ⬝ᵥ c = S *ᵥ z ⬝ᵥ S *ᵥ (U *ᵥ w) := by
      calc
        w ⬝ᵥ c = (Sᵀ *ᵥ (S *ᵥ z)) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ w) :=
          Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec U w _
        _ = (U *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ (S *ᵥ z)) := dotProduct_comm _ _
        _ = _ := Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec S (U *ᵥ w) (S *ᵥ z)
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hnormal).symm.trans hcEq.symm
  have hCS : w ⬝ᵥ c ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 c‖ := by
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, star_trivial, dotProduct_comm] using
      real_inner_le_norm (WithLp.toLp 2 w) (WithLp.toLp 2 c)
  have hlow := hS w
  rw [hUw, henergy] at hlow
  have hcross' : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 c‖ ≤ γ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ := hcross
  have hbound : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ≤ (γ / α) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ := by
    by_cases hw0 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 0
    · rw [hw0]
      positivity
    have hwpos : 0 < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hw0)
    have h := hCS.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcross' (norm_nonneg _))
    have h' : α * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ≤ γ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ := by
      nlinarith
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact (le_div_iff₀' hα).2 h'
  have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hbound 2
  rw [mul_pow, div_pow] at hsquare
  have hopt := isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b
  have horth : Aᵀ *ᵥ z = 0 := by
    have h := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq A b xstar).1 hopt
    simp only [z, Matrix.mulVec_sub, h, sub_self]
  have hpyth := norm_sub_mulVec_sq_eq_add_of_transpose_mulVec_eq_zero horth x
  have hneg : A *ᵥ (xstar - x) = -(U *ᵥ w) := by
    rw [hw, ← Matrix.mulVec_neg, neg_sub]
  rw [hneg, WithLp.toLp_neg, norm_neg, hUw] at hpyth
  rw [hpyth]
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ ^ 2 + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceInjection.norm_sub_mulVec_le_one_add_of_cross_residual_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceInjection.norm_sub_mulVec_le_one_add_of_cross_residual_le
    {k m n r : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {b : m → ℝ} {x : n → ℝ} {α γ ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsSubspaceInjection S U α) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hbudget : γ ^ 2 ≤ ε * α ^ 2) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hA : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hx : IsLeastSquaresSolution (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x)
    (hcross : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Uᵀ *ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ (S *ᵥ
        (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)))))‖ ≤
      γ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ (1 + ε) *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := hS.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_le_of_cross_residual_le hα hγ hU hA hx hcross
  have hratio : γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2 ≤ ε := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hα)).2 hbudget
  have hnorm : 0 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add_left hratio 1) (sq_nonneg
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖)
  have hextra : 0 ≤ ε * (1 + ε) *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  apply le_of_sq_le_sq _ (mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + ε) hnorm)
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖ ^ 2 := hsq
    _ ≤ (1 + ε) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))‖ ^ 2 := by
          simpa only [add_comm] using hmul
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith only [hextra]

name: NLAlib.sketchAndSolve_eq_of_square_orthonormal_sketch
statement:
theorem sketchAndSolve_eq_of_square_orthonormal_sketch
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) K) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) K)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (hΩ : HasOrthonormalCols Ω) :
    sketchAndSolve A Ωᴴ B=moorePenroseInverse A*B
proof:
:= by
  have hright : Ω*Ωᴴ=1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hΩ.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have ht : HasOrthonormalCols Ωᴴ := by
    rw [HasOrthonormalCols,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact hright
  unfold sketchAndSolve
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols Ωᴴ A ht,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Ω Ωᴴ B,hright,Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.sketchAndSolve_eq_zero_and_residual_of_rank_eq_zero
statement:

name: NLAlib.frobSq_optimalResidual_le
statement:
private theorem frobSq_optimalResidual_le {m n : ℕ} {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ)
    (X : Matrix (Fin n) p ℝ) :
    frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) ≤ frobSq (B - A * X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQA⟩ := exists_orthonormal_frame_reproducing_matrix A
  have hproj : Q * Qᵀ = A * moorePenroseInverse A :=
    mul_conjTranspose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse hQ hQA (by simp)
  have hres : projResidual Q B = (1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B := by
    rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hproj]
  have h := frobSq_residual_le_frobSq_sub_mul hQ B ((Qᵀ * A) * X)
  rwa [hres, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQA] at h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem measureReal_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : A.rank + 2 ≤ s)
    (hbudget : (A.rank : ℝ) ≤ δ * ε * ((s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1)) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) <
      frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let c := frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B)
  let f := fun ω => frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ :=
    integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix hΨ A B hs
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := frobSq_nonneg _
  have hf : ∀ ω, c ≤ f ω := fun ω => frobSq_optimalResidual_le A B _
  have hi' : Integrable (fun ω => f ω - c) μ := hi.sub (integrable_const _)
  have he' : ∫ ω, f ω - c ∂μ = (A.rank : ℝ) / ((s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1) * c := by
    rw [integral_sub hi (integrable_const _), he, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    dsimp [c]
    ring
  have hden : 0 < (s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1 := by
    have hs' : (A.rank : ℝ) + 2 ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hs
    linarith
  have hratio : (A.rank : ℝ) / ((s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1) ≤ δ * ε :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hden).2 hbudget
  by_cases hc0 : c = 0
  · have hae : f =ᵐ[μ] 0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun ω => frobSq_nonneg _) hi).1 (by
        change ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ = 0
        rw [he, show frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) = 0 from hc0, mul_zero])
    have hnull : μ {ω | (1 + ε) * c < f ω} = 0 := by
      apply measure_mono_null (t := {ω | f ω ≠ 0}) _ (ae_iff.mp hae)
      intro ω hω
      dsimp at hω ⊢
      rw [hc0, mul_zero] at hω
      exact ne_of_gt hω
    change μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * c < f ω} ≤ δ
    rw [measureReal_def, hnull, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    exact hδ.le
  · have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hc0)
    have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => sub_nonneg.mpr (hf ω)) hi' (ε * c)
    rw [he'] at hm
    have hsub : {ω | (1 + ε) * c < f ω} ⊆ {ω | ε * c ≤ f ω - c} := by
      intro ω hω
      dsimp at hω ⊢
      linarith
    change μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * c < f ω} ≤ δ
    apply (measureReal_mono hsub).trans
    apply (le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ (mul_pos hε hcpos))
    calc
      ε * c * μ.real {ω | ε * c ≤ f ω - c} ≤
          (A.rank : ℝ) / ((s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1) * c := hm
      _ ≤ δ * ε * c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio hc
      _ = ε * c * δ := by ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_gaussianSketchSolveDim_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_gaussianSketchSolveDim_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hs : gaussianSketchSolveDim A.rank ε δ ≤ s) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) <
      frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : A.rank + 2 + ⌈(A.rank : ℝ) / (δ * ε)⌉₊ ≤ s := hs
  apply measureReal_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix
    hΨ A B hε hδ (by omega)
  have hceil := Nat.le_ceil ((A.rank : ℝ) / (δ * ε))
  have hsreal : (A.rank : ℝ) + 2 + (⌈(A.rank : ℝ) / (δ * ε)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ s := by
    exact_mod_cast hs'
  have hratio : (A.rank : ℝ) / (δ * ε) ≤ (s : ℝ) - A.rank - 1 := by linarith
  have h := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hδ hε)).1 hratio
  simpa only [mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_frobNorm_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_gaussianSketchSolveDim_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_frobNorm_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_gaussianSketchSolveDim_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (gaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℝ)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hs : gaussianSketchSolveDim A.rank ε δ ≤ s) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * frobNorm ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) <
      frobNorm (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  apply (measureReal_mono (s₂ := {ω | (1 + ε) *
    frobSq ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) <
      frobSq (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)}) ?_).trans
    (measureReal_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_gt_le_of_gaussianSketchSolveDim_le
      hΨ A B hε hδ hs)
  intro ω hω
  dsimp at hω ⊢
  rw [← frobNorm_sq, ← frobNorm_sq]
  have hc := frobNorm_nonneg ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B)
  have hf := frobNorm_nonneg (B - A * sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᵀ B)
  have hsq := mul_self_lt_mul_self (mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + ε) hc) hω
  have hextra : 0 ≤ ε * (1 + ε) * frobNorm ((1 - A * moorePenroseInverse A) * B) ^ 2 := by
    positivity
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.exists_orthonormal_mul_isUnit_of_isUnit_gram
proof:
:= by
  let R := CFC.sqrt (Xᴴ * X)
  have hG := (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X).nonneg
  have hR : IsUnit R := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff _ hG).2 hX
  have hRd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).1 hR
  have hRR : R * R = Xᴴ * X := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hG
  have hRh : Rᴴ = R := by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Xᴴ * X)).star_eq
  refine ⟨X * R⁻¹, R, ?_, hR, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul_cancel_right R X hRd⟩
  change (X * R⁻¹)ᴴ * (X * R⁻¹) = 1
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, hRh]
  calc
    R⁻¹ * Xᴴ * (X * R⁻¹) = R⁻¹ * (Xᴴ * X) * R⁻¹ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (R⁻¹ * R) * (R * R⁻¹) := by rw [← hRR]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hRd, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hRd, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_mul_right
proof:
:= by
  have hGram : rowSubsetGram (Q * R) S = Rᴴ * rowSubsetGram Q S * R := by
    simp only [rowSubsetGram, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [rowSubsetVolume, hGram, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose,
    ← ofReal_rowSubsetVolume Q S]
  have he : star R.det * (rowSubsetVolume Q S : 𝕜) * R.det =
      ((‖R.det‖ ^ 2 * rowSubsetVolume Q S : ℝ) : 𝕜) := by
    rw [RCLike.ofReal_mul, RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.star_def]
    calc
      _ = (starRingEnd 𝕜 R.det * R.det) * (rowSubsetVolume Q S : 𝕜) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [RCLike.conj_mul]
  rw [he, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeLaw_eq_projectionRowVolumeLaw
statement:
private theorem rowVolumeLaw_eq_projectionRowVolumeLaw (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (R : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hR : IsUnit R)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume (Q * R) Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    rowVolumeLaw (Q * R) Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard) =
      projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext_of_measureReal_singleton
  intro S
  rw [rowVolumeLaw_singleton, projectionRowVolumeLaw_singleton]
  have hRdet : R.det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR)
  have hc : ‖R.det‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hRdet)
  simp only [rowSubsetVolume_mul_right, rowSubsetVolume_univ_of_orthonormal Q hQ,
    Nat.sub_self, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, mul_one, rowVolumeWeight]
  by_cases hS : S.card = Fintype.card d
  · simp only [Finset.mem_powersetCard, Finset.subset_univ, hS, and_self, if_true]
    exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hc
  · simp [hS]

name: NLAlib.mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul_eq [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (R : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hR : IsUnit R)
    (J : SizedSubset n d) (hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume Q J.val) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    (Q * R) * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse (Q * R) J.val * Y) =
      projectionVolumeInterpolant Q Y J.val
proof:
:= by
  have hRdet : R.det ≠ 0 := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR)
  have hJ' : 0 < rowSubsetVolume (Q * R) J.val := by
    rw [rowSubsetVolume_mul_right]
    exact mul_pos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hRdet)) hJ
  rw [rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul _ J hJ' Y,
    projectionVolumeInterpolant, rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul _ J hJ Y]
  have hsub : (Q * R).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id =
      Q.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id * R := rfl
  rw [hsub, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  calc
    _ = Q * (R * R⁻¹) * ((Q.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id)⁻¹ *
        Y.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR),
      Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_right_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols Q R hQ,
    moorePenroseInverse_eq_inv_of_isUnit R hR]
  calc
    _ = Q * (R * R⁻¹) * Qᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR),
      Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_rowVolume_error_eq_projection
statement:
private theorem integral_frobSq_rowVolume_error_eq_projection [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (R : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hR : IsUnit R)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume (Q * R) Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (Y - (Q * R) * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse (Q * R) S * Y))
      ∂rowVolumeLaw (Q * R) Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard)) =
    ∫ S, frobSq (Y - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q Y S) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowVolumeLaw_eq_projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ R hR hT hcard,
    integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw, integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro J _
  by_cases hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume Q J.val
  · rw [mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul_eq Q R hR J hJ Y]
  · have hz := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hJ) (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg Q J.val)
    rw [hz, zero_smul, zero_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_le
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_le [Fintype r]
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (Y - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * Y))
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq ((1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X) * Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsUnit (Xᴴ * X) := by
    have h := (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X Finset.univ).mp hT
    simpa only [rowSubsetGram, coordinateSelector_univ, Matrix.mul_one] using h
  obtain ⟨Q, R, hQ, hR, rfl⟩ := exists_orthonormal_mul_isUnit_of_isUnit_gram X hX
  rw [integral_frobSq_rowVolume_error_eq_projection Q hQ R hR hT hcard,
    mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_right_eq Q hQ R hR, ← residual_eq_one_sub_mul]
  exact integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_le Q hQ Y

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_of_full_support
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_of_full_support [Fintype r]
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n)
    (hfull : ∀ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d),
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (Y - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * Y))
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard)) =
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq ((1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X) * Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsUnit (Xᴴ * X) := by
    have h := (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X Finset.univ).mp hT
    simpa only [rowSubsetGram, coordinateSelector_univ, Matrix.mul_one] using h
  obtain ⟨Q, R, hQ, hR, rfl⟩ := exists_orthonormal_mul_isUnit_of_isUnit_gram X hX
  rw [integral_frobSq_rowVolume_error_eq_projection Q hQ R hR hT hcard,
    mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul_right_eq Q hQ R hR, ← residual_eq_one_sub_mul]
  apply integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq_of_full_support Q hQ Y
  intro S hS
  have h := (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit (Q * R) S).mpr (hfull S hS)
  rw [rowSubsetVolume_mul_right] at h
  apply (rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit Q S).mp
  exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_mul_replicateCol_eq_re_quadForm
statement:
private theorem frobSq_mul_replicateCol_eq_re_quadForm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) :
    frobSq (A * Matrix.replicateCol Unit v) = RCLike.re (quadForm (Aᴴ * A) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, dotProduct, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.replicateCol_apply, Finset.univ_unique,
    Finset.sum_singleton, Pi.star_apply, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul,
    ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.le_of_re_quadForm_le
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hB.sub hA)
  intro v
  change 0 ≤ quadForm (B - A) v
  rw [← (hB.sub hA).ofReal_re_quadForm v, RCLike.ofReal_nonneg]
  simpa only [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, map_sub] using sub_nonneg.mpr (h v)

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_integral_rowVolumeLaw
statement:
private theorem re_quadForm_integral_rowVolumeLaw (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) (F : Finset n → Matrix n n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm
      (∫ S, F S ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl
        (by simpa using hcard)) v) =
      ∫ S, RCLike.re (quadForm (F S) v)
        ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw, integral_rowVolumeLaw]
  simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    dotProduct_smul, map_sum, RCLike.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.gram_one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse
proof:
:= by
  rw [(Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian X)).eq]
  exact (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem X).one_sub

name: NLAlib.integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_le
statement:
theorem integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_le (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    (∫ S, (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ *
      (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) • (1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_re_quadForm_le
  · exact Matrix.isHermitian_integral (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S =>
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self _)
  · exact (Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian X)).smul
      (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint])
  · intro v
    rw [re_quadForm_integral_rowVolumeLaw X hT hcard]
    have h := integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_le X
      (Matrix.replicateCol Unit v) hT hcard
    have hres (S : Finset n) :
        Matrix.replicateCol Unit v - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S *
          Matrix.replicateCol Unit v) =
        (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S) * Matrix.replicateCol Unit v := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    simp_rw [hres] at h
    simp only [frobSq_mul_replicateCol_eq_re_quadForm,
      gram_one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse] at h
    simpa only [quadForm, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, RCLike.smul_re] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_eq_of_full_support
statement:
theorem integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_eq_of_full_support (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n)
    (hfull : ∀ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d),
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)) :
    (∫ S, (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ *
      (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard)) =
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) • (1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_le X hT hcard)
  apply le_of_re_quadForm_le
  · exact (Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian X)).smul
      (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint])
  · exact Matrix.isHermitian_integral (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S =>
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self _)
  · intro v
    rw [re_quadForm_integral_rowVolumeLaw X hT hcard]
    have h := integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_of_full_support X
      (Matrix.replicateCol Unit v) hT hcard hfull
    have hres (S : Finset n) :
        Matrix.replicateCol Unit v - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S *
          Matrix.replicateCol Unit v) =
        (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S) * Matrix.replicateCol Unit v := by
      rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    simp_rw [hres] at h
    simp only [frobSq_mul_replicateCol_eq_re_quadForm,
      gram_one_sub_mul_moorePenroseInverse] at h
    simpa only [quadForm, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, RCLike.smul_re] using h.ge

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_le_of_hasLaw [Fintype r]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) (S : Ω → Finset n)
    (hS : HasLaw S (rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl
      (by simpa using hcard)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, frobSq (Y - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X (S ω) * Y)) ∂μ) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq ((1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X) * Y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ T, frobSq (Y - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T * Y))
        ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard) :=
      hS.integral_comp (show AEStronglyMeasurable _ _ from .of_discrete)
    _ ≤ _ := integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_le X Y hT hcard

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_of_hasLaw_of_full_support
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_of_hasLaw_of_full_support
    [Fintype r] {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) (S : Ω → Finset n)
    (hS : HasLaw S (rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl
      (by simpa using hcard)) μ)
    (hfull : ∀ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d),
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X T)) :
    (∫ ω, frobSq (Y - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X (S ω) * Y)) ∂μ) =
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq ((1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X) * Y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ T, frobSq (Y - X * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T * Y))
        ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard) :=
      hS.integral_comp (show AEStronglyMeasurable _ _ from .of_discrete)
    _ = _ := integral_frobSq_sub_mul_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_eq_of_full_support
      X Y hT hcard hfull

name: NLAlib.integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) (S : Ω → Finset n)
    (hS : HasLaw S (rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl
      (by simpa using hcard)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X (S ω))ᴴ *
      (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X (S ω)) ∂μ) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) • (1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ T, (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)ᴴ *
        (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)

statement:
theorem integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_eq_of_hasLaw_of_full_support
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X Finset.univ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card n) (S : Ω → Finset n)
    (hS : HasLaw S (rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl
      (by simpa using hcard)) μ)
    (hfull : ∀ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d),
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X T)) :
    (∫ ω, (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X (S ω))ᴴ *
      (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X (S ω)) ∂μ) =
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) • (1 - X * moorePenroseInverse X)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ T, (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)ᴴ *
        (1 - X * rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)
        ∂rowVolumeLaw X Finset.univ (Fintype.card d) hT le_rfl (by simpa using hcard) :=
      hS.integral_comp (show AEStronglyMeasurable _ _ from .of_discrete)
    _ = _ := integral_conjTranspose_mul_rowVolume_error_eq_of_full_support X hT hcard hfull

name: NLAlib.circularComplexGaussian_frameNoise_moments
statement:
private theorem circularComplexGaussian_frameNoise_moments
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} {m r s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℂ) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hrs : r+1≤s)
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, frobSq (sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) ∂μ)=
        (r:ℝ)/((s:ℝ)-r)*frobSq (projResidual Q B) ∧
      ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B i j) μ ∧
        ∫ ω, sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B i j ∂μ=0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Qp,hQp,hcomp⟩ := exists_unitary_complement Q hQ
  have hQQp := conjTranspose_mul_eq_zero_of_completion hQ hQp hcomp
  have hXY := hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix_blocks_of_hasLaw hΨ Q Qp hQ hQp hQQp
  let D := Qpᴴ*projResidual Q B
  have hN (ω : Ωs) : sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B=
      pinvL (Qᴴ*Ψ ω)ᴴ*(Qpᴴ*Ψ ω)ᴴ*D := by
    rw [sketchSolveFrameNoise_eq_completion Q Qp (Ψ ω)ᴴ B hQ hcomp]
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    rfl
  have hD : frobSq D=frobSq (projResidual Q B) := by
    have hh : Qp*D=projResidual Q B := (residual_eq_mul_conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ hcomp B).symm
    rw [← hh,frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQp.conjTranspose_mul_self]
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_complexGaussian_regression_noise hrs hXY D
  rw [hD] at hv
  simp_rw [hN]
  refine ⟨hi,hv,fun i j => ?_⟩
  exact integrable_and_integral_complexGaussian_regression_noise_entry hrs hXY D i j

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_sub_mul_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p]
    {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℂ) (hs : A.rank+1≤s) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) ∂μ=
        (1+(A.rank:ℝ)/((s:ℝ)-A.rank))*frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)
proof:
:= by
  have := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hQA,hProj⟩ := exists_orthonormal_range_frame A
  have hRank : A.rank=Fintype.card (Fin A.rank) := by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  obtain ⟨hi,hv,hmean⟩ := circularComplexGaussian_frameNoise_moments hΨ Q hQ hs B
  have hE : projResidual Q B=(1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B :=
    projResidual_eq_optimalResidual A Q hQ hQA hRank B
  rw [hE] at hv
  have heq : (fun ω => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)+frobSq (sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_complexGaussian_sketch_full_rank_on_frame hΨ Q hQ (by omega)] with ω hω
    exact frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_eq A Q hQ hQA hRank (Ψ ω)ᴴ B hω
  refine ⟨((integrable_const _).add hi).congr heq.symm,?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq,integral_add (integrable_const _) hi,integral_const,
    probReal_univ,one_smul,hv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_sketchAndSolve_of_hasLaw_circularComplexGaussianMatrix
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {μ : Measure Ωs} {m n s : ℕ}
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] [DecidableEq p]
    {Ψ : Ωs → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℂ}
    (hΨ : HasLaw Ψ (circularComplexGaussianMatrix (Fin m) (Fin s)) μ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) p ℂ) (hs : A.rank+1≤s) :
    Integrable (fun ω => sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B ∂μ=moorePenroseInverse A*B
proof:
:= by
  have := hΨ.isProbabilityMeasure
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hQA,hProj⟩ := exists_orthonormal_range_frame A
  have hRank : A.rank=Fintype.card (Fin A.rank) := by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  obtain ⟨hNi,hNv,hmean⟩ := circularComplexGaussian_frameNoise_moments hΨ Q hQ hs B
  let R := Qᴴ*A
  let F := fun ω => pinvR R*sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B
  have hFi (i : Fin n) (j : p) : Integrable (fun ω => F ω i j) μ := by
    change Integrable (fun ω => ∑ k,pinvR R i k*sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B k j) μ
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => (hmean k j).1.const_mul _
  have hFv (i : Fin n) (j : p) : (∫ ω, F ω i j ∂μ)=0 := by
    change (∫ ω,∑ k,pinvR R i k*sketchSolveFrameNoise Q (Ψ ω)ᴴ B k j ∂μ)=0
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => (hmean k j).1.const_mul _]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    rw [integral_const_mul,(hmean k j).2,mul_zero]
  have hFM : Integrable F μ := Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr hFi
  have hF0 : (∫ ω,F ω ∂μ)=0 := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.integral_apply hFM i j,hFv]
    rfl
  have heq : (fun ω => sketchAndSolve A (Ψ ω)ᴴ B) =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => moorePenroseInverse A*B+F ω := by
    filter_upwards [ae_complexGaussian_sketch_full_rank_on_frame hΨ Q hQ (by omega)] with ω hω
    exact sketchAndSolve_eq_frame_noise A Q hQ hQA hRank (Ψ ω)ᴴ B hω
  refine ⟨((integrable_const _).add hFM).congr heq.symm,?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq,integral_add (integrable_const _) hFM,integral_const,
    probReal_univ,one_smul,hF0,add_zero]

          frobSq ((1-A*moorePenroseInverse A)*B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_frobSq_residual_sketchAndSolve_haar_real A B hs helln
  obtain ⟨hμ,hE⟩ := integrable_and_integral_comp_unitaryHaarAdjointSketchLaw_of_hasLaw hS
    (fun Q => frobSq (B-A*sketchAndSolve A Q B)) (measurable_frobSq_sketchAndSolve_residual A B) hi
  exact ⟨hμ,hE.trans hv⟩

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_le (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε)
    (hε : ε < 1) (hA : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hx : IsLeastSquaresSolution (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x) (y : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 + ε) / (1 - ε) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ y)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hemb : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin,
      (1 - ε) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 := by
    rintro v ⟨w, rfl⟩
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using h w
  have hAx (z : n → ℝ) : A *ᵥ z ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin := hA ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have h₁ := (hemb _ (sub_mem hb (hAx x))).1
  have h₂ := (hemb _ (sub_mem hb (hAx y))).2
  have h₃ : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ y))‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hx y) 2
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  exact (le_div_iff₀' (sub_pos.mpr hε)).2 (h₁.trans (h₃.trans h₂))

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε)
    (hε : ε < 1) (hA : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hx : IsLeastSquaresSolution (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x) (y : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((1 + ε) / (1 - ε)) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ y)‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = Real.sqrt (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2) :=
      (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 + ε) / (1 - ε) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ y)‖ ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (h.norm_sub_mulVec_sq_le hε hA hb hx y)
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul' _ (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_le (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε)
    (hε₀ : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε < 1)
    (hA : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin)
    (hx : IsLeastSquaresSolution (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x) (y : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (1 + ε) / (1 - ε) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ y)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 1 ≤ (1 + ε) / (1 - ε) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hε)).2 (by linarith)
  refine (h.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt hε hA hb hx y).trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg _)
  exact (Real.sqrt_le_iff).2 ⟨by linarith, by nlinarith⟩

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_fromCols
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_fromCols
    (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S (Matrix.fromCols A (Matrix.replicateCol Unit b)) ε)
    (hε₀ : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε < 1)
    (hx : IsLeastSquaresSolution (S * A) (S *ᵥ b) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ (1 + ε) / (1 - ε) *

  · refine ⟨Sum.elim 0 (fun _ : Unit => 1), ?_⟩

name: NLAlib.measurable_nystromPreconditioner
statement:
theorem measurable_nystromPreconditioner {B : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ} {a : Ω → ℝ}
    (hB : Measurable B) (ha : Measurable a) (hPSD : ∀ ω, (B ω).PosSemidef)
    {R : ℝ} (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBN : ∀ ω, specNorm (B ω) ≤ R)
    (ha0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ a ω) (haR : ∀ ω, a ω ≤ R) (μ : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => nystromPreconditioner (B ω) (a ω) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : Measurable (fun ω => B ω - a ω • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) := by
    apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    exact ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp hB).sub (ha.mul_const _)
  have hHS : ∀ ω, (B ω - a ω • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).IsHermitian := fun ω =>
    (hPSD ω).isHermitian.sub (Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _)))
  have hHN : ∀ ω, specNorm (B ω - a ω • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) ≤ 2 * R := by
    intro ω
    have hh : specNorm (a ω • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) = a ω * specNorm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
      simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (ha0 ω)]
    have hI : specNorm (a ω • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) ≤ a ω := by
      rw [hh]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (ha0 ω) specNorm_one_le
    exact (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hBN ω, haR ω])
  have hC := measurable_cfc_of_specNorm_le hH hHS hHN
    (fun t : ℝ => max (-t) 0) (by fun_prop)
  have he : (fun ω => nystromPreconditioner (B ω) (a ω) μ) =
      fun ω => (a ω + μ)⁻¹ • (B ω + μ • 1 +
        cfc (fun t : ℝ => max (-t) 0) (B ω - a ω • 1)) := by
    funext ω
    exact nystromPreconditioner_eq_cfc_shift (hPSD ω).isHermitian _ _
  rw [he]
  apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
  intro i j
  exact (ha.add_const μ).inv.mul ((((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp hB).add_const _).add
    ((Matrix.measurable_entry i j).comp hC))

name: NLAlib.spectrum_nystromPreconditioner_subset
statement:
theorem spectrum_nystromPreconditioner_subset [Nonempty n] {B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) {R a μ : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBN : specNorm B ≤ R)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (haR : a ≤ R) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    spectrum ℝ (nystromPreconditioner B a μ) ⊆ Set.Icc 1 ((R+μ)/μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [nystromPreconditioner] at hz
  have he := cfc_map_spectrum (R := ℝ) (a := B)
    (f := fun t : ℝ => (max t a + μ) / (a + μ)) hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint (by fun_prop)
  rw [he] at hz
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hz
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hB.nonneg ht
  have htR : t ≤ R := by
    have h := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem ht
    rw [← specNorm_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht0] at h
    exact h.trans hBN
  have hm : max t a ≤ R := max_le htR haR
  have hd : 0 < a+μ := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ha0 hμ
  refine ⟨(one_le_div hd).mpr (by linarith [le_max_right t a]), ?_⟩
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hd hμ).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measurable_nystromPreconditionedMatrix
statement:
theorem measurable_nystromPreconditionedMatrix [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {B : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ} {a : Ω → ℝ}
    (hB : Measurable B) (ha : Measurable a) (hPSD : ∀ ω, (B ω).PosSemidef)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBN : ∀ ω, specNorm (B ω) ≤ R)
    (ha0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ a ω) (haR : ∀ ω, a ω ≤ R) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => nystromPreconditionedMatrix A (B ω) (a ω) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := measurable_nystromPreconditioner hB ha hPSD hR hBN ha0 haR μ
  have hPS : ∀ ω, (nystromPreconditioner (B ω) (a ω) μ).IsHermitian := fun ω =>
    (nystromPreconditioner_posDef (hPSD ω) (ha0 ω) hμ).isHermitian
  have hR := measurable_cfc_of_spectrum_subset hP hPS isCompact_Icc
    (fun ω => spectrum_nystromPreconditioner_subset (hPSD ω) hR (hBN ω)
      (ha0 ω) (haR ω) hμ) (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹) (by
        apply ContinuousOn.inv₀ Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousOn
        intro t ht
        exact ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one ht.1)))
  exact (hR.matrix_mul measurable_const).matrix_mul hR

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_conditionNumber_nystrom_rounded_lt_28
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_conditionNumber_nystrom_rounded_lt_28
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ))) ν) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
      (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal) ν ∧
      ∫ ω, (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
        (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal ∂ν < 28
proof:
:= by
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  by_cases hAz : A = 0
  · subst A
    have he (ω : Ωs) := conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_zero_eq_one (Ω ω) hμ
    refine ⟨(integrable_const 1).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (he ω).symm), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall he), integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul]
    norm_num
  by_cases hw : nystromSketchWidth A μ ≤ n
  · exact integrable_and_integral_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_lt_28
      hA hμ (nystromSketchHead_pos_of_ne_zero hAz hμ) hw (le_nystromSketchHead A μ) Ω hΩ
  · have he := ae_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_eq_one_of_dim_le
      hA Ω hΩ (by omega) hμ
    refine ⟨(integrable_const 1).congr (he.mono fun _ h => h.symm), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae he, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    norm_num

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_rounded_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_rounded_le
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ))) ν) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (A-nystrom A (Ω ω))) ν ∧
      ∫ ω, specNorm (A-nystrom A (Ω ω)) ∂ν ≤ (6+2*Real.exp 1^2)*μ
proof:
:= by
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hb : 0 ≤ (6+2*Real.exp 1^2)*μ := by positivity
  by_cases hAz : A = 0
  · subst A
    have he (ω : Ωs) : specNorm ((0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)-nystrom 0 (Ω ω)) = 0 := by
      simp [nystrom, specNorm_zero]
    refine ⟨(integrable_const 0).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (he ω).symm), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall he), integral_zero]
    exact hb
  by_cases hw : nystromSketchWidth A μ ≤ n
  · have hk0 := nystromSketchHead_pos_of_ne_zero hAz hμ
    exact integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_effectiveDimension
      hA hμ hk0 (by unfold nystromSketchWidth at hw; omega) (le_nystromSketchHead A μ) Ω hΩ
  · have he : (fun ω => specNorm (A-nystrom A (Ω ω))) =ᵐ[ν] fun _ => 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ae_nystrom_eq_of_dim_le hA Ω hΩ (by omega)] with ω hω
      rw [hω, sub_self, specNorm_zero]
    refine ⟨(integrable_const 0).congr he.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae he, integral_zero]
    exact hb

name: NLAlib.measurable_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix
statement:
theorem measurable_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix {n ℓ : ℕ}
    [Nonempty (Fin n)] {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    Measurable (fun Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ =>
      (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ)).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := measurable_nystrom (t := Fin ℓ) A
  have ha : Measurable (nystromFloor (ℓ := ℓ) A) :=
    (continuous_singularValues_array (ℓ-1)).measurable.comp hB
  have hBN (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ) : specNorm (nystrom A Ω) ≤ specNorm A :=
    ((posSemidef_nystrom hA Ω).specNorm_le_iff (specNorm_nonneg A)).mpr
      ((Matrix.le_iff.mpr (posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA Ω)).trans
        ((hA.specNorm_le_iff (specNorm_nonneg A)).mp le_rfl))
  have ha0 (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ) : 0 ≤ nystromFloor A Ω := singularValues_nonneg _ _
  have haR (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ) : nystromFloor A Ω ≤ specNorm A :=
    (singularValues_le_specNorm _ _).trans (hBN Ω)
  have hM := measurable_nystromPreconditionedMatrix A hB ha (posSemidef_nystrom hA)
    (specNorm_nonneg A) hBN ha0 haR hμ
  have hPSD (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ) :=
    nystromPreconditionedMatrix_posDef (posSemidef_nystrom hA Ω)
      (Matrix.le_iff.mpr (posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA Ω)) (ha0 Ω) hμ
  have he : (fun Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ =>
      (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ)).toReal) =
