      fun Ω => specNorm (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ) *
        specNorm (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ)⁻¹ := by
    funext Ω
    exact conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit (hPSD Ω).isUnit
  rw [he]
  exact (measurable_specNorm_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp hM)).mul
    (measurable_specNorm_of_entries (Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mp (measurable_matrix_inv.comp hM)))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_lt_28
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_lt_28
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n k : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hwidth : k+(k+1) ≤ n)
    (hk : 3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ / 2 ≤ k)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k+(k+1))) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k+(k+1)))) ν) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
      (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal) ν ∧
      ∫ ω, (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
        (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal ∂ν < 28
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let f := fun ω => (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
    (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal
  obtain ⟨hEi, hEb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_effectiveDimension
    hA hμ hk0 (by omega : k<n) hk Ω hΩ
  have hD : 0 ≤ nystromEffectiveDimension A μ := by
    unfold nystromEffectiveDimension effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i)
      (add_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hμ.le)
  have hfloor (ω : Ωs) : nystromFloor A (Ω ω) ≤ μ := by
    change singularValues (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (k+(k+1)-1) ≤ μ
    let j : Fin n := ⟨k+(k+1)-1, by omega⟩
    apply (singularValues_nystrom_le hA (Ω ω) j).trans
    have h := apply_le_mul_of_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum_le
      (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) (fun i => singularValues_nonneg A i)
      (fun i l hil => singularValues_antitone A hil) hμ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) j (by
        change (1 + 1 / (1 : ℝ)) * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ (j.val : ℝ) + 1
        have hj : j.val = 2*k := by dsimp [j]; omega
        rw [hj]
        push_cast
        linarith)
    simpa using h
  have hb (ω : Ωs) : f ω ≤ 2 + specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)) / μ := by
    have h := conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_toReal_le
      (a := nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) (posSemidef_nystrom hA (Ω ω))
      (Matrix.le_iff.mpr (posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA (Ω ω)))
      (singularValues_nonneg (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (k+(k+1)-1)) hμ
    apply h.trans
    rw [add_div]
    have h1 := (div_le_one hμ).mpr (hfloor ω)
    linarith
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable f ν :=
    ((measurable_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix hA hμ).comp_aemeasurable
      hΩ.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hf0 (ω : Ωs) : 0 ≤ f ω := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hi : Integrable f ν := ((integrable_const 2).add (hEi.div_const μ)).mono' hm
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf0 ω), Pi.add_apply] using hb ω)
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  have hb' := integral_mono_ae hi ((integrable_const 2).add (hEi.div_const μ))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hb'
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const 2) (hEi.div_const μ), integral_const, integral_div,
    probReal_univ, one_smul] at hb'
  have hE := (div_le_iff₀ hμ).mpr hEb
  have he := Real.exp_one_lt_three
  have he0 := Real.exp_pos (1 : ℝ)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.nystromPCGRate_nonneg
statement: theorem nystromPCGRate_nonneg : 0 ≤ nystromPCGRate
proof:
:= by
  have h : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt 56 := by
    have hh := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 56 by norm_num)
    rw [Real.sqrt_one] at hh
    exact hh
  unfold nystromPCGRate
  exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.nystromPCGRate_lt_seventySeven_div_hundred
statement: theorem nystromPCGRate_lt_seventySeven_div_hundred : nystromPCGRate < 77/100
proof:
:= by
  unfold nystromPCGRate
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < Real.sqrt 56+1)).mpr
  have h := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 56)
  have h0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (56:ℝ)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.log_div_le_nystromPCGIterations
statement:
theorem log_div_le_nystromPCGIterations (ε : ℝ) :
    Real.log (2/ε) / Real.log (100/77) ≤ nystromPCGIterations ε
proof: := Nat.le_ceil _

name: NLAlib.nystromPCGIterations_le
statement:
theorem nystromPCGIterations_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (nystromPCGIterations ε : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2/ε) / Real.log (100/77) + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold nystromPCGIterations
  apply (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one _).le
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply Real.log_nonneg
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hε).mpr (by linarith)
  · exact (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 100/77)).le

name: NLAlib.nystromPCGRate_pow_le_sq
statement:
theorem nystromPCGRate_pow_le_sq {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : nystromPCGIterations ε ≤ q) : (2*nystromPCGRate^q)^2 ≤ ε^2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < Real.log (100/77) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog : Real.log (2/ε) ≤ (q:ℝ)*Real.log (100/77) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hc).mp
    exact (log_div_le_nystromPCGIterations ε).trans (by exact_mod_cast hq)
  have heq : (77/100:ℝ)^q = Real.exp (-((q:ℝ)*Real.log (100/77))) := by
    rw [show -((q:ℝ)*Real.log (100/77)) = (q:ℝ)*(-Real.log (100/77)) by ring,
      Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 100/77)]
    norm_num
  have hex := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hlog)
  rw [← heq, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (div_pos (by norm_num) hε)] at hex
  have hinv : (2/ε)⁻¹ = ε/2 := by field_simp
  rw [hinv] at hex
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ nystromPCGRate_nonneg
    nystromPCGRate_lt_seventySeven_div_hundred.le q
  have hu : 2*nystromPCGRate^q ≤ ε := by linarith
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg nystromPCGRate_nonneg q)) hu 2

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_sq_mul_of_isPCGIterate_nystrom_rounded
statement:
theorem quadForm_sub_le_sq_mul_of_isPCGIterate_nystrom_rounded
    {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ)) ℝ)
    (hE : specNorm (A-nystrom A Ω) ≤ 54*μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {q : ℕ} (hq : nystromPCGIterations ε ≤ q)
    {c x₀ xs x : Fin n → ℝ} (hxs : (A+μ•1)*ᵥxs=c)
    (hx : IsPCGIterate (A+μ•1)
      (nystromPreconditioner (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ) c x₀ q x) :
    quadForm (A+μ•1) (x-xs) ≤ ε^2 * quadForm (A+μ•1) (x₀-xs)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate_nystrom_rounded hA hμ Ω hE hxs hx
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (nystromPCGRate_pow_le_sq hε hq)
    ((hA.add (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul hμ.le)).quadForm_nonneg (x₀-xs)))

name: NLAlib.ae_nystrom_eq_of_dim_le
statement:
theorem ae_nystrom_eq_of_dim_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {n ℓ : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ) (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ)) μ)
    (hℓ : n ≤ ℓ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, nystrom A (G ω) = A
proof:
:= by
  have hr : (CFC.sqrt A).rank ≤ ℓ := (Matrix.rank_le_card_width _).trans (by simpa using hℓ)
  filter_upwards [ae_rsvd_rangeProjector_mul_eq_of_rank_le (CFC.sqrt A) G hG hr] with ω hω
  have hz : specNorm (A - nystrom A (G ω)) = 0 := by
    rw [specNorm_sub_nystrom_eq_sqrt_residual hA, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
      hω, sub_self, specNorm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num)]
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hz))).symm

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditioner_eq_smul_add_of_floor_le_spectrum
statement:
theorem nystromPreconditioner_eq_smul_add_of_floor_le_spectrum
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (a μ : ℝ) (hfloor : ∀ t ∈ spectrum ℝ A, a ≤ t) :
    nystromPreconditioner A a μ = (a+μ)⁻¹ • (A + μ • 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : cfc (fun t : ℝ => t + μ) A = A + μ • 1 := by
    rw [cfc_add_const μ (fun t : ℝ => t) A (by fun_prop) hA.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint,
      cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [← hc, ← cfc_const_mul (a+μ)⁻¹ (fun t : ℝ => t+μ) A (by fun_prop), nystromPreconditioner]
  apply cfc_congr
  intro t ht
  dsimp only
  rw [max_eq_left (hfloor t ht)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditionedMatrix_self_eq_smul_one
statement:
theorem nystromPreconditionedMatrix_self_eq_smul_one
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {a μ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hfloor : ∀ t ∈ spectrum ℝ A, a ≤ t) :
    nystromPreconditionedMatrix A A a μ = (a+μ) • 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc : a+μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ha hμ)
  have hP := nystromPreconditioner_posDef hA ha hμ
  have he : A + μ • 1 = (a+μ) • nystromPreconditioner A a μ := by
    rw [nystromPreconditioner_eq_smul_add_of_floor_le_spectrum hA a μ hfloor,
      smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  rw [nystromPreconditionedMatrix, he, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hP]

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_smul_one_toReal
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_smul_one_toReal {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) : (conditionNumber (c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hc
  have hi : (c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ = c⁻¹ • 1 := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc), one_smul]
  rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hp.isUnit, hi]
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos hc, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc), mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)]

name: NLAlib.singularValues_last_le_spectrum
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hA.isHermitian.range_eigenvalues₀] at ht
  obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := ht
  have hi : i.val ≤ ℓ-1 := by have := i.isLt; simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this; omega
  exact (singularValues_antitone A hi).trans_eq
    (singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA i)

name: NLAlib.ae_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_eq_one_of_dim_le
statement:
theorem ae_conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_eq_one_of_dim_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {ν : Measure Ω} {n ℓ : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (G : Ω → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ) (hG : HasLaw G (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ)) ν)
    (hℓ : n ≤ ℓ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν, (conditionNumber
      (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A (nystrom A (G ω)) (nystromFloor A (G ω)) μ)).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_nystrom_eq_of_dim_le hA G hG hℓ] with ω hω
  rw [nystromFloor, hω, nystromPreconditionedMatrix_self_eq_smul_one hA
    (singularValues_nonneg _ _) hμ (singularValues_last_le_spectrum hA hℓ)]
  exact conditionNumber_smul_one_toReal (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (singularValues_nonneg _ _) hμ)

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_zero_eq_one
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_zero_eq_one
    {n ℓ : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin ℓ) ℝ)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix 0 (nystrom 0 G) (nystromFloor 0 G) μ)).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : nystrom (0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) G = 0 := by simp [nystrom]
  have hf : nystromFloor (0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) G = 0 := by
    rw [nystromFloor, hz]
    exact singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le _ (by simp)
  rw [hz, hf, nystromPreconditionedMatrix_self_eq_smul_one Matrix.PosSemidef.zero
    (by norm_num) hμ (fun t ht => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg (show (0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) ≤ 0 from le_rfl) ht),
    zero_add]
  exact conditionNumber_smul_one_toReal hμ

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditioner_posDef
statement:
theorem nystromPreconditioner_posDef {B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    {a μ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hμ : 0 < μ) : (nystromPreconditioner B a μ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.isStrictlyPositive_iff_posDef.mp
  apply (cfc_isStrictlyPositive_iff _ B (by fun_prop) hB.isHermitian).mpr
  intro t _
  exact div_pos (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (ha.trans (le_max_right t a)) hμ)
    (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ha hμ)

name: NLAlib.cfc_add_shift
statement:
private theorem cfc_add_shift (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (μ : ℝ) :
    cfc (fun t : ℝ => t + μ) B = B + μ • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_add_const μ (fun t : ℝ => t) B (by fun_prop) hB.isSelfAdjoint, cfc_id' ℝ B hB.isSelfAdjoint,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.one_le_nystromPreconditioner
statement:
theorem one_le_nystromPreconditioner {B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    {a μ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hμ : 0 < μ) : 1 ≤ nystromPreconditioner B a μ
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < a + μ := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ha hμ
  have h := cfc_mono (a := B) (f := fun _ : ℝ => 1)
    (g := fun t : ℝ => (max t a + μ) / (a + μ))
    (fun t _ => (one_le_div hd).mpr (by linarith [le_max_right t a]))
    continuousOn_const (by fun_prop)
  simpa only [cfc_const (1 : ℝ) B hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint, map_one, nystromPreconditioner] using h

name: NLAlib.add_smul_one_le_smul_nystromPreconditioner
proof:
:= by
  have hd : a + μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ha hμ)
  rw [← cfc_add_shift B hB.isHermitian μ, nystromPreconditioner,
    ← cfc_const_mul (a + μ) (fun t : ℝ => (max t a + μ) / (a + μ)) B (by fun_prop)]
  refine cfc_mono ?_ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  intro t _
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd]
  exact add_le_add (le_max_left t a) le_rfl

name: NLAlib.smul_nystromPreconditioner_le_add_smul_one
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < a + μ := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ha hμ
  rw [← cfc_add_shift B hB.isHermitian μ, nystromPreconditioner,
    ← cfc_const_mul μ (fun t : ℝ => (max t a + μ) / (a + μ)) B (by fun_prop)]
  refine cfc_mono ?_ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  intro t ht
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := (spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg hB.nonneg) ht
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hd]
  rcases le_total t a with hta | hat
  · rw [max_eq_right hta]
    nlinarith
  · rw [max_eq_left hat]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditioner_sandwich
statement:
theorem nystromPreconditioner_sandwich {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hBA : B ≤ A) {a μ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    μ • nystromPreconditioner B a μ ≤ A + μ • 1 ∧
      A + μ • 1 ≤ (a + μ + specNorm (A - B)) • nystromPreconditioner B a μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (smul_nystromPreconditioner_le_add_smul_one hB ha hμ).trans
      (add_le_add hBA le_rfl)
  · have hE : (A - B).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hBA
    have hEn : A - B ≤ specNorm (A - B) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) :=
      (hE.specNorm_le_iff (specNorm_nonneg _)).mp le_rfl
    have hEP := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (one_le_nystromPreconditioner hB ha hμ)
      (specNorm_nonneg (A - B))
    have h := add_le_add (add_smul_one_le_smul_nystromPreconditioner hB ha hμ)
      (hEn.trans hEP)
    convert h using 1 <;> module

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditioner_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem nystromPreconditioner_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal
    {B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : B.IsHermitian) (a μ : ℝ) :
    nystromPreconditioner B a μ =
      (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (((max (hB.eigenvalues i) a + μ) / (a + μ) : ℝ) : 𝕜)) *
        (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [nystromPreconditioner, hB.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc,
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditioner_eq_cfc_shift
statement:
theorem nystromPreconditioner_eq_cfc_shift {B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (a μ : ℝ) :
    nystromPreconditioner B a μ = (a + μ)⁻¹ •
      (B + μ • 1 + cfc (fun t : ℝ => max (-t) 0) (B - a • 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : cfc (fun t : ℝ => t - a) B = B - a • 1 := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun t : ℝ => t) (fun _ : ℝ => a) B,
      cfc_id' ℝ B hB.isSelfAdjoint, cfc_const a B hB.isSelfAdjoint,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have hcomp : cfc (fun t : ℝ => max (-t) 0) (B - a • 1) =
      cfc (fun t : ℝ => max (-(t-a)) 0) B := by
    rw [← hshift, ← cfc_comp (fun t : ℝ => max (-t) 0) (fun t : ℝ => t-a) B
      hB.isSelfAdjoint (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    rfl
  rw [hcomp, ← cfc_add_shift B hB μ, ← cfc_add B (fun t : ℝ => t+μ)
    (fun t : ℝ => max (-(t-a)) 0) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    ← cfc_const_mul (a+μ)⁻¹ (fun t : ℝ => t+μ+max (-(t-a)) 0) B (by fun_prop)]
  apply cfc_congr
  intro t _
  dsimp only
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have he : max t a + μ = t + μ + max (-(t-a)) 0 := by
    rcases le_total t a with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ -(t-a))]
      ring
    · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_right (by linarith : -(t-a) ≤ 0)]
      ring
  rw [he]
  ring

name: NLAlib.nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_le_mul_nystromEffectiveDimension
statement:
theorem nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_le_mul_nystromEffectiveDimension
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ k) :
    nuclearNorm (A - truncatedSVD A k) ≤ μ * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_eq_sum]
  have he : (∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)), if k ≤ i.val then singularValues A i else 0) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, if k ≤ i.val then singularValues A i else 0 :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin n)) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  rw [he]
  have ht := sum_filter_ge_le_mul_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
    (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) (fun i => singularValues_nonneg A i)
    (fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone A hij) hμ k hk
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Finset.sum_filter, nystromEffectiveDimension] using ht

name: NLAlib.singularValues_nystrom_le
proof:
:= by
  have hB := posSemidef_nystrom hA Ω
  let j' : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin n)) := ⟨j.val, by simp⟩
  rw [singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hB j',
    singularValues_eq_eigenvalues₀_of_posSemidef hA j']
  exact Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_of_le hB.isHermitian
    hA.isHermitian (Matrix.le_iff.mpr (posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA Ω)) j'

name: NLAlib.singularValues_le_two_mul_of_nystromEffectiveDimension_le
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_two_mul_of_nystromEffectiveDimension_le
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (k : ℕ) (hkn : k < n) (hk : 3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ / 2 ≤ k) :
    singularValues A k ≤ 2 * μ
proof:
:= by
  apply apply_le_mul_of_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum_le
    (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) (fun i => singularValues_nonneg A i)
    (fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone A hij) hμ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    (⟨k, hkn⟩ : Fin n)
  change (1 + 1 / (2 : ℝ)) * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.singularValues_nystrom_floor_le_regularization
statement:
theorem singularValues_nystrom_floor_le_regularization
    {n k : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hwidth : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n)
    (hk : nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ k)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (2 * k + 1)) ℝ) :
    singularValues (nystrom A Ω) (2 * k) ≤ μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (singularValues_nystrom_le hA Ω ⟨2*k, by omega⟩).trans
  have h := apply_le_mul_of_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum_le
    (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) (fun i => singularValues_nonneg A i)
    (fun i j hij => singularValues_antitone A hij) hμ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    (⟨2*k, by omega⟩ : Fin n) (by
      change (1 + 1 / (1 : ℝ)) * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ ((2*k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1
      push_cast
      linarith)
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_effectiveDimension
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le_of_effectiveDimension
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n k : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n)
    (hk : 3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ / 2 ≤ k)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + (k + 1))) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (k + (k + 1)))) ν) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω))) ν ∧
      ∫ ω, specNorm (A - nystrom A (Ω ω)) ∂ν ≤
        (6 + 2 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2) * μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_le hA
    (by omega : 2 ≤ k+1) hkn Ω hΩ
  have hD : 0 ≤ nystromEffectiveDimension A μ := by
    unfold nystromEffectiveDimension effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i)
      (add_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hμ.le)
  have hDk : nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ k := by linarith
  have htail := nuclearNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_le_mul_nystromEffectiveDimension A hμ k hDk
  have hnext := singularValues_le_two_mul_of_nystromEffectiveDimension_le A hμ k hkn hk
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hcoef : Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * (k : ℝ) + (k + 1)) / (k + 1) ^ 2 ≤
      3 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 / k := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hkR]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.exp 1)]
  have hco0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * (2 * (k : ℝ) + (k + 1)) / (k + 1) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hnuc := nuclearNorm_nonneg (A - truncatedSVD A k)
  have ht1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoef hnuc
  have ht2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htail (show 0 ≤ 3 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 / k by positivity)
  have ht3 : μ * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ * (3 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 / k) ≤
      2 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * μ := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hkR]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (show 3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ) by linarith)
      (show 0 ≤ μ * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hh]
  refine ⟨hi, hb.trans ?_⟩
  push_cast
  rw [show ((k : ℝ) + 1 - 1) = k by ring, mul_div_cancel_right₀ (2 : ℝ) (ne_of_gt hkR)]
  nlinarith [ht1.trans (ht2.trans ht3)]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_conditionNumber_nystrom_rounded_le_56_gt_half
statement:
theorem measureReal_conditionNumber_nystrom_rounded_le_56_gt_half
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ))) ν) :
    1/2 < ν.real {ω | (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
      (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal ≤ 56}
proof:
:= by
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let f := fun ω => (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A
    (nystrom A (Ω ω)) (nystromFloor A (Ω ω)) μ)).toReal
  obtain ⟨hi,hb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_conditionNumber_nystrom_rounded_lt_28 hA hμ Ω hΩ
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (ENNReal.toReal_nonneg : 0 ≤ f ω)) hi 56
  have hbad : ν.real {ω | 56 < f ω} < 1/2 := by
    have hsub : {ω | 56 < f ω} ⊆ {ω | 56 ≤ f ω} := by
      intro ω h
      exact (show 56 < f ω from h).le
    have hh := measureReal_mono (μ := ν) hsub
    change ∫ ω, f ω ∂ν < 28 at hb
    change 56 * ν.real {ω | 56 ≤ f ω} ≤ ∫ ω, f ω ∂ν at hm
    linarith
  have hnull : NullMeasurableSet {ω | f ω ≤ 56} ν :=
    hi.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_preimage measurableSet_Iic
  have hc := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl₀ (μ := ν) hnull
  rw [probReal_univ] at hc
  have he : {ω | f ω ≤ 56}ᶜ = {ω | 56 < f ω} := by ext ω; simp
  rw [he] at hc
  change 1/2 < ν.real {ω | f ω ≤ 56}
  linarith

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate_nystrom_rounded
statement:
theorem quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate_nystrom_rounded
    {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ)) ℝ)
    (hE : specNorm (A-nystrom A Ω) ≤ 54*μ)
    {c x₀ xs x : Fin n → ℝ} (hxs : (A+μ•1)*ᵥxs=c) {q : ℕ}
    (hx : IsPCGIterate (A+μ•1)
      (nystromPreconditioner (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ) c x₀ q x) :
    quadForm (A+μ•1) (x-xs) ≤ (2*nystromPCGRate^q)^2 * quadForm (A+μ•1) (x₀-xs)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := posSemidef_nystrom hA Ω
  have hBA := Matrix.le_iff.mpr (posSemidef_sub_nystrom hA Ω)
  have ha : 0 ≤ nystromFloor A Ω := singularValues_nonneg _ _
  have hf := nystromFloor_le_regularization_of_effectiveDimension hA hμ
    (nystromEffectiveDimension_le_nystromSketchHead A hμ) Ω
  have hP := nystromPreconditioner_posDef hB ha hμ
  have hs := nystromPreconditioner_sandwich hB hBA ha hμ
  have hbound : nystromFloor A Ω+μ+specNorm (A-nystrom A Ω) ≤ 56*μ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ μ+μ+54*μ := add_le_add (add_le_add hf (le_refl μ)) hE
      _ = 56*μ := by ring
  have hu : A+μ•1 ≤ (56*μ) • nystromPreconditioner (nystrom A Ω) (nystromFloor A Ω) μ :=
    hs.2.trans (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right hbound hP.posSemidef.nonneg)
  have hr : (Real.sqrt (56*μ)-Real.sqrt μ)/(Real.sqrt (56*μ)+Real.sqrt μ) = nystromPCGRate := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 56)]
    unfold nystromPCGRate
    have hp := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hμ
    have h56 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (56:ℝ)
    field_simp
  have hh := quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate hP hμ (by linarith : μ≤56*μ) hs.1 hu hxs hx
  rwa [hr] at hh

name: NLAlib.measureReal_nystrom_rounded_residual_le_gt_half
statement:
theorem measureReal_nystrom_rounded_residual_le_gt_half
    {Ωs : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωs] {ν : Measure Ωs}
    {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (Ω : Ωs → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ)) ℝ)
    (hΩ : HasLaw Ω (gaussianMatrix (Fin n) (Fin (nystromSketchWidth A μ))) ν) :
    1/2 < ν.real {ω | specNorm (A-nystrom A (Ω ω)) ≤ 54*μ}
proof:
:= by
  have := hΩ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let f := fun ω => specNorm (A-nystrom A (Ω ω))
  obtain ⟨hi,hb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sub_nystrom_rounded_le hA hμ Ω hΩ
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => specNorm_nonneg (A-nystrom A (Ω ω))) hi (54*μ)
  have hbad : ν.real {ω | 54*μ < f ω} < 1/2 := by
    have hsub : {ω | 54*μ < f ω} ⊆ {ω | 54*μ ≤ f ω} := by
      intro ω h
      exact (show 54*μ < f ω from h).le
    have hh := measureReal_mono (μ := ν) hsub
    have he := Real.exp_one_lt_three
    have he0 := Real.exp_pos (1:ℝ)
    have hconst : 6+2*Real.exp 1^2 < 27 := by nlinarith
    have hb' : ∫ ω, f ω ∂ν < 27*μ := lt_of_le_of_lt hb (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hconst hμ)
    have hm' : 54*μ*ν.real {ω | 54*μ ≤ f ω} < 27*μ := lt_of_le_of_lt hm hb'
    have hgood : ν.real {ω | 54*μ ≤ f ω} < 1/2 := by
      by_contra h
      have hn := le_of_not_gt h
      have hlow : 27*μ ≤ 54*μ*ν.real {ω | 54*μ ≤ f ω} := by
        calc
          _ = (54*μ)*(1/2) := by ring
          _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (by positivity)
      exact not_lt_of_ge hlow hm'
    exact hh.trans_lt hgood
  have hnull : NullMeasurableSet {ω | f ω ≤ 54*μ} ν :=
    hi.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_preimage measurableSet_Iic
  have hc := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl₀ (μ := ν) hnull
  rw [probReal_univ] at hc
  have he : {ω | f ω ≤ 54*μ}ᶜ = {ω | 54*μ < f ω} := by ext ω; simp
  rw [he] at hc
  change 1/2 < ν.real {ω | f ω ≤ 54*μ}
  linarith

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_toReal_le_of_sandwich
proof:
:= by
  have hM : M.PosDef := posDef_of_posDef_le (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hα) hl
  have hn := (hM.posSemidef.specNorm_le_iff (hα.le.trans hαβ)).mpr hu
  have hi := inv_le_inv_of_posDef (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hα) hl
  have hid : (α • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ = α⁻¹ • 1 := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hα), one_smul]
  rw [hid] at hi
  have hni := (hM.inv.posSemidef.specNorm_le_iff (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le)).mpr hi
  rw [conditionNumber_toReal_of_isUnit hM.isUnit, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_le_mul hn hni (specNorm_nonneg _) (hα.le.trans hαβ)

name: NLAlib.conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_toReal_le
statement:
theorem conditionNumber_nystromPreconditionedMatrix_toReal_le {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hBA : B ≤ A) {a μ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    (conditionNumber (nystromPreconditionedMatrix A B a μ)).toReal ≤
      1 + (a + specNorm (A - B)) / μ
proof:
:= by
  let P := nystromPreconditioner B a μ
  let R := cfc (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹) P
  have hP : P.PosDef := nystromPreconditioner_posDef hB ha hμ
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRPR : R * nystromPreconditioner B a μ * R = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hP
  have hs := nystromPreconditioner_sandwich hB hBA ha hμ
  have hl : μ • 1 ≤ R * (A + μ • 1) * R := by
    have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hs.1).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [hR.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.smul_mul, hRPR] using h
  have hu : R * (A + μ • 1) * R ≤ (a + μ + specNorm (A - B)) • 1 := by
    have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hs.2).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [hR.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.smul_mul, hRPR] using h
  have hh : μ ≤ a + μ + specNorm (A - B) := by linarith [specNorm_nonneg (A - B)]
  exact (conditionNumber_toReal_le_of_sandwich hμ hh hl hu).trans_eq (by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hμ]
    ring)

name: NLAlib.nystromPreconditionedMatrix_posDef
proof:
:= by
  let P := nystromPreconditioner B a μ
  let R := cfc (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹) P
  have hP : P.PosDef := nystromPreconditioner_posDef hB ha hμ
  have hR : R.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hRPR : R * nystromPreconditioner B a μ * R = 1 := cfc_inv_sqrt_mul_self_mul_inv_sqrt hP
  apply posDef_of_posDef_le (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hμ)
  have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp (nystromPreconditioner_sandwich hB hBA ha hμ).1)
    |>.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same R
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  change (R * (A + μ • 1) * R - μ • 1).PosSemidef
  simpa only [hR.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hRPR] using h

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate_nystromPreconditioner
statement:
theorem quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate_nystromPreconditioner {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hBA : B ≤ A) {a μ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    {c x₀ xs x : n → ℝ} (hxs : (A + μ • 1) *ᵥ xs = c) {q : ℕ}
    (hx : IsPCGIterate (A + μ • 1) (nystromPreconditioner B a μ) c x₀ q x) :
    quadForm (A + μ • 1) (x - xs) ≤
      (2 * ((Real.sqrt (a + μ + specNorm (A - B)) - Real.sqrt μ) /
        (Real.sqrt (a + μ + specNorm (A - B)) + Real.sqrt μ)) ^ q) ^ 2 *
          quadForm (A + μ • 1) (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := nystromPreconditioner_sandwich hB hBA ha hμ
  exact quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate (nystromPreconditioner_posDef hB ha hμ)
    hμ (by linarith [specNorm_nonneg (A - B)]) hs.1 hs.2 hxs hx

name: NLAlib.le_nystromSketchHead
statement:
theorem le_nystromSketchHead {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (μ : ℝ) :
    3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ / 2 ≤ nystromSketchHead A μ
proof: := Nat.le_ceil _

name: NLAlib.nystromEffectiveDimension_nonneg
statement:
theorem nystromEffectiveDimension_nonneg {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) : 0 ≤ nystromEffectiveDimension A μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold nystromEffectiveDimension effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i)
    (add_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hμ.le)

name: NLAlib.nystromEffectiveDimension_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nystromEffectiveDimension_pos_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    0 < nystromEffectiveDimension A μ
proof:
:= by
  have hn : specNorm A ≠ 0 := by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, ne_eq, norm_eq_zero] using hA
  have hpos := lt_of_le_of_ne (specNorm_nonneg A) (Ne.symm hn)
  have hσ : 0 < singularValues A 0 := by rwa [singularValues_zero_eq_specNorm]
  have ht : 0 < singularValues A 0 / (singularValues A 0 + μ) :=
    div_pos hσ (add_pos hσ hμ)
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le ht
  unfold nystromEffectiveDimension effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum
  let i0 : Fin n := ⟨0, by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card (Fin n))⟩
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := i0) (fun (i : Fin n) _ => div_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i)
    (add_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg A i) hμ.le)) (Finset.mem_univ i0)

name: NLAlib.nystromSketchHead_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nystromSketchHead_pos_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    0 < nystromSketchHead A μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (nystromEffectiveDimension_pos_of_ne_zero hA hμ))
    (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.nystromSketchWidth_le
statement:
theorem nystromSketchWidth_le {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    (nystromSketchWidth A μ : ℝ) ≤ 3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ + 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one
    (show 0 ≤ 3 * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ / 2 by
      have := nystromEffectiveDimension_nonneg A hμ; positivity)).le
  unfold nystromSketchWidth nystromSketchHead
  push_cast
  linarith

name: NLAlib.nystromFloor_le_regularization_of_effectiveDimension
statement:
theorem nystromFloor_le_regularization_of_effectiveDimension {n k : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hk : nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ k)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (k+(k+1))) ℝ) : nystromFloor A Ω ≤ μ
proof:
:= by
  change singularValues (nystrom A Ω) (k+(k+1)-1) ≤ μ
  by_cases hj : k+(k+1)-1 < n
  · let j : Fin n := ⟨k+(k+1)-1, hj⟩
    apply (singularValues_nystrom_le hA Ω j).trans
    have h := apply_le_mul_of_effectiveDimensionOfSpectrum_le
      (fun i : Fin n => singularValues A i) (fun i => singularValues_nonneg A i)
      (fun i l hil => singularValues_antitone A hil) hμ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) j (by
        change (1 + 1 / (1 : ℝ)) * nystromEffectiveDimension A μ ≤ (j.val : ℝ) + 1
        have he : j.val = 2*k := by dsimp [j]; omega
        rw [he]
        push_cast
        linarith)
    simpa using h
  · rw [singularValues_eq_zero_of_height_le _ (by simpa using Nat.le_of_not_gt hj)]
    exact hμ.le

name: NLAlib.nystromEffectiveDimension_le_nystromSketchHead
proof:
:= by
  have := le_nystromSketchHead A μ
  have := nystromEffectiveDimension_nonneg A hμ
  linarith

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (i : m) : 0 ≤ prob A i
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg A)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob
statement: theorem sum_prob (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) : ∑ i, prob A i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hF : frobSq A ≠ 0 := (frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA
  have hS := frobSq_eq_sum_re_star_dotProduct_self A
  simp only [star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real] at hS
  unfold prob
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hS, div_self hF]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_solution
statement:
theorem step_sub_solution (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b)
    (i : m) :
    step A b x i - xs = (x - xs) - ((A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)) • A i
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b i = A i ⬝ᵥ xs := by rw [← hxs]; rfl
  rw [step, hb, dotProduct_sub, ← neg_sub (A i ⬝ᵥ x), neg_div, neg_smul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step
statement:
theorem sqErr_step (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (i : m) :
    (step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs) =
      (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) ^ 2 / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_sub_solution A b xs x hxs i]
  set e := x - xs
  set a := A i
  set t := (a ⬝ᵥ e) / (a ⬝ᵥ a)
  have hae : e ⬝ᵥ a = a ⬝ᵥ e := dotProduct_comm _ _
  simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hae]
  by_cases ha : a ⬝ᵥ a = 0
  · simp [t, ha]
  · simp only [t]
    field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_eq
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) =
      (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) - (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) / frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sqErr_step A b xs x hxs, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
    sum_prob A hA, one_mul, mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [prob]
  by_cases ha : A i ⬝ᵥ A i = 0
  · have : A i = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp ha
    simp [this]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) :
    ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst hA
    simp only [prob, frobSq_zero, div_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero, one_mul]
    exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  rw [expected_sqErr_step_eq A b xs x hxs hA]
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hσ (x - xs)) hF.le
  rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range
statement:
theorem rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) :
    0 ≤ 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst hA
    simp
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, A i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hA (Matrix.ext fun i j => by simp [h i])
  have hmem : A i ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin := ⟨Pi.single i 1, by
    ext j
    simp⟩
  have hpos : 0 < A i ⬝ᵥ A i := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
    (Ne.symm fun h => hi (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h))
  have hbound : σ ^ 2 ≤ frobSq A := le_of_mul_le_mul_right
    ((hσ _ hmem).trans (mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_le_frobSq_mul A (A i))) hpos
  rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one hF]
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_zero
statement:
theorem expErr_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) :
    expErr A b xs x 0 = (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_succ
statement:
theorem expErr_succ (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x (k + 1) = ∑ i, prob A i * expErr A b xs (step A b x i) k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le
statement:
theorem expErr_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · 
    have h0 : ∀ v : n → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v = 0 := fun v => by simp [dotProduct]
    have : ∀ k (x : n → ℝ), expErr A b xs x k = 0 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro x; exact h0 _
      | succ k ih => intro x; simp [expErr_succ, ih]
    rw [this, h0, mul_zero]
  · have hρ := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ (fun v _ => hσ v)
    induction k generalizing x with
    | zero => simp [expErr_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [expErr_succ]
      calc ∑ i, prob A i * expErr A b xs (step A b x i) k
          ≤ ∑ i, prob A i * ((1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k *
              ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs))) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _) (prob_nonneg A i)
        _ = (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k *
              ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; ext i; ring
        _ ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k *
              ((1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (expected_sqErr_step_le A b xs x hxs σ hσ)
              (pow_nonneg hρ k)
        _ = (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ (k + 1) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_eq_sum_paths
statement:
theorem expErr_eq_sum_paths (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x k = ∑ ω : Fin k → m,
      (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) * ((run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (run A b k ω x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr_zero, run]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [expErr_succ, ← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => m).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [ih, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
    simp [Fin.consEquiv, run, Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_le
statement:
theorem sum_paths_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ ω : Fin k → m,
      (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) * ((run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (run A b k ω x - xs)) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← expErr_eq_sum_paths]
  exact expErr_le A b xs hxs σ hσ x k

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailAverage_sub_eq
statement:
private theorem tailAverage_sub_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (burn N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (ω : (Fin burn → m) × (Fin N → m)) :
    tailAverage A b x burn N ω - xs =
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • runSumError A b xs N ω.2 (run A b burn ω.1 x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tailAverage, runSumError, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hN)), one_smul]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run_sub_mem_range
statement:
private theorem run_sub_mem_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) (ω : Fin k → m) :
    run A b k ω x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => exact hx
  | succ k ih =>
    exact ih _ (step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range A b xs x hx (ω 0)) (Fin.tail ω)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_two_paths_dotProduct_runSumError_le
statement:
private theorem sum_two_paths_dotProduct_runSumError_le [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (burn N : ℕ) :
    let q
proof:
:= 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
    let V := ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) / σ ^ 2
    (∑ ω₁ : Fin burn → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω₁ j)) *
      (∑ ω₂ : Fin N → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω₂ j)) *
        (runSumError A b xs N ω₂ (run A b burn ω₁ x) ⬝ᵥ
          runSumError A b xs N ω₂ (run A b burn ω₁ x)))) ≤
      tailInitialWeight q N * q ^ burn * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) +
        ((1 + q) / (1 - q)) * N * V := by
  dsimp only
  let q := 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
  let V := ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) / σ ^ 2
  let C := (1 + q) / (1 - q)
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ hσ
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ ω₁ : Fin burn → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω₁ j)) *
        (tailInitialWeight q N * ((run A b burn ω₁ x - xs) ⬝ᵥ
          (run A b burn ω₁ x - xs)) + (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω₁ _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (by
          have hσnorm : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
              σ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 := by
            simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hσ
          simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using
            sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_le A hA b xs hxs hσ0 hσnorm _
              (run_sub_mem_range A b xs x hx burn ω₁) N)
        (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => prob_nonneg A (ω₁ j))
    _ = tailInitialWeight q N * expErr A b xs x burn +
        (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V := by
      rw [expErr_eq_sum_paths]
      simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
        sum_prod_prob A hA, one_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ω _
      ring
    _ ≤ tailInitialWeight q N * (q ^ burn * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) + V) +
        (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (expErr_le_add_div_sq_of_sub_mem_range A b xs hσ0 hσ x hx burn)
        (tailInitialWeight_nonneg hq0 N)) le_rfl
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.integral_dotProduct_tailAverage_sub_eq
statement:
private theorem integral_dotProduct_tailAverage_sub_eq
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (burn N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∫ ω, (tailAverage A b x burn N ω - xs) ⬝ᵥ (tailAverage A b x burn N ω - xs)
      ∂((kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA burn).toMeasure.prod
        (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA N).toMeasure)) =
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      (∑ ω₁ : Fin burn → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω₁ j)) *
        (∑ ω₂ : Fin N → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω₂ j)) *
          (runSumError A b xs N ω₂ (run A b burn ω₁ x) ⬝ᵥ
            runSumError A b xs N ω₂ (run A b burn ω₁ x))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [integral_prod _ Integrable.of_finite]
  simp_rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum, tailAverage_sub_eq A b xs x burn N hN]
  have hw (k : ℕ) (ω : Fin k → m) : (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA k ω).toReal =
      ∏ j, prob A (ω j) := by
    simp only [kaczmarzRowPathPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => prob_nonneg A (ω j))
  simp_rw [hw, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω₁ _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω₂ _
  ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_sq_le [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin)
    (burn N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let q
proof:
:= 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
    let V := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ xs)‖ ^ 2 / σ ^ 2
    (∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tailAverage A b x burn N ω - xs)‖ ^ 2
      ∂((kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA burn).toMeasure.prod
        (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA N).toMeasure)) ≤
      (tailInitialWeight q N / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * q ^ burn * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2 +
        ((1 + q) / (1 - q)) * V / N := by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hσ ⊢
  rw [integral_dotProduct_tailAverage_sub_eq A hA b xs x burn N hN]
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (sum_two_paths_dotProduct_runSumError_le A hA b xs hxs hσ0 hσ x hx burn N)
    (sq_nonneg (N : ℝ)⁻¹)).trans_eq
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hN)]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.runSum_eq_sum_prefix_run
statement:
theorem runSum_eq_sum_prefix_run (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (ω : Fin k → m) (x : n → ℝ) :
    runSum A b k ω x = ∑ t : Fin k,
      run A b t (fun j => ω ⟨j.val, lt_trans j.isLt t.isLt⟩) x
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [runSum]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [runSum, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    change x + runSum A b k (Fin.tail ω) (step A b x (ω 0)) = x + _
    rw [ih]
    congr 1

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.runSumError_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem runSumError_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (ω : Fin 0 → m) : runSumError A b xs 0 ω x = 0
proof: := by simp [runSumError, runSum]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.runSumError_succ
statement:
theorem runSumError_succ (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (ω : Fin (k + 1) → m) :
    runSumError A b xs (k + 1) ω x =
      (x - xs) + runSumError A b xs k (Fin.tail ω) (step A b x (ω 0))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [runSumError, runSum, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_smul_runSumError_eq_sum_pow_mulVec
statement:
theorem sum_paths_smul_runSumError_eq_sum_pow_mulVec [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ ω : Fin k → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) • runSumError A b xs k ω x) =
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ t *ᵥ (x - xs)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => m).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [Fin.consEquiv, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.cons_zero,
      Fin.cons_succ, runSumError_succ, Fin.tail_cons, mul_smul, smul_add]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_smul,
      sum_prod_prob A hA, one_smul, ih]
    rw [sum_prob A hA, one_smul, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr 1
    simp_rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    simp_rw [← Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_sum, sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq_mulVec A hA b xs x hxs,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_succ
statement:
theorem sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_succ (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0)
    (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ ω : Fin (k + 1) → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (runSumError A b xs (k + 1) ω x)‖ ^ 2) =
      -‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2 +
      2 * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (∑ ω : Fin (k + 1) → m,
        (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) • runSumError A b xs (k + 1) ω x)) +
      ∑ i, prob A i * (∑ ω : Fin k → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (runSumError A b xs k ω (step A b x i))‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  have he (ω : Fin (k + 1) → m) :
      runSumError A b xs (k + 1) ω x ⬝ᵥ runSumError A b xs (k + 1) ω x =
      -((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) + 2 * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ runSumError A b xs (k + 1) ω x) +
      (runSumError A b xs k (Fin.tail ω) (step A b x (ω 0)) ⬝ᵥ
        runSumError A b xs k (Fin.tail ω) (step A b x (ω 0))) := by
    rw [runSumError_succ]
    simp only [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add]
    rw [dotProduct_comm (runSumError A b xs k (Fin.tail ω) (step A b x (ω 0))) (x - xs)]
    ring
  simp_rw [he, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_prod_prob A hA, one_mul,
      dotProduct_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ω _
    rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · rw [← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => m).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ω _
    simp only [Fin.consEquiv, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.cons_zero,
      Fin.cons_succ, Fin.tail_cons, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rowProjector_mul_transpose
statement:
private theorem rowProjector_mul_transpose (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (moorePenroseInverse A * A) * Aᵀ = Aᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (moorePenroseInverse A * A)ᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A * A :=
    (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq
  calc
    _ = (A * (moorePenroseInverse A * A))ᵀ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hs]
    _ = Aᵀ := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rowProjector_mulVec_mem_range
statement:
private theorem rowProjector_mulVec_mem_range (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    (moorePenroseInverse A * A) *ᵥ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ *ᵥ v, ?_⟩
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul]
  exact congrArg (fun M : Matrix n n ℝ => M *ᵥ v)
    (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rowProjector_mulVec_eq_self
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, rowProjector_mul_transpose]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.dotProduct_rowProjector_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (moorePenroseInverse A * A)ᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A * A :=
    (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq
  symm
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hs,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isIdempotentElem A).eq, dotProduct_comm]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.specNorm_rowProjector_sub_smul_gram_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_rowProjector_sub_smul_gram_le
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2) :
    specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A * A - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ≤
      1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hσ
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A)
    (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hq := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ hσ
  apply (specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le _
    ((moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).sub
      ((show (Aᵀ * A).IsHermitian from Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).smul
        (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint]))) _ hq).mpr
  intro v
  let w := (moorePenroseInverse A * A) *ᵥ v
  have hAv : A *ᵥ w = A *ᵥ v := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]
  have hww : w ⬝ᵥ w ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v := by
    rw [← dotProduct_rowProjector_eq]
    exact dotProduct_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec_le_dotProduct_self A v
  have hu := mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_le_frobSq_mul A w
  have hl := hσ w (rowProjector_mulVec_mem_range A v)
  rw [hAv] at hu hl
  have he : v ⬝ᵥ ((moorePenroseInverse A * A - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) *ᵥ v) =
      w ⬝ᵥ w - ((A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) / frobSq A := by
    have hg : v ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ v) = (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
        Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul,
      dotProduct_rowProjector_eq, hg]
    simp only [w, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [he]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ w ⬝ᵥ w - ((A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) / frobSq A := by
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_iff₀ hF).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hu))
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
  have hlow := (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hl hF.le)
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * (w ⬝ᵥ w) := by
      rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      linarith
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hww hq

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.meanError_mulVec_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  exact Submodule.sub_mem _ hv (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ⟨A *ᵥ v, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.pow_meanError_mulVec_eq_pow_rowCompression_mulVec
statement:
private theorem pow_meanError_mulVec_eq_pow_rowCompression_mulVec
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ)
    (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ k *ᵥ v =
      (moorePenroseInverse A * A - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ k *ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      ih _ (meanError_mulVec_mem_range A v hv), pow_succ, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    congr 1
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, rowProjector_mulVec_eq_self A v hv]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.abs_dotProduct_pow_meanError_mulVec_le_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_pow_meanError_mulVec_le_of_mem_range
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2)
    (v : n → ℝ) (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ ((1 - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ k *ᵥ v)| ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  haveI : Nonempty n := Classical.byContradiction fun hn => hA (by
    haveI : IsEmpty n := not_nonempty_iff.mp hn
    ext i j
    exact isEmptyElim j)
  rw [pow_meanError_mulVec_eq_pow_rowCompression_mulVec A v hv]
  apply (abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm _ v).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (dotProduct_self_nonneg v)
  change ‖(moorePenroseInverse A * A - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ k‖ ≤ _
  exact (norm_pow_le _ _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
    (specNorm_rowProjector_sub_smul_gram_le A hA σ hσ) k)

name: NLAlib.expErr_le_frobConditionNumber
statement:
theorem expErr_le_frobConditionNumber [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : IsUnit (Aᵀ * A)) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (k : ℕ) :
    Kaczmarz.expErr A b xs x k ≤
      (1 - 1 / frobConditionNumber A ^ 2) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Kaczmarz.expErr_le A b xs hxs (specNorm (pinvL A))⁻¹
    (inv_specNorm_pinvL_sq_mul_dotProduct_le A hA) x k
  have hRate : 1 - (specNorm (pinvL A))⁻¹ ^ 2 / frobSq A =
      1 - 1 / frobConditionNumber A ^ 2 := by
    rw [frobConditionNumber, moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvL A hA, mul_pow, frobNorm_sq]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, inv_pow]
  simpa only [hRate] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_sqErr_kaczmarzRowPathPMF
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_kaczmarzRowPathPMF [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin k → m,
      (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs)
      ∂(kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA k).toMeasure) = Kaczmarz.expErr A b xs x k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum, Kaczmarz.expErr_eq_sum_paths]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω _
  change (ENNReal.ofReal (∏ j, Kaczmarz.prob A (ω j))).toReal • _ = _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => Kaczmarz.prob_nonneg A (ω j))]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_sqErr_kaczmarz_le_frobConditionNumber
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_kaczmarz_le_frobConditionNumber
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA0 : A ≠ 0) (hA : IsUnit (Aᵀ * A))
    (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin k → m,
      (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs)
      ∂(kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA0 k).toMeasure) ≤
      (1 - 1 / frobConditionNumber A ^ 2) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sqErr_kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA0 b xs x k]
  exact expErr_le_frobConditionNumber A hA b xs x hxs k

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq
statement:
theorem sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0)
    (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, prob A i • (step A b x i - xs)) =
      (x - xs) + (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrow (i : m) :
      prob A i • (((b i - A i ⬝ᵥ x) / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)) • A i) =
        ((frobSq A)⁻¹ * (b i - A i ⬝ᵥ x)) • A i := by
    by_cases hi : A i ⬝ᵥ A i = 0
    · simp [dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hi]
    · rw [smul_smul, prob]
      congr 1
      field_simp
  have hs (i : m) : step A b x i - xs =
      (x - xs) + ((b i - A i ⬝ᵥ x) / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)) • A i := by
    rw [step]
    abel
  simp_rw [hs, smul_add, hrow]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, sum_prob A hA, one_smul]
  congr 1
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec,
    dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq_mulVec [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) :
    (∑ i, prob A i • (step A b x i - xs)) =
      (1 - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) *ᵥ (x - xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq A hA b xs x, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    Matrix.smul_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have he : Aᵀ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) = -(Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs))) := by
    have hn := (isLeastSquaresSolution_iff_transpose_mulVec_mulVec_eq A b xs).mp hxs
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    rw [← hn]
    abel
  rw [he, smul_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prod_prob
statement:
theorem sum_prod_prob (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ ω : Fin k → m, ∏ j, prob A (ω j)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum]
  simp only [sum_prob A hA, Finset.prod_const_one]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_smul_run_sub_eq_pow_mulVec
statement:
theorem sum_paths_smul_run_sub_eq_pow_mulVec [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ ω : Fin k → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) • (run A b k ω x - xs)) =
      (1 - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ k *ᵥ (x - xs)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [run]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => m).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [Fin.consEquiv, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.cons_zero,
      Fin.cons_succ, run, Fin.tail_cons, mul_smul]
    simp_rw [← Finset.smul_sum, ih]
    simp_rw [← Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_sum, sum_prob_smul_step_sub_eq_mulVec A hA b xs x hxs]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.integral_run_sub_eq_pow_mulVec
statement:
theorem integral_run_sub_eq_pow_mulVec [DecidableEq n]
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin k → m, run A b k ω x - xs ∂(kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA k).toMeasure) =
      (1 - (frobSq A)⁻¹ • (Aᵀ * A)) ^ k *ᵥ (x - xs)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  have hw (ω : Fin k → m) : (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA k ω).toReal =
      ∏ j, prob A (ω j) := by
    simp only [kaczmarzRowPathPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => prob_nonneg A (ω j))
  simp_rw [hw]
  exact sum_paths_smul_run_sub_eq_pow_mulVec A hA b xs hxs x k

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem tailInitialWeight_zero (q : ℝ) : tailInitialWeight q 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tailInitialWeight]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_nonneg {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ tailInitialWeight q N
proof:
:= by
  unfold tailInitialWeight
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun t _ => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (pow_nonneg hq t)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_succ
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_succ (q : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q (N + 1) =
      1 + 2 * (∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)) + q * tailInitialWeight q N
proof:
:= by
  unfold tailInitialWeight
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, pow_zero, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, add_assoc, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_comm]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le
statement:
theorem one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    1 + 2 * (∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)) ≤ (1 + q) / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 0) (n := N) hq0 hq1
  rw [← Finset.range_eq_Ico, pow_zero] at hg
  have hs : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)) = q * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ t := by
    simp_rw [pow_succ', Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hs]
  calc
    _ ≤ 1 + 2 * (q * (1 / (1 - q))) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hq1)]; ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_le_sq
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_le_sq {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    have hp : q ^ N ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hq0 hq1
    rw [tailInitialWeight, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    change tailInitialWeight q N + (2 * (N : ℝ) + 1) * q ^ N ≤ _
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (show 0 ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_le_mul
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_le_mul {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q N ≤ ((1 + q) / (1 - q)) * N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [tailInitialWeight_succ]
    have hc := one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le hq0 hq1 N
    have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq1.le (tailInitialWeight_nonneg hq0 N)
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_le_div
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_le_div {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q N ≤ ((1 + q) / (1 - q)) / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp; positivity
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [tailInitialWeight_succ]
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 + q) / (1 - q) + q * (((1 + q) / (1 - q)) / (1 - q)) :=
        add_le_add (one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le hq0 hq1 N)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hq0)
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hq1)]; ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step_eq_add
statement:
theorem sqErr_step_eq_add (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (i : m) :
    (step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh) =
      (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) ^ 2 / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i) +
        (b i - A i ⬝ᵥ xh) ^ 2 / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)
proof:
:= by
  set d := x - xh
  set a := A i
  have hstep : step A b x i - xh = d + ((b i - a ⬝ᵥ xh - a ⬝ᵥ d) / (a ⬝ᵥ a)) • a := by
    simp only [step, d, a, dotProduct_sub]
    abel_nf
  rw [hstep]
  have hda : d ⬝ᵥ a = a ⬝ᵥ d := dotProduct_comm _ _
  simp only [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hda]
  by_cases ha : a ⬝ᵥ a = 0
  · have : a = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp ha
    simp [this]
  · field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le_add
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_le_add (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) :
    ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
        (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst hA
    simp only [prob, frobSq_zero, div_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero, one_mul,
      add_zero]
    exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hterm : ∀ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) ≤
      prob A i * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) ^ 2 / frobSq A +
        (b - A *ᵥ xh) i ^ 2 / frobSq A := fun i => by
    rw [sqErr_step_eq_add A b xh x i]
    have hei : (b - A *ᵥ xh) i = b i - A i ⬝ᵥ xh := rfl
    rw [hei]
    by_cases ha : A i ⬝ᵥ A i = 0
    · have h0 : A i = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp ha
      have hp : prob A i = 0 := by simp [prob, h0]
      rw [hp, h0]
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_dotProduct, sub_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
        not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, zero_div, zero_add]
      exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg A)
    · rw [prob]
      apply le_of_eq
      field_simp
  set d := x - xh
  set e := b - A *ᵥ xh
  calc ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh))
      ≤ ∑ i, (prob A i * (d ⬝ᵥ d) - (A i ⬝ᵥ d) ^ 2 / frobSq A + e i ^ 2 / frobSq A) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hterm i
    _ = d ⬝ᵥ d - (A *ᵥ d) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ d) / frobSq A + e ⬝ᵥ e / frobSq A := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_prob A hA,
          one_mul, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_div, mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_sq]
        simp only [dotProduct, sq]
    _ ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * (d ⬝ᵥ d) + e ⬝ᵥ e / frobSq A := by
        have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hσ d) hF.le
        rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
        linarith

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add
statement:
theorem expErr_le_add (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xh x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ j) *
        ((b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ρ := 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
  set c := (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := div_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg A)
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have h0 : ∀ v : n → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v = 0 := fun v => by simp [dotProduct]
    have : ∀ k (x : n → ℝ), expErr A b xh x k = 0 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro x; exact h0 _
      | succ k ih => intro x; simp [expErr_succ, ih]
    rw [this, h0, mul_zero, zero_add]
    have hρ : ρ = 1 := by
      have hF : frobSq A = 0 := by
        rw [frobSq_eq_zero_iff]; ext i j; exact (IsEmpty.false j).elim
      simp [ρ, hF]
    rw [hρ]
    simp only [one_pow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hc
  have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ (fun v _ => hσ v)
  have hsum : ∀ i, 0 ≤ prob A i := prob_nonneg A
  have hsum1 : ∑ i, prob A i ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hA : A = 0
    · subst hA; simp [prob]
    · rw [sum_prob A hA]
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [expErr_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ρ ^ j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => pow_nonneg hρ j
    generalize ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ρ ^ j = S at ih hS ⊢
    calc ∑ i, prob A i * expErr A b xh (step A b x i) k
        ≤ ∑ i, prob A i * (ρ ^ k * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) + S * c) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _) (hsum i)
      _ = ρ ^ k * ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) +
            (∑ i, prob A i) * (S * c) := by
          simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 1
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
      _ ≤ ρ ^ k * (ρ * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) + c) + 1 * (S * c) := by
          gcongr
          exact expected_sqErr_step_le_add A b xh x σ hσ
      _ = ρ ^ (k + 1) * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) + (S + ρ ^ k) * c := by ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_div_sq
statement:
theorem expErr_le_add_div_sq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xh x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
      (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / σ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (expErr_le_add A b xh σ hσ x k).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
  set c := (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · 
    have hF : frobSq A = 0 := by
      rw [frobSq_eq_zero_iff]; ext i j; exact (IsEmpty.false j).elim
    simp only [hF, div_zero, mul_zero]
    positivity
  have j : n := hn.some
  have hA : A ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := hσ (Pi.single j 1)
    have h1 : (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ Pi.single j 1 = 1 := by simp
    rw [h1, mul_one, h0, Matrix.zero_mulVec, dotProduct_zero] at this
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hσ0]
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A :=
    rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ (fun v _ => hσ v)
  have hρ1 : 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A < 1 := by
    have : 0 < σ ^ 2 / frobSq A := div_pos (by positivity) hF
    linarith
  have hgeom : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ i ≤ frobSq A / σ ^ 2 := by
    have h := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 0) (n := k) hρ0 hρ1
    rw [← Finset.range_eq_Ico, pow_zero] at h
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    field_simp
    ring
  calc (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ i) * (c / frobSq A)
      ≤ frobSq A / σ ^ 2 * (c / frobSq A) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgeom (div_nonneg hc hF.le)
    _ = c / σ ^ 2 := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ)
    (hx : x - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (i : m) :
    step A b x i - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : step A b x i - xh =
      (x - xh) + ((b i - A i ⬝ᵥ x) / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)) • A i := by
    simp only [step]
    abel
  rw [hstep]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ hx (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩)
  ext j
  simp

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hρ : 0 ≤ 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A := by
    by_cases hA : A = 0
    · subst hA; simp
    have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, A i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hA (Matrix.ext fun i j => by simp [h i])
    have hmem : A i ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin := ⟨Pi.single i 1, by
      ext j; simp⟩
    have h1 := hσ _ hmem
    have h2 := mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_le_frobSq_mul A (A i)
    have hpos : 0 < A i ⬝ᵥ A i := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
      (Ne.symm (fun h => hi (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h)))
    have : σ ^ 2 ≤ frobSq A := le_of_mul_le_mul_right (h1.trans h2) hpos
    rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one hF]
    exact this
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [expErr_succ]
    have hstep : ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) ≤
        (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := by
      by_cases hA : A = 0
      · subst hA
        simp only [prob, frobSq_zero, div_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero,
          one_mul]
        exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
      rw [expected_sqErr_step_eq A b xs x hxs hA]
      have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
      have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hσ _ hx) hF.le
      rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      linarith
    calc ∑ i, prob A i * expErr A b xs (step A b x i) k
        ≤ ∑ i, prob A i * ((1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k *
            ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (ih _ (step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range A b xs x hx i)) (prob_nonneg A i)
      _ = (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k *
            ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; ext i; ring
      _ ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (pow_nonneg hρ k)
      _ = (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ (k + 1) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_zero_le_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem expErr_zero_le_moorePenroseInverse [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (b : m → ℝ) (hb : ∃ y, A *ᵥ y = b) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) 0 k ≤
      (1 - (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k *
        ((moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b))
proof:
:= by
  set B := moorePenroseInverse A
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hb
  have hxs : A *ᵥ (B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) = A *ᵥ y := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, mul_moorePenroseInverse_mul]
  have hmem : (0 : n → ℝ) - B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin := by
    
    have hBeq : B = Aᵀ * (Bᵀ * B) := by
      have hsym : (B * A)ᵀ = B * A := moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A
      calc B = B * A * B := (moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse A).symm
        _ = (B * A)ᵀ * B := by rw [hsym]
        _ = Aᵀ * (Bᵀ * B) := by rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hB' : B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) = Aᵀ *ᵥ ((Bᵀ * B) *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hBeq]
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    refine ⟨-((Bᵀ * B) *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)), ?_⟩
    rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_neg, zero_sub, hB']
  have h := expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range A (A *ᵥ y) (B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) hxs
    (specNorm B)⁻¹ (fun v hv => inv_specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq_mul_dotProduct_le A hv) 0 hmem k
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_le
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (N : ℕ) :
    let q
proof:
:= 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
    let V := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ xs)‖ ^ 2 / σ ^ 2
    (∑ ω : Fin N → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (runSumError A b xs N ω x)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      tailInitialWeight q N * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2 +
        (((1 + q) / (1 - q)) * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V := by
  have hσnorm := hσ
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hσ ⊢
  let q := 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
  let V := ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) / σ ^ 2
  let C := (1 + q) / (1 - q)
  change _ ≤ tailInitialWeight q N * _ + (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A)
    (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ hσ
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    have hp : 0 < σ ^ 2 / frobSq A := div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hσ0) hF
    linarith
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := div_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg σ)
  have hnoise : (1 - q) * V = ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) / frobSq A := by
    dsimp [q, V]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hσ0, ne_of_gt hF]
    ring
  induction N generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    let E := (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
    let G := ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)
    have hmean : (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (∑ ω : Fin (N + 1) → m,
        (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) • runSumError A b xs (N + 1) ω x) ≤ (1 + G) * E := by
