      rw [sum_paths_smul_runSumError_eq_sum_pow_mulVec A hA b xs hxs x (N + 1),
        dotProduct_sum]
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ t * E := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro t _
          exact (le_abs_self _).trans
            (by simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using
              abs_dotProduct_pow_meanError_mulVec_le_of_mem_range A hA σ hσnorm _ hx t)
        _ = (1 + G) * E := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_range_succ']
          simp only [pow_zero]
          dsimp [G]
          ring
    have hstep : (∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs))) ≤
        q * E + (1 - q) * V := by
      rw [hnoise]
      exact expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range A b xs x σ hσ hx
    have hfuture :
        (∑ i, prob A i * (∑ ω : Fin N → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) *
          (runSumError A b xs N ω (step A b x i) ⬝ᵥ
            runSumError A b xs N ω (step A b x i)))) ≤
        tailInitialWeight q N * (q * E + (1 - q) * V) +
          (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ i, prob A i *
            (tailInitialWeight q N * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) +
              (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (ih _ (step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range A b xs x hx i)) (prob_nonneg A i)
        _ = tailInitialWeight q N *
            (∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs))) +
              (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V := by
          simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_prob A hA,
            one_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (tailInitialWeight_nonneg hq0 N)) le_rfl
    have hrec := sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_succ A hA b xs x N
    simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hrec
    rw [hrec]
    have hc : 1 + 2 * G ≤ C := one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le hq0 hq1 N
    have ht : tailInitialWeight q (N + 1) = 1 + 2 * G + q * tailInitialWeight q N :=
      tailInitialWeight_succ q N
    rw [ht]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hcv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hV
    change -E + 2 * _ + _ ≤ _
    nlinarith only [hmean, hfuture, hcv]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_mem_range_transpose
statement:
private theorem moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_mem_range_transpose
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) :
    moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(moorePenroseInverse A)ᵀ *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b), ?_⟩
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have hs : (moorePenroseInverse A * A)ᵀ = moorePenroseInverse A * A :=
    (moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian A).eq
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hs, moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse]

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_sq_le
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin)
    (burn N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let xs
proof:
:= moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
    let κ := frobConditionNumber A
    let q := 1 - 1 / κ ^ 2
    let V := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ xs)‖ ^ 2
    let E := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2
    let M := ∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tailAverage A b x burn N ω - xs)‖ ^ 2
      ∂((kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA burn).toMeasure.prod
        (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA N).toMeasure)
    M ≤ q ^ burn * E + (2 * κ ^ 2 - 1) * V / N ∧
      M ≤ (2 * κ ^ 2 - 1) / N * (κ ^ 2 * q ^ burn / N * E + V) := by
  dsimp only
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  let xs := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
  let κ := frobConditionNumber A
  let q := 1 - 1 / κ ^ 2
  let V := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 * ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs))
  let E := (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
  let C := 2 * κ ^ 2 - 1
  have hM : 0 < specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) := by
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr ((moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA)
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A)
    (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hκ : 0 < κ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [κ, frobConditionNumber]
    rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq]
    exact mul_pos hF (sq_pos_of_pos hM)
  have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hκ
  have hr : 1 - (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 / frobSq A = q := by
    dsimp [q, κ, frobConditionNumber]
    rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, inv_pow]
  have hs := fun v (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) =>
    inv_specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq_mul_dotProduct_le A hv
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := hr ▸ rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A _ hs
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by dsimp [q]; linarith [one_div_pos.mpr hκ]
  have hC : (1 + q) / (1 - q) = C := by
    dsimp [q, C]
    field_simp [hκne]
    ring
  have hV : ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) /
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 = V := by
    dsimp [V]
    rw [inv_pow, div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have he : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin :=
    Submodule.sub_mem _ hx (moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_mem_range_transpose A b)
  have hsNorm : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hs
  have hb := integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_sq_le A hA b xs
    (isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b) (inv_pos.mpr hM) hsNorm
    x he burn N hN
  dsimp only at hb
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hb
  rw [hr, hC, hV] at hb
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hqE : 0 ≤ q ^ burn * E := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq0 burn) hE
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hw1 : tailInitialWeight q N / (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hNpos)]
    exact tailInitialWeight_le_sq hq0 hq1.le N
  have hw2 : tailInitialWeight q N ≤ C * κ ^ 2 := by
    have hw := tailInitialWeight_le_div hq0 hq1 N
    rw [hC] at hw
    have hd : C / (1 - q) = C * κ ^ 2 := by
      have hden : 1 - q = 1 / κ ^ 2 := by dsimp [q]; ring
      simp only [hden, one_div, div_inv_eq_mul]
    rwa [hd] at hw
  constructor
  · refine hb.trans ?_
    change (tailInitialWeight q N / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * q ^ burn * E + C * V / N ≤
      q ^ burn * E + C * V / N
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw1 hqE
    nlinarith only [ht]
  · refine hb.trans ?_
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw2 (sq_nonneg (N : ℝ))) hqE
    calc
      _ ≤ (C * κ ^ 2 / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * (q ^ burn * E) + C * V / N := by
        nlinarith only [ht]
      _ = C / N * (κ ^ 2 * q ^ burn / N * E + V) := by
        field_simp

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tendsto_integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_sq
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_sq
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (burn : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      ∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tailAverage A b x burn N ω - moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b)‖ ^ 2
        ∂((kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA burn).toMeasure.prod
          (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA N).toMeasure)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let xs := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
  let K := frobConditionNumber A ^ 2
  let q := 1 - 1 / K
  let V := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 *
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ xs)‖ ^ 2
  let E := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2
  let C := 2 * K - 1
  have hden : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ho : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C / N) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden
  have hi : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => K * q ^ burn / N) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C / N * (K * q ^ burn / N * E + V))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul, zero_add] using ho.mul ((hi.mul_const E).add_const V)
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun N =>
    integral_nonneg fun ω => sq_nonneg _)) _ hlimit
  apply Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr
  refine ⟨1, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  exact (integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_sq_le
    A hA b x hx burn N hN).2

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (hx : x - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) :
    ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
        (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst hA
    simp only [prob, frobSq_zero, div_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero,
      one_mul, add_zero]
    exact dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hterm : ∀ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) ≤
      prob A i * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) ^ 2 / frobSq A +
        (b - A *ᵥ xh) i ^ 2 / frobSq A := fun i => by
    rw [sqErr_step_eq_add A b xh x i]
    have hei : (b - A *ᵥ xh) i = b i - A i ⬝ᵥ xh := rfl
    rw [hei]
    by_cases ha : A i ⬝ᵥ A i = 0
    · have h0 : A i = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp ha
      have hp : prob A i = 0 := by simp [prob, h0]
      rw [hp, h0]
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_dotProduct, sub_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
        not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, zero_div, zero_add]
      exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg A)
    · rw [prob]
      apply le_of_eq
      field_simp
  set d := x - xh
  set e := b - A *ᵥ xh
  calc ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh))
      ≤ ∑ i, (prob A i * (d ⬝ᵥ d) - (A i ⬝ᵥ d) ^ 2 / frobSq A + e i ^ 2 / frobSq A) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hterm i
    _ = d ⬝ᵥ d - (A *ᵥ d) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ d) / frobSq A + e ⬝ᵥ e / frobSq A := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_prob A hA,
          one_mul, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_div, mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_sq]
        simp only [dotProduct, sq]
    _ ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * (d ⬝ᵥ d) + e ⬝ᵥ e / frobSq A := by
        have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hσ _ hx) hF.le
        rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
        linarith

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem expErr_le_add_of_sub_mem_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xh x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ j) *
        ((b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ρ := 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
  set c := (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := div_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (frobSq_nonneg A)
  have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ hσ
  have hsum1 : ∑ i, prob A i ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hA : A = 0
    · subst hA
      simp [prob]
    · rw [sum_prob A hA]
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [expErr_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ρ ^ j :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => pow_nonneg hρ j
    generalize ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ρ ^ j = T at ih hS ⊢
    calc ∑ i, prob A i * expErr A b xh (step A b x i) k
        ≤ ∑ i, prob A i * (ρ ^ k * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) + T * c) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (ih _ (step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range A b xh x hx i)) (prob_nonneg A i)
      _ = ρ ^ k * ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xh)) +
          (∑ i, prob A i) * (T * c) := by
          simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 1
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
      _ ≤ ρ ^ k * (ρ * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) + c) + 1 * (T * c) := by
          gcongr
          exact expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range A b xh x σ hσ hx
      _ = ρ ^ (k + 1) * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) + (T + ρ ^ k) * c := by ring

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_div_sq_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem expErr_le_add_div_sq_of_sub_mem_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xh x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
      (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / σ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (expErr_le_add_of_sub_mem_range A b xh σ hσ x hx k).trans
    (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
  set c := (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  by_cases hA : A = 0
  · subst hA
    simp only [frobSq_zero, div_zero, mul_zero]
    positivity
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A) (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hρ0 := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ hσ
  have hρ1 : 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A < 1 := by
    have : 0 < σ ^ 2 / frobSq A := div_pos (by positivity) hF
    linarith
  have hgeom : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ i ≤ frobSq A / σ ^ 2 := by
    have h := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 0) (n := k) hρ0 hρ1
    rw [← Finset.range_eq_Ico, pow_zero] at h
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    field_simp
    ring
  calc (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ i) * (c / frobSq A)
      ≤ frobSq A / σ ^ 2 * (c / frobSq A) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgeom (div_nonneg hc hF.le)
    _ = c / σ ^ 2 := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_sqErr_kaczmarz_le_add_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_kaczmarz_le_add_of_sub_mem_range
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin k → m, (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xh)
      ∂(kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA k).toMeasure) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ j) *
          ((b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / frobSq A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sqErr_kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA b xh x k]
  exact Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_of_sub_mem_range A b xh σ hσ x hx k

name: NLAlib.integral_sqErr_kaczmarz_le_add_div_sq_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_kaczmarz_le_add_div_sq_of_sub_mem_range
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xh ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin k → m, (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xh)
      ∂(kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA k).toMeasure) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) +
        (b - A *ᵥ xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xh) / σ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sqErr_kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA b xh x k]
  exact Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_div_sq_of_sub_mem_range A b xh hσ0 hσ x hx k

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.step_sub_solution
statement:
theorem step_sub_solution (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (S : Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (x : n → ℝ) :
    step A b S x - xs =
      (x - xs) - (moorePenroseInverse (Sᵀ * A) * (Sᵀ * A)) *ᵥ (x - xs)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Sᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - b) = (Sᵀ * A) *ᵥ (x - xs) := by
    rw [← hxs, ← Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  rw [step, h, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  abel

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expected_sqErr_step_eq
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1) (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b)
    (x : n → ℝ) :
    ∑ j, p j * ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs)) =
      (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) - (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (expectedProjector A p S *ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [step_sub_solution A b _ hxs x, dotProduct_self_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec,
    mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp1, one_mul, expectedProjector,
    Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.dotProduct_expectedProjector_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_expectedProjector_mulVec_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (p : J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1)
    (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ (expectedProjector A p S *ᵥ v) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expectedProjector, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  calc ∑ j, p j * (v ⬝ᵥ ((moorePenroseInverse ((S j)ᵀ * A) * ((S j)ᵀ * A)) *ᵥ v))
      ≤ ∑ j, p j * (v ⬝ᵥ v) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (dotProduct_moorePenroseInverse_mul_mulVec_le_dotProduct_self _ v) (hp j)
    _ = v ⬝ᵥ v := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hp1, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_le
statement:
theorem expErr_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)
    (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1) (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : ∀ v : n → ℝ, lam * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (expectedProjector A p S *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b p S xs x k ≤ (1 - lam) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hW := dotProduct_expectedProjector_mulVec_le A p hp hp1 S
  have hstep : ∀ x : n → ℝ, ∑ j, p j * ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs)) ≤
      (1 - lam) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := fun x => by
    rw [expected_sqErr_step_eq A b p hp1 S hxs x]
    have := hlam (x - xs)
    linarith
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · have h0 : ∀ v : n → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v = 0 := fun v => by simp [dotProduct]
    have : ∀ k (x : n → ℝ), expErr A b p S xs x k = 0 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro x; exact h0 _
      | succ k ih => intro x; simp [expErr, ih]
    rw [this, h0, mul_zero]
  have hρ : 0 ≤ 1 - lam := by
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := hn
    have h1 := hlam (Pi.single i 1)
    have h2 := hW (Pi.single i 1)
    have he : (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ Pi.single i 1 = 1 := by simp
    rw [he, mul_one] at h1
    rw [he] at h2
    linarith
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr]
  | succ k ih =>
    show ∑ j, p j * expErr A b p S xs (step A b (S j) x) k ≤ _
    calc ∑ j, p j * expErr A b p S xs (step A b (S j) x) k
        ≤ ∑ j, p j * ((1 - lam) ^ k * ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _) (hp j)
      _ = (1 - lam) ^ k * ∑ j, p j * ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
      _ ≤ (1 - lam) ^ k * ((1 - lam) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep x) (pow_nonneg hρ k)
      _ = (1 - lam) ^ (k + 1) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.step_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem step_sub_mem_range (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (S : Matrix m s ℝ)
    (xs x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) :
    step A b S x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  let B := moorePenroseInverse (Sᵀ * A)
  have hB : B = Aᵀ * (S * (Bᵀ * B)) := by
    have hsym : (B * (Sᵀ * A))ᵀ = B * (Sᵀ * A) :=
      moorePenroseInverse_mul_isHermitian (Sᵀ * A)
    calc B = B * (Sᵀ * A) * B :=
          (moorePenroseInverse_mul_moorePenroseInverse (Sᵀ * A)).symm
      _ = (B * (Sᵀ * A))ᵀ * B := by rw [hsym]
      _ = Aᵀ * (S * (Bᵀ * B)) := by
          rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hstep : step A b S x - xs = (x - xs) - B *ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - b)) := by
    dsimp [step, B]
    abel
  rw [hstep]
  refine Submodule.sub_mem _ hx ⟨(S * (Bᵀ * B)) *ᵥ (Sᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - b)), ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hB]

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range
statement:
theorem expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (p : J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1)
    (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      lam * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (expectedProjector A p S *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b p S xs x k ≤ (1 - lam) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hW := dotProduct_expectedProjector_mulVec_le A p hp hp1 S
  have hsol : ∀ k, expErr A b p S xs xs k = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp [expErr]
    | succ k ih => simp [expErr, step, hxs, ih]
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hx0 : x = xs
    · subst x
      simp [hsol]
    have hpos : 0 < (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (Ne.symm fun h =>
        hx0 (sub_eq_zero.mp (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h)))
    have hlam1 : lam ≤ 1 :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by simpa only [one_mul] using (hlam _ hx).trans (hW _)) hpos
    have hρ : 0 ≤ 1 - lam := sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1
    have hstep : ∑ j, p j * ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs)) ≤
        (1 - lam) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := by
      rw [expected_sqErr_step_eq A b p hp1 S hxs x]
      have := hlam _ hx
      linarith
    show ∑ j, p j * expErr A b p S xs (step A b (S j) x) k ≤ _
    calc ∑ j, p j * expErr A b p S xs (step A b (S j) x) k
        ≤ ∑ j, p j * ((1 - lam) ^ k *
            ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (ih _ (step_sub_mem_range A b (S j) xs x hx)) (hp j)
      _ = (1 - lam) ^ k * ∑ j, p j *
          ((step A b (S j) x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b (S j) x - xs)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
      _ ≤ (1 - lam) ^ k * ((1 - lam) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (pow_nonneg hρ k)
      _ = (1 - lam) ^ (k + 1) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_eq_sum_paths
statement:
theorem expErr_eq_sum_paths (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (p : J → ℝ) (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b p S xs x k = ∑ ω : Fin k → J,
      (∏ j, p (ω j)) * ((run A b S k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (run A b S k ω x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [expErr, run]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [expErr, ← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => J).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [ih, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
    simp [Fin.consEquiv, run, Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_sqErr_pathLaw
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_pathLaw [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1)
    (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (run A b S k ω x - xs)‖ ^ 2
      ∂pathLaw p hp hp1 k) = expErr A b p S xs x k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  rw [pathLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum, expErr_eq_sum_paths]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω _
  change (ENNReal.ofReal (∏ j, p (ω j))).toReal • _ = _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hp (ω j))]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_sqErr_pathLaw_le
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_pathLaw_le [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1)
    (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : ∀ v : n → ℝ, lam * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (expectedProjector A p S *ᵥ v))
    (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (run A b S k ω x - xs)‖ ^ 2
      ∂pathLaw p hp hp1 k) ≤ (1 - lam) ^ k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sqErr_pathLaw]
  simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using
    expErr_le A b p hp hp1 S hxs
      (by simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hlam) x k

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_sqErr_pathLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_pathLaw_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1)
    (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    {H : Ω → Fin k → J} (hH : HasLaw H (pathLaw p hp hp1 k) μ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (run A b S k (H ω) x - xs)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      expErr A b p S xs x k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_sqErr_pathLaw A b p hp hp1 S xs x k]
  exact hH.integral_comp ((measurable_of_finite (fun h : Fin k → J =>
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (run A b S k h x - xs)‖ ^ 2)).aestronglyMeasurable)

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_sqErr_pathLaw_le_of_sub_mem_range_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_pathLaw_le_of_sub_mem_range_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}

    (hlam : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,

    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ)
    {H : Ω → Fin k → J} (hH : HasLaw H (pathLaw p hp hp1 k) μ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (run A b S k (H ω) x - xs)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      (1 - lam) ^ k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2

:= by

  simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using

      (by simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hlam) x hx k

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_projector_sketchLaw

      ∂sketchLaw p hp hp1) = expectedProjector A p S
proof:
:= by

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_projector_sketchLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_projector_sketchLaw_of_hasLaw

      expectedProjector A p S
proof:

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.integral_sqErr_iidPathLaw_le_of_sub_mem_range
statement:

statement:
theorem integral_sqErr_iidPathLaw_le_of_sub_mem_range_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J]

    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (k : ℕ)

name: NLAlib.matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (ν : ι → Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) : 0 ≤ matrixDifferenceThirdMoment ν
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  exact integral_nonneg (fun p => div_nonneg
    (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_ae_norm_le
statement:
private theorem integrable_of_ae_norm_le {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → E} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:=
  (MemLp.of_bound hf C hC : MemLp f 1 μ).integrable le_rfl

name: NLAlib.integrable_id_of_ae_specNorm_centered_le
statement:
theorem integrable_id_of_ae_specNorm_centered_le
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    Integrable (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ => S) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hT : Integrable (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ => S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ν :=
    integrable_of_ae_norm_le (by fun_prop) hbound
  have hsum : Integrable (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ =>
      (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) + ∫ T, T ∂ν) ν := hT.add (integrable_const _)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel, id_eq] using hsum

name: NLAlib.memLp_id_of_ae_specNorm_centered_le
statement:
theorem memLp_id_of_ae_specNorm_centered_le
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ} {p : ENNReal}
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    MemLp (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ => S) p ν
proof:
:= by
  have hT : MemLp (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ => S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) p ν :=
    MemLp.of_bound (by fun_prop) L hbound
  have hsum : MemLp (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ =>
      (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) + ∫ T, T ∂ν) p ν := hT.add (memLp_const _)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hsum

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrix_centered_pow_of_ae_specNorm_le
statement:
theorem integrable_matrix_centered_pow_of_ae_specNorm_le
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ => (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ^ k) ν
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_of_ae_norm_le (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [hbound] with S hS
  exact (norm_pow_le _ k).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hS k)

name: NLAlib.integral_matrix_centered_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_matrix_centered_eq_zero
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    (∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ∂ν) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun S : Matrix n n ℂ => S) ν :=
    integrable_id_of_ae_specNorm_centered_le ν hbound
  calc
    _ = (∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, S ∂ν) - ∫ _ : Matrix n n ℂ, (∫ T, T ∂ν) ∂ν :=
      integral_sub hi (integrable_const _)
    _ = 0 := by simp

name: NLAlib.ae_specNorm_matrix_sub_copy_le
statement:
theorem ae_specNorm_matrix_sub_copy_le
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    ∀ᵐ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ ∂ν.prod ν,
      specNorm (p.1 - p.2) ≤ 2 * L
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hbound,
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hbound] with p hp hq
  have he : p.1 - p.2 = (p.1 - ∫ T, T ∂ν) - (p.2 - ∫ T, T ∂ν) := by abel
  rw [he]
  change ‖p.1 - ∫ T, T ∂ν‖ ≤ L at hp
  change ‖p.2 - ∫ T, T ∂ν‖ ≤ L at hq
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hp, hq])

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrix_sub_copy_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_matrix_sub_copy_sq
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    Integrable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => (p.1 - p.2) ^ 2) (ν.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_of_ae_norm_le (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [ae_specNorm_matrix_sub_copy_le ν hbound] with p hp
  exact (norm_pow_le _ 2).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp 2)

name: NLAlib.integral_matrix_sub_copy_sq
statement:
theorem integral_matrix_sub_copy_sq
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    (∫ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ, (p.1 - p.2) ^ 2 ∂ν.prod ν) =
      2 • ∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ^ 2 ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun S => S - ∫ R, R ∂ν
  have hT : Integrable T ν := by
    exact integrable_of_ae_norm_le (by fun_prop) hbound
  have hT2 : Integrable (fun S => T S ^ 2) ν :=
    integrable_matrix_centered_pow_of_ae_specNorm_le ν hL hbound 2
  have hmean : (∫ S, T S ∂ν) = 0 := integral_matrix_centered_eq_zero ν hbound
  have hcross := integral_prod_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ)) hT hT
  have hcross' := integral_prod_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ)).flip hT hT
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', hmean, mul_zero] at hcross
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', hmean, mul_zero] at hcross'
  have hexpand (p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ) :
      (p.1 - p.2) ^ 2 = T p.1 ^ 2 - T p.1 * T p.2 - T p.2 * T p.1 + T p.2 ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [T]
    noncomm_ring
  have hrev : Integrable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ => T p.2 * T p.1) (ν.prod ν) :=
    (hT.mul_prod hT).swap
  have hfirst : Integrable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ =>
      T p.1 ^ 2 - T p.1 * T p.2) (ν.prod ν) := (hT2.comp_fst ν).sub (hT.mul_prod hT)
  have hsecond : Integrable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ =>
      T p.1 ^ 2 - T p.1 * T p.2 - T p.2 * T p.1) (ν.prod ν) := hfirst.sub hrev
  simp_rw [hexpand]
  rw [integral_add hsecond (hT2.comp_snd ν), integral_sub hfirst hrev,
    integral_sub (hT2.comp_fst ν) (hT.mul_prod hT), hcross, hcross',
    integral_fun_fst (μ := ν) (ν := ν) (fun S => T S ^ 2),
    integral_fun_snd (μ := ν) (ν := ν) (fun S => T S ^ 2)]
  simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul, sub_zero, two_smul, T]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_sq_nonneg
statement:
private theorem re_trace_sq_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    0 ≤ (A ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow A hA]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integrable_re_trace
proof:
