    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hf).re

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_matrix_sub_copy_pow_three
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_matrix_sub_copy_pow_three
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, S.IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    Integrable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ =>
      schattenNormReal (p.1 - p.2) 3 ^ 3) (ν.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ =>
      schattenNormReal (p.1 - p.2) 3 ^ 3) (ν.prod ν) :=
    (((continuous_schattenNormReal (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).comp
      (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)).pow 3).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply (MemLp.of_bound hm ((2 * L) * (Fintype.card n * (2 * L) ^ 2)) ?_ :
    MemLp _ 1 (ν.prod ν)).integrable le_rfl
  filter_upwards [ae_specNorm_matrix_sub_copy_le ν hbound,
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hHerm,
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hHerm] with p hp hH1 hH2
  have hH := hH1.sub hH2
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _)]
  have htr : ((p.1 - p.2) ^ 2).trace.re ≤ Fintype.card n * (2 * L) ^ 2 := by
    apply (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans
    apply (norm_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm _).trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact (norm_pow_le _ 2).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp 2)
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (p.1 - p.2) * ((p.1 - p.2) ^ 2).trace.re :=
      schattenNormReal_pow_three_le_specNorm_mul_re_trace_sq hH
    _ ≤ (2 * L) * (Fintype.card n * (2 * L) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul hp htr (re_trace_sq_nonneg hH) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_matrix_sub_copy_pow_three_div_card_le
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_matrix_sub_copy_pow_three_div_card_le
    (ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, S.IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ S ∂ν, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ≤ L) :
    (∫ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ,
      schattenNormReal (p.1 - p.2) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂ν.prod ν) ≤
      4 * L * ((∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ^ 2 ∂ν).trace.re /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hcubic := integrable_schattenNormReal_matrix_sub_copy_pow_three ν hL hHerm hbound
  have hsq := integrable_matrix_sub_copy_sq ν hL hbound
  have htr := integrable_re_trace hsq
  have hh := integral_mono_ae hcubic (htr.const_mul (2 * L)) ?_
  swap
  · filter_upwards [ae_specNorm_matrix_sub_copy_le ν hbound,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hHerm,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hHerm] with p hp hH1 hH2
    have hH := hH1.sub hH2
    exact (schattenNormReal_pow_three_le_specNorm_mul_re_trace_sq hH).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (re_trace_sq_nonneg hH))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hh
  have he : (∫ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ, ((p.1 - p.2) ^ 2).trace.re ∂ν.prod ν) =
      2 * (∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν) ^ 2 ∂ν).trace.re := by
    have ht : (∫ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ, (p.1 - p.2) ^ 2 ∂ν.prod ν).trace.re =
        ∫ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ, ((p.1 - p.2) ^ 2).trace.re ∂ν.prod ν := by
      simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using Matrix.re_trace_integral hsq
    rw [← ht, integral_matrix_sub_copy_sq ν hL hbound]
    simp [two_smul, two_mul]
  rw [integral_div]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((2 * L) * ∫ p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ,
        ((p.1 - p.2) ^ 2).trace.re ∂ν.prod ν) / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [he]; ring

name: NLAlib.matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance
statement:
theorem matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_le_four_mul_bound_mul_variance
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ν : ι → Measure (Matrix n n ℂ))
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ S ∂ν i, S.IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ S ∂ν i, specNorm (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν i) ≤ L) :
    matrixDifferenceThirdMoment ν ≤
      4 * L * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν i) ^ 2 ∂ν i)
proof:
:= by
  let V := ∑ i, ∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν i) ^ 2 ∂ν i
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have htrace : V.trace.re / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ≤ specNorm V := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖V.trace‖ / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Complex.re_le_norm _) hd.le
      _ ≤ ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * specNorm V) / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_trace_le_card_mul_specNorm V) hd.le
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, 4 * L * ((∫ S : Matrix n n ℂ, (S - ∫ T, T ∂ν i) ^ 2 ∂ν i).trace.re /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ =>
      integral_schattenNormReal_matrix_sub_copy_pow_three_div_card_le (ν i) hL (hHerm i) (hbound i))
    _ = 4 * L * (V.trace.re / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [V, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum, Finset.sum_div, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htrace (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_norm_mulVec_pow_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_norm_mulVec_pow_two_mul_le
    {Ω α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (z : Ω → α → ℝ) (hz : AEMeasurable z μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hmoment : ∀ a : α → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ z ω) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ z ω) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ C * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p))
    (T : Matrix β α ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ z ω)‖ ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ z ω)‖ ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ C * frobSq T ^ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : β → ℝ := fun i => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (T i)‖
  let u : β → α → ℝ := fun i => (c i)⁻¹ • T i
  let X : β → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => u i ⬝ᵥ z ω
  have hu (i : β) : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (u i)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hci : c i = 0
    · simp [u, hci]
    · have hc : 0 ≤ c i := norm_nonneg _
      simp only [u, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hc)]
      change (c i)⁻¹ * c i ≤ 1
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hci]
  have hXi (i : β) : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω ^ (2 * p)) μ := (hmoment (u i)).1
  have hXm (i : β) : (∫ ω, X i ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ C := by
    apply (hmoment (u i)).2.trans
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hC (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hu i))
  have h := integrable_and_integral_sum_mul_sq_pow_le c X
    (fun i => by dsimp [X]; fun_prop) hp hXi hXm
  have hentry (i : β) (ω : Ω) : c i * X i ω = T i ⬝ᵥ z ω := by
    by_cases hci : c i = 0
    · have hT : T i = 0 := by
        apply WithLp.toLp_injective (p := 2)
        simpa only [WithLp.toLp_zero] using (norm_eq_zero.mp hci)
      simp [hT, hci]
    · simp [X, u, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, hci]
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ z ω)‖ ^ (2 * p) =
      (∑ i, (c i * X i ω) ^ 2) ^ p := by
    rw [pow_mul, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, dotProduct, ← pow_two, hentry]
  have hcoeff : (∑ i, c i ^ 2) = frobSq T := by
    simp only [c, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, dotProduct, ← pow_two,
      frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  simpa only [← hpoint, hcoeff] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_bilinear_real_smul
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_smul,Matrix.mulVec_smul,star_smul,star_trivial,
    smul_dotProduct,dotProduct_smul,smul_smul,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.unitBall_bilinear_budget_of_unitSphere
statement:
private theorem unitBall_bilinear_budget_of_unitSphere
    (μ : Measure M) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0≤b)
    (h : ∀ v w : E, ‖v‖=1 → ‖w‖=1 →
      (∫ A : M, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ)≤b)
    (v w : E) (hv : ‖v‖≤1) (hw : ‖w‖≤1) :
    (∫ A : M, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ)≤b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv0 : v=0
  · simpa [hv0] using hb
  by_cases hw0 : w=0
  · simpa [hw0] using hb
  let v' := NormedSpace.normalize v
  let w' := NormedSpace.normalize w
  have hn : ‖v‖*‖w‖≤1 := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul hv hw (norm_nonneg w) (show (0 : ℝ)≤1 by norm_num)
  have hscale : (‖v‖*‖w‖)^2≤1 := pow_le_one₀ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg v) (norm_nonneg w)) hn
  have he (A : M) :
      ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 =
        (‖v‖*‖w‖)^2 * ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖^2 := by
    have hh := norm_bilinear_real_smul (A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) v' w' ‖v‖ ‖w‖
    simp only [v',w',NormedSpace.norm_smul_normalize,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at hh
    rw [hh]
    ring
  calc
    _ = (‖v‖*‖w‖)^2 *
        (∫ A : M, ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) := by
      simp_rw [he]
      exact integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ ∫ A : M, ‖star v'.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w'.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_left (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _) hscale
    _ ≤ b := h v' w' (NormedSpace.norm_normalize hv0) (NormedSpace.norm_normalize hw0)

name: NLAlib.bilinearWeakVariance_eq_sSup_unitSphere
statement:
theorem bilinearWeakVariance_eq_sSup_unitSphere [Nonempty n]
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ) :
    bilinearWeakVariance μ = sSup ((fun q : E×E => ∫ A : M,
      ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) ''
        {q | ‖q.1‖=1 ∧ ‖q.2‖=1})
proof:
:= by
  let S := ((fun q : E×E => ∫ A : M,
    ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) ''
      {q | ‖q.1‖=1 ∧ ‖q.2‖=1})
  have hSb : BddAbove S := (bddAbove_centered_bilinear_moments μ hμ).mono (by
    rintro _ ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q,⟨hq.1.le,hq.2.le⟩,rfl⟩)
  have hSn : 0≤sSup S := by
    apply Real.sSup_nonneg
    rintro _ ⟨q,_,rfl⟩
    exact integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := exists_norm_eq E (show (0 : ℝ)≤1 by norm_num)
    exact ⟨_,⟨(v,v),⟨hv,hv⟩,rfl⟩⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply bilinearWeakVariance_le μ
    exact unitBall_bilinear_budget_of_unitSphere μ hSn
      (fun v w hv hw => le_csSup hSb ⟨(v,w),⟨hv,hw⟩,rfl⟩)
  · apply csSup_le hSne
    rintro _ ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    exact integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance μ hμ q.1 q.2 hq.1.le hq.2.le

name: NLAlib.bilinearWeakVariance_le_of_unitSphere
statement:
theorem bilinearWeakVariance_le_of_unitSphere (μ : Measure M) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0≤b)
    (h : ∀ v w : E, ‖v‖=1 → ‖w‖=1 →
      (∫ A : M, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ)≤b) :
    bilinearWeakVariance μ≤b
proof:
:=
  bilinearWeakVariance_le μ (unitBall_bilinear_budget_of_unitSphere μ hb h)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_bilinearWeakVariance_eq_sSup_unitSphere
statement:
theorem sqrt_bilinearWeakVariance_eq_sSup_unitSphere [Nonempty n]
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ) :
    Real.sqrt (bilinearWeakVariance μ) = sSup ((fun q : E×E => Real.sqrt (∫ A : M,
      ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ)) ''
        {q | ‖q.1‖=1 ∧ ‖q.2‖=1})
proof:
:= by
  let S := ((fun q : E×E => Real.sqrt (∫ A : M,
    ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ)) ''
      {q | ‖q.1‖=1 ∧ ‖q.2‖=1})
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := exists_norm_eq E (show (0 : ℝ)≤1 by norm_num)
    exact ⟨_,⟨(v,v),⟨hv,hv⟩,rfl⟩⟩
  have hLUB : IsLUB S (Real.sqrt (bilinearWeakVariance μ)) := by
    constructor
    · rintro _ ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance
        μ hμ q.1 q.2 hq.1.le hq.2.le)
    · intro b hb
      have hb0 : 0≤b := by
        obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hSne
        have hr0 : 0≤r := by
          rcases hr with ⟨q,_,rfl⟩
          exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        exact hr0.trans (hb hr)
      apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨hb0,?_⟩
      apply bilinearWeakVariance_le_of_unitSphere μ (sq_nonneg b)
      intro v w hv hw
      exact (Real.sqrt_le_iff.mp (hb ⟨(v,w),⟨hv,hw⟩,rfl⟩)).2
  exact (hLUB.csSup_eq hSne).symm

name: NLAlib.sum_integral_norm_sq_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance_shifted_sum
statement:
theorem sum_integral_norm_sq_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance_shifted_sum
    {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → M) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω)≤R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i=0)
    (A₀ : M) (v w : E) (hv : ‖v‖≤1) (hw : ‖w‖≤1) :
    (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i) ≤
      bilinearWeakVariance ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → Ω => A₀+∑ i,Z i (x i)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : SecondCountableTopology M := inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let X (x : ι → Ω) := A₀+∑ i,Z i (x i)
  let ρ := (Measure.pi ν).map X
  have hXm : Measurable X := measurable_const.add (Finset.measurable_fun_sum _ fun i _ =>
    (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hLaw : HasLaw X ρ (Measure.pi ν) := ⟨hXm.aemeasurable,rfl⟩
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := (Measure.pi ν).isProbabilityMeasure_map hXm.aemeasurable
  have hZi (i : ι) : MemLp (Z i) 2 (ν i) :=
    MemLp.of_bound (hZm i).aestronglyMeasurable R (hZ i)
  have hsum : MemLp (fun x : ι → Ω => ∑ i,Z i (x i)) 2 (Measure.pi ν) :=
    memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
      (hZi i).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν i)
  have hX : MemLp X 2 (Measure.pi ν) := (memLp_const A₀).add hsum
  have hρ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 ρ :=
    (memLp_map_measure_iff aestronglyMeasurable_id hXm.aemeasurable).mpr (by
      simpa only [Function.id_comp] using hX)
  have hsummean : (∫ x : ι → Ω, ∑ i,Z i (x i) ∂Measure.pi ν)=0 := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (f := fun i (x : ι → Ω) => Z i (x i)) (fun i _ =>
      (measurePreserving_eval ν i).integrable_comp_of_integrable ((hZi i).integrable one_le_two))]
    simp only [integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := _) (hZi _).aestronglyMeasurable,
      hmean,Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hm : (∫ A : M,A ∂ρ)=A₀ := by
    rw [← hLaw.integral_eq]
    change (∫ x : ι → Ω,A₀+(∑ i,Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν)=A₀
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const A₀) (hsum.integrable one_le_two),
      integral_const,hsummean]
    simp
  have hc : Continuous (fun A : M =>
      ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M,B ∂ρ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2) := by fun_prop
  have he := hLaw.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_def,X,hm,add_sub_cancel_left] at he
  rw [← integral_norm_sq_bilinear_sum_pi_eq_sum ν Z hZm hZ hmean v w,he]
  simpa only [hm] using
    integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance ρ hρ v w hv hw

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_fderiv_sub_sub_smul_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_fderiv_sub_sub_smul_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (x D V : Ω → E) (hxm : AEMeasurable x μ) (hDm : AEMeasurable D μ)
    (hVm : AEMeasurable V μ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (L (D ω)) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (L (V ω)) ≤ r) :
    let Φ : E → ℂ
proof:
:= fun y => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
    Integrable (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => (fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω + a • D ω) - fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω)) (D ω) -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x ω - a • V ω) ![D ω, D ω]) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω + a • D ω) - fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω)) (D ω) -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x ω - a • V ω) ![D ω, D ω] ∂μ) =
        a ^ 2 • ∫ ω, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) ∂μ := by
  dsimp only
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun y => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let C : ℝ := 2 * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p + 3) * r ^ 3
  have hKm : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)) μ := by
    have hc := (continuous_resolventMomentTaylorKernel A hA ζ hζ p a).measurable
    have h := hc.comp_aemeasurable (hxm.prodMk (hDm.prodMk hVm))
    exact h.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hKb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      ‖resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [hBound] with ω hω
    apply norm_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_le A hA ζ hζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) hr
    · simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω.1
    · simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω.2
  have hKi : Integrable
      (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)) μ :=
    (integrable_const C).mono' hKm hKb
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) :
      (fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω + a • D ω) - fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω)) (D ω) -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x ω - a • V ω) ![D ω, D ω] =
      a ^ 2 • resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) :=
    fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
      A hA ζ hζ p (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) a
  refine ⟨hKi, (hKi.smul (a ^ 2)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hpoint ω).symm), ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, a ^ 2 • resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    _ = _ := integral_smul _ _

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (γ : Measure (ι → M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (U V : Ω → ι → M) (hU : HasLaw U γ μ) (hV : HasLaw V γ μ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, specNorm (A i) ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, (U ω i - V ω i) ^ 2)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, (U ω i - V ω i) ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤
        4 * ∫ A, specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2) ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := hU.isProbabilityMeasure
  let F : (ι → M) → ℝ := fun A => specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2)
  have hFc : Continuous F := by
    simp only [F, specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  have hFi : Integrable F γ := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound hFc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R ^ 2) ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hBound] with A hA
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
    change ‖∑ i, A i ^ 2‖ ≤ _
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖A i ^ 2‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, R ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [pow_two]
        exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (by
          simpa only [pow_two] using (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (A i)) hR).mpr (hA i))
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hUi : Integrable (fun ω => F (U ω)) μ := by
    have hi : Integrable F (μ.map U) := by rwa [hU.map_eq]
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hU.aemeasurable
  have hVi : Integrable (fun ω => F (V ω)) μ := by
    have hi : Integrable F (μ.map V) := by rwa [hV.map_eq]
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hV.aemeasurable
  have hUH : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ i, (U ω i).IsHermitian := by
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun A : ι → M => ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) hU.aemeasurable
    rw [hU.map_eq]
    exact ae_all_iff.mpr hHerm
  have hVH : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ i, (V ω i).IsHermitian := by
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun A : ι → M => ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) hV.aemeasurable
    rw [hV.map_eq]
    exact ae_all_iff.mpr hHerm
  have hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (∑ i, (U ω i - V ω i) ^ 2) ≤
      2 * (F (U ω) + F (V ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hUH, hVH] with ω hωU hωV
    exact specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le (U ω) (V ω) hωU hωV
  have hDiffMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, (U ω i - V ω i) ^ 2)) μ := by
    exact (hFc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
      (hU.aemeasurable.sub hV.aemeasurable)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hDomInt := (hUi.add hVi).const_mul 2
  have hDiffInt : Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, (U ω i - V ω i) ^ 2)) μ := by
    refine hDomInt.mono' hDiffMeas ?_
    filter_upwards [hdom] with ω hω
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _), Pi.add_apply] using hω
  refine ⟨hDiffInt, ?_⟩
  have heU : (∫ ω, F (U ω) ∂μ) = ∫ A, F A ∂γ :=
    hU.integral_comp hFi.aestronglyMeasurable
  have heV : (∫ ω, F (V ω) ∂μ) = ∫ A, F A ∂γ :=
    hV.integral_comp hFi.aestronglyMeasurable
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ ω, 2 * (F (U ω) + F (V ω)) ∂μ := integral_mono_ae hDiffInt hDomInt hdom
    _ = 2 * ((∫ ω, F (U ω) ∂μ) + ∫ ω, F (V ω) ∂μ) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hUi hVi]
    _ = _ := by rw [heU, heV]; dsimp [F]; ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_copy_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_copy_sub_sq_le
    (γ : Measure (ι → M)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, specNorm (A i) ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun p : (ι → M) × (ι → M) =>
      specNorm (∑ i, (p.1 i - p.2 i) ^ 2)) (γ.prod γ) ∧
      (∫ p : (ι → M) × (ι → M), specNorm (∑ i, (p.1 i - p.2 i) ^ 2) ∂γ.prod γ) ≤
        4 * ∫ A, specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2) ∂γ
proof:
:=
  integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le_of_hasLaw γ Prod.fst Prod.snd
    (measurePreserving_fst (μ := γ) (ν := γ)).hasLaw
    (measurePreserving_snd (μ := γ) (ν := γ)).hasLaw hR hHerm hBound

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_prod_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_prod_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : ι → Ω → M) (hMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => specNorm (∑ i, (Z i p.1 - Z i p.2) ^ 2))
      (μ.prod μ) ∧
      (∫ p : Ω × Ω, specNorm (∑ i, (Z i p.1 - Z i p.2) ^ 2) ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
        4 * ∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let F : Ω → ι → M := fun ω i => Z i ω
  have hFm : Measurable F := measurable_pi_iff.mpr hMeas
  let γ : Measure (ι → M) := μ.map F
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure γ := μ.isProbabilityMeasure_map hFm.aemeasurable
  have hF : HasLaw F γ μ := ⟨hFm.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have hγHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, (A i).IsHermitian := by
    intro i
    apply (ae_map_iff hFm.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · exact hHerm i
    · change MeasurableSet {A : ι → M | (A i)ᴴ = A i}
      exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : ι → M => (A i)ᴴ))
        (continuous_apply i)).measurableSet
  have hγBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, specNorm (A i) ≤ R := by
    intro i
    apply (ae_map_iff hFm.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · exact hBound i
    · have hc : Continuous (fun A : ι → M => specNorm (A i)) := by
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (continuous_apply i).norm
      exact (isClosed_le hc continuous_const).measurableSet
  have hU : HasLaw (fun p : Ω × Ω => F p.1) γ (μ.prod μ) :=
    hF.fun_comp (measurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).hasLaw
  have hV : HasLaw (fun p : Ω × Ω => F p.2) γ (μ.prod μ) :=
    hF.fun_comp (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).hasLaw
  have h := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le_of_hasLaw γ
    (fun p : Ω × Ω => F p.1) (fun p : Ω × Ω => F p.2) hU hV hR hγHerm hγBound
  have hc : Continuous (fun A : ι → M => specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2)) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  have he : (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) ∂μ) =
      ∫ A, specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2) ∂γ := hF.integral_comp hc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  rwa [← he] at h

name: NLAlib.aemeasurable_resolventCubicRemainder
statement:
private theorem aemeasurable_resolventCubicRemainder
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (A D F : Ω → M) (hA : AEMeasurable A μ) (hD : AEMeasurable D μ)
    (hF : AEMeasurable F μ) (a : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) :
    AEMeasurable (fun ω => resolventCubicRemainder (A ω) (D ω) (F ω) a ζ) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ := (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hA
  have h₁ := (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable (hA.sub (hD.const_smul a))
  have h₂ := (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable (hA.sub (hF.const_smul a))
  have hE := hF.sub hD
  unfold resolventCubicRemainder
  exact ((((((h₀.mul hF).mul h₂).mul hD).mul h₁).mul hD).mul h₀).add
    ((((((h₂.mul hD).mul h₁).mul hE).mul h₂).mul hD).mul h₀) |>.add
    ((((((h₂.mul hD).mul h₂).mul hD).mul h₀).mul hF).mul h₂) |>.add
    ((((((h₁.mul hE).mul h₂).mul hD).mul h₀).mul hD).mul h₁) |>.add
    ((((((h₂.mul hD).mul h₀).mul hF).mul h₂).mul hD).mul h₁) |>.add
    ((((((h₂.mul hD).mul h₂).mul hD).mul h₁).mul hE).mul h₂)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_resolventCubicRemainder_le_uniform
statement:
private theorem specNorm_resolventCubicRemainder_le_uniform
    (A D F : M) (a r : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hDn : specNorm D ≤ r) (hFn : specNorm F ≤ r)
    (hEn : specNorm (F - D) ≤ r) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm (resolventCubicRemainder A D F a ζ) ≤
      12 * r ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + 9 * a ^ 2 * r ^ 5 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  have hsq (X : M) (hX : X.IsHermitian) (hXn : specNorm X ≤ r) :
      specNorm (X ^ 2) ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    have hs : specNorm X ^ 2 = specNorm (X ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [hX.eq, pow_two] using specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self X
    rw [← hs]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hr).mpr hXn
  have h := specNorm_sum_resolventCubicRemainder_le A (fun _ : Unit => D)
    (fun _ : Unit => F) a r ζ hA (fun _ => hD) (fun _ => hF) hr
    (fun _ => hDn) (fun _ => hFn) (fun _ => hEn) hζ
  simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have hD₂ := hsq D hD hDn
  have hF₂ := hsq F hF hFn
  have hE₂ := hsq (F - D) (hF.sub hD) hEn
  have h₁ : 8 * specNorm (D ^ 2) + 2 * specNorm ((F - D) ^ 2) +
      2 * specNorm (F ^ 2) ≤ 8 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r ^ 2 := by
    linarith only [hD₂, hF₂, hE₂]
  have h₂ : 3 * specNorm (D ^ 2) + 6 * specNorm (F ^ 2) ≤ 3 * r ^ 2 + 6 * r ^ 2 := by
    linarith only [hD₂, hF₂]
  calc
    _ ≤ r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 *
        (8 * specNorm (D ^ 2) + 2 * specNorm ((F - D) ^ 2) + 2 * specNorm (F ^ 2)) +
        a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6 * (3 * specNorm (D ^ 2) + 6 * specNorm (F ^ 2)) := h
    _ ≤ r * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 * (8 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r ^ 2) +
        a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6 * (3 * r ^ 2 + 6 * r ^ 2) := by
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ (by positivity))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_specNorm_card_smul_integral_resolventCubicRemainder_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_specNorm_card_smul_integral_resolventCubicRemainder_le
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (L : E →L[ℝ] M)
    (A : C × Z → M)
    (hAm : AEMeasurable A ((Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1).prod γ))
    (hAH : ∀ᵐ q ∂(Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1).prod γ, (A q).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, (L x).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (a : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    let P
proof:
:= (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1).prod γ
    let Q := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
    let D := fun (q : C × Z) i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 1))
    let F := fun (q : C × Z) i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 2))
    let T := fun (q : C × Z) i => resolventCubicRemainder (A q) (D q i) (F q i) a ζ
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => T (q.1.2, q.2) q.1.1) Q ∧
      (∀ i, Integrable (fun q : C × Z => T q i) P) ∧
      specNorm ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) •
        (∫ q : (ι × C) × Z, T (q.1.2, q.2) q.1.1 ∂Q)) ≤
        (96 * R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + 288 * a ^ 2 * R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) *
          ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let P₀ := Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1
  let P := P₀.prod γ
  let Q := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
  let drop : (ι × C) × Z → C × Z := fun q => (q.1.2, q.2)
  let D : (C × Z) → ι → M := fun q i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 1))
  let F : (C × Z) → ι → M := fun q i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 2))
  let T : (C × Z) → ι → M := fun q i => resolventCubicRemainder (A q) (D q i) (F q i) a ζ
  let m : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → (C × Z) → ℝ := fun s t q =>
    specNorm (∑ i, (L (q.1 (i, s) - q.1 (i, t))) ^ 2)
  let σ : ℝ := ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν
  let r : ℝ := 2 * R
  let c : ℝ := |ζ.im|⁻¹
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)
  have hdrop : MeasurePreserving drop Q P := by
    exact (measurePreserving_snd (μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure) (ν := P)).comp
      (measurePreserving_prodAssoc (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure P₀ γ)
  have hAll : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, ∀ i, ∀ s : Fin 3,
      (L (q.1 (i, s))).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (L (q.1 (i, s))) ≤ R := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro s
    have hl := (measurePreserving_eval (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) (i, s)).hasLaw.comp
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P₀) (ν := γ)).hasLaw
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : E => (L x).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (L x) ≤ R) hl.aemeasurable
    rw [hl.map_eq]
    filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with x hH hB
    exact ⟨hH, hB⟩
  have hE (q : C × Z) (i : ι) : F q i - D q i = L (q.1 (i, 1) - q.1 (i, 2)) := by
    simp only [F, D, map_sub]
    abel
  have hGood : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, (A q).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ i,
      (D q i).IsHermitian ∧ (F q i).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (D q i) ≤ r ∧
        specNorm (F q i) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (F q i - D q i) ≤ r := by
    filter_upwards [hAH, hAll] with q hA hq
    refine ⟨hA, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hsub (s t : Fin 3) : specNorm (L (q.1 (i, s) - q.1 (i, t))) ≤ r := by
      rw [map_sub]
      exact (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by dsimp [r]; linarith [(hq i s).2, (hq i t).2])
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hsub 0 1, hsub 0 2, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [D]; rw [map_sub]; exact (hq i 0).1.sub (hq i 1).1
    · dsimp [F]; rw [map_sub]; exact (hq i 0).1.sub (hq i 2).1
    · rw [hE]; exact hsub 1 2
  have hLmeas (i : ι) (s : Fin 3) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z => L (q.1 (i, s))) :=
    L.continuous.measurable.comp ((measurable_pi_apply (i, s)).comp measurable_fst)
  have hDmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z => D q i) := by
    simpa only [D, map_sub] using (hLmeas i 0).fun_sub (hLmeas i 1)
  have hFmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z => F q i) := by
    simpa only [F, map_sub] using (hLmeas i 0).fun_sub (hLmeas i 2)
  have hTi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun q : C × Z => T q i) P := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (aemeasurable_resolventCubicRemainder A _ _ hAm (hDmeas i).aemeasurable
        (hFmeas i).aemeasurable a ζ).aestronglyMeasurable
      (12 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 4 + 9 * a ^ 2 * r ^ 5 * c ^ 6) ?_
    filter_upwards [hGood] with q hq
    exact specNorm_resolventCubicRemainder_le_uniform (A q) (D q i) (F q i) a r ζ hq.1
      (hq.2 i).1 (hq.2 i).2.1 hr (hq.2 i).2.2.1 (hq.2 i).2.2.2.1
      (hq.2 i).2.2.2.2 hζ
  have hDs : Measurable (fun p : ι × C => L (p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 1))) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    simpa only [map_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Function.comp_def] using
      (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 0))).fun_sub
        (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 1)))
  have hFs : Measurable (fun p : ι × C => L (p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 2))) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    simpa only [map_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Function.comp_def] using
      (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 0))).fun_sub
        (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 2)))
  have hGoodSel : ∀ᵐ q ∂Q, (A (drop q)).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ i,
      (D (drop q) i).IsHermitian ∧ (F (drop q) i).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (D (drop q) i) ≤ r ∧
        specNorm (F (drop q) i) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (F (drop q) i - D (drop q) i) ≤ r := by
    exact ae_of_ae_map (p := fun q : C × Z => (A q).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ i,
      (D q i).IsHermitian ∧ (F q i).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (D q i) ≤ r ∧
        specNorm (F q i) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (F q i - D q i) ≤ r)
      hdrop.measurable.aemeasurable (by rw [hdrop.map_eq]; exact hGood)
  have hAmpull : AEMeasurable (A ∘ drop) Q := by
    have hh : AEMeasurable A (Q.map drop) := by rwa [hdrop.map_eq]
    exact hh.comp_aemeasurable hdrop.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hTsel : Integrable (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => T (drop q) q.1.1) Q := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (aemeasurable_resolventCubicRemainder (A ∘ drop) _ _
        hAmpull (hDs.comp measurable_fst).aemeasurable
        (hFs.comp measurable_fst).aemeasurable a ζ).aestronglyMeasurable
      (12 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 4 + 9 * a ^ 2 * r ^ 5 * c ^ 6) ?_
    filter_upwards [hGoodSel] with q hq
    exact specNorm_resolventCubicRemainder_le_uniform _ _ _ a r ζ hq.1
      (hq.2 q.1.1).1 (hq.2 q.1.1).2.1 hr (hq.2 q.1.1).2.2.1
      (hq.2 q.1.1).2.2.2.1 (hq.2 q.1.1).2.2.2.2 hζ
  refine ⟨hTsel, hTi, ?_⟩
  have hm (s t : Fin 3) : Integrable (m s t) P ∧ (∫ q, m s t q ∂P) ≤ 4 * σ := by
    have hs := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_resamplingTriple_prod_copy_sub_sq_le
      ν γ L hR hHerm hBound s t
    have hmc : Measurable (m s t) := by
      have hsub (i : ι) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z =>
          L (q.1 (i, s)) - L (q.1 (i, t))) := (hLmeas i s).sub (hLmeas i t)
      have hsum : Measurable (fun q : C × Z =>
          ∑ i, (L (q.1 (i, s)) - L (q.1 (i, t))) ^ 2) := by
        apply Finset.measurable_sum
        intro i _
        simpa only [pow_two] using (hsub i).matrix_mul (hsub i)
      simpa only [m, map_sub, specNorm_eq_norm, Function.comp_def] using
        continuous_norm.measurable.comp hsum
    have hi : Integrable ((m s t) ∘ drop) Q := hs.1
    have hb : (∫ q, m s t (drop q) ∂Q) ≤ 4 * σ := hs.2
    have he : (∫ q, m s t (drop q) ∂Q) = ∫ q, m s t q ∂P :=
      hdrop.hasLaw.integral_comp hmc.aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [he] at hb
    exact ⟨(hdrop.integrable_comp hmc.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hi, hb⟩
  have hAgg : Integrable (fun q : C × Z => ∑ i, T q i) P :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hTi i)
  have hAverage : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) •
        (∫ q : (ι × C) × Z, T (drop q) q.1.1 ∂Q) =
      ∫ q : C × Z, ∑ i, T q i ∂P := by
    exact card_smul_integral_uniform_prod_prod P₀ γ (fun i x z => T (x, z) i) hTsel
  have hPoint : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, specNorm (∑ i, T q i) ≤
      r * c ^ 4 * (8 * m 0 1 q + 2 * m 1 2 q + 2 * m 0 2 q) +
        a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6 * (3 * m 0 1 q + 6 * m 0 2 q) := by
    filter_upwards [hGood] with q hq
    have h := specNorm_sum_resolventCubicRemainder_le (A q) (D q) (F q) a r ζ hq.1
      (fun i => (hq.2 i).1) (fun i => (hq.2 i).2.1) hr
      (fun i => (hq.2 i).2.2.1) (fun i => (hq.2 i).2.2.2.1)
      (fun i => (hq.2 i).2.2.2.2) hζ
    simpa only [hE] using h
  have hB₀ : Integrable (fun q : C × Z => 8 * m 0 1 q + 2 * m 1 2 q) P :=
    ((hm 0 1).1.const_mul 8).add ((hm 1 2).1.const_mul 2)
  have hB₁ : Integrable (fun q : C × Z => 8 * m 0 1 q + 2 * m 1 2 q + 2 * m 0 2 q) P :=
    hB₀.add ((hm 0 2).1.const_mul 2)
  have hB₂ : Integrable (fun q : C × Z => 3 * m 0 1 q + 6 * m 0 2 q) P :=
    ((hm 0 1).1.const_mul 3).add ((hm 0 2).1.const_mul 6)
  have hBudget : Integrable (fun q : C × Z =>
      r * c ^ 4 * (8 * m 0 1 q + 2 * m 1 2 q + 2 * m 0 2 q) +
        a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6 * (3 * m 0 1 q + 6 * m 0 2 q)) P :=
    (hB₁.const_mul (r * c ^ 4)).add (hB₂.const_mul (a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6))
  rw [hAverage, specNorm_eq_norm]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ q : C × Z, specNorm (∑ i, T q i) ∂P := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ q : C × Z,
        r * c ^ 4 * (8 * m 0 1 q + 2 * m 1 2 q + 2 * m 0 2 q) +
          a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6 * (3 * m 0 1 q + 6 * m 0 2 q) ∂P :=
      integral_mono_ae hAgg.norm hBudget hPoint
    _ = r * c ^ 4 *
        (8 * (∫ q, m 0 1 q ∂P) + 2 * (∫ q, m 1 2 q ∂P) + 2 * (∫ q, m 0 2 q ∂P)) +
          a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6 * (3 * (∫ q, m 0 1 q ∂P) + 6 * (∫ q, m 0 2 q ∂P)) := by
      rw [integral_add (hB₁.const_mul (r * c ^ 4))
        (hB₂.const_mul (a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6)), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
      rw [integral_add hB₀ ((hm 0 2).1.const_mul 2),
        integral_add ((hm 0 1).1.const_mul 8) ((hm 1 2).1.const_mul 2),
        integral_add ((hm 0 1).1.const_mul 3) ((hm 0 2).1.const_mul 6)]
      simp only [integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ r * c ^ 4 * (8 * (4 * σ) + 2 * (4 * σ) + 2 * (4 * σ)) +
          a ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 6 * (3 * (4 * σ) + 6 * (4 * σ)) := by
      have h01 := (hm 0 1).2
      have h12 := (hm 1 2).2
      have h02 := (hm 0 2).2
      apply add_le_add
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        linarith only [h01, h12, h02]
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        linarith only [h01, h02]
    _ = _ := by dsimp [r, c, σ]; ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_resamplingTriple_prod_copy_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_resamplingTriple_prod_copy_sub_sq_le
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (L : E →L[ℝ] M) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, (L x).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (a b : Fin 3) :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × C) × Z =>
      specNorm (∑ i, (L (q.1.2 (i, a) - q.1.2 (i, b))) ^ 2))
        ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
      (∫ q : (ι × C) × Z,
        specNorm (∑ i, (L (q.1.2 (i, a) - q.1.2 (i, b))) ^ 2)
          ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ≤
        4 * ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let G : (ι → E) → ι → M := fun x i => L (x i)
  have hGm : Measurable G := measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i =>
    L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  let δ : Measure (ι → M) := (Measure.pi ν).map G
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure δ := (Measure.pi ν).isProbabilityMeasure_map hGm.aemeasurable
  have hG : HasLaw G δ (Measure.pi ν) := ⟨hGm.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have hδHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂δ, (A i).IsHermitian := by
    intro i
    apply (ae_map_iff hGm.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · have hi := (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw
      exact ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : E => (L x).IsHermitian) hi.aemeasurable
        (by rw [hi.map_eq]; exact hHerm i)
    · change MeasurableSet {A : ι → M | (A i)ᴴ = A i}
      exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : ι → M => (A i)ᴴ))
        (continuous_apply i)).measurableSet
  have hδBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂δ, specNorm (A i) ≤ R := by
    intro i
    apply (ae_map_iff hGm.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · have hi := (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw
      exact ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : E => specNorm (L x) ≤ R) hi.aemeasurable
        (by rw [hi.map_eq]; exact hBound i)
    · have hc : Continuous (fun A : ι → M => specNorm (A i)) := by
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (continuous_apply i).norm
      exact (isClosed_le hc continuous_const).measurableSet
  have hU : HasLaw (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => fun i => L (q.1.2 (i, a))) δ
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) :=
    hG.comp (hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy ν γ a)
  have hV : HasLaw (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => fun i => L (q.1.2 (i, b))) δ
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) :=
    hG.comp (hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy ν γ b)
  have h := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_le_of_hasLaw δ
    (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => fun i => L (q.1.2 (i, a)))
    (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => fun i => L (q.1.2 (i, b))) hU hV hR hδHerm hδBound
  have hc : Continuous (fun A : ι → M => specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2)) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  have he : (∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν) =
      ∫ A, specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2) ∂δ := hG.integral_comp hc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← he] at h
  simpa only [map_sub] using h

name: NLAlib.memLp_and_lpNorm_comp_of_hasLaw
statement:
private theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_comp_of_hasLaw
    {Ω α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure α} {T : Ω → α} (hT : HasLaw T ν μ)
    {f : α → ℝ} {q : ℝ≥0∞} (hf : MemLp f q ν) :
    MemLp (f ∘ T) q μ ∧ lpNorm (f ∘ T) q μ = lpNorm f q ν
proof:
:= by
  have hMap : MemLp f q (μ.map T) := by rwa [hT.map_eq]
  have hComp : MemLp (f ∘ T) q μ := hMap.comp_of_map hT.aemeasurable
  refine ⟨hComp, ?_⟩
  rw [← toReal_eLpNorm hComp.1, ← toReal_eLpNorm hf.1]
  apply congrArg ENNReal.toReal
  have h := eLpNorm_map_measure (p := q) hMap.1 hT.aemeasurable
  rw [hT.map_eq] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.memLp_and_lpNorm_two_mul_add_add_le
statement:
private theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_two_mul_add_add_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {q : ℝ≥0∞}
    {f g h : Ω → ℝ} (hf : MemLp f q μ) (hg : MemLp g q μ) (hh : MemLp h q μ)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    MemLp (fun x => 2 * (f x + g x + h x)) q μ ∧
      lpNorm (fun x => 2 * (f x + g x + h x)) q μ ≤
        2 * (lpNorm f q μ + lpNorm g q μ + lpNorm h q μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨((hf.add hg).add hh).const_mul 2, ?_⟩
  change lpNorm (fun x => (2 : ℝ) * (f + g + h) x) q μ ≤ _
  have hscale : lpNorm (fun x => (2 : ℝ) * (f + g + h) x) q μ =
      2 * lpNorm (f + g + h) q μ := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using lpNorm_fun_natCast_mul 2 (f + g + h) q μ
  rw [hscale]
  have hfg := lpNorm_add_le (g := g) hf hq
  have hfgh := lpNorm_add_le (g := h) (hf.add hg) hq
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfgh.trans (add_le_add hfg le_rfl)) (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.memLp_and_lpNorm_two_mul_sum_resamplingTriple_prod_copy_sq_le
statement:
theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_two_mul_sum_resamplingTriple_prod_copy_sq_le
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (L : E →L[ℝ] M) {q : ℝ≥0∞} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hMass : MemLp (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2))
      q (Measure.pi ν)) :
    MemLp (fun x : (ι × C) × Z =>
      2 * (specNorm (∑ i, (L (x.1.2 (i, 0))) ^ 2) +
        specNorm (∑ i, (L (x.1.2 (i, 1))) ^ 2) +
        specNorm (∑ i, (L (x.1.2 (i, 2))) ^ 2)))
      q ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
      lpNorm (fun x : (ι × C) × Z =>
        2 * (specNorm (∑ i, (L (x.1.2 (i, 0))) ^ 2) +
          specNorm (∑ i, (L (x.1.2 (i, 1))) ^ 2) +
          specNorm (∑ i, (L (x.1.2 (i, 2))) ^ 2)))
        q ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ≤
      6 * lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2))
        q (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
  let F : (ι → E) → ℝ := fun x => specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2)
  let T : Fin 3 → ((ι × C) × Z) → (ι → E) :=
    fun a x i => x.1.2 (i, a)
  let m : Fin 3 → ((ι × C) × Z) → ℝ := fun a x => F (T a x)
  have hm : ∀ a : Fin 3, MemLp (m a) q μ ∧
      lpNorm (m a) q μ = lpNorm F q (Measure.pi ν) := by
    intro a
    have hLaw : HasLaw (T a) (Measure.pi ν) μ :=
      hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy ν γ a
    exact memLp_and_lpNorm_comp_of_hasLaw hLaw hMass
  obtain ⟨hMem, hNorm⟩ := memLp_and_lpNorm_two_mul_add_add_le
    (hm 0).1 (hm 1).1 (hm 2).1 hq
  refine ⟨hMem, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * (lpNorm (m 0) q μ + lpNorm (m 1) q μ + lpNorm (m 2) q μ) := hNorm
    _ = _ := by rw [(hm 0).2, (hm 1).2, (hm 2).2]; ring

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_sum_of_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_sum_of_covariance_eq
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → M) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] (hρ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 ρ)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A i),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j); ρ] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → Ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ k, Z k (x k)) i),
        (fun x : ι → Ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ k, Z k (x k)) j); Measure.pi ν])
    (v w : n → ℂ) :
    (∫ A : M, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((A - ∫ B, B ∂ρ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i
proof:
:= by
  have hZi (i : ι) : MemLp (Z i) 2 (ν i) :=
    MemLp.of_bound (hZm i).aestronglyMeasurable R (hZ i)
  have hsum : MemLp (fun x : ι → Ω => ∑ i, Z i (x i)) 2 (Measure.pi ν) := by
    exact memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
      (hZi i).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν i)
  have hm : (∫ x : ι → Ω, ∑ i, Z i (x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (f := fun i (x : ι → Ω) => Z i (x i)) (fun i _ =>
      (measurePreserving_eval ν i).integrable_comp_of_integrable ((hZi i).integrable one_le_two))]
    simp only [integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := _) (hZi _).aestronglyMeasurable,
      hmean, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have h := integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_of_matrix_covariance_eq
    hsum hρ (fun i j => (hcov i j).symm) v w
  simp only [hm, sub_zero, id_eq] at h
  rw [← h]
  simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using
    integral_norm_sq_bilinear_sum_pi_eq_sum ν Z hZm hZ hmean
      (WithLp.toLp 2 v) (WithLp.toLp 2 w)

name: NLAlib.memLp_schattenNormReal
statement:
theorem memLp_schattenNormReal {p : ℝ≥0∞} (D : Ω → Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (hD : MemLp D p μ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    MemLp (fun ω => schattenNormReal (D ω) q) p μ
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / q)
  refine (hD.norm.const_mul c).mono'
    ((continuous_schattenNormReal hq).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hD.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)]
  calc
    schattenNormReal (D ω) q ≤ (Matrix.rank (D ω) : ℝ) ^ (1 / q) * specNorm (D ω) :=
      schattenNormReal_le_rank_rpow_mul_specNorm _ hq
    _ ≤ c * ‖D ω‖ := by
      rw [← specNorm_eq_norm]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (specNorm_nonneg _)
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast (D ω).rank_le_card_width)
        (one_div_nonneg.mpr hq.le)

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_pow_of_memLp
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_pow_of_memLp
    (D : Ω → Matrix m n 𝕜) {p : ℕ} (hD : MemLp D p μ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => schattenNormReal (D ω) q ^ p) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := (memLp_schattenNormReal D hD hq).integrable_norm_pow hp
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _)] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_gaussianEvenMoment_mul_integral_dotProduct_self_pow_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_gaussianEvenMoment_mul_integral_dotProduct_self_pow_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {r p : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ)
    (hy : Measurable y) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hdir : ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ A * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ p) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ ∧
      gaussianEvenMoment p * (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p ∂μ) ≤
        A * gaussianRadialMoment r p
proof:
:= by
  have hdirN (a : Fin r → ℝ) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ A * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p) := by
    simpa only [pow_mul, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hdir a
  have hnorm := (integrable_and_integral_norm_mulVec_pow_two_mul_le y hy.aemeasurable
    (by omega) hA hdirN (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)).1
  simp only [one_mulVec, pow_mul, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hnorm
  let γ := gaussianVector (Fin r)
  have hGN : Integrable (fun g : Fin r → ℝ => (g ⬝ᵥ g) ^ p) γ := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast, dotProduct, ← pow_two] using
      integrable_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector r (p : ℝ) (by positivity)
  have hGI : (∫ g : Fin r → ℝ, (g ⬝ᵥ g) ^ p ∂γ) = gaussianRadialMoment r p := by
    simpa only [dotProduct, ← pow_two] using integral_pow_sum_sq_gaussianVector hr p
  have hprod : Integrable
      (fun v : (Fin r → ℝ) × Ω => (v.1 ⬝ᵥ y v.2) ^ (2 * p)) (γ.prod μ) := by
    apply (hGN.mul_prod hnorm).mono'
    · apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
      unfold dotProduct
      fun_prop
    · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      intro v
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (v.1 ⬝ᵥ y v.2) ^ (2 * p) := by
        rw [pow_mul]
        positivity
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
      have hcs : (v.1 ⬝ᵥ y v.2) ^ 2 ≤ (v.1 ⬝ᵥ v.1) * (y v.2 ⬝ᵥ y v.2) := by
        simpa only [dotProduct, ← pow_two] using sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq univ v.1 (y v.2)
      simpa only [pow_mul, mul_pow] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg _) hcs p
  refine ⟨hnorm, ?_⟩
  calc
    gaussianEvenMoment p * (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p ∂μ) =
        ∫ ω, ∫ g : Fin r → ℝ, (g ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * p) ∂γ ∂μ := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      intro ω
      simpa only [dotProduct_comm] using
        (integrable_and_integral_dotProduct_pow_two_mul_gaussianVector (y ω) p).2.symm
    _ = ∫ g : Fin r → ℝ, ∫ ω, (g ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ∂γ :=
      (integral_integral_swap hprod).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ g : Fin r → ℝ, A * (g ⬝ᵥ g) ^ p ∂γ :=
      integral_mono hprod.integral_prod_left (hGN.const_mul A) fun g => (hdir g).2
    _ = A * gaussianRadialMoment r p := by rw [integral_const_mul, hGI]

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_bilinear_eq_of_matrix_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_bilinear_eq_of_matrix_mean_covariance_eq
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {X : Ω → M} {Y : Ω' → M} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 ν)
    (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, Y ω ∂ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) j); μ] =
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Y ω) i),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Y ω) j); ν]) (v w : n → ℂ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (X ω *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∫ ω, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Y ω *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let E := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  let L := ((Matrix.bilinearCLM v w).restrictScalars ℝ).comp E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hEX := E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hX
  have hEY := E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hY
  have hm : (∫ ω, E (X ω) ∂μ) = ∫ ω, E (Y ω) ∂ν := by
    calc
      _ = E (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) := E.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (hX.integrable one_le_two)
      _ = E (∫ ω, Y ω ∂ν) := congrArg E hmean
      _ = _ := (E.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (hY.integrable one_le_two)).symm
  have hL (A : M) : L (E A) = star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) := by
    change star v ⬝ᵥ (E.symm (E A) *ᵥ w) = star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w)
    rw [E.symm_apply_apply]
  have h := integral_norm_sq_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    hEX hEY hm hcov L
  change (∫ ω, ‖L (E (X ω))‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∫ ω, ‖L (E (Y ω))‖ ^ 2 ∂ν at h
  simpa only [hL] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_of_matrix_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_eq_of_matrix_covariance_eq
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {X : Ω → M} {Y : Ω' → M} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) j); μ] =
      cov[(fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Y ω) i),
        (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Y ω) j); ν]) (v w : n → ℂ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((X ω - ∫ z, X z ∂μ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∫ ω, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((Y ω - ∫ z, Y z ∂ν) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hXc : MemLp (fun ω => X ω-∫ z, X z ∂μ) 2 μ := hX.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hYc : MemLp (fun ω => Y ω-∫ z, Y z ∂ν) 2 ν := hY.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hm : (∫ ω, (X ω-∫ z, X z ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ ω, (Y ω-∫ z, Y z ∂ν) ∂ν := by
    rw [integral_sub (hX.integrable one_le_two) (integrable_const _),
      integral_sub (hY.integrable one_le_two) (integrable_const _)]
    simp
  apply integral_norm_sq_bilinear_eq_of_matrix_mean_covariance_eq hXc hYc hm _ v w
  intro i j
  let E := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  have hXi : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i) 2 μ :=
    (E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hX).eval i
  have hXj : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) j) 2 μ :=
    (E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hX).eval j
  have hYi : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Y ω) i) 2 ν :=
    (E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hY).eval i
  have hYj : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Y ω) j) 2 ν :=
    (E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hY).eval j
  simp only [map_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [covariance_sub_const_left (hXi.integrable one_le_two),
    covariance_sub_const_right (hXj.integrable one_le_two),
    covariance_sub_const_left (hYi.integrable one_le_two),
    covariance_sub_const_right (hYj.integrable one_le_two)]
  exact hcov i j

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_weighted_sq_pow_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_weighted_sq_pow_le
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (p : ℕ) (hXi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => X i ω ^ (2 * p)) μ)
    {C : ℝ} (hmoment : ∀ i, (∫ ω, X i ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p ∂μ) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hright : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ (2 * p)) μ :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hXi i).const_mul (w i)
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) :
      (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p ≤ ∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ (2 * p) := by
    simpa only [← pow_mul] using Real.pow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean_pow
      Finset.univ w (fun i => X i ω ^ 2) (fun i _ => hw i) hsum
      (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) p
  have hleft : Integrable (fun ω => (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p) μ := by
    apply hright.mono_nonneg
      (show AEMeasurable (fun ω => (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p) μ from by
        fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => pow_nonneg
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (sq_nonneg _)) p
    · exact ae_of_all _ hpoint
  refine ⟨hleft, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ ω, (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, ∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hleft hright hpoint
    _ = ∑ i, w i * ∫ ω, X i ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hXi i).const_mul (w i)]
      simp only [integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, w i * C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmoment i) (hw i)
    _ = C := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sum_mul_sq_pow_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_sum_mul_sq_pow_le
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (c : ι → ℝ) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hXi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => X i ω ^ (2 * p)) μ)
    {C : ℝ} (hmoment : ∀ i, (∫ ω, X i ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (∑ i, (c i * X i ω) ^ 2) ^ p) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (∑ i, (c i * X i ω) ^ 2) ^ p ∂μ) ≤ C * (∑ i, c i ^ 2) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : ℝ := ∑ i, c i ^ 2
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · have hc (i : ι) : c i = 0 := by
      have hi : c i ^ 2 ≤ s := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (c j))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c i)]
    simp [hc, ne_of_gt hp]
  have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs (Ne.symm hs0)
  let w : ι → ℝ := fun i => c i ^ 2 / s
  have hw (i : ι) : 0 ≤ w i := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hs
  have hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1 := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hs0
  have h := integrable_and_integral_weighted_sq_pow_le w hw hw1 X hX p hXi hmoment
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) : (∑ i, (c i * X i ω) ^ 2) ^ p =
      s ^ p * (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp [w]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [← hpoint] using h.1.const_mul (s ^ p)
  · calc
      (∫ ω, (∑ i, (c i * X i ω) ^ 2) ^ p ∂μ) =
          s ^ p * ∫ ω, (∑ i, w i * X i ω ^ 2) ^ p ∂μ := by
            simp_rw [hpoint]
            rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ s ^ p * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.2 (pow_nonneg hs _)
      _ = C * (∑ i, c i ^ 2) ^ p := mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_integral_sq_le_card_sq_mul_of_bilinear_budget
statement:
theorem specNorm_sum_integral_sq_le_card_sq_mul_of_bilinear_budget
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0≤R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω)≤R)
    (hbudget : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖≤1 → ‖b‖≤1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ν i)≤v) :
    specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i) ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsqMeas (i : ι) : Measurable (fun ω => Z i ω^2) := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using (hZm i).matrix_mul (hZm i)
  have hiSq (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω^2) (ν i) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hsqMeas i).aestronglyMeasurable (R^2)
    filter_upwards [hZB i] with ω hω
    exact (norm_pow_le' (Z i ω) (by norm_num : 0<(2 : ℕ))).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω) 2)
  have hiEntry (i : ι) (j k : n) : Integrable (fun ω => ‖Z i ω j k‖^2) (ν i) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((((Matrix.measurable_entry j k).comp (hZm i)).norm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (R^2)
    filter_upwards [hZB i] with ω hω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR).mpr ((norm_apply_le_specNorm _ j k).trans hω)
  have hnonneg : 0≤∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hZH i] with ω hω
    change (Z i ω^2-(0 : Matrix n n ℂ)).PosSemidef
    simpa only [sub_zero,hω.eq,pow_two] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)
  have htrace (i : ι) : (∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i).trace.re =
      ∑ j, ∑ k, ∫ ω, ‖Z i ω j k‖^2 ∂ν i := by
    change RCLike.re (∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i).trace = _
    rw [Matrix.re_trace_integral (hiSq i)]
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, frobSq (Z i ω) ∂ν i := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hZH i] with ω hω
        simpa only [hω.eq,pow_two] using (frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)).symm
      _ = ∫ ω, ∑ j, ∑ k, ‖Z i ω j k‖^2 ∂ν i := by simp_rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ =>
          integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hiEntry i j k))]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hiEntry i j k)
  let e (j : n) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := EuclideanSpace.single j 1
  have heNorm (j : n) : ‖e j‖≤1 := by simp [e]
  have heval (j k : n) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
      star (e j).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (e k).ofLp)=A j k := by simp [e]
  have hentry (j k : n) : (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖Z i ω j k‖^2 ∂ν i)≤v := by
    simpa only [heval] using hbudget (e j) (e k) (heNorm j) (heNorm k)
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i).trace.re := hnonneg.posSemidef.specNorm_le_re_trace
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∫ ω, ‖Z i ω j k‖^2 ∂ν i := by
      simp only [Matrix.trace_sum,Complex.re_sum,htrace]
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖Z i ω j k‖^2 ∂ν i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : n, ∑ _k : n, v :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hentry j k
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

name: NLAlib.norm_six_word_remainder_le_cubic
statement:
private theorem norm_six_word_remainder_le_cubic
    (ζ : ℂ) (A B C D E F : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C D E +
        D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A C C F D)‖ ≤
      |ζ.im|⁻¹^4 * (4 * (schattenNormReal D 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) +
        schattenNormReal E 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) +
        schattenNormReal F 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let d := schattenNormReal D 3
  let e := schattenNormReal E 3
  let f := schattenNormReal F 3
  let c := |ζ.im|⁻¹^4 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := div_nonneg (by positivity) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hd := schattenNormReal_nonneg D 3
  have he := schattenNormReal_nonneg E 3
  have hf := schattenNormReal_nonneg F 3
  have h₁ := norm_normalizedTrace_mul_resolventSquareSecondDifference_le
    ζ A B C D D E hA hB hC hζ
  have h₂ := norm_normalizedTrace_mul_resolventSquareSecondDifference_le
    ζ A C C D F D hA hC hC hζ
  have hu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (three_mul_mul_mul_le_add_cube hd hd he) hc
  have hv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (three_mul_mul_mul_le_add_cube hd hf hd) hc
  have hb₁ : ‖normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C D E)‖ ≤
      c * (2*d^3+e^3) := h₁.trans (by convert hu using 1 <;> dsimp [c,d,e] <;> ring)
  have hb₂ : ‖normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A C C F D)‖ ≤
      c * (2*d^3+f^3) := h₂.trans (by convert hv using 1 <;> dsimp [c,d,f] <;> ring)
  rw [normalizedTrace_add]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C D E)‖ +
        ‖normalizedTrace (D * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A C C F D)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ c * (2*d^3+e^3) + c * (2*d^3+f^3) := add_le_add hb₁ hb₂
    _ = _ := by dsimp [c,d,e,f]; ring

name: NLAlib.aemeasurable_six_word_remainder
statement:
private theorem aemeasurable_six_word_remainder
    (ζ : ℂ) (A B C D E F : Ω → M)
    (hA : AEMeasurable A P) (hB : AEMeasurable B P) (hC : AEMeasurable C P)
    (hD : AEMeasurable D P) (hE : AEMeasurable E P) (hF : AEMeasurable F P) :
    AEMeasurable (fun ω => normalizedTrace
      (D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (B ω) (C ω) (D ω) (E ω) +
        D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (C ω) (C ω) (F ω) (D ω))) P
proof:
:= by
  have hRA := (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hA
  have hRB := (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hB
  have hRC := (measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hC
  have htr : Measurable (normalizedTrace : M → ℂ) :=
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_id.matrix_trace).measurable
  apply htr.comp_aemeasurable
  unfold resolventSquareSecondDifference
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_norm_integral_six_word_remainder_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_norm_integral_six_word_remainder_le
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (A B C D E F : Ω → M)
    (hAm : AEMeasurable A P) (hBm : AEMeasurable B P) (hCm : AEMeasurable C P)
    (hDm : AEMeasurable D P) (hEm : AEMeasurable E P) (hFm : AEMeasurable F P)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (A ω).IsHermitian)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (B ω).IsHermitian)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (C ω).IsHermitian)
    (hD3 : Integrable (fun ω => schattenNormReal (D ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) P)
    (hE3 : Integrable (fun ω => schattenNormReal (E ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) P)
    (hF3 : Integrable (fun ω => schattenNormReal (F ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) P)
    (m : ℝ)
    (hmD : (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (D ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂P) = m)
    (hmE : (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (E ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂P) = m)
    (hmF : (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (F ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂P) = m) :
    Integrable (fun ω => normalizedTrace
      (D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (B ω) (C ω) (D ω) (E ω) +
        D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (C ω) (C ω) (F ω) (D ω))) P ∧
    ‖∫ ω, normalizedTrace
      (D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (B ω) (C ω) (D ω) (E ω) +
        D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (C ω) (C ω) (F ω) (D ω)) ∂P‖ ≤
      6 * m / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  let g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => |ζ.im|⁻¹^4 *
    (4 * (schattenNormReal (D ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) +
      schattenNormReal (E ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) +
      schattenNormReal (F ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
  have hg : Integrable g P := ((hD3.const_mul 4).add hE3 |>.add hF3).const_mul _
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ‖normalizedTrace
      (D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (B ω) (C ω) (D ω) (E ω) +
        D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (C ω) (C ω) (F ω) (D ω))‖ ≤ g ω := by
    filter_upwards [hA,hB,hC] with ω hA hB hC
    exact norm_six_word_remainder_le_cubic ζ _ _ _ _ _ _ hA hB hC hζ
  have hmeas := (aemeasurable_six_word_remainder ζ A B C D E F
    hAm hBm hCm hDm hEm hFm).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine ⟨hg.mono' hmeas hbound, (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg hbound).trans_eq ?_⟩
  have hDE : Integrable (fun ω =>
      4 * (schattenNormReal (D ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) +
        schattenNormReal (E ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) P :=
    (hD3.const_mul 4).add hE3
  dsimp [g]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hDE hF3,
    integral_add (hD3.const_mul 4) hE3, integral_const_mul, hmD, hmE, hmF]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_norm_integral_six_word_remainder_le_of_memLp
statement:
theorem integrable_and_norm_integral_six_word_remainder_le_of_memLp
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (A B C D E F : Ω → M)
    (hAm : AEMeasurable A P) (hBm : AEMeasurable B P) (hCm : AEMeasurable C P)
    (hD : MemLp D 3 P) (hE : MemLp E 3 P) (hF : MemLp F 3 P)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (A ω).IsHermitian)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (B ω).IsHermitian)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (C ω).IsHermitian)
    (m : ℝ)
    (hmD : (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (D ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂P) = m)
    (hmE : (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (E ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂P) = m)
    (hmF : (∫ ω, schattenNormReal (F ω) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂P) = m) :
    Integrable (fun ω => normalizedTrace
      (D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (B ω) (C ω) (D ω) (E ω) +
        D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (C ω) (C ω) (F ω) (D ω))) P ∧
    ‖∫ ω, normalizedTrace
      (D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (B ω) (C ω) (D ω) (E ω) +
        D ω * resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ (A ω) (C ω) (C ω) (F ω) (D ω)) ∂P‖ ≤
      6 * m / |ζ.im|^4
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_and_norm_integral_six_word_remainder_le ζ hζ A B C D E F
    hAm hBm hCm hD.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable hE.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
    hF.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable hA hB hC _ _ _ m hmD hmE hmF
  · exact (integrable_schattenNormReal_pow_of_memLp D (p := 3) hD (by decide) (by norm_num)).div_const _
  · exact (integrable_schattenNormReal_pow_of_memLp E (p := 3) hE (by decide) (by norm_num)).div_const _
  · exact (integrable_schattenNormReal_pow_of_memLp F (p := 3) hF (by decide) (by norm_num)).div_const _

name: NLAlib.norm_column_sq_le_frobSq
statement:
private theorem norm_column_sq_le_frobSq (Z : Matrix r q K) (j : q) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z.col j)‖^2 ≤ frobSq Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg ‖Z i k‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: NLAlib.integrable_norm_mulVec_sq_of_integrable_frobSq
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_mulVec_sq_of_integrable_frobSq
    (μ : Measure (Matrix r q K)) (hμ : Integrable (fun Z => frobSq Z) μ) (x : q → K) :
    Integrable (fun Z => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z*ᵥx)‖^2) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (hμ.mul_const (‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖^2)).mono' (by fun_prop)
  apply ae_of_all
  intro Z
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  exact sum_norm_sq_mulVec_le_frobSq Z x

name: NLAlib.exists_unitary_column_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_unitary_column_eq (x : q → K) (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖=1) (j : q) :
    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup q K,(U : Matrix q q K).col j=x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Matrix q Unit K := fun i _ => x i
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols V := by
    apply (hasOrthonormalCols_iff_orthonormal V).mpr
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro a b
    have hab : a=b := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst b
    change inner K (WithLp.toLp 2 x) (WithLp.toLp 2 x) = _
    rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,hx]
    simp
  let e : Unit ↪ q := ⟨fun _ => j,fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨W,hW,hcol⟩ := exists_unitary_completion V hV e
  refine ⟨⟨W,Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr hW⟩,?_⟩
  funext i
  exact hcol i ()

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq_fixed_column
statement:
private theorem integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq_fixed_column
    (μ : Measure (Matrix r q K)) (hinv : RightUnitaryInvariant μ) (j : q) (x : q → K) :
    (∫ Z,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z*ᵥx)‖^2 ∂μ) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖^2 * ∫ Z,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z.col j)‖^2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · simp [hx]
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖≠0 := by
    intro h
    exact hx ((WithLp.toLp_eq_zero 2).mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h))
  let y : q → K := (‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • x
  have hy : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖=1 := by
    change ‖(‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • WithLp.toLp 2 x‖=1
    rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)),inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
  obtain ⟨U,hU⟩ := exists_unitary_column_eq y hy j
  have hrep : x = (‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ : ℝ) • y := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hn,one_smul]
  have hcol (Z : Matrix r q K) : (Z*(U : Matrix q q K)).col j = Z*ᵥy := by
    funext i
    change ∑ k,Z i k*(U : Matrix q q K) k j = ∑ k,Z i k*y k
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [← congrFun hU k]
    rfl
  have hp (Z : Matrix r q K) : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z*ᵥx)‖^2 =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖^2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((Z*(U : Matrix q q K)).col j)‖^2 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hrep]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul,WithLp.toLp_smul,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _),mul_pow,hcol]
  have hl : HasLaw (fun Z : Matrix r q K => Z*(U : Matrix q q K)) μ μ :=
    ⟨(by fun_prop),hinv U⟩
  simp_rw [hp]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  congr 1
  exact hl.integral_comp (f := fun Z : Matrix r q K => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z.col j)‖^2) (by
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold Matrix.col
    fun_prop)

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_mulVec_sq_of_rightUnitaryInvariant
statement:
theorem integral_norm_mulVec_sq_of_rightUnitaryInvariant [Nonempty q]
    (μ : Measure (Matrix r q K)) (hμ : Integrable (fun Z => frobSq Z) μ)
    (hinv : RightUnitaryInvariant μ) (x : q → K) :
    (∫ Z,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z*ᵥx)‖^2 ∂μ) =
      ((∫ Z,frobSq Z ∂μ)/Fintype.card q)*‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  let j : q := Classical.arbitrary q
  let c := ∫ Z,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z.col j)‖^2 ∂μ
  have he (i : q) : (∫ Z,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z.col i)‖^2 ∂μ)=c := by
    have h := integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq_fixed_column μ hinv j (Pi.single i 1)
    simpa using h
  have hc : (∫ Z,frobSq Z ∂μ) = Fintype.card q*c := by
    have hpoint (Z : Matrix r q K) : frobSq Z = ∑ i,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z.col i)‖^2 := by
      simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,Matrix.col_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    simp_rw [hpoint]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hμ.mono' (by
        apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        unfold Matrix.col
        fun_prop)
      (ae_of_all _ fun Z => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)];exact norm_column_sq_le_frobSq Z i))]
    simp only [he,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq_fixed_column μ hinv j x,hc]
  have hn : (Fintype.card q : ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := q)
  dsimp [c]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_of_rightUnitaryInvariant
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_frobSq_mul_of_rightUnitaryInvariant [Nonempty q]
    (μ : Measure (Matrix r q K)) (hμ : Integrable (fun Z => frobSq Z) μ)
    (hinv : RightUnitaryInvariant μ) (D : Matrix q p K) :
    Integrable (fun Z => frobSq (Z*D)) μ ∧
      (∫ Z,frobSq (Z*D) ∂μ) = ((∫ Z,frobSq Z ∂μ)/Fintype.card q)*frobSq D
proof:
:= by
  have hp (Z : Matrix r q K) : frobSq (Z*D) = ∑ j,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Z*ᵥD.col j)‖^2 := by
    simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.mulVec,Matrix.col_apply,dotProduct]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  constructor
  · simp_rw [hp]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_norm_mulVec_sq_of_integrable_frobSq μ hμ (D.col j))
  · simp_rw [hp]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_norm_mulVec_sq_of_integrable_frobSq μ hμ (D.col j))]
    simp_rw [integral_norm_mulVec_sq_of_rightUnitaryInvariant μ hμ hinv]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    simp only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq,Matrix.col_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrix_of_integrable_frobSq
statement:
theorem integrable_matrix_of_integrable_frobSq
    (μ : Measure (Matrix r q K)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : Integrable (fun Z => frobSq Z) μ) :
    Integrable (fun Z => Z) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Integrable (fun Z : Matrix r q K => ‖Z‖^2) μ := by
    apply hμ.mono' (by fun_prop)
    apply ae_of_all
    intro Z
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact specNorm_sq_le_frobSq Z
  exact ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm aestronglyMeasurable_id).mpr hs).integrable (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.integral_matrix_eq_zero_of_rightUnitaryInvariant
statement:
theorem integral_matrix_eq_zero_of_rightUnitaryInvariant
    (μ : Measure (Matrix r q K)) (hinv : RightUnitaryInvariant μ) : (∫ Z,Z ∂μ)=0
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup q K := ⟨-1,Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mpr (by simp)⟩
  have hl : HasLaw (fun Z : Matrix r q K => Z*(U : Matrix q q K)) μ μ :=
    ⟨(by fun_prop),hinv U⟩
  have he := hl.integral_eq
  change (∫ Z,Z*(-1 : Matrix q q K) ∂μ)=∫ Z,Z ∂μ at he
  simp only [Matrix.mul_neg,Matrix.mul_one] at he
  rw [integral_neg (fun Z : Matrix r q K => Z)] at he
  ext i j
  have h := congrArg (fun Z : Matrix r q K => Z i j) he
  change -(∫ Z,Z ∂μ) i j = (∫ Z,Z ∂μ) i j at h
  change (∫ Z,Z ∂μ) i j = 0
  linear_combination -(1/2 : K)*h

name: NLAlib.bilinearWeakVariance_nonneg
statement: theorem bilinearWeakVariance_nonneg (μ : Measure M) : 0 ≤ bilinearWeakVariance μ
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_centered_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_centered_specNorm_sq
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ)
    (v w : E) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    (∫ A : M, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ A : M, specNorm (A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ)^2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : MemLp (fun A : M => A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) 2 μ := hμ.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hb := ((Matrix.bilinearCLM v.ofLp w.ofLp).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_memLp' hc
  change MemLp (fun A : M => star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)) 2 μ at hb
  have hi := hb.integrable_norm_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hn : Integrable (fun A : M => specNorm (A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ)^2) μ := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hc.integrable_norm_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  apply integral_mono hi hn
  intro A
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
    (norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm _ v w hv hw) 2

name: NLAlib.bddAbove_centered_bilinear_moments
statement:
theorem bddAbove_centered_bilinear_moments
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ) :
    BddAbove ((fun q : E × E => ∫ A : M,
      ‖star q.1.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ q.2.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) ''
        {q | ‖q.1‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖q.2‖ ≤ 1})
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∫ A : M, specNorm (A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ)^2 ∂μ, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  exact integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_centered_specNorm_sq μ hμ q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_bilinearWeakVariance
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ)
    (v w : E) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    (∫ A : M, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) ≤
      bilinearWeakVariance μ
proof:

  le_csSup (bddAbove_centered_bilinear_moments μ hμ) ⟨(v,w), ⟨hv,hw⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.bilinearWeakVariance_le
statement:
theorem bilinearWeakVariance_le (μ : Measure M) {b : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ v w : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∫ A : M, ‖star v.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ) *ᵥ w.ofLp)‖^2 ∂μ) ≤ b) :
    bilinearWeakVariance μ ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨0, ⟨(0,0), by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    exact h q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2

name: NLAlib.bilinearWeakVariance_le_centered_specNorm_sq

    bilinearWeakVariance μ ≤ ∫ A : M, specNorm (A-∫ B : M, B ∂μ)^2 ∂μ
