  bilinearWeakVariance_le μ (integral_norm_sq_centered_bilinear_le_centered_specNorm_sq μ hμ)

name: NLAlib.ae_eq_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance
statement:
theorem ae_eq_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hL2 : MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) 2 ρ)
    (A₀ : M) (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀)
    (hcov : ∀ j : J, cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j); ρ] = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A = A₀
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A ∂ρ) = matrixRealCoordinates A₀ := by
    have h := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := m) (n := n)).integral_comp_comm
      (μ := ρ) (fun A : M => A)
    change (∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A ∂ρ) =
      matrixRealCoordinates (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) at h
    exact h.trans (congrArg matrixRealCoordinates hmean)
  have hcoords (j : J) : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, matrixRealCoordinates A j = matrixRealCoordinates A₀ j := by
    let P : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj j
    have hj : MemLp (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j) 2 ρ := P.comp_memLp' hL2
    have hvar : Var[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j); ρ] = 0 :=
      (covariance_self hj.aemeasurable).symm.trans (hcov j)
    have hmj := P.integral_comp_comm (hL2.integrable one_le_two)
    change (∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A j ∂ρ) =
      (∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A ∂ρ) j at hmj
    rw [hm] at hmj
    exact (ae_eq_integral_of_variance_eq_zero hj hvar).mono fun A hA => hA.trans hmj
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hcoords] with A hA
  exact (matrixRealCoordinates : M ≃ₗ[ℝ] E).injective (funext hA)

name: NLAlib.eq_dirac_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance
statement:
theorem eq_dirac_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hL2 : MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) 2 ρ)
    (A₀ : M) (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀)
    (hcov : ∀ j : J, cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j),
      (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j); ρ] = 0) :
    ρ = Measure.dirac A₀
proof:
:= by
  have hAE := ae_eq_of_matrix_mean_eq_of_zero_coordinate_covariance ρ hL2 A₀ hmean hcov
  calc
    ρ = ρ.map id := (Measure.map_id).symm
    _ = ρ.map (fun _ : M => A₀) := Measure.map_congr hAE
    _ = Measure.dirac A₀ := by simp only [Measure.map_const, measure_univ, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_norm_integral_sum_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_first_copy_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_norm_integral_sum_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_first_copy_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (x₀ : Ω → E) (hx₀m : AEMeasurable x₀ μ)
    (z : Ω → Fin 3 → ι → E) (hzm : AEMeasurable z μ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ s i, specNorm (L (z ω s i)) ≤ R)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (p : ℝ) * R ≤ |ζ.im|)
    (hMass : MemLp (fun ω => 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 0 i) ^ 2) +
      specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 1 i) ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 2 i) ^ 2)))
      (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ) :
    let mass
proof:
:= fun ω => 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 0 i) ^ 2) +
      specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 1 i) ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 2 i) ^ 2))
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
      (x₀ ω - a • (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)) (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)
        (z ω 1 i - z ω 2 i)) μ ∧
      ‖∫ ω, ∑ i, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
        (x₀ ω - a • (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)) (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)
          (z ω 1 i - z ω 2 i) ∂μ‖ ≤
        ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          3 * (2 * R) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * lpNorm mass (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ *
            (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (A + L (x₀ ω)) ζ p ∂μ) ^
              (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ)) := by
  classical
  let mass : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => 2 * (specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 0 i) ^ 2) +
    specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 1 i) ^ 2) + specNorm (∑ i, L (z ω 2 i) ^ 2))
  let U : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => resolventEvenMoment (A + L (x₀ ω)) ζ p
  let q : ℝ := ((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ)
  let K : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 * (2 * R) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4
  let F : Ω → ℂ := fun ω => ∑ i, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
    (x₀ ω - a • (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)) (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)
      (z ω 1 i - z ω 2 i)
  have hKm (i : ι) : AEMeasurable (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
      (x₀ ω - a • (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)) (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)
        (z ω 1 i - z ω 2 i)) μ := by
    have hDm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i) μ :=
      ((hzm.eval 0).eval i).sub ((hzm.eval 1).eval i)
    have hVm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω 1 i - z ω 2 i) μ :=
      ((hzm.eval 1).eval i).sub ((hzm.eval 2).eval i)
    have hxm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => x₀ ω - a • (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i)) μ :=
      hx₀m.sub (hDm.const_smul a)
    have ht : AEMeasurable (fun ω =>
        (x₀ ω - a • (z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i), z ω 0 i - z ω 1 i, z ω 1 i - z ω 2 i)) μ :=
      hxm.prodMk (hDm.prodMk hVm)
    have hc := (continuous_resolventMomentTaylorKernel A hA ζ hζ p a).measurable
    have hcomp := hc.comp_aemeasurable ht
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  have hFm : AEStronglyMeasurable F μ :=
    (Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hKm i)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hX : AEMeasurable (fun ω => A + L (x₀ ω)) μ :=
    aemeasurable_const.add ((L).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hx₀m)
  have hXHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A + L (x₀ ω)).IsHermitian :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (x₀ ω))
  have hUi : Integrable U μ :=
    (integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le μ _ hX hXHerm hζ hp).1
  have hUnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ U ω :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ ζ hp
  have hMnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ mass ω := by
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg
      (add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)) (specNorm_nonneg _))
  have hq : q = (2 * (p : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * p) := by
    dsimp only [q]
    simp only [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * p), Nat.cast_mul,
      Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one]
  obtain ⟨hGi, hGb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_mul_rpow_le_lpNorm_two_mul
    p hp hMass hUi hMnn hUnn
  rw [← hq] at hGi hGb
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp only [K]; positivity
  have hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖F ω‖ ≤ K * (mass ω * U ω ^ q) := by
    filter_upwards [hZ] with ω hω
    have hb := norm_sum_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_first_copy_le
      A hA ζ hζ hp (x₀ ω) (z ω) hR hω ha0 ha1 hsmall
    change ‖F ω‖ ≤ ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 * (2 * R) * mass ω * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * U ω ^ q at hb
    convert hb using 1
    dsimp only [K]
    ring
  have hKi : Integrable (fun ω => K * (mass ω * U ω ^ q)) μ := hGi.const_mul K
  have hFi : Integrable F μ := hKi.mono' hFm hBound
  refine ⟨hFi, ?_⟩
  calc
    ‖∫ ω, F ω ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ ω, K * (mass ω * U ω ^ q) ∂μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hKi hBound
    _ = K * ∫ ω, mass ω * U ω ^ q ∂μ := integral_const_mul K _
    _ ≤ K * (lpNorm mass (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ * (∫ ω, U ω ∂μ) ^ q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGb hK
    _ = _ := by dsimp only [K, U, q]; ring

name: NLAlib.matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map
statement:
theorem matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (T : E → Matrix n n ℂ) (hT : Measurable T) :
    matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) =
      ∑ i, ∫ p : E × E, schattenNormReal (T p.1 - T p.2) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂(ν i).prod (ν i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold matrixDifferenceThirdMoment
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hm : MeasurePreserving T (ν i) ((ν i).map T) := ⟨hT,rfl⟩
  have htest : Measurable (fun p : Matrix n n ℂ × Matrix n n ℂ =>
      schattenNormReal (p.1-p.2) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) :=
    ((((continuous_schattenNormReal (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).comp
      (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)).pow 3).div_const _).measurable
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,Prod.map_fst,Prod.map_snd] using
    ((hm.prod hm).hasLaw.integral_comp htest.aestronglyMeasurable).symm

name: NLAlib.matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_continuousLinearMap
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) =
      ∑ i, ∫ p : E × E, schattenNormReal (T (p.1-p.2)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂(ν i).prod (ν i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_sub] using matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map ν T T.continuous.measurable

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_linear_copy_difference_pow_three
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_linear_copy_difference_pow_three
    (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : MemLp (id : E → E) 3 ν)
    (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun p : E × E => schattenNormReal (T (p.1-p.2)) 3 ^ 3 /
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) (ν.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : MemLp (fun p : E × E => p.1) 3 (ν.prod ν) :=
    hν.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_fst (μ := ν) (ν := ν))
  have hs : MemLp (fun p : E × E => p.2) 3 (ν.prod ν) :=
    hν.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_snd (μ := ν) (ν := ν))
  have hT : MemLp (fun p : E × E => T (p.1-p.2)) 3 (ν.prod ν) :=
    T.comp_memLp' (hf.sub hs)
  exact (integrable_schattenNormReal_pow_of_memLp _ hT (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).div_const _

name: NLAlib.matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_nonneg
statement:
theorem matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_nonneg
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    0 ≤ matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_continuousLinearMap]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  exact integral_nonneg fun p => div_nonneg
    (pow_nonneg (schattenNormReal_nonneg _ _) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i)) (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (∫ p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E),
      schattenNormReal (T (p.2 (p.1,a)-p.2 (p.1,b))) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
      ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let G : E → ℝ := fun x => schattenNormReal (T x) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  have hG : Measurable G :=
    ((((continuous_schattenNormReal (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).comp T.continuous).pow 3).div_const _).measurable
  have hi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun p : E × E => G (p.1-p.2)) ((ν i).prod (ν i)) :=
    integrable_schattenNormReal_linear_copy_difference_pow_three (ν i) (hν i) T
  calc
    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∫ p : E × E, G (p.1-p.2) ∂(ν i).prod (ν i) :=
      integral_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν a b hab G hG hi
    _ = _ := by rw [matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_continuousLinearMap]; dsimp [G]; ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i)) (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Integrable (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) =>
      schattenNormReal (T (p.2 (p.1,a)-p.2 (p.1,b))) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine integrable_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν a b hab
    (fun x => schattenNormReal (T x) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ?_ ?_
  · exact ((((continuous_schattenNormReal (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).comp
      T.continuous).pow 3).div_const _).measurable
  · intro i
    exact integrable_schattenNormReal_linear_copy_difference_pow_three (ν i) (hν i) T

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i)) (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z =>
      schattenNormReal (T (q.1.2 (q.1.1,a)-q.1.2 (q.1.1,b))) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν hν T a b hab).comp_fst γ

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i)) (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z,
      schattenNormReal (T (q.1.2 (q.1.1,a)-q.1.2 (q.1.1,b))) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let G : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) → ℝ := fun p =>
    schattenNormReal (T (p.2 (p.1,a)-p.2 (p.1,b))) 3 ^ 3 / (Fintype.card n : ℝ)
  change (∫ q, G q.1 ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) = _
  rw [integral_fun_fst (μ := resamplingTripleMeasure ν) (ν := γ) G]
  simp only [probReal_univ,one_smul]
  exact integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν hν T a b hab

name: NLAlib.integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_differences
statement:
theorem integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_differences
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i)) (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z =>
      schattenNormReal (T (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleFirst q.1)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z =>
      schattenNormReal (T (resamplingTripleFirst q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z =>
      schattenNormReal (T (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [resamplingTriple_difference] using
      integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference ν hν T γ 0 1 (by decide)
  · simpa only [resamplingTriple_first_sub_second] using
      integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference ν hν T γ 1 2 (by decide)
  · simpa only [resamplingTriple_difference_second] using
      integrable_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference ν hν T γ 0 2 (by decide)

name: NLAlib.integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_differences
statement:
theorem integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_differences
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 3 (ν i)) (T : E →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] :
    ((∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z,
      schattenNormReal (T (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleFirst q.1)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) ∧
    ((∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z,
      schattenNormReal (T (resamplingTripleFirst q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) ∧
    ((∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × Z,
      schattenNormReal (T (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1-resamplingTripleSecond q.1)) 3 ^ 3 /
        (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i => (ν i).map T) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [resamplingTriple_difference] using
      integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference ν hν T γ 0 1 (by decide)
  · simpa only [resamplingTriple_first_sub_second] using
      integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference ν hν T γ 1 2 (by decide)
  · simpa only [resamplingTriple_difference_second] using
      integral_schattenNormReal_resamplingTriple_prod_selected_difference ν hν T γ 0 2 (by decide)

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_rpow_inv_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_rpow_inv_le {f : Ω → E} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ q) μ) :
    (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤ (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < q := hp.trans_le hpq
  have hqLp : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ := by
    apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hf (by simp [hqpos]) (by simp)).mp
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hqpos.le] using hq
  have hLp := eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hpq) hf
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hqLp.eLpNorm_ne_top hLp
  rw [toReal_eLpNorm hf, toReal_eLpNorm hf,
    lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by simp [hp]) (by simp) hf,
    lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by simp [hqpos]) (by simp) hf] at hreal
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hqpos.le, one_div]
    using hreal

name: NLAlib.integrable_rpow_and_integral_rpow_inv_le
statement:
theorem integrable_rpow_and_integral_rpow_inv_le {f : Ω → ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hnonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ f ω)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq : Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ q) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f ω ^ p) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, f ω ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤ (∫ ω, f ω ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖f ω‖ = f ω := hnonneg.mono fun _ h => Real.norm_of_nonneg h
  have hqnorm : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ q) μ :=
    hq.congr (hnorm.mono fun _ h => congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ q) h.symm)
  have hpnorm := integrable_norm_rpow_of_le hf hp.le (hp.trans_le hpq).le hpq hqnorm
  refine ⟨hpnorm.congr (hnorm.mono fun _ h => congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) h), ?_⟩
  have h := integral_norm_rpow_inv_le hf hp hpq hqnorm
  simpa only [integral_congr_ae (hnorm.mono fun _ h => congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) h),
    integral_congr_ae (hnorm.mono fun _ h => congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ q) h)] using h

name: NLAlib.wordCreation_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordCreation_apply_single (i : ι) (w : List ι) (z : ℂ) :
    wordCreation i (lp.single 2 w z) = lp.single 2 (i :: w) z
proof:
:= by
  convert! lp.embeddingLinearIsometry_apply_single
    (𝕜 := ℂ) (⟨List.cons i, List.cons_injective⟩ : List ι ↪ List ι) w z using 1
  · unfold wordCreation
    congr 1
    ext v
    by_cases hv : v = w <;> simp [lp.single_apply, hv]
  · ext v
    by_cases hv : v = i :: w <;> simp [lp.single_apply, hv]

name: NLAlib.wordAnnihilation_apply_single_nil

    wordAnnihilation i (lp.single 2 [] z) = 0

name: NLAlib.wordAnnihilation_apply_single_cons
statement:

theorem wordAnnihilation_apply_single_cons (i j : ι) (w : List ι) (z : ℂ) :
    wordAnnihilation i (lp.single 2 (j :: w) z) =
      if i = j then lp.single 2 w z else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext v
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [wordAnnihilation_apply, lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  · simp [wordAnnihilation_apply, lp.single_apply, hij]

proof:

  apply lp.ext_continuousLinearMap (by simp : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
  intro w
  ext z
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap]
  · simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, hij]

name: NLAlib.star_wordCreation_mul_wordCreation

name: NLAlib.abs_wordMatrixVacuum_gramMoment_rpow_sub_le_norm
statement:
theorem abs_wordMatrixVacuum_gramMoment_rpow_sub_le_norm
    (S T : M) (hS : S ∈ wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι))
    (hT : T ∈ wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι)) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    |((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star S*S)^m)).re) ^
        ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹) -
      ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star T*T)^m)).re) ^
        ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)| ≤ ‖S-T‖
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with
  | inl hD =>
    have he : S=T := by ext i; exact (hD.false i).elim
    subst T
    simp
  | inr hD =>
    let : Nonempty D := hD
    let P := wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι)
    let hclosed : IsClosed (P : Set M) := isClosed_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra
    let : CStarAlgebra P := StarSubalgebra.cstarAlgebra P (h_closed := hclosed)
    let : PartialOrder P := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder P
    let : StarOrderedRing P := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing P
    let τ : P →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ :=
      PositiveLinearMap.mk₀
        ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)).comp
          P.subtype.toAlgHom.toLinearMap)
        (fun X hX => by
          apply (wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι)).map_nonneg
          have hXX : X=star (CFC.sqrt X)*CFC.sqrt X := by
            rw [(CFC.sqrt_nonneg X).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq,CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self X hX]
          change 0≤(X : M)
          calc
            _ ≤ star ((CFC.sqrt X : P) : M)*((CFC.sqrt X : P) : M) :=
              star_mul_self_nonneg _
            _ = (X : M) := congrArg (fun Z : P => (Z : M)) hXX.symm)
    have hτ : τ 1=1 := wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_one
    have htrace (X Y : P) : τ (X*Y)=τ (Y*X) :=
      wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_mul_comm X.val Y.val X.property Y.property
    have h := τ.abs_gramMoment_rpow_sub_le_norm hτ htrace
      (⟨S,hS⟩ : P) (⟨T,hT⟩ : P) m hm
    exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_mean_uniform
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_mean_uniform
    (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0<q) (hr : 0<r)
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 4<K) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im)
    (hησ : z.im≤Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))) :
    ‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4*q : ℝ)) *
        (2*q*r+1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4*q : ℝ)) *
          (((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            ((star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z) *
              resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z) ^ (2*q))).re) ^
                (1 / (4*q : ℝ)) +
            18*Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))/z.im^2*(K/(r : ℝ)+K⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  let C := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (D := D) (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B)
  let Y := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination (0 : Matrix D D ℂ) A
  have hD : IsSelfAdjoint (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) :=
    hA₀.isSelfAdjoint.map
      (CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv (n := D) (A := ℂ)).toStarAlgHom
  have hY : IsSelfAdjoint Y := isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination (by simp) hA
  have hdeg : ∀ i j, Y i j∈wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1 :=
    wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan 0 A
  have hzero : CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (0 : Matrix D D ℂ)=0 := rfl
  have hnorm : ‖Y‖≤2*Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2)) := by
    simpa only [hzero,map_zero,sub_zero] using
      norm_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le 0 A hA
  have heq : C (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀)+Y=wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A := by
    simp only [Y,wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination,C,hzero,map_zero,zero_add]
  have h := norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow_mean_uniform
    q r hq hr (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀) hD Y hY hdeg hK hnorm hz hησ
  rwa [heq] at h

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_add
statement:
theorem wordMatrixTensor_add (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (T U : B) :
    wordMatrixTensor A (T + U) = wordMatrixTensor A T + wordMatrixTensor A U
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordMatrixTensor
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change A i j • (T + U) = A i j • T + A i j • U
  exact smul_add _ _ _

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixTensor_zero (A : Matrix D D ℂ) :
    wordMatrixTensor A (0 : B) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordMatrixTensor
  rw [← map_zero (CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W))]
  congr 1
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change A i j • (0 : B) = 0
  exact smul_zero _

name: NLAlib.star_wordMatrixTensor
statement:
theorem star_wordMatrixTensor (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (T : B) :
    star (wordMatrixTensor A T) = wordMatrixTensor Aᴴ (star T)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordMatrixTensor
  rw [← map_star]
  congr 1
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change star (A j i • T) = star (A j i) • star T
  exact star_smul _ _

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_mul
statement:
theorem wordMatrixTensor_mul (A E : Matrix D D ℂ) (T U : B) :
    wordMatrixTensor A T * wordMatrixTensor E U = wordMatrixTensor (A * E) (T * U)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordMatrixTensor
  rw [← map_mul]
  congr 1
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change (∑ l, (A i l • T) * (E l j • U)) = (∑ l, A i l * E l j) • (T * U)
  simp only [Finset.sum_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_one
statement:
theorem wordMatrixTensor_one (A : Matrix D D ℂ) :
    wordMatrixTensor A (1 : B) = wordMatrixCoefficientHom A
proof:

  simp only [wordMatrixTensor_apply, wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply,

name: NLAlib.star_sum_wordMatrixOperator
statement:
private theorem star_sum_wordMatrixOperator [Fintype ι] (f : ι → K →L[ℂ] K) :
    star (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i, star (f i)
proof:
:= by
  change ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (f i)
  exact map_sum _ _ _

name: NLAlib.star_wordMatrixCreationSum_mul
statement:
theorem star_wordMatrixCreationSum_mul [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) :
    star (wordMatrixCreationSum A) * wordMatrixCreationSum A =
      wordMatrixCoefficientHom (∑ i, (A i)ᴴ * A i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordMatrixCreationSum
  rw [star_sum_wordMatrixOperator, Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, star_wordMatrixTensor, wordMatrixTensor_mul,
    star_wordCreation_mul_wordCreation]
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp only [ite_true, wordMatrixTensor_one]
  · intro j _ hji
    simp only [if_neg (Ne.symm hji), wordMatrixTensor_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixCreationSum_sq
statement:
theorem norm_wordMatrixCreationSum_sq [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) :

proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixCreationSum
statement:

name: NLAlib.sum_wordMatrixTensor_wordField_eq
statement:
theorem sum_wordMatrixTensor_wordField_eq [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, wordMatrixTensor (A i) (wordField i)) =
      wordMatrixCreationSum A + star (wordMatrixCreationSum A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordField, wordAnnihilation, ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    wordMatrixTensor_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, wordMatrixCreationSum,

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_wordMatrixTensor_wordField_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_wordMatrixTensor_wordField_le [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    ‖∑ i, wordMatrixTensor (A i) (wordField i)‖ ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_wordMatrixTensor_wordField_eq A hA]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖wordMatrixCreationSum A‖ + ‖star (wordMatrixCreationSum A)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2)) := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map,
        norm_wordMatrixCreationSum]
      simp only [fun i => (hA i).eq, ← pow_two]
      ring

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le

theorem norm_wordMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le [Fintype ι]

name: NLAlib.norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_high
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_high
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q) {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im)
    (hση : Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))≤z.im)
    (hspec : z.re∈spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) :
    ‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z‖ ≤
      5*(Fintype.card D : ℝ)^(1/(4*q : ℝ))*
        ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
          ((star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)*
            resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)^(2*q))).re)^
              (1/(4*q : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let X := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
  let V := CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W)
  let R := resolvent X z
  let b : ℝ := (Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
    (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star R*R)^(2*q))).re
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint X := isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA
  have hVX : V X=wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A := toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
  have hspecV : z.re∈spectrum ℝ (V X) := by
    rw [hself.map_spectrum_real V CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom_injective]
    exact hspec
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hres⟩ := exists_unit_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_residual_le hA₀ A hA hz hση
    (by rwa [hVX] at hspecV)
  let u := wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v
  have hu : ‖u‖=1 := by simpa only [u,LinearIsometry.norm_map] using hv
  have hVR : V R=resolvent (V X) z := V.toAlgHom.map_resolvent
    (hself.isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne')
  have hlower : (5*z.im)⁻¹≤‖V R u‖ := by
    rw [hVR,hVX]
    exact (isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).inv_le_norm_resolvent_apply_of_residual_le
      hz.ne' hu (by positivity) hres
  have hmoment : ‖V R u‖≤b^(1/(4*q : ℝ)) := by
    have h := norm_toPiLp_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_le_gramMoment R v hv (2*q) (by omega)
    have he : ((2 : ℝ)*(2*q : ℕ))⁻¹=1/(4*q : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hnorm : ‖R‖≤z.im⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [abs_of_pos hz] using hself.norm_resolvent_le hz.ne'
  have hinv : 5*(5*z.im)⁻¹=z.im⁻¹ := by field_simp [hz.ne']
  have hbound : ‖R‖≤5*b^(1/(4*q : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ z.im⁻¹ := hnorm
      _ = 5*(5*z.im)⁻¹ := hinv.symm
      _ ≤ 5*‖V R u‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlower (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment (by norm_num)
  have hτ : 0≤(wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star R*R)^(2*q))).re :=
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp ((wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι)).map_nonneg
      (CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg R) (2*q)))).1
  have hfactor : b^(1/(4*q : ℝ))=
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ)^(1/(4*q : ℝ))*
        ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star R*R)^(2*q))).re)^
          (1/(4*q : ℝ)) := Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hτ
  rw [hfactor,← mul_assoc] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.norm_wordVacuumExpectation_entry_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordVacuumExpectation_entry_le (T : M) (i j : D) :
    ‖wordVacuumExpectation ι (T i j)‖≤‖T‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖wordVacuum ι‖*‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖wordVacuum ι‖*(‖T i j‖*‖wordVacuum ι‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((T i j).le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ := by simpa only [norm_wordVacuum,one_mul,mul_one] using
      (show ‖T i j‖≤‖T‖ from CStarMatrix.norm_entry_le_norm)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_wordMatrixVacuumCompression_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_wordMatrixVacuumCompression_le (T : M) :
    specNorm (wordMatrixVacuumCompression T)≤(Fintype.card D : ℝ)*‖T‖
proof:
:= by
  have hf : frobSq (wordMatrixVacuumCompression T)≤(Fintype.card D : ℝ)^2*‖T‖^2 := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : D,∑ _j : D,‖T‖^2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
          (norm_wordVacuumExpectation_entry_le T i j) 2
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  have hh := (specNorm_sq_le_frobSq (wordMatrixVacuumCompression T)).trans hf
  have hn := specNorm_nonneg (wordMatrixVacuumCompression T)
  have hd : 0≤(Fintype.card D : ℝ)*‖T‖ := by positivity
  nlinarith only [hh,hn,hd]

name: NLAlib.norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_log_order
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_log_order
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q) (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card D : ℝ)≤q)
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im)
    (hspec : z.re∈spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) :
    ‖resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z‖ ≤
      (438*Real.exp 5)*
        (((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
          ((star (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)*
            resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)^(2*q))).re)^
              (1/(4*q : ℝ)) +
          Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))/((Fintype.card D : ℝ)^2*z.im^2))
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with
  | inl hD =>
    let : Subsingleton M := ⟨fun S T => by ext i; exact (hD.false i).elim⟩
    rw [spectrum.of_subsingleton] at hspec
    exact hspec.elim
  | inr hD =>
    let : Nonempty D := hD
    let d : ℝ := Fintype.card D
    let σ := Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))
    let X := wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
    let R := resolvent X z
    let lp : ℝ := ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
      ((star R*R)^(2*q))).re)^(1/(4*q : ℝ))
    let E : ℝ := σ/(d^2*z.im^2)
    let c : ℝ := 73*Real.exp 5
    have hd : 1≤d := by
      change 1≤(Fintype.card D : ℝ)
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Fintype.card_pos (α := D)))
    have hdpos : 0<d := zero_lt_one.trans_le hd
    have hqR : 1≤(q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hq)
    have hτ : 0≤(wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star R*R)^(2*q))).re :=
      (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp ((wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι)).map_nonneg
        (CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg R) (2*q)))).1
    have hlp : 0≤lp := Real.rpow_nonneg hτ _
    have hE : 0≤E := by dsimp only [E,σ]; positivity
    have hc : 0<c := by dsimp only [c]; positivity
    have hc6 : 438*Real.exp 5=6*c := by dsimp only [c]; ring
    change ‖R‖≤(438*Real.exp 5)*(lp+E)
    rw [hc6]
    by_cases hησ : z.im≤σ
    · let r : ℕ := 36*(Fintype.card D)^4
      let K : ℝ := 6*d^2
      have hr : 0<r := by dsimp only [r]; positivity
      have hK : 4<K := by
        have hh : 1≤d^2 := one_le_pow₀ hd
        dsimp only [K]
        linarith only [hh]
      have hb := norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_mean_uniform
        q r hq hr hA₀ A hA hK hz hησ
      have hbase : (2*q*(r : ℝ)+1 : ℝ)=72*q*d^4+1 := by
        dsimp only [r,d]
        push_cast
        ring
      have herror : 18*σ/z.im^2*(K/(r : ℝ)+K⁻¹)=6*E := by
        dsimp only [K,r,E,d]
        push_cast
        field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := D)),hz.ne']
        ring
      change ‖R‖≤d^(3/(4*q : ℝ))*(2*q*(r : ℝ)+1)^(3/(4*q : ℝ))*
        (lp+18*σ/z.im^2*(K/(r : ℝ)+K⁻¹)) at hb
      rw [hbase,herror] at hb
      have hfactor : d^(3/(4*q : ℝ))*(72*q*d^4+1)^(3/(4*q : ℝ))≤c :=
        nativeResolventMomentFactor_le hd hqR hlog
      calc
        _ ≤ _ := hb
        _ ≤ c*(lp+6*E) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfactor (by positivity)
        _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith only [mul_nonneg hc.le hlp]
    · have hση : σ≤z.im := le_of_not_ge hησ
      have hb := norm_resolvent_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_le_evenMoment_high
        q hq hA₀ A hA hz hση hspec
      have hdim : d^(1/(4*q : ℝ))≤Real.exp (1/4) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hdpos]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hh : Real.log d/(4*q : ℝ)≤1/4 :=
          (div_le_iff₀ (show 0<(4*q : ℝ) by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith only [hlog])
        simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul] using hh
      have hdimc : 5*d^(1/(4*q : ℝ))≤c := by
        calc
          _ ≤ 5*Real.exp (1/4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdim (by norm_num)
          _ ≤ 5*Real.exp 5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
          _ ≤ _ := by dsimp only [c]; nlinarith only [Real.exp_pos (5 : ℝ)]
      change ‖R‖≤5*d^(1/(4*q : ℝ))*lp at hb
      exact hb.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdimc hlp).trans
        (by nlinarith only [mul_nonneg hc.le hlp,mul_nonneg hc.le hE]))

name: NLAlib.list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan
statement:
private theorem list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan (w : List ι) {k : ℕ} (hw : w.length ≤ k) :
    (w.map wordField).prod ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.wordFieldDegreeSpan_mono
statement:
private theorem wordFieldDegreeSpan_mono {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) j ≤ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  exact list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan w (hw.trans hjk)

name: NLAlib.mul_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan
statement:
private theorem mul_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan {j k : ℕ} {S T : B}
    (hS : S ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) j)
    (hT : T ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    S * T ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (j + k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂
    (p := fun S T _ _ => S * T ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (j + k))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hS hT
  · rintro _ _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    simpa only [List.map_append, List.prod_append] using
      list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan (u ++ v) (by simp; omega : (u ++ v).length ≤ j + k)
  · intro _ _; simp only [zero_mul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro _ _; simp only [mul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2
    simpa only [add_mul] using Submodule.add_mem _ h1 h2
  · intro _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2
    simpa only [mul_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ h1 h2
  · intro c _ _ _ _ h
    simpa only [smul_mul_assoc] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c h
  · intro c _ _ _ _ h
    simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c h

name: NLAlib.star_list_prod_wordField
statement:
private theorem star_list_prod_wordField (w : List ι) :
    star (w.map wordField).prod = (w.reverse.map wordField).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w hw =>
    simp [List.reverse_cons, List.map_append, List.prod_append, star_mul, hw,
      (isSelfAdjoint_wordField i).star_eq]

name: NLAlib.star_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hT using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem _ h =>
    rcases h with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    rw [star_list_prod_wordField]
    exact list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan w.reverse (by simpa using hw)
  | zero => simp only [star_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => simpa only [star_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ h1 h2
  | smul c _ _ h => simpa only [star_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ (star c) h

name: NLAlib.wordWickOperator_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan
statement:
private theorem wordWickOperator_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan (w : List ι) :
    wordWickOperator w ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil =>
    simpa only [wordWickOperator, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil] using
      list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan ([] : List ι) le_rfl
  | singleton i =>
    simpa only [wordWickOperator, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
      List.prod_nil, mul_one] using list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan [i] le_rfl
  | cons_cons i j w hw hcons =>
    change wordField i * wordWickOperator (j :: w) -
      (if i = j then wordWickOperator w else 0) ∈ _
    apply Submodule.sub_mem
    · have hi : wordField i ∈ wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1 := by
        simpa using list_prod_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan [i] le_rfl
      simpa only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_comm 1] using
        mul_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan hi (hcons j)
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [if_pos hij]
        exact wordFieldDegreeSpan_mono (by simp; omega) hw
      · rw [if_neg hij]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: NLAlib.wordFieldDegreeSpan_eq_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
private theorem wordFieldDegreeSpan_eq_wordWickDegreeSpan (k : ℕ) :
    wordFieldDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k = wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact wordWickDegreeSpan_mono hw (list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan w)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨m, w⟩, rfl⟩
    apply wordFieldDegreeSpan_mono _ (wordWickOperator_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan w.toList)
    have hw : w.toList.length = (m : ℕ) := by simp
    rw [hw]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ m.isLt

name: NLAlib.star_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordFieldDegreeSpan_eq_wordWickDegreeSpan] at hT ⊢
  exact star_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan hT

name: NLAlib.mul_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem mul_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan {j k : ℕ} {S T : B}
    (hS : S ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) j)
    (hT : T ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    S * T ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (j + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordFieldDegreeSpan_eq_wordWickDegreeSpan] at hS hT ⊢
  exact mul_mem_wordFieldDegreeSpan hS hT

name: NLAlib.star_wordVacuumProjection
statement:
@[simp]
theorem star_wordVacuumProjection : star (wordVacuumProjection ι) = wordVacuumProjection ι

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumProjection_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordVacuumProjection_apply_single (w : List ι) (z : ℂ) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.commute_wordCreation_wordRightCreation
statement:
theorem commute_wordCreation_wordRightCreation (i j : ι) :
    Commute (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap (wordRightCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  change _ * _ = _ * _
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def]
  apply lp.ext_continuousLinearMap (by simp : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
  intro w
  ext z
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap]

name: NLAlib.wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightCreation_sub
statement:
theorem wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightCreation_sub (i j : ι) :
    wordAnnihilation i * (wordRightCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap -
        (wordRightCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap * wordAnnihilation i =
      if i = j then wordVacuumProjection ι else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply lp.ext_continuousLinearMap (by simp : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
  intro w
  ext z
  cases w with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hij : i = j <;>
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, hij]
  | cons a w =>
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> by_cases hia : i = a <;>
      simp_all [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap]

name: NLAlib.commute_wordField_wordRightField
statement:
theorem commute_wordField_wordRightField (i j : ι) :
    Commute (wordField i) (wordRightField j)
proof:
:= by
  let C : B := (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap
  let D : B := (wordRightCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hc : Commute C D := commute_wordCreation_wordRightCreation i j
  have ha : Commute (star C) (star D) := hc.star_star
  have hd : star C * D - D * star C = if i = j then wordVacuumProjection ι else 0 := by
    simpa only [C, D, wordAnnihilation, ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] using
      wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightCreation_sub i j
  have hds : star D * C - C * star D = if i = j then wordVacuumProjection ι else 0 := by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simpa only [star_sub, star_mul, star_star, if_pos hij,
        star_wordVacuumProjection] using congrArg star hd
    · simpa only [star_sub, star_mul, star_star, if_neg hij,
        star_zero] using congrArg star hd
  have hm : star C * D + C * star D = D * star C + star D * C := by
    have h := sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.mp (hd.trans hds.symm)
    simpa only [add_comm] using h
  change Commute (C + star C) (D + star D)
  change _ * _ = _ * _
  calc
    (C + star C) * (D + star D) = C * D + star C * star D + (star C * D + C * star D) := by
      noncomm_ring
    _ = D * C + star D * star C + (D * star C + star D * C) := by rw [hc.eq, ha.eq, hm]
    _ = (D + star D) * (C + star C) := by noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le_residual
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le_residual
    {A₀ : M} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → M} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) (y : M)
    (hc : ((Fintype.card D : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹)*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*specNorm y≤1/2) :
    specNorm (y-wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z)≤
      2*((Fintype.card D : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹)*
        specNorm ((z•(1 : M)-A₀-coefficientSandwichSum A y)*y-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z*
      (z•(1 : M)-A₀-coefficientSandwichSum A (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z))=1 := by
    rw [coefficientSandwichSum_apply_of_isHermitian A hA]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (wordNativeDysonResolvent_dyson hA₀ hA hz)
  have hn := specNorm_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le hA₀ hA hz
  have hh : ‖wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z‖*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*‖y‖≤1/2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ((Fintype.card D : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹)*‖coefficientSandwichSum A‖*‖y‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := hc
  exact (norm_sub_le_two_mul_norm_mul_norm_dyson_residual
    (coefficientSandwichSum A) A₀ (z•(1 : M)) _ y hm hh).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (by norm_num)) (norm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re_nonneg
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re_nonneg (T : M) :
    0 ≤ (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
  positivity

name: NLAlib.norm_entry_wordVacuum_le_sqrt_card_mul
statement:
theorem norm_entry_wordVacuum_le_sqrt_card_mul (T : M) (i j : D) :
    ‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D) *
      Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re)
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_entry_wordVacuum_sq_le_card_mul_wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re T i j
  have hm := wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re_nonneg T
  have hc : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hright : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D) *
      Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re) := by positivity
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D) *
      Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re)) ^ 2 =
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) *
        (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hc, Real.sq_sqrt hm]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (T i j (wordVacuum ι))]

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_apply (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι)) (i j : D) :
    wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P i j = FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → B) (P i j)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_le [Fintype ι] (k : ℕ)
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι))
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈
      (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι) (P i j)).coeff.support,
        w.toList.length ≤ k) :
    ‖wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P‖ ≤
      ((Fintype.card D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D)) *
        ((k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1)) *
          Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            (star (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P) * wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P)).re)
proof:
:= by
  let T := wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P
  let r := ((k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1)) *
    (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D) *
      Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re))
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp only [r]; positivity
  have hT (i j : D) : ‖T i j‖ ≤ r := by
    exact (norm_freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_le k (P i j) (hdeg i j)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_entry_wordVacuum_le_sqrt_card_mul T i j) (by positivity))
  have h := CStarMatrix.norm_le_card_mul_of_forall_norm_entry_le T hr hT
  change ‖T‖ ≤ _
  convert! h using 1
  dsimp only [r]
  ring

name: NLAlib.realWordResolventCFC
statement: private theorem realWordResolventCFC : IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ M IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := M)

name: NLAlib.norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow
    (k q r : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (T : M) (hself : IsSelfAdjoint T)
    (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ‖resolvent T z‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
        (2 * q * r * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
          (((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            ((star (resolvent T z) * resolvent T z) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^
              (1 / (4 * q : ℝ)) + 12 * ‖T‖ / ((r : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with
  | inl hD =>
    have hzero : resolvent T z = 0 := by ext i; exact (hD.false i).elim
    have hcard : Fintype.card D = 0 := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mpr hD
    have he : (3 : ℝ) / (4 * q) ≠ 0 := by
      have hqR : 0 < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
      positivity
    simp only [hzero, norm_zero, hcard, Nat.cast_zero, Real.zero_rpow he, zero_mul,
      le_refl]
  | inr hD =>
    let : Nonempty D := hD
    let φ := wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι)
    have hφ : φ 1 = 1 := wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_one
    let hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) :=
      isProbabilityMeasure_positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hφ hself
    let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖
    let δ : ℝ := 6 * ‖T‖ / ((r : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2)
    have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := by dsimp only [δ]; positivity
    have hf : Continuous f := by
      apply Continuous.norm
      apply (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal).inv₀
      intro x hx
      have heq : z = (x : ℂ) := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
      have : z.im = 0 := by rw [heq]; rfl
      exact hz.ne' this
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, happ⟩ := exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_approximation
      hz ‖T‖ (norm_nonneg _) r hr
    have hinterval (x : spectrum ℝ T) : (x : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-‖T‖) ‖T‖ := by
      have hone : ‖(1 : M)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have h := CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self (x := (1 : M))
        simp only [star_one, one_mul] at h
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1 : M)]
      have hb : |(x : ℝ)| ≤ ‖T‖ := by
        have hb : |(x : ℝ)| ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖(1 : M)‖ := by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using spectrum.norm_le_norm_mul_of_mem x.property
        exact hb.trans
          (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg T) hone)
      exact abs_le.mp hb
    have happrox (x : spectrum ℝ T) : |Q.eval (x : ℝ) - f x| ≤ δ := by
      simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using happ x (hinterval x)
    have hmem : MemLp (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => f x) (4 * q : ENNReal)
        (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) :=
      (hf.comp continuous_subtype_val).memLp_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
    have hp : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 4 * q := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ 4 * q by omega)
    have hLp : lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => Q.eval (x : ℝ)) (4 * q : ENNReal)
        (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) ≤
        lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => f x) (4 * q : ENNReal)
          (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) + δ :=
      lpNorm_le_add_of_uniform_approximation hmem hp
        (by exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (by simp)) hδ happrox
    have hnormdiff : ‖cfc f T - Polynomial.aeval T Q‖ ≤ δ := by
      rw [← cfc_polynomial Q T hself, ← cfc_sub f (fun x => Q.eval x) T
        hf.continuousOn Q.continuous.continuousOn]
      apply norm_cfc_le hδ
      intro x hx
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm] using happrox ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hnorm : ‖resolvent T z‖ ≤ ‖Polynomial.aeval T Q‖ + δ := by
      rw [← hself.norm_cfc_resolvent_modulus hz.ne']
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖Polynomial.aeval T Q‖ + ‖cfc f T - Polynomial.aeval T Q‖ :=
          norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' _ _
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl hnormdiff
    have hdegree := aeval_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (D := D) (ι := ι) hT Q
      (Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_degree_le hQ)
    have hpoly := norm_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow (D := D) (ι := ι) (r * k) q hq
      (Polynomial.aeval T Q) hdegree
    have hpolyLp : lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => Q.eval (x : ℝ)) (4 * q : ENNReal)
        (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) =
          ((φ ((star (Polynomial.aeval T Q) * Polynomial.aeval T Q) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^
            ((4 * q : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      have hQeq : cfc (fun x : ℝ => Q.eval x) T = Polynomial.aeval T Q :=
        cfc_polynomial Q T hself
      calc
        _ = ((φ ((star (cfc Q.eval T) * cfc Q.eval T) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^
            ((4 * q : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_eq_gramMoment φ hself
            Q.eval Q.continuous.continuousOn q hq
        _ = _ := by rw [hQeq]
    have hresLp : lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => f x) (4 * q : ENNReal)
        (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) =
          ((φ ((star (resolvent T z) * resolvent T z) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^
            ((4 * q : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      lpNorm_positiveSpectrumMeasure_resolvent_modulus φ hself hz.ne' q hq
    let C : ℝ := (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
      (2 * q * r * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ))
    have hCzero : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
    have hCone : 1 ≤ C := by
      dsimp only [C]
      apply one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
      · apply Real.one_le_rpow
        · exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Fintype.card_pos (α := D)))
        · positivity
      · apply Real.one_le_rpow
        · have hn : 0 ≤ (2 * q * r * k : ℝ) := by positivity
          linarith
        · positivity
    have hpoly' : ‖Polynomial.aeval T Q‖ ≤
        C * lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => Q.eval (x : ℝ)) (4 * q : ENNReal)
          (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) := by
      rw [hpolyLp]
      simpa only [C, φ, wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap_apply,
        one_div, Nat.cast_mul, ← mul_assoc] using hpoly
    have hbound : ‖resolvent T z‖ ≤
        C * (lpNorm (fun x : spectrum ℝ T => f x) (4 * q : ENNReal)
          (positiveSpectrumMeasure φ hself) + 2 * δ) := by
      have ha := (hnorm.trans (add_le_add hpoly' le_rfl)).trans
        (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLp hCzero) le_rfl)
      have hb : δ ≤ C * δ := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    rw [hresLp] at hbound
    convert hbound using 1
    simp only [C, δ, φ, wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap_apply, one_div]
    ring

name: NLAlib.toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
statement:
theorem toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) :
    CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W)
      (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) = wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination wordMatrixLinearCombination
  rw [map_add,map_sum]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (i j : D) :
    wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : B) ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1 := by
    simpa only [wordWickOperator] using
      wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan ([] : List ι) (by simp : 0≤1)
  have hf (k : ι) : wordField k ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1 := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.prod_cons,List.prod_nil,mul_one,
      List.length_cons,List.length_nil] using
      list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan [k]
  change (A₀ i j) • (1 : B)+(∑ k, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix
      (fun i j => A k i j • wordField k)) i j ∈ _
  apply Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h1)
  let F : ι → M := fun k => CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => A k i j • wordField k)
  have hsum (s : Finset ι) : (∑ k∈s, F k) i j=∑ k∈s, A k i j•wordField k := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => rfl
    | @insert k s hk ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hk,Finset.sum_insert hk,CStarMatrix.add_apply,ih]
      rfl
  rw [show (∑ k, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => A k i j•wordField k)) i j=
    ∑ k, A k i j•wordField k from hsum Finset.univ]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hf k)

name: NLAlib.isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
proof:
:= by
  apply (CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_toPiLpStarAlgHom_iff _).mp
  rw [toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination]
  exact isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA

name: NLAlib.norm_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian) :
    ‖wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A-
      CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A₀)‖ ≤
        2*Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CStarMatrix.norm_toPiLpStarAlgHom,map_sub,toPiLp_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination]
  exact norm_wordMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le A₀ A hA

name: NLAlib.freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (k : ℕ) (P : FreeAlgebra ℂ ι)
    (hdeg : ∀ w ∈ (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι) P).coeff.support,
      w.toList.length ≤ k) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → B) P ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:= by
  have hEval : FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → B) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ B (FreeMonoid ι) (FreeMonoid.lift wordField)).comp
        (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι)).toAlgHom := by
    ext i
    simp [FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid]
  rw [hEval, AlgHom.comp_apply, MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply]
  simp only [FreeMonoid.lift_apply]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro w hw
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  exact wordWickDegreeSpan_mono (hdeg w hw) (list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan w.toList)

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (k : ℕ)
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι))
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈
      (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι) (P i j)).coeff.support,
        w.toList.length ≤ k) (i j : D) :
    wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:=
  freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan k (P i j) (hdeg i j)

name: NLAlib.mul_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem mul_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan {j k : ℕ} {S T : M}
    (hS : ∀ i l, S i l ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) j)
    (hT : ∀ l i, T l i ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    ∀ i l, (S * T) i l ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (j + k)
proof:
:= by
  intro i l
  rw [CStarMatrix.mul_apply]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun a _ => mul_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (hS i a) (hT a l))

name: NLAlib.star_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  rw [CStarMatrix.star_apply]
  exact star_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (hT j i)

name: NLAlib.pow_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    intro i j
    simp only [pow_zero, zero_mul, CStarMatrix.one_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · rw [if_pos hij]
      simpa only [wordWickOperator] using
        wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan ([] : List ι) (by simp : ([] : List ι).length ≤ 0)
    · rw [if_neg hij]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ q hq =>
    simpa only [pow_succ, Nat.succ_mul] using mul_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan hq hT

name: NLAlib.norm_le_wordMatrixVacuumL2_of_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem norm_le_wordMatrixVacuumL2_of_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan [Fintype ι]
    (k : ℕ) (T : M) (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    ‖T‖ ≤ ((Fintype.card D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D)) *
      ((k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1)) *
        Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re)
proof:
:= by
  let r := ((k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1)) *
    (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D) *
      Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re))
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp only [r]; positivity
  have hbound (i j : D) : ‖T i j‖ ≤ r :=
    (norm_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum_of_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (hT i j)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_entry_wordVacuum_le_sqrt_card_mul T i j) (by positivity))
  have h := CStarMatrix.norm_le_card_mul_of_forall_norm_entry_le T hr hbound
  convert! h using 1
  dsimp only [r]
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_pow_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment
statement:
theorem norm_pow_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment [Fintype ι] (k q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (T : M) (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    ‖T‖ ^ (2 * q) ≤ ((Fintype.card D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D)) *
      ((2 * q * k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * q * k + 1)) *
        Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
          ((star T * T) ^ (2 * q))).re)
proof:
:= by
  have hGram : ∀ i j, (star T * T) i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (2 * k) := by
    simpa only [two_mul] using
      mul_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (star_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan hT) hT
  have hQ := pow_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan hGram q
  have hQ' : ∀ i j, ((star T * T) ^ q) i j ∈
      wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (2 * q * k) := by
    have hdegree : q * (2 * k) = 2 * q * k := by ring
    simpa only [hdegree] using hQ
  have h := norm_le_wordMatrixVacuumL2_of_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
    (2 * q * k) ((star T * T) ^ q) hQ'
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint (star T * T) := IsSelfAdjoint.star_mul_self T
  have hnormGram : ‖star T * T‖ = ‖T‖ * ‖T‖ :=
    CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self (x := T)
  have hnorm : ‖(star T * T) ^ q‖ = ‖T‖ ^ (2 * q) := by
    rw [hSA.norm_pow_of_pos hq, hnormGram, ← pow_two, ← pow_mul]
  have hstar : star ((star T * T) ^ q) * (star T * T) ^ q = (star T * T) ^ (2 * q) := by
    rw [(hSA.pow q).star_eq, ← pow_add, ← two_mul]
  simpa only [hnorm, hstar, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one] using h

name: NLAlib.rpow_inv_two_mul_mul_sqrt
statement:
private theorem rpow_inv_two_mul_mul_sqrt {x q : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (x * Real.sqrt x) ^ ((2 * q)⁻¹) = x ^ (3 / (4 * q))
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 ≤ (2 * q)⁻¹ := by positivity
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hx (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx,
    ← Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg hx hr (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.rpow_inv_two_mul_sqrt
statement:
private theorem rpow_inv_two_mul_sqrt {x q : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (Real.sqrt x) ^ ((2 * q)⁻¹) = x ^ (1 / (4 * q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.norm_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow
statement:
theorem norm_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow [Fintype ι] (k q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (T : M) (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    ‖T‖ ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
      (2 * q * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
        ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
          ((star T * T) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^ (1 / (4 * q : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hqR : 0 < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint (star T * T) := IsSelfAdjoint.star_mul_self T
  have hstar : star ((star T * T) ^ q) * (star T * T) ^ q = (star T * T) ^ (2 * q) := by
    rw [(hSA.pow q).star_eq, ← pow_add, ← two_mul]
  have hm : 0 ≤ (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
      ((star T * T) ^ (2 * q))).re := by
    rw [← hstar]
    exact wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re_nonneg _
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (z := (((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) (by positivity)
    (norm_pow_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment k q hq T hT) (by positivity)
  rw [Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (norm_nonneg T) (by omega)] at h
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
    Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity),
    rpow_inv_two_mul_mul_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hqR,
    rpow_inv_two_mul_mul_sqrt (by positivity) hqR,
    rpow_inv_two_mul_sqrt hm hqR] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_le_evenMoment_rpow
statement:
theorem norm_wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_le_evenMoment_rpow [Fintype ι]
    (k q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι))
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈
      (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι) (P i j)).coeff.support,
        w.toList.length ≤ k) :
    ‖wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
        (2 * q * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
          ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            ((star (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P) *
              wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^ (1 / (4 * q : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  norm_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow k q hq _
    (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan k P hdeg)

name: NLAlib.wordWickDegreeIndex_toList_injective
statement:
private theorem wordWickDegreeIndex_toList_injective (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun w : WordWickDegreeIndex ι k => w.2.toList)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨m, u⟩ ⟨n, v⟩ h
  have hmn : m = n := Fin.ext (by
    have hlen := congrArg List.length h
    simpa using hlen)
