name: NLAlib.orthonormal_wordWickDegreeBasis
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro u v
  simp [lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply,
    (wordWickDegreeIndex_toList_injective (ι := ι) k).eq_iff]

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_wordWickOperator_wordVacuum_sq
statement:
theorem norm_sum_wordWickOperator_wordVacuum_sq [Fintype ι] (k : ℕ)
    (a : WordWickDegreeIndex ι k → ℂ) :
    ‖(∑ w, a w • wordWickOperator w.2.toList) (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ w, ‖a w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := (orthonormal_wordWickDegreeBasis (ι := ι) k).orthogonalFamily.norm_sum
    a Finset.univ
  simpa only [sum_apply, smul_apply, wordWickOperator_wordVacuum,
    LinearIsometry.toSpanSingleton_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_wordWickOperator_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum
statement:
theorem norm_sum_wordWickOperator_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum [Fintype ι] (k : ℕ)
    (a : WordWickDegreeIndex ι k → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ w, a w • wordWickOperator w.2.toList‖ ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1) *
        ‖(∑ w, a w • wordWickOperator w.2.toList) (wordVacuum ι)‖
proof:
:= by
  let b : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ := fun m => Real.sqrt (∑ w : List.Vector ι m, ‖a ⟨m, w⟩‖ ^ 2)
  let T : B := ∑ w, a w • wordWickOperator w.2.toList
  have hb (m : Fin (k + 1)) : 0 ≤ b m := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hb2 (m : Fin (k + 1)) : (b m) ^ 2 = ∑ w : List.Vector ι m, ‖a ⟨m, w⟩‖ ^ 2 := by
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hmass : ∑ m, (b m) ^ 2 = ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp_rw [hb2]
    rw [← Fintype.sum_sigma']
    exact (norm_sum_wordWickOperator_wordVacuum_sq k a).symm
  have hcs : (∑ m, b m) ^ 2 ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := Finset.univ) (f := b)
    simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hmass] using h
  have hsum : ∑ m, b m ≤ Real.sqrt (k + 1) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖ := by
    have hk : 0 ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (k + 1) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖ := by positivity
    have hrightsq : (Real.sqrt (k + 1) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖) ^ 2 =
        (k + 1 : ℝ) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hk]
    nlinarith
  change ‖T‖ ≤ _
  calc
    ‖T‖ = ‖∑ m : Fin (k + 1), ∑ w : List.Vector ι m,
        a ⟨m, w⟩ • wordWickOperator w.toList‖ := by simp only [T, Fintype.sum_sigma]
    _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin (k + 1), ‖∑ w : List.Vector ι m,
        a ⟨m, w⟩ • wordWickOperator w.toList‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin (k + 1), (m + 1 : ℝ) * b m := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m _
      exact norm_sum_wordWickOperator_le m (fun w => a ⟨m, w⟩)
    _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin (k + 1), (k + 1 : ℝ) * b m := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m _
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hb m)
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ m.isLt)
    _ = (k + 1 : ℝ) * ∑ m, b m := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (k + 1) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
    _ = _ := mul_assoc _ _ _ |>.symm

name: NLAlib.norm_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum_of_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem norm_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum_of_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan [Fintype ι]
    {k : ℕ} {T : B} (hT : T ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    ‖T‖ ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1) * ‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℂ).mp hT
  exact norm_sum_wordWickOperator_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum k a

name: NLAlib.freeAlgebraEvaluation_wordField
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeAlgebraEvaluation_wordField
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι)) :
    CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ (wordField : ι → B) P=wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.normalizedPositiveFunctional_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix
statement:
theorem normalizedPositiveFunctional_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1) (X : ι → A)
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι)) :
    CStarMatrix.normalizedPositiveFunctional φ (CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X P)=
      wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P)
proof:
:= by
  change (Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹*(∑ j,φ (FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ X (P j j)))=
    (Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹*(∑ j,wordVacuumExpectation ι (FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ wordField (P j j)))
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
    freeAlgebra_lift_moment_eq_wordField_of_semicircular φ.toLinearMap hφ X hFree hLaw (P j j)

name: NLAlib.normalizedPositiveFunctional_freeAlgebraEvaluation_pow_eq_wordMatrix
statement:
theorem normalizedPositiveFunctional_freeAlgebraEvaluation_pow_eq_wordMatrix
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1) (X : ι → A)
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι)) (n : ℕ) :
    CStarMatrix.normalizedPositiveFunctional φ ((CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X P)^n)=
      wordMatrixVacuumExpectation ((wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P)^n)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := normalizedPositiveFunctional_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix φ hφ X hFree hLaw (P^n)
  change CStarMatrix.normalizedPositiveFunctional φ (CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X (P^n))=
    wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ (wordField : ι → B) (P^n)) at hh
  simpa only [map_pow,freeAlgebraEvaluation_wordField] using hh

name: NLAlib.spectrum_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix_of_semicircular
statement:
theorem spectrum_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix_of_semicircular
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1)
    (hfaithful : ∀ a : A, φ (star a*a)=0 → a=0) (X : ι → A)
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι))
    (hPX : IsSelfAdjoint (CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X P))
    (hPW : IsSelfAdjoint (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P)) :
    spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X P)=
      spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P)
proof:
:= by
  apply spectrum_real_eq_of_faithful_power_moments
    (CStarMatrix.normalizedPositiveFunctional φ) (wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι))
    ⊤ isClosed_univ (wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι)) isClosed_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra
  · intro T _ hz
    exact CStarMatrix.eq_zero_of_normalizedPositiveFunctional_star_mul_eq_zero φ hfaithful T hz
  · intro T hT hz
    exact eq_zero_of_entries_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_eq_zero T hT hz
  · exact hPX
  · exact hPW
  · trivial
  · intro i j
    exact freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra (P i j)
  · intro n
    exact congrArg Complex.re
      (normalizedPositiveFunctional_freeAlgebraEvaluation_pow_eq_wordMatrix φ hφ X hFree hLaw P n)

name: NLAlib.norm_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix_of_semicircular
statement:
theorem norm_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix_of_semicircular
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1)
    (hfaithful : ∀ a : A, φ (star a*a)=0 → a=0) (X : ι → A)
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (P : Matrix D D (FreeAlgebra ℂ ι))
    (hPX : IsSelfAdjoint (CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X P))
    (hPW : IsSelfAdjoint (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P)) :
    ‖CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation ℂ X P‖=‖wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P‖
proof:
:= by
  have hs := spectrum_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix_of_semicircular φ hφ hfaithful X hFree hLaw P hPX hPW
  rw [← hPX.toReal_spectralRadius_eq_norm,← hPW.toReal_spectralRadius_eq_norm]
  simp only [spectralRadius,hs]

name: NLAlib.wordRightAnnihilation_mul_wordField_sub
statement:
theorem wordRightAnnihilation_mul_wordField_sub (i j : ι) :
    wordRightAnnihilation i*wordField j-wordField j*wordRightAnnihilation i=
      if i=j then wordVacuumProjection ι else 0
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Commute (wordRightAnnihilation i) (wordAnnihilation j) := by
    simpa only [wordAnnihilation,wordRightAnnihilation,
      ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] using
      (commute_wordCreation_wordRightCreation j i).star_star.symm
  have hc : wordRightAnnihilation i*(wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap-
      (wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap*wordRightAnnihilation i=
      if i=j then wordVacuumProjection ι else 0 := by
    have h := congrArg star (wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightCreation_sub j i)
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · simpa only [star_sub,star_mul,wordAnnihilation,wordRightAnnihilation,
        ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,star_star,if_pos hij,if_pos hij.symm,
        star_wordVacuumProjection] using h
    · simpa only [star_sub,star_mul,wordAnnihilation,wordRightAnnihilation,
        ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,star_star,if_neg hij,if_neg (Ne.symm hij),
        star_zero] using h
  calc
    _ = (wordRightAnnihilation i*(wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap-
      (wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap*wordRightAnnihilation i)+
        (wordRightAnnihilation i*wordAnnihilation j-
          wordAnnihilation j*wordRightAnnihilation i) := by
      unfold wordField
      noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [ha.eq,sub_self,add_zero,hc]

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_apply
statement:
theorem wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_apply (i : ι) (t : M) (a b : D) :
    (wordMatrixRightAnnihilation (D := D) i*t) a b=wordRightAnnihilation i*t a b
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : D => wordRightAnnihilation i)*CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm t) a b=_
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.mul_wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_apply
statement:
theorem mul_wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_apply (i : ι) (t : M) (a b : D) :
    (t*wordMatrixRightAnnihilation (D := D) i) a b=t a b*wordRightAnnihilation i
proof:
:= by
  change (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm t*Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : D => wordRightAnnihilation i)) a b=_
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_entry
statement:
private theorem sum_entry (f : ι → M) (a b : D) :
    (∑ i, f i) a b=∑ i, f i a b
proof:
:= by
  have hs (s : Finset ι) : (∑ i∈s, f i) a b=∑ i∈s, f i a b := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => rfl
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi,Finset.sum_insert hi,CStarMatrix.add_apply,ih]
  exact hs Finset.univ

name: NLAlib.wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_apply
statement:
theorem wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_apply (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (a b : D) :
    wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A a b=
      A₀ a b•(1 : B)+∑ i, A i a b•wordField i
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
  rw [CStarMatrix.add_apply,sum_entry]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_linearCombination_sub
statement:
theorem wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_linearCombination_sub
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (i : ι) :
    wordMatrixRightAnnihilation i*wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A-
      wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A*wordMatrixRightAnnihilation i=
      wordMatrixVacuumSandwich (ι := ι) (A i)
proof:
:= by
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro a b
  rw [CStarMatrix.sub_apply,wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_apply,
    mul_wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_apply,wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_apply]
  change _=A i a b•wordVacuumProjection ι
  calc
    _ = ∑ j, A j a b•(wordRightAnnihilation i*wordField j-
        wordField j*wordRightAnnihilation i) := by
      simp only [mul_add,add_mul,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul,
        mul_smul_comm,smul_mul_assoc,mul_one,one_mul,smul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      abel
    _ = _ := by simp [wordRightAnnihilation_mul_wordField_sub]

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumCompression_rightAnnihilation_resolvent
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumCompression_rightAnnihilation_resolvent
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (i : ι)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈resolventSet ℂ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) :
    wordMatrixVacuumCompression
      (wordMatrixRightAnnihilation i*resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)=
      wordMatrixVacuumCompression (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)*
        A i*wordMatrixVacuumCompression (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (wordMatrixVacuumCompression (D := D) (ι := ι))
    (spectrum.mul_resolvent_sub_resolvent_mul (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)
      (wordMatrixRightAnnihilation i) hz)
  rw [map_sub,wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_linearCombination_sub,
    wordMatrixVacuumCompression_mul_sandwich_mul] at hc
  have hz0 : wordMatrixVacuumCompression
      (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z*
        wordMatrixRightAnnihilation i)=0 := by
    ext a b
    rw [wordMatrixVacuumCompression_apply,mul_wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_apply,
      wordVacuumExpectation_mul_rightAnnihilation]
    rfl
  rwa [hz0,sub_zero] at hc

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumCompression_linearCombination_mul
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumCompression_linearCombination_mul
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (t : M) :
    wordMatrixVacuumCompression (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A*t)=
      A₀*wordMatrixVacuumCompression t+
        ∑ i, A i*wordMatrixVacuumCompression (wordMatrixRightAnnihilation i*t)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply,Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,
    wordMatrixVacuumCompression_apply,wordMatrixRightAnnihilation_mul_apply]
  simp only [CStarMatrix.mul_apply,map_sum,
    wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_apply,add_mul,Finset.sum_mul,map_add,
    smul_mul_assoc,one_mul,map_smul,smul_eq_mul,
    wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_mul_eq_rightAnnihilation,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumCompression_resolvent_dyson
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumCompression_resolvent_dyson
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈resolventSet ℂ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) :
    (z•(1 : Matrix D D ℂ)-A₀-
      ∑ i, A i*wordMatrixVacuumCompression (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)*A i)*
        wordMatrixVacuumCompression (resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)=1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (wordMatrixVacuumCompression (D := D) (ι := ι))
    (Ring.mul_inverse_cancel (algebraMap ℂ M z-wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) hz)
  change wordMatrixVacuumCompression
    ((algebraMap ℂ M z-wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)*
      resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)=_ at h
  rw [sub_mul,map_sub,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,smul_mul_assoc,one_mul,map_smul,
    wordMatrixVacuumCompression_linearCombination_mul,wordMatrixVacuumCompression_one] at h
  simp_rw [wordMatrixVacuumCompression_rightAnnihilation_resolvent A₀ A _ hz] at h
  rw [sub_mul,sub_mul,smul_mul_assoc,one_mul,Finset.sum_mul]
  simpa only [mul_assoc,sub_sub] using h

name: NLAlib.word_scalar_operator_injective
statement:
private theorem word_scalar_operator_injective :
    Function.Injective (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w hzw
  have h := congrArg (wordVacuumExpectation ι) hzw
  simpa only [StarAlgHom.ofId_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    map_smul, wordVacuumExpectation_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using h

name: NLAlib.wordCStarCoefficientHom_injective
statement:
theorem wordCStarCoefficientHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (wordCStarCoefficientHom (D := D) (ι := ι))
proof:
:=
  CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom_injective.comp
    (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom_injective _ word_scalar_operator_injective)

name: NLAlib.norm_wordCStarCoefficientHom
statement:
theorem norm_wordCStarCoefficientHom (A : CStarMatrix D D ℂ) :
    ‖wordCStarCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map wordCStarCoefficientHom wordCStarCoefficientHom_injective A

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (v : K) (i : D) :
    wordMatrixCoefficientHom A v i = ∑ j, A i j • v j
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordMatrixCoefficientHom, wordCStarCoefficientHom,
    StarAlgHom.ofId_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixCoefficientHom
statement:
theorem norm_wordMatrixCoefficientHom (A : Matrix D D ℂ) :
    ‖wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A‖ = specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  change ‖wordCStarCoefficientHom (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix A)‖ = specNorm A
  rw [norm_wordCStarCoefficientHom, CStarMatrix.norm_ofMatrix_complex]
  exact (specNorm_eq_norm A).symm

name: NLAlib.isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixCoefficientHom
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixCoefficientHom {A : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A)

:=
  hA.isSelfAdjoint.map wordMatrixCoefficientHom

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixTensor_apply (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (T : B) (v : K) (i : D) :
    wordMatrixTensor A T v i = ∑ j, A i j • T (v j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordMatrixTensor, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_one_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixTensor_one_apply (T : B) (v : K) (i : D) :
    wordMatrixTensor (1 : Matrix D D ℂ) T v i = T (v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordMatrixTensor_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [Ne.symm hji]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixTensor_eq_coefficient_mul
statement:
theorem wordMatrixTensor_eq_coefficient_mul (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (T : B) :
    wordMatrixTensor A T = wordMatrixCoefficientHom A * wordMatrixTensor 1 T
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change wordMatrixTensor A T v i =
    wordMatrixCoefficientHom A (wordMatrixTensor 1 T v) i
  rw [wordMatrixTensor_apply, wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply]
  simp only [wordMatrixTensor_one_apply]

name: NLAlib.commute_wordMatrixCoefficientHom_wordMatrixTensor_one
statement:
theorem commute_wordMatrixCoefficientHom_wordMatrixTensor_one (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (T : B) :
    Commute (wordMatrixCoefficientHom A) (wordMatrixTensor 1 T)
proof:
:= by
  change _ * _ = _ * _
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply, wordMatrixTensor_one_apply, map_sum, map_smul]

name: NLAlib.norm_wordMatrixTensor
statement:
theorem norm_wordMatrixTensor (A : Matrix D D ℂ) (T : B) :
    ‖wordMatrixTensor A T‖ = ‖CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => A i j • T)‖
proof:
:=
  CStarMatrix.norm_toPiLpStarAlgHom _

name: NLAlib.isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixTensor
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixTensor {A : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {T : B} (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) : IsSelfAdjoint (wordMatrixTensor A T)
proof:
:= by
  apply (CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_toPiLpStarAlgHom_iff _).mpr
  change star (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => A i j • T)) =
    CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => A i j • T)
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change star (A j i • T) = A i j • T
  rw [star_smul, hT.star_eq, hA.apply]

name: NLAlib.isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixLinearCombination
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordMatrixLinearCombination
  exact IsSelfAdjoint.add (R := K →L[ℂ] K)
    (isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) hA₀)
    (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixTensor (hA i) (isSelfAdjoint_wordField i)))

name: NLAlib.spectrum_wordMatrixCoefficientHom
statement:
theorem spectrum_wordMatrixCoefficientHom {A : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A) = spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  let e : Matrix D D ℂ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix D D ℂ := CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv
  have hC : IsSelfAdjoint (e A) := hA.isSelfAdjoint.map e.toStarAlgHom
  change spectrum ℝ (wordCStarCoefficientHom (D := D) (ι := ι) (e A)) = spectrum ℝ A
  calc
    _ = spectrum ℝ (e A) := hC.map_spectrum_real
      (wordCStarCoefficientHom (D := D) (ι := ι))
      (wordCStarCoefficientHom_injective (D := D) (ι := ι))
    _ = spectrum ℝ A := AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq (e.toAlgEquiv.restrictScalars ℝ) A

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_mean_spectrum_dist_le_wordMatrixLinearCombination
statement:
theorem exists_mem_mean_spectrum_dist_le_wordMatrixLinearCombination [Fintype ι]
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) :
    ∃ y ∈ spectrum ℝ A₀,
      dist x y ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hd⟩ := IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_norm_sub
    (isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) hA₀) hx
  have hspec : spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A₀) = spectrum ℝ A₀ :=
    spectrum_wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) hA₀
  refine ⟨y, hspec.subset hy, hd.trans ?_⟩
  rw [norm_sub_rev]
  exact norm_wordMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le A₀ A hA

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_wordMatrixLinearCombination_spectrum_dist_le_mean
statement:
theorem exists_mem_wordMatrixLinearCombination_spectrum_dist_le_mean [Fintype ι]
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ spectrum ℝ A₀) :
    ∃ y ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A),
      dist x y ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A₀) := by
    rwa [spectrum_wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) hA₀]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hd⟩ := IsSelfAdjoint.exists_mem_spectrum_real_dist_le_norm_sub
    (isSelfAdjoint_wordMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA) hx'
  exact ⟨y, hy, hd.trans (norm_wordMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le A₀ A hA)⟩

name: NLAlib.hausdorffDist_spectrum_wordMatrixLinearCombination_mean_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_spectrum_wordMatrixLinearCombination_mean_le [Fintype ι]
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) (spectrum ℝ A₀) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ i, A i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist (by positivity)
  · exact fun _ hx => exists_mem_mean_spectrum_dist_le_wordMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ A hA hx
  · exact fun _ hx => exists_mem_wordMatrixLinearCombination_spectrum_dist_le_mean hA₀ A hA hx

name: NLAlib.specNorm_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_wordNativeDysonResolvent_le
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) :
    specNorm (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z)≤(Fintype.card D : ℝ)*|z.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact (specNorm_wordMatrixVacuumCompression_le _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).norm_resolvent_le hz)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.wordNativeDysonResolvent_dyson
statement:
theorem wordNativeDysonResolvent_dyson
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) :
    (z•(1 : Matrix D D ℂ)-A₀-
      ∑ i, A i*wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z*A i)*wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z=1
proof:
:= by
  exact wordMatrixVacuumCompression_resolvent_dyson A₀ A
    ((isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz)

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_wordNativeDysonResolvent
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_wordNativeDysonResolvent
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im≠0) :
    HasDerivAt (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A)
      (wordMatrixVacuumCompression
        (-(resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z)^2)) z
proof:
:= by
  have hr := spectrum.hasDerivAt_resolvent_const_left
    ((isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).isUnit_algebraMap_sub_of_im_ne_zero hz)
  exact (wordMatrixVacuumCompressionCLM (D := D) (ι := ι)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z hr

name: NLAlib.differentiableOn_wordNativeDysonResolvent
statement:
theorem differentiableOn_wordNativeDysonResolvent
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A) {z : ℂ | z.im≠0}
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  exact (hasDerivAt_wordNativeDysonResolvent hA₀ hA hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

name: NLAlib.analyticOnNhd_wordNativeDysonResolvent
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_wordNativeDysonResolvent
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A) {z : ℂ | z.im≠0}
proof:
:= by
  exact (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn
    (isOpen_ne_fun Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).mpr
      (differentiableOn_wordNativeDysonResolvent hA₀ hA)

name: NLAlib.wordNativeDysonResolvent_star
statement:
theorem wordNativeDysonResolvent_star
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    {A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ} (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (z : ℂ) :
    wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A (star z)=(wordNativeDysonResolvent A₀ A z)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have hself := (isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hA).star_eq
  have hr := star_resolvent (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A) z
  rw [hself] at hr
  unfold wordNativeDysonResolvent
  rw [← hr]
  ext i j
  simp only [wordMatrixVacuumCompression_apply,CStarMatrix.star_apply,
    wordVacuumExpectation_star,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_star_mul
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_star_mul (T : B) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (star T * T) = (‖T (wordVacuum ι)‖ : ℂ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K (𝕜 := ℂ) (T (wordVacuum ι))

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_commute_wordRightField_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_commute_wordRightField_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero
    (T : B) (hComm : ∀ i, Commute T (wordRightField i))
    (hVac : T (wordVacuum ι) = 0) : T = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ w : List ι, w.length = n → T (lp.single 2 w 1) = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro w hw
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' w with hw0 | ⟨v, j, rfl⟩
      · subst w
        simpa only [wordVacuum] using hVac
      · have hv : v.length < n := by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hw; omega
        have hTv : T (lp.single 2 v 1) = 0 := ih v.length hv v rfl
        have hAnn : T (wordRightAnnihilation j (lp.single 2 v 1)) = 0 := by
          rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' v with hv0 | ⟨u, k, rfl⟩
          · subst v
            simp
          · have hu : u.length < n := by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hv; omega
            have hTu : T (lp.single 2 u 1) = 0 := ih u.length hu u rfl
            by_cases hjk : j = k <;> simp [hjk, hTu]
        have h := congrArg (fun S : B => S (lp.single 2 v 1)) (hComm j).eq
        change T (wordRightField j (lp.single 2 v 1)) =
          wordRightField j (T (lp.single 2 v 1)) at h
        rw [hTv, map_zero] at h
        simpa only [wordRightField, add_apply,
          LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, wordRightCreation_apply_single,
          map_add, hAnn, add_zero] using h
  apply lp.ext_continuousLinearMap (by simp : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
  intro w
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    zero_apply]
  have hz : lp.single 2 w z = z • (lp.single 2 w 1 : WordHilbertSpace ι) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
      lp.single_smul (E := fun _ : List ι => ℂ) 2 w z (1 : ℂ)
  rw [hz, map_smul, hsingle w.length w rfl, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.commute_wordRightField_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra
statement:
theorem commute_wordRightField_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra {T : B}
    (hT : T ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι) (j : ι) : Commute T (wordRightField j)
proof:
:= by
  have hRight : wordRightField j ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ
      (Set.range (wordField : ι → B)) := by
    apply (StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff ℂ).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(commute_wordField_wordRightField i j).eq,
      by simpa only [(isSelfAdjoint_wordField i).star_eq] using
        (commute_wordField_wordRightField i j).eq⟩
  have hDouble := StarSubalgebra.topologicalClosure_adjoin_le_centralizer_centralizer ℂ
    (Set.range (wordField : ι → B)) hT
  exact ((StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff ℂ).mp hDouble (wordRightField j) hRight).1.symm

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero {T : B}
    (hT : T ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι) (hVac : T (wordVacuum ι) = 0) : T = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_commute_wordRightField_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero T
    (commute_wordRightField_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra hT) hVac

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_wordVacuumExpectation_star_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_wordVacuumExpectation_star_mul_eq_zero {T : B}
    (hT : T ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι) (hZero : wordVacuumExpectation ι (star T * T) = 0) : T = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero hT
  have hInner : inner ℂ (T (wordVacuum ι)) (T (wordVacuum ι)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
      ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right] using hZero
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp hInner

name: NLAlib.wordWickCutOperator_eq_row_matrix_row_adjoint
statement:
private theorem wordWickCutOperator_eq_row_matrix_row_adjoint (j k : ℕ)
    (a : List.Vector ι j → List.Vector ι k → ℂ) :
    wordWickCutOperator j k a =
      (wordCreationRowAlong j ⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩).comp
        ((wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) (wordWickCutMatrix j k a)).comp
          (wordCreationRowAlong k ⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩).adjoint)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hR (v : List.Vector ι k) :
      (wordCreationRowAlong k
        (⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩ : List.Vector ι k ↪
          List.Vector ι j ⊕ List.Vector ι k)).adjoint x (Sum.inr v) =
        star (wordCreationProduct v.toList) x :=
    wordCreationRowAlong_adjoint_apply k _ x v
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, wordCreationRowAlong_apply,
    wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, wordWickCutMatrix,
    Matrix.fromBlocks, hR,
    wordWickCutOperator, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def]

name: NLAlib.norm_wordWickCutOperator_le
statement:
theorem norm_wordWickCutOperator_le (j k : ℕ)
    (a : List.Vector ι j → List.Vector ι k → ℂ) :
    ‖wordWickCutOperator j k a‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ u, ∑ v, ‖a u v‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordWickCutOperator_eq_row_matrix_row_adjoint]
  let L := wordCreationRowAlong (ι := ι) j
    (⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩ : List.Vector ι j ↪
      List.Vector ι j ⊕ List.Vector ι k)
  let R := wordCreationRowAlong (ι := ι) k
    (⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩ : List.Vector ι k ↪
      List.Vector ι j ⊕ List.Vector ι k)
  let T := wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) (wordWickCutMatrix j k a)
  change ‖L.comp (T.comp R.adjoint)‖ ≤ _
  have hL := norm_wordCreationRowAlong_le_one (ι := ι) j
    (⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩ : List.Vector ι j ↪
      List.Vector ι j ⊕ List.Vector ι k)
  have hR := norm_wordCreationRowAlong_le_one (ι := ι) k
    (⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩ : List.Vector ι k ↪
      List.Vector ι j ⊕ List.Vector ι k)
  have hR' : ‖R.adjoint‖ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using hR
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖L‖ * (‖T‖ * ‖R.adjoint‖) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ 1 * (‖T‖ * 1) :=
      mul_le_mul hL (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR' (norm_nonneg T))
        (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg T) (norm_nonneg R.adjoint)) zero_le_one
    _ = specNorm (wordWickCutMatrix j k a) := by
      dsimp only [T]
      rw [norm_wordMatrixCoefficientHom]
      ring
    _ ≤ frobNorm (wordWickCutMatrix j k a) := specNorm_le_frobNorm _
    _ = _ := by
      simp [frobNorm, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, wordWickCutMatrix,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks]

name: NLAlib.realMeanResolventCFC
statement:
private theorem realMeanResolventCFC (A : Type*) [CStarAlgebra A] :
    IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint
proof:
:=
  IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus (A := A)

name: NLAlib.scalar_coefficient_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem scalar_coefficient_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
    (D₀ : CStarMatrix D D ℂ) (k : ℕ) (i j : D) :
    CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀ i j ∈
      wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : B) ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k := by
    simpa only [wordWickOperator] using
      wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan ([] : List ι) (Nat.zero_le k)
  change (algebraMap ℂ B (D₀ i j)) ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h1

name: NLAlib.norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow_mean_uniform_of_re_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow_mean_uniform_of_re_eq_zero
    (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0<q) (hr : 0<r)
    (D₀ : CStarMatrix D D ℂ) (hD : IsSelfAdjoint D₀)
    (Y : M) (hY : IsSelfAdjoint Y)
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, Y i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1)
    {σ K : ℝ} (hK : 4<K) (hnorm : ‖Y‖≤2*σ)
    {z : ℂ} (hre : z.re=0) (hz : 0<z.im) (hησ : z.im≤σ) :
    ‖resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4*q : ℝ)) *
        (2*q*r+1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4*q : ℝ)) *
          (((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            ((star (resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z) *
              resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z) ^
                (2*q))).re) ^ (1 / (4*q : ℝ)) +
            18*σ/z.im^2*(K/(r : ℝ)+K⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with
  | inl hDempty =>
    have hzero : resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z=0 :=
      by ext i; exact (hDempty.false i).elim
    have hcard : Fintype.card D=0 := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mpr hDempty
    have he : (3 : ℝ)/(4*q)≠0 := by
      have hqR : 0<(q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
      positivity
    simp only [hzero,norm_zero,hcard,Nat.cast_zero,Real.zero_rpow he,zero_mul,le_refl]
  | inr hDnonempty =>
    let : Nonempty D := hDnonempty
    let C := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (D := D) (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B)
    let d : M := C D₀
    let e : M := cfcSymmetricClamp (K*σ) d
    let X : M := d+Y
    let Z : M := e+Y
    let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3/(4*q : ℝ)) *
      (2*q*r+1 : ℝ) ^ (3/(4*q : ℝ))
    let δ : ℝ := 9*σ/(K*z.im^2)
    let lp : M → ℝ := fun R =>
      ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star R*R)^(2*q))).re) ^
        (1/(4*q : ℝ))
    have hσ : 0<σ := hz.trans_le hησ
    have hKpos : 0<K := by linarith only [hK]
    have hrR : 0<(r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hr
    have hc1 : 1≤c := by
      apply one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
      · exact Real.one_le_rpow
          (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Fintype.card_pos (α := D))))
          (by positivity)
      · exact Real.one_le_rpow (by
            have hp : 0≤(2 : ℝ)*q*r := by positivity
            linarith only [hp])
          (by positivity)
    have hc : 0≤c := le_trans (by norm_num) hc1
    have hδ : 0≤δ := by dsimp only [δ]; positivity
    have hd : IsSelfAdjoint d := hD.map C
    have he : IsSelfAdjoint e := isSelfAdjoint_cfcSymmetricClamp _ _
    have hX : IsSelfAdjoint X := hd.add hY
    have hZ : IsSelfAdjoint Z := he.add hY
    have heq : e=C (cfcSymmetricClamp (K*σ) D₀) := by
      exact (C.map_cfc (fun x : ℝ => max (-(K*σ)) (min (K*σ) x)) D₀
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hD hd).symm
    have hdegX : ∀ i j, X i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1 := by
      intro i j
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (scalar_coefficient_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan D₀ 1 i j)
        (hdeg i j)
    have hdegZ : ∀ i j, Z i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1 := by
      intro i j
      change e i j+Y i j ∈ _
      rw [heq]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _
        (scalar_coefficient_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (cfcSymmetricClamp (K*σ) D₀) 1 i j)
        (hdeg i j)
    have hRef : ‖resolvent d z-resolvent e z‖≤(K*σ)⁻¹ :=
      hd.norm_resolvent_sub_cfcSymmetricClamp_le hre hz (mul_pos hKpos hσ)
    have hdiff : ‖resolvent X z-resolvent Z z‖≤δ := by
      exact norm_resolvent_sub_le_of_reference_difference hX hZ hd he hz
        (by dsimp only [X,Z]; noncomm_ring) hησ hKpos
        (by simpa only [X,add_sub_cancel_left] using hnorm)
        (by simpa only [Z,add_sub_cancel_left] using hnorm) hRef
    have hmemX : resolvent X z ∈ wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι) := by
      rw [hX.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne']
      exact cfc_mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra _ (mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra_of_entries_degree hdegX)
    have hmemZ : resolvent Z z ∈ wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι) := by
      rw [hZ.resolvent_eq_cfc_of_im_ne_zero hz.ne']
      exact cfc_mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra _ (mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra_of_entries_degree hdegZ)
    have hLp : lp (resolvent Z z)≤lp (resolvent X z)+δ := by
      have hm := (abs_wordMatrixVacuum_gramMoment_rpow_sub_le_norm
        (resolvent Z z) (resolvent X z) hmemZ hmemX (2*q) (by omega)).trans
          (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hdiff)
      have he : ((2 : ℝ)*(2*q : ℕ))⁻¹=1/(4*q : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      simp only [he] at hm
      have hh : lp (resolvent Z z)-lp (resolvent X z)≤δ := (le_abs_self _).trans hm
      linarith only [hh]
    have hZnorm : ‖Z‖≤(K+2)*σ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖e‖+‖Y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ K*σ+2*σ := add_le_add
          (norm_cfcSymmetricClamp_le _ (mul_pos hKpos hσ).le d) hnorm
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hnonuniform : ‖resolvent Z z‖≤
        c*(lp (resolvent Z z)+12*‖Z‖/((r : ℝ)*z.im^2)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_one,mul_one] using
        norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow 1 q r hq hr Z hZ hdegZ hz
    have herror : 2*δ+12*((K+2)*σ)/((r : ℝ)*z.im^2) ≤
        18*σ/z.im^2*(K/(r : ℝ)+K⁻¹) := by
      have hlinear : 12*(K+2)≤18*K := by linarith only [hK]
      calc
        _ ≤ 2*δ+18*K*σ/((r : ℝ)*z.im^2) := by
          apply add_le_add le_rfl
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlinear hσ.le]
        _ = _ := by dsimp only [δ]; field_simp [hKpos.ne',hz.ne',hrR.ne']; ring
    change ‖resolvent X z‖≤c*(lp (resolvent X z)+_)
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖resolvent Z z‖+δ := by
        calc
          _ = ‖resolvent Z z+(resolvent X z-resolvent Z z)‖ := by
            congr 1
            abel
          _ ≤ ‖resolvent Z z‖+‖resolvent X z-resolvent Z z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl hdiff
      _ ≤ c*(lp (resolvent Z z)+12*‖Z‖/((r : ℝ)*z.im^2))+δ :=
        add_le_add hnonuniform le_rfl
      _ ≤ c*(lp (resolvent X z)+δ+12*((K+2)*σ)/((r : ℝ)*z.im^2))+δ := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ c*(lp (resolvent X z)+(2*δ+12*((K+2)*σ)/((r : ℝ)*z.im^2))) := by
        nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1 hδ]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl herror) hc

name: NLAlib.norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow_mean_uniform
statement:
theorem norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow_mean_uniform
    (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0<q) (hr : 0<r)
    (D₀ : CStarMatrix D D ℂ) (hD : IsSelfAdjoint D₀)
    (Y : M) (hY : IsSelfAdjoint Y)
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, Y i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) 1)
    {σ K : ℝ} (hK : 4<K) (hnorm : ‖Y‖≤2*σ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im) (hησ : z.im≤σ) :
    ‖resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4*q : ℝ)) *
        (2*q*r+1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4*q : ℝ)) *
          (((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            ((star (resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z) *
              resolvent (CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B) D₀+Y) z) ^
                (2*q))).re) ^ (1 / (4*q : ℝ)) +
            18*σ/z.im^2*(K/(r : ℝ)+K⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  let C := CStarMatrix.mapStarAlgHom (D := D) (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ B)
  let D₁ : CStarMatrix D D ℂ := D₀-(z.re : ℂ)•1
  let ζ : ℂ := z-(z.re : ℂ)
  have hscalar : IsSelfAdjoint ((z.re : ℂ)•(1 : CStarMatrix D D ℂ)) := by
    change star ((z.re : ℂ)•(1 : CStarMatrix D D ℂ))=_
    simp only [star_smul,star_one,Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hD₁ : IsSelfAdjoint D₁ := hD.sub hscalar
  have hre : ζ.re=0 := by simp only [ζ,Complex.sub_re,Complex.ofReal_re,sub_self]
  have him : ζ.im=z.im := by simp only [ζ,Complex.sub_im,Complex.ofReal_im,sub_zero]
  have hR : resolvent (C D₁+Y) ζ=resolvent (C D₀+Y) z := by
    dsimp only [D₁,ζ]
    rw [map_sub,map_smul,map_one]
    have he : C D₀-(z.re : ℂ)•1+Y=(C D₀+Y)-(z.re : ℂ)•1 := by abel
    rw [he]
    exact resolvent_sub_smul_one_sub_eq _ _ _
  have hb := norm_resolvent_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment_rpow_mean_uniform_of_re_eq_zero
    q r hq hr D₁ hD₁ Y hY hdeg hK hnorm hre (by rwa [him]) (by rwa [him])
  change ‖resolvent (C D₀+Y) z‖≤_
  rw [hR,him] at hb
  exact hb

name: NLAlib.wordCutEquiv_take
proof:
:= by
  change (u.toList ++ v.toList.reverse).take j = _
  have hu : u.toList.length = j := by simp
  exact List.take_left' hu

name: NLAlib.wordCutEquiv_drop_reverse
proof:
:= by
  change ((u.toList ++ v.toList.reverse).drop j).reverse = _
  have hu : u.toList.length = j := by simp
