name: NLAlib.norm_sum_wordWick_normal_cut_le
statement:
private theorem norm_sum_wordWick_normal_cut_le [Fintype ι] (m j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ m)
    (a : List.Vector ι m → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ w, a w • (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.take j) *
      star (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.drop j).reverse))‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (∑ w, ‖a w‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let e := wordCutEquiv (ι := ι) m j hj
  have he : (∑ w, a w • (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.take j) *
      star (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.drop j).reverse))) =
      wordWickCutOperator j (m - j) (fun u v => a (e (u, v))) := by
    rw [wordWickCutOperator, ← Fintype.sum_prod_type']
    symm
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv e
    intro uv
    rcases uv with ⟨u, v⟩
    dsimp only [e]
    simp only [wordCutEquiv_take, wordCutEquiv_drop_reverse]
  rw [he]
  convert! norm_wordWickCutOperator_le j (m - j) (fun u v => a (e (u, v))) using 1
  congr 1
  rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type']
  exact (e.sum_comp (fun w => ‖a w‖ ^ 2)).symm

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_wordWickOperator_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_wordWickOperator_le [Fintype ι] (m : ℕ)
    (a : List.Vector ι m → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ w, a w • wordWickOperator w.toList‖ ≤
      (m + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (∑ w, ‖a w‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ w, a w • wordWickOperator w.toList) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ w, a w •
        (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.take j) *
          star (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.drop j).reverse)) := by
    have hlen (w : List.Vector ι m) : w.toList.length = m := by simp
    simp_rw [wordWickOperator_eq_sum_cuts, hlen, Finset.smul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  rw [hsum]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        ‖∑ w, a w • (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.take j) *
          star (wordCreationProduct (w.toList.drop j).reverse))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), Real.sqrt (∑ w, ‖a w‖ ^ 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact norm_sum_wordWick_normal_cut_le m j
        (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) a
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_apply (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ D) (j : D) :
    wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v j=v j•wordVacuum ι
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumVectorPositiveMap_one
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumVectorPositiveMap_one {v : EuclideanSpace ℂ D} (hv : ‖v‖=1) :
    wordMatrixVacuumVectorPositiveMap (ι := ι) v (1 : M)=1
proof:
:= by
  change inner ℂ (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)
    (CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W) (1 : M)
      (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v))=1
  rw [map_one,one_apply_eq_self,inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,
    LinearIsometry.norm_map,hv]
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.norm_toPiLp_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_toPiLp_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_sq_le (T : M) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ D) :
    ‖CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W) T
      (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)‖^2 ≤
      ‖v‖^2*(Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
        (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T*T)).re
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with
  | inl hD =>
    have hv : v=0 := by ext j; exact (hD.false j).elim
    simp only [hv,map_zero,norm_zero,zero_pow (by decide : 2≠0),zero_mul,le_refl]
  | inr hD =>
    let : Nonempty D := hD
    have hcard : (Fintype.card D : ℝ)≠0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
    have henergy : (Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
        (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T*T)).re =
          ∑ j, ∑ i, ‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖^2 := by
      rw [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul,Complex.ofReal_re,← mul_assoc,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hcard,one_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc,henergy]
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom_apply]
    simp only [wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_apply,map_smul]
    calc
      _ ≤ (∑ j, ‖v j‖*‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖)^2 := by
        apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
        simpa only [norm_smul] using norm_sum_le
          (Finset.univ : Finset D) (fun j => v j•T i j (wordVacuum ι))
      _ ≤ _ := by
        simpa using Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
          (Finset.univ : Finset D) (fun j => ‖v j‖) (fun j => ‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖)

name: NLAlib.re_inner_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_le_card_mul_expectation
statement:
theorem re_inner_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_le_card_mul_expectation
    {T : M} (hT : 0≤T) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ D) :
    (inner ℂ (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)
      (CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W) T
        (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v))).re ≤
      ‖v‖^2*(Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
        (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) T).re
proof:
:= by
  let S := CFC.sqrt T
  let V := CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W)
  have hSS : star S*S=T := by
    rw [(CFC.sqrt_nonneg T).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq,CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self T hT]
  have hcompose : (V S).adjoint.comp (V S)=V T := by
    change star (V S)*V S=V T
    rw [← map_star,← map_mul,hSS]
  have h := norm_toPiLp_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_sq_le S v
  rw [hSS] at h
  have heq : ‖V S (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)‖^2 =
      (inner ℂ (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)
        (V T (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v))).re := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_right,hcompose]
    rfl
  rwa [heq] at h

name: NLAlib.wordCreationRowAlong_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordCreationRowAlong_apply (m : ℕ) (e : List.Vector ι m ↪ D) (x : K) :
    wordCreationRowAlong m e x = ∑ w, wordCreationProduct w.toList (x (e w))
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordCreationRowAlong, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]

name: NLAlib.norm_wordCreationRowAlong_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_wordCreationRowAlong_le_one (m : ℕ) (e : List.Vector ι m ↪ D) :
    ‖wordCreationRowAlong m e‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro x
  rw [one_mul]
  have hsq : ‖wordCreationRowAlong m e x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ w, ‖x (e w)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [wordCreationRowAlong_apply]
    simpa only [wordPrefixIsometry_apply] using
      (orthogonalFamily_wordPrefixIsometry (ι := ι) m).norm_sum
        (fun w => x (e w)) Finset.univ
  have hle : ∑ w : List.Vector ι m, ‖x (e w)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    calc
      _ = ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.map e, ‖x d‖ ^ 2 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ d : D, ‖x d‖ ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (wordCreationRowAlong m e x), norm_nonneg x]

name: NLAlib.wordCreationRowAlong_apply_single
statement:
theorem wordCreationRowAlong_apply_single (m : ℕ) (e : List.Vector ι m ↪ D)
    (w : List.Vector ι m) (x : W) :
    wordCreationRowAlong m e (PiLp.single 2 (e w) x) = wordCreationProduct w.toList x
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordCreationRowAlong_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single w]
  · simp
  · intro v _ hvw
    simp [e.injective.ne hvw]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.wordCreationRowAlong_adjoint_apply
statement:
theorem wordCreationRowAlong_adjoint_apply (m : ℕ) (e : List.Vector ι m ↪ D)
    (x : W) (w : List.Vector ι m) :
    (wordCreationRowAlong m e).adjoint x (e w) = star (wordCreationProduct w.toList) x
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro z
  have h := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (wordCreationRowAlong m e)
    (PiLp.single 2 (e w) z) x
  rw [wordCreationRowAlong_apply_single, PiLp.inner_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (e w)] at h
  · simpa only [PiLp.single_eq_same, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right] using h
  · intro d _ hd
    simp [hd]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_star
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_star (T : B) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (star T) = star (wordVacuumExpectation ι T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, wordVacuumExpectation_apply]
  simpa only [RCLike.star_def] using
    (inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) (T (wordVacuum ι)) (wordVacuum ι)).symm

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_mul_wordField
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_mul_wordField {T : B}
    (hT : T ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι) (i : ι) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (T * wordField i) =
      wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i * T)
proof:
:= by
  have hComm := commute_wordRightField_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra hT i
  have hAdj : (wordRightField i).adjoint = wordRightField i :=
    (isSelfAdjoint_wordRightField i).adjoint_eq
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, wordField_wordVacuum,
    ← wordRightField_wordVacuum]
  change inner ℂ (wordVacuum ι) ((T * wordRightField i) (wordVacuum ι)) = _
  rw [hComm.eq, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ← hAdj, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  rw [wordRightField_wordVacuum, wordVacuumExpectation_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hLeft := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (wordField i)
    (wordVacuum ι) (T (wordVacuum ι))
  rw [(isSelfAdjoint_wordField i).adjoint_eq, wordField_wordVacuum] at hLeft
  exact hLeft.symm

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_mul_eq_of_mem_adjoin
statement:
private theorem wordVacuumExpectation_mul_eq_of_mem_adjoin
    {S : B} (hS : S ∈ StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (wordField : ι → B))) :
    ∀ T ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι,
      wordVacuumExpectation ι (T * S) = wordVacuumExpectation ι (S * T)
proof:
:= by
  induction hS using StarAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem S hS =>
    rcases hS with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro T hT
    exact wordVacuumExpectation_mul_wordField hT i
  | algebraMap z =>
    intro T _
    rw [Algebra.commutes]
  | add S₁ S₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
    intro T hT
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, map_add, h₁ T hT, h₂ T hT]
  | mul S₁ S₂ hS₁ hS₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    intro T hT
    have hm₁ : S₁ ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι :=
      StarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _ hS₁
    have hm₂ : S₂ ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι :=
      StarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _ hS₂
    calc
      _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι ((T * S₁) * S₂) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι (S₂ * (T * S₁)) := h₂ _ (mul_mem hT hm₁)
      _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι ((S₂ * T) * S₁) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι (S₁ * (S₂ * T)) := h₁ _ (mul_mem hm₂ hT)
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_assoc]
  | star S _ h =>
    intro T hT
    have hs := congrArg star (h (star T) (star_mem hT))
    simpa only [← wordVacuumExpectation_star, star_mul, star_star] using hs.symm

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_mul_comm
proof:
:= by
  have hClosed : IsClosed {S : B | wordVacuumExpectation ι (T * S) =
      wordVacuumExpectation ι (S * T)} :=
    isClosed_eq ((wordVacuumExpectation ι).continuous.comp
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
      ((wordVacuumExpectation ι).continuous.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))
  exact closure_minimal (fun S hS => wordVacuumExpectation_mul_eq_of_mem_adjoin hS T hT)
    hClosed hS

name: NLAlib.wordField_apply_single_cons
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordField, add_apply, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap,
    wordCreation_apply_single, wordAnnihilation_apply_single_cons]

name: NLAlib.wordWickOperator_wordVacuum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordWickOperator_wordVacuum (w : List ι) :
    wordWickOperator w (wordVacuum ι) = lp.single 2 w 1
proof:
:= by
  induction w using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil => simp [wordWickOperator, wordVacuum]
  | singleton i => simpa only [wordWickOperator] using wordField_wordVacuum i
  | cons_cons i j w hw hcons =>
    change (wordField i * wordWickOperator (j :: w) -
      if i = j then wordWickOperator w else 0) (wordVacuum ι) = _
    rw [sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      hcons j, wordField_apply_single_cons]
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, hw]

name: NLAlib.wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra
statement:
private theorem wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra (i : ι) :
    wordField i ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι
proof:
:=
  StarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _
    (StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Set.mem_range_self i))

name: NLAlib.wordWickOperator_mem_wordFieldAlgebra
statement:
theorem wordWickOperator_mem_wordFieldAlgebra (w : List ι) :
    wordWickOperator w ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι
proof:
:= by
  induction w using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil => exact one_mem _
  | singleton i => exact wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra i
  | cons_cons i j w hw hcons =>
    apply sub_mem (mul_mem (wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra i) (hcons j))
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp only [hij, if_true, if_false]
    · exact hw
    · exact zero_mem _

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_star_wordWickOperator_mul
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_star_wordWickOperator_mul (w v : List ι) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (star (wordWickOperator w) * wordWickOperator v) =
      if w = v then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
    wordWickOperator_wordVacuum, wordWickOperator_wordVacuum]
  simp [lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: NLAlib.wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_eq_affineCombination
statement:
theorem wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_eq_affineCombination
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (C : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) :
    wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ C=CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C wordField
proof:
:= by
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  let E : M →ₗ[ℂ] B :=
    { toFun := fun T => T i j
      map_add' T U := CStarMatrix.add_apply T U i j
      map_smul' c T := CStarMatrix.smul_apply c T i j }
  let F : ι → M := fun k => CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => C k i j•wordField k)
  have hs : (∑ k,F k) i j=∑ k,C k i j•wordField k := by
    exact map_sum E F Finset.univ
  unfold wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
  rw [CStarMatrix.add_apply]
  change (A₀ i j)•(1 : B)+(∑ k,F k) i j=algebraMap ℂ B (A₀ i j)+∑ k,C k i j•wordField k
  rw [hs,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial
statement:
theorem wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (C : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) :
    wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation (FreeAlgebra.matrixLinearPolynomial A₀ C)=
      wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← freeAlgebraEvaluation_wordField,CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial,
    wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination_eq_affineCombination]

name: NLAlib.spectrum_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
statement:
theorem spectrum_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1)
    (hfaithful : ∀ a : A, φ (star a*a)=0 → a=0) (X : ι → A)
    (hX : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (X i))
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (C : ι → Matrix D D ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ i, (C i).IsHermitian) :
    spectrum ℝ (CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C X)=
      spectrum ℝ (wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ C)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := spectrum_freeAlgebraEvaluation_eq_wordMatrix_of_semicircular φ hφ hfaithful X hFree hLaw
    (FreeAlgebra.matrixLinearPolynomial A₀ C)
    (by rw [CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial]
        exact CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_affineCombination A₀ hA₀ C hC X hX)
    (by rw [wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial]
        exact isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hC)
  simpa only [CStarMatrix.freeAlgebraEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial,
    wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation_matrixLinearPolynomial] using hh

name: NLAlib.norm_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
statement:
theorem norm_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination
    (φ : A →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1)
    (hfaithful : ∀ a : A, φ (star a*a)=0 → a=0) (X : ι → A)
    (hX : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (X i))
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ.toLinearMap X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (C : ι → Matrix D D ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ i, (C i).IsHermitian) :
    ‖CStarMatrix.affineCombination ℂ A₀ C X‖=‖wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination A₀ C‖
proof:
:= by
  have hs := spectrum_affineCombination_eq_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination φ hφ hfaithful X hX hFree hLaw A₀ hA₀ C hC
  have hleft := CStarMatrix.isSelfAdjoint_affineCombination A₀ hA₀ C hC X hX
  have hright := isSelfAdjoint_wordNativeMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ hC
  rw [← hleft.toReal_spectralRadius_eq_norm,← hright.toReal_spectralRadius_eq_norm]
  simp only [spectralRadius,hs]

name: NLAlib.wordAnnihilation_apply_single_eq_zero_of_head?_ne
statement:
private theorem wordAnnihilation_apply_single_eq_zero_of_head?_ne
    (i : ι) (w : List ι) (hhead : w.head? ≠ some i) (z : ℂ) :
    wordAnnihilation i (lp.single 2 w z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w =>
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      intro hij
      subst j
      exact hhead rfl
    simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_single
statement:
theorem aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_single
    (i : ι) (w : List ι) (hhead : w.head? ≠ some i) (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i) (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ (n : ℤ)))
        (lp.single 2 w z) = lp.single 2 (List.replicate n i ++ w) z
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one =>
    simp [wordField, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap,
      wordAnnihilation_apply_single_eq_zero_of_head?_ne i w hhead z]
  | more n hn hn1 =>
    have hRec : Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) -
          Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ (n : ℤ) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        Polynomial.Chebyshev.S_add_two ℂ (n : ℤ)
    rw [hRec, map_sub, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_X]
    simp only [sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hn, hn1]
    simp [wordField, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap,
      List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append]

name: NLAlib.aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_wordVacuum
statement:
theorem aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_wordVacuum (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i) (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ (n : ℤ))) (wordVacuum ι) =
      lp.single 2 (List.replicate n i) 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [wordVacuum, List.append_nil] using
    aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_single i [] (by simp) n 1

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι
        (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i) (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ (n : ℤ))) =
      if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_wordVacuum]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn, wordVacuum]
  · simp [wordVacuum, lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply, hn]

name: NLAlib.list_prod_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_wordVacuum
statement:
theorem list_prod_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_wordVacuum
    (blocks : List (ι × ℕ)) (hpos : ∀ b ∈ blocks, 0 < b.2)
    (hchain : blocks.IsChain (fun b c => b.1 ≠ c.1)) :
    ((blocks.map (fun b => Polynomial.aeval (wordField b.1)
        (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ (b.2 : ℤ)))).prod) (wordVacuum ι) =
      lp.single 2 (blocks.flatMap (fun b => List.replicate b.2 b.1)) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction blocks with
  | nil => simp [wordVacuum]
  | cons b blocks ih =>
    rcases b with ⟨i, n⟩
    have hposTail : ∀ b ∈ blocks, 0 < b.2 := fun b hb => hpos b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    have hchainTail : blocks.IsChain (fun b c => b.1 ≠ c.1) := hchain.tail
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ih hposTail hchainTail]
    have hhead : (blocks.flatMap (fun b => List.replicate b.2 b.1)).head? ≠ some i := by
      cases blocks with
      | nil => simp
      | cons b blocks =>
        rcases b with ⟨j, m⟩
        have hm : 0 < m := hposTail (j, m) (by simp)
        have hij : i ≠ j := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain).1
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm.ne'
        simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append,
          List.head?_cons, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq] using hij.symm
    simpa only [List.flatMap_cons] using
      aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_single i _ hhead n 1

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_list_prod_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_eq_zero
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_list_prod_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_eq_zero
    (blocks : List (ι × ℕ)) (hne : blocks ≠ [])
    (hpos : ∀ b ∈ blocks, 0 < b.2)
    (hchain : blocks.IsChain (fun b c => b.1 ≠ c.1)) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι ((blocks.map (fun b => Polynomial.aeval (wordField b.1)
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S ℂ (b.2 : ℤ)))).prod) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply,
    list_prod_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_apply_wordVacuum blocks hpos hchain]
  cases blocks with
  | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
  | cons b blocks =>
    rcases b with ⟨i, n⟩
    have hn : 0 < n := hpos (i, n) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
    simp [wordVacuum, List.flatMap_cons, List.replicate_succ,
      lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply]

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_apply (T : M) :
    wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) T =
      (Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, wordVacuumExpectation ι (T j j)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_eq_sum_block_vector_states
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_eq_sum_block_vector_states (T : M) :
    wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) T =
      (Fintype.card D : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ j,
        inner ℂ (PiLp.single 2 j (wordVacuum ι))
          (CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W) T
            (PiLp.single 2 j (wordVacuum ι)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_apply]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply]
  symm
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [PiLp.single_eq_same]
    congr 1
    exact CStarMatrix.toPiLpCLM_apply_single T j (wordVacuum ι) j
  · intro k _ hkj
    simp [hkj]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul (T : M) :
    wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T) =
      (((Fintype.card D : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ j, ∑ i, ‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_apply, CStarMatrix.mul_apply,
    CStarMatrix.star_apply, map_sum, wordVacuumExpectation_star_mul]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap_apply (T : M) :
    wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι) T =
      wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) T
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_one [Nonempty D] :
    wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (1 : M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_apply, CStarMatrix.one_apply_eq,
    wordVacuumExpectation_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero)

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_mul_comm
statement:
theorem wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_mul_comm (S T : M)
    (hS : ∀ i j, S i j ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι)
    (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι) :
    wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (S * T) =
      wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (T * S)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_apply, CStarMatrix.mul_apply, map_sum]
  congr 1
  calc
    ∑ i, ∑ j, wordVacuumExpectation ι (S i j * T j i) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, wordVacuumExpectation ι (T j i * S i j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact wordVacuumExpectation_mul_comm (hT j i) (hS i j)
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_entries_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_entries_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_eq_zero
    (T : M) (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι)
    (hZero : wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T) = 0) : T = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  have : Nonempty D := ⟨j⟩
  have hcard : (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hreal : (Fintype.card D : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ j, ∑ i, ‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re hZero
    simpa only [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] using h
  have hsum := (mul_eq_zero.mp hreal).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero hcard)
  have hcol := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun col _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun row _ => sq_nonneg ‖T row col (wordVacuum ι)‖))).mp
      hsum j (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hentry := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun row _ =>
    sq_nonneg ‖T row j (wordVacuum ι)‖)).mp hcol i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact eq_zero_of_mem_wordFieldAlgebra_of_apply_wordVacuum_eq_zero (hT i j)
    (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hentry))

name: NLAlib.norm_entry_wordVacuum_sq_le_card_mul_wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re
statement:
theorem norm_entry_wordVacuum_sq_le_card_mul_wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul_re
    (T : M) (i j : D) :
    ‖T i j (wordVacuum ι)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card D : ℝ) *
      (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) (star T * T)).re
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty D := ⟨j⟩
  have hcard : (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [wordMatrixVacuumExpectation_star_mul, Complex.ofReal_re, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hcard, one_mul]
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun row _ => sq_nonneg ‖T row j (wordVacuum ι)‖)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun col _ =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun row _ => sq_nonneg ‖T row col (wordVacuum ι)‖))
      (Finset.mem_univ j))

name: NLAlib.wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (w : List ι) {k : ℕ}
    (hlen : w.length ≤ k) : wordWickOperator w ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨⟨⟨w.length, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hlen⟩, ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.wordWickDegreeSpan_mono
statement:
theorem wordWickDegreeSpan_mono {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) j ≤ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨⟨m, w⟩, rfl⟩
  apply wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
  have hw : w.toList.length = (m : ℕ) := by simp
  rw [hw]
  exact (Nat.le_of_lt_succ m.isLt).trans hjk

name: NLAlib.wordField_mul_wordWickOperator_cons
statement:
theorem wordField_mul_wordWickOperator_cons (i j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    wordField i * wordWickOperator (j :: w) =
      wordWickOperator (i :: j :: w) + if i = j then wordWickOperator w else 0
proof:
:= by
  change wordField i * wordWickOperator (j :: w) =
    (wordField i * wordWickOperator (j :: w) -
      if i = j then wordWickOperator w else 0) +
        if i = j then wordWickOperator w else 0
  exact (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.wordField_mul_wordWickOperator_mem
statement:
private theorem wordField_mul_wordWickOperator_mem (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    wordField i * wordWickOperator w ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (w.length + 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil =>
    simpa only [wordWickOperator, mul_one, List.length_nil, zero_add] using
      (wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan [i] (by simp : [i].length ≤ 1))
  | cons j w =>
    rw [wordField_mul_wordWickOperator_cons]
    apply Submodule.add_mem
    · exact wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan _ (by simp)
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [if_pos hij]
        exact wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan _ (by simp; omega)
      · rw [if_neg hij]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: NLAlib.wordField_mul_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
proof:
:= by
  let L : B →ₗ[ℂ] B :=
    { toFun := fun T => wordField i * T
      map_add' := fun _ _ => mul_add _ _ _
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => mul_smul_comm _ _ _ }
  have hspan : wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k ≤
      (wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (k + 1)).comap L := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨m, w⟩, rfl⟩
    change wordField i * wordWickOperator w.toList ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (k + 1)
    apply wordWickDegreeSpan_mono (k := k + 1) _ (wordField_mul_wordWickOperator_mem i w.toList)
    have hw : w.toList.length = (m : ℕ) := by simp
    rw [hw]
    exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ m.isLt)
  exact hspan hT

name: NLAlib.list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan (w : List ι) :
    (w.map wordField).prod ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    simpa only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, List.length_nil, wordWickOperator] using
      (wordWickOperator_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan ([] : List ι)
        (by simp : ([] : List ι).length ≤ 0))
  | cons i w hw =>
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
      wordField_mul_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan i hw

name: NLAlib.norm_finsupp_sum_list_prod_wordField_le
statement:
theorem norm_finsupp_sum_list_prod_wordField_le [Fintype ι] (k : ℕ)
    (a : List ι →₀ ℂ) (hdeg : ∀ w ∈ a.support, w.length ≤ k) :
    ‖a.sum (fun w z => z • (w.map wordField).prod)‖ ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1) *
        ‖(a.sum (fun w z => z • (w.map wordField).prod)) (wordVacuum ι)‖
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum_of_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro w hw
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  exact wordWickDegreeSpan_mono (hdeg w hw) (list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan w)

name: NLAlib.norm_monoidAlgebra_lift_wordField_le
statement:
theorem norm_monoidAlgebra_lift_wordField_le [Fintype ι] (k : ℕ)
    (P : MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid ι))
    (hdeg : ∀ w ∈ P.coeff.support, w.toList.length ≤ k) :
    ‖MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ B (FreeMonoid ι) (FreeMonoid.lift wordField) P‖ ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1) *
        ‖(MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ B (FreeMonoid ι) (FreeMonoid.lift wordField) P) (wordVacuum ι)‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply, FreeMonoid.lift_apply]
  apply norm_le_mul_sqrt_vacuum_of_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro w hw
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  exact wordWickDegreeSpan_mono (hdeg w hw) (list_prod_wordField_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan w.toList)

name: NLAlib.norm_freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_le
statement:
theorem norm_freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_le [Fintype ι] (k : ℕ) (P : FreeAlgebra ℂ ι)
    (hdeg : ∀ w ∈ (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι) P).coeff.support,
      w.toList.length ≤ k) :
    ‖FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → B) P‖ ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k + 1) *
        ‖(FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → B) P) (wordVacuum ι)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hEval : FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → B) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ B (FreeMonoid ι) (FreeMonoid.lift wordField)).comp
        (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι)).toAlgHom := by
    ext i
    simp [FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid]
  rw [hEval, AlgHom.comp_apply]
  exact norm_monoidAlgebra_lift_wordField_le k _ hdeg

name: NLAlib.aeval_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan
statement:
theorem aeval_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan {k r : ℕ} {T : M}
    (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k)
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ r) :
    ∀ i j, (Polynomial.aeval T Q) i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (r * k)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  let E : M →ₗ[ℝ] B :=
    { toFun S := S i j
      map_add' S U := CStarMatrix.add_apply S U i j
      map_smul' c S := CStarMatrix.smul_apply c S i j }
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
  change E (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1), Q.coeff n • T ^ n) ∈ _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro n hn
  change Q.coeff n • (T ^ n) i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) (r * k)
  rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ)]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  apply wordWickDegreeSpan_mono _ (pow_entries_mem_wordWickDegreeSpan hT n i j)
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right k ((Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)).trans hQ)

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_apply
    (T : WordHilbertSpace ι →L[ℂ] WordHilbertSpace ι) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι T = inner ℂ (wordVacuum ι) (T (wordVacuum ι))
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.isSelfAdjoint_wordField
statement: theorem isSelfAdjoint_wordField (i : ι) : IsSelfAdjoint (wordField i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [wordField, wordAnnihilation, ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] using
    IsSelfAdjoint.add_star_self (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap

name: NLAlib.norm_wordField_le_two
statement: theorem norm_wordField_le_two (i : ι) : ‖wordField i‖ ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hC : ‖(wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (wordCreation i).norm_toContinuousLinearMap_le
  have hA : ‖wordAnnihilation i‖ ≤ 1 := by
    change ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ 1
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map] using hC
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.wordField_wordVacuum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordField_wordVacuum (i : ι) :
    wordField i (wordVacuum ι) = lp.single 2 [i] 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordField, wordVacuum, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_one :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (1 : WordHilbertSpace ι →L[ℂ] WordHilbertSpace ι) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, wordVacuum]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordField (i : ι) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, wordField_wordVacuum]
  simp [wordVacuum, lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_mul_wordField
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_mul_wordField (i j : ι) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i * wordField j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hi : (wordField i).adjoint = wordField i := (isSelfAdjoint_wordField i).adjoint_eq
  have h := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (wordField i)
    (wordVacuum ι) (wordField j (wordVacuum ι))
  rw [hi] at h
  rw [h, wordField_wordVacuum, wordField_wordVacuum]
  simp [lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: NLAlib.norm_toPiLp_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_le_gramMoment
statement:
theorem norm_toPiLp_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_le_gramMoment
    (T : M) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ D) (hv : ‖v‖=1) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) :
    ‖CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W) T
      (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)‖ ≤
      ((Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
        (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star T*T)^m)).re) ^
          ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := wordMatrixVacuumVectorPositiveMap (ι := ι) v
  let V := CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W)
  let u := wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v
  let b : ℝ := (Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
    (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star T*T)^m)).re
  have hφ : φ 1=1 := wordMatrixVacuumVectorPositiveMap_one hv
  have hG : 0≤star T*T := star_mul_self_nonneg T
  have hGp : 0≤(star T*T)^m := CStarAlgebra.pow_nonneg hG m
  have hτ : 0≤(wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star T*T)^m)).re :=
    (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp
      ((wordMatrixVacuumPositiveMap (D := D) (ι := ι)).map_nonneg hGp)).1
  have hb : 0≤b := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hτ
  have hdom : (φ ((star T*T)^m)).re≤b := by
    change (inner ℂ (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)
      (CStarMatrix.toPiLpStarAlgHom (D := D) (H := W) ((star T*T)^m)
        (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v))).re≤
          (Fintype.card D : ℝ)*
            (wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι) ((star T*T)^m)).re
    have h := re_inner_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_le_card_mul_expectation hGp v
    simpa only [hv,one_pow,one_mul] using h
  have hφG : (φ (star T*T)).re=‖V T u‖^2 := by
    change (inner ℂ u (V (star T*T) u)).re=_
    rw [map_mul,map_star]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_right (V T) u).symm
  have hstep : ‖V T u‖^2≤b^((m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← hφG]
    exact (φ.re_le_re_pow_rpow hφ hG m hm).trans
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp (φ.map_nonneg hGp)).1 hdom
        (by positivity))
  have hexp : ((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)*(2 : ℕ)=(m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    push_cast
    field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm.ne']
  have hsquare : (b^((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹))^2=b^((m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hb,hexp]
  have hroot : 0≤b^((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹) := Real.rpow_nonneg hb _
  change ‖V T u‖≤b^((2*m : ℝ)⁻¹)
  nlinarith only [hstep,hsquare,hroot,norm_nonneg (V T u)]

name: NLAlib.wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightField_sub
statement:
theorem wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightField_sub (i j : ι) :
    wordAnnihilation i * wordRightField j - wordRightField j * wordAnnihilation i =
      if i = j then wordVacuumProjection ι else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hAA : Commute (wordAnnihilation i) (wordRightAnnihilation j) := by
    simpa only [wordAnnihilation, wordRightAnnihilation,
      ← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] using
      (commute_wordCreation_wordRightCreation i j).star_star
  calc
    _ = (wordAnnihilation i * (wordRightCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap -
        (wordRightCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap * wordAnnihilation i) +
        (wordAnnihilation i * wordRightAnnihilation j -
          wordRightAnnihilation j * wordAnnihilation i) := by
      unfold wordRightField
      noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hAA.eq, sub_self, add_zero, wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightCreation_sub]

name: NLAlib.wordField_pow_wordVacuum_eq_wordRightField_pow
statement:
theorem wordField_pow_wordVacuum_eq_wordRightField_pow (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    (wordField i ^ n) (wordVacuum ι) = (wordRightField i ^ n) (wordVacuum ι)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      wordField_wordVacuum, ← wordRightField_wordVacuum]
    have h := congrArg (fun T : B => T (wordVacuum ι))
      ((commute_wordField_wordRightField i i).pow_left n).eq
    change (wordField i ^ n) (wordRightField i (wordVacuum ι)) =
      wordRightField i ((wordField i ^ n) (wordVacuum ι)) at h
    rw [h, ih]
    simp only [pow_succ', ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordRightField_pow_eq
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordRightField_pow_eq (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordRightField i ^ n) =
      wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, wordVacuumExpectation_apply,
    ← wordField_pow_wordVacuum_eq_wordRightField_pow]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_mul_projection_mul
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_mul_projection_mul (S T : B) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (S * wordVacuumProjection ι * T) =
      wordVacuumExpectation ι S * wordVacuumExpectation ι T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, wordVacuumProjection, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply,
    map_smul, inner_smul_right]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_mul_eq_annihilation
proof:
:= by
  have hCreation : wordVacuumExpectation ι ((wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap * T) = 0 := by
    rw [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap
        (T (wordVacuum ι)) (wordVacuum ι)]
    change inner ℂ (wordAnnihilation i (wordVacuum ι)) (T (wordVacuum ι)) = 0
    simp only [wordAnnihilation_wordVacuum, inner_zero_left]
  rw [wordField, add_mul, map_add, hCreation, zero_add]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_succ_succ
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_succ_succ (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ (n + 2)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ k) *
        wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ (n - k))
proof:
:= by
  have hDef : wordAnnihilation i * wordRightField i -
      wordRightField i * wordAnnihilation i = wordVacuumProjection ι := by
    simpa using wordAnnihilation_mul_wordRightField_sub i i
  have hPow := mul_pow_sub_pow_mul_eq_sum (wordAnnihilation i) (wordRightField i) (n + 1)
  rw [hDef] at hPow
  have hPhi := congrArg (wordVacuumExpectation ι) hPow
  simp only [map_sub, map_sum, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hPhi
  have hKill : wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordRightField i ^ (n + 1) * wordAnnihilation i) = 0 := by
    simp only [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, wordAnnihilation_wordVacuum, map_zero, inner_zero_right]
  rw [hKill, sub_zero] at hPhi
  simp_rw [wordVacuumExpectation_mul_projection_mul,
    wordVacuumExpectation_wordRightField_pow_eq] at hPhi
  calc
    _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i * wordField i ^ (n + 1)) := by
      rw [← pow_succ']
    _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordAnnihilation i * wordField i ^ (n + 1)) :=
      wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_mul_eq_annihilation i _
    _ = wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordAnnihilation i * wordRightField i ^ (n + 1)) := by
      simp only [wordVacuumExpectation_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def,
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [wordField_pow_wordVacuum_eq_wordRightField_pow]
    _ = _ := hPhi

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_eq
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_eq (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ n) =
      if Even n then (catalan (n / 2) : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_ite_even_catalan_of_recursion
    (fun n => wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ n))
    (by simp) (by simpa only [pow_one] using wordVacuumExpectation_wordField i)
    (wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_succ_succ i) n

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_even
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_even (i : ι) (k : ℕ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ (2 * k)) = (catalan k : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_eq,
    if_pos (Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega)), show (2 * k) / 2 = k by omega]

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_odd
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_odd (i : ι) (k : ℕ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (wordField i ^ (2 * k + 1)) = 0
proof:

  rw [wordVacuumExpectation_wordField_pow_eq, if_neg (Nat.not_even_two_mul_add_one k)]

name: NLAlib.isFreeFamily_wordField

    NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily

name: NLAlib.aeval_moment_eq_wordField_of_semicircular
statement:
theorem aeval_moment_eq_wordField_of_semicircular
    (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (X : ι → A)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)
    (i : ι) (P : Polynomial ℂ) :
    φ (Polynomial.aeval (X i) P)=wordVacuumExpectation ι (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i) P)
proof:

name: NLAlib.freeAlgebra_lift_moment_eq_wordField_of_semicircular
statement:
theorem freeAlgebra_lift_moment_eq_wordField_of_semicircular
    (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (hφ : φ 1=1) (X : ι → A)
    (hFree : NoncommutativeProbability.IsFreeFamily φ X)
    (hLaw : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), φ (X i^n)=if Even n then (catalan (n/2) : ℂ) else 0)

proof:

    (wordVacuumExpectation ι).toLinearMap X wordField hφ wordVacuumExpectation_one
    hFree isFreeFamily_wordField (aeval_moment_eq_wordField_of_semicircular φ X hLaw) P

name: NLAlib.freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra
statement:
theorem freeAlgebra_lift_wordField_mem_wordFieldAlgebra (P : FreeAlgebra ℂ ι) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (wordField : ι → (WordHilbertSpace ι →L[ℂ] WordHilbertSpace ι)) P∈wordFieldAlgebra ι
proof:
:= by
  induction P using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simpa only [AlgHom.commutes] using (wordFieldAlgebra ι).algebraMap_mem c
  | grade1 i =>
    simp only [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    exact StarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _
      (StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Set.mem_range_self i))
  | mul P Q hP hQ => simpa only [map_mul] using mul_mem hP hQ
  | add P Q hP hQ => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hP hQ

name: NLAlib.wordMatrixCoefficientHom_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_eigenvector
statement:
theorem wordMatrixCoefficientHom_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_eigenvector
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (k : D) :
    wordMatrixCoefficientHom A₀ (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) (hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k)) =
      (hA₀.eigenvalues k : ℂ)•
        wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) (hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k)
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  rw [wordMatrixCoefficientHom_apply]
  simp only [PiLp.smul_apply,wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_apply,smul_smul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  have he := congrFun (hA₀.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis k) i
  change (∑ j, A₀ i j*(hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k) j)=
    (hA₀.eigenvalues k : ℂ)*(hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k) i at he
  change (∑ j, A₀ i j*(hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k) j)•wordVacuum ι=
    ((hA₀.eigenvalues k : ℂ)*(hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k) i)•wordVacuum ι
  exact congrArg (fun c : ℂ => c•wordVacuum ι) he

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_residual_le
statement:
theorem exists_unit_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_residual_le
    {A₀ : Matrix D D ℂ} (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix D D ℂ) (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0<z.im)
    (hση : Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))≤z.im)
    (hspec : z.re∈spectrum ℝ (wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)) :
    ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ D, ‖v‖=1 ∧
      ‖(algebraMap ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K) z-wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A)
        (wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v)‖≤5*z.im
proof:
:= by
  let σ := Real.sqrt (specNorm (∑ k, A k^2))
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hdist⟩ := exists_mem_mean_spectrum_dist_le_wordMatrixLinearCombination hA₀ A hA hspec
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hA₀.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues ▸ ht
  let v := hA₀.eigenvectorBasis k
  let u := wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding (ι := ι) v
  let X := wordMatrixLinearCombination A₀ A
  let d := wordMatrixCoefficientHom (ι := ι) A₀
  let Y := X-d
  have hv : ‖v‖=1 := hA₀.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.norm_eq_one k
  have hu : ‖u‖=1 := by simpa only [u,LinearIsometry.norm_map] using hv
  have hdu : d u=(t : ℂ)•u := by
    rw [← hk]
    exact wordMatrixCoefficientHom_wordMatrixVacuumEmbedding_eigenvector hA₀ k
  have hY : ‖Y‖≤2*σ := norm_wordMatrixLinearCombination_sub_mean_le A₀ A hA
  have hscalar : ‖z-(t : ℂ)‖≤2*σ+z.im := by
    have hd : |z.re-t|≤2*σ := by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hdist
    calc
      _ ≤ |(z-(t : ℂ)).re|+|(z-(t : ℂ)).im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _
      _ ≤ _ := by
        simp only [Complex.sub_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.sub_im,Complex.ofReal_im,
          sub_zero,abs_of_pos hz]
        exact add_le_add hd le_rfl
  have hXu : X u=d u+Y u := by
    dsimp only [Y]
    rw [sub_apply]
    abel
  have hres : (algebraMap ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K) z-X) u=(z-(t : ℂ))•u-Y u := by
    rw [sub_apply,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,smul_apply,one_apply_eq_self,hXu,hdu,sub_smul]
    abel
  refine ⟨v,hv,?_⟩
  change ‖(algebraMap ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K) z-X) u‖≤5*z.im
  rw [hres]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(z-(t : ℂ))•u‖+‖Y u‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖z-(t : ℂ)‖*‖u‖+‖Y‖*‖u‖ :=
      add_le_add (norm_smul _ _).le (Y.le_opNorm u)
    _ ≤ (2*σ+z.im)*1+(2*σ)*1 := by
      rw [hu]
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscalar zero_le_one)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hY zero_le_one)
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith only [hση]

name: NLAlib.wordRightCreation_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordRightCreation_apply_single (i : ι) (w : List ι) (z : ℂ) :

proof:
:= by
  convert! lp.embeddingLinearIsometry_apply_single (𝕜 := ℂ)
    (⟨fun w => w ++ [i], List.append_left_injective [i]⟩ : List ι ↪ List ι) w z using 1
  · unfold wordRightCreation
    congr 1
    ext v
    by_cases hv : v = w <;> simp [lp.single_apply, hv]
  · ext v
    by_cases hv : v = w ++ [i] <;> simp [lp.single_apply, hv]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevWordBasis_apply

proof:

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_aeval_eq_chebyshev_repr_zero
statement:
private theorem wordVacuumExpectation_aeval_eq_chebyshev_repr_zero
    (i : ι) (P : Polynomial ℂ) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i) P) =
      chebyshevWordBasis.repr P 0
proof:
:= by
  let L : Polynomial ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ := (wordVacuumExpectation ι).toLinearMap.comp
    (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i)).toLinearMap
  let C : Polynomial ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ := (Finsupp.lapply 0).comp chebyshevWordBasis.repr.toLinearMap
  have hLC : L = C := by
    apply chebyshevWordBasis.ext
    intro n
    change wordVacuumExpectation ι (Polynomial.aeval (wordField i) (chebyshevWordBasis n)) =
      chebyshevWordBasis.repr (chebyshevWordBasis n) 0
    rw [Module.Basis.repr_self_apply, chebyshevWordBasis_apply,
      wordVacuumExpectation_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField]
  exact congrArg (fun f : Polynomial ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ => f P) hLC

name: NLAlib.wordVacuumExpectation_ofFn_prod_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem wordVacuumExpectation_ofFn_prod_aeval_eq_zero
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (color : Fin m → ι)
    (hchain : (List.ofFn color).IsChain (· ≠ ·)) (P : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ)
    (hCenter : ∀ j, wordVacuumExpectation ι (Polynomial.aeval (wordField (color j)) (P j)) = 0) :
    wordVacuumExpectation ι
      ((List.ofFn (fun j => Polynomial.aeval (wordField (color j)) (P j))).prod) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin m → ℕ →₀ ℂ := fun j => chebyshevWordBasis.repr (P j)
  let F := wordPolynomialMoment color
  have hZero (j : Fin m) : c j 0 = 0 := by
    change chebyshevWordBasis.repr (P j) 0 = 0
    rw [← wordVacuumExpectation_aeval_eq_chebyshev_repr_zero (color j) (P j)]
    exact hCenter j
  have hExpansion (j : Fin m) :
      (∑ n ∈ (c j).support, c j n • chebyshevWordBasis n) = P j := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using
      chebyshevWordBasis.linearCombination_repr (P j)
  change F P = 0
  have hP : P = fun j => ∑ n ∈ (c j).support, c j n • chebyshevWordBasis n := by
    funext j
    exact (hExpansion j).symm
  rw [hP, F.map_sum_finset]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro degree hDegree
  rw [F.map_smul_univ]
  have hPos (j : Fin m) : 0 < degree j := by
    have hMem := (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hDegree) j
    have hCoeff := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hMem
    by_contra hNot
    have hDeg : degree j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hNot
    exact hCoeff (by simpa only [hDeg] using hZero j)
  have hBlocksNe : List.ofFn (fun j => (color j, degree j)) ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have hLen := congrArg List.length h
    simp only [List.length_ofFn, List.length_nil] at hLen
    omega
  have hBlocksPos : ∀ b ∈ List.ofFn (fun j => (color j, degree j)), 0 < b.2 := by
    intro b hb
    rcases List.mem_ofFn.mp hb with ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hPos j
  have hBlocksChain : (List.ofFn (fun j => (color j, degree j))).IsChain
      (fun b d => b.1 ≠ d.1) := by
    apply List.isChain_ofFn.mpr
    intro k hk
    exact (List.isChain_ofFn.mp hchain) k hk
  have hBlock := wordVacuumExpectation_list_prod_aeval_chebyshevS_wordField_eq_zero
    (List.ofFn (fun j => (color j, degree j))) hBlocksNe hBlocksPos hBlocksChain
  have hF : F (fun j => chebyshevWordBasis (degree j)) = 0 := by
    change wordVacuumExpectation ι ((List.ofFn (fun j =>
      Polynomial.aeval (wordField (color j)) (chebyshevWordBasis (degree j)))).prod) = 0
    simp_rw [chebyshevWordBasis_apply]
    simpa only [List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using hBlock
  simp only [hF, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.wordCreationProduct_apply_single

theorem wordCreationProduct_apply_single (u v : List ι) (z : ℂ) :

name: NLAlib.wordWickNormalOrder_cons
statement:
private theorem wordWickNormalOrder_cons (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    wordWickNormalOrder (i :: w) =
      (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap * wordWickNormalOrder w +
        wordAnnihilation i * star (wordCreationProduct w.reverse)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordWickNormalOrder, List.reverse_cons, wordCreationProduct_append, star_mul]
  simp [wordAnnihilation, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]

name: NLAlib.wordWickOperator_eq_normalOrder
statement:
private theorem wordWickOperator_eq_normalOrder (w : List ι) :
    wordWickOperator w = wordWickNormalOrder w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil => rfl
  | singleton i =>
    simp [wordWickOperator, wordWickNormalOrder,
      wordField, wordAnnihilation, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  | cons_cons i j w hw hcons =>
    simp only [wordWickOperator, hw, hcons j]
    rw [wordWickNormalOrder_cons j w]
    rw [wordWickNormalOrder_cons i (j :: w)]
    rw [wordWickNormalOrder_cons j w]
    have hrel : wordAnnihilation i * (wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap =
        if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] using wordAnnihilation_comp_wordCreation i j
    have hrev : star (wordCreationProduct (j :: w).reverse) =
        wordAnnihilation j * star (wordCreationProduct w.reverse) := by
      rw [List.reverse_cons, wordCreationProduct_append, star_mul]
      simp [wordAnnihilation, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
    rw [hrev]
    change (((wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap + wordAnnihilation i) *
      ((wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap * wordWickNormalOrder w +
        wordAnnihilation j * star (wordCreationProduct w.reverse)) -
      (if i = j then wordWickNormalOrder w else 0)) = _
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hrel]
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp only [hij, if_true, if_false, one_mul, zero_mul]
    · noncomm_ring
    · noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.wordWickOperator_eq_sum_cuts
statement:
theorem wordWickOperator_eq_sum_cuts (w : List ι) :
    wordWickOperator w = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (w.length + 1),
      wordCreationProduct (w.take j) *
        star (wordCreationProduct (w.drop j).reverse)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordWickOperator_eq_normalOrder]
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [wordWickNormalOrder]
  | cons i w hw =>
    change (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap * wordWickNormalOrder w +
      star (wordCreationProduct (i :: w).reverse) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (w.length + 1 + 1),
          wordCreationProduct ((i :: w).take j) *
            star (wordCreationProduct ((i :: w).drop j).reverse)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [List.take_zero, List.drop_zero, wordCreationProduct_nil,
      one_mul, List.take_succ_cons, List.drop_succ_cons, wordCreationProduct_cons]
    rw [hw, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1

name: NLAlib.mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (T : M) :
    T ∈ wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι) ↔
      ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: NLAlib.isClosed_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra
statement:
theorem isClosed_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra :
    IsClosed (wordMatrixFieldAlgebra (D := D) (ι := ι) : Set M)
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (wordFieldAlgebra ι : Set B) :=
    StarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  change IsClosed {T : M | ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordFieldAlgebra ι}
  simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro i
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro j
  have he : Continuous (fun T : M => T i j) :=
    (continuous_apply j).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp CStarMatrix.ofMatrixL.symm.continuous)
  exact hclosed.preimage he

name: NLAlib.wordWickDegreeSpan_le_wordFieldAlgebra

theorem wordWickDegreeSpan_le_wordFieldAlgebra (k : ℕ) :

  rintro T ⟨⟨m,w⟩,rfl⟩
  exact wordWickOperator_mem_wordFieldAlgebra w.toList

name: NLAlib.mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra_of_entries_degree

:=
  fun i j => wordWickDegreeSpan_le_wordFieldAlgebra k (hT i j)

name: NLAlib.cfc_mem_wordMatrixFieldAlgebra

:= by
