name: NLAlib.wordPrefixIsometry_toContinuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem wordPrefixIsometry_toContinuousLinearMap (w : List ι) :
    (wordPrefixIsometry w).toContinuousLinearMap = wordCreationProduct w
proof:
:= by
  apply lp.ext_continuousLinearMap (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
  intro v
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, lp.singleContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, wordPrefixIsometry]
  calc
    _ = (lp.single 2 (w ++ v) z : W) := by
      convert! lp.embeddingLinearIsometry_apply_single (𝕜 := ℂ)
        (⟨(w ++ ·), List.append_right_injective w⟩ : List ι ↪ List ι) v z using 1
      · congr 1
        ext q
        by_cases hq : q = v <;> simp [lp.single_apply, hq]
      · ext q
        by_cases hq : q = w ++ v <;> simp [lp.single_apply, hq]
    _ = _ := (wordCreationProduct_apply_single w v z).symm

name: NLAlib.wordPrefixIsometry_apply
statement:
theorem wordPrefixIsometry_apply (w : List ι) (x : W) :
    wordPrefixIsometry w x = wordCreationProduct w x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun T : B => T x) (wordPrefixIsometry_toContinuousLinearMap w)

name: NLAlib.star_wordCreationProduct_mul_of_length_eq
statement:
theorem star_wordCreationProduct_mul_of_length_eq (u v : List ι)
    (hlen : u.length = v.length) :
    star (wordCreationProduct u) * wordCreationProduct v = if u = v then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    have hv : v = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hlen.symm
    subst v
    simp
  | cons i u hu =>
    cases v with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons j v =>
      have hlen' : u.length = v.length := Nat.succ.inj hlen
      rw [wordCreationProduct_cons, wordCreationProduct_cons, star_mul]
      calc
        _ = star (wordCreationProduct u) *
            (star (wordCreation i).toContinuousLinearMap *
              (wordCreation j).toContinuousLinearMap) * wordCreationProduct v := by
          noncomm_ring
        _ = _ := by
          rw [star_wordCreation_mul_wordCreation]
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst j
            simp [hu v hlen']
          · simp [hij]

name: NLAlib.orthogonalFamily_wordPrefixIsometry
statement:
theorem orthogonalFamily_wordPrefixIsometry (m : ℕ) :
    OrthogonalFamily ℂ (fun _ : List.Vector ι m => W)
      (fun w => wordPrefixIsometry w.toList)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv x y
  have huv' : u.toList ≠ v.toList := fun h => huv (Subtype.ext h)
  have hzero : star (wordCreationProduct u.toList) * wordCreationProduct v.toList = 0 := by
    rw [star_wordCreationProduct_mul_of_length_eq u.toList v.toList (by simp),
      if_neg huv']
  have h := congrArg (fun T : B => T y) hzero
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, zero_apply] at h
  rw [← LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, wordPrefixIsometry_toContinuousLinearMap,
    ← LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, wordPrefixIsometry_toContinuousLinearMap,
    ← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, h, inner_zero_right]

name: NLAlib.wordCreationRow_apply
statement:
theorem wordCreationRow_apply [Fintype ι] (m : ℕ)
    (x : PiLp 2 (fun _ : List.Vector ι m => W)) :
    wordCreationRow m x = ∑ w, wordCreationProduct w.toList (x w)
proof:
:= by
  change (orthogonalFamily_wordPrefixIsometry (ι := ι) m).linearIsometry
    ((lpPiLpₗᵢ (fun _ : List.Vector ι m => W) ℂ).symm x) = _
  rw [OrthogonalFamily.linearIsometry_apply, tsum_fintype]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  change wordPrefixIsometry w.toList (x w) = wordCreationProduct w.toList (x w)
  exact congrArg (fun T : B => T (x w)) (wordPrefixIsometry_toContinuousLinearMap w.toList)

name: NLAlib.norm_wordCreationRow_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_wordCreationRow_le_one [Fintype ι] (m : ℕ) :
    ‖(wordCreationRow (ι := ι) m).toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (wordCreationRow m).norm_toContinuousLinearMap_le

name: NLAlib.memLp_resamplingTriple_sums
statement:
theorem memLp_resamplingTriple_sums
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i)) :
    MemLp resamplingTripleOriginal 2 (resamplingTripleMeasure ν) ∧
      MemLp resamplingTripleFirst 2 (resamplingTripleMeasure ν) ∧
      MemLp resamplingTripleSecond 2 (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := identDistrib_resamplingTriple_original_first ν
  have hX := (hp.comp measurable_fst).symm.memLp_snd
    (memLp_independentResamplingOriginal ν hν)
  have hpair := (identDistrib_independentResampling_pair ν).comp measurable_fst
  have hXp := (hp.comp measurable_snd).symm.memLp_snd
    (hpair.memLp_snd (memLp_independentResamplingOriginal ν hν))
  have hXpp := (identDistrib_resamplingTripleSecond_original ν).symm.memLp_snd hX
  exact ⟨hX, hXp, hXpp⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_eq_canonical
statement:
theorem integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_eq_canonical
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    (∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      ∫ q, independentResamplingOriginal q ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν
proof:
:=
  ((identDistrib_resamplingTriple_original_first ν).comp measurable_fst).integral_eq

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingTriple
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingTriple
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (g : E → F) (hgc : Continuous g) (C : ℝ) (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ p, B (resamplingTripleOriginal p -
        ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
      (g (resamplingTripleOriginal p)) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ p, B (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p)
          (g (resamplingTripleOriginal p) - g (resamplingTripleFirst p))
          ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
proof:
:= by
  borelize F
  let P := independentResamplingMeasure ν
  let X : ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) → E := independentResamplingOriginal
  let X' : ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) → E := independentResamplingPartner
  have hXm : Measurable X := by unfold X independentResamplingOriginal; fun_prop
  have hX : MemLp X 2 P := memLp_independentResamplingOriginal ν hν
  have htest : MemLp (g ∘ X) 2 P := MemLp.of_bound
    (hgc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX.aestronglyMeasurable) C
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => hgb _))
  have hcomap : @Measurable ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) E
      (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) _ X :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] (g ∘ X) P :=
    (hgc.stronglyMeasurable.comp_measurable hcomap).aestronglyMeasurable
  have h := integral_bilin_exchangeable (identDistrib_independentResampling_pair ν)
    hX g hgc.measurable htest hXm.comap_le hgm (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹
    (by positivity) (condExp_independentResampling_sum ν
      (fun i => (hν i).integrable one_le_two)) B
  have hfactor : (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2 := by
    rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]
    ring
  rw [hfactor] at h
  have hp := identDistrib_resamplingTriple_original_first ν
  have hleft := (hp.comp (show Measurable (fun p : E × E =>
      B (p.1 - ∫ q, X q ∂P) (g p.1)) by fun_prop)).integral_eq
  have hright := (hp.comp (show Measurable (fun p : E × E =>
      B (p.1 - p.2) (g p.1 - g p.2)) by fun_prop)).integral_eq
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hleft hright
  rw [integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_eq_canonical ν]
  change (∫ p, B (resamplingTripleOriginal p - ∫ q, X q ∂P)
    (g (resamplingTripleOriginal p)) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) = _
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_covariance_resamplingTriple
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_covariance_resamplingTriple
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i)) (u v : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∫ p, u (resamplingTripleOriginal p -
        ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) *
      v (resamplingTripleOriginal p -
        ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
      ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2 *
        ∫ p, u (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p) *
          v (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p)
          ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
proof:
:= by
  let P := independentResamplingMeasure ν
  let X : ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) → E := independentResamplingOriginal
  have hXm : Measurable X := by unfold X independentResamplingOriginal; fun_prop
  have hX := memLp_independentResamplingOriginal ν hν
  have hXs : StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] X :=
    (show @Measurable ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) E
      (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) _ X from
      measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl).stronglyMeasurable
  have h := integral_coordinate_covariance_exchangeable
    (identDistrib_independentResampling_pair ν) hX hXm.comap_le hXs
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ (by positivity)
    (condExp_independentResampling_sum ν (fun i => (hν i).integrable one_le_two)) u v
  have hfactor : (2 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2 := by
    rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]
    ring
  rw [hfactor] at h
  have hp := identDistrib_resamplingTriple_original_first ν
  have hleft := (hp.comp (show Measurable (fun p : E × E =>
      u (p.1 - ∫ q, X q ∂P) * v (p.1 - ∫ q, X q ∂P)) by fun_prop)).integral_eq
  have hright := (hp.comp (show Measurable (fun p : E × E =>
      u (p.1 - p.2) * v (p.1 - p.2)) by fun_prop)).integral_eq
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hleft hright
  rw [integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_eq_canonical ν]
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_eval
statement:
theorem covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_eval
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i)) (i j : κ) :
    cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
      (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j); resamplingTripleMeasure ν] =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2 *
        ∫ p, (resamplingTripleOriginal p i - resamplingTripleFirst p i) *
          (resamplingTripleOriginal p j - resamplingTripleFirst p j)
          ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_coordinate_covariance_resamplingTriple ν hν
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) i)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) j)
  have hX := ((memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1).integrable one_le_two
  have hi := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) i).integral_comp_comm hX
  have hj := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) j).integral_comp_comm hX
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] at hi hj
  simpa only [covariance, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.sub_apply, hi, hj] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_exchangeable
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : @Measure Ω mΩ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X X' : Ω → E}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (f : E → F) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hfX : MemLp (f ∘ X) 2 μ)
    (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (f ∘ X) μ)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | m] =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    (∫ ω, B (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (f (X ω)) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω) - f (X' ω)) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hXp : MemLp X' 2 μ := (hex.comp measurable_fst).memLp_snd hX
  have hfXp : MemLp (f ∘ X') 2 μ :=
    (hex.comp (hf.comp measurable_fst)).memLp_snd hfX
  have hD : MemLp (X - X') 2 μ := hX.sub hXp
  have hC : MemLp (fun ω => X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) 2 μ := hX.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hU : Integrable (fun ω => B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω))) μ :=
    (B.memLp_of_bilin 1 hD hfX).integrable le_rfl
  have hV : Integrable (fun ω => B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X' ω))) μ :=
    (B.memLp_of_bilin 1 hD hfXp).integrable le_rfl
  have hL : Integrable (fun ω => B (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (f (X ω))) μ :=
    (B.memLp_of_bilin 1 hC hfX).integrable le_rfl
  have hce := condExp_bilin_of_aestronglyMeasurable_right B hfm hU
    (hD.integrable one_le_two)
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hce
  have hfirst : (∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω)) ∂μ) =
      α • ∫ ω, B (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (f (X ω)) ∂μ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, μ[fun ω => B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω)) | m] ω ∂μ :=
        (integral_condExp hm).symm
      _ = ∫ ω, α • B (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (f (X ω)) ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hce, hreg] with ω hc hr
        change μ[(fun t => X t - X' t) | m] ω = _ at hr
        rw [hc, hr]
        simp
      _ = _ := integral_smul _ _
  have hswap : (∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω)) ∂μ) =
      -(∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X' ω)) ∂μ) := by
    have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : E × E => B (p.1 - p.2) (f p.1)) :=
      (B.continuous₂.measurable.comp ((measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd).prodMk
        (hf.comp measurable_fst)))
    have he := (hex.comp hmeas).integral_eq
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, B (X' ω - X ω) (f (X' ω)) ∂μ := he
      _ = ∫ ω, -(B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X' ω))) ∂μ := by
        congr 1
        funext ω
        rw [← neg_sub]
        simp
      _ = _ := integral_neg _
  have hv : (∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X' ω)) ∂μ) =
      -(∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω)) ∂μ) := by rw [hswap, neg_neg]
  have he : (∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω) - f (X' ω)) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α) • ∫ ω, B (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (f (X ω)) ∂μ := by
    have hpoint (ω : Ω) : B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω) - f (X' ω)) =
        B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω)) - B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X' ω)) := (B _).map_sub _ _
    simp_rw [hpoint]
    rw [integral_sub hU hV, hv, sub_neg_eq_add,
      hfirst, ← add_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hα), one_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_covariance_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_covariance_exchangeable
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : @Measure Ω mΩ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X X' : Ω → E}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (hXm : StronglyMeasurable[m] X)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | m] =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
    (u v : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, u (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) * v (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ * ∫ ω, u (X ω - X' ω) * v (X ω - X' ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let f : E → E := fun x => x - ∫ t, X t ∂μ
  have hf : Measurable f := measurable_id.sub measurable_const
  have hfX : MemLp (f ∘ X) 2 μ := hX.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (f ∘ X) μ :=
    (hXm.sub stronglyMeasurable_const).aestronglyMeasurable
  have h := integral_bilin_exchangeable hex hX f hf hfX hm hfm α hα hreg
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp u v)
  change (∫ ω, u (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) * v (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
    (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, u (X ω - X' ω) *
      v ((X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) - (X' ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ)) ∂μ at h
  simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, smul_eq_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_resamplingTripleToIndependent
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_resamplingTripleToIndependent
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    MeasurePreserving resamplingTripleToIndependent
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν) (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  let s : ι ⊕ ι → ι × Fin 3 := Sum.elim (fun j => (j, 0)) (fun j => (j, 1))
  have hs : Function.Injective s := by
    intro a b hab
    rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b
    · exact congrArg Sum.inl (congrArg Prod.fst hab)
    · have hf := congrArg Prod.snd hab
      norm_num [s] at hf
    · have hf := congrArg Prod.snd hab
      norm_num [s] at hf
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (congrArg Prod.fst hab)
  have hsel := (hasLaw_pi_select (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) s hs).measurePreserving
    (by fun_prop)
  have hpack := measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi
    (fun k : ι ⊕ ι => ν (s k).1)
  have hv : MeasurePreserving
      (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => ((fun j => x (j, 0)), (fun j => x (j, 1))))
      (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
    exact hpack.comp hsel
  let ρ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure
  have h0 := (MeasurePreserving.id ρ).prod hv
  have h1 := (measurePreserving_prodAssoc ρ (Measure.pi ν) (Measure.pi ν)).symm
  have h2 := (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := ρ) (ν := Measure.pi ν)).prod
    (MeasurePreserving.id (Measure.pi ν))
  have h3 := measurePreserving_prodAssoc (Measure.pi ν) ρ (Measure.pi ν)
  exact h3.comp (h2.comp (h1.comp h0))

name: NLAlib.measurable_independentResampling_pair
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.prodMk
  · unfold independentResamplingOriginal
    fun_prop
  · unfold independentResamplingPartner
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro j hj
    apply Measurable.ite
    · convert (measurableSet_singleton j).preimage
        (measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd : Measurable
          (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) => p.2.1)) using 1
      ext p
      simp [eq_comm]
    · fun_prop
    · fun_prop

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_first
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_first
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw (fun p => (resamplingTripleOriginal p, resamplingTripleFirst p))
      ((independentResamplingMeasure ν).map
        (fun p => (independentResamplingOriginal p, independentResamplingPartner p)))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : HasLaw (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) =>
      (independentResamplingOriginal p, independentResamplingPartner p))
      ((independentResamplingMeasure ν).map
        (fun p => (independentResamplingOriginal p, independentResamplingPartner p)))
      (independentResamplingMeasure ν) :=
    ⟨measurable_independentResampling_pair.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have h := hp.comp (measurePreserving_resamplingTripleToIndependent ν).hasLaw
  have hf : (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) =>
      (independentResamplingOriginal p, independentResamplingPartner p)) ∘
      resamplingTripleToIndependent =
      fun p => (resamplingTripleOriginal p, resamplingTripleFirst p) := by
    funext p
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, independentResamplingPartner,
        resamplingTripleToIndependent, resamplingTripleFirst]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = p.1 <;> simp [hji]
  rw [hf] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.identDistrib_resamplingTriple_original_first
statement:
theorem identDistrib_resamplingTriple_original_first
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    IdentDistrib (fun p => (resamplingTripleOriginal p, resamplingTripleFirst p))
      (fun p => (independentResamplingOriginal p, independentResamplingPartner p))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν) (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_first ν
  exact ⟨h.aemeasurable, measurable_independentResampling_pair.aemeasurable, h.map_eq⟩

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_resamplingReorder
statement:
private theorem measurePreserving_resamplingReorder
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (ρ : Measure ι)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] :
    MeasurePreserving resamplingReorder ((Measure.pi ν).prod (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν)))
      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (measurePreserving_prodAssoc (Measure.pi ν) ρ (Measure.pi ν)).symm
  have h2 := (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := Measure.pi ν) (ν := ρ)).prod
    (MeasurePreserving.id (Measure.pi ν))
  have h3 := measurePreserving_prodAssoc ρ (Measure.pi ν) (Measure.pi ν)
  have h4 := (MeasurePreserving.id ρ).prod
    (measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow E E ι ν ν).symm
  exact h4.comp (h3.comp (h2.comp h1))

name: NLAlib.identDistrib_independentResampling_pair
statement:
theorem identDistrib_independentResampling_pair
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    IdentDistrib (fun p => (independentResamplingOriginal p, independentResamplingPartner p))
      (fun p => (independentResamplingPartner p, independentResamplingOriginal p))
      (independentResamplingMeasure ν) (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure
  have hm := measurePreserving_resamplingReorder ν ρ
  have hi : IdentDistrib resamplingReorder id (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j))) :=
    ⟨hm.measurable.aemeasurable, aemeasurable_id,
      by simpa only [independentResamplingMeasure, ρ, Measure.map_id] using hm.map_eq⟩
  have hp : Measurable (fun p : ι × (ι → E × E) => (resamplingOriginal p, resamplingPartner p)) := by
    unfold resamplingOriginal resamplingPartner
    apply Measurable.prodMk
    · fun_prop
    · apply Finset.measurable_sum
      intro j hj
      apply Measurable.ite
      · convert ((measurableSet_singleton j).preimage
          (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : ι × (ι → E × E) → ι))) using 1
        ext p; simp [eq_comm]
      · fun_prop
      · fun_prop
  have hq : Measurable (fun p : ι × (ι → E × E) => (resamplingPartner p, resamplingOriginal p)) :=
    measurable_swap.comp hp
  have h := (hi.comp hp).trans ((identDistrib_resampling_pair ν ρ).trans (hi.comp hq).symm)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, resamplingReorder,
    resamplingOriginal, resamplingPartner, independentResamplingOriginal,
    independentResamplingPartner] using h

name: NLAlib.independentResamplingOriginal_sub_partner
statement:
theorem independentResamplingOriginal_sub_partner (p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) :
    independentResamplingOriginal p - independentResamplingPartner p = p.1 p.2.1 - p.2.2 p.2.1
proof:
:= by
  exact resamplingOriginal_sub_partner (resamplingReorder p)

name: NLAlib.integrable_selected_difference
statement:
private theorem integrable_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) (ρ : Measure ι) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] :
    Integrable (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) => p.1 p.2.1 - p.2.2 p.2.1)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν)))
proof:
:= by
  have hi (j : ι) : Integrable (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) =>
      if j = p.2.1 then p.1 j - p.2.2 j else 0)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν))) := by
    have hx := (integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := j) (hν j)).comp_fst (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν))
    have hy := ((integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := j) (hν j)).comp_snd ρ).comp_snd (Measure.pi ν)
    have hs : MeasurableSet {p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) | j = p.2.1} := by
      convert ((measurableSet_singleton j).preimage (measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd)) using 1
      ext p; simp [eq_comm]
    refine ((hx.sub hy).indicator hs).congr (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
    by_cases hp : j = p.2.1 <;> simp [Set.indicator, hp]
  simpa only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using
    (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun j _ => hi j)

name: NLAlib.integral_selected_difference
statement:
private theorem integral_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) (x : ι → E) :
    (∫ p : ι × (ι → E), (x p.1 - p.2 p.1)
      ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod (Measure.pi ν)) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ j, x j - ∑ j, ∫ t, t ∂ν j)
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure
  have hi (j : ι) : Integrable (fun p : ι × (ι → E) =>
      if j = p.1 then x j - p.2 j else 0) (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
    have hj := (integrable_const (x j) : Integrable (fun _ : ι × (ι → E) => x j) (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    have hy := (integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := j) (hν j)).comp_snd ρ
    have hs : MeasurableSet {p : ι × (ι → E) | j = p.1} := by
      convert ((measurableSet_singleton j).preimage measurable_fst) using 1
      ext p; simp [eq_comm]
    refine ((hj.sub hy).indicator hs).congr (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
    by_cases hp : j = p.1 <;> simp [Set.indicator, hp]
  have hi' : Integrable (fun p : ι × (ι → E) => x p.1 - p.2 p.1) (ρ.prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using
      (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun j _ => hi j)
  have hEval (j : ι) : Integrable (fun x : ι → E => x j) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := j) (hν j)
  rw [integral_prod _ hi']
  simp_rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) (hEval _),
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_eval (μ := ν)]
  rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    ← Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: NLAlib.condExp_independentResampling_originals
statement:
theorem condExp_independentResampling_originals
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) :
    condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance) (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
      (independentResamplingOriginal - independentResamplingPartner) =ᵐ[independentResamplingMeasure ν]
      fun p => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (independentResamplingOriginal p - ∑ j, ∫ t, t ∂ν j)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := integrable_selected_difference ν hν (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure
  have hg : StronglyMeasurable (fun x : ι → E =>
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ j, x j - ∑ j, ∫ t, t ∂ν j)) := by
    apply Continuous.stronglyMeasurable
    fun_prop
  have h := condExp_prod_fst_of_integral_eq hf hg (integral_selected_difference ν hν)
  have he : (independentResamplingOriginal - independentResamplingPartner :
      ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) → E) =
      (fun p => p.1 p.2.1 - p.2.2 p.2.1) := by
    funext p
    exact independentResamplingOriginal_sub_partner p
  simpa only [he, independentResamplingOriginal, independentResamplingMeasure] using h

name: NLAlib.memLp_independentResamplingOriginal
statement:
theorem memLp_independentResamplingOriginal
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i)) :
    MemLp independentResamplingOriginal 2 (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hc (j : ι) : MemLp (fun x : ι → E => x j) 2 (Measure.pi ν) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] using
      (hν j).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν j)
  have hs : MemLp (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j) 2 (Measure.pi ν) := by
    simpa using memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hc j)
  have hf := hs.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_fst (μ := Measure.pi ν)
    (ν := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod (Measure.pi ν)))
  change MemLp (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) => ∑ j, p.1 j) 2
    ((Measure.pi ν).prod ((PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod (Measure.pi ν)))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hf

name: NLAlib.integral_independentResamplingOriginal
statement:
theorem integral_independentResamplingOriginal
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) :
    (∫ p, independentResamplingOriginal p ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν) =
      ∑ j, ∫ t, t ∂ν j
proof:
:= by
  have hc (j : ι) : Integrable (fun x : ι → E => x j) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := j) (hν j)
  have hs : Integrable (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    simpa using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hc j)
  change (∫ p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)), ∑ j, p.1 j
    ∂(Measure.pi ν).prod ((PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod (Measure.pi ν))) = _
  rw [integral_prod _ (hs.comp_fst _)]
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hc j)]
  simp only [integral_eval (μ := ν)]

name: NLAlib.condExp_independentResampling_sum
statement:
theorem condExp_independentResampling_sum
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) :
    condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap independentResamplingOriginal inferInstance)
      (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
      (independentResamplingOriginal - independentResamplingPartner) =ᵐ[independentResamplingMeasure ν]
      fun p => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (independentResamplingOriginal p - ∫ t, independentResamplingOriginal t
          ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hfst : Measurable (Prod.fst : ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) → (ι → E)) := measurable_fst
  have hsum : Measurable (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j) := by fun_prop
  have hcomp : @Measurable ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) E
      (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance) _ independentResamplingOriginal :=
    hsum.comp (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl)
  have hle := hcomp.comap_le
  have hm : Measurable independentResamplingOriginal := hsum.comp hfst
  have hreg := condExp_independentResampling_originals ν hν
  rw [← integral_independentResamplingOriginal ν hν] at hreg
  have ht := condExp_condExp_of_le (μ := independentResamplingMeasure ν)
    (f := independentResamplingOriginal - independentResamplingPartner) hle hfst.comap_le
  have hg := condExp_congr_ae (m := MeasurableSpace.comap independentResamplingOriginal inferInstance) hreg
  have hXsm : StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap independentResamplingOriginal inferInstance]
      (independentResamplingOriginal : ((ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E))) → E) :=
    (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl).stronglyMeasurable
  have hsm : StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap independentResamplingOriginal inferInstance]
      (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (independentResamplingOriginal p - ∫ t, independentResamplingOriginal t
          ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν)) :=
    (hXsm.sub stronglyMeasurable_const).const_smul _
  have hXi : Integrable independentResamplingOriginal (independentResamplingMeasure ν) := by
    have hc (j : ι) : Integrable (fun x : ι → E => x j) (Measure.pi ν) :=
      integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := j) (hν j)
    have hs : Integrable (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j) (Measure.pi ν) := by
      simpa using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hc j)
    change Integrable (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) => ∑ j, p.1 j)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod ((PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    exact hs.comp_fst _
  have hgi : Integrable (fun p : (ι → E) × (ι × (ι → E)) => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ •
      (independentResamplingOriginal p - ∫ t, independentResamplingOriginal t
        ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν)) (independentResamplingMeasure ν) :=
    (hXi.sub (integrable_const _)).smul _
  rw [condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable hm.comap_le hsm hgi] at hg
  exact ht.symm.trans hg

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_triple_selected_sum
statement:
private theorem hasLaw_triple_selected_sum
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (a : Fin 3) :
    HasLaw (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => ∑ j, p.2 (j, if j = p.1 then a else 0))
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j)) (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Measurable (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) =>
      ∑ j, p.2 (j, if j = p.1 then a else 0)) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => ∑ j, x (j, if j = i then a else 0))
    fun_prop
  apply hasLaw_prod_of_sections hg
  intro i
  have hsel := hasLaw_pi_select (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)
    (fun j => (j, if j = i then a else 0)) (by intro j k h; exact congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hs : HasLaw (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j)
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j)) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩
  exact hs.comp hsel

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTripleOriginal
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTripleOriginal
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw resamplingTripleOriginal ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  change HasLaw (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => ∑ j, p.2 (j, 0)) _ _
  simpa only [ite_self] using hasLaw_triple_selected_sum ν 0

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTripleFirst
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTripleFirst
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw resamplingTripleFirst ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof: := hasLaw_triple_selected_sum ν 1

name: NLAlib.identDistrib_resamplingTripleSecond_original
statement:
theorem identDistrib_resamplingTripleSecond_original
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    IdentDistrib resamplingTripleSecond resamplingTripleOriginal
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν) (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(hasLaw_resamplingTripleSecond ν).aemeasurable, (hasLaw_resamplingTripleOriginal ν).aemeasurable,
    (hasLaw_resamplingTripleSecond ν).map_eq.trans (hasLaw_resamplingTripleOriginal ν).map_eq.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.resamplingTriple_difference_second
statement:
theorem resamplingTriple_difference_second (p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) :
    resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleSecond p = p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold resamplingTripleOriginal resamplingTripleSecond
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_eq_single p.1]
  · simp
  · intro j hj hji; simp [hji]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.resamplingTriple_first_sub_second
statement:
theorem resamplingTriple_first_sub_second (p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) :
    resamplingTripleFirst p - resamplingTripleSecond p = p.2 (p.1, 1) - p.2 (p.1, 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleSecond p) -
        (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p) := by abel
    _ = _ := by rw [resamplingTriple_difference_second, resamplingTriple_difference]; abel

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_coordinate_pair
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_coordinate_pair
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (i : ι) (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    HasLaw (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => (x (i, a), x (i, b))) ((ν i).prod (ν i))
      (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : iIndepFun (fun k (x : (ι × Fin 3) → E) => x k)
      (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) := iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  exact (hi.indepFun (by intro h; exact hab (congrArg Prod.snd h))).hasLaw_prod
    (measurePreserving_eval (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) (i, a)).hasLaw
    (measurePreserving_eval (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) (i, b)).hasLaw

name: NLAlib.integrable_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
statement:
theorem integrable_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (G : E → ℝ) (hG : Measurable G)
    (hGi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : E × E => G (p.1 - p.2)) ((ν i).prod (ν i))) :
    Integrable (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => G (p.2 (p.1, a) - p.2 (p.1, b)))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => G (p.2 (p.1, a) - p.2 (p.1, b))) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => G (x (i, a) - x (i, b)))
    exact hG.comp ((measurable_pi_apply _).sub (measurable_pi_apply _))
  apply (integrable_prod_iff hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  refine ⟨ae_of_all _ fun i => ?_, Integrable.of_finite⟩
  have hp := (hasLaw_resamplingTriple_coordinate_pair ν i a b hab).measurePreserving (by fun_prop)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hp.integrable_comp_of_integrable (hGi i)

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
statement:
theorem integral_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (G : E → ℝ) (hG : Measurable G)
    (hGi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : E × E => G (p.1 - p.2)) ((ν i).prod (ν i))) :
    (∫ p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E), G (p.2 (p.1, a) - p.2 (p.1, b))
      ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∫ p : E × E, G (p.1 - p.2) ∂(ν i).prod (ν i)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν a b hab G hG hGi
  change (∫ p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E), G (p.2 (p.1, a) - p.2 (p.1, b))
    ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)) = _
  rw [integral_prod _ hi]
  have he (i : ι) :
      (∫ x : (ι × Fin 3) → E, G (x (i, a) - x (i, b)) ∂Measure.pi (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)) =
        ∫ p : E × E, G (p.1 - p.2) ∂(ν i).prod (ν i) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      (hasLaw_resamplingTriple_coordinate_pair ν i a b hab).integral_comp (hGi i).aestronglyMeasurable
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTriple_original_sub_first
statement:
theorem integral_resamplingTriple_original_sub_first
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (G : E → ℝ) (hG : Measurable G)
    (hGi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : E × E => G (p.1 - p.2)) ((ν i).prod (ν i))) :
    (∫ p, G (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∫ p : E × E, G (p.1 - p.2) ∂(ν i).prod (ν i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [resamplingTriple_difference] using
    integral_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν 0 1 (by decide) G hG hGi

theorem integral_resamplingTriple_first_sub_second

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTriple_original_sub_second
statement:
theorem integral_resamplingTriple_original_sub_second
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_mul_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_trace_mul_exchangeable
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X X' : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hXm : Measurable X) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ)
    (f : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hfX : MemLp (f ∘ X) 2 μ) (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ)) :
    (∫ ω, ((X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) * f (X ω)).trace ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, ((X ω - X' ω) * (f (X ω) - f (X' ω))).trace ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    finiteBilinCLM ((mulLinearMap ℝ).compr₂ (traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ))
  have hm : MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance ≤ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω› := hXm.comap_le
  have hx : @Measurable Ω (Matrix n n ℂ) (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) _ X :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] (f ∘ X) μ :=
    (hf.comp hx).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  exact integral_bilin_exchangeable hex hX f hf hfX hm hfm α hα hreg B

name: NLAlib.integral_kronecker_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_kronecker_exchangeable
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X X' : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hXm : Measurable X) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ)) :
    (∫ ω, Matrix.kronecker (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, Matrix.kronecker (X ω - X' ω) (X ω - X' ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix (n × n) (n × n) ℂ :=
    finiteBilinCLM (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ]
      Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (n × n) (n × n) ℂ)
  let f : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun A => A - ∫ t, X t ∂μ
  have hf : Measurable f := measurable_id.sub measurable_const
  have hfX : MemLp (f ∘ X) 2 μ := hX.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hm : MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance ≤ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω› := hXm.comap_le
  have hx : @Measurable Ω (Matrix n n ℂ) (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) _ X :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] (f ∘ X) μ :=
    (hf.comp hx).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have h := integral_bilin_exchangeable hex hX f hf hfX hm hfm α hα hreg B
  change (∫ ω, Matrix.kronecker (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
    (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, Matrix.kronecker (X ω - X' ω)
      ((X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) - (X' ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ)) ∂μ at h
  simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_real_covariance_tensor_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_real_covariance_tensor_exchangeable
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X X' : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hXm : Measurable X) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
    (r : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) :
    (∫ ω, Matrix.vecMulVec (r (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
      (r (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ)) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, Matrix.vecMulVec (r (X ω - X' ω)) (r (X ω - X' ω)) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix κ κ ℝ :=
    finiteBilinCLM ((vecMulVecBilin ℝ ℝ).compl₁₂ r.toLinearMap r.toLinearMap)
  let f : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := fun A => A - ∫ t, X t ∂μ
  have hf : Measurable f := measurable_id.sub measurable_const
  have hfX : MemLp (f ∘ X) 2 μ := hX.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hm : MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance ≤ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω› := hXm.comap_le
  have hx : @Measurable Ω (Matrix n n ℂ) (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) _ X :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] (f ∘ X) μ :=
    (hf.comp hx).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have h := integral_bilin_exchangeable hex hX f hf hfX hm hfm α hα hreg B
  change (∫ ω, Matrix.vecMulVec (r (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
    (r (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ)) ∂μ) =
    (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, Matrix.vecMulVec (r (X ω - X' ω))
      (r ((X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) - (X' ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))) ∂μ at h
  simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using h

name: NLAlib.indepFun_third_section
statement:
private theorem indepFun_third_section
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (i : ι) :
    IndepFun (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => x (i, 0) - x (i, 1))
      (fun x => ∑ j, x (thirdSelection i j)) (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset (ι × Fin 3) := {(i, 0), (i, 1)}
  let T : Finset (ι × Fin 3) := Finset.univ.image (thirdSelection i)
  have hST : Disjoint S T := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro k hkS hkT
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hkT
    have hji : j = i := by
      have h := hkS
      simp only [S, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
      rcases h with h | h <;> exact congrArg Prod.fst h
    subst j
    simpa [S, thirdSelection] using hkS
  have hi : iIndepFun (fun k (x : (ι × Fin 3) → E) => x k)
      (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) := iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  have hind := hi.indepFun_finset S T hST (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  let f : (S → E) → E := fun x => x ⟨(i, 0), by simp [S]⟩ - x ⟨(i, 1), by simp [S]⟩
  let g : (T → E) → E := fun x => ∑ j, x ⟨thirdSelection i j, by simp [T]⟩
  have hf : Measurable f := by unfold f; fun_prop
  have hg : Measurable g := by unfold g; fun_prop
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, f, g] using hind.comp hf hg

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_third_section
statement:
private theorem hasLaw_third_section
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (i : ι) :
    HasLaw (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => ∑ j, x (thirdSelection i j))
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j))
      (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsel := hasLaw_pi_select (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) (thirdSelection i)
    (by intro j k h; exact congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hs : HasLaw (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j)
      ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j)) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩
  exact hs.comp hsel

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTripleSecond
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTripleSecond
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw resamplingTripleSecond ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Measurable (resamplingTripleSecond : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) → E) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => ∑ j, x (j, if j = i then 2 else 0))
    fun_prop
  exact hasLaw_prod_of_sections hg (fun i => hasLaw_third_section ν i)

name: NLAlib.resamplingTriple_difference
statement:
theorem resamplingTriple_difference (p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) :
    resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p = p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold resamplingTripleOriginal resamplingTripleFirst
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_eq_single p.1]
  · simp
  · intro j hj hji; simp [hji]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.indepFun_resamplingTriple_difference_second
statement:
theorem indepFun_resamplingTriple_difference_second
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    IndepFun (resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleFirst)
      resamplingTripleSecond (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Measurable (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 1)) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => x (i, 0) - x (i, 1))
    fun_prop
  have hg : Measurable (resamplingTripleSecond : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) → E) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => ∑ j, x (j, if j = i then 2 else 0))
    fun_prop
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun x : ι → E => ∑ j, x j)) :=
    (Measure.pi ν).isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have h := indepFun_prod_of_sections (ρ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure) hf hg (fun i => indepFun_third_section ν i)
    (fun i => hasLaw_third_section ν i)
  have he : (resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleFirst : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) → E) =
      (fun p => p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 1)) := by
    funext p
    exact resamplingTriple_difference p
  simpa only [he, resamplingTripleMeasure] using h

name: NLAlib.coordinateSwap_measurable
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_measurable :
    Measurable (fun p : ι × (ι → E × E) => coordinateSwap p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro j
  exact Measurable.ite (by
      convert ((measurableSet_singleton j).preimage
        (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : ι × (ι → E × E) → ι))) using 1
      ext p
      simp [eq_comm])
    (measurable_swap.comp ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd))
    ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd)

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_coordinateSwap
statement:
private theorem measurePreserving_coordinateSwap
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (i : ι) :
    MeasurePreserving (coordinateSwap i)
      (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)) (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j))
proof:
:= by
  change MeasurePreserving (fun (x : ι → E × E) j => if j = i then (x j).swap else x j) _ _
  refine measurePreserving_pi (fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)) (fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j))
    (f := fun j (z : E × E) => if j = i then z.swap else z) ?_
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · simpa only [coordinateSwap, hj, if_true] using
      (Measure.measurePreserving_swap : MeasurePreserving Prod.swap ((ν j).prod (ν j)) ((ν j).prod (ν j)))
  · simp only [hj, if_false]
    constructor
    · exact measurable_id
    · exact Measure.map_id

name: NLAlib.resamplingOriginal_measurable
statement: private theorem resamplingOriginal_measurable : Measurable (resamplingOriginal : ι × (ι → E × E) → E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold resamplingOriginal
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.resamplingPartner_measurable
statement: private theorem resamplingPartner_measurable : Measurable (resamplingPartner : ι × (ι → E × E) → E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold resamplingPartner
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro j hj
  exact Measurable.ite (by
      convert ((measurableSet_singleton j).preimage
        (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : ι × (ι → E × E) → ι))) using 1
      ext p
      simp [eq_comm])
    (((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd).snd)
    (((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd).fst)

name: NLAlib.resampling_swap
statement:
private theorem resampling_swap (p : ι × (ι → E × E)) :
    (resamplingOriginal (p.1, coordinateSwap p.1 p.2),
      resamplingPartner (p.1, coordinateSwap p.1 p.2)) =
    (resamplingPartner p, resamplingOriginal p)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    by_cases hji : j = p.1 <;> simp [resamplingOriginal, resamplingPartner, coordinateSwap, hji]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    by_cases hji : j = p.1 <;> simp [resamplingOriginal, resamplingPartner, coordinateSwap, hji]

name: NLAlib.identDistrib_resampling_pair
statement:
theorem identDistrib_resampling_pair
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (ρ : Measure ι) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] :
    IdentDistrib (fun p : ι × (ι → E × E) => (resamplingOriginal p, resamplingPartner p))
      (fun p => (resamplingPartner p, resamplingOriginal p))
      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)))
      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (MeasurePreserving.id ρ).skew_product coordinateSwap_measurable
    (ae_of_all ρ fun i => (measurePreserving_coordinateSwap ν i).map_eq)
  have hi : IdentDistrib (fun p : ι × (ι → E × E) => (p.1, coordinateSwap p.1 p.2)) id
      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)))
      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j))) :=
    ⟨hm.measurable.aemeasurable, aemeasurable_id, by simpa using hm.map_eq⟩
  have h := hi.comp (resamplingOriginal_measurable.prodMk resamplingPartner_measurable)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, resampling_swap, id_eq] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.resamplingOriginal_sub_partner
statement:
theorem resamplingOriginal_sub_partner (p : ι × (ι → E × E)) :
    resamplingOriginal p - resamplingPartner p = (p.2 p.1).1 - (p.2 p.1).2
proof:
:= by
  unfold resamplingOriginal resamplingPartner
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p.1]
  · simp
  · intro j hj hji; simp [hji]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a : Fin 3) :
    HasLaw (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => fun i => q.1.2 (i, a))
      (Measure.pi ν) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hasLaw_pi_select (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)
    (fun i => (i, a)) (by intro i j h; exact congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hi := (measurePreserving_snd
    (μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure)
    (ν := Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1)).hasLaw
  have hn := (measurePreserving_fst (μ := resamplingTripleMeasure ν) (ν := γ)).hasLaw
  exact hs.comp (hi.comp hn)

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_selected_difference
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    HasLaw (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => p.2 (p.1, a) - p.2 (p.1, b))
      (resamplingDifferenceLaw ν) (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => p.2 (p.1, a) - p.2 (p.1, b)) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → E => x (i, a) - x (i, b))
    fun_prop
  apply hasLaw_prod_of_section_laws hm
  intro i
  have hd : HasLaw (fun p : E × E => p.1 - p.2)
      (((ν i).prod (ν i)).map (fun p : E × E => p.1 - p.2)) ((ν i).prod (ν i)) :=
    ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩
  exact hd.comp (hasLaw_resamplingTriple_coordinate_pair ν i a b hab)

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_sub_first
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_sub_first
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw (resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleFirst)
      (resamplingDifferenceLaw ν) (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleFirst : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) → E) =
      (fun p => p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 1)) := by funext p; exact resamplingTriple_difference p
  rw [he]
  exact hasLaw_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν 0 1 (by decide)

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_first_sub_second
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_first_sub_second
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw (resamplingTripleFirst - resamplingTripleSecond)
      (resamplingDifferenceLaw ν) (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (resamplingTripleFirst - resamplingTripleSecond : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) → E) =
      (fun p => p.2 (p.1, 1) - p.2 (p.1, 2)) := by funext p; exact resamplingTriple_first_sub_second p
  rw [he]
  exact hasLaw_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν 1 2 (by decide)

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_sub_second
statement:
theorem hasLaw_resamplingTriple_original_sub_second
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw (resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleSecond)
      (resamplingDifferenceLaw ν) (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleSecond : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) → E) =
      (fun p => p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 2)) := by funext p; exact resamplingTriple_difference_second p
  rw [he]
  exact hasLaw_resamplingTriple_selected_difference ν 0 2 (by decide)

name: NLAlib.sum_normalizedSamplingProbabilities
statement:
theorem sum_normalizedSamplingProbabilities {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (u : ι → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (ht : 0 < ∑ i, u i) :
    ∑ i, normalizedSamplingProbabilities u i = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply NNReal.coe_injective
  simp only [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_one, normalizedSamplingProbabilities]
  simp_rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (hu _) ht.le)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_self ht.ne']

name: NLAlib.coe_normalizedSamplingProbabilities
statement:
theorem coe_normalizedSamplingProbabilities {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (u : ι → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (ht : 0 < ∑ i, u i) (i : ι) :
    (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u i : ℝ) = u i / ∑ j, u j
proof:
:=
  Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (hu i) ht.le)

name: NLAlib.sum_sampleCount_nsmul
statement:
theorem sum_sampleCount_nsmul {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommMonoid M] {s : ℕ} (ω : Fin s → ι) (f : ι → M) :
    (∑ i, sampleCount ω i • f i) = ∑ j, f (ω j)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sampleCount, Finset.sum_const] using
    Finset.sum_fiberwise' (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s)) ω f

name: NLAlib.card_sampleCount_support_le
statement:
theorem card_sampleCount_support_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {s : ℕ} (ω : Fin s → ι) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => sampleCount ω i ≠ 0)).card ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => sampleCount ω i ≠ 0) = Finset.univ.image ω := by
    ext i
    simp [sampleCount]
  rw [he]
  exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)

name: NLAlib.integral_finiteSamplingLaw
statement:
theorem integral_finiteSamplingLaw {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (p : ι → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) (f : ι → E) :
    ∫ i, f i ∂finiteSamplingLaw p hp = ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSamplingLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp [finiteSamplingPMF]

name: NLAlib.finiteSamplingLaw_singleton
statement:
theorem finiteSamplingLaw_singleton {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] (p : ι → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) (i : ι) :
    finiteSamplingLaw p hp {i} = p i
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSamplingLaw, PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton i)]
  simp [finiteSamplingPMF]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_dotProduct_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_exp_dotProduct_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ∫ g : Fin d → ℝ, Real.exp (a ⬝ᵥ g) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d)) =
      Real.exp (‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  have hs : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (t * x) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    intro t
    simpa only [mgf, id_eq, zero_mul, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, zero_add] using
      congrFun (mgf_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)) t
  simp only [dotProduct, Real.exp_sum]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun i (x : ℝ) => Real.exp (a i * x))]
  simp_rw [hs]
  rw [← Real.exp_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  simp only [pow_two]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sqrt_mul_dotProduct_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_exp_sqrt_mul_dotProduct_gaussianVector {d : ℕ}
    (v : Fin d → ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    ∫ g : Fin d → ℝ, Real.exp (Real.sqrt (2 * θ) * (g ⬝ᵥ v))
        ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d)) = Real.exp (θ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun g : Fin d → ℝ => Real.exp (Real.sqrt (2 * θ) * (g ⬝ᵥ v))) =
      (fun g => Real.exp ((Real.sqrt (2 * θ) • v) ⬝ᵥ g)) := by
    funext g
    rw [smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm g v]
  rw [heq, integral_exp_dotProduct_gaussianVector, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self,
    norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * θ by positivity)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, hs]
  ring

name: NLAlib.aemeasurable_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {d : ℕ} {X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ}
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ) : AEMeasurable X μ
proof:
:= by
  apply aemeasurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  simpa using (hmgf (Pi.single i 1)).aemeasurable

name: NLAlib.lintegral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf
statement:
theorem lintegral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1 / 2) :
    (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (θ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2)) ∂μ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - 2 * θ) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  let γ := gaussianVector (Fin d)
  let F : Ω → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ := fun ω g =>
    Real.exp (Real.sqrt (2 * θ) * (g ⬝ᵥ X ω))
  have hXm := aemeasurable_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF hmgf
  have hcoord (i : Fin d) : AEMeasurable (fun ω => X ω i) μ :=
    aemeasurable_pi_iff.mp hXm i
  have hFmeas : AEMeasurable (Function.uncurry F) (μ.prod γ) := by
    have hcoord' (i : Fin d) : AEMeasurable
        (fun z : Ω × (Fin d → ℝ) => X z.1 i) (μ.prod γ) := (hcoord i).comp_fst
    dsimp [Function.uncurry, F, dotProduct]
    apply AEMeasurable.exp
    apply AEMeasurable.const_mul
    exact Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
      (((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd).aemeasurable.mul (hcoord' i))
  have hlin (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
      (∫ g, Real.exp (Real.sqrt (2 * θ) * (g ⬝ᵥ v)) ∂γ) =
        Real.exp (θ * (v ⬝ᵥ v)) := by
    rw [integral_exp_sqrt_mul_dotProduct_gaussianVector v hθ0, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  have hF (ω : Ω) : Integrable (F ω) γ := by
    apply Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero
    rw [show (∫ g, F ω g ∂γ) = Real.exp (θ * (X ω ⬝ᵥ X ω)) from hlin (X ω)]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  have hgauss : (∫ g : Fin d → ℝ, Real.exp (θ * (g ⬝ᵥ g)) ∂γ) =
      (1 - 2 * θ) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    have hh := integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (1 - 2 * θ)
      (show 0 < 1 - 2 * θ by linarith)
    rw [show -((1 - 2 * θ - 1) / 2) = θ by ring, Fintype.card_fin] at hh
    simpa only [dotProduct, ← sq] using hh
  have hgint : Integrable (fun g : Fin d → ℝ => Real.exp (θ * (g ⬝ᵥ g))) γ :=
    Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero (by rw [hgauss]; exact
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (show 0 < 1 - 2 * θ by linarith) _).ne')
  have hsection (g : Fin d → ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω => F ω g) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, F ω g ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (θ * (g ⬝ᵥ g)) := by
    let u := Real.sqrt (2 * θ) • g
    have hsu := hmgf u
    have heu : ((‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) / 2 = θ * (g ⬝ᵥ g) := by
      rw [NNReal.coe_pow, coe_nnnorm, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * θ by positivity)]
      ring
    have heq : (fun ω => Real.exp (1 * (X ω ⬝ᵥ u))) = (fun ω => F ω g) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [u, F, one_mul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm]
    constructor
    · simpa only [heq] using hsu.integrable_exp_mul 1
    · have hh := hsu.mgf_le 1
      rw [mgf, heq] at hh
      simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at hh
      change (∫ ω, F ω g ∂μ) ≤
        Real.exp (((‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) / 2) at hh
      rwa [heu] at hh
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ ω, ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (F ω g) ∂γ ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro ω
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hF ω)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun g => (Real.exp_pos _).le), hlin (X ω)]
    _ = ∫⁻ g, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F ω g) ∂μ ∂γ :=
      lintegral_lintegral_swap hFmeas.ennreal_ofReal
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (θ * (g ⬝ᵥ g))) ∂γ := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro g
      change (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F ω g) ∂μ) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (θ * (g ⬝ᵥ g)))
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hsection g).1
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hsection g).2
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hgint
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun g => (Real.exp_pos _).le), hgauss]

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_sq_norm_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_sq_norm_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1 / 2) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hXm := aemeasurable_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF hmgf
  have hc (i : Fin d) : AEMeasurable (fun ω => X ω i) μ :=
    aemeasurable_pi_iff.mp hXm i
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2)) μ := by
    simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, dotProduct]
    apply AEMeasurable.exp
    apply AEMeasurable.const_mul
    exact Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hc i).mul (hc i)
  refine ⟨hm.aestronglyMeasurable,
    (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le)).2 ?_⟩
  exact (lintegral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf μ X hmgf hθ0 hθ1).trans_lt (by simp)

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf
statement:
theorem integral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1 / 2) :
    (∫ ω, Real.exp (θ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤
      (1 - 2 * θ) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (show 0 < 1 - 2 * θ by linarith) (-((d : ℝ) / 2))
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hpos.le,
    ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_exp_sq_norm_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF μ X hmgf hθ0 hθ1)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
  exact lintegral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf μ X hmgf hθ0 hθ1

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sq_norm_ge_le_chi_square_mgf
statement:
theorem measureReal_sq_norm_ge_le_chi_square_mgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ)
    (u θ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1 / 2) :
    μ.real {ω | u ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2} ≤
      Real.exp (-θ * u) * (1 - 2 * θ) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hh := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf (μ := μ)
    (X := fun ω => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2) u hθ0 (integrable_exp_sq_norm_of_directional_hasSubgaussianMGF μ X hmgf hθ0 hθ1)
  apply hh.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  exact integral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf μ X hmgf hθ0 hθ1

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sq_norm_ge_one_add_mul_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sq_norm_ge_one_add_mul_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * d ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2} ≤
      Real.exp (-((d : ℝ) / 2) * (ε - Real.log (1 + ε)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1ε : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
  let θ := ε / (2 * (1 + ε))
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := by positivity
  have hθ1 : θ < 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp only [θ]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have h2 : 1 - 2 * θ = (1 + ε)⁻¹ := by dsimp only [θ]; field_simp; ring
  refine (measureReal_sq_norm_ge_le_chi_square_mgf μ X hmgf ((1 + ε) * d) θ hθ0 hθ1).trans
    (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [h2, Real.inv_rpow h1ε.le, ← Real.rpow_neg h1ε.le, neg_neg, Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1ε,
    ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  dsimp only [θ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sq_norm_ge_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sq_norm_ge_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hmgf : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) μ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω | d + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * x) + 2 * x ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity), ofReal_measureReal]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with rfl | hd
  · rcases hx.eq_or_lt with rfl | hx0
    · rw [neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
      exact prob_le_one
    · have heq : {ω | ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 * Real.sqrt (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x) + 2 * x ≤
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω)‖ ^ 2} = ∅ := by
        ext ω
        simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, dotProduct, Finset.univ_eq_empty,
          Finset.sum_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero, zero_add,
          Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        linarith
      rw [heq, measure_empty]
      exact zero_le
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  let a := Real.sqrt (x / d)
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 = x / d := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) * x) = d * a := by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) * x = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / d) by field_simp,
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq hd0.le]
  have hthreshold : (d : ℝ) + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * x) + 2 * x =
      (1 + (2 * a + 2 * a ^ 2)) * d := by
    rw [hsqrt, ha2]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hthreshold]
  rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ((measureReal_sq_norm_ge_one_add_mul_le μ X hmgf
    (by positivity)).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_))
  have hlog : Real.log (1 + (2 * a + 2 * a ^ 2)) ≤ 2 * a := by
    rw [Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (by positivity)]
    have hh := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2 * a by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hx' : x = a ^ 2 * d := by rw [ha2]; field_simp
  rw [hx']
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sq_norm_le_chi_square_mgf_pmf

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (p : PMF Ω) {d : ℕ} (X : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
