name: NLAlib.rooted_inverse_chiSquare_moment_mono
statement:
private theorem rooted_inverse_chiSquare_moment_mono {d : ℕ} {q r : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hqr : q ≤ r) (hrd : r < (d : ℝ) / 2) :
    (∫ x : Fin d → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ q ∂gaussianVector (Fin d)) ^ (1 / q) ≤
      (∫ x : Fin d → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ r ∂gaussianVector (Fin d)) ^ (1 / r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_rpow_and_integral_rpow_inv_le
    (f := fun x : Fin d → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ?_ ?_ hq hqr
    (integrable_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector r (hq.trans_le hqr).le hrd)).2
  · exact (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => inv_nonneg.mpr
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg (x j))

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_root_le_three_div
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_root_le_three_div {d : ℕ}
    (hd : 5 ≤ d) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqd : 2 * q + 1 ≤ (d : ℝ)) :
    (∫ x : Fin d → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ q ∂gaussianVector (Fin d)) ^ (1 / q) ≤
      3 / (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (5 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  let r : ℝ := ((d : ℝ) - 1) / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hroot := rooted_inverse_chiSquare_moment_mono (d := d) hq (r := r) (by dsimp [r]; linarith)
    (by dsimp [r]; linarith)
  refine hroot.trans ?_
  have hend := (integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_lt hd).le
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x : Fin d → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ r ∂gaussianVector (Fin d) :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
  calc
    _ ≤ ((3 / (d : ℝ)) ^ r) ^ (1 / r) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hnonneg hend (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / r)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3 / (d : ℝ)),
        mul_one_div_cancel hr.ne', Real.rpow_one]

name: NLAlib.rooted_inverse_chiSquare_two_le_two
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [Real.Gamma_one_half_eq, Real.Gamma_one, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_nonneg
  have ht := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  have hp := Real.pi_le_four
  have htwo : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [div_pow]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2)).mpr (by nlinarith)

name: NLAlib.inverse_chiSquare_four_endpoint_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [Real.Gamma_one_half_eq, Real.Gamma_two]
  have hs : Real.sqrt Real.pi ≤ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_nonneg, Real.sqrt_nonneg Real.pi, Real.pi_le_four]
  have ht : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2)
  exact (div_le_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))).mpr (hs.trans ht)

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_root_le_four_div
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_root_le_four_div {d : ℕ}
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hqd : 2 * q + 1 ≤ (d : ℝ)) :
    (∫ x : Fin d → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ q ∂gaussianVector (Fin d)) ^ (1 / q) ≤
      4 / (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : 5 ≤ d
  · exact (integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_root_le_three_div hd hq hqd).trans
      (by gcongr; norm_num)
  have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
    have hd1 : 1 < d := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  interval_cases d
  · have h := rooted_inverse_chiSquare_moment_mono (d := 2) hq (r := 1 / 2) (by norm_num at hqd ⊢; linarith)
      (by norm_num)
    have hb := h.trans rooted_inverse_chiSquare_two_le_two
    norm_num at hb ⊢
    exact hb
  · have h := rooted_inverse_chiSquare_moment_mono (d := 3) hq (r := 1) (by norm_num at hqd ⊢; linarith)
      (by norm_num)
    have he : (∫ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (1 : ℝ)
        ∂gaussianVector (Fin 3)) ^ (1 / (1 : ℝ)) = 1 := by
      have hi := integral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin 3) (by norm_num)
      norm_num at hi ⊢
      exact hi
    rw [he] at h
    exact h.trans (by norm_num)
  · have h := rooted_inverse_chiSquare_moment_mono (d := 4) hq (r := 3 / 2) (by norm_num at hqd ⊢; linarith)
      (by norm_num)
    have hm : 0 ≤ ∫ x : Fin 4 → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
        ∂gaussianVector (Fin 4) := integral_nonneg fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    have hb := Real.rpow_le_one hm inverse_chiSquare_four_endpoint_le_one
      (by norm_num : 0 ≤ 1 / (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    exact h.trans (by simpa using hb)

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_root_le_four_div_of_hasLaw
proof:
:= by
  have hf : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ q)
      (gaussianVector (Fin d)) := (by fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [show (∫ ω, (∑ j, X ω j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ q ∂μ) =
    ∫ x : Fin d → ℝ, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ q ∂gaussianVector (Fin d) from hX.integral_comp hf]
  exact integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_root_le_four_div hq hqd

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_neg_mul_sq_gaussianReal_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem integral_exp_neg_mul_sq_gaussianReal_eq_rpow (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) :
    ∫ y, Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * y ^ 2) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = u ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num)]
  simp only [gaussianPDFReal_def, smul_eq_mul, NNReal.coe_one, sub_zero, mul_one]
  have h : ∀ x : ℝ, (√(2 * π))⁻¹ * rexp (-x ^ 2 / 2) * rexp (-((u - 1) / 2) * x ^ 2)
      = (√(2 * π))⁻¹ * rexp (-(u / 2) * x ^ 2) := by
    intro x; rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussian]
  have h2 : π / (u / 2) = (2 * π) / u := by field_simp
  rw [h2, Real.sqrt_div (by positivity), Real.rpow_neg hu.le, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have : √(2 * π) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (u : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 < u) :
    ∫ x : ι → ℝ, Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * ∑ j, x j ^ 2)
      ∂(gaussianVector ι) = u ^ (-((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * ∑ j, x j ^ 2)
      = ∏ j, Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * x j ^ 2) := by
    intro x; rw [Finset.mul_sum, Real.exp_sum]
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun _ y => Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * y ^ 2))]
  simp only [integral_exp_neg_mul_sq_gaussianReal_eq_rpow u hu, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_univ]
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hu.le]
  congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.ae_sum_sq_pos_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem ae_sum_sq_pos_gaussianVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hd : 1 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(gaussianVector ι), 0 < ∑ j, x j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have : NullSingletonClass (gaussianReal 0 1) := nullSingletonClass_gaussianReal (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨i₀⟩ : Nonempty ι := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  have hnull : (gaussianVector ι) (Function.eval i₀ ⁻¹' {0}) = 0 :=
    Measure.pi_eval_preimage_null _ (measure_singleton 0)
  filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hnull] with x hx
  have hx0 : x i₀ ≠ 0 := by simpa using hx
  have h1 : x i₀ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, x j ^ 2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => x j ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ _)
  have h2 : 0 < x i₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sum_sq_le_le_exp_mul_rpow
proof:
:= by
  set μ := gaussianVector (Fin d)
  have hint : Integrable (fun g : Fin d → ℝ => Real.exp (-s * ∑ i, g i ^ 2)) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) ?_ ?_
    · exact (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun g : Fin d → ℝ =>
        Real.exp (-s * ∑ i, g i ^ 2))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine ae_of_all _ fun g => ?_
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have : 0 ≤ ∑ i, g i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith
  have h := measure_le_le_exp_mul_mgf (X := fun g : Fin d → ℝ => ∑ i, g i ^ 2) (μ := μ) u
    (neg_nonpos.mpr hs) hint
  have hmgf : mgf (fun g : Fin d → ℝ => ∑ i, g i ^ 2) μ (-s)
      = (1 + 2 * s) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    have := integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (1 + 2 * s) (by linarith)
    rw [show -((1 + 2 * s - 1) / 2) = -s by ring, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    exact this
  rw [hmgf, neg_neg] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sum_sq_le_le_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_sq_le_le_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hud : u ≤ d) :
    (gaussianVector (Fin d)).real {g | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ u}
      ≤ (Real.exp 1 * u / d) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity), ofReal_measureReal]
  rcases hu.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu0
  · 
    have hnull : (gaussianVector (Fin d))
        {g : Fin d → ℝ | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ 0} = 0 := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      ((ae_sum_sq_pos_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (by simpa using hd)).mono
        fun g hg hmem => (not_le.mpr hg) hmem)
    rw [hnull]
    exact zero_le
  · set s := ((d:ℝ) / u - 1) / 2 with hs_def
    have hdu : 1 ≤ (d:ℝ) / u := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hu0]; linarith
    have hs : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs_def]; linarith
    have h1 : 1 + 2 * s = (d:ℝ) / u := by rw [hs_def]; ring
    have hsu : s * u = ((d:ℝ) - u) / 2 := by rw [hs_def]; field_simp
    have hch := measureReal_sum_sq_le_le_exp_mul_rpow (d := d) u s hs
    rw [h1, hsu, Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), ← Real.inv_rpow (by positivity), inv_div] at hch
    have hrhs : (Real.exp 1 * u / d) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)
        = Real.exp ((d:ℝ) / 2) * (u / d) ^ ((d:ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc, Real.mul_rpow (Real.exp_pos 1).le (by positivity), Real.exp_one_rpow]
    rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    refine hch.trans ?_
    rw [hrhs]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sum_sq_le_one_sub_mul_le_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_sq_le_one_sub_mul_le_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (gaussianVector (Fin d)).real {g | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ (1 - ε) * d}
      ≤ Real.exp (((d : ℝ) / 2) * (ε + Real.log (1 - ε)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1ε : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
  set s := ε / (2 * (1 - ε)) with hs_def
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := by positivity
  have h2 : 1 + 2 * s = (1 - ε)⁻¹ := by rw [hs_def]; field_simp; ring
  refine (measureReal_sum_sq_le_le_exp_mul_rpow ((1 - ε) * d) s hs).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [h2, Real.inv_rpow h1ε.le, ← Real.rpow_neg h1ε.le, neg_neg, Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1ε,
    ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  rw [hs_def]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_sum_sq_le_exp_mul_rpow
statement:
theorem measureReal_le_sum_sq_le_exp_mul_rpow {d : ℕ} (u t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t)
    (ht1 : t < 1 / 2) :
    (gaussianVector (Fin d)).real {g | u ≤ ∑ i, g i ^ 2}
      ≤ Real.exp (-t * u) * (1 - 2 * t) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  set μ := gaussianVector (Fin d)
  have hlap := integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (1 - 2 * t)
    (by linarith)
  rw [show -((1 - 2 * t - 1) / 2) = t by ring, Fintype.card_fin] at hlap
  have hint : Integrable (fun g : Fin d → ℝ => Real.exp (t * ∑ i, g i ^ 2)) μ :=
    Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero (by
      rw [hlap]; exact (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _).ne')
  have h := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf (X := fun g : Fin d → ℝ => ∑ i, g i ^ 2) (μ := μ) u ht0
    hint
  have hmgf : mgf (fun g : Fin d → ℝ => ∑ i, g i ^ 2) μ t
      = (1 - 2 * t) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)) := hlap
  rwa [hmgf] at h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_sum_sq_le_gaussianVector
proof:
:= by
  have h1ε : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
  set t := ε / (2 * (1 + ε)) with ht_def
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by positivity
  have ht1 : t < 1 / 2 := by
    rw [ht_def, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
  have h2 : 1 - 2 * t = (1 + ε)⁻¹ := by rw [ht_def]; field_simp; ring
  refine (measureReal_le_sum_sq_le_exp_mul_rpow ((1 + ε) * d) t ht0 ht1).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [h2, Real.inv_rpow h1ε.le, ← Real.rpow_neg h1ε.le, neg_neg, Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1ε,
    ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  rw [ht_def]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_eq_mul_sqrt_div
statement:
private lemma sqrt_mul_eq_mul_sqrt_div {d x : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    Real.sqrt (d * x) = d * Real.sqrt (x / d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show d * x = d ^ 2 * (x / d) by field_simp, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
    Real.sqrt_sq hd.le]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le_sum_sq_le_gaussianVector
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity), ofReal_measureReal]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with rfl | hd
  · rcases hx.eq_or_lt with rfl | hx0
    · simp
    · have : {g : Fin 0 → ℝ | ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 * Real.sqrt (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x) + 2 * x
          ≤ ∑ i, g i ^ 2} = ∅ := by
        ext g; simp; linarith
      rw [this, measure_empty]; exact zero_le
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  set a := Real.sqrt (x / d) with ha_def
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 = x / d := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hset : {g : Fin d → ℝ | d + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * x) + 2 * x ≤ ∑ i, g i ^ 2}
      = {g | (1 + (2 * a + 2 * a ^ 2)) * d ≤ ∑ i, g i ^ 2} := by
    have : (d : ℝ) + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * x) + 2 * x = (1 + (2 * a + 2 * a ^ 2)) * d := by
      rw [sqrt_mul_eq_mul_sqrt_div hd0, ← ha_def, ha2]; field_simp; ring
    rw [this]
  rw [hset]
  rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ((measureReal_le_sum_sq_le_gaussianVector (by positivity)).trans
    (Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_))
  have hlog : Real.log (1 + (2 * a + 2 * a ^ 2)) ≤ 2 * a := by
    rw [Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (by positivity)]
    have := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * a)
    nlinarith
  have hx' : x = a ^ 2 * d := by rw [ha2]; field_simp
  rw [hx']
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sum_sq_le_sub_two_sqrt_mul_le_gaussianVector
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity), ofReal_measureReal]
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  set u := 2 * Real.sqrt (x / d) with hu_def
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by positivity
  have hu2 : u ^ 2 = 4 * (x / d) := by
    rw [hu_def, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]; norm_num
  have hset : {g : Fin d → ℝ | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ d - 2 * Real.sqrt (d * x)}
      = {g | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ (1 - u) * d} := by
    have : (d : ℝ) - 2 * Real.sqrt (d * x) = (1 - u) * d := by
      rw [sqrt_mul_eq_mul_sqrt_div hd0, hu_def]; ring
    rw [this]
  rw [hset]
  rcases lt_or_ge u 1 with hu1 | hu1
  · rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      ((measureReal_sum_sq_le_one_sub_mul_le_gaussianVector hu0 hu1).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_))
    have hlog := log_one_sub_le_neg_sub_sq_div_two hu0 hu1
    have hx' : x = u ^ 2 * d / 4 := by rw [hu2]; field_simp
    rw [hx']
    have : (d : ℝ) / 2 * (u + Real.log (1 - u)) ≤ (d : ℝ) / 2 * (-(u ^ 2 / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
    linarith
  · have hnull : (gaussianVector (Fin d))
        {g : Fin d → ℝ | ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ (1 - u) * d} = 0 := by
      refine measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
        ((ae_sum_sq_pos_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (by simpa using hd)).mono
          fun g hg hmem => ?_)
      have : (1 - u) * (d : ℝ) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hd0.le
      exact (not_le.mpr hg) ((show ∑ i, g i ^ 2 ≤ (1 - u) * d from hmem).trans this)
    rw [hnull]; exact zero_le

name: NLAlib.lintegral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
private lemma lintegral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqd : q < (d : ℝ) / 2) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d))
      = ENNReal.ofReal (Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - q) / (2 ^ q * Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2)))
proof:
:= by
  set μ := gaussianVector (Fin d) with hμ
  have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with h | h
    · subst h; simp at hqd; linarith
    · exact h
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 := by linarith
  have hGq : 0 < Gamma q := Gamma_pos_of_pos hq
  have hGd : 0 < Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2) := Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0
  set S : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, x j ^ 2 with hS
  
  set K : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ → ENNReal :=
    fun x v => ENNReal.ofReal ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * (v ^ (q - 1) * Real.exp (-(S x * v)))) with hK
  have step1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal (((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q) = ∫⁻ v in Ioi 0, K x v := by
    filter_upwards [ae_sum_sq_pos_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (by simpa using hd1)] with x hx
    simp only [hK]
    rw [lintegral_ofReal_mul_rpow_mul_exp_Ioi hq hx (Gamma q)⁻¹ (inv_nonneg.mpr hGq.le)]
    congr 1
    rw [one_div]
    field_simp
  rw [lintegral_congr_ae step1]
  have hKm : Measurable (Function.uncurry K) := by
    simp only [hK, hS]
    fun_prop
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap hKm.aemeasurable]
  
  have step2 : ∀ v ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ x, K x v ∂μ
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1) * (1 + 2 * v) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2))) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := hv
    have hc : 0 ≤ (Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1) :=
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hGq.le) (Real.rpow_nonneg hv0.le _)
    have hmeas : Measurable fun x => (Gamma q)⁻¹ * (v ^ (q - 1) * Real.exp (-(S x * v))) := by
      simp only [hS]; fun_prop
    have hint : Integrable (fun x => (Gamma q)⁻¹ * (v ^ (q - 1) * Real.exp (-(S x * v)))) μ := by
      refine (integrable_const ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1))).mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      have hSx : 0 ≤ S x := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
      have he : Real.exp (-(S x * v)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc (Gamma q)⁻¹ * (v ^ (q - 1) * Real.exp (-(S x * v)))
          = ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1)) * Real.exp (-(S x * v)) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1)) * 1 := by gcongr
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    simp only [hK]
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by positivity)]
    congr 1
    have hlap := integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := Fin d) (1 + 2 * v)
      (by linarith)
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hlap
    have hfun : ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ, (Gamma q)⁻¹ * (v ^ (q - 1) * Real.exp (-(S x * v)))
        = ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1)) *
          Real.exp (-((1 + 2 * v - 1) / 2) * ∑ j, x j ^ 2) := by
      intro x; simp only [hS]; ring_nf
    simp_rw [hfun]
    rw [integral_const_mul, hlap]
  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi step2]
  
  set Gd := Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2) with hGd'
  set L : ℝ → ℝ → ENNReal := fun v w => ENNReal.ofReal
    ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1) * Gd⁻¹ * (w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * Real.exp (-((1 + 2 * v) * w))))
    with hL
  have step3 : ∀ v ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * v ^ (q - 1) * (1 + 2 * v) ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)))
        = ∫⁻ w in Ioi 0, L v w := by
    intro v hv
    have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := hv
    have h12 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + 2 * v := by linarith
    simp only [hL]
    rw [lintegral_ofReal_mul_rpow_mul_exp_Ioi hx0 h12 _ (by
      have := Real.rpow_nonneg hv0.le (q - 1); positivity)]
    congr 1
    rw [one_div, Real.inv_rpow h12.le, ← Real.rpow_neg h12.le]
    field_simp
    exact hGd'
  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi step3]
  have hLm : Measurable (Function.uncurry L) := by
    simp only [hL]
    fun_prop
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap hLm.aemeasurable]
  
  have step4 : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ v in Ioi 0, L v w
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((Gd⁻¹ * (2 ^ q)⁻¹) *
          (w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - q - 1) * Real.exp (-(1 * w)))) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw0 : (0 : ℝ) < w := hw
    have hfun : ∀ v : ℝ, L v w = ENNReal.ofReal
        (((Gamma q)⁻¹ * Gd⁻¹ * w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * Real.exp (-w)) *
          (v ^ (q - 1) * Real.exp (-((2 * w) * v)))) := by
      intro v
      simp only [hL]
      congr 1
      have : Real.exp (-((1 + 2 * v) * w)) = Real.exp (-w) * Real.exp (-((2 * w) * v)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      rw [this]; ring
    simp_rw [hfun]
    rw [lintegral_ofReal_mul_rpow_mul_exp_Ioi hq (by positivity) _ (by
      have := Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1); positivity)]
    congr 1
    have h1 : (1 / (2 * w)) ^ q = (2 ^ q)⁻¹ * w ^ (-q) := by
      rw [one_div, Real.inv_rpow (by positivity), Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hw0.le,
        Real.rpow_neg hw0.le, mul_inv]
    have h2 : w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * w ^ (-q) = w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - q - 1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hw0]; congr 1; ring
    rw [h1, one_mul]
    calc (Gamma q)⁻¹ * Gd⁻¹ * w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * Real.exp (-w) *
          ((2 ^ q)⁻¹ * w ^ (-q) * Gamma q)
        = ((Gamma q)⁻¹ * Gamma q) * Gd⁻¹ * (2 ^ q)⁻¹ *
          (w ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * w ^ (-q)) * Real.exp (-w) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hGq.ne', h2]; ring
  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi step4]
  
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 - q := by linarith
  rw [lintegral_ofReal_mul_rpow_mul_exp_Ioi ha one_pos _ (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  rw [div_one, Real.one_rpow, one_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_aux
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_aux {d : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hqd : q < (d : ℝ) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q)
        (gaussianVector (Fin d)) ∧
    ∫ x, ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d))
      = Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - q) / (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hq.eq_or_lt with h0 | hq0
  · subst h0
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 := hqd
    have hG := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0).ne'
    simp only [Real.rpow_zero, sub_zero, one_mul]
    refine ⟨integrable_const _, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_const]
    simp [hG]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[gaussianVector (Fin d)]
      (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)) _
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q) := by fun_prop
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 := by linarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - q) / (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 - q)
    have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0
    positivity
  refine ⟨⟨hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hnn, lintegral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector q hq0 hqd]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  · rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hnn hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable,
      lintegral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector q hq0 hqd, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hpos]

name: NLAlib.integrable_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hqd : q < (d : ℝ) / 2) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q) (gaussianVector (Fin d))
proof:
:=
  (integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_aux q hq hqd).1

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hqd : q < (d : ℝ) / 2) :
    ∫ x, ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ q ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d))
      = Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - q) / (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:=
  (integrable_and_integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_aux q hq hqd).2

name: NLAlib.exp_one_pow_mul_three_lt
statement:
private lemma exp_one_pow_mul_three_lt {n : ℕ} (hn : 5 ≤ n) :
    Real.exp 1 ^ n * 3 < 2 * 3 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 5 := ⟨n - 5, by omega⟩
  have he : Real.exp 1 < 2.7182818286 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have he0 : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have he3 : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := by linarith
  have h5 : Real.exp 1 ^ 5 * 3 < 2 * 3 ^ 5 := by
    have : Real.exp 1 ^ 5 < 2.7182818286 ^ 5 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ he he0.le (by norm_num)
    have : (2.7182818286 : ℝ) ^ 5 * 3 < 2 * 3 ^ 5 := by norm_num
    nlinarith
  have hm : Real.exp 1 ^ m ≤ 3 ^ m := pow_le_pow_left₀ he0.le he3 m
  rw [pow_add, pow_add]
  have : 0 < Real.exp 1 ^ 5 := by positivity
  have : (0 : ℝ) < 3 ^ m := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_pi_div_lt_rpow
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : (5 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  set x : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / 2 with hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by positivity
  set q : ℝ := ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2 with hq
  set G := Gamma x with hGdef
  have hG : 0 < G := Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0
  set s := √x with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx0
  set sp := √π with hsp
  have hspsq : sp ^ 2 = π := Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_pos.le
  have F1 : Gamma (x + 1 / 2) ≤ G * s := Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt hx0
  have F2 : G * Gamma (x + 1 / 2) = Gamma n * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ)) * sp := by
    rw [hGdef, Real.Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half, hx, show 2 * ((n : ℝ) / 2) = n by ring]
  have F3 : (n : ℝ) * Gamma n = (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.Gamma_add_one hn0.ne', Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have F4 := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling n
  have F5 : √(2 * π * n) = 2 * sp * s := by
    rw [show 2 * π * (n : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 * π * x by rw [hx]; ring, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  have F6 := exp_one_pow_mul_three_lt hn
  have F7 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ)) * 2 ^ n = 2 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have hen : Real.exp 1 ^ n > 0 := by positivity
  have hdivpow : ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n = (n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n := div_pow _ _ _
  have h1 : G * Gamma (x + 1 / 2) ≤ G ^ 2 * s := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left F1 hG.le; nlinarith
  have h3 : (n.factorial : ℝ) * sp * 2 ≤ n * 2 ^ n * G ^ 2 * s := by
    have h2 : Gamma n * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ)) * sp ≤ G ^ 2 * s := F2 ▸ h1
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n * 2 ^ n := by positivity
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hpos
    calc (n.factorial : ℝ) * sp * 2
        = (n * Gamma n) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ)) * 2 ^ n) * sp := by rw [F3, F7]; ring
      _ = n * 2 ^ n * (Gamma n * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ)) * sp) := by ring
      _ ≤ n * 2 ^ n * (G ^ 2 * s) := this
      _ = n * 2 ^ n * G ^ 2 * s := by ring
  have h4 : 2 * sp * s * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) ≤ n.factorial := by
    rw [← F5, ← hdivpow]; exact F4
  have h5 : 4 * π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) * s ≤ n * 2 ^ n * G ^ 2 * s := by
    calc 4 * π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) * s
        = (2 * sp * s * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n)) * sp * 2 := by rw [← hspsq]; ring
      _ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * sp * 2 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ _ := h3
  have h6 : 4 * π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) ≤ n * 2 ^ n * G ^ 2 :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_right h5 hs0
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
  have key : 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ n < n * 6 ^ n * G ^ 2 := by
    have h7 : 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ n < 4 * π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) * 3 ^ n := by
      rw [show 4 * π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) * 3 ^ n
        = (π * (n : ℝ) ^ n) * (2 * (2 * 3 ^ n)) / Real.exp 1 ^ n by ring]
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hen]
      have hpn : 0 < π * (n : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
      nlinarith
    calc 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ n < 4 * π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n / Real.exp 1 ^ n) * 3 ^ n := h7
      _ ≤ n * 2 ^ n * G ^ 2 * 3 ^ n := by gcongr
      _ = n * 6 ^ n * G ^ 2 := by
        rw [show (6 : ℝ) ^ n = 2 ^ n * 3 ^ n by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num]; ring
  have h2q : 2 * q = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by rw [hq]; ring
  have hsq : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → (a ^ q) ^ 2 = a ^ n / a := by
    intro a ha
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (a ^ q) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul ha.le, show q * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * q by
      push_cast; ring, h2q, Real.rpow_sub_one ha.ne', Real.rpow_natCast a n]
  have hA : sp * (n : ℝ) ^ q < (6 : ℝ) ^ q * G := by
    apply lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 (by positivity)
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hspsq, hsq _ hn0, hsq 6 (by norm_num)]
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have : π * ((n : ℝ) ^ n * (n : ℝ)⁻¹) = (6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ n) * (6 * (n : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
    rw [this, show (6 : ℝ) ^ n * 6⁻¹ * G ^ 2 = (n * 6 ^ n * G ^ 2) * (6 * (n : ℝ))⁻¹ by
      field_simp]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right key (by positivity)
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity), Real.div_rpow (by norm_num) hn0.le]
  rw [show (3 : ℝ) ^ q / (n : ℝ) ^ q * (2 ^ q * G) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ q * 3 ^ q) * G / (n : ℝ) ^ q by
    ring, ← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num), lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  norm_num
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_lt
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector_lt {d : ℕ} (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    ∫ x, ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (((d : ℝ) - 1) / 2) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d))
      < (3 / (d : ℝ)) ^ (((d : ℝ) - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (5 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  rw [integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (d := d) (((d : ℝ) - 1) / 2) (by linarith)
    (by linarith), show (d : ℝ) / 2 - ((d : ℝ) - 1) / 2 = 1 / 2 by ring, Real.Gamma_one_half_eq]
  exact sqrt_pi_div_lt_rpow hd

name: NLAlib.integrable_inv_sum_sq_pow_two_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_inv_sum_sq_pow_two_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin d → ℝ => ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) (gaussianVector (Fin d))
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (5 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hint := integrable_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (d := d) 2 (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  simpa only [Real.rpow_two] using hint

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_sum_sq_pow_two_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_inv_sum_sq_pow_two_gaussianVector {d : ℕ} (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    ∫ x, ((∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianVector (Fin d))
      = 1 / (((d : ℝ) - 2) * ((d : ℝ) - 4))
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (5 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hval := integral_rpow_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (d := d) 2 (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  simp only [Real.rpow_two] at hval
  rw [hval]
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 - 2 := by linarith
  have hG : 0 < Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 2) := Gamma_pos_of_pos ha
  have hGd : Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2) = ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * (((d : ℝ) / 2 - 2) *
      Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 2)) := by
    calc Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2) = Gamma (((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) + 1) := by congr 1; ring
      _ = ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) := Real.Gamma_add_one (by linarith)
      _ = ((d : ℝ) / 2 - 1) * Gamma (((d : ℝ) / 2 - 2) + 1) := by congr 2; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.Gamma_add_one ha.ne']
  rw [hGd]
  have h1 : (d : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : (d : ℝ) - 4 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 - 1 := by linarith
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (mul_ne_zero h1 h2)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_and_integral_exp_eq_inv
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * S) / 2
      = Real.exp ((-(S / 2)) * u) * (Real.exp (S / 2) / 2) := by
    intro u; rw [mul_div_assoc', ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
  simp_rw [h]
  have hneg : -(S / 2) < 0 := by linarith
  refine ⟨(integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi hneg 1).mul_const _, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_mul_const, integral_exp_mul_Ioi hneg]
  have he : rexp (-(S / 2)) * rexp (S / 2) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  have hS0 : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  rw [mul_one, show -rexp (-(S / 2)) / -(S / 2) * (rexp (S / 2) / 2)
    = (rexp (-(S / 2)) * rexp (S / 2)) / S by field_simp, he, one_div]

name: NLAlib.lintegral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
private lemma lintegral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hd : 3 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂(gaussianVector ι)
      = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2))
proof:
:= by
  set d := Fintype.card ι with hdd
  set μ := gaussianVector ι with hμ
  set K : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun x u => Real.exp (-((u - 1) / 2) * ∑ j, x j ^ 2) / 2 with hK
  have hK_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry K) := by
    simp only [hK]; fun_prop
  
  have step1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹
      = ∫⁻ u in Ioi 1, ENNReal.ofReal (K x u) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_sum_sq_pos_gaussianVector (ι := ι) (by omega)] with x hx
    obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ := integrableOn_and_integral_exp_eq_inv _ hx
    rw [← hval, ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => by positivity)]
  rw [lintegral_congr_ae step1]
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (hK_cont.measurable.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable)]
  
  have step2 : ∀ u ∈ Ioi (1 : ℝ), ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (K x u) ∂μ
      = ENNReal.ofReal (u ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)) / 2) := by
    intro u hu
    have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < u := lt_trans one_pos hu
    have hmeas : Measurable fun x => K x u :=
      (hK_cont.comp (Continuous.prodMk_left u)).measurable
    have hint : Integrable (fun x => K x u) μ := by
      refine (integrable_const (1 / 2 : ℝ)).mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ j, x j ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
      have : -((u - 1) / 2) * ∑ j, x j ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
        have : 0 ≤ (u - 1) / 2 := by have := hu.out; linarith
        nlinarith
      have := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr this
      simp only [hK]; linarith
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by positivity)]
    congr 1
    simp only [hK]
    rw [integral_div, integral_exp_neg_mul_sum_sq_gaussianVector u hu0]
  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi step2]
  
  have hd3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have ha : -((d : ℝ) / 2) < -1 := by linarith
  have hint3 : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => u ^ (-((d : ℝ) / 2)) / 2) (Ioi 1) :=
    (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt ha one_pos).div_const _
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint3]
  · congr 1
    rw [integral_div, integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt ha one_pos, Real.one_rpow]
    have : (d : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have : -((d : ℝ) / 2) + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have : (2 : ℝ) - d ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp
    linear_combination inv_mul_cancel₀ this
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < u := lt_trans one_pos hu
    positivity

name: NLAlib.integrable_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hd : 3 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[gaussianVector ι] (fun x : ι → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      inv_nonneg.mpr (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hnn, lintegral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector hd]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hd : 3 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∫ x, (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂(gaussianVector ι) = 1 / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[gaussianVector ι] (fun x : ι → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      inv_nonneg.mpr (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => (∑ j, x j ^ 2)⁻¹) := by fun_prop
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) := by
    have : (3 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast hd
    apply div_nonneg zero_le_one; linarith
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hnn hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable,
    lintegral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector hd, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hpos]

name: NLAlib.sum_fin2_piFinset_eq_sum_fin
proof:

  rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type (fun p : Fin (M+1) × Fin (M+1) => F ![p.1.val,p.2.val])]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun α hα =>
    ((⟨α 0,mem_range.mp (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hα 0)⟩ : Fin (M+1)),
      (⟨α 1,mem_range.mp (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hα 1)⟩ : Fin (M+1))))

    fin_cases i

    · exact congrArg (fun p : Fin (M+1) × Fin (M+1) => p.2.val) hab
  · intro p _
    refine ⟨![p.1.val,p.2.val],?_,?_⟩
    · apply Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact mem_range.mpr p.1.isLt
      · exact mem_range.mpr p.2.isLt
    · simp
  · intro α _
    congr 1
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_spectral_inclusion_failure_le_resolvent_grid
statement:
theorem measureReal_spectral_inclusion_failure_le_resolvent_grid
    {Ω n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A B : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A ω).IsHermitian) (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (B ω).IsHermitian)
    (N : Finset ℝ) {η C δ ε : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : δ+(C+1)*ε/η^2 ≤ (2*η)⁻¹) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω),
      ∀ β ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), 2*C*η < dist ξ β} ≤
        μ.real {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε} +
          ∑ u ∈ N, μ.real {ω |
            C*specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ <
              specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω),
    ∀ β ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), 2*C*η < dist ξ β}
  let L : Set Ω := {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε}
  let E (u : ℝ) : Set Ω := {ω |
    C*specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ <
      specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))}
  have hs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ F → ω ∈ L ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, E u := by
    filter_upwards [hA, hB] with ω hωA hωB
    intro hf
    by_cases hcover : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
    · right
      have hn : ¬ ∀ u ∈ N,
          specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)) ≤
            C*specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ := by
        intro hcmp
        obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hfar⟩ := hf
        obtain ⟨β, hβ, hclose⟩ := forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
          hωA hωB (N : Set ℝ) hη hC hcover hcmp herror ξ hξ
        exact not_lt_of_ge hclose (hfar β hβ)
      push Not at hn
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hbad⟩ := hn
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem u (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hu hbad)
    · exact Or.inl hcover
  have hm : μ.real F ≤ μ.real (L ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, E u) :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) (measure_mono_ae hs)
  exact hm.trans ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans
    (add_le_add le_rfl (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le N E)))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Integrable (fun ω => resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := ((measurable_resolventEvenMoment ζ p).comp_aemeasurable hXm).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p‖ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p) := by
    filter_upwards [hX] with ω hω
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (X ω) ζ hp)]
    exact resolventEvenMoment_le_inv_abs_im_pow (X ω) hω hζ hp
  refine ⟨Integrable.of_bound hm _ hb, ?_⟩
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa [Measure.real] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb)

name: NLAlib.integral_resolventEvenMoment_pos
statement:
theorem integral_resolventEvenMoment_pos [Nonempty n]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    0 < ∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le μ X hXm hX hζ hp).1
  have hPos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 < resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p :=
    hX.mono fun _ hω => hω.resolventEvenMoment_pos hζ hp
  apply (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae (hPos.mono fun _ h => h.le) hi).2
  have hs : Function.support (fun ω => resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p) =ᵐ[μ]
      (Set.univ : Set Ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hPos] with ω hω
    apply propext
    change resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ≠ 0 ↔ True
    exact iff_true_intro hω.ne'
  rw [measure_congr hs]
  simp

name: NLAlib.integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le
statement:
theorem integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (X ω) ζ hp
  have hbound := (integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le μ X hXm hX hζ hp).2
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ ((|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p)) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hnonneg hbound (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, one_div,
        Real.rpow_rpow_inv (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) hk.ne']

name: NLAlib.abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ν : Measure Ω') [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (Y : Ω' → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hYm : AEMeasurable Y ν)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) (hY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    |(∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) -
      (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (Y ω) ζ p ∂ν) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hxb := integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le μ X hXm hX hζ hp
  have hyb := integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le ν Y hYm hY hζ hp
  have hxn : 0 ≤ (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ^
      (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (X ω) ζ hp) _
  have hyn : 0 ≤ (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (Y ω) ζ p ∂ν) ^
      (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (Y ω) ζ hp) _
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_pow
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (X ω) ζ ^ p * resolvent (X ω) (star ζ) ^ p)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : (star ζ).im ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hζ
  let T : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    (normalizedTraceLinearMap : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (X ω) ζ ^ p * resolvent (X ω) (star ζ) ^ p)) μ := by
    apply AEMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact T.continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
      (((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hXm).pow_const p |>.mul
        (((measurable_matrix_resolvent (star ζ)).comp_aemeasurable hXm).pow_const p))
  apply Integrable.of_bound hm ((|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p))
  filter_upwards [hX] with ω hω
  have hr : ‖resolvent (X ω) ζ‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hs : ‖resolvent (X ω) (star ζ)‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg, specNorm_eq_norm] using
      hω.specNorm_resolvent_le hstar
  have hpow (Y : Matrix n n ℂ) : ‖Y ^ p‖ ≤ ‖Y‖ ^ p := by
    cases p with
    | zero =>
      simpa only [pow_zero, ← specNorm_eq_norm] using
        (specNorm_one_le (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ))
    | succ k => exact norm_pow_le' Y (Nat.succ_pos k)
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖resolvent (X ω) ζ ^ p * resolvent (X ω) (star ζ) ^ p‖ :=
      by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
        (norm_normalizedTrace_le_specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ ^ p * resolvent (X ω) (star ζ) ^ p))
    _ ≤ ‖resolvent (X ω) ζ‖ ^ p * ‖resolvent (X ω) (star ζ)‖ ^ p :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul (hpow _) (hpow _)
        (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
    _ ≤ (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ p * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ p :=
      mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr p)
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hs p)
        (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

name: NLAlib.integral_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_mixed_pow
statement:
theorem integral_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_mixed_pow
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) =
      (∫ ω, normalizedTrace (resolvent (X ω) ζ ^ p *
        resolvent (X ω) (star ζ) ^ p) ∂μ).re
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, (normalizedTrace (resolvent (X ω) ζ ^ p *
        resolvent (X ω) (star ζ) ^ p)).re ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hX] with ω hω
      exact resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow hω ζ p
    _ = _ := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm
      (integrable_normalizedTrace_resolvent_mixed_pow μ X hXm hX hζ p)

name: NLAlib.sum_damping_chebyshevCoeff_mul_discrepancy_le
statement:
theorem sum_damping_chebyshevCoeff_mul_discrepancy_le
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, chebyshevJacksonDamping k j * chebyshevCoeff f j *
      chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν j) ≤ (L : ℝ) * chebyshevMomentError μ ν k
proof:
:= by
  let a := fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ) * (chebyshevJacksonDamping k j * chebyshevCoeff f j)
  let b := fun j : ℕ => chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν j / j
  have heq (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Icc 1 k) :
      a j * b j = chebyshevJacksonDamping k j * chebyshevCoeff f j *
        chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν j := by
    have hj0 : (j : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by have := mem_Icc.mp hj; omega : j ≠ 0)
    dsimp [a, b]
    field_simp
  have henergy : (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, a j ^ 2) ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    apply le_trans _ (sum_mul_sq_chebyshevCoeff_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf (Icc 1 k)
      (by intro j hj; exact (mem_Icc.mp hj).1))
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    have hρ := chebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc (by have := mem_Icc.mp hj; omega : j ≤ k + 1)
    dsimp [a]
    calc
      _ = chebyshevJacksonDamping k j ^ 2 * ((j : ℝ) ^ 2 * chebyshevCoeff f j ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * ((j : ℝ) ^ 2 * chebyshevCoeff f j ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [hρ.1, hρ.2]) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, a j ^ 2) ≤ (L : ℝ) := by
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt henergy).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_sq L.coe_nonneg)
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, a j * b j := sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => (heq j hj).symm)
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, a j ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, b j ^ 2) :=
      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ a b
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * chebyshevMomentError μ ν k :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hroot (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_chebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_eq_sum
statement:
theorem integral_chebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_eq_sum
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, (chebyshevJacksonApprox f k).eval x ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, (chebyshevJacksonApprox f k).eval x ∂ν) =
      ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 k, chebyshevJacksonDamping k j * chebyshevCoeff f j *
        chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν j
proof:
:= by
  have hInt (m : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
      (∫ x, (chebyshevJacksonApprox f k).eval x ∂m) =
        ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), (chebyshevJacksonDamping k j * chebyshevCoeff f j) *
          ∫ x, (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x ∂m := by
    simp only [chebyshevJacksonApprox, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
    rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) =>
      (chebyshevJacksonDamping k j * chebyshevCoeff f j) * (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x)
      _ (fun j _ =>
      (integrable_of_ae_mem_Icc_of_continuousOn m hm
        (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).continuous.continuousOn).const_mul _)]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hInt μ hμ, hInt ν hν, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [← mul_sub]
  change (∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), _ * chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν j) = _
  have hzero : chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν 0 = 0 := by
    simp [chebyshevMomentDiscrepancy]
  have hrange : range (k + 1) = insert 0 (Icc 1 k) := by
    ext j
    simp only [mem_range, mem_insert, mem_Icc]
    omega
  rw [hrange, sum_insert (by simp), hzero, mul_zero, zero_add]

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_le_chebyshevMomentError
statement:
theorem integral_sub_le_chebyshevMomentError
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤
      12 * (L : ℝ) / k + (L : ℝ) * chebyshevMomentError μ ν k
proof:
:= by
  let p := chebyshevJacksonApprox f k
  have hIf (m : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : Integrable f m :=
    integrable_of_ae_mem_Icc_of_continuousOn m hm hf.continuousOn
  have hIp (m : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : Integrable p.eval m :=
    integrable_of_ae_mem_Icc_of_continuousOn m hm p.continuous.continuousOn
  have herror (m : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
      |(∫ x, p.eval x ∂m) - ∫ x, f x ∂m| ≤ 6 * (L : ℝ) / k := by
    rw [← integral_sub (hIp m hm) (hIf m hm), ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := 6 * (L : ℝ) / k) ?_).trans_eq (by simp)
    filter_upwards [hm] with x hx
    exact abs_eval_chebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le hf hk hx
  have hμerr := (abs_le.mp (herror μ hμ)).1
  have hνerr := (abs_le.mp (herror ν hν)).2
  have hmoment := sum_damping_chebyshevCoeff_mul_discrepancy_le hf μ ν k
  rw [← integral_chebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_eq_sum μ ν hμ hν f k] at hmoment
  change (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) - (∫ x, p.eval x ∂ν) ≤ _ at hmoment
  calc
    _ ≤ 6 * (L : ℝ) / k + 6 * (L : ℝ) / k + (L : ℝ) * chebyshevMomentError μ ν k := by
      linarith
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_twelve_div_add_chebyshevMomentError
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_twelve_div_add_chebyshevMomentError
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (12 / k + chebyshevMomentError μ ν k)
proof:
:= by
  apply wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact_of_lipschitzOn_integral_sub_le
    μ ν isCompact_Icc hμ hν
  intro f hf
  simpa using integral_sub_le_chebyshevMomentError μ ν hμ hν hk hf

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_thirtySix_div_add_chebyshevMomentError
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_thirtySix_div_add_chebyshevMomentError
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (36 / k + chebyshevMomentError μ ν k)
proof:
:= by
  apply (wassersteinEDistOne_le_twelve_div_add_chebyshevMomentError μ ν hμ hν hk).trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  gcongr
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.tensorGaussChebyshevRule_sum

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorNormalizedChebyshev_mul
proof:
:= by

  simp only [integral_normalizedChebyshev_mul]

  · subst β;simp

name: NLAlib.tensorGaussChebyshevRule_normalized_mul
statement:
theorem tensorGaussChebyshevRule_normalized_mul {L : ℕ} (hL : 0<L)
    (α β : ι → ℕ) (hα : ∀ i,α i<L) (hβ : ∀ i,β i<L) :
    tensorGaussChebyshevRule L (fun x => tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x*tensorNormalizedChebyshev β x) =
      if α=β then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorNormalizedChebyshev,← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [tensorGaussChebyshevRule_prod L (fun i x => normalizedChebyshev (α i) x*normalizedChebyshev (β i) x)]
  simp_rw [gaussChebyshevRule_normalized_mul hL (hα _) (hβ _)]
  by_cases he : α=β
  · subst β;simp
  · rw [if_neg he]
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp he
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (if_neg hi)

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_nonneg
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_nonneg
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) (M : ℕ) {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i,x i ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :

proof:
:= by

  intro r
  exact tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx r.property

name: NLAlib.tensorGaussChebyshevRule_density_mul_eq_integral
statement:
theorem tensorGaussChebyshevRule_density_mul_eq_integral
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ)
    (β : ι → ℕ) (hβ : ∀ i,β i≤M) :
    tensorGaussChebyshevRule (M+1) (fun x =>
      tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x*tensorNormalizedChebyshev β x) =
      ∫ x,tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x*tensorNormalizedChebyshev β x
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => measureT)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_eq_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [tensorGaussChebyshevRule_sum,integral_finsetSum]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro α hα
    have hα' i : α i<M+1 := mem_range.mp (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hα i)
    have hβ' i : β i<M+1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hβ i)
    simp_rw [show ∀ x : ι → ℝ,tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α*tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x*
      tensorChebyshevMoment μ α*tensorNormalizedChebyshev β x =
      (tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α*tensorChebyshevMoment μ α)*
        (tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x*tensorNormalizedChebyshev β x) from fun x => by ring]
    rw [tensorGaussChebyshevRule_const_mul,integral_const_mul,
      tensorGaussChebyshevRule_normalized_mul (by omega) α β hα' hβ',
      integral_tensorNormalizedChebyshev_mul]
  · intro α _
    apply integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous
    fun_prop

name: NLAlib.continuous_tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ) :
    Continuous (tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M)
proof:
:= by
  have he : tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M = fun x =>
      ∑ α ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : ι => range (M+1)),
        tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α*tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x*tensorChebyshevMoment μ α :=
    funext (tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_eq_sum μ M)
  rw [he]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_eq_density
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_eq_density
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ x,f x ∂tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M) =
      ∫ x,tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x*f (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => measureT)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_eq_map_withDensity,integral_map
    (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).measurable.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      (continuous_tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_nonneg μ M hx)]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ) :
    (∫ x,tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => measureT)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have he := integral_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_eq_density μ M (fun _ => 1) continuous_const
  simpa using he.symm

name: NLAlib.tensorGaussChebyshevRule_density_eq_one
statement:
theorem tensorGaussChebyshevRule_density_eq_one
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ) :
    tensorGaussChebyshevRule (M+1) (tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := (1/sqrt π)^Fintype.card ι
  have hc : 0<c := by dsimp [c];positivity
  have hzero (x : ι → ℝ) : tensorNormalizedChebyshev (0 : ι → ℕ) x = c := by
    simp [tensorNormalizedChebyshev,c]
  have he := tensorGaussChebyshevRule_density_mul_eq_integral μ M (0 : ι → ℕ) (by simp)
  simp_rw [hzero,show ∀ x : ι → ℝ,tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x*c =
    c*tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x from fun x => mul_comm _ _] at he
  rw [tensorGaussChebyshevRule_const_mul,integral_const_mul,integral_tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity] at he
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) (M : ℕ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ x,f x ∂tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M) =
      tensorGaussChebyshevRule (M+1) (fun x => tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x*f (WithLp.toLp 2 x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw,integral_finsetSum_measure (fun σ _ =>
    (integrable_dirac (by simp)).smul_measure_nnreal)]
  simp only [integral_smul_nnreal_measure,integral_dirac,NNReal.smul_def,
    coe_tensorChebyshevQuadratureWeight,smul_eq_mul,tensorGaussChebyshevRule,
    WithLp.toLp_ofLp,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro σ _

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw_normalized_eq
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw_normalized_eq
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ)
    (β : ι → ℕ) (hβ : ∀ i,β i≤M) :
    (∫ x,tensorNormalizedChebyshev β (WithLp.ofLp x) ∂tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M) =
      ∫ x,tensorNormalizedChebyshev β (WithLp.ofLp x) ∂tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M

    μ M (fun x => tensorNormalizedChebyshev β (WithLp.ofLp x))
      ((continuous_tensorNormalizedChebyshev β).comp (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 _))]

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_chebyshevCube_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw
statement:

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_chebyshevCube_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw_le
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw_le
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube (Fin 2))) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {M : ℕ} (hM : 1≤M) :
    wassersteinEDistOne (tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M) (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (24/(M : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : tensorChebyshevMomentError (tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M)
      (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M) M = 0 := by
    unfold tensorChebyshevMomentError
    have he : ∀ β ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
        tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy (tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M)
          (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M) β = 0 := by
      intro β hβ
      rw [tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy,integral_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw_normalized_eq μ M β]
      · exact sub_self _
      · intro i
        have h := mem_range.mp (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hβ).2 i)
        omega
    have hs : (∑ β ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
        (tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy (tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M)
          (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M) β / sqrt (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq β))^2) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro β hβ
      rw [he β hβ]
      simp
    rw [hs,sqrt_zero]
  have h := wassersteinEDistOne_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError
    (tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M) (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M)
    (ae_mem_chebyshevCube_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M)
    (ae_mem_chebyshevCube_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw μ M) hM
  norm_num only [hzero,mul_zero,add_zero,Nat.cast_ofNat,show (12 : ℝ)*2=24 by norm_num] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.exists_finite_support_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw
statement:
theorem exists_finite_support_tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),s.card ≤ (M+1)^Fintype.card ι ∧
      tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw μ M (s : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := (Finset.univ : Finset (ι → Fin (M+1))).image (tensorGaussChebyshevNode (M+1))
  refine ⟨s,?_,?_⟩
  · apply Finset.card_image_le.trans
    simp
  · rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem,tensorChebyshevQuadratureLaw,ae_finsetSum_measure_iff]
    intro σ _
    apply Measure.ae_smul_measure
    have hh : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.dirac (tensorGaussChebyshevNode (M+1) σ),
        x ∈ (s : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) := by
      apply (ae_dirac_iff (p := fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => x ∈ (s : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)))
        s.finite_toSet.measurableSet).mpr
      simp [s]
    filter_upwards [hh] with x hx
    exact fun he => he hx

name: NLAlib.memLp_specNorm_resolvent
statement:
theorem memLp_specNorm_resolvent
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (q : ℝ≥0∞) :
    MemLp (fun ω => specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ)) q μ
proof:
:= by
  apply MemLp.of_bound
    (((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hXm).norm.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (|ζ.im|⁻¹)
  filter_upwards [hX] with ω hω
  change ‖specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ)‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
  exact hω.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_resolvent_pow
statement:
private theorem integrable_specNorm_resolvent_pow
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ) ^ q) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    ((((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hXm).norm).pow_const q).aestronglyMeasurable
    (|ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ q)
  filter_upwards [hX] with ω hω
  change ‖specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ) ^ q‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ q
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _)]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) (hω.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ) q

name: NLAlib.integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_lpNorm_specNorm
statement:
theorem integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_le_lpNorm_specNorm
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      lpNorm (fun ω => specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by positivity) (by finiteness)
    (memLp_specNorm_resolvent μ X hXm hX hζ (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞))).1]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _),
    show (2 * (p : ℝ)) = ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ) by simp, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hi := (integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le μ X hXm hX hζ hp).1
  have hn := integrable_specNorm_resolvent_pow μ X hXm hX hζ (2*p)
  have hb := integral_mono hi hn (fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_le_specNorm_pow (X ω) ζ hp)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.rpow_natCast, one_div] using
    Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (integral_nonneg fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (X ω) ζ hp) hb
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ (2 * (p : ℝ))⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
statement:
theorem lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_le_card_rpow_mul_integral_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lpNorm (fun ω => specNorm (resolvent (X ω) ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by positivity) (by finiteness)
    (memLp_specNorm_resolvent μ X hXm hX hζ (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞))).1]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _),
    show (2 * (p : ℝ)) = ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ) by simp, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hi := (integrable_and_integral_resolventEvenMoment_le μ X hXm hX hζ hp).1
  have hn := integrable_specNorm_resolvent_pow μ X hXm hX hζ (2*p)
  have hb := integral_mono hn (hi.const_mul (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
    (fun ω => specNorm_resolvent_pow_le_card_mul_resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ hp)
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hb
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∫ ω, resolventEvenMoment (X ω) ζ p ∂μ) ^
        (2 * (p : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
      · exact integral_nonneg fun ω => pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
      · exact hb
      · positivity
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity)
          (integral_nonneg fun ω => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg (X ω) ζ hp)]
                simp only [one_div]

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_le_momentError
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_le_momentError
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d))
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw (chebyshevCubeLift ν) M) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (18*d/M + Real.sqrt ((d:ℝ)*Real.pi^d/2)*tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν M)
proof:
:= by
  have := isProbabilityMeasure_chebyshevCubeLift ν hν
  have hsm := wassersteinEDistOne_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw_le (chebyshevCubeLift ν) hM
  rw [map_chebyshevCubeLift ν hν] at hsm
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hsm
  have he : 0 ≤ tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν M := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hh := wassersteinEDistOne_le_add_of_ae_mem_compact μ ν
    (tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw (chebyshevCubeLift ν) M) isCompact_chebyshevCube hμ hν
    (ae_mem_chebyshevCube_tensorChebyshevSmoothedLaw _ M)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 12*(d:ℝ)/M + Real.sqrt ((d:ℝ)*Real.pi^d/2)*tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν M)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 6*(d:ℝ)/M)
    (wassersteinEDistOne_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν hμ hν hM) hsm
  convert hh using 1
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_tensor_damping_coeff_mul_discrepancy_le
statement:
theorem sum_tensor_damping_coeff_mul_discrepancy_le {d : ℕ}
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (chebyshevCube (Fin d)))
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices d k, tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α *
      tensorChebyshevCoeff f α * tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α) ≤
      sqrt ((d : ℝ) * π ^ d / 2) * (L : ℝ) * tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν k
proof:
:= by
  let s := tensorChebyshevMomentIndices d k
  let a := fun α : Fin d → ℕ => sqrt (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α) *
    (tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α)
  let b := fun α : Fin d → ℕ => tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α /
    sqrt (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)
  have heq (α : Fin d → ℕ) (hα : α ∈ s) : a α * b α =
      tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α *
        tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α := by
    have hq := sqrt_pos.2 (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq_pos (mem_erase.mp hα).1)
    dsimp [a, b]
    field_simp
  have henergy0 : (∑ α ∈ s, tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * π ^ d * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := hf.extend_real
    simp_rw [tensorChebyshevCoeff_congr hfg]
    exact sum_norm_sq_mul_tensorChebyshevCoeff_sq_le_of_lipschitzWith hg s
  have henergy : (∑ α ∈ s, a α ^ 2) ≤ (d : ℝ) * π ^ d * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    apply le_trans _ henergy0
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro α hα
    have hρ := tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping_mem_Icc (M := k) (α := α) (fun i => by
      have h := Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp (mem_erase.mp hα).2 i
      have := mem_range.mp h
      omega)
    dsimp [a]
    rw [mul_pow, sq_sqrt (by unfold tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq; positivity)]
    calc
      _ = tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α ^ 2 *
          (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [hρ.1, hρ.2]) (by
          unfold tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq
          positivity)
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  have hroot : sqrt (∑ α ∈ s, a α ^ 2) ≤ sqrt ((d : ℝ) * π ^ d / 2) * (L : ℝ) := by
    refine (sqrt_le_sqrt henergy).trans_eq ?_
    rw [show (d : ℝ) * π ^ d * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 =
      ((d : ℝ) * π ^ d / 2) * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 by ring,
      sqrt_mul (by positivity), sqrt_sq L.coe_nonneg]
  calc
    _ = ∑ α ∈ s, a α * b α := sum_congr rfl (fun α hα => (heq α hα).symm)
    _ ≤ sqrt (∑ α ∈ s, a α ^ 2) * sqrt (∑ α ∈ s, b α ^ 2) :=
      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt s a b
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hroot (sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevMomentError_sq
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevMomentError_sq {d : ℕ}
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) (k : ℕ) :
    tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν k ^ 2 =
      ∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices d k,
        tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α ^ 2 / tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevMomentError, sq_sqrt (sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro α _
  rw [div_pow, sq_sqrt (by unfold tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq; positivity)]

name: NLAlib.integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_eq_sum
statement:
theorem integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_eq_sum {d : ℕ}
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d))
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f k x ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f k x ∂ν) =
      ∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices d k, tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α *
        tensorChebyshevCoeff f α * tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α
proof:
:= by
  have hInt (m : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) :
      (∫ x, tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f k x ∂m) =
        ∑ α ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin d => range (k + 1)),
          (tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α) *
            ∫ x, tensorNormalizedChebyshev α (WithLp.ofLp x) ∂m := by
    unfold tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox
    rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun α x =>
      (tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping k α * tensorChebyshevCoeff f α) *
        tensorNormalizedChebyshev α (WithLp.ofLp x)) _ (fun α _ =>
      (integrable_of_ae_mem_chebyshevCube_of_continuousOn m hm
        ((continuous_tensorNormalizedChebyshev α).comp
          (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 _)).continuousOn).const_mul _)]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hInt μ hμ, hInt ν hν, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [← mul_sub]
  change (∑ α ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin d => range (k + 1)),
    _ * tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α) = _
  have hzero : tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν (0 : Fin d → ℕ) = 0 := by
    simp [tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy, tensorNormalizedChebyshev]
  have hmem : (0 : Fin d → ℕ) ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin d => range (k + 1)) := by
    simp
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hmem, hzero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError
statement:
theorem integral_sub_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError {d : ℕ}
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d))
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (chebyshevCube (Fin d))) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤
      12 * d * (L : ℝ) / k + sqrt ((d : ℝ) * π ^ d / 2) * (L : ℝ) *
        tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν k
proof:
:= by
  let p := tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f k
  have hIf (m : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) : Integrable f m :=
    integrable_of_ae_mem_chebyshevCube_of_continuousOn m hm hf.continuousOn
  have hIp (m : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) : Integrable p m :=
    integrable_of_ae_mem_chebyshevCube_of_continuousOn m hm
      (continuous_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox f k).continuousOn
  have herror (m : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
      (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) :
      |(∫ x, p x ∂m) - ∫ x, f x ∂m| ≤ 6 * d * (L : ℝ) / k := by
    rw [← integral_sub (hIp m hm) (hIf m hm), ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := 6 * d * (L : ℝ) / k) ?_).trans_eq (by simp)
    filter_upwards [hm] with x hx
    simpa only [p, Real.norm_eq_abs, Fintype.card_fin] using
      abs_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf hk hx
  have hμerr := (abs_le.mp (herror μ hμ)).1
  have hνerr := (abs_le.mp (herror ν hν)).2
  have hmoment := sum_tensor_damping_coeff_mul_discrepancy_le hf μ ν k
  rw [← integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonApprox_sub_eq_sum μ ν hμ hν f k] at hmoment
  change (∫ x, p x ∂μ) - (∫ x, p x ∂ν) ≤ _ at hmoment
  calc
    _ ≤ 6 * d * (L : ℝ) / k + 6 * d * (L : ℝ) / k +
        sqrt ((d : ℝ) * π ^ d / 2) * (L : ℝ) * tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν k := by linarith
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.wassersteinEDistOne_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError
statement:
theorem wassersteinEDistOne_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError {d : ℕ}
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d))
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ chebyshevCube (Fin d)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    wassersteinEDistOne μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
      (12 * d / k + sqrt ((d : ℝ) * π ^ d / 2) * tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν k)
proof:
:= by
  apply wassersteinEDistOne_le_of_ae_mem_compact_of_lipschitzOn_integral_sub_le
    μ ν isCompact_chebyshevCube hμ hν
  intro f hf
  simpa using integral_sub_le_tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν hμ hν hk hf

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_specNorm_integral_resolvent_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_specNorm_integral_resolvent_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → M)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (fun ω => resolvent (X ω) ζ) μ ∧
      specNorm (∫ ω, resolvent (X ω) ζ ∂μ) ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hm := ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp_aemeasurable hXm).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖resolvent (X ω) ζ‖ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ :=
    hX.mono fun ω hω => hω.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  refine ⟨Integrable.of_bound hm _ hb, ?_⟩
  simpa [specNorm_eq_norm, Measure.real] using
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_resolvent_sub_integral_resolvent_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_resolvent_sub_integral_resolvent_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ν : Measure Ω') [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (X : Ω → M) (Y : Ω' → M)
    (hXm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hYm : AEMeasurable Y ν)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) (hY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    specNorm ((∫ ω, resolvent (X ω) ζ ∂μ) - ∫ ω, resolvent (Y ω) ζ ∂ν) ≤
      2 * |ζ.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (integrable_and_specNorm_integral_resolvent_le μ X hXm hX ζ hζ).2
  have hy := (integrable_and_specNorm_integral_resolvent_le ν Y hYm hY ζ hζ).2
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (∫ ω, resolvent (X ω) ζ ∂μ) +
        specNorm (∫ ω, resolvent (Y ω) ζ ∂ν) := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ + |ζ.im|⁻¹ := add_le_add hx hy
    _ = _ := (two_mul _).symm

name: NLAlib.measurable_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_input
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.measurable
