name: NLAlib.comp_tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel_eq_withDensity
statement:
theorem comp_tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel_eq_withDensity
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ) :
    (tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel M) ∘ₘ μ =
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => measureT)).withDensity
        (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel, Kernel.comp_const_withDensity μ _
    (measurable_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_input M).ennreal_ofReal]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
  have : CompactSpace (chebyshevCube ι) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp isCompact_chebyshevCube
  have hc : Continuous (fun r : chebyshevCube ι =>
      tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r.val)) :=
    (continuous_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M).comp'
      (continuous_const.prodMk ((PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 _).comp continuous_subtype_val))
  have hi : Integrable (fun r : chebyshevCube ι =>
      tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r.val)) μ :=
    hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hp : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] (fun r : chebyshevCube ι =>
      tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r.val)) :=
    ae_of_all _ (fun r => tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx r.property)
  exact (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi hp).symm

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_eq_sum
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity_eq_sum [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Measure (chebyshevCube ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : ℕ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity μ M x =
      ∑ α ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : ι => Finset.range (M + 1)),
        tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x *
          tensorChebyshevMoment μ α
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (chebyshevCube ι) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp isCompact_chebyshevCube
  unfold tensorChebyshevSmoothedDensity
  simp_rw [tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_eq_sum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (f := fun (α : ι → ℕ) (r : chebyshevCube ι) =>
    tensorChebyshevJacksonDamping M α * tensorNormalizedChebyshev α x *
      tensorNormalizedChebyshev α (WithLp.ofLp r.val)) _ (fun α _ => ?_)]
  · simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
    rfl
  · apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport _ (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
    unfold tensorNormalizedChebyshev normalizedChebyshev
    fun_prop

name: NLAlib.lintegral_edist_tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_edist_tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel_le {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (r : chebyshevCube ι) :
    (∫⁻ x, edist r.val (WithLp.toLp 2 x) ∂tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel M r) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Fintype.card ι / M)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => edist r.val (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) :=
    (continuous_const.edist (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _)).measurable
  rw [tensorChebyshevSmoothingKernel, Kernel.lintegral_withDensity _
    (measurable_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_input M).ennreal_ofReal r hm]
  simp only [Kernel.const_apply]
  have he (x : ι → ℝ) : edist r.val (WithLp.toLp 2 x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x - r.val‖ := by
    rw [edist_comm, edist_dist, dist_eq_norm]
  simp_rw [he, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul' (norm_nonneg _)]
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ =>
      tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r.val) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x - r.val‖)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => measureT)) := integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop)
  have hp : 0 ≤ᵐ[Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => measureT)] (fun x =>
      tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel M x (WithLp.ofLp r.val) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x - r.val‖) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
    exact mul_nonneg (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx r.property) (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi hp]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  apply le_trans _ (integral_tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_mul_sum_abs_sub_le hM r.property)
  apply integral_mono_ae hi (integrable_pi_measureT_of_continuous (by fun_prop))
  filter_upwards [ae_mem_chebyshevCube (ι := ι)] with x hx
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (tensorChebyshevJacksonKernel_nonneg M hx r.property)
  exact euclidean_norm_le_sum_abs (WithLp.toLp 2 x - r.val)

    (p.1.val, WithLp.toLp 2 p.2)) (measurable_fst.edist measurable_snd) (by fun_prop)]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_resolvent_grid
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_spectra_gt_le_resolvent_grid
    {Ω n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A B : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (A ω).IsHermitian) (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (B ω).IsHermitian)
    (N : Finset ℝ) {η C δ ε : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : δ+(C+1)*ε/η^2 ≤ (2*η)⁻¹) :
    μ.real {ω | 2*C*η < Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A ω)) (spectrum ℝ (B ω))} ≤
      μ.real {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε} +
      μ.real {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε} +
      ∑ u ∈ N, μ.real {ω |
        C*specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ <
          specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)) ∨
        C*specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ <
          specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Set Ω := {ω | 2*C*η <
    Metric.hausdorffDist (spectrum ℝ (A ω)) (spectrum ℝ (B ω))}
  let L : Set Ω := {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε}
  let K : Set Ω := {ω | ¬ ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε}
  let E (u : ℝ) : Set Ω := {ω |
    C*specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ <
      specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I)) ∨
    C*specNorm (resolvent (A ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))+δ <
      specNorm (resolvent (B ω) ((u : ℂ)+(η : ℂ)*Complex.I))}
  have hsub : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ F → ω ∈ (L ∪ K) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, E u := by
    filter_upwards [hA, hB] with ω hωA hωB
    intro hf
    by_cases hcoverA : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (A ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
    · by_cases hcoverB : ∀ ξ ∈ spectrum ℝ (B ω), ∃ u ∈ N, |ξ-u| ≤ ε
      · by_cases hbad : ∃ u ∈ N, ω ∈ E u
        · obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hbad
          exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem u (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hu he))
        · have hpoint (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ N) : ω ∉ E u := fun hh => hbad ⟨u,hu,hh⟩
          have hforward := forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
            hωA hωB (N : Set ℝ) hη hC hcoverA (fun u hu =>
              le_of_not_gt (fun hh => hpoint u hu (Or.inl hh))) herror
          have hreverse := forall_exists_mem_spectrum_dist_le_of_resolvent_net
            hωB hωA (N : Set ℝ) hη hC hcoverB (fun u hu =>
              le_of_not_gt (fun hh => hpoint u hu (Or.inr hh))) herror
          exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge (Metric.hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC) hη.le) hforward hreverse) hf)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hcoverB)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hcoverA)
  have hm : μ.real F ≤ μ.real ((L ∪ K) ∪ ⋃ u ∈ N, E u) :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) (measure_mono_ae hsub)
  exact hm.trans ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans
    (add_le_add (measureReal_union_le _ _)
      (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le N E)))

name: NLAlib.sum_range_add_one_inv_sq_add_sq_le
statement:
private theorem sum_range_add_one_inv_sq_add_sq_le (M : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∑ k ∈ range M, (c^2+((k+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2)⁻¹) ≤ π/(2*c)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ => (c^2+x^2)⁻¹) (Icc 0 (M : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
    nlinarith [hx.1,hy.1]
  have hi := AntitoneOn.sum_le_integral (f := fun x : ℝ => (c^2+x^2)⁻¹)
    (a := M) (x₀ := 0) (by simpa using ha)
  simp only [zero_add] at hi
  apply hi.trans
  rw [integral_inv_sq_add_sq hc.ne',zero_div,arctan_zero,sub_zero]
  have h := arctan_lt_pi_div_two ((M : ℝ)/c)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
  convert hmul using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_range_add_one_inv_sq_le
statement:
private theorem sum_range_add_one_inv_sq_le (M : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range M, (((j+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2)⁻¹) ≤ π^2/6
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_zeta_two.summable.sum_le_tsum (range (M+1)) (fun _ _ => by positivity)
  rw [hasSum_zeta_two.tsum_eq,Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h
  simpa only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),div_zero,zero_add,add_zero,one_div] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_tensor_lattice_eq_square
proof:
:= by
  let s := Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 2 => range (M+1))
  have hzero : (0 : Fin 2 → ℕ) ∈ s := Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr (fun _ => by simp)
  have herase := s.sum_erase_add (fun α => (tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)⁻¹) hzero
  have he : (∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,(tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)⁻¹) =
      ∑ α ∈ s,(tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [tensorChebyshevMomentIndices,s,tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq,
      Pi.zero_apply,Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),
      Finset.sum_const_zero,inv_zero,add_zero] using herase
  rw [he,← Finset.sum_product (f := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => ((p.1 : ℝ)^2+(p.2 : ℝ)^2)⁻¹)]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun α _ => (α 0,α 1))
  · intro α hα
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hα 0,Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hα 1⟩
  · intro α hα β hβ hab
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact congrArg Prod.fst hab
    · exact congrArg Prod.snd hab
  · intro p hp
    refine ⟨![p.1,p.2],?_,?_⟩
    · apply Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1
      · exact (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2
    · simp
  · intro α _
    simp [tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq,Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: NLAlib.sum_square_inv_eq_axes_add_interior
statement:
private theorem sum_square_inv_eq_axes_add_interior (M : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (M+1),∑ k ∈ range (M+1),((j : ℝ)^2+(k : ℝ)^2)⁻¹) =
      2*(∑ j ∈ range M,(((j+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2)⁻¹) +
      ∑ j ∈ range M,∑ k ∈ range M,
        ((((j+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2+((k+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),zero_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),inv_zero]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_range_succ',Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_inv_tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq_le {M : ℕ} (_hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    (∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,(tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)⁻¹) ≤
      5+(π/2)*log M
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_tensor_lattice_eq_square,sum_square_inv_eq_axes_add_interior]
  have hrows : (∑ j ∈ range M,∑ k ∈ range M,
      ((((j+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2+((k+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2))⁻¹) ≤ (π/2)*(harmonic M : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range M,π/(2*((j+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Finset.sum_le_sum
        (fun j _ => sum_range_add_one_inv_sq_add_sq_le M (by positivity))
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [harmonic,Rat.cast_sum,Rat.cast_inv,Rat.cast_natCast,Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        push_cast
        field_simp
  have haxes := sum_range_add_one_inv_sq_le M
  have hh := harmonic_le_one_add_log M
  have hp : π^2/3+π/2 ≤ 5 := by nlinarith [pi_pos,pi_lt_d2]
  have hlog := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (by positivity : 0 ≤ π/2)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.tensorChebyshevMomentError_le_of_discrepancy_le
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevMomentError_le_of_discrepancy_le
    (μ ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hcoord : ∀ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,
      |tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α| ≤ R) :
    tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν M ≤ R*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 ≤ 5+(π/2)*log M := by
    have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM
    have hl := log_nonneg hm
    positivity
  have he : tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν M ^ 2 ≤ R^2*(5+(π/2)*log M) := by
    rw [tensorChebyshevMomentError_sq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,R^2*(tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)⁻¹ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro α hα
        have hsq : tensorChebyshevMomentDiscrepancy μ ν α ^ 2 ≤ R^2 := by
          have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hcoord α hα)
          simpa only [sq_abs] using h
        exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsq (by
          unfold tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq
          positivity)).trans_eq (by ring)
      _ = R^2*∑ α ∈ tensorChebyshevMomentIndices 2 M,(tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq α)⁻¹ :=
        (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_inv_tensorChebyshevIndexNormSq_le hM) (sq_nonneg R)
  have hroot : (R*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M))^2 = R^2*(5+(π/2)*log M) := by
    rw [mul_pow,sq_sqrt hL]
  have hnon : 0 ≤ tensorChebyshevMomentError μ ν M := sqrt_nonneg _
  have hright : 0 ≤ R*sqrt (5+(π/2)*log M) := mul_nonneg hR (sqrt_nonneg _)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.ofReal_exp_neg_sq_le_gaussianReal_abs_gt
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) ≤ 3 := by
    have h := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)
    nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_four]
  have hi : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [one_div] using
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)) hs
  have hpdf : ∀ u ∈ Ioc x (x + 1),
      (1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(x + 1) ^ 2 / 2) ≤ gaussianPDFReal 0 1 u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [gaussianPDFReal_def]
    simp only [NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
    have he : Real.exp (-(x + 1) ^ 2 / 2) ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith [hu.1, hu.2]
    exact mul_le_mul hi he (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ _ in Ioc x (x + 1),
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(x + 1) ^ 2 / 2)) := by
          simp [Real.volume_Ioc]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ u in Ioc x (x + 1), gaussianPDF 0 1 u := by
      exact setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioc fun u hu =>
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hpdf u hu)
    _ = gaussianReal 0 1 (Ioc x (x + 1)) :=
      (gaussianReal_apply 0 (by norm_num : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0) _).symm
    _ ≤ _ := measure_mono fun u hu => hu.1.trans_le (le_abs_self u)

name: NLAlib.two_mul_exp_neg_four_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
  have h8 : (8 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 3 := by
    rw [show (3 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 + 1 by norm_num, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (1 : ℝ)]
  have he : (6 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((7 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + 1) ^ 2) := by
    refine (by linarith : (6 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 3).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
  have hid : Real.exp (-(x + 1) ^ 2 / 2) =
      Real.exp (-4 * (x + 1) ^ 2) * Real.exp ((7 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + 1) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hid]
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-4 * (x + 1) ^ 2)]

name: NLAlib.measure_abs_gt_le_of_lintegral_exp_sq
statement:
theorem measure_abs_gt_le_of_lintegral_exp_sq {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ {ω | t < |X ω|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(t / K) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have he : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((t / K) ^ 2)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsub : {ω | t < |X ω|} ⊆
      {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((t / K) ^ 2)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2))} := by
    intro ω hω
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have h : t / K ≤ |X ω| / K := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hω.le hK.le
    rw [show |X ω| / K = |X ω / K| by rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hK]] at h
    nlinarith [sq_abs (X ω / K), div_nonneg ht hK.le, abs_nonneg (X ω / K)]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((t / K) ^ 2)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2))} := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)) ∂μ) /
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((t / K) ^ 2)) :=
      meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (by fun_prop) he ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    _ ≤ 2 / ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((t / K) ^ 2)) :=
      ENNReal.div_le_div_right hpsi _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat, ← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
        div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg]

name: NLAlib.measure_abs_gt_le_gaussian_shift_of_lintegral_exp_sq
statement:
theorem measure_abs_gt_le_gaussian_shift_of_lintegral_exp_sq
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / (2 * K)) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) :
    μ {ω | t < |X ω|} ≤
      gaussianReal 0 1 {g : ℝ | t < 4 * K * (1 + |g|)}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t < 4 * K
  · have he : {g : ℝ | t < 4 * K * (1 + |g|)} = univ := by
      ext g
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_univ, iff_true]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg g]
    rw [he, measure_univ]
    exact prob_le_one
  · have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by linarith
    let x := t / (4 * K) - 1
    have hx : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; rw [sub_nonneg, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
    have hxid : t / (2 * K) = 2 * (x + 1) := by dsimp [x]; field_simp; ring
    have he : {g : ℝ | x < |g|} = {g : ℝ | t < 4 * K * (1 + |g|)} := by
      ext g
      dsimp [x]
      constructor <;> intro h
      · have hh : t / (4 * K) < 1 + |g| := by linarith
        have hh' := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * K)).mp hh
        nlinarith
      · have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * K)).mpr
          (show t < (1 + |g|) * (4 * K) by nlinarith)
        linarith
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(t / (2 * K)) ^ 2)) :=
        measure_abs_gt_le_of_lintegral_exp_sq hX (by positivity) hpsi ht0
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-4 * (x + 1) ^ 2)) := by
        have hpow : -(2 * (x + 1)) ^ 2 = -4 * (x + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [hxid, hpow]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(x + 1) ^ 2 / 2)) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (two_mul_exp_neg_four_sq_le hx)
      _ ≤ gaussianReal 0 1 {g : ℝ | x < |g|} := ofReal_exp_neg_sq_le_gaussianReal_abs_gt hx
      _ = _ := congrArg (gaussianReal 0 1) he

name: NLAlib.lintegral_exp_sub_sq_le_two
statement:
theorem lintegral_exp_sub_sq_le_two {ν : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν ≤ 2) :
    (∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (((p.1 - p.2) / (2 * K)) ^ 2))
      ∂ν.prod ν) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp (x y : ℝ) : Real.exp (((x - y) / (2 * K)) ^ 2) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2) + Real.exp ((y / K) ^ 2)) := by
    have hsq : ((x - y) / (2 * K)) ^ 2 ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (x / K) ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (y / K) ^ 2 := by
      have hid : (x - y) / (2 * K) = ((x / K) - (y / K)) / 2 := by ring
      rw [hid]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x / K + y / K)]
    have hc := convexOn_exp.2 (mem_univ ((x / K) ^ 2)) (mem_univ ((y / K) ^ 2))
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = 1)
    refine (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hsq).trans ?_
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_add] using hc
  have hfst : (∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((p.1 / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν.prod ν) =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν := by
    rw [lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
    simp
  have hsnd : (∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((p.2 / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν.prod ν) =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν := by
    rw [lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
    simp
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((p.1 / K) ^ 2)) +
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((p.2 / K) ^ 2))) ∂ν.prod ν := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro p
      dsimp only
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hp p.1 p.2)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ((∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν) +
          ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν) := by
      rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (by fun_prop), lintegral_add_left (by fun_prop), hfst, hsnd]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (2 + 2) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 := by
      norm_num [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos]
      rw [show (4 : ℝ≥0∞) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, ← mul_assoc,
        ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by norm_num) (by simp), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.gaussianHalfMeanProbability_pos
statement:
theorem gaussianHalfMeanProbability_pos {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    0 < gaussianHalfMeanProbability κ
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianHalfMeanProbability
  have h := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr
    (neg_neg_of_pos (show 0 < κ ^ 2 / 16 by positivity))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.le_gaussianTailComparisonConstant
statement:
theorem le_gaussianTailComparisonConstant {A κ c : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hc : 0 < c) : A ≤ gaussianTailComparisonConstant A κ c
proof:
:= by
  have hδ := inv_nonneg.mpr (gaussianHalfMeanProbability_pos hκ).le
  have hci := inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le
  unfold gaussianTailComparisonConstant
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gaussianHalfMeanProbability_le_measure_ge_half_mean
statement:
theorem gaussianHalfMeanProbability_le_measure_ge_half_mean
    {Y : Ω → ℝ} {m κ : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => Y ω - ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ)
    (hmean : κ * m ≤ ∫ y, Y y ∂μ) :
    gaussianHalfMeanProbability κ ≤ μ.real {ω | (∫ y, Y y ∂μ) / 2 ≤ Y ω}
proof:
:= by
  let a := ∫ y, Y y ∂μ
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hκ hm) hmean
  have hYm : AEMeasurable Y μ := by
    convert h.aemeasurable.add_const a using 1
    funext ω
    dsimp [a]
    ring
  have htail := h.neg.measure_ge_le (show 0 ≤ a / 2 by positivity)
  have hmono : μ.real {ω | Y ω < a / 2} ≤
      μ.real {ω | a / 2 ≤ -(Y ω - a)} :=
    measureReal_mono (fun ω hω => by dsimp at hω ⊢; linarith) (by finiteness)
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(a / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * m ^ 2))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(κ ^ 2 / 16)) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt (mul_pos hκ hm)) hmean 2
    dsimp [a] at *
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 2 * (2 * m ^ 2) by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith [hsq]
  have hbad : μ.real {ω | Y ω < a / 2} ≤ Real.exp (-(κ ^ 2 / 16)) :=
    hmono.trans (htail.trans hexp)
  have hcomp := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl₀
    (nullMeasurableSet_le aemeasurable_const hYm :
      NullMeasurableSet {ω | a / 2 ≤ Y ω} μ)
  have heq : {ω | a / 2 ≤ Y ω}ᶜ = {ω | Y ω < a / 2} := by ext ω; simp
  rw [heq, probReal_univ] at hcomp
  unfold gaussianHalfMeanProbability
  change 1 - Real.exp (-(κ ^ 2 / 16)) ≤ μ.real {ω | a / 2 ≤ Y ω}
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measure_ge_le_mul_measure_ge_div_of_gaussian_concentration
statement:
theorem measure_ge_le_mul_measure_ge_div_of_gaussian_concentration
    {X Y : Ω → ℝ} {A κ c m : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => Y ω - ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ)
    (hmean : (∫ y, X y ∂μ) ≤ A * ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
    (hscale : κ * m ≤ ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
    (hlower : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → c * Real.exp (-(u / m) ^ 2) ≤ μ.real {ω | u ≤ Y ω})
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} ≤ gaussianTailComparisonConstant A κ c *
      μ.real {ω | t / gaussianTailComparisonConstant A κ c ≤ Y ω}
proof:
:= by
  let C := gaussianTailComparisonConstant A κ c
  let a := ∫ y, Y y ∂μ
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hκ hm) hscale
  have hδ := gaussianHalfMeanProbability_pos hκ
  have hAi : 0 ≤ 4 * A := by positivity
  have hCi : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le
  have hδi : 0 ≤ (gaussianHalfMeanProbability κ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hδ.le
  have hC4 : 4 ≤ C := by dsimp [C, gaussianTailComparisonConstant]; linarith
  have hCA : 4 * A ≤ C := by dsimp [C, gaussianTailComparisonConstant]; linarith
  have hCδ : (gaussianHalfMeanProbability κ)⁻¹ ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C, gaussianTailComparisonConstant]; linarith
  have hCc : c⁻¹ ≤ C := by dsimp [C, gaussianTailComparisonConstant]; linarith
  have hC : 0 < C := by linarith
  change μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} ≤ C * μ.real {ω | t / C ≤ Y ω}
  by_cases hsmall : t ≤ 2 * A * a
  · have hthresh : t / C ≤ a / 2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hC).mpr
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCA ha.le]
    have hhalf := gaussianHalfMeanProbability_le_measure_ge_half_mean hm hκ hY hscale
    have hmono : μ.real {ω | a / 2 ≤ Y ω} ≤ μ.real {ω | t / C ≤ Y ω} :=
      measureReal_mono (fun ω hω => hthresh.trans hω) (by finiteness)
    have hprod : 1 ≤ C * gaussianHalfMeanProbability κ := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCδ hδ.le
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hδ.ne'] at hh
      exact hh
    exact measureReal_le_one.trans (hprod.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hhalf.trans hmono) hC.le))
  · have hlarge : 2 * A * a ≤ t := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hsmall)
    have hcenter : t / 2 ≤ t - ∫ y, X y ∂μ := by dsimp [a] at hlarge; linarith
    have hmono : μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t / 2 ≤ X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ} :=
      measureReal_mono (fun ω hω => by dsimp at hω ⊢; linarith) (by finiteness)
    have hupper := hmono.trans (hX.measure_ge_le (show 0 ≤ t / 2 by positivity))
    have hexp : Real.exp (-(t / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * m ^ 2))) ≤
        Real.exp (-((t / C) / m) ^ 2) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hC2 : 16 ≤ C ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [show -(t / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * m ^ 2)) = -(t ^ 2 / (16 * m ^ 2)) by ring,
        show -((t / C) / m) ^ 2 = -(t ^ 2 / (C ^ 2 * m ^ 2)) by ring]
      exact neg_le_neg (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg t)
        (by positivity) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC2 (sq_nonneg m)))
    have hlow := hlower (t / C) (div_nonneg ht hC.le)
    have hprod : 1 ≤ C * c := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCc hc.le
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne'] at hh
      exact hh
    apply hupper.trans (hexp.trans ?_)
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod (Real.exp_pos (-((t / C) / m) ^ 2)).le
    have hh' : Real.exp (-((t / C) / m) ^ 2) ≤
        C * (c * Real.exp (-((t / C) / m) ^ 2)) := by
      simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using hh
    exact hh'.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hC.le)

name: NLAlib.memLp_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem memLp_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) c μ) (q : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp X q μ
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (h.memLp q).add (memLp_const (∫ y, X y ∂μ))
  have heq : ((fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) + fun _ => ∫ y, X y ∂μ) = X := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rwa [heq] at hh

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_ofReal_le_integral_add_two_mul_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem lpNorm_ofReal_le_integral_add_two_mul_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) c μ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    lpNorm X (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ ≤ (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) + 2 * Real.sqrt ((c : ℝ) * p)
proof:
:= by
  let k := ⌈p / 2⌉₊
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < k := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hlo : p ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ) := by
    have hh := Nat.le_ceil (p / 2)
    dsimp [k]
    linarith
  have hhi : (k : ℝ) ≤ p := by
    have hh := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity : 0 ≤ p / 2)
    dsimp [k]
    linarith
  have hMq : MemLp X (2 * (k : ℝ≥0∞)) μ := by
    have hh := memLp_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF h (2 * (k : ℝ≥0))
    simpa using hh
  have hexp : ENNReal.ofReal p ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (k : ℝ)) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hlo
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hmono := ENNReal.toReal_mono hMq.eLpNorm_ne_top
    (eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le hexp hMq.aestronglyMeasurable)
  rw [toReal_eLpNorm hMq.aestronglyMeasurable,
    toReal_eLpNorm hMq.aestronglyMeasurable] at hmono
  apply (hmono.trans (lpNorm_le_integral_add_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF hX h hk)).trans
  refine add_le_add le_rfl ?_
  calc
    Real.sqrt (4 * (c : ℝ) * k) ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * ((c : ℝ) * p)) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by
        simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi
          (show 0 ≤ 4 * (c : ℝ) from by positivity))
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4),
      show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_mono
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_mono {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {c d : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) (hcd : (c : ℝ) ≤ d) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF X d μ where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= h.integrable_exp_mul t
  mgf_le t := by
    have hmul : (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) * t ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcd (sq_nonneg t)
    calc
      mgf X μ t ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) := h.mgf_le t
      _ ≤ exp ((d : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
          exact exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_finset_sum_mul_of_iIndepFun
proof:
:= by
  have hind_mul :
      iIndepFun (fun i => fun ω => a i * X i ω) μ := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hind.comp (fun i x => a i * x) (fun i => by fun_prop)
  have hmgf_mul :
      ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => a i * X i ω)
      (Real.toNNReal (a i ^ 2) * c i) μ := by
    intro i hi
    convert (hmgf i hi).const_mul (a i) using 1
    rw [Real.toNNReal_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a i))]
    rfl
  exact HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hind_mul hmgf_mul

name: NLAlib.integral_le_one_div_mul_log_integral_exp_mul
statement:
theorem integral_le_one_div_mul_log_integral_exp_mul {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX_int : Integrable X μ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hexpX_int : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 / t) * log (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (convexOn_exp.map_integral_le continuous_exp.continuousOn isClosed_univ
    (by simp) (hX_int.const_mul t) hexpX_int)
  have h1 : ∫ ω, t * X ω ∂μ = t * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ := integral_const_mul t X
  have h2 : t * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ log (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) := by
    have hexp_bound : exp (t * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ := h1 ▸ h
    calc
      t * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = log (exp (t * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ)) := (log_exp _).symm
      _ ≤ log (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) :=
        log_le_log (exp_pos _) hexp_bound
  calc
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) * t / t := by
      calc
        ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) * 1 := by ring
        _ = (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) * (t / t) := by rw [div_self ht.ne']
        _ = (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) * t / t := by ring
    _ ≤ log (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) / t := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) ht.le
    _ = (1 / t) * log (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_nonpos_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_nonpos_of_hasSubgaussianMGF {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_
  set t : ℝ := ε / ((c : ℝ) + 1) with ht_def
  have hden_pos : 0 < (c : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    rw [ht_def]
    positivity
  have hmean := integral_le_one_div_mul_log_integral_exp_mul h.integrable ht_pos
    (h.integrable_exp_mul t)
  have hmgf_pos : 0 < mgf X μ t := mgf_pos (h.integrable_exp_mul t)
  have hlog_le : log (mgf X μ t) ≤ (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2 := by
    calc
      log (mgf X μ t) ≤ log (exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2)) :=
        log_le_log hmgf_pos (h.mgf_le t)
      _ = (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2 := log_exp _
  have hmean_le : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 / t) * ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) :=
    hmean.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le (by positivity))
  calc
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 / t) * ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) := hmean_le
    _ = (c : ℝ) * t / 2 := by field_simp [ht_pos.ne']
    _ ≤ ε := by
      rw [ht_def]
      have hratio : (c : ℝ) / ((c : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 :=
        (div_le_one hden_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      calc
        (c : ℝ) * (ε / ((c : ℝ) + 1)) / 2 =
            (ε / 2) * ((c : ℝ) / ((c : ℝ) + 1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (ε / 2) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio (by positivity)
        _ ≤ ε := by linarith
    _ = 0 + ε := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ 0 := integral_nonpos_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h
  have hle_neg : ∫ ω, -X ω ∂μ ≤ 0 := integral_nonpos_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h.neg
  have hge : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_neg] at hle_neg
    linarith
  exact le_antisymm hle hge

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero hY_meas
    (hY_bound.mono fun ω hω => abs_le.mp hω) hY_center
  have hc : ((‖R - -R‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) = ⟨R ^ 2, sq_nonneg R⟩ := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simp only [NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_div, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_neg_eq_add,
      NNReal.coe_ofNat]
    rw [← two_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hR]
    norm_num
    rfl
  rw [← hc]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_cosh_mul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_cosh_mul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) (t : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, cosh (t * X ω) ∂μ ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hint_pos : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
    h.integrable_exp_mul t
  have hint_neg : Integrable (fun ω => exp (-(t * X ω))) μ := by
    convert h.integrable_exp_mul (-t) using 1
    ext ω
    ring_nf
  have h_eq :
      ∫ ω, cosh (t * X ω) ∂μ =
        (mgf X μ t + mgf X μ (-t)) / 2 := by
    calc ∫ ω, cosh (t * X ω) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, (exp (t * X ω) + exp (-(t * X ω))) / 2 ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with ω
          rw [Real.cosh_eq]
      _ = (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) + exp (-(t * X ω)) ∂μ) / 2 := by
          rw [integral_div]
      _ = (mgf X μ t + mgf X μ (-t)) / 2 := by
          rw [integral_add hint_pos hint_neg]
          change (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ + ∫ ω, exp (-(t * X ω)) ∂μ) / 2 =
            (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ + ∫ ω, exp (-t * X ω) ∂μ) / 2
          simp only [neg_mul]
  rw [h_eq]
  have hpos_le : mgf X μ t ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) :=
    h.mgf_le t
  have hneg_le : mgf X μ (-t) ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    simpa [sq] using h.mgf_le (-t)
  nlinarith [hpos_le, hneg_le]

name: NLAlib.integral_even_taylor_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  have hint_pos : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
    h.integrable_exp_mul t
  have hint_neg : Integrable (fun ω => exp (-(t * X ω))) μ := by
    convert h.integrable_exp_mul (-t) using 1
    ext ω
    ring_nf
  have hterm_int :
      Integrable (fun ω => (t * X ω) ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ)) μ := by
    have hpow :
        Integrable (fun ω => (t * X ω) ^ (2 * m)) μ := by
      exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul
        (X := fun ω => t * X ω) (t := 1) one_ne_zero
        (by
          convert hint_pos using 1
          ext ω
          ring_nf)
        (by
          convert hint_neg using 1
          ext ω
          ring_nf)
        (2 * m)
    exact hpow.div_const _
  have hcosh_int : Integrable (fun ω => cosh (t * X ω)) μ := by
    have hsum : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω) + exp (-(t * X ω))) μ :=
      hint_pos.add hint_neg
    convert hsum.div_const 2 using 1
    ext ω
    rw [Real.cosh_eq]
  calc ∫ ω, (t * X ω) ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) ∂μ
      ≤ ∫ ω, cosh (t * X ω) ∂μ := by
        exact integral_mono_ae hterm_int hcosh_int
          (ae_of_all _ fun ω => cosh_taylor_term_le (t * X ω) m)
    _ ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) :=
        integral_cosh_mul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h t

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_two_mul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  have hle := integral_even_taylor_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h s m
  have hscale :
      ∫ ω, (s * X ω) ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) ∂μ =
        (s ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ)) *
          ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
    calc ∫ ω, (s * X ω) ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, (s ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ)) *
            X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with ω
          rw [mul_pow]
          ring
      _ = (s ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ)) *
          ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hscale] at hle
  have hcoef_pos :
      0 < s ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have hbound :
      ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ
        ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * s ^ 2 / 2) /
          (s ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcoef_pos]
    nlinarith [hle]
  calc ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ
      ≤ exp ((c : ℝ) * s ^ 2 / 2) /
          (s ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ)) := hbound
    _ = (Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / s ^ (2 * m) *
        exp ((c : ℝ) * s ^ 2 / 2) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hs, Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * m))]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((c : ℝ) + 1)
  let s : ℝ := sqrt q
  have hc1_pos : 0 < (c : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hq_pos : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := hq_pos.le
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := by
    dsimp [s]
    exact sqrt_pos.mpr hq_pos
  have hs_pow : s ^ (2 * m) = q ^ m := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [pow_mul, sq_sqrt hq_nonneg]
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [sq_sqrt hq_nonneg]
  have hmoment := integral_pow_two_mul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h hs_pos m
  have hterm_eq :
      ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ =
        (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
    calc ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with ω
          field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)]
      _ = (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hterm_eq]
  have hcoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  calc (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ
      ≤ (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) *
          ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / s ^ (2 * m) *
            exp ((c : ℝ) * s ^ 2 / 2)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment hcoef_nonneg
    _ = θ ^ m *
          (((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m) *
            exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2) := by
        rw [hs_pow, hs_sq]
        field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)]
    _ ≤ θ ^ m * (((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m) * exp (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
        have hfac := factorial_two_mul_div_factorial_le_succ_pow m
        have hratio :
            ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m
              ≤ ((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m := by
          have hnum_pos : 0 < (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m) := by positivity
          have hc1pow_nonneg : 0 ≤ ((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m := by positivity
          calc
            ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m
                = ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) *
                  (((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m / (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m)) := by
                    dsimp [q]
                    rw [div_pow]
                    field_simp [hc1_pos.ne']
            _ ≤ (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m) *
                  (((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m / (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m)) := by
                    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfac
                      (div_nonneg hc1pow_nonneg hnum_pos.le)
            _ = ((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m := by
                    field_simp [ne_of_gt hnum_pos]
        have hexp_le : exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2) ≤ exp (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
          apply exp_le_exp.mpr
          have hc_le : (c : ℝ) / ((c : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
            rw [div_le_one hc1_pos]
            linarith
          have hnon : 0 ≤ ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
          calc
            (c : ℝ) * q / 2 =
                ((c : ℝ) / ((c : ℝ) + 1)) * (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) := by
                  dsimp [q]
                  field_simp [hc1_pos.ne']
            _ ≤ 1 * (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_le hnon
            _ ≤ (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
                norm_num
                nlinarith
        calc
          θ ^ m * (((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m) *
              exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2)
              ≤ θ ^ m * ((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2) := by
                gcongr
          _ ≤ θ ^ m * ((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * exp (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
                gcongr
    _ = exp 1 * (θ * ((c : ℝ) + 1) * exp 1) ^ m := by
        rw [show (m + 1 : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) + 1 by norm_num, exp_add]
        rw [show exp (m : ℝ) = exp 1 ^ m by
          rw [show (m : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) * 1 by ring, Real.exp_nat_mul]]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]
        ring

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / C0
  let s : ℝ := sqrt q
  have hq_pos : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := hq_pos.le
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := by
    dsimp [s]
    exact sqrt_pos.mpr hq_pos
  have hs_pow : s ^ (2 * m) = q ^ m := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [pow_mul, sq_sqrt hq_nonneg]
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [sq_sqrt hq_nonneg]
  have hmoment := integral_pow_two_mul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h hs_pos m
  have hterm_eq :
      ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ =
        (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
    calc ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with ω
          field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)]
      _ = (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hterm_eq]
  have hcoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  calc (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * m) ∂μ
      ≤ (θ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) *
          ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / s ^ (2 * m) *
            exp ((c : ℝ) * s ^ 2 / 2)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment hcoef_nonneg
    _ = θ ^ m *
          (((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m) *
            exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2) := by
        rw [hs_pow, hs_sq]
        field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)]
    _ ≤ θ ^ m * C0 ^ m * exp (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
        have hfac := factorial_two_mul_div_factorial_le_succ_pow m
        have hratio :
            ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m
              ≤ C0 ^ m := by
          have hnum_pos : 0 < (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m) := by positivity
          have hC0pow_nonneg : 0 ≤ C0 ^ m := by positivity
          calc
            ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m
                = ((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) *
                  (C0 ^ m / (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m)) := by
                    dsimp [q]
                    rw [div_pow]
                    field_simp [hC0.ne']
            _ ≤ (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m) *
                  (C0 ^ m / (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ m)) := by
                    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfac
                      (div_nonneg hC0pow_nonneg hnum_pos.le)
            _ = C0 ^ m := by
                    field_simp [ne_of_gt hnum_pos]
        have hexp_le : exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2) ≤ exp (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
          apply exp_le_exp.mpr
          have hc_div_le : (c : ℝ) / C0 ≤ 1 := by
            rw [div_le_one hC0]
            exact hc_le
          have hnon : 0 ≤ ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
          calc
            (c : ℝ) * q / 2 =
                ((c : ℝ) / C0) * (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) := by
                  dsimp [q]
                  field_simp [hC0.ne']
            _ ≤ 1 * (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_div_le hnon
            _ ≤ (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
                norm_num
                nlinarith
        calc
          θ ^ m * (((Nat.factorial (2 * m) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) / q ^ m) *
              exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2)
              ≤ θ ^ m * C0 ^ m * exp ((c : ℝ) * q / 2) := by
                gcongr
          _ ≤ θ ^ m * C0 ^ m * exp (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
                gcongr
    _ = exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ m := by
        rw [show (m + 1 : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) + 1 by norm_num, exp_add]
        rw [show exp (m : ℝ) = exp 1 ^ m by
          rw [show (m : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) * 1 by ring, Real.exp_nat_mul]]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]
        ring

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hterm :=
    integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h
      (θ := 1) (C0 := C0) (by norm_num) hC0 hc_le 1
  convert hterm using 1 <;> ring_nf

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_four_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hterm :=
    integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h
      (θ := 1) (C0 := C0) (by norm_num) hC0 hc_le 2
  have hfac : (Nat.factorial 2 : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num
  have hterm' : ∫ ω, X ω ^ 4 / 2 ∂μ ≤ exp 1 * (C0 * exp 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hfun :
        (fun ω : Ω => (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * X ω ^ (2 * 2) /
          (Nat.factorial 2 : ℝ)) =
          (fun ω : Ω => X ω ^ 4 / 2) := by
      funext ω
      norm_num [hfac]
    rw [hfun] at hterm
    simpa only [one_mul] using hterm
  have hscale : ∫ ω, X ω ^ 4 / 2 ∂μ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 4 ∂μ := by
    calc
      ∫ ω, X ω ^ 4 / 2 ∂μ = ∫ ω, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * X ω ^ 4 ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with ω
        ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 4 ∂μ := by rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hscale] at hterm'
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_centered_sq_le_exp_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_exp_centered_sq_le_exp_quadratic_nonneg {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) {θ C0 : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hc_le : (c : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_half : θ * C0 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) ∂μ ≤
      exp (2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  set m : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ with hm_def
  set r : ℝ := θ * C0 * exp 1 with hr_def
  have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ m := by
    rw [hm_def]
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω => sq_nonneg (X ω))
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
  have hr_half : r ≤ 1 / 2 := by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_half
  have hr_lt : r < 1 := by linarith
  have hsmall : θ * C0 * exp 1 < 1 := by simpa only [hr_def] using hr_lt
  have hbase :=
    integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_linear_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ
      hC0 hc_le hsmall
  have hcenter :
      ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - m)) ∂μ =
        exp (-θ * m) * ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
    calc
      ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - m)) ∂μ
          = ∫ ω, exp (-θ * m) * exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
            apply integral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards with ω
            rw [← exp_add]
            congr 1
            ring
      _ = exp (-θ * m) * ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
            rw [integral_const_mul]
  have htail_nonneg :
      0 ≤ exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
    have hden_pos : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
    positivity
  have hmul_base :
      exp (-θ * m) * ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤
        exp (-θ * m) *
          (1 + θ * m + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹)) := by
    rw [← hm_def] at hbase
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase (exp_nonneg _)
  have hmain :
      exp (-θ * m) *
          (1 + θ * m + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹))
        ≤ 1 + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
    have hexp_le_one : exp (-θ * m) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      nlinarith [hθ, hm_nonneg]
    have htail_mul :
        exp (-θ * m) * (exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹)) ≤
          exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
      calc
        exp (-θ * m) * (exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹))
            ≤ 1 * (exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹)) := by
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp_le_one htail_nonneg
        _ = exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by ring
    calc
      exp (-θ * m) *
          (1 + θ * m + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹))
          = exp (-(θ * m)) * (1 + θ * m) +
              exp (-θ * m) * (exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹)) := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ 1 + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) :=
          add_le_add (exp_neg_mul_one_add_le_one (θ * m)) htail_mul
  have htail_le :
      exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) ≤ 2 * exp 1 * r ^ 2 := by
    have hden_pos : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
    have hinv_le : (1 - r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ hden_pos two_pos]
      linarith
    have hmul : r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹ ≤ r ^ 2 * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv_le (sq_nonneg r)
    calc
      exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) ≤ exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (exp_pos 1).le
      _ = 2 * exp 1 * r ^ 2 := by ring
  calc
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - m)) ∂μ := by rw [hm_def]
    _ = exp (-θ * m) * ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := hcenter
    _ ≤ exp (-θ * m) *
          (1 + θ * m + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹)) := hmul_base
    _ ≤ 1 + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) := hmain
    _ ≤ 1 + 2 * exp 1 * r ^ 2 := by linarith
    _ ≤ exp (2 * exp 1 * r ^ 2) := by
      simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * exp 1 * r ^ 2)
    _ = exp (2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) := by rw [hr_def]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_centered_sq_le_exp_quadratic_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  set a : ℝ := -θ with ha_def
  set m : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ with hm_def
  set M4 : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ^ 4 ∂μ with hM4_def
  have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha_def]; linarith
  have hX2_int : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) μ := by
    exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul
      (X := X) (t := 1) one_ne_zero
      (h.integrable_exp_mul 1)
      (h.integrable_exp_mul (-1)) 2
  have hX4_int : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 4) μ := by
    exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul
      (X := X) (t := 1) one_ne_zero
      (h.integrable_exp_mul 1)
      (h.integrable_exp_mul (-1)) 4
  have hneg_int : Integrable (fun ω => exp (-a * X ω ^ 2)) μ := by
    exact Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX2_int.aemeasurable.const_mul (-a)).exp.aestronglyMeasurable) 1 (by
        filter_upwards with ω
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (exp_nonneg _)]
        rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr ha_nonneg) (sq_nonneg (X ω)))
  have hpoly_int :
      Integrable (fun ω => 1 - a * X ω ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4) μ :=
    ((integrable_const 1).sub (hX2_int.const_mul a)).add (hX4_int.const_mul (a ^ 2))
  have hneg_bound :
      ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ 1 - a * m + a ^ 2 * M4 := by
    have hpoint :
        (fun ω => exp (-a * X ω ^ 2)) ≤ᵐ[μ]
          fun ω => 1 - a * X ω ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4 := by
      filter_upwards with ω
      have hbasic := exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq
        (mul_nonneg ha_nonneg (sq_nonneg (X ω)))
      calc
        exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) = exp (-(a * X ω ^ 2)) := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ 1 - (a * X ω ^ 2) + (a * X ω ^ 2) ^ 2 := hbasic
        _ = 1 - a * X ω ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4 := by ring_nf
    calc
      ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ
          ≤ ∫ ω, 1 - a * X ω ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4 ∂μ :=
            integral_mono_ae hneg_int hpoly_int hpoint
      _ = 1 - a * m + a ^ 2 * M4 := by
        calc
          ∫ ω, 1 - a * X ω ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4 ∂μ
              = ∫ ω, (1 - a * X ω ^ 2) + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4 ∂μ := by rfl
          _ = ∫ ω, 1 - a * X ω ^ 2 ∂μ + ∫ ω, a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4 ∂μ := by
              rw [show (fun ω => (1 - a * X ω ^ 2) + a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4) =
                (fun ω => 1 - a * X ω ^ 2) + (fun ω => a ^ 2 * X ω ^ 4) by
                rfl]
              exact integral_add ((integrable_const 1).sub (hX2_int.const_mul a))
                (hX4_int.const_mul (a ^ 2))
          _ = (1 - a * m) + a ^ 2 * M4 := by
              rw [integral_sub (integrable_const 1) (hX2_int.const_mul a)]
              rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
              rw [hm_def, hM4_def]
              simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
          _ = 1 - a * m + a ^ 2 * M4 := by ring_nf
  have hcenter :
      ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - m)) ∂μ =
        exp (a * m) * ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
    calc
      ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - m)) ∂μ
          = ∫ ω, exp (a * m) * exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
            apply integral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards with ω
            rw [← exp_add]
            congr 1
            rw [ha_def]
            ring_nf
      _ = exp (a * m) * ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
            rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hM4_bound : M4 ≤ 2 * exp 1 * (C0 * exp 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hM4_def]
    exact integral_pow_four_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hC0 hc_le
  have hmgf_le_exp_M4 :
      exp (a * m) * ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ exp (a ^ 2 * M4) := by
    calc
      exp (a * m) * ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ
          ≤ exp (a * m) * (1 - a * m + a ^ 2 * M4) := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hneg_bound (exp_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ exp (a * m) * exp (-a * m + a ^ 2 * M4) := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (-a * m + a ^ 2 * M4)])
              (exp_nonneg _)
      _ = exp (a ^ 2 * M4) := by
            rw [← exp_add]
            ring_nf
  have hquad_le :
      a ^ 2 * M4 ≤ a ^ 2 * (2 * exp 1 * (C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM4_bound (sq_nonneg a)
  calc
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - m)) ∂μ := by rw [hm_def]
    _ = exp (a * m) * ∫ ω, exp (-a * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := hcenter
    _ ≤ exp (a ^ 2 * M4) := hmgf_le_exp_M4
    _ ≤ exp (a ^ 2 * (2 * exp 1 * (C0 * exp 1) ^ 2)) :=
        exp_le_exp.mpr hquad_le
    _ = exp (2 * exp 1 * ((-θ) * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) := by
        rw [ha_def]
        ring_nf

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_centered_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:= by
  set m : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ with hm_def
  rcases le_total 0 θ with hθ_nonneg | hθ_nonpos
  · have hsmall : θ * C0 * exp 1 < 1 := by
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg hθ_nonneg] using hθ_abs
    have hsq_int :=
      integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ_nonneg hC0 hc_le hsmall
    convert hsq_int.const_mul (exp (-θ * m)) using 1
    ext ω
    rw [← exp_add]
    rw [hm_def]
    ring_nf
  · set a : ℝ := -θ with ha_def
    have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha_def]; linarith
    have hX2_int : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) μ := by
      exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul
        (X := X) (t := 1) one_ne_zero
        (h.integrable_exp_mul 1)
        (h.integrable_exp_mul (-1)) 2
    have hneg_int : Integrable (fun ω => exp (-a * X ω ^ 2)) μ := by
      exact Integrable.of_bound
        ((hX2_int.aemeasurable.const_mul (-a)).exp.aestronglyMeasurable) 1 (by
          filter_upwards with ω
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (exp_nonneg _)]
          rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
          exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr ha_nonneg) (sq_nonneg (X ω)))
    convert hneg_int.const_mul (exp (a * m)) using 1
    ext ω
    rw [← exp_add]
    rw [hm_def, ha_def]
    ring_nf

name: NLAlib.centered_sq_cgf_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hθ_abs_lt : |θ| * C0 * exp 1 < 1 := by
    linarith
  have hint := integrable_exp_centered_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hC0 hc_le hθ_abs_lt
  have hmgf_pos :
      0 < mgf (fun ω => X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) μ θ :=
    mgf_pos hint
  have hmgf_le :
      mgf (fun ω => X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) μ θ ≤
        exp (2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) := by
    rcases le_total 0 θ with hθ_nonneg | hθ_nonpos
    · have hhalf : θ * C0 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hθ_nonneg] at hθ_abs
        exact hθ_abs
      change (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) ∂μ) ≤ _
      exact integral_exp_centered_sq_le_exp_quadratic_nonneg h hθ_nonneg hC0 hc_le hhalf
    · have hbound :=
        integral_exp_centered_sq_le_exp_quadratic_nonpos h hθ_nonpos hC0 hc_le
      calc
        mgf (fun ω => X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) μ θ
            ≤ exp (2 * exp 1 * ((-θ) * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) := by
              change (∫ ω, exp (θ * (X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) ∂μ) ≤ _
              exact hbound
        _ = exp (2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) := by ring_nf
  calc
    cgf (fun ω => X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) μ θ
        = log (mgf (fun ω => X ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) μ θ) := rfl
    _ ≤ log (exp (2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2)) :=
        log_le_log hmgf_pos hmgf_le
    _ = 2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2 := by rw [log_exp]

name: NLAlib.cgf_const_mul
statement:
theorem cgf_const_mul {μ : Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → ℝ} (a θ : ℝ) :
    cgf (fun ω => a * Y ω) μ θ = cgf Y μ (a * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cgf, cgf, mgf_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.iIndepFun_centered_sq
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    hind.comp
      (fun i x => x ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X i ω ^ 2 ∂μ)
      (fun _ => by fun_prop)

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
    {νX νY : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure νX] [IsProbabilityMeasure νY]
    {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF id cX νX)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF id cY νY) {C0 θ : ℝ}
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hcX : (cX : ℝ) ≤ C0) (hcY : (cY : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_half : (C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * C0 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => exp (θ * p.2 * p.1)) (νY.prod νX)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => exp (θ * p.2 * p.1)
  have hf_aesm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (νY.prod νX) := by
    dsimp [f]
    fun_prop
  rw [integrable_prod_iff hf_aesm]
  constructor
  · filter_upwards with y
    have hinner := hX.integrable_exp_mul (θ * y)
    convert hinner using 1
    ext x
    dsimp [f]
    ring_nf
  · have hθ2_nonneg : 0 ≤ C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
    have hbound_int :
        Integrable (fun y : ℝ => exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2)) νY :=
      integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le hY hθ2_nonneg hC0 hcY (by
        linarith [hθ_half])
    refine Integrable.mono' hbound_int ?_ ?_
    · exact hf_aesm.norm.integral_prod_right'
    · filter_upwards with y
      have hinner_eq :
          ∫ x, ‖f (y, x)‖ ∂νX = mgf id νX (θ * y) := by
        unfold mgf
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with x
        dsimp [f]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (exp_nonneg _)]
        ring_nf
      have hmgf := hX.mgf_le (θ * y)
      have hquad_le :
          (cX : ℝ) * (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ C0 * θ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 / 2 := by
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
        calc
          (cX : ℝ) * (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2 =
              (cX : ℝ) * ((θ * y) ^ 2 / 2) := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ C0 * ((θ * y) ^ 2 / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcX hnonneg
          _ = C0 * θ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 / 2 := by ring_nf
      have hle :
          ∫ x, ‖f (y, x)‖ ∂νX ≤ exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2) := by
        rw [hinner_eq]
        calc
          mgf id νX (θ * y) ≤ exp ((cX : ℝ) * (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2) := hmgf
          _ ≤ exp (C0 * θ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 / 2) := exp_le_exp.mpr hquad_le
          _ = exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2) := by ring_nf
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ?_]
      · exact hle
      · exact integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
    {νX νY : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure νX] [IsProbabilityMeasure νY]
    {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF id cX νX)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF id cY νY) {C0 θ : ℝ}
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hcX : (cX : ℝ) ≤ C0) (hcY : (cY : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_half : (C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * C0 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, exp (θ * p.2 * p.1) ∂(νY.prod νX) ≤
      exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * C0 ^ 2 * θ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => exp (θ * p.2 * p.1)
  have hf_int :
      Integrable f (νY.prod νX) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
      hX hY hC0 hcX hcY hθ_half
  have hθ2_nonneg : 0 ≤ C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  have hbound_int :
      Integrable (fun y : ℝ => exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2)) νY :=
    integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le hY hθ2_nonneg hC0 hcY (by
      linarith [hθ_half])
  have houter_bound :
      (fun y : ℝ => ∫ x, f (y, x) ∂νX) ≤ᵐ[νY]
        fun y : ℝ => exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards with y
    have hinner_eq :
        ∫ x, f (y, x) ∂νX = mgf id νX (θ * y) := by
      unfold mgf
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      dsimp [f]
      ring_nf
    have hmgf := hX.mgf_le (θ * y)
    have hquad_le :
        (cX : ℝ) * (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ C0 * θ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 / 2 := by
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
      calc
        (cX : ℝ) * (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2 =
            (cX : ℝ) * ((θ * y) ^ 2 / 2) := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ C0 * ((θ * y) ^ 2 / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcX hnonneg
        _ = C0 * θ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 / 2 := by ring_nf
    rw [hinner_eq]
    calc
      mgf id νX (θ * y) ≤ exp ((cX : ℝ) * (θ * y) ^ 2 / 2) := hmgf
      _ ≤ exp (C0 * θ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 / 2) := exp_le_exp.mpr hquad_le
      _ = exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2) := by ring_nf
  calc
    ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, exp (θ * p.2 * p.1) ∂(νY.prod νX)
        = ∫ y, ∫ x, f (y, x) ∂νX ∂νY := by
          rw [integral_prod f hf_int]
    _ ≤ ∫ y, exp ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ 2) ∂νY := by
          exact integral_mono_ae hf_int.integral_prod_left hbound_int houter_bound
    _ ≤ exp (2 * exp 1 * ((C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * C0 * exp 1)) :=
          integral_exp_mul_sq_le_exp_linear_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
            hY hθ2_nonneg hC0 hcY hθ_half
    _ = exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * C0 ^ 2 * θ ^ 2) := by
          congr 1
          ring_nf

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_prod_of_indepFun_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_prod_of_indepFun_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Y : Ω → ℝ}
    (hind : X ⟂ᵢ[μ] Y)
    {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY μ) {C0 θ : ℝ}
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hcX : (cX : ℝ) ≤ C0) (hcY : (cY : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_half : (C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * C0 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * X ω * Y ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let φ : Ω → ℝ × ℝ := fun ω => (Y ω, X ω)
  let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => exp (θ * p.2 * p.1)
  have hφ : AEMeasurable φ μ :=
    (hY.aestronglyMeasurable.prodMk hX.aestronglyMeasurable).aemeasurable
  have hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.map φ) := by
    dsimp [g]
    fun_prop
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX.aemeasurable
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map Y) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hprod_int :
      Integrable g ((μ.map Y).prod (μ.map X)) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
      (νX := μ.map X) (νY := μ.map Y)
      ((HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hX.aemeasurable).2 hX)
      ((HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hY.aemeasurable).2 hY)
      hC0 hcX hcY hθ_half
  have hmap_eq :
      μ.map φ = (μ.map Y).prod (μ.map X) := by
    simpa [φ] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
        hY.aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable).mp hind.symm
  have hmap_int : Integrable g (μ.map φ) := by
    rwa [hmap_eq]
  have hcomp := (integrable_map_measure hg hφ).1 hmap_int
  convert hcomp using 1
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_prod_le_of_indepFun_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_prod_le_of_indepFun_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Y : Ω → ℝ}
    (hind : X ⟂ᵢ[μ] Y)
    {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY μ) {C0 θ : ℝ}
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hcX : (cX : ℝ) ≤ C0) (hcY : (cY : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_half : (C0 * θ ^ 2 / 2) * C0 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω * Y ω) ∂μ ≤ exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * C0 ^ 2 * θ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : Ω → ℝ × ℝ := fun ω => (Y ω, X ω)
  let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => exp (θ * p.2 * p.1)
  have hφ : AEMeasurable φ μ :=
    (hY.aestronglyMeasurable.prodMk hX.aestronglyMeasurable).aemeasurable
  have hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.map φ) := by
    dsimp [g]
    fun_prop
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX.aemeasurable
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map Y) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hmap_eq :
      μ.map φ = (μ.map Y).prod (μ.map X) := by
    simpa [φ] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
        hY.aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable).mp hind.symm
  have hprod_bound :
      ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g p ∂((μ.map Y).prod (μ.map X)) ≤
        exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * C0 ^ 2 * θ ^ 2) :=
    integral_exp_mul_snd_fst_prod_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
      (νX := μ.map X) (νY := μ.map Y)
      ((HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hX.aemeasurable).2 hX)
      ((HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hY.aemeasurable).2 hY)
      hC0 hcX hcY hθ_half
  calc
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω * Y ω) ∂μ
        = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g p ∂(μ.map φ) := by
          rw [integral_map hφ hg]
    _ = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g p ∂((μ.map Y).prod (μ.map X)) := by rw [hmap_eq]
    _ ≤ exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * C0 ^ 2 * θ ^ 2) := hprod_bound

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_le_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_le_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ 2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  let F : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)
  have hFnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] F := ae_of_all _ fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hFi : Integrable F μ := by
    apply (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable
      (hX.div_const K |>.pow_const 2 |>.exp |>.aestronglyMeasurable) hFnonneg).1
    exact ne_of_lt (hpsi.trans_lt (by norm_num))
  have hFb : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) ≤ 2 := by
    apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).1
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hFi hFnonneg]
    simpa [F] using hpsi
  let C : ℝ := (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) : X ω ^ (2 * p) ≤ C * F ω := by
    have ht := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2) (sq_nonneg _) p
    have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < p.factorial := by exact_mod_cast p.factorial_pos
    have ht' := (div_le_iff₀ hfac).1 ht
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht' (pow_nonneg hK.le (2 * p))
    have hid : K ^ (2 * p) * ((X ω / K) ^ 2) ^ p = X ω ^ (2 * p) := by
      rw [← pow_mul, div_pow]
      field_simp
    rw [hid] at hm
    simpa [C, F, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hm
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ (2 * p)) μ := by
    apply (hFi.const_mul C).mono_nonneg (hX.pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact ae_of_all _ fun _ => Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right p) _
    · exact ae_of_all _ hpoint
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ ω, X ω ^ (2 * p) ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, C * F ω ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hi (hFi.const_mul C) hpoint
    _ = C * ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ C * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFb hC
    _ = 2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p) := by dsimp [C]; ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_le_of_directional_exp_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_le_of_directional_exp_sq
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (ν : Measure (α → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ u : α → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν ≤ 2)
    (p : ℕ) (a : α → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p)) ν ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) ∂ν) ≤
        2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : ℝ := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · have ha : a = 0 := by
      apply WithLp.toLp_injective (p := 2)
      simpa only [WithLp.toLp_zero] using (norm_eq_zero.mp hs)
    subst a
    by_cases hp : p = 0
    · subst p
      simp
    · have hp' : 2 * p ≠ 0 := Nat.mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hp
      simp [hp']
  have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hs)
  let u : α → ℝ := s⁻¹ • a
  have hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [u, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hspos.le)]
    change s⁻¹ * s = 1
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hs
  have h := integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_le_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two
    (X := fun g => u ⬝ᵥ g) (by fun_prop) hK (hpsi u hu) p
  have hpoint (g : α → ℝ) :
      (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) = s ^ (2 * p) * (u ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) := by
    simp only [u, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, mul_pow, inv_pow]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [← hpoint] using h.1.const_mul (s ^ (2 * p))
  · calc
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) ∂ν) =
          s ^ (2 * p) * ∫ g, (u ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) ∂ν := by
            simp_rw [hpoint]
            rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ s ^ (2 * p) * (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.2 (pow_nonneg hspos.le _)
      _ = _ := by dsimp [s]; ring

name: NLAlib.summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  set r : ℝ := θ * ((c : ℝ) + 1) * exp 1 with hr_def
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by
    rw [hr_def]
    positivity
  have hgeom : Summable fun m : ℕ => exp 1 * r ^ m :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg (by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_small)).mul_left
      (exp 1)
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ?_ ?_ hgeom
  · intro m
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
      exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hθ m) (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right m) (X ω)))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.factorial m)))
  · intro m
    simpa only [hr_def] using integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h hθ m

name: NLAlib.summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) {θ C0 : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hc_le : (c : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_small : θ * C0 * exp 1 < 1) :
    Summable fun m : ℕ =>
      ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  set r : ℝ := θ * C0 * exp 1 with hr_def
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by
    rw [hr_def]
    positivity
  have hgeom : Summable fun m : ℕ => exp 1 * r ^ m :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg (by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_small)).mul_left
      (exp 1)
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ?_ ?_ hgeom
  · intro m
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
      exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hθ m) (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right m) (X ω)))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.factorial m)))
  · intro m
    simpa only [hr_def] using
      integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le m

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum_integrals
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum_integrals {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hsum : Summable fun m : ℕ =>
      ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ) :
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ =
      ∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → Ω → ℝ :=
    fun m ω => θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)
  have hF_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] F m := by
    intro m
    exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
      dsimp [F]
      exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hθ m) (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right m) (X ω)))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.factorial m))
  have hF_int : ∀ m : ℕ, Integrable (F m) μ := by
    intro m
    have hpow : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ (2 * m)) μ := by
      exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul
        (X := X) (t := 1) one_ne_zero
        (h.integrable_exp_mul 1)
        (h.integrable_exp_mul (-1))
        (2 * m)
    dsimp [F]
    exact (hpow.const_mul (θ ^ m)).div_const _
  have hF_sum_norm : Summable fun m : ℕ => ∫ ω, ‖F m ω‖ ∂μ := by
    convert hsum using 1
    ext m
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hF_nonneg m] with ω hω
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hω]
  have htsum := integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hF_int hF_sum_norm
  change ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ = ∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ω, F m ω ∂μ
  rw [htsum]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with ω
  dsimp [F]
  rw [exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum θ (X ω)]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_sq_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  set r : ℝ := θ * C0 * exp 1 with hr_def
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
  have hr_lt : r < 1 := by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_small
  have hsum :=
    summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le hθ_small
  have hgeom : Summable fun m : ℕ => exp 1 * r ^ m :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt).mul_left (exp 1)
  rw [integral_exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum_integrals h hθ hsum]
  calc
    (∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ)
        ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, exp 1 * r ^ m := by
          refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum ?_ hsum hgeom
          intro m
          simpa only [hr_def] using
            integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le m
    _ = exp 1 * (1 - r)⁻¹ := by
          rw [tsum_mul_left]
          rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt]
    _ = exp 1 * (1 - θ * C0 * exp 1)⁻¹ := by rw [hr_def]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) {θ C0 : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hc_le : (c : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_small : θ * C0 * exp 1 < 1) :
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤
      1 + exp 1 * ((θ * C0 * exp 1) * (1 - θ * C0 * exp 1)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  set r : ℝ := θ * C0 * exp 1 with hr_def
  let term : ℕ → ℝ :=
    fun m => ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
  have hr_lt : r < 1 := by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_small
  have hsum : Summable term := by
    simpa only [term] using
      summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le hθ_small
  have hterm0 : term 0 = 1 := by
    change (∫ ω : Ω, θ ^ (0 : ℕ) * X ω ^ (2 * 0) /
      (Nat.factorial 0 : ℝ) ∂μ) = 1
    have hfun :
        (fun ω : Ω => θ ^ 0 * X ω ^ (2 * 0) / (Nat.factorial 0 : ℝ)) =
          (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) := by
      funext ω
      norm_num
    rw [hfun]
    rw [integral_const, probReal_univ]
    norm_num
  have htail_sum : Summable fun n : ℕ => term (n + 1) := by
    exact (summable_nat_add_iff (f := term) 1).mpr hsum
  have hgeom_tail : Summable fun n : ℕ => exp 1 * r ^ (n + 1) := by
    have hgeom_base : Summable fun n : ℕ => r ^ n :=
      summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt
    have hgeom_shift : Summable fun n : ℕ => r ^ (n + 1) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => r ^ n) 1).mpr hgeom_base
    exact hgeom_shift.mul_left (exp 1)
  rw [integral_exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum_integrals h hθ (by simpa only [term] using hsum)]
  change (∑' m : ℕ, term m) ≤ 1 + exp 1 * (r * (1 - r)⁻¹)
  rw [hsum.tsum_eq_zero_add, hterm0]
  gcongr
  calc
    (∑' n : ℕ, term (n + 1)) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, exp 1 * r ^ (n + 1) := by
      refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum ?_ htail_sum hgeom_tail
      intro n
      simpa only [term, hr_def] using
        integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le (n + 1)
    _ = exp 1 * (r * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left]
      rw [show (∑' n : ℕ, r ^ (n + 1)) = r * (1 - r)⁻¹ by
        have hgeom_base : Summable fun n : ℕ => r ^ n :=
          summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt
        have hsplit := hgeom_base.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
        rw [Finset.sum_range_one, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt] at hsplit
        have hshift : (∑' n : ℕ, r ^ (n + 1)) = (1 - r)⁻¹ - 1 := by
          linarith
        rw [hshift]
        have hden : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp [hden]
        ring]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_linear_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_linear_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) {θ C0 : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hc_le : (c : ℝ) ≤ C0)
    (hθ_small : θ * C0 * exp 1 < 1) :
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤
      1 + θ * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ +
        exp 1 * (((θ * C0 * exp 1) ^ 2) * (1 - θ * C0 * exp 1)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  set r : ℝ := θ * C0 * exp 1 with hr_def
  let term : ℕ → ℝ :=
    fun m => ∫ ω, θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ∂μ
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
  have hr_lt : r < 1 := by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_small
  have hsum : Summable term := by
    simpa only [term] using
      summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le hθ_small
  have hterm0 : term 0 = 1 := by
    change (∫ ω : Ω, θ ^ (0 : ℕ) * X ω ^ (2 * 0) /
      (Nat.factorial 0 : ℝ) ∂μ) = 1
    have hfun :
        (fun ω : Ω => θ ^ 0 * X ω ^ (2 * 0) / (Nat.factorial 0 : ℝ)) =
          (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) := by
      funext ω
      norm_num
    rw [hfun]
    rw [integral_const, probReal_univ]
    norm_num
  have hterm1 : term 1 = θ * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    change (∫ ω : Ω, θ ^ (1 : ℕ) * X ω ^ (2 * 1) /
      (Nat.factorial 1 : ℝ) ∂μ) = θ * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ
    have hfun :
        (fun ω : Ω => θ ^ 1 * X ω ^ (2 * 1) / (Nat.factorial 1 : ℝ)) =
          (fun ω : Ω => θ * X ω ^ 2) := by
      funext ω
      norm_num
    rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
  have htail_sum : Summable fun n : ℕ => term (n + 2) := by
    exact (summable_nat_add_iff (f := term) 2).mpr hsum
  have hgeom_tail : Summable fun n : ℕ => exp 1 * r ^ (n + 2) := by
    have hgeom_base : Summable fun n : ℕ => r ^ n :=
      summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt
    have hgeom_shift : Summable fun n : ℕ => r ^ (n + 2) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => r ^ n) 2).mpr hgeom_base
    exact hgeom_shift.mul_left (exp 1)
  rw [integral_exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum_integrals h hθ (by simpa only [term] using hsum)]
  change (∑' m : ℕ, term m) ≤
    1 + θ * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ + exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹)
  have hsplit := hsum.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 2
