  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, hterm0, hterm1] at hsplit
  rw [← hsplit]
  gcongr
  calc
    (∑' n : ℕ, term (n + 2)) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, exp 1 * r ^ (n + 2) := by
      refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum ?_ htail_sum hgeom_tail
      intro n
      simpa only [term, hr_def] using
        integral_exp_sq_series_term_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le (n + 2)
    _ = exp 1 * (r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left]
      rw [show (∑' n : ℕ, r ^ (n + 2)) = r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹ by
        have hgeom_base : Summable fun n : ℕ => r ^ n :=
          summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt
        have hsplit2 := hgeom_base.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 2
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one,
          tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt] at hsplit2
        have hshift : (∑' n : ℕ, r ^ (n + 2)) = (1 - r)⁻¹ - (1 + r) := by
          linarith
        rw [hshift]
        have hden : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp [hden]
        ring]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_sq_le_exp_linear_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:= by
  set r : ℝ := θ * C0 * exp 1 with hr_def
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
  have hr_half : r ≤ 1 / 2 := by simpa only [hr_def] using hθ_half
  have hr_lt : r < 1 := by linarith
  have hbase :=
    integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le
      (by simpa only [hr_def] using hr_lt)
  have hden_pos : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
  have hinv_le : (1 - r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ hden_pos two_pos]
    linarith
  have htail :
      exp 1 * (r * (1 - r)⁻¹) ≤ 2 * exp 1 * r := by
    have hmul : r * (1 - r)⁻¹ ≤ r * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv_le hr_nonneg
    calc
      exp 1 * (r * (1 - r)⁻¹) ≤ exp 1 * (r * 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (exp_pos 1).le
      _ = 2 * exp 1 * r := by ring
  calc
    ∫ ω, exp (θ * X ω ^ 2) ∂μ
        ≤ 1 + exp 1 * (r * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
          simpa only [hr_def] using hbase
    _ ≤ 1 + 2 * exp 1 * r := by linarith
    _ ≤ exp (2 * exp 1 * r) := by
          simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * exp 1 * r)
    _ = exp (2 * exp 1 * (θ * C0 * exp 1)) := by rw [hr_def]

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_summable_integrals
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → Ω → ℝ :=
    fun m ω => θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)
  have hF_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] F m := by
    intro m
    exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
      dsimp [F]
      exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hθ m) (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right m) (X ω)))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.factorial m))
  have hF_int : ∀ m : ℕ, Integrable (F m) μ := by
    intro m
    have hpow : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ (2 * m)) μ := by
      exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul
        (X := X) (t := 1) one_ne_zero
        (h.integrable_exp_mul 1)
        (h.integrable_exp_mul (-1))
        (2 * m)
    dsimp [F]
    exact (hpow.const_mul (θ ^ m)).div_const _
  have hF_integral_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ ∫ ω, F m ω ∂μ := by
    intro m
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (hF_nonneg m)
  have hF_lintegral_eq :
      (∑' m : ℕ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F m ω) ∂μ) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ω, F m ω ∂μ) := by
    calc (∑' m : ℕ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F m ω) ∂μ)
        = ∑' m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, F m ω ∂μ) := by
          congr with m
          exact (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hF_int m) (hF_nonneg m)).symm
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ω, F m ω ∂μ) := by
          exact (ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg hF_integral_nonneg hsum).symm
  have h_exp_lintegral_eq :
      ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (θ * X ω ^ 2)) ∂μ =
        ∑' m : ℕ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F m ω) ∂μ := by
    calc ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (θ * X ω ^ 2)) ∂μ
        = ∫⁻ ω, ∑' m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (F m ω) ∂μ := by
          apply lintegral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with ω
          have hsummable :
              Summable fun m : ℕ => F m ω := by
            convert Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (θ * X ω ^ 2) using 1
            ext m
            dsimp [F]
            rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
          rw [exp_mul_sq_eq_tsum θ (X ω)]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg
            (fun m => by
              show 0 ≤ θ ^ m * X ω ^ (2 * m) / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)
              exact div_nonneg
                (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hθ m)
                  (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right m) (X ω)))
                (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.factorial m))) hsummable
      _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F m ω) ∂μ := by
          rw [lintegral_tsum]
          intro m
          exact (hF_int m).aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have h_exp_lintegral_ne_top :
      ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (θ * X ω ^ 2)) ∂μ ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [h_exp_lintegral_eq, hF_lintegral_eq]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  exact (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable
    ((h.aemeasurable.pow_const 2).const_mul θ).exp.aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun ω => (exp_pos _).le)).mp h_exp_lintegral_ne_top

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:=
  integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_summable_integrals h hθ
    (summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h hθ hθ_small)

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
proof:
:=
  integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_summable_integrals h hθ
    (summable_integral_exp_sq_series_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le h hθ hC0 hc_le hθ_small)

name: NLAlib.sum_fin_inv_add_two_sq_le
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_inv_add_two_sq_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hstrong (m : ℕ) : (∑ i : Fin m, ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
      1 - ((m : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
    induction m with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [show (m : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = (m : ℝ) + 2 by ring]
      have hstep : (((m : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ - ((m : ℝ) + 2)⁻¹ := by
        have hm : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        field_simp
        nlinarith
      linarith
  exact (hstrong n).trans (sub_le_self _ (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)))

name: NLAlib.sq_le_rank_weighted_exponential
statement:
private theorem sq_le_rank_weighted_exponential (x D l : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hl : 1 / 2 ≤ l) :
    x ^ 2 ≤ 32 * D ^ 2 + 32 * D ^ 2 * Real.exp (l * (x ^ 2 / (16 * D ^ 2) - 2))
proof:
:= by
  let u := x ^ 2 / (16 * D ^ 2) - 2
  have hprod : x ^ 2 = 16 * D ^ 2 * (u + 2) := by dsimp [u]; field_simp; ring
  have hexp : u ≤ 2 * Real.exp (l * u) := by
    by_cases hu : u ≤ 0
    · exact hu.trans (by positivity)
    · have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := (lt_of_not_ge hu).le
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (l * u)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl hu0]
  change x ^ 2 ≤ 32 * D ^ 2 + 32 * D ^ 2 * Real.exp (l * u)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg D]

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_pi_le_sixteen_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_log_envelope
statement:
theorem integral_norm_pi_le_sixteen_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_log_envelope
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (c i) μ) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (henv : ∀ i, (c i : ℝ) * Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ D ^ 2) :
    (∫ ω, ‖fun i => X i ω‖ ∂μ) ≤ 16 * D
proof:
:= by
  let l : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)
  let θ : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => l i / (16 * D ^ 2)
  let C : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => D ^ 2 / l i
  let F : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω =>
    Real.exp (θ i * X i ω ^ 2) / ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)
  have hl (i : Fin n) : 1 / 2 ≤ l i := by
    have h2 : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
    exact h2.trans (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by
      have hi : 0 ≤ (((i : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      linarith))
  have hl0 (i : Fin n) : 0 < l i := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hl i)
  have hθ (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ θ i := div_nonneg (hl0 i).le (by positivity)
  have hC (i : Fin n) : 0 < C i := div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hD) (hl0 i)
  have hc (i : Fin n) : (c i : ℝ) ≤ C i := (le_div_iff₀ (hl0 i)).mpr (henv i)
  have hθC (i : Fin n) : θ i * C i = 1 / 16 := by
    dsimp [θ, C]
    field_simp [(hl0 i).ne', hD.ne']
  have hsmall (i : Fin n) : θ i * C i * Real.exp 1 < 1 := by
    rw [hθC]
    linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three]
  have hExp (i : Fin n) : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ i * X i ω ^ 2)) μ :=
    integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le (hX i) (hθ i) (hC i) (hc i) (hsmall i)
  have hExpBound (i : Fin n) : (∫ ω, Real.exp (θ i * X i ω ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤ 4 := by
    have h := integral_exp_mul_sq_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
      (hX i) (hθ i) (hC i) (hc i) (hsmall i)
    rw [hθC] at h
    apply h.trans
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three] :
      0 < 1 - (1 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.exp 1)]
    linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three]
  have hFi (i : Fin n) : Integrable (F i) μ := (hExp i).div_const _
  have hFb (i : Fin n) : (∫ ω, F i ω ∂μ) ≤ 4 / ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) := by
    rw [show (∫ ω, F i ω ∂μ) =
      (∫ ω, Real.exp (θ i * X i ω ^ 2) ∂μ) / ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) from integral_div ..]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hExpBound i) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hW2 : MemLp (fun ω => fun i => X i ω) 2 μ := by
    apply memLp_pi_iff.mpr
    intro i
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hX i).aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
    exact integrable_pow_of_integrable_exp_mul one_ne_zero
      ((hX i).integrable_exp_mul 1) ((hX i).integrable_exp_mul (-1)) 2
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) : ‖fun i => X i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤
      32 * D ^ 2 + 32 * D ^ 2 * ∑ i, F i ω := by
    have hcoord (i : Fin n) : X i ω ^ 2 ≤
        32 * D ^ 2 + 32 * D ^ 2 * ∑ j, F j ω := by
      have h := sq_le_rank_weighted_exponential (X i ω) D (l i) hD (hl i)
      have he : Real.exp (l i * (X i ω ^ 2 / (16 * D ^ 2) - 2)) = F i ω := by
        have hearg : l i * (X i ω ^ 2 / (16 * D ^ 2) - 2) = θ i * X i ω ^ 2 - 2 * l i := by
          dsimp [θ]; ring
        rw [hearg, Real.exp_sub]
        dsimp [F, l]
        rw [two_mul, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by positivity), sq]
        ring
      rw [he] at h
      exact h.trans (by
        gcongr
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => F j ω)
          (fun j _ => by dsimp [F]; positivity) (Finset.mem_univ i))
    have hS : 0 ≤ 32 * D ^ 2 + 32 * D ^ 2 * ∑ i, F i ω := by
      dsimp [F]; positivity
    have hnorm : ‖fun i => X i ω‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (32 * D ^ 2 + 32 * D ^ 2 * ∑ i, F i ω) := by
      apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).mpr
      intro i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hcoord i)
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hS, norm_nonneg (fun i => X i ω)]
  have hsum : (∑ i, ∫ ω, F i ω ∂μ) ≤ 4 := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, 4 / ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hFb i
      _ = 4 * ∑ i : Fin n, ((((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ 4 := by nlinarith [sum_fin_inv_add_two_sq_le n]
  have hsquare := integral_mono hW2.norm.integrable_sq
    ((integrable_const _).add ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hFi i)).const_mul _)) hpoint
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hsquare
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hFi i)).const_mul _),
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hFi i)] at hsquare
  apply integral_le_of_integral_sq_le μ _ (hW2.norm.integrable (by norm_num))
    hW2.norm.integrable_sq (16 * D) (by positivity)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg D]

name: NLAlib.affineNormProfile_even
statement: private theorem affineNormProfile_even (z a : E) : Function.Even (affineNormProfile z a)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  simp only [affineNormProfile, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg]
  ring

name: NLAlib.affineNormProfile_continuous
statement: private theorem affineNormProfile_continuous (z a : E) : Continuous (affineNormProfile z a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineNormProfile
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.convexOn_norm_add_smul
statement:
private theorem convexOn_norm_add_smul (z a : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun t : ℝ => ‖z + t • a‖)
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] E := (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight a
  have h := convexOn_univ_norm.comp_affineMap
    (L.toAffineMap + AffineMap.const ℝ ℝ z)
  simpa [L, Function.comp_def, add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.affineNormProfile_convex
statement:
private theorem affineNormProfile_convex (z a : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (affineNormProfile z a)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := convexOn_norm_add_smul z a
  have hn : ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun t : ℝ => ‖z - t • a‖) := by
    simpa only [smul_neg, sub_eq_add_neg] using convexOn_norm_add_smul z (-a)
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy α β hα hβ hab
  have hp' := hp.2 hx hy hα hβ hab
  have hn' := hn.2 hx hy hα hβ hab
  simp only [affineNormProfile, smul_eq_mul] at hp' hn' ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.affineNormProfile_le
statement:
private theorem affineNormProfile_le (z a : E) (t : ℝ) :
    affineNormProfile z a t ≤ ‖z‖ + |t| * ‖a‖
proof:
:= by
  have hp := norm_add_le z (t • a)
  have hn := norm_sub_le z (t • a)
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hp hn
  unfold affineNormProfile
  linarith

name: NLAlib.affineNormProfile_nonneg
statement:
private theorem affineNormProfile_nonneg (z a : E) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ affineNormProfile z a t
proof: := by unfold affineNormProfile; positivity

name: NLAlib.integrable_norm_add_smul
statement:
private theorem integrable_norm_add_smul {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X μ) (z a : E) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖z + X ω • a‖) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ‖z + t • a‖) := by fun_prop
  refine ((integrable_const ‖z‖).add (hX.norm.mul_const ‖a‖)).mono'
    (hc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  change |‖z + X ω • a‖| ≤ ‖z‖ + |X ω| * ‖a‖
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  simpa only [norm_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_add_le z (X ω • a)

name: NLAlib.integrable_affineNormProfile
statement:
private theorem integrable_affineNormProfile {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X μ) (z a : E) :
    Integrable (fun ω => affineNormProfile z a (X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp := integrable_norm_add_smul hX z a
  have hn := integrable_norm_add_smul hX.neg z a
  simpa only [affineNormProfile, Pi.add_apply, Pi.neg_apply, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg] using (hp.add hn).div_const 2

name: NLAlib.two_thirds_le_integral_abs_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem two_thirds_le_integral_abs_gaussianReal :
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ g : ℝ, |g| ∂gaussianReal 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have he : (∫ g : ℝ, |g| ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = Real.sqrt 2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi := by
    norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at h ⊢
    exact h
  rw [he, le_div_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos)]
  have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  have hsp := Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_pos.le
  have hn2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)
  have hnp := Real.sqrt_nonneg Real.pi
  nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_four]

name: NLAlib.affineNormProfile_abs
statement:
private theorem affineNormProfile_abs (z a : E) (t : ℝ) :
    affineNormProfile z a |t| = affineNormProfile z a t
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total 0 t with ht | ht
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos ht, affineNormProfile_even z a t]

name: NLAlib.integral_affineNormProfile_gaussian
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (memLp_id_gaussianReal 1).integrable le_rfl
  have hp := integrable_norm_add_smul (hg.const_mul c) z a
  have hn := integrable_norm_add_smul (hg.const_mul (-c)) z a
  simp only [id_eq] at hp hn
  have he : (∫ g : ℝ, ‖z - (c * g) • a‖ ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      ∫ g : ℝ, ‖z + (c * g) • a‖ ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
    have hneg : (gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun g : ℝ => -g) = gaussianReal 0 1 := by
      simpa using (gaussianReal_map_neg (μ := 0) (v := 1))
    calc
      _ = ∫ g : ℝ, ‖z + (c * (-g)) • a‖ ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
        congr 1; funext g; rw [mul_neg, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← integral_map (φ := fun g : ℝ => -g)
          (f := fun g : ℝ => ‖z + (c * g) • a‖) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), hneg]
  unfold affineNormProfile
  rw [integral_div, integral_add hp (by simpa only [neg_mul, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg] using hn), he]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_add_smul_le_copy_profile
statement:
private theorem integral_norm_add_smul_le_copy_profile {ν : Measure ℝ}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) ν)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂ν = 0) (z a : E) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖z + x • a‖ ∂ν) ≤
      ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, affineNormProfile z a (p.1 - p.2) ∂ν.prod ν
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 - p.2) (ν.prod ν) :=
    (hν.comp_fst ν).sub (hν.comp_snd ν)
  have hpd := integrable_norm_add_smul hd z a
  have hnd := integrable_norm_add_smul hd.neg z a
  have hsym : (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖z - (p.1 - p.2) • a‖ ∂ν.prod ν) =
      ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖z + (p.1 - p.2) • a‖ ∂ν.prod ν := by
    have hs := integral_prod_swap (μ := ν) (ν := ν)
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ‖z + (p.1 - p.2) • a‖)
    convert hs using 1
    congr 1; funext p
    simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap]
    congr 1
    module
  have hbound : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖z + x • a‖ ∂ν) ≤
      ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖z + (p.1 - p.2) • a‖ ∂ν.prod ν := by
    rw [integral_prod _ hpd]
    refine integral_mono (integrable_norm_add_smul hν z a) hpd.integral_prod_left ?_
    intro x
    have hy := (integrable_const x).sub hν
    have hj := (convexOn_norm_add_smul z a).map_integral_le
      (by fun_prop) isClosed_univ (ae_of_all ν fun _ => mem_univ _) hy
      (integrable_norm_add_smul hy z a)
    change ‖z + (∫ y : ℝ, x - y ∂ν) • a‖ ≤ _ at hj
    have hνi : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) ν :=
      hν.congr (ae_of_all ν fun y => rfl)
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const x) hνi, integral_const, probReal_univ,
      one_smul, hmean, sub_zero] at hj
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, id_eq] using hj
  have he : (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, affineNormProfile z a (p.1 - p.2) ∂ν.prod ν) =
      ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖z + (p.1 - p.2) • a‖ ∂ν.prod ν := by
    unfold affineNormProfile
    rw [integral_div, integral_add hpd
      (by simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg] using hnd), hsym]
    ring
  rwa [he]

name: NLAlib.integral_shifted_gaussian_profile_le
proof:
:= by
  let γ := gaussianReal 0 1
  have hg : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) γ := (memLp_id_gaussianReal 1).integrable le_rfl
  have hga : Integrable (fun g : ℝ => |g|) γ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id_eq] using hg.norm
  have hw := (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add hga |>.const_mul (4 * K)
  have ht := hga.const_mul (10 * K)
  have hwi := integrable_affineNormProfile hw z a
  have hti := integrable_affineNormProfile ht z a
  have hc := affineNormProfile_convex z a
  have hpt (g : ℝ) : affineNormProfile z a (4 * K * (1 + |g|)) ≤
      (3 / 5 : ℝ) * affineNormProfile z a ((20 / 3 : ℝ) * K) +
        (2 / 5 : ℝ) * affineNormProfile z a (10 * K * |g|) := by
    have h := hc.2 (mem_univ ((20 / 3 : ℝ) * K)) (mem_univ (10 * K * |g|))
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 5) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / 5)
      (by norm_num : (3 / 5 : ℝ) + 2 / 5 = 1)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring
  have hi := integral_mono hwi
    ((integrable_const ((3 / 5 : ℝ) * affineNormProfile z a ((20 / 3 : ℝ) * K))).add
      (hti.const_mul (2 / 5 : ℝ))) hpt
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (hti.const_mul _), integral_const,
    probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_const_mul] at hi
  have hj := hc.map_integral_le (affineNormProfile_continuous z a).continuousOn
    isClosed_univ (ae_of_all γ fun _ => mem_univ _) ht hti
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hj
  have hm := hc.monotoneOn_nonneg_of_even (affineNormProfile_even z a)
  have hJ : (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ g : ℝ, |g| ∂γ := two_thirds_le_integral_abs_gaussianReal
  have hs : affineNormProfile z a ((20 / 3 : ℝ) * K) ≤
      affineNormProfile z a (10 * K * ∫ g : ℝ, |g| ∂γ) :=
    hm (by change 0 ≤ (20 / 3 : ℝ) * K; positivity)
      (by change 0 ≤ 10 * K * ∫ g : ℝ, |g| ∂γ; positivity) (by nlinarith)
  have he : (∫ g : ℝ, affineNormProfile z a (10 * K * |g|) ∂γ) =
      ∫ g : ℝ, ‖z + (10 * K * g) • a‖ ∂γ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ g : ℝ, affineNormProfile z a (10 * K * g) ∂γ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with g
        rw [show 10 * K * |g| = |10 * K * g| by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (show 0 < 10 * K by positivity)]]
        exact affineNormProfile_abs z a _
      _ = _ := integral_affineNormProfile_gaussian z a (10 * K)
  rw [← he]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_add_smul_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_add_smul_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq
    {ν : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂ν = 0)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν ≤ 2)
    (z a : E) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖z + x • a‖ ∂ν) ≤
      ∫ g : ℝ, ‖z + (10 * K * g) • a‖ ∂gaussianReal 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have hν : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) ν :=
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two aemeasurable_id K hK hmean hpsi).memLp 1
      |>.integrable le_rfl
  have hd : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 - p.2) (ν.prod ν) :=
    (hν.comp_fst ν).sub (hν.comp_snd ν)
  let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun g => 4 * K * (1 + |g|)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => affineNormProfile z a (max t 0)
  have hfc : Continuous f := (affineNormProfile_continuous z a).comp (continuous_id.max continuous_const)
  have hfm : Monotone f := by
    intro s t hst
    change affineNormProfile z a (max s 0) ≤ affineNormProfile z a (max t 0)
    apply (affineNormProfile_convex z a).monotoneOn_nonneg_of_even (affineNormProfile_even z a)
    · exact le_max_right s 0
    · exact le_max_right t 0
    · exact max_le_max hst le_rfl
  have hg : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (memLp_id_gaussianReal 1).integrable le_rfl
  have hW : Integrable W (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    simpa only [W, Real.norm_eq_abs, id_eq, Pi.add_apply] using
      ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add hg.norm).const_mul (4 * K)
  have hc := lintegral_comp_le_of_measure_lt_le hd.aemeasurable.norm hW.aemeasurable
    (fun t => measure_abs_gt_le_gaussian_shift_of_lintegral_exp_sq
      hd.aemeasurable hK (lintegral_exp_sub_sq_le_two hK hpsi) t)
    hfc hfm (fun t => affineNormProfile_nonneg z a _)
  have hleft (p : ℝ × ℝ) : f |p.1 - p.2| = affineNormProfile z a (p.1 - p.2) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [max_eq_left (abs_nonneg _), affineNormProfile_abs]
  have hright (g : ℝ) : f (W g) = affineNormProfile z a (W g) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [max_eq_left (by dsimp [W]; positivity)]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hc
  simp_rw [hleft, hright] at hc
  have hdi := integrable_affineNormProfile hd z a
  have hWi := integrable_affineNormProfile hW z a
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hdi (ae_of_all _ fun _ => affineNormProfile_nonneg z a _),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hWi (ae_of_all _ fun _ => affineNormProfile_nonneg z a _)] at hc
  have hb : (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, affineNormProfile z a (p.1 - p.2) ∂ν.prod ν) ≤
      ∫ g : ℝ, affineNormProfile z a (W g) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (integral_nonneg fun _ => affineNormProfile_nonneg z a _)).mp hc
  exact (integral_norm_add_smul_le_copy_profile hν hmean z a).trans
    (hb.trans (integral_shifted_gaussian_profile_le z a hK))

name: NLAlib.quadratic_remainder_le_exp_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hYoung : |u * y| ≤ u ^ 2 / 2 + y ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [sq_abs u, sq_abs y, sq_nonneg (|u| - |y|)]
  have hy : y ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2) := by
    nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (y ^ 2 / 2)]
  have he : Real.exp |u * y| ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2 + y ^ 2 / 2) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hYoung
  calc
    (u * y) ^ 2 * Real.exp |u * y| = u ^ 2 * (y ^ 2 * Real.exp |u * y|) := by ring
    _ ≤ u ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2)) *
        Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2 + y ^ 2 / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul hy he (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg u)
    _ = 2 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (y ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      have hs : Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2) = Real.exp (y ^ 2) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc
        u ^ 2 * (2 * Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2) *
            (Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2))) =
          2 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2) *
            (Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hs]

name: NLAlib.quadratic_remainder_le_exp_abs
statement:
private theorem quadratic_remainder_le_exp_abs (u y : ℝ) (hu : |u| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (u * y) ^ 2 * Real.exp |u * y| ≤ 8 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp |y|
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : |u * y| ≤ |y| / 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu (abs_nonneg y)]
  have hy : y ^ 2 ≤ 8 * Real.exp (|y| / 2) := by
    have hp := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (|y| / 2) (by positivity) 2
    norm_num at hp
    nlinarith [sq_abs y]
  have he : Real.exp |u * y| ≤ Real.exp (|y| / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlin
  calc
    (u * y) ^ 2 * Real.exp |u * y| = u ^ 2 * (y ^ 2 * Real.exp |u * y|) := by ring
    _ ≤ u ^ 2 * ((8 * Real.exp (|y| / 2)) * Real.exp (|y| / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul hy he (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg u)
    _ = 8 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp |y| := by
      have hs : Real.exp (|y| / 2) * Real.exp (|y| / 2) = Real.exp |y| := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc
        u ^ 2 * (8 * Real.exp (|y| / 2) * Real.exp (|y| / 2)) =
          8 * u ^ 2 * (Real.exp (|y| / 2) * Real.exp (|y| / 2)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hs]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_le_two_of_lintegral_le
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] F := Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpos
  have hfi : Integrable F μ := ⟨hF.aestronglyMeasurable,
    (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hnonneg).2 (hbound.trans_lt (by norm_num))⟩
  refine ⟨hfi, ?_⟩
  apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).1
  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfi hnonneg]
  simpa using hbound

name: NLAlib.mgf_le_of_remainder_bound
statement:
private theorem mgf_le_of_remainder_bound {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X F : Ω → ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hXi : Integrable X μ) (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hFi : Integrable F μ) (hFb : ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (t c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hrem : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤ 1 + t * X ω + c * F ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ ∧ mgf X μ t ≤ 1 + 2 * c
proof:
:= by
  have hright := ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add (hXi.const_mul t)).add (hFi.const_mul c)
  have hexp : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
    hright.mono_nonneg (by fun_prop)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hrem)
  refine ⟨hexp, ?_⟩
  have hb := integral_mono hexp hright hrem
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hb
  rw [integral_add (f := fun ω => 1 + t * X ω) (g := fun ω => c * F ω)
      ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add (hXi.const_mul t)) (hFi.const_mul c),
    integral_add (f := fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (g := fun ω => t * X ω)
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)) (hXi.const_mul t),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hmean] at hb
  simp only [integral_const, measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    mul_zero, add_zero] at hb
  exact hb.trans (by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFb hc])

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ 2) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF X ⟨9 * K ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hFi, hFb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_le_two_of_lintegral_le
    (F := fun ω => Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hpsi
  have hXi : Integrable X μ := by
    apply (hFi.const_mul K).mono' hX.aestronglyMeasurable
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hy : |X ω / K| ≤ Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2) := by
      have h1 : |X ω / K| ≤ 1 + (X ω / K) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_abs (X ω / K), sq_nonneg (|X ω / K| - 1 / 2)]
      linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2)]
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hK] at hy
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hK).mp hy
  have hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ ∧
      mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (9 * K ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    intro t
    let u := t * K
    have hrem : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤
        1 + t * X ω + (2 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2)) *
          Real.exp ((X ω / K) ^ 2) := by
      intro ω
      have hid : t * X ω = u * (X ω / K) := by dsimp [u]; field_simp
      have h1 := exp_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs (t * X ω)
      have h2 := quadratic_remainder_le_exp_sq u (X ω / K)
      rw [← hid] at h2
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hexp, hb⟩ := mgf_le_of_remainder_bound hX hXi hmean hFi hFb t
      (2 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2)) (by positivity) hrem
    refine ⟨hexp, hb.trans ?_⟩
    have he : 1 ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
    have hex : 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (4 * u ^ 2) := by
      linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (4 * u ^ 2)]
    calc
      1 + 2 * (2 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2)) ≤
          Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2) * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (4 * u ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hex (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (9 * K ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        dsimp [u]
        ring
  exact ⟨fun t => (hbound t).1, fun t => (hbound t).2⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem integrable_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (|X ω| / K)) ∂μ ≤ 2) :
    Integrable X μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hFi, -⟩ := integrable_and_integral_le_two_of_lintegral_le
    (F := fun ω => Real.exp (|X ω| / K)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hpsi
  apply (hFi.const_mul K).mono' hX.aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro ω
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hy : |X ω| / K ≤ Real.exp (|X ω| / K) := by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (|X ω| / K)]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hK).mp hy

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (|X ω| / K)) ∂μ ≤ 2) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t| ≤ 1 / (2 * K)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hFi, -⟩ := integrable_and_integral_le_two_of_lintegral_le
    (F := fun ω => Real.exp (|X ω| / K)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hpsi
  refine hFi.mono' (Real.measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable (hX.const_mul t)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc t * X ω ≤ |t * X ω| := le_abs_self _
    _ = |t| * |X ω| := abs_mul _ _
    _ ≤ 1 / (2 * K) * |X ω| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ |X ω| / K := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) hK (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.mgf_le_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hFi, hFb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_le_two_of_lintegral_le
    (F := fun ω => Real.exp (|X ω| / K)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hpsi
  have hXi : Integrable X μ := integrable_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two hX K hK hpsi
  let u := t * K
  have hu : |u| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have ht' := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * K)).mp ht
    dsimp [u]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hK]
    nlinarith
  have hrem : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤
      1 + t * X ω + (8 * u ^ 2) * Real.exp (|X ω| / K) := by
    intro ω
    have hid : t * X ω = u * (X ω / K) := by dsimp [u]; field_simp
    have h1 := exp_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs (t * X ω)
    have h2 := quadratic_remainder_le_exp_abs u (X ω / K) hu
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hK] at h2
    rw [← hid] at h2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨-, hb⟩ := mgf_le_of_remainder_bound hX hXi hmean hFi hFb t
    (8 * u ^ 2) (by positivity) hrem
  refine hb.trans ?_
  have hh := Real.add_one_le_exp (16 * u ^ 2)
  have heq : 16 * u ^ 2 = 16 * K ^ 2 * t ^ 2 := by dsimp [u]; ring
  rw [heq] at hh
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sqrt_mul_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem measureReal_sqrt_mul_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | Real.sqrt c * t < |X ω|} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc
  · have hz := h.ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
    have he : {ω | Real.sqrt (0 : ℝ≥0) * t < |X ω|} =ᵐ[μ] (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hz] with ω hω
      apply propext
      change (Real.sqrt (0 : ℝ≥0) * t < |X ω|) ↔ False
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hω
      simp [hω]
    rw [measureReal_congr he, measureReal_empty]
    positivity
  · have hc' : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
    have hb := measureReal_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h
      (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (c : ℝ)) ht)
    have he : -(Real.sqrt c * t) ^ 2 / (2 * c) = -t ^ 2 / 2 := by
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (c : ℝ) ^ 2 = (c : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt c.2
      have hmul := congrArg (fun r : ℝ => r * t ^ 2) hsqrt
      rw [mul_pow]
      field_simp [hc']
      nlinarith
    rwa [he] at hb

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_two_mul_le_sqrt_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem lpNorm_two_mul_le_sqrt_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lpNorm X (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * (c : ℝ) * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hpr : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have h2p : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * p : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hGamma : (p : ℝ) * Real.Gamma p = (p.factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.Gamma_add_one hpr.ne', Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have hmoment := integral_abs_rpow_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h h2p
  have he : (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) = (p : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he] at hmoment
  have hfac : (p.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ p := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow p
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
  have hmoment' : (∫ ω, |X ω| ^ ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) ∂μ) ≤
      (4 * (c : ℝ) * p) ^ p := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * (c : ℝ)) ^ p * (p.factorial : ℝ) := by
        calc
          _ ≤ ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * (c : ℝ)) ^ (p : ℝ) * Real.Gamma p :=
            hmoment
          _ = 2 * (2 * (c : ℝ)) ^ p * ((p : ℝ) * Real.Gamma p) := by
            simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.rpow_natCast]
            ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hGamma]
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * (c : ℝ)) ^ p * (p : ℝ) ^ p := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 2 ^ p * (2 * (c : ℝ)) ^ p * (p : ℝ) ^ p := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow, ← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by positivity) (by finiteness)
    h.aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((4 * (c : ℝ) * p) ^ p) ^ (2 * (p : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
      · exact integral_nonneg fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
      · simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hmoment'
      · positivity
    _ = Real.sqrt (4 * (c : ℝ) * p) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      congr 1
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_le_integral_add_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem lpNorm_le_integral_add_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) c μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lpNorm X (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ ≤
      (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) + Real.sqrt (4 * (c : ℝ) * p)
proof:
:= by
  have hmean : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ := integral_nonneg hX
  have he : X = (fun _ : Ω => ∫ y, X y ∂μ) +
      (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) := by ext ω; simp
  calc
    _ ≤ lpNorm (fun _ : Ω => ∫ y, X y ∂μ) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ +
        lpNorm (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ := by
      conv_lhs => rw [he]
      apply lpNorm_add_le (memLp_const _)
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * p)
    _ = (∫ y, X y ∂μ) +
        lpNorm (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ := by
      rw [lpNorm_const' (by positivity) (by finiteness), probReal_univ, Real.one_rpow,
        mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hmean]
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (lpNorm_two_mul_le_sqrt_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h hp)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_lpNorm_sub_le_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_lpNorm_sub_le_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) {c : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ) c μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | X ω + Real.sqrt (4 * (c : ℝ) * p) + t <
      lpNorm X (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := lpNorm_le_integral_add_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF hX h hp
  apply (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) (fun ω hω => ?_)).trans
    (measureReal_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h ht)
  change t < |X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ|
  have hs := neg_le_abs (X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ)
  change X ω + Real.sqrt (4 * (c : ℝ) * p) + t <
    lpNorm X (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) μ at hω
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_Ioi_two_mul_exp_mul_rpow
statement:
private lemma integral_Ioi_two_mul_exp_mul_rpow {c p : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => 2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c)) * t ^ (p - 1)) (Ioi 0) ∧
      ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), 2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c)) * t ^ (p - 1) =
        (2 * c) ^ (p / 2) * Gamma (p / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * c) := by positivity
  have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => 2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c)) * t ^ (p - 1)) =
      fun t => 2 * (t ^ (p - 1) * exp (-(1 / (2 * c)) * t ^ (2 : ℝ))) := by
    funext t
    rw [rpow_two]
    ring_nf
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨(integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow (by linarith) two_pos hb).const_mul 2, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow two_pos (by linarith) hb]
  have h1 : (p - 1 + 1) / 2 = p / 2 := by ring
  have h2 : -(p - 1 + 1) / 2 = -(p / 2) := by ring
  rw [h1, h2, one_div (2 * c), inv_rpow (by positivity), rpow_neg (by positivity), inv_inv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : {ω | t < |X ω|} ⊆ {ω | t ≤ X ω} ∪ {ω | t ≤ (-X) ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_union, Pi.neg_apply] at hω ⊢
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (X ω) with h0 | h0
    · left; rw [abs_of_nonneg h0] at hω; exact hω.le
    · right; rw [abs_of_neg h0] at hω; exact hω.le
  calc μ.real {ω | t < |X ω|} ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} + μ.real {ω | t ≤ (-X) ω} :=
        (measureReal_mono hsub).trans (measureReal_union_le _ _)
    _ ≤ exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c)) + exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c)) :=
        add_le_add (h.measure_ge_le ht) (h.neg.measure_ge_le ht)
    _ = 2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * c)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_rpow_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc0
  · have h0 := h.ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
    have hint : ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ p ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [integral_congr_ae (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))]
      · simp
      filter_upwards [h0] with ω hω
      simp [hω, zero_rpow hp.ne']
    rw [hint, NNReal.coe_zero, mul_zero, zero_rpow (by positivity), mul_zero, zero_mul]
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < c := lt_of_le_of_ne c.2 (by exact_mod_cast hc0.symm)
  obtain ⟨hI, hval⟩ := integral_Ioi_two_mul_exp_mul_rpow hc hp
  have hXm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => |X ω|) μ := h.aemeasurable.abs
  have hlin : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (|X ω| ^ p) ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (p * ((2 * c) ^ (p / 2) * Gamma (p / 2))) := by
    rw [lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul μ (ae_of_all _ fun ω => abs_nonneg (X ω)) hXm hp,
      ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp.le, ← hval,
      ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hI (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi
        fun t (ht : 0 < t) => by positivity)]
    gcongr 1
    refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun t (ht : 0 < t) => ?_
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ← ofReal_measureReal]
    exact mul_le_mul_left (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      (measureReal_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF h ht.le)) _
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by positivity)
    (hXm.pow_const p).aestronglyMeasurable]
  calc (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (|X ω| ^ p) ∂μ).toReal
      ≤ p * ((2 * c) ^ (p / 2) * Gamma (p / 2)) :=
        ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) hlin
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_rademacher
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_rademacher {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℝ)
    {ε : Ω → ι → ℝ} (hε : HasLaw ε (rademacherVector ι) μ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => ∑ i, a i * ε ω i) (‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖₊ ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  have := hε.isProbabilityMeasure
  have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_finset_sum_mul_of_iIndepFun hε.iIndepFun_eval_of_rademacherVector
    (c := fun _ => 1) (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hε.hasLaw_eval_rademacherMeasure i))
    a
  refine (congrArg (fun c : ℝ≥0 => HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => ∑ i, a i * ε ω i) c μ) ?_).mp h
  ext
  simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (sq_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_rpow_sum_mul_rademacher_le
statement:
theorem integral_abs_rpow_sum_mul_rademacher_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℝ)
    {ε : Ω → ι → ℝ} (hε : HasLaw ε (rademacherVector ι) μ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫ ω, |∑ i, a i * ε ω i| ^ p ∂μ ≤
      p * (2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) * Gamma (p / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have := hε.isProbabilityMeasure
  simpa using integral_abs_rpow_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_rademacher a hε) hp

name: NLAlib.integral_le_log_div_of_integral_exp_le
statement:
private lemma integral_le_log_div_of_integral_exp_le [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {M : Ω → ℝ}
    (hM : Integrable M μ) {s B : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hexp : Integrable (fun ω => exp (s * M ω)) μ) (hB : ∫ ω, exp (s * M ω) ∂μ ≤ B) :
    ∫ ω, M ω ∂μ ≤ log B / s
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : exp (∫ ω, s * M ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, exp (s * M ω) ∂μ :=
    convexOn_exp.map_integral_le continuousOn_exp isClosed_univ (ae_of_all _ fun _ => trivial)
      (hM.const_mul s) hexp
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hJ
  have hBpos : 0 < B := (exp_pos _).trans_le (hJ.trans hB)
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hs, mul_comm]
  exact (le_log_iff_exp_le hBpos).2 (hJ.trans hB)

name: NLAlib.abs_iSup_le_sum_abs
statement:
private lemma abs_iSup_le_sum_abs {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → ℝ) :

proof:

  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_eq_iSup_fintype f
  rw [← hj]

name: NLAlib.integrable_iSup_of_integrable
statement:
private lemma integrable_iSup_of_integrable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i, Integrable (Y i) μ) : Integrable (fun ω => ⨆ i, Y i ω) μ
proof:
:=
  (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => (hY i).abs).mono'
    (AEMeasurable.iSup fun i => (hY i).aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Finset.sum_apply] using abs_iSup_le_sum_abs (Y · ω))

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_le_aux
statement:
private lemma integral_iSup_le_aux [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [Nonempty ι] [Fintype κ] (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i, Integrable (Y i) μ)
    (F : κ → Ω → ℝ) (hF : ∀ k, Integrable (F k) μ) {s b : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hexp : ∀ ω, exp (s * ⨆ i, Y i ω) ≤ ∑ k, F k ω) (hb : ∀ k, ∫ ω, F k ω ∂μ ≤ b) :
    ∫ ω, ⨆ i, Y i ω ∂μ ≤ log (Fintype.card κ * b) / s
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => ⨆ i, Y i ω) μ :=
    AEMeasurable.iSup fun i => (hY i).aemeasurable
  have hint : Integrable (fun ω => ⨆ i, Y i ω) μ := integrable_iSup_of_integrable Y hY
  have hsum : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ k, F k ω) μ := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun k _ => hF k
  have hexpint : Integrable (fun ω => exp (s * ⨆ i, Y i ω)) μ :=
    hsum.mono' (measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable (hm.const_mul s)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
        exact hexp ω)
  refine integral_le_log_div_of_integral_exp_le hint hs hexpint ?_
  calc ∫ ω, exp (s * ⨆ i, Y i ω) ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, ∑ k, F k ω ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hexpint hsum hexp
    _ = ∑ k, ∫ ω, F k ω ∂μ := integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => hF k
    _ ≤ ∑ _k : κ, b := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hb k
    _ = Fintype.card κ * b := by simp

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∫ ω, ⨆ i, X i ω ∂μ ≤ log (Fintype.card ι) / s + c * s / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : ∀ ω, exp (s * ⨆ i, X i ω) ≤ ∑ i, exp (s * X i ω) := by
    intro ω
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_eq_iSup_fintype (X · ω)
    rw [← hj]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => exp (s * X i ω)) (fun i _ => (exp_pos _).le)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hle := integral_iSup_le_aux X (fun i => (h i).integrable)
    (fun i ω => exp (s * X i ω)) (fun i => (h i).integrable_exp_mul s) hs hexp
    (fun i => (h i).mgf_le s)
  refine hle.trans_eq ?_
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  rw [log_mul hN.ne' (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp, add_div]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∫ ω, ⨆ i, |X i ω| ∂μ ≤ log (2 * Fintype.card ι) / s + c * s / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : ∀ ω, exp (s * ⨆ i, |X i ω|) ≤
      ∑ k : ι × Bool, exp ((if k.2 then s else -s) * X k.1 ω) := by
    intro ω
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_eq_iSup_fintype (fun i => |X i ω|)
    rw [← hj]
    have hj2 : exp (s * |X j ω|) ≤ ∑ b : Bool, exp ((if b then s else -s) * X j ω) := by
      simp only [Fintype.sum_bool, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (X j ω) with h0 | h0
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg h0]; linarith [exp_pos (-s * X j ω)]
      · rw [abs_of_neg h0, mul_neg, ← neg_mul]; linarith [exp_pos (s * X j ω)]
    refine hj2.trans ?_
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ∑ b : Bool, exp ((if b then s else -s) * X i ω))
      (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => (exp_pos _).le) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hb : ∀ k : ι × Bool, ∫ ω, exp ((if k.2 then s else -s) * X k.1 ω) ∂μ ≤
      exp (c * s ^ 2 / 2) := by
    intro k
    have := (h k.1).mgf_le (if k.2 then s else -s)
    split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> simpa [mgf] using this
  have hle := integral_iSup_le_aux (fun i ω => |X i ω|) (fun i => (h i).integrable.abs)
    (fun (k : ι × Bool) ω => exp ((if k.2 then s else -s) * X k.1 ω))
    (fun k => (h k.1).integrable_exp_mul _) hs hexp hb
  refine hle.trans_eq ?_
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_comm _ (2 : ℝ),
    log_mul (by positivity) (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp, add_div]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.le_sqrt_of_forall_le_div_add
statement:
private lemma le_sqrt_of_forall_le_div_add {x L c : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → x ≤ L / s + c * s / 2) : x ≤ √(2 * c * L)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hL.eq_or_lt with rfl | hL'
  · rw [mul_zero, sqrt_zero]
    by_contra hx
    push Not at hx
    have := h (x / (c + 1)) (by positivity)
    rw [zero_div, zero_add] at this
    have h1 : c * (x / (c + 1)) / 2 < x := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  rcases hc.eq_or_lt with rfl | hc'
  · rw [mul_zero, zero_mul, sqrt_zero]
    by_contra hx
    push Not at hx
    have := h (2 * L / x) (by positivity)
    rw [zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero, div_div_eq_mul_div] at this
    have h1 : L * x / (2 * L) = x / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith
  set r := √(2 * c * L) with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hr2 : r * r = 2 * c * L := mul_self_sqrt (by positivity)
  have := h (r / c) (by positivity)
  have h1 : L / (r / c) + c * (r / c) / 2 = r := by
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_le_sqrt_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:=
  le_sqrt_of_forall_le_div_add (log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)) c.2
    fun _ hs => integral_iSup_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF X c h hs

name: NLAlib.integral_iSup_abs_le_sqrt_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
proof:
:=
  le_sqrt_of_forall_le_div_add
    (log_nonneg (by have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
                    linarith)) c.2
    fun _ hs => integral_iSup_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF X c h hs

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq
    (ν : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (z : E) (a : ι → E) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫ g : ι → ℝ, ‖z + (10 * K) • (∑ i, g i • a i)‖ ∂gaussianVector ι
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 10 * K
  let η : ι → Measure ℝ := fun _ => (gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun g : ℝ => c * g)
  have hp : ∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (η i) := fun _ =>
    (gaussianReal 0 1).isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have hg : Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (memLp_id_gaussianReal 1).integrable le_rfl
  have hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (ν i) := fun i =>
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two aemeasurable_id K hK (hmean i)
      (hpsi i)).memLp 1 |>.integrable le_rfl
  have hη : ∀ i, Integrable (id : ℝ → ℝ) (η i) := by
    intro i
    apply (integrable_map_measure aestronglyMeasurable_id (by fun_prop)).mpr
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] using hg.const_mul c
  have hstep : ∀ i (w : E), (∫ t : ℝ, ‖w + t • a i‖ ∂ν i) ≤
      ∫ t : ℝ, ‖w + t • a i‖ ∂η i := by
    intro i w
    change _ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, ‖w + t • a i‖ ∂(gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun g : ℝ => c * g)
    rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    exact integral_norm_add_smul_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq K hK (hmean i)
      (hpsi i) w (a i)
  have hi := @MeasureTheory.integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le E _ _ ι _ ν η inferInstance hp hν hη a hstep z
  have hm : MeasurePreserving (fun g : ι → ℝ => fun i => c * g i)
      (gaussianVector ι) (Measure.pi η) := by
    exact measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1) η
      (fun _ => ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩)
  have he : (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi η) =
      ∫ g : ι → ℝ, ‖z + ∑ i, (c * g i) • a i‖ ∂gaussianVector ι := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => ‖z + ∑ i, x i • a i‖) := by fun_prop
    rw [← hm.map_eq, integral_map hm.measurable.aemeasurable hc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hf (g : ι → ℝ) : (∑ i, (c * g i) • a i) = c • ∑ i, g i • a i := by
    simp only [mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [hf] at he
  rw [he] at hi
  exact hi

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq
    (ν : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (a : ι → E) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ‖∑ i, x i • a i‖ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (10 * K) * ∫ g : ι → ℝ, ‖∑ i, g i • a i‖ ∂gaussianVector ι
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_norm_add_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq ν K hK hmean hpsi (0 : E) a
  simpa only [zero_add, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 10 * K),
    integral_const_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_rademacherMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_rademacherMeasure (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂rademacherMeasure = (f 1 + f (-1)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi : ∀ a : ℝ, Integrable f ((1 / 2 : ENNReal) • Measure.dirac a) :=
    fun a => (integrable_dirac (by simp)).smul_measure (by simp)
  rw [rademacherMeasure, integral_add_measure (hi 1) (hi (-1)), integral_smul_measure,
    integral_smul_measure, integral_dirac, integral_dirac]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_div, ENNReal.toReal_one, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_id_rademacherMeasure
statement: theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_id_rademacherMeasure : HasSubgaussianMGF id 1 rademacherMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (μ := rademacherMeasure)
    (X := id) aemeasurable_id ae_mem_Icc_rademacherMeasure integral_id_rademacherMeasure

name: NLAlib.ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure
statement:
theorem ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hr : HasLaw r rademacherMeasure μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, r ω = 1 ∨ r ω = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hS : MeasurableSet {x : ℝ | x = 1 ∨ x = -1} :=
    (measurableSet_singleton 1).union (measurableSet_singleton (-1))
  rw [← ae_map_iff hr.aemeasurable hS, hr.map_eq]

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure
statement:
theorem memLp_two_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hr : HasLaw r rademacherMeasure μ) :

proof:
:=
  have := hr.isProbabilityMeasure
  MemLp.of_bound hr.aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    ((ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure hr).mono fun ω h => by

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hr : HasLaw r rademacherMeasure μ) :

proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_map hr.aemeasurable (f := fun x : ℝ => x) aestronglyMeasurable_id
  rw [hr.map_eq, integral_id_rademacherMeasure] at h

name: NLAlib.integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure

:= by

  rw [integral_congr_ae ((ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure hr).mono
    fun ω h => by rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h] : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, r ω ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ))]
  simp

statement:

    ((ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure hr).mono fun ω h => by

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_four_eq_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure

    (hr : HasLaw r rademacherMeasure μ) :

  rw [integral_congr_ae ((ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure hr).mono

name: NLAlib.ae_forall_sq_eq_one_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem ae_forall_sq_eq_one_rademacherVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] :

  intro i
  filter_upwards [ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure
    (hasLaw_eval_rademacherVector i)] with ξ hξ

name: NLAlib.integrable_ciSup_sum_norm_sq_of_continuous
statement:
theorem integrable_ciSup_sum_norm_sq_of_continuous
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℂ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hX : ∀ i ω t, ‖X i ω t‖ ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => ⨆ t, ∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le (Measure.pi ν)
    (fun x t => ∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2)
  · intro t
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
      ((hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).norm.pow 2
  · intro x t
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hX i (x i) t)

name: NLAlib.integral_ciSup_sum_norm_sq_le_mean_add_sixteen_mul_of_centered
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_norm_sq_le_mean_add_sixteen_mul_of_centered
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℂ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hX : ∀ i ω t, ‖X i ω t‖ ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i t, ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i = 0)
    (hneg : ∀ t, ∃ u, ∀ i ω, X i ω u = -X i ω t)
    (hvariance : ∀ t, (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖X i ω t‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      2 * v + 16 * R *
        ∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖ ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let Y (k : Bool) (i : ι) (ω : Ω) (t : T) : ℝ :=
    if k then (X i ω t).re else (X i ω t).im
  have hYc (k : Bool) (i : ι) (t : T) : Continuous (fun ω => Y k i ω t) := by
    cases k <;> simp only [Y, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    · exact Complex.continuous_im.comp (hXc i t)
    · exact Complex.continuous_re.comp (hXc i t)
  have hY (k : Bool) (i : ι) (ω : Ω) (t : T) : |Y k i ω t| ≤ R := by
    cases k
    · exact (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _).trans (hX i ω t)
    · exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (hX i ω t)
  have hXi (i : ι) (t : T) : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω t) (ν i) :=
    Integrable.of_bound (hXc i t).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable R
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => hX i ω t)
  have hYi (k : Bool) (i : ι) (t : T) : Integrable (fun ω => Y k i ω t ^ 2) (ν i) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hYc k i t).pow 2).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable (R ^ 2)
    apply ae_of_all
    intro ω
    change ‖Y k i ω t ^ 2‖ ≤ R ^ 2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hY k i ω t)
  have hXsq (i : ι) (t : T) : Integrable (fun ω => ‖X i ω t‖ ^ 2) (ν i) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hXc i t).norm.pow 2).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable (R ^ 2)
    apply ae_of_all
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hX i ω t)
  have hYm (k : Bool) (i : ι) (t : T) : ∫ ω, Y k i ω t ∂ν i = 0 := by
    cases k
    · change (∫ ω, (X i ω t).im ∂ν i) = 0
      simpa using Complex.imCLM.integral_comp_comm (hXi i t) |>.trans
        (congrArg Complex.imCLM (hmean i t))
    · change (∫ ω, (X i ω t).re ∂ν i) = 0
      simpa using Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm (hXi i t) |>.trans
        (congrArg Complex.reCLM (hmean i t))
  have hYn (k : Bool) (t : T) : ∃ u, ∀ i ω, Y k i ω u = -Y k i ω t := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hneg t
    refine ⟨u, fun i ω => ?_⟩
    cases k <;> simp [Y, hu]
  have hYv (k : Bool) (t : T) : (∑ i, ∫ ω, Y k i ω t ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v := by
    apply le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => integral_mono (hYi k i t) (hXsq i t) ?_)
      (hvariance t)
    intro ω
    cases k
    · have h := Complex.sq_norm_sub_sq_im (X i ω t)
      change (X i ω t).im ^ 2 ≤ ‖X i ω t‖ ^ 2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X i ω t).re]
    · have h := Complex.sq_norm_sub_sq_re (X i ω t)
      change (X i ω t).re ^ 2 ≤ ‖X i ω t‖ ^ 2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X i ω t).im]
  have hnorm (x : ι → Ω) (t : T) : ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, R :=
    (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hX i (x i) t)
  have hN : Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => ⨆ t, ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖) μ := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le μ
      (fun x t => ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖)
    · intro t
      exact (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).norm
    · intro x t
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using hnorm x t
  have hL (k : Bool) : Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => ⨆ t, ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t) μ := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le μ
      (fun x t => ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t)
    · intro t
      exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hYc k i t).comp (continuous_apply i)
    · intro x t
      exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
        (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hY k i (x i) t)
  have hQ (k : Bool) : Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => ⨆ t, ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ^ 2) μ := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le μ
      (fun x t => ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ^ 2)
    · intro t
      exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => ((hYc k i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).pow 2
    · intro x t
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
        simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hY k i (x i) t)
  have hbQ (k : Bool) (x : ι → Ω) : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ^ 2) := by
    refine ⟨∑ _i : ι, R ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
      simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hY k i (x i) t)
  have hleL (k : Bool) :
      (∫ x, ⨆ t, ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, ⨆ t, ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖ ∂μ := by
    apply integral_mono (hL k) hN
    intro x
    apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    apply le_trans (b := ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖)
    · cases k
      · simpa [Y, Complex.im_sum] using Complex.im_le_norm (∑ i, X i (x i) t)
      · simpa [Y, Complex.re_sum] using Complex.re_le_norm (∑ i, X i (x i) t)
    · exact le_ciSup ⟨∑ _i : ι, R, by rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩; exact hnorm x u⟩ t
  have hbound (k : Bool) : (∫ x, ⨆ t, ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      v + 8 * R * ∫ x, ⨆ t, ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖ ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_ciSup_sum_sq_le_mean_add_eight_mul_of_centered ν
      (Y k) (hYc k) hR (hY k) (hYm k) (hYn k) (hYv k)
    change (∫ x, ⨆ t, ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      v + 8 * R * ∫ x, ⨆ t, ∑ i, Y k i (x i) t ∂μ at h
    nlinarith [hleL k]
  have hsplit := integral_mono
    (integrable_ciSup_sum_norm_sq_of_continuous ν X hXc hR hX)
    ((hQ true).add (hQ false)) (fun x => ?_)
  · change (∫ x, ⨆ t, ∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ x, (⨆ t, ∑ i, Y true i (x i) t ^ 2) +
        (⨆ t, ∑ i, Y false i (x i) t ^ 2) ∂μ at hsplit
    rw [integral_add (hQ true) (hQ false)] at hsplit
    linarith [hbound true, hbound false]
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    calc
      (∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2) =
          (∑ i, Y true i (x i) t ^ 2) + ∑ i, Y false i (x i) t ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        have h := Complex.sq_norm_sub_sq_re (X i (x i) t)
        change ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2 = (X i (x i) t).re ^ 2 + (X i (x i) t).im ^ 2
        linarith
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (le_ciSup (hbQ true x) t) (le_ciSup (hbQ false x) t)

name: NLAlib.integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_of_bounded
statement:
theorem integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_of_bounded
    (X : ι → T → ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i t, |X i t| ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun r : ι → ℝ => ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i t) (rademacherVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (measurable_ciSup_sum_mul_of_bounded X hX).aestronglyMeasurable
    ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R)
  filter_upwards [ae_norm_le_one_rademacherVector (κ := ι)] with r hr
  have ht (t : T) : |∑ i, r i * X i t| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, |r i * X i t| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, R := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [abs_mul]
        have hi : |r i| ≤ 1 := by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (norm_le_pi_norm r i).trans hr
        exact (mul_le_mul hi (hX i t) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (one_mul R)
      _ = _ := by simp
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_ciSup_le_of_abs_le _ ht

name: NLAlib.integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_of_abs_sub_le
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_of_abs_sub_le
    (X Y : ι → T → ℝ) {R S : ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ i t, |X i t| ≤ R) (hY : ∀ i t, |Y i t| ≤ S)
    (hcontract : ∀ i t u, |Y i t - Y i u| ≤ |X i t - X i u|) :
    (∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * Y i t ∂rademacherVector ι) ≤
      ∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i t ∂rademacherVector ι
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A (s : Finset ι) (i : ι) (t : T) := if i ∈ s then Y i t else X i t
  have hA (s : Finset ι) (i : ι) (t : T) : |A s i t| ≤ max R S := by
    dsimp [A]
    split_ifs
    · exact (hY i t).trans (le_max_right R S)
    · exact (hX i t).trans (le_max_left R S)
  have hI (s : Finset ι) : Integrable
      (fun r : ι → ℝ => ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * A s i t) (rademacherVector ι) :=
    integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_of_bounded (A s) (hA s)
  have hstep (s : Finset ι) (i : ι) (hi : i ∉ s) :
      (∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ j, r j * A (insert i s) j t ∂rademacherVector ι) ≤
        ∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ j, r j * A s j t ∂rademacherVector ι := by
    rw [← integral_integral_update_pi (fun _ : ι => rademacherMeasure) i (hI (insert i s)),
      ← integral_integral_update_pi (fun _ : ι => rademacherMeasure) i (hI s)]
    apply integral_mono
      (integrable_integral_update_pi (fun _ : ι => rademacherMeasure) i (hI (insert i s)))
      (integrable_integral_update_pi (fun _ : ι => rademacherMeasure) i (hI s))
    intro r
    dsimp only []
    rw [integral_rademacherMeasure, integral_rademacherMeasure]
    let b (t : T) := ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, r j * A s j t
    have hsplit (q : Finset ι) (v : ℝ) (t : T) :
        (∑ j, Function.update r i v j * A q j t) =
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, r j * A q j t) + v * A q i t := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
      simp only [Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1]
    have hsamerest (v : ℝ) (t : T) :
        (∑ j, Function.update r i v j * A (insert i s) j t) = b t + v * Y i t := by
      rw [hsplit]
      have hs : A (insert i s) i t = Y i t := by simp [A]
      rw [hs]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have hji : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
      simp only [A, Finset.mem_insert, hji, false_or]
    have hsameold (v : ℝ) (t : T) :
        (∑ j, Function.update r i v j * A s j t) = b t + v * X i t := by
      rw [hsplit]
      simp only [A, hi, if_false]
      rfl
    simp_rw [hsamerest, hsameold, one_mul, neg_one_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by norm_num)
    apply Real.ciSup_add_ciSup_le_of_abs_sub_le b (X i) (Y i)
    · refine ⟨(∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, |r j| * max R S) + R, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      apply add_le_add _ ((le_abs_self _).trans (hX i t))
      dsimp [b]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans <| (abs_mul _ _).trans_le <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA s j t) (abs_nonneg _)
    · refine ⟨(∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, |r j| * max R S) + R, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      change b t + -(X i t) ≤ _
      apply add_le_add _ ((neg_le_abs _).trans (hX i t))
      dsimp [b]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans <| (abs_mul _ _).trans_le <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA s j t) (abs_nonneg _)
    · exact hcontract i
  have hind (s : Finset ι) :
      (∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * A s i t ∂rademacherVector ι) ≤
        ∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * A ∅ i t ∂rademacherVector ι := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact le_rfl
    | @insert i s hi ih => exact (hstep s i hi).trans ih
  simpa only [A, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.notMem_empty, if_true, if_false] using hind Finset.univ

name: NLAlib.integral_ciSup_sum_mul_sq_rademacherVector_le
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_mul_sq_rademacherVector_le
    (X : ι → T → ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hX : ∀ i t, |X i t| ≤ R) :
    (∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i t ^ 2 ∂rademacherVector ι) ≤
      2 * R * ∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i t ∂rademacherVector ι
proof:
:= by
  have hscaled (i : ι) (t : T) : |2 * R * X i t| ≤ 2 * R ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hX i t) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R)]
  have hsquare (i : ι) (t : T) : |X i t ^ 2| ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hX i t)
  have hdiff (i : ι) (t u : T) :
      |X i t ^ 2 - X i u ^ 2| ≤ |2 * R * X i t - 2 * R * X i u| := by
    have hs : |X i t + X i u| ≤ 2 * R :=
      (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hX i t, hX i u])
    calc
      _ = |X i t - X i u| * |X i t + X i u| := by
        rw [← abs_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
      _ ≤ |X i t - X i u| * (2 * R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R)]
        ring
  have h := integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_of_abs_sub_le
    (fun i t => 2 * R * X i t) (fun i t => X i t ^ 2) hscaled hsquare hdiff
  have he (r : ι → ℝ) :
      (⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * (2 * R * X i t)) = 2 * R * (⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i t) := by
    rw [Real.mul_iSup_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R)]
    congr 1
    funext t
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  simp_rw [he] at h
  rw [integral_const_mul] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_neg_rademacherMeasure
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_neg_rademacherMeasure :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : ℝ => -x) rademacherMeasure rademacherMeasure
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurable_neg, ?_⟩
  rw [rademacherMeasure, Measure.map_add _ _ measurable_neg,
    Measure.map_smul, Measure.map_smul]
  simp only [Measure.map_dirac' measurable_neg]
  simp only [neg_neg]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_update_neg_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_update_neg_rademacherVector (i : κ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : κ → ℝ => Function.update x i (-x i))
      (rademacherVector _)
      (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let f (j : κ) (t : ℝ) := if j = i then -t else t
  have hf (j : κ) : MeasurePreserving (f j) rademacherMeasure rademacherMeasure := by
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · simpa only [f, hji, if_true] using measurePreserving_neg_rademacherMeasure
    · change MeasurePreserving (fun t => if j = i then -t else t) rademacherMeasure rademacherMeasure
      simp only [hji, if_false]
      exact MeasurePreserving.id rademacherMeasure
  have h := measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : κ => rademacherMeasure)
    (fun _ : κ => rademacherMeasure) hf
  convert h using 1
  funext x j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j; simp only [Function.update_self, f, if_true]
  · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hji, f, hji, if_false]

name: NLAlib.integral_update_neg_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem integral_update_neg_rademacherVector
    (i : κ) (f : (κ → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫ x, f (Function.update x i (-x i)) ∂(rademacherVector _)) =
      ∫ x, f x ∂(rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  have h := measurePreserving_update_neg_rademacherVector i
  calc _ = ∫ x, f x ∂(rademacherVector κ).map
        (fun x => Function.update x i (-x i)) :=
      (integral_map h.measurable.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [h.map_eq]

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_mul_coordinate_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_mul_coordinate_rademacherVector (i j : κ) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, x i * x j ∂(rademacherVector _)) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    have hsign : ∀ᵐ x : κ → ℝ ∂(rademacherVector _),
        x i = 1 ∨ x i = -1 :=
      (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := fun _ : κ => rademacherMeasure) (i := i)).eventually
        ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_rademacherMeasure
    have he : (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * x i) =ᵐ[(rademacherVector _)]
        fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := hsign.mono fun x hx => by rcases hx with h | h <;> simp [h]
    rw [integral_congr_ae he]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hij]
    have hflip := integral_update_neg_rademacherVector i
      (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * x j) (by fun_prop)
    simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij), neg_mul,
      integral_neg] at hflip
    linarith

name: NLAlib.ae_norm_le_one_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem ae_norm_le_one_rademacherVector :
    ∀ᵐ x : κ → ℝ ∂(rademacherVector _), ‖x‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : ∀ j : κ, ∀ᵐ x : κ → ℝ ∂(rademacherVector _),
      x j = 1 ∨ x j = -1 := fun j =>
    (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := fun _ : κ => rademacherMeasure) (i := j)).eventually
      ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_rademacherMeasure
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_all.2 hcoord] with x hx
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).2
  intro j
  rcases hx j with h | h <;> simp [h]

name: NLAlib.integrable_coordinate_mul_coordinate_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_mul_coordinate_rademacherVector (i j : κ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * x j)
      (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [ae_norm_le_one_rademacherVector (κ := κ)] with x hx
  rw [norm_mul]
  have hi : ‖x i‖ ≤ 1 := (norm_le_pi_norm x i).trans hx
  have hj : ‖x j‖ ≤ 1 := (norm_le_pi_norm x j).trans hx
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul hi hj (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one

name: NLAlib.integrable_rademacherVector_of_polynomial_growth
statement:
theorem integrable_rademacherVector_of_polynomial_growth
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (C : ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) :
    Integrable f (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hC : 0 ≤ C
  · apply (integrable_const (C * 2 ^ d : ℝ)).mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_norm_le_one_rademacherVector (κ := κ)] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc _ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d := hbound x
      _ ≤ C * 2 ^ d := by gcongr; linarith
  · have heq : f = 0 := by
      funext x
      have h := hbound x
      have hn : C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (lt_of_not_ge hC) (by positivity)
      exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (abs_nonneg (f x))) (lt_of_le_of_lt h hn))
    rw [heq]
    exact integrable_zero _ _ _

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_dotProduct_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_dotProduct_rademacherVector
    (u : ι → ℝ) (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x : ι → ℝ => u ⬝ᵥ x) 1 (rademacherVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∑ i, u i ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self u
    rw [hu] at h
    simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two, one_mul] using h.symm
  have hproxy : (∑ i, Real.toNNReal (u i ^ 2) * (1 : ℝ≥0)) = 1 := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one,
      Real.coe_toNNReal', max_eq_left (sq_nonneg _)] using hs
  have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_finset_sum_mul_of_iIndepFun
    (iIndepFun_eval_rademacherVector ι)
    (c := fun _ => (1 : ℝ≥0))
    (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hasLaw_eval_rademacherVector i)) u
  simpa only [hproxy, dotProduct] using h

name: NLAlib.lintegral_exp_sq_dotProduct_rademacherVector_le_two
statement:
theorem lintegral_exp_sq_dotProduct_rademacherVector_le_two
    (u : ι → ℝ) (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
    (∫⁻ x : ι → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 / (10 : ℝ) ^ 2))
      ∂rademacherVector ι) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmgf := hasSubgaussianMGF_dotProduct_rademacherVector u hu
  have he0 := Real.exp_pos (1 : ℝ)
  have he3 := Real.exp_one_lt_three
  have hsmall : (1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1 < 1 := by linarith
  have hi := integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le hmgf
    (θ := 1 / 100) (C0 := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hsmall
  have hb := integral_exp_mul_sq_le_one_add_tail_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le hmgf
    (θ := 1 / 100) (C0 := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hsmall
  have hbound : (∫ x : ι → ℝ, Real.exp ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2)
      ∂rademacherVector ι) ≤ 2 := by
    apply hb.trans
    have hden : 0 < 1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1 := by linarith
    rw [show Real.exp 1 * ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1 *
        (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1)⁻¹) =
        (Real.exp 1 * ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1)) /
          (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1) by ring]
    have heSq : Real.exp 1 ^ 2 < 9 := by nlinarith
    have ht : Real.exp 1 * ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1) /
        (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 * Real.exp 1) ≤ 1 :=
      (div_le_one hden).2 (by nlinarith)
    linarith
  have hexp (x : ι → ℝ) : Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 / (10 : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      Real.exp ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) := by congr 1; ring
  simp_rw [hexp]
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (ae_of_all _ fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound).trans_eq (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.abs_sum_mul_le_sum_abs
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hY i t).trans (le_abs_self R)) (abs_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integrable_signed_sup_fixed
statement:
private theorem integrable_signed_sup_fixed
    {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [MeasurableSpace S] [OpensMeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (Y : ι → S → T → ℝ)
    (hYc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun x => Y i x t)) {R : ℝ}
    (hY : ∀ i x t, |Y i x t| ≤ R) (r : ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * Y i x t) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le μ
    (fun x t => ∑ i, r i * Y i x t)
  · intro t
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hYc i t).const_mul (r i)
  · intro x t
    exact abs_sum_mul_le_sum_abs (fun i t => Y i x t) (fun i t => hY i x t) r t

name: NLAlib.integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous
statement:
theorem integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous
    {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S]
    [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] (μ : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Y : ι → S → T → ℝ) (hYc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun x => Y i x t))
    {R : ℝ} (hY : ∀ i x t, |Y i x t| ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun p : S × (ι → ℝ) => ⨆ t, ∑ i, p.2 i * Y i p.1 t)
      (μ.prod (rademacherVector ι))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : S × (ι → ℝ) => ⨆ t, ∑ i, p.2 i * Y i p.1 t) := by
    apply measurable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_bddAbove
    · intro t
      exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
        ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd).mul ((hYc i t).comp continuous_fst)
    · intro p
      exact ⟨∑ i, |p.2 i| * |R|, by
        rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (abs_sum_mul_le_sum_abs (fun i t => Y i p.1 t) (fun i t => hY i p.1 t) p.2 t)⟩
  apply Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * |R|)
  have hr : ∀ᵐ p : S × (ι → ℝ) ∂μ.prod (rademacherVector ι), ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := rademacherVector ι)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (ae_norm_le_one_rademacherVector (κ := ι))
  filter_upwards [hr] with p hp
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply Real.abs_ciSup_le_of_abs_le
  intro t
  apply (abs_sum_mul_le_sum_abs (fun i t => Y i p.1 t) (fun i t => hY i p.1 t) p.2 t).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, |R| := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hi : |p.2 i| ≤ 1 := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (norm_le_pi_norm p.2 i).trans hp
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (abs_nonneg R)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.integral_signed_copy_sub_eq
statement:
private theorem integral_signed_copy_sub_eq
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
