    {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R)
    (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, r i = 1 ∨ r i = -1) :
    (∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
      ∑ i, r i * (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
        ∂(Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) =
      ∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
        ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
          ∂(Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  let pairLaw := Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)
  let U (q : ι → Ω × Ω) := ⨆ t, ∑ i, (X i (q i).1 t - X i (q i).2 t)
  let V (q : ι → Ω × Ω) := ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * (X i (q i).1 t - X i (q i).2 t)
  have hUc (t : T) : Continuous (fun q : ι → Ω × Ω =>
      ∑ i, (X i (q i).1 t - X i (q i).2 t)) := by
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
      ((hXc i t).comp (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_apply i))).sub
        ((hXc i t).comp (continuous_snd.comp (continuous_apply i)))
  have hUb (q : ι → Ω × Ω) (t : T) :
      |∑ i, (X i (q i).1 t - X i (q i).2 t)| ≤
        (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (2 * |R|) := by
    apply (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, (2 * |R|) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hs : |X i (q i).1 t - X i (q i).2 t| ≤
            |X i (q i).1 t| + |X i (q i).2 t| := abs_sub _ _
        exact hs.trans (by linarith [hX i (q i).1 t, hX i (q i).2 t, le_abs_self R])
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hUi : Integrable U pairLaw := integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le pairLaw _ hUc hUb
  have hswap (q : ι → Ω × Ω) :
      U (fun i => if r i = -1 then (q i).swap else q i) = V q := by
    dsimp only [U, V]
    congr 1
    funext t
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rcases hr i with hi | hi
    · norm_num [hi]
    · simp only [hi, if_true, Prod.swap, neg_one_mul]
      ring
  have hMP := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Ω Ω ι ν ν
  have hU := hMP.integral_comp' (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
    ⨆ t, ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t))
  have hV := hMP.integral_comp' (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
    ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t))
  change (∫ q, U q ∂pairLaw) = _ at hU
  change (∫ q, V q ∂pairLaw) = _ at hV
  calc
    _ = ∫ q, V q ∂pairLaw := hV.symm
    _ = ∫ q, U (fun i => if r i = -1 then (q i).swap else q i) ∂pairLaw := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun q => (hswap q).symm
    _ = ∫ q, U q ∂pairLaw :=
      integral_pi_prod_swap_if ν (fun i => r i = -1) U hUi.aestronglyMeasurable
    _ = _ := hU

name: NLAlib.integral_signed_copy_sub_le_add
statement:
private theorem integral_signed_copy_sub_le_add
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R) (r : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
      ∑ i, r i * (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
        ∂(Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) ≤
      (∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i (x i) t ∂Measure.pi ν) +
        ∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * (-X i (x i) t) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  have hDc (i : ι) (t : T) : Continuous (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) :=
    ((hXc i t).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst)).sub
      ((hXc i t).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd))
  have hDb (i : ι) (p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) (t : T) :
      |X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t| ≤ 2 * |R| :=
    (abs_sub _ _).trans
      (by linarith [hX i (p.1 i) t, hX i (p.2 i) t, le_abs_self R])
  have hD := integrable_signed_sup_fixed (μ.prod μ)
    (fun i p t => X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) hDc hDb r
  have hF := integrable_signed_sup_fixed μ (fun i x t => X i (x i) t)
    (fun i t => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)) (fun i x t => hX i (x i) t) r
  have hN := integrable_signed_sup_fixed μ (fun i x t => -X i (x i) t)
    (fun i t => ((hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).neg)
    (fun i x t => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hX i (x i) t) r
  have hle := integral_mono hD ((hF.comp_fst μ).add (hN.comp_snd μ)) (fun p => by
    apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    have h1 := le_ciSup (Real.bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le
      (fun i t => X i (p.1 i) t) (fun i t => hX i (p.1 i) t) r) t
    have h2 := le_ciSup (Real.bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le
      (fun i t => -X i (p.2 i) t)
        (fun i t => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hX i (p.2 i) t) r) t
    calc
      _ = (∑ i, r i * X i (p.1 i) t) + ∑ i, r i * (-X i (p.2 i) t) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add h1 h2)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hle
  rw [integral_add (hF.comp_fst μ) (hN.comp_snd μ),
    integral_prod _ (hF.comp_fst μ), integral_prod _ (hN.comp_snd μ)] at hle
  simpa only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] using hle

name: NLAlib.integral_ciSup_sum_copy_sub_le_two_mul_integral_rademacherVector
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_copy_sub_le_two_mul_integral_rademacherVector
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R) :
    (∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
      ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
        ∂(Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) ≤
      2 * ∫ x : ι → Ω, ∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t,
        ∑ i, r i * X i (x i) t ∂rademacherVector ι ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let F (x : ι → Ω) (r : ι → ℝ) := ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i (x i) t
  let N (x : ι → Ω) (r : ι → ℝ) := ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * (-X i (x i) t)
  let G (p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) (r : ι → ℝ) :=
    ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t)
  let d := ∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
    ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) ∂μ.prod μ
  have hF : Integrable (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → ℝ) => F p.1 p.2)
      (μ.prod (rademacherVector ι)) :=
    integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous μ
      (fun i x t => X i (x i) t)
      (fun i t => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)) (fun i x t => hX i (x i) t)
  have hN : Integrable (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → ℝ) => N p.1 p.2)
      (μ.prod (rademacherVector ι)) :=
    integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous μ
      (fun i x t => -X i (x i) t)
      (fun i t => ((hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).neg)
      (fun i x t => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hX i (x i) t)
  have hDc (i : ι) (t : T) : Continuous (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) :=
    ((hXc i t).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst)).sub
      ((hXc i t).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd))
  have hDb (i : ι) (p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) (t : T) :
      |X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t| ≤ 2 * |R| :=
    (abs_sub _ _).trans
      (by linarith [hX i (p.1 i) t, hX i (p.2 i) t, le_abs_self R])
  have hG : Integrable (fun q : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) × (ι → ℝ) => G q.1 q.2)
      ((μ.prod μ).prod (rademacherVector ι)) :=
    integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous (μ.prod μ)
      (fun i p t => X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) hDc hDb
  have hsign : ∀ᵐ r : ι → ℝ ∂rademacherVector ι, ∀ i, r i = 1 ∨ r i = -1 := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    exact ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hasLaw_eval_rademacherVector i)
  have hconst : (fun r : ι → ℝ => ∫ p, G p r ∂μ.prod μ) =ᵐ[rademacherVector ι]
      fun _ => d := hsign.mono fun r hr => integral_signed_copy_sub_eq ν X hXc hX r hr
  have hle := integral_mono hG.integral_prod_right
    (hF.integral_prod_right.add hN.integral_prod_right)
    (fun r => integral_signed_copy_sub_le_add ν X hXc hX r)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hle
  rw [integral_congr_ae hconst, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul,
    integral_add hF.integral_prod_right hN.integral_prod_right] at hle
  have hswapF : (∫ r, ∫ x, F x r ∂μ ∂rademacherVector ι) =
      ∫ x, ∫ r, F x r ∂rademacherVector ι ∂μ :=
    (integral_integral_swap hF).symm
  have hswapN : (∫ r, ∫ x, N x r ∂μ ∂rademacherVector ι) =
      ∫ x, ∫ r, N x r ∂rademacherVector ι ∂μ :=
    (integral_integral_swap hN).symm
  rw [hswapF, hswapN] at hle
  have hneg : (∫ x, ∫ r, N x r ∂rademacherVector ι ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ x, ∫ r, F x r ∂rademacherVector ι ∂μ := by
    apply integral_mono hN.integral_prod_left hF.integral_prod_left
    intro x
    apply integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_of_abs_sub_le
      (fun i t => X i (x i) t) (fun i t => -X i (x i) t)
      (fun i t => hX i (x i) t)
      (fun i t => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hX i (x i) t)
    intro i t u
    rw [neg_sub_neg, abs_sub_comm]
  change d ≤ 2 * ∫ x, ∫ r, F x r ∂rademacherVector ι ∂μ
  linarith

name: NLAlib.ciSup_sum_neg_eq_of_sign_closed
statement:
private theorem ciSup_sum_neg_eq_of_sign_closed
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R)
    (hneg : ∀ t, ∃ u, ∀ i ω, X i ω u = -X i ω t) (x : ι → Ω) :
    (⨆ t, ∑ i, -X i (x i) t) = ⨆ t, ∑ i, X i (x i) t
proof:
:= by
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ∑ i, X i (x i) t) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using Real.bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le
      (fun i t => X i (x i) t) (fun i t => hX i (x i) t) (fun _ => 1)
  have hn : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ∑ i, -X i (x i) t) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using Real.bddAbove_range_sum_mul_of_abs_le
      (fun i t => -X i (x i) t)
      (fun i t => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hX i (x i) t) (fun _ => 1)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hneg t
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, X i (x i) u := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact (hu i (x i)).symm
      _ ≤ _ := le_ciSup hb u
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hneg t
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, -X i (x i) u := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [hu i (x i), neg_neg]
      _ ≤ _ := le_ciSup hn u

name: NLAlib.integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_two_mul_of_centered
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_two_mul_of_centered
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R : ℝ} (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i t, ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i = 0)
    (hneg : ∀ t, ∃ u, ∀ i ω, X i ω u = -X i ω t) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, ∫ r : ι → ℝ, ⨆ t,
      ∑ i, r i * X i (x i) t ∂rademacherVector ι ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      2 * ∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, X i (x i) t ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let F (x : ι → Ω) (r : ι → ℝ) := ⨆ t, ∑ i, r i * X i (x i) t
  let d := ∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
    ∑ i, (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) ∂μ.prod μ
  have hF : Integrable (fun p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → ℝ) => F p.1 p.2)
      (μ.prod (rademacherVector ι)) :=
    integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous μ
      (fun i x t => X i (x i) t)
      (fun i t => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)) (fun i x t => hX i (x i) t)
  have hsign : ∀ᵐ r : ι → ℝ ∂rademacherVector ι, ∀ i, r i = 1 ∨ r i = -1 := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    exact ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_hasLaw_rademacherMeasure (hasLaw_eval_rademacherVector i)
  have hpoint (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, r i = 1 ∨ r i = -1) :
      (∫ x, F x r ∂μ) ≤ d := by
    have hY (i : ι) (ω : Ω) (t : T) : |r i * X i ω t| ≤ |R| := by
      have hi : |r i| = 1 := by rcases hr i with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]
      rw [abs_mul, hi, one_mul]
      exact (hX i ω t).trans (le_abs_self R)
    have hYmean (t : T) : (∑ i, ∫ ω, r i * X i ω t ∂ν i) ≤ 0 := by
      simp_rw [integral_const_mul, hmean, mul_zero]
      simp
    have h := integral_ciSup_sum_pi_le_mean_add_integral_copy_sub ν
      (fun i ω t => r i * X i ω t)
      (fun i t => (hXc i t).const_mul (r i)) hY hYmean
    have he : (∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
        ∑ i, (r i * X i (p.1 i) t - r i * X i (p.2 i) t) ∂μ.prod μ) =
        ∫ p : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), ⨆ t,
          ∑ i, r i * (X i (p.1 i) t - X i (p.2 i) t) ∂μ.prod μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      apply ae_of_all
      intro p
      dsimp only
      congr 1
      funext t
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    rw [zero_add, he, integral_signed_copy_sub_eq ν X hXc hX r hr] at h
    exact h
  have hle := integral_mono_ae hF.integral_prod_right (integrable_const d)
    (hsign.mono fun r hr => hpoint r hr)
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hle
  rw [← integral_integral_swap hF] at hle
  have htri := integral_signed_copy_sub_le_add ν X hXc hX (fun _ => 1)
  simp only [one_mul] at htri
  simp_rw [ciSup_sum_neg_eq_of_sign_closed X hX hneg] at htri
  change (∫ x, ∫ r, F x r ∂rademacherVector ι ∂μ) ≤ _
  change d ≤ _ at htri
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_ciSup_sum_sq_le_mean_add_eight_mul_of_centered
statement:
theorem integral_ciSup_sum_sq_le_mean_add_eight_mul_of_centered
    (X : ι → Ω → T → ℝ) (hXc : ∀ i t, Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hX : ∀ i ω t, |X i ω t| ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i t, ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i = 0)
    (hneg : ∀ t, ∃ u, ∀ i ω, X i ω u = -X i ω t)
    (hvariance : ∀ t, (∑ i, ∫ ω, X i ω t ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, X i (x i) t ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      v + 8 * R * ∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ∑ i, X i (x i) t ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  have hSq (i : ι) (ω : Ω) (t : T) : |X i ω t ^ 2| ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hX i ω t)
  have hcenter := integral_ciSup_sum_pi_le_mean_add_integral_copy_sub ν
    (fun i ω t => X i ω t ^ 2) (fun i t => (hXc i t).pow 2) hSq hvariance
  have hcopy := integral_ciSup_sum_copy_sub_le_two_mul_integral_rademacherVector ν
    (fun i ω t => X i ω t ^ 2) (fun i t => (hXc i t).pow 2) hSq
  have hF := integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous μ
    (fun i x t => X i (x i) t)
    (fun i t => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)) (fun i x t => hX i (x i) t)
  have hQ := integrable_ciSup_sum_mul_prod_rademacherVector_of_continuous μ
    (fun i x t => X i (x i) t ^ 2)
    (fun i t => ((hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).pow 2) (fun i x t => hSq i (x i) t)
  have hcontract := integral_mono hQ.integral_prod_left
    (hF.integral_prod_left.const_mul (2 * R)) (fun x =>
      integral_ciSup_sum_mul_sq_rademacherVector_le (fun i t => X i (x i) t)
        hR (fun i t => hX i (x i) t))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hcontract
  have hreverse := integral_ciSup_sum_mul_rademacherVector_le_two_mul_of_centered ν
    X hXc hX hmean hneg
  have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcontract (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreverse (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * R)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.tendsto_dTransformMoment_of_weak_convergence
statement:
theorem tendsto_dTransformMoment_of_weak_convergence
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {μs : I → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ} {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
    (hweak : Tendsto μs l (𝓝 μ)) {bs : I → ℝ} {b y : ℝ}
    (hbs : Tendsto bs l (𝓝 b)) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hs : ∀ i, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 (bs i))
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun i => dTransformMoment (μs i : Measure ℝ) k y) l
      (𝓝 (dTransformMoment (μ : Measure ℝ) k y))
proof:
:= by
  let c := (b + y) / 2
  have hbc : b < c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
  have hcy : c < y := by dsimp [c]; linarith
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := hb.trans hbc.le
  have hsc : ∀ᶠ i in l, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 c := by
    filter_upwards [hbs.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hbc)] with i hi z hz
    exact ⟨(hs i hz).1, (hs i hz).2.trans hi.le⟩
  have hμc : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 c :=
    fun z hz => ⟨(hμ hz).1, (hμ hz).2.trans hbc.le⟩
  exact ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_integral_of_support_subset_Icc hweak hc hsc hμc
    (((continuousOn_const.sub (continuousOn_id.pow 2)).inv₀
      (fun z hz => (dTransform_denominator_pos hc hcy hz).ne')).pow (k + 1))

name: NLAlib.tendsto_singularValuePsi_of_weak_convergence
statement:
theorem tendsto_singularValuePsi_of_weak_convergence
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {μs : I → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ} {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
    (hweak : Tendsto μs l (𝓝 μ)) {bs γs : I → ℝ} {b γ y : ℝ}
    (hbs : Tendsto bs l (𝓝 b)) (hγs : Tendsto γs l (𝓝 γ))
    (hbs0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ bs i) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ i, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 (bs i))
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    Tendsto (fun i => singularValuePsi (μs i : Measure ℝ) (γs i) y) l
      (𝓝 (singularValuePsi (μ : Measure ℝ) γ y))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := tendsto_dTransformMoment_of_weak_convergence hweak hbs hb hs hμ hy 0
  have h1 := tendsto_dTransformMoment_of_weak_convergence hweak hbs hb hs hμ hy 1
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := (hb.trans_lt hy).ne'
  have hp : Tendsto (fun i => singularValuePhi (μs i : Measure ℝ) y) l
      (𝓝 (singularValuePhi (μ : Measure ℝ) y)) := by
    simpa only [singularValuePhi_eq_mul_moment] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := y)).mul h0
  have hd := h0.sub ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := 2 * y ^ 2)).mul h1)
  have hc : Tendsto (fun i => singularValueCompanionPhi (μs i : Measure ℝ) (γs i) y) l
      (𝓝 (singularValueCompanionPhi (μ : Measure ℝ) γ y)) := by
    exact (hγs.mul hp).add (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub hγs).div
      tendsto_const_nhds hy0)
  have hdc := (hγs.mul hd).sub
    (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub hγs).div tendsto_const_nhds (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0))
  have hden : singularValuePhi (μ : Measure ℝ) y *
      singularValueCompanionPhi (μ : Measure ℝ) γ y ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (singularValuePhi_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) hb hμ hy).ne'
      (singularValueCompanionPhi_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) hγ hγ1 hb hμ hy).ne'
  have ht := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := y)).mul ((hd.mul hc).add (hp.mul hdc))).div
    (hp.mul hc) hden
  rw [← singularValuePsi_eq_moments (μ : Measure ℝ) hb hμ hy] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [hbs.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hy)] with i hi
  exact (singularValuePsi_eq_moments (μs i : Measure ℝ) (hbs0 i) (hs i) hi).symm

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment_kernel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment_kernel (k : ℕ) (y z : ℝ)
    (hden : y ^ 2 - z ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ((t ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1))
      (-2 * (k + 1 : ℝ) * y * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 2)) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 2).sub_const (z ^ 2)).inv hden).pow (k + 1)
  convert! h using 1
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply, Pi.inv_apply, id_eq, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add,
    Nat.cast_one, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow, pow_add]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) (k : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (dTransformMoment μ k)
      (-2 * (k + 1 : ℝ) * y * dTransformMoment μ (k + 1) y) y
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.1 ∧ p.2 ^ 2 < p.1 ^ 2}
  let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t z => ((t ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1)
  let D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun t z =>
    (-2 * (k + 1 : ℝ) * t * ((t ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 2)) • 1
  have hU : IsOpen U := (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_snd.pow 2) (continuous_fst.pow 2))
  have hden (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ U) : p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr hp.2).ne'
  have hinv : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) U :=
    ((continuous_fst.pow 2).sub (continuous_snd.pow 2)).continuousOn.inv₀ hden
  have hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) U := hinv.pow (k + 1)
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.1 p.2) U :=
    (((continuous_const.mul continuous_fst).continuousOn.mul (hinv.pow (k + 2))).smul
      continuousOn_const)
  have hderiv (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ U) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun t => F t p.2) (D p.1 p.2) p.1 := by
    convert! (hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment_kernel k p.1 p.2 (hden p hp)).hasFDerivAt using 1
    ext
    simp [D, mul_comm]
  have hpoint (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ μ.support) : (y, z) ∈ U :=
    ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hb hy, sub_pos.mp (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy (hsupport hz))⟩
  have h := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_compact_support μ
    (μ.isCompact_support_of_subset_Icc hsupport) F D U hU hF hD hderiv y hpoint
  have hDint : (∫ z, D y z ∂μ) =
      (-2 * (k + 1 : ℝ) * y * dTransformMoment μ (k + 1) y) •
        (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    simp only [D, integral_smul_const, integral_const_mul, dTransformMoment, Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [hDint] at h
  convert! h.hasDerivAt using 1
  simp only [dTransformMoment, smul_apply, one_apply_eq_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    HasDerivAt (singularValuePhi μ)
      (dTransformMoment μ 0 y - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_id y).mul (hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment μ hb hsupport hy 0)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_one] at h
  have he : (fun t => t * dTransformMoment μ 0 t) = singularValuePhi μ :=
    funext fun t => (singularValuePhi_eq_mul_moment μ t).symm
  change HasDerivAt (fun t => t * dTransformMoment μ 0 t)
    (1 * dTransformMoment μ 0 y + y * (-2 * y * dTransformMoment μ 1 y)) y at h
  rw [he] at h
  convert! h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_singularValuePsi_eq_neg_four
statement:
theorem existsUnique_singularValuePsi_eq_neg_four
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {γ b : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :
    ∃! y, b < y ∧ y ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * b ∧ singularValuePsi μ γ y = -4
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 1 < Real.sqrt 3 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3), Real.sqrt_nonneg (3 : ℝ)]
  have hhi : b < Real.sqrt 3 * b := by nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsqrt hb]
  have he := tendsto_singularValuePsi_atBot_of_edge_thickness μ hγ.le hγ1 hb hsupport hthick
  let : NeBot (𝓝[>] b) := nhdsWithin_Ioi_neBot le_rfl
  have hay : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[>] b, b < y := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨ha, hpa⟩, hahi⟩ := ((hay.and (he.eventually_lt_atBot (-4))).and
    (mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hhi))).exists
  have hc := (continuousOn_singularValuePsi μ hγ.le hγ1 hb.le hsupport).mono
    (show Icc a (Real.sqrt 3 * b) ⊆ Ioi b from fun x hx => ha.trans_le hx.1)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hre⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hahi.le hc
    (show (-4 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (singularValuePsi μ γ a)
      (singularValuePsi μ γ (Real.sqrt 3 * b)) from
      ⟨hpa.le, neg_four_le_singularValuePsi_sqrt_three_mul μ hγ.le hγ1 hb hsupport⟩)
  refine ⟨r, ⟨ha.trans_le hr.1, hr.2, hre⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact (strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem).injOn
    hy.1 (ha.trans_le hr.1) (hy.2.2.trans hre.symm)

name: NLAlib.screeThreshold_eq_of_root
statement:
theorem screeThreshold_eq_of_root (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b r : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hr : b < r) (hre : singularValuePsi μ γ r = -4) :
    screeThreshold μ γ b = r
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : r ∈ {y | b < y ∧ -4 ≤ singularValuePsi μ γ y} := ⟨hr, hre.symm.le⟩
  apply csInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt ⟨r, hmem⟩
  · intro y hy
    by_contra h
    have hlt := strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem hy.1 hr
      (lt_of_not_ge h)
    rw [hre] at hlt
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hy.2) hlt
  · intro w hw
    exact ⟨r, hmem, hw⟩

name: NLAlib.screeThreshold_spec
statement:
theorem screeThreshold_spec (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {γ b : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :
    b < screeThreshold μ γ b ∧ screeThreshold μ γ b ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * b ∧
      singularValuePsi μ γ (screeThreshold μ γ b) = -4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _⟩ := existsUnique_singularValuePsi_eq_neg_four μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem hthick
  rwa [screeThreshold_eq_of_root μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem hr.1 hr.2.2]

name: NLAlib.singularValuePsi_eq_neg_four_iff_eq_screeThreshold
statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_eq_neg_four_iff_eq_screeThreshold
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {γ b y : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePsi μ γ y = -4 ↔ y = screeThreshold μ γ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    exact (screeThreshold_eq_of_root μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem hy he).symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact (screeThreshold_spec μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem hthick).2.2

name: NLAlib.bisectionInterval_screeThreshold
statement:
theorem bisectionInterval_screeThreshold (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) (j : ℕ) :
    let p
proof:
:= bisectionInterval (singularValuePsi μ γ) (-4) b (Real.sqrt 3 * b) j
    b ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 < screeThreshold μ γ b ∧ screeThreshold μ γ b ≤ p.2 ∧
      p.2 - p.1 = (Real.sqrt 3 - 1) * b / 2 ^ j := by
  obtain ⟨hl, hu, he⟩ := screeThreshold_spec μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem hthick
  have hp := bisectionInterval_contains_root
    (strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hbmem) he le_rfl hl hu j
  refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2, ?_⟩
  rw [bisectionInterval_sub]
  ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_singularValuePsi_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_singularValuePsi_atTop (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) :
    Tendsto (singularValuePsi μ γ) atTop (𝓝 (-2))
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 - b ^ 2) atTop atTop := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (-(b ^ 2))
      (tendsto_pow_atTop (by decide : 2 ≠ 0))
  have hsmall : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => 4 * b ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_zero, Function.comp_apply] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds (x := 4 * b ^ 2)).mul (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hgap)
  have hlower : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => -2 - 4 * b ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2))
      atTop (𝓝 (-2)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (-2 : ℝ))).sub hsmall
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlower tendsto_const_nhds
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop b] with y hy
    exact (singularValuePsi_bounds μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hy).1
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop b] with y hy
    exact (singularValuePsi_bounds μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hy).2

name: NLAlib.singularValueCompanionPhi_pos
statement:
theorem singularValueCompanionPhi_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    0 < singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ) :=
    isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1
  rw [← singularValuePhi_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hy]
  exact singularValuePhi_pos _ hb (support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset μ hb hsupport) hy

name: NLAlib.singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity
statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePsi μ γ y = singularValueElasticity μ y +
      singularValueElasticity (dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ) y
proof:
:= by
  let ν := dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1
  change singularValuePsi μ γ y = singularValueElasticity μ y + singularValueElasticity ν y
  have hsν : ν.support ⊆ Icc 0 b := support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset μ hb hsupport
  have heq : singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] singularValuePhi ν := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with t ht
    exact (singularValuePhi_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport ht).symm
  have hφ := (hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi μ hb hsupport hy).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hν := (hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi ν hb hsν hy).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hc := hν.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  have hD : HasDerivAt (singularValueDTransform μ γ)
      (deriv (singularValuePhi μ) y * singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y +
        singularValuePhi μ y * deriv (singularValuePhi ν) y) y := by
    convert! hφ.mul hc using 1
  unfold singularValuePsi
  rw [hD.deriv]
  unfold singularValueDTransform singularValueElasticity
  rw [heq.eq_of_nhds]
  field_simp [(singularValuePhi_pos μ hb hsupport hy).ne',
    (singularValuePhi_pos ν hb hsν hy).ne']

name: NLAlib.continuousOn_singularValuePsi
statement:
theorem continuousOn_singularValuePsi (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) :
    ContinuousOn (singularValuePsi μ γ) (Ioi b)
proof:
:= by
  let ν := dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1
  have hsν : ν.support ⊆ Icc 0 b := support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset μ hb hsupport
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun y => singularValueElasticity μ y + singularValueElasticity ν y) (Ioi b) := by
    intro y hy
    exact ((hasDerivAt_singularValueElasticity μ hb hsupport hy).continuousAt.add
      (hasDerivAt_singularValueElasticity ν hb hsν hy).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  apply hc.congr
  intro y hy
  exact singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hy

name: NLAlib.strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support) :
    StrictMonoOn (singularValuePsi μ γ) (Ioi b)
proof:
:= by
  let ν := dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ.le hγ1
  have hsν : ν.support ⊆ Icc 0 b := support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset μ hb.le hsupport
  have hbν : b ∈ ν.support := mem_support_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hbmem
  have hm := strictMonoOn_singularValueElasticity μ hb hsupport hbmem
  have hn := strictMonoOn_singularValueElasticity ν hb hsν hbν
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rw [singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity μ hγ.le hγ1 hb.le hsupport hx,
    singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity μ hγ.le hγ1 hb.le hsupport hy]
  exact add_lt_add (hm hx hy hxy) (hn hx hy hxy)

name: NLAlib.singularValuePhi_eq_mul_moment
statement:
theorem singularValuePhi_eq_mul_moment (μ : Measure ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    singularValuePhi μ y = y * dTransformMoment μ 0 y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [singularValuePhi, dTransformMoment, zero_add, pow_one, div_eq_mul_inv,
    integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.dTransform_denominator_pos
statement:
theorem dTransform_denominator_pos {b y z : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hy : b < y)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 b) : 0 < y ^ 2 - z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := le_trans hb hy.le
  exact sub_pos.mpr ((sq_lt_sq₀ hz.1 hy0).mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hz.2 hy))

name: NLAlib.integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel
statement:
theorem integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z => ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hden (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ μ.support) : y ^ 2 - z ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy (hsupport hz)).ne'
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ => ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1)) μ.support :=
    ((continuousOn_const.sub (continuousOn_id.pow 2)).inv₀ hden).pow (k + 1)
  have hi := hc.integrableOn_compact (μ := μ) (μ.isCompact_support_of_subset_Icc hsupport)
  have hre : μ.restrict μ.support = μ :=
    Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem (s := μ.support) μ.support_mem_ae
  rwa [IntegrableOn, hre] at hi

name: NLAlib.isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  change ENNReal.ofReal γ * μ univ + ENNReal.ofReal (1 - γ) * (Measure.dirac (0 : ℝ)) univ = 1
  rw [measure_univ, measure_univ, mul_one, mul_one,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_add hγ (sub_nonneg.mpr hγ1)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset
proof:
:= by
  apply (dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ).support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc
  apply ae_add_measure_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · exact Measure.ae_smul_measure (μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport) _
  · exact Measure.ae_smul_measure ((ae_dirac_iff measurableSet_Icc).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hb⟩) _

name: NLAlib.mem_support_dTransformCompanionMeasure
proof:
:= by
  apply (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall b).mpr
  intro U hU
  have hμU := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall b).mp hbmem U hU
  have hp : 0 < ENNReal.ofReal γ * μ U :=
    ENNReal.mul_pos (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hγ).ne' hμU.ne'
  apply hp.trans_le
  change ENNReal.ofReal γ * μ U ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal γ * μ U + ENNReal.ofReal (1 - γ) * (Measure.dirac (0 : ℝ)) U
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le

name: NLAlib.singularValuePhi_dTransformCompanionMeasure
statement:
theorem singularValuePhi_dTransformCompanionMeasure (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePhi (dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ) y = singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun z => y / (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 0).const_mul y
  have hid : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => y / (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)) (Measure.dirac 0) :=
    integrable_dirac (by finiteness)
  unfold singularValuePhi dTransformCompanionMeasure
  rw [integral_add_measure (hi.smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
      (hid.smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top), integral_smul_measure, integral_smul_measure,
    integral_dirac, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hγ, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hγ1)]
  unfold singularValueCompanionPhi singularValuePhi
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), sub_zero]
  congr 1
  field_simp [(lt_of_le_of_lt hb hy).ne']

name: NLAlib.singularValuePhi_pos
statement:
theorem singularValuePhi_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    0 < singularValuePhi μ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [singularValuePhi_eq_mul_moment]
  exact mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt hb hy) (dTransformMoment_pos μ hb hsupport hy 0)

name: NLAlib.singularValueElasticity_eq_moments
statement:
theorem singularValueElasticity_eq_moments (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValueElasticity μ y =
      1 - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y / dTransformMoment μ 0 y
proof:
:= by
  unfold singularValueElasticity
  rw [(hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi μ hb hsupport hy).deriv, singularValuePhi_eq_mul_moment]
  field_simp [(dTransformMoment_pos μ hb hsupport hy 0).ne', (lt_of_le_of_lt hb hy).ne']

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_singularValueElasticity
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_singularValueElasticity (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    HasDerivAt (singularValueElasticity μ)
      (4 * y * (2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 2 y * dTransformMoment μ 0 y -
        y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y ^ 2 -
        dTransformMoment μ 1 y * dTransformMoment μ 0 y) / dTransformMoment μ 0 y ^ 2) y
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment μ hb hsupport hy 0
  have h1 := hasDerivAt_dTransformMoment μ hb hsupport hy 1
  have hnum := (((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 2).const_mul 2).mul h1
  have hquot := (hnum.div h0 (dTransformMoment_pos μ hb hsupport hy 0).ne').const_sub 1
  have heq : singularValueElasticity μ =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
      (fun t => 1 - 2 * t ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 t / dTransformMoment μ 0 t) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with t ht
    exact singularValueElasticity_eq_moments μ hb hsupport ht
  convert! hquot.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq using 1
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply, Pi.mul_apply, id_eq, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one,
    zero_add, mul_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  field_simp [(dTransformMoment_pos μ hb hsupport hy 0).ne']
  ring

name: NLAlib.deriv_singularValueElasticity_pos
statement:
theorem deriv_singularValueElasticity_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b)
    (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support) (hy : b < y) :
    0 < deriv (singularValueElasticity μ) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_singularValueElasticity μ hb.le hsupport hy).deriv]
  have h0 := dTransformMoment_pos μ hb.le hsupport hy 0
  have h1 := dTransformMoment_pos μ hb.le hsupport hy 1
  have hcs := dTransformMoment_one_sq_le_zero_mul_two μ hb.le hsupport hy
  have hdef := sq_mul_dTransformMoment_one_sub_zero_pos μ hb hsupport hbmem hy
  have hcs' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs (sq_nonneg y)
  have hprod := mul_pos h1 hdef
  have hn : 0 < 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 2 y * dTransformMoment μ 0 y -
      y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y ^ 2 -
      dTransformMoment μ 1 y * dTransformMoment μ 0 y := by nlinarith only [hcs', hprod]
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hb.trans hy)) hn) (sq_pos_of_pos h0)

name: NLAlib.strictMonoOn_singularValueElasticity
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_singularValueElasticity (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support) :
    StrictMonoOn (singularValueElasticity μ) (Ioi b)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ioi b)
  · intro y hy
    exact (hasDerivAt_singularValueElasticity μ hb.le hsupport hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro y hy
    exact deriv_singularValueElasticity_pos μ hb hsupport hbmem (interior_subset hy)

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_inv_sub_of_support_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem memLp_two_inv_sub_of_support_subset_Icc (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    MemLp (fun z => (y - z)⁻¹) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  apply MemLp.of_bound (by fun_prop) ((y - b)⁻¹)
  filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
  have hyz : 0 < y - z := by linarith [hz.2]
  have hyb : 0 < y - b := sub_pos.mpr hy
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hyz)]
  exact (inv_le_inv₀ hyz hyb).mpr (by linarith [hz.2])

name: NLAlib.singularValuePhi_le_integral_inv_sub
statement:
theorem singularValuePhi_le_integral_inv_sub (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePhi μ y ≤ ∫ z, (y - z)⁻¹ ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun z => y / (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 0).const_mul y
  have hk := (memLp_two_inv_sub_of_support_subset_Icc μ hsupport hy).integrable one_le_two
  apply integral_mono_ae hi hk
  filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
  have hyz : 0 < y - z := by linarith [hz.2]
  have hyp : 0 < y + z := by linarith [hz.1]
  have he : y / (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2) = (y / (y + z)) * (y - z)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp [hyz.ne', hyp.ne', (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz).ne']
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hcoeff : y / (y + z) ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hyp).mpr (by linarith [hz.1])
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (inv_nonneg.mpr hyz.le)

name: NLAlib.div_two_edgeMoment_le_neg_deriv_singularValuePhi
statement:
theorem div_two_edgeMoment_le_neg_deriv_singularValuePhi
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {b y : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValueEdgeMoment μ y / 2 ≤ -deriv (singularValuePhi μ) y
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Integrable (fun z => (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 0
  have h1 := (integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 1).const_mul (2 * y ^ 2)
  have hk := (memLp_two_inv_sub_of_support_subset_Icc μ hsupport hy).integrable_sq
  have he : -deriv (singularValuePhi μ) y =
      ∫ z, 2 * y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂μ := by
    rw [(hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi μ hb hsupport hy).deriv, integral_sub h1 h0, integral_const_mul]
    simp only [dTransformMoment, zero_add, pow_one]
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hle := integral_mono_ae (hk.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (h1.sub h0) (show
      (fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((y - z)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤ᵐ[μ]
        (fun z => 2 * y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) from by
    filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
    have hyz : 0 < y - z := by linarith [hz.2]
    have hyp : 0 < y + z := by linarith [hz.1]
    have hid : 2 * y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ =
        ((y ^ 2 + z ^ 2) / (y + z) ^ 2) * ((y - z)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [hyz.ne', hyp.ne', (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz).ne']
      ring
    rw [hid]
    have hcoeff : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (y ^ 2 + z ^ 2) / (y + z) ^ 2 := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hyp)).mpr
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - z)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (sq_nonneg _))
  change (∫ z, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((y - z)⁻¹) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ z, 2 * y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂μ at hle
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hle
  simpa only [singularValueEdgeMoment, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_comm] using hle

name: NLAlib.sqrt_edgeMoment_div_two_le_neg_deriv_div_singularValuePhi
statement:
theorem sqrt_edgeMoment_div_two_le_neg_deriv_div_singularValuePhi
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {b y : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    Real.sqrt (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y) / 2 ≤
      -deriv (singularValuePhi μ) y / singularValuePhi μ y
proof:
:= by
  have hk := memLp_two_inv_sub_of_support_subset_Icc μ hsupport hy
  have hv := variance_nonneg (fun z => (y - z)⁻¹) μ
  rw [variance_eq_sub hk] at hv
  have hN : 0 ≤ singularValueEdgeMoment μ y := integral_nonneg fun z => sq_nonneg _
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hN
  have hroot := Real.sqrt_nonneg (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y)
  have hM : (∫ z, (y - z)⁻¹ ∂μ) ≤ Real.sqrt (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y) := by
    change 0 ≤ singularValueEdgeMoment μ y - (∫ z, (y - z)⁻¹ ∂μ) ^ 2 at hv
    nlinarith
  have hφ := (singularValuePhi_le_integral_inv_sub μ hb hsupport hy).trans hM
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hφ hroot
  have hd := div_two_edgeMoment_le_neg_deriv_singularValuePhi μ hb hsupport hy
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (singularValuePhi_pos μ hb hsupport hy)).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.singularValuePsi_le_neg_sqrt_edgeMoment
statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_le_neg_sqrt_edgeMoment
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {γ b y : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePsi μ γ y ≤ -(b / 2) * Real.sqrt (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y) - 1
proof:
:= by
  let ν := dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1
  have hc := (singularValueElasticity_bounds ν hb.le
    (support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset μ hb.le hsupport) hy).2
  have hr := sqrt_edgeMoment_div_two_le_neg_deriv_div_singularValuePhi μ hb.le hsupport hy
  have hr' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (hb.trans hy).le
  have hb' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy.le
    (div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y)) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
  rw [singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity μ hγ hγ1 hb.le hsupport hy]
  change singularValueElasticity μ y + singularValueElasticity ν y ≤ _
  have he : singularValueElasticity μ y ≤ -(b / 2) * Real.sqrt (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y) := by
    calc
      singularValueElasticity μ y = -(y * (-deriv (singularValuePhi μ) y /
          singularValuePhi μ y)) := by unfold singularValueElasticity; ring
      _ ≤ -(b * (Real.sqrt (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y) / 2)) :=
        neg_le_neg (hb'.trans hr')
      _ = _ := by ring
  linarith

name: NLAlib.tendsto_singularValuePsi_atBot_of_edge_thickness
statement:
theorem tendsto_singularValuePsi_atBot_of_edge_thickness
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {γ b : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :
    Tendsto (singularValuePsi μ γ) (𝓝[>] b) atBot
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp hthick).const_mul_atTop_of_neg
    (show -(b / 2) < 0 by linarith)
  apply tendsto_atBot.mpr
  intro M
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually_le_atBot (M + 1), self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hM hy
  change -(b / 2) * Real.sqrt (singularValueEdgeMoment μ y) ≤ M + 1 at hM
  have hbound := singularValuePsi_le_neg_sqrt_edgeMoment μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hy
  linarith

name: NLAlib.tendsto_screeThreshold_of_weak_convergence
statement:
theorem tendsto_screeThreshold_of_weak_convergence
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {μs : I → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ} {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
    (hweak : Tendsto μs l (𝓝 μ)) {bs γs : I → ℝ} {b γ : ℝ}
    (hbs : Tendsto bs l (𝓝 b)) (hγs : Tendsto γs l (𝓝 γ))
    (hbs0 : ∀ i, 0 < bs i) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hγs0 : ∀ i, 0 < γs i) (hγs1 : ∀ i, γs i ≤ 1) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ i, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 (bs i))
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 b)
    (hsmem : ∀ i, bs i ∈ (μs i : Measure ℝ).support) (hbmem : b ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hsthick : ∀ i, Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment (μs i : Measure ℝ)) (𝓝[>] (bs i)) atTop)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment (μ : Measure ℝ)) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun i => screeThreshold (μs i : Measure ℝ) (γs i) (bs i)) l
      (𝓝 (screeThreshold (μ : Measure ℝ) γ b))
proof:
:= by
  have hT := screeThreshold_spec (μ : Measure ℝ) hγ hγ1 hb hμ hbmem hthick
  have hTs i := screeThreshold_spec (μs i : Measure ℝ) (hγs0 i) (hγs1 i)
    (hbs0 i) (hs i) (hsmem i) (hsthick i)
  have hf := strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi (μ : Measure ℝ) hγ hγ1 hb hμ hbmem
  have hfs i := strictMonoOn_singularValuePsi (μs i : Measure ℝ) (hγs0 i) (hγs1 i)
    (hbs0 i) (hs i) (hsmem i)
  have hconv (x : ℝ) (hx : b < x) := tendsto_singularValuePsi_of_weak_convergence
    hweak hbs hγs (fun i => (hbs0 i).le) hb.le hγ.le hγ1 hs hμ hx
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x, hax, hxT⟩ := exists_between (max_lt_iff.mpr ⟨ha, hT.1⟩)
    have hbx : b < x := (le_max_right a b).trans_lt hax
    have hax' : a < x := (le_max_left a b).trans_lt hax
    have hpx : singularValuePsi (μ : Measure ℝ) γ x < -4 := by
      rw [← hT.2.2]
      exact hf hbx hT.1 hxT
    filter_upwards [(hconv x hbx).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hpx),
      hbs.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hbx)] with i hi hbi
    have hxt : x < screeThreshold (μs i : Measure ℝ) (γs i) (bs i) := by
      apply ((hfs i).lt_iff_lt hbi (hTs i).1).mp
      rwa [(hTs i).2.2]
    exact hax'.trans hxt
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x, hTx, hxa⟩ := exists_between ha
    have hbx : b < x := hT.1.trans hTx
    have hpx : -4 < singularValuePsi (μ : Measure ℝ) γ x := by
      rw [← hT.2.2]
      exact hf hT.1 hbx hTx
    filter_upwards [(hconv x hbx).eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hpx),
      hbs.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hbx)] with i hi hbi
    have htx : screeThreshold (μs i : Measure ℝ) (γs i) (bs i) < x := by
      apply ((hfs i).lt_iff_lt (hTs i).1 hbi).mp
      rwa [(hTs i).2.2]
    exact htx.trans hxa

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_singularValueCompanionPhi
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_singularValueCompanionPhi (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    HasDerivAt (singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ)
      (γ * (dTransformMoment μ 0 y - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y) -
        (1 - γ) / y ^ 2) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi μ hb hsupport hy).const_mul γ).add
    ((hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt (hb.trans_lt hy))).const_mul (1 - γ))
  convert! h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.singularValuePsi_eq_moments
statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_eq_moments (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePsi μ γ y =
      y * ((dTransformMoment μ 0 y - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y) *
          singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y + singularValuePhi μ y *
          (γ * (dTransformMoment μ 0 y - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y) -
            (1 - γ) / y ^ 2)) /
        (singularValuePhi μ y * singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_singularValuePhi μ hb hsupport hy).mul
    (hasDerivAt_singularValueCompanionPhi (γ := γ) μ hb hsupport hy)
  change HasDerivAt (singularValueDTransform μ γ) _ y at hd
  unfold singularValuePsi
  rw [hd.deriv]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.dTransformMoment_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
  filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
  exact (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz)) (k + 1)).le

name: NLAlib.dTransformMoment_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hn := dTransformMoment_nonneg μ hb hsupport hy k
  by_contra hnot
  have hz : dTransformMoment μ k y = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnot) hn
  have hp : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun z => ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) := by
    filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
    exact (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz)) (k + 1)).le
  have he := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hp
    (integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy k)).mp hz
  obtain ⟨z, hzs, hzz⟩ := ((μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport).and he).exists
  have hpos := pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hzs)) (k + 1)
  change ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) = 0 at hzz
  linarith

name: NLAlib.dTransformMoment_one_sq_le_zero_mul_two
statement:
theorem dTransformMoment_one_sq_le_zero_mul_two (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    dTransformMoment μ 1 y ^ 2 ≤ dTransformMoment μ 0 y * dTransformMoment μ 2 y
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun z => (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
    exact (inv_pos.mpr (dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz)).le
  have h1 : Integrable (fun z => (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 0
  have h2 : Integrable (fun z => ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) μ :=
    integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 1
  have h3 : Integrable (fun z => ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 3) μ :=
    integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 2
  simpa only [dTransformMoment, zero_add, pow_one] using
    sq_integral_sq_le_integral_mul_integral_cube hp h1 h2 h3

name: NLAlib.sq_mul_dTransformMoment_one_sub_zero_pos
statement:
theorem sq_mul_dTransformMoment_one_sub_zero_pos
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {b y : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support) (hy : b < y) :
    0 < y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y - dTransformMoment μ 0 y
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2
  have he (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 b) :
      y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ = f z := by
    dsimp [f]
    field_simp [(dTransform_denominator_pos hb.le hy hz).ne']
    ring
  have hae : (fun z => y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) =ᵐ[μ] f :=
    (μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport).mono fun z hz => he z hz
  have hi : Integrable f μ :=
    ((integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb.le hsupport hy 1).const_mul (y ^ 2) |>.sub
      (by simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using
        integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb.le hsupport hy 0)).congr hae
  have hidentity : y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y - dTransformMoment μ 0 y = ∫ z, f z ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_congr_ae hae]
    rw [integral_sub ((integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb.le hsupport hy 1).const_mul _)
      (by simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using
        integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb.le hsupport hy 0), integral_const_mul]
    simp only [dTransformMoment, zero_add, pow_one]
  rw [hidentity]
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∫ z, f z ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun z => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  by_contra hnot
  have hz := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun z => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg z) (sq_nonneg _)) hi).mp
    (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnot) hn)
  have hz0 : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, z ∈ ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport, hz] with z hzs hzz
    change z ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 = 0 at hzz
    have hk : ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
      (sq_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (dTransform_denominator_pos hb.le hy hzs))).ne'
    have hzsq : z ^ 2 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hzz).resolve_right hk
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, sq_eq_zero_iff] using hzsq
  have hs0 : μ.support ⊆ ({0} : Set ℝ) :=
    μ.support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_singleton hz0
  have hbzero := hs0 hbmem
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hbzero
  linarith

name: NLAlib.dTransformMoment_zero_le_sq_mul_one
statement:
theorem dTransformMoment_zero_le_sq_mul_one (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    dTransformMoment μ 0 y ≤ y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Integrable (fun z => (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 0
  have h1 := (integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 1).const_mul (y ^ 2)
  have he := integral_mono_ae h0 h1 (show (fun z => (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      (fun z => y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) from by
    filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
    have hid : y ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ =
        z ^ 2 * ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [(dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz).ne']
      ring
    have hp := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg z) (sq_nonneg ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹))
    linarith)
  simpa only [integral_const_mul, dTransformMoment, zero_add, pow_one] using he

name: NLAlib.dTransformMoment_one_le_inv_gap_mul_zero
statement:
theorem dTransformMoment_one_le_inv_gap_mul_zero (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    dTransformMoment μ 1 y ≤ (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)⁻¹ * dTransformMoment μ 0 y
proof:
:= by
  have hgap := dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy (show b ∈ Icc 0 b from ⟨hb, le_rfl⟩)
  have h0 : Integrable (fun z => (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add, pow_one] using integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 0
  have he := integral_mono_ae (integrable_dTransformMoment_kernel μ hb hsupport hy 1)
    (h0.const_mul ((y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)⁻¹)) (show
      (fun z => ((y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤ᵐ[μ]
        (fun z => (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)⁻¹ * (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹) from by
    filter_upwards [μ.ae_mem_Icc_of_support_subset hsupport] with z hz
    have hden := dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy hz
    have hzb : z ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 := (sq_le_sq₀ hz.1 hb).mpr hz.2
    have hk : (y ^ 2 - z ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hden hgap).mpr (by linarith)
    simpa only [pow_two, mul_comm] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk (inv_nonneg.mpr hden.le))
  simpa only [integral_const_mul, dTransformMoment, zero_add, pow_one] using he

name: NLAlib.singularValueElasticity_bounds
statement:
theorem singularValueElasticity_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    -1 - 2 * b ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2) ≤ singularValueElasticity μ y ∧
      singularValueElasticity μ y ≤ -1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := dTransformMoment_pos μ hb hsupport hy 0
  have hlow := dTransformMoment_zero_le_sq_mul_one μ hb hsupport hy
  have hhigh := dTransformMoment_one_le_inv_gap_mul_zero μ hb hsupport hy
  have hgap := dTransform_denominator_pos hb hy (show b ∈ Icc 0 b from ⟨hb, le_rfl⟩)
  have hl : 1 ≤ y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y / dTransformMoment μ 0 y :=
    (le_div_iff₀ h0).mpr (by simpa only [one_mul] using hlow)
  have hu0 : dTransformMoment μ 1 y / dTransformMoment μ 0 y ≤ (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
    (div_le_iff₀ h0).mpr hhigh
  have hu : y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y / dTransformMoment μ 0 y ≤
      y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu0 (sq_nonneg y)
  have he : -1 - 2 * b ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2) = 1 - 2 * (y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2)) := by
    field_simp [hgap.ne']
    ring
  rw [singularValueElasticity_eq_moments μ hb hsupport hy, he]
  have he2 : 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y / dTransformMoment μ 0 y =
      2 * (y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y / dTransformMoment μ 0 y) := by ring
  rw [he2]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.singularValuePsi_bounds
statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    -2 - 4 * b ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2) ≤ singularValuePsi μ γ y ∧ singularValuePsi μ γ y ≤ -2
proof:
:= by
  let ν := dTransformCompanionMeasure μ γ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := isProbabilityMeasure_dTransformCompanionMeasure μ hγ hγ1
  have h := singularValueElasticity_bounds μ hb hsupport hy
  have hn := singularValueElasticity_bounds ν hb (support_dTransformCompanionMeasure_subset μ hb hsupport) hy
  rw [singularValuePsi_eq_add_elasticity μ hγ hγ1 hb hsupport hy]
  change -2 - 4 * b ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 - b ^ 2) ≤
      singularValueElasticity μ y + singularValueElasticity ν y ∧
    singularValueElasticity μ y + singularValueElasticity ν y ≤ -2
  constructor
  · have hl := add_le_add h.1 hn.1
    convert hl using 1 <;> (first | rfl | ring)
  · simpa only [show (-1 : ℝ) + -1 = -2 by norm_num] using add_le_add h.2 hn.2

name: NLAlib.neg_four_le_singularValuePsi_sqrt_three_mul
statement:
theorem neg_four_le_singularValuePsi_sqrt_three_mul (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) :
    -4 ≤ singularValuePsi μ γ (Real.sqrt 3 * b)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 1 < Real.sqrt 3 := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (3 : ℝ)]
  have hy : b < Real.sqrt 3 * b := by nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsqrt hb]
  have h := (singularValuePsi_bounds μ hγ hγ1 hb.le hsupport hy).1
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 3 * b) ^ 2 = 3 * b ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)]
  have he : -2 - 4 * b ^ 2 / ((Real.sqrt 3 * b) ^ 2 - b ^ 2) = -4 := by
    rw [hs]
    field_simp [hb.ne']
    ring
  rwa [he] at h

name: NLAlib.lintegral_le_of_tail_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_le_of_tail_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
    (hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (F : ℝ → ℝ)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, a < t → μ.real {x | t < f x} ≤ F t) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal a + ∫⁻ t in Ioi a, ENNReal.ofReal (F t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt μ hnn hf, ← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi ha,
    lintegral_union measurableSet_Ioi Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same]
  refine add_le_add ?_ ?_
  · calc ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 a, μ {x | t < f x} ≤ ∫⁻ _ in Ioc 0 a, 1 :=
          lintegral_mono fun _ => prob_le_one
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal a := by
          rw [setLIntegral_const, one_mul, Real.volume_Ioc, sub_zero]
  · refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ {x | t < f x})]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (htail t ht)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_le_of_tail_le
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_le_of_tail_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
    (hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (F : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF : IntegrableOn F (Ioi a)) (hFnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioi a)] F)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, a < t → μ.real {x | t < f x} ≤ F t) :
    Integrable f μ ∧ ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ a + ∫ t in Ioi a, F t
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := lintegral_le_of_tail_le μ f hf hnn ha F htail
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hF hFnn,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_add ha (integral_nonneg_of_ae hFnn)] at hbound
  have hfin : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt hbound ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  refine ⟨⟨hf.aestronglyMeasurable, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hnn).2 hfin⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hnn hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (add_nonneg ha (integral_nonneg_of_ae hFnn)) hbound

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_le_of_tail_le_rpow
statement:
private theorem integrable_and_integral_le_of_tail_le_rpow {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
    (hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (C m : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hm : 1 < m)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ.real {x | t < f x} ≤ C * t ^ (-m)) :
    Integrable f μ ∧ ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ C ^ (1 / m) * m / (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  set a : ℝ := C ^ (1 / m) with ha_def
  have ha : 0 < a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hC _
  have hm1 : 0 < m - 1 := by linarith
  
  have hCa : C * a ^ (-m + 1) = a := by
    rw [ha_def, ← Real.rpow_mul hC.le]
    have : 1 / m * (-m + 1) = 1 / m - 1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [this, Real.rpow_sub_one hC.ne']
    field_simp
  
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => C * t ^ (-m)) (Ioi a) :=
    (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) ha).const_mul C
  have hval : ∫ t in Ioi a, C * t ^ (-m) = a / (m - 1) := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) ha]
    have hne : -m + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hne' : 1 - m ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [show C * (-a ^ (-m + 1) / (-m + 1)) = (C * a ^ (-m + 1)) / (m - 1) by
      field_simp; ring, hCa]
  have hnnF : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioi a)] fun t => C * t ^ (-m) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact mul_nonneg hC.le (Real.rpow_nonneg (lt_trans ha ht).le _)
  obtain ⟨hintf, hle⟩ := integrable_and_integral_le_of_tail_le μ f hf hnn ha.le
    (fun t => C * t ^ (-m)) hint hnnF (fun t ht => htail t (lt_trans ha ht))
  refine ⟨hintf, hle.trans_eq ?_⟩
  rw [hval]
  dsimp only [a]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_specNorm_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_specNorm_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (A : Ω → Matrix m n ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hA : ∀ (x : n → ℝ) (y : m → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 →
      HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)) c μ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | 2 * (√(2 * Real.log 9 * (Fintype.card m + Fintype.card n) * c) + √c * t) <
        specNorm (A ω)} ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hunitn : ∀ (x : n → ℝ), x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct (𝕜 := ℝ) x
    simp only [star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, hx] at h
    exact pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero |>.1 h
  have hunitm : ∀ (y : m → ℝ), y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct (𝕜 := ℝ) y
    simp only [star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, hy] at h
    exact pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero |>.1 h
  replace hA := fun x y hx hy => hA x y (hunitn x hx) (hunitm y hy)
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity), ofReal_measureReal]
  set a := √(2 * Real.log 9 * (Fintype.card m + Fintype.card n) * c) with ha
  set u := a + √c * t with hu
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by positivity
  obtain ⟨N, hN1, hN2, hN3⟩ := exists_finset_sphere_net n (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨N', hN'1, hN'2, hN'3⟩ := exists_finset_sphere_net m (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 by norm_num)
  have h9 : (1 + 2 / (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = 9 := by norm_num
  rw [h9] at hN2 hN'2
  
  have hsub : {ω | 2 * u < specNorm (A ω)} ⊆
      ⋃ x ∈ N, ⋃ y ∈ N', {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_exists, not_lt] at hnot
    have := specNorm_le_div_of_net_bilinear (A ω) N N' (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hu0 hN'1
      hN3 hN'3 fun x hx y hy => hnot x hx y hy
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hω
    have h2 : u / (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = 2 * u := by ring
    linarith
  have hunion : μ {ω | 2 * u < specNorm (A ω)} ≤
      ∑ x ∈ N, ∑ y ∈ N', μ {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} :=
    calc μ {ω | 2 * u < specNorm (A ω)}
        ≤ μ (⋃ x ∈ N, ⋃ y ∈ N', {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)}) := measure_mono hsub
      _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ N, μ (⋃ y ∈ N', {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)}) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ N, ∑ y ∈ N', μ {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
  refine hunion.trans ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with hc | hc
  · 
    subst hc
    have hzero : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N', μ {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} = 0 := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have h0 := (hA x y (hN1 x hx) (hN'1 y hy)).ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
      have hu' : u = 0 := by simp [hu, ha]
      apply measure_mono_null (t := {ω | (fun ω => y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)) ω ≠ (0 : Ω → ℝ) ω})
      · intro ω hω h
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.zero_apply] at hω h
        linarith
      · exact ae_iff.1 h0
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y hy => hzero x hx y hy]
    exact zero_le
  have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) < c := lt_of_le_of_ne c.2 (by exact_mod_cast hc.symm)
  have hterm : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N', μ {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * c))) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hsg := hA x y (hN1 x hx) (hN'1 y hy)
    calc μ {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} ≤ μ {ω | u ≤ y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)} :=
          measure_mono fun ω hω => by
            simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hω ⊢; exact hω.le
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (μ.real {ω | u ≤ y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)}) :=
          (ofReal_measureReal (measure_ne_top _ _)).symm
      _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hsg.measure_ge_le hu0)
  
  set k : ℕ := Fintype.card m + Fintype.card n with hk
  have hlog9 : 0 ≤ Real.log 9 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 = 2 * Real.log 9 * k * c := by
    rw [ha, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), hk]; push_cast; ring
  have hsc : √(c : ℝ) ^ 2 = c := Real.sq_sqrt c.2
  have hu2 : 2 * Real.log 9 * k * c + c * t ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 := by
    have : u ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * a * (√c * t) + √(c : ℝ) ^ 2 * t ^ 2 := by rw [hu]; ring
    rw [this, ha2, hsc]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg (c : ℝ))) ht]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * c)) ≤
      Real.exp (-(k * Real.log 9)) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hcard : (N.card : ℝ) * N'.card ≤ Real.exp (k * Real.log 9) := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num), hk, pow_add, mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul hN'2 hN2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hrhs : (N.card : ℝ) * N'.card * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * c)) ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    calc (N.card : ℝ) * N'.card * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * c))
        ≤ Real.exp (k * Real.log 9) * (Real.exp (-(k * Real.log 9)) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul hcard hexp (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
  calc ∑ x ∈ N, ∑ y ∈ N', μ {ω | u < y ⬝ᵥ (A ω *ᵥ x)}
      ≤ ∑ x ∈ N, ∑ y ∈ N', ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * c))) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y hy => hterm x hx y hy
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((N.card : ℝ) * N'.card * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * c))) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),
          ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hrhs

name: NLAlib.integral_reindex

theorem integral_fromBlocks_diag {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_mgf
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_mgf {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Ω → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * s ω)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (s ω • A)) μ ∧
    ∫ ω, matrixExp (s ω • A) ∂μ = cfc (fun t => mgf s μ t) A
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun ω => matrixExp (s ω • A)) =
      fun ω => ∑ i, Real.exp (hA.eigenvalues i * s ω) • eigenvectorProjector hA i := by
    funext ω
    rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc A hA, cfc_eq_sum_smul_eigenvectorProjector hA]
    simp only [mul_comm]
  rw [h]
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hs _).smul_const _), ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hs _).smul_const _), cfc_eq_sum_smul_eigenvectorProjector hA]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [integral_smul_const]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_two_mul_le_four_mul_scale
statement:
private theorem lpNorm_two_mul_le_four_mul_scale
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {p : ℕ} (hp : 0<p) (hX : MemLp X ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) μ)
    {V c D : ℝ} (hD : 0<D)
    (hsmall : c*((p : ℝ)/D) ≤ 1/2)
    (hquad : V*((p : ℝ)/D)^2 ≤ p)
    (hexp : ∀ s : ℝ, 0≤s → c*s<1 → ∀ e : ℝ, e=1 ∨ e= -1 →
      Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s*(e*X ω))) μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ s : ℝ, 0≤s → c*s<1 → ∀ e : ℝ, e=1 ∨ e= -1 →
      (∫ ω, Real.exp (s*(e*X ω)) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (V*s^2/(2*(1-c*s)))) :
    lpNorm X ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) μ ≤ 4*D
proof:
:= by have hpr : (0 : ℝ)

Real.exp (s*X ω)) μ := by simpa only [one_mul] using hexp s hs.le hdom 1 (Or.inl rfl) have hneg : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (-(s*X ω))) μ := by simpa only [neg_one_mul,mul_neg] using hexp s hs.le hdom (-1) (Or.inr rfl) have hposb : (∫ ω, Real.exp (s*X ω) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (p : ℝ) := by have hh := (hmgf s hs.le hdom 1 (Or.inl rfl)).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hpar) simpa only [one_mul] using hh have hnegb : (∫ ω, Real.exp (-(s*X ω)) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (p : ℝ) := by have hh := (hmgf s hs.le hdom (-1) (Or.inr rfl)).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hpar) simpa only [neg_one_mul,mul_neg] using hh have hcosh : Integrable (fun ω => Real.cosh (s*X ω)) μ := by convert (hpos.add hneg).div_const 2 using 1 funext ω exact Real.cosh_eq (s*X ω) have hcoshb : (∫ ω, Real.cosh (s*X ω) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (p : ℝ) := by have he : (∫ ω, Real.cosh (s*X ω) ∂μ) = ((∫ ω, Real.exp (s*X ω) ∂μ)+(∫ ω, Real.exp (-(s*X ω)) ∂μ))/2 := by simp_rw [Real.cosh_eq] rw [integral_div,integral_add hpos hneg] rw [he] linarith have heven (x : ℝ) : ‖x‖^(2*p)=x^(2*p) := by simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs,pow_mul,sq_abs] have hiPow : Integrable (fun ω => X ω^(2*p)) μ := by simpa only [heven] using hX.integrable_norm_pow hn have hiTerm : Integrable (fun ω => (s*X ω)^(2*p)/(Nat.factorial (2*p) : ℝ)) μ := by simpa only [mul_pow] using (hiPow.const_mul (s^(2*p))).div_const (Nat.factorial (2*p) : ℝ) have hterm : (∫ ω, (s*X ω)^(2*p)/(Nat.factorial (2*p) : ℝ) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (p : ℝ) := (integral_mono_ae hiTerm hcosh (Eventually.of_forall fun ω => cosh_taylor_term_le (s*X ω) p)).trans hcoshb have hscale : (∫ ω, (s*X ω)^(2*p)/(Nat.factorial (2*p) : ℝ) ∂μ) = (s^(2*p)/(Nat.factorial (2*p) : ℝ))*(∫ ω, X ω^(2*p) ∂μ) := by simp_rw [mul_pow,div_eq_mul_inv] rw [← integral_const_mul] apply integral_congr_ae exact Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by ring rw [hscale] at hterm have hcoef : 0 Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right p) (X ω)) hm' (by positivity) _ = _ := Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (by positivity) hn have heq : 4*(p : ℝ)/s=4*D := by dsimp only [s] field_simp [hpr.ne',hD.ne'] rwa [heq] at hlp

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_two_mul_le_sqrt_add_of_subgamma_mgf
statement:
theorem lpNorm_two_mul_le_sqrt_add_of_subgamma_mgf
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {p : ℕ} (hp : 0<p) (hX : MemLp X ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) μ)

    (hmgf : ∀ s : ℝ, 0≤s → c*s<1 → ∀ e : ℝ, e=1 ∨ e= -1 →
      (∫ ω, Real.exp (s*(e*X ω)) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (V*s^2/(2*(1-c*s)))) :
