proof: := by have hpr : (0 : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.randomProxy_entropy_factor_le
statement:
private theorem randomProxy_entropy_factor_le
    {a E u : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hdom : Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u < 1) :
    (3 * u ^ 2) / ((2 * a)⁻¹ - 3 * u ^ 2) * (E / a) ≤
      (6 * E) * u ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (6 * a) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hcsq : Real.sqrt (6 * a) ^ 2 = 6 * a := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hcu : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u := mul_nonneg hc hu
  have hcusq : (Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u) ^ 2 < 1 :=
    by simpa only [one_pow] using
      (sq_lt_sq₀ hcu (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mpr hdom
  have hden : 0 < 1 - 6 * a * u ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hcsq] at hcusq
    linarith
  have hθ : 0 < (2 * a)⁻¹ - 3 * u ^ 2 := by
    apply sub_pos.mpr
    rw [← one_div]
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * a)).mpr
    nlinarith
  have he : (3 * u ^ 2) / ((2 * a)⁻¹ - 3 * u ^ 2) * (E / a) =
      (6 * E) * u ^ 2 / (1 - 6 * a * u ^ 2) := by
    field_simp [ha.ne', hθ.ne', hden.ne']
    ring
  rw [he]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden (sq_pos_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdom))).mpr
  have hsq : (1 - Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - 6 * a * u ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hcu (sub_nonneg.mpr hdom.le)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sign_mul_sub_integral_pi_le_of_random_proxy
statement:
theorem integral_exp_sign_mul_sub_integral_pi_le_of_random_proxy
    {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M)
    (W : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ)
    (hWi : Integrable W ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    (hgrad : ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      (∑ i, max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) ≤ W q)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ^ 2 ≤ a)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      |f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))| ≤ b)
    (hWexp : Integrable (fun q => Real.exp (W q / (2 * a)))
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    (hWlog : Real.log (∫ q, Real.exp (W q / (2 * a))
      ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) ≤
        (∫ q, W q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) / a)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hdom : Real.sqrt (6 * a) * s < 1)
    {e : ℝ} (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) :
    (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂Measure.pi ν))) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      Real.exp ((6 * ∫ q, W q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) *
        s ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (6 * a) * s))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let P := μ.prod μ
  let g : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => e * f x
  have hgm : Measurable g := by fun_prop
  have hgb : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ M := by
    intro x
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · simpa only [g, one_mul] using hbound x
    · simpa only [g, neg_one_mul, abs_neg] using hbound x
  have hW0 : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, 0 ≤ W q :=
    hgrad.mono fun q hq => (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _).trans hq
  have hEW : 0 ≤ ∫ q, W q ∂P := integral_nonneg_of_ae hW0
  have hint (u : ℝ) : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (u * g x)) μ :=
    integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc hgm.aemeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => abs_le.mp (hgb x))
  have hc : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (6 * a) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hbc : b ≤ Real.sqrt (6 * a) := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ hb hc).mp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hent (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hcu : Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u < 1) :
      (∫ x, u * g x * Real.exp (u * g x) ∂μ) -
        (∫ x, Real.exp (u * g x) ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (u * g x) ∂μ) ≤
      ((6 * ∫ q, W q ∂P) * u ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u) ^ 2) *
        ∫ x, Real.exp (u * g x) ∂μ := by
    let Y : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ := fun q => Real.exp (u * g q.1)
    have hYi : Integrable Y P := (hint u).comp_fst μ
    have hYlogb : Integrable (fun x =>
        Real.exp (u * g x) * Real.log (Real.exp (u * g x))) μ := by
      have h := ((hint u).bdd_mul hgm.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hgb x)).const_mul u
      convert h using 1
      ext x
      rw [Real.log_exp]
      ring
    have hYlog : Integrable (fun q => Y q * Real.log (Y q)) P := hYlogb.comp_fst μ
    have hYint : (∫ q, Y q ∂P) = ∫ x, Real.exp (u * g x) ∂μ := by
      simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
        (integral_fun_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ) (fun x => Real.exp (u * g x)))
    have hYlogint : (∫ q, Y q * Real.log (Y q) ∂P) =
        ∫ x, Real.exp (u * g x) * Real.log (Real.exp (u * g x)) ∂μ := by
      simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
        (integral_fun_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ) (fun x => Real.exp (u * g x) *
          Real.log (Real.exp (u * g x))))
    have hYV : Integrable (fun q => Y q * W q) P := by
      apply hWi.bdd_mul (by fun_prop) (c := Real.exp (|u| * M))
      exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
        simpa only [Y, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
          Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := u) (hgb q.1)
    have hVi : Integrable (fun q => Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W q)) P := by
      convert hWexp using 1
      ext q
      congr 1
      ring
    have hub : u * b ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbc hu.le]
    have hp := entropy_exp_sign_mul_pi_le_three_integral_proxy_of_bounded
      ν f hfm M hM hbound W hWi hgrad hdiff hu.le hub he
    have hproxy : (∫ q, Y q * Real.log (Y q) ∂P) -
        (∫ q, Y q ∂P) * Real.log (∫ q, Y q ∂P) ≤
      (3 * u ^ 2) * ∫ q, Y q * W q ∂P := by
      rw [hYint, hYlogint]
      simpa only [Y, g, P, μ, Real.log_exp, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hp
    have hcsq : Real.sqrt (6 * a) ^ 2 = 6 * a := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hcusq : (Real.sqrt (6 * a) * u) ^ 2 < 1 :=
      by simpa only [one_pow] using
        (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_nonneg hc hu.le) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mpr hcu
    have hθ : 3 * u ^ 2 < (2 * a)⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_pow, hcsq] at hcusq
      rw [← one_div]
      apply (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * a)).mpr
      nlinarith
    have hG := entropy_le_mul_log_integral_exp_of_weighted_proxy
      P Y W (fun q => Real.exp_pos _) hYi hYlog hYV
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3 * u ^ 2) hθ hVi hproxy
    have hlog : Real.log (∫ q, Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W q) ∂P) ≤
        (∫ q, W q ∂P) / a := by
      have hfun : (fun q => Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W q)) =
          (fun q => Real.exp (W q / (2 * a))) := by
        ext q
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hfun]
      exact hWlog
    have hEY : 0 ≤ ∫ q, Y q ∂P := integral_nonneg fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hG' := hG.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog
      (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_pos.mpr hθ).le) hEY))
    have hf := randomProxy_entropy_factor_le ha hEW hu.le hcu
    have hf' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf hEY
    have hall := hG'.trans (by
      calc (3 * u ^ 2) / ((2 * a)⁻¹ - 3 * u ^ 2) * (∫ q, Y q ∂P) *
          ((∫ q, W q ∂P) / a) =
          ((3 * u ^ 2) / ((2 * a)⁻¹ - 3 * u ^ 2) * ((∫ q, W q ∂P) / a)) *
            (∫ q, Y q ∂P) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hf')
    rw [hYint, hYlogint] at hall
    simpa only [Y, P, Real.log_exp, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hall
  have h := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_rational_entropy_le μ g hc hint hent hs hdom
  have hmean : (∫ x, g x ∂μ) = e * ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
    dsimp [g]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hmean] at h
  have hfun : (fun x => Real.exp (s * (e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ)))) =
      (fun x => Real.exp (-(s * (e * ∫ y, f y ∂μ))) * Real.exp (s * g x)) := by
    ext x
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    dsimp [g]
    ring
  rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Real.exp_pos (-(s * (e * ∫ y, f y ∂μ)))).le
  exact hmul.trans_eq (by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring)

name: NLAlib.young_scaled
statement:
private lemma young_scaled {Z U m : ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z) (hm : 0 < m) :
    Z * U ≤ Z * Real.log Z - Z * Real.log m - Z + m * Real.exp U
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (U - Real.log (Z / m))
  have h2 : Real.exp (U - Real.log (Z / m)) = m * Real.exp U / Z := by
    rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (div_pos hZ hm)]; field_simp
  rw [h2, Real.log_div hZ.ne' hm.ne'] at h1
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hZ] at h1
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_le_entropy_of_integral_exp_le_one
statement:
theorem integral_mul_le_entropy_of_integral_exp_le_one {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (Z U : α → ℝ) (hZ : ∀ t, 0 < Z t) (hZi : Integrable Z ν)
    (hZl : Integrable (fun t => Z t * Real.log (Z t)) ν)
    (hZU : Integrable (fun t => Z t * U t) ν) (hU : Integrable (fun t => Real.exp (U t)) ν)
    (hU1 : ∫ t, Real.exp (U t) ∂ν ≤ 1) :
    ∫ t, Z t * U t ∂ν ≤ ∫ t, Z t * Real.log (Z t) ∂ν - (∫ t, Z t ∂ν) * Real.log (∫ t, Z t ∂ν)
proof:
:= by
  set m := ∫ t, Z t ∂ν with hm_def
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    rw [hm_def, integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg (fun t => (hZ t).le) hZi]
    have : Function.support Z = Set.univ := by
      ext t; simp [(hZ t).ne']
    rw [this]; simp
  have hpt : ∀ t, Z t * U t ≤ Z t * Real.log (Z t) - Z t * Real.log m - Z t
      + m * Real.exp (U t) := fun t => young_scaled (hZ t) hm
  have hint : Integrable (fun t => Z t * Real.log (Z t) - Z t * Real.log m - Z t
      + m * Real.exp (U t)) ν :=
    ((hZl.sub (hZi.mul_const _)).sub hZi).add (hU.const_mul m)
  have h := integral_mono hZU hint hpt
  have hA : Integrable (fun t => Z t * Real.log (Z t) - Z t * Real.log m) ν :=
    hZl.sub (hZi.mul_const _)
  have e1 : ∫ t, (Z t * Real.log (Z t) - Z t * Real.log m - Z t + m * Real.exp (U t)) ∂ν
      = (∫ t, Z t * Real.log (Z t) ∂ν) - m * Real.log m - m + m * ∫ t, Real.exp (U t) ∂ν := by
    rw [integral_add (f := fun t => Z t * Real.log (Z t) - Z t * Real.log m - Z t)
      (g := fun t => m * Real.exp (U t)) (hA.sub hZi) (hU.const_mul m),
      integral_sub (f := fun t => Z t * Real.log (Z t) - Z t * Real.log m) hA hZi,
      integral_sub hZl (hZi.mul_const _), integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const]
  rw [e1] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.lmarginal_of_indep
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [lmarginal]
  have : ∀ y, F (Function.updateFinset x S y) = F x :=
    fun y => hF _ _ (fun j hj => by simp [Function.updateFinset_def, hj])
  simp_rw [this]; simp

name: NLAlib.lintegral_lmarginal
statement:
private lemma lintegral_lmarginal (S : Finset ι) {F : (ι → Ω) → ℝ≥0∞} (hF : Measurable F) :
    ∫⁻ x, lmarginal μ S F x ∂(Measure.pi μ) = ∫⁻ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:=
  lintegral_eq_of_lmarginal_eq S (hF.lmarginal μ) hF
    (lmarginal_of_indep S _ (fun _ _ h => lmarginal_congr μ F h))

name: NLAlib.lintegral_mul_indep
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : lmarginal μ S (fun x => F x * W x) = fun x => lmarginal μ S F x * W x := by
    ext x; simp only [lmarginal]
    have : ∀ y, W (Function.updateFinset x S y) = W x :=
      fun y => hWi _ _ (fun j hj => by simp [Function.updateFinset_def, hj])
    simp_rw [this]
    exact lintegral_mul_const (f := fun y => F (Function.updateFinset x S y)) _
      (hF.comp measurable_updateFinset)
  have := lintegral_lmarginal (μ := μ) S (F := fun x => F x * W x) (hF.mul hW)
  rw [h1] at this
  exact this.symm

name: NLAlib.measurable_ofReal_Z
statement: private lemma measurable_ofReal_Z : Measurable (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y))
proof:
:=
  ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hZm

name: NLAlib.margA_measurable
statement:
private lemma margA_measurable (S : Finset ι) :
    Measurable (lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)))
proof:
:=
  (measurable_ofReal_Z hZm).lmarginal μ

name: NLAlib.margE_measurable
statement: private lemma margE_measurable (S : Finset ι) : Measurable (margE μ S Z)
proof:
:=
  (margA_measurable hZm S).ennreal_toReal

name: NLAlib.margA_pos
statement:
private lemma margA_pos (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → Ω) :
    0 < lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lmarginal]
  rw [lintegral_pos_iff_support (f := fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z (Function.updateFinset x S y)))
    ((measurable_ofReal_Z hZm).comp measurable_updateFinset)]
  have : Function.support (fun y : (∀ i : S, Ω) => ENNReal.ofReal (Z (Function.updateFinset x S y)))
      = Set.univ := by
    ext y; simp [hZ]
  rw [this]; simp

name: NLAlib.lintegral_margA
statement:
private lemma lintegral_margA (S : Finset ι) :
    ∫⁻ x, lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) x ∂(Measure.pi μ) ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_lmarginal S (measurable_ofReal_Z hZm)]
  exact hZi.lintegral_lt_top.ne

name: NLAlib.ae_margA_lt_top
statement:
private lemma ae_margA_lt_top (S : Finset ι) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi μ), lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) x < ∞
proof:
:=
  ae_lt_top (margA_measurable hZm S) (lintegral_margA hZm hZi S)

name: NLAlib.margE_nonneg
statement: private lemma margE_nonneg (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → Ω) : 0 ≤ margE μ S Z x
proof: := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: NLAlib.ae_margE_pos
statement: private lemma ae_margE_pos (S : Finset ι) : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi μ), 0 < margE μ S Z x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_margA_lt_top hZm hZi S] with x hx
  exact ENNReal.toReal_pos (margA_pos hZm hZ S x).ne' hx.ne

name: NLAlib.margE_empty
statement: private lemma margE_empty : margE μ ∅ Z = Z
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [margE, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hZ x).le]

name: NLAlib.margE_univ
statement: private lemma margE_univ (x : ι → Ω) : margE μ Finset.univ Z x = ∫ y, Z y ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [margE, lmarginal_univ]
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hZi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hZ y).le),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (integral_nonneg fun y => (hZ y).le)]

name: NLAlib.margE_congr
statement:
private lemma margE_congr (S : Finset ι) {x y : ι → Ω} (h : ∀ j ∉ S, x j = y j) :
    margE μ S Z x = margE μ S Z y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [margE]; rw [lmarginal_congr μ _ h]

name: NLAlib.margE_update_of_mem
statement:
private lemma margE_update_of_mem (S : Finset ι) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ S) (x : ι → Ω) (t : Ω) :
    margE μ S Z (Function.update x i t) = margE μ S Z x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [margE]; rw [lmarginal_update_of_mem μ hi]

name: NLAlib.integrable_margE
statement: private lemma integrable_margE (S : Finset ι) : Integrable (margE μ S Z) (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:=
  integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top (margA_measurable hZm S).aemeasurable
    (lintegral_margA hZm hZi S)

name: NLAlib.mul_negLog_le
statement: private lemma mul_negLog_le {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) : b * max (-Real.log b) 0 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hb.lt_or_eq with hb | hb
  · rcases le_total 1 b with h1 | h1
    · have : max (-Real.log b) 0 = 0 := by
        rw [max_eq_right]; linarith [Real.log_nonneg h1]
      rw [this]; norm_num
    · have hl := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hb
      have : max (-Real.log b) 0 = -Real.log b := by
        rw [max_eq_left]; linarith [Real.log_nonpos hb.le h1]
      rw [this]
      have : b * (1 - b⁻¹) = b - 1 := by field_simp
      nlinarith
  · subst hb; simp

name: NLAlib.neg_one_le_mul_log
statement: private lemma neg_one_le_mul_log {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) : -1 ≤ m * Real.log m
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm.lt_or_eq with hm | hm
  · have hl := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hm
    have : m * (1 - m⁻¹) = m - 1 := by field_simp
    nlinarith
  · subst hm; simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_Z_mul_negLog
statement:
private lemma integrable_Z_mul_negLog (S : Finset ι) :
    Integrable (fun x => Z x * max (-Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) 0) (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun x => Z x * max (-Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) 0) :=
    hZm.mul (((Real.measurable_log.comp (margE_measurable hZm S)).neg).max measurable_const)
  refine ⟨hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
    mul_nonneg (hZ x).le (le_max_right _ _))]
  have hW : Measurable (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (max (-Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) 0)) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
      (((Real.measurable_log.comp (margE_measurable hZm S)).neg).max measurable_const)
  have e1 : (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Z x * max (-Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) 0))
      = fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Z x) * ENNReal.ofReal (max (-Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) 0) := by
    ext x; rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hZ x).le]
  rw [e1, lintegral_mul_indep S (measurable_ofReal_Z hZm) hW
    (fun x y h => by simp only [margE_congr S h])]
  calc ∫⁻ x, lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) x
          * ENNReal.ofReal (max (-Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) 0) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
        ≤ ∫⁻ _x, 1 ∂(Measure.pi μ) := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
          simp only [margE]
          set A := lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) x
          rcases eq_or_ne A ∞ with hA | hA
          · rw [hA]; simp
          · rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hA, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,
              ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
            exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.2 (mul_negLog_le ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    _ < ∞ := by simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_Z_mul_log_margE
statement:
private lemma integrable_Z_mul_log_margE
    (hZl : Integrable (fun x => Z x * Real.log (Z x)) (Measure.pi μ))
    (S : Finset ι) :
    Integrable (fun x => Z x * Real.log (margE μ S Z x)) (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' (((hZl.abs.add hZi).add (integrable_margE hZm hZi S)).add
    (integrable_Z_mul_negLog hZm hZ hZi S))
    (hZm.mul (Real.measurable_log.comp (margE_measurable hZm S))).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  have hZx := hZ x
  have hb := margE_nonneg (μ := μ) S (Z := Z) x
  set b := margE μ S Z x
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hn : 0 ≤ max (-Real.log b) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hn2 : -Real.log b ≤ max (-Real.log b) 0 := le_max_left _ _
  rcases hb.lt_or_eq with hb | hb
  · have hy := young_scaled (U := Real.log b) hZx one_pos
    rw [Real.log_one, Real.exp_log hb] at hy
    have hlow : -(Z x * max (-Real.log b) 0) ≤ Z x * Real.log b := by nlinarith
    have := abs_nonneg (Z x * Real.log (Z x))
    have := le_abs_self (Z x * Real.log (Z x))
    have := mul_nonneg hZx.le hn
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
  · rw [← hb, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, abs_zero]
    have := abs_nonneg (Z x * Real.log (Z x))
    have := mul_nonneg hZx.le hn
    linarith

name: NLAlib.stronglyMeasurable_section_integral
statement:
private lemma stronglyMeasurable_section_integral (i : ι) {G : (ι → Ω) → ℝ} (hG : Measurable G) :
    StronglyMeasurable (fun x => ∫ t, G (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))
proof:
:=
  StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    (f := fun p : (ι → Ω) × Ω => G (Function.update p.1 i p.2))
    (hG.comp measurable_update').stronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.step_bound
statement:
private lemma step_bound (hZl : Integrable (fun x => Z x * Real.log (Z x)) (Measure.pi μ))
    (S : Finset ι) (i : ι) (hi : i ∉ S) :
    ∫ x, Z x * (Real.log (margE μ S Z x) - Real.log (margE μ (insert i S) Z x)) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
      ≤ ∫ x, entI μ i Z x ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  set U := fun x => Real.log (margE μ S Z x) - Real.log (margE μ (insert i S) Z x) with hU_def
  have hZU : Integrable (fun x => Z x * U x) (Measure.pi μ) := by
    have := (integrable_Z_mul_log_margE hZm hZ hZi hZl S).sub
      (integrable_Z_mul_log_margE hZm hZ hZi hZl (insert i S))
    refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simp only [hU_def, Pi.sub_apply]; ring
  have hUm : Measurable U :=
    (Real.measurable_log.comp (margE_measurable hZm S)).sub
      (Real.measurable_log.comp (margE_measurable hZm (insert i S)))
  rw [← integral_integral_update_pi μ i hZU]
  have hinner := integrable_integral_update_pi μ i hZU
  
  have key : ∀ x, Integrable (fun t => Z (Function.update x i t)) (μ i) →
      Integrable (fun t => Z (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (Z (Function.update x i t))) (μ i) →
      Integrable (fun t => Z (Function.update x i t) * U (Function.update x i t)) (μ i) →
      lmarginal μ (insert i S) (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) x < ∞ →
      ∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) * U (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i) ≤ entI μ i Z x := by
    intro x h1 h2 h3 h4
    set c := margE μ (insert i S) Z x with hc_def
    have hc : 0 < c := ENNReal.toReal_pos (margA_pos hZm hZ _ x).ne' h4.ne
    have hcu : ∀ t, margE μ (insert i S) Z (Function.update x i t) = c := fun t =>
      margE_update_of_mem (insert i S) (Finset.mem_insert_self i S) x t
    have hins := lmarginal_insert (μ := μ) _ (measurable_ofReal_Z hZm) hi x
    have hmeasA : Measurable (fun t => lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y))
        (Function.update x i t)) := (margA_measurable hZm S).comp (measurable_update x)
    have hfin : ∫⁻ t, lmarginal μ S (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Z y)) (Function.update x i t)
        ∂(μ i) ≠ ∞ := by rw [← hins]; exact h4.ne
    have hae := ae_lt_top hmeasA hfin
    have hexp : (fun t => Real.exp (U (Function.update x i t)))
        =ᵐ[μ i] fun t => margE μ S Z (Function.update x i t) / c := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with t ht
      have hpos : 0 < margE μ S Z (Function.update x i t) :=
        ENNReal.toReal_pos (margA_pos hZm hZ _ _).ne' ht.ne
      simp only [hU_def, hcu, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hpos, Real.exp_log hc]
    have hintE : Integrable (fun t => margE μ S Z (Function.update x i t)) (μ i) :=
      integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hmeasA.aemeasurable hfin
    have hint1 : ∫ t, margE μ S Z (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i) = c := by
      simp only [margE]
      rw [integral_toReal hmeasA.aemeasurable hae, ← hins]
      rfl
    refine integral_mul_le_entropy_of_integral_exp_le_one (μ i) (fun t => Z (Function.update x i t))
      (fun t => U (Function.update x i t))
      (fun t => hZ _) h1 h2 h3 ((hintE.div_const c).congr hexp.symm) ?_
    rw [integral_congr_ae hexp, integral_div, hint1, div_self hc.ne']
  have hae1 := ae_integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hZi
  have hae2 := ae_integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hZl
  have hae3 := ae_integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hZU
  have hae4 := ae_margA_lt_top hZm hZi (insert i S)
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi μ),
      ∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) * U (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i) ≤ entI μ i Z x := by
    filter_upwards [hae1, hae2, hae3, hae4] with x h1 h2 h3 h4 using key x h1 h2 h3 h4
  
  have hmeasEnt : Measurable (entI μ i Z) := by
    have m1 := (stronglyMeasurable_section_integral (μ := μ) i
      (hZm.mul (Real.measurable_log.comp hZm))).measurable
    have m2 := (stronglyMeasurable_section_integral (μ := μ) i hZm).measurable
    exact m1.sub (m2.mul (Real.measurable_log.comp m2))
  have hup := integrable_integral_update_pi μ i hZl
  have hEnt : Integrable (entI μ i Z) (Measure.pi μ) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' ((hinner.abs.add hup.abs).add (integrable_const 1))
      hmeasEnt.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hbound] with x hx
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i) :=
      integral_nonneg fun t => (hZ _).le
    have hml := neg_one_le_mul_log hm0
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hEdef : entI μ i Z x = (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) *
        Real.log (Z (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i))
        - (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))
          * Real.log (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) := rfl
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · have := neg_abs_le (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) * U (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))
      have := abs_nonneg (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) *
        Real.log (Z (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i))
      linarith
    · have := le_abs_self (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) *
        Real.log (Z (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i))
      have := abs_nonneg (∫ t, Z (Function.update x i t) * U (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))
      rw [hEdef]; linarith
  exact integral_mono_ae hinner hEnt hbound

name: NLAlib.telescope
statement:
private lemma telescope (hZl : Integrable (fun x => Z x * Real.log (Z x)) (Measure.pi μ))
    (S : Finset ι) :
    ∫ x, Z x * Real.log (Z x) ∂(Measure.pi μ) - ∫ x, Z x * Real.log (margE μ S Z x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, ∫ x, entI μ i Z x ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [margE_empty hZ]
  | insert i S hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    have hstep := step_bound hZm hZ hZi hZl S i hi
    have e : ∫ x, Z x * (Real.log (margE μ S Z x) - Real.log (margE μ (insert i S) Z x))
        ∂(Measure.pi μ) = ∫ x, Z x * Real.log (margE μ S Z x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
          - ∫ x, Z x * Real.log (margE μ (insert i S) Z x) ∂(Measure.pi μ) := by
      rw [← integral_sub (integrable_Z_mul_log_margE hZm hZ hZi hZl S)
        (integrable_Z_mul_log_margE hZm hZ hZi hZl (insert i S))]
      congr 1; ext x; ring
    rw [e] at hstep
    linarith

name: NLAlib.entropy_pi_le_sum_integral_entropy_update
statement:
theorem entropy_pi_le_sum_integral_entropy_update {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (h : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hmeas : Measurable h) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < h x)
    (hint : Integrable h (Measure.pi μ))
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => h x * Real.log (h x)) (Measure.pi μ)) :
    ∫ x, h x * Real.log (h x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
      - (∫ x, h x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) * Real.log (∫ x, h x ∂(Measure.pi μ))
      ≤ ∑ i, ∫ x, (∫ t, h (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (h (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i)
          - (∫ t, h (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))
            * Real.log (∫ t, h (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := telescope hmeas hpos hint hlog Finset.univ
  simp only [margE_univ hpos hint, integral_mul_const] at ht
  exact ht

name: NLAlib.entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_sum_integral_update_posPart_sq_of_bounded
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_sum_integral_update_posPart_sq_of_bounded
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      s ^ 2 * ∑ i, ∫ x, ∫ t,
        Real.exp (s * f x) * max (f x - f (Function.update x i t)) 0 ^ 2
          ∂ν i ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let Y : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (s * f x)
  let H : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun i x => ∫ t,
    Real.exp (s * f x) * max (f x - f (Function.update x i t)) 0 ^ 2 ∂ν i
  have hYm : Measurable Y := by fun_prop
  have hY : Integrable Y (Measure.pi ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hYm.aestronglyMeasurable (Real.exp (|s| * M))
    apply ae_of_all
    intro x
    simpa only [Y, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
      Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := s) (hbound x)
  have hYlog : Integrable (fun x => Y x * Real.log (Y x)) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop)
      (Real.exp (|s| * M) * (|s| * M))
    apply ae_of_all
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    dsimp [Y]
    rw [Real.log_exp, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (hbound x))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound x) (abs_nonneg s))
      (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg s) (abs_nonneg _)) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hHi (i : ι) : Integrable (H i) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    exact (integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
      (μ := (Measure.pi ν).prod (ν i))
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × Ω => f q.1)
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × Ω => f (Function.update q.1 i q.2))
      (hfm.comp measurable_fst) (hfm.comp measurable_update') hM
      (fun q => hbound q.1) (fun q => hbound _) s).integral_prod_left
  have ht := entropy_pi_le_sum_integral_entropy_update ν Y hYm
    (fun x => Real.exp_pos _) hY hYlog
  have hlocal (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) :
      (∫ s, Y (Function.update x i s) * Real.log (Y (Function.update x i s)) ∂ν i) -
        (∫ s, Y (Function.update x i s) ∂ν i) *
          Real.log (∫ s, Y (Function.update x i s) ∂ν i) ≤
        s ^ 2 * ∫ s, H i (Function.update x i s) ∂ν i := by
    have hh := entropy_exp_mul_le_integral_posPart_sq_of_bounded (ν i)
      (fun s => f (Function.update x i s)) (hfm.comp (measurable_update x))
      M hM (fun s => hbound _) hs
    have hU := integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
      (μ := (ν i).prod (ν i))
      (fun q : Ω × Ω => f (Function.update x i q.1))
      (fun q : Ω × Ω => f (Function.update x i q.2))
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hM (fun q => hbound _) (fun q => hbound _) s
    rw [integral_prod _ hU] at hh
    simpa only [Y, H, Function.update_idem, Real.log_exp, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
      mul_assoc] using hh
  have hsum : ∑ i, ∫ x,
      ((∫ s, Y (Function.update x i s) * Real.log (Y (Function.update x i s)) ∂ν i) -
        (∫ s, Y (Function.update x i s) ∂ν i) *
          Real.log (∫ s, Y (Function.update x i s) ∂ν i)) ∂Measure.pi ν ≤
      ∑ i, s ^ 2 * ∫ x, H i x ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have hE := integrable_entropy_update_of_nonneg ν i hYm
      (fun x => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hY hYlog
    have h := integral_mono hE
      ((integrable_integral_update_pi ν i (hHi i)).const_mul (s ^ 2)) (hlocal i)
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_integral_update_pi ν i (hHi i)] at h
    exact h
  have h := ht.trans hsum
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  simpa only [Y, H, Real.log_exp, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h

name: NLAlib.entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_resampling_posPart_sq_of_bounded
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_resampling_posPart_sq_of_bounded
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      s ^ 2 * ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        Real.exp (s * f q.1) * ∑ i,
          max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2
            ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  have hK (i : ι) : Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      Real.exp (s * f q.1) * max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
    exact integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => f q.1)
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hM (fun q => hbound q.1) (fun q => hbound _) s
  have he : (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      Real.exp (s * f q.1) * ∑ i,
        max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) =
      ∑ i, ∫ x, ∫ t,
        Real.exp (s * f x) * max (f x - f (Function.update x i t)) 0 ^ 2
          ∂ν i ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hK i)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [integral_prod _ (hK i)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := i)
      (f := fun t => Real.exp (s * f x) * max (f x - f (Function.update x i t)) 0 ^ 2)
      (by
        have ht : Measurable (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)) :=
          hfm.comp (measurable_update x)
        exact (measurable_const.mul (((measurable_const.sub ht).max
          measurable_const).pow_const 2)).aestronglyMeasurable)
  rw [he]
  exact entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_sum_integral_update_posPart_sq_of_bounded
    ν f hfm M hM hbound hs

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_nonneg_mul_log_integrable
statement:
theorem integrable_of_nonneg_mul_log_integrable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f : α → ℝ} (hfm : Measurable f)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) ν) :
    Integrable f ν
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' (hlog.abs.add (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)))
    hfm.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf x)]
  have h := Real.self_sub_one_le_mul_log (hf x)
  have ha := le_abs_self (f x * Real.log (f x))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.mul_log_integral_le_integral_mul_log_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_log_integral_le_integral_mul_log_of_nonneg {α : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hint : Integrable f ν)
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) ν) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂ν) * Real.log (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ≤ ∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂ν
proof:
:=
  Real.convexOn_mul_log.map_integral_le Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousOn
    isClosed_Ici (ae_of_all _ fun x => hf x) hint hlog

name: NLAlib.integrable_mul_log_add_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem integrable_mul_log_add_of_nonneg {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f : α → ℝ} (hfm : Measurable f)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hint : Integrable f ν)
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) ν)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => (f x + δ) * Real.log (f x + δ)) ν
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' ((hlog.abs.add hint).add (integrable_const (2 : ℝ)))
    (Real.continuous_mul_log.measurable.comp (hfm.add measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact abs_add_mul_log_add_le (f x) δ (hf x) hδ hδ1

name: NLAlib.tendsto_integral_mul_log_add_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_mul_log_add_of_nonneg {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f : α → ℝ} (hfm : Measurable f)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hint : Integrable f ν)
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) ν)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ n, 0 < δ n) (hδ1 : ∀ n, δ n ≤ 1)
    (hδlim : Tendsto δ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (f x + δ n) * Real.log (f x + δ n) ∂ν)
      atTop (nhds (∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂ν))
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun x => |f x * Real.log (f x)| + f x + 2)
    (fun n => (Real.continuous_mul_log.measurable.comp
      (hfm.add measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((hlog.abs.add hint).add (integrable_const (2 : ℝ)))
    (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_) (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_add_mul_log_add_le (f x) (δ n) (hf x) (hδ n) (hδ1 n)
  · have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => f x + δ n) atTop (nhds (f x)) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := f x)).add hδlim
    exact (Real.continuous_mul_log.tendsto (f x)).comp hlim

name: NLAlib.integrable_mul_log_integral_update_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem integrable_mul_log_integral_update_of_nonneg (i : ι)
    {f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ} (hfm : Measurable f) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hint : Integrable f (Measure.pi μ))
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) (Measure.pi μ)) :
    Integrable (fun x => (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) *
      Real.log (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))) (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas := measurable_integral_update_pi μ i hfm
  have hupper := integrable_integral_update_pi μ i hlog
  refine Integrable.mono' (hupper.abs.add (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)))
    (Real.continuous_mul_log.measurable.comp hmeas).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hint,
    ae_integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hlog] with x h1 h2
  have hu := mul_log_integral_le_integral_mul_log_of_nonneg
    (fun t => hf (Function.update x i t)) h1 h2
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i) :=
    integral_nonneg fun t => hf _
  have hl := Real.self_sub_one_le_mul_log hm0
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have ha := abs_nonneg (∫ t,
      f (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (f (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i))
    linarith
  · have ha := le_abs_self (∫ t,
      f (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (f (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i))
    linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_entropy_update_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem integrable_entropy_update_of_nonneg (i : ι) {f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ}
    (hfm : Measurable f) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hint : Integrable f (Measure.pi μ))
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) (Measure.pi μ)) :
    Integrable (fun x => (∫ t,
      f (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (f (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i)) -
        (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) *
          Real.log (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))) (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_integral_update_pi μ i hlog).sub
    (integrable_mul_log_integral_update_of_nonneg μ i hfm hf hint hlog)

name: NLAlib.integral_entropy_update_eq_sub_integral_mul_log_mean
statement:
theorem integral_entropy_update_eq_sub_integral_mul_log_mean (i : ι)
    {f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ} (hfm : Measurable f) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hint : Integrable f (Measure.pi μ))
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) (Measure.pi μ)) :
    (∫ x, ((∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (f (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i)) -
      (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) *
        Real.log (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i))) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) =
      (∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ∫ x, (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) *
          Real.log (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_integral_update_pi μ i hlog)
    (integrable_mul_log_integral_update_of_nonneg μ i hfm hf hint hlog),
    integral_integral_update_pi μ i hlog]

name: NLAlib.entropy_pi_le_sum_integral_entropy_update_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem entropy_pi_le_sum_integral_entropy_update_of_nonneg
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hlog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) (Measure.pi μ)) :
    ∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
      - (∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) * Real.log (∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ))
      ≤ ∑ i, ∫ x, (∫ t,
          f (Function.update x i t) * Real.log (f (Function.update x i t)) ∂(μ i))
        - (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) *
          Real.log (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)) ∂(Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hint := integrable_of_nonneg_mul_log_integrable hfm hf hlog
  let mean : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun i x => ∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) ∂(μ i)
  have hmeanm (i : ι) : Measurable (mean i) := measurable_integral_update_pi μ i hfm
  have hmeann (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) : 0 ≤ mean i x := integral_nonneg fun t => hf _
  have hmeani (i : ι) : Integrable (mean i) (Measure.pi μ) :=
    integrable_integral_update_pi μ i hint
  have hmeanl (i : ι) : Integrable (fun x => mean i x * Real.log (mean i x)) (Measure.pi μ) :=
    integrable_mul_log_integral_update_of_nonneg μ i hfm hf hint hlog
  let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  have hδpos (n : ℕ) : 0 < δ n := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδle (n : ℕ) : δ n ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
    linarith
  have hδlim : Tendsto δ atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hshiftm (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun x => f x + δ n) := hfm.add measurable_const
  have hshiftn (n : ℕ) (x : ι → Ω) : 0 ≤ f x + δ n := by
    have h1 := hf x
    have h2 := hδpos n
    linarith
  have hshiftp (n : ℕ) (x : ι → Ω) : 0 < f x + δ n := by
    have h1 := hf x
    have h2 := hδpos n
    linarith
  have hshifti (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => f x + δ n) (Measure.pi μ) :=
    hint.add (integrable_const _)
  have hshiftl (n : ℕ) :
      Integrable (fun x => (f x + δ n) * Real.log (f x + δ n)) (Measure.pi μ) :=
    integrable_mul_log_add_of_nonneg hfm hf hint hlog (hδpos n) (hδle n)
  have hshiftint (n : ℕ) : (∫ x, f x + δ n ∂(Measure.pi μ)) =
      (∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) + δ n := by
    rw [integral_add hint (integrable_const _)]
    simp
  have hlocal (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
      (∫ x, (∫ t, (f (Function.update x i t) + δ n) *
          Real.log (f (Function.update x i t) + δ n) ∂(μ i)) -
        (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) + δ n ∂(μ i)) *
          Real.log (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) + δ n ∂(μ i)) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) =
      (∫ x, (f x + δ n) * Real.log (f x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ∫ x, (mean i x + δ n) * Real.log (mean i x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ) := by
    rw [integral_entropy_update_eq_sub_integral_mul_log_mean μ i
      (hshiftm n) (hshiftn n) (hshifti n) (hshiftl n)]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_integrable_comp_update_pi μ i hint] with x hx
    have he : (∫ t, f (Function.update x i t) + δ n ∂(μ i)) = mean i x + δ n := by
      rw [integral_add hx (integrable_const _)]
      simp only [integral_const]
      simp [mean]
    rw [he]
  have hpoint (n : ℕ) :
      (∫ x, (f x + δ n) * Real.log (f x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ((∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) + δ n) *
          Real.log ((∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) + δ n) ≤
      ∑ i, ((∫ x, (f x + δ n) * Real.log (f x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ∫ x, (mean i x + δ n) * Real.log (mean i x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) := by
    have h := entropy_pi_le_sum_integral_entropy_update μ
      (fun x => f x + δ n) (hshiftm n) (hshiftp n) (hshifti n) (hshiftl n)
    rw [hshiftint n] at h
    simpa only [hlocal] using h
  have hT := tendsto_integral_mul_log_add_of_nonneg hfm hf hint hlog δ hδpos hδle hδlim
  have hM : Tendsto (fun n => ((∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) + δ n) *
      Real.log ((∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) + δ n)) atTop
      (nhds ((∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) * Real.log (∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)))) := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => (∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ)) + δ n) atTop
        (nhds (∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ))) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ∫ x, f x ∂(Measure.pi μ))).add hδlim
    exact (Real.continuous_mul_log.tendsto _).comp hlim
  have hR : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i,
      ((∫ x, (f x + δ n) * Real.log (f x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ∫ x, (mean i x + δ n) * Real.log (mean i x + δ n) ∂(Measure.pi μ))) atTop
      (nhds (∑ i, ((∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ∫ x, mean i x * Real.log (mean i x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)))) := by
    exact tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => hT.sub
      (tendsto_integral_mul_log_add_of_nonneg (hmeanm i) (hmeann i) (hmeani i)
        (hmeanl i) δ hδpos hδle hδlim)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ((∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) -
        ∫ x, mean i x * Real.log (mean i x) ∂(Measure.pi μ)) :=
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' (hT.sub hM) hR hpoint
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ =>
      (integral_entropy_update_eq_sub_integral_mul_log_mean μ i hfm hf hint hlog).symm

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_entropy_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_entropy_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hint : ∀ s : ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * f ω)) μ)
    (hent : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      ∫ ω, s * f ω * Real.exp (s * f ω) ∂μ
        - (∫ ω, Real.exp (s * f ω) ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ ω, Real.exp (s * f ω) ∂μ)
        ≤ c * s ^ 2 * ∫ ω, Real.exp (s * f ω) ∂μ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (s * f ω) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp (s * ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ + c * s ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ → ℝ := mgf f μ with hMdef
  set E : ℝ := ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ with hEdef
  have hint' : ∀ u : ℝ, u ∈ interior (integrableExpSet f μ) := by
    intro u
    have : integrableExpSet f μ = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun v => hint v
    simp [this]
  set M' : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ∫ ω, f ω * Real.exp (u * f ω) ∂μ with hM'def
  have hM : ∀ u, HasDerivAt M (M' u) u := fun u => hasDerivAt_mgf (hint' u)
  have hMpos : ∀ u, 0 < M u := fun u => mgf_pos (hint u)
  have hMeq : ∀ u, ∫ ω, Real.exp (u * f ω) ∂μ = M u := fun u => rfl
  
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.log (M u) - u * E - c * u ^ 2 with hGdef
  set G' : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => M' u / M u - E - c * (2 * u) with hG'def
  have hG : ∀ u, HasDerivAt G (G' u) u := by
    intro u
    have h1 := (hM u).log (hMpos u).ne'
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_id u).mul_const E
    have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 u).const_mul c)
    have := (h1.sub h2).sub h3
    refine HasDerivAt.congr_deriv (f := G) this ?_
    simp only [hG'def]
    ring
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by simp [hGdef, hMdef]
  have hG'0 : G' 0 = 0 := by
    simp [hG'def, hM'def, hMdef, hEdef]
  
  set φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => G u / u with hφdef
  have hφ : ∀ u, 0 < u → HasDerivAt φ ((G' u * u - G u * 1) / u ^ 2) u := by
    intro u hu
    exact (hG u).div (hasDerivAt_id u) hu.ne'
  have hnum : ∀ u, 0 < u → G' u * u - G u * 1 ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    have he := hent u hu
    rw [hMeq] at he
    have hfe : ∫ ω, u * f ω * Real.exp (u * f ω) ∂μ = u * M' u := by
      simp_rw [mul_assoc]; rw [integral_const_mul]
    rw [hfe] at he
    have hMu := hMpos u
    have key : u * (M' u / M u) - Real.log (M u) ≤ c * u ^ 2 := by
      have : u * (M' u / M u) - Real.log (M u) = (u * M' u - M u * Real.log (M u)) / M u := by
        field_simp
      rw [this, div_le_iff₀ hMu]; linarith
    simp only [hG'def, hGdef]
    nlinarith [key]
  have hanti : AntitoneOn φ (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ioi 0)
    · intro u hu
      exact (hφ u hu).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · rw [interior_Ioi]
      intro u hu
      exact (hφ u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · rw [interior_Ioi]
      intro u hu
      rw [(hφ u hu).deriv]
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hnum u hu) (sq_nonneg _)
  
  rcases hs.eq_or_lt with hs0 | hspos
  · subst hs0
    simp only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, zero_add, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
      not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero]
    simp
  have hslope := (hG 0).tendsto_slope_zero_right
  rw [hG'0] at hslope
  have hφs : φ s ≤ 0 := by
    refine ge_of_tendsto hslope ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hspos] with u hu
    simp only [zero_add, hG0, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact hanti hu.1 hspos hu.2.le
  have hGs : G s ≤ 0 := by
    have : G s = φ s * s := by simp [hφdef, hspos.ne']
    rw [this]; exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hφs hs
  rw [hMeq]
  have hlog : Real.log (M s) ≤ s * E + c * s ^ 2 := by simp only [hGdef] at hGs; linarith
  calc M s = Real.exp (Real.log (M s)) := (Real.exp_log (hMpos s)).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog

name: NLAlib.sum_resampling_posPart_sq_le_of_deletions
statement:
theorem sum_resampling_posPart_sq_le_of_deletions
    (W : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (Wi : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ i x, Wi i x ≤ W x)
    (hindep : ∀ i x t, Wi i (Function.update x i t) = Wi i x)
    {a : ℝ} (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ i, (W x - Wi i x) ^ 2 ≤ a * W x)
    (x y : ι → Ω) :
    ∑ i, max (W x - W (Function.update x i (y i))) 0 ^ 2 ≤ a * W x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans _ (hsum x)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (le_max_right _ _) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlower i x))).mpr
  apply max_le _ (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlower i x))
  have h := hlower i (Function.update x i (y i))
  rw [hindep] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions
    (W : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hWm : Measurable W) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |W x| ≤ M) (Wi : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ i x, Wi i x ≤ W x)
    (hindep : ∀ i x t, Wi i (Function.update x i t) = Wi i x)
    {a : ℝ} (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ i, (W x - Wi i x) ^ 2 ≤ a * W x)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ x, s * W x * Real.exp (s * W x) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * W x) ∂Measure.pi ν) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * W x) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      a * s ^ 2 * ∫ x, W x * Real.exp (s * W x) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  have hY : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (s * W x)) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (Real.exp (|s| * M))
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
        Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := s) (hbound x)
  have hWY : Integrable (fun x => W x * Real.exp (s * W x)) μ :=
    hY.bdd_mul hWm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound x)
  have hUi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      Real.exp (s * W q.1) * max (W q.1 - W (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2)
      (μ.prod μ) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => W q.1)
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => W (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hM (fun q => hbound q.1) (fun q => hbound _) s
  have hU : Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      Real.exp (s * W q.1) * ∑ i,
        max (W q.1 - W (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) (μ.prod μ) := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hUi i)
  have hpoint (q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) :
      Real.exp (s * W q.1) * (∑ i,
        max (W q.1 - W (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) ≤
      a * (W q.1 * Real.exp (s * W q.1)) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (sum_resampling_posPart_sq_le_of_deletions W Wi hlower hindep hsum q.1 q.2)
      (Real.exp_pos (s * W q.1)).le
    nlinarith
  have hmono := integral_mono hU ((hWY.const_mul a).comp_fst μ) hpoint
  rw [integral_fun_fst (fun x : ι → Ω => a * (W x * Real.exp (s * W x))),
    probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_const_mul] at hmono
  have h := entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_resampling_posPart_sq_of_bounded
    ν W hWm M hM hbound hs
  exact h.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (sq_nonneg s)).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.log_integral_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions
statement:
theorem log_integral_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions
    (W : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hWm : Measurable W) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |W x| ≤ M) (Wi : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ i x, Wi i x ≤ W x)
    (hindep : ∀ i x t, Wi i (Function.update x i t) = Wi i x)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ i, (W x - Wi i x) ^ 2 ≤ a * W x)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hdom : a * s < 1) :
    Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * W x) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      s * (∫ x, W x ∂Measure.pi ν) / (1 - a * s)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  have hint (u : ℝ) : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (u * W x)) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (Real.exp (|u| * M))
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
        Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := u) (hbound x)
  have hint' (u : ℝ) : u ∈ interior (integrableExpSet W μ) := by
    have he : integrableExpSet W μ = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall hint
    simp [he]
  have hderiv (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (cgf W μ) (deriv (cgf W μ) u) u :=
    (analyticAt_cgf (hint' u)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hde (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (_hdom : a * u < 1) :
      u * deriv (cgf W μ) u - cgf W μ u ≤ a * u ^ 2 * deriv (cgf W μ) u := by
    have h := entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions ν W hWm M hM hbound
      Wi hlower hindep hsum hu.le
    have he : (∫ x, u * W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ) =
        u * ∫ x, W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ := by
      simp_rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    change (∫ x, u * W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ) -
      mgf W μ u * cgf W μ u ≤ _ at h
    rw [he] at h
    have hpos := mgf_pos (hint u)
    have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h hpos.le
    rw [deriv_cgf (hint' u)]
    calc u * ((∫ x, W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ) / mgf W μ u) - cgf W μ u =
        (u * (∫ x, W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ) - mgf W μ u * cgf W μ u) / mgf W μ u := by
          field_simp [hpos.ne']
      _ ≤ (a * u ^ 2 * (∫ x, W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ)) / mgf W μ u := hh
      _ = a * u ^ 2 * ((∫ x, W x * Real.exp (u * W x) ∂μ) / mgf W μ u) := by ring
  have h := Real.le_div_one_sub_mul_of_hasDerivAt_self_bound
    (cgf W μ) (deriv (cgf W μ)) hderiv (by simp) ha hde hs hdom
  rw [deriv_cgf_zero (hint' 0), probReal_univ, div_one] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.log_integral_exp_div_two_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions
statement:
theorem log_integral_exp_div_two_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions
    (W : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hWm : Measurable W) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |W x| ≤ M) (Wi : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ i x, Wi i x ≤ W x)
    (hindep : ∀ i x t, Wi i (Function.update x i t) = Wi i x)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ i, (W x - Wi i x) ^ 2 ≤ a * W x) :
    Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (W x / (2 * a)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (∫ x, W x ∂Measure.pi ν) / a
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ (2 * a)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
  have hdom : a * (2 * a)⁻¹ < 1 := by
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
    apply (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr
    linarith
  have h := log_integral_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions ν W hWm M hM hbound
    Wi hlower hindep ha.le hsum hs hdom
  have hexp : (fun x => Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W x)) =
      (fun x => Real.exp (W x / (2 * a))) := by
    ext x
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp] at h
  convert h using 1
  field_simp [ha.ne']
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_rational_entropy_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_rational_entropy_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) {c C : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hint : ∀ u : ℝ, Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (u * f x)) μ)
    (hent : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → c * u < 1 →
      (∫ x, u * f x * Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) -
        (∫ x, Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) ≤
      (C * u ^ 2 / (1 - c * u) ^ 2) * ∫ x, Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hdom : c * s < 1) :
    (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.exp (s * (∫ x, f x ∂μ) + C * s ^ 2 / (1 - c * s))
proof:
:= by
  have hint' (u : ℝ) : u ∈ interior (integrableExpSet f μ) := by
    have he : integrableExpSet f μ = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall hint
    simp [he]
  have hderiv (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (cgf f μ) (deriv (cgf f μ) u) u :=
    (analyticAt_cgf (hint' u)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hde (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hcu : c * u < 1) :
      u * deriv (cgf f μ) u - cgf f μ u ≤ C * u ^ 2 / (1 - c * u) ^ 2 := by
    have he := hent u hu hcu
    have hfe : (∫ x, u * f x * Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) =
        u * ∫ x, f x * Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ := by
      simp_rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    change (∫ x, u * f x * Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) -
      mgf f μ u * cgf f μ u ≤ _ at he
    rw [hfe] at he
    have hpos := mgf_pos (hint u)
    have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he hpos.le
    rw [deriv_cgf (hint' u)]
    calc u * ((∫ x, f x * Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) / mgf f μ u) - cgf f μ u =
        (u * (∫ x, f x * Real.exp (u * f x) ∂μ) - mgf f μ u * cgf f μ u) / mgf f μ u := by
          field_simp [hpos.ne']
      _ ≤ ((C * u ^ 2 / (1 - c * u) ^ 2) * mgf f μ u) / mgf f μ u := hh
      _ = C * u ^ 2 / (1 - c * u) ^ 2 := by rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hpos.ne']
  have h := Real.le_affine_add_div_of_hasDerivAt_bound
    (cgf f μ) (deriv (cgf f μ)) hderiv (by simp) hc hde hs hdom
  rw [deriv_cgf_zero (hint' 0), probReal_univ, div_one] at h
  calc (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) = Real.exp (cgf f μ s) :=
      (Real.exp_log (mgf_pos (hint s))).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_proxy_of_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem integrable_exp_mul_proxy_of_abs_bound
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) {M : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M)
    (W : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ)
    (hWi : Integrable W ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) (s : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun q => Real.exp (s * f q.1) * W q)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  apply hWi.bdd_mul (by
    have hm : Measurable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => Real.exp (s * f q.1)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact hm.aestronglyMeasurable) (c := Real.exp (|s| * M))
  exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
      Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := s) (hbound q.1)

name: NLAlib.entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_proxy_of_bounded
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_proxy_of_bounded
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M)
    (W : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ)
    (hWi : Integrable W ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    (hgrad : ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      (∑ i, max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) ≤ W q)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      s ^ 2 * ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), Real.exp (s * f q.1) * W q
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  have hUi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      Real.exp (s * f q.1) * max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => f q.1)
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hM (fun q => hbound q.1) (fun q => hbound _) s
  have hU : Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      Real.exp (s * f q.1) * ∑ i,
        max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2)
      ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hUi i)
  have h := integral_mono_ae hU
    (integrable_exp_mul_proxy_of_abs_bound ν f hfm hbound W hWi s)
    (hgrad.mono fun q hq => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  exact (entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_resampling_posPart_sq_of_bounded
    ν f hfm M hM hbound hs).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (sq_nonneg s))

name: NLAlib.entropy_exp_neg_mul_pi_le_exp_mul_integral_proxy_of_bounded
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_neg_mul_pi_le_exp_mul_integral_proxy_of_bounded
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M)
    (W : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ)
    (hWi : Integrable W ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    (hgrad : ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      (∑ i, max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) ≤ W q)
    {b : ℝ}
    (hdiff : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      |f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))| ≤ b)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ x, s * (-f x) * Real.exp (s * (-f x)) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (-f x)) ∂Measure.pi ν) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (-f x)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (Real.exp (s * b) * s ^ 2) *
        ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω), Real.exp (s * (-f q.1)) * W q
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let P : ι → ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ := fun i q =>
    Real.exp (s * (-f q.1)) * max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2
  let N : ι → ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ := fun i q =>
    Real.exp (s * (-f q.1)) * max ((-f q.1) - (-f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))) 0 ^ 2
  have hN (i : ι) : Integrable (N i) (μ.prod μ) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_posPart_sub_sq_of_abs_le
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => -f q.1)
      (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => -f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hM
      (fun q => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hbound q.1)
      (fun q => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hbound _) s
  have hP (i : ι) : Integrable (P i) (μ.prod μ) := by
    have hi : Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
        max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) (μ.prod μ) := by
      apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) ((2 * M) ^ 2)
      exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        apply (sq_le_sq₀ (le_max_right _ _) (by positivity)).mpr
        apply max_le _ (by positivity)
        linarith [(abs_le.mp (hbound q.1)).2, (abs_le.mp (hbound
          (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))).1]
    apply hi.bdd_mul (by
      have hm : Measurable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) => Real.exp (s * (-f q.1))) := by
        fun_prop
      exact hm.aestronglyMeasurable) (c := Real.exp (|s| * M))
    exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
        Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := s)
          (by simpa only [abs_neg] using hbound q.1)
  have horient (i : ι) : (∫ q, N i q ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
      Real.exp (s * b) * ∫ q, P i q ∂μ.prod μ := by
    have hp := measurePreserving_prod_pi_update_swap ν i
    have hNi := hp.integrable_comp_of_integrable (hN i)
    have he := integral_prod_pi_update_swap ν i (N i) (hN i).aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [← he]
    have hmono := integral_mono_ae hNi ((hP i).const_mul (Real.exp (s * b))) ?_
    · simpa only [μ, Function.comp_def, integral_const_mul] using hmono
    filter_upwards [hdiff i] with q hq
    simp only [Function.comp_def, N, Function.update_self, Function.update_idem,
      Function.update_eq_self, neg_sub_neg]
    have hx : Real.exp (s * (-f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))) ≤
        Real.exp (s * b) * Real.exp (s * (-f q.1)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hd := (le_abs_self (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))).trans hq
      nlinarith
    simpa only [P, mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx
      (sq_nonneg (max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0))
  have hsum : (∫ q, ∑ i, N i q ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
      Real.exp (s * b) * ∫ q, ∑ i, P i q ∂μ.prod μ := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hN i),
      integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hP i), Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => horient i
  have hproxy := integral_mono_ae
    (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hP i))
    (integrable_exp_mul_proxy_of_abs_bound ν (fun x => -f x) (by fun_prop)
      (fun x => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hbound x) W hWi s) ?_
  · have hbase := entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_resampling_posPart_sq_of_bounded
      ν (fun x => -f x) (by fun_prop) M hM
      (fun x => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hbound x) hs
    have he : (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
        Real.exp (s * (-f q.1)) * ∑ i,
          max ((-f q.1) - (-f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)))) 0 ^ 2) =
        (fun q => ∑ i, N i q) := by
      ext q
      simp only [N, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [he] at hbase
    have hall := hsum.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hproxy (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    exact hbase.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hall (sq_nonneg s)).trans_eq (by ring))
  filter_upwards [hgrad] with q hq
  simpa only [P, ← Finset.mul_sum] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (Real.exp_pos (s * (-f q.1))).le

name: NLAlib.entropy_exp_sign_mul_pi_le_three_integral_proxy_of_bounded
statement:
theorem entropy_exp_sign_mul_pi_le_three_integral_proxy_of_bounded
    (f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ) (hfm : Measurable f) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M)
    (W : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ)
    (hWi : Integrable W ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)))
    (hgrad : ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      (∑ i, max (f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) ≤ W q)
    {b : ℝ}
    (hdiff : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)),
      |f q.1 - f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))| ≤ b)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsb : s * b ≤ 1)
    {e : ℝ} (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) :
    (∫ x, s * (e * f x) * Real.exp (s * (e * f x)) ∂Measure.pi ν) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (e * f x)) ∂Measure.pi ν) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (e * f x)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (3 * s ^ 2) * ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        Real.exp (s * (e * f q.1)) * W q
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
proof:
:= by
  have hW0 : ∀ᵐ q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)), 0 ≤ W q :=
    hgrad.mono fun q hq => (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _).trans hq
  have hnonneg (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      Real.exp (u * f q.1) * W q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) :=
    integral_nonneg_of_ae (hW0.mono fun q hq => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hq)
  rcases he with rfl | rfl
  · simpa only [one_mul] using
      (entropy_exp_mul_pi_le_integral_proxy_of_bounded ν f hfm M hM hbound W hWi
        hgrad hs).trans (by nlinarith [hnonneg s, sq_nonneg s])
  · have h := entropy_exp_neg_mul_pi_le_exp_mul_integral_proxy_of_bounded
      ν f hfm M hM hbound W hWi hgrad hdiff hs
    have hE : Real.exp (s * b) ≤ 3 :=
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hsb).trans (Real.exp_one_lt_three).le
    have hN : 0 ≤ ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        Real.exp (s * (-f q.1)) * W q ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) := by
      simpa only [neg_mul, mul_neg] using hnonneg (-s)
    simpa only [neg_one_mul] using h.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (sq_nonneg s)) hN)

name: NLAlib.mul_integral_mul_le_entropy_add_mul_log_integral_exp
statement:
theorem mul_integral_mul_le_entropy_add_mul_log_integral_exp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Y V : Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ x, 0 < Y x)
    (hYi : Integrable Y μ) (hYlog : Integrable (fun x => Y x * Real.log (Y x)) μ)
    (hYV : Integrable (fun x => Y x * V x) μ)
    {θ : ℝ} (hVi : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (θ * V x)) μ) :
    θ * (∫ x, Y x * V x ∂μ) ≤
      ((∫ x, Y x * Real.log (Y x) ∂μ) -
        (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Y x ∂μ)) +
      (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (θ * V x) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  let m : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.exp (θ * V x) ∂μ
  have hm : 0 < m := mgf_pos hVi
  let U : Ω → ℝ := fun x => θ * V x - Real.log m
  have hUeq : (fun x => Real.exp (U x)) =
      (fun x => Real.exp (θ * V x) / m) := by
    ext x
    dsimp [U]
    rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hm]
  have hUi : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (U x)) μ := by
    rw [hUeq]
    exact hVi.div_const m
  have hUone : ∫ x, Real.exp (U x) ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hUeq, integral_div]
    change m / m ≤ 1
    rw [div_self hm.ne']
  have hYUi : Integrable (fun x => Y x * U x) μ := by
    convert (hYV.const_mul θ).sub (hYi.mul_const (Real.log m)) using 1
    ext x
    dsimp [U]
    ring
  have hg := integral_mul_le_entropy_of_integral_exp_le_one μ Y U
    hY hYi hYlog hYUi hUi hUone
  have he : ∫ x, Y x * U x ∂μ =
      θ * (∫ x, Y x * V x ∂μ) - (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log m := by
    have hfun : (fun x => Y x * U x) =
        (fun x => θ * (Y x * V x) - Y x * Real.log m) := by
      ext x
      dsimp [U]
      ring
    rw [hfun, integral_sub (f := fun x => θ * (Y x * V x))
      (g := fun x => Y x * Real.log m) (hYV.const_mul θ)
      (hYi.mul_const (Real.log m)), integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const]
  rw [he] at hg
  dsimp [m] at hg
  linarith

name: NLAlib.entropy_le_mul_log_integral_exp_of_weighted_proxy
statement:
theorem entropy_le_mul_log_integral_exp_of_weighted_proxy
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Y V : Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ x, 0 < Y x)
    (hYi : Integrable Y μ) (hYlog : Integrable (fun x => Y x * Real.log (Y x)) μ)
    (hYV : Integrable (fun x => Y x * V x) μ)
    {θ v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hθ : v < θ)
    (hVi : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (θ * V x)) μ)
    (hproxy : (∫ x, Y x * Real.log (Y x) ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) ≤
        v * (∫ x, Y x * V x ∂μ)) :
    (∫ x, Y x * Real.log (Y x) ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) ≤
      v / (θ - v) * (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) *
        Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (θ * V x) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := mul_integral_mul_le_entropy_add_mul_log_integral_exp
    μ Y V hY hYi hYlog hYV hVi
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hv
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := hv.trans_lt hθ
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hproxy hθpos.le
  have he : v / (θ - v) * (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) *
      Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (θ * V x) ∂μ) =
      (v * (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (θ * V x) ∂μ)) / (θ - v) := by ring
  rw [he]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hθ)).mpr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.condExp_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_matrixLog_of_ae_posDef_condExp
statement:
theorem condExp_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_matrixLog_of_ae_posDef_condExp
    {Ω n : Type*} {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ) [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) μ)
    (hTrace : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (H + X ω)) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (μ[(fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) | m] ω).PosDef) :
    μ[(fun ω => traceExp (H + X ω)) | m] ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => traceExp (H + matrixLog (μ[(fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) | m] ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (matrixExp (X ω)).PosDef :=
    hHerm.mono fun ω hω => (posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp _ hω).1
  have heq : (fun ω => traceExp (H + matrixLog (matrixExp (X ω)))) =ᵐ[μ]
      (fun ω => traceExp (H + X ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    rw [(posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp _ hω).2]
  have hJ := ConcaveOn.condExp_map_le_of_condExp_mem hm (lieb_concavity H hH)
    (continuousOn_traceExp_add_matrixLog H) hpos hExp (hTrace.congr heq.symm) hmean
  filter_upwards [hJ, condExp_congr_ae heq] with ω hω hEq
  rw [← hEq]
  exact hω

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixExp_smul_of_ae_le_algebraMap
statement:
theorem integrable_matrixExp_smul_of_ae_le_algebraMap [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) {L θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) L) :
    Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix n n ℂ) := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
    dsimp [matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  refine Integrable.of_bound (hc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX) (Real.exp (θ * L)) ?_
  filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω hHerm hBound
  rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc _ hHerm]
  apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  intro x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    ((le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hHerm).mp hBound x hx) hθ)

name: NLAlib.ae_condExp_matrixExp_one_le_and_condExp_sq_posSemidef_and_matrixLog_le
statement:
theorem ae_condExp_matrixExp_one_le_and_condExp_sq_posSemidef_and_matrixLog_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    {X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : Integrable X μ)
    (hX2 : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) μ) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hMean : μ[X | m] =ᵐ[μ] 0) {L θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθL : θ * L < 3)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) L) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ μ[(fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) | m] ω ∧
      (μ[(fun ω => X ω ^ 2) | m] ω).PosSemidef ∧
      matrixLog (μ[(fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) | m] ω) ≤
        ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • μ[(fun ω => X ω ^ 2) | m] ω
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ := (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)
  let M : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ := μ[(fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) | m]
  let V : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ := μ[(fun ω => X ω ^ 2) | m]
  have hExp := integrable_matrixExp_smul_of_ae_le_algebraMap hX.1 hHerm hθ.le hBound
  have hXθ : Integrable (fun ω => θ • X ω) μ := hX.smul θ
  have hX2g : Integrable (fun ω => g • X ω ^ 2) μ := hX2.smul g
  have hlin : Integrable (fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) μ :=
    (integrable_const 1).add hXθ
  have hquad : Integrable (fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω + g • X ω ^ 2) μ :=
    hlin.add hX2g
  have hCElin : μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) | m] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    filter_upwards [condExp_add (integrable_const (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) hXθ m,
      condExp_smul θ X m, hMean] with ω ha hs hzero
    change μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) | m] ω = _ at ha
    change μ[(fun ω => θ • X ω) | m] ω = θ • μ[X | m] ω at hs
    change μ[X | m] ω = 0 at hzero
    rw [ha, condExp_const hm 1]
    change 1 + μ[(fun ω => θ • X ω) | m] ω = 1
    rw [hs, hzero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hCEquad : μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω + g • X ω ^ 2) | m] =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => 1 + g • V ω := by
    filter_upwards [condExp_add hlin hX2g m, condExp_smul g (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) m, hCElin]
      with ω ha hs hl
    change μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω + g • X ω ^ 2) | m] ω = _ at ha
    change μ[(fun ω => g • X ω ^ 2) | m] ω = g • V ω at hs
    change μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) | m] ω = 1 at hl
    rw [ha]
    change μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) | m] ω +
      μ[(fun ω => g • X ω ^ 2) | m] ω = 1 + g • V ω
    rw [hl, hs]
  have htangent : (fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    exact one_add_le_matrixExp_of_isHermitian _
      (hω.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial θ)))
  have hlinear := ae_condExp_le_condExp_of_ae_le hm hlin hExp htangent
  have hpolynomial : (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω + g • X ω ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω hω hB
    exact matrixExp_smul_le_one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_of_spectrum_le _ hω
      (fun x hx => exp_mul_le_one_add_mul_add_sq_mul_of_le hθ hθL
        ((le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le hω).mp hB x hx))
  have hupper := ae_condExp_le_condExp_of_ae_le hm hExp hquad hpolynomial
  have hV := ae_posSemidef_condExp_of_ae_posSemidef hm hX2 (hHerm.mono fun ω hω => by
    have heq : X ω ^ 2 = (X ω)ᴴ * X ω := by rw [hω.eq, sq]
    rw [heq]
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _)
  filter_upwards [hlinear, hupper, hCElin, hCEquad, hV] with ω hl hu hcl hcu hv
  change μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω) | m] ω ≤ M ω at hl
  change M ω ≤ μ[(fun ω => (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + θ • X ω + g • X ω ^ 2) | m] ω at hu
  rw [hcl] at hl
  rw [hcu] at hu
  refine ⟨hl, hv, ?_⟩
  have hMpd : (M ω).PosDef := by
    have hp := (Matrix.PosDef.one : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).PosDef).add_posSemidef (Matrix.le_iff.mp hl)
    have heq : 1 + (M ω - 1) = M ω := by abel
    rw [heq] at hp
    exact hp
  have hgv : (g • V ω).IsHermitian := hv.isHermitian.smul
    (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial g))
  have hexp := posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp (g • V ω) hgv
  have hu' : M ω ≤ matrixExp (g • V ω) :=
    hu.trans (one_add_le_matrixExp_of_isHermitian _ hgv)
  have hlog := CFC.log_monotoneOn hMpd.isStrictlyPositive hexp.1.isStrictlyPositive hu'
  change matrixLog (M ω) ≤ matrixLog (matrixExp (g • V ω)) at hlog
  rw [hexp.2] at hlog
  exact hlog
