    exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
      integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ =>
        (hP i j k l).const_mul (A i j * A k l)
  have hind2 : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IndepFun (fun ω => z ω i) (fun ω => z ω j) μ :=
    fun i j h => hindep.indepFun h
  rw [variance_eq_sub ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hQ.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hQ2)]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [integral_quadForm_sq A hmeas hindep hmean hsq h4 hm4,
    integral_quadForm_eq_trace A hL2 hind2 hmean hsq]
  ring

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ) {m₄ : ℝ}
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = m₄) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] =
      2 * (frobSq A - ∑ i, A i i ^ 2) + (m₄ - 1) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [variance_quadForm A hmeas hindep hmean hsq h4 hm4]
  have h1 : ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * A j i = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
      have h := hA.apply i j
      rw [star_trivial] at h
      rw [h, sq]
  have h2 : frobSq A = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 := by
    simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, sq]
  rw [h1, h2]
  ring

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_three
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_three [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ)
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = 3) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] = 2 * frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian hA hmeas hindep hmean hsq h4 hm4]
  ring

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_one
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_one [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ)
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = 1) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] = 2 * (frobSq A - ∑ i, A i i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian hA hmeas hindep hmean hsq h4 hm4]
  ring

name: NLAlib.hanson_wright_of_constants
statement:
private theorem hanson_wright_of_constants {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ}
    {K C t : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hC_domain : 4 * exp 1 ≤ C)
    (hC_diag_quad : 8 * exp 1 ^ 3 ≤ C)
    (hC_offdiag_domain : 16 * exp 1 ≤ C ^ 2)
    (hC_offdiag_quad : 64 * exp 1 ^ 2 ≤ C)
    (hF : 0 < frobNorm A) (hOp : 0 < specNorm A)
    (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |centeredQuadraticForm μ A X ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) *
        min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
          (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hHW : HasHansonWrightMGF μ A X K C :=
    hasHansonWrightMGF_of_subgaussian hK hC hC_domain hC_diag_quad
      hC_offdiag_domain hC_offdiag_quad hOp hind hmgf
  have hv : 0 < K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hb : 0 < K ^ 2 * specNorm A := by positivity
  exact measureReal_abs_ge_le_two_mul_exp_of_cgf_le hC hv hb
    (Y := centeredQuadraticForm μ A X)
    (fun l hl => by
      have hl' : |l| ≤ (2 * C * K ^ 2 * specNorm A)⁻¹ := by
        convert hl using 2
        ring
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hHW.1 l hl')
    (fun l hl => by
      have hl' : |l| ≤ (2 * C * K ^ 2 * specNorm A)⁻¹ := by
        convert hl using 2
        ring
      exact hHW.2 l hl') ht

name: NLAlib.hanson_wright_mgf_fin
statement:
private theorem hanson_wright_mgf_fin {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |centeredQuadraticForm μ A X ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * (64 * exp 1 ^ 2))) *
        min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2)) (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)))
proof:
:= by
  let C0 : ℝ := 64 * exp 1 ^ 2
  have hexp_pos : 0 < exp 1 := exp_pos 1
  have hexp_ge_one : 1 ≤ exp 1 := one_le_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
  have hexp_le_eight : exp 1 ≤ 8 := by
    nlinarith [exp_one_lt_three.le]
  have hC0_pos : 0 < C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    positivity
  have hC0_domain : 4 * exp 1 ≤ C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_ge_one
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * exp 1)
    nlinarith
  have hC0_diag_quad : 8 * exp 1 ^ 3 ≤ C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le_eight
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 8 * exp 1 ^ 2)
    nlinarith
  have hC0_ge_offdiag : 16 * exp 1 ≤ C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_ge_one
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 16 * exp 1)
    nlinarith
  have hC0_ge_one : 1 ≤ C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    nlinarith [hexp_ge_one, sq_nonneg (exp 1)]
  have hC0_sq_ge : C0 ≤ C0 ^ 2 := by
    have hC0_nonneg : 0 ≤ C0 := hC0_pos.le
    have hmul := mul_le_mul hC0_ge_one (le_refl C0) hC0_nonneg hC0_nonneg
    simpa [pow_two] using hmul
  have hC0_offdiag_domain : 16 * exp 1 ≤ C0 ^ 2 :=
    hC0_ge_offdiag.trans hC0_sq_ge
  have hC0_offdiag_quad : 64 * exp 1 ^ 2 ≤ C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    rfl
  change μ.real {ω | t ≤ |centeredQuadraticForm μ A X ω|} ≤
    2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * C0)) *
      min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
        (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)))
  by_cases hF : 0 < frobNorm A
  · by_cases hOp : 0 < specNorm A
    · exact
        hanson_wright_of_constants (μ := μ) (A := A) (X := X)
          (K := K) (C := C0) (t := t) hK hC0_pos hC0_domain
          hC0_diag_quad hC0_offdiag_domain hC0_offdiag_quad hF hOp
          hind hmgf ht
    · have hOp_nonneg : 0 ≤ specNorm A := specNorm_nonneg A
      have hOp_zero : specNorm A = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hOp) hOp_nonneg
      have hfirst_nonneg :
          0 ≤ t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2) := by positivity
      have hsecond_zero : t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A) = 0 := by
        rw [hOp_zero, mul_zero, div_zero]
      have hmin :
          min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
              (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)) = 0 := by
        rw [hsecond_zero, min_eq_right hfirst_nonneg]
      calc
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |centeredQuadraticForm μ A X ω|} ≤ (1 : ℝ) := measureReal_le_one
        _ ≤ 2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * C0)) *
            min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
              (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A))) := by
            rw [hmin]
            norm_num
  · have hF_nonneg : 0 ≤ frobNorm A := frobNorm_nonneg A
    have hF_zero : frobNorm A = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hF) hF_nonneg
    have hOp_nonneg : 0 ≤ specNorm A := specNorm_nonneg A
    have hfirst_zero :
        t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2) = 0 := by
      rw [hF_zero]
      simp
    have hsecond_nonneg : 0 ≤ t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A) :=
      div_nonneg ht (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg K) hOp_nonneg)
    have hmin :
        min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
            (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)) = 0 := by
      rw [hfirst_zero, min_eq_left hsecond_nonneg]
    calc
      μ.real {ω | t ≤ |centeredQuadraticForm μ A X ω|} ≤ (1 : ℝ) := measureReal_le_one
      _ ≤ 2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * C0)) *
          min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2))
            (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A))) := by
          rw [hmin]
          norm_num

name: NLAlib.hanson_wright_mgf
statement:
theorem hanson_wright_mgf {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |quadForm A (fun i => X i ω) -
      ∫ ω', quadForm A (fun i => X i ω') ∂μ|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2)) (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)))
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
  have h := hanson_wright_mgf_fin (A := A.reindex e e) (X := fun k => X (e.symm k)) hK
    (hind.precomp e.symm.injective) (fun k => hmgf (e.symm k)) t ht
  rw [show (4 : ℝ) * (64 * exp 1 ^ 2) = 256 * exp 1 ^ 2 by ring] at h
  have hq : ∀ ω, quadForm (A.reindex e e) (fun k => X (e.symm k) ω) =
      quadForm A (fun i => X i ω) := fun ω => quadForm_reindex A e (fun i => X i ω)
  simp only [centeredQuadraticForm, randomQuadraticForm, hq, frobNorm_reindex,
    specNorm_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.hanson_wright_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two
statement:
theorem hanson_wright_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hind : iIndepFun X μ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (exp ((X i ω / K) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |quadForm A (fun i => X i ω) -
      ∫ ω', quadForm A (fun i => X i ω') ∂μ|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (20736 * exp 1 ^ 2)) *
        min (t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2)) (t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) ⟨(3 * K) ^ 2, sq_nonneg (3 * K)⟩ μ := by
    intro i
    have hp : (⟨9 * K ^ 2, by positivity⟩ : ℝ≥0) =
        ⟨(3 * K) ^ 2, sq_nonneg (3 * K)⟩ := by
      ext
      ring
    rw [← hp]
    exact hasSubgaussianMGF_of_lintegral_exp_sq_le_two (hX i) K hK (hmean i) (hpsi i)
  have h := hanson_wright_mgf A X (3 * K) (by positivity) hind hmgf t ht
  let u := t ^ 2 / (K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2)
  let v := t / (K ^ 2 * specNorm A)
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (256 * exp 1 ^ 2)
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := div_nonneg ht
    (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg K) (specNorm_nonneg A))
  have hquad : t ^ 2 / ((3 * K) ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2) = u / 81 := by
    dsimp [u]
    rw [div_div]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hlinear : t / ((3 * K) ^ 2 * specNorm A) = v / 9 := by
    dsimp [v]
    rw [div_div]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hquad, hlinear] at h
  have hmin : (1 / 81 : ℝ) * min u v ≤ min (u / 81) (v / 9) := by
    apply le_min
    · nlinarith [min_le_left u v]
    · nlinarith [min_le_right u v]
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hscale : c / 81 = 1 / (20736 * exp 1 ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [c]
    rw [div_div]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hexp : exp (-c * min (u / 81) (v / 9)) ≤
      exp (-(1 / (20736 * exp 1 ^ 2)) * min u v) := by
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    rw [← hscale]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin hc]
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by norm_num))

name: NLAlib.toEuclideanCLM_adjoint
statement:
lemma toEuclideanCLM_adjoint {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A) =
      Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A.conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).adjoint =
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A.conjTranspose)
  congr 1
  exact (Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint A).symm

name: NLAlib.trace_adjoint_comp_toEuclideanCLM_eq_frobSq
statement:
lemma trace_adjoint_comp_toEuclideanCLM_eq_frobSq {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (LinearMap.trace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A) ∘L
        Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).toLinearMap) = frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  let T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A
  let S : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∘L T
  change (LinearMap.trace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) S.toLinearMap = frobSq A
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner S.toLinearMap (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)]
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  dsimp [S, T]
  have hbasis (i : Fin n) :
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ j).ofLp i =
        if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp]
  rw [toEuclideanCLM_adjoint]
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp]
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec,
    dotProduct]
  have hsum_basis (k : Fin n) :
      (∑ x, A x k * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 *
        ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp x_1) =
        ∑ x, A x k * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    apply congrArg (fun z => A x k * z)
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x_1 _
    apply congrArg (fun z => A x x_1 * z)
    exact hbasis x_1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · have hsum_step :
        inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp j)
            (∑ x, A x j * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 *
              ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp x_1) =
          inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp j)
            (∑ x, A x j * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
      congrArg (fun z => inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp j) z)
        (hsum_basis j)
    calc
      inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp j)
          (∑ x, A x j * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 *
            ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp x_1) =
          inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp j)
          (∑ x, A x j * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
        hsum_step
      _ = inner ℝ (if j = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
            (∑ x, A x j * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
        congrArg (fun z => inner ℝ z
          (∑ x, A x j * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
          (hbasis j)
      _ = ∑ x, A x j ^ 2 := by
        simp
        ring_nf
  · intro i _ hij
    have hsum_step :
        inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp i)
            (∑ x, A x i * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 *
              ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp x_1) =
          inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp i)
            (∑ x, A x i * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
      congrArg (fun z => inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp i) z)
        (hsum_basis i)
    calc
      inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp i)
          (∑ x, A x i * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 *
            ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp x_1) =
          inner ℝ (((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) j).ofLp i)
          (∑ x, A x i * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
        hsum_step
      _ = inner ℝ (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
            (∑ x, A x i * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
        congrArg (fun z => inner ℝ z
          (∑ x, A x i * ∑ x_1, A x x_1 * (if x_1 = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
          (hbasis i)
      _ = 0 := by simp [hij]
  · intro hj
    exact (hj (Finset.mem_univ j)).elim

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_adjoint_comp_le_opNorm_sq
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_adjoint_comp_le_opNorm_sq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) :
    let S : E →L[ℝ] E
proof:
:= ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∘L T
    let hSpos : S.toLinearMap.IsPositive :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_adjoint_comp_self T).toLinearMap
    hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 := by
  intro S hSpos
  let hsym := hSpos.isSymmetric
  let b := hsym.eigenvectorBasis (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E)
  let e := b i
  let lam := hsym.eigenvalues rfl i
  have heig : S.toLinearMap e = lam • e := by
    exact hsym.apply_eigenvectorBasis (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E) i
  have hinner : inner ℝ (S e) e = lam := by
    rw [show S e = S.toLinearMap e by rfl, heig]
    rw [inner_smul_left]
    rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
    simp [e, b]
  have hnorm_sq : ‖T e‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ (S e) e := by
    simpa [S] using ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_left T e
  have hnorm_le : ‖T e‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
    have h := T.le_opNorm e
    simpa [e, b, OrthonormalBasis.norm_eq_one] using h
  have hnorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖T e‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hop_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖T‖ := norm_nonneg _
  calc
    lam = ‖T e‖ ^ 2 := by rw [← hinner, ← hnorm_sq]
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_quadratic_stdGaussian_le
statement:
lemma integral_exp_quadratic_stdGaussian_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (hTpos : T.toLinearMap.IsPositive) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
      θ * hTpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∫ x : E, exp (θ * inner ℝ (T x) x) ∂(stdGaussian E) ≤
      exp (2 * exp 1 ^ 2 * θ *
        (∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), hTpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i))
proof:
:= by
  let hsym := hTpos.isSymmetric
  let b := hsym.eigenvectorBasis (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E)
  let lam : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ := fun i => hsym.eigenvalues rfl i
  have hnonneg : ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), 0 ≤ lam i := by
    intro i
    simpa [lam, hsym] using hTpos.nonneg_eigenvalues
      (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E) i
  have hsynth_aemeas :
      AEMeasurable (fun z : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ => ∑ i, z i • b i)
        (gaussianVector (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E))) := by
    exact (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
      (continuous_apply i).smul continuous_const).aemeasurable
  have hf_aesm :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : E => exp (θ * inner ℝ (T x) x))
        (Measure.map (fun z : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ => ∑ i, z i • b i)
          (gaussianVector (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)))) := by
    fun_prop
  rw [stdGaussian_eq_map_pi_orthonormalBasis b]
  rw [integral_map hsynth_aemeas hf_aesm]
  have hpoint : ∀ z : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ,
      exp (θ * inner ℝ (T (∑ i, z i • b i)) (∑ i, z i • b i)) =
        ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), exp ((θ * lam i) * z i ^ 2) := by
    intro z
    change exp (θ * inner ℝ (T.toLinearMap (∑ i, z i • b i)) (∑ i, z i • b i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), exp ((θ * lam i) * z i ^ 2)
    have hquad :=
      symmetric_inner_apply_eq_sum_eigenvalues_repr T.toLinearMap hsym (∑ i, z i • b i)
    rw [hquad]
    have hsum_eq :
        (∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
            hsym.eigenvalues rfl i * (hsym.eigenvectorBasis rfl).repr
              (∑ i, z i • b i) i ^ 2) =
          ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), lam i * z i ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have hcoord :
          (hsym.eigenvectorBasis rfl).repr (∑ i, z i • b i) i = z i := by
        change b.repr (∑ i, z i • b i) i = z i
        exact orthonormalBasis_repr_sum_smul b z i
      rw [hcoord]
    rw [hsum_eq]
    rw [← Real.exp_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  calc
    ∫ (x : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ),
        exp (θ * inner ℝ (T (∑ i, x i • b i)) (∑ i, x i • b i))
        ∂(gaussianVector (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)))
        = ∫ (x : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ),
          ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), exp ((θ * lam i) * x i ^ 2)
        ∂(gaussianVector (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E))) := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with z
          exact hpoint z
    _ = ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
          ∫ x : ℝ, exp ((θ * lam i) * x ^ 2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
          exact (integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (𝕜 := ℝ)
            (ι := Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) (E := fun _ => ℝ)
            (f := fun i x => exp ((θ * lam i) * x ^ 2))
            (μ := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1))
    _ ≤ ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
          exp (2 * exp 1 * ((θ * lam i) * 1 * exp 1)) := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro i _
            exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => exp_nonneg _)
          · intro i _
            have hθi : 0 ≤ θ * lam i := mul_nonneg hθ (hnonneg i)
            have hle := integral_exp_mul_sq_le_exp_linear_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
              (μ := gaussianReal 0 1) (hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal 1)
              (θ := θ * lam i) (C0 := 1) hθi (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_
            · simpa only [id_eq] using hle
            · convert hsmall i using 1; ring
    _ = exp (2 * exp 1 ^ 2 * θ *
          (∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), lam i)) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_sum]
          congr 1
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_quadratic_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma integrable_exp_quadratic_stdGaussian {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (hTpos : T.toLinearMap.IsPositive) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
      θ * hTpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i * exp 1 < 1) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => exp (θ * inner ℝ (T x) x)) (stdGaussian E)
proof:
:= by
  let hsym := hTpos.isSymmetric
  let b := hsym.eigenvectorBasis (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E)
  let lam : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ := fun i => hsym.eigenvalues rfl i
  have hnonneg : ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), 0 ≤ lam i := by
    intro i
    simpa [lam, hsym] using hTpos.nonneg_eigenvalues
      (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E) i
  have hsynth_aemeas :
      AEMeasurable (fun z : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ => ∑ i, z i • b i)
        (gaussianVector (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E))) := by
    exact (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
      (continuous_apply i).smul continuous_const).aemeasurable
  have hf_aesm :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : E => exp (θ * inner ℝ (T x) x))
        (Measure.map (fun z : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ => ∑ i, z i • b i)
          (gaussianVector (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)))) := by
    fun_prop
  have hpoint : ∀ z : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ,
      exp (θ * inner ℝ (T (∑ i, z i • b i)) (∑ i, z i • b i)) =
        ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), exp ((θ * lam i) * z i ^ 2) := by
    intro z
    change exp (θ * inner ℝ (T.toLinearMap (∑ i, z i • b i)) (∑ i, z i • b i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), exp ((θ * lam i) * z i ^ 2)
    have hquad :=
      symmetric_inner_apply_eq_sum_eigenvalues_repr T.toLinearMap hsym (∑ i, z i • b i)
    rw [hquad]
    have hsum_eq :
        (∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
            hsym.eigenvalues rfl i * (hsym.eigenvectorBasis rfl).repr
              (∑ i, z i • b i) i ^ 2) =
          ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), lam i * z i ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have hcoord :
          (hsym.eigenvectorBasis rfl).repr (∑ i, z i • b i) i = z i := by
        change b.repr (∑ i, z i • b i) i = z i
        exact orthonormalBasis_repr_sum_smul b z i
      rw [hcoord]
    rw [hsum_eq]
    rw [← Real.exp_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [stdGaussian_eq_map_pi_orthonormalBasis b]
  rw [integrable_map_measure hf_aesm hsynth_aemeas]
  refine (MeasureTheory.Integrable.fintype_prod (𝕜 := ℝ)
    (ι := Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) (E := ℝ)
    (f := fun i x => exp ((θ * lam i) * x ^ 2))
    (μ := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1) ?_).congr ?_
  · intro i
    have hθi : 0 ≤ θ * lam i := mul_nonneg hθ (hnonneg i)
    exact integrable_exp_mul_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
      (μ := gaussianReal 0 1) (hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal 1)
      (θ := θ * lam i) (C0 := 1) hθi (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by
        simpa [mul_assoc] using hsmall i)
  · filter_upwards with z
    exact (hpoint z).symm

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_inner_toEuclideanCLM_prod_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma integrable_exp_inner_toEuclideanCLM_prod_stdGaussian {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {l : ℝ}
    (hsmall : (l ^ 2 / 2) * specNorm A ^ 2 * exp 1 < 1) :
    Integrable
      (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        exp (l * inner ℝ (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A p.1) p.2))
      ((stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).prod
        (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
proof:
:= by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
  let γ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let T : E →L[ℝ] E := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A
  let S : E →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∘L T
  let hSpos : S.toLinearMap.IsPositive :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_adjoint_comp_self T).toLinearMap
  let f : E × E → ℝ := fun p => exp (l * inner ℝ (T p.1) p.2)
  have hf_aesm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (γ.prod γ) := by
    dsimp [f]
    fun_prop
  have hθ_nonneg : 0 ≤ l ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  have hsmall_eig :
      ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
        (l ^ 2 / 2) * hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i * exp 1 < 1 := by
    intro i
    have heig_le : hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [S, hSpos] using eigenvalue_adjoint_comp_le_opNorm_sq T i
    have hcoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ l ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
    have hstep :
        (l ^ 2 / 2) * hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i * exp 1 ≤
          (l ^ 2 / 2) * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * exp 1 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heig_le hcoef_nonneg) (exp_nonneg 1)
    have hnorm : ‖T‖ = specNorm A := (Matrix.cstar_norm_def A).symm
    rw [hnorm] at hstep
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hstep hsmall
  have hquad_int :
      Integrable (fun y : E => exp ((l ^ 2 / 2) * inner ℝ (S y) y)) γ :=
    integrable_exp_quadratic_stdGaussian S hSpos hθ_nonneg hsmall_eig
  rw [integrable_prod_iff hf_aesm]
  constructor
  · filter_upwards with y
    change Integrable (fun x : E => exp (l * inner ℝ (T y) x)) γ
    exact integrable_exp_innerSL_stdGaussian (E := E) (T y) l
  · have houter_eq :
        (fun y : E => ∫ x : E, ‖f (y, x)‖ ∂γ) =ᵐ[γ]
          fun y : E => exp ((l ^ 2 / 2) * inner ℝ (S y) y) := by
      filter_upwards with y
      have hinner :
          ∫ x : E, ‖f (y, x)‖ ∂γ =
            ∫ x : E, exp (l * inner ℝ (T y) x) ∂γ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with x
        dsimp [f]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (exp_nonneg _)]
      rw [hinner, integral_exp_innerSL_stdGaussian (E := E) (T y) l]
      have hnorm_sq : ‖T y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ (S y) y := by
        simpa [S] using ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_left T y
      rw [hnorm_sq]
      ring_nf
    exact hquad_int.congr houter_eq.symm

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_inner_toEuclideanCLM_prod_stdGaussian_le
statement:
lemma integral_exp_inner_toEuclideanCLM_prod_stdGaussian_le {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {l : ℝ}
    (hsmall : (l ^ 2 / 2) * specNorm A ^ 2 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∫ p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
        exp (l * inner ℝ (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A p.1) p.2)
      ∂((stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).prod
        (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))) ≤
      exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * frobNorm A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
  let γ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let T : E →L[ℝ] E := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A
  let S : E →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∘L T
  let hSpos : S.toLinearMap.IsPositive :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_adjoint_comp_self T).toLinearMap
  let f : E × E → ℝ := fun p => exp (l * inner ℝ (T p.1) p.2)
  have hf_int : Integrable f (γ.prod γ) :=
    integrable_exp_inner_toEuclideanCLM_prod_stdGaussian A (by
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hsmall (by norm_num))
  have hθ_nonneg : 0 ≤ l ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  have hsmall_eig :
      ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
        (l ^ 2 / 2) * hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro i
    have heig_le : hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [S, hSpos] using eigenvalue_adjoint_comp_le_opNorm_sq T i
    have hcoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ l ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
    have hstep :
        (l ^ 2 / 2) * hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i * exp 1 ≤
          (l ^ 2 / 2) * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * exp 1 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heig_le hcoef_nonneg) (exp_nonneg 1)
    have hnorm : ‖T‖ = specNorm A := (Matrix.cstar_norm_def A).symm
    rw [hnorm] at hstep
    exact hstep.trans hsmall
  have hsum_eq :
      (∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i) =
        frobSq A := by
    have htrace_eigs :
        (LinearMap.trace ℝ E) S.toLinearMap =
          ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i := by
      simpa using hSpos.isSymmetric.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
        (by rfl : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ E)
    have htrace_frob :
        (LinearMap.trace ℝ E) S.toLinearMap = frobSq A := by
      simpa [E, S, T] using trace_adjoint_comp_toEuclideanCLM_eq_frobSq A
    exact htrace_eigs.symm.trans htrace_frob
  have hinner_eq :
      (fun y : E => ∫ x : E, f (y, x) ∂γ) =ᵐ[γ]
        fun y : E => exp ((l ^ 2 / 2) * inner ℝ (S y) y) := by
    filter_upwards with y
    rw [integral_exp_innerSL_stdGaussian (E := E) (T y) l]
    have hnorm_sq : ‖T y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ (S y) y := by
      simpa [S] using ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_left T y
    rw [hnorm_sq]
    ring_nf
  calc
    ∫ p : E × E, f p ∂(γ.prod γ)
        = ∫ y : E, ∫ x : E, f (y, x) ∂γ ∂γ := by
          rw [integral_prod f hf_int]
    _ = ∫ y : E, exp ((l ^ 2 / 2) * inner ℝ (S y) y) ∂γ := by
          exact integral_congr_ae hinner_eq
    _ ≤ exp (2 * exp 1 ^ 2 * (l ^ 2 / 2) *
          (∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E), hSpos.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i)) :=
          integral_exp_quadratic_stdGaussian_le S hSpos hθ_nonneg hsmall_eig
    _ = exp (exp 1 ^ 2 * l ^ 2 * frobNorm A ^ 2) := by
          rw [hsum_eq, frobNorm_sq]
          congr 1
          ring

name: NLAlib.diagonalCenteredQuadraticForm_cgf_le
statement:
lemma diagonalCenteredQuadraticForm_cgf_le {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ}
    {K C θ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hC_domain : exp 1 ≤ C) (hC_quad : 2 * exp 1 ^ 3 ≤ C)
    (hOp : 0 < specNorm A)
    (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) ⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ μ)
    (hθ : |θ| ≤ (2 * C * K ^ 2 * specNorm A)⁻¹) :
    cgf (diagonalCenteredQuadraticForm μ A X) μ θ ≤
      C * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ :=
    fun i ω => X i ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X i ω ^ 2 ∂μ
  let Z : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => A i i * Y i ω
  have hKsq_pos : 0 < K ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hK
  have hKsq_nonneg : 0 ≤ K ^ 2 := hKsq_pos.le
  have hC0_le : ((⟨K ^ 2, sq_nonneg K⟩ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤ K ^ 2 := by simp
  have hscale :
      |θ| * K ^ 2 * specNorm A ≤ 1 / (2 * C) := by
    have hfactor_nonneg : 0 ≤ K ^ 2 * specNorm A :=
      mul_nonneg hKsq_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg A)
    calc
      |θ| * K ^ 2 * specNorm A
          = |θ| * (K ^ 2 * specNorm A) := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ (2 * C * K ^ 2 * specNorm A)⁻¹ * (K ^ 2 * specNorm A) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ hfactor_nonneg
      _ = 1 / (2 * C) := by
          field_simp [hC.ne', hKsq_pos.ne', hOp.ne']
  have hhalf_i : ∀ i, |A i i * θ| * K ^ 2 * exp 1 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro i
    have hdiag := abs_diag_le_specNorm A i
    have hθ_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ |θ| := abs_nonneg θ
    have hle_op :
        |θ| * |A i i| * K ^ 2 ≤ |θ| * specNorm A * K ^ 2 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiag hθ_abs_nonneg) hKsq_nonneg
    calc
      |A i i * θ| * K ^ 2 * exp 1
          = (|θ| * |A i i| * K ^ 2) * exp 1 := by
              rw [abs_mul]
              ring_nf
      _ ≤ (|θ| * specNorm A * K ^ 2) * exp 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle_op (exp_nonneg 1)
      _ = (|θ| * K ^ 2 * specNorm A) * exp 1 := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * C)) * exp 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscale (exp_nonneg 1)
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          have hdiv : exp 1 / C ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hC).mpr hC_domain
          calc
            (1 / (2 * C)) * exp 1 = (1 / 2) * (exp 1 / C) := by
              field_simp [hC.ne']
            _ ≤ (1 / 2) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num)
            _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hZ_indep : iIndepFun Z μ := by
    have hY_indep : iIndepFun Y μ := by
      simpa only [Y] using iIndepFun_centered_sq (μ := μ) (X := X) hind
    simpa only [Z, Function.comp_def] using
      hY_indep.comp (fun i x => A i i * x) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  have hZ_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Z i) μ := by
    intro i
    change AEMeasurable
      (fun ω => A i i * (X i ω ^ 2 - ∫ ω, X i ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) μ
    exact (((hmgf i).aemeasurable.pow_const 2).sub_const _).const_mul _
  have hZ_int :
      ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
        Integrable (fun ω => exp (θ * Z i ω)) μ := by
    intro i _
    have hsmall_lt : |A i i * θ| * K ^ 2 * exp 1 < 1 := by
      linarith [hhalf_i i]
    have hint :=
      integrable_exp_centered_sq_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
        (hmgf i) hKsq_pos hC0_le hsmall_lt
    convert hint using 1
    ext ω
    change exp (θ * (A i i * (X i ω ^ 2 - ∫ x, X i x ^ 2 ∂μ))) = _
    ring_nf
  have hcgf_sum :
      cgf (fun ω => ∑ i, Z i ω) μ θ = ∑ i, cgf (Z i) μ θ := by
    have hfun : (fun ω => ∑ i, Z i ω) = (∑ i, Z i) := by
      ext ω
      simp
    rw [hfun]
    exact hZ_indep.cgf_sum₀ hZ_meas (s := Finset.univ) hZ_int
  have hcgf_i :
      ∀ i, cgf (Z i) μ θ ≤
        2 * exp 1 * (A i i * θ * K ^ 2 * exp 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have hbase :=
      centered_sq_cgf_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_of_le
        (hmgf i) hKsq_pos hC0_le (hhalf_i i)
    calc
      cgf (Z i) μ θ
          = cgf (Y i) μ (A i i * θ) := by
              dsimp [Z]
              exact cgf_const_mul (μ := μ) (Y := Y i) (A i i) θ
      _ ≤ 2 * exp 1 * (A i i * θ * K ^ 2 * exp 1) ^ 2 := hbase
  have hsum_cgf_le :
      (∑ i, cgf (Z i) μ θ) ≤
        ∑ i, 2 * exp 1 * (A i i * θ * K ^ 2 * exp 1) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hcgf_i i
  have hsum_eq :
      (∑ i, 2 * exp 1 * (A i i * θ * K ^ 2 * exp 1) ^ 2) =
        (2 * exp 1 ^ 3) * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring_nf
  have hconst_le :
      (2 * exp 1 ^ 3) * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2 ≤
        C * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2 := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 := by positivity
    have hdiag_le := sum_diag_sq_le_frobNorm_sq A
    calc
      (2 * exp 1 ^ 3) * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2
          = (2 * exp 1 ^ 3) * (θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2 := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ C * (θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_quad hnonneg)
            (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg (A i i))
      _ ≤ C * (θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4) * frobNorm A ^ 2 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiag_le
            (mul_nonneg hC.le hnonneg)
      _ = C * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2 := by ring_nf
  calc
    cgf (diagonalCenteredQuadraticForm μ A X) μ θ
        = cgf (fun ω => ∑ i, Z i ω) μ θ := by rfl
    _ = ∑ i, cgf (Z i) μ θ := hcgf_sum
    _ ≤ ∑ i, 2 * exp 1 * (A i i * θ * K ^ 2 * exp 1) ^ 2 := hsum_cgf_le
    _ = (2 * exp 1 ^ 3) * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2 := hsum_eq
    _ ≤ C * θ ^ 2 * K ^ 4 * frobNorm A ^ 2 := hconst_le

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_fin_coordinate_oscillation
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_fin_coordinate_oscillation
    (N : ℕ) {S : Fin N → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (S i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, Measure (S i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M)
    (c : Fin N → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i),
      |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i) (θ : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, Real.exp (θ * f x) ∂Measure.pi μ ≤
      Real.exp (θ * (∫ x, f x ∂Measure.pi μ) + θ ^ 2 * (∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 8)
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    let x₀ : ∀ i : Fin 0, S i := fun i => Fin.elim0 i
    have he : f = fun _ => f x₀ := funext fun _ => congrArg f (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    rw [he]
    simp
  | succ N ih =>
    let ν := Measure.pi (fun i : Fin N => μ i.succ)
    let F (p : S 0 × (∀ i : Fin N, S i.succ)) := f (Fin.cons p.1 p.2)
    have hcons : Measurable (fun p : S 0 × (∀ i : Fin N, S i.succ) => Fin.cons p.1 p.2) := by
      refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => ?_
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simpa using measurable_fst
      · simpa only [Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_def] using
          (measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd
    have hFm : Measurable F := hf.comp hcons
    have hFM (p) : |F p| ≤ M := hM _
    have hFi : Integrable F ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
      Integrable.of_bound hFm.aestronglyMeasurable M (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFM)
    have hFsection (y : ∀ i : Fin N, S i.succ) : Integrable (fun z => F (z, y)) (μ 0) :=
      Integrable.of_bound (hFm.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
        M (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => hFM _)
    let g (y : ∀ i : Fin N, S i.succ) := ∫ z, F (z, y) ∂μ 0
    have hgm : Measurable g := hFm.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left'.measurable
    have hgM (y) : |g y| ≤ M := by
      calc |g y| ≤ ∫ z, |F (z, y)| ∂μ 0 := by
            simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun z => F (z, y))
        _ ≤ ∫ _ : S 0, M ∂μ 0 :=
            integral_mono (hFsection y).abs (integrable_const _) (fun _ => hFM _)
        _ = M := by simp
    have hgcoord : ∀ i (y : ∀ j : Fin N, S j.succ) (z : S i.succ),
        |g (Function.update y i z) - g y| ≤ c i.succ := by
      intro i y z
      rw [show g (Function.update y i z) - g y =
        ∫ a, F (a, Function.update y i z) - F (a, y) ∂μ 0 from
          (integral_sub (hFsection _) (hFsection _)).symm]
      have hi := (hFsection (Function.update y i z)).sub (hFsection y)
      calc |∫ a, F (a, Function.update y i z) - F (a, y) ∂μ 0| ≤
          ∫ a, |F (a, Function.update y i z) - F (a, y)| ∂μ 0 := by
            simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm
              (fun a => F (a, Function.update y i z) - F (a, y))
        _ ≤ ∫ _ : S 0, c i.succ ∂μ 0 := by
            refine integral_mono hi.abs (integrable_const _) fun a => ?_
            simpa only [F, Fin.cons_update] using hcoord i.succ (Fin.cons a y) z
        _ = c i.succ := by simp
    have hrec := ih (fun i => μ i.succ) g hgm hgM (fun i => c i.succ)
      (fun i => hc i.succ) hgcoord
    have heqf : (∫ x, f x ∂Measure.pi μ) = ∫ y, g y ∂ν := by
      rw [← ((measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0).symm).integral_comp']
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (integral_prod_symm (μ := μ 0) (ν := ν) _ hFi)
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with p
      apply congrArg f
      change Fin.insertNth 0 p.1 p.2 = Fin.cons p.1 p.2
      exact Fin.insertNth_zero _ _
    have heqexp : (∫ x, Real.exp (θ * f x) ∂Measure.pi μ) =
        ∫ y, ∫ z, Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) ∂μ 0 ∂ν := by
      rw [← ((measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0).symm).integral_comp']
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (integral_prod_symm (μ := μ 0) (ν := ν) _
        (integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (t := θ) hFm.aemeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_le.mp (hFM x))))
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with p
      congr 2
      apply congrArg f
      change Fin.insertNth 0 p.1 p.2 = Fin.cons p.1 p.2
      exact Fin.insertNth_zero _ _
    have hfiber (y : ∀ i : Fin N, S i.succ) :
        (∫ z, Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) ∂μ 0) ≤
          Real.exp (θ * g y + θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8) := by
      have hd : ∀ a b, |F (a, y) - F (b, y)| ≤ c 0 := by
        intro a b
        simpa only [F, Fin.update_cons_zero] using hcoord 0 (Fin.cons b y) a
      have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_range_oscillation (μ := μ 0) (fun z => F (z, y))
        (hFm.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aemeasurable (hc 0) hd
      have h := hsg.mgf_le θ
      change (∫ z, Real.exp (θ * (F (z, y) - g y)) ∂μ 0) ≤ _ at h
      have he : ∀ z, Real.exp (θ * (F (z, y) - g y)) =
          Real.exp (-θ * g y) * Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) := by
        intro z; rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      simp only [he, integral_const_mul] at h
      have hcanc : Real.exp (-θ * g y) * Real.exp (θ * g y) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Real.exp_pos (θ * g y)).le
      calc (∫ z, Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) ∂μ 0) =
            Real.exp (θ * g y) * (Real.exp (-θ * g y) *
              (∫ z, Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) ∂μ 0)) := by
                rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp (θ * g y)) (Real.exp (-θ * g y)),
                  hcanc, one_mul]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (θ * g y) * Real.exp ((c 0 ^ 2 / 4) * θ ^ 2 / 2) := hmul
        _ = Real.exp (θ * g y + θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [heqexp, heqf, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have hleft : Integrable (fun y => ∫ z, Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) ∂μ 0) ν :=
      (integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (μ := (μ 0).prod ν) (t := θ) hFm.aemeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_le.mp (hFM x))).integral_prod_right
    have hright : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (θ * g y + θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8)) ν := by
      simp_rw [Real.exp_add]
      exact (integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (t := θ) hgm.aemeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_le.mp (hgM x))).mul_const _
    calc (∫ y, ∫ z, Real.exp (θ * F (z, y)) ∂μ 0 ∂ν) ≤
          ∫ y, Real.exp (θ * g y + θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8) ∂ν :=
            integral_mono hleft hright hfiber
      _ = Real.exp (θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8) * ∫ y, Real.exp (θ * g y) ∂ν := by
            simp_rw [Real.exp_add, mul_comm _ (Real.exp (θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8))]
            rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (θ ^ 2 * c 0 ^ 2 / 8) *
          Real.exp (θ * (∫ y, g y ∂ν) + θ ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin N, c i.succ ^ 2) / 8) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrec (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (θ * (∫ y, g y ∂ν) + θ ^ 2 * (c 0 ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin N, c i.succ ^ 2) / 8) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_coordinate_oscillation
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_coordinate_oscillation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (S i)] (μ : ∀ i, Measure (S i))
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i), |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i)
    (θ : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, Real.exp (θ * f x) ∂Measure.pi μ ≤
      Real.exp (θ * (∫ x, f x ∂Measure.pi μ) + θ ^ 2 * (∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 8)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  let E := MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft S e
  have hu (j) (x : ∀ i : Fin (Fintype.card ι), S (e i)) (y : S (e j)) :
      E (Function.update x j y) = Function.update (E x) (e j) y := by
    change (Equiv.piCongrLeft' S e.symm).symm (Function.update x j y) =
      Function.update ((Equiv.piCongrLeft' S e.symm).symm x) (e j) y
    simpa using Function.piCongrLeft'_symm_update S e.symm x j y
  have h := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_fin_coordinate_oscillation (Fintype.card ι)
    (fun i => μ (e i)) (fun x => f (E x)) (hf.comp E.measurable)
    (fun x => hM (E x)) (fun i => c (e i)) (fun i => hc (e i))
    (fun i x y => by rw [hu]; exact hcoord (e i) (E x) y) θ
  have hi (g : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) :
      (∫ x, g (E x) ∂Measure.pi (fun i => μ (e i))) = ∫ x, g x ∂Measure.pi μ :=
    (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft μ e).integral_comp' g
  rw [hi (fun x => Real.exp (θ * f x)), hi f, e.sum_comp (fun i => c i ^ 2)] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_pi_of_coordinate_oscillation
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_pi_of_coordinate_oscillation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (S i)] (μ : ∀ i, Measure (S i))
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i), |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => f x - ∫ y, f y ∂Measure.pi μ)
      ⟨(∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 4, by positivity⟩ (Measure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i, Nonempty (S i) := fun i => nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (μ i)
  let x₀ : ∀ i, S i := fun i => Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (S i))
  let M := |f x₀| + ∑ i, c i
  have hM (x) : |f x| ≤ M := by
    have h := abs_sub_le_sum_of_coordinate_oscillation f c hcoord x₀ x
    calc |f x| ≤ |f x - f x₀| + |f x₀| := by
          simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using abs_add_le (f x - f x₀) (f x₀)
      _ ≤ (∑ i, c i) + |f x₀| := add_le_add h le_rfl
      _ = M := add_comm _ _
  let m := ∫ y, f y ∂Measure.pi μ
  refine ⟨fun θ => integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (t := θ) (a := -(M + |m|)) (b := M + |m|)
    (hf.sub_const m).aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_le.mp ?_), fun θ => ?_⟩
  · calc |f x - m| ≤ |f x| + |m| := by
          simpa only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] using abs_sub_le (f x) 0 m
      _ ≤ M + |m| := add_le_add (hM x) le_rfl
  · have h := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_of_coordinate_oscillation μ f hf hM c hc hcoord θ
    change (∫ x, Real.exp (θ * (f x - m)) ∂Measure.pi μ) ≤
      Real.exp (((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 4) * θ ^ 2 / 2)
    have he (x) : Real.exp (θ * (f x - m)) = Real.exp (-θ * m) * Real.exp (θ * f x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    simp only [he, integral_const_mul]
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Real.exp_pos _).le).trans_eq ?_
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    dsimp only [m]
    ring

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_independent_coordinate_oscillation
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_of_independent_coordinate_oscillation
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (S i)]
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → S i) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i), |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => f (fun i => X i ω) - ∫ ω', f (fun i => X i ω') ∂μ)
      ⟨(∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 4, by positivity⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  let Y (ω : Ω) : ∀ i, S i := fun i => X i ω
  have hY : Measurable Y := measurable_pi_lambda _ hX
  let ν (i : ι) := μ.map (X i)
  let : ∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) := fun i =>
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX i).aemeasurable
  have hlaw : μ.map Y = Measure.pi ν := hind.map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (hX i).aemeasurable)
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_pi_of_coordinate_oscillation ν f hf c hc hcoord
  have hm : (∫ x, f x ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∫ ω, f (Y ω) ∂μ := by
    rw [← hlaw]
    exact integral_map hY.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hlaw] at hsg
  have h := hsg.of_map hY.aemeasurable
  rw [← hlaw] at hm
  rw [hm] at h
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Y] using h

name: NLAlib.measure_ge_le_mcdiarmidTail
statement:
theorem measure_ge_le_mcdiarmidTail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {Z : Ω → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hZ : HasSubgaussianMGF Z ⟨C / 4, by positivity⟩ μ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ Z ω} ≤ mcdiarmidTail C t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : C = 0
  · subst C
    have hp : (⟨(0 : ℝ) / 4, by positivity⟩ : NNReal) = 0 := by ext; simp
    rw [hp] at hZ
    have hsg : HasSubgaussianMGF Z 0 μ := hZ
    have hz := hsg.ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
    have he : μ {ω | t ≤ Z ω} = 0 := by
      rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
      filter_upwards [hz] with ω hω
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hω
      rw [hω]
      exact not_le.mpr ht
    simp [mcdiarmidTail, ht, measureReal_def, he]
  · have h := hZ.measure_ge_le ht.le
    refine h.trans_eq ?_
    simp only [mcdiarmidTail, if_neg hzero]
    change Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (C / 4))) = Real.exp (-2 * t ^ 2 / C)
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.mcdiarmid_upper_tail
statement:
theorem mcdiarmid_upper_tail
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (S i)]
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → S i) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i), |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ f (fun i => X i ω) - ∫ ω', f (fun i => X i ω') ∂μ} ≤
      mcdiarmidTail (∑ i, c i ^ 2) t
proof:
:=
  measure_ge_le_mcdiarmidTail (by positivity)
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_independent_coordinate_oscillation X hX hind f hf c hc hcoord) ht

name: NLAlib.mcdiarmid_lower_tail
statement:
theorem mcdiarmid_lower_tail
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (S i)]
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → S i) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (f : (∀ i, S i) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i (x : ∀ j, S j) (y : S i), |f (Function.update x i y) - f x| ≤ c i)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∫ ω', f (fun i => X i ω') ∂μ) - f (fun i => X i ω)} ≤
      mcdiarmidTail (∑ i, c i ^ 2) t
proof:
:= by
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_independent_coordinate_oscillation X hX hind f hf c hc hcoord
  have h := measure_ge_le_mcdiarmidTail (by positivity) hsg.neg ht
  simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_sub] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
    {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ι → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ) (hK : ∀ i, 0 < K i)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (|X i ω| / K i)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (B : ℝ) (hKB : ∀ i, K i ≤ B) (s : ℝ) (hs : |s| ≤ 1 / (2 * B)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * ∑ i, X i ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hdomain : ∀ i, |s| ≤ 1 / (2 * K i) := fun i => hs.trans
    (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hK i)) (by nlinarith [hKB i]))
  simpa only [Finset.sum_apply] using hind.integrable_exp_mul_sum
    (t := s) hX (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => integrable_exp_mul_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
      (hX i).aemeasurable (K i) (hK i) (hpsi i) (hdomain i))

name: NLAlib.mgf_sum_le_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem mgf_sum_le_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
    {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ι → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hK : ∀ i, 0 < K i) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (|X i ω| / K i)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (B : ℝ) (hKB : ∀ i, K i ≤ B) (s : ℝ) (hs : |s| ≤ 1 / (2 * B)) :
    mgf (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) μ s ≤ Real.exp (16 * (∑ i, K i ^ 2) * s ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdomain : ∀ i, |s| ≤ 1 / (2 * K i) := fun i => hs.trans
    (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hK i)) (by nlinarith [hKB i]))
  have heq : mgf (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) μ s = ∏ i, mgf (X i) μ s := by
    have hfun : (∑ i, X i) = fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω := by
      funext ω
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [← hfun]
    exact hind.mgf_sum (t := s) hX Finset.univ
  rw [heq]
  calc
    ∏ i, mgf (X i) μ s ≤ ∏ i, Real.exp (16 * K i ^ 2 * s ^ 2) :=
      Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => mgf_nonneg)
        (fun i _ => mgf_le_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two (hX i).aemeasurable (K i) (hK i)
          (hmean i) (hpsi i) (hdomain i))
    _ = Real.exp (∑ i, 16 * K i ^ 2 * s ^ 2) := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
    _ = Real.exp (16 * (∑ i, K i ^ 2) * s ^ 2) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_ge_le_exp_of_cgf_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_ge_le_exp_of_cgf_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : Ω → ℝ} {v b C t : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (hcgf : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ → cgf Y μ l ≤ C * l ^ 2 * v)
    (hint : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (l * Y ω)) μ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ Y ω} ≤
      exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with rfl | ht_pos
  · calc μ.real {ω | 0 ≤ Y ω}
      _ ≤ (1 : ℝ) := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top prob_le_one
      _ = exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (0 ^ 2 / v) (0 / b)) := by simp
  · set l : ℝ := min (t / (2 * C * v)) ((2 * C * b)⁻¹) with hl_def
    have hden_v : 0 < 2 * C * v := by positivity
    have hden_b : 0 < 2 * C * b := by positivity
    have hl_nonneg : 0 ≤ l := by
      rw [hl_def]
      exact le_min (div_nonneg ht (le_of_lt hden_v)) (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hden_b))
    have hl_domain : |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hl_nonneg, hl_def]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    have hl_le_v : l ≤ t / (2 * C * v) := by
      rw [hl_def]
      exact min_le_left _ _
    have hl_mul_le_t : l * (2 * C * v) ≤ t := by
      rwa [le_div_iff₀ hden_v] at hl_le_v
    have hquad_le : C * l ^ 2 * v ≤ l * t / 2 := by
      nlinarith [hl_mul_le_t, hl_nonneg, hC.le, hv.le]
    have h_exp_to_half : -l * t + C * l ^ 2 * v ≤ -(l * t / 2) := by
      linarith
    have h_rate :
        l * t / 2 = (1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b) := by
      by_cases hcase : t / (2 * C * v) ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹
      · have htb_le_v : t * b ≤ v := by
          rw [inv_eq_one_div] at hcase
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hden_v hden_b] at hcase
          nlinarith [hcase, hC, hb]
        have hmin : min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b) = t ^ 2 / v := by
          rw [min_eq_left]
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hv hb]
          nlinarith [htb_le_v, ht_pos]
        rw [hl_def, min_eq_left hcase, hmin]
        field_simp [hC.ne', hv.ne']
        ring
      · have hcase' : (2 * C * b)⁻¹ ≤ t / (2 * C * v) := le_of_not_ge hcase
        have hv_le_tb : v ≤ t * b := by
          rw [inv_eq_one_div] at hcase'
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hden_b hden_v] at hcase'
          nlinarith [hcase', hC, hv]
        have hmin : min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b) = t / b := by
          rw [min_eq_right]
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hb hv]
          nlinarith [hv_le_tb, ht_pos]
        rw [hl_def, min_eq_right hcase', hmin]
        field_simp [hC.ne', hb.ne']
        ring
    have h_chernoff : μ.real {ω | t ≤ Y ω} ≤ exp (-l * t + cgf Y μ l) :=
      measure_ge_le_exp_cgf t hl_nonneg (hint l hl_domain)
    calc μ.real {ω | t ≤ Y ω}
      _ ≤ exp (-l * t + cgf Y μ l) := h_chernoff
      _ ≤ exp (-l * t + C * l ^ 2 * v) := by
        exact exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hcgf l hl_domain])
      _ ≤ exp (-(l * t / 2)) := exp_le_exp.mpr h_exp_to_half
      _ = exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b)) := by
        rw [h_rate]
        ring_nf

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_ge_le_two_mul_exp_of_cgf_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_ge_le_two_mul_exp_of_cgf_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {Y : Ω → ℝ} {v b C t : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hv : 0 < v) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hcgf : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ → cgf Y μ l ≤ C * l ^ 2 * v)
    (hint : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (l * Y ω)) μ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |Y ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := measureReal_ge_le_exp_of_cgf_le hC hv hb hcgf hint ht
  have hcgf_neg :
      ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ →
        cgf (fun ω => -Y ω) μ l ≤ C * l ^ 2 * v := by
    intro l hl
    have h_eq : cgf (fun ω => -Y ω) μ l = cgf Y μ (-l) := by
      unfold cgf mgf
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with ω
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [h_eq]
    have hl' : |-l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ := by simpa [abs_neg] using hl
    simpa using hcgf (-l) hl'
  have hint_neg : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (l * (-Y ω))) μ := by
    intro l hl
    convert hint (-l) (by simpa [abs_neg] using hl) using 1
    ext ω
    ring_nf
  have hneg := measureReal_ge_le_exp_of_cgf_le hC hv hb hcgf_neg hint_neg ht
  have h_subset :
      {ω | t ≤ |Y ω|} ⊆ {ω | t ≤ Y ω} ∪ {ω | t ≤ -Y ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_union] at hω ⊢
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (Y ω) with hY | hY
    · left
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg hY] using hω
    · right
      simpa [abs_of_neg hY] using hω
  calc (μ {ω | t ≤ |Y ω|}).toReal
      ≤ (μ ({ω | t ≤ Y ω} ∪ {ω | t ≤ -Y ω})).toReal := by
        exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top μ _) (measure_mono h_subset)
    _ ≤ (μ {ω | t ≤ Y ω}).toReal + (μ {ω | t ≤ -Y ω}).toReal := by
        rw [← ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top μ _) (measure_ne_top μ _)]
        exact ENNReal.toReal_mono
          (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨measure_ne_top μ _, measure_ne_top μ _⟩)
          (measure_union_le _ _)
    _ ≤ exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b)) +
        exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b)) := by
        exact add_le_add hpos hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.bernstein_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem bernstein_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two
    {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ι → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hK : ∀ i, 0 < K i) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (|X i ω| / K i)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (hKB : ∀ i, K i ≤ B) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |∑ i, X i ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(1 / 64 : ℝ) * min (t ^ 2 / (∑ i, K i ^ 2)) (t / B))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V := ∑ i, K i ^ 2
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  show μ.real {ω | t ≤ |∑ i, X i ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(1 / 64 : ℝ) * min (t ^ 2 / V) (t / B))
  rcases hV0.eq_or_lt with hVz | hV
  · have hVeq : V = 0 := hVz.symm
    rw [hVeq, div_zero, min_eq_left (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t / B)]
    norm_num
    have hm : μ.real {ω | t ≤ |∑ i, X i ω|} ≤ 1 := by
      simpa [measureReal_def] using
        (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) (Set.subset_univ {ω | t ≤ |∑ i, X i ω|}))
    linarith
  · have hint := fun s (hs : |s| ≤ 1 / (2 * B)) =>
      integrable_exp_mul_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two X K hX hind hK hpsi B hKB s hs
    have hloc := fun s (hs : |s| ≤ 1 / (2 * B)) =>
      mgf_sum_le_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two X K hX hind hK hmean hpsi B hKB s hs
    have hdom : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * 16 * (B / 16))⁻¹ → |l| ≤ 1 / (2 * B) := by
      intro l hl
      convert hl using 1
      field_simp
    have htail := measureReal_abs_ge_le_two_mul_exp_of_cgf_le
      (Y := fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) (C := 16) (v := V) (b := B / 16)
      (by norm_num) hV (by positivity)
      (fun l hl => by
        calc cgf (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) μ l
            ≤ Real.log (Real.exp (16 * V * l ^ 2)) :=
              Real.log_le_log (mgf_pos (hint l (hdom l hl))) (hloc l (hdom l hl))
          _ = 16 * l ^ 2 * V := by rw [Real.log_exp]; ring)
      (fun l hl => hint l (hdom l hl)) ht
    refine htail.trans ?_
    gcongr 2 * Real.exp ?_
    have hmin : min (t ^ 2 / V) (t / B) ≤ min (t ^ 2 / V) (t / (B / 16)) := by
      refine min_le_min le_rfl ?_
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hB.le
    have h64 : (1 : ℝ) / (4 * 16) = 1 / 64 := by norm_num
    rw [h64]
    nlinarith [hmin]

name: NLAlib.bernstein_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two_uniform
statement:
theorem bernstein_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two_uniform
    {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (|X i ω| / K)) ∂μ ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |∑ i, X i ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(1 / 64 : ℝ) * min (t ^ 2 / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * K ^ 2)) (t / K))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] using
    bernstein_sum_of_lintegral_exp_abs_le_two X (fun _ => K) hX hind
      (fun _ => hK) hmean hpsi K hK (fun _ => le_rfl) t ht

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ) -
        ∫ y, specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) ζ) ∂gaussianVector ι)
      ⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) ^ 2 = σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 := by ring
  simpa only [one_mul, he] using hasSubgaussianMGF_of_logSobolev
    hasEuclideanLogSobolev_gaussianVector
    (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ))
    (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) (by positivity)
    (abs_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy D hD A hA hσ henergy ζ hζ)

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_variance
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_variance
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun x : ι → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector ι] ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ) -
        ∫ y, specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) ζ) ∂gaussianVector ι)
      ⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy
    D hD A hA hσ _ ζ hζ
  simpa only [variance_re_quadForm_gaussianSeries] using hvariance

name: NLAlib.integral_matrixExp_smul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_matrixExp_smul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : HasLaw g (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, matrixExp ((θ * g ω) • A) ∂μ) = matrixExp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) • A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_of_hasSubgaussianMGF A hA
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal hg) θ, matrixExp_smul_sq_eq_cfc A hA]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [mgf_gaussianReal hg.map_eq]
  congr 1
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one]
  ring

name: NLAlib.matrixLog_integral_matrixExp_smul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem matrixLog_integral_matrixExp_smul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (A : Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : HasLaw g (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp ((θ * g ω) • A) ∂μ) = (θ ^ 2 / 2) • A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_matrixExp_smul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal A hA hg θ]
  exact CFC.log_exp _ (IsSelfAdjoint.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))
    (hA.isSelfAdjoint.pow 2))

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_pi_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_pi_le
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R v η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η)
        ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) ∧
      (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) ≤
        (2 / η ^ 4) * (8 * v + 64 * R *
          ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
        (32 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6) * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) *
          specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i) + R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let Y (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) := Z i (x i)
  let D (q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) (i : ι) := Y i q.1 - Y i q.2
  have hYm (i : ι) : Measurable (Y i) := (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hYH (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (Y i x).IsHermitian :=
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZH i)
  have hYB (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, specNorm (Y i x) ≤ R :=
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ i)
  have hDH : ∀ᵐ q ∂μ.prod μ, ∀ i, (D q i).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae (ae_all_iff.mpr hYH),
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae (ae_all_iff.mpr hYH)] with q h₁ h₂
    exact fun i => (h₁ i).sub (h₂ i)
  have hBC := integrable_and_integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_le μ Y hYm hR hYB
  have hGC := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sub_sq_prod_le μ Y hYm hR hYH hYB
  have hgram : (fun q => specNorm (∑ i, (D q i)ᴴ * D q i)) =ᵐ[μ.prod μ]
      (fun q => specNorm (∑ i, D q i ^ 2)) := by
    filter_upwards [hDH] with q hq
    simp only [(hq _).eq, pow_two]
  have hGi : Integrable (fun q => specNorm (∑ i, (D q i)ᴴ * D q i)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hGC.1.congr hgram.symm
  have hWi : Integrable (fun q => resolventVarianceProxy (D q) Finset.univ R η) (μ.prod μ) := by
    convert (hBC.1.const_mul (2 / η ^ 4)).add (hGi.const_mul (8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6)) using 1 <;>
      rfl
  refine ⟨hWi, ?_⟩
  have hSquare := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff μ Y hR hYm
    (iIndepFun_pi fun i => (hZm i).aemeasurable) hYH hYB
  have hSecond : (∑ i, ∫ x, Y i x ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Z i ω ^ 2) (ν i) := by
      simpa only [pow_two] using ((hZm i).matrix_mul (hZm i)).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw.integral_comp hm
  rw [hSecond] at hSquare
  have hBbound := integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_pi_le ν Z hZm hR hZ hmean hvariance
  have hGbound : (∫ q, specNorm (∑ i, (D q i)ᴴ * D q i) ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
      4 * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
        R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n)) := by
    rw [integral_congr_ae hgram]
    exact hGC.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSquare.2 (by norm_num))
  change (∫ q, resolventVarianceProxy (D q) Finset.univ R η ∂μ.prod μ) ≤ _
  simp only [resolventVarianceProxy, matrixVarianceProxy]
  rw [integral_add (hBC.1.const_mul _) (hGi.const_mul _), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 / η ^ 4) * (8 * v + 64 * R *
          ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂μ) +
        (8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6) * (4 * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) *
          specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i) + R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n))) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBbound (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGbound (by positivity))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_and_measureReal_specNorm_sum_le_bernstein_hermitian
statement:
theorem integral_and_measureReal_specNorm_sum_le_bernstein_hermitian
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun Z μ)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂μ = 0) :
    ((∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂μ)*Real.log (2*Fintype.card n)) +
        R*Real.log (2*Fintype.card n)/3) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → μ.real {ω | t ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω)} ≤
      bernsteinTail (2*Fintype.card n) (specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂μ)) R t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : NeZero (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let f := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  let E : Matrix n n ℂ ≃ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
    Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℝ ℂ e e
  let Y : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
    fun k ω => E (Z (f k) ω)
  have hEMeas : Measurable E := E.toContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous.measurable
  have hYm : ∀ k, Measurable (Y k) := fun k => hEMeas.comp (hZm (f k))
  have hYind : iIndepFun Y μ := (iIndepFun.precomp f.injective hIndep).comp
    (fun _ => E) (fun _ => hEMeas)
  have hYbound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Y k ω) ≤ R := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hZ (f k)] with ω hω
    change specNorm ((Z (f k) ω).reindex e e) ≤ R
    rwa [specNorm_reindex]
  have hYmean : ∀ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro k
    rw [show (∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ) = E (∫ ω, Z (f k) ω ∂μ) from
      integral_reindex μ e (Z (f k)), hmean, map_zero]
  have hsum (ω : Ω) : (∑ k, Y k ω) = E (∑ i, Z i ω) := by
    change (∑ k, E (Z (f k) ω)) = _
    rw [← map_sum]
    exact congrArg E (f.sum_comp (fun i => Z i ω))
  have hnorm (ω : Ω) : specNorm (∑ k, Y k ω) = specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω) := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact specNorm_reindex _ e e
  have hprod (k : Fin (Fintype.card ι)) :
      (∫ ω, Y k ω * (Y k ω)ᴴ ∂μ) = E (∫ ω, Z (f k) ω^2 ∂μ) ∧
      (∫ ω, (Y k ω)ᴴ * Y k ω ∂μ) = E (∫ ω, Z (f k) ω^2 ∂μ) := by
    have hp : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y k ω * (Y k ω)ᴴ = E (Z (f k) ω^2) ∧
        (Y k ω)ᴴ * Y k ω = E (Z (f k) ω^2) := by
      filter_upwards [hZH (f k)] with ω hω
      have hH : (Y k ω).IsHermitian := hω.submatrix e.symm
      have he : E (Z (f k) ω^2) = (Y k ω)^2 :=
        (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ e).map_pow _ 2
      rw [he, pow_two, hH.eq]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(integral_congr_ae (hp.mono fun _ h => h.1)).trans
        (integral_reindex μ e (fun ω => Z (f k) ω^2)),
      (integral_congr_ae (hp.mono fun _ h => h.2)).trans
        (integral_reindex μ e (fun ω => Z (f k) ω^2))⟩
  have hvar :
      (∑ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω*(Y k ω)ᴴ ∂μ) = E (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂μ) ∧
      (∑ k, ∫ ω, (Y k ω)ᴴ*Y k ω ∂μ) = E (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂μ) := by
    have he : (∑ k, E (∫ ω, Z (f k) ω^2 ∂μ)) = E (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂μ) := by
      rw [← map_sum]
      exact congrArg E (f.sum_comp (fun i => ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂μ))
    exact ⟨(Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => (hprod k).1).trans he,
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => (hprod k).2).trans he⟩
  have he := integral_specNorm_sum_le_of_specNorm_le μ Y hR hYm hYind hYmean hYbound
  simp only [hvar.1, hvar.2, show ∀ A : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm (E A) = specNorm A from
    fun A => specNorm_reindex A e e, max_self, hnorm] at he
  constructor
  · simpa only [two_mul, Nat.cast_add] using he
  · intro t hpos
    have ht := measureReal_specNorm_sum_ge_le_bernsteinTail μ Y hR hYm hYind hYmean hYbound hpos
    simpa only [hvar.1, hvar.2, show ∀ A : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm (E A) = specNorm A from
      fun A => specNorm_reindex A e e, max_self, hnorm, two_mul] using ht

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_sum_pi_le_two_mul_sqrt_add_of_log_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_sum_pi_le_two_mul_sqrt_add_of_log_le
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R σ p : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card n) (hlog : Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤ p)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i) ≤ σ^2) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      2*σ*Real.sqrt p + R*p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Y (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) := Z i (x i)
  have hYm : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i) := fun i => (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hYH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, (Y i x).IsHermitian := fun i =>
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZH i)
  have hYB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, specNorm (Y i x) ≤ R := fun i =>
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ i)
  have hYmean : ∀ i, ∫ x, Y i x ∂Measure.pi ν = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [show (∫ x, Y i x ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i from
      integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := i) (hZm i).aestronglyMeasurable, hmean]
  have hYsq : (∑ i, ∫ x, Y i x^2 ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simpa only [Y, pow_two] using integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := i)
      ((hZm i).matrix_mul (hZm i)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have he := (integral_and_measureReal_specNorm_sum_le_bernstein_hermitian
    (Measure.pi ν) Y hR hYm (iIndepFun_pi fun i => (hZm i).aemeasurable)
      hYH hYB hYmean).1
  rw [hYsq] at he
  have hdR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card n := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card n := by positivity
  have hlog2 : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card n) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hdR
  have hlogsum : Real.log (2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤ 2*p := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hdpos.ne']
    linarith
  have hlognonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have harg : 2*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i)*Real.log (2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)) ≤
      2*σ^2*(2*p) := mul_le_mul
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvariance (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) hlogsum
      hlognonneg (by positivity)
  have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt harg
  have hsqrteq : Real.sqrt (2*σ^2*(2*p)) = 2*σ*Real.sqrt p := by
    rw [show 2*σ^2*(2*p) = (2*σ)^2*p by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  rw [hsqrteq] at hsqrt
  have hlin : R*Real.log (2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ))/3 ≤ R*p := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogsum hR
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ R*p := mul_nonneg hR hp
    linarith
  exact he.trans (add_le_add hsqrt hlin)

name: NLAlib.gaussianTraceInflation_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem gaussianTraceInflation_zero_right (R : ℝ) :
    gaussianTraceInflation R 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [gaussianTraceInflation]

name: NLAlib.gaussianTraceInflation_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem gaussianTraceInflation_zero_left (θ : ℝ) :
    gaussianTraceInflation 0 θ = θ
proof: := by norm_num [gaussianTraceInflation]

name: NLAlib.gaussianTraceInflation_sq_div_two
statement:
theorem gaussianTraceInflation_sq_div_two (R θ : ℝ) :
    gaussianTraceInflation R θ ^ 2 / 2 =
      θ ^ 2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient (θ * R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianTraceInflation, mul_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (expSecondRemainderCoefficient_nonneg _))]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianTraceInflation_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianTraceInflation_nonneg (R : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    0 ≤ gaussianTraceInflation R θ
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg hθ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.le_gaussianTraceInflation
statement:
theorem le_gaussianTraceInflation {R θ : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    θ ≤ gaussianTraceInflation R θ
proof:
:= by
  have hc := one_half_le_expSecondRemainderCoefficient (mul_nonneg hθ hR)
  have hs : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient (θ * R)) := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show
      1 ≤ 2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient (θ * R) by linarith)
  simpa only [mul_one, gaussianTraceInflation] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hθ

name: NLAlib.gaussianTraceInflation_sq_le_div
statement:
theorem gaussianTraceInflation_sq_le_div {R θ : ℝ} (hθR : θ * R < 3) :
    gaussianTraceInflation R θ ^ 2 ≤ θ ^ 2 / (1 - θ * R / 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (expSecondRemainderCoefficient_le_div hθR) (sq_nonneg θ)
  have heq := gaussianTraceInflation_sq_div_two R θ
  calc
    _ = 2 * (θ ^ 2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient (θ * R)) := by linarith
    _ ≤ 2 * (θ ^ 2 * ((1 / 2) / (1 - θ * R / 3))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianTraceInflation_sub_le_div
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < 1 - θ * R / 3 := by linarith
  have hB : 0 ≤ θ + R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * (1 - θ * R / 3)) := by positivity
  have hid : (θ + R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * (1 - θ * R / 3))) ^ 2 =
      θ ^ 2 / (1 - θ * R / 3) +
        (R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * (1 - θ * R / 3))) ^ 2 := by
    let d := 1 - θ * R / 3
    change (θ + R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * d)) ^ 2 = θ ^ 2 / d + (R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * d)) ^ 2
    field_simp [show d ≠ 0 from hd.ne']
    dsimp [d]
    ring
  have hsq : θ ^ 2 / (1 - θ * R / 3) ≤
      (θ + R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * (1 - θ * R / 3))) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hid]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
  have hg := gaussianTraceInflation_sq_le_div hθR
  have hg0 := gaussianTraceInflation_nonneg R hθ
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_quadratic_variance
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_quadratic_variance
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun Z => specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ)
      ⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hrep⟩ := exists_hermitian_gaussian_series_representation γ hmean hHerm
  let J := (n × n) ⊕ (n × n)
  let S : (J → ℝ) → M := fun x => ∑ i, x i • A i
  have hSm : Measurable S := by fun_prop
  have hid : IdentDistrib S (id : M → M) (gaussianVector J) γ :=
    ⟨hSm.aemeasurable, aemeasurable_id, by simpa only [Measure.map_id] using hrep.symm⟩
  have hvarianceS : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun x : J → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector J] ≤ σ ^ 2 := by
    intro u hu
    have hq : Measurable (fun Z : M => (quadForm Z u).re) := by
      simp only [quadForm, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
      fun_prop
    have he := (hid.comp hq).variance_eq
    have he' : Var[fun x : J → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector J] =
        Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, S] using he
    exact he'.trans_le (hvariance u hu)
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_affineSeries_of_quadratic_variance
    D hD A hA hσ hvarianceS ζ hζ
  have ho : Measurable (fun Z : M => specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ)) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Function.comp_def, Pi.add_apply, id_eq] using
