      ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp (measurable_const.add measurable_id)).norm
  have hobs := hid.comp ho
  simp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, S] at hobs
  have hmeanobs : (∫ x : J → ℝ, specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ) ∂gaussianVector J) =
      ∫ Z, specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) ∂γ := hobs.integral_eq
  have hcenter := hobs.sub_const (∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ)
  have hsg' : HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x : J → ℝ => specNorm (resolvent (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ζ) -
        ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ)
      ⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ (gaussianVector J) := by
    rw [← hmeanobs]
    exact hsg
  exact hsg'.congr_identDistrib hcenter

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_bilinear_second_moment
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_bilinear_second_moment
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂γ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun Z => specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ)
      ⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ γ
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_quadratic_variance
    γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ _ ζ hζ
  intro u hu
  have hq : Measurable (fun Z : M => (quadForm Z u).re) := by
    exact Complex.measurable_re.comp (quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).continuous.measurable
  have heq : (∫ Z : M, (quadForm Z u).re ^ 2 ∂γ) =
      ∫ Z : M, ‖star u ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ u)‖ ^ 2 ∂γ := by
    apply integral_congr_ae (hHerm.mono fun Z hZ => ?_)
    change (quadForm Z u).re ^ 2 = ‖quadForm Z u‖ ^ 2
    have he := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖ ^ 2) (hZ.ofReal_re_quadForm u)
    change ‖(((quadForm Z u).re : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = ‖quadForm Z u‖ ^ 2 at he
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, _root_.sq_abs] at he
    exact he
  exact (variance_le_expectation_sq hq.aestronglyMeasurable).trans
    (heq.trans_le (hbilinear u u hu hu))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_abs_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_sub_mean_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_abs_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_sub_mean_le
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂γ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    γ.real {Z | (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
      |specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_bilinear_second_moment
    γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hbilinear ζ hζ
  by_cases hσ0 : σ = 0
  · have hzero : (fun Z => specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) -
        ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ) =ᵐ[γ] (0 : M → ℝ) := by
      have hc : (⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ : NNReal) = 0 := by
        apply NNReal.coe_eq_zero.mp
        change σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 = 0
        simp only [hσ0, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_mul]
      rw [hc] at hsg
      exact hsg.ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
    have he : {Z : M | (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
        |specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ|} =ᵐ[γ]
          (∅ : Set M) := by
      filter_upwards [hzero] with Z hZ
      change specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ = 0 at hZ
      apply propext
      change ((σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
        |specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ| ↔ False)
      simp only [hσ0, zero_mul, hZ, abs_zero, lt_self_iff_false]
    rw [measureReal_congr he]
    simp only [measureReal_empty]
    positivity
  · have hη : |ζ.im| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr hζ
    have hb := measureReal_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF hsg
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) ht)
    have he : -((σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4)) = -t ^ 2 / 2 := by
      field_simp [hσ0, hη]
    change γ.real {Z | (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
      |specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-((σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t) ^ 2 /
          (2 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4))) at hb
    rw [he] at hb
    exact hb

name: NLAlib.matrix_bernstein_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.matrix_bernstein_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n N : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (S : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L) :
    let Z
proof:
:= fun ω => ∑ k, S k ω
    let v := rectSecondMoment μ Z
    v = max (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ))
      (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ)) ∧
    (∫ ω, specNorm (Z ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * v * Real.log (m + n)) + L * Real.log (m + n) / 3 ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → μ.real {ω | t ≤ specNorm (Z ω)} ≤
      bernsteinTail (m + n) v L t := by
  intro Z v
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm] at hBound
  
  have hSL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (S k) 2 μ := fun k =>
    MemLp.of_bound (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable L (hBound k)
  have hSint : ∀ k, Integrable (S k) μ := fun k => (hSL2 k).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hSL2h : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => (S k ω).conjTranspose) 2 μ := by
    intro k
    refine MemLp.of_bound ((measurable_ct m n).comp (hMeas k)).aestronglyMeasurable L ?_
    filter_upwards [hBound k] with ω hω
    rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose]
    exact hω
  have hSmeanh : ∀ k, (∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) = 0 := by
    intro k
    rw [integral_ct μ (S k) (hSint k), hMean k, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero]
  
  have hZh : ∀ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose = ∑ k, (S k ω).conjTranspose := by
    intro ω
    simp only [Z, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
  have hZZ : ∫ ω, Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose ∂μ =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ := by
    simp_rw [hZh]
    exact integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ S id Matrix.conjTranspose measurable_id
      (measurable_ct m n) hMeas hIndep hSL2 hSL2h hMean
  have hZhZ : ∫ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω ∂μ =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ := by
    simp_rw [hZh]
    exact integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ S Matrix.conjTranspose id
      (measurable_ct m n) measurable_id hMeas hIndep hSL2h hSL2 hSmeanh
  have hv1 : v = max (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ))
      (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ)) := by
    show max (specNorm (∫ ω, Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose ∂μ))
      (specNorm (∫ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω ∂μ)) = _
    rw [hZZ, hZhZ]
  
  have hZint : ∫ ω, Z ω ∂μ = 0 := by
    simp only [Z]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hSint k)]
    simp [hMean]
  have hZmeas : Measurable Z := Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)
  have hZL2 : MemLp Z 2 μ := memLp_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hSL2 k)
  have hdv := hermitianSecondMoment_dilation_eq_rectSecondMoment μ Z hZL2
  rw [hZint] at hdv
  simp only [sub_zero] at hdv
  
  have : NeZero (m + n) := ⟨by have := NeZero.ne m; omega⟩
  let X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin (m + n)) (Fin (m + n)) ℂ :=
    fun k ω => phiLin m n (S k ω)
  have hXmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k) := fun k => (measurable_phiLin m n).comp (hMeas k)
  have hXherm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian := fun k =>
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => (dilation_identities (S k ω)).1.submatrix _)
  have hXL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ := by
    intro k
    refine MemLp.of_bound (hXmeas k).aestronglyMeasurable L ?_
    filter_upwards [hBound k] with ω hω
    simp only [X]
    rw [norm_phiLin]
    exact hω
  have hXindep : iIndepFun X μ :=
    hIndep.comp (fun _ => phiLin m n) (fun _ => measurable_phiLin m n)
  have hXmean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0 := by
    intro k
    simp only [X]
    rw [integral_phiLin μ (S k) (hSint k), hMean k, map_zero]
  have hXbound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hBound k] with ω hω
    simp only [X]
    rw [lambdaMax_phiLin]
    exact hω
  have hY : ∀ ω, ∑ k, phiLin m n (S k ω) = phiLin m n (Z ω) := by
    intro ω
    simp only [Z, map_sum]
  have hlam : ∀ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, phiLin m n (S k ω)) = specNorm (Z ω) := by
    intro ω
    rw [hY ω, lambdaMax_phiLin, specNorm_eq_norm]
  have hvY : hermitianSecondMoment μ (fun ω => ∑ k, phiLin m n (S k ω)) = v := by
    have hsq : ∀ ω, (phiLin m n (Z ω)) ^ 2 =
        Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (dilation (Z ω) ^ 2) := by
      intro ω
      rw [phiLin_apply, ← Matrix.coe_reindexAlgEquiv ℝ, map_pow]
    unfold hermitianSecondMoment
    simp_rw [hY, hsq]
    rw [integral_reindex, specNorm_reindex]
    exact hdv
  have hvX : specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = v := by
    rw [← hermitianSecondMoment_sum_eq μ X hXmeas hXL2 hXindep hXmean]
    exact hvY
  have H2 := integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_of_lambdaMax_le μ X hL hXmeas hXherm hXL2 hXindep hXmean
    hXbound
  refine ⟨hv1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [X, hlam] at H2
    rw [hvX] at H2
    simpa [Nat.cast_add] using H2
  · intro t ht
    have := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_bernsteinTail μ X hL hXmeas hXherm hXL2 hXindep hXmean
      hXbound ht
    simp only [X, hlam] at this
    rwa [hvX] at this

name: NLAlib.rectSecondMoment_sum_eq
statement:
theorem rectSecondMoment_sum_eq {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ) (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L) :
    rectSecondMoment μ (fun ω => ∑ k, S k ω) =
      max (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ))
        (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ))
proof:
:=
  (matrix_bernstein_package μ S L hL hMeas hIndep hMean hBound).1

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_sum_le_of_specNorm_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_sum_le_of_specNorm_le {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * max (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ))
        (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ)) * Real.log (m + n)) +
        L * Real.log (m + n) / 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv, hE, -⟩ := matrix_bernstein_package μ S L hL hMeas hIndep hMean hBound
  rwa [hv] at hE

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_sum_ge_le_bernsteinTail
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_sum_ge_le_bernsteinTail {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ specNorm (∑ k, S k ω)} ≤
      bernsteinTail (m + n) (max (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ))
        (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ))) L t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv, -, hT⟩ := matrix_bernstein_package μ S L hL hMeas hIndep hMean hBound
  have := hT t ht
  rwa [hv] at this

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_matrixLog
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_matrixLog {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (X : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hMeas : Measurable X) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (H + X ω) ∂μ) ≤
      traceExp (H + matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (X ω) ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (matrixExp (X ω)).PosDef :=
    hHerm.mono fun ω hω => (posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp (X ω) hω).1
  have hm := posDef_integral_of_ae_posDef μ (fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) hExp hp
  have heq : (fun ω => traceExp (H + matrixLog (matrixExp (X ω)))) =ᵐ[μ]
      (fun ω => traceExp (H + X ω)) :=
    hHerm.mono fun ω hω => by dsimp only; rw [(posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp (X ω) hω).2]
  have hi := (integrable_matrixExp_add_and_traceExp_add μ H hH X hMeas hHerm hExp).2
  rw [← integral_congr_ae heq]
  exact ConcaveOn.le_map_integral_of_integral_mem μ _ _ _ (lieb_concavity H hH)
    (continuousOn_traceExp_add_matrixLog H) hp hExp (hi.congr heq.symm) hm

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_lambdaMax_sub_and_integral_le_of_trace_comparison
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_lambdaMax_sub_and_integral_le_of_trace_comparison
    (Y : Ω → M) (hY : AEMeasurable Y P) (hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2)
    {R θ : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθR : θ * R < 3)
    (htrace : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • (Y ω + D))) P)
    (hcomparison : (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • (Y ω + D)) ∂P) ≤
      ∫ Z, traceExp (θ • D + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z) ∂γ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax (Y ω + D) -
      ∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ))) P ∧
    (∫ ω, Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax (Y ω + D) -
      ∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ)) ∂P) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp
        ((σ ^ 2 + R * (∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ) / 3) * θ ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (R / 3) * θ)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ with hzero | hpos
  · rw [← hzero]
    constructor
    · simpa only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero] using (integrable_const (1 : ℝ) : Integrable _ P)
    · simp only [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul,
        zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero, zero_div, mul_one]
      exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := n)
  let m : ℝ := ∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ
  let φ : ℝ := ∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ
  let g : ℝ := gaussianTraceInflation R θ
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => lambdaMax (Y ω + D)) P := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using aemeasurable_lambdaMax_add_of_ae_isHermitian D hD hY hYHerm
  have hedom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P,
      Real.exp (θ * lambdaMax (Y ω + D)) ≤ traceExp (θ • (Y ω + D)) :=
    hYHerm.mono fun ω hω =>
      (exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ (hω.add hD) θ).2.1 hpos
  have hexp : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ * lambdaMax (Y ω + D))) P := by
    apply htrace.mono' (Real.measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable (hm.const_mul θ)).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [hedom] with ω hω
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using hω
  have hecenter (ω : Ω) : Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax (Y ω + D) - m)) =
      Real.exp (-θ * m) * Real.exp (θ * lambdaMax (Y ω + D)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hcenter : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax (Y ω + D) - m))) P := by
    simp_rw [hecenter]
    exact hexp.const_mul _
  refine ⟨hcenter, ?_⟩
  have hφ : 0 ≤ φ := integral_lambdaMax_gaussian_nonneg γ hHerm hmean hσ hvariance
  have hscale := integral_lambdaMax_smul_add_smul_gaussian_le γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance
    hθ (le_gaussianTraceInflation hR hθ)
  have hgauss := integral_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian_le_exp_mean γ (θ • D)
    (hD.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)) hHerm hmean hσ hvariance g
  have hraw := (integral_mono_ae hexp htrace hedom).trans (hcomparison.trans hgauss)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - θ * R / 3 := by linarith
  have hdiff := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussianTraceInflation_sub_le_div hR hθ hθR) hφ
  have hsq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussianTraceInflation_sq_le_div hθR) (sq_nonneg σ)
  have he : (∫ Z, lambdaMax (θ • D + g • Z) ∂γ) + g ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2 - θ * m ≤
      (σ ^ 2 + R * φ / 3) * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - (R / 3) * θ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (g - θ) * φ + g ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2 := by
        change (∫ Z, lambdaMax (θ • D + g • Z) ∂γ) ≤ θ * m + (g - θ) * φ at hscale
        linarith
      _ ≤ (R * θ ^ 2 / (6 * (1 - θ * R / 3))) * φ +
          (θ ^ 2 / (1 - θ * R / 3)) * σ ^ 2 / 2 := by
        change (g - θ) * φ ≤ _ at hdiff
        change g ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 ≤ _ at hsq
        linarith
      _ = _ := by
        have hden' : 1 - (R / 3) * θ = 1 - θ * R / 3 := by ring
        rw [hden']
        field_simp [hden.ne']
        ring
  change (∫ ω, Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax (Y ω + D) - m)) ∂P) ≤ _
  simp_rw [hecenter]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * m) * ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
        Real.exp ((∫ Z, lambdaMax (θ • D + g • Z) ∂γ) + g ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hraw (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp
        ((∫ Z, lambdaMax (θ • D + g • Z) ∂γ) + g ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2 - θ * m) := by
      rw [mul_left_comm, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr he) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.exists_isGaussian_integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem exists_isGaussian_integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_of_hasLaw
    {N : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (W : Fin N → Ω → M) (ν : Fin N → Measure M)
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) (ν i) P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ H, H ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H ≤ R • (1 : M)) :
    ∃ γ : Measure M, IsGaussian γ ∧ (∫ H, H ∂γ) = 0 ∧
      (∀ᵐ H ∂γ, H.IsHermitian) ∧
      (∀ a b, cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, W i ω) a,
        fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, W i ω) b; P] =
          cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; γ]) ∧
      ∀ D : M, D.IsHermitian →
        (∫ ω, lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) ∂P) ≤
            (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
              Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * Real.log (Fintype.card n)) +
              (R / 3) * Real.log (Fintype.card n) ∧
        (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → P.real {ω |
            (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
              (R / 3) * s < lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D)} ≤
                (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s)) ∧
        (0 < R → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → P.real {ω |
            (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
              (R / 3) * s ≤ lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D)} ≤
                (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s))
proof:
:= by
  let (i : Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) :=
    (hW i).isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mp inferInstance
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγmean, hγHerm, hγcov⟩ :=
    exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq_sum ν hν2 hνmean hνHerm
  let : IsGaussian γ := hγ
  refine ⟨γ, hγ, hγmean, hγHerm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b
    exact (covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum_of_hasLaw W ν hW hind hν2 a b).trans
      (hγcov a b)
  · intro D hD
    exact integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy_of_hasLaw
      W ν hW hind hν2 hνmean hνHerm hR hbound γ hγHerm hγmean hγcov D hD

name: NLAlib.trace_re_eq_sum
statement:
private lemma trace_re_eq_sum (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (Matrix.trace A).re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i
proof:
:= by

  simp

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_zero
statement: private lemma lambdaMax_zero [NeZero d] : lambdaMax (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMax, spectrum.zero_eq, csSup_singleton]

name: NLAlib.neg_posSemidef
statement:
private lemma neg_posSemidef (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hb : lambdaMax A ≤ 0) : (-A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A ≤ cfc (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) A :=
    cfc_mono (fun x hx => le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le A hA hb x hx)
  rw [cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isSelfAdjoint, cfc_const_zero] at h1
  simpa using Matrix.le_iff.mp h1

name: NLAlib.trace_re_integrable
proof:
:=
  Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp
    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hZ)

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_re
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm
    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hZ)
  have h2 := (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm hZ
